entries.yo: Ní atetekọṣe Ọlọrun dá ọrun ati aiye.
entries.en: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.

entries.yo: Aiye si wà ni jũju, o si ṣofo; òkunkun si wà loju ibú: Ẹmi Ọlọrun si nràbaba loju omi.
entries.en: And the earth was without form, and void; and darkness was upon the face of the deep. And the Spirit of God moved upon the face of the waters.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si wipe, Ki imọlẹ ki o wà: imọlẹ si wà.
entries.en: And God said, Let there be light: and there was light.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si ri imọlẹ na, pe o dara: Ọlọrun si pàla si agbedemeji imọlẹ ati òkunkun.
entries.en: And God saw the light, that it was good: and God divided the light from the darkness.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si pè imọlẹ ni Ọsán, ati òkunkun ni Oru. Ati aṣalẹ ati owurọ̀ o di ọjọ́ kini.
entries.en: And God called the light Day, and the darkness he called Night. And the evening and the morning were the first day.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si wipe, Ki ofurufu ki o wà li agbedemeji omi, ki o si yà omi kuro lara omi.
entries.en: And God said, Let there be a firmament in the midst of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si ṣe ofurufu, o si yà omi ti o wà nisalẹ ofurufu kuro lara omi ti o wà loke ofurufu: o si ri bẹ̃.
entries.en: And God made the firmament, and divided the waters which were under the firmament from the waters which were above the firmament: and it was so.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si pè ofurufu ni Ọrun. Ati aṣalẹ ati owurọ̀ o di ọjọ́ keji.
entries.en: And God called the firmament Heaven. And the evening and the morning were the second day.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si wipe, Ki omi abẹ ọrun ki o wọjọ pọ̀ si ibi kan, ki iyangbẹ ilẹ ki o si hàn: o si ri bẹ̃.
entries.en: And God said, Let the waters under the heaven be gathered together unto one place, and let the dry land appear: and it was so.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si pè iyangbẹ ilẹ ni Ilẹ; o si pè iwọjọpọ̀ omi ni Okun: Ọlọrun si ri pe o dara.
entries.en: And God called the dry land Earth; and the gathering together of the waters called he Seas: and God saw that it was good.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si wipe, Ki ilẹ ki o hù oko, eweko ti yio ma so eso, ati igi eleso ti yio ma so eso ni irú tirẹ̀, ti o ni irugbin ninu lori ilẹ: o si ri bẹ̃.
entries.en: And God said, Let the earth bring forth grass, the herb yielding seed, and the fruit tree yielding fruit after his kind, whose seed is in itself, upon the earth: and it was so.

entries.yo: Ilẹ si sú koriko jade, eweko ti nso eso ni irú tirẹ̀, ati igi ti nso eso, ti o ni irugbin ninu ni irú tirẹ̀: Ọlọrun si ri pe o dara.
entries.en: And the earth brought forth grass, and herb yielding seed after his kind, and the tree yielding fruit, whose seed was in itself, after his kind: and God saw that it was good.

entries.yo: Ati aṣalẹ ati owurọ̀ o di ọjọ́ kẹta.
entries.en: And the evening and the morning were the third day.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si wipe, Ki awọn imọlẹ ki o wà li ofurufu ọrun, lati pàla ọsán on oru; ki nwọn ki o si ma wà fun àmi, ati fun akoko, ati fun ọjọ́, ati fun ọdún:
entries.en: And God said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years:

entries.yo: Ki nwọn ki o si jẹ́ imọlẹ li ofurufu ọrun, lati mọlẹ sori ilẹ: o si ri bẹ̃.
entries.en: And let them be for lights in the firmament of the heaven to give light upon the earth: and it was so.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si dá imọlẹ nla meji; imọlẹ ti o tobi lati ṣe akoso ọsán, ati imọlẹ ti o kere lati ṣe akoso oru: o si dá awọn irawọ pẹlu.
entries.en: And God made two great lights; the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night: he made the stars also.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si sọ wọn lọjọ̀ li ofurufu ọrun, lati ma tàn imọlẹ sori ilẹ,
entries.en: And God set them in the firmament of the heaven to give light upon the earth,

entries.yo: Ati lati ṣe akoso ọsán ati akoso oru, ati lati pàla imọlẹ on òkunkun: Ọlọrun si ri pe o dara.
entries.en: And to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness: and God saw that it was good.

entries.yo: Ati aṣalẹ ati owurọ̀ o di ọjọ́ kẹrin.
entries.en: And the evening and the morning were the fourth day.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si wipe, Ki omi ki o kún fun ọ̀pọlọpọ ẹdá alãye ti nrakò, ati ki ẹiyẹ ki o ma fò loke ilẹ li oju-ofurufu ọrun.
entries.en: And God said, Let the waters bring forth abundantly the moving creature that hath life, and fowl that may fly above the earth in the open firmament of heaven.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si dá erinmi nlanla ati ẹdá alãye gbogbo ti nrakò, ti omi kún fun li ọ̀pọlọpọ ni irú wọn, ati ẹiyẹ abiyẹ ni irú rẹ̀: Ọlọrun si ri pe o dara.
entries.en: And God created great whales, and every living creature that moveth, which the waters brought forth abundantly, after their kind, and every winged fowl after his kind: and God saw that it was good.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si súre fun wọn pe, Ẹ ma bi si i, ẹ si mã rẹ̀, ki ẹ kún inu omi li okun, ki ẹiyẹ ki o si ma rẹ̀ ni ilẹ.
entries.en: And God blessed them, saying, Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let fowl multiply in the earth.

entries.yo: Ati aṣalẹ ati owurọ̀ o di ọjọ́ karun.
entries.en: And the evening and the morning were the fifth day.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si wipe, Ki ilẹ ki o mu ẹdá alãye ni irú rẹ̀ jade wá, ẹran-ọ̀sin, ati ohun ti nrakò, ati ẹranko ilẹ ni irú rẹ̀: o si ri bẹ̃.
entries.en: And God said, Let the earth bring forth the living creature after his kind, cattle, and creeping thing, and beast of the earth after his kind: and it was so.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si dá ẹranko ilẹ ni irú tirẹ̀, ati ẹran-ọ̀sin ni irú tirẹ̀, ati ohun gbogbo ti nrakò lori ilẹ ni irú tirẹ̀: Ọlọrun si ri pe o dara.
entries.en: And God made the beast of the earth after his kind, and cattle after their kind, and every thing that creepeth upon the earth after his kind: and God saw that it was good.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si wipe, Jẹ ki a dá enia li aworan wa, gẹgẹ bi irí wa: ki nwọn ki o si jọba lori ẹja okun, ati lori ẹiyẹ oju-ọrun, ati lori ẹranko, ati lori gbogbo ilẹ, ati lori ohun gbogbo ti nrakò lori ilẹ.
entries.en: And God said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness: and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over the cattle, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li Ọlọrun dá enia li aworan rẹ̀, li aworan Ọlọrun li o dá a; ati akọ ati abo li o dá wọn.
entries.en: So God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si súre fun wọn. Ọlọrun si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ ma bi si i, ki ẹ si ma rẹ̀, ki ẹ si gbilẹ, ki ẹ si ṣe ikawọ rẹ̀; ki ẹ si ma jọba lori ẹja okun, ati lori ẹiyẹ oju-ọrun, ati lori ohun alãye gbogbo ti nrakò lori ilẹ.
entries.en: And God blessed them, and God said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth, and subdue it: and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over every living thing that moveth upon the earth.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si wipe, kiye si i, Mo fi eweko gbogbo ti o wà lori ilẹ gbogbo ti nso eso fun nyin, ati igi gbogbo ninu eyiti iṣe igi eleso ti nso; ẹnyin ni yio ma ṣe onjẹ fun.
entries.en: And God said, Behold, I have given you every herb bearing seed, which is upon the face of all the earth, and every tree, in the which is the fruit of a tree yielding seed; to you it shall be for meat.

entries.yo: Ati fun gbogbo ẹranko ilẹ, ati fun gbogbo ẹiyẹ oju-ọrun, ati fun ohun gbogbo ti o nrakò lori ilẹ, ti iṣe alaye, ni mo fi eweko tutu gbogbo fun li onjẹ: o si ri bẹ̃.
entries.en: And to every beast of the earth, and to every fowl of the air, and to every thing that creepeth upon the earth, wherein there is life, I have given every green herb for meat: and it was so.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si ri ohun gbogbo ti o dá, si kiyesi i, daradara ni. Ati aṣalẹ ati owurọ̀ o di ọjọ́ kẹfa.
entries.en: And God saw every thing that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. And the evening and the morning were the sixth day.

entries.yo: BẸ li a pari ọrun on aiye, ati gbogbo ogun wọn.
entries.en: Thus the heavens and the earth were finished, and all the host of them.

entries.yo: Ni ijọ́ keje Ọlọrun si pari iṣẹ rẹ̀ ti o ti nṣe; o si simi ni ijọ́ keje kuro ninu iṣẹ rẹ̀ gbogbo ti o ti nṣe.
entries.en: And on the seventh day God ended his work which he had made; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had made.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si busi ijọ́ keje, o si yà a si mimọ́; nitori pe, ninu rẹ̀ li o simi kuro ninu iṣẹ rẹ̀ gbogbo ti o ti bẹ̀rẹ si iṣe.
entries.en: And God blessed the seventh day, and sanctified it: because that in it he had rested from all his work which God created and made.

entries.yo: Itan ọrun on aiye ni wọnyi nigbati a dá wọn, li ọjọ́ ti OLUWA Ọlọrun dá aiye on ọrun.
entries.en: These are the generations of the heavens and of the earth when they were created, in the day that the LORD God made the earth and the heavens,

entries.yo: Ati olukuluku igi igbẹ ki o to wà ni ilẹ, ati olukuluku eweko igbẹ ki nwọn ki o to hù: OLUWA Ọlọrun kò sa ti rọ̀jo si ilẹ, kò si sí enia kan lati ro ilẹ.
entries.en: And every plant of the field before it was in the earth, and every herb of the field before it grew: for the LORD God had not caused it to rain upon the earth, and there was not a man to till the ground.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ikũku a ti ilẹ wá, a si ma rin oju ilẹ gbogbo.
entries.en: But there went up a mist from the earth, and watered the whole face of the ground.

entries.yo: OLUWA Ọlọrun si fi erupẹ ilẹ mọ enia; o si mí ẹmí ìye si ihò imu rẹ̀; enia si di alãye ọkàn.
entries.en: And the LORD God formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.

entries.yo: OLUWA Ọlọrun si gbìn ọgbà kan niha ìla-õrùn ni Edeni; nibẹ̀ li o si fi ọkunrin na ti o ti mọ si.
entries.en: And the LORD God planted a garden eastward in Eden; and there he put the man whom he had formed.

entries.yo: Lati inu ilẹ li OLUWA Ọlọrun mu onirũru igi hù jade wá, ti o dara ni wiwò, ti o si dara fun onjẹ; ìgi ìye pẹlu lãrin ọgbà na, ati igi ìmọ rere ati buburu.
entries.en: And out of the ground made the LORD God to grow every tree that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food; the tree of life also in the midst of the garden, and the tree of knowledge of good and evil.

entries.yo: Odò kan si ti Edeni ṣàn wá lati rin ọgbà na; lati ibẹ̀ li o gbé yà, o si di ipa ori mẹrin.
entries.en: And a river went out of Eden to water the garden; and from thence it was parted, and became into four heads.

entries.yo: Orukọ ekini ni Pisoni: on li eyiti o yi gbogbo ilẹ Hafila ká, nibiti wurà wà;
entries.en: The name of the first is Pison: that is it which compasseth the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold;

entries.yo: Wurà ilẹ na si dara: nibẹ ni bedeliumu (ojia) wà ati okuta oniki.
entries.en: And the gold of that land is good: there is bdellium and the onyx stone.

entries.yo: Orukọ odò keji si ni Gihoni: on na li eyiti o yi gbogbo ilẹ Kuṣi ká.
entries.en: And the name of the second river is Gihon: the same is it that compasseth the whole land of Ethiopia.

entries.yo: Ati orukọ odò kẹta ni Hiddekeli: on li eyiti nṣàn lọ si ìha ìla-õrùn Assiria. Ati odò kẹrin ni Euferate.
entries.en: And the name of the third river is Hiddekel: that is it which goeth toward the east of Assyria. And the fourth river is Euphrates.

entries.yo: OLUWA Ọlọrun si mu ọkunrin na, o si fi i sinu ọgbà Edeni lati ma ro o, ati lati ma ṣọ́ ọ.
entries.en: And the LORD God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to dress it and to keep it.

entries.yo: OLUWA Ọlọrun si fi aṣẹ fun ọkunrin na pe, Ninu gbogbo igi ọgbà ni ki iwọ ki o ma jẹ:
entries.en: And the LORD God commanded the man, saying, Of every tree of the garden thou mayest freely eat:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ninu igi ìmọ rere ati bururu nì, iwọ kò gbọdọ jẹ ninu rẹ̀: nitoripe li ọjọ́ ti iwọ ba jẹ ninu rẹ̀ kikú ni iwọ o kú.
entries.en: But of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, thou shalt not eat of it: for in the day that thou eatest thereof thou shalt surely die.

entries.yo: OLUWA Ọlọrun si wipe, kò dara ki ọkunrin na ki o nikan ma gbé; emi o ṣe oluranlọwọ ti o dabi rẹ̀ fun u.
entries.en: And the LORD God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him.

entries.yo: Lati inu ilẹ li OLUWA Ọlọrun si ti dá ẹranko igbẹ gbogbo, ati ẹiyẹ oju-ọrun gbogbo; o si mu wọn tọ̀ Adamu wá lati wò orukọ ti yio sọ wọn; orukọkorukọ ti Adamu si sọ olukuluku ẹda alãye, on li orukọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And out of the ground the LORD God formed every beast of the field, and every fowl of the air; and brought them unto Adam to see what he would call them: and whatsoever Adam called every living creature, that was the name thereof.

entries.yo: Adamu si sọ ẹran-ọ̀sin gbogbo, ati ẹiyẹ oju-ọrun, ati ẹranko igbẹ gbogbo, li orukọ; ṣugbọn fun Adamu a kò ri oluranlọwọ ti o dabi rẹ̀ fun u.
entries.en: And Adam gave names to all cattle, and to the fowl of the air, and to every beast of the field; but for Adam there was not found an help meet for him.

entries.yo: OLUWA Ọlọrun si mu orun ìjika kùn Adamu, o si sùn: o si yọ ọkan ninu egungun-ìha rẹ̀, o si fi ẹran di ipò rẹ̀:
entries.en: And the LORD God caused a deep sleep to fall upon Adam and he slept: and he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh instead thereof;

entries.yo: OLUWA Ọlọrun si fi egungun-ìha ti o mu ni ìha ọkunrin na mọ obinrin, o si mu u tọ̀ ọkunrin na wá.
entries.en: And the rib, which the LORD God had taken from man, made he a woman, and brought her unto the man.

entries.yo: Adamu si wipe, Eyiyi li egungun ninu egungun mi, ati ẹran-ara ninu ẹran-ara mi: Obinrin li a o ma pè e, nitori ti a mu u jade lati ara ọkunrin wá.
entries.en: And Adam said, This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh: she shall be called Woman, because she was taken out of Man.

entries.yo: Nitori na li ọkunrin yio ṣe ma fi baba on iya rẹ̀ silẹ, yio si fi ara mọ́ aya rẹ̀: nwọn o si di ara kan.
entries.en: Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife: and they shall be one flesh.

entries.yo: Awọn mejeji si wà ni ìhoho, ati ọkunrin na ati obinrin rẹ̀, nwọn kò si tiju.
entries.en: And they were both naked, the man and his wife, and were not ashamed.

entries.yo: EJÒ sa ṣe alarekereke jù ẹranko igbẹ iyoku lọ ti OLUWA Ọlọrun ti dá. O si wi fun obinrin na pe, õtọ li Ọlọrun wipe, Ẹnyin kò gbọdọ jẹ gbogbo eso igi ọgbà?
entries.en: Now the serpent was more subtil than any beast of the field which the LORD God had made. And he said unto the woman, Yea, hath God said, Ye shall not eat of every tree of the garden?

entries.yo: Obinrin na si wi fun ejò na pe, Awa a ma jẹ ninu eso igi ọgbà:
entries.en: And the woman said unto the serpent, We may eat of the fruit of the trees of the garden:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ninu eso igi nì ti o wà lãrin ọgbà Ọlọrun ti wipe, Ẹnyin kò gbọdọ jẹ ninu rẹ̀, bẹ̃li ẹnyin kò gbọdọ fọwọkàn a, ki ẹnyin ki o má ba kú.
entries.en: But of the fruit of the tree which is in the midst of the garden, God hath said, Ye shall not eat of it, neither shall ye touch it, lest ye die.

entries.yo: Ejò na si wi fun obinrin na pe, Ẹnyin ki yio ku ikú kikú kan.
entries.en: And the serpent said unto the woman, Ye shall not surely die:

entries.yo: Nitori Ọlọrun mọ̀ pe, li ọjọ́ ti ẹnyin ba jẹ ninu rẹ̀, nigbana li oju nyin yio là, ẹnyin o si dabi Ọlọrun, ẹ o mọ̀ rere ati buburu.
entries.en: For God doth know that in the day ye eat thereof, then your eyes shall be opened, and ye shall be as gods, knowing good and evil.

entries.yo: Nigbati obinrin na si ri pe, igi na dara ni jijẹ, ati pe, o si dara fun oju, ati igi ti a ifẹ lati mu ni gbọ́n, o mu ninu eso rẹ̀ o si jẹ, o si fi fun ọkọ rẹ̀ pẹlu rẹ̀, on si jẹ.
entries.en: And when the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was pleasant to the eyes, and a tree to be desired to make one wise, she took of the fruit thereof, and did eat, and gave also unto her husband with her; and he did eat.

entries.yo: Oju awọn mejeji si là, nwọn si mọ̀ pe nwọn wà ni ìhoho; nwọn si gán ewe ọpọtọ pọ̀, nwọn si dá ibantẹ fun ara wọn.
entries.en: And the eyes of them both were opened, and they knew that they were naked; and they sewed fig leaves together, and made themselves aprons.

entries.yo: Nwọn si gbọ́ ohùn OLUWA Ọlọrun, o nrìn ninu ọgbà ni itura ọjọ́: Adamu ati aya rẹ̀ si fi ara wọn pamọ́ kuro niwaju OLUWA Ọlọrun lãrin igi ọgbà.
entries.en: And they heard the voice of the LORD God walking in the garden in the cool of the day: and Adam and his wife hid themselves from the presence of the LORD God amongst the trees of the garden.

entries.yo: OLUWA Ọlọrun si kọ si Adamu, o si wi fun u pe, Nibo ni iwọ wà?
entries.en: And the LORD God called unto Adam, and said unto him, Where art thou?

entries.yo: O si wipe, Mo gbọ́ ohùn rẹ ninu ọgbà, ẹ̀ru si bà mi, nitori ti mo wà ni ìhoho; mo si fi ara pamọ́.
entries.en: And he said, I heard thy voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I was naked; and I hid myself.

entries.yo: O si wi pe, Tali o wi fun ọ pe iwọ wà ni ìhoho? iwọ ha jẹ ninu igi nì, ninu eyiti mo paṣẹ fun ọ pe iwọ kò gbọdọ jẹ?
entries.en: And he said, Who told thee that thou wast naked? Hast thou eaten of the tree, whereof I commanded thee that thou shouldest not eat?

entries.yo: Ọkunrin na si wipe, Obinrin ti iwọ fi pẹlu mi, on li o fun mi ninu eso igi na, emi si jẹ.
entries.en: And the man said, The woman whom thou gavest to be with me, she gave me of the tree, and I did eat.

entries.yo: OLUWA Ọlọrun si bi obinrin na pe, Ewo ni iwọ ṣe yi? Obinrin na si wipe, Ejò li o tàn mi, mo si jẹ.
entries.en: And the LORD God said unto the woman, What is this that thou hast done? And the woman said, The serpent beguiled me, and I did eat.

entries.yo: OLUWA Ọlọrun si wi fun ejò na pe, nitori ti iwọ ti ṣe eyi, a fi iwọ bú ninu gbogbo ẹran ati ninu gbogbo ẹranko igbẹ; inu rẹ ni iwọ o ma fi wọ́, erupẹ ilẹ ni iwọ o ma jẹ li ọjọ́ aiye rẹ gbogbo.
entries.en: And the LORD God said unto the serpent, Because thou hast done this, thou art cursed above all cattle, and above every beast of the field; upon thy belly shalt thou go, and dust shalt thou eat all the days of thy life:

entries.yo: Emi o si fi ọta sãrin iwọ ati obinrin na, ati sãrin irú-ọmọ rẹ ati irú-ọmọ rẹ̀: on o fọ́ ọ li ori, iwọ o si pa a ni gigĩsẹ.
entries.en: And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.

entries.yo: Fun obinrin na li o wipe, Emi o sọ ipọnju ati iloyun rẹ di pupọ̀; ni ipọnju ni iwọ o ma bimọ; lọdọ ọkọ rẹ ni ifẹ rẹ yio ma fà si, on ni yio si ma ṣe olori rẹ.
entries.en: Unto the woman he said, I will greatly multiply thy sorrow and thy conception; in sorrow thou shalt bring forth children; and thy desire shall be to thy husband, and he shall rule over thee.

entries.yo: O si wi fun Adamu pe, Nitoriti iwọ gbà ohùn aya rẹ gbọ́, ti iwọ si jẹ ninu eso igi na, ninu eyiti mo ti paṣẹ fun ọ pe, iwọ kò gbọdọ jẹ ninu rẹ̀; a fi ilẹ bú nitori rẹ; ni ipọnju ni iwọ o ma jẹ ninu rẹ̀ li ọjọ́ aiye rẹ gbogbo;
entries.en: And unto Adam he said, Because thou hast hearkened unto the voice of thy wife, and hast eaten of the tree, of which I commanded thee, saying, Thou shalt not eat of it: cursed is the ground for thy sake; in sorrow shalt thou eat of it all the days of thy life;

entries.yo: Ẹgún on oṣuṣu ni yio ma hù jade fun ọ, iwọ o si ma jẹ eweko igbẹ:
entries.en: Thorns also and thistles shall it bring forth to thee; and thou shalt eat the herb of the field;

entries.yo: Li õgùn oju rẹ ni iwọ o ma jẹun, titi iwọ o fi pada si ilẹ; nitori inu rẹ̀ li a ti mu ọ wá, erupẹ sa ni iwọ, iwọ o si pada di erupẹ.
entries.en: In the sweat of thy face shalt thou eat bread, till thou return unto the ground; for out of it wast thou taken: for dust thou art, and unto dust shalt thou return.

entries.yo: Adamu si pè orukọ aya rẹ̀ ni Efa; nitori on ni iṣe iya alãye gbogbo.
entries.en: And Adam called his wife's name Eve; because she was the mother of all living.

entries.yo: Ati fun Adamu ati fun aya rẹ̀ li OLUWA Ọlọrun da ẹwu awọ, o si fi wọ̀ wọn.
entries.en: Unto Adam also and to his wife did the LORD God make coats of skins, and clothed them.

entries.yo: OLUWA Ọlọrun si wipe, Wò o, ọkunrin na dabi ọkan ninu wa lati mọ̀ rere ati bururu: njẹ nisisiyi ki o má ba nà ọwọ́ rẹ̀ ki o si mu ninu eso igi ìye pẹlu, ki o si jẹ, ki o si yè titi lai;
entries.en: And the LORD God said, Behold, the man is become as one of us, to know good and evil: and now, lest he put forth his hand, and take also of the tree of life, and eat, and live for ever:

entries.yo: Nitorina OLUWA Ọlọrun lé e jade kuro ninu ọgbà Edeni, lati ma ro ilẹ ninu eyiti a ti mu u jade wá.
entries.en: Therefore the LORD God sent him forth from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from whence he was taken.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li o lé ọkunrin na jade; o si fi awọn kerubu ati idà ina dè ìha ìla-õrùn Edeni ti njù kakiri, lati ma ṣọ́ ọ̀na igi ìye na.
entries.en: So he drove out the man; and he placed at the east of the garden of Eden Cherubims, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life.

entries.yo: ADAMU si mọ̀ Efa aya rẹ̀; o si loyun, o si bí Kaini, o si wipe, Mo ri ọkunrin kan gbà lọwọ OLUWA.
entries.en: And Adam knew Eve his wife; and she conceived, and bare Cain, and said, I have gotten a man from the LORD.

entries.yo: O si bí Abeli arakunrin rẹ̀. Abeli a si ma ṣe oluṣọ-agutan, ṣugbọn Kaini a ma ṣe aroko.
entries.en: And she again bare his brother Abel. And Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, li opin ọjọ́ wọnni ti Kaini mu ọrẹ ninu eso ilẹ fun OLUWA wá.
entries.en: And in process of time it came to pass, that Cain brought of the fruit of the ground an offering unto the LORD.

entries.yo: Ati Abeli, on pẹlu mu ninu akọbi ẹran-ọ̀sin ani ninu awọn ti o sanra. OLUWA si fi ojurere wò Abeli ati ọrẹ rẹ̀;
entries.en: And Abel, he also brought of the firstlings of his flock and of the fat thereof. And the LORD had respect unto Abel and to his offering:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Kaini ati ọrẹ rẹ̀ ni kò nãni. Kaini si binu gidigidi, oju rẹ̀ si rẹ̀wẹsi.
entries.en: But unto Cain and to his offering he had not respect. And Cain was very wroth, and his countenance fell.

entries.yo: OLUWA si bi Kaini pe, Ẽṣe ti inu fi mbi ọ? ẽ si ti ṣe ti oju rẹ̀ fi rẹ̀wẹsi?
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Cain, Why art thou wroth? and why is thy countenance fallen?

entries.yo: Bi iwọ ba ṣe rere, ara ki yio ha yá ọ? bi iwọ kò ba si ṣe rere, ẹ̀ṣẹ ba li ẹnu-ọ̀na, lọdọ rẹ ni ifẹ rẹ̀ yio ma fà si, iwọ o si ma ṣe alakoso rẹ̀.
entries.en: If thou doest well, shalt thou not be accepted? and if thou doest not well, sin lieth at the door. And unto thee shall be his desire, and thou shalt rule over him.

entries.yo: Kaini si ba Abeli arakunrin rẹ̀ sọ̀rọ: o si ṣe, nigbati nwọn wà li oko, Kaini dide si Abeli arakunrin rẹ̀, o si lù u pa.
entries.en: And Cain talked with Abel his brother: and it came to pass, when they were in the field, that Cain rose up against Abel his brother, and slew him.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun Kaini pe, Nibo ni Abeli arakunrin rẹ wà? O si wipe, Emi kò mọ̀; emi iṣe olutọju arakunrin mi bi?
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Cain, Where is Abel thy brother? And he said, I know not: Am I my brother's keeper?

entries.yo: O si wipe, Kini iwọ ṣe nì? Ohùn ẹ̀jẹ arakunrin rẹ nkigbe pè mi lati inu ilẹ wá.
entries.en: And he said, What hast thou done? the voice of thy brother's blood crieth unto me from the ground.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi a fi ọ ré lori ilẹ, ti o yanu rẹ̀ gbà ẹ̀jẹ arakunrin rẹ lọwọ rẹ.
entries.en: And now art thou cursed from the earth, which hath opened her mouth to receive thy brother's blood from thy hand;

entries.yo: Nigbati iwọ ba ro ilẹ, lati isisiyi lọ, ki yio fi agbara rẹ̀ so eso fun ọ mọ; isansa ati alarinkiri ni iwọ o ma jẹ li aiye.
entries.en: When thou tillest the ground, it shall not henceforth yield unto thee her strength; a fugitive and a vagabond shalt thou be in the earth.

entries.yo: Kaini si wi fun OLUWA pe, ìya ẹ̀ṣẹ mi pọ̀ jù eyiti emi lè rù lọ.
entries.en: And Cain said unto the LORD, My punishment is greater than I can bear.

entries.yo: Kiye si i, iwọ lé mi jade loni kuro lori ilẹ; emi o si di ẹniti o pamọ kuro loju rẹ; emi o si ma jẹ isansa ati alarinkiri li aiye; yio si ṣe ẹnikẹni ti o ba ri mi yio lù mi pa.
entries.en: Behold, thou hast driven me out this day from the face of the earth; and from thy face shall I be hid; and I shall be a fugitive and a vagabond in the earth; and it shall come to pass, that every one that findeth me shall slay me.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun u pe, Nitorina ẹnikẹni ti o ba pa Kaini a o gbẹsan lara rẹ̀ lẹrinmeje. OLUWA si sàmi si Kaini lara, nitori ẹniti o ba ri i ki o má ba pa a.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto him, Therefore whosoever slayeth Cain, vengeance shall be taken on him sevenfold. And the LORD set a mark upon Cain, lest any finding him should kill him.

entries.yo: Kaini si jade lọ kuro niwaju OLUWA, o si joko ni ilẹ Nodi, ni ìha ìla-õrùn Edeni.
entries.en: And Cain went out from the presence of the LORD, and dwelt in the land of Nod, on the east of Eden.

entries.yo: Kaini si mọ̀ aya rẹ̀; o si loyun, o si bí Enoku: o si tẹ̀ ilu kan dó, o si sọ orukọ ilu na ni Enoku bi orukọ ọmọ rẹ̀ ọkunrin.
entries.en: And Cain knew his wife; and she conceived, and bare Enoch: and he builded a city, and called the name of the city, after the name of his son, Enoch.

entries.yo: Fun Enoku li a bí Iradi: Iradi si bí Mehujaeli: Mehujaeli si bí Metuṣaeli: Metuṣaeli si bí Lameki.
entries.en: And unto Enoch was born Irad: and Irad begat Mehujael: and Mehujael begat Methusael: and Methusael begat Lamech.

entries.yo: Lameki si fẹ́ obinrin meji: orukọ ekini ni Ada, ati orukọ ekeji ni Silla.
entries.en: And Lamech took unto him two wives: the name of the one was Adah, and the name of the other Zillah.

entries.yo: Ada si bí Jabali: on ni baba irú awọn ti o ngbé agọ́, ti nwọn si li ẹran-ọ̀sin.
entries.en: And Adah bare Jabal: he was the father of such as dwell in tents, and of such as have cattle.

entries.yo: Orukọ arakunrin rẹ̀ ni Jubali: on ni baba irú gbogbo awọn ti nlò dùru ati fère.
entries.en: And his brother's name was Jubal: he was the father of all such as handle the harp and organ.

entries.yo: Ati Silla on pẹlu bí Tubali-kaini, olukọni gbogbo ọlọnà idẹ, ati irin: arabinrin Tubali-kaini ni Naama.
entries.en: And Zillah, she also bare Tubal-cain, an instructer of every artificer in brass and iron: and the sister of Tubal-cain was Naamah.

entries.yo: Lameki si wi fun awọn aya rẹ̀ pe, Ada on Silla, ẹ gbọ́ ohùn mi; ẹnyin aya Lameki, ẹ fetisi ọ̀rọ mi: nitoriti mo pa ọkunrin kan si ẹ̀dun mi, ati ọdọmọkunrin kan si ipalara mi.
entries.en: And Lamech said unto his wives, Adah and Zillah, Hear my voice; ye wives of Lamech, hearken unto my speech: for I have slain a man to my wounding, and a young man to my hurt.

entries.yo: Bi a o gbẹsan Kaini lẹrinmeje, njẹ ti Lameki ni ìgba ãdọrin meje.
entries.en: If Cain shall be avenged sevenfold, truly Lamech seventy and sevenfold.

entries.yo: Adamu si tun mọ̀ aya rẹ̀, o si bí ọmọkunrin kan, o si pè orukọ rẹ̀ ni Seti: o wipe, nitori Ọlọrun yàn irú-ọmọ miran fun mi ni ipò Abeli ti Kaini pa.
entries.en: And Adam knew his wife again; and she bare a son, and called his name Seth: For God, said she, hath appointed me another seed instead of Abel, whom Cain slew.

entries.yo: Ati Seti, on pẹlu li a bí ọmọkunrin kan fun; o si pè orukọ rẹ̀ ni Enoṣi: nigbana li awọn enia bẹ̀rẹ si ikepè orukọ OLUWA.
entries.en: And to Seth, to him also there was born a son; and he called his name Enos: then began men to call upon the name of the LORD.

entries.yo: EYI ni iwe iran Adamu: Li ọjọ́ ti Ọlọrun dá ọkunrin, li aworan Ọlọrun li o dá a.
entries.en: This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, in the likeness of God made he him;

entries.yo: Ati akọ ati abo li o dá wọn; o si súre fun wọn, o si pè orukọ wọn ni Adamu, li ọjọ́ ti a dá wọn.
entries.en: Male and female created he them; and blessed them, and called their name Adam, in the day when they were created.

entries.yo: Adamu si wà li ãdoje ọdún, o si bí ọmọkunrin kan ni jijọ ati li aworan ara rẹ̀; o si pè orukọ rẹ̀ ni Seti:
entries.en: And Adam lived an hundred and thirty years, and begat a son in his own likeness, after his image; and called his name Seth:

entries.yo: Ọjọ́ Adamu, lẹhin ti o bí Seti, jẹ ẹgbẹrin ọdún: o si bí ọmọkunrin ati ọmọbinrin:
entries.en: And the days of Adam after he had begotten Seth were eight hundred years: and he begat sons and daughters:

entries.yo: Gbogbo ọjọ́ ti Adamu wà si jẹ ẹ̃dẹgbẹrun ọdún o lé ọgbọ̀n: o si kú.
entries.en: And all the days that Adam lived were nine hundred and thirty years: and he died.

entries.yo: Seti si wà li ọgọrun ọdún o lé marun, o si bí Enoṣi:
entries.en: And Seth lived an hundred and five years, and begat Enos:

entries.yo: Seti si wà li ẹgbẹrin ọdún o lé meje lẹhin ti o bí Enoṣi, o si bí ọmọkunrin ati ọmọbinrin:
entries.en: And Seth lived after he begat Enos eight hundred and seven years, and begat sons and daughters:

entries.yo: Ati gbogbo ọjọ́ Seti jẹ ẹ̃dẹgbẹrun ọdun o lé mejila: o si kú.
entries.en: And all the days of Seth were nine hundred and twelve years: and he died.

entries.yo: Enoṣi si wà li ãdọrun ọdún, o si bí Kenani:
entries.en: And Enos lived ninety years, and begat Cainan:

entries.yo: Enoṣi si wà li ẹgbẹrin ọdún o lé mẹ̃dogun lẹhin ti o bí Kenani, o si bí ọmọkunrin ati ọmọbinrin:
entries.en: And Enos lived after he begat Cainan eight hundred and fifteen years, and begat sons and daughters:

entries.yo: Gbogbo ọjọ́ Enoṣi si jẹ ẹ̃dẹgbẹrun ọdún o lé marun: o si kú.
entries.en: And all the days of Enos were nine hundred and five years: and he died.

entries.yo: Kenani si wà li ãdọrin ọdún, o si bí Mahalaleli:
entries.en: And Cainan lived seventy years, and begat Mahalaleel:

entries.yo: Kenani si wà li ẹgbẹrin ọdún o lé ogoji lẹhin ti o bí Mahalaleli, o si bí ọmọkunrin ati ọmọbinrin:
entries.en: And Cainan lived after he begat Mahalaleel eight hundred and forty years, and begat sons and daughters:

entries.yo: Gbogbo ọjọ́ Kenani si jẹ ẹ̃dẹgbẹrun ọdún o lé mẹwa: o si kú.
entries.en: And all the days of Cainan were nine hundred and ten years: and he died.

entries.yo: Mahalaleli si wà li ọgọta ọdún o lé marun, o si bí Jaredi:
entries.en: And Mahalaleel lived sixty and five years, and begat Jared:

entries.yo: Mahalaleli si wà li ẹgbẹrin ọdún o lé ọgbọ̀n, lẹhin ti o bí Jaredi, o si bí ọmọkunrin ati ọmọbinrin:
entries.en: And Mahalaleel lived after he begat Jared eight hundred and thirty years, and begat sons and daughters:

entries.yo: Gbogbo ọjọ́ Mahalaleli si jẹ ẹ̃dẹgbẹ̀run ọdún o dí marun: o si kú.
entries.en: And all the days of Mahalaleel were eight hundred ninety and five years: and he died.

entries.yo: Jaredi si wà li ọgọjọ ọdún o lé meji, o si bí Enoku:
entries.en: And Jared lived an hundred sixty and two years, and he begat Enoch:

entries.yo: Jaredi si wà li ẹgbẹrin ọdún lẹhin igbati o bì Enoku, o si bí ọmọkunrin ati ọmọbinrin:
entries.en: And Jared lived after he begat Enoch eight hundred years, and begat sons and daughters:

entries.yo: Gbogbo ọjọ́ Jaredi si jẹ ẹgbẹrun ọdún o dí mejidilogoji: o si kú.
entries.en: And all the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty and two years: and he died.

entries.yo: Enoku si wà li ọgọta ọdún o lé marun, o si bí Metusela:
entries.en: And Enoch lived sixty and five years, and begat Methuselah:

entries.yo: Enoku si ba Ọlọrun rìn li ọ̃dunrun ọdún lẹhin ti o bì Metusela, o si bí ọmọkunrin ati ọmọbinrin:
entries.en: And Enoch walked with God after he begat Methuselah three hundred years, and begat sons and daughters:

entries.yo: Gbogbo ọjọ́ Enoku si jẹ irinwo ọdún o dí marundilogoji:
entries.en: And all the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty and five years:

entries.yo: Enoku si ba Ọlọrun rìn: on kò si sí; nitori ti Ọlọrun mu u lọ.
entries.en: And Enoch walked with God: and he was not; for God took him.

entries.yo: Metusela si wà li ọgọsan ọdún o lé meje, o si bí Lameki:
entries.en: And Methuselah lived an hundred eighty and seven years, and begat Lamech:

entries.yo: Metusela si wà li ẹgbẹrin ọdún o dí mejidilogun lẹhin igbati o bí Lameki, o si bí ọmọkunrin ati ọmọbinrin:
entries.en: And Methuselah lived after he begat Lamech seven hundred eighty and two years, and begat sons and daughters:

entries.yo: Gbogbo ọjọ́ Metusela si jẹ ẹgbẹrun ọdún o dí mọkanlelọgbọ̀n: o si kú.
entries.en: And all the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty and nine years: and he died.

entries.yo: Lameki si wà li ọgọsan ọdún o lé meji, o si bí ọmọkunrin kan:
entries.en: And Lamech lived an hundred eighty and two years, and begat a son:

entries.yo: O si sọ orukọ rẹ̀ ni Noa, pe, Eleyi ni yio tù wa ni inu ni iṣẹ ati lãla ọwọ́ wa, nitori ilẹ ti OLUWA ti fibú.
entries.en: And he called his name Noah, saying, This same shall comfort us concerning our work and toil of our hands, because of the ground which the LORD hath cursed.

entries.yo: Lameki si wà li ẹgbẹta ọdún o dí marun, lẹhin ti o bí Noa, o si bí ọmọkunrin ati ọmọbinrin:
entries.en: And Lamech lived after he begat Noah five hundred ninety and five years, and begat sons and daughters:

entries.yo: Gbogbo ọjọ́ Lameki si jẹ ẹgbẹrin ọdún o dí mẹtalelogun: o si kú.
entries.en: And all the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy and seven years: and he died.

entries.yo: Noa si jẹ ẹni ẹ̃dẹgbẹta ọdún: Noa si bí Ṣemu, Hamu, ati Jafeti.
entries.en: And Noah was five hundred years old: and Noah begat Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

entries.yo: O si ṣe nigbati enia bẹ̀rẹ si irẹ̀ lori ilẹ, ti a si bí ọmọbinrin fun wọn,
entries.en: And it came to pass, when men began to multiply on the face of the earth, and daughters were born unto them,

entries.yo: Ni awọn ọmọ Ọlọrun ri awọn ọmọbinrin enia pe, nwọn lẹwà; nwọn fẹ́ aya fun ara wọn ninu gbogbo awọn ti nwọn yàn.
entries.en: That the sons of God saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wipe, Ẹmi mi ki yio fi igba-gbogbo ba enia jà, ẹran-ara sa li on pẹlu: ọjọ́ rẹ̀ yio si jẹ ọgọfa ọdún.
entries.en: And the LORD said, My spirit shall not always strive with man, for that he also is flesh: yet his days shall be an hundred and twenty years.

entries.yo: Awọn òmirán wà li aiye li ọjọ́ wọnni; ati lẹhin eyini pẹlu, nigbati awọn ọmọ Ọlọrun wọle tọ̀ awọn ọmọbinrin enia lọ, ti nwọn si bí ọmọ fun wọn, awọn na li o di akọni ti o wà nigbãni, awọn ọkunrin olokikí.
entries.en: There were giants in the earth in those days; and also after that, when the sons of God came in unto the daughters of men, and they bare children to them, the same became mighty men which were of old, men of renown.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si ri pe ìwabuburu enia di pipọ̀ li aiye, ati pe gbogbo ìro ọkàn rẹ̀ kìki ibi ni lojojumọ.
entries.en: And GOD saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually.

entries.yo: Inu OLUWA si bajẹ nitori ti o dá enia si aiye, o si dùn u de ọkàn rẹ̀.
entries.en: And it repented the LORD that he had made man on the earth, and it grieved him at his heart.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wipe, Emi o pa enia ti mo ti dá run kuro li ori ilẹ; ati enia, ati ẹranko, ati ohun ti nrakò, ati ẹiyẹ oju-ọrun; nitori inu mi bajẹ ti mo ti dá wọn.
entries.en: And the LORD said, I will destroy man whom I have created from the face of the earth; both man, and beast, and the creeping thing, and the fowls of the air; for it repenteth me that I have made them.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Noa ri ojurere loju OLUWA.
entries.en: But Noah found grace in the eyes of the LORD.

entries.yo: Wọnyi ni ìtan Noa: Noa ṣe olõtọ ati ẹniti o pé li ọjọ́ aiye rẹ̀, Noa mba Ọlọrun rìn.
entries.en: These are the generations of Noah: Noah was a just man and perfect in his generations, and Noah walked with God.

entries.yo: Noa si bí ọmọkunrin mẹta, Ṣemu, Hamu, ati Jafeti.
entries.en: And Noah begat three sons, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

entries.yo: Aiye si bajẹ niwaju Ọlọrun, aiye si kún fun ìwa-agbara.
entries.en: The earth also was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si bojuwò aiye, si kiye si i, o bajẹ; nitori olukuluku enia ti bà ìwa rẹ̀ jẹ li aiye.
entries.en: And God looked upon the earth, and, behold, it was corrupt; for all flesh had corrupted his way upon the earth.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si wi fun Noa pe, Opin gbogbo enia de iwaju mi; nitori ti aiye kún fun ìwa-agbara lati ọwọ́ wọn; si kiye si i, emi o si pa wọn run pẹlu aiye.
entries.en: And God said unto Noah, The end of all flesh is come before me; for the earth is filled with violence through them; and, behold, I will destroy them with the earth.

entries.yo: Iwọ fi igi goferi kàn ọkọ́ kan; ikele-ikele ni iwọ o ṣe ninu ọkọ́ na, iwọ o si fi ọ̀da kùn u ninu ati lode.
entries.en: Make thee an ark of gopher wood; rooms shalt thou make in the ark, and shalt pitch it within and without with pitch.

entries.yo: Bayi ni iwọ o si ṣe e: Ìna ọkọ̀ na yio jẹ ọ̃dunrun igbọ́nwọ, ìbú rẹ̀ ãdọta igbọ́nwọ, ati giga rẹ̀ ọgbọ̀n igbọ̀nwọ.
entries.en: And this is the fashion which thou shalt make it of: The length of the ark shall be three hundred cubits, the breadth of it fifty cubits, and the height of it thirty cubits.

entries.yo: Ferese ni iwọ o si ṣe si ọkọ̀ na ni igbọ́nwọ kan ni ki iwọ ki o si pari wọn loke; lẹgbẹ ni iwọ o si dá ẹnu-ọ̀na ọkọ̀ na, si: pẹlu yara isalẹ, atẹle, ati ẹkẹta loke ni iwọ o ṣe e.
entries.en: A window shalt thou make to the ark, and in a cubit shalt thou finish it above; and the door of the ark shalt thou set in the side thereof; with lower, second, and third stories shalt thou make it.

entries.yo: Ati emi, wò o, emi nmu kikun-omi bọ̀ wá si aiye, lati pa gbogbo ohun alãye run, ti o li ẹmi ãye ninu kuro labẹ ọrun; ohun gbogbo ti o wà li aiye ni yio si kú.
entries.en: And, behold, I, even I, do bring a flood of waters upon the earth, to destroy all flesh, wherein is the breath of life, from under heaven; and every thing that is in the earth shall die.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn iwọ li emi o ba dá majẹmu mi; iwọ o si wọ̀ inu ọkọ̀ na, iwọ ati awọn ọmọ rẹ, ati aya rẹ, ati awọn aya awọn ọmọ rẹ pẹlu rẹ.
entries.en: But with thee will I establish my covenant; and thou shalt come into the ark, thou, and thy sons, and thy wife, and thy sons' wives with thee.

entries.yo: Ati ninu ẹdá alãye gbogbo, ninu onirũru ẹran, meji meji ninu gbogbo ẹran ni iwọ o mu wọ̀ inu ọkọ̀ na, lati mu nwọn là pẹlu rẹ; ti akọ ti abo ni ki nwọn ki o jẹ.
entries.en: And of every living thing of all flesh, two of every sort shalt thou bring into the ark, to keep them alive with thee; they shall be male and female.

entries.yo: Ninu ẹiyẹ nipa irú ti wọn, ninu ẹran-ọ̀sin nipa irú ti wọn, ninu ohun gbogbo ti nrakò ni ilẹ nipa irú tirẹ̀, meji meji ninu gbogbo wọn ni yio ma tọ̀ ọ wá lati mu wọn wà lãye.
entries.en: Of fowls after their kind, and of cattle after their kind, of every creeping thing of the earth after his kind, two of every sort shall come unto thee, to keep them alive.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si mu ninu ohun jijẹ gbogbo, iwọ o si kó wọn jọ si ọdọ rẹ; yio si ṣe onjẹ fun iwọ, ati fun wọn.
entries.en: And take thou unto thee of all food that is eaten, and thou shalt gather it to thee; and it shall be for food for thee, and for them.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Noa si ṣe; gẹgẹ bi gbogbo eyiti Ọlọrun paṣẹ fun u, bẹli o ṣe.
entries.en: Thus did Noah; according to all that God commanded him, so did he.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun Noa pe, iwọ wá, ati gbogbo awọn ara ile rẹ sinu ọkọ̀, nitori iwọ ni mo ri li olododo niwaju mi ni iran yi.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Noah, Come thou and all thy house into the ark; for thee have I seen righteous before me in this generation.

entries.yo: Ninu onirũru ẹran ti o mọ́ meje meje ni ki iwọ ki o mu wọn, ati akọ ati abo rẹ̀; ati ninu ẹran ti kò mọ́ meji meji, ati akọ ati abo rẹ̀.
entries.en: Of every clean beast thou shalt take to thee by sevens, the male and his female: and of beasts that are not clean by two, the male and his female.

entries.yo: Ninu ẹiyẹ oju-ọrun pẹlu ni meje meje, ati akọ ati abo; lati dá irú si lãye lori ilẹ gbogbo.
entries.en: Of fowls also of the air by sevens, the male and the female; to keep seed alive upon the face of all the earth.

entries.yo: Nitori ijọ́ meje si i, emi o mu òjo rọ̀ si ilẹ li ogoji ọsán ati li ogoji oru; ohun alãye gbogbo ti mo dá li emi o parun kuro lori ilẹ.
entries.en: For yet seven days, and I will cause it to rain upon the earth forty days and forty nights; and every living substance that I have made will I destroy from off the face of the earth.

entries.yo: Noa si ṣe gẹgẹ bi gbogbo eyiti OLUWA paṣẹ fun u.
entries.en: And Noah did according unto all that the LORD commanded him.

entries.yo: Noa si jẹ ẹni ẹgbẹta ọdún nigbati kíkun-omi de si aiye.
entries.en: And Noah was six hundred years old when the flood of waters was upon the earth.

entries.yo: Noa si wọle, ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, ati aya rẹ̀, ati aya awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ pẹlu rẹ̀, sinu ọkọ̀, nitori kíkun-omi.
entries.en: And Noah went in, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons' wives with him, into the ark, because of the waters of the flood.

entries.yo: Ninu ẹranko mimọ́, ati ninu ẹranko ti kò mọ́, ati ninu ẹiyẹ, ati ninu ohun gbogbo ti nrakò lori ilẹ,
entries.en: Of clean beasts, and of beasts that are not clean, and of fowls, and of every thing that creepeth upon the earth,

entries.yo: Nwọn wọle tọ̀ Noa lọ sinu ọkọ̀ ni meji meji, ati akọ ati abo, bi Ọlọrun ti fi aṣẹ fun Noa.
entries.en: There went in two and two unto Noah into the ark, the male and the female, as God had commanded Noah.

entries.yo: O si ṣe ni ijọ́ keje, bẹ̃ni kíkun-omi de si aiye.
entries.en: And it came to pass after seven days, that the waters of the flood were upon the earth.

entries.yo: Li ẹgbẹta ọdún ọjọ́ aiye Noa, li oṣù keji, ni ọjọ́ kẹtadilogun oṣù, li ọjọ́ na ni gbogbo isun ibú nla ya, ati ferese iṣàn omi ọrun si ṣí silẹ.
entries.en: In the six hundredth year of Noah's life, in the second month, the seventeenth day of the month, the same day were all the fountains of the great deep broken up, and the windows of heaven were opened.

entries.yo: Òjo na si wà lori ilẹ li ogoji ọsán on ogoji oru.
entries.en: And the rain was upon the earth forty days and forty nights.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ́ na gan ni Noa wọ̀ inu ọkọ̀, ati Ṣemu, ati Hamu, ati Jafeti, awọn ọmọ Noa, ati aya Noa, (ati awọn aya ọmọ rẹ̀ mẹta pẹlu wọn).
entries.en: In the selfsame day entered Noah, and Shem, and Ham, and Japheth, the sons of Noah, and Noah's wife, and the three wives of his sons with them, into the ark;

entries.yo: Awọn, ati gbogbo ẹranko ni irú tirẹ̀, ati ẹran-ọ̀sin gbogbo ni irú tirẹ̀, ati ohun gbogbo ti nrakò lori ilẹ ni irú tirẹ̀, ati gbogbo ẹiyẹ nla ni irú tirẹ̀, ati gbogbo ẹiyẹ abiyẹ.
entries.en: They, and every beast after his kind, and all the cattle after their kind, and every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth after his kind, and every fowl after his kind, every bird of every sort.

entries.yo: Nwọn si wọle tọ̀ Noa lọ sinu ọkọ̀, meji meji ninu ẹda gbogbo, ninu eyiti ẹmi ìye wà.
entries.en: And they went in unto Noah into the ark, two and two of all flesh, wherein is the breath of life.

entries.yo: Awọn ti o si wọle lọ, nwọn wọle ti akọ ti abo ninu ẹdá gbogbo, bi Ọlọrun ti fi aṣẹ fun u. OLUWA si sé e mọ́ ile.
entries.en: And they that went in, went in male and female of all flesh, as God had commanded him: and the LORD shut him in.

entries.yo: Ikún-omi si wà li ogoji ọjọ́ lori ilẹ; omi si nwú si i, o si mu ọkọ̀ fó soke, o si gbera kuro lori ilẹ.
entries.en: And the flood was forty days upon the earth; and the waters increased, and bare up the ark, and it was lift up above the earth.

entries.yo: Omi si gbilẹ, o si nwú si i gidigidi lori ilẹ; ọkọ̀ na si fó soke loju omi.
entries.en: And the waters prevailed, and were increased greatly upon the earth; and the ark went upon the face of the waters.

entries.yo: Omi si gbilẹ gidigidi lori ilẹ; ati gbogbo oke giga, ti o wà ni gbogbo abẹ ọrun, li a bò mọlẹ.
entries.en: And the waters prevailed exceedingly upon the earth; and all the high hills, that were under the whole heaven, were covered.

entries.yo: Omi gbilẹ soke ni igbọ́nwọ mẹ̃dogun; a si bò gbogbo okenla mọlẹ.
entries.en: Fifteen cubits upward did the waters prevail; and the mountains were covered.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ẹdá ti nrìn lori ilẹ si kú, ti ẹiyẹ, ti ẹran-ọ̀sin, ti ẹranko, ti ohun gbogbo ti nrakò lori ilẹ ati gbogbo enia:
entries.en: And all flesh died that moved upon the earth, both of fowl, and of cattle, and of beast, and of every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth, and every man:

entries.yo: Gbogbo ohun ti ẹmi ìye wà ni ihò imu rẹ̀, gbogbo ohun ti o wà ni iyangbẹ ilẹ si kú.
entries.en: All in whose nostrils was the breath of life, of all that was in the dry land, died.

entries.yo: Ohun alãye gbogbo ti o wà lori ilẹ li a si parun, ati enia, ati ẹran-ọ̀sin, ati ohun ti nrakò, ati ẹiyẹ oju-ọrun, nwọn si run kuro lori ilẹ. Noa nikan li o kù, ati awọn ti o wà pẹlu rẹ̀ ninu ọkọ̀.
entries.en: And every living substance was destroyed which was upon the face of the ground, both man, and cattle, and the creeping things, and the fowl of the heaven; and they were destroyed from the earth: and Noah only remained alive, and they that were with him in the ark.

entries.yo: Omi si gbilẹ li aiye li ãdọjọ ọjọ́.
entries.en: And the waters prevailed upon the earth an hundred and fifty days.

entries.yo: ỌLỌRUN si ranti Noa, ati ohun alãye gbogbo, ati gbogbo ẹran-ọ̀sin ti o wà pẹlu rẹ̀ ninu ọkọ̀: Ọlọrun si mu afẹfẹ kọja lori ilẹ, omi na si fà.
entries.en: And God remembered Noah, and every living thing, and all the cattle that was with him in the ark: and God made a wind to pass over the earth, and the waters asswaged;

entries.yo: A si dí gbogbo isun ibú ati awọn ferese ọrun, o si mu òjo dá lati ọrun wá.
entries.en: The fountains also of the deep and the windows of heaven were stopped, and the rain from heaven was restrained;

entries.yo: Omi si npada kuro lori ilẹ, lojojumọ lẹhin ãdọjọ ọjọ́, omi si fà.
entries.en: And the waters returned from off the earth continually: and after the end of the hundred and fifty days the waters were abated.

entries.yo: Ọkọ̀ si kanlẹ li oṣù keje, ni ijọ́ kẹtadilogun oṣù, lori oke Ararati.
entries.en: And the ark rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, upon the mountains of Ararat.

entries.yo: Omi si nfà titi o fi di oṣù kẹwa: li oṣù kẹwa, li ọjọ́ kini oṣù li ori awọn okenla hàn,
entries.en: And the waters decreased continually until the tenth month: in the tenth month, on the first day of the month, were the tops of the mountains seen.

entries.yo: O si ṣe li opin ogoji ọjọ́, ni Noa ṣí ferese ọkọ̀ ti o kàn:
entries.en: And it came to pass at the end of forty days, that Noah opened the window of the ark which he had made:

entries.yo: O si rán ìwo kan jade, ti o fò jade lọ ka kiri titi omi fi gbẹ kuro lori ilẹ.
entries.en: And he sent forth a raven, which went forth to and fro, until the waters were dried up from off the earth.

entries.yo: O si rán oriri kan jade, lati ọdọ rẹ̀ lọ, ki o wò bi omi ba nfà kuro lori ilẹ;
entries.en: Also he sent forth a dove from him, to see if the waters were abated from off the face of the ground;

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn oriri kò ri ibi isimi fun atẹlẹsẹ̀ rẹ̀, o si pada tọ ọ lọ ninu ọkọ̀, nitoriti omi wà lori ilẹ gbogbo: nigbana li o si nawọ rẹ̀, o mu u, o si fà a si ọdọ rẹ̀ ninu ọkọ̀.
entries.en: But the dove found no rest for the sole of her foot, and she returned unto him into the ark, for the waters were on the face of the whole earth: then he put forth his hand, and took her, and pulled her in unto him into the ark.

entries.yo: O si duro li ọjọ́ meje miran si i: o si tun rán oriri na jade lati inu ọkọ̀ lọ.
entries.en: And he stayed yet other seven days; and again he sent forth the dove out of the ark;

entries.yo: Oriri na si pada wọle tọ̀ ọ wá li aṣalẹ; si kiyesi i, o já ewe olifi si ẹnu rẹ̀: bẹ̃li Noa si mọ̀ pe omi ngbẹ kuro lori ilẹ.
entries.en: And the dove came in to him in the evening; and, lo, in her mouth was an olive leaf pluckt off: so Noah knew that the waters were abated from off the earth.

entries.yo: O si tun duro ni ijọ́ meje miran, o si rán oriri na jade; ti kò si tun pada tọ̀ ọ wá mọ́.
entries.en: And he stayed yet other seven days; and sent forth the dove; which returned not again unto him any more.

entries.yo: O si ṣe li ọdún kọkanlelẹgbẹta, li oṣù kini, li ọjọ́ kini oṣù na, on li omi gbẹ kuro lori ilẹ: Noa si ṣí ideri ọkọ̀, o si wò, si kiyesi i ori ilẹ gbẹ.
entries.en: And it came to pass in the six hundredth and first year, in the first month, the first day of the month, the waters were dried up from off the earth: and Noah removed the covering of the ark, and looked, and, behold, the face of the ground was dry.

entries.yo: Li oṣù keji, ni ijọ́ kẹtadilọgbọ̀n oṣù, on ni ilẹ gbẹ.
entries.en: And in the second month, on the seven and twentieth day of the month, was the earth dried.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si sọ fun Noa pe,
entries.en: And God spake unto Noah, saying,

entries.yo: Jade kuro ninu ọkọ̀, iwọ, ati aya rẹ, ati awọn ọmọ rẹ, ati awọn aya ọmọ rẹ pẹlu rẹ.
entries.en: Go forth of the ark, thou, and thy wife, and thy sons, and thy sons' wives with thee.

entries.yo: Mu ohun alãye gbogbo ti o wà pẹlu rẹ jade pẹlu rẹ, ninu ẹdá gbogbo, ti ẹiyẹ, ti ẹran-ọ̀sin, ati ti ohun gbogbo ti nrakò lori ilẹ; ki nwọn ki o le ma gbá yìn lori ilẹ, ki nwọn bí si i, ki nwọn si ma rẹ̀ si i lori ilẹ.
entries.en: Bring forth with thee every living thing that is with thee, of all flesh, both of fowl, and of cattle, and of every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth; that they may breed abundantly in the earth, and be fruitful, and multiply upon the earth.

entries.yo: Noa si jade, ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, ati aya rẹ̀, ati awọn aya ọmọ rẹ̀ pẹlu rẹ̀;
entries.en: And Noah went forth, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons' wives with him:

entries.yo: Gbogbo ẹranko, gbogbo ohun ti nrakò, ati ẹiyẹ gbogbo, ati ohunkohun ti nrakò lori ilẹ, gẹgẹ bi irú ti wọn, nwọn jade ninu ọkọ̀.
entries.en: Every beast, every creeping thing, and every fowl, and whatsoever creepeth upon the earth, after their kinds, went forth out of the ark.

entries.yo: Noa si tẹ́ pẹpẹ fun OLUWA; o si mu ninu ẹranko mimọ́ gbogbo, ati ninu ẹiyẹ mimọ́ gbogbo, o si rú ẹbọ-ọrẹ sisun lori pẹpẹ na.
entries.en: And Noah builded an altar unto the LORD; and took of every clean beast, and of every clean fowl, and offered burnt offerings on the altar.

entries.yo: OLUWA si gbọ́ õrun didùn; OLUWA si wi li ọkàn rẹ̀ pe, Emi ki yio si tun fi ilẹ ré nitori enia mọ́; nitori ìro ọkàn enia ibi ni lati ìgba ewe rẹ̀ wá; bẹ̃li emi ki yio tun kọlù ohun alãye gbogbo mọ́ bi mo ti ṣe.
entries.en: And the LORD smelled a sweet savour; and the LORD said in his heart, I will not again curse the ground any more for man's sake; for the imagination of man's heart is evil from his youth; neither will I again smite any more every thing living, as I have done.

entries.yo: Niwọ̀n ìgba ti aiye yio wà, ìgba irugbìn, ati ìgba ikore, ìgba otutu ati oru, ìgba ẹ̃run on òjo, ati ọsán ati oru, ki yio dẹkun.
entries.en: While the earth remaineth, seedtime and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night shall not cease.

entries.yo: ỌLỌRUN si sure fun Noa, ati fun awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, o si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ ma bí si i, ẹ si ma rẹ̀, ki ẹ si kún aiye.
entries.en: And God blessed Noah and his sons, and said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth.

entries.yo: Ati ìbẹru nyin, ati ìfoya nyin, yio ma wà lara gbogbo ẹranko aiye, ati lara gbogbo ẹiyẹ oju-ọrun, ati lara gbogbo ohun ti nrakò ni ilẹ, ati lara gbogbo ẹja okun; ọwọ́ nyin li a fi wọn lé.
entries.en: And the fear of you and the dread of you shall be upon every beast of the earth, and upon every fowl of the air, upon all that moveth upon the earth, and upon all the fishes of the sea; into your hand are they delivered.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ohun alãye, ti nrakò, ni yio ma ṣe onjẹ fun nyin; gẹgẹ bi eweko tutu ni mo fi ohun gbogbo fun nyin.
entries.en: Every moving thing that liveth shall be meat for you; even as the green herb have I given you all things.

entries.yo: Kìki ẹran pẹlu ẹmi rẹ̀, ani ẹ̀jẹ rẹ̀, on li ẹnyin kò gbọdọ jẹ.
entries.en: But flesh with the life thereof, which is the blood thereof, shall ye not eat.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ ẹ̀jẹ nyin ani ẹmi nyin li emi o si bère; lọwọ gbogbo ẹranko li emi o bère rẹ̀, ati lọwọ enia, lọwọ arakunrin olukuluku enia li emi o bère ẹmi enia.
entries.en: And surely your blood of your lives will I require; at the hand of every beast will I require it, and at the hand of man; at the hand of every man's brother will I require the life of man.

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni ti o ba ta ẹ̀jẹ enia silẹ, lati ọwọ́ enia li a o si ta ẹ̀jẹ rẹ̀ silẹ: nitoripe li aworan Ọlọrun li o dá enia.
entries.en: Whoso sheddeth man's blood, by man shall his blood be shed: for in the image of God made he man.

entries.yo: Ati ẹnyin, ki ẹnyin ki o ma bí si i; ki ẹ si ma rẹ̀ si i, ki ẹ si ma gbá yìn lori ilẹ, ki ẹ si ma rẹ̀ ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And you, be ye fruitful, and multiply; bring forth abundantly in the earth, and multiply therein.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si wi fun Noa, ati fun awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ pẹlu rẹ̀, pe,
entries.en: And God spake unto Noah, and to his sons with him, saying,

entries.yo: Ati emi, kiye si i, emi ba nyin dá majẹmu mi, ati awọn irú-ọmọ nyin lẹhin nyin;
entries.en: And I, behold, I establish my covenant with you, and with your seed after you;

entries.yo: Ati gbogbo ẹdá alãye ti o wà pẹlu nyin; ti ẹiyẹ, ti ẹran-ọ̀sin, ati ẹranko aiye pélu nyin; lati gbogbo awọn ti o ti inu ọkọ̀ jade, titi o fi de gbogbo ẹranko aiye.
entries.en: And with every living creature that is with you, of the fowl, of the cattle, and of every beast of the earth with you; from all that go out of the ark, to every beast of the earth.

entries.yo: Emi o si ba nyin dá majẹmu mi; a ki yio si fi kíkun-omi ké gbogbo ẹdá kuro mọ́; bẹ̃ni kíkun-omi ki yio sí mọ́, lati pa aiye run.
entries.en: And I will establish my covenant with you; neither shall all flesh be cut off any more by the waters of a flood; neither shall there any more be a flood to destroy the earth.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si wipe, Eyiyi li àmi majẹmu mi ti mo ba nyin dá, ati gbogbo ẹdá alãye ti o wà pẹlu nyin, fun atirandiran:
entries.en: And God said, This is the token of the covenant which I make between me and you and every living creature that is with you, for perpetual generations:

entries.yo: Mo fi òṣumare mi si awọsanma, on ni yio si ma ṣe àmi majẹmu mi ti mo ba aiye dá.
entries.en: I do set my bow in the cloud, and it shall be for a token of a covenant between me and the earth.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, nigbati mo ba mu awọsanma wá si ori ilẹ, a o si ma ri òṣumare na li awọsanma:
entries.en: And it shall come to pass, when I bring a cloud over the earth, that the bow shall be seen in the cloud:

entries.yo: Emi o si ranti majẹmu mi, ti o wà lãrin emi ati ẹnyin, ati gbogbo ọkàn alãye ni gbogbo ẹdá; omi ki yio si di kíkun mọ́ lati pa gbogbo ẹdá run.
entries.en: And I will remember my covenant, which is between me and you and every living creature of all flesh; and the waters shall no more become a flood to destroy all flesh.

entries.yo: Òṣumare na yio si wà li awọsanma; emi o si ma wò o, ki emi le ma ranti majẹmu lailai ti o wà pẹlu Ọlọrun ati gbogbo ọkàn alãye ti o wà ninu gbogbo ẹdá ti o wà li aiye.
entries.en: And the bow shall be in the cloud; and I will look upon it, that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is upon the earth.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si wi fun Noa pe, Eyiyi li àmi majẹmu na, ti mo ba ara mi ati ẹdá gbogbo ti o wà lori ilẹ dá.
entries.en: And God said unto Noah, This is the token of the covenant, which I have established between me and all flesh that is upon the earth.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Noa, ti o si jade ninu ọkọ̀ ni Ṣemu, ati Hamu, ati Jafeti: Hamu si ni baba Kenaani.
entries.en: And the sons of Noah, that went forth of the ark, were Shem, and Ham, and Japheth: and Ham is the father of Canaan.

entries.yo: Awọn mẹta wọnyi li ọmọ Noa: lati ọdọ wọn li a gbé ti tàn ká gbogbo aiye.
entries.en: These are the three sons of Noah: and of them was the whole earth overspread.

entries.yo: Noa si bẹ̀rẹ si iṣe àgbẹ, o si gbìn ọgbà-àjara:
entries.en: And Noah began to be an husbandman, and he planted a vineyard:

entries.yo: O si mu ninu ọti-waini na, o mu amupara; o si tú ara rẹ̀ si ìhoho ninu agọ́ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he drank of the wine, and was drunken; and he was uncovered within his tent.

entries.yo: Hamu, baba Kenaani, si ri ìhoho baba rẹ̀, o si sọ fun awọn arakunrin rẹ̀ meji lode.
entries.en: And Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brethren without.

entries.yo: Ati Ṣemu ati Jafeti mu gọgọwu, nwọn si fi le ejika awọn mejeji, nwọn si fi ẹhin rìn, nwọn si bò ìhoho baba wọn; oju wọn si wà lẹhin; nwọn kò si ri ìhoho baba wọn.
entries.en: And Shem and Japheth took a garment, and laid it upon both their shoulders, and went backward, and covered the nakedness of their father; and their faces were backward, and they saw not their father's nakedness.

entries.yo: Noa si jí kuro li oju ọti-waini rẹ̀, o si mọ̀ ohun ti ọmọ rẹ̀ kekere ṣe si i.
entries.en: And Noah awoke from his wine, and knew what his younger son had done unto him.

entries.yo: O si wipe, Egbe ni fun Kenaani; iranṣẹ awọn iranṣẹ ni yio ma ṣe fun awọn arakunrin rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he said, Cursed be Canaan; a servant of servants shall he be unto his brethren.

entries.yo: O si wipe, Olubukun li OLUWA Ọlọrun Ṣemu; Kenaani yio ma ṣe iranṣẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he said, Blessed be the LORD God of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun yio mu Jafeti gbilẹ, yio si ma gbé agọ́ Ṣemu; Kenaani yio si ma ṣe iranṣẹ wọn.
entries.en: God shall enlarge Japheth, and he shall dwell in the tents of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant.

entries.yo: Noa si wà ni irinwo ọdun o din ãdọta, lẹhin ìkún-omi.
entries.en: And Noah lived after the flood three hundred and fifty years.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ọjọ́ Noa jẹ ẹgbẹrun ọdún o dí ãdọta: o si kú.
entries.en: And all the days of Noah were nine hundred and fifty years: and he died.

entries.yo: IRAN awọn ọmọ Noa ni wọnyi, Ṣemu, Hamu, ati Jafeti: ati fun wọn li a si bí ọmọ lẹhin kíkun-omi.
entries.en: Now these are the generations of the sons of Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth: and unto them were sons born after the flood.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Jafeti; Gomeri, ati Magogu, ati Madai, ati Jafani, ati Tubali, ati Meṣeki, ati Tirasi.
entries.en: The sons of Japheth; Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Gomeri, Aṣkenasi, ati Rifati, ati Togarma.
entries.en: And the sons of Gomer; Ashkenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Jafani; Eliṣa, ati Tarṣiṣi, Kittimu, ati Dodanimu.
entries.en: And the sons of Javan; Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.

entries.yo: Lati ọdọ awọn wọnyi li a ti pín erekuṣu awọn orilẹ-ède ni ilẹ wọn, olukuluku gẹgẹ bi ohùn rẹ̀; gẹgẹ bi idile wọn, li orilẹ-ède wọn.
entries.en: By these were the isles of the Gentiles divided in their lands; every one after his tongue, after their families, in their nations.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Hamu; Kuṣi, ati Misraimu, ati Futi, ati Kenaani.
entries.en: And the sons of Ham; Cush, and Mizraim, and Phut, and Canaan.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Kuṣi; Seba, ati Hafila, ati Sabta, ati Raama, ati Sabteka; ati awọn ọmọ Raama; Ṣeba, ati Dedani.
entries.en: And the sons of Cush; Seba, and Havilah, and Sabtah, and Raamah, and Sabtecha: and the sons of Raamah; Sheba, and Dedan.

entries.yo: Kuṣi si bí Nimrodu: on si bẹ̀rẹ si idi alagbara li aiye.
entries.en: And Cush begat Nimrod: he began to be a mighty one in the earth.

entries.yo: On si ṣe ogbóju ọdẹ niwaju OLUWA: nitori na li a ṣe nwipe, Gẹgẹ bi Nimrodu ogbóju ọdẹ niwaju OLUWA.
entries.en: He was a mighty hunter before the LORD: wherefore it is said, Even as Nimrod the mighty hunter before the LORD.

entries.yo: Ipilẹṣẹ ijọba rẹ̀ ni Babeli, ati Ereki, ati Akkadi, ati Kalne, ni ilẹ Ṣinari.
entries.en: And the beginning of his kingdom was Babel, and Erech, and Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.

entries.yo: Lati ilẹ na ni Aṣṣuri ti jade lọ, o si tẹ̀ Ninefe, ati ilu Rehoboti, ati Kala dó.
entries.en: Out of that land went forth Asshur, and builded Nineveh, and the city Rehoboth, and Calah,

entries.yo: Ati Reseni lagbedemeji Ninefe on Kala: eyi na ni ilu nla.
entries.en: And Resen between Nineveh and Calah: the same is a great city.

entries.yo: Misraimu si bí Ludimu, ati Anamimu, ati Lehabimu, ati Naftuhimu,
entries.en: And Mizraim begat Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,

entries.yo: Ati Patrusimu, ati Kasluhimu (lati ọdọ ẹniti Filistimu ti wá), ati Kaftorimu.
entries.en: And Pathrusim, and Casluhim, (out of whom came Philistim,) and Caphtorim.

entries.yo: Kenaani si bí Sidoni akọbi rẹ̀, ati Heti,
entries.en: And Canaan begat Sidon his firstborn, and Heth,

entries.yo: Ati awọn ara Jebusi, ati awọn ara Amori, ati awọn ara Girgaṣi,
entries.en: And the Jebusite, and the Amorite, and the Girgasite,

entries.yo: Ati awọn ara Hiffi, ati awọn ara Arki, ati awọn ara Sini,
entries.en: And the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,

entries.yo: Ati awọn ara Arfadi, ati awọn ara Semari, ati awọn ara Hamati; lẹhin eyini ni idile awọn ara Kenaani tàn kalẹ.
entries.en: And the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite: and afterward were the families of the Canaanites spread abroad.

entries.yo: Ati àgbegbe awọn ara Kenaani ni Sidoni, bi o ti mbọ̀wa Gerari, titi de Gasa; bi o ti nlọ si Sodomu, ati Gomorra, ati Adma, ati Seboimu, titi dé Laṣa.
entries.en: And the border of the Canaanites was from Sidon, as thou comest to Gerar, unto Gaza; as thou goest, unto Sodom, and Gomorrah, and Admah, and Zeboim, even unto Lasha.

entries.yo: Awọn wọnyi li ọmọ Hamu, gẹgẹ bi idile wọn, gẹgẹ bi ohùn wọn, ni ilẹ wọn, ati li orilẹ-ède wọn.
entries.en: These are the sons of Ham, after their families, after their tongues, in their countries, and in their nations.

entries.yo: Fun Ṣemu pẹlu, baba gbogbo awọn ọmọ Eberi, ẹgbọn Jafeti ati fun on li a bimọ.
entries.en: Unto Shem also, the father of all the children of Eber, the brother of Japheth the elder, even to him were children born.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Ṣemu: Elamu, ati Aṣṣuri, ati Arfaksadi, ati Ludi, ati Aramu.
entries.en: The children of Shem; Elam, and Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Aramu; Usi, ati Huli, ati Geteri, ati Maṣi.
entries.en: And the children of Aram; Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Mash.

entries.yo: Arfaksadi si bí Ṣela; Ṣela si bí Eberi.
entries.en: And Arphaxad begat Salah; and Salah begat Eber.

entries.yo: Ati fun Eberi li a bí ọmọkunrin meji; orukọ ekini ni Pelegi; nitori nigba ọjọ́ rẹ̀ ni ilẹ yà; orukọ arakunrin rẹ̀ ni Joktani.
entries.en: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of one was Peleg; for in his days was the earth divided; and his brother's name was Joktan.

entries.yo: Joktani si bí Almodadi, ati Ṣelefi, ati Hasarmafeti, ati Jera,
entries.en: And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazar-maveth, and Jerah,

entries.yo: Ati Hadoramu, ati Usali, ati Dikla,
entries.en: And Hadoram, and Uzal, and Diklah,

entries.yo: Ati Obali, ati Abimaeli, ati Ṣeba,
entries.en: And Obal, and Abimael, and Sheba,

entries.yo: Ati Ofiri, ati Hafila, ati Jobabu: gbogbo awọn wọnyi li ọmọ Joktani.
entries.en: And Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab: all these were the sons of Joktan.

entries.yo: Ibugbe wọn si ti Meṣa lọ, bi iwọ ti nlọ si Sefari, oke kan ni ìla-õrùn.
entries.en: And their dwelling was from Mesha, as thou goest unto Sephar a mount of the east.

entries.yo: Awọn wọnyi li ọmọ Ṣemu, gẹgẹ bi idile wọn, gẹgẹ bi ohùn wọn, ni ilẹ wọn, li orilẹ-ède wọn.
entries.en: These are the sons of Shem, after their families, after their tongues, in their lands, after their nations.

entries.yo: Wọnyi ni idile awọn ọmọ Noa, gẹgẹ bi iran wọn, li orilẹ-ède wọn: lati ọwọ́ awọn wọnyi wá li a ti pín orilẹ-ède aiye lẹhin kíkun-omi.
entries.en: These are the families of the sons of Noah, after their generations, in their nations: and by these were the nations divided in the earth after the flood.

entries.yo: GBOGBO aiye si jẹ ède kan, ati ọ̀rọ kan.
entries.en: And the whole earth was of one language, and of one speech.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, bi nwọn ti nrìn lati ìha ìla-õrùn lọ, ti nwọn ri pẹtẹlẹ kan ni ilẹ Ṣinari; nwọn si tẹdo sibẹ̀.
entries.en: And it came to pass, as they journeyed from the east, that they found a plain in the land of Shinar; and they dwelt there.

entries.yo: Nwọn si wi, ikini si ekeji pe, Ẹ wá na, ẹ jẹ ki a mọ briki, ki a si sun wọn jina. Briki ni nwọn ni li okuta, ọ̀da-ilẹ ni nwọn si nfi ṣe ọ̀rọ.
entries.en: And they said one to another, Go to, let us make brick, and burn them throughly. And they had brick for stone, and slime had they for morter.

entries.yo: Nwọn si wipe, Ẹ wá na, ẹ jẹ ki a tẹ̀ ilu kan dó, ki a si mọ ile-iṣọ kan, ori eyiti yio si kàn ọrun; ki a si li orukọ, ki a má ba tuka kiri sori ilẹ gbogbo.
entries.en: And they said, Go to, let us build us a city and a tower, whose top may reach unto heaven; and let us make us a name, lest we be scattered abroad upon the face of the whole earth.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọkalẹ wá iwò ilu ati ile-iṣọ́ na, ti awọn ọmọ enia nkọ́.
entries.en: And the LORD came down to see the city and the tower, which the children of men builded.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wipe, Kiye si i, ọkan li awọn enia, ède kan ni gbogbo wọn ni; eyi ni nwọn bẹ̀rẹ si iṣe: njẹ nisisiyi kò sí ohun ti a o le igbà lọwọ wọn ti nwọn ti rò lati ṣe.
entries.en: And the LORD said, Behold, the people is one, and they have all one language; and this they begin to do: and now nothing will be restrained from them, which they have imagined to do.

entries.yo: Ẹ wá na, ẹ jẹ ki a sọkalẹ lọ, ki a dà wọn li ède rú nibẹ̀, ki nwọn ki o máṣe gbedè ara wọn mọ́.
entries.en: Go to, let us go down, and there confound their language, that they may not understand one another's speech.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li OLUWA tú wọn ká lati ibẹ̀ lọ si ori ilẹ gbogbo: nwọn si ṣíwọ ilu ti nwọn ntẹdó.
entries.en: So the LORD scattered them abroad from thence upon the face of all the earth: and they left off to build the city.

entries.yo: Nitorina li a ṣe npè orukọ ilu na ni Babeli; nitori ibẹ̀ li OLUWA gbe dà ède araiye rú, lati ibẹ̀ lọ OLUWA si tú wọn ká kiri si ori ilẹ gbogbo.
entries.en: Therefore is the name of it called Babel; because the LORD did there confound the language of all the earth: and from thence did the LORD scatter them abroad upon the face of all the earth.

entries.yo: Wọnyi ni iran Ṣemu: Ṣemu jẹ ẹni ọgọrun ọdún, o si bí Arfaksadi li ọdún keji lẹhin kíkun-omi.
entries.en: These are the generations of Shem: Shem was an hundred years old, and begat Arphaxad two years after the flood:

entries.yo: Ṣemu si wà li ẹ̃dẹgbẹta ọdún, lẹhin igbati o bí Arfaksadi tan, o si bí ọmọkunrin ati ọmọbinrin.
entries.en: And Shem lived after he begat Arphaxad five hundred years, and begat sons and daughters.

entries.yo: Arfaksadi si wà li arundilogoji ọdún, o si bí Ṣela:
entries.en: And Arphaxad lived five and thirty years, and begat Salah:

entries.yo: Arfaksadi si wà ni irinwo ọdún o le mẹta, lẹhin igbati o bí Ṣela tan, o si bí ọmọkunrin ati ọmọbinrin.
entries.en: And Arphaxad lived after he begat Salah four hundred and three years, and begat sons and daughters.

entries.yo: Ṣela si wà ni ọgbọ̀n ọdún, o si bí Eberi:
entries.en: And Salah lived thirty years, and begat Eber:

entries.yo: Ṣela si wà ni irinwo ọdún o le mẹta lẹhin ti o bí Eberi tan, o si bí ọmọkunrin ati ọmọbinrin.
entries.en: And Salah lived after he begat Eber four hundred and three years, and begat sons and daughters.

entries.yo: Eberi si wà li ọgbọ̀n ọdún o le mẹrin, o si bí Pelegi:
entries.en: And Eber lived four and thirty years, and begat Peleg:

entries.yo: Eberi si wà ni irinwo ọdún o le ọgbọ̀n lẹhin igbati o bí Pelegi tan, o si bí ọmọkunrin ati ọmọbinrin.
entries.en: And Eber lived after he begat Peleg four hundred and thirty years, and begat sons and daughters.

entries.yo: Pelegi si wà li ọgbọ̀n ọdún, o si bì Reu:
entries.en: And Peleg lived thirty years, and begat Reu:

entries.yo: Pelegi si wà ni igba ọdún o le mẹsan lẹhin igbati o bí Reu tan, o si bí ọmọkunrin ati ọmọbinrin.
entries.en: And Peleg lived after he begat Reu two hundred and nine years, and begat sons and daughters.

entries.yo: Reu si wà li ọgbọ̀n ọdún o le meji, o si bí Serugu:
entries.en: And Reu lived two and thirty years, and begat Serug:

entries.yo: Reu si wà ni igba ọdún o le meje, lẹhin igbati o bí Serugu tan, o si bí ọmọkunrin ati ọmọbinrin.
entries.en: And Reu lived after he begat Serug two hundred and seven years, and begat sons and daughters.

entries.yo: Serugu si wà li ọgbọ̀n ọdún, o si bí Nahori:
entries.en: And Serug lived thirty years, and begat Nahor:

entries.yo: Serugu si wà ni igba ọdún, lẹhin igba ti o bí Nahori tan, o si bí ọmọkunrin ati ọmọbinrin.
entries.en: And Serug lived after he begat Nahor two hundred years, and begat sons and daughters.

entries.yo: Nahori si jẹ ẹni ọdún mọkanlelọgbọ̀n o si bí Tera:
entries.en: And Nahor lived nine and twenty years, and begat Terah:

entries.yo: Nahori si wà li ọgọfa ọdún o dí ọkan, lẹhin igbati o bí Tera tan, o si bí ọmọkunrin ati ọmọbinrin.
entries.en: And Nahor lived after he begat Terah an hundred and nineteen years, and begat sons and daughters.

entries.yo: Tera si wà li ãdọrin ọdún, o si bí Abramu, Nahori, ati Harani.
entries.en: And Terah lived seventy years, and begat Abram, Nahor, and Haran.

entries.yo: Iran Tera si li eyi: Tera bi Abramu, Nahori, ati Harani; Harani si bí Loti.
entries.en: Now these are the generations of Terah: Terah begat Abram, Nahor, and Haran; and Haran begat Lot.

entries.yo: Harani si kú ṣaju Tera baba rẹ̀, ni ilẹ ibi rẹ̀, ni Uri ti Kaldea.
entries.en: And Haran died before his father Terah in the land of his nativity, in Ur of the Chaldees.

entries.yo: Ati Abramu ati Nahor si fẹ aya fun ara wọn: orukọ aya Abramu ni Sarai; ati orukọ aya Nahori ni Milka, ọmọbinrin Harani, baba Milka, ati baba Iska.
entries.en: And Abram and Nahor took them wives: the name of Abram's wife was Sarai; and the name of Nahor's wife, Milcah, the daughter of Haran, the father of Milcah, and the father of Iscah.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Sarai yàgan; kò li ọmọ.
entries.en: But Sarai was barren; she had no child.

entries.yo: Tera si mu Abramu ọmọ rẹ̀, ati Loti, ọmọ Harani, ọmọ ọmọ rẹ̀, ati Sarai aya ọmọ rẹ̀, aya Abramu ọmọ rẹ̀; nwọn si ba wọn jade kuro ni Uri ti Kaldea, lati lọ si ilẹ Kenaani; nwọn si wá titi de Harani, nwọn si joko sibẹ̀.
entries.en: And Terah took Abram his son, and Lot the son of Haran his son's son, and Sarai his daughter in law, his son Abram's wife; and they went forth with them from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan; and they came unto Haran, and dwelt there.

entries.yo: Ọjọ́ Tera si jẹ igba ọdún o le marun: Tera si kú ni Harani.
entries.en: And the days of Terah were two hundred and five years: and Terah died in Haran.

entries.yo: OLUWA si ti wi fun Abramu pe, Jade kuro ni ilẹ rẹ, ati kuro lọdọ awọn ara rẹ, ati kuro ni ile baba rẹ, si ilẹ kan ti emi o fi hàn ọ:
entries.en: Now the LORD had said unto Abram, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and from thy father's house, unto a land that I will shew thee:

entries.yo: Emi o si sọ ọ di orilẹ-ède nla, emi o si busi i fun ọ, emi o si sọ orukọ rẹ di nla; ibukun ni iwọ o si jasi:
entries.en: And I will make of thee a great nation, and I will bless thee, and make thy name great; and thou shalt be a blessing:

entries.yo: Emi o bukun fun awọn ti nsúre fun ọ, ẹniti o nfi ọ ré li emi o si fi ré; ninu rẹ li a o ti bukun fun gbogbo idile aiye.
entries.en: And I will bless them that bless thee, and curse him that curseth thee: and in thee shall all families of the earth be blessed.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li Abramu lọ, bi OLUWA ti sọ fun u; Loti si ba a lọ: Abramu si jẹ ẹni arundilọgọrin ọdún nigbati o jade ni Harani.
entries.en: So Abram departed, as the LORD had spoken unto him; and Lot went with him: and Abram was seventy and five years old when he departed out of Haran.

entries.yo: Abramu si mu Sarai aya rẹ̀, ati Loti ọmọ arakunrin rẹ̀, ati gbogbo ini wọn ti nwọn kojọ, enia gbogbo ti nwọn ni ni Harani, nwọn si jade lati lọ si ilẹ Kenaani; ni ilẹ Kenaani ni nwọn si wá si.
entries.en: And Abram took Sarai his wife, and Lot his brother's son, and all their substance that they had gathered, and the souls that they had gotten in Haran; and they went forth to go into the land of Canaan; and into the land of Canaan they came.

entries.yo: Abramu si là ilẹ na kọja lọ si ibi ti a npè ni Ṣekemu, si igbo More. Awọn ara Kenaani si wà ni ilẹ na ni ìgba na.
entries.en: And Abram passed through the land unto the place of Sichem, unto the plain of Moreh. And the Canaanite was then in the land.

entries.yo: OLUWA si fi ara hàn fun Abramu, o si wipe, Irú-ọmọ rẹ li emi o fi ilẹ yi fun: nibẹ̀ li o si tẹ́ pẹpẹ fun OLUWA ti o fi ara hàn a.
entries.en: And the LORD appeared unto Abram, and said, Unto thy seed will I give this land: and there builded he an altar unto the LORD, who appeared unto him.

entries.yo: O si ṣí kuro nibẹ̀ lọ si ori oke kan ni ìha ìla-õrùn Beteli, o si pa agọ́ rẹ̀, Beteli ni ìwọ-õrùn ati Hai ni ìla-õrùn: o si tẹ́ pẹpẹ kan nibẹ̀ fun OLUWA, o si kepè orukọ OLUWA.
entries.en: And he removed from thence unto a mountain on the east of Bethel, and pitched his tent, having Bethel on the west, and Hai on the east: and there he builded an altar unto the LORD, and called upon the name of the LORD.

entries.yo: Abramu si nrìn lọ, o nlọ si ìha gusù sibẹ̀.
entries.en: And Abram journeyed, going on still toward the south.

entries.yo: Ìyan kan si mu ni ilẹ na: Abramu si sọkalẹ lọ si Egipti lati ṣe atipo nibẹ̀; nitoriti ìyan na mu gidigidi ni ilẹ na.
entries.en: And there was a famine in the land: and Abram went down into Egypt to sojourn there; for the famine was grievous in the land.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati o kù si dẹ̀dẹ lati wọ̀ Egipti, o wi fun Sarai aya rẹ̀ pe, Kiyesi i nisisiyi, emi mọ̀ pe arẹwà obinrin lati wò ni iwọ:
entries.en: And it came to pass, when he was come near to enter into Egypt, that he said unto Sarai his wife, Behold now, I know that thou art a fair woman to look upon:

entries.yo: Nitorina yio si ṣe, nigbati awọn ara Egipti yio ri ọ, nwọn o wipe, aya rẹ̀ li eyi: nwọn o si pa mi, ṣugbọn nwọn o dá ọ si.
entries.en: Therefore it shall come to pass, when the Egyptians shall see thee, that they shall say, This is his wife: and they will kill me, but they will save thee alive.

entries.yo: Mo bẹ̀ ọ, wipe, arabinrin mi ni iwọ iṣe: ki o le irọ̀ mi lọrùn nitori rẹ; ọkàn mi yio si yè nitori rẹ.
entries.en: Say, I pray thee, thou art my sister: that it may be well with me for thy sake; and my soul shall live because of thee.

entries.yo: O si ṣe nigbati Abramu de Egipti, awọn ara Egipti wò obinrin na pe arẹwà enia gidigidi ni.
entries.en: And it came to pass, that, when Abram was come into Egypt, the Egyptians beheld the woman that she was very fair.

entries.yo: Awọn ijoye Farao pẹlu ri i, nwọn si ròhin rẹ̀ niwaju Farao; a si mu obinrin na lọ si ile Farao.
entries.en: The princes also of Pharaoh saw her, and commended her before Pharaoh: and the woman was taken into Pharaoh's house.

entries.yo: O si nṣikẹ Abramu gidigidi nitori rẹ̀: on si li agutan, ati akọ-malu, ati akọ-kẹtẹkẹtẹ, ati iranṣẹkunrin ati iranṣẹbinrin, abo-kẹtẹkẹtẹ, ati ibakasiẹ.
entries.en: And he entreated Abram well for her sake: and he had sheep, and oxen, and he asses, and menservants, and maidservants, and she asses, and camels.

entries.yo: OLUWA si fi iyọnu nla yọ Farao ati awọn ara ile rẹ̀ li ẹnu, nitori Sarai aya Abramu.
entries.en: And the LORD plagued Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai Abram's wife.

entries.yo: Farao si pè Abramu, o wipe, ewo li eyiti iwọ ṣe si mi yi? ẽṣe ti iwọ kò fi wi fun mi pe, aya rẹ ni iṣe?
entries.en: And Pharaoh called Abram, and said, What is this that thou hast done unto me? why didst thou not tell me that she was thy wife?

entries.yo: Ẽṣe ti iwọ fi wipe, arabinrin mi ni iṣe? bẹ̃li emi iba fẹ ẹ li aya mi si: njẹ nisisiyi wò aya rẹ, mu u, ki o si ma ba tirẹ lọ.
entries.en: Why saidst thou, She is my sister? so I might have taken her to me to wife: now therefore behold thy wife, take her, and go thy way.

entries.yo: Farao si paṣẹ fun awọn ọkunrin rẹ̀ nitori Abramu: nwọn si sìn i jade lọ, ati aya rẹ̀, ati ohun gbogbo ti o ni.
entries.en: And Pharaoh commanded his men concerning him: and they sent him away, and his wife, and all that he had.

entries.yo: ABRAMU si goke lati Egipti wá, on, ati aya rẹ̀, ati ohun gbogbo ti o ni, ati Loti pẹlu rẹ̀, si ìha gusu.
entries.en: And Abram went up out of Egypt, he, and his wife, and all that he had, and Lot with him, into the south.

entries.yo: Abramu si là gidigidi, li ẹran-ọ̀sin, ni fadaka, ati ni wurà.
entries.en: And Abram was very rich in cattle, in silver, and in gold.

entries.yo: O si nrìn ìrin rẹ̀ lati ìha gusu lọ titi o si fi de Beteli, de ibi ti agọ́ rẹ̀ ti wà ni iṣaju, lagbedemeji Beteli on Hai.
entries.en: And he went on his journeys from the south even to Bethel, unto the place where his tent had been at the beginning, between Bethel and Hai;

entries.yo: Si ibi pẹpẹ ti o ti tẹ́ nibẹ̀ ni iṣaju: nibẹ̀ li Abramu si nkepè orukọ OLUWA.
entries.en: Unto the place of the altar, which he had made there at the first: and there Abram called on the name of the LORD.

entries.yo: Ati Loti pẹlu, ti o ba Abramu lọ, ni agbo-ẹran, ati ọwọ́-ẹran, ati agọ́.
entries.en: And Lot also, which went with Abram, had flocks, and herds, and tents.

entries.yo: Ilẹ na kò si le igbà wọn, ki nwọn ki o le igbé pọ̀: nitori ini wọn pọ̀, bẹ̃nì nwọn kò si le gbé pọ̀.
entries.en: And the land was not able to bear them, that they might dwell together: for their substance was great, so that they could not dwell together.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni gbolohùn asọ̀ si wà lãrin awọn darandaran Abramu, ati awọn darandaran Loti: ati awọn ara Kenaani ati awọn enia Perissi ngbé ilẹ na ni ìgba na.
entries.en: And there was a strife between the herdmen of Abram's cattle and the herdmen of Lot's cattle: and the Canaanite and the Perizzite dwelled then in the land.

entries.yo: Abramu si wi fun Loti pe, Emi bẹ̀ ọ, máṣe jẹ ki gbolohùn asọ̀ ki o wà lãrin temi tirẹ, ati lãrin awọn darandaran mi, ati awọn darandaran rẹ; nitori pe ará li awa iṣe.
entries.en: And Abram said unto Lot, Let there be no strife, I pray thee, between me and thee, and between my herdmen and thy herdmen; for we be brethren.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ilẹ kọ́ eyi niwaju rẹ? emi bẹ̀ ọ, yà ara rẹ kuro lọdọ mi: bi iwọ ba pọ̀ si apa òsi, njẹ emi o pọ̀ si ọtún; tabi bi iwọ ba pọ̀ si apa ọtùn, njẹ emi o pọ̀ si òsi.
entries.en: Is not the whole land before thee? separate thyself, I pray thee, from me: if thou wilt take the left hand, then I will go to the right; or if thou depart to the right hand, then I will go to the left.
