entries.yo: Loti si gboju rẹ̀ si oke, o si wò gbogbo àgbegbe Jordani, pe o li omi nibi gbogbo, ki OLUWA ki o to pa Sodomu on Gomorra run, bi ọgbà OLUWA, bi ilẹ Egipti, bi iwọ ti mbọ̀wa si Soari.
entries.en: And Lot lifted up his eyes, and beheld all the plain of Jordan, that it was well watered every where, before the LORD destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah, even as the garden of the LORD, like the land of Egypt, as thou comest unto Zoar.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Loti yàn gbogbo àgbegbe Jordani fun ara rẹ̀; Loti si nrìn lọ si ìha ìla-õrùn: bẹ̃ni nwọn yà ara wọn, ekini kuro lọdọ ekeji.
entries.en: Then Lot chose him all the plain of Jordan; and Lot journeyed east: and they separated themselves the one from the other.

entries.yo: Abramu si joko ni ilẹ Kenaani, Loti si joko ni ilu àgbegbe nì, o si pagọ́ rẹ̀ titi de Sodomu.
entries.en: Abram dwelled in the land of Canaan, and Lot dwelled in the cities of the plain, and pitched his tent toward Sodom.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn ọkunrin Sodomu ṣe enia buburu, ati ẹlẹṣẹ gidigidi niwaju OLUWA.
entries.en: But the men of Sodom were wicked and sinners before the LORD exceedingly.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun Abramu, lẹhin igbati Loti yà kuro lọdọ rẹ̀ tan pe, Gbé oju rẹ soke nisisiyi, ki o si wò lati ibi ti o gbé wà nì lọ, si ìha ariwa, ati si ìha gusu, si ìha ìla-õrùn, ati si ìha ìwọ-õrùn:
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Abram, after that Lot was separated from him, Lift up now thine eyes, and look from the place where thou art northward, and southward, and eastward, and westward:

entries.yo: Gbogbo ilẹ ti o ri nì, iwọ li emi o sa fi fun ati fun irú-ọmọ rẹ lailai.
entries.en: For all the land which thou seest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed for ever.

entries.yo: Emi o si ṣe irú-ọmọ rẹ bi erupẹ ilẹ: tobẹ̃ bi o ba ṣepe enia kan ba le kà iye erupẹ ilẹ, on li a o to le kaye irú-ọmọ rẹ pẹlu.
entries.en: And I will make thy seed as the dust of the earth: so that if a man can number the dust of the earth, then shall thy seed also be numbered.

entries.yo: Dide, rìn ilẹ na já ni ìna rẹ̀, ati ni ibú rẹ̀; nitori iwọ li emi o fi fun.
entries.en: Arise, walk through the land in the length of it and in the breadth of it; for I will give it unto thee.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Abramu ṣí agọ́ rẹ̀, o si wá o si joko ni igbo Mamre, ti o wà ni Hebroni, o si tẹ́ pẹpẹ kan nibẹ̀ fun OLUWA.
entries.en: Then Abram removed his tent, and came and dwelt in the plain of Mamre, which is in Hebron, and built there an altar unto the LORD.

entries.yo: O SI ṣe li ọjọ́ Amrafeli ọba Ṣinari, Arioku ọba Ellasari, Kedorlaomeri ọba Elamu, ati Tidali ọba awọn orilẹ-ède;
entries.en: And it came to pass in the days of Amraphel king of Shinar, Arioch king of Ellasar, Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Tidal king of nations;

entries.yo: Ti nwọn ba Bera ọba Sodomu jagun, pẹlu Birṣa ọba Gomorra, Ṣinabu ọba Adma, ati Semeberi ọba Seboimu, pẹlu ọba Bela (eyini ni Soari).
entries.en: That these made war with Bera king of Sodom, and with Birsha king of Gomorrah, Shinab king of Admah, and Shemeber king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela, which is Zoar.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn wọnyi li o dapọ̀ li afonifoji Siddimu, ti iṣe Okun Iyọ̀.
entries.en: All these were joined together in the vale of Siddim, which is the salt sea.

entries.yo: Nwọn sìn Kedorlaomeri li ọdún mejila, li ọdún kẹtala nwọn ṣọ̀tẹ.
entries.en: Twelve years they served Chedorlaomer, and in the thirteenth year they rebelled.

entries.yo: Li ọdún kẹrinla ni Kedorlaomeri, wá ati awọn ọba ti o wà pẹlu rẹ̀, nwọn kọlu awọn Refaimu ni Aṣteroti-Karnaimu, ati awọn Susimu ni Hamu, ati awọn Emimu ni pẹtẹlẹ Kiriataimu,
entries.en: And in the fourteenth year came Chedorlaomer, and the kings that were with him, and smote the Rephaims in Ashteroth Karnaim, and the Zuzims in Ham, and the Emims in Shaveh Kiriathaim,

entries.yo: Ati awọn ara Hori li oke Seiri wọn, titi o fi de igbo Parani, ti o wà niha ijù.
entries.en: And the Horites in their mount Seir, unto El-paran, which is by the wilderness.

entries.yo: Nwọn si pada, nwọn si wá si Enmiṣpati, eyini ni Kadeṣi, nwọn si kọlu gbogbo oko awọn ara Amaleki, ati awọn ara Amori ti o tẹdo ni Hasesontamari pẹlu.
entries.en: And they returned, and came to En-mishpat, which is Kadesh, and smote all the country of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites that dwelt in Hazezon-tamar.

entries.yo: Ọba Sodomu si jade, ati ọba Gomorra, ati ọba Adma, ati ọba Seboimu, ati ọba Bela, (eyini ni Soari;) nwọn si tẹgun si ara wọn li afonifoji Siddimu;
entries.en: And there went out the king of Sodom, and the king of Gomorrah, and the king of Admah, and the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (the same is Zoar;) and they joined battle with them in the vale of Siddim;

entries.yo: Si Kedorlaomeri ọba Elamu, ati si Tidali ọba awọn orilẹ-ède, ati Amrafeli ọba Ṣinari, ati Arioku ọba Ellasari, ọba mẹrin si marun.
entries.en: With Chedorlaomer the king of Elam, and with Tidal king of nations, and Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Ellasar; four kings with five.

entries.yo: Afonifoji Siddimu si jẹ kìki kòto ọ̀da-ilẹ; awọn ọba Sodomu ati ti Gomorra sá, nwọn si ṣubu nibẹ̀; awọn ti o si kù sálọ si ori oke.
entries.en: And the vale of Siddim was full of slimepits; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and fell there; and they that remained fled to the mountain.

entries.yo: Nwọn si kó gbogbo ẹrù Sodomu on Gomorra ati gbogbo onjẹ wọn, nwọn si ba ti wọn lọ.
entries.en: And they took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah, and all their victuals, and went their way.

entries.yo: Nwọn si mu Loti, ọmọ arakunrin Abramu, ti ngbé Sodomu, nwọn si kó ẹrù rẹ̀, nwọn si lọ.
entries.en: And they took Lot, Abram's brother's son, who dwelt in Sodom, and his goods, and departed.

entries.yo: Ẹnikan ti o sá asalà de, o si rò fun Abramu Heberu nì; on sa tẹdo ni igbo Mamre ara Amori, arakunrin Eṣkoli ati arakunrin Aneri: awọn wọnyi li o mba Abramu ṣe pọ̀.
entries.en: And there came one that had escaped, and told Abram the Hebrew; for he dwelt in the plain of Mamre the Amorite, brother of Eschol, and brother of Aner: and these were confederate with Abram.

entries.yo: Nigbati Abramu gbọ́ pe a dì arakunrin on ni igbekun, o kó awọn ọmọ ọdọ rẹ̀ ti a ti kọ́, ti a bí ni ile rẹ̀ jade, ọrindinirinwo enia o din meji, o si lepa wọn de Dani.
entries.en: And when Abram heard that his brother was taken captive, he armed his trained servants, born in his own house, three hundred and eighteen, and pursued them unto Dan.

entries.yo: O si pín ara rẹ̀, on, pẹlu awọn ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ̀, si wọn li oru, o si kọlù wọn, o si lépa wọn de Hoba, ti o wà li apa òsi Damasku:
entries.en: And he divided himself against them, he and his servants, by night, and smote them, and pursued them unto Hobah, which is on the left hand of Damascus.

entries.yo: O si gbà gbogbo ẹrù na pada, o si gbà Loti arakunrin rẹ̀ pada pẹlu, ati ẹrù rẹ̀, ati awọn obinrin pẹlu, ati awọn enia.
entries.en: And he brought back all the goods, and also brought again his brother Lot, and his goods, and the women also, and the people.

entries.yo: Ọba Sodomu si jade lọ ipade rẹ̀ li àbọ iṣẹgun Kedorlaomeri ati awọn ọba ti o pẹlu rẹ̀, li afonifoji Ṣafe, ti iṣe Afonifoji Ọba.
entries.en: And the king of Sodom went out to meet him after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer, and of the kings that were with him, at the valley of Shaveh, which is the king's dale.

entries.yo: Melkisedeki ọba Salemu si mu onjẹ ati ọti waini jade wá: on a si ma ṣe alufa Ọlọrun Ọga-ogo.
entries.en: And Melchizedek king of Salem brought forth bread and wine: and he was the priest of the most high God.

entries.yo: O si súre fun u, o si wipe, Ibukun ni fun Abramu, ti Ọlọrun ọga-ogo, ẹniti o ni ọrun on aiye.
entries.en: And he blessed him, and said, Blessed be Abram of the most high God, possessor of heaven and earth:

entries.yo: Olubukun si li Ọlọrun ọga-ogo ti o fi awọn ọta rẹ le ọ lọwọ. On si dá idamẹwa ohun gbogbo fun u.
entries.en: And blessed be the most high God, which hath delivered thine enemies into thy hand. And he gave him tithes of all.

entries.yo: Ọba Sodomu si wi fun Abramu pe, Dá awọn enia fun mi, ki o si mu ẹrù fun ara rẹ.
entries.en: And the king of Sodom said unto Abram, Give me the persons, and take the goods to thyself.

entries.yo: Abramu si wi fun ọba Sodomu pe, Mo ti gbé ọwọ́ mi soke si OLUWA, Ọlọrun ọga-ogo, ti o ni ọrun on aiye,
entries.en: And Abram said to the king of Sodom, I have lift up mine hand unto the LORD, the most high God, the possessor of heaven and earth,

entries.yo: Pe, emi ki yio mu lati fọnran owu titi dé okùn bàta, ati pe, emi kì yio mu ohun kan ti iṣe tirẹ, ki iwọ ki o má ba wipe, Mo sọ Abramu di ọlọrọ̀:
entries.en: That I will not take from a thread even to a shoelatchet, and that I will not take any thing that is thine, lest thou shouldest say, I have made Abram rich:

entries.yo: Bikoṣe kìki eyiti awọn ọdọmọkunrin ti jẹ, ati ipín ti awọn ọkunrin ti o ba mi lọ; Aneri, Eṣkoli, ati Mamre; jẹ ki nwọn ki o mu ipín ti wọn.
entries.en: Save only that which the young men have eaten, and the portion of the men which went with me, Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre; let them take their portion.

entries.yo: LẸHIN nkan wọnyi ọ̀rọ OLUWA tọ̀ Abramu wá li ojuran, wipe, Má bẹ̀ru, Abramu; Emi li asà rẹ, ère nla rẹ gidigidi.
entries.en: After these things the word of the LORD came unto Abram in a vision, saying, Fear not, Abram: I am thy shield, and thy exceeding great reward.

entries.yo: Abramu si wipe, OLUWA Ọlọrun, kini iwọ o fi fun mi, emi sa nlọ li ailọmọ, Elieseri ti Damasku yi si ni ẹniti o ni ile mi?
entries.en: And Abram said, Lord GOD, what wilt thou give me, seeing I go childless, and the steward of my house is this Eliezer of Damascus?

entries.yo: Abramu si wipe, Wo o emi ni iwọ kò fi irú-ọmọ fun: si wo o, ẹrú ti a bi ni ile mi ni yio jẹ arolé.
entries.en: And Abram said, Behold, to me thou hast given no seed: and, lo, one born in my house is mine heir.

entries.yo: Si wo o, ọ̀rọ OLUWA tọ̀ ọ wá, wipe, Eleyi ki yio ṣe arole rẹ; bikoṣe ẹniti yio ti inu ara rẹ jade, on ni yio ṣe arole rẹ.
entries.en: And, behold, the word of the LORD came unto him, saying, This shall not be thine heir; but he that shall come forth out of thine own bowels shall be thine heir.

entries.yo: O si mu u jade wá si gbangba, o si wi pe, Gboju wò oke ọrun nisisiyi, ki o si kà irawọ bi iwọ ba le kà wọn: o si wi fun u pe, Bẹ̃ni irú-ọmọ rẹ yio ri.
entries.en: And he brought him forth abroad, and said, Look now toward heaven, and tell the stars, if thou be able to number them: and he said unto him, So shall thy seed be.

entries.yo: O si gba OLUWA gbọ́; on si kà a si fun u li ododo.
entries.en: And he believed in the LORD; and he counted it to him for righteousness.

entries.yo: O si wi fun u pe, Emi li OLUWA ti o mu ọ jade lati Uri ti Kaldea wá, lati fi ilẹ yi fun ọ lati jogun rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he said unto him, I am the LORD that brought thee out of Ur of the Chaldees, to give thee this land to inherit it.

entries.yo: O si wipe, OLUWA Ọlọrun, nipa bawo li emi o fi mọ̀ pe emi o jogun rẹ̀?
entries.en: And he said, Lord GOD, whereby shall I know that I shall inherit it?

entries.yo: O si wi fun u pe, Mu ẹgbọrọ malu ọlọdun mẹta fun mi wá, ati ewurẹ ọlọdun mẹta, ati àgbo ọlọdun mẹta, ati oriri kan, ati ọmọ ẹiyẹle kan.
entries.en: And he said unto him, Take me an heifer of three years old, and a she goat of three years old, and a ram of three years old, and a turtledove, and a young pigeon.

entries.yo: O si mu gbogbo nkan wọnyi wá sọdọ rẹ̀, o si là wọn li agbedemeji, o si fi ẹ̀la ekini kọju si ekeji: bikoṣe awọn ẹiyẹ ni kò là.
entries.en: And he took unto him all these, and divided them in the midst, and laid each piece one against another: but the birds divided he not.

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn ẹiyẹ si sọkalẹ wá si ori okú wọnyi, Abramu lé wọn kuro.
entries.en: And when the fowls came down upon the carcases, Abram drove them away.

entries.yo: O si ṣe nigbati õrùn nwọ̀ lọ, orun ìjika kùn Abramu; si kiyesi i, ẹ̀ru bà a, òkunkun biribiri si bò o.
entries.en: And when the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell upon Abram; and, lo, an horror of great darkness fell upon him.

entries.yo: On si wi fun Abramu pe, Mọ̀ nitõtọ pe irú-ọmọ rẹ yio ṣe alejo ni ilẹ ti ki iṣe ti wọn, nwọn o si sìn wọn, nwọn o si jẹ wọn ni íya ni irinwo ọdún;
entries.en: And he said unto Abram, Know of a surety that thy seed shall be a stranger in a land that is not theirs, and shall serve them; and they shall afflict them four hundred years;

entries.yo: Ati orilẹ-ède na pẹlu ti nwọn o ma sìn, li emi o dá lẹjọ: lẹhin na ni nwọn o si jade ti awọn ti ọrọ̀ pipọ̀.
entries.en: And also that nation, whom they shall serve, will I judge: and afterward shall they come out with great substance.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si tọ̀ awọn baba rẹ lọ li alafia; li ogbologbo ọjọ́ li a o sin ọ.
entries.en: And thou shalt go to thy fathers in peace; thou shalt be buried in a good old age.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ni iran kẹrin, nwọn o si tun pada wá nihinyi: nitori ẹ̀ṣẹ awọn ara Amori kò ti ikún.
entries.en: But in the fourth generation they shall come hither again: for the iniquity of the Amorites is not yet full.

entries.yo: O si ṣe nigbati õrùn wọ̀, òkunkun si ṣú, kiyesi i ileru elẽfin, ati iná fitila ti nkọja lãrin ẹ̀la wọnni.
entries.en: And it came to pass, that, when the sun went down, and it was dark, behold a smoking furnace, and a burning lamp that passed between those pieces.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ́ na gan li OLUWA bá Abramu dá majẹmu pe, irú-ọmọ rẹ ni mo fi ilẹ yi fun, lati odò Egipti wá, titi o fi de odò nla nì, odò Euferate:
entries.en: In the same day the LORD made a covenant with Abram, saying, Unto thy seed have I given this land, from the river of Egypt unto the great river, the river Euphrates:

entries.yo: Awọn enia Keni, ati awọn enia Kenissi, ati awọn enia Kadmoni,
entries.en: The Kenites, and the Kenizzites, and the Kadmonites,

entries.yo: Ati awọn enia Hitti, ati awọn enia Perissi, ati awọn Refaimu,
entries.en: And the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the Rephaims,

entries.yo: Ati awọn enia Amori, ati awọn enia Kenaani, ati awọn Girgaṣi, ati awọn Jebusi.
entries.en: And the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Girgashites, and the Jebusites.

entries.yo: SARAI, aya Abramu, kò bímọ fun u: ṣugbọn o li ọmọ-ọdọ kan obinrin, ara Egipti, orukọ ẹniti ijẹ Hagari.
entries.en: Now Sarai Abram's wife bare him no children: and she had an handmaid, an Egyptian, whose name was Hagar.

entries.yo: Sarai si wi fun Abramu pe, kiyesi i na, OLUWA dá mi duro lati bímọ: emi bẹ̀ ọ, wọle tọ̀ ọmọbinrin ọdọ mi; o le ṣepe bọya emi a ti ipasẹ rẹ̀ li ọmọ. Abramu si gbà ohùn Sarai gbọ́.
entries.en: And Sarai said unto Abram, Behold now, the LORD hath restrained me from bearing: I pray thee, go in unto my maid; it may be that I may obtain children by her. And Abram hearkened to the voice of Sarai.

entries.yo: Sarai, aya Abramu, si mu Hagari ọmọbinrin ọdọ rẹ̀ ara Egipti na, lẹhin igbati Abramu gbé ilẹ Kenaani li ọdún mẹwa, o si fi i fun Abramu ọkọ rẹ̀ lati ma ṣe aya rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Sarai Abram's wife took Hagar her maid the Egyptian, after Abram had dwelt ten years in the land of Canaan, and gave her to her husband Abram to be his wife.

entries.yo: On si wọle tọ̀ Hagari, o si loyun: nigbati o ri pe on loyun, oluwa rẹ̀ obinrin wa di ẹ̀gan li oju rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he went in unto Hagar, and she conceived: and when she saw that she had conceived, her mistress was despised in her eyes.

entries.yo: Sarai si wi fun Abramu pe, Ẹbi mi wà lori rẹ: emi li o fi ọmọbinrin ọdọ mi fun ọ li àiya; nigbati o si ri pe on loyun, mo di ẹ̀gan li oju rẹ̀: ki OLUWA ki o ṣe idajọ lãrin temi tirẹ.
entries.en: And Sarai said unto Abram, My wrong be upon thee: I have given my maid into thy bosom; and when she saw that she had conceived, I was despised in her eyes: the LORD judge between me and thee.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Abramu wi fun Sarai pe, Wò o, ọmọbinrin ọdọ rẹ wà li ọwọ́ rẹ: fi i ṣe bi o ti tọ́ li oju rẹ. Nigbati Sarai nfõró rẹ̀, o sá lọ kuro lọdọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: But Abram said unto Sarai, Behold, thy maid is in thy hand; do to her as it pleaseth thee. And when Sarai dealt hardly with her, she fled from her face.

entries.yo: Angeli OLUWA si ri i li ẹba isun omi ni ijù, li ẹba isun omi li ọ̀na Ṣuri.
entries.en: And the angel of the LORD found her by a fountain of water in the wilderness, by the fountain in the way to Shur.

entries.yo: O si wipe, Hagari ọmọbinrin ọdọ Sarai, nibo ni iwọ ti mbọ̀? nibo ni iwọ si nrè? O si wipe, emi sá kuro niwaju Sarai oluwa mi.
entries.en: And he said, Hagar, Sarai's maid, whence camest thou? and whither wilt thou go? And she said, I flee from the face of my mistress Sarai.

entries.yo: Angeli OLUWA na si wi fun u pe, Pada, lọ si ọdọ oluwa rẹ, ki o si tẹriba fun u.
entries.en: And the angel of the LORD said unto her, Return to thy mistress, and submit thyself under her hands.

entries.yo: Angeli OLUWA na si wi fun u pe, Ni bíbi emi o mu iru-ọmọ rẹ bísi i, a ki yio si le kà wọn fun ọ̀pọlọpọ.
entries.en: And the angel of the LORD said unto her, I will multiply thy seed exceedingly, that it shall not be numbered for multitude.

entries.yo: Angeli OLUWA na si wi fun u pe, kiyesi i iwọ loyun, iwọ o si bí ọmọkunrin, iwọ o si sọ orukọ rẹ̀ ni Iṣmaeli; nitoriti OLUWA ti gbọ́ ohùn arò rẹ.
entries.en: And the angel of the LORD said unto her, Behold, thou art with child, and shalt bear a son, and shalt call his name Ishmael; because the LORD hath heard thy affliction.

entries.yo: Jagidijagan enia ni yio si ṣe; ọwọ́ rẹ̀ yio wà lara enia gbogbo, ọwọ́ enia gbogbo yio si wà lara rẹ̀: on o si ma gbé iwaju gbogbo awọn arakunrin rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he will be a wild man; his hand will be against every man, and every man's hand against him; and he shall dwell in the presence of all his brethren.

entries.yo: O si pè orukọ OLUWA ti o ba a sọ̀rọ ni, Iwọ Ọlọrun ti o ri mi: nitori ti o wipe, Emi ha wá ẹniti o ri mi kiri nihin?
entries.en: And she called the name of the LORD that spake unto her, Thou God seest me: for she said, Have I also here looked after him that seeth me?

entries.yo: Nitori na li a ṣe npè kanga na ni Beer-lahai-roi: kiyesi i, o wà li agbedemeji Kadeṣi on Beredi.
entries.en: Wherefore the well was called Beer-lahai-roi; behold, it is between Kadesh and Bered.

entries.yo: Hagari si bí ọmọkunrin kan fun Abramu: Abramu si pè orukọ ọmọ ti Hagari bí ni Iṣmaeli.
entries.en: And Hagar bare Abram a son: and Abram called his son's name, which Hagar bare, Ishmael.

entries.yo: Abramu si jẹ ẹni ẹrindilãdọrun ọdún, nigbati Hagari bí Iṣmaeli fun Abramu.
entries.en: And Abram was fourscore and six years old, when Hagar bare Ishmael to Abram.

entries.yo: NIGBATI Abramu si di ẹni ọkandilọgọrun ọdún, OLUWA farahàn Abramu, o si wi fun u pe, Emi li Ọlọrun Olodumare; mã rìn niwaju mi, ki iwọ ki o si pé.
entries.en: And when Abram was ninety years old and nine, the LORD appeared to Abram, and said unto him, I am the Almighty God; walk before me, and be thou perfect.

entries.yo: Emi o si ba ọ dá majẹmu mi, emi o si sọ ọ di pupọ̀ gidigidi.
entries.en: And I will make my covenant between me and thee, and will multiply thee exceedingly.

entries.yo: Abramu si dojubolẹ; Ọlọrun si ba a sọ̀rọ pe,
entries.en: And Abram fell on his face: and God talked with him, saying,

entries.yo: Bi o ṣe ti emi ni, kiyesi i, majẹmu mi wà pẹlu rẹ, iwọ o si ṣe baba orilẹ-ède pupọ̀.
entries.en: As for me, behold, my covenant is with thee, and thou shalt be a father of many nations.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li a ki yio si pe orukọ rẹ ni Abramu mọ́, bikoṣe Abrahamu li orukọ rẹ yio jẹ; nitoriti mo ti sọ ọ di baba orilẹ-ède pupọ̀.
entries.en: Neither shall thy name any more be called Abram, but thy name shall be Abraham; for a father of many nations have I made thee.

entries.yo: Emi o si mu ọ bí si i pupọpupọ, ọ̀pọ orilẹ-ède li emi o si mu ti ọdọ rẹ wá, ati awọn ọba ni yio ti inu rẹ jade wá.
entries.en: And I will make thee exceeding fruitful, and I will make nations of thee, and kings shall come out of thee.

entries.yo: Emi o si gbe majẹmu mi kalẹ lãrin temi tirẹ, ati lãrin irú-ọmọ rẹ lẹhin rẹ ni iran-iran wọn, ni majẹmu aiyeraiye, lati ma ṣe Ọlọrun rẹ, ati ti irú-ọmọ rẹ lẹhin rẹ.
entries.en: And I will establish my covenant between me and thee and thy seed after thee in their generations for an everlasting covenant, to be a God unto thee, and to thy seed after thee.

entries.yo: Emi o si fi ilẹ ti iwọ ṣe alejo nibẹ̀ fun ọ, ati fun irú-ọmọ rẹ lẹhin rẹ, gbogbo ilẹ Kenaani ni iní titi lailai; emi o si ma ṣe Ọlọrun wọn.
entries.en: And I will give unto thee, and to thy seed after thee, the land wherein thou art a stranger, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession; and I will be their God.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si wi fun Abrahamu pe, Nitorina ki iwọ ki o ma pa majẹmu mi mọ́, iwọ, ati irú-ọmọ rẹ lẹhin rẹ ni iran-iran wọn.
entries.en: And God said unto Abraham, Thou shalt keep my covenant therefore, thou, and thy seed after thee in their generations.

entries.yo: Eyi ni majẹmu mi, ti ẹnyin o ma pamọ́ lãrin temi ti nyin, ati lãrin irú-ọmọ rẹ, lẹhin rẹ; gbogbo ọmọkunrin inu nyin li a o kọ ni ilà.
entries.en: This is my covenant, which ye shall keep, between me and you and thy seed after thee; Every man child among you shall be circumcised.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin o si kọ ara nyin ni ilà; on ni yio si ṣe àmi majẹmu lãrin temi ti nyin.
entries.en: And ye shall circumcise the flesh of your foreskin; and it shall be a token of the covenant betwixt me and you.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba si di ọmọkunrin ijọ mẹjọ ninu nyin li a o kọ ni ilà, gbogbo ọmọkunrin ni iran-iran nyin, ati ẹniti a bí ni ile, tabi ti a fi owo rà lọwọ alejo, ti ki iṣe irú-ọmọ rẹ.
entries.en: And he that is eight days old shall be circumcised among you, every man child in your generations, he that is born in the house, or bought with money of any stranger, which is not of thy seed.

entries.yo: Ẹniti a bí ni ile rẹ, ati ẹniti a fi owo rẹ rà, a kò le ṣe alaikọ ọ ni ilà: bẹ̃ni majẹmu mi yio si wà li ara nyin ni majẹmu aiyeraiye.
entries.en: He that is born in thy house, and he that is bought with thy money, must needs be circumcised: and my covenant shall be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant.

entries.yo: Ati ọmọkunrin alaikọlà ti a kò kọ ni ilà ara rẹ̀, ọkàn na li a o si ké kuro ninu awọn enia rẹ̀, o dà majẹmu mi.
entries.en: And the uncircumcised man child whose flesh of his foreskin is not circumcised, that soul shall be cut off from his people; he hath broken my covenant.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si wi fun Abrahamu pe, Bi o ṣe ti Sarai, aya rẹ nì, iwọ ki yio pè orukọ rẹ̀ ni Sarai mọ́, bikoṣe Sara li orukọ rẹ̀ yio ma jẹ.
entries.en: And God said unto Abraham, As for Sarai thy wife, thou shalt not call her name Sarai, but Sarah shall her name be.

entries.yo: Emi o si busi i fun u, emi o si bùn ọ li ọmọkunrin kan pẹlu lati ọdọ rẹ̀ wá, bẹ̃li emi o si busi i fun u, on o si ṣe iya ọ̀pọ orilẹ-ède; awọn ọba enia ni yio ti ọdọ rẹ̀ wá.
entries.en: And I will bless her, and give thee a son also of her: yea, I will bless her, and she shall be a mother of nations; kings of people shall be of her.

entries.yo: Nigbana li Abrahamu dojubolẹ, o si rẹrin, o si wi li ọkàn rẹ̀ pe, A o ha bímọ fun ẹni ọgọrun ọdún? Sara ti iṣe ẹni ãdọrun ọdún yio ha bímọ bi?
entries.en: Then Abraham fell upon his face, and laughed, and said in his heart, Shall a child be born unto him that is an hundred years old? and shall Sarah, that is ninety years old, bear?

entries.yo: Abrahamu si wi fun Ọlọrun pe, Ki Iṣmaeli ki o wà lãye niwaju rẹ!
entries.en: And Abraham said unto God, O that Ishmael might live before thee!

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si wipe, Sara, aya rẹ, yio bí ọmọkunrin kan fun ọ nitõtọ; iwọ o si sọ orukọ rẹ̀ ni Isaaki: emi o fi idi majẹmu mi mulẹ pẹlu rẹ̀, ni majẹmu aiyeraiye, ati pẹlu irú-ọmọ rẹ̀ lẹhin rẹ̀.
entries.en: And God said, Sarah thy wife shall bear thee a son indeed; and thou shalt call his name Isaac: and I will establish my covenant with him for an everlasting covenant, and with his seed after him.

entries.yo: Emi si ti gbọ́ adura rẹ fun Iṣmaeli: kiyesi i, emi o si busi i fun u, emi o si mu u bisi i, emi o si sọ ọ di pupọ̀ gidigidi; ijoye mejila ni on o bí, emi o si sọ ọ di orilẹ-ède nla:
entries.en: And as for Ishmael, I have heard thee: Behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly; twelve princes shall he beget, and I will make him a great nation.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn majẹmu mi li emi o ba Isaaki dá, ẹniti Sara yio bí fun ọ li akoko iwoyi amọ́dun.
entries.en: But my covenant will I establish with Isaac, which Sarah shall bear unto thee at this set time in the next year.

entries.yo: O si fi i silẹ li ọ̀rọ iba a sọ, Ọlọrun si lọ soke kuro lọdọ Abrahamu.
entries.en: And he left off talking with him, and God went up from Abraham.

entries.yo: Abrahamu si mu Iṣmaeli, ọmọ rẹ̀ ọkunrin, ati gbogbo awọn ọmọ-ọdọ ọkunrin ti a bí ni ile rẹ̀, ati gbogbo awọn ti a fi owo rẹ̀ rà, gbogbo ẹniti iṣe ọkunrin ninu awọn enia ile Abrahamu; o si kọ wọn ni ilà ara li ọjọ́ na gan, bi Ọlọrun ti sọ fun u.
entries.en: And Abraham took Ishmael his son, and all that were born in his house, and all that were bought with his money, every male among the men of Abraham's house; and circumcised the flesh of their foreskin in the selfsame day, as God had said unto him.

entries.yo: Abrahamu si jẹ ẹni ọkandilọgọrun ọdún, nigbati a kọ ọ ni ilà ara rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Abraham was ninety years old and nine, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.

entries.yo: Ati Iṣmaeli ọmọ rẹ̀ ọkunrin jẹ ẹni ọdún mẹtala nigbati a kọ ọ ni ilà ara rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Ishmael his son was thirteen years old, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ́ na gan li a kọ Abrahamu ni ilà, ati Iṣmaeli ọmọ rẹ̀ ọkunrin.
entries.en: In the selfsame day was Abraham circumcised, and Ishmael his son.

entries.yo: Ati gbogbo awọn ọkunrin ile rẹ̀, ti a bi ninu ile rẹ̀, ati ti a si fi owo rà lọwọ alejò, ni a kọ ni ilà pẹlu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And all the men of his house, born in the house, and bought with money of the stranger, were circumcised with him.

entries.yo: OLUWA si farahàn a ni igbo Mamre: on si joko li ẹnu-ọ̀na agọ́ ni imõru ọjọ́:
entries.en: And the LORD appeared unto him in the plains of Mamre: and he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day;

entries.yo: O si gbé oju rẹ̀ soke, o wò, si kiyesi i, ọkunrin mẹta duro li ẹba ọdọ rẹ̀: nigbati o si ri wọn, o sure lati ẹnu-ọ̀na agọ́ lọ ipade wọn, o si tẹriba silẹ.
entries.en: And he lift up his eyes and looked, and, lo, three men stood by him: and when he saw them, he ran to meet them from the tent door, and bowed himself toward the ground,

entries.yo: O si wipe, OLUWA mi, njẹ bi mo ba ri ore-ọfẹ li oju rẹ, emi bẹ̀ ọ, máṣe kọja lọ kuro lọdọ ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ:
entries.en: And said, My Lord, if now I have found favour in thy sight, pass not away, I pray thee, from thy servant:

entries.yo: Jẹ ki a mu omi diẹ wá nisisiyi, ki ẹnyin ki o si wẹ̀ ẹsẹ̀ nyin, ki ẹnyin ki o si simi labẹ igi:
entries.en: Let a little water, I pray you, be fetched, and wash your feet, and rest yourselves under the tree:

entries.yo: Emi o si mu onjẹ diẹ wá, ki ẹnyin si fi ọkàn nyin balẹ; lẹhin eyini ki ẹnyin ma kọja lọ: njẹ nitorina li ẹnyin ṣe tọ̀ ọmọ-ọdọ nyin wá. Nwọn si wipe, Ṣe bẹ̃ bi iwọ ti wi.
entries.en: And I will fetch a morsel of bread, and comfort ye your hearts; after that ye shall pass on: for therefore are ye come to your servant. And they said, So do, as thou hast said.

entries.yo: Abrahamu si yara tọ̀ Sara lọ ninu agọ́, o wipe, Yara mu òṣuwọn iyẹfun daradara mẹta, ki o pò o, ki o si dín akara.
entries.en: And Abraham hastened into the tent unto Sarah, and said, Make ready quickly three measures of fine meal, knead it, and make cakes upon the hearth.

entries.yo: Abrahamu si sure lọ sinu agbo, o si mu ẹgbọrọ-malu kan ti o rọ̀ ti o dara, o fi fun ọmọkunrin kan; on si yara lati sè e.
entries.en: And Abraham ran unto the herd, and fetcht a calf tender and good, and gave it unto a young man; and he hasted to dress it.

entries.yo: O si mu orí-amọ́, ati wàra, ati ẹgbọrọ malu ti o sè, o si gbé e kalẹ niwaju wọn: on si duro tì wọn li abẹ igi na, nwọn si jẹ ẹ.
entries.en: And he took butter, and milk, and the calf which he had dressed, and set it before them; and he stood by them under the tree, and they did eat.

entries.yo: Nwọn si bi i pe, nibo ni Sara aya rẹ wà? o si wipe, wò o ninu agọ́.
entries.en: And they said unto him, Where is Sarah thy wife? And he said, Behold, in the tent.

entries.yo: O si wipe, Emi o si tun pada tọ̀ ọ wá nitõtọ ni iwoyi amọ́dun; si kiyesi i, Sara aya rẹ yio li ọmọkunrin kan. Sara si gbọ́ li ẹnu-ọ̀na agọ́ ti o wà lẹhin ọkunrin na.
entries.en: And he said, I will certainly return unto thee according to the time of life; and, lo, Sarah thy wife shall have a son. And Sarah heard it in the tent door, which was behind him.

entries.yo: Njẹ Abrahamu on Sara gbó, nwọn si pọ̀ li ọjọ́; o si dẹkun ati ma ri fun Sara bi ìwa obinrin.
entries.en: Now Abraham and Sarah were old and well stricken in age; and it ceased to be with Sarah after the manner of women.

entries.yo: Nitorina Sara rẹrin ninu ara rẹ̀ wipe, Lẹhin igbati mo di ogbologbo tan, emi o ha li ayọ̀, ti oluwa mi si di ogbologbo pẹlu?
entries.en: Therefore Sarah laughed within herself, saying, After I am waxed old shall I have pleasure, my lord being old also?

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun Abrahamu pe, Nitori kini Sara ṣe nrẹrin wipe, Emi o ha bímọ nitõtọ, ẹniti o ti gbó tán?
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Abraham, Wherefore did Sarah laugh, saying, Shall I of a surety bear a child, which am old?

entries.yo: Ohun kan ha ṣoro fun OLUWA? li akoko ti a dá emi o pada tọ̀ ọ wa, ni iwoyi amọ́dun, Sara yio si li ọmọkunrin kan.
entries.en: Is any thing too hard for the LORD? At the time appointed I will return unto thee, according to the time of life, and Sarah shall have a son.

entries.yo: Sara si sẹ, wipe, Emi kò rẹrin; nitoriti o bẹ̀ru. On si wipe, Bẹ̃kọ; ṣugbọn iwọ rẹrin.
entries.en: Then Sarah denied, saying, I laughed not; for she was afraid. And he said, Nay; but thou didst laugh.

entries.yo: Awọn ọkunrin na si dide kuro nibẹ̀, nwọn kọju sihà Sodomu: Abrahamu si ba wọn lọ lati sìn wọn de ọ̀na.
entries.en: And the men rose up from thence, and looked toward Sodom: and Abraham went with them to bring them on the way.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wipe, Emi o ha pa ohun ti emi o ṣe mọ́ fun Abrahamu:
entries.en: And the LORD said, Shall I hide from Abraham that thing which I do;

entries.yo: Nitori pe, Abrahamu yio sa di orilẹ-ède nla ati alagbara, ati gbogbo orilẹ-ède aiye li a o bukun fun nipasẹ rẹ̀?
entries.en: Seeing that Abraham shall surely become a great and mighty nation, and all the nations of the earth shall be blessed in him?

entries.yo: Nitoriti mo mọ̀ ọ pe, on o fi aṣẹ fun awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ ati fun awọn ara ile rẹ̀ lẹhin rẹ̀, ki nwọn ki o ma pa ọ̀na OLUWA mọ́ lati ṣe ododo ati idajọ; ki OLUWA ki o le mu ohun ti o ti sọ fun Abrahamu wá fun u.
entries.en: For I know him, that he will command his children and his household after him, and they shall keep the way of the LORD, to do justice and judgment; that the LORD may bring upon Abraham that which he hath spoken of him.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wipe, Nitori ti igbe Sodomu on Gomorra pọ̀, ati nitori ti ẹ̀ṣẹ wọn pàpọju.
entries.en: And the LORD said, Because the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great, and because their sin is very grievous;

entries.yo: Emi o sọkalẹ lọ nisisiyi, ki nri bi nwọn tilẹ ṣe, gẹgẹ bi okikí igbe rẹ̀, ti o de ọdọ mi; bi bẹ si kọ, emi o mọ̀.
entries.en: I will go down now, and see whether they have done altogether according to the cry of it, which is come unto me; and if not, I will know.

entries.yo: Awọn ọkunrin na si yi oju wọn pada kuro nibẹ̀, nwọn si lọ si Sodomu: ṣugbọn Abrahamu duro sibẹ̀ niwaju OLUWA.
entries.en: And the men turned their faces from thence, and went toward Sodom: but Abraham stood yet before the LORD.

entries.yo: Abrahamu si sunmọ ọdọ rẹ̀, o si wipe, Iwọ o ha run olododo pẹlu enia buburu?
entries.en: And Abraham drew near, and said, Wilt thou also destroy the righteous with the wicked?

entries.yo: Bọya ãdọta olododo yio wà ninu ilu na: iwọ o ha run u, iwọ ki yio ha dá ibẹ̀ na si nitori ãdọta olododo ti o wà ninu rẹ̀?
entries.en: Peradventure there be fifty righteous within the city: wilt thou also destroy and not spare the place for the fifty righteous that are therein?

entries.yo: O ha dára, ti iwọ o fi ṣe bi irú eyi, lati run olododo pẹlu enia buburu; ti awọn olododo yio fi dabi awọn enia buburu, o ha dára: Onidajọ gbogbo aiye ki yio ha ṣe eyi ti o tọ́?
entries.en: That be far from thee to do after this manner, to slay the righteous with the wicked: and that the righteous should be as the wicked, that be far from thee: Shall not the Judge of all the earth do right?

entries.yo: OLUWA si wipe, Bi mo ba ri ãdọta olododo ninu ilu Sodomu, njẹ emi o dá gbogbo ibẹ̀ si nitori wọn.
entries.en: And the LORD said, If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the city, then I will spare all the place for their sakes.

entries.yo: Abrahamu si dahùn o si wipe, Wò o nisisiyi, emi ti dawọle e lati ba OLUWA sọ̀rọ, emi ẹniti iṣe erupẹ ati ẽru.
entries.en: And Abraham answered and said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the Lord, which am but dust and ashes:

entries.yo: Bọya marun a dín ninu ãdọta olododo na: iwọ o ha run gbogbo ilu na nitori marun? On si wipe, Bi mo ba ri marunlelogoji nibẹ̀, emi ki yio run u.
entries.en: Peradventure there shall lack five of the fifty righteous: wilt thou destroy all the city for lack of five? And he said, If I find there forty and five, I will not destroy it.

entries.yo: O si tun sọ fun u ẹ̀wẹ, o ni, Bọya, a o ri ogoji nibẹ̀, On si wipe, Emi ki o run u nitori ogoji.
entries.en: And he spake unto him yet again, and said, Peradventure there shall be forty found there. And he said, I will not do it for forty's sake.

entries.yo: O si tun wipe, Jọ̃, ki inu ki o máṣe bi OLUWA, emi o si ma wi: bọya a o ri ọgbọ̀n nibẹ̀. On si wipe, Emi ki yio run u bi mo ba ri ọgbọ̀n nibẹ̀.
entries.en: And he said unto him, Oh let not the Lord be angry, and I will speak: Peradventure there shall thirty be found there. And he said, I will not do it, if I find thirty there.

entries.yo: O si wipe, Wò o na, emi ti dawọle e lati ba OLUWA sọ̀rọ: bọya a o ri ogun nibẹ̀. On si wipe, Emi ki yio run u nitori ogun.
entries.en: And he said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the Lord: Peradventure there shall be twenty found there. And he said, I will not destroy it for twenty's sake.

entries.yo: O si wipe, Jọ̃, ki inu ki o máṣe bi OLUWA, ẹ̃kanṣoṣo yi li emi o si wi mọ. Bọya a o ri mẹwa nibẹ̀. On si wipe, Emi ki yio run u nitori mẹwa.
entries.en: And he said, Oh let not the Lord be angry, and I will speak yet but this once: Peradventure ten shall be found there. And he said, I will not destroy it for ten's sake.

entries.yo: OLUWA si ba tirẹ̀ lọ, lojukanna bi o ti ba Abrahamu sọ̀rọ tan; Abrahamu si pada lọ si ibujoko rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the LORD went his way, as soon as he had left communing with Abraham: and Abraham returned unto his place.

entries.yo: AWỌN Angeli meji si wá si Sodomu li aṣalẹ; Loti si joko li ẹnu-bode Sodomu: bi Loti si ti ri wọn, o dide lati pade wọn: o si dojubolẹ;
entries.en: And there came two angels to Sodom at even; and Lot sat in the gate of Sodom: and Lot seeing them rose up to meet them; and he bowed himself with his face toward the ground;

entries.yo: O si wipe, Kiyesi i nisisiyi, ẹnyin oluwa mi, emi bẹ̀ nyin, ẹ yà si ile ọmọ-ọdọ nyin, ki ẹ si wọ̀, ki ẹ si wẹ̀ ẹsẹ̀ nyin, ẹnyin o si dide ni kùtukutu, ki ẹ si ma ba ti nyin lọ. Nwọn si wipe, Ndao; ṣugbọn awa o joko ni igboro li oru oni.
entries.en: And he said, Behold now, my lords, turn in, I pray you, into your servant's house, and tarry all night, and wash your feet, and ye shall rise up early, and go on your ways. And they said, Nay; but we will abide in the street all night.

entries.yo: O si rọ̀ wọn gidigidi; nwọn si yà tọ̀ ọ, nwọn si wọ̀ inu ile rẹ̀; o si sè àse fun wọn, o si dín àkara alaiwu fun wọn, nwọn si jẹ.
entries.en: And he pressed upon them greatly; and they turned in unto him, and entered into his house; and he made them a feast, and did bake unleavened bread, and they did eat.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ki nwọn ki o to dubulẹ, awọn ọkunrin ara ilu na, awọn ọkunrin Sodomu, nwọn yi ile na ká, ati àgba ati ewe, gbogbo enia lati ori igun mẹrẹrin wá.
entries.en: But before they lay down, the men of the city, even the men of Sodom, compassed the house round, both old and young, all the people from every quarter:

entries.yo: Nwọn si pè Loti, nwọn si bi i pe, Nibo li awọn ọkunrin ti o tọ̀ ọ wá li alẹ yi wà? mu wọn jade fun wa wá, ki awa ki o le mọ̀ wọn.
entries.en: And they called unto Lot, and said unto him, Where are the men which came in to thee this night? bring them out unto us, that we may know them.

entries.yo: Loti si jade tọ̀ wọn lọ li ẹnu-ọ̀na, o si sé ilẹkun lẹhin rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Lot went out at the door unto them, and shut the door after him,

entries.yo: O si wipe, Arakunrin, emi bẹ̀ nyin, ẹ máṣe hùwa buburu bẹ̃.
entries.en: And said, I pray you, brethren, do not so wickedly.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i nisisiyi, emi li ọmọbinrin meji ti kò ti imọ̀ ọkunrin: emi bẹ̀ nyin, ẹ jẹ ki nmu wọn jade tọ̀ nyin wá, ki ẹnyin ki o si fi wọn ṣe bi o ti tọ́ loju nyin: ṣugbọn awọn ọkunrin wọnyi ṣa ni ki ẹ má ṣe ni nkan; nitorina ni nwọn sa ṣe wá si abẹ orule mi.
entries.en: Behold now, I have two daughters which have not known man; let me, I pray you, bring them out unto you, and do ye to them as is good in your eyes: only unto these men do nothing; for therefore came they under the shadow of my roof.

entries.yo: Nwọn si wipe, Bì sẹhin. Nwọn si tun wipe, Eyiyi wá iṣe atipo, on si fẹ iṣe onidajọ: njẹ iwọ li a o tilẹ ṣe ni buburu jù wọn lọ. Nwọn si rọlù ọkunrin na, ani Loti, nwọn si sunmọ ọ lati fọ́ ilẹkun.
entries.en: And they said, Stand back. And they said again, This one fellow came in to sojourn, and he will needs be a judge: now will we deal worse with thee, than with them. And they pressed sore upon the man, even Lot, and came near to break the door.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn ọkunrin na nà ọwọ́ wọn, nwọn si fà Loti mọ́ ọdọ sinu ile, nwọn si tì ilẹkun.
entries.en: But the men put forth their hand, and pulled Lot into the house to them, and shut to the door.

entries.yo: Nwọn si bù ifọju lù awọn ọkunrin ti o wà li ẹnu-ọ̀na ile na, ati ewe ati àgba: bẹ̃ni nwọn dá ara wọn li agara lati ri ẹnu-ọ̀na.
entries.en: And they smote the men that were at the door of the house with blindness, both small and great: so that they wearied themselves to find the door.

entries.yo: Awọn ọkunrin na si wi fun Loti pe, Iwọ ni ẹnikan nihin pẹlu? ana rẹ ọkunrin, ati awọn ọmọ rẹ ọkunrin, ati awọn ọmọ rẹ obinrin, ati ohunkohun ti iwọ ni ni ilu, mu wọn jade kuro nihinyi:
entries.en: And the men said unto Lot, Hast thou here any besides? son in law, and thy sons, and thy daughters, and whatsoever thou hast in the city, bring them out of this place:

entries.yo: Nitori awa o run ibi yi, nitori ti igbe wọn ndi pupọ̀ niwaju OLUWA; OLUWA si rán wa lati run u.
entries.en: For we will destroy this place, because the cry of them is waxen great before the face of the LORD; and the LORD hath sent us to destroy it.

entries.yo: Loti si jade, o si sọ fun awọn ana rẹ̀ ọkunrin, ti nwọn gbe awọn ọmọbinrin rẹ̀ ni iyawo, o wipe, Ẹ dide, ẹ jade kuro nihinyi; nitoriti OLUWA yio run ilu yi. Ṣugbọn o dabi ẹlẹtàn loju awọn ana rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Lot went out, and spake unto his sons in law, which married his daughters, and said, Up, get you out of this place; for the LORD will destroy this city. But he seemed as one that mocked unto his sons in law.

entries.yo: Nigbati ọ̀yẹ si nla, nigbana li awọn angeli na le Loti ni ire wipe, Dide, mu aya rẹ, ati awọn ọmọbinrin rẹ mejeji ti o wà nihin; ki iwọ ki o má ba run ninu ìya ẹ̀ṣẹ ilu yi.
entries.en: And when the morning arose, then the angels hastened Lot, saying, Arise, take thy wife, and thy two daughters, which are here; lest thou be consumed in the iniquity of the city.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si nlọra, awọn ọkunrin na nawọ mu u li ọwọ́, ati ọwọ́ aya rẹ̀, ati ọwọ́ ọmọbinrin rẹ̀ mejeji; OLUWA sa ṣãnu fun u: nwọn si mu u jade, nwọn si fi i sẹhin odi ilu na.
entries.en: And while he lingered, the men laid hold upon his hand, and upon the hand of his wife, and upon the hand of his two daughters; the LORD being merciful unto him: and they brought him forth, and set him without the city.

entries.yo: O si ṣe nigbati nwọn mu wọn jade sẹhin odi tan, li o wipe, Sá asalà fun ẹmi rẹ; máṣe wò ẹhin rẹ, bẹ̃ni ki iwọ ki o máṣe duro ni gbogbo pẹtẹlẹ; sá asalà lọ si ori oke, ki iwọ ki o má ba ṣegbe.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when they had brought them forth abroad, that he said, Escape for thy life; look not behind thee, neither stay thou in all the plain; escape to the mountain, lest thou be consumed.

entries.yo: Loti si wi fun wọn pe, Bẹ̃kọ, oluwa mi:
entries.en: And Lot said unto them, Oh, not so, my Lord:

entries.yo: Kiyesi i na, ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ ti ri ore-ọfẹ gbà li oju rẹ, iwọ si ti gbe ãnu rẹ ga, ti iwọ ti fi hàn mi ni gbigbà ẹmi mi là; ṣugbọn emi ki yio le salọ si ori oke, ki ibi ki o má ba bá mi nibẹ̀, ki emi ki o má ba kú.
entries.en: Behold now, thy servant hath found grace in thy sight, and thou hast magnified thy mercy, which thou hast shewed unto me in saving my life; and I cannot escape to the mountain, lest some evil take me, and I die:

entries.yo: Kiyesi i na, ilu yi sunmọ tosi lati sá si, kekere si ni: jọ̃, jẹ ki nsalà si ibẹ, (kekere ha kọ?) ọkàn mi yio si yè.
entries.en: Behold now, this city is near to flee unto, and it is a little one: Oh, let me escape thither, (is it not a little one?) and my soul shall live.

entries.yo: O si wi fun u pe, Wò o, mo gbà fun ọ niti ohun kan yi pẹlu pe, emi ki yio run ilu yi, nitori eyiti iwọ ti sọ.
entries.en: And he said unto him, See, I have accepted thee concerning this thing also, that I will not overthrow this city, for the which thou hast spoken.

entries.yo: Yara, salà sibẹ̀; nitori emi kò le ṣe ohun kan titi iwọ o fi de ibẹ̀. Nitorina li a ṣe npè orukọ ilu na ni Soari.
entries.en: Haste thee, escape thither; for I cannot do any thing till thou be come thither. Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar.

entries.yo: Orùn là sori ilẹ nigbati Loti wọ̀ ilu Soari.
entries.en: The sun was risen upon the earth when Lot entered into Zoar.

entries.yo: Nigbana li OLUWA rọ̀jo sulfuri (okuta ina) ati iná lati ọdọ OLUWA lati ọrun wá si ori Sodomu on Gomorra:
entries.en: Then the LORD rained upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah brimstone and fire from the LORD out of heaven;

entries.yo: O si run ilu wọnni, ati gbogbo Pẹtẹlẹ, ati gbogbo awọn ara ilu wọnni, ati ohun ti o hù jade ni ilẹ.
entries.en: And he overthrew those cities, and all the plain, and all the inhabitants of the cities, and that which grew upon the ground.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn aya rẹ̀ bojuwò ẹhin lẹhin rẹ̀, o si di ọwọ̀n iyọ̀.
entries.en: But his wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.

entries.yo: Abrahamu si dide ni kutukutu owurọ̀, o lọ si ibi ti o gbé duro niwaju OLUWA:
entries.en: And Abraham gat up early in the morning to the place where he stood before the LORD:

entries.yo: O si wò ìha Sodomu on Gomorra, ati ìha gbogbo ilẹ àgbegbe wọnni, o si wò o, si kiyesi i, ẽfin ilẹ na rú soke bi ẽfin ileru.
entries.en: And he looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land of the plain, and beheld, and, lo, the smoke of the country went up as the smoke of a furnace.

entries.yo: O si ṣe nigbati Ọlọrun run ilu àgbegbe wọnni ni Ọlọrun ranti Abrahamu, o si rán Loti jade kuro lãrin iparun na, nigbati o run ilu wọnni ninu eyiti Loti gbé ti joko.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when God destroyed the cities of the plain, that God remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out of the midst of the overthrow, when he overthrew the cities in the which Lot dwelt.

entries.yo: Loti si jade kuro ni Soari: o si ngbé ori oke, ati awọn ọmọbinrin rẹ̀ mejeji pẹlu rẹ̀; nitoriti o bẹ̀ru ati gbé Soari: o si ngbé inu ihò, on ati awọn ọmọbinrin rẹ̀ mejeji.
entries.en: And Lot went up out of Zoar, and dwelt in the mountain, and his two daughters with him; for he feared to dwell in Zoar: and he dwelt in a cave, he and his two daughters.

entries.yo: Eyi akọbi si wi fun atẹle pe, Baba wa gbó, kò si sí ọkunrin kan li aiye mọ́ ti yio wọle tọ̀ wa wá gẹgẹ bi iṣe gbogbo aiye.
entries.en: And the firstborn said unto the younger, Our father is old, and there is not a man in the earth to come in unto us after the manner of all the earth:

entries.yo: Wá, jẹ ki a mu baba wa mu ọti-waini, awa o si sùn tì i, ki a le ni irú-ọmọ lati ọdọ baba wa.
entries.en: Come, let us make our father drink wine, and we will lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father.

entries.yo: Nwọn si mu baba wọn mu ọti-waini li oru na: eyi akọbi wọle tọ̀ ọ, o si sùn tì baba rẹ̀; on kò si mọ̀ igbati o dubulẹ, ati igbati o dide.
entries.en: And they made their father drink wine that night: and the firstborn went in, and lay with her father; and he perceived not when she lay down, nor when she arose.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, ni ijọ́ keji, ni ẹgbọn wi fun aburo pe, kiyesi i, emi sùn tì baba mi li oru aná: jẹ ki a si mu u mu ọti-waini li oru yi pẹlu: ki iwọ ki o si wọle, ki o si sùn tì i, ki awa ki o le ni irú-ọmọ lati ọdọ baba wa.
entries.en: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the firstborn said unto the younger, Behold, I lay yesternight with my father: let us make him drink wine this night also; and go thou in, and lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our Father.

entries.yo: Nwọn si mu baba wọn mu ọti-waini li oru na pẹlu: aburo si dide, o si sùn tì i, on kò si mọ̀ igbati o dubulẹ, ati igbati o dide.
entries.en: And they made their father drink wine that night also: and the younger arose, and lay with him; and he perceived not when she lay down, nor when she arose.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li awọn ọmọbinrin Loti mejeji loyun fun baba wọn.
entries.en: Thus were both the daughters of Lot with child by their father.

entries.yo: Eyi akọ́bi si bí ọmọkunrin kan, o si pè orukọ rẹ̀ ni Moabu: on ni baba awọn ara Moabu titi di oni.
entries.en: And the firstborn bare a son, and called his name Moab: the same is the father of the Moabites unto this day.

entries.yo: Eyi atẹle, on pẹlu si bí ọmọkunrin kan, o si pè orukọ rẹ̀ ni Ben-ammi: on ni baba awọn ọmọ Ammoni, titi di oni.
entries.en: And the younger, she also bare a son, and called his name Benammi: the same is the father of the children of Ammon unto this day.

entries.yo: ABRAHAMU si ṣí lati ibẹ̀ lọ si ilẹ ìha gusù, o si joko li agbedemeji Kadeṣi on Ṣuri; o si ṣe atipo ni Gerari.
entries.en: And Abraham journeyed from thence toward the south country, and dwelled between Kadesh and Shur, and sojourned in Gerar.

entries.yo: Abrahamu si wi niti Sara aya rẹ̀ pe, Arabinrin mi ni: Abimeleki ọba Gerari si ranṣẹ, o si mu Sara.
entries.en: And Abraham said of Sarah his wife, She is my sister: and Abimelech king of Gerar sent, and took Sarah.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Ọlọrun tọ̀ Abimeleki wá li ojuran li oru, o si wi fun u pe, kiyesi i, okú ni iwọ, nitori obinrin ti iwọ mu nì; nitori aya ọkunrin kan ni iṣe.
entries.en: But God came to Abimelech in a dream by night, and said to him, Behold, thou art but a dead man, for the woman which thou hast taken; for she is a man's wife.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Abimeleki kò sunmọ ọ: o si wipe, OLUWA, iwọ o run orilẹ-ède olododo pẹlu?
entries.en: But Abimelech had not come near her: and he said, Lord, wilt thou slay also a righteous nation?

entries.yo: On kọ ló ha wi fun mi pe arabinrin mi ni iṣe? on, obinrin tikalarẹ̀ si wipe, arakunrin mi ni: li otitọ inu ati alaiṣẹ̀ ọwọ́ mi, ni mo fi ṣe eyi.
entries.en: Said he not unto me, She is my sister? and she, even she herself said, He is my brother: in the integrity of my heart and innocency of my hands have I done this.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si wi fun u li ojuran pe, Bẹ̃ni, emi mọ̀ pe li otitọ inu rẹ ni iwọ ṣe eyi; nitorina li emi si ṣe dá ọ duro ki o má ba ṣẹ̀ mi: nitorina li emi kò ṣe jẹ ki iwọ ki o fọwọkàn a.
entries.en: And God said unto him in a dream, Yea, I know that thou didst this in the integrity of thy heart; for I also withheld thee from sinning against me: therefore suffered I thee not to touch her.

entries.yo: Njẹ nitori na mu aya ọkunrin na pada fun u; woli li on sa iṣe, on o si gbadura fun ọ, iwọ o si yè: bi iwọ kò ba si mu u pada, ki iwọ ki o mọ̀ pe, kikú ni iwọ o kú, iwọ, ati gbogbo ẹniti o jẹ tirẹ.
entries.en: Now therefore restore the man his wife; for he is a prophet, and he shall pray for thee, and thou shalt live: and if thou restore her not, know thou that thou shalt surely die, thou, and all that are thine.

entries.yo: Nitorina Abimeleki dide ni kutukutu owurọ̀, o si pè gbogbo awọn ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ̀, o si wi gbogbo nkan wọnyi li eti wọn: ẹ̀ru si bà awọn enia na gidigidi.
entries.en: Therefore Abimelech rose early in the morning, and called all his servants, and told all these things in their ears: and the men were sore afraid.

entries.yo: Nigbana li Abimeleki pè Abrahamu, o si wi fun u pe, Kili o ṣe si wa yi? ẹ̀ṣẹ kini mo ṣẹ̀ ọ, ti iwọ fi mu ẹ̀ṣẹ nla wá si ori mi, ati si ori ijọba mi? iwọ hùwa si mi ti a ki ba hù.
entries.en: Then Abimelech called Abraham, and said unto him, What hast thou done unto us? and what have I offended thee, that thou hast brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin? thou hast done deeds unto me that ought not to be done.

entries.yo: Abimeleki si wi fun Abrahamu pe, Kini iwọ ri, ti iwọ fi ṣe nkan yi?
entries.en: And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What sawest thou, that thou hast done this thing?

entries.yo: Abrahamu si wipe, Nitoriti mo rò pe, nitõtọ ẹ̀ru Ọlọrun kò sí nihinyi; nwọn o si pa mi nitori aya mi.
entries.en: And Abraham said, Because I thought, Surely the fear of God is not in this place; and they will slay me for my wife's sake.

entries.yo: Ati pẹlupẹlu nitõtọ arabinrin mi ni iṣe, ọmọbinrin baba mi ni, ṣugbọn ki iṣe ọmọbinrin iya mi; o si di aya mi.
entries.en: And yet indeed she is my sister; she is the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife.

entries.yo: O si ṣe nigbati Ọlọrun mu mi rìn kiri lati ile baba mi wá, on ni mo wi fun u pe, eyi ni ore rẹ ti iwọ o ma ṣe fun mi; nibikibi ti awa o gbé de, ma wi nipa ti emi pe, arakunrin mi li on.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when God caused me to wander from my father's house, that I said unto her, This is thy kindness which thou shalt shew unto me; at every place whither we shall come, say of me, He is my brother.

entries.yo: Abimeleki si mu agutan, ati akọmalu, ati iranṣẹkunrin, ati iranṣẹbinrin, o si fi wọn fun Abrahamu, o si mu Sara, aya rẹ̀, pada fun u.
entries.en: And Abimelech took sheep, and oxen, and menservants, and womenservants, and gave them unto Abraham, and restored him Sarah his wife.

entries.yo: Abimeleki si wipe, Kiyesi i, ilẹ mi niyi niwaju rẹ: joko nibiti o wù ọ.
entries.en: And Abimelech said, Behold, my land is before thee: dwell where it pleaseth thee.

entries.yo: O si wi fun Sara pe, Kiyesi i, mo fi ẹgbẹrun ìwọn fadaka fun arakunrin rẹ: kiyesi i, on ni ibojú fun ọ fun gbogbo awọn ti o wà lọdọ rẹ, ati niwaju gbogbo awọn ẹlomiran li a da ọ lare.
entries.en: And unto Sarah he said, Behold, I have given thy brother a thousand pieces of silver: behold, he is to thee a covering of the eyes, unto all that are with thee, and with all other: thus she was reproved.

entries.yo: Abrahamu si gbadura si Ọlọrun: Ọlọrun si mu Abimeleki li ara dá, ati aya rẹ̀, ati awọn ọmọbinrin-ọdọ rẹ̀; nwọn si bimọ.
entries.en: So Abraham prayed unto God: and God healed Abimelech, and his wife, and his maidservants; and they bare children.

entries.yo: Nitori OLUWA ti sé inu awọn ara ile Abimeleki pinpin, nitori ti Sara, aya Abrahamu.
entries.en: For the LORD had fast closed up all the wombs of the house of Abimelech, because of Sarah Abraham's wife.

entries.yo: OLUWA si bẹ̀ Sara wò bi o ti wi, OLUWA si ṣe fun Sara bi o ti sọ.
entries.en: And the LORD visited Sarah as he had said, and the LORD did unto Sarah as he had spoken.

entries.yo: Sara si loyun, o si bí ọmọkunrin kan fun Abrahamu li ogbologbo rẹ̀, li akokò igbati Ọlọrun dá fun u.
entries.en: For Sarah conceived, and bare Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him.

entries.yo: Abrahamu si pè orukọ ọmọ rẹ̀ ti a bí fun u, ni Isaaki, ẹniti Sara bí fun u.
entries.en: And Abraham called the name of his son that was born unto him, whom Sarah bare to him, Isaac.

entries.yo: Abrahamu si kọ Isaaki ọmọ rẹ̀ ni ilà, nigbati o di ọmọ ijọ́ mẹjọ, gẹgẹ bi Ọlọrun ti fi aṣẹ fun u.
entries.en: And Abraham circumcised his son Isaac being eight days old, as God had commanded him.

entries.yo: Abrahamu si jẹ ẹni ọgọrun ọdún, nigbati a bí Isaaki ọmọ rẹ̀ fun u.
entries.en: And Abraham was an hundred years old, when his son Isaac was born unto him.

entries.yo: Sara si wipe, Ọlọrun pa mi lẹrin; gbogbo ẹniti o gbọ́ yio si rẹrin pẹlu mi.
entries.en: And Sarah said, God hath made me to laugh, so that all that hear will laugh with me.

entries.yo: O si wipe, Tani iba wi fun Abrahamu pe, Sara yio fi ọmú fun ọmọ mu? mo sá bí ọmọ kan fun u li ogbologbo rẹ̀.
entries.en: And she said, Who would have said unto Abraham, that Sarah should have given children suck? for I have born him a son in his old age.

entries.yo: Ọmọ na si dàgba, a si já a li ẹnu ọmú: Abrahamu si sè àse nla li ọjọ́ na ti a já Isaaki li ẹnu ọmú.
entries.en: And the child grew, and was weaned: and Abraham made a great feast the same day that Isaac was weaned.

entries.yo: Sara si ri ọmọ Hagari, ara Egipti, ti o bí fun Abrahamu, o nfi i rẹrin.
entries.en: And Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, which she had born unto Abraham, mocking.

entries.yo: Nitorina li o ṣe wi fun Abrahamu pe, Lé ẹrubirin yi jade ti on ti ọmọ rẹ̀: nitoriti ọmọ ẹrubirin yi ki yio ṣe arole pẹlu Isaaki, ọmọ mi.
entries.en: Wherefore she said unto Abraham, Cast out this bondwoman and her son: for the son of this bondwoman shall not be heir with my son, even with Isaac.

entries.yo: Ọrọ yi si buru gidigidi li oju Abrahamu nitori ọmọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the thing was very grievous in Abraham's sight because of his son.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si wi fun Abrahamu pe, Máṣe jẹ ki o buru li oju rẹ nitori ọmọdekunrin na, ati nitori ẹrubirin rẹ; ni gbogbo eyiti Sara sọ fun ọ, fetisi ohùn rẹ̀; nitori ninu Isaaki li a o ti pè irú-ọmọ rẹ.
entries.en: And God said unto Abraham, Let it not be grievous in thy sight because of the lad, and because of thy bondwoman; in all that Sarah hath said unto thee, hearken unto her voice; for in Isaac shall thy seed be called.

entries.yo: Ati ọmọ ẹrubirin na pẹlu li emi o sọ di orilẹ-ède, nitori irú-ọmọ rẹ ni iṣe.
entries.en: And also of the son of the bondwoman will I make a nation, because he is thy seed.

entries.yo: Abrahamu si dide ni kutukutu owurọ̀, o mu àkara ati ìgo omi kan, o fi fun Hagari, o gbé e lé e li ejika, ati ọmọ na, o si lé e jade: on si lọ, o nrìn kakiri ni ijù Beer-ṣeba.
entries.en: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread, and a bottle of water, and gave it unto Hagar, putting it on her shoulder, and the child, and sent her away: and she departed, and wandered in the wilderness of Beer-sheba.

entries.yo: Omi na si tán ninu ìgo, o si sọ̀ ọmọ na si abẹ ìgboro kan.
entries.en: And the water was spent in the bottle, and she cast the child under one of the shrubs.

entries.yo: O si lọ, o joko kọju si i, li ọ̀na jijìn rére, o tó bi itafasi kan: nitori ti o wipe, Ki emi má ri ikú ọmọ na. O si joko kọju si i, o gbé ohùn rẹ̀ soke, o nsọkun.
entries.en: And she went, and sat her down over against him a good way off, as it were a bowshot: for she said, Let me not see the death of the child. And she sat over against him, and lift up her voice, and wept.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si gbọ́ ohùn ọmọdekunrin na: angeli Ọlọrun si pè Hagari lati ọrun wá, o bi i pe, Kili o ṣe ọ, Hagari? máṣe bẹ̀ru; nitori ti Ọlọrun ti gbọ́ ohùn ọmọdekunrin na nibiti o gbé wà.
entries.en: And God heard the voice of the lad; and the angel of God called Hagar out of heaven, and said unto her, What aileth thee, Hagar? fear not; for God hath heard the voice of the lad where he is.

entries.yo: Dide, gbé ọmọdekunrin na, ki o si dì i mu; nitori ti emi o sọ ọ di orilẹ-ède nla.
entries.en: Arise, lift up the lad, and hold him in thine hand; for I will make him a great nation.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si ṣí i li oju, o si ri kanga omi kan; o lọ, o si pọnmi kún ìgo na, o si fi fun ọmọdekunrin na mu.
entries.en: And God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water; and she went, and filled the bottle with water, and gave the lad drink.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si wà pẹlu ọmọdekunrin na; o si dàgba, o si joko ni ijù, o di tafatafa.
entries.en: And God was with the lad; and he grew, and dwelt in the wilderness, and became an archer.

entries.yo: O si joko ni ijù Parani: iya rẹ̀ si fẹ́ obinrin fun u lati ilẹ Egipti wá.
entries.en: And he dwelt in the wilderness of Paran: and his mother took him a wife out of the land of Egypt.

entries.yo: O si ṣe li akokò na, ni Abimeleki ati Fikoli, olori ogun rẹ̀, wi fun Abrahamu pe, Ọlọrun pẹlu rẹ ni gbogbo ohun ti iwọ nṣe.
entries.en: And it came to pass at that time, that Abimelech and Phichol the chief captain of his host spake unto Abraham, saying, God is with thee in all that thou doest:

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi fi Ọlọrun bura fun mi nihinyi pe iwọ ki yio ṣe ẹ̀tan si mi, tabi si ọmọ mi, tabi si ọmọ-ọmọ mi: ṣugbọn gẹgẹ bi iṣeun ti mo ṣe si ọ, bẹ̃ni iwọ o si ṣe si mi, ati si ilẹ ti iwọ ti ṣe atipo ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: Now therefore swear unto me here by God that thou wilt not deal falsely with me, nor with my son, nor with my son's son: but according to the kindness that I have done unto thee, thou shalt do unto me, and to the land wherein thou hast sojourned.

entries.yo: Abrahamu si wipe, emi o bura.
entries.en: And Abraham said, I will swear.

entries.yo: Abrahamu si ba Abimeleki wi nitori kanga omi kan, ti awọn ọmọ-ọdọ Abimeleki fi agbara gbà.
entries.en: And Abraham reproved Abimelech because of a well of water, which Abimelech's servants had violently taken away.

entries.yo: Abimeleki si wipe, emi kò mọ̀ ẹniti o ṣe nkan yi: bẹ̃ni iwọ kò sọ fun mi, bẹ̃li emi kò gbọ́, bikoṣe loni.
entries.en: And Abimelech said, I wot not who hath done this thing: neither didst thou tell me, neither yet heard I of it, but to day.

entries.yo: Abrahamu si mu agutan, ati akọmalu, o fi wọn fun Abimeleki; awọn mejeji si dá majẹmu.
entries.en: And Abraham took sheep and oxen, and gave them unto Abimelech; and both of them made a covenant.

entries.yo: Abrahamu si yà abo ọdọ-agutan meje ninu agbo si ọ̀tọ fun ara wọn.
entries.en: And Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.

entries.yo: Abimeleki si bi Abrahamu pe, kili a le mọ̀ abo ọdọ-agutan meje ti iwọ yà si ọ̀tọ fun ara wọn yi si?
entries.en: And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What mean these seven ewe lambs which thou hast set by themselves?

entries.yo: O si wipe, nitori abo ọdọ-agutan meje yi ni iwọ o gbà lọwọ mi, ki nwọn ki o le ṣe ẹrí mi pe, emi li o wà kanga yi.
entries.en: And he said, For these seven ewe lambs shalt thou take of my hand, that they may be a witness unto me, that I have digged this well.

entries.yo: Nitorina li o ṣe pè ibẹ̀ na ni Beer-ṣeba; nitori nibẹ̀ li awọn mejeji gbé bura.
entries.en: Wherefore he called that place Beer-sheba; because there they sware both of them.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni nwọn si dá majẹmu ni Beer-ṣeba: nigbana li Abimeleki dide, ati Fikoli, olori ogun rẹ̀, nwọn si pada lọ si ilẹ awọn ara Filistia.
entries.en: Thus they made a covenant at Beer-sheba: then Abimelech rose up, and Phichol the chief captain of his host, and they returned into the land of the Philistines.

entries.yo: Abrahamu si lọ́ igi tamariski kan ni Beer-ṣeba, nibẹ̀ li o si pè orukọ OLUWA, Ọlọrun Aiyeraiye.
entries.en: And Abraham planted a grove in Beer-sheba, and called there on the name of the LORD, the everlasting God.

entries.yo: Abrahamu si ṣe atipo ni ilẹ awọn ara Filistia li ọjọ́ pupọ̀.
entries.en: And Abraham sojourned in the Philistines' land many days.

entries.yo: O si ṣe lẹhin nkan wọnyi ni Ọlọrun dan Abrahamu wò, o si wi fun u pe, Abrahamu: on si dahùn pe, Emi niyi.
entries.en: And it came to pass after these things, that God did tempt Abraham, and said unto him, Abraham: and he said, Behold, here I am.

entries.yo: O si wi fun u pe, Mu ọmọ rẹ nisisiyi, Isaaki, ọmọ rẹ na kanṣoṣo, ti iwọ fẹ́, ki iwọ ki o si lọ si ilẹ Moria; ki o si fi i rubọ sisun nibẹ̀ lori ọkan ninu oke ti emi o sọ fun ọ.
entries.en: And he said, Take now thy son, thine only son Isaac, whom thou lovest, and get thee into the land of Moriah; and offer him there for a burnt offering upon one of the mountains which I will tell thee of.

entries.yo: Abrahamu si dide ni kutukutu owurọ̀, o si dì kẹtẹkẹtẹ rẹ̀ ni gãrì, o si mu meji ninu awọn ọdọmọkunrin rẹ̀ pẹlu rẹ̀, ati Isaaki, ọmọ rẹ̀, o si là igi fun ẹbọ sisun na, o si dide, o si lọ si ibi ti Ọlọrun sọ fun u.
entries.en: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and saddled his ass, and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son, and clave the wood for the burnt offering, and rose up, and went unto the place of which God had told him.

entries.yo: Ni ijọ́ kẹta Abrahamu si gbé oju rẹ̀ soke, o ri ibẹ̀ na li okere.
entries.en: Then on the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw the place afar off.

entries.yo: Abrahamu si wi fun awọn ọdọmọkunrin rẹ̀, pe, Ẹnyin joko nihin pẹlu kẹtẹkẹtẹ; ati emi ati ọmọ yi yio lọ si ọhùn ni, a o si gbadura, a o si tun pada tọ̀ nyin wá.
entries.en: And Abraham said unto his young men, Abide ye here with the ass; and I and the lad will go yonder and worship, and come again to you,

entries.yo: Abrahamu si mu igi ẹbọ sisun na, o si dì i rù Isaaki, ọmọ rẹ̀; o si mu iná li ọwọ́ rẹ̀, ati ọbẹ; awọn mejeji si jùmọ nlọ.
entries.en: And Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering, and laid it upon Isaac his son; and he took the fire in his hand, and a knife; and they went both of them together.

entries.yo: Isaaki si sọ fun Abrahamu baba rẹ̀, o si wipe, Baba mi: on si wipe, Emi niyi, ọmọ mi. On si wipe, Wò iná on igi; ṣugbọn nibo li ọdọ-agutan ẹbọ sisun na gbé wà?
entries.en: And Isaac spake unto Abraham his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here am I, my son. And he said, Behold the fire and the wood: but where is the lamb for a burnt offering?

entries.yo: Abrahamu si wipe, Ọmọ mi, Ọlọrun tikalarẹ̀ ni yio pèse ọdọ-agutan fun ẹbọ sisun: bẹ̃li awọn mejeji jùmọ nlọ.
entries.en: And Abraham said, My son, God will provide himself a lamb for a burnt offering: so they went both of them together.

entries.yo: Nwọn si de ibi ti Ọlọrun ti wi fun u; Abrahamu si tẹ́ pẹpẹ kan nibẹ̀, o si to igi rere, o si dì Isaaki ọmọ rẹ̀, o si dá a bulẹ li ori pẹpẹ lori igi na.
entries.en: And they came to the place which God had told him of; and Abraham built an altar there, and laid the wood in order, and bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar upon the wood.

entries.yo: Abrahamu si nawọ rẹ̀, o si mu ọbẹ na lati dúmbu ọmọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Abraham stretched forth his hand, and took the knife to slay his son.

entries.yo: Angeli OLUWA nì si kọ si i lati ọrun wá, o wipe, Abrahamu, Abrahamu: o si dahùn pe, Emi niyi.
entries.en: And the angel of the LORD called unto him out of heaven, and said, Abraham, Abraham: and he said, Here am I.

entries.yo: O si wipe, Máṣe fọwọkàn ọmọde nì, bẹ̃ni iwọ kó gbọdọ ṣe e ni nkan: nitori nisisiyi emi mọ̀ pe iwọ bẹ̀ru Ọlọrun, nigbati iwọ kò ti dù mi li ọmọ rẹ, ọmọ rẹ na kanṣoṣo.
entries.en: And he said, Lay not thine hand upon the lad, neither do thou any thing unto him: for now I know that thou fearest God, seeing thou hast not withheld thy son, thine only son from me.

entries.yo: Abrahamu si gbé oju rẹ̀ soke, o wò, si kiyesi i, lẹhin rẹ̀, àgbo kan ti o fi iwo rẹ̀ há ni pantiri: Abrahamu si lọ o mu àgbo na, o si fi i rubọ sisun ni ipò ọmọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold behind him a ram caught in a thicket by his horns: and Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering in the stead of his son.

entries.yo: Abrahamu si pè orukọ ibẹ̀ na ni Jehofajire: bi a ti nwi titi di oni yi, Li oke OLUWA li a o gbé ri i.
entries.en: And Abraham called the name of that place Jehovah-jireh: as it is said to this day, In the mount of the LORD it shall be seen.

entries.yo: Angeli OLUWA nì si kọ si Abrahamu lati ọrun wá lẹrinkeji,
entries.en: And the angel of the LORD called unto Abraham out of heaven the second time,

entries.yo: O si wipe, Emi tikalami ni mo fi bura, li OLUWA wi, nitori bi iwọ ti ṣe nkan yi, ti iwọ kò si dù mi li ọmọ rẹ, ọmọ rẹ na kanṣoṣo:
entries.en: And said, By myself have I sworn, saith the LORD, for because thou hast done this thing, and hast not withheld thy son, thine only son:

entries.yo: Pe ni bibukún emi o bukún fun ọ, ati ni bíbisi emi o mu irú-ọmọ rẹ bísi i bi irawọ oju-ọrun, ati bi iyanrin eti okun; irú-ọmọ rẹ ni yio si ni ẹnubode awọn ọta wọn;
entries.en: That in blessing I will bless thee, and in multiplying I will multiply thy seed as the stars of the heaven, and as the sand which is upon the sea shore; and thy seed shall possess the gate of his enemies;

entries.yo: Ati ninu irú-ọmọ rẹ li a o bukún fun gbogbo orilẹ-ède aiye: nitori ti iwọ ti gbà ohùn mi gbọ́.
entries.en: And in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed; because thou hast obeyed my voice.

entries.yo: Abrahamu si pada tọ̀ awọn ọdọmọkunrin rẹ̀ lọ, nwọn si dide, nwọn si jùmọ lọ si Beer-ṣeba; Abrahamu si joko ni Beer-ṣeba.
entries.en: So Abraham returned unto his young men, and they rose up and went together to Beer-sheba; and Abraham dwelt at Beer-sheba.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, lẹhin nkan wọnyi, li a sọ fun Abrahamu pe, kiyesi i, Milka, on pẹlu si ti bimọ fun Nahori, arakunrin rẹ;
entries.en: And it came to pass after these things, that it was told Abraham, saying, Behold, Milcah, she hath also born children unto thy brother Nahor;

entries.yo: Husi akọ́bi rẹ̀, ati Busi arakunrin rẹ̀, ati Kemueli baba Aramu.
entries.en: Huz his firstborn, and Buz his brother, and Kemuel the father of Aram,

entries.yo: Ati Kesedi, ati Haso, ati Pildaṣi, ati Jidlafu, ati Betueli.
entries.en: And Chesed, and Hazo, and Pildash, and Jidlaph, and Bethuel.

entries.yo: Betueli si bí Rebeka: awọn mẹjọ yi ni Milka bí fun Nahori, arakunrin Abrahamu.
entries.en: And Bethuel begat Rebekah: these eight Milcah did bear to Nahor, Abraham's brother.

entries.yo: Ati àle rẹ̀, orukọ ẹniti ijẹ Rehuma, on pẹlu si bí Teba, ati Gahamu, ati Tahaṣi, ati Maaka.
entries.en: And his concubine, whose name was Reumah, she bare also Tebah, and Gaham, and Thahash, and Maachah.

entries.yo: SARA si di ẹni ẹtadilãdoje ọdún: iye ọdún aiye Sara li eyi.
entries.en: And Sarah was an hundred and seven and twenty years old: these were the years of the life of Sarah.

entries.yo: Sara si kú ni Kirjat-arba; eyi na ni Hebroni ni ilẹ Kenaani: Abrahamu si wá lati ṣọ̀fọ Sara ati lati sọkun rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Sarah died in Kirjath-arba; the same is Hebron in the land of Canaan: and Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her.

entries.yo: Abrahamu si dide kuro niwaju okú rẹ̀, o si sọ fun awọn ọmọ Heti, wipe,
entries.en: And Abraham stood up from before his dead, and spake unto the sons of Heth, saying,

entries.yo: Alejò ati atipo li emi iṣe lọdọ nyin: ẹ fun mi ni ilẹ-isinku lãrin nyin, ki emi ki o le sin okú mi kuro ni iwaju mi.
entries.en: I am a stranger and a sojourner with you: give me a possession of a buryingplace with you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Heti si dá Abrahamu lohùn, nwọn si wi fun u pe,
entries.en: And the children of Heth answered Abraham, saying unto him,

entries.yo: Oluwa mi, gbọ́ ti wa: alagbara ọmọ-alade ni iwọ lãrin wa: ninu ãyò bojì wa ni ki o sin okú rẹ; kò sí ẹnikẹni ninu wa ti yio fi ibojì rẹ̀ dù ọ, ki iwọ ki o má sin okú rẹ.
entries.en: Hear us, my lord: thou art a mighty prince among us: in the choice of our sepulchres bury thy dead; none of us shall withhold from thee his sepulchre, but that thou mayest bury thy dead.

entries.yo: Abrahamu si dide duro, o si tẹriba fun awọn enia ilẹ na, fun awọn ọmọ Heti.
entries.en: And Abraham stood up, and bowed himself to the people of the land, even to the children of Heth.

entries.yo: O si ba wọn sọ̀rọ wipe, Bi o ba ṣe pe ti inu nyin ni ki emi ki o sin okú mi kuro ni iwaju mi, ẹ gbọ́ ti emi, ki ẹ si bẹ̀ Efroni, ọmọ Sohari, fun mi,
entries.en: And he communed with them, saying, If it be your mind that I should bury my dead out of my sight; hear me, and intreat for me to Ephron the son of Zohar,

entries.yo: Ki o le fun mi ni ihò Makpela, ti o ni, ti o wà li opinlẹ oko rẹ̀; li oju-owo ni ki o fifun mi, fun ilẹ-isinku lãrin nyin.
entries.en: That he may give me the cave of Machpelah, which he hath, which is in the end of his field; for as much money as it is worth he shall give it me for a possession of a buryingplace amongst you.

entries.yo: Efroni si joko lãrin awọn ọmọ Heti: Efroni, ọmọ Heti, si dá Abrahamu lohùn li eti gbogbo awọn ọmọ Heti, ani li eti gbogbo awọn ti nwọ̀ ẹnubode ilu rẹ̀ wipe,
entries.en: And Ephron dwelt among the children of Heth: and Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the audience of the children of Heth, even of all that went in at the gate of his city, saying,

entries.yo: Bẹ̃kọ, Oluwa mi, gbọ́ ti emi, mo fi oko na fun ọ, ati ihò ti o wà nibẹ̀, mo fi fun ọ: li oju awọn ọmọ awọn enia mi ni mo fi i fun ọ: sin okú rẹ.
entries.en: Nay, my lord, hear me: the field give I thee, and the cave that is therein, I give it thee; in the presence of the sons of my people give I it thee: bury thy dead.

entries.yo: Abrahamu si tẹriba niwaju awọn enia ilẹ na.
entries.en: And Abraham bowed down himself before the people of the land.

entries.yo: O si wi fun Efroni, li eti awọn enia ilẹ na pe, Njẹ bi iwọ o ba fi i fun mi, emi bẹ̀ ọ, gbọ́ ti emi: emi o san owo oko na fun ọ; gbà a lọwọ mi, emi o si sin okú mi nibẹ̀.
entries.en: And he spake unto Ephron in the audience of the people of the land, saying, But if thou wilt give it, I pray thee, hear me: I will give thee money for the field; take it of me, and I will bury my dead there.

entries.yo: Efroni si da Abrahamu li ohùn, o wi fun u pe,
entries.en: And Ephron answered Abraham, saying unto him,

entries.yo: Oluwa mi, gbọ́ ti emi: irinwo òṣuwọn ṣekeli fadaka ni ilẹ jẹ; kili eyini lãrin temi tirẹ? sa sin okú rẹ.
entries.en: My lord, hearken unto me: the land is worth four hundred shekels of silver; what is that betwixt me and thee? bury therefore thy dead.

entries.yo: Abrahamu si gbọ́ ti Efroni; Abrahamu si wọ̀n iye fadaka na fun Efroni, ti o sọ li eti awọn ọmọ Heti, irinwo òṣuwọn ṣekeli fadaka, ti o kọja lọdọ awọn oniṣòwo.
entries.en: And Abraham hearkened unto Ephron; and Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver, which he had named in the audience of the sons of Heth, four hundred shekels of silver, current money with the merchant.

entries.yo: Oko Efroni ti o wà ni Makpela, ti o wà niwaju Mamre, oko na, ati ihò ti o wà ninu rẹ̀, ati gbogbo igi ti o wà ni oko na, ti o wà ni gbogbo ẹba rẹ̀ yika, li a ṣe daju,
entries.en: And the field of Ephron, which was in Machpelah, which was before Mamre, the field, and the cave which was therein, and all the trees that were in the field, that were in all the borders round about, were made sure

entries.yo: Fun Abrahamu ni ilẹ-ini, li oju awọn ọmọ Heti, li oju gbogbo awọn ti nwọ̀ ẹnubode ilu rẹ̀.
entries.en: Unto Abraham for a possession in the presence of the children of Heth, before all that went in at the gate of his city.

entries.yo: Lẹhin eyi li Abrahamu sin Sara, aya rẹ̀, ninu ihò oko Makpela, niwaju Mamre: eyi nã ni Hebroni ni ilẹ Kenaani.
entries.en: And after this, Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah before Mamre: the same is Hebron in the land of Canaan.

entries.yo: Ati oko na, ati ihò ti o wà nibẹ̀, li a ṣe daju fun Abrahamu, ni ilẹ isinku, lati ọwọ́ awọn ọmọ Heti wá.
entries.en: And the field, and the cave that is therein, were made sure unto Abraham for a possession of a buryingplace by the sons of Heth.

entries.yo: ABRAHAMU si gbó, o si pọ̀ li ọjọ́: OLUWA si ti busi i fun Abrahamu li ohun gbogbo.
entries.en: And Abraham was old, and well stricken in age: and the LORD had blessed Abraham in all things.

entries.yo: Abrahamu si wi fun iranṣẹ rẹ̀, agba ile rẹ̀ ti o ṣe olori ohun gbogbo ti o ni pe, Emi bẹ̀ ọ, fi ọwọ rẹ si abẹ itan mi;
entries.en: And Abraham said unto his eldest servant of his house, that ruled over all that he had, Put, I pray thee, thy hand under my thigh:

entries.yo: Emi o si mu ọ fi OLUWA bura, Ọlọrun ọrun, ati Ọlọrun aiye, pe iwọ ki yio fẹ́ aya fun ọmọ mi ninu awọn ọmọbinrin ara Kenaani, lãrin awọn ẹniti mo ngbé:
entries.en: And I will make thee swear by the LORD, the God of heaven, and the God of the earth, that thou shalt not take a wife unto my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I dwell:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn iwọ o lọ si ilẹ mi, ati si ọdọ awọn ará mi, ki iwọ ki o si fẹ́ aya fun Isaaki, ọmọ mi.
entries.en: But thou shalt go unto my country, and to my kindred, and take a wife unto my son Isaac.

entries.yo: Iranṣẹ na si wi fun u pe, Bọya obinrin na ki yio fẹ́ ba mi wá si ilẹ yi: mo ha le mu ọmọ rẹ pada lọ si ilẹ ti iwọ gbé ti wá?
entries.en: And the servant said unto him, Peradventure the woman will not be willing to follow me unto this land: must I needs bring thy son again unto the land from whence thou camest?

entries.yo: Abrahamu si wi fun u pe, Kiyesara ki iwọ ki o má tun mu ọmọ mi pada lọ sibẹ̀.
entries.en: And Abraham said unto him, Beware thou that thou bring not my son thither again.

entries.yo: OLUWA Ọlọrun ọrun, ti o mu mi lati ile baba mi wá, ati lati ilẹ ti a bi mi, ẹniti o sọ fun mi, ti o si bura fun mi, wipe, Irú-ọmọ rẹ li emi o fi ilẹ yi fun; on ni yio rán angeli rẹ̀ ṣaju rẹ, iwọ o si fẹ́ aya lati ibẹ̀ fun ọmọ mi wá.
entries.en: The LORD God of heaven, which took me from my father's house, and from the land of my kindred, and which spake unto me, and that sware unto me, saying, Unto thy seed will I give this land; he shall send his angel before thee, and thou shalt take a wife unto my son from thence.

entries.yo: Bi obinrin na kò ba si fẹ́ tẹle ọ, njẹ nigbana li ọrùn rẹ yio mọ́ kuro ni ibura mi yi: ọkan ni, ki iwọ máṣe tun mu ọmọ mi pada lọ sibẹ̀.
entries.en: And if the woman will not be willing to follow thee, then thou shalt be clear from this my oath: only bring not my son thither again.

entries.yo: Iranṣẹ na si fi ọwọ́ rẹ̀ si abẹ itan Abrahamu oluwa rẹ̀, o si bura fun u nitori ọ̀ran yi.
entries.en: And the servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master, and sware to him concerning that matter.

entries.yo: Iranṣẹ na si mu ibakasiẹ mẹwa, ninu ibakasiẹ oluwa rẹ̀, o si lọ; nitori pe li ọwọ́ rẹ̀ ni gbogbo ẹrù oluwa rẹ̀ wà: o si dide, o si lọ si Mesopotamia, si ilu Nahori.
entries.en: And the servant took ten camels of the camels of his master, and departed; for all the goods of his master were in his hand: and he arose, and went to Mesopotamia, unto the city of Nahor.

entries.yo: O si mu awọn ibakasiẹ rẹ̀ kunlẹ lẹhin ode ilu na li ẹba kanga omi kan nigba aṣalẹ, li akokò igbati awọn obinrin ima jade lọ pọnmi.
entries.en: And he made his camels to kneel down without the city by a well of water at the time of the evening, even the time that women go out to draw water.

entries.yo: O si wipe, OLUWA, Ọlọrun Abrahamu oluwa mi, emi bẹ̀ ọ, ṣe ọ̀na mi ni rere loni, ki o si ṣe ore fun Abrahamu oluwa mi.
entries.en: And he said, O LORD God of my master Abraham, I pray thee, send me good speed this day, and shew kindness unto my master Abraham.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, emi duro li ẹba kanga omi yi; awọn ọmọbinrin ara ilu na njade wá lati pọnmi:
entries.en: Behold, I stand here by the well of water; and the daughters of the men of the city come out to draw water:

entries.yo: Ki o si jẹ ki o ṣe pe, omidan ti emi o wi fun pe, Emi bẹ̀ ọ, sọ ladugbo rẹ kalẹ, ki emi ki o mu; ti on o si wipe, Mu, emi o si fi fun awọn ibakasiẹ rẹ mu pẹlu: on na ni ki o jẹ ẹniti iwọ yàn fun Isaaki iranṣẹ rẹ; nipa eyi li emi o si mọ̀ pe, iwọ ti ṣe ore fun oluwa mi.
entries.en: And let it come to pass, that the damsel to whom I shall say, Let down thy pitcher, I pray thee, that I may drink; and she shall say, Drink, and I will give thy camels drink also: let the same be she that thou hast appointed for thy servant Isaac; and thereby shall I know that thou hast shewed kindness unto my master.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, ki on to pari ọ̀rọ isọ, kiyesi i, Rebeka jade de, ẹniti a bí fun Betueli, ọmọ Milka, aya Nahori, arakunrin Abrahamu, ti on ti ladugbo rẹ̀ li ejika rẹ̀.
entries.en: And it came to pass, before he had done speaking, that, behold, Rebekah came out, who was born to Bethuel, son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham's brother, with her pitcher upon her shoulder.

entries.yo: Omidan na li ẹwà gidigidi lati wò, wundia ni, bẹ̃li ẹnikẹni kò ti imọ̀ ọ: o si sọkalẹ lọ sinu kanga, o si pọn ladugbo rẹ̀ kún, o si goke.
entries.en: And the damsel was very fair to look upon, a virgin, neither had any man known her: and she went down to the well, and filled her pitcher, and came up.

entries.yo: Iranṣẹ na si sure lọ ipade rẹ̀, o si wipe, Emi bẹ̀ ọ, jẹ ki nmu omi diẹ ninu ladugbo rẹ.
entries.en: And the servant ran to meet her, and said, Let me, I pray thee, drink a little water of thy pitcher.

entries.yo: O si dahùn pe, Mu, oluwa mi: o si yara, o sọ̀ ladugbo rẹ̀ ka ọwọ́, o si fun u mu.
entries.en: And she said, Drink, my lord: and she hasted, and let down her pitcher upon her hand, and gave him drink.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si fun u mu tan, o si wipe, Emi o pọn fun awọn ibakasiẹ rẹ pẹlu, titi nwọn o fi mu tan.
entries.en: And when she had done giving him drink, she said, I will draw water for thy camels also, until they have done drinking.

entries.yo: O si yara, o si tú ladugbo rẹ̀ sinu ibumu, o si tun pada sure lọ si kanga lati pọn omi, o si pọn fun gbogbo awọn ibakasiẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And she hasted, and emptied her pitcher into the trough, and ran again unto the well to draw water, and drew for all his camels.

entries.yo: ọkunrin na si tẹjumọ ọ, o dakẹ, lati mọ̀ bi OLUWA mu ìrin on dara, bi bẹ̃kọ.
entries.en: And the man wondering at her held his peace, to wit whether the LORD had made his journey prosperous or not.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, bi awọn ibakasiẹ ti mu omi tan, ni ọkunrin na mu oruka wurà àbọ ìwọn ṣekeli, ati jufù meji fun ọwọ́ rẹ̀, ti ìwọn ṣekeli wurà mẹwa;
entries.en: And it came to pass, as the camels had done drinking, that the man took a golden earring of half a shekel weight, and two bracelets for her hands of ten shekels weight of gold;

entries.yo: O si bi i pe, Ọmọbinrin tani iwọ iṣe? Emi bẹ̀ ọ, wi fun mi: àye wà ni ile baba rẹ fun wa lati wọ̀ si?
entries.en: And said, Whose daughter art thou? tell me, I pray thee: is there room in thy father's house for us to lodge in?

entries.yo: On si wi fun u pe, Ọmọbinrin Betueli, ọmọ Milka, ti o bí fun Nahori, li emi iṣe.
entries.en: And she said unto him, I am the daughter of Bethuel the son of Milcah, which she bare unto Nahor.

entries.yo: O si wi fun u pe, Awa ni koriko ati sakasáka tó pẹlu, ati àye lati wọ̀ si.
entries.en: She said moreover unto him, We have both straw and provender enough, and room to lodge in.

entries.yo: Ọkunrin na si tẹriba, o si sìn OLUWA.
entries.en: And the man bowed down his head, and worshipped the LORD.
