entries.yo: O si wipe, Olubukún li OLUWA, Ọlọrun Abrahamu, oluwa mi, ti kò jẹ ki ãnu rẹ̀ ati otitọ rẹ̀ ki o yẹ̀ kuro lọdọ, oluwa mi, niti emi, OLUWA fi ẹsẹ̀ mi le ọ̀na ile awọn arakunrin baba mi.
entries.en: And he said, Blessed be the LORD God of my master Abraham, who hath not left destitute my master of his mercy and his truth: I being in the way, the LORD led me to the house of my master's brethren.

entries.yo: Omidan na si sure, o si rò nkan wọnyi fun awọn ara ile iya rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the damsel ran, and told them of her mother's house these things.

entries.yo: Rebeka si li arakunrin kan, orukọ rẹ̀ si ni Labani: Labani si sure jade tọ̀ ọkunrin na lọ si ibi kanga.
entries.en: And Rebekah had a brother, and his name was Laban: and Laban ran out unto the man, unto the well.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, bi o ti ri oruka, ati jufù li ọwọ́ arabinrin rẹ̀, ti o si gbọ́ ọ̀rọ Rebeka arabinrin rẹ̀ pe, Bayi li ọkunrin na ba mi sọ; bẹ̃li o si tọ̀ ọkunrin na wá; si kiyesi i, o duro tì awọn ibakasiẹ rẹ̀ leti kanga na.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when he saw the earring and bracelets upon his sister's hands, and when he heard the words of Rebekah his sister, saying, Thus spake the man unto me; that he came unto the man; and, behold, he stood by the camels at the well.

entries.yo: O si wipe, Wọle, iwọ ẹni-ibukún OLUWA; ẽṣe ti iwọ fi duro lode? mo sá ti pèse àye silẹ ati àye fun awọn ibakasiẹ.
entries.en: And he said, Come in, thou blessed of the LORD; wherefore standest thou without? for I have prepared the house, and room for the camels.

entries.yo: Ọkunrin na si wọle na wá; o si tú awọn ibakasiẹ, o si fun awọn ibakasiẹ, ni koriko ati sakasáka, ati omi fun u lati wẹ̀ ẹsẹ̀ rẹ̀, ati ẹsẹ̀ awọn ọkunrin ti o pẹlu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the man came into the house: and he ungirded his camels, and gave straw and provender for the camels, and water to wash his feet, and the men's feet that were with him.

entries.yo: A si gbé onjẹ kalẹ fun u lati jẹ: ṣugbọn on si wipe, Emi ki yio jẹun titi emi o fi jiṣẹ mi tán. On si wipe, Ma wi.
entries.en: And there was set meat before him to eat: but he said, I will not eat, until I have told mine errand. And he said, Speak on.

entries.yo: O si wipe, Ọmọ-ọdọ Abrahamu li emi iṣe.
entries.en: And he said, I am Abraham's servant.

entries.yo: OLUWA si ti bukún fun oluwa mi gidigidi; o si di pupọ̀: o si fun u li agutan, ati mãlu, ati fadaka, ati wurà, ati iranṣẹkunrin, ati iranṣẹbinrin, ati ibakasiẹ, ati kẹtẹkẹtẹ.
entries.en: And the LORD hath blessed my master greatly; and he is become great: and he hath given him flocks, and herds, and silver, and gold, and menservants, and maidservants, and camels, and asses.

entries.yo: Sara, aya oluwa mi, si bí ọmọ kan fun oluwa mi nigbati on (Sara) gbó tán: on li o si fi ohun gbogbo ti o ni fun.
entries.en: And Sarah my master's wife bare a son to my master when she was old: and unto him hath he given all that he hath.

entries.yo: Oluwa mi si mu mi bura, wipe, Iwọ kò gbọdọ fẹ́ obinrin fun ọmọ mi ninu awọn ọmọbinrin ara Kenaani ni ilẹ ẹniti emi ngbé:
entries.en: And my master made me swear, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife to my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I dwell:

entries.yo: Bikoṣe ki iwọ ki o lọ si ile baba mi, ati si ọdọ awọn ibatan mi, ki o si fẹ́ aya fun ọmọ mi.
entries.en: But thou shalt go unto my father's house, and to my kindred, and take a wife unto my son.

entries.yo: Emi si wi fun oluwa mi pe, Bọya obinrin na ki yio tẹle mi.
entries.en: And I said unto my master, Peradventure the woman will not follow me.

entries.yo: O si wi fun mi pe, OLUWA, niwaju ẹniti emi nrìn, yio rán angeli rẹ̀ pelu rẹ, yio si mu ọ̀na rẹ dara; iwọ o si fẹ́ aya fun ọmọ mi lati ọdọ awọn ibatan mi, ati lati inu ile baba mi:
entries.en: And he said unto me, The LORD, before whom I walk, will send his angel with thee, and prosper thy way; and thou shalt take a wife for my son of my kindred, and of my father's house:

entries.yo: Nigbana li ọrùn rẹ yio mọ́ kuro ninu ibura mi yi, nigbati iwọ ba de ọdọ awọn ibatan mi; bi nwọn kò ba si fi ẹnikan fun ọ, ọrùn rẹ yio si mọ́ kuro ninu ibura mi.
entries.en: Then shalt thou be clear from this my oath, when thou comest to my kindred; and if they give not thee one, thou shalt be clear from my oath.

entries.yo: Emi si de si ibi kanga loni, mo si wipe, OLUWA, Ọlọrun Abrahamu oluwa mi, bi iwọ ba mu ọ̀na àjo mi ti mo nlọ nisisiyi dara:
entries.en: And I came this day unto the well, and said, O LORD God of my master Abraham, if now thou do prosper my way which I go;

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, mo duro li ẹba kanga omi; ki o si ṣẹ, pe nigbati wundia na ba jade wá ipọn omi, ti mo ba si wi fun u pe, Emi bẹ̀ ọ, bùn mi li omi diẹ ki emi mu lati inu ladugbo rẹ;
entries.en: Behold, I stand by the well of water; and it shall come to pass, that when the virgin cometh forth to draw water, and I say to her, Give me, I pray thee, a little water of thy pitcher to drink;

entries.yo: Ti o si wi fun mi pe, Iwọ mu, emi o si pọn fun awọn ibakasiẹ rẹ pẹlu: ki on na ki o ṣe obinrin ti OLUWA ti yàn fun ọmọ oluwa mi.
entries.en: And she say to me, Both drink thou, and I will also draw for thy camels: let the same be the woman whom the LORD hath appointed out for my master's son.

entries.yo: Ki emi ki o si tó wi tán li ọkàn mi, kiyesi i, Rebeka jade de ti on ti ladugbo rẹ̀ li ejika rẹ̀; o si sọkalẹ lọ sinu kanga, o pọn omi: emi si wi fun u pe, Mo bẹ̀ ọ, jẹ ki emi mu omi.
entries.en: And before I had done speaking in mine heart, behold, Rebekah came forth with her pitcher on her shoulder; and she went down unto the well, and drew water: and I said unto her, Let me drink, I pray thee.

entries.yo: O si yara, o si sọ ladugbo rẹ̀ kalẹ kuro li ejika rẹ̀, o si wipe, Mu, emi o si fi fun awọn ibakasiẹ rẹ mu pẹlu; bẹ̃li emi mu, o si fi fun awọn ibakasiẹ mu pẹlu.
entries.en: And she made haste, and let down her pitcher from her shoulder, and said, Drink, and I will give thy camels drink also: so I drank, and she made the camels drink also.

entries.yo: Emi si bi i, mo si wipe, Ọmọbinrin tani iwọ iṣe? o si wipe, Ọmọbinrin Betueli, ọmọ Nahori, ti Milka bí fun u: emi si fi oruka si i ni imu, ati jufù si ọwọ́ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And I asked her, and said, Whose daughter art thou? And she said, The daughter of Bethuel, Nahor's son, whom Milcah bare unto him: and I put the earring upon her face, and the bracelets upon her hands.

entries.yo: Emi si tẹriba, mo si wolẹ fun OLUWA, mo si fi ibukún fun OLUWA, Ọlọrun Abrahamu oluwa mi, ti o mu mi tọ̀ ọ̀na titọ lati mu ọmọbinrin arakunrin oluwa mi fun ọmọ rẹ̀ wá.
entries.en: And I bowed down my head, and worshipped the LORD, and blessed the LORD God of my master Abraham, which had led me in the right way to take my master's brother's daughter unto his son.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, bi ẹnyin o ba bá oluwa mi lò inu rere ati otitọ, ẹ wi fun mi: bi bẹ̃ si kọ; ẹ wi fun mi: ki emi ki o le pọ̀ si apa ọtún, tabi si òsi.
entries.en: And now if ye will deal kindly and truly with my master, tell me: and if not, tell me; that I may turn to the right hand, or to the left.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Labani ati Betueli dahùn nwọn si wipe, Lọdọ OLUWA li ohun na ti jade wá: awa kò le sọ rere tabi buburu fun ọ.
entries.en: Then Laban and Bethuel answered and said, The thing proceedeth from the LORD: we cannot speak unto thee bad or good.

entries.yo: Wò o, Rebeka niyi niwaju rẹ, mu u, ki o si ma lọ, ki on ki o si ma ṣe aya ọmọ oluwa rẹ, bi OLUWA ti wi.
entries.en: Behold, Rebekah is before thee, take her, and go, and let her be thy master's son's wife, as the LORD hath spoken.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati iranṣẹ Abrahamu gbọ́ ọ̀rọ wọn, o wolẹ fun OLUWA.
entries.en: And it came to pass, that, when Abraham's servant heard their words, he worshipped the LORD, bowing himself to the earth.

entries.yo: Iranṣẹ na si yọ ohun èlo fadaka, ati èlo wurà jade, ati aṣọ, o si fi wọn fun Rebeka: o si fi ohun iyebiye pẹlu fun arakunrin rẹ̀ ati fun iya rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the servant brought forth jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment, and gave them to Rebekah: he gave also to her brother and to her mother precious things.

entries.yo: Nwọn si jẹ, nwọn si mu, on ati awọn ọkunrin ti o wà pẹlu rẹ̀, nwọn si wọ̀ nibẹ̀ li oru ijọ́ na; nwọn si dide li owurọ̀, o si wipe, Ẹ rán mi lọ si ọdọ oluwa mi.
entries.en: And they did eat and drink, he and the men that were with him, and tarried all night; and they rose up in the morning, and he said, Send me away unto my master.

entries.yo: Arakunrin ati iya rẹ̀ si wipe, Jẹ ki omidan na ki o ba wa joko ni ijọ́ melokan, bi ijọ́ mẹwa, lẹhin eyini ni ki o ma wa lọ.
entries.en: And her brother and her mother said, Let the damsel abide with us a few days, at the least ten; after that she shall go.

entries.yo: On si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ máṣe da mi duro, OLUWA sa ti ṣe ọ̀na mi ni rere; ẹ rán mi, ki emi ki o le tọ̀ oluwa mi lọ.
entries.en: And he said unto them, Hinder me not, seeing the LORD hath prospered my way; send me away that I may go to my master.

entries.yo: Nwọn si wipe, Awa o pè omidan na, a o si bère li ẹnu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And they said, We will call the damsel, and inquire at her mouth.

entries.yo: Nwọn si pè Rebeka, nwọn bi i pe, Iwọ o bá ọkunrin yi lọ? o si wipe, Emi o lọ.
entries.en: And they called Rebekah, and said unto her, Wilt thou go with this man? And she said, I will go.

entries.yo: Nwọn si rán Rebeka, arabinrin wọn, ati olutọ rẹ̀, ati iranṣẹ Abrahamu, ati awọn ọkunrin rẹ̀ lọ.
entries.en: And they sent away Rebekah their sister, and her nurse, and Abraham's servant, and his men.

entries.yo: Nwọn si súre fun Rebeka, nwọn si wi fun u pe, Iwọ li arabinrin wa, ki iwọ, ki o si ṣe iya ẹgbẹgbẹrun lọnà ẹgbãrun, ki irú-ọmọ rẹ ki o si ni ẹnubode awọn ti o korira wọn.
entries.en: And they blessed Rebekah, and said unto her, Thou art our sister, be thou the mother of thousands of millions, and let thy seed possess the gate of those which hate them.

entries.yo: Rebeka si dide, ati awọn omidan rẹ̀, nwọn si gùn awọn ibakasiẹ, nwọn si tẹle ọkunrin na: iranṣẹ na si mu Rebeka, o si ba tirẹ̀ lọ.
entries.en: And Rebekah arose, and her damsels, and they rode upon the camels, and followed the man: and the servant took Rebekah, and went his way.

entries.yo: Isaaki si nti ọ̀na kanga Lahai-roi mbọ̀wá; nitori ilu ìha gusù li on ngbé.
entries.en: And Isaac came from the way of the well Lahai-roi; for he dwelt in the south country.

entries.yo: Isaaki si jade lọ ṣe àṣaro li oko li aṣalẹ: o si gbé oju rẹ̀ soke, o si ri i, si kiyesi i, awọn ibakasiẹ mbọ̀wá.
entries.en: And Isaac went out to meditate in the field at the eventide: and he lifted up his eyes, and saw, and, behold, the camels were coming.

entries.yo: Rebeka si gbé oju rẹ̀ soke, nigbati o ri Isaaki, o sọkalẹ lori ibakasiẹ.
entries.en: And Rebekah lifted up her eyes, and when she saw Isaac, she lighted off the camel.

entries.yo: Nitori ti o ti bi iranṣẹ na pe, ọkunrin ewo li o nrìn bọ̀ li oko lati wá pade wa nì? Iranṣẹ na si ti wi fun u pe, oluwa mi ni: nitori na li o ṣe mu iboju o fi bò ara rẹ̀.
entries.en: For she had said unto the servant, What man is this that walketh in the field to meet us? And the servant had said, It is my master: therefore she took a vail, and covered herself.

entries.yo: Iranṣẹ na si rò ohun gbogbo ti on ṣe fun Isaaki.
entries.en: And the servant told Isaac all things that he had done.

entries.yo: Isaaki si mu u wá si inu agọ́ Sara, iya rẹ̀, o si mu Rebeka, o di aya rẹ̀; o si fẹ́ ẹ; a si tu Isaaki ninu lẹhin ikú iya rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah's tent, and took Rebekah, and she became his wife; and he loved her: and Isaac was comforted after his mother's death.

entries.yo: ABRAHAMU si tun fẹ́ aya kan, orukọ rẹ̀ a ma jẹ Ketura.
entries.en: Then again Abraham took a wife, and her name was Keturah.

entries.yo: O si bí Simrani, ati Jokṣani, ati Medani, ati Midiani, ati Iṣbaku, ati Ṣua fun u.
entries.en: And she bare him Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah.

entries.yo: Jokṣani si bí Ṣeba, ati Dedani. Awọn ọmọ Dedani si ni Aṣurimu, ati Letuṣimu, ati Leumimu.
entries.en: And Jokshan begat Sheba, and Dedan. And the sons of Dedan were Asshurim, and Letushim, and Leummim.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Midiani; Efa, ati Eferi, ati Hanoku, ati Abida, ati Eldaa. Gbogbo awọn wọnyi li ọmọ Ketura.
entries.en: And the sons of Midian; Ephah, and Epher, and Hanoch, and Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the children of Keturah.

entries.yo: Abrahamu si fi gbogbo ohun ti o ni fun Isaaki.
entries.en: And Abraham gave all that he had unto Isaac.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn ọmọ àle ti Abrahamu ni, Abrahamu bùn wọn li ẹ̀bun, o si rán wọn lọ kuro lọdọ Isaaki, ọmọ rẹ̀, nigbati o wà lãye, si ìha ìla-õrùn, si ilẹ ìla-õrùn.
entries.en: But unto the sons of the concubines, which Abraham had, Abraham gave gifts, and sent them away from Isaac his son, while he yet lived, eastward, unto the east country.

entries.yo: Iwọnyi si li ọjọ́ ọdún aiye Abrahamu ti o wà, arun dí lọgọsan ọdún.
entries.en: And these are the days of the years of Abraham's life which he lived, an hundred threescore and fifteen years.

entries.yo: Abrahamu si jọwọ ẹmi rẹ̀ lọwọ, o si kú li ogbologbo, arugbo, o kún fun ọjọ́; a si kó o jọ pẹlu awọn enia rẹ̀.
entries.en: Then Abraham gave up the ghost, and died in a good old age, an old man, and full of years; and was gathered to his people.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, Isaaki ati Iṣmaeli si sin i ni ihò Makpela, li oko Efroni, ọmọ Sohari enia Hitti, ti o wà niwaju Mamre;
entries.en: And his sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron the son of Zohar the Hittite, which is before Mamre;

entries.yo: Oko ti Abrahamu rà lọwọ awọn ọmọ Heti: nibẹ̀ li a gbé sin Abrahamu, ati Sara, aya rẹ̀.
entries.en: The field which Abraham purchased of the sons of Heth: there was Abraham buried, and Sarah his wife.

entries.yo: O si ṣe lẹhin ikú Abrahamu li Ọlọrun bukún fun Isaaki, ọmọ rẹ̀; Isaaki si joko leti kanga Lahai-roi.
entries.en: And it came to pass after the death of Abraham, that God blessed his son Isaac; and Isaac dwelt by the well Lahai-roi.

entries.yo: Iwọnyi si ni iran Iṣmaeli, ọmọ Abrahamu, ti Hagari, ara Egipti, ọmọbinrin ọdọ Sara bí fun Abrahamu:
entries.en: Now these are the generations of Ishmael, Abraham's son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah's handmaid, bare unto Abraham:

entries.yo: Iwọnyi si li orukọ awọn ọmọkunrin Iṣmaeli, nipa orukọ wọn, ni iran idile wọn: akọ́bi Iṣmaeli, Nebajotu; ati Kedari, ati Adbeeli, ati Mibsamu,
entries.en: And these are the names of the sons of Ishmael, by their names, according to their generations: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebajoth; and Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,

entries.yo: Ati Miṣma, ati Duma, ati Masa;
entries.en: And Mishma, and Dumah, and Massa,

entries.yo: Hadari, ati Tema, Jeturi, Nafiṣi, ati Kedema:
entries.en: Hadar, and Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah:

entries.yo: Awọn wọnyi li awọn ọmọ Iṣmaeli, iwọnyi si li orukọ wọn, li ori-ori ilu wọn, li ori-ori ile odi wọn; ijoye mejila li orilẹ-ède wọn.
entries.en: These are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names, by their towns, and by their castles; twelve princes according to their nations.

entries.yo: Iwọnyi si li ọdún aiye Iṣmaeli, ẹtadilogoje ọdún: o si jọwọ ẹmi rẹ̀ lọwọ, o si kú; a si kó o jọ pọ̀ pẹlu awọn enia rẹ.
entries.en: And these are the years of the life of Ishmael, an hundred and thirty and seven years: and he gave up the ghost and died; and was gathered unto his people.

entries.yo: Nwọn si tẹ̀dó lati Hafila lọ titi o fi de Ṣuri, ti o wà niwaju Egipti, bi iwọ ti nlọ sìha Assiria: o si kú niwaju awọn arakonrin rẹ̀ gbogbo.
entries.en: And they dwelt from Havilah unto Shur, that is before Egypt, as thou goest toward Assyria: and he died in the presence of all his brethren.

entries.yo: Iwọnyi si ni iran Isaaki, ọmọ Abrahamu: Abrahamu bí Isaaki:
entries.en: And these are the generations of Isaac, Abraham's son: Abraham begat Isaac:

entries.yo: Isaaki si jẹ ẹni ogoji ọdún, nigbati o mu Rebeka, ọmọbinrin Betueli, ara Siria ti Padan-aramu, arabinrin Labani ara Siria, li aya.
entries.en: And Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah to wife, the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Padan-aram, the sister to Laban the Syrian.

entries.yo: Isaaki si bẹ̀ OLUWA fun aya rẹ̀, nitoriti o yàgan: OLUWA si gbà ẹ̀bẹ rẹ̀, Rebeka, aya rẹ̀, si loyun.
entries.en: And Isaac intreated the LORD for his wife, because she was barren: and the LORD was intreated of him, and Rebekah his wife conceived.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ si njàgudu ninu rẹ̀: o si wipe, bi o ba ṣe pe bẹ̃ni yio ri, ẽṣe ti mo fi ri bayi? O si lọ bère lọdọ OLUWA.
entries.en: And the children struggled together within her; and she said, If it be so, why am I thus? And she went to inquire of the LORD.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun u pe, orilẹ-ède meji ni mbẹ ninu rẹ, irú enia meji ni yio yà lati inu rẹ: awọn enia kan yio le jù ekeji lọ; ẹgbọ́n ni yio si ma sìn aburo.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto her, Two nations are in thy womb, and two manner of people shall be separated from thy bowels; and the one people shall be stronger than the other people; and the elder shall serve the younger.

entries.yo: Nigbati ọjọ́ rẹ̀ ti yio bí si pé, si kiyesi i, ibeji li o wà ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And when her days to be delivered were fulfilled, behold, there were twins in her womb.

entries.yo: Akọ́bi si jade wá, o pupa, ara rẹ̀ gbogbo ri bí aṣọ onirun; nwọn si sọ orukọ rẹ̀ ni Esau.
entries.en: And the first came out red, all over like an hairy garment; and they called his name Esau.

entries.yo: Ati lẹhin eyini li arakunrin rẹ̀ jade wá, ọwọ́ rẹ̀ si dì gigĩsẹ Esau mu; a si sọ orukọ rẹ̀ ni Jakobu: Isaaki si jẹ ẹni ọgọta ọdún nigbati Rebeka bí wọn.
entries.en: And after that came his brother out, and his hand took hold on Esau's heel; and his name was called Jacob: and Isaac was threescore years old when she bare them.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọdekunrin na si dàgba: Esau si ṣe ọlọgbọ́n ọdẹ, ara oko; Jakobu si ṣe ọbọrọ́ enia, a ma gbé inu agọ́.
entries.en: And the boys grew: and Esau was a cunning hunter, a man of the field; and Jacob was a plain man, dwelling in tents.

entries.yo: Isaaki si fẹ́ Esau, nitori ti o njẹ ninu ẹran-ọdẹ rẹ̀: ṣugbọn Rebeka fẹ́ Jakobu.
entries.en: And Isaac loved Esau, because he did eat of his venison: but Rebekah loved Jacob.

entries.yo: Jakobu si pa ìpẹtẹ: Esau si ti inu igbẹ́ dé, o si rẹ̀ ẹ:
entries.en: And Jacob sod pottage: and Esau came from the field, and he was faint:

entries.yo: Esau si wi fun Jakobu pe, Emi bẹ̀ ọ, fi ìpẹtẹ rẹ pupa nì bọ́ mi; nitori ti o rẹ̀ mi: nitori na li a ṣe npè orukọ rẹ̀ ni Edomu.
entries.en: And Esau said to Jacob, Feed me, I pray thee, with that same red pottage; for I am faint: therefore was his name called Edom.

entries.yo: Jakobu si wipe, Tà ogún-ibí rẹ fun mi loni.
entries.en: And Jacob said, Sell me this day thy birthright.

entries.yo: Esau si wipe, Sa wò o na, emi ni nkú lọ yi: ore kini ogún-ibí yi yio si ṣe fun mi?
entries.en: And Esau said, Behold, I am at the point to die: and what profit shall this birthright do to me?

entries.yo: Jakobu si wipe, Bura fun mi loni; o si bura fun u: o si tà ogún-ibí rẹ̀ fun Jakobu.
entries.en: And Jacob said, Swear to me this day; and he sware unto him: and he sold his birthright unto Jacob.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Jakobu fi àkara ati ìpẹtẹ lentile fun Esau; o si jẹ, o si mu, o si dide, o si ba tirẹ̀ lọ: bayi ni Esau gàn ogún-ibí rẹ̀.
entries.en: Then Jacob gave Esau bread and pottage of lentiles; and he did eat and drink, and rose up, and went his way: thus Esau despised his birthright.

entries.yo: ÌYAN kan si mu ni ilẹ na, lẹhin ìyan ti o tetekọ mu li ọjọ́ Abrahamu. Isaaki si tọ̀ Abimeleki, ọba awọn ara Filistia lọ, si Gerari.
entries.en: And there was a famine in the land, beside the first famine that was in the days of Abraham. And Isaac went unto Abimelech king of the Philistines unto Gerar.

entries.yo: OLUWA si farahàn a, o si wipe, Máṣe sọkalẹ lọ si Egipti; joko ni ilẹ ti emi o wi fun ọ.
entries.en: And the LORD appeared unto him, and said, Go not down into Egypt; dwell in the land which I shall tell thee of:

entries.yo: Mã ṣe atipo ni ilẹ yi, emi o si pẹlu rẹ, emi o si bukún u fun ọ; nitori iwọ ati irú-ọmọ rẹ, li emi o fi gbogbo ilẹ wọnyi fun, emi o si mu ara ti mo bú fun Abrahamu, baba rẹ, ṣẹ.
entries.en: Sojourn in this land, and I will be with thee, and will bless thee; for unto thee, and unto thy seed, I will give all these countries, and I will perform the oath which I sware unto Abraham thy father;

entries.yo: Emi o si mu irú-ọmọ rẹ bisi i bi irawọ oju-ọrun, emi o si fi gbogbo ilẹ wọnyi fun irú-ọmọ rẹ; ati nipasẹ irú-ọmọ rẹ li a o bukún gbogbo orilẹ-ède aiye;
entries.en: And I will make thy seed to multiply as the stars of heaven, and will give unto thy seed all these countries; and in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed;

entries.yo: Nitoriti Abrahamu gbà ohùn mi gbọ́, o si pa ìlọ mi, aṣẹ mi, ìlana mi, ati ofin mi mọ́.
entries.en: Because that Abraham obeyed my voice, and kept my charge, my commandments, my statutes, and my laws.

entries.yo: Isaaki si joko ni Gerari.
entries.en: And Isaac dwelt in Gerar:

entries.yo: Awọn ọkunrin ibẹ̀ na bi i lẽre niti aya rẹ̀: o si wipe, Arabinrin mi ni: nitoriti o bẹ̀ru ati wipe, Aya mi ni; o ni, ki awọn ọkunrin ibẹ̀ na ki o má ba pa mi nitori Rebeka; nitoriti on li ẹwà lati wò.
entries.en: And the men of the place asked him of his wife; and he said, She is my sister: for he feared to say, She is my wife; lest, said he, the men of the place should kill me for Rebekah; because she was fair to look upon.

entries.yo: O si ṣe nigbati o joko nibẹ̀ pẹ titi, ni Abimeleki, ọba awọn ara Filistia, wò ode li ojuferese, o si ri, si kiyesi i, Isaaki mba Rebeka aya rẹ̀ wẹ́.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when he had been there a long time, that Abimelech king of the Philistines looked out at a window, and saw, and, behold, Isaac was sporting with Rebekah his wife.

entries.yo: Abimeleki si pè Isaaki, o si wipe, Kiyesi i, nitõtọ aya rẹ ni iṣe: iwọ ha ti ṣe wipe, Arabinrin mi ni? Isaaki si wi fun u pe, Nitoriti mo wipe, ki emi ki o má ba kú nitori rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Abimelech called Isaac, and said, Behold, of a surety she is thy wife: and how saidst thou, She is my sister? And Isaac said unto him, Because I said, Lest I die for her.

entries.yo: Abimeleki si wipe, Kili eyiti iwọ ṣe si wa yi? Bí ọkan ninu awọn enia bá lọ bá aya rẹ ṣe iṣekuṣe nkọ? iwọ iba si mu ẹ̀ṣẹ wá si ori wa.
entries.en: And Abimelech said, What is this thou hast done unto us? one of the people might lightly have lien with thy wife, and thou shouldest have brought guiltiness upon us.

entries.yo: Abimeleki si kìlọ fun gbogbo awọn enia rẹ̀ wipe, Ẹnikẹni ti o ba tọ́ ọkunrin yi tabi aya rẹ̀, kikú ni yio kú.
entries.en: And Abimelech charged all his people, saying, He that toucheth this man or his wife shall surely be put to death.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Isaaki funrugbìn ni ilẹ na, o si ri ọrọrún mu li ọdún na; OLUWA si busi i fun u:
entries.en: Then Isaac sowed in that land, and received in the same year an hundredfold: and the LORD blessed him.

entries.yo: Ọkunrin na si di pupọ̀, o si nlọ si iwaju, o si npọ̀ si i titi o fi di enia nla gidigidi.
entries.en: And the man waxed great, and went forward, and grew until he became very great:

entries.yo: Nitori ti o ni agbo-agutan, ati ini agbo-ẹran nla ati ọ̀pọlọpọ ọmọ-ọdọ: awọn ara Filistia si ṣe ilara rẹ̀.
entries.en: For he had possession of flocks, and possessions of herds, and great store of servants: and the Philistines envied him.

entries.yo: Nitori gbogbo kanga ti awọn ọmọ-ọdọ baba rẹ̀ ti wà li ọjọ́ Abrahamu, baba rẹ̀, awọn ara Filistia dí wọn, nwọn si fi erupẹ dí wọn.
entries.en: For all the wells which his father's servants had digged in the days of Abraham his father, the Philistines had stopped them, and filled them with earth.

entries.yo: Abimeleki si wi fun Isaaki pe, Lọ kuro lọdọ wa; nitori ti iwọ lagbara pupọ̀ ju wa lọ.
entries.en: And Abimelech said unto Isaac, Go from us; for thou art much mightier than we.

entries.yo: Isaaki si ṣí kuro nibẹ̀, o si pa agọ́ rẹ̀ ni afonifoji Gerari, o si joko nibẹ̀.
entries.en: And Isaac departed thence, and pitched his tent in the valley of Gerar, and dwelt there.

entries.yo: Isaaki si tun wà kanga omi, ti nwọn ti wà li ọjọ́ Abrahamu, baba rẹ̀; nitori ti awọn ara Filistia ti dí wọn lẹhin ikú Abrahamu: o si pè orukọ wọn gẹgẹ bi orukọ ti baba rẹ̀ sọ wọn.
entries.en: And Isaac digged again the wells of water, which they had digged in the days of Abraham his father; for the philistines had stopped them after the death of Abraham: and he called their names after the names by which his father had called them.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ-ọdọ Isaaki si wàlẹ li afonifoji nì, nwọn si kàn kanga isun omi nibẹ̀.
entries.en: And Isaac's servants digged in the valley, and found there a well of springing water.

entries.yo: Awọn darandaran Gerari si mba awọn darandaran Isaaki jà, wipe, Ti wa li omi na: o si sọ orukọ kanga na ni Eseki; nitori ti nwọn bá a jà.
entries.en: And the herdmen of Gerar did strive with Isaac's herdmen, saying, The water is ours: and he called the name of the well Esek; because they strove with him.

entries.yo: Nwọn si tun wà kanga miran, nwọn si tun jà nitori eyi na pẹlu: o si sọ orukọ rẹ̀ ni Sitna.
entries.en: And they digged another well, and strove for that also:and he called the name of it Sitnah.

entries.yo: O si ṣí kuro nibẹ̀, o si wà kanga miran: nwọn kò si jà nitori rẹ̀: o si pè orukọ rẹ̀ ni Rehoboti; o si wipe, Njẹ nigbayi li OLUWA tó fi àye fun wa, awa o si ma bisi i ni ilẹ yi.
entries.en: And he removed from thence, and digged another well; and for that they strove not: and he called the name of it Rehoboth; and he said, For now the LORD hath made room for us, and we shall be fruitful in the land.

entries.yo: O si goke lati ibẹ̀ lọ si Beer-ṣeba.
entries.en: And he went up from thence to Beer-sheba.

entries.yo: OLUWA si farahàn a li oru ọjọ́ na, o si wipe, Emi li Ọlọrun Abrahamu, baba rẹ: máṣe bẹ̀ru, nitori ti emi wà pẹlu rẹ, emi o si busi i fun ọ, emi o si mu irú-ọmọ rẹ rẹ̀, nitori Abrahamu ọmọ-ọdọ mi.
entries.en: And the LORD appeared unto him the same night, and said, I am the God of Abraham thy father: fear not, for I am with thee, and will bless thee, and multiply thy seed for my servant Abraham's sake.

entries.yo: O si tẹ́ pẹpẹ kan nibẹ̀, o si kepè orukọ OLUWA, o si pa agọ́ rẹ̀ nibẹ̀: awọn ọmọ-ọdọ Isaaki si wà kanga kan nibẹ̀.
entries.en: And he builded an altar there, and called upon the name of the LORD and pitched his tent there: and there Isaac's servants digged a well.

entries.yo: Nigbana li Abimeleki tọ̀ ọ lati Gerari lọ, ati Ahusati, ọkan ninu awọn ọ̀rẹ́ rẹ̀, ati Fikoli, olori ogun rẹ̀.
entries.en: Then Abimelech went to him from Gerar, and Ahuzzath one of his friends, and Phichol the chief captain of his army.

entries.yo: Isaaki si bi wọn pe, Nitori kili ẹnyin ṣe tọ̀ mi wá, ẹnyin sa korira mi, ẹnyin si ti lé mi kuro lọdọ nyin?
entries.en: And Isaac said unto them, Wherefore come ye to me, seeing ye hate me, and have sent me away from you?

entries.yo: Nwọn si wipe, Awa ri i nitõtọ pe, OLUWA wà pẹlu rẹ: awa si wipe, Njẹ nisisiyi jẹ ki ibura ki o wà lãrin wa, ani lãrin tawa tirẹ, ki awa ki o si ba iwọ dá majẹmu;
entries.en: And they said, We saw certainly that the LORD was with thee: and we said, Let there be now an oath betwixt us, even betwixt us and thee, and let us make a covenant with thee;

entries.yo: Pe iwọ ki yio ṣe wa ni ibi, bi awa kò si ti fọwọkàn ọ, ati bi awa kò si ti ṣe ọ ni nkan bikoṣe rere, ti awa si rán ọ jade li alafia: nisisiyi ẹni-ibukún OLUWA ni iwọ.
entries.en: That thou wilt do us no hurt, as we have not touched thee, and as we have done unto thee nothing but good, and have sent thee away in peace: thou art now the blessed of the LORD.

entries.yo: O si sè àse fun wọn, nwọn si jẹ, nwọn si mu.
entries.en: And he made them a feast, and they did eat and drink.

entries.yo: Nwọn si dide ni kutukutu owurọ̀, nwọn si bura fun ara wọn: Isaaki si rán wọn pada lọ, nwọn si lọ kuro lọdọ rẹ̀ li alafia.
entries.en: And they rose up betimes in the morning, and sware one to another: and Isaac sent them away, and they departed from him in peace.

entries.yo: O si ṣe li ọjọ́ kanna li awọn ọmọ-ọdọ Isaaki wá, nwọn si rò fun u niti kanga ti nwọn wà, nwọn si wi fun u pe, Awa kàn omi.
entries.en: And it came to pass the same day, that Isaac's servants came, and told him concerning the well which they had digged, and said unto him, We have found water.

entries.yo: O sọ orukọ rẹ̀ ni Ṣeba: nitorina li orukọ ilu na ṣe njẹ Beer-ṣeba titi di oni.
entries.en: And he called it Shebah: therefore the name of the city is Beer-sheba unto this day.

entries.yo: Esau si di ẹni ogoji ọdún nigbati o mu Juditi li aya, ọmọbinrin Beeri, ara Hitti, ati Baṣemati, ọmọbinrin Eloni, ara Hitti:
entries.en: And Esau was forty years old when he took to wife Judith the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and Bashemath the daughter of Elon the Hittite:

entries.yo: Ohun ti o ṣe ibinujẹ fun Isaaki ati fun Rebeka.
entries.en: Which were a grief of mind unto Isaac and to Rebekah.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, ti Isaaki gbó, ti oju rẹ̀ si nṣe bàibai, tobẹ̃ ti kò le riran, o pè Esau, ọmọ rẹ̀ akọ́bi, o si wi fun u pe, Ọmọ mi: on si dá a li ohùn pe, Emi niyi.
entries.en: And it came to pass, that when Isaac was old, and his eyes were dim, so that he could not see, he called Esau his eldest son, and said unto him, My son: and he said unto him, Behold, here am I.

entries.yo: O si wipe, Wò o na, emi di arugbo, emi kò si mọ̀ ọjọ́ ikú mi;
entries.en: And he said, Behold now, I am old, I know not the day of my death:

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, emi bẹ̀ ọ, mu ohun ọdẹ rẹ, apó rẹ, ati ọrun rẹ, ki o si jade lọ si igbẹ́ ki o si pa ẹran-igbẹ́ fun mi wá:
entries.en: Now therefore take, I pray thee, thy weapons, thy quiver and thy bow, and go out to the field, and take me some venison;

entries.yo: Ki o si sè ẹran adidùn fun mi, bi irú eyiti mo fẹ́, ki o si gbé e tọ̀ mi wá, ki emi ki o jẹ: ki ọkàn mi ki o súre fun ọ ki emi to kú.
entries.en: And make me savoury meat, such as I love, and bring it to me, that I may eat; that my soul may bless thee before I die.

entries.yo: Rebeka si gbọ́ nigbati Isaaki nwi fun Esau, ọmọ rẹ̀. Esau si lọ si igbẹ́ lọ iṣọdẹ, lati pa ẹran-igbẹ́ wá.
entries.en: And Rebekah heard when Isaac spake to Esau his son. And Esau went to the field to hunt for venison, and to bring it.

entries.yo: Rebeka si wi fun Jakobu ọmọ rẹ̀ pe, Wò o, mo gbọ́ baba rẹ wi fun Esau arakunrin rẹ pe,
entries.en: And Rebekah spake unto Jacob her son, saying, Behold, I heard thy father speak unto Esau thy brother, saying,

entries.yo: Mu ẹran-igbẹ́ fun mi wá, ki o si sè ẹran adidùn fun mi, ki emi ki o jẹ, ki emi ki o sure fun ọ niwaju OLUWA ṣaju ikú mi.
entries.en: Bring me venison, and make me savoury meat, that I may eat, and bless thee before the LORD before my death.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, ọmọ mi, gbọ́ ohùn mi, gẹgẹ bi emi o ti paṣẹ fun ọ.
entries.en: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice according to that which I command thee.

entries.yo: Lọ nisisiyi sinu agbo-ẹran, ki o si mu ọmọ ewurẹ meji daradara fun mi lati ibẹ̀ wá: emi o si sè wọn li ẹran adidùn fun baba rẹ, bi irú eyiti o fẹ́:
entries.en: Go now to the flock, and fetch me from thence two good kids of the goats; and I will make them savoury meat for thy father, such as he loveth:

entries.yo: Iwọ o si gbé e tọ̀ baba rẹ lọ, ki o le jẹ, ki o le súre fun ọ, ki on to kú.
entries.en: And thou shalt bring it to thy father, that he may eat, and that he may bless thee before his death.

entries.yo: Jakobu si wi fun Rebeka iya rẹ̀ pe, Kiyesi i, enia onirun ni Esau arakunrin mi, alara ọbọrọ́ si li emi:
entries.en: And Jacob said to Rebekah his mother, Behold, Esau my brother is a hairy man, and I am a smooth man:

entries.yo: Bọya baba mi yio fọwọbà mi, emi o si dabi ẹlẹ̀tan fun u; emi o si mu egún wá si ori mi ki yio ṣe ibukún.
entries.en: My father peradventure will feel me, and I shall seem to him as a deceiver; and I shall bring a curse upon me, and not a blessing.

entries.yo: Iya rẹ̀ si wi fun u pe, lori mi ni ki egún rẹ wà, ọmọ mi: sá gbọ́ ohùn mi, ki o si lọ mu wọn fun mi wá.
entries.en: And his mother said unto him, Upon me be thy curse, my son: only obey my voice, and go fetch me them.

entries.yo: O si lọ, o mu wọn, o si fà wọn tọ̀ iya rẹ̀ wá: iya rẹ̀ si sè ẹran adidùn; bi irú eyiti baba rẹ̀ fẹ́.
entries.en: And he went, and fetched, and brought them to his mother: and his mother made savoury meat, such as his father loved.

entries.yo: Rebeka si mu ãyo aṣọ Esau, ọmọ rẹ̀ ẹgbọ́n, ti o wà lọdọ rẹ̀ ni ile, o si fi wọn wọ̀ Jakobu, ọmọ rẹ̀ aburo:
entries.en: And Rebekah took goodly raiment of her eldest son Esau, which were with her in the house, and put them upon Jacob her younger son:

entries.yo: O si fi awọ awọn ọmọ ewurẹ wọnni bò o li ọwọ́, ati si ọbọrọ́ ọrùn rẹ̀:
entries.en: And she put the skins of the kids of the goats upon his hands, and upon the smooth of his neck:

entries.yo: O si fi ẹran adidùn na, ati àkara ti o ti pèse, le Jakobu, ọmọ rẹ̀, lọwọ.
entries.en: And she gave the savoury meat and the bread, which she had prepared, into the hand of her son Jacob.

entries.yo: O si tọ̀ baba rẹ̀ wá, o wipe, Baba mi: on si wipe, Emi niyi; iwọ tani nì ọmọ mi?
entries.en: And he came unto his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here am I; who art thou, my son?

entries.yo: Jakobu si wi fun baba rẹ̀ pe, Emi Esau akọ́bi rẹ ni; emi ti ṣe gẹgẹ bi o ti sọ fun mi, dide joko, emi bẹ̀ ọ, ki o si jẹ ninu ẹran-igbẹ́ mi, ki ọkàn rẹ le súre fun mi.
entries.en: And Jacob said unto his father, I am Esau thy firstborn; I have done according as thou badest me: arise, I pray thee, sit and eat of my venison, that thy soul may bless me.

entries.yo: Isaaki si wi fun ọmọ rẹ̀ pe, Ẽti ri ti iwọ fi tete ri i bẹ̃, ọmọ mi? on si wipe, Nitoriti OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ mu u tọ̀ mi wá ni.
entries.en: And Isaac said unto his son, How is it that thou hast found it so quickly, my son? And he said, Because the LORD thy God brought it to me.

entries.yo: Isaaki si wi fun Jakobu pe, Emi bẹ̀ ọ, sunmọ mi, ki emi ki o fọwọbà ọ, ọmọ mi, bi iwọ iṣe Esau, ọmọ mi nitotọ, bi bẹ̃kọ.
entries.en: And Isaac said unto Jacob, Come near, I pray thee, that I may feel thee, my son, whether thou be my very son Esau or not.

entries.yo: Jakobu si sunmọ Isaaki baba rẹ̀, o si fọwọbà a, o si wipe, Ohùn Jakobu li ohùn, ṣugbọn ọwọ́ li ọwọ́ Esau.
entries.en: And Jacob went near unto Isaac his father; and he felt him, and said, The voice is Jacob's voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau.

entries.yo: On kò si mọ̀ ọ, nitoriti ọwọ́ rẹ̀ ṣe onirun, bi ọwọ́ Esau, arakunrin rẹ̀: bẹ̃li o sure fun u.
entries.en: And he discerned him not, because his hands were hairy, as his brother Esau's hands: so he blessed him.

entries.yo: O si wipe, Iwọ ni Esau ọmọ mi nitotọ? o si wipe, emi ni.
entries.en: And he said, Art thou my very son Esau? And he said, I am.

entries.yo: O si wipe, Gbé e sunmọ ọdọ mi, emi o si jẹ ninu ẹran-igbẹ́ ọmọ mi, ki ọkàn mi ki o le sure fun ọ. O si gbé e sunmọ ọdọ rẹ̀, o si jẹ: o si gbé ọti-waini fun u, on si mu.
entries.en: And he said, Bring it near to me, and I will eat of my son's venison, that my soul may bless thee. And he brought it near to him, and he did eat: and he brought him wine, and he drank.

entries.yo: Isaaki baba rẹ̀ si wi fun u pe, Sunmọ ihín nisisiyi ọmọ mi, ki o si fi ẹnu kò mi li ẹnu.
entries.en: And his father Isaac said unto him, Come near now, and kiss me, my son.

entries.yo: O si sunmọ ọ, o si fi ẹnu kò o li ẹnu: o si gbọ́ õrùn aṣọ rẹ̀, o si sure fun u, o si wipe, Wò o, õrùn ọmọ mi o dabi õrùn oko eyiti OLUWA ti busi.
entries.en: And he came near, and kissed him: and he smelled the smell of his raiment, and blessed him, and said, See, the smell of my son is as the smell of a field which the LORD hath blessed:

entries.yo: Ọlọrun yio si fun ọ ninu ìri ọrun, ati ninu ọrá ilẹ, ati ọ̀pọlọpọ ọkà ati ọti-waini:
entries.en: Therefore God give thee of the dew of heaven, and the fatness of the earth, and plenty of corn and wine:

entries.yo: Ki enia ki o mã sìn ọ, ki orilẹ-ède ki o mã tẹriba fun ọ: mã ṣe oluwa awọn arakunrin rẹ, ki awọn ọmọ iya rẹ ki o tẹriba fun ọ: ifibú li awọn ẹniti o fi ọ bú, ibukún si ni fun awọn ẹniti o sure fun ọ.
entries.en: Let people serve thee, and nations bow down to thee: be lord over thy brethren, and let thy mother's sons bow down to thee: cursed be every one that curseth thee, and blessed be he that blesseth thee.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, bi Isaaki ti pari ire isú fun Jakobu, ti Jakobu si fẹrẹ má jade tan kuro niwaju Isaaki baba rẹ̀, ni Esau, arakunrin rẹ̀ wọle de lati igbẹ́ ọdẹ rẹ̀ wá.
entries.en: And it came to pass, as soon as Isaac had made an end of blessing Jacob, and Jacob was yet scarce gone out from the presence of Isaac his father, that Esau his brother came in from his hunting.

entries.yo: On pẹlu si ti sè ẹran adidùn, o si mu u tọ̀ baba rẹ̀ wá, o si wi fun baba rẹ̀ pe, Ki baba mi ki o dide ki o si jẹ ninu ẹran-igbẹ́ ọmọ rẹ̀, ki ọkàn rẹ le sure fun mi.
entries.en: And he also had made savoury meat, and brought it unto his father, and said unto his father, Let my father arise, and eat of his son's venison, that thy soul may bless me.

entries.yo: Isaaki baba rẹ̀ si bi i pe, Iwọ tani nì? on si wipe, Emi Esau, ọmọ rẹ akọbi ni.
entries.en: And Isaac his father said unto him, Who art thou? And he said, I am thy son, thy firstborn Esau.

entries.yo: Isaaki si warìri gidigidi rekọja, o si wipe, Tani nla? tali ẹniti o ti pa ẹran-igbẹ́, ti o si gbé e tọ̀ mi wá, emi si ti jẹ ninu gbogbo rẹ̀, ki iwọ ki o to de, emi si ti sure fun u? nitõtọ a o si bukún fun u.
entries.en: And Isaac trembled very exceedingly, and said, Who? where is he that hath taken venison, and brought it me, and I have eaten of all before thou camest, and have blessed him? yea, and he shall be blessed.

entries.yo: Nigbati Esau gbọ́ ọ̀rọ baba rẹ̀, o fi igbe nlanla ta, o si sun ẹkun kikorò gidigidi, o si wi fun baba rẹ̀ pe, Sure fun mi, ani fun emi pẹlu, baba mi.
entries.en: And when Esau heard the words of his father, he cried with a great and exceeding bitter cry, and said unto his father, Bless me, even me also, O my father.

entries.yo: O si wipe, Arakunrin rẹ fi erú wá, o si ti gbà ibukún rẹ lọ.
entries.en: And he said, Thy brother came with subtilty, and hath taken away thy blessing.

entries.yo: O si wipe, A kò ha pè orukọ rẹ̀ ni Jakobu ndan? nitori o jì mi li ẹsẹ̀ ni ìgba meji yi: o gbà ogún-ibi lọwọ mi; si kiyesi i, nisisiyi o si gbà ire mi lọ. O si wipe, Iwọ kò ha pa ire kan mọ́ fun mi?
entries.en: And he said, Is not he rightly named Jacob? for he hath supplanted me these two times: he took away my birthright; and, behold, now he hath taken away my blessing. And he said, Hast thou not reserved a blessing for me?

entries.yo: Isaaki si dahùn o si wi fun Esau pe, Wõ, emi ti fi on ṣe oluwa rẹ, ati gbogbo awọn arakunrin rẹ̀ li emi ti fi ṣe iranṣẹ rẹ̀; ati ọkà ati ọti-waini ni mo fi gbè e: ewo li emi o ha ṣe fun ọ nisisiyi, ọmọ mi?
entries.en: And Isaac answered and said unto Esau, Behold, I have made him thy lord, and all his brethren have I given to him for servants; and with corn and wine have I sustained him: and what shall I do now unto thee, my son?

entries.yo: Esau si wi fun baba rẹ̀ pe, Ire kanṣoṣo li o ni iwọ baba mi? sure fun mi, ani fun mi pẹlu, baba mi? Esau si gbé ohùn rẹ̀ soke, o sọkun.
entries.en: And Esau said unto his father, Hast thou but one blessing, my father? bless me, even me also, O my father. And Esau lifted up his voice, and wept.

entries.yo: Isaaki baba rẹ̀ si dahùn o si wi fun u pe, Wõ, ibujoko rẹ yio jẹ ọrá ilẹ, ati ibi ìri ọrun lati oke wá;
entries.en: And Isaac his father answered and said unto him, Behold, thy dwelling shall be the fatness of the earth, and of the dew of heaven from above;

entries.yo: Nipa idà rẹ ni iwọ o ma gbé, iwọ o si ma sìn arakunrin rẹ; yio si ṣe nigbati iwọ ba di alagbara tan, iwọ o já àjaga rẹ̀ kuro li ọrùn rẹ.
entries.en: And by thy sword shalt thou live, and shalt serve thy brother; and it shall come to pass when thou shalt have the dominion, that thou shalt break his yoke from off thy neck.

entries.yo: Esau si korira Jakobu nitori ire ti baba rẹ̀ su fun u: Esau si wi li ọkàn rẹ̀ pe, Ọjọ́ ọ̀fọ baba mi sunmọ-etile; nigbana li emi o pa Jakobu, arakunrin mi.
entries.en: And Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing wherewith his father blessed him: and Esau said in his heart, The days of mourning for my father are at hand; then will I slay my brother Jacob.

entries.yo: A si sọ ọ̀rọ Esau akọ́bi rẹ̀ wọnyi fun Rebeka: on si ranṣẹ o si pè Jakobu, ọmọ rẹ̀ aburo, o si wi fun u pe, Kiyesi i, Esau, arakunrin rẹ, ntù ara rẹ ninu niti rẹ lati pa ọ.
entries.en: And these words of Esau her elder son were told to Rebekah: and she sent and called Jacob her younger son, and said unto him, Behold, thy brother Esau, as touching thee, doth comfort himself, purposing to kill thee.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi ọmọ mi, gbọ́ ohùn mi; si dide, sá tọ̀ Labani arakunrin mi lọ si Harani;
entries.en: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice; and arise, flee thou to Laban my brother to Haran;

entries.yo: Ki o si bá a joko ni ijọ́ melo kan, titi ibinu arakunrin rẹ yio fi tuka;
entries.en: And tarry with him a few days, until thy brother's fury turn away;

entries.yo: Titi inu arakunrin rẹ yio fi tutu si ọ, ti yio si fi gbagbe ohun ti o fi ṣe e: nigbana li emi o ranṣẹ mu ọ lati ibẹ̀ wá: ẽṣe ti emi o fi fẹ́ ẹnyin mejeji kù ni ijọ́ kanṣoṣo?
entries.en: Until thy brother's anger turn away from thee, and he forget that which thou hast done to him: then I will send, and fetch thee from thence: why should I be deprived also of you both in one day?

entries.yo: Rebeka si wi fun Isaaki pe, Agara aiye mi ma dá mi nitori awọn ọmọbinrin Heti, bi Jakobu ba fẹ́ aya ninu awọn ọmọbinrin Heti, bi irú awọn wọnyi yi iṣe ninu awọn ọmọbinrin ilẹ yi, aiye mi o ha ti ri?
entries.en: And Rebekah said to Isaac, I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth: if Jacob take a wife of the daughters of Heth, such as these which are of the daughters of the land, what good shall my life do me?

entries.yo: ISAAKI si pè Jakobu, o si sùre fun u, o si kìlọ fun u, o si wi fun u pe, Iwọ kò gbọdọ fẹ́ aya ninu awọn ọmọbinrin Kenaani.
entries.en: And Isaac called Jacob, and blessed him, and charged him, and said unto him, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan.

entries.yo: Dide, lọ si Padan-aramu, si ile Betueli, baba iya rẹ; ki iwọ ki o si fẹ́ aya lati ibẹ̀ wá ninu awọn ọmọbinrin Labani, arakunrin iya rẹ.
entries.en: Arise, go to Padan-aram, to the house of Bethuel thy mother's father; and take thee a wife from thence of the daughters of Laban thy mother's brother.

entries.yo: Ki Ọlọrun Olodumare ki o gbè ọ, ki o si mu ọ bisi i, ki o si mu ọ rẹ̀ si i, ki iwọ ki o le di ọ̀pọlọpọ enia.
entries.en: And God Almighty bless thee, and make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, that thou mayest be a multitude of people;

entries.yo: Ki o si fi ibukún Abrahamu fun ọ, fun iwọ ati fun irú-ọmọ rẹ pẹlu rẹ; ki iwọ ki o le ni ilẹ na ninu eyiti iwọ nṣe atipo, ti Ọlọrun fi fun Abrahamu.
entries.en: And give thee the blessing of Abraham, to thee, and to thy seed with thee; that thou mayest inherit the land wherein thou art a stranger, which God gave unto Abraham.

entries.yo: Isaaki si rán Jakobu lọ: o si lọ si Padan-aramu si ọdọ Labani, ọmọ Betueli, ara Siria, arakunrin Rebeka, iya Jakobu on Esau.
entries.en: And Isaac sent away Jacob: and he went to Padan-aram unto Laban, son of Bethuel the Syrian, the brother of Rebekah, Jacob's and Esau's mother.

entries.yo: Nigbati Esau ri pe Isaaki sure fun Jakobu ti o si rán a lọ si Padan-aramu, lati fẹ́ aya lati ibẹ̀; ati pe bi o ti sure fun u, o si kìlọ fun u wipe, iwọ kò gbọdọ fẹ́ aya ninu awọn ọmọbinrin Kenaani;
entries.en: When Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob, and sent him away to Padan-aram, to take him a wife from thence; and that as he blessed him he gave him a charge, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan;

entries.yo: Ati pe Jakobu gbọ́ ti baba ati ti iya rẹ̀, ti o si lọ si Padan-aramu:
entries.en: And that Jacob obeyed his father and his mother, and was gone to Padan-aram;

entries.yo: Nigbati Esau ri pe awọn ọmọbinrin Kenaani kò wù Isaaki baba rẹ̀;
entries.en: And Esau seeing that the daughters of Canaan pleased not Isaac his father;

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Esau tọ̀ Iṣmaeli lọ, o si fẹ́ Mahalati ọmọbinrin Iṣmaeli, ọmọ Abrahamu, arabinrin Nebajotu, kún awọn obinrin ti o ni.
entries.en: Then went Esau unto Ishmael, and took unto the wives which he had Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael Abraham's son, the sister of Nebajoth, to be his wife.

entries.yo: Jakobu si jade kuro lati Beer-ṣeba lọ, o si lọ si ìha Harani.
entries.en: And Jacob went out from Beer-sheba, and went toward Haran.

entries.yo: O si de ibi kan, o duro nibẹ̀ li oru na, nitori õrùn wọ̀; o si mu ninu okuta ibẹ̀ na, o fi ṣe irọri rẹ̀, o si sùn nibẹ̀ na.
entries.en: And he lighted upon a certain place, and tarried there all night, because the sun was set; and he took of the stones of that place, and put them for his pillows, and lay down in that place to sleep.

entries.yo: O si lá alá, si kiyesi i, a gbé àkasọ kan duro lori ilẹ, ori rẹ̀ si de oke ọrun: si kiyesi i, awọn angeli Ọlọrun ngoke, nwọn si nsọkalẹ lori rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he dreamed, and behold a ladder set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven: and behold the angels of God ascending and descending on it.

entries.yo: Si kiyesi i, OLUWA duro loke rẹ̀, o si wi pe, Emi li OLUWA, Ọlọrun Abrahamu baba rẹ, ati Ọlọrun Isaaki; ilẹ ti iwọ dubulẹ le nì, iwọ li emi o fi fun, ati fun irú-ọmọ rẹ.
entries.en: And, behold, the LORD stood above it, and said, I am the LORD God of Abraham thy father, and the God of Isaac: the land whereon thou liest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed;

entries.yo: Irú-ọmọ rẹ yio si ri bi erupẹ̀ ilẹ, iwọ o si tàn kalẹ si ìha ìwọ-õrùn, ati si ìha ìla-õrùn, ati si ìha ariwa, ati si ìha gusù: ninu rẹ, ati ninu irú-ọmọ rẹ li a o bukún fun gbogbo ibatan aiye.
entries.en: And thy seed shall be as the dust of the earth, and thou shalt spread abroad to the west, and to the east, and to the north, and to the south: and in thee and in thy seed shall all the families of the earth be blessed.

entries.yo: Si kiyesi i, emi wà pẹlu rẹ, emi o sì pa ọ mọ́ ni ibi gbogbo ti iwọ nlọ, emi o si tun mu ọ bọ̀wá si ilẹ yi; nitori emi ki yio kọ̀ ọ silẹ, titi emi o fi ṣe eyiti mo wi fun ọ tan.
entries.en: And, behold, I am with thee, and will keep thee in all places whither thou goest, and will bring thee again into this land; for I will not leave thee, until I have done that which I have spoken to thee of.

entries.yo: Jakobu si jí li oju-orun rẹ̀, o si wipe, OLUWA mbẹ nihinyi nitõtọ; emi kò si mọ̀.
entries.en: And Jacob awaked out of his sleep, and he said, Surely the LORD is in this place; and I knew it not.

entries.yo: Ẹrù si bà a, o si wipe, Ihinyi ti li ẹ̀ru tó! eyi ki iṣe ibi omiran, bikoṣe ile Ọlọrun, eyi si li ẹnubode ọrun.
entries.en: And he was afraid, and said, How dreadful is this place! this is none other but the house of God, and this is the gate of heaven.

entries.yo: Jakobu si dide ni kutukutu owurọ̀, o si mu okuta ti o fi ṣe irọri rẹ̀, o si fi lelẹ fun ọwọ̀n, o si ta oróro si ori rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Jacob rose up early in the morning, and took the stone that he had put for his pillows, and set it up for a pillar, and poured oil upon the top of it.

entries.yo: O si pè orukọ ibẹ̀ na ni Beteli: ṣugbọn Lusi li orukọ ilu na ri.
entries.en: And he called the name of that place Bethel: but the name of that city was called Luz at the first.

entries.yo: Jakobu si jẹ́ ẹjẹ́ wipe, Bi Ọlọrun ba pẹlu mi, ti o si pa mi mọ́ li ọ̀na yi ti emi ntọ̀, ti o si fun mi li ohun jijẹ, ati aṣọ bibora,
entries.en: And Jacob vowed a vow, saying, If God will be with me, and will keep me in this way that I go, and will give me bread to eat, and raiment to put on,

entries.yo: Ti mo si pada wá si ile baba mi li alafia; njẹ OLUWA ni yio ma ṣe Ọlọrun mi.
entries.en: So that I come again to my father's house in peace; then shall the LORD be my God:

entries.yo: Okuta yi, ti mo fi lelẹ ṣe ọwọ̀n ni yio si ṣe ile Ọlọrun: ati ninu ohun gbogbo ti iwọ o fi fun mi, emi o si fi idamẹwa rẹ̀ fun ọ.
entries.en: And this stone, which I have set for a pillar, shall be God's house: and of all that thou shalt give me I will surely give the tenth unto thee.

entries.yo: JAKOBU si mu ọ̀na àjo rẹ̀ pọ̀n, o si wá si ilẹ awọn ara ìla-õrùn.
entries.en: Then Jacob went on his journey, and came into the land of the people of the east.

entries.yo: O si wò, si kiyesi i, kanga kan ninu oko, si kiyesi i, agbo-agutan mẹta dubulẹ tì i; nitori pe, lati inu kanga na wá ni nwọn ti nfi omi fun awọn agbo-agutan: okuta nla si wà li ẹnu kanga na.
entries.en: And he looked, and behold a well in the field, and, lo, there were three flocks of sheep lying by it; for out of that well they watered the flocks: and a great stone was upon the well's mouth.

entries.yo: Nibẹ̀ ni gbogbo awọn agbo-ẹran kojọ pọ̀ si: nwọn si fun awọn agutan li omi, nwọn si tun yí okuta dí ẹnu kanga si ipò rẹ̀.
entries.en: And thither were all the flocks gathered: and they rolled the stone from the well's mouth, and watered the sheep, and put the stone again upon the well's mouth in his place.

entries.yo: Jakobu si bi wọn pe, Ẹnyin arakunrin mi, nibo li ẹnyin ti wá? nwọn si wipe, lati Harani li a ti wá.
entries.en: And Jacob said unto them, My brethren, whence be ye? And they said, Of Haran are we.

entries.yo: O si bi wọn pe, ẹnyin mọ̀ Labani, ọmọ Nahori? Nwọn si wipe, Awa mọ̀ ọ.
entries.en: And he said unto them, Know ye Laban the son of Nahor? And they said, We know him.

entries.yo: O si bi wọn pe, Alafia ki o wà bi? nwọn si wipe Alafia ni; si kiyesi i, Rakeli, ọmọbinrin rẹ̀ mbọ̀wá pẹlu ọwọ́-ẹran.
entries.en: And he said unto them, Is he well? And they said, He is well: and, behold, Rachel his daughter cometh with the sheep.

entries.yo: O si wipe, Kiyesi i, ọjọ́ mbẹ sibẹ̀, bẹ̃ni kò tó akokò ti awọn ẹran yio wọjọ pọ̀: ẹ fun awọn agutan li omi, ki ẹ si lọ ibọ́ wọn.
entries.en: And he said, Lo, it is yet high day, neither is it time that the cattle should be gathered together: water ye the sheep, and go and feed them.

entries.yo: Nwọn si wipe, Awa kò le ṣe e, titi gbogbo awọn agbo-ẹran yio fi wọjọ pọ̀, ti nwọn o si fi yí okuta kuro li ẹnu kanga; nigbana li a le fun awọn agutan li omi.
entries.en: And they said, We cannot, until all the flocks be gathered together, and till they roll the stone from the well's mouth; then we water the sheep.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si mba wọn sọ̀rọ lọwọ, Rakeli de pẹlu awọn agutan baba rẹ̀: on li o sa nṣọ́ wọn.
entries.en: And while he yet spake with them, Rachel came with her father's sheep: for she kept them.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati Jakobu ri Rakeli, ọmọbinrin Labani, arakunrin iya rẹ̀, ati agutan Labani, arakunrin iya rẹ̀, ni Jakobu si sunmọ ibẹ̀, o si yí okuta kuro li ẹnu kanga, o si fi omi fun gbogbo agbo-ẹran Labani, arakunrin iya rẹ̀.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban his mother's brother, and the sheep of Laban his mother's brother, that Jacob went near, and rolled the stone from the well's mouth, and watered the flock of Laban his mother's brother.

entries.yo: Jakobu si fi ẹnu kò Rakeli li ẹnu, o si gbé ohùn rẹ̀ soke, o sọkun.
entries.en: And Jacob kissed Rachel, and lifted up his voice, and wept.

entries.yo: Jakobu si wi fun Rakeli pe arakunrin baba rẹ̀ li on, ati pe, ọmọ Rebeka li on: ọmọbinrin na si sure o si sọ fun baba rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Jacob told Rachel that he was her father's brother, and that he was Rebekah's son: and she ran and told her father.

entries.yo: O si ṣe ti Labani gburó Jakobu, ọmọ arabinrin rẹ̀, o sure lọ ipade rẹ̀, o si gbá a mú, o si fi ẹnu kò o li ẹnu, o si mu u wá si ile rẹ̀. On si ròhin gbogbo nkan wọnni fun Labani.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when Laban heard the tidings of Jacob his sister's son, that he ran to meet him, and embraced him, and kissed him, and brought him to his house. And he told Laban all these things.

entries.yo: Labani si wi fun u pe, egungun on ẹran-ara mi ni iwọ iṣe nitõtọ. O si bá a joko ni ìwọn oṣù kan.
entries.en: And Laban said to him, Surely thou art my bone and my flesh. And he abode with him the space of a month.

entries.yo: Labani si wi fun Jakobu pe, Iwọ o ha ma sìn mi li asan bi, nitoriti iwọ iṣe arakunrin mi? elo li owo iṣẹ rẹ, wi fun mi?
entries.en: And Laban said unto Jacob, Because thou art my brother, shouldest thou therefore serve me for nought? tell me, what shall thy wages be?

entries.yo: Labani si ni ọmọbinrin meji: orukọ ẹgbọ́n a ma jẹ Lea, orukọ aburo a si ma jẹ Rakeli.
entries.en: And Laban had two daughters: the name of the elder was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.

entries.yo: Oju Lea kò li ẹwà, ṣugbọn Rakeli ṣe arẹwà, o si wù ni.
entries.en: Leah was tender eyed; but Rachel was beautiful and well favoured.

entries.yo: Jakobu si fẹ́ Rakeli; o si wipe, Emi o sìn ọ li ọdún meje nitori Rakeli, ọmọbinrin rẹ abikẹhin.
entries.en: And Jacob loved Rachel; and said, I will serve thee seven years for Rachel thy younger daughter.

entries.yo: Labani si wipe, O san lati fi i fun ọ, jù ki nfi i fun ẹlomiran lọ: ba mi joko.
entries.en: And Laban said, It is better that I give her to thee, than that I should give her to another man: abide with me.

entries.yo: Jakobu si sìn i li ọdún meje fun Rakeli; nwọn sì dabi ijọ́ melokan li oju rẹ̀ nitori ifẹ́ ti o fẹ́ ẹ.
entries.en: And Jacob served seven years for Rachel; and they seemed unto him but a few days, for the love he had to her.

entries.yo: Jakobu si wi fun Labani pe, Fi aya mi fun mi, nitoriti ọjọ́ mi pé, ki emi ki o le wọle tọ̀ ọ.
entries.en: And Jacob said unto Laban, Give me my wife, for my days are fulfilled, that I may go in unto her.

entries.yo: Labani si pè gbogbo awọn enia ibẹ̀ jọ, o si se àse.
entries.en: And Laban gathered together all the men of the place, and made a feast.

entries.yo: O si ṣe li alẹ, o mú Lea ọmọbinrin rẹ̀, o sìn i tọ̀ ọ wá; on si wọle tọ̀ ọ lọ.
entries.en: And it came to pass in the evening, that he took Leah his daughter, and brought her to him; and he went in unto her.

entries.yo: Labani si fi Silpa, ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ̀, fun Lea, ọmọbinrin rẹ̀, ni iranṣẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Laban gave unto his daughter Leah Zilpah his maid for an handmaid.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, li owurọ, wò o, o jẹ́ Lea: o si wi fun Labani pe, Ẽwo li eyiti iwọ ṣe si mi yi? nitori Rakeli ki mo ṣe sìn ọ, njẹ ẽhatiṣe ti o fi ṣe erú si mi?
entries.en: And it came to pass, that in the morning, behold, it was Leah: and he said to Laban, What is this thou hast done unto me? did not I serve with thee for Rachel? wherefore then hast thou beguiled me?

entries.yo: Labani si wi fun u pe, A kò gbọdọ ṣe bẹ̃ ni ilẹ wa, lati sìn aburo ṣaju ẹgbọ́n.
entries.en: And Laban said, It must not be so done in our country, to give the younger before the firstborn.

entries.yo: Ṣe ọ̀sẹ ti eleyi pé, awa o si fi eyi fun ọ pẹlu, nitori ìsin ti iwọ o sìn mi li ọdún meje miran si i.
entries.en: Fulfil her week, and we will give thee this also for the service which thou shalt serve with me yet seven other years.

entries.yo: Jakobu si ṣe bẹ̃, o si ṣe ọ̀sẹ rẹ̀ pé: o si fi Rakeli ọmọbinrin rẹ̀ fun u li aya pẹlu.
entries.en: And Jacob did so, and fulfilled her week: and he gave him Rachel his daughter to wife also.

entries.yo: Labani si fi Bilha, ọmọbinrin ọdọ rẹ̀, fun Rakeli, ọmọbinrin rẹ̀, ni iranṣẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Laban gave to Rachel his daughter Bilhah his handmaid to be her maid.

entries.yo: O si wọle tọ̀ Rakeli pẹlu, o si fẹ́ Rakeli jù Lea lọ, o si sìn i li ọdún meje miran si i.
entries.en: And he went in also unto Rachel, and he loved also Rachel more than Leah, and served with him yet seven other years.

entries.yo: Nigbati OLUWA si ri i pe a korira Lea, o ṣi i ni inu: ṣugbọn Rakeli yàgan.
entries.en: And when the LORD saw that Leah was hated, he opened her womb: but Rachel was barren.

entries.yo: Lea si loyun, o si bí ọmọkunrin kan, o si sọ orukọ rẹ̀ ni Reubeni: nitori ti o wipe, OLUWA wò ìya mi nitõtọ: njẹ nitorina, ọkọ mi yio fẹ́ mi.
entries.en: And Leah conceived, and bare a son, and she called his name Reuben: for she said, Surely the LORD hath looked upon my affliction; now therefore my husband will love me.

entries.yo: O si tun yún, o si bí ọmọkunrin kan; o si wipe, Nitori ti OLUWA ti gbọ́ pe a korira mi, nitorina li o ṣe fun mi li ọmọ yi pẹlu: o si sọ orukọ rẹ̀ ni Simeoni.
entries.en: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and said, Because the LORD hath heard that I was hated, he hath therefore given me this son also: and she called his name Simeon.

entries.yo: O si tun loyun, o si bí ọmọkunrin kan; o si wipe, Njẹ nigbayi li ọkọ mi yio faramọ́ mi, nitori ti mo bí ọmọkunrin mẹta fun u: nitorina li o ṣe sọ orukọ rẹ̀ ni Lefi.
entries.en: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and said, Now this time will my husband be joined unto me, because I have born him three sons: therefore was his name called Levi.

entries.yo: O si tun yún, o si bí ọmọkunrin kan: o si wipe, Nigbayi li emi o yìn OLUWA: nitorina li a ṣe sọ orukọ rẹ̀ ni Judah; o si dẹkun bíbi.
entries.en: And she conceived again, and bare a son: and she said, Now will I praise the LORD: therefore she called his name Judah; and left bearing.

entries.yo: NIGBATI Rakeli ri pe on kò bimọ fun Jakobu, Rakeli ṣe ilara arabinrin rẹ̀; o si wi fun Jakobu pe, Fun mi li ọmọ, bikoṣe bẹ̃ emi o kú.
entries.en: And when Rachel saw that she bare Jacob no children, Rachel envied her sister; and said unto Jacob, Give me children, or else I die.

entries.yo: Jakobu si binu si Rakeli: o si wipe, Emi ha wà ni ipò Ọlọrun, ẹniti o dù ọ li ọmọ bíbi?
entries.en: And Jacob's anger was kindled against Rachel: and he said, Am I in God's stead, who hath withheld from thee the fruit of the womb?

entries.yo: On si wipe, Wò Bilha iranṣẹbinrin mi, wọle tọ̀ ọ; on ni yio si bí lori ẽkun mi, ki a le gbé mi ró pẹlu nipasẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And she said, Behold my maid Bilhah, go in unto her; and she shall bear upon my knees that I may also have children by her.

entries.yo: O si fi Bilha, iranṣẹbinrin rẹ̀, fun u li aya: Jakobu si wọle tọ̀ ọ.
entries.en: And she gave him Bilhah her handmaid to wife: and Jacob went in unto her.

entries.yo: Bilha si yún, o si bí ọmọkunrin kan fun Jakobu.
entries.en: And Bilhah conceived, and bare Jacob a son.

entries.yo: Rakeli si wipe, Ọlọrun ti ṣe idajọ mi, o si ti gbọ́ ohùn mi, o si fi ọmọkunrin kan fun mi pẹlu: nitorina li o ṣe sọ orukọ rẹ̀ ni Dani.
entries.en: And Rachel said, God hath judged me, and hath also heard my voice, and hath given me a son: therefore called she his name Dan.

entries.yo: Bilha, iranṣẹbinrin Rakeli, si tun yún, o si bi ọmọkunrin keji fun Jakobu.
entries.en: And Bilhah Rachel's maid conceived again, and bare Jacob a second son.

entries.yo: Rakeli si wipe, Ijakadi nla ni mo fi bá arabinrin mi ja, emi si dá a: o si sọ orukọ rẹ̀ ni Naftali.
entries.en: And Rachel said, With great wrestlings have I wrestled with my sister, and I have prevailed: and she called his name Naphtali.

entries.yo: Nigbati Lea ri pe on dẹkun ọmọ bíbi, o si mú Silpa, iranṣẹbinrin rẹ̀, o si fi i fun Jakobu li aya.
entries.en: When Leah saw that she had left bearing, she took Zilpah her maid, and gave her Jacob to wife.

entries.yo: Silpa, iranṣẹbinrin Lea, si bí ọmọkunrin kan fun Jakobu.
entries.en: And Zilpah Leah's maid bare Jacob a son.

entries.yo: Lea si wipe, Ire de: o si sọ orukọ rẹ̀ ni Gadi.
entries.en: And Leah said, A troop cometh: and she called his name Gad.

entries.yo: Silpa iranṣẹbinrin Lea si bí ọmọkunrin keji fun Jakobu.
entries.en: And Zilpah Leah's maid bare Jacob a second son.

entries.yo: Lea si wipe, Alabukún fun li emi, nitori ti awọn ọmọbinrin yio ma pè mi li alabukún fun: o si sọ orukọ rẹ̀ ni Aṣeri.
entries.en: And Leah said, Happy am I, for the daughters will call me blessed: and she called his name Asher.

entries.yo: Li akokò ìgba ikore alikama, Reubeni si lọ, o si ri eso mandraki ni igbẹ́, o si mú wọn fun Lea iya rẹ̀ wá ile. Nigbana ni Rakeli wi fun Lea pe, Emi bẹ̀ ọ, bùn mi ninu mandraki ọmọ rẹ.
entries.en: And Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest, and found mandrakes in the field, and brought them unto his mother Leah. Then Rachel said to Leah, Give me, I pray thee, of thy son's mandrakes.

entries.yo: O si wi fun u pe, Iṣe nkan kekere ti iwọ gbà ọkọ lọwọ mi? iwọ si nfẹ́ gbà mandraki ọmọ mi pẹlu? Rakeli si wipe, Nitori na ni yio ṣe sùn tì ọ li alẹ yi nitori mandraki ọmọ rẹ.
entries.en: And she said unto her, Is it a small matter that thou hast taken my husband? and wouldest thou take away my son's mandrakes also? And Rachel said, Therefore he shall lie with thee to night for thy son's mandrakes.

entries.yo: Jakobu si ti inu oko dé li aṣalẹ, Lea si jade lọ ipade rẹ̀, o si wipe, Iwọ kò le ṣe aima wọle tọ̀ mi wá, nitori ti emi ti fi mandraki ọmọ mi bẹ̀ ọ li ọ̀wẹ. On si sùn tì i li oru na.
entries.en: And Jacob came out of the field in the evening, and Leah went out to meet him, and said, Thou must come in unto me; for surely I have hired thee with my son's mandrakes. And he lay with her that night.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si gbọ́ ti Lea, o si yún, o si bí ọmọkunrin karun fun Jakobu.
entries.en: And God hearkened unto Leah, and she conceived, and bare Jacob the fifth son.

entries.yo: Lea si wipe, Ọlọrun san ọ̀ya mi fun mi, nitori ti mo fi iranṣẹbinrin mi fun ọkọ mi; o si pè orukọ rẹ̀ ni Issakari.
entries.en: And Leah said, God hath given me my hire, because I have given my maiden to my husband: and she called his name Issachar.

entries.yo: Lea si tun yún, o si bí ọmọkunrin kẹfa fun Jakobu.
entries.en: And Leah conceived again, and bare Jacob the sixth son.

entries.yo: Lea si wipe, Ọlọrun ti fun mi li ẹ̀bun rere; nigbayi li ọkọ mi yio tó ma bá mi gbé, nitori ti mo bí ọmọkunrin mẹfa fun u: o si pè orukọ rẹ̀ ni Sebuluni.
entries.en: And Leah said, God hath endued me with a good dowry; now will my husband dwell with me, because I have born him six sons: and she called his name Zebulun.

entries.yo: Nikẹhin rẹ̀ li o si bí ọmọbinrin kan, o si pè orukọ rẹ̀ ni Dina.
entries.en: And afterwards she bare a daughter, and called her name Dinah.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si ranti Rakeli, Ọlọrun si gbọ́ tirẹ̀, o si ṣí i ni inu.
entries.en: And God remembered Rachel, and God hearkened to her, and opened her womb.

entries.yo: O si yún, o si bí ọmọkunrin kan; o si wipe, Ọlọrun mú ẹ̀gan mi kuro:
entries.en: And she conceived, and bare a son; and said, God hath taken away my reproach:

entries.yo: O si pè orukọ rẹ̀ ni Josefu; o si wipe, Ki OLUWA ki o fi ọmọkunrin kan kún u fun mi pẹlu.
entries.en: And she called his name Joseph; and said, The LORD shall add to me another son.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati Rakeli bí Josefu tán, Jakobu si wi fun Labani pe, Rán mi jade lọ, ki emi ki o le ma lọ si ibiti mo ti wá, ati si ilẹ mi.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when Rachel had born Joseph, that Jacob said unto Laban, Send me away, that I may go unto mine own place, and to my country.

entries.yo: Fun mi li awọn obinrin mi, ati awọn ọmọ mi, nitori awọn ẹniti mo ti nsìn ọ, ki o si jẹ ki nma lọ: iwọ sá mọ̀ ìsin ti mo sìn ọ.
entries.en: Give me my wives and my children, for whom I have served thee, and let me go: for thou knowest my service which I have done thee.

entries.yo: Labani si wipe, Duro, emi bẹ̀ ọ, bi o ba ṣepe emi ri ore-ọfẹ li oju rẹ, joko: nitori ti mo ri i pe, OLUWA ti bukún fun mi nitori rẹ.
entries.en: And Laban said unto him, I pray thee, if I have found favour in thine eyes, tarry: for I have learned by experience that the LORD hath blessed me for thy sake.

entries.yo: O si wi fun u pe, Sọ iye owo iṣẹ rẹ, emi o si fi fun ọ.
entries.en: And he said, Appoint me thy wages, and I will give it.

entries.yo: O si wi fun u pe, Iwọ mọ̀ bi emi ti sìn ọ, ati bi ẹran-ọ̀sin rẹ ti wà lọdọ mi.
entries.en: And he said unto him, Thou knowest how I have served thee, and how thy cattle was with me.

entries.yo: Diẹ ni iwọ sá ti ní ki nto dé ọdọ rẹ, OLUWA si busi i li ọ̀pọlọpọ fun ọ lati ìgba ti mo ti dé: njẹ nisisiyi nigbawo li emi o pèse fun ile mi?
entries.en: For it was little which thou hadst before I came, and it is now increased unto a multitude; and the LORD hath blessed thee since my coming: and now when shall I provide for mine own house also?

entries.yo: O si bi i pe, Kili emi o fi fun ọ? Jakobu si wi pe, Iwọ máṣe fun mi li ohun kan: bi iwọ o ba le ṣe eyi fun mi, emi o ma bọ́, emi o si ma ṣọ́ agbo-ẹran rẹ.
entries.en: And he said, What shall I give thee? And Jacob said, Thou shalt not give me any thing: if thou wilt do this thing for me, I will again feed and keep thy flock:

entries.yo: Emi o là gbogbo agbo-ẹran rẹ já loni, emi o mú gbogbo ẹran abilà ati alamì kuro nibẹ̀, ati gbogbo ẹran pupa rúsurusu kuro ninu awọn agutan, ati gbogbo ẹran alamì ati abilà ninu awọn ewurẹ: eyi ni yio si ma ṣe ọ̀ya mi.
entries.en: I will pass through all thy flock to day, removing from thence all the speckled and spotted cattle, and all the brown cattle among the sheep, and the spotted and speckled among the goats: and of such shall be my hire.

entries.yo: Ododo mi yio si jẹ mi li ẹrí li ẹhin-ọla nigbati iwọ o wá wò ọ̀ya mi: gbogbo eyiti kò ba ṣe abilà ati alami ninu awọn ewurẹ, ti kò si ṣe pupa rúsurusu ninu awọn agutan, on na ni ki a kà si mi li ọrùn bi olè.
entries.en: So shall my righteousness answer for me in time to come, when it shall come for my hire before thy face: every one that is not speckled and spotted among the goats, and brown among the sheep, that shall be counted stolen with me.

entries.yo: Labani si wipe, Wò o, jẹ ki o ri bi ọ̀rọ rẹ.
entries.en: And Laban said, Behold, I would it might be according to thy word.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ́ na li o si yà awọn obukọ oni-tototó ati alamì, ati gbogbo awọn ewurẹ ti o ṣe abilà ati alamì, ati gbogbo awọn ti o ní funfun diẹ lara, ati gbogbo oni-pupa rúsurusu ninu awọn agutan, o si fi wọn lé awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ lọwọ.
entries.en: And he removed that day the he goats that were ringstraked and spotted, and all the she goats that were speckled and spotted, and every one that had some white in it, and all the brown among the sheep, and gave them into the hand of his sons.

entries.yo: O si fi ìrin ọjọ́ mẹta si agbedemeji on tikalarẹ̀ ati Jakobu: Jakobu si mbọ́ agbo-ẹran Labani iyokù.
entries.en: And he set three days' journey betwixt himself and Jacob: and Jacob fed the rest of Laban's flocks.

entries.yo: Jakobu si mú ọpá igi-poplari tutù, ati igi haseli, ati kesnuti; o si bó wọn li abófin, o si mu ki funfun ti o wà lara awọn ọpá na hàn.
entries.en: And Jacob took him rods of green poplar, and of the hazel and chesnut tree; and pilled white strakes in them, and made the white appear which was in the rods.

entries.yo: O si fi ọpá ti o bó lelẹ niwaju awọn agbo-ẹran li oju àgbará, ni ibi ọkọ̀ imumi, nigbati awọn agbo-ẹran wá mu omi, ki nwọn ki o le yún nigbati nwọn ba wá mumi.
entries.en: And he set the rods which he had pilled before the flocks in the gutters in the watering troughs when the flocks came to drink, that they should conceive when they came to drink.

entries.yo: Awọn agbo-ẹran si yún niwaju ọpá wọnni, nwọn si bí ẹran oni-tototó, ati abilà, ati alamì.
entries.en: And the flocks conceived before the rods, and brought forth cattle ringstraked, speckled, and spotted.

entries.yo: Jakobu si yà awọn ọdọ-agutan, o si kọju awọn agbo-ẹran si oni-tototó, ati gbogbo onìpupa rúsurusu ninu agbo-ẹran Labani: o si fi awọn agbo-ẹran si ọ̀tọ fun ara rẹ̀, kò si fi wọn sinu ẹran Labani.
entries.en: And Jacob did separate the lambs, and set the faces of the flocks toward the ringstraked, and all the brown in the flock of Laban; and he put his own flocks by themselves, and put them not unto Laban's cattle.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati ẹran ti o lera jù ba yún, Jakobu a si fi ọpá na lelẹ niwaju awọn ẹran na li oju àgbará, ki nwọn o le ma yún lãrin ọpá wọnni.
entries.en: And it came to pass, whensoever the stronger cattle did conceive, that Jacob laid the rods before the eyes of the cattle in the gutters, that they might conceive among the rods.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati awọn ẹran ba ṣe alailera, on ki ifi si i; bẹ̃li ailera ṣe ti Labani, awọn ti o lera jẹ́ ti Jakobu.
entries.en: But when the cattle were feeble, he put them not in: so the feebler were Laban's, and the stronger Jacob's.

entries.yo: ọkunrin na si pọ̀ gidigidi, o si li ẹran-ọ̀sin pupọ̀, ati iranṣẹbinrin, ati iranṣẹkunrin, ati ibakasiẹ, ati kẹtẹkẹtẹ.
entries.en: And the man increased exceedingly, and had much cattle, and maidservants, and menservants, and camels, and asses.

entries.yo: O SI gbọ́ ọ̀rọ awọn ọmọ Labani ti nwọn wipe, Jakobu kó nkan gbogbo ti iṣe ti baba wa; ati ninu ohun ti iṣe ti baba wa li o ti ní gbogbo ọrọ̀ yi.
entries.en: And he heard the words of Laban's sons, saying, Jacob hath taken away all that was our father's; and of that which was our father's hath he gotten all this glory.

entries.yo: Jakobu si wò oju Labani, si kiyesi i, kò ri si i bi ìgba atijọ.
entries.en: And Jacob beheld the countenance of Laban, and, behold, it was not toward him as before.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun Jakobu pe, Pada lọ si ilẹ awọn baba rẹ, ati si ọdọ awọn ara rẹ; emi o si pẹlu rẹ.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Jacob, Return unto the land of thy fathers, and to thy kindred; and I will be with thee.

entries.yo: Jakobu si ranṣẹ o si pè Rakeli on Lea si pápa si ibi agbo-ẹran rẹ̀,
entries.en: And Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the field unto his flock,

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Emi wò oju baba nyin pe, kò ri si mi bi ìgba atijọ; ṣugbọn Ọlọrun baba mi ti wà pẹlu mi.
entries.en: And said unto them, I see your father's countenance, that it is not toward me as before; but the God of my father hath been with me.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin si mọ̀ pe gbogbo agbara mi li emi fi sìn baba nyin.
entries.en: And ye know that with all my power I have served your father.

entries.yo: Baba nyin si ti tàn mi jẹ, o si pa ọ̀ya mi dà nigba mẹwa: ṣugbọn Ọlọrun kò jẹ ki o pa mi lara.
entries.en: And your father hath deceived me, and changed my wages ten times; but God suffered him not to hurt me.

entries.yo: Bi o ba si wi bayi pe, Awọn abilà ni yio ṣe ọ̀ya rẹ; gbogbo awọn ẹran a si bí abilà: bi o ba si wi bayi, Awọn oni-tototó ni yio ṣe ọ̀ya rẹ; gbogbo awọn ẹran a si bí oni-tototó.
entries.en: If he said thus, The speckled shall be thy wages; then all the cattle bare speckled: and if he said thus, The ringstraked shall be thy hire; then bare all the cattle ringstraked.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li Ọlọrun si gbà ẹran baba nyin, o si fi wọn fun mi.
entries.en: Thus God hath taken away the cattle of your father, and given them to me.

entries.yo: O si ṣe li akokò ti awọn ẹran yún, mo si gbé oju mi soke, mo si ri li oju-alá, si kiyesi i, awọn obukọ ti o ngùn awọn ẹran jẹ́ oni-tototó, abilà, ati alamì.
entries.en: And it came to pass at the time that the cattle conceived, that I lifted up mine eyes, and saw in a dream, and, behold, the rams which leaped upon the cattle were ringstraked, speckled, and grisled.

entries.yo: Angeli Ọlọrun si sọ fun mi li oju-alá pe, Jakobu: emi si wipe, Emi niyi.
entries.en: And the angel of God spake unto me in a dream, saying, Jacob: And I said, Here am I.

entries.yo: O si wipe, Gbé oju rẹ soke nisisiyi, ki o si wò, gbogbo awọn obukọ ti ngùn awọn ẹran li o ṣe tototó, abilà, ati alamì: nitori ti emi ti ri ohun gbogbo ti Labani nṣe si ọ.
entries.en: And he said, Lift up now thine eyes, and see, all the rams which leap upon the cattle are ringstraked, speckled, and grisled: for I have seen all that Laban doeth unto thee.

entries.yo: Emi li Ọlọrun Beteli, nibiti iwọ gbé ta oróro si ọwọ̀n, nibiti iwọ gbè jẹ́ ẹjẹ́ fun mi: dide nisisiyi, jade kuro ni ilẹ yi, ki o si pada lọ si ilẹ ti a bi ọ.
entries.en: I am the God of Bethel, where thou anointedst the pillar, and where thou vowedst a vow unto me: now arise, get thee out from this land, and return unto the land of thy kindred.

entries.yo: Rakeli ati Lea si dahùn nwọn si wi fun u pe, Ipín, tabi ogún kan ha tun kù fun wa mọ́ ni ile baba wa?
entries.en: And Rachel and Leah answered and said unto him, Is there yet any portion or inheritance for us in our father's house?

entries.yo: Alejò ki on nkà wa si? nitori ti o ti tà wa; o si ti mù owo wa jẹ gúdu-gudu.
entries.en: Are we not counted of him strangers? for he hath sold us, and hath quite devoured also our money.

entries.yo: Nitori ọrọ̀ gbogbo ti Ọlọrun ti gbà lọwọ baba wa, eyinì ni ti wa, ati ti awọn ọmọ wa: njẹ nisisiyi ohunkohun ti Ọlọrun ba sọ fun ọ, on ni ki o ṣe.
entries.en: For all the riches which God hath taken from our father, that is ours, and our children's: now then, whatsoever God hath said unto thee, do.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Jakobu dide, o si gbé awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ ati awọn aya rẹ̀ gùn ibakasiẹ.
entries.en: Then Jacob rose up, and set his sons and his wives upon camels;

entries.yo: O si kó gbogbo ẹran rẹ̀ lọ, ati gbogbo ẹrù ti o ní, ẹran ti o ní fun ara rẹ̀, ti o ní ni Padan-aramu, lati ma tọ̀ Isaaki baba rẹ̀ lọ ni ilẹ Kenaani.
entries.en: And he carried away all his cattle, and all his goods which he had gotten, the cattle of his getting, which he had gotten in Padan-aram, for to go to Isaac his father in the land of Canaan.

entries.yo: Labani si lọ irẹrun agutan rẹ̀: Rakeli si ti jí awọn ere baba rẹ̀ lọ.
entries.en: And Laban went to shear his sheep: and Rachel had stolen the images that were her father's.

entries.yo: Jakobu si tàn Labani ara Siria jẹ, niti pe kò wi fun u ti o fi salọ.
entries.en: And Jacob stole away unawares to Laban the Syrian, in that he told him not that he fled.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li o kó ohun gbogbo ti o ní salọ: o si dide, o si kọja odò, o si kọju rẹ̀ si oke Gileadi.
entries.en: So he fled with all that he had; and he rose up, and passed over the river, and set his face toward the mount Gilead.

entries.yo: A si wi fun Labani ni ijọ́ kẹta pe, Jakobu salọ.
entries.en: And it was told Laban on the third day that Jacob was fled.

entries.yo: O si mú awọn arakunrin rẹ̀ pẹlu rẹ̀, o si lepa rẹ̀ ni ìrin ijọ́ meje: o si bá a li oke Gileadi.
entries.en: And he took his brethren with him, and pursued after him seven days' journey; and they overtook him in the mount Gilead.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si tọ̀ Labani, ara Siria wá li oru li oju-alá, o si wi fun u pe, Kiyesi ara rẹ, ki iwọ ki o máṣe bá Jakobu sọ rere tabi buburu.
entries.en: And God came to Laban the Syrian in a dream by night, and said unto him, Take heed that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Labani bá Jakobu. Jakobu ti pa agọ́ rẹ̀ li oke na: ati Labani pẹlu awọn arakunrin rẹ̀ dó li oke Gileadi.
entries.en: Then Laban overtook Jacob. Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the mount: and Laban with his brethren pitched in the mount of Gilead.

entries.yo: Labani si wi fun Jakobu pe, Kini iwọ ṣe nì, ti iwọ tàn mi jẹ ti iwọ si kó awọn ọmọbinrin mi lọ bi ìgbẹsin ti a fi idà mú?
entries.en: And Laban said to Jacob, What hast thou done, that thou hast stolen away unawares to me, and carried away my daughters, as captives taken with the sword?

entries.yo: Ẽṣe ti iwọ fi salọ li aṣíri, ti iwọ si tàn mi jẹ; ti iwọ kò si wi fun mi ki emi ki o le fi ayọ̀ ati orin, ati ìlu, ati dùru, sìn ọ;
entries.en: Wherefore didst thou flee away secretly, and steal away from me; and didst not tell me, that I might have sent thee away with mirth, and with songs, with tabret, and with harp?

entries.yo: Ti iwọ kò si jẹ ki emi fi ẹnu kò awọn ọmọkunrin ati ọmọbinrin mi li ẹnu? iwọ ṣiwere li eyiti iwọ ṣe yi.
entries.en: And hast not suffered me to kiss my sons and my daughters? thou hast now done foolishly in so doing.

entries.yo: O wà ni ipa mi lati ṣe nyin ni ibi: ṣugbọn Ọlọrun baba nyin ti sọ fun mi li oru aná pe, Kiyesi ara rẹ ki iwọ ki o máṣe bá Jakobu sọ rere tabi buburu.
entries.en: It is in the power of my hand to do you hurt: but the God of your father spake unto me yesternight, saying, Take thou heed that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad.

entries.yo: Ati nisisiyi, iwọ kò le ṣe ailọ, nitori ti ọkàn rẹ fà gidigidi si ile baba rẹ, ṣugbọn ẽhaṣe ti iwọ fi jí awọn oriṣa mi lọ?
entries.en: And now, though thou wouldest needs be gone, because thou sore longedst after thy father's house, yet wherefore hast thou stolen my gods?

entries.yo: Jakobu si dahùn o si wi fun Labani pe, Nitori ti mo bẹ̀ru ni: nitori ti mo wipe, iwọ le fi agbara gbà awọn ọmọbinrin rẹ lọwọ mi.
entries.en: And Jacob answered and said to Laban, Because I was afraid: for I said, Peradventure thou wouldest take by force thy daughters from me.

entries.yo: Lọwọ ẹnikẹni ti iwọ ba ri awọn oriṣa rẹ ki o máṣe wà lãye: li oju awọn arakunrin wa wọnyi, wá ohun ti iṣe tirẹ lọdọ mi, ki o si mú u si ọdọ rẹ. Jakobu kò sa mọ̀ pe Rakeli ti jí wọn.
entries.en: With whomsoever thou findest thy gods, let him not live: before our brethren discern thou what is thine with me, and take it to thee. For Jacob knew not that Rachel had stolen them.

entries.yo: Labani si wọ̀ inu agọ́ Jakobu lọ, ati inu agọ́ Lea, ati inu agọ́ awọn iranṣẹbinrin mejeji; ṣugbọn kò ri wọn. Nigbana li o jade kuro ninu agọ́ Lea, o si wọ̀ inu agọ́ Rakeli lọ.
entries.en: And Laban went into Jacob's tent, and into Leah's tent, and into the two maidservants' tents; but he found them not. Then went he out of Leah's tent, and entered into Rachel's tent.

entries.yo: Rakeli si gbé awọn ere na, o si fi wọn sinu gãri ibakasiẹ, o si joko le wọn. Labani si wá gbogbo agọ́ ṣugbọn kò ri wọn.
entries.en: Now Rachel had taken the images, and put them in the camel's furniture, and sat upon them. And Laban searched all the tent, but found them not.

entries.yo: O si wi fun baba rẹ̀ pe, Oluwa mi, máṣe jẹ ki o bi ọ ninu nitori ti emi kò le dide niwaju rẹ; nitori ti iṣe obinrin mbẹ lara mi. O si wá agọ́ kiri, ṣugbọn kò ri awọn ere na.
entries.en: And she said to her father, Let it not displease my lord that I cannot rise up before thee; for the custom of women is upon me. And he searched, but found not the images.

entries.yo: Inu si bi Jakobu, o si bá Labani sọ̀: Jakobu si dahùn o wi fun Labani pe, Kini irekọja mi? kili ẹ̀ṣẹ mi ti iwọ fi lepa mi wìriwiri bẹ̃?
entries.en: And Jacob was wroth, and chode with Laban: and Jacob answered and said to Laban, What is my trespass? what is my sin, that thou hast so hotly pursued after me?

entries.yo: Njẹ bi iwọ ti tú ẹrù mi gbogbo, kili iwọ ri ninu gbogbo nkan ile rẹ? gbé e kalẹ nihinyi niwaju awọn arakunrin rẹ, ki nwọn ki o le ṣe idajọ rẹ̀ fun awa mejeji.
entries.en: Whereas thou hast searched all my stuff, what hast thou found of all thy household stuff? set it here before my brethren and thy brethren, that they may judge betwixt us both.

entries.yo: Ogún ọdún yi ni mo ti wà lọdọ rẹ; agutan rẹ ati ewurẹ rẹ kò sọnù, agbo ọwọ́-ẹran rẹ li emi kò si pajẹ.
entries.en: This twenty years have I been with thee; thy ewes and thy she goats have not cast their young, and the rams of thy flock have I not eaten.

entries.yo: Eyiti ẹranko fàya emi kò mú u fun ọ wá; emi li o gbà òfo rẹ̀; li ọwọ́ mi ni iwọ bère rẹ̀, a ba jí i li ọsán, a ba jí i li oru.
entries.en: That which was torn of beasts I brought not unto thee; I bare the loss of it; of my hand didst thou require it, whether stolen by day, or stolen by night.

entries.yo: Bayi ni mo wà; ongbẹ ngbẹ mi li ọsán, otutù si nmu mi li oru: orun mi si dá kuro li oju mi.
entries.en: Thus I was; in the day the drought consumed me, and the frost by night; and my sleep departed from mine eyes.
