entries.yo: Bayi li o ri fun mi li ogún ọdún ni ile rẹ; mo sìn ọ li ọdún mẹrinla nitori awọn ọmọbinrin rẹ mejeji, ati li ọdún mẹfa nitori ohun-ọ̀sin rẹ: iwọ si pa ọ̀ya mi dà nigba mẹwa.
entries.en: Thus have I been twenty years in thy house; I served thee fourteen years for thy two daughters, and six years for thy cattle: and thou hast changed my wages ten times.

entries.yo: Bikoṣe bi Ọlọrun baba mi, Ọlọrun Abrahamu, ati ẹ̀ru Isaaki ti wà pẹlu mi, nitõtọ ofo ni iwọ iba rán mi jade lọ. Ọlọrun ri ipọnju mi, ati lãla ọwọ́ mi, o si ba ọ wi li oru aná.
entries.en: Except the God of my father, the God of Abraham, and the fear of Isaac, had been with me, surely thou hadst sent me away now empty. God hath seen mine affliction and the labour of my hands, and rebuked thee yesternight.

entries.yo: Labani si dahùn o si wi fun Jakobu pe, Awọn ọmọbinrin wọnyi, awọn ọmọbinrin mi ni, ati awọn ọmọ wọnyi, awọn ọmọ mi ni, ati awọn ọwọ́-ẹran wọnyi ọwọ́-ẹran mi ni, ati ohun gbogbo ti o ri ti emi ni: kili emi iba si ṣe si awọn ọmọbinrin mi wọnyi loni, tabi si awọn ọmọ wọn ti nwọn bí?
entries.en: And Laban answered and said unto Jacob, These daughters are my daughters, and these children are my children, and these cattle are my cattle, and all that thou seest is mine: and what can I do this day unto these my daughters, or unto their children which they have born?

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, wá, jẹ ki a bá ara wa dá majẹmu, temi tirẹ; ki o si ṣe ẹrí lãrin temi tirẹ.
entries.en: Now therefore come thou, let us make a covenant, I and thou; and let it be for a witness between me and thee.

entries.yo: Jakobu si mú okuta kan, o si gbé e ró ṣe ọwọ̀n.
entries.en: And Jacob took a stone, and set it up for a pillar.

entries.yo: Jakobu si wi fun awọn arakunrin rẹ̀ pe, Ẹ ma kó okuta jọ; nwọn si kó okuta jọ, nwọn si ṣe òkiti: nwọn si jẹun nibẹ̀ lori òkiti na.
entries.en: And Jacob said unto his brethren, Gather stones; and they took stones, and made an heap: and they did eat there upon the heap.

entries.yo: Labani si sọ orukọ rẹ̀ ni Jegari-Sahaduta: ṣugbọn Jakobu sọ ọ ni Galeedi.
entries.en: And Laban called it Jegar-sahadutha: but Jacob called it Galeed.

entries.yo: Labani si wipe, Òkiti yi li ẹri lãrin temi tirẹ loni. Nitori na li a ṣe sọ orukọ rẹ̀ ni Galeedi:
entries.en: And Laban said, This heap is a witness between me and thee this day. Therefore was the name of it called Galeed;

entries.yo: Ati Mispa; nitori ti o wipe, Ki OLUWA ki o ma ṣọ́ temi tirẹ nigbati a o yà kuro lọdọ ara wa.
entries.en: And Mizpah; for he said, The LORD watch between me and thee, when we are absent one from another.

entries.yo: Bi iwọ ba pọ́n awọn ọmọbinrin mi li oju, tabi bi iwọ ba fẹ́ aya miran pẹlu awọn ọmọbinrin mi, kò sí ẹnikan pẹlu wa; wò o, Ọlọrun li ẹlẹri lãrin temi tirẹ.
entries.en: If thou shalt afflict my daughters, or if thou shalt take other wives beside my daughters, no man is with us; see, God is witness betwixt me and thee.

entries.yo: Labani si wi fun Jakobu pe, Wò òkiti yi, si wò ọwọ̀n yi, ti mo gbé ró lãrin temi tirẹ.
entries.en: And Laban said to Jacob, Behold this heap, and behold this pillar, which I have cast betwixt me and thee;

entries.yo: Òkiti yi li ẹri, ọwọ̀n yi li ẹri, pe emi ki yio rekọja òkiti yi sọdọ rẹ; ati pe iwọ ki yio si rekọja òkiti yi ati ọwọ̀n yi sọdọ mi fun ibi.
entries.en: This heap be witness, and this pillar be witness, that I will not pass over this heap to thee, and that thou shalt not pass over this heap and this pillar unto me, for harm.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun Abrahamu, ati Ọlọrun Nahori, Ọlọrun baba wọn, ni ki o ṣe idajọ lãrin wa. Jakobu si fi ẹ̀ru Isaaki baba rẹ̀ bura.
entries.en: The God of Abraham, and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge betwixt us. And Jacob sware by the fear of his father Isaac.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Jakobu rubọ lori oke na, o si pè awọn arakunrin rẹ̀ wá ijẹun: nwọn si jẹun, nwọn si fi gbogbo oru ijọ́ na sùn lori oke na.
entries.en: Then Jacob offered sacrifice upon the mount, and called his brethren to eat bread: and they did eat bread, and tarried all night in the mount.

entries.yo: Ni kutukutu owurọ̀ Labani si dide, o si fi ẹnu kò awọn ọmọkunrin, ati awọn ọmọbinrin rẹ̀ li ẹnu, o si sure fun wọn: Labani si dide, o si pada lọ si ipò rẹ̀.
entries.en: And early in the morning Laban rose up, and kissed his sons and his daughters, and blessed them: and Laban departed, and returned unto his place.

entries.yo: JAKOBU si nlọ li ọ̀na rẹ̀, awọn angeli Ọlọrun si pade rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Jacob went on his way, and the angels of God met him.

entries.yo: Nigbati Jakobu si ri wọn, o ni, Ogun Ọlọrun li eyi: o si sọ orukọ ibẹ̀ na ni Mahanaimu.
entries.en: And when Jacob saw them, he said, This is God's host: and he called the name of that place Mahanaim.

entries.yo: Jakobu si ranṣẹ siwaju rẹ̀ si Esau, arakunrin rẹ̀, si ilẹ Seiri, pápa oko Edomu.
entries.en: And Jacob sent messengers before him to Esau his brother unto the land of Seir, the country of Edom.

entries.yo: O si rán wọn wipe, Bayi ni ki ẹnyin ki o wi fun Esau, oluwa mi; Bayi ni Jakobu iranṣẹ rẹ wi, Mo ti ṣe atipo lọdọ Labani, mo si ti ngbé ibẹ̀ titi o fi di isisiyi:
entries.en: And he commanded them, saying, Thus shall ye speak unto my lord Esau; Thy servant Jacob saith thus, I have sojourned with Laban, and stayed there until now:

entries.yo: Mo si ní malu, ati kẹtẹkẹtẹ, ati agbo-ẹran, ati iranṣẹkunrin, ati iranṣẹbinrin: mo si ranṣẹ wá wi fun oluwa mi, ki emi ki o le ri ore-ọfẹ li oju rẹ.
entries.en: And I have oxen, and asses, flocks, and menservants, and womenservants: and I have sent to tell my lord, that I may find grace in thy sight.

entries.yo: Awọn onṣẹ si pada tọ̀ Jakobu wá, wipe, Awa dé ọdọ Esau, arakunrin rẹ, o si mbọ̀wá kò ọ, irinwo ọkunrin li o si wà pẹlu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the messengers returned to Jacob, saying, We came to thy brother Esau, and also he cometh to meet thee, and four hundred men with him.

entries.yo: Nigbana li ẹ̀ru bà Jakobu gidigidi, ãjo si mú u, o si pín awọn enia ti o wà lọdọ rẹ̀, ati awọn ọwọ́-ẹran, awọn ọwọ́-malu, ati awọn ibakasiẹ, si ipa meji;
entries.en: Then Jacob was greatly afraid and distressed: and he divided the people that was with him, and the flocks, and herds, and the camels, into two bands;

entries.yo: O si wipe, bi Esau ba kàn ẹgbẹ kan, ti o si kọlù u, njẹ ẹgbẹ keji ti o kù yio là.
entries.en: And said, If Esau come to the one company, and smite it, then the other company which is left shall escape.

entries.yo: Jakobu si wipe, Ọlọrun Abrahamu baba mi, ati Ọlọrun Isaaki baba mi, OLUWA ti o wi fun mi pe, pada lọ si ilẹ rẹ, ati sọdọ awọn ara rẹ, emi o si ṣe ọ ni rere:
entries.en: And Jacob said, O God of my father Abraham, and God of my father Isaac, the LORD which saidst unto me, Return unto thy country, and to thy kindred, and I will deal well with thee:

entries.yo: Emi kò yẹ si kikini ninu gbogbo ãnu, ati ninu gbogbo otitọ, ti iwọ fihàn fun ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ, nitori pe, kìki ọpá mi ni mo fi kọja Jordani yi; nisisiyi emi si di ẹgbẹ meji.
entries.en: I am not worthy of the least of all the mercies, and of all the truth, which thou hast shewed unto thy servant; for with my staff I passed over this Jordan; and now I am become two bands.

entries.yo: Emi bẹ̀ ọ, gbà mi lọwọ arakunrin mi, lọwọ Esau: nitori ti mo bẹ̀ru rẹ̀, ki o má ba wá lati kọlù mi, ti iya ti ọmọ.
entries.en: Deliver me, I pray thee, from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esau: for I fear him, lest he will come and smite me, and the mother with the children.

entries.yo: Iwọ si wipe, Nitõtọ emi o ṣe ọ ni rere, emi o si ṣe irú-ọmọ rẹ bi iyanrin okun, ti a kò le kà fun ọ̀pọlọpọ.
entries.en: And thou saidst, I will surely do thee good, and make thy seed as the sand of the sea, which cannot be numbered for multitude.

entries.yo: O si sùn nibẹ̀ li alẹ ijọ́ na; o si mú ninu ohun ti o tẹ̀ ẹ li ọwọ li ọrẹ fun Esau, arakunrin rẹ̀;
entries.en: And he lodged there that same night; and took of that which came to his hand a present for Esau his brother;

entries.yo: Igba ewurẹ, on ogún obukọ, igba agutan, on ogún àgbo,
entries.en: Two hundred she goats, and twenty he goats, two hundred ewes, and twenty rams,

entries.yo: Ọgbọ̀n ibakasiẹ ti o ní wàra, pẹlu awọn ọmọ wọn, ogojì abo-malu on akọ-malu mẹwa, ogún abo-kẹtẹkẹtẹ, on ọmọ-kẹtẹkẹtẹ mẹwa.
entries.en: Thirty milch camels with their colts, forty kine, and ten bulls, twenty she asses, and ten foals.

entries.yo: O si fi wọn lé ọwọ́ awọn ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ̀, ni ọ̀wọ́ kọkan; o si wi fun awọn ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ̀ pe, Ẹnyin ṣaju mi, ki ẹ si fi àlàfo si agbedemeji ọwọ́-ọwọ.
entries.en: And he delivered them into the hand of his servants, every drove by themselves; and said unto his servants, Pass over before me, and put a space betwixt drove and drove.

entries.yo: O si fi aṣẹ fun eyiti o tète ṣaju wipe, Nigbati Esau, arakunrin mi, ba pade rẹ, ti o si bi ọ wipe, Ti tani iwọ? nibo ni iwọ si nrè? ati ti tani wọnyi niwaju rẹ?
entries.en: And he commanded the foremost, saying, When Esau my brother meeteth thee, and asketh thee, saying, Whose art thou? and whither goest thou? and whose are these before thee?

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ki iwọ ki o wipe, Ti Jakobu iranṣẹ rẹ ni; ọrẹ ti o rán si Esau oluwa mi ni: si kiyesi i, on tikalarẹ̀ si mbẹ lẹhin wa.
entries.en: Then thou shalt say, They be thy servant Jacob's; it is a present sent unto my lord Esau: and, behold, also he is behind us.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li o si fi aṣẹ fun ekeji, ati fun ẹkẹta, ati fun gbogbo awọn ti o tẹle ọwọ́ wọnni wipe, Bayibayi ni ki ẹnyin ki o wi fun Esau nigbati ẹnyin ba ri i.
entries.en: And so commanded he the second, and the third, and all that followed the droves, saying, On this manner shall ye speak unto Esau, when ye find him.

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o wi pẹlu pe, Kiyesi i, Jakobu iranṣẹ rẹ mbọ̀ lẹhin wa. Nitori ti o wipe, Emi o fi ọrẹ ti o ṣaju mi tù u loju, lẹhin eyini emi o ri oju rẹ̀, bọya yio tẹwọgbà mi.
entries.en: And say ye moreover, Behold, thy servant Jacob is behind us. For he said, I will appease him with the present that goeth before me, and afterward I will see his face; peradventure he will accept of me.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li ọrẹ na si kọja lọ niwaju rẹ̀: on tikalarẹ̀ si sùn li oru na ninu awọn ẹgbẹ.
entries.en: So went the present over before him: and himself lodged that night in the company.

entries.yo: O si dide li oru na, o si mú awọn aya rẹ̀ mejeji, ati awọn iranṣẹbinrin rẹ̀ mejeji, ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ mọkọkanla, o si kọja iwọdò Jabboku.
entries.en: And he rose up that night, and took his two wives, and his two womenservants, and his eleven sons, and passed over the ford Jabbok.

entries.yo: O si mú wọn, o si rán wọn si oke odò na, o si rán ohun ti o ní kọja si oke odò.
entries.en: And he took them, and sent them over the brook, and sent over that he had.

entries.yo: O si kù Jakobu nikan; ọkunrin kan si mbá a jijakadi titi o fi di afẹmọ́jumọ.
entries.en: And Jacob was left alone; and there wrestled a man with him until the breaking of the day.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si ri pe on kò le dá a, o fọwọkàn a ni ihò egungun itan rẹ̀; ihò egungun itan Jakobu si yẹ̀ li orike, bi o ti mbá a jijakadi.
entries.en: And when he saw that he prevailed not against him, he touched the hollow of his thigh; and the hollow of Jacob's thigh was out of joint, as he wrestled with him.

entries.yo: O si wipe, Jẹ ki emi ki o lọ nitori ti ojúmọ mọ́ tán. On si wipe, Emi ki yio jẹ ki iwọ ki o lọ, bikoṣepe iwọ ba sure fun mi.
entries.en: And he said, Let me go, for the day breaketh. And he said, I will not let thee go, except thou bless me.

entries.yo: O si bi i pe, Orukọ rẹ? On si dahùn pe, Jakobu.
entries.en: And he said unto him, What is thy name? And he said, Jacob.

entries.yo: O si wipe, A ki yio pè orukọ rẹ ni Jakobu mọ́, bikoṣe Israeli: nitoripe, iwọ ti ba Ọlọrun ati enia jà, iwọ si bori.
entries.en: And he said, Thy name shall be called no more Jacob, but Israel: for as a prince hast thou power with God and with men, and hast prevailed.

entries.yo: Jakobu si bi i o si wipe, Emi bẹ̀ ọ, sọ orukọ rẹ fun mi. On si wipe, Ẽṣe ti iwọ fi mbère orukọ mi? o si sure fun u nibẹ̀.
entries.en: And Jacob asked him, and said, Tell me, I pray thee, thy name. And he said, Wherefore is it that thou dost ask after my name? And he blessed him there.

entries.yo: Jakobu si sọ orukọ ibẹ̀ na ni Penieli: o ni, Nitori ti mo ri Ọlọrun li ojukoju, a si dá ẹmi mi si.
entries.en: And Jacob called the name of the place Peniel: for I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved.

entries.yo: Bi o si ti nkọja Penieli, õrùn là bá a, o si nmukun ni itan rẹ̀.
entries.en: And as he passed over Penuel the sun rose upon him, and he halted upon his thigh.

entries.yo: Nitori na li awọn ọmọ Israeli ki iṣe ijẹ iṣan ti ifà, ti o wà ni kòto itan, titi o fi di oni-oloni: nitori ti o fọwọkàn kòto egungun itan Jakobu ni iṣan ti ifà.
entries.en: Therefore the children of Israel eat not of the sinew which shrank, which is upon the hollow of the thigh, unto this day: because he touched the hollow of Jacob's thigh in the sinew that shrank.

entries.yo: JAKOBU si gbé oju rẹ̀ soke, o si wò, si kiyesi i, Esau dé, ati irinwo ọkunrin pẹlu rẹ̀. On si pín awọn ọmọ fun Lea, ati fun Rakeli, ati fun awọn iranṣẹbinrin mejeji.
entries.en: And Jacob lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, Esau came, and with him four hundred men. And he divided the children unto Leah, and unto Rachel, and unto the two handmaids.

entries.yo: O si tì awọn iranṣẹbinrin ati awọn ọmọ wọn ṣaju, ati Lea ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ tẹle wọn, ati Rakeli ati Josefu kẹhin.
entries.en: And he put the handmaids and their children foremost, and Leah and her children after, and Rachel and Joseph hindermost.

entries.yo: On si kọja lọ siwaju wọn, o si wolẹ li ẹrinmeje titi o fi dé ọdọ arakunrin rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he passed over before them, and bowed himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.

entries.yo: Esau si sure lati pade rẹ̀, o si gbá a mú, o si rọmọ́ ọ li ọrùn, o si fi ẹnu kò o li ẹnu: nwọn si sọkun.
entries.en: And Esau ran to meet him, and embraced him, and fell on his neck, and kissed him: and they wept.

entries.yo: O si gbé oju rẹ̀ soke, o si ri awọn obinrin ati awọn ọmọ; o si bi i pe, Tani wọnyi pẹlu rẹ? On si wipe, Awọn ọmọ ti Ọlọrun fi ore-ọfẹ fun iranṣẹ rẹ ni.
entries.en: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw the women and the children; and said, Who are those with thee? And he said, The children which God hath graciously given thy servant.

entries.yo: Nigbana li awọn iranṣẹbinrin sunmọ ọdọ rẹ̀, awọn ati awọn ọmọ wọn, nwọn si tẹriba.
entries.en: Then the handmaidens came near, they and their children, and they bowed themselves.

entries.yo: Ati Lea pẹlu ti on ti awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ sunmọ ọdọ rẹ̀, nwọn si tẹriba: nikẹhin ni Josefu ati Rakeli si sunmọ ọdọ rẹ̀, nwọn si tẹriba.
entries.en: And Leah also with her children came near, and bowed themselves: and after came Joseph near and Rachel, and they bowed themselves.

entries.yo: O si wipe, Kini iwọ fi ọwọ́ ti mo pade ni pè? On si wipe, Lati fi ri ore-ọfẹ li oju oluwa mi ni.
entries.en: And he said, What meanest thou by all this drove which I met? And he said, These are to find grace in the sight of my lord.

entries.yo: Esau si wipe, Emi ní tó, arakunrin mi; pa eyiti o ní mọ́ fun ara rẹ.
entries.en: And Esau said, I have enough, my brother; keep that thou hast unto thyself.

entries.yo: Jakobu si wipe, Bẹ̃kọ, emi bẹ̀ ọ, bi o ba ṣepe emi ba ri ore-ọfẹ li oju rẹ nisisiyi, njẹ gbà ọrẹ mi lọwọ mi: nitori ti emi sa ri oju rẹ bi ẹnipe emi ri oju Ọlọrun, ti inu rẹ si dùn si mi;
entries.en: And Jacob said, Nay, I pray thee, if now I have found grace in thy sight, then receive my present at my hand: for therefore I have seen thy face, as though I had seen the face of God, and thou wast pleased with me.

entries.yo: Emi bẹ̀ ọ, gbà ẹ̀bun mi ti a mú fun ọ wá; nitori ti Ọlọrun fi ore-ọfẹ ba mi ṣe, ati pe, nitori ti mo ní tó. O si rọ̀ ọ, on si gbà a.
entries.en: Take, I pray thee, my blessing that is brought to thee; because God hath dealt graciously with me, and because I have enough. And he urged him, and he took it.

entries.yo: O si wipe, Jẹ ki a bọ́ si ọ̀na ìrin wa, ki a si ma lọ, emi o si ṣaju rẹ.
entries.en: And he said, Let us take our journey, and let us go, and I will go before thee.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn on wi fun u pe, oluwa mi mọ̀ pe awọn ọmọ kò lera, ati awọn agbo-ẹran, ati ọwọ́-malu ati awọn ọmọ wọn wà pẹlu mi: bi enia ba si dà wọn li àdaju li ọjọ́ kan, gbogbo agbo ni yio kú.
entries.en: And he said unto him, My lord knoweth that the children are tender, and the flocks and herds with young are with me: and if men should overdrive them one day, all the flock will die.

entries.yo: Emi bẹ̀ ọ, ki oluwa mi ki o ma kọja nṣó niwaju iranṣẹ rẹ̀: emi o si ma fà wá pẹlẹ, gẹgẹ bi awọn ẹran ti o saju mi, ati bi ara awọn ọmọ ti le gbà, titi emi o fi dé ọdọ oluwa mi ni Seiri.
entries.en: Let my lord, I pray thee, pass over before his servant: and I will lead on softly, according as the cattle that goeth before me and the children be able to endure, until I come unto my lord unto Seir.

entries.yo: Esau si wipe, Njẹ ki emi ki o fi enia diẹ silẹ pẹlu rẹ ninu awọn enia ti o pẹlu mi. On si wipe, Nibo li eyini jasi, ki emi ki o sa ri õre-ọfẹ li oju oluwa mi.
entries.en: And Esau said, Let me now leave with thee some of the folk that are with me. And he said, What needeth it? let me find grace in the sight of my lord.

entries.yo: Esau si pada li ọjọ́ na li ọ̀na rẹ̀ lọ si Seiri.
entries.en: So Esau returned that day on his way unto Seir.

entries.yo: Jakobu si rìn lọ si Sukkotu, o si kọ́ ile fun ara rẹ̀, o si pa agọ́ fun awọn ẹran rẹ̀: nitorina li a ṣe sọ orukọ ibẹ̀ na ni Sukkotu.
entries.en: And Jacob journeyed to Succoth, and built him an house, and made booths for his cattle: therefore the name of the place is called Succoth.

entries.yo: Jakobu si wá li alafia, si ilu Ṣekemu ti o wà ni ilẹ Kenaani, nigbati o ti Padan-aramu dé: o si pa agọ́ rẹ̀ niwaju ilu na.
entries.en: And Jacob came to Shalem, a city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, when he came from Padan-aram; and pitched his tent before the city.

entries.yo: O si rà oko biri kan, nibiti o gbé ti pa agọ́ rẹ̀ lọwọ awọn ọmọ Hamori, baba Ṣekemu, li ọgọrun owo fadaka.
entries.en: And he bought a parcel of a field, where he had spread his tent, at the hand of the children of Hamor, Shechem's father, for an hundred pieces of money.

entries.yo: O si tẹ́ pẹpẹ kan sibẹ̀, o si sọ orukọ rẹ̀ ni El-Elohe-Israeli.
entries.en: And he erected there an altar, and called it El-elohe-Israel.

entries.yo: DINA ọmọbinrin Lea, ti o bí fun Jakobu si jade lọ lati wò awọn ọmọbinrin ilu na.
entries.en: And Dinah the daughter of Leah, which she bare unto Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.

entries.yo: Nigbati Ṣekemu, ọmọ Hamori, ara Hiffi, ọmọ alade ilu na ri i, o mú u, o si wọle tọ̀ ọ, o si bà a jẹ́.
entries.en: And when Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, prince of the country, saw her, he took her, and lay with her, and defiled her.

entries.yo: Ọkàn rẹ̀ si fà mọ́ Dina, ọmọbinrin Jakobu, o si fẹ́ omidan na, o si sọ̀rọ rere fun omidan na.
entries.en: And his soul clave unto Dinah the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the damsel, and spake kindly unto the damsel.

entries.yo: Ṣekemu si sọ fun Hamori baba rẹ̀ pe, Fẹ́ omidan yi fun mi li aya.
entries.en: And Shechem spake unto his father Hamor, saying, Get me this damsel to wife.

entries.yo: Jakobu si gbọ́ pe o ti bà Dina ọmọbinrin on jẹ́; njẹ awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ wà pẹlu awọn ẹran ni pápa: Jakobu si pa ẹnu rẹ̀ mọ́ titi nwọn fi dé.
entries.en: And Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah his daughter: now his sons were with his cattle in the field: and Jacob held his peace until they were come.

entries.yo: Hamori, baba Ṣekemu, si jade tọ̀ Jakobu lọ lati bá a sọ̀rọ.
entries.en: And Hamor the father of Shechem went out unto Jacob to commune with him.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Jakobu si ti oko dé nigbati nwọn gbọ́: inu awọn ọkunrin na si bàjẹ́, inu si ru wọn gidigidi, nitori ti o ṣe ohun buburu ni Israeli, niti o bá ọmọbinrin Jakobu dàpọ: ohun ti a ki ba ti ṣe.
entries.en: And the sons of Jacob came out of the field when they heard it: and the men were grieved, and they were very wroth, because he had wrought folly in Israel in lying with Jacob's daughter; which thing ought not to be done.

entries.yo: Hamori si bá wọn sọ̀rọ pe, Ọkàn Ṣekemu, ọmọ mi, nfẹ́ ọmọbinrin nyin; emi bẹ̀ nyin, ẹ fi i fun u li aya.
entries.en: And Hamor communed with them, saying, The soul of my son Shechem longeth for your daughter: I pray you give her him to wife.

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o si bá wa gbeyawo, ki ẹnyin ki o si fi awọn ọmọbinrin nyin fun wa, ki ẹnyin ki o si ma mú awọn ọmọbinrin wa.
entries.en: And make ye marriages with us, and give your daughters unto us, and take our daughters unto you.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin o si ma bá wa gbé: ilẹ yio si wà niwaju nyin, ẹnyin o joko ki ẹ si ma ṣòwo ninu rẹ̀, ki ẹ si ma ní iní ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And ye shall dwell with us: and the land shall be before you; dwell and trade ye therein, and get you possessions therein.

entries.yo: Ṣekemu si wi fun baba omidan na ati fun awọn arakunrin rẹ̀ pe, Ẹ jẹ ki emi ri ore-ọfẹ li oju nyin, ohun ti ẹnyin o si kà fun mi li emi o fi fun nyin.
entries.en: And Shechem said unto her father and unto her brethren, Let me find grace in your eyes, and what ye shall say unto me I will give.

entries.yo: Ẹ bère ana lọwọ mi ati ẹ̀bun bi o ti wù ki o pọ̀ to, emi o si fi fun nyin gẹgẹ bi ẹnyin o ti kà fun mi: ṣugbọn ẹ fun mi li omidan na li aya.
entries.en: Ask me never so much dowry and gift, and I will give according as ye shall say unto me: but give me the damsel to wife.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Jakobu si fi ẹ̀tan da Ṣekemu ati Hamori baba rẹ̀ lohùn, nwọn si wipe, nitori ti o bà Dina arabinrin wọn jẹ́:
entries.en: And the sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father deceitfully, and said, because he had defiled Dinah their sister:

entries.yo: Nwọn si wi fun wọn pe, Awa kò le ṣe nkan yi lati fi arabinrin wa fun ẹni alaikọlà, nitori ohun àbuku ni fun wa;
entries.en: And they said unto them, We cannot do this thing, to give our sister to one that is uncircumcised; for that were a reproach unto us:

entries.yo: Kiki ninu eyi li awa le jẹ fun nyin: bi ẹnyin o ba wà bi awa, pe ki a kọ olukuluku ọkunrin nyin li ilà.
entries.en: But in this will we consent unto you: If ye will be as we be, that every male of you be circumcised;

entries.yo: Nigbana li awa o fi awọn ọmọbinrin wa fun nyin, awa o si mú awọn ọmọbinrin nyin sọdọ wa; awa o si ma bá nyin gbé, awa o si di enia kanna.
entries.en: Then will we give our daughters unto you, and we will take your daughters to us, and we will dwell with you, and we will become one people.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi ẹnyin kò ba gbọ́ ti wa lati kọlà; njẹ awa o mú ọmọbinrin wa, awa o si ba ti wa lọ.
entries.en: But if ye will not hearken unto us, to be circumcised; then will we take our daughter, and we will be gone.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ wọn si dún mọ́ Hamori, ati Ṣekemu, ọmọ Hamori.
entries.en: And their words pleased Hamor, and Shechem Hamor's son.

entries.yo: Ọdọmọkunrin na kò si pẹ́ titi lati ṣe nkan na, nitoriti o fẹ́ ọmọbinrin Jakobu; o si li ọlá jù gbogbo ara ile baba rẹ̀ lọ.
entries.en: And the young man deferred not to do the thing, because he had delight in Jacob's daughter: and he was more honourable than all the house of his father.

entries.yo: Ati Hamori ati Ṣekemu ọmọ rẹ̀ wá si ẹnubode ilu wọn, nwọn si bá awọn ara ilu wọn sọ̀rọ wipe,
entries.en: And Hamor and Shechem his son came unto the gate of their city, and communed with the men of their city, saying,

entries.yo: Awọn ọkunrin wọnyi mbá wa gbé li alafia; nitorina ẹ jẹ ki nwọn ki o ma gbé ilẹ yi, ki nwọn ki o si ma ṣòwo nibẹ̀; kiyesi i, ilẹ sa gbàye tó niwaju wọn; ẹnyin jẹ ki a ma fẹ́ awọn ọmọbinrin wọn li aya, ki awa ki o si ma fi awọn ọmọbinrin wa fun wọn.
entries.en: These men are peaceable with us; therefore let them dwell in the land, and trade therein; for the land, behold, it is large enough for them; let us take their daughters to us for wives, and let us give them our daughters.

entries.yo: Kìki ninu eyi li awọn ọkunrin na o ṣe jẹ fun wa, lati ma bá wa gbé, lati di enia kan, bi gbogbo ọkunrin inu wa ba kọlà, gẹgẹ bi nwọn ti kọlà.
entries.en: Only herein will the men consent unto us for to dwell with us, to be one people, if every male among us be circumcised, as they are circumcised.

entries.yo: Tiwa kọ ẹran wọn, ati ẹrù wọn, ati gbogbo ohunọ̀sin wọn yio ha ṣe? ki a sa jẹ fun wọn nwọn o si ma ba wa joko,
entries.en: Shall not their cattle and their substance and every beast of theirs be ours? only let us consent unto them, and they will dwell with us.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn ti njade li ẹnubode ilu wọn si fetisi ti Hamori ati ti Ṣekemu ọmọ rẹ̀; a si kọ gbogbo awọn ọkunrin ni ilà, gbogbo ẹniti o nti ẹnubode wọn jade.
entries.en: And unto Hamor and unto Shechem his son hearkened all that went out of the gate of his city; and every male was circumcised, all that went out of the gate of his city.

entries.yo: O si ṣe ni ọjọ́ kẹta, ti ọgbẹ wọn kan, ni awọn ọmọkunrin Jakobu meji si dide, Simeoni ati Lefi, awọn arakunrin Dina, olukuluku nwọn mú idà rẹ̀, nwọn si fi igboyà wọ̀ ilu na, nwọn si pa gbogbo awọn ọkunrin.
entries.en: And it came to pass on the third day, when they were sore, that two of the sons of Jacob, Simeon and Levi, Dinah's brethren, took each man his sword, and came upon the city boldly, and slew all the males.

entries.yo: Nwọn si fi oju idà pa Hamori ati Ṣekemu, ọmọ rẹ̀, nwọn si mú Dina jade kuro ni ile Ṣekemu, nwọn si jade lọ.
entries.en: And they slew Hamor and Shechem his son with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah out of Shechem's house, and went out.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Jakobu si wọle awọn ti a pa, nwọn si kó ilu na lọ, nitori ti nwọn bà arabinrin wọn jẹ́.
entries.en: The sons of Jacob came upon the slain, and spoiled the city, because they had defiled their sister.

entries.yo: Nwọn kó agutan wọn, ati akọmalu wọn, ati kẹtẹkẹtẹ wọn, ati ohun ti o wà ni ilu na, ati eyiti o wà li oko.
entries.en: They took their sheep, and their oxen, and their asses, and that which was in the city, and that which was in the field,

entries.yo: Ati ọrọ̀ wọn gbogbo, ati gbogbo ọmọ wọn wẹ́rẹ, ati aya wọn ni nwọn dì ni igbekun, nwọn si kó ohun gbogbo ti o wà ninu ile lọ.
entries.en: And all their wealth, and all their little ones, and their wives took they captive, and spoiled even all that was in the house.

entries.yo: Jakobu si wi fun Simeoni on Lefi pe, Ẹnyin mu wahalà bá mi niti ẹnyin mu mi di õrun ninu awọn onilẹ, ninu awọn ara Kenaani ati awọn enia Perissi: bi emi kò si ti pọ̀ ni iye, nwọn o kó ara wọn jọ si mi, nwọn o si pa mi: a o si pa mi run, emi ati ile mi.
entries.en: And Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, Ye have troubled me to make me to stink among the inhabitants of the land, among the Canaanites and the Perizzites: and I being few in number, they shall gather themselves together against me, and slay me; and I shall be destroyed, I and my house.

entries.yo: Nwọn si wipe, Ki on ki o ha ṣe si arabinrin wa bi ẹnipe si panṣaga?
entries.en: And they said, Should he deal with our sister as with an harlot?

entries.yo: ỌLỌRUN si wi fun Jakobu pe, Dide goke lọ si Beteli ki o si joko nibẹ̀, ki o si tẹ́ pẹpẹ kan nibẹ̀, fun Ọlọrun, ti o farahàn ọ, nigbati iwọ sá kuro niwaju Esau, arakunrin rẹ.
entries.en: And God said unto Jacob, Arise, go up to Bethel, and dwell there: and make there an altar unto God, that appeared unto thee when thou fleddest from the face of Esau thy brother.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Jakobu wi fun awọn ara ile rẹ̀, ati fun gbogbo awọn ti o wà li ọdọ rẹ̀ pe, Ẹ mú àjeji oriṣa ti o wà lọwọ nyin kuro, ki ẹnyin ki o si sọ ara nyin di mimọ́, ki ẹnyin ki o si pa aṣọ nyin dà:
entries.en: Then Jacob said unto his household, and to all that were with him, Put away the strange gods that are among you, and be clean, and change your garments:

entries.yo: Ẹ si jẹ ki a dide, ki a si goke lọ si Beteli; nibẹ̀ li emi o si gbé tẹ́ pẹpẹ kan fun Ọlọrun ti o da mi li ohùn li ọjọ́ ipọnju mi, ẹniti o si wà pẹlu mi li àjo ti mo rè.
entries.en: And let us arise, and go up to Bethel; and I will make there an altar unto God, who answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me in the way which I went.

entries.yo: Nwọn si fi gbogbo àjeji oriṣa ti o wà lọwọ wọn fun Jakobu, ati gbogbo oruka eti ti o wà li eti wọn: Jakobu si pa wọn mọ́ li abẹ igi oaku ti o wà leti Ṣekemu.
entries.en: And they gave unto Jacob all the strange gods which were in their hand, and all their earrings which were in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the oak which was by Shechem.

entries.yo: Nwọn si rìn lọ: ẹ̀ru Ọlọrun si mbẹ lara ilu ti o yi wọn ká, nwọn kò si lepa awọn ọmọ Jakobu.
entries.en: And they journeyed: and the terror of God was upon the cities that were round about them, and they did not pursue after the sons of Jacob.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Jakobu si wá si Lusi, ti o wà ni ilẹ Kenaani, eyinì ni Beteli, on ati gbogbo enia ti o wà lọdọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: So Jacob came to Luz, which is in the land of Canaan, that is, Bethel, he and all the people that were with him.

entries.yo: O si tẹ́ pẹpẹ kan nibẹ̀, o si sọ orukọ ibẹ̀ na ni El-bet-el: nitori pe nibẹ̀ li Ọlọrun tọ̀ ọ wá, nigbati o sá kuro niwaju arakunrin rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he built there an altar, and called the place El-beth-el: because there God appeared unto him, when he fled from the face of his brother.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Debora olutọ́ Rebeka kú, a si sin i nisalẹ Beteli labẹ igi oaku kan: orukọ rẹ̀ a si ma jẹ́ Alloni-bakutu.
entries.en: But Deborah Rebekah's nurse died, and she was buried beneath Bethel under an oak: and the name of it was called Allon-bachuth.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si tún farahàn Jakobu, nigbati o ti Padan-aramu bọ̀, o si sure fun u.
entries.en: And God appeared unto Jacob again, when he came out of Padan-aram, and blessed him.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si wi fun u pe, Jakobu li orukọ rẹ: a ki yio pè orukọ rẹ ni Jakobu mọ́, bikoṣe Israeli li orukọ rẹ yio ma jẹ́: o si sọ orukọ rẹ̀ ni Israeli.
entries.en: And God said unto him, Thy name is Jacob: thy name shall not be called any more Jacob, but Israel shall be thy name: and he called his name Israel.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si wi fun u pe, Emi li Ọlọrun Olodumare: ma bisi i, si ma rẹ̀; orilẹ-ède, ati ẹgbẹ-ẹgbẹ orilẹ-ède ni yio ti ọdọ rẹ wá, awọn ọba yio si ti inu rẹ jade wá;
entries.en: And God said unto him, I am God Almighty: be fruitful and multiply; a nation and a company of nations shall be of thee, and kings shall come out of thy loins;

entries.yo: Ati ilẹ ti mo ti fi fun Abrahamu ati Isaaki, iwọ li emi o fi fun, ati irú-ọmọ rẹ lẹhin rẹ li emi o fi ilẹ na fun.
entries.en: And the land which I gave Abraham and Isaac, to thee I will give it, and to thy seed after thee will I give the land.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si lọ soke kuro lọdọ rẹ̀ ni ibi ti o gbé mbá a sọ̀rọ.
entries.en: And God went up from him in the place where he talked with him.

entries.yo: Jakobu si fi ọwọ̀n kan lelẹ ni ibi ti o gbé bá a sọ̀rọ, ani ọwọ̀n okuta: o si ta ọrẹ ohun mimu si ori rẹ̀, o si ta oróro si ori rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he talked with him, even a pillar of stone: and he poured a drink offering thereon, and he poured oil thereon.

entries.yo: Jakobu si sọ orukọ ibi ti Ọlọrun gbé bá a sọ̀rọ ni Beteli.
entries.en: And Jacob called the name of the place where God spake with him, Bethel.

entries.yo: Nwọn si rìn lati Beteli lọ; o si kù diẹ ki nwọn ki o dé Efrati: ibi si tẹ̀ Rakeli: o si ṣoro jọjọ fun u.
entries.en: And they journeyed from Bethel; and there was but a little way to come to Ephrath: and Rachel travailed, and she had hard labour.

entries.yo: O si ṣe nigbati o wà ninu irọbí, ni iyãgba wi fun u pe, Máṣe bẹ̀ru: iwọ o si li ọmọkunrin yi pẹlu.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when she was in hard labour, that the midwife said unto her, Fear not; thou shalt have this son also.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, bi ọkàn rẹ̀ ti nlọ̀ (o sa kú) o sọ orukọ rẹ̀ ni Ben-oni: ṣugbọn baba rẹ̀ sọ ọ ni Benjamini.
entries.en: And it came to pass, as her soul was in departing, (for she died) that she called his name Ben-oni: but his father called him Benjamin.

entries.yo: Rakeli si kú, a si sin i li ọ̀na Efrati, ti iṣe Betlehemu.
entries.en: And Rachel died, and was buried in the way to Ephrath, which is Bethlehem.

entries.yo: Jakobu si fi ọwọ̀n kan lelẹ li oju-õri rẹ̀, eyinì ni Ọwọ̀n oju-õri Rakeli titi di oni-oloni.
entries.en: And Jacob set a pillar upon her grave: that is the pillar of Rachel's grave unto this day.

entries.yo: Israeli si nrìn lọ, o si pa agọ́ rẹ̀ niwaju ile iṣọ Ederi.
entries.en: And Israel journeyed, and spread his tent beyond the tower of Edar.

entries.yo: O si ṣe nigbati Israeli joko ni ilẹ na, Reubeni si wọle tọ̀ Bilha, àle baba rẹ̀ lọ; Israeli si gbọ́. Njẹ awọn ọmọ Jakobu jẹ́ mejila.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when Israel dwelt in that land, that Reuben went and lay with Bilhah his father's concubine: and Israel heard it. Now the sons of Jacob were twelve:

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Lea; Reubẹni, akọ́bi Jakobu, ati Simeoni, ati Lefi, ati Judah, ati Issakari, ati Sebuluni.
entries.en: The sons of Leah; Reuben, Jacob's firstborn, and Simeon, and Levi, and Judah, and Issachar, and Zebulun:

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Rakeli; Josefu, ati Benjamini:
entries.en: The sons of Rachel; Joseph, and Benjamin:

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Bilha, iranṣẹbinrin Rakeli; Dani, ati Naftali:
entries.en: And the sons of Bilhah, Rachel's handmaid; Dan, and Naphtali:

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Silpa, iranṣẹbinrin Lea; Gadi ati Aṣeri. Awọn wọnyi li ọmọ Jakobu, ti a bí fun u ni Padanaramu.
entries.en: And the sons of Zilpah, Leah's handmaid; Gad, and Asher: these are the sons of Jacob, which were born to him in Padan-aram.

entries.yo: Jakobu si dé ọdọ Isaaki baba rẹ̀, ni Mamre, si Kiriat-arba, ti iṣe Hebroni, nibiti Abrahamu ati Isaaki gbé ṣe atipo pẹlu.
entries.en: And Jacob came unto Isaac his father unto Mamre, unto the city of Arbah, which is Hebron, where Abraham and Isaac sojourned.

entries.yo: Ọjọ́ Isaaki si jẹ́ ọgọsan ọdún.
entries.en: And the days of Isaac were an hundred and fourscore years.

entries.yo: Isaaki si jọwọ ẹmi rẹ̀ lọwọ, o si kú, a si kó o jọ pẹlu awọn enia rẹ̀, o gbó, o si kún fun ọjọ́, awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, Esau ati Jakobu si sin i.
entries.en: And Isaac gave up the ghost, and died, and was gathered unto his people, being old and full of days: and his sons Esau and Jacob buried him.

entries.yo: WỌNYI si ni iran Esau, ẹniti iṣe Edomu.
entries.en: Now these are the generations of Esau, who is Edom.

entries.yo: Esau fẹ́ awọn aya rẹ̀ ninu awọn ọmọbinrin Kenaani; Ada, ọmọbinrin Eloni, enia Hitti, ati Aholibama, ọmọbinrin Ana, ọmọbinrin Sibeoni, ara Hiffi;
entries.en: Esau took his wives of the daughters of Canaan; Adah the daughter of Elon the Hittite, and Aholibamah the daughter of Anah the daughter of Zibeon the Hivite;

entries.yo: Ati Baṣemati, ọmọbinrin Iṣmaeli, arabinrin Nebajotu.
entries.en: And Bashemath Ishmael's daughter, sister of Nebajoth.

entries.yo: Ada si bí Elifasi fun Esau; Baṣemati si bí Reueli;
entries.en: And Adah bare to Esau Eliphaz; and Bashemath bare Reuel;

entries.yo: Aholibama si bí Jeuṣi, ati Jaalamu, ati Kora: awọn wọnyi li ọmọkunrin Esau, ti a bí fun u ni ilẹ Kenaani.
entries.en: And Aholibamah bare Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah: these are the sons of Esau, which were born unto him in the land of Canaan.

entries.yo: Esau si mú awọn aya rẹ̀, ati awọn ọmọkunrin rẹ̀, ati awọn ọmọbinrin rẹ̀, ati gbogbo awọn enia ile rẹ̀, ati ẹran rẹ̀, ati gbogbo ohun-ọ̀sin, ati ohun iní gbogbo ti o ní ni ilẹ Kenaani; o si lọ si ilẹ kan kuro niwaju Jakobu arakunrin rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Esau took his wives, and his sons, and his daughters, and all the persons of his house, and his cattle, and all his beasts, and all his substance, which he had got in the land of Canaan; and went into the country from the face of his brother Jacob.

entries.yo: Nitori ti ọrọ̀ wọn pọ̀ jù ki nwọn ki o gbé pọ̀ lọ; ilẹ ti nwọn si ṣe atipo si kò le gbà wọn, nitori ohun-ọ̀sin wọn.
entries.en: For their riches were more than that they might dwell together; and the land wherein they were strangers could not bear them because of their cattle.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Esau tẹ̀dó li oke Seiri: Esau ni Edomu.
entries.en: Thus dwelt Esau in mount Seir: Esau is Edom.

entries.yo: Wọnyi si ni iran Esau, baba awọn ara Edomu, li oke Seiri:
entries.en: And these are the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in mount Seir:

entries.yo: Wọnyi li orukọ awọn ọmọ Esau; Elifasi, ọmọ Ada, aya Esau, Rueli, ọmọ Baṣemati, aya Esau.
entries.en: These are the names of Esau's sons; Eliphaz the son of Adah the wife of Esau, Reuel the son of Bashemath the wife of Esau.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Elifasi ni Temani, Omari, Sefo, ati Gatamu, ati Kenasi.
entries.en: And the sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam, and Kenaz.

entries.yo: Timna li o si ṣe àle Elifasi, ọmọ Esau; on si bí Amaleki fun Elifasi; wọnyi si li awọn ọmọ Ada, aya Esau.
entries.en: And Timna was concubine to Eliphaz Esau's son; and she bare to Eliphaz Amalek: these were the sons of Adah Esau's wife.

entries.yo: Wọnyi si li awọn ọmọ Reueli; Nahati, ati Sera, Ṣamma, ati Misa: awọn wọnyi li awọn ọmọ Baṣemati, aya Esau.
entries.en: And these are the sons of Reuel; Nahath, and Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah: these were the sons of Bashemath Esau's wife.

entries.yo: Wọnyi si li awọn ọmọ Aholibama, ọmọbinrin Ana, ọmọbinrin Sibeoni, aya Esau: on si bí Jeuṣi fun Esau, ati Jaalamu, ati Kora.
entries.en: And these were the sons of Aholibamah, the daughter of Anah the daughter of Zibeon, Esau's wife: and she bare to Esau Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah.

entries.yo: Awọn wọnyi ni olori ninu awọn ọmọ Esau: awọn ọmọ Elifasi, akọ́bi Esau; Temani olori, Omari olori, Sefo olori, Kenasi olori,
entries.en: These were dukes of the sons of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz the firstborn son of Esau; duke Teman, duke Omar, duke Zepho, duke Kenaz,

entries.yo: Kora olori, Gatamu olori, Amaleki olori: wọnyi li awọn olori ti o ti ọdọ Elifasi wá ni ilẹ Edomu; wọnyi li awọn ọmọ Ada.
entries.en: Duke Korah, duke Gatam, and duke Amalek: these are the dukes that came of Eliphaz in the land of Edom; these were the sons of Adah.

entries.yo: Wọnyi si li awọn ọmọ Reueli ọmọ Esau; Nahati olori, Sera olori, Ṣamma olori, Misa olori; wọnyi li awọn olori ti o ti ọdọ Reueli wá ni ilẹ Edomu; wọnyi li awọn ọmọ Baṣemati, aya Esau.
entries.en: And these are the sons of Reuel Esau's son; duke Nahath, duke Zerah, duke Shammah, duke Mizzah: these are the dukes that came of Reuel in the land of Edom; these are the sons of Bashemath Esau's wife.

entries.yo: Wọnyi si li awọn ọmọ Aholibama, aya Esau; Jeuṣi olori, Jaalamu olori, Kora olori: wọnyi li awọn ti o ti ọdọ Aholibama wá, aya Esau, ọmọbinrin Ana.
entries.en: And these are the sons of Aholibamah Esau's wife; duke Jeush, duke Jaalam, duke Korah: these were the dukes that came of Aholibamah the daughter of Anah, Esau's wife.

entries.yo: Wọnyi li awọn ọmọ Esau, eyini ni Edomu, wọnyi si li awọn olori wọn.
entries.en: These are the sons of Esau, who is Edom, and these are their dukes.

entries.yo: Wọnyi li awọn ọmọ Seiri, enia Hori, ti o tẹ̀dó ni ilẹ na; Lotani, ati Ṣobali, ati Sibeoni, ati Ana,
entries.en: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, who inhabited the land; Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah,

entries.yo: Ati Diṣoni, ati Eseri, ati Diṣani: wọnyi li awọn olori enia Hori, awọn ọmọ Seiri ni ilẹ Edomu.
entries.en: And Dishon, and Ezer, and Dishan: these are the dukes of the Horites, the children of Seir in the land of Edom.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Lotani ni Hori ati Hemamu: arabinrin Lotani si ni Timna.
entries.en: And the children of Lotan were Hori and Hemam; and Lotan's sister was Timna.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Ṣobali ni wọnyi; Alfani, ati Mahanati, ati Ebali, Sefo, ati Onamu.
entries.en: And the children of Shobal were these; Alvan, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.

entries.yo: Wọnyi si li awọn ọmọ Sibeoni; ati Aja on Ana: eyi ni Ana ti o ri awọn isun omi gbigbona ni ijù, bi o ti mbọ́ awọn kẹtẹkẹtẹ Sibeoni baba rẹ̀.
entries.en: And these are the children of Zibeon; both Ajah, and Anah: this was that Anah that found the mules in the wilderness, as he fed the asses of Zibeon his father.

entries.yo: Wọnyi si li awọn ọmọ Ana; Disoni ati Aholibama, ọmọbinrin Ana.
entries.en: And the children of Anah were these; Dishon, and Aholibamah the daughter of Anah.

entries.yo: Wọnyi si li awọn ọmọ Diṣoni; Hemdani, ati Eṣbani, ati Itrani, ati Kerani.
entries.en: And these are the children of Dishon; Hemdan, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Eseri ni wọnyi; Bilhani, ati Saafani, ati Akani.
entries.en: The children of Ezer are these; Bilhan, and Zaavan, and Akan.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Diṣani ni wọnyi; Usi ati Arani.
entries.en: The children of Dishan are these: Uz, and Aran.

entries.yo: Wọnyi li awọn olori ti o ti ọdọ Hori wá; Lotani olori, Ṣobali olori, Sibeoni olori, Ana olori,
entries.en: These are the dukes that came of the Horites; duke Lotan, duke Shobal, duke Zibeon, duke Anah,

entries.yo: Diṣoni olori, Eseri olori, Diṣani olori; wọnyi li awọn olori awọn enia Hori, ninu awọn olori wọn ni ilẹ Seiri.
entries.en: Duke Dishon, duke Ezer, duke Dishan: these are the dukes that came of Hori, among their dukes in the land of Seir.

entries.yo: Wọnyi si li awọn ọba ti o jẹ ni ilẹ Edomu, ki ọba kan ki o to jọba lori awọn ọmọ Israeli.
entries.en: And these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom, before there reigned any king over the children of Israel.

entries.yo: Bela ti iṣe ọmọ Beori si jọba ni Edomu: orukọ ilu rẹ̀ a si ma jẹ́ Dinhaba.
entries.en: And Bela the son of Beor reigned in Edom: and the name of his city was Dinhabah.

entries.yo: Bela si kú, Jobabu ọmọ Sera ti Bosra si jọba ni ipò rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.

entries.yo: Jobabu si kú, Huṣamu ti ilẹ Temani si jọba ni ipò rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Jobab died, and Husham of the land of Temani reigned in his stead.

entries.yo: Huṣamu si kú, Hadadi ọmọ Bedadi, ẹniti o kọlù Midiani ni igbẹ́ Moabu si jọba ni ipò rẹ̀: orukọ ilu rẹ̀ si ni Afiti.
entries.en: And Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Avith.

entries.yo: Hadadi si kú, Samla ti Masreka si jọba ni ipò rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.

entries.yo: Samla si kú, Ṣaulu ti Rehobotu leti odò nì si jọba ni ipò rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Samlah died, and Saul of Rehoboth by the river reigned in his stead.

entries.yo: Ṣaulu si kú, Baal-hanani ọmọ Akbori si jọba ni ipò rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Saul died, and Baal-hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.

entries.yo: Baal-hanani ọmọ Akbori si kú, Hadari si jọba ni ipò rẹ̀: orukọ ilu rẹ̀ si ni Pau; Mehetabeli si li orukọ aya rẹ̀, ọmọbinrin Metredi, ọmọbinrin Mesahabu.
entries.en: And Baal-hanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Pau; and his wife's name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.

entries.yo: Wọnyi si li orukọ awọn olori ti o ti ọdọ Esau wá, gẹgẹ bi idile wọn, nipa ipò wọn, nipa orukọ wọn; Timna olori, Alfa olori, Jeteti olori;
entries.en: And these are the names of the dukes that came of Esau, according to their families, after their places, by their names; duke Timnah, duke Alvah, duke Jetheth,

entries.yo: Aholibama olori, Ela olori, Pinoni olori;
entries.en: Duke Aholibamah, duke Elah, duke Pinon,

entries.yo: Kenasi olori, Temani olori, Mibsari olori;
entries.en: Duke Kenaz, duke Teman, duke Mibzar,

entries.yo: Magdieli olori, Iramu olori: wọnyi li awọn olori Edomu, nipa itẹ̀dó wọn ni ilẹ iní wọn: eyi ni Esau, baba awọn ara Edomu.
entries.en: Duke Magdiel, duke Iram: these be the dukes of Edom, according to their habitations in the land of their possession: he is Esau the father of the Edomites.

entries.yo: JAKOBU si joko ni ilẹ ti baba rẹ̀ ti ṣe atipo, ani ilẹ Kenaani.
entries.en: And Jacob dwelt in the land wherein his father was a stranger, in the land of Canaan.

entries.yo: Wọnyi ni iran Jakobu. Nigbati Josefu di ẹni ọdún mẹtadilogun, o nṣọ́ agbo-ẹran pẹlu awọn arakunrin rẹ̀; ọmọde na si wà pẹlu awọn ọmọ Bilha, ati pẹlu awọn ọmọ Silpa, awọn aya baba rẹ̀; Josefu si mú ihin buburu wọn wá irò fun baba wọn.
entries.en: These are the generations of Jacob. Joseph, being seventeen years old, was feeding the flock with his brethren; and the lad was with the sons of Bilhah, and with the sons of Zilpah, his father's wives: and Joseph brought unto his father their evil report.

entries.yo: Israeli si fẹ́ Josefu jù gbogbo awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ lọ, nitori ti iṣe ọmọ ogbó rẹ̀; o si dá ẹ̀wu alarabara aṣọ fun u.
entries.en: Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, because he was the son of his old age: and he made him a coat of many colours.

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn arakunrin rẹ̀ ri pe baba wọn fẹ́ ẹ jù gbogbo awọn arakunrin rẹ̀ lọ, nwọn korira rẹ̀, nwọn kò si le sọ̀rọ si i li alafia.
entries.en: And when his brethren saw that their father loved him more than all his brethren, they hated him, and could not speak peaceably unto him.

entries.yo: Josefu si lá alá kan, o si rọ́ ọ fun awọn arakunrin rẹ̀; nwọn si tun korira rẹ̀ si i.
entries.en: And Joseph dreamed a dream, and he told it his brethren: and they hated him yet the more.

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Mo bẹ̀ nyin, ẹ gbọ́ alá yi ti mo lá.
entries.en: And he said unto them, Hear, I pray you, this dream which I have dreamed:

entries.yo: Sa wò o, awa nyí ití li oko, si wò o, ití mi dide, o si duro ṣanṣan; si wò o, ití ti nyin dide duro yiká, nwọn si ntẹriba fun ití mi.
entries.en: For, behold, we were binding sheaves in the field, and, lo, my sheaf arose, and also stood upright; and, behold, your sheaves stood round about, and made obeisance to my sheaf.

entries.yo: Awọn arakunrin rẹ̀ si wi fun u pe, Iwọ o ha jọba lori wa bi? tabi iwọ o ṣe olori wa nitõtọ? nwọn si tun korira rẹ̀ si i nitori alá rẹ̀ ati nitori ọ̀rọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And his brethren said to him, Shalt thou indeed reign over us? or shalt thou indeed have dominion over us? And they hated him yet the more for his dreams, and for his words.

entries.yo: O si tun lá alá miran, o si rọ́ ọ fun awọn arakunrin rẹ̀, o wipe, Sa wò o, mo tun lá alá kan si i; si wò o, õrùn, ati oṣupa, ati irawọ mọkanla nforibalẹ fun mi.
entries.en: And he dreamed yet another dream, and told it his brethren, and said, Behold, I have dreamed a dream more; and, behold, the sun and the moon and the eleven stars made obeisance to me.

entries.yo: O si rọ́ ọ fun baba rẹ̀, ati fun awọn arakunrin rẹ̀: baba rẹ̀ si bá a wi, o si wi fun u pe, Alá kili eyi ti iwọ lá yi? emi ati iya rẹ, ati awọn arakunrin rẹ yio ha wá nitõtọ, lati foribalẹ fun ọ bi?
entries.en: And he told it to his father, and to his brethren: and his father rebuked him, and said unto him, What is this dream that thou hast dreamed? Shall I and thy mother and thy brethren indeed come to bow down ourselves to thee to the earth?

entries.yo: Awọn arakunrin rẹ̀ si ṣe ilara rẹ̀; ṣugbọn baba rẹ̀ pa ọ̀rọ na mọ́.
entries.en: And his brethren envied him; but his father observed the saying.

entries.yo: Awọn arakunrin rẹ̀ si lọ lati bọ́ agbo-ẹran baba wọn ni Ṣekemu.
entries.en: And his brethren went to feed their father's flock in Shechem.

entries.yo: Israeli si wi fun Josefu pe, Ni Ṣekemu ki awọn arakunrin rẹ gbé mbọ́ ẹran? wá, emi o si rán ọ si wọn. On si wi fun u pe, Emi niyi.
entries.en: And Israel said unto Joseph, Do not thy brethren feed the flock in Shechem? come, and I will send thee unto them. And he said to him, Here am I.

entries.yo: O si wi fun u pe, Mo bẹ̀ ọ, lọ wò alafia awọn arakunrin rẹ, ati alafia awọn agbo-ẹran; ki o si mú ihin pada fun mi wá. Bẹ̃li o si rán a lati afonifoji Hebroni lọ, on si dé Ṣekemu.
entries.en: And he said to him, Go, I pray thee, see whether it be well with thy brethren, and well with the flocks; and bring me word again. So he sent him out of the vale of Hebron, and he came to Shechem.

entries.yo: Ọkunrin kan si ri i, si wò o, o nrìn kakiri ni pápa: ọkunrin na si bi i pe, Kini iwọ nwá?
entries.en: And a certain man found him, and, behold, he was wandering in the field: and the man asked him, saying, What seekest thou?

entries.yo: On si wipe, Emi nwá awọn arakunrin mi: mo bẹ̀ ọ, sọ ibi ti nwọn gbé mbọ́ agbo-ẹran wọn fun mi.
entries.en: And he said, I seek my brethren: tell me, I pray thee, where they feed their flocks.

entries.yo: Ọkunrin na si wipe, Nwọn ti lọ kuro nihin; nitori mo gbọ́, nwọn nwipe, ẹ jẹ ki a lọ si Dotani. Josefu si lepa awọn arakunrin rẹ̀, o si ri wọn ni Dotani.
entries.en: And the man said, They are departed hence; for I heard them say, Let us go to Dothan. And Joseph went after his brethren, and found them in Dothan.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si ri i lokere; ki o tilẹ to sunmọ eti ọdọ wọn, nwọn di rikiṣi si i lati pa a.
entries.en: And when they saw him afar off, even before he came near unto them, they conspired against him to slay him.

entries.yo: Nwọn si wi fun ara wọn pe, Wò o, alála nì mbọ̀wá.
entries.en: And they said one to another, Behold, this dreamer cometh.

entries.yo: Nisisiyi ẹ wá, ẹ jẹ ki a pa a, ki a si wọ́ ọ sọ sinu ọkan ninu ihò wọnyi, awa o si wipe ẹranko buburu li o pa a jẹ: awa o si ma wò bi alá rẹ̀ yio ti ri.
entries.en: Come now therefore, and let us slay him, and cast him into some pit, and we will say, Some evil beast hath devoured him: and we shall see what will become of his dreams.

entries.yo: Reubeni si gbọ́, o si gbà a li ọwọ́ won; o si wipe, Ẹ máṣe jẹ ki a gbà ẹmi rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Reuben heard it, and he delivered him out of their hands; and said, Let us not kill him.

entries.yo: Reubeni si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ máṣe ta ẹ̀jẹ, ṣugbọn ẹ sọ ọ sinu ihò yi ti mbẹ li aginjù, ki ẹ má si fọwọkàn a; nitori ki o ba le gbà a lọwọ wọn lati mú u pada tọ̀ baba rẹ̀ lọ.
entries.en: And Reuben said unto them, Shed no blood, but cast him into this pit that is in the wilderness, and lay no hand upon him; that he might rid him out of their hands, to deliver him to his father again.

entries.yo: O si ṣe nigbati Josefu dé ọdọ awọn arakunrin rẹ̀, nwọn bọ́ ẹ̀wu Josefu, ẹ̀wu alarabara aṣọ ti o wà lara rẹ̀;
entries.en: And it came to pass, when Joseph was come unto his brethren, that they stript Joseph out of his coat, his coat of many colours that was on him;

entries.yo: Nwọn si mú u, nwọn si gbe e sọ sinu ihò kan: ihò na si gbẹ, kò li omi.
entries.en: And they took him, and cast him into a pit: and the pit was empty, there was no water in it.

entries.yo: Nwọn si joko lati jẹun: nwọn si gbé oju wọn soke, nwọn si wò, si kiyesi i, ọwọ́-èro ara Iṣmaeli nti Gileadi bọ̀; ti awọn ti ibakasiẹ ti o rù turari ati ikunra ati ojia, nwọn nmú wọn lọ si Egipti.
entries.en: And they sat down to eat bread: and they lifted up their eyes and looked, and, behold, a company of Ishmeelites came from Gilead with their camels bearing spicery and balm and myrrh, going to carry it down to Egypt.

entries.yo: Judah si wi fun awọn arakunrin rẹ̀ pe, Ere ki li o jẹ́ bi awa ba pa arakunrin wa, ti a si bò ẹ̀jẹ rẹ̀?
entries.en: And Judah said unto his brethren, What profit is it if we slay our brother, and conceal his blood?

entries.yo: Ẹ wá ẹ jẹ ki a tà a fun awọn ara Iṣmaeli ki a má si fọwọ wa kàn a; nitori arakunrin wa ati ara wa ni iṣe. Awọn arakunrin rẹ̀ si gbà tirẹ̀.
entries.en: Come, and let us sell him to the Ishmeelites, and let not our hand be upon him; for he is our brother and our flesh. And his brethren were content.

entries.yo: Nigbana li awọn oniṣòwo ara Midiani nkọja lọ; nwọn si fà a, nwọn si yọ Josefu jade ninu ihò, nwọn si tà Josefu li ogún owo fadaka: nwọn si mú Josefu lọ si Egipti.
entries.en: Then there passed by Midianites merchantmen; and they drew and lifted up Joseph out of the pit, and sold Joseph to the Ishmeelites for twenty pieces of silver: and they brought Joseph into Egypt.

entries.yo: Reubeni si pada lọ si ihò; si wò o, Josefu kò sí ninu ihò na; o si fà aṣọ rẹ̀ ya.
entries.en: And Reuben returned unto the pit; and, behold, Joseph was not in the pit; and he rent his clothes.

entries.yo: O si pada tọ̀ awọn arakunrin rẹ̀ lọ, o si wipe, Ọmọde na kò sí; ati emi, nibo li emi o gbé wọ̀?
entries.en: And he returned unto his brethren, and said, The child is not; and I, whither shall I go?

entries.yo: Nwọn si mú ẹ̀wu Josefu, nwọn si pa ọmọ ewurẹ kan, nwọn si rì ẹ̀wu na sinu ẹ̀jẹ na.
entries.en: And they took Joseph's coat, and killed a kid of the goats, and dipped the coat in the blood;

entries.yo: Nwọn si fi ẹ̀wu alarabara aṣọ na ranṣẹ, nwọn si mú u tọ̀ baba wọn wá; nwọn si wipe, Eyi li awa ri: mọ̀ nisisiyi bi ẹ̀wu ọmọ rẹ ni, bi on kọ́.
entries.en: And they sent the coat of many colours, and they brought it to their father; and said, This have we found: know now whether it be thy son's coat or no.

entries.yo: On si mọ̀ ọ, o si wipe, Ẹ̀wu ọmọ mi ni; ẹranko buburu ti pa a jẹ; li aiṣe aniani, a ti fà Josefu ya pẹrẹpẹrẹ.
entries.en: And he knew it, and said, It is my son's coat; an evil beast hath devoured him; Joseph is without doubt rent in pieces.

entries.yo: Jakobu si fà aṣọ rẹ̀ ya, o si fi aṣọ ọ̀fọ si ara rẹ̀, o si ṣọ̀fọ ọmọ rẹ̀ li ọjọ́ pupọ̀.
entries.en: And Jacob rent his clothes, and put sackcloth upon his loins, and mourned for his son many days.

entries.yo: Ati gbogbo awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ ọkunrin, ati gbogbo awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ obinrin dide lati ṣìpẹ fun u; ṣugbọn o kọ̀ lati gbipẹ̀; o si wipe, Ninu ọ̀fọ li emi o sa sọkalẹ tọ̀ ọmọ mi lọ si isà-okú. Bayi ni baba rẹ̀ sọkun rẹ̀.
entries.en: And all his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him; but he refused to be comforted; and he said, For I will go down into the grave unto my son mourning. Thus his father wept for him.

entries.yo: Awọn ara Midiani si tà a si Egipti fun Potifari, ijoye Farao kan, ati olori ẹṣọ́.
entries.en: And the Midianites sold him into Egypt unto Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh's, and captain of the guard.

entries.yo: O SI ṣe li akokò na, ni Judah sọkalẹ lọ kuro lọdọ awọn arakunrin rẹ̀, o si yà sọdọ ara Adullamu kan, orukọ ẹniti ijẹ́ Hira.
entries.en: And it came to pass at that time, that Judah went down from his brethren, and turned in to a certain Adullamite, whose name was Hirah.

entries.yo: Judah si ri ọmọbinrin ara Kenaani kan nibẹ̀, orukọ ẹniti ijẹ́ Ṣua; o si mú u, o si wọle tọ̀ ọ.
entries.en: And Judah saw there a daughter of a certain Canaanite, whose name was Shuah; and he took her, and went in unto her.

entries.yo: O si yún, o si bí ọmọkunrin kan; o si sọ orukọ rẹ̀ ni Eri.
entries.en: And she conceived, and bare a son; and he called his name Er.

entries.yo: O si tun yún, o si bí ọmọkunrin kan; o si sọ orukọ rẹ̀ ni Onani.
entries.en: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and she called his name Onan.

entries.yo: O si tun yún, o si bí ọmọkunrin kan; o si sọ orukọ rẹ̀ ni Ṣela: o wà ni Kesibu, nigbati o bí i.
entries.en: And she yet again conceived, and bare a son; and called his name Shelah: and he was at Chezib, when she bare him.

entries.yo: Judah si fẹ́ aya fun Eri akọ́bi rẹ̀, orukọ ẹniti ijẹ́ Tamari.
entries.en: And Judah took a wife for Er his firstborn, whose name was Tamar.

entries.yo: Eri akọ́bi Judah si ṣe enia buburu li oju OLUWA; OLUWA si pa a.
entries.en: And Er, Judah's firstborn, was wicked in the sight of the LORD; and the LORD slew him.

entries.yo: Judah si wi fun Onani pe, Wọle tọ̀ aya arakunrin rẹ lọ, ki o si ṣú u li opó, ki o si bimọ si ipò arakunrin rẹ.
entries.en: And Judah said unto Onan, Go in unto thy brother's wife, and marry her, and raise up seed to thy brother.

entries.yo: Onani si mọ̀ pe, irú-ọmọ ki yio ṣe tirẹ̀; o si ṣe bi o ti wọle tọ̀ aya arakunrin rẹ̀ lọ, o si dà a silẹ, ki o má ba fi irú-ọmọ fun arakunrin rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Onan knew that the seed should not be his; and it came to pass, when he went in unto his brother's wife, that he spilled it on the ground, lest that he should give seed to his brother.

entries.yo: Ohun ti o si ṣe buru loju OLUWA, nitori na li OLUWA pa a pẹlu.
entries.en: And the thing which he did displeased the LORD: wherefore he slew him also.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Judah wi fun Tamari aya ọmọ rẹ̀ pe, Joko li opó ni ile baba rẹ, titi Ṣela ọmọ mi o fi dàgba: nitori o wipe, Ki on má ba kú pẹlu, bi awọn arakunrin rẹ̀. Tamari si lọ, o si joko ni ile baba rẹ̀.
entries.en: Then said Judah to Tamar his daughter in law, Remain a widow at thy father's house, till Shelah my son be grown: for he said, Lest peradventure he die also, as his brethren did. And Tamar went and dwelt in her father's house.

entries.yo: Nigbati ọjọ́ si npẹ́, ọmọbinrin Ṣua, aya Juda kú; Judah si gbipẹ̀, o si tọ̀ awọn olurẹrun agutan rẹ̀, lọ si Timnati, on ati Hira ọ̀rẹ́ rẹ̀, ara Adullamu.
entries.en: And in process of time the daughter of Shuah Judah's wife died; and Judah was comforted, and went up unto his sheepshearers to Timnath, he and his friend Hirah the Adullamite.

entries.yo: A si wi fun Tamari pe, Kiyesi i, baba ọkọ rẹ lọ si Timnati lati rẹrun agutan rẹ̀.
entries.en: And it was told Tamar, saying, Behold thy father in law goeth up to Timnath to shear his sheep.

entries.yo: O si bọ́ aṣọ opó rẹ̀ kuro li ara rẹ̀, o si fi iboju bò ara rẹ̀, o si roṣọ, o si joko li ẹnubode Enaimu, ti o wà li ọ̀na Timnati; nitoriti o ri pe Ṣela dàgba, a kò si fi on fun u li aya.
entries.en: And she put her widow's garments off from her, and covered her with a vail, and wrapped herself, and sat in an open place, which is by the way to Timnath; for she saw that Shelah was grown, and she was not given unto him to wife.

entries.yo: Nigbati Judah ri i, o fi i pè panṣaga; nitori o boju rẹ̀.
entries.en: When Judah saw her, he thought her to be an harlot; because she had covered her face.

entries.yo: O si yà tọ̀ ọ li ẹba ọ̀na, o si wipe, Emi bẹ̀ ọ, wá na, jẹ ki emi ki o wọle tọ̀ ọ; (on kò sa mọ̀ pe aya ọmọ on ni iṣe.) On si wipe Kini iwọ o fi fun mi, ki iwọ ki o le wọle tọ̀ mi?
entries.en: And he turned unto her by the way, and said, Go to, I pray thee, let me come in unto thee; (for he knew not that she was his daughter in law.) And she said, What wilt thou give me, that thou mayest come in unto me?

entries.yo: O si wipe, emi o rán ọmọ ewurẹ kan si ọ lati inu agbo wá. On si wipe, iwọ ki o fi ògo fun mi titi iwọ o fi rán a wá?
entries.en: And he said, I will send thee a kid from the flock. And she said, Wilt thou give me a pledge, till thou send it?

entries.yo: O si bi i pe, Ògo kili emi o fi fun ọ? on si wipe, Èdidi rẹ, ati okùn rẹ, ati ọpá rẹ ti o wà li ọwọ́ rẹ; o si fi wọn fun u, o si wọle tọ̀ ọ lọ, on si ti ipa ọdọ rẹ̀ yún.
entries.en: And he said, What pledge shall I give thee? And she said, Thy signet, and thy bracelets, and thy staff that is in thine hand. And he gave it her, and came in unto her, and she conceived by him.

entries.yo: On si dide, o ba tirẹ̀ lọ, o si bọ́ iboju rẹ̀ lelẹ kuro lara rẹ̀, o si mú aṣọ opó rẹ̀ ró.
entries.en: And she arose, and went away, and laid by her vail from her, and put on the garments of her widowhood.

entries.yo: Judah si rán ọmọ ewurẹ na lati ọwọ́ ọ̀rẹ́ rẹ̀, ara Adullamu na lọ, lati gbà ògo nì wá lọwọ obinrin na: ṣugbọn on kò ri i.
entries.en: And Judah sent the kid by the hand of his friend the Adullamite, to receive his pledge from the woman's hand: but he found her not.

entries.yo: Nigbana li o bère lọwọ awọn ọkunrin ibẹ̀ na pe, Nibo ni panṣaga nì ngbé, ti o wà ni Enaimu li ẹba ọ̀na? Nwọn si wipe, Panṣaga kan kò sí nihin.
entries.en: Then he asked the men of that place, saying, Where is the harlot, that was openly by the way side? And they said, There was no harlot in this place.

entries.yo: O si pada tọ̀ Judah lọ, o si wipe, Emi kò ri i; ati pẹlu awọn ọkunrin ara ibẹ̀ na wipe, Kò sí panṣaga kan nibẹ̀.
entries.en: And he returned to Judah, and said, I cannot find her; and also the men of the place said, that there was no harlot in this place.

entries.yo: Judah si wipe, Jẹ ki o ma mú u fun ara rẹ̀, ki oju ki o má tì wa: kiyesi i, emi rán ọmọ ewurẹ yi, iwọ kò si ri i.
entries.en: And Judah said, Let her take it to her, lest we be shamed: behold, I sent this kid, and thou hast not found her.

entries.yo: O si ṣe niwọ̀n oṣù mẹta lẹhin rẹ̀, ni a wi fun Judah pe, Tamari aya ọmọ rẹ ṣe àgbere; si kiyesi i pẹlu, o fi àgbere loyun. Judah si wipe, Mú u jade wá, ki a si dána sun u.
entries.en: And it came to pass about three months after, that it was told Judah, saying, Tamar thy daughter in law hath played the harlot; and also, behold, she is with child by whoredom. And Judah said, Bring her forth, and let her be burnt.

entries.yo: Nigbati a si mú u jade, o ranṣẹ si baba ọkọ rẹ̀ pe, ọkunrin ti o ní nkan wọnyi li emi yún fun: o si wipe, Emi bẹ̀ ọ, mọ̀ wọn, ti tani nkan wọnyi, èdidi, ati okùn, ati ọpá.
entries.en: When she was brought forth, she sent to her father in law, saying, By the man, whose these are, am I with child: and she said, Discern, I pray thee, whose are these, the signet, and bracelets, and staff.

entries.yo: Judah si jẹwọ, o si wipe, O ṣe olododo jù mi lọ; nitori ti emi kò fi i fun Ṣela ọmọ mi. On kò si mọ̀ ọ mọ́ lai.
entries.en: And Judah acknowledged them, and said, She hath been more righteous than I; because that I gave her not to Shelah my son. And he knew her again no more.

entries.yo: O si ṣe li akokò ti o nrọbí, si kiyesi i, ìbejì wà ni inu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And it came to pass in the time of her travail, that, behold, twins were in her womb.

entries.yo: O si ṣe nigbati o nrọbí, ti ọkan yọ ọwọ́ jade: iyãgba si mú okùn ododó o so mọ́ ọ li ọwọ́, o wipe, Eyi li o kọ jade.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when she travailed, that the one put out his hand: and the midwife took and bound upon his hand a scarlet thread, saying, This came out first,

entries.yo: O si ṣe, bi o ti fà ọwọ́ rẹ̀ pada, si kiyesi i, aburo rẹ̀ jade: o si wipe, Ẽṣe ti iwọ fi yà? yiyà yi wà li ara rẹ, nitori na li a ṣe sọ orukọ rẹ̀ ni Peresi:
entries.en: And it came to pass, as he drew back his hand, that, behold, his brother came out: and she said, How hast thou broken forth? this breach be upon thee: therefore his name was called Pharez.

entries.yo: Nikẹhin li arakunrin rẹ̀ jade, ti o li okùn ododó li ọwọ́ rẹ̀: a si sọ orukọ rẹ̀ ni Sera.
entries.en: And afterward came out his brother, that had the scarlet thread upon his hand: and his name was called Zarah.

entries.yo: A SI mú Josefu sọkalẹ wá si Egipti; Potifari, ijoye Farao kan, olori ẹṣọ́, ara Egipti, si rà a lọwọ awọn ara Iṣmaeli ti o mú u sọkalẹ wá sibẹ̀.
entries.en: And Joseph was brought down to Egypt; and Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh, captain of the guard, an Egyptian, bought him of the hands of the Ishmeelites, which had brought him down thither.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wà pẹlu Josefu, o si ṣe alasiki enia; o si wà ni ile oluwa rẹ̀ ara Egipti na.
entries.en: And the LORD was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man; and he was in the house of his master the Egyptian.

entries.yo: Oluwa rẹ̀ si ri pe OLUWA pẹlu rẹ̀, ati pe, OLUWA mu ohun gbogbo ti o ṣe dara li ọwọ́ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And his master saw that the LORD was with him, and that the LORD made all that he did to prosper in his hand.

entries.yo: Josefu si ri ojurere li oju rẹ̀, on si nsìn i: o si fi i jẹ́ olori ile rẹ̀, ati ohun gbogbo ti o ní on li o fi lé e lọwọ.
entries.en: And Joseph found grace in his sight, and he served him: and he made him overseer over his house, and all that he had he put into his hand.

entries.yo: O si ṣe lati ìgba ti o ti fi Josefu jẹ́ olori ile rẹ̀, ati olori ohun gbogbo ti o ní, ni OLUWA busi ile ara Egipti na nitori Josefu: ibukún OLUWA si wà lara ohun gbogbo ti o ní ni ile ati li oko.
entries.en: And it came to pass from the time that he had made him overseer in his house, and over all that he had, that the LORD blessed the Egyptian's house for Joseph's sake; and the blessing of the LORD was upon all that he had in the house, and in the field.

entries.yo: O si fi ohun gbogbo ti o ní si ọwọ́ Josefu; kò si mọ̀ ohun ti on ní bikoṣe onjẹ ti o njẹ. Josefu si ṣe ẹni daradara ati arẹwà enia.
entries.en: And he left all that he had in Joseph's hand; and he knew not ought he had, save the bread which he did eat. And Joseph was a goodly person, and well favoured.

entries.yo: O si ṣe lẹhin nkan wọnyi, ni aya oluwa rẹ̀ gbé oju lé Josefu; o si wipe, Bá mi ṣe.
entries.en: And it came to pass after these things, that his master's wife cast her eyes upon Joseph; and she said, Lie with me.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn on kọ̀, o si wi fun aya oluwa rẹ̀ pe, kiyesi i, oluwa mi kò mọ̀ ohun ti o wà lọdọ mi ni ile, o si ti fi ohun gbogbo ti o ní lé mi lọwọ:
entries.en: But he refused, and said unto his master's wife, Behold, my master wotteth not what is with me in the house, and he hath committed all that he hath to my hand;

entries.yo: Kò sí ẹniti o pọ̀ jù mi lọ ninu ile yi; bẹ̃ni kò si pa ohun kan mọ́ kuro lọwọ mi bikoṣe iwọ, nitori pe aya rẹ̀ ni iwọ iṣe: njẹ emi o ha ti ṣe hù ìwabuburu nla yi, ki emi si dẹ̀ṣẹ si Ọlọrun?
entries.en: There is none greater in this house than I; neither hath he kept back any thing from me but thee, because thou art his wife: how then can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God?

entries.yo: O si ṣe, bi o ti nsọ fun Josefu lojojumọ́, ti on kò si gbọ́ tirẹ̀ lati dubulẹ tì i, tabi lati bá a ṣe.
entries.en: And it came to pass, as she spake to Joseph day by day, that he hearkened not unto her, to lie by her, or to be with her.

entries.yo: O si ṣe niwọ̀n akokò yi, ti Josefu wọle lọ lati ṣe iṣẹ rẹ̀; ti kò si sí ẹnikan ninu awọn ọkunrin ile ninu ile nibẹ̀.
entries.en: And it came to pass about this time, that Joseph went into the house to do his business; and there was none of the men of the house there within.

entries.yo: On si di Josefu li aṣọ mú, o wipe, bá mi ṣe: on si jọwọ aṣọ rẹ̀ si i lọwọ, o si sá, o bọ sode.
entries.en: And she caught him by his garment, saying, Lie with me: and he left his garment in her hand, and fled, and got him out.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati o ri i pe Josefu jọwọ aṣọ rẹ̀ si i lọwọ, ti o si sá jade,
entries.en: And it came to pass, when she saw that he had left his garment in her hand, and was fled forth,

entries.yo: Nigbana li o kepè awọn ọkunrin ile rẹ̀, o si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ wò o, o mú Heberu kan wọle tọ̀ wa wá lati fi wa ṣe ẹlẹyà; o wọle tọ̀ mi wá lati bá mi ṣe, mo si kigbe li ohùn rara:
entries.en: That she called unto the men of her house, and spake unto them, saying, See, he hath brought in an Hebrew unto us to mock us; he came in unto me to lie with me, and I cried with a loud voice:

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati o gbọ́ pe mo gbé ohùn mi soke ti mo si kigbe, o jọwọ aṣọ rẹ̀ sọdọ mi, o si sá, o bọ sode.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when he heard that I lifted up my voice and cried, that he left his garment with me, and fled, and got him out.

entries.yo: O si fi aṣọ Josefu lelẹ li ẹba ọdọ rẹ̀, titi oluwa rẹ̀ fi bọ̀wá ile.
entries.en: And she laid up his garment by her, until his lord came home.

entries.yo: O si wi fun u bi ọ̀rọ wọnyi pe, Ẹrú Heberu ti iwọ mu tọ̀ wa, o wọle tọ̀ mi lati fi mi ṣe ẹlẹyà:
entries.en: And she spake unto him according to these words, saying, The Hebrew servant, which thou hast brought unto us, came in unto me to mock me:

entries.yo: O si ṣe, bi mo ti gbé ohùn mi soke ti mo si ké, o si jọwọ aṣọ rẹ̀ sọdọ mi, o si sá jade.
entries.en: And it came to pass, as I lifted up my voice and cried, that he left his garment with me, and fled out.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati oluwa rẹ̀ gbọ́ ọ̀rọ aya rẹ̀, ti o sọ fun u wipe, Bayibayi li ẹrú rẹ ṣe si mi; o binu gidigidi.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when his master heard the words of his wife, which she spake unto him, saying, After this manner did thy servant to me; that his wrath was kindled.

entries.yo: Oluwa Josefu si mú u, o si fi i sinu túbu, nibiti a gbé ndè awọn ara túbu ọba; o si wà nibẹ̀ ninu túbu.
entries.en: And Joseph's master took him, and put him into the prison, a place where the king's prisoners were bound: and he was there in the prison.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn OLUWA wà pẹlu Josefu, o si ṣãnu fun u, o si fun u li ojurere li oju onitúbu.
entries.en: But the LORD was with Joseph, and shewed him mercy, and gave him favour in the sight of the keeper of the prison.

entries.yo: Onitúbu si fi gbogbo awọn ara túbu ti o wà ninu túbu lé Josefu lọwọ; ohunkohun ti nwọn ba si ṣe nibẹ̀, on li oluṣe rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the keeper of the prison committed to Joseph's hand all the prisoners that were in the prison; and whatsoever they did there, he was the doer of it.

entries.yo: Onitúbu kò si bojuwò ohun kan ti o wà li ọwọ́ rẹ̀; nitori ti OLUWA wà pẹlu rẹ̀, ati ohun ti o ṣe OLUWA mú u dara.
entries.en: The keeper of the prison looked not to any thing that was under his hand; because the LORD was with him, and that which he did, the LORD made it to prosper.

entries.yo: O SI ṣe lẹhin nkan wọnyi, li agbọti ọba Egipti ati alasè rẹ̀ ṣẹ̀ ọba Egipti oluwa wọn.
entries.en: And it came to pass after these things, that the butler of the king of Egypt and his baker had offended their lord the king of Egypt.

entries.yo: Farao si binu si meji ninu awọn ijoye rẹ̀, si olori awọn agbọti, ati si olori awọn alasè.
entries.en: And Pharaoh was wroth against two of his officers, against the chief of the butlers, and against the chief of the bakers.

entries.yo: O si fi wọn sinu túbu ninu ile olori ẹṣọ́, sinu túbu ti a gbé dè Josefu si.
entries.en: And he put them in ward in the house of the captain of the guard, into the prison, the place where Joseph was bound.

entries.yo: Olori ẹṣọ́ na si fi Josefu jẹ́ olori wọn; o si nṣe itọju wọn: nwọn si pẹ diẹ ninu túbu na.
entries.en: And the captain of the guard charged Joseph with them, and he served them: and they continued a season in ward.

entries.yo: Awọn mejeji si lá alá kan, olukuluku lá alá tirẹ̀ li oru kanna, olukuluku bi itumọ̀ alá tirẹ̀, agbọti ati alasè ọba Egipti, ti a dè sinu túba na.
entries.en: And they dreamed a dream both of them, each man his dream in one night, each man according to the interpretation of his dream, the butler and the baker of the king of Egypt, which were bound in the prison.

entries.yo: Josefu si wọle tọ̀ wọn lọ li owurọ̀, o si wò wọn, si kiyesi i, nwọn fajuro.
entries.en: And Joseph came in unto them in the morning, and looked upon them, and, behold, they were sad.

entries.yo: O si bi awọn ijoye Farao ti o wà pẹlu rẹ̀ ninu ile túbu oluwa rẹ̀ pe, Ẽṣe ti oju nyin fi buru bẹ̃ loni?
entries.en: And he asked Pharaoh's officers that were with him in the ward of his lord's house, saying, Wherefore look ye so sadly to day?

entries.yo: Nwọn si wi fun u pe, Awa lá alá, kò si sí onitumọ̀ rẹ̀. Josefu si wi fun wọn pe, Ti Ọlọrun ki itumọ̀ iṣe ndan? emi bẹ̀ nyin, ẹ rọ́ wọn fun mi.
entries.en: And they said unto him, We have dreamed a dream, and there is no interpreter of it. And Joseph said unto them, Do not interpretations belong to God? tell me them, I pray you.

entries.yo: Olori agbọti si rọ́ alá tirẹ̀ fun Josefu, o si wi fun u pe, Li oju alá mi, kiyesi i, àjara kan wà niwaju mi,
entries.en: And the chief butler told his dream to Joseph, and said to him, In my dream, behold, a vine was before me;

entries.yo: Ati lara àjara na li ẹka mẹta wà; o si rudi, itana rẹ̀ si tú jade; ati ṣiri rẹ̀ si so eso-ájara ti o pọ́n.
entries.en: And in the vine were three branches: and it was as though it budded, and her blossoms shot forth; and the clusters thereof brought forth ripe grapes:

entries.yo: Ago Farao si wà li ọwọ́ mi: emi si mú eso-àjara na, mo si fún wọn sinu ago Farao, mo si fi ago na lé Farao lọwọ.
entries.en: And Pharaoh's cup was in my hand: and I took the grapes, and pressed them into Pharaoh's cup, and I gave the cup into Pharaoh's hand.

entries.yo: Josefu si wi fun u pe, Itumọ̀ rẹ̀ li eyi: ẹka mẹta nì, ijọ́ mẹta ni:
entries.en: And Joseph said unto him, This is the interpretation of it: The three branches are three days:

entries.yo: Ni ijọ́ mẹta oni, ni Farao yio gbe ori rẹ soke yio si mú ọ pada si ipò rẹ: iwọ o si fi ago lé Farao li ọwọ́ gẹgẹ bi ti ìgba iṣaju nigbati iwọ ti iṣe agbọti rẹ̀.
entries.en: Yet within three days shall Pharaoh lift up thine head, and restore thee unto thy place: and thou shalt deliver Pharaoh's cup into his hand, after the former manner when thou wast his butler.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ki o ranti mi nigbati o ba dara fun ọ, ki o si fi iṣeun rẹ hàn fun mi, emi bẹ̀ ọ, ki o si da orukọ mi fun Farao, ki o si mú mi jade ninu ile yi.
entries.en: But think on me when it shall be well with thee, and shew kindness, I pray thee, unto me, and make mention of me unto Pharaoh, and bring me out of this house:

entries.yo: Nitõtọ jíji li a jí mi tà lati ilẹ awọn Heberu wá: ati nihinyi pẹlu, emi kò ṣe nkan ti nwọn fi fi mi sinu ihò-túbu yi.
entries.en: For indeed I was stolen away out of the land of the Hebrews: and here also have I done nothing that they should put me into the dungeon.

entries.yo: Nigbati olori alasè ri pe itumọ̀ alá na dara, o si wi fun Josefu pe, Emi wà li oju-alá mi pẹlu, si kiyesi i, emi rù agbọ̀n àkara funfun mẹta li ori mi:
entries.en: When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was good, he said unto Joseph, I also was in my dream, and, behold, I had three white baskets on my head:

entries.yo: Ati ninu agbọ̀n ti o wà loke li onirũru onjẹ sisè wà fun Farao; awọn ẹiyẹ si njẹ ẹ ninu agbọ̀n na ti o wà li ori mi.
entries.en: And in the uppermost basket there was of all manner of bakemeats for Pharaoh; and the birds did eat them out of the basket upon my head.

entries.yo: Josefu si dahún o si wipe, itumọ̀ rẹ̀ li eyi: agbọ̀n mẹta nì, ijọ́ mẹta ni.
entries.en: And Joseph answered and said, This is the interpretation thereof: The three baskets are three days:

entries.yo: Ni ijọ́ mẹta oni ni Farao yio gbé ori rẹ kuro lara rẹ, yio si so ọ rọ̀ lori igi kan; awọn ẹiyẹ yio si ma jẹ ẹran ara rẹ kuro lara rẹ.
entries.en: Yet within three days shall Pharaoh lift up thy head from off thee, and shall hang thee on a tree; and the birds shall eat thy flesh from off thee.

entries.yo: O si ṣe ni ijọ́ kẹta, ti iṣe ọjọ́ ibí Farao, ti o sè àse fun awọn ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ̀ gbogbo: o si gbé ori olori agbọti soke ati ti olori awọn alasè lãrin awọn ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And it came to pass the third day, which was Pharaoh's birthday, that he made a feast unto all his servants: and he lifted up the head of the chief butler and of the chief baker among his servants.

entries.yo: O si tun mú olori agbọti pada si ipò rẹ̀; on si fi ago lé Farao li ọwọ́:
entries.en: And he restored the chief butler unto his butlership again; and he gave the cup into Pharaoh's hand:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn olori alasè li o sorọ̀: bi Josefu ti tumọ̀ alá na fun wọn.
entries.en: But he hanged the chief baker: as Joseph had interpreted to them.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn olori agbọti kò ranti Josefu, o gbagbe rẹ̀.
entries.en: Yet did not the chief butler remember Joseph, but forgat him.

entries.yo: O SI ṣe li opin ọdún meji ṣanṣan, ni Farao lá alá: si kiyesi i, o duro li ẹba odo.
entries.en: And it came to pass at the end of two full years, that Pharaoh dreamed: and, behold, he stood by the river.

entries.yo: Si kiyesi i abo-malu meje, ti o dara ni wiwò, ti o sanra, jade lati inu odò na wá: nwọn si njẹ ninu ẽsu-odò.
entries.en: And, behold, there came up out of the river seven well favoured kine and fatfleshed; and they fed in a meadow.

entries.yo: Si kiyesi i, abo-malu meje miran ti o buru ni wiwò, ti o si rù, jade lẹhin wọn lati inu odò na wá; nwọn si duro tì awọn abo-malu nì ni bèbe odò na.
entries.en: And, behold, seven other kine came up after them out of the river, ill favoured and leanfleshed; and stood by the other kine upon the brink of the river.

entries.yo: Awọn abo-malu ti o buru ni wiwò ti o si rù si mú awọn abo-malu meje ti o dara ni wiwò ti o si sanra wọnni jẹ. Bẹ̃ni Farao jí.
entries.en: And the ill favoured and leanfleshed kine did eat up the seven well favoured and fat kine. So Pharaoh awoke.

entries.yo: O si sùn, o si lá alá lẹrinkeji: si kiyesi i, ṣiri ọkà meje yọ lara igi ọkà kan, ti o kún ti o si dara.
entries.en: And he slept and dreamed the second time: and, behold, seven ears of corn came up upon one stalk, rank and good.

entries.yo: Si kiyesi i, ṣiri ọkà meje ti o fori, ti afẹfẹ íla-õrùn rẹ̀ dànu si rú jade lẹhin wọn.
entries.en: And, behold, seven thin ears and blasted with the east wind sprung up after them.

entries.yo: Ṣiri meje ti o fori si mú ṣiri meje daradara ti o kún nì jẹ. Farao si jí, si kiyesi i, alá ni.
entries.en: And the seven thin ears devoured the seven rank and full ears. And Pharaoh awoke, and, behold, it was a dream.

entries.yo: O si ṣe li owurọ̀, ti ọkàn rẹ̀ kò lelẹ; o si ranṣẹ o si pè gbogbo awọn amoye Egipti, ati gbogbo awọn ọ̀mọran ibẹ̀ wá: Farao si rọ́ alá rẹ̀ fun wọn: ṣugbọn kò sí ẹnikan ti o le tumọ wọn fun Farao.
entries.en: And it came to pass in the morning that his spirit was troubled; and he sent and called for all the magicians of Egypt, and all the wise men thereof: and Pharaoh told them his dream; but there was none that could interpret them unto Pharaoh.

entries.yo: Nigbana li olori agbọti wi fun Farao pe, Emi ranti ẹ̀ṣẹ mi loni:
entries.en: Then spake the chief butler unto Pharaoh, saying, I do remember my faults this day:

entries.yo: Farao binu si awọn ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ̀, o si fi mi sinu túbu ni ile-túbu olori ẹṣọ́, emi ati olori alasè:
entries.en: Pharaoh was wroth with his servants, and put me in ward in the captain of the guard's house, both me and the chief baker:

entries.yo: Awa si lá alá li oru kanna, emi ati on; awa lá alá olukuluku bi itumọ̀ alá tirẹ̀.
entries.en: And we dreamed a dream in one night, I and he; we dreamed each man according to the interpretation of his dream.

entries.yo: Ọdọmọkunrin kan ara Heberu, ọmọ-ọdọ olori ẹṣọ́, si wà nibẹ̀ pẹlu wa; awa si rọ́ wọn fun u, o si tumọ̀ alá wa fun wa, o tumọ̀ fun olukuluku gẹgẹ bi alá tirẹ̀.
entries.en: And there was there with us a young man, an Hebrew, servant to the captain of the guard; and we told him, and he interpreted to us our dreams; to each man according to his dream he did interpret.

entries.yo: O si ṣe bi o ti tumọ̀ fun wa, bẹ̃li o si ri; emi li o mú pada si ipò iṣẹ mi, on li o si sorọ̀.
entries.en: And it came to pass, as he interpreted to us, so it was; me he restored unto mine office, and him he hanged.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Farao ranṣẹ o si pè Josefu, nwọn si yara mú u jade kuro ninu ihò-túbu; o si fari rẹ̀, o si parọ̀ aṣọ rẹ̀, o si tọ̀ Farao wá.
entries.en: Then Pharaoh sent and called Joseph, and they brought him hastily out of the dungeon: and he shaved himself, and changed his raiment, and came in unto Pharaoh.

entries.yo: Farao sí wi fun Josefu pe, Emi lá alá, kò si si ẹnikan ti o le tumọ̀ rẹ̀: emi si gburó rẹ pe, bi iwọ ba gbọ́ alá, iwọ le tumọ̀ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, I have dreamed a dream, and there is none that can interpret it: and I have heard say of thee, that thou canst understand a dream to interpret it.

entries.yo: Josefu si da Farao li ohùn pe, Ki iṣe emi: Ọlọrun ni yio fi idahùn alafia fun Farao.
entries.en: And Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, It is not in me: God shall give Pharaoh an answer of peace.

entries.yo: Farao si wi fun Josefu pe, Li oju-alá mi, kiyesi i, emi duro lori bèbe odò.
entries.en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, In my dream, behold, I stood upon the bank of the river:

entries.yo: Si kiyesi i, abo-malu meje ti o sanra, ti o si dara lati wò, jade lati inu odò na wa; nwọn si njẹ ni ẽsu-odò:
entries.en: And, behold, there came up out of the river seven kine, fatfleshed and well favoured; and they fed in a meadow:
