entries.yo: Si kiyesi i, abo-malu meje miran ti o joro, ti o burujù ni wiwò, ti o si rù, jade soke lẹhin wọn, nwọn buru tobẹ̃ ti emi kò ri irú wọn rí ni ilẹ Egipti.
entries.en: And, behold, seven other kine came up after them, poor and very ill favoured and leanfleshed, such as I never saw in all the land of Egypt for badness:

entries.yo: Awọn abo-malu ti o rù, ti nwọn si buru ni wiwò, nwọn mú awọn abo-malu meje sisanra iṣaju wọnni jẹ:
entries.en: And the lean and the ill favoured kine did eat up the first seven fat kine:

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si jẹ wọn tán, a kò le mọ̀ pe, nwọn ti jẹ wọn: nwọn si buru ni wiwò sibẹ̀ gẹgẹ bi ìgba iṣaju. Bẹ̃ni mo jí.
entries.en: And when they had eaten them up, it could not be known that they had eaten them; but they were still ill favoured, as at the beginning. So I awoke.

entries.yo: Mo si ri li oju-alá mi, si kiyesi i, ṣiri ọkà meje jade lara igi ọkà kan, o kún o si dara:
entries.en: And I saw in my dream, and, behold, seven ears came up in one stalk, full and good:

entries.yo: Si kiyesi i, ṣiri ọkà meje rirẹ̀, ti o si fori, ati ti ẹfũfu ìla-õrùn rẹ̀ dànu, o rú jade lẹhin wọn:
entries.en: And, behold, seven ears, withered, thin, and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them:

entries.yo: Awọn ṣiri ti o fori si mú awọn ṣiri rere meje nì jẹ; mo si rọ́ ọ fun awọn amoye; ṣugbọn kò sí ẹniti o le sọ ọ fun mi.
entries.en: And the thin ears devoured the seven good ears: and I told this unto the magicians; but there was none that could declare it to me.

entries.yo: Josefu si wi fun Farao pe, Ọkan li alá Farao: Ọlọrun ti fi ohun ti on mbọ̀wá iṣe hàn fun Farao.
entries.en: And Joseph said unto Pharaoh, The dream of Pharaoh is one: God hath shewed Pharaoh what he is about to do.

entries.yo: Awọn abo-malu daradara meje nì, ọdún meje ni: ati ṣiri daradara meje nì, ọdún meje ni: ọkan li alá na.
entries.en: The seven good kine are seven years; and the seven good ears are seven years: the dream is one.

entries.yo: Ati awọn abo-malu meje nì ti o rù ti o si buru ni wiwò ti nwọn jade soke lẹhin wọn, ọdún meje ni; ati ṣiri ọkà meje ti o fori nì, ti ẹfũfu ìla-õrùn rẹ̀ dànu nì, ọdún meje ìyan ni yio jasi.
entries.en: And the seven thin and ill favoured kine that came up after them are seven years; and the seven empty ears blasted with the east wind shall be seven years of famine.

entries.yo: Eyi li ohun ti mo ti wi fun Farao pe, ohun ti Ọlọrun mbọ̀wá iṣe, o ti fihàn fun Farao.
entries.en: This is the thing which I have spoken unto Pharaoh: What God is about to do he sheweth unto Pharaoh.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, ọdún meje ọ̀pọ mbọ̀ já gbogbo ilẹ Egipti:
entries.en: Behold, there come seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt:

entries.yo: Lẹhin wọn ọdún meje ìyan si mbọ̀; gbogbo ọ̀pọ nì li a o si gbagbe ni ilẹ Egipti; ìyan na yio si run ilẹ;
entries.en: And there shall arise after them seven years of famine; and all the plenty shall be forgotten in the land of Egypt; and the famine shall consume the land;

entries.yo: A ki yio si mọ̀ ọ̀pọ na mọ́ ni ilẹ nitori ìyan na ti yio tẹle e, nitori yio mú gidigidi.
entries.en: And the plenty shall not be known in the land by reason of that famine following; for it shall be very grievous.

entries.yo: Nitorina li alá na ṣe dìlu ni meji fun Farao; nitoripe lati ọdọ Ọlọrun li a ti fi idi ọ̀ran na mulẹ, Ọlọrun yio si mú u ṣẹ kánkan.
entries.en: And for that the dream was doubled unto Pharaoh twice; it is because the thing is established by God, and God will shortly bring it to pass.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, ki Farao ki o wò amoye ati ọlọgbọ́n ọkunrin kan, ki o si fi i ṣe olori ilẹ Egipti.
entries.en: Now therefore let Pharaoh look out a man discreet and wise, and set him over the land of Egypt.

entries.yo: Ki Farao ki o ṣe eyi, ki o si yàn awọn alabojuto si ilẹ yi, ki nwọn ki o si gbà idamarun ni ilẹ Egipti li ọdún meje ọ̀pọ nì.
entries.en: Let Pharaoh do this, and let him appoint officers over the land, and take up the fifth part of the land of Egypt in the seven plenteous years.

entries.yo: Ki nwọn ki o si kó gbogbo onjẹ ọdún meje rere nì ti o dé, ki nwọn ki o si tò ọkà jọ si ọwọ́ Farao, ki nwọn ki o si pa onjẹ mọ́ ni ilu wọnni.
entries.en: And let them gather all the food of those good years that come, and lay up corn under the hand of Pharaoh, and let them keep food in the cities.

entries.yo: Onjẹ na ni yio si ṣe isigbẹ fun ilẹ dè ọdún meje ìyan na, ti mbọ̀wá si ilẹ Egipti; ki ilẹ ki o má ba run nitori ìyan na.
entries.en: And that food shall be for store to the land against the seven years of famine, which shall be in the land of Egypt; that the land perish not through the famine.

entries.yo: Ohun na si dara li oju Farao, ati li oju gbogbo awọn ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the thing was good in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of all his servants.

entries.yo: Farao si wi fun awọn ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ̀ pe, A ha le ri ẹnikan bi irú eyi, ọkunrin ti Ẹmi Ọlọrun mbẹ ninu rẹ̀?
entries.en: And Pharaoh said unto his servants, Can we find such a one as this is, a man in whom the Spirit of God is?

entries.yo: Farao si wi fun Josefu pe, Niwọnbi Ọlọrun ti fi gbogbo nkan yi hàn ọ, kò sí ẹniti o ṣe amoye ati ọlọgbọ́n bi iwọ:
entries.en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Forasmuch as God hath shewed thee all this, there is none so discreet and wise as thou art:

entries.yo: Iwọ ni yio ṣe olori ile mi, gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ rẹ li a o si ma ṣe akoso awọn enia mi: itẹ́ li emi o fi tobi jù ọ lọ:
entries.en: Thou shalt be over my house, and according unto thy word shall all my people be ruled: only in the throne will I be greater than thou.

entries.yo: Farao si wi fun Josefu pe, Wò o, emi fi ọ jẹ́ olori gbogbo ilẹ Egipti.
entries.en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, See, I have set thee over all the land of Egypt.

entries.yo: Farao si bọ́ oruka ọwọ́ rẹ̀ kuro, o si fi bọ̀ Josefu li ọwọ́, o si wọ̀ ọ li aṣọ ọ̀gbọ daradara, o si fi ẹ̀wọn wurà si i li ọrùn;
entries.en: And Pharaoh took off his ring from his hand, and put it upon Joseph's hand, and arrayed him in vestures of fine linen, and put a gold chain about his neck;

entries.yo: O si mu u gùn kẹkẹ́ keji ti o ní; nwọn si nké niwaju rẹ̀ pe, Kabiyesi: o si fi i jẹ́ olori gbogbo ilẹ Egipti.
entries.en: And he made him to ride in the second chariot which he had; and they cried before him, Bow the knee: and he made him ruler over all the land of Egypt.

entries.yo: Farao si wi fun Josefu pe, Emi ni Farao, lẹhin rẹ ẹnikẹni kò gbọdọ gbé ọwọ́ tabi ẹsẹ̀ soke ni gbogbo ilẹ Egipti.
entries.en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, I am Pharaoh, and without thee shall no man lift up his hand or foot in all the land of Egypt.

entries.yo: Farao si sọ orukọ Josefu ni Safnati-paanea; o si fi Asenati fun u li aya, ọmọbinrin Potifera, alufa Oni. Josefu si jade lọ si ori ilẹ Egipti.
entries.en: And Pharaoh called Joseph's name Zaphnath-paaneah; and he gave him to wife Asenath the daughter of Poti-pherah priest of On. And Joseph went out over all the land of Egypt.

entries.yo: Josefu si jẹ́ ẹni ọgbọ̀n ọdún nigbati o duro niwaju Farao ọba Egipti. Josefu si jade kuro niwaju Farao, o si là gbogbo ilẹ Egipti já.
entries.en: And Joseph was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt. And Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh, and went throughout all the land of Egypt.

entries.yo: Li ọdún meje ọ̀pọ nì, ilẹ si so eso ni ikunwọ-ikunwọ.
entries.en: And in the seven plenteous years the earth brought forth by handfuls.

entries.yo: O si kó gbogbo onjẹ ọdún meje nì jọ, ti o wà ni ilẹ Egipti, o si fi onjẹ na ṣura ni ilu wọnni: onjẹ oko ilu ti o yi i ká, on li o kójọ sinu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he gathered up all the food of the seven years, which were in the land of Egypt, and laid up the food in the cities: the food of the field, which was round about every city, laid he up in the same.

entries.yo: Josefu si kó ọkà jọ bi iyanrin okun lọ̀pọlọpọ; titi o fi dẹkun ati mã ṣirò; nitori ti kò ní iye.
entries.en: And Joseph gathered corn as the sand of the sea, very much, until he left numbering; for it was without number.

entries.yo: A si bí ọmọkunrin meji fun Josefu, ki ọdún ìyan na ki o to dé, ti Asenati bí fun u, ọmọbinrin Potifera, alufa Oni.
entries.en: And unto Joseph were born two sons before the years of famine came, which Asenath the daughter of Poti-pherah priest of On bare unto him.

entries.yo: Josefu si sọ orukọ akọ́bi ni Manasse: wipe, Nitori ti Ọlọrun mu mi gbagbe gbogbo iṣẹ́ mi, ati gbogbo ile baba mi.
entries.en: And Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh: For God, said he, hath made me forget all my toil, and all my father's house.

entries.yo: Orukọ ekeji li o si sọ ni Efraimu: nitori Ọlọrun ti mu mi bisi i ni ilẹ ipọnju mi.
entries.en: And the name of the second called he Ephraim: For God hath caused me to be fruitful in the land of my affliction.

entries.yo: Ọdún meje ọ̀pọ na ti o wà ni ilẹ Egipti si pari.
entries.en: And the seven years of plenteousness, that was in the land of Egypt, were ended.

entries.yo: Ọdún meje ìyan si bẹ̀rẹ si dé, gẹgẹ bi Josefu ti wi: ìyan na si mú ni ilẹ gbogbo; ṣugbọn ni gbogbo ilẹ Egipti li onjẹ gbé wà.
entries.en: And the seven years of dearth began to come, according as Joseph had said: and the dearth was in all lands; but in all the land of Egypt there was bread.

entries.yo: Nigbati ìyan mú ni gbogbo ilẹ Egipti, awọn enia kigbe onjẹ tọ̀ Farao: Farao si wi fun gbogbo awọn ara Egipti pe, Ẹ ma tọ̀ Josefu lọ; ohunkohun ti o ba wi fun nyin ki ẹ ṣe.
entries.en: And when all the land of Egypt was famished, the people cried to Pharaoh for bread: and Pharaoh said unto all the Egyptians, Go unto Joseph; what he saith to you, do.

entries.yo: Ìyan na si wà lori ilẹ gbogbo: Josefu si ṣí gbogbo ile iṣura silẹ, o si ntà fun awọn ara Egipti; ìyan na si nmú si i ni ilẹ Egipti.
entries.en: And the famine was over all the face of the earth: and Joseph opened all the storehouses, and sold unto the Egyptians; and the famine waxed sore in the land of Egypt.

entries.yo: Ilẹ gbogbo li o si wá si Egipti lati rà onjẹ lọdọ Josefu; nitori ti ìyan na mú gidigidi ni ilẹ gbogbo.
entries.en: And all countries came into Egypt to Joseph for to buy corn; because that the famine was so sore in all lands.

entries.yo: NIGBATI Jakobu si ri pe ọkà wà ni Egipti, Jakobu wi fun awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ pe, Eṣe ti ẹnyin fi nwò ara nyin li oju?
entries.en: Now when Jacob saw that there was corn in Egypt, Jacob said unto his sons, Why do ye look one upon another?

entries.yo: O si wipe, Wò o, mo gbọ́ pe ọkà mbẹ ni Egipti: ẹ sọkalẹ lọ sibẹ̀, ki ẹ si rà fun wa lati ibẹ̀ wá; ki awa ki o le yè, ki a máṣe kú.
entries.en: And he said, Behold, I have heard that there is corn in Egypt: get you down thither, and buy for us from thence; that we may live, and not die.

entries.yo: Awọn arakunrin Josefu mẹwẹwa si sọkalẹ lọ lati rà ọkà ni Egipti.
entries.en: And Joseph's ten brethren went down to buy corn in Egypt.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Jakobu kò rán Benjamini arakunrin Josefu pẹlu awọn arakunrin rẹ̀; nitori ti o wipe, Ki ibi ki o má ba bá a.
entries.en: But Benjamin, Joseph's brother, Jacob sent not with his brethren; for he said, Lest peradventure mischief befall him.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Israeli si wá irà ọkà ninu awọn ti o wá: nitori ìyan na mú ni ilẹ Kenaani.
entries.en: And the sons of Israel came to buy corn among those that came: for the famine was in the land of Canaan.

entries.yo: Josefu li o si ṣe balẹ ilẹ na, on li o ntà fun gbogbo awọn enia ilẹ na; awọn arakunrin Josefu si wá, nwọn si tẹ̀ ori wọn ba fun u, nwọn dojubolẹ.
entries.en: And Joseph was the governor over the land, and he it was that sold to all the people of the land: and Joseph's brethren came, and bowed down themselves before him with their faces to the earth.

entries.yo: Josefu si ri awọn arakunrin rẹ̀, o si mọ̀ wọn, ṣugbọn o fi ara rẹ̀ ṣe àjeji fun wọn, o si sọ̀rọ akọ si wọn: o si wi fun wọn pe, Nibo li ẹnyin ti wá? nwọn si wipe, Lati ilẹ Kenaani lati rà onjẹ.
entries.en: And Joseph saw his brethren, and he knew them, but made himself strange unto them, and spake roughly unto them; and he said unto them, Whence come ye? And they said, From the land of Canaan to buy food.

entries.yo: Josefu si mọ̀ awọn arakunrin rẹ̀, ṣugbọn awọn kò mọ̀ ọ.
entries.en: And Joseph knew his brethren, but they knew not him.

entries.yo: Josefu si ranti alá wọnni ti o ti lá si wọn, o si wi fun wọn pe, Amí li ẹnyin; lati ri ìhoho ilẹ yi li ẹnyin ṣe wá.
entries.en: And Joseph remembered the dreams which he dreamed of them, and said unto them, Ye are spies; to see the nakedness of the land ye are come.

entries.yo: Nwọn si wi fun u pe, Bẹ̃kọ, oluwa mi, ṣugbọn lati rà onjẹ li awọn iranṣẹ rẹ ṣe wá.
entries.en: And they said unto him, Nay, my lord, but to buy food are thy servants come.

entries.yo: Ọmọ ẹnikan na ni gbogbo wa iṣe; olõtọ enia li awa, awa iranṣẹ rẹ ki iṣe amí.
entries.en: We are all one man's sons; we are true men, thy servants are no spies.

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Bẹ̃kọ, ṣugbọn lati ri ìhoho ilẹ li ẹ ṣe wá.
entries.en: And he said unto them, Nay, but to see the nakedness of the land ye are come.

entries.yo: Nwọn si wipe, Arakunrin mejila li awa iranṣẹ rẹ, ọmọ ẹnikan na ni ilẹ Kenaani: si wò o, eyi abikẹhin si wà lọdọ baba wa loni-oloni, ọkan kò si sí.
entries.en: And they said, Thy servants are twelve brethren, the sons of one man in the land of Canaan; and, behold, the youngest is this day with our father, and one is not.

entries.yo: Josefu si wi fun wọn pe, On na li eyiti mo wi fun nyin pe, Amí li ẹnyin:
entries.en: And Joseph said unto them, That is it that I spake unto you, saying, Ye are spies:

entries.yo: Eyi bayi li a o fi ridi nyin, nipa ẹmi Farao bi ẹnyin o ti lọ nihin, bikoṣepe arakunrin abikẹhin nyin wá ihinyi.
entries.en: Hereby ye shall be proved: By the life of Pharaoh ye shall not go forth hence, except your youngest brother come hither.

entries.yo: Ẹ rán ẹnikan ninu nyin, ki o si mú arakunrin nyin wá, a o si pa nyin mọ́ ninu túbu, ki a le ridi ọ̀rọ nyin, bi otitọ wà ninu nyin: bikoṣe bẹ̃, ẹmi Farao bi amí ki ẹnyin iṣe.
entries.en: Send one of you, and let him fetch your brother, and ye shall be kept in prison, that your words may be proved, whether there be any truth in you: or else by the life of Pharaoh surely ye are spies.

entries.yo: O si kó gbogbo wọn pọ̀ sinu túbu ni ijọ́ mẹta.
entries.en: And he put them all together into ward three days.

entries.yo: Josefu si wi fun wọn ni ijọ́ kẹta pe, Ẹ ṣe eyi ki ẹ si yè; nitori emi bẹ̀ru Ọlọrun.
entries.en: And Joseph said unto them the third day, This do, and live; for I fear God:

entries.yo: Bi ẹnyin ba ṣe olõtọ enia, ki a mú ọkan ninu awọn arakunrin nyin dè ni ile túbu nyin: ẹ lọ, ẹ mú ọkà lọ nitori ìyan ile nyin.
entries.en: If ye be true men, let one of your brethren be bound in the house of your prison: go ye, carry corn for the famine of your houses:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹ mú arakunrin nyin abikẹhin fun mi wá; bẹ̃li a o si mọ̀ ọ̀rọ nyin li otitọ, ẹ ki yio si kú. Nwọn si ṣe bẹ̃.
entries.en: But bring your youngest brother unto me; so shall your words be verified, and ye shall not die. And they did so.

entries.yo: Nwọn si wi fun ara wọn pe, Awa jẹbi nitõtọ nipa ti arakunrin wa, niti pe, a ri àrokan ọkàn rẹ̀, nigbati o bẹ̀ wa, awa kò si fẹ́ igbọ́; nitorina ni iyọnu yi ṣe bá wa.
entries.en: And they said one to another, We are verily guilty concerning our brother, in that we saw the anguish of his soul, when he besought us, and we would not hear; therefore is this distress come upon us.

entries.yo: Reubeni si da wọn li ohùn pe, Emi kò wi fun nyin pe, Ẹ máṣe ṣẹ̀ si ọmọde na; ẹ kò si fẹ̀ igbọ́? si wò o, nisisiyi, a mbère ẹ̀jẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Reuben answered them, saying, Spake I not unto you, saying, Do not sin against the child; and ye would not hear? therefore, behold, also his blood is required.

entries.yo: Nwọn kò si mọ̀ pe Josefu gbède wọn; nitori gbedegbẹyọ li o fi mba wọn sọ̀rọ.
entries.en: And they knew not that Joseph understood them; for he spake unto them by an interpreter.

entries.yo: O si yipada kuro lọdọ wọn, o si sọkun; o si tun pada tọ̀ wọn wá, o si bá wọn sọ̀rọ, o si mú Ṣimeoni ninu wọn, o si dè e li oju wọn.
entries.en: And he turned himself about from them, and wept; and returned to them again, and communed with them, and took from them Simeon, and bound him before their eyes.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Josefu paṣẹ ki nwọn fi ọkà kún inu àpo wọn, ki nwọn si mú owo olukuluku pada sinu àpo rẹ̀, ki nwọn ki o si fun wọn li onjẹ ọ̀na; bayi li o si ṣe fun wọn.
entries.en: Then Joseph commanded to fill their sacks with corn, and to restore every man's money into his sack, and to give them provision for the way: and thus did he unto them.

entries.yo: Nwọn si dì ọkà lé kẹtẹkẹtẹ wọn, nwọn si lọ kuro nibẹ̀.
entries.en: And they laded their asses with the corn, and departed thence.

entries.yo: Bi ọkan ninu wọn si ti tú àpo rẹ̀ ni ile-èro lati fun kẹtẹkẹtẹ rẹ̀ li onjẹ, o kofiri owo rẹ̀; si wò o, o wà li ẹnu àpo rẹ̀.
entries.en: And as one of them opened his sack to give his ass provender in the inn, he espied his money; for, behold, it was in his sack's mouth.

entries.yo: O si wi fun awọn arakunrin rẹ̀ pe, Nwọn mú owo mi pada; si wò o, o tilẹ wà li àpo mi: àiya si fò wọn, ẹ̀ru si bà wọn, nwọn nwi fun ara wọn pe, Kili eyiti Ọlọrun ṣe si wa yi?
entries.en: And he said unto his brethren, My money is restored; and, lo, it is even in my sack: and their heart failed them, and they were afraid, saying one to another, What is this that God hath done unto us?

entries.yo: Nwọn si dé ọdọ Jakobu baba wọn ni ilẹ Kenaani, nwọn si ròhin ohun gbogbo ti o bá wọn fun u wipe,
entries.en: And they came unto Jacob their father unto the land of Canaan, and told him all that befell unto them; saying,

entries.yo: Ọkunrin na ti iṣe oluwa ilẹ na, sọ̀rọ lile si wa, o si fi wa pè amí ilẹ na.
entries.en: The man, who is the lord of the land, spake roughly to us, and took us for spies of the country.

entries.yo: A si wi fun u pe, Olõtọ, enia li awa; awa ki iṣe amí:
entries.en: And we said unto him, We are true men; we are no spies:

entries.yo: Arakunrin mejila li awa, ọmọ baba wa; ọkan kò sí, abikẹhin si wà lọdọ baba wa ni ilẹ Kenaani loni-oloni.
entries.en: We be twelve brethren, sons of our father; one is not, and the youngest is this day with our father in the land of Canaan.

entries.yo: Ọkunrin na, oluwa ilẹ na, si wi fun wa pe, Nipa eyi li emi o fi mọ̀ pe olõtọ enia li ẹnyin; ẹ fi ọkan ninu awọn arakunrin nyin silẹ lọdọ mi, ki ẹ si mú onjẹ nitori ìyan ile nyin, ki ẹ si ma lọ.
entries.en: And the man, the lord of the country, said unto us, Hereby shall I know that ye are true men; leave one of your brethren here with me, and take food for the famine of your households, and be gone:

entries.yo: Ẹ si mú arakunrin nyin abikẹhin nì tọ̀ mi wá: nigbana li emi o mọ̀ pe ẹnyin ki iṣe amí, bikoṣe olõtọ enia: emi o si fi arakunrin nyin lé nyin lọwọ, ẹnyin o si ma ṣòwo ni ilẹ yi.
entries.en: And bring your youngest brother unto me: then shall I know that ye are no spies, but that ye are true men: so will I deliver you your brother, and ye shall traffick in the land.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, bi nwọn ti ndà àpo wọn, wò o, ìdi owo olukuluku wà ninu àpo rẹ̀: nigbati awọn ati baba wọn si ri ìdi owo wọnni, ẹ̀ru bà wọn.
entries.en: And it came to pass as they emptied their sacks, that, behold, every man's bundle of money was in his sack: and when both they and their father saw the bundles of money, they were afraid.

entries.yo: Jakobu baba wọn si wi fun wọn pe, Emi li ẹnyin gbà li ọmọ: Josefu kò sí; Simeoni kò si sí; ẹ si nfẹ́ mú Benjamini lọ: lara mi ni gbogbo nkan wọnyi pọ̀ si.
entries.en: And Jacob their father said unto them, Me have ye bereaved of my children: Joseph is not, and Simeon is not, and ye will take Benjamin away: all these things are against me.

entries.yo: Reubeni si wi fun baba rẹ̀ pe, Pa ọmọ mi mejeji bi emi kò ba mú u fun ọ wá: fi i lé mi lọwọ, emi o si mú u pada fun ọ wá.
entries.en: And Reuben spake unto his father, saying, Slay my two sons, if I bring him not to thee: deliver him into my hand, and I will bring him to thee again.

entries.yo: On si wipe, Ọmọ mi ki yio bá nyin sọkalẹ lọ; nitori arakunrin rẹ̀ ti kú, on nikan li o si kù: bi ibi ba bá a li ọ̀na ti ẹnyin nlọ, nigbana li ẹnyin o fi ibinujẹ mú ewú mi lọ si isà-okú.
entries.en: And he said, My son shall not go down with you; for his brother is dead, and he is left alone: if mischief befall him by the way in the which ye go, then shall ye bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave.

entries.yo: ÌYAN na si mú ni ilẹ na gidigidi.
entries.en: And the famine was sore in the land.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati nwọn jẹ ọkà ti nwọn ti múbọ̀ Egipti wá tán, baba wọn wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ tun lọ irà onjẹ diẹ fun wa wá.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when they had eaten up the corn which they had brought out of Egypt, their father said unto them, Go again, buy us a little food.

entries.yo: Judah si wi fun u pe, ọkunrin na tẹnumọ́ ọ gidigidi fun wa pe, Ẹnyin kò gbọdọ ri oju mi, bikoṣepe arakunrin nyin ba pẹlu nyin.
entries.en: And Judah spake unto him, saying, The man did solemnly protest unto us, saying, Ye shall not see my face, except your brother be with you.

entries.yo: Bi iwọ o ba rán arakunrin wa pẹlu wa, awa o sọkalẹ lọ lati rà onjẹ fun ọ:
entries.en: If thou wilt send our brother with us, we will go down and buy thee food:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi iwọ ki yio ba rán a, awa ki yio sọkalẹ lọ: nitoriti ọkunrin na wi fun wa pe, Ẹnyin ki yio ri oju mi, bikoṣe arakunrin nyin ba pẹlu nyin.
entries.en: But if thou wilt not send him, we will not go down: for the man said unto us, Ye shall not see my face, except your brother be with you.

entries.yo: Israeli si wipe, Ẽṣe ti ẹnyin fi hùwa buburu bẹ̃ si mi, ti ẹnyin fi wi fun ọkunrin na pe, ẹnyin ní arakunrin kan pẹlu?
entries.en: And Israel said, Wherefore dealt ye so ill with me, as to tell the man whether ye had yet a brother?

entries.yo: Nwọn si wipe, ọkunrin na bère timọtimọ niti awa tikara wa, ati niti ibatan wa, wipe, Baba nyin wà sibẹ̀? ẹnyin li arakunrin miran? awa si wi fun u bi ọ̀rọ wọnyi: awa o ti ṣe le mọ̀ daju pe yio wipe, Mú arakunrin nyin sọkalẹ wá?
entries.en: And they said, The man asked us straitly of our state, and of our kindred, saying, Is your father yet alive? have ye another brother? and we told him according to the tenor of these words: could we certainly know that he would say, Bring your brother down?

entries.yo: Judah si wi fun Israeli baba rẹ̀ pe, Rán ọdọmọde na ba mi lọ, awa o si dide, a o lọ; ki awa ki o le yè, ki a má si ṣe kú, ati awa ati iwọ, ati awọn ọmọ wẹrẹ wa.
entries.en: And Judah said unto Israel his father, Send the lad with me, and we will arise and go; that we may live, and not die, both we, and thou, and also our little ones.

entries.yo: Emi ni yio ṣe onigbọwọ rẹ̀: li ọwọ́ mi ni iwọ o bère rẹ̀; bi emi kò ba mú u pada fun ọ wá, ki nsi mu u duro niwaju rẹ, njẹ emi ni yio rù ẹbi na lailai.
entries.en: I will be surety for him; of my hand shalt thou require him: if I bring him not unto thee, and set him before thee, then let me bear the blame for ever:

entries.yo: Bikoṣepe bi awa ti nṣe ilọra, awa iba sa ti pada bọ̀ lẹrinkeji nisisiyi.
entries.en: For except we had lingered, surely now we had returned this second time.

entries.yo: Israeli baba wọn si wi fun wọn pe, Njẹ bi bẹ̃ ba ni, eyi ni ki ẹ ṣe, ẹ mú ninu ãyo eso ilẹ yi, sinu ohun-èlo nyin, ki ẹ si mú ọrẹ lọ fun ọkunrin na, ikunra diẹ, ati oyin diẹ, ati turari, ojia, eso pupa, ati eso almondi:
entries.en: And their father Israel said unto them, If it must be so now, do this; take of the best fruits in the land in your vessels, and carry down the man a present, a little balm, and a little honey, spices, and myrrh, nuts, and almonds:

entries.yo: Ki ẹ si mú owo miran li ọwọ́ nyin; ati owo ti a mú pada wá li ẹnu àpo nyin, ẹ si tun mú u li ọwọ́ lọ; bọya o le ṣe èṣi:
entries.en: And take double money in your hand; and the money that was brought again in the mouth of your sacks, carry it again in your hand; peradventure it was an oversight:

entries.yo: Ẹ mú arakunrin nyin pẹlu, ẹ si dide, ẹ tun pada tọ̀ ọkunrin na lọ:
entries.en: Take also your brother, and arise, go again unto the man:

entries.yo: Ki Ọlọrun Olodumare ki o si fun nyin li ãnu niwaju ọkunrin na, ki o le rán arakunrin nyin ọhún wá, ati Benjamini. Bi a ba gbà mi li ọmọ, a gbà mi li ọmọ.
entries.en: And God Almighty give you mercy before the man, that he may send away your other brother, and Benjamin. If I be bereaved of my children, I am bereaved.

entries.yo: Awọn ọkunrin na si mú ọrẹ na, nwọn si mú iṣẹ́po owo meji li ọwọ́ wọn, ati Benjamini; nwọn si dide, nwọn si sọkalẹ lọ si Egipti, nwọn si duro niwaju Josefu.
entries.en: And the men took that present, and they took double money in their hand, and Benjamin; and rose up, and went down to Egypt, and stood before Joseph.

entries.yo: Nigbati Josefu si ri Benjamini pẹlu wọn, o wi fun olori ile rẹ̀ pe, Mú awọn ọkunrin wọnyi rè ile, ki o si pa ẹran, ki o si pèse: nitori ti awọn ọkunrin wọnyi yio ba mi jẹun li ọjọkanri.
entries.en: And when Joseph saw Benjamin with them, he said to the ruler of his house, Bring these men home, and slay, and make ready; for these men shall dine with me at noon.

entries.yo: Ọkunrin na si ṣe bi Josefu ti wi; ọkunrin na si mú awọn ọkunrin na lọ si ile Josefu.
entries.en: And the man did as Joseph bade; and the man brought the men into Joseph's house.

entries.yo: Awọn ọkunrin na si mbẹ̀ru, nitori ti a mú wọn wá si ile Josefu; nwọn si wipe, Nitori owo ti a mú pada sinu àpo wa li akọ́wa li a ṣe mú wa wọle; ki o le fẹ wa lẹfẹ, ki o si le kọlù wa, ki o si le kó wa ṣe ẹrú ati awọn kẹtẹkẹtẹ wa.
entries.en: And the men were afraid, because they were brought into Joseph's house; and they said, Because of the money that was returned in our sacks at the first time are we brought in; that he may seek occasion against us, and fall upon us, and take us for bondmen, and our asses.

entries.yo: Nwọn si sunmọ iriju ile Josefu, nwọn si bá a sọ̀rọ li ẹnu-ọ̀na ile na,
entries.en: And they came near to the steward of Joseph's house, and they communed with him at the door of the house,

entries.yo: Nwọn si wipe, Alagba, nitõtọ li awa sọkalẹ wá ni iṣaju lati rà onjẹ:
entries.en: And said, O sir, we came indeed down at the first time to buy food:

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati awa dé ile-èro, ti awa tú àpo wa, si kiyesi i, owo olukuluku wà li ẹnu àpo rẹ̀, owo wa ni pípe ṣánṣan: awa si tun mú u li ọwọ́ pada wá.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when we came to the inn, that we opened our sacks, and, behold, every man's money was in the mouth of his sack, our money in full weight: and we have brought it again in our hand.

entries.yo: Owo miran li awa si mú li ọwọ́ wa sọkalẹ wá lati rà onjẹ: awa kò mọ̀ ẹniti o fi owo wa sinu àpo wa.
entries.en: And other money have we brought down in our hands to buy food: we cannot tell who put our money in our sacks.

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Alafia ni fun nyin, ẹ má bẹ̀ru: Ọlọrun nyin ati Ọlọrun baba nyin, li o fun nyin ni iṣura ninu àpo nyin: owo nyin dé ọwọ́ mi. O si mú Simeoni jade tọ̀ wọn wá.
entries.en: And he said, Peace be to you, fear not: your God, and the God of your father, hath given you treasure in your sacks: I had your money. And he brought Simeon out unto them.

entries.yo: Ọkunrin na si mú awọn ọkunrin na wá si ile Josefu, o si fun wọn li omi, nwọn si wẹ̀ ẹsẹ̀ wọn; o si fun awọn kẹtẹkẹtẹ wọn li ohun jijẹ.
entries.en: And the man brought the men into Joseph's house, and gave them water, and they washed their feet; and he gave their asses provender.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ti mú ọrẹ na silẹ dè atibọ̀ Josefu lọsán: nitori ti nwọn gbọ́ pe nwọn o jẹun nibẹ̀.
entries.en: And they made ready the present against Joseph came at noon: for they heard that they should eat bread there.

entries.yo: Nigbati Josefu si wọlé, nwọn si mú ọrẹ ti o wà li ọwọ́ wọn fun u wá sinu ile, nwọn si tẹriba fun u ni ilẹ.
entries.en: And when Joseph came home, they brought him the present which was in their hand into the house, and bowed themselves to him to the earth.

entries.yo: On si bère alafia wọn, o si wipe, Alafia ki baba nyin wà, arugbo na ti ẹnyin wi? o wà lãye sibẹ̀?
entries.en: And he asked them of their welfare, and said, Is your father well, the old man of whom ye spake? Is he yet alive?

entries.yo: Nwọn si dahun pe, Ara baba wa, iranṣẹ rẹ le, o wà sibẹ̀. Nwọn si tẹri wọn ba, nwọn si bù ọlá fun u.
entries.en: And they answered, Thy servant our father is in good health, he is yet alive. And they bowed down their heads, and made obeisance.

entries.yo: O si gbé oju rẹ̀ soke, o si ri Benjamini, aburo rẹ̀, ọmọ iya rẹ̀, o si wipe, Abikẹhin nyin na ti ẹnyin wi fun mi li eyi? o si wipe, Ki Ọlọrun ki o ṣe ojurere si ọ, ọmọ mi.
entries.en: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw his brother Benjamin, his mother's son, and said, Is this your younger brother, of whom ye spake unto me? And he said, God be gracious unto thee, my son.

entries.yo: Josefu si yara; nitori ti inu yọ́ ọ si aburo rẹ̀: o wá ibi ti yio gbé sọkun; o si bọ́ si iyẹwu, o si sọkun nibẹ̀.
entries.en: And Joseph made haste; for his bowels did yearn upon his brother: and he sought where to weep; and he entered into his chamber, and wept there.

entries.yo: O si bọju rẹ̀, o si jade; o si mú oju dá, o si wipe, Ẹ gbé onjẹ kalẹ.
entries.en: And he washed his face, and went out, and refrained himself, and said, Set on bread.

entries.yo: Nwọn si gbé tirẹ̀ kalẹ fun u lọ̀tọ, ati fun wọn lọ̀tọ, ati fun awọn ara Egipti ti o mbá a jẹun lọ̀tọ; nitori ti awọn ara Egipti kò gbọdọ bá awọn enia Heberu jẹun; nitori irira ni fun awọn ara Egipti.
entries.en: And they set on for him by himself, and for them by themselves, and for the Egyptians, which did eat with him, by themselves: because the Egyptians might not eat bread with the Hebrews; for that is an abomination unto the Egyptians.

entries.yo: Nwọn si joko niwaju rẹ̀, akọ́bi gẹgẹ bi ipò ibí rẹ̀, ati abikẹhin gẹgẹ bi ipò ewe rẹ̀: ẹnu si yà awọn ọkunrin na si ara wọn.
entries.en: And they sat before him, the firstborn according to his birthright, and the youngest according to his youth: and the men marvelled one at another.

entries.yo: O si bù onjẹ fun wọn lati iwaju rẹ̀ lọ: ṣugbọn onjẹ Benjamini jù ti ẹnikẹni wọn lẹrinmarun. Nwọn si mu, nwọn si bá a ṣe ariya.
entries.en: And he took and sent messes unto them from before him: but Benjamin's mess was five times so much as any of theirs. And they drank, and were merry with him.

entries.yo: O SI fi aṣẹ fun iriju ile rẹ̀, wipe, Fi onjẹ kún inu àpo awọn ọkunrin wọnyi, ìwọn ti nwọn ba le rù, ki o si fi owo olukuluku si ẹnu àpo rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he commanded the steward of his house, saying, Fill the men's sacks with food, as much as they can carry, and put every man's money in his sack's mouth.

entries.yo: Ki o si fi ago mi, ago fadaka nì, si ẹnu àpo abikẹhin, ati owo ọkà rẹ̀. O si ṣe gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ ti Josefu ti sọ.
entries.en: And put my cup, the silver cup, in the sack's mouth of the youngest, and his corn money. And he did according to the word that Joseph had spoken.

entries.yo: Bi ojúmọ si ti mọ́, a si rán awọn ọkunrin na lọ, awọn ati awọn kẹtẹkẹtẹ wọn.
entries.en: As soon as the morning was light, the men were sent away, they and their asses.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si jade kuro ni ilu na, ti nwọn kò si jìna, Josefu wi fun iriju rẹ̀ pe, Dide, lepa awọn ọkunrin na; nigbati iwọ ba si bá wọn, wi fun wọn pe, Ẽṣe ti ẹnyin fi fi buburu san rere?
entries.en: And when they were gone out of the city, and not yet far off, Joseph said unto his steward, Up, follow after the men; and when thou dost overtake them, say unto them, Wherefore have ye rewarded evil for good?

entries.yo: Ninu eyi ki oluwa mi ima mu, eyiti o si fi nmọ̀ran? ẹnyin ṣe buburu li eyiti ẹnyin ṣe yi.
entries.en: Is not this it in which my lord drinketh, and whereby indeed he divineth? ye have done evil in so doing.

entries.yo: O si lé wọn bá, o si sọ ọ̀rọ wọnyi fun wọn.
entries.en: And he overtook them, and he spake unto them these same words.

entries.yo: Nwọn si wi fun u pe, Ẽṣe ti oluwa mi fi sọ irú ọ̀rọ wọnyi? Ki a má ri pe awọn ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ ṣe bi irú nkan wọnyi.
entries.en: And they said unto him, Wherefore saith my lord these words? God forbid that thy servants should do according to this thing:

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, owo ti awa ri li ẹnu àpo wa, awa si tun mú pada fun ọ lati ilẹ Kenaani wá: bawo li awa o ṣe jí fadaka tabi wurà ninu ile oluwa rẹ?
entries.en: Behold, the money, which we found in our sacks' mouths, we brought again unto thee out of the land of Canaan: how then should we steal out of thy lord's house silver or gold?

entries.yo: Lọdọ ẹnikẹni ninu awọn iranṣẹ rẹ ti a ba ri i, ki o kú, ati awa pẹlu ki a di ẹrú oluwa mi.
entries.en: With whomsoever of thy servants it be found, both let him die, and we also will be my lord's bondmen.

entries.yo: O si wipe, Njẹ ki o si ri bẹ̃ gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ nyin: ẹniti a ba ri i li ọwọ́ rẹ̀ on ni yio di ẹrú mi, ẹnyin o si ṣe alailẹṣẹ.
entries.en: And he said, Now also let it be according unto your words; he with whom it is found shall be my servant; and ye shall be blameless.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni olukuluku nwọn yara sọ̀ àpo rẹ̀ kalẹ, olukuluku nwọn si tú àpo rẹ̀.
entries.en: Then they speedily took down every man his sack to the ground, and opened every man his sack.

entries.yo: O si nwá a kiri, o bẹ̀rẹ lati ẹgbọ́n wá, o si pin lọdọ abikẹhin: a si ri ago na ninu àpo Benjamini.
entries.en: And he searched, and began at the eldest, and left at the youngest: and the cup was found in Benjamin's sack.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni nwọn fà aṣọ wọn ya olukuluku si dì ẹrù lé kẹtẹkẹtẹ rẹ̀, nwọn si pada lọ si ilu.
entries.en: Then they rent their clothes, and laded every man his ass, and returned to the city.

entries.yo: Ati Judah ati awọn arakunrin rẹ̀ wá si ile Josefu; on sa wà nibẹ̀: nwọn si wolẹ niwaju rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Judah and his brethren came to Joseph's house; for he was yet there: and they fell before him on the ground.

entries.yo: Josefu si wi fun wọn pe, Iwa kili eyiti ẹnyin hù yi? ẹnyin kò mọ̀ pe irú enia bi emi a ma mọ̀ran nitõtọ?
entries.en: And Joseph said unto them, What deed is this that ye have done? wot ye not that such a man as I can certainly divine?

entries.yo: Judah si wipe, Kili a o wi fun oluwa mi? kili a o fọ̀? tabi awa o ti ṣe wẹ̀ ara wa mọ́? Ọlọrun ti hú ẹ̀ṣẹ awọn iranṣẹ rẹ jade: wò o, awa di ẹrú oluwa mi, ati awa, ati ẹniti a ri ago na li ọwọ́ rẹ̀ pẹlu.
entries.en: And Judah said, What shall we say unto my lord? what shall we speak? or how shall we clear ourselves? God hath found out the iniquity of thy servants: behold, we are my lord's servants, both we, and he also with whom the cup is found.

entries.yo: On si wipe, Ki a má ri pe emi o ṣe bẹ̃: ṣugbọn ọkunrin na li ọwọ́ ẹniti a ri ago na, on ni yio ṣe ẹrú mi; bi o ṣe ti ẹnyin, ẹ goke tọ̀ baba nyin lọ li alafia.
entries.en: And he said, God forbid that I should do so: but the man in whose hand the cup is found, he shall be my servant; and as for you, get you up in peace unto your father.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Judah sunmọ ọdọ rẹ̀, o si wipe, Oluwa mi, emi bẹ̀ ọ, jẹ ki iranṣẹ rẹ ki o sọ gbolohùn ọ̀rọ kan li eti oluwa mi, ki o máṣe binu si iranṣẹ rẹ; bi Farao tikalarẹ̀ ni iwọ sá ri.
entries.en: Then Judah came near unto him, and said, Oh my lord, let thy servant, I pray thee, speak a word in my lord's ears, and let not thine anger burn against thy servant: for thou art even as Pharaoh.

entries.yo: Oluwa mi bère lọwọ awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀, wipe, Ẹnyin ní baba, tabi arakunrin bi?
entries.en: My lord asked his servants, saying, Have ye a father, or a brother?

entries.yo: Awa si wi fun oluwa mi pe, Awa ní baba, arugbo, ati ọmọ kan li ogbologbo rẹ̀, abikẹhin; arakunrin rẹ̀ si kú, on nikanṣoṣo li o si kù li ọmọ iya rẹ̀, baba rẹ̀ si fẹ́ ẹ.
entries.en: And we said unto my lord, We have a father, an old man, and a child of his old age, a little one; and his brother is dead, and he alone is left of his mother, and his father loveth him.

entries.yo: Iwọ si wi fun awọn iranṣẹ rẹ pe, Mú u sọkalẹ tọ̀ mi wá, ki emi ki o le fi oju mi kàn a.
entries.en: And thou saidst unto thy servants, Bring him down unto me, that I may set mine eyes upon him.

entries.yo: Awa si wi fun oluwa mi pe, Ọdọmọde na kò le fi baba rẹ̀ silẹ: nitoripe bi o ba fi i silẹ, baba rẹ̀ yio kú.
entries.en: And we said unto my lord, The lad cannot leave his father: for if he should leave his father, his father would die.

entries.yo: Iwọ si wi fun awọn iranṣẹ rẹ pe, Ayaṣebi arakunrin nyin abikẹhin ba bá nyin sọkalẹ wá, ẹnyin ki yio ri oju mi mọ́.
entries.en: And thou saidst unto thy servants, Except your youngest brother come down with you, ye shall see my face no more.

entries.yo: O si ṣe nigbati awa goke tọ̀ baba mi iranṣẹ rẹ lọ, awa sọ̀rọ oluwa mi fun u.
entries.en: And it came to pass when we came up unto thy servant my father, we told him the words of my lord.

entries.yo: Baba wa si wipe, Ẹ tun lọ irà onjẹ diẹ fun wa wá.
entries.en: And our father said, Go again, and buy us a little food.

entries.yo: Awa si wipe, Awa kò le sọkalẹ lọ: bi arakunrin wa abikẹhin ba pẹlu wa, njẹ awa o sọkalẹ lọ; nitori ti awa ki o le ri oju ọkunrin na, bikoṣepe arakunrin wa abikẹhin ba pẹlu wa.
entries.en: And we said, We cannot go down: if our youngest brother be with us, then will we go down: for we may not see the man's face, except our youngest brother be with us.

entries.yo: Baba mi iranṣẹ rẹ si wi fun wa pe Ẹnyin mọ̀ pe aya mi bí ọmọ meji fun mi:
entries.en: And thy servant my father said unto us, Ye know that my wife bare me two sons:

entries.yo: Ọkan si ti ọdọ mi jade lọ, mo si wipe, Nitõtọ a fà a ya pẹrẹpẹrẹ; emi kò si ri i lati igbana wá:
entries.en: And the one went out from me, and I said, Surely he is torn in pieces; and I saw him not since:

entries.yo: Bi ẹnyin ba si mú eyi lọ lọwọ mi pẹlu, ti ibi kan si ṣe e, ibinujẹ li ẹnyin o fi mú ewú mi lọ si isà-okú.
entries.en: And if ye take this also from me, and mischief befall him, ye shall bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, nigbati mo ba dé ọdọ baba mi, iranṣẹ rẹ, ti ọmọde na kò si wà pẹlu wa; bẹ̃ni ẹmi rẹ̀ dìmọ́ ẹmi ọmọde na;
entries.en: Now therefore when I come to thy servant my father, and the lad be not with us; seeing that his life is bound up in the lad's life;

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, bi o ba ri pe ọmọde na kò pẹlu wa, yio kú: awọn iranṣẹ rẹ yio si fi ibinujẹ mú ewú baba wa iranṣẹ rẹ lọ si isà-okú.
entries.en: It shall come to pass, when he seeth that the lad is not with us, that he will die: and thy servants shall bring down the gray hairs of thy servant our father with sorrow to the grave.

entries.yo: Nitori iranṣẹ rẹ li o ṣe onigbọwọ ọmọde na fun baba mi wipe, Bi emi kò ba mú u tọ̀ ọ wá, emi ni o gbà ẹbi na lọdọ baba mi lailai.
entries.en: For thy servant became surety for the lad unto my father, saying, If I bring him not unto thee, then I shall bear the blame to my father for ever.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi emi bẹ̀ ọ, jẹ ki iranṣẹ rẹ ki o joko ni ipò ọmọde na li ẹrú fun oluwa mi; ki o si jẹ ki ọmọde na ki o bá awọn arakunrin rẹ̀ goke lọ.
entries.en: Now therefore, I pray thee, let thy servant abide instead of the lad a bondman to my lord; and let the lad go up with his brethren.

entries.yo: Nitori bi bawo li emi o fi goke tọ̀ baba mi lọ ki ọmọde na ki o ma wà pẹlu mi? ki emi má ba ri ibi ti mbọ̀wá bá baba mi.
entries.en: For how shall I go up to my father, and the lad be not with me? lest peradventure I see the evil that shall come on my father.

entries.yo: NIGBANA ni Josefu kò le mu oju dá mọ́ niwaju gbogbo awọn ti o duro tì i; o si kigbe pe, Ẹ mu ki gbogbo enia ki o jade kuro lọdọ mi. Ẹnikẹni kò si duro tì i, nigbati Josefu sọ ara rẹ̀ di mimọ̀ fun awọn arakunrin rẹ̀.
entries.en: Then Joseph could not refrain himself before all them that stood by him; and he cried, Cause every man to go out from me. And there stood no man with him, while Joseph made himself known unto his brethren.

entries.yo: O si sọkun kikan: ati awọn ara Egipti ati awọn ara ile Farao gbọ́.
entries.en: And he wept aloud: and the Egyptians and the house of Pharaoh heard.

entries.yo: Josefu si wi fun awọn arakunrin rẹ̀ pe, Emi ni Josefu; baba mi wà sibẹ̀? awọn arakunrin rẹ̀ kò si le da a lohùn; nitori ti ẹ̀ru bà wọn niwaju rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I am Joseph; doth my father yet live? And his brethren could not answer him; for they were troubled at his presence.

entries.yo: Josefu si wi fun awọn arakunrin rẹ̀ pe, Emi bẹ̀ nyin ẹ sunmọ ọdọ mi. Nwọn si sunmọ ọ. O si wi pe, Emi ni Josefu, arakunrin nyin, ti ẹnyin tà si Egipti.
entries.en: And Joseph said unto his brethren, Come near to me, I pray you. And they came near. And he said, I am Joseph your brother, whom ye sold into Egypt.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, ẹ máṣe binujẹ, ki ẹ má si ṣe binu si ara nyin, ti ẹnyin tà mi si ihin: nitori pe, Ọlọrun li o rán mi siwaju nyin lati gbà ẹmi là.
entries.en: Now therefore be not grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that ye sold me hither: for God did send me before you to preserve life.

entries.yo: Lati ọdún meji yi ni ìyan ti nmú ni ilẹ: o si tun kù ọdún marun si i, ninu eyiti a ki yio ni itulẹ tabi ikorè.
entries.en: For these two years hath the famine been in the land: and yet there are five years, in the which there shall neither be earing nor harvest.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si rán mi siwaju nyin lati da irú-ọmọ si fun nyin lori ilẹ, ati lati fi ìgbala nla gbà ẹmi nyin là.
entries.en: And God sent me before you to preserve you a posterity in the earth, and to save your lives by a great deliverance.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, ki iṣe ẹnyin li o rán mi si ihin, bikoṣe Ọlọrun: o si ti fi mi ṣe baba fun Farao, ati oluwa gbogbo ile rẹ̀, ati alakoso gbogbo ilẹ Egipti.
entries.en: So now it was not you that sent me hither, but God: and he hath made me a father to Pharaoh, and lord of all his house, and a ruler throughout all the land of Egypt.

entries.yo: Ẹ yara ki ẹ si goke tọ̀ baba mi lọ, ki ẹ si wi fun u pe, Bayi ni Josefu ọmọ rẹ wipe, Ọlọrun fi mi jẹ́ oluwa gbogbo Egipti: sọkalẹ tọ̀ mi wá, má si ṣe duro.
entries.en: Haste ye, and go up to my father, and say unto him, Thus saith thy son Joseph, God hath made me lord of all Egypt: come down unto me, tarry not:

entries.yo: Iwọ o si joko ni ilẹ Goṣeni, iwọ o si wà leti ọdọ mi, iwọ, ati awọn ọmọ rẹ, ati awọn ọmọ ọmọ rẹ, ati ọwọ-ẹran rẹ, ati ọwọ́-malu rẹ, ati ohun gbogbo ti iwọ ní.
entries.en: And thou shalt dwell in the land of Goshen, and thou shalt be near unto me, thou, and thy children, and thy children's children, and thy flocks, and thy herds, and all that thou hast:

entries.yo: Nibẹ̀ li emi o si ma bọ́ ọ; nitori ọdún ìyan kù marun si i; ki iwọ, ati awọn ara ile rẹ, ati ohun gbogbo ti iwọ ní, ki o má ba ri ipọnju.
entries.en: And there will I nourish thee; for yet there are five years of famine; lest thou, and thy household, and all that thou hast, come to poverty.

entries.yo: Si kiyesi i, oju nyin, ati oju Benjamini arakunrin mi ri pe, ẹnu mi li o nsọ̀rọ fun nyin.
entries.en: And, behold, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin, that it is my mouth that speaketh unto you.

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o si ròhin gbogbo ogo mi ni Egipti fun baba mi, ati ti ohun gbogbo ti ẹnyin ri; ki ẹnyin ki o si yara, ki ẹ si mú baba mi sọkalẹ wá ihin.
entries.en: And ye shall tell my father of all my glory in Egypt, and of all that ye have seen; and ye shall haste and bring down my father hither.

entries.yo: O si rọ̀mọ́ Benjamini arakunrin rẹ̀ li ọrùn, o si sọkun; Benjamini si sọkun li ọrùn rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he fell upon his brother Benjamin's neck, and wept; and Benjamin wept upon his neck.

entries.yo: O si fi ẹnu kò gbogbo awọn arakunrin rẹ̀ li ẹnu, o si sọkun si wọn lara: lẹhin eyini li awọn arakunrin rẹ̀ bá a sọ̀rọ.
entries.en: Moreover he kissed all his brethren, and wept upon them: and after that his brethren talked with him.

entries.yo: A si gbọ́ ìhin na ni ile Farao pe, awọn arakunrin Josefu dé: o si dùn mọ́ Farao ati awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the fame thereof was heard in Pharaoh's house, saying, Joseph's brethren are come: and it pleased Pharaoh well, and his servants.

entries.yo: Farao si wi fun Josefu pe, Wi fun awọn arakunrin rẹ, Eyi ni ki ẹ ṣe; ẹ dì ẹrù lé ẹranko nyin, ki ẹ si lọ si ilẹ Kenaani;
entries.en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Say unto thy brethren, This do ye; lade your beasts, and go, get you unto the land of Canaan;

entries.yo: Ẹ si mú baba nyin, ati awọn ara ile nyin, ki ẹ si tọ̀ mi wá; emi o si fun nyin li ohun rere ilẹ Egipti, ẹnyin o si ma jẹ ọrá ilẹ yi.
entries.en: And take your father and your households, and come unto me: and I will give you the good of the land of Egypt, and ye shall eat the fat of the land.

entries.yo: Njẹ a fun ọ li aṣẹ, eyi ni ki ẹ ṣe; ẹ mú kẹkẹ́-ẹrù lati ilẹ Egipti fun awọn ọmọ wẹrẹ nyin, ati fun awọn aya nyin, ki ẹ si mú baba nyin, ki ẹ si wá.
entries.en: Now thou art commanded, this do ye; take you wagons out of the land of Egypt for your little ones, and for your wives, and bring your father, and come.

entries.yo: Ẹ má si ṣe aniyàn ohun-èlo; nitori ohun rere gbogbo ilẹ Egipti ti nyin ni.
entries.en: Also regard not your stuff; for the good of all the land of Egypt is yours.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Israeli si ṣe bẹ̃: Josefu si fi kẹkẹ́-ẹrù fun wọn, gẹgẹ bi aṣẹ Farao, o si fi onjẹ ọ̀na fun wọn.
entries.en: And the children of Israel did so: and Joseph gave them wagons, according to the commandment of Pharaoh, and gave them provision for the way.

entries.yo: O fi ìparọ-aṣọ fun gbogbo wọn fun olukuluku wọn; ṣugbọn Benjamini li o fi ọdunrun owo fadaka fun, ati ìparọ-aṣọ marun.
entries.en: To all of them he gave each man changes of raiment; but to Benjamin he gave three hundred pieces of silver, and five changes of raiment.

entries.yo: Bayi li o si ranṣẹ si baba rẹ̀; kẹtẹkẹtẹ mẹwa ti o rù ohun rere Egipti, ati abo-kẹtẹkẹtẹ mẹwa ti o rù ọkà ati àkara ati onjẹ fun baba rẹ̀ li ọ̀na.
entries.en: And to his father he sent after this manner; ten asses laden with the good things of Egypt, and ten she asses laden with corn and bread and meat for his father by the way.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li o rán awọn arakunrin rẹ̀ lọ, nwọn si lọ: o si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ máṣe jà li ọ̀na.
entries.en: So he sent his brethren away, and they departed: and he said unto them, See that ye fall not out by the way.

entries.yo: Nwọn si goke lati ilẹ Egipti lọ, nwọn si dé ọdọ Jakobu baba wọn ni ilẹ Kenaani.
entries.en: And they went up out of Egypt, and came into the land of Canaan unto Jacob their father,

entries.yo: Nwọn si wi fun u pe, Josefu mbẹ lãye sibẹ̀, on si ni bãlẹ gbogbo ilẹ Egipti. O si rẹ̀ Jakobu dé inu nitori ti kò gbà wọn gbọ́.
entries.en: And told him, saying, Joseph is yet alive, and he is governor over all the land of Egypt. And Jacob's heart fainted, for he believed them not.

entries.yo: Nwọn si sọ ọ̀rọ Josefu gbogbo fun u, ti o wi fun wọn: nigbati o si ri kẹkẹ́-ẹrù ti Josefu rán wá lati fi mú u lọ, ọkàn Jakobu baba wọn sọji:
entries.en: And they told him all the words of Joseph, which he had said unto them: and when he saw the wagons which Joseph had sent to carry him, the spirit of Jacob their father revived:

entries.yo: Israeli si wipe, O tó; Josefu ọmọ mi mbẹ lãye sibẹ̀; emi o lọ ki nsi ri i ki emi ki o to kú.
entries.en: And Israel said, It is enough; Joseph my son is yet alive: I will go and see him before I die.

entries.yo: ISRAELI si mú ọ̀na àjo rẹ̀ pọ̀n ti on ti ohun gbogbo ti o ní, o si dé Beer-ṣeba, o si rú ẹbọ si Ọlọrun Isaaki baba rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Israel took his journey with all that he had, and came to Beer-sheba, and offered sacrifices unto the God of his father Isaac.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si bá Israeli sọ̀rọ li ojuran li oru, o si wipe, Jakobu, Jakobu. O si wipe, Emi niyi.
entries.en: And God spake unto Israel in the visions of the night, and said, Jacob, Jacob. And he said, Here am I.

entries.yo: O si wipe, Emi li Ọlọrun, Ọlọrun baba rẹ: má bẹ̀ru lati sọkalẹ lọ si ilẹ Egipti; nitori ibẹ̀ li emi o gbé sọ iwọ di orilẹ-ède nla.
entries.en: And he said, I am God, the God of thy father: fear not to go down into Egypt; for I will there make of thee a great nation:

entries.yo: Emi o si bá ọ sọkalẹ lọ si Egipti; emi o si mú ọ goke wá nitõtọ: Josefu ni yio si fi ọwọ́ rẹ̀ pa ọ li oju dé.
entries.en: I will go down with thee into Egypt; and I will also surely bring thee up again: and Joseph shall put his hand upon thine eyes.

entries.yo: Jakobu si dide lati Beer-ṣeba lọ: awọn ọmọ Israeli si mú Jakobu baba wọn lọ, ati awọn ọmọ wẹrẹ wọn, ati awọn aya wọn, ninu kẹkẹ́-ẹrù ti Farao rán lati mú u lọ.
entries.en: And Jacob rose up from Beer-sheba: and the sons of Israel carried Jacob their father, and their little ones, and their wives, in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.

entries.yo: Nwọn si mú ẹran wọn, ati ẹrù wọn, ti nwọn ní ni ilẹ Kenaani, nwọn si wá si Egipti, Jakobu, ati gbogbo irú-ọmọ rẹ̀ pẹlu rẹ̀:
entries.en: And they took their cattle, and their goods, which they had gotten in the land of Canaan, and came into Egypt, Jacob, and all his seed with him:

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, ati awọn ọmọ ọmọ rẹ̀ pẹlu rẹ̀, ati awọn ọmọbinrin rẹ̀, ati awọn ọmọbinrin awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, gbogbo irú-ọmọ rẹ̀ li o mú pẹlu rẹ̀ wá si ilẹ Egipti.
entries.en: His sons, and his sons' sons with him, his daughters, and his sons' daughters, and all his seed brought he with him into Egypt.

entries.yo: Wọnyi si li orukọ awọn ọmọ Israeli, ti o wá si Egipti, Jakobu ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀: Reubeni, akọ́bi Jakobu.
entries.en: And these are the names of the children of Israel, which came into Egypt, Jacob and his sons: Reuben, Jacob's firstborn.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Reubeni; Hanoku, ati Pallu, ati Hesroni, ati Karmi.
entries.en: And the sons of Reuben; Hanoch, and Phallu, and Hezron, and Carmi.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Simeoni; Jemueli, ati Jamini, ati Ohadi, ati Jakini, ati Sohari, ati Ṣaulu, ọmọ obinrin ara Kenaani kan.
entries.en: And the sons of Simeon; Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Lefi; Gerṣoni, Kohati, ati Merari.
entries.en: And the sons of Levi; Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Judah; Eri ati Onani, ati Ṣela, ati Peresi, ati Sera: ṣugbọn Eri on Onani ti kú ni ilẹ Kenaani. Ati awọn ọmọ Peresi ni Hesroni on Hamulu.
entries.en: And the sons of Judah; Er, and Onan, and Shelah, and Pharez, and Zerah: but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. And the sons of Pharez were Hezron and Hamul.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Issakari; Tola, ati Pufa, ati Jobu, ati Simroni.
entries.en: And the sons of Issachar; Tola, and Phuvah, and Job, and Shimron.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Sebuluni; Seredi, ati Eloni, ati Jaleeli.
entries.en: And the sons of Zebulun; Sered, and Elon, and Jahleel.

entries.yo: Awọn wọnyi li awọn ọmọ Lea, ti o bí fun Jakobu ni Padan-aramu, pẹlu Dina ọmọbinrin rẹ̀: gbogbo ọkàn awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ ọkunrin ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ obinrin, o jẹ́ mẹtalelọgbọ̀n.
entries.en: These be the sons of Leah, which she bare unto Jacob in Padan-aram, with his daughter Dinah: all the souls of his sons and his daughters were thirty and three.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Gadi; Sifioni, ati Haggi, Ṣuni, ati Esboni, Eri, ati Arodi, ati Areli.
entries.en: And the sons of Gad; Ziphion, and Haggi, Shuni, and Ezbon, Eri, and Arodi, and Areli.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Aṣeri; Jimna, ati Iṣua, ati Isui, ati Beria, ati Sera arabinrin wọn: ati awọn ọmọ Beria; Heberi, ati Malkieli.
entries.en: And the sons of Asher; Jimnah, and Ishuah, and Isui, and Beriah, and Serah their sister: and the sons of Beriah; Heber, and Malchiel.

entries.yo: Wọnyi li awọn ọmọ Silpa, ti Labani fi fun Lea ọmọbinrin rẹ̀, wọnyi li o si bí fun Jakobu, ọkàn mẹrindilogun.
entries.en: These are the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah his daughter, and these she bare unto Jacob, even sixteen souls.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Rakeli aya Jakobu; Josefu ati Benjamini.
entries.en: The sons of Rachel Jacob's wife; Joseph, and Benjamin.

entries.yo: Manasse ati Efraimu li a si bí fun Josefu ni ilẹ Egipti, ti Asenati ọmọbinrin Potifera alufa Oni bí fun u.
entries.en: And unto Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, which Asenath the daughter of Poti-pherah priest of On bare unto him.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Benjamini; Bela, ati Bekeri, ati Aṣbeli, Gera, ati Naamani, Ehi, ati Roṣi, Muppimu, ati Huppimu, ati Ardi.
entries.en: And the sons of Benjamin were Belah, and Becher, and Ashbel, Gera, and Naaman, Ehi, and Rosh, Muppim, and Huppim, and Ard.

entries.yo: Wọnyi li awọn ọmọ Rakeli, ti a bí fun Jakobu: gbogbo ọkàn na jẹ́ mẹrinla.
entries.en: These are the sons of Rachel, which were born to Jacob: all the souls were fourteen.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Dani; Huṣimu.
entries.en: And the sons of Dan; Hushim.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Naftali; Jahseeli, ati Guni, ati Jeseri, ati Ṣillemu.
entries.en: And the sons of Naphtali; Jahzeel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shillem.

entries.yo: Wọnyi si li awọn ọmọ Bilha, ti Labani fi fun Rakeli ọmọbinrin rẹ̀, o si bí wọnyi fun Jakobu: gbogbo ọkàn na jẹ́ meje.
entries.en: These are the sons of Bilhah, which Laban gave unto Rachel his daughter, and she bare these unto Jacob: all the souls were seven.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ọkàn ti o ba Jakobu wá si Egipti, ti o si ti inu Jakobu jade, li àika aya awọn ọmọ Jakobu, ọkàn na gbogbo jẹ́ mẹrindilãdọrin;
entries.en: All the souls that came with Jacob into Egypt, which came out of his loins, besides Jacob's sons' wives, all the souls were threescore and six;

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Josefu ti a bí fun u ni Egipti jẹ́ ọkàn meji; gbogbo ọkàn ile Jakobu, ti o wá si ilẹ Egipti jẹ́ ãdọrin ọkàn.
entries.en: And the sons of Joseph, which were born him in Egypt, were two souls: all the souls of the house of Jacob, which came into Egypt, were threescore and ten.

entries.yo: O si rán Judah siwaju rẹ̀ si Josefu ki o kọju wọn si Goṣeni; nwọn si dé ilẹ Goṣeni.
entries.en: And he sent Judah before him unto Joseph, to direct his face unto Goshen; and they came into the land of Goshen.

entries.yo: Josefu si dì kẹkẹ́ rẹ̀, o si lọ si Goṣeni lọ ipade Israeli baba rẹ̀, o si fi ara rẹ̀ hàn a; on si rọ̀ mọ́ ọ li ọrùn, o si sọkun si i li ọrùn pẹ titi.
entries.en: And Joseph made ready his chariot, and went up to meet Israel his father, to Goshen, and presented himself unto him; and he fell on his neck, and wept on his neck a good while.

entries.yo: Israeli si wi fun Josefu pe, Jẹ ki emi ki o kú wayi, bi mo ti ri oju rẹ yi, nitori ti iwọ wà lãye sibẹ̀.
entries.en: And Israel said unto Joseph, Now let me die, since I have seen thy face, because thou art yet alive.

entries.yo: Josefu si wi fun awọn arakunrin rẹ̀, ati fun awọn ara ile baba rẹ̀ pe, Emi o goke lọ, emi o si sọ fun Farao, emi o si wi fun u pe, Awọn arakunrin mi, ati awọn ara ile baba mi, ti o wà ni ilẹ Kenaani, nwọn tọ̀ mi wá;
entries.en: And Joseph said unto his brethren, and unto his father's house, I will go up, and shew Pharaoh, and say unto him, My brethren, and my father's house, which were in the land of Canaan, are come unto me;

entries.yo: Oluṣọ-agutan si li awọn ọkunrin na, ẹran sisìn ni iṣẹ wọn; nwọn si dà agbo-ẹran ati ọwọ́-ẹran wọn wá, ati ohun gbogbo ti nwọn ní.
entries.en: And the men are shepherds, for their trade hath been to feed cattle; and they have brought their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, nigbati Farao ba pè nyin, ti yio si bi nyin pe, Kini iṣẹ nyin?
entries.en: And it shall come to pass, when Pharaoh shall call you, and shall say, What is your occupation?

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o wipe, Òwo awọn iranṣẹ rẹ li ẹran sisìn lati ìgba ewe wa wá titi o fi di isisiyi, ati awa, ati awọn baba wa pẹlu: ki ẹnyin ki o le joko ni ilẹ Goṣeni; nitori irira li oluṣọ-agutan gbogbo si awọn ara Egipti.
entries.en: That ye shall say, Thy servants' trade hath been about cattle from our youth even until now, both we, and also our fathers: that ye may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd is an abomination unto the Egyptians.

entries.yo: NIGBANA ni Josefu wọle, o si sọ fun Farao, o si wipe, Baba mi, ati awọn arakunrin mi ati ọwọ́-ẹran wọn, ati ọwọ́-malu wọn, ati ohun gbogbo ti nwọn ní, nwọn ti ilẹ Kenaani wá; si kiyesi i, nwọn mbẹ ni ilẹ Goṣeni.
entries.en: Then Joseph came and told Pharaoh, and said, My father and my brethren, and their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have, are come out of the land of Canaan; and, behold, they are in the land of Goshen.

entries.yo: O si mú marun ninu awọn arakunrin rẹ̀, o si mu wọn duro niwaju Farao.
entries.en: And he took some of his brethren, even five men, and presented them unto Pharaoh.

entries.yo: Farao si bi awọn arakunrin rẹ̀ pe, Kini iṣẹ nyin? Nwọn si wi fun Farao pe, Oluṣọ-agutan li awọn iranṣẹ rẹ, ati awa, ati awọn baba wa pẹlu.
entries.en: And Pharaoh said unto his brethren, What is your occupation? And they said unto Pharaoh, Thy servants are shepherds, both we, and also our fathers.

entries.yo: Nwọn si wi fun Farao pẹlu pe, Nitori ati ṣe atipo ni ilẹ yi li awa ṣe wá; nitori awọn iranṣẹ rẹ kò ní papa-oko tutù fun ọwọ́-ẹran wọn; nitori ti ìyan yi mú gidigidi ni ilẹ Kenaani: njẹ nitorina awa bẹ̀ ọ, jẹ ki awọn iranṣẹ rẹ ki o joko ni ilẹ Goṣeni.
entries.en: They said moreover unto Pharaoh, For to sojourn in the land are we come; for thy servants have no pasture for their flocks; for the famine is sore in the land of Canaan: now therefore, we pray thee, let thy servants dwell in the land of Goshen.

entries.yo: Farao si wi fun Josefu pe, Baba rẹ ati awọn arakunrin rẹ tọ̀ ọ wá:
entries.en: And Pharaoh spake unto Joseph, saying, Thy father and thy brethren are come unto thee:

entries.yo: Ilẹ Egipti ni yi niwaju rẹ; ninu ãyo ilẹ ni ki o mu baba ati awọn arakunrin rẹ joko; jẹ ki nwọn ki o joko ni ilẹ Goṣeni: bi iwọ ba si mọ̀ ẹnikẹni ti o li ãpọn ninu wọn, njẹ ki iwọ ki o ṣe wọn li olori lori ẹran-ọsin mi.
entries.en: The land of Egypt is before thee; in the best of the land make thy father and brethren to dwell; in the land of Goshen let them dwell: and if thou knowest any men of activity among them, then make them rulers over my cattle.

entries.yo: Josefu si mú Jakobu baba rẹ̀ wọle wá, o si mu u duro niwaju Farao: Jakobu si sure fun Farao.
entries.en: And Joseph brought in Jacob his father, and set him before Pharaoh: and Jacob blessed Pharaoh.

entries.yo: Farao si bi Jakobu pe, Ọdún melo li ọjọ́ aiye rẹ?
entries.en: And Pharaoh said unto Jacob, How old art thou?

entries.yo: Jakobu si wi fun Farao pe, Ãdoje ọdún li ọjọ́ atipo mi: diẹ ti on ti buburu li ọdún ọjọ́ aiye mi jẹ́, nwọn kò si ti idé ọdún ọjọ́ aiye awọn baba mi li ọjọ́ atipo wọn.
entries.en: And Jacob said unto Pharaoh, The days of the years of my pilgrimage are an hundred and thirty years: few and evil have the days of the years of my life been, and have not attained unto the days of the years of the life of my fathers in the days of their pilgrimage.

entries.yo: Jakobu si sure fun Farao, o si jade kuro niwaju Farao.
entries.en: And Jacob blessed Pharaoh, and went out from before Pharaoh.

entries.yo: Josefu si fi baba rẹ̀ ati awọn arakunrin rẹ̀ joko, o si fun wọn ni iní ni ilẹ Egipti, ni ibi ãyo ilẹ, ni ilẹ Ramesesi, bi Farao ti pa li aṣẹ.
entries.en: And Joseph placed his father and his brethren, and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt, in the best of the land, in the land of Rameses, as Pharaoh had commanded.

entries.yo: Josefu si fi onjẹ bọ́ baba rẹ̀, ati awọn arakunrin rẹ̀, ati gbogbo ile baba rẹ̀ gẹgẹ bi iye awọn ọmọ wọn.
entries.en: And Joseph nourished his father, and his brethren, and all his father's household, with bread, according to their families.

entries.yo: Onjẹ kò si sí ni gbogbo ilẹ; nitori ti ìyan na mú gidigidi, tobẹ̃ ti ilẹ Egipti ati gbogbo ilẹ Kenaani gbẹ nitori ìyan na.
entries.en: And there was no bread in all the land; for the famine was very sore, so that the land of Egypt and all the land of Canaan fainted by reason of the famine.

entries.yo: Josefu si kó gbogbo owo ti a ri ni ilẹ Egipti ati ni ilẹ Kenaani jọ, fun ọkà ti nwọn rà: Josefu si kó owo na wá si ile Farao.
entries.en: And Joseph gathered up all the money that was found in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, for the corn which they bought: and Joseph brought the money into Pharaoh's house.

entries.yo: Nigbati owo si tán ni ilẹ Egipti, ati ni ilẹ Kenaani, gbogbo awọn ara Egipti tọ̀ Josefu wá, nwọn si wipe, Fun wa li onjẹ: nitori kili awa o ṣe kú li oju rẹ? owo sa tán.
entries.en: And when money failed in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, all the Egyptians came unto Joseph, and said, Give us bread: for why should we die in thy presence? for the money faileth.

entries.yo: Josefu si wipe, Ẹ mú ẹran nyin wá, emi o si fun nyin li onjẹ dipò ẹran nyin, bi owo ba tán.
entries.en: And Joseph said, Give your cattle; and I will give you for your cattle, if money fail.

entries.yo: Nwọn si mú ẹran wọn tọ̀ Josefu wá: Josefu si fun wọn li onjẹ dipò ẹṣin, ati ọwọ́-ẹran, ati dipò ọwọ́-malu, ati kẹtẹkẹtẹ: o si fi onjẹ bọ́ wọn dipò gbogbo ẹran wọn li ọdún na.
entries.en: And they brought their cattle unto Joseph: and Joseph gave them bread in exchange for horses, and for the flocks, and for the cattle of the herds, and for the asses: and he fed them with bread for all their cattle for that year.

entries.yo: Nigbati ọdún na si pari, nwọn si tọ̀ ọ wá li ọdún keji, nwọn si wi fun u pe, Awa ki yio pa a mọ́ lọdọ oluwa mi, bi a ti ná owo wa tán; ẹran-ọ̀sin si ti di ti oluwa mi; kò si sí nkan ti o kù li oju oluwa mi, bikoṣe ara wa, ati ilẹ wa:
entries.en: When that year was ended, they came unto him the second year, and said unto him, We will not hide it from my lord, how that our money is spent; my lord also hath our herds of cattle; there is not ought left in the sight of my lord, but our bodies, and our lands:

entries.yo: Nitori kili awa o ṣe kú li oju rẹ, ati awa ati ilẹ wa? fi onjẹ rà wa ati ilẹ wa, ati awa ati ilẹ wa yio ma ṣe ẹrú Farao: ki o si fun wa ni irugbìn, ki awa ki o le yè, ki a má kú, ki ilẹ ki o má ṣe di ahoro.
entries.en: Wherefore shall we die before thine eyes, both we and our land? buy us and our land for bread, and we and our land will be servants unto Pharaoh: and give us seed, that we may live, and not die, that the land be not desolate.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Josefu rà gbogbo ilẹ Egipti fun Farao; nitori olukuluku awọn ara Egipti li o tà oko rẹ̀, nitori ti ìyan na mú wọn: ilẹ si di ti Farao.
entries.en: And Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh; for the Egyptians sold every man his field, because the famine prevailed over them: so the land became Pharaoh's.

entries.yo: Bi o si ṣe ti awọn enia ni, o ṣí wọn si ilu, lati opin ilẹ kan ni Egipti dé opin ilẹ keji.
entries.en: And as for the people, he removed them to cities from one end of the borders of Egypt even to the other end thereof.

entries.yo: Kìki ilẹ awọn alufa ni kò rà; nitori ti awọn alufa ní ipín ti wọn lati ọwọ́ Farao wá, nwọn si njẹ ipín wọn ti Farao fi fun wọn; nitorina ni nwọn kò fi tà ilẹ wọn.
entries.en: Only the land of the priests bought he not; for the priests had a portion assigned them of Pharaoh, and did eat their portion which Pharaoh gave them: wherefore they sold not their lands.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Josefu wi fun awọn enia pe, Kiyesi i, emi ti rà nyin loni ati ilẹ nyin fun Farao: wò o, irugbìn niyi fun nyin, ki ẹnyin ki o si gbìn ilẹ na.
entries.en: Then Joseph said unto the people, Behold, I have bought you this day and your land for Pharaoh: lo, here is seed for you, and ye shall sow the land.

entries.yo: Yio si se, ni ikore ki ẹnyin ki o fi ida-marun fun Farao, ọ̀na mẹrin yio jẹ́ ti ara nyin fun irugbìn oko, ati fun onjẹ nyin, ati fun awọn ara ile nyin, ati onjẹ fun awọn ọmọ nyin wẹrẹ.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass in the increase, that ye shall give the fifth part unto Pharaoh, and four parts shall be your own, for seed of the field, and for your food, and for them of your households, and for food for your little ones.

entries.yo: Nwọn si wipe, Iwọ ti gbà ẹmi wa là: ki awa ki o ri ore-ọfẹ li oju oluwa mi, awa o si ma ṣe ẹrú Farao.
entries.en: And they said, Thou hast saved our lives: let us find grace in the sight of my lord, and we will be Pharaoh's servants.

entries.yo: Josefu si ṣe e ni ilana ni ilẹ Egipti titi di oni-oloni pe, Farao ni yio ma ní idamarun; bikoṣe ilẹ awọn alufa nikan ni kò di ti Farao.
entries.en: And Joseph made it a law over the land of Egypt unto this day, that Pharaoh should have the fifth part; except the land of the priests only, which became not Pharaoh's.

entries.yo: Israeli si joko ni ilẹ Egipti, ni ilẹ Goṣeni; nwọn si ní iní nibẹ̀, nwọn bísi i, nwọn si rẹ̀ gidigidi.
entries.en: And Israel dwelt in the land of Egypt, in the country of Goshen; and they had possessions therein, and grew, and multiplied exceedingly.

entries.yo: Jakobu si wà li ọdún mẹtadilogun ni ilẹ Egipti; gbogbo ọjọ́ aiye Jakobu si jẹ́ ãdọjọ ọdún o di mẹta:
entries.en: And Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years: so the whole age of Jacob was an hundred forty and seven years.

entries.yo: Akokò Israeli si sunmọ-etile ti yio kú: o si pè Josefu ọmọ rẹ̀, o si wi fun u pe, Emi bẹ̀ ọ, bi emi ba ri ojurere li oju rẹ, jọ̃, fi ọwọ́ rẹ si abẹ itan mi, ki o si ṣe ãnu ati otitọ fun mi; emi bẹ̀ ọ, máṣe sin mi ni Egipti.
entries.en: And the time drew nigh that Israel must die: and he called his son Joseph, and said unto him, If now I have found grace in thy sight, put, I pray thee, thy hand under my thigh, and deal kindly and truly with me; bury me not, I pray thee, in Egypt:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati emi ba sùn pẹlu awọn baba mi, iwọ o gbe mi jade ni Egipti, ki o si sin mi ni iboji wọn. On si wipe, Emi o ṣe bi iwọ ti wi.
entries.en: But I will lie with my fathers, and thou shalt carry me out of Egypt, and bury me in their buryingplace. And he said, I will do as thou hast said.

entries.yo: O si wipe, Bura fun mi. On si bura fun u. Israeli si tẹriba lori akete.
entries.en: And he said, Swear unto me. And he sware unto him. And Israel bowed himself upon the bed's head.

entries.yo: O SI ṣe lẹhin nkan wọnyi ni ẹnikan wi fun Josefu pe, Kiyesi i, ara baba rẹ kò dá: o si mú awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ mejeji, Manasse ati Efraimu pẹlu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And it came to pass after these things, that one told Joseph, Behold, thy father is sick: and he took with him his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.

entries.yo: Ẹnikan si sọ fun Jakobu, o si wipe, Kiyesi i, Josefu ọmọ rẹ tọ̀ ọ wá: Israeli si gbiyanju, o si joko lori akete.
entries.en: And one told Jacob, and said, Behold, thy son Joseph cometh unto thee: and Israel strengthened himself, and sat upon the bed.

entries.yo: Jakobu si wi fun Josefu pe, Ọlọrun Olodumare farahàn mi ni Lusi ni ilẹ Kenaani, o si sure fun mi,
entries.en: And Jacob said unto Joseph, God Almighty appeared unto me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and blessed me,

entries.yo: O si wi fun mi pe, Kiyesĩ, Emi o mu ọ bisi i, Emi o mu ọ rẹ̀, Emi o si sọ ọ di ọ̀pọlọpọ enia; Emi o si fi ilẹ yi fun irú-ọmọ rẹ lẹhin rẹ ni iní titi aiye.
entries.en: And said unto me, Behold, I will make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, and I will make of thee a multitude of people; and will give this land to thy seed after thee for an everlasting possession.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi Efraimu ati Manasse, awọn ọmọ rẹ mejeji ti a bí fun ọ ni ilẹ Egipti, ki emi ki o tó tọ̀ ọ wá ni Egipti, ti emi ni nwọn: bi Reubeni on Simeoni, bẹ̃ni nwọn o jẹ́ ti emi.
entries.en: And now thy two sons, Ephraim and Manasseh, which were born unto thee in the land of Egypt before I came unto thee into Egypt, are mine; as Reuben and Simeon, they shall be mine.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn ọmọ rẹ ti iwọ bí lẹhin wọn ni yio ṣe tirẹ, a o si ma pè wọn li orukọ awọn arakunrin wọn ni ilẹ iní wọn.
entries.en: And thy issue, which thou begettest after them, shall be thine, and shall be called after the name of their brethren in their inheritance.

entries.yo: Ati emi, nigbati mo ti Paddani wá, Rakeli kú lọwọ mi ni ilẹ Kenaani li ọ̀na, nigbati o kù diẹ ti a ba fi dé Efrati: emi si sin i nibẹ̀ li ọ̀na Efrati (eyi na ni Betlehemu).
entries.en: And as for me, when I came from Padan, Rachel died by me in the land of Canaan in the way, when yet there was but a little way to come unto Ephrath: and I buried her there in the way of Ephrath; the same is Bethlehem.

entries.yo: Israeli si wò awọn ọmọ Josefu, o si bère pe, Tani wọnyi?
entries.en: And Israel beheld Joseph's sons, and said, Who are these?

entries.yo: Josefu wi fun baba rẹ̀ pe, Awọn ọmọ mi ni, ti Ọlọrun fifun mi nihinyi. O si wipe, Emi bẹ̀ ọ, mú wọn wá sọdọ mi, emi o si sure fun wọn.
entries.en: And Joseph said unto his father, They are my sons, whom God hath given me in this place. And he said, Bring them, I pray thee, unto me, and I will bless them.

entries.yo: Njẹ oju Israeli ṣú baìbai nitori ogbó, kò le riran. On si mú wọn sunmọ ọdọ rẹ̀: o si fi ẹnu kò wọn li ẹnu, o si gbá wọn mọra.
entries.en: Now the eyes of Israel were dim for age, so that he could not see. And he brought them near unto him; and he kissed them, and embraced them.

entries.yo: Israeli si wi fun Josefu pe, Emi kò dába ati ri oju rẹ mọ́: si kiyesi i, Ọlọrun si fi irú-ọmọ rẹ hàn mi pẹlu.
entries.en: And Israel said unto Joseph, I had not thought to see thy face: and, lo, God hath shewed me also thy seed.

entries.yo: Josefu si mú wọn kuro li ẽkun rẹ̀, o si tẹriba, o dà oju rẹ̀ bolẹ.
entries.en: And Joseph brought them out from between his knees, and he bowed himself with his face to the earth.

entries.yo: Josefu si mú awọn mejeji, Efraimu li ọwọ́ ọtún rẹ̀ si ọwọ́ òsi Israeli, ati Manasse lọwọ òsi rẹ̀, si ọwọ́ ọtún Israeli, o si mú wọn sunmọ ọdọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Joseph took them both, Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel's left hand, and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israel's right hand, and brought them near unto him.

entries.yo: Israeli si nà ọwọ́ ọtún rẹ̀, o si fi lé Efraimu ẹniti iṣe aburo li ori, ati ọwọ́ òsi rẹ̀ lé ori Manasse, o mọ̃mọ̀ mu ọwọ́ rẹ̀ lọ bẹ̃: nitori Manasse ni iṣe akọ́bi.
entries.en: And Israel stretched out his right hand, and laid it upon Ephraim's head, who was the younger, and his left hand upon Manasseh's head, guiding his hands wittingly; for Manasseh was the firstborn.

entries.yo: O si sure fun Josefu, o si wipe, Ọlọrun, niwaju ẹniti Abrahamu ati Isaaki awọn baba mi rìn, Ọlọrun na ti o bọ́ mi lati ọjọ́ aiye mi titi di oni,
entries.en: And he blessed Joseph, and said, God, before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac did walk, the God which fed me all my life long unto this day,

entries.yo: Angeli na ti o dá mi ni ìde kuro ninu ibi gbogbo, ki o gbè awọn ọmọde wọnyi; ki a si pè orukọ mi mọ́ wọn lara, ati orukọ Abrahamu ati Isaaki awọn baba mi; ki nwọn ki o si di ọ̀pọlọpọ lãrin aiye.
entries.en: The Angel which redeemed me from all evil, bless the lads; and let my name be named on them, and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac; and let them grow into a multitude in the midst of the earth.

entries.yo: Nigbati Josefu ri pe baba rẹ̀ fi ọwọ́ ọtún rẹ̀ lé Efraimu lori, inu rẹ̀ kò dùn: o si mú baba rẹ̀ li ọwọ́, lati ṣí i kuro li ori Efraimu si ori Manasse.
entries.en: And when Joseph saw that his father laid his right hand upon the head of Ephraim, it displeased him: and he held up his father's hand, to remove it from Ephraim's head unto Manasseh's head.

entries.yo: Josefu si wi fun baba rẹ̀ pe, Bẹ̃kọ, baba mi: nitori eyi li akọ́bi; fi ọwọ́ ọtún rẹ lé e li ori.
entries.en: And Joseph said unto his father, Not so, my father: for this is the firstborn; put thy right hand upon his head.

entries.yo: Baba rẹ̀ si kọ̀, o si wipe, Emi mọ̀, ọmọ mi, emi mọ̀: on pẹlu yio di enia, yio si pọ̀ pẹlu: ṣugbọ́n nitõtọ aburo rẹ̀ yio jù u lọ, irú-ọmọ rẹ̀ yio si di ọ̀pọlọpọ orilẹ-ède.
entries.en: And his father refused, and said, I know it, my son, I know it: he also shall become a people, and he also shall be great: but truly his younger brother shall be greater than he, and his seed shall become a multitude of nations.

entries.yo: O si sure fun wọn li ọjọ́ na pe, Iwọ ni Israeli o ma fi sure, wipe, Ki Ọlọrun ki o ṣe nyin bi Efraimu on Manasse: bẹ̃li o fi Efraimu ṣaju Manasse.
entries.en: And he blessed them that day, saying, In thee shall Israel bless, saying, God make thee as Ephraim and as Manasseh: and he set Ephraim before Manasseh.

entries.yo: Israeli si wi fun Josefu pe, Wò o, emi kú: ṣugbọn Ọlọrun yio wà pẹlu nyin, yio si tun mú nyin lọ si ilẹ awọn baba nyin.
entries.en: And Israel said unto Joseph, Behold, I die: but God shall be with you, and bring you again unto the land of your fathers.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu, emi si fi ilẹ-biri kan fun ọ jù awọn arakunrin rẹ lọ, ti mo fi idà ti on ti ọrun mi gbà lọwọ awọn enia Amori.
entries.en: Moreover I have given to thee one portion above thy brethren, which I took out of the hand of the Amorite with my sword and with my bow.

entries.yo: JAKOBU si pè awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, o si wipe, Ẹ kó ara nyin jọ, ki emi ki o le wi ohun ti yio bá nyin lẹhin-ọla fun nyin.
entries.en: And Jacob called unto his sons, and said, Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you that which shall befall you in the last days.

entries.yo: Ẹ kó ara nyin jọ, ki ẹ si gbọ́, ẹnyin ọmọ Jakobu; ki ẹ si fetisi ti Israeli baba nyin.
entries.en: Gather yourselves together, and hear, ye sons of Jacob; and hearken unto Israel your father.

entries.yo: Reubeni, iwọ li akọ́bi mi, agbara mi, ati ipilẹṣẹ ipá mi, titayọ ọlá, ati titayọ agbara.
entries.en: Reuben, thou art my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength, the excellency of dignity, and the excellency of power:

entries.yo: Ẹnirirú bi omi, iwọ ki yio le tayọ; nitori ti iwọ gùn ori ẹni baba rẹ; iwọ si bà a jẹ́: o gùn ori akete mi.
entries.en: Unstable as water, thou shalt not excel; because thou wentest up to thy father's bed; then defiledst thou it: he went up to my couch.

entries.yo: Simeoni on Lefi, arakunrin ni nwọn; ohun-èlo ìka ni idà wọn.
entries.en: Simeon and Levi are brethren; instruments of cruelty are in their habitations.

entries.yo: Ọkàn mi, iwọ máṣe wọ̀ ìmọ wọn; ninu ajọ wọn, ọlá mi, máṣe bá wọn dàpọ; nitoripe, ni ibinu wọn nwọn pa ọkunrin kan, ati ni girimakayi wọn, nwọn já malu ni patì.
entries.en: O my soul, come not thou into their secret; unto their assembly, mine honour, be not thou united: for in their anger they slew a man, and in their selfwill they digged down a wall.

entries.yo: Ifibú ni ibinu wọn, nitori ti o rorò; ati ikannu wọn, nitori ti o ní ìka: emi o pin wọn ni Jakobu, emi o si tú wọn ká ni Israeli.
entries.en: Cursed be their anger, for it was fierce; and their wrath, for it was cruel: I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter them in Israel.

entries.yo: Judah, iwọ li ẹniti awọn arakunrin rẹ yio ma yìn; ọwọ́ rẹ yio wà li ọrùn awọn ọtá rẹ; awọn ọmọ baba rẹ yio foribalẹ niwaju rẹ.
entries.en: Judah, thou art he whom thy brethren shall praise: thy hand shall be in the neck of thine enemies; thy father's children shall bow down before thee.

entries.yo: Ọmọ kiniun ni Judah; ọmọ mi, ni ibi-ọdẹ ni iwọ ti goke: o bẹ̀rẹ, o ba bi kiniun, ati bi ogbó kiniun; tani yio lé e dide?
entries.en: Judah is a lion's whelp: from the prey, my son, thou art gone up: he stooped down, he couched as a lion, and as an old lion; who shall rouse him up?

entries.yo: Ọpá-alade ki yio ti ọwọ́ Judah kuro, bẹ̃li olofin ki yio kuro lãrin ẹsẹ̀ rẹ̀, titi Ṣiloh yio fi dé; on li awọn enia yio gbọ́ tirẹ̀.
entries.en: The sceptre shall not depart from Judah, nor a lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh come; and unto him shall the gathering of the people be.

entries.yo: Yio ma so ọmọ ẹṣin rẹ̀ mọ́ ara àjara, ati ọmọ kẹtẹkẹtẹ rẹ̀ mọ́ ara ãyo àjara; o ti fọ̀ ẹ̀wu rẹ̀ ninu ọtí-waini, ati aṣọ rẹ̀ ninu ẹ̀jẹ eso àjara:
entries.en: Binding his foal unto the vine, and his ass's colt unto the choice vine; he washed his garments in wine, and his clothes in the blood of grapes:

entries.yo: Oju rẹ̀ yio pọ́n fun ọtí-waini, ehín rẹ̀ yio si funfun fun wàra.
entries.en: His eyes shall be red with wine, and his teeth white with milk.

entries.yo: Sebuloni ni yio ma gbé ebute okun: on ni yio si ma wà fun ebute ọkọ̀; ipinlẹ rẹ̀ yio si dé Sidoni.
entries.en: Zebulun shall dwell at the haven of the sea; and he shall be for an haven of ships; and his border shall be unto Zidon.

entries.yo: Issakari ni kẹtẹkẹtẹ ti o lera, ti o dubulẹ lãrin awọn agbo-agutan.
entries.en: Issachar is a strong ass couching down between two burdens:

entries.yo: O si ri pe isimi dara, ati ilẹ na pe o wuni; o si tẹ̀ ejiká rẹ̀ lati rẹrù, on si di ẹni nsìnrú.
entries.en: And he saw that rest was good, and the land that it was pleasant; and bowed his shoulder to bear, and became a servant unto tribute.

entries.yo: Dani yio ma ṣe idajọ awọn enia rẹ̀, bi ọkan ninu awọn ẹ̀ya Israeli.
entries.en: Dan shall judge his people, as one of the tribes of Israel.

entries.yo: Dani yio dabi ejò li ẹba ọ̀na, bi paramọlẹ li ọ̀na, ti ibù ẹṣin ṣán ni gigĩsẹ, tòbẹ̃ ti ẹniti o gùn u yio fi ṣubu sẹhin.
entries.en: Dan shall be a serpent by the way, an adder in the path, that biteth the horse heels, so that his rider shall fall backward.

entries.yo: Emi ti duro dè ìgbala rẹ, OLUWA!
entries.en: I have waited for thy salvation, O LORD.

entries.yo: Gadi ọwọ́-ogun ni yio kọlù u: ṣugbọn on lé wọn.
entries.en: Gad, a troop shall overcome him: but he shall overcome at the last.

entries.yo: Lati inu Aṣeri wá onjẹ rẹ̀ yio lọrá, on o si ma mú adidùn ọba wá.
entries.en: Out of Asher his bread shall be fat, and he shall yield royal dainties.

entries.yo: Naftali li abo-agbọnrin ti o le sare: o funni li ọ̀rọ rere.
entries.en: Naphtali is a hind let loose: he giveth goodly words.

entries.yo: Josefu li ẹka eleso pupọ̀, ẹka eleso pupọ̀ li ẹba kanga; ẹtun ẹniti o yọ si ori ogiri.
entries.en: Joseph is a fruitful bough, even a fruitful bough by a well; whose branches run over the wall:

entries.yo: Awọn tafàtafa bà a ninu jẹ́ pọ̀ju, nwọn si tafà si i, nwọn si korira rẹ̀:
entries.en: The archers have sorely grieved him, and shot at him, and hated him:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ọrun rẹ̀ joko li agbara, a si mú apa ọwọ́ rẹ̀ larale, lati ọwọ́ Alagbara Jakobu wá, (lati ibẹ̀ li oluṣọ-agutan, okuta Israeli,)
entries.en: But his bow abode in strength, and the arms of his hands were made strong by the hands of the mighty God of Jacob; (from thence is the shepherd, the stone of Israel:)

entries.yo: Ani lati ọwọ́ Ọlọrun baba rẹ wá, ẹniti yio ràn ọ lọwọ; ati lati ọwọ́ Olodumare wá, ẹniti yio fi ibukún lati oke ọrun busi i fun ọ, ibukún ọgbun ti o wà ni isalẹ, ibukún ọmú, ati ti inu.
entries.en: Even by the God of thy father, who shall help thee; and by the Almighty, who shall bless thee with blessings of heaven above, blessings of the deep that lieth under, blessings of the breasts, and of the womb:

entries.yo: Ibukún baba rẹ ti jù ibukún awọn baba nla mi lọ, titi dé opin oke aiyeraiye wọnni: nwọn o si ma gbé ori Josefu, ati li atari ẹniti a yàsọtọ lãrin awọn arakunrin rẹ̀.
entries.en: The blessings of thy father have prevailed above the blessings of my progenitors unto the utmost bound of the everlasting hills: they shall be on the head of Joseph, and on the crown of the head of him that was separate from his brethren.

entries.yo: Benjamini ni yio ma fàniya bi ikõkò: ni kutukutu ni yio ma jẹ ẹran-ọdẹ rẹ̀, ati li aṣalẹ ni yio ma pín ikogun rẹ̀.
entries.en: Benjamin shall ravin as a wolf: in the morning he shall devour the prey, and at night he shall divide the spoil.

entries.yo: Gbogbo wọnyi li awọn ẹ̀ya Israeli mejejila: eyi ni baba wọn si sọ fun wọn, o si sure fun wọn; olukuluku bi ibukún tirẹ̀, li o sure fun wọn.
