entries.en: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel: and this is it that their father spake unto them, and blessed them; every one according to his blessing he blessed them.

entries.yo: O si kìlọ fun wọn, o si sọ fun wọn pe, A o kó mi jọ pọ̀ pẹlu awọn enia mi: ẹ sin mi pẹlu awọn baba mi ni ihò ti o mbẹ li oko Efroni ara Hitti.
entries.en: And he charged them, and said unto them, I am to be gathered unto my people: bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite,

entries.yo: Ninu ihò ti o mbẹ ninu oko Makpela ti mbẹ niwaju Mamre, ni ilẹ Kenaani, ti Abrahamu rà pẹlu oko lọwọ Efroni, ara Hitti fun ilẹ-isinku.
entries.en: In the cave that is in the field of Machpelah, which is before Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field of Ephron the Hittite for a possession of a buryingplace.

entries.yo: Nibẹ̀ ni nwọn sin Abrahamu ati Sara aya rẹ̀; nibẹ̀ ni nwọn sin Isaaki ati Rebeka aya rẹ̀; nibẹ̀ ni mo si sin Lea:
entries.en: There they buried Abraham and Sarah his wife; there they buried Isaac and Rebekah his wife; and there I buried Leah.

entries.yo: Lọwọ awọn ọmọ Heti li a ti rà oko na ti on ti ihò ti o wà nibẹ̀.
entries.en: The purchase of the field and of the cave that is therein was from the children of Heth.

entries.yo: Nigbati Jakobu si ti pari aṣẹ ipa fun awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, o kó ẹsẹ̀ rẹ̀ jọ sori akete, o si jọwọ ẹmi rẹ̀ lọwọ, a si kó o jọ pẹlu awọn enia rẹ̀.
entries.en: And when Jacob had made an end of commanding his sons, he gathered up his feet into the bed, and yielded up the ghost, and was gathered unto his people.

entries.yo: JOSEFU si ṣubu lé baba rẹ̀ li oju, o si sọkun si i lara, o si fi ẹnu kò o li ẹnu.
entries.en: And Joseph fell upon his father's face, and wept upon him, and kissed him.

entries.yo: Josefu si paṣẹ fun awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀, awọn oniṣegun, ki nwọn ki o kùn baba on li ọṣẹ: awọn oniṣegun si kùn Israeli li ọṣẹ.
entries.en: And Joseph commanded his servants the physicians to embalm his father: and the physicians embalmed Israel.

entries.yo: Nwọn si kún ogoji ọjọ́ fun u; nitoripe bẹ̃li a ikún ọjọ́ awọn ti a kùn li ọṣẹ: awọn ara Egipti si ṣọ̀fọ rẹ̀ li ãdọrin ọjọ́.
entries.en: And forty days were fulfilled for him; for so are fulfilled the days of those which are embalmed: and the Egyptians mourned for him threescore and ten days.

entries.yo: Nigbati ọjọ́ ọ̀fọ rẹ̀ kọja, Josefu sọ fun awọn ara ile Farao pe, Njẹ bi emi ba ri ore-ọfẹ li oju nyin emi bẹ̀ nyin, ẹ wi li eti Farao pe,
entries.en: And when the days of his mourning were past, Joseph spake unto the house of Pharaoh, saying, If now I have found grace in your eyes, speak, I pray you, in the ears of Pharaoh, saying,

entries.yo: Baba mi mu mi bura wipe, Kiyesi i, emi kú: ni isà mi ti mo ti wà fun ara mi ni ilẹ Kenaani, nibẹ̀ ni ki iwọ ki o sin mi. Njẹ nitorina emi bẹ̀ ọ, jẹ ki emi ki o goke lọ, ki emi ki o si lọ isin baba mi, emi o si tun pada wá.
entries.en: My father made me swear, saying, Lo, I die: in my grave which I have digged for me in the land of Canaan, there shalt thou bury me. Now therefore let me go up, I pray thee, and bury my father, and I will come again.

entries.yo: Farao si wipe, Goke lọ, ki o si sin okú baba rẹ, gẹgẹ bi o ti mu ọ bura.
entries.en: And Pharaoh said, Go up, and bury thy father, according as he made thee swear.

entries.yo: Josefu si goke lọ lati sin baba rẹ̀: ati gbogbo awọn iranṣẹ Farao, ati awọn àlagba ile rẹ̀, ati gbogbo awọn àlagba ilẹ Egipti si bá a goke lọ.
entries.en: And Joseph went up to bury his father: and with him went up all the servants of Pharaoh, the elders of his house, and all the elders of the land of Egypt,

entries.yo: Ati gbogbo awọn ara ile Josefu, ati awọn arakunrin rẹ̀, ati awọn ara ile baba rẹ̀: kìki awọn ọmọ wẹ́wẹ wọn, ati ọwọ́-ẹran wọn, ati ọwọ́-malu wọn, ni nwọn fi silẹ ni ilẹ Goṣeni.
entries.en: And all the house of Joseph, and his brethren, and his father's house: only their little ones, and their flocks, and their herds, they left in the land of Goshen.

entries.yo: Ati kẹkẹ́ ati ẹlẹṣin si bá a goke lọ: ẹgbẹ nlanla si ni ẹgbẹ na.
entries.en: And there went up with him both chariots and horsemen: and it was a very great company.

entries.yo: Nwọn si dé ibi ilẹ ipakà Atadi, ti o wà li oke Jordani, nibẹ̀ ni nwọn si gbé fi ohùn rére ẹkún nlanla ṣọ̀fọ rẹ̀: o si ṣọ̀fọ fun baba rẹ̀ li ọjọ́ meje.
entries.en: And they came to the threshingfloor of Atad, which is beyond Jordan, and there they mourned with a great and very sore lamentation: and he made a mourning for his father seven days.

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn ara ilẹ na, awọn ara Kenaani, si ri ọ̀fọ na ni ibi ilẹ ipakà Atadi, nwọn wipe, Ọ̀fọ nla li eyi fun awọn ara Egipti: nitorina ni nwọn ṣe sọ orukọ rẹ̀ ni Abel-misraimu, ti o wà loke odò Jordani.
entries.en: And when the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, saw the mourning in the floor of Atad, they said, This is a grievous mourning to the Egyptians: wherefore the name of it was called Abel-mizraim, which is beyond Jordan.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ si ṣe bi o ti fi aṣẹ fun wọn:
entries.en: And his sons did unto him according as he commanded them:

entries.yo: Nitori ti awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ mú u lọ si ilẹ Kenaani, nwọn si sin i ninu ihò oko Makpela, ti Abrahamu rà pẹlu oko fun iní ilẹ isinku, lọwọ Efroni ara Hitti, niwaju Mamre.
entries.en: For his sons carried him into the land of Canaan, and buried him in the cave of the field of Machpelah, which Abraham bought with the field for a possession of a buryingplace of Ephron the Hittite, before Mamre.

entries.yo: Josefu si pada wá si Egipti, on ati awọn arakunrin rẹ̀, ati gbogbo awọn ti o bá a goke lọ lati sin baba rẹ̀, lẹhin ti o ti sin baba rẹ̀ tán.
entries.en: And Joseph returned into Egypt, he, and his brethren, and all that went up with him to bury his father, after he had buried his father.

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn arakunrin Josefu ri pe baba wọn kú tán, nwọn wipe, Bọya Josefu yio korira wa, yio si gbẹsan gbogbo ibi ti a ti ṣe si i lara wa.
entries.en: And when Joseph's brethren saw that their father was dead, they said, Joseph will peradventure hate us, and will certainly requite us all the evil which we did unto him.

entries.yo: Nwọn si rán onṣẹ tọ̀ Josefu lọ wipe, Baba rẹ ti paṣẹ ki o tó kú pe,
entries.en: And they sent a messenger unto Joseph, saying, Thy father did command before he died, saying,

entries.yo: Bayi ni ki ẹnyin wi fun Josefu pe, Njẹ emi bẹ̀ ọ, dari irekọja ati ẹ̀ṣẹ awọn arakunrin rẹ jì wọn, nitori ibi ti nwọn ṣe si ọ. Njẹ nisisiyi, awa bẹ̀ ọ, dari irekọja awọn iranṣẹ Ọlọrun baba rẹ jì wọn. Josefu si sọkun nigbati nwọn sọ fun u.
entries.en: So shall ye say unto Joseph, Forgive, I pray thee now, the trespass of thy brethren, and their sin; for they did unto thee evil: and now, we pray thee, forgive the trespass of the servants of the God of thy father. And Joseph wept when they spake unto him.

entries.yo: Awọn arakunrin rẹ̀ si lọ pẹlu, nwọn wolẹ niwaju rẹ̀: nwọn si wipe, Wò o, iranṣẹ rẹ li awa iṣe.
entries.en: And his brethren also went and fell down before his face; and they said, Behold, we be thy servants.

entries.yo: Josefu si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ má bẹ̀ru: emi ha wà ni ipò Ọlọrun?
entries.en: And Joseph said unto them, Fear not: for am I in the place of God?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi o ṣe ti nyin ni, ibi li ẹnyin rò si mi; ṣugbọn Ọlọrun mọ̀ ọ si rere, lati mu u ṣẹ, bi o ti ri loni lati gbà ọ̀pọlọpọ enia là.
entries.en: But as for you, ye thought evil against me; but God meant it unto good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, ẹ má bẹ̀ru: emi o bọ́ nyin, ati awọn ọmọ wẹrẹ nyin. O si tù wọn ninu, o si sọ̀rọ rere fun wọn.
entries.en: Now therefore fear ye not: I will nourish you, and your little ones. And he comforted them, and spake kindly unto them.

entries.yo: Josefu si joko ni Egipti, on ati ile baba rẹ̀: Josefu si wà li ãdọfa ọdún.
entries.en: And Joseph dwelt in Egypt, he, and his father's house: and Joseph lived an hundred and ten years.

entries.yo: Josefu si ri awọn ọmọloju Efraimu ti iran kẹta; awọn ọmọ Makiri, ọmọ Manasse li a si gbé kà ori ẽkun Josefu pẹlu.
entries.en: And Joseph saw Ephraim's children of the third generation: the children also of Machir the son Manasseh were brought up upon Joseph's knees.

entries.yo: Josefu si wi fun awọn arakunrin rẹ̀ pe, Emi kú: Ọlọrun yio si bẹ̀ nyin wò nitõtọ, yio si mú nyin jade kuro ni ilẹ yi, si ilẹ ti o ti bura fun Abrahamu, fun Isaaki, ati fun Jakobu.
entries.en: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I die: and God will surely visit you, and bring you out of this land unto the land which he sware to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.

entries.yo: Josefu si mu awọn ọmọ Israeli bura, wipe, Ọlọrun yio bẹ̀ nyin wò nitõtọ, ki ẹnyin ki o si rù egungun mi lati ihin lọ.
entries.en: And Joseph took an oath of the children of Israel, saying, God will surely visit you, and ye shall carry up my bones from hence.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Josefu kú, o jẹ́ ẹni ãdọfa ọdún: nwọn si kùn u li ọṣẹ, a si tẹ́ ẹ sinu posi ni Egipti.
entries.en: So Joseph died, being an hundred and ten years old: and they embalmed him, and he was put in a coffin in Egypt.

entries.yo: NJẸ orukọ awọn ọmọ Israeli, ti o wá si Egipti pẹlu Jakobu ni wọnyi; olukuluku pẹlu ile rẹ̀.
entries.en: Now these are the names of the children of Israel, which came into Egypt; every man and his household came with Jacob.

entries.yo: Reubeni, Simeoni, Lefi, ati Judah;
entries.en: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah,

entries.yo: Issakari, Sebuluni, ati Benjamini;
entries.en: Issachar, Zebulun, and Benjamin,

entries.yo: Dani ati Naftali, Gadi ati Aṣeri.
entries.en: Dan, and Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.

entries.yo: Ati gbogbo ọkàn ti o ti inu Jakobu jade, o jẹ́ ãdọrin ọkàn: Josefu sa ti wà ni Egipti.
entries.en: And all the souls that came out of the loins of Jacob were seventy souls: for Joseph was in Egypt already.

entries.yo: Josefu si kú, ati gbogbo awọn arakunrin rẹ̀, ati gbogbo iran na.
entries.en: And Joseph died, and all his brethren, and all that generation.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Israeli si bisi i, nwọn si pọ̀si i gidigidi, nwọn si rẹ̀, nwọn si di alagbara nla jọjọ; ilẹ na si kún fun wọn.
entries.en: And the children of Israel were fruitful, and increased abundantly, and multiplied, and waxed exceeding mighty; and the land was filled with them.

entries.yo: Ọba titun miran si wa ijẹ ni Egipti, ti kò mọ́ Josefu.
entries.en: Now there arose up a new king over Egypt, which knew not Joseph.

entries.yo: O si wi fun awọn enia rẹ̀ pe, kiye si i, enia awọn ọmọ Israeli npọ̀, nwọn si nlagbara jù wa lọ:
entries.en: And he said unto his people, Behold, the people of the children of Israel are more and mightier than we:

entries.yo: Ẹ wá na, ẹ jẹ ki a fi ọgbọ́n ba wọn ṣe; ki nwọn ki o máṣe bisi i, yio si ṣe nigbati ogun kan ba ṣẹ̀, nwọn o dàpọ mọ́ awọn ọtá wa pẹlu, nwọn o ma bá wa jà, nwọn o si jade kuro ni ilẹ yi.
entries.en: Come on, let us deal wisely with them; lest they multiply, and it come to pass, that, when there falleth out any war, they join also unto our enemies, and fight against us, and so get them up out of the land.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni nwọn ṣe yàn akoniṣiṣẹ le wọn, lati fi iṣẹ wọn pọ́n wọn loju. Nwọn si kọ́ ilu iṣura fun Farao, Pitomu ati Ramesesi.
entries.en: Therefore they did set over them taskmasters to afflict them with their burdens. And they built for Pharaoh treasure cities, Pithom and Raamses.

entries.yo: Bi nwọn si ti npọ́n wọn loju si i, bẹ̃ni nwọn mbisi i, ti nwọn si npọ̀. Inu wọn si bàjẹ́ nitori awọn ọmọ Israeli.
entries.en: But the more they afflicted them, the more they multiplied and grew. And they were grieved because of the children of Israel.

entries.yo: Awọn ara Egipti si mu awọn ọmọ Israeli sìn li asìnpa:
entries.en: And the Egyptians made the children of Israel to serve with rigour:

entries.yo: Nwọn si fi ìsin lile, li erupẹ ati ni briki ṣiṣe, ati ni oniruru ìsin li oko mu aiye wọn korò: gbogbo ìsin wọn ti nwọn mu wọn sìn, asìnpa ni.
entries.en: And they made their lives bitter with hard bondage, in morter, and in brick, and in all manner of service in the field: all their service, wherein they made them serve, was with rigour.

entries.yo: Ọba Egipti si wi fun awọn iyãgbà Heberu; orukọ ọkan ninu ẹniti ijẹ Ṣifra, ati orukọ ekeji ni Pua:
entries.en: And the king of Egypt spake to the Hebrew midwives, of which the name of the one was Shiphrah, and the name of the other Puah:

entries.yo: O si wipe, Nigbati ẹnyin ba nṣe iṣẹ iyãgbà fun awọn obinrin Heberu, ti ẹnyin ba ri wọn ni ikunlẹ; bi o ba ṣe ọmọkunrin ni, njẹ ki ẹnyin ki o pa a; ṣugbọn bi o ba ṣe ọmọbinrin ni, njẹ on o yè.
entries.en: And he said, When ye do the office of a midwife to the Hebrew women, and see them upon the stools; if it be a son, then ye shall kill him: but if it be a daughter, then she shall live.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn iyãgbà bẹ̀ru Ọlọrun, nwọn kò si ṣe bi ọba Egipti ti fi aṣẹ fun wọn, nwọn si da awọn ọmọkunrin si.
entries.en: But the midwives feared God, and did not as the king of Egypt commanded them, but saved the men children alive.

entries.yo: Ọba Egipti si pè awọn iyãgbà na, o si wi fun wọn pe, Ẽṣe ti ẹnyin fi ṣe irú nkan yi ti ẹnyin si da awọn ọmọkunrin si?
entries.en: And the king of Egypt called for the midwives, and said unto them, Why have ye done this thing, and have saved the men children alive?

entries.yo: Awọn iyãgbà si wi fun Farao pe, nitoriti awọn obinrin Heberu kò ri bi awọn obinrin Egipti; nitoriti ara yá wọn, nwọn a si ti bí ki awọn iyãgbà to wọle tọ̀ wọn lọ.
entries.en: And the midwives said unto Pharaoh, Because the Hebrew women are not as the Egyptian women; for they are lively, and are delivered ere the midwives come in unto them.

entries.yo: Nitorina Ọlọrun ṣe rere fun awọn iyãgbà na: awọn enia na si mbisi i, nwọn si di alagbara koko.
entries.en: Therefore God dealt well with the midwives: and the people multiplied, and waxed very mighty.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nitoriti awọn iyãgbà bẹ̀ru Ọlọrun, on si kọle fun wọn.
entries.en: And it came to pass, because the midwives feared God, that he made them houses.

entries.yo: Farao si paṣẹ fun gbogbo awọn enia rẹ̀, wipe, Gbogbo ọmọkunrin ti a bí on ni ki ẹnyin gbé jù sinu odò, gbogbo awọn ọmọbinrin ni ki ẹnyin ki o dasi.
entries.en: And Pharaoh charged all his people, saying, Every son that is born ye shall cast into the river, and every daughter ye shall save alive.

entries.yo: ỌKUNRIN kan ara ile Lefi si lọ, o si fẹ́ ọmọbinrin Lefi kan.
entries.en: And there went a man of the house of Levi, and took to wife a daughter of Levi.

entries.yo: Obinrin na si yún, o si bi ọmọkunrin kan: nigbati o si ri i pe, o ṣe ọmọ didara, o pa a mọ́ li oṣù mẹta.
entries.en: And the woman conceived, and bare a son: and when she saw him that he was a goodly child, she hid him three months.

entries.yo: Nigbati kò si le pa a mọ́ mọ́, o ṣe apoti ẽsu fun u, o si fi ọ̀da ilẹ ati oje igi ṣán a; o si tẹ́ ọmọ na sinu rẹ̀; o si gbé e sinu koriko odò li ẹba odò na.
entries.en: And when she could not longer hide him, she took for him an ark of bulrushes, and daubed it with slime and with pitch, and put the child therein; and she laid it in the flags by the river's brink.

entries.yo: Arabinrin rẹ̀ si duro li òkere, lati mọ̀ ohun ti yio ṣe ọmọ na.
entries.en: And his sister stood afar off, to wit what would be done to him.

entries.yo: Ọmọbinrin Farao si sọkalẹ wá lati wẹ̀ li odò; awọn ọmọbinrin ọdọ rẹ̀ si nrìn lọ li ẹba odò na; nigbati o si ri apoti na lãrin koriko odò, o rán ọmọbinrin ọdọ rẹ̀ kan lati lọ gbé e wá.
entries.en: And the daughter of Pharaoh came down to wash herself at the river; and her maidens walked along by the river's side; and when she saw the ark among the flags, she sent her maid to fetch it.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si ṣi i, o ri ọmọ na; si kiyesi i ọmọde na nsọkun. Inu rẹ̀ si yọ́ si i, o si wipe, Ọkan ninu awọn ọmọ Heberu li eyi.
entries.en: And when she had opened it, she saw the child: and, behold, the babe wept. And she had compassion on him, and said, This is one of the Hebrews' children.

entries.yo: Nigbana li arabinrin rẹ̀ wi fun ọmọbinrin Farao pe, Emi ka lọ ipè alagbatọ kan fun ọ wá ninu awọn obinrin Heberu, ki o tọ́ ọmọ na fun ọ?
entries.en: Then said his sister to Pharaoh's daughter, Shall I go and call to thee a nurse of the Hebrew women, that she may nurse the child for thee?

entries.yo: Ọmọbinrin Farao si wi fun u pe, Lọ. Ọmọbinrin na si lọ, o si pè iya ọmọ na wá.
entries.en: And Pharaoh's daughter said to her, Go. And the maid went and called the child's mother.

entries.yo: Ọmọbinrin Farao si wi fun u pe, Gbé ọmọ yi lọ ki o si tọ́ ọ fun mi, emi o si san owo iṣẹ rẹ fun ọ. Obinrin na si gbé ọmọ na lọ, o si tọ́ ọ.
entries.en: And Pharaoh's daughter said unto her, Take this child away, and nurse it for me, and I will give thee thy wages. And the woman took the child, and nursed it.

entries.yo: Ọmọ na si dàgba, o si mú u tọ̀ ọmọbinrin Farao wá, on si di ọmọ rẹ̀. O si sọ orukọ rẹ̀ ni Mose, o si wipe, Nitoriti mo fà a jade ninu omi.
entries.en: And the child grew, and she brought him unto Pharaoh's daughter, and he became her son. And she called his name Moses: and she said, Because I drew him out of the water.

entries.yo: O si ṣe li ọjọ́ wọnni, ti Mose dàgba, o jade tọ̀ awọn arakunrin rẹ̀ lọ, o si wò iṣẹ wọn: o si ri ara Egipti kan o nlù Heberu kan, ọkan ninu awọn arakunrin rẹ̀.
entries.en: And it came to pass in those days, when Moses was grown, that he went out unto his brethren, and looked on their burdens: and he spied an Egyptian smiting an Hebrew, one of his brethren.

entries.yo: O si wò ihin, o wò ọhún, nigbati o si ri pe, kò si ẹnikan, o lù ara Egipti na pa, o si bò o ninu yanrin.
entries.en: And he looked this way and that way, and when he saw that there was no man, he slew the Egyptian, and hid him in the sand.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si jade lọ ni ijọ́ keji, kiyesi i, ọkunrin meji ara Heberu mbá ara wọn jà: o si wi fun ẹniti o firan si ẹnikeji rẹ̀ pe, Ẽṣe ti iwọ fi nlù ẹgbẹ rẹ?
entries.en: And when he went out the second day, behold, two men of the Hebrews strove together: and he said to him that did the wrong, Wherefore smitest thou thy fellow?

entries.yo: On si wipe, Tali o fi ọ jẹ́ olori ati onidajọ lori wa? iwọ fẹ́ pa mi bi o ti pa ara Egipti? Mose si bẹ̀ru, o si wipe, Lõtọ ọ̀ran yi di mimọ̀.
entries.en: And he said, Who made thee a prince and a judge over us? intendest thou to kill me, as thou killedst the Egyptian? And Moses feared, and said, Surely this thing is known.

entries.yo: Nigbati Farao si gbọ́ ọ̀ran yi, o nwá ọ̀na lati pa Mose. Ṣugbọn Mose sá kuro niwaju Farao, o si ngbé ilẹ Midiani: o si joko li ẹba kanga kan.
entries.en: Now when Pharaoh heard this thing, he sought to slay Moses. But Moses fled from the face of Pharaoh, and dwelt in the land of Midian: and he sat down by a well.

entries.yo: Njẹ alufa Midiani li ọmọbinrin meje, nwọn si wá, nwọn pọn omi, nwọn si kún ọkọ̀ imumi lati fi omi fun agbo-ẹran baba wọn.
entries.en: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters: and they came and drew water, and filled the troughs to water their father's flock.

entries.yo: Awọn oluṣọ-agutan si wá, nwọn si lé wọn kuro: nigbana ni Mose dide duro, o ràn wọn lọwọ, o si fi omi fun agbo-ẹran wọn.
entries.en: And the shepherds came and drove them away: but Moses stood up and helped them, and watered their flock.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si padà dé lati ọdọ Reueli baba wọn, o ni Ẽtiri ti ẹnyin fi tète dé bẹ̃ loni?
entries.en: And when they came to Reuel their father, he said, How is it that ye are come so soon to day?

entries.yo: Nwọn si wipe, Ara Egipti kan li o gbà wa lọwọ awọn oluṣọ-agutan, o si pọn omi to fun wa pẹlu, o si fi fun agbo-ẹran.
entries.en: And they said, An Egyptian delivered us out of the hand of the shepherds, and also drew water enough for us, and watered the flock.

entries.yo: O si wi fun awọn ọmọbinrin rẹ̀ pe Nibo li o gbé wà? ẽṣe ti ẹnyin fi ọkunrin na silẹ? ẹ pè e ki o le wá ijẹun.
entries.en: And he said unto his daughters, And where is he? why is it that ye have left the man? call him, that he may eat bread.

entries.yo: O si dùn mọ́ Mose lati ma bá ọkunrin na gbé: on si fi Sippora ọmọbinrin rẹ̀ fun Mose.
entries.en: And Moses was content to dwell with the man: and he gave Moses Zipporah his daughter.

entries.yo: On si bi ọmọkunrin kan fun u, o si sọ orukọ rẹ̀ ni Gerṣomu: nitoriti o wipe, Emi ti nṣe atipo ni ilẹ ajeji.
entries.en: And she bare him a son, and he called his name Gershom: for he said, I have been a stranger in a strange land.

entries.yo: O si ṣe lẹhin ọjọ́ pupọ̀, ti ọba Egipti kú: awọn ọmọ Israeli si ngbin nitori ìsin na, nwọn si ke, igbe wọn si goke tọ̀ Ọlọrun lọ nitori ìsin wọn.
entries.en: And it came to pass in process of time, that the king of Egypt died: and the children of Israel sighed by reason of the bondage, and they cried, and their cry came up unto God by reason of the bondage.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si gbọ́ irora wọn, Ọlọrun si ranti majẹmu rẹ̀ pẹlu Abrahamu, pẹlu Isaaki, ati pẹlu Jakobu.
entries.en: And God heard their groaning, and God remembered his covenant with Abraham, with Isaac, and with Jacob.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si bojuwò awọn ọmọ Israeli, Ọlọrun si mọ̀ ọ fun wọn.
entries.en: And God looked upon the children of Israel, and God had respect unto them.

entries.yo: MOSE si nṣọ́ agbo-ẹran Jetro baba aya rẹ̀, alufa Midiani: o si dà agbo-ẹran na lọ si apa ẹhin ijù, o si dé Horebu, oke Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Now Moses kept the flock of Jethro his father in law, the priest of Midian: and he led the flock to the backside of the desert, and came to the mountain of God, even to Horeb.

entries.yo: Angeli OLUWA si farahàn a ninu ọwọ́ iná lati inu ãrin igbẹ̀: on si wò, si kiyesi i, iná njó igbẹ́, igbẹ́ na kò si run.
entries.en: And the angel of the LORD appeared unto him in a flame of fire out of the midst of a bush: and he looked, and, behold, the bush burned with fire, and the bush was not consumed.

entries.yo: Mose si wipe, Njẹ emi o yipada si apakan, emi o si wò iran nla yi, ẽṣe ti igbẹ́ yi kò run.
entries.en: And Moses said, I will now turn aside, and see this great sight, why the bush is not burnt.

entries.yo: Nigbati OLUWA ri pe, o yipada si apakan lati wò o, Ọlọrun kọ si i lati inu ãrin igbẹ́ na wá, o si wipe, Mose, Mose. On si dahun pe, Emi niyi.
entries.en: And when the LORD saw that he turned aside to see, God called unto him out of the midst of the bush, and said, Moses, Moses. And he said, Here am I.

entries.yo: O si wipe, Máṣe sunmọ ihin: bọ́ salubata rẹ kuro li ẹsẹ̀ rẹ, nitori ibiti iwọ gbé duro si nì, ilẹ mimọ́ ni.
entries.en: And he said, Draw not nigh hither: put off thy shoes from off thy feet, for the place whereon thou standest is holy ground.

entries.yo: O si wipe, Emi li Ọlọrun baba rẹ, Ọlọrun Abrahamu, Ọlọrun Isaaki, ati Ọlọrun Jakobu. Mose si pa oju rẹ̀ mọ́; nitoriti o bẹ̀ru lati bojuwò Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Moreover he said, I am the God of thy father, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. And Moses hid his face; for he was afraid to look upon God.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wipe, Nitõtọ emi ti ri ipọnju awọn enia mi ti o wà ni Egipti, mo si gbọ́ igbe wọn nitori awọn akoniṣiṣẹ wọn; nitoriti mo mọ̀ ibanujẹ wọn;
entries.en: And the LORD said, I have surely seen the affliction of my people which are in Egypt, and have heard their cry by reason of their taskmasters; for I know their sorrows;

entries.yo: Emi si sọkalẹ wa lati gbà wọn lọwọ awọn ara Egipti, ati lati mú wọn goke ti ilẹ na wá si ilẹ rere ati nla, si ilẹ ti nṣàn fun wàra ati fun oyin; si ibi ti awọn ara Kenaani, ati ti awọn Hitti, ati ti awọn Amori, ati ti awọn Perissi, ati ti awọn Hifi, ati ti awọn Jebusi.
entries.en: And I am come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians, and to bring them up out of that land unto a good land and a large, unto a land flowing with milk and honey; unto the place of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, kiyesi i, igbe awọn ọmọ Israeli dé ọdọ mi; emi si ti ri pẹlu, wahala ti awọn ọba Egipti nwahala wọn.
entries.en: Now therefore, behold, the cry of the children of Israel is come unto me: and I have also seen the oppression wherewith the Egyptians oppress them.

entries.yo: Nitorina wá nisisiyi, emi o si rán ọ si Farao, ki iwọ ki o le mú awọn enia mi, awọn ọmọ Israeli, lati Egipti jade wá.
entries.en: Come now therefore, and I will send thee unto Pharaoh, that thou mayest bring forth my people the children of Israel out of Egypt.

entries.yo: Mose si wi fun Ọlọrun pe, Tali emi, ti emi o fi tọ̀ Farao lọ, ati ti emi o fi le mú awọn ọmọ Israeli jade lati Egipti wá?
entries.en: And Moses said unto God, Who am I, that I should go unto Pharaoh, and that I should bring forth the children of Israel out of Egypt?

entries.yo: O si wipe, Nitõtọ emi o wà pẹlu rẹ; eyi ni yio si ṣe àmi fun ọ pe, emi li o rán ọ: nigbati iwọ ba mú awọn enia na lati Egipti jade wá, ẹnyin o sìn Ọlọrun lori oke yi.
entries.en: And he said, Certainly I will be with thee; and this shall be a token unto thee, that I have sent thee: When thou hast brought forth the people out of Egypt, ye shall serve God upon this mountain.

entries.yo: Mose si wi fun Ọlọrun pe, Kiyesi i, nigbati mo ba dé ọdọ awọn ọmọ Israeli, ti emi o si wi fun wọn pe, Ọlọrun awọn baba nyin li o rán mi si nyin; ti nwọn o si bi mi pe, Orukọ rẹ̀? kili emi o wi fun wọn?
entries.en: And Moses said unto God, Behold, when I come unto the children of Israel, and shall say unto them, The God of your fathers hath sent me unto you; and they shall say to me, What is his name? what shall I say unto them?

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si wi fun Mose pe, EMI NI ẸNITI O WA: o si wipe, Bayi ni ki o wi fun awọn ọmọ Israeli pe, EMI NI li o rán mi si nyin.
entries.en: And God said unto Moses, I AM THAT I AM: and he said, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, I AM hath sent me unto you.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si wi fun Mose pẹlu pe, Bayi ni ki iwọ ki o wi fun awọn ọmọ Israeli; OLUWA, Ọlọrun awọn baba nyin, Ọlọrun Abrahamu, Ọlọrun Isaaki, ati Ọlọrun Jakobu, li o rán mi si nyin: eyi li orukọ mi titilai, eyi si ni iranti mi lati irandiran.
entries.en: And God said moreover unto Moses, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, The LORD God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, hath sent me unto you: this is my name for ever, and this is my memorial unto all generations.

entries.yo: Lọ, ki o si kó awọn àgba Israeli jọ, ki o si wi fun wọn pe, OLUWA, Ọlọrun awọn baba nyin, Ọlọrun Abrahamu, ti Isaaki, ati ti Jakobu, li o farahàn mi wipe, Lõtọ ni mo ti bẹ̀ nyin wò, mo si ti ri ohun ti a nṣe si nyin ni Egipti:
entries.en: Go, and gather the elders of Israel together, and say unto them, The LORD God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Jacob, appeared unto me, saying, I have surely visited you, and seen that which is done to you in Egypt:

entries.yo: Emi si ti wipe, Emi o mú nyin goke jade ninu ipọnju Egipti si ilẹ awọn ara Kenaani, ati ti awọn Hitti, ati ti awọn Amori, ati ti awọn Perissi, ati ti awọn Hifi, ati ti awọn Jebusi, si ilẹ ti nṣàn fun wàra ati fun oyin.
entries.en: And I have said, I will bring you up out of the affliction of Egypt unto the land of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, unto a land flowing with milk and honey.

entries.yo: Nwọn o si fetisi ohùn rẹ: iwọ o si wá, iwọ ati awọn àgba Israeli, sọdọ ọba Egipti, ẹnyin o si wi fun u pe, OLUWA, Ọlọrun awọn Heberu pade wa: jẹ ki a lọ nisisiyi, awa bẹ̀ ọ, ni ìrin ijọ́ mẹta si ijù, ki awa ki o le rubọ si OLUWA Ọlọrun wa.
entries.en: And they shall hearken to thy voice: and thou shalt come, thou and the elders of Israel, unto the king of Egypt, and ye shall say unto him, The LORD God of the Hebrews hath met with us: and now let us go, we beseech thee, three days' journey into the wilderness, that we may sacrifice to the LORD our God.

entries.yo: Emi si mọ̀ pe ọba Egipti ki yio jẹ ki ẹnyin ki o lọ, ki tilẹ iṣe nipa ọwọ́ agbara.
entries.en: And I am sure that the king of Egypt will not let you go, no, not by a mighty hand.

entries.yo: Emi o si nà ọwọ́ mi, emi o si fi iṣẹ-iyanu mi gbogbo kọlù Egipti ti emi o ṣe lãrin rẹ̀: lẹhin eyinì li on o to jọwọ nyin lọwọ lọ.
entries.en: And I will stretch out my hand, and smite Egypt with all my wonders which I will do in the midst thereof: and after that he will let you go.

entries.yo: Emi o si fi ojurere fun awọn enia yi li oju awọn ara Egipti: yio si ṣe, nigbati ẹnyin o lọ, ẹnyin ki yio lọ li ofo:
entries.en: And I will give this people favour in the sight of the Egyptians: and it shall come to pass, that, when ye go, ye shall not go empty:

entries.yo: Olukuluku obinrin ni yio si bère ohun-èlo fadaka, ati ohun-èlo wurà, ati aṣọ, lọwọ aladugbo rẹ̀, ati lọwọ ẹniti o nṣe atipo ninu ile rẹ̀: ẹnyin o si fi wọn si ara awọn ọmọkunrin nyin, ati si ara awọn ọmọbinrin nyin: ẹnyin o si kó ẹrù awọn ara Egipti.
entries.en: But every woman shall borrow of her neighbour, and of her that sojourneth in her house, jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment: and ye shall put them upon your sons, and upon your daughters; and ye shall spoil the Egyptians.

entries.yo: MOSE si dahùn o si wipe, Ṣugbọn kiyesi i, nwọn ki yio gbà mi gbọ́, bẹ̃ni nwọn ki yio fetisi ohùn mi: nitoriti nwọn o wipe, OLUWA kò farahàn ọ.
entries.en: And Moses answered and said, But, behold, they will not believe me, nor hearken unto my voice: for they will say, The LORD hath not appeared unto thee.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun u pe, Kini wà li ọwọ́ rẹ nì? On si wipe, Ọpá ni.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto him, What is that in thine hand? And he said, A rod.

entries.yo: O si wi fun u pe, Sọ ọ si ilẹ. On si sọ ọ si ilẹ, o si di ejò; Mose si sá kuro niwaju rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he said, Cast it on the ground. And he cast it on the ground, and it became a serpent; and Moses fled from before it.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun Mose pe, Nà ọwọ́ rẹ ki o si mú u ni ìru: (On si nà ọwọ́ rẹ̀, o si mú u, o si di ọpá si i li ọwọ́:)
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Put forth thine hand, and take it by the tail. And he put forth his hand, and caught it, and it became a rod in his hand:

entries.yo: Ki nwọn ki o le gbàgbọ́ pe, OLUWA, Ọlọrun awọn baba wọn, Ọlọrun Abrahamu, Ọlọrun Isaaki, ati Ọlọrun Jakobu, li o farahàn ọ.
entries.en: That they may believe that the LORD God of their fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, hath appeared unto thee.

entries.yo: OLUWA si tun wi fun u pe, Fi ọwọ́ rẹ bọ̀ àiya rẹ. O si fi ọwọ́ rẹ̀ bọ̀ àiya rẹ̀: nigbati o si fà a yọ jade, si kiyesi i, ọwọ́ rẹ̀ dẹ́tẹ̀, o fún bi ẹ̀gbọn owu.
entries.en: And the LORD said furthermore unto him, Put now thine hand into thy bosom. And he put his hand into his bosom: and when he took it out, behold, his hand was leprous as snow.

entries.yo: O si wipe, Tun fi ọwọ́ rẹ bọ̀ àiya rẹ. (O si tun fi ọwọ́ rẹ̀ bọ̀ àiya rẹ̀; o si fà a yọ jade li àiya rẹ̀; si kiyesi i, o si pada bọ̀ bi ẹran ara rẹ̀.)
entries.en: And he said, Put thine hand into thy bosom again. And he put his hand into his bosom again; and plucked it out of his bosom, and, behold, it was turned again as his other flesh.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, bi nwọn kò ba gbà ọ gbọ́, ti nwọn kò si fetisi ohùn iṣẹ-àmi iṣaju, njẹ nwọn o gbà ohùn iṣẹ-àmi ikẹhin gbọ́.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass, if they will not believe thee, neither hearken to the voice of the first sign, that they will believe the voice of the latter sign.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, bi nwọn kò ba si gbà àmi mejeji yi gbọ́ pẹlu, ti nwọn kò si fetisi ohùn rẹ, njẹ ki iwọ ki o bù ninu omi odò nì, ki o si dà a si iyangbẹ ilẹ: omi na ti iwọ bù ninu odò yio di ẹ̀jẹ ni iyangbẹ ilẹ.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass, if they will not believe also these two signs, neither hearken unto thy voice, that thou shalt take of the water of the river, and pour it upon the dry land: and the water which thou takest out of the river shall become blood upon the dry land.

entries.yo: Mose si wi fun OLUWA pe, Oluwa, emi ki iṣe ẹni ọ̀rọ-sisọ nigba atijọ wá, tabi lati igbati o ti mbá iranṣẹ rẹ sọ̀rọ: ṣugbọn olohùn wuwo ni mi, ati alahọn wuwo.
entries.en: And Moses said unto the LORD, O my Lord, I am not eloquent, neither heretofore, nor since thou hast spoken unto thy servant: but I am slow of speech, and of a slow tongue.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun u pe, Tali o dá ẹnu enia? tabi tali o dá odi, tabi aditi, tabi ariran, tabi afọju? Emi OLUWA ha kọ́?
entries.en: And the LORD said unto him, Who hath made man's mouth? or who maketh the dumb, or deaf, or the seeing, or the blind? have not I the LORD?

entries.yo: Njẹ lọ nisisiyi, emi o si pẹlu ẹnu rẹ, emi o si kọ́ ọ li eyiti iwọ o wi.
entries.en: Now therefore go, and I will be with thy mouth, and teach thee what thou shalt say.

entries.yo: On si wipe, Oluwa, emi bẹ̀ ọ, rán ẹniti iwọ o rán.
entries.en: And he said, O my Lord, send, I pray thee, by the hand of him whom thou wilt send.

entries.yo: Inu OLUWA si ru si Mose, o si wipe, Aaroni arakunrin rẹ ọmọ Lefi kò ha wà? Emi mọ̀ pe o le sọ̀rọ jọjọ. Ati pẹlu, kiyesi i, o si mbọ̀wá ipade rẹ: nigbati o ba si ri ọ, on o yọ̀ ninu ọkàn rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Moses, and he said, Is not Aaron the Levite thy brother? I know that he can speak well. And also, behold, he cometh forth to meet thee: and when he seeth thee, he will be glad in his heart.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si sọ̀rọ fun u, iwọ o si fi ọ̀rọ si i li ẹnu: emi o si pẹlu ẹnu rẹ, ati pẹlu ẹnu rẹ̀, emi o si kọ́ nyin li eyiti ẹnyin o ṣe.
entries.en: And thou shalt speak unto him, and put words in his mouth: and I will be with thy mouth, and with his mouth, and will teach you what ye shall do.

entries.yo: On ni yio si ma ṣe ogbifọ rẹ fun awọn enia: yio si ṣe, on o ma jẹ́ ẹnu fun ọ, iwọ o si ma jẹ́ bi Olọrun fun u.
entries.en: And he shall be thy spokesman unto the people: and he shall be, even he shall be to thee instead of a mouth, and thou shalt be to him instead of God.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si mú ọpá yi li ọwọ́ rẹ, eyiti iwọ o ma fi ṣe iṣẹ-àmi.
entries.en: And thou shalt take this rod in thine hand, wherewith thou shalt do signs.

entries.yo: Mose si lọ, o si pada tọ̀ Jetro ana rẹ̀, o si wi fun u pe, Emi bẹ̀ ọ, jẹ ki nlọ ki emi si pada tọ̀ awọn arakunrin mi ti o wà ni Egipti, ki emi ki o si wò bi nwọn wà li ãye sibẹ̀. Jetro si wi fun Mose pe, Mã lọ li alafia.
entries.en: And Moses went and returned to Jethro his father in law, and said unto him, Let me go, I pray thee, and return unto my brethren which are in Egypt, and see whether they be yet alive. And Jethro said to Moses, Go in peace.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun Mose ni Midiani pe, Lọ, pada si Egipti: nitori gbogbo enia ti nwá ẹmi rẹ ti kú tán.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Moses in Midian, Go, return into Egypt: for all the men are dead which sought thy life.

entries.yo: Mose si mú aya rẹ̀ ati awọn ọmọ-ọkunrin rẹ̀, o si gbé wọn gùn kẹtẹkẹtẹ kan, o si pada si ilẹ Egipti: Mose si mú ọpá Ọlọrun na li ọwọ́ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Moses took his wife and his sons, and set them upon an ass, and he returned to the land of Egypt: and Moses took the rod of God in his hand.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun Mose pe, Nigbati iwọ ba dé Egipti, kiyesi i ki iwọ ki o ṣe gbogbo iṣẹ-iyanu, ti mo filé ọ lọwọ, niwaju Farao, ṣugbọn emi o mu àiya rẹ̀ le, ti ki yio fi jẹ ki awọn enia na ki o lọ.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, When thou goest to return into Egypt, see that thou do all those wonders before Pharaoh, which I have put in thine hand: but I will harden his heart, that he shall not let the people go.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si wi fun Farao pe, Bayi li OLUWA wi, Ọmọ mi ni Israeli, akọ́bi mi:
entries.en: And thou shalt say unto Pharaoh, Thus saith the LORD, Israel is my son, even my firstborn:

entries.yo: Emi si ti wi fun ọ pe, Jẹ ki ọmọ mi ki o lọ, ki o le ma sìn mi; iwọ si ti kọ̀ lati jẹ ki o lọ: kiyesi i, emi o pa ọmọ rẹ, ani akọ́bi rẹ.
entries.en: And I say unto thee, Let my son go, that he may serve me: and if thou refuse to let him go, behold, I will slay thy son, even thy firstborn.

entries.yo: O si ṣe li ọ̀na ninu ile-èro, li OLUWA pade rẹ̀, o si nwá ọ̀na lati pa a.
entries.en: And it came to pass by the way in the inn, that the LORD met him, and sought to kill him.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Sippora mú okuta mimú, o si kọ ọmọ rẹ̀ ni ilà abẹ, o si sọ ọ si ẹsẹ̀ Mose, o si wipe, Ọkọ ẹlẹjẹ ni iwọ fun mi nitõtọ.
entries.en: Then Zipporah took a sharp stone, and cut off the foreskin of her son, and cast it at his feet, and said, Surely a bloody husband art thou to me.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li o jọwọ rẹ̀ lọwọ lọ. Nigbana ni Sippora wipe, Ọkọ ẹlẹjẹ ni iwọ nitori ikọlà na.
entries.en: So he let him go: then she said, A bloody husband thou art, because of the circumcision.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun Aaroni pe, Lọ si ijù lọ ipade Mose. On si lọ, o si pade rẹ̀ li oke Ọlọrun, o si fi ẹnu kò o li ẹnu.
entries.en: And the LORD said to Aaron, Go into the wilderness to meet Moses. And he went, and met him in the mount of God, and kissed him.

entries.yo: Mose si sọ gbogbo ọ̀rọ OLUWA ti o rán a fun Aaroni, ati gbogbo aṣẹ iṣẹ-àmi ti o fi fun u.
entries.en: And Moses told Aaron all the words of the LORD who had sent him, and all the signs which he had commanded him.

entries.yo: Mose ati Aaroni si lọ, nwọn si kó gbogbo àgba awọn ọmọ Israeli jọ:
entries.en: And Moses and Aaron went and gathered together all the elders of the children of Israel:

entries.yo: Aaroni si sọ gbogbo ọ̀rọ ti OLUWA ti sọ fun Mose, o si ṣe iṣẹ-àmi na li oju awọn enia na.
entries.en: And Aaron spake all the words which the LORD had spoken unto Moses, and did the signs in the sight of the people.

entries.yo: Awọn enia na si gbàgbọ́: nigbati nwọn si gbọ́ pe, OLUWA ti bẹ̀ awọn ọmọ Israeli wò, ati pe o si ti ri ipọnju wọn, nigbana ni nwọn tẹ̀ ori wọn ba, nwọn si sìn.
entries.en: And the people believed: and when they heard that the LORD had visited the children of Israel, and that he had looked upon their affliction, then they bowed their heads and worshipped.

entries.yo: LẸHIN eyinì ni Mose ati Aaroni wọle, nwọn si wi fun Farao pe, Bayi li OLUWA, Ọlọrun Israeli wi, Jẹ ki awọn enia mi ki o lọ, ki nwọn ki o le ṣe ajọ fun mi ni ijù.
entries.en: And afterward Moses and Aaron went in, and told Pharaoh, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Let my people go, that they may hold a feast unto me in the wilderness.

entries.yo: Farao si wipe, Tali OLUWA, ti emi o fi gbà ohùn rẹ̀ gbọ́ lati jẹ ki Israeli ki o lọ? Emi kò mọ̀ OLUWA na, bẹ̃li emi ki yio jẹ ki Israeli ki o lọ.
entries.en: And Pharaoh said, Who is the LORD, that I should obey his voice to let Israel go? I know not the LORD, neither will I let Israel go.

entries.yo: Nwọn si wipe, Ọlọrun awọn Heberu li o pade wa: awa bẹ̀ ọ, jẹ ki a lọ ni ìrin ijọ́ mẹta si ijù, ki a si rubọ si OLUWA Ọlọrun wa; ki o má ba fi ajakalẹ-àrun tabi idà kọlù wa.
entries.en: And they said, The God of the Hebrews hath met with us: let us go, we pray thee, three days' journey into the desert, and sacrifice unto the LORD our God; lest he fall upon us with pestilence, or with the sword.

entries.yo: Ọba Egipti si wi fun wọn pe, Mose ati Aaroni, nitori kili ẹnyin ṣe dá awọn enia duro ninu iṣẹ wọn? ẹ lọ si iṣẹ nyin.
entries.en: And the king of Egypt said unto them, Wherefore do ye, Moses and Aaron, let the people from their works? get you unto your burdens.

entries.yo: Farao si wipe, Kiyesi i awọn enia ilẹ yi pọ̀ju nisisiyi, ẹnyin si mu wọn simi kuro ninu iṣẹ wọn.
entries.en: And Pharaoh said, Behold, the people of the land now are many, and ye make them rest from their burdens.

entries.yo: Farao si paṣẹ li ọjọ́ na fun awọn akoniṣiṣẹ awọn enia, ati fun awọn olori wọn wipe,
entries.en: And Pharaoh commanded the same day the taskmasters of the people, and their officers, saying,

entries.yo: Ẹnyin kò gbọdọ fun awọn enia na ni koriko mọ́ lati ma ṣe briki, bi ìgba atẹhinwá: jẹ ki nwọn ki o ma lọ ṣà koriko fun ara wọn.
entries.en: Ye shall no more give the people straw to make brick, as heretofore: let them go and gather straw for themselves.

entries.yo: Ati iye briki ti nwọn ti ima ṣe ni ìgba atẹhinwá, on ni ki ẹnyin bù fun wọn; ẹnyin kò gbọdọ ṣẹ nkan kù kuro nibẹ̀: nitoriti nwọn nṣe imẹlẹ; nitorina ni nwọn ṣe nke wipe, Jẹ ki a lọ rubọ si Ọlorun wa.
entries.en: And the tale of the bricks, which they did make heretofore, ye shall lay upon them; ye shall not diminish ought thereof: for they be idle; therefore they cry, saying, Let us go and sacrifice to our God.

entries.yo: Ẹ jẹ ki iṣẹ ki o wuwo fun awọn ọkunrin na, ki nwọn ki o le ma ṣe lãlã ninu rẹ̀; ẹ má si ṣe jẹ ki nwọn ki o fiyesi ọ̀rọ eke.
entries.en: Let there more work be laid upon the men, that they may labour therein; and let them not regard vain words.

entries.yo: Awọn akoniṣiṣẹ enia na si jade, ati awọn olori wọn, nwọn si sọ fun awọn enia na, pe, Bayi ni Farao wipe, Emi ki yio fun nyin ni koriko mọ́.
entries.en: And the taskmasters of the people went out, and their officers, and they spake to the people, saying, Thus saith Pharaoh, I will not give you straw.

entries.yo: Ẹ lọ, ẹ wá koriko nibiti ẹnyin gbé le ri i: ṣugbọn a ki yio ṣẹ nkan kù ninu iṣẹ nyin.
entries.en: Go ye, get you straw where ye can find it: yet not ought of your work shall be diminished.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li awọn enia na si tuka kiri ká gbogbo ilẹ Egipti lati ma ṣà idi koriko ni ipò koriko.
entries.en: So the people were scattered abroad throughout all the land of Egypt to gather stubble instead of straw.

entries.yo: Awọn akoniṣiṣẹ lé wọn ni ire wipe, Ẹ ṣe iṣẹ nyin pé, iṣẹ ojojumọ́ nyin, bi igbati koriko mbẹ.
entries.en: And the taskmasters hasted them, saying, Fulfil your works, your daily tasks, as when there was straw.

entries.yo: Ati awọn olori awọn ọmọ Israeli, ti awọn akoniṣiṣẹ Farao yàn lé wọn, li a nlù, ti a si mbilère pe, Ẽṣe ti ẹnyin kò ṣe iṣẹ nyin pé ni briki ṣiṣe li ana ati li oni, bi ìgba atẹhinwá?
entries.en: And the officers of the children of Israel, which Pharaoh's taskmasters had set over them, were beaten, and demanded, Wherefore have ye not fulfilled your task in making brick both yesterday and to day, as heretofore?

entries.yo: Nigbana li awọn olori awọn ọmọ Israeli wá, nwọn si ke tọ̀ Farao wipe, Ẽṣe ti iwọ fi nṣe awọn iranṣẹ rẹ bayi?
entries.en: Then the officers of the children of Israel came and cried unto Pharaoh, saying, Wherefore dealest thou thus with thy servants?

entries.yo: A kò fi koriko fun awọn iranṣẹ rẹ, nwọn si nwi fun wa pe, Ẹ ṣe briki: si kiyesi i, a nlù awọn iranṣẹ rẹ; ṣugbọn lọwọ awọn enia rẹ li ẹbi wà.
entries.en: There is no straw given unto thy servants, and they say to us, Make brick: and, behold, thy servants are beaten; but the fault is in thine own people.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn on wipe, Ẹnyin ọlẹ, ẹnyin ọlẹ: nitorina li ẹ ṣe wipe, Jẹ ki a lọ ṣẹbọ si OLUWA.
entries.en: But he said, Ye are idle, ye are idle: therefore ye say, Let us go and do sacrifice to the LORD.

entries.yo: Njẹ ẹ lọ nisisiyi, ẹ ṣiṣẹ; a ki yio sá fi koriko fun nyin, sibẹ̀ iye briki nyin yio pé.
entries.en: Go therefore now, and work; for there shall no straw be given you, yet shall ye deliver the tale of bricks.

entries.yo: Awọn olori awọn ọmọ Israeli si ri pe, ọ̀ran wọn kò li oju, lẹhin igbati a wipe, Ẹ ki o dinkù ninu iye briki nyin ojojumọ́.
entries.en: And the officers of the children of Israel did see that they were in evil case, after it was said, Ye shall not minish ought from your bricks of your daily task.

entries.yo: Nwọn si bá Mose on Aaroni, ẹniti o duro lati pade wọn bi nwọn ti nti ọdọ Farao jade wá:
entries.en: And they met Moses and Aaron, who stood in the way, as they came forth from Pharaoh:

entries.yo: Nwọn si wi fun wọn pe, Ki OLUWA ki o wò nyin, ki o si ṣe idajọ; nitoriti ẹnyin mu wa di okú-õrùn li oju Farao, ati li oju awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀, lati fi idá lé wọn lọwọ lati pa wa.
entries.en: And they said unto them, The LORD look upon you, and judge; because ye have made our savour to be abhorred in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of his servants, to put a sword in their hand to slay us.

entries.yo: Mose si pada tọ̀ OLUWA lọ, o si wi fun u pe, OLUWA, ẽtiṣe ti o fi ṣe buburu si awọn enia yi bẹ̃? ẽtiṣe ti o fi rán mi?
entries.en: And Moses returned unto the LORD, and said, Lord, wherefore hast thou so evil entreated this people? why is it that thou hast sent me?

entries.yo: Nitori igbati mo ti tọ̀ Farao wá lati sọ̀rọ li orukọ rẹ, buburu li o ti nṣe si awọn enia yi; bẹ̃ni ni gbigbà iwọ kò si gbà awọn enia rẹ.
entries.en: For since I came to Pharaoh to speak in thy name, he hath done evil to this people; neither hast thou delivered thy people at all.

entries.yo: NIGBANA li OLUWA wi fun Mose pe, Nigbayi ni iwọ o ri ohun ti emi o ṣe si Farao: nitori ọwọ́ agbara li on o ṣe jọwọ wọn lọwọ lọ, ati pẹlu ọwọ́ agbara li on o fi tì wọn jade kuro ni ilẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Then the LORD said unto Moses, Now shalt thou see what I will do to Pharaoh: for with a strong hand shall he let them go, and with a strong hand shall he drive them out of his land.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si sọ fun Mose, o si wi fun u pe, Emi ni JEHOFA:
entries.en: And God spake unto Moses, and said unto him, I am the LORD:

entries.yo: Emi si farahàn Abrahamu, Isaaki, ati Jakobu, li orukọ Ọlọrun Olodumare, ṣugbọn orukọ mi JEHOFA, ni nwọn kò fi mọ̀ mi.
entries.en: And I appeared unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob, by the name of God Almighty, but by my name JEHOVAH was I not known to them.

entries.yo: Emi si ti bá wọn da majẹmu mi pẹlu, lati fun wọn ni ilẹ Kenaani, ilẹ atipo wọn, nibiti nwọn gbé ṣe atipo.
entries.en: And I have also established my covenant with them, to give them the land of Canaan, the land of their pilgrimage, wherein they were strangers.

entries.yo: Emi si ti gbọ́ irora awọn ọmọ Israeli pẹlu, ti awọn ara Egipti nmu sìn; emi si ti ranti majẹmu mi.
entries.en: And I have also heard the groaning of the children of Israel, whom the Egyptians keep in bondage; and I have remembered my covenant.

entries.yo: Nitorina wi fun awọn ọmọ Israeli pe, Emi li OLUWA, emi o si mú nyin jade kuro labẹ ẹrù awọn ara Egipti, emi o si yọ nyin kuro li oko-ẹrú wọn, emi o si fi apa ninà ati idajọ nla da nyin ni ìde:
entries.en: Wherefore say unto the children of Israel, I am the LORD, and I will bring you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians, and I will rid you out of their bondage, and I will redeem you with a stretched out arm, and with great judgments:

entries.yo: Emi o si gbà nyin ṣe enia fun ara mi, emi o si jẹ́ Ọlọrun fun nyin: ẹnyin o si mọ̀ pe emi li OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin, ti o mú nyin jade kuro labẹ ẹrù awọn ara Egipti.
entries.en: And I will take you to me for a people, and I will be to you a God: and ye shall know that I am the LORD your God, which bringeth you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians.

entries.yo: Emi o si mú nyin lọ sinu ilẹ na, ti mo ti bura lati fi fun Abrahamu, fun Isaaki, ati fun Jakobu; emi o si fi i fun nyin ni iní: Emi li OLUWA.
entries.en: And I will bring you in unto the land, concerning the which I did swear to give it to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; and I will give it you for an heritage: I am the LORD.

entries.yo: Mose si sọ bẹ̃ fun awọn ọmọ Israeli: ṣugbọn nwọn kò gbà ti Mose gbọ́ fun ibinujẹ ọkàn, ati fun ìsin lile.
entries.en: And Moses spake so unto the children of Israel: but they hearkened not unto Moses for anguish of spirit, and for cruel bondage.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Wọle, sọ fun Farao ọba Egipti pe, ki o jẹ ki awọn ọmọ Israeli ki o lọ kuro ni ilẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Go in, speak unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, that he let the children of Israel go out of his land.

entries.yo: Mose si sọ niwaju OLUWA wipe, Kiyesi i, awọn ọmọ Israeli kò gbọ́ ti emi, Farao yio ha ti ṣe gbọ́ ti emi, emi ẹniti iṣe alaikọlà ète?
entries.en: And Moses spake before the LORD, saying, Behold, the children of Israel have not hearkened unto me; how then shall Pharaoh hear me, who am of uncircumcised lips?

entries.yo: OLUWA si bá Mose ati Aaroni sọ̀rọ, o si fi aṣẹ fun wọn si awọn ọmọ Israeli, ati si Farao, ọba Egipti, lati mú awọn ọmọ Israeli jade ni ilẹ Egipti.
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, and gave them a charge unto the children of Israel, and unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt.

entries.yo: Wọnyi li olori ile baba wọn: awọn ọmọ Reubeni akọ́bi Israeli; Hanoku, ati Pallu, Hesroni, ati Karmi: wọnyi ni idile Reubeni.
entries.en: These be the heads of their fathers' houses: The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel; Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi: these be the families of Reuben.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Simeoni; Jemueli, ati Jamini, ati Ohadi, ati Jakini, ati Sohari, ati Ṣaulu ọmọ obinrin ara Kénaani; wọnyi ni idile Simeoni.
entries.en: And the sons of Simeon; Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman: these are the families of Simeon.

entries.yo: Wọnyi si li orukọ awọn ọmọ Lefi ni iran wọn; Gerṣoni, ati Kohati, ati Merari: ọdún aiye Lefi si jẹ́ mẹtadilogoje.
entries.en: And these are the names of the sons of Levi according to their generations; Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari: and the years of the life of Levi were an hundred thirty and seven years.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Gerṣoni; Libni, ati Ṣimei, ni idile wọn.
entries.en: The sons of Gershon; Libni, and Shimi, according to their families.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Kohati; Amramu ati Ishari, ati Hebroni, ati Ussieli ọdún aiye Kohati si jẹ́ ãdoje o le mẹta.
entries.en: And the sons of Kohath; Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel: and the years of the life of Kohath were an hundred thirty and three years.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Merari; Mahali, ati Muṣi. Wọnyi ni idile Lefi ni iran wọn.
entries.en: And the sons of Merari; Mahali and Mushi: these are the families of Levi according to their generations.

entries.yo: Amramu si fẹ́ Jokebedi arabinrin baba rẹ̀ li aya, on li o si bi Aaroni ati Mose fun u: ọdún aiye Amramu si jẹ́ mẹtadilogoje.
entries.en: And Amram took him Jochebed his father's sister to wife; and she bare him Aaron and Moses: and the years of the life of Amram were an hundred and thirty and seven years.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Ishari; Kora, ati Nefegi, ati Sikri.
entries.en: And the sons of Izhar; Korah, and Nepheg, and Zichri.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Ussieli; Miṣaeli, ati Elsafani, ati Sitri.
entries.en: And the sons of Uzziel; Mishael, and Elzaphan, and Zithri.

entries.yo: Aaroni si fẹ́ Eliṣeba, ọmọbinrin Aminadabu, arabinrin Naṣoni, li aya; on si bí Nadabu ati Abihu, Eleasari, ati Itamari fun u.
entries.en: And Aaron took him Elisheba, daughter of Amminadab, sister of Naashon, to wife; and she bare him Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Kora; Assiri, ati Elkana, ati Abiasafu; wọnyi ni idile awọn ọmọ Kora.
entries.en: And the sons of Korah; Assir, and Elkanah, and Abiasaph: these are the families of the Korhites.

entries.yo: Eleasari ọmọ Aaroni si fẹ́ ọkan ninu awọn ọmọbinrin Putieli li aya; on si bi Finehasi fun u: wọnyi li olori awọn baba awọn ọmọ Lefi ni idile wọn.
entries.en: And Eleazar Aaron's son took him one of the daughters of Putiel to wife; and she bare him Phinehas: these are the heads of the fathers of the Levites according to their families.

entries.yo: Wọnyi ni Aaroni on Mose na, ẹniti OLUWA sọ fun pe, Ẹ mú awọn ọmọ Israeli jade kuro ni ilẹ Egipti, gẹgẹ bi ogun wọn.
entries.en: These are that Aaron and Moses, to whom the LORD said, Bring out the children of Israel from the land of Egypt according to their armies.

entries.yo: Awọn wọnyi li o bá Farao ọba Egipti sọ̀rọ lati mú awọn ọmọ Israeli jade kuro ni Egipti: wọnyi ni Mose ati Aaroni na.
entries.en: These are they which spake to Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring out the children of Israel from Egypt: these are that Moses and Aaron.

entries.yo: O si ṣe li ọjọ́ ti OLUWA bá Mose sọ̀rọ ni ilẹ Egipti,
entries.en: And it came to pass on the day when the LORD spake unto Moses in the land of Egypt,

entries.yo: Ni OLUWA sọ fun Mose wipe, Emi li OLUWA: sọ gbogbo eyiti mo wi fun ọ fun Farao ọba Egipti.
entries.en: That the LORD spake unto Moses, saying, I am the LORD: speak thou unto Pharaoh king of Egypt all that I say unto thee.

entries.yo: Mose si wi niwaju OLUWA pe, Kiyesi i, alaikọlà ète li emi, Farao yio ha ti ṣe fetisi ti emi?
entries.en: And Moses said before the LORD, Behold, I am of uncircumcised lips, and how shall Pharaoh hearken unto me?

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun Mose pe, Wò o, emi fi ọ ṣe ọlọrun fun Farao: Aaroni arakunrin rẹ ni yio si ma ṣe wolĩ rẹ.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, See, I have made thee a god to Pharaoh: and Aaron thy brother shall be thy prophet.

entries.yo: Iwọ o sọ gbogbo eyiti mo palaṣẹ fun ọ: Aaroni arakunrin rẹ ni yio si ma sọ fun Farao pe, ki o rán awọn ọmọ Israeli jade ni ilẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Thou shalt speak all that I command thee: and Aaron thy brother shall speak unto Pharaoh, that he send the children of Israel out of his land.

entries.yo: Emi o si mu Farao li àiya le, emi o si sọ iṣẹ-àmi mi ati iṣẹ-iyanu mi di pupọ̀ ni ilẹ Egipti.
entries.en: And I will harden Pharaoh's heart, and multiply my signs and my wonders in the land of Egypt.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Farao ki yio gbọ́ ti nyin, emi o si fi ọwọ́ mi lé Egipti, emi o si fi idajọ nla mú awọn ogun mi, ani awọn ọmọ Israeli enia mi, jade kuro ni ilẹ Egipti.
entries.en: But Pharaoh shall not hearken unto you, that I may lay my hand upon Egypt, and bring forth mine armies, and my people the children of Israel, out of the land of Egypt by great judgments.

entries.yo: Awọn ara Egipti yio si mọ̀ pe, emi li OLUWA, nigbati mo ba nà ọwọ́ mi lé Egipti, ti mo si mú awọn ọmọ Israeli jade kuro lãrin wọn.
entries.en: And the Egyptians shall know that I am the LORD, when I stretch forth mine hand upon Egypt, and bring out the children of Israel from among them.

entries.yo: Mose ati Aaroni si ṣe bẹ̃; bi OLUWA ti paṣẹ fun wọn; bẹ̃ni nwọn ṣe.
entries.en: And Moses and Aaron did as the LORD commanded them, so did they.

entries.yo: Mose jẹ́ ẹni ọgọrin ọdún, Aaroni si jẹ́ ẹni ọgọrin ọdún o le mẹta, nigbati nwọn sọ̀rọ fun Farao.
entries.en: And Moses was fourscore years old, and Aaron fourscore and three years old, when they spake unto Pharaoh.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose ati fun Aaroni pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

entries.yo: Nigbati Farao yio ba wi fun nyin pe, Ẹ fi iṣẹ-iyanu kan hàn: nigbana ni ki iwọ ki o wi fun Aaroni pe, Mú ọpá rẹ, ki o si fi i lelẹ niwaju Farao, yio si di ejò.
entries.en: When Pharaoh shall speak unto you, saying, Shew a miracle for you: then thou shalt say unto Aaron, Take thy rod, and cast it before Pharaoh, and it shall become a serpent.

entries.yo: Mose ati Aaroni si wọle tọ̀ Farao lọ, nwọn si ṣe bi OLUWA ti paṣẹ fun wọn: Aaroni si fi ọpá rẹ̀ lelẹ niwaju Farao ati niwaju awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀, o si di ejò.
entries.en: And Moses and Aaron went in unto Pharaoh, and they did so as the LORD had commanded: and Aaron cast down his rod before Pharaoh, and before his servants, and it became a serpent.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Farao pẹlu pè awọn ọlọgbọ́n ati awọn oṣó: awọn pẹlu, ani awọn alalupayida Egipti, si fi idán wọn ṣe bẹ̃ gẹgẹ.
entries.en: Then Pharaoh also called the wise men and the sorcerers: now the magicians of Egypt, they also did in like manner with their enchantments.

entries.yo: Nitoriti olukuluku nwọn fi ọpá rẹ̀ lelẹ, nwọn si di ejò: ṣugbọn ọpá Aaroni gbe ọpá wọn mì.
entries.en: For they cast down every man his rod, and they became serpents: but Aaron's rod swallowed up their rods.

entries.yo: Aiya Farao si le, kò si fetisi ti wọn; bi OLUWA ti wi.
entries.en: And he hardened Pharaoh's heart, that he hearkened not unto them; as the LORD had said.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun Mose pe, Aiya Farao di lile, o kọ̀ lati jẹ ki awọn enia na ki o lọ.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Pharaoh's heart is hardened, he refuseth to let the people go.

entries.yo: Tọ̀ Farao lọ li owurọ̀; kiyesi i, o njade lọ si odò; ki iwọ ki o si duro lati pade rẹ̀ leti odò; ati ọpá nì ti o di ejò ni ki iwọ ki o mú li ọwọ́ rẹ.
entries.en: Get thee unto Pharaoh in the morning; lo, he goeth out unto the water; and thou shalt stand by the river's brink against he come; and the rod which was turned to a serpent shalt thou take in thine hand.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si wi fun u pe, OLUWA, Ọlọrun awọn Heberu, li o rán mi si ọ wipe, Jẹ ki awọn enia mi ki o lọ, ki nwọn ki o le sìn mi ni ijù: si kiyesi i, titi di isisiyi iwọ kò gbọ́.
entries.en: And thou shalt say unto him, The LORD God of the Hebrews hath sent me unto thee, saying, Let my people go, that they may serve me in the wilderness: and, behold, hitherto thou wouldest not hear.

entries.yo: Bayi li OLUWA wi, Ninu eyi ni iwọ o fi mọ̀ pe emi li OLUWA: kiyesi i, emi o fi ọpá ti o wà li ọwọ́ mi lù omi ti o wà li odò, nwọn o si di ẹ̀jẹ.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD, In this thou shalt know that I am the LORD: behold, I will smite with the rod that is in mine hand upon the waters which are in the river, and they shall be turned to blood.

entries.yo: Ẹja ti o wà ninu odò na yio si kú, odò na yio si ma rùn; awọn ara Egipti yio si korira ati ma mu ninu omi odò na.
entries.en: And the fish that is in the river shall die, and the river shall stink; and the Egyptians shall lothe to drink of the water of the river.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe, Wi fun Aaroni pe, Mú ọpá rẹ, ki o si nà ọwọ́ rẹ si oju omi Egipti wọnni, si odò wọn, si omi ṣiṣàn wọn, ati ikudu wọn, ati si gbogbo ikojọpọ omi wọn, ki nwọn le di ẹ̀jẹ; ẹ̀jẹ yio si wà ni gbogbo ilẹ Egipti, ati ninu ohun-èlo igi, ati ninu ohun-èlo okuta.
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Take thy rod, and stretch out thine hand upon the waters of Egypt, upon their streams, upon their rivers, and upon their ponds, and upon all their pools of water, that they may become blood; and that there may be blood throughout all the land of Egypt, both in vessels of wood, and in vessels of stone.

entries.yo: Mose ati Aaroni si ṣe bẹ̃ bi OLUWA ti fi aṣẹ fun wọn; o si gbé ọpá na soke o si lù omi ti o wà li odò li oju Farao, ati li oju awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀; a si sọ gbogbo omi ti o wà li odò na di ẹ̀jẹ.
entries.en: And Moses and Aaron did so, as the LORD commanded; and he lifted up the rod, and smote the waters that were in the river, in the sight of Pharaoh, and in the sight of his servants; and all the waters that were in the river were turned to blood.

entries.yo: Ẹja ti o wà li odò si kú; odò na si nrùn, awọn ara Egipti kò si le mu ninu omi odò na; ẹ̀jẹ si wà ni gbogbo ilẹ Egipti,
entries.en: And the fish that was in the river died; and the river stank, and the Egyptians could not drink of the water of the river; and there was blood throughout all the land of Egypt.

entries.yo: Awọn alalupayida Egipti si fi idán wọn ṣe bẹ̃: àiya Farao si le, bẹ̃ni kò si fetisi ti wọn; bi OLUWA ti wi.
entries.en: And the magicians of Egypt did so with their enchantments: and Pharaoh's heart was hardened, neither did he hearken unto them; as the LORD had said.

entries.yo: Farao si pada o lọ si ile rẹ̀, kò si fi ọkàn rẹ̀ si eyi pẹlu.
entries.en: And Pharaoh turned and went into his house, neither did he set his heart to this also.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn ara Egipti si wàlẹ yi odò na ká fun omi mimu; nitoriti nwọn kò le mu ninu omi na.
entries.en: And all the Egyptians digged round about the river for water to drink; for they could not drink of the water of the river.

entries.yo: Ọjọ́ meje si pé, lẹhin igbati OLUWA lù odò na.
entries.en: And seven days were fulfilled, after that the LORD had smitten the river.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe, Tọ̀ Farao lọ, ki o si wi fun u pe, Bayi li OLUWA wipe, Jẹ ki awọn enia mi ki o lọ, ki nwọn ki o le sìn mi.
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, Go unto Pharaoh, and say unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Let my people go, that they may serve me.

entries.yo: Bi iwọ ba si kọ̀ lati jẹ ki nwọn ki o lọ, kiyesi i, emi o fi ọpọlọ kọlù gbogbo ẹkùn rẹ:
entries.en: And if thou refuse to let them go, behold, I will smite all thy borders with frogs:

entries.yo: Odò yio si bi ọpọlọ jade li ọ̀pọlọpọ, nwọn o si goke, nwọn o si wá sinu ile rẹ, ati sinu ibùsun rẹ, ati sori akete rẹ, ati sinu ile awọn ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ, ati sara awọn enia rẹ, ati sinu ãro rẹ, ati sinu ọpọ́n ìpo-iyẹfun rẹ:
entries.en: And the river shall bring forth frogs abundantly, which shall go up and come into thine house, and into thy bedchamber, and upon thy bed, and into the house of thy servants, and upon thy people, and into thine ovens, and into thy kneadingtroughs:

entries.yo: Awọn ọpọlọ na yio si gùn ọ lara, ati lara awọn enia rẹ, ati lara gbogbo awọn iranṣẹ rẹ.
entries.en: And the frogs shall come up both on thee, and upon thy people, and upon all thy servants.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe, Wi fun Aaroni pe, Nà ọwọ́ rẹ pẹlu ọpá rẹ sori odò wọnni, sori omi ṣiṣàn, ati sori ikojọpọ̀ omi, ki o si mú ọpọlọ jade wá sori ilẹ Egipti.
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Stretch forth thine hand with thy rod over the streams, over the rivers, and over the ponds, and cause frogs to come up upon the land of Egypt.

entries.yo: Aaroni si nà ọwọ́ rẹ̀ sori omi Egipti; awọn ọpọlọ si goke wá, nwọn si bò ilẹ Egipti.
entries.en: And Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt; and the frogs came up, and covered the land of Egypt.

entries.yo: Awọn alalupayida si fi idán wọn ṣe bẹ̃, nwọn si mú ọpọlọ jade wá sori ilẹ Egipti.
entries.en: And the magicians did so with their enchantments, and brought up frogs upon the land of Egypt.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Farao pè Mose ati Aaroni, o si wipe, Ẹ bẹ̀ OLUWA, ki o le mú awọn ọpọlọ kuro lọdọ mi, ati kuro lọdọ awọn enia mi; emi o si jẹ ki awọn enia na ki o lọ, ki nwọn ki o le ṣẹbọ si OLUWA.
entries.en: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron, and said, Intreat the LORD, that he may take away the frogs from me, and from my people; and I will let the people go, that they may do sacrifice unto the LORD.

entries.yo: Mose si wi fun Farao pe, Paṣẹ fun mi: nigbawo li emi o bẹ̀bẹ fun ọ, ati fun awọn iranṣẹ rẹ, ati fun awọn enia rẹ, lati run awọn ọpọlọ kuro lọdọ rẹ, ati kuro ninu ile rẹ, ki nwọn ki o kù ni kìki odò nikan?
entries.en: And Moses said unto Pharaoh, Glory over me: when shall I intreat for thee, and for thy servants, and for thy people, to destroy the frogs from thee and thy houses, that they may remain in the river only?

entries.yo: On si wipe, Li ọla. O si wipe, Ki o ri bi ọ̀rọ rẹ; ki iwọ ki o le mọ̀ pe, kò sí ẹniti o dabi OLUWA Ọlọrun wa.
entries.en: And he said, To morrow. And he said, Be it according to thy word: that thou mayest know that there is none like unto the LORD our God.

entries.yo: Awọn ọpọlọ yio si lọ kuro lọdọ rẹ, ati kuro ninu ile rẹ, ati kuro lọdọ awọn iranṣẹ rẹ, ati kuro lọdọ awọn enia rẹ; ni kìki odò ni nwọn o kù si.
entries.en: And the frogs shall depart from thee, and from thy houses, and from thy servants, and from thy people; they shall remain in the river only.

entries.yo: Mose ati Aaroni si jade kuro lọdọ Farao: Mose si kigbe si OLUWA nitori ọpọlọ ti o ti múwa si ara Farao.
entries.en: And Moses and Aaron went out from Pharaoh: and Moses cried unto the LORD because of the frogs which he had brought against Pharaoh.

entries.yo: OLUWA si ṣe gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ Mose; awọn ọpọlọ na si kú kuro ninu ile, ninu agbalá, ati kuro ninu oko.
entries.en: And the LORD did according to the word of Moses; and the frogs died out of the houses, out of the villages, and out of the fields.

entries.yo: Nwọn si kó wọn jọ li òkiti-òkiti: ilẹ na si nrùn.
entries.en: And they gathered them together upon heaps: and the land stank.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati Farao ri pe isimi wà, o mu àiya rẹ̀ le, kò si fetisi ti wọn; bi OLUWA ti wi.
entries.en: But when Pharaoh saw that there was respite, he hardened his heart, and hearkened not unto them; as the LORD had said.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun Mose pe, Sọ fun Aaroni pe, Nà ọpá rẹ, ki o si lù ekuru ilẹ, ki o le di iná já gbogbo ilẹ Egipti.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Stretch out thy rod, and smite the dust of the land, that it may become lice throughout all the land of Egypt.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣe bẹ̃; Aaroni si nà ọwọ́ rẹ̀ pẹlu ọpá rẹ̀, o si lù erupẹ ilẹ, iná si wà lara enia, ati lara ẹran; gbogbo ekuru ilẹ li o di iná já gbogbo ilẹ Egipti.
entries.en: And they did so; for Aaron stretched out his hand with his rod, and smote the dust of the earth, and it became lice in man, and in beast; all the dust of the land became lice throughout all the land of Egypt.

entries.yo: Awọn alalupayida si fi idán wọn ṣe bẹ̃ lati mú iná jade wá, ṣugbọn nwọn kò le ṣe e: bẹ̃ni iná si wà lara enia, ati lara ẹran.
entries.en: And the magicians did so with their enchantments to bring forth lice, but they could not: so there were lice upon man, and upon beast.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni awọn alalupayida wi fun Farao pe, Ika Ọlọrun li eyi: ṣugbọn àiya Farao le, kò si fetisi ti wọn; bi OLUWA ti wi.
entries.en: Then the magicians said unto Pharaoh, This is the finger of God: and Pharaoh's heart was hardened, and he hearkened not unto them; as the LORD had said.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun Mose pe, Dide ni kutukutu owurọ̀, ki o si duro niwaju Farao; kiyesi i, o njade lọ si odò; ki o si wi fun u pe, Bayi li OLUWA wi, Jẹ ki awọn enia mi ki o lọ, ki nwọn ki o le sìn mi.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Rise up early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh; lo, he cometh forth to the water; and say unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Let my people go, that they may serve me.

entries.yo: Bi iwọ kò ba si jẹ ki awọn enia mi ki o lọ, kiyesi i, emi o rán ọwọ́ eṣinṣin si ọ, ati sara iranṣẹ rẹ, ati sara awọn enia rẹ, ati sinu awọn ile rẹ: gbogbo ile awọn ara Egipti ni yio si kún fun ọwọ́ eṣinṣin, ati ilẹ ti nwọn gbé wà pẹlu.
entries.en: Else, if thou wilt not let my people go, behold, I will send swarms of flies upon thee, and upon thy servants, and upon thy people, and into thy houses: and the houses of the Egyptians shall be full of swarms of flies, and also the ground whereon they are.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ́ na li emi o yà ilẹ Goṣeni sọ̀tọ, ninu eyiti awọn enia mi tẹ̀dó si, ti eṣinṣin ki yio sí nibẹ̀; nitori ki iwọ ki o le mọ̀ pe, emi li OLUWA lãrin ilẹ aiye.
entries.en: And I will sever in that day the land of Goshen, in which my people dwell, that no swarms of flies shall be there; to the end thou mayest know that I am the LORD in the midst of the earth.

entries.yo: Emi o si pàla si agbedemeji awọn enia mi ati awọn enia rẹ: li ọla ni iṣẹ-amì yi yio si wà.
entries.en: And I will put a division between my people and thy people: to morrow shall this sign be.

entries.yo: OLUWA si ṣe bẹ̃; ọwọ́ eṣinṣin ọ̀pọlọpọ si dé sinu ile Farao, ati sinu ile awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀: ati ni gbogbo ilẹ Egipti, ilẹ na bàjẹ́ nitori ọwọ́ eṣinṣin wọnni.
entries.en: And the LORD did so; and there came a grievous swarm of flies into the house of Pharaoh, and into his servants' houses, and into all the land of Egypt: the land was corrupted by reason of the swarm of flies.

entries.yo: Farao si ranṣẹ pè Mose ati Aaroni o si wipe; Ẹ ma lọ ṣẹbọ si Ọlọrun nyin ni ilẹ yi.
entries.en: And Pharaoh called for Moses and for Aaron, and said, Go ye, sacrifice to your God in the land.

entries.yo: Mose si wipe, Kò tọ́ lati ṣe bẹ̃; nitori awa o fi ohun irira awọn ara Egipti rubọ si OLUWA Ọlọrun wa: wò o, awa le fi ohun irira awọn ara Egipti rubọ li oju wọn, nwọn ki yio ha sọ wa li okuta?
entries.en: And Moses said, It is not meet so to do; for we shall sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians to the LORD our God: lo, shall we sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians before their eyes, and will they not stone us?

entries.yo: Awa o lọ ni ìrin ijọ́ mẹta sinu ijù, ki a si rubọ si OLUWA Ọlọrun wa, bi on o ti paṣẹ fun wa.
entries.en: We will go three days' journey into the wilderness, and sacrifice to the LORD our God, as he shall command us.

entries.yo: Farao si wipe, Emi o jẹ ki ẹnyin lọ, ki ẹ le rubọ si OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin ni ijù; kìki ki ẹnyin ki o máṣe lọ jìna jù: ẹ bẹ̀bẹ fun mi.
entries.en: And Pharaoh said, I will let you go, that ye may sacrifice to the LORD your God in the wilderness; only ye shall not go very far away: intreat for me.

entries.yo: Mose si wipe, Kiyesi i, emi njade lọ kuro lọdọ rẹ, emi o si bẹ̀ OLUWA ki ọwọ́ eṣinṣin wọnyi ki o le ṣi kuro lọdọ Farao, kuro lọdọ awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀, ati kuro lọdọ awọn enia rẹ̀, li ọla: kìki ki Farao ki o máṣe ẹ̀tan mọ́ li aijẹ ki awọn enia na ki o lọ rubọ si OLUWA.
entries.en: And Moses said, Behold, I go out from thee, and I will intreat the LORD that the swarms of flies may depart from Pharaoh, from his servants, and from his people, to morrow: but let not Pharaoh deal deceitfully any more in not letting the people go to sacrifice to the LORD.

entries.yo: Mose si jade kuro lọdọ Farao, o si bẹ̀ OLUWA.
entries.en: And Moses went out from Pharaoh, and intreated the LORD.

entries.yo: OLUWA si ṣe gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ Mose; o si ṣi ọwọ́ eṣinṣin na kuro lọdọ Farao, ati kuro lọdọ awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀, ati kuro lọdọ awọn enia rẹ̀; ọkan kò kù.
entries.en: And the LORD did according to the word of Moses; and he removed the swarms of flies from Pharaoh, from his servants, and from his people; there remained not one.

entries.yo: Farao si mu àiya rẹ̀ le nigbayi pẹlu, kò si jẹ ki awọn enia na ki o lọ.
entries.en: And Pharaoh hardened his heart at this time also, neither would he let the people go.

entries.yo: NIGBANA li OLUWA wi fun Mose pe, Wọle tọ̀ Farao lọ ki o si wi fun u pe, Bayi li OLUWA, Ọlọrun awọn Heberu wi, Jẹ ki awọn enia mi ki o lọ, ki nwọn le sìn mi.
entries.en: Then the LORD said unto Moses, Go in unto Pharaoh, and tell him, Thus saith the LORD God of the Hebrews, Let my people go, that they may serve me.

entries.yo: Nitoripe, bi iwọ ba kọ̀ lati jẹ ki nwọn lọ, ti iwọ si da wọn duro sibẹ̀,
entries.en: For if thou refuse to let them go, and wilt hold them still,

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, ọwọ́ OLUWA mbẹ lara ẹran-ọ̀sin rẹ ti mbẹ li oko, lara ẹṣin, lara kẹtẹkẹtẹ, lara ibakasiẹ, lara ọwọ́-malu, ati lara agbo-agutan wọnni: ajakalẹ-àrun buburu mbọ̀.
entries.en: Behold, the hand of the LORD is upon thy cattle which is in the field, upon the horses, upon the asses, upon the camels, upon the oxen, and upon the sheep: there shall be a very grievous murrain.

entries.yo: OLUWA yio si pàla si agbedemeji ẹran-ọ̀sin Israeli ati ẹran-ọ̀sin Egipti: kò si ohun kan ti yio kú ninu gbogbo eyiti iṣe ti awọn ọmọ Israeli.
entries.en: And the LORD shall sever between the cattle of Israel and the cattle of Egypt: and there shall nothing die of all that is the children's of Israel.

entries.yo: OLUWA si dá akokò kan wipe, Li ọla li OLUWA yio ṣe nkan yi ni ilẹ yi.
entries.en: And the LORD appointed a set time, saying, To morrow the LORD shall do this thing in the land.

entries.yo: OLUWA si ṣe nkan na ni ijọ́ keji, gbogbo ẹran-ọ̀sin Egipti si kú: ṣugbọn ninu ẹran-ọ̀sin awọn ọmọ Israeli ọkanṣoṣọ kò si kú.
entries.en: And the LORD did that thing on the morrow, and all the cattle of Egypt died: but of the cattle of the children of Israel died not one.

entries.yo: Farao si ranṣẹ, si kiyesi i, ọkanṣoṣo kò kú ninu ẹran-ọ̀sin awọn ọmọ Israeli. Àiya Farao si le, kò si jẹ ki awọn enia na ki o lọ.
entries.en: And Pharaoh sent, and, behold, there was not one of the cattle of the Israelites dead. And the heart of Pharaoh was hardened, and he did not let the people go.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun Mose ati fun Aaroni pe, Bù ikunwọ ẽru ninu ileru, ki Mose ki o kù u si oju-ọrun li oju Farao.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Moses and unto Aaron, Take to you handfuls of ashes of the furnace, and let Moses sprinkle it toward the heaven in the sight of Pharaoh.

entries.yo: Yio si di ekuru lẹbulẹbu ni gbogbo ilẹ Egipti, yio si di õwo ti yio ma tú pẹlu ileròro lara enia, ati lara ẹran, ká gbogbo ilẹ Egipti.
entries.en: And it shall become small dust in all the land of Egypt, and shall be a boil breaking forth with blains upon man, and upon beast, throughout all the land of Egypt.

entries.yo: Nwọn si bù ẽru ninu ileru, nwọn duro niwaju Farao; Mose si kù u si oke ọrun; o si di õwo ti o ntú jade pẹlu ileròro lara enia ati lara ẹran.
entries.en: And they took ashes of the furnace, and stood before Pharaoh; and Moses sprinkled it up toward heaven; and it became a boil breaking forth with blains upon man, and upon beast.

entries.yo: Awọn alalupayida kò si le duro niwaju Mose nitori õwo wọnni; nitoriti õwo na wà lara awọn alalupayida, ati lara gbogbo awọn ara Egipti.
entries.en: And the magicians could not stand before Moses because of the boils; for the boil was upon the magicians, and upon all the Egyptians.

entries.yo: OLUWA si mu àiya Farao le, kò si gbọ́ ti wọn; bi OLUWA ti sọ fun Mose.
entries.en: And the LORD hardened the heart of Pharaoh, and he hearkened not unto them; as the LORD had spoken unto Moses.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun Mose pe, Dide ni kutukutu owurọ̀, ki o si duro niwaju Farao, ki o si wi fun u pe, Bayi li OLUWA, Ọlọrun awọn Heberu wi, Jẹ ki awọn enia mi ki o lọ ki nwọn le sìn mi.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Rise up early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh, and say unto him, Thus saith the LORD God of the Hebrews, Let my people go, that they may serve me.

entries.yo: Nitori ìgba yi li emi o rán gbogbo iyọnu mi si àiya rẹ, ati sara awọn iranṣẹ rẹ, ati sara awọn enia rẹ; ki iwọ ki o le mọ̀ pe kò si ẹlomiran bi emi ni gbogbo aiye.
entries.en: For I will at this time send all my plagues upon thine heart, and upon thy servants, and upon thy people; that thou mayest know that there is none like me in all the earth.

entries.yo: Nitori nisisiyi, emi iba nà ọwọ́ mi, ki emi ki o le fi ajakalẹ-àrun lù ọ, ati awọn enia rẹ; a ba si ti ke ọ kuro lori ilẹ.
entries.en: For now I will stretch out my hand, that I may smite thee and thy people with pestilence; and thou shalt be cut off from the earth.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nitori eyi pãpa li emi ṣe mu ọ duro, lati fi agbara mi hàn lara rẹ; ati ki a le ròhin orukọ mi ká gbogbo aiye.
entries.en: And in very deed for this cause have I raised thee up, for to shew in thee my power; and that my name may be declared throughout all the earth.

entries.yo: Titi di isisiyi iwọ ngbé ara rẹ ga si awọn enia mi pe, iwọ ki yio jẹ ki nwọn ki o lọ?
entries.en: As yet exaltest thou thyself against my people, that thou wilt not let them go?

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, li ọla li akokò yi, li emi o mu ọ̀pọ yinyin rọ̀ si ilẹ, irú eyiti kò ti si ni Egipti lati ipilẹṣẹ rẹ̀ titi o fi di isisiyi.
entries.en: Behold, to morrow about this time I will cause it to rain a very grievous hail, such as hath not been in Egypt since the foundation thereof even until now.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi ranṣẹ, ki o si kó ẹran rẹ bọ̀, ati ohun gbogbo ti o ni ninu oko; nitori olukuluku enia ati ẹran ti a ba ri li oko, ti a kò si múbọ̀ wá ile, yinyin yio bọ lù wọn, nwọn o si kú.
entries.en: Send therefore now, and gather thy cattle, and all that thou hast in the field; for upon every man and beast which shall be found in the field, and shall not be brought home, the hail shall come down upon them, and they shall die.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o bẹ̀ru ọ̀rọ OLUWA ninu awọn iranṣẹ Farao, mu ki awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀ ati awọn ẹran-ọ̀sin rẹ̀ sá padà wá ile:
entries.en: He that feared the word of the LORD among the servants of Pharaoh made his servants and his cattle flee into the houses:

entries.yo: Ẹniti kò si kà ọ̀rọ OLUWA si, jọwọ awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀ ati awọn ẹran-ọ̀sin rẹ̀ si oko.
entries.en: And he that regarded not the word of the LORD left his servants and his cattle in the field.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe, Nà ọwọ́ rẹ si oke ọrun, ki yinyin ki o le bọ́ si gbogbo ilẹ Egipti, sara enia, ati sara ẹranko, ati sara eweko igbẹ́ gbogbo, já gbogbo ilẹ Egipti.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Stretch forth thine hand toward heaven, that there may be hail in all the land of Egypt, upon man, and upon beast, and upon every herb of the field, throughout the land of Egypt.

entries.yo: Mose si nà ọpá rẹ̀ si ọrun: OLUWA si rán ãra ati yinyin, iná na si njó lori ilẹ; OLUWA si rọ̀ yinyin sori ilẹ Egipti.
entries.en: And Moses stretched forth his rod toward heaven: and the LORD sent thunder and hail, and the fire ran along upon the ground; and the LORD rained hail upon the land of Egypt.

entries.yo: Yinyin si bọ́, iná si dàpọ mọ́ yinyin na, o papọ̀ju, irú rẹ̀ kò si ri ni gbogbo ilẹ Egipti lati ìgba ti o ti di orilẹ-ède.
entries.en: So there was hail, and fire mingled with the hail, very grievous, such as there was none like it in all the land of Egypt since it became a nation.

entries.yo: Yinyin na si lù ohun gbogbo ti o wà ninu oko bolẹ, ati enia ati ẹranko, já gbogbo ilẹ Egipti; yinyin na si lù gbogbo eweko bolẹ, o si fà gbogbo igi igbẹ́ ya.
entries.en: And the hail smote throughout all the land of Egypt all that was in the field, both man and beast; and the hail smote every herb of the field, and brake every tree of the field.

entries.yo: Ni kìki ilẹ Goṣeni, nibiti awọn ọmọ Israeli gbé wà, ni yinyin kò si.
entries.en: Only in the land of Goshen, where the children of Israel were, was there no hail.

entries.yo: Farao si ranṣẹ, o si pè Mose ati Aaroni, o si wi fun wọn pe, Emi ṣẹ̀ nigbayi: OLUWA li olododo, ẹni buburu si li emi ati awọn enia mi.
entries.en: And Pharaoh sent, and called for Moses and Aaron, and said unto them, I have sinned this time: the LORD is righteous, and I and my people are wicked.

entries.yo: Ẹ bẹ̀ OLUWA (o sa to) ki ãra nla ati yinyin wọnyi ki o máṣe si mọ́; emi o si jẹ ki ẹ ma lọ; ẹ ki yio si duro mọ́.
entries.en: Intreat the LORD (for it is enough) that there be no more mighty thunderings and hail; and I will let you go, and ye shall stay no longer.

entries.yo: Mose si wi fun u pe, Bi mo ba ti jade ni ilu, emi o tẹ́ ọwọ́ mi si OLUWA; ãra yio si dá, bẹ̃ni yinyin ki yio si mọ́; ki iwọ ki o le mọ̀ pe ti OLUWA li aiye.
entries.en: And Moses said unto him, As soon as I am gone out of the city, I will spread abroad my hands unto the LORD; and the thunder shall cease, neither shall there be any more hail; that thou mayest know how that the earth is the LORD's.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi o ṣe tirẹ ni ati ti awọn iranṣẹ rẹ, emi mọ̀ pe sibẹ, ẹnyin kò ti ibẹ̀ru OLUWA Ọlọrun.
entries.en: But as for thee and thy servants, I know that ye will not yet fear the LORD God.

entries.yo: A si lù ọgbọ́ ati ọkà barle bolẹ; nitori ọkà barle wà ni ipẹ́, ọgbọ́ si rudi.
entries.en: And the flax and the barley was smitten: for the barley was in the ear, and the flax was bolled.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn alikama ati ọkà (rie) li a kò lù bolẹ: nitoriti nwọn kò ti idàgba.
entries.en: But the wheat and the rie were not smitten: for they were not grown up.

entries.yo: Mose si jade kuro lọdọ Farao sẹhin ilu, o si tẹ́ ọwọ́ rẹ̀ si OLUWA; ãra ati yinyin si dá, bẹ̃li òjo kò si rọ̀ si ilẹ̀ mọ́.
entries.en: And Moses went out of the city from Pharaoh, and spread abroad his hands unto the LORD: and the thunders and hail ceased, and the rain was not poured upon the earth.

entries.yo: Nigbati Farao ri pe, òjo ati yinyin ati ãra dá, o ṣẹ̀ si i, o si sé àiya rẹ̀ le, on ati awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And when Pharaoh saw that the rain and the hail and the thunders were ceased, he sinned yet more, and hardened his heart, he and his servants.

entries.yo: Àiya Farao si le, bẹ̃ni kò si jẹ ki awọn ọmọ Israeli ki o lọ; bi OLUWA ti wi lati ọwọ́ Mose.
entries.en: And the heart of Pharaoh was hardened, neither would he let the children of Israel go; as the LORD had spoken by Moses.
