entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe, Wọle tọ̀ Farao lọ: nitoriti mo mu àiya rẹ̀ le, ati àiya awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀, ki emi ki o le fi iṣẹ-àmi mi wọnyi hàn niwaju rẹ̀:
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go in unto Pharaoh: for I have hardened his heart, and the heart of his servants, that I might shew these my signs before him:

entries.yo: Ati ki iwọ ki o le wi li eti ọmọ rẹ, ati ti ọmọ ọmọ rẹ, ohun ti mo ṣe ni Egipti, ati iṣẹ-àmi mi ti mo ṣe ninu wọn; ki ẹnyin ki o le mọ̀ pe emi li OLUWA.
entries.en: And that thou mayest tell in the ears of thy son, and of thy son's son, what things I have wrought in Egypt, and my signs which I have done among them; that ye may know how that I am the LORD.

entries.yo: Mose ati Aaroni si wọle tọ̀ Farao lọ, nwọn si wi fun u pe, Bayi li OLUWA Ọlọrun Heberu wi, Iwọ o ti kọ̀ pẹ tó lati rẹ̀ ara rẹ silẹ niwaju mi? jẹ ki awọn enia mi ki o lọ, ki nwọn ki o le sìn mi.
entries.en: And Moses and Aaron came in unto Pharaoh, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD God of the Hebrews, How long wilt thou refuse to humble thyself before me? let my people go, that they may serve me.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi iwọ ba si kọ̀ lati jẹ ki awọn enia mi ki o lọ, kiyesi i, li ọla li emi o mú eṣú wá si ẹkùn rẹ:
entries.en: Else, if thou refuse to let my people go, behold, to morrow will I bring the locusts into thy coast:

entries.yo: Nwọn o si bò oju ilẹ ti ẹnikan ki yio fi le ri ilẹ: nwọn o si jẹ ajẹkù eyiti o bọ́, ti o kù fun nyin lọwọ yinyin, yio si jẹ igi nyin gbogbo ti o nruwe ninu oko.
entries.en: And they shall cover the face of the earth, that one cannot be able to see the earth: and they shall eat the residue of that which is escaped, which remaineth unto you from the hail, and shall eat every tree which groweth for you out of the field:

entries.yo: Nwọn o si kún ile rẹ, ati ile awọn iranṣẹ rẹ gbogbo, ati ile awọn ara Egipti gbogbo; ti awọn baba rẹ, ati awọn baba baba rẹ kò ri ri, lati ìgba ọjọ́ ti nwọn ti wà lori ilẹ titi o fi di oni-oloni. O si yipada, o jade kuro lọdọ Farao.
entries.en: And they shall fill thy houses, and the houses of all thy servants, and the houses of all the Egyptians; which neither thy fathers, nor thy fathers' fathers have seen, since the day that they were upon the earth unto this day. And he turned himself, and went out from Pharaoh.

entries.yo: Awọn iranṣẹ Farao si wi fun u pe, ọkunrin yi yio ti ṣe ikẹkùn si wa pẹ to? jẹ ki awọn ọkunrin na ki o lọ, ki nwọn ki o le sìn OLUWA Ọlọrun wọn: iwọ kò ti imọ̀ pe Egipti run tán?
entries.en: And Pharaoh's servants said unto him, How long shall this man be a snare unto us? let the men go, that they may serve the LORD their God: knowest thou not yet that Egypt is destroyed?

entries.yo: A si tun mú Mose ati Aaroni wá sọdọ Farao: o si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ lọ sìn OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin; ṣugbọn awọn tani yio ha lọ?
entries.en: And Moses and Aaron were brought again unto Pharaoh: and he said unto them, Go, serve the LORD your God: but who are they that shall go?

entries.yo: Mose si wipe, Awa o lọ ati ewe ati àgba, ati awọn ọmọkunrin wa ati awọn ọmọbinrin wa, pẹlu awọn agbo, ati ọwọ́-ẹran wa li awa o lọ; nitori ajọ OLUWA ni fun wa:
entries.en: And Moses said, We will go with our young and with our old, with our sons and with our daughters, with our flocks and with our herds will we go; for we must hold a feast unto the LORD.

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Ki OLUWA ki o pẹlu nyin bẹ̃, bi emi o ti jẹ ki ẹ lọ yi, ati awọn ewe nyin: ẹ wò o; nitori ibi mbẹ niwaju nyin.
entries.en: And he said unto them, Let the LORD be so with you, as I will let you go, and your little ones: look to it; for evil is before you.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃kọ: ẹnyin ọkunrin ẹ lọ, ki ẹ si sìn OLUWA; eyinì li ẹnyin sá nfẹ́. Nwọn si lé wọn jade kuro niwaju Farao.
entries.en: Not so: go now ye that are men, and serve the LORD; for that ye did desire. And they were driven out from Pharaoh's presence.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun Mose pe, Nà ọwọ́ rẹ sori ilẹ Egipti nitori eṣú, ki nwọn ki o le wá sori ilẹ Egipti, ki nwọn ki o si le jẹ gbogbo eweko ilẹ yi, gbogbo eyiti yinyin ti kù silẹ.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Stretch out thine hand over the land of Egypt for the locusts, that they may come up upon the land of Egypt, and eat every herb of the land, even all that the hail hath left.

entries.yo: Mose si nà ọpá rẹ̀ si ori ilẹ Egipti, OLUWA si mu afẹfẹ ìla-õrùn kan fẹ́ si ori ilẹ na, ni gbogbo ọsán na, ati gbogbo oru na; nigbati o di owurọ̀, afẹfẹ ila-õrùn mú awọn eṣú na wá.
entries.en: And Moses stretched forth his rod over the land of Egypt, and the LORD brought an east wind upon the land all that day, and all that night; and when it was morning, the east wind brought the locusts.

entries.yo: Awọn eṣú na si goke sori ilẹ Egipti gbogbo, nwọn si bà si ẹkùn Egipti gbogbo; nwọn papọ̀ju, kò si irú eṣú bẹ̃ ṣaju wọn, bẹ̃ni lẹhin wọn irú wọn ki yio si si.
entries.en: And the locusts went up over all the land of Egypt, and rested in all the coasts of Egypt: very grievous were they; before them there were no such locusts as they, neither after them shall be such.

entries.yo: Nitoriti nwọn bò oju ilẹ gbogbo, tobẹ̃ ti ilẹ fi ṣú; nwọn si jẹ gbogbo eweko ilẹ na, ati gbogbo eso igi ti yinyin kù silẹ: kò si kù ohun tutù kan lara igi, tabi lara eweko igbẹ́, já gbogbo ilẹ Egipti.
entries.en: For they covered the face of the whole earth, so that the land was darkened; and they did eat every herb of the land, and all the fruit of the trees which the hail had left: and there remained not any green thing in the trees, or in the herbs of the field, through all the land of Egypt.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Farao ranṣẹ pè Mose ati Aaroni kánkan; o si wipe, Emi ti ṣẹ̀ si OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin, ati si nyin.
entries.en: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron in haste; and he said, I have sinned against the LORD your God, and against you.

entries.yo: Njẹ nitorina emi bẹ̀ nyin, ẹ fi ẹ̀ṣẹ mi jì lẹ̃kanṣoṣo yi, ki ẹ si bẹ̀ OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin, ki o le mú ikú yi kuro lọdọ mi.
entries.en: Now therefore forgive, I pray thee, my sin only this once, and intreat the LORD your God, that he may take away from me this death only.

entries.yo: On si jade kuro niwaju Farao, o si bẹ̀ OLUWA.
entries.en: And he went out from Pharaoh, and intreated the LORD.

entries.yo: OLUWA si yi afẹfẹ ìwọ-õrùn lile-lile ti o si fẹ́ awọn eṣú na kuro, o si gbá wọn lọ sinu Okun Pupa; kò si kù eṣú kanṣoṣo ni gbogbo ẹkùn Egipti.
entries.en: And the LORD turned a mighty strong west wind, which took away the locusts, and cast them into the Red sea; there remained not one locust in all the coasts of Egypt.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn OLUWA mu àiya Farao le, bẹ̃ni kò si jẹ ki awọn ọmọ Israeli ki o lọ.
entries.en: But the LORD hardened Pharaoh's heart, so that he would not let the children of Israel go.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun Mose pe, Nà ọwọ́ rẹ si ọrun, ki òkunkun ki o ṣú yiká ilẹ Egipti, ani òkunkun ti a le fọwọbà.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Stretch out thine hand toward heaven, that there may be darkness over the land of Egypt, even darkness which may be felt.

entries.yo: Mose si nà ọwọ́ rẹ̀ si ọrun; òkunkun biribiri si ṣú ni gbogbo ilẹ Egipti ni ijọ́ mẹta:
entries.en: And Moses stretched forth his hand toward heaven; and there was a thick darkness in all the land of Egypt three days:

entries.yo: Nwọn kò ri ara wọn, bẹ̃li ẹnikan kò si dide ni ipò tirẹ̀ ni ijọ́ mẹta: ṣugbọn gbogbo awọn ọmọ Israeli li o ni imọle ni ibugbé wọn.
entries.en: They saw not one another, neither rose any from his place for three days: but all the children of Israel had light in their dwellings.

entries.yo: Farao si pè Mose, o si wipe, Ẹ ma lọ, ẹ sìn OLUWA; kìki agbo ati ọwọ́-ẹran nyin ni ki o kù lẹhin; ki awọn ewe nyin ki o bá nyin lọ pẹlu.
entries.en: And Pharaoh called unto Moses, and said, Go ye, serve the LORD; only let your flocks and your herds be stayed: let your little ones also go with you.

entries.yo: Mose si wipe, Iwọ kò le ṣaima fun wa li ohun ẹbọ pẹlu ati ẹbọ sisun, ti awa o fi rubọ si OLUWA Ọlọrun wa.
entries.en: And Moses said, Thou must give us also sacrifices and burnt offerings, that we may sacrifice unto the LORD our God.

entries.yo: Ẹran-ọ̀sin wa yio si bá wa lọ pẹlu; a ki yio fi ibósẹ-ẹran kan silẹ lẹhin; nitori ninu rẹ̀ li awa o mú sìn OLUWA Ọlọrun wa; awa kò si mọ̀ ohun na ti a o fi sìn OLUWA, titi awa o fi dé ibẹ̀.
entries.en: Our cattle also shall go with us; there shall not an hoof be left behind; for thereof must we take to serve the LORD our God; and we know not with what we must serve the LORD, until we come thither.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn OLUWA mu àiya Farao le, kò si fẹ́ jẹ ki nwọn lọ.
entries.en: But the LORD hardened Pharaoh's heart, and he would not let them go.

entries.yo: Farao si wi fun u pe, Kuro lọdọ mi, ma ṣọ́ ara rẹ, máṣe tun ri oju mi mọ́; nitori ni ijọ́ na ti iwọ ba ri oju mi iwọ o kú.
entries.en: And Pharaoh said unto him, Get thee from me, take heed to thyself, see my face no more; for in that day thou seest my face thou shalt die.

entries.yo: Mose si wipe, Iwọ fọ̀ rere; emi ki yio tun ri oju rẹ mọ́.
entries.en: And Moses said, Thou hast spoken well, I will see thy face again no more.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun Mose pe, Emi o tun mú iyọnu kan wá sara Farao, ati sara Egipti; lẹhin eyinì ni on o jọwọ nyin lọwọ lọ lati ihin: nigbati on o jẹ ki ẹ lọ, àtitán ni yio tì nyin jade nihin.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Yet will I bring one plague more upon Pharaoh, and upon Egypt; afterwards he will let you go hence: when he shall let you go, he shall surely thrust you out hence altogether.

entries.yo: Wi nisisiyi li eti awọn enia wọnyi, ki olukuluku ọkunrin ki o bère lọdọ aladugbo rẹ̀ ati olukuluku obinrin lọdọ aladugbo rẹ̀, ohun-èlo fadaka, ati ohun-èlo wurà.
entries.en: Speak now in the ears of the people, and let every man borrow of his neighbour, and every woman of her neighbour, jewels of silver, and jewels of gold.

entries.yo: OLUWA si fi ojurere fun awọn enia na li oju awọn ara Egipti. Pẹlupẹlu Mose ọkunrin nì o pọ̀ gidigidi ni ilẹ Egipti, li oju awọn iranṣẹ Farao, ati li oju awọn enia na.
entries.en: And the LORD gave the people favour in the sight of the Egyptians. Moreover the man Moses was very great in the land of Egypt, in the sight of Pharaoh's servants, and in the sight of the people.

entries.yo: Mose si wipe, Bayi li OLUWA wi, Lãrin ọganjọ li emi o jade lọ sãrin Egipti:
entries.en: And Moses said, Thus saith the LORD, About midnight will I go out into the midst of Egypt:

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn akọ́bi ti o wà ni ilẹ Egipti ni yio si kú, lati akọ́bi Farao lọ ti o joko lori itẹ́ rẹ̀, titi yio si fi dé akọ́bi iranṣẹbinrin ti o wà lẹhin ọlọ; ati gbogbo akọ́bi ẹran.
entries.en: And all the firstborn in the land of Egypt shall die, from the firstborn of Pharaoh that sitteth upon his throne, even unto the firstborn of the maidservant that is behind the mill; and all the firstborn of beasts.

entries.yo: Ẹkún nla yio si wà ni gbogbo ilẹ Egipti, eyiti irú rẹ̀ kò si ri, ti ki yio si si irú rẹ̀ mọ́.
entries.en: And there shall be a great cry throughout all the land of Egypt, such as there was none like it, nor shall be like it any more.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn si ọkan ninu awọn ọmọ Israeli li ajá ki yio yọ ahọn rẹ̀, si enia tabi si ẹran: ki ẹnyin ki o le mọ̀ bi OLUWA ti fi ìyatọ sãrin awọn ara Egipti ati Israeli.
entries.en: But against any of the children of Israel shall not a dog move his tongue, against man or beast: that ye may know how that the LORD doth put a difference between the Egyptians and Israel.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn iranṣẹ rẹ wọnyi ni yio si sọkalẹ tọ̀ mi wá, ti nwọn o si fori wọn balẹ fun mi pe, Iwọ jade lọ ati gbogbo awọn enia ẹhin rẹ: lẹhin ìgba na li emi o to jade. O si jade kuro niwaju Farao ni ibinu nla.
entries.en: And all these thy servants shall come down unto me, and bow down themselves unto me, saying, Get thee out, and all the people that follow thee: and after that I will go out. And he went out from Pharaoh in a great anger.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun Mose pe, Farao ki yio gbọ́ tirẹ; ki a le sọ iṣẹ-iyanu mi di pupọ̀ ni ilẹ Egipti.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Pharaoh shall not hearken unto you; that my wonders may be multiplied in the land of Egypt.

entries.yo: Mose ati Aaroni si ṣe gbogbo iṣẹ-iyanu wọnyi niwaju Farao: OLUWA si mu àiya Farao le, bẹ̃ni kò si fẹ́ jẹ ki awọn ọmọ Israeli ki o jade lọ kuro ni ilẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Moses and Aaron did all these wonders before Pharaoh: and the LORD hardened Pharaoh's heart, so that he would not let the children of Israel go out of his land.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose ati Aaroni ni ilẹ Egipti pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses and Aaron in the land of Egypt, saying,

entries.yo: Oṣù yi ni yio ṣe akọ́kà oṣù fun nyin: on ni yio ṣe ekini oṣù ọdún fun nyin.
entries.en: This month shall be unto you the beginning of months: it shall be the first month of the year to you.

entries.yo: Ẹ sọ fun gbogbo ijọ awọn enia Israeli pe, Ni ijọ́ kẹwa oṣù yi ni ki olukuluku wọn ki o mú ọdọ-agutan sọdọ, gẹgẹ bi ile baba wọn, ọdọ-agutan kan fun ile kan:
entries.en: Speak ye unto all the congregation of Israel, saying, In the tenth day of this month they shall take to them every man a lamb, according to the house of their fathers, a lamb for an house:

entries.yo: Bi awọn ara ile na ba si kere jù ìwọn ọdọ-agutan na lọ, ki on ati aladugbo rẹ̀ ti o sunmọ-eti ile rẹ̀, ki o mú gẹgẹ bi iye awọn ọkàn na, olukuluku ni ìwọn ijẹ rẹ̀ ni ki ẹ ṣiro ọdọ-agutan na.
entries.en: And if the household be too little for the lamb, let him and his neighbour next unto his house take it according to the number of the souls; every man according to his eating shall make your count for the lamb.

entries.yo: Ailabùku ni ki ọdọ-agutan nyin ki o jẹ́, akọ ọlọdún kan: ẹnyin o mú u ninu agutan, tabi ninu ewurẹ:
entries.en: Your lamb shall be without blemish, a male of the first year: ye shall take it out from the sheep, or from the goats:

entries.yo: Ẹnyin o si fi i pamọ́ titi o fi di ijọ́ kẹrinla oṣù na: gbogbo agbajọ ijọ Israeli ni yio pa a li aṣalẹ.
entries.en: And ye shall keep it up until the fourteenth day of the same month: and the whole assembly of the congregation of Israel shall kill it in the evening.

entries.yo: Nwọn o si mú ninu ẹ̀jẹ na, nwọn o si fi tọ́ ara opó ìha mejeji, ati sara atẹrigba ile wọnni, ninu eyiti nwọn o jẹ ẹ.
entries.en: And they shall take of the blood, and strike it on the two side posts and on the upper door post of the houses, wherein they shall eat it.

entries.yo: Nwọn o si jẹ ẹran na ti a fi iná sun li oru na, ati àkara alaiwu; ewebẹ kikorò ni nwọn o fi jẹ ẹ.
entries.en: And they shall eat the flesh in that night, roast with fire, and unleavened bread; and with bitter herbs they shall eat it.

entries.yo: Ẹ máṣe jẹ ninu rẹ̀ ni tutù, tabi ti a fi omi bọ̀, bikoṣepe sisun ninu iná; ati ori rẹ̀, ati itan rẹ̀, ati akopọ̀ inu rẹ̀ pẹlu.
entries.en: Eat not of it raw, nor sodden at all with water, but roast with fire; his head with his legs, and with the purtenance thereof.

entries.yo: Ẹ kò si gbọdọ jẹ ki nkan ki o kù silẹ ninu rẹ̀ dé ojumọ́; eyiti o ba si kù di ijọ́ keji on ni ki ẹnyin ki o daná sun.
entries.en: And ye shall let nothing of it remain until the morning; and that which remaineth of it until the morning ye shall burn with fire.

entries.yo: Bayi li ẹnyin o si jẹ ẹ; ti ẹnyin ti àmure didì li ẹgbẹ nyin, bàta nyin li ẹsẹ̀ nyin, ati ọpá nyin li ọwọ́ nyin, ẹnyin o si yara jẹ ẹ: irekọja OLUWA ni.
entries.en: And thus shall ye eat it; with your loins girded, your shoes on your feet, and your staff in your hand; and ye shall eat it in haste: it is the LORD's passover.

entries.yo: Nitoriti emi o là ilẹ Egipti já li oru na, emi o si kọlù gbogbo awọn akọ́bi ni ilẹ Egipti, ti enia ati ti ẹran; ati lara gbogbo oriṣa Egipti li emi o ṣe idajọ: emi li OLUWA.
entries.en: For I will pass through the land of Egypt this night, and will smite all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both man and beast; and against all the gods of Egypt I will execute judgment: I am the LORD.

entries.yo: Ẹ̀jẹ na ni yio si ṣe àmi fun nyin lara ile ti ẹnyin gbé wà: nigbati emi ba ri ẹ̀jẹ na, emi o ré nyin kọja, iyọnu na ki yio wá sori nyin lati run nyin nigbati mo ba kọlù ilẹ Egipti.
entries.en: And the blood shall be to you for a token upon the houses where ye are: and when I see the blood, I will pass over you, and the plague shall not be upon you to destroy you, when I smite the land of Egypt.

entries.yo: Ọjọ́ oni ni yio si ma ṣe ọjọ́ iranti fun nyin, ẹnyin o si ma ṣe e li ajọ fun OLUWA ni iran-iran nyin, ẹ o si ma ṣe e li ajọ nipa ìlana lailai.
entries.en: And this day shall be unto you for a memorial; and ye shall keep it a feast to the LORD throughout your generations; ye shall keep it a feast by an ordinance for ever.

entries.yo: Ijọ́ meje li ẹ o fi ma jẹ àkara alaiwu; li ọjọ́ kini gan li ẹ o palẹ iwukàra mọ́ kuro ni ile nyin; nitori ẹniti o ba jẹ àkara wiwu lati ọjọ́ kini lọ titi o fi di ọjọ́ keje, ọkàn na li a o ke kuro ninu Israeli.
entries.en: Seven days shall ye eat unleavened bread; even the first day ye shall put away leaven out of your houses: for whosoever eateth leavened bread from the first day until the seventh day, that soul shall be cut off from Israel.

entries.yo: Ati li ọjọ́ kini ki apejọ mimọ́ ki o wà, ati li ọjọ́ keje apejọ mimọ́ yio wà fun nyin; a ki yio ṣe iṣẹkiṣẹ ninu wọn, bikoṣe eyiti olukuluku yio jẹ, kìki eyinì li a le ṣe ninu nyin.
entries.en: And in the first day there shall be an holy convocation, and in the seventh day there shall be an holy convocation to you; no manner of work shall be done in them, save that which every man must eat, that only may be done of you.

entries.yo: Ẹ o si kiyesi ajọ aiwukàra; nitori li ọjọ́ na gan ni mo mú ogun nyin jade kuro ni ilẹ Egipti; nitorina ni ki ẹ ma kiyesi ọjọ́ na ni iran-iran nyin nipa ìlana lailai.
entries.en: And ye shall observe the feast of unleavened bread; for in this selfsame day have I brought your armies out of the land of Egypt: therefore shall ye observe this day in your generations by an ordinance for ever.

entries.yo: Li oṣù kini li ọjọ kẹrinla oṣù na li aṣalẹ li ẹ o jẹ àkara alaiwu, titi yio fi di ọjọ́ kọkanlelogun oṣù na li aṣalẹ.
entries.en: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month at even, ye shall eat unleavened bread, until the one and twentieth day of the month at even.

entries.yo: Ni ọjọ́ meje ni ki a máṣe ri iwukàra ninu ile nyin: nitori ẹniti o ba jẹ eyiti a wu, ọkàn na li a o ke kuro ninu ijọ Israeli, iba ṣe alejò, tabi ẹniti a bi ni ilẹ na.
entries.en: Seven days shall there be no leaven found in your houses: for whosoever eateth that which is leavened, even that soul shall be cut off from the congregation of Israel, whether he be a stranger, or born in the land.

entries.yo: Ẹ kò gbọdọ jẹ ohunkohun ti a wu; ninu ibugbé nyin gbogbo li ẹnyin o jẹ àkara alaiwu.
entries.en: Ye shall eat nothing leavened; in all your habitations shall ye eat unleavened bread.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Mose pè gbogbo awọn àgba Israeli, o si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ jade lọ imú ọdọ-agutan fun ara nyin, gẹgẹ bi idile nyin, ki ẹ si pa irekọja na.
entries.en: Then Moses called for all the elders of Israel, and said unto them, Draw out and take you a lamb according to your families, and kill the passover.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin o si mú ìdi ewe-hissopu, ẹ o si fi bọ̀ ẹ̀jẹ ti o wà ninu awokoto, ẹ o si fi ẹ̀jẹ na ti o wà ninu awokoto kùn ara atẹrigba, ati opó ìha mejeji; ẹnikẹni ninu nyin kò si gbọdọ jade lati ẹnu-ọ̀na ile rẹ̀ titi yio fi di owurọ̀.
entries.en: And ye shall take a bunch of hyssop, and dip it in the blood that is in the bason, and strike the lintel and the two side posts with the blood that is in the bason; and none of you shall go out at the door of his house until the morning.

entries.yo: Nitoriti OLUWA yio kọja lati kọlù awọn ara Egipti; nigbati o ba si ri ẹ̀jẹ lara atẹrigba, ati lara opó ìha mejeji, OLUWA yio si rekọja ẹnu-ọ̀na na, ki yio jẹ ki apanirun ki o wọle nyin wá lati kọlù nyin.
entries.en: For the LORD will pass through to smite the Egyptians; and when he seeth the blood upon the lintel, and on the two side posts, the LORD will pass over the door, and will not suffer the destroyer to come in unto your houses to smite you.

entries.yo: Ẹ o si ma kiyesi nkan yi nipa ìlana fun ọ, ati fun awọn ọmọ rẹ lailai.
entries.en: And ye shall observe this thing for an ordinance to thee and to thy sons for ever.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati ẹ ba dé ilẹ na ti OLUWA yio fi fun nyin, gẹgẹ bi o ti wi, bẹ̃li ẹ o si ma kiyesi ìsin yi.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass, when ye be come to the land which the LORD will give you, according as he hath promised, that ye shall keep this service.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe nigbati awọn ọmọ nyin ba bi nyin pe, Eredi ìsin yi?
entries.en: And it shall come to pass, when your children shall say unto you, What mean ye by this service?

entries.yo: Ki ẹ wipe, Ẹbọ irekọja OLUWA ni, ẹniti o rekọja ile awọn ọmọ Israeli ni Egipti, nigbati o kọlù awọn ara Egipti, ti o si dá ile wa si. Awọn enia si tẹriba nwọn si sìn.
entries.en: That ye shall say, It is the sacrifice of the LORD's passover, who passed over the houses of the children of Israel in Egypt, when he smote the Egyptians, and delivered our houses. And the people bowed the head and worshipped.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Israeli si lọ, nwọn si ṣe bi OLUWA ti fi aṣẹ fun Mose ati Aaroni, bẹ̃ni nwọn ṣe.
entries.en: And the children of Israel went away, and did as the LORD had commanded Moses and Aaron, so did they.

entries.yo: O si ṣe lãrin ọganjọ́ li OLUWA pa gbogbo awọn akọ́bi ni ilẹ Egipti, lati akọ́bi Farao lọ ti o joko lori itẹ́ rẹ̀ titi o fi dé akọ́bi ẹrú ti o wà ni túbu; ati gbogbo akọ́bi ẹran-ọ̀sin.
entries.en: And it came to pass, that at midnight the LORD smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharoah that sat on his throne unto the firstborn of the captive that was in the dungeon; and all the firstborn of cattle.

entries.yo: Farao si dide li oru, on ati gbogbo awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀, ati awọn ara Egipti; igbe nla si ta ni Egipti; nitoriti kò si ile kan ti enia kan kò kú.
entries.en: And Pharaoh rose up in the night, he, and all his servants, and all the Egyptians; and there was a great cry in Egypt; for there was not a house where there was not one dead.

entries.yo: O si pè Mose on Aaroni li oru, o si wipe, Ẹ dide, ki ẹ jade lọ kuro lãrin awọn enia mi, ati ẹnyin ati awọn ọmọ Israeli; ki ẹ si lọ sìn OLUWA, bi ẹ ti wi.
entries.en: And he called for Moses and Aaron by night, and said, Rise up, and get you forth from among my people, both ye and the children of Israel; and go, serve the LORD, as ye have said.

entries.yo: Ẹ si mú agbo nyin ati ọwọ́-ẹran nyin, bi ẹ ti wi, ki ẹ si ma lọ; ki ẹ si sure fun mi pẹlu.
entries.en: Also take your flocks and your herds, as ye have said, and be gone; and bless me also.

entries.yo: Awọn ara Egipti si nrọ̀ awọn enia na, ki nwọn ki o le rán wọn jade lọ kuro ni ilẹ na kánkan; nitoriti nwọn wipe, Gbogbo wa di okú.
entries.en: And the Egyptians were urgent upon the people, that they might send them out of the land in haste; for they said, We be all dead men.

entries.yo: Awọn enia na si mú iyẹfun pipò wọn ki nwọn ki o to fi iwukàra si i, a si dì ọpọ́n ìpo-iyẹfun wọn sinu aṣọ wọn lé ejika wọn.
entries.en: And the people took their dough before it was leavened, their kneadingtroughs being bound up in their clothes upon their shoulders.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Israeli si ṣe gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ Mose; nwọn si bère ohun-èlo fadaka, ati ohun-èlo wurà, ati aṣọ lọwọ awọn ara Egipti.
entries.en: And the children of Israel did according to the word of Moses; and they borrowed of the Egyptians jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment:

entries.yo: OLUWA si fun awọn enia na li ojurere li oju awọn ara Egipti, bẹ̃ni nwọn si fun wọn li ohun ti nwọn bère. Nwọn si kó ẹrù awọn ara Egipti.
entries.en: And the LORD gave the people favour in the sight of the Egyptians, so that they lent unto them such things as they required. And they spoiled the Egyptians.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Israeli si rìn lati Ramesesi lọ si Sukkotu, nwọn to ìwọn ọgbọ̀n ọkẹ ẹlẹsẹ̀ ọkunrin, li àika ọmọde.
entries.en: And the children of Israel journeyed from Rameses to Succoth, about six hundred thousand on foot that were men, beside children.

entries.yo: Ati ọ̀pọ enia ti o dàpọ mọ́ wọn bá wọn goke lọ pẹlu; ati agbo, ati ọwọ́-ẹran, ani ọ̀pọlọpọ ẹran.
entries.en: And a mixed multitude went up also with them; and flocks, and herds, even very much cattle.

entries.yo: Nwọn si yan àkara iyẹfun pipò alaiwu ti nwọn mú jade ti Egipti wá, nwọn kò sa fi iwukàra si i; nitoriti a tì wọn jade kuro ni Egipti, nwọn kò si le duro, bẹ̃ni nwọn kò pèse ohun jijẹ kan fun ara wọn.
entries.en: And they baked unleavened cakes of the dough which they brought forth out of Egypt, for it was not leavened; because they were thrust out of Egypt, and could not tarry, neither had they prepared for themselves any victual.

entries.yo: Njẹ ìgba atipo awọn ọmọ Israeli ti nwọn ṣe ni ilẹ Egipti, o jẹ́ irinwo ọdún o le ọgbọ̀n.
entries.en: Now the sojourning of the children of Israel, who dwelt in Egypt, was four hundred and thirty years.

entries.yo: O si ṣe li opin irinwo ọdún o le ọgbọ̀n, ani li ọjọ́ na gan, li o si ṣe ti gbogbo ogun OLUWA jade kuro ni ilẹ Egipti.
entries.en: And it came to pass at the end of the four hundred and thirty years, even the selfsame day it came to pass, that all the hosts of the LORD went out from the land of Egypt.

entries.yo: Oru ti a ikiyesi ni gidigidi si OLUWA ni mimú wọn jade kuro ni ilẹ Egipti: eyi li oru ti a ikiyesi si OLUWA, li ati irandiran gbogbo awọn ọmọ Israeli.
entries.en: It is a night to be much observed unto the LORD for bringing them out from the land of Egypt: this is that night of the LORD to be observed of all the children of Israel in their generations.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun Mose ati Aaroni pe, Eyi ni ìlana irekọja: alejokalejò ki yio jẹ ninu rẹ̀:
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Moses and Aaron, This is the ordinance of the passover: There shall no stranger eat thereof:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn iranṣẹ ẹnikẹni ti a fi owo rà, nigbati iwọ ba kọ ọ nilà, nigbana ni ki o jẹ ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: But every man's servant that is bought for money, when thou hast circumcised him, then shall he eat thereof.

entries.yo: Alejò ati alagbaṣe ki yio jẹ ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: A foreigner and an hired servant shall not eat thereof.

entries.yo: Ni ile kan li a o jẹ ẹ; iwọ kò gbọdọ mú ninu ẹran rẹ̀ jade sode kuro ninu ile na; bẹ̃li ẹnyin kò gbọdọ fọ́ ọkan ninu egungun rẹ̀.
entries.en: In one house shall it be eaten; thou shalt not carry forth ought of the flesh abroad out of the house; neither shall ye break a bone thereof.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ijọ Israeli ni yio ṣe e.
entries.en: All the congregation of Israel shall keep it.

entries.yo: Nigbati alejò kan ba nṣe atipo lọdọ rẹ, ti o si nṣe ajọ irekọja si OLUWA, ki a kọ gbogbo ọkunrin rẹ̀ nilà, nigbana ni ki ẹ jẹ ki o sunmọtosi, ki o si ṣe e; on o si dabi ẹniti a bi ni ilẹ na: nitoriti kò si ẹni alaikọlà ti yio jẹ ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And when a stranger shall sojourn with thee, and will keep the passover to the LORD, let all his males be circumcised, and then let him come near and keep it; and he shall be as one that is born in the land: for no uncircumcised person shall eat thereof.

entries.yo: Ofin kan ni fun ibilẹ ati fun alejò ti o ṣe atipo ninu nyin.
entries.en: One law shall be to him that is homeborn, and unto the stranger that sojourneth among you.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni gbogbo awọn ọmọ Israeli ṣe; bi OLUWA ti fi aṣẹ fun Mose ati Aaroni, bẹ̃ni nwọn ṣe.
entries.en: Thus did all the children of Israel; as the LORD commanded Moses and Aaron, so did they.

entries.yo: O si ṣe li ọjọ́ na gan, OLUWA mú awọn ọmọ Israeli jade kuro ni ilẹ Egipti, gẹgẹ bi ogun wọn.
entries.en: And it came to pass the selfsame day, that the LORD did bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt by their armies.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Yà gbogbo awọn akọ́bi sọ̀tọ fun mi, gbogbo eyiti iṣe akọ́bi ninu awọn ọmọ Israeli, ati ti enia, ati ti ẹran: ti emi ni iṣe.
entries.en: Sanctify unto me all the firstborn, whatsoever openeth the womb among the children of Israel, both of man and of beast: it is mine.

entries.yo: Mose si wi fun awọn enia na pe, Ẹ ranti ọjọ́ oni, ninu eyiti ẹnyin jade kuro ni Egipti, kuro li oko-ẹrú; nitori ọwọ́ agbara li OLUWA fi mú nyin jade kuro nihin: a ki yio si jẹ àkara wiwu.
entries.en: And Moses said unto the people, Remember this day, in which ye came out from Egypt, out of the house of bondage; for by strength of hand the LORD brought you out from this place: there shall no leavened bread be eaten.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ́ oni li ẹnyin jade li oṣù Abibu.
entries.en: This day came ye out in the month Abib.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe nigbati OLUWA yio mú ọ dé ilẹ awọn ara Kenaani, ati ti awọn enia Hitti, ati ti awọn ara Amori, ati awọn Hifi, ati awọn Jebusi, ti o ti bura fun awọn baba rẹ lati fi fun ọ, ilẹ ti nṣàn fun warà ati fun oyin, on ni iwọ o ma sìn ìsin yi li oṣù yi.
entries.en: And it shall be when the LORD shall bring thee into the land of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, which he sware unto thy fathers to give thee, a land flowing with milk and honey, that thou shalt keep this service in this month.

entries.yo: Ijọ́ meje ni iwọ o fi jẹ àkara alaiwu, li ọjọ́ keje li ajọ yio wà fun OLUWA.
entries.en: Seven days thou shalt eat unleavened bread, and in the seventh day shall be a feast to the LORD.

entries.yo: Ọjọ́ meje li a o fi jẹ àkara alaiwu; ki a má si ṣe ri àkara wiwu lọdọ rẹ, bẹ̃ni ki a má si ṣe ri iwukàra lọdọ rẹ ni gbogbo ẹkùn rẹ.
entries.en: Unleavened bread shall be eaten seven days; and there shall no leavened bread be seen with thee, neither shall there be leaven seen with thee in all thy quarters.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si sọ fun ọmọ rẹ li ọjọ́ na pe, A nṣe eyi nitori eyiti OLUWA ṣe fun mi nigbati mo jade kuro ni Egipti.
entries.en: And thou shalt shew thy son in that day, saying, This is done because of that which the LORD did unto me when I came forth out of Egypt.

entries.yo: Yio si ma ṣe àmi fun ọ li ọwọ́ rẹ, ati fun àmi iranti li agbedemeji oju rẹ, ki ofin OLUWA ki o le wà li ẹnu rẹ: nitori ọwọ́ agbara li OLUWA fi mú ọ jade kuro ni Egipti.
entries.en: And it shall be for a sign unto thee upon thine hand, and for a memorial between thine eyes, that the LORD's law may be in thy mouth: for with a strong hand hath the LORD brought thee out of Egypt.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni ki iwọ ki o ma kiyesi ìlana yi li akokò rẹ̀ li ọdọdún.
entries.en: Thou shalt therefore keep this ordinance in his season from year to year.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe nigbati OLUWA ba mú ọ dé ilẹ awọn ara Kenaani, bi o ti bura fun ọ, ati fun awọn baba rẹ, ti yio si fi fun ọ.
entries.en: And it shall be when the LORD shall bring thee into the land of the Canaanites, as he sware unto thee and to thy fathers, and shall give it thee,

entries.yo: Ni iwọ o si yà gbogbo akọ́bi sọ̀tọ fun OLUWA, ati gbogbo akọ́bi ẹran ti iwọ ni; ti OLUWA li awọn akọ.
entries.en: That thou shalt set apart unto the LORD all that openeth the matrix, and every firstling that cometh of a beast which thou hast; the males shall be the LORD's.

entries.yo: Ati gbogbo akọ́bi kẹtẹkẹtẹ ni ki iwọ ki o fi ọdọ-agutan rapada; bi iwọ kò ba rà a pada, njẹ ki iwọ ki o sẹ ẹ li ọrùn: ati gbogbo akọ́bi enia ninu awọn ọmọ ọkunrin rẹ ni iwọ o rapada.
entries.en: And every firstling of an ass thou shalt redeem with a lamb; and if thou wilt not redeem it, then thou shalt break his neck: and all the firstborn of man among thy children shalt thou redeem.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe nigbati ọmọ rẹ yio bère lọwọ rẹ lẹhin-ọla pe, Kili eyi? ki iwọ ki o wi fun u pe, Ọwọ́ agbara li OLUWA fi mú wa jade kuro ni ilẹ Egipti, kuro li oko-ẹrú:
entries.en: And it shall be when thy son asketh thee in time to come, saying, What is this? that thou shalt say unto him, By strength of hand the LORD brought us out from Egypt, from the house of bondage:

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati Farao kọ̀ lati jẹ ki a lọ, on li OLUWA pa gbogbo akọ́bi ni ilẹ Egipti, ati akọ́bi enia, ati akọ́bi ẹran; nitorina ni mo ṣe fi gbogbo akọ́bi ti iṣe akọ rubọ si OLUWA; ṣugbọn gbogbo awọn akọ́bi ọmọ ọkunrin mi ni mo rapada.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when Pharaoh would hardly let us go, that the LORD slew all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both the firstborn of man, and the firstborn of beast: therefore I sacrifice to the LORD all that openeth the matrix, being males; but all the firstborn of my children I redeem.

entries.yo: Yio si ma ṣe àmi li ọwọ́ rẹ, ati ọjá-igbaju lagbedemeji oju rẹ: nitori ọwọ́ agbara li OLUWA fi mú wa jade kuro ni Egipti.
entries.en: And it shall be for a token upon thine hand, and for frontlets between thine eyes: for by strength of hand the LORD brought us forth out of Egypt.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati Farao jẹ ki awọn enia na ki o lọ tán, Ọlọrun kò si mú wọn tọ̀ ọ̀na ilẹ awọn ara Filistia, eyi li o sa yá; nitoriti Ọlọrun wipe, Ki awọn enia má ba yi ọkàn pada nigbati nwọn ba ri ogun, ki nwọn si pada lọ si Egipti.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when Pharaoh had let the people go, that God led them not through the way of the land of the Philistines, although that was near; for God said, Lest peradventure the people repent when they see war, and they return to Egypt:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Ọlọrun mu wọn yi lọ li ọ̀na ijù Okun Pupa: awọn ọmọ Israeli jade lọ kuro ni ilẹ Egipti ni ihamọra.
entries.en: But God led the people about, through the way of the wilderness of the Red sea: and the children of Israel went up harnessed out of the land of Egypt.

entries.yo: Mose si gbé egungun Josefu lọ pẹlu rẹ̀; nitori ibura lile li o mu awọn ọmọ Israeli bu pe, Lõtọ li Ọlọrun yio bẹ̀ nyin wò; ki ẹnyin ki o si rù egungun mi lọ pẹlu nyin kuro nihin.
entries.en: And Moses took the bones of Joseph with him: for he had straitly sworn the children of Israel, saying, God will surely visit you; and ye shall carry up my bones away hence with you.

entries.yo: Nwọn si mu ọ̀na-àjo wọn pọ̀n lati Sukkoti lọ, nwọn si dó si Etamu leti ijù.
entries.en: And they took their journey from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, in the edge of the wilderness.

entries.yo: OLUWA si nlọ niwaju wọn, ninu ọwọ̀n awọsanma li ọsán, lati ma ṣe amọna fun wọn; ati li oru li ọwọ̀n iná lati ma fi imọlẹ fun wọn; lati ma rìn li ọsán ati li oru.
entries.en: And the LORD went before them by day in a pillar of a cloud, to lead them the way; and by night in a pillar of fire, to give them light; to go by day and night:

entries.yo: Ọwọ̀n awọsanma na kò kuro li ọsán, tabi ọwọ̀n iná li oru, niwaju awọn enia na.
entries.en: He took not away the pillar of the cloud by day, nor the pillar of fire by night, from before the people.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Sọ fun awọn ọmọ Israeli pe, ki nwọn ki o dari, ki nwọn ki o si dó si iwaju Pi-hahirotu, li agbedemeji Migdolu on okun, niwaju Baal-sefoni: lọkankan rẹ̀ li ẹba okun ni ki ẹnyin ki o dó si.
entries.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, that they turn and encamp before Pi-hahiroth, between Migdol and the sea, over against Baal-zephon: before it shall ye encamp by the sea.

entries.yo: Nitoriti Farao yio wi niti awọn ọmọ Israeli pe, Nwọn há ni ilẹ na, ijù na sé wọn mọ́.
entries.en: For Pharaoh will say of the children of Israel, They are entangled in the land, the wilderness hath shut them in.

entries.yo: Emi o si mu àiya Farao le, ti yio fi lepa wọn; a o si yìn mi logo lori Farao, ati lori ogun rẹ̀ gbogbo; ki awọn ara Egipti ki o le mọ̀ pe, emi li OLUWA. Nwọn si ṣe bẹ̃.
entries.en: And I will harden Pharaoh's heart, that he shall follow after them; and I will be honoured upon Pharaoh, and upon all his host; that the Egyptians may know that I am the LORD. And they did so.

entries.yo: A si wi fun ọba Egipti pe, awọn enia na sá: àiya Farao ati awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀ si yi si awọn enia na, nwọn si wipe, Ẽṣe ti awa fi ṣe eyi, ti awa fi jẹ ki Israeli ki o lọ kuro ninu ìsin wa?
entries.en: And it was told the king of Egypt that the people fled: and the heart of Pharaoh and of his servants was turned against the people, and they said, Why have we done this, that we have let Israel go from serving us?

entries.yo: O si dì kẹkẹ́ rẹ̀, o si mú awọn enia rẹ̀ pẹlu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he made ready his chariot, and took his people with him:

entries.yo: O si mú ẹgbẹta ãyo kẹkẹ́, ati gbogbo kẹkẹ́ Egipti, ati olori si olukuluku wọn.
entries.en: And he took six hundred chosen chariots, and all the chariots of Egypt, and captains over every one of them.

entries.yo: OLUWA si mu àiya Farao ọba Egipti le, o si lepa awọn ọmọ Israeli: ọwọ́ giga li awọn ọmọ Israeli si fi jade lọ.
entries.en: And the LORD hardened the heart of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and he pursued after the children of Israel: and the children of Israel went out with an high hand.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn ara Egipti lepa wọn, gbogbo ẹṣin ati kẹkẹ́ Farao, ati awọn ẹlẹṣin rẹ̀, ati awọn ogun rẹ̀, o si lé wọn bá, nwọn duro li ẹba okun ni ìha Pi-hahirotu niwaju Baal-sefoni.
entries.en: But the Egyptians pursued after them, all the horses and chariots of Pharaoh, and his horsemen, and his army, and overtook them encamping by the sea, beside Pi-hahiroth, before Baal-zephon.

entries.yo: Nigbati Farao si nsunmọtosi, awọn ọmọ Israeli gbé oju soke, si kiyesi i, awọn ara Egipti mbọ̀ lẹhin wọn; ẹ̀ru si bà wọn gidigidi: awọn ọmọ Israeli si kigbe pè OLUWA.
entries.en: And when Pharaoh drew nigh, the children of Israel lifted up their eyes, and, behold, the Egyptians marched after them; and they were sore afraid: and the children of Israel cried out unto the LORD.

entries.yo: Nwọn si wi fun Mose pe, Nitoriti isà kò sí ni Egipti, ki iwọ ṣe mú wa wá lati kú ni ijù? ẽṣe ti iwọ fi ṣe wa bẹ̃, lati mú wa jade ti Egipti wá?
entries.en: And they said unto Moses, Because there were no graves in Egypt, hast thou taken us away to die in the wilderness? wherefore hast thou dealt thus with us, to carry us forth out of Egypt?

entries.yo: Ọrọ yi ki awa ti sọ fun ọ ni Egipti pe, Jọwọ wa jẹ ki awa ki o ma sìn awọn ara Egipti? O sá san fun wa lati ma sin awọn ara Egipti, jù ki awa kú li aginjù lọ.
entries.en: Is not this the word that we did tell thee in Egypt, saying, Let us alone, that we may serve the Egyptians? For it had been better for us to serve the Egyptians, than that we should die in the wilderness.

entries.yo: Mose si wi fun awọn enia na pe, Ẹ má bẹ̀ru, ẹ duro jẹ, ki ẹ si ri ìgbala OLUWA, ti yio fihàn nyin li oni: nitori awọn ara Egipti ti ẹnyin ri li oni yi, ẹnyin ki yio si tun ri wọn mọ́ lailai.
entries.en: And Moses said unto the people, Fear ye not, stand still, and see the salvation of the LORD, which he will shew to you to day: for the Egyptians whom ye have seen to day, ye shall see them again no more for ever.

entries.yo: Nitoriti OLUWA yio jà fun nyin, ki ẹnyin ki o si pa ẹnu nyin mọ́.
entries.en: The LORD shall fight for you, and ye shall hold your peace.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun Mose pe, Ẽṣe ti iwọ fi nkepè mi? sọ fun awọn ọmọ Israeli ki nwọn ki o tẹ̀ siwaju:
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Wherefore criest thou unto me? speak unto the children of Israel, that they go forward:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn iwọ gbé ọpá rẹ soke, ki iwọ ki o si nà ọwọ́ rẹ si oju okun ki o si yà a meji: awọn ọmọ Israeli yio si là ãrin okun na kọja ni iyangbẹ ilẹ.
entries.en: But lift thou up thy rod, and stretch out thine hand over the sea, and divide it: and the children of Israel shall go on dry ground through the midst of the sea.

entries.yo: Ati emi kiyesi i, emi o mu àiya awọn ara Egipti le, nwọn o si tẹle wọn: a o si yìn mi logo lori Farao, ati lori gbogbo ogun rẹ̀, ati lori awọn kẹkẹ́ rẹ̀, ati lori awọn ẹlẹṣin rẹ̀.
entries.en: And I, behold, I will harden the hearts of the Egyptians, and they shall follow them: and I will get me honour upon Pharaoh, and upon all his host, upon his chariots, and upon his horsemen.

entries.yo: Awọn ara Egipti yio si mọ̀ pe, emi li OLUWA, nigbati mo ba gbà ogo lori Farao, lori awọn kẹkẹ́ rẹ̀, ati lori awọn ẹlẹṣin rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the Egyptians shall know that I am the LORD, when I have gotten me honour upon Pharaoh, upon his chariots, and upon his horsemen.

entries.yo: Angeli Ọlọrun na ti o ṣaju ogun Israeli, o si ṣi lọ ṣẹhin wọn; ọwọ̀n awọsanma si ṣi kuro niwaju wọn, o si duro lẹhin wọn:
entries.en: And the angel of God, which went before the camp of Israel, removed and went behind them; and the pillar of the cloud went from before their face, and stood behind them:

entries.yo: O si wá si agbedemeji ogun awọn ara Egipti ati ogun Israeli; o si ṣe awọsanma ati òkunkun fun awọn ti ọhún, ṣugbọn o ṣe imọlẹ li oru fun awọn ti ihin: bẹ̃li ekini kò sunmọ ekeji ni gbogbo oru na.
entries.en: And it came between the camp of the Egyptians and the camp of Israel; and it was a cloud and darkness to them, but it gave light by night to these: so that the one came not near the other all the night.

entries.yo: Mose si nà ọwọ́ rẹ̀ si oju okun; OLUWA si fi afẹfẹ lile ìla-õrùn mu okun bì sẹhin ni gbogbo oru na, o si mu okun gbẹ: omi na si pinya.
entries.en: And Moses stretched out his hand over the sea; and the LORD caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all that night, and made the sea dry land, and the waters were divided.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Israeli si lọ sinu ãrin okun ni ilẹ gbigbẹ: omi si ṣe odi si wọn li ọwọ ọtún, ati ọwọ́ òsi.
entries.en: And the children of Israel went into the midst of the sea upon the dry ground: and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left.

entries.yo: Awọn ara Egipti si lepa wọn, nwọn si wọ̀ ọ tọ̀ wọn lọ lãrin okun, ati gbogbo ẹṣin Farao, ati kẹkẹ́ rẹ̀, ati awọn ẹlẹṣin rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the Egyptians pursued, and went in after them to the midst of the sea, even all Pharaoh's horses, his chariots, and his horsemen.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigba iṣọ owurọ̀, OLUWA bojuwò ogun ara Egipti lãrin ọwọ̀n iná, ati ti awọsanma, o si pá ogun awọn ara Egipti làiya.
entries.en: And it came to pass, that in the morning watch the LORD looked unto the host of the Egyptians through the pillar of fire and of the cloud, and troubled the host of the Egyptians,

entries.yo: O si yẹ̀ kẹkẹ́ wọn, nwọn si nwọ́ turu, awọn ara Egipti si wipe, Ẹ jẹ ki a sá kuro niwaju Israeli; nitoriti OLUWA mbá awọn ara Egipti jà fun wọn.
entries.en: And took off their chariot wheels, that they drave them heavily: so that the Egyptians said, Let us flee from the face of Israel; for the LORD fighteth for them against the Egyptians.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun Mose pe; Nà ọwọ́ rẹ si oju okun, ki omi ki o tun pada wá sori awọn ara Egipti, sori kẹkẹ́ wọn, ati sori ẹlẹṣin wọn.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Stretch out thine hand over the sea, that the waters may come again upon the Egyptians, upon their chariots, and upon their horsemen.

entries.yo: Mose si nà ọwọ́ rẹ̀ si oju okun, okun si pada bọ̀ si ipò rẹ̀ nigbati ilẹ mọ́; awọn ara Egipti si sá lù u. OLUWA si bì awọn ara Egipti ṣubu lãrin okun.
entries.en: And Moses stretched forth his hand over the sea, and the sea returned to his strength when the morning appeared; and the Egyptians fled against it; and the LORD overthrew the Egyptians in the midst of the sea.

entries.yo: Omi si pada, o si bò kẹkẹ́, ati awọn ẹlẹṣin, ati gbogbo ogun Farao ti o wọ̀ inu okun tọ̀ wọn lẹhin lọ; ọkanṣoṣo kò kù ninu wọn.
entries.en: And the waters returned, and covered the chariots, and the horsemen, and all the host of Pharaoh that came into the sea after them; there remained not so much as one of them.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn ọmọ Israeli rìn ni iyangbẹ ilẹ lãrin okun; omi si jẹ́ odi fun wọn li ọwọ́ ọtún, ati li ọwọ́ òsi wọn.
entries.en: But the children of Israel walked upon dry land in the midst of the sea; and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left.

entries.yo: Bayi li OLUWA gbà Israeli là li ọjọ́ na lọwọ awọn ara Egipti; Israeli si ri okú awọn ara Egipti leti okun.
entries.en: Thus the LORD saved Israel that day out of the hand of the Egyptians; and Israel saw the Egyptians dead upon the sea shore.

entries.yo: Israeli si ri iṣẹ nla ti OLUWA ṣe lara awọn ara Egipti: awọn enia na si bẹ̀ru OLUWA, nwọn si gbà OLUWA ati Mose iranṣẹ rẹ̀ gbọ́.
entries.en: And Israel saw that great work which the LORD did upon the Egyptians: and the people feared the LORD, and believed the LORD, and his servant Moses.

entries.yo: NIGBANA ni Mose ati awọn ọmọ Israeli kọ orin yi si OLUWA nwọn si wipe, Emi o kọrin si OLUWA, nitoriti o pọ̀ li ogo: ati ẹṣin ati ẹlẹṣin on li o bì ṣubu sinu okun.
entries.en: Then sang Moses and the children of Israel this song unto the LORD, and spake, saying, I will sing unto the LORD, for he hath triumphed gloriously: the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.

entries.yo: OLUWA li agbara ati orin mi, on li o si di ìgbala mi: eyi li Ọlọrun mi, emi o si fi ìyin fun u; Ọlọrun baba mi, emi o gbé e leke.
entries.en: The LORD is my strength and song, and he is become my salvation: he is my God, and I will prepare him an habitation; my father's God, and I will exalt him.

entries.yo: Ologun li OLUWA; OLUWA li orukọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: The LORD is a man of war: the LORD is his name.

entries.yo: Kẹkẹ́ Farao ati ogun rẹ̀ li o mu wọ̀ inu okun: awọn ãyo olori ogun rẹ̀ li o si rì ninu Okun Pupa.
entries.en: Pharaoh's chariots and his host hath he cast into the sea: his chosen captains also are drowned in the Red sea.

entries.yo: Ibú bò wọn mọlẹ: nwọn rì si isalẹ bi okuta.
entries.en: The depths have covered them: they sank into the bottom as a stone.

entries.yo: OLUWA, ọwọ́ ọtún rẹ li ogo ninu agbara: OLUWA, ọwọ́ ọtún rẹ fọ́ ọtá tútu.
entries.en: Thy right hand, O LORD, is become glorious in power: thy right hand, O LORD, hath dashed in pieces the enemy.

entries.yo: Ati ni ọ̀pọlọpọ ọlá rẹ ni iwọ bì awọn ti o dide si ọ ṣubu; iwọ rán ibinu rẹ, ti o run wọn bi akemọlẹ idi koriko.
entries.en: And in the greatness of thine excellency thou hast overthrown them that rose up against thee: thou sentest forth thy wrath, which consumed them as stubble.

entries.yo: Ati nipa ẽmi imu rẹ, li omi si fi wọjọ pọ̀, ìṣan omi dide duro gangan bi ogiri; ibú si dìlu lãrin okun.
entries.en: And with the blast of thy nostrils the waters were gathered together, the floods stood upright as an heap, and the depths were congealed in the heart of the sea.

entries.yo: Ọtá wipe, Emi o lepa, emi o bá wọn, emi o pín ikogun: a o tẹ́ ifẹkufẹ mi lọrùn lara wọn; emi o fà dà mi yọ, ọwọ́ mi ni yio pa wọn run.
entries.en: The enemy said, I will pursue, I will overtake, I will divide the spoil; my lust shall be satisfied upon them; I will draw my sword, my hand shall destroy them.

entries.yo: Iwọ si mu afẹfẹ rẹ fẹ́, okun bò wọn mọlẹ: nwọn rì bi ojé ninu omi nla.
entries.en: Thou didst blow with thy wind, the sea covered them: they sank as lead in the mighty waters.

entries.yo: Tali o dabi iwọ, OLUWA, ninu awọn alagbara? tali o dabi iwọ, ologo ni mimọ́, ẹlẹru ni iyìn, ti nṣe ohun iyanu?
entries.en: Who is like unto thee, O LORD, among the gods? who is like thee, glorious in holiness, fearful in praises, doing wonders?

entries.yo: Iwọ nà ọwọ́ ọtún rẹ, ilẹ gbe wọn mì.
entries.en: Thou stretchedst out thy right hand, the earth swallowed them.

entries.yo: Ninu ãnu rẹ ni iwọ fi ṣe amọ̀na awọn enia na ti iwọ ti rapada: iwọ si nfi agbara rẹ tọ́ wọn lọ si ibujoko mimọ́ rẹ.
entries.en: Thou in thy mercy hast led forth the people which thou hast redeemed: thou hast guided them in thy strength unto thy holy habitation.

entries.yo: Awọn enia gbọ́, nwọn warìri; ikãnu si mú awọn olugbe Palestina.
entries.en: The people shall hear, and be afraid: sorrow shall take hold on the inhabitants of Palestina.

entries.yo: Nigbana li ẹnu yà awọn balẹ Edomu; iwarìri si mú awọn alagbara Moabu: gbogbo awọn olugbe Kenaani yọ́ dànu.
entries.en: Then the dukes of Edom shall be amazed; the mighty men of Moab, trembling shall take hold upon them; all the inhabitants of Canaan shall melt away.

entries.yo: Ibẹru-bojo mú wọn; nipa titobi apa rẹ nwọn duro jẹ bi okuta; titi awọn enia rẹ fi rekọja, OLUWA, titi awọn enia rẹ ti iwọ ti rà fi rekọja.
entries.en: Fear and dread shall fall upon them; by the greatness of thine arm they shall be as still as a stone; till thy people pass over, O LORD, till the people pass over, which thou hast purchased.

entries.yo: Iwọ o mú wọn wọle, iwọ o si gbìn wọn sinu oke ilẹ-iní rẹ, OLUWA, ni ibi ti iwọ ti ṣe fun ara rẹ, lati mã gbé, OLUWA; ni ibi mimọ́ na, ti ọwọ́ rẹ ti gbekalẹ.
entries.en: Thou shalt bring them in, and plant them in the mountain of thine inheritance, in the place, O LORD, which thou hast made for thee to dwell in, in the Sanctuary, O Lord, which thy hands have established.

entries.yo: OLUWA yio jọba lai ati lailai.
entries.en: The LORD shall reign for ever and ever.

entries.yo: Nitori ẹṣin Farao wọ̀ inu okun lọ, pẹlu kẹkẹ́ rẹ̀ ati awọn ẹlẹṣin rẹ̀, OLUWA si tun mú omi okun pada si wọn lori; ṣugbọn awọn ọmọ Israeli rìn ni ilẹ gbigbẹ lãrin okun.
entries.en: For the horse of Pharaoh went in with his chariots and with his horsemen into the sea, and the LORD brought again the waters of the sea upon them; but the children of Israel went on dry land in the midst of the sea.

entries.yo: Ati Miriamu wolĩ obinrin, arabinrin Aaroni, o mú ìlu li ọwọ́ rẹ̀: gbogbo awọn obinrin si jade tẹle e ti awọn ti ìlu ati ijó.
entries.en: And Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took a timbrel in her hand; and all the women went out after her with timbrels and with dances.

entries.yo: Miriamu si da wọn li ohùn pe, Ẹ kọrin si OLUWA nitoriti o pọ̀ li ogo; ẹṣin ati ẹlẹṣin on li o bì ṣubu sinu okun.
entries.en: And Miriam answered them, Sing ye to the LORD, for he hath triumphed gloriously; the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Mose mú Israeli jade lati Okun Pupa wá, nwọn si jade lọ si ijù Ṣuri; nwọn si lọ ni ìrin ijọ́ mẹta ni ijù na, nwọn kò si ri omi.
entries.en: So Moses brought Israel from the Red sea, and they went out into the wilderness of Shur; and they went three days in the wilderness, and found no water.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn dé Mara, nwọn ko le mu ninu omi Mara, nitoriti o korò; nitorina li a ṣe sọ orukọ rẹ̀ ni Mara.
entries.en: And when they came to Marah, they could not drink of the waters of Marah, for they were bitter: therefore the name of it was called Marah.

entries.yo: Awọn enia na si nkùn si Mose wipe, Kili awa o mu?
entries.en: And the people murmured against Moses, saying, What shall we drink?

entries.yo: O si kepè OLUWA; OLUWA si fi igi kan hàn a, nigbati o si sọ ọ sinu omi na, omi si di didùn. Nibẹ̀ li o si gbé ṣe ofin ati ìlana fun wọn, nibẹ̀ li o si gbé dán wọn wò;
entries.en: And he cried unto the LORD; and the LORD shewed him a tree, which when he had cast into the waters, the waters were made sweet: there he made for them a statute and an ordinance, and there he proved them,

entries.yo: O si wipe, Bi iwọ o ba tẹtisilẹ gidigidi si ohùn OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ, ti o ba si ṣe eyiti o tọ́ li oju rẹ̀, ti iwọ o ba si fetisi ofin rẹ̀, ti iwọ o ba si pa gbogbo aṣẹ rẹ̀ mọ́, emi ki yio si fi ọkan ninu àrun wọnni ti mo múwa sara awọn ara Egipti si ọ lara: nitori emi li OLUWA ti o mu ọ lara dá.
entries.en: And said, If thou wilt diligently hearken to the voice of the LORD thy God, and wilt do that which is right in his sight, and wilt give ear to his commandments, and keep all his statutes, I will put none of these diseases upon thee, which I have brought upon the Egyptians: for I am the LORD that healeth thee.

entries.yo: Nwọn si dé Elimu, nibiti kanga omi mejila gbé wà, ati ãdọrin ọpẹ: nwọn si dó si ìha omi wọnni nibẹ̀.
entries.en: And they came to Elim, where were twelve wells of water, and threescore and ten palm trees: and they encamped there by the waters.

entries.yo: NWỌN si ṣí lati Elimu, gbogbo ijọ awọn ọmọ Israeli si dé ijù Sini, ti o wà li agbedemeji Elimu on Sinai, ni ijọ́ kẹdogun oṣù keji, lẹhin igbati nwọn jade kuro ni ilẹ Egipti.
entries.en: And they took their journey from Elim, and all the congregation of the children of Israel came unto the wilderness of Sin, which is between Elim and Sinai, on the fifteenth day of the second month after their departing out of the land of Egypt.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ijọ awọn ọmọ Israeli si nkùn si Mose ati si Aaroni ni ijù na:
entries.en: And the whole congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and Aaron in the wilderness:

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Israeli si wi fun wọn pe, Awa iba ti ti ọwọ́ OLUWA kú ni Egipti, nigbati awa joko tì ìkoko ẹran, ti awa njẹ ajẹyo; ẹnyin sá mú wa jade wá si ijù yi, lati fi ebi pa gbogbo ijọ yi.
entries.en: And the children of Israel said unto them, Would to God we had died by the hand of the LORD in the land of Egypt, when we sat by the flesh pots, and when we did eat bread to the full; for ye have brought us forth into this wilderness, to kill this whole assembly with hunger.

entries.yo: Nigbana li OLUWA sọ fun Mose pe, Kiyesi i, emi o rọ̀jo onjẹ fun nyin lati ọrun wá; awọn enia yio si ma jade lọ ikó ìwọn ti õjọ li ojojumọ́, ki emi ki o le dan wọn wò, bi nwọn o fẹ́ lati ma rìn nipa ofin mi, bi bẹ̃kọ.
entries.en: Then said the LORD unto Moses, Behold, I will rain bread from heaven for you; and the people shall go out and gather a certain rate every day, that I may prove them, whether they will walk in my law, or no.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, li ọjọ́ kẹfa, nwọn o si pèse eyiti nwọn múwa; yio si to ìwọn meji eyiti nwọn ima kó li ojojumọ́.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass, that on the sixth day they shall prepare that which they bring in; and it shall be twice as much as they gather daily.

entries.yo: Mose ati Aaroni si wi fun gbogbo awọn ọmọ Israeli pe, Li aṣalẹ, li ẹnyin o si mọ̀ pe, OLUWA li o mú nyin jade lati Egipti wá:
entries.en: And Moses and Aaron said unto all the children of Israel, At even, then ye shall know that the LORD hath brought you out from the land of Egypt:

entries.yo: Ati li owurọ̀ li ẹnyin o si ri ogo OLUWA; nitoriti o gbọ́ kikùn nyin si OLUWA: ta si li awa, ti ẹnyin nkùn si wa?
entries.en: And in the morning, then ye shall see the glory of the LORD; for that he heareth your murmurings against the LORD: and what are we, that ye murmur against us?

entries.yo: Mose si wi pe, Bayi ni yio ri nigbati OLUWA yio fun nyin li ẹran jẹ li aṣalẹ, ati onjẹ ajẹyo li owurọ̀; nitoriti OLUWA gbọ́ kikùn nyin ti ẹnyin kùn si i: ta si li awa? kikùn nyin ki iṣe si wa, bikoṣe si OLUWA.
entries.en: And Moses said, This shall be, when the LORD shall give you in the evening flesh to eat, and in the morning bread to the full; for that the LORD heareth your murmurings which ye murmur against him: and what are we? your murmurings are not against us, but against the LORD.

entries.yo: Mose si sọ fun Aaroni pe, Sọ fun gbogbo ijọ awọn ọmọ Israeli pe, Ẹ sunmọ iwaju OLUWA, nitoriti o ti gbọ́ kikùn nyin.
entries.en: And Moses spake unto Aaron, Say unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, Come near before the LORD: for he hath heard your murmurings.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati Aaroni nsọ fun gbogbo ijọ awọn ọmọ Israeli, nwọn si bojuwò ìha ijù, si kiyesi i, ogo OLUWA hàn li awọsanma na.
entries.en: And it came to pass, as Aaron spake unto the whole congregation of the children of Israel, that they looked toward the wilderness, and, behold, the glory of the LORD appeared in the cloud.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Emi ti gbọ́ kikùn awọn ọmọ Israeli: sọ fun wọn pe, Li aṣalẹ ẹnyin o jẹ ẹran, ati li owurọ̀ a o si fi onjẹ kún nyin; ẹnyin o si mọ̀ pe, emi li OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin.
entries.en: I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel: speak unto them, saying, At even ye shall eat flesh, and in the morning ye shall be filled with bread; and ye shall know that I am the LORD your God.

entries.yo: O si ṣe li aṣalẹ ni aparò fò dé, nwọn si bò ibudó mọlẹ; ati li owurọ̀ ìri si sẹ̀ yi gbogbo ibudó na ká.
entries.en: And it came to pass, that at even the quails came up, and covered the camp: and in the morning the dew lay round about the host.

entries.yo: Nigbati ìri ti o sẹ̀ bolẹ si fà soke, si kiyesi i, lori ilẹ ijù na, ohun ribiribi, o kere bi ìri didì li ori ilẹ.
entries.en: And when the dew that lay was gone up, behold, upon the face of the wilderness there lay a small round thing, as small as the hoar frost on the ground.

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn ọmọ Israeli si ri i, nwọn wi fun ara wọn pe, Kili eyi? nitoriti nwọn kò mọ̀ ohun na. Mose si wi fun wọn pe, Eyi li onjẹ ti OLUWA fi fun nyin lati jẹ.
entries.en: And when the children of Israel saw it, they said one to another, It is manna: for they wist not what it was. And Moses said unto them, This is the bread which the LORD hath given you to eat.

entries.yo: Eyi li ohun ti OLUWA ti palaṣẹ, ki olukuluku ki o ma kó bi ìwọn ijẹ rẹ̀; òṣuwọn omeri kan fun ẹni kọkan, gẹgẹ bi iye awọn enia nyin, ki olukuluku nyin mú fun awọn ti o wà ninu agọ́ rẹ̀.
entries.en: This is the thing which the LORD hath commanded, Gather of it every man according to his eating, an omer for every man, according to the number of your persons; take ye every man for them which are in his tents.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Israeli si ṣe bẹ̃, nwọn si kó, ẹlomiran pupọ̀jù, ẹlomiran li aito.
entries.en: And the children of Israel did so, and gathered, some more, some less.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si fi òṣuwọn omeri wọ̀n ọ, ẹniti o kó pupọ̀ kò ni nkan lé, ẹniti o si kó kere jù, kò ṣe alaito nwọn si kó olukuluku bi ijẹ tirẹ̀.
entries.en: And when they did mete it with an omer, he that gathered much had nothing over, and he that gathered little had no lack; they gathered every man according to his eating.

entries.yo: Mose si wi fun wọn pe, Ki ẹnikan ki o má kùsilẹ ninu rẹ̀ titi di owurọ̀.
entries.en: And Moses said, Let no man leave of it till the morning.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nwọn kò gbọ́ ti Mose; bẹ̃li ẹlomiran si kùsilẹ ninu rẹ̀ titi di owurọ̀, o si di idin, o si rùn; Mose si binu si wọn.
entries.en: Notwithstanding they hearkened not unto Moses; but some of them left of it until the morning, and it bred worms, and stank: and Moses was wroth with them.

entries.yo: Nwọn si nkó o li orowurọ̀, olukuluku bi ijẹ tirẹ̀; nigbati õrùn si mu, o yọ́.
entries.en: And they gathered it every morning, every man according to his eating: and when the sun waxed hot, it melted.

entries.yo: O si ṣe ni ijọ́ kẹfa, nwọn kó ìwọn onjẹ ẹrinmeji, omeri meji fun ẹni kọkan: gbogbo awọn olori ijọ na si wá nwọn sọ fun Mose.
entries.en: And it came to pass, that on the sixth day they gathered twice as much bread, two omers for one man: and all the rulers of the congregation came and told Moses.

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Eyi na li OLUWA ti wi pe, Ọla li ọjọ́ isimi, isimi mimọ́ fun OLUWA; ẹ yan eyiti ẹnyin ni iyan, ki ẹ si bọ̀ eyiti ẹnyin ni ibọ̀; eyiti o si kù, ẹ fi i silẹ lati pa a mọ́ dé owurọ̀.
entries.en: And he said unto them, This is that which the LORD hath said, To morrow is the rest of the holy sabbath unto the LORD: bake that which ye will bake to day, and seethe that ye will seethe; and that which remaineth over lay up for you to be kept until the morning.

entries.yo: Nwọn si fi i silẹ titi di owurọ̀, bi Mose ti paṣẹ fun wọn; kò si rùn, bẹ̃ni kò sí idin ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And they laid it up till the morning, as Moses bade: and it did not stink, neither was there any worm therein.

entries.yo: Mose si wi pe, Ẹ jẹ eyinì li oni; nitori oni li ọjọ́ isimi fun OLUWA: li oni ẹnyin ki yio ri i ninu igbẹ́.
entries.en: And Moses said, Eat that to day; for to day is a sabbath unto the LORD: to day ye shall not find it in the field.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ́ mẹfa li ẹ o ma kó o; ṣugbọn li ọjọ́ keje li ọjọ́ isimi, ninu rẹ̀ ni ki yio si nkan.
entries.en: Six days ye shall gather it; but on the seventh day, which is the sabbath, in it there shall be none.

entries.yo: O si ṣe li ọjọ́ keje awọn kan ninu awọn enia jade lọ ikó, nwọn kò si ri nkan.
entries.en: And it came to pass, that there went out some of the people on the seventh day for to gather, and they found none.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun Mose pe, Ẹ o ti kọ̀ lati pa aṣẹ mi ati ofin mi mọ́ pẹ to?
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, How long refuse ye to keep my commandments and my laws?

entries.yo: Wò o, OLUWA sa ti fi ọjọ́ isimi fun nyin, nitorina li o ṣe fi onjẹ ijọ́ meji fun nyin li ọjọ́ kẹfa; ki olukuluku ki o joko ni ipò rẹ̀, ki ẹnikẹni ki o máṣe jade kuro ni ipò rẹ̀ li ọjọ́ keje.
entries.en: See, for that the LORD hath given you the sabbath, therefore he giveth you on the sixth day the bread of two days; abide ye every man in his place, let no man go out of his place on the seventh day.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li awọn enia na simi li ọjọ́ keje.
entries.en: So the people rested on the seventh day.

entries.yo: Awọn ara ile Israeli si pè orukọ rẹ̀ ni Manna; o si dabi irugbìn korianderi, funfun; adùn rẹ̀ si dabi àkara fẹlẹfẹlẹ ti a fi oyin ṣe.
entries.en: And the house of Israel called the name thereof Manna: and it was like coriander seed, white; and the taste of it was like wafers made with honey.

entries.yo: Mose si wipe, Eyi li ohun ti OLUWA palaṣẹ, Ẹ kún òṣuwọn omeri kan ninu rẹ̀ lati pamọ́ fun irandiran nyin; ki nwọn ki o le ma ri onjẹ ti mo fi bọ́ nyin ni ijù, nigbati mo mú nyin jade kuro ni ilẹ Egipti
entries.en: And Moses said, This is the thing which the LORD commandeth, Fill an omer of it to be kept for your generations; that they may see the bread wherewith I have fed you in the wilderness, when I brought you forth from the land of Egypt.

entries.yo: Mose si wi fun Aaroni pe, Mú ìkoko kan, ki o si fi òṣuwọn omeri kan ti o kún fun manna sinu rẹ̀, ki o si gbé e kalẹ niwaju OLUWA, lati pa a mọ́ fun irandiran nyin.
entries.en: And Moses said unto Aaron, Take a pot, and put an omer full of manna therein, and lay it up before the LORD, to be kept for your generations.

entries.yo: Bi OLUWA ti paṣẹ fun Mose, bẹ̃li Aaroni gbé e kalẹ niwaju ibi Ẹrí lati pa a mọ́.
entries.en: As the LORD commanded Moses, so Aaron laid it up before the Testimony, to be kept.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Israeli si jẹ manna li ogoji ọdún, titi nwọn fi dé ilẹ ti a tẹ̀dó; nwọn jẹ manna titi nwọn fi dé àgbegbe ilẹ Kenaani.
entries.en: And the children of Israel did eat manna forty years, until they came to a land inhabited; they did eat manna, until they came unto the borders of the land of Canaan.

entries.yo: Njẹ òṣuwọn omeri kan ni idamẹwa efa.
entries.en: Now an omer is the tenth part of an ephah.

entries.yo: GBOGBO ijọ awọn ọmọ Israeli si rìn lati ijù Sini lọ, ni ìrin wọn, gẹgẹ bi ofin OLUWA, nwọn si dó ni Refidimu: omi kò si si fun awọn enia na lati mu.
entries.en: And all the congregation of the children of Israel journeyed from the wilderness of Sin, after their journeys, according to the commandment of the LORD, and pitched in Rephidim: and there was no water for the people to drink.

entries.yo: Nitorina li awọn enia na ṣe mbá Mose sọ̀, nwọn si wipe, Fun wa li omi ki a mu. Mose si wi fun wọn pe, Ẽṣe ti ẹnyin fi mbà mi sọ̀? ẽṣe ti ẹnyin fi ndán OLUWA wò?
entries.en: Wherefore the people did chide with Moses, and said, Give us water that we may drink. And Moses said unto them, Why chide ye with me? wherefore do ye tempt the LORD?

entries.yo: Ongbẹ omi si ngbẹ awọn enia na nibẹ̀; awọn enia na si nkùn si Mose, nwọn si wipe, Ẽtiri ti iwọ fi mú wa goke lati Egipti wá, lati fi ongbẹ pa wa ati awọn ọmọ wa, ati ẹran wa?
entries.en: And the people thirsted there for water; and the people murmured against Moses, and said, Wherefore is this that thou hast brought us up out of Egypt, to kill us and our children and our cattle with thirst?

entries.yo: Mose si kepè OLUWA, wipe, Kili emi o ṣe fun awọn enia yi? nwọn fẹrẹ̀ sọ mi li okuta.
entries.en: And Moses cried unto the LORD, saying, What shall I do unto this people? they be almost ready to stone me.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun Mose pe, Kọja lọ siwaju awọn enia na, ki o si mú ninu awọn àgbagba Israeli pẹlu rẹ, ki o si mú ọpá rẹ, ti o fi lù odò nì li ọwọ́ rẹ, ki o si ma lọ.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go on before the people, and take with thee of the elders of Israel; and thy rod, wherewith thou smotest the river, take in thine hand, and go.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, emi o duro niwaju rẹ nibẹ̀ lori okuta ni Horebu; iwọ o si lù okuta na, omi yio si jade ninu rẹ̀, ki awọn enia ki o le mu. Mose si ṣe bẹ̃ li oju awọn àgbagba Israeli.
entries.en: Behold, I will stand before thee there upon the rock in Horeb; and thou shalt smite the rock, and there shall come water out of it, that the people may drink. And Moses did so in the sight of the elders of Israel.

entries.yo: O si sọ orukọ ibẹ̀ ni Massa, ati Meriba, nitori asọ̀ awọn ọmọ Israeli, ati nitoriti nwọn dan OLUWA wò pe, OLUWA ha mbẹ lãrin wa, tabi kò si?
entries.en: And he called the name of the place Massah, and Meribah, because of the chiding of the children of Israel, and because they tempted the LORD, saying, Is the LORD among us, or not?

entries.yo: Nigbana li Amaleki wá, o si bá Israeli jà ni Refidimu.
entries.en: Then came Amalek, and fought with Israel in Rephidim.

entries.yo: Mose si wi fun Joṣua pe, Yàn enia fun wa, ki o si jade lọ ibá Amaleki jà: li ọla li emi o duro lori oke ti emi ti ọpá Ọlọrun li ọwọ́ mi.
entries.en: And Moses said unto Joshua, Choose us out men, and go out, fight with Amalek: to morrow I will stand on the top of the hill with the rod of God in mine hand.

entries.yo: Joṣua si ṣe bi Mose ti wi fun u, o si bá Amaleki jà: ati Mose, Aaroni, on Huri lọ sori oke na.
entries.en: So Joshua did as Moses had said to him, and fought with Amalek: and Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati Mose ba gbé ọwọ́ rẹ̀ soke, Israeli a bori: nigbati o ba si rẹ̀ ọwọ́ rẹ̀ silẹ, Amaleki a bori.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when Moses held up his hand, that Israel prevailed: and when he let down his hand, Amalek prevailed.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ọwọ́ kún Mose; nwọn si mú okuta kan, nwọn si fi si abẹ rẹ̀, o si joko lé e; Aaroni ati Huri si mu u li ọwọ́ ró, ọkan li apa kini, ekeji li apa keji; ọwọ́ rẹ̀ si duro gan titi o fi di ìwọ-õrùn.
entries.en: But Moses' hands were heavy; and they took a stone, and put it under him, and he sat thereon; and Aaron and Hur stayed up his hands, the one on the one side, and the other on the other side; and his hands were steady until the going down of the sun.

entries.yo: Joṣua si fi oju idà ṣẹgun Amaleki ati awọn enia rẹ̀ tútu
entries.en: And Joshua discomfited Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun Mose pe, Kọ eyi sinu iwe fun iranti, ki o si kà a li eti Joṣua; nitoriti emi o pa iranti Amaleki run patapata kuro labẹ ọrun.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Write this for a memorial in a book, and rehearse it in the ears of Joshua: for I will utterly put out the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven.

entries.yo: Mose si tẹ́ pẹpẹ kan, o si sọ orukọ rẹ̀ ni JEHOFA-nissi:
entries.en: And Moses built an altar, and called the name of it Jehovah-nissi:

entries.yo: O si wipe, OLUWA ti bura: OLUWA yio bá Amaleki jà lati irandiran.
entries.en: For he said, Because the LORD hath sworn that the LORD will have war with Amalek from generation to generation.

entries.yo: NIGBATI Jetro, alufa Midiani, ana Mose, gbọ́ ohun gbogbo ti Ọlọrun ti ṣe fun Mose, ati fun Israeli awọn enia rẹ̀, ati pe, OLUWA mú Israeli lati Egipti jade wá;
entries.en: When Jethro, the priest of Midian, Moses' father in law, heard of all that God had done for Moses, and for Israel his people, and that the LORD had brought Israel out of Egypt;

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Jetro, ana Mose, mú Sippora aya Mose wá, lẹhin ti o ti rán a pada.
entries.en: Then Jethro, Moses' father in law, took Zipporah, Moses' wife, after he had sent her back,

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ mejeji: ti orukọ ọkan njẹ Gerṣomu; nitoriti o wipe, Emi ṣe alejò ni ilẹ ajeji.
entries.en: And her two sons; of which the name of the one was Gershom; for he said, I have been an alien in a strange land:

entries.yo: Ati orukọ ekeji ni Elieseri; nitoriti o wipe, Ọlọrun baba mi li alatilẹhin mi, o si gbà mi lọwọ idà Farao:
entries.en: And the name of the other was Eliezer; for the God of my father, said he, was mine help, and delivered me from the sword of Pharaoh:

entries.yo: Ati Jetro, ana Mose, o tọ̀ Mose wá ti on ti awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, ati aya rẹ̀ si ijù, nibiti o gbé dó si lẹba oke Ọlọrun.
entries.en: And Jethro, Moses' father in law, came with his sons and his wife unto Moses into the wilderness, where he encamped at the mount of God:

entries.yo: O si wi fun Mose pe, Emi Jetro ana rẹ li o tọ̀ ọ wá, pẹlu aya rẹ, ati awọn ọmọ rẹ mejeji pẹlu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he said unto Moses, I thy father in law Jethro am come unto thee, and thy wife, and her two sons with her.

entries.yo: Mose si jade lọ ipade ana rẹ̀, o si tẹriba, o si fi ẹnu kò o li ẹnu, nwọn si bére alafia ara wọn; nwọn si wọ̀ inu agọ́.
entries.en: And Moses went out to meet his father in law, and did obeisance, and kissed him; and they asked each other of their welfare; and they came into the tent.

entries.yo: Mose si sọ ohun gbogbo ti OLUWA ti ṣe si Farao, ati si awọn ara Egipti nitori Israeli fun ana rẹ̀, ati gbogbo ipọnju ti o bá wọn li ọ̀na, ati bi OLUWA ti gbà wọn.
entries.en: And Moses told his father in law all that the LORD had done unto Pharaoh and to the Egyptians for Israel's sake, and all the travail that had come upon them by the way, and how the LORD delivered them.

entries.yo: Jetro si yọ̀ nitori gbogbo ore ti OLUWA ti ṣe fun Israeli, ẹniti o ti gbàla lọwọ awọn ara Egipti.
entries.en: And Jethro rejoiced for all the goodness which the LORD had done to Israel, whom he had delivered out of the hand of the Egyptians.

entries.yo: Jetro si wipe, Olubukún li OLUWA, ẹniti o gbà nyin là lọwọ awọn ara Egipti, ati lọwọ Farao, ẹniti o gbà awọn enia là lọwọ awọn ara Egipti.
entries.en: And Jethro said, Blessed be the LORD, who hath delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of Pharaoh, who hath delivered the people from under the hand of the Egyptians.

entries.yo: Mo mọ̀ nisisiyi pe OLUWA tobi jù gbogbo oriṣa lọ: nitõtọ, ninu ọ̀ran ti nwọn ti ṣeféfe si wọn.
entries.en: Now I know that the LORD is greater than all gods: for in the thing wherein they dealt proudly he was above them.

entries.yo: Jetro, ana Mose, si mù ẹbọ sisun, ati ẹbọ wá fun Ọlọrun: Aaroni si wá, ati gbogbo awọn àgba Israeli, lati bá ana Mose jẹun niwaju Ọlọrun.
entries.en: And Jethro, Moses' father in law, took a burnt offering and sacrifices for God: and Aaron came, and all the elders of Israel, to eat bread with Moses' father in law before God.

entries.yo: O si ṣe ni ijọ́ keji ni Mose joko lati ma ṣe idajọ awọn enia: awọn enia si duro tì Mose lati owurọ̀ titi o fi di aṣalẹ.
entries.en: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Moses sat to judge the people: and the people stood by Moses from the morning unto the evening.

entries.yo: Nigbati ana Mose si ri gbogbo eyiti on nṣe fun awọn enia, o ni, Kili eyiti iwọ nṣe fun awọn enia yi? ẽṣe ti iwọ nikan fi dá joko, ti gbogbo enia si duro tì ọ, lati owurọ̀ titi o fi di aṣalẹ?
entries.en: And when Moses' father in law saw all that he did to the people, he said, What is this thing that thou doest to the people? why sittest thou thyself alone, and all the people stand by thee from morning unto even?

entries.yo: Mose si wi fun ana rẹ̀ pe, Nitoriti awọn enia ntọ̀ mi wá lati bère lọwọ Ọlọrun ni:
entries.en: And Moses said unto his father in law, Because the people come unto me to inquire of God:

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn ba li ẹjọ́, nwọn a tọ̀ mi wá; emi a si ṣe idajọ larin ẹnikini ati ẹnikeji, emi a si ma mú wọn mọ̀ ìlana Ọlọrun, ati ofin rẹ̀.
entries.en: When they have a matter, they come unto me; and I judge between one and another, and I do make them know the statutes of God, and his laws.

entries.yo: Ana Mose si wi fun u pe, Eyiti iwọ nṣe nì kò dara.
entries.en: And Moses' father in law said unto him, The thing that thou doest is not good.

entries.yo: Dajudaju iwọ o dá ara rẹ lagara, ati iwọ, ati awọn enia yi ti o pẹlu rẹ: nitoriti nkan yi wuwo jù fun ọ; iwọ nikan ki yio le ṣe e tikalãrẹ.
entries.en: Thou wilt surely wear away, both thou, and this people that is with thee: for this thing is too heavy for thee; thou art not able to perform it thyself alone.

entries.yo: Fetisilẹ nisisiyi si ohùn mi; emi o fun ọ ni ìmọ, Ọlọrun yio si pẹlu rẹ: iwọ wà niwaju Ọlọrun fun awọn enia yi, ki iwọ ki o ma mú ọ̀ran wọn wá si ọdọ Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Hearken now unto my voice, I will give thee counsel, and God shall be with thee: Be thou for the people to Godward, that thou mayest bring the causes unto God:

entries.yo: Ki o si ma kọ́ wọn ni ìlana ati ofin wọnni, ki o si ma fi ọ̀na ti nwọn o ma rìn hàn fun wọn ati iṣẹ ti nwọn o ma ṣe.
entries.en: And thou shalt teach them ordinances and laws, and shalt shew them the way wherein they must walk, and the work that they must do.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu iwọ o si ṣà ninu gbogbo awọn enia yi awọn ọkunrin ti o to, ti o bẹ̀ru Ọlọrun, awọn ọkunrin olõtọ, ti o korira ojukokoro; irú awọn wọnni ni ki o fi jẹ́ olori wọn, lati ṣe olori ẹgbẹgbẹrun, ati olori ọrọrún, ati olori arãdọta, ati olori mẹwamẹwa.
entries.en: Moreover thou shalt provide out of all the people able men, such as fear God, men of truth, hating covetousness; and place such over them, to be rulers of thousands, and rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens:

entries.yo: Ki nwọn ki o si ma ṣe idajọ awọn enia nigbakugba: yio si ṣe, gbogbo ẹjọ́ nla ni ki nwọn ki o ma mú tọ̀ ọ wá, ṣugbọn gbogbo ẹjọ́ kekeké ni ki nwọn ki o ma dá: yio si rọrùn fun iwọ tikalarẹ, nwọn o si ma bá ọ rù ẹrù na.
entries.en: And let them judge the people at all seasons: and it shall be, that every great matter they shall bring unto thee, but every small matter they shall judge: so shall it be easier for thyself, and they shall bear the burden with thee.

entries.yo: Bi iwọ ba jẹ ṣe nkan yi, bi Ọlọrun ba si fi aṣẹ fun ọ bẹ̃, njẹ iwọ o le duro pẹ, ati gbogbo awọn enia yi pẹlu ni yio si dé ipò wọn li alafia.
entries.en: If thou shalt do this thing, and God command thee so, then thou shalt be able to endure, and all this people shall also go to their place in peace.

entries.yo: Mose si gbà ohùn ana rẹ̀ gbọ́, o si ṣe ohun gbogbo ti o wi.
entries.en: So Moses hearkened to the voice of his father in law, and did all that he had said.

entries.yo: Mose si yàn awọn enia ti o to ninu gbogbo Israeli, o si fi wọn ṣe olori awọn enia, olori ẹgbẹgbẹrun, olori ọrọrún, olori arãdọta, olori mẹwamẹwa.
entries.en: And Moses chose able men out of all Israel, and made them heads over the people, rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.

entries.yo: Nwọn si nṣe idajọ awọn enia nigbakugba: ọ̀ran ti o ṣoro, nwọn a mútọ̀ Mose wá, ṣugbọn awọn tikalawọn ṣe idajọ gbogbo ọ̀ran kekeké.
entries.en: And they judged the people at all seasons: the hard causes they brought unto Moses, but every small matter they judged themselves.

entries.yo: Mose si jẹ ki ana rẹ̀ ki o lọ; on si ba tirẹ̀ lọ si ilẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Moses let his father in law depart; and he went his way into his own land.

entries.yo: LI oṣù kẹta, ti awọn ọmọ Israeli jade kuro ni ilẹ Egipti tán, li ọjọ́ na gan ni nwọn dé ijù Sinai.
entries.en: In the third month, when the children of Israel were gone forth out of the land of Egypt, the same day came they into the wilderness of Sinai.

entries.yo: Nwọn sá ti ṣi kuro ni Refidimu, nwọn si wá si ijù Sinai, nwọn si dó si ijù na; nibẹ̀ ni Israeli si dó si niwaju oke na.
entries.en: For they were departed from Rephidim, and were come to the desert of Sinai, and had pitched in the wilderness; and there Israel camped before the mount.

entries.yo: Mose si goke tọ̀ Ọlọrun lọ, OLUWA si kọ si i lati oke na wá wipe, Bayi ni ki iwọ ki o sọ fun ile Jakobu, ki o si wi fun awọn ọmọ Israeli pe;
entries.en: And Moses went up unto God, and the LORD called unto him out of the mountain, saying, Thus shalt thou say to the house of Jacob, and tell the children of Israel;

entries.yo: Ẹnyin ti ri ohun ti mo ti ṣe si awọn ara Egipti, ati bi mo ti rù nyin li apa-ìyẹ́ idì, ti mo si mú nyin tọ̀ ara mi wá.
entries.en: Ye have seen what I did unto the Egyptians, and how I bare you on eagles' wings, and brought you unto myself.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, bi ẹnyin ba fẹ́ gbà ohùn mi gbọ́ nitõtọ, ti ẹ o si pa majẹmu mi mọ́, nigbana li ẹnyin o jẹ́ iṣura fun mi jù gbogbo enia lọ: nitori gbogbo aiye ni ti emi.
entries.en: Now therefore, if ye will obey my voice indeed, and keep my covenant, then ye shall be a peculiar treasure unto me above all people: for all the earth is mine:

entries.yo: Ẹnyin o si ma jẹ́ ijọba alufa fun mi, ati orilẹ-ède mimọ́. Wọnyi li ọ̀rọ ti iwọ o sọ fun awọn ọmọ Israeli.
entries.en: And ye shall be unto me a kingdom of priests, and an holy nation. These are the words which thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel.

entries.yo: Mose si wá o si ranṣẹ pè awọn àgba awọn enia, o si fi gbogbo ọ̀rọ wọnyi lelẹ niwaju wọn ti OLUWA palaṣẹ fun u.
entries.en: And Moses came and called for the elders of the people, and laid before their faces all these words which the LORD commanded him.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn enia na si jùmọ dahùn, nwọn si wipe, Ohun gbogbo ti OLUWA wi li awa o ṣe. Mose si mú ọ̀rọ awọn enia pada tọ̀ OLUWA lọ.
entries.en: And all the people answered together, and said, All that the LORD hath spoken we will do. And Moses returned the words of the people unto the LORD.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun Mose pe, Wò o, emi tọ̀ ọ wá ninu awọsanma ṣíṣu, ki awọn enia ki o le ma gbọ́ nigbati mo ba mbá ọ sọ̀rọ, ki nwọn ki o si ma gbà ọ gbọ́ pẹlu lailai. Mose si sọ ọ̀rọ awọn enia na fun OLUWA.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Lo, I come unto thee in a thick cloud, that the people may hear when I speak with thee, and believe thee for ever. And Moses told the words of the people unto the LORD.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun Mose pe, Tọ̀ awọn enia yi lọ, ki o si yà wọn simimọ́ li oni ati li ọla, ki nwọn ki o si fọ̀ asọ wọn.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go unto the people, and sanctify them to day and to morrow, and let them wash their clothes,

entries.yo: Ki nwọn ki o si mura dè ijọ́ kẹta: nitori ni ijọ́ kẹta OLUWA yio sọkalẹ sori oke Sinai li oju awọn enia gbogbo.
entries.en: And be ready against the third day: for the third day the LORD will come down in the sight of all the people upon mount Sinai.

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o si sagbàra fun awọn enia yiká, pe, Ẹ ma kiyesi ara nyin, ki ẹ máṣe gùn ori oke lọ, ki ẹ má si ṣe fọwọbà eti rẹ̀: ẹnikẹni ti o ba fọwọkàn oke na, pipa ni nitõtọ:
entries.en: And thou shalt set bounds unto the people round about, saying, Take heed to yourselves, that ye go not up into the mount, or touch the border of it: whosoever toucheth the mount shall be surely put to death:

entries.yo: Ọwọkọwọ́ kò gbọdọ kàn a, bikoṣepe ki a sọ ọ li okuta, tabi ki a gún u pa nitõtọ; iba ṣe ẹranko iba ṣe enia, ki yio là a: nigbati ipè ba dún, ki nwọn ki o gùn oke wá.
entries.en: There shall not an hand touch it, but he shall surely be stoned, or shot through; whether it be beast or man, it shall not live: when the trumpet soundeth long, they shall come up to the mount.

entries.yo: Mose si sọkalẹ lati ori oke na wá sọdọ awọn enia, o si yà awọn enia si mimọ́, nwọn si fọ̀ aṣọ wọn.
