entries.en: And Moses went down from the mount unto the people, and sanctified the people; and they washed their clothes.

entries.yo: O si wi fun awọn enia pe, Ẹ mura dè ijọ́ kẹta: ki ẹ máṣe sunmọ aya nyin.
entries.en: And he said unto the people, Be ready against the third day: come not at your wives.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, li owurọ̀ ijọ́ kẹta, ni ãrá ati mànamána wà, ati awọsanma ṣíṣu dùdu lori òke na, ati ohùn ipè na si ndún kikankikan; tobẹ̃ ti gbogbo awọn ti o wà ni ibudó warìri.
entries.en: And it came to pass on the third day in the morning, that there were thunders and lightnings, and a thick cloud upon the mount, and the voice of the trumpet exceeding loud; so that all the people that was in the camp trembled.

entries.yo: Mose si mú awọn enia jade lati ibudó wá lati bá Ọlọrun pade; nwọn si duro ni ìha isalẹ oke na.
entries.en: And Moses brought forth the people out of the camp to meet with God; and they stood at the nether part of the mount.

entries.yo: Oke Sinai si jẹ́ kìki ẽfi, nitoriti OLUWA sọkalẹ sori rẹ̀ ninu iná: ẽfi na si goke bi ẽfi ileru, gbogbo oke na si mì tìtì.
entries.en: And mount Sinai was altogether on a smoke, because the LORD descended upon it in fire: and the smoke thereof ascended as the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mount quaked greatly.

entries.yo: O si ṣe ti ohùn ipè si dún, ti o si mulẹ kijikiji, Mose sọ̀rọ, Ọlọrun si fi ãrá da a li ohùn.
entries.en: And when the voice of the trumpet sounded long, and waxed louder and louder, Moses spake, and God answered him by a voice.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọkalẹ wá si oke Sinai, lori oke na: OLUWA si pè Mose lori oke na; Mose si goke lọ.
entries.en: And the LORD came down upon mount Sinai, on the top of the mount: and the LORD called Moses up to the top of the mount; and Moses went up.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun Mose pe, Sọkalẹ, kìlọ fun awọn enia, ki nwọn ki o má ba yà sọdọ OLUWA lati bẹ̀ ẹ wò, ki ọ̀pọ ki o má ba ṣegbe ninu wọn.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go down, charge the people, lest they break through unto the LORD to gaze, and many of them perish.

entries.yo: Si jẹ ki awọn alufa pẹlu, ti o sunmọ OLUWA, ki o yà ara wọn si mimọ́, ki OLUWA ki o má ba kọlù wọn.
entries.en: And let the priests also, which come near to the LORD, sanctify themselves, lest the LORD break forth upon them.

entries.yo: Mose si wi fun OLUWA pe, Awọn enia ki yio le wá sori oke Sinai: nitoriti iwọ ti kìlọ fun wa pe, Sọ agbàra yi oke na ká, ki o si yà a si mimọ́.
entries.en: And Moses said unto the LORD, The people cannot come up to mount Sinai: for thou chargedst us, saying, Set bounds about the mount, and sanctify it.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun u pe, Lọ, sọkalẹ; ki iwọ ki o si goke wá, iwọ ati Aaroni pẹlu rẹ: ṣugbọn ki awọn alufa ati awọn enia ki o máṣe yà lati goke tọ̀ OLUWA wá, ki o má ba kọlù wọn.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto him, Away, get thee down, and thou shalt come up, thou, and Aaron with thee: but let not the priests and the people break through to come up unto the LORD, lest he break forth upon them.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Mose sọkalẹ tọ̀ awọn enia lọ, o si sọ̀rọ fun wọn.
entries.en: So Moses went down unto the people, and spake unto them.

entries.yo: ỌLỌRUN si sọ gbogbo ọ̀rọ wọnyi pe,
entries.en: And God spake all these words, saying,

entries.yo: Emi li OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ, ti o mú ọ jade lati ilẹ Egipti, lati oko-ẹrú jade wá.
entries.en: I am the LORD thy God, which have brought thee out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

entries.yo: Iwọ kò gbọdọ lí Ọlọrun miran pẹlu mi.
entries.en: Thou shalt have no other gods before me.

entries.yo: Iwọ kò gbọdọ yá ere fun ara rẹ, tabi aworan ohun kan ti mbẹ loke ọrun, tabi ti ohun kan ti mbẹ ni isalẹ ilẹ, tabi ti ohun kan ti mbẹ ninu omi ni isalẹ̀ ilẹ.
entries.en: Thou shalt not make unto thee any graven image, or any likeness of any thing that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth:

entries.yo: Iwọ kò gbọdọ tẹ̀ ori ara rẹ ba fun wọn, bẹ̃ni iwọ kò gbọdọ sìn wọn: nitori emi li OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ, Ọlọrun owú ni mi, ti mbẹ̀ ẹ̀ṣẹ awọn baba wò lara awọn ọmọ, lati irandiran kẹta ati ẹkẹrin ninu awọn ti o korira mi;
entries.en: Thou shalt not bow down thyself to them, nor serve them: for I the LORD thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me;

entries.yo: Emi a si ma fi ãnu hàn ẹgbẹgbẹrun awọn ti o fẹ́ mi, ti nwọn si npa ofin mi mọ́.
entries.en: And shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me, and keep my commandments.

entries.yo: Iwọ kò gbọdọ pè orukọ OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ lasan; nitoriti OLUWA ki yio mu awọn ti o pè orukọ rẹ̀ lasan bi alailẹ̀ṣẹ li ọrùn.
entries.en: Thou shalt not take the name of the LORD thy God in vain; for the LORD will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain.

entries.yo: Ranti ọjọ́ isimi, lati yà a simimọ́.
entries.en: Remember the sabbath day, to keep it holy.

entries.yo: Ọjọ́ mẹfa ni iwọ o ṣiṣẹ, ti iwọ o si ṣe iṣẹ rẹ gbogbo:
entries.en: Six days shalt thou labour, and do all thy work:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ọjọ́ keje li ijọ́ isimi OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ: ninu rẹ̀ iwọ kò gbọdọ ṣe iṣẹkiṣẹ kan, iwọ, ati ọmọ rẹ ọkunrin, ati ọmọ rẹ obinrin, ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ ọkunrin, ati ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ obinrin, ati ohunọ̀sin rẹ, ati alejò rẹ̀ ti mbẹ ninu ibode rẹ:
entries.en: But the seventh day is the sabbath of the LORD thy God: in it thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, thy manservant, nor thy maidservant, nor thy cattle, nor thy stranger that is within thy gates:

entries.yo: Nitori ni ijọ́ mẹfa li OLUWA dá ọrun on aiye, okun ati ohun gbogbo ti mbẹ ninu wọn, o si simi ni ijọ́ keje: nitorina li OLUWA ṣe busi ijọ́ keje, o si yà a si mimọ́.
entries.en: For in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that in them is, and rested the seventh day: wherefore the LORD blessed the sabbath day, and hallowed it.

entries.yo: Bọ̀wọ fun baba on iya rẹ: ki ọjọ́ rẹ ki o le pẹ ni ilẹ ti OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ fi fun ọ.
entries.en: Honour thy father and thy mother: that thy days may be long upon the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.

entries.yo: Iwọ kò gbọdọ pania.
entries.en: Thou shalt not kill.

entries.yo: Iwọ kò gbọdọ ṣe panṣaga.
entries.en: Thou shalt not commit adultery.

entries.yo: Iwọ kò gbọdọ jale.
entries.en: Thou shalt not steal.

entries.yo: Iwọ kò gbọdọ jẹri eke si ẹnikeji rẹ.
entries.en: Thou shalt not bear false witness against thy neighbour.

entries.yo: Iwọ kò gbọdọ ṣojukokoro si ile ẹnikeji rẹ, iwọ kò gbọdọ ṣojukokoro si aya ẹnikeji rẹ, tabi si ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ̀ ọkunrin, tabi ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ̀ obinrin, akọmalu rẹ̀, kẹtẹkẹtẹ rẹ̀, tabi ohun gbogbo ti iṣe ti ẹnikeji rẹ.
entries.en: Thou shalt not covet thy neighbour's house, thou shalt not covet thy neighbour's wife, nor his manservant, nor his maidservant, nor his ox, nor his ass, nor any thing that is thy neighbour's.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn enia na si ri ãrá na, ati mànamána na, ati ohùn ipè na, nwọn ri oke na nṣe ẽfi: nigbati awọn enia si ri i, nwọn ṣí, nwọn duro li òkere rére.
entries.en: And all the people saw the thunderings, and the lightnings, and the noise of the trumpet, and the mountain smoking: and when the people saw it, they removed, and stood afar off.

entries.yo: Nwọn si wi fun Mose pe, Iwọ ma bá wa sọ̀rọ̀, awa o si gbọ́: ṣugbọn máṣe jẹ ki Ọlọrun ki o bá wa sọ̀rọ, ki awa ki o má ba kú.
entries.en: And they said unto Moses, Speak thou with us, and we will hear: but let not God speak with us, lest we die.

entries.yo: Mose si wi fun awọn enia pe, Ẹ má bẹ̀ru: nitoriti Ọlọrun wá lati dan nyin wò, ati ki ẹ̀ru rẹ̀ ki o le ma wà li oju nyin, ki ẹnyin ki o máṣe ṣẹ̀.
entries.en: And Moses said unto the people, Fear not: for God is come to prove you, and that his fear may be before your faces, that ye sin not.

entries.yo: Awọn enia si duro li òkere rére, Mose si sunmọ ibi òkunkun ṣiṣu na nibiti Ọlọrun gbé wà.
entries.en: And the people stood afar off, and Moses drew near unto the thick darkness where God was.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun Mose pe, Bayi ni ki iwọ ki o wi fun awọn ọmọ Israeli pe, Ẹnyin ri bi emi ti bá nyin sọ̀rọ lati ọrun wá.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Thus thou shalt say unto the children of Israel, Ye have seen that I have talked with you from heaven.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin kò gbọdọ ṣe ọlọrun miran pẹlu mi; Ẹnyin kò gbọdọ ṣe ọlọrun fadaka, tabi ọlọrun wurà, fun ara nyin.
entries.en: Ye shall not make with me gods of silver, neither shall ye make unto you gods of gold.

entries.yo: Pẹpẹ erupẹ ni ki iwọ mọ fun mi, lori rẹ̀ ni ki iwọ ki o ma ru ẹbọ sisun rẹ, ati ẹbọ alafia rẹ, agutan rẹ, ati akọmalu rẹ: ni ibi gbogbo ti mo ba gbé fi iranti orukọ mi si, emi o ma tọ̀ ọ wá, emi o si ma bukún fun ọ.
entries.en: An altar of earth thou shalt make unto me, and shalt sacrifice thereon thy burnt offerings, and thy peace offerings, thy sheep, and thine oxen: in all places where I record my name I will come unto thee, and I will bless thee.

entries.yo: Bi iwọ o ba si mọ pẹpẹ okuta fun mi, iwọ kò gbọdọ fi okuta gbigbẹ́ mọ ọ: nitori bi iwọ ba gbé ohun-ọnà rẹ lé ori rẹ̀, iwọ sọ ọ di aimọ́.
entries.en: And if thou wilt make me an altar of stone, thou shalt not build it of hewn stone: for if thou lift up thy tool upon it, thou hast polluted it.

entries.yo: Iwọ kò si gbọdọ ba àkasọ gùn ori pẹpẹ mi, ki ìhoho rẹ ki o máṣe hàn lori rẹ̀.
entries.en: Neither shalt thou go up by steps unto mine altar, that thy nakedness be not discovered thereon.

entries.yo: NJẸ wọnyi ni idajọ ti iwọ o gbekalẹ niwaju wọn.
entries.en: Now these are the judgments which thou shalt set before them.

entries.yo: Bi iwọ ba rà ọkunrin Heberu li ẹrú, ọdún mẹfa ni on o sìn: li ọdún keje yio si jade bi omnira lọfẹ.
entries.en: If thou buy an Hebrew servant, six years he shall serve: and in the seventh he shall go out free for nothing.

entries.yo: Bi o ba nikan wọle wá, on o si nikan jade lọ: bi o ba ti gbé iyawo, njẹ ki aya rẹ̀ ki o bá a jade lọ.
entries.en: If he came in by himself, he shall go out by himself: if he were married, then his wife shall go out with him.

entries.yo: Bi o ba ṣepe oluwa rẹ̀ li o fun u li aya, ti on si bi ọmọkunrin tabi ọmọbinrin fun u; aya ati awọn ọmọ ni yio jẹ́ ti oluwa rẹ̀, on tikara rẹ̀ yio si nikan jade lọ.
entries.en: If his master have given him a wife, and she have born him sons or daughters; the wife and her children shall be her master's, and he shall go out by himself.

entries.yo: Bi ẹru na ba si wi ni gbangba pe, Emi fẹ́ oluwa mi, aya mi, ati awọn ọmọ mi; emi ki yio jade lọ idi omnira:
entries.en: And if the servant shall plainly say, I love my master, my wife, and my children; I will not go out free:

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ki oluwa rẹ̀ ki o mú u lọ sọdọ awọn onidajọ; yio si mú u lọ si ẹnu-ọ̀na, tabi si opó ẹnu-ọ̀na; oluwa rẹ̀ yio si fi olù lú u li eti; on a si ma sìn i titi aiye.
entries.en: Then his master shall bring him unto the judges; he shall also bring him to the door, or unto the door post; and his master shall bore his ear through with an aul; and he shall serve him for ever.

entries.yo: Bi ẹnikan ba si tà ọmọ rẹ̀ obinrin li ẹrú, on ki yio jade lọ bi awọn ẹrú ọkunrin ti ijade lọ.
entries.en: And if a man sell his daughter to be a maidservant, she shall not go out as the menservants do.

entries.yo: Bi on kò ba wù oluwa rẹ̀, ti o ti fẹ́ ẹ fun ara rẹ̀, njẹ ki o jẹ ki a rà a pada, on ki yio lagbara lati tà a fun ajeji enia, o sa ti tàn a jẹ.
entries.en: If she please not her master, who hath betrothed her to himself, then shall he let her be redeemed: to sell her unto a strange nation he shall have no power, seeing he hath dealt deceitfully with her.

entries.yo: Bi o ba si fẹ́ ẹ fun ọmọkunrin rẹ̀, ki o ma ṣe si i bi a ti iṣe si ọmọbinrin ẹni.
entries.en: And if he have betrothed her unto his son, he shall deal with her after the manner of daughters.

entries.yo: Bi o ba si fẹ́ obinrin miran; onjẹ rẹ̀, aṣọ rẹ̀, ati iṣe ọkọlaya rẹ̀, ki o máṣe yẹ̀.
entries.en: If he take him another wife; her food, her raiment, and her duty of marriage, shall he not diminish.

entries.yo: Bi on ki yio ba si ṣe ohun mẹtẹta yi fun u, njẹ ki on ki o jade kuro lọfẹ li aisan owo.
entries.en: And if he do not these three unto her, then shall she go out free without money.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba lù enia, tobẹ̃ ti o si ku, pipa li a o pa a.
entries.en: He that smiteth a man, so that he die, shall be surely put to death.

entries.yo: Bi o ba ṣepe enia kò ba dèna, ṣugbọn ti o ṣepe Ọlọrun li o fi lé e lọwọ, njẹ emi o yàn ibi fun ọ, nibiti on o gbé salọ si.
entries.en: And if a man lie not in wait, but God deliver him into his hand; then I will appoint thee a place whither he shall flee.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi enia ba ṣìka si aladugbo rẹ̀, lati fi ẹ̀tan pa a; ki iwọ ki o tilẹ mú u lati ibi pẹpẹ mi lọ, ki o le kú.
entries.en: But if a man come presumptuously upon his neighbour, to slay him with guile; thou shalt take him from mine altar, that he may die.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba si lù baba, tabi iya rẹ̀, pipa li a o pa a.
entries.en: And he that smiteth his father, or his mother, shall be surely put to death.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba si ji enia, ti o si tà a, tabi ti a ri i li ọwọ́ rẹ̀, pipa li a o pa a.
entries.en: And he that stealeth a man, and selleth him, or if he be found in his hand, he shall surely be put to death.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba si bú baba tabi iya rẹ̀, pipa li a o pa a.
entries.en: And he that curseth his father, or his mother, shall surely be put to death.

entries.yo: Bi awọn ọkunrin ba si jùmọ̀ njà, ti ekini fi okuta lù ekeji, tabi ti o jìn i li ẹsẹ̀, ti on kò si kú ṣugbọn ti o da a bulẹ:
entries.en: And if men strive together, and one smite another with a stone, or with his fist, and he die not, but keepeth his bed:

entries.yo: Bi o ba si tun dide, ti o ntẹ̀ ọpá rìn kiri ni ita, nigbana li ẹniti o lù u yio to bọ́; kìki gbèse akokò ti o sọnù ni yio san, on o si ṣe ati mu u lara da ṣaṣa.
entries.en: If he rise again, and walk abroad upon his staff, then shall he that smote him be quit: only he shall pay for the loss of his time, and shall cause him to be thoroughly healed.

entries.yo: Bi ẹnikan ba si fi ọpá lù ẹrú rẹ̀ ọkunrin tabi obinrin, ti o si kú si i li ọwọ́, a o gbẹsan rẹ̀ nitõtọ.
entries.en: And if a man smite his servant, or his maid, with a rod, and he die under his hand; he shall be surely punished.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi o ba duro di ijọ́ kan, tabi meji, a ki yio gbẹsan rẹ̀: nitoripe owo rẹ̀ ni iṣe.
entries.en: Notwithstanding, if he continue a day or two, he shall not be punished: for he is his money.

entries.yo: Bi awọn ọkunrin ba njà, ti nwọn si pa obinrin aboyún lara, tobẹ̃ ti oyún rẹ̀ ṣẹ́, ṣugbọn ti ibi miran kò si pẹlu: a o mu ki o san nitõtọ, gẹgẹ bi ọkọ obinrin na yio ti dá lé e; on o si san a niwaju onidajọ.
entries.en: If men strive, and hurt a woman with child, so that her fruit depart from her, and yet no mischief follow: he shall be surely punished, according as the woman's husband will lay upon him; and he shall pay as the judges determine.

entries.yo: Bi ibi kan ba si pẹlu, njẹ ki iwọ ki o fi ẹmi dipò ẹmi.
entries.en: And if any mischief follow, then thou shalt give life for life,

entries.yo: Fi oju dipò oju, ehín dipò ehín, ọwọ́ dipò ọwọ́, ẹsẹ̀ dipò ẹsẹ̀.
entries.en: Eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,

entries.yo: Fi ijóna dipò ijóna, ọgbẹ́, dipò ọgbẹ́, ìna dipò ìna.
entries.en: Burning for burning, wound for wound, stripe for stripe.

entries.yo: Bi o ba ṣepe ẹnikan ba lù ẹrú rẹ̀ ọkunrin tabi ẹrú rẹ̀ obinrin li oju ti o si fọ́; ki o si jọwọ rẹ̀ lọ li omnira nitori oju rẹ̀.
entries.en: And if a man smite the eye of his servant, or the eye of his maid, that it perish; he shall let him go free for his eye's sake.

entries.yo: Bi o ba si ká ehín ẹrú rẹ̀ ọkunrin, tabi ehín ẹrú rẹ̀ obinrin; ki o si jọwọ rẹ̀ lọ li omnira nitori ehín rẹ̀.
entries.en: And if he smite out his manservant's tooth, or his maidservant's tooth; he shall let him go free for his tooth's sake.

entries.yo: Bi akọmalu ba kàn ọkunrin tabi obinrin ti o si kú: sísọ ni ki a sọ akọmalu na li okuta pa bi o ti wù ki o ṣe, ki a má si ṣe jẹ ẹran rẹ̀; ṣugbọn ọrùn oni-akọmalu na yio mọ́.
entries.en: If an ox gore a man or a woman, that they die: then the ox shall be surely stoned, and his flesh shall not be eaten; but the owner of the ox shall be quit.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi o ba ṣepe akọmalu na a ti ma fi iwo rẹ̀ kàn nigba atijọ, ti a si ti kìlọ fun oluwa rẹ̀, ti kò si sé e mọ, ṣugbọn ti o pa ọkunrin tabi obinrin, akọmalu na li a o sọ li okuta pa, oluwa rẹ̀ li a o si lù pa pẹlu.
entries.en: But if the ox were wont to push with his horn in time past, and it hath been testified to his owner, and he hath not kept him in, but that he hath killed a man or a woman; the ox shall be stoned, and his owner also shall be put to death.

entries.yo: Bi o ba si ṣepe a bù iye owo kan fun u, njẹ iyekiye ti a bù fun u ni yio fi ṣe irapada ẹmi rẹ̀.
entries.en: If there be laid on him a sum of money, then he shall give for the ransom of his life whatsoever is laid upon him.

entries.yo: Iba kàn ọmọkunrin, tabi iba kàn ọmọbinrin, gẹgẹ bi irú idajọ yi li a o ṣe si i.
entries.en: Whether he have gored a son, or have gored a daughter, according to this judgment shall it be done unto him.

entries.yo: Bi akọmalu na ba kan ẹrukunrin tabi ẹrubirin; on o si san ọgbọ̀n ṣekeli fadakà fun oluwa rẹ̀, a o si sọ akọmalu na li okuta pa.
entries.en: If the ox shall push a manservant or a maidservant; he shall give unto their master thirty shekels of silver, and the ox shall be stoned.

entries.yo: Bi ẹnikan ba ṣi ihò silẹ, tabi bi ọkunrin kan ba si wà ihò silẹ, ti kò si bò o, ti akọmalu tabi kẹtẹkẹtẹ ba bọ́ sinu rẹ̀;
entries.en: And if a man shall open a pit, or if a man shall dig a pit, and not cover it, and an ox or an ass fall therein;

entries.yo: Oni-ihò na yio si san; yio si fi owo fun oluwa wọn; okú ẹran a si jẹ́ tirẹ̀.
entries.en: The owner of the pit shall make it good, and give money unto the owner of them; and the dead beast shall be his.

entries.yo: Bi akọmalu ẹnikan ba si pa akọmalu ẹnikeji lara ti o si kú; ki nwọn ki o tà ãye akọmalu, ki nwọn ki o si pín owo rẹ̀; oku ni ki nwọn ki o si pín pẹlu.
entries.en: And if one man's ox hurt another's, that he die; then they shall sell the live ox, and divide the money of it; and the dead ox also they shall divide.

entries.yo: Tabi bi a ba si mọ̀ pe akọmalu na a ti ma kàn nigba atijọ ti oluwa rẹ̀ kò sé e mọ́; on o fi akọmalu san akọmalu nitõtọ; okú a si jẹ́ tirẹ̀.
entries.en: Or if it be known that the ox hath used to push in time past, and his owner hath not kept him in; he shall surely pay ox for ox; and the dead shall be his own.

entries.yo: BI ọkunrin kan ba ji akọmalu, tabi agutan kan, ti o si pa a, tabi ti o tà a; yio san akọmalu marun dipò akọmalu kan, ati agutan mẹrin dipò agutan kan.
entries.en: If a man shall steal an ox, or a sheep, and kill it, or sell it; he shall restore five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep.

entries.yo: Bi a ba ri olè ti nrunlẹ wọle, ti a si lù u ti o kú, a ki yio ta ẹ̀jẹ silẹ fun u.
entries.en: If a thief be found breaking up, and be smitten that he die, there shall no blood be shed for him.

entries.yo: Bi õrùn ba là bá a, a o ta ẹ̀jẹ silẹ fun u; sisan li on iba san; bi kò ni nkan, njẹ a o tà a nitori olè rẹ̀.
entries.en: If the sun be risen upon him, there shall be blood shed for him; for he should make full restitution; if he have nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft.

entries.yo: Bi a ba ri ohun ti o ji na li ọwọ́ rẹ̀ nitõtọ li ãye, iba ṣe akọmalu, tabi kẹtẹkẹtẹ, tabi agutan; on o san a pada ni meji.
entries.en: If the theft be certainly found in his hand alive, whether it be ox, or ass, or sheep; he shall restore double.

entries.yo: Bi ọkunrin kan ba mu ki a jẹ oko tabi agbalá-àjara kan, ti o si tú ẹran rẹ̀ silẹ, ti o si jẹ li oko ẹlomiran; ninu ãyo oko ti ara rẹ̀, ati ninu ãyo agbalá-àjara tirẹ̀, ni yio fi san ẹsan.
entries.en: If a man shall cause a field or vineyard to be eaten, and shall put in his beast, and shall feed in another man's field; of the best of his own field, and of the best of his own vineyard, shall he make restitution.

entries.yo: Bi iná ba ṣẹ̀, ti o si mu ẹwọn, ti abà ọkà, tabi ọkà aiṣá, tabi oko li o joná; ẹniti o ràn iná na yio san ẹsan nitõtọ.
entries.en: If fire break out, and catch in thorns, so that the stacks of corn, or the standing corn, or the field, be consumed therewith; he that kindled the fire shall surely make restitution.

entries.yo: Bi ẹnikan ba fi owo tabi ohunèlo fun ẹnikeji rẹ̀ pamọ́; ti a ji i ni ile ọkunrin na; bi a ba mu olè na, ki o san a ni meji.
entries.en: If a man shall deliver unto his neighbour money or stuff to keep, and it be stolen out of the man's house; if the thief be found, let him pay double.

entries.yo: Bi a kò ba mú olè na, njẹ ki a mú bale na wá siwaju awọn onidajọ, bi on kò ba fọwọkàn ẹrù ẹnikeji rẹ̀.
entries.en: If the thief be not found, then the master of the house shall be brought unto the judges, to see whether he have put his hand unto his neighbour's goods.

entries.yo: Nitori irú ẹ̀ṣẹ gbogbo, iba ṣe ti akọmalu, ti kẹtẹkẹtẹ, ti agutan, ti aṣọ, tabi ti irũru ohun ti o nù, ti ẹlomiran pè ni ti on, ẹjọ́ awọn mejeji yio wá siwaju awọn onidajọ; ẹniti awọn onidajọ ba dẹbi fun, on o san a ni iṣẹmeji fun ẹnikeji rẹ̀.
entries.en: For all manner of trespass, whether it be for ox, for ass, for sheep, for raiment, or for any manner of lost thing, which another challengeth to be his, the cause of both parties shall come before the judges; and whom the judges shall condemn, he shall pay double unto his neighbour.

entries.yo: Bi enia ba fi kẹtẹkẹtẹ, tabi akọmalu, tabi agutan, tabi ẹrankẹran lé ẹnikeji rẹ̀ lọwọ lati ma sìn; ti o ba si kú, tabi ti o farapa, tabi ti a lé e sọnù, ti ẹnikan kò ri i;
entries.en: If a man deliver unto his neighbour an ass, or an ox, or a sheep, or any beast, to keep; and it die, or be hurt, or driven away, no man seeing it:

entries.yo: Ibura OLUWA yio wà lãrin awọn mejeji, pe, on kò fọwọkàn ẹrù ẹnikeji on; ki on ki o si gbà, on ki yio si san ẹsan.
entries.en: Then shall an oath of the LORD be between them both, that he hath not put his hand unto his neighbour's goods; and the owner of it shall accept thereof, and he shall not make it good.

entries.yo: Bi o ba ṣepe a ji i lọwọ rẹ̀, on o san ẹsan fun oluwa rẹ̀.
entries.en: And if it be stolen from him, he shall make restitution unto the owner thereof.

entries.yo: Bi o ba ṣepe a si fà a ya, njẹ ki o mú u wa ṣe ẹrí, on ki yio si san ẹsan eyiti a fàya.
entries.en: If it be torn in pieces, then let him bring it for witness, and he shall not make good that which was torn.

entries.yo: Bi enia ba si yá ohun kan lọwọ ẹnikeji rẹ̀, ti o si farapa, tabi ti o kú, ti olohun kò si nibẹ̀, on o san ẹsan nitõtọ.
entries.en: And if a man borrow ought of his neighbour, and it be hurt, or die, the owner thereof being not with it, he shall surely make it good.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi olohun ba wà nibẹ̀, on ki yio san ẹsan: bi o ba ṣe ohun ti a fi owo gbà lò ni, o dé fun owo igbàlo rẹ̀.
entries.en: But if the owner thereof be with it, he shall not make it good: if it be an hired thing, it came for his hire.

entries.yo: Bi ọkunrin kan ba si tàn wundia kan ti a kò ti ifẹ́, ti o si mọ̀ ọ, fifẹ́ ni yio si fẹ́ ẹ li aya rẹ̀.
entries.en: And if a man entice a maid that is not betrothed, and lie with her, he shall surely endow her to be his wife.

entries.yo: Bi baba rẹ̀ ba kọ̀ jalẹ lati fi i fun u, on o san ojì gẹgẹ bi ifẹ́ wundia.
entries.en: If her father utterly refuse to give her unto him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins.

entries.yo: Iwọ kò gbọdọ jẹ ki ajẹ́ ki o wà lãye.
entries.en: Thou shalt not suffer a witch to live.

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni ti o ba bá ẹranko dàpọ pipa li a o pa a.
entries.en: Whosoever lieth with a beast shall surely be put to death.

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni ti o ba rubọ si oriṣakoriṣa, bikoṣe si JEHOFA nikanṣoṣo, a o pa a run tútu.
entries.en: He that sacrificeth unto any god, save unto the LORD only, he shall be utterly destroyed.

entries.yo: Iwọ kò gbọdọ ṣìka si alejò, bẹ̃ni iwọ kò gbọdọ ni i lara: nitoripe alejò li ẹnyin ti jẹ́ ni ilẹ Egipti.
entries.en: Thou shalt neither vex a stranger, nor oppress him: for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin kò gbọdọ jẹ opó ni ìya, tabi ọmọ alainibaba.
entries.en: Ye shall not afflict any widow, or fatherless child.

entries.yo: Bi iwọ ba jẹ wọn ni ìyakiya, ti nwọn si kigbe pè mi, emi o gbọ́ igbe wọn nitõtọ.
entries.en: If thou afflict them in any wise, and they cry at all unto me, I will surely hear their cry;

entries.yo: Ibinu mi yio si gboná, emi o si fi idà pa nyin; awọn aya nyin yio si di opó, awọn ọmọ nyin a si di alainibaba.
entries.en: And my wrath shall wax hot, and I will kill you with the sword; and your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless.

entries.yo: Bi iwọ ba yá ẹnikẹni ninu awọn enia mi li owo ti o ṣe talaka lọdọ rẹ, iwọ ki yio jẹ́ bi agbẹ̀da fun u; bẹ̃ni iwọ ki yio gbẹ̀da lọwọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: If thou lend money to any of my people that is poor by thee, thou shalt not be to him as an usurer, neither shalt thou lay upon him usury.

entries.yo: Bi o ba ṣepe iwọ gbà aṣọ ẹnikeji rẹ ṣe ògo, ki iwọ ki o si fi i fun u, ki õrùn to wọ̀:
entries.en: If thou at all take thy neighbour's raiment to pledge, thou shalt deliver it unto him by that the sun goeth down:

entries.yo: Nitori kìki eyi ni ibora rẹ̀, aṣọ rẹ̀ ti yio fi bora ni: kini on o fi bora sùn? yio si ṣe bi o ba kigbe pè mi, emi o gbọ́; nitori alãnu li emi.
entries.en: For that is his covering only, it is his raiment for his skin: wherein shall he sleep? and it shall come to pass, when he crieth unto me, that I will hear; for I am gracious.

entries.yo: Iwọ kò gbọdọ gàn awọn onidajọ, bẹ̃ni iwọ kò gbọdọ bú ijoye kan ninu awọn enia rẹ.
entries.en: Thou shalt not revile the gods, nor curse the ruler of thy people.

entries.yo: Iwọ kò gbọdọ jafara lati mú irè oko rẹ wá, ati ọti rẹ. Akọ́bi awọn ọmọ rẹ ọkunrin ni iwọ o fi fun mi.
entries.en: Thou shalt not delay to offer the first of thy ripe fruits, and of thy liquors: the firstborn of thy sons shalt thou give unto me.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ gẹgẹ ni ki iwọ ki o fi akọmalu ati agutan rẹ ṣe: ijọ́ meje ni ki o ba iya rẹ̀ gbọ́; ni ijọ́ kẹjọ ni ki iwọ ki o fi i fun mi.
entries.en: Likewise shalt thou do with thine oxen, and with thy sheep: seven days it shall be with his dam; on the eighth day thou shalt give it me.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin o si jẹ́ enia mimọ́ fun mi; nitorina ẹnyin kò gbọdọ jẹ ẹran ti a ti ọwọ ẹranko igbẹ́ fàya; ajá ni ki ẹnyin ki o wọ́ ọ fun.
entries.en: And ye shall be holy men unto me: neither shall ye eat any flesh that is torn of beasts in the field; ye shall cast it to the dogs.

entries.yo: IWỌ kò gbọdọ gbà ìhin eke: máṣe li ọwọ́ si i pẹlu enia buburu lati ṣe ẹlẹri aiṣododo.
entries.en: Thou shalt not raise a false report: put not thine hand with the wicked to be an unrighteous witness.

entries.yo: Iwọ kò gbọdọ tọ̀ ọ̀pọlọpọ enia lẹhin lati ṣe ibi, bẹ̃ni iwọ kò gbọdọ sọ̀rọ̀ li ọ̀ran ki o tẹ̀ si ọ̀pọ enia lati yi ẹjọ́ po.
entries.en: Thou shalt not follow a multitude to do evil; neither shalt thou speak in a cause to decline after many to wrest judgment:

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni iwọ kò gbọdọ gbè talaka li ẹjọ́ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Neither shalt thou countenance a poor man in his cause.

entries.yo: Bi iwọ ba bá akọmalu tabi kẹtẹkẹtẹ ọtá rẹ ti o ṣina, ki iwọ ki o mú u pada fun u wá nitõtọ.
entries.en: If thou meet thine enemy's ox or his ass going astray, thou shalt surely bring it back to him again.

entries.yo: Bi iwọ ba ri kẹtẹkẹtẹ ẹniti o korira rẹ, ti o dubulẹ labẹ ẹrù rẹ̀, ti iwọ iba yẹra lati bá a tú u, iwọ o bá a tú u nitõtọ.
entries.en: If thou see the ass of him that hateth thee lying under his burden, and wouldest forbear to help him, thou shalt surely help with him.

entries.yo: Iwọ kò gbọdọ yi ẹjọ́ talaka rẹ po li ọ̀ran rẹ̀.
entries.en: Thou shalt not wrest the judgment of thy poor in his cause.

entries.yo: Takéte li ọ̀ran eke; ati alaiṣẹ ati olododo ni iwọ kò gbọdọ pa: nitoriti emi ki yio dá enia buburu lare.
entries.en: Keep thee far from a false matter; and the innocent and righteous slay thou not: for I will not justify the wicked.

entries.yo: Iwọ kò gbọdọ gbà ọrẹ: nitori ọrẹ ni ifọ́ awọn ti o riran loju, a si yi ọ̀ran awọn olododo po.
entries.en: And thou shalt take no gift: for the gift blindeth the wise, and perverteth the words of the righteous.

entries.yo: Ati pẹlu iwọ kò gbọdọ pọ́n alejò kan loju: ẹnyin sa ti mọ̀ inu alejò, nitoriti ẹnyin ti jẹ́ alejò ni ilẹ Egipti.
entries.en: Also thou shalt not oppress a stranger: for ye know the heart of a stranger, seeing ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.

entries.yo: Ọdún mẹfa ni iwọ o si gbìn ilẹ rẹ, on ni iwọ o si kó eso rẹ̀ jọ.
entries.en: And six years thou shalt sow thy land, and shalt gather in the fruits thereof:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn li ọdún keje iwọ o jẹ ki o simi, ki o si gbé jẹ; ki awọn talaka enia rẹ ki o ma jẹ ninu rẹ̀: eyiti nwọn si fisilẹ ni ki ẹran igbẹ ki o ma jẹ. Irú bẹ̃ gẹgẹ ni iwọ o ṣe si agbalá-àjara, ati agbalá-olifi rẹ.
entries.en: But the seventh year thou shalt let it rest and lie still; that the poor of thy people may eat: and what they leave the beasts of the field shall eat. In like manner thou shalt deal with thy vineyard, and with thy oliveyard.

entries.yo: Ijọ́ mẹfa ni iwọ o ṣe iṣẹ rẹ, ni ijọ́ keje ki iwọ ki o si simi: ki akọmalu rẹ, ati kẹtẹkẹtẹ rẹ ki o le simi, ki a le tù ọmọ iranṣẹbinrin rẹ, ati alejò, lara.
entries.en: Six days thou shalt do thy work, and on the seventh day thou shalt rest: that thine ox and thine ass may rest, and the son of thy handmaid, and the stranger, may be refreshed.

entries.yo: Ati li ohun gbogbo ti mo wi fun nyin, ẹ ma ṣọra: ki ẹ má si ṣe iranti orukọ oriṣakoriṣa ki a má ṣe gbọ́ ọ li ẹnu nyin.
entries.en: And in all things that I have said unto you be circumspect: and make no mention of the name of other gods, neither let it be heard out of thy mouth.

entries.yo: Ni ìgba mẹta ni iwọ o ṣe ajọ fun mi li ọdún.
entries.en: Three times thou shalt keep a feast unto me in the year.

entries.yo: Iwọ o kiyesi ajọ aiwukàra: ijọ́ meje ni iwọ o fi jẹ àkara alaiwu, bi mo ti pa a laṣẹ fun ọ, li akokò oṣù Abibu (nitori ninu rẹ̀ ni iwọ jade kuro ni Egipti); a kò gbọdọ ri ẹnikan niwaju mi li ọwọ́ ofo:
entries.en: Thou shalt keep the feast of unleavened bread: (thou shalt eat unleavened bread seven days, as I commanded thee, in the time appointed of the month Abib; for in it thou camest out from Egypt: and none shall appear before me empty:)

entries.yo: Ati ajọ ikore, akọ́so iṣẹ rẹ, ti iwọ gbìn li oko rẹ: ati ajọ ikore oko, li opin ọdún, nigbati iwọ ba ṣe ikore iṣẹ oko rẹ tán.
entries.en: And the feast of harvest, the firstfruits of thy labours, which thou hast sown in the field: and the feast of ingathering, which is in the end of the year, when thou hast gathered in thy labours out of the field.

entries.yo: Ni ìgba mẹta li ọdún ni gbogbo awọn ọkunrin rẹ yio farahàn niwaju Oluwa JEHOFA.
entries.en: Three times in the year all thy males shall appear before the Lord GOD.

entries.yo: Iwọ kò gbọdọ ta ọrẹ ẹ̀jẹ ẹbọ mi ti on ti àkara wiwu; bẹ̃li ọrá ẹbọ ajọ mi kò gbọdọ kù titi di ojumọ́.
entries.en: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread; neither shall the fat of my sacrifice remain until the morning.

entries.yo: Akọ́ka eso ilẹ rẹ ni ki iwọ ki o múwa si ile OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ. Iwọ kò gbọdọ bọ̀ ọmọ ewurẹ ninu warà iya rẹ̀.
entries.en: The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring into the house of the LORD thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother's milk.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, emi rán angeli kan siwaju rẹ lati pa ọ mọ́ li ọ̀na, ati lati mú ọ dé ibi ti mo ti pèse silẹ.
entries.en: Behold, I send an Angel before thee, to keep thee in the way, and to bring thee into the place which I have prepared.

entries.yo: Kiyesi ara lọdọ rẹ̀, ki o si gbà ohùn rẹ̀ gbọ́, máṣe bi i ninu; nitoriti ki yio dari irekọja nyin jì nyin, nitoriti orukọ mi mbẹ lara rẹ̀.
entries.en: Beware of him, and obey his voice, provoke him not; for he will not pardon your transgressions: for my name is in him.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi iwọ o ba gbà ohùn rẹ̀ gbọ́ nitõtọ, ti iwọ si ṣe gbogbo eyiti mo wi; njẹ emi o jasi ọtá awọn ẹniti nṣe ọtá nyin, emi o si foró awọn ti nforó nyin.
entries.en: But if thou shalt indeed obey his voice, and do all that I speak; then I will be an enemy unto thine enemies, and an adversary unto thine adversaries.

entries.yo: Nitoriti angeli mi yio ṣaju rẹ, yio si mú ọ dé ọdọ awọn enia Amori, ati awọn Hitti, ati awọn Perissi, ati awọn ara Kenaani, awọn Hifi, ati awọn Jebusi: emi a si ke wọn kuro.
entries.en: For mine Angel shall go before thee, and bring thee in unto the Amorites, and the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites: and I will cut them off.

entries.yo: Iwọ kò gbọdọ tẹriba fun oriṣa wọn, bẹ̃ni iwọ kò gbọdọ sìn wọn, ki o má si ṣe gẹgẹ bi iṣe wọn: bikoṣepe ki iwọ ki o fọ́ wọn tútu, ki iwọ ki o si wó ere wọn palẹ.
entries.en: Thou shalt not bow down to their gods, nor serve them, nor do after their works: but thou shalt utterly overthrow them, and quite break down their images.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin o si ma sìn OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin, on o si busi onjẹ rẹ, ati omi rẹ; emi o si mú àrun kuro lãrin rẹ.
entries.en: And ye shall serve the LORD your God, and he shall bless thy bread, and thy water; and I will take sickness away from the midst of thee.

entries.yo: Obinrin kan ki yio ṣẹ́nu, bẹ̃ni ki yio yàgan ni ilẹ rẹ: iye ọjọ́ rẹ li emi ó fi kún.
entries.en: There shall nothing cast their young, nor be barren, in thy land: the number of thy days I will fulfil.

entries.yo: Emi o rán ẹ̀ru mi siwaju rẹ, emi o si dà gbogbo awọn enia rú ọdọ ẹniti iwọ o dé, emi o si mu gbogbo awọn ọtá rẹ yi ẹ̀hin wọn dà si ọ.
entries.en: I will send my fear before thee, and will destroy all the people to whom thou shalt come, and I will make all thine enemies turn their backs unto thee.

entries.yo: Emi o si rán agbọ́n siwaju rẹ, ti yio lé awọn enia Hifi, ati awọn ara Kenaani, ati awọn enia Hitti kuro niwaju rẹ.
entries.en: And I will send hornets before thee, which shall drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before thee.

entries.yo: Emi ki yio lé wọn jade kuro niwaju rẹ li ọdún kan; ki ilẹ na ki o má ba di ijù, ki ẹranko igbẹ́ ki o má ba rẹ̀ si ọ.
entries.en: I will not drive them out from before thee in one year; lest the land become desolate, and the beast of the field multiply against thee.

entries.yo: Diẹdiẹ li emi o ma lé wọn jade kuro niwaju rẹ, titi iwọ o fi di pupọ̀, ti iwọ o si tẹ̀ ilẹ na dó.
entries.en: By little and little I will drive them out from before thee, until thou be increased, and inherit the land.

entries.yo: Emi o si fi opinlẹ rẹ lelẹ, lati Okun Pupa wá titi yio fi dé okun awọn ara Filistia, ati lati aṣalẹ̀ nì wá dé odò nì; nitoriti emi o fi awọn olugbe ilẹ na lé nyin lọwọ; iwọ o si lé wọn jade kuro niwaju rẹ.
entries.en: And I will set thy bounds from the Red sea even unto the sea of the Philistines, and from the desert unto the river: for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand; and thou shalt drive them out before thee.

entries.yo: Iwọ kò gbọdọ bá wọn ṣe adehùn, ati awọn oriṣa wọn pẹlu.
entries.en: Thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor with their gods.

entries.yo: Nwọn kò gbọdọ joko ni ilẹ rẹ, ki nwọn ki o má ba mu ọ ṣẹ̀ si mi: nitori bi iwọ ba sìn oriṣa wọn, yio ṣe idẹkùn fun ọ nitõtọ.
entries.en: They shall not dwell in thy land, lest they make thee sin against me: for if thou serve their gods, it will surely be a snare unto thee.

entries.yo: O SI wi fun Mose pe, Goke tọ̀ OLUWA wá, iwọ, ati Aaroni, Nadabu, ati Abihu, ati ãdọrin ninu awọn àgba Israeli; ki ẹnyin ki o si ma sìn li òkere rére.
entries.en: And he said unto Moses, Come up unto the LORD, thou, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and worship ye afar off.

entries.yo: Mose nikanṣoṣo ni yio si sunmọ OLUWA; ṣugbọn awọn wọnyi kò gbọdọ sunmọ tosi; bẹ̃li awọn enia kò gbọdọ bá a gòke lọ.
entries.en: And Moses alone shall come near the LORD: but they shall not come nigh; neither shall the people go up with him.

entries.yo: Mose si wá o si sọ gbogbo ọ̀rọ OLUWA, ati gbogbo idajọ fun awọn enia: gbogbo enia si fi ohùn kan dahùn wipe, Gbogbo ọ̀rọ ti OLUWA wi li awa o ṣe.
entries.en: And Moses came and told the people all the words of the LORD, and all the judgments: and all the people answered with one voice, and said, All the words which the LORD hath said will we do.

entries.yo: Mose si kọwe gbogbo ọ̀rọ OLUWA, o si dide ni kùtukutu owurọ̀, o si tẹ́ pẹpẹ kan nisalẹ òke na, o mọ ọwọ̀n mejila, gẹgẹ bi ẹ̀ya Israeli mejila.
entries.en: And Moses wrote all the words of the LORD, and rose up early in the morning, and builded an altar under the hill, and twelve pillars, according to the twelve tribes of Israel.

entries.yo: O si rán awọn ọdọmọkunrin ninu awọn ọmọ Israeli, nwọn si ru ẹbọ sisun, nwọn si fi akọmalu ru ẹbọ alafia si OLUWA.
entries.en: And he sent young men of the children of Israel, which offered burnt offerings, and sacrificed peace offerings of oxen unto the LORD.

entries.yo: Mose si mú àbọ ẹ̀jẹ na o si fi i sinu awokòto; ati àbọ ẹ̀jẹ na o fi wọ́n ara pẹpẹ na.
entries.en: And Moses took half of the blood, and put it in basons; and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.

entries.yo: O si mú iwé majẹmu nì, o si kà a li eti awọn enia: nwọn si wipe, Gbogbo eyiti OLUWA wi li awa o ṣe, awa o si gbọràn.
entries.en: And he took the book of the covenant, and read in the audience of the people: and they said, All that the LORD hath said will we do, and be obedient.

entries.yo: Mose si mú ẹ̀jẹ na, o si wọ́n ọ sara awọn enia, o si wipe, Kiyesi ẹ̀jẹ majẹmu, ti OLUWA bá nyin dá nipasẹ ọ̀rọ gbogbo wọnyi.
entries.en: And Moses took the blood, and sprinkled it on the people, and said, Behold the blood of the covenant, which the LORD hath made with you concerning all these words.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Mose, ati Aaroni, Nadabu, ati Abihu, ati ãdọrin ninu awọn àgba Israeli gòke lọ:
entries.en: Then went up Moses, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel:

entries.yo: Nwọn si ri Ọlọrun Israeli; bi iṣẹ okuta Safire wà li abẹ ẹsẹ̀ rẹ̀, o si dabi irisi ọrun ni imọ́toto rẹ̀.
entries.en: And they saw the God of Israel: and there was under his feet as it were a paved work of a sapphire stone, and as it were the body of heaven in his clearness.

entries.yo: Kò si nà ọwọ́ rẹ̀ lé awọn ọlọlá ọmọ Israeli: nwọn si ri Ọlọrun, nwọn si jẹ, nwọn si mu.
entries.en: And upon the nobles of the children of Israel he laid not his hand: also they saw God, and did eat and drink.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun Mose pe, Gòke tọ̀ mi wá sori òke, ki o si duro nibẹ̀; emi o si fi walã okuta fun ọ, ati aṣẹ kan, ati ofin ti mo ti kọ, ki iwọ ki o le ma kọ́ wọn.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Come up to me into the mount, and be there: and I will give thee tables of stone, and a law, and commandments which I have written; that thou mayest teach them.

entries.yo: Mose si dide, ati Joṣua iranṣẹ rẹ̀: Mose si gòke lọ si oke Ọlọrun.
entries.en: And Moses rose up, and his minister Joshua: and Moses went up into the mount of God.

entries.yo: O si wi fun awọn àgba na pe, Ẹ duro dè wa nihinyi, titi awa o fi tun pada tọ̀ nyin wá: si kiyesi i, Aaroni ati Huri mbẹ pẹlu nyin: bi ẹnikan ba li ọ̀ran kan, ki o tọ̀ wọn wá.
entries.en: And he said unto the elders, Tarry ye here for us, until we come again unto you: and, behold, Aaron and Hur are with you: if any man have any matters to do, let him come unto them.

entries.yo: Mose si gòke lọ sori òke na, awọsanma si bò òke na mọlẹ.
entries.en: And Moses went up into the mount, and a cloud covered the mount.

entries.yo: Ogo OLUWA si sọkalẹ sori òke Sinai, awọsanma na si bò o mọlẹ ni ijọ́ mẹfa: ni ijọ́ keje o ké si Mose lati ãrin awọsanma wá.
entries.en: And the glory of the LORD abode upon mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days: and the seventh day he called unto Moses out of the midst of the cloud.

entries.yo: Iwò ogo OLUWA dabi iná ajonirun li ori òke na li oju awọn ọmọ Israeli.
entries.en: And the sight of the glory of the LORD was like devouring fire on the top of the mount in the eyes of the children of Israel.

entries.yo: Mose si lọ sãrin awọsanma na, o sì gùn ori òke na: Mose si wà lori òke li ogoji ọsán ati ogoji oru.
entries.en: And Moses went into the midst of the cloud, and gat him up into the mount: and Moses was in the mount forty days and forty nights.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Sọ fun awọn ọmọ Israeli pe, ki nwọn ki o mú ọrẹ fun mi wá: lọwọ olukuluku enia ti o ba fifunni tinutinu ni ki ẹnyin ki o gbà ọrẹ mi.
entries.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, that they bring me an offering: of every man that giveth it willingly with his heart ye shall take my offering.

entries.yo: Eyi si li ọrẹ ti ẹnyin o gbà lọwọ wọn; wurà, ati fadakà, ati idẹ;
entries.en: And this is the offering which ye shall take of them; gold, and silver, and brass,

entries.yo: Ati aṣọ-alaró, ati elesè-àluko, ati ododó, ati ọ̀gbọ, ati irun ewurẹ;
entries.en: And blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats' hair,

entries.yo: Ati awọ àgbo ti a sè ni pupa, ati awọ seali, ati igi ṣittimu.
entries.en: And rams' skins dyed red, and badgers' skins, and shittim wood,

entries.yo: Oróro fun fitila, olõrùn fun oróro itasori, ati fun turari didùn;
entries.en: Oil for the light, spices for anointing oil, and for sweet incense,

entries.yo: Okuta oniki, ati okuta ti a o tò si ẹ̀wu-efodi, ati si igbàiya.
entries.en: Onyx stones, and stones to be set in the ephod, and in the breastplate.

entries.yo: Ki nwọn ki o si ṣe ibi mimọ́ kan fun mi; ki emi ki o le ma gbé ãrin wọn.
entries.en: And let them make me a sanctuary; that I may dwell among them.

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi gbogbo eyiti mo fihàn ọ, nipa apẹrẹ agọ́, ati apẹrẹ gbogbo ohunèlo inu rẹ̀, bẹ̃ni ki ẹnyin ki o si ṣe e.
entries.en: According to all that I shew thee, after the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all the instruments thereof, even so shall ye make it.

entries.yo: Nwọn o si ṣe apoti igi ṣittimu: igbọnwọ meji on àbọ ni gigùn rẹ̀, ati igbọnwọ kan on àbọ ni ibú rẹ̀, ati igbọnwọ kan on àbọ ni giga rẹ̀.
entries.en: And they shall make an ark of shittim wood: two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si fi kìki wurà bò o, ninu ati lode ni iwọ o fi bò o, iwọ o si ṣe igbáti wurà sori rẹ̀ yiká.
entries.en: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, within and without shalt thou overlay it, and shalt make upon it a crown of gold round about.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si ṣe oruka wurà mẹrin si i, iwọ o si fi wọn si igun mẹrin rẹ̀; oruka meji yio si wà li apa kini rẹ̀, oruka meji yio si wà li apa keji rẹ̀.
entries.en: And thou shalt cast four rings of gold for it, and put them in the four corners thereof; and two rings shall be in the one side of it, and two rings in the other side of it.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si ṣe ọpá ṣittimu, ki iwọ ki o si fi wurà bò wọn.
entries.en: And thou shalt make staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si fi ọpá wọnni bọ̀ inu oruka wọnni ni ìha apoti na, ki a le ma fi wọn gbé apoti na.
entries.en: And thou shalt put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark, that the ark may be borne with them.

entries.yo: Ọpá wọnni yio si ma wà ninu oruka apoti na: a ki yio si yọ wọn kuro ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: The staves shall be in the rings of the ark: they shall not be taken from it.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si fi ẹrí ti emi o fi fun ọ sinu apoti nì.
entries.en: And thou shalt put into the ark the testimony which I shall give thee.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si fi kìki wurà ṣe itẹ-anu: igbọnwọ meji on àbọ ni gigùn rẹ̀, ati igbọnwọ kan on àbọ ni ibú rẹ̀.
entries.en: And thou shalt make a mercy seat of pure gold: two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si ṣe kerubu wurà meji; ni iṣẹ lilù ni ki iwọ ki o fi ṣe wọn, ni ìku itẹ́-ãnu na mejeji.
entries.en: And thou shalt make two cherubims of gold, of beaten work shalt thou make them, in the two ends of the mercy seat.

entries.yo: Si ṣe kerubu kini ni ìku kan, ati kerubu keji ni ìku keji: lati itẹ́-ãnu ni ki ẹnyin ki o ṣe awọn kerubu na ni ìku rẹ̀ mejeji.
entries.en: And make one cherub on the one end, and the other cherub on the other end: even of the mercy seat shall ye make the cherubims on the two ends thereof.

entries.yo: Awọn kerubu na yio si nà iyẹ́-apa wọn si oke, ki nwọn ki o fi iyẹ́-apa wọn bò itẹ́-ãnu na, ki nwọn ki o si kọjusi ara wọn; itẹ́-ãnu na ni ki awọn kerubu na ki o kọjusi.
entries.en: And the cherubims shall stretch forth their wings on high, covering the mercy seat with their wings, and their faces shall look one to another; toward the mercy seat shall the faces of the cherubims be.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si fi itẹ́-ãnu na sori apoti na; ati ninu apoti na ni iwọ o fi ẹri ti emi o fi fun ọ si.
entries.en: And thou shalt put the mercy seat above upon the ark; and in the ark thou shalt put the testimony that I shall give thee.

entries.yo: Nibẹ̀ li emi o ma pade rẹ, emi o si ma bá ọ sọ̀rọ lati oke itẹ́-ãnu wá, lati ãrin awọn kerubu mejeji wá, ti o wà lori apoti ẹrí na, niti ohun gbogbo ti emi o palaṣẹ fun ọ si awọn ọmọ Israeli.
entries.en: And there I will meet with thee, and I will commune with thee from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubims which are upon the ark of the testimony, of all things which I will give thee in commandment unto the children of Israel.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si ṣe tabili igi ṣittimu kan: igbọnwọ meji ni gigùn rẹ̀, ati igbọnwọ kan ni ibú rẹ̀, ati igbọnwọ kan on àbọ ni giga rẹ̀.
entries.en: Thou shalt also make a table of shittim wood: two cubits shall be the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si fi kìki wurà bò o, iwọ o si ṣe igbáti wurà si i yiká.
entries.en: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, and make thereto a crown of gold round about.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si ṣe eti kan bi ibú-atẹlẹwọ si i yiká, iwọ o si ṣe igbáti wurà si eti rẹ̀ yiká.
entries.en: And thou shalt make unto it a border of an hand breadth round about, and thou shalt make a golden crown to the border thereof round about.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si ṣe oruka wurà mẹrin si i, iwọ o si fi oruka wọnni si igun mẹrẹrin, ti o wà li ẹsẹ̀ rẹ̀ mẹrẹrin.
entries.en: And thou shalt make for it four rings of gold, and put the rings in the four corners that are on the four feet thereof.

entries.yo: Li abẹ igbáti na li oruka wọnni yio wà, fun ibi ọpá lati ma fi rù tabili na.
entries.en: Over against the border shall the rings be for places of the staves to bear the table.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si ṣe ọpá igi ṣittimu, iwọ o si fi wurà bò wọn, ki a le ma fi wọn rù tabili na.
entries.en: And thou shalt make the staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold, that the table may be borne with them.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si ṣe awopọkọ rẹ̀, ati ṣibi rẹ̀, ati ìgo rẹ̀, ati awo rẹ̀, lati ma fi dà: kìki wurà ni ki iwọ ki o fi ṣe wọn.
entries.en: And thou shalt make the dishes thereof, and spoons thereof, and covers thereof, and bowls thereof, to cover withal: of pure gold shalt thou make them.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si ma gbé àkara ifihàn kalẹ lori tabili na niwaju mi nigbagbogbo.
entries.en: And thou shalt set upon the table shewbread before me alway.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si fi kìki wurà ṣe ọpá-fitila kan: iṣẹlilù li a o fi ṣe ọpá-fitila na, ipilẹ rẹ̀, ọpá rẹ̀; ago rẹ̀, irudi rẹ̀, ati itanna rẹ̀, ọkanna ni nwọn o jẹ́:
entries.en: And thou shalt make a candlestick of pure gold: of beaten work shall the candlestick be made: his shaft, and his branches, his bowls, his knops, and his flowers, shall be of the same.

entries.yo: Ẹka mẹfa ni yio yọ ni ìha rẹ̀; ẹka mẹta ọpá-fitila na ni ìha kan, ati ẹka mẹta ọpá-fitila na ni ìha keji:
entries.en: And six branches shall come out of the sides of it; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side, and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side:

entries.yo: Ago mẹta ni ki a ṣe bi itanna almondi, pẹlu irudi ati itanna li ẹka kan; ati ago mẹta ti a ṣe bi itanna almondi li ẹka ekeji, pẹlu irudi ati itanna: bẹ̃li ẹka mẹfẹ̃fa ti o yọ lara ọpá-fitila na.
entries.en: Three bowls made like unto almonds, with a knop and a flower in one branch; and three bowls made like almonds in the other branch, with a knop and a flower: so in the six branches that come out of the candlestick.

entries.yo: Ati ninu ọpá-fitila na li ago mẹrin yio wà ti a ṣe bi itanna almondi, pẹlu irudi wọn ati itanna wọn.
entries.en: And in the candlestick shall be four bowls made like unto almonds, with their knops and their flowers.

entries.yo: Irudi kan yio si wà nisalẹ ẹka rẹ̀ meji ki o ri bakanna, irudi kan yio si wà nisalẹ ẹka rẹ̀ meji ki o ri bakanna, irudi kan yio si wà nisalẹ ẹka rẹ̀ meji ki o ri bakanna, gẹgẹ bi ẹka rẹ̀ mẹfẹfa ti o ti ara ọpá-fitila na yọ jade.
entries.en: And there shall be a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, according to the six branches that proceed out of the candlestick.

entries.yo: Irudi wọn ati ẹka wọn ki o ri bakanna: ki gbogbo rẹ̀ ki o jẹ́ lilù kìki wurà kan.
entries.en: Their knops and their branches shall be of the same: all it shall be one beaten work of pure gold.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si ṣe fitila rẹ̀ na, meje: ki nwọn ki o si fi fitila wọnni sori rẹ̀, ki nwọn ki o le ma ṣe imọlẹ si iwaju rẹ̀.
entries.en: And thou shalt make the seven lamps thereof: and they shall light the lamps thereof, that they may give light over against it.

entries.yo: Ati alumagaji rẹ̀, ati awo alumagaji rẹ̀, kìki wurà ni ki o jẹ́.
entries.en: And the tongs thereof, and the snuffdishes thereof, shall be of pure gold.

entries.yo: Talenti kan kìki wurà ni ki o fi ṣe e, pẹlu gbogbo ohunèlo wọnyi.
entries.en: Of a talent of pure gold shall he make it, with all these vessels.

entries.yo: Si kiyesi i, ki iwọ ki o ṣe wọn gẹgẹ bi apẹrẹ wọn, ti a fihàn ọ lori oke.
entries.en: And look that thou make them after their pattern, which was shewed thee in the mount.

entries.yo: IWỌ o fi aṣọ-tita mẹwa ṣe agọ́ na; aṣọ ọ̀gbọ olokùn wiwẹ, ati ti aṣọ-alaró, ati ti elesè-àluko, ati ti ododó, ti on ti awọn kerubu iṣẹ ọlọnà ni ki iwọ ki o ṣe wọn.
entries.en: Moreover thou shalt make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet: with cherubims of cunning work shalt thou make them.

entries.yo: Ina aṣọ-tita kan ki o jẹ́ igbọnwọ mejidilọgbọ̀n, ibò aṣọ-tita kan igbọnwọ mẹrin: gbogbo aṣọ-tita na ni ki o jẹ́ ìwọn kanna.
entries.en: The length of one curtain shall be eight and twenty cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: and every one of the curtains shall have one measure.

entries.yo: Aṣọ-tita marun ni ki a solù mọ́ ara wọn; ati aṣọ-tita marun keji ni ki a solù mọ́ ara wọn.
entries.en: The five curtains shall be coupled together one to another; and other five curtains shall be coupled one to another.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si ṣe ojóbo aṣọ-alaró si eti aṣọ-tita kan lati iṣẹti rẹ̀ wá ni ibi isolù, ati bẹ̃ gẹgẹ ni iwọ o ṣe li eti ikangun aṣọ-tita keji, ni ibi isolù keji.
entries.en: And thou shalt make loops of blue upon the edge of the one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling; and likewise shalt thou make in the uttermost edge of another curtain, in the coupling of the second.

entries.yo: Ãdọta ojóbo ni ki iwọ ki o ṣe si aṣọ-tita kan, ãdọta ojóbo ni ki iwọ ki o si ṣe si eti aṣọ-tita ti o wà ni isolù keji; ki ojóbo ki o le kọ́ ara wọn.
entries.en: Fifty loops shalt thou make in the one curtain, and fifty loops shalt thou make in the edge of the curtain that is in the coupling of the second; that the loops may take hold one of another.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si ṣe ãdọta ikọ́ wurà, iwọ o si fi ikọ́ na fà awọn aṣọ-tita so: on o si jẹ́ agọ́ kan.
entries.en: And thou shalt make fifty taches of gold, and couple the curtains together with the taches: and it shall be one tabernacle.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si ṣe aṣọ-tita irun ewurẹ, lati ṣe ibori sori agọ́ na: aṣọ-tita mọkanla ni iwọ o ṣe e.
entries.en: And thou shalt make curtains of goats' hair to be a covering upon the tabernacle: eleven curtains shalt thou make.

entries.yo: Ìna aṣọ-tita kan yio jẹ́ ọgbọ̀n igbọnwọ, ati ibò aṣọ-tita kan yio jẹ́ igbọnwọ mẹrin: aṣọ-tita mọkọkanla na yio si jẹ́ ìwọn kanna.
entries.en: The length of one curtain shall be thirty cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: and the eleven curtains shall be all of one measure.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si so aṣọ-tita marun lù mọ́ ara wọn li ọ̀tọ, ati aṣọ-tita mẹfa lù mọ́ ara wọn li ọ̀tọ, iwọ o si ṣẹ aṣọ-tita kẹfa po ni meji niwaju agọ́ na.
entries.en: And thou shalt couple five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves, and shalt double the sixth curtain in the forefront of the tabernacle.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si ṣe ãdọta ojóbo li eti aṣọ-tita na, ti o yọ si ode jù ninu isolù, ati ãdọta ojóbo li eti aṣọ-tita ti o so ekeji lù.
entries.en: And thou shalt make fifty loops on the edge of the one curtain that is outmost in the coupling, and fifty loops in the edge of the curtain which coupleth the second.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si ṣe ãdọta ikọ́ idẹ, ki o si fi ikọ́ wọnni sinu ojóbo, ki o si fi so agọ́ na pọ̀, yio si jẹ́ ọkan.
entries.en: And thou shalt make fifty taches of brass, and put the taches into the loops, and couple the tent together, that it may be one.

entries.yo: Ati iyokù ti o kù ninu aṣọ-tita agọ́ na, àbọ aṣọ-tita ti o kù, yio rọ̀ sori ẹhin agọ na.
entries.en: And the remnant that remaineth of the curtains of the tent, the half curtain that remaineth, shall hang over the backside of the tabernacle.

entries.yo: Ati igbọnwọ kan li apa kan, ati igbọnwọ kan li apa keji, eyiti o kù ni ìna aṣọ-tita agọ́ na, yio si rọ̀ si ìha agọ́ na ni ìha ihin ati ni ìha ọhún, lati bò o.
entries.en: And a cubit on the one side, and a cubit on the other side of that which remaineth in the length of the curtains of the tent, it shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and on that side, to cover it.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si ṣe ibori awọ àgbo ti a sè ni pupa fun agọ́ na, ati ibori awọ seali lori rẹ̀.
entries.en: And thou shalt make a covering for the tent of rams' skins dyed red, and a covering above of badgers' skins.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si ṣe apáko igi ṣittimu fun agọ́ na li ogurodo.
entries.en: And thou shalt make boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood standing up.

entries.yo: Igbọnwọ mẹwa ni gigùn apáko na, ati igbọnwọ kan on àbọ ni ibò apáko kan.
entries.en: Ten cubits shall be the length of a board, and a cubit and a half shall be the breadth of one board.

entries.yo: Ìtẹbọ meji ni ki o wà li apáko kan, ti o tò li ẹsẹ-ẹsẹ̀ si ara wọn: bayi ni ki iwọ ki o ṣe si gbogbo apáko agọ́ na.
entries.en: Two tenons shall there be in one board, set in order one against another: thus shalt thou make for all the boards of the tabernacle.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si ṣe apáko agọ́ na, ogún apáko ni ìha gusù si ìha gusù.
entries.en: And thou shalt make the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards on the south side southward.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si ṣe ogoji ihò-ìtẹbọ fadakà nisalẹ ogún apáko wọnni; ihò-ìtẹbọ meji nisalẹ apáko kan fun ìtẹbọ meji na, ati ihò-ìtẹbọ meji nisalẹ apáko keji fun ìtẹbọ meji na;
entries.en: And thou shalt make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for his two tenons, and two sockets under another board for his two tenons.

entries.yo: Ati ìha keji agọ́ na ni ìha ariwa, ogún apáko ni yio wà nibẹ̀:
entries.en: And for the second side of the tabernacle on the north side there shall be twenty boards:

entries.yo: Ati ogoji ihò-ìtẹbọ fadakà wọn; ihò-ìtẹbọ meji nisalẹ apáko na kan, ati ihò-ìtẹbọ meji nisalẹ apáko keji.
entries.en: And their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

entries.yo: Ati fun ìha agọ́ na ni ìha ìwọ-õrùn apáko mẹfa ni ki iwọ ki o ṣe.
entries.en: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward thou shalt make six boards.

entries.yo: Ati apáko meji ni iwọ o ṣe fun igun agọ́ na ni ìha ẹhin rẹ̀.
entries.en: And two boards shalt thou make for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides.

entries.yo: A o si so wọn pọ̀ nisalẹ, a o si so wọn pọ̀ li oke ori rẹ̀ si oruka kan: bẹ̃ni yio si ṣe ti awọn mejeji; nwọn o si ṣe ti igun mejeji.
entries.en: And they shall be coupled together beneath, and they shall be coupled together above the head of it unto one ring: thus shall it be for them both; they shall be for the two corners.

entries.yo: Nwọn o si jẹ́ apáko mẹjọ, ati ihò-ìtẹbọ fadakà wọn, ihò-ìtẹbọ mẹrindilogun; ihò-ìtẹbọ meji nisalẹ apáko kan, ati ihò-ìtẹbọ meji nisalẹ apáko keji.
entries.en: And they shall be eight boards, and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si ṣe ọpá idabu igi ṣittimu; marun fun apáko ìha kan agọ́ na,
entries.en: And thou shalt make bars of shittim wood; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,

entries.yo: Ati ọpá idabu marun fun apáko na ni ìha keji agọ́ na, ati ọpá idabu marun fun apáko na ni ìha agọ́ na, fun ìha mejeji ni ìha ìwọ-õrùn.
entries.en: And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle, for the two sides westward.

entries.yo: Ati ọpá ãrin li agbedemeji apáko wọnni yio ti ìku dé ìku.
entries.en: And the middle bar in the midst of the boards shall reach from end to end.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si fi wurà bò apáko wọnni, iwọ o si fi wurà ṣe oruka wọn li àye fun ọpá idabu wọnni: iwọ o si fi wurà bò ọpá idabu wọnni.
entries.en: And thou shalt overlay the boards with gold, and make their rings of gold for places for the bars: and thou shalt overlay the bars with gold.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si gbé agọ́ na ró, gẹgẹ bi apẹrẹ rẹ̀, ti a fihàn ọ lori oke.
entries.en: And thou shalt rear up the tabernacle according to the fashion thereof which was shewed thee in the mount.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si ṣe aṣọ-ikele alaró, ati elesè-àluko, ati ododó, ati ọ̀gbọ olokùn wiwẹ ti iṣẹ ọlọnà: ti on ti awọn kerubu nì ki a ṣe e:
entries.en: And thou shalt make a vail of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen of cunning work: with cherubims shall it be made:

entries.yo: Iwọ o si fi rọ̀ sara opó igi ṣittimu mẹrin, ti a fi wurà bò, wurà ni ikọ́ wọn lori ihò-ìtẹbọ fadakà mẹrẹrin na.
entries.en: And thou shalt hang it upon four pillars of shittim wood overlaid with gold: their hooks shall be of gold, upon the four sockets of silver.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si ta aṣọ-ikele na si abẹ ikọ́ wọnni, ki iwọ ki o le mú apoti ẹrí nì wá si inu aṣọ-ikele nì: aṣọ-ikele nì ni yio si pinya lãrin ibi mimọ́ ati ibi mimọ́ julọ fun nyin.
entries.en: And thou shalt hang up the vail under the taches, that thou mayest bring in thither within the vail the ark of the testimony: and the vail shall divide unto you between the holy place and the most holy.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si fi itẹ́-ãnu sori apoti ẹrí nì, ni ibi mimọ́ julọ.
entries.en: And thou shalt put the mercy seat upon the ark of the testimony in the most holy place.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si gbé tabili na kà ẹhin ode aṣọ-ikele nì, ati ọpá-fitila nì kọjusi tabili na ni ìha agọ́ na ni ìha gusù: iwọ o si gbé tabili na kà ìha ariwa.
entries.en: And thou shalt set the table without the vail, and the candlestick over against the table on the side of the tabernacle toward the south: and thou shalt put the table on the north side.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si ṣe aṣọ-tita kan fun ẹnu-ọ̀na agọ́ na, ti aṣọ-alaró, ti elesè-aluko, ti ododó, ati ti ọ̀gbọ olokùn wiwẹ, ti a fi iṣẹ abẹ́rẹ ṣe.
entries.en: And thou shalt make an hanging for the door of the tent, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, wrought with needlework.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si ṣe opó igi ṣittimu marun fun aṣọ-tita na, ki o si fi wurà bò wọn; ati ikọ́ wọn wurà: iwọ o si dà ihò-ìtẹbọ idẹ marun fun wọn.
entries.en: And thou shalt make for the hanging five pillars of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold, and their hooks shall be of gold: and thou shalt cast five sockets of brass for them.

entries.yo: IWỌ o si tẹ́ pẹpẹ igi ṣittimu kan, ìna rẹ̀ igbọnwọ marun, ati ìbú rẹ̀ igbọnwọ marun; ìwọn kan ni ìha mẹrẹrin: igbọnwọ mẹta si ni giga rẹ̀.
entries.en: And thou shalt make an altar of shittim wood, five cubits long, and five cubits broad; the altar shall be foursquare: and the height thereof shall be three cubits.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si ṣe iwo rẹ̀ si ori igun mẹrẹrin rẹ̀: iwo rẹ̀ yio si wà lara rẹ̀: iwọ o si fi idẹ bò o.
entries.en: And thou shalt make the horns of it upon the four corners thereof: his horns shall be of the same: and thou shalt overlay it with brass.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si ṣe tasà rẹ̀ lati ma gbà ẽru rẹ̀, ati ọkọ́ rẹ̀, ati awokòto rẹ̀ ati kọkọrọ ẹran rẹ̀, ati awo-iná rẹ̀ wọnni: gbogbo ohun-èlo rẹ̀ ni iwọ o fi idẹ ṣe.
entries.en: And thou shalt make his pans to receive his ashes, and his shovels, and his basons, and his fleshhooks, and his firepans: all the vessels thereof thou shalt make of brass.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si ṣe oju-àro idẹ fun u ni iṣẹ-àwọn; lara àwọn na ni ki iwọ ki o ṣe oruka mẹrin ni igun mẹrẹrin rẹ̀.
entries.en: And thou shalt make for it a grate of network of brass; and upon the net shalt thou make four brasen rings in the four corners thereof.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si fi si abẹ ayiká pẹpẹ na nisalẹ, ki àwọn na ki o le dé idaji pẹpẹ na.
entries.en: And thou shalt put it under the compass of the altar beneath, that the net may be even to the midst of the altar.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si ṣe ọpá fun pẹpẹ na, ọpá igi ṣittimu, iwọ o si fi idẹ bò wọn.
entries.en: And thou shalt make staves for the altar, staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with brass.

entries.yo: A o si fi ọpá rẹ̀ bọ̀ oruka wọnni, ọpá wọnni yio si wà ni ìha mejeji pẹpẹ na, lati ma fi rù u.
entries.en: And the staves shall be put into the rings, and the staves shall be upon the two sides of the altar, to bear it.

entries.yo: Onihò ninu ni iwọ o fi apáko ṣe e: bi a ti fihàn ọ lori oke, bẹ̃ni ki nwọn ki o ṣe e.
entries.en: Hollow with boards shalt thou make it: as it was shewed thee in the mount, so shall they make it.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si ṣe agbalá agọ́ na: ni ìha gusù lọwọ ọtún li aṣọ-tita agbalá ti ọ̀gbọ olokùn wiwẹ ti ọgọrun igbọnwọ ìna, yio wà ni ìha kan:
entries.en: And thou shalt make the court of the tabernacle: for the south side southward there shall be hangings for the court of fine twined linen of an hundred cubits long for one side:

entries.yo: Ati ogún opó rẹ̀, ati ogún ihò-ìtẹbọ wọn, ki o jẹ́ idẹ; ikọ́ opó wọnni ati ọpá isopọ̀ wọn ki o jẹ́ fadakà.
entries.en: And the twenty pillars thereof and their twenty sockets shall be of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets shall be of silver.

entries.yo: Ati bẹ̃ gẹgẹ niti ìha ariwa ni gigùn aṣọ-tita wọnni yio jẹ́ ọgọrun igbọnwọ ni ìna wọn, ati ogún opó rẹ̀, ati ogún ihò-ìtẹbọ rẹ̀ ki o jẹ́ idẹ; ikọ́ opó wọnni ati ọpá isopọ̀ wọn ki o jẹ́ fadakà.
entries.en: And likewise for the north side in length there shall be hangings of an hundred cubits long, and his twenty pillars and their twenty sockets of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver.

entries.yo: Ati niti ibú agbalá na, ni ìha ìwọ-õrùn li aṣọ-tita ãdọta igbọnwọ yio wà: opó wọn mẹwa, ati ihò-ìtẹbọ wọn mẹwa.
entries.en: And for the breadth of the court on the west side shall be hangings of fifty cubits: their pillars ten, and their sockets ten.

entries.yo: Ati ibú agbalá na ni ìha ìla-õrùn si ìha ìla-õrùn yio jẹ́ ãdọta igbọnwọ.
entries.en: And the breadth of the court on the east side eastward shall be fifty cubits.

entries.yo: Aṣọ-tita apakan ẹnu-ọ̀na na yio jẹ́ igbọnwọ mẹdogun: opó wọn mẹta, ihò-ìtẹbọ wọn mẹta.
entries.en: The hangings of one side of the gate shall be fifteen cubits: their pillars three, and their sockets three.

entries.yo: Ati ni ìha keji ni aṣọ-tita igbọnwọ mẹdogun yio wà: opó wọn mẹta, ati ihò-ìtẹbọ wọn mẹta.
entries.en: And on the other side shall be hangings fifteen cubits: their pillars three, and their sockets three.

entries.yo: Ati fun ẹnu-ọ̀na agbalá na aṣọ-tita ogún igbọnwọ yio wà, ti aṣọ-alaró, ati elesè-àluko, ati ododó, ati ti ọ̀gbọ olokùn wiwẹ, ti a fi iṣẹ abẹ́rẹ ṣe: opó wọn mẹrin, ati ihò-ìtẹbọ wọn mẹrin.
entries.en: And for the gate of the court shall be an hanging of twenty cubits, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, wrought with needlework: and their pillars shall be four, and their sockets four.

entries.yo: Gbogbo opó ti o yi sarè na ká li a o si fi ọpá fadakà sopọ̀; ikọ́ wọn yio jẹ́ fadakà, ati ihò-ìtẹbọ wọn ti idẹ.
entries.en: All the pillars round about the court shall be filleted with silver; their hooks shall be of silver, and their sockets of brass.

entries.yo: Ìna agbalá na ki o jẹ́ ọgọrun igbọnwọ, ati ibú rẹ̀ arãdọtọta igbọnwọ, ati giga rẹ̀ igbọnwọ marun, ti ọ̀gbọ olokùn wiwẹ, ati ihò-ìtẹbọ wọn ti idẹ.
entries.en: The length of the court shall be an hundred cubits, and the breadth fifty every where, and the height five cubits of fine twined linen, and their sockets of brass.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ohun-èlo agọ́ na, ni gbogbo ìsin rẹ̀, ati gbogbo ekàn rẹ̀, ati gbogbo ekàn agbalá na ki o jẹ́ idẹ.
entries.en: All the vessels of the tabernacle in all the service thereof, and all the pins thereof, and all the pins of the court, shall be of brass.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si paṣẹ fun awọn ọmọ Israeli, ki nwọn ki o mú oróro olifi daradara ti a gún fun ọ wá, fun imọlẹ, lati mu ki fitila ki o ma tàn nigbagbogbo.
entries.en: And thou shalt command the children of Israel, that they bring thee pure oil olive beaten for the light, to cause the lamp to burn always.

entries.yo: Li agọ́ ajọ lẹhin ode aṣọ-ikele ti o wà niwaju ẹ̀rí na, Aaroni ti on ti awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ ni yio tọju rẹ̀ lati alẹ titi di owurọ̀ niwaju OLUWA: yio si di ìlana lailai ni irandiran wọn lọdọ awọn ọmọ Israeli.
entries.en: In the tabernacle of the congregation without the vail, which is before the testimony, Aaron and his sons shall order it from evening to morning before the LORD: it shall be a statute for ever unto their generations on the behalf of the children of Israel.

entries.yo: IWỌ si mú Aaroni arakunrin rẹ, ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ pẹlu rẹ̀ si ọdọ rẹ, kuro ninu awọn ọmọ Israeli, ki on ki o le ma ṣe iṣẹ alufa fun mi, ani Aaroni, Nadabu ati Abihu, Eleasari ati Itamari, awọn ọmọ Aaroni.
entries.en: And take thou unto thee Aaron thy brother, and his sons with him, from among the children of Israel, that he may minister unto me in the priest's office, even Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar, Aaron's sons.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si dá aṣọ mimọ́ fun Aaroni arakunrin rẹ fun ogo ati fun ọṣọ́.
entries.en: And thou shalt make holy garments for Aaron thy brother for glory and for beauty.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si sọ fun gbogbo awọn ti o ṣe amoye, awọn ẹniti mo fi ẹmi ọgbọ́n kún, ki nwọn ki o le dá aṣọ Aaroni lati yà a simimọ́, ki o le ma ṣe iṣẹ alufa fun mi.
entries.en: And thou shalt speak unto all that are wise hearted, whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom, that they may make Aaron's garments to consecrate him, that he may minister unto me in the priest's office.

entries.yo: Wọnyi si li aṣọ ti nwọn o dá; igbàiya kan, ati ẹ̀wu-efodi, ati aṣọ igunwà, ati ẹ̀wu-awọtẹlẹ ọlọnà, fila, ati ọjá-amure: nwọn o si dá aṣọ mimọ́ wọnyi fun Aaroni arakunrin rẹ, ati fun awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, ki on ki o le ma ṣe iṣẹ alufa fun mi.
entries.en: And these are the garments which they shall make; a breastplate, and an ephod, and a robe, and a broidered coat, a mitre, and a girdle: and they shall make holy garments for Aaron thy brother, and his sons, that he may minister unto me in the priest's office.

entries.yo: Nwọn o si mú wurà, ati aṣọ-alaró, ati elesè-àluko, ati ododó, ati ọ̀gbọ.
entries.en: And they shall take gold, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen.

entries.yo: Nwọn o si ṣe ẹ̀wu-efodi ti wurà, ti aṣọ-alaró, ati elesè-àluko, ti ododó, ati ọ̀gbọ olokùn wiwẹ iṣẹ ọlọnà,
entries.en: And they shall make the ephod of gold, of blue, and of purple, of scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cunning work.

entries.yo: Yio ní aṣọ ejika meji ti o solù li eti rẹ̀ mejeji; bẹ̃ni ki a so o pọ̀.
entries.en: It shall have the two shoulderpieces thereof joined at the two edges thereof; and so it shall be joined together.

entries.yo: Ati onirũru-ọnà ọjá rẹ̀, ti o wà lori rẹ̀ yio ri bakanna, gẹgẹ bi iṣẹ rẹ̀; ti wurà, ti aṣọ-alaró, ododó, ati ọ̀gbọ olokùn wiwẹ.
entries.en: And the curious girdle of the ephod, which is upon it, shall be of the same, according to the work thereof; even of gold, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si mú okuta oniki meji, iwọ o si fin orukọ awọn ọmọ Israeli sara wọn:
entries.en: And thou shalt take two onyx stones, and grave on them the names of the children of Israel:

entries.yo: Orukọ awọn mẹfa sara okuta kan, ati orukọ mẹfa iyokù sara okuta keji, gẹgẹ bi ìbí wọn.
entries.en: Six of their names on one stone, and the other six names of the rest on the other stone, according to their birth.

entries.yo: Iṣẹ-ọnà afin-okuta, bi ifin èdidi-àmi, ni iwọ o fin okuta mejeji gẹgẹ bi orukọ awọn ọmọ Israeli: iwọ o si dè wọn si oju-ìde wurà.
entries.en: With the work of an engraver in stone, like the engravings of a signet, shalt thou engrave the two stones with the names of the children of Israel: thou shalt make them to be set in ouches of gold.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si fi okuta mejeji si ejika ẹ̀wu-efodu na, li okuta iranti fun awọn ọmọ Israeli; Aaroni yio si ma rù orukọ wọn niwaju OLUWA li ejika rẹ̀ mejeji fun iranti.
entries.en: And thou shalt put the two stones upon the shoulders of the ephod for stones of memorial unto the children of Israel: and Aaron shall bear their names before the LORD upon his two shoulders for a memorial.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si ṣe oju-ìde wurà:
entries.en: And thou shalt make ouches of gold;

entries.yo: Ati okùn ẹ̀wọn meji ti kìki wurà; iṣẹ ọnà-lilọ ni ki iwọ ki o fi ṣe wọn, ki iwọ ki o si so okùn ẹ̀wọn iṣẹ ọnà-lilọ ni si oju-ìde na.
entries.en: And two chains of pure gold at the ends; of wreathen work shalt thou make them, and fasten the wreathen chains to the ouches.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si fi iṣẹ ọgbọ́n na ṣe igbàiya idajọ na; nipa iṣẹ-ọnà ẹ̀wu-efodi ni iwọ o ṣe e; ti wurà, ti aṣọ-alaró, ati elesè-àluko, ati ododò, ati ọ̀gbọ olokùn wiwẹ ni iwọ o fi ṣe e.
entries.en: And thou shalt make the breastplate of judgment with cunning work; after the work of the ephod thou shalt make it; of gold, of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, and of fine twined linen, shalt thou make it.

entries.yo: Iha mẹrin ọgbọgba ni ki iwọ ki o ṣe e ni iṣẹpo meji; ika kan ni ìna rẹ̀, ika kan si ni ibú rẹ̀.
entries.en: Foursquare it shall be being doubled; a span shall be the length thereof, and a span shall be the breadth thereof.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si tò ìto okuta sinu rẹ̀, ẹsẹ̀ okuta mẹrin: ẹsẹ̀ kini, sardiu, topasi, ati smaragdu; eyi li ẹsẹ̀ kini:
entries.en: And thou shalt set in it settings of stones, even four rows of stones: the first row shall be a sardius, a topaz, and a carbuncle: this shall be the first row.

entries.yo: Ẹsẹ̀ keji, emeraldi, safiru, ati diamondi;
entries.en: And the second row shall be an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond.

entries.yo: Ati ẹsẹ̀ kẹta, ligure, agate, ati ametistu;
entries.en: And the third row a ligure, an agate, and an amethyst.

entries.yo: Ati ẹsẹ̀ kẹrin, berilu, ati oniki, ati jasperi: a o si tò wọn si oju wurà ni didè wọn.
entries.en: And the fourth row a beryl, and an onyx, and a jasper: they shall be set in gold in their inclosings.

entries.yo: Okuta wọnni yio si wà gẹgẹ bi orukọ awọn ọmọ Israeli mejila, gẹgẹ bi orukọ wọn; bi ifin edidi-àmi; olukuluku gẹgẹ bi orukọ rẹ̀ ni nwọn o wà fun ẹ̀ya Israeli mejejila.
entries.en: And the stones shall be with the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names, like the engravings of a signet; every one with his name shall they be according to the twelve tribes.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si ṣe okùn ẹ̀wọn kìka wurà iṣẹ ọnà-lilọ si igbàiya na.
entries.en: And thou shalt make upon the breastplate chains at the ends of wreathen work of pure gold.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si ṣe oruka wurà meji sara igbàiya na, iwọ o si fi oruka meji na si eti mejeji igbàiya na.
entries.en: And thou shalt make upon the breastplate two rings of gold, and shalt put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si fi okùn ẹ̀wọn wurà mejeji sinu oruka meji wọnni li eti igbàiya na.
entries.en: And thou shalt put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings which are on the ends of the breastplate.

entries.yo: Ati eti ẹ̀wọn meji ni ki iwọ ki o so mọ́ oju-ìde mejeji, ki o si fi si ejika ẹ̀wu-efodi na niwaju rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the other two ends of the two wreathen chains thou shalt fasten in the two ouches, and put them on the shoulderpieces of the ephod before it.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si ṣe oruka wurà meji, iwọ o si fi wọn si eti mejeji igbàiya na li eti rẹ̀, ti o wà ni ìha ẹ̀wu-efodi na ni ìha inú.
entries.en: And thou shalt make two rings of gold, and thou shalt put them upon the two ends of the breastplate in the border thereof, which is in the side of the ephod inward.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si ṣe oruka wurà meji, iwọ o si fi wọn si ejika ẹ̀wu-efodi mejeji nisalẹ, si ìha iwaju rẹ̀, ti o kọjusi isolù rẹ̀, loke onirũru-ọnà ọjá ẹ̀wu-efodi na.
entries.en: And two other rings of gold thou shalt make, and shalt put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath, toward the forepart thereof, over against the other coupling thereof, above the curious girdle of the ephod.

entries.yo: Nwọn o si fi oruka rẹ̀ so igbàiya na mọ́ oruka ẹ̀wu-efodi na ti on ti ọjá àwọn alaró, ki o le wà loke onirũru-ọnà ọjá ẹ̀wu-efodi na, ki a má si ṣe tú igbàiya na kuro lara ẹ̀wu-efodi na.
entries.en: And they shall bind the breastplate by the rings thereof unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it may be above the curious girdle of the ephod, and that the breastplate be not loosed from the ephod.

entries.yo: Aaroni yio si ma rù orukọ awọn ọmọ Israeli ninu igbàiya idajọ li àiya rẹ̀, nigbati o ba nwọ̀ ibi mimọ́ nì lọ, fun iranti nigbagbogbo niwaju OLUWA.
entries.en: And Aaron shall bear the names of the children of Israel in the breastplate of judgment upon his heart, when he goeth in unto the holy place, for a memorial before the LORD continually.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si fi Urimu on Tummimu sinu igbàiya idajọ; nwọn o si wà li àiya Aaroni, nigbati o ba nwọle lọ niwaju OLUWA; Aaroni yio si ma rù idajọ awọn ọmọ Israeli li àiya rẹ̀ nigbagbogbo niwaju OLUWA.
entries.en: And thou shalt put in the breastplate of judgment the Urim and the Thummim; and they shall be upon Aaron's heart, when he goeth in before the LORD: and Aaron shall bear the judgment of the children of Israel upon his heart before the LORD continually.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si ṣe aṣọ igunwa ẹ̀wu-efodi na ni kìki aṣọ-alaró.
entries.en: And thou shalt make the robe of the ephod all of blue.

entries.yo: Oju ọrùn yio si wà lãrin rẹ̀ fun ori; ọjá iṣẹti yio si wà yi oju rẹ̀ ká, iṣẹ-oniṣọnà gẹgẹ bi ẹ̀wu ogun, ki o má ba fàya.
entries.en: And there shall be an hole in the top of it, in the midst thereof: it shall have a binding of woven work round about the hole of it, as it were the hole of an habergeon, that it be not rent.

entries.yo: Ati ni iṣẹti rẹ̀ nisalẹ ni iwọ o ṣe pomegranate aṣọ-alaró, ati elesè-àluko, ati ododó, yi iṣẹti rẹ̀ ká; ati ṣaworo wurà lãrin wọn yiká;
entries.en: And beneath upon the hem of it thou shalt make pomegranates of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, round about the hem thereof; and bells of gold between them round about:

entries.yo: Ṣaworo wurà kan ati pomegranate kan, ṣaworo wurà kan ati pomegranate kan, li eti iṣẹti aṣọ igunwa na yiká.
entries.en: A golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a pomegranate, upon the hem of the robe round about.

entries.yo: On o si wà lara Aaroni lati ma fi ṣiṣẹ: a o si ma gbọ́ iró rẹ̀ nigbati o ba wọ̀ ibi mimọ́ lọ niwaju OLUWA, ati nigbati o ba si njade bọ̀, ki o má ba kú.
entries.en: And it shall be upon Aaron to minister: and his sound shall be heard when he goeth in unto the holy place before the LORD, and when he cometh out, that he die not.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si ṣe awo ni kìki wurà, iwọ o si fin sara rẹ̀, gẹgẹ bi fifin èdidi-àmi pe, MIMỌ́ SI OLUWA.
entries.en: And thou shalt make a plate of pure gold, and grave upon it, like the engravings of a signet, HOLINESS TO THE LORD.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si fi i sara ọjá-àwọn alaró, ki o le ma wà lara fila nì, niwaju fila na ni ki o wà.
entries.en: And thou shalt put it on a blue lace, that it may be upon the mitre; upon the forefront of the mitre it shall be.

entries.yo: On o si ma wà niwaju ori Aaroni, ki Aaroni le ma rù ẹ̀ṣẹ ohun mimọ́, ti awọn ọmọ Israeli yio si yàsimimọ́, ninu gbogbo ẹ̀bun mimọ́ wọn: on o si ma wà niwaju ori rẹ̀ nigbagbogbo, ki OLUWA ki o le ni inudidùn si wọn.
entries.en: And it shall be upon Aaron's forehead, that Aaron may bear the iniquity of the holy things, which the children of Israel shall hallow in all their holy gifts; and it shall be always upon his forehead, that they may be accepted before the LORD.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si fi ọ̀gbọ didara wun ẹ̀wu-awọtẹlẹ, iwọ o si fi ọ̀gbọ didara ṣe fila, iwọ o si fi iṣẹ abẹ́rẹ ṣe ọjá-amure.
entries.en: And thou shalt embroider the coat of fine linen, and thou shalt make the mitre of fine linen, and thou shalt make the girdle of needlework.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si dá ẹ̀wu-awọtẹlẹ fun awọn ọmọ Aaroni, iwọ o si dá ọjá-amure fun wọn, iwọ o si dá fila fun wọn, fun ogo ati fun ọṣọ́.
entries.en: And for Aaron's sons thou shalt make coats, and thou shalt make for them girdles, and bonnets shalt thou make for them, for glory and for beauty.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si fi wọn wọ̀ Aaroni arakunrin rẹ, ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ pẹlu rẹ̀; iwọ o si ta oróro si wọn li ori, iwọ o si yà wọn simimọ́, iwọ o si sọ wọn di mimọ́, ki nwọn ki o le ma ṣe iṣẹ alufa fun mi.
entries.en: And thou shalt put them upon Aaron thy brother, and his sons with him; and shalt anoint them, and consecrate them, and sanctify them, that they may minister unto me in the priest's office.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si dá ṣòkoto ọ̀gbọ fun wọn lati ma fi bò ìhoho wọn, ki o ti ibadi dé itan:
entries.en: And thou shalt make them linen breeches to cover their nakedness; from the loins even unto the thighs they shall reach:

entries.yo: Nwọn o si wà lara Aaroni, ati lara awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, nigbati nwọn ba wọ̀ inu agọ́ ajọ lọ, tabi nigbati nwọn ba sunmọ pẹpẹ, lati ṣiṣẹ ni ibi mimọ́; ki nwọn ki o má ba dẹ̀ṣẹ, nwọn a si kú: ìlana lailai ni fun u ati fun irú-ọmọ rẹ̀ lẹhin rẹ̀.
entries.en: And they shall be upon Aaron, and upon his sons, when they come in unto the tabernacle of the congregation, or when they come near unto the altar to minister in the holy place; that they bear not iniquity, and die: it shall be a statute for ever unto him and his seed after him.

entries.yo: EYI si li ohun ti iwọ o ṣe si wọn lati yà wọn simimọ́, lati ma ṣe alufa fun mi: mú ẹgbọ̀rọ akọmalu kan, ati àgbo meji ti kò li abùku.
entries.en: And this is the thing that thou shalt do unto them to hallow them, to minister unto me in the priest's office: Take one young bullock, and two rams without blemish,

entries.yo: Ati àkara alaiwu, ati adidùn àkara alaiwu ti a fi oróro pò, ati àkara fẹlẹfẹlẹ alaiwu ti a ta oróro si lori; iyẹfun alikama ni ki o fi ṣe wọn.
