entries.en: And unleavened bread, and cakes unleavened tempered with oil, and wafers unleavened anointed with oil: of wheaten flour shalt thou make them.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si fi wọn sinu agbọ̀n kan, iwọ o si mú wọn wá ninu agbọ̀n na, pẹlu akọmalu na ati àgbo mejeji.
entries.en: And thou shalt put them into one basket, and bring them in the basket, with the bullock and the two rams.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si mú Aaroni pẹlu awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ wá si ẹnu-ọ̀na agọ́ ajọ, iwọ o si fi omi wẹ̀ wọn.
entries.en: And Aaron and his sons thou shalt bring unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and shalt wash them with water.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si mú aṣọ wọnni, iwọ o si fi ẹ̀wu-awọtẹlẹ nì wọ̀ Aaroni, ati aṣọ igunwa efodi, ati efodi, ati igbàiya, ki o si fi onirũru-ọnà ọjá ẹ̀wu-efodi dì i.
entries.en: And thou shalt take the garments, and put upon Aaron the coat, and the robe of the ephod, and the ephod, and the breastplate, and gird him with the curious girdle of the ephod:

entries.yo: Iwọ o si fi fila nì dé e li ori, iwọ o si fi adé mimọ́ nì sara fila na.
entries.en: And thou shalt put the mitre upon his head, and put the holy crown upon the mitre.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni iwọ o si mú oróro itasori, iwọ o si dà a si i li ori, iwọ o si fi oróro yà a simimọ́.
entries.en: Then shalt thou take the anointing oil, and pour it upon his head, and anoint him.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si mú awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ wá tosi, iwọ o si wọ̀ wọn li ẹ̀wu.
entries.en: And thou shalt bring his sons, and put coats upon them.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si dì wọn li ọjá-amure, Aaroni ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, iwọ o si fi fila dé wọn: iṣẹ-alufa yio si ma jẹ́ ti wọn ni ìlana titi aiye: iwọ o si yà Aaroni ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ simimọ́.
entries.en: And thou shalt gird them with girdles, Aaron and his sons, and put the bonnets on them: and the priest's office shall be theirs for a perpetual statute: and thou shalt consecrate Aaron and his sons.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si mú akọmalu na wá siwaju agọ́ ajọ: ati Aaroni ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ yio si fi ọwọ́ wọn lé akọmalu na li ori.
entries.en: And thou shalt cause a bullock to be brought before the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the bullock.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si pa akọmalu na niwaju OLUWA, loju ọ̀na agọ́ ajọ.
entries.en: And thou shalt kill the bullock before the LORD, by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si mú ninu ẹ̀jẹ akọmalu na, iwọ o si fi ika rẹ tọ́ ọ sara iwo pẹpẹ na; iwọ o si dà gbogbo ẹ̀jẹ na si ìha isalẹ pẹpẹ na.
entries.en: And thou shalt take of the blood of the bullock, and put it upon the horns of the altar with thy finger, and pour all the blood beside the bottom of the altar.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si mú gbogbo ọrá ti o bò ifun lori, ati àwọn ti o bori ẹ̀dọ, ati ti iwe mejeji, ati ọrá ti o wà lara wọn, iwọ o si sun u lori pẹpẹ na.
entries.en: And thou shalt take all the fat that covereth the inwards, and the caul that is above the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, and burn them upon the altar.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹran akọmalu na, ati awọ rẹ̀, ati igbẹ rẹ̀, on ni ki iwọ ki o fi iná sun lẹhin ode ibudó: ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ ni.
entries.en: But the flesh of the bullock, and his skin, and his dung, shalt thou burn with fire without the camp: it is a sin offering.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si mú àgbo kan; ati Aaroni ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ yio si fi ọwọ́ wọn lé àgbo na li ori.
entries.en: Thou shalt also take one ram; and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the ram.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si pa àgbo na, iwọ o si mú ẹ̀jẹ rẹ̀, iwọ o si fi i wọ́n pẹpẹ na yiká.
entries.en: And thou shalt slay the ram, and thou shalt take his blood, and sprinkle it round about upon the altar.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si kun àgbo na, iwọ o si fọ̀ ifun rẹ̀, ati itan rẹ̀, iwọ o si fi wọn lé ara wọn, ati lé ori rẹ̀.
entries.en: And thou shalt cut the ram in pieces, and wash the inwards of him, and his legs, and put them unto his pieces, and unto his head.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si sun gbogbo àgbo na lori pẹpẹ na: ẹbọ sisun ni si OLUWA: õrùn didùn ni, ẹbọ ti a fi iná ṣe si OLUWA.
entries.en: And thou shalt burn the whole ram upon the altar: it is a burnt offering unto the LORD: it is a sweet savour, an offering made by fire unto the LORD.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si mú àgbo keji; Aaroni ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ yio si fi ọwọ́ wọn lé àgbo na li ori.
entries.en: And thou shalt take the other ram; and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the ram.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ki iwọ ki o pa àgbo na, ki o si mú ninu ẹ̀jẹ rẹ̀, ki o si tọ́ ọ si eti ọtún Aaroni, ati si eti ọtún awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, ati si àtampako ọwọ́ ọtún wọn, ati si àtampako ẹsẹ̀ ọtún wọn, ki o si fi ẹ̀jẹ na wọ́n pẹpẹ na yiká.
entries.en: Then shalt thou kill the ram, and take of his blood, and put it upon the tip of the right ear of Aaron, and upon the tip of the right ear of his sons, and upon the thumb of their right hand, and upon the great toe of their right foot, and sprinkle the blood upon the altar round about.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si mú ninu ẹ̀jẹ ti o wà lori pẹpẹ, ati ninu oróro itasori, iwọ o si wọ́n ọ sara Aaroni, ati sara aṣọ rẹ̀, ati sara awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, ati sara aṣọ awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ pẹlu rẹ̀: ki a le sọ ọ di mimọ́, ati aṣọ rẹ̀, ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, ati aṣọ awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ pẹlu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And thou shalt take of the blood that is upon the altar, and of the anointing oil, and sprinkle it upon Aaron, and upon his garments, and upon his sons, and upon the garments of his sons with him: and he shall be hallowed, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons' garments with him.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si mú ọrá, ati ìru ti o lọrá ti àgbo na, ati ọrá ti o bò ifun lori, ati àwọn ti o bò ẹ̀dọ̀, ati iwe mejeji, ati ọrá ti o wà lara wọn, ati itan ọtún; nitori àgbo ìyasimimọ́ ni:
entries.en: Also thou shalt take of the ram the fat and the rump, and the fat that covereth the inwards, and the caul above the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, and the right shoulder; for it is a ram of consecration:

entries.yo: Ati ìṣu àkara kan, ati àkara kan ti a fi oróro din, ati àkara fẹlẹfẹlẹ kan kuro ninu agbọ̀n àkara alaiwu, ti o wà niwaju OLUWA:
entries.en: And one loaf of bread, and one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer out of the basket of the unleavened bread that is before the LORD:

entries.yo: Iwọ o si fi gbogbo rẹ̀ lé Aaroni lọwọ, ati lé ọwọ́ awọn ọmọ rẹ̀; iwọ o si ma fì wọn li ẹbọ fifì niwaju OLUWA.
entries.en: And thou shalt put all in the hands of Aaron, and in the hands of his sons; and shalt wave them for a wave offering before the LORD.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si gbà wọn li ọwọ́ wọn, iwọ o si sun wọn lori pẹpẹ na li ẹbọ sisun, fun õrùn didùn niwaju OLUWA: ẹbọ ti a fi iná ṣe ni si OLUWA.
entries.en: And thou shalt receive them of their hands, and burn them upon the altar for a burnt offering, for a sweet savour before the LORD: it is an offering made by fire unto the LORD.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si mú igẹ̀ àgbo ìyasimimọ́ Aaroni, iwọ o si fì i li ẹbọ fifì niwaju OLUWA; ìpín tirẹ li eyinì.
entries.en: And thou shalt take the breast of the ram of Aaron's consecration, and wave it for a wave offering before the LORD: and it shall be thy part.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si yà igẹ̀ ẹbọ fifì na simimọ́, ati itan ẹbọ agbesọsoke, ti a fì, ti a si gbesọsoke ninu àgbo ìyasimimọ́ na, ani ninu eyiti iṣe ti Aaroni, ati ninu eyiti iṣe ti awọn ọmọ rẹ̀:
entries.en: And thou shalt sanctify the breast of the wave offering, and the shoulder of the heave offering, which is waved, and which is heaved up, of the ram of the consecration, even of that which is for Aaron, and of that which is for his sons:

entries.yo: Eyi ni yio si ma ṣe ti Aaroni ati ti awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ ni ìlana lailai lọwọ awọn ọmọ Israeli: nitori ẹbọ agbesọsoke ni: ẹbọ agbesọsoke ni yio si ṣe lati ọwọ́ awọn ọmọ Israeli, ninu ẹbọ alafia wọn, ani ẹbọ agbesọsoke wọn si OLUWA.
entries.en: And it shall be Aaron's and his sons' by a statute for ever from the children of Israel: for it is an heave offering: and it shall be an heave offering from the children of Israel of the sacrifice of their peace offerings, even their heave offering unto the LORD.

entries.yo: Ati aṣọ mimọ́ ti Aaroni ni yio ṣe ti awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ lẹhin rẹ̀, lati ma fi oróro yàn wọn ninu wọn, ati lati ma yà wọn simimọ́ ninu wọn.
entries.en: And the holy garments of Aaron shall be his sons' after him, to be anointed therein, and to be consecrated in them.

entries.yo: Ẹnikan ninu awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ ti o ba jẹ́ alufa ni ipò rẹ̀ ni yio mú wọn wọ̀ ni ijọ́ meje, nigbati o ba wá sinu agọ́ ajọ, lati ṣe ìsin ni ibi mimọ́ nì.
entries.en: And that son that is priest in his stead shall put them on seven days, when he cometh into the tabernacle of the congregation to minister in the holy place.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si mú àgbo ìyasimimọ́ nì, iwọ o si bọ̀ ẹran rẹ̀ ni ibi mimọ́ kan.
entries.en: And thou shalt take the ram of the consecration, and seethe his flesh in the holy place.

entries.yo: Aaroni ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ yio si jẹ ẹran àgbo na, ati àkara na ti o wà ninu agbọ̀n nì, li ẹnu-ọ̀na agọ́ ajọ.
entries.en: And Aaron and his sons shall eat the flesh of the ram, and the bread that is in the basket, by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

entries.yo: Nwọn o si jẹ nkan wọnni ti a fi ṣètutu na, lati yà wọn simimọ́, ati lati sọ wọn di mimọ́: ṣugbọn alejò ni kò gbọdọ jẹ ninu rẹ̀, nitoripe mimọ́ ni.
entries.en: And they shall eat those things wherewith the atonement was made, to consecrate and to sanctify them: but a stranger shall not eat thereof, because they are holy.

entries.yo: Bi ohun kan ninu ẹran ìyasimimọ́ na, tabi ninu àkara na, ba kú titi di ojumọ́, nigbana ni ki iwọ ki o fi iná sun iyokù: a ki yio jẹ ẹ, nitoripe mimọ́ ni.
entries.en: And if ought of the flesh of the consecrations, or of the bread, remain unto the morning, then thou shalt burn the remainder with fire: it shall not be eaten, because it is holy.

entries.yo: Bayi ni iwọ o si ṣe fun Aaroni, ati fun awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, gẹgẹ bi ohun gbogbo ti mo paṣẹ fun ọ: ijọ́ meje ni iwọ o fi yà wọn simimọ́.
entries.en: And thus shalt thou do unto Aaron, and to his sons, according to all things which I have commanded thee: seven days shalt thou consecrate them.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si ma pa akọmalu kọkan li ojojumọ́ ṣe ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ fun ètutu: iwọ o si wẹ̀ pẹpẹ na mọ́, nigbati iwọ ba ṣètutu si i tán, iwọ o si ta oróro si i lati yà a simimọ́.
entries.en: And thou shalt offer every day a bullock for a sin offering for atonement: and thou shalt cleanse the altar, when thou hast made an atonement for it, and thou shalt anoint it, to sanctify it.

entries.yo: Ni ijọ́ meje ni iwọ o fi ṣètutu si pẹpẹ na, iwọ o si yà a simimọ́: on o si ṣe pẹpẹ mimọ́ julọ; ohunkohun ti o ba fọwọkàn pẹpẹ na, mimọ́ ni yio jẹ́.
entries.en: Seven days thou shalt make an atonement for the altar, and sanctify it; and it shall be an altar most holy: whatsoever toucheth the altar shall be holy.

entries.yo: Njẹ eyi ni iwọ o ma fi rubọ lori pẹpẹ na; ọdọ-agutan meji ọlọdún kan li ojojumọ́ lailai.
entries.en: Now this is that which thou shalt offer upon the altar; two lambs of the first year day by day continually.

entries.yo: Ọdọ-agutan kan ni iwọ o fi rubọ li owurọ̀; ati ọdọ-agutan keji ni iwọ o fi rubọ li aṣalẹ:
entries.en: The one lamb thou shalt offer in the morning; and the other lamb thou shalt offer at even:

entries.yo: Ati idamẹwa òṣuwọn iyẹfun ti a fi idamẹrin hini oróro ti a gún pòlu; ati idamẹrin òṣuwọn hini ọti-waini fun ẹbọ mimu, fun ọdọ-agutan ekini.
entries.en: And with the one lamb a tenth deal of flour mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil; and the fourth part of an hin of wine for a drink offering.

entries.yo: Ọdọ-agutan keji ni ki iwọ ki o pa rubọ li aṣalẹ, iwọ o si ṣe si i gẹgẹ bi ẹbọ jijẹ owurọ̀, ati gẹgẹ bi ẹbọ mimu rẹ̀, fun õrùn didùn, ẹbọ ti a fi iná ṣe ni si OLUWA.
entries.en: And the other lamb thou shalt offer at even, and shalt do thereto according to the meat offering of the morning, and according to the drink offering thereof, for a sweet savour, an offering made by fire unto the LORD.

entries.yo: Ẹbọ sisun titilai ni yio ṣe lati irandiran nyin li ẹnu-ọ̀na agọ́ ajọ niwaju OLUWA: nibiti emi o ma bá nyin pade lati ma bá ọ sọ̀rọ nibẹ̀.
entries.en: This shall be a continual burnt offering throughout your generations at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the LORD: where I will meet you, to speak there unto thee.

entries.yo: Nibẹ̀ li emi o ma pade awọn ọmọ Israeli; a o si fi ogo mi yà agọ́ na simimọ́.
entries.en: And there I will meet with the children of Israel, and the tabernacle shall be sanctified by my glory.

entries.yo: Emi o si yà agọ́ ajọ na simimọ́, ati pẹpẹ nì: emi o si yà Aaroni ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ simimọ́, lati ma ṣe iṣẹ alufa fun mi.
entries.en: And I will sanctify the tabernacle of the congregation, and the altar: I will sanctify also both Aaron and his sons, to minister to me in the priest's office.

entries.yo: Emi o si ma gbé ãrin awọn ọmọ Israeli, emi o si ma ṣe Ọlọrun wọn.
entries.en: And I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will be their God.

entries.yo: Nwọn o si mọ̀ pe emi li OLUWA Ọlọrun wọn, ti o mú wọn lati ilẹ Egipti jade wá, ki emi ki o le ma gbé ãrin wọn: emi li OLUWA Ọlọrun wọn.
entries.en: And they shall know that I am the LORD their God, that brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, that I may dwell among them: I am the LORD their God.

entries.yo: IWỌ o si ṣe pẹpẹ kan lati ma jó turari lori rẹ̀: igi ṣittimu ni ki iwọ ki o fi ṣe e.
entries.en: And thou shalt make an altar to burn incense upon: of shittim wood shalt thou make it.

entries.yo: Igbọnwọ kan ni gigùn rẹ̀, ati igbọnwọ kan ni ibú rẹ̀; ìha mẹrin ọgbọgba ni ki o jẹ́: igbọnwọ meji si ni giga rẹ̀: iwo rẹ̀ yio si wà lara rẹ̀.
entries.en: A cubit shall be the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof; foursquare shall it be: and two cubits shall be the height thereof: the horns thereof shall be of the same.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si fi kìki wurà bò o, oke rẹ̀, ati ìha rẹ̀ yiká, ati iwo rẹ̀; iwọ o si ṣe igbáti wurà yi i ká.
entries.en: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, the top thereof, and the sides thereof round about, and the horns thereof; and thou shalt make unto it a crown of gold round about.

entries.yo: Ati oruka wurà meji ni ki iwọ ki o ṣe nisalẹ igbáti rẹ̀, ni ìha igun rẹ̀ meji, li ẹgbẹ rẹ̀ mejeji ni ki iwọ ki o ṣe e si; nwọn o si jasi ipò fun ọpá wọnni, lati ma fi gbé e.
entries.en: And two golden rings shalt thou make to it under the crown of it, by the two corners thereof, upon the two sides of it shalt thou make it; and they shall be for places for the staves to bear it withal.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si fi igi ṣittimu ṣe ọpá wọnni, iwọ o si fi wurà bò wọn.
entries.en: And thou shalt make the staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si gbé e kà iwaju aṣọ-ikele nì ti o wà lẹba apoti ẹrí, niwaju itẹ́-ãnu ti o wà lori apoti ẹrí nì, nibiti emi o ma bá ọ pade.
entries.en: And thou shalt put it before the vail that is by the ark of the testimony, before the mercy seat that is over the testimony, where I will meet with thee.

entries.yo: Aaroni yio si ma jó turari didùn lori rẹ̀; li orowurọ̀, nigbati o ba tun fitila wọnni ṣe, on o si ma jó o lori rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Aaron shall burn thereon sweet incense every morning: when he dresseth the lamps, he shall burn incense upon it.

entries.yo: Nigbati Aaroni ba si tàn fitila wọnni li aṣalẹ, yio si ma jó turari lori rẹ̀, turari titilai niwaju OLUWA lati irandiran nyin.
entries.en: And when Aaron lighteth the lamps at even, he shall burn incense upon it, a perpetual incense before the LORD throughout your generations.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin kò gbọdọ mú ajeji turari wá sori rẹ̀, tabi ẹbọ sisun, tabi ẹbọ onjẹ: bẹ̃li ẹnyin kò gbọdọ dà ẹbọ ohun mimu sori rẹ̀.
entries.en: Ye shall offer no strange incense thereon, nor burnt sacrifice, nor meat offering; neither shall ye pour drink offering thereon.

entries.yo: Aaroni yio si ma fi ẹ̀jẹ ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ ètutu ṣètutu lori iwo rẹ̀ lẹ̃kan li ọdún: yio ṣètutu lori rẹ̀ lẹ̃kan li ọdun lati irandiran nyin: mimọ́ julọ ni si OLUWA.
entries.en: And Aaron shall make an atonement upon the horns of it once in a year with the blood of the sin offering of atonements: once in the year shall he make atonement upon it throughout your generations: it is most holy unto the LORD.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Nigbati iwọ ba kà iye awọn ọmọ Israeli, gẹgẹ bi ẹgbẹ wọn, nigbana li olukuluku ọkunrin yio mú irapada ọkàn rẹ̀ fun OLUWA wá, nigbati iwọ ba kà iye wọn; ki ajakalẹ-àrun ki o máṣe si ninu wọn, nigbati iwọ ba nkà iye wọn.
entries.en: When thou takest the sum of the children of Israel after their number, then shall they give every man a ransom for his soul unto the LORD, when thou numberest them; that there be no plague among them, when thou numberest them.

entries.yo: Eyi ni nwọn o múwa, olukuluku ẹniti o ba kọja sinu awọn ti a kà, àbọ ṣekeli, ani ṣekeli ibi mimọ́: (ogún gera ni ṣekeli kan:) àbọ ṣekeli li ọrẹ fun OLUWA.
entries.en: This they shall give, every one that passeth among them that are numbered, half a shekel after the shekel of the sanctuary: (a shekel is twenty gerahs:) an half shekel shall be the offering of the LORD.

entries.yo: Olukuluku ẹniti o ba kọja sinu awọn ti a kà, lati ẹni ogún ọdún ati jù bẹ̃ lọ, ni yio fi ọrẹ fun OLUWA.
entries.en: Every one that passeth among them that are numbered, from twenty years old and above, shall give an offering unto the LORD.

entries.yo: Olowo ki o san jù bẹ̃ lọ, bẹ̃li awọn talaka kò si gbọdọ di li àbọ ṣekeli, nigbati nwọn ba mú ọrẹ wá fun OLUWA, lati ṣètutu fun ọkàn nyin.
entries.en: The rich shall not give more, and the poor shall not give less than half a shekel, when they give an offering unto the LORD, to make an atonement for your souls.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si gbà owo ètutu na lọwọ awọn ọmọ Israeli, iwọ o si fi i lelẹ fun ìsin agọ́ ajọ; ki o le ma ṣe iranti fun awọn ọmọ Israeli niwaju OLUWA, lati ṣètutu fun ọkàn nyin.
entries.en: And thou shalt take the atonement money of the children of Israel, and shalt appoint it for the service of the tabernacle of the congregation; that it may be a memorial unto the children of Israel before the LORD, to make an atonement for your souls.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Iwọ o si ṣe agbada idẹ kan, ati ẹsẹ̀ rẹ̀ idẹ, fun wiwẹ̀: iwọ o si gbẹ́ e kà agbedemeji agọ́ ajọ, ati pẹpẹ nì, iwọ o si pọn omi sinu rẹ̀.
entries.en: Thou shalt also make a laver of brass, and his foot also of brass, to wash withal: and thou shalt put it between the tabernacle of the congregation and the altar, and thou shalt put water therein.

entries.yo: Nitori Aaroni ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ yio ma wẹ̀ ọwọ́ wọn ati ẹsẹ̀ wọn nibẹ̀:
entries.en: For Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet thereat:

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn ba nwọ̀ inu agọ́ ajọ lọ, nwọn o fi omi wẹ̀ ki nwọn ki o má ba kú: tabi nigbati nwọn ba sunmọ pẹpẹ nì lati ṣe ìsin, lati ru ẹbọ sisun ti a fi iná ṣe si OLUWA:
entries.en: When they go into the tabernacle of the congregation, they shall wash with water, that they die not; or when they come near to the altar to minister, to burn offering made by fire unto the LORD:

entries.yo: Nwọn o si wẹ̀ ọwọ́ wọn ati ẹsẹ̀ wọn, ki nwọn ki o má ba kú: yio si di ìlana fun wọn lailai, fun u ati fun irú-ọmọ rẹ̀ lati irandiran wọn.
entries.en: So they shall wash their hands and their feet, that they die not: and it shall be a statute for ever to them, even to him and to his seed throughout their generations.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: Moreover the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Iwọ mú ãyo olõrùn si ọdọ rẹ, pẹlu ojia sísan ẹdẹgbẹta ṣekeli, ati kinnamoni didùn idameji bẹ̃, ani ãdọtalerugba ṣekeli, ati kalamu didùn ãdọtalerugba ṣekeli,
entries.en: Take thou also unto thee principal spices, of pure myrrh five hundred shekels, and of sweet cinnamon half so much, even two hundred and fifty shekels, and of sweet calamus two hundred and fifty shekels,

entries.yo: Ati kassia ẹdẹgbẹta ṣekeli, ṣekeli ibi mimọ́, ati hini oróro olifi kan:
entries.en: And of cassia five hundred shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary, and of oil olive an hin:

entries.yo: Iwọ o si ṣe e li oróro mimọ́ ikunra, ti a fi ọgbọ́n alapòlu pò: yio si jẹ́ oróro mimọ́ itasori.
entries.en: And thou shalt make it an oil of holy ointment, an ointment compound after the art of the apothecary: it shall be an holy anointing oil.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si ta ninu rẹ̀ sara agọ́ ajọ, ati apoti ẹrí nì,
entries.en: And thou shalt anoint the tabernacle of the congregation therewith, and the ark of the testimony,

entries.yo: Ati tabili ati ohunèlo rẹ̀ gbogbo, ati ọpáfitila ati ohun-èlo rẹ̀, ati pẹpẹ turari,
entries.en: And the table and all his vessels, and the candlestick and his vessels, and the altar of incense,

entries.yo: Ati pẹpẹ ẹbọ sisun pẹlu gbogbo ohunèlo rẹ̀, ati agbada ati ẹsẹ̀ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the altar of burnt offering with all his vessels, and the laver and his foot.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si yà wọn simimọ́, ki nwọn ki o le ṣe mimọ́ julọ: ohunkohun ti o ba fọwọkàn wọn yio di mimọ́.
entries.en: And thou shalt sanctify them, that they may be most holy: whatsoever toucheth them shall be holy.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si ta òróró sí Aaroni ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, iwọ o si yà wọn si mimọ́, ki nwọn ki o le ma ṣe alufa fun mi.
entries.en: And thou shalt anoint Aaron and his sons, and consecrate them, that they may minister unto me in the priest's office.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si sọ fun awọn ọmọ Israeli pe, Eyi ni yio ma ṣe oróro mimọ́ itasori fun mi lati irandiran nyin.
entries.en: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, This shall be an holy anointing oil unto me throughout your generations.

entries.yo: A ko gbọdọ dà a si ara enia, bẹ̃li ẹnyin kò gbọdọ ṣe irú rẹ̀, ni ìwọn pipò rẹ̀: mimọ́ ni, yio si ma ṣe mimọ́ fun nyin.
entries.en: Upon man's flesh shall it not be poured, neither shall ye make any other like it, after the composition of it: it is holy, and it shall be holy unto you.

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni ti o ba pò bi irú rẹ̀, tabi ẹnikẹni ti o ba fi sara alejò ninu rẹ̀, on li a o si ke kuro ninu awọn enia rẹ̀.
entries.en: Whosoever compoundeth any like it, or whosoever putteth any of it upon a stranger, shall even be cut off from his people.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun Mose pe, Mú olõrùn didùn sọdọ rẹ, stakte, ati onika, ati galbanumu; olõrùn didùn wọnyi, pẹlu turari daradara: òṣuwọn kan na li olukuluku;
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Take unto thee sweet spices, stacte, and onycha, and galbanum; these sweet spices with pure frankincense: of each shall there be a like weight:

entries.yo: Iwọ o si ṣe e ni turari, apòlu nipa ọgbọ́n-ọnà alapòlu, ti a fi iyọ̀ si, ti o dara ti o si mọ́.
entries.en: And thou shalt make it a perfume, a confection after the art of the apothecary, tempered together, pure and holy:

entries.yo: Iwọ o si gún diẹ ninu rẹ̀ kunna, iwọ o si fi i siwaju ẹrí ninu rẹ̀ ninu agọ́ ajọ, nibiti emi o gbé ma bá ọ pade: yio ṣe mimọ́ julọ fun nyin.
entries.en: And thou shalt beat some of it very small, and put of it before the testimony in the tabernacle of the congregation, where I will meet with thee: it shall be unto you most holy.

entries.yo: Ati ti turari ti iwọ o ṣe, ẹnyin kò gbọdọ ṣe e fun ara nyin ni ìwọn pipò rẹ̀: yio si ṣe mimọ́ fun ọ si OLUWA.
entries.en: And as for the perfume which thou shalt make, ye shall not make to yourselves according to the composition thereof: it shall be unto thee holy for the LORD.

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni ti o ba ṣe irú rẹ̀, lati ma gbõrùn rẹ̀, on li a o ke kuro ninu awọn enia rẹ̀.
entries.en: Whosoever shall make like unto that, to smell thereto, shall even be cut off from his people.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Wò ó, emi ti pè Besaleli li orukọ, ọmọ Uri, ọmọ Huri, ti ẹ̀ya Judah:
entries.en: See, I have called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah:

entries.yo: Emi si fi ẹmi Ọlọrun kún u li ọgbọ́n, ati li oyé, ati ni ìmọ, ati li onirũru iṣẹ-ọnà.
entries.en: And I have filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship,

entries.yo: Lati humọ̀ alarabara iṣẹ, lati ṣiṣẹ ni wurà, ati ni fadakà, ati ni idẹ,
entries.en: To devise cunning works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,

entries.yo: Ati li okuta gbigbẹ lati tò wọn, ati ni igi fifin, lati ṣiṣẹ li onirũru iṣẹ-ọnà.
entries.en: And in cutting of stones, to set them, and in carving of timber, to work in all manner of workmanship.

entries.yo: Ati emi, kiyesi i, mo fi Oholiabu, ọmọ Ahisamaki, ti ẹ̀ya Dani, pẹlu rẹ̀; ati ninu ọkàn awọn ti iṣe ọlọgbọ́n inu ni mo fi ọgbọ́n si, ki nwọn ki o le ma ṣe ohun gbogbo ti mo palaṣẹ fun ọ:
entries.en: And I, behold, I have given with him Aholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan: and in the hearts of all that are wise hearted I have put wisdom, that they may make all that I have commanded thee;

entries.yo: Agọ́ ajọ na, ati apoti ẹrí nì, ati itẹ́-ãnu ti o wà lori rẹ̀, ati gbogbo ohunèlo Agọ́ na.
entries.en: The tabernacle of the congregation, and the ark of the testimony, and the mercy seat that is thereupon, and all the furniture of the tabernacle,

entries.yo: Ati tabili na ati ohun-èlo rẹ̀, ati ọpá-fitila mimọ́ pẹlu gbogbo ohunèlo rẹ̀, ati pẹpẹ turari;
entries.en: And the table and his furniture, and the pure candlestick with all his furniture, and the altar of incense,

entries.yo: Ati pẹpẹ ẹbọ sisun pẹlu gbogbo ohunèlo rẹ̀, ati agbada nì ti on ti ẹsẹ̀ rẹ̀;
entries.en: And the altar of burnt offering with all his furniture, and the laver and his foot,

entries.yo: Ati aṣọ ìsin, ati aṣọ mimọ́ wọnni fun Aaroni alufa, ati aṣọ awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, lati ma fi ṣe iṣẹ alufa;
entries.en: And the cloths of service, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest's office,

entries.yo: Ati oróro itasori, ati turari olõrùn didùn fun ibi mimọ́ nì: gẹgẹ bi gbogbo eyiti mo palaṣẹ fun ọ ni nwọn o ṣe.
entries.en: And the anointing oil, and sweet incense for the holy place: according to all that I have commanded thee shall they do.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o sọ fun awọn ọmọ Israeli pe, Ọjọ́ isimi mi li ẹnyin o pamọ́ nitõtọ: nitori àmi ni lãrin emi ati lãrin nyin lati irandiran nyin; ki ẹnyin ki o le mọ̀ pe emi li OLUWA ti o yà nyin simimọ́.
entries.en: Speak thou also unto the children of Israel, saying, Verily my sabbaths ye shall keep: for it is a sign between me and you throughout your generations; that ye may know that I am the LORD that doth sanctify you.

entries.yo: Nitorina ki ẹnyin ki o ma pa ọjọ́ isimi mọ́; nitoripe mimọ́ ni fun nyin: ẹniti o ba bà a jẹ́ on li a o pa nitõtọ: nitori ẹnikẹni ti o ba ṣe iṣẹkiṣẹ kan ninu rẹ̀, ọkàn na li a o ke kuro ninu awọn enia rẹ̀.
entries.en: Ye shall keep the sabbath therefore; for it is holy unto you: every one that defileth it shall surely be put to death: for whosoever doeth any work therein, that soul shall be cut off from among his people.

entries.yo: Ijọ́ mẹfa ni ki a ṣe iṣẹ; ṣugbọn ni ọjọ́ keje ni ọjọ́ isimi, mimọ́ ni si OLUWA: ẹnikẹni ti o ba ṣe iṣẹkiṣẹ li ọjọ́ isimi, on li a o si pa nitõtọ.
entries.en: Six days may work be done; but in the seventh is the sabbath of rest, holy to the LORD: whosoever doeth any work in the sabbath day, he shall surely be put to death.

entries.yo: Nitorina li awọn ọmọ Israeli yio ṣe ma pa ọjọ́ isimi mọ́, lati ma kiyesi ọjọ́ isimi lati irandiran wọn, fun majẹmu titilai.
entries.en: Wherefore the children of Israel shall keep the sabbath, to observe the sabbath throughout their generations, for a perpetual covenant.

entries.yo: Àmi ni iṣe lãrin emi ati lãrin awọn ọmọ Israeli titilai: nitori ni ijọ́ mẹfa li OLUWA dá ọrun on aiye, ni ijọ́ keje o si simi, o si ṣe ìtura.
entries.en: It is a sign between me and the children of Israel for ever: for in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day he rested, and was refreshed.

entries.yo: O si fi walã ẹrí meji, walã okuta, ti a fi ika Ọlọrun kọ, fun Mose, nigbati o pari ọ̀rọ bibá a sọ tán lori oke Sinai.
entries.en: And he gave unto Moses, when he had made an end of communing with him upon mount Sinai, two tables of testimony, tables of stone, written with the finger of God.

entries.yo: NIGBATI awọn enia ri pe, Mose pẹ lati sọkalẹ ti ori òke wá, awọn enia kó ara wọn jọ sọdọ Aaroni, nwọn si wi fun u pe, Dide, dá oriṣa fun wa, ti yio ma ṣaju wa lọ; bi o ṣe ti Mose yi ni, ọkunrin nì ti o mú wa gòke lati ilẹ Egipti wá, awa kò mọ̀ ohun ti o ṣe e.
entries.en: And when the people saw that Moses delayed to come down out of the mount, the people gathered themselves together unto Aaron, and said unto him, Up, make us gods, which shall go before us; for as for this Moses, the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.

entries.yo: Aaroni si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ kán oruka wurà ti o wà li eti awọn aya nyin, ati ti awọn ọmọkunrin nyin, ati ti awọn ọmọbinrin nyin, ki ẹ si mú wọn tọ̀ mi wá.
entries.en: And Aaron said unto them, Break off the golden earrings, which are in the ears of your wives, of your sons, and of your daughters, and bring them unto me.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn enia si kán oruka wurà ti o wà li eti wọn, nwọn si mú wọn tọ̀ Aaroni wá.
entries.en: And all the people brake off the golden earrings which were in their ears, and brought them unto Aaron.

entries.yo: O si gbà wọn li ọwọ́ wọn, o si fi ohun-ọnà fifin ṣe e, nigbati o si dà a li aworan ẹgbọrọmalu tán: nwọn si wipe, Israeli, wọnyi li oriṣa rẹ, ti o mú ọ gòke lati ilẹ Egipti wá.
entries.en: And he received them at their hand, and fashioned it with a graving tool, after he had made it a molten calf: and they said, These be thy gods, O Israel, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.

entries.yo: Nigbati Aaroni si ri i, o tẹ́ pẹpẹ kan niwaju rẹ̀; Aaroni si kede, o si wipe, Ọla li ajọ fun OLUWA.
entries.en: And when Aaron saw it, he built an altar before it; and Aaron made proclamation, and said, To morrow is a feast to the LORD.

entries.yo: Nwọn si dide ni kùtukutu ijọ́ keji nwọn si ru ẹbọ sisun, nwọn si mú ẹbọ alafia wá; awọn enia si joko lati jẹ ati lati mu, nwọn si dide lati ṣire.
entries.en: And they rose up early on the morrow, and offered burnt offerings, and brought peace offerings; and the people sat down to eat and to drink, and rose up to play.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe, Lọ, sọkalẹ lọ; nitoriti awọn enia rẹ, ti iwọ mú gòke lati ilẹ Egipti wá, nwọn ti ṣẹ̀.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go, get thee down; for thy people, which thou broughtest out of the land of Egypt, have corrupted themselves:

entries.yo: Nwọn ti yipada kánkan kuro ni ipa-ọ̀na ti mo làsilẹ fun wọn: nwọn ti dá ere ẹgbọrọmalu fun ara wọn, nwọn si ti mbọ ọ, nwọn si ti rubọ si i, nwọn nwipe, Israeli, wọnyi li oriṣa rẹ, ti o mú ọ gòke lati ilẹ̀ Egipti wá.
entries.en: They have turned aside quickly out of the way which I commanded them: they have made them a molten calf, and have worshipped it, and have sacrificed thereunto, and said, These be thy gods, O Israel, which have brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun Mose pe, Emi ti ri awọn enia yi, si kiyesi i, ọlọrùn lile enia ni:
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, I have seen this people, and, behold, it is a stiffnecked people:

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi jọwọ mi jẹ, ki ibinu mi ki o gbona si wọn, ki emi ki o le pa wọn run: emi o si sọ iwọ di orilẹ-ède nla.
entries.en: Now therefore let me alone, that my wrath may wax hot against them, and that I may consume them: and I will make of thee a great nation.

entries.yo: Mose si bẹ̀ OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ̀, o si wipe, OLUWA, ẽtiṣe ti ibinu rẹ fi gbona si awọn enia rẹ, ti iwọ fi ipá nla ati ọwọ́ agbara rẹ mú lati ilẹ Egipti jade wá?
entries.en: And Moses besought the LORD his God, and said, LORD, why doth thy wrath wax hot against thy people, which thou hast brought forth out of the land of Egypt with great power, and with a mighty hand?

entries.yo: Nitori kini awọn ara Egipti yio ṣe sọ wipe, Nitori ibi li o ṣe mú wọn jade, lati pa wọn lori oke, ati lati run wọn kuro lori ilẹ? Yipada kuro ninu ibinu rẹ ti o muna, ki o si yi ọkàn pada niti ibi yi si awọn enia rẹ.
entries.en: Wherefore should the Egyptians speak, and say, For mischief did he bring them out, to slay them in the mountains, and to consume them from the face of the earth? Turn from thy fierce wrath, and repent of this evil against thy people.

entries.yo: Ranti Abrahamu, Isaaki, ati Israeli awọn iranṣẹ rẹ, ẹniti iwọ fi ara rẹ bura fun, ti iwọ si wi fun wọn pe, Emi o mu irú-ọmọ nyin bisi i bi irawọ ọrun, ati gbogbo ilẹ na ti mo ti sọ nì, irú-ọmọ nyin li emi o fi fun, nwọn o si jogún rẹ̀ lailai.
entries.en: Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, thy servants, to whom thou swarest by thine own self, and saidst unto them, I will multiply your seed as the stars of heaven, and all this land that I have spoken of will I give unto your seed, and they shall inherit it for ever.

entries.yo: OLUWA si yi ọkàn pada niti ibi na ti o ti sọ pe on o ṣe si awọn enia rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the LORD repented of the evil which he thought to do unto his people.

entries.yo: Mose si yipada, o si sọkalẹ lati ori òke na wá, walã ẹrí meji nì si wà li ọwọ́ rẹ̀; walã ti a kọwe si ni ìha mejeji; lara ekini ati ekeji li a kọwe si.
entries.en: And Moses turned, and went down from the mount, and the two tables of the testimony were in his hand: the tables were written on both their sides; on the one side and on the other were they written.

entries.yo: Iṣẹ́ Ọlọrun si ni walã wọnni, ikọwe na ni ikọwe Ọlọrun, a fin i sara walã na.
entries.en: And the tables were the work of God, and the writing was the writing of God, graven upon the tables.

entries.yo: Nigbati Joṣua si gbọ́ ariwo awọn enia na, bi nwọn ti nhó, o wi fun Mose pe, Ariwo ogun mbẹ ni ibudó.
entries.en: And when Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted, he said unto Moses, There is a noise of war in the camp.

entries.yo: Mose si wi pe, Ki iṣe ohùn ariwo awọn ti nhó nitori iṣẹgun, bẹ̃ni ki iṣe ohùn ariwo awọn ti nkigbe pe a ṣẹgun wọn: ohùn awọn ti nkọrin ni mo gbọ́ yi.
entries.en: And he said, It is not the voice of them that shout for mastery, neither is it the voice of them that cry for being overcome: but the noise of them that sing do I hear.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, bi o ti sunmọ ibudó, o si ri ẹgbọrọmalu na, ati agbo ijó: ibinu Mose si ru gidigidi, o si sọ walã wọnni silẹ kuro li ọwọ́ rẹ̀, o si fọ́ wọn nisalẹ òke na.
entries.en: And it came to pass, as soon as he came nigh unto the camp, that he saw the calf, and the dancing: and Moses' anger waxed hot, and he cast the tables out of his hands, and brake them beneath the mount.

entries.yo: O si mú ẹgbọrọ-malu na ti nwọn ṣe, o si sun u ni iná, o si lọ̀ ọ di ẹ̀tu, o si kù u soju omi, o si mu awọn ọmọ Israeli mu u.
entries.en: And he took the calf which they had made, and burnt it in the fire, and ground it to powder, and strawed it upon the water, and made the children of Israel drink of it.

entries.yo: Mose si wi fun Aaroni pe, Kili awọn enia wọnyi fi ṣe ọ, ti iwọ fi mú ẹ̀ṣẹ̀ nla wá sori wọn?
entries.en: And Moses said unto Aaron, What did this people unto thee, that thou hast brought so great a sin upon them?

entries.yo: Aaroni si wipe, Máṣe jẹ ki ibinu oluwa mi ki o gbona: iwọ mọ̀ awọn enia yi pe, nwọn buru.
entries.en: And Aaron said, Let not the anger of my lord wax hot: thou knowest the people, that they are set on mischief.

entries.yo: Awọn li o sa wi fun mi pe, Ṣe oriṣa fun wa, ti yio ma ṣaju wa: bi o ṣe ti Mose yi ni, ọkunrin nì ti o mú wa gòke lati ilẹ Egipti wá, awa kò mọ̀ ohun ti o ṣe e.
entries.en: For they said unto me, Make us gods, which shall go before us: for as for this Moses, the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.

entries.yo: Emi si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹnikẹni ti o ba ni wurà, ki nwọn ki o kán a kuro; bẹ̃ni nwọn fi fun mi: nigbana li emi fi i sinu iná, ẹgbọrọmalu yi si ti jade wá.
entries.en: And I said unto them, Whosoever hath any gold, let them break it off. So they gave it me: then I cast it into the fire, and there came out this calf.

entries.yo: Nigbati Mose ri i pe awọn enia na kò ṣe ikoso; nitoriti Aaroni sọ wọn di alailakoso lãrin awọn ti o dide si wọn.
entries.en: And when Moses saw that the people were naked; (for Aaron had made them naked unto their shame among their enemies:)

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Mose duro li ẹnubode ibudó, o si wipe, Ẹnikẹni ti o wà ni ìha ti OLUWA, ki o tọ̀ mi wá. Gbogbo awọn ọmọ Lefi si kó ara wọn jọ sọdọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Then Moses stood in the gate of the camp, and said, Who is on the LORD's side? let him come unto me. And all the sons of Levi gathered themselves together unto him.

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Bayi li OLUWA, Ọlọrun Israeli, wipe, Ki olukuluku ọkunrin ki o kọ idà rẹ̀ si ẹgbẹ́ rẹ̀, ki ẹ si ma wọle, ki ẹ si ma jade lati ẹnubode dé ẹnubode já gbogbo ibudó, olukuluku ki o si pa arakunrin rẹ̀, ati olukuluku ki o si pa ẹgbẹ rẹ̀, ati olukuluku ki o si pa aladugbo rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he said unto them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Put every man his sword by his side, and go in and out from gate to gate throughout the camp, and slay every man his brother, and every man his companion, and every man his neighbour.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Lefi si ṣe gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ Mose: awọn ti o ṣubu ninu awọn enia li ọjọ́ na to ìwọn ẹgbẹdogun enia.
entries.en: And the children of Levi did according to the word of Moses: and there fell of the people that day about three thousand men.

entries.yo: Mose sa ti wipe, Ẹ yà ara nyin simimọ́ li oni fun OLUWA, ani olukuluku ọkunrin lara ọmọ rẹ̀, ati lara arakunrin rẹ̀; ki o le fi ibukún si nyin lori li oni.
entries.en: For Moses had said, Consecrate yourselves to day to the LORD, even every man upon his son, and upon his brother; that he may bestow upon you a blessing this day.

entries.yo: O si ṣe ni ijọ́ keji, ni Mose wi fun awọn enia pe, Ẹnyin dá ẹ̀ṣẹ nla: njẹ nisisiyi, emi o gòke tọ̀ OLUWA, bọya emi o ṣètutu fun ẹ̀ṣẹ nyin.
entries.en: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Moses said unto the people, Ye have sinned a great sin: and now I will go up unto the LORD; peradventure I shall make an atonement for your sin.

entries.yo: Mose si pada tọ̀ OLUWA lọ, o si wipe, Yẽ, awọn enia wọnyi ti dá ẹ̀ṣẹ nla, nwọn si dá oriṣa wurà fun ara wọn.
entries.en: And Moses returned unto the LORD, and said, Oh, this people have sinned a great sin, and have made them gods of gold.

entries.yo: Nisisiyi, bi iwọ o ba dari ẹ̀ṣẹ wọn jì wọn; bi bẹ̃ si kọ, emi bẹ̀ ọ, pa mi rẹ́ kuro ninu iwé rẹ ti iwọ ti kọ.
entries.en: Yet now, if thou wilt forgive their sin--; and if not, blot me, I pray thee, out of thy book which thou hast written.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun Mose pe, Ẹnikẹni ti o ṣẹ̀ mi, on li emi o parẹ́ kuro ninu iwé mi.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Whosoever hath sinned against me, him will I blot out of my book.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi lọ, ma mú awọn enia na lọ si ibiti mo ti sọ fun ọ: kiyesi i, angeli mi yio ṣaju rẹ: ṣugbọn li ọjọ́ ti emi o ṣe ìbẹwo, emi o bẹ̀ ẹ̀ṣẹ wọn wò lara wọn.
entries.en: Therefore now go, lead the people unto the place of which I have spoken unto thee: behold, mine Angel shall go before thee: nevertheless in the day when I visit I will visit their sin upon them.

entries.yo: OLUWA si yọ awọn enia na lẹnu, nitoriti nwọn ṣe ẹgbọrọ-malu, ti Aaroni ṣe.
entries.en: And the LORD plagued the people, because they made the calf, which Aaron made.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun Mose pe, Dide, gòke lati ihin lọ, iwọ ati awọn enia na ti iwọ mú gòke lati ilẹ Egipti wá, si ilẹ ti mo ti bura fun Abrahamu, fun Isaaki, ati fun Jakobu, wipe, Irú-ọmọ rẹ li emi o fi i fun:
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Depart, and go up hence, thou and the people which thou hast brought up out of the land of Egypt, unto the land which I sware unto Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, Unto thy seed will I give it:

entries.yo: Emi o si rán angeli kan si iwaju rẹ; emi o si lé awọn ara Kenaani, awọn ara Amori, ati awọn ara Hitti, ati awọn ara Perissi, ati awọn ara Hifi, ati awọn ara Jebusi jade:
entries.en: And I will send an angel before thee; and I will drive out the Canaanite, the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite:

entries.yo: Si ilẹ ti nṣàn fun warà ati fun oyin; emi ki yio sa gòke lọ lãrin rẹ; nitori ọlọrùn lile ni iwọ: ki emi ki o má ba run ọ li ọ̀na.
entries.en: Unto a land flowing with milk and honey: for I will not go up in the midst of thee; for thou art a stiffnecked people: lest I consume thee in the way.

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn enia na si gbọ́ ihin buburu yi, nwọn kãnu: enia kan kò si wọ̀ ohun ọṣọ́ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And when the people heard these evil tidings, they mourned: and no man did put on him his ornaments.

entries.yo: OLUWA si ti wi fun Mose pe, Wi fun awọn ọmọ Israeli pe, ọlọ́rùn lile ni nyin: bi emi ba gòke wá sãrin rẹ ni iṣẹju kan, emi o si run ọ: njẹ nisisiyi bọ́ ohun ọṣọ́ rẹ kuro lara rẹ, ki emi ki o le mọ̀ ohun ti emi o fi ọ ṣe.
entries.en: For the LORD had said unto Moses, Say unto the children of Israel, Ye are a stiffnecked people: I will come up into the midst of thee in a moment, and consume thee: therefore now put off thy ornaments from thee, that I may know what to do unto thee.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Israeli si bọ́ ohun ọṣọ́ wọn kuro lara wọn leti oke Horebu.
entries.en: And the children of Israel stripped themselves of their ornaments by the mount Horeb.

entries.yo: Mose si mú agọ́ na, o si pa a lẹhin ibudó, li òkere rére si ibudó; o pè e ni Agọ́ ajọ. O si ṣe, olukuluku ẹniti mbère OLUWA o jade lọ si agọ́ ajọ, ti o wà lẹhin ibudó.
entries.en: And Moses took the tabernacle, and pitched it without the camp, afar off from the camp, and called it the Tabernacle of the congregation. And it came to pass, that every one which sought the LORD went out unto the tabernacle of the congregation, which was without the camp.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati Mose jade lọ si ibi agọ́ na, gbogbo awọn enia a si dide duro, olukuluku a si duro li ẹnu-ọ̀na agọ́ rẹ̀, a ma wò ẹhin Mose, titi yio fi dé ibi agọ́ na.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when Moses went out unto the tabernacle, that all the people rose up, and stood every man at his tent door, and looked after Moses, until he was gone into the tabernacle.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, bi Mose ti dé ibi agọ́ na, ọwọ̀n awọsanma sọkalẹ, o si duro li ẹnu-ọ̀na agọ́ na: OLUWA si bá Mose sọ̀rọ.
entries.en: And it came to pass, as Moses entered into the tabernacle, the cloudy pillar descended, and stood at the door of the tabernacle, and the LORD talked with Moses.

entries.yo: Gbogbo enia si ri ọwọ̀n awọsanma na o duro li ẹnu-ọ̀na agọ́ na: gbogbo enia si dide duro, nwọn si wolẹ sìn, olukuluku li ẹnu-ọ̀na agọ́ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And all the people saw the cloudy pillar stand at the tabernacle door: and all the people rose up and worshipped, every man in his tent door.

entries.yo: OLUWA si bá Mose sọ̀rọ li ojukoju, bi enia ti ibá ọ̀rẹ́ rẹ̀ sọ̀rọ. O si tun pada lọ si ibudó: ṣugbọn Joṣua iranṣẹ rẹ̀, ọmọ Nuni, ọdọmọkunrin kan, kò lọ kuro ninu agọ́ na.
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses face to face, as a man speaketh unto his friend. And he turned again into the camp: but his servant Joshua, the son of Nun, a young man, departed not out of the tabernacle.

entries.yo: Mose si wi fun OLUWA pe, Wò o, iwọ wi fun mi pe, Mú awọn enia wọnyi gòke lọ: sibẹ̀ iwọ kò jẹ ki emi ki o mọ̀ ẹniti iwọ o rán pẹlu mi. Ṣugbọn iwọ wipe, Emi mọ̀ ọ li orukọ, iwọ si ri ore-ọfẹ li oju mi pẹlu.
entries.en: And Moses said unto the LORD, See, thou sayest unto me, Bring up this people: and thou hast not let me know whom thou wilt send with me. Yet thou hast said, I know thee by name, and thou hast also found grace in my sight.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, emi bẹ̀ ọ, bi mo ba ri ore-ọfẹ li oju rẹ, fi ọ̀na rẹ hàn mi nisisiyi, ki emi ki o le mọ̀ ọ, ki emi ki o le ri ore-ọfẹ li oju rẹ: ki o si rò pe orilẹ-ède yi enia rẹ ni.
entries.en: Now therefore, I pray thee, if I have found grace in thy sight, shew me now thy way, that I may know thee, that I may find grace in thy sight: and consider that this nation is thy people.

entries.yo: On si wipe, Oju mi yio ma bá ọ lọ, emi o si fun ọ ni isimi.
entries.en: And he said, My presence shall go with thee, and I will give thee rest.

entries.yo: On si wi fun u pe, Bi oju rẹ kò ba bá wa lọ, máṣe mú wa gòke lati ihin lọ.
entries.en: And he said unto him, If thy presence go not with me, carry us not up hence.

entries.yo: Nipa ewo li a o fi mọ̀ nihinyi pe, emi ri ore-ọfẹ li oju rẹ, ani emi ati awọn enia rẹ? ki iha iṣe ni ti pe iwọ mbá wa lọ ni, bẹ̃ni a o si yà wa sọ̀tọ, emi ati awọn enia rẹ, kuro lara gbogbo enia ti o wà lori ilẹ?
entries.en: For wherein shall it be known here that I and thy people have found grace in thy sight? is it not in that thou goest with us? so shall we be separated, I and thy people, from all the people that are upon the face of the earth.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun Mose pe, Emi o ṣe ohun yi ti iwọ sọ pẹlu: nitoriti iwọ ri ore-ọfẹ li oju mi, emi si mọ̀ ọ li orukọ.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, I will do this thing also that thou hast spoken: for thou hast found grace in my sight, and I know thee by name.

entries.yo: O si wi fun u pe, Emi bẹ̀ ọ, fi ogo rẹ̀ hàn mi.
entries.en: And he said, I beseech thee, shew me thy glory.

entries.yo: On si wi fun u pe, Emi o mu gbogbo ore mi kọja niwaju rẹ, emi o si pè orukọ OLUWA niwaju rẹ; emi o si ṣe ore-ọfẹ fun ẹniti emi nfẹ ṣe ore-ọfẹ fun, emi o si ṣe ãnu fun ẹniti emi o ṣe ãnu fun.
entries.en: And he said, I will make all my goodness pass before thee, and I will proclaim the name of the LORD before thee; and will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and will shew mercy on whom I will shew mercy.

entries.yo: On si wipe, Iwọ kò le ri oju mi: nitoriti kò sí enia kan ti iri mi, ti si yè.
entries.en: And he said, Thou canst not see my face: for there shall no man see me, and live.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wipe, Wò, ibi kan wà lẹba ọdọ mi, iwọ o si duro lori apata:
entries.en: And the LORD said, Behold, there is a place by me, and thou shalt stand upon a rock:

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, nigbati ogo mi ba nrekọja, emi o fi ọ sinu palapala apata, emi o si fi ọwọ́ mi bò ọ titi emi o fi rekọja:
entries.en: And it shall come to pass, while my glory passeth by, that I will put thee in a clift of the rock, and will cover thee with my hand while I pass by:

entries.yo: Nigbati emi o mú ọwọ́ mi kuro, iwọ o si ri akẹhinsi mi: ṣugbọn oju mi li a ki iri.
entries.en: And I will take away mine hand, and thou shalt see my back parts: but my face shall not be seen.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun Mose pe, Iwọ gbẹ́ walã okuta meji bi ti iṣaju: emi o si kọ ọ̀rọ walã ti iṣaju, ti iwọ ti fọ́, sara walã wọnyi.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Hew thee two tables of stone like unto the first: and I will write upon these tables the words that were in the first tables, which thou brakest.

entries.yo: Si mura li owurọ̀, ki iwọ ki o si gún òke Sinai wá li owurọ̀, ki o si wá duro niwaju mi nibẹ̀ lori òke na.
entries.en: And be ready in the morning, and come up in the morning unto mount Sinai, and present thyself there to me in the top of the mount.

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni ki yio si bá ọ gòke wá, ki a má si ṣe ri ẹnikẹni pẹlu li òke na gbogbo; bẹ̃ni ki a máṣe jẹ ki agbo-agutan tabi ọwọ́-ẹran ki o jẹ niwaju òke na.
entries.en: And no man shall come up with thee, neither let any man be seen throughout all the mount; neither let the flocks nor herds feed before that mount.

entries.yo: On si gbẹ́ walã okuta meji bi ti iṣaju; Mose si dide ni kutukutu owurọ̀, o si gún òke Sinai, bi OLUWA ti paṣẹ fun u, o si mú walã okuta mejeji li ọwọ́ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he hewed two tables of stone like unto the first; and Moses rose up early in the morning, and went up unto mount Sinai, as the LORD had commanded him, and took in his hand the two tables of stone.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọkalẹ ninu awọsanma, o si bá a duro nibẹ̀, o si pè orukọ OLUWA.
entries.en: And the LORD descended in the cloud, and stood with him there, and proclaimed the name of the LORD.

entries.yo: OLUWA si rekọja niwaju rẹ̀, o si nkepè, OLUWA, OLUWA, Olọrun alãnu ati olore-ọfẹ, onipamọra, ati ẹniti o pọ̀ li ore ati otitọ;
entries.en: And the LORD passed by before him, and proclaimed, The LORD, The LORD God, merciful and gracious, longsuffering, and abundant in goodness and truth,

entries.yo: Ẹniti o npa ãnu mọ́ fun ẹgbẹgbẹrun, ti o ndari aiṣedede, ati irekọja, ati ẹ̀ṣẹ jì, ati nitõtọ ti ki ijẹ ki ẹlẹbi lọ laijiyà; a ma bẹ̀ ẹ̀ṣẹ awọn baba wò lara awọn omọ, ati lara awọn ọmọ ọmọ, lati irandiran ẹkẹta ati ẹkẹrin.
entries.en: Keeping mercy for thousands, forgiving iniquity and transgression and sin, and that will by no means clear the guilty; visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children, and upon the children's children, unto the third and to the fourth generation.

entries.yo: Mose si yara, o si foribalẹ, o si sìn.
entries.en: And Moses made haste, and bowed his head toward the earth, and worshipped.

entries.yo: On si wipe, Njẹ bi mo ba ri ore-ọfẹ li oju rẹ nisisiyi Oluwa, emi bẹ̀ ọ, jẹ ki Oluwa ki o ma bá wa lọ; nitori enia ọlọrùn lile ni; ki o si dari aiṣẹdede wa ati ẹ̀ṣẹ wa jì, ki o si fi wa ṣe iní rẹ.
entries.en: And he said, If now I have found grace in thy sight, O Lord, let my Lord, I pray thee, go among us; for it is a stiffnecked people; and pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us for thine inheritance.

entries.yo: On si wipe, Kiyesi i, emi dá majẹmu kan: emi o ṣe ohun iyanu, niwaju gbogbo awọn enia rẹ irú eyiti a kò ti iṣe lori ilẹ gbogbo rí, ati ninu gbogbo orilẹ-ède: ati gbogbo enia ninu awọn ti iwọ wà, nwọn o ri iṣẹ OLUWA, nitori ohun ẹ̀ru li emi o fi ọ ṣe.
entries.en: And he said, Behold, I make a covenant: before all thy people I will do marvels, such as have not been done in all the earth, nor in any nation: and all the people among which thou art shall see the work of the LORD: for it is a terrible thing that I will do with thee.

entries.yo: Iwọ kiyesi eyiti emi palaṣẹ fun ọ li oni yi: kiyesi i, emi lé awọn Amori jade niwaju rẹ, ati awọn ara Kenaani, ati awọn ara Hitti, ati awọn ara Perissi, ati awọn ara Hifi, ati awọn ara Jebusi.
entries.en: Observe thou that which I command thee this day: behold, I drive out before thee the Amorite, and the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite.

entries.yo: Ma ṣọ́ ara rẹ ki iwọ ki o má ba bá awọn ara ilẹ na dá majẹmu, nibikibi ti iwọ nlọ, ki o má ba di idẹwò fun ọ lãrin rẹ:
entries.en: Take heed to thyself, lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land whither thou goest, lest it be for a snare in the midst of thee:

entries.yo: Bikoṣepe ki ẹnyin ki o wó pẹpẹ wọn, ki ẹnyin ki o fọ́ ọwọ̀n wọn, ki ẹnyin si wó ere oriṣa wọn lulẹ.
entries.en: But ye shall destroy their altars, break their images, and cut down their groves:

entries.yo: Nitoriti ẹnyin kò gbọdọ bọ oriṣa: nitori OLUWA, orukọ ẹniti ijẹ Ojowu, Ọlọrun ojowú li on:
entries.en: For thou shalt worship no other god: for the LORD, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God:

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o má ba bá awọn ara ilẹ na dá majẹmu, nigbati nwọn ba nṣe àgbere tọ̀ oriṣa wọn, ti nwọn si nrubọ si oriṣa wọn, ti nwọn si pè ọ ti iwọ si lọ jẹ ninu ẹbọ wọn;
entries.en: Lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, and they go a whoring after their gods , and do sacrifice unto their gods, and one call thee, and thou eat of his sacrifice;

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o má si ṣe fẹ́ ninu awọn ọmọbinrin wọn fun awọn ọmokọnrin rẹ, ki awọn ọmọbinrin wọn ki o má ba ṣe àgbere tọ̀ oriṣa wọn, ki nwọn ki o má ba mu ki awọn ọmọkunrin rẹ ki o ṣe àgbere tọ̀ oriṣa wọn.
entries.en: And thou take of their daughters unto thy sons, and their daughters go a whoring after their gods, and make thy sons go a whoring after their gods.

entries.yo: Iwọ kò gbọdọ dà ere oriṣakoriṣa kan fun ara rẹ.
entries.en: Thou shalt make thee no molten gods.

entries.yo: Ajọ aiwukàra ni ki iwọ ki o ma pamọ́. Ijọ́ meje ni iwọ o jẹ àkara alaiwu, bi mo ti paṣẹ fun ọ, ni ìgba oṣù Abibu: nitoripe li oṣù Abibu ni iwọ jade kuro ni Egipti.
entries.en: The feast of unleavened bread shalt thou keep. Seven days thou shalt eat unleavened bread, as I commanded thee, in the time of the month Abib: for in the month Abib thou camest out from Egypt.

entries.yo: Gbogbo akọ́bi ni ti emi; ati akọ ninu gbogbo ohunọ̀sin rẹ; akọ́bi ti malu, ati ti agutan.
entries.en: All that openeth the matrix is mine; and every firstling among thy cattle, whether ox or sheep, that is male.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn akọ́bi kẹtẹkẹtẹ ni ki iwọ ki o fi ọdọ-agutan rapada: bi iwọ kò ba si rà a pada, njẹ ki iwọ ki o ṣẹ́ ẹ li ọrùn. Gbogbo akọ́bi ninu awọn ọmọkunrin rẹ ni ki iwọ ki o rapada. Kò si sí ẹnikan ti yio farahàn niwaju mi lọwọ ofo.
entries.en: But the firstling of an ass thou shalt redeem with a lamb: and if thou redeem him not, then shalt thou break his neck. All the firstborn of thy sons thou shalt redeem. And none shall appear before me empty.

entries.yo: Ijọ́ mẹfa ni ki iwọ ki o ṣe iṣẹ́, ṣugbọn ni ijọ́ keje ni ki iwọ ki o simi: ni ìgba ifunrugbìn, ati ni ìgba ikore ni ki iwọ ki o simi.
entries.en: Six days thou shalt work, but on the seventh day thou shalt rest: in earing time and in harvest thou shalt rest.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si ma kiyesi ajọ ọ̀sẹ, akọ́so eso alikama, ati ajọ ikore li opin ọdún.
entries.en: And thou shalt observe the feast of weeks, of the firstfruits of wheat harvest, and the feast of ingathering at the year's end.

entries.yo: Li ẹrinmẹta li ọdún kan ni gbogbo awọn ọmọkunrin rẹ yio farahàn niwaju Oluwa, ỌLỌRUN, Ọlọrun Israeli.
entries.en: Thrice in the year shall all your men children appear before the Lord GOD, the God of Israel.

entries.yo: Nitoriti emi o lé awọn orilẹ-ède nì jade niwaju rẹ, emi o si fẹ̀ ipinlẹ rẹ: bẹ̃li ẹnikẹni ki yio fẹ́ ilẹ̀-iní rẹ, nigbati iwọ o gòke lọ lati pejọ niwaju OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ li ẹrinmẹta li ọdún kan.
entries.en: For I will cast out the nations before thee, and enlarge thy borders: neither shall any man desire thy land, when thou shalt go up to appear before the LORD thy God thrice in the year.

entries.yo: Iwọ kò gbọdọ ta ẹ̀jẹ ẹbọ mi silẹ nibiti iwukàra wà, bẹ̃li ẹbọ ajọ irekọja kò gbọdọ kù titi di owurọ̀.
entries.en: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leaven; neither shall the sacrifice of the feast of the passover be left unto the morning.

entries.yo: Akọ́so eso ilẹ rẹ ni ki iwọ ki o mú wa si ile OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ. Iwọ kò gbọdọ bọ̀ ọmọ ewurẹ ninu warà iya rẹ̀.
entries.en: The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring unto the house of the LORD thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother's milk.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun Mose pe, Iwọ kọwe ọ̀rọ wọnyi: nitori nipa ìmọ ọ̀rọ wọnyi li emi bá iwọ ati Israeli dá majẹmu.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Write thou these words: for after the tenor of these words I have made a covenant with thee and with Israel.

entries.yo: On si wà nibẹ̀, lọdọ OLUWA li ogoji ọsán ati ogoji oru: on kò jẹ onjẹ, bẹ̃ni kò mu omi. On si kọwe ọ̀rọ majẹmu na, ofin mẹwa nì, sara walã wọnni.
entries.en: And he was there with the LORD forty days and forty nights; he did neither eat bread, nor drink water. And he wrote upon the tables the words of the covenant, the ten commandments.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati Mose sọkalẹ lati ori òke Sinai wá ti on ti walã ẹrí mejeji nì li ọwọ́ Mose, nigbati o sọkalẹ ti ori òke na wá, ti Mose kò mọ̀ pe awọ oju on ndán nitoriti o bá a sọ̀rọ.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when Moses came down from mount Sinai with the two tables of testimony in Moses' hand, when he came down from the mount, that Moses wist not that the skin of his face shone while he talked with him.

entries.yo: Nigbati Aaroni ati gbogbo awọn ọmọ Israeli ri Mose, kiyesi i, awọ oju rẹ̀ ndán; nwọn si bẹ̀ru lati sunmọ ọdọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And when Aaron and all the children of Israel saw Moses, behold, the skin of his face shone; and they were afraid to come nigh him.

entries.yo: Mose si kọ si wọn; ati Aaroni ati gbogbo awọn ijoye inu ajọ si pada tọ̀ ọ́ wá: Mose si bá wọn sọ̀rọ.
entries.en: And Moses called unto them; and Aaron and all the rulers of the congregation returned unto him: and Moses talked with them.

entries.yo: Lẹhin eyinì ni gbogbo awọn ọmọ Israeli si sunmọ ọ: o si paṣẹ gbogbo ohun ti OLUWA bá a sọ lori òke Sinai fun wọn.
entries.en: And afterward all the children of Israel came nigh: and he gave them in commandment all that the LORD had spoken with him in mount Sinai.

entries.yo: Nigbati Mose si bá wọn sọ̀rọ tán, o fi iboju bò oju rẹ̀.
entries.en: And till Moses had done speaking with them, he put a vail on his face.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati Mose ba lọ si iwaju OLUWA lati bá a sọ̀rọ, a mú iboju na kuro titi o fi jade: a si jade, a si bá awọn ọmọ Israeli sọ̀rọ aṣẹ ti a pa fun u.
entries.en: But when Moses went in before the LORD to speak with him, he took the vail off, until he came out. And he came out, and spake unto the children of Israel that which he was commanded.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Israeli si ri oju Mose pe, awọ, oju rẹ̀ ndán: Mose si tun fi iboju bò oju rẹ̀, titi o fi wọle lọ bá a sọ̀rọ.
entries.en: And the children of Israel saw the face of Moses, that the skin of Moses' face shone: and Moses put the vail upon his face again, until he went in to speak with him.

entries.yo: MOSE si pè apejọ gbogbo ijọ awọn ọmọ Israeli, o si wi fun wọn pe, Wọnyi li ọ̀rọ ti OLUWA palaṣẹ pe, ki ẹnyin ki o ṣe wọn.
entries.en: And Moses gathered all the congregation of the children of Israel together, and said unto them, These are the words which the LORD hath commanded, that ye should do them.

entries.yo: Ijọ́ mẹfa ni ki a fi ṣe iṣẹ, ṣugbọn ijọ́ keje ni yio ṣe ọjọ́ mimọ́ fun nyin, ọjọ́ isimi ọ̀wọ si OLUWA: ẹnikẹni ti o ba ṣe iṣẹ ninu rẹ̀ li a o lupa nitõtọ.
entries.en: Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day there shall be to you an holy day, a sabbath of rest to the LORD: whosoever doeth work therein shall be put to death.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin kò gbọdọ da iná ni ile nyin gbogbo li ọjọ́ isimi.
entries.en: Ye shall kindle no fire throughout your habitations upon the sabbath day.

entries.yo: Mose si sọ fun gbogbo ijọ awọn ọmọ Israeli pe, Eyi li ohun ti OLUWA palaṣẹ, wipe,
entries.en: And Moses spake unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, This is the thing which the LORD commanded, saying,

entries.yo: Ẹnyin mú ọrẹ wá lati inu ara nyin fun OLUWA: ẹnikẹni ti ọkàn rẹ̀ fẹ́, ki o mú u wá, li ọrẹ fun OLUWA; wurà, ati fadakà, ati idẹ;
entries.en: Take ye from among you an offering unto the LORD: whosoever is of a willing heart, let him bring it, an offering of the LORD; gold, and silver, and brass,

entries.yo: Ati aṣọ-alaró, ati elesè-àluko, ati ododó, ati ọ̀gbọ didara, ati irun ewurẹ;
entries.en: And blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats' hair,

entries.yo: Ati awọ àgbo ti a sè ni pupa, ati awọ seali, ati igi ṣittimu;
entries.en: And rams' skins dyed red, and badgers' skins, and shittim wood,

entries.yo: Ati oróro fun fitila, ati olõrùn fun oróro itasori, ati fun turari didùn;
entries.en: And oil for the light, and spices for anointing oil, and for the sweet incense,

entries.yo: Ati okuta oniki, ati okuta ti a o tò si ẹ̀wu-efodi, ati si igbàiya.
entries.en: And onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod, and for the breastplate.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ọlọgbọ́n inú ninu nyin yio si wá, yio si wá ṣiṣẹ gbogbo ohun ti OLUWA palaṣẹ;
entries.en: And every wise hearted among you shall come, and make all that the LORD hath commanded;

entries.yo: Ibugbé na, ti on ti agọ́ rẹ̀, ati ibori rẹ̀, kọkọrọ rẹ̀, ati apáko rẹ̀, ọpá rẹ̀, ọwọ̀n rẹ̀, ati ihò-ìtẹbọ rẹ̀;
entries.en: The tabernacle, his tent, and his covering, his taches, and his boards, his bars, his pillars, and his sockets,

entries.yo: Apoti nì, ati ọpá rẹ̀, itẹ́-ãnu nì, ati aṣọ-ikele na;
entries.en: The ark, and the staves thereof, with the mercy seat, and the vail of the covering,

entries.yo: Tabili na, ati ọpá rẹ̀, ati ohun-èlo rẹ̀ gbogbo, ati àkara ifihàn nì;
entries.en: The table, and his staves, and all his vessels, and the shewbread,

entries.yo: Ati ọpà-fitila na fun titanna, ati ohun-elo rẹ̀, ati fitila rẹ̀, pẹlu oróro fun titanna.
entries.en: The candlestick also for the light, and his furniture, and his lamps, with the oil for the light,

entries.yo: Ati pẹpẹ turari, ati ọpá rẹ̀, ati oróro itasori, ati turari didùn, ati aṣọ-sisorọ̀ fun ẹnu-ọ̀na, ani atiwọle ẹnu agọ́ na;
entries.en: And the incense altar, and his staves, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the hanging for the door at the entering in of the tabernacle,

entries.yo: Ati pẹpẹ ẹbọsisun, ti on ti àwọn oju-àro idẹ rẹ̀, ati ọpá rẹ̀, ati gbogbo ohun-èlo rẹ̀, agbada na ti on ti ẹsẹ rẹ̀;
entries.en: The altar of burnt offering, with his brasen grate, his staves, and all his vessels, the laver and his foot,

entries.yo: Aṣọ-isorọ̀ ti agbalá, ọwọ̀n rẹ̀, ati ihò-ìtẹbọ rẹ̀, ati aṣọ-isorọ̀ fun ẹnu-ọ̀na agbalá na;
entries.en: The hangings of the court, his pillars, and their sockets, and the hanging for the door of the court,

entries.yo: Ekàn agọ́ na, ati ekàn agbalá na, ati okùn wọn;
entries.en: The pins of the tabernacle, and the pins of the court, and their cords,

entries.yo: Aṣọ ìsin wọnni, lati sìn ni ibi mimọ́, aṣọ mimọ́ wọnni fun Aaroni alufa, ati aṣọ awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, lati ma fi ṣe iṣẹ alufa.
entries.en: The cloths of service, to do service in the holy place, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest's office.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ijọ awọn ọmọ Israeli si lọ kuro ni iwaju Mose.
entries.en: And all the congregation of the children of Israel departed from the presence of Moses.

entries.yo: Nwọn si wá, olukuluku ẹniti ọkàn rẹ́ ru ninu rẹ̀, ati olukuluku ẹniti ọkàn rẹ̀ mu u fẹ́, nwọn si mú ọrẹ OLUWA wá fun iṣẹ agọ́ ajọ na, ati fun ìsin rẹ̀ gbogbo, ati fun aṣọ mimọ́ wọnni.
entries.en: And they came, every one whose heart stirred him up, and every one whom his spirit made willing, and they brought the LORD's offering to the work of the tabernacle of the congregation, and for all his service, and for the holy garments.

entries.yo: Nwọn si wá, ati ọkunrin ati obinrin, iye awọn ti ọkàn wọn fẹ́, nwọn si mú jufù wá, ati oruka-eti, ati oruka-àmi, ati ilẹkẹ wurà, ati onirũru ohun ọṣọ́ wurà; ati olukuluku enia ti o nta ọrẹ, o ta ọrẹ wurà fun OLUWA.
entries.en: And they came, both men and women, as many as were willing hearted, and brought bracelets, and earrings, and rings, and tablets, all jewels of gold: and every man that offered offered an offering of gold unto the LORD.

entries.yo: Ati olukuluku enia lọdọ ẹniti a ri aṣọ-alaró, ati elesè àluko, ati ododó, ati ọ̀gbọ daradara, ati irun ewurẹ, ati awọ àgbo pupa, ati awọ seali, mú wọn wá.
entries.en: And every man, with whom was found blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats' hair, and red skins of rams, and badgers' skins, brought them.

entries.yo: Olukuluku ẹniti o ta ọrẹ fadakà ati idẹ, o mú ọrẹ OLUWA wá: ati olukuluku enia lati ọdọ ẹniti a ri igi ṣittimu fun iṣẹkiṣẹ ìsin na, mú u wá.
entries.en: Every one that did offer an offering of silver and brass brought the LORD's offering: and every man, with whom was found shittim wood for any work of the service, brought it.

entries.yo: Ati gbogbo awọn obinrin ti iṣe ọlọgbọ́n inu, nwọn fi ọwọ́ wọn ranwu, nwọn si mú eyiti nwọn ran wá, ti alaró, ati ti elesè-àluko, ati ti ododó, ati ti ọ̀gbọ daradara.
entries.en: And all the women that were wise hearted did spin with their hands, and brought that which they had spun, both of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, and of fine linen.

entries.yo: Ati gbogbo awọn obinrin inu ẹniti o ru soke li ọgbọ́n nwọn ran irun ewurẹ.
entries.en: And all the women whose heart stirred them up in wisdom spun goats' hair.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ijoye mú okuta oniki wá, ati okuta ti a o tò, fun ẹ̀wu-efodi nì, ati fun igbàiya nì;
entries.en: And the rulers brought onyx stones, and stones to be set, for the ephod, and for the breastplate;

entries.yo: Ati olõrùn, ati oróro; fun fitila, ati fun oróro itasori, ati fun turari didùn.
entries.en: And spice, and oil for the light, and for the anointing oil, and for the sweet incense.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Israeli ta ọrẹ atinuwa fun OLUWA; olukuluku ọkunrin ati obinrin, ẹniti ọkàn wọn mu wọn fẹ́ lati mú u wá fun onirũru iṣẹ, ti OLUWA palaṣẹ ni ṣiṣe lati ọwọ́ Mose wá,
entries.en: The children of Israel brought a willing offering unto the LORD, every man and woman, whose heart made them willing to bring for all manner of work, which the LORD had commanded to be made by the hand of Moses.

entries.yo: Mose si wi fun awọn ọmọ Israeli pe, Wò o, OLUWA ti pè Besaleli ọmọ Uri, ọmọ Huri, ti ẹ̀ya Judah, li orukọ.
entries.en: And Moses said unto the children of Israel, See, the LORD hath called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah;

entries.yo: O si fi ẹmi Ọlọrun kún u li ọgbọ́n, li oyé, ni ìmọ, ati li onirũru iṣẹ-ọnà;
entries.en: And he hath filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship;

entries.yo: Ati lati humọ̀ alarabara iṣẹ, lati ṣiṣẹ ni wurà, ati ni fadakà, ati ni idẹ,
entries.en: And to devise curious works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,

entries.yo: Ati li okuta gbigbẹ́ lati tò wọn, ati ni igi fifin, lati ṣiṣẹ li onirũru iṣẹ-ọnà.
entries.en: And in the cutting of stones, to set them, and in carving of wood, to make any manner of cunning work.

entries.yo: O si fi sinu ọkàn rẹ̀ lati ma kọni, ati on, ati Oholiabu, ọmọ Ahisamaki, ti ẹ̀ya Dani.
entries.en: And he hath put in his heart that he may teach, both he, and Aholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.

entries.yo: O si fi ọgbọ́n inu kún wọn, lati ṣe onirũru iṣẹ, ti alagbẹdẹ, ati ti ọnà, ati ti agunnà, li aṣọ-alaró, ati li elesè-àluko, li ododó, ati li ọ̀gbọ daradara, ati ti ahunṣọ, ati ti awọn ẹniti nṣe iṣẹkiṣẹ ati ti awọn ẹniti nhumọ̀ iṣẹ-ọnà.
entries.en: Them hath he filled with wisdom of heart, to work all manner of work, of the engraver, and of the cunning workman, and of the embroiderer, in blue, and in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen, and of the weaver, even of them that do any work, and of those that devise cunning work.

entries.yo: BESALELI ati Oholiabu yio si ṣiṣẹ, ati olukuluku ọlọgbọ́n inu, ninu ẹniti OLUWA fi ọgbọn ati oyé si, lati mọ̀ bi a ti ṣiṣẹ onirũru iṣẹ ìsin ibi mimọ́ na, gẹgẹ bi gbogbo ohun ti OLUWA ti palaṣẹ.
entries.en: Then wrought Bezaleel and Aholiab, and every wise hearted man, in whom the LORD put wisdom and understanding to know how to work all manner of work for the service of the sanctuary, according to all that the LORD had commanded.

entries.yo: Mose si pè Besaleli ati Oholiabu, ati gbogbo ọkunrin ọlọgbọ́n inu, ninu ọkàn ẹniti OLUWA fi ọgbọ́n si, ani gbogbo ẹniti inu wọn ru soke lati wá si ibi iṣẹ na lati ṣe e:
entries.en: And Moses called Bezaleel and Aholiab, and every wise hearted man, in whose heart the LORD had put wisdom, even every one whose heart stirred him up to come unto the work to do it:

entries.yo: Nwọn si gbà gbogbo ọrẹ na lọwọ Mose, ti awọn ọmọ Israeli múwa fun iṣẹ ìsin ibi mimọ́ na, lati fi ṣe e. Sibẹ̀ nwọn si nmú ọrẹ ọfẹ fun u wá li orowurọ̀.
entries.en: And they received of Moses all the offering, which the children of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary, to make it withal. And they brought yet unto him free offerings every morning.

entries.yo: Ati gbogbo awọn ọkunrin ọlọgbọ́n, ti o ṣe gbogbo isẹ ibi mimọ́ na, lọ olukuluku kuro ni ibi iṣẹ rẹ̀ ti nwọn ṣe;
entries.en: And all the wise men, that wrought all the work of the sanctuary, came every man from his work which they made;

entries.yo: Nwọn si sọ fun Mose pe, Awọn enia múwa pupọ̀ju fun iṣẹ ìsin na, ti OLUWA palaṣẹ ni ṣiṣe.
entries.en: And they spake unto Moses, saying, The people bring much more than enough for the service of the work, which the LORD commanded to make.

entries.yo: Mose si paṣẹ, nwọn si ṣe ki nwọn ki o kede yi gbogbo ibudó na ká, wipe, Máṣe jẹ ki ọkunrin tabi obinrin ki o tun ṣe iṣẹkiṣẹ fun ọrẹ ibi mimọ́ na mọ́. Bẹ̃li a da awọn enia lẹkun ati ma múwa.
entries.en: And Moses gave commandment, and they caused it to be proclaimed throughout the camp, saying, Let neither man nor woman make any more work for the offering of the sanctuary. So the people were restrained from bringing.

entries.yo: Nitoriti ohun-èlo ti nwọn ni o to fun gbogbo iṣẹ na, lati fi ṣe e, o si pọ̀ju.
entries.en: For the stuff they had was sufficient for all the work to make it, and too much.

entries.yo: Ati olukuluku ọkunrin ọlọgbọ́n ninu awọn ti o ṣe iṣẹ agọ́ na, nwọn ṣiṣẹ aṣọ-tita mẹwa; ti ọ̀gbọ olokùn wiwẹ, ati ti aṣọ-alaró, ati ti elesè-àluko, ati ti ododó, pẹlu awọn kerubu, iṣẹ-ọnà li on fi ṣe wọn.
entries.en: And every wise hearted man among them that wrought the work of the tabernacle made ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet: with cherubims of cunning work made he them.

entries.yo: Ina aṣọ-tita kan jẹ́ igbọnwọ mejidilọgbọ̀n, ati ibò aṣọ-tita kan jẹ́ igbọnwọ mẹrin: gbogbo aṣọ-tita na jẹ́ ìwọn kanna.
entries.en: The length of one curtain was twenty and eight cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: the curtains were all of one size.

entries.yo: O si so aṣọ-tita marun lù mọ́ ara wọn: ati aṣọ-tita marun keji li o si solù mọ́ ara wọn.
entries.en: And he coupled the five curtains one unto another: and the other five curtains he coupled one unto another.

entries.yo: O si pa ojóbo aṣọ-alaró li eti aṣọ-tita kan lati iṣẹti rẹ̀ wá ni ibi isolù; bẹ̃ gẹgẹ li o ṣe si ìha eti ikangun aṣọ-tita keji nibi isolù keji.
entries.en: And he made loops of blue on the edge of one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling: likewise he made in the uttermost side of another curtain, in the coupling of the second.

entries.yo: Ãdọta ojóbo li o pa lara aṣọ-tita kan, ati ãdọta ojóbo li o si pa li eti aṣọ-tita ti o wà ni isolù keji: ojóbo na so aṣọ-tita kini mọ́ keji.
entries.en: Fifty loops made he in one curtain, and fifty loops made he in the edge of the curtain which was in the coupling of the second: the loops held one curtain to another.

entries.yo: O si ṣe ãdọta ikọ́ wurà, o si fi ikọ́ wọnni fi aṣọ-tita kan kọ́ ekeji: bẹ̃li o si di odidi agọ́.
entries.en: And he made fifty taches of gold, and coupled the curtains one unto another with the taches: so it became one tabernacle.

entries.yo: O si ṣe aṣọ-tita irun ewurẹ fun agọ́ na lori ibugbé na: aṣọ-tita mọkanla li o ṣe wọn.
entries.en: And he made curtains of goats' hair for the tent over the tabernacle: eleven curtains he made them.

entries.yo: Ìna aṣọ-tita kan jẹ́ ọgbọ̀n igbọnwọ, ibò aṣọ-tita kan si jẹ́ igbọnwọ mẹrin: aṣọ-tita mọkọkanla jẹ́ ìwọn kanna.
entries.en: The length of one curtain was thirty cubits, and four cubits was the breadth of one curtain: the eleven curtains were of one size.

entries.yo: O si so aṣọ-tita marun lù mọ́ ara wọn, ati aṣọ-tita mẹfa lù mọ́ ara wọn.
entries.en: And he coupled five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves.

entries.yo: O si pa ãdọta ojóbo si ìha eti ikangun aṣọ-tita na ni ibi isolù, ati ãdọta ojóbo li o si pa si eti aṣọ-tita ti o so ekeji lù.
entries.en: And he made fifty loops upon the uttermost edge of the curtain in the coupling, and fifty loops made he upon the edge of the curtain which coupleth the second.

entries.yo: O si ṣe ãdọta ikọ́ idẹ lati so agọ́ na lù pọ̀, ki o le ṣe ọkan.
entries.en: And he made fifty taches of brass to couple the tent together, that it might be one.

entries.yo: O si ṣe ibori awọ àgbo ti a sè ni pupa fun agọ́ na, ati ibori awọ seali lori eyi.
entries.en: And he made a covering for the tent of rams' skins dyed red, and a covering of badgers' skins above that.

entries.yo: O si ṣe apáko igi ṣittimu fun agọ́ na li ogurodo.
entries.en: And he made boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood, standing up.

entries.yo: Gigùn apáko kan jẹ́ igbọnwọ mẹwa, ati ibú apáko kan jẹ́ igbọnwọ kan on àbọ.
entries.en: The length of a board was ten cubits, and the breadth of a board one cubit and a half.

entries.yo: Apáko kan ni ìtẹbọ meji, nwọn jìna si ara wọn li ọgbọgba; bẹ̃li o ṣe sara gbogbo apáko agọ́ na.
entries.en: One board had two tenons, equally distant one from another: thus did he make for all the boards of the tabernacle.

entries.yo: O si fi apáko ṣe agọ́ na; ogún apáko ni fun ìha ọtún, si ìha gusù:
entries.en: And he made boards for the tabernacle; twenty boards for the south side southward:

entries.yo: Ati ogoji ihò-ìtẹbọ fadakà li o ṣe nisalẹ ogún apáko wọnni; ihò-ìtẹbọ meji nisalẹ apáko kan fun ìtẹbọ rẹ̀ meji, ati ihò-ìtẹbọ rẹ̀ meji nisalẹ apáko keji fun ìtẹbọ rẹ̀ meji.
entries.en: And forty sockets of silver he made under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for his two tenons, and two sockets under another board for his two tenons.

entries.yo: Ati fun ìha keji agọ́ na, ti o wà ni ìha ariwa, o ṣe ogún apáko,
entries.en: And for the other side of the tabernacle, which is toward the north corner, he made twenty boards,

entries.yo: Ati ogoji ihò-ìtẹbọ wọn ti fadakà; ihò-ìtẹbọ meji nisalẹ apáko kan, ati ihò-ìtẹbọ meji nisalẹ apáko keji.
entries.en: And their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

entries.yo: Ati fun ìha agọ́ na ni ìha ìwọ-õrùn o ṣe apáko mẹfa.
entries.en: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward he made six boards.

entries.yo: Apáko meji li o ṣe fun igun agọ́ na ni ìha mejeji.
entries.en: And two boards made he for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides.

entries.yo: A si so wọn lù nisalẹ, a si so wọn lù pọ̀ li ori rẹ̀, si oruka kan: bẹ̃li o ṣe si awọn meji ni igun mejeji.
entries.en: And they were coupled beneath, and coupled together at the head thereof, to one ring: thus he did to both of them in both the corners.

entries.yo: Apáko mẹjọ li o wà, ihò-ìtẹbọ wọn si jẹ́ ihò-ìtẹbọ mẹrindilogun ti fadakà; ìtẹbọ mejimeji li o wà nisalẹ apáko kọkan.
entries.en: And there were eight boards; and their sockets were sixteen sockets of silver, under every board two sockets.

entries.yo: O si ṣe ọpá igi ṣittimu; marun fun apáko ìha kan agọ́ na,
entries.en: And he made bars of shittim wood; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,

entries.yo: Ati ọpá marun fun apáko ìha keji agọ́ na, ati ọpá marun fun apáko agọ́ na fun ìha ìwọ-õrùn.
entries.en: And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the sides westward.

entries.yo: O si ṣe ọpá ãrin o yọ jade lara apáko wọnni, lati opin ekini dé ekeji.
entries.en: And he made the middle bar to shoot through the boards from the one end to the other.

entries.yo: O si fi wurà bò apáko wọnni, o si fi wurà ṣe oruka wọn, lati ṣe ipò fun ọpá wọnni, o si fi wurà bò ọpá wọnni.
entries.en: And he overlaid the boards with gold, and made their rings of gold to be places for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.

entries.yo: O si fi aṣọ-alaró, ati ti elesè-àluko, ati ti ododó, ati ti ọ̀gbọ olokùn wiwẹ ṣe aṣọ-ikele: iṣẹ ọlọnà li o fi ṣe e ti on ti awọn kerubu.
entries.en: And he made a vail of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen: with cherubims made he it of cunning work.

entries.yo: O si ṣe opó igi ṣittimu mẹrin si i, o si fi wurà bò wọn: kọkọrọ wọn ti wurà ni, o si dà ihò-ìtẹbọ fadakà mẹrin fun wọn.
entries.en: And he made thereunto four pillars of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold: their hooks were of gold; and he cast for them four sockets of silver.

entries.yo: O si ṣe aṣọ-isorọ̀ kan fun ẹnu-ọ̀na Agọ́ na, aṣọ-alaró, ati elesè-àluko, ati ododó, ati ọ̀gbọ olokùn wiwẹ, ti iṣẹ abẹ́rẹ;
entries.en: And he made an hanging for the tabernacle door of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, of needlework;

entries.yo: Ati opó rẹ̀ mararun ti on ti kọkọrọ wọn: o si fi wurà bò ọnà ori wọn, ati ọjá wọn: ṣugbọn idẹ ni ihò-ìtẹbọ wọn mararun.
entries.en: And the five pillars of it with their hooks: and he overlaid their chapiters and their fillets with gold: but their five sockets were of brass.

entries.yo: BESALELI si fi igi ṣittimu ṣe apoti na: igbọnwọ meji on àbọ ni gigùn rẹ̀, ati igbọnwọ kan on àbọ ni ibú rẹ̀, igbọnwọ kan on àbọ si ni giga rẹ̀:
entries.en: And Bezaleel made the ark of shittim wood: two cubits and a half was the length of it, and a cubit and a half the breadth of it, and a cubit and a half the height of it:

entries.yo: O si fi kìki wurà bò o ninu ati lode, o si ṣe igbáti wurà si i yiká.
entries.en: And he overlaid it with pure gold within and without, and made a crown of gold to it round about.

entries.yo: O si dà oruka wurà mẹrin fun u, lati fi si igun mẹrẹrin rẹ̀; oruka meji si ìha kini rẹ̀, ati meji si ìha keji rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he cast for it four rings of gold, to be set by the four corners of it; even two rings upon the one side of it, and two rings upon the other side of it.

entries.yo: O si fi igi ṣittimu ṣe ọpá, o si fi wurà bò wọn.
entries.en: And he made staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold.

entries.yo: O si fi ọpá wọnni bọ̀ inu oruka wọnni ni ìha apoti na, lati ma rù apoti na
entries.en: And he put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark, to bear the ark.

entries.yo: O si fi kìki wurà ṣe itẹ́-ãnu na: igbọnwọ meji on àbọ ni gigùn rẹ̀, ati igbọnwọ kan on àbọ ni ibú rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he made the mercy seat of pure gold: two cubits and a half was the length thereof, and one cubit and a half the breadth thereof.

entries.yo: O si ṣe kerubu wurà meji; iṣẹ lilù li o ṣe wọn, ni ìku mejeji itẹ́-ãnu na;
entries.en: And he made two cherubims of gold, beaten out of one piece made he them, on the two ends of the mercy seat;

entries.yo: Kerubu kan ni ìku kini, ati kerubu keji ni ìku keji: lati ara itẹ́-ãnu li o ti ṣe awọn kerubu na ni ìku mejeji rẹ̀.
entries.en: One cherub on the end on this side, and another cherub on the other end on that side: out of the mercy seat made he the cherubims on the two ends thereof.

entries.yo: Awọn kerubu na si nà iyẹ́-apa wọn soke, nwọn si fi iyẹ́-apa wọn bò itẹ́-ãnu na, nwọn si dojukọ ara wọn; itẹ́-ãnu na ni awọn kerubu kọjusi.
entries.en: And the cherubims spread out their wings on high, and covered with their wings over the mercy seat, with their faces one to another; even to the mercy seatward were the faces of the cherubims.

entries.yo: O si fi igi ṣittimu ṣe tabili kan: igbọnwọ meji ni gigùn rẹ̀, ati igbọnwọ kan ni ibú rẹ̀, igbọnwọ kan on àbọ si ni giga rẹ̀:
entries.en: And he made the table of shittim wood: two cubits was the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof:

entries.yo: O si fi kìki wurà bò o, o si ṣe igbáti wurà si i yiká.
entries.en: And he overlaid it with pure gold, and made thereunto a crown of gold round about.

entries.yo: O si ṣe eti kan bi ibú-atẹlẹwọ si i yiká, o si ṣe igbáti wurà kan fun eti rẹ̀ yiká.
entries.en: Also he made thereunto a border of an handbreadth round about; and made a crown of gold for the border thereof round about.

entries.yo: O si dà oruka wurà mẹrin fun u, o si fi oruka wọnni si igun mẹrẹrin, ti o wà ni ibi ẹsẹ̀ mẹrẹrin rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he cast for it four rings of gold, and put the rings upon the four corners that were in the four feet thereof.
