entries.yo: Labẹ igbáti na ni oruka wọnni wà, àye fun ọpá lati fi rù tabili na.
entries.en: Over against the border were the rings, the places for the staves to bear the table.

entries.yo: O si fi igi ṣittimu ṣe ọpá wọnni, o si fi wurà bò wọn, lati ma rù tabili na.
entries.en: And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold, to bear the table.

entries.yo: O si ṣe ohunèlo wọnni ti o wà lori tabili na, awopọkọ rẹ̀, ati ṣibi rẹ̀, ati awokòto rẹ̀, ati ìgo rẹ̀, lati ma fi dà ohun mimu, kìki wurà ni.
entries.en: And he made the vessels which were upon the table, his dishes, and his spoons, and his bowls, and his covers to cover withal, of pure gold.

entries.yo: O si fi kìki wurà, ṣe ọpá-fitila: iṣẹ lilù li o ṣe ọpá-fitila na; ọpá rẹ̀, ati ẹka rẹ̀, ago rẹ̀, irudi rẹ̀, ati itanna rẹ̀, ọkanna ni nwọn:
entries.en: And he made the candlestick of pure gold: of beaten work made he the candlestick; his shaft, and his branch, his bowls, his knops, and his flowers, were of the same:

entries.yo: Ẹka mẹfa li o jade ni ìha rẹ̀; ẹka mẹta ọpá-fitila na ni ìha kan rẹ̀, ati ẹka mẹta ọpá-fitila na, ni ìha keji rẹ̀.
entries.en: And six branches going out of the sides thereof; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side thereof, and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side thereof:

entries.yo: Ago mẹta ti a ṣe bi itanna almondi li ẹka kan, irudi kan ati itanna; ati ago mẹta ti a ṣe bi itanna almondi li ẹka keji, irudi kan ati itanna: bẹ̃ni li ẹka mẹfẹfa ti o jade lara ọpá-fitila na.
entries.en: Three bowls made after the fashion of almonds in one branch, a knop and a flower; and three bowls made like almonds in another branch, a knop and a flower: so throughout the six branches going out of the candlestick.

entries.yo: Ati ninu ọpá-fitila na li a ṣe ago mẹrin bi itanna almondi, irudi rẹ̀, ati itanna rẹ̀:
entries.en: And in the candlestick were four bowls made like almonds, his knops, and his flowers:

entries.yo: Ati irudi kan nisalẹ ẹka meji lara rẹ̀, ati irudi kan nisalẹ ẹka meji lara rẹ̀, ati irudi kan nisalẹ ẹka meji lara rẹ̀, gẹgẹ bi ẹka mẹfẹfa ti o jade lara rẹ̀.
entries.en: And a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, according to the six branches going out of it.

entries.yo: Irudi wọn ati ẹka wọn jẹ bakanna: gbogbo rẹ̀ jẹ́ iṣẹ lilù kìki wurà kan.
entries.en: Their knops and their branches were of the same: all of it was one beaten work of pure gold.

entries.yo: O si ṣe fitila rẹ̀, meje, ati alumagaji rẹ̀, ati awo rẹ̀, kìki wurà ni.
entries.en: And he made his seven lamps, and his snuffers, and his snuffdishes, of pure gold.

entries.yo: Talenti kan kìki wurà li o fi ṣe e, ati gbogbo ohunèlo rẹ̀.
entries.en: Of a talent of pure gold made he it, and all the vessels thereof.

entries.yo: O si fi igi ṣittimu ṣe pẹpẹ turari: gigùn rẹ̀ jẹ́ igbọnwọ kan, ibú rẹ̀ si jẹ́ igbọnwọ kan, ìha mẹrin ọgbọgba; giga rẹ̀ si jẹ́ igbọnwọ meji; iwo rẹ̀ wà lara rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he made the incense altar of shittim wood: the length of it was a cubit, and the breadth of it a cubit; it was foursquare; and two cubits was the height of it; the horns thereof were of the same.

entries.yo: O si fi kìki wurà bò o, ati òke rẹ̀, ati ìha rẹ̀ yiká, ati iwo rẹ̀: o si ṣe igbáti wurà si i yiká.
entries.en: And he overlaid it with pure gold, both the top of it, and the sides thereof round about, and the horns of it: also he made unto it a crown of gold round about.

entries.yo: O si ṣe oruka wurà meji si i nisalẹ̀ igbáti rẹ̀ na, ni ìha igun rẹ̀ meji, ìha mejeji rẹ̀, lati ṣe àye fun ọpá wọnni lati ma fi rù u.
entries.en: And he made two rings of gold for it under the crown thereof, by the two corners of it, upon the two sides thereof, to be places for the staves to bear it withal.

entries.yo: O si fi igi ṣittimu ṣe ọpá wọnni, o si fi wurà bò wọn.
entries.en: And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold.

entries.yo: O si ṣe oróro mimọ́ itasori nì, ati õrùn didùn kìki turari, gẹgẹ bi iṣẹ alapòlu.
entries.en: And he made the holy anointing oil, and the pure incense of sweet spices, according to the work of the apothecary.

entries.yo: O SI fi igi ṣittimu ṣe pẹpẹ ẹbọsisun: igbọnwọ marun ni gigùn rẹ̀, ati igbọnwọ marun ni ibú rẹ̀; onìha mẹrin ọgbọgba ni; igbọnwọ mẹta si ni giga rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he made the altar of burnt offering of shittim wood: five cubits was the length thereof, and five cubits the breadth thereof; it was foursquare; and three cubits the height thereof.

entries.yo: O si ṣe iwo rẹ̀ si i ni igun rẹ̀ mẹrẹrin; iwo rẹ̀ wà lara rẹ̀: o si fi idẹ bò o.
entries.en: And he made the horns thereof on the four corners of it; the horns thereof were of the same: and he overlaid it with brass.

entries.yo: O si ṣe gbogbo ohunèlo pẹpẹ na, ìkoko rẹ̀, ọkọ́ rẹ̀, ati awokòto rẹ̀, ati kọkọrọ ẹran rẹ̀, ati awo iná wọnni: gbogbo ohunèlo rẹ̀ li o fi idẹ ṣe.
entries.en: And he made all the vessels of the altar, the pots, and the shovels, and the basons, and the fleshhooks, and the firepans: all the vessels thereof made he of brass.

entries.yo: O si ṣe àro idẹ fun pẹpẹ na ni iṣẹ àwọn nisalẹ ayiká rẹ̀, dé agbedemeji rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he made for the altar a brasen grate of network under the compass thereof beneath unto the midst of it.

entries.yo: O si dà oruka mẹrin fun ìku mẹrẹrin àro idẹ na, li àye fun ọpá wọnni.
entries.en: And he cast four rings for the four ends of the grate of brass, to be places for the staves.

entries.yo: O si fi igi ṣittimu ṣe ọpá wọnni, o si fi idẹ bò wọn.
entries.en: And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with brass.

entries.yo: O si fi ọpá wọnni sinu oruka ni ìha pẹpẹ na, lati ma fi rù u; o fi apáko ṣe pẹpẹ na li onihò ninu.
entries.en: And he put the staves into the rings on the sides of the altar, to bear it withal; he made the altar hollow with boards.

entries.yo: O si fi idẹ ṣe agbada na, o si fi idẹ ṣe ẹsẹ̀ rẹ̀, ti awojiji ẹgbẹ awọn obinrin ti npejọ lati sìn li ẹnu-ọ̀na agọ́ ajọ.
entries.en: And he made the laver of brass, and the foot of it of brass, of the lookingglasses of the women assembling, which assembled at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

entries.yo: O si ṣe agbalá na: ni ìha gusù li ọwọ́ ọtún aṣọ-tita agbalá na jẹ́ ọ̀gbọ olokùn wiwẹ, ọgọrun igbọnwọ:
entries.en: And he made the court: on the south side southward the hangings of the court were of fine twined linen, an hundred cubits:

entries.yo: Opó wọn jẹ́ ogún, ihò-ìtẹbọ idẹ wọn jẹ́ ogún; kọkọrọ opó wọnni ati ọjá wọn jẹ́ fadakà.
entries.en: Their pillars were twenty, and their brasen sockets twenty; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver.

entries.yo: Ati fun ìha ariwa ọgọrun igbọnwọ, opó wọn jẹ́ ogún, ati ihò-ìtẹbọ idẹ wọn jẹ́ ogún; kọkọrọ opó wọnni ati ọjá wọn jẹ́ fadakà.
entries.en: And for the north side the hangings were an hundred cubits, their pillars were twenty, and their sockets of brass twenty; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver.

entries.yo: Ati fun ìha ìwọ-õrùn li aṣọ-tita ãdọta igbọnwọ, opó wọn mẹwa, ati ihò-ìtẹbọ wọn mẹwa; kọkọrọ opó wọnni ati ọjá wọn jẹ́ fadakà.
entries.en: And for the west side were hangings of fifty cubits, their pillars ten, and their sockets ten; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver.

entries.yo: Ati fun ìha ìla-õrùn, si ìha ìla-õrùn ãdọta igbọnwọ.
entries.en: And for the east side eastward fifty cubits.

entries.yo: Aṣọ-tita apakan jẹ́ igbọnwọ mẹdogun; opó wọn jẹ́ mẹta, ati ihò-ìtẹbọ wọn jẹ́ mẹta.
entries.en: The hangings of the one side of the gate were fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

entries.yo: Ati fun apa keji: li apa ihin ati li apa ọhún ẹnu-ọ̀na agbalá na, li aṣọ-tita onigbọnwọ mẹdogun wà; opó wọn jẹ́ mẹta, ati ihò-ìtẹbọ wọn jẹ́ mẹta.
entries.en: And for the other side of the court gate, on this hand and that hand, were hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

entries.yo: Gbogbo aṣọ-tita agbalá na yiká jẹ́ ọ̀gbọ olokùn wiwẹ.
entries.en: All the hangings of the court round about were of fine twined linen.

entries.yo: Ati ihò-ìtẹbọ fun opó wọnni jẹ́ idẹ; kọkọrọ opó wọnni ati ọjá wọn jẹ́ fadakà; ati ibori ori wọn jẹ́ fadakà; ati gbogbo opó agbalá na li a fi fadakà gbà li ọjá.
entries.en: And the sockets for the pillars were of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver; and the overlaying of their chapiters of silver; and all the pillars of the court were filleted with silver.

entries.yo: Ati aṣọ-isorọ̀ ẹnu-ọ̀na agbalá na jẹ́ iṣẹ abẹ́rẹ, aṣọ-alaró, ati elesè-aluko, ati ododó, ati ọ̀gbọ olokùn wiwẹ: ogún igbọnwọ si ni gigùn rẹ̀, ati giga ni ibò rẹ̀ jẹ́ igbọnwọ marun, o bá aṣọ-tita agbalá wọnni ṣedede.
entries.en: And the hanging for the gate of the court was needlework, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen: and twenty cubits was the length, and the height in the breadth was five cubits, answerable to the hangings of the court.

entries.yo: Opó wọn si jẹ́ mẹrin, ati ihò-ìtẹbọ wọn ti idẹ, mẹrin; kọkọrọ wọn jẹ́ fadakà, ati ibori ori wọn ati ọjá wọn jẹ́ fadakà.
entries.en: And their pillars were four, and their sockets of brass four; their hooks of silver, and the overlaying of their chapiters and their fillets of silver.

entries.yo: Ati gbogbo ekàn agọ́ na, ati ti agbalá rẹ̀ yiká jẹ́ idẹ.
entries.en: And all the pins of the tabernacle, and of the court round about, were of brass.

entries.yo: Eyi ni iye agọ́ na, agọ́ ẹrí nì, bi a ti kà wọn, gẹgẹ bi ofin Mose, fun ìrin awọn ọmọ Lefi, lati ọwọ́ Itamari wá, ọmọ Aaroni alufa.
entries.en: This is the sum of the tabernacle, even of the tabernacle of testimony, as it was counted, according to the commandment of Moses, for the service of the Levites, by the hand of Ithamar, son to Aaron the priest.

entries.yo: Besaleli ọmọ Uri, ọmọ Huri, ti ẹ̀ya Judah, si ṣe ohun gbogbo ti OLUWA paṣẹ fun Mose.
entries.en: And Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made all that the LORD commanded Moses.

entries.yo: Ati Oholiabu pẹlu rẹ̀, ọmọ Ahisamaki, ti ẹ̀ya Dani, alagbẹdẹ, ati ọlọgbọ́n ọlọnà, alaró ati ahunṣọ alaró, ati elesè-àluko, ati ododó, ati ọ̀gbọ didara.
entries.en: And with him was Aholiab, son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver, and a cunning workman, and an embroiderer in blue, and in purple, and in scarlet, and fine linen.

entries.yo: Gbogbo wurà ti a lò si iṣẹ na, ni onirũru iṣẹ ibi mimọ́ nì, ani wurà ọrẹ nì, o jẹ́ talenti mọkandilọgbọ̀n, ati ẹgbẹrin ṣekeli o din ãdọrin, ni ìwọn ṣekeli ibi mimọ́.
entries.en: All the gold that was occupied for the work in all the work of the holy place, even the gold of the offering, was twenty and nine talents, and seven hundred and thirty shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary.

entries.yo: Ati fadakà awọn ẹniti a kà ninu ijọ-enia jẹ́ ọgọrun talenti, ati ṣekeli ojidilẹgbẹsan o le mẹdogun, ni ìwọn ṣekeli ibi mimọ́:
entries.en: And the silver of them that were numbered of the congregation was an hundred talents, and a thousand seven hundred and threescore and fifteen shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:

entries.yo: Abọ ṣekeli kan li ori ọkunrin kọkan, ni ìwọn ṣekeli ibi mimọ́, lori ori olukuluku ti o kọja sinu awọn ti a kà, lati ẹni ogún ọdún ati jù bẹ̃ lọ, jẹ́ ọgbọ̀n ọkẹ le ẹgbẹtadilogun o le ãdọjọ enia.
entries.en: A bekah for every man, that is, half a shekel, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for every one that went to be numbered, from twenty years old and upward, for six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty men.

entries.yo: Ati ninu ọgọrun talenti fadakà na li a ti dà ihò-ìtẹbọ wọnni ti ibi mimọ́, ati ihò-ìtẹbọ ti aṣọ-ikele na, ọgọrun ihò-ìtẹbọ ninu ọgọrun talenti na, talenti ka fun ihò-ìtẹbọ kan.
entries.en: And of the hundred talents of silver were cast the sockets of the sanctuary, and the sockets of the vail; an hundred sockets of the hundred talents, a talent for a socket.

entries.yo: Ati ninu ojidilẹgbẹsan ṣekeli o le mẹdogun, o mú ṣe kọkọrọ fun ọwọ̀n wọnni, o si fi i bò ori wọn, o si fi i ṣe ọjá wọn.
entries.en: And of the thousand seven hundred seventy and five shekels he made hooks for the pillars, and overlaid their chapiters, and filleted them.

entries.yo: Ati idẹ ọrẹ na jẹ́ ãdọrin talenti, ati egbejila ṣekeli.
entries.en: And the brass of the offering was seventy talents, and two thousand and four hundred shekels.

entries.yo: On li o si fi ṣe ihò-ìtẹbọ ẹnu-ọ̀na agọ́ ajọ ati pẹpẹ idẹ na, ati àro idẹ sara rẹ̀, ati gbogbo ohun-èlo pẹpẹ na,
entries.en: And therewith he made the sockets to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the brasen altar, and the brasen grate for it, and all the vessels of the altar,

entries.yo: Ati ihò-ìtẹbọ agbalá, na yikà, ati ìho-ìtẹbọ ẹnu-ọ̀na agbalá, ati gbogbo ekàn agọ́ na, ati gbogbo ekàn agbalà na yikà.
entries.en: And the sockets of the court round about, and the sockets of the court gate, and all the pins of the tabernacle, and all the pins of the court round about.

entries.yo: NWỌN si fi ninu aṣọ-alaró, ati elesè-àluko, ati ododó, dá aṣọ ìsin, lati ma fi sìn ni ibi mimọ́, nwọn si dá aṣọ mimọ́ ti iṣe fun Aaroni; bi OLUWA ti fi aṣẹ fun Mose.
entries.en: And of the blue, and purple, and scarlet, they made cloths of service, to do service in the holy place, and made the holy garments for Aaron; as the LORD commanded Moses.

entries.yo: O si ṣe ẹ̀wu-efodi na ti wurà, ati aṣọ-alaró, ati elesè-àluko, ati ododó, ati ọ̀gbọ olokùn wiwẹ.
entries.en: And he made the ephod of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.

entries.yo: Nwọn si lù wurà nì di ewé fẹlẹfẹlẹ, nwọn si là a li okùn wẹ́wẹ, ati lati fi ṣe iṣẹ ọlọnà sinu aṣọ-alaró, ati sinu elesè-àluko, ati sinu ododó, ati sinu ọ̀gbọ didara nì.
entries.en: And they did beat the gold into thin plates, and cut it into wires, to work it in the blue, and in the purple, and in the scarlet, and in the fine linen, with cunning work.

entries.yo: Nwọn ṣe aṣọ ejika si i, lati so o lù: li eti mejeji li a so o lù.
entries.en: They made shoulderpieces for it, to couple it together: by the two edges was it coupled together.

entries.yo: Ati onirũru-ọnà ọjá ti o wà lara rẹ̀, lati fi dì i o jẹ́ ọkanna, gẹgẹ bi iṣẹ rẹ̀; ti wurà, aṣọ-alaró, elesè-àluko, ti ododó, ati ti ọ̀gbọ olokùn wiwẹ; bi OLUWA ti fi aṣẹ fun Mose.
entries.en: And the curious girdle of his ephod, that was upon it, was of the same, according to the work thereof; of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen; as the LORD commanded Moses.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣiṣẹ́ okuta oniki ti a tò sinu oju-ìde wurà, ti a fin bi ifin èdidi-àmi ti a fin orukọ awọn ọmọ Israeli si.
entries.en: And they wrought onyx stones inclosed in ouches of gold, graven, as signets are graven, with the names of the children of Israel.

entries.yo: O si fi wọn si ejika ẹ̀wu-efodi na, li okuta, iranti fun awọn ọmọ Israeli: bi OLUWA ti fi aṣẹ fun Mose.
entries.en: And he put them on the shoulders of the ephod, that they should be stones for a memorial to the children of Israel; as the LORD commanded Moses.

entries.yo: O si fi iṣẹ ọlọnà ṣiṣẹ igbàiya na, bi iṣẹ ẹ̀wu-efodi nì; ti wurà, ati aṣọ-alaró, ati elesè-àluko, ati ododo, ati ọ̀gbọ olokùn wiwẹ.
entries.en: And he made the breastplate of cunning work, like the work of the ephod; of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.

entries.yo: Oniha mẹrin ọgbọgba ni; nwọn ṣe igbàiya na ni iṣẹpo meji: ika kan ni gigùn rẹ̀, ika kan si ni ibú rẹ̀, o jẹ́ iṣẹpo meji.
entries.en: It was foursquare; they made the breastplate double: a span was the length thereof, and a span the breadth thereof, being doubled.

entries.yo: Nwọn si tò ẹsẹ̀ okuta mẹrin si i: ẹsẹ̀ ekini ni sardiu, ati topasi, ati smaragdu; eyi li ẹsẹ̀ kini.
entries.en: And they set in it four rows of stones: the first row was a sardius, a topaz, and a carbuncle: this was the first row.

entries.yo: Ati ẹsẹ̀ keji, emeraldi, safiru, ati diamondi.
entries.en: And the second row, an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond.

entries.yo: Ati ẹsẹ̀ kẹta, ligure, agate, ati ametistu.
entries.en: And the third row, a ligure, an agate, and an amethyst.

entries.yo: Ati ẹsẹ̀ kẹrin, berilu, oniki, ati jasperi: a si tò wọn si oju-ìde wurà ni titò wọn.
entries.en: And the fourth row, a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper: they were inclosed in ouches of gold in their inclosings.

entries.yo: Okuta wọnni si jasi gẹgẹ bi orukọ awọn ọmọ Israeli mejila, gẹgẹ bi orukọ wọn, bi ifin èdidi-àmi, olukuluku ti on ti orukọ rẹ̀, gẹgẹ bi ẹ̀ya mejejila.
entries.en: And the stones were according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names, like the engravings of a signet, every one with his name, according to the twelve tribes.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣe ẹ̀wọn iṣẹ-ọnà-lilọ kìki wurà si igbàiya na.
entries.en: And they made upon the breastplate chains at the ends, of wreathen work of pure gold.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣe oju-ìde wurà meji, ati oruka wurà meji; nwọn si fi oruka mejeji si eti igbàiya na mejeji.
entries.en: And they made two ouches of gold, and two gold rings; and put the two rings in the two ends of the breastplate.

entries.yo: Nwọn si fi ẹ̀wọn wurà iṣẹ-ọnà-lilọ mejeji bọ̀ inu oruka wọnni, ni eti igbàiya na.
entries.en: And they put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings on the ends of the breastplate.

entries.yo: Ati eti mejeji ti ẹ̀wọn iṣẹ-lilọ mejeji nì ni nwọn fi mọ́ inu oju-ìde mejeji, nwọn si fi wọn sara okùn ejika ẹ̀wu-efodi na niwaju rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the two ends of the two wreathen chains they fastened in the two ouches, and put them on the shoulderpieces of the ephod, before it.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣe oruka wurà meji, nwọn si fi wọn si eti mejeji igbàiya na, si eti rẹ̀ ti o wà, ni ìha ẹ̀wu-efodi na ni ìha inu.
entries.en: And they made two rings of gold, and put them on the two ends of the breastplate, upon the border of it, which was on the side of the ephod inward.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣe oruka wurà meji, nwọn si fi wọn si ìha mejeji ẹ̀wu-efodi na nisalẹ, si ìha iwaju rẹ̀, ki o kọjusi isolù rẹ̀, loke ọjá ẹ̀wu-efodi na.
entries.en: And they made two other golden rings, and put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath, toward the forepart of it, over against the other coupling thereof, above the curious girdle of the ephod.

entries.yo: Nwọn si fi oruka rẹ̀ dè igbàiya na mọ́ oruka ẹ̀wu-efodi pẹlu ọjá-àwọn aṣọ-aláró, ki o le ma wà lori onirũru-ọnà ọjá ẹ̀wu-efodi na, ati ki igbàiya ni ki o máṣe tú kuro lara ẹ̀wu-efodi na; bi OLUWA ti fi aṣẹ fun Mose.
entries.en: And they did bind the breastplate by his rings unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it might be above the curious girdle of the ephod, and that the breastplate might not be loosed from the ephod; as the LORD commanded Moses.

entries.yo: O si ṣe aṣọ igunwa ẹ̀wu-efodi na ni iṣẹ wiwun, gbogbo rẹ̀ jẹ́ aṣọ-aláró.
entries.en: And he made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue.

entries.yo: Oju-ọrùn si wà li agbedemeji aṣọ-igunwa na, o dabi oju-ẹ̀wu ogun, pẹlu ọjá yi oju na ká, ki o máṣe ya.
entries.en: And there was an hole in the midst of the robe, as the hole of an habergeon, with a band round about the hole, that it should not rend.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣe pomegranate aṣọ: alaró, ati elesè-àluko, ati ododó, ati ọ̀gbọ olokùn wiwẹ si iṣẹti aṣọ-igunwa na.
entries.en: And they made upon the hems of the robe pomegranates of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined linen.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣe ṣaworo kìki wurà, nwọn si fi ṣaworo na si alafo pomegranate wọnni si eti iṣẹti aṣọ igunwa na, yiká li alafo pomegranate wọnni;
entries.en: And they made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates upon the hem of the robe, round about between the pomegranates;

entries.yo: Ṣaworo kan ati pomegranate kan, ṣaworo kan ati pomegranate kan, yi iṣẹti aṣọ-igunwa na ká lati ma fi ṣiṣẹ alufa; bi OLUWA ti fi aṣẹ fun Mose.
entries.en: A bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, round about the hem of the robe to minister in; as the LORD commanded Moses.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣe ẹ̀wu ọ̀gbọ daradara ti iṣẹ híhun fun Aaroni, ati fun awọn ọmo rẹ̀,
entries.en: And they made coats of fine linen of woven work for Aaron, and for his sons,

entries.yo: Ati fila ọṣọ́ ọ̀gbọ daradara, ati fila ọ̀gbọ didara, ati ṣòkoto ọ̀gbọ olokún wiwẹ,
entries.en: And a mitre of fine linen, and goodly bonnets of fine linen, and linen breeches of fine twined linen,

entries.yo: Ati ọjá ọ̀gbọ olokùn wiwẹ́, ati ti aṣọ-alaró, ti elesè-àluko, ati ti ododo, oniṣẹ abẹ́rẹ; bi OLUWA ti fi aṣẹ fun Mose.
entries.en: And a girdle of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, of needlework; as the LORD commanded Moses.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣe awo adé mimọ́ na ni kìki wurà, nwọn si kọwe si i, ikọwe bi fifin èdidi-àmi, MIMỌ SI OLUWA.
entries.en: And they made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote upon it a writing, like to the engravings of a signet, HOLINESS TO THE LORD.

entries.yo: Nwọn si dì ọjá àwọn alaró mọ́ ọ, lati fi dì i loke sara fila na; bi OLUWA ti paṣẹ fun Mose.
entries.en: And they tied unto it a lace of blue, to fasten it on high upon the mitre; as the LORD commanded Moses.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni gbogbo iṣẹ agọ́ ti agọ́ ajọ na pari: awọn ọmọ Israeli si ṣe gẹgẹ bi gbogbo eyiti OLUWA palaṣẹ fun Mose, bẹ̃ni nwọn ṣe.
entries.en: Thus was all the work of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation finished: and the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so did they.

entries.yo: Nwọn si mú agọ́ na tọ̀ Mose wá, agọ́ na, ati gbogbo ohunèlo rẹ̀, ikọ́ rẹ̀, apáko rẹ̀, ọ̀pá rẹ̀, ati ọwọ̀n rẹ̀, ati ihò-ìtẹbọ rẹ̀ wọnni;
entries.en: And they brought the tabernacle unto Moses, the tent, and all his furniture, his taches, his boards, his bars, and his pillars, and his sockets,

entries.yo: Ati ibori awọ àgbo ti a sè ni pupa, ati ibori awọ seali, ati ikele aṣọ-tita.
entries.en: And the covering of rams' skins dyed red, and the covering of badgers' skins, and the vail of the covering,

entries.yo: Apoti ẹrí nì, ati ọpá rẹ̀ wọnni, ati itẹ́-ãnu nì;
entries.en: The ark of the testimony, and the staves thereof, and the mercy seat,

entries.yo: Tabili na, ati gbogbo ohunèlo rẹ̀, ati àkara ifihàn;
entries.en: The table, and all the vessels thereof, and the shewbread,

entries.yo: Ọpá-fitila mimọ́, pẹlu fitila rẹ̀ wọnni, fitila ti a tò li ẹsẹ̀-ẹsẹ̀, ati gbogbo ohun-èlo rẹ̀, ati oróro titanna;
entries.en: The pure candlestick, with the lamps thereof, even with the lamps to be set in order, and all the vessels thereof, and the oil for light,

entries.yo: Ati pẹpẹ wurà, ati oróro itasori, ati turari didùn, ati aṣọ-isorọ̀ fun ẹnu-ọ̀na agọ́ na;
entries.en: And the golden altar, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the hanging for the tabernacle door,

entries.yo: Pẹpẹ idẹ, ati oju-àro-àwọn idẹ rẹ̀, ọpá rẹ̀, ati gbogbo ohunèlo rẹ̀, agbada na ati ẹsẹ̀ rẹ̀;
entries.en: The brasen altar, and his grate of brass, his staves, and all his vessels, the laver and his foot,

entries.yo: Aṣọ-tita agbalá na, ọwọ̀n rẹ̀ ati ihò-ìtẹbọ̀ rẹ̀, ati aṣọ-isorọ̀ ẹnu-ọ̀na agbalá na, okùn rẹ̀, ati ekàn rẹ̀, ati gbogbo ohunèlo ìsin agọ́ na, ani agọ́ ajọ;
entries.en: The hangings of the court, his pillars, and his sockets, and the hanging for the court gate, his cords, and his pins, and all the vessels of the service of the tabernacle, for the tent of the congregation,

entries.yo: Aṣọ ìsin lati ma fi sìn ninu ibi mimọ́, ati aṣọ mimọ́ wọnni fun Aaroni alufa, ati aṣọ awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, lati ma fi ṣe iṣẹ alufa.
entries.en: The cloths of service to do service in the holy place, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and his sons' garments, to minister in the priest's office.

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi gbogbo ohun ti OLUWA fi aṣẹ fun Mose, bẹ̃li awọn ọmọ Israeli ṣe gbogbo iṣẹ na.
entries.en: According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so the children of Israel made all the work.

entries.yo: Mose si bojuwò gbogbo iṣẹ na, si kiyesi i, nwọn si ṣe e bi OLUWA ti palaṣẹ, bẹ̃ gẹgẹ ni nwọn ṣe e; Mose si sure fun wọn.
entries.en: And Moses did look upon all the work, and, behold, they have done it as the LORD had commanded, even so had they done it: and Moses blessed them.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Li ọjọ́ kini oṣù kini ni ki iwọ ki o gbé ibugbé agọ́ na ró.
entries.en: On the first day of the first month shalt thou set up the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si fi apoti ẹrí nì sinu rẹ̀, iwọ o si ta aṣọ-ikele ni bò apoti na.
entries.en: And thou shalt put therein the ark of the testimony, and cover the ark with the vail.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si gbé tabili wọle, ki o si tò ohun wọnni ti o ni itò si ori rẹ̀; iwọ o si mú ọpá-fitila wọle, iwọ o si tò fitila rẹ̀ wọnni lori rẹ̀.
entries.en: And thou shalt bring in the table, and set in order the things that are to be set in order upon it; and thou shalt bring in the candlestick, and light the lamps thereof.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si fi pẹpẹ wurà ti turari nì si iwaju apoti ẹrí, iwọ o si fi aṣọ-isorọ̀ ẹnu-ọ̀na sara agọ́ na.
entries.en: And thou shalt set the altar of gold for the incense before the ark of the testimony, and put the hanging of the door to the tabernacle.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si fi pẹpẹ ẹbọsisun nì si iwaju ẹnu-ọ̀na ibugbé agọ́ ajọ.
entries.en: And thou shalt set the altar of the burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si gbé agbada nì kà agbede-meji agọ́ ajọ ati pẹpẹ, iwọ o si pọn omi sinu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And thou shalt set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar, and shalt put water therein.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si fà agbalá na yiká, iwọ o si ta aṣọ-isorọ̀ si ẹnu-ọ̀na agbalá na.
entries.en: And thou shalt set up the court round about, and hang up the hanging at the court gate.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si mù oróro itasori nì, iwọ o si ta a sara agọ́ na, ati sara ohun gbogbo ti o wà ninu rẹ̀, iwọ o si yà a simimọ́, ati gbogbo ohun-èlo rẹ̀: yio si jẹ́ mimọ́.
entries.en: And thou shalt take the anointing oil, and anoint the tabernacle, and all that is therein, and shalt hallow it, and all the vessels thereof: and it shall be holy.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si ta oróro sara pẹpẹ ẹbọsisun, ati gbogbo ohun-èlo rẹ̀, iwọ o si yà pẹpẹ na simimọ́: yio si ma jẹ́ pẹpẹ ti o mọ́ julọ.
entries.en: And thou shalt anoint the altar of the burnt offering, and all his vessels, and sanctify the altar: and it shall be an altar most holy.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si ta oróro sara agbada ati ẹsẹ̀ rẹ̀, iwọ o si yà a simimọ́.
entries.en: And thou shalt anoint the laver and his foot, and sanctify it.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si mú Aaroni ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ wá si ẹnu-ọ̀na agọ́ ajọ, iwọ o si fi omi wẹ̀ wọn.
entries.en: And thou shalt bring Aaron and his sons unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and wash them with water.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si fi aṣọ mimọ́ wọnni wọ̀ Aaroni; iwọ o si ta oróro si i li ori, iwọ o si yà a simimọ́, ki o le ma ṣe iṣẹ alufa fun mi.
entries.en: And thou shalt put upon Aaron the holy garments, and anoint him, and sanctify him; that he may minister unto me in the priest's office.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si mú awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ wá, iwọ o si fi ẹ̀wu wọ̀ wọn:
entries.en: And thou shalt bring his sons, and clothe them with coats:

entries.yo: Iwọ o si ta oróro si wọn li ori, bi iwọ ti ta si baba wọn li ori, ki nwọn ko le ma ṣe iṣẹ alufa fun mi: nitoriti itasori wọn yio jẹ́ iṣẹ-alufa lailai nitõtọ, lati irandiran wọn.
entries.en: And thou shalt anoint them, as thou didst anoint their father, that they may minister unto me in the priest's office: for their anointing shall surely be an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Mose ṣe: gẹgẹ bi eyiti OLUWA palaṣẹ fun u, bẹ̃li o ṣe.
entries.en: Thus did Moses: according to all that the LORD commanded him, so did he.

entries.yo: O si ṣe li oṣù kini li ọdún keji ni ijọ́ kini oṣù na, ni a gbé agọ́ na ró.
entries.en: And it came to pass in the first month in the second year, on the first day of the month, that the tabernacle was reared up.

entries.yo: Mose si gbé agọ́ na ró, o si de ihò-ìtẹbọ rẹ̀, o si tò apáko rẹ̀, o si fi ọpá rẹ̀ bọ̀ ọ, o si gbé ọwọ̀n rẹ̀ ró.
entries.en: And Moses reared up the tabernacle, and fastened his sockets, and set up the boards thereof, and put in the bars thereof, and reared up his pillars.

entries.yo: O si nà aṣọ agọ́ na sori agọ́, o si fi ibori agọ́ na bò o li ori; bi OLUWA ti paṣẹ fun Mose.
entries.en: And he spread abroad the tent over the tabernacle, and put the covering of the tent above upon it; as the LORD commanded Moses.

entries.yo: O si mú, o si fi ẹrí nì sinu apoti na, o si fi ọpá wọnni sara apoti na, o si fi itẹ́-ãnu nì si oke lori apoti na:
entries.en: And he took and put the testimony into the ark, and set the staves on the ark, and put the mercy seat above upon the ark:

entries.yo: O si gbé apoti na wá sinu agọ́, o si ta aṣọ-ikele, o si ta a bò apoti ẹrí; bi OLUWA ti paṣẹ fun Mose.
entries.en: And he brought the ark into the tabernacle, and set up the vail of the covering, and covered the ark of the testimony; as the LORD commanded Moses.

entries.yo: O si fi tabili nì sinu agọ́ ajọ, ni ìha ariwa agọ́ na, lẹhin ode aṣọ-ikele nì.
entries.en: And he put the table in the tent of the congregation, upon the side of the tabernacle northward, without the vail.

entries.yo: O si tò àkara na lẹ̀sẹsẹ daradara lori rẹ̀ niwaju OLUWA; bi OLUWA ti paṣẹ fun Mose.
entries.en: And he set the bread in order upon it before the LORD; as the LORD had commanded Moses.

entries.yo: O si fi ọpá-fitila nì sinu agọ́ ajọ, ki o kọjusi tabili nì ni ìha gusù agọ na.
entries.en: And he put the candlestick in the tent of the congregation, over against the table, on the side of the tabernacle southward.

entries.yo: O si tàn fitila wọnni siwaju OLUWA; bi OLUWA ti paṣẹ fun Mose.
entries.en: And he lighted the lamps before the LORD; as the LORD commanded Moses.

entries.yo: O si fi pẹpẹ wurà nì sinu agọ́ ajọ niwaju aṣọ-ikele nì:
entries.en: And he put the golden altar in the tent of the congregation before the vail:

entries.yo: O si fi turari didùn joná lori rẹ̀; bi OLUWA ti paṣẹ fun Mose.
entries.en: And he burnt sweet incense thereon; as the LORD commanded Moses.

entries.yo: O si ta aṣọ-isorọ̀ nì si ẹnu-ọ̀na agọ́ na.
entries.en: And he set up the hanging at the door of the tabernacle.

entries.yo: O si fi pẹpẹ ẹbọsisun si ẹnu-ọ̀na ibugbé agọ́ ajọ, o si ru ẹbọ sisun, ati ẹbọ ohunjijẹ lori rẹ̀; bi OLUWA ti paṣẹ fun Mose.
entries.en: And he put the altar of burnt offering by the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation, and offered upon it the burnt offering and the meat offering; as the LORD commanded Moses.

entries.yo: O si gbé agbada nì kà agbede-meji agọ́ ajọ ati pẹpẹ, o si pọn omi si i, lati ma fi wẹ̀.
entries.en: And he set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar, and put water there, to wash withal.

entries.yo: Ati Mose ati Aaroni ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ wẹ̀ ọwọ́ ati ẹsẹ̀ wọn ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Moses and Aaron and his sons washed their hands and their feet thereat:

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn ba lọ sinu agọ́ ajọ, ati nigbati nwọn ba sunmọ pẹpẹ na, nwọn a wẹ̀; bi OLUWA ti paṣẹ fun Mose.
entries.en: When they went into the tent of the congregation, and when they came near unto the altar, they washed; as the LORD commanded Moses.

entries.yo: O si fà agbalá na yi agọ́ ati pẹpẹ na ká, o si ta aṣọ-isorọ̀ ẹnu-ọ̀na agbalá na. Bẹ̃ni Mose pari iṣẹ na.
entries.en: And he reared up the court round about the tabernacle and the altar, and set up the hanging of the court gate. So Moses finished the work.

entries.yo: Nigbana li awọsanma bò agọ́ ajọ, ogo OLUWA si kún inu agọ́ na.
entries.en: Then a cloud covered the tent of the congregation, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.

entries.yo: Mose kò si le wọ̀ inu agọ́ ajọ lọ, nitoriti awọsanma wà lori rẹ̀, ogo OLUWA si kun inu agọ́ na.
entries.en: And Moses was not able to enter into the tent of the congregation, because the cloud abode thereon, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.

entries.yo: Nigbati a si fà awọsanma na soke, kuro lori agọ́ na, awọn ọmọ Israeli a ma dide rìn lọ ni ìrin wọn gbogbo:
entries.en: And when the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the children of Israel went onward in all their journeys:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi a kò fà awọsanma na soke, njẹ nwọn kò ni idide rìn titi ọjọ-kọjọ́ ti o ba fà soke.
entries.en: But if the cloud were not taken up, then they journeyed not till the day that it was taken up.

entries.yo: Nitoriti awọsanma OLUWA wà lori agọ́ na li ọsán, iná si wà ninu awọsanma na li oru, li oju gbogbo ile Israeli, ni gbogbo ìrin wọn.
entries.en: For the cloud of the LORD was upon the tabernacle by day, and fire was on it by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel, throughout all their journeys.

entries.yo: OLUWA si pè Mose, o si sọ fun u lati inu agọ́ ajọ wa, pe,
entries.en: And the LORD called unto Moses, and spake unto him out of the tabernacle of the congregation, saying,

entries.yo: Sọ fun awọn ọmọ Israeli, ki o si wi fun wọn pe, Bi ẹnikan ninu nyin ba mú ọrẹ-ẹbọ wá fun OLUWA, ki ẹnyin ki o mú ọrẹ-ẹbọ nyin wá ninu ohunọ̀sin, ani ti inu ọwọ́-ẹran, ati ti agbo-ẹran.
entries.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, If any man of you bring an offering unto the LORD, ye shall bring your offering of the cattle, even of the herd, and of the flock.

entries.yo: Bi ọrẹ-ẹbọ rẹ̀ ba ṣe ẹbọ sisun ti inu ọwọ́-ẹran, ki on ki o mú akọ wá alailabùku: ki o mú u wá tinutinu rẹ̀ si ẹnu-ọ̀na agọ́ ajọ siwaju OLUWA.
entries.en: If his offering be a burnt sacrifice of the herd, let him offer a male without blemish: he shall offer it of his own voluntary will at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the LORD.

entries.yo: Ki o si fi ọwọ rẹ̀ lé ori ẹbọ sisun na; yio si di itẹwọgbà fun u lati ṣètutu fun u.
entries.en: And he shall put his hand upon the head of the burnt offering; and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.

entries.yo: Ki o si pa akọmalu na niwaju OLUWA: awọn alufa, awọn ọmọ Aaroni, yio si mú ẹ̀jẹ na wá, nwọn o si fi ẹ̀jẹ na wọ́n ori pẹpẹ nì yiká ti mbẹ li ẹnu-ọ̀na agọ́ ajọ.
entries.en: And he shall kill the bullock before the LORD: and the priests, Aaron's sons, shall bring the blood, and sprinkle the blood round about upon the altar that is by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

entries.yo: Ki o si bó ẹbọ sisun na; ki o si kun u.
entries.en: And he shall flay the burnt offering, and cut it into his pieces.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Aaroni alufa ni yio si fi iná sori pẹpẹ na, nwọn o si tò igi lori iná na:
entries.en: And the sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire upon the altar, and lay the wood in order upon the fire:

entries.yo: Awọn alufa, awọn ọmọ Aaroni yio si tò ninu rẹ̀, ani ori ati ọrá wọn sori igi ti mbẹ lori iná, ti mbẹ lori pẹpẹ:
entries.en: And the priests, Aaron's sons, shall lay the parts, the head, and the fat, in order upon the wood that is on the fire which is upon the altar:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ifun rẹ̀, ati itan rẹ̀ ni ki o ṣàn ninu omi: ki alufa ki o si sun gbogbo rẹ̀ lori pẹpẹ na lati ṣe ẹbọ sisun, ẹbọ ti a fi iná ṣe, õrùn didùn si OLUWA.
entries.en: But his inwards and his legs shall he wash in water: and the priest shall burn all on the altar, to be a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.

entries.yo: Bi ọrẹ-ẹbọ rẹ̀ ba si ṣe ti agbo-ẹran, eyinì ni ti agutan, tabi ti ewurẹ, fun ẹbọ sisun; akọ ni ki o múwa alailabùku.
entries.en: And if his offering be of the flocks, namely, of the sheep, or of the goats, for a burnt sacrifice; he shall bring it a male without blemish.

entries.yo: Ki o si pa a niwaju OLUWA li ẹba pẹpẹ ni ìha ariwa: ati awọn alufa, awọn ọmọ Aaroni yio si bù ẹ̀jẹ rẹ̀ wọ́n ori pẹpẹ na yiká.
entries.en: And he shall kill it on the side of the altar northward before the LORD: and the priests, Aaron's sons, shall sprinkle his blood round about upon the altar.

entries.yo: Ki o si kun u, ori rẹ̀ ati ọrá rẹ̀: alufa na yio si tò wọn sori igi ti mbẹ lori iná ti mbẹ lori pẹpẹ:
entries.en: And he shall cut it into his pieces, with his head and his fat: and the priest shall lay them in order on the wood that is on the fire which is upon the altar:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ki o ṣìn ifun ati itan rẹ̀ ninu omi: ki alufa na ki o si mú gbogbo rẹ̀ wá, ki o si sun u lori pẹpẹ: ẹbọ sisun ni, ẹbọ ti a fi iná ṣe, õrùn didùn si OLUWA.
entries.en: But he shall wash the inwards and the legs with water: and the priest shall bring it all, and burn it upon the altar: it is a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.

entries.yo: Bi o ba si ṣepe ti ẹiyẹ ni ẹbọ sisun ọrẹ-ẹbọ rẹ̀ si OLUWA, njẹ ki o mú ọrẹ-ẹbọ rẹ̀ wá ninu àdaba, tabi ninu ọmọ ẹiyẹle.
entries.en: And if the burnt sacrifice for his offering to the LORD be of fowls, then he shall bring his offering of turtledoves, or of young pigeons.

entries.yo: Ki alufa na ki o si mú u wá si pẹpẹ na, ki o si mi i li ọrùn, ki o si sun u lori pẹpẹ na; ẹ̀jẹ rẹ̀ ni ki o si ro si ẹba pẹpẹ na.
entries.en: And the priest shall bring it unto the altar, and wring off his head, and burn it on the altar; and the blood thereof shall be wrung out at the side of the altar:

entries.yo: Ki o si fà ajẹsi rẹ̀ já pẹlu ẽri rẹ̀, ki o si kó o lọ si ẹba pẹpẹ na ni ìha ìlà-õrùn, lori ibi ẽru nì:
entries.en: And he shall pluck away his crop with his feathers, and cast it beside the altar on the east part, by the place of the ashes:

entries.yo: Ki o si là a ti on ti iyẹ́-apa rẹ̀, ṣugbọn ki yio pín i ni meji jalẹ: ki alufa ki o si sun u lori pẹpẹ na, lori igi na ti mbẹ lori iná: ẹbọ sisun ni, ẹbọ ti a fi iná ṣe, õrùn didùn si OLUWA.
entries.en: And he shall cleave it with the wings thereof, but shall not divide it asunder: and the priest shall burn it upon the altar, upon the wood that is upon the fire: it is a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.

entries.yo: NIGBATI ẹnikan ba si nta ọrẹ-ẹbọ ohunjijẹ fun OLUWA, ki ọrẹ-ẹbọ rẹ̀ ki o jẹ ti iyẹfun daradara; ki o si dà oróro sori rẹ̀, ki o si fi turari sori rẹ̀.
entries.en: And when any will offer a meat offering unto the LORD, his offering shall be of fine flour; and he shall pour oil upon it, and put frankincense thereon:

entries.yo: Ki o si mú u tọ̀ awọn alufa, awọn ọmọ Aaroni wá: ki alufa si bù ikunwọ kan ninu rẹ̀, ninu iyẹfun na, ati ninu oróro na, pẹlu gbogbo turari rẹ̀; ki o si sun ẹbọ-iranti rẹ̀ lori pẹpẹ, lati ṣe ẹbọ ti a fi iná ṣe, õrùn didùn si OLUWA:
entries.en: And he shall bring it to Aaron's sons the priests: and he shall take thereout his handful of the flour thereof, and of the oil thereof, with all the frankincense thereof; and the priest shall burn the memorial of it upon the altar, to be an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD:

entries.yo: Iyokù ti ẹbọ ohunjijẹ na, a si jẹ ti Aaroni, ati ti awọn ọmọ rẹ̀: ohun mimọ́ julọ lati inu ẹbọ OLUWA ni ti a fi iná ṣe.
entries.en: And the remnant of the meat offering shall be Aaron's and his sons': it is a thing most holy of the offerings of the LORD made by fire.

entries.yo: Bi iwọ ba si mú ọrẹ-ẹbọ ohunjijẹ wá, ti a yan ninu àro, ki o jẹ́ àkara alaiwu iyẹfun didara, ti a fi oróro pò, tabi àkara fẹlẹfẹlẹ alaiwu ti a ta oróro si.
entries.en: And if thou bring an oblation of a meat offering baken in the oven, it shall be unleavened cakes of fine flour mingled with oil, or unleavened wafers anointed with oil.

entries.yo: Ati bi ọrẹ-ẹbọ rẹ̀ ba ṣe ohunjijẹ, ti a ṣe ninu awopẹtẹ, ki o jẹ́ ti iyẹfun didara alaiwu, ti a fi òróró pò.
entries.en: And if thy oblation be a meat offering baken in a pan, it shall be of fine flour unleavened, mingled with oil.

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o si dá a kelekele, ki o si dà oróro sori rẹ̀: ẹbọ ohunjijẹ ni.
entries.en: Thou shalt part it in pieces, and pour oil thereon: it is a meat offering.

entries.yo: Ati bi ọrẹ-ẹbọ rẹ ba ṣe ẹbọ ohunjijẹ, ti a yan ninu apẹ, iyẹfun didara ni ki a fi ṣe e pẹlu oróro.
entries.en: And if thy oblation be a meat offering baken in the fryingpan, it shall be made of fine flour with oil.

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o si mú ẹbọ ohunjijẹ na wá, ti a fi nkan wọnyi ṣe fun OLUWA: on o si mú u tọ̀ alufa na wá, ki on ki o si mú u wá sori pẹpẹ nì.
entries.en: And thou shalt bring the meat offering that is made of these things unto the LORD: and when it is presented unto the priest, he shall bring it unto the altar.

entries.yo: Alufa yio si mú ẹbọ-iranti ninu ohunjijẹ na, yio si sun u lori pẹpẹ: ẹbọ ti a fi iná ṣe, õrùn didùn si OLUWA.
entries.en: And the priest shall take from the meat offering a memorial thereof, and shall burn it upon the altar: it is an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.

entries.yo: Eyiti o si kù ninu ẹbọ ohunjijẹ, ki o jẹ́ ti Aaroni, ati ti awọn ọmọ rẹ̀: ohun mimọ́ julọ ni, ọrẹ-ẹbọ OLUWA ti a fi iná ṣe.
entries.en: And that which is left of the meat offering shall be Aaron's and his sons': it is a thing most holy of the offerings of the LORD made by fire.

entries.yo: A kò gbọdọ fi iwukàra ṣe gbogbo ẹbọ ohunjijẹ ti ẹnyin o mú tọ̀ OLUWA wá: nitori ẹnyin kò gbọdọ sun iwukàra, tabi: oyinkoyin, ninu ọrẹ-ẹbọ OLUWA, ti a fi iná ṣe.
entries.en: No meat offering, which ye shall bring unto the LORD, shall be made with leaven: for ye shall burn no leaven, nor any honey, in any offering of the LORD made by fire.

entries.yo: Bi ọrẹ-ẹbọ akọ́so, ẹnyin le mú wọn wá fun OLUWA: ṣugbọn a ki yio sun wọn lori pẹpẹ fun õrùn didùn.
entries.en: As for the oblation of the firstfruits, ye shall offer them unto the LORD: but they shall not be burnt on the altar for a sweet savour.

entries.yo: Ati gbogbo ọrẹ-ẹbọ ohunjijẹ rẹ ni ki iwọ ki o fi iyọ̀ dùn; bẹ̃ni iwọ kò gbọdọ jẹ ki iyọ̀ majẹmu Ọlọrun rẹ ki o má sí ninu ẹbọ ohunjijẹ rẹ: gbogbo ọrẹ-ẹbọ rẹ ni ki iwọ ki o fi iyọ̀ si.
entries.en: And every oblation of thy meat offering shalt thou season with salt; neither shalt thou suffer the salt of the covenant of thy God to be lacking from thy meat offering: with all thine offerings thou shalt offer salt.

entries.yo: Bi iwọ ba si mú ẹbọ ohunjijẹ akọ́so rẹ wá fun OLUWA, ki iwọ ki o si mú ṣiri ọkà daradara ti a yan lori iná wá fun ẹbọ ohunjijẹ akọ́so rẹ, ọkà gigún, ti ṣiri tutù.
entries.en: And if thou offer a meat offering of thy firstfruits unto the LORD, thou shalt offer for the meat offering of thy firstfruits green ears of corn dried by the fire, even corn beaten out of full ears.

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o si fi oróro sori rẹ̀, ki o si fi turari sori rẹ̀: ẹbọ ohunjijẹ ni.
entries.en: And thou shalt put oil upon it, and lay frankincense thereon: it is a meat offering.

entries.yo: Ki alufa ki o si sun ẹbọ-iranti rẹ̀, apakan ninu ọkà gigún rẹ̀, ati apakan ninu oróro rẹ̀, pẹlu gbogbo turari rẹ̀: ẹbọ ti a fi iná ṣe ni si OLUWA.
entries.en: And the priest shall burn the memorial of it, part of the beaten corn thereof, and part of the oil thereof, with all the frankincense thereof: it is an offering made by fire unto the LORD.

entries.yo: BI ọrẹ-ẹbọ rẹ̀ ba si ṣe ẹbọ alafia, bi o ba mú u lati inu ọwọ́-ẹran wá, on iba ṣe akọ tabi abo, ki o mú u wá siwaju OLUWA li ailabùku.
entries.en: And if his oblation be a sacrifice of peace offering, if he offer it of the herd; whether it be a male or female, he shall offer it without blemish before the LORD.

entries.yo: Ki o si fi ọwọ́ rẹ̀ lé ori ọrẹ-ẹbọ rẹ̀, ki o si pa a li ẹnu-ọ̀na agọ́ ajọ: ki awọn alufa, awọn ọmọ Aaroni ki o si fi ẹ̀jẹ na wọ́n ori pẹpẹ nì yiká.
entries.en: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of his offering, and kill it at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron's sons the priests shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar round about.

entries.yo: Ki o si mú ninu ẹbọ alafia nì wá, ọrẹ-ẹbọ ti a fi iná ṣe si OLUWA; ọrá ti o bò ifun lori, ati gbogbo ọrá ti mbẹ lara ifun na.
entries.en: And he shall offer of the sacrifice of the peace offering an offering made by fire unto the LORD; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,

entries.yo: Ati iwe nì mejeji, ati ọrá ti mbẹ́ lara wọn, ti mbẹ li ẹba ìha, ati àwọn ti o bò ẹ̀dọ, pẹlu iwe nì, on ni ki o mú kuro.
entries.en: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away.

entries.yo: Ki awọn ọmọ Aaroni ki o si sun u lori pẹpẹ nì lori ẹbọ sisun, ti mbẹ lori igi ti o wà lori iná: ẹbọ ti a fi iná ṣe ni, õrùn didùn si OLUWA.
entries.en: And Aaron's sons shall burn it on the altar upon the burnt sacrifice, which is upon the wood that is on the fire: it is an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.

entries.yo: Bi ọrẹ-ẹbọ rẹ̀ fun ọrẹ-ẹbọ alafia si OLUWA ba ṣe ti agbo-ẹran; akọ tabi abo, ki o mú u wá li ailabùku.
entries.en: And if his offering for a sacrifice of peace offering unto the LORD be of the flock; male or female, he shall offer it without blemish.

entries.yo: Bi o ba mu ọdọ-agutan wá fun ọrẹ-ẹbọ rẹ̀, njẹ ki o mú u wá siwaju OLUWA:
entries.en: If he offer a lamb for his offering, then shall he offer it before the LORD.

entries.yo: Ki o si fi ọwọ́ rẹ̀ lé ori ọrẹ-ẹbọ rẹ̀, ki o si pa a niwaju agọ́ ajọ: ki awọn ọmọ Aaroni ki o si fi ẹ̀jẹ rẹ̀ wọ́n ori pẹpẹ na yiká.
entries.en: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of his offering, and kill it before the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron's sons shall sprinkle the blood thereof round about upon the altar.

entries.yo: Ki o si múwa ninu ẹbọ alafia nì, ẹbọ ti a fi iná ṣe si OLUWA; ọrá rẹ̀, ati gbogbo ìru rẹ̀ ti o lọrá, on ni ki o mú kuro sunmọ egungun ẹhin; ati ọrá ti o bò ifun lori, ati gbogbo ọrá ti mbẹ lara ifun,
entries.en: And he shall offer of the sacrifice of the peace offering an offering made by fire unto the LORD; the fat thereof, and the whole rump, it shall he take off hard by the backbone; and the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,

entries.yo: Ati iwe mejeji, ati ọrá ti mbẹ lara wọn, ti mbẹ lẹba ìha, ati àwọn ti o bò ẹ̀dọ, pẹlu iwe nì, on ni ki o mú kuro.
entries.en: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, which is by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away.

entries.yo: Ki alufa ki o si sun u lori pẹpẹ: onjẹ ẹbọ ti a fi iná ṣe si OLUWA ni.
entries.en: And the priest shall burn it upon the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire unto the LORD.

entries.yo: Bi ọrẹ-ẹbọ rẹ̀ ba si ṣe ewurẹ, njẹ ki o mú u wá siwaju OLUWA:
entries.en: And if his offering be a goat, then he shall offer it before the LORD.

entries.yo: Ki o si fi ọwọ́ rẹ̀ lé ori rẹ̀, ki o si pa a niwaju agọ́ ajọ: ki awọn ọmọ Aaroni ki o si fi ẹ̀jẹ rẹ̀ wọ́n ori pẹpẹ na yiká.
entries.en: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of it, and kill it before the tabernacle of the congregation: and the sons of Aaron shall sprinkle the blood thereof upon the altar round about.

entries.yo: Ki o si mú ninu ọrẹ-ẹbọ rẹ̀ wá, ani ẹbọ ti a fi iná ṣe si OLUWA; ọrá ti o bò ifun lori, ati gbogbo ọrá ti o mbẹ lara ifun,
entries.en: And he shall offer thereof his offering, even an offering made by fire unto the LORD; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,

entries.yo: Ati iwe nì mejeji, ati ọrá ti mbẹ lara wọn, ti mbẹ lẹba ìha, ati àwọn ti o bò ẹ̀dọ, pẹlu iwe nì, on ni ki o mú kuro.
entries.en: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, which is by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away.

entries.yo: Ki alufa ki o si sun wọn lori pẹpẹ: onjẹ ẹbọ ti a fi iná ṣe fun õrùn didùn ni: ti OLUWA ni gbogbo ọrá.
entries.en: And the priest shall burn them upon the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire for a sweet savour: all the fat is the LORD's.

entries.yo: Ìlana titilai ni fun irandiran nyin, ni gbogbo ibugbé nyin, pe ki ẹnyin ki o máṣe jẹ ọrá tabi ẹ̀jẹ.
entries.en: It shall be a perpetual statute for your generations throughout all your dwellings, that ye eat neither fat nor blood.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Sọ fun awọn ọmọ Israeli pe, Bi ọkàn kan ba fi aimọ̀ sẹ̀ si ọkan ninu ofin OLUWA, li ohun ti kò yẹ ni ṣiṣe, ti o si ṣẹ̀ si ọkan ninu wọn:
entries.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a soul shall sin through ignorance against any of the commandments of the LORD concerning things which ought not to be done, and shall do against any of them:

entries.yo: Bi alufa ti a fi oróro yàn ba ṣẹ̀ gẹgẹ bi ẹ̀ṣẹ awọn enia; nigbana ni ki o mú ẹgbọrọ akọmalu kan alailabùku fun ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ wá fun OLUWA nitori ẹ̀ṣẹ ti o ti ṣẹ̀.
entries.en: If the priest that is anointed do sin according to the sin of the people; then let him bring for his sin, which he hath sinned, a young bullock without blemish unto the LORD for a sin offering.

entries.yo: Ki o si mú akọmalu na wá si ẹnu-ọ̀na agọ́ ajọ niwaju OLUWA; ki o si fi ọwọ́ rẹ̀ lé ori akọmalu na, ki o si pa akọmalu na niwaju OLUWA.
entries.en: And he shall bring the bullock unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the LORD; and shall lay his hand upon the bullock's head, and kill the bullock before the LORD.

entries.yo: Ki alufa na ti a fi oróro yàn, ki o bù ninu ẹ̀jẹ akọmalu na, ki o si mú u wá si agọ́ ajọ:
entries.en: And the priest that is anointed shall take of the bullock's blood, and bring it to the tabernacle of the congregation:

entries.yo: Ki alufa na ki o tẹ̀ iká rẹ̀ bọ̀ inu ẹ̀jẹ na, ki o si fi ninu ẹ̀jẹ na wọ́n nkan nigba meje niwaju OLUWA, niwaju aṣọ-ikele ibi mimọ́.
entries.en: And the priest shall dip his finger in the blood, and sprinkle of the blood seven times before the LORD, before the vail of the sanctuary.

entries.yo: Ki alufa ki o si fi diẹ ninu ẹ̀jẹ na sara iwo pẹpẹ turari didùn niwaju OLUWA, eyiti mbẹ ninu agọ́ ajọ; ki o si dà gbogbo ẹ̀jẹ akọmalu nì si isalẹ pẹpẹ ẹbọsisun, ti mbẹ li ẹnu-ọ̀na agọ́ ajọ.
entries.en: And the priest shall put some of the blood upon the horns of the altar of sweet incense before the LORD, which is in the tabernacle of the congregation: and shall pour all the blood of the bullock at the bottom of the altar of the burnt offering, which is at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

entries.yo: Ki o si mú gbogbo ọrá akọmalu nì fun ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ kuro lara rẹ̀; ọrá ti o bò ifun lori, ati gbogbo ọrá ti mbẹ lara ifun na,
entries.en: And he shall take off from it all the fat of the bullock for the sin offering; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,

entries.yo: Ati iwe mejeji, ati ọrá ti mbẹ lara wọn, ti mbẹ lẹba ìha, ati àwọn ti o bò ẹ̀dọ, pẹlu iwe, on ni ki o mú kuro,
entries.en: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, which is by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away,

entries.yo: Bi a ti mú u kuro lara akọmalu ẹbọ-ọrẹ ẹbọ alafia: ki alufa ki o si sun wọn lori pẹpẹ ẹbọsisun.
entries.en: As it was taken off from the bullock of the sacrifice of peace offerings: and the priest shall burn them upon the altar of the burnt offering.

entries.yo: Ati awọ akọmalu na, ati gbogbo ẹran rẹ̀, pẹlu ori rẹ̀, ati pẹlu itan rẹ̀, ati ifun rẹ̀, ati igbẹ́ rẹ̀,
entries.en: And the skin of the bullock, and all his flesh, with his head, and with his legs, and his inwards, and his dung,

entries.yo: Ani gbogbo akọmalu na ni ki o mú jade lọ sẹhin ibudó si ibi mimọ́ kan, ni ibi ti a ndà ẽru si, ki o si fi iná sun u lori igi: ni ibi ti a ndà ẽru si ni ki a sun u.
entries.en: Even the whole bullock shall he carry forth without the camp unto a clean place, where the ashes are poured out, and burn him on the wood with fire: where the ashes are poured out shall he be burnt.

entries.yo: Bi gbogbo ijọ enia Israeli ba si fi aimọ̀ ṣẹ̀, ti ohun na si pamọ́ li oju ijọ, ti nwọn si ṣì ohun kan ṣe si ọkan ninu ofin OLUWA, ti a ki ba ṣe, ti nwọn si jẹbi;
entries.en: And if the whole congregation of Israel sin through ignorance, and the thing be hid from the eyes of the assembly, and they have done somewhat against any of the commandments of the LORD concerning things which should not be done, and are guilty;

entries.yo: Nigbati ẹ̀ṣẹ ti nwọn ba ti ṣẹ̀ si i, ba di mimọ̀, nigbana ni ki ijọ enia ki o mú ẹgbọrọ akọmalu kan wá nitori ẹ̀ṣẹ na, ki nwọn ki o si mú u wá siwaju agọ́ ajọ.
entries.en: When the sin, which they have sinned against it, is known, then the congregation shall offer a young bullock for the sin, and bring him before the tabernacle of the congregation.

entries.yo: Ki awọn àgbagba ijọ enia ki o fi ọwọ́ wọn lé ori akọmalu na niwaju OLUWA: ki a si pa akọmalu na niwaju OLUWA.
entries.en: And the elders of the congregation shall lay their hands upon the head of the bullock before the LORD: and the bullock shall be killed before the LORD.

entries.yo: Ki alufa ti a fi oróro yàn ki o si mú ninu ẹ̀jẹ akọmalu na wá si agọ́ ajọ:
entries.en: And the priest that is anointed shall bring of the bullock's blood to the tabernacle of the congregation:

entries.yo: Ki alufa na ki o si tẹ̀ iká rẹ̀ bọ̀ inu ẹ̀jẹ na, ki o si wọ́n ọ nigba meje niwaju OLUWA, niwaju aṣọ-ikele.
entries.en: And the priest shall dip his finger in some of the blood, and sprinkle it seven times before the LORD, even before the vail.

entries.yo: Ki o si fi diẹ ninu ẹ̀jẹ na sara iwo pẹpẹ ti mbẹ niwaju OLUWA, ti mbẹ ninu agọ́ ajọ, ki o si dà gbogbo ẹ̀jẹ na si isalẹ pẹpẹ ẹbọsisun, ti mbẹ li ẹnu-ọ̀na agọ́ ajọ.
entries.en: And he shall put some of the blood upon the horns of the altar which is before the LORD, that is in the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall pour out all the blood at the bottom of the altar of the burnt offering, which is at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

entries.yo: Ki o si mú gbogbo ọrá rẹ̀ lara rẹ̀, ki o si sun u lori pẹpẹ.
entries.en: And he shall take all his fat from him, and burn it upon the altar.

entries.yo: Ki o si fi akọmalu na ṣe; bi o ti fi akọmalu ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ ṣe, bẹ̃ni ki o si fi eyi ṣe: ki alufa na ki o si ṣètutu fun wọn, a o si dari rẹ̀ jì wọn.
entries.en: And he shall do with the bullock as he did with the bullock for a sin offering, so shall he do with this: and the priest shall make an atonement for them, and it shall be forgiven them.

entries.yo: Ki o si gbé akọmalu na jade lọ sẹhin ibudó, ki o si sun u bi o ti sun akọmalu iṣaju: ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ ni fun ijọ enia.
entries.en: And he shall carry forth the bullock without the camp, and burn him as he burned the first bullock: it is a sin offering for the congregation.

entries.yo: Nigbati ijoye kan ba ṣẹ̀, ti o si fi aimọ̀ rú ọkan ninu ofin OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ̀, ti a ki ba rú, ti o si jẹbi;
entries.en: When a ruler hath sinned, and done somewhat through ignorance against any of the commandments of the LORD his God concerning things which should not be done, and is guilty;

entries.yo: Tabi bi ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ̀, ninu eyiti o ti ṣẹ̀, ba di mímọ̀ fun u; ki o mú ọrẹ-ẹbọ rẹ̀ wá, ọmọ ewurẹ kan, akọ alailabùku:
entries.en: Or if his sin, wherein he hath sinned, come to his knowledge; he shall bring his offering, a kid of the goats, a male without blemish:

entries.yo: Ki o si fi ọwọ́ rẹ̀ lé ori ewurẹ na, ki o si pa a ni ibiti nwọn gbé npa ẹbọ sisun niwaju OLUWA: ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ ni.
entries.en: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the goat, and kill it in the place where they kill the burnt offering before the LORD: it is a sin offering.

entries.yo: Ki alufa na ki o si fi iká rẹ̀ mú ninu ẹ̀jẹ ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ na, ki o si fi i sara iwo pẹpẹ ẹbọsisun, ki o si dà ẹ̀jẹ si isalẹ pẹpẹ ẹbọsisun.
entries.en: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out his blood at the bottom of the altar of burnt offering.

entries.yo: Ki o si sun gbogbo ọrá rẹ̀ li ori pẹpẹ, bi ti ọrá ẹbọ alafia: ki alufa ki o si ṣètutu fun u nitori ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ̀, a o si dari rẹ̀ jì i.
entries.en: And he shall burn all his fat upon the altar, as the fat of the sacrifice of peace offerings: and the priest shall make an atonement for him as concerning his sin, and it shall be forgiven him.

entries.yo: Bi ọkan ninu awọn enia ilẹ na ba fi aimọ̀ sẹ̀, nigbati o ba ṣì ohun kan ṣe si ọkan ninu ofin OLUWA ti a ki ba ṣe, ti o si jẹbi;
entries.en: And if any one of the common people sin through ignorance, while he doeth somewhat against any of the commandments of the LORD concerning things which ought not to be done, and be guilty;

entries.yo: Tabi bi ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ̀, ti o ti ṣẹ̀, ba di mimọ̀ fun u, nigbana ni ki o mú ọrẹ-ẹbọ rẹ̀ wá, ọmọ ewurẹ kan, abo alailabùku, nitori ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ̀ ti o ti ṣẹ̀.
entries.en: Or if his sin, which he hath sinned, come to his knowledge: then he shall bring his offering, a kid of the goats, a female without blemish, for his sin which he hath sinned.

entries.yo: Ki o si fi ọwọ́ rẹ̀ lé ori ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ na, ki o si pa ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ na ni ibi ẹbọsisun.
entries.en: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin offering, and slay the sin offering in the place of the burnt offering.

entries.yo: Ki alufa ki o si fi iká rẹ̀ mú ninu ẹ̀jẹ na, ki o si fi i sara iwo pẹpẹ ẹbọsisun, ki o si dà gbogbo ẹ̀jẹ rẹ̀ si isalẹ pẹpẹ.
entries.en: And the priest shall take of the blood thereof with his finger, and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out all the blood thereof at the bottom of the altar.

entries.yo: Ki o si mú gbogbo ọrá rẹ̀ kuro, bi a ti imú ọrá kuro ninu ẹbọ ọrẹ-ẹbọ alafia; ki alufa ki o si sun u lori pẹpẹ fun õrùn didùn si OLUWA; ki alufa na ki o si ṣètutu fun u, a o si dari rẹ̀ jì i.
entries.en: And he shall take away all the fat thereof, as the fat is taken away from off the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall burn it upon the altar for a sweet savour unto the LORD; and the priest shall make an atonement for him, and it shall be forgiven him.

entries.yo: Bi o ba si mú ọdọ-agutan kan wá fun ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ, ki o si mú u wá, abo alailabùku.
entries.en: And if he bring a lamb for a sin offering, he shall bring it a female without blemish.

entries.yo: Ki o si fi ọwọ́ rẹ̀ lé ori ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ na, ki o si pa a fun ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ ni ibi ti nwọn gbé npa ẹbọ sisun.
entries.en: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin offering, and slay it for a sin offering in the place where they kill the burnt offering

entries.yo: Ki alufa ki o si fi iká rẹ̀ mú ninu ẹ̀jẹ ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ na, ki o si fi i sara iwo pẹpẹ ẹbọsisun, ki o si dà gbogbo ẹ̀jẹ rẹ̀ si isalẹ pẹpẹ:
entries.en: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out all the blood thereof at the bottom of the altar:

entries.yo: Ki o si mú gbogbo ọrá rẹ̀ kuro, bi a ti imú ọrá ọdọ-agutan kuro ninu ẹbọ ọrẹ-ẹbọ alafia; ki alufa ki o si sun wọn lori pẹpẹ, gẹgẹ bi ẹbọ ti a fi iná ṣe si OLUWA: ki alufa ki o si ṣètutu fun ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ̀ ti o ti ṣẹ̀, a o si dari rẹ̀ jì i.
entries.en: And he shall take away all the fat thereof, as the fat of the lamb is taken away from the sacrifice of the peace offerings; and the priest shall burn them upon the altar, according to the offerings made by fire unto the LORD: and the priest shall make an atonement for his sin that he hath committed, and it shall be forgiven him.

entries.yo: BI ẹnikan ba si ṣẹ̀, ti o si gbọ́ ohùn ibura, ti o si ṣe ẹlẹri, bi on ba ri tabi bi on ba mọ̀, ti kò ba wi, njẹ ki o rù aiṣedede rẹ̀.
entries.en: And if a soul sin, and hear the voice of swearing, and is a witness, whether he hath seen or known of it; if he do not utter it, then he shall bear his iniquity.

entries.yo: Tabi bi ẹnikan ba farakàn ohun alaimọ́ kan, iba ṣe okú ẹranko alaimọ́, tabi okú ẹranọ̀sin alaimọ́, tabi okú ohun ti nrakò alaimọ́, ti o ba si pamọ́ fun u, on pẹlu yio si ṣe alaimọ́, yio si jẹbi:
entries.en: Or if a soul touch any unclean thing, whether it be a carcase of an unclean beast, or a carcase of unclean cattle, or the carcase of unclean creeping things, and if it be hidden from him; he also shall be unclean, and guilty.

entries.yo: Tabi bi o ba farakàn ohun aimọ́ ti enia, ohunkohun aimọ́ ti o wù ki o ṣe ti a fi sọ enia di elẽri, ti o ba si pamọ́ fun u; nigbati o ba mọ̀, nigbana ni on yio jẹbi:
entries.en: Or if he touch the uncleanness of man, whatsoever uncleanness it be that a man shall be defiled withal, and it be hid from him; when he knoweth of it, then he shall be guilty.

entries.yo: Tabi bi ẹnikan ba bura, ti o nfi ète rẹ̀ sọ ati ṣe ibi, tabi ati ṣe rere, ohunkohun ti o wù ki o ṣe ti enia ba fi ibura sọ, ti o ba si pamọ́ fun u; nigbati o ba mọ̀, nigbana ni on yio jẹbi ọkan ninu ohun wọnyi:
entries.en: Or if a soul swear, pronouncing with his lips to do evil, or to do good, whatsoever it be that a man shall pronounce with an oath, and it be hid from him; when he knoweth of it, then he shall be guilty in one of these.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, nigbati o ba jẹbi ọkan ninu ohun wọnyi, ki o jẹwọ pe on ti ṣẹ̀ li ohun na.
entries.en: And it shall be, when he shall be guilty in one of these things, that he shall confess that he hath sinned in that thing:

entries.yo: Ki o si mú ẹbọ ẹbi rẹ̀ wá fun OLUWA, nitori ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ̀ ti o ti ṣẹ̀, abo lati inu agbo-ẹran wá, ọdọ-agutan tabi ọmọ ewurẹ kan, fun ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ; ki alufa ki o si ṣètutu fun u nitori ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the LORD for his sin which he hath sinned, a female from the flock, a lamb or a kid of the goats, for a sin offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for him concerning his sin.

entries.yo: Bi kò ba si le mú ọdọ-agutan wá, njẹ ki o mú àdaba meji tabi ọmọ ẹiyẹle meji wá fun ẹbọ ẹbi fun OLUWA nitori ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ̀, ti o ti ṣẹ̀; ọkan fun ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ, ati ekeji fun ẹbọ sisun.
entries.en: And if he be not able to bring a lamb, then he shall bring for his trespass, which he hath committed, two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, unto the LORD; one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering.

entries.yo: Ki o si mú wọn tọ̀ alufa wá, ẹniti yio tète rubọ eyiti iṣe ti ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ, ti yio si mi i li ọrùn, ṣugbọn ki yio pín i meji:
entries.en: And he shall bring them unto the priest, who shall offer that which is for the sin offering first, and wring off his head from his neck, but shall not divide it asunder:

entries.yo: Ki o si fi ninu ẹ̀jẹ ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ nì wọ́n ìha pẹpẹ; ati ẹ̀jẹ iyokù ni ki a ro si isalẹ pẹpẹ na: ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ ni.
entries.en: And he shall sprinkle of the blood of the sin offering upon the side of the altar; and the rest of the blood shall be wrung out at the bottom of the altar: it is a sin offering.

entries.yo: Ki o si ru ekeji li ẹbọ sisun, gẹgẹ bi ìlana na: ki alufa ki o si ṣètutu fun u, nitori ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ̀ ti o ti ṣẹ̀, a o si dari rẹ̀ jì i.
entries.en: And he shall offer the second for a burnt offering, according to the manner: and the priest shall make an atonement for him for his sin which he hath sinned, and it shall be forgiven him.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi on kò ba le mú àdaba meji, tabi ọmọ ẹiyẹle meji wá, njẹ ki ẹniti o ṣẹ̀ na ki o mú idamẹwa òṣuwọn efa iyẹfun daradara wá fun ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ; ki o máṣe fi oróro si i, bẹ̃ni ki o máṣe fi turari sori rẹ̀: nitoripe ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ ni.
entries.en: But if he be not able to bring two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, then he that sinned shall bring for his offering the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a sin offering; he shall put no oil upon it, neither shall he put any frankincense thereon: for it is a sin offering.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ki o mú u tọ̀ alufa wá, ki alufa ki o si bù ikunwọ rẹ̀ kan ninu rẹ̀, ani ẹbọ-iranti rẹ̀, ki o si sun u lori pẹpẹ na, gẹgẹ bi ẹbọ ti a fi iná ṣe si OLUWA: ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ ni.
entries.en: Then shall he bring it to the priest, and the priest shall take his handful of it, even a memorial thereof, and burn it on the altar, according to the offerings made by fire unto the LORD: it is a sin offering.

entries.yo: Ki alufa ki o si ṣètutu fun u nitori ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ̀ ti o ti ṣẹ̀ li ọkan ninu wọnyi, a o si dari rẹ̀ jì i: iyokù si jẹ́ ti alufa, bi ẹbọ ohunjijẹ.
entries.en: And the priest shall make an atonement for him as touching his sin that he hath sinned in one of these, and it shall be forgiven him: and the remnant shall be the priest's, as a meat offering.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Bi ẹnikan ba ṣìṣe, ti o ba si fi aimọ̀ ṣẹ̀ ninu ohun mimọ́ OLUWA; nigbana ni ki o múwa fun OLUWA nitori ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ̀, àgbo kan alailabùku lati inu agbo-ẹran wá, ni idiyele rẹ nipa ṣekeli fadakà, gẹgẹ bi ṣekeli ibi mimọ́ fun ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ.
entries.en: If a soul commit a trespass, and sin through ignorance, in the holy things of the LORD; then he shall bring for his trespass unto the LORD a ram without blemish out of the flocks, with thy estimation by shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for a trespass offering:

entries.yo: Ki o si ṣe atunṣe nitori ibi ti o ti ṣe ninu ohun mimọ́, ki o si fi idamarun pẹlu rẹ̀, ki o si fi i fun alufa: alufa yio si fi àgbo ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ na ṣètutu fun u, a o si dari rẹ̀ jì i.
entries.en: And he shall make amends for the harm that he hath done in the holy thing, and shall add the fifth part thereto, and give it unto the priest: and the priest shall make an atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering, and it shall be forgiven him.

entries.yo: Bi ẹnikan ba si ṣẹ̀, ti o ba si ṣe ọkan ninu nkan wọnyi, eyiti ofin OLUWA kọ̀ lati ṣe; bi kò tilẹ mọ̀, ṣugbọn o jẹbi, yio si rù ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And if a soul sin, and commit any of these things which are forbidden to be done by the commandments of the LORD; though he wist it not, yet is he guilty, and shall bear his iniquity.

entries.yo: Ki o si mú àgbo kan alailabùku lati inu agbo-ẹran tọ̀ alufa wá ni idiyele rẹ, fun ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ: ki alufa ki o si ṣètutu fun u nitori aimọ̀ rẹ̀ ninu eyiti o ṣìṣe ti kò si mọ̀, a o si dari rẹ̀ jì i.
entries.en: And he shall bring a ram without blemish out of the flock, with thy estimation, for a trespass offering, unto the priest: and the priest shall make an atonement for him concerning his ignorance wherein he erred and wist it not, and it shall be forgiven him.

entries.yo: Ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ ni: nitõtọ li o dẹ̀ṣẹ si OLUWA.
entries.en: It is a trespass offering: he hath certainly trespassed against the LORD.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Bi ẹnikan ba ṣẹ̀, ti o dẹ̀ṣẹ si OLUWA, ti o si sẹ́ fun ẹnikeji rẹ̀, li ohun ti o fi fun u pamọ́, tabi li ohun ti a fi dógo, tabi ohun ti a fi agbara gbà, tabi ti o rẹ ẹnikeji rẹ̀ jẹ;
entries.en: If a soul sin, and commit a trespass against the LORD, and lie unto his neighbour in that which was delivered him to keep, or in fellowship, or in a thing taken away by violence, or hath deceived his neighbour;

entries.yo: Tabi ti o ri ohun ti o nù he, ti o si ṣeké nitori rẹ̀, ti o si bura eké; li ọkan ninu gbogbo ohun ti enia ṣe, ti o ṣẹ̀ ninu rẹ̀:
entries.en: Or have found that which was lost, and lieth concerning it, and sweareth falsely; in any of all these that a man doeth, sinning therein:

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, bi o ba ti ṣẹ̀, ti o si jẹbi, ki o si mú ohun ti o fi agbara gbà pada, tabi ohun ti o fi irẹjẹ ní, tabi ohun ti a fi fun u pamọ́, tabi ohun ti o nù ti o rihe.
entries.en: Then it shall be, because he hath sinned, and is guilty, that he shall restore that which he took violently away, or the thing which he hath deceitfully gotten, or that which was delivered him to keep, or the lost thing which he found,

entries.yo: Tabi gbogbo eyi na nipa eyiti o bura eké; ki o tilẹ mú u pada li oju-owo rẹ̀, ki o si fi idamarun rẹ̀ lé ori rẹ̀, ki o si fi i fun olohun, li ọjọ́ ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Or all that about which he hath sworn falsely; he shall even restore it in the principal, and shall add the fifth part more thereto, and give it unto him to whom it appertaineth, in the day of his trespass offering.

entries.yo: Ki o si mú ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ̀ wá fun OLUWA, àgbo kan alailabùku lati inu agbo-ẹran tọ̀ alufa wá, ni idiyele rẹ fun ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ:
entries.en: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the LORD, a ram without blemish out of the flock, with thy estimation, for a trespass offering, unto the priest:

entries.yo: Alufa yio si ṣètutu fun u niwaju OLUWA, a o si dari rẹ̀ jì; nitori ohunkohun ninu gbogbo ohun eyiti o ti ṣe ti o si jẹbi ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the priest shall make an atonement for him before the LORD: and it shall be forgiven him for any thing of all that he hath done in trespassing therein.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Paṣẹ fun Aaroni ati fun awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ pe, Eyi li ofin ẹbọ sisun: Ẹbọ sisun ni, nitori sisun rẹ̀ lori pẹpẹ ni gbogbo oru titi di owurọ̀, iná pẹpẹ na yio si ma jò ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: Command Aaron and his sons, saying, This is the law of the burnt offering: It is the burnt offering, because of the burning upon the altar all night unto the morning, and the fire of the altar shall be burning in it.

entries.yo: Ki alufa ki o si mú ẹ̀wu ọ̀gbọ rẹ̀ wọ̀, ati ṣòkoto ọ̀gbọ rẹ̀ nì ki o fi si ara rẹ̀, ki o si kó ẽru ti iná jọ, ti on ti ẹbọ sisun lori pẹpẹ, ki o si fi i si ìha pẹpẹ.
entries.en: And the priest shall put on his linen garment, and his linen breeches shall he put upon his flesh, and take up the ashes which the fire hath consumed with the burnt offering on the altar, and he shall put them beside the altar.

entries.yo: Ki o si bọ́ ẹ̀wu rẹ̀ silẹ, ki o si mú ẹ̀wu miran wọ̀, ki o si gbé ẽru wọnni jade lọ sẹhin ibudó si ibi kan ti o mọ́.
entries.en: And he shall put off his garments, and put on other garments, and carry forth the ashes without the camp unto a clean place.

entries.yo: Ki iná ori pẹpẹ nì ki o si ma jó lori rẹ̀; ki a máṣe pa a; ki alufa ki o si ma kòná igi lori rẹ̀ li orowurọ̀, ki o si tò ẹbọ sisun sori rẹ̀; ki o si ma sun ọrá ẹbọ alafia lori rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the fire upon the altar shall be burning in it; it shall not be put out: and the priest shall burn wood on it every morning, and lay the burnt offering in order upon it; and he shall burn thereon the fat of the peace offerings.

entries.yo: Ki iná ki o ma jó titi lori pẹpẹ na; kò gbọdọ kú lai.
entries.en: The fire shall ever be burning upon the altar; it shall never go out.

entries.yo: Eyi si li ofin ẹbọ ohunjijẹ: ki awọn ọmọ Aaroni ki o ru u niwaju OLUWA, niwaju pẹpẹ.
entries.en: And this is the law of the meat offering: the sons of Aaron shall offer it before the LORD, before the altar.

entries.yo: Ki o si bù ikunwọ rẹ̀ kan ninu rẹ̀, ninu iyẹfun didara ẹbọ ohunjijẹ na, ati ti oróro rẹ̀, ati gbogbo turari ti mbẹ lori ẹbọ ohunjijẹ, ki o si sun u lori pẹpẹ fun õrùn didùn, ani fun iranti rẹ̀, si OLUWA.
entries.en: And he shall take of it his handful, of the flour of the meat offering, and of the oil thereof, and all the frankincense which is upon the meat offering, and shall burn it upon the altar for a sweet savour, even the memorial of it, unto the LORD.

entries.yo: Iyokù rẹ̀ ni Aaroni ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ yio jẹ: àkara alaiwu ni, ki a jẹ ẹ ni ibi mimọ́; ni agbalá agọ́ ajọ ni ki nwọn ki o jẹ ẹ.
entries.en: And the remainder thereof shall Aaron and his sons eat: with unleavened bread shall it be eaten in the holy place; in the court of the tabernacle of the congregation they shall eat it.

entries.yo: Ki a máṣe fi iwukàra yan a. Mo ti fi i fun wọn ni ipín ti wọn ninu ẹbọ mi ti a fi iná ṣe; mimọ́ julọ ni, bi ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ, ati bi ẹbọ ẹbi.
entries.en: It shall not be baken with leaven. I have given it unto them for their portion of my offerings made by fire; it is most holy, as is the sin offering, and as the trespass offering.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn ọkunrin ninu awọn ọmọ Aaroni ni ki o jẹ ninu rẹ̀, yio jasi aṣẹ titilai ni iraniran nyin, nipa ẹbọ OLUWA ti a fi iná ṣe: ẹnikẹni ti o ba kàn wọn yio di mimọ́.
entries.en: All the males among the children of Aaron shall eat of it. It shall be a statute for ever in your generations concerning the offerings of the LORD made by fire: every one that toucheth them shall be holy.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Eyi li ọrẹ-ẹbọ Aaroni ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, ti nwọn o ru si OLUWA, li ọjọ́ ti a fi oróro yàn a; idamẹwa òṣuwọn efa iyẹfun didara fun ẹbọ ohunjijẹ titilai, àbọ rẹ̀ li owurọ̀, ati àbọ rẹ̀ li alẹ.
entries.en: This is the offering of Aaron and of his sons, which they shall offer unto the LORD in the day when he is anointed; the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a meat offering perpetual, half of it in the morning, and half thereof at night.

entries.yo: Ninu awopẹtẹ ni ki a fi oróro ṣe e; nigbati a ba si bọ̀ ọ, ki iwọ ki o si mú u wọ̀ ile: ati ìṣu yiyan ẹbọ ohunjijẹ na ni ki iwọ ki o fi rubọ õrùn didùn si OLUWA.
entries.en: In a pan it shall be made with oil; and when it is baken, thou shalt bring it in: and the baken pieces of the meat offering shalt thou offer for a sweet savour unto the LORD.

entries.yo: Ati alufa ninu awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ ti a fi oróro yàn ni ipò rẹ̀ ni ki o ru u: aṣẹ titilai ni fun OLUWA, sisun ni ki a sun u patapata.
entries.en: And the priest of his sons that is anointed in his stead shall offer it: it is a statute for ever unto the LORD, it shall be wholly burnt.

entries.yo: Nitori gbogbo ẹbọ ohunjijẹ alufa, sisun ni ki a sun u patapata: a kò gbọdọ jẹ ẹ.
entries.en: For every meat offering for the priest shall be wholly burnt: it shall not be eaten.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Sọ fun Aaroni ati fun awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ pe, Eyi li ofin ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ: ni ibi ti a gbé pa ẹbọ sisun, ni ki a si pa ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ niwaju OLUWA: mimọ́ julọ ni.
entries.en: Speak unto Aaron and to his sons, saying, This is the law of the sin offering: In the place where the burnt offering is killed shall the sin offering be killed before the LORD: it is most holy.

entries.yo: Alufa ti o ru u fun ẹ̀ṣẹ ni ki o jẹ ẹ: ni ibi mimọ́ kan ni ki a jẹ ẹ, ninu agbalá agọ́ ajọ.
entries.en: The priest that offereth it for sin shall eat it: in the holy place shall it be eaten, in the court of the tabernacle of the congregation.

entries.yo: Ohunkohun ti o ba kàn ẹran rẹ̀ yio di mimọ́: nigbati ẹ̀jẹ rẹ̀ ba si ta sara aṣọ kan, ki iwọ ki o si fọ̀ eyiti o ta si na ni ibi mimọ́ kan.
entries.en: Whatsoever shall touch the flesh thereof shall be holy: and when there is sprinkled of the blood thereof upon any garment, thou shalt wash that whereon it was sprinkled in the holy place.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ohunèlo àmọ, ninu eyiti a gbé bọ̀ ọ on ni ki a fọ́; bi a ba si bọ̀ ọ ninu ìkoko idẹ, ki a si fọ̀ ọ, ki a si ṣìn i ninu omi.
entries.en: But the earthen vessel wherein it is sodden shall be broken: and if it be sodden in a brasen pot, it shall be both scoured, and rinsed in water.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn ọkunrin ninu awọn alufa ni ki o jẹ ninu rẹ̀: mimọ́ julọ ni.
entries.en: All the males among the priests shall eat thereof: it is most holy.

entries.yo: Kò si sí ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ kan, ẹ̀jẹ eyiti a múwa sinu agọ́ ajọ, lati fi ṣètutu ni ibi mimọ́, ti a gbọdọ jẹ: sisun ni ki a sun u ninu iná.
entries.en: And no sin offering, whereof any of the blood is brought into the tabernacle of the congregation to reconcile withal in the holy place, shall be eaten: it shall be burnt in the fire.

entries.yo: EYI si li ofin ẹbọ ẹbi: mimọ́ julọ ni.
entries.en: Likewise this is the law of the trespass offering: it is most holy.

entries.yo: Ni ibi ti nwọn gbé pa ẹbọ sisun ni ki nwọn ki o pa ẹbọ ẹbi: ki o si fi ẹ̀jẹ rẹ̀ wọ́n ori pẹpẹ yiká.
entries.en: In the place where they kill the burnt offering shall they kill the trespass offering: and the blood thereof shall he sprinkle round about upon the altar.

entries.yo: Ki o si fi gbogbo ọrá inu rẹ̀ rubọ; ìru rẹ̀ ti o lọrá, ati ọrá ti o bò ifun lori,
entries.en: And he shall offer of it all the fat thereof; the rump, and the fat that covereth the inwards,

entries.yo: Ati iwe mejeji, ati ọrá ti mbẹ lara wọn, ti mbẹ lẹba ìha, ati àwọn ti o bò ẹ̀dọ, pẹlu iwe, on ni ki o mú kuro:
entries.en: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the flanks, and the caul that is above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away:

entries.yo: Ki alufa ki o si sun wọn lori pẹpẹ, ẹbọ ti a fi iná ṣe si OLUWA: ẹbọ ẹbi ni.
entries.en: And the priest shall burn them upon the altar for an offering made by fire unto the LORD: it is a trespass offering.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ọkunrin ninu awọn alufa ni ki o jẹ ninu rẹ̀: ni ibi mimọ́ kan ki a jẹ ẹ: mimọ́ julọ ni.
entries.en: Every male among the priests shall eat thereof: it shall be eaten in the holy place: it is most holy.

entries.yo: Bi ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ, bẹ̃ si li ẹbọ ẹbi: ofin kan ni fun wọn: alufa ti nfi i ṣètutu ni ki on ní i.
entries.en: As the sin offering is, so is the trespass offering: there is one law for them: the priest that maketh atonement therewith shall have it.

entries.yo: Ati alufa ti nru ẹbọ sisun ẹnikẹni, ani alufa na ni yio ní awọ ẹran ẹbọ sisun, ti o ru fun ara rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the priest that offereth any man's burnt offering, even the priest shall have to himself the skin of the burnt offering which he hath offered.

entries.yo: Ati gbogbo ẹbọ ohunjijẹ ti a yan ninu àro, ati gbogbo eyiti a yan ninu apẹ, ati ninu awopẹtẹ, ni ki o jẹ́ ti alufa ti o ru u.
entries.en: And all the meat offering that is baken in the oven, and all that is dressed in the fryingpan, and in the pan, shall be the priest's that offereth it.

entries.yo: Ati gbogbo ẹbọ ohunjijẹ ti a fi oróro pò, ati gbigbẹ, ni ki gbogbo awọn ọmọ Aaroni ki o ní, ẹnikan bi ẹnikeji rẹ̀.
entries.en: And every meat offering, mingled with oil, and dry, shall all the sons of Aaron have, one as much as another.

entries.yo: Eyi si ni ofin ẹbọ alafia, ti on o ru si OLUWA.
entries.en: And this is the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which he shall offer unto the LORD.

entries.yo: Bi o ba mú u wá fun idupẹ́, njẹ ki o mú adidùn àkara alaiwu wá ti a fi oróro pò, pẹlu ẹbọ ọpẹ́ rẹ̀, ati àkara fẹlẹfẹlẹ alaiwu ti a ta oróro si, ati adidùn àkara iyẹfun didara, ti a fi oróro pò, ti a din.
entries.en: If he offer it for a thanksgiving, then he shall offer with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mingled with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and cakes mingled with oil, of fine flour, fried.

entries.yo: Pẹlu adidùn àkara wiwu ki o mú ọrẹ-ẹbọ pẹlu ẹbọ alafia rẹ̀ wa fun idupẹ́.
entries.en: Besides the cakes, he shall offer for his offering leavened bread with the sacrifice of thanksgiving of his peace offerings.

entries.yo: Ati ninu rẹ̀ ni ki o mú ọkan kuro ninu gbogbo ọrẹ-ẹbọ na fun ẹbọ agbesọsoke si OLUWA; ki o si jẹ́ ti alufa ti o nwọ́n ẹ̀jẹ ẹbọ alafia.
entries.en: And of it he shall offer one out of the whole oblation for an heave offering unto the LORD, and it shall be the priest's that sprinkleth the blood of the peace offerings.

entries.yo: Ati ẹran ẹbọ alafia rẹ̀ fun idupẹ́, ki a jẹ ẹ li ọjọ́ na ti a fi rubọ; ki o máṣe kù ninu rẹ̀ silẹ titi di owurọ̀.
entries.en: And the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving shall be eaten the same day that it is offered; he shall not leave any of it until the morning.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi ẹbọ-ọrẹ rẹ̀ ba ṣe ti ẹjẹ́, tabi ọrẹ-ẹbọ atinuwá, ki a jẹ ẹ li ọjọ́ na ti o ru ẹbọ rẹ̀: ati ni ijọ́ keji ni ki a jẹ iyokù rẹ̀ pẹlu:
entries.en: But if the sacrifice of his offering be a vow, or a voluntary offering, it shall be eaten the same day that he offereth his sacrifice: and on the morrow also the remainder of it shall be eaten:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn iyokù ninu ẹran ẹbọ na ni ijọ́ kẹta ni ki a fi iná sun.
entries.en: But the remainder of the flesh of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burnt with fire.
