entries.yo: Bi a ba si jẹ ninu ẹran ẹbọ alafia rẹ̀ rára ni ijọ́ kẹta, ki yio dà, bẹ̃li a ki yio kà a si fun ẹniti o ru u: irira ni yio jasi, ọkàn ti o ba si jẹ ẹ yio rù ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And if any of the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings be eaten at all on the third day, it shall not be accepted, neither shall it be imputed unto him that offereth it: it shall be an abomination, and the soul that eateth of it shall bear his iniquity.

entries.yo: Ẹran ti o ba si kàn ohun aimọ́ kan, a kò gbọdọ jẹ ẹ; sisun ni ki a fi iná sun u. Ṣugbọn ẹran na ni, gbogbo ẹniti o mọ́ ni ki o jẹ ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the flesh that toucheth any unclean thing shall not be eaten; it shall be burnt with fire: and as for the flesh, all that be clean shall eat thereof.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ọkàn na ti o ba jẹ ninu ẹran ẹbọ alafia, ti iṣe ti OLUWA, ti on ti ohun aimọ́ rẹ̀ lara rẹ̀, ani ọkàn na li a o ke kuro ninu awọn enia rẹ̀.
entries.en: But the soul that eateth of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings, that pertain unto the LORD, having his uncleanness upon him, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu ọkàn na ti o ba fọwọkàn ohun aimọ́ kan, bi aimọ́ enia, tabi ẹranko alaimọ́, tabi ohun irira elẽri, ti o si jẹ ninu ẹran ẹbọ alafia, ti iṣe ti OLUWA, ani ọkàn na li a o ke kuro ninu awọn enia rẹ̀.
entries.en: Moreover the soul that shall touch any unclean thing, as the uncleanness of man, or any unclean beast, or any abominable unclean thing, and eat of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which pertain unto the LORD, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Sọ fun awọn ọmọ Israeli pe, Ẹnyin kò gbọdọ jẹ ọrákọra akọmalu, tabi ti agutan, tabi ti ewurẹ.
entries.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Ye shall eat no manner of fat, of ox, or of sheep, or of goat.

entries.yo: Ati ọrá ẹran ti o tikara rẹ̀ kú, ati ọrá eyiti ẹranko fàya, on ni ki a ma lò ni ilò miran: ṣugbọn ẹnyin kò gbọdọ jẹ ẹ.
entries.en: And the fat of the beast that dieth of itself, and the fat of that which is torn with beasts, may be used in any other use: but ye shall in no wise eat of it.

entries.yo: Nitoripe ẹnikẹni ti o ba jẹ ọrá ẹran, ninu eyiti enia mú rubọ ti a fi iná ṣe si OLUWA, ani ọkàn ti o ba jẹ ẹ on li a o ke kuro ninu awọn enia rẹ̀.
entries.en: For whosoever eateth the fat of the beast, of which men offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD, even the soul that eateth it shall be cut off from his people.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu ẹnyin kò gbọdọ jẹ ẹ̀jẹkẹjẹ, iba ṣe ti ẹiyẹ tabi ti ẹran, ninu ibugbé nyin gbogbo.
entries.en: Moreover ye shall eat no manner of blood, whether it be of fowl or of beast, in any of your dwellings.

entries.yo: Ọkànkọkàn ti o ba jẹ ẹ̀jẹkẹjẹ, ani ọkàn na li a o ke kuro ninu awọn enia rẹ̀.
entries.en: Whatsoever soul it be that eateth any manner of blood, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Sọ fun awọn ọmọ Israeli pe, Ẹniti o ba ru ẹbọ alafia rẹ̀ si OLUWA, ki o mú ọrẹ-ẹbọ rẹ̀ tọ̀ OLUWA wá ninu ẹbọ alafia rẹ̀:
entries.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, He that offereth the sacrifice of his peace offerings unto the LORD shall bring his oblation unto the LORD of the sacrifice of his peace offerings.

entries.yo: Ọwọ́ on tikara rẹ̀ ni ki o fi mú ẹbọ OLUWA ti a fi iná ṣe wá; ọrá pẹlu igẹ̀ rẹ̀, on ni ki o múwa, ki a le fì igẹ̀ na li ẹbọ fifì niwaju OLUWA.
entries.en: His own hands shall bring the offerings of the LORD made by fire, the fat with the breast, it shall he bring, that the breast may be waved for a wave offering before the LORD.

entries.yo: Ki alufa na ki o sun ọrá na lori pẹpẹ: ṣugbọn ki igẹ̀ na ki o jẹ́ ti Aaroni ati ti awọn ọmọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the priest shall burn the fat upon the altar: but the breast shall be Aaron's and his sons'.

entries.yo: Itan ọtún ni ki ẹnyin ki o fi fun alufa, fun ẹbọ agbesọsoke ninu ẹbọ alafia nyin.
entries.en: And the right shoulder shall ye give unto the priest for an heave offering of the sacrifices of your peace offerings.

entries.yo: Ninu awọn ọmọ Aaroni ẹniti o rubọ ẹ̀jẹ ẹbọ alafia, ati ọrá, ni ki o ní itan ọtun fun ipín tirẹ̀.
entries.en: He among the sons of Aaron, that offereth the blood of the peace offerings, and the fat, shall have the right shoulder for his part.

entries.yo: Nitoripe igẹ̀ fifì ati itan agbeṣọsoke, ni mo gbà lọwọ awọn ọmọ Israeli ninu ẹbọ alafia wọn, mo si fi wọn fun Aaroni alufa, ati fun awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ nipa ìlana titilai, lati inu awọn ọmọ Israeli.
entries.en: For the wave breast and the heave shoulder have I taken of the children of Israel from off the sacrifices of their peace offerings, and have given them unto Aaron the priest and unto his sons by a statute for ever from among the children of Israel.

entries.yo: Eyi ni ipín Aaroni, ati ìpín awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, ninu ẹbọ OLUWA ti a fi iná ṣe, li ọjọ́ na ti o mú wọn wá lati ṣe alufa OLUWA;
entries.en: This is the portion of the anointing of Aaron, and of the anointing of his sons, out of the offerings of the LORD made by fire, in the day when he presented them to minister unto the LORD in the priest's office;

entries.yo: Ti OLUWA palaṣẹ lati fi fun wọn lati inu awọn ọmọ Israeli, li ọjọ́ ti o fi oróro yàn wọn. Ìlana lailai ni iraniran wọn.
entries.en: Which the LORD commanded to be given them of the children of Israel, in the day that he anointed them, by a statute for ever throughout their generations.

entries.yo: Eyi li ofin ẹbọ sisun, ti ẹbọ ohunjijẹ, ati ti ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ, ati ti ẹbọ ẹbi, ati ti ìyasimimọ́, ati ti ẹbọ alafia;
entries.en: This is the law of the burnt offering, of the meat offering, and of the sin offering, and of the trespass offering, and of the consecrations, and of the sacrifice of the peace offerings;

entries.yo: Ti OLUWA palaṣẹ fun Mose li òke Sinai, li ọjọ́ ti o paṣẹ fun awọn ọmọ Israeli lati ma mú ọrẹ-ẹbọ wọn wá fun OLUWA ni ijù Sinai.
entries.en: Which the LORD commanded Moses in mount Sinai, in the day that he commanded the children of Israel to offer their oblations unto the LORD, in the wilderness of Sinai.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Mú Aaroni ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ pẹlu rẹ̀, ati ẹ̀wu wọnni, ati oróro itasori, ati akọmalu kan fun ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ, ati àgbo meji, ati agbọ̀n àkara alaiwu kan;
entries.en: Take Aaron and his sons with him, and the garments, and the anointing oil, and a bullock for the sin offering, and two rams, and a basket of unleavened bread;

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o si pè gbogbo ijọ enia jọ si ẹnu-ọ̀na agọ́ ajọ.
entries.en: And gather thou all the congregation together unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

entries.yo: Mose si ṣe bi OLUWA ti fi aṣẹ fun u; a si pe awọn enia jọ si ẹnu-ọ̀na agọ́ ajọ.
entries.en: And Moses did as the LORD commanded him; and the assembly was gathered together unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

entries.yo: Mose si wi fun ijọ enia pe, Eyi li ohun ti OLUWA palaṣẹ lati ṣe.
entries.en: And Moses said unto the congregation, This is the thing which the LORD commanded to be done.

entries.yo: Mose si mú Aaroni ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ wá, o si fi omi wẹ̀ wọn.
entries.en: And Moses brought Aaron and his sons, and washed them with water.

entries.yo: O si wọ̀ ọ li ẹ̀wu, o si fi amure dì i, o si fi aṣọ igunwa wọ̀ ọ, o si wọ̀ ọ li ẹ̀wu-efodi, o si fi onirũru-ọ̀na ọjá ẹ̀wu-efodi dì i, o si fi gbà a li ọjá.
entries.en: And he put upon him the coat, and girded him with the girdle, and clothed him with the robe, and put the ephod upon him, and he girded him with the curious girdle of the ephod, and bound it unto him therewith.

entries.yo: O si dì igbàiya mọ́ ọ; o si fi Urimu ati Tummimu sinu igbàiya na.
entries.en: And he put the breastplate upon him: also he put in the breastplate the Urim and the Thummim.

entries.yo: O si fi fila dé e li ori; ati lara fila na pẹlu, ani niwaju rẹ̀, li o fi awo wurà na si, adé mimọ́ nì; bi OLUWA ti fi aṣẹ fun Mose.
entries.en: And he put the mitre upon his head; also upon the mitre, even upon his forefront, did he put the golden plate, the holy crown; as the LORD commanded Moses.

entries.yo: Mose si mú oróro itasori, o si ta a sara agọ́, ati sara ohun gbogbo ti mbẹ ninu rẹ̀, o si yà wọn simimọ́.
entries.en: And Moses took the anointing oil, and anointed the tabernacle and all that was therein, and sanctified them.

entries.yo: O si mú ninu rẹ̀ fi wọ́n ori pẹpẹ nigba meje, o si ta a sara pẹpẹ na, ati si gbogbo ohunèlo rẹ̀, ati agbada ati ẹsẹ̀ rẹ̀, lati yà wọn simimọ́.
entries.en: And he sprinkled thereof upon the altar seven times, and anointed the altar and all his vessels, both the laver and his foot, to sanctify them.

entries.yo: O si dà ninu oróro itasori si ori Aaroni, o si ta a si i lara, lati yà a simimọ́.
entries.en: And he poured of the anointing oil upon Aaron's head, and anointed him, to sanctify him.

entries.yo: Mose si mú awọn ọmọ Aaroni wá, o si fi ẹ̀wu wọ̀ wọn, o si fi amure di wọn, o si fi fila dé wọn li ori; bi OLUWA ti fi aṣẹ fun Mose.
entries.en: And Moses brought Aaron's sons, and put coats upon them, and girded them with girdles, and put bonnets upon them; as the LORD commanded Moses.

entries.yo: O si mú akọmalu wá fun ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ: ati Aaroni ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ fọwọ́ wọn lé ori akọmalu na fun ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ.
entries.en: And he brought the bullock for the sin offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the bullock for the sin offering.

entries.yo: O si pa a; Mose si mú ẹ̀jẹ na, o si fi iká rẹ̀ tọ́ ọ sara iwo pẹpẹ na yiká, o si wẹ̀ pẹpẹ na mọ́, o si dà ẹ̀jẹ na si isalẹ pẹpẹ, o si yà a simimọ́, lati ṣètutu fun u.
entries.en: And he slew it; and Moses took the blood, and put it upon the horns of the altar round about with his finger, and purified the altar, and poured the blood at the bottom of the altar, and sanctified it, to make reconciliation upon it.

entries.yo: O si mú gbogbo ọrá ti mbẹ lara ifun, ati àwọn ti o bò ẹ̀dọ, ati iwe mejeji, ati ọrá wọn, Mose si sun u lori pẹpẹ.
entries.en: And he took all the fat that was upon the inwards, and caul above the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and Moses burned it upon the altar.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn akọmalu na, ati awọ rẹ̀, ati ẹran rẹ̀, ati igbẹ́ rẹ̀, on li o fi iná sun lẹhin ibudó; bi OLUWA ti fi aṣẹ fun Mose.
entries.en: But the bullock, and his hide, his flesh, and his dung, he burnt with fire without the camp; as the LORD commanded Moses.

entries.yo: O si mú àgbo ẹbọ sisun wá: Aaroni ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ si fọwọ́ wọn lé ori àgbo na.
entries.en: And he brought the ram for the burnt offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.

entries.yo: O si pa a: Mose si fi ẹ̀jẹ na wọ́n ori pẹpẹ yiká.
entries.en: And he killed it; and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about.

entries.yo: O si kun àgbo na; Mose si sun ori rẹ̀, ati ara rẹ̀, ati ọrá na.
entries.en: And he cut the ram into pieces; and Moses burnt the head, and the pieces, and the fat.

entries.yo: O si ṣìn ifun rẹ̀ ati itan rẹ̀ ninu omi; Mose si sun gbogbo àgbo na lori pẹpẹ: ẹbọ sisun fun õrùn didùn ni: ani ẹbọ ti a fi iná ṣe si OLUWA; bi OLUWA ti fi aṣẹ fun Mose.
entries.en: And he washed the inwards and the legs in water; and Moses burnt the whole ram upon the altar: it was a burnt sacrifice for a sweet savour, and an offering made by fire unto the LORD; as the LORD commanded Moses.

entries.yo: O si mú àgbo keji wá, àgbo ìyasimimọ́: Aaroni ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ si fọwọ́ wọn lé ori àgbo na.
entries.en: And he brought the other ram, the ram of consecration: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.

entries.yo: O si pa a; Mose si mú ninu ẹ̀jẹ rẹ̀, o si tọ́ ọ si eti ọtún Aaroni, ati si àtampako ọwọ́ ọtún rẹ̀, ati si àtampako ẹsẹ̀ ọtún rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he slew it; and Moses took of the blood of it, and put it upon the tip of Aaron's right ear, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot.

entries.yo: O si mú awọn ọmọ Aaroni wá, Mose si tọ́ ninu ẹ̀jẹ na si eti ọtún wọn, ati si àtampako ọwọ́ ọtún wọn, ati si àtampako ẹsẹ̀ ọtún wọn: Mose si fi ẹ̀jẹ na wọ́n ori pẹpẹ yiká.
entries.en: And he brought Aaron's sons, and Moses put of the blood upon the tip of their right ear, and upon the thumbs of their right hands, and upon the great toes of their right feet: and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about.

entries.yo: O si mú ọrá na, ati ìru ti o lọrá, ati gbogbo ọrá ti o mbẹ lara ifun, ati àwọn ti o bò ẹ̀dọ, ati iwe mejeji, ati ọrá wọn, ati itan ọtún:
entries.en: And he took the fat, and the rump, and all the fat that was upon the inwards, and the caul above the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and the right shoulder:

entries.yo: Ati lati inu agbọ̀n àkara alaiwu, ti o wà niwaju OLUWA, o mú adidùn àkara alaiwu kan, ati adidùn àkara oloróro kan, ati àkara fẹlẹfẹlẹ kan, o si fi wọn sori ọrá nì, ati si itan ọtún na:
entries.en: And out of the basket of unleavened bread, that was before the LORD, he took one unleavened cake, and a cake of oiled bread, and one wafer, and put them on the fat, and upon the right shoulder:

entries.yo: O si fi gbogbo rẹ̀ lé Aaroni li ọwọ́, ati lé ọwọ́ awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, o si fì wọn li ẹbọ fifì niwaju OLUWA.
entries.en: And he put all upon Aaron's hands, and upon his sons' hands, and waved them for a wave offering before the LORD.

entries.yo: Mose si gbà wọn li ọwọ́ wọn, o si sun wọn lori pẹpẹ li ẹbọ sisun: ìyasimimọ́ ni nwọn fun õrùn didùn: ẹbọ ti a fi iná ṣe ni si OLUWA.
entries.en: And Moses took them from off their hands, and burnt them on the altar upon the burnt offering: they were consecrations for a sweet savour: it is an offering made by fire unto the LORD.

entries.yo: Mose si mú igẹ̀ ẹran na, o si fì i li ẹbọ fifì niwaju OLUWA: nitori ipín ti Mose ni ninu àgbo ìyasimimọ́; bi OLUWA ti fi aṣẹ fun Mose.
entries.en: And Moses took the breast, and waved it for a wave offering before the LORD: for of the ram of consecration it was Moses' part; as the LORD commanded Moses.

entries.yo: Mose si mú ninu oróro itasori nì, ati ninu ẹ̀jẹ ti mbẹ lori pẹpẹ, o si fi i wọ́n ara Aaroni, ati ara aṣọ rẹ̀ wọnni, ati ara awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, ati ara aṣọ awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ pẹlu rẹ̀; o si yà Aaroni simimọ́, ati aṣọ rẹ̀ wọnni, ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, ati aṣọ awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ pẹlu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Moses took of the anointing oil, and of the blood which was upon the altar, and sprinkled it upon Aaron, and upon his garments, and upon his sons, and upon his sons' garments with him; and sanctified Aaron, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons' garments with him.

entries.yo: Mose si wi fun Aaroni ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ pe, Ẹ bọ̀ ẹran na li ẹnu-ọ̀na agọ́ ajọ: nibẹ̀ ni ki ẹnyin si jẹ ẹ pẹlu àkara nì ti mbẹ ninu agbọ̀n ìyasimimọ́, bi mo ti fi aṣẹ lelẹ wipe, Aaroni ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ ni ki o jẹ ẹ.
entries.en: And Moses said unto Aaron and to his sons, Boil the flesh at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and there eat it with the bread that is in the basket of consecrations, as I commanded, saying, Aaron and his sons shall eat it.

entries.yo: Eyiti o ba si kù ninu ẹran na ati ninu àkara na ni ki ẹnyin ki o fi iná sun.
entries.en: And that which remaineth of the flesh and of the bread shall ye burn with fire.

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o máṣe jade si ẹnu-ọ̀na agọ́ ajọ ni ijọ́ meje, titi ọjọ́ ìyasimimọ́ nyin yio fi pé; nitori ijọ́ meje ni a o fi yà nyin simimọ́.
entries.en: And ye shall not go out of the door of the tabernacle of the congregation in seven days, until the days of your consecration be at an end: for seven days shall he consecrate you.

entries.yo: Bi o ti ṣe li oni yi, bẹ̃li OLUWA fi aṣẹ lelẹ lati ṣe, lati ṣètutu fun nyin.
entries.en: As he hath done this day, so the LORD hath commanded to do, to make an atonement for you.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni ki ẹnyin ki o joko nibi ẹnu-ọ̀na agọ́ ajọ, li ọsán ati li oru ni ijọ́ meje, ki ẹnyin ki o si ma pa aṣẹ OLUWA mọ́, ki ẹnyin ki o má ba kú: nitoripe bẹ̃li a fi aṣẹ fun mi.
entries.en: Therefore shall ye abide at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation day and night seven days, and keep the charge of the LORD, that ye die not: for so I am commanded.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li Aaroni ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ ṣe ohun gbogbo ti OLUWA ti fi aṣẹ lelẹ lati ọwọ́ Mose wá.
entries.en: So Aaron and his sons did all things which the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses.

entries.yo: O si ṣe ni ijọ́ kẹjọ, ni Mose pè Aaroni ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, ati awọn àgba Israeli;
entries.en: And it came to pass on the eighth day, that Moses called Aaron and his sons, and the elders of Israel;

entries.yo: O si wi fun Aaroni pe, Mú ọmọ akọmalu kan fun ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ, ati àgbo kan alailabùku fun ẹbọ sisun, ki o fi wọn rubọ niwaju OLUWA.
entries.en: And he said unto Aaron, Take thee a young calf for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering, without blemish, and offer them before the LORD.

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o si sọ fun awọn ọmọ Israeli pe, Ẹ mú obukọ kan wá fun ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ; ati ọmọ malu kan, ati ọdọ-agutan kan, mejeji ọlọdún kan, alailabùku, fun ẹbọ sisun;
entries.en: And unto the children of Israel thou shalt speak, saying, Take ye a kid of the goats for a sin offering; and a calf and a lamb, both of the first year, without blemish, for a burnt offering;

entries.yo: Ati akọmalu kan ati àgbo kan fun ẹbọ alafia, lati fi ru ẹbọ niwaju OLUWA; ati ẹbọ ohunjijẹ ti a fi oróro pò: nitoripe li oni li OLUWA yio farahàn nyin.
entries.en: Also a bullock and a ram for peace offerings, to sacrifice before the LORD; and a meat offering mingled with oil: for to day the LORD will appear unto you.

entries.yo: Nwọn si mú ohun ti Mose filelẹ li aṣẹ́ wá siwaju agọ́ ajọ: gbogbo ijọ si sunmọtosi nwọn si duro niwaju OLUWA.
entries.en: And they brought that which Moses commanded before the tabernacle of the congregation: and all the congregation drew near and stood before the LORD.

entries.yo: Mose si wipe, Eyi li ohun ti OLUWA filelẹ li aṣẹ, ki ẹnyin ki o ṣe: ogo OLUWA yio si farahàn nyin.
entries.en: And Moses said, This is the thing which the LORD commanded that ye should do: and the glory of the LORD shall appear unto you.

entries.yo: Mose si sọ fun Aaroni pe, Sunmọ pẹpẹ, ki o si ru ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ, ati ẹbọ sisun rẹ, ki o si ṣètutu fun ara rẹ, ati fun awọn enia: ki o si ru ọrẹ-ẹbọ awọn enia, ki o si ṣètutu fun wọn; bi OLUWA ti fi aṣẹ lelẹ.
entries.en: And Moses said unto Aaron, Go unto the altar, and offer thy sin offering, and thy burnt offering, and make an atonement for thyself, and for the people: and offer the offering of the people, and make an atonement for them; as the LORD commanded.

entries.yo: Aaroni si sunmọ pẹpẹ, o si pa ọmọ malu ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ, ti iṣe ti on tikalarẹ̀.
entries.en: Aaron therefore went unto the altar, and slew the calf of the sin offering, which was for himself.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Aaroni si mú ẹ̀jẹ na tọ̀ ọ wá: o si tẹ̀ iká rẹ̀ bọ̀ inu ẹ̀jẹ na, o si tọ́ ọ sara iwo pẹpẹ, o si dà ẹ̀jẹ na si isalẹ pẹpẹ:
entries.en: And the sons of Aaron brought the blood unto him: and he dipped his finger in the blood, and put it upon the horns of the altar, and poured out the blood at the bottom of the altar:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ọrá, ati iwe, ati àwọn ti o bò ẹ̀dọ ti ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ, o sun u lori pẹpẹ; bi OLUWA ti fi aṣẹ fun Mose.
entries.en: But the fat, and the kidneys, and the caul above the liver of the sin offering, he burnt upon the altar; as the LORD commanded Moses.

entries.yo: Ati ẹran ati awọ li o fi iná sun lẹhin ibudó.
entries.en: And the flesh and the hide he burnt with fire without the camp.

entries.yo: O si pa ẹbọ sisun: awọn ọmọ Aaroni si mú ẹ̀jẹ rẹ̀ tọ̀ ọ wá, o si fi i wọ́n ori pẹpẹ yiká.
entries.en: And he slew the burnt offering; and Aaron's sons presented unto him the blood, which he sprinkled round about upon the altar.

entries.yo: Nwọn si mú ẹbọ sisun tọ̀ ọ wá, ti on ti ipín rẹ̀, ati ori: o si sun wọn lori pẹpẹ.
entries.en: And they presented the burnt offering unto him, with the pieces thereof, and the head: and he burnt them upon the altar.

entries.yo: O si ṣìn ifun ati itan rẹ̀, o si sun wọn li ẹbọ sisun lori pẹpẹ.
entries.en: And he did wash the inwards and the legs, and burnt them upon the burnt offering on the altar.

entries.yo: O si mú ọrẹ-ẹbọ awọn enia wá, o si mú obukọ, ti iṣe ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ fun awọn enia, o si pa a, o si fi i rubọ ẹ̀ṣẹ, bi ti iṣaju.
entries.en: And he brought the people's offering, and took the goat, which was the sin offering for the people, and slew it, and offered it for sin, as the first.

entries.yo: O si mú ẹbọ sisun wá, o si ru u gẹgẹ bi ìlana na.
entries.en: And he brought the burnt offering, and offered it according to the manner.

entries.yo: O si mú ẹbọ ohunjijẹ wá, o si bù ikunwọ kan ninu rẹ̀, o si sun u lori pẹpẹ, pẹlu ẹbọ sisun owurọ̀.
entries.en: And he brought the meat offering, and took an handful thereof, and burnt it upon the altar, beside the burnt sacrifice of the morning.

entries.yo: O si pa akọmalu ati àgbo fun ẹbọ alafia, ti iṣe ti awọn enia; awọn ọmọ Aaroni si mú ẹ̀jẹ na tọ̀ ọ wá, o si fi i wọ́n ori pẹpẹ yiká.
entries.en: He slew also the bullock and the ram for a sacrifice of peace offerings, which was for the people: and Aaron's sons presented unto him the blood, which he sprinkled upon the altar round about,

entries.yo: Ati ọrá inu akọmalu na ati ti inu àgbo na, ìru rẹ̀ ti o lọrá, ati eyiti o bò ifun, ati iwe, ati àwọn ti o bò ẹ̀dọ:
entries.en: And the fat of the bullock and of the ram, the rump, and that which covereth the inwards, and the kidneys, and the caul above the liver:

entries.yo: Nwọn si fi ọrá na lé ori igẹ̀ wọnni, o si sun ọrà na lori pẹpẹ.
entries.en: And they put the fat upon the breasts, and he burnt the fat upon the altar:

entries.yo: Ati igẹ̀ na ati itan ọtún ni Aaroni fì li ẹbọ fifì niwaju OLUWA; bi Mose ti fi aṣẹ lelẹ.
entries.en: And the breasts and the right shoulder Aaron waved for a wave offering before the LORD; as Moses commanded.

entries.yo: Aaroni si gbé ọwọ́ rẹ̀ soke si awọn enia, o si sure fun wọn; o si sọkalẹ kuro ni ibi irubọ ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ, ẹbọ sisun, ati ẹbọ alafia.
entries.en: And Aaron lifted up his hand toward the people, and blessed them, and came down from offering of the sin offering, and the burnt offering, and peace offerings.

entries.yo: Mose ati Aaroni si wọ̀ inu agọ́ ajọ, nwọn si jade, nwọn si sure fun awọn enia: ogo OLUWA si farahàn fun gbogbo enia.
entries.en: And Moses and Aaron went into the tabernacle of the congregation, and came out, and blessed the people: and the glory of the LORD appeared unto all the people.

entries.yo: Iná kan si ti ọdọ OLUWA jade wá, o si jó ẹbọ sisun ati ọrá ori pẹpẹ na; nigbati gbogbo awọn enia ri i, nwọn hó kùhu, nwọn si dojubolẹ.
entries.en: And there came a fire out from before the LORD, and consumed upon the altar the burnt offering and the fat: which when all the people saw, they shouted, and fell on their faces.

entries.yo: ATI Nadabu ati Abihu, awọn ọmọ Aaroni, olukuluku nwọn mú awo-turari rẹ̀, nwọn si fi iná sinu wọn, nwọn si fi turari sori wọn, nwọn si mú ajeji iná wá siwaju OLUWA, ti on kò fi aṣẹ fun wọn.
entries.en: And Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, took either of them his censer, and put fire therein, and put incense thereon, and offered strange fire before the LORD, which he commanded them not.

entries.yo: Iná si ti ọdọ OLUWA jade, o si run wọn, nwọn si kú niwaju OLUWA.
entries.en: And there went out fire from the LORD, and devoured them, and they died before the LORD.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Mose wi fun Aaroni pe, Eyiyi li OLUWA wipe, A o yà mi simimọ́ ninu awọn ti nsunmọ mi, ati niwaju awọn enia gbogbo li a o yìn mi li ogo. Aaroni si dakẹ.
entries.en: Then Moses said unto Aaron, This is it that the LORD spake, saying, I will be sanctified in them that come nigh me, and before all the people I will be glorified. And Aaron held his peace.

entries.yo: Mose si pé Miṣaeli ati Elsafani, awọn ọmọ Usieli arakunrin Aaroni, o si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ sunmọ ihin, ẹ gbé awọn arakunrin nyin kuro niwaju ibi mimọ́ jade sẹhin ibudó.
entries.en: And Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan, the sons of Uzziel the uncle of Aaron, and said unto them, Come near, carry your brethren from before the sanctuary out of the camp.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni nwọn sunmọ ibẹ̀, nwọn si gbé ti awọn ti ẹ̀wu wọn jade sẹhin ibudó; bi Mose ti wi.
entries.en: So they went near, and carried them in their coats out of the camp; as Moses had said.

entries.yo: Mose si wi fun Aaroni, ati fun Eleasari ati fun Itamari, awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ pe, Ẹ máṣe ṣi ibori nyin, bẹ̃ni ki ẹ má si ṣe fà aṣọ nyin ya; ki ẹnyin ki o má ba kú, ati ki ibinu ki o má ba wá sori gbogbo ijọ: ṣugbọn ki awọn arakunrin nyin, gbogbo ile Israeli ki o sọkun ijóna ti OLUWA ṣe yi.
entries.en: And Moses said unto Aaron, and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar, his sons, Uncover not your heads, neither rend your clothes; lest ye die, and lest wrath come upon all the people: but let your brethren, the whole house of Israel, bewail the burning which the LORD hath kindled.

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o má si ṣe jade kuro lati ibi ẹnu-ọ̀na agọ́ ajọ, ki ẹnyin ki o má ba kú: nitoripe oróro itasori OLUWA mbẹ lara nyin. Nwọn si ṣe gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ Mose.
entries.en: And ye shall not go out from the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, lest ye die: for the anointing oil of the LORD is upon you. And they did according to the word of Moses.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Aaroni pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Aaron, saying,

entries.yo: Máṣe mu ọti-waini tabi ọti lile, iwọ, tabi awọn ọmọ rẹ pẹlu rẹ, nigbati ẹnyin ba wọ̀ inu agọ́ ajọ lọ, ki ẹnyin ki o má ba kú: ìlana ni titilai ni iraniran nyin:
entries.en: Do not drink wine nor strong drink, thou, nor thy sons with thee, when ye go into the tabernacle of the congregation, lest ye die: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations:

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o le ma fi ìyatọ sãrin mimọ́ ati aimọ́, ati sãrin ẽri ati ailẽri;
entries.en: And that ye may put difference between holy and unholy, and between unclean and clean;

entries.yo: Ati ki ẹnyin ki o le ma kọ́ awọn ọmọ Israeli ni gbogbo ìlana ti OLUWA ti sọ fun wọn lati ọwọ́ Mose wá.
entries.en: And that ye may teach the children of Israel all the statutes which the LORD hath spoken unto them by the hand of Moses.

entries.yo: Mose si wi fun Aaroni, ati fun Eleasari ati fun Itamari, awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ ti o kù pe, Ẹ mú ẹbọ ohunjijẹ ti o kù ninu ẹbọ OLUWA, ti a fi iná ṣe, ki ẹ si jẹ ẹ lainí iwukàra lẹba pẹpẹ: nitoripe mimọ́ julọ ni:
entries.en: And Moses spake unto Aaron, and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar, his sons that were left, Take the meat offering that remaineth of the offerings of the LORD made by fire, and eat it without leaven beside the altar: for it is most holy:

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o si jẹ ẹ ni ibi mimọ́, nitoripe ipín tirẹ, ati ipín awọn ọmọ rẹ ni, ninu ẹbọ OLUWA ti a fi iná ṣe: nitoripe, bẹ̃li a fi aṣẹ fun mi.
entries.en: And ye shall eat it in the holy place, because it is thy due, and thy sons' due, of the sacrifices of the LORD made by fire: for so I am commanded.

entries.yo: Ati igẹ̀ fifì, ati itan agbesọsoke ni ki ẹnyin ki o jẹ ni ibi mimọ́ kan; iwọ, ati awọn ọmọkunrin rẹ, ati awọn ọmọbinrin rẹ pẹlu rẹ: nitoripe ipín tirẹ ni, ati ipín awọn ọmọ rẹ, ti a fi fun nyin ninu ẹbọ alafia awọn ọmọ Israeli.
entries.en: And the wave breast and heave shoulder shall ye eat in a clean place; thou, and thy sons, and thy daughters with thee: for they be thy due, and thy sons' due, which are given out of the sacrifices of peace offerings of the children of Israel.

entries.yo: Itan agbesọsoke ati igẹ̀ fifì ni ki nwọn ki o ma múwa pẹlu ẹbọ ti a fi iná ṣe ti ọrá, lati fì i fun ẹbọ fifì niwaju OLUWA: yio si ma jẹ́ tirẹ, ati ti awọn ọmọ rẹ pẹlu rẹ, nipa ìlana titilai; bi OLUWA ti fi aṣẹ lelẹ.
entries.en: The heave shoulder and the wave breast shall they bring with the offerings made by fire of the fat, to wave it for a wave offering before the LORD; and it shall be thine, and thy sons' with thee, by a statute for ever; as the LORD hath commanded.

entries.yo: Mose si fi pẹlẹpẹlẹ wá ewurẹ ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ nì, si kiyesi i, a ti sun u: o si binu si Eleasari ati Itamari, awọn ọmọ Aaroni ti o kù, wipe,
entries.en: And Moses diligently sought the goat of the sin offering, and, behold, it was burnt: and he was angry with Eleazar and Ithamar, the sons of Aaron which were left alive, saying,

entries.yo: Nitori kini ẹnyin kò ṣe jẹ ẹbọ èṣẹ na ni ibi mimọ́, nitoripe mimọ́ julọ ni, a si ti fi fun nyin lati rù ẹ̀ṣẹ ijọ enia, lati ṣètutu fun wọn niwaju OLUWA?
entries.en: Wherefore have ye not eaten the sin offering in the holy place, seeing it is most holy, and God hath given it you to bear the iniquity of the congregation, to make atonement for them before the LORD?

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, a kò mú ẹ̀jẹ rẹ̀ wá sinu ibi mimọ́: ẹnyin iba ti jẹ ẹ nitõtọ ni ibi mimọ́, bi mo ti paṣẹ.
entries.en: Behold, the blood of it was not brought in within the holy place: ye should indeed have eaten it in the holy place, as I commanded.

entries.yo: Aaroni si wi fun Mose pe, Kiyesi i, li oni ni nwọn ru ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ wọn ati ẹbọ sisun wọn niwaju OLUWA; irú nkan wọnyi li o si ṣubulù mi: emi iba si ti jẹ ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ li oni, o ha le dara li oju OLUWA?
entries.en: And Aaron said unto Moses, Behold, this day have they offered their sin offering and their burnt offering before the LORD; and such things have befallen me: and if I had eaten the sin offering to day, should it have been accepted in the sight of the LORD?

entries.yo: Nigbati Mose gbọ́ eyi inu rẹ̀ si tutù.
entries.en: And when Moses heard that, he was content.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose ati fun Aaroni, o wi fun wọn pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses and to Aaron, saying unto them,

entries.yo: Sọ fun awọn ọmọ Israeli pe, Wọnyi li ẹranko ti ẹnyin o ma jẹ ninu gbogbo ẹran ti mbẹ lori ilẹ aiye.
entries.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, These are the beasts which ye shall eat among all the beasts that are on the earth.

entries.yo: Ohunkohun ti o ba yà bàta-ẹsẹ̀, ti o si là li ẹsẹ̀, ti o si njẹ apọjẹ, ninu ẹran, on ni ki ẹnyin ki o ma jẹ.
entries.en: Whatsoever parteth the hoof, and is clovenfooted, and cheweth the cud, among the beasts, that shall ye eat.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn wọnyi ni ki ẹ máṣe jẹ ninu awọn ti njẹ apọjẹ, tabi awọn ti o si yà bàta-ẹsẹ̀: bi ibakasiẹ, nitoriti o njẹ apọjẹ ṣugbọn kò yà bàta-ẹsẹ, alaimọ́ li o jasi fun nyin.
entries.en: Nevertheless these shall ye not eat of them that chew the cud, or of them that divide the hoof: as the camel, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.

entries.yo: Ati gara, nitoriti o njẹ apọjẹ, ṣugbọn kò yà bàta-ẹsẹ̀, alaimọ́ li o jasi fun nyin.
entries.en: And the coney, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.

entries.yo: Ati ehoro, nitoriti o njẹ apọjẹ, ṣugbọn kò yà bàta-ẹsẹ̀, alaimọ́ li o jasi fun nyin.
entries.en: And the hare, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.

entries.yo: Ati ẹlẹdẹ̀, bi o ti yà bàta-ẹsẹ̀, ti o si là ẹsẹ̀, ṣugbọn on kò jẹ apọjẹ, alaimọ́ li o jasi fun nyin.
entries.en: And the swine, though he divide the hoof, and be clovenfooted, yet he cheweth not the cud; he is unclean to you.

entries.yo: Ninu ẹran wọn li ẹnyin kò gbọdọ jẹ, okú wọn li ẹnyin kò gbọdọ fọwọkàn; alaimọ́ ni nwọn jasi fun nyin.
entries.en: Of their flesh shall ye not eat, and their carcase shall ye not touch; they are unclean to you.

entries.yo: Wọnyi ni ki ẹnyin ki o ma jẹ ninu gbogbo ohun ti mbẹ ninu omi: ohunkohun ti o ba ní lẹbẹ ati ipẹ́, ninu omi, ninu okun, ati ninu odò, awọn ni ki ẹnyin ki o ma jẹ.
entries.en: These shall ye eat of all that are in the waters: whatsoever hath fins and scales in the waters, in the seas, and in the rivers, them shall ye eat.

entries.yo: Ati gbogbo eyiti kò ní lẹbẹ ati ipẹ́ li okun, ati li odò, ninu gbogbo ohun ti nrá ninu omi, ati ninu ohun alãye kan ti mbẹ ninu omi, irira ni nwọn o jasi fun nyin,
entries.en: And all that have not fins and scales in the seas, and in the rivers, of all that move in the waters, and of any living thing which is in the waters, they shall be an abomination unto you:

entries.yo: Ani irira ni nwọn o ma jẹ́ fun nyin: ẹnyin kò gbọdọ jẹ ninu ẹran wọn, okú wọn ni ẹ o sì kàsi irira.
entries.en: They shall be even an abomination unto you; ye shall not eat of their flesh, but ye shall have their carcases in abomination.

entries.yo: Ohunkohun ti kò ba ní lẹbẹ ati ipẹ́, ninu omi, on ni ki ẹnyin kàsi irira fun.
entries.en: Whatsoever hath no fins nor scales in the waters, that shall be an abomination unto you.

entries.yo: Wọnyi li ẹnyin o si ma kàsi irira ninu ẹiyẹ; awọn li a kò gbọdọ jẹ, irira ni nwọn iṣe: idì, ati aṣá-idì, ati idì-ẹja.
entries.en: And these are they which ye shall have in abomination among the fowls; they shall not be eaten, they are an abomination: the eagle, and the ossifrage, and the ospray,

entries.yo: Ati igún, ati aṣá li onirũru rẹ̀;
entries.en: And the vulture, and the kite after his kind;

entries.yo: Ati gbogbo ìwo li onirũru rẹ̀;
entries.en: Every raven after his kind;

entries.yo: Ati ogongo, ati owiwi, ati ẹlulu, ati awodi li onirũru rẹ̀,
entries.en: And the owl, and the night hawk, and the cuckow, and the hawk after his kind,

entries.yo: Ati òyo ati ìgo, ati owiwi;
entries.en: And the little owl, and the cormorant, and the great owl,

entries.yo: Ati ogbugbu, ati ofù, ati àkala;
entries.en: And the swan, and the pelican, and the gier eagle,

entries.yo: Ati àkọ, ati ondẹ li onirũru rẹ̀, ati atọka, ati adán.
entries.en: And the stork, the heron after her kind, and the lapwing, and the bat.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ohun ti nrakò, ti nfò ti o si nfi mẹrẹrin rìn ni ki ẹnyin kàsi irira fun nyin.
entries.en: All fowls that creep, going upon all four, shall be an abomination unto you.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn wọnyi ni ki ẹnyin ki o ma jẹ ninu gbogbo ohun ti nfò, ti nrakò, ti nfi gbogbo mẹrẹrin rìn, ti o ní tete lori ẹsẹ̀ wọn, lati ma fi ta lori ilẹ;
entries.en: Yet these may ye eat of every flying creeping thing that goeth upon all four, which have legs above their feet, to leap withal upon the earth;

entries.yo: Ani ninu wọnyi ni ki ẹnyin ma jẹ; eṣú ni irú rẹ̀, ati eṣú onihoho nipa irú rẹ̀, ati ọbọnbọn nipa irú rẹ̀, ati ẹlẹnga nipa irú rẹ̀.
entries.en: Even these of them ye may eat; the locust after his kind, and the bald locust after his kind, and the beetle after his kind, and the grasshopper after his kind.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn gbogbo ohun iyokù ti nfò ti nrakò, ti o ní ẹsẹ̀ mẹrin, on ni ki ẹnyin kàsi irira fun nyin.
entries.en: But all other flying creeping things, which have four feet, shall be an abomination unto you.

entries.yo: Nitori wọnyi li ẹnyin o si jẹ́ alaimọ́: ẹnikẹni ti o ba farakàn okú wọn ki o jẹ́ alaimọ́ titi di aṣalẹ:
entries.en: And for these ye shall be unclean: whosoever toucheth the carcase of them shall be unclean until the even.

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni ti o ba si rù ohun kan ninu okú wọn ki o fọ̀ aṣọ rẹ̀, ki o si jẹ́ alaimọ́ titi di aṣalẹ.
entries.en: And whosoever beareth ought of the carcase of them shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even.

entries.yo: Ẹranko gbogbo ti o yà bàta-ẹsẹ̀, ti kò si là ẹsẹ̀, tabi ti kò si jẹ apọjẹ, ki o jẹ́ alaimọ́ fun nyin: gbogbo ẹniti o ba farakàn wọn ki o jẹ́ alaimọ́.
entries.en: The carcases of every beast which divideth the hoof, and is not clovenfooted, nor cheweth the cud, are unclean unto you: every one that toucheth them shall be unclean.

entries.yo: Ati ohunkohun ti o ba si nrìn lori ẽkanna rẹ̀, ninu gbogbo onirũru ẹranko, ti nfi ẹsẹ̀ mẹrẹrin rìn, alaimọ́ ni nwọn fun nyin: ẹnikẹni ti o ba farakàn okú wọn ki o jẹ́ alaimọ́ titi di aṣalẹ.
entries.en: And whatsoever goeth upon his paws, among all manner of beasts that go on all four, those are unclean unto you: whoso toucheth their carcase shall be unclean until the even.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba si rù okú wọn ki o si fọ̀ aṣọ rẹ̀, ki o si jẹ́ alaimọ́ titi di aṣalẹ: alaimọ́ ni nwọn fun nyin.
entries.en: And he that beareth the carcase of them shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: they are unclean unto you.

entries.yo: Wọnyi ni yio si jasi alaimọ́ fun nyin ninu ohun ti nrakò lori ilẹ; ase, ati eku, ati awun nipa irú rẹ̀.
entries.en: These also shall be unclean unto you among the creeping things that creep upon the earth; the weasel, and the mouse, and the tortoise after his kind,

entries.yo: Ati ọmọ̃le, ati ahanhan, ati alãmu, ati agiliti, ati agẹmọ.
entries.en: And the ferret, and the chameleon, and the lizard, and the snail, and the mole.

entries.yo: Wọnyi li alaimọ́ fun nyin ninu gbogbo ohun ti nrakò: ẹnikẹni ti o ba farakàn okú wọn, ki o jẹ́ alaimọ́ titi di aṣalẹ.
entries.en: These are unclean to you among all that creep: whosoever doth touch them, when they be dead, shall be unclean until the even.

entries.yo: Ati lara ohunkohun ti okú wọn ba ṣubulù, ki o jasi alaimọ́; ibaṣe ohun èlo-igi, tabi aṣọ, tabi awọ, tabi àpo, ohunèlo ti o wù ki o ṣe, ninu eyiti a nṣe iṣẹ kan, a kò gbọdọ má fi bọ̀ inu omi, on o si jasi alaimọ́ titi di aṣalẹ; bẹ̃li a o si sọ ọ di mimọ́.
entries.en: And upon whatsoever any of them, when they are dead, doth fall, it shall be unclean; whether it be any vessel of wood, or raiment, or skin, or sack, whatsoever vessel it be, wherein any work is done, it must be put into water, and it shall be unclean until the even; so it shall be cleansed.

entries.yo: Ati gbogbo ohunèlo amọ̀, ninu eyiti ọkan ninu okú nwọn ba bọ́ si, ohunkohun ti o wù ki o wà ninu rẹ̀ yio di alaimọ́, ki ẹnyin ki o si fọ́ ọ.
entries.en: And every earthen vessel, whereinto any of them falleth, whatsoever is in it shall be unclean; and ye shall break it.

entries.yo: Ninu onjẹ gbogbo ti a o ba jẹ, ti irú omi nì ba dà si, yio di alaimọ́: ati ohun mimu gbogbo ti a o ba mu ninu irú ohunèlo na yio di alaimọ́.
entries.en: Of all meat which may be eaten, that on which such water cometh shall be unclean: and all drink that may be drunk in every such vessel shall be unclean.

entries.yo: Ati ohunkohun lara eyiti ninu okú wọn ba ṣubulù, yio di alaimọ́; iba ṣe àro, tabí idana, wiwó ni ki a wó wọn lulẹ: alaimọ́ ni nwọn, nwọn o si jẹ́ alaimọ́ fun nyin.
entries.en: And every thing whereupon any part of their carcase falleth shall be unclean; whether it be oven, or ranges for pots, they shall be broken down: for they are unclean, and shall be unclean unto you.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn orisun tabi kanga kan, ninu eyiti omi pupọ̀ gbé wà, yio jẹ́ mimọ́: ṣugbọn eyiti o ba kàn okú wọn yio jẹ́ alaimọ́.
entries.en: Nevertheless a fountain or pit, wherein there is plenty of water, shall be clean: but that which toucheth their carcase shall be unclean.

entries.yo: Bi ninu okú wọn ba bọ́ sara irugbìn kan ti iṣe gbigbìn, yio jẹ́ mimọ́.
entries.en: And if any part of their carcase fall upon any sowing seed which is to be sown, it shall be clean.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi a ba dà omi sara irugbìn na, ti ninu okú wọn ba si bọ́ sinu rẹ̀, yio si jẹ́ alaimọ́ fun nyin.
entries.en: But if any water be put upon the seed, and any part of their carcase fall thereon, it shall be unclean unto you.

entries.yo: Ati bi ẹran kan, ninu eyiti ẹnyin ba ma jẹ, ba kú; ẹniti o ba farakàn okú rẹ̀ yio jẹ́ alaimọ́ titi di aṣalẹ.
entries.en: And if any beast, of which ye may eat, die; he that toucheth the carcase thereof shall be unclean until the even.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba si jẹ ninu okú rẹ̀, ki o si fọ̀ aṣọ rẹ̀, ki o si jẹ́ alaimọ́ titi di aṣalẹ: ẹniti o ba si rù okú rẹ̀ ki o si fọ̀ aṣọ rẹ̀, ki o si jẹ́ alaimọ́ titi di aṣalẹ.
entries.en: And he that eateth of the carcase of it shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: he also that beareth the carcase of it shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even.

entries.yo: Ati ohun gbogbo ti nrakò lori ilẹ yio jasi irira; a ki yio jẹ ẹ.
entries.en: And every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth shall be an abomination; it shall not be eaten.

entries.yo: Ohunkohun ti nfi inu wọ́, ati ohunkohun ti nfi mẹrẹrin rìn, ati ohunkohun ti o ba ní ẹsẹ̀ pupọ̀, ani ohun gbogbo ti nrakò lori ilẹ, awọn li ẹnyin kò gbọdọ jẹ; nitoripe irira ni nwọn.
entries.en: Whatsoever goeth upon the belly, and whatsoever goeth upon all four, or whatsoever hath more feet among all creeping things that creep upon the earth, them ye shall not eat; for they are an abomination.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin kò gbọdọ fi ohun kan ti nrakò, sọ ara nyin di irira, bẹ̃li ẹnyin kò gbọdọ fi wọn sọ ara nyin di alaimọ́ ti ẹnyin o fi ti ipa wọn di elẽri.
entries.en: Ye shall not make yourselves abominable with any creeping thing that creepeth, neither shall ye make yourselves unclean with them, that ye should be defiled thereby.

entries.yo: Nitoripe Emi li OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin: nitorina ni ki ẹnyin ki o yà ara nyin si mimọ́, ki ẹnyin ki o si jẹ́ mimọ́; nitoripe mimọ́ li Emi: bẹ̃li ẹnyin kò gbọdọ fi ohunkohun ti nrakò sọ ara nyin di elẽri.
entries.en: For I am the LORD your God: ye shall therefore sanctify yourselves, and ye shall be holy; for I am holy: neither shall ye defile yourselves with any manner of creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.

entries.yo: Nitoripe Emi li OLUWA ti o mú nyin gòke ti ilẹ Egipti wá, lati ma ṣe Ọlọrun nyin: nitorina ki ẹnyin ki o jẹ́ mimọ́, nitoripe mimọ́ li Emi.
entries.en: For I am the LORD that bringeth you up out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: ye shall therefore be holy, for I am holy.

entries.yo: Eyiyi li ofin ẹranko, ati ti ẹiyẹ, ati ti ẹda gbogbo alãye ti nrá ninu omi, ati ti ẹda gbogbo ti nrakò lori ilẹ:
entries.en: This is the law of the beasts, and of the fowl, and of every living creature that moveth in the waters, and of every creature that creepeth upon the earth:

entries.yo: Lati fi iyatọ sãrin aimọ́ ati mimọ́, ati sãrin ohun alãye ti a ba ma jẹ, ati ohun alãye ti a ki ba jẹ.
entries.en: To make a difference between the unclean and the clean, and between the beast that may be eaten and the beast that may not be eaten.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Sọ fun awọn ọmọ Israeli pe, Bi obinrin kan ba lóyun, ti o si bi ọmọkunrin, nigbana ni ki o jẹ́ alaimọ́ ni ijọ́ meje; gẹgẹ bi ọjọ́ ìyasọtọ fun ailera rẹ̀ ni ki o jẹ́ alaimọ́.
entries.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a woman have conceived seed, and born a man child: then she shall be unclean seven days; according to the days of the separation for her infirmity shall she be unclean.

entries.yo: Ni ijọ́ kẹjọ ni ki a si kọ ọmọkunrin na nilà.
entries.en: And in the eighth day the flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised.

entries.yo: Ki obinrin na ki o si wà ninu ẹ̀jẹ ìwẹnumọ́ rẹ̀ li ọjọ́ mẹtalelọgbọ̀n; ki o máṣe fọwọkàn ohun mimọ́ kan, bẹ̃ni ki o máṣe lọ sinu ibi mimọ́, titi ọjọ́ ìwẹnumọ́ rẹ̀ yio fi pé.
entries.en: And she shall then continue in the blood of her purifying three and thirty days; she shall touch no hallowed thing, nor come into the sanctuary, until the days of her purifying be fulfilled.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi o ba bi ọmọbinrin, nigbana ni ki o jẹ́ alaimọ́ li ọsẹ̀ meji, bi ti inu ìyasọtọ rẹ̀: ki o si wà ninu ẹ̀jẹ ìwẹnumọ́ rẹ̀ li ọgọta ọjọ́ o le mẹfa.
entries.en: But if she bear a maid child, then she shall be unclean two weeks, as in her separation: and she shall continue in the blood of her purifying threescore and six days.

entries.yo: Nigbati ọjọ́ ìwẹnumọ́ rẹ̀ ba pé, fun ọmọkunrin, tabi fun ọmọbinrin, ki o mú ọdọ-agutan ọlọdún kan wá fun ẹbọ sisun, ati ẹiyẹle, tabi àdaba, fun ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ tọ̀ alufa wá, si ẹnu-ọ̀na agọ ajọ:
entries.en: And when the days of her purifying are fulfilled, for a son, or for a daughter, she shall bring a lamb of the first year for a burnt offering, and a young pigeon, or a turtledove, for a sin offering, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, unto the priest:

entries.yo: Ẹniti yio ru u niwaju OLUWA, ti yio si ṣètutu fun u; on o si di mimọ́ kuro ninu isun ẹ̀jẹ rẹ̀. Eyi li ofin fun ẹniti o bi ọmọkunrin tabi ọmọbinrin.
entries.en: Who shall offer it before the LORD, and make an atonement for her; and she shall be cleansed from the issue of her blood. This is the law for her that hath born a male or a female.

entries.yo: Bi kò ba si le mú ọdọ-agutan wá, njẹ ki o mú àdaba meji, tabi ọmọ ẹiyẹle meji wá; ọkan fun ẹbọ sisun, ati ekeji fun ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ: alufa yio si ṣètutu fun u, on o si di mimọ́.
entries.en: And if she be not able to bring a lamb, then she shall bring two turtles, or two young pigeons; the one for the burnt offering, and the other for a sin offering: and the priest shall make an atonement for her, and she shall be clean.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose ati fun Aaroni pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses and Aaron, saying,

entries.yo: Nigbati enia kan ba ní iwú, apá, tabi àmi didán kan li awọ ara rẹ̀, ti o si mbẹ li awọ ara rẹ̀ bi àrun ẹ̀tẹ; nigbana ni ki a mú u tọ̀ Aaroni alufa wá, tabi ọkan ninu awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, alufa:
entries.en: When a man shall have in the skin of his flesh a rising, a scab, or a bright spot, and it be in the skin of his flesh like the plague of leprosy; then he shall be brought unto Aaron the priest, or unto one of his sons the priests:

entries.yo: Alufa yio si wò àrun ti mbẹ li awọ ara rẹ̀: bi irun ti mbẹ li oju àrun na ba si di funfun, ati ti àrun na li oju rẹ̀ ba jìn jù awọ ara rẹ̀ lọ, àrun ẹ̀tẹ ni: ki alufa ki o si wò o, ki o si pè e li alaimọ́.
entries.en: And the priest shall look on the plague in the skin of the flesh: and when the hair in the plague is turned white, and the plague in sight be deeper than the skin of his flesh, it is a plague of leprosy: and the priest shall look on him, and pronounce him unclean.

entries.yo: Bi àmi didán na ba funfun li awọ ara rẹ̀, ati li oju rẹ̀ ti kò si jìn jù awọ lọ, ti irun rẹ̀ kò di funfun, nigbana ni ki alufa ki o sé alarun na mọ́ ni ijọ́ meje:
entries.en: If the bright spot be white in the skin of his flesh, and in sight be not deeper than the skin, and the hair thereof be not turned white; then the priest shall shut up him that hath the plague seven days:

entries.yo: Ki alufa ki o si wò o ni ijọ́ keje: si kiyesi i, bi àrun na ba duro li oju rẹ̀, ti àrun na kò ba si ràn li ara rẹ̀, nigbana ni ki alufa ki o sé e mọ́ ni ijọ́ meje si i:
entries.en: And the priest shall look on him the seventh day: and, behold, if the plague in his sight be at a stay, and the plague spread not in the skin; then the priest shall shut him up seven days more:

entries.yo: Ki alufa ki o si tun wò o ni ijọ́ keje: si kiyesi i, bi àrun na ba ṣe bi ẹni wodú, ti àrun na kò si ràn si i li awọ ara, ki alufa ki o pè e ni mimọ́: kìki apá ni: ki o si fọ̀ aṣọ rẹ̀, ki o jẹ́ mimọ́.
entries.en: And the priest shall look on him again the seventh day: and, behold, if the plague be somewhat dark, and the plague spread not in the skin, the priest shall pronounce him clean: it is but a scab: and he shall wash his clothes, and be clean.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi apá na ba ràn pupọ̀ si i li awọ ara, lẹhin igbati alufa ti ri i tán fun mimọ́ rẹ̀, alufa yio si tun wò o.
entries.en: But if the scab spread much abroad in the skin, after that he hath been seen of the priest for his cleansing, he shall be seen of the priest again:

entries.yo: Alufa yio wò o, kiyesi i, apá na ràn li awọ ara rẹ̀, nigbana ni ki alufa ki o pè e li alaimọ́: ẹ̀tẹ ni.
entries.en: And if the priest see that, behold, the scab spreadeth in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a leprosy.

entries.yo: Nigbati àrun ẹ̀tẹ ba mbẹ li ara enia, nigbana ni ki a mú u tọ̀ alufa wá;
entries.en: When the plague of leprosy is in a man, then he shall be brought unto the priest;

entries.yo: Ki alufa ki o si wò o, si kiyesi i, bi iwú na ba funfun li awọ ara rẹ̀, ti o si sọ irun rẹ̀ di funfun, ti õju si mbẹ ninu iwú na,
entries.en: And the priest shall see him: and, behold, if the rising be white in the skin, and it have turned the hair white, and there be quick raw flesh in the rising;

entries.yo: Ẹ̀tẹ lailai ni li awọ ara rẹ̀, ki alufa ki o pè e li alaimọ́: ki o máṣe sé e mọ́; nitoripe alaimọ́ ni.
entries.en: It is an old leprosy in the skin of his flesh, and the priest shall pronounce him unclean, and shall not shut him up: for he is unclean.

entries.yo: Bi ẹ̀tẹ ba si sọ jade kakiri li awọ ara, ti ẹ̀tẹ na ba si bò gbogbo ara ẹniti o ní àrun na, lati ori rẹ̀ titi dé ẹsẹ̀ rẹ̀, nibikibi ti alufa ba wò;
entries.en: And if a leprosy break out abroad in the skin, and the leprosy cover all the skin of him that hath the plague from his head even to his foot, wheresoever the priest looketh;

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ki alufa ki o wò o: si kiyesi i, bi ẹ̀tẹ na ba bò gbogbo ara rẹ̀, ki o pè àlarun na ni mimọ́; gbogbo rẹ̀ di funfun: mimọ́ li on.
entries.en: Then the priest shall consider: and, behold, if the leprosy have covered all his flesh, he shall pronounce him clean that hath the plague: it is all turned white: he is clean.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ni ijọ́ ti õju na ba hàn ninu rẹ̀, ki o jẹ́ alaimọ́.
entries.en: But when raw flesh appeareth in him, he shall be unclean.

entries.yo: Ki alufa ki o wò õju na, ki o si pè e li alaimọ́: nitoripe aimọ́ li õju: ẹ̀tẹ ni.
entries.en: And the priest shall see the raw flesh, and pronounce him to be unclean: for the raw flesh is unclean: it is a leprosy.

entries.yo: Tabi bi õju na ba yipada, ti o si di funfun, ki o si tọ̀ alufa wá,
entries.en: Or if the raw flesh turn again, and be changed unto white, he shall come unto the priest;

entries.yo: Alufa yio si wò o: si kiyesi i, bi àrun na ba di funfun, nigbana ni ki alufa ki o pè àlarun na ni mimọ́: mimọ́ li on.
entries.en: And the priest shall see him: and, behold, if the plague be turned into white; then the priest shall pronounce him clean that hath the plague: he is clean.

entries.yo: Ara pẹlu, ninu eyi, ani li awọ ara ti õwo ti sọ, ti o si jiná,
entries.en: The flesh also, in which, even in the skin thereof, was a boil, and is healed,

entries.yo: Ati ni apá õwo na bi iwú funfun ba mbẹ nibẹ̀, tabi àmi didán, funfun ti o si ṣe bi ẹni pọ́n ki a si fi i hàn alufa;
entries.en: And in the place of the boil there be a white rising, or a bright spot, white, and somewhat reddish, and it be shewed to the priest;

entries.yo: Alufa yio wò o, si kiyesi i, li oju rẹ̀ bi o ba jìn jù awọ ara lọ, ti irun rẹ̀ si di funfun, ki alufa ki o pè e li alaimọ́: àrun ẹ̀tẹ li o sọ jade ninu õwo na.
entries.en: And if, when the priest seeth it, behold, it be in sight lower than the skin, and the hair thereof be turned white; the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a plague of leprosy broken out of the boil.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi alufa na ba wò o, si kiyesi i, ti irun funfun kò si sí ninu rẹ̀, bi kò ba si jìn jù awọ ara lọ, ti o si dabi ẹni wodú, nigbana ni ki alufa ki o sé e mọ́ ni ijọ́ meje:
entries.en: But if the priest look on it, and, behold, there be no white hairs therein, and if it be not lower than the skin, but be somewhat dark; then the priest shall shut him up seven days:

entries.yo: Bi o ba si ràn siwaju li awọ ara rẹ̀, nigbana ni ki alufa ki o pè e ni alaimọ́: àrun ni.
entries.en: And if it spread much abroad in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a plague.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi àmi didán na ba duro ni ipò rẹ̀, ti kò si ràn, õwo tita ni; ki alufa ki o si pè e ni mimọ́.
entries.en: But if the bright spot stay in his place, and spread not, it is a burning boil; and the priest shall pronounce him clean.

entries.yo: Tabi bi ara kan ba mbẹ, ninu awọ ara eyiti ijóni bi iná ba wà, ti ojú jijóna na ba ní àmi funfun didán, ti o ṣe bi ẹni pọn rusurusu tabi funfun;
entries.en: Or if there be any flesh, in the skin whereof there is a hot burning, and the quick flesh that burneth have a white bright spot, somewhat reddish, or white;

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ki alufa ki o wò o: si kiyesi i, bi irun ninu àmi didán na ba di funfun, ti o ba si jìn jù awọ ara lọ li oju; ẹ̀tẹ li o ti inu ijóni nì sọ jade; nitorina ni ki alufa ki o pè e ni alaimọ́: àrun ẹ̀tẹ ni.
entries.en: Then the priest shall look upon it: and, behold, if the hair in the bright spot be turned white, and it be in sight deeper than the skin; it is a leprosy broken out of the burning: wherefore the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is the plague of leprosy.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi alufa ba wò o, si kiyesi i, ti kò sí irun funfun li apá didán na, ti kò si jìn jù awọ ara iyokù lọ, ṣugbọn ti o ṣe bi ẹni ṣújú; nigbana ni ki alufa ki o sé e mọ́ ni ijọ́ meje:
entries.en: But if the priest look on it, and, behold, there be no white hair in the bright spot, and it be no lower than the other skin, but be somewhat dark; then the priest shall shut him up seven days:

entries.yo: Ki alufa ki o si wò o ni ijọ́ keje: bi o ba si ràn siwaju li awọ ara rẹ̀, nigbana ni ki alufa ki o pè e li alaimọ́; àrun ẹ̀tẹ ni.
entries.en: And the priest shall look upon him the seventh day: and if it be spread much abroad in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is the plague of leprosy.

entries.yo: Bi àmi didán na ba si duro ni ipò rẹ̀, ti kò si ràn si i li awọ ara, ṣugbọn ti o dabi ẹni sújú: iwú ijóni ni, ki alufa ki o si pè e ni mimọ́: nitoripe ijóni tita ni.
entries.en: And if the bright spot stay in his place, and spread not in the skin, but it be somewhat dark; it is a rising of the burning, and the priest shall pronounce him clean: for it is an inflammation of the burning.

entries.yo: Bi ọkunrin tabi obinrin kan ba ní àrun li ori rẹ̀ tabi li àgbọn,
entries.en: If a man or woman have a plague upon the head or the beard;

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ki alufa ki o wò àrun na: si kiyesi i, bi o ba jìn jù awọ ara lọ li oju, bi irun tinrin pupa ba mbẹ ninu rẹ̀, nigbana ni ki alufa ki o pè e li aimọ́: ipẹ́ gbigbẹ ni, ani ẹ̀tẹ li ori tabi li àgbọn ni.
entries.en: Then the priest shall see the plague: and, behold, if it be in sight deeper than the skin; and there be in it a yellow thin hair; then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a dry scall, even a leprosy upon the head or beard.

entries.yo: Bi alufa ba si wò àrun pipa na, si kiyesi i, ti kò ba jìn jù awọ ara lọ li oju, ti kò si sí irun dudu ninu rẹ̀, nigbana ni ki alufa ki o sé àlarun pipa na mọ́ ni ijọ́ meje:
entries.en: And if the priest look on the plague of the scall, and, behold, it be not in sight deeper than the skin, and that there is no black hair in it; then the priest shall shut up him that hath the plague of the scall seven days:

entries.yo: Ni ijọ́ keje ki alufa ki o si wò àrun na: si kiyesi i, bi pipa na kò ba ràn, ti kò si sí irun pupa ninu rẹ̀, ti pipa na kò si jìn jù awọ ara lọ li oju,
entries.en: And in the seventh day the priest shall look on the plague: and, behold, if the scall spread not, and there be in it no yellow hair, and the scall be not in sight deeper than the skin;

entries.yo: Ki o fári, ṣugbọn ki o máṣe fá ibi pipa na; ki alufa ki o si sé ẹni pipa nì mọ́ ni ijọ́ meje si i:
entries.en: He shall be shaven, but the scall shall he not shave; and the priest shall shut up him that hath the scall seven days more:

entries.yo: Ni ijọ́ keje ki alufa ki o si wò pipa na; si kiyesi i bi pipa na kò ba ràn si awọ ara, ti kò ba jìn jù awọ ara lọ li oju; nigbana ni ki alufa ki o pè e ni mimọ́: ki o si fọ̀ aṣọ rẹ̀, ki o si jẹ́ mimọ́.
entries.en: And in the seventh day the priest shall look on the scall: and, behold, if the scall be not spread in the skin, nor be in sight deeper than the skin; then the priest shall pronounce him clean: and he shall wash his clothes, and be clean.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi pipa na ba ràn siwaju li awọ ara rẹ̀ lẹhin ìpenimimọ́ rẹ̀;
entries.en: But if the scall spread much in the skin after his cleansing;

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ki alufa ki o wò o: si kiyesi i, bi pipa na ba ràn siwaju li awọ ara, ki alufa ki o máṣe wá irun pupa mọ́; alaimọ́ ni.
entries.en: Then the priest shall look on him: and, behold, if the scall be spread in the skin, the priest shall not seek for yellow hair; he is unclean.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn li oju rẹ̀ bi pipa na ba duro, ti irun dudu si hù ninu rẹ̀; pipa na jiná, mimọ́ li on: ki alufa ki o pè e ni mimọ́.
entries.en: But if the scall be in his sight at a stay, and that there is black hair grown up therein; the scall is healed, he is clean: and the priest shall pronounce him clean.

entries.yo: Bi ọkunrin kan tabi obinrin kan ba ní àmi didán li awọ ara wọn, ani àmi funfun didán;
entries.en: If a man also or a woman have in the skin of their flesh bright spots, even white bright spots;

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ki alufa ki o wò o: si kiyesi i, bi àmi didán li awọ ara wọn ba ṣe bi ẹni ṣe funfun ṣe dudu; ifinra li o sọ jade li ara; mimọ́ li on.
entries.en: Then the priest shall look: and, behold, if the bright spots in the skin of their flesh be darkish white; it is a freckled spot that groweth in the skin; he is clean.

entries.yo: Ati ọkunrin ti irun rẹ̀ ba re kuro li ori rẹ̀, apari ni; ṣugbọn mimọ́ li on.
entries.en: And the man whose hair is fallen off his head, he is bald; yet is he clean.

entries.yo: Ẹniti irun rẹ̀ ba re silẹ ni ìha iwaju rẹ̀, o pari ni iwaju; ṣugbọn mimọ́ li on.
entries.en: And he that hath his hair fallen off from the part of his head toward his face, he is forehead bald: yet is he clean.

entries.yo: Bi õju funfun-pupa rusurusu ba mbẹ li ori pipa na, tabi iwaju ori pipa na; ẹ̀tẹ li o sọ jade ninu pipa ori na, tabi ni pipá iwaju na.
entries.en: And if there be in the bald head, or bald forehead, a white reddish sore; it is a leprosy sprung up in his bald head, or his bald forehead.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ki alufa ki o wò o: si kiyesi i, bi iwú õju na ba funfun-pupa rusurusu ni pipa ori rẹ̀, tabi pipa iwaju rẹ̀, bi ẹ̀tẹ ti ihàn li awọ ara;
entries.en: Then the priest shall look upon it: and, behold, if the rising of the sore be white reddish in his bald head, or in his bald forehead, as the leprosy appeareth in the skin of the flesh;

entries.yo: Ẹlẹtẹ ni, alaimọ́ ni: ki alufa ki o pè e li aimọ́ patapata; àrun rẹ̀ mbẹ li ori rẹ̀.
entries.en: He is a leprous man, he is unclean: the priest shall pronounce him utterly unclean; his plague is in his head.

entries.yo: Ati adẹ́tẹ na, li ara ẹniti àrun na gbé wà, ki o fà aṣọ rẹ̀ ya, ki o si fi ori rẹ̀ silẹ ni ìhoho, ki o si fi ìbo bò ète rẹ̀ òke, ki o si ma kepe, Alaimọ́, alaimọ́.
entries.en: And the leper in whom the plague is, his clothes shall be rent, and his head bare, and he shall put a covering upon his upper lip, and shall cry, Unclean, unclean.

entries.yo: Ni gbogbo ọjọ́ ti àrun na mbẹ li ara rẹ̀ ni ki o jẹ́ elẽri; alaimọ́ ni: on nikan ni ki o ma gbé; lẹhin ibudó ni ibujoko rẹ̀ yio gbé wà.
entries.en: All the days wherein the plague shall be in him he shall be defiled; he is unclean: he shall dwell alone; without the camp shall his habitation be.

entries.yo: Ati aṣọ ti àrun ẹ̀tẹ mbẹ ninu rẹ̀, iba ṣe aṣọ kubusu, tabi aṣọ ọ̀gbọ;
entries.en: The garment also that the plague of leprosy is in, whether it be a woollen garment, or a linen garment;

entries.yo: Iba ṣe ni ita, tabi ni iwun; ti ọ̀gbọ, tabi ti kubusu; iba ṣe li awọ, tabi ohun kan ti a fi awọ ṣe;
entries.en: Whether it be in the warp, or woof; of linen, or of woollen; whether in a skin, or in any thing made of skin;

entries.yo: Bi àrun na ba ṣe bi ọbẹdo tabi bi pupa lara aṣọ na, tabi lara awọ na, iba ṣe ni ita, tabi ni iwun, tabi ninu ohunèlo awọ kan; àrun ẹ̀tẹ ni, ki a si fi i hàn alufa:
entries.en: And if the plague be greenish or reddish in the garment, or in the skin, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin; it is a plague of leprosy, and shall be shewed unto the priest:

entries.yo: Ki alufa ki o si wò àrun na, ki o si sé ohun ti o ní àrun na mọ́ ni ijọ́ meje:
entries.en: And the priest shall look upon the plague, and shut up it that hath the plague seven days:

entries.yo: Ki o si wò àrun na ni ijọ́ keje: bi àrun na ba ràn sara aṣọ na, iba ṣe ni ita, tabi ni iwun, tabi ninu awọ, tabi ninu ohun ti a fi awọ ṣe; àrun oun ẹ̀tẹ kikẹ̀ ni; alaimọ́ ni.
entries.en: And he shall look on the plague on the seventh day: if the plague be spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in a skin, or in any work that is made of skin; the plague is a fretting leprosy; it is unclean.

entries.yo: Nitorina ki o fi aṣọ na jóna, iba ṣe ita, tabi iwun, ni kubusu tabi li ọ̀gbọ, tabi ninu ohunèlo awọ kan, ninu eyiti àrun na gbé wà: nitoripe ẹ̀tẹ kikẹ̀ ni; ki a fi jóna.
entries.en: He shall therefore burn that garment, whether warp or woof, in woollen or in linen, or any thing of skin, wherein the plague is: for it is a fretting leprosy; it shall be burnt in the fire.

entries.yo: Bi alufa ba si wò, si kiyesi i, ti àrun na kò ba tàn sara aṣọ na, iba ṣe ni ita, tabi ni iwun, tabi ninu ohunèlo kan ti a fi awọ ṣe;
entries.en: And if the priest shall look, and, behold, the plague be not spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin;

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ki alufa ki o paṣẹ ki nwọn ki o fọ̀ ohun na ninu eyiti àrun na gbé wà, ki o si sé e mọ́ ni ijọ meje si i.
entries.en: Then the priest shall command that they wash the thing wherein the plague is, and he shall shut it up seven days more:

entries.yo: Ki alufa ki o si wò àrun na, lẹhin igbati a fọ̀ ọ tán: si kiyesi i, bi àrun na kò ba pa awọ rẹ̀ dà, ti àrun na kò si ràn si i, alaimọ́ ni; ninu iná ni ki iwọ ki o sun u; o kẹ̀ ninu, iba gbo ninu tabi lode.
entries.en: And the priest shall look on the plague, after that it is washed: and, behold, if the plague have not changed his colour, and the plague be not spread; it is unclean; thou shalt burn it in the fire; it is fret inward, whether it be bare within or without.

entries.yo: Bi alufa ba si wò, si kiyesi i, ti àrun na ba ṣe bi ẹni wodú lẹhin igbati o ba fọ̀ ọ tán; nigbana ni ki o fà a ya kuro ninu aṣọ na, tabi ninu awọ na, tabi ninu ita, tabi ninu iwun:
entries.en: And if the priest look, and, behold, the plague be somewhat dark after the washing of it; then he shall rend it out of the garment, or out of the skin, or out of the warp, or out of the woof:

entries.yo: Bi o ba si hàn sibẹ̀ ninu aṣọ na, iba ṣe ni ita, tabi ni iwun, tabi ninu ohunèlo kan ti a fi awọ ṣe, àrun riràn ni: ki iwọ ki o fi iná sun ohun ti àrun na wà ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And if it appear still in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin; it is a spreading plague: thou shalt burn that wherein the plague is with fire.

entries.yo: Ati aṣọ na, iba ṣe ni ita, tabi ni iwun, tabi ninu ohunkohun ti a fi awọ ṣe, ti iwọ ba fọ̀, bi àrun na ba wọ́n kuro ninu wọn nigbana ni ki a tun fọ̀ ọ lẹkeji, on o si jẹ́ mimọ́.
entries.en: And the garment, either warp, or woof, or whatsoever thing of skin it be, which thou shalt wash, if the plague be departed from them, then it shall be washed the second time, and shall be clean.

entries.yo: Eyi li ofin àrun ẹ̀tẹ, ninu aṣọ, kubusu tabi ti ọ̀gbọ, iba ṣe ni ita, tabi ni iwun, tabi ohunkohun èlo awọ kan, lati pè e ni mimọ́, tabi lati pè e li aimọ́.
entries.en: This is the law of the plague of leprosy in a garment of woollen or linen, either in the warp, or woof, or any thing of skins, to pronounce it clean, or to pronounce it unclean.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Eyi ni yio ma ṣe ofin adẹ́tẹ li ọjọ́ ìwẹnumọ́ rẹ̀: ki a mú u tọ̀ alufa wá:
entries.en: This shall be the law of the leper in the day of his cleansing: He shall be brought unto the priest:

entries.yo: Ki alufa ki o si jade sẹhin ibudó; ki alufa ki o si wò o, si kiyesi i, bi àrun ẹ̀tẹ na ba jiná li ara adẹ́tẹ na:
entries.en: And the priest shall go forth out of the camp; and the priest shall look, and, behold, if the plague of leprosy be healed in the leper;

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ki alufa ki o paṣẹ pe, ki a mú ãye ẹiyẹ meji mimọ́ wá, fun ẹniti a o wẹ̀numọ́, pẹlu igi opepe, ati ododó, ati ewe-hissopu:
entries.en: Then shall the priest command to take for him that is to be cleansed two birds alive and clean, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop:

entries.yo: Ki alufa ki o paṣẹ pe ki a pa ọkan ninu ẹiyẹ nì ninu ohunèlo àmọ li oju omi ti nṣàn:
entries.en: And the priest shall command that one of the birds be killed in an earthen vessel over running water:

entries.yo: Niti ẹiyẹ alãye, ki o mú u, ati igi opepe, ati ododó, ati ewe-hissopu, ki o si fi wọn ati ẹiyẹ alãye nì bọ̀ inu ẹ̀jẹ ẹiyẹ ti a pa li oju omi ti nṣàn:
entries.en: As for the living bird, he shall take it, and the cedar wood, and the scarlet, and the hyssop, and shall dip them and the living bird in the blood of the bird that was killed over the running water:

entries.yo: Ki o si fi wọ́n ẹniti a o wẹ̀numọ́ kuro ninu ẹ̀tẹ nigba meje, ki o si pè e ni mimọ́, ki o si jọwọ ẹiyẹ alãye nì lọwọ lọ si gbangba oko.
entries.en: And he shall sprinkle upon him that is to be cleansed from the leprosy seven times, and shall pronounce him clean, and shall let the living bird loose into the open field.

entries.yo: Ki ẹniti a o wẹ̀numọ́ nì ki o si fọ̀ aṣọ rẹ̀, ki o si fá gbogbo irun ori rẹ̀ kuro, ki o si wẹ̀ ara rẹ̀ ninu omi, ki o le mọ́: lẹhin eyinì ni ki o wọ̀ ibudó, ṣugbọn ki o gbé ẹhin ode agọ́ rẹ̀ ni ijọ́ meje.
entries.en: And he that is to be cleansed shall wash his clothes, and shave off all his hair, and wash himself in water, that he may be clean: and after that he shall come into the camp, and shall tarry abroad out of his tent seven days.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe ni ijọ́ keje, ni ki o fá gbogbo irun ori rẹ̀ kuro li ori rẹ̀, ati irungbọn rẹ̀, ati ipenpeju rẹ̀, ani gbogbo irun rẹ̀ ni ki o fá kuro: ki o si fọ̀ aṣọ rẹ̀, ki o si wẹ̀ ara rẹ̀ pẹlu ninu omi, on o si di mimọ́.
entries.en: But it shall be on the seventh day, that he shall shave all his hair off his head and his beard and his eyebrows, even all his hair he shall shave off: and he shall wash his clothes, also he shall wash his flesh in water, and he shall be clean.

entries.yo: Ni ijọ́ kẹjọ ki o mú ọdọ-agutan meji akọ alailabùku wá, ati ọdọ-agutan kan abo ọlọdún kan alailabùku, ati idamẹwa mẹta òṣuwọn deali iyẹfun didara fun ẹbọ ohunjijẹ, ti a fi oróro pò, ati òṣuwọn logu oróro kan.
entries.en: And on the eighth day he shall take two he lambs without blemish, and one ewe lamb of the first year without blemish, and three tenth deals of fine flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, and one log of oil.

entries.yo: Ki alufa ti o sọ ọ di mimọ́ ki o mú ọkunrin na ti a o sọ di mimọ́, ati nkan wọnni wá, siwaju OLUWA, si ẹnu-ọ̀na agọ́ ajọ:
entries.en: And the priest that maketh him clean shall present the man that is to be made clean, and those things, before the LORD, at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:

entries.yo: Ki alufa ki o mú akọ ọdọ-agutan kan, ki o si fi i ru ẹbọ ẹbi, ati òṣuwọn logu oróro, ki o si fì wọn li ẹbọ fifì niwaju OLUWA:
entries.en: And the priest shall take one he lamb, and offer him for a trespass offering, and the log of oil, and wave them for a wave offering before the LORD:

entries.yo: Ki o si pa akọ ọdọ-agutan na ni ibiti on o gbé pa ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ ati ẹbọ sisun, ní ibi mimọ́ nì: nitoripe bi ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ ti jẹ́ ti alufa, bẹ̃ si ni ẹbọ irekọja: mimọ́ julọ ni:
entries.en: And he shall slay the lamb in the place where he shall kill the sin offering and the burnt offering, in the holy place: for as the sin offering is the priest's, so is the trespass offering: it is most holy:

entries.yo: Ki alufa ki o si mú ninu ẹ̀jẹ ẹbọ ẹbi na, ki alufa ki o si fi i si eti ọtún ẹniti a o wẹ̀numọ́, ati si àtampako ọwọ́ ọtún rẹ̀, ati si àtampako ẹsẹ̀ ọtún rẹ̀:
entries.en: And the priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering, and the priest shall put it upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot:

entries.yo: Ki alufa ki o si mú ninu oróro òṣuwọn logu na, ki o si dà a si atẹlẹwọ òsi ara rẹ̀:
entries.en: And the priest shall take some of the log of oil, and pour it into the palm of his own left hand:

entries.yo: Ki alufa ki o si tẹ̀ ika rẹ̀ ọtún bọ̀ inu oróro na ti mbẹ li ọwọ́ òsi rẹ̀, ki o si fi ika rẹ̀ ta ninu oróro na nigba meje niwaju OLUWA:
entries.en: And the priest shall dip his right finger in the oil that is in his left hand, and shall sprinkle of the oil with his finger seven times before the LORD:

entries.yo: Ati ninu oróro iyokù ti mbẹ li ọwọ́ rẹ̀ ni ki alufa ki o fi si etí ọtún ẹniti a o wẹ̀numọ́, ati si àtampako ọwọ́ ọtún rẹ̀, ati si àtampako ẹsẹ̀ ọtún rẹ̀, lori ẹ̀jẹ ẹbọ ẹbi:
entries.en: And of the rest of the oil that is in his hand shall the priest put upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot, upon the blood of the trespass offering:

entries.yo: Ati oróro iyokù ti mbẹ li ọwọ́ alufa ni ki o dà si ori ẹniti a o wẹ̀numọ́: ki alufa ki o si ṣètutu fun u niwaju OLUWA.
entries.en: And the remnant of the oil that is in the priest's hand he shall pour upon the head of him that is to be cleansed: and the priest shall make an atonement for him before the LORD.

entries.yo: Ki alufa ki o si ru ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ, ki o si ṣètutu fun ẹniti a o wẹ̀numọ́ kuro ninu aimọ́ rẹ̀; lẹhin eyinì ni ki o pa ẹran ẹbọ sisun.
entries.en: And the priest shall offer the sin offering, and make an atonement for him that is to be cleansed from his uncleanness; and afterward he shall kill the burnt offering:

entries.yo: Ki alufa ki o si ru ẹbọ sisun, ati ẹbọ ohunjijẹ lori pẹpẹ: ki alufa ki o ṣètutu fun u, on o si di mimọ́.
entries.en: And the priest shall offer the burnt offering and the meat offering upon the altar: and the priest shall make an atonement for him, and he shall be clean.

entries.yo: Bi o ba si ṣe talaka, ti kò le mú tobẹ̃ wá, njẹ ki o mú akọ ọdọ-agutan kan wá fun ẹbọ ẹbi lati fì, lati ṣètutu fun u, ati ọkan ninu idamẹwa òṣuwọn deali iyẹfun daradara ti a fi oróro pò fun ẹbọ ohunjijẹ, ati òṣuwọn logu oróro kan;
entries.en: And if he be poor, and cannot get so much; then he shall take one lamb for a trespass offering to be waved, to make an atonement for him, and one tenth deal of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering, and a log of oil;

entries.yo: Ati àdaba meji, tabi ọmọ ẹiyẹle meji, irú eyiti ọwọ́ rẹ̀ ba to; ki ọkan ki o si ṣe ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ, ki ekeji ki o si ṣe ẹbọ sisun.
entries.en: And two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, such as he is able to get; and the one shall be a sin offering, and the other a burnt offering.

entries.yo: Ki o si mú wọn tọ̀ alufa wá ni ijọ́ kẹjọ fun ìwẹnumọ́ rẹ̀, si ẹnu-ọ̀na agọ́ ajọ, niwaju OLUWA.
entries.en: And he shall bring them on the eighth day for his cleansing unto the priest, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, before the LORD.

entries.yo: Ki alufa ki o si mú ọdọ-agutan ẹbọ ẹbi, ati òṣuwọn logu oróro, ki alufa ki o si fì wọn li ẹbọ fifì niwaju OLUWA.
entries.en: And the priest shall take the lamb of the trespass offering, and the log of oil, and the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before the LORD:

entries.yo: Ki o si pa ọdọ-agutan ẹbọ ẹbi, ki alufa ki o si mú ninu ẹ̀jẹ ẹbọ ẹbi na, ki o si fi i si etí ọtún ẹniti a o wẹ̀numọ́, ati si àtampako ọwọ́ ọtún rẹ̀, ati si àtampako ẹsẹ̀ ọtún rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he shall kill the lamb of the trespass offering, and the priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering, and put it upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot:

entries.yo: Ki alufa ki o si dà ninu oróro na si atẹlẹwọ òsi ara rẹ̀:
entries.en: And the priest shall pour of the oil into the palm of his own left hand:

entries.yo: Ki alufa ki o si fi iká rẹ̀ ọtún ta ninu oróro na ti mbẹ li ọwọ́ òsi rẹ̀ nigba meje niwaju OLUWA:
entries.en: And the priest shall sprinkle with his right finger some of the oil that is in his left hand seven times before the LORD:

entries.yo: Ki alufa ki o si fi ninu oróro na ti mbẹ li ọwọ́ rẹ̀ si eti ọtún ẹniti a o wẹ̀numọ́, ati si àtampako ọwọ́ ọtún rẹ̀, ati si àtampako ẹsẹ̀ ọtún rẹ̀, si ibi ẹ̀jẹ ẹbọ ẹbi:
entries.en: And the priest shall put of the oil that is in his hand upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot, upon the place of the blood of the trespass offering:

entries.yo: Ati oróro iyokù ti mbẹ li ọwọ́ alufa ni ki o fi si ori ẹniti a o wẹ̀numọ́, lati ṣètutu fun u niwaju OLUWA.
entries.en: And the rest of the oil that is in the priest's hand he shall put upon the head of him that is to be cleansed, to make an atonement for him before the LORD.

entries.yo: Ki o si fi ọkan ninu àdaba nì rubọ, tabi ọkan ninu ọmọ ẹiyẹle nì, iru eyiti ọwọ́ rẹ̀ ba to:
entries.en: And he shall offer the one of the turtledoves, or of the young pigeons, such as he can get;

entries.yo: Ani irú eyiti apa rẹ̀ ka, ọkan fun ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ, ati ekeji fun ẹbọ sisun, pẹlu ẹbọ ohunjijẹ: ki alufa ki o si ṣètutu fun ẹniti a o wẹ̀numọ́ niwaju OLUWA.
entries.en: Even such as he is able to get, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, with the meat offering: and the priest shall make an atonement for him that is to be cleansed before the LORD.

entries.yo: Eyi li ofin rẹ̀ li ara ẹniti àrun ẹ̀tẹ wà, apa ẹniti kò le ka ohun ìwẹnumọ́ rẹ̀.
entries.en: This is the law of him in whom is the plague of leprosy, whose hand is not able to get that which pertaineth to his cleansing.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose ati fun Aaroni pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

entries.yo: Nigbati ẹnyin ba dé ilẹ Kenaani, ti mo fi fun nyin ni ilẹ-iní, ti mo ba si fi àrun ẹ̀tẹ sinu ile kan ninu ilẹ-iní nyin;
entries.en: When ye be come into the land of Canaan, which I give to you for a possession, and I put the plague of leprosy in a house of the land of your possession;

entries.yo: Ti onile na si wá ti o si wi fun alufa pe, O jọ li oju mi bi ẹnipe àrun mbẹ ninu ile na:
entries.en: And he that owneth the house shall come and tell the priest, saying, It seemeth to me there is as it were a plague in the house:

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ki alufa ki o fun wọn li aṣẹ, ki nwọn ki o kó ohun ile na jade, ki alufa ki o to wọ̀ inu rẹ̀ lọ lati wò àrun na, ki ohun gbogbo ti mbẹ ninu ile na ki o máṣe jẹ́ alaimọ́: lẹhin eyinì ni ki alufa ki o wọ̀ ọ lati wò ile na:
entries.en: Then the priest shall command that they empty the house, before the priest go into it to see the plague, that all that is in the house be not made unclean: and afterward the priest shall go in to see the house:

entries.yo: Ki o si wò àrun na, si kiyesi i, bi àrun na ba mbẹ lara ogiri ile na pẹlu ìla gbòrogbòro, bi ẹni ṣe bi ọbẹdò tabi pupa rusurusu, ti o jìn li oju jù ogiri lọ;
entries.en: And he shall look on the plague, and, behold, if the plague be in the walls of the house with hollow strakes, greenish or reddish, which in sight are lower than the wall;

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ki alufa ki o jade ninu ile na si ẹnu-ọ̀na ile na, ki o si há ilẹkun ile na ni ijọ́ meje:
entries.en: Then the priest shall go out of the house to the door of the house, and shut up the house seven days:

entries.yo: Ki alufa ki o tun wá ni ijọ́ keje, ki o si wò o: si kiyesi i, bi àrun na ba ràn lara ogiri ile na;
entries.en: And the priest shall come again the seventh day, and shall look: and, behold, if the plague be spread in the walls of the house;

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ki alufa ki o paṣẹ ki nwọn ki o yọ okuta na kuro lara eyiti àrun na gbé wà, ki nwọn ki o si kó wọn lọ si ibi aimọ́ kan lẹhin ilu na:
entries.en: Then the priest shall command that they take away the stones in which the plague is, and they shall cast them into an unclean place without the city:

entries.yo: Ki o si mu ki nwọn ki o ha inu ile na yiká kiri, ki nwọn ki o kó erupẹ ti a ha nì kuro lọ si ẹhin ilu na si ibi aimọ́ kan:
entries.en: And he shall cause the house to be scraped within round about, and they shall pour out the dust that they scrape off without the city into an unclean place:

entries.yo: Ki nwọn ki o si mú okuta miran, ki nwọn ki o si fi i di ipò okuta wọnni, ki nwọn ki o si mú ọrọ miran ki nwọn ki o si fi rẹ́ ile na.
entries.en: And they shall take other stones, and put them in the place of those stones; and he shall take other morter, and shall plaister the house.

entries.yo: Bi àrùn na ba si tun pada wá, ti o si tun sọ jade ninu ile na, lẹhin igbati nwọn ba yọ okuta wọnni kuro, ati lẹhin igbati nwọn ba ha ile na, ati lẹhin igbati nwọn ba rẹ́ ẹ;
entries.en: And if the plague come again, and break out in the house, after that he hath taken away the stones, and after he hath scraped the house, and after it is plaistered;

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ki alufa ki o wá, ki o wò o, si kiyesi i, bi àrun ba ràn si i ninu ile na, ẹ̀tẹ kikẹ̀ ni mbẹ ninu ile na: aimọ́ ni.
entries.en: Then the priest shall come and look, and, behold, if the plague be spread in the house, it is a fretting leprosy in the house: it is unclean.

entries.yo: Ki o si wó ile na, okuta rẹ̀, ati ìti igi rẹ̀, ati gbogbo erupẹ ile na; ki o si kó wọn jade kuro ninu ilu na lọ si ibi aimọ́ kan.
entries.en: And he shall break down the house, the stones of it, and the timber thereof, and all the morter of the house; and he shall carry them forth out of the city into an unclean place.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba si wọ̀ ile na ni gbogbo ìgba na ti a sé e mọ́, ki o jẹ́ alaimọ́ titi di aṣalẹ.
entries.en: Moreover he that goeth into the house all the while that it is shut up shall be unclean until the even.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba dubulẹ ninu ile na ki o fọ̀ aṣọ rẹ̀: ẹniti o jẹun ninu ile na ki o si fọ̀ aṣọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he that lieth in the house shall wash his clothes; and he that eateth in the house shall wash his clothes.

entries.yo: Ati bi alufa ba wọ̀ ile, ti o si wò o, si kiyesi i, ti àrun inu ile na kò ba ràn si i, lẹhin igbati a rẹ́ ile na tán; nigbana ni ki alufa ki o pè ile na ni mimọ́, nitoripe àrun na ti jiná.
entries.en: And if the priest shall come in, and look upon it, and, behold, the plague hath not spread in the house, after the house was plaistered: then the priest shall pronounce the house clean, because the plague is healed.

entries.yo: Ki o si mú ẹiyẹ meji, ati igi opepe, ati ododó, ati ewe-hissopu wá, lati wẹ̀ ile na mọ́:
entries.en: And he shall take to cleanse the house two birds, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop:

entries.yo: Ki o si pa ọkan ninu ẹiyẹ na, ninu ohunèlo amọ loju omi ti nṣàn:
entries.en: And he shall kill the one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water:

entries.yo: Ki o si mú igi opepe, ati ewe-hissopu, ati ododó, ati ẹiyẹ alãye nì, ki o si tẹ̀ wọn bọ̀ inu ẹ̀jẹ ẹiyẹ ti a pa nì, ati ninu omi ṣiṣàn nì, ki o si fi wọ́n ile na nigba meje:
entries.en: And he shall take the cedar wood, and the hyssop, and the scarlet, and the living bird, and dip them in the blood of the slain bird, and in the running water, and sprinkle the house seven times:

entries.yo: Ki o si fi ẹ̀jẹ ẹiyẹ na wẹ̀ ile na mọ́, ati pẹlu omi ṣiṣàn nì, ati pẹlu ẹiyẹ alãye nì, ati pẹlu igi opepe nì, ati pẹlu ewe-hissopu nì, ati pẹlu ododó:
entries.en: And he shall cleanse the house with the blood of the bird, and with the running water, and with the living bird, and with the cedar wood, and with the hyssop, and with the scarlet:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ki o jọwọ ẹiyẹ alãye nì lọwọ lọ kuro ninu ilu lọ sinu gbangba oko, ki o si ṣètutu si ile na: yio si di mimọ́.
entries.en: But he shall let go the living bird out of the city into the open fields, and make an atonement for the house: and it shall be clean.

entries.yo: Eyi li ofin fun gbogbo onirũru àrun ẹ̀tẹ, ati ipẹ́;
entries.en: This is the law for all manner of plague of leprosy, and scall,

entries.yo: Ati fun ẹ̀tẹ aṣọ, ati ti ile;
