entries.en: And for the leprosy of a garment, and of a house,

entries.yo: Ati fun wiwu, ati fun apá, ati fun àmi didán:
entries.en: And for a rising, and for a scab, and for a bright spot:

entries.yo: Lati kọni nigbati o ṣe alaimọ́, ati nigbati o ṣe mimọ́: eyi li ofin ẹ̀tẹ.
entries.en: To teach when it is unclean, and when it is clean: this is the law of leprosy.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose ati fun Aaroni pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses and to Aaron, saying,

entries.yo: Sọ fun awọn ọmọ Israeli, ki o si wi fun wọn pe, Nigbati ẹnikan ba ní àrun isun lara rẹ̀, nitori isun rẹ̀ alaimọ́ li on.
entries.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When any man hath a running issue out of his flesh, because of his issue he is unclean.

entries.yo: Eyi ni yio si jẹ́ aimọ́ rẹ̀ ninu isun rẹ̀: ara rẹ̀ iba ma sun isun rẹ̀, tabi bi ara rẹ̀ si dá kuro ninu isun rẹ̀, aimọ́ rẹ̀ ni iṣe.
entries.en: And this shall be his uncleanness in his issue: whether his flesh run with his issue, or his flesh be stopped from his issue, it is his uncleanness.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ori akete ti ẹniti o ní isun na ba dubulẹ lé, aimọ́ ni: ati gbogbo ohun ti o joko lé yio jẹ́ alaimọ́.
entries.en: Every bed, whereon he lieth that hath the issue, is unclean: and every thing, whereon he sitteth, shall be unclean.

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni ti o ba farakàn akete rẹ̀ ki o fọ̀ aṣọ rẹ̀, ki o si wẹ̀ ara rẹ̀ ninu omi, ki o si jẹ́ alaimọ́ titi di aṣalẹ.
entries.en: And whosoever toucheth his bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o si joko lé ohunkohun ti ẹniti o ní isun ti joko lé, ki o fọ̀ aṣọ rẹ̀, kí ó sì wẹ ara rẹ̀ ninu omi, ki o si jẹ́ alaimọ́ titi di aṣalẹ.
entries.en: And he that sitteth on any thing whereon he sat that hath the issue shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o si farakàn ara ẹniti o ní isun, ki o fọ̀ aṣọ rẹ̀, ki o si wẹ̀ ara rẹ̀ ninu omi, ki o si jẹ́ alaimọ́ titi di aṣalẹ.
entries.en: And he that toucheth the flesh of him that hath the issue shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

entries.yo: Bi ẹniti o ní isun ba tutọ sara ẹniti o mọ́; nigbana ni ki o fọ̀ aṣọ rẹ̀, ki o si wẹ ara rẹ̀ ninu omi, ki o si jẹ́ alaimọ́ titi di aṣalẹ.
entries.en: And if he that hath the issue spit upon him that is clean; then he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

entries.yo: Ati asákasá ti o wù ki ẹniti o ní isun ki o gùn ki o jẹ́ alaimọ́.
entries.en: And what saddle soever he rideth upon that hath the issue shall be unclean.

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni ti o ba farakàn ohun kan ti o wà nisalẹ rẹ̀, ki o jẹ́ alaimọ́ titi di aṣalẹ: ati ẹniti o rù ohun kan ninu nkan wọnni, ki o fọ̀ aṣọ rẹ̀, ki o si wẹ̀ ara rẹ̀ ninu omi, ki o si jẹ́ alaimọ́ titi di aṣalẹ.
entries.en: And whosoever toucheth any thing that was under him shall be unclean until the even: and he that beareth any of those things shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

entries.yo: Ati ẹnikẹni ti ẹniti o ní isun ba farakàn, ti kò ti wẹ̀ ọwọ́ rẹ̀ ninu omi, ki o fọ̀ aṣọ rẹ̀, ki o si wẹ̀ ara rẹ̀ ninu omi, ki o si jẹ́ alaimọ́ titi di aṣalẹ.
entries.en: And whomsoever he toucheth that hath the issue, and hath not rinsed his hands in water, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

entries.yo: Ati ohunèlo amọ̀, ti ẹniti o ní isun ba fọwọkàn, fifọ́ ni ki a fọ́ ọ: ati gbogbo ohunèlo igi ni ki a ṣàn ninu omi.
entries.en: And the vessel of earth, that he toucheth which hath the issue, shall be broken: and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.

entries.yo: Nigbati ẹniti o ní isun ba si di mimọ́ kuro ninu isun rẹ̀, nigbana ni ki o kà ijọ́ meje fun ara rẹ̀, fun isọdimimọ́ rẹ̀, ki o si fọ̀ aṣọ rẹ̀, ki o si wẹ̀ ara rẹ̀ ninu omi ti nṣàn, yio si jẹ́ mimọ́.
entries.en: And when he that hath an issue is cleansed of his issue; then he shall number to himself seven days for his cleansing, and wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in running water, and shall be clean.

entries.yo: Ati ni ijọ́ kẹjọ, ki o mú àdaba meji, tabi ọmọ ẹiyẹle meji fun ara rẹ̀, ki o si wá siwaju OLUWA si ẹnu-ọ̀na agọ́ ajọ, ki o si fi wọn fun alufa:
entries.en: And on the eighth day he shall take to him two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and come before the LORD unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and give them unto the priest:

entries.yo: Ki alufa ki o si fi wọn rubọ, ọkan fun ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ, ati ekeji fun ẹbọ sisun; ki alufa ki o si ṣètutu fun u niwaju OLUWA nitori isun rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the priest shall offer them, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for him before the LORD for his issue.

entries.yo: Ati bi ohun irú ìdapọ ọkunrin ba ti ara rẹ̀ jade, nigbana ni ki o wẹ̀ gbogbo ara rẹ̀ ninu omi, ki o si jẹ́ alaimọ́ titi di aṣalẹ.
entries.en: And if any man's seed of copulation go out from him, then he shall wash all his flesh in water, and be unclean until the even.

entries.yo: Ati gbogbo aṣọ, ati gbogbo awọ, lara eyiti ohun irú ìdapọ ba wà, on ni ki a fi omi fọ̀, ki o si jẹ́ alaimọ́ titi di aṣalẹ.
entries.en: And every garment, and every skin, whereon is the seed of copulation, shall be washed with water, and be unclean until the even.

entries.yo: Ati obinrin na, ẹniti ọkunrin ba bá dàpọ ti on ti ohun irú ìdapọ, ki awọn mejeji ki o wẹ̀ ninu omi, ki nwọn ki o si jẹ́ alaimọ́ titi di aṣalẹ.
entries.en: The woman also with whom man shall lie with seed of copulation, they shall both bathe themselves in water, and be unclean until the even.

entries.yo: Bi obinrin kan ba si ní isun, ti isun rẹ̀ li ara rẹ̀ ba jasi ẹ̀jẹ, ki a yà a sapakan ni ijọ́ meje: ẹnikẹni ti o ba si farakàn a, ki o jẹ́ alaimọ́ titi di aṣalẹ.
entries.en: And if a woman have an issue, and her issue in her flesh be blood, she shall be put apart seven days: and whosoever toucheth her shall be unclean until the even.

entries.yo: Ati ohun gbogbo ti o dubulẹ lé ninu ile ìyasapakan rẹ̀ yio jẹ́ aimọ́: ohunkohun pẹlu ti o joko lé yio jẹ́ aimọ́.
entries.en: And every thing that she lieth upon in her separation shall be unclean: every thing also that she sitteth upon shall be unclean.

entries.yo: Ati ẹnikẹni ti o ba farakàn akete rẹ̀, ki o fọ̀ aṣọ rẹ̀, ki o si wẹ̀ ara rẹ̀ ninu omi, ki o si jẹ́ alaimọ́ titi di aṣalẹ.
entries.en: And whosoever toucheth her bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

entries.yo: Ati ẹnikẹni ti o ba farakàn ohun kan ti o joko lé, ki o fọ̀ aṣọ rẹ̀, ki o si wẹ̀ ara rẹ̀ ninu omi, ki o si jẹ́ alaimọ́ titi di aṣalẹ.
entries.en: And whosoever toucheth any thing that she sat upon shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

entries.yo: Bi o ba si ṣepe lara akete rẹ̀ ni, tabi lara ohun ti o joko lé, nigbati o ba farakàn a, ki on ki o jẹ́ alaimọ́ titi di aṣalẹ.
entries.en: And if it be on her bed, or on any thing whereon she sitteth, when he toucheth it, he shall be unclean until the even.

entries.yo: Bi ọkunrin kan ba si bá a dàpọ rára, ti ohun obinrin rẹ̀ ba mbẹ lara ọkunrin na, ki on ki o jẹ́ alaimọ́ ni ijọ́ meje; ati gbogbo akete ti on dubulẹ lé ki o jẹ́ aimọ́.
entries.en: And if any man lie with her at all, and her flowers be upon him, he shall be unclean seven days; and all the bed whereon he lieth shall be unclean.

entries.yo: Ati bi obinrin kan ba ní isun ẹ̀jẹ li ọjọ́ pupọ̀ le ìgba ìyasapakan rẹ̀; tabi bi o ba si sun rekọja ìgba ìyasapakan rẹ̀; gbogbo ọjọ́ isun aimọ́ rẹ̀ yio si ri bi ọjọ́ ìyasapakan rẹ̀: o jẹ́ alaimọ́.
entries.en: And if a woman have an issue of her blood many days out of the time of her separation, or if it run beyond the time of her separation; all the days of the issue of her uncleanness shall be as the days of her separation: she shall be unclean.

entries.yo: Gbogbo akete ti o dubulẹ lé ni gbogbo ọjọ́ isun rẹ̀ ki o si jẹ́ fun u bi akete ìyasapakan rẹ̀: ati ohunkohun ti o joko lé ki o jẹ́ aimọ́, bi aimọ́ ìyasapakan rẹ̀.
entries.en: Every bed whereon she lieth all the days of her issue shall be unto her as the bed of her separation: and whatsoever she sitteth upon shall be unclean, as the uncleanness of her separation.

entries.yo: Ati ẹnikẹni ti o ba farakàn nkan wọnni ki o jẹ́ alaimọ́, ki o si fọ̀ aṣọ rẹ̀, ki o si wẹ̀ ara rẹ̀ ninu omi, ki o si jẹ̀ alaimọ́ titi di aṣalẹ.
entries.en: And whosoever toucheth those things shall be unclean, and shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi obinrin na ba di mimọ́ kuro ninu isun rẹ̀, nigbana ni ki o kà ijọ́ meje fun ara rẹ̀, lẹhin eyinì ni ki o si jẹ́ mimọ́.
entries.en: But if she be cleansed of her issue, then she shall number to herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean.

entries.yo: Ati ni ijọ́ kẹjọ ki o mú àdaba meji, tabi ọmọ ẹiyẹle meji fun ara rẹ̀, ki o si mú wọn tọ̀ alufa wá, si ẹnu-ọ̀na agọ́ ajọ.
entries.en: And on the eighth day she shall take unto her two turtles, or two young pigeons, and bring them unto the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

entries.yo: Ki alufa ki o si ru ọkan li ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ, ati ekeji li ẹbọ sisun; ki alufa ki o si ṣètutu fun u niwaju OLUWA nitori isun aimọ́ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the priest shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for her before the LORD for the issue of her uncleanness.

entries.yo: Bayi ni ki ẹnyin ki o yà awọn ọmọ Israeli kuro ninu aimọ́ wọn; ki nwọn ki o má ba kú ninu aimọ́ wọn, nigbati nwọn ba sọ ibugbé mi ti mbẹ lãrin wọn di aimọ́.
entries.en: Thus shall ye separate the children of Israel from their uncleanness; that they die not in their uncleanness, when they defile my tabernacle that is among them.

entries.yo: Eyi li ofin ẹniti o ní isun, ati ti ẹniti ohun irú rẹ̀ jade lara rẹ̀, ti o si ti ipa rẹ̀ di alaimọ́;
entries.en: This is the law of him that hath an issue, and of him whose seed goeth from him, and is defiled therewith;

entries.yo: Ati ti ẹniti o ri ohun obinrin rẹ̀, ati ti ẹniti o ní isun, ati ti ọkunrin, ati ti obinrin, ati ti ẹniti o ba bá ẹniti iṣe alaimọ́ dàpọ.
entries.en: And of her that is sick of her flowers, and of him that hath an issue, of the man, and of the woman, and of him that lieth with her that is unclean.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose lẹhin ikú awọn ọmọ Aaroni meji, nigbati nwọn rubọ niwaju OLUWA, ti nwọn si kú;
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they offered before the LORD, and died;

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe, Sọ fun Aaroni arakunrin rẹ, ki o máṣe wá nigbagbogbo sinu ibi mimọ́, ninu aṣọ-ikele niwaju itẹ́-ãnu, ti o wà lori apoti nì; ki o má ba kú: nitoripe emi o farahàn ninu awọsanma lori itẹ́-ãnu.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Speak unto Aaron thy brother, that he come not at all times into the holy place within the vail before the mercy seat, which is upon the ark; that he die not: for I will appear in the cloud upon the mercy seat.

entries.yo: Bayi ni ki Aaroni ki o ma wá sinu ibi mimọ́: pẹlu ẹgbọrọ akọmalu fun ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ, ati àgbo fun ẹbọ sisun.
entries.en: Thus shall Aaron come into the holy place: with a young bullock for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering.

entries.yo: Ki o si mú ẹ̀wu ọ̀gbọ mimọ́ wọ̀, ki o si bọ̀ ṣòkoto ọ̀gbọ nì si ara rẹ̀, ki a si fi amure ọ̀gbọ kan dì i, fila ọ̀gbọ ni ki a fi ṣe e li ọṣọ́: aṣọ mimọ́ ni wọnyi; nitorina ni o ṣe wẹ̀ ara rẹ̀ ninu omi, ki o si mú wọn wọ̀.
entries.en: He shall put on the holy linen coat, and he shall have the linen breeches upon his flesh, and shall be girded with a linen girdle, and with the linen mitre shall he be attired: these are holy garments; therefore shall he wash his flesh in water, and so put them on.

entries.yo: Ki o si gbà ọmọ ewurẹ meji akọ fun ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ, ati àgbo kan fun ẹbọ sisun, lọwọ ijọ awọn ọmọ Israeli.
entries.en: And he shall take of the congregation of the children of Israel two kids of the goats for a sin offering, and one ram for a burnt offering.

entries.yo: Ki Aaroni ki o si fi akọmalu ru ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ, ti iṣe ti on tikara rẹ̀, ki o si ṣètutu fun ara rẹ̀, ati fun ile rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Aaron shall offer his bullock of the sin offering, which is for himself, and make an atonement for himself, and for his house.

entries.yo: Ki o si mú ewurẹ meji nì, ki o si mú wọn wá siwaju OLUWA si ẹnu-ọ̀na agọ́ ajọ.
entries.en: And he shall take the two goats, and present them before the LORD at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

entries.yo: Ki Aaroni ki o si di ìbo ewurẹ meji na; ìbo kan fun OLUWA, ati ìbo keji fun Asaseli (ewurẹ idasilẹlọ).
entries.en: And Aaron shall cast lots upon the two goats; one lot for the LORD, and the other lot for the scapegoat.

entries.yo: Ki Aaroni ki o si mú ewurẹ ti ìbo OLUWA mú wá, ki o si fi ru ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ.
entries.en: And Aaron shall bring the goat upon which the LORD's lot fell, and offer him for a sin offering.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ewurẹ ti ìbo mú fun Asaseli on ni ki o múwa lãye siwaju OLUWA, lati fi i ṣètutu, ati ki o si jọwọ rẹ̀ lọwọ lọ si ijù fun Asaseli.
entries.en: But the goat, on which the lot fell to be the scapegoat, shall be presented alive before the LORD, to make an atonement with him, and to let him go for a scapegoat into the wilderness.

entries.yo: Ki Aaroni ki o si mú akọmalu ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ wá, ti iṣe ti on tikararẹ̀, ki o si ṣètutu fun ara rẹ̀, ati fun ile rẹ̀, ki o si pa akọmalu ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ ti iṣe fun ara rẹ̀:
entries.en: And Aaron shall bring the bullock of the sin offering, which is for himself, and shall make an atonement for himself, and for his house, and shall kill the bullock of the sin offering which is for himself:

entries.yo: Ki o si mú awo-turari ti o kún fun ẹyin iná lati ori pẹpẹ wá lati iwaju OLUWA, ki ọwọ́ rẹ̀ ki o si kún fun turari didùn ti a gún kunná, ki o si mú u wá sinu aṣọ-ikele:
entries.en: And he shall take a censer full of burning coals of fire from off the altar before the LORD, and his hands full of sweet incense beaten small, and bring it within the vail:

entries.yo: Ki o si fi turari na sinu iná niwaju OLUWA, ki ẽfin turari ki o le bò itẹ́-ãnu ti mbẹ lori ẹri, ki on ki o má ba kú.
entries.en: And he shall put the incense upon the fire before the LORD, that the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy seat that is upon the testimony, that he die not:

entries.yo: Ki o si mú ninu ẹ̀jẹ akọmalu na, ki o si fi ika rẹ̀ wọn ọ sori itẹ́-ãnu ni ìha ìla-õrùn; ati niwaju itẹ́-ãnu ni ki o fi ìka rẹ̀ wọ́n ninu ẹ̀jẹ na nigba meje.
entries.en: And he shall take of the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle it with his finger upon the mercy seat eastward; and before the mercy seat shall he sprinkle of the blood with his finger seven times.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ki o pa ewurẹ ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ, eyiti iṣe ti awọn enia, ki o si mú ẹ̀jẹ rẹ̀ wá sinu aṣọ-ikele, ki o si fi ẹ̀jẹ na ṣe bi o ti fi ẹ̀jẹ akọmalu ṣe, ki o si fi wọ́n ori itẹ̀-ãnu, ati niwaju itẹ́-ãnu:
entries.en: Then shall he kill the goat of the sin offering, that is for the people, and bring his blood within the vail, and do with that blood as he did with the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle it upon the mercy seat, and before the mercy seat:

entries.yo: Ki o si ṣètutu si ibi mimọ́ nì, nitori aimọ́ awọn ọmọ Israeli, ati nitori irekọja wọn, ani gbogbo ẹ̀ṣẹ wọn: bẹ̃ni ki o si ṣe si agọ́ ajọ, ti mbẹ lọdọ wọn ninu aimọ́ wọn.
entries.en: And he shall make an atonement for the holy place, because of the uncleanness of the children of Israel, and because of their transgressions in all their sins: and so shall he do for the tabernacle of the congregation, that remaineth among them in the midst of their uncleanness.

entries.yo: Ki o má si sí ẹnikan ninu agọ́ ajọ nigbati o ba wọle lati ṣètutu ninu ibi mimọ́, titi yio fi jade, ti o si ti ṣètutu fun ara rẹ̀, ati fun ile rẹ̀, ati fun gbogbo ijọ enia Israeli.
entries.en: And there shall be no man in the tabernacle of the congregation when he goeth in to make an atonement in the holy place, until he come out, and have made an atonement for himself, and for his household, and for all the congregation of Israel.

entries.yo: Ki o si jade si ibi pẹpẹ ti mbẹ niwaju OLUWA, ki o si ṣètutu si i; ki o si mú ninu ẹ̀jẹ akọmalu na, ati ninu ẹ̀jẹ ewurẹ na, ki o si fi i sara iwo pẹpẹ na yiká.
entries.en: And he shall go out unto the altar that is before the LORD, and make an atonement for it; and shall take of the blood of the bullock, and of the blood of the goat, and put it upon the horns of the altar round about.

entries.yo: Ki o si fi ika rẹ̀ mú ninu ẹ̀jẹ na wọ́n ara rẹ̀ nigba meje, ki o si wẹ̀ ẹ mọ́, ki o si yà a simimọ́ kuro ninu aimọ́ awọn ọmọ Israeli.
entries.en: And he shall sprinkle of the blood upon it with his finger seven times, and cleanse it, and hallow it from the uncleanness of the children of Israel.

entries.yo: Nigbati o ba si pari ati ṣètutu si ibi mimọ́, ati si agọ́ ajọ, ati pẹpẹ, ki o mú ewurẹ alãye nì wá:
entries.en: And when he hath made an end of reconciling the holy place, and the tabernacle of the congregation, and the altar, he shall bring the live goat:

entries.yo: Ki Aaroni ki o si fi ọwọ́ rẹ̀ mejeji lé ori ewurẹ alãye na, ki o si jẹwọ gbogbo aiṣedede awọn ọmọ Israeli sori rẹ̀, ati gbogbo irekọja wọn, ani gbogbo ẹ̀ṣẹ wọn; ki o si fi wọn lé ori ewurẹ na, ki o si ti ọwọ́ ẹniti o yẹ rán a lọ si ijù:
entries.en: And Aaron shall lay both his hands upon the head of the live goat, and confess over him all the iniquities of the children of Israel, and all their transgressions in all their sins, putting them upon the head of the goat, and shall send him away by the hand of a fit man into the wilderness:

entries.yo: Ki ewurẹ na ki o si rù gbogbo aiṣedede wọn lori rẹ̀ lọ si ilẹ ti a kò tẹ̀dó: ki o si jọwọ ewurẹ na lọwọ lọ sinu ijù.
entries.en: And the goat shall bear upon him all their iniquities unto a land not inhabited: and he shall let go the goat in the wilderness.

entries.yo: Ki Aaroni ki o si wá sinu agọ́ ajọ, ki o si bọ́ aṣọ ọ̀gbọ wọnni silẹ, ti o múwọ̀ nigbati o wọ̀ ibi mimọ́ lọ, ki o si fi wọn sibẹ̀:
entries.en: And Aaron shall come into the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall put off the linen garments, which he put on when he went into the holy place, and shall leave them there:

entries.yo: Ki o si fi omi wẹ̀ ara rẹ̀ ni ibi mimọ́ kan, ki o si mú aṣọ rẹ̀ wọ̀, ki o si jade wá, ki o si ru ẹbọ sisun rẹ̀, ati ẹbọ sisun awọn enia, ki o si ṣètutu fun ara rẹ̀ ati fun awọn enia.
entries.en: And he shall wash his flesh with water in the holy place, and put on his garments, and come forth, and offer his burnt offering, and the burnt offering of the people, and make an atonement for himself, and for the people.

entries.yo: Ọrá ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ nì ni ki o si sun lori pẹpẹ.
entries.en: And the fat of the sin offering shall he burn upon the altar.

entries.yo: Ati ẹniti o jọwọ ewurẹ nì lọwọ lọ fun Asaseli, ki o fọ̀ aṣọ rẹ̀, ki o si wẹ̀ ara rẹ̀ ninu omi, lẹhin eyinì ni ki o wá si ibudó.
entries.en: And he that let go the goat for the scapegoat shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward come into the camp.

entries.yo: Ati akọmalu nì fun ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ, ati ewurẹ nì fun ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ, ẹ̀jẹ eyiti a múwa lati fi ṣètutu ni ibi mimọ́, ni ki ẹnikan ki o mú jade lọ sẹhin ode ibudó; ki nwọn ki o si sun awọ wọn, ati ẹran wọn, ati igbẹ́ wọn ninu iná.
entries.en: And the bullock for the sin offering, and the goat for the sin offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the holy place, shall one carry forth without the camp; and they shall burn in the fire their skins, and their flesh, and their dung.

entries.yo: Ati ẹniti o sun wọn ni ki o fọ̀ aṣọ rẹ̀, ki o si wẹ̀ ara rẹ̀ ninu omi, lẹhin eyinì ni ki o wá si ibudó.
entries.en: And he that burneth them shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.

entries.yo: Eyi ni ki o si ma ṣe ìlana lailai fun nyin: pe li oṣù keje, li ọjọ́ kẹwa oṣù, ni ki ẹnyin ki o pọ́n ọkàn nyin loju, ki ẹnyin má si ṣe iṣẹ kan rára, iba ṣe ibilẹ, tabi alejò ti nṣe atipo lãrin nyin:
entries.en: And this shall be a statute for ever unto you: that in the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, ye shall afflict your souls, and do no work at all, whether it be one of your own country, or a stranger that sojourneth among you:

entries.yo: Nitoripe li ọjọ́ na li a o ṣètutu fun nyin, lati wẹ̀ nyin mọ́; ki ẹnyin ki o le mọ́ kuro ninu gbogbo ẹ̀ṣẹ nyin niwaju OLUWA.
entries.en: For on that day shall the priest make an atonement for you, to cleanse you, that ye may be clean from all your sins before the LORD.

entries.yo: On o jẹ́ ọjọ́ isimi fun nyin, ki ẹnyin ki o si pọ́n ọkàn nyin loju, nipa ìlana titilai.
entries.en: It shall be a sabbath of rest unto you, and ye shall afflict your souls, by a statute for ever.

entries.yo: Ati alufa na, ẹniti a o ta oróro si li ori, ati ẹniti a o yàsimimọ́ si iṣẹ-alufa dipò baba rẹ̀, on ni ki o ṣètutu na, ki o si mú aṣọ ọ̀gbọ wọnni wọ̀, ani aṣọ mimọ́ wọnni:
entries.en: And the priest, whom he shall anoint, and whom he shall consecrate to minister in the priest's office in his father's stead, shall make the atonement, and shall put on the linen clothes, even the holy garments:

entries.yo: Ki o si ṣètutu si ibi mimọ́, ki o si ṣètutu si agọ́ ajọ, ati si pẹpẹ; ki o si ṣètutu fun awọn alufa, ati fun gbogbo ijọ enia.
entries.en: And he shall make an atonement for the holy sanctuary, and he shall make an atonement for the tabernacle of the congregation, and for the altar, and he shall make an atonement for the priests, and for all the people of the congregation.

entries.yo: Ki eyi ki o si jẹ́ ìlana titilai fun nyin, lati ṣètutu fun awọn ọmọ Israeli nitori ẹ̀ṣẹ wọn gbogbo lẹ̃kan li ọdún. O si ṣe bi OLUWA ti fi aṣẹ fun Mose.
entries.en: And this shall be an everlasting statute unto you, to make an atonement for the children of Israel for all their sins once a year. And he did as the LORD commanded Moses.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Sọ fun Aaroni, ati fun awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, ati fun gbogbo awọn ọmọ Israeli, ki o si wi fun wọn pe; Eyi li ohun ti OLUWA ti palaṣẹ, wipe,
entries.en: Speak unto Aaron, and unto his sons, and unto all the children of Israel, and say unto them; This is the thing which the LORD hath commanded, saying,

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni ti iṣe enia ile Israeli, ti o ba pa akọmalu tabi ọdọ-agutan, tabi ewurẹ, ninu ibudó, tabi ti o pa a lẹhin ibudó,
entries.en: What man soever there be of the house of Israel, that killeth an ox, or lamb, or goat, in the camp, or that killeth it out of the camp,

entries.yo: Ti kò si mú u wá si ẹnu-ọ̀na agọ́ ajọ, lati ru u li ẹbọ wi OLUWA niwaju agọ́ OLUWA: a o kà ẹ̀jẹ si ọkunrin na lọrùn, o ta ẹ̀jẹ silẹ; ọkunrin na li a o si ke kuro ninu awọn enia rẹ̀:
entries.en: And bringeth it not unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, to offer an offering unto the LORD before the tabernacle of the LORD; blood shall be imputed unto that man; he hath shed blood; and that man shall be cut off from among his people:

entries.yo: Nitori idí eyi pe, ki awọn ọmọ Israeli ki o le ma mú ẹbọ wọn wá, ti nwọn ru ni oko gbangba, ani ki nwọn ki o le mú u tọ̀ OLUWA wá, si ẹnu-ọ̀na agọ́ ajọ, sọdọ alufa, ki o si ru wọn li ẹbọ alafia si OLUWA.
entries.en: To the end that the children of Israel may bring their sacrifices, which they offer in the open field, even that they may bring them unto the LORD, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, unto the priest, and offer them for peace offerings unto the LORD.

entries.yo: Ki alufa ki o si bù ẹ̀jẹ na wọ́n ori pẹpẹ OLUWA li ẹnu-ọ̀na agọ́ ajọ, ki o si sun ọrá na fun õrùn didún si OLUWA.
entries.en: And the priest shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar of the LORD at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and burn the fat for a sweet savour unto the LORD.

entries.yo: Ki nwọn ki o má si ṣe ru ẹbọ wọn si obukọ mọ́, ti nwọn ti ntọ̀ lẹhin ṣe àgbere. Eyi ni yio ma ṣe ìlana lailai fun wọn ni iran-iran wọn.
entries.en: And they shall no more offer their sacrifices unto devils, after whom they have gone a whoring. This shall be a statute for ever unto them throughout their generations.

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o si wi fun wọn, Ẹnikẹni ninu ile Israeli, tabi ninu alejò ti nṣe atipo ninu wọn, ti o ru ẹbọ sisun tabi ẹbọ kan,
entries.en: And thou shalt say unto them, Whatsoever man there be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers which sojourn among you, that offereth a burnt offering of sacrifice,

entries.yo: Ti kò si mú u wá si ẹnu-ọ̀na agọ́ ajọ, lati ru u si OLUWA; ani ọkunrin na li a o ke kuro ninu awọn enia rẹ̀.
entries.en: And bringeth it not unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, to offer it unto the LORD; even that man shall be cut off from among his people.

entries.yo: Ati ẹnikẹni ninu ile Israeli, tabi ninu alejò ti nṣe atipo ninu wọn, ti o ba jẹ ẹ̀jẹkẹjẹ; ani emi o kọ oju mi si ọkàn na ti o jẹ ẹ̀jẹ, emi o si ke e kuro ninu awọn enia rẹ̀.
entries.en: And whatsoever man there be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among you, that eateth any manner of blood; I will even set my face against that soul that eateth blood, and will cut him off from among his people.

entries.yo: Nitoripe ẹmi ara mbẹ ninu ẹ̀jẹ: emi si ti fi i fun nyin lati ma fi ṣètutu fun ọkàn nyin lori pẹpẹ nì: nitoripe ẹ̀jẹ ni iṣe ètutu fun ọkàn.
entries.en: For the life of the flesh is in the blood: and I have given it to you upon the altar to make an atonement for your souls: for it is the blood that maketh an atonement for the soul.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni mo ṣe wi fun awọn ọmọ Israeli pe, Ọkàn kan ninu nyin kò gbọdọ jẹ ẹ̀jẹ, bẹ̃li alejò kan ti nṣe atipo ninu nyin kò gbọdọ jẹ ẹ̀jẹ.
entries.en: Therefore I said unto the children of Israel, No soul of you shall eat blood, neither shall any stranger that sojourneth among you eat blood.

entries.yo: Ati ẹnikẹni ninu awọn ọmọ Israeli, tabi ninu awọn alejò ti nṣe atipo ninu wọn, ti nṣe ọdẹ ti o si mú ẹranko tabi ẹiyẹ ti a ba jẹ; ani ki o ro ẹ̀jẹ rẹ̀ dànu, ki o si fi erupẹ bò o.
entries.en: And whatsoever man there be of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among you, which hunteth and catcheth any beast or fowl that may be eaten; he shall even pour out the blood thereof, and cover it with dust.

entries.yo: Nitoripe ẹmi gbogbo ara ni, ẹ̀jẹ rẹ̀ ni ẹmi rẹ̀: nitorina ni mo ṣe wi fun awọn ọmọ Israeli pe, Ẹnyin kò gbọdọ jẹ ẹ̀jẹ ẹrankẹran: nitoripe ẹ̀jẹ li ẹmi ara gbogbo: ẹnikẹni ti o ba jẹ ẹ li a o ke kuro.
entries.en: For it is the life of all flesh; the blood of it is for the life thereof: therefore I said unto the children of Israel, Ye shall eat the blood of no manner of flesh: for the life of all flesh is the blood thereof: whosoever eateth it shall be cut off.

entries.yo: Ati gbogbo ọkàn ti o ba jẹ ẹran ti o tikara rẹ̀ kú, tabi eyiti a fàya, iba ṣe ọkan ninu awọn ibilẹ, tabi alejò, ki o fọ̀ aṣọ rẹ̀, ki o si wẹ̀ ara rẹ̀ ninu omi, ki o si jẹ́ alaimọ́ titi di aṣalẹ: nigbana li on o mọ́.
entries.en: And every soul that eateth that which died of itself, or that which was torn with beasts, whether it be one of your own country, or a stranger, he shall both wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even: then shall he be clean.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi kò ba fọ̀ wọn, tabi ti kò si wẹ̀ ara rẹ̀; njẹ on o rù ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: But if he wash them not, nor bathe his flesh; then he shall bear his iniquity.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Sọ fun awọn ọmọ Israeli, ki o si wi fun wọn pe, Emi li OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin.
entries.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, I am the LORD your God.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin kò gbọdọ hùwa bi ìwa ilẹ Egipti nibiti ẹnyin ti ngbé: ẹnyin kò si gbọdọ hùwa ìwa ilẹ Kenaani, nibiti emi o mú nyin lọ: bẹ̃li ẹnyin kò gbọdọ rìn nipa ìlana wọn.
entries.en: After the doings of the land of Egypt, wherein ye dwelt, shall ye not do: and after the doings of the land of Canaan, whither I bring you, shall ye not do: neither shall ye walk in their ordinances.

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o ma ṣe ofin mi, ki ẹnyin si ma pa ìlana mi mọ́, lati ma rìn ninu wọn: Emi li OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin.
entries.en: Ye shall do my judgments, and keep mine ordinances, to walk therein: I am the LORD your God.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin o si ma pa ìlana mi mọ́, ati ofin mi: eyiti bi enia ba ṣe, on o ma yè ninu wọn: Emi li OLUWA.
entries.en: Ye shall therefore keep my statutes, and my judgments: which if a man do, he shall live in them: I am the LORD.

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni kò gbọdọ sunmọ ẹnikan ti iṣe ibatan rẹ̀ lati tú ìhoho rẹ̀: Emi li OLUWA.
entries.en: None of you shall approach to any that is near of kin to him, to uncover their nakedness: I am the LORD.

entries.yo: Ihoho baba rẹ, tabi ìhoho iya rẹ̀, ni iwọ kò gbọdọ tú: iya rẹ ni iṣe; iwọ kò gbọdọ tú ìhoho rẹ̀.
entries.en: The nakedness of thy father, or the nakedness of thy mother, shalt thou not uncover: she is thy mother; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.

entries.yo: Ihoho aya baba rẹ ni iwọ kò gbọdọ tú: ìhoho baba rẹ ni.
entries.en: The nakedness of thy father's wife shalt thou not uncover: it is thy father's nakedness.

entries.yo: Ihoho arabinrin rẹ, ọmọ baba rẹ, tabi ọmọ iya rẹ, ti a bi ni ile, tabi ti a bi li ode, ani ìhoho wọn ni iwọ kò gbọdọ tú.
entries.en: The nakedness of thy sister, the daughter of thy father, or daughter of thy mother, whether she be born at home, or born abroad, even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover.

entries.yo: Ìhoho ọmọbinrin ọmọ rẹ ọkunrin, tabi ti ọmọbinrin ọmọ rẹ obinrin, ani ìhoho wọn ni iwọ kò gbọdọ tú: nitoripe ìhoho ara rẹ ni nwọn.
entries.en: The nakedness of thy son's daughter, or of thy daughter's daughter, even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover: for theirs is thine own nakedness.

entries.yo: Ìhoho ọmọbinrin aya baba rẹ, ti a bi lati inu baba rẹ wá, arabinrin rẹ ni, iwọ kò gbọdọ tú ìhoho rẹ̀.
entries.en: The nakedness of thy father's wife's daughter, begotten of thy father, she is thy sister, thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.

entries.yo: Iwọ kò gbọdọ tú ìhoho arabinrin baba rẹ: ibatan baba rẹ ni.
entries.en: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father's sister: she is thy father's near kinswoman.

entries.yo: Iwọ kò gbọdọ tú ìhoho arabinrin iya rẹ: nitoripe ibatan iya rẹ ni.
entries.en: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother's sister: for she is thy mother's near kinswoman.

entries.yo: Iwọ kò gbọdọ tú ìhoho arakunrin baba rẹ, iwọ kò gbọdọ sunmọ aya rẹ̀: arabinrin baba rẹ ni.
entries.en: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father's brother, thou shalt not approach to his wife: she is thine aunt.

entries.yo: Iwọ kò gbọdọ tú ìhoho aya ọmọ rẹ: nitoripe aya ọmọ rẹ ni iṣe; iwọ kò gbọdọ tú ìhoho rẹ̀.
entries.en: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy daughter in law: she is thy son's wife; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.

entries.yo: Iwọ kò gbọdọ tú ìhoho aya arakunrin rẹ: ìhoho arakunrin rẹ ni.
entries.en: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy brother's wife: it is thy brother's nakedness.

entries.yo: Iwọ kò gbọdọ tú ìhoho obinrin ati ti ọmọbinrin rẹ̀; bẹ̃ni iwọ kò gbọdọ fẹ ọmọbinrin ọmọ rẹ̀ ọkunrin, tabi ọmọbinrin ọmọ rẹ̀ obinrin, lati tú ìhoho wọn; nitoripe ibatan ni nwọn: ohun buburu ni.
entries.en: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter, neither shalt thou take her son's daughter, or her daughter's daughter, to uncover her nakedness; for they are her near kinswomen: it is wickedness.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni iwọ kò gbọdọ fẹ́ arabinrin aya rẹ li aya, lati bà a ninu jẹ́, lati tú ìhoho rẹ̀, pẹlu rẹ̀ nigbati o wà lãye.
entries.en: Neither shalt thou take a wife to her sister, to vex her, to uncover her nakedness, beside the other in her life time.

entries.yo: Ati pẹlu iwọ kò gbọdọ sunmọ obinrin kan lati tú u ni ìhoho, ni ìwọn igbati a yà a sapakan nitori aimọ́ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Also thou shalt not approach unto a woman to uncover her nakedness, as long as she is put apart for her uncleanness.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu iwọ kò gbọdọ bá aya ẹnikeji rẹ dàpọ lati bà ara rẹ jẹ́ pẹlu rẹ̀.
entries.en: Moreover thou shalt not lie carnally with thy neighbour's wife, to defile thyself with her.

entries.yo: Iwọ kò si gbọdọ fi irú-ọmọ rẹ kan fun Moleki, bẹ̃ni iwọ kò gbọdọ bà orukọ Ọlọrun rẹ jẹ́: Emi li OLUWA.
entries.en: And thou shalt not let any of thy seed pass through the fire to Molech, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I am the LORD.

entries.yo: Iwọ kò gbọdọ bá ọkunrin dápọ bi obinrin: irira ni.
entries.en: Thou shalt not lie with mankind, as with womankind: it is abomination.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni iwọ kò gbọdọ bá ẹranko kan dàpọ, lati fi i bà ara rẹ jẹ́: bẹ̃ni obinrin kan kò gbọdọ duro niwaju ẹranko kan lati dubulẹ tì i: idaru-dàpọ ni.
entries.en: Neither shalt thou lie with any beast to defile thyself therewith: neither shall any woman stand before a beast to lie down thereto: it is confusion.

entries.yo: Ẹ máṣe bà ara nyin jẹ́ ninu gbogbo nkan wọnyi: nitoripe ninu gbogbo nkan wọnyi li awọn orilẹ-ède, ti mo lé jade niwaju nyin dibajẹ́:
entries.en: Defile not ye yourselves in any of these things: for in all these the nations are defiled which I cast out before you:

entries.yo: Ilẹ na si dibajẹ́: nitorina ni mo ṣe bẹ̀ ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ̀ wò lori rẹ̀, ilẹ tikararẹ̀ si bì awọn olugbé rẹ̀ jade.
entries.en: And the land is defiled: therefore I do visit the iniquity thereof upon it, and the land itself vomiteth out her inhabitants.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni ki ẹnyin ki o ṣe ma pa ìlana ati ofin mi mọ́, ki ẹnyin ki o máṣe ṣe ọkan ninu irira wọnyi; tabi ẹnikan ninu ibilẹ nyin, tabi alejò ti nṣe atipo ninu nyin:
entries.en: Ye shall therefore keep my statutes and my judgments, and shall not commit any of these abominations; neither any of your own nation, nor any stranger that sojourneth among you:

entries.yo: Nitoripe gbogbo irira wọnyi li awọn ọkunrin ilẹ na ṣe, ti o ti wà ṣaju nyin, ilẹ na si dibajẹ́;
entries.en: (For all these abominations have the men of the land done, which were before you, and the land is defiled;)

entries.yo: Ki ilẹ na ki o má ba bì nyin jade pẹlu, nigbati ẹnyin ba bà a jẹ́, bi o ti bì awọn orilẹ-ède jade, ti o ti wà ṣaju nyin.
entries.en: That the land spue not you out also, when ye defile it, as it spued out the nations that were before you.

entries.yo: Nitoripe ẹnikẹni ti o ba ṣe ọkan ninu irira wọnyi, ani ọkàn wọnni ti o ba ṣe wọn li a o ke kuro lãrin awọn enia wọn.
entries.en: For whosoever shall commit any of these abominations, even the souls that commit them shall be cut off from among their people.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni ki ẹnyin ki o pa aṣẹ mi mọ́, ki ẹnyin ki o máṣe ọkan ninu irira wọnyi, ti nwọn ti ṣe ṣaju nyin, ki ẹnyin ki o má si bà ara nyin jẹ́ ninu rẹ̀: Emi li OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin.
entries.en: Therefore shall ye keep mine ordinance, that ye commit not any one of these abominable customs, which were committed before you, and that ye defile not yourselves therein: I am the LORD your God.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Sọ fun gbogbo ijọ awọn ọmọ Israeli, ki o si wi fun wọn pe, Ki ẹnyin ki o jẹ́ mimọ́: nitoripe Emi OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin jẹ́ mimọ́.
entries.en: Speak unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, and say unto them, Ye shall be holy: for I the LORD your God am holy.

entries.yo: Ki olukuluku nyin ki o bẹ̀ru iya rẹ̀, ati baba rẹ̀, ki o si ma pa ọjọ́ isimi mi mọ́: Emi li OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin.
entries.en: Ye shall fear every man his mother, and his father, and keep my sabbaths: I am the LORD your God.

entries.yo: Ẹ máṣe yipada si ere, bẹ̃ni ki ẹnyin má si ṣe ṣe oriṣa didà fun ara nyin: Emi li OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin.
entries.en: Turn ye not unto idols, nor make to yourselves molten gods: I am the LORD your God.

entries.yo: Bi ẹnyin ba si ru ẹbọ alafia si OLUWA, ki ẹnyin ki o ru u ki ẹ le di ẹni itẹwọgbà.
entries.en: And if ye offer a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the LORD, ye shall offer it at your own will.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ́ ti ẹnyin ru ẹbọ na ni ki a jẹ ẹ, ati ni ijọ́ keji: bi ohun kan ba si kù ninu rẹ̀ titi di ijọ́ kẹta, ninu iná ni ki a sun u.
entries.en: It shall be eaten the same day ye offer it, and on the morrow: and if ought remain until the third day, it shall be burnt in the fire.

entries.yo: Bi a ba si jẹ ninu rẹ̀ rára ni ijọ́ kẹta, irira ni; ki yio dà:
entries.en: And if it be eaten at all on the third day, it is abominable; it shall not be accepted.

entries.yo: Nitorina ẹniti o ba jẹ ẹ ni yio rù ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ̀, nitoriti o bà ohun mimọ́ OLUWA jẹ́: ọkàn na li a o si ke kuro ninu awọn enia rẹ̀.
entries.en: Therefore every one that eateth it shall bear his iniquity, because he hath profaned the hallowed thing of the LORD: and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.

entries.yo: Ati nigbati ẹnyin ba nṣe ikore ilẹ nyin, iwọ kò gbọdọ ṣa igun oko rẹ li aṣatán, bẹ̃ni iwọ kò gbọdọ pa èṣẹ́ ikore rẹ.
entries.en: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not wholly reap the corners of thy field, neither shalt thou gather the gleanings of thy harvest.

entries.yo: Iwọ kò si gbọdọ pèṣẹ́ ọgbà-àjara rẹ, bẹ̃ni iwọ kò gbọdọ ká gbogbo àjara ọgbà-àjara rẹ; ki iwọ ki o fi wọn silẹ fun awọn talaka ati alejò: Emi li OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin.
entries.en: And thou shalt not glean thy vineyard, neither shalt thou gather every grape of thy vineyard; thou shalt leave them for the poor and stranger: I am the LORD your God.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin kò gbọdọ jale, bẹ̃li ẹnyin kò gbọdọ ṣe alaiṣõtọ, bẹ̃li ẹnyin kò gbọdọ ṣeké fun ara nyin.
entries.en: Ye shall not steal, neither deal falsely, neither lie one to another.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin kò si gbọdọ fi orukọ mi bura eké, bẹ̃ni iwọ kò gbọdọ bà orukọ Ọlọrun rẹ jẹ́: Emi li OLUWA.
entries.en: And ye shall not swear by my name falsely, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I am the LORD.

entries.yo: Iwọ kò gbọdọ rẹ́ ẹnikeji rẹ jẹ, bẹ̃ni iwọ kò gbọdọ jẹ haramu: owo ọ̀ya alagbaṣe kò gbọdọ sùn ọdọ rẹ titi di owurọ̀.
entries.en: Thou shalt not defraud thy neighbour, neither rob him: the wages of him that is hired shall not abide with thee all night until the morning.

entries.yo: Iwọ kò gbọdọ bú aditi, tabi ki o fi ohun idugbolu siwaju afọju, ṣugbọn ki iwọ ki o bẹ̀ru Ọlọrun rẹ: Emi li OLUWA.
entries.en: Thou shalt not curse the deaf, nor put a stumblingblock before the blind, but shalt fear thy God: I am the LORD.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin kò gbọdọ ṣe aiṣododo ni idajọ: iwọ kò gbọdọ gbè talaka, bẹ̃ni iwọ kò gbọdọ ṣe ojusaju alagbara: li ododo ni ki iwọ ki o mã ṣe idajọ ẹnikeji rẹ.
entries.en: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment: thou shalt not respect the person of the poor, nor honour the person of the mighty: but in righteousness shalt thou judge thy neighbour.

entries.yo: Iwọ kò gbọdọ lọ soke lọ sodo bi olofófo lãrin awọn enia rẹ: bẹ̃ni iwọ kò gbọdọ ró tì ẹ̀jẹ ẹnikeji rẹ: Emi li OLUWA.
entries.en: Thou shalt not go up and down as a talebearer among thy people: neither shalt thou stand against the blood of thy neighbour: I am the LORD.

entries.yo: Iwọ kò gbọdọ korira arakunrin rẹ li ọkàn rẹ: ki iwọ ki o bá ẹnikeji rẹ wi, ki iwọ ki o máṣe jẹbi nitori ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Thou shalt not hate thy brother in thine heart: thou shalt in any wise rebuke thy neighbour, and not suffer sin upon him.

entries.yo: Iwọ kò gbọdọ gbẹsan, bẹ̃ni ki o máṣe ṣe ikùnsinu si awọn ọmọ enia rẹ, ṣugbọn ki iwọ ki o fẹ́ ẹnikeji rẹ bi ara rẹ: Emi li OLUWA.
entries.en: Thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people, but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself: I am the LORD.

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o pa ìlana mi mọ́. Iwọ kò gbọdọ jẹ ki ẹranọ̀sin rẹ ki o ba onirũru dàpọ: iwọ kò gbọdọ fọ́n daru-dàpọ irugbìn si oko rẹ: bẹ̃li aṣọ ti a fi ọ̀gbọ ati kubusu hun pọ̀ kò gbọdọ kan ara rẹ.
entries.en: Ye shall keep my statutes. Thou shalt not let thy cattle gender with a diverse kind: thou shalt not sow thy field with mingled seed: neither shall a garment mingled of linen and woollen come upon thee.

entries.yo: Ati ẹnikẹni ti o ba bá obinrin dàpọ, ti iṣe ẹrú, ti a fẹ́ fun ọkọ, ti a kò ti ràpada rára, ti a kò ti sọ di omnira; ọ̀ran ìna ni; ki a máṣe pa wọn, nitoriti obinrin na ki iṣe omnira.
entries.en: And whosoever lieth carnally with a woman, that is a bondmaid, betrothed to an husband, and not at all redeemed, nor freedom given her; she shall be scourged; they shall not be put to death, because she was not free.

entries.yo: Ki ọkunrin na ki o si mú ẹbọ ẹbi rẹ̀ wá fun OLUWA, si ẹnu-ọ̀na agọ́ ajọ, ani àgbo kan fun ẹbọ ẹbi.
entries.en: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the LORD, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, even a ram for a trespass offering.

entries.yo: Ki alufa ki o si fi àgbo ẹbọ ẹbi ṣètutu fun u niwaju OLUWA nitori ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ̀ ti o da: a o si dari ẹ̀ṣẹ ti o da jì i.
entries.en: And the priest shall make an atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering before the LORD for his sin which he hath done: and the sin which he hath done shall be forgiven him.

entries.yo: Ati nigbati ẹnyin o ba si dé ilẹ na, ti ẹnyin o si gbìn onirũru igi fun onjẹ, nigbana ni ki ẹnyin kà eso rẹ̀ si alaikọlà: li ọdún mẹta ni ki o jasi bi alaikọlà fun nyin; ki a máṣe jẹ ẹ.
entries.en: And when ye shall come into the land, and shall have planted all manner of trees for food, then ye shall count the fruit thereof as uncircumcised: three years shall it be as uncircumcised unto you: it shall not be eaten of.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn li ọdún kẹrin, gbogbo eso rẹ̀ na ni yio jẹ́ mimọ́, si ìyin OLUWA.
entries.en: But in the fourth year all the fruit thereof shall be holy to praise the LORD withal.

entries.yo: Ati li ọdún karun ni ki ẹnyin ki o ma jẹ ninu eso rẹ̀, ki o le ma mú ibisi rẹ̀ wá fun nyin: Emi li OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin.
entries.en: And in the fifth year shall ye eat of the fruit thereof, that it may yield unto you the increase thereof: I am the LORD your God.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin kò gbọdọ jẹ ohun kan ti on ti ẹ̀jẹ: bẹ̃li ẹnyin kò gbọdọ ṣe ifaiya, tabi ṣe akiyesi ìgba.
entries.en: Ye shall not eat any thing with the blood: neither shall ye use enchantment, nor observe times.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin kò gbọdọ gẹ̀ ori nyin, bẹ̃ni iwọ kò gbọdọ tọ́ irungbọn rẹ.
entries.en: Ye shall not round the corners of your heads, neither shalt thou mar the corners of thy beard.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin kò gbọdọ sín gbẹ́rẹ kan si ara nyin nitori okú, bẹ̃li ẹnyin kò gbọdọ kọ àmi kan si ara nyin: Emi li OLUWA.
entries.en: Ye shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor print any marks upon you: I am the LORD.

entries.yo: Máṣe bà ọmọ rẹ obinrin jẹ́, lati mu u ṣe àgbere; ki ilẹ na ki o má ba di ilẹ àgbere, ati ki ilẹ na má ba kún fun ìwabuburu.
entries.en: Do not prostitute thy daughter, to cause her to be a whore; lest the land fall to whoredom, and the land become full of wickedness.

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o si ma pa ọjọ́ isimi mi mọ́, ki ẹnyin ki o si bọ̀wọ fun ibi mimọ́ mi: Emi li OLUWA.
entries.en: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I am the LORD.

entries.yo: Máṣe yipada tọ̀ awọn ti o ní ìmọ afọṣẹ, bẹ̃ni ki ẹnyin ki o má si ṣe wá ajẹ́ kiri, lati fi wọn bà ara nyin jẹ́: Emi li OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin.
entries.en: Regard not them that have familiar spirits, neither seek after wizards, to be defiled by them: I am the LORD your God.

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o si dide duro niwaju ori-ewú, ki o si bọ̀wọ fun oju arugbo, ki o si bẹ̀ru Ọlọrun rẹ: Emi li OLUWA.
entries.en: Thou shalt rise up before the hoary head, and honour the face of the old man, and fear thy God: I am the LORD.

entries.yo: Ati bi alejò kan ba nṣe atipo pẹlu rẹ ni ilẹ nyin, ẹnyin kò gbọdọ ni i lara.
entries.en: And if a stranger sojourn with thee in your land, ye shall not vex him.

entries.yo: Ki alejò ti mbá nyin gbé ki o jasi fun nyin bi ibilẹ, ki iwọ ki o si fẹ́ ẹ bi ara rẹ; nitoripe ẹnyin ti ṣe alejò ni ilẹ Egipti: Emi li OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin.
entries.en: But the stranger that dwelleth with you shall be unto you as one born among you, and thou shalt love him as thyself; for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt: I am the LORD your God.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin kò gbọdọ ṣe aiṣododo ni idajọ, ni ìwọn ọpá, ni òṣuwọn iwuwo, tabi ni òṣuwọn oninu.
entries.en: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in meteyard, in weight, or in measure.

entries.yo: Oṣuwọn otitọ, òṣuwọn iwuwo otitọ, òṣuwọn efa otitọ, ati òṣuwọn hini otitọ, ni ki ẹnyin ki o ní: Emi li OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin, ti o mú nyin lati ilẹ Egipti jade wá.
entries.en: Just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin, shall ye have: I am the LORD your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni ki ẹnyin ki o si ma kiyesi gbogbo ìlana mi, ati si gbogbo idajọ mi, ki ẹnyin si ma ṣe wọn: Emi li OLUWA.
entries.en: Therefore shall ye observe all my statutes, and all my judgments, and do them: I am the LORD.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Iwọ o si sọ fun awọn ọmọ Israeli pe, Ẹnikẹni ninu awọn ọmọ Israeli, tabi ninu awọn alejò ti nṣe atipo ni Israeli, ti o ba fi ninu irú-ọmọ rẹ̀ fun Moleki; pipa ni ki a pa a: ki awọn enia ilẹ na ki o sọ ọ li okuta pa.
entries.en: Again, thou shalt say to the children of Israel, Whosoever he be of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn in Israel, that giveth any of his seed unto Molech; he shall surely be put to death: the people of the land shall stone him with stones.

entries.yo: Emi o si kọju mi si ọkunrin na, emi o si ke e kuro lãrin awọn enia rẹ̀; nitoriti o fi ninu irú-ọmọ rẹ̀ fun Moleki, lati sọ ibi mimọ́ mi di aimọ́, ati lati bà orukọ mimọ́ mi jẹ́.
entries.en: And I will set my face against that man, and will cut him off from among his people; because he hath given of his seed unto Molech, to defile my sanctuary, and to profane my holy name.

entries.yo: Bi awọn enia ilẹ na ba si mú oju wọn kuro lara ọkunrin na, nigbati o ba fi ninu irú-ọmọ rẹ̀ fun Moleki, ti nwọn kò si pa a:
entries.en: And if the people of the land do any ways hide their eyes from the man, when he giveth of his seed unto Molech, and kill him not:

entries.yo: Nigbana li emi o kọju si ọkunrin na, ati si idile rẹ̀, emi o si ke e kuro, ati gbogbo awọn ti o ṣe àgbere tọ̀ ọ lẹhin, lati ma ṣe àgbere tọ̀ Moleki lẹhin, lãrin awọn enia wọn.
entries.en: Then I will set my face against that man, and against his family, and will cut him off, and all that go a whoring after him, to commit whoredom with Molech, from among their people.

entries.yo: Ati ọkàn ti o ba yipada tọ̀ awọn ti o ní ìmọ afọṣẹ, ati ajẹ́, lati ṣe àgbere tọ̀ wọn lẹhin, ani emi o kọju mi si ọkàn na, emi o si ke e kuro lãrin awọn enia rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the soul that turneth after such as have familiar spirits, and after wizards, to go a whoring after them, I will even set my face against that soul, and will cut him off from among his people.

entries.yo: Nitorina ẹnyin yà ara nyin simimọ́, ki ẹnyin ki o si jẹ́ mimọ́: nitoripe Emi li OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin.
entries.en: Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be ye holy: for I am the LORD your God.

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o si ma pa ìlana mi mọ́, ki ẹnyin si ma ṣe wọn: Emi li OLUWA ti nyà nyin simimọ́.
entries.en: And ye shall keep my statutes, and do them: I am the LORD which sanctify you.

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni ti o ba fi baba tabi iya rẹ̀ ré, pipa li a o pa a: o fi baba on iya rẹ̀ ré; ẹ̀jẹ rẹ̀ wà lori rẹ̀.
entries.en: For every one that curseth his father or his mother shall be surely put to death: he hath cursed his father or his mother; his blood shall be upon him.

entries.yo: Ati ọkunrin na ti o bá aya ọkunrin miran ṣe panṣaga, ani on ti o bá aya ẹnikeji rẹ̀ ṣe panṣaga, panṣaga ọkunrin ati panṣaga obinrin li a o pa nitõtọ.
entries.en: And the man that committeth adultery with another man's wife, even he that committeth adultery with his neighbour's wife, the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death.

entries.yo: Ati ọkunrin ti o bá aya baba rẹ̀ dàpọ, o tú ìhoho baba rẹ̀: pipa li a o pa awọn mejeji; ẹ̀jẹ wọn yio wà lori wọn.
entries.en: And the man that lieth with his father's wife hath uncovered his father's nakedness: both of them shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.

entries.yo: Ọkunrin kan ti o ba bá aya ọmọ rẹ̀ dàpọ, pipa ni ki a pa awọn mejeji: nwọn ṣe rudurudu; ẹ̀jẹ wọn wà lori wọn.
entries.en: And if a man lie with his daughter in law, both of them shall surely be put to death: they have wrought confusion; their blood shall be upon them.

entries.yo: Ati ọkunrin ti o ba bá ọkunrin dàpọ, bi ẹni ba obinrin dàpọ, awọn mejeji li o ṣe ohun irira: pipa li a o pa wọn; ẹ̀jẹ wọn yio wà lori wọn.
entries.en: If a man also lie with mankind, as he lieth with a woman, both of them have committed an abomination: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.

entries.yo: Ati ọkunrin ti o ba fẹ́ obinrin ati iya rẹ̀, ìwabuburu ni: iná li a o fi sun wọn, ati on ati awọn; ki ìwabuburu ki o má ṣe sí lãrin nyin.
entries.en: And if a man take a wife and her mother, it is wickedness: they shall be burnt with fire, both he and they; that there be no wickedness among you.

entries.yo: Ati ọkunrin ti o ba bá ẹranko dàpọ, pipa ni ki a pa a: ki ẹnyin ki o si pa ẹranko na.
entries.en: And if a man lie with a beast, he shall surely be put to death: and ye shall slay the beast.

entries.yo: Bi obinrin kan ba si sunmọ ẹranko kan, lati dubulẹ tì i, ki iwọ ki o pa obinrin na, ati ẹranko na: pipa ni ki a pa wọn; ẹ̀jẹ wọn yio wà lori wọn.
entries.en: And if a woman approach unto any beast, and lie down thereto, thou shalt kill the woman, and the beast: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.

entries.yo: Ati bi ọkunrin kan ba fẹ́ arabinrin rẹ̀, ọmọbinrin baba rẹ̀, tabi ọmọbinrin iya rẹ̀, ti o si ri ìhoho rẹ̀, ti on si ri ìhoho rẹ̀; ohun buburu ni; a o si ke wọn kuro loju awọn enia wọn: o tú ìhoho arabinrin rẹ̀; on o rù ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And if a man shall take his sister, his father's daughter, or his mother's daughter, and see her nakedness, and she see his nakedness; it is a wicked thing; and they shall be cut off in the sight of their people: he hath uncovered his sister's nakedness; he shall bear his iniquity.

entries.yo: Ati bi ọkunrin kan ba bá obinrin dàpọ ti o ní ohun obinrin rẹ̀ lara, ti o ba si tú u ni ìhoho; o tú isun rẹ̀ ni ìhoho, obinrin na si fi isun ẹ̀jẹ rẹ̀ hàn: awọn mejeji li a o si ke kuro lãrin awọn enia wọn.
entries.en: And if a man shall lie with a woman having her sickness, and shall uncover her nakedness; he hath discovered her fountain, and she hath uncovered the fountain of her blood: and both of them shall be cut off from among their people.

entries.yo: Iwọ kò si gbọdọ tú ìhoho arabinrin iya rẹ, tabi ti arabinrin baba rẹ: nitoripe o tú ìhoho ibatan rẹ̀: nwọn o rù ẹ̀ṣẹ wọn.
entries.en: And thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother's sister, nor of thy father's sister: for he uncovereth his near kin: they shall bear their iniquity.

entries.yo: Bi ọkunrin kan ba si bá aya arakunrin õbi rẹ̀ dàpọ, o tú ìhoho arakunrin õbi rẹ̀: nwọn o rù ẹ̀ṣẹ wọn; nwọn o kú li ailọmọ.
entries.en: And if a man shall lie with his uncle's wife, he hath uncovered his uncle's nakedness: they shall bear their sin; they shall die childless.

entries.yo: Bi ọkunrin kan ba si fẹ́ aya arakunrin rẹ̀, ohun-aimọ́ ni: o tú ìhoho arakunrin rẹ̀; nwọn o jẹ́ alailọmọ.
entries.en: And if a man shall take his brother's wife, it is an unclean thing: he hath uncovered his brother's nakedness; they shall be childless.

entries.yo: Nitorina li ẹnyin o ṣe ma pa gbogbo ìlana mi mọ́, ati gbogbo idajọ mi, ki ẹnyin si ma ṣe wọn: ki ilẹ na, ninu eyiti mo mú nyin wá tẹ̀dó si, ki o má ṣe bì nyin jade.
entries.en: Ye shall therefore keep all my statutes, and all my judgments, and do them: that the land, whither I bring you to dwell therein, spue you not out.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin kò si gbọdọ rìn ninu ìlana orilẹ-ède, ti emi lé jade kuro niwaju nyin: nitoriti nwọn ṣe gbogbo wọnyi, nitorina ni mo ṣe korira wọn.
entries.en: And ye shall not walk in the manners of the nation, which I cast out before you: for they committed all these things, and therefore I abhorred them.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi ti wi fun nyin pe, Ẹnyin o ní ilẹ wọn, ati pe emi o fi i fun nyin lati ní i, ilẹ ti nṣàn fun warà ati fun oyin: Emi li OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin, ti o yà nyin sọ̀tọ kuro ninu awọn orilẹ-ède.
entries.en: But I have said unto you, Ye shall inherit their land, and I will give it unto you to possess it, a land that floweth with milk and honey: I am the LORD your God, which have separated you from other people.

entries.yo: Nitorina ki ẹnyin ki o fi ìyatọ sãrin ẹranko mimọ́ ati alaimọ́, ati sãrin ẹiyẹ alaimọ́ ati mimọ́: ki ẹnyin ki o má si ṣe fi ẹranko, tabi ẹiyẹ, tabi ohunkohun alãye kan ti nrakò lori ilẹ, ti mo ti yàsọ̀tọ fun nyin bi alaimọ́, sọ ọkàn nyin di irira.
entries.en: Ye shall therefore put difference between clean beasts and unclean, and between unclean fowls and clean: and ye shall not make your souls abominable by beast, or by fowl, or by any manner of living thing that creepeth on the ground, which I have separated from you as unclean.

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o si jẹ́ mimọ́ fun mi: nitoripe mimọ́ li Emi OLUWA, mo si ti yà nyin sọ̀tọ kuro ninu awọn orilẹ-ède, ki ẹnyin ki o le jẹ́ ti emi.
entries.en: And ye shall be holy unto me: for I the LORD am holy, and have severed you from other people, that ye should be mine.

entries.yo: Ọkunrin pẹlu tabi obinrin ti o ní ìmo afọṣẹ, tabi ti iṣe ajẹ́, pipa ni ki a pa a: okuta ni ki a fi sọ wọn pa: ẹ̀jẹ wọn yio wà lori wọn.
entries.en: A man also or woman that hath a familiar spirit, or that is a wizard, shall surely be put to death: they shall stone them with stones: their blood shall be upon them.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe, Sọ fun awọn alufa, awọn ọmọ Aaroni, ki o si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹnikẹni ninu awọn enia rẹ̀ kò gbọdọ di alaimọ́ nitori okú.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Speak unto the priests the sons of Aaron, and say unto them, There shall none be defiled for the dead among his people:

entries.yo: Bikoṣe fun ibatan rẹ̀ ti o sunmọ ọ, eyinì ni, iya rẹ̀, ati baba rẹ̀, ati ọmọ rẹ̀ ọkunrin, ati ọmọ rẹ̀ obinrin, ati arakunrin rẹ̀;
entries.en: But for his kin, that is near unto him, that is, for his mother, and for his father, and for his son, and for his daughter, and for his brother,

entries.yo: Ati arabinrin rẹ̀ ti iṣe wundia, ti o wà lọdọ rẹ̀, ti kò ti ilí ọkọ, nitori rẹ̀ ni ki o di alaimọ́.
entries.en: And for his sister a virgin, that is nigh unto him, which hath had no husband; for her may he be defiled.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn on kò gbọdọ ṣe ara rẹ̀ li aimọ́, lati bà ara rẹ̀ jẹ́, olori kan sa ni ninu awọn enia rẹ̀.
entries.en: But he shall not defile himself, being a chief man among his people, to profane himself.

entries.yo: Nwọn kò gbọdọ dá ori wọn fá, bẹ̃ni nwọn kò gbọdọ tọ́ irungbọn wọn, tabi singbẹrẹ kan si ara wọn.
entries.en: They shall not make baldness upon their head, neither shall they shave off the corner of their beard, nor make any cuttings in their flesh.

entries.yo: Ki nwọn ki o si jasi mimọ́ fun Ọlọrun wọn, ki nwọn ki o má si ṣe bà orukọ Ọlọrun wọn jẹ́: nitoripe ẹbọ OLUWA ti a fi ina ṣe, ati àkara Ọlọrun wọn, ni nwọn fi nrubọ: nitorina ni ki nwọn ki o jẹ́ mimọ́.
entries.en: They shall be holy unto their God, and not profane the name of their God: for the offerings of the LORD made by fire, and the bread of their God, they do offer: therefore they shall be holy.

entries.yo: Nwọn kò gbọdọ fẹ́ aya ti iṣe àgbere, tabi ẹni ibàjẹ́; bẹ̃ni nwọn kò gbọdọ fẹ́ obinrin ti a ti ọdọ ọkọ rẹ̀ kọ̀silẹ: nitoripe mimọ́ li on fun Ọlọrun rẹ̀.
entries.en: They shall not take a wife that is a whore, or profane; neither shall they take a woman put away from her husband: for he is holy unto his God.

entries.yo: Nitorina ki ẹnyin ki o yà a simimọ́; nitoriti o nrubọ àkara Ọlọrun rẹ: yio jẹ́ mimọ́ si ọ: nitoripe mimọ́ li Emi OLUWA, ti o yà nyin simimọ́.
entries.en: Thou shalt sanctify him therefore; for he offereth the bread of thy God: he shall be holy unto thee: for I the LORD, which sanctify you, am holy.

entries.yo: Ati bi ọmọbinrin alufa kan, ba fi iṣẹ àgbere bà ara rẹ̀ jẹ́, o bà baba rẹ̀ jẹ́: iná li a o da sun u.
entries.en: And the daughter of any priest, if she profane herself by playing the whore, she profaneth her father: she shall be burnt with fire.

entries.yo: Ati olori alufa ninu awọn arakunrin rẹ̀, ori ẹniti a dà oróro itasori si, ti a si yàsọtọ lati ma wọ̀ aṣọ wọnni, ki o máṣe ṣi ibori rẹ̀, tabi ki o fà aṣọ rẹ̀ ya;
entries.en: And he that is the high priest among his brethren, upon whose head the anointing oil was poured, and that is consecrated to put on the garments, shall not uncover his head, nor rend his clothes;

entries.yo: Ki o má si ṣe wọle tọ̀ okú kan lọ, bẹ̃ni ki o máṣe sọ ara rẹ̀ di alaimọ́ nitori baba rẹ̀, tabi nitori iya rẹ̀;
entries.en: Neither shall he go in to any dead body, nor defile himself for his father, or for his mother;

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni ki o máṣe jade kuro ninu ibi mimọ́, bẹ̃ni ki o máṣe bà ibi mimọ́ Ọlọrun rẹ̀ jẹ́, nitoripe adé oróro itasori Ọlọrun rẹ̀ mbẹ lori rẹ̀: Emi li OLUWA.
entries.en: Neither shall he go out of the sanctuary, nor profane the sanctuary of his God; for the crown of the anointing oil of his God is upon him: I am the LORD.

entries.yo: Wundia ni ki o fẹ́ li aya fun ara rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he shall take a wife in her virginity.

entries.yo: Opó, tabi obinrin ikọsilẹ, tabi ẹni-ibàjẹ́, tabi panṣaga, wọnyi ni on kò gbọdọ fẹ́: bikoṣe wundia ni ki o fẹ́ li aya lati inu awọn enia rẹ̀.
entries.en: A widow, or a divorced woman, or profane, or an harlot, these shall he not take: but he shall take a virgin of his own people to wife.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni ki o máṣe bà irú-ọmọ rẹ̀ jẹ́ ninu awọn enia rẹ̀: nitoripe Emi li OLUWA ti o yà a simimọ́.
entries.en: Neither shall he profane his seed among his people: for I the LORD do sanctify him.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Sọ fun Aaroni pe, Ẹnikẹni ninu irú-ọmọ rẹ ni iran-iran wọn, ti o ní àbuku kan, ki o máṣe sunmọtosi lati rubọ àkara Ọlọrun rẹ̀.
entries.en: Speak unto Aaron, saying, Whosoever he be of thy seed in their generations that hath any blemish, let him not approach to offer the bread of his God.

entries.yo: Nitoripe gbogbo ọkunrin ti o ní àbuku, ki o máṣe sunmọtosi: ọkunrin afọju, tabi amukun, tabi arẹ́mu, tabi ohun kan ti o leke,
entries.en: For whatsoever man he be that hath a blemish, he shall not approach: a blind man, or a lame, or he that hath a flat nose, or any thing superfluous,

entries.yo: Tabi ọkunrin ti iṣe aṣẹ́sẹ̀, tabi aṣẹ́wọ,
entries.en: Or a man that is brokenfooted, or brokenhanded,

entries.yo: Tabi abuké, tabi arará, tabi ẹniti o ní àbuku kan li oju rẹ̀, tabi ti o ní ekuru, tabi ipẹ́, tabi ti kóro rẹ̀ fọ́;
entries.en: Or crookbackt, or a dwarf, or that hath a blemish in his eye, or be scurvy, or scabbed, or hath his stones broken;

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni ti o ní àbuku ninu irúọmọ Aaroni alufa kò gbọdọ sunmọtosi lati ru ẹbọ OLUWA ti a fi iná ṣe: on li àbuku; kò gbọdọ sunmọtosi lati rubọ àkara Ọlọrun rẹ̀.
entries.en: No man that hath a blemish of the seed of Aaron the priest shall come nigh to offer the offerings of the LORD made by fire: he hath a blemish; he shall not come nigh to offer the bread of his God.

entries.yo: On o ma jẹ àkara Ọlọrun rẹ̀, ti mimọ́ julọ ati ti mimọ́.
entries.en: He shall eat the bread of his God, both of the most holy, and of the holy.

entries.yo: Kìki on ki yio wọ̀ inu aṣọ-ikele nì lọ, bẹ̃ni ki o máṣe sunmọ pẹpẹ, nitoriti on ní àbuku; ki on ki o máṣe bà ibi mimọ́ mi jẹ́: nitori Emi li OLUWA ti o yà wọn simimọ́.
entries.en: Only he shall not go in unto the vail, nor come nigh unto the altar, because he hath a blemish; that he profane not my sanctuaries: for I the LORD do sanctify them.

entries.yo: Mose si wi fun Aaroni, ati fun awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, ati fun gbogbo awọn ọmọ Israeli.
entries.en: And Moses told it unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Israel.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Sọ fun Aaroni ati fun awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ pe, ki nwọn ki o yà ara wọn sọ̀tọ kuro ninu ohun mimọ́ awọn ọmọ Israeli, ki nwọn ki o má si ṣe bà orukọ mimọ́ mi jẹ́ ninu ohun wọnni, ti nwọn yàsimimọ́ fun mi: Emi li OLUWA,
entries.en: Speak unto Aaron and to his sons, that they separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel, and that they profane not my holy name in those things which they hallow unto me: I am the LORD.

entries.yo: Wi fun wọn pe, Ẹnikẹni ninu gbogbo irú-ọmọ nyin ninu awọn iran nyin, ti o ba sunmọ ohun mimọ́, ti awọn ọmọ Israeli yàsimimọ́ fun OLUWA, ti o ní aimọ́ rẹ̀ lara rẹ̀, ọkàn na li a o ke kuro niwaju mi: Emi li OLUWA.
entries.en: Say unto them, Whosoever he be of all your seed among your generations, that goeth unto the holy things, which the children of Israel hallow unto the LORD, having his uncleanness upon him, that soul shall be cut off from my presence: I am the LORD.

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni ninu irú-ọmọ Aaroni ti iṣe adẹtẹ, tabi ti o ní isun; ki o máṣe jẹ ninu ohun mimọ́, titi on o fi di mimọ́. Ati ẹnikẹni ti o farakàn ohun ti iṣe aimọ́, bi okú, tabi ọkunrin ti ohun-irú nti ara rẹ̀ jade;
entries.en: What man soever of the seed of Aaron is a leper, or hath a running issue; he shall not eat of the holy things, until he be clean. And whoso toucheth any thing that is unclean by the dead, or a man whose seed goeth from him;

entries.yo: Tabi ẹniti o ba farakàn ohun ti nrakò kan, ti yio sọ ọ di aimọ́, tabi enia kan ti yio sọ ọ di aimọ́, irú aimọ́ ti o wù ki o ní;
entries.en: Or whosoever toucheth any creeping thing, whereby he may be made unclean, or a man of whom he may take uncleanness, whatsoever uncleanness he hath;

entries.yo: Ọkàn ti o ba farakàn ọkan ninu irú ohun bẹ̃ ki o jẹ́ alaimọ́ titi di aṣalẹ, ki o má si ṣe jẹ ninu ohun mimọ́, bikoṣepe o ba fi omi wẹ̀ ara rẹ̀.
entries.en: The soul which hath touched any such shall be unclean until even, and shall not eat of the holy things, unless he wash his flesh with water.

entries.yo: Nigbati õrùn ba si wọ̀, on o di mimọ́; lẹhin eyinì ki o si ma jẹ ninu ohun mimọ́, nitoripe onjẹ rẹ̀ ni.
entries.en: And when the sun is down, he shall be clean, and shall afterward eat of the holy things; because it is his food.

entries.yo: On kò gbọdọ jẹ ẹran ti o kú fun ara rẹ̀, tabi eyiti ẹranko fàya, lati fi i bà ara rẹ̀ jẹ́: Emi li OLUWA.
entries.en: That which dieth of itself, or is torn with beasts, he shall not eat to defile himself therewith: I am the LORD.

entries.yo: Nitorina ki nwọn ki o ma pa ìlana mi mọ́, ki nwọn ki o máṣe rù ẹ̀ṣẹ nitori rẹ̀, nwọn a si kú nitorina, bi nwọn ba bà a jẹ́: Emi li OLUWA ti o yà wọn simimọ́.
entries.en: They shall therefore keep mine ordinance, lest they bear sin for it, and die therefore, if they profane it: I the LORD do sanctify them.

entries.yo: Alejò kan kò gbọdọ jẹ ninu ohun mimọ́: alabagbé alufa, tabi alagbaṣe kò gbọdọ jẹ ninu ohun mimọ́ na.
entries.en: There shall no stranger eat of the holy thing: a sojourner of the priest, or an hired servant, shall not eat of the holy thing.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi alufa ba fi owo rẹ̀ rà ẹnikan, ki o jẹ ninu rẹ̀; ẹniti a si bi ninu ile rẹ̀, ki nwọn ki o ma jẹ ninu onjẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: But if the priest buy any soul with his money, he shall eat of it, and he that is born in his house: they shall eat of his meat.

entries.yo: Bi ọmọbinrin alufa na ba si ní alejò kan li ọkọ, obinrin na kò le jẹ ninu ẹbọ fifì ohun mimọ́.
entries.en: If the priest's daughter also be married unto a stranger, she may not eat of an offering of the holy things.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi ọmọbinrin alufa na ba di opó, tabi ẹni-ikọsilẹ, ti kò si lí ọmọ, ti o si pada wá si ile baba rẹ̀, bi ìgba ewe rẹ̀, ki o ma jẹ ninu onjẹ baba rẹ̀: ṣugbọn alejò kan kò gbọdọ jẹ ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: But if the priest's daughter be a widow, or divorced, and have no child, and is returned unto her father's house, as in her youth, she shall eat of her father's meat: but there shall no stranger eat thereof.

entries.yo: Bi ẹnikan ba si jẹ ninu ohun mimọ́ li aimọ̀, njẹ ki o fi idamarun rẹ̀ lé e, ki o si fi i fun alufa pẹlu ohun mimọ́ na.
entries.en: And if a man eat of the holy thing unwittingly, then he shall put the fifth part thereof unto it, and shall give it unto the priest with the holy thing.

entries.yo: Nwọn kò si gbọdọ bà ohun mimọ́ awọn ọmọ Israeli jẹ́, ti nwọn mú fun OLUWA wá:
entries.en: And they shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, which they offer unto the LORD;

entries.yo: Tabi lati jẹ ki nwọn ki o rù aiṣedede ti o mú ẹbi wá, nigbati nwọn ba njẹ ohun mimọ́ wọn: nitoripe Emi li OLUWA ti o yà wọn simimọ́.
entries.en: Or suffer them to bear the iniquity of trespass, when they eat their holy things: for I the LORD do sanctify them.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Sọ fun Aaroni, ati fun awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, ati fun gbogbo awọn ọmọ Israeli, ki o si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹnikẹni ninu ile Israeli, tabi ninu awọn alejò ni Israeli, ti o ba fẹ́ ru ọrẹ-ẹbọ rẹ̀ nitori ẹjẹ́ wọn gbogbo, ati nitori ẹbọ rẹ̀ atinuwá gbogbo, ti nwọn nfẹ́ ru si OLUWA fun ẹbọ sisun;
entries.en: Speak unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Israel, and say unto them, Whatsoever he be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers in Israel, that will offer his oblation for all his vows, and for all his freewill offerings, which they will offer unto the LORD for a burnt offering;

entries.yo: Ki o le dà fun nyin, akọ alailabùkun ni ki ẹnyin ki o fi ru u, ninu malu, tabi ninu agutan, tabi ninu ewurẹ.
entries.en: Ye shall offer at your own will a male without blemish, of the beeves, of the sheep, or of the goats.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ohunkohun ti o ní abùku, li ẹnyin kò gbọdọ múwa: nitoripe ki yio dà fun nyin.
entries.en: But whatsoever hath a blemish, that shall ye not offer: for it shall not be acceptable for you.

entries.yo: Ati ẹnikẹni ti o ba ru ẹbọ alafia si OLUWA, lati san ẹjẹ́, tabi ẹbọ ifẹ́-atinuwá ni malu tabi agutan, ki o pé ki o ba le dà; ki o máṣe sí abùku kan ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And whosoever offereth a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the LORD to accomplish his vow, or a freewill offering in beeves or sheep, it shall be perfect to be accepted; there shall be no blemish therein.

entries.yo: Afọju, tabi fifàya, tabi eyiti a palara, tabi elegbo, elekuru, tabi oni-ipẹ́, wọnyi li ẹnyin kò gbọdọ fi rubọ si OLUWA, bẹ̃ni ẹnyin kò gbọdọ fi ninu wọn ṣe ẹbọ ti a fi iná ṣe si OLUWA lori pẹpẹ.
entries.en: Blind, or broken, or maimed, or having a wen, or scurvy, or scabbed, ye shall not offer these unto the LORD, nor make an offering by fire of them upon the altar unto the LORD.

entries.yo: Ibaṣe akọmalu tabi ọdọ-agutan ti o ní ohun ileke kan, tabi ohun abùku kan, eyinì ni ki iwọ ma fi ru ẹbọ ifẹ́-atinuwá; ṣugbọn fun ẹjẹ́ ki yio dà.
entries.en: Either a bullock or a lamb that hath any thing superfluous or lacking in his parts, that mayest thou offer for a freewill offering; but for a vow it shall not be accepted.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin kò gbọdọ mú eyiti kóro rẹ̀ fọ́, tabi ti a tẹ̀, tabi ti a ya, tabi ti a là, wá rubọ si OLUWA; ki ẹnyin máṣe e ni ilẹ nyin.
entries.en: Ye shall not offer unto the LORD that which is bruised, or crushed, or broken, or cut; neither shall ye make any offering thereof in your land.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni ẹnyin kò gbọdọ ti ọwọ́ alejò rubọ àkara Ọlọrun nyin ninu gbogbo wọnyi; nitoripe ibàjẹ́ wọn mbẹ ninu wọn, abùku si mbẹ ninu wọn: nwọn ki yio dà fun nyin.
entries.en: Neither from a stranger's hand shall ye offer the bread of your God of any of these; because their corruption is in them, and blemishes be in them: they shall not be accepted for you.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Nigbati a ba bi akọmalu kan, tabi agutan kan, tabi ewurẹ kan, nigbana ni ki o gbé ijọ meje lọdọ iya rẹ̀; ati lati ijọ́ kẹjọ ati titi lọ on o di itẹwọgbà fun ẹbọ ti a fi iná ṣe si OLUWA.
entries.en: When a bullock, or a sheep, or a goat, is brought forth, then it shall be seven days under the dam; and from the eighth day and thenceforth it shall be accepted for an offering made by fire unto the LORD.

entries.yo: Ibaṣe abomalu tabi agutan, ẹnyin kò gbọdọ pa a ati ọmọ rẹ̀ li ọjọ́ kanna.
entries.en: And whether it be cow or ewe, ye shall not kill it and her young both in one day.

entries.yo: Nigbati ẹnyin ba si ru ẹbọ ọpẹ́ si OLUWA, ẹ ru u ki o le dà.
entries.en: And when ye will offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving unto the LORD, offer it at your own will.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ́ na ni ki a jẹ ẹ; ẹnyin kò gbọdọ ṣẹ́kù silẹ ninu rẹ̀ titi di ijọ́ keji: Emi li OLUWA.
entries.en: On the same day it shall be eaten up; ye shall leave none of it until the morrow: I am the LORD.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni ki ẹnyin ki o ma pa aṣẹ mi mọ́, ki ẹnyin si ma ṣe wọn: Emi li OLUWA.
entries.en: Therefore shall ye keep my commandments, and do them: I am the LORD.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni ẹnyin kò gbọdọ bà orukọ mimọ́ mi jẹ́; bikoṣe ki a yà mi simimọ́ lãrin awọn ọmọ Israeli: Emi li OLUWA ti nyà nyin simimọ́,
entries.en: Neither shall ye profane my holy name; but I will be hallowed among the children of Israel: I am the LORD which hallow you,

entries.yo: Ti o mú nyin jade lati ilẹ Egipti wá, lati ma ṣe Ọlọrun nyin: Emi li OLUWA.
entries.en: That brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am the LORD.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Sọ fun awọn ọmọ Israeli, ki o si wi fun wọn pe, ajọ OLUWA, ti ẹnyin o pè fun apejọ mimọ́, wọnyi li ajọ mi.
entries.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, Concerning the feasts of the LORD, which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations, even these are my feasts.

entries.yo: Ijọ́ mẹfa ni ki a ṣe iṣẹ: ṣugbọn ni ijọ́ keje li ọjọ́ isimi, apejọ mimọ́; ẹnyin kò gbọdọ ṣe iṣẹ kan ninu rẹ̀: nitoripe ọjọ́-isimi OLUWA ni ninu ibujoko nyin gbogbo.
entries.en: Six days shall work be done: but the seventh day is the sabbath of rest, an holy convocation; ye shall do no work therein: it is the sabbath of the LORD in all your dwellings.

entries.yo: Wọnyi li ajọ OLUWA, ani apejọ mimọ́, ti ẹnyin o pè li akokò wọn.
entries.en: These are the feasts of the LORD, even holy convocations, which ye shall proclaim in their seasons.

entries.yo: Ni ijọ́ kẹrinla oṣù kini, li aṣalẹ, li ajọ irekọja OLUWA.
entries.en: In the fourteenth day of the first month at even is the LORD's passover.

entries.yo: Ati li ọjọ́ kẹdogun oṣù na li ajọ àkara alaiwu si OLUWA: ijọ́ meje li ẹnyin o jẹ àkara alaiwu.
entries.en: And on the fifteenth day of the same month is the feast of unleavened bread unto the LORD: seven days ye must eat unleavened bread.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ́ kini ki ẹnyin ki o ní apejọ mimọ́: ẹnyin kò gbọdọ ṣe iṣẹ agbara ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: In the first day ye shall have an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work therein.

entries.yo: Bikoṣe ki ẹnyin ki o ru ẹbọ ti a fi iná ṣe si OLUWA ni ijọ́ meje: ni ijọ́ keje ni apejọ mimọ́: ẹnyin kò gbọdọ ṣe iṣẹ agbara.
entries.en: But ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD seven days: in the seventh day is an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work therein.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Sọ fun awọn ọmọ Israeli, ki o si wi fun wọn pe, Nigbati ẹnyin ba dé ilẹ ti mo fi fun nyin, ti ẹnyin o si ma ṣe ikore rẹ̀, nigbana ni ki ẹnyin ki o mú ìdi-ọkà kan akọ́so ikore nyin tọ̀ alufa wá:
entries.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come into the land which I give unto you, and shall reap the harvest thereof, then ye shall bring a sheaf of the firstfruits of your harvest unto the priest:

entries.yo: On o si fì ìdi-ọkà na niwaju OLUWA, lati ṣe itẹwọgbà fun nyin: ni ijọ́ keji lẹhin ọjọ́-isimi ni ki alufa ki o fì i.
entries.en: And he shall wave the sheaf before the LORD, to be accepted for you: on the morrow after the sabbath the priest shall wave it.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ́ ti ẹnyin fì ìdi-ọkà ni ki ẹnyin ki o rubọ akọ ọdọ-agutan ọlọdún kan alailabùku fun ẹbọ sisun si OLUWA.
entries.en: And ye shall offer that day when ye wave the sheaf an he lamb without blemish of the first year for a burnt offering unto the LORD.

entries.yo: Ati ẹbọ ohunjijẹ rẹ̀ ki o jẹ́ meji idamẹwa òṣuwọn iyẹfun daradara, ti a fi oróro pò, ẹbọ ti a fi iná ṣe ni si OLUWA fun õrun didùn: ati ẹbọ ohun-mimu rẹ̀ ni ki o ṣe ọtí-waini idamẹrin òṣuwọn hini.
entries.en: And the meat offering thereof shall be two tenth deals of fine flour mingled with oil, an offering made by fire unto the LORD for a sweet savour: and the drink offering thereof shall be of wine, the fourth part of an hin.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin kò si gbọdọ jẹ àkara, tabi ọkà yiyan, tabi ọkà tutù ninu ipẹ́, titi yio fi di ọjọ́ na gan ti ẹnyin mú ọrẹ-ẹbọ tọ̀ Ọlọrun nyin wá: ki o si jasi ìlana titilai ni iran-iran nyin ni ibujoko nyin gbogbo.
entries.en: And ye shall eat neither bread, nor parched corn, nor green ears, until the selfsame day that ye have brought an offering unto your God: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

entries.yo: Lati ijọ́ keji lẹhin ọjọ́-isimi, ni ọjọ́ ti ẹnyin mú ìdi-ọkà ẹbọ fifì nì wá, ki ẹnyin ki o si kà ọjọ́-isimi meje pé;
entries.en: And ye shall count unto you from the morrow after the sabbath, from the day that ye brought the sheaf of the wave offering; seven sabbaths shall be complete:

entries.yo: Ani di ijọ́ keji lẹhin ọjọ́-isimi keje, ki ẹnyin ki o kà ãdọta ọjọ́; ki ẹnyin ki o si ru ẹbọ ohunjijẹ titun si OLUWA.
entries.en: Even unto the morrow after the seventh sabbath shall ye number fifty days; and ye shall offer a new meat offering unto the LORD.

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o si mú lati inu ibugbé nyin wá, ìṣu-àkara fifì meji ti idamẹwa meji òṣuwọn: ki nwọn ki o jẹ́ ti iyẹfun daradara, ki a fi iwukàra yan wọn, akọ́so ni nwọn fun OLUWA.
entries.en: Ye shall bring out of your habitations two wave loaves of two tenth deals: they shall be of fine flour; they shall be baken with leaven; they are the firstfruits unto the LORD.

entries.yo: Pẹlu àkara na ki ẹnyin ki o si fi ọdọ-agutan meje ọlọdún kan alailabukù rubọ, ati ẹgbọrọ akọmalu kan, ati àgbo meji: ki nwọn ki o jẹ́ ẹbọ sisun si OLUWA, pẹlu ẹbọ ohunjijẹ wọn, ati ẹbọ ohunmimu wọn, ani ẹbọ ti a fi iná ṣe olõrùn didùn ni si OLUWA.
entries.en: And ye shall offer with the bread seven lambs without blemish of the first year, and one young bullock, and two rams: they shall be for a burnt offering unto the LORD, with their meat offering, and their drink offerings, even an offering made by fire, of sweet savour unto the LORD.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ki ẹnyin ki o fi obukọ kan ru ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ, ati akọ ọdọ-agutan meji ọlọdún kan ru ẹbọ alafia.
entries.en: Then ye shall sacrifice one kid of the goats for a sin offering, and two lambs of the first year for a sacrifice of peace offerings.

entries.yo: Ki alufa ki o si fi wọn pẹlu àkara àwọn akọ́so fun ẹbọ fifì niwaju OLUWA, pẹlu ọdọ-agutan meji nì: ki nwọn ki o si jẹ́ mimọ́ si OLUWA fun alufa na.
entries.en: And the priest shall wave them with the bread of the firstfruits for a wave offering before the LORD, with the two lambs: they shall be holy to the LORD for the priest.

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o si kede li ọjọ́ na gan; ki o le jẹ́ apejọ mimọ́ fun nyin: ẹnyin kò gbọdọ ṣe iṣẹ agbara kan: yio si ma ṣe ìlana fun nyin titilai ni ibujoko nyin gbogbo ni iran-iran nyin.
entries.en: And ye shall proclaim on the selfsame day, that it may be an holy convocation unto you: ye shall do no servile work therein: it shall be a statute for ever in all your dwellings throughout your generations.

entries.yo: Nigbati ẹnyin ba nṣe ikore ilẹ nyin, iwọ kò gbọdọ ṣa ẹba oko rẹ li aṣatán, bẹ̃ni iwọ kò gbọdọ pèṣẹ́ ikore rẹ̀: ki iwọ ki o fi i silẹ fun awọn talaka, ati fun alejò: Emi li OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin.
entries.en: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not make clean riddance of the corners of thy field when thou reapest, neither shalt thou gather any gleaning of thy harvest: thou shalt leave them unto the poor, and to the stranger: I am the LORD your God.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Sọ fun awọn ọmọ Israeli pe, Li oṣù keje, li ọjọ́ kini oṣù ni ki ẹnyin ki o ní isimi; iranti ifunpe, apejọ mimọ́.
entries.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, In the seventh month, in the first day of the month, shall ye have a sabbath, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, an holy convocation.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin kò gbọdọ ṣe iṣẹ agbara kan: bikoṣepe ki ẹnyin ki o ru ẹbọ ti a fi iná ṣe si OLUWA.
entries.en: Ye shall do no servile work therein: but ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Ijọ́ kẹwa oṣù keje yi ni ki o ṣe ọjọ́ ètutu: ki apejọ mimọ́ wà fun nyin, ki ẹnyin ki o si pọ́n ọkàn nyin loju, ki ẹ si ru ẹbọ ti a fi iná ṣe si OLUWA.
entries.en: Also on the tenth day of this seventh month there shall be a day of atonement: it shall be an holy convocation unto you; and ye shall afflict your souls, and offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin kò si gbọdọ ṣe iṣẹ kan li ọjọ́ na yi: nitoripe ọjọ́ ètutu ni, lati ṣètutu fun nyin niwaju OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin.
entries.en: And ye shall do no work in that same day: for it is a day of atonement, to make an atonement for you before the LORD your God.

entries.yo: Nitoripe ọkànkọkàn ti kò ba pọ́n ara rẹ̀ loju li ọjọ́ na yi, on li a o ke kuro ninu awọn enia rẹ̀.
entries.en: For whatsoever soul it be that shall not be afflicted in that same day, he shall be cut off from among his people.

entries.yo: Ati ọkànkọkan ti o ba ṣe iṣẹ kan li ọjọ́ na yi, ọkàn na li emi o run kuro lãrin awọn enia rẹ̀.
entries.en: And whatsoever soul it be that doeth any work in that same day, the same soul will I destroy from among his people.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin kò gbọdọ ṣe iṣẹkiṣẹ kan: ki o jẹ́ ìlana titilai ni iran-iran nyin ni ibujoko nyin gbogbo.
entries.en: Ye shall do no manner of work: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

entries.yo: Ọjọ́-isimi ni fun nyin, ki ẹnyin ki o si pọn ọkàn nyin loju: lo ọjọ́ kẹsan oṣù na li alẹ, lati alẹ dé alẹ, ni ki ẹnyin ki o ma pa ọjọ́-isimi nyin mọ́.
entries.en: It shall be unto you a sabbath of rest, and ye shall afflict your souls: in the ninth day of the month at even, from even unto even, shall ye celebrate your sabbath.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Sọ fun awọn ọmọ Israeli pe, Ọjọ́ kẹdogun oṣù keje yi li ajọ agọ́ ni ijọ́ meje si OLUWA.
entries.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, The fifteenth day of this seventh month shall be the feast of tabernacles for seven days unto the LORD.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ́ kini li apejọ mimọ́: ẹnyin kò gbọdọ ṣe iṣẹ agbara kan.
entries.en: On the first day shall be an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work therein.

entries.yo: Ijọ meje ni ki ẹnyin fi ru ẹbọ ti a fi iná ṣe si OLUWA: ni ijọ́ kẹjọ li apejọ́ mimọ́ fun nyin; ki ẹnyin ki o si ru ẹbọ ti a fi iná ṣe si OLUWA; ọjọ́ ajọ ni; ẹnyin kò gbọdọ ṣe iṣẹ agbara kan.
