entries.en: Seven days ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD: on the eighth day shall be an holy convocation unto you; and ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD: it is a solemn assembly; and ye shall do no servile work therein.

entries.yo: Wọnyi li ajọ OLUWA, ti ẹnyin o kedé lati jẹ́ apejọ mimọ́, lati ru ẹbọ ti a fi iná ṣe si OLUWA, ẹbọ sisun, ati ẹbọ ohunjijẹ, ẹbọ, ati ẹbọ ohunmimu, olukuluku wọn li ọjọ́ rẹ̀:
entries.en: These are the feasts of the LORD, which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations, to offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD, a burnt offering, and a meat offering, a sacrifice, and drink offerings, every thing upon his day:

entries.yo: Pẹlu ọjọ́-isimi OLUWA, ati pẹlu ẹ̀bun nyin, ati pẹlu gbogbo ẹjẹ́ nyin, ati pẹlu gbogbo ẹbọ atinuwá nyin ti ẹnyin fi fun OLUWA.
entries.en: Beside the sabbaths of the LORD, and beside your gifts, and beside all your vows, and beside all your freewill offerings, which ye give unto the LORD.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu li ọjọ́ kẹdogun oṣù keje na, nigbati ẹnyin ba ṣe ikore eso ilẹ tán, ki ẹnyin ki o si ṣe ajọ si OLUWA ni ijọ́ meje: li ọjọ́ kini ki isimi ki o wà, ati li ọjọ́ kẹjọ ki isimi ki o wà,
entries.en: Also in the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when ye have gathered in the fruit of the land, ye shall keep a feast unto the LORD seven days: on the first day shall be a sabbath, and on the eighth day shall be a sabbath.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ́ kini ki ẹnyin ki o si mú eso igi daradara, imọ̀-ọpẹ, ati ẹká igi ti o bò, ati ti igi wilo odò; ki ẹnyin ki o si ma yọ̀ niwaju OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin ni ijọ́ meje.
entries.en: And ye shall take you on the first day the boughs of goodly trees, branches of palm trees, and the boughs of thick trees, and willows of the brook; and ye shall rejoice before the LORD your God seven days.

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o si ma pa a mọ́ li ajọ fun OLUWA ni ijọ́ meje li ọdún: ìlana ni titilai ni iran-iran nyin: ki ẹnyin ki o ma ṣe e li oṣù keje.
entries.en: And ye shall keep it a feast unto the LORD seven days in the year. It shall be a statute for ever in your generations: ye shall celebrate it in the seventh month.

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o ma gbé inu agọ́ ni ijọ́ meje; gbogbo ibilẹ ni Israeli ni ki o gbé inu agọ́:
entries.en: Ye shall dwell in booths seven days; all that are Israelites born shall dwell in booths:

entries.yo: Ki iran-iran nyin ki o le mọ̀ pe, Emi li o mu awọn ọmọ Israeli gbé inu agọ́, nigbati mo mú wọn lati ilẹ Egipti jade wá: Emi li OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin.
entries.en: That your generations may know that I made the children of Israel to dwell in booths, when I brought them out of the land of Egypt: I am the LORD your God.

entries.yo: Mose si sọ gbogbo ajọ OLUWA wọnyi fun awọn ọmọ Israeli.
entries.en: And Moses declared unto the children of Israel the feasts of the LORD.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Fi aṣẹ fun awọn ọmọ Israeli pe, ki nwọn ki o mú oróro daradara ti olifi gigún fun ọ wá, fun imọlẹ lati ma mu fitila jó nigbagbogbo.
entries.en: Command the children of Israel, that they bring unto thee pure oil olive beaten for the light, to cause the lamps to burn continually.

entries.yo: Lẹhin ode aṣọ-ikele ẹrí, ninu agọ́ ajọ, ni ki Aaroni ki o tọju rẹ̀ lati aṣalẹ di owurọ̀ nigbagbogbo niwaju OLUWA: ìlana ni titilai ni iran-iran nyin.
entries.en: Without the vail of the testimony, in the tabernacle of the congregation, shall Aaron order it from the evening unto the morning before the LORD continually: it shall be a statute for ever in your generations.

entries.yo: Ki o si tọju fitila lori ọpá-fitila mimọ́ nì nigbagbogbo niwaju OLUWA.
entries.en: He shall order the lamps upon the pure candlestick before the LORD continually.

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o si mú iyẹfun daradara, ki o si yan ìṣu-àkara mejila ninu rẹ̀: idamẹwa meji òṣuwọn ni ki o wà ninu ìṣu-àkara kan.
entries.en: And thou shalt take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes thereof: two tenth deals shall be in one cake.

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o si tò wọn li ẹsẹ meji, mẹfa li ẹsẹ kan, lori tabili mimọ́ niwaju OLUWA.
entries.en: And thou shalt set them in two rows, six on a row, upon the pure table before the LORD.

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o si fi turari daradara sori ẹsẹ̀ kọkan ki o le wà lori ìṣu-àkara na fun iranti, ani ẹbọ ti a fi iná ṣe si OLUWA.
entries.en: And thou shalt put pure frankincense upon each row, that it may be on the bread for a memorial, even an offering made by fire unto the LORD.

entries.yo: Li ọjọjọ́ isimi ni ki ẹ ma tun u tò niwaju OLUWA titi; gbigbà ni lọwọ awọn ọmọ Israeli nipa majẹmu titi aiye.
entries.en: Every sabbath he shall set it in order before the LORD continually, being taken from the children of Israel by an everlasting covenant.

entries.yo: Ki o si ma jẹ́ ti Aaroni ati ti awọn ọmọ rẹ; ki nwọn ki o si ma jẹ ẹ ni ibi mimọ́ kan: nitoripe mimọ́ julọ ni fun u ninu ẹbọ OLUWA ti a fi iná ṣe, ìlana titilai.
entries.en: And it shall be Aaron's and his sons'; and they shall eat it in the holy place: for it is most holy unto him of the offerings of the LORD made by fire by a perpetual statute.

entries.yo: Ati ọmọkunrin obinrin Israeli kan, ti baba rẹ̀ ṣe ara Egipti, o jade lọ ninu awọn ọmọ Israeli: ọmọkunrin obinrin Israeli yi ati ọkunrin Israeli kan si jà ni ibudó.
entries.en: And the son of an Israelitish woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel: and this son of the Israelitish woman and a man of Israel strove together in the camp;

entries.yo: Eyi ọmọkunrin obinrin Israeli yi, sọ̀rọ buburu si Orukọ nì, o si fi bú: nwọn si mú u tọ̀ Mose wá. Orukọ iya rẹ̀ ama jẹ Ṣelomiti, ọmọbinrin Dibri, ti ẹ̀ya Dani.
entries.en: And the Israelitish woman's son blasphemed the name of the LORD, and cursed. And they brought him unto Moses: (and his mother's name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan:)

entries.yo: Nwọn si ha a mọ́ ile-ìde, titi a o fi fi inu OLUWA hàn fun wọn.
entries.en: And they put him in ward, that the mind of the LORD might be shewed them.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Mú ẹniti o ṣe ifibu nì wá sẹhin ibudó; ki gbogbo awọn ti o si gbọ́ ọ ki o fi ọwọ́ wọn lé ori rẹ̀, ki gbogbo ijọ enia ki o le sọ ọ li okuta.
entries.en: Bring forth him that hath cursed without the camp; and let all that heard him lay their hands upon his head, and let all the congregation stone him.

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o si sọ fun awọn ọmọ Israeli pe, Ẹnikẹni ti o ba fi Ọlọrun rẹ̀ bú yio rù ẹ̀ṣẹ̀ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Whosoever curseth his God shall bear his sin.

entries.yo: Ati ẹniti o sọ̀rọ buburu si orukọ OLUWA nì, pipa ni ki a pa a: gbogbo ijọ enia ni ki o sọ ọ li okuta pa nitõtọ: ati alejò, ati ibilẹ, nigbati o ba sọ̀rọbuburu si orukọ OLUWA, pipa li a o pa a.
entries.en: And he that blasphemeth the name of the LORD, he shall surely be put to death, and all the congregation shall certainly stone him: as well the stranger, as he that is born in the land, when he blasphemeth the name of the LORD, shall be put to death.

entries.yo: Ati ẹniti o ba gbà ẹmi enia, pipa li a o pa a:
entries.en: And he that killeth any man shall surely be put to death.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba si lù ẹran kan pa, ki o san a pada: ẹmi fun ẹmi.
entries.en: And he that killeth a beast shall make it good; beast for beast.

entries.yo: Bi ẹnikan ba si ṣe abùku kan si ara ẹnikeji rẹ̀; bi o ti ṣe, bẹ̃ni ki a ṣe si i;
entries.en: And if a man cause a blemish in his neighbour; as he hath done, so shall it be done to him;

entries.yo: Ẹ̀ya fun ẹ̀ya, oju fun oju, ehin fun ehin; bi on ti ṣe abùku si ara enia, bẹ̃ni ki a ṣe si i.
entries.en: Breach for breach, eye for eye, tooth for tooth: as he hath caused a blemish in a man, so shall it be done to him again.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba si lù ẹran pa, ki o san a pada: ẹniti o ba si lù enia pa, a o pa a.
entries.en: And he that killeth a beast, he shall restore it: and he that killeth a man, he shall be put to death.

entries.yo: Irú ofin kan li ẹnyin o ní, gẹgẹ bi fun alejò bẹ̃ni fun ibilẹ: nitoripe Emi li OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin.
entries.en: Ye shall have one manner of law, as well for the stranger, as for one of your own country: for I am the LORD your God.

entries.yo: Mose si sọ fun awọn ọmọ Israeli, pe ki nwọn ki o mú ẹniti o ṣe ifibu nì jade lọ sẹhin ibudó, ki nwọn ki o si sọ ọ li okuta pa. Awọn ọmọ Israeli si ṣe bi OLUWA ti fi aṣẹ fun Mose.
entries.en: And Moses spake to the children of Israel, that they should bring forth him that had cursed out of the camp, and stone him with stones. And the children of Israel did as the LORD commanded Moses.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose li òke Sinai pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses in mount Sinai, saying,

entries.yo: Sọ fun awọn ọmọ Israeli, ki o si wi fun wọn pe, Nigbati ẹnyin ba dé ilẹ ti mo fi fun nyin, nigbana ni ki ilẹ na ki o pa isimi kan mọ́ fun OLUWA.
entries.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land which I give you, then shall the land keep a sabbath unto the LORD.

entries.yo: Ọdún mẹfa ni iwọ o fi gbìn oko rẹ, ọdún mẹfa ni iwọ o si fi rẹwọ ọgbà-ajara rẹ, ti iwọ o si kó eso rẹ̀ jọ;
entries.en: Six years thou shalt sow thy field, and six years thou shalt prune thy vineyard, and gather in the fruit thereof;

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ọdún keje ki o si jasi ìgba isimi fun ilẹ na, isimi fun OLUWA: iwọ kò gbọdọ gbìn oko rẹ, bẹ̃ni iwọ kò gbọdọ rẹwọ ọgbà-àjara rẹ.
entries.en: But in the seventh year shall be a sabbath of rest unto the land, a sabbath for the LORD: thou shalt neither sow thy field, nor prune thy vineyard.

entries.yo: Eyiti o ba lalẹ̀ hù ninu ikore rẹ iwọ kò gbọdọ ká, bẹ̃ni iwọ kò gbọdọ ká eso àjara rẹ ti iwọ kò rẹ́ lọwọ: nitoripe ọdún isimi ni fun ilẹ na.
entries.en: That which groweth of its own accord of thy harvest thou shalt not reap, neither gather the grapes of thy vine undressed: for it is a year of rest unto the land.

entries.yo: Ọdún isimi ilẹ na yio si ma ṣe ohunjijẹ fun nyin; fun iwọ, ati fun iranṣẹ rẹ ọkunrin, ati fun iranṣẹ rẹ obinrin, ati fun alagbaṣe rẹ, ati fun alejò rẹ ti nṣe atipo lọdọ rẹ;
entries.en: And the sabbath of the land shall be meat for you; for thee, and for thy servant, and for thy maid, and for thy hired servant, and for thy stranger that sojourneth with thee,

entries.yo: Ati fun ohunọ̀sin rẹ, ati fun ẹran ti mbẹ ni ilẹ rẹ, ni ki ibisi rẹ̀ gbogbo ki o ṣe onjẹ fun.
entries.en: And for thy cattle, and for the beast that are in thy land, shall all the increase thereof be meat.

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o si kà ọdún isimi meje fun ara rẹ, ọdún meje ìgba meje; ati akokò ọdún isimi meje ni yio jẹ́ ọdún mọkandilãdọta fun ọ.
entries.en: And thou shalt number seven sabbaths of years unto thee, seven times seven years; and the space of the seven sabbaths of years shall be unto thee forty and nine years.

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o si mu ki ipè ki o dún ni ijọ́ kẹwa oṣù keje, li ọjọ́ ètutu ni ki ẹnyin ki o mu ipè na dún ni gbogbo ilẹ nyin.
entries.en: Then shalt thou cause the trumpet of the jubile to sound on the tenth day of the seventh month, in the day of atonement shall ye make the trumpet sound throughout all your land.

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o si yà arãdọta ọdún simimọ́, ki ẹnyin ki o si kede idasilẹ ni ilẹ na fun gbogbo awọn ti ngbé inu rẹ̀: yio si ma jẹ́ jubeli fun nyin; ki ẹnyin ki o si pada olukuluku si ilẹ-iní rẹ̀, ki olukuluku nyin ki o si pada sinu idile rẹ̀.
entries.en: And ye shall hallow the fiftieth year, and proclaim liberty throughout all the land unto all the inhabitants thereof: it shall be a jubile unto you; and ye shall return every man unto his possession, and ye shall return every man unto his family.

entries.yo: Ọdún jubeli ni ki arãdọta ọdún ki o jasi fun nyin: ẹnyin kò gbọdọ gbìn, bẹ̃li ẹnyin kò gbọdọ ká ilalẹ-hù inu rẹ̀, bẹ̃li ẹnyin kò gbọdọ ká eso àjara rẹ̀ ti a kò rẹ-lọwọ.
entries.en: A jubile shall that fiftieth year be unto you: ye shall not sow, neither reap that which groweth of itself in it, nor gather the grapes in it of thy vine undressed.

entries.yo: Nitoripe jubeli ni; mimọ́ ni ki o jasi fun nyin: ibisi rẹ̀ ni ki ẹnyin o ma jẹ lati inu oko wa.
entries.en: For it is the jubile; it shall be holy unto you: ye shall eat the increase thereof out of the field.

entries.yo: Li ọdún jubeli yi ni ki olukuluku nyin ki o pada lọ si ilẹ-iní rẹ̀.
entries.en: In the year of this jubile ye shall return every man unto his possession.

entries.yo: Bi iwọ ba si tà ọjà fun ẹnikeji rẹ, tabi bi iwọ ba rà lọwọ ẹnikeji rẹ, ẹnyin kò gbọdọ rẹ ara nyin jẹ:
entries.en: And if thou sell ought unto thy neighbour, or buyest ought of thy neighbour's hand, ye shall not oppress one another:

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi iye ọdún lẹhin jubeli ni ki iwọ ki o rà lọwọ ẹnikeji rẹ, ati gẹgẹ bi iye ọdún ikore rẹ̀ ni ki o tà fun ọ.
entries.en: According to the number of years after the jubile thou shalt buy of thy neighbour, and according unto the number of years of the fruits he shall sell unto thee:

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi ọ̀pọ ọdún ni ki iwọ ki o bù owo rẹ̀ sí i, ati gẹgẹ bi ọdún rẹ̀ ti fàsẹhin, ni ki iwọ ki o si bù owo rẹ̀ kù; nitoripe gẹgẹ bi iye ọdún ikore ni ki o tà fun ọ.
entries.en: According to the multitude of years thou shalt increase the price thereof, and according to the fewness of years thou shalt diminish the price of it: for according to the number of the years of the fruits doth he sell unto thee.

entries.yo: Nitorina ẹnyin kò gbọdọ rẹ ara nyin jẹ; bikoṣe pe ki iwọ ki o bẹ̀ru Ọlọrun rẹ: nitoripe Emi li OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin.
entries.en: Ye shall not therefore oppress one another; but thou shalt fear thy God: for I am the LORD your God.

entries.yo: Nitorina ki ẹnyin ki o ma ṣe ìlana mi, ki ẹ si ma pa ofin mi mọ́, ki ẹ si ma ṣe wọn; ẹnyin o si ma gbé ilẹ na li ailewu.
entries.en: Wherefore ye shall do my statutes, and keep my judgments, and do them; and ye shall dwell in the land in safety.

entries.yo: Ilẹ na yio si ma mú ibisi rẹ̀ wá, ẹ o si ma jẹ ajẹyo, ẹ o si ma gbé inu rẹ̀ li ailewu.
entries.en: And the land shall yield her fruit, and he shall eat your fill, and dwell therein in safety.

entries.yo: Bi ẹnyin ba si wipe, Kili awa o ha ma jẹ li ọdún keje? sa wo o, awa kò gbọdọ gbìn, bẹ̃li awa kò gbọdọ kó ire wa:
entries.en: And if ye shall say, What shall we eat the seventh year? behold, we shall not sow, nor gather in our increase:

entries.yo: Nigbana li emi o fi aṣẹ ibukún mi fun nyin li ọdún kẹfa, on o si so eso jade fun nyin fun ọdún mẹta.
entries.en: Then I will command my blessing upon you in the sixth year, and it shall bring forth fruit for three years.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin o si gbìn li ọdún kẹjọ, ẹnyin o si ma jẹ ninu eso lailai titi di ọdún kẹsan, titi eso rẹ̀ yio fi dé ni ẹnyin o ma jẹ ohun isigbẹ.
entries.en: And ye shall sow the eighth year, and eat yet of old fruit until the ninth year; until her fruits come in ye shall eat of the old store.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin kò gbọdọ tà ilẹ lailai; nitoripe ti emi ni ilẹ: nitoripe alejò ati atipo ni nyin lọdọ mi.
entries.en: The land shall not be sold for ever: for the land is mine; for ye are strangers and sojourners with me.

entries.yo: Ati ni gbogbo ilẹ-iní nyin ki ẹnyin ki o si ma ṣe ìrapada fun ilẹ.
entries.en: And in all the land of your possession ye shall grant a redemption for the land.

entries.yo: Bi arakunrin rẹ ba di talakà, ti o ba si tà ninu ilẹ-iní rẹ̀, bi ẹnikan ninu awọn ibatan rẹ̀ ba si wá lati rà a, njẹ ki o rà eyiti arakunrin rẹ̀ ti tà pada.
entries.en: If thy brother be waxen poor, and hath sold away some of his possession, and if any of his kin come to redeem it, then shall he redeem that which his brother sold.

entries.yo: Bi ọkunrin na kò ba ní ẹnikan ti yio rà a pada, ti on tikara rẹ̀ ti di olowo ti o ní to lati rà a pada;
entries.en: And if the man have none to redeem it, and himself be able to redeem it;

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ki o kà ọdún ìta rẹ̀, ki o si mú elé owo rẹ̀ pada fun ẹniti o tà a fun, ki on ki o le pada lọ si ilẹ-iní rẹ̀.
entries.en: Then let him count the years of the sale thereof, and restore the overplus unto the man to whom he sold it; that he may return unto his possession.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi o ba ṣepe on kò le san a pada fun u, njẹ ki ohun ti o tà na ki o gbé ọwọ́ ẹniti o rà a titi di ọdún jubeli: yio si bọ́ ni jubeli, on o si pada lọ si ilẹ-iní rẹ̀.
entries.en: But if he be not able to restore it to him, then that which is sold shall remain in the hand of him that hath bought it until the year of jubile: and in the jubile it shall go out, and he shall return unto his possession.

entries.yo: Bi ọkunrin kan ba si tà ile gbigbé kan ni ilu olodi, njẹ ki o rà a pada ni ìwọn ọdún kan lẹhin ti o tà a; ni ìwọn ọdún kan ni ki o rà a pada.
entries.en: And if a man sell a dwelling house in a walled city, then he may redeem it within a whole year after it is sold; within a full year may he redeem it.

entries.yo: Bi a kò ba si rà a ni ìwọn ọdún kan gbako, njẹ ki ile na ki o di ti ẹniti o rà a titilai ni iran-iran rẹ̀: ki yio bọ́ ni jubeli.
entries.en: And if it be not redeemed within the space of a full year, then the house that is in the walled city shall be established for ever to him that bought it throughout his generations: it shall not go out in the jubile.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ile ileto wọnni ti kò ni odi yi wọn ká awọn li a kà si ibi oko ilu: ìrapada li awọn wọnni, nwọn o si bọ́ ni jubeli.
entries.en: But the houses of the villages which have no wall round about them shall be counted as the fields of the country: they may be redeemed, and they shall go out in the jubile.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn niti ilu awọn ọmọ Lefi, ile ilu iní wọn, ni awọn ọmọ Lefi o ma ràpada nigbakugba.
entries.en: Notwithstanding the cities of the Levites, and the houses of the cities of their possession, may the Levites redeem at any time.

entries.yo: Bi ẹnikan ba si rà lọwọ awọn ọmọ Lefi, njẹ ile ti a tà na, ni ilu iní rẹ̀, ki o bọ́ ni jubeli: nitoripe ile ilu awọn ọmọ Lefi ni ilẹ-iní wọn lãrin awọn ọmọ Israeli.
entries.en: And if a man purchase of the Levites, then the house that was sold, and the city of his possession, shall go out in the year of jubile: for the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession among the children of Israel.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ilẹ ẹba ilu wọn ni nwọn kò gbọdọ tà; nitoripe ilẹ-iní wọn ni titi aiye.
entries.en: But the field of the suburbs of their cities may not be sold; for it is their perpetual possession.

entries.yo: Ati bi arakunrin rẹ ba di talakà, ti ọwọ́ rẹ̀ ba si rẹlẹ lọdọ rẹ; njẹ ki iwọ ki o ràn a lọwọ; ibaṣe alejò, tabi atipo; ki on ki o le wà pẹlu rẹ.
entries.en: And if thy brother be waxen poor, and fallen in decay with thee; then thou shalt relieve him: yea, though he be a stranger, or a sojourner; that he may live with thee.

entries.yo: Iwọ máṣe gbà elé lọwọ rẹ̀, tabi ẹdá; ṣugbọn bẹ̀ru Ọlọrun rẹ; ki arakunrin rẹ ki o le wà pẹlu rẹ.
entries.en: Take thou no usury of him, or increase: but fear thy God; that thy brother may live with thee.

entries.yo: Iwọ kò gbọdọ fi owo rẹ fun u li ẹdá, tabi ki o wín i li onjẹ rẹ fun asanlé.
entries.en: Thou shalt not give him thy money upon usury, nor lend him thy victuals for increase.

entries.yo: Emi li OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin, ti o mú nyin lati ilẹ Egipti jade wá, lati fi ilẹ Kenaani fun nyin, ati lati ma ṣe Ọlọrun nyin.
entries.en: I am the LORD your God, which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan, and to be your God.

entries.yo: Ati bi arakunrin rẹ ti mba ọ gbé ba di talakà, ti o si tà ara rẹ̀ fun ọ; iwọ kò gbọdọ sìn i ni ìsin-ẹrú:
entries.en: And if thy brother that dwelleth by thee be waxen poor, and be sold unto thee; thou shalt not compel him to serve as a bondservant:

entries.yo: Bikoṣe bi alagbaṣe, ati bi atipo, ni ki o ma ba ọ gbé, ki o si ma sìn ọ titi di ọdún jubeli:
entries.en: But as an hired servant, and as a sojourner, he shall be with thee, and shall serve thee unto the year of jubile:

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ki o lọ kuro lọdọ rẹ, ati on ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ pẹlu rẹ̀, ki o si pada lọ si idile rẹ̀, ati si ilẹ-iní awọn baba rẹ̀ ni ki o pada si.
entries.en: And then shall he depart from thee, both he and his children with him, and shall return unto his own family, and unto the possession of his fathers shall he return.

entries.yo: Nitoripe iranṣẹ mi ni nwọn iṣe, ti mo mú lati ilẹ Egipti jade wá: a kò gbọdọ tà wọn bi ẹni tà ẹrú.
entries.en: For they are my servants, which I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: they shall not be sold as bondmen.

entries.yo: Iwọ kò gbọdọ fi irorò sìn i; ṣugbọn ki iwọ ki o bẹ̀ru Ọlọrun rẹ.
entries.en: Thou shalt not rule over him with rigour; but shalt fear thy God.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ẹrú rẹ ọkunrin, ati awọn ẹrú rẹ obinrin, ti iwọ o ní; ki nwọn ki o jẹ́ ati inu awọn orilẹ-ède wá ti o yi nyin ká, ninu wọn ni ki ẹnyin ki o ma rà awọn ẹrú-ọkunrin ati awọn ẹrú-obinrin.
entries.en: Both thy bondmen, and thy bondmaids, which thou shalt have, shall be of the heathen that are round about you; of them shall ye buy bondmen and bondmaids.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu ninu awọn ọmọ alejò ti nṣe atipo pẹlu nyin, ninu wọn ni ki ẹnyin ki o rà, ati ninu awọn idile wọn ti mbẹ pẹlu nyin, ti nwọn bi ni ilẹ nyin: nwọn o si jẹ iní nyin.
entries.en: Moreover of the children of the strangers that do sojourn among you, of them shall ye buy, and of their families that are with you, which they begat in your land: and they shall be your possession.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin o si ma fi wọn jẹ ogún fun awọn ọmọ nyin lẹhin nyin, lati ní wọn ni iní; ẹnyin o si ma sìn wọn lailai: ṣugbọn ninu awọn arakunrin nyin awọn ọmọ Israeli, ẹnikan kò gbọdọ fi irorò sìn ẹnikeji rẹ̀.
entries.en: And ye shall take them as an inheritance for your children after you, to inherit them for a possession; they shall be your bondmen for ever: but over your brethren the children of Israel, ye shall not rule one over another with rigour.

entries.yo: Ati bi alejò tabi atipo kan ba di ọlọrọ̀ lọdọ rẹ, ati arakunrin rẹ kan leti ọdọ rẹ̀ ba di talakà, ti o ba si tà ara rẹ̀ fun alejò tabi atipo na leti ọdọ rẹ, tabi fun ibatan idile alejò na:
entries.en: And if a sojourner or stranger wax rich by thee, and thy brother that dwelleth by him wax poor, and sell himself unto the stranger or sojourner by thee, or to the stock of the stranger's family:

entries.yo: Lẹhin igbati o tà ara rẹ̀ tán, a si tún le rà a pada; ọkan ninu awọn arakunrin rẹ̀ le rà a:
entries.en: After that he is sold he may be redeemed again; one of his brethren may redeem him:

entries.yo: Ibaṣe arakunrin õbi rẹ̀, tabi ọmọ arakunrin õbi rẹ̀, le rà a, tabi ibatan rẹ̀ ninu idile rẹ̀ le rà a; tabi bi o ba di ọlọrọ̀, o le rà ara rẹ̀.
entries.en: Either his uncle, or his uncle's son, may redeem him, or any that is nigh of kin unto him of his family may redeem him; or if he be able, he may redeem himself.

entries.yo: Ki o si ba ẹniti o rà a ṣìro lati ọdún ti o ti tà ara rẹ̀ fun u titi di ọdún jubeli: ki iye owo ìta rẹ̀ ki o si ri gẹgẹ bi iye ọdún, gẹgẹ bi ìgba alagbaṣe ni ki o ri fun u.
entries.en: And he shall reckon with him that bought him from the year that he was sold to him unto the year of jubile: and the price of his sale shall be according unto the number of years, according to the time of an hired servant shall it be with him.

entries.yo: Bi ọdún rẹ̀ ba kù pupọ̀ sibẹ̀, gẹgẹ bi iye wọn ni ki o si san owo ìrasilẹ rẹ̀ pada ninu owo ti a fi rà a.
entries.en: If there be yet many years behind, according unto them he shall give again the price of his redemption out of the money that he was bought for.

entries.yo: Bi o ba si ṣepe kìki ọdún diẹ li o kù titi di ọdún jubeli, njẹ ki o ba a ṣìro, gẹgẹ bi iye ọdún rẹ̀ ni ki o san owo ìrasilẹ rẹ̀ pada.
entries.en: And if there remain but few years unto the year of jubile, then he shall count with him, and according unto his years shall he give him again the price of his redemption.

entries.yo: Bi alagbaṣe ọdọdún ni ki o ma ba a gbé: ki on ki o máṣe fi irorò sìn i li oju rẹ.
entries.en: And as a yearly hired servant shall he be with him: and the other shall not rule with rigour over him in thy sight.

entries.yo: Bi a kò ba si fi wọnyi rà a silẹ, njẹ ki o jade lọ li ọdún jubeli, ati on, ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ pẹlu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And if he be not redeemed in these years, then he shall go out in the year of jubile, both he, and his children with him.

entries.yo: Nitoripe iranṣẹ mi li awọn ọmọ Israeli iṣe; iranṣẹ mi ni nwọn ti mo mú lati ilẹ Egipti jade wá: Emi li OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin.
entries.en: For unto me the children of Israel are servants; they are my servants whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: I am the LORD your God.

entries.yo: ẸNYIN kò gbọdọ yá oriṣa, bẹ̃ni ẹnyin kò gbọdọ gbé ere tabi ọwọ̀n kan dide naró fun ara nyin, bẹ̃li ẹnyin kò gbọdọ gbé ere okuta gbigbẹ kalẹ ni ilẹ nyin, lati tẹriba fun u: nitoripe Emi li OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin.
entries.en: Ye shall make you no idols nor graven image, neither rear you up a standing image, neither shall ye set up any image of stone in your land, to bow down unto it: for I am the LORD your God.

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o pa ọjọ́-isimi mi mọ́, ki ẹ si bọ̀wọ fun ibi mimọ́ mi: Emi li OLUWA.
entries.en: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I am the LORD.

entries.yo: Bi ẹnyin ba nrìn ninu ìlana mi, ti ẹ si npa ofin mi mọ́, ti ẹ si nṣe wọn;
entries.en: If ye walk in my statutes, and keep my commandments, and do them;

entries.yo: Nigbana li emi o fun nyin li òjo li akokò rẹ̀, ilẹ yio si ma mú ibisi rẹ̀ wá, igi oko yio si ma so eso wọn.
entries.en: Then I will give you rain in due season, and the land shall yield her increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.

entries.yo: Ipakà nyin yio si dé ìgba ikore àjara, igba ikore àjara yio si dé ìgba ifunrugbìn: ẹnyin o si ma jẹ onjẹ nyin li ajẹyo, ẹ o si ma gbé ilẹ nyin li ailewu.
entries.en: And your threshing shall reach unto the vintage, and the vintage shall reach unto the sowing time: and ye shall eat your bread to the full, and dwell in your land safely.

entries.yo: Emi o si fi alafia si ilẹ na, ẹnyin o si dubulẹ, kò si sí ẹniti yio dẹruba nyin: emi o si mu ki ẹranko buburu ki o dasẹ kuro ni ilẹ na, bẹ̃ni idà ki yio là ilẹ nyin já.
entries.en: And I will give peace in the land, and ye shall lie down, and none shall make you afraid: and I will rid evil beasts out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin o si lé awọn ọtá nyin, nwọn o si ti ipa idà ṣubu niwaju nyin.
entries.en: And ye shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.

entries.yo: Marun ninu nyin yio si lé ọgọrun, ọgọrun ninu nyin yio si lé ẹgbarun: awọn ọtá nyin yio si ti ipa idà ṣubu niwaju nyin.
entries.en: And five of you shall chase an hundred, and an hundred of you shall put ten thousand to flight: and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.

entries.yo: Nitoriti emi o fi ojurere wò nyin, emi o si mu nyin bisi i, emi o si sọ nyin di pupọ̀, emi o si gbé majẹmu mi kalẹ pẹlu nyin.
entries.en: For I will have respect unto you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you, and establish my covenant with you.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin o si ma jẹ ohun isigbẹ, ẹnyin o si ma kó ohun ẹgbẹ jade nitori ohun titun.
entries.en: And ye shall eat old store, and bring forth the old because of the new.

entries.yo: Emi o si gbé ibugbé mi kalẹ lãrin nyin: ọkàn mi ki yio si korira nyin.
entries.en: And I will set my tabernacle among you: and my soul shall not abhor you.

entries.yo: Emi o si ma rìn lãrin nyin, emi o si ma ṣe Ọlọrun nyin, ẹnyin o si ma ṣe enia mi.
entries.en: And I will walk among you, and will be your God, and ye shall be my people.

entries.yo: Emi li OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin ti o mú nyin lati ilẹ Egipti jade wá, ki ẹnyin ki o máṣe wà li ẹrú wọn; emi si ti dá ìde àjaga nyin, mo si mu nyin rìn lõrogangan.
entries.en: I am the LORD your God, which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, that ye should not be their bondmen; and I have broken the bands of your yoke, and made you go upright.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi ẹnyin kò ba gbọ́ ti emi, ti ẹ kò si ṣe gbogbo ofin wọnyi;
entries.en: But if ye will not hearken unto me, and will not do all these commandments;

entries.yo: Bi ẹnyin ba si gàn ìlana mi, tabi bi ọkàn nyin ba korira idajọ mi, tobẹ̃ ti ẹnyin ki yio fi ṣe gbogbo ofin mi, ṣugbọn ti ẹnyin dà majẹmu mi;
entries.en: And if ye shall despise my statutes, or if your soul abhor my judgments, so that ye will not do all my commandments, but that ye break my covenant:

entries.yo: Emi pẹlu yio si ṣe eyi si nyin; emi o tilẹ rán ẹ̀ru si nyin, àrun-igbẹ ati òjojo gbigbona, ti yio ma jẹ oju run, ti yio si ma mú ibinujẹ ọkàn wá: ẹnyin o si fun irugbìn nyin lasan, nitoripe awọn ọtá nyin ni yio jẹ ẹ.
entries.en: I also will do this unto you; I will even appoint over you terror, consumption, and the burning ague, that shall consume the eyes, and cause sorrow of heart: and ye shall sow your seed in vain, for your enemies shall eat it.

entries.yo: Emi o si kọ oju mi si nyin, a o si pa nyin niwaju awọn ọtá nyin: awọn ti o korira nyin ni yio si ma ṣe olori nyin; ẹnyin o si ma sá nigbati ẹnikan kò lé nyin.
entries.en: And I will set my face against you, and ye shall be slain before your enemies: they that hate you shall reign over you; and ye shall flee when none pursueth you.

entries.yo: Ninu gbogbo eyi, bi ẹnyin kò ba si gbọ́ ti emi, nigbana li emi o jẹ nyin ni ìya ni ìgba meje si i nitori ẹ̀ṣẹ nyin.
entries.en: And if ye will not yet for all this hearken unto me, then I will punish you seven times more for your sins.

entries.yo: Emi o si ṣẹ́ igberaga agbara nyin; emi o si sọ ọrun nyin dabi irin, ati ilẹ nyin dabi idẹ:
entries.en: And I will break the pride of your power; and I will make your heaven as iron, and your earth as brass:

entries.yo: Ẹnyin o si lò agbara nyin lasan: nitoriti ilẹ nyin ki yio mú ibisi rẹ̀ wá, bẹ̃ni igi ilẹ nyin ki yio so eso wọn.
entries.en: And your strength shall be spent in vain: for your land shall not yield her increase, neither shall the trees of the land yield their fruits.

entries.yo: Bi ẹnyin ba si nrìn lodi si mi, ti ẹnyin kò si gbọ́ ti emi; emi o si mú iyọnu ìgba meje wá si i lori nyin gẹgẹ bi ẹ̀ṣẹ nyin.
entries.en: And if ye walk contrary unto me, and will not hearken unto me; I will bring seven times more plagues upon you according to your sins.

entries.yo: Emi o si rán ẹranko wá sinu nyin pẹlu, ti yio ma gbà nyin li ọmọ, ti yio si ma run nyin li ẹran-ọ̀sin, ti yio si mu nyin dinkù; opópo nyin yio si dahoro.
entries.en: I will also send wild beasts among you, which shall rob you of your children, and destroy your cattle, and make you few in number; and your highways shall be desolate.

entries.yo: Bi ẹnyin kò ba gbà ìkilọ mi nipa nkan wọnyi, ṣugbọn ti ẹnyin o ma rìn lodi si mi;
entries.en: And if ye will not be reformed by me by these things, but will walk contrary unto me;

entries.yo: Nigbana li emi pẹlu yio ma rìn lodi si nyin, emi o si jẹ nyin ni ìya si i ni ìgba meje nitori ẹ̀ṣẹ nyin.
entries.en: Then will I also walk contrary unto you, and will punish you yet seven times for your sins.

entries.yo: Emi o si mú idà wá sori nyin, ti yio gbà ẹsan majẹmu mi; a o si kó nyin jọ pọ̀ ninu ilu nyin, emi o rán ajakalẹ-àrun sãrin nyin; a o si fi nyin lé ọtá lọwọ.
entries.en: And I will bring a sword upon you, that shall avenge the quarrel of my covenant: and when ye are gathered together within your cities, I will send the pestilence among you; and ye shall be delivered into the hand of the enemy.

entries.yo: Nigbati mo ba ṣẹ́ ọpá onjẹ nyin, obinrin mẹwa yio yan àkara nyin ninu àro kan, ìwọ̀n ni nwọn o si ma fi fun nyin li àkara nyin: ẹnyin o si ma jẹ, ẹ ki yio si yó.
entries.en: And when I have broken the staff of your bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven, and they shall deliver you your bread again by weight: and ye shall eat, and not be satisfied.

entries.yo: Ninu gbogbo eyi bi ẹnyin kò ba si gbọ́ ti emi, ti ẹ ba si nrìn lodi si mi;
entries.en: And if ye will not for all this hearken unto me, but walk contrary unto me;

entries.yo: Nigbana li emi o ma rìn lodi si nyin pẹlu ni ikannu; emi pẹlu yio si nà nyin ni ìgba meje nitori ẹ̀ṣẹ nyin.
entries.en: Then I will walk contrary unto you also in fury; and I, even I, will chastise you seven times for your sins.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin o si jẹ ẹran-ara awọn ọmọ nyin ọkunrin, ati ẹran-ara awọn ọmọ nyin obinrin li ẹnyin o jẹ.
entries.en: And ye shall eat the flesh of your sons, and the flesh of your daughters shall ye eat.

entries.yo: Emi o si run ibi giga nyin wọnni, emi o si ke ere nyin lulẹ, emi o si wọ́ okú nyin sori okú oriṣa nyin; ọkàn mi yio si korira nyin.
entries.en: And I will destroy your high places, and cut down your images, and cast your carcases upon the carcases of your idols, and my soul shall abhor you.

entries.yo: Emi o si sọ ilu nyin di ahoro, emi o si sọ ibi mimọ́ nyin di ahoro, emi ki yio gbọ́ adùn õrùn didùn nyin mọ́.
entries.en: And I will make your cities waste, and bring your sanctuaries unto desolation, and I will not smell the savour of your sweet odours.

entries.yo: Emi o si sọ ilẹ na di ahoro: ẹnu yio si yà awọn ọtá nyin ti ngbé inu rẹ̀ si i.
entries.en: And I will bring the land into desolation: and your enemies which dwell therein shall be astonished at it.

entries.yo: Emi o si tú nyin ká sinu awọn orilẹ-ède, emi o si yọ idà tì nyin lẹhin: ilẹ nyin yio si di ahoro, ati ilu nyin yio di ahoro.
entries.en: And I will scatter you among the heathen, and will draw out a sword after you: and your land shall be desolate, and your cities waste.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ilẹ na yio ní isimi rẹ̀, ni gbogbo ọjọ́ idahoro rẹ̀, ẹnyin o si wà ni ilẹ awọn ọtá nyin; nigbana ni ilẹ yio simi, ti yio si ní isimi rẹ̀.
entries.en: Then shall the land enjoy her sabbaths, as long as it lieth desolate, and ye be in your enemies' land; even then shall the land rest, and enjoy her sabbaths.

entries.yo: Ni gbogbo ọjọ́ idahoro rẹ̀ ni yio ma simi; nitoripe on kò simi li ọjọ́-isimi nyin, nigbati ẹnyin ngbé inu rẹ̀.
entries.en: As long as it lieth desolate it shall rest; because it did not rest in your sabbaths, when ye dwelt upon it.

entries.yo: Ati lara awọn ti o kù lãye ninu nyin, li emi o rán ijàiya si ọkàn wọn ni ilẹ awọn ọtá wọn: iró mimì ewé yio si ma lé wọn; nwọn o si sá, bi ẹni sá fun idà; nwọn o si ma ṣubu nigbati ẹnikan kò lepa.
entries.en: And upon them that are left alive of you I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies; and the sound of a shaken leaf shall chase them; and they shall flee, as fleeing from a sword; and they shall fall when none pursueth.

entries.yo: Nwọn o si ma ṣubulù ara wọn, bi ẹnipe niwaju idà, nigbati kò sí ẹniti nlepa: ẹnyin ki yio si lí agbara lati duro niwaju awọn ọtá nyin.
entries.en: And they shall fall one upon another, as it were before a sword, when none pursueth: and ye shall have no power to stand before your enemies.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin o si ṣegbé ninu awọn orilẹ-ède, ilẹ awọn ọtá nyin yio si mú nyin jẹ.
entries.en: And ye shall perish among the heathen, and the land of your enemies shall eat you up.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ti o kù ninu nyin yio si joro ninu ẹ̀ṣẹ wọn ni ilẹ awọn ọtá nyin; ati nitori ẹ̀ṣẹ awọn baba wọn pẹlu ni nwọn o ma joro pẹlu wọn.
entries.en: And they that are left of you shall pine away in their iniquity in your enemies' lands; and also in the iniquities of their fathers shall they pine away with them.

entries.yo: Bi nwọn ba si jẹwọ irekọja wọn, ati irekọja awọn baba wọn, pẹlu ọ̀tẹ wọn ti nwọn ti ṣe si mi, ati pẹlu nitoripe nwọn ti rìn lodi si mi;
entries.en: If they shall confess their iniquity, and the iniquity of their fathers, with their trespass which they trespassed against me, and that also they have walked contrary unto me;

entries.yo: Emi pẹlu rìn lodi si wọn, mo si mú wọn wá si ilẹ awọn ọtá wọn: njẹ bi àiya wọn alaikọlà ba rẹ̀silẹ, ti nwọn ba si gbà ibawi ẹ̀ṣẹ wọn;
entries.en: And that I also have walked contrary unto them, and have brought them into the land of their enemies; if then their uncircumcised hearts be humbled, and they then accept of the punishment of their iniquity:

entries.yo: Nigbana li emi o ranti majẹmu mi pẹlu Jakobu; ati majẹmu mi pẹlu Isaaki, ati majẹmu mi pẹlu Abrahamu li emi o ranti; emi o si ranti ilẹ na.
entries.en: Then will I remember my covenant with Jacob, and also my covenant with Isaac, and also my covenant with Abraham will I remember; and I will remember the land.

entries.yo: Nwọn o si fi ilẹ na silẹ, on o si ní isimi rẹ̀, nigbati o ba di ahoro li aisí wọn; nwọn o si gbà ibawi ẹ̀ṣẹ wọn: nitoripe, ani nitoripe nwọn gàn idajọ mi, ati ọkàn wọn korira ìlana mi.
entries.en: The land also shall be left of them, and shall enjoy her sabbaths, while she lieth desolate without them: and they shall accept of the punishment of their iniquity: because, even because they despised my judgments, and because their soul abhorred my statutes.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn sibẹ̀ ninu gbogbo eyina, nigbati nwọn ba wà ni ilẹ awọn ọtá wọn, emi ki yio tà wọn nù, bẹ̃li emi ki yio korira wọn, lati run wọn patapata, ati lati dà majẹmu mi pẹlu wọn: nitoripe Emi li OLUWA Ọlọrun wọn:
entries.en: And yet for all that, when they be in the land of their enemies, I will not cast them away, neither will I abhor them, to destroy them utterly, and to break my covenant with them: for I am the LORD their God.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nitori wọn emi o ranti majẹmu awọn baba nla wọn, ti mo mú lati ilẹ Egipti jade wá li oju awọn orilẹ-ède, ki emi ki o le ma ṣe Ọlọrun wọn: Emi li OLUWA.
entries.en: But I will for their sakes remember the covenant of their ancestors, whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the heathen, that I might be their God: I am the LORD.

entries.yo: Wọnyi ni ìlana ati idajọ, ati ofin ti OLUWA dásilẹ, lãrin on ati awọn ọmọ Israeli li òke Sinai nipa ọwọ́ Mose.
entries.en: These are the statutes and judgments and laws, which the LORD made between him and the children of Israel in mount Sinai by the hand of Moses.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Sọ fun awọn ọmọ Israeli, ki o si wi fun wọn pe, Nigbati enia kan ba jẹ́ ẹjẹ́ pataki kan, ki awọn enia na ki o jẹ́ ti OLUWA gẹgẹ bi idiyelé rẹ.
entries.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When a man shall make a singular vow, the persons shall be for the LORD by thy estimation.

entries.yo: Idiyelé rẹ fun ọkunrin yio si jẹ́ lati ẹni ogún ọdún lọ titi di ọgọta ọdún, idiyelé rẹ yio si jẹ́ ãdọta ṣekeli fadakà, gẹgẹ bi ṣekeli ibi mimọ́.
entries.en: And thy estimation shall be of the male from twenty years old even unto sixty years old, even thy estimation shall be fifty shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary.

entries.yo: Bi on ba si ṣe obinrin, njẹ ki idiyelé rẹ ki o jẹ́ ọgbọ̀n ṣekeli.
entries.en: And if it be a female, then thy estimation shall be thirty shekels.

entries.yo: Bi o ba si ṣepe lati ọmọ ọdún marun lọ, titi di ẹni ogún ọdún, njẹ ki idiyelé rẹ ki o jẹ́ ogún ṣekeli fun ọkunrin, ati fun obinrin ṣekeli mẹwa.
entries.en: And if it be from five years old even unto twenty years old, then thy estimation shall be of the male twenty shekels, and for the female ten shekels.

entries.yo: Bi o ba si ṣepe lati ọmọ oṣù kan lọ titi di ọmọ ọdún marun, njẹ ki idiyelé rẹ fun ọkunrin ki o jẹ́ ṣekeli fadakà marun, ati fun obinrin, idiyelé rẹ yio jẹ ṣekeli fadakà mẹta.
entries.en: And if it be from a month old even unto five years old, then thy estimation shall be of the male five shekels of silver, and for the female thy estimation shall be three shekels of silver.

entries.yo: Bi o ba si ṣe lati ẹni ọgọta ọdún lọ tabi jù bẹ̃ lọ; bi o ba jẹ́ ọkunrin, njẹ ki idiyelé rẹ ki o jẹ́ ṣekeli mẹdogun, ati fun obinrin ṣekeli mẹwa.
entries.en: And if it be from sixty years old and above; if it be a male, then thy estimation shall be fifteen shekels, and for the female ten shekels.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi on ba ṣe talakà jù idiyele lọ, njẹ ki o lọ siwaju alufa, ki alufa ki o diyelé e; gẹgẹ bi agbara ẹniti o jẹ́ ẹjẹ́ na ni ki alufa ki o diyelé e.
entries.en: But if he be poorer than thy estimation, then he shall present himself before the priest, and the priest shall value him; according to his ability that vowed shall the priest value him.

entries.yo: Bi o ba si ṣepe ẹran ni, ninu eyiti enia mú ọrẹ-ẹbọ tọ̀ OLUWA wá, gbogbo eyiti ẹnikẹni ba múwa ninu irú nkan wọnni fun OLUWA ki o jẹ́ mimọ́.
entries.en: And if it be a beast, whereof men bring an offering unto the LORD, all that any man giveth of such unto the LORD shall be holy.

entries.yo: On kò gbọdọ pa a dà, bẹ̃ni kò gbọdọ pàrọ rẹ̀, rere fun buburu, tabi buburu fun rere: bi o ba ṣepe yio pàrọ rẹ̀ rára, ẹran fun ẹran, njẹ on ati ipàrọ rẹ̀ yio si jẹ́ mimọ́.
entries.en: He shall not alter it, nor change it, a good for a bad, or a bad for a good: and if he shall at all change beast for beast, then it and the exchange thereof shall be holy.

entries.yo: Bi o ba si ṣepe ẹran alaimọ́ kan ni, ninu eyiti nwọn kò mú rubọ si OLUWA, njẹ ki o mú ẹran na wá siwaju alufa:
entries.en: And if it be any unclean beast, of which they do not offer a sacrifice unto the LORD, then he shall present the beast before the priest:

entries.yo: Ki alufa ki o si diyelé e, ibaṣe rere tabi buburu: bi iwọ alufa ba ti diyelé e, bẹ̃ni ki o ri.
entries.en: And the priest shall value it, whether it be good or bad: as thou valuest it, who art the priest, so shall it be.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi o ba fẹ́ rà a pada rára, njẹ ki o fi idamarun rẹ̀ kún idiyelé rẹ.
entries.en: But if he will at all redeem it, then he shall add a fifth part thereof unto thy estimation.

entries.yo: Bi enia kan yio ba si yà ile rẹ̀ sọtọ̀ lati jẹ́ mimọ́ fun OLUWA, njẹ ki alufa ki o diyelé e, ibaṣe rere tabi buburu: bi alufa ba ti diyelé e, bẹ̃ni ki o ri.
entries.en: And when a man shall sanctify his house to be holy unto the LORD, then the priest shall estimate it, whether it be good or bad: as the priest shall estimate it, so shall it stand.

entries.yo: Ati bi ẹniti o yà a sọ̀tọ ba nfẹ́ rà ile rẹ̀ pada, njẹ ki o fi idamarun owo idiyelé rẹ̀ kún u, yio si jẹ́ tirẹ̀.
entries.en: And if he that sanctified it will redeem his house, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of thy estimation unto it, and it shall be his.

entries.yo: Bi enia kan ba si nfẹ́ yà ninu oko ti o jogún sọ̀tọ fun OLUWA, njẹ ki idiyelé rẹ ki o jẹ́ bi irugbìn rẹ̀: òṣuwọn homeri irugbìn barle kan ãdọta ṣekeli fadakà.
entries.en: And if a man shall sanctify unto the LORD some part of a field of his possession, then thy estimation shall be according to the seed thereof: an homer of barley seed shall be valued at fifty shekels of silver.

entries.yo: Bi o ba yà oko rẹ̀ sọ̀tọ lati ọdún jubeli wá, gẹgẹ bi idiyelé rẹ bẹ̃ni ki o ri.
entries.en: If he sanctify his field from the year of jubile, according to thy estimation it shall stand.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi o ba yà oko rẹ̀ sọtọ̀ lẹhin ọdún jubeli, njẹ ki alufa ki o ṣìro owo rẹ̀ fun u, gẹgẹ bi ìwọn ọdún ti o kù, titi di ọdún jubeli, a o si din i kù ninu idiyelé rẹ.
entries.en: But if he sanctify his field after the jubile, then the priest shall reckon unto him the money according to the years that remain, even unto the year of the jubile, and it shall be abated from thy estimation.

entries.yo: Ati bi ẹniti o yà oko na sọtọ̀ ba fẹ́ rà a pada, njẹ ki o fi idamarun owo idiyelé rẹ kún u, yio si jẹ́ tirẹ̀.
entries.en: And if he that sanctified the field will in any wise redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of thy estimation unto it, and it shall be assured to him.

entries.yo: Bi on kò ba si fẹ́ rà oko na pada, tabi bi o ba ti tà oko na fun ẹlomiran, ki a máṣe rà a pada mọ́.
entries.en: And if he will not redeem the field, or if he have sold the field to another man, it shall not be redeemed any more.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn oko na, nigbati o ba yọ li ọdún jubeli, ki o jẹ́ mimọ́ fun OLUWA, bi oko ìya-sọtọ; iní rẹ̀ yio jẹ́ ti alufa.
entries.en: But the field, when it goeth out in the jubile, shall be holy unto the LORD, as a field devoted; the possession thereof shall be the priest's.

entries.yo: Ati bi ẹnikan ba yà oko kan sọ̀tọ fun OLUWA ti on ti rà, ti ki iṣe ninu oko ti o jogún;
entries.en: And if a man sanctify unto the LORD a field which he hath bought, which is not of the fields of his possession;

entries.yo: Njẹ ki alufa ki o ṣìro iye idiyelé rẹ̀ fun u, titi di ọdún jubeli: ki on ki o si fi idiyelé rẹ li ọjọ́ na, bi ohun mimọ́ fun OLUWA.
entries.en: Then the priest shall reckon unto him the worth of thy estimation, even unto the year of the jubile: and he shall give thine estimation in that day, as a holy thing unto the LORD.

entries.yo: Li ọdún jubeli ni ki oko na ki o pada sọdọ ẹniti o rà a, ani sọdọ rẹ̀ ti ẹniti ini ilẹ na iṣe.
entries.en: In the year of the jubile the field shall return unto him of whom it was bought, even to him to whom the possession of the land did belong.

entries.yo: Ki gbogbo idiyelé rẹ ki o si jẹ́ gẹgẹ bi ṣekeli ibi mimọ́: ogún gera ni ṣekeli kan.
entries.en: And all thy estimations shall be according to the shekel of the sanctuary: twenty gerahs shall be the shekel.

entries.yo: Kìki akọ́bi ẹran, ti iṣe akọ́bi ti OLUWA, li ẹnikan kò gbọdọ yàsọtọ; ibaṣe akọmalu, tabi agutan: ti OLUWA ni.
entries.en: Only the firstling of the beasts, which should be the LORD's firstling, no man shall sanctify it; whether it be ox, or sheep: it is the LORD's.

entries.yo: Bi o ba ṣe ti ẹran alaimọ́ ni, njẹ ki o gbà a silẹ gẹgẹ bi idiyelé rẹ, ki o si fi idamarun rẹ̀ kún u: tabi bi kò ba si rà a pada, njẹ ki a tà a, gẹgẹ bi idiyelé rẹ.
entries.en: And if it be of an unclean beast, then he shall redeem it according to thine estimation, and shall add a fifth part of it thereto: or if it be not redeemed, then it shall be sold according to thy estimation.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn kò sí ohun ìyasọtọ kan, ti enia ba yàsọtọ fun OLUWA ninu ohun gbogbo ti o ní, ati enia, ati ẹran, ati ilẹ-iní rẹ̀, ti a gbọdọ tà tabi ti a gbọdọ rà pada: ohun gbogbo ti a ba yàsọtọ mimọ́ julọ ni si OLUWA.
entries.en: Notwithstanding no devoted thing, that a man shall devote unto the LORD of all that he hath, both of man and beast, and of the field of his possession, shall be sold or redeemed: every devoted thing is most holy unto the LORD.

entries.yo: Kò sí ẹni ìyasọtọ ti a ba yàsọtọ ninu enia, ti a le gbàsilẹ; pipa ni ki a pa a.
entries.en: None devoted, which shall be devoted of men, shall be redeemed; but shall surely be put to death.

entries.yo: Ati gbogbo idamẹwa ilẹ na ibaṣe ti irugbìn ilẹ na, tabi ti eso igi, ti OLUWA ni: mimọ́ ni fun OLUWA.
entries.en: And all the tithe of the land, whether of the seed of the land, or of the fruit of the tree, is the LORD's: it is holy unto the LORD.

entries.yo: Bi o ba ṣepe enia ba ràpada rára ninu ohun idamẹwa rẹ̀, ki o si fi idamarun kún u.
entries.en: And if a man will at all redeem ought of his tithes, he shall add thereto the fifth part thereof.

entries.yo: Ati gbogbo idamẹwa ọwọ́ ẹran, tabi ti agbo-ẹran, ani ohunkohun ti o ba kọja labẹ ọpá, ki ẹkẹwa ki o jẹ́ mimọ́ fun OLUWA.
entries.en: And concerning the tithe of the herd, or of the flock, even of whatsoever passeth under the rod, the tenth shall be holy unto the LORD.

entries.yo: Ki o máṣe yẹ̀ ẹ wò bi o jẹ́ rere tabi buburu, bẹ̃li on kò gbọdọ pàrọ rẹ̀: bi o ba si ṣepe o pàrọ rẹ̀ rára, njẹ ati on ati ipàrọ rẹ̀ yio jẹ́ mimọ́; a kò gbọdọ rà a pada.
entries.en: He shall not search whether it be good or bad, neither shall he change it: and if he change it at all, then both it and the change thereof shall be holy; it shall not be redeemed.

entries.yo: Wọnyi li ofin, ti OLUWA palaṣẹ fun Mose fun awọn ọmọ Israeli li òke Sinai.
entries.en: These are the commandments, which the LORD commanded Moses for the children of Israel in mount Sinai.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose ni ijù Sinai, ninu agọ́ ajọ, li ọjọ́ kini oṣù keji, li ọdún keji, ti nwọn jade lati ilẹ Egipti wá, wipe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the tabernacle of the congregation, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they were come out of the land of Egypt, saying,

entries.yo: Ẹ kaye gbogbo ijọ awọn ọmọ Israeli, nipa idile wọn, nipa ile baba wọn, gẹgẹ bi iye orukọ, olukuluku ọkunrin, nipa ori wọn;
entries.en: Take ye the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel, after their families, by the house of their fathers, with the number of their names, every male by their polls;

entries.yo: Lati ẹni ogún ọdún lọ ati jù bẹ̃ lọ, gbogbo awọn ti o le jade lọ si ogun ni Israeli, iwọ ati Aaroni ni ki o kaye wọn gẹgẹ bi ogun wọn.
entries.en: From twenty years old and upward, all that are able to go forth to war in Israel: thou and Aaron shall number them by their armies.

entries.yo: Ki ọkunrin kọkan lati inu olukuluku ẹ̀ya ki o si wà pẹlu nyin; ki olukuluku jẹ́ olori ile awọn baba rẹ̀.
entries.en: And with you there shall be a man of every tribe; every one head of the house of his fathers.

entries.yo: Wọnyi si li orukọ awọn ọkunrin na ti yio duro pẹlu nyin: ti Reubeni; Elisuri ọmọ Ṣedeuri.
entries.en: And these are the names of the men that shall stand with you: of the tribe of Reuben; Elizur the son of Shedeur.

entries.yo: Ti Simeoni; Ṣelumieli ọmọ Suriṣaddai.
entries.en: Of Simeon; Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

entries.yo: Ti Juda; Naṣoni ọmọ Amminadabu.
entries.en: Of Judah; Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

entries.yo: Ti Issakari; Netaneli ọmọ Suari.
entries.en: Of Issachar; Nethaneel the son of Zuar.

entries.yo: Ti Sebuluni; Eliabu ọmọ Heloni.
entries.en: Of Zebulun; Eliab the son of Helon.

entries.yo: Ti awọn ọmọ Josefu: ti Efraimu; Elliṣama ọmọ Ammihudu: ti Manasse; Gamalieli ọmọ Pedasuru.
entries.en: Of the children of Joseph: of Ephraim; Elishama the son of Ammihud: of Manasseh; Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

entries.yo: Ti Benjamini; Abidani ọmọ Gideoni.
entries.en: Of Benjamin; Abidan the son of Gideoni.

entries.yo: Ti Dani; Ahieseri ọmọ Ammiṣaddai.
entries.en: Of Dan; Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

entries.yo: Ti Aṣeri; Pagieli ọmọ Okanri.
entries.en: Of Asher; Pagiel the son of Ocran.

entries.yo: Ti Gadi; Eliasafu ọmọ Deueli.
entries.en: Of Gad; Eliasaph the son of Deuel.

entries.yo: Ti Naftali; Ahira ọmọ Enani.
entries.en: Of Naphtali; Ahira the son of Enan.

entries.yo: Wọnyi li awọn ti a yàn ninu ijọ, olori ẹ̀ya awọn baba wọn, awọn olori ẹgbẹgbẹrun ni Israeli.
entries.en: These were the renowned of the congregation, princes of the tribes of their fathers, heads of thousands in Israel.

entries.yo: Ati Mose ati Aaroni mú awọn ọkunrin wọnyi ti a pè li orukọ:
entries.en: And Moses and Aaron took these men which are expressed by their names:

entries.yo: Nwọn si pè gbogbo ijọ enia pọ̀ li ọjọ́ kini oṣù keji, nwọn si pìtan iran wọn gẹgẹ bi idile wọn, nipa ile baba wọn, gẹgẹ bi iye orukọ, lati ẹni ogún ọdún lọ ati jù bẹ̃ lọ, nipa ori wọn.
entries.en: And they assembled all the congregation together on the first day of the second month, and they declared their pedigrees after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, by their polls.

entries.yo: Bi OLUWA ti paṣẹ fun Mose, bẹ̃li o si kaye wọn ni ijù Sinai.
entries.en: As the LORD commanded Moses, so he numbered them in the wilderness of Sinai.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Reubeni, akọ́bi Israeli, iran wọn, nipa idile wọn, nipa ile baba wọn, gẹgẹ bi iye orukọ, nipa ori wọn, gbogbo ọkunrin lati ẹni ogún ọdún lọ ati jù bẹ̃ lọ, gbogbo awọn ti o le jade lọ si ogun;
entries.en: And the children of Reuben, Israel's eldest son, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, by their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

entries.yo: Awọn ti a kà ninu wọn, ninu ẹ̀ya Reubeni, o jẹ́ ẹgba mẹtalelogun o le ẹdẹgbẹta.
entries.en: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Reuben, were forty and six thousand and five hundred.

entries.yo: Ti awọn ọmọ Simeoni, iran wọn, nipa idile wọn, nipa ile baba wọn, awọn ti a kà ninu wọn, gẹgẹ bi iye orukọ, nipa ori wọn, gbogbo ọkunrin lati ẹni ogún ọdún lọ ati jù bẹ̃ lọ, gbogbo awọn ti o le jade lọ si ogun;
entries.en: Of the children of Simeon, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, those that were numbered of them, according to the number of the names, by their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

entries.yo: Awọn ti a kà ninu wọn, ninu ẹ̀ya Simeoni, o jẹ́ ẹgba mọkandilọgbọ̀n o le ẹdegbeje.
entries.en: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Simeon, were fifty and nine thousand and three hundred.

entries.yo: Ti awọn ọmọ Gadi, iran wọn, nipa idile wọn, nipa ile baba wọn, gẹgẹ bi iye orukọ, lati ẹni ogún ọdún lọ ati jù bẹ̃ lọ, gbogbo awọn ti o le jade lọ si ogun;
entries.en: Of the children of Gad, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

entries.yo: Awọn ti a kà ninu wọn, ninu ẹ̀ya Gadi, o jẹ́ ẹgba mejilelogun o le ãdọtalelẹgbẹjọ.
entries.en: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Gad, were forty and five thousand six hundred and fifty.

entries.yo: Ti awọn ọmọ Juda, iran wọn, nipa idile wọn, nipa ile baba wọn, gẹgẹ bi iye orukọ, lati ẹni ogún ọdún lọ ati jù bẹ̃ lọ, gbogbo awọn ti o le jade lọ si ogun;
entries.en: Of the children of Judah, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

entries.yo: Awọn ti a kà ninu wọn, ninu ẹ̀ya Juda, o jẹ́ ẹgbã mẹtadilogoji o le ẹgbẹ̀ta.
entries.en: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Judah, were threescore and fourteen thousand and six hundred.

entries.yo: Ti awọn ọmọ Issakari, iran wọn, nipa idile wọn, nipa ile baba wọn, gẹgẹ bi iye orukọ, lati ẹni ogún ọdún lọ ati jù bẹ̃ lọ, gbogbo awọn ti o le jade lọ si ogun;
entries.en: Of the children of Issachar, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

entries.yo: Awọn ti a kà ninu wọn, ninu ẹ̀ya Issakari, o jẹ́ ẹgbã mẹtadilọgbọ̀n o le irinwo.
entries.en: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Issachar, were fifty and four thousand and four hundred.

entries.yo: Ti awọn ọmọ Sebuluni, iran wọn, nipa idile wọn, nipa ile baba wọn, gẹgẹ bi iye orukọ, lati ẹni ogún ọdún lọ ati jù bẹ̃ lọ, gbogbo awọn ti o le jade lọ si ogun;
entries.en: Of the children of Zebulun, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

entries.yo: Awọn ti a kà ninu wọn, ninu ẹ̀ya Sebuluni, o jẹ́ ẹgbã mejidilọgbọ̀n o le egbeje.
entries.en: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Zebulun, were fifty and seven thousand and four hundred.

entries.yo: Ti awọn ọmọ Josefu, eyinì ni, ti awọn ọmọ Efraimu, iran wọn, nipa idile wọn, nipa ile baba wọn, gẹgẹ bi iye orukọ, lati ẹni ogún ọdún lọ ati jù bẹ̃ lọ, gbogbo awọn ti o le jade lọ si ogun;
entries.en: Of the children of Joseph, namely, of the children of Ephraim, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

entries.yo: Awọn ti a kà ninu wọn, ninu ẹ̀ya Efraimu, o jẹ́ ọkẹ meji o le ẹdẹgbẹta.
entries.en: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Ephraim, were forty thousand and five hundred.

entries.yo: Ti awọn ọmọ Manasse, iran wọn, nipa idile wọn, nipa ile baba wọn, gẹgẹ bi iye orukọ, lati ẹni ogún ọdún lọ ati jù bẹ̃ lọ, gbogbo awọn ti o le jade lọ si ogun;
entries.en: Of the children of Manasseh, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

entries.yo: Awọn ti a kà ninu wọn, ninu ẹ̀ya Manasse, o jẹ́ ẹgba mẹrindilogun o le igba.
entries.en: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Manasseh, were thirty and two thousand and two hundred.

entries.yo: Ti awọn ọmọ Benjamini, iran wọn, nipa idile wọn, nipa ile baba wọn, gẹgẹ bi iye orukọ, lati ẹni ogún ọdún lọ ati jù bẹ̃ lọ, gbogbo awọn ti o le jade lọ si ogun;
entries.en: Of the children of Benjamin, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

entries.yo: Awọn ti a kà ninu wọn, ninu ẹ̀ya Benjamini, o jẹ́ ẹgba mẹtadilogun o le egbeje.
entries.en: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Benjamin, were thirty and five thousand and four hundred.

entries.yo: Ti awọn ọmọ Dani, iran wọn, nipa idile wọn, nipa ile baba wọn, gẹgẹ bi iye orukọ, lati ẹni ogún ọdún lọ ati jù bẹ̃ lọ, gbogbo awọn ti o le jade lọ si ogun;
entries.en: Of the children of Dan, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

entries.yo: Awọn ti a kà ninu wọn, ninu ẹ̀ya Dani, o jẹ́ ẹgbã mọkanlelọgbọ̀n o le ẹdẹgbẹrin.
entries.en: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Dan, were threescore and two thousand and seven hundred.

entries.yo: Ti awọn ọmọ Aṣeri, iran wọn, nipa idile wọn, nipa ile baba wọn, gẹgẹ bi iye orukọ, lati ẹni ogún ọdún lọ ati jù bẹ̃ lọ, gbogbo awọn ti o le jade lọ si ogun;
entries.en: Of the children of Asher, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

entries.yo: Awọn ti a kà ninu wọn, ninu ẹ̀ya Aṣeri, o jẹ́ ọkẹ meji o le ẹdẹgbẹjọ.
entries.en: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Asher, were forty and one thousand and five hundred.

entries.yo: Ti awọn ọmọ Naftali, iran wọn, nipa idile wọn, nipa ile baba wọn, gẹgẹ bi iye orukọ, lati ẹni ogún ọdún lọ ati jù bẹ̃ lọ, gbogbo awọn ti o le jade lọ si ogun;
entries.en: Of the children of Naphtali, throughout their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

entries.yo: Awọn ti a kà ninu wọn, ninu ẹ̀ya Naftali, o jẹ́ ẹgba mẹrindilọgbọ̀n o le egbeje.
entries.en: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Naphtali, were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.

entries.yo: Wọnyi li awọn ti a kà, ti Mose ati Aaroni kà, ati awọn olori Israeli, ọkunrin mejila: olukuluku wà fun ile awọn baba rẹ̀.
entries.en: These are those that were numbered, which Moses and Aaron numbered, and the princes of Israel, being twelve men: each one was for the house of his fathers.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni gbogbo awọn ti a kà ninu awọn ọmọ Israeli, nipa ile baba wọn, lati ẹni ogún ọdún lọ ati jù bẹ̃ lọ, gbogbo awọn ti o le jade lọ si ogun ni Israeli;
entries.en: So were all those that were numbered of the children of Israel, by the house of their fathers, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war in Israel;

entries.yo: Ani gbogbo awọn ti a kà o jẹ́ ọgbọ̀n ọkẹ enia o le egbejidilogun din ãdọta.
entries.en: Even all they that were numbered were six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn ọmọ Lefi gẹgẹ bi ẹ̀ya baba wọn li a kò kà mọ́ wọn.
entries.en: But the Levites after the tribe of their fathers were not numbered among them.

entries.yo: Nitoripe OLUWA ti sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: For the LORD had spoken unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Kìki ẹ̀ya Lefi ni ki iwọ ki o máṣe kà, bẹ̃ni ki iwọ ki o máṣe kà iye wọn mọ́ awọn ọmọ Israeli.
entries.en: Only thou shalt not number the tribe of Levi, neither take the sum of them among the children of Israel:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ki iwọ ki o yàn awọn ọmọ Lefi sori agọ́ érí, ati sori gbogbo ohun-èlo rẹ̀, ati sori ohun gbogbo ti iṣe tirẹ̀: awọn ni ki o ma rù agọ́, ati gbogbo ohun-èlo rẹ̀; awọn ni yio si ma ṣe iṣẹ-ìsin rẹ̀, ki nwọn ki o si dó yi agọ́ na ká.
entries.en: But thou shalt appoint the Levites over the tabernacle of testimony, and over all the vessels thereof, and over all things that belong to it: they shall bear the tabernacle, and all the vessels thereof; and they shall minister unto it, and shall encamp round about the tabernacle.

entries.yo: Nigbati agọ́ na ba si ṣí siwaju, ki awọn ọmọ Lefi ki o tú u palẹ: nigbati nwọn o ba si pa agọ́ na, awọn ọmọ Lefi ni ki o gbé e duro: alejó ti o ba sunmọtosi, pipa ni.
entries.en: And when the tabernacle setteth forward, the Levites shall take it down: and when the tabernacle is to be pitched, the Levites shall set it up: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.

entries.yo: Ki awọn ọmọ Israeli ki o si pa agọ́ wọn, olukuluku ni ibudó rẹ̀, ati olukuluku lẹba ọpagun rẹ̀, gẹgẹ bi ogun wọn.
entries.en: And the children of Israel shall pitch their tents, every man by his own camp, and every man by his own standard, throughout their hosts.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn ọmọ Lefi ni ki o dó yi agọ́ erí na ká, ki ibinu ki o má ba si lara ijọ awọn ọmọ Israeli: ki awọn ọmọ Lefi ki o si ma ṣe itọju agọ́ ẹrí na.
entries.en: But the Levites shall pitch round about the tabernacle of testimony, that there be no wrath upon the congregation of the children of Israel: and the Levites shall keep the charge of the tabernacle of testimony.

entries.yo: Bayi ni awọn ọmọ Israeli si ṣe; gẹgẹ bi gbogbo eyiti OLUWA ti paṣẹ fun Mose, bẹ̃ni nwọn ṣe.
entries.en: And the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so did they.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose ati fun Aaroni pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

entries.yo: Ki olukuluku awọn ọmọ Israeli ki o pa agọ́ rẹ̀ lẹba ọpagun rẹ̀, pẹlu asia ile baba wọn: ki nwọn ki o pagọ́ kọjusi agọ́ ajọ yiká.
entries.en: Every man of the children of Israel shall pitch by his own standard, with the ensign of their father's house: far off about the tabernacle of the congregation shall they pitch.

entries.yo: Ki awọn ti iṣe ti ọpagun ibudó Juda ki o dó ni ìha ìla-õrùn si ìha ìla-õrùn, gẹgẹ bi ogun wọn: Naṣoni ọmọ Amminadabu yio si jẹ́ olori awọn ọmọ Juda.
entries.en: And on the east side toward the rising of the sun shall they of the standard of the camp of Judah pitch throughout their armies: and Nahshon the son of Amminadab shall be captain of the children of Judah.

entries.yo: Ati ogun rẹ̀, ati awọn ti a kà ninu wọn, jẹ́ ẹgba mẹtadilogoji o le ẹgbẹta.
entries.en: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were threescore and fourteen thousand and six hundred.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ti o pagọ́ gbè e ki o jẹ́ ẹ̀ya Issakari: Netaneli ọmọ Suari yio si jẹ́ olori awọn ọmọ Issakari:
entries.en: And those that do pitch next unto him shall be the tribe of Issachar: and Nethaneel the son of Zuar shall be captain of the children of Issachar.

entries.yo: Ati ogun rẹ̀, ati awọn ti a kà ninu wọn, jẹ́ ẹgba mẹtadilọgbọ̀n o le irinwo.
entries.en: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, were fifty and four thousand and four hundred.

entries.yo: Ati ẹ̀ya Sebuluni: Eliabu ọmọ Heloni yio si jẹ́ olori awọn ọmọ Sebuluni:
entries.en: Then the tribe of Zebulun: and Eliab the son of Helon shall be captain of the children of Zebulun.

entries.yo: Ati ogun rẹ̀, ati awọn ti a kà ninu wọn, jẹ́ ẹgba mejidilọgbọ̀n o le egbeje.
entries.en: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, were fifty and seven thousand and four hundred.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn ti a kà ni ibudó Juda jẹ́ ẹgba mẹtalelãdọrun o le irinwo, gẹgẹ bi ogun wọn. Awọn yi ni yio kọ́ ṣí.
entries.en: All that were numbered in the camp of Judah were an hundred thousand and fourscore thousand and six thousand and four hundred, throughout their armies. These shall first set forth.

entries.yo: Ni ìha gusù ni ki ọpagun ibudó Reubeni ki o wà, gẹgẹ bi ogun wọn: Elisuru ọmọ Ṣedeuru yio si jẹ́ olori awọn ọmọ Reubeni:
entries.en: On the south side shall be the standard of the camp of Reuben according to their armies: and the captain of the children of Reuben shall be Elizur the son of Shedeur.

entries.yo: Ati ogun rẹ̀, ati awọn ti a kà ninu wọn, jẹ́ ẹgba mẹtalelogun o le ẹdẹgbẹta.
entries.en: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, were forty and six thousand and five hundred.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ti o pagọ́ tì i ki o jẹ́ ẹ̀ya Simeoni: Ṣelumieli ọmọ Suriṣaddai ni yio si jẹ́ olori awọn ọmọ Simeoni:
entries.en: And those which pitch by him shall be the tribe of Simeon: and the captain of the children of Simeon shall be Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

entries.yo: Ati ogun rẹ̀, ati awọn ti a kà ninu wọn, jẹ́ ẹgba mọkandilọgbòn o le ẹdegbeje.
entries.en: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were fifty and nine thousand and three hundred.

entries.yo: Ati ẹ̀ya Gadi: Eliasafu ọmọ Deueli ni yio si jẹ́ olori ogun ti awọn ọmọ Gadi:
entries.en: Then the tribe of Gad: and the captain of the sons of Gad shall be Eliasaph the son of Reuel.

entries.yo: Ati ogun rẹ̀, ati awọn ti a kà ninu wọn, jẹ́ ẹgba mejilelogun o le ãdọtalelẹgbẹjọ.
entries.en: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty and five thousand and six hundred and fifty.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn ti a kà ni ibudó Reubeni jẹ́ ẹgba marundilọgọrin o le ãdọtalelegbeje, gẹgẹ bi ogun wọn. Awọn ni yio si ṣí ṣikeji.
entries.en: All that were numbered in the camp of Reuben were an hundred thousand and fifty and one thousand and four hundred and fifty, throughout their armies. And they shall set forth in the second rank.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni agọ́ ajọ yio si ṣí, pẹlu ibudó, awọn ọmọ Lefi lãrin ibudó: bi nwọn ti dó bẹ̃ni nwọn o ṣí, olukuluku ni ipò rẹ̀, pẹlu ọpagun wọn.
entries.en: Then the tabernacle of the congregation shall set forward with the camp of the Levites in the midst of the camp: as they encamp, so shall they set forward, every man in his place by their standards.

entries.yo: Ni ìha ìwọ-õrùn ni ki ọpagun ibudó Efraimu ki o wà gẹgẹ bi ogun wọn: Eliṣama ọmọ Ammihudu yio si jẹ́ olori awọn ọmọ Efraimu:
entries.en: On the west side shall be the standard of the camp of Ephraim according to their armies: and the captain of the sons of Ephraim shall be Elishama the son of Ammihud.

entries.yo: Ati ogun rẹ̀, ati awọn ti a kà ninu wọn, jẹ́ ọkẹ meji o le ẹdẹgbẹta.
entries.en: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty thousand and five hundred.

entries.yo: Ati lẹba rẹ̀ ni ki ẹ̀ya Manasse ki o wà: Gamalieli ọmọ Pedahsuru yio si jẹ́ olori awọn ọmọ Manasse:
entries.en: And by him shall be the tribe of Manasseh: and the captain of the children of Manasseh shall be Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

entries.yo: Ati ogun rẹ̀, ati awọn ti a kà ninu wọn, jẹ́ ẹgba mẹrindilogun o le igba.
entries.en: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were thirty and two thousand and two hundred.

entries.yo: Ati ẹ̀ya Benjamini: Abidani ọmọ Gideoni yio si jẹ́ olori awọn ọmọ Benjamini:
entries.en: Then the tribe of Benjamin: and the captain of the sons of Benjamin shall be Abidan the son of Gideoni.

entries.yo: Ati ogun rẹ̀, ati awọn ti a kà ninu wọn, jẹ́ ẹgba mẹtadilogun o le egbeje.
entries.en: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were thirty and five thousand and four hundred.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn ti a kà ni ibudó Efraimu, jẹ́ ẹgba mẹrinlelãdọta o le ọgọrun, gẹgẹ bi ogun wọn. Awọn ni yio si ṣí ṣikẹta.
entries.en: All that were numbered of the camp of Ephraim were an hundred thousand and eight thousand and an hundred, throughout their armies. And they shall go forward in the third rank.

entries.yo: Ọpagun ibudó Dani ni ki o wà ni ìha ariwa gẹgẹ bi ogun wọn: Ahieseri ọmọ Ammiṣaddai yio si jẹ́ olori awọn ọmọ Dani.
entries.en: The standard of the camp of Dan shall be on the north side by their armies: and the captain of the children of Dan shall be Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

entries.yo: Ati ogun rẹ̀, ati awọn ti a kà ninu wọn, jẹ́ ẹgba mọkanlelọgbọ̀n o le ẹdẹgbẹrin.
entries.en: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were threescore and two thousand and seven hundred.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ti o dó tì i ni ki o jẹ́ ẹ̀ya Aṣeri: Pagieli ọmọ Okrani yio si jẹ́ olori awọn ọmọ Aṣeri:
entries.en: And those that encamp by him shall be the tribe of Asher: and the captain of the children of Asher shall be Pagiel the son of Ocran.

entries.yo: Ati ogun rẹ̀, ati awọn ti a kà ninu wọn, jẹ́ ọkẹ meji o le ẹdẹgbẹjọ.
entries.en: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty and one thousand and five hundred.

entries.yo: Ati ẹ̀ya Naftali: Ahira ọmọ Enani yio si jẹ́ olori awọn ọmọ Naftali:
entries.en: Then the tribe of Naphtali: and the captain of the children of Naphtali shall be Ahira the son of Enan.

entries.yo: Ati ogun rẹ̀, ati awọn ti a kà ninu wọn, jẹ́ ẹgba mẹrindilọgbọ̀n o le egbeje.
entries.en: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn ti a kà ni ibudó Dani, jẹ́ ẹgba mejidilọgọrin o le ẹgbẹjọ. Awọn ni yio ṣí kẹhin pẹlu ọpagun wọn.
entries.en: All they that were numbered in the camp of Dan were an hundred thousand and fifty and seven thousand and six hundred. They shall go hindmost with their standards.

entries.yo: Eyi li awọn ti a kà ninu awọn ọmọ Israeli gẹgẹ bi ile baba wọn: gbogbo awọn ti a kà ni ibudó gẹgẹ bi ogun wọn, jẹ́ ọgbọ̀n ọkẹ o le egbejidilogun din ãdọta.
entries.en: These are those which were numbered of the children of Israel by the house of their fathers: all those that were numbered of the camps throughout their hosts were six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn ọmọ Lefi li a kò kà mọ́ awọn ọmọ Israeli; bi OLUWA ti paṣẹ fun Mose.
entries.en: But the Levites were not numbered among the children of Israel; as the LORD commanded Moses.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Israeli si ṣe gẹgẹ bi gbogbo eyiti OLUWA paṣẹ fun Mose: bẹ̃ni nwọn si dó pẹlu ọpagun wọn, bẹ̃ni nwọn si nṣí, olukuluku nipa idile wọn, gẹgẹ bi ile baba wọn.
entries.en: And the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses: so they pitched by their standards, and so they set forward, every one after their families, according to the house of their fathers.

entries.yo: WỌNYI si li awọn iran Aaroni ati Mose li ọjọ́ ti OLUWA bá Mose sọ̀rọ li òke Sinai.
entries.en: These also are the generations of Aaron and Moses in the day that the LORD spake with Moses in mount Sinai.

entries.yo: Wọnyi si li orukọ awọn ọmọ Aaroni; Nadabu akọ́bi, ati Abihu, Eleasari, ati Itamari.
entries.en: And these are the names of the sons of Aaron; Nadab the firstborn, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

entries.yo: Wọnyi li orukọ awọn ọmọ Aaroni, awọn alufa ti a ta oróro si wọn li ori, ẹniti o yàsọtọ lati ma ṣe iranṣẹ ni ipò iṣẹ alufa.
entries.en: These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the priests which were anointed, whom he consecrated to minister in the priest's office.

entries.yo: Nadabu ati Abihu si kú niwaju OLUWA, nigbati nwọn rubọ iná àjeji niwaju OLUWA ni ijù Sinai, nwọn kò si lí ọmọ: ati Eleasari ati Itamari nṣe iṣẹ alufa niwaju Aaroni baba wọn.
entries.en: And Nadab and Abihu died before the LORD, when they offered strange fire before the LORD, in the wilderness of Sinai, and they had no children: and Eleazar and Ithamar ministered in the priest's office in the sight of Aaron their father.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Mú ẹ̀ya Lefi sunmọtosi, ki o si mú wọn wá siwaju Aaroni alufa, ki nwọn le ma ṣe iranṣẹ fun u.
entries.en: Bring the tribe of Levi near, and present them before Aaron the priest, that they may minister unto him.

entries.yo: Ki nwọn ki o ma pa aṣẹ rẹ̀ mọ́, ati aṣẹ gbogbo ajọ niwaju agọ́ ajọ, lati ṣe iṣẹ-ìsin agọ́.
entries.en: And they shall keep his charge, and the charge of the whole congregation before the tabernacle of the congregation, to do the service of the tabernacle.

entries.yo: Ki nwọn ki o si ma pa gbogbo ohun-èlo agọ́ ajọ mọ́, ati aṣẹ awọn ọmọ Israeli, lati ṣe iṣẹ-ìsin agọ́.
entries.en: And they shall keep all the instruments of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the charge of the children of Israel, to do the service of the tabernacle.

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o si fi awọn ọmọ Lefi fun Aaroni ati fun awọn ọmọ rẹ̀: patapata li a fi wọn fun u ninu awọn ọmọ Israeli.
entries.en: And thou shalt give the Levites unto Aaron and to his sons: they are wholly given unto him out of the children of Israel.

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o si yàn Aaroni ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, ki nwọn ki o si ma duro si iṣẹalufa wọn: alejò ti o ba si sunmọtosi pipa ni ki a pa a.
entries.en: And thou shalt appoint Aaron and his sons, and they shall wait on their priest's office: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Ati emi, kiyesi i, emi ti gbà awọn ọmọ Lefi kuro lãrin awọn ọmọ Israeli ni ipò gbogbo akọ́bi ti o ṣí inu ninu awọn ọmọ Israeli; nitorina ti emi li awọn ọmọ Lefi iṣe:
entries.en: And I, behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel instead of all the firstborn that openeth the matrix among the children of Israel: therefore the Levites shall be mine;

entries.yo: Nitoripe ti emi ni gbogbo akọ́bi; nitoripe li ọjọ́ na ti mo kọlù gbogbo akọ́bi ni ilẹ Egipti, ni mo yà gbogbo akọ́bi sọ̀tọ fun ara mi ni Israeli, ati enia ati ẹran: ti emi ni nwọn o ma ṣe: Emi li OLUWA.
entries.en: Because all the firstborn are mine; for on the day that I smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt I hallowed unto me all the firstborn in Israel, both man and beast: mine shall they be: I am the LORD.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose ni ijù Sinai pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying,

entries.yo: Kaye awọn ọmọ Lefi gẹgẹ bi ile baba wọn, nipa idile wọn: gbogbo ọkunrin lati ẹni oṣù kan lọ ati jù bẹ̃ lọ, ni ki iwọ ki o kà wọn.
entries.en: Number the children of Levi after the house of their fathers, by their families: every male from a month old and upward shalt thou number them.

entries.yo: Mose si kà wọn gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ OLUWA, bi a ti paṣẹ fun u.
entries.en: And Moses numbered them according to the word of the LORD, as he was commanded.

entries.yo: Wọnyi si ni awọn ọmọ Lefi gẹgẹ bi orukọ wọn; Gerṣoni, ati Kohati, ati Merari.
entries.en: And these were the sons of Levi by their names; Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari.

entries.yo: Wọnyi si ni orukọ awọn ọmọ Gerṣoni gẹgẹ bi idile wọn; Libni ati Ṣimei.
entries.en: And these are the names of the sons of Gershon by their families; Libni, and Shimei.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Kohati gẹgẹ bi idile wọn: Amramu, ati Ishari, Hebroni, ati Usieli.
entries.en: And the sons of Kohath by their families; Amram, and Izehar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Merari gẹgẹ bi idile wọn; Mali, ati Muṣi. Wọnyi ni awọn idile Lefi gẹgẹ bi ile baba wọn.
entries.en: And the sons of Merari by their families; Mahli, and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to the house of their fathers.

entries.yo: Ti Gerṣoni ni idile awọn ọmọ Libni, ati idile awọn ọmọ Ṣimei; wọnyi ni idile awọn ọmọ Gerṣoni.
entries.en: Of Gershon was the family of the Libnites, and the family of the Shimites: these are the families of the Gershonites.

entries.yo: Awọn ti a kà ninu wọn, gẹgẹ bi iye gbogbo awọn ọkunrin, lati ẹni oṣù kan lọ ati jù bẹ̃ lọ, ani iye awọn ti a kà ninu wọn, jẹ́ ẹgbata o le ẹdẹgbẹjọ.
entries.en: Those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, even those that were numbered of them were seven thousand and five hundred.

entries.yo: Awọn idile awọn ọmọ Gerṣoni ni ki o dó lẹhin agọ́ ni ìha ìwọ-õrùn.
entries.en: The families of the Gershonites shall pitch behind the tabernacle westward.

entries.yo: Ati Eliasafu ọmọ Laeli ni ki o ṣe olori ile baba awọn ọmọ Gerṣoni.
entries.en: And the chief of the house of the father of the Gershonites shall be Eliasaph the son of Lael.

entries.yo: Ati itọju awọn ọmọ Gerṣoni ninu agọ́ ajọ ni, Agọ́, ibori rẹ̀, ati aṣọ-isorọ̀ ti ẹnu-ọ̀na agọ́ ajọ,
entries.en: And the charge of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation shall be the tabernacle, and the tent, the covering thereof, and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation,

entries.yo: Ati aṣọ isorọ̀ ti agbalá, ati aṣọtita ti ẹnu-ọ̀na agbalá, ti mbẹ lẹba agọ́, ati lẹba pẹpẹ yiká, ati okùn rẹ̀ fun gbogbo iṣẹ-ìsin rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the hangings of the court, and the curtain for the door of the court, which is by the tabernacle, and by the altar round about, and the cords of it for all the service thereof.

entries.yo: Ati ti Kohati ni idile awọn ọmọ Amramu, ati idile ti awọn ọmọ Ishari, ati idile ti awọn ọmọ Hebroni, ati idile ti awọn ọmọ Usieli: wọnyi ni idile awọn ọmọ Kohati.
entries.en: And of Kohath was the family of the Amramites, and the family of the Izeharites, and the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites: these are the families of the Kohathites.

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi iye gbogbo awọn ọkunrin lati ẹni oṣù kan lọ ati jù bẹ̃ lọ, nwọn jẹ́ ẹgba mẹrin o le ẹgbẹta, ti nṣe itọju ibi-mimọ́.
entries.en: In the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, were eight thousand and six hundred, keeping the charge of the sanctuary.

entries.yo: Awọn idile ti awọn ọmọ Kohati ni ki o pagọ́ lẹba agọ́ si ìha gusù.
entries.en: The families of the sons of Kohath shall pitch on the side of the tabernacle southward.

entries.yo: Ati Elisafani ọmọ Usieli ni ki o ṣe olori ile baba awọn idile awọn ọmọ Kohati.
entries.en: And the chief of the house of the father of the families of the Kohathites shall be Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.

entries.yo: Apoti, ati tabeli, ati ọpá-fitila, ati pẹpẹ wọnni, ati ohun-èlo ibi-mimọ́, eyiti nwọn fi nṣe iṣẹ alufa, ati aṣọ-tita, ati gbogbo ohun-èlo iṣẹ-ìsin rẹ̀, ni yio jẹ́ ohun itọju wọn.
entries.en: And their charge shall be the ark, and the table, and the candlestick, and the altars, and the vessels of the sanctuary wherewith they minister, and the hanging, and all the service thereof.

entries.yo: Eleasari ọmọ Aaroni alufa ni yio si ṣe olori awọn olori awọn ọmọ Lefi, on ni yio si ma ṣe itọju awọn ti nṣe itọju ibi-mimọ́.
entries.en: And Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be chief over the chief of the Levites, and have the oversight of them that keep the charge of the sanctuary.

entries.yo: Ti Merari ni idile awọn ọmọ Mali, ati idile awọn ọmọ Musi: wọnyi ni idile Merari.
entries.en: Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites, and the family of the Mushites: these are the families of Merari.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ti a kà ninu wọn, gẹgẹ bi iye gbogbo awọn ọkunrin, lati ọmọ oṣù kan lọ ati jù bẹ̃ lọ, nwọn jẹ́ ọgbọkanlelọgbọ̀n.
entries.en: And those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, were six thousand and two hundred.

entries.yo: Ati Surieli ọmọ Abihaili ni ki o ṣe olori ile baba awọn idile Merari; ki nwọn ki o dó ni ìhà agọ́ si ìhà ariwa.
