entries.en: And the chief of the house of the father of the families of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail: these shall pitch on the side of the tabernacle northward.

entries.yo: Iṣẹ itọju awọn ọmọ Merari yio si jẹ́ apáko agọ́, ati ọpá-idabu rẹ̀, ati opó rẹ̀, ati ihò-ìtẹbọ rẹ̀, ati gbogbo ohun-èlo rẹ̀, ati gbogbo ohun-èlo ìsin rẹ̀;
entries.en: And under the custody and charge of the sons of Merari shall be the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and the sockets thereof, and all the vessels thereof, and all that serveth thereto,

entries.yo: Ati opó agbalá yiká, ati ihò-ìtẹbọ wọn, ati ẽkàn wọn, ati okùn wọn.
entries.en: And the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn ti o pagọ́ niwaju agọ́ na, si ìha ìla-õrùn, ani niwaju agọ́ ajọ si ìha ìla-õrùn ni, ki o jẹ́ Mose, ati Aaroni ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, ti nwọn nṣe itọju ibi-mimọ́, fun itọju awọn ọmọ Israeli; alejò ti o ba si sunmọtosi pipa li a o pa a.
entries.en: But those that encamp before the tabernacle toward the east, even before the tabernacle of the congregation eastward, shall be Moses, and Aaron and his sons, keeping the charge of the sanctuary for the charge of the children of Israel; and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn ti a kà ninu awọn ọmọ Lefi, ti Mose ati Aaroni kà nipa aṣẹ OLUWA, gẹgẹ bi idile wọn, gbogbo awọn ọkunrin lati ọmọ oṣù kan lọ ati jù bẹ̃ lọ, nwọn jẹ́ ẹgba mọkanla,
entries.en: All that were numbered of the Levites, which Moses and Aaron numbered at the commandment of the LORD, throughout their families, all the males from a month old and upward, were twenty and two thousand.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe, Kà gbogbo awọn akọ́bi ọkunrin awọn ọmọ Israeli lati ọmọ oṣù kan lọ ati jù bẹ̃ lọ, ki o si gbà iye orukọ wọn.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Number all the firstborn of the males of the children of Israel from a month old and upward, and take the number of their names.

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o si gbà awọn ọmọ Lefi fun mi (Emi li OLUWA) ni ipò gbogbo awọn akọ́bi ninu awọn ọmọ Israeli; ati ohun-ọ̀sin awọn ọmọ Lefi, ni ipò gbogbo awọn akọ́bi ninu ohun-ọ̀sin awọn ọmọ Israeli.
entries.en: And thou shalt take the Levites for me (I am the LORD) instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel; and the cattle of the Levites instead of all the firstlings among the cattle of the children of Israel.

entries.yo: Mose si kà gbogbo awọn akọ́bi ninu awọn ọmọ Israeli, bi OLUWA ti paṣẹ fun u.
entries.en: And Moses numbered, as the LORD commanded him, all the firstborn among the children of Israel.

entries.yo: Ati gbogbo awọn akọ́bi ọkunrin nipa iye orukọ, lati ọmọ oṣù kan lọ ati jù bẹ̃ lọ ninu eyiti a kà ninu wọn, jẹ́ ẹgba mọkanla o le ọrinlugba o din meje.
entries.en: And all the firstborn males by the number of names, from a month old and upward, of those that were numbered of them, were twenty and two thousand two hundred and threescore and thirteen.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Gbà awọn ọmọ Lefi ni ipò gbogbo awọn akọ́bi ninu awọn ọmọ Israeli, ati ohun-ọ̀sin awọn ọmọ Lefi nipò ohun-ọ̀sin wọn; awọn ọmọ Lefi yio si jẹ́ ti emi; Emi li OLUWA.
entries.en: Take the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel, and the cattle of the Levites instead of their cattle; and the Levites shall be mine: I am the LORD.

entries.yo: Ati fun ìrapada awọn ọrinlugba din meje ti awọn akọ́bi ninu awọn ọmọ Israeli, ti nwọn fi jù awọn ọmọ Lefi lọ,
entries.en: And for those that are to be redeemed of the two hundred and threescore and thirteen of the firstborn of the children of Israel, which are more than the Levites;

entries.yo: Ani ki o gbà ṣekeli marun-marun li ori ẹni kọkan, gẹgẹ bi ṣekeli ibi-mimọ́ ni ki o gbà wọn; (ogun gera ni ṣekeli kan):
entries.en: Thou shalt even take five shekels apiece by the poll, after the shekel of the sanctuary shalt thou take them: (the shekel is twenty gerahs:)

entries.yo: Ki o si fi ninu owo na, ani owo ìrapada ti o lé ninu wọn, fun Aaroni ati fun awọn ọmọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And thou shalt give the money, wherewith the odd number of them is to be redeemed, unto Aaron and to his sons.

entries.yo: Mose si gbà owo ìrapada lọwọ awọn ti o lé lori awọn ti a fi awọn ọmọ Lefi rasilẹ:
entries.en: And Moses took the redemption money of them that were over and above them that were redeemed by the Levites:

entries.yo: Lọwọ awọn akọ́bi awọn ọmọ Israeli li o gbà owo na; egbeje ṣekeli o din marundilogoji, gẹgẹ bi ṣekeli ibi mimọ́:
entries.en: Of the firstborn of the children of Israel took he the money; a thousand three hundred and threescore and five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:

entries.yo: Mose si fi owo awọn ti a rapada fun Aaroni ati fun awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ OLUWA, gẹgẹ bi OLUWA ti paṣẹ fun Mose.
entries.en: And Moses gave the money of them that were redeemed unto Aaron and to his sons, according to the word of the LORD, as the LORD commanded Moses.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose ati Aaroni pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

entries.yo: Kà iye awọn ọmọ Kohati kuro ninu awọn ọmọ Lefi, nipa idile wọn, ile baba wọn,
entries.en: Take the sum of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, after their families, by the house of their fathers,

entries.yo: Lati ẹni ọgbọ̀n ọdún lọ ati jù bẹ̃ lọ, ani titi di ẹni ãdọta ọdún, gbogbo ẹniti o wọ̀ inu iṣẹ-ìsin, lati ṣe iṣẹ ninu agọ́ ajọ.
entries.en: From thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old, all that enter into the host, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.

entries.yo: Eyi ni yio ṣe iṣẹ-ìsin awọn ọmọ Kohati ninu agọ́ ajọ, niti ohun mimọ́ julọ wọnni:
entries.en: This shall be the service of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation, about the most holy things:

entries.yo: Nigbati ibudó ba si ṣí siwaju, Aaroni o wá, ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, nwọn o si bọ́ aṣọ-ikele rẹ̀ silẹ, nwọn o si fi i bò apoti ẹrí;
entries.en: And when the camp setteth forward, Aaron shall come, and his sons, and they shall take down the covering vail, and cover the ark of testimony with it:

entries.yo: Nwọn o fi awọ seali bò o, nwọn o si nà aṣọ kìki alaró bò o, nwọn o si tẹ̀ ọpá nì bọ̀ ọ.
entries.en: And shall put thereon the covering of badgers' skins, and shall spread over it a cloth wholly of blue, and shall put in the staves thereof.

entries.yo: Ati lori tabili àkara ifihàn nì, ki nwọn ki o nà aṣọ alaró kan si, ki nwọn ki o si fi awopọkọ sori rẹ̀, ati ṣibi ati awokòto, ati ìgo ohun didà: ati àkara ìgbagbogbo nì ki o wà lori rẹ̀:
entries.en: And upon the table of shewbread they shall spread a cloth of blue, and put thereon the dishes, and the spoons, and the bowls, and covers to cover withal: and the continual bread shall be thereon:

entries.yo: Ki nwọn ki o si nà aṣọ ododó bò wọn, ki nwọn ki o si fi awọ seali bò o, ki nwọn ki o si tẹ̀ ọpá rẹ̀ bọ̀ ọ.
entries.en: And they shall spread upon them a cloth of scarlet, and cover the same with a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put in the staves thereof.

entries.yo: Ki nwọn ki o si mú aṣọ alaró kan, ki nwọn ki o si fi bò ọpá-fitila nì, ati fitila rẹ̀, ati alumagaji rẹ̀, ati awo alumagaji rẹ̀, ati gbogbo ohunèlo oróro rẹ̀, eyiti nwọn fi nṣe iṣẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And they shall take a cloth of blue, and cover the candlestick of the light, and his lamps, and his tongs, and his snuffdishes, and all the oil vessels thereof, wherewith they minister unto it:

entries.yo: Ki nwọn ki o si fi on ati gbogbo ohun-èlo rẹ̀ sinu awọ seali, ki nwọn ki o si gbé e lé ori igi.
entries.en: And they shall put it and all the vessels thereof within a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put it upon a bar.

entries.yo: Ati lori pẹpẹ wurà ni ki nwọn ki o nà aṣọ alaró kan si, nwọn o si fi awọ seali bò o, nwọn o si tẹ̀ ọpá rẹ̀ bọ̀ ọ.
entries.en: And upon the golden altar they shall spread a cloth of blue, and cover it with a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put to the staves thereof:

entries.yo: Ki nwọn ki o si kó gbogbo ohunèlo ìsin, ti nwọn fi nṣe iṣẹ-ìsin ninu ibi-mimọ́, ki nwọn ki o si fi wọn sinu aṣọ alaró kan, ki nwọn ki o si fi awọ seali bò wọn, ki nwon ki o si fi wọn kà ori igi.
entries.en: And they shall take all the instruments of ministry, wherewith they minister in the sanctuary, and put them in a cloth of blue, and cover them with a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put them on a bar:

entries.yo: Ki nwọn ki o si kó ẽru kuro lori pẹpẹ, ki nwọn ki o si nà aṣọ elesè-aluko kan bò o.
entries.en: And they shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth thereon:

entries.yo: Ki nwọn ki o si fi gbogbo ohun-èlo rẹ̀ ti nwọn fi ṣe iṣẹ-ìsin rẹ̀ sori rẹ̀, awo iná, ati kọkọrọ ẹran, ati ọkọ́-ẽru, ati awokòto, ati gbogbo ohun-èlo pẹpẹ na; ki nwọn ki o si nà awọ seali sori rẹ̀, ki nwọn ki o si tẹ ọpá rẹ̀ bọ̀ ọ.
entries.en: And they shall put upon it all the vessels thereof, wherewith they minister about it, even the censers, the fleshhooks, and the shovels, and the basons, all the vessels of the altar; and they shall spread upon it a covering of badgers' skins, and put to the staves of it.

entries.yo: Nigbati Aaroni ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ ba pari ati bò ibi-mimọ́ na tán, ati gbogbo ohun-èlo ibi-mimọ́ na, nigbati ibudó yio ba ṣí siwaju; lẹhin eyinì, li awọn ọmọ Kohati yio wá lati gbé e: ṣugbọn nwọn kò gbọdọ fọwọkàn ohun mimọ́ kan, ki nwọn ki o má ba kú. Wọnyi li ẹrù awọn ọmọ Kohati ninu agọ́ ajọ.
entries.en: And when Aaron and his sons have made an end of covering the sanctuary, and all the vessels of the sanctuary, as the camp is to set forward; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to bear it: but they shall not touch any holy thing, lest they die. These things are the burden of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation.

entries.yo: Ohun itọju Eleasari ọmọ Aaroni alufa si ni oróro fitila, ati turari didùn, ati ẹbọ ohunjijẹ ìgbagbogbo, ati oróro itasori, ati itọju agọ́ na gbogbo, ati ti ohun gbogbo ti mbẹ ninu rẹ̀, ninu ibi-mimọ́ nì, ati ohun-èlo rẹ̀ na.
entries.en: And to the office of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest pertaineth the oil for the light, and the sweet incense, and the daily meat offering, and the anointing oil, and the oversight of all the tabernacle, and of all that therein is, in the sanctuary, and in the vessels thereof.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose ati fun Aaroni pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

entries.yo: Ẹ máṣe ke ẹ̀ya idile awọn ọmọ Kohati kuro lãrin awọn ọmọ Lefi:
entries.en: Cut ye not off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bayi ni ki ẹ ṣe fun wọn, ki nwọn ki o le yè, ki nwọn ki o má ba kú, nigbati nwọn ba sunmọ ohun mimọ́ julọ: ki Aaroni ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ wọnú ilé, ki nwọn si yàn wọn olukuluku si iṣẹ rẹ̀ ati si ẹrù rẹ̀;
entries.en: But thus do unto them, that they may live, and not die, when they approach unto the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in, and appoint them every one to his service and to his burden:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nwọn kò gbọdọ wọle lọ lati wò ohun mimọ́ ni iṣẹju kan, ki nwọn ki o má ba kú.
entries.en: But they shall not go in to see when the holy things are covered, lest they die.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Kà iye awọn ọmọ Gerṣoni pẹlu, gẹgẹ bi ile baba wọn, nipa idile wọn;
entries.en: Take also the sum of the sons of Gershon, throughout the houses of their fathers, by their families;

entries.yo: Lati ẹni ọgbọ̀n ọdún lọ ati jù bẹ̃ lọ titi di ẹni ãdọta ọdún ni ki o kaye wọn; gbogbo awọn ti o wọnu-ile lọ lati ṣe iṣẹ-ìsin, lati ṣe iṣẹ ninu agọ́ ajọ.
entries.en: From thirty years old and upward until fifty years old shalt thou number them; all that enter in to perform the service, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.

entries.yo: Eyi ni iṣẹ-ìsin idile awọn ọmọ Gerṣoni, lati sìn ati lati rù ẹrù:
entries.en: This is the service of the families of the Gershonites, to serve, and for burdens:

entries.yo: Awọn ni yio si ma rù aṣọ-ikele agọ́, ati agọ́ ajọ, ibori rẹ̀, ati ibori awọ seali ti mbẹ lori rẹ̀, ati aṣọ-tita fun ẹnu-ọ̀na agọ́ ajọ;
entries.en: And they shall bear the curtains of the tabernacle, and the tabernacle of the congregation, his covering, and the covering of the badgers' skins that is above upon it, and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation,

entries.yo: Ati aṣọ-isorọ̀ ti agbalá, ati aṣọ-tita fun ẹnu-ọ̀na agbalá, ti mbẹ lẹba agọ́ ati lẹba pẹpẹ yiká, ati okùn wọn, ati gbogbo ohun-èlo iṣẹ-ìsin wọn, ati ohun gbogbo ti a ṣe fun wọn; bẹ̃ni nwọn o ma sìn.
entries.en: And the hangings of the court, and the hanging for the door of the gate of the court, which is by the tabernacle and by the altar round about, and their cords, and all the instruments of their service, and all that is made for them: so shall they serve.

entries.yo: Nipa aṣẹ Aaroni ati ti awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ ni ki gbogbo iṣẹ-ìsin awọn ọmọ Gerṣoni jẹ́, ni gbogbo ẹrù wọn, ati ni gbogbo iṣẹ-ìsin wọn: ki ẹnyin si yàn wọn si itọju gbogbo ẹrù wọn.
entries.en: At the appointment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burdens, and in all their service: and ye shall appoint unto them in charge all their burdens.

entries.yo: Eyi ni iṣẹ-ìsin idile awọn ọmọ Gerṣoni ninu agọ́ ajọ: ki itọju wọn ki o si wà li ọwọ́ Itamari ọmọ
entries.en: This is the service of the families of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation: and their charge shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Merari, ki iwọ ki o kà wọn gẹgẹ bi idile wọn, nipa ile baba wọn;
entries.en: As for the sons of Merari, thou shalt number them after their families, by the house of their fathers;

entries.yo: Lati ẹni ọgbọ̀n ọdún lọ ati jù bẹ̃ lọ ani titi di ẹni ãdọta ọdún ni ki iwọ ki o kà wọn, gbogbo ẹniti o wọ̀ inu iṣẹ-ìsin na lati ṣe iṣẹ ninu agọ́ ajọ́.
entries.en: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old shalt thou number them, every one that entereth into the service, to do the work of the tabernacle of the congregation.

entries.yo: Eyi si ni itọju ẹrù wọn, gẹgẹ bi gbogbo iṣẹ-ìsin wọn ninu agọ́ ajo; awọn apáko agọ́, ati ọpá-idabu rẹ̀, ati opó rẹ̀, ati ìhò-ìtẹbọ rẹ̀,
entries.en: And this is the charge of their burden, according to all their service in the tabernacle of the congregation; the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and sockets thereof,

entries.yo: Ati opó agbalá yiká, ati ihò-ìtẹbọ wọn, ati ẽkàn wọn, ati okùn wọn, pẹlu ohun-èlo wọn gbogbo, ati pẹlu ohun-ìsin wọn gbogbo: li orukọ li orukọ ni ki ẹnyin ki o kà ohun-èlo ti iṣe itọju ẹrù wọn.
entries.en: And the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords, with all their instruments, and with all their service: and by name ye shall reckon the instruments of the charge of their burden.

entries.yo: Eyi ni iṣẹ-ìsin idile awọn ọmọ Merari, gẹgẹ bi iṣẹ-ìsin wọn gbogbo, ninu agọ́ ajọ, labẹ Itamari ọmọ Aaroni alufa.
entries.en: This is the service of the families of the sons of Merari, according to all their service, in the tabernacle of the congregation, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

entries.yo: Mose ati Aaroni ati awọn olori ijọ awọn enia si kà awọn ọmọ Kohati nipa idile wọn, ati gẹgẹ bi ile baba wọn,
entries.en: And Moses and Aaron and the chief of the congregation numbered the sons of the Kohathites after their families, and after the house of their fathers,

entries.yo: Lati ẹni ọgbọ̀n ọdún lọ ati jù bẹ̃ lọ ani titi di ẹni ãdọta ọdún, gbogbo ẹniti o wọ̀ inu iṣẹ-ìsin na fun iṣẹ ninu agọ́ ajọ:
entries.en: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation:

entries.yo: Awọn ti a si kà ninu wọn nipa idile wọn jẹ́ ẹgbẹrinla o din ãdọta.
entries.en: And those that were numbered of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred and fifty.

entries.yo: Wọnyi li awọn ti a kà ni idile awọn ọmọ Kohati, gbogbo awọn ti o le ṣe iṣẹ-ìsin ninu agọ́ ajọ, ti Mose ati Aaroni kà, gẹgẹ bi aṣẹ OLUWA nipa ọwọ́ Mose.
entries.en: These were they that were numbered of the families of the Kohathites, all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation, which Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of the LORD by the hand of Moses.

entries.yo: Awọn ti a si kà ninu awọn ọmọ Gerṣoni, nipa idile wọn, ati gẹgẹ bi ile baba wọn,
entries.en: And those that were numbered of the sons of Gershon, throughout their families, and by the house of their fathers,

entries.yo: Lati ẹni ọgbọ̀n ọdún lọ ati jù bẹ̃ lọ ani titi di ẹni ãdọta ọdún, gbogbo ẹniti o wọ̀ inu iṣẹ-ìsin na, fun iṣẹ ninu agọ́ ajọ,
entries.en: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation,

entries.yo: Ani awọn ti a kà ninu wọn, nipa idile wọn, gẹgẹ bi ile baba wọn, jẹ́ ẹgbẹtala o le ọgbọ̀n.
entries.en: Even those that were numbered of them, throughout their families, by the house of their fathers, were two thousand and six hundred and thirty.

entries.yo: Wọnyi li awọn ti a kà ni idile awọn ọmọ Gerṣoni, gbogbo awọn ti o ṣe iṣẹ-ìsin ninu agọ́ ajọ, ti Mose ati Aaroni kà gẹgẹ bi aṣẹ OLUWA.
entries.en: These are they that were numbered of the families of the sons of Gershon, of all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation, whom Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of the LORD.

entries.yo: Awọn ti a si kà ni idile awọn ọmọ Merari, nipa idile wọn, gẹgẹ bi ile baba wọn,
entries.en: And those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, throughout their families, by the house of their fathers,

entries.yo: Lati ẹni ọgbọ̀n ọdún lọ ati jù bẹ̃ lọ, ani titi di ẹni ãdọta ọdún, gbogbo ẹniti o wọ̀ inu iṣẹ-ìsin na, fun iṣẹ ninu agọ́ ajọ,
entries.en: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation,

entries.yo: Ani awọn ti a kà ninu wọn nipa idile wọn jẹ́ ẹgbẹrindilogun.
entries.en: Even those that were numbered of them after their families, were three thousand and two hundred.

entries.yo: Wọnyi li awọn ti a kà ninu idile awọn ọmọ Merari, ti Mose ati Aaroni kà gẹgẹ bi aṣẹ OLUWA nipa ọwọ́ Mose.
entries.en: These be those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the word of the LORD by the hand of Moses.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn ti a kà ninu awọn ọmọ Lefi, ti Mose ati Aaroni ati awọn olori Israeli kà, nipa idile wọn, ati gẹgẹ bi ile baba wọn,
entries.en: All those that were numbered of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron and the chief of Israel numbered, after their families, and after the house of their fathers,

entries.yo: Lati ẹni ọgbọ̀n ọdún lọ ati jù bẹ̃ lọ ani titi di ẹni ãdọta ọdún, gbogbo ẹniti o wá lati ṣe iṣẹ-ìsin, ati iṣẹ ẹrù ninu agọ́ ajọ,
entries.en: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that came to do the service of the ministry, and the service of the burden in the tabernacle of the congregation,

entries.yo: Ani awọn ti a kà ninu wọn, jẹ́ ẹgbẹtalelẹgbarin o din ogun.
entries.en: Even those that were numbered of them, were eight thousand and five hundred and fourscore.

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi aṣẹ OLUWA li a kà wọn nipa ọwọ́ Mose, olukuluku nipa iṣẹ-ìsin rẹ̀, ati gẹgẹ bi ẹrù rẹ̀: bẹ̃li a ti ọwọ́ rẹ̀ kà wọn, bi OLUWA ti fi aṣẹ fun Mose.
entries.en: According to the commandment of the LORD they were numbered by the hand of Moses, every one according to his service, and according to his burden: thus were they numbered of him, as the LORD commanded Moses.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Paṣẹ fun awọn ọmọ Israeli, ki nwọn ki o yọ gbogbo adẹ̀tẹ kuro ni ibudó, ati gbogbo ẹniti o ní isun, ati ẹnikẹni ti o di alaimọ́ nipa okú:
entries.en: Command the children of Israel, that they put out of the camp every leper, and every one that hath an issue, and whosoever is defiled by the dead:

entries.yo: Ati ọkunrin ati obinrin ni ki ẹnyin ki o yọ kuro, lẹhin ode ibudó ni ki ẹ fi wọn si; ki nwọn ki o máṣe sọ ibudó wọn di alaimọ́, lãrin eyiti Emi ngbé.
entries.en: Both male and female shall ye put out, without the camp shall ye put them; that they defile not their camps, in the midst whereof I dwell.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Israeli si ṣe bẹ̃, nwọn si yọ wọn sẹhin ibudó: bi OLUWA ti sọ fun Mose, bẹ̃ li awọn ọmọ Israeli ṣe.
entries.en: And the children of Israel did so, and put them out without the camp: as the LORD spake unto Moses, so did the children of Israel.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Sọ fun awọn ọmọ Israeli pe, Nigbati ọkunrin kan tabi obinrin kan ba dá ẹ̀ṣẹkẹṣẹ ti enia ida, ti o ṣe irekọja si OLUWA, ti oluwarẹ̀ si jẹ̀bi;
entries.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, When a man or woman shall commit any sin that men commit, to do a trespass against the LORD, and that person be guilty;

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ki nwọn ki o jẹwọ ẹ̀ṣẹ ti nwọn ṣẹ̀: ki o si san ẹsan ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ̀ li oju-owo, ki o si fi idamarun rẹ̀ lé e, ki o si fi i fun ẹniti on jẹbi rẹ̀.
entries.en: Then they shall confess their sin which they have done: and he shall recompense his trespass with the principal thereof, and add unto it the fifth part thereof, and give it unto him against whom he hath trespassed.

entries.yo: Bi o ba si ṣepe ọkunrin na kò ní ibatan kan lati san ẹsan ẹ̀ṣẹ na fun, ki a san ẹsan na fun OLUWA, ani fun alufa; pẹlu àgbo ètutu, ti a o fi ṣètutu fun u.
entries.en: But if the man have no kinsman to recompense the trespass unto, let the trespass be recompensed unto the LORD, even to the priest; beside the ram of the atonement, whereby an atonement shall be made for him.

entries.yo: Ati gbogbo ẹbọ agbesọsoke ohun mimọ́ gbogbo ti awọn ọmọ Israeli, ti nwọn mú tọ̀ alufa wá, yio jẹ́ tirẹ̀.
entries.en: And every offering of all the holy things of the children of Israel, which they bring unto the priest, shall be his.

entries.yo: Ati ohun mimọ́ olukuluku, ki o jẹ́ tirẹ̀: ohunkohun ti ẹnikan ba fi fun alufa ki o jẹ́ tirẹ̀.
entries.en: And every man's hallowed things shall be his: whatsoever any man giveth the priest, it shall be his.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Sọ fun awọn ọmọ Israeli, ki o si wi fun wọn pe, Bi aya ọkunrin kan ba yapa, ti o si ṣẹ̀ ẹ,
entries.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, If any man's wife go aside, and commit a trespass against him,

entries.yo: Ti ọkunrin kan si bá a dàpọ, ti o si pamọ́ fun ọkọ rẹ̀, ti o si sin, ti on si di ẹni ibàjẹ́, ti kò si sí ẹlẹri kan si i, ti a kò si mú u mọ ọ,
entries.en: And a man lie with her carnally, and it be hid from the eyes of her husband, and be kept close, and she be defiled, and there be no witness against her, neither she be taken with the manner;

entries.yo: Ti ẹmi owú ba dé si i, ti o si njowú aya rẹ̀, ti obinrin na si di ẹni ibàjẹ́: tabi bi ẹmi owú ba dé si i, ti o si njowú aya rẹ̀, ṣugbọn ti on kò di ẹni ibàjẹ́:
entries.en: And the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be defiled: or if the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be not defiled:

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ki ọkunrin na ki o mú aya rẹ́ tọ̀ alufa wá, ki o si mú ọrẹ-ẹbọ rẹ̀ wá fun u, idamẹwa òṣuwọn efa iyẹfun barle; ki o máṣe dà oróro sori rẹ̀, bẹ̃ni ki o máṣe fi turari sinu rẹ̀; nitoripe ẹbọ ohunjijẹ owú ni, ẹbọ ohunjijẹ iranti ni, ti nmú irekọja wá si iranti.
entries.en: Then shall the man bring his wife unto the priest, and he shall bring her offering for her, the tenth part of an ephah of barley meal; he shall pour no oil upon it, nor put frankincense thereon; for it is an offering of jealousy, an offering of memorial, bringing iniquity to remembrance.

entries.yo: Ki alufa na ki o si mú u sunmọtosi, ki o mu u duro niwaju OLUWA:
entries.en: And the priest shall bring her near, and set her before the LORD:

entries.yo: Ki alufa ki o si bù omi mimọ́ ninu ohun-èlo amọ̀ kan; ati ninu erupẹ ti mbẹ ni ilẹ agọ́ ni ki alufa ki o bù, ki o si fi i sinu omi na:
entries.en: And the priest shall take holy water in an earthen vessel; and of the dust that is in the floor of the tabernacle the priest shall take, and put it into the water:

entries.yo: Ki alufa ki o si mu obinrin na duro niwaju OLUWA, ki o si ṣí ibori obinrin na, ki o si fi ẹbọ ohunjijẹ iranti na lé e li ọwọ́, ti iṣe ẹbọ ohunjijẹ owú: ati li ọwọ́ alufa ni omi kikorò ti imú egún wá yio wà.
entries.en: And the priest shall set the woman before the LORD, and uncover the woman's head, and put the offering of memorial in her hands, which is the jealousy offering: and the priest shall have in his hand the bitter water that causeth the curse:

entries.yo: Alufa na yio si mu u bura, yio si wi fun obinrin na pe, Bi ọkunrin kò ba bá ọ dàpọ, bi iwọ kò ba si yàsapakan si ìwa-aimọ́, labẹ ọkọ rẹ, ki iwọ ki o yege omi kikorò yi ti imú egún wá:
entries.en: And the priest shall charge her by an oath, and say unto the woman, If no man have lain with thee, and if thou hast not gone aside to uncleanness with another instead of thy husband, be thou free from this bitter water that causeth the curse:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi iwọ ba yapa, labẹ ọkọ rẹ, ti iwọ si di ẹni ibàjẹ́, ti ọkunrin miran si bá ọ dàpọ laiṣe ọkọ rẹ:
entries.en: But if thou hast gone aside to another instead of thy husband, and if thou be defiled, and some man have lain with thee beside thine husband:

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ki alufa ki o mu ki obinrin na fi èpe bura, ki alufa ki o si wi fun obinrin na pe, Ki OLUWA ki o sọ ọ di ẹni egún, ati ẹni ifire ninu awọn enia rẹ, nigbati OLUWA ba mu itan rẹ rà, ti o si mu inu rẹ wú;
entries.en: Then the priest shall charge the woman with an oath of cursing, and the priest shall say unto the woman, The LORD make thee a curse and an oath among thy people, when the LORD doth make thy thigh to rot, and thy belly to swell;

entries.yo: Ati omi yi ti nmú egún wá ki o wọ̀ inu rẹ lọ, lati mu inu rẹ wú, ati lati mu itan rẹ rà: ki obinrin na ki o si wipe, Amin, amin.
entries.en: And this water that causeth the curse shall go into thy bowels, to make thy belly to swell, and thy thigh to rot: And the woman shall say, Amen, amen.

entries.yo: Ki alufa ki o si kọ egún yi sinu iwé, ki o si fi omi kikorò na wẹ̀ ẹ nù:
entries.en: And the priest shall write these curses in a book, and he shall blot them out with the bitter water:

entries.yo: Ki o si jẹ ki obinrin na ki o mu omi kikorò na ti imú egún wá: omi na ti imú egún wá yio si wọ̀ inu rẹ̀ lọ, a si di kikorò.
entries.en: And he shall cause the woman to drink the bitter water that causeth the curse: and the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her, and become bitter.

entries.yo: Nigbana li alufa yio gbà ẹbọ ohunjijẹ owú na li ọwọ́ obinrin na, yio si fì ẹbọ ohunjijẹ na niwaju OLUWA, yio si ru u lori pẹpẹ:
entries.en: Then the priest shall take the jealousy offering out of the woman's hand, and shall wave the offering before the LORD, and offer it upon the altar:

entries.yo: Ki alufa ki o si bù ikunwọ kan ninu ẹbọ ohunjijẹ na, ani iranti rẹ̀, ki o si sun u lori pẹpẹ, lẹhin eyinì ki o jẹ ki obinrin na mu omi na.
entries.en: And the priest shall take an handful of the offering, even the memorial thereof, and burn it upon the altar, and afterward shall cause the woman to drink the water.

entries.yo: Nigbati o ba si mu omi na tán, yio si ṣe, bi o ba ṣe ẹni ibàjẹ́, ti o si ṣẹ̀ ọkọ rẹ̀, omi ti imú egún wá yio si wọ̀ inu rẹ̀ lọ, a si di kikorò, inu rẹ̀, a si wú, itan rẹ̀ a si rà: obinrin na a si di ẹni egún lãrin awọn enia rẹ̀.
entries.en: And when he hath made her to drink the water, then it shall come to pass, that, if she be defiled, and have done trespass against her husband, that the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her, and become bitter, and her belly shall swell, and her thigh shall rot: and the woman shall be a curse among her people.

entries.yo: Bi obinrin na kò ba si ṣe ẹni ibàjẹ́, ṣugbọn ti o mọ́; njẹ yio yege, yio si lóyun.
entries.en: And if the woman be not defiled, but be clean; then she shall be free, and shall conceive seed.

entries.yo: Eyi li ofin owú, nigbati obinrin kan ba yapa, labẹ ọkọ rẹ̀, ti o si di ẹni ibàjẹ́;
entries.en: This is the law of jealousies, when a wife goeth aside to another instead of her husband, and is defiled;

entries.yo: Tabi nigbati ẹmi owú ba dé si ọkọ kan, ti o ba si njowú obinrin rẹ̀; nigbana yio mu obinrin na duro niwaju OLUWA, ki alufa ki o si ṣe gbogbo ofin yi si i.
entries.en: Or when the spirit of jealousy cometh upon him, and he be jealous over his wife, and shall set the woman before the LORD, and the priest shall execute upon her all this law.

entries.yo: Nigbana li ọkunrin na yio bọ́ kuro ninu aiṣedede, obinrin na yio si rù aiṣedede ara rẹ̀.
entries.en: Then shall the man be guiltless from iniquity, and this woman shall bear her iniquity.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Sọ fun awọn ọmọ Israeli, ki o si wi fun wọn pe, Nigbati ọkunrin kan tabi obinrin kan ba yà ara wọn sapakan lati ṣe ileri ti Nasiri, lati yà ara wọn si OLUWA:
entries.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When either man or woman shall separate themselves to vow a vow of a Nazarite, to separate themselves unto the LORD:

entries.yo: Ki o yà ara rẹ̀ kuro ninu ọti-waini tabi ọti lile; ki o má si ṣe mu ọti-waini kikan, tabi ọti lile ti o kan, ki o má si ṣe mu ọti eso-àjara kan, bẹ̃ni kò gbọdọ jẹ eso-àjara tutù tabi gbigbẹ.
entries.en: He shall separate himself from wine and strong drink, and shall drink no vinegar of wine, or vinegar of strong drink, neither shall he drink any liquor of grapes, nor eat moist grapes, or dried.

entries.yo: Ni gbogbo ọjọ́ ìyasapakan rẹ̀ ni ki o gbọdọ jẹ ohun kan ti a fi eso-àjara ṣe, lati kóro rẹ̀ titi dé ẽpo rẹ̀.
entries.en: All the days of his separation shall he eat nothing that is made of the vine tree, from the kernels even to the husk.

entries.yo: Ni gbogbo ọjọ́ ileri ìyasapakan rẹ̀, ki abẹ kan máṣe kàn a li ori: titi ọjọ́ wọnni yio fi pé, ninu eyiti o yà ara rẹ̀ si OLUWA, ki o jẹ́ mimọ́, ki o si jẹ ki ìdi irun ori rẹ̀ ki o ma dàgba.
entries.en: All the days of the vow of his separation there shall no rasor come upon his head: until the days be fulfilled, in the which he separateth himself unto the LORD, he shall be holy, and shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow.

entries.yo: Ni gbogbo ọjọ́ ti o yà ara rẹ̀ si OLUWA, on kò gbọdọ sunmọ okú.
entries.en: All the days that he separateth himself unto the LORD he shall come at no dead body.

entries.yo: On kò gbọdọ sọ ara rẹ̀ di alaimọ́ nitori baba rẹ̀, tabi nitori iya rẹ̀, nitori arakunrin rẹ̀, tabi nitori arabinrin rẹ̀, nigbati nwọn ba kú: nitoripe ìyasapakan Ọlọrun rẹ̀ mbẹ li ori rẹ̀.
entries.en: He shall not make himself unclean for his father, or for his mother, for his brother, or for his sister, when they die: because the consecration of his God is upon his head.

entries.yo: Ni gbogbo ọjọ́ ìyasapakan rẹ̀, mimọ́ li on fun OLUWA.
entries.en: All the days of his separation he is holy unto the LORD.

entries.yo: Bi enia kan ba si kú lojiji lẹba ọdọ rẹ̀, ti o ba si bà ori ìyasapakan rẹ̀ jẹ́; nigbana ni ki o fá ori rẹ̀ li ọjọ́ ìwẹnumọ́ rẹ̀, ni ijọ́ keje ni ki o fá a.
entries.en: And if any man die very suddenly by him, and he hath defiled the head of his consecration; then he shall shave his head in the day of his cleansing, on the seventh day shall he shave it.

entries.yo: Ati ni ijọ́ kẹjọ ki o mú àdaba meji, tabi ọmọ ẹiyẹle meji tọ̀ alufa wá, si ẹnu-ọ̀na agọ́ ajọ:
entries.en: And on the eighth day he shall bring two turtles, or two young pigeons, to the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:

entries.yo: Ki alufa ki o si ru ọkan li ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ, ati ekeji li ẹbọ sisun, ki o si ṣètutu fun u, nitoriti o ṣẹ̀ nipa okú, ki o si yà ori rẹ̀ simimọ́ li ọjọ́ na.
entries.en: And the priest shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, and make an atonement for him, for that he sinned by the dead, and shall hallow his head that same day.

entries.yo: Ki o si yà ọjọ́ ìyasapakan rẹ̀ simimọ́ si OLUWA, ki o si mú akọ ọdọ-agutan kan ọlọdún kan wá, fun ẹbọ ẹbi: ṣugbọn ọjọ́ ti o ti ṣaju yio di asan, nitoripe ìyasapakan rẹ̀ bàjẹ́.
entries.en: And he shall consecrate unto the LORD the days of his separation, and shall bring a lamb of the first year for a trespass offering: but the days that were before shall be lost, because his separation was defiled.

entries.yo: Eyi si li ofin ti Nasiri, nigbati ọjọ́ ìyasapakan rẹ̀ ba pé: ki a si mú u wá si ẹnu-ọ̀na agọ́ ajọ:
entries.en: And this is the law of the Nazarite, when the days of his separation are fulfilled: he shall be brought unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:

entries.yo: On o si mú ọrẹ-ẹbọ rẹ̀ wá fun OLUWA, akọ ọdọ-agutan kan ọlọdún kan alailabùkun fun ẹbọ sisun, ati abo ọdọ-agutan kan ọlọdún kan alailabùkun fun ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ, ati àgbo kan alailabùkun fun ẹbọ alafia.
entries.en: And he shall offer his offering unto the LORD, one he lamb of the first year without blemish for a burnt offering, and one ewe lamb of the first year without blemish for a sin offering, and one ram without blemish for peace offerings,

entries.yo: Ati agbọ̀n àkara alaiwu kan, àkara adidùn iyẹfun daradara ti a fi oróro pò, ati àkara fẹlẹfẹlẹ alaiwu ti a ta oróro si, ati ẹbọ ohunjijẹ wọn, ati ẹbọ ohunmimu wọn.
entries.en: And a basket of unleavened bread, cakes of fine flour mingled with oil, and wafers of unleavened bread anointed with oil, and their meat offering, and their drink offerings.

entries.yo: Ki alufa ki o mú wọn wá siwaju OLUWA, ki o si ru ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ̀ ati ẹbọ sisun rẹ̀:
entries.en: And the priest shall bring them before the LORD, and shall offer his sin offering, and his burnt offering:

entries.yo: Ki o si ru àgbo na li ẹbọ alafia si OLUWA, pẹlu agbọ̀n àkara alaiwu: ki alufa pẹlu ki o si ru ẹbọ ohunjijẹ rẹ̀, ati ẹbọ ohunmimu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he shall offer the ram for a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the LORD, with the basket of unleavened bread: the priest shall offer also his meat offering, and his drink offering.

entries.yo: Ki Nasiri na ki o fá ori ìyasapakan rẹ̀ li ẹnu-ọ̀na agọ́ àjọ, ki o si mú irun ori ìyasapakan rẹ̀ ki o si fi i sinu iná ti mbẹ labẹ ẹbọ alafia na.
entries.en: And the Nazarite shall shave the head of his separation at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall take the hair of the head of his separation, and put it in the fire which is under the sacrifice of the peace offerings.

entries.yo: Ki alufa ki o si mú apá bibọ̀ àgbo na, ati àkara adidùn kan alaiwu kuro ninu agbọ̀n na, ati àkara fẹlẹfẹlẹ kan alaiwu, ki o si fi wọn lé ọwọ́ Nasiri na, lẹhin ìgba ti a fá irun ori ìyasapakan rẹ̀ tán:
entries.en: And the priest shall take the sodden shoulder of the ram, and one unleavened cake out of the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and shall put them upon the hands of the Nazarite, after the hair of his separation is shaven:

entries.yo: Ki alufa ki o si fì wọn li ẹbọ fifì niwaju OLUWA: mimọ́ li eyi fun alufa na, pẹlu àiya fifì, ati itan agbesọsoke: lẹhin na Nasiri na le ma mu ọti-waini.
entries.en: And the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before the LORD: this is holy for the priest, with the wave breast and heave shoulder: and after that the Nazarite may drink wine.

entries.yo: Eyi li ofin ti Nasiri ti o ṣe ileri, ati ti ọrẹ-ẹbọ rẹ̀ si OLUWA fun ìyasapakan rẹ̀ li àika eyiti ọwọ́ on le tẹ̀: gẹgẹ bi ileri ti o ṣe, bẹ̃ni ki o ṣe nipa ofin ìyasapakan rẹ̀.
entries.en: This is the law of the Nazarite who hath vowed, and of his offering unto the LORD for his separation, beside that that his hand shall get: according to the vow which he vowed, so he must do after the law of his separation.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Sọ fun Aaroni ati fun awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ pe, Bayi li ẹnyin o ma sure fun awọn ọmọ Israeli; ki ẹ ma wi fun wọn pe,
entries.en: Speak unto Aaron and unto his sons, saying, On this wise ye shall bless the children of Israel, saying unto them,

entries.yo: Ki OLUWA ki o busi i fun ọ, ki o si pa ọ mọ́:
entries.en: The LORD bless thee, and keep thee:

entries.yo: Ki OLUWA ki o mu oju rẹ̀ mọlẹ si ọ lara, ki o si ṣãnu fun ọ:
entries.en: The LORD make his face shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee:

entries.yo: Ki OLUWA ki o ma bojuwò ọ, ki o si ma fun ọ ni alafia.
entries.en: The LORD lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee peace.

entries.yo: Bayi ni nwọn o fi orukọ mi sara awọn ọmọ Israeli; emi o si busi i fun wọn.
entries.en: And they shall put my name upon the children of Israel; and I will bless them.

entries.yo: OSI ṣe li ọjọ́ na ti Mose gbé agọ́ na ró tán, ti o si ta oróro si i ti o si yà a simimọ́, ati gbogbo ohun-èlo rẹ̀, ati pẹpẹ na ati gbogbo ohun-èlo rẹ̀, ti o si ta oróro si wọn, ti o si yà wọn simimọ́;
entries.en: And it came to pass on the day that Moses had fully set up the tabernacle, and had anointed it, and sanctified it, and all the instruments thereof, both the altar and all the vessels thereof, and had anointed them, and sanctified them;

entries.yo: Ni awọn ijoye Israeli, awọn olori ile baba wọn, awọn olori ẹ̀ya wọnni, ti iṣe olori awọn ti a kà, mú ọrẹ wá:
entries.en: That the princes of Israel, heads of the house of their fathers, who were the princes of the tribes, and were over them that were numbered, offered:

entries.yo: Nwọn si mú ọrẹ-ẹbọ wọn wá siwaju OLUWA, kẹkẹ́-ẹrù mẹfa ti a bò, ati akọmalu mejila; kẹkẹ́-ẹrù kan fun ijoye meji, ati akọmalu kan fun ọkọkan: nwọn si mú wọn wá siwaju agọ́ ajọ.
entries.en: And they brought their offering before the LORD, six covered wagons, and twelve oxen; a wagon for two of the princes, and for each one an ox: and they brought them before the tabernacle.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Gbà a lọwọ wọn, ki nwọn ki o le jẹ́ ati fi ṣe iṣẹ-ìsin agọ́ ajọ; ki iwọ ki o si fi wọn fun awọn ọmọ Lefi, fun olukuluku gẹgẹ bi iṣẹ-ìsin rẹ̀.
entries.en: Take it of them, that they may be to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation; and thou shalt give them unto the Levites, to every man according to his service.

entries.yo: Mose si gbà kẹkẹ́-ẹrù wọnni, ati akọmalu, o si fi wọn fun awọn ọmọ Lefi.
entries.en: And Moses took the wagons and the oxen, and gave them unto the Levites.

entries.yo: Kẹkẹ́-ẹrù meji ati akọmalu mẹrin, li o fi fun awọn ọmọ Gerṣoni, gẹgẹ bi iṣẹ-ìsin wọn:
entries.en: Two wagons and four oxen he gave unto the sons of Gershon, according to their service:

entries.yo: Ati kẹkẹ́-ẹrù mẹrin ati akọmalu mẹjọ li o fi fun awọn ọmọ Merari, gẹgẹ bi iṣẹ-ìsin wọn, li ọwọ́ Itamari ọmọ Aaroni alufa.
entries.en: And four wagons and eight oxen he gave unto the sons of Merari, according unto their service, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn kò fi fun awọn ọmọ Kohati: nitoripe iṣẹ-ìsin ibi-mimọ́ ni ti wọn; li ohun ti nwọn o ma fi ejika rù.
entries.en: But unto the sons of Kohath he gave none: because the service of the sanctuary belonging unto them was that they should bear upon their shoulders.

entries.yo: Awọn olori si mú ọrẹ wá fun ìyasimimọ́ pẹpẹ li ọjọ́ ti a ta oróro si i, ani awọn olori mú ọrẹ-ẹbọ wọn wá siwaju pẹpẹ na.
entries.en: And the princes offered for dedicating of the altar in the day that it was anointed, even the princes offered their offering before the altar.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun Mose pe, Ki nwọn ki o ma mú ọrẹ-ẹbọ wọn wá, olukuluku olori li ọjọ́ tirẹ̀ fun ìyasimimọ̀ pẹpẹ.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, They shall offer their offering, each prince on his day, for the dedicating of the altar.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o si mú ọrẹ-ẹbọ tirẹ̀ wá li ọjọ́ kini ni Naṣoni ọmọ Amminadabu, ti ẹ̀ya Juda.
entries.en: And he that offered his offering the first day was Nahshon the son of Amminadab, of the tribe of Judah:

entries.yo: Ọrẹ-ẹbọ tirẹ̀ si jẹ́ awopọkọ kan ti fadakà, ìwọn rẹ̀ ãdoje ṣekeli, awokòto kan ti fadakà ãdọrin ṣekeli, gẹgẹ bi ṣekeli ibi-mimọ́; mejeji wọn kún fun iyẹfun daradara ti a fi oróro pò, fun ẹbọ ohunjijẹ;
entries.en: And his offering was one silver charger, the weight thereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them were full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:

entries.yo: Ṣibi kan ìwọn ṣekeli mẹwa wurà, o kún fun turari;
entries.en: One spoon of ten shekels of gold, full of incense:

entries.yo: Ẹgbọrọ akọmalu kan, àgbo kan, akọ ọdọ-agutan kan ọlọdún kan, fun ẹbọ sisun;
entries.en: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:

entries.yo: Akọ ewurẹ kan fun ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ;
entries.en: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:

entries.yo: Ati fun ẹbọ ti ẹbọ alafia, akọmalu meji, àgbo marun, obukọ marun, akọ ọdọ-agutan marun ọlọdún kan: eyi li ọrẹ-ẹbọ ti Naṣoni ọmọ Amminadabu.
entries.en: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ́ keji ni Netaneeli ọmọ Suari, olori ti Issakari mú ọrẹ wá:
entries.en: On the second day Nethaneel the son of Zuar, prince of Issachar, did offer:

entries.yo: On múwa fun ọrẹ-ẹbọ tirẹ̀ awopọkọ kan ti fadakà, ìwọn rẹ̀ jẹ́ ãdoje ṣekeli, awokòto kan ti fadakà ãdọrin ṣekeli, gẹgẹ bi ṣekeli ibi-mimọ́; mejeji wọn kún fun iyẹfun daradara ti a fi oróro pò, fun ẹbọ ohunjijẹ:
entries.en: He offered for his offering one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:

entries.yo: Ṣibi kan ìwọn ṣekeli mẹwa wurà, o kún fun turari;
entries.en: One spoon of gold of ten shekels, full of incense:

entries.yo: Ẹgbọrọ akọmalu kan, àgbo kan, akọ ọdọ-agutan kan ọlọdún kan, fun ẹbọ sisun;
entries.en: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:

entries.yo: Akọ ewurẹ kan fun ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ;
entries.en: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:

entries.yo: Ati fun ẹbọ ti ẹbọ alafia, akọmalu meji, àgbo marun, obukọ marun, akọ ọdọ-agutan marun ọlọdún kan: eyi li ọrẹ-ẹbọ ti Netaneeli ọmọ Suari.
entries.en: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Nethaneel the son of Zuar.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ́ kẹta Eliabu ọmọ Heloni, olori awọn ọmọ Sebuluni:
entries.en: On the third day Eliab the son of Helon, prince of the children of Zebulun, did offer:

entries.yo: Ọrẹ-ẹbọ tirẹ̀ jẹ́ awopọkọ kan ti fadakà, ìwọn rẹ̀ jẹ́ ãdoje ṣekeli, awokòto kan ti fadakà ãdọrin ṣekeli, gẹgẹ bi ṣekeli ibi-mimọ́; mejeji wọn kún fun iyẹfun daradara ti a fi oróro pò, fun ẹbọ ohunjijẹ;
entries.en: His offering was one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:

entries.yo: Ṣibi kan ìwọn ṣekeli mẹwa wurà, o kún fun turari;
entries.en: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:

entries.yo: Ẹgbọrọ akọmalu kan, àgbo kan, akọ ọdọ-agutan kan ọlọdún kan, fun ẹbọ sisun;
entries.en: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:

entries.yo: Akọ ewurẹ kan fun ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ;
entries.en: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:

entries.yo: Ati fun ẹbọ ti ẹbọ alafia, akọmalu meji, àgbo marun, obukọ marun, akọ ọdọ-agutan marun ọlọdún kan: eyi li ọrẹ-ẹbọ ti Eliabu ọmọ Heloni.
entries.en: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Eliab the son of Helon.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ́ kẹrin Elisuri ọmọ Ṣedeuri, olori awọn ọmọ Reubeni;
entries.en: On the fourth day Elizur the son of Shedeur, prince of the children of Reuben, did offer:

entries.yo: Ọrẹ-ẹbọ tirẹ̀ jẹ̀ awopọkọ kan ti fadakà, ìwọn rẹ̀ jẹ́ ãdoje ṣekeli, awokòto kan ti fadakà ãdọrin ṣekeli, gẹgẹ bi ṣekeli ibi-mimọ́; mejeji wọn kún fun iyẹfun daradara ti a fi oróro pò fun ẹbọ ohunjijẹ;
entries.en: His offering was one silver charger of the weight of an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:

entries.yo: Ṣibi kan ìwọn ṣekeli mẹwa wurà, o kún fun turari;
entries.en: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:

entries.yo: Ẹgbọrọ akọmalu kan, àgbo kan, akọ ọdọ-agutan kan ọlọdún kan, fun ẹbọ sisun;
entries.en: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:

entries.yo: Akọ ewurẹ kan fun ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ;
entries.en: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:

entries.yo: Ati fun ẹbọ ti ẹbọ alafia, akọmalu meji, àgbo marun, obukọ marun, akọ ọdọ-agutan marun ọlọdún kan: eyi li ọrẹ-ẹbọ ti Elisuri ọmọ Ṣedeuri.
entries.en: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Elizur the son of Shedeur.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ́ karun Ṣelumieli ọmọ Suriṣuddai, olori awọn ọmọ Simeoni:
entries.en: On the fifth day Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai, prince of the children of Simeon, did offer:

entries.yo: Ọrẹ-ẹbọ tirẹ̀ jẹ́ awopọkọ kan ti fadakà, ìwọn rẹ̀ jẹ́ ãdoje ṣekeli, awokòto kan ti fadakà ãdọrin ṣekeli, gẹgẹ bi ṣekeli ibi-mimọ́; mejeji wọn kún fun iyẹfun daradara ti a fi oróro pò fun ẹbọ ohunjijẹ;
entries.en: His offering was one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:

entries.yo: Ṣibi kan ìwọn ṣekeli mẹwa wurà, o kún fun turari;
entries.en: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:

entries.yo: Ẹgbọrọ akọmalu kan, àgbo kan, akọ ọdọ-agutan kan ọlọdún kan, fun ẹbọ sisun;
entries.en: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:

entries.yo: Akọ ewurẹ kan fun ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ;
entries.en: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:

entries.yo: Ati fun ẹbọ ti ẹbọ alafia, akọmalu meji, àgbo marun, obukọ marun, akọ ọdọ-agutan marun ọlọdún kan: eyi li ọrẹ-ẹbọ Ṣelumieli ọmọ Ṣuriṣaddai.
entries.en: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ́ kẹfa Eliasafu ọmọ Deueli, olori awọn ọmọ Gadi:
entries.en: On the sixth day Eliasaph the son of Deuel, prince of the children of Gad, offered:

entries.yo: Ọrẹ-ẹbọ tirẹ̀ jẹ́ awopọkọ kan ti fadakà, ìwọn rẹ̀ jẹ́ ãdoje ṣekeli, awokòto kan ti fadakà ãdọrin ṣekeli, gẹgẹ bi ṣekeli ibi-mimọ́; mejeji wọn kún fun iyẹfun daradara ti a fi oróro pò fun ẹbọ ohunjijẹ;
entries.en: His offering was one silver charger of the weight of an hundred and thirty shekels, a silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:

entries.yo: Ṣibi kan ìwọn ṣekeli mẹwa wurà, o kún fun turari;
entries.en: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:

entries.yo: Ẹgbọrọ akọmalu kan, àgbo kan, akọ ọdọ-agutan kan ọlọdún kan, fun ẹbọ sisun;
entries.en: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:

entries.yo: Akọ ewure kan fun ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ;
entries.en: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:

entries.en: On the eleventh day Pagiel the son of Ocran, prince of the children of Asher, offered:

entries.yo: Ọrẹ-ẹbọ tirẹ̀ jẹ́ awopọkọ kan ti fadakà, ìwọn rẹ̀ jẹ́ ãdoje ṣekeli, awokòto kan ti fadakà ìwọn ãdọrin ṣekeli, gẹgẹ bi ṣekeli ibi-mimọ́; mejeji wọn kún fun iyẹfun daradara ti a fi oróro pò, fun ẹbọ ohunjijẹ;

entries.yo: Li ọjọ́ kejila Ahira ọmọ Enani, olori awọn ọmọ Naftali:
entries.en: On the twelfth day Ahira the son of Enan, prince of the children of Naphtali, offered:

entries.yo: Ọrẹ-ẹbọ tirẹ̀ jẹ̀ awopọkọ kan ti fadakà, ìwọn rẹ̀ jẹ́ ãdoje ṣekeli, awokòto kan ti fadakà ãdọrin ṣekeli, gẹgẹ bi ṣekeli ibi-mimọ́; mejeji wọn kún fun iyẹfun daradara ti a fi oróro pò, fun ẹbọ ohunjijẹ;
entries.en: His offering was one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:

entries.yo: Ṣibi kan ìwọn ṣekeli mẹwa wurà, o kún fun turari;
entries.en: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:

entries.yo: Ẹgbọrọ akọmalu kan, àgbo kan, akọ ọdọ-agutan kan ọlọdún kan, fun ẹbọ sisun;

entries.en: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:

entries.en: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Ahira the son of Enan.

entries.yo: Eyi ni ìyasimimọ́ pẹpẹ, li ọjọ́ ti a ta oróro si i, lati ọwọ́ awọn olori Israeli wá: awopọkọ fadakà mejila, awokòto fadakà mejila, ṣibi wurà mejila:
entries.en: This was the dedication of the altar, in the day when it was anointed, by the princes of Israel: twelve chargers of silver, twelve silver bowls, twelve spoons of gold:

entries.yo: Awopọkọ fadakà kọkan jẹ́ ãdoje ṣekeli: awokòto kọkan jẹ́ ãdọrin: gbogbo ohun-èlo fadakà jẹ́ egbejila ṣekeli, gẹgẹ bi ṣekeli ibi-mimọ́;
entries.en: Each charger of silver weighing an hundred and thirty shekels, each bowl seventy: all the silver vessels weighed two thousand and four hundred shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:

entries.yo: Ṣibi wurà jẹ́ mejila, nwọn kún fun turari, ṣibi kọkan jẹ́ ṣekeli mẹwa, gẹgẹ bi ṣekeli ibi-mimọ́; gbogbo wurà agọ́ na jẹ́ ọgọfa ṣekeli.
entries.en: The golden spoons were twelve, full of incense, weighing ten shekels apiece, after the shekel of the sanctuary: all the gold of the spoons was an hundred and twenty shekels.

entries.yo: Gbogbo akọmalu fun ẹbọ sisun jẹ́ ẹgbọrọ akọmalu mejila, àgbo mejila, akọ ọdọ-agutan ọlọdún kan mejila, pẹlu ẹbọ ohunjijẹ wọn: ati akọ ewurẹ fun ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ, mejila.
entries.en: All the oxen for the burnt offering were twelve bullocks, the rams twelve, the lambs of the first year twelve, with their meat offering: and the kids of the goats for sin offering twelve.

entries.yo: Ati gbogbo akọmalu fun ẹbọ ti ẹbọ alafia jẹ́ akọmalu mẹrinlelogun, àgbo ọgọta, obukọ ọgọta, akọ ọdọ-agutan ọlọdún kan ọgọta. Eyi ni ìyasimimọ́ pẹpẹ, lẹhin igbati a ta oróro si i.
entries.en: And all the oxen for the sacrifice of the peace offerings were twenty and four bullocks, the rams sixty, the he goats sixty, the lambs of the first year sixty. This was the dedication of the altar, after that it was anointed.

entries.yo: Nigbati Mose si wọ̀ inu agọ́ ajọ lọ lati bá a (Ọlọrun) sọ̀rọ, nigbana li o gbọ́ ohùn ti nfọ̀ si i lati ori itẹ́-ãnu nì wá ti mbẹ lori apoti ẹrí, lati agbedemeji awọn kerubu meji nì wá: o si bá a sọ̀rọ.
entries.en: And when Moses was gone into the tabernacle of the congregation to speak with him, then he heard the voice of one speaking unto him from off the mercy seat that was upon the ark of testimony, from between the two cherubims: and he spake unto him.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pẹ,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Sọ fun Aaroni, ki o si wi fun u pe, Nigbati iwọ ba tàn fitila, ki fitila mejeje na ki o ma tàn imọlẹ lori ọpá-fitila.
entries.en: Speak unto Aaron, and say unto him, When thou lightest the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light over against the candlestick.

entries.yo: Aaroni si ṣe bẹ̃; o tàn fitila wọnni lori ọpá-fitila na, bi OLUWA ti paṣẹ fun Mose.
entries.en: And Aaron did so; he lighted the lamps thereof over against the candlestick, as the LORD commanded Moses.

entries.yo: Iṣẹ ọpá-fitila na yi si jẹ̀ ti wurà lilù; titi dé isalẹ rẹ̀, titi dé itanna rẹ̀, o jẹ́ iṣẹ lulù: gẹgẹ bi apẹrẹ ti OLUWA fihàn Mose, bẹ̃li o ṣe ọpá-fitila na.
entries.en: And this work of the candlestick was of beaten gold, unto the shaft thereof, unto the flowers thereof, was beaten work: according unto the pattern which the LORD had shewed Moses, so he made the candlestick.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Yọ awọn ọmọ Lefi kuro ninu awọn ọmọ Israeli, ki o si wẹ̀ wọn mọ́.
entries.en: Take the Levites from among the children of Israel, and cleanse them.

entries.yo: Bayi ni ki iwọ ki o si ṣe si wọn, lati wẹ̀ wọn mọ́; Wọn omi etutu si wọn lara, ki nwọn ki o si fá gbogbo ara wọn, ki nwọn ki o si fọ̀ aṣọ wọn, ki nwọn ki o si wẹ̀ ara wọn mọ́.
entries.en: And thus shalt thou do unto them, to cleanse them: Sprinkle water of purifying upon them, and let them shave all their flesh, and let them wash their clothes, and so make themselves clean.

entries.yo: Ki nwọn ki o si mú ẹgbọrọ akọmalu kan pẹlu ẹbọ ohunjijẹ rẹ̀, ani iyẹfun daradara ti a fi oróro pò, ati ẹgbọrọ akọmalu keji ni ki iwọ ki o mú fun ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ.
entries.en: Then let them take a young bullock with his meat offering, even fine flour mingled with oil, and another young bullock shalt thou take for a sin offering.

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o si mú awọn ọmọ Lefi wá siwaju agọ́ ajọ: ki iwọ ki o si pe gbogbo ijọ awọn ọmọ Israeli jọ pọ̀:
entries.en: And thou shalt bring the Levites before the tabernacle of the congregation: and thou shalt gather the whole assembly of the children of Israel together:

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o si mú awọn ọmọ Lefi wá siwaju OLUWA: ki awọn ọmọ Israeli ki o si fi ọwọ́ wọn lé awọn ọmọ Lefi.
entries.en: And thou shalt bring the Levites before the LORD: and the children of Israel shall put their hands upon the Levites:

entries.yo: Ki Aaroni ki o si mú awọn ọmọ Lefi wá siwaju OLUWA, bi ọrẹ fifì lati ọdọ awọn ọmọ Israeli wá, ki nwọn ki o le ma ṣe iṣẹ-ìsin OLUWA.
entries.en: And Aaron shall offer the Levites before the LORD for an offering of the children of Israel, that they may execute the service of the LORD.

entries.yo: Ki awọn ọmọ Lefi ki o si fi ọwọ́ wọn lé ori ẹgbọrọ akọmalu wọnni: ki iwọ ki o si ru ọkan li ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ, ati ekeji li ẹbọ sisun si OLUWA, lati ṣètutu fun awọn ọmọ Lefi.
entries.en: And the Levites shall lay their hands upon the heads of the bullocks: and thou shalt offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, unto the LORD, to make an atonement for the Levites.

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o si mu awọn ọmọ Lefi duro niwaju Aaroni, ati niwaju awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, ki o si mú wọn wá li ọrẹ fifì fun OLUWA.
entries.en: And thou shalt set the Levites before Aaron, and before his sons, and offer them for an offering unto the LORD.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni ki iwọ ki o yà awọn ọmọ Lefi sọ̀tọ kuro lãrin awọn ọmọ Israeli: awọn ọmọ Lefi yio si jẹ́ ti emi.
entries.en: Thus shalt thou separate the Levites from among the children of Israel: and the Levites shall be mine.

entries.yo: Lẹhin eyinì li awọn ọmọ Lefi yio ma wọ̀ inu ile lọ lati ṣe iṣẹ-ìsin agọ́ ajọ: ki iwọ ki o si wẹ̀ wọn mọ́, ki o si mú wọn wá li ọrẹ fifì.
entries.en: And after that shall the Levites go in to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation: and thou shalt cleanse them, and offer them for an offering.

entries.yo: Nitoripe patapata li a fi wọn fun mi ninu awọn ọmọ Israeli; ni ipò gbogbo awọn ti o ṣí inu, ani gbogbo akọ́bi ninu awọn ọmọ Israeli, ni mo gbà wọn fun ara mi.
entries.en: For they are wholly given unto me from among the children of Israel; instead of such as open every womb, even instead of the firstborn of all the children of Israel, have I taken them unto me.

entries.yo: Nitoripe ti emi ni gbogbo akọ́bi ninu awọn ọmọ Israeli, ati ti enia ati ti ẹran: li ọjọ́ ti mo kọlù gbogbo akọ̀bi ni ilẹ Egipti ni mo ti yà wọn simimọ́ fun ara mi.
entries.en: For all the firstborn of the children of Israel are mine, both man and beast: on the day that I smote every firstborn in the land of Egypt I sanctified them for myself.

entries.yo: Emi si ti gbà awọn ọmọ Lefi dipò gbogbo akọ́bi ninu awọn ọmọ Israeli.
entries.en: And I have taken the Levites for all the firstborn of the children of Israel.

entries.yo: Emi si fi awọn ọmọ Lefi fun Aaroni ati fun awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ li ọrẹ lati inu awọn ọmọ Israeli wá, lati ma ṣe iṣẹ-ìsin awọn ọmọ Israeli ninu agọ́ ajọ, ati lati ma ṣètutu fun awọn ọmọ Israeli: ki àrun má ba sí ninu awọn ọmọ Israeli, nigbati awọn ọmọ Israeli ba sunmọ ibi-mimọ́.
entries.en: And I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and to his sons from among the children of Israel, to do the service of the children of Israel in the tabernacle of the congregation, and to make an atonement for the children of Israel: that there be no plague among the children of Israel, when the children of Israel come nigh unto the sanctuary.

entries.yo: Bayi ni Mose, ati Aaroni, ati gbogbo ijọ awọn ọmọ Israeli, ṣe si awọn ọmọ Lefi: gẹgẹ bi gbogbo eyiti OLUWA paṣẹ fun Mose niti awọn ọmọ Lefi, bẹ̃li awọn ọmọ Israeli ṣe si wọn.
entries.en: And Moses, and Aaron, and all the congregation of the children of Israel, did to the Levites according unto all that the LORD commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did the children of Israel unto them.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Lefi si wẹ̀ ara wọn mọ́ kuro ninu ẹ̀ṣẹ, nwọn si fọ̀ aṣọ wọn; Aaroni si mú wọn wá li ọrẹ fifì siwaju OLUWA: Aaroni si ṣètutu fun wọn lati wẹ̀ wọn mọ́.
entries.en: And the Levites were purified, and they washed their clothes; and Aaron offered them as an offering before the LORD; and Aaron made an atonement for them to cleanse them.

entries.yo: Lẹhin eyinì ni awọn ọmọ Lefi si wọle lọ lati ṣe iṣẹ-ìsin ninu agọ́ ajọ niwaju Aaroni, ati niwaju awọn ọmọ rẹ̀: bi OLUWA ti paṣẹ fun Mose niti awọn ọmọ Lefi, bẹ̃ni nwọn ṣe si wọn.
entries.en: And after that went the Levites in to do their service in the tabernacle of the congregation before Aaron, and before his sons: as the LORD had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did they unto them.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Eyi ni ti awọn ọmọ Lefi: lati ẹni ọdún mẹdọgbọ̀n lọ ati jù bẹ̃ lọ ni ki nwọn ki o ma wọle lọ lati ṣe iṣẹ-ìsin ninu agọ́ ajọ.
entries.en: This is it that belongeth unto the Levites: from twenty and five years old and upward they shall go in to wait upon the service of the tabernacle of the congregation:

entries.yo: Ati lati ẹni ãdọta ọdún ni ki nwọn ki o ṣiwọ iṣẹ-ìsin, ki nwọn ki o má si ṣe sìn mọ́;
entries.en: And from the age of fifty years they shall cease waiting upon the service thereof, and shall serve no more:

entries.yo: Bikoṣepe ki nwọn ki o ma ṣe iranṣẹ pẹlu awọn arakunrin wọn ninu agọ́ ajọ, lati ma ṣe itọju, ki nwọn ki o má si ṣe iṣẹ-ìsin mọ́. Bayi ni ki iwọ ki o ṣe si awọn ọmọ Lefi niti itọju wọn.
entries.en: But shall minister with their brethren in the tabernacle of the congregation, to keep the charge, and shall do no service. Thus shalt thou do unto the Levites touching their charge.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose ni ijù Sinai, li oṣù kini ọdún keji ti nwọn ti ilẹ Egipti jade wá, wipe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the first month of the second year after they were come out of the land of Egypt, saying,

entries.yo: Ki awọn ọmọ Israeli ki o si ma pa ajọ irekọja mọ́ li akokò rẹ̀.
entries.en: Let the children of Israel also keep the passover at his appointed season.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ́ kẹrinla oṣù yi, li aṣalẹ, ni ki ẹnyin ki o ma ṣe e li akokò rẹ̀: gẹgẹ bi aṣẹ rẹ̀ gbogbo, ati gẹgẹ bi ìlana rẹ̀ gbogbo, ni ki ẹnyin ki o pa a mọ́.
entries.en: In the fourteenth day of this month, at even, ye shall keep it in his appointed season: according to all the rites of it, and according to all the ceremonies thereof, shall ye keep it.

entries.yo: Mose si sọ fun awọn ọmọ Israeli ki nwọn ki o ma pa ajọ irekọja mọ́:
entries.en: And Moses spake unto the children of Israel, that they should keep the passover.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣe ajọ irekọja li ọjọ́ kẹrinla, oṣù kini, li aṣalẹ ni ijù Sinai: gẹgẹ bi gbogbo eyiti OLUWA paṣẹ fun Mose, bẹ̃li awọn ọmọ Israeli ṣe.
entries.en: And they kept the passover on the fourteenth day of the first month at even in the wilderness of Sinai: according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so did the children of Israel.

entries.yo: Awọn ọkunrin kan wà ti nwọn ti ipa okú ọkunrin kan di alaimọ́, nwọn kò si le ṣe ajọ irekọja li ọjọ́ na: nwọn si wá siwaju Mose ati siwaju Aaroni li ọjọ́ na:
entries.en: And there were certain men, who were defiled by the dead body of a man, that they could not keep the passover on that day: and they came before Moses and before Aaron on that day:

entries.yo: Awọn ọkunrin na si wi fun u pe, Awa ti ipa okú ọkunrin kan di alaimọ́: nitori kili a o ṣe fàsẹhin ti awa ki o le mú ọrẹ-ẹbọ OLUWA wá li akokò rẹ̀ pẹlu awọn ọmọ Israeli?
entries.en: And those men said unto him, We are defiled by the dead body of a man: wherefore are we kept back, that we may not offer an offering of the LORD in his appointed season among the children of Israel?

entries.yo: Mose si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ duro na; ki emi ki o le gbọ́ aṣẹ ti OLUWA yio pa niti nyin.
entries.en: And Moses said unto them, Stand still, and I will hear what the LORD will command concerning you.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Sọ fun awọn ọmọ Israeli pe, Bi ẹnikẹni ninu nyin, tabi ninu iran nyin, ba ti ipa okú di alaimọ́, tabi bi o ba wà li ọ̀na àjo jijìn rére, sibẹ̀ on o pa ajọ irekọja mọ́ fun OLUWA.
entries.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If any man of you or of your posterity shall be unclean by reason of a dead body, or be in a journey afar off, yet he shall keep the passover unto the LORD.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ́ kẹrinla oṣù keji li aṣalẹ ni ki nwọn ki o pa a mọ́; ki nwọn si fi àkara alaiwu jẹ ẹ ati ewebẹ kikorò:
entries.en: The fourteenth day of the second month at even they shall keep it, and eat it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.

entries.yo: Ki nwọn ki o máṣe kùsilẹ ninu rẹ̀ titi di owurọ̀, bẹ̃ni nwọn kò gbọdọ fọ́ egungun rẹ̀ kan: gẹgẹ bi gbogbo ìlana irekọja ni ki nwọn ki o ṣe e.
entries.en: They shall leave none of it unto the morning, nor break any bone of it: according to all the ordinances of the passover they shall keep it.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ọkunrin na ti o mọ́ ti kò si sí li ọ̀na àjo, ti o si fàsẹhin lati pa irekọja mọ́, ani ọkàn na li a o ke kuro ninu awọn enia rẹ̀: nitoriti kò mú ọrẹ-ẹbọ OLUWA wá li akokò rẹ̀, ọkunrin na yio rù ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: But the man that is clean, and is not in a journey, and forbeareth to keep the passover, even the same soul shall be cut off from among his people: because he brought not the offering of the LORD in his appointed season, that man shall bear his sin.

entries.yo: Bi alejò kan ba si nṣe atipo lọdọ nyin, ti o si nfẹ́ pa irekọja mọ́ fun OLUWA; gẹgẹ bi ìlana irekọja, ati gẹgẹ bi aṣẹ rẹ̀, ni ki o ṣe bẹ̃: ìlana kan ni ki ẹnyin ki o ní, ati fun alejò, ati fun ibilẹ.
entries.en: And if a stranger shall sojourn among you, and will keep the passover unto the LORD; according to the ordinance of the passover, and according to the manner thereof, so shall he do: ye shall have one ordinance, both for the stranger, and for him that was born in the land.

entries.yo: Ati li ọjọ́ ti a gbé agọ́ ró awọsanma si bò agọ́ na, eyinì ni, agọ́ ẹrí: ati li alẹ o si hàn lori agọ́ na bi iná, titi o fi di owurọ̀.
entries.en: And on the day that the tabernacle was reared up the cloud covered the tabernacle, namely, the tent of the testimony: and at even there was upon the tabernacle as it were the appearance of fire, until the morning.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li o si ri nigbagbogbo: awọsanma bò o, ati oye iná li oru.
entries.en: So it was alway: the cloud covered it by day, and the appearance of fire by night.

entries.yo: Nigbati awọsanma ba ká soke kuro lori agọ́ na, lẹhin na awọn ọmọ Israeli a si ṣí: nibiti awọsanma ba si duro, nibẹ̀ li awọn ọmọ Israeli idó si.
entries.en: And when the cloud was taken up from the tabernacle, then after that the children of Israel journeyed: and in the place where the cloud abode, there the children of Israel pitched their tents.

entries.yo: Nipa aṣẹ OLUWA awọn ọmọ Israeli a ṣí, nipa aṣẹ OLUWA nwọn a si dó: ni gbogbo ọjọ́ ti awọsanma ba simi lori agọ́ na, nwọn a dó.
entries.en: At the commandment of the LORD the children of Israel journeyed, and at the commandment of the LORD they pitched: as long as the cloud abode upon the tabernacle they rested in their tents.

entries.yo: Nigbati awọsanma ba si pẹ li ọjọ́ pupọ̀ lori agọ́ na, awọn ọmọ Israeli a si ma ṣe afiyesi aṣẹ OLUWA, nwọn ki si iṣi.
entries.en: And when the cloud tarried long upon the tabernacle many days, then the children of Israel kept the charge of the LORD, and journeyed not.

entries.yo: Nigba miran awọsanma a wà li ọjọ́ diẹ lori agọ́ na; nigbana gẹgẹ bi aṣẹ OLUWA nwọn a dó, gẹgẹ bi aṣẹ OLUWA nwọn a si ṣí.
entries.en: And so it was, when the cloud was a few days upon the tabernacle; according to the commandment of the LORD they abode in their tents, and according to the commandment of the LORD they journeyed.

entries.yo: Nigba miran awọsanma a duro lati alẹ titi di owurọ̀; nigbati awọsanma si ṣí soke li owurọ̀, nwọn a ṣí: iba ṣe li ọsán tabi li oru, ti awọsanma ba ká soke, nwọn a ṣí.
entries.en: And so it was, when the cloud abode from even unto the morning, and that the cloud was taken up in the morning, then they journeyed: whether it was by day or by night that the cloud was taken up, they journeyed.

entries.yo: Bi ijọ́ meji ni, tabi oṣù kan, tabi ọdún kan, ti awọsanma ba pẹ lori agọ́ na, ti o simi lé e, awọn ọmọ Israeli a dó, nwọn ki si iṣí: ṣugbọn nigbati o ba ká soke, nwọn a ṣí.
entries.en: Or whether it were two days, or a month, or a year, that the cloud tarried upon the tabernacle, remaining thereon, the children of Israel abode in their tents, and journeyed not: but when it was taken up, they journeyed.

entries.yo: Nipa aṣẹ OLUWA nwọn a dó, ati nipa aṣẹ OLUWA nwọn a ṣí: nwọn a ma ṣe afiyesi aṣẹ OLUWA, gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ OLUWA nipa ọwọ́ Mose.
entries.en: At the commandment of the LORD they rested in the tents, and at the commandment of the LORD they journeyed: they kept the charge of the LORD, at the commandment of the LORD by the hand of Moses.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Iwọ ṣe ipè fadakà meji; iṣẹ́-ọnà lilù ni ki o ṣe wọn: iwọ o si ma fi wọn pè ajọ, iwọ o si ma fi wọn ṣí ibudó.
entries.en: Make thee two trumpets of silver; of a whole piece shalt thou make them: that thou mayest use them for the calling of the assembly, and for the journeying of the camps.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn ba fun wọn, ki gbogbo ijọ ki o pé sọdọ rẹ li ẹnu-ọ̀na agọ́ ajọ.
entries.en: And when they shall blow with them, all the assembly shall assemble themselves to thee at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

entries.yo: Bi o ba ṣepe ipè kan ni nwọn fun, nigbana ni ki awọn ijoye, olori ẹgbẹgbẹrun enia Israeli, ki o pejọ sọdọ rẹ.
entries.en: And if they blow but with one trumpet, then the princes, which are heads of the thousands of Israel, shall gather themselves unto thee.

entries.yo: Nigbati ẹnyin ba si fun ipè idagiri, nigbana ni ki awọn ibudó ti o wà ni ìha ìla-õrùn ki o ṣí siwaju.
entries.en: When ye blow an alarm, then the camps that lie on the east parts shall go forward.

entries.yo: Nigbati ẹnyin ba si fun ipè idagiri nigba keji, nigbana ni ki awọn ibudó ti o wà ni ìha gusù ki o ṣì siwaju: ki nwọn ki o si fun ipè idagiri ṣíṣi wọn.
entries.en: When ye blow an alarm the second time, then the camps that lie on the south side shall take their journey: they shall blow an alarm for their journeys.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati a o ba pè ijọ pọ̀, ki ẹ fun ipè, ṣugbọn ẹ kò gbọdọ fun ti idagiri.
entries.en: But when the congregation is to be gathered together, ye shall blow, but ye shall not sound an alarm.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Aaroni, awọn alufa, ni ki o si fun ipè na; ki nwọn ki o si ma ṣe ìlana lailai fun nyin ni iran-iran nyin.
entries.en: And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow with the trumpets; and they shall be to you for an ordinance for ever throughout your generations.

entries.yo: Bi ẹnyin ba si lọ si ogun ni ilẹ nyin lọ ipade awọn ọtá ti nni nyin lara, nigbana ni ki ẹnyin ki o fi ipè fun idagiri; a o si ranti nyin niwaju OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin, a o si gbà nyin lọwọ awọn ọtá nyin.
entries.en: And if ye go to war in your land against the enemy that oppresseth you, then ye shall blow an alarm with the trumpets; and ye shall be remembered before the LORD your God, and ye shall be saved from your enemies.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ̀ ayọ̀ nyin pẹlu, ati li ajọ nyin, ati ni ìbẹrẹ oṣù nyin, ni ki ẹnyin ki o fun ipè sori ẹbọ sisun nyin, ati sori ẹbọ ti ẹbọ alafia nyin; ki nwọn ki o le ma ṣe iranti fun nyin niwaju Ọlọrun nyin: Emi ni OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin.
entries.en: Also in the day of your gladness, and in your solemn days, and in the beginnings of your months, ye shall blow with the trumpets over your burnt offerings, and over the sacrifices of your peace offerings; that they may be to you for a memorial before your God: I am the LORD your God.

entries.yo: O si ṣe li ogun ọjọ́ oṣù keji, li ọdún keji, ni awọsanma ká soke kuro lori agọ́ ẹrí.
entries.en: And it came to pass on the twentieth day of the second month, in the second year, that the cloud was taken up from off the tabernacle of the testimony.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Israeli si dide ìrin wọn lati ijù Sinai; awọsanma na si duro ni ijù Parani.
entries.en: And the children of Israel took their journeys out of the wilderness of Sinai; and the cloud rested in the wilderness of Paran.

entries.yo: Nwọn si bẹ̀rẹsi iṣí gẹgẹ bi aṣẹ OLUWA nipa ọwọ́ Mose.
entries.en: And they first took their journey according to the commandment of the LORD by the hand of Moses.

entries.yo: Ọpágun ibudó awọn ọmọ Juda si kọ́ ṣí gẹgẹ bi ogun wọn: olori ogun rẹ̀ si ni Naṣoni ọmọ Amminadabu.
entries.en: In the first place went the standard of the camp of the children of Judah according to their armies: and over his host was Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

entries.yo: Olori ogun ẹ̀ya awọn ọmọ Issakari si ni Netaneli ọmọ Suari.
entries.en: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Issachar was Nethaneel the son of Zuar.

entries.yo: Olori ogun ẹ̀ya awọn ọmọ Sebuluni ni Eliabu ọmọ Heloni.
entries.en: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Zebulun was Eliab the son of Helon.

entries.yo: A si tú agọ́ na palẹ; awọn ọmọ Gerṣoni, ati awọn ọmọ Merari ti nrù agọ́ si ṣí.
entries.en: And the tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari set forward, bearing the tabernacle.

entries.yo: Ọpágun ibudó Reubeni si ṣí gẹgẹ bi ogun wọn: Elisuri ọmọ Ṣedeuri si li olori ogun rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the standard of the camp of Reuben set forward according to their armies: and over his host was Elizur the son of Shedeur.

entries.yo: Ati olori ogun ẹ̀ya awọn ọmọ Simeoni ni Ṣelumieli ọmọ Suriṣaddai
entries.en: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Simeon was Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

entries.yo: Ati olori ogun ẹ̀ya awọn ọmọ Gadi ni Eliasafu ọmọ Deueli.
entries.en: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Gad was Eliasaph the son of Deuel.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Kohati ti nrù ohun mimọ́ si ṣí: awọn ti iṣaju a si ma gbé agọ́ ró dè atidé wọn.
entries.en: And the Kohathites set forward, bearing the sanctuary: and the other did set up the tabernacle against they came.

entries.yo: Ọpágun ibudó awọn ọmọ Efraimu si ṣí gẹgẹ bi ogun wọn: Eliṣama ọmọ Ammihudu si li olori ogun rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the standard of the camp of the children of Ephraim set forward according to their armies: and over his host was Elishama the son of Ammihud.

entries.yo: Ati olori ogun ẹ̀ya awọn ọmọ Manasse ni Gamalieli ọmọ Pedasuri.
entries.en: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Manasseh was Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

entries.yo: Ati olori ogun ẹ̀ya awọn ọmọ Benjamini ni Abidani ọmọ Gideoni.
entries.en: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Benjamin was Abidan the son of Gideoni.

entries.yo: Ọpágun ibudó awọn ọmọ Dani, ti o kẹhin gbogbo ibudó, si ṣí gẹgẹ bi ogun wọn: olori ogun rẹ̀ si ni Ahieseri ọmọ Ammiṣaddai.
entries.en: And the standard of the camp of the children of Dan set forward, which was the rereward of all the camps throughout their hosts: and over his host was Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

entries.yo: Ati olori ogun ẹ̀ya awọn ọmọ Aṣeri ni Pagieli ọmọ Okrani.
entries.en: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Asher was Pagiel the son of Ocran.

entries.yo: Ati olori ogun ẹ̀ya awọn ọmọ Naftali ni Ahira ọmọ Enani.
entries.en: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Naphtali was Ahira the son of Enan.

entries.yo: Bayi ni ìrin awọn ọmọ Israeli gẹgẹ bi ogun wọn; nwọn si ṣí.
entries.en: Thus were the journeyings of the children of Israel according to their armies, when they set forward.

entries.yo: Mose si wi fun Hobabu, ọmọ Ragueli ara Midiani, ana Mose pe, Awa nṣí lọ si ibi ti OLUWA ti wi pe, Emi o fi i fun nyin: wá ba wa lọ, awa o ṣe ọ li ore: nitoripe OLUWA sọ̀rọ rere nipa Israeli.
entries.en: And Moses said unto Hobab, the son of Raguel the Midianite, Moses' father in law, We are journeying unto the place of which the LORD said, I will give it you: come thou with us, and we will do thee good: for the LORD hath spoken good concerning Israel.

entries.yo: On si wi fun u pe, Emi ki yio lọ; ṣugbọn emi o pada lọ si ilẹ mi, ati sọdọ ará mi.
entries.en: And he said unto him, I will not go; but I will depart to mine own land, and to my kindred.

entries.yo: O si wipe, Máṣe fi wa silẹ, emi bẹ̀ ọ; iwọ sà mọ̀ pe ni ijù li awa dó si, iwọ o si ma ṣe oju fun wa.
entries.en: And he said, Leave us not, I pray thee; forasmuch as thou knowest how we are to encamp in the wilderness, and thou mayest be to us instead of eyes.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, bi iwọ ba bá wa lọ, yio si ṣe, pe, orekore ti OLUWA ba ṣe fun wa, on na li awa o ṣe fun ọ.
entries.en: And it shall be, if thou go with us, yea, it shall be, that what goodness the LORD shall do unto us, the same will we do unto thee.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣí kuro ni òke OLUWA ni ìrin ijọ́ mẹta: apoti majẹmu OLUWA si ṣiwaju wọn ni ìrin ijọ́ mẹta, lati wá ibi isimi fun wọn.
entries.en: And they departed from the mount of the LORD three days' journey: and the ark of the covenant of the LORD went before them in the three days' journey, to search out a resting place for them.

entries.yo: Awọsanma OLUWA mbẹ lori wọn li ọsán, nigbati nwọn ba ṣí kuro ninu ibudó.
entries.en: And the cloud of the LORD was upon them by day, when they went out of the camp.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati apoti ẹrí ba ṣí siwaju, Mose a si wipe, Dide, OLUWA, ki a si tú awọn ọtá rẹ ká; ki awọn ti o korira rẹ ki o si salọ kuro niwaju rẹ.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when the ark set forward, that Moses said, Rise up, LORD, and let thine enemies be scattered; and let them that hate thee flee before thee.

entries.yo: Nigbati o ba si simi, on a wipe, Pada, OLUWA, sọdọ ẹgbẹgbarun awọn enia Israeli.
entries.en: And when it rested, he said, Return, O LORD, unto the many thousands of Israel.

entries.yo: AWỌN enia na nṣe irahùn, nwọn nsọ ohun buburu li etí OLUWA: nigbati OLUWA si gbọ́ ọ, ibinu rẹ̀ si rú; iná OLUWA si ràn ninu wọn, o si run awọn ti o wà li opin ibudó na.
entries.en: And when the people complained, it displeased the LORD: and the LORD heard it; and his anger was kindled; and the fire of the LORD burnt among them, and consumed them that were in the uttermost parts of the camp.

entries.yo: Awọn enia na si kigbe tọ̀ Mose lọ; nigbati Mose si gbadura si OLUWA, iná na si rẹlẹ.
entries.en: And the people cried unto Moses; and when Moses prayed unto the LORD, the fire was quenched.

entries.yo: O si pè orukọ ibẹ̀ na ni Tabera: nitoriti iná OLUWA jó lãrin wọn.
entries.en: And he called the name of the place Taberah: because the fire of the LORD burnt among them.

entries.yo: Awọn adalú ọ̀pọ enia ti o wà pẹlu wọn ṣe ifẹkufẹ: awọn ọmọ Israeli pẹlu si tun sọkun wipe, Tani yio fun wa li ẹran jẹ?
entries.en: And the mixt multitude that was among them fell a lusting: and the children of Israel also wept again, and said, Who shall give us flesh to eat?

entries.yo: Awa ranti ẹja, ti awa ti njẹ ni Egipti li ọfẹ; ati apálà, ati bàra, ati ewebẹ, ati alubọsa, ati eweko:
entries.en: We remember the fish, which we did eat in Egypt freely; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlick:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nisisiyi ọkàn wa gbẹ: kò sí ohun kan rára, bikọse manna yi niwaju wa.
entries.en: But our soul is dried away: there is nothing at all, beside this manna, before our eyes.

entries.yo: Manna na si dabi irugbìn korianderi, àwọ rẹ̀ si dabi àwọ okuta-bedeliumu.
entries.en: And the manna was as coriander seed, and the colour thereof as the colour of bdellium.

entries.yo: Awọn enia na a ma lọ kakiri, nwọn a si kó o, nwọn a si lọ̀ ọ ninu ọlọ, tabi nwọn a si gún u ninu odó, nwọn a si sè e ninu ìkoko, nwọn a si fi din àkara: itọwò rẹ̀ si ri bi itọwò àkara oróro.
entries.en: And the people went about, and gathered it, and ground it in mills, or beat it in a mortar, and baked it in pans, and made cakes of it: and the taste of it was as the taste of fresh oil.

entries.yo: Nigbati ìri ba si sẹ̀ si ibudó li oru, manna a bọ́ si i.
entries.en: And when the dew fell upon the camp in the night, the manna fell upon it.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Mose gbọ́, awọn enia nsọkun ni idile wọn, olukuluku li ẹnu-ọ̀na agọ́ tirẹ̀: ibinu OLUWA si rú si wọn gidigidi; o si buru loju Mose.
entries.en: Then Moses heard the people weep throughout their families, every man in the door of his tent: and the anger of the LORD was kindled greatly; Moses also was displeased.

entries.yo: Mose si wi fun OLUWA pe, Nitori kini iwọ fi npọ́n iranṣẹ rẹ loju? nitori kili emi kò si ṣe ri ore-ọfẹ li oju rẹ, ti iwọ fi dì ẹrù gbogbo enia yi lé mi?
entries.en: And Moses said unto the LORD, Wherefore hast thou afflicted thy servant? and wherefore have I not found favour in thy sight, that thou layest the burden of all this people upon me?

entries.yo: Iṣe emi li o lóyun gbogbo enia yi? iṣe emi li o bi wọn, ti iwọ fi wi fun mi pe, Ma gbé wọn lọ li õkanaiya rẹ, bi baba iti igbé ọmọ ọmú, si ilẹ ti iwọ ti bura fun awọn baba wọn.
entries.en: Have I conceived all this people? have I begotten them, that thou shouldest say unto me, Carry them in thy bosom, as a nursing father beareth the sucking child, unto the land which thou swarest unto their fathers?

entries.yo: Nibo li emi o gbé ti mú ẹran wá fi fun gbogbo enia yi? nitoriti nwọn nsọkun si mi wipe, Fun wa li ẹran, ki awa ki o jẹ.
entries.en: Whence should I have flesh to give unto all this people? for they weep unto me, saying, Give us flesh, that we may eat.

entries.yo: Emi nikan kò le rù gbogbo awọn enia yi, nitoriti nwọn wuwo jù fun mi.
entries.en: I am not able to bear all this people alone, because it is too heavy for me.

entries.yo: Ati bi bayi ni iwọ o ṣe si mi, emi bẹ̀ ọ, pa mi kánkan, bi mo ba ri ore-ọfẹ li oju rẹ; má si ṣe jẹ ki emi ri òṣi mi.
