entries.en: And if thou deal thus with me, kill me, I pray thee, out of hand, if I have found favour in thy sight; and let me not see my wretchedness.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe, Pe ãdọrin ọkunrin ninu awọn àgba Israeli jọ sọdọ mi, ẹniti iwọ mọ̀ pe, nwọn ṣe àgba awọn enia, ati olori wọn; ki o si mú wọn wá si agọ́ ajọ, ki nwọn ki o si duro nibẹ̀ pẹlu rẹ.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Gather unto me seventy men of the elders of Israel, whom thou knowest to be the elders of the people, and officers over them; and bring them unto the tabernacle of the congregation, that they may stand there with thee.

entries.yo: Emi o si sọkalẹ wá, emi o si bá ọ sọ̀rọ nibẹ̀: emi o si mú ninu ẹmi ti mbẹ lara rẹ, emi o si fi i sara wọn; nwọn o si ma bá ọ rù ẹrù awọn enia na, ki iwọ ki o máṣe nikan rù u.
entries.en: And I will come down and talk with thee there: and I will take of the spirit which is upon thee, and will put it upon them; and they shall bear the burden of the people with thee, that thou bear it not thyself alone.

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o si wi fun awọn enia na pe, Ẹ yà ara nyin simimọ́ dè ọla, ẹnyin o si jẹ ẹran: nitoriti ẹnyin sọkun li etí OLUWA, wipe, Tani yio fun wa li ẹran jẹ? o sá dara fun wa ni Egipti: nitorina ni OLUWA yio ṣe fun nyin li ẹran, ẹnyin o si jẹ.
entries.en: And say thou unto the people, Sanctify yourselves against to morrow, and ye shall eat flesh: for ye have wept in the ears of the LORD, saying, Who shall give us flesh to eat? for it was well with us in Egypt: therefore the LORD will give you flesh, and ye shall eat.

entries.yo: Ẹ ki o jẹ ni ijọ́ kan, tabi ni ijọ́ meji, tabi ni ijọ́ marun, bẹ̃ni ki iṣe ijọ́ mẹwa, tabi ogún ọjọ́;
entries.en: Ye shall not eat one day, nor two days, nor five days, neither ten days, nor twenty days;

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn li oṣù kan tọ̀tọ, titi yio fi yọ jade ni ihò-imu nyin, ti yio si fi sú nyin: nitoriti ẹnyin gàn OLUWA ti mbẹ lãrin nyin, ẹnyin si sọkun niwaju rẹ̀, wipe, Ẽṣe ti awa fi jade lati Egipti wá?
entries.en: But even a whole month, until it come out at your nostrils, and it be loathsome unto you: because that ye have despised the LORD which is among you, and have wept before him, saying, Why came we forth out of Egypt?

entries.yo: Mose si wipe, Awọn enia na, lãrin awọn ẹniti emi wà, jẹ́ ọgbọ̀n ọkẹ ẹlẹsẹ̀; iwọ si wipe, Emi o fun wọn li ẹran, ki nwọn ki o le ma jẹ li oṣù kan tọ̀tọ.
entries.en: And Moses said, The people, among whom I am, are six hundred thousand footmen; and thou hast said, I will give them flesh, that they may eat a whole month.

entries.yo: Agbo-ẹran tabi ọwọ́-ẹran ni ki a pa fun wọn, lati tó fun wọn ni? tabi gbogbo ẹja okun li a o kójọ fun wọn lati tó fun wọn?
entries.en: Shall the flocks and the herds be slain for them, to suffice them? or shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to suffice them?

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe, Ọwọ́ OLUWA ha kúru bi? iwọ o ri i nisisiyi bi ọ̀rọ mi yio ṣẹ si ọ, tabi bi ki yio ṣẹ.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Is the LORD's hand waxed short? thou shalt see now whether my word shall come to pass unto thee or not.

entries.yo: Mose si jade lọ, o si sọ ọ̀rọ OLUWA fun awọn enia: o si pe ãdọrin ọkunrin ninu awọn àgba enia jọ, o si mu wọn duro yi agọ́ ká.
entries.en: And Moses went out, and told the people the words of the LORD, and gathered the seventy men of the elders of the people, and set them round about the tabernacle.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọkalẹ wá ninu awọsanma, o si bá a sọ̀rọ, o si mú ninu ẹmi ti o wà lara rẹ̀, o si fi i sara awọn ãdọrin àgba na: o si ṣe, nigbati ẹmi na bà lé wọn, nwọn sì sọtẹlẹ ṣugbọn nwọn kò ṣe bẹ̃ mọ́.
entries.en: And the LORD came down in a cloud, and spake unto him, and took of the spirit that was upon him, and gave it unto the seventy elders: and it came to pass, that, when the spirit rested upon them, they prophesied, and did not cease.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn o kù meji ninu awọn ọkunrin na ni ibudó, orukọ ekini a ma jẹ́ Eldadi, orukọ ekeji Medadi: ẹmi na si bà lé wọn; nwọn si mbẹ ninu awọn ti a kà, ṣugbọn nwọn kò jade lọ si agọ́: nwọn si nsọtẹlẹ ni ibudó.
entries.en: But there remained two of the men in the camp, the name of the one was Eldad, and the name of the other Medad: and the spirit rested upon them; and they were of them that were written, but went not out unto the tabernacle: and they prophesied in the camp.

entries.yo: Ọmọkunrin kan si súre, o si sọ fun Mose, o si wipe, Eldadi ati Medadi nsọtẹlẹ ni ibudó.
entries.en: And there ran a young man, and told Moses, and said, Eldad and Medad do prophesy in the camp.

entries.yo: Joṣua ọmọ Nuni, iranṣẹ Mose, ọkan ninu awọn ọmọkunrin rẹ̀ dahùn, o si wipe, Mose oluwa mi, dá wọn lẹkun.
entries.en: And Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Moses, one of his young men, answered and said, My lord Moses, forbid them.

entries.yo: Mose si wi fun u pe, Iwọ njowú nitori mi? gbogbo enia OLUWA iba le jẹ́ wolĩ, ki OLUWA ki o fi ẹmi rẹ̀ si wọn lara!
entries.en: And Moses said unto him, Enviest thou for my sake? would God that all the LORD's people were prophets, and that the LORD would put his spirit upon them!

entries.yo: Mose si lọ si ibudó, on ati awọn àgba Israeli.
entries.en: And Moses gat him into the camp, he and the elders of Israel.

entries.yo: Afẹfẹ kan si ti ọdọ OLUWA jade lọ, o si mú aparò lati okun wá, o si dà wọn si ibudó, bi ìwọn ìrin ijọ́ kan ni ìha ihin, ati bi ìwọn ìrin ijọ́ kan ni ìha ọhún yi ibudó ká, ni ìwọn igbọnwọ meji lori ilẹ.
entries.en: And there went forth a wind from the LORD, and brought quails from the sea, and let them fall by the camp, as it were a day's journey on this side, and as it were a day's journey on the other side, round about the camp, and as it were two cubits high upon the face of the earth.

entries.yo: Awọn enia si duro ni gbogbo ọjọ́ na, ati ni gbogbo oru na, ati ni gbogbo ọjọ́ keji, nwọn si nkó aparò: ẹniti o kó kére, kó òṣuwọn homeri mẹwa: nwọn si sá wọn silẹ fun ara wọn yi ibudó ká.
entries.en: And the people stood up all that day, and all that night, and all the next day, and they gathered the quails: he that gathered least gathered ten homers: and they spread them all abroad for themselves round about the camp.

entries.yo: Nigbati ẹran na si mbẹ lãrin ehín wọn, ki nwọn ki o tó jẹ ẹ, ibinu OLUWA si rú si awọn enia na, OLUWA si fi àrun nla gidigidi kọlù awọn enia na.
entries.en: And while the flesh was yet between their teeth, ere it was chewed, the wrath of the LORD was kindled against the people, and the LORD smote the people with a very great plague.

entries.yo: A si pè orukọ ibẹ̀ na ni Kibrotu-hattaafa: nitoripe nibẹ̀ ni nwọn gbé sinku awọn enia ti o ṣe ifẹkufẹ.
entries.en: And he called the name of that place Kibroth-hattaavah: because there they buried the people that lusted.

entries.yo: Awọn enia na si dide ìrin wọn lati Kibrotu-hattaafa lọ si Haserotu; nwọn si dó si Haserotu.
entries.en: And the people journeyed from Kibroth-hattaavah unto Hazeroth; and abode at Hazeroth.

entries.yo: A TI Miriamu ati Aaroni sọ̀rọ òdi si Mose nitori obinrin ara Etiopia ti o gbé ni iyawo: nitoripe o gbé obinrin ara Etiopia kan ni iyawo.
entries.en: And Miriam and Aaron spake against Moses because of the Ethiopian woman whom he had married: for he had married an Ethiopian woman.

entries.yo: Nwọn si wipe, Nipa Mose nikan ni OLUWA ha sọ̀rọ bi? kò ha ti ipa wa sọ̀rọ pẹlu? OLUWA si gbọ́ ọ.
entries.en: And they said, Hath the LORD indeed spoken only by Moses? hath he not spoken also by us? And the LORD heard it.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ọkunrin na Mose, o ṣe ọlọkàn tutù jù gbogbo enia lọ ti mbẹ lori ilẹ.
entries.en: (Now the man Moses was very meek, above all the men which were upon the face of the earth.)

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose, ati fun Aaroni, ati fun Miriamu li ojiji pe, Ẹnyin mẹtẹta ẹ jade wá si agọ́ ajọ. Awọn mẹtẹta si jade.
entries.en: And the LORD spake suddenly unto Moses, and unto Aaron, and unto Miriam, Come out ye three unto the tabernacle of the congregation. And they three came out.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọkalẹ wá ninu ọwọ̀n awọsanma, o si duro li ẹnu-ọ̀na agọ́ na, o si pè Aaroni ati Miriamu: awọn mejeji si jade wá.
entries.en: And the LORD came down in the pillar of the cloud, and stood in the door of the tabernacle, and called Aaron and Miriam: and they both came forth.

entries.yo: O si wipe, Ẹ gbọ́ ọ̀rọ mi nisisiyi: bi wolĩ OLUWA ba mbẹ ninu nyin, emi OLUWA yio farahàn fun u li ojuran, emi o si bá a sọ̀rọ li oju-alá.
entries.en: And he said, Hear now my words: If there be a prophet among you, I the LORD will make myself known unto him in a vision, and will speak unto him in a dream.

entries.yo: Mose iranṣẹ mi kò ri bẹ̃, olõtọ ni ninu gbogbo ile mi.
entries.en: My servant Moses is not so, who is faithful in all mine house.

entries.yo: On li emi mbá sọ̀rọ li ẹnu ko ẹnu, ati ni gbangba, ki si iṣe li ọ̀rọ ti o ṣe òkunkun; apẹrẹ OLUWA li on o si ri: njẹ nitori kili ẹnyin kò ṣe bẹ̀ru lati sọ̀rọ òdi si Mose iranṣẹ mi?
entries.en: With him will I speak mouth to mouth, even apparently, and not in dark speeches; and the similitude of the LORD shall he behold: wherefore then were ye not afraid to speak against my servant Moses?

entries.yo: Ibinu OLUWA si rú si wọn; o si lọ.
entries.en: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against them; and he departed.

entries.yo: Awọsanma si lọ kuro lori Agọ́ na; si kiyesi i, Miriamu di adẹ̀tẹ, o fun bi òjo didì; Aaroni si wò Miriamu, si kiyesi i, o di adẹ̀tẹ.
entries.en: And the cloud departed from off the tabernacle; and, behold, Miriam became leprous, white as snow: and Aaron looked upon Miriam, and, behold, she was leprous.

entries.yo: Aaroni si wi fun Mose pe, Yẽ, oluwa mi, emi bẹ̀ ọ, máṣe kà ẹ̀ṣẹ na si wa lọrùn, eyiti awa fi wère ṣe, ati eyiti awa ti dẹ̀ṣẹ.
entries.en: And Aaron said unto Moses, Alas, my lord, I beseech thee, lay not the sin upon us, wherein we have done foolishly, and wherein we have sinned.

entries.yo: Emi bẹ̀ ọ máṣe jẹ ki o dabi ẹniti o kú, ẹniti àbọ ara rẹ̀ run tán nigbati o ti inu iya rẹ̀ jade.
entries.en: Let her not be as one dead, of whom the flesh is half consumed when he cometh out of his mother's womb.

entries.yo: Mose si kigbe pè OLUWA, wipe, Ọlọrun, emi bẹ̀ ọ, mu u lara dá nisisiyi.
entries.en: And Moses cried unto the LORD, saying, Heal her now, O God, I beseech thee.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun Mose pe, Bi baba rẹ̀, tilẹ tu itọ si i li oju, njẹ oju ki ba tì i ni ijọ́ meje? Ki a sé e mọ́ ẹhin ibudó ni ijọ́ meje, lẹhin eyinì ki a gbà a sinu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, If her father had but spit in her face, should she not be ashamed seven days? let her be shut out from the camp seven days, and after that let her be received in again.

entries.yo: A si sé Miriamu mọ́ ẹhin ibudó ni ijọ́ meje: awọn enia kò si ṣí titi a fi gbà Miriamu pada.
entries.en: And Miriam was shut out from the camp seven days: and the people journeyed not till Miriam was brought in again.

entries.yo: Lẹhin eyinì li awọn enia si ṣí kuro ni Haserotu, nwọn si dó si ijù Parani.
entries.en: And afterward the people removed from Hazeroth, and pitched in the wilderness of Paran.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Rán enia, ki nwọn ki o si ṣe amí ilẹ Kenaani, ti mo fi fun awọn ọmọ Israeli: ọkunrin kan ni ki ẹnyin ki o rán ninu ẹ̀ya awọn baba wọn, ki olukuluku ki o jẹ́ ijoye ninu wọn.
entries.en: Send thou men, that they may search the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel: of every tribe of their fathers shall ye send a man, every one a ruler among them.

entries.yo: Mose si rán wọn lati ijù Parani lọ, gẹgẹ bi aṣẹ OLUWA: gbogbo awọn ọkunrin na jẹ́ olori awọn ọmọ Israeli.
entries.en: And Moses by the commandment of the LORD sent them from the wilderness of Paran: all those men were heads of the children of Israel.

entries.yo: Orukọ wọn si ni wọnyi: ninu ẹ̀ya Reubeni, Ṣammua ọmọ Sakuru.
entries.en: And these were their names: of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur.

entries.yo: Ninu ẹ̀ya Simeoni, Ṣafati ọmọ Hori.
entries.en: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori.

entries.yo: Ninu ẹ̀ya Juda, Kalebu ọmọ Jefunne.
entries.en: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

entries.yo: Ninu ẹ̀ya Issakari, Igali ọmọ Josefu.
entries.en: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph.

entries.yo: Ninu ẹ̀ya Efraimu, Oṣea ọmọ Nuni.
entries.en: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Oshea the son of Nun.

entries.yo: Ninu ẹ̀ya Benjamini, Palti ọmọ Rafu.
entries.en: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.

entries.yo: Ninu ẹ̀ya Sebuluni, Gaddieli ọmọ Sodi.
entries.en: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi.

entries.yo: Ninu ẹ̀ya Josefu, eyinì ni, ninu ẹ̀ya Manasse, Gadi ọmọ Susi.
entries.en: Of the tribe of Joseph, namely, of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.

entries.yo: Ninu ẹ̀ya Dani, Ammieli ọmọ Gemalli.
entries.en: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.

entries.yo: Ninu ẹ̀ya Aṣeri, Seturu ọmọ Mikaeli.
entries.en: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.

entries.yo: Ninu ẹ̀ya Naftali, Nabi ọmọ Fofsi.
entries.en: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi.

entries.yo: Ninu ẹ̀ya Gaddi, Geueli ọmọ Maki.
entries.en: Of the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.

entries.yo: Wọnyi li orukọ awọn ọkunrin na, ti Mose rán lati lọ ṣe amí ilẹ na. Mose si sọ Oṣea ọmọ Nuni ni Joṣua.
entries.en: These are the names of the men which Moses sent to spy out the land. And Moses called Oshea the son of Nun Jehoshua.

entries.yo: Mose si rán wọn lọ ṣe amí ilẹ Kenaani, o si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ gbà ọ̀na ìha gusù yi, ki ẹ sì lọ sori òke nì.
entries.en: And Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said unto them, Get you up this way southward, and go up into the mountain:

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin si wò ilẹ na, bi o ti ri; ati awọn enia ti ngbé inu rẹ̀, bi nwọn ṣe alagbara tabi alailagbara, bi diẹ ni nwọn, tabi pupọ̀;
entries.en: And see the land, what it is; and the people that dwelleth therein, whether they be strong or weak, few or many;

entries.yo: Ati bi ilẹ na ti nwọn ngbé ti ri, bi didara ni bi buburu ni; ati bi ilu ti nwọn ngbé ti ri, bi ninu agọ́ ni, tabi ninu ilu odi;
entries.en: And what the land is that they dwell in, whether it be good or bad; and what cities they be that they dwell in, whether in tents, or in strong holds;

entries.yo: Ati bi ilẹ na ti ri, bi ẹlẹtu ni tabi bi aṣalẹ̀, bi igi ba mbẹ ninu rẹ̀, tabi kò sí. Ki ẹnyin ki o si mu ọkàn le, ki ẹnyin si mú ninu eso ilẹ na wá. Njẹ ìgba na jẹ́ akokò pipọn akọ́so àjara.
entries.en: And what the land is, whether it be fat or lean, whether there be wood therein, or not. And be ye of good courage, and bring of the fruit of the land. Now the time was the time of the firstripe grapes.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni nwọn gòke lọ, nwọn si ṣe amí ilẹ na lati ijù Sini lọ dé Rehobu, ati lọ si Hamati.
entries.en: So they went up, and searched the land from the wilderness of Zin unto Rehob, as men come to Hamath.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ti ìha gusù gòke lọ, nwọn si dé Hebroni; nibiti Ahimani, Ṣeṣai, ati Talmai, awọn ọmọ Anaki gbé wà. (A ti tẹ̀ Hebroni dò li ọdún meje ṣaju Soani ni Egipti.)
entries.en: And they ascended by the south, and came unto Hebron; where Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)

entries.yo: Nwọn si dé odò Eṣkolu, nwọn si rẹ́ ọwọ́ àjara kan, ti on ti ìdi eso-àjara kan lati ibẹ̀ wá, awọn enia meji si fi ọpá rù u; nwọn si mú ninu eso-pomegranate, ati ti ọpọtọ́ wá.
entries.en: And they came unto the brook of Eshcol, and cut down from thence a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bare it between two upon a staff; and they brought of the pomegranates, and of the figs.

entries.yo: Nwọn si sọ ibẹ̀ na ni odò Eṣkolu, nitori ìdi-eso ti awọn ọmọ Israeli rẹ́ lati ibẹ̀ wá.
entries.en: The place was called the brook Eshcol, because of the cluster of grapes which the children of Israel cut down from thence.

entries.yo: Nwọn si pada ni rirìn ilẹ na wò lẹhin ogoji ọjọ́.
entries.en: And they returned from searching of the land after forty days.

entries.yo: Nwọn si lọ nwọn tọ̀ Mose wá, ati Aaroni, ati gbogbo ijọ awọn ọmọ Israeli, ni ijù Parani, ni Kadeṣi; nwọn si mú ọ̀rọ pada tọ̀ wọn wá, ati gbogbo ijọ, nwọn si fi eso ilẹ na hàn wọn.
entries.en: And they went and came to Moses, and to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word unto them, and unto all the congregation, and shewed them the fruit of the land.

entries.yo: Nwọn si rò fun u, nwọn si wipe, Awa dé ilẹ na nibiti iwọ gbé rán wa lọ, nitõtọ li o nṣàn fun warà ati fun oyin; eyi si li eso rẹ̀.
entries.en: And they told him, and said, We came unto the land whither thou sentest us, and surely it floweth with milk and honey; and this is the fruit of it.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn alagbara ni awọn enia ti ngbé inu ilẹ na, ilu olodi si ni ilu wọn, nwọn tobi gidigidi: ati pẹlupẹlu awa ri awọn ọmọ Anaki nibẹ̀.
entries.en: Nevertheless the people be strong that dwell in the land, and the cities are walled, and very great: and moreover we saw the children of Anak there.

entries.yo: Awọn ara Amaleki si ngbé ilẹ ìha gusù: ati awọn Hitti, ati awọn Jebusi, ati awọn Amori, ngbé ori-òke: awọn ara Kenaani si ngbé ẹba okun, ati ni àgbegbe Jordani.
entries.en: The Amalekites dwell in the land of the south: and the Hittites, and the Jebusites, and the Amorites, dwell in the mountains: and the Canaanites dwell by the sea, and by the coast of Jordan.

entries.yo: Kalebu si pa awọn enia lẹnu mọ́ niwaju Mose, o si wipe, Ẹ jẹ ki a gòke lọ lẹ̃kan, ki a si gbà a; nitoripe awa le ṣẹ́ ẹ.
entries.en: And Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, Let us go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn ọkunrin ti o bá a gòke lọ wipe, Awa kò le gòke tọ̀ awọn enia na lọ; nitoriti nwọn lagbara jù wa lọ.
entries.en: But the men that went up with him said, We be not able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.

entries.yo: Nwọn si mú ìhin buburu ti ilẹ na, ti nwọn ti ṣe amí wá fun awọn ọmọ Israeli, wipe, Ilẹ na ti awa là já lati ṣe amí rẹ̀, ilẹ ti imu awọn enia rẹ̀ jẹ ni; ati gbogbo enia ti awa ri ninu rẹ̀ jẹ́ enia ti o ṣigbọnlẹ.
entries.en: And they brought up an evil report of the land which they had searched unto the children of Israel, saying, The land, through which we have gone to search it, is a land that eateth up the inhabitants thereof; and all the people that we saw in it are men of a great stature.

entries.yo: Ati nibẹ̀ li awa gbé ri awọn omirán, awọn ọmọ Anaki ti o ti inu awọn omirán wá: awa si dabi ẹlẹnga li oju ara wa, bẹ̃li awa si ri li oju wọn.
entries.en: And there we saw the giants, the sons of Anak, which come of the giants: and we were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.

entries.yo: GBOGBO ijọ si gbé ohùn wọn soke, nwọn si ke: awọn enia na si sọkun li oru na.
entries.en: And all the congregation lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn ọmọ Israeli si nkùn si Mose ati si Aaroni: gbogbo ijọ si wi fun wọn pe, Awa iba kuku ti kú ni ilẹ Egipti! tabi awa iba kú li aginjù yi!
entries.en: And all the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron: and the whole congregation said unto them, Would God that we had died in the land of Egypt! or would God we had died in this wilderness!

entries.yo: Nitori kini OLUWA ṣe mú wa wá si ilẹ yi, lati ti ipa idà ṣubu? Awọn aya wa, ati awọn ọmọ wa yio di ijẹ: kò ha san fun wa ki a pada lọ si Egipti?
entries.en: And wherefore hath the LORD brought us unto this land, to fall by the sword, that our wives and our children should be a prey? were it not better for us to return into Egypt?

entries.yo: Nwọn si wi fun ara wọn pe, Ẹ jẹ ki a yàn olori, ki a si pada lọ si Egipti.
entries.en: And they said one to another, Let us make a captain, and let us return into Egypt.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Mose ati Aaroni doju wọn bolẹ niwaju gbogbo ijọ awọn ọmọ Israeli.
entries.en: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel.

entries.yo: Ati Joṣua ọmọ Nuni ati Kalebu ọmọ Jefunne, ti o wà ninu awọn ti o ṣe amí ilẹ na, fà aṣọ wọn ya:
entries.en: And Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, which were of them that searched the land, rent their clothes:

entries.yo: Nwọn si sọ fun gbogbo ijọ awọn ọmọ Israeli, wipe, Ilẹ na ti awa là já lati ṣe amí rẹ̀, ilẹ na dara gidigidi.
entries.en: And they spake unto all the company of the children of Israel, saying, The land, which we passed through to search it, is an exceeding good land.

entries.yo: Bi OLUWA ba fẹ́ wa, njẹ yio mú wa wọ̀ inu ilẹ na yi, yio si fi i fun wa; ilẹ ti nṣàn fun warà ati fun oyin.
entries.en: If the LORD delight in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it us; a land which floweth with milk and honey.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹ máṣe ṣọ̀tẹ si OLUWA, bẹ̃ni ki ẹ máṣe bẹ̀ru awọn enia ilẹ na; nitoripe onjẹ wa ni nwọn; àbo wọn ti fi wọn silẹ, OLUWA si wà pẹlu wa: ẹ máṣe bẹ̀ru wọn.
entries.en: Only rebel not ye against the LORD, neither fear ye the people of the land; for they are bread for us: their defence is departed from them, and the LORD is with us: fear them not.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ijọ si wipe ki a sọ wọn li okuta. Ṣugbọn ogo OLUWA hàn ninu agọ́ ajọ niwaju gbogbo awọn ọmọ Israeli.
entries.en: But all the congregation bade stone them with stones. And the glory of the LORD appeared in the tabernacle of the congregation before all the children of Israel.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun Mose pe, Awọn enia yi yio ti kẹgàn mi pẹ tó? yio si ti pẹ tó ti nwọn o ṣe alaigbà mi gbọ́, ni gbogbo iṣẹ-àmi ti mo ṣe lãrin wọn?
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, How long will this people provoke me? and how long will it be ere they believe me, for all the signs which I have shewed among them?

entries.yo: Emi o fi ajakalẹ-àrun kọlù wọn, emi o si gbà ogún wọn lọwọ wọn, emi o si sọ iwọ di orilẹ-ède nla, ati alagbara jù wọn lọ.
entries.en: I will smite them with the pestilence, and disinherit them, and will make of thee a greater nation and mightier than they.

entries.yo: Mose si wi fun OLUWA pe, Ṣugbọn awọn ara Egipti yio gbọ́; nitoripe nipa agbara rẹ ni iwọ fi mú awọn enia yi jade lati inu wọn wá;
entries.en: And Moses said unto the LORD, Then the Egyptians shall hear it, (for thou broughtest up this people in thy might from among them;)

entries.yo: Nwọn o si wi fun awọn ara ilẹ yi: nwọn sá ti gbọ́ pe iwọ OLUWA mbẹ lãrin awọn enia yi, nitoripe a ri iwọ OLUWA li ojukoju, ati pe awọsanma rẹ duro lori wọn, ati pe iwọ li o ṣaju wọn, ninu ọwọ̀n awọsanma nigba ọsán, ati ninu ọwọ̀n iná li oru.
entries.en: And they will tell it to the inhabitants of this land: for they have heard that thou LORD art among this people, that thou LORD art seen face to face, and that thy cloud standeth over them, and that thou goest before them, by day time in a pillar of a cloud, and in a pillar of fire by night.

entries.yo: Njẹ bi iwọ ba pa gbogbo awọn enia yi bi ẹnikan, nigbana li awọn orilẹ-ède ti o ti gbọ́ okikí rẹ yio wipe,
entries.en: Now if thou shalt kill all this people as one man, then the nations which have heard the fame of thee will speak, saying,

entries.yo: Nitoriti OLUWA kò le mú awọn enia yi dé ilẹ ti o ti fi bura fun wọn, nitorina li o ṣe pa wọn li aginjù.
entries.en: Because the LORD was not able to bring this people into the land which he sware unto them, therefore he hath slain them in the wilderness.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, emi bẹ̀ ọ, jẹ ki agbara OLUWA ki o tobi, gẹgẹ bi iwọ ti sọ rí pe,
entries.en: And now, I beseech thee, let the power of my Lord be great, according as thou hast spoken, saying,

entries.yo: Olupamọra ati ẹniti o pọ̀ li ãnu li OLUWA, ti ndari ẹ̀ṣẹ ati irekọja jì, ati bi o ti wù ki o ri, ti ki ijẹ ki ẹlẹbi lọ laijìya; a ma bẹ̀ ẹ̀ṣẹ awọn baba wò lara awọn ọmọ, titi dé iran kẹta ati ẹkẹrin.
entries.en: The LORD is longsuffering, and of great mercy, forgiving iniquity and transgression, and by no means clearing the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation.

entries.yo: Emi bẹ̀ ọ, dari ẹ̀ṣẹ awọn enia yi jì, gẹgẹ bi titobi ãnu rẹ, ati bi iwọ ti darijì awọn enia yi, lati Egipti titi di isisiyi.
entries.en: Pardon, I beseech thee, the iniquity of this people according unto the greatness of thy mercy, and as thou hast forgiven this people, from Egypt even until now.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wipe, Emi ti darijì gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ rẹ:
entries.en: And the LORD said, I have pardoned according to thy word:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nitõtọ, bi mo ti wà, gbogbo aiye yio si kún fun ogo OLUWA;
entries.en: But as truly as I live, all the earth shall be filled with the glory of the LORD.

entries.yo: Nitori gbogbo awọn enia wọnyi ti o ti ri ogo mi, ati iṣẹ-àmi mi, ti mo ti ṣe ni Egipti ati li aginjù, ti nwọn si dan mi wò nigba mẹwa yi, ti nwọn kò si fetisi ohùn mi;
entries.en: Because all those men which have seen my glory, and my miracles, which I did in Egypt and in the wilderness, and have tempted me now these ten times, and have not hearkened to my voice;

entries.yo: Nitõtọ nwọn ki yio ri ilẹ na ti mo ti fi bura fun awọn baba wọn, bẹ̃ni ọkan ninu awọn ti o gàn mi ki yio ri i:
entries.en: Surely they shall not see the land which I sware unto their fathers, neither shall any of them that provoked me see it:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Kalebu iranṣẹ mi, nitoriti o ní ọkàn miran ninu rẹ̀, ti o si tẹle mi mọtimọti, on li emi o múlọ sinu ilẹ na nibiti o ti rè; irú-ọmọ rẹ̀ ni yio si ní i.
entries.en: But my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and hath followed me fully, him will I bring into the land whereinto he went; and his seed shall possess it.

entries.yo: Njẹ awọn ara Amaleki ati awọn ara Kenaani ngbé afonifoji: li ọla ẹ pada, ki ẹ si ṣi lọ si aginjù nipa ọ̀na Okun Pupa.
entries.en: (Now the Amalekites and the Canaanites dwelt in the valley.) To morrow turn you, and get you into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose ati fun Aaroni pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

entries.yo: Emi o ti mu sũru pẹ to fun ijọ enia buburu yi ti nkùn si mi? Emi ti gbọ́ kikùn awọn ọmọ Israeli, ti nwọn kùn si mi.
entries.en: How long shall I bear with this evil congregation, which murmur against me? I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against me.

entries.yo: Wi fun wọn pe, OLUWA wipe, Bi mo ti wà nitõtọ, bi ẹnyin ti sọ li etí mi, bẹ̃li emi o ṣe si nyin:
entries.en: Say unto them, As truly as I live, saith the LORD, as ye have spoken in mine ears, so will I do to you:

entries.yo: Okú nyin yio ṣubu li aginjù yi; ati gbogbo awọn ti a kà ninu nyin, gẹgẹ bi iye gbogbo nyin, lati ẹni ogún ọdún lọ ati jú bẹ̃ lọ, ti ẹ kùn si mi,
entries.en: Your carcases shall fall in this wilderness; and all that were numbered of you, according to your whole number, from twenty years old and upward, which have murmured against me,

entries.yo: Ẹnyin ki yio dé inu ilẹ na, ti mo ti bura lati mu nyin gbé inu rẹ̀, bikoṣe Kalebu ọmọ Jefunne, ati Joṣua ọmọ Nuni.
entries.en: Doubtless ye shall not come into the land, concerning which I sware to make you dwell therein, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn ọmọ wẹ́wẹ nyin, ti ẹnyin wipe yio di ijẹ, awọn li emi o muwọ̀ ọ, awọn ni yio si mọ̀ ilẹ na ti ẹnyin gàn.
entries.en: But your little ones, which ye said should be a prey, them will I bring in, and they shall know the land which ye have despised.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹnyin, okú nyin yio ṣubu li aginjú yi.
entries.en: But as for you, your carcases, they shall fall in this wilderness.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ nyin yio si ma rìn kiri li aginjù li ogoji ọdún, nwọn o si ma rù ìwa-àgbere nyin, titi okú nyin yio fi ṣòfo tán li aginjù.
entries.en: And your children shall wander in the wilderness forty years, and bear your whoredoms, until your carcases be wasted in the wilderness.

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi iye ọjọ́ ti ẹnyin fi rìn ilẹ na wò, ani ogoji ọjọ́, ọjọ́ kan fun ọdún kan, li ẹnyin o rù ẹ̀ṣẹ nyin, ani ogoji ọdún, ẹnyin o si mọ̀ ibà ileri mi jẹ́.
entries.en: After the number of the days in which ye searched the land, even forty days, each day for a year, shall ye bear your iniquities, even forty years, and ye shall know my breach of promise.

entries.yo: Emi OLUWA ti sọ, Emi o ṣe e nitõtọ si gbogbo ijọ buburu yi, ti nwọn kójọ pọ̀ si mi: li aginjù yi ni nwọn o run, nibẹ̀ ni nwọn o si kú si.
entries.en: I the LORD have said, I will surely do it unto all this evil congregation, that are gathered together against me: in this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọkunrin na ti Mose rán lọ lati rìn ilẹ na wò, ti nwọn pada, ti nwọn si mu gbogbo ijọ kùn si i, ni mimú ìhin buburu ilẹ na wá,
entries.en: And the men, which Moses sent to search the land, who returned, and made all the congregation to murmur against him, by bringing up a slander upon the land,

entries.yo: Ani awọn ọkunrin na ti o mú ìhin buburu ilẹ na wá, nwọn ti ipa àrun kú niwaju OLUWA.
entries.en: Even those men that did bring up the evil report upon the land, died by the plague before the LORD.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Joṣua ọmọ Nuni, ati Kalebu ọmọ Jefunne, ninu awọn ọkunrin na ti o rìn ilẹ na lọ, wà lãye.
entries.en: But Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, which were of the men that went to search the land, lived still.

entries.yo: Mose si sọ ọ̀rọ wọnyi fun gbogbo awọn ọmọ Israeli: awọn enia na si kãnu gidigidi.
entries.en: And Moses told these sayings unto all the children of Israel: and the people mourned greatly.

entries.yo: Nwọn si dide ni kùtukutu owurọ̀, nwọn si gùn ori òke nì lọ, wipe, Kiyesi i, awa niyi, awa o si gòke lọ si ibiti OLUWA ti ṣe ileri: nitoripe awa ti ṣẹ̀.
entries.en: And they rose up early in the morning, and gat them up into the top of the mountain, saying, Lo, we be here, and will go up unto the place which the LORD hath promised: for we have sinned.

entries.yo: Mose si wipe, Ẽṣe ti ẹnyin fi nre aṣẹ OLUWA kọja? kì yio sa gbè nyin.
entries.en: And Moses said, Wherefore now do ye transgress the commandment of the LORD? but it shall not prosper.

entries.yo: Ẹ máṣe gòke lọ, nitoriti OLUWA kò sí lãrin nyin, ki a má ba lù nyin bolẹ niwaju awọn ọtá nyin.
entries.en: Go not up, for the LORD is not among you; that ye be not smitten before your enemies.

entries.yo: Nitoriti awọn ara Amaleki ati awọn ara Kenaani mbẹ niwaju nyin, ẹnyin o si ti ipa idà ṣubu: nitoriti ẹnyin ti yipada kuro lẹhin OLUWA, nitorina OLUWA ki yio si pẹlu nyin.
entries.en: For the Amalekites and the Canaanites are there before you, and ye shall fall by the sword: because ye are turned away from the LORD, therefore the LORD will not be with you.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nwọn fi igberaga gòke lọ sori òke na: ṣugbọn apoti ẹrí OLUWA, ati Mose, kò jade kuro ni ibudò.
entries.en: But they presumed to go up unto the hill top: nevertheless the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and Moses, departed not out of the camp.

entries.yo: Nigbana li awọn ara Amaleki sọkalẹ wá, ati awọn ara Kenaani ti ngbé ori-òke na, nwọn si kọlù wọn nwọn si ṣẹ́ wọn titi dé Horma.
entries.en: Then the Amalekites came down, and the Canaanites which dwelt in that hill, and smote them, and discomfited them, even unto Hormah.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Sọ fun awọn ọmọ Israeli, ki o si wi fun wọn pe, Nigbati ẹnyin ba dé ilẹ ibujoko nyin, ti mo fi fun nyin,
entries.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come into the land of your habitations, which I give unto you,

entries.yo: Ti ẹnyin o ba si ṣe ẹbọ iná si OLUWA, ẹbọ sisun, tabi ẹbọ, lati san ẹjẹ́, tabi ẹbọ ifẹ́-atinuwá, tabi ninu ajọ nyin lati ṣe õrùn didùn si OLUWA ninu agbo-ẹran, tabi ọwọ́-ẹran:
entries.en: And will make an offering by fire unto the LORD, a burnt offering, or a sacrifice in performing a vow, or in a freewill offering, or in your solemn feasts, to make a sweet savour unto the LORD, of the herd, or of the flock:

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ki ẹniti nru ọrẹ-ẹbọ rẹ̀ na si OLUWA ki o mú ẹbọ ohunjijẹ wá, idamẹwa òṣuwọn iyẹfun ti a fi idamẹrin òṣuwọn hini oróro pò:
entries.en: Then shall he that offereth his offering unto the LORD bring a meat offering of a tenth deal of flour mingled with the fourth part of an hin of oil.

entries.yo: Ati idamẹrin òṣuwọn hini ọti-waini fun ẹbọ ohunmimu ni ki iwọ ki o pèse pẹlu ẹbọ sisun, tabi ẹbọ, fun ọdọ-agutan kan.
entries.en: And the fourth part of an hin of wine for a drink offering shalt thou prepare with the burnt offering or sacrifice, for one lamb.

entries.yo: Tabi fun àgbo kan, ki iwọ ki o pèse ẹbọ ohunjijẹ idamẹwa meji òṣuwọn iyẹfun pẹlu idamẹta òṣuwọn hini oróro:
entries.en: Or for a ram, thou shalt prepare for a meat offering two tenth deals of flour mingled with the third part of an hin of oil.

entries.yo: Ati fun ẹbọ ohunmimu, ki iwọ ki o mú idamẹta òṣuwọn hini ọti-waini wá, fun õrùn didùn si OLUWA.
entries.en: And for a drink offering thou shalt offer the third part of an hin of wine, for a sweet savour unto the LORD.

entries.yo: Bi iwọ ba si pèse ẹgbọrọ akọmalu kan fun ẹbọ sisun, tabi fun ẹbọ kan, lati san ẹjẹ́, tabi ẹbọ alafia si OLUWA:
entries.en: And when thou preparest a bullock for a burnt offering, or for a sacrifice in performing a vow, or peace offerings unto the LORD:

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ki o mu wá pẹlu ẹgbọrọ akọmalu na, ẹbọ ohunjijẹ idamẹwa mẹta òṣuwọn iyẹfun ti a fi àbọ òsuwọn hini oróro pò.
entries.en: Then shall he bring with a bullock a meat offering of three tenth deals of flour mingled with half an hin of oil.

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o si múwa fun ẹbọ ohunmimu àbọ òṣuwọn hini ọti-waini, ẹbọ ti a fi iná ṣe, õrùn didùn si OLUWA.
entries.en: And thou shalt bring for a drink offering half an hin of wine, for an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.

entries.yo: Bayi ni ki a ṣe niti akọmalu kan, tabi niti àgbo kan, tabi niti akọ ọdọ-agutan kan, tabi niti ọmọ-ewurẹ kan.
entries.en: Thus shall it be done for one bullock, or for one ram, or for a lamb, or a kid.

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi iye ti ẹnyin o pèse, bẹ̃ni ki ẹnyin ki o ṣe si olukuluku gẹgẹ bi iye wọn.
entries.en: According to the number that ye shall prepare, so shall ye do to every one according to their number.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ibilẹ ni ki o ma ṣe nkan wọnyi bayi, nigbati nwọn ba nru ẹbọ ti a fi iná ṣe, ti õrùn didùn si OLUWA.
entries.en: All that are born of the country shall do these things after this manner, in offering an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.

entries.yo: Ati bi alejò kan ba nṣe atipo lọdọ nyin, tabi ẹnikẹni ti o wù ki o ṣe ninu nyin ni iran nyin, ti o si nfẹ́ ru ẹbọ ti a fi iná ṣe, ti õrùn didùn si OLUWA; bi ẹnyin ti ṣe, bẹ̃ni ki on ki o ṣe.
entries.en: And if a stranger sojourn with you, or whosoever be among you in your generations, and will offer an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD; as ye do, so he shall do.

entries.yo: Ìlana kan ni ki o wà fun ẹnyin ijọ enia, ati fun alejò ti nṣe atipo lọdọ nyin, ìlana titilai, ni iran-iran nyin: bi ẹnyin ti ri, bẹ̃ni ki alejò ki o si ri niwaju OLUWA.
entries.en: One ordinance shall be both for you of the congregation, and also for the stranger that sojourneth with you, an ordinance for ever in your generations: as ye are, so shall the stranger be before the LORD.

entries.yo: Ofin kan ati ìlana kan ni ki o wà fun nyin, ati fun alejò ti nṣe atipo lọdọ nyin.
entries.en: One law and one manner shall be for you, and for the stranger that sojourneth with you.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Sọ fun awọn ọmọ Israeli, ki o si wi fun wọn pe, Nigbati ẹnyin ba dé ilẹ na nibiti emi nmú nyin lọ,
entries.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land whither I bring you,

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, nigbati ẹnyin ba njẹ ninu onjẹ ilẹ na, ki ẹnyin ki o mú ẹbọ igbesọsoke wá fun OLUWA.
entries.en: Then it shall be, that, when ye eat of the bread of the land, ye shall offer up an heave offering unto the LORD.

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o mú àkara atetekọṣu iyẹfun nyin wá fun ẹbọ igbesọsoke: bi ẹnyin ti ṣe ti ẹbọ igbesọsoke ilẹ ipakà, bẹ̃ni ki ẹnyin gbé e sọ.
entries.en: Ye shall offer up a cake of the first of your dough for an heave offering: as ye do the heave offering of the threshingfloor, so shall ye heave it.

entries.yo: Ninu atetekọ́ṣu iyẹfun nyin ni ki ẹnyin ki o fi fun OLUWA li ẹbọ igbesọsoke, ni iran-iran nyin.
entries.en: Of the first of your dough ye shall give unto the LORD an heave offering in your generations.

entries.yo: Bi ẹnyin ba si ṣìṣe, ti ẹnyin kò si kiyesi gbogbo ofin wọnyi ti OLUWA ti sọ fun Mose,
entries.en: And if ye have erred, and not observed all these commandments, which the LORD hath spoken unto Moses,

entries.yo: Ani gbogbo eyiti OLUWA ti paṣẹ fun nyin lati ọwọ́ Mose wá, lati ọjọ́ na ti OLUWA ti paṣẹ fun Mose, ati lati isisiyi lọ, ni iran-iran nyin;
entries.en: Even all that the LORD hath commanded you by the hand of Moses, from the day that the LORD commanded Moses, and henceforward among your generations;

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, bi a ba fi aimọ̀ ṣe ohun kan ti ijọ kò mọ̀, ki gbogbo ijọ ki o mú ẹgbọrọ akọmalu kan wá fun ẹbọ sisun, fun õrùn didùn si OLUWA, pẹlu ẹbọ ohunjijẹ rẹ̀, ati ẹbọ ohunmimu rẹ̀, gẹgẹ bi ìlana na, ati obukọ kan fun ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ.
entries.en: Then it shall be, if ought be committed by ignorance without the knowledge of the congregation, that all the congregation shall offer one young bullock for a burnt offering, for a sweet savour unto the LORD, with his meat offering, and his drink offering, according to the manner, and one kid of the goats for a sin offering.

entries.yo: Ki alufa ki o si ṣètutu fun gbogbo ijọ awọn ọmọ Israeli, a o si darijì wọn; nitoripe aimọ̀ ni, nwọn si ti mú ọrẹ-ẹbọ wọn wá, ẹbọ ti a fi iná ṣe si OLUWA, ati ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ wọn niwaju OLUWA, nitori aimọ̀ wọn:
entries.en: And the priest shall make an atonement for all the congregation of the children of Israel, and it shall be forgiven them; for it is ignorance: and they shall bring their offering, a sacrifice made by fire unto the LORD, and their sin offering before the LORD, for their ignorance:

entries.yo: A o si darijì gbogbo ijọ awọn ọmọ Israeli, ati alejò ti iṣe atipo lọdọ wọn; nitoripe gbogbo enia wà li aimọ̀.
entries.en: And it shall be forgiven all the congregation of the children of Israel, and the stranger that sojourneth among them; seeing all the people were in ignorance.

entries.yo: Bi ọkàn kan ba si fi aimọ̀ ṣẹ̀, nigbana ni ki o mú abo-ewurẹ ọlọdún kan wá, fun ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ.
entries.en: And if any soul sin through ignorance, then he shall bring a she goat of the first year for a sin offering.

entries.yo: Ki alufa ki o ṣètutu fun ọkàn na ti o ṣẹ̀, nigbati o ba ṣẹ̀ li aimọ̀ niwaju OLUWA, lati ṣètutu fun u; a o si darijì i.
entries.en: And the priest shall make an atonement for the soul that sinneth ignorantly, when he sinneth by ignorance before the LORD, to make an atonement for him; and it shall be forgiven him.

entries.yo: Ofin kan ni ki ẹnyin ki o ní fun ẹniti o ṣẹ̀ ni aimọ̀, ati fun ẹniti a bi ninu awọn ọmọ Israeli, ati fun alejò ti nṣe atipo ninu wọn.
entries.en: Ye shall have one law for him that sinneth through ignorance, both for him that is born among the children of Israel, and for the stranger that sojourneth among them.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ọkàn na ti o ba fi ikugbu ṣe ohun kan, iba ṣe ibilẹ tabi alejò, o sọ̀rọbuburu si OLUWA; ọkàn na li a o si ke kuro ninu awọn enia rẹ̀.
entries.en: But the soul that doeth ought presumptuously, whether he be born in the land, or a stranger, the same reproacheth the LORD; and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.

entries.yo: Nitoriti o gàn ọ̀rọ OLUWA, o si ru ofin rẹ̀; ọkàn na li a o ke kuro patapata, ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ̀ yio wà lori rẹ̀.
entries.en: Because he hath despised the word of the LORD, and hath broken his commandment, that soul shall utterly be cut off; his iniquity shall be upon him.

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn ọmọ Israeli wà li aginjù, nwọn ri ọkunrin kan ti nṣẹ́ igi li ọjọ́-isimi.
entries.en: And while the children of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man that gathered sticks upon the sabbath day.

entries.yo: Awọn ti o ri i ti nṣẹ́ igi mú u tọ̀ Mose ati Aaroni wá, ati gbogbo ijọ.
entries.en: And they that found him gathering sticks brought him unto Moses and Aaron, and unto all the congregation.

entries.yo: Nwọn si há a mọ́ ile-ìde, nitoriti a kò ti isọ bi a o ti ṣe e.
entries.en: And they put him in ward, because it was not declared what should be done to him.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe, Pipa li a o pa ọkunrin na: gbogbo ijọ ni yio sọ ọ li okuta pa lẹhin ibudó.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, The man shall be surely put to death: all the congregation shall stone him with stones without the camp.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ijọ si mú u wá sẹhin ibudó, nwọn si sọ ọ li okuta, on si kú; bi OLUWA ti paṣẹ fun Mose.
entries.en: And all the congregation brought him without the camp, and stoned him with stones, and he died; as the LORD commanded Moses.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Sọ fun awọn ọmọ Israeli, ki o si fi aṣẹ fun wọn ki nwọn ki o ṣe wajawaja si eti aṣọ wọn ni iran-iran wọn, ati ki nwọn ki o si fi ọjábulẹ alaró si wajawaja eti aṣọ na:
entries.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and bid them that they make them fringes in the borders of their garments throughout their generations, and that they put upon the fringe of the borders a ribband of blue:

entries.yo: Yio si ma ṣe bi wajawaja fun nyin, ki ẹnyin ki o le ma wò o, ki ẹ si ma ranti gbogbo ofin OLUWA, ki ẹ si ma ṣe wọn: ki ẹnyin ki o má si ṣe tẹle ìro ọkàn nyin ati oju ara nyin, ti ẹnyin ti ima ṣe àgbere tọ̀ lẹhin:
entries.en: And it shall be unto you for a fringe, that ye may look upon it, and remember all the commandments of the LORD, and do them; and that ye seek not after your own heart and your own eyes, after which ye use to go a whoring:

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o le ma ranti, ki ẹ si ma ṣe ofin mi gbogbo, ki ẹnyin ki o le jẹ́ mimọ́ si Ọlọrun nyin.
entries.en: That ye may remember, and do all my commandments, and be holy unto your God.

entries.yo: Emi ni OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin, ti o mú nyin jade lati ilẹ Egipti wá, lati ma ṣe Ọlọrun nyin: Emi ni OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin.
entries.en: I am the LORD your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am the LORD your God.

entries.yo: NJẸ Kora, ọmọ Ishari, ọmọ Kohati, ọmọ Lefi, ati Datani on Abiramu, awọn ọmọ Eliabu, ati On, ọmọ Peleti, awọn ọmọ Reubeni, dìmọ:
entries.en: Now Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, and Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On, the son of Peleth, sons of Reuben, took men:

entries.yo: Nwọn si dide niwaju Mose, pẹlu ãdọtalerugba ọkunrin ninu awọn ọmọ Israeli, ijoye ninu ijọ, awọn olorukọ ninu ajọ, awọn ọkunrin olokikí:
entries.en: And they rose up before Moses, with certain of the children of Israel, two hundred and fifty princes of the assembly, famous in the congregation, men of renown:

entries.yo: Nwọn si kó ara wọn jọ pọ̀ si Mose ati si Aaroni, nwọn si wi fun wọn pe, O tó gẹ, nitoripe gbogbo ijọ li o jẹ́ mimọ́, olukuluku wọn, OLUWA si mbẹ lãrin wọn: nitori kili ẹnyin ha ṣe ngbé ara nyin ga jù ijọ OLUWA lọ?
entries.en: And they gathered themselves together against Moses and against Aaron, and said unto them, Ye take too much upon you, seeing all the congregation are holy, every one of them, and the LORD is among them: wherefore then lift ye up yourselves above the congregation of the LORD?

entries.yo: Nigbati Mose gbọ́, o doju rẹ̀ bolẹ:
entries.en: And when Moses heard it, he fell upon his face:

entries.yo: O si sọ fun Kora ati fun gbogbo ẹgbẹ rẹ̀ pe, Li ọla OLUWA yio fi ẹniti iṣe tirẹ̀ hàn, ati ẹniti o mọ́; yio si mu u sunmọ ọdọ rẹ̀: ani ẹniti on ba yàn ni yio mu sunmọ ọdọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he spake unto Korah and unto all his company, saying, Even to morrow the LORD will shew who are his, and who is holy; and will cause him to come near unto him: even him whom he hath chosen will he cause to come near unto him.

entries.yo: Ẹ ṣe eyi; Ẹ mú awo-turari, Kora, ati gbogbo ẹgbẹ rẹ̀;
entries.en: This do; Take you censers, Korah, and all his company;

entries.yo: Ki ẹ si fi iná sinu wọn, ki ẹ si fi turari sinu wọn niwaju OLUWA li ọla: yio si ṣe, ọkunrin ti OLUWA ba yàn, on ni ẹni mimọ́: o tó gẹ, ẹnyin ọmọ Lefi.
entries.en: And put fire therein, and put incense in them before the LORD to morrow: and it shall be that the man whom the LORD doth choose, he shall be holy: ye take too much upon you, ye sons of Levi.

entries.yo: Mose si wi fun Kora pe, Emi bẹ̀ nyin, ẹnyin ọmọ Lefi, ẹ gbọ́:
entries.en: And Moses said unto Korah, Hear, I pray you, ye sons of Levi:

entries.yo: Ohun kekere ha ni li oju nyin, ti Ọlọrun Israeli yà nyin kuro ninu ijọ Israeli, lati mú nyin sunmọ ọdọ ara rẹ̀ lati ma ṣe iṣẹ-ìsin agọ́ OLUWA, ati lati ma duro niwaju ijọ lati ma ṣe iranṣẹ fun wọn;
entries.en: Seemeth it but a small thing unto you, that the God of Israel hath separated you from the congregation of Israel, to bring you near to himself to do the service of the tabernacle of the LORD, and to stand before the congregation to minister unto them?

entries.yo: O si mú iwọ sunmọ ọdọ rẹ̀, ati awọn arakunrin rẹ gbogbo, awọn ọmọ Lefi pẹlu rẹ; ẹnyin si nwá iṣẹ-alufa pẹlu?
entries.en: And he hath brought thee near to him, and all thy brethren the sons of Levi with thee: and seek ye the priesthood also?

entries.yo: Nitorina, iwọ ati gbogbo ẹgbẹ rẹ kójọ pọ̀ si OLUWA: ati kini Aaroni, ti ẹnyin nkùn si i?
entries.en: For which cause both thou and all thy company are gathered together against the LORD: and what is Aaron, that ye murmur against him?

entries.yo: Mose si ranṣẹ pè Datani ati Abiramu, awọn ọmọ Eliabu: nwọn si wipe, Awa ki yio gòke wá:
entries.en: And Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab: which said, We will not come up:

entries.yo: Ohun kekere ha ni ti iwọ mú wa gòke lati ilẹ ti nṣàn fun warà ati fun oyin wá, lati pa wa li aginjù, ti iwọ fi ara rẹ jẹ́ alade lori wa patapata?
entries.en: Is it a small thing that thou hast brought us up out of a land that floweth with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, except thou make thyself altogether a prince over us?

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu iwọ kò ti imú wa dé ilẹ kan ti nṣàn fun warà ati fun oyin, bẹ̃ni iwọ kò fun wa ni iní ilẹ ati ọgba-àjara: iwọ o yọ oju awọn ọkunrin wọnyi bi? awa ki yio gòke wá.
entries.en: Moreover thou hast not brought us into a land that floweth with milk and honey, or given us inheritance of fields and vineyards: wilt thou put out the eyes of these men? we will not come up.

entries.yo: Mose si binu gidigidi, o si wi fun OLUWA pe, Máṣe kà ẹbọ wọn si: emi kò gbà kẹtẹkẹtẹ kan lọwọ wọn, bẹ̃li emi kò pa ẹnikan wọn lara.
entries.en: And Moses was very wroth, and said unto the LORD, Respect not thou their offering: I have not taken one ass from them, neither have I hurt one of them.

entries.yo: Mose wi fun Kora pe, Ki iwọ ati gbogbo ẹgbẹ rẹ ki o wá siwaju OLUWA, iwọ, ati awọn, ati Aaroni li ọla:
entries.en: And Moses said unto Korah, Be thou and all thy company before the LORD, thou, and they, and Aaron, to morrow:

entries.yo: Ki olukuluku wọn ki o mú awo-turari rẹ̀, ki ẹ si fi turari sinu wọn, ki olukuluku nyin ki o mú awo-turari rẹ̀ wá siwaju OLUWA, ãdọtalerugba awo-turari; iwọ pẹlu ati Aaroni, olukuluku awo-turari rẹ̀.
entries.en: And take every man his censer, and put incense in them, and bring ye before the LORD every man his censer, two hundred and fifty censers; thou also, and Aaron, each of you his censer.

entries.yo: Olukuluku wọn si mú awo-turari rẹ̀, nwọn si fi iná sinu wọn, nwọn si fi turari lé ori wọn, nwọn si duro li ẹnu-ọ̀na agọ́ ajọ, pẹlu Mose ati Aaroni.
entries.en: And they took every man his censer, and put fire in them, and laid incense thereon, and stood in the door of the tabernacle of the congregation with Moses and Aaron.

entries.yo: Kora si kó gbogbo ijọ enia jọ si wọn si ẹnu-ọ̀na agọ́ ajọ: ogo OLUWA si hàn si gbogbo ijọ enia na.
entries.en: And Korah gathered all the congregation against them unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and the glory of the LORD appeared unto all the congregation.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose ati Aaroni pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

entries.yo: Ẹ yà ara nyin kuro lãrin ijọ yi, ki emi ki o run wọn ni iṣéju kan.
entries.en: Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment.

entries.yo: Nwọn si doju wọn bolẹ, nwọn wipe, Ọlọrun, Ọlọrun ẹmi gbogbo enia, ọkunrin kan ha le ṣẹ̀, ki iwọ ki o si binu si gbogbo ijọ?
entries.en: And they fell upon their faces, and said, O God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, and wilt thou be wroth with all the congregation?

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Sọ fun ijọ pe, Ẹ gòke wá kuro ni sakani agọ́ Kora, Datani, ati Abiramu.
entries.en: Speak unto the congregation, saying, Get you up from about the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.

entries.yo: Mose si dide, o si tọ̀ Datani ati Abiramu lọ; awọn àgba Israeli si tẹle e.
entries.en: And Moses rose up and went unto Dathan and Abiram; and the elders of Israel followed him.

entries.yo: O si sọ fun ijọ pe, Mo bẹ̀ nyin, ẹ kuro ni ibi agọ́ awọn ọkunrin buburu yi, ẹ má si ṣe fọwọkàn ohun kan ti iṣe ti wọn, ki ẹ má ba run ninu gbogbo ẹ̀ṣẹ wọn.
entries.en: And he spake unto the congregation, saying, Depart, I pray you, from the tents of these wicked men, and touch nothing of theirs, lest ye be consumed in all their sins.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni nwọn si gòke lọ kuro nibi agọ́ Kora, Datani ati Abiramu, ni ìha gbogbo: Datani ati Abiramu si jade, nwọn si duro li ẹnu-ọ̀na agọ́ wọn, ati awọn aya wọn, ati awọn ọmọ wọn ọkunrin, ati awọn ọmọ wọn wẹ́wẹ.
entries.en: So they gat up from the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, on every side: and Dathan and Abiram came out, and stood in the door of their tents, and their wives, and their sons, and their little children.

entries.yo: Mose si wipe, Nipa eyi li ẹnyin o mọ̀ pe OLUWA li o rán mi lati ṣe gbogbo iṣẹ wọnyi; ati pe emi kò ṣe wọn lati inu ara mi wá.
entries.en: And Moses said, Hereby ye shall know that the LORD hath sent me to do all these works; for I have not done them of mine own mind.

entries.yo: Bi awọn ọkunrin wọnyi ba kú bi gbogbo enia ti ikú, tabi bi a ba si bẹ̀ wọn wò bi ãti ibẹ̀ gbogbo enia wò; njẹ OLUWA ki o rán mi.
entries.en: If these men die the common death of all men, or if they be visited after the visitation of all men; then the LORD hath not sent me.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi OLUWA ba ṣe ohun titun, ti ilẹ ba si là ẹnu rẹ̀, ti o si gbe wọn mì, pẹlu ohun gbogbo ti iṣe ti wọn, ti nwọn si sọkalẹ lọ si ipò-okú lãye; nigbana ẹnyin o mọ̀ pe awọn ọkunrin wọnyi ti gàn OLUWA.
entries.en: But if the LORD make a new thing, and the earth open her mouth, and swallow them up, with all that appertain unto them, and they go down quick into the pit; then ye shall understand that these men have provoked the LORD.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, bi o ti pari gbogbo ọ̀rọ wọnyi ni sisọ, ni ilẹ là pẹrẹ nisalẹ wọn:
entries.en: And it came to pass, as he had made an end of speaking all these words, that the ground clave asunder that was under them:

entries.yo: Ilẹ si yà ẹnu rẹ̀, o si gbe wọn mì, ati awọn ara ile wọn, ati gbogbo awọn enia ti iṣe ti Kora, ati gbogbo ẹrù wọn.
entries.en: And the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up, and their houses, and all the men that appertained unto Korah, and all their goods.

entries.yo: Awọn, ati ohun gbogbo ti iṣe ti wọn, sọkalẹ lọ lãye si ipò-okú, ilẹ si pa ẹnu dé mọ́ wọn, nwọn si run kuro ninu ijọ.
entries.en: They, and all that appertained to them, went down alive into the pit, and the earth closed upon them: and they perished from among the congregation.

entries.yo: Gbogbo enia Israeli ti o yi wọn ká si salọ nitori igbe wọn: nitoriti nwọn wipe, Ki ilẹ ki o má ba gbe wa mì pẹlu.
entries.en: And all Israel that were round about them fled at the cry of them: for they said, Lest the earth swallow us up also.

entries.yo: Iná si jade wá lati ọdọ OLUWA, o si run awọn ãdọtalerugba ọkunrin nì ti nwọn mú turari wá.
entries.en: And there came out a fire from the LORD, and consumed the two hundred and fifty men that offered incense.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Sọ fun Eleasari ọmọ Aaroni alufa, pe ki o mú awo-turari wọnni kuro ninu ijóna, ki iwọ ki o si tu iná na ká sọhún; nitoripe nwọn jẹ́ mimọ́.
entries.en: Speak unto Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, that he take up the censers out of the burning, and scatter thou the fire yonder; for they are hallowed.

entries.yo: Awo-turari ti awọn ẹlẹṣẹ wọnyi si ọkàn ara wọn, ni ki nwọn ki o fi ṣe awo fẹlẹfẹlẹ fun ibori pẹpẹ: nitoriti nwọn mú wọn wá siwaju OLUWA, nitorina ni nwọn ṣe jẹ́ mimọ́: nwọn o si ma ṣe àmi fun awọn ọmọ Israeli.
entries.en: The censers of these sinners against their own souls, let them make them broad plates for a covering of the altar: for they offered them before the LORD, therefore they are hallowed: and they shall be a sign unto the children of Israel.

entries.yo: Eleasari alufa si mú awo-turari idẹ wọnni, eyiti awọn ẹniti o jóna fi mú ẹbọ wá; a si rọ wọn li awo fẹlẹfẹlẹ fun ibori pẹpẹ:
entries.en: And Eleazar the priest took the brasen censers, wherewith they that were burnt had offered; and they were made broad plates for a covering of the altar:

entries.yo: Lati ma ṣe ohun iranti fun awọn ọmọ Israeli, ki alejò kan, ti ki iṣe irú-ọmọ Aaroni, ki o máṣe sunmọtosi lati mú turari wá siwaju OLUWA; ki o má ba dabi Kora, ati awọn ẹgbẹ rẹ̀: bi OLUWA ti wi fun u lati ọwọ́ Mose wá.
entries.en: To be a memorial unto the children of Israel, that no stranger, which is not of the seed of Aaron, come near to offer incense before the LORD; that he be not as Korah, and as his company: as the LORD said to him by the hand of Moses.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ni ijọ́ keji gbogbo ijọ awọn ọmọ Israeli nkùn si Mose ati si Aaroni, wipe, Ẹnyin pa awọn enia OLUWA.
entries.en: But on the morrow all the congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron, saying, Ye have killed the people of the LORD.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati ijọ pejọ pọ̀ si Mose ati si Aaroni, ti nwọn si wò ìha agọ́ ajọ: si kiyesi i, awọsanma bò o, ogo OLUWA si farahàn.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when the congregation was gathered against Moses and against Aaron, that they looked toward the tabernacle of the congregation: and, behold, the cloud covered it, and the glory of the LORD appeared.

entries.yo: Mose ati Aaroni si wá siwaju agọ́ ajọ.
entries.en: And Moses and Aaron came before the tabernacle of the congregation.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Ẹ lọ kuro lãrin ijọ yi, ki emi ki o run wọn ni iṣẹju kan. Nwọn si doju wọn bolẹ.
entries.en: Get you up from among this congregation, that I may consume them as in a moment. And they fell upon their faces.

entries.yo: Mose si wi fun Aaroni pe, Mú awo-turari kan, ki o si fi iná sinu rẹ̀ lati ori pẹpẹ nì wá, ki o si fi turari lé ori rẹ̀, ki o si yára lọ sọdọ ijọ, ki o si ṣètutu fun wọn: nitoriti ibinu jade lati ọdọ OLUWA lọ; iyọnu ti bẹ̀rẹ na.
entries.en: And Moses said unto Aaron, Take a censer, and put fire therein from off the altar, and put on incense, and go quickly unto the congregation, and make an atonement for them: for there is wrath gone out from the LORD; the plague is begun.

entries.yo: Aaroni si mú awo-turari bi Mose ti fi aṣẹ fun u, o si sure lọ sãrin ijọ; si kiyesi i, iyọnu ti bẹ̀rẹ na lãrin awọn enia: o si fi turari sinu rẹ̀, o si ṣètutu fun awọn enia na.
entries.en: And Aaron took as Moses commanded, and ran into the midst of the congregation; and, behold, the plague was begun among the people: and he put on incense, and made an atonement for the people.

entries.yo: O si duro li agbedemeji okú ati alãye; iyọnu na si duro.
entries.en: And he stood between the dead and the living; and the plague was stayed.

entries.yo: Awọn ti o kú ninu iyọnu na si jẹ́ ẹgba meje o le ẹ̃dẹgbẹrin, laìka awọn ti o kú niti ọ̀ran Kora.
entries.en: Now they that died in the plague were fourteen thousand and seven hundred, beside them that died about the matter of Korah.

entries.yo: Aaroni si pada tọ̀ Mose lọ si ibi ẹnu-ọ̀na agọ́ ajọ: iyọnu na si duro.
entries.en: And Aaron returned unto Moses unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and the plague was stayed.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Sọ fun awọn ọmọ Israeli, ki o si gbà ọpá kọkan lọwọ wọn, gẹgẹ bi ile awọn baba wọn, lọwọ gbogbo awọn olori wọn gẹgẹ bi ile awọn baba wọn ọpá mejila: ki o si kọ́ orukọ olukuluku si ara ọpá rẹ̀.
entries.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and take of every one of them a rod according to the house of their fathers, of all their princes according to the house of their fathers twelve rods: write thou every man's name upon his rod.

entries.yo: Ki o si kọ orukọ Aaroni sara ọpá Lefi: nitoripe ọpá kan yio jẹ́ fun ori ile awọn baba wọn.
entries.en: And thou shalt write Aaron's name upon the rod of Levi: for one rod shall be for the head of the house of their fathers.

entries.yo: Ki o si fi wọn lelẹ ninu agọ́ ajọ, niwaju ẹrí, nibiti emi o gbé pade nyin.
entries.en: And thou shalt lay them up in the tabernacle of the congregation before the testimony, where I will meet with you.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, ọpá ẹniti emi o yàn yio ruwe: emi o si da kikùn awọn ọmọ Israeli duro kuro lọdọ mi, ti nwọn nkùn si nyin.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass, that the man's rod, whom I shall choose, shall blossom: and I will make to cease from me the murmurings of the children of Israel, whereby they murmur against you.

entries.yo: Mose si sọ fun awọn ọmọ Israeli, gbogbo awọn olori wọn si fun u li ọpá, ọpá kan fun olori kan, gẹgẹ bi ile awọn baba wọn, ani ọpá mejila: ọpá Aaroni si wà ninu ọpá wọn.
entries.en: And Moses spake unto the children of Israel, and every one of their princes gave him a rod apiece, for each prince one, according to their fathers' houses, even twelve rods: and the rod of Aaron was among their rods.

entries.yo: Mose si fi ọpá wọnni lelẹ niwaju OLUWA ninu agọ́ ẹrí.
entries.en: And Moses laid up the rods before the LORD in the tabernacle of witness.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, ni ijọ́ keji ti Mose wọ̀ inu agọ́ ẹrí lọ; si kiyesi i, ọpá Aaroni fun ile Lefi rudi, o si tú, o si tanna, o si so eso almondi.
entries.en: And it came to pass, that on the morrow Moses went into the tabernacle of witness; and, behold, the rod of Aaron for the house of Levi was budded, and brought forth buds, and bloomed blossoms, and yielded almonds.

entries.yo: Mose si kó gbogbo ọpá na lati iwaju OLUWA jade tọ̀ gbogbo awọn ọmọ Israeli wá: nwọn si wò, olukuluku si mú ọpá tirẹ̀.
entries.en: And Moses brought out all the rods from before the LORD unto all the children of Israel: and they looked, and took every man his rod.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe, Mú ọpá Aaroni pada wa siwaju ẹrí, lati fi pamọ́ fun àmi fun awọn ọlọ̀tẹ nì; ki iwọ ki o si gbà kikùn wọn kuro lọdọ mi patapata ki nwọn ki o má ba kú.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Bring Aaron's rod again before the testimony, to be kept for a token against the rebels; and thou shalt quite take away their murmurings from me, that they die not.

entries.yo: Mose si ṣe bẹ̃: bi OLUWA ti fi aṣẹ fun u, bẹ̃li o ṣe.
entries.en: And Moses did so: as the LORD commanded him, so did he.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Israeli si sọ fun Mose pe, Kiyesi i, awa kú, awa gbé, gbogbo wa gbé.
entries.en: And the children of Israel spake unto Moses, saying, Behold, we die, we perish, we all perish.

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni ti o ba sunmọ agọ́ OLUWA yio kú: awa o ha fi kikú run bi?
entries.en: Whosoever cometh any thing near unto the tabernacle of the LORD shall die: shall we be consumed with dying?

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Aaroni pe, Iwọ ati awọn ọmọ rẹ, ati ile baba rẹ pẹlu rẹ, ni yio ma rù ẹ̀ṣẹ ibi-mimọ́: ati iwọ ati awọn ọmọ rẹ pẹlu rẹ ni yio ma rù ẹ̀ṣẹ iṣẹ-alufa nyin.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Aaron, Thou and thy sons and thy father's house with thee shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary: and thou and thy sons with thee shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood.

entries.yo: Ati awọn arakunrin rẹ pẹlu, ẹ̀ya Lefi, ẹ̀ya baba rẹ, ni ki o múwa pẹlu rẹ, ki nwọn ki o le dàpọ pẹlu rẹ, ki nwọn ki o ma ṣe iranṣẹ fun ọ: ṣugbọn iwọ ati awọn ọmọ rẹ pẹlu rẹ ni yio ma ṣe iranṣẹ niwaju agọ́ ẹrí.
entries.en: And thy brethren also of the tribe of Levi, the tribe of thy father, bring thou with thee, that they may be joined unto thee, and minister unto thee: but thou and thy sons with thee shall minister before the tabernacle of witness.

entries.yo: Ki nwọn ki o ma pa aṣẹ rẹ mọ́, ki nwọn ki o si ma ṣe itọju gbogbo agọ́, kìki pe nwọn kò gbọdọ sunmọ ohun-èlo ibi-mimọ́ ati pẹpẹ, ki ati awọn, ati ẹnyin pẹlu ki o má ba kú.
entries.en: And they shall keep thy charge, and the charge of all the tabernacle: only they shall not come nigh the vessels of the sanctuary and the altar, that neither they, nor ye also, die.

entries.yo: Ki nwọn ki o si dàpọ pẹlu rẹ, ki nwọn ki o si ma ṣe itọju agọ́ ajọ, gẹgẹ bi gbogbo iṣẹ-ìsin agọ́: alejò kan kò sí gbọdọ sunmọ ọdọ nyin.
entries.en: And they shall be joined unto thee, and keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation, for all the service of the tabernacle: and a stranger shall not come nigh unto you.

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o si ma ṣe itọju ibi-mimọ́, ati itọju pẹpẹ: ki ibinu ki o má ba sí mọ́ lori awọn ọmọ Israeli.
entries.en: And ye shall keep the charge of the sanctuary, and the charge of the altar: that there be no wrath any more upon the children of Israel.

entries.yo: Ati emi, kiyesi i, mo ti mú awọn arakunrin nyin, awọn ọmọ Lefi kuro ninu awọn ọmọ Israeli: ẹnyin li a fi wọn fun bi ẹ̀bun fun OLUWA, lati ma ṣe iṣẹ-ìsin agọ́ ajọ.
entries.en: And I, behold, I have taken your brethren the Levites from among the children of Israel: to you they are given as a gift for the LORD, to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation.

entries.yo: Iwọ ati awọn ọmọ rẹ pẹlu rẹ ni yio si ma ṣe itọju iṣẹ-alufa nyin niti ohun gbogbo ti iṣe ti pẹpẹ, ati ti inu aṣọ-ikele: ẹnyin o si ma sìn: emi ti fi iṣẹ-alufa nyin fun nyin, bi iṣẹ-ìsin ẹ̀bun: alejò ti o ba si sunmọtosi li a o pa.
entries.en: Therefore thou and thy sons with thee shall keep your priest's office for every thing of the altar, and within the vail; and ye shall serve: I have given your priest's office unto you as a service of gift: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Aaroni pe, Kiyesi i, emi si ti fi itọju ẹbọ igbesọsoke mi fun ọ pẹlu, ani gbogbo ohun mimọ́ awọn ọmọ Israeli, iwọ li emi fi wọn fun ni ipín, ati fun awọn ọmọ rẹ, bi ipín lailai.
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Aaron, Behold, I also have given thee the charge of mine heave offerings of all the hallowed things of the children of Israel; unto thee have I given them by reason of the anointing, and to thy sons, by an ordinance for ever.

entries.yo: Eyi ni yio ṣe tirẹ ninu ohun mimọ́ julọ, ti a mú kuro ninu iná; gbogbo ọrẹ-ẹbọ wọn, gbogbo ẹbọ ohunjijẹ wọn, ati gbogbo ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ wọn, ati gbogbo ẹbọ ẹbi wọn, ti nwọn o mú fun mi wá, mimọ́ julọ ni yio jasi fun iwọ ati fun awọn ọmọ rẹ.
entries.en: This shall be thine of the most holy things, reserved from the fire: every oblation of theirs, every meat offering of theirs, and every sin offering of theirs, and every trespass offering of theirs, which they shall render unto me, shall be most holy for thee and for thy sons.

entries.yo: Bi ohun mimọ́ julọ ni ki iwọ ki o ma jẹ ẹ: gbogbo ọkunrin ni yio jẹ ẹ; mimọ́ ni yio jẹ́ fun ọ.
entries.en: In the most holy place shalt thou eat it; every male shall eat it: it shall be holy unto thee.

entries.yo: Eyi si ni tirẹ; ẹbọ igbesọsoke ẹ̀bun wọn, pẹlu gbogbo ẹbọ fifì awọn ọmọ Israeli: emi ti fi wọn fun ọ, ati fun awọn ọmọ rẹ ọkunrin ati fun awọn ọmọ rẹ obinrin pẹlu rẹ, bi ipín lailai: gbogbo awọn ti o mọ́ ninu ile rẹ ni ki o jẹ ẹ.
entries.en: And this is thine; the heave offering of their gift, with all the wave offerings of the children of Israel: I have given them unto thee, and to thy sons and to thy daughters with thee, by a statute for ever: every one that is clean in thy house shall eat of it.

entries.yo: Gbogbo oróro daradara, ati gbogbo ọti-waini daradara, ati alikama, akọ́so ninu wọn ti nwọn o mú fun OLUWA wá, iwọ ni mo fi wọn fun.
entries.en: All the best of the oil, and all the best of the wine, and of the wheat, the firstfruits of them which they shall offer unto the LORD, them have I given thee.

entries.yo: Akọ́so gbogbo ohun ti o wà ni ilẹ wọn, ti nwọn o mú fun OLUWA wá, tirẹ ni yio jẹ́; gbogbo ẹniti o mọ́ ni ile rẹ ni ki o jẹ ẹ.
entries.en: And whatsoever is first ripe in the land, which they shall bring unto the LORD, shall be thine; every one that is clean in thine house shall eat of it.

entries.yo: Ohun ìyasọtọ gbogbo ni Israeli ni ki o jẹ́ tirẹ.
entries.en: Every thing devoted in Israel shall be thine.

entries.yo: Gbogbo akọ́bi ninu gbogbo ohun alãye, ti nwọn o mú wa fun OLUWA, iba ṣe ti enia tabi ti ẹranko, ki o jẹ́ tirẹ: ṣugbọn rirà ni iwọ o rà akọ́bi enia silẹ, ati akọ́bi ẹran alaimọ́ ni ki iwọ ki o rà silẹ.
entries.en: Every thing that openeth the matrix in all flesh, which they bring unto the LORD, whether it be of men or beasts, shall be thine: nevertheless the firstborn of man shalt thou surely redeem, and the firstling of unclean beasts shalt thou redeem.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn ti a o ràsilẹ, lati ẹni oṣù kan ni ki iwọ ki o ràsilẹ, gẹgẹ bi idiyelé rẹ, li owo ṣekeli marun, nipa ṣekeli ibi-mimọ́ (ti o jẹ́ ogun gera).
entries.en: And those that are to be redeemed from a month old shalt thou redeem, according to thine estimation, for the money of five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary, which is twenty gerahs.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn akọ́bi akọmalu, tabi akọbi agutan, tabi akọ́bi ewurẹ, ni iwọ kò gbọdọ ràsilẹ; mimọ́ ni nwọn: ẹ̀jẹ wọn ni ki iwọ ki o ta sori pẹpẹ, ki iwọ ki o si sun ọrá wọn li ẹbọ ti a fi iná ṣe, fun õrùn didùn si OLUWA.
entries.en: But the firstling of a cow, or the firstling of a sheep, or the firstling of a goat, thou shalt not redeem; they are holy: thou shalt sprinkle their blood upon the altar, and shalt burn their fat for an offering made by fire, for a sweet savour unto the LORD.

entries.yo: Ki ẹran wọn ki o si jẹ́ tirẹ, bi àiya fifì, ati bi itan ọtún, ni yio jẹ́ tirẹ.
entries.en: And the flesh of them shall be thine, as the wave breast and as the right shoulder are thine.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ẹbọ igbesọsoke ohun mimọ́ wọnni, ti awọn ọmọ Israeli múwa fun OLUWA, ni mo ti fi fun ọ, ati fun awọn ọmọ rẹ ọkunrin, ati fun awọn ọmọ rẹ obinrin pẹlu rẹ, bi ipín lailai: majẹmu iyọ̀ ni lailai niwaju OLUWA fun ọ ati fun irú-ọmọ rẹ pẹlu rẹ.
entries.en: All the heave offerings of the holy things, which the children of Israel offer unto the LORD, have I given thee, and thy sons and thy daughters with thee, by a statute for ever: it is a covenant of salt for ever before the LORD unto thee and to thy seed with thee.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Aaroni pe, Iwọ ki yio ní iní ninu ilẹ wọn, bẹ̃ni iwọ ki yio ní ipín lãrin wọn: Emi ni ipín rẹ ati iní rẹ lãrin awọn ọmọ Israeli.
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Aaron, Thou shalt have no inheritance in their land, neither shalt thou have any part among them: I am thy part and thine inheritance among the children of Israel.

entries.yo: Si kiyesi i, emi si ti fi gbogbo idamẹwa ni Israeli fun awọn ọmọ Lefi ni iní, nitori iṣẹ-ìsin wọn ti nwọn nṣe, ani iṣẹ-ìsin agọ́ ajọ.
entries.en: And, behold, I have given the children of Levi all the tenth in Israel for an inheritance, for their service which they serve, even the service of the tabernacle of the congregation.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Israeli kò si gbọdọ sunmọ agọ́ ajọ, ki nwọn ki o má ba rù ẹ̀ṣẹ, ki nwọn má ba kú.
entries.en: Neither must the children of Israel henceforth come nigh the tabernacle of the congregation, lest they bear sin, and die.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn ọmọ Lefi ni ki o ma ṣe iṣẹ-ìsin agọ́ ajọ, awọn ni yio si ma rù ẹ̀ṣẹ wọn: ìlana lailai ni ni iran-iran nyin, ati lãrin awọn ọmọ Israeli, nwọn kò gbọdọ ní ilẹ-iní.
entries.en: But the Levites shall do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation, and they shall bear their iniquity: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations, that among the children of Israel they have no inheritance.

entries.yo: Nitori idamẹwa awọn ọmọ Israeli, ti nwọn múwa li ẹbọ igbesọsoke fun OLUWA, ni mo ti fi fun awọn ọmọ Lefi lati ní: nitorina ni mo ṣe wi fun wọn pe, Nwọn kò gbọdọ ní ilẹ-iní lãrin awọn ọmọ Israeli.
entries.en: But the tithes of the children of Israel, which they offer as an heave offering unto the LORD, I have given to the Levites to inherit: therefore I have said unto them, Among the children of Israel they shall have no inheritance.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Si sọ fun awọn ọmọ Lefi, ki o si wi fun wọn pe, Nigbati ẹnyin ba ngbà idamẹwa ti mo ti fi fun nyin ni ilẹiní nyin lọwọ awọn ọmọ Israeli, nigbana ni ki ẹnyin ki o mú ẹbọ igbesọsoke ninu rẹ̀ wá fun OLUWA, idamẹwa ninu idamẹwa na.
entries.en: Thus speak unto the Levites, and say unto them, When ye take of the children of Israel the tithes which I have given you from them for your inheritance, then ye shall offer up an heave offering of it for the LORD, even a tenth part of the tithe.

entries.yo: A o si kà ẹbọ igbesọsoke nyin yi si nyin, bi ẹnipe ọkà lati ilẹ ipakà wá, ati bi ọti lati ibi ifunti wá.
entries.en: And this your heave offering shall be reckoned unto you, as though it were the corn of the threshingfloor, and as the fulness of the winepress.

entries.yo: Bayi li ẹnyin pẹlu yio ma mú ẹbọ igbesọsoke wá fun OLUWA ninu gbogbo idamẹwa nyin, ti ẹnyin ngbà lọwọ awọn ọmọ Israeli; ki ẹnyin ki o si mú ẹbọ igbesọsoke OLUWA ninu rẹ̀ tọ̀ Aaroni alufa wá.
entries.en: Thus ye also shall offer an heave offering unto the LORD of all your tithes, which ye receive of the children of Israel; and ye shall give thereof the LORD's heave offering to Aaron the priest.

entries.yo: Ninu gbogbo ẹ̀bun nyin ni ki ẹnyin ki o si mú gbogbo ẹbọ igbesọsoke OLUWA wá, ninu gbogbo eyiti o dara, ani eyiti a yàsimimọ́ ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: Out of all your gifts ye shall offer every heave offering of the LORD, of all the best thereof, even the hallowed part thereof out of it.

entries.yo: Nitorina ki iwọ ki o wi fun wọn pe, Nigbati ẹnyin ba fi eyiti o dara ninu rẹ̀ ṣe ẹbọ igbesọsoke, nigbana ni ki a kà a fun awọn ọmọ Lefi bi ọkà ilẹ-ipakà, ati bi ibisi ibi-ifunti.
entries.en: Therefore thou shalt say unto them, When ye have heaved the best thereof from it, then it shall be counted unto the Levites as the increase of the threshingfloor, and as the increase of the winepress.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin o si jẹ ẹ ni ibi gbogbo, ati ẹnyin ati awọn ara ile nyin: nitoripe ère nyin ni fun iṣẹ-ìsin nyin ninu agọ́ ajọ.
entries.en: And ye shall eat it in every place, ye and your households: for it is your reward for your service in the tabernacle of the congregation.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin ki yio si rù ẹ̀ṣẹ nitori rẹ̀, nigbati ẹnyin ba fi eyiti o dara ninu rẹ̀ ṣe ẹbọ igbesọsoke: bẹ̃li ẹnyin kò gbọdọ bà ohun mimọ́ awọn ọmọ Israeli jẹ́, ki ẹnyin ki o má ba kú.
entries.en: And ye shall bear no sin by reason of it, when ye have heaved from it the best of it: neither shall ye pollute the holy things of the children of Israel, lest ye die.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose ati fun Aaroni pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

entries.yo: Eyi ni ìlana ofin, ti OLUWA palaṣẹ, wipe, Sọ fun awọn ọmọ Israeli, ki nwọn ki o mú ẹgbọrọ abomalu pupa kan tọ̀ ọ wá, alailabawọ́n, ati alailabùku, ati lara eyiti a kò ti dì àjaga mọ́:
entries.en: This is the ordinance of the law which the LORD hath commanded, saying, Speak unto the children of Israel, that they bring thee a red heifer without spot, wherein is no blemish, and upon which never came yoke:

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin si fi i fun Eleasari alufa, ki on ki o mú u jade lọ sẹhin ibudó, ki ẹnikan ki o si pa a niwaju rẹ̀:
entries.en: And ye shall give her unto Eleazar the priest, that he may bring her forth without the camp, and one shall slay her before his face:

entries.yo: Ki Eleasari alufa, ki o fi iká rẹ̀ mú ninu ẹ̀jẹ rẹ̀, ki o si fi ninu ẹ̀jẹ rẹ̀ wọ́n iwaju agọ́ ajọ ni ìgba meje.
entries.en: And Eleazar the priest shall take of her blood with his finger, and sprinkle of her blood directly before the tabernacle of the congregation seven times:

entries.yo: Ki ẹnikan ki o si sun ẹgbọrọ abomalu na li oju rẹ̀; awọ rẹ̀, ati ẹran rẹ̀, ati ẹ̀jẹ rẹ̀, pẹlu igbẹ́ rẹ̀, ni ki o sun:
entries.en: And one shall burn the heifer in his sight; her skin, and her flesh, and her blood, with her dung, shall he burn:

entries.yo: Ki alufa na ki o mú igi opepe, ati hissopu, ati ododó, ki o si jù u sãrin ẹgbọrọ abomalu ti a nsun.
entries.en: And the priest shall take cedar wood, and hyssop, and scarlet, and cast it into the midst of the burning of the heifer.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ki alufa na ki o fọ̀ ãṣọ rẹ̀, ki o si wẹ̀ ara rẹ̀ ninu omi, lẹhin na ki o si wá si ibudó, ki alufa na ki o si jẹ́ alaimọ́ titi di aṣalẹ.
entries.en: Then the priest shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp, and the priest shall be unclean until the even.

entries.yo: Ki ẹniti o sun u ki o si fọ̀ aṣọ rẹ̀ ninu omi, ki o si wẹ̀ ara rẹ̀ ninu omi, ki o si jẹ́ alaimọ́ titi di aṣalẹ.
entries.en: And he that burneth her shall wash his clothes in water, and bathe his flesh in water, and shall be unclean until the even.

entries.yo: Ki ọkunrin kan ti o mọ́ ki o si kó ẽru ẹgbọrọ abomalu na, ki o si kó o jọ si ibi kan ti o mọ́ lẹhin ibudó, ki a si pa a mọ́ fun ijọ awọn ọmọ Israeli fun omi ìyasapakan: ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ ni.
entries.en: And a man that is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer, and lay them up without the camp in a clean place, and it shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Israel for a water of separation: it is a purification for sin.

entries.yo: Ki ẹniti o si kó ẽru ẹgbọrọ abomalu na ki o fọ̀ aṣọ rẹ̀, ki o si jẹ́ alaimọ́ titi di aṣalẹ: yio si jẹ́ ilana titilai, fun awọn ọmọ Israeli, ati fun alejò ti nṣe atipo ninu wọn.
entries.en: And he that gathereth the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: and it shall be unto the children of Israel, and unto the stranger that sojourneth among them, for a statute for ever.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba fọwọkàn okú ẹnikan ki o jẹ́ alaimọ ni ijọ́ meje.
entries.en: He that toucheth the dead body of any man shall be unclean seven days.

entries.yo: Ki oluwarẹ̀ ki o fi i wẹ̀ ara rẹ̀ mọ́ ni ijọ́ kẹta, ati ni ijọ́ keje yio di mimọ́: ṣugbọn bi kò ba wẹ̀ ara rẹ̀ ni ijọ́ kẹta, njẹ ni ijọ́ keje ki yio di mimọ́.
entries.en: He shall purify himself with it on the third day, and on the seventh day he shall be clean: but if he purify not himself the third day, then the seventh day he shall not be clean.

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni ti o ba fọwọkàn okú ẹnikan ti o kú, ti kò si wẹ̀ ara rẹ̀ mọ́, o bà agọ́ OLUWA jẹ́; ọkàn na li a o si ke kuro ninu Israeli: nitoriti a kò wọ́n omi ìyasapakan si i lara, alaimọ́ li o jẹ̀; aimọ́ rẹ̀ mbẹ lara rẹ̀ sibẹ̀,
entries.en: Whosoever toucheth the dead body of any man that is dead, and purifieth not himself, defileth the tabernacle of the LORD; and that soul shall be cut off from Israel: because the water of separation was not sprinkled upon him, he shall be unclean; his uncleanness is yet upon him.

entries.yo: Eyi li ofin na, nigbati enia kan ba kú ninu agọ́ kan: gbogbo ẹniti o wọ̀ inu agọ́ na, ati ohun gbogbo ti mbẹ ninu agọ́ na, yio jẹ́ alaimọ́ ni ijọ́ meje.
entries.en: This is the law, when a man dieth in a tent: all that come into the tent, and all that is in the tent, shall be unclean seven days.

entries.yo: Ati ohun-èlo gbogbo ti o ṣi silẹ, ti kò ní ideri lori rẹ̀, alaimọ́ ni.
entries.en: And every open vessel, which hath no covering bound upon it, is unclean.

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni ti o ba si fọwọkàn ẹnikan ti a fi idà pa ni gbangba igbẹ́, tabi okú kan, tabi egungun ẹnikan, tabi isà-okú, yio jẹ́ alaimọ́ ni ijọ́ meje.
entries.en: And whosoever toucheth one that is slain with a sword in the open fields, or a dead body, or a bone of a man, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.

entries.yo: Ati fun ẹni aimọ́ kan ki nwọn ki o mú ninu ẽru sisun ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ nì, ki a si bù omi ti nṣàn si i ninu ohun-èlo kan:
entries.en: And for an unclean person they shall take of the ashes of the burnt heifer of purification for sin, and running water shall be put thereto in a vessel:

entries.yo: Ki ẹnikan ti o mọ́ ki o si mú hissopu, ki o si tẹ̀ ẹ bọ̀ inu omi na, ki o si fi i wọ́n agọ́ na, ati ohun-èlo gbogbo, ati sara awọn enia ti o wá nibẹ̀, ati sara ẹniti o fọwọkàn egungun kan, tabi ẹnikan ti a pa, tabi ẹnikan ti o kú, tabi isà-okú:
entries.en: And a clean person shall take hyssop, and dip it in the water, and sprinkle it upon the tent, and upon all the vessels, and upon the persons that were there, and upon him that touched a bone, or one slain, or one dead, or a grave:

entries.yo: Ki ẹniti o mọ́ na ki o si bùwọ́n alaimọ́ na ni ijọ́ kẹta, ati ni ijọ́ keje: ati ni ijọ́ keje ki o si wẹ̀ ara rẹ̀ mọ́; ki o si fọ̀ aṣọ rẹ̀, ki o si wẹ̀ ara rẹ̀ ninu omì, yio si di mimọ́ li aṣalẹ.
entries.en: And the clean person shall sprinkle upon the unclean on the third day, and on the seventh day: and on the seventh day he shall purify himself, and wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and shall be clean at even.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹniti o ba jẹ́ alaimọ́, ti kò ba wẹ̀ ara rẹ̀ mọ́, ọkàn na li a o ke kuro ninu ijọ, nitoriti o bà ibi-mimọ́ OLUWA jẹ́: a kò si ta omi ìyasapakan si i lara; alaimọ́ li on.
entries.en: But the man that shall be unclean, and shall not purify himself, that soul shall be cut off from among the congregation, because he hath defiled the sanctuary of the LORD: the water of separation hath not been sprinkled upon him; he is unclean.

entries.yo: Yio si ma jẹ́ ìlana lailai fun wọn, pe ẹniti o ba bú omi ìyasapakan wọ́n ẹni, ki o fọ̀ aṣọ rẹ̀; ati ẹniti o si fọwọkàn omi ìyasapakan na yio jẹ́ alaimọ́ titi di aṣalẹ.
entries.en: And it shall be a perpetual statute unto them, that he that sprinkleth the water of separation shall wash his clothes; and he that toucheth the water of separation shall be unclean until even.

entries.yo: Ati ohunkohun ti ẹni aimọ́ na ba si farakàn, yio jẹ́ alaimọ́; ọkàn ti o ba si farakàn a, yio jẹ́ alaimọ́ titi di aṣalẹ.
entries.en: And whatsoever the unclean person toucheth shall be unclean; and the soul that toucheth it shall be unclean until even.

entries.yo: AWỌN ọmọ Israeli si wá, ani gbogbo ijọ, si aginjù Sini li oṣù kini: awọn enia na si joko ni Kadeṣi; Miriamu si kú nibẹ̀, a si sin i nibẹ̀.
entries.en: Then came the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, into the desert of Zin in the first month: and the people abode in Kadesh; and Miriam died there, and was buried there.
