entries.yo: Omi kò si sí fun ijọ: nwọn si kó ara wọn jọ pọ̀ si Mose ati si Aaroni.
entries.en: And there was no water for the congregation: and they gathered themselves together against Moses and against Aaron.

entries.yo: Awọn enia si mbá Mose sọ̀, nwọn si wipe, Awa iba kuku ti kú nigbati awọn arakunrin wa kú niwaju OLUWA!
entries.en: And the people chode with Moses, and spake, saying, Would God that we had died when our brethren died before the LORD!

entries.yo: Ẽha si ti ṣe ti ẹnyin fi mú ijọ OLUWA wá si aginjù yi, ki awa ati ẹran wá ki o kú nibẹ̀?
entries.en: And why have ye brought up the congregation of the LORD into this wilderness, that we and our cattle should die there?

entries.yo: Ẽha si ti ṣe ti ẹnyin fi mú wa gòke ti Egipti wá, lati mú wa wá si ibi buburu yi? ki iṣe ibi irugbìn, tabi ti ọpọtọ, tabi ti àjara, tabi ti pomegranate; bẹ̃ni kò sí omi lati mu.
entries.en: And wherefore have ye made us to come up out of Egypt, to bring us in unto this evil place? it is no place of seed, or of figs, or of vines, or of pomegranates; neither is there any water to drink.

entries.yo: Mose ati Aaroni si lọ kuro niwaju ijọ si ẹnu-ọ̀na agọ́ ajọ, nwọn si doju wọn bolẹ: ogo OLUWA si hàn si wọn.
entries.en: And Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and they fell upon their faces: and the glory of the LORD appeared unto them.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Mú ọpá nì, ki o si pe ijọ awọn enia jọ, iwọ, ati Aaroni arakunrin rẹ, ki ẹ sọ̀rọ si apata nì li oju wọn, yio si tú omi rẹ̀ jade; iwọ o si mú omi lati inu apata na jade fun wọn wá: iwọ o si fi fun ijọ ati fun ẹran wọn mu.
entries.en: Take the rod, and gather thou the assembly together, thou, and Aaron thy brother, and speak ye unto the rock before their eyes; and it shall give forth his water, and thou shalt bring forth to them water out of the rock: so thou shalt give the congregation and their beasts drink.

entries.yo: Mose si mú ọpá na lati iwaju OLUWA lọ, bi o ti fun u li aṣẹ.
entries.en: And Moses took the rod from before the LORD, as he commanded him.

entries.yo: Mose ati Aaroni si pe ijọ awọn enia jọ niwaju apata na, o si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹnyin gbọ̀ nisisiyi, ẹnyin ọlọtẹ; ki awa ki o ha mú omi lati inu apata yi fun nyin wá bi?
entries.en: And Moses and Aaron gathered the congregation together before the rock, and he said unto them, Hear now, ye rebels; must we fetch you water out of this rock?

entries.yo: Mose si gbé ọwọ́ rẹ̀ soke, o si fi ọpá rẹ̀ lù apata na lẹ̃meji: omi si tú jade li ọ̀pọlọpọ, ijọ awọn enia si mu, ati ẹran wọn pẹlu.
entries.en: And Moses lifted up his hand, and with his rod he smote the rock twice: and the water came out abundantly, and the congregation drank, and their beasts also.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose ati fun Aaroni pe, Nitoriti ẹnyin kò gbà mi gbọ́, lati yà mi simimọ́ loju awọn ọmọ Israeli, nitorina ẹnyin ki yio mú ijọ awọn enia yi lọ si ilẹ na ti mo fi fun wọn.
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses and Aaron, Because ye believed me not, to sanctify me in the eyes of the children of Israel, therefore ye shall not bring this congregation into the land which I have given them.

entries.yo: Wọnyi li omi Meriba; nitoriti awọn ọmọ Israeli bá OLUWA sọ̀, o si di ẹni ìya-simimọ́ ninu wọn.
entries.en: This is the water of Meribah; because the children of Israel strove with the LORD, and he was sanctified in them.

entries.yo: Mose si rán onṣẹ lati Kadeṣi si ọba Edomu, wipe, Bayi ni Israeli arakunrin rẹ wi, Iwọ sá mọ̀ gbogbo ìrin ti o bá wa:
entries.en: And Moses sent messengers from Kadesh unto the king of Edom, Thus saith thy brother Israel, Thou knowest all the travail that hath befallen us:

entries.yo: Bi awọn baba wa ti sọkalẹ lọ si Egipti, ti awa si ti gbé Egipti ni ìgba pipẹ; awọn ara Egipti si ni wa lara, ati awọn baba wa:
entries.en: How our fathers went down into Egypt, and we have dwelt in Egypt a long time; and the Egyptians vexed us, and our fathers:

entries.yo: Nigbati awa si kepè OLUWA, o gbọ́ ohùn wa, o si rán angeli kan, o si mú wa lati Egipti jade wá; si kiyesi i, awa mbẹ ni Kadeṣi, ilu kan ni ipinlẹ àgbegbe rẹ:
entries.en: And when we cried unto the LORD, he heard our voice, and sent an angel, and hath brought us forth out of Egypt: and, behold, we are in Kadesh, a city in the uttermost of thy border:

entries.yo: Jẹ ki awa ki o là ilẹ rẹ kọja lọ, awa bẹ̀ ọ: awa ki yio là inu oko rẹ, tabi inu ọgbà-àjara, bẹ̃li awa ki yio mu ninu omi kanga: ọ̀na opópo ọba li awa o gbà, awa ki o yà si ọwọ́ ọtún tabi si òsi, titi awa o fi kọja ipinlẹ rẹ.
entries.en: Let us pass, I pray thee, through thy country: we will not pass through the fields, or through the vineyards, neither will we drink of the water of the wells: we will go by the king's highway, we will not turn to the right hand nor to the left, until we have passed thy borders.

entries.yo: Edomu si wi fun u pe, Iwọ ki yio kọja lọdọ mi, ki emi ki o má ba jade si ọ ti emi ti idà.
entries.en: And Edom said unto him, Thou shalt not pass by me, lest I come out against thee with the sword.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Israeli si wi fun u pe, Ọ̀na opópo ọba li awa o gbà: bi awa ba mu ninu omi rẹ, emi ati ẹran mi, njẹ emi o san owo rẹ̀: laiṣe ohun miran, ki nsá fi ẹsẹ̀ mi là ilẹ kọja.
entries.en: And the children of Israel said unto him, We will go by the high way: and if I and my cattle drink of thy water, then I will pay for it: I will only, without doing any thing else, go through on my feet.

entries.yo: O si wipe, Iwọ ki yio là ilẹ kọja. Edomu si mú ọ̀pọ enia jade tọ̀ ọ wá pẹlu ọwọ́ agbara.
entries.en: And he said, Thou shalt not go through. And Edom came out against him with much people, and with a strong hand.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li Edomu kọ̀ lati fi ọ̀na fun Israeli li àgbegbe rẹ̀: Israeli si ṣẹri kuro lọdọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his border: wherefore Israel turned away from him.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Israeli, ani gbogbo ijọ si ṣí kuro ni Kadeṣi, nwọn si wá si òke Hori.
entries.en: And the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, journeyed from Kadesh, and came unto mount Hor.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose ati fun Aaroni li òke Hori li àgbegbe ilẹ Edomu wipe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses and Aaron in mount Hor, by the coast of the land of Edom, saying,

entries.yo: A o kó Aaroni jọ pẹlu awọn enia rẹ̀: nitoripe on ki yio wọ̀ inu ilẹ na ti mo fi fun awọn ọmọ Israeli, nitoriti ẹnyin ṣọ̀tẹ si aṣẹ mi, nibi omi Meriba.
entries.en: Aaron shall be gathered unto his people: for he shall not enter into the land which I have given unto the children of Israel, because ye rebelled against my word at the water of Meribah.

entries.yo: Mú Aaroni ati Eleasari ọmọ rẹ̀, ki o si mú wọn wá si ori-òke Hori:
entries.en: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son, and bring them up unto mount Hor:

entries.yo: Ki o si bọ́ Aaroni li aṣọ rẹ̀, ki o si fi wọn wọ̀ Eleasari ọmọ rẹ̀: a o si kó Aaroni jọ pẹlu awọn enia rẹ̀, yio si kú nibẹ̀.
entries.en: And strip Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son: and Aaron shall be gathered unto his people, and shall die there.

entries.yo: Mose si ṣe bi OLUWA ti fun u li aṣẹ: nwọn si gòke lọ si ori òke Hori li oju gbogbo ijọ.
entries.en: And Moses did as the LORD commanded: and they went up into mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.

entries.yo: Mose si bọ́ Aaroni li aṣọ rẹ̀, o si fi wọn wọ̀ Eleasari ọmọ rẹ̀; Aaroni si kú nibẹ̀ li ori òke na: Mose ati Eleasari si sọkalẹ lati ori òke na wá.
entries.en: And Moses stripped Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son; and Aaron died there in the top of the mount: and Moses and Eleazar came down from the mount.

entries.yo: Nigbati gbogbo ijọ ri pe Aaroni kú, nwọn ṣọfọ Aaroni li ọgbọ̀n ọjọ́, ani gbogbo ile Israeli.
entries.en: And when all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead, they mourned for Aaron thirty days, even all the house of Israel.

entries.yo: Ẹni ara Kenaani, ọba Aradi, ti ngbé ìha Gusù, gbọ́ pe Israeli gbà ọ̀na amí yọ; nigbana li o bá Israeli jà, o si mú ninu wọn ni igbekun.
entries.en: And when king Arad the Canaanite, which dwelt in the south, heard tell that Israel came by the way of the spies; then he fought against Israel, and took some of them prisoners.

entries.yo: Israeli si jẹ́ ẹjẹ́ fun OLUWA, wipe, Bi iwọ ba fi awọn enia yi lé mi lọwọ nitõtọ, njẹ emi o run ilu wọn patapata.
entries.en: And Israel vowed a vow unto the LORD, and said, If thou wilt indeed deliver this people into my hand, then I will utterly destroy their cities.

entries.yo: OLUWA si gbọ́ ohùn Israeli, o si fi awọn ara Kenaani tọrẹ, nwọn si run wọn patapata, ati ilu wọn: o si sọ orukọ ibẹ̀ na ni Horma.
entries.en: And the LORD hearkened to the voice of Israel, and delivered up the Canaanites; and they utterly destroyed them and their cities: and he called the name of the place Hormah.

entries.yo: Nwọn si rìn lati òke Hori lọ li ọ̀na Okun Pupa, lati yi ilẹ Edomu ká: sũru si tán awọn enia na pupọ̀pupọ nitori ọ̀na na.
entries.en: And they journeyed from mount Hor by the way of the Red sea, to compass the land of Edom: and the soul of the people was much discouraged because of the way.

entries.yo: Awọn enia na si bá Ọlọrun, ati Mose sọ̀ pe, Ẽṣe ti ẹnyin fi mú wa gòke lati Egipti jade wá lati kú li aginjù? nitoripe àkara kò sí, bẹ̃ni kò sí omi; onjẹ futẹfutẹ yi si sú ọkàn wa.
entries.en: And the people spake against God, and against Moses, Wherefore have ye brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? for there is no bread, neither is there any water; and our soul loatheth this light bread.

entries.yo: OLUWA si rán ejò amubina si awọn enia na, nwọn si bù awọn enia na ṣan; ọ̀pọlọpọ ninu Israeli si kú.
entries.en: And the LORD sent fiery serpents among the people, and they bit the people; and much people of Israel died.

entries.yo: Nitorina li awọn enia na ṣe tọ̀ Mose wá, nwọn si wipe, Awa ti ṣẹ̀, nitoriti awa ti bá OLUWA ati iwọ sọ̀; gbadura si OLUWA ki o mú ejò wọnyi kuro lọdọ wa. Mose si gbadura fun awọn enia na.
entries.en: Therefore the people came to Moses, and said, We have sinned, for we have spoken against the LORD, and against thee; pray unto the LORD, that he take away the serpents from us. And Moses prayed for the people.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun Mose pe, Rọ ejò amubina kan, ki o si fi i sori ọpá-gigùn kan: yio si ṣe, olukuluku ẹniti ejò ba bùṣan, nigbati o ba wò o, yio yè.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Make thee a fiery serpent, and set it upon a pole: and it shall come to pass, that every one that is bitten, when he looketh upon it, shall live.

entries.yo: Mose si rọ ejò idẹ kan, o si fi i sori ọpá-gigùn na: o si ṣe, pe bi ejò kan ba bù enia kan ṣan, nigbati o ba wò ejò idẹ na, on a yè.
entries.en: And Moses made a serpent of brass, and put it upon a pole, and it came to pass, that if a serpent had bitten any man, when he beheld the serpent of brass, he lived.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Israeli si ṣi siwaju, nwọn si dó ni Obotu.
entries.en: And the children of Israel set forward, and pitched in Oboth.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣi lati Obotu lọ, nwọn si dó si Iye-abarimu, li aginjù ti mbẹ niwaju Moabu, ni ìha ìla-õrùn.
entries.en: And they journeyed from Oboth, and pitched at Ije-abarim, in the wilderness which is before Moab, toward the sunrising.

entries.yo: Lati ibẹ̀ lọ nwọn ṣí, nwọn si dó si afonifoji Seredi.
entries.en: From thence they removed, and pitched in the valley of Zared.

entries.yo: Lati ibẹ̀ lọ nwọn ṣí, nwọn si dó si ìha keji Arnoni, ti mbẹ li aginjù, ti o ti àgbegbe awọn ọmọ Amori wá: nitoripe Arnoni ni ipinlẹ Moabu, lãrin Moabu ati awọn Amori.
entries.en: From thence they removed, and pitched on the other side of Arnon, which is in the wilderness that cometh out of the coasts of the Amorites: for Arnon is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni a ṣe wi ninu iwé Ogun OLUWA pe, Ohun ti o ṣe li Okun Pupa, ati li odò Arnoni.
entries.en: Wherefore it is said in the book of the wars of the LORD, What he did in the Red sea, and in the brooks of Arnon,

entries.yo: Ati ni iṣàn-odò nì ti o darí si ibujoko Ari, ti o si gbè ipinlẹ Moabu.
entries.en: And at the stream of the brooks that goeth down to the dwelling of Ar, and lieth upon the border of Moab.

entries.yo: Lati ibẹ̀ nwọn si lọ si Beeri: eyinì ni kanga eyiti OLUWA sọ fun Mose pe, Pe awọn enia jọ, emi o si fun wọn li omi.
entries.en: And from thence they went to Beer: that is the well whereof the LORD spake unto Moses, Gather the people together, and I will give them water.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Israeli kọrin yi pe: Sun jade iwọ kanga; ẹ ma kọrin si i:
entries.en: Then Israel sang this song, Spring up, O well; sing ye unto it:

entries.yo: Kanga na, ti awọn olori wà, ti awọn ọlọlá awọn enia si fi ọpá-alade na, ati ọpá wọn wà. Ati lati aginjù na, nwọn lọ si Mattana.
entries.en: The princes digged the well, the nobles of the people digged it, by the direction of the lawgiver, with their staves. And from the wilderness they went to Mattanah:

entries.yo: Ati Mattana nwọn lọ si Nahalieli: ati lati Nahalieli nwọn lọ si Bamotu:
entries.en: And from Mattanah to Nahaliel: and from Nahaliel to Bamoth:

entries.yo: Ati lati Bamotu li afonifoji nì, ti mbẹ ni ilẹ Moabu, si óke Pisga, ti o si kọjusi aginjù.
entries.en: And from Bamoth in the valley, that is in the country of Moab, to the top of Pisgah, which looketh toward Jeshimon.

entries.yo: Israeli si rán onṣẹ si Sihoni ọba awọn ọmọ Amori, wipe,
entries.en: And Israel sent messengers unto Sihon king of the Amorites, saying,

entries.yo: Jẹ ki emi là ilẹ rẹ kọja lọ: awa ki yio yà sinu oko, tabi ọgba-àjara; awa ki yio mu ninu omi kanga: ọ̀na opópo ọba li a o gbà, titi awa o fi kọja ipinlẹ rẹ.
entries.en: Let me pass through thy land: we will not turn into the fields, or into the vineyards; we will not drink of the waters of the well: but we will go along by the king's high way, until we be past thy borders.

entries.yo: Sihoni kò si jẹ ki Israeli ki o là àgbegbe rẹ̀ kọja: ṣugbọn Sihoni kó gbogbo awọn enia rẹ̀ jọ, nwọn si jade tọ̀ Israeli lọ li aginjù, o si wá si Jahasi, o bá Israeli jà.
entries.en: And Sihon would not suffer Israel to pass through his border: but Sihon gathered all his people together, and went out against Israel into the wilderness: and he came to Jahaz, and fought against Israel.

entries.yo: Israeli si fi oju idà kọlù u, o si gbà ilẹ rẹ̀ lati Arnoni lọ dé Jaboku, ani dé ti awọn ọmọ Ammoni; nitoripe ipinlẹ ti awọn ọmọ Ammoni lí agbara.
entries.en: And Israel smote him with the edge of the sword, and possessed his land from Arnon unto Jabbok, even unto the children of Ammon: for the border of the children of Ammon was strong.

entries.yo: Israeli si gbà gbogbo ilunla wọnni: Israeli si joko ninu gbogbo ilunla ti awọn ọmọ Amori, ni Heṣboni, ati ni ilu rẹ̀ gbogbo.
entries.en: And Israel took all these cities: and Israel dwelt in all the cities of the Amorites, in Heshbon, and in all the villages thereof.

entries.yo: Nitoripe Heṣboni ni ilunla Sihoni ọba awọn ọmọ Amori, ẹniti o ti bá ọba Moabu atijọ jà, ti o si gbà gbogbo ilẹ rẹ̀ li ọwọ́ rẹ̀, titi dé Arnoni.
entries.en: For Heshbon was the city of Sihon the king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab, and taken all his land out of his hand, even unto Arnon.

entries.yo: Nitorina awọn ti nkọrin owe a ma wipe, Wá si Heṣboni, jẹ ki a tẹ̀ ilunla Sihoni dó ki a si tun fi idi rẹ̀ mulẹ:
entries.en: Wherefore they that speak in proverbs say, Come into Heshbon, let the city of Sihon be built and prepared:

entries.yo: Nitoriti iná kan ti Heṣboni jade lọ, ọwọ́-iná kan lati ilunla Sihoni: o si run Ari ti Moabu, ati awọn oluwa ibi giga Arnoni.
entries.en: For there is a fire gone out of Heshbon, a flame from the city of Sihon: it hath consumed Ar of Moab, and the lords of the high places of Arnon.

entries.yo: Egbé ni fun iwọ, Moabu! Ẹ gbé, ẹnyin enia Kemoṣi: on ti fi awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ ọkunrin bi isansa, ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ obinrin bi igbekun, fun Sihoni ọba awọn ọmọ Amori.
entries.en: Woe to thee, Moab! thou art undone, O people of Chemosh: he hath given his sons that escaped, and his daughters, into captivity unto Sihon king of the Amorites.

entries.yo: Awa tafà si wọn; Heṣboni ṣegbé titi dé Diboni, awa si ti run wọn titi dé Nofa, ti o dé Medeba.
entries.en: We have shot at them; Heshbon is perished even unto Dibon, and we have laid them waste even unto Nophah, which reacheth unto Medeba.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li awọn ọmọ Israeli joko ni ilẹ awọn ọmọ Amori.
entries.en: Thus Israel dwelt in the land of the Amorites.

entries.yo: Mose si rán enia lọ ṣe amí Jaseri, nwọn si gbà ilu rẹ̀, nwọn si lé awọn ọmọ Amori ti o wà nibẹ̀.
entries.en: And Moses sent to spy out Jaazer, and they took the villages thereof, and drove out the Amorites that were there.

entries.yo: Nwọn si yipada, nwọn si gòke lọ li ọ̀na Baṣani: Ogu ọba Baṣani si jade tọ̀ wọn lọ, on, ati gbogbo awọn enia rẹ̀, si ogun ni Edrei.
entries.en: And they turned and went up by the way of Bashan: and Og the king of Bashan went out against them, he, and all his people, to the battle at Edrei.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun Mose pe, Máṣe bẹ̀ru rẹ̀: nitoripe mo ti fi on lé ọ lọwọ, ati gbogbo awọn enia rẹ̀, ati ilẹ rẹ̀; ki iwọ ki o si ṣe si i bi iwọ ti ṣe si Sihoni ọba awọn ọmọ Amori, ti ngbé Heṣboni.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Fear him not: for I have delivered him into thy hand, and all his people, and his land; and thou shalt do to him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites, which dwelt at Heshbon.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni nwọn si kọlù u, ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, ati gbogbo awọn enia rẹ̀, titi kò fi kù ọkan silẹ fun u lãye: nwọn si gbà ile rẹ̀.
entries.en: So they smote him, and his sons, and all his people, until there was none left him alive: and they possessed his land.

entries.yo: AWỌN ọmọ Israeli si ṣí, nwọn si dó si pẹtẹlẹ̀ Moabu li apa keji Jordani ti o kọjusi Jeriko.
entries.en: And the children of Israel set forward, and pitched in the plains of Moab on this side Jordan by Jericho.

entries.yo: Balaki ọmọ Sippori si ri gbogbo eyiti Israeli ti ṣe si awọn ọmọ Amori.
entries.en: And Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites.

entries.yo: Moabu si bẹ̀ru awọn enia na gidigidi, nitoriti nwọn pọ̀: aisimi si bá Moabu nitori awọn ọmọ Israeli.
entries.en: And Moab was sore afraid of the people, because they were many: and Moab was distressed because of the children of Israel.

entries.yo: Moabu si wi fun awọn àgba Midiani pe, Nisisiyi li awọn ẹgbẹ yi yio lá ohun gbogbo ti o yi wa ká, bi akọmalu ti ilá koriko igbẹ́. Balaki ọmọ Sippori si jẹ́ ọba awọn ara Moabu ni ìgba na.
entries.en: And Moab said unto the elders of Midian, Now shall this company lick up all that are round about us, as the ox licketh up the grass of the field. And Balak the son of Zippor was king of the Moabites at that time.

entries.yo: O si ránṣẹ si Balaamu ọmọ Beori si Petori, ti o wà lẹba Odò, si ilẹ awọn ọmọ enia rẹ̀, lati pè e wá, wipe, Wò o, awọn enia kan ti ilẹ Egipti jade wá: si kiyesi i, nwọn bò oju ilẹ, nwọn si joko tì mi:
entries.en: He sent messengers therefore unto Balaam the son of Beor to Pethor, which is by the river of the land of the children of his people, to call him, saying, Behold, there is a people come out from Egypt: behold, they cover the face of the earth, and they abide over against me:

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi wa, emi bẹ̀ ọ, fi awọn enia yi bú fun mi; nitoriti nwọn lí agbara jù fun mi; bọya emi o bori, ki awa ki o kọlù wọn, ki emi ki o le lé wọn lọ kuro ni ilẹ yi: nitoriti emi mọ̀ pe ibukún ni fun ẹniti iwọ ba bukún, ifibú si ni ẹniti iwọ ba fibú.
entries.en: Come now therefore, I pray thee, curse me this people; for they are too mighty for me: peradventure I shall prevail, that we may smite them, and that I may drive them out of the land: for I wot that he whom thou blessest is blessed, and he whom thou cursest is cursed.

entries.yo: Ati awọn àgba Moabu, ati awọn àgba Midiani dide lọ ti awọn ti ọrẹ ìbere-afọṣẹ li ọwọ́ wọn; nwọn si tọ̀ Balaamu wá, nwọn si sọ ọ̀rọ Balaki fun u.
entries.en: And the elders of Moab and the elders of Midian departed with the rewards of divination in their hand; and they came unto Balaam, and spake unto him the words of Balak.

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ wọ̀ nihin li alẹ yi, emi o si mú ọ̀rọ pada tọ̀ nyin wá, bi OLUWA yio ti sọ fun mi: awọn ijoye Moabu si wọ̀ sọdọ Balaamu.
entries.en: And he said unto them, Lodge here this night, and I will bring you word again, as the LORD shall speak unto me: and the princes of Moab abode with Balaam.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si tọ̀ Balaamu wá, o si wipe, Awọn ọkunrin wo ni wọnyi lọdọ rẹ?
entries.en: And God came unto Balaam, and said, What men are these with thee?

entries.yo: Balaamu si wi fun Ọlọrun pe, Balaki ọmọ Sippori, ọba Moabu, li o ranṣẹ si mi pe,
entries.en: And Balaam said unto God, Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, hath sent unto me, saying,

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, awọn enia kan ti ilẹ Egipti jade wá, ti o bò oju ilẹ: wá nisisiyi, fi wọn bú fun mi; bọya emi o le bá wọn jà, emi a si lé wọn lọ.
entries.en: Behold, there is a people come out of Egypt, which covereth the face of the earth: come now, curse me them; peradventure I shall be able to overcome them, and drive them out.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si wi fun Balaamu pe, Iwọ kò gbọdọ bá wọn lọ; iwọ kò gbọdọ fi awọn enia na bú: nitoripe ẹni ibukún ni nwọn.
entries.en: And God said unto Balaam, Thou shalt not go with them; thou shalt not curse the people: for they are blessed.

entries.yo: Balaamu si dide li owurọ̀, o si wi fun awọn ijoye Balaki pe, Ẹ ma ba ti nyin lọ si ilẹ nyin: nitoriti OLUWA kọ̀ lati jẹ ki mbá nyin lọ.
entries.en: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and said unto the princes of Balak, Get you into your land: for the LORD refuseth to give me leave to go with you.

entries.yo: Awọn ijoye Moabu si dide, nwọn si tọ̀ Balaki lọ, nwọn si wipe, Balaamu kọ̀ lati bá wa wá.
entries.en: And the princes of Moab rose up, and they went unto Balak, and said, Balaam refuseth to come with us.

entries.yo: Balaki si tun rán awọn ijoye si i, ti o si lí ọlá jù wọn lọ.
entries.en: And Balak sent yet again princes, more, and more honourable than they.

entries.yo: Nwọn tọ̀ Balaamu wá, nwọn si wi fun u pe, Bayi ni Balaki ọmọ Sippori wi pe, Emi bẹ̀ ọ, máṣe jẹ ki ohun kan ki o di ọ lọwọ lati tọ̀ mi wá:
entries.en: And they came to Balaam, and said to him, Thus saith Balak the son of Zippor, Let nothing, I pray thee, hinder thee from coming unto me:

entries.yo: Nitoripe, emi o sọ ọ di ẹni nla gidigidi, emi o si ṣe ohunkohun ti iwọ wi fun mi: nitorina wá, emi bẹ̀ ọ, fi awọn enia yi bú fun mi.
entries.en: For I will promote thee unto very great honour, and I will do whatsoever thou sayest unto me: come therefore, I pray thee, curse me this people.

entries.yo: Balaamu si dahùn o si wi fun awọn iranṣẹ Balaki pe, Balaki iba fẹ́ fun mi ni ile rẹ̀ ti o kún fun fadaká ati wurà, emi kò le rekọja ọ̀rọ OLUWA Ọlọrun mi, lati ṣe ohun kekere tabi nla.
entries.en: And Balaam answered and said unto the servants of Balak, If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot go beyond the word of the LORD my God, to do less or more.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, emi bẹ̀ nyin, ẹ wọ̀ nihin pẹlu li oru yi, ki emi ki o le mọ̀ eyiti OLUWA yio wi fun mi si i.
entries.en: Now therefore, I pray you, tarry ye also here this night, that I may know what the LORD will say unto me more.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si tọ̀ Balaamu wá li oru, o si wi fun u pe, Bi awọn ọkunrin na ba wá pè ọ, dide, bá wọn lọ; ṣugbọn kìki ọ̀rọ ti emi o sọ fun ọ, eyinì ni ki iwọ ki o ṣe.
entries.en: And God came unto Balaam at night, and said unto him, If the men come to call thee, rise up, and go with them; but yet the word which I shall say unto thee, that shalt thou do.

entries.yo: Balaamu si dide li owurọ̀, o si dì kẹtẹkẹtẹ rẹ̀ ni gãri, o si bá awọn ijoye Moabu lọ.
entries.en: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and saddled his ass, and went with the princes of Moab.

entries.yo: Ibinu Ọlọrun si rú nitoriti o lọ: angeli OLUWA si duro loju ọ̀na lati di i lọ̀na. Njẹ on gùn kẹtẹkẹtẹ rẹ̀, awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀ mejeji si wà pẹlu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And God's anger was kindled because he went: and the angel of the LORD stood in the way for an adversary against him. Now he was riding upon his ass, and his two servants were with him.

entries.yo: Kẹtẹkẹtẹ na si ri angeli OLUWA duro loju ọ̀na, idà rẹ̀ fifàyọ si wà li ọwọ́ rẹ̀: kẹtẹkẹtẹ na si yà kuro loju ọ̀na, o si wọ̀ inu igbẹ́: Balaamu si lù kẹtẹkẹtẹ na, lati darí rẹ̀ soju ọ̀na.
entries.en: And the ass saw the angel of the LORD standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand: and the ass turned aside out of the way, and went into the field: and Balaam smote the ass, to turn her into the way.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni angeli OLUWA duro li ọna toro ọgbà-àjara meji, ogiri mbẹ ni ìha ihin, ati ogiri ni ìha ọhún.
entries.en: But the angel of the LORD stood in a path of the vineyards, a wall being on this side, and a wall on that side.

entries.yo: Kẹtẹkẹtẹ na si ri angeli OLUWA, o fún ara rẹ̀ mọ́ ogiri, o si fún ẹsẹ̀ Balaamu mọ́ ogiri: on si tun lù u.
entries.en: And when the ass saw the angel of the LORD, she thrust herself unto the wall, and crushed Balaam's foot against the wall: and he smote her again.

entries.yo: Angeli OLUWA si tun sun siwaju, o si tun duro ni ibi tõro kan, nibiti àye kò sí lati yà si ọwọ́ ọtún tabi si òsi.
entries.en: And the angel of the LORD went further, and stood in a narrow place, where was no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left.

entries.yo: Nigbati kẹtẹkẹtẹ na si ri angeli OLUWA, o wólẹ̀ labẹ Balaamu: ibinu Balaamu si rú pupọ̀, o si fi ọpá lu kẹtẹkẹtẹ na.
entries.en: And when the ass saw the angel of the LORD, she fell down under Balaam: and Balaam's anger was kindled, and he smote the ass with a staff.

entries.yo: OLUWA si là kẹtẹkẹtẹ na li ohùn, o si wi fun Balaamu pe, Kini mo fi ṣe ọ, ti iwọ fi lù mi ni ìgba mẹta yi?
entries.en: And the LORD opened the mouth of the ass, and she said unto Balaam, What have I done unto thee, that thou hast smitten me these three times?

entries.yo: Balaamu si wi fun kẹtẹkẹtẹ na pe, Nitoriti iwọ fi mi ṣẹsin: idà iba wà li ọwọ́ mi, nisisiyi li emi iba pa ọ.
entries.en: And Balaam said unto the ass, Because thou hast mocked me: I would there were a sword in mine hand, for now would I kill thee.

entries.yo: Kẹtẹkẹtẹ na si wi fun Balaamu pe, Kẹtẹkẹtẹ rẹ ki emi ṣe, ti iwọ ti ngùn lati ìgba ti emi ti ṣe tirẹ titi di oni? emi a ha ma ṣe si ọ bẹ̃ rí? On si dahùn wipe, Ndao.
entries.en: And the ass said unto Balaam, Am not I thine ass, upon which thou hast ridden ever since I was thine unto this day? was I ever wont to do so unto thee? And he said, Nay.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni OLUWA là Balaamu li oju, o si ri angeli OLUWA duro loju ọ̀na, idà rẹ̀ fifàyọ si wà li ọwọ́ rẹ̀: o si tẹ̀ ori ba, o si doju rẹ̀ bolẹ.
entries.en: Then the LORD opened the eyes of Balaam, and he saw the angel of the LORD standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand: and he bowed down his head, and fell flat on his face.

entries.yo: Angeli OLUWA si wi fun u pe, Ẽṣe ti iwọ fi lù kẹtẹkẹtẹ rẹ ni ìgba mẹta yi? Kiyesi i, emi jade wá lati di ọ lọ̀na, nitori ọ̀na rẹ lòdi niwaju mi.
entries.en: And the angel of the LORD said unto him, Wherefore hast thou smitten thine ass these three times? behold, I went out to withstand thee, because thy way is perverse before me:

entries.yo: Kẹtẹkẹtẹ na si ri mi, o si yà fun mi ni ìgba mẹta yi: bikoṣe bi o ti yà fun mi, pipa ni emi iba pa ọ, emi a si dá on si.
entries.en: And the ass saw me, and turned from me these three times: unless she had turned from me, surely now also I had slain thee, and saved her alive.

entries.yo: Balaamu si wi fun angeli OLUWA pe, Emi ti ṣẹ̀; nitori emi kò mọ̀ pe iwọ duro dè mi li ọ̀na; njẹ bi kò ba ṣe didùn inu rẹ, emi o pada.
entries.en: And Balaam said unto the angel of the LORD, I have sinned; for I knew not that thou stoodest in the way against me: now therefore, if it displease thee, I will get me back again.

entries.yo: Angeli OLUWA si wi fun Balaamu pe, Ma bá awọn ọkunrin na lọ: ṣugbọn kìki ọ̀rọ ti emi o sọ fun ọ, eyinì ni ki iwọ ki o sọ. Bẹ̃ni Balaamu bá awọn ijoye Balaki lọ.
entries.en: And the angel of the LORD said unto Balaam, Go with the men: but only the word that I shall speak unto thee, that thou shalt speak. So Balaam went with the princes of Balak.

entries.yo: Nigbati Balaki gbọ́ pe Balaamu dé, o jade lọ ipade rẹ̀ si Ilu Moabu, ti mbẹ ni àgbegbe Arnoni, ti iṣe ipẹkun ipinlẹ na.
entries.en: And when Balak heard that Balaam was come, he went out to meet him unto a city of Moab, which is in the border of Arnon, which is in the utmost coast.

entries.yo: Balaki si wi fun Balaamu pe, Emi kò ha ranṣẹ kanjukanju si ọ lati pè ọ? ẽṣe ti iwọ kò fi tọ̀ mi wá? emi kò ha to lati sọ ọ di ẹni nla?
entries.en: And Balak said unto Balaam, Did I not earnestly send unto thee to call thee? wherefore camest thou not unto me? am I not able indeed to promote thee to honour?

entries.yo: Balaamu si wi fun Balaki pe, Kiyesi i, emi tọ̀ ọ wá: emi ha lí agbara kan nisisiyi rára lati wi ohun kan? ọ̀rọ ti OLUWA fi si mi li ẹnu, on li emi o sọ.
entries.en: And Balaam said unto Balak, Lo, I am come unto thee: have I now any power at all to say any thing? the word that God putteth in my mouth, that shall I speak.

entries.yo: Balaamu si bá Balaki lọ, nwọn si wá si Kiriati-husotu.
entries.en: And Balaam went with Balak, and they came unto Kirjath-huzoth.

entries.yo: Balaki si rubọ akọmalu ati agutan, o si ranṣẹ si Balaamu, ati si awọn ijoye ti mbẹ pẹlu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Balak offered oxen and sheep, and sent to Balaam, and to the princes that were with him.

entries.yo: O si ṣe ni ijọ́ keji, ni Balaki mú Balaamu, o si mú u wá si ibi giga Baali, ki o ba le ri apakan awọn enia na lati ibẹ̀ lọ.
entries.en: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Balak took Balaam, and brought him up into the high places of Baal, that thence he might see the utmost part of the people.

entries.yo: BALAAMU si wi fun Balaki pe, Mọ pẹpẹ meje fun mi nihin, ki o si pèse akọ-malu meje, ati àgbo meje fun mi nihin.
entries.en: And Balaam said unto Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven oxen and seven rams.

entries.yo: Balaki si ṣe bi Balaamu ti wi; ati Balaki ati Balaamu fi akọmalu kan ati àgbo kan rubọ lori pẹpẹ kọkan.
entries.en: And Balak did as Balaam had spoken; and Balak and Balaam offered on every altar a bullock and a ram.

entries.yo: Balaamu si wi fun Balaki pe, Duro tì ẹbọ sisun rẹ, emi o si lọ; bọya OLUWA yio wá pade mi: ohunkohun ti o si fihàn mi emi o wi fun ọ. O si lọ si ibi giga kan.
entries.en: And Balaam said unto Balak, Stand by thy burnt offering, and I will go: peradventure the LORD will come to meet me: and whatsoever he sheweth me I will tell thee. And he went to an high place.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si pade Balaamu: o si wi fun u pe, Emi ti pèse pẹpẹ meje silẹ, mo si ti fi akọmalu kan ati àgbo kan rubọ lori pẹpẹ kọkan.
entries.en: And God met Balaam: and he said unto him, I have prepared seven altars, and I have offered upon every altar a bullock and a ram.

entries.yo: OLUWA si fi ọ̀rọ si Balaamu li ẹnu, o si wipe, Pada tọ̀ Balaki lọ, bayi ni ki iwọ ki o si sọ.
entries.en: And the LORD put a word in Balaam's mouth, and said, Return unto Balak, and thus thou shalt speak.

entries.yo: O si pada tọ̀ ọ lọ, si kiyesi i, on duro tì ẹbọ sisun rẹ̀, on ati gbogbo awọn ijoye Moabu.
entries.en: And he returned unto him, and, lo, he stood by his burnt sacrifice, he, and all the princes of Moab.

entries.yo: O si bẹ̀rẹsi owe rẹ̀, o si wipe, Balaki ọba Moabu mú mi lati Aramu wá, lati òke-nla ìla-õrún wá, wipe, Wá, fi Jakobu bú fun mi, si wá, ki o fi Israeli ré.
entries.en: And he took up his parable, and said, Balak the king of Moab hath brought me from Aram, out of the mountains of the east, saying, Come, curse me Jacob, and come, defy Israel.

entries.yo: Emi o ti ṣe fibú, ẹniti Ọlọrun kò fibú? tabi emi o si ti ṣe firé, ẹniti OLUWA kò firé?
entries.en: How shall I curse, whom God hath not cursed? or how shall I defy, whom the LORD hath not defied?

entries.yo: Nitoripe lati ori apata wọnni ni mo ri i, ati lati òke wọnni ni mo wò o: kiyesi i, awọn enia yi yio dágbé, a ki yio si kà wọn kún awọn orilẹ-ède.
entries.en: For from the top of the rocks I see him, and from the hills I behold him: lo, the people shall dwell alone, and shall not be reckoned among the nations.

entries.yo: Tali o le kà erupẹ Jakobu, ati iye idamẹrin Israeli? Jẹ ki emi ki o kú ikú olododo, ki igbẹhin mi ki o si dabi tirẹ̀!
entries.en: Who can count the dust of Jacob, and the number of the fourth part of Israel? Let me die the death of the righteous, and let my last end be like his!

entries.yo: Balaki si wi fun Balaamu pe, Kini iwọ nṣe si mi yi? mo mú ọ wá lati fi awọn ọtá mi bú, si kiyesi i, iwọ si sure fun wọn patapata.
entries.en: And Balak said unto Balaam, What hast thou done unto me? I took thee to curse mine enemies, and, behold, thou hast blessed them altogether.

entries.yo: On si dahùn o si wipe, Emi ha le ṣe aiṣọra lati sọ eyiti OLUWA fi si mi li ẹnu bi?
entries.en: And he answered and said, Must I not take heed to speak that which the LORD hath put in my mouth?

entries.yo: Balaki si wi fun u pe, Emi bẹ̀ ọ, bá mi lọ si ibomiran, lati ibiti iwọ o le ri wọn; kìki apakan wọn ni iwọ o ri, iwọ ki yio si ri gbogbo wọn tán; ki o si fi wọn bú fun mi lati ibẹ̀ lọ.
entries.en: And Balak said unto him, Come, I pray thee, with me unto another place, from whence thou mayest see them: thou shalt see but the utmost part of them, and shalt not see them all: and curse me them from thence.

entries.yo: O si mú u wá si igbẹ Sofimu sori òke Pisga, o si mọ pẹpẹ meje, o si fi akọmalu kan ati àgbo kan rubọ lori pẹpẹ kọkan.
entries.en: And he brought him into the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars, and offered a bullock and a ram on every altar.

entries.yo: On si wi fun Balaki pe, Duro nihin tì ẹbọ sisun rẹ, emi o si lọ ipade OLUWA lọhùn yi.
entries.en: And he said unto Balak, Stand here by thy burnt offering, while I meet the LORD yonder.

entries.yo: OLUWA si pade Balaamu, o si fi ọ̀rọ si i li ẹnu, wipe, Tun pada tọ̀ Balaki lọ, ki o si wi bayi.
entries.en: And the LORD met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, Go again unto Balak, and say thus.

entries.yo: O si tọ̀ ọ wá, kiyesi i, o duro tì ẹbọ sisun rẹ̀, ati awọn ijoye Moabu pẹlu rẹ̀. Balaki si bi i pe, Kini OLUWA sọ?
entries.en: And when he came to him, behold, he stood by his burnt offering, and the princes of Moab with him. And Balak said unto him, What hath the LORD spoken?

entries.yo: O si bẹ̀rẹsi owe rẹ̀, o si wipe, Dide, Balaki, ki o si gbọ́; ki o si fetisi mi, iwọ ọmọ Sipporu:
entries.en: And he took up his parable, and said, Rise up, Balak, and hear; hearken unto me, thou son of Zippor:

entries.yo: Ọlọrun ki iṣe enia ti yio fi ṣeké; bẹ̃ni ki iṣe ọmọ enia ti yio fi ronupiwada: a ma wi, ki o má si ṣe bi? tabi a ma sọ̀rọ ki o má mu u ṣẹ?
entries.en: God is not a man, that he should lie; neither the son of man, that he should repent: hath he said, and shall he not do it? or hath he spoken, and shall he not make it good?

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, emi gbà aṣẹ ati sure: on si ti sure, emi kò si le yì i.
entries.en: Behold, I have received commandment to bless: and he hath blessed; and I cannot reverse it.

entries.yo: On kò ri ẹ̀ṣẹ ninu Jakobu, bẹ̃ni kò ri ibi ninu Israeli: OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ̀ pẹlu rẹ̀, ihó-ayọ ọba si mbẹ ninu wọn.
entries.en: He hath not beheld iniquity in Jacob, neither hath he seen perverseness in Israel: the LORD his God is with him, and the shout of a king is among them.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun mú wọn lati Egipti jade wá; o ní agbara bi ti agbanrere.
entries.en: God brought them out of Egypt; he hath as it were the strength of an unicorn.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ kò sí ìfaiya si Jakobu, bẹ̃ni kò sí afọṣẹ si Israeli: nisisiyi li a o ma wi niti Jakobu ati niti Israeli, Ohun ti Ọlọrun ṣe!
entries.en: Surely there is no enchantment against Jacob, neither is there any divination against Israel: according to this time it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel, What hath God wrought!

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, awọn enia na yio dide bi abokiniun, yio si gbé ara rẹ̀ soke bi kiniun: on ki yio dubulẹ titi yio fi jẹ ohun ọdẹ, titi yio si fi mu ninu ẹ̀jẹ ohun pipa.
entries.en: Behold, the people shall rise up as a great lion, and lift up himself as a young lion: he shall not lie down until he eat of the prey, and drink the blood of the slain.

entries.yo: Balaki si wi fun Balaamu pe, Kuku má fi wọn bú, bẹ̃ni ki o máṣe sure fun wọn rára.
entries.en: And Balak said unto Balaam, Neither curse them at all, nor bless them at all.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Balaamu dahún, o si wi fun Balaki pe, Emi kò ha ti wi fun ọ pe, Gbogbo eyiti OLUWA ba sọ, on ni emi o ṣe?
entries.en: But Balaam answered and said unto Balak, Told not I thee, saying, All that the LORD speaketh, that I must do?

entries.yo: Balaki si wi fun Balaamu pe, Wá, emi bẹ̀ ọ, emi o mú ọ lọ si ibomiran; bọya yio wù Ọlọrun ki iwọ ki o fi wọn bú fun mi lati ibẹ̀ lọ.
entries.en: And Balak said unto Balaam, Come, I pray thee, I will bring thee unto another place; peradventure it will please God that thou mayest curse me them from thence.

entries.yo: Balaki si mú Balaamu wá sori òke Peoru, ti o kọjusi aginjù.
entries.en: And Balak brought Balaam unto the top of Peor, that looketh toward Jeshimon.

entries.yo: Balaamu si wi fun Balaki pe, Mọ pẹpẹ meje fun mi nihin, ki o si pèse akọmalu meje ati àgbo meje fun mi nihin.
entries.en: And Balaam said unto Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven bullocks and seven rams.

entries.yo: Balaki si ṣe bi Balaamu ti wi, o si fi akọmalu kan ati àgbo kan rubọ lori pẹpẹ kọkan.
entries.en: And Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered a bullock and a ram on every altar.

entries.yo: NIGBATI Balaamu ri pe o wù OLUWA lati bukún Israeli, on kò lọ mọ́ bi ìgba iṣaju, lati wá ìfaiya, ṣugbọn o doju rẹ̀ kọ aginjù.
entries.en: And when Balaam saw that it pleased the LORD to bless Israel, he went not, as at other times, to seek for enchantments, but he set his face toward the wilderness.

entries.yo: Balaamu si gbé oju rẹ̀ soke o si ri Israeli dó gẹgẹ bi ẹ̀ya wọn; ẹmi Ọlọrun si wá sara rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Balaam lifted up his eyes, and he saw Israel abiding in his tents according to their tribes; and the spirit of God came upon him.

entries.yo: O si bẹ̀rẹsi owe rẹ̀, o si wipe, Balaamu ọmọ Beori nwi, ọkunrin ti oju rẹ̀ sí nwi:
entries.en: And he took up his parable, and said, Balaam the son of Beor hath said, and the man whose eyes are open hath said:

entries.yo: Ẹniti o gbọ́ ọ̀rọ Ọlọrun nwi, ti o nri iran Olodumare, ti o nṣubu lọ, ti oju rẹ̀ ṣí.
entries.en: He hath said, which heard the words of God, which saw the vision of the Almighty, falling into a trance, but having his eyes open:

entries.yo: Jakobu, agọ́ rẹ wọnyi ti dara tó, ati ibugbé rẹ iwọ Israeli!
entries.en: How goodly are thy tents, O Jacob, and thy tabernacles, O Israel!

entries.yo: Bi afonifoji ni nwọn tẹ́ lọ bẹrẹ, bi ọgbà lẹba odònla, bi igi aloe ti OLUWA gbìn, ati bi igi kedari lẹba omi.
entries.en: As the valleys are they spread forth, as gardens by the river's side, as the trees of lign aloes which the LORD hath planted, and as cedar trees beside the waters.

entries.yo: Omi o ṣàn jade lati inu agbè rẹ̀ wá, irú rẹ̀ yio si wà ninu omi pupọ̀, ọba rẹ̀ yio si ga jù Agagi lọ, ijọba rẹ̀ li a o si gbeleke.
entries.en: He shall pour the water out of his buckets, and his seed shall be in many waters, and his king shall be higher than Agag, and his kingdom shall be exalted.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun mú u lati Egipti jade wá; o ní agbara bi ti agbanrere: on o jẹ awọn orilẹ-ède ti iṣe ọtá rẹ̀ run, yio si fọ́ egungun wọn, yio si fi ọfà rẹ̀ ta wọn li atapoyọ.
entries.en: God brought him forth out of Egypt; he hath as it were the strength of an unicorn: he shall eat up the nations his enemies, and shall break their bones, and pierce them through with his arrows.

entries.yo: O ba, o dubulẹ bi kiniun, ati bi abo-kiniun: tani yio lé e dide? Ibukún ni fun ẹniti o sure fun ọ, ifibú si ni ẹniti o fi ọ bú.
entries.en: He couched, he lay down as a lion, and as a great lion: who shall stir him up? Blessed is he that blesseth thee, and cursed is he that curseth thee.

entries.yo: Ibinu Balaki si rú si Balaamu, o si fi ọwọ́ lù ọwọ́ pọ̀: Balaki si wi fun Balaamu pe, Emi pè ọ lati fi awọn ọtá mi bú, si kiyesi i iwọ si súre fun wọn patapata ni ìgba mẹta yi.
entries.en: And Balak's anger was kindled against Balaam, and he smote his hands together: and Balak said unto Balaam, I called thee to curse mine enemies, and, behold, thou hast altogether blessed them these three times.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi sálọ si ibujoko rẹ: emi ti rò lati sọ ọ di ẹni nla; ṣugbọn kiyesi i, OLUWA fà ọ sẹhin kuro ninu ọlá.
entries.en: Therefore now flee thou to thy place: I thought to promote thee unto great honour; but, lo, the LORD hath kept thee back from honour.

entries.yo: Balaamu si wi fun Balaki pe, Emi kò ti sọ fun awọn onṣẹ rẹ pẹlu ti iwọ rán si mi pe,
entries.en: And Balaam said unto Balak, Spake I not also to thy messengers which thou sentest unto me, saying,

entries.yo: Bi Balaki tilẹ fẹ́ lati fi ile rẹ̀ ti o kún fun fadakà ati wurá fun mi, emi kò le rekọja ọ̀rọ OLUWA, lati ṣe rere tabi buburu lati inu ara mi wá; ṣugbọn eyiti OLUWA wi, eyina li emi o sọ?
entries.en: If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot go beyond the commandment of the LORD, to do either good or bad of mine own mind; but what the LORD saith, that will I speak?

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi si kiyesi i, emi nlọ sọdọ awọn enia mi: wá, emi o si sọ fun ọ ohun ti awọn enia yi yio ṣe si awọn enia rẹ li ẹhin-ọla.
entries.en: And now, behold, I go unto my people: come therefore, and I will advertise thee what this people shall do to thy people in the latter days.

entries.yo: O si bẹ̀rẹsi owe rẹ̀, o si wipe, Balaamu ọmọ Beori nwi, ọkunrin ti oju rẹ̀ ṣí nwi:
entries.en: And he took up his parable, and said, Balaam the son of Beor hath said, and the man whose eyes are open hath said:

entries.yo: Ẹniti o gbọ́ ọ̀rọ Ọlọrun nwi, ti o si mọ̀ imọ̀ Ọga-Ogo, ti o ri iran Olodumare, ti o nṣubu lọ, ti oju rẹ̀ si ṣí:
entries.en: He hath said, which heard the words of God, and knew the knowledge of the most High, which saw the vision of the Almighty, falling into a trance, but having his eyes open:

entries.yo: Emi ri i, ṣugbọn ki iṣe nisisiyi: emi si wò o, ṣugbọn kò sunmọtosi: irawọ kan yio ti inu Jakobu jade wá, ọpa-alade kan yio si ti inu Israeli dide, yio si kọlù awọn igun Moabu, yio si ṣẹ́ gbogbo awọn ọmọ irọkẹ̀kẹ.
entries.en: I shall see him, but not now: I shall behold him, but not nigh: there shall come a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Israel, and shall smite the corners of Moab, and destroy all the children of Sheth.

entries.yo: Edomu yio si di iní, Seiri pẹlu yio si di iní, fun awọn ọtá rẹ̀; Israeli yio si ṣe iṣe-agbara.
entries.en: And Edom shall be a possession, Seir also shall be a possession for his enemies; and Israel shall do valiantly.

entries.yo: Lati inu Jakobu li ẹniti yio ní ijọba yio ti jade wá, yio si run ẹniti o kù ninu ilunla.
entries.en: Out of Jacob shall come he that shall have dominion, and shall destroy him that remaineth of the city.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si wò Amaleki, o si bẹ̀rẹsi owe rẹ̀, o si wipe, Amaleki ni ekini ninu awọn orilẹ-ède; ṣugbọn igbẹhin rẹ̀ ni ki o ṣegbé.
entries.en: And when he looked on Amalek, he took up his parable, and said, Amalek was the first of the nations; but his latter end shall be that he perish for ever.

entries.yo: O si wò awọn ara Keni, o si bẹ̀rẹsi owe rẹ̀, o si wipe, Agbara ni ibujoko rẹ̀, iwọ si tẹ́ itẹ́ rẹ sinu okuta.
entries.en: And he looked on the Kenites, and took up his parable, and said, Strong is thy dwellingplace, and thou puttest thy nest in a rock.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn a o run awọn ara Keni, titi awọn ara Aṣṣuri yio kó o lọ ni igbekùn.
entries.en: Nevertheless the Kenite shall be wasted, until Asshur shall carry thee away captive.

entries.yo: O si bẹ̀rẹsi owe rẹ̀, o si wipe, A, tani yio wà, nigbati Ọlọrun yio ṣe eyi!
entries.en: And he took up his parable, and said, Alas, who shall live when God doeth this!

entries.yo: Awọn ọkọ̀ yio ti ebute Kittimu wá, nwọn o si pọn Aṣṣuri loju, nwọn o si pọn Eberi loju, on pẹlu yio si ṣegbé.
entries.en: And ships shall come from the coast of Chittim, and shall afflict Asshur, and shall afflict Eber, and he also shall perish for ever.

entries.yo: Balaamu si dide, o si lọ o si pada si ibujoko rẹ̀; Balaki pẹlu si ba ọ̀na rẹ̀ lọ.
entries.en: And Balaam rose up, and went and returned to his place: and Balak also went his way.

entries.yo: ISRAELI si joko ni Ṣittimu, awọn enia na si bẹ̀rẹsi iṣe panṣaga pẹlu awọn ọmọbinrin Moabu:
entries.en: And Israel abode in Shittim, and the people began to commit whoredom with the daughters of Moab.

entries.yo: Nwọn si pe awọn enia na si ẹbọ oriṣa wọn; awọn enia na si jẹ, nwọn si tẹriba fun oriṣa wọn.
entries.en: And they called the people unto the sacrifices of their gods: and the people did eat, and bowed down to their gods.

entries.yo: Israeli si dà ara rẹ̀ pọ̀ mọ́ Baali-peoru: ibinu OLUWA si rú si Israeli.
entries.en: And Israel joined himself unto Baal-peor: and the anger of the LORD was kindled against Israel.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe, Mú gbogbo awọn olori awọn enia na, ki o si so wọn rọ̀ si õrùn niwaju OLUWA, ki imuna ibinu OLUWA ki o le yipada kuro lọdọ Israeli.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Take all the heads of the people, and hang them up before the LORD against the sun, that the fierce anger of the LORD may be turned away from Israel.

entries.yo: Mose si wi fun awọn onidajọ Israeli pe, Ki olukuluku nyin ki o pa awọn enia rẹ̀ ti o dàpọ mọ́ Baali-peoru.
entries.en: And Moses said unto the judges of Israel, Slay ye every one his men that were joined unto Baal-peor.

entries.yo: Si kiyesi i, ọkan ninu awọn ọmọ Israeli wá o si mú obinrin Midiani kan tọ̀ awọn arakunrin rẹ̀ wá li oju Mose, ati li oju gbogbo ijọ awọn ọmọ Israeli, ti nsọkun ni ẹnu-ọ̀na agọ́ ajọ.
entries.en: And, behold, one of the children of Israel came and brought unto his brethren a Midianitish woman in the sight of Moses, and in the sight of all the congregation of the children of Israel, who were weeping before the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

entries.yo: Nigbati Finehasi, ọmọ Eleasari, ọmọ Aaroni alufa ri i, o dide lãrin ijọ, o si mú ọ̀kọ kan li ọwọ́ rẹ̀;
entries.en: And when Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw it, he rose up from among the congregation, and took a javelin in his hand;

entries.yo: O si tọ̀ ọkunrin Israeli na lọ ninu agọ́, o si fi gún awọn mejeji li agunyọ, ọkunrin Israeli na, ati obinrin na ni inu rẹ̀. Àrun si da lãrin awọn ọmọ Israeli.
entries.en: And he went after the man of Israel into the tent, and thrust both of them through, the man of Israel, and the woman through her belly. So the plague was stayed from the children of Israel.

entries.yo: Awọn ti o si kú ninu àrun na jẹ́ ẹgba mejila.
entries.en: And those that died in the plague were twenty and four thousand.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Finehasi, ọmọ Eleasari, ọmọ Aaroni alufa ti yi ibinu mi pada kuro lara awọn ọmọ Israeli, nipa itara rẹ̀ nitori mi lãrin wọn, ki emi ki o máṣe run awọn ọmọ Israeli ninu owú mi.
entries.en: Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, hath turned my wrath away from the children of Israel, while he was zealous for my sake among them, that I consumed not the children of Israel in my jealousy.

entries.yo: Nitorina wipe, Kiyesi i, emi fi majẹmu alafia mi fun u.
entries.en: Wherefore say, Behold, I give unto him my covenant of peace:

entries.yo: Yio jẹ́ tirẹ̀ ati ti irú-ọmọ rẹ̀ lẹhin rẹ̀, ani majẹmu iṣẹ-alufa titi-aiye; nitoriti o ṣe itara fun Ọlọrun rẹ̀, o si ṣètutu fun awọn ọmọ Israeli.
entries.en: And he shall have it, and his seed after him, even the covenant of an everlasting priesthood; because he was zealous for his God, and made an atonement for the children of Israel.

entries.yo: Njẹ orukọ ọkunrin Israeli na ti a pa, ani ti a pa pẹlu obinrin Midiani na, a ma jẹ́ Simri, ọmọ Salu, olori ile kan ninu awọn ọmọ Simeoni.
entries.en: Now the name of the Israelite that was slain, even that was slain with the Midianitish woman, was Zimri, the son of Salu, a prince of a chief house among the Simeonites.

entries.yo: Orukọ obinrin Midiani na ti a pa a si ma jẹ́ Kosbi, ọmọbinrin Suru; ti iṣe olori awọn enia kan, ati ti ile kan ni Midiani.
entries.en: And the name of the Midianitish woman that was slain was Cozbi, the daughter of Zur; he was head over a people, and of a chief house in Midian.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Yọ awọn ara Midiani lẹnu, ki o si kọlù wọn.
entries.en: Vex the Midianites, and smite them:

entries.yo: Nitoriti nwọn fi ẹ̀tan wọn yọ nyin lẹnu, eyiti nwọn tàn nyin niti ọ̀ran Peori, ati niti ọ̀ran Kosbi, ọmọ ijoye Midiani kan, arabinrin wọn, ẹniti a pa li ọjọ́ àrun nì niti ọ̀ran Peori.
entries.en: For they vex you with their wiles, wherewith they have beguiled you in the matter of Peor, and in the matter of Cozbi, the daughter of a prince of Midian, their sister, which was slain in the day of the plague for Peor's sake.

entries.yo: O SI ṣe lẹhin àrun na, ni OLUWA sọ fun Mose ati fun Eleasari alufa ọmọ Aaroni pe,
entries.en: And it came to pass after the plague, that the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, saying,

entries.yo: Kà iye gbogbo ijọ awọn ọmọ Israeli, lati ẹni ogún ọdún lọ ati jù bẹ̃ lọ, gẹgẹ bi ile awọn baba wọn, gbogbo awọn ti o le lọ si ogun ni Israeli.
entries.en: Take the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel, from twenty years old and upward, throughout their father's house, all that are able to go to war in Israel.

entries.yo: Mose ati Eleasari alufa si sọ fun wọn ni pẹtẹlẹ̀ Moabu, lẹba Jordani leti Jeriko pe,
entries.en: And Moses and Eleazar the priest spake with them in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,

entries.yo: Ẹ kà iye awọn enia na, lati ẹni ogún ọdún lọ ati jù bẹ̃ lọ; bi OLUWA ti paṣẹ fun Mose, ati fun awọn ọmọ Israeli, ti o ti ilẹ Egipti jade wá.
entries.en: Take the sum of the people, from twenty years old and upward; as the LORD commanded Moses and the children of Israel, which went forth out of the land of Egypt.

entries.yo: Reubeni, akọ́bi Israeli: awọn ọmọ Reubeni; Hanoki, lati ọdọ ẹniti idile awọn ọmọ Hanoki ti wá: ti Pallu, idile awọn ọmọ Pallu:
entries.en: Reuben, the eldest son of Israel: the children of Reuben; Hanoch, of whom cometh the family of the Hanochites: of Pallu, the family of the Palluites:

entries.yo: Ti Hesroni, idile awọn ọmọ Hesroni: ti Karmi, idile awọn ọmọ Karmi.
entries.en: Of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites: of Carmi, the family of the Carmites.

entries.yo: Wọnyi ni idile awọn ọmọ Reubeni: awọn ti a si kà ninu wọn jẹ́ ẹgba mọkanlelogun o le ẹgbẹsan o din ãdọrin.
entries.en: These are the families of the Reubenites: and they that were numbered of them were forty and three thousand and seven hundred and thirty.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Pallu; Eliabu.
entries.en: And the sons of Pallu; Eliab.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Eliabu; Nemueli, ati Datani, ati Abiramu. Eyi ni Datani ati Abiramu na, ti nwọn lí okiki ninu ijọ, ti nwọn bá Mose ati Aaroni jà ninu ẹgbẹ Kora, nigbati nwọn bá OLUWA jà.
entries.en: And the sons of Eliab; Nemuel, and Dathan, and Abiram. This is that Dathan and Abiram, which were famous in the congregation, who strove against Moses and against Aaron in the company of Korah, when they strove against the LORD:

entries.yo: Ti ilẹ si là ẹnu rẹ̀, ti o si gbe wọn mì pọ̀ pẹlu Kora, nigbati ẹgbẹ na fi kú, nigbati iná fi run awọn ãdọtalerugba ọkunrin, ti nwọn si di àmi kan.
entries.en: And the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up together with Korah, when that company died, what time the fire devoured two hundred and fifty men: and they became a sign.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn ọmọ Kora kò kú.
entries.en: Notwithstanding the children of Korah died not.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Simeoni bi idile wọn: ti Nemueli, idile Nemueli: ti Jamini, idile Jamini: ti Jakini, idile Jakini:
entries.en: The sons of Simeon after their families: of Nemuel, the family of the Nemuelites: of Jamin, the family of the Jaminites: of Jachin, the family of the Jachinites:

entries.yo: Ti Sera, idile Sera: ti Ṣaulu, idile Ṣaulu.
entries.en: Of Zerah, the family of the Zarhites: of Shaul, the family of the Shaulites.

entries.yo: Wọnyi ni idile awọn ọmọ Simeoni, ẹgba mọkanla o le igba.
entries.en: These are the families of the Simeonites, twenty and two thousand and two hundred.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Gadi bi idile wọn: ti Sefoni, idile Sefoni: ti Haggi, idile Haggi: ti Ṣuni, idile Ṣuni:
entries.en: The children of Gad after their families: of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites: of Haggi, the family of the Haggites: of Shuni, the family of the Shunites:

entries.yo: Ti Osni, idile Osni: ti Eri, idile Eri:
entries.en: Of Ozni, the family of the Oznites: of Eri, the family of the Erites:

entries.yo: Ti Arodu, idile Arodu: ti Areli, idile Areli.
entries.en: Of Arod, the family of the Arodites: of Areli, the family of the Arelites.

entries.yo: Wọnyi ni idile awọn ọmọ Gadi gẹgẹ bi awọn ti a kà ninu wọn, nwọn jẹ́ ọkẹ meji o le ẹdẹgbẹta.
entries.en: These are the families of the children of Gad according to those that were numbered of them, forty thousand and five hundred.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Juda, ni Eri ati Onani: ati Eri ati Onani kú ni ilẹ Kenaani.
entries.en: The sons of Judah were Er and Onan: and Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Juda gẹgẹ bi idile wọn; ti Ṣela, idile Ṣela: ti Peresi, idile Peresi: ti Sera, idile Sera.
entries.en: And the sons of Judah after their families were; of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites: of Pharez, the family of the Pharzites: of Zerah, the family of the Zarhites.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Peresi; ti Hesroni, idile Hesroni: ti Hamulu, idile Hamulu.
entries.en: And the sons of Pharez were; of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites: of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites.

entries.yo: Wọnyi ni idile Juda gẹgẹ bi awọn ti a kà ninu wọn, nwọn jẹ́ ẹgba mejidilogoji o le ẹdẹgbẹta.
entries.en: These are the families of Judah according to those that were numbered of them, threescore and sixteen thousand and five hundred.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Issakari gẹgẹ bi idile wọn: ti Tola, idile Tola: ti Pufa, idile Pufa:
entries.en: Of the sons of Issachar after their families: of Tola, the family of the Tolaites: of Pua, the family of the Punites:

entries.yo: Ti Jaṣubu, idile Jaṣubu: ti Ṣimroni, idile Ṣimroni.
entries.en: Of Jashub, the family of the Jashubites: of Shimron, the family of the Shimronites.

entries.yo: Wọnyi ni idile Issakari gẹgẹ bi awọn ti a kà ninu wọn, nwọn jẹ́ ẹgba mejilelọgbọ̀n o le ọdunrun.
entries.en: These are the families of Issachar according to those that were numbered of them, threescore and four thousand and three hundred.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Sebuluni gẹgẹ bi idile wọn: ti Seredi, idile Seredi: ti Eloni, idile Eloni: ti Jaleeli, idile Jaleeli.
entries.en: Of the sons of Zebulun after their families: of Sered, the family of the Sardites: of Elon, the family of the Elonites: of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.

entries.yo: Wọnyi ni idile awọn ọmọ Sebuluni gẹgẹ bi awọn ti a kà ninu wọn, nwọn jẹ́ ọkẹ mẹta o le ẹdẹgbẹta.
entries.en: These are the families of the Zebulunites according to those that were numbered of them, threescore thousand and five hundred.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Josefu gẹgẹ bi idile wọn: Manasse ati Efraimu.
entries.en: The sons of Joseph after their families were Manasseh and Ephraim.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Manasse: ti Makiri, idile Makiri: Makiri si bi Gileadi: ti Gileadi, idile awọn ọmọ Gileadi.
entries.en: Of the sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites: and Machir begat Gilead: of Gilead come the family of the Gileadites.

entries.yo: Wọnyi li awọn ọmọ Gileadi: ti Ieseri, idile Ieseri: ti Heleki, idile Heleki:
entries.en: These are the sons of Gilead: of Jeezer, the family of the Jeezerites: of Helek, the family of the Helekites:

entries.yo: Ati ti Asrieli, idile Asrieli: ati ti Ṣekemu, idile Ṣekemu:
entries.en: And of Asriel, the family of the Asrielites: and of Shechem, the family of the Shechemites:

entries.yo: Ati Ṣemida, idile awọn ọmọ Ṣemida: ati ti Heferi, idile awọn ọmọ Heferi.
entries.en: And of Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites: and of Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.

entries.yo: Selofehadi ọmọ Heferi kò si lí ọmọkunrin, bikọse ọmọbinrin: orukọ awọn ọmọbinrin Selofehadi a ma jẹ Mala, ati Noa, ati Hogla, Milka, ati Tirsa.
entries.en: And Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but daughters: and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

entries.yo: Wọnyi ni idile Manasse, ati awọn ti a kà ninu wọn jẹ́ ẹgba mẹrindilọgbọ̀n o le ẹdẹgbẹrin.
entries.en: These are the families of Manasseh, and those that were numbered of them, fifty and two thousand and seven hundred.

entries.yo: Wọnyi li awọn ọmọ Efraimu gẹgẹ bi idile wọn: ti Ṣutela, idile awọn ọmọ Ṣutela: ti Bekeri, idile awọn ọmọ Bekeri: ti Tahani, idile awọn ọmọ Tahani.
entries.en: These are the sons of Ephraim after their families: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthalhites: of Becher, the family of the Bachrites: of Tahan, the family of the Tahanites.

entries.yo: Wọnyi li awọn ọmọ Ṣutela: ti Erani, idile awọn ọmọ Erani.
entries.en: And these are the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the family of the Eranites.

entries.yo: Wọnyi ni idile awọn ọmọ Efraimu gẹgẹ bi awọn ti a kà ninu wọn, nwọn jẹ́ ẹgba mẹrindilogun o le ẹdẹgbẹta. Wọnyi li awọn ọmọ Josefu gẹgẹ bi idile wọn.
entries.en: These are the families of the sons of Ephraim according to those that were numbered of them, thirty and two thousand and five hundred. These are the sons of Joseph after their families.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Benjamini gẹgẹ bi idile wọn: ti Bela, idile awọn ọmọ Bela: ti Aṣbeli, idile awọn ọmọ Aṣbeli: ti Ahiramu, idile awọn ọmọ Ahiramu.
entries.en: The sons of Benjamin after their families: of Bela, the family of the Belaites: of Ashbel, the family of the Ashbelites: of Ahiram, the family of the Ahiramites:

entries.yo: Ti Ṣefamu, idile awọn ọmọ Ṣufamu: ti Hufamu, idile awọn ọmọ Hufamu.
entries.en: Of Shupham, the family of the Shuphamites: of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Bela si ni Ardi ati Naamani: ti Ardi, idile awọn ọmọ Ardi: ati ti Naamani, idile awọn ọmọ Naamani.
entries.en: And the sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: of Ard, the family of the Ardites: and of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.

entries.yo: Wọnyi li awọn ọmọ Benjamini gẹgẹ bi idile wọn: ati awọn ti a kà ninu wọn jẹ́ ẹgba mejilelogun o le ẹgbẹjọ.
entries.en: These are the sons of Benjamin after their families: and they that were numbered of them were forty and five thousand and six hundred.

entries.yo: Wọnyi li awọn ọmọ Dani gẹgẹ bi idile wọn: ti Ṣuhamu, idile awọn ọmọ Ṣuhamu. Wọnyi ni idile Dani gẹgẹ bi idile wọn.
entries.en: These are the sons of Dan after their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These are the families of Dan after their families.

entries.yo: Gbogbo idile awọn ọmọ Ṣuhamu, gẹgẹ bi awọn ti a kà ninu wọn, nwọn jẹ́ ẹgba mejilelọgbọ̀n o le irinwo.
entries.en: All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those that were numbered of them, were threescore and four thousand and four hundred.

entries.yo: Ti awọn ọmọ Aṣeri gẹgẹ bi idile wọn: ti Imna, idile awọn ọmọ Imna: ti Iṣfi, idile awọn ọmọ Iṣfi: ti Beria, idile awọn ọmọ Beria.
entries.en: Of the children of Asher after their families: of Jimna, the family of the Jimnites: of Jesui, the family of the Jesuites: of Beriah, the family of the Beriites.

entries.yo: Ti awọn ọmọ Beria: ti Heberi, idile awọn ọmọ Heberi: ti Malkieli, idile awọn ọmọ Malkieli.
entries.en: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites: of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.

entries.yo: Orukọ ọmọ Aṣeri obinrin a si ma jẹ́ Sera.
entries.en: And the name of the daughter of Asher was Sarah.

entries.yo: Wọnyi ni idile awọn ọmọ Aṣeri gẹgẹ bi awọn ti a kà ninu wọn; nwọn jẹ́ ẹgba mẹrindilọgbọ̀n o le egbeje.
entries.en: These are the families of the sons of Asher according to those that were numbered of them; who were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.

entries.yo: Ti awọn ọmọ Naftali gẹgẹ bi idile wọn: ti Jaseeli, idile awọn ọmọ Jaseeli: ti Guni, idile awọn ọmọ Guni:
entries.en: Of the sons of Naphtali after their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites: of Guni, the family of the Gunites:

entries.yo: Ti Jeseri, idile awọn ọmọ Jeseri: ti Ṣillemu, idile awọn ọmọ Ṣillemu.
entries.en: Of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites: of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.

entries.yo: Wọnyi ni idile ti Naftali gẹgẹ bi idile wọn: awọn ti a si kà ninu wọn jẹ́ ẹgba mejilelogun o le egbeje.
entries.en: These are the families of Naphtali according to their families: and they that were numbered of them were forty and five thousand and four hundred.

entries.yo: Wọnyi li a kà ninu awọn ọmọ Israeli, ọgbọ̀n ọkẹ, o le ẹgbẹsan o din ãdọrin.
entries.en: These were the numbered of the children of Israel, six hundred thousand and a thousand seven hundred and thirty.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Fun awọn wọnyi ni ki a pín ilẹ na ni iní gẹgẹ bi iye orukọ.
entries.en: Unto these the land shall be divided for an inheritance according to the number of names.

entries.yo: Fun awọn ti o pọ̀ ni ki iwọ ki o fi ilẹ-iní pupọ̀ fun, ati fun awọn ti o kére ni ki iwọ ki o fi diẹ fun: ki a fi ilẹ-iní olukuluku fun u gẹgẹ bi iye awọn ti a kà ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: To many thou shalt give the more inheritance, and to few thou shalt give the less inheritance: to every one shall his inheritance be given according to those that were numbered of him.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn kèké li a o fi pín ilẹ na: gẹgẹ bi orukọ ẹ̀ya awọn baba wọn ni ki nwọn ki o ní i.
entries.en: Notwithstanding the land shall be divided by lot: according to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi kèké ni ki a pín ilẹ-iní na lãrin awọn pupọ̀ ati diẹ.
entries.en: According to the lot shall the possession thereof be divided between many and few.

entries.yo: Wọnyi si li awọn ti a kà ninu awọn ọmọ Lefi, gẹgẹ bi idile wọn: ti Gerṣoni, idile awọn ọmọ Gerṣoni: ti Kohati, idile awọn ọmọ Kohati: ti Merari, idile awọn ọmọ Merari.
entries.en: And these are they that were numbered of the Levites after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites: of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites: of Merari, the family of the Merarites.

entries.yo: Wọnyi ni idile awọn ọmọ Lefi: idile awọn ọmọ Libni, idile awọn ọmọ Hebroni, idile awọn ọmọ Mali, idile awọn ọmọ Muṣi, idile awọn ọmọ Kora. Kohati si bi Amramu.
entries.en: These are the families of the Levites: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, the family of the Korathites. And Kohath begat Amram.

entries.yo: Orukọ aya Amramu a si ma jẹ́ Jokebedi, ọmọbinrin Lefi, ti iya rẹ̀ bi fun Lefi ni Egipti: on si bi Aaroni, ati Mose, ati Miriamu arabinrin wọn fun Amramu.
entries.en: And the name of Amram's wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, whom her mother bare to Levi in Egypt: and she bare unto Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.

entries.yo: Ati fun Aaroni li a bi Nadabu ati Abihu, Eleasari ati Itamari.
entries.en: And unto Aaron was born Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

entries.yo: Ati Nadabu ati Abihu kú, nigbati nwọn mú iná ajeji wá siwaju OLUWA.
entries.en: And Nadab and Abihu died, when they offered strange fire before the LORD.

entries.yo: Awọn ti a si kà ninu wọn jẹ́ ẹgba mọkanla o le ẹgbẹrun, gbogbo awọn ọkunrin lati ọmọ oṣù kan ati jù bẹ̃ lọ: nitoripe a kò kà wọn kún awọn ọmọ Israeli, nitoriti a kò fi ilẹ-iní fun wọn ninu awọn ọmọ Israeli.
entries.en: And those that were numbered of them were twenty and three thousand, all males from a month old and upward: for they were not numbered among the children of Israel, because there was no inheritance given them among the children of Israel.

entries.yo: Wọnyi li awọn ti a kà lati ọwọ́ Mose ati Eleasari alufa wá, awọn ẹniti o kà awọn ọmọ Israeli ni pẹtẹlẹ̀ Moabu lẹba Jordani leti Jeriko.
entries.en: These are they that were numbered by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who numbered the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ninu wọnyi kò sì ọkunrin kan ninu awọn ti Mose ati Aaroni alufa kà, nigbati nwọn kà awọn ọmọ Israeli li aginjù Sinai.
entries.en: But among these there was not a man of them whom Moses and Aaron the priest numbered, when they numbered the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.

entries.yo: Nitoriti OLUWA ti wi fun wọn pe, Kíku ni nwọn o kú li aginjù. Kò si kù ọkunrin kan ninu wọn, bikoṣe Kalebu ọmọ Jefunne, ati Joṣua ọmọ Nuni.
entries.en: For the LORD had said of them, They shall surely die in the wilderness. And there was not left a man of them, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.

entries.yo: NIGBANA ni awọn ọmọbinrin Selofehadi, ọmọ Heferi, ọmọ Gileadi, ọmọ Makiri, ọmọ Manasse, ti idile Manasse ọmọ Josefu wá: wọnyi si li orukọ awọn ọmọbinrin rẹ̀; Mala, Noa, ati Hogla, ati Milka, ati Tirsa.
entries.en: Then came the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph: and these are the names of his daughters; Mahlah, Noah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Tirzah.

entries.yo: Nwọn si duro niwaju Mose, ati niwaju Eleasari alufa, ati niwaju awọn olori ati gbogbo ijọ, li ẹnu-ọ̀na agọ́ ajọ, wipe,
entries.en: And they stood before Moses, and before Eleazar the priest, and before the princes and all the congregation, by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, saying,

entries.yo: Baba wa kú li aginjù, on kò si sí ninu ẹgbẹ awọn ti o kó ara wọn jọ pọ̀ si OLUWA ninu ẹgbẹ Kora: ṣugbọn o kú ninu ẹ̀ṣẹ ara rẹ̀; kò si lí ọmọkunrin.
entries.en: Our father died in the wilderness, and he was not in the company of them that gathered themselves together against the LORD in the company of Korah; but died in his own sin, and had no sons.

entries.yo: Ẽhaṣe ti orukọ, baba wa yio fi parẹ kuro ninu idile rẹ̀, nitoriti kò lí ọmọkunrin? Fun wa ni ilẹ-iní lãrin awọn arakunrin baba wa.
entries.en: Why should the name of our father be done away from among his family, because he hath no son? Give unto us therefore a possession among the brethren of our father.

entries.yo: Mose si mú ọ̀ran wọn wá siwaju OLUWA.
entries.en: And Moses brought their cause before the LORD.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọbinrin Selofehadi sọ rere: nitõtọ, fun wọn ni ilẹ-iní kan lãrin awọn arakunrin baba wọn; ki iwọ ki o si ṣe ki ilẹ-iní baba wọn ki o kọja sọdọ wọn.
entries.en: The daughters of Zelophehad speak right: thou shalt surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father's brethren; and thou shalt cause the inheritance of their father to pass unto them.

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o si sọ fun awọn ọmọ Israeli pe, Bi ọkunrin kan ba kú, ti kò si lí ọmọkunrin, njẹ ki ẹnyin ki o ṣe ki ilẹ-iní rẹ̀ ki o kọja sọdọ ọmọbinrin rẹ̀.
entries.en: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a man die, and have no son, then ye shall cause his inheritance to pass unto his daughter.

entries.yo: Bi on kò ba si lí ọmọbinrin, njẹ ki ẹnyin ki o fi ilẹ-ini rẹ̀ fun awọn arakunrin rẹ̀.
entries.en: And if he have no daughter, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his brethren.

entries.yo: Bi on kò ba si lí arakunrin, njẹ ki ẹnyin ki o fi ilẹ-iní rẹ̀ fun awọn arakunrin baba rẹ̀:
entries.en: And if he have no brethren, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his father's brethren.

entries.yo: Bi baba rẹ̀ kò ba si lí arakunrin, njẹ ki ẹnyin ki o fi ilẹ-iní rẹ̀ fun ibatan rẹ̀, ti o sunmọ ọ ni idile rẹ̀, on ni ki o jogún rẹ̀: yio si jasi ìlana idajọ fun awọn ọmọ Israeli, gẹgẹ bi OLUWA ti paṣẹ fun Mose.
entries.en: And if his father have no brethren, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his kinsman that is next to him of his family, and he shall possess it: and it shall be unto the children of Israel a statute of judgment, as the LORD commanded Moses.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe, Gùn ori òke Abarimu yi lọ, ki o si wò ilẹ na ti mo fi fun awọn ọmọ Israeli.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Get thee up into this mount Abarim, and see the land which I have given unto the children of Israel.

entries.yo: Nigbati iwọ ba ri i tán, a o si kó iwọ jọ pẹlu awọn enia rẹ, gẹgẹ bi a ti kó Aaroni arakunrin rẹ jọ.
entries.en: And when thou hast seen it, thou also shalt be gathered unto thy people, as Aaron thy brother was gathered.

entries.yo: Nitoriti ẹnyin ṣọ̀tẹ si aṣẹ mi li aginjù Sini, ni ìja ijọ, lati yà mi simimọ́ ni ibi omi nì niwaju wọn. (Wọnyi li omi Meriba ni Kadeṣi li aginjù Sini.)
entries.en: For ye rebelled against my commandment in the desert of Zin, in the strife of the congregation, to sanctify me at the water before their eyes: that is the water of Meribah in Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.

entries.yo: Mose si sọ fun OLUWA pe,
entries.en: And Moses spake unto the LORD, saying,

entries.yo: Jẹ ki OLUWA, Ọlọrun ẹmi gbogbo enia, ki o yàn ọkunrin kan sori ijọ,
entries.en: Let the LORD, the God of the spirits of all flesh, set a man over the congregation,

entries.yo: Ti yio ma ṣaju wọn jade lọ, ti yio si ma ṣaju wọn wọle wá, ti yio si ma sìn wọn lọ, ti yio si ma mú wọn bọ̀; ki ijọ enia OLUWA ki o máṣe dabi agutan ti kò lí oluṣọ.
entries.en: Which may go out before them, and which may go in before them, and which may lead them out, and which may bring them in; that the congregation of the LORD be not as sheep which have no shepherd.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe, Iwọ mú Joṣua ọmọ Nuni, ọkunrin ninu ẹniti ẹmi wà, ki o si fi ọwọ́ rẹ lé e lori;
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Take thee Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the spirit, and lay thine hand upon him;

entries.yo: Ki o si mu u duro niwaju Eleasari alufa, ati niwaju gbogbo ijọ; ki o si fi aṣẹ fun u li oju wọn.
entries.en: And set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and give him a charge in their sight.

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o si fi ninu ọlá rẹ si i lara, ki gbogbo ijọ awọn ọmọ Israeli ki o le gbà a gbọ́.
entries.en: And thou shalt put some of thine honour upon him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may be obedient.

entries.yo: Ki on si duro niwaju Eleasari alufa, ẹniti yio bère fun u nipa idajọ Urimu niwaju OLUWA: nipa ọ̀rọ rẹ̀ ni ki nwọn ki o jade lọ, ati nipa ọ̀rọ rẹ̀ ni ki nwọn ki o wọle, ati on, ati gbogbo awọn ọmọ Israeli pẹlu rẹ̀, ani gbogbo ijọ.
entries.en: And he shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall ask counsel for him after the judgment of Urim before the LORD: at his word shall they go out, and at his word they shall come in, both he, and all the children of Israel with him, even all the congregation.

entries.yo: Mose si ṣe bi OLUWA ti paṣẹ fun u: o si mú Joṣua, o si mu u duro niwaju Eleasari alufa, ati niwaju gbogbo ijọ:
entries.en: And Moses did as the LORD commanded him: and he took Joshua, and set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation:

entries.yo: O si fi ọwọ́ rẹ̀ lé e lori, o si fi aṣẹ fun u, bi OLUWA ti wi lati ọwọ́ Mose.
entries.en: And he laid his hands upon him, and gave him a charge, as the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Fi aṣẹ fun awọn ọmọ Israeli, ki o si wi fun wọn pe, Ọrẹ-ẹbọ mi, ati àkara mi fun ẹbọ mi ti a fi iná ṣe, fun õrùn didùn si mi, ni ki ẹnyin ma kiyesi lati mú fun mi wá li akokò wọn.
entries.en: Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, My offering, and my bread for my sacrifices made by fire, for a sweet savour unto me, shall ye observe to offer unto me in their due season.

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o si wi fun wọn pe, Eyi li ẹbọ ti a fi iná ṣe, ti ẹnyin o ma múwa fun OLUWA, akọ ọdọ-agutan meji ọlọdún kan alailabùku li ojojumọ́, fun ẹbọ sisun igbagbogbo.
entries.en: And thou shalt say unto them, This is the offering made by fire which ye shall offer unto the LORD; two lambs of the first year without spot day by day, for a continual burnt offering.

entries.yo: Ọdọ-agutan kan ni ki iwọ ki o fi rubọ li owurọ̀, ati ọdọ-agutan keji ni ki iwọ ki o fi rubọ li aṣalẹ;
entries.en: The one lamb shalt thou offer in the morning, and the other lamb shalt thou offer at even;

entries.yo: Ati idamẹwa òṣuwọn efa iyẹfun fun ẹbọ ohunjijẹ, ti a fi idamẹrin òṣuwọn hini oróro gigún pò.
entries.en: And a tenth part of an ephah of flour for a meat offering, mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil.

entries.yo: Ẹbọ sisun igbagbogbo ni, ti a ti lanasilẹ li òke Sinai fun õrùn didùn, ẹbọ ti a fi iná ṣe si OLUWA.
entries.en: It is a continual burnt offering, which was ordained in mount Sinai for a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the LORD.

entries.yo: Ati ẹbọ ohunmimu rẹ̀ ki o jẹ́ idamẹrin òṣuwọn hini fun ọdọ-agutan kan: ni ibi-mimọ ni ki iwọ da ọti lile nì silẹ fun OLUWA fun ẹbọ ohunmimu.
entries.en: And the drink offering thereof shall be the fourth part of an hin for the one lamb: in the holy place shalt thou cause the strong wine to be poured unto the LORD for a drink offering.

entries.yo: Ọdọ-agutan keji ni ki iwọ ki o fi rubọ li aṣalẹ: bi ẹbọ ohunjijẹ ti owurọ̀, ati bi ẹbọ ohunmimu rẹ̀ ni ki iwọ ki o ṣe, ẹbọ ti a fi iná ṣe, õrùn didùn si OLUWA.
entries.en: And the other lamb shalt thou offer at even: as the meat offering of the morning, and as the drink offering thereof, thou shalt offer it, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.

entries.yo: Ati li ọjọ́-isimi akọ ọdọ-agutan meji ọlọdún kan alailabùku, ati idamẹwa meji òṣuwọn iyẹfun fun ẹbọ ohunjijẹ, ti a fi oróro pò, ati ẹbọ ohunmimu rẹ̀:
entries.en: And on the sabbath day two lambs of the first year without spot, and two tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, and the drink offering thereof:

entries.yo: Eyi li ẹbọ sisun ọjọjọ́ isimi, pẹlu ẹbọ sisun igbagbogbo, ati ẹbọ ohunmimu rẹ̀.
entries.en: This is the burnt offering of every sabbath, beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.

entries.yo: Ati ni ìbẹrẹ òṣu nyin ki ẹnyin ki o ru ẹbọ sisun kan si OLUWA; ẹgbọrọ akọmalu meji, ati àgbo kan, akọ ọdọ-agutan meje ọlọdún kan alailabùku;
entries.en: And in the beginnings of your months ye shall offer a burnt offering unto the LORD; two young bullocks, and one ram, seven lambs of the first year without spot;

entries.yo: Ati idamẹwa mẹta òṣuwọn iyẹfun, ti a fi oróro pò, fun akọmalu kan, fun ẹbọ ohunjijẹ; ati idamẹwa meji òṣuwọn iyẹfun, ti a fi oróro pò, fun àgbo kan, fun ẹbọ ohunjijẹ:
entries.en: And three tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, for one bullock; and two tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, for one ram;

entries.yo: Ati idamẹwa òṣuwọn iyẹfun, ti a fi oróro pò, fun ọdọ-agutan kan fun ẹbọ ohunjijẹ; fun ẹbọ sisun õrùn didùn, ẹbọ ti a fi iná ṣe si OLUWA.
entries.en: And a several tenth deal of flour mingled with oil for a meat offering unto one lamb; for a burnt offering of a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the LORD.

entries.yo: Ki ẹbọ ohunmimu wọn ki o jẹ́ àbọ òṣuwọn hini ti ọti-waini fun akọmalu kan, ati idamẹta òṣuwọn hini fun àgbo kan, ati idamẹrin òṣuwọn hini fun ọdọ-agutan kan: eyi li ẹbọ sisun oṣuṣù ni gbogbo oṣù ọdún.
entries.en: And their drink offerings shall be half an hin of wine unto a bullock, and the third part of an hin unto a ram, and a fourth part of an hin unto a lamb: this is the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year.

entries.yo: A o si fi obukọ kan ru ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ si OLUWA; pẹlu ẹbọ sisun igbagbogbo, ati ẹbọ ohunmimu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering unto the LORD shall be offered, beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.

entries.yo: Ati li ọjọ́ kẹrinla oṣù kini, ni irekọja OLUWA.
entries.en: And in the fourteenth day of the first month is the passover of the LORD.

entries.yo: Ati li ọjọ́ kẹdogun oṣù na yi li ajọ: ni ijọ́ meje ni ki a fi jẹ àkara alaiwu.
entries.en: And in the fifteenth day of this month is the feast: seven days shall unleavened bread be eaten.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ́ kini ki apejọ mimọ́ ki o wà; ẹnyin kò gbọdọ ṣe iṣẹ agbara kan:
entries.en: In the first day shall be an holy convocation; ye shall do no manner of servile work therein:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ki ẹnyin ki o ru ẹbọ kan ti a fi iná ṣe, ẹbọ sisun si OLUWA; ẹgbọrọ akọmalu meji, ati àgbo kan, ati akọ ọdọ-agutan meje ọlọdun kan: ki nwọn ki o jẹ́ alailabùku fun nyin.
entries.en: But ye shall offer a sacrifice made by fire for a burnt offering unto the LORD; two young bullocks, and one ram, and seven lambs of the first year: they shall be unto you without blemish:

entries.yo: Ẹbọ ohunjijẹ wọn iyẹfun ti a fi oróro pò, idamẹwa mẹta òṣuwọn ni ki ẹnyin ki o múwa fun akọmalu kan, ati idamẹwa meji òṣuwọn fun àgbo na.
entries.en: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil: three tenth deals shall ye offer for a bullock, and two tenth deals for a ram;

entries.yo: Ati idamẹwa òṣuwọn ni ki iwọ ki o múwa fun ọdọ-agutan kan, fun gbogbo ọdọ-agutan mejeje;
entries.en: A several tenth deal shalt thou offer for every lamb, throughout the seven lambs:

entries.yo: Ati obukọ kan fun ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ, lati ṣètutu fun nyin.
entries.en: And one goat for a sin offering, to make an atonement for you.

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o mú wọnyi wá pẹlu ẹbọ sisun owurọ̀, ti iṣe ti ẹbọ sisun igbagbogbo.
entries.en: Ye shall offer these beside the burnt offering in the morning, which is for a continual burnt offering.

entries.yo: Bayi ni ki ẹnyin rubọ li ọjọjọ́, jalẹ ni ijọ́ mejeje, onjẹ ẹbọ ti a fi iná ṣe, ti õrùn didùn si OLUWA: ki a ru u pẹlu ẹbọ sisun igbagbogbo, ati ẹbọ ohunmimu rẹ̀.
entries.en: After this manner ye shall offer daily, throughout the seven days, the meat of the sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD: it shall be offered beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.

entries.yo: Ati ni ijọ́ keje ki ẹnyin ki o ní apejọ mimọ́; ẹnyin kò gbọdọ ṣe iṣẹ agbara kan.
entries.en: And on the seventh day ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ́ akọ́so pẹlu, nigbati ẹnyin ba mú ẹbọ ohunjijẹ titun wá fun OLUWA, lẹhin ọsẹ̀ nyin wọnni, ki ẹnyin ki o ní apejọ mimọ́; ẹnyin kò gbọdọ ṣe iṣẹ agbara kan:
entries.en: Also in the day of the firstfruits, when ye bring a new meat offering unto the LORD, after your weeks be out, ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ki ẹnyin ki o fi ẹgbọrọ akọmalu meji, àgbo kan, akọ ọdọ-agutan meje ọlọdún kan, ru ẹbọ sisun fun õrùn didùn si OLUWA;
entries.en: But ye shall offer the burnt offering for a sweet savour unto the LORD; two young bullocks, one ram, seven lambs of the first year;
