entries.yo: Ati ẹbọ ohunjijẹ wọn, iyẹfun ti a fi oróro pò, idamẹwa mẹta òṣuwọn fun akọmalu kan, ati idamẹwa meji òṣuwọn fun àgbo kan,
entries.en: And their meat offering of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals unto one bullock, two tenth deals unto one ram,

entries.yo: Ati idamẹwa òṣuwọn fun ọdọ-agutan kan, bẹ̃ni fun ọdọ-agutan mejeje;
entries.en: A several tenth deal unto one lamb, throughout the seven lambs;

entries.yo: Ati obukọ kan, lati ṣètutu fun nyin.
entries.en: And one kid of the goats, to make an atonement for you.

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o ru wọn pẹlu ẹbọ sisun igba-gbogbo, ati ẹbọ ohunjijẹ rẹ̀ (ki nwọn ki o jẹ́ alailabùku fun nyin), ati ẹbọ ohunmimu wọn.
entries.en: Ye shall offer them beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, (they shall be unto you without blemish) and their drink offerings.

entries.yo: ATI li oṣù keje, li ọjọ́ kini oṣù na ki ẹnyin ki o ní apejọ mimọ́; ẹnyin kò gbọdọ ṣe iṣẹ agbara kan: ọjọ́ ifunpe ni fun nyin.
entries.en: And in the seventh month, on the first day of the month, ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work: it is a day of blowing the trumpets unto you.

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o si fi ẹgbọrọ akọmalu kan, àgbo kan, ati akọ ọdọ-agutan meje ọlọdún kan alailabùku ru ẹbọ sisun fun õrùn didùn si OLUWA:
entries.en: And ye shall offer a burnt offering for a sweet savour unto the LORD; one young bullock, one ram, and seven lambs of the first year without blemish:

entries.yo: Ati ẹbọ ohunjijẹ wọn, iyẹfun ti a fi oróro pò, idamẹwa mẹta òṣuwọn fun akọmalu kan, ati idamẹwa meji òṣuwọn fun àgbo kan,
entries.en: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals for a bullock, and two tenth deals for a ram,

entries.yo: Ati idamẹwa òṣuwọn fun ọdọ-agutan kan, bẹ̃ni fun ọdọ-agutan mejeje:
entries.en: And one tenth deal for one lamb, throughout the seven lambs:

entries.yo: Ati obukọ kan fun ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ, lati ṣètutu fun nyin;
entries.en: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering, to make an atonement for you:

entries.yo: Pẹlu ẹbọ sisun oṣù, ati ẹbọ ohunjijẹ rẹ̀, ati ẹbọ sisun igbagbogbo, ati ẹbọ ohunjijẹ rẹ̀, ati ẹbọ ohunmimu wọn, gẹgẹ bi ìlana wọn, fun õrùn didùn, ẹbọ ti a fi iná ṣe si OLUWA.
entries.en: Beside the burnt offering of the month, and his meat offering, and the daily burnt offering, and his meat offering, and their drink offerings, according unto their manner, for a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the LORD.

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o si ní apejọ mimọ́ ni ijọ́ kẹwa oṣù keje na yi; ki ẹnyin ki o si pọ́n ọkàn nyin loju; ẹnyin kò gbọdọ ṣe iṣẹkiṣẹ kan:
entries.en: And ye shall have on the tenth day of this seventh month an holy convocation; and ye shall afflict your souls: ye shall not do any work therein:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ki ẹnyin ki o ru ẹbọ sisun si OLUWA fun õrùn didùn; ẹgbọrọ akọmalu kan, àgbo kan, ati akọ ọdọ-agutan meje ọlọdún kan; ki nwọn ki o si jẹ́ alailabùku fun nyin:
entries.en: But ye shall offer a burnt offering unto the LORD for a sweet savour; one young bullock, one ram, and seven lambs of the first year; they shall be unto you without blemish:

entries.yo: Ati ẹbọ ohunjijẹ wọn, iyẹfun ti a fi oróro pò, idamẹwa mẹta òṣuwọn fun akọmalu kan, ati idamẹwa meji ọsuwọn fun àgbo kan,
entries.en: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals to a bullock, and two tenth deals to one ram,

entries.yo: Ati idamẹwa òṣuwọn fun ọdọ-agutan kan, bẹ̃ni fun ọdọ-agutan mejeje:
entries.en: A several tenth deal for one lamb, throughout the seven lambs:

entries.yo: Obukọ kan fun ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ; pẹlu ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ fun ètutu, ati ẹbọ sisun igbagbogbo, ati ẹbọ ohunjijẹ rẹ̀, ati ẹbọ ohunmimu wọn.
entries.en: One kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the sin offering of atonement, and the continual burnt offering, and the meat offering of it, and their drink offerings.

entries.yo: Ati ni ijọ́ kẹdogun oṣù keje, ki ẹnyin ki o ní apejọ mimọ́; ẹnyin kò gbọdọ ṣe iṣẹ agbara kan, ki ẹnyin ki o si ṣe ajọ fun OLUWA ni ijọ́ meje:
entries.en: And on the fifteenth day of the seventh month ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work, and ye shall keep a feast unto the LORD seven days:

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o si ru ẹbọ sisun kan, ẹbọ ti a fi iná ṣe, ti õrùn didùn si OLUWA; ẹgbọrọ akọmalu mẹtala, àgbo meji, ati akọ ọdọ-agutan mẹrinla ọlọdún kan; ki nwọn ki o jẹ́ alailabùku:
entries.en: And ye shall offer a burnt offering, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD; thirteen young bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year; they shall be without blemish:

entries.yo: Ati ẹbọ ohun-jijẹ wọn, iyẹfun ti a fi oróro pò, idamẹwa mẹta òṣuwọn fun akọmalu kan, bẹ̃ni fun akọmalu mẹtẹtala, idamẹwa meji òṣuwọn fun àgbo kan, bẹ̃ni fun àgbo mejeji,
entries.en: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals unto every bullock of the thirteen bullocks, two tenth deals to each ram of the two rams,

entries.yo: Ati idamẹwa òṣuwọn fun ọdọ-agutan kan, bẹ̃ni fun ọdọ-agutan mẹrẹrinla:
entries.en: And a several tenth deal to each lamb of the fourteen lambs:

entries.yo: Ati obukọ kan fun ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ; pẹlu ẹbọ sisun igbagbogbo, ẹbọ ohunjijẹ rẹ̀, ati ẹbọ ohunmimu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.

entries.yo: Ati ni ijọ́ keji ni ki ẹnyin ki o fi ẹgbọrọ akọmalu mejila, àgbo meji, ọdọ-agutan mẹrinla ọlọdún kan alailabùku rubọ:
entries.en: And on the second day ye shall offer twelve young bullocks, two rams, fourteen lambs of the first year without spot:

entries.yo: Ati ẹbọ ohunjijẹ wọn, ati ẹbọ ohunmimu wọn fun akọmalu, fun àgbo, ati fun ọdọ-agutan, ki o jẹ́ bi iye wọn, gẹgẹ bi ìlana na:
entries.en: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:

entries.yo: Ati obukọ kan fun ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ; pẹlu ẹbọ sisun igbagbogbo, ati ẹbọ ohunjijẹ rẹ̀, ati ẹbọ ohunmimu wọn.
entries.en: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and the meat offering thereof, and their drink offerings.

entries.yo: Ati ni ijọ́ kẹta akọmalu mọkanla, àgbo meji, akọ ọdọ-agutan mẹrinla ọlọdún kan alailabùku;
entries.en: And on the third day eleven bullocks, two rams, fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish;

entries.yo: Ati ẹbọ ohunjijẹ wọn, ati ẹbọ ohunmimu wọn fun akọmalu, fun àgbo, ati fun ọdọ-agutan, ki o jẹ́ bi iye wọn, gẹgẹ bi ìlana na:
entries.en: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:

entries.yo: Ati obukọ kan fun ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ; pẹlu ẹbọ sisun igbagbogbo, ati ẹbọ ohunjijẹ rẹ̀, ati ẹbọ ohunmimu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, and his drink offering.

entries.yo: Ati ni ijọ́ kẹrin akọmalu mẹwa, àgbo meji, ati ọdọ-agutan mẹrinla ọlọdún kan alailabùku:
entries.en: And on the fourth day ten bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish:

entries.yo: Ẹbọ ohunjijẹ wọn, ati ẹbọ ohunmimu wọn fun akọmalu, fun àgbo, ati fun ọdọ-agutan, ki o jẹ́ bi iye wọn, gẹgẹ bi ìlana na:
entries.en: Their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:

entries.yo: Ati obukọ kan fun ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ; pẹlu ẹbọ sisun igbagbogbo, ẹbọ ohunjijẹ rẹ̀, ati ẹbọ ohunmimu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.

entries.yo: Ati ni ijọ́ karun akọmalu mẹsan, àgbo meji, ati akọ ọdọ-agutan mẹrinla ọlọdún kan alailabùku:
entries.en: And on the fifth day nine bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without spot:

entries.yo: Ati ẹbọ ohunjijẹ wọn, ati ẹbọ ohunmimu wọn fun akọmalu, fun àgbo, ati fun ọdọ-agutan, ki o jẹ́ bi iye wọn, gẹgẹ bi ìlana na:
entries.en: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:

entries.yo: Ati obukọ kan fun ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ: pẹlu ẹbọ sisun igbagbogbo, ati ẹbọ ohunjijẹ rẹ̀, ati ẹbọ ohunmimu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, and his drink offering.

entries.yo: Ati ni ijọ́ kẹfa akọmalu mẹjọ, àgbo meji, ati akọ ọdọ-agutan mẹrinla ọlọdún kan alailabùku:
entries.en: And on the sixth day eight bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish:

entries.yo: Ati ẹbọ ohunjijẹ wọn, ati ẹbọ ohunmimu wọn fun akọmalu, fun àgbo, ati fun ọdọ-agutan, ki o jẹ́ bi iye wọn, gẹgẹ bi ìlana na:
entries.en: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:

entries.yo: Ati obukọ kan fun ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ; pẹlu ẹbọ sisun igbagbogbo, ẹbọ ohunjijẹ rẹ̀, ati ẹbọ ohunmimu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.

entries.yo: Ati ni ijọ́ keje akọmalu meje, àgbo meji, ati akọ ọdọ-agutan mẹrinla ọlọdún kan alailabùku:
entries.en: And on the seventh day seven bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish:

entries.yo: Ati ẹbọ ohunjijẹ wọn, ati ẹbọ ohunmimu wọn fun akọmalu, fun àgbo, ati fun ọdọ-agutan, ki o jẹ́ bi iye wọn, gẹgẹ bi ìlana na:
entries.en: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:

entries.yo: Ati obukọ kan fun ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ; pẹlu ẹbọ sisun igbagbogbo, ẹbọ ohunjijẹ rẹ̀, ati ẹbọ ohunmimu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.

entries.yo: Ni ijọ́ kẹjọ ki ẹnyin ki o ní ajọ ti o ni ironu: ẹnyin kò gbọdọ ṣe iṣẹ agbara kan.
entries.en: On the eighth day ye shall have a solemn assembly: ye shall do no servile work therein:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ki ẹnyin ki o ru ẹbọ sisun, ẹbọ ti a fi iná ṣe, ti õrùn didùn si OLUWA: akọmalu kan, àgbo kan, akọ ọdọ-agutan meje ọlọdún kan alailabùku:
entries.en: But ye shall offer a burnt offering, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD: one bullock, one ram, seven lambs of the first year without blemish:

entries.yo: Ati ẹbọ ohunjijẹ wọn, ati ẹbọ ohunmimu wọn fun akọmalu, fun àgbo, ati fun ọdọ-agutan, ki o jẹ́ bi iye wọn, gẹgẹ bi ìlana na:
entries.en: Their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullock, for the ram, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:

entries.yo: Ati obukọ kan fun ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ; pẹlu ẹbọ sisun igbagbogbo, ati ẹbọ ohunjijẹ rẹ̀, ati ẹbọ ohunmimu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, and his drink offering.

entries.yo: Ẹbọ wọnyi ni ki ẹnyin ki o ru si OLUWA li ajọ nyin, pẹlu ẹjẹ́ nyin, ati ẹbọ ọrẹ-atinuwa nyin, fun ẹbọ sisun nyin, ati fun ẹbọ ohunjijẹ nyin, ati fun ẹbọ ohun mimu nyin, ati fun ẹbọ alafia nyin.
entries.en: These things ye shall do unto the LORD in your set feasts, beside your vows, and your freewill offerings, for your burnt offerings, and for your meat offerings, and for your drink offerings, and for your peace offerings.

entries.yo: Mose si sọ fun awọn ọmọ Israeli gẹgẹ bi gbogbo eyiti OLUWA ti fi aṣẹ lelẹ fun Mose.
entries.en: And Moses told the children of Israel according to all that the LORD commanded Moses.

entries.yo: MOSE si sọ fun awọn olori awọn ẹ̀ya awọn ọmọ Israeli, wipe, Eyi li ohun ti OLUWA palaṣẹ.
entries.en: And Moses spake unto the heads of the tribes concerning the children of Israel, saying, This is the thing which the LORD hath commanded.

entries.yo: Bi ọkunrin kan ba jẹ́ ẹjẹ́ fun OLUWA, tabi ti o ba bura lati fi dè ara rẹ̀ ni ìde, ki on ki o máṣe bà ọ̀rọ rẹ̀ jẹ; ki on ki o ṣe gẹgẹ bi gbogbo eyiti o ti ẹnu rẹ̀ jade.
entries.en: If a man vow a vow unto the LORD, or swear an oath to bind his soul with a bond; he shall not break his word, he shall do according to all that proceedeth out of his mouth.

entries.yo: Bi obinrin kan pẹlu ba si jẹ́ ẹjẹ́ fun OLUWA, ti o si dè ara rẹ̀ ni ìde, ni ile baba rẹ̀ ni ìgba ewe rẹ̀;
entries.en: If a woman also vow a vow unto the LORD, and bind herself by a bond, being in her father's house in her youth;

entries.yo: Ti baba rẹ̀ si gbọ́ ẹjẹ́ rẹ̀, ati ìde rẹ̀ ti o fi dè ara rẹ̀, ti baba rẹ̀ ba si pa ẹnu rẹ̀ mọ́ si i; njẹ ki gbogbo ẹjẹ́ rẹ̀ ki o duro, ati gbogbo ìde ti o fi dè ara rẹ̀ yio si duro.
entries.en: And her father hear her vow, and her bond wherewith she hath bound her soul, and her father shall hold his peace at her: then all her vows shall stand, and every bond wherewith she hath bound her soul shall stand.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi baba rẹ̀ ba kọ̀ fun u li ọjọ́ na ti o gbọ́; kò sí ọkan ninu ẹjẹ́ rẹ̀, tabi ninu ìde ti o fi dè ara rẹ̀, ti yio duro: OLUWA yio si darijì i, nitoriti baba rẹ̀ kọ̀ fun u.
entries.en: But if her father disallow her in the day that he heareth; not any of her vows, or of her bonds wherewith she hath bound her soul, shall stand: and the LORD shall forgive her, because her father disallowed her.

entries.yo: Bi o ba si kúku li ọkọ, nigbati o jẹ́ ẹjẹ́, tabi ti o sọ̀rọ kan lati ẹnu rẹ̀ jade, ninu eyiti o fi dè ara rẹ̀ ni ìde;
entries.en: And if she had at all an husband, when she vowed, or uttered ought out of her lips, wherewith she bound her soul;

entries.yo: Ti ọkọ rẹ̀ si gbọ́, ti o si pa ẹnu rẹ̀ mọ́ si i li ọjọ́ na ti o gbọ́; njẹ ẹjẹ́ rẹ̀ yio duro, ìde ti o fi dè ara rẹ̀ yio si duro.
entries.en: And her husband heard it, and held his peace at her in the day that he heard it: then her vows shall stand, and her bonds wherewith she bound her soul shall stand.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi ọkọ rẹ̀ ba kọ̀ fun u li ọjọ́ na ti o gbọ́; njẹ on o mu ẹjẹ́ rẹ̀ ti o jẹ́ ati ohun ti o ti ẹnu rẹ̀ jade, eyiti o fi dè ara rẹ̀ dasan: OLUWA yio si darijì i.
entries.en: But if her husband disallowed her on the day that he heard it; then he shall make her vow which she vowed, and that which she uttered with her lips, wherewith she bound her soul, of none effect: and the LORD shall forgive her.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn gbogbo ẹjẹ́ opó, ati ti obinrin ti a kọ̀silẹ, ti nwọn fi dè ara wọn, yio wà lọrùn rẹ̀.
entries.en: But every vow of a widow, and of her that is divorced, wherewith they have bound their souls, shall stand against her.

entries.yo: Bi o ba si jẹjẹ́ ni ile ọkọ rẹ̀, tabi ti o si fi ibura dè ara rẹ̀ ni ìde,
entries.en: And if she vowed in her husband's house, or bound her soul by a bond with an oath;

entries.yo: Ti ọkọ rẹ̀ si gbọ́, ti o si pa ẹnu rẹ̀ mọ́ si i, ti kò si kọ̀ fun u: njẹ gbogbo ẹjẹ́ rẹ̀ ni yio duro, ati gbogbo ìde ti o fi dè ara rẹ̀ yio si duro.
entries.en: And her husband heard it, and held his peace at her, and disallowed her not: then all her vows shall stand, and every bond wherewith she bound her soul shall stand.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi ọkọ rẹ̀ ba sọ wọn dasan patapata li ọjọ́ na ti o gbọ́; njẹ ohunkohun ti o ti ẹnu rẹ̀ jade nipasẹ̀ ẹjẹ́ rẹ̀, tabi nipasẹ̀ ìde ọkàn rẹ̀, ki yio duro: ọkọ rẹ̀ ti sọ wọn dasan; OLUWA yio si darijì i.
entries.en: But if her husband hath utterly made them void on the day he heard them; then whatsoever proceeded out of her lips concerning her vows, or concerning the bond of her soul, shall not stand: her husband hath made them void; and the LORD shall forgive her.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ẹjẹ́ ati ibura ìde lati fi pọ́n ara loju, ọkọ rẹ̀ li o le mu u duro, o si le sọ ọ dasan.
entries.en: Every vow, and every binding oath to afflict the soul, her husband may establish it, or her husband may make it void.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi ọkọ rẹ̀ ba pa ẹnu rẹ̀ mọ́ si i patapata lati ọjọ́ dé ọjọ́; njẹ o fi mu gbogbo ẹjẹ́ rẹ̀ duro, tabi gbogbo ìde rẹ̀ ti mbẹ lara rẹ̀; o mu wọn duro, nitoriti o pa ẹnu rẹ̀ mọ si i li ọjọ́ na ti o gbọ́.
entries.en: But if her husband altogether hold his peace at her from day to day; then he establisheth all her vows, or all her bonds, which are upon her: he confirmeth them, because he held his peace at her in the day that he heard them.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi o ba sọ wọn dasan, lẹhin igbati o gbọ́; njẹ on ni yio rù ẹ̀ṣẹ obinrin na.
entries.en: But if he shall any ways make them void after that he hath heard them; then he shall bear her iniquity.

entries.yo: Wọnyi ni ìlana ti OLUWA palaṣẹ fun Mose, lãrin ọkunrin ati aya rẹ̀, lãrin baba ati ọmọbinrin rẹ̀, ti iṣe ewe ninu ile baba rẹ̀.
entries.en: These are the statutes, which the LORD commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, between the father and his daughter, being yet in her youth in her father's house.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Gbẹsan awọn ọmọ Israeli lara awọn ara Midiani: lẹhin eyinì ni a o kó ọ jọ pẹlu awọn enia rẹ.
entries.en: Avenge the children of Israel of the Midianites: afterward shalt thou be gathered unto thy people.

entries.yo: Mose si sọ fun awọn enia na pe, Ki ninu nyin ki o hamọra ogun, ki nwọn ki o si tọ̀ awọn ara Midiani lọ, ki nwọn ki o si gbẹsan OLUWA lara Midiani.
entries.en: And Moses spake unto the people, saying, Arm some of yourselves unto the war, and let them go against the Midianites, and avenge the LORD of Midian.

entries.yo: Ninu ẹ̀ya kọkan ẹgbẹrun enia, ni gbogbo ẹ̀ya Israeli, ni ki ẹnyin ki o rán lọ si ogun na.
entries.en: Of every tribe a thousand, throughout all the tribes of Israel, shall ye send to the war.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni nwọn si yàn ninu awọn ẹgbẹgbẹrun enia Israeli, ẹgbẹrun enia ninu ẹ̀ya kọkan, ẹgba mẹfa enia ti o hamọra ogun.
entries.en: So there were delivered out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand of every tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.

entries.yo: Mose si rán wọn lọ si ogun na, ẹgbẹrun enia ninu ẹ̀ya kọkan, awọn ati Finehasi ọmọ Eleasari alufa si ogun na, ti on ti ohunèlo ibi-mimọ́, ati ipè wọnni li ọwọ́ rẹ̀ lati fun.
entries.en: And Moses sent them to the war, a thousand of every tribe, them and Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the holy instruments, and the trumpets to blow in his hand.

entries.yo: Nwón si bá awọn ara Midiani jà, bi OLUWA ti paṣẹ fun Mose; nwọn si pa gbogbo awọn ọkunrin.
entries.en: And they warred against the Midianites, as the LORD commanded Moses; and they slew all the males.

entries.yo: Nwọn si pa awọn ọba Midiani, pẹlu awọn iyokù ti a pa; eyinì ni Efi, ati Rekemu, ati Suru, ati Huri, ati Reba, ọba Midiani marun: Balaamu ọmọ Beoru ni nwọn si fi idà pa.
entries.en: And they slew the kings of Midian, beside the rest of them that were slain; namely, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, five kings of Midian: Balaam also the son of Beor they slew with the sword.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Israeli si mú gbogbo awọn obinrin Midiani ni igbẹsin, ati awọn ọmọ kekere wọn, nwọn si kó gbogbo ohunọ̀sin wọn, ati gbogbo agboẹran wọn, ati gbogbo ẹrù wọn.
entries.en: And the children of Israel took all the women of Midian captives, and their little ones, and took the spoil of all their cattle, and all their flocks, and all their goods.

entries.yo: Nwọn si fi iná kun gbogbo ilu wọn ninu eyiti nwọn ngbé, ati gbogbo ibudó wọn.
entries.en: And they burnt all their cities wherein they dwelt, and all their goodly castles, with fire.

entries.yo: Nwọn si kó gbogbo ikogun wọn, ati gbogbo ohun-iní, ati enia ati ẹran.
entries.en: And they took all the spoil, and all the prey, both of men and of beasts.

entries.yo: Nwọn si kó igbẹsin, ati ohun-iní, ati ikogun na wá sọdọ Mose, ati Eleasari alufa, ati sọdọ ijọ awọn ọmọ Israeli, si ibudó ni pẹtẹlẹ̀ Moabu, ti mbẹ lẹba Jordani leti Jeriko.
entries.en: And they brought the captives, and the prey, and the spoil, unto Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and unto the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the camp at the plains of Moab, which are by Jordan near Jericho.

entries.yo: Ati Mose, ati Eleasari alufa, ati gbogbo awọn olori ijọ, jade lọ ipade wọn lẹhin ibudó.
entries.en: And Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and all the princes of the congregation, went forth to meet them without the camp.

entries.yo: Mose si binu si awọn olori ogun na, pẹlu awọn balogun ẹgbẹgbẹrun, ati balogun ọrọrún, ti o ti ogun na bọ̀.
entries.en: And Moses was wroth with the officers of the host, with the captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, which came from the battle.

entries.yo: Mose si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ da gbogbo awọn obinrin si?
entries.en: And Moses said unto them, Have ye saved all the women alive?

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, nipaṣe ọ̀rọ Balaamu awọn wọnyi li o mu awọn ọmọ Israeli dẹ̀ṣẹ si OLUWA niti ọ̀ran Peori, ti àrun si fi wà ninu ijọ OLUWA.
entries.en: Behold, these caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against the LORD in the matter of Peor, and there was a plague among the congregation of the LORD.

entries.yo: Njẹ nitorina, ẹ pa gbogbo ọkunrin ninu awọn ọmọ wẹ́wẹ, ki ẹ si pa gbogbo awọn obinrin ti o ti mọ̀ ọkunrin nipa ibá dapọ̀.
entries.en: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman that hath known man by lying with him.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn gbogbo awọn ọmọbinrin kekeké ti nwọn kò mọ̀ ọkunrin nipa ibá dapọ̀, ni ki ẹnyin dasi fun ara nyin.
entries.en: But all the women children, that have not known a man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o si duro lẹhin ibudó ni ijọ meje: ẹnikẹni ti o ba pa enia, ati ẹnikẹni ti o ba farakàn ẹniti a pa, ki ẹnyin si wẹ̀ ara nyin mọ́, ati ara awọn igbẹsin nyin ni ijọ́ kẹta, ati ni ijọ́ keje.
entries.en: And do ye abide without the camp seven days: whosoever hath killed any person, and whosoever hath touched any slain, purify both yourselves and your captives on the third day, and on the seventh day.

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin si fọ̀ gbogbo aṣọ nyin mọ́, ati gbogbo ohun ti a fi awọ ṣe, ati ohun gbogbo iṣẹ irun ewurẹ, ati ohun gbogbo ti a fi igi ṣe.
entries.en: And purify all your raiment, and all that is made of skins, and all work of goats' hair, and all things made of wood.

entries.yo: Eleasari alufa si wi fun awọn ologun ti nwọn lọ si ogun na pe, Eyi ni ilana ofin ti OLUWA filelẹ li aṣẹ fun Mose.
entries.en: And Eleazar the priest said unto the men of war which went to the battle, This is the ordinance of the law which the LORD commanded Moses;

entries.yo: Kìki wurà, ati fadakà, ati idẹ ati irin, ati tanganran, ati ojé,
entries.en: Only the gold, and the silver, the brass, the iron, the tin, and the lead,

entries.yo: Gbogbo ohun ti o le kọja ninu iná, ni ki ẹnyin ki o mu là iná já yio si di mimọ́; ṣugbọn a o fi omi ìyasapakan wẹ̀ ẹ mọ́: ati gbogbo ohun ti kò le kọja ninu iná ni ki a mu là inu omi.
entries.en: Every thing that may abide the fire, ye shall make it go through the fire, and it shall be clean: nevertheless it shall be purified with the water of separation: and all that abideth not the fire ye shall make go through the water.

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o si fọ̀ aṣọ nyin ni ijọ́ keje, ẹnyin o si di mimọ́, lẹhin eyinì li ẹnyin o si wá sinu ibudó.
entries.en: And ye shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and ye shall be clean, and afterward ye shall come into the camp.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Kà iye ikogun ti a kó, ti enia ati ti ẹran, iwọ ati Eleasari alufa, ati awọn olori ile baba ijọ:
entries.en: Take the sum of the prey that was taken, both of man and of beast, thou, and Eleazar the priest, and the chief fathers of the congregation:

entries.yo: Ki o si pín ikogun na si ipa meji; lãrin awọn ologun, ti o jade lọ si ogun na, ati lãrin gbogbo ijọ.
entries.en: And divide the prey into two parts; between them that took the war upon them, who went out to battle, and between all the congregation:

entries.yo: Ki o si gbà ohun idá ti OLUWA lọwọ awọn ologun ti nwọn jade lọ si ogun na: ọkan ninu ẹdẹgbẹta, ninu awọn enia, ati ninu malu, ati ninu kẹtẹkẹtẹ, ati ninu agbo-ẹran:
entries.en: And levy a tribute unto the LORD of the men of war which went out to battle: one soul of five hundred, both of the persons, and of the beeves, and of the asses, and of the sheep:

entries.yo: Gbà a ninu àbọ ti wọn, ki o si fi i fun Eleasari alufa, fun ẹbọ igbesọsoke OLUWA.
entries.en: Take it of their half, and give it unto Eleazar the priest, for an heave offering of the LORD.

entries.yo: Ati ninu àbọ ti iṣe ti awọn ọmọ Israeli, ki iwọ ki o si gbà ipín kan ninu ãdọta, ninu enia, ninu malu, ninu kẹtẹkẹtẹ, ati ninu agbo-ẹran, ninu onirũru ẹran, ki o si fi wọn fun awọn ọmọ Lefi, ti nṣe itọju agọ́ OLUWA.
entries.en: And of the children of Israel's half, thou shalt take one portion of fifty, of the persons, of the beeves, of the asses, and of the flocks, of all manner of beasts, and give them unto the Levites, which keep the charge of the tabernacle of the LORD.

entries.yo: Ati Mose ati Eleasari alufa si ṣe bi OLUWA ti paṣẹ fun Mose.
entries.en: And Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the LORD commanded Moses.

entries.yo: Ati ikogun ti o kù ninu ohun-iní ti awọn ologun kó, o jẹ́ ọkẹ mẹrinlelọgbọ̀n o din ẹgbẹdọgbọ̀n agutan,
entries.en: And the booty, being the rest of the prey which the men of war had caught, was six hundred thousand and seventy thousand and five thousand sheep,

entries.yo: Ẹgba mẹrindilogoji malu,
entries.en: And threescore and twelve thousand beeves,

entries.yo: Ọkẹ mẹta o le ẹgbẹrun kẹtẹkẹtẹ,
entries.en: And threescore and one thousand asses,

entries.yo: Ati enia ninu awọn obinrin ti kò mọ̀ ọkunrin nipa ibá dàpọ, gbogbo wọn jẹ́ ẹgba mẹrindilogun.
entries.en: And thirty and two thousand persons in all, of woman that had not known man by lying with him.

entries.yo: Ati àbọ ti iṣe ipín ti awọn ti o jade lọ si ogun, o jẹ́ ẹgba mejidilãdọsan o le ẹdẹgbẹjọ agutan ni iye:
entries.en: And the half, which was the portion of them that went out to war, was in number three hundred thousand and seven and thirty thousand and five hundred sheep:

entries.yo: Idá ti OLUWA ninu agutan wọnni jẹ́ ẹdẹgbẹrin o din mẹdọgbọ̀n.
entries.en: And the LORD's tribute of the sheep was six hundred and threescore and fifteen.

entries.yo: Ati malu jẹ́ ẹgba mejidilogun; ninu eyiti idá ti OLUWA jẹ mejilelãdọrin.
entries.en: And the beeves were thirty and six thousand; of which the LORD's tribute was threescore and twelve.

entries.yo: Kẹtẹkẹtẹ si jẹ́ ẹgba mẹdogun o le ẹdẹgbẹta; ninu eyiti idá ti OLUWA jẹ́ ọgọta o le ọkan.
entries.en: And the asses were thirty thousand and five hundred; of which the LORD's tribute was threescore and one.

entries.yo: Awọn enia si jẹ́ ẹgba mẹjọ; ninu eyiti idá ti OLUWA jẹ́ ọgbọ̀n o le meji.
entries.en: And the persons were sixteen thousand; of which the LORD's tribute was thirty and two persons.

entries.yo: Mose si fi idá ti ẹbọ igbesọsoke OLUWA fun Eleasari alufa, bi OLUWA ti paṣẹ fun Mose.
entries.en: And Moses gave the tribute, which was the LORD's heave offering, unto Eleazar the priest, as the LORD commanded Moses.

entries.yo: Ati ninu àbọ ti awọn ọmọ Israeli, ti Mose pín kuro ninu ti awọn ọkunrin ti o jagun na,
entries.en: And of the children of Israel's half, which Moses divided from the men that warred,

entries.yo: (Njẹ àbọ ti ijọ jẹ́ ẹgba mejidilãdọsan o le ẹdẹgbẹjọ agutan,
entries.en: (Now the half that pertained unto the congregation was three hundred thousand and thirty thousand and seven thousand and five hundred sheep,

entries.yo: Ati ẹgba mejidilogun malu.
entries.en: And thirty and six thousand beeves,

entries.yo: Ati ẹgba mẹdogun o le ẹdẹgbẹta kẹtẹkẹtẹ.
entries.en: And thirty thousand asses and five hundred,

entries.yo: Ati ẹgba mẹjọ enia;)
entries.en: And sixteen thousand persons;)

entries.yo: Ani ninu àbọ ti awọn ọmọ Israeli, Mose mú ipín kan ninu ãdọta, ati ti enia ati ti ẹran, o si fi wọn fun awọn ọmọ Lefi, ti nṣe itọju agọ́ OLUWA; bi OLUWA ti paṣẹ fun Mose.
entries.en: Even of the children of Israel's half, Moses took one portion of fifty, both of man and of beast, and gave them unto the Levites, which kept the charge of the tabernacle of the LORD; as the LORD commanded Moses.

entries.yo: Ati awọn olori ti o wà lori ẹgbẹgbẹrun ogun na, ati awọn balogun ẹgbẹgbẹrun, ati awọn balogun ọrọrún, wá sọdọ Mose:
entries.en: And the officers which were over thousands of the host, the captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds, came near unto Moses:

entries.yo: Nwọn si wi fun Mose pe, Awọn iranṣẹ rẹ ti kà iye awọn ologun, ti mbẹ ni itọju wa, ọkunrin kan ninu wa kò si din.
entries.en: And they said unto Moses, Thy servants have taken the sum of the men of war which are under our charge, and there lacketh not one man of us.

entries.yo: Nitorina li awa ṣe mú ọrẹ-ebọ wá fun OLUWA, ohunkohun ti olukuluku ri, ohun ọ̀ṣọ wurà, ẹ̀wọn, ati jufù, ati oruka-àmi, ati oruka-etí, ati ìlẹkẹ, lati fi ṣètutu fun ọkàn wa niwaju OLUWA.
entries.en: We have therefore brought an oblation for the LORD, what every man hath gotten, of jewels of gold, chains, and bracelets, rings, earrings, and tablets, to make an atonement for our souls before the LORD.

entries.yo: Mose ati Eleasari alufa si gbà wurà na lọwọ wọn, ani gbogbo ohun-iṣẹ ọsọ́.
entries.en: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of them, even all wrought jewels.

entries.yo: Ati gbogbo wurà ẹbọ igbesọsoke ti nwọn múwa fun OLUWA, lati ọdọ awọn balogun ẹgbẹgbẹrun, ati lati ọdọ awọn balogun ọrọrún, o jẹ́ ẹgba mẹjọ o le ẹdẹgbẹrin o le ãdọta ṣekeli.
entries.en: And all the gold of the offering that they offered up to the LORD, of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred and fifty shekels.

entries.yo: (Nitoripe awọn ologun ti kó ẹrù, olukuluku fun ara rẹ̀.)
entries.en: (For the men of war had taken spoil, every man for himself.)

entries.yo: Mose ati Eleasari alufa si gbà wurà na lọwọ awọn balogun ẹgbẹgbẹrun, ati lọwọ awọn balogun ọrọrún nwọn si mú u wá sinu agọ́ ajọ, ni iranti fun awọn ọmọ Israeli niwaju OLUWA.
entries.en: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the tabernacle of the congregation, for a memorial for the children of Israel before the LORD.

entries.yo: NJẸ awọn ọmọ Reubeni ati awọn ọmọ Gadi ní ọ̀pọlọpọ ohunọ̀sin: nwọn si ri ilẹ Jaseri, ati ilẹ Gileadi, si kiyesi i, ibẹ̀ na, ibi ohunọ̀sin ni;
entries.en: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of cattle: and when they saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead, that, behold, the place was a place for cattle;

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Gadi ati awọn ọmọ Reubeni si wá, nwọn si sọ fun Mose, ati fun Eleasari alufa ati fun awọn olori ijọ pe,
entries.en: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spake unto Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and unto the princes of the congregation, saying,

entries.yo: Atarotu, ati Diboni, ati Jaseri, ati Nimra, ati Heṣboni, ati Eleale, ati Ṣebamu, ati Nebo, ati Beoni.
entries.en: Ataroth, and Dibon, and Jazer, and Nimrah, and Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Shebam, and Nebo, and Beon,

entries.yo: Ilẹ na ti OLUWA ti kọlù niwaju ijọ Israeli, ilẹ ohunọ̀sin ni, awa iranṣẹ rẹ si ní ohunọ̀sin.
entries.en: Even the country which the LORD smote before the congregation of Israel, is a land for cattle, and thy servants have cattle:

entries.yo: Nwọn si wipe, Bi awa ba ri ore-ọfẹ li oju rẹ, jẹ ki a fi ilẹ yi fun awọn iranṣẹ rẹ fun ilẹ-iní; ki o má si ṣe mú wa gòke Jordani lọ.
entries.en: Wherefore, said they, if we have found grace in thy sight, let this land be given unto thy servants for a possession, and bring us not over Jordan.

entries.yo: Mose si wi fun awọn ọmọ Gadi ati fun awọn ọmọ Reubeni pe, Awọn arakunrin nyin yio ha lọ si ogun, ki ẹnyin ki o si joko nihinyi?
entries.en: And Moses said unto the children of Gad and to the children of Reuben, Shall your brethren go to war, and shall ye sit here?

entries.yo: Ẽṣe ti ẹnyin fi ntán ọkàn awọn ọmọ Israeli niyanju ati rekọja lọ sinu ilẹ ti OLUWA fi fun wọn?
entries.en: And wherefore discourage ye the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which the LORD hath given them?

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li awọn baba nyin ṣe, nigbati mo rán wọn lati Kadeṣi-barnea lọ lati wò ilẹ na.
entries.en: Thus did your fathers, when I sent them from Kadesh-barnea to see the land.

entries.yo: Nitoripe nigbati nwọn gòke lọ dé afonifoji Eṣkolu, ti nwọn si ri ilẹ na, nwọn tán ọkàn awọn ọmọ Israeli niyanju, ki nwọn ki o má le lọ sinu ilẹ ti OLUWA ti fi fun wọn.
entries.en: For when they went up unto the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which the LORD had given them.

entries.yo: Ibinu Ọlọrun si rú si wọn nigbana, o si bura, wipe,
entries.en: And the LORD's anger was kindled the same time, and he sware, saying,

entries.yo: Nitõtọ ọkan ninu awọn ọkunrin wọnyi ti o gòke lati Egipti wá, lati ẹni ogún ọdún lọ ati jù bẹ̃ lọ, ki yio ri ilẹ na ti mo ti bura fun Abrahamu, fun Isaaki, ati fun Jakobu: nitoriti nwọn kò tẹle mi lẹhin patapata.
entries.en: Surely none of the men that came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I sware unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob; because they have not wholly followed me:

entries.yo: Bikoṣe Kalebu ọmọ Jefunne ọmọ Kenissi, ati Joṣua ọmọ Nuni: nitoripe awọn li o tẹle OLUWA lẹhin patapata.
entries.en: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite, and Joshua the son of Nun: for they have wholly followed the LORD.

entries.yo: Ibinu OLUWA si rú si Israeli, o si mu wọn rìn kiri li aginjù li ogoji ọdún, titi gbogbo iran na, ti o ṣe buburu li oju OLUWA fi run.
entries.en: And the LORD's anger was kindled against Israel, and he made them wander in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation, that had done evil in the sight of the LORD, was consumed.

entries.yo: Si kiyesi i, ẹnyin dide ni ipò baba nyin, iran ẹ̀lẹṣẹ, lati mu ibinu gbigbona OLUWA pọ̀ si i si Israeli.
entries.en: And, behold, ye are risen up in your fathers' stead, an increase of sinful men, to augment yet the fierce anger of the LORD toward Israel.

entries.yo: Nitoripe bi ẹnyin ba yipada kuro lẹhin rẹ̀, on o si tun fi wọn silẹ li aginjù; ẹnyin o si run gbogbo awọn enia yi.
entries.en: For if ye turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and ye shall destroy all this people.

entries.yo: Nwọn si sunmọ ọ wipe, Awa o kọ́ ile-ẹran nihinyi fun ohunọ̀sin wa, ati ilu fun awọn ọmọ wẹ́wẹ wa:
entries.en: And they came near unto him, and said, We will build sheepfolds here for our cattle, and cities for our little ones:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awa tikala wa yio di ihamọra wa giri, niwaju awọn ọmọ Israeli, titi awa o fi mú wọn dé ipò wọn: awọn ọmọ wẹ́wẹ wa yio si ma gbé inu ilu olodi nitori awọn ara ilẹ na.
entries.en: But we ourselves will go ready armed before the children of Israel, until we have brought them unto their place: and our little ones shall dwell in the fenced cities because of the inhabitants of the land.

entries.yo: Awa ki yio pada bọ̀ si ile wa, titi olukuluku awọn ọmọ Israeli yio fi ní ilẹ-iní rẹ̀.
entries.en: We will not return unto our houses, until the children of Israel have inherited every man his inheritance.

entries.yo: Nitoripe awa ki yio ní ilẹ-iní pẹlu wọn ni ìha ọhún Jordani, tabi niwaju: nitoriti awa ní ilẹ-iní wa ni ìha ihin Jordani ni ìha ìla õrùn.
entries.en: For we will not inherit with them on yonder side Jordan, or forward; because our inheritance is fallen to us on this side Jordan eastward.

entries.yo: Mose si wi fun wọn pe, Bi ẹnyin o ba ṣe eyi; bi ẹnyin o ba di ihamọra niwaju OLUWA lọ si ogun,
entries.en: And Moses said unto them, If ye will do this thing, if ye will go armed before the LORD to war,

entries.yo: Bi gbogbo nyin yio ba gòke Jordani ni ihamora niwaju OLUWA, titi yio fi lé awọn ọtá rẹ̀ kuro niwaju rẹ̀,
entries.en: And will go all of you armed over Jordan before the LORD, until he hath driven out his enemies from before him,

entries.yo: Ti a o si fi ṣẹ́ ilẹ na niwaju OLUWA: lẹhin na li ẹnyin o pada, ẹnyin o si jẹ́ àlailẹṣẹ niwaju OLUWA, ati niwaju Israeli; ilẹ yi yio si ma jẹ́ iní nyin niwaju OLUWA.
entries.en: And the land be subdued before the LORD: then afterward ye shall return, and be guiltless before the LORD, and before Israel; and this land shall be your possession before the LORD.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi ẹnyin ki yio ba ṣe bẹ̃, kiyesi i, ẹnyin dẹ̀ṣẹ si OLUWA, ki o si dá nyin loju pe, ẹ̀ṣẹ nyin yio fi nyin hàn.
entries.en: But if ye will not do so, behold, ye have sinned against the LORD: and be sure your sin will find you out.

entries.yo: Ẹ kọ́ ilu fun awọn ọmọ wẹ́wẹ nyin, ati agbo fun agutan nyin; ki ẹ si ṣe eyiti o ti ẹnu nyin jade wa.
entries.en: Build you cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which hath proceeded out of your mouth.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Gadi, ati awọn Reubeni si sọ fun Mose pe, Awọn iranṣẹ rẹ yio ṣe bi oluwa mi ti fi aṣẹ lelẹ.
entries.en: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben spake unto Moses, saying, Thy servants will do as my lord commandeth.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ wẹ́wẹ wa, ati awọn aya wa, agbo-ẹran wa, ati gbogbo ohunọsìn wa yio wà nibẹ̀ ni ilu Gileadi:
entries.en: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our cattle, shall be there in the cities of Gilead:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn iranṣẹ rẹ yio gòke odò, olukuluku ni ihamọra ogun, niwaju OLUWA lati jà, bi oluwa mi ti wi.
entries.en: But thy servants will pass over, every man armed for war, before the LORD to battle, as my lord saith.

entries.yo: Mose si paṣẹ fun Eleasari alufa, ati fun Joṣua ọmọ Nuni, ati fun awọn olori ile baba awọn ẹ̀ya ọmọ Israeli, nipa ti wọn.
entries.en: So concerning them Moses commanded Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the chief fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel:

entries.yo: Mose si wi fun wọn pe, Bi awọn ọmọ Gadi ati awọn ọmọ Reubeni yio ba bá nyin gòke Jordani lọ, olukuluku ni ihamọra fun ogun, niwaju OLUWA, ti a si ṣẹ́ ilẹ na niwaju nyin; njẹ ki ẹnyin ki o fi ilẹ Gileadi fun wọn ni iní:
entries.en: And Moses said unto them, If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over Jordan, every man armed to battle, before the LORD, and the land shall be subdued before you; then ye shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi nwọn kò ba fẹ́ ba nyin gòke odò ni ihamọra, njẹ ki nwọn ki o ní iní lãrin nyin ni ilẹ Kenaani.
entries.en: But if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Gadi ati awọn ọmọ Reubeni dahùn, wipe, Bi OLUWA ti wi fun awọn iranṣẹ rẹ, bẹ̃li awa o ṣe.
entries.en: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, As the LORD hath said unto thy servants, so will we do.

entries.yo: Awa o gòke lọ ni ihamọra niwaju OLUWA si ilẹ Kenaani, ki iní wa ni ìha ihin Jordani ki o le jẹ́ ti wa.
entries.en: We will pass over armed before the LORD into the land of Canaan, that the possession of our inheritance on this side Jordan may be ours.

entries.yo: Mose si fi ilẹ-ọba Sihoni ọba awọn ọmọ Amori, ati ilẹ-ọba Ogu ọba Baṣani fun wọn, ani fun awọn ọmọ Gadi, ati fun awọn ọmọ Reubeni, ati fun àbọ ẹ̀ya Manasse ọmọ Josefu, ilẹ na, pẹlu ilu rẹ̀ li àgbegbe rẹ̀, ani ilu ilẹ na yiká.
entries.en: And Moses gave unto them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and unto half the tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, the land, with the cities thereof in the coasts, even the cities of the country round about.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Gadi si kọ́ Didoni, ati Atarotu, ati Aroeri;
entries.en: And the children of Gad built Dibon, and Ataroth, and Aroer,

entries.yo: Ati Atrotu-ṣofani, ati Jaseri, ati Jogbeha;
entries.en: And Atroth, Shophan, and Jaazer, and Jogbehah,

entries.yo: Ati Beti-nimra, ati Beti-harani, ilu olodi, ati agbo fun agutan.
entries.en: And Beth-nimrah, and Beth-haran, fenced cities: and folds for sheep.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Reubeni si kọ́ Heṣboni, ati Eleale, ati Kiriataimu.
entries.en: And the children of Reuben built Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Kirjathaim,

entries.yo: Ati Nebo, ati Baali-meoni, (nwọn pàrọ orukọ wọn,) ati Sibma: nwọn si sọ ilu ti nwọn kọ́ li orukọ miran.
entries.en: And Nebo, and Baal-meon, (their names being changed,) and Shibmah: and gave other names unto the cities which they builded.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Makiri ọmọ Manase si lọ si Gileadi, nwọn si gbà a, nwọn si lé awọn ọmọ Amori ti o wà ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, and took it, and dispossessed the Amorite which was in it.

entries.yo: Mose si fi Gileadi fun Makiri ọmọ Manase; o si joko ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Moses gave Gilead unto Machir the son of Manasseh; and he dwelt therein.

entries.yo: Jairi ọmọ Manasse, si lọ, o si gbà awọn ilu wọn, o si sọ wọn ni Haffotu-jairi.
entries.en: And Jair the son of Manasseh went and took the small towns thereof, and called them Havoth-jair.

entries.yo: Noba si lọ, o si gbà Kenati, ati awọn ileto rẹ̀, o si sọ ọ ni Noba, nipa orukọ ara rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Nobah went and took Kenath, and the villages thereof, and called it Nobah, after his own name.

entries.yo: WỌNYI ni ìrin awọn ọmọ Israeli, ti o ti ilẹ Egipti jade wá pẹlu awọn ogun wọn, nipa ọwọ́ Mose ati Aaroni.
entries.en: These are the journeys of the children of Israel, which went forth out of the land of Egypt with their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.

entries.yo: Mose si kọwe ijadelọ wọn gẹgẹ bi ìrin wọn, nipa aṣẹ OLUWA; wọnyi si ni ìrin wọn gẹgẹ bi ijadelọ wọn.
entries.en: And Moses wrote their goings out according to their journeys by the commandment of the LORD: and these are their journeys according to their goings out.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣí kuro ni Ramesesi li oṣù kini, ni ijọ́ kẹdogun oṣù kini na; ni ijọ́ keji ajọ irekọja li awọn ọmọ Israeli jade pẹlu ọwọ́ giga li oju gbogbo awọn ara Egipti.
entries.en: And they departed from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the morrow after the passover the children of Israel went out with an high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians.

entries.yo: Bi awọn ara Egipti ti nsinkú gbogbo awọn akọ́bi wọn ti OLUWA kọlù ninu wọn: lara awọn oriṣa wọn pẹlu li OLUWA ṣe idajọ.
entries.en: For the Egyptians buried all their firstborn, which the LORD had smitten among them: upon their gods also the LORD executed judgments.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Israeli si ṣí kuro ni Ramesesi, nwọn si dó si Sukkotu.
entries.en: And the children of Israel removed from Rameses, and pitched in Succoth.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣí kuro ni Sukkotu, nwọn si dó si Etamu, ti mbẹ leti aginjù.
entries.en: And they departed from Succoth, and pitched in Etham, which is in the edge of the wilderness.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣí kuro ni Etamu, nwọn si pada lọ si Pi-hahirotu, ti mbẹ niwaju Baali-sefoni: nwọn si dó siwaju Migdolu.
entries.en: And they removed from Etham, and turned again unto Pi-hahiroth, which is before Baal-zephon: and they pitched before Migdol.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣí kuro niwaju Hahirotu, nwọn si là ãrin okun já lọ si aginjù: nwọn si rìn ìrin ijọ́ mẹta li aginjù Etamu, nwọn si dó si Mara.
entries.en: And they departed from before Pi-hahiroth, and passed through the midst of the sea into the wilderness, and went three days' journey in the wilderness of Etham, and pitched in Marah.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣí kuro ni Mara, nwọn si wá si Elimu: ni Elimu ni orisun omi mejila, ati ãdọrin igi ọpẹ wà; nwọn si dó sibẹ̀.
entries.en: And they removed from Marah, and came unto Elim: and in Elim were twelve fountains of water, and threescore and ten palm trees; and they pitched there.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣí kuro ni Elimu, nwọn si dó si ẹba Okun Pupa.
entries.en: And they removed from Elim, and encamped by the Red sea.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣí kuro li Okun Pupa, nwọn si dó si aginjù Sini.
entries.en: And they removed from the Red sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣí kuro ni aginjù Sini, nwọn si dó si Dofka.
entries.en: And they took their journey out of the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣí kuro ni Dofka, nwọn si dó si Aluṣi.
entries.en: And they departed from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣí kuro ni Aluṣi, nwọn si dó si Refidimu, nibiti omi kò gbé sí fun awọn enia na lati mu.
entries.en: And they removed from Alush, and encamped at Rephidim, where was no water for the people to drink.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣí kuro ni Refidimu, nwọn si dó si aginjù Sinai.
entries.en: And they departed from Rephidim, and pitched in the wilderness of Sinai.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣí kuro ni aginjù Sinai, nwọn si dó si Kibrotu-hattaafa.
entries.en: And they removed from the desert of Sinai, and pitched at Kibroth-hattaavah.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣí kuro ni Kibrotu-hattaafa, nwọn si dó si Haserotu.
entries.en: And they departed from Kibroth-hattaavah, and encamped at Hazeroth.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣí kuro ni Haserotu, nwọn si dó si Ritma.
entries.en: And they departed from Hazeroth, and pitched in Rithmah.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣí kuro ni Ritma, nwọn si dó si Rimmon-peresi.
entries.en: And they departed from Rithmah, and pitched at Rimmon-parez.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣí kuro ni Rimmon-peresi, nwọn si dó si Libna.
entries.en: And they departed from Rimmon-parez, and pitched in Libnah.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣí kuro ni Libna, nwọn si dó si Rissa.
entries.en: And they removed from Libnah, and pitched at Rissah.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣí kuro ni Rissa, nwọn si dó si Kehelata.
entries.en: And they journeyed from Rissah, and pitched in Kehelathah.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣí kuro ni Kehelata, nwọn si dó si òke Ṣeferi.
entries.en: And they went from Kehelathah, and pitched in mount Shapher.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣí kuro ni òke Ṣeferi, nwọn si dó si Harada.
entries.en: And they removed from mount Shapher, and encamped in Haradah.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣí kuro ni Harada, nwọn si dó si Makhelotu.
entries.en: And they removed from Haradah, and pitched in Makheloth.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣí kuro ni Makhelotu, nwọn si dó si Tahati.
entries.en: And they removed from Makheloth, and encamped at Tahath.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣí kuro ni Tahati, nwọn si dó si Tera.
entries.en: And they departed from Tahath, and pitched at Tarah.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣí kuro ni Tera, nwọn si dó si Mitka.
entries.en: And they removed from Tarah, and pitched in Mithcah.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣí kuro ni Mitka, nwọn si dó si Haṣmona.
entries.en: And they went from Mithcah, and pitched in Hashmonah.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣí kuro ni Haṣmona, nwọn si dó si Moserotu.
entries.en: And they departed from Hashmonah, and encamped at Moseroth.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣí kuro ni Moserotu, nwọn si dó si Bene-jaakani.
entries.en: And they departed from Moseroth, and pitched in Bene-jaakan.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣí kuro ni Bene-jaakani, nwọn si dó si Hori-haggidgadi.
entries.en: And they removed from Bene-jaakan, and encamped at Hor-hagidgad.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣí kuro ni Hori-haggidgadi, nwọn si dó si Jotbata.
entries.en: And they went from Hor-hagidgad, and pitched in Jotbathah.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣí kuro ni Jotbata, nwọn si dó si Abrona.
entries.en: And they removed from Jotbathah, and encamped at Ebronah.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣí kuro ni Abrona, nwọn si dó si Esion-geberi.
entries.en: And they departed from Ebronah, and encamped at Ezion-gaber.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣí kuro ni Esion-geberi, nwọn si dó si aginjù Sini, (ti ṣe Kadeṣi),
entries.en: And they removed from Ezion-gaber, and pitched in the wilderness of Zin, which is Kadesh.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣí kuro ni Kadeṣi, nwọn si dó si òke Hori, leti ilẹ Edomu.
entries.en: And they removed from Kadesh, and pitched in mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.

entries.yo: Aaroni alufa si gùn òke Hori lọ nipa aṣẹ OLUWA, o si kú nibẹ̀, li ogoji ọdún lẹhin ti awọn ọmọ Israeli ti ilẹ Egipti jade wá, li ọjọ́ kini oṣù karun.
entries.en: And Aaron the priest went up into mount Hor at the commandment of the LORD, and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel were come out of the land of Egypt, in the first day of the fifth month.

entries.yo: Aaroni si jẹ́ ẹni ọgọfa ọdún o le mẹta nigbati o kú li òke Hori.
entries.en: And Aaron was an hundred and twenty and three years old when he died in mount Hor.

entries.yo: Ara Kenaani, ọba Aradi, ti ngbé ìha gusù ni ilẹ Kenaani, o gburó pe awọn ọmọ Israeli mbọ̀.
entries.en: And king Arad the Canaanite, which dwelt in the south in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣí kuro ni òke Hori, nwọn si dó si Salmona.
entries.en: And they departed from mount Hor, and pitched in Zalmonah.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣí ni Salmona, nwọn si dó si Punoni.
entries.en: And they departed from Zalmonah, and pitched in Punon.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣí kuro ni Punoni, nwọn si dó si Obotu.
entries.en: And they departed from Punon, and pitched in Oboth.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣí kuro ni Obotu, nwọn si dó si Iye-abarimu, li àgbegbe Moabu.
entries.en: And they departed from Oboth, and pitched in Ije-abarim, in the border of Moab.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣí kuro ni Iyimu, nwọn si dó si Dibon-gadi.
entries.en: And they departed from Iim, and pitched in Dibon-gad.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣí kuro ni Dibon-gadi, nwọn si dó si Almon-diblataimu.
entries.en: And they removed from Dibon-gad, and encamped in Almon-diblathaim.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣí kuro ni Almon-diblataimu, nwọn si dó si òke Abarimu, niwaju Nebo.
entries.en: And they removed from Almon-diblathaim, and pitched in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣí kuro ni òke Abarimu, nwọn si dó si pẹtẹlẹ̀ Moabu lẹba Jordani leti Jeriko.
entries.en: And they departed from the mountains of Abarim, and pitched in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.

entries.yo: Nwọn si dó si ẹba Jordani, lati Beti-jeṣimotu titi dé Abeli-ṣittimu ni pẹtẹlẹ̀ Moabu.
entries.en: And they pitched by Jordan, from Beth-jesimoth even unto Abel-shittim in the plains of Moab.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose ni pẹtẹlẹ̀ Moabu lẹba Jordani leti Jeriko, wipe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,

entries.yo: Sọ fun awọn ọmọ Israeli, ki o si wi fun wọn pe, Nigbati ẹnyin ba gòke odò Jordani si ilẹ Kenaani:
entries.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye are passed over Jordan into the land of Canaan;

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ki ẹnyin ki o lé gbogbo awọn ara ilẹ na kuro niwaju nyin; ki ẹnyin si run gbogbo aworán wọn, ki ẹnyin si run gbogbo ere didà wọn, ki ẹnyin si wó gbogbo ibi giga wọn palẹ:
entries.en: Then ye shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, and destroy all their pictures, and destroy all their molten images, and quite pluck down all their high places:

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o si gbà ilẹ na, ki ẹnyin ki o si ma gbé inu rẹ̀: nitoripe mo ti fi ilẹ na fun nyin lati ní i.
entries.en: And ye shall dispossess the inhabitants of the land, and dwell therein: for I have given you the land to possess it.

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o si fi keké pín ilẹ na ni iní fun awọn idile nyin; fun ọ̀pọ ni ki ẹnyin ki o fi ilẹ-iní pupọ̀ fun, ati fun diẹ ni ki ẹnyin ki o fi ilẹ-iní diẹ fun: ki ilẹ-iní olukuluku ki o jẹ́ ibiti keké rẹ̀ ba bọ́ si; gẹgẹ bi ẹ̀ya awọn baba nyin ni ki ẹnyin ki o ní i.
entries.en: And ye shall divide the land by lot for an inheritance among your families: and to the more ye shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer ye shall give the less inheritance: every man's inheritance shall be in the place where his lot falleth; according to the tribes of your fathers ye shall inherit.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi ẹnyin kò ba lé awọn ara ilẹ na kuro niwaju nyin; yio si ṣe, awọn ti ẹnyin jẹ ki o kù ninu wọn yio di ẹgún si oju nyin, ati ẹgún si nyin ni ìha, nwọn o si ma yọ nyin lẹnu ni ilẹ na, ninu eyiti ẹnyin ngbé.
entries.en: But if ye will not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you; then it shall come to pass, that those which ye let remain of them shall be pricks in your eyes, and thorns in your sides, and shall vex you in the land wherein ye dwell.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, bi emi ti rò lati ṣe si wọn, bẹ̃ni emi o ṣe si nyin.
entries.en: Moreover it shall come to pass, that I shall do unto you, as I thought to do unto them.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Fi aṣẹ fun awọn ọmọ Israeli, ki o si wi fun wọn pe, Nigbati ẹnyin ba dé ilẹ Kenaani, (eyi ni ilẹ ti yio bọ́ si nyin lọwọ ni iní, ani ilẹ Kenaani gẹgẹ bi àgbegbe rẹ̀,)
entries.en: Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land of Canaan; (this is the land that shall fall unto you for an inheritance, even the land of Canaan with the coasts thereof:)

entries.yo: Njẹ ki ìha gusù nyin ki o jẹ́ ati aginjù Sini lọ titi dé ẹba Edomu, ati opinlẹ gusù nyin ki o jẹ́ lati opin Okun Iyọ̀ si ìha ìla-õrùn:
entries.en: Then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the coast of Edom, and your south border shall be the outmost coast of the salt sea eastward:

entries.yo: Ki opinlẹ nyin ki o si yí lati gusù wá si ìgoke Akrabbimu, ki o si kọja lọ si Sini: ati ijadelọ rẹ̀ ki o jẹ́ ati gusù lọ si Kadeṣi-barnea, ki o si dé Hasari-addari, ki o si kọja si Asmoni:
entries.en: And your border shall turn from the south to the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass on to Zin: and the going forth thereof shall be from the south to Kadesh-barnea, and shall go on to Hazar-addar, and pass on to Azmon:

entries.yo: Ki opinlẹ rẹ̀ ki o si yiká lati Asmoni lọ dé odò Egipti, okun ni yio si jẹ́ opin rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the border shall fetch a compass from Azmon unto the river of Egypt, and the goings out of it shall be at the sea.

entries.yo: Ati opinlẹ ìha ìwọ-õrùn, ani okun nla ni yio jẹ́ opin fun nyin: eyi ni yio jẹ́ opinlẹ ìha ìwọ-õrùn fun nyin.
entries.en: And as for the western border, ye shall even have the great sea for a border: this shall be your west border.

entries.yo: Eyi ni yio si jẹ́ opinlẹ ìha ariwa fun nyin: lati okun nla lọ ki ẹnyin ki o fi ori sọ òke Hori:
entries.en: And this shall be your north border: from the great sea ye shall point out for you mount Hor:

entries.yo: Lati òke Hori lọ ki ẹnyin ki o fi ori sọ ati wọ̀ Hamati; ijadelọ opinlẹ na yio si jẹ́ Sedadi:
entries.en: From mount Hor ye shall point out your border unto the entrance of Hamath; and the goings forth of the border shall be to Zedad:

entries.yo: Opinlẹ rẹ yio si dé Sifroni, ati ijadelọ rẹ̀ yio dé Hasari-enani: eyi ni yio jẹ́ opinlẹ ìha ariwa nyin.
entries.en: And the border shall go on to Ziphron, and the goings out of it shall be at Hazar-enan: this shall be your north border.

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o si sàmi si opinlẹ nyin ni ìha ìla-õrùn lati Hasari-enani lọ dé Ṣefamu:
entries.en: And ye shall point out your east border from Hazar-enan to Shepham:

entries.yo: Ki opinlẹ na ki o si ti Ṣefamu sọkalẹ lọ si Ribla, ni ìha ìla-õrùn Aini; ki opinlẹ na ki o si sọkalẹ lọ, ki o si dé ìha okun Kinnereti ni ìha ìla-õrùn.
entries.en: And the coast shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain; and the border shall descend, and shall reach unto the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward:

entries.yo: Ki opinlẹ na ki o si sọkalẹ lọ si Jordani, ijadelọ rẹ̀ yio jẹ Okun Iyọ̀: eyi ni yio jẹ́ ilẹ nyin gẹgẹ bi àgbegbe rẹ̀ yiká kiri.
entries.en: And the border shall go down to Jordan, and the goings out of it shall be at the salt sea: this shall be your land with the coasts thereof round about.

entries.yo: Mose si paṣẹ fun awọn ọmọ Israeli, wipe, Eyi ni ilẹ na ti ẹnyin o fi keké gbà ni iní, ti OLUWA paṣẹ lati fi fun ẹ̀ya mẹsan, ati àbọ ẹ̀ya nì:
entries.en: And Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, This is the land which ye shall inherit by lot, which the LORD commanded to give unto the nine tribes, and to the half tribe:

entries.yo: Fun ẹ̀ya awọn ọmọ Reubeni gẹgẹ bi ile baba wọn, ati ẹ̀ya awọn ọmọ Gadi gẹgẹ bi ile baba wọn ti gbà; àbọ ẹ̀ya Manasse si ti gbà, ipín wọn:
entries.en: For the tribe of the children of Reuben according to the house of their fathers, and the tribe of the children of Gad according to the house of their fathers, have received their inheritance; and half the tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance:

entries.yo: Ẹ̀ya mejẽji ati àbọ ẹ̀ya nì ti gbà ipín wọn ni ìha ihin Jordani leti Jeriko, ni ìha gabasi, ni ìha ìla-õrùn.
entries.en: The two tribes and the half tribe have received their inheritance on this side Jordan near Jericho eastward, toward the sunrising.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Wọnyi li orukọ awọn ọkunrin ti yio pín ilẹ na fun nyin: Eleasari alufa, ati Joṣua ọmọ Nuni.
entries.en: These are the names of the men which shall divide the land unto you: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o si mú olori kan ninu ẹ̀ya kọkan, lati pín ilẹ na ni iní.
entries.en: And ye shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land by inheritance.

entries.yo: Orukọ awọn ọkunrin na si ni wọnyi: ni ẹ̀ya Juda, Kalebu ọmọ Jefunne.
entries.en: And the names of the men are these: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

entries.yo: Ati ni ẹ̀ya awọn ọmọ Simeoni, Ṣemueli ọmọ Ammihudu.
entries.en: And of the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.

entries.yo: Ni ẹ̀ya Benjamini, Elidadi ọmọ Kisloni.
entries.en: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.

entries.yo: Ati olori ẹ̀ya awọn ọmọ Dani, Bukki ọmọ Jogli.
entries.en: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Dan, Bukki the son of Jogli.

entries.yo: Olori awọn ọmọ Josefu: ni ẹ̀ya awọn ọmọ Manasse, Hannieli ọmọ Efodu:
entries.en: The prince of the children of Joseph, for the tribe of the children of Manasseh, Hanniel the son of Ephod.

entries.yo: Ati olori ẹ̀ya awọn ọmọ Efraimu, Kemueli ọmọ Ṣiftani.
entries.en: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Ephraim, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.

entries.yo: Ati olori ẹ̀ya awọn ọmọ Sebuluni, Elisafani ọmọ Parnaki.
entries.en: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Zebulun, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.

entries.yo: Ati olori ẹ̀ya awọn ọmọ Issakari, Paltieli ọmọ Assani.
entries.en: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Issachar, Paltiel the son of Azzan.

entries.yo: Ati olori ẹ̀ya awọn ọmọ Aṣeri, Ahihudu ọmọ Ṣelomi.
entries.en: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Asher, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.

entries.yo: Ati olori ẹ̀ya awọn ọmọ Naftali, Pedaheli ọmọ Ammihudu.
entries.en: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Naphtali, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.

entries.yo: Awọn wọnyi li ẹniti OLUWA paṣẹ fun lati pín iní na fun awọn ọmọ Israeli ni ilẹ Kenaani.
entries.en: These are they whom the LORD commanded to divide the inheritance unto the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose ni pẹtẹlẹ̀ Moabu lẹba Jordani leti Jeriko, wipe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,

entries.yo: Paṣẹ fun awọn ọmọ Israeli, ki nwọn ki o fi ilu fun awọn ọmọ Lefi ninu ipín ilẹ-iní wọn, lati ma gbé; ki ẹnyin ki o si fi ẹbẹba-ilu fun awọn ọmọ Lefi ni ilu wọnni yi wọn ká.
entries.en: Command the children of Israel, that they give unto the Levites of the inheritance of their possession cities to dwell in; and ye shall give also unto the Levites suburbs for the cities round about them.

entries.yo: Ki nwọn ki o ní ilu lati ma gbé; ati ẹbẹba-ilu wọn fun ohunọ̀sin wọn, ati fun ohun-iní wọn, ati fun gbogbo ẹran wọn.
entries.en: And the cities shall they have to dwell in; and the suburbs of them shall be for their cattle, and for their goods, and for all their beasts.

entries.yo: Ati ẹbẹba-ilu, ti ẹnyin o fi fun awọn ọmọ Lefi, lati odi ilu lọ sẹhin rẹ̀ ki o jẹ́ ẹgbẹrun igbọnwọ yiká.
entries.en: And the suburbs of the cities, which ye shall give unto the Levites, shall reach from the wall of the city and outward a thousand cubits round about.

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o si wọ̀n lati ẹhin ode ilu na lọ ni ìha ìla-õrùn ẹgba igbọnwọ, ati ni ìha gusù ẹgba igbọnwọ, ati ni ìha ìwọ-õrùn ẹgba igbọnwọ, ati ni ìha ariwa ẹgba igbọnwọ; ki ilu na ki o si wà lãrin. Eyi ni yio si ma ṣe ẹbẹba-ilu fun wọn.
entries.en: And ye shall measure from without the city on the east side two thousand cubits, and on the south side two thousand cubits, and on the west side two thousand cubits, and on the north side two thousand cubits and the city shall be in the midst: this shall be to them the suburbs of the cities.

entries.yo: Ati ninu ilu ti ẹnyin o fi fun awọn ọmọ Lefi, mẹfa o jẹ́ ilu àbo, ti ẹnyin o yàn fun aṣi-enia-pa, ki o le ma salọ sibẹ̀: ki ẹnyin ki o si fi ilu mejilelogoji kún wọn.
entries.en: And among the cities which ye shall give unto the Levites there shall be six cities for refuge, which ye shall appoint for the manslayer, that he may flee thither: and to them ye shall add forty and two cities.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ilu ti ẹnyin o fi fun awọn ọmọ Lefi ki o jẹ́ mejidilãdọta: wọnyi ni ki ẹnyin fi fun wọn pẹlu ẹbẹba wọn.
entries.en: So all the cities which ye shall give to the Levites shall be forty and eight cities: them shall ye give with their suburbs.

entries.yo: Ati ilu ti ẹnyin o fi fun wọn, ki o jẹ́ ninu ilẹ-iní awọn ọmọ Israeli, lọwọ ẹniti o ní pupọ̀ lí ẹnyin o gbà pupọ̀; ṣugbọn lọwọ ẹniti o ní diẹ li ẹnyin o gbà diẹ: ki olukuluku ki o fi ninu ilu rẹ̀ fun awọn ọmọ Lefi gẹgẹ bi ilẹ-iní rẹ̀ ti o ní.
entries.en: And the cities which ye shall give shall be of the possession of the children of Israel: from them that have many ye shall give many; but from them that have few ye shall give few: every one shall give of his cities unto the Levites according to his inheritance which he inheriteth.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.yo: Sọ fun awọn ọmọ Israeli, ki o si wi fun wọn pe, Nigbati ẹnyin ba gòke Jordani lọ si ilẹ Kenaani;
entries.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come over Jordan into the land of Canaan;

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ki ẹnyin ki o yàn ilu fun ara nyin ti yio jẹ́ ilu àbo fun nyin; ki apania ti o pa enia li aimọ̀ ki o le ma sa lọ sibẹ̀.
entries.en: Then ye shall appoint you cities to be cities of refuge for you; that the slayer may flee thither, which killeth any person at unawares.

entries.yo: Nwọn o si jasi ilu àbo kuro lọwọ agbẹsan; ki ẹniti o pa enia ki o má ba kú titi yio fi duro niwaju ijọ awọn enia ni idajọ.
entries.en: And they shall be unto you cities for refuge from the avenger; that the manslayer die not, until he stand before the congregation in judgment.

entries.yo: Ati ninu ilu wọnyi ti ẹnyin o fi fun wọn, mẹfa yio jẹ́ ilu àbo fun nyin.
entries.en: And of these cities which ye shall give six cities shall ye have for refuge.

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o yàn ilu mẹta ni ìha ihin Jordani, ki ẹnyin ki o si yàn ilu mẹta ni ilẹ Kenaani, ti yio ma jẹ́ ilu àbo.
entries.en: Ye shall give three cities on this side Jordan, and three cities shall ye give in the land of Canaan, which shall be cities of refuge.

entries.yo: Ilu mẹfa wọnyi ni yio ma jẹ́ àbo fun awọn ọmọ Israeli, ati fun alejò ati fun atipo lãrin wọn: ki olukuluku ẹniti o ba pa enia li aimọ̀ ki o le ma salọ sibẹ̀.
entries.en: These six cities shall be a refuge, both for the children of Israel, and for the stranger, and for the sojourner among them: that every one that killeth any person unawares may flee thither.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi o ba fi ohunèlo irin lù u, ti o si kú, apania li on: pipa li a o pa apania na.
entries.en: And if he smite him with an instrument of iron, so that he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.

entries.yo: Ati bi o ba sọ okuta lù u, ti o le ti ipa rẹ̀ kú, ti o si kú, apania li on: a o pa apania na.
entries.en: And if he smite him with throwing a stone, wherewith he may die, and he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.

entries.yo: Tabi bi o ba fi ohun-èlo igi lù u, ti o le ti ipa rẹ̀ kú, ti o si kú, apania li on: pipa li a o pa apania na.
entries.en: Or if he smite him with an hand weapon of wood, wherewith he may die, and he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.

entries.yo: Agbẹsan ẹ̀jẹ tikalarẹ̀ ni ki o pa apania na: nigbati o ba bá a, ki o pa a.
entries.en: The revenger of blood himself shall slay the murderer: when he meeteth him, he shall slay him.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi o ba ṣepe o fi irira gún u, tabi ti o ba sọ nkan lù u, lati ibuba wá, ti on si kú;
entries.en: But if he thrust him of hatred, or hurl at him by laying of wait, that he die;

entries.yo: Tabi bi o nṣe ọtá, ti o fi ọwọ́ rẹ̀ lù u, ti on si kú: ẹniti o lù u nì pipa li a o pa a; nitoripe apania li on: agbẹsan ẹ̀jẹ ni ki o pa apania na, nigbati o ba bá a.
entries.en: Or in enmity smite him with his hand, that he die: he that smote him shall surely be put to death; for he is a murderer: the revenger of blood shall slay the murderer, when he meeteth him.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi o ba fi nkan gún u lojiji laiṣe ọtá, tabi ti o sọ ohunkohun lù u laiba dè e,
entries.en: But if he thrust him suddenly without enmity, or have cast upon him any thing without laying of wait,

entries.yo: Tabi okuta kan li o sọ, nipa eyiti enia le fi kú, ti kò ri i, ti o si sọ ọ lù u, ti on si kú, ti ki ṣe ọtá rẹ̀, ti kò si wá ibi rẹ̀:
entries.en: Or with any stone, wherewith a man may die, seeing him not, and cast it upon him, that he die, and was not his enemy, neither sought his harm:

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ki ijọ ki o ṣe idajọ lãrin ẹniti o pa enia ati agbẹsan ẹ̀jẹ na, gẹgẹ bi idajọ wọnyi:
entries.en: Then the congregation shall judge between the slayer and the revenger of blood according to these judgments:

entries.yo: Ki ijọ ki o si gbà ẹniti o pani li ọwọ́ agbẹsan ẹ̀jẹ, ki ijọ ki o si mú u pada lọ si ilu àbo rẹ̀, nibiti o ti sá si: ki o si ma gbé ibẹ̀ titi di ìgba ikú olori alufa, ti a fi oróro mimọ́ yàn.
entries.en: And the congregation shall deliver the slayer out of the hand of the revenger of blood, and the congregation shall restore him to the city of his refuge, whither he was fled: and he shall abide in it unto the death of the high priest, which was anointed with the holy oil.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi apania na ba ṣèṣi jade lọ si opinlẹ ilu àbo rẹ̀, nibiti o ti sá si;
entries.en: But if the slayer shall at any time come without the border of the city of his refuge, whither he was fled;

entries.yo: Ti agbẹsan ẹ̀jẹ na si ri i lẹhin opinlẹ ilu àbo rẹ̀, ti agbẹsan ẹ̀jẹ si pa apania na; on ki yio jẹbi ẹ̀jẹ:
entries.en: And the revenger of blood find him without the borders of the city of his refuge, and the revenger of blood kill the slayer; he shall not be guilty of blood:

entries.yo: Nitoripe on iba joko ninu ilu àbo rẹ̀ titi di ìgba ikú olori alufa: ati lẹhin ikú olori alufa ki apania na ki o pada lọ si ilẹ iní rẹ̀.
entries.en: Because he should have remained in the city of his refuge until the death of the high priest: but after the death of the high priest the slayer shall return into the land of his possession.

entries.yo: Ohun wọnyi ni o si jẹ́ ìlana idajọ fun nyin ni iraniran nyin ni ibujoko nyin gbogbo.
entries.en: So these things shall be for a statute of judgment unto you throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni ti o ba pa enia, lati ẹnu awọn ẹlẹri wá li a o pa apania na: ṣugbọn ẹlẹri kanṣoṣo ki yio jẹri si ẹnikan lati pa a.
entries.en: Whoso killeth any person, the murderer shall be put to death by the mouth of witnesses: but one witness shall not testify against any person to cause him to die.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu ki ẹnyin ki o máṣe gbà ohun-irasilẹ fun ẹmi apania, ti o jẹbi ikú: ṣugbọn pipa ni ki a pa a.
entries.en: Moreover ye shall take no satisfaction for the life of a murderer, which is guilty of death: but he shall be surely put to death.

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o má si ṣe gbà ohun-irasilẹ fun ẹniti o salọ si ilu àbo rẹ̀, pe ki on ki o tun pada lọ ijoko ni ilẹ na, titi di ìgba ikú alufa.
entries.en: And ye shall take no satisfaction for him that is fled to the city of his refuge, that he should come again to dwell in the land, until the death of the priest.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin kò si gbọdọ bà ilẹ na jẹ́ ninu eyiti ẹnyin ngbé: nitoripe ẹ̀jẹ ama bà ilẹ jẹ́: a kò si le ṣètutu fun ilẹ nitori ẹ̀je ti a ta sinu rẹ̀, bikoṣe nipa ẹ̀jẹ ẹniti o ta a.
entries.en: So ye shall not pollute the land wherein ye are: for blood it defileth the land: and the land cannot be cleansed of the blood that is shed therein, but by the blood of him that shed it.

entries.yo: Iwọ kò si gbọdọ sọ ilẹ na di alaimọ́, ninu eyiti ẹnyin o joko, ninu eyiti emi ngbé: nitori Emi JEHOFA ni ngbé inu awọn ọmọ Israeli.
entries.en: Defile not therefore the land which ye shall inhabit, wherein I dwell: for I the LORD dwell among the children of Israel.

entries.yo: AWỌN baba àgba ti idile awọn ọmọ Gileadi ọmọ Makiri, ọmọ Manasse, ti idile awọn ọmọ Josefu, sunmọtosi, nwọn si sọ niwaju Mose, ati niwaju awọn olori, awọn baba àgba awọn ọmọ Israeli:
entries.en: And the chief fathers of the families of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near, and spake before Moses, and before the princes, the chief fathers of the children of Israel:

entries.yo: Nwọn si wipe, OLUWA ti paṣẹ fun oluwa mi lati fi keké pín ilẹ na fun awọn ọmọ Israeli ni iní: a si fi aṣẹ fun oluwa mi lati ọdọ OLUWA wá lati fi ilẹiní Selofehadi arakunrin wa fun awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ obinrin.
entries.en: And they said, The LORD commanded my lord to give the land for an inheritance by lot to the children of Israel: and my lord was commanded by the LORD to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother unto his daughters.

entries.yo: Bi a ba si gbé wọn niyawo fun ẹnikan ninu awọn ọmọkunrin ẹ̀ya awọn ọmọ Israeli miran, nigbana ni a o gbà ilẹ-iní wọn kuro ninu ilẹ-iní awọn baba wa, a o si fi kún ilẹ-iní ẹ̀ya ti a gbé wọn si: bẹ̃li a o si gbà a kuro ninu ipín ilẹ-iní ti wa.
entries.en: And if they be married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Israel, then shall their inheritance be taken from the inheritance of our fathers, and shall be put to the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received: so shall it be taken from the lot of our inheritance.

entries.yo: Ati nigbati ọdún jubeli awọn ọmọ Israeli ba dé, nigbana li a o fi ilẹ-iní wọn kún ilẹ-iní ẹ̀ya ti a gbé wọn si: bẹ̃li a o si gbà ilẹ-iní wọn kuro ninu ilẹ-iní ẹ̀ya awọn baba wa.
entries.en: And when the jubile of the children of Israel shall be, then shall their inheritance be put unto the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received: so shall their inheritance be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.

entries.yo: Mose si paṣẹ fun awọn ọmọ Israeli gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ OLUWA, pe, Ẹ̀ya awọn ọmọ Josefu fọ̀ rere.
entries.en: And Moses commanded the children of Israel according to the word of the LORD, saying, The tribe of the sons of Joseph hath said well.

entries.yo: Eyi li ohun ti OLUWA palaṣẹ nipa ti awọn ọmọbinrin Selofehadi, wipe, Ki nwọn ki o ṣe aya ẹniti o wù wọn; kiki pe, ninu idile ẹ̀ya baba wọn ni ki nwọn ki o gbeyawo si.
entries.en: This is the thing which the LORD doth command concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, Let them marry to whom they think best; only to the family of the tribe of their father shall they marry.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni ilẹ-iní awọn ọmọ Israeli ki yio yi lati ẹ̀ya de ẹ̀ya: nitori ki olukuluku awọn ọmọ Israeli ki o le faramọ́ ilẹ-iní ẹ̀ya awọn baba rẹ̀:
entries.en: So shall not the inheritance of the children of Israel remove from tribe to tribe: for every one of the children of Israel shall keep himself to the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.

entries.yo: Ati gbogbo awọn ọmọbinrin, ti o ní ilẹ-iní ninu ẹ̀ya awọn ọmọ Israeli, ki o ṣe aya fun ọkan ninu idile ẹ̀ya baba rẹ̀, ki olukuluku awọn ọmọ Israeli ki o le ma jogún ilẹ-iní awọn baba rẹ̀.
entries.en: And every daughter, that possesseth an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel, shall be wife unto one of the family of the tribe of her father, that the children of Israel may enjoy every man the inheritance of his fathers.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni ki ilẹ-iní ki o máṣe yi lati ẹ̀ya kan lọ si ẹ̀ya keji; ṣugbọn ki olukuluku ẹ̀ya awọn ọmọ Israeli ki o faramọ́ ilẹ-iní tirẹ̀.
entries.en: Neither shall the inheritance remove from one tribe to another tribe; but every one of the tribes of the children of Israel shall keep himself to his own inheritance.

entries.yo: Bi OLUWA ti paṣẹ fun Mose, bẹ̃li awọn ọmọbinrin Selofehadi ṣe:
entries.en: Even as the LORD commanded Moses, so did the daughters of Zelophehad:

entries.yo: Nitoripe a gbé Mala, Tirsa, ati Hogla, ati Milka, ati Noa, awọn ọmọbinrin Selofehadi niyawo fun awọn ọmọ arakunrin baba wọn.
entries.en: For Mahlal, Tirzah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married unto their father's brothers' sons:

entries.yo: A si gbé wọn niyawo sinu idile awọn ọmọ Manasse ọmọ Josefu, ilẹ-ini wọn si duro ninu ẹ̀ya idile baba wọn.
entries.en: And they were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph, and their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.

entries.yo: Wọnyi ni aṣẹ ati idajọ ti OLUWA palaṣẹ fun awọn ọmọ Israeli lati ọwọ́ Mose, ni pẹtẹlẹ̀ Moabu lẹba Jordani leti Jeriko.
entries.en: These are the commandments and the judgments, which the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses unto the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.

entries.yo: WỌNYI li ọ̀rọ ti Mose sọ fun gbogbo Israeli ni ìha ihin Jordani li aginjù, ni pẹtẹlẹ̀ ti o kọjusi Okun Pupa, li agbedemeji Parani, ati Tofeli, ati Labani, ati Haserotu, ati Disahabu.
entries.en: These be the words which Moses spake unto all Israel on this side Jordan in the wilderness, in the plain over against the Red sea, between Paran, and Tophel, and Laban, and Hazeroth, and Dizahab.

entries.yo: Ijọ́ mọkanla ni lati Horebu wá li ọ̀na òke Seiri dé Kadeṣi-barnea.
entries.en: (There are eleven days' journey from Horeb by the way of mount Seir unto Kadesh-barnea.)

entries.yo: O si ṣe nigbati o di ogoji ọdún, li oṣù kọkanla, li ọjọ́ kini oṣù na, ni Mose sọ fun awọn ọmọ Israeli, gẹgẹ bi gbogbo eyiti OLUWA ti fun u li aṣẹ fun wọn;
entries.en: And it came to pass in the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first day of the month, that Moses spake unto the children of Israel, according unto all that the LORD had given him in commandment unto them;

entries.yo: Lẹhin igbati o pa Sihoni tán ọba awọn ọmọ Amori, ti o ngbé Heṣboni, ati Ogu ọba Baṣani, ti o ngbé Aṣtarotu, ni Edrei:
entries.en: After he had slain Sihon the king of the Amorites, which dwelt in Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, which dwelt at Astaroth in Edrei:

entries.yo: Ni ìha ihin Jordani, ni ilẹ Moabu, on ni Mose bẹ̀rẹsi isọ asọye ofin yi, wipe,
entries.en: On this side Jordan, in the land of Moab, began Moses to declare this law, saying,

entries.yo: OLUWA Ọlọrun wa sọ fun wa ni Horebu, wipe, Ẹ gbé ori òke yi pẹ to:
entries.en: The LORD our God spake unto us in Horeb, saying, Ye have dwelt long enough in this mount:

entries.yo: Ẹ yipada, ki ẹnyin si mú ọ̀na nyin pọ̀n, ki ẹ si lọ si òke awọn ọmọ Amori, ati si gbogbo àgbegbe rẹ̀, ni pẹtẹlẹ̀, li ori òke, ati li afonifoji, ati ni ìha gusù, ati leti okun, si ilẹ awọn ara Kenaani, ati si Lebanoni, dé odò nla nì, odò Euferate.
entries.en: Turn you, and take your journey, and go to the mount of the Amorites, and unto all the places nigh thereunto, in the plain, in the hills, and in the vale, and in the south, and by the sea side, to the land of the Canaanites, and unto Lebanon, unto the great river, the river Euphrates.

entries.yo: Wò o, mo ti fi ilẹ na siwaju nyin: ẹ wọ̀ ọ lọ ki ẹ si gbà ilẹ na ti OLUWA bura fun awọn baba nyin, fun Abrahamu, fun Isaaki, ati fun Jakobu, lati fi fun wọn ati fun irú-ọmọ wọn lẹhin wọn.
entries.en: Behold, I have set the land before you: go in and possess the land which the LORD sware unto your fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, to give unto them and to their seed after them.

entries.yo: Mo si sọ fun nyin ni ìgba na pe, Emi nikan kò le rù ẹrù nyin:
entries.en: And I spake unto you at that time, saying, I am not able to bear you myself alone:

entries.yo: OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin ti mu nyin bisi i, si kiyesi i, li oni ẹnyin dabi irawọ oju-ọrun fun ọ̀pọ.
entries.en: The LORD your God hath multiplied you, and, behold, ye are this day as the stars of heaven for multitude.

entries.yo: Ki OLUWA, Ọlọrun awọn baba nyin ki o fi kún iye nyin ni ìgba ẹgbẹrun, ki o si busi i fun nyin, bi o ti ṣe ileri fun nyin!
entries.en: (The LORD God of your fathers make you a thousand times so many more as ye are, and bless you, as he hath promised you!)

entries.yo: Emi o ti ṣe le nikan rù inira nyin, ati ẹrù nyin, ati ìja nyin?
entries.en: How can I myself alone bear your cumbrance, and your burden, and your strife?

entries.yo: Ẹ mú awọn ọkunrin ọlọgbọ́n wá, ati amoye, ati ẹniti a mọ̀ ninu awọn ẹ̀ya nyin, emi o si fi wọn jẹ olori nyin.
entries.en: Take you wise men, and understanding, and known among your tribes, and I will make them rulers over you.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin si da mi li ohùn, ẹ si wipe, Ohun ti iwọ sọ nì, o dara lati ṣe.
entries.en: And ye answered me, and said, The thing which thou hast spoken is good for us to do.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni mo mú olori awọn ẹ̀ya nyin, awọn ọlọgbọ́n ọkunrin, ẹniti a mọ̀, mo si fi wọn jẹ olori nyin, olori ẹgbẹgbẹrun, ati olori ọrọrún, ati olori arãdọta, ati olori mẹwa-mẹwa, ati awọn olori gẹgẹ bi awọn ẹ̀ya nyin.
entries.en: So I took the chief of your tribes, wise men, and known, and made them heads over you, captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, and captains over fifties, and captains over tens, and officers among your tribes.

entries.yo: Mo si fi aṣẹ lelẹ fun awọn onidajọ nyin nigbana pe, Ẹ ma gbọ́ ẹjọ́ lãrin awọn arakunrin nyin, ki ẹ si ma ṣe idajọ ododo lãrin olukuluku ati arakunrin rẹ̀, ati alejò ti mbẹ lọdọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And I charged your judges at that time, saying, Hear the causes between your brethren, and judge righteously between every man and his brother, and the stranger that is with him.

entries.yo: Ẹ kò gbọdọ ṣe ojuṣaju ni idajọ; ẹ gbọ́ ti ewe gẹgẹ bi ti àgba; ẹ kò gbọdọ bẹ̀ru oju enia; nitoripe ti Ọlọrun ni idajọ: ọ̀ran ti o ba si ṣoro fun nyin, ẹ mú u tọ̀ mi wá, emi o si gbọ́ ọ.
entries.en: Ye shall not respect persons in judgment; but ye shall hear the small as well as the great; ye shall not be afraid of the face of man; for the judgment is God's: and the cause that is too hard for you, bring it unto me, and I will hear it.

entries.yo: Emi si fi aṣẹ ohun gbogbo ti ẹnyin o ma ṣe lelẹ fun nyin ni ìgba na.
entries.en: And I commanded you at that time all the things which ye should do.

entries.yo: Nigbati awa si kuro ni Horebu, awa rìn gbogbo aginjù nla nì ti o ni ẹ̀ru já, ti ẹnyin ri li ọ̀na òke awọn ọmọ Amori, bi OLUWA Ọlọrun wa ti fun wa li aṣẹ; awa si wá si Kadeṣi-barnea.
entries.en: And when we departed from Horeb, we went through all that great and terrible wilderness, which ye saw by the way of the mountain of the Amorites, as the LORD our God commanded us; and we came to Kadesh-barnea.

entries.yo: Emi si wi fun nyin pe, Ẹnyin dé òke awọn ọmọ Amori na, ti OLUWA Ọlọrun wa fi fun wa.
