entries.en: And I said unto you, Ye are come unto the mountain of the Amorites, which the LORD our God doth give unto us.

entries.yo: Wò o, OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ ti fi ilẹ na siwaju rẹ: gòke lọ, ki o si gbà a, bi OLUWA, Ọlọrun awọn baba rẹ ti wi fun ọ; máṣe bẹ̀ru, bẹ̃ni ki àiya máṣe fò ọ.
entries.en: Behold, the LORD thy God hath set the land before thee: go up and possess it, as the LORD God of thy fathers hath said unto thee; fear not, neither be discouraged.

entries.yo: Gbogbo nyin si tọ̀ mi wá, ẹ si wipe, Jẹ ki awa ki o rán enia lọ siwaju wa, ki nwọn ki o si rìn ilẹ na wò fun wa, ki nwọn ki o si mú ìhin pada tọ̀ wa wá, niti ọ̀na ti a o ba gòke lọ, ati ti ilu ti a o yọ si.
entries.en: And ye came near unto me every one of you, and said, We will send men before us, and they shall search us out the land, and bring us word again by what way we must go up, and into what cities we shall come.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ na si dara loju mi: mo si yàn ọkunrin mejila ninu nyin, ẹnikan ninu ẹ̀ya kan:
entries.en: And the saying pleased me well: and I took twelve men of you, one of a tribe:

entries.yo: Nwọn si yipada nwọn si lọ sori òke, nwọn si wá si afonifoji Eṣkolù, nwọn si rìn ilẹ na wò.
entries.en: And they turned and went up into the mountain, and came unto the valley of Eshcol, and searched it out.

entries.yo: Nwọn si mú ninu eso ilẹ na li ọwọ́ wọn, nwọn si mú u sọkalẹ wá fun wa, nwọn si mú ìhin pada wá fun wa, nwọn si wipe, Ilẹ ti OLUWA wa fi fun wa, ilẹ rere ni.
entries.en: And they took of the fruit of the land in their hands, and brought it down unto us, and brought us word again, and said, It is a good land which the LORD our God doth give us.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹnyin kò fẹ́ gòke lọ, ẹnyin si ṣọ̀tẹ si aṣẹ OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin:
entries.en: Notwithstanding ye would not go up, but rebelled against the commandment of the LORD your God:

entries.yo: Ẹnyin si kùn ninu agọ́ nyin, wipe, Nitoriti OLUWA korira wa, li o ṣe mú wa lati Egipti jade wá, lati fi wa lé ọwọ́ awọn ọmọ Amori, lati run wa.
entries.en: And ye murmured in your tents, and said, Because the LORD hated us, he hath brought us forth out of the land of Egypt, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us.

entries.yo: Nibo li awa o gbé gòke lọ? awọn arakunrin wa ti daiyajá wa, wipe, Awọn enia na sigbọnlẹ jù wa lọ; ilu wọn tobi a si mọdi wọn kan ọrun; pẹlupẹlu awa ri awọn ọmọ Anaki nibẹ̀.
entries.en: Whither shall we go up? our brethren have discouraged our heart, saying, The people is greater and taller than we; the cities are great and walled up to heaven; and moreover we have seen the sons of the Anakims there.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni mo wi fun nyin pe, Ẹ máṣe fòya, bẹ̃ni ki ẹ máṣe bẹ̀ru wọn.
entries.en: Then I said unto you, Dread not, neither be afraid of them.

entries.yo: OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin ti nṣaju nyin, on ni yio jà fun nyin, gẹgẹ bi gbogbo eyiti o ṣe fun nyin ni Egipti li oju nyin;
entries.en: The LORD your God which goeth before you, he shall fight for you, according to all that he did for you in Egypt before your eyes;

entries.yo: Ati li aginjù, nibiti iwọ ri bi OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ ti gbé ọ, bi ọkunrin ti igbé ọmọ rẹ̀, li ọ̀na nyin gbogbo ti ẹnyin rìn, titi ẹnyin fi dé ihinyi.
entries.en: And in the wilderness, where thou hast seen how that the LORD thy God bare thee, as a man doth bear his son, in all the way that ye went, until ye came into this place.

entries.yo: Sibẹ̀ ninu nkan yi ẹnyin kò gbà OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin gbọ́.
entries.en: Yet in this thing ye did not believe the LORD your God,

entries.yo: Ti nlọ li ọ̀na ṣaju nyin, lati wá ibi fun nyin, ti ẹnyin o pagọ́ nyin si, ninu iná li oru, lati fi ọ̀na ti ẹnyin o gbà hàn nyin, ati ninu awọsanma li ọsán.
entries.en: Who went in the way before you, to search you out a place to pitch your tents in, in fire by night, to shew you by what way ye should go, and in a cloud by day.

entries.yo: OLUWA si gbọ́ ohùn ọ̀rọ nyin, o si binu, o si bura, wipe,
entries.en: And the LORD heard the voice of your words, and was wroth, and sware, saying,

entries.yo: Nitõtọ ọkan ninu awọn ọkunrin wọnyi ti iran buburu yi, ki yio ri ilẹ rere na, ti mo ti bura lati fi fun awọn baba nyin,
entries.en: Surely there shall not one of these men of this evil generation see that good land, which I sware to give unto your fathers,

entries.yo: Bikoṣe Kalebu ọmọ Jefunne, on ni yio ri i; on li emi o fi ilẹ na ti o tẹ̀mọlẹ fun, ati fun awọn ọmọ rẹ̀: nitoriti o tẹle OLUWA lẹhin patapata.
entries.en: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh; he shall see it, and to him will I give the land that he hath trodden upon, and to his children, because he hath wholly followed the LORD.

entries.yo: OLUWA si binu si mi pẹlu nitori nyin, wipe, Iwọ pẹlu ki yio dé ibẹ̀:
entries.en: Also the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, saying, Thou also shalt not go in thither.

entries.yo: Joṣua ọmọ Nuni, ti ima duro niwaju rẹ, on ni yio dé ibẹ̀: gbà a ni iyanju; nitoripe on ni yio mu Israeli ní i.
entries.en: But Joshua the son of Nun, which standeth before thee, he shall go in thither: encourage him: for he shall cause Israel to inherit it.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ wẹ́wẹ nyin, ti ẹnyin wipe nwọn o di ijẹ, ati awọn ọmọ nyin, ti nwọn kò mọ̀ rere tabi buburu loni yi, awọn ni o dé ibẹ̀, awọn li emi o si fi i fun, awọn ni yio si ní i.
entries.en: Moreover your little ones, which ye said should be a prey, and your children, which in that day had no knowledge between good and evil, they shall go in thither, and unto them will I give it, and they shall possess it.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi o ṣe ti nyin ni, ẹ pada, ẹ mú ọ̀na nyin pọ̀n lọ si aginjù li ọ̀na Okun Pupa.
entries.en: But as for you, turn you, and take your journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea.

entries.yo: Nigbana li ẹ dahùn, ẹ si wi fun mi pe, Awa ti ṣẹ̀ si OLUWA, awa o gòke lọ, a o si jà, gẹgẹ bi gbogbo eyiti OLUWA Ọlọrun wa palaṣẹ fun wa. Ati olukuluku nyin dì ihamọra ogun rẹ̀, ẹnyin mura lati gùn ori òke na.
entries.en: Then ye answered and said unto me, We have sinned against the LORD, we will go up and fight, according to all that the LORD our God commanded us. And when ye had girded on every man his weapons of war, ye were ready to go up into the hill.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun mi pe, Wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ máṣe gòke lọ, bẹ̃ni ki ẹ màṣe jà; nitoriti emi kò sí lãrin nyin; ki a má ba lé nyin niwaju awọn ọtá nyin.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto me, Say unto them, Go not up, neither fight; for I am not among you; lest ye be smitten before your enemies.

entries.yo: Mo sọ fun nyin, ẹnyin kò si gbọ́; ẹnyin ṣọ̀tẹ si aṣẹ OLUWA, ẹnyin sì kùgbu lọ si ori òke na.
entries.en: So I spake unto you; and ye would not hear, but rebelled against the commandment of the LORD, and went presumptuously up into the hill.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Amori, ti ngbé ori òke na, si jade tọ̀ nyin wá, nwọn si lepa nyin, bi oyin ti iṣe, nwọn si run nyin ni Seiri, titi dé Horma.
entries.en: And the Amorites, which dwelt in that mountain, came out against you, and chased you, as bees do, and destroyed you in Seir, even unto Hormah.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin si pada ẹ sì sọkun niwaju OLUWA; ṣugbọn OLUWA kò gbọ́ ohùn nyin, bẹ̃ni kò fetisi nyin.
entries.en: And ye returned and wept before the LORD; but the LORD would not hearken to your voice, nor give ear unto you.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin si joko ni Kadeṣi li ọjọ́ pupọ̀, gẹgẹ bi ọjọ́ ti ẹnyin joko nibẹ̀.
entries.en: So ye abode in Kadesh many days, according unto the days that ye abode there.

entries.yo: NIGBANA li awa pada, awa si mú ọ̀na wa pọ̀n lọ si aginjù li ọ̀na Okun Pupa, bi OLUWA ti sọ fun mi: awa si yi òke Seiri ká li ọjọ́ pupọ̀.
entries.en: Then we turned, and took our journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea, as the LORD spake unto me: and we compassed mount Seir many days.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun mi pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto me, saying,

entries.yo: Ẹnyin ti yi òke yi ká pẹ to: ẹ pada si ìha ariwa.
entries.en: Ye have compassed this mountain long enough: turn you northward.

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o si fi aṣẹ fun awọn enia, pe, Ẹnyin o là ẹkùn awọn arakunrin nyin kọja, awọn ọmọ Esau ti ngbé Seiri; ẹ̀ru nyin yio bà wọn: nitorina ẹ ṣọra nyin gidigidi:
entries.en: And command thou the people, saying, Ye are to pass through the coast of your brethren the children of Esau, which dwell in Seir; and they shall be afraid of you: take ye good heed unto yourselves therefore:

entries.yo: Ẹ máṣe bá wọn jà; nitoripe emi ki yio fun nyin ninu ilẹ wọn, ani to bi ẹsẹ̀ kan: nitoriti mo ti fi òke Seiri fun Esau ni iní.
entries.en: Meddle not with them; for I will not give you of their land, no, not so much as a foot breadth; because I have given mount Seir unto Esau for a possession.

entries.yo: Owo ni ki ẹnyin fi rà onjẹ lọwọ wọn, ti ẹnyin o jẹ; owo ni ki ẹnyin si fi rà omi lọwọ wọn pẹlu, ti ẹnyin o mu.
entries.en: Ye shall buy meat of them for money, that ye may eat; and ye shall also buy water of them for money, that ye may drink.

entries.yo: Nitoriti OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ ti bukún ọ ninu iṣẹ ọwọ́ rẹ gbogbo: o ti mọ̀ ìrin rẹ li aginjù nla yi: li ogoji ọdún yi OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ ti mbẹ pẹlu rẹ; ọdá ohun kan kò dá ọ.
entries.en: For the LORD thy God hath blessed thee in all the works of thy hand: he knoweth thy walking through this great wilderness: these forty years the LORD thy God hath been with thee; thou hast lacked nothing.

entries.yo: Nigbati awa si kọja lẹba awọn arakunrin wa awọn ọmọ Esau, ti ngbé Seiri, li ọ̀na pẹtẹlẹ̀ lati Elati wá, ati lati Esion-geberi wá, awa pada, awa si kọja li ọ̀na aginjù Moabu.
entries.en: And when we passed by from our brethren the children of Esau, which dwelt in Seir, through the way of the plain from Elath, and from Ezion-gaber, we turned and passed by the way of the wilderness of Moab.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun mi pe, Ẹ máṣe bi awọn ara Moabu ninu, bẹ̃ni ki ẹ máṣe fi ogun jà wọn: nitoripe emi ki yio fi ninu ilẹ rẹ̀ fun ọ ni iní; nitoriti mo ti fi Ari fun awọn ọmọ Lotu ni iní.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto me, Distress not the Moabites, neither contend with them in battle: for I will not give thee of their land for a possession; because I have given Ar unto the children of Lot for a possession.

entries.yo: (Awọn Emimu ti ngbé inu rẹ̀ ni ìgba atijọ rí, awọn enia nla, nwọn si pọ̀, nwọn si sigbọnlẹ, bi awọn ọmọ Anaki:
entries.en: The Emims dwelt therein in times past, a people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakims;

entries.yo: Ti a nkà kún awọn omirán, bi awọn ọmọ Anaki; ṣugbọn awọn ara Moabu a ma pè wọn ni Emimu.
entries.en: Which also were accounted giants, as the Anakims; but the Moabites call them Emims.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Hori pẹlu ti ngbé Seiri rí, ṣugbọn awọn ọmọ Esau tẹle wọn, nwọn si run wọn kuro niwaju wọn, nwọn si ngbé ibẹ̀ ni ipò wọn; gẹgẹ bi Israeli ti ṣe si ilẹ-iní rẹ̀, ti OLUWA fi fun wọn.)
entries.en: The Horims also dwelt in Seir beforetime; but the children of Esau succeeded them, when they had destroyed them from before them, and dwelt in their stead; as Israel did unto the land of his possession, which the LORD gave unto them.

entries.yo: Mo ní, Dide nisisiyi, ki ẹ si gòke odò Seredi. Awa si gòke odò Seredi lọ.
entries.en: Now rise up, said I, and get you over the brook Zered. And we went over the brook Zered.

entries.yo: Ìgba ti awa fi ti Kadeṣi-barnea wá, titi awa fi gòke odò Seredi lọ, o jẹ́ ọgbọ̀n ọdún o le mẹjọ; titi gbogbo iran awọn ologun fi run kuro ninu ibudó, bi OLUWA ti bura fun wọn.
entries.en: And the space in which we came from Kadesh-barnea, until we were come over the brook Zered, was thirty and eight years; until all the generation of the men of war were wasted out from among the host, as the LORD sware unto them.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu ọwọ́ OLUWA lodi si wọn nitõtọ, lati run wọn kuro ninu ibudó, titi nwọn fi run tán.
entries.en: For indeed the hand of the LORD was against them, to destroy them from among the host, until they were consumed.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li o si ṣe, ti gbogbo awọn ologun nì run, ti nwọn si kú tán ninu awọn enia na,
entries.en: So it came to pass, when all the men of war were consumed and dead from among the people,

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun mi pe,
entries.en: That the LORD spake unto me, saying,

entries.yo: Iwọ o là ilẹ Ari lọ li oni, li àgbegbe Moabu:
entries.en: Thou art to pass over through Ar, the coast of Moab, this day:

entries.yo: Nigbati iwọ ba sunmọtosi awọn ọmọ Ammoni, máṣe bi wọn ninu, bẹ̃ni ki o máṣe bá wọn jà: nitoripe emi ki yio fi ninu ilẹ awọn ọmọ Ammoni fun ọ ni iní: nitoriti mo ti fi i fun awọn ọmọ Lotu ni iní.
entries.en: And when thou comest nigh over against the children of Ammon, distress them not, nor meddle with them: for I will not give thee of the land of the children of Ammon any possession; because I have given it unto the children of Lot for a possession.

entries.yo: (A si kà eyinì pẹlu si ilẹ awọn omirán; awọn omirán ti ngbé inu rẹ̀ rí; awọn ọmọ Ammoni a si ma pè wọn ni Samsummimu.
entries.en: (That also was accounted a land of giants: giants dwelt therein in old time; and the Ammonites call them Zamzummims;

entries.yo: Awọn enia nla, ti nwọn si pọ̀, nwọn si sigbọnlẹ, bi awọn ọmọ Anaki; ṣugbọn OLUWA run wọn niwaju wọn; nwọn si tẹle wọn, nwọn si ngbé ibẹ̀ ni ipò wọn;
entries.en: A people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakims; but the LORD destroyed them before them; and they succeeded them, and dwelt in their stead:

entries.yo: Bi o ti ṣe fun awọn ọmọ Esau, ti ngbé Seiri, nigbati o run awọn ọmọ Hori kuro niwaju wọn; ti nwọn si tẹle wọn, ti nwọn si ngbé ibẹ̀ ni ipò wọn titi di oni-oloni:
entries.en: As he did to the children of Esau, which dwelt in Seir, when he destroyed the Horims from before them; and they succeeded them, and dwelt in their stead even unto this day:

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Affimu ti ngbé awọn ileto, titi dé Gasa, awọn ọmọ Kaftori, ti o ti ọdọ Kaftori wá, run wọn, nwọn si ngbé ibẹ̀ ni ipò wọn.)
entries.en: And the Avims which dwelt in Hazerim, even unto Azzah, the Caphtorims, which came forth out of Caphtor, destroyed them, and dwelt in their stead.)

entries.yo: Ẹ dide, ẹ mú ọ̀na nyin pọ̀n, ki ẹ si gòke odò Arnoni: wò o, emi fi Sihoni ọmọ Amori, ọba Heṣboni lé ọ lọwọ, ati ilẹ rẹ̀: bẹ̀rẹsi gbà a, ki o si bá a jagun.
entries.en: Rise ye up, take your journey, and pass over the river Arnon: behold, I have given into thine hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land: begin to possess it, and contend with him in battle.

entries.yo: Li oni yi li emi o bẹ̀rẹsi fi ìfoya rẹ, ati ẹ̀ru rẹ sara awọn orilẹ-ède ti mbẹ ni gbogbo abẹ ọrun, ti yio gburó rẹ, ti yio si warìri, ti yio si ṣe ipàiya nitori rẹ.
entries.en: This day will I begin to put the dread of thee and the fear of thee upon the nations that are under the whole heaven, who shall hear report of thee, and shall tremble, and be in anguish because of thee.

entries.yo: Mo si rán onṣẹ lati aginjù Kedemotu lọ sọdọ Sihoni ọba Heṣboni pẹlu ọ̀rọ alafia, wipe,
entries.en: And I sent messengers out of the wilderness of Kedemoth unto Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace, saying,

entries.yo: Jẹ ki emi ki o là ilẹ rẹ kọja lọ: ọ̀na opópo li emi o gbà, emi ki yio yà si ọtún tabi si òsi.
entries.en: Let me pass through thy land: I will go along by the high way, I will neither turn unto the right hand nor to the left.

entries.yo: Pẹlu owo ni ki iwọ ki o tà onjẹ fun mi, ki emi ki o jẹ; pẹlu owo ni ki iwọ ki o si fun mi li omi, ki emi ki o mu: kìki ki nsá fi ẹsẹ̀ mi kọja;
entries.en: Thou shalt sell me meat for money, that I may eat; and give me water for money, that I may drink: only I will pass through on my feet;

entries.yo: Bi awọn ọmọ Esau ti ngbé Seiri, ati awọn ara Moabu ti ngbé Ari, ti ṣe si mi; titi emi o fi gòke Jordani si ilẹ ti OLUWA Ọlọrun wa fi fun wa.
entries.en: (As the children of Esau which dwell in Seir, and the Moabites which dwell in Ar, did unto me;) until I shall pass over Jordan into the land which the LORD our God giveth us.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Sihoni ọba Heṣboni kò jẹ ki a kọja lẹba on: nitoriti OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ mu u li àiya le, o sọ ọkàn rẹ̀ di agídi, ki o le fi on lé ọ lọwọ, bi o ti ri li oni yi.
entries.en: But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass by him: for the LORD thy God hardened his spirit, and made his heart obstinate, that he might deliver him into thy hand, as appeareth this day.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun mi pe, Wò o, emi ti bẹ̀rẹsi fi Sihoni ati ilẹ rẹ̀ fun ọ niwaju rẹ: bẹ̀rẹsi gbà a, ki iwọ ki o le ní ilẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto me, Behold, I have begun to give Sihon and his land before thee: begin to possess, that thou mayest inherit his land.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Sihoni jade si wa, on ati gbogbo awọn enia rẹ̀, fun ìja ni Jahasi.
entries.en: Then Sihon came out against us, he and all his people, to fight at Jahaz.

entries.yo: OLUWA Ọlọrun si fi i lé wa lọwọ niwaju wa; awa si kọlù u, ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, ati gbogbo awọn enia rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the LORD our God delivered him before us; and we smote him, and his sons, and all his people.

entries.yo: Awa si kó gbogbo ilu rẹ̀ ni ìgba na, awa si run awọn ọkunrin patapata, ati awọn obinrin, ati awọn ọmọ wẹ́wẹ, ni gbogbo ilu; awa kò jẹ ki ọkan ki o kù:
entries.en: And we took all his cities at that time, and utterly destroyed the men, and the women, and the little ones, of every city, we left none to remain:

entries.yo: Kìki ohunọ̀sin li a kó ni ikogun fun ara wa, ati ikogun ilu wọnni ti awa kó.
entries.en: Only the cattle we took for a prey unto ourselves, and the spoil of the cities which we took.

entries.yo: Lati Aroeri lọ, ti mbẹ leti afonifoji Arnoni, ati lati ilu ni lọ ti mbẹ lẹba afonifoji nì, ani dé Gileadi, kò sí ilu kan ti o le jù fun wa: OLUWA Ọlọrun wa fi gbogbo wọn fun wa:
entries.en: From Aroer, which is by the brink of the river of Arnon, and from the city that is by the river, even unto Gilead, there was not one city too strong for us: the LORD our God delivered all unto us:

entries.yo: Kìki ilẹ awọn ọmọ Ammoni ni iwọ kò sunmọ, tabi ibikibi lẹba odò Jaboku, tabi ilu òke wọnni, tabi ibikibi ti OLUWA Ọlọrun wa kọ̀ fun wa.
entries.en: Only unto the land of the children of Ammon thou camest not, nor unto any place of the river Jabbok, nor unto the cities in the mountains, nor unto whatsoever the LORD our God forbad us.

entries.yo: NIGBANA li awa pada, a si lọ soke li ọ̀na Baṣani: Ogu ọba Baṣani si jade si wa, on ati gbogbo awọn enia rẹ̀, fun ìja ni Edrei.
entries.en: Then we turned, and went up the way to Bashan: and Og the king of Bashan came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun mi pe, Máṣe bẹ̀ru rẹ̀: nitoripe emi ti fi on, ati gbogbo awọn enia rẹ̀, ati ilẹ rẹ̀, le ọ lọwọ; iwọ o si ṣe si i bi iwọ ti ṣe si Sihoni ọba ọmọ Amori, ti ngbé Heṣboni.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto me, Fear him not: for I will deliver him, and all his people, and his land, into thy hand; and thou shalt do unto him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites, which dwelt at Heshbon.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni OLUWA Ọlọrun wa fi Ogu, ọba Baṣani, ati gbogbo awọn enia rẹ̀, lé wa lọwọ pẹlu: awa si kọlù u titi kò si kù ẹnikan silẹ fun u.
entries.en: So the LORD our God delivered into our hands Og also, the king of Bashan, and all his people: and we smote him until none was left to him remaining.

entries.yo: Awa si kó gbogbo ilu rẹ̀ ni ìgba na; kò sí ilu kan ti awa kò gbà lọwọ wọn; ọgọta ilu, gbogbo ẹkùn Argobu, ilẹ ọba Ogu ni Baṣani.
entries.en: And we took all his cities at that time, there was not a city which we took not from them, threescore cities, all the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ilu wọnyi li a mọ odi giga si pẹlu ibode, ati idabu-ẹ̀kun; laikà ọ̀pọlọpọ ilu alailodi.
entries.en: All these cities were fenced with high walls, gates, and bars; beside unwalled towns a great many.

entries.yo: Awa si run wọn patapata, bi awa ti ṣe si Sihoni ọba Heṣboni, ni rirun awọn ọkunrin, obinrin, ati awọn ọmọ wẹ́wẹ patapata, ni ilu na gbogbo.
entries.en: And we utterly destroyed them, as we did unto Sihon king of Heshbon, utterly destroying the men, women, and children, of every city.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn gbogbo ohunọ̀sin, ati ikogun ilu wọnni li awa kó ni ikogun fun ara wa.
entries.en: But all the cattle, and the spoil of the cities, we took for a prey to ourselves.

entries.yo: Nigbana li awa gbà li ọwọ́ awọn ọba ọmọ Amori mejeji, ilẹ ti mbẹ ni ìha ẹ̀bá Jordani, lati afonifoji Arnoni lọ dé òke Hermoni;
entries.en: And we took at that time out of the hand of the two kings of the Amorites the land that was on this side Jordan, from the river of Arnon unto mount Hermon;

entries.yo: (Awọn ara Sidoni a ma pè Hermoni ni Sirioni, ati awọn ọmọ Amori a si ma pè e ni Seniri;)
entries.en: (Which Hermon the Sidonians call Sirion; and the Amorites call it Shenir;)

entries.yo: Gbogbo ilu pẹtẹlẹ̀ na, ati gbogbo Gileadi, ati gbogbo Baṣani, dé Saleka ati Edrei, awọn ilu ilẹ ọba Ogu ni Baṣani.
entries.en: All the cities of the plain, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, unto Salchah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.

entries.yo: (Ogu ọba Baṣani nikanṣoṣo li o sá kù ninu awọn omirán iyokù; kiyesi i, akete rẹ̀ jẹ́ akete irin; kò ha wà ni Rabba ti awọn ọmọ Ammoni? igbọnwọ mẹsan ni gigùn rẹ̀, igbọnwọ mẹrin si ni ibú rẹ̀, ni igbọnwọ ọkunrin.)
entries.en: For only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of giants; behold, his bedstead was a bedstead of iron; is it not in Rabbath of the children of Ammon? nine cubits was the length thereof, and four cubits the breadth of it, after the cubit of a man.

entries.yo: Ati ilẹ na yi, ti awa gbà ni ìgbana, lati Aroeri, ti mbẹ lẹba afonifoji Arnoni, ati àbọ òke Gileadi, ati ilu inu rẹ̀, ni mo fi fun awọn ọmọ Reubeni, ati fun awọn ọmọ Gadi:
entries.en: And this land, which we possessed at that time, from Aroer, which is by the river Arnon, and half mount Gilead, and the cities thereof, gave I unto the Reubenites and to the Gadites.

entries.yo: Ati iyokù Gileadi, ati gbogbo Baṣani, ilẹ ọba Ogu, ni mo fi fun àbọ ẹ̀ya Manasse; gbogbo ẹkùn Argobu, pẹlu gbogbo Baṣani. (Ti a ma pè ni ilẹ awọn omirán.
entries.en: And the rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, being the kingdom of Og, gave I unto the half tribe of Manasseh; all the region of Argob, with all Bashan, which was called the land of giants.

entries.yo: Jairi ọmọ Manasse mú gbogbo ilẹ Argobu, dé opinlẹ Geṣuri ati Maakati; o si sọ wọn, ani Baṣan, li orukọ ara rẹ̀, ni Haffotu-jairi titi, di oni.)
entries.en: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the country of Argob unto the coasts of Geshuri and Maachathi; and called them after his own name, Bashan-havoth-jair, unto this day.

entries.yo: Mo si fi Gileadi fun Makiri.
entries.en: And I gave Gilead unto Machir.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Reubeni, ati awọn ọmọ Gadi ni mo fi fun lati Gileadi, ani dé afonifoji Arnoni, agbedemeji afonifoji, ati opinlẹ rẹ̀; ani dé odò Jaboku, ti iṣe ipinlẹ awọn ọmọ Ammoni;
entries.en: And unto the Reubenites and unto the Gadites I gave from Gilead even unto the river Arnon half the valley, and the border even unto the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;

entries.yo: Pẹtẹlẹ̀ ni pẹlu, ati Jordani ati opinlẹ rẹ̀, lati Kinnereti lọ titi dé okun pẹtẹlẹ̀, ani Okun Iyọ̀, nisalẹ awọn orisun Pisga ni ìha ìla-õrùn.
entries.en: The plain also, and Jordan, and the coast thereof, from Chinnereth even unto the sea of the plain, even the salt sea, under Ashdoth-pisgah eastward.

entries.yo: Mo si fun nyin li aṣẹ ni ìgbana, wipe, OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin ti fi ilẹ yi fun nyin lati ní i: ẹnyin o si kọja si ìha keji ni ihamọra ogun niwaju awọn arakunrin nyin, awọn ọmọ Israeli, gbogbo awọn akọni ọkunrin.
entries.en: And I commanded you at that time, saying, The LORD your God hath given you this land to possess it: ye shall pass over armed before your brethren the children of Israel, all that are meet for the war.

entries.yo: Kìki awọn aya nyin, ati awọn ọmọ wẹ́wẹ nyin, ati ohunọ̀sin nyin, (emi mọ̀ pe ẹnyin lí ohunọ̀sin pupọ̀,) ni yio duro ni ilu nyin ti mo ti fi fun nyin;
entries.en: But your wives, and your little ones, and your cattle, (for I know that ye have much cattle,) shall abide in your cities which I have given you;

entries.yo: Titi OLUWA o fi fi isimi fun awọn arakunrin nyin, gẹgẹ bi o ti fi fun ẹnyin, ati titi awọn pẹlu yio fi ní ilẹ na ti OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin ti fi fun wọn loke Jordani: nigbana li ẹnyin o pada, olukuluku si ilẹ-iní rẹ̀, ti mo ti fi fun nyin.
entries.en: Until the LORD have given rest unto your brethren, as well as unto you, and until they also possess the land which the LORD your God hath given them beyond Jordan: and then shall ye return every man unto his possession, which I have given you.

entries.yo: Emi si fi aṣẹ fun Joṣua ni ìgbana, wipe, Oju rẹ ti ri gbogbo eyiti OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin ti ṣe si awọn ọba mejeji wọnyi: bẹ̃ni OLUWA yio ṣe si gbogbo ilẹ-ọba nibiti iwọ o kọja.
entries.en: And I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, Thine eyes have seen all that the LORD your God hath done unto these two kings: so shall the LORD do unto all the kingdoms whither thou passest.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin kò gbọdọ bẹ̀ru wọn: nitoripe OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin, on ni yio jà fun nyin.
entries.en: Ye shall not fear them: for the LORD your God he shall fight for you.

entries.yo: Emi si bẹ̀ OLUWA ni ìgba na, wipe,
entries.en: And I besought the LORD at that time, saying,

entries.yo: OLUWA Ọlọrun, iwọ ti bẹ̀rẹsi fi titobi rẹ hàn fun iranṣẹ rẹ, ati ọwọ́ agbara rẹ: nitoripe Ọlọrun wo ni li ọrun ati li aiye, ti o le ṣe gẹgẹ bi iṣẹ rẹ, ati gẹgẹ bi iṣẹ-agbara rẹ?
entries.en: O Lord GOD, thou hast begun to shew thy servant thy greatness, and thy mighty hand: for what God is there in heaven or in earth, that can do according to thy works, and according to thy might?

entries.yo: Emi bẹ̀ ọ, jẹ ki emi ki o kọja si ìha keji, ki emi si ri ilẹ rere na ti mbẹ loke Jordani, òke daradara nì, ati Lebanoni.
entries.en: I pray thee, let me go over, and see the good land that is beyond Jordan, that goodly mountain, and Lebanon.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn OLUWA binu si mi nitori nyin, kò si gbọ́ ti emi: OLUWA si wi fun mi pe, O to gẹ; má tun bá mi sọ ọ̀rọ yi mọ́.
entries.en: But the LORD was wroth with me for your sakes, and would not hear me: and the LORD said unto me, Let it suffice thee; speak no more unto me of this matter.

entries.yo: Gùn ori òke Pisga lọ, ki o si gbé oju rẹ soke si ìha ìwọ-õrùn, ati si ìha ariwa, ati si ìha gusù, ati si ìha ìla-õrùn, ki o si fi oju rẹ wò o: nitoripe iwọ ki yio gòke Jordani yi.
entries.en: Get thee up into the top of Pisgah, and lift up thine eyes westward, and northward, and southward, and eastward, and behold it with thine eyes: for thou shalt not go over this Jordan.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn fi aṣẹ fun Joṣua, ki o si gbà a niyanju, ki o si mu u li ọkàn le: nitoripe on ni yio gòke lọ niwaju awọn enia yi, on o si mu wọn ni ilẹ na ti iwọ o ri.
entries.en: But charge Joshua, and encourage him, and strengthen him: for he shall go over before this people, and he shall cause them to inherit the land which thou shalt see.

entries.yo: Awa si joko li afonifoji ti o kọjusi Beti-peori.
entries.en: So we abode in the valley over against Beth-peor.

entries.yo: NJẸ nisisiyi Israeli, fetisi ìlana ati idajọ, ti emi nkọ́ nyin, lati ṣe wọn; ki ẹnyin ki o le yè, ki ẹ si lọ igba ilẹ na ti OLUWA, Ọlọrun awọn baba nyin fi fun nyin.
entries.en: Now therefore hearken, O Israel, unto the statutes and unto the judgments, which I teach you, for to do them, that ye may live, and go in and possess the land which the LORD God of your fathers giveth you.

entries.yo: Ẹ kò gbọdọ fikún ọ̀rọ na ti mo palaṣẹ fun nyin, bẹ̃li ẹnyin kò gbọdọ bù kuro ninu rẹ̀, ki ẹnyin ki o le pa ofin OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin mọ́, ti mo palaṣẹ fun nyin.
entries.en: Ye shall not add unto the word which I command you, neither shall ye diminish ought from it, that ye may keep the commandments of the LORD your God which I command you.

entries.yo: Oju nyin ti ri ohun ti OLUWA ṣe nitori Baali-peori: nitoripe gbogbo awọn ọkunrin ti o tẹlé Baali-peori lẹhin, OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ ti run wọn kuro lãrin rẹ.
entries.en: Your eyes have seen what the LORD did because of Baal-peor: for all the men that followed Baal-peor, the LORD thy God hath destroyed them from among you.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹnyin ti o faramọ́ OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin, gbogbo nyin mbẹ lãye li oni.
entries.en: But ye that did cleave unto the LORD your God are alive every one of you this day.

entries.yo: Wò o, emi ti kọ́ nyin ni ìlana ati idajọ, bi OLUWA Ọlọrun mi ti paṣẹ fun mi, pe ki ẹnyin ki o le ma ṣe bẹ̃ ni ilẹ na nibiti ẹnyin nlọ lati gbà a.
entries.en: Behold, I have taught you statutes and judgments, even as the LORD my God commanded me, that ye should do so in the land whither ye go to possess it.

entries.yo: Nitorina ẹ pa wọn mọ́, ki ẹ si ma ṣe wọn; nitoripe eyi li ọgbọ́n nyin ati oye nyin li oju awọn orilẹ-ède, ti yio gbọ́ gbogbo ìlana wọnyi, ti yio si wipe, Ọlọgbọ́n ati amoye enia nitõtọ ni orilẹ-ède nla yi.
entries.en: Keep therefore and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the nations, which shall hear all these statutes, and say, Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.

entries.yo: Nitori orilẹ-ède nla wo li o wà, ti o ní Ọlọrun sunmọ wọn to, bi OLUWA Ọlọrun wa ti ri ninu ohun gbogbo ti awa kepè e si?
entries.en: For what nation is there so great, who hath God so nigh unto them, as the LORD our God is in all things that we call upon him for?

entries.yo: Ati orilẹ-ède nla wo li o si wà, ti o ní ìlana ati idajọ ti iṣe ododo to bi gbogbo ofin yi, ti mo fi siwaju nyin li oni?
entries.en: And what nation is there so great, that hath statutes and judgments so righteous as all this law, which I set before you this day?

entries.yo: Kìki ki iwọ ki o ma kiyesara rẹ, ki o si ṣọ́ ọkàn rẹ gidigidi, ki iwọ ki o má ba gbagbé ohun ti oju rẹ ti ri, ati ki nwọn ki o má ba lọ kuro li àiya rẹ li ọjọ́ aiye rẹ gbogbo; ṣugbọn ki iwọ ki o ma fi wọn kọ́ awọn ọmọ rẹ, ati awọn ọmọ ọmọ rẹ;
entries.en: Only take heed to thyself, and keep thy soul diligently, lest thou forget the things which thine eyes have seen, and lest they depart from thy heart all the days of thy life: but teach them thy sons, and thy sons' sons;

entries.yo: Li ọjọ́ ti iwọ duro niwaju OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ ni Horebu, nigbati OLUWA wi fun mi pe, Pe awọn enia yi jọ fun mi, emi o si mu wọn gbọ́ ọ̀rọ mi, ki nwọn ki o le ma kọ́ ati bẹ̀ru mi li ọjọ́ gbogbo ti nwọn o wà lori ilẹ, ati ki nwọn ki o le ma kọ́ awọn ọmọ wọn.
entries.en: Specially the day that thou stoodest before the LORD thy God in Horeb, when the LORD said unto me, Gather me the people together, and I will make them hear my words, that they may learn to fear me all the days that they shall live upon the earth, and that they may teach their children.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin si sunmọtosi, ẹ si duro nisalẹ òke nì; òke na si njòna dé agbedemeji ọrun, pẹlu òkunkun, ati awọsanma, ati òkunkun biribiri.
entries.en: And ye came near and stood under the mountain; and the mountain burned with fire unto the midst of heaven, with darkness, clouds, and thick darkness.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ̀rọ si nyin lati ãrin iná na wá: ẹnyin gbọ́ ohùn ọ̀rọ na, ṣugbọn ẹ kò ri apẹrẹ kan; kìki ohùn li ẹnyin gbọ́.
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto you out of the midst of the fire: ye heard the voice of the words, but saw no similitude; only ye heard a voice.

entries.yo: O si sọ majẹmu rẹ̀ fun nyin, ti o palaṣẹ fun nyin lati ṣe, ani ofin mẹwa nì; o si kọ wọn sara walã okuta meji.
entries.en: And he declared unto you his covenant, which he commanded you to perform, even ten commandments; and he wrote them upon two tables of stone.

entries.yo: OLUWA si paṣẹ fun mi ni ìgba na lati kọ́ nyin ni ìlana ati idajọ, ki ẹnyin ki o le ma ṣe wọn ni ilẹ na nibiti ẹnyin nlọ lati gbà a.
entries.en: And the LORD commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and judgments, that ye might do them in the land whither ye go over to possess it.

entries.yo: Nitorina ki ẹnyin ki o ma kiyesara nyin gidigidi, nitoripe ẹnyin kò ri apẹrẹ kan li ọjọ́ ti OLUWA bá nyin sọ̀rọ ni Horebu lati ãrin iná wá:
entries.en: Take ye therefore good heed unto yourselves; for ye saw no manner of similitude on the day that the LORD spake unto you in Horeb out of the midst of the fire:

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o má ba bà ara nyin jẹ́, ki ẹ má si lọ ṣe ere gbigbẹ, apẹrẹ ohunkohun, aworán akọ tabi abo.
entries.en: Lest ye corrupt yourselves, and make you a graven image, the similitude of any figure, the likeness of male or female,

entries.yo: Aworán ẹrankẹran ti mbẹ lori ilẹ, aworán ẹiyẹkẹiyẹ ti nfò li oju-ọrun.
entries.en: The likeness of any beast that is on the earth, the likeness of any winged fowl that flieth in the air,

entries.yo: Aworán ohunkohun ti nrakò lori ilẹ, aworán ẹjakẹja ti mbẹ ninu omi nisalẹ ilẹ:
entries.en: The likeness of any thing that creepeth on the ground, the likeness of any fish that is in the waters beneath the earth:

entries.yo: Ati ki iwọ ki o má ba gbé oju rẹ soke ọrun, nigbati iwọ ba si ri õrùn, ati oṣupa, ati irawọ, ani gbogbo ogun ọrun, ki a má ba sún ọ lọ ibọ wọn, ki o si ma sìn wọn, eyiti OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ fi fun gbogbo orilẹ-ède labẹ ọrun gbogbo.
entries.en: And lest thou lift up thine eyes unto heaven, and when thou seest the sun, and the moon, and the stars, even all the host of heaven, shouldest be driven to worship them, and serve them, which the LORD thy God hath divided unto all nations under the whole heaven.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn OLUWA ti gbà nyin, o si mú nyin lati ileru irin, lati Egipti jade wá, lati ma jẹ́ enia iní fun u, bi ẹnyin ti ri li oni yi.
entries.en: But the LORD hath taken you, and brought you forth out of the iron furnace, even out of Egypt, to be unto him a people of inheritance, as ye are this day.

entries.yo: OLUWA si binu si mi nitori nyin, o si bura pe, emi ki yio gòke Jordani, ati pe emi ki yio wọ̀ inu ilẹ rere nì, ti OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ fi fun ọ ni ilẹ-iní.
entries.en: Furthermore the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, and sware that I should not go over Jordan, and that I should not go in unto that good land, which the LORD thy God giveth thee for an inheritance:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi o kú ni ilẹ yi, emi ki yio gòke odò Jordani: ṣugbọn ẹnyin o gòke ẹnyin o si gbà ilẹ rere na.
entries.en: But I must die in this land, I must not go over Jordan: but ye shall go over, and possess that good land.

entries.yo: Ẹ ma ṣọra nyin, ki ẹnyin má ba gbagbé majẹmu OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin, ti o ti bá nyin dá, ki ẹnyin má ba lọ ṣe ere finfin fun ara nyin, tabi aworán ohunkohun ti OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ ti kọ̀ fun ọ.
entries.en: Take heed unto yourselves, lest ye forget the covenant of the LORD your God, which he made with you, and make you a graven image, or the likeness of any thing, which the LORD thy God hath forbidden thee.

entries.yo: Nitori OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ ajonirun iná ni, Ọlọrun owú.
entries.en: For the LORD thy God is a consuming fire, even a jealous God.

entries.yo: Nigbati iwọ ba bi ọmọ, ati ọmọ ọmọ, ti ẹ ba si pẹ ni ilẹ na, ti ẹ si bà ara nyin jẹ́, ti ẹ si ṣe ere finfin, tabi aworán ohunkohun, ti ẹ si ṣe eyiti o buru li oju OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ lati mu u binu:
entries.en: When thou shalt beget children, and children's children, and ye shall have remained long in the land, and shall corrupt yourselves, and make a graven image, or the likeness of any thing, and shall do evil in the sight of the LORD thy God, to provoke him to anger:

entries.yo: Mo pè ọrun ati aiye jẹri si nyin li oni, pe lọ́gan li ẹnyin o run kuro patapata ni ilẹ na nibiti ẹnyin ngòke Jordani lọ lati gbà a; ẹnyin ki yio lò ọjọ́ nyin pẹ ninu rẹ̀, ṣugbọn ẹnyin o si run patapata.
entries.en: I call heaven and earth to witness against you this day, that ye shall soon utterly perish from off the land whereunto ye go over Jordan to possess it; ye shall not prolong your days upon it, but shall utterly be destroyed.

entries.yo: OLUWA yio si tú nyin ká ninu awọn orilẹ-ède, diẹ ni ẹnyin o si kù ni iye ninu awọn orilẹ-ède, nibiti OLUWA yio darí nyin si.
entries.en: And the LORD shall scatter you among the nations, and ye shall be left few in number among the heathen, whither the LORD shall lead you.

entries.yo: Nibẹ̀ li ẹnyin o si ma sìn oriṣa, iṣẹ ọwọ́ enia, igi ati okuta, ti kò riran, ti kò si gbọran, ti kò jẹun, ti kò si gbõrun.
entries.en: And there ye shall serve gods, the work of men's hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi iwọ ba wá OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ lati ibẹ̀ lọ, iwọ o ri i, bi iwọ ba fi gbogbo àiya rẹ, ati gbogbo ọkàn rẹ wá a.
entries.en: But if from thence thou shalt seek the LORD thy God, thou shalt find him, if thou seek him with all thy heart and with all thy soul.

entries.yo: Nigbati iwọ ba mbẹ ninu ipọnju, ti nkan gbogbo wọnyi ba si bá ọ, nikẹhin ọjọ́, bi iwọ ba yipada si OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ, ti iwọ ba si gbà ohùn rẹ̀ gbọ́:
entries.en: When thou art in tribulation, and all these things are come upon thee, even in the latter days, if thou turn to the LORD thy God, and shalt be obedient unto his voice;

entries.yo: Nitoripe Ọlọrun alãnu ni OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ; on ki yio kọ̀ ọ silẹ, bẹ̃ni ki yio run ọ, bẹ̃ni ki yio gbagbé majẹmu awọn baba rẹ, ti o ti bura fun wọn.
entries.en: (For the LORD thy God is a merciful God;) he will not forsake thee, neither destroy thee, nor forget the covenant of thy fathers which he sware unto them.

entries.yo: Njẹ bère nisisiyi niti ọjọ́ igbãni, ti o ti mbẹ ṣaju rẹ, lati ọjọ́ ti Ọlọrun ti dá enia sori ilẹ, ki o si bère lati ìha ọrun kini dé ìha keji, bi irú nkan bi ohun nla yi wà rí, tabi bi a gburó irú rẹ̀ rí?
entries.en: For ask now of the days that are past, which were before thee, since the day that God created man upon the earth, and ask from the one side of heaven unto the other, whether there hath been any such thing as this great thing is, or hath been heard like it?

entries.yo: Awọn enia kan ha gbọ́ ohùn Ọlọrun rí ki o ma bá wọn sọ̀rọ lati ãrin iná wá, bi iwọ ti gbọ́, ti o si wà lãye?
entries.en: Did ever people hear the voice of God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as thou hast heard, and live?

entries.yo: Tabi Ọlọrun ha dán a wò rí lati lọ mú orilẹ-ède kan fun ara rẹ̀ lati ãrin orilẹ-ède miran wá, nipa idanwò, nipa àmi, ati nipa iṣẹ-iyanu, ati nipa ogun, ati nipa ọwọ́ agbara, ati nipa ninà apa, ati nipa ẹ̀ru nla, gẹgẹ bi gbogbo eyiti OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin ṣe fun nyin ni Egipti ni oju nyin?
entries.en: Or hath God assayed to go and take him a nation from the midst of another nation, by temptations, by signs, and by wonders, and by war, and by a mighty hand, and by a stretched out arm, and by great terrors, according to all that the LORD your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?

entries.yo: Iwọ li a fihàn, ki iwọ ki o le mọ̀ pe OLUWA on li Ọlọrun; kò sí ẹlomiran lẹhin rẹ̀.
entries.en: Unto thee it was shewed, that thou mightest know that the LORD he is God; there is none else beside him.

entries.yo: O mu ọ gbọ́ ohùn rẹ̀ lati ọrun wá, ki o le kọ́ ọ: ati lori ilẹ aiye o fi iná nla rẹ̀ hàn ọ; iwọ si gbọ́ ọ̀rọ rẹ̀ lati ãrin iná wá.
entries.en: Out of heaven he made thee to hear his voice, that he might instruct thee: and upon earth he shewed thee his great fire; and thou heardest his words out of the midst of the fire.

entries.yo: Ati nitoriti o fẹ́ awọn baba rẹ, nitorina li o ṣe yàn irú-ọmọ wọn lẹhin wọn, o si fi agbara nla rẹ̀ mú ọ lati Egipti jade wá li oju rẹ̀;
entries.en: And because he loved thy fathers, therefore he chose their seed after them, and brought thee out in his sight with his mighty power out of Egypt;

entries.yo: Lati lé awọn orilẹ-ède jade kuro niwaju rẹ, ti o tobi, ti o si lagbara jù ọ lọ, lati mú ọ wọle, lati fi ilẹ wọn fun ọ ni iní, bi o ti ri li oni yi.
entries.en: To drive out nations from before thee greater and mightier than thou art, to bring thee in, to give thee their land for an inheritance, as it is this day.

entries.yo: Nitorina ki iwọ ki o mọ̀ li oni, ki o si rò li ọkàn rẹ pe, OLUWA on li Ọlọrun loke ọrun, ati lori ilẹ nisalẹ: kò sí ẹlomiran.
entries.en: Know therefore this day, and consider it in thine heart, that the LORD he is God in heaven above, and upon the earth beneath: there is none else.

entries.yo: Nitorina ki iwọ ki o pa ìlana rẹ̀ mọ́, ati ofin rẹ̀, ti mo palaṣẹ fun ọ li oni, ki o le dara fun ọ, ati fun awọn ọmọ rẹ lẹhin rẹ, ati ki iwọ ki o le mu ọjọ́ rẹ pẹ lori ilẹ, ti OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ fi fun ọ lailai.
entries.en: Thou shalt keep therefore his statutes, and his commandments, which I command thee this day, that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee, and that thou mayest prolong thy days upon the earth, which the LORD thy God giveth thee, for ever.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Mose yà ilu mẹta sọ̀tọ ni ìha ẹ̀bá Jordani si ìha ìla-õrùn.
entries.en: Then Moses severed three cities on this side Jordan toward the sunrising;

entries.yo: Ki apania ki o le ma sá sibẹ̀, ti o ba ṣì ẹnikeji rẹ̀ pa, ti kò si korira rẹ̀ ni ìgba atijọ rí; ati pe bi o ba sá si ọkan ninu ilu wọnyi ki o le là:
entries.en: That the slayer might flee thither, which should kill his neighbour unawares, and hated him not in times past; and that fleeing unto one of these cities he might live:

entries.yo: Beseri ni ijù, ni ilẹ pẹtẹlẹ̀, ti awọn ọmọ Reubeni; ati Ramotu ni Gileadi, ti awọn ọmọ Gadi; ati Golani ni Baṣani, ti awọn ọmọ Manasse.
entries.en: Namely, Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain country, of the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead, of the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan, of the Manassites.

entries.yo: Eyi li ofin na ti Mose filelẹ niwaju awọn ọmọ Israeli:
entries.en: And this is the law which Moses set before the children of Israel:

entries.yo: Wọnyi li ẹrí, ati ìlana, ati idajọ, ti Mose filelẹ fun awọn ọmọ Israeli, lẹhin igbati nwọn ti Egipti jade wá;
entries.en: These are the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, which Moses spake unto the children of Israel, after they came forth out of Egypt,

entries.yo: Ni ìha ẹ̀bá Jordani, ni afonifoji ti o kọjusi Beti-peori, ni ilẹ Sihoni ọba awọn ọmọ Amori, ti ngbé Heṣboni, ẹniti Mose ati awọn ọmọ Israeli kọlù, lẹhin igbati nwọn ti Egipti jade wá:
entries.en: On this side Jordan, in the valley over against Beth-peor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt at Heshbon, whom Moses and the children of Israel smote, after they were come forth out of Egypt:

entries.yo: Nwọn si gbà ilẹ rẹ̀, ati ilẹ Ogu ọba Baṣani, awọn ọba Amori mejeji ti mbẹ ni ìha ẹ̀bá Jordani si ìha ìla-õrùn;
entries.en: And they possessed his land, and the land of Og king of Bashan, two kings of the Amorites, which were on this side Jordan toward the sunrising;

entries.yo: Lati Aroeri lọ, ti mbẹ leti afonifoji Arnoni, ani dé òke Sioni (ti iṣe Hermoni,)
entries.en: From Aroer, which is by the bank of the river Arnon, even unto mount Sion, which is Hermon,

entries.yo: Ati gbogbo pẹtẹlẹ̀ nì, ni ìha ẹ̀bá Jordani ni ìha ìla-õrùn, ani dé okun pẹtẹlẹ̀ nì, nisalẹ awọn orisun Pisga.
entries.en: And all the plain on this side Jordan eastward, even unto the sea of the plain, under the springs of Pisgah.

entries.yo: MOSE si pè gbogbo Israeli, o si wi fun wọn pe, Israeli, gbọ́ ìlana ati idajọ ti emi nsọ li etí nyin li oni, ki ẹnyin ki o le kọ́ wọn, ki ẹ si ma pa wọn mọ́, lati ma ṣe wọn.
entries.en: And Moses called all Israel, and said unto them, Hear, O Israel, the statutes and judgments which I speak in your ears this day, that ye may learn them, and keep, and do them.

entries.yo: OLUWA Ọlọrun wa bá wa dá majẹmu ni Horebu.
entries.en: The LORD our God made a covenant with us in Horeb.

entries.yo: OLUWA kò bá awọn baba wa dá majẹmu yi, bikoṣe awa, ani awa, ti gbogbo wa mbẹ lãye nihin li oni.
entries.en: The LORD made not this covenant with our fathers, but with us, even us, who are all of us here alive this day.

entries.yo: OLUWA bá nyin sọ̀rọ li ojukoju lori òke na, lati ãrin iná wá,
entries.en: The LORD talked with you face to face in the mount out of the midst of the fire,

entries.yo: (Emi duro li agbedemeji OLUWA ati ẹnyin ni ìgba na, lati sọ ọ̀rọ OLUWA fun nyin: nitoripe ẹnyin bẹ̀ru nitori iná na, ẹnyin kò si gòke lọ sori òke na;) wipe,
entries.en: (I stood between the LORD and you at that time, to shew you the work of the LORD: for ye were afraid by reason of the fire, and went not up into the mount;) saying,

entries.yo: Emi li OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ, ti o mú ọ lati ilẹ Egipti, lati oko-ẹrú jade wá.
entries.en: I am the LORD thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.

entries.yo: Iwọ kò gbọdọ ní ọlọrun miran pẹlu mi.
entries.en: Thou shalt have none other gods before me.

entries.yo: Iwọ kò gbọdọ yá ere fun ara rẹ, tabi aworán apẹrẹ kan ti mbẹ loke ọrun, tabi ti mbẹ ni ilẹ nisalẹ, tabi ti mbẹ ninu omi ni isalẹ ilẹ:
entries.en: Thou shalt not make thee any graven image, or any likeness of any thing that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the waters beneath the earth:

entries.yo: Iwọ kò gbọdọ tẹ̀ ori rẹ ba fun wọn, bẹ̃ni iwọ kò gbọdọ sìn wọn: nitoripe emi OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ Ọlọrun owú ni mi, ti mbẹ̀ ẹ̀ṣẹ awọn baba wò lara awọn ọmọ, ati lara iran kẹta ati ẹkẹrin ninu awọn ti o korira mi.
entries.en: Thou shalt not bow down thyself unto them, nor serve them: for I the LORD thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me,

entries.yo: Emi a si ma ṣe ãnu fun ẹgbẹgbẹrun awọn ti o fẹ́ mi, ti nwọn si pa ofin mi mọ́.
entries.en: And shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me and keep my commandments.

entries.yo: Iwọ kò gbọdọ pè orukọ OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ li asan: nitoriti OLUWA ki yio mu ẹniti o pè orukọ rẹ̀ li asan bi alailẹṣẹ lọrùn.
entries.en: Thou shalt not take the name of the LORD thy God in vain: for the LORD will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain.

entries.yo: Kiyesi ọjọ́-isimi lati yà a simimọ́, bi OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ ti paṣẹ fun ọ.
entries.en: Keep the sabbath day to sanctify it, as the LORD thy God hath commanded thee.

entries.yo: Ijọ́ mẹfa ni iwọ o ṣiṣẹ, ti iwọ o si ṣe iṣẹ rẹ gbogbo:
entries.en: Six days thou shalt labour, and do all thy work:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ọjọ́ keje li ọjọ́-isimi OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ: ninu rẹ̀ iwọ kò gbọdọ ṣe iṣẹkiṣẹ kan, iwọ, ati ọmọ rẹ ọkunrin, ati ọmọ rẹ obinrin, ati ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ ọkunrin, ati ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ obinrin, ati akọmalu rẹ, ati kẹtẹkẹtẹ rẹ, ati ohunọ̀sin rẹ kan, ati alejò ti mbẹ ninu ibode rẹ; ki ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ ọkunrin ati ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ obinrin ki o le simi gẹgẹ bi iwọ.
entries.en: But the seventh day is the sabbath of the LORD thy God: in it thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, nor thy manservant, nor thy maidservant, nor thine ox, nor thine ass, nor any of thy cattle, nor thy stranger that is within thy gates; that thy manservant and thy maidservant may rest as well as thou.

entries.yo: Si ranti pe iwọ ti ṣe iranṣẹ ni ilẹ Egipti, ati pe OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ mú ọ lati ibẹ̀ jade wá nipa ọwọ́ agbara, ati nipa ninà apa: nitorina li OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ ṣe paṣẹ fun ọ lati pa ọjọ́-isimi mọ́.
entries.en: And remember that thou wast a servant in the land of Egypt, and that the LORD thy God brought thee out thence through a mighty hand and by a stretched out arm: therefore the LORD thy God commanded thee to keep the sabbath day.

entries.yo: Bọ̀wọ fun baba ati iya rẹ, bi OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ ti paṣẹ fun ọ: ki ọjọ́ rẹ ki o le pẹ, ati ki o le dara fun ọ, ni ilẹ ti OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ fi fun ọ.
entries.en: Honour thy father and thy mother, as the LORD thy God hath commanded thee; that thy days may be prolonged, and that it may go well with thee, in the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.

entries.yo: Iwọ kò gbọdọ pania.
entries.en: Thou shalt not kill.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni iwọ kò gbọdọ ṣe panṣaga.
entries.en: Neither shalt thou commit adultery.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni iwọ kò gbọdọ jale.
entries.en: Neither shalt thou steal.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni iwọ kò gbọdọ jẹri-eké si ẹnikeji rẹ.
entries.en: Neither shalt thou bear false witness against thy neighbour.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni iwọ kò gbọdọ ṣojukokoro si aya ẹnikeji rẹ; bẹ̃ni iwọ kò gbọdọ ṣojukokoro si ile ẹnikeji rẹ, oko rẹ̀, ati ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ̀ ọkunrin, ati ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ̀ obinrin, akọmalu rẹ̀, ati kẹtẹkẹtẹ rẹ̀, ati ohun gbogbo ti iṣe ti ẹnikeji rẹ.
entries.en: Neither shalt thou desire thy neighbour's wife, neither shalt thou covet thy neighbour's house, his field, or his manservant, or his maidservant, his ox, or his ass, or any thing that is thy neighbour's.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ wọnyi ni OLUWA sọ fun gbogbo ijọ nyin lori òke lati ãrin iná, awọsanma, ati lati inu òkunkun biribiri wá, pẹlu ohùn nla: kò si fi kún u mọ́. O si kọ wọn sara walã okuta meji, o si fi wọn fun mi.
entries.en: These words the LORD spake unto all your assembly in the mount out of the midst of the fire, of the cloud, and of the thick darkness, with a great voice: and he added no more. And he wrote them in two tables of stone, and delivered them unto me.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati ẹnyin gbọ́ ohùn nì lati ãrin òkunkun na wá, ti òke na si njó, ti ẹnyin sunmọ ọdọ mi, gbogbo olori awọn ẹ̀ya nyin, ati awọn àgba nyin:
entries.en: And it came to pass, when ye heard the voice out of the midst of the darkness, (for the mountain did burn with fire,) that ye came near unto me, even all the heads of your tribes, and your elders;

entries.yo: Ẹnyin si wipe, Kiyesi i, OLUWA Ọlọrun wa fi ogo rẹ̀ ati titobi rẹ̀ hàn wa, awa si ti gbọ́ ohùn rẹ̀ lati ãrin iná wá: awa ti ri li oni pe, OLUWA a ma ba enia sọ̀rọ̀, on a si wà lãye.
entries.en: And ye said, Behold, the LORD our God hath shewed us his glory and his greatness, and we have heard his voice out of the midst of the fire: we have seen this day that God doth talk with man, and he liveth.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi ẽṣe ti awa o fi kú? nitoripe iná nla yi yio jó wa run: bi awa ba tun gbọ́ ohùn OLUWA Ọlọrun wa, njẹ awa o kú.
entries.en: Now therefore why should we die? for this great fire will consume us: if we hear the voice of the LORD our God any more, then we shall die.

entries.yo: Nitoripe tani mbẹ ninu gbogbo araiye ti o ti igbọ́ ohùn Ọlọrun alãye ti nsọ̀rọ lati ãrin iná wá, bi awa ti gbọ́, ti o si wà lãye?
entries.en: For who is there of all flesh, that hath heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as we have, and lived?

entries.yo: Iwọ sunmọtosi, ki o si gbọ́ gbogbo eyiti OLUWA Ọlọrun wa yio wi: ki iwọ ki o sọ fun wa gbogbo ohun ti OLUWA Ọlọrun wa yio sọ fun ọ: awa o si gbọ́, awa o si ṣe e.
entries.en: Go thou near, and hear all that the LORD our God shall say: and speak thou unto us all that the LORD our God shall speak unto thee; and we will hear it, and do it.

entries.yo: OLUWA si gbọ́ ohùn ọ̀rọ nyin, nigbati ẹnyin sọ fun mi; OLUWA si sọ fun mi pe, emi ti gbọ́ ohùn ọ̀rọ awọn enia yi, ti nwọn sọ fun ọ: nwọn wi rere ni gbogbo eyiti nwọn sọ.
entries.en: And the LORD heard the voice of your words, when ye spake unto me; and the LORD said unto me, I have heard the voice of the words of this people, which they have spoken unto thee: they have well said all that they have spoken.

entries.yo: Irú ọkàn bayi iba ma wà ninu wọn, ki nwọn ki o le ma bẹ̀ru mi, ki nwọn ki o si le ma pa gbogbo ofin mi mọ́ nigbagbogbo, ki o le dara fun wọn, ati fun awọn ọmọ wọn titilai!
entries.en: O that there were such an heart in them, that they would fear me, and keep all my commandments always, that it might be well with them, and with their children for ever!

entries.yo: Lọ wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ pada lọ sinu agọ́ nyin.
entries.en: Go say to them, Get you into your tents again.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn, iwọ, duro nihin lọdọ mi, emi o si sọ ofin nì gbogbo fun ọ, ati ìlana, ati idajọ, ti iwọ o ma kọ́ wọn, ki nwọn ki o le ma ṣe wọn ni ilẹ na ti mo ti fi fun wọn lati ní.
entries.en: But as for thee, stand thou here by me, and I will speak unto thee all the commandments, and the statutes, and the judgments, which thou shalt teach them, that they may do them in the land which I give them to possess it.

entries.yo: Nitorina ki ẹnyin ki o ma kiyesi ati ṣe bi OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin ti paṣẹ fun nyin: ki ẹnyin ki o máṣe yi si ọtún tabi si òsi.
entries.en: Ye shall observe to do therefore as the LORD your God hath commanded you: ye shall not turn aside to the right hand or to the left.

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o si ma rìn ninu gbogbo ọ̀na ti OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin palaṣẹ fun nyin, ki ẹnyin ki o le yè, ki o si le dara fun nyin, ati ki ẹnyin ki o le mu ọjọ́ nyin pẹ ni ilẹ ti ẹnyin yio ní.
entries.en: Ye shall walk in all the ways which the LORD your God hath commanded you, that ye may live, and that it may be well with you, and that ye may prolong your days in the land which ye shall possess.

entries.yo: NJẸ wọnyi li ofin, ìlana, ati idajọ, ti OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin ti palaṣẹ lati ma kọ́ nyin, ki ẹnyin ki o le ma ṣe wọn ni ilẹ nibiti ẹnyin gbé nlọ lati gbà a:
entries.en: Now these are the commandments, the statutes, and the judgments, which the LORD your God commanded to teach you, that ye might do them in the land whither ye go to possess it:

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o le ma bẹ̀ru OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ, lati pa gbogbo ìlana rẹ̀ ati ofin rẹ̀ mọ́, ti emi fi fun ọ, iwọ, ati ọmọ rẹ, ati ọmọ ọmọ rẹ, li ọjọ́ aiye rẹ gbogbo; ki ọjọ́ rẹ ki o le pẹ.
entries.en: That thou mightest fear the LORD thy God, to keep all his statutes and his commandments, which I command thee, thou, and thy son, and thy son's son, all the days of thy life; and that thy days may be prolonged.

entries.yo: Nitorina gbọ́, Israeli, ki o si ma kiyesi i lati ṣe e; ki o le dara fun ọ, ati ki ẹnyin ki o le ma pọ̀si i li ọ̀pọlọpọ, bi OLUWA Ọlọrun awọn baba rẹ ti ṣe ileri fun ọ, ni ilẹ ti nṣàn fun warà ati fun oyin.
entries.en: Hear therefore, O Israel, and observe to do it; that it may be well with thee, and that ye may increase mightily, as the LORD God of thy fathers hath promised thee, in the land that floweth with milk and honey.

entries.yo: Gbọ́, Israeli: OLUWA Ọlọrun wa, OLUWA kan ni.
entries.en: Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God is one LORD:

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o si fi gbogbo àiya rẹ, ati gbogbo ọkàn rẹ, ati gbogbo agbara rẹ fẹ́ OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ.
entries.en: And thou shalt love the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might.

entries.yo: Ati ọ̀rọ wọnyi, ti mo palaṣẹ fun ọ li oni, ki o ma wà ni àiya rẹ:
entries.en: And these words, which I command thee this day, shall be in thine heart:

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o si ma fi wọn kọ́ awọn ọmọ rẹ gidigidi, ki iwọ ki o si ma fi wọn ṣe ọ̀rọ isọ nigbati iwọ ba joko ninu ile rẹ, ati nigbati iwọ ba nrìn li ọ̀na, ati nigbati iwọ ba dubulẹ, ati nigbati iwọ ba dide.
entries.en: And thou shalt teach them diligently unto thy children, and shalt talk of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, and when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o si so wọn mọ́ ọwọ́ rẹ fun àmi, ki nwọn ki o si ma ṣe ọja-igbaju niwaju rẹ.
entries.en: And thou shalt bind them for a sign upon thine hand, and they shall be as frontlets between thine eyes.

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o si kọ wọn sara opó ile rẹ, ati sara ilẹkun ọ̀na-ode rẹ.
entries.en: And thou shalt write them upon the posts of thy house, and on thy gates.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, nigbati OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ ba mú ọ dé ilẹ na, ti o bura fun awọn baba rẹ, fun Abrahamu, fun Isaaki, ati fun Jakobu, lati fun ọ ni ilu ti o tobi ti o si dara, ti iwọ kò mọ̀,
entries.en: And it shall be, when the LORD thy God shall have brought thee into the land which he sware unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give thee great and goodly cities, which thou buildedst not,

entries.yo: Ati ile ti o kún fun ohun rere gbogbo, ti iwọ kò kún, ati kanga wiwà, ti iwọ kò wà, ọgbà-àjara ati igi oróro, ti iwọ kò gbìn; nigbati iwọ ba jẹ tán ti o ba si yó;
entries.en: And houses full of all good things, which thou filledst not, and wells digged, which thou diggedst not, vineyards and olive trees, which thou plantedst not; when thou shalt have eaten and be full;

entries.yo: Kiyesara rẹ ki iwọ ki o má ba gbagbé OLUWA ti o mú ọ lati ilẹ Egipti jade wá, kuro li oko-ẹrú.
entries.en: Then beware lest thou forget the LORD, which brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.

entries.yo: Bẹ̀ru OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ, ki o si ma sìn i, ki o si ma bura li orukọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Thou shalt fear the LORD thy God, and serve him, and shalt swear by his name.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin kò gbọdọ tọ̀ ọlọrun miran lẹhin, ninu oriṣa awọn enia, ti o yi nyin ká kiri;
entries.en: Ye shall not go after other gods, of the gods of the people which are round about you;

entries.yo: Nitori OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ Ọlọrun owú ni ninu nyin; ki ibinu OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ ki o má ba rú si ọ, on a si run ọ kuro lori ilẹ.
entries.en: (For the LORD thy God is a jealous God among you) lest the anger of the LORD thy God be kindled against thee, and destroy thee from off the face of the earth.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin kò gbọdọ dán OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin wò, bi ẹnyin ti dan a wò ni Massa.
entries.en: Ye shall not tempt the LORD your God, as ye tempted him in Massah.

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o pa ofin OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin mọ́ gidigidi, ati ẹrí rẹ̀, ati ìlana rẹ̀, ti o filelẹ li aṣẹ fun ọ.
entries.en: Ye shall diligently keep the commandments of the LORD your God, and his testimonies, and his statutes, which he hath commanded thee.

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o ma ṣe eyiti o tọ́, ti o si dara li oju OLUWA: ki o le dara fun ọ, ati ki iwọ ki o le wọ̀ ilẹ rere nì lọ ki o si gbà a, eyiti OLUWA bura fun awọn baba rẹ,
entries.en: And thou shalt do that which is right and good in the sight of the LORD: that it may be well with thee, and that thou mayest go in and possess the good land which the LORD sware unto thy fathers,

entries.yo: Lati tì awọn ọtá rẹ gbogbo jade kuro niwaju rẹ, bi OLUWA ti wi.
entries.en: To cast out all thine enemies from before thee, as the LORD hath spoken.

entries.yo: Nigbati ọmọ rẹ ba bi ọ lère lẹhin-ọla, wipe, Kini èredi ẹrí, ati ìlana, ati idajọ wọnyi, ti OLUWA Ọlọrun filelẹ li aṣẹ fun nyin?
entries.en: And when thy son asketh thee in time to come, saying, What mean the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, which the LORD our God hath commanded you?

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ki iwọ ki o wi fun ọmọ rẹ pe, Ẹrú Farao li awa ti ṣe ni Egipti; OLUWA si fi ọwọ́ agbara mú wa jade lati Egipti wá.
entries.en: Then thou shalt say unto thy son, We were Pharaoh's bondmen in Egypt; and the LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand:

entries.yo: OLUWA si fi àmi ati iṣẹ-iyanu, ti o tobi ti o si buru hàn lara Egipti, lara Farao, ati lara gbogbo ara ile rẹ̀ li oju wa:
entries.en: And the LORD shewed signs and wonders, great and sore, upon Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his household, before our eyes:

entries.yo: O si mú wa jade lati ibẹ̀ wá, ki o le mú wa wọ̀ inu rẹ̀, lati fun wa ni ilẹ na ti o bura fun awọn baba wa.
entries.en: And he brought us out from thence, that he might bring us in, to give us the land which he sware unto our fathers.

entries.yo: OLUWA si pa a laṣẹ fun wa, lati ma ṣe gbogbo ìlana wọnyi, lati ma bẹ̀ru OLUWA Ọlọrun wa, fun ire wa nigbagbogbo, ki o le pa wa mọ́ lãye, bi o ti ri li oni yi.
entries.en: And the LORD commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear the LORD our God, for our good always, that he might preserve us alive, as it is at this day.

entries.yo: Yio si jẹ́ ododo wa, bi awa ba nṣọ́ ati ma ṣe gbogbo ofin wọnyi niwaju OLUWA Ọlọrun wa, bi o ti paṣẹ fun wa.
entries.en: And it shall be our righteousness, if we observe to do all these commandments before the LORD our God, as he hath commanded us.

entries.yo: NIGBATI OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ ba mú ọ dé ilẹ na nibiti iwọ gbé nlọ lati gbà a, ti o ba lé orilẹ-ède pupọ̀ kuro niwaju rẹ, awọn Hitti, ati awọn Girgaṣi, ati awọn Amori, ati awọn ara Kenaani, ati awọn Perissi, ati awọn Hifi, ati awọn Jebusi, orilẹ-ède meje, ti o pọ̀ ti o si lagbara jù ọ lọ;
entries.en: When the LORD thy God shall bring thee into the land whither thou goest to possess it, and hath cast out many nations before thee, the Hittites, and the Girgashites, and the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, seven nations greater and mightier than thou;

entries.yo: Nigbati OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ ba fi wọn lé ọ lọwọ, iwọ o si kọlù wọn; ki o si run wọn patapata; iwọ kò gbọdọ bá wọn dá majẹmu, bẹ̃ni iwọ kò gbọdọ ṣãnu fun wọn:
entries.en: And when the LORD thy God shall deliver them before thee; thou shalt smite them, and utterly destroy them; thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor shew mercy unto them:

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni iwọ kò gbọdọ bá wọn dá ana; ọmọbinrin rẹ ni iwọ kò gbọdọ fi fun ọmọkunrin rẹ̀, ati ọmọbinrin rẹ̀ ni iwọ kò gbọdọ mú fun ọmọkunrin rẹ.
entries.en: Neither shalt thou make marriages with them; thy daughter thou shalt not give unto his son, nor his daughter shalt thou take unto thy son.

entries.yo: Nitoripe nwọn o yi ọmọkunrin rẹ pada lati ma tọ̀ mi lẹhin, ki nwọn ki o le ma sìn ọlọrun miran: ibinu OLUWA o si rú si nyin, on a si run ọ lojiji.
entries.en: For they will turn away thy son from following me, that they may serve other gods: so will the anger of the LORD be kindled against you, and destroy thee suddenly.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bayi li ẹnyin o fi wọn ṣe; ẹnyin o wó pẹpẹ wọn, ẹ o si bì ọwọ̀n wọn lulẹ, ẹ o si ke igbo oriṣa wọn lulẹ, ẹ o si fi iná jó gbogbo ere finfin wọn.
entries.en: But thus shall ye deal with them; ye shall destroy their altars, and break down their images, and cut down their groves, and burn their graven images with fire.

entries.yo: Nitoripe enia mimọ́ ni iwọ fun OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ: OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ ti yàn ọ lati jẹ́ enia ọ̀tọ fun ara rẹ̀, jù gbogbo enia lọ ti mbẹ lori ilẹ.
entries.en: For thou art an holy people unto the LORD thy God: the LORD thy God hath chosen thee to be a special people unto himself, above all people that are upon the face of the earth.

entries.yo: OLUWA kò fi ifẹ́ rẹ̀ si nyin lara, bẹ̃ni kò yàn nyin, nitoriti ẹnyin pọ̀ ni iye jù awọn enia kan lọ; nitoripe ẹnyin li o tilẹ kére jù ninu gbogbo enia:
entries.en: The LORD did not set his love upon you, nor choose you, because ye were more in number than any people; for ye were the fewest of all people:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nitoriti OLUWA fẹ́ nyin, ati nitoriti on fẹ́ pa ara ti o ti bú fun awọn baba nyin mọ́, ni OLUWA ṣe fi ọwọ́ agbara mú nyin jade, o si rà nyin pada kuro li oko-ẹrú, kuro li ọwọ́ Farao ọba Egipti.
entries.en: But because the LORD loved you, and because he would keep the oath which he had sworn unto your fathers, hath the LORD brought you out with a mighty hand, and redeemed you out of the house of bondmen, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.

entries.yo: Nitorina ki iwọ ki o mọ̀ pe, OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ, on li Ọlọrun; Ọlọrun olõtọ, ti npa majẹmu mọ́ ati ãnu fun awọn ti o fẹ́ ẹ, ti nwọn si pa ofin rẹ̀ mọ́ dé ẹgbẹrun iran;
entries.en: Know therefore that the LORD thy God, he is God, the faithful God, which keepeth covenant and mercy with them that love him and keep his commandments to a thousand generations;

entries.yo: Ti o si nsan a pada fun awọn ti o korira rẹ̀ li oju wọn, lati run wọn: on ki yio jafara fun ẹniti o korira rẹ̀, on o san a fun u loju rẹ̀.
entries.en: And repayeth them that hate him to their face, to destroy them: he will not be slack to him that hateth him, he will repay him to his face.

entries.yo: Nitorina ki iwọ ki o pa ofin, ati ìlana, ati idajọ mọ́, ti mo palaṣẹ fun ọ li oni, lati ma ṣe wọn.
entries.en: Thou shalt therefore keep the commandments, and the statutes, and the judgments, which I command thee this day, to do them.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, nitoriti ẹnyin fetisi idajọ wọnyi, ti ẹ si npa wọn mọ́, ti ẹ si nṣe wọn, njẹ OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ yio ma pa majẹmu ati ãnu mọ́ fun ọ, ti o ti bura fun awọn baba rẹ:
entries.en: Wherefore it shall come to pass, if ye hearken to these judgments, and keep, and do them, that the LORD thy God shall keep unto thee the covenant and the mercy which he sware unto thy fathers:

entries.yo: On o si fẹ́ ọ, yio si bukún ọ, yio si mu ọ bisi i: on o si bukún ọmọ inu rẹ, ati eso ilẹ rẹ, ọkà rẹ, ati ọti-waini rẹ, ati oróro rẹ, ibisi malu rẹ, ati awọn ọmọ agbo-agutan rẹ, ni ilẹ na ti o ti bura fun awọn baba rẹ lati fi fun ọ.
entries.en: And he will love thee, and bless thee, and multiply thee: he will also bless the fruit of thy womb, and the fruit of thy land, thy corn, and thy wine, and thine oil, the increase of thy kine, and the flocks of thy sheep, in the land which he sware unto thy fathers to give thee.

entries.yo: Iwọ o jẹ́ ẹni ibukún jù gbogbo enia lọ: ki yio sí akọ tabi abo ninu nyin ti yio yàgan, tabi ninu ohunọ̀sin nyin.
entries.en: Thou shalt be blessed above all people: there shall not be male or female barren among you, or among your cattle.

entries.yo: OLUWA yio si gbà àrun gbogbo kuro lọdọ rẹ, ki yio si fi ọkan ninu àrun buburu Egipti, ti iwọ mọ̀, si ọ lara, ṣugbọn on o fi wọn lé ara gbogbo awọn ti o korira rẹ.
entries.en: And the LORD will take away from thee all sickness, and will put none of the evil diseases of Egypt, which thou knowest, upon thee; but will lay them upon all them that hate thee.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si run gbogbo awọn enia ti OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ yio fi fun ọ; oju rẹ kò gbọdọ ṣãnu fun wọn: bẹ̃ni iwọ kò gbọdọ sìn awọn oriṣa wọn; nitoripe idẹkùn li eyinì yio jẹ́ fun ọ.
entries.en: And thou shalt consume all the people which the LORD thy God shall deliver thee; thine eye shall have no pity upon them: neither shalt thou serve their gods; for that will be a snare unto thee.

entries.yo: Bi iwọ ba wi li ọkàn rẹ pe, Awọn orilẹ-ède wọnyi pọ̀ jù mi lọ; bawo li emi o ṣe le lé wọn jade?
entries.en: If thou shalt say in thine heart, These nations are more than I; how can I dispossess them?

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o máṣe bẹ̀ru wọn: ṣugbọn ki iwọ ki o ranti daradara ohun ti OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ ṣe si Farao, ati si gbogbo Egipti;
entries.en: Thou shalt not be afraid of them: but shalt well remember what the LORD thy God did unto Pharaoh, and unto all Egypt;

entries.yo: Idanwò nla ti oju rẹ ri, ati àmi, ati iṣẹ-iyanu, ati ọwọ́ agbara, ati ninà apa, ti OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ fi mú ọ jade: bẹ̃ni OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ yio ṣe si gbogbo awọn enia na ẹ̀ru ẹniti iwọ mbà.
entries.en: The great temptations which thine eyes saw, and the signs, and the wonders, and the mighty hand, and the stretched out arm, whereby the LORD thy God brought thee out: so shall the LORD thy God do unto all the people of whom thou art afraid.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ yio rán agbọ́n sinu wọn, titi awọn ti o kù, ti nwọn si fi ara wọn pamọ́ fun ọ yio fi run.
entries.en: Moreover the LORD thy God will send the hornet among them, until they that are left, and hide themselves from thee, be destroyed.

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o máṣe fòya wọn: nitoriti OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ mbẹ lãrin rẹ, Ọlọrun ti o tobi ti o si lẹrù.
entries.en: Thou shalt not be affrighted at them: for the LORD thy God is among you, a mighty God and terrible.

entries.yo: OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ yio tì awọn orilẹ-ède na jade diẹdiẹ niwaju rẹ: ki iwọ ki o máṣe run wọn tán lẹ̃kan, ki ẹranko igbẹ́ ki o má ba pọ̀ si ọ.
entries.en: And the LORD thy God will put out those nations before thee by little and little: thou mayest not consume them at once, lest the beasts of the field increase upon thee.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ yio fi wọn lé ọ lọwọ, yio si fi iparun nla pa wọn run, titi nwọn o fi run.
entries.en: But the LORD thy God shall deliver them unto thee, and shall destroy them with a mighty destruction, until they be destroyed.

entries.yo: On o si fi awọn ọba wọn lé ọ lọwọ, iwọ o si pa orukọ wọn run kuro labẹ ọrun: kò sí ọkunrin kan ninu wọn ti yio le duro niwaju rẹ, titi iwọ o fi run wọn tán.
entries.en: And he shall deliver their kings into thine hand, and thou shalt destroy their name from under heaven: there shall no man be able to stand before thee, until thou have destroyed them.

entries.yo: Ere finfin oriṣa wọn ni ki ẹnyin ki o fi iná jó: iwọ kò gbọdọ ṣe ojukokoro fadakà tabi wurà ti mbẹ lara wọn, bẹ̃ni ki o máṣe mú u fun ara rẹ, ki o má ba di idẹkùn fun ọ; nitoripe ohun irira ni si OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ:
entries.en: The graven images of their gods shall ye burn with fire: thou shalt not desire the silver or gold that is on them, nor take it unto thee, lest thou be snared therein: for it is an abomination to the LORD thy God.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni iwọ kò gbọdọ mú ohun irira wá sinu ile rẹ, ki iwọ ki o má ba di ẹni ifibú bi rẹ̀: ṣugbọn ki iwọ ki o korira rẹ̀ patapata, ki iwọ ki o si kà a si ohun irira patapata; nitoripe ohun ìyasọtọ ni.
entries.en: Neither shalt thou bring an abomination into thine house, lest thou be a cursed thing like it: but thou shalt utterly detest it, and thou shalt utterly abhor it; for it is a cursed thing.

entries.yo: GBOGBO ofin ti mo palaṣẹ fun ọ li oni, ni ki ẹnyin ma kiyesi lati ṣe, ki ẹnyin ki o le yè, ki ẹnyin si ma pọ̀ si i, ki ẹnyin si wọnu rẹ̀ lọ lati gbà ilẹ na ti OLUWA ti bura fun awọn baba nyin.
entries.en: All the commandments which I command thee this day shall ye observe to do, that ye may live, and multiply, and go in and possess the land which the LORD sware unto your fathers.

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o si ranti ọ̀na gbogbo ti OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ ti mu ọ rìn li aginjù lati ogoji ọdún yi wá, lati rẹ̀ ọ silẹ, ati lati dan ọ wò, lati mọ̀ ohun ti o wà li àiya rẹ, bi iwọ o pa ofin rẹ̀ mọ́, bi bẹ̃kọ.
entries.en: And thou shalt remember all the way which the LORD thy God led thee these forty years in the wilderness, to humble thee, and to prove thee, to know what was in thine heart, whether thou wouldest keep his commandments, or no.

entries.yo: O si rẹ̀ ọ silẹ, o si fi ebi pa ọ, o si fi manna bọ́ ọ, ti iwọ kò mọ̀, bẹ̃ni awọn baba rẹ kò mọ̀; ki o le mu ọ mọ̀ pe enia kò ti ipa onjẹ nikan wà lãye, bikoṣe nipa gbogbo ọ̀rọ ti o ti ẹnu OLUWA jade li enia wà lãye.
entries.en: And he humbled thee, and suffered thee to hunger, and fed thee with manna, which thou knewest not, neither did thy fathers know; that he might make thee know that man doth not live by bread only, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of the LORD doth man live.

entries.yo: Aṣọ rẹ kò gbó mọ́ ọ lara, bẹ̃li ẹsẹ̀ rẹ kò wú, lati ogoji ọdún yi wá.
entries.en: Thy raiment waxed not old upon thee, neither did thy foot swell, these forty years.

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o si mọ̀ li ọkàn rẹ pe, bi enia ti ibá ọmọ rẹ̀ wi, bẹ̃ni OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ bá ọ wi.
entries.en: Thou shalt also consider in thine heart, that, as a man chasteneth his son, so the LORD thy God chasteneth thee.

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o pa ofin OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ mọ́, lati ma rìn li ọ̀na rẹ̀, ati lati ma bẹ̀ru rẹ̀.
entries.en: Therefore thou shalt keep the commandments of the LORD thy God, to walk in his ways, and to fear him.

entries.yo: Nitori OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ mú ọ wá sinu ilẹ rere, ilẹ odò omi, ti orisun ati ti abẹ-ilẹ, ti nrú soke lati afonifoji ati òke jade wa;
entries.en: For the LORD thy God bringeth thee into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of fountains and depths that spring out of valleys and hills;

entries.yo: Ilẹ alikama ati ọkà-barle, ati àjara ati igi ọpọtọ ati igi pomegranate; ilẹ oróro olifi, ati oyin;
entries.en: A land of wheat, and barley, and vines, and fig trees, and pomegranates; a land of oil olive, and honey;

entries.yo: Ilẹ ninu eyiti iwọ ki o fi ìṣẹ jẹ onjẹ, iwọ ki yio fẹ ohun kan kù ninu rẹ̀; ilẹ ti okuta rẹ̀ iṣe irin, ati lati inu òke eyiti iwọ o ma wà idẹ.
entries.en: A land wherein thou shalt eat bread without scarceness, thou shalt not lack any thing in it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills thou mayest dig brass.

entries.yo: Nigbati iwọ ba si jẹun tán ti o si yo, nigbana ni iwọ o fi ibukún fun OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ, nitori ilẹ rere na ti o fi fun ọ.
entries.en: When thou hast eaten and art full, then thou shalt bless the LORD thy God for the good land which he hath given thee.

entries.yo: Ma kiyesara rẹ ki iwọ ki o má ṣe gbagbé OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ, li aipa ofin rẹ̀, ati idajọ rẹ̀, ati ìlana rẹ̀ mọ́, ti mo filelẹ li aṣẹ fun ọ li oni:
entries.en: Beware that thou forget not the LORD thy God, in not keeping his commandments, and his judgments, and his statutes, which I command thee this day:

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o má ba jẹ yó tán, ki o kọ ile daradara, ki o si ma gbé inu rẹ̀;
entries.en: Lest when thou hast eaten and art full, and hast built goodly houses, and dwelt therein;

entries.yo: Ati ki ọwọ́-ẹran rẹ ati agbo-ẹran rẹ, ki o ma ba pọ̀si i tán, ki fadakà rẹ ati wurà rẹ pọ̀si i, ati ki ohun gbogbo ti iwọ ní pọ̀si i;
entries.en: And when thy herds and thy flocks multiply, and thy silver and thy gold is multiplied, and all that thou hast is multiplied;

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ki ọkàn rẹ wa gbé soke, iwọ a si gbagbé OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ, ti o mú ọ lati ilẹ Egipti jade wá, kuro li oko-ẹrú;
entries.en: Then thine heart be lifted up, and thou forget the LORD thy God, which brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage;

entries.yo: Ẹniti o mu ọ rìn aginjù nla ti o si li ẹ̀ru, nibiti ejò amubina wà, ati akẽkẽ, ati ọdá, nibiti omi kò sí; ẹniti o mú omi jade fun ọ lati inu okuta akọ wá;
entries.en: Who led thee through that great and terrible wilderness, wherein were fiery serpents, and scorpions, and drought, where there was no water; who brought thee forth water out of the rock of flint;

entries.yo: Ẹniti o fi manna bọ́ ọ li aginjù, ti awọn baba rẹ kò mọ̀ rí; ki o le rẹ̀ ọ silẹ, ki o le dan ọ wò, lati ṣe ọ li ore nigbẹhin rẹ:
entries.en: Who fed thee in the wilderness with manna, which thy fathers knew not, that he might humble thee, and that he might prove thee, to do thee good at thy latter end;

entries.yo: Iwọ a si wi li ọkàn rẹ pe, Agbara mi ati ipa ọwọ́ mi li o fun mi li ọrọ̀ yi.
entries.en: And thou say in thine heart, My power and the might of mine hand hath gotten me this wealth.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ki iwọ ki o ranti OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ; nitoripe, on li o fun ọ li agbara lati lí ọrọ̀, ki on ki o le fi idi majẹmu rẹ̀ ti o bura fun awọn baba rẹ kalẹ, bi o ti ri li oni yi.
entries.en: But thou shalt remember the LORD thy God: for it is he that giveth thee power to get wealth, that he may establish his covenant which he sware unto thy fathers, as it is this day.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, bi iwọ ba gbagbe OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ, ti iwọ si tẹle ọlọrun miran, ti o si nsìn wọn, ti o si mbọ wọn, emi tẹnumọ́ ọ fun nyin pe, rirun li ẹnyin o run.
entries.en: And it shall be, if thou do at all forget the LORD thy God, and walk after other gods, and serve them, and worship them, I testify against you this day that ye shall surely perish.

entries.yo: Bi awọn orilẹ-ède ti OLUWA run kuro niwaju nyin, bẹ̃li ẹnyin o run; nitoripe ẹnyin ṣe àigbọran si ohùn OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin.
entries.en: As the nations which the LORD destroyeth before your face, so shall ye perish; because ye would not be obedient unto the voice of the LORD your God.

entries.yo: GBỌ́, Israeli: iwọ o gòke Jordani li oni, lati wọle lọ ìgba awọn orilẹ-ède ti o tobi ti o si lagbara jù ọ lọ, ilu ti o tobi, ti a mọdi rẹ̀ kàn ọrun,
entries.en: Hear, O Israel: Thou art to pass over Jordan this day, to go in to possess nations greater and mightier than thyself, cities great and fenced up to heaven,

entries.yo: Awọn enia ti o tobi ti o si sigbọnlẹ, awọn ọmọ Anaki, ti iwọ mọ̀, ti iwọ si gburó pe, Tali o le duro niwaju awọn ọmọ Anaki?
entries.en: A people great and tall, the children of the Anakims, whom thou knowest, and of whom thou hast heard say, Who can stand before the children of Anak!

entries.yo: Iwọ o si mọ̀ li oni pe, OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ on ni ngòke ṣaju rẹ lọ bi iná ajonirun; yio pa wọn run, on o si rẹ̀ wọn silẹ niwaju rẹ: iwọ o si lé wọn jade, iwọ o si pa wọn run kánkán, bi OLUWA ti wi fun ọ.
entries.en: Understand therefore this day, that the LORD thy God is he which goeth over before thee; as a consuming fire he shall destroy them, and he shall bring them down before thy face: so shalt thou drive them out, and destroy them quickly, as the LORD hath said unto thee.

entries.yo: Máṣe sọ li ọkàn rẹ, lẹhin igbati OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ ba tì wọn jade kuro niwaju rẹ, wipe, Nitori ododo mi ni OLUWA ṣe mú mi wá lati gbà ilẹ yi: ṣugbọn nitori ìwabuburu awọn orilẹ-ède wọnyi ni OLUWA ṣe lé wọn jade kuro niwaju rẹ.
entries.en: Speak not thou in thine heart, after that the LORD thy God hath cast them out from before thee, saying, For my righteousness the LORD hath brought me in to possess this land: but for the wickedness of these nations the LORD doth drive them out from before thee.

entries.yo: Ki iṣe nitori ododo rẹ, tabi nitori pipé ọkàn rẹ, ni iwọ fi nlọ lati gbà ilẹ wọn: ṣugbọn nitori ìwabuburu awọn orilẹ-ède wọnyi li OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ ṣe lé wọn kuro niwaju rẹ, ati ki o le mu ọ̀rọ na ṣẹ ti OLUWA ti bura fun awọn baba rẹ, Abrahamu, Isaaki, ati Jakobu.
entries.en: Not for thy righteousness, or for the uprightness of thine heart, dost thou go to possess their land: but for the wickedness of these nations the LORD thy God doth drive them out from before thee, and that he may perform the word which the LORD sware unto thy fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

entries.yo: Nitorina ki o yé ọ pe, OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ kò fi ilẹ rere yi fun ọ lati ní i nitori ododo rẹ; nitoripe enia ọlọrùn lile ni iwọ.
entries.en: Understand therefore, that the LORD thy God giveth thee not this good land to possess it for thy righteousness; for thou art a stiffnecked people.

entries.yo: Ranti, máṣe gbagbé, bi iwọ ti mu OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ binu li aginjù: lati ọjọ́ na ti iwọ ti jade kuro ni ilẹ Egipti, titi ẹnyin fi dé ihin yi, ẹnyin ti nṣọ̀tẹ si OLUWA.
entries.en: Remember, and forget not, how thou provokedst the LORD thy God to wrath in the wilderness: from the day that thou didst depart out of the land of Egypt, until ye came unto this place, ye have been rebellious against the LORD.

entries.yo: Ati ni Horebu ẹnyin mu OLUWA binu, OLUWA si binu si nyin tobẹ̃ ti o fẹ́ pa nyin run.
entries.en: Also in Horeb ye provoked the LORD to wrath, so that the LORD was angry with you to have destroyed you.

entries.yo: Nigbati mo gòke lọ sori òke lati gbà walã okuta wọnni, ani walã majẹmu nì ti OLUWA bá nyin dá, nigbana mo gbé ogoji ọsán, ati ogoji oru lori òke na, emi kò jẹ onjẹ, bẹ̃li emi kò mu omi.
entries.en: When I was gone up into the mount to receive the tables of stone, even the tables of the covenant which the LORD made with you, then I abode in the mount forty days and forty nights, I neither did eat bread nor drink water:

entries.yo: OLUWA si fi walã okuta meji fun mi, ti a fi ika Ọlọrun kọ; ati lara wọn li a kọ ọ gẹgẹ bi gbogbo ọ̀rọ na, ti OLUWA bá nyin sọ li òke na lati inu ãrin iná wá li ọjọ́ ajọ nì.
entries.en: And the LORD delivered unto me two tables of stone written with the finger of God; and on them was written according to all the words, which the LORD spake with you in the mount out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly.

entries.yo: O si ṣe li opin ogoji ọsán ati ogoji oru, ti OLUWA fi walã okuta meji nì fun mi, ani walã majẹmu nì.
entries.en: And it came to pass at the end of forty days and forty nights, that the LORD gave me the two tables of stone, even the tables of the covenant.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun mi pe, Dide, sọkalẹ kánkán lati ihin lọ; nitoriti awọn enia rẹ, ti iwọ mú lati ilẹ Egipti jade wá, ti bà ara wọn jẹ́; nwọn yipada kánkán kuro li ọ̀na ti mo palaṣẹ fun wọn; nwọn ti yá ere didà fun ara wọn.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto me, Arise, get thee down quickly from hence; for thy people which thou hast brought forth out of Egypt have corrupted themselves; they are quickly turned aside out of the way which I commanded them; they have made them a molten image.

entries.yo: OLUWA sọ fun mi pẹlu pe, Emi ti ri enia yi, si kiyesi i, enia ọlọrùn lile ni:
entries.en: Furthermore the LORD spake unto me, saying, I have seen this people, and, behold, it is a stiffnecked people:
