entries.yo: Yàgo fun mi, ki emi ki o pa wọn run, ki emi si pa orukọ wọn rẹ́ kuro labẹ ọrun: emi o si sọ iwọ di orilẹ-ède ti o lagbara ti o si pọ̀ jù wọn lọ.
entries.en: Let me alone, that I may destroy them, and blot out their name from under heaven: and I will make of thee a nation mightier and greater than they.

entries.yo: Emi si pada, mo si sọkalẹ lati ori òke nì wá, òke na si njóna: walã meji ti majẹmu nì si wà li ọwọ́ mi mejeji.
entries.en: So I turned and came down from the mount, and the mount burned with fire: and the two tables of the covenant were in my two hands.

entries.yo: Mo si wò, si kiyesi i, ẹnyin ti ṣẹ̀ si OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin, ẹnyin si ti yá ẹgbọrọ-malu didà fun ara nyin: ẹnyin ti yipada kánkán kuro li ọ̀na ti OLUWA ti palaṣẹ fun nyin.
entries.en: And I looked, and, behold, ye had sinned against the LORD your God, and had made you a molten calf: ye had turned aside quickly out of the way which the LORD had commanded you.

entries.yo: Emi si mú walã meji nì, mo si sọ wọn silẹ kuro li ọwọ́ mi mejeji, mo si fọ́ wọn niwaju nyin.
entries.en: And I took the two tables, and cast them out of my two hands, and brake them before your eyes.

entries.yo: Emi si wolẹ niwaju OLUWA bi ti iṣaju, li ogoji ọsán ati ogoji oru; emi kò jẹ onjẹ, bẹ̃ni emi kò mu omi; nitori gbogbo ẹ̀ṣẹ nyin ti ẹnyin ṣẹ̀, ni ṣiṣe buburu li oju OLUWA, lati mu u binu.
entries.en: And I fell down before the LORD, as at the first, forty days and forty nights: I did neither eat bread, nor drink water, because of all your sins which ye sinned, in doing wickedly in the sight of the LORD, to provoke him to anger.

entries.yo: Nitoriti emi bẹ̀ru ibinu ati irunu OLUWA si nyin lati pa nyin run. OLUWA si gbọ́ ti emi nigbana pẹlu.
entries.en: For I was afraid of the anger and hot displeasure, wherewith the LORD was wroth against you to destroy you. But the LORD hearkened unto me at that time also.

entries.yo: OLUWA si binu si Aaroni gidigidi ti iba fi pa a run: emi si gbadura fun Aaroni nigbana pẹlu.
entries.en: And the LORD was very angry with Aaron to have destroyed him: and I prayed for Aaron also the same time.

entries.yo: Emi si mú ẹ̀ṣẹ nyin, ẹgbọrọ-malu ti ẹnyin ṣe, mo si fi iná sun u, mo si gún u, mo si lọ̀ ọ kúnna, titi o fi dabi ekuru: mo si kó ekuru rẹ̀ lọ idà sinu odò ti o ti òke na ṣànwalẹ.
entries.en: And I took your sin, the calf which ye had made, and burnt it with fire, and stamped it, and ground it very small, even until it was as small as dust: and I cast the dust thereof into the brook that descended out of the mount.

entries.yo: Ati ni Tabera, ati ni Massa, ati ni Kibrotu-hattaafa, ẹnyin mu OLUWA binu.
entries.en: And at Taberah, and at Massah, and at Kibroth-hattaavah, ye provoked the LORD to wrath.

entries.yo: Nigbati OLUWA rán nyin lati Kadeṣi-barnea lọ, wipe, Gòke lọ ki o si gbà ilẹ na ti mo fi fun nyin; nigbana li ẹnyin ṣọ̀tẹ si aṣẹ OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin, ẹnyin kò si gbà a gbọ́, bẹ̃li ẹnyin kò si fetisi ohùn rẹ̀.
entries.en: Likewise when the LORD sent you from Kadesh-barnea, saying, Go up and possess the land which I have given you; then ye rebelled against the commandment of the LORD your God, and ye believed him not, nor hearkened to his voice.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin ti nṣọ̀tẹ si OLUWA lati ọjọ́ ti mo ti mọ̀ nyin.
entries.en: Ye have been rebellious against the LORD from the day that I knew you.

entries.yo: Mo si wolẹ niwaju OLUWA li ogoji ọsán ati li ogoji oru, bi mo ti wolẹ niṣaju; nitoriti OLUWA wipe, on o run nyin.
entries.en: Thus I fell down before the LORD forty days and forty nights, as I fell down at the first; because the LORD had said he would destroy you.

entries.yo: Mo si gbadura sọdọ OLUWA wipe, Oluwa ỌLỌRUN, máṣe run awọn enia rẹ ati iní rẹ, ti iwọ ti fi titobi rẹ̀ ràsilẹ, ti iwọ mú lati Egipti jade wá pẹlu ọwọ́ agbara.
entries.en: I prayed therefore unto the LORD, and said, O Lord GOD, destroy not thy people and thine inheritance, which thou hast redeemed through thy greatness, which thou hast brought forth out of Egypt with a mighty hand.

entries.yo: Ranti Abrahamu, Isaaki, ati Jakobu awọn iranṣẹ rẹ; máṣe wò agídi awọn enia yi, tabi ìwabuburu wọn, tabi ẹ̀ṣẹ wọn:
entries.en: Remember thy servants, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob; look not unto the stubbornness of this people, nor to their wickedness, nor to their sin:

entries.yo: Ki awọn enia ilẹ na ninu eyiti iwọ ti mú wa jade wá ki o má ba wipe, Nitoriti OLUWA kò le mú wọn dé ilẹ na ti o ti ṣe ileri fun wọn, ati nitoriti o korira wọn, li o ṣe mú wọn jade wá lati pa wọn li aginjù.
entries.en: Lest the land whence thou broughtest us out say, Because the LORD was not able to bring them into the land which he promised them, and because he hated them, he hath brought them out to slay them in the wilderness.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn sibẹ̀ enia rẹ ni nwọn iṣe, ati iní rẹ, ti iwọ mú jade nipa agbara nla rẹ, ati nipa ninà apa rẹ.
entries.en: Yet they are thy people and thine inheritance, which thou broughtest out by thy mighty power and by thy stretched out arm.

entries.yo: NIGBANA li OLUWA wi fun mi pe, Gbẹ́ walã okuta meji bi ti iṣaju, ki o si tọ̀ mi wá lori òke na, ki o si ṣe apoti igi kan.
entries.en: At that time the LORD said unto me, Hew thee two tables of stone like unto the first, and come up unto me into the mount, and make thee an ark of wood.

entries.yo: Emi o si kọ ọ̀rọ ti o ti wà lara walã iṣaju ti iwọ fọ́, sara walã wọnyi, iwọ o si fi wọn sinu apoti na.
entries.en: And I will write on the tables the words that were in the first tables which thou brakest, and thou shalt put them in the ark.

entries.yo: Emi si ṣe apoti igi ṣittimu kan, mo si gbẹ́ walã okuta meji bi ti isaju, mo si lọ sori òke na, walã mejeji si wà li ọwọ́ mi.
entries.en: And I made an ark of shittim wood, and hewed two tables of stone like unto the first, and went up into the mount, having the two tables in mine hand.

entries.yo: On si kọ ofin mẹwẹwa sara walã wọnni, gẹgẹ bi o ti kọ ti iṣaju, ti OLUWA sọ fun nyin lori òke na lati inu ãrin iná wá li ọjọ́ ajọ nì; OLUWA si fi wọn fun mi.
entries.en: And he wrote on the tables, according to the first writing, the ten commandments, which the LORD spake unto you in the mount out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly: and the LORD gave them unto me.

entries.yo: Mo si pada, mo si sọkalẹ lati ori òke na wá, mo si fi walã wọnni sinu apoti ti mo ti ṣe; nwọn si wà nibẹ̀, bi OLUWA ti paṣẹ fun mi.
entries.en: And I turned myself and came down from the mount, and put the tables in the ark which I had made; and there they be, as the LORD commanded me.

entries.yo: (Awọn ọmọ Israeli si dide ìrin wọn lati Beerotu ti iṣe ti awọn ọmọ Jaakani lọ si Mosera: nibẹ̀ li Aaroni gbé kú, nibẹ̀ li a si sin i; Eleasari ọmọ rẹ̀ si nṣe iṣẹ alufa ni ipò rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the children of Israel took their journey from Beeroth of the children of Jaakan to Mosera: there Aaron died, and there he was buried; and Eleazar his son ministered in the priest's office in his stead.

entries.yo: Lati ibẹ̀ nwọn si lọ si Gudgoda; ati lati Gudgoda lọ si Jotbati, ilẹ olodò omi.
entries.en: From thence they journeyed unto Gudgodah; and from Gudgodah to Jotbath, a land of rivers of waters.

entries.yo: Nigbana li OLUWA yà ẹ̀ya Lefi sọ̀tọ, lati ma rù apoti majẹmu OLUWA, lati ma duro niwaju OLUWA lati ma ṣe iranṣẹ fun u, ati lati ma sure li orukọ rẹ̀, titi di oni yi.
entries.en: At that time the LORD separated the tribe of Levi, to bear the ark of the covenant of the LORD, to stand before the LORD to minister unto him, and to bless in his name, unto this day.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni Lefi kò ṣe ní ipín tabi iní pẹlu awọn arakunrin rẹ̀; OLUWA ni iní rẹ̀, gẹgẹ bi OLUWA Ọlọrun ti ṣe ileri fun u.)
entries.en: Wherefore Levi hath no part nor inheritance with his brethren; the LORD is his inheritance, according as the LORD thy God promised him.

entries.yo: Emi si duro lori òke na, gẹgẹ bi ìgba iṣaju, li ogoji ọsán ati ogoji oru: OLUWA si gbọ́ ti emi ni igbana pẹlu, OLUWA kò si fẹ́ run ọ.
entries.en: And I stayed in the mount, according to the first time, forty days and forty nights; and the LORD hearkened unto me at that time also, and the LORD would not destroy thee.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun mi pe, Dide, mú ọ̀na ìrin rẹ niwaju awọn enia, ki nwọn ki o le wọ̀ inu rẹ̀ lọ, ki nwọn ki o le gbà ilẹ na, ti mo ti bura fun awọn baba wọn lati fi fun wọn.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto me, Arise, take thy journey before the people, that they may go in and possess the land, which I sware unto their fathers to give unto them.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, Israeli, kini OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ mbère lọdọ rẹ, bikoṣe lati ma bẹ̀ru OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ, lati ma rìn li ọ̀na rẹ̀ gbogbo, lati ma fẹ́ ẹ, ati lati ma sìn OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ pẹlu àiya rẹ gbogbo, ati pẹlu ọkàn rẹ gbogbo,
entries.en: And now, Israel, what doth the LORD thy God require of thee, but to fear the LORD thy God, to walk in all his ways, and to love him, and to serve the LORD thy God with all thy heart and with all thy soul,

entries.yo: Lati ma pa ofin OLUWA mọ́, ati ìlana rẹ̀, ti mo filelẹ fun ọ li aṣẹ li oni, fun ire rẹ?
entries.en: To keep the commandments of the LORD, and his statutes, which I command thee this day for thy good?

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, ti OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ li ọrun, ati ọrun dé ọrun, aiye pẹlu, ti on ti ohun gbogbo ti mbẹ ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: Behold, the heaven and the heaven of heavens is the LORD's thy God, the earth also, with all that therein is.

entries.yo: Kìki OLUWA ni inudidùn si awọn baba rẹ lati fẹ́ wọn, on si yàn irú-ọmọ wọn lẹhin wọn, ani ẹnyin jù gbogbo enia lọ, bi o ti ri li oni yi.
entries.en: Only the LORD had a delight in thy fathers to love them, and he chose their seed after them, even you above all people, as it is this day.

entries.yo: Nitorina ẹ kọ àiya nyin nilà, ki ẹ má si ṣe ọlọrùn lile mọ́.
entries.en: Circumcise therefore the foreskin of your heart, and be no more stiffnecked.

entries.yo: Nitori OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin, Ọlọrun awọn ọlọrun ni ati OLUWA awọn oluwa, Ọlọrun titobi, alagbara, ati ẹ̀lẹru, ti ki iṣe ojuṣaju, bẹ̃ni ki igba abẹtẹlẹ.
entries.en: For the LORD your God is God of gods, and Lord of lords, a great God, a mighty, and a terrible, which regardeth not persons, nor taketh reward:

entries.yo: On ni ima ṣe idajọ alainibaba ati opó, o si fẹ́ alejò, lati fun u li onjẹ ati aṣọ.
entries.en: He doth execute the judgment of the fatherless and widow, and loveth the stranger, in giving him food and raiment.

entries.yo: Nitorina ki ẹnyin ki o ma fẹ́ alejò: nitoripe ẹnyin ṣe alejò ni ilẹ Egipti.
entries.en: Love ye therefore the stranger: for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o ma bẹ̀ru OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ; on ni ki iwọ ki o ma sìn, on ni ki iwọ ki o si faramọ́, orukọ rẹ̀ ni ki o si ma fi bura.
entries.en: Thou shalt fear the LORD thy God; him shalt thou serve, and to him shalt thou cleave, and swear by his name.

entries.yo: On ni iyìn rẹ, on si li Ọlọrun rẹ, ti o ṣe ohun nla ati ohun ẹ̀lẹru wọnni fun ọ, ti oju rẹ ri.
entries.en: He is thy praise, and he is thy God, that hath done for thee these great and terrible things, which thine eyes have seen.

entries.yo: Awọn baba rẹ sọkalẹ lọ si Egipti ti awọn ti ãdọrin enia; ṣugbọn nisisiyi OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ sọ ọ dabi irawọ ọrun li ọ̀pọlọpọ.
entries.en: Thy fathers went down into Egypt with threescore and ten persons; and now the LORD thy God hath made thee as the stars of heaven for multitude.

entries.yo: NITORINA ki iwọ ki o fẹ́ OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ, ki o si ma pa ikilọ̀ rẹ̀, ati ìlana rẹ̀, ati idajọ rẹ̀, ati ofin rẹ̀ mọ́, nigbagbogbo.
entries.en: Therefore thou shalt love the LORD thy God, and keep his charge, and his statutes, and his judgments, and his commandments, alway.

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o si mọ̀ li oni: nitoripe awọn ọmọ nyin ti emi nsọ fun ti kò mọ̀, ti kò si ri ibawi OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin, titobi rẹ̀, ọwọ́ agbara rẹ̀, ati ninà apa rẹ̀,
entries.en: And know ye this day: for I speak not with your children which have not known, and which have not seen the chastisement of the LORD your God, his greatness, his mighty hand, and his stretched out arm,

entries.yo: Ati iṣẹ-àmi rẹ̀, ati iṣẹ rẹ̀, ti o ṣe lãrin Egipti, si Farao ọba Egipti, ati si gbogbo ilẹ rẹ̀;
entries.en: And his miracles, and his acts, which he did in the midst of Egypt unto Pharaoh the king of Egypt, and unto all his land;

entries.yo: Ati ohun ti o ṣe si ogun Egipti, si ẹṣin wọn, ati kẹkẹ́-ogun wọn; bi o ti mu ki omi Okun Pupa bò wọn mọlẹ bi nwọn ti nlepa nyin lọ, ati bi OLUWA ti run wọn titi di oni-oloni;
entries.en: And what he did unto the army of Egypt, unto their horses, and to their chariots; how he made the water of the Red sea to overflow them as they pursued after you, and how the LORD hath destroyed them unto this day;

entries.yo: Ati bi o ti ṣe si nyin li aginjù, titi ẹnyin fi dé ihin yi;
entries.en: And what he did unto you in the wilderness, until ye came into this place;

entries.yo: Ati bi o ti ṣe si Datani ati Abiramu, awọn ọmọ Eliabu, ọmọ Reubeni; bi ilẹ ti yà ẹnu rẹ̀, ti o si gbe wọn mì, ati ara ile wọn, ati agọ́ wọn, ati ohun alãye gbogbo ti o tẹle wọn, lãrin gbogbo Israeli:
entries.en: And what he did unto Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, the son of Reuben: how the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up, and their households, and their tents, and all the substance that was in their possession, in the midst of all Israel:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn oju nyin ti ri gbogbo iṣẹ nla OLUWA ti o ṣe.
entries.en: But your eyes have seen all the great acts of the LORD which he did.

entries.yo: Nitorina ki ẹnyin ki o pa gbogbo ofin mọ́ ti mo filelẹ li aṣẹ fun nyin li oni, ki ẹnyin ki o le lagbara, ki ẹnyin ki o si wọ̀ inu rẹ̀ lọ, ki ẹ si gbà ilẹ na, nibiti ẹnyin nlọ lati gbà a;
entries.en: Therefore shall ye keep all the commandments which I command you this day, that ye may be strong, and go in and possess the land, whither ye go to possess it;

entries.yo: Ati ki ẹnyin ki o le mu ọjọ́ nyin pẹ ni ilẹ na, ti OLUWA ti bura fun awọn baba nyin, lati fi fun wọn ati fun irú-ọmọ wọn, ilẹ ti nṣàn fun warà ati fun oyin.
entries.en: And that ye may prolong your days in the land, which the LORD sware unto your fathers to give unto them and to their seed, a land that floweth with milk and honey.

entries.yo: Nitoripe ilẹ na, nibiti iwọ nlọ lati gbà a, kò dabi ilẹ Egipti, nibiti ẹnyin ti jade wá, nibiti iwọ gbìn irugbìn rẹ, ti iwọ si nfi ẹsẹ̀ rẹ bomirin i, bi ọgbà ewebẹ̀:
entries.en: For the land, whither thou goest in to possess it, is not as the land of Egypt, from whence ye came out, where thou sowedst thy seed, and wateredst it with thy foot, as a garden of herbs:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ilẹ na, nibiti ẹnyin nlọ lati gbà a, ilẹ òke ati afonifoji ni, ti o si nmu omi òjo ọrun:
entries.en: But the land, whither ye go to possess it, is a land of hills and valleys, and drinketh water of the rain of heaven:

entries.yo: Ilẹ ti OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ nṣe itọju; oju OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ mbẹ lara rẹ̀ nigbagbogbo, lati ìbẹrẹ ọdún dé opin ọdún.
entries.en: A land which the LORD thy God careth for: the eyes of the LORD thy God are always upon it, from the beginning of the year even unto the end of the year.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, bi ẹnyin ba fetisi ofin mi daradara, ti mo filelẹ li aṣẹ fun nyin li oni, lati ma fẹ́ OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin, ati lati ma sìn i pẹlu àiya nyin gbogbo, ati pẹlu ọkàn nyin gbogbo,
entries.en: And it shall come to pass, if ye shall hearken diligently unto my commandments which I command you this day, to love the LORD your God, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul,

entries.yo: Nigbana li emi o ma fun nyin li òjo ilẹ nyin li akokò rẹ̀, òjo akọ́rọ̀ ati òjo àrọkuro, ki iwọ ki o le ma kó ọkà rẹ, ati ọti-waini rẹ, ati oróro rẹ sinu ile.
entries.en: That I will give you the rain of your land in his due season, the first rain and the latter rain, that thou mayest gather in thy corn, and thy wine, and thine oil.

entries.yo: Emi o si fi koriko sinu pápa rẹ fun ohunọ̀sin rẹ, ki iwọ ki o le jẹun ki o si yó.
entries.en: And I will send grass in thy fields for thy cattle, that thou mayest eat and be full.

entries.yo: Ẹ ma ṣọ́ ara nyin, ki a má ba tàn àiya nyin jẹ, ki ẹ má si ṣe yapa, ki ẹ si sìn ọlọrun miran, ki ẹ si ma bọ wọn;
entries.en: Take heed to yourselves, that your heart be not deceived, and ye turn aside, and serve other gods, and worship them;

entries.yo: Ibinu OLUWA a si rú si nyin, on a si sé ọrun, ki òjo ki o má ba sí, ati ki ilẹ ki o má ba so eso rẹ̀; ẹnyin a si run kánkán kuro ni ilẹ rere na ti OLUWA fi fun nyin.
entries.en: And then the LORD's wrath be kindled against you, and he shut up the heaven, that there be no rain, and that the land yield not her fruit; and lest ye perish quickly from off the good land which the LORD giveth you.

entries.yo: Ẹ fi ọ̀rọ mi wọnyi si àiya nyin ati si ọkàn nyin, ki ẹ si so wọn mọ́ ọwọ́ nyin fun àmi, ki nwọn ki o si ma ṣe ọjá-igbaju niwaju nyin.
entries.en: Therefore shall ye lay up these my words in your heart and in your soul, and bind them for a sign upon your hand, that they may be as frontlets between your eyes.

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o si ma fi wọn kọ́ awọn ọmọ nyin, ki ẹnyin ma fi wọn ṣe ọ̀rọ isọ nigbati iwọ ba joko ninu ile rẹ, ati nigbati iwọ ba nrìn li ọ̀na, nigbati iwọ ba dubulẹ, ati nigbati iwọ ba dide.
entries.en: And ye shall teach them your children, speaking of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o si kọ wọn sara opó ile rẹ, ati sara ilẹkun-ọ̀na-ode rẹ:
entries.en: And thou shalt write them upon the door posts of thine house, and upon thy gates:

entries.yo: Ki ọjọ́ nyin ki o le ma pọ̀si i, ati ọjọ́ awọn ọmọ nyin, ni ilẹ na ti OLUWA bura fun awọn baba nyin lati fi fun wọn, bi ọjọ́ ọrun lori ilẹ aiye.
entries.en: That your days may be multiplied, and the days of your children, in the land which the LORD sware unto your fathers to give them, as the days of heaven upon the earth.

entries.yo: Nitoripe bi ẹnyin ba pa gbogbo ofin yi mọ́ gidigidi, ti mo palaṣẹ fun nyin, lati ma ṣe e; lati ma fẹ́ OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin, lati ma rìn ni gbogbo ọ̀na rẹ̀, ati lati faramọ́ ọ;
entries.en: For if ye shall diligently keep all these commandments which I command you, to do them, to love the LORD your God, to walk in all his ways, and to cleave unto him;

entries.yo: Nigbana ni OLUWA yio lé gbogbo awọn orilẹ-ède wọnyi jade kuro niwaju nyin, ẹnyin o si gbà orilẹ-ède ti o tobi ti o si lagbara jù nyin lọ.
entries.en: Then will the LORD drive out all these nations from before you, and ye shall possess greater nations and mightier than yourselves.

entries.yo: Ibi gbogbo ti atẹlẹsẹ̀ nyin ba tẹ̀ yio jẹ́ ti nyin: lati aginjù nì, ati Lebanoni, lati odò nla nì, odò Euferate, ani dé ikẹhin okun ni yio jẹ́ opinlẹ nyin.
entries.en: Every place whereon the soles of your feet shall tread shall be yours: from the wilderness and Lebanon, from the river, the river Euphrates, even unto the uttermost sea shall your coast be.

entries.yo: Kò sí ọkunrin kan ti yio le duro niwaju nyin: OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin, yio fi ìbẹru nyin ati ìfoiya nyin sara gbogbo ilẹ ti ẹnyin o tẹ̀, bi on ti wi fun nyin.
entries.en: There shall no man be able to stand before you: for the LORD your God shall lay the fear of you and the dread of you upon all the land that ye shall tread upon, as he hath said unto you.

entries.yo: Wò o, emi fi ibukún ati egún siwaju nyin li oni;
entries.en: Behold, I set before you this day a blessing and a curse;

entries.yo: Ibukún, bi ẹnyin ba gbà ofin OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin gbọ́, ti mo palaṣẹ fun nyin li oni:
entries.en: A blessing, if ye obey the commandments of the LORD your God, which I command you this day:

entries.yo: Ati egún, bi ẹnyin kò ba gbà ofin OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin gbọ́ ti ẹnyin ba si yipada kuro li ọ̀na ti mo palaṣẹ fun nyin li oni, lati ma tọ̀ ọlọrun miran lẹhin, ti ẹnyin kò mọ̀ rí.
entries.en: And a curse, if ye will not obey the commandments of the LORD your God, but turn aside out of the way which I command you this day, to go after other gods, which ye have not known.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, nigbati OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ ba mú ọ dé ilẹ na, nibiti iwọ nlọ lati gbà a, ki iwọ ki o ma sure lori òke Gerisimu, ki iwọ ki o si ma gegun lori òke Ebali.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass, when the LORD thy God hath brought thee in unto the land whither thou goest to possess it, that thou shalt put the blessing upon mount Gerizim, and the curse upon mount Ebal.

entries.yo: Awọn kọ ha wà ni ìha keji Jordani, li ọ̀na ìwọ-õrùn, ni ilẹ awọn ara Kenaani, ti ngbé Araba ti o kọjusi Gilgali, lẹba igbó More?
entries.en: Are they not on the other side Jordan, by the way where the sun goeth down, in the land of the Canaanites, which dwell in the champaign over against Gilgal, beside the plains of Moreh?

entries.yo: Nitoripe ẹnyin o gòke Jordani lati wọle ati lati gbà ilẹ na, ti OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin fi fun nyin, ẹnyin o si gbà a, ẹnyin o si ma gbé inu rẹ̀.
entries.en: For ye shall pass over Jordan to go in to possess the land which the LORD your God giveth you, and ye shall possess it, and dwell therein.

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o si ma kiyesi ati ma ṣe gbogbo ìlana ati idajọ wọnni, ti mo fi siwaju nyin li oni.
entries.en: And ye shall observe to do all the statutes and judgments which I set before you this day.

entries.yo: WỌNYI ni ìlana ati idajọ, ti ẹnyin o ma kiyesi lati ma ṣe ni ilẹ na ti OLUWA, Ọlọrun awọn baba rẹ fi fun ọ lati ní, ni gbogbo ọjọ́ ti ẹnyin o wà lori ilẹ-aiye.
entries.en: These are the statutes and judgments, which ye shall observe to do in the land, which the LORD God of thy fathers giveth thee to possess it, all the days that ye live upon the earth.

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o run ibi gbogbo wọnni patapata, nibiti awọn orilẹ-ède nì, ti ẹnyin o gbà, nsìn oriṣa wọn, lori òke giga, ati lori òke kekeké, ati labẹ igi tutù gbogbo:
entries.en: Ye shall utterly destroy all the places, wherein the nations which ye shall possess served their gods, upon the high mountains, and upon the hills, and under every green tree:

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o si wó pẹpẹ wọn, ki ẹ si bì ọwọ̀n wọn ṣubu, ki ẹ si fi iná kun igbo oriṣa wọn; ki ẹnyin ki o si ke ere fifin wọn lulẹ, ki ẹ si run orukọ wọn kuro ni ibẹ na.
entries.en: And ye shall overthrow their altars, and break their pillars, and burn their groves with fire; and ye shall hew down the graven images of their gods, and destroy the names of them out of that place.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin kò gbọdọ ṣe bẹ̃ si OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin.
entries.en: Ye shall not do so unto the LORD your God.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ibi ti OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin yio yàn ninu gbogbo ẹ̀ya nyin lati fi orukọ rẹ̀ si, ani ibujoko rẹ̀ li ẹnyin o ma wálọ, ati nibẹ̀ ni ki iwọ ki o ma wá:
entries.en: But unto the place which the LORD your God shall choose out of all your tribes to put his name there, even unto his habitation shall ye seek, and thither thou shalt come:

entries.yo: Nibẹ̀ ni ki ẹnyin ki o ma mú ẹbọ sisun nyin wá, ati ẹbọ nyin, ati idamẹwa nyin, ati ẹbọ igbesọsoke ọwọ́ nyin, ati ẹjẹ́ nyin, ati ẹbọ ifẹ́-atinuwa nyin, ati akọ́bi ọwọ́-ẹran nyin ati ti agbo-ẹran nyin:
entries.en: And thither ye shall bring your burnt offerings, and your sacrifices, and your tithes, and heave offerings of your hand, and your vows, and your freewill offerings, and the firstlings of your herds and of your flocks:

entries.yo: Nibẹ̀ ni ki ẹnyin ki o si ma jẹ niwaju OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin, ki ẹnyin ki o si ma yọ̀ ninu ohun gbogbo ti ẹnyin fi ọwọ́ nyin lé, ẹnyin ati awọn ara ile nyin, ninu eyiti OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ fi bukún u fun ọ.
entries.en: And there ye shall eat before the LORD your God, and ye shall rejoice in all that ye put your hand unto, ye and your households, wherein the LORD thy God hath blessed thee.

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o máṣe ṣe gẹgẹ bi gbogbo ohun ti awa nṣe nihin li oni, olukuluku enia ohun ti o tọ́ li oju ara rẹ̀:
entries.en: Ye shall not do after all the things that we do here this day, every man whatsoever is right in his own eyes.

entries.yo: Nitoripe ẹnyin kò sá ti idé ibi-isimi, ati ilẹ iní, ti OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin fi fun nyin.
entries.en: For ye are not as yet come to the rest and to the inheritance, which the LORD your God giveth you.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati ẹnyin ba gòke Jordani, ti ẹnyin si joko ni ilẹ na ti OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin fi fun nyin ni iní, ti o ba si fun nyin ni isimi kuro lọwọ awọn ọtá nyin gbogbo yiká, ti ẹnyin si joko li alafia:
entries.en: But when ye go over Jordan, and dwell in the land which the LORD your God giveth you to inherit, and when he giveth you rest from all your enemies round about, so that ye dwell in safety;

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ibikan yio wà ti OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin yio yàn lati fi orukọ rẹ̀ si, nibẹ̀ li ẹnyin o ma mú gbogbo ohun ti mo palaṣẹ fun nyin wá; ẹbọ sisun nyin, ati ẹbọ nyin, idamẹwa nyin, ati ẹbọ igbesọsoke ọwọ́ nyin, ati gbogbo àṣayan ẹjẹ́ nyin ti ẹnyin jẹ́ fun OLUWA.
entries.en: Then there shall be a place which the LORD your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell there; thither shall ye bring all that I command you; your burnt offerings, and your sacrifices, your tithes, and the heave offering of your hand, and all your choice vows which ye vow unto the LORD:

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o si ma yọ̀ niwaju OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin, ẹnyin, ati awọn ọmọ nyin ọkunrin, ati awọn ọmọ nyin obinrin, ati awọn ọmọ-ọdọ nyin ọkunrin, ati awọn ọmọ-ọdọ nyin obinrin, ati ọmọ Lefi ti mbẹ ninu ibode nyin, nitori on kò ní ipín tabi iní pẹlu nyin.
entries.en: And ye shall rejoice before the LORD your God, ye, and your sons, and your daughters, and your menservants, and your maidservants, and the Levite that is within your gates; forasmuch as he hath no part nor inheritance with you.

entries.yo: Ma ṣọ́ ara rẹ ki iwọ ki o máṣe ru ẹbọ sisun rẹ ni ibi gbogbo ti iwọ ba ri:
entries.en: Take heed to thyself that thou offer not thy burnt offerings in every place that thou seest:

entries.yo: Bikoṣe ni ibi ti OLUWA yio yàn ninu ọkan ninu awọn ẹ̀ya rẹ, nibẹ̀ ni ki iwọ ki o ma ru ẹbọ sisun rẹ, nibẹ̀ ni ki iwọ ki o si ma ṣe ohun gbogbo ti mo palaṣẹ fun ọ.
entries.en: But in the place which the LORD shall choose in one of thy tribes, there thou shalt offer thy burnt offerings, and there thou shalt do all that I command thee.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ki iwọ ki o ma pa, ki o si ma jẹ ẹran ninu ibode rẹ gbogbo, ohunkohun ti ọkàn rẹ ba fẹ́, gẹgẹ bi ibukún OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ ti o fi fun ọ: alaimọ́ ati ẹni mimọ́ ni ki o ma jẹ ninu rẹ̀, bi esuro, ati bi agbọnrin.
entries.en: Notwithstanding thou mayest kill and eat flesh in all thy gates, whatsoever thy soul lusteth after, according to the blessing of the LORD thy God which he hath given thee: the unclean and the clean may eat thereof, as of the roebuck, and as of the hart.

entries.yo: Kìki ẹ̀jẹ li ẹnyin kò gbọdọ jẹ; lori ilẹ ni ki ẹ dà a si bi omi.
entries.en: Only ye shall not eat the blood; ye shall pour it upon the earth as water.

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o máṣe jẹ idamẹwa ọkà rẹ ninu ibode rẹ, tabi ti ọti-waini rẹ, tabi ti oróro rẹ, tabi ti akọ́bi ọwọ́-ẹran rẹ, tabi ti agbo-ẹran rẹ, tabi ti ẹjẹ́ rẹ ti iwọ jẹ́, tabi ẹbọ ifẹ́-atinuwa rẹ, tabi ẹbọ igbesọsoke ọwọ́ rẹ:
entries.en: Thou mayest not eat within thy gates the tithe of thy corn, or of thy wine, or of thy oil, or the firstlings of thy herds or of thy flock, nor any of thy vows which thou vowest, nor thy freewill offerings, or heave offering of thine hand:

entries.yo: Bikoṣe ki iwọ ki o jẹ wọn niwaju OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ, ni ibi ti OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ yio gbé yàn, iwọ, ati ọmọ rẹ ọkunrin, ati ọmọ rẹ obinrin, ati ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ ọkunrin, ati ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ obinrin, ati ọmọ Lefi ti mbẹ ninu ibode rẹ: ki iwọ ki o si ma yọ̀ niwaju OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ ninu ohun gbogbo ti iwọ fi ọwọ́ rẹ le.
entries.en: But thou must eat them before the LORD thy God in the place which the LORD thy God shall choose, thou, and thy son, and thy daughter, and thy manservant, and thy maidservant, and the Levite that is within thy gates: and thou shalt rejoice before the LORD thy God in all that thou puttest thine hands unto.

entries.yo: Ma ṣọ́ ara rẹ ki iwọ ki o máṣe kọ̀ ọmọ Lefi silẹ ni gbogbo ọjọ́ rẹ lori ilẹ.
entries.en: Take heed to thyself that thou forsake not the Levite as long as thou livest upon the earth.

entries.yo: Nigbati OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ ba sọ àgbegbe rẹ di nla, bi on ti ṣe ileri fun ọ, ti iwọ ba si wipe, Emi o jẹ ẹran, nitoriti ọkàn rẹ nfẹ́ ẹran ijẹ; ki iwọ ki o ma jẹ ẹran, ohunkohun ti ọkàn rẹ ba nfẹ́.
entries.en: When the LORD thy God shall enlarge thy border, as he hath promised thee, and thou shalt say, I will eat flesh, because thy soul longeth to eat flesh; thou mayest eat flesh, whatsoever thy soul lusteth after.

entries.yo: Bi o ba ṣepe, ibi ti OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ ba yàn, lati fi orukọ rẹ̀ si, ba jìna jù fun ọ, njẹ ki iwọ ki o pa ninu ọwọ́-ẹran rẹ ati ninu agbo-ẹran rẹ, ti OLUWA fi fun ọ, bi emi ti fi aṣẹ fun o, ki iwọ ki o si ma jẹ ohunkohun ti ọkàn rẹ ba fẹ́ ninu ibode rẹ.
entries.en: If the place which the LORD thy God hath chosen to put his name there be too far from thee, then thou shalt kill of thy herd and of thy flock, which the LORD hath given thee, as I have commanded thee, and thou shalt eat in thy gates whatsoever thy soul lusteth after.

entries.yo: Ani bi ã ti ijẹ esuro, ati agbọnrin, bẹ̃ni ki iwọ ki o ma jẹ wọn: alaimọ́ ati ẹni mimọ́ yio jẹ ninu wọn bakanna.
entries.en: Even as the roebuck and the hart is eaten, so thou shalt eat them: the unclean and the clean shall eat of them alike.

entries.yo: Kìki ki o ṣọ́ ara rẹ gidigidi ki iwọ ki o máṣe jẹ ẹ̀jẹ: nitoripe ẹ̀jẹ li ẹmi; iwọ kò si gbọdọ jẹ ẹmi pẹlu ẹran.
entries.en: Only be sure that thou eat not the blood: for the blood is the life; and thou mayest not eat the life with the flesh.

entries.yo: Iwọ kò gbọdọ jẹ ẹ; iwọ o dà a silẹ bi omi.
entries.en: Thou shalt not eat it; thou shalt pour it upon the earth as water.

entries.yo: Iwọ kò gbọdọ jẹ ẹ; ki o le ma dara fun ọ, ati fun awọn ọmọ rẹ lẹhin rẹ, nigbati iwọ ba nṣe eyiti o tọ́ li oju OLUWA.
entries.en: Thou shalt not eat it; that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee, when thou shalt do that which is right in the sight of the LORD.

entries.yo: Kìki ohun mimọ́ rẹ ti iwọ ní, ati ẹjẹ́ rẹ ni ki iwọ ki o mú, ki o si lọ si ibi ti OLUWA yio yàn:
entries.en: Only thy holy things which thou hast, and thy vows, thou shalt take, and go unto the place which the LORD shall choose:

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o si ma ru ẹbọ sisun rẹ, ẹran ati ẹ̀jẹ na, lori pẹpẹ OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ: ati ẹ̀jẹ ẹbọ rẹ ni ki a dà sori pẹpẹ OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ, ki iwọ ki o si ma jẹ ẹran na.
entries.en: And thou shalt offer thy burnt offerings, the flesh and the blood, upon the altar of the LORD thy God: and the blood of thy sacrifices shall be poured out upon the altar of the LORD thy God, and thou shalt eat the flesh.

entries.yo: Kiyesara ki o si ma gbọ́ gbogbo ọ̀rọ wọnyi ti mo palaṣẹ fun ọ, ki o le dara fun ọ, ati fun awọn ọmọ rẹ lẹhin rẹ lailai, nigbati iwọ ba ṣe eyiti o dara ti o si tọ́ li oju OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ.
entries.en: Observe and hear all these words which I command thee, that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee for ever, when thou doest that which is good and right in the sight of the LORD thy God.

entries.yo: Nigbati OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ ba ke awọn orilẹ-ède wọnni kuro niwaju rẹ, nibiti iwọ gbé nlọ lati gbà wọn, ti iwọ si rọpò wọn, ti iwọ si joko ni ilẹ wọn;
entries.en: When the LORD thy God shall cut off the nations from before thee, whither thou goest to possess them, and thou succeedest them, and dwellest in their land;

entries.yo: Ma ṣọ́ ara rẹ ki iwọ má ba bọ́ si idẹkùn ati tẹle wọn lẹhin, lẹhin igbati a ti run wọn kuro niwaju rẹ; ki iwọ ki o má si bère oriṣa wọn, wipe, Bawo li awọn orilẹ-ède wọnyi ti nsìn oriṣa wọn? emi o si ṣe bẹ̃ pẹlu.
entries.en: Take heed to thyself that thou be not snared by following them, after that they be destroyed from before thee; and that thou inquire not after their gods, saying, How did these nations serve their gods? even so will I do likewise.

entries.yo: Iwọ kò gbọdọ ṣe bẹ̃ si OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ; nitoripe gbogbo ohun irira si OLUWA, ti on korira ni nwọn ti nṣe si awọn oriṣa wọn; nitoripe awọn ọmọkunrin, ati awọn ọmọbinrin wọn pẹlu ni nwọn nsun ninu iná fun oriṣa wọn.
entries.en: Thou shalt not do so unto the LORD thy God: for every abomination to the LORD, which he hateth, have they done unto their gods; for even their sons and their daughters they have burnt in the fire to their gods.

entries.yo: Ohunkohun ti mo filelẹ li aṣẹ fun nyin, ẹ ma kiyesi lati ṣe e: iwọ kò gbọdọ fikún u, bẹ̃ni iwọ kò gbọdọ bù kuro ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: What thing soever I command you, observe to do it: thou shalt not add thereto, nor diminish from it.

entries.yo: BI wolĩ kan ba hù lãrin rẹ, tabi alalá kan, ti o si fi àmi tabi iṣẹ́-iyanu kan hàn ọ,
entries.en: If there arise among you a prophet, or a dreamer of dreams, and giveth thee a sign or a wonder,

entries.yo: Ti àmi na tabi iṣẹ-iyanu na ti o sọ fun ọ ba ṣẹ, wipe, Ẹ jẹ ki a tẹlé ọlọrun miran lẹhin, ti iwọ kò ti mọ̀ rí, ki a si ma sìn wọn;
entries.en: And the sign or the wonder come to pass, whereof he spake unto thee, saying, Let us go after other gods, which thou hast not known, and let us serve them;

entries.yo: Iwọ kò gbọdọ fetisi ọ̀rọ wolĩ na, tabi alalá na: nitoripe OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin ndan nyin wò ni, lati mọ̀ bi ẹnyin ba fi gbogbo àiya nyin, ati gbogbo ọkàn nyin fẹ́ OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin.
entries.en: Thou shalt not hearken unto the words of that prophet, or that dreamer of dreams: for the LORD your God proveth you, to know whether ye love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul.

entries.yo: Lẹhin OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin ni ki ẹnyin ki o ma rìn, on ni ki ẹ si ma bẹ̀ru, ki ẹ si ma pa ofin rẹ̀ mọ́, ki ẹ si ma gbà ohùn rẹ̀ gbọ́, ki ẹ si ma sìn i, ki ẹ si ma faramọ́ ọ.
entries.en: Ye shall walk after the LORD your God, and fear him, and keep his commandments, and obey his voice, and ye shall serve him, and cleave unto him.

entries.yo: Ati wolĩ na, tabi alalá na, ni ki ẹnyin ki o pa; nitoriti o ti sẹ ọtẹ̀ si OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin, ti o mú nyin lati ilẹ Egipti jade wá, ti o ti rà nyin kuro li oko-ẹrú, lati tì ọ kuro li oju ọ̀na ti OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ filelẹ li aṣẹ fun ọ lati ma rìn ninu rẹ̀. Bẹ̃ni ki iwọ ki o si mú ibi kuro lãrin rẹ.
entries.en: And that prophet, or that dreamer of dreams, shall be put to death; because he hath spoken to turn you away from the LORD your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed you out of the house of bondage, to thrust thee out of the way which the LORD thy God commanded thee to walk in. So shalt thou put the evil away from the midst of thee.

entries.yo: Bi arakunrin rẹ, ọmọ iya rẹ, tabi ọmọ rẹ ọkunrin, tabi ọmọ rẹ obinrin, tabi aya õkan-àiya rẹ, tabi ọrẹ́ rẹ, ti o dabi ọkàn ara rẹ, bi o ba tàn ọ ni ìkọkọ, wipe, Jẹ ki a lọ ki a ma sìn ọlọrun miran, ti iwọ kò mọ̀ rí, iwọ, tabi awọn baba rẹ;
entries.en: If thy brother, the son of thy mother, or thy son, or thy daughter, or the wife of thy bosom, or thy friend, which is as thine own soul, entice thee secretly, saying, Let us go and serve other gods, which thou hast not known, thou, nor thy fathers;

entries.yo: Ninu awọn oriṣa awọn enia ti o yi nyin kakiri, ti o sunmọ ọ, tabi ti o jìna si ọ, lati opin ilẹ dé opin ilẹ;
entries.en: Namely, of the gods of the people which are round about you, nigh unto thee, or far off from thee, from the one end of the earth even unto the other end of the earth;

entries.yo: Iwọ kò gbọdọ jẹ fun u, bẹ̃ni iwọ kò gbọdọ fetisi tirẹ̀; bẹ̃ni ki oju ki o máṣe ro ọ, bẹ̃ni ki iwọ ki o máṣe da a si, bẹ̃ni ki iwọ ki o máṣe bò o:
entries.en: Thou shalt not consent unto him, nor hearken unto him; neither shall thine eye pity him, neither shalt thou spare, neither shalt thou conceal him:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn pipa ni ki o pa a; ọwọ́ rẹ ni yio kọ́ wà lara rẹ̀ lati pa a, ati lẹhin na ọwọ́ gbogbo enia.
entries.en: But thou shalt surely kill him; thine hand shall be first upon him to put him to death, and afterwards the hand of all the people.

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o si sọ ọ li okuta, ki o kú; nitoriti o nwá ọ̀na lati tì ọ kuro lọdọ OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ, ti o mú ọ lati ilẹ Egipti jade wá, kuro li oko-ẹrú.
entries.en: And thou shalt stone him with stones, that he die; because he hath sought to thrust thee away from the LORD thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.

entries.yo: Gbogbo Israeli yio si gbọ́, nwọn o si bẹ̀ru, nwọn ki o si tun hù ìwabuburu bi irú eyi mọ́ lãrin nyin.
entries.en: And all Israel shall hear, and fear, and shall do no more any such wickedness as this is among you.

entries.yo: Bi iwọ ba gbọ́ ninu ọkan ninu awọn ilu rẹ, ti OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ fi fun ọ lati ma gbé inu rẹ̀ pe,
entries.en: If thou shalt hear say in one of thy cities, which the LORD thy God hath given thee to dwell there, saying,

entries.yo: Awọn ọkunrin kan, awọn ọmọ Beliali, nwọn jade lọ kuro ninu nyin, nwọn si kó awọn ara ilu wọn sẹhin, wipe, Ẹ jẹ ki a lọ ki a ma sìn ọlọrun miran, ti ẹnyin kò mọ̀ rí.
entries.en: Certain men, the children of Belial, are gone out from among you, and have withdrawn the inhabitants of their city, saying, Let us go and serve other gods, which ye have not known;

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ki iwọ ki o bère, ki iwọ ki o si ṣe àwari, ki o si bère pẹlẹpẹlẹ; si kiyesi i, bi o ba ṣe otitọ, ti ohun na ba si da nyin loju, pe a ṣe irú nkan irira bẹ̃ ninu nyin;
entries.en: Then shalt thou inquire, and make search, and ask diligently; and, behold, if it be truth, and the thing certain, that such abomination is wrought among you;

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o fi oju idà kọlù awọn ara ilu na nitõtọ, lati run u patapata, ati ohun gbogbo ti mbẹ ninu rẹ̀, ati ohunọ̀sin inu rẹ̀, ni ki iwọ ki o fi oju idà pa.
entries.en: Thou shalt surely smite the inhabitants of that city with the edge of the sword, destroying it utterly, and all that is therein, and the cattle thereof, with the edge of the sword.

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o si kó gbogbo ikogun rẹ̀ si ãrin igboro rẹ̀, ki iwọ ki o si fi iná kun ilu na, ati gbogbo ikogun rẹ̀ patapata fun OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ: ki o si ma jasi òkiti lailai; a ki yio si tun tẹ̀ ẹ dó mọ́.
entries.en: And thou shalt gather all the spoil of it into the midst of the street thereof, and shalt burn with fire the city, and all the spoil thereof every whit, for the LORD thy God: and it shall be an heap for ever; it shall not be built again.

entries.yo: Ki ọkan ninu ohun ìyasọtọ na má si ṣe mọ́ ọ lọwọ; ki OLUWA ki o le yipada kuro ninu imuna ibinu rẹ̀, ki o si ma ṣãnu fun ọ, ki o si ma ṣe iyọnu rẹ, ki o si ma mu ọ bisi i, bi o ti bura fun awọn baba rẹ;
entries.en: And there shall cleave nought of the cursed thing to thine hand: that the LORD may turn from the fierceness of his anger, and shew thee mercy, and have compassion upon thee, and multiply thee, as he hath sworn unto thy fathers;

entries.yo: Nigbati iwọ ba fetisi ohùn OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ, lati pa gbogbo ofin rẹ̀ mọ́, ti mo palaṣẹ fun ọ li oni, lati ma ṣe eyiti o tọ́ li oju OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ.
entries.en: When thou shalt hearken to the voice of the LORD thy God, to keep all his commandments which I command thee this day, to do that which is right in the eyes of the LORD thy God.

entries.yo: ỌMỌ OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin li ẹnyin iṣe: ẹnyin kò gbọdọ̀ bù ara nyin li abẹ, bẹ̃ni ẹnyin kò gbọdọ fá iwaju nyin nitori okú.
entries.en: Ye are the children of the LORD your God: ye shall not cut yourselves, nor make any baldness between your eyes for the dead.

entries.yo: Nitoripe enia mimọ́ ni iwọ fun OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ, OLUWA si ti yàn ọ lati ma ṣe enia ọ̀tọ fun ara rẹ̀, jù gbogbo orilẹ-ède lọ ti mbẹ lori ilẹ.
entries.en: for thou art an holy people unto the LORD thy God, and the LORD hath chosen thee to be a peculiar people unto himself, above all the nations that are upon the earth.

entries.yo: Iwọ kò gbọdọ jẹ ohun irira kan.
entries.en: Thou shalt not eat any abominable thing.

entries.yo: Wọnyi li ẹranko ti ẹnyin o ma jẹ: akọmalu, agutan, ati ewurẹ,
entries.en: These are the beasts which ye shall eat: the ox, the sheep, and the goat,

entries.yo: Agbọnrin, ati esuwo, ati gala, ati ewurẹ igbẹ́, ati pigargi, ati ẹfọ̀n, ati ẹtu.
entries.en: The hart, and the roebuck, and the fallow deer, and the wild goat, and the pygarg, and the wild ox, and the chamois.

entries.yo: Ati gbogbo ẹranko ti o là bàta-ẹsẹ̀, ti o si pinyà bàta-ẹsẹ̀ si meji, ti o si njẹ apọjẹ ninu ẹranko, eyinì ni ki ẹnyin ki o ma jẹ.
entries.en: And every beast that parteth the hoof, and cleaveth the cleft into two claws, and cheweth the cud among the beasts, that ye shall eat.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn wọnyi ni ẹnyin kò gbọdọ jẹ ninu awọn ti njẹ apọjẹ, tabi ninu awọn ti o là bàta-ẹsẹ̀; bi ibakasiẹ, ati ehoro, ati garà, nitoriti nwọn njẹ apọjẹ ṣugbọn nwọn kò là bàta-ẹsẹ̀, alaimọ́ ni nwọn jasi fun nyin:
entries.en: Nevertheless these ye shall not eat of them that chew the cud, or of them that divide the cloven hoof; as the camel, and the hare, and the coney: for they chew the cud, but divide not the hoof; therefore they are unclean unto you.

entries.yo: Ati ẹlẹdẹ̀, nitoriti o là bàta-ẹsẹ̀ ṣugbọn kò jẹ apọjẹ, alaimọ́ ni fun nyin: ẹnyin kò gbọdọ jẹ ninu ẹran wọn, bẹ̃li ẹnyin kò gbọdọ fọwọkàn okú wọn.
entries.en: And the swine, because it divideth the hoof, yet cheweth not the cud, it is unclean unto you: ye shall not eat of their flesh, nor touch their dead carcase.

entries.yo: Wọnyi ni ki ẹnyin ki o ma jẹ ninu gbogbo eyiti mbẹ ninu omi: gbogbo eyiti o ní lẹbẹ ti o si ní ipẹ́ ni ki ẹnyin ki o ma jẹ.
entries.en: These ye shall eat of all that are in the waters: all that have fins and scales shall ye eat:

entries.yo: Ati ohunkohun ti kò ba ní lẹbẹ ti kò si ní ipẹ́, ki ẹnyin ki o máṣe jẹ ẹ; alaimọ́ ni fun nyin.
entries.en: And whatsoever hath not fins and scales ye may not eat; it is unclean unto you.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ẹiyẹ ti o mọ́ ni ki ẹnyin ki o ma jẹ.
entries.en: Of all clean birds ye shall eat.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn wọnyi li awọn ti ẹnyin kò gbọdọ jẹ ninu wọn: idì, ati aṣa-idì, ati idì-ẹja.
entries.en: But these are they of which ye shall not eat: the eagle, and ossifrage, and the ospray,

entries.yo: Ati glede, ati aṣá, ati gunugun li onirũru rẹ̀;
entries.en: And the glede, and the kite, and the vulture after his kind,

entries.yo: Ati gbogbo ìwo li onirũru rẹ̀;
entries.en: And every raven after his kind,

entries.yo: Ati ogongo, ati owiwi, ati ẹlulu, ati awodi li onirũru rẹ̀;
entries.en: And the owl, and the night hawk, and the cuckow, and the hawk after his kind,

entries.yo: Owiwi kekere, ati owiwi nla, ati ogbugbu;
entries.en: The little owl, and the great owl, and the swan,

entries.yo: Ati pelikan, ati àkala, ati ìgo;
entries.en: And the pelican, and the gier eagle, and the cormorant,

entries.yo: Ati àkọ, ati ondẹ li onirũru rẹ̀, ati atọka, ati adán.
entries.en: And the stork, and the heron after her kind, and the lapwing, and the bat.

entries.yo: Ati ohun gbogbo ti nrakò ti nfò, o jẹ́ alaimọ́ fun nyin: a kò gbọdọ jẹ wọn.
entries.en: And every creeping thing that flieth is unclean unto you: they shall not be eaten.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn gbogbo ẹiyẹ ti o mọ́ ni ki ẹnyin ki o ma jẹ.
entries.en: But of all clean fowls ye may eat.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin kò gbọdọ jẹ ohunkohun ti o tikara rẹ̀ kú: iwọ le fi i fun alejò ti mbẹ ninu ibode rẹ, ki on ki o jẹ ẹ; tabi ki iwọ ki o tà a fun ajeji: nitoripe enia mimọ́ ni iwọ fun OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ. Iwọ kò gbọdọ bọ̀ ọmọ ewurẹ ninu warà iya rẹ̀.
entries.en: Ye shall not eat of any thing that dieth of itself: thou shalt give it unto the stranger that is in thy gates, that he may eat it; or thou mayest sell it unto an alien: for thou art an holy people unto the LORD thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother's milk.

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o dá idamẹwa gbogbo ibisi irugbìn rẹ, ti nti oko rẹ wá li ọdọdún.
entries.en: Thou shalt truly tithe all the increase of thy seed, that the field bringeth forth year by year.

entries.yo: Niwaju OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ, ni ibi ti on o gbé yàn lati fi orukọ rẹ̀ si, ni ki iwọ ki o si ma jẹ idamẹwa ọkà rẹ, ti ọti-waini rẹ, ati ti oróro rẹ, ati akọ́bi ọwọ́-ẹran rẹ, ati ti agbo-ẹran rẹ; ki iwọ ki o le ma kọ́ ati bẹ̀ru OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ nigbagbogbo.
entries.en: And thou shalt eat before the LORD thy God, in the place which he shall choose to place his name there, the tithe of thy corn, of thy wine, and of thine oil, and the firstlings of thy herds and of thy flocks; that thou mayest learn to fear the LORD thy God always.

entries.yo: Bi ọ̀na na ba si jìn jù fun ọ, ti iwọ ki yio fi le rù u lọ, tabi bi ibi ti OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ yio yàn lati fi orukọ rẹ̀ si ba jìn jù fun ọ, nigbati OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ ba bukún ọ:
entries.en: And if the way be too long for thee, so that thou art not able to carry it; or if the place be too far from thee, which the LORD thy God shall choose to set his name there, when the LORD thy God hath blessed thee:

entries.yo: Njẹ ki iwọ ki o yi i si owo, ki iwọ ki o si dì owo na li ọwọ́ rẹ, ki o si lọ si ibi na, ti OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ yio yàn.
entries.en: Then shalt thou turn it into money, and bind up the money in thine hand, and shalt go unto the place which the LORD thy God shall choose:

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o si ná owo na si ohunkohun ti ọkàn rẹ ba fẹ́, si akọmalu, tabi agutan, tabi ọti-waini, tabi ọti lile kan, tabi si ohunkohun ti ọkàn rẹ ba fẹ́: ki iwọ ki o si ma jẹ nibẹ̀ niwaju OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ, ki iwọ ki o si ma yọ̀, iwọ, ati awọn ara ile rẹ:
entries.en: And thou shalt bestow that money for whatsoever thy soul lusteth after, for oxen, or for sheep, or for wine, or for strong drink, or for whatsoever thy soul desireth: and thou shalt eat there before the LORD thy God, and thou shalt rejoice, thou, and thine household,

entries.yo: Ati ọmọ Lefi ti mbẹ ninu ibode rẹ; iwọ kò gbọdọ kọ̀ ọ silẹ; nitoriti kò ní ipín tabi iní pẹlu rẹ.
entries.en: And the Levite that is within thy gates; thou shalt not forsake him; for he hath no part nor inheritance with thee.

entries.yo: Li opin ọdún mẹta ni ki iwọ ki o mú gbogbo idamẹwa ibisi rẹ wa li ọdún na, ki iwọ ki o si gbé e kalẹ ninu ibode rẹ:
entries.en: At the end of three years thou shalt bring forth all the tithe of thine increase the same year, and shalt lay it up within thy gates:

entries.yo: Ati ọmọ Lefi, nitoriti kò ní ipín tabi iní pẹlu rẹ, ati alejò, ati alainibaba, ati opó, ti mbẹ ninu ibode rẹ, yio wá, nwọn o si jẹ nwọn o si yó; ki OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ ki o le bukún ọ ninu gbogbo iṣẹ ọwọ́ rẹ ti iwọ nṣe.
entries.en: And the Levite, (because he hath no part nor inheritance with thee,) and the stranger, and the fatherless, and the widow, which are within thy gates, shall come, and shall eat and be satisfied; that the LORD thy God may bless thee in all the work of thine hand which thou doest.

entries.yo: LẸHIN ọdún mejemeje ni ki iwọ ki o ma ṣe ijọwọlọwọ.
entries.en: At the end of every seven years thou shalt make a release.

entries.yo: Ọ̀na ijọwọlọwọ na si li eyi: gbogbo onigbese ti o wín ẹnikeji rẹ̀ ni nkan ki o jọwọ rẹ̀ lọwọ; ki o ma ṣe fi agbara bère rẹ̀ lọwọ ẹnikeji rẹ̀, tabi lọwọ arakunrin rẹ̀; nitoriti a pè e ni ijọwọlọwọ OLUWA.
entries.en: And this is the manner of the release: Every creditor that lendeth ought unto his neighbour shall release it;he shall not exact it of his neighbour, or of his brother; because it is called the LORD's release.

entries.yo: Iwọ le fi agbara bère lọwọ alejò: ṣugbọn eyiti ṣe tirẹ ti mbẹ li ọwọ́ arakunrin rẹ, ni ki iwọ ki o jọwọ rẹ̀ lọwọ.
entries.en: Of a foreigner thou mayest exact it again: but that which is thine with thy brother thine hand shall release;

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ki yio sí talaka ninu nyin; (nitoripe OLUWA yio busi i fun ọ pupọ̀ ni ilẹ na, ti OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ fi fun ọ ni iní lati gbà a;)
entries.en: Save when there shall be no poor among you; for the LORD shall greatly bless thee in the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee for an inheritance to possess it:

entries.yo: Kìki bi iwọ ba fi ifarabalẹ fetisi ohùn OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ, lati ma kiyesi gbogbo ofin yi, ti mo filelẹ li aṣẹ fun ọ li oni lati ṣe.
entries.en: Only if thou carefully hearken unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to observe to do all these commandments which I command thee this day.

entries.yo: Nitoripe OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ yio busi i fun ọ, bi o ti ṣe ileri fun ọ: iwọ o si ma wín ọ̀pọlọpọ orilẹ-ède, ṣugbọn iwọ ki yio tọrọ; iwọ o si ma ṣe olori ọ̀pọlọpọ orilẹ-ède, ṣugbọn nwọn ki yio ṣe olori rẹ.
entries.en: For the LORD thy God blesseth thee, as he promised thee: and thou shalt lend unto many nations, but thou shalt not borrow; and thou shalt reign over many nations,but they shall not reign over thee.

entries.yo: Bi talakà kan ba mbẹ ninu nyin, ọkan ninu awọn arakunrin rẹ, ninu ibode rẹ kan, ni ilẹ rẹ ti OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ fi fun ọ, ki iwọ ki o máṣe mu àiya rẹ le si i, bẹ̃ni ki iwọ ki o máṣe há ọwọ́ rẹ si talakà arakunrin rẹ:
entries.en: If there be among you a poor man of one of thy brethren within any of thy gates in thy land which the LORD thy God giveth thee, thou shalt not harden thine heart, nor shut thine hand from thy poor brother:

entries.yo: Sugbọn lilà ni ki iwọ ki o là ọwọ́ rẹ fun u, ki iwọ ki o si wín i li ọ̀pọlọpọ tó fun ainí rẹ̀, li ohun ti nfẹ́.
entries.en: But thou shalt open thine hand wide unto him, and shalt surely lend him sufficient for his need, in that which he wanteth.

entries.yo: Ma kiyesara ki ìro buburu kan ki o máṣe sí ninu àiya rẹ, wipe, Ọdún keje, ọdún ijọwọlọwọ sunmọtosi; oju rẹ a si buru si arakunrin rẹ talakà, ti iwọ kò si fun u ni nkan; on a si kigbe pè OLUWA nitori rẹ, a si di ẹ̀ṣẹ fun ọ.
entries.en: Beware that there be not a thought in thy wicked heart, saying, The seventh year, the year of release, is at hand; and thine eye be evil against thy poor brother, and thou givest him nought; and he cry unto the LORD against thee, and it be sin unto thee.

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o fi fun u nitõtọ, ki inu rẹ ki o máṣe bàjẹ́ nigbati iwọ ba fi fun u: nitoripe nitori nkan yi ni OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ yio busi i fun ọ ni gbogbo iṣẹ rẹ, ati ni gbogbo ohun ti iwọ ba dá ọwọ́ rẹ lé.
entries.en: Thou shalt surely give him, and thine heart shall not be grieved when thou givest unto him: because that for this thing the LORD thy God shall bless thee in all thy works, and in all that thou puttest thine hand unto.

entries.yo: Nitoripe talakà kò le tán ni ilẹ na: nitorina ni mo ṣe paṣẹ fun ọ, wipe, Ki iwọ ki o là ọwọ́ rẹ fun arakunrin rẹ, fun talakà rẹ, ati fun alainí rẹ, ninu ilẹ rẹ.
entries.en: For the poor shall never cease out of the land: therefore I command thee, saying, Thou shalt open thine hand wide unto thy brother, to thy poor, and to thy needy, in thy land.

entries.yo: Ati bi a ba tà arakunrin rẹ kan fun ọ, ọkunrin Heberu, tabi obinrin Heberu, ti o si sìn ọ li ọdún mẹfa; njẹ li ọdún keje ki iwọ ki o rán a lọ kuro lọdọ rẹ li ominira.
entries.en: And if thy brother, an Hebrew man, or an Hebrew woman , be sold unto thee, and serve thee six years; then in the seventh year thou shalt let him go free from thee.

entries.yo: Nigbati iwọ ba si nrán a lọ li ominira kuro lọdọ rẹ, iwọ kò gbọdọ jẹ ki o lọ li ọwọ́ ofo:
entries.en: And when thou sendest him out free from thee, thou shalt not let him go away empty:

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o pèse fun u li ọ̀pọlọpọ lati inu agbo-ẹran rẹ wá, ati lati ilẹ-ipakà rẹ, ati lati ibi ifunti rẹ, ninu eyiti OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ fi bukún ọ ni ki iwọ ki o fi fun u.
entries.en: Thou shalt furnish him liberally out of thy flock, and out of thy floor, and out of thy winepress: of that wherewith the LORD thy God hath blessed thee thou shalt give unto him.

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o si ranti pe, iwọ a ti ma ṣe ẹrú ni ilẹ Egipti, ati pe OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ si gbà ọ silẹ: nitorina ni mo ṣe fi aṣẹ nkan yi lelẹ fun ọ li oni.
entries.en: And thou shalt remember that thou wast a bondman in the land of Egypt, and the LORD thy God redeemed thee: therefore I command thee this thing to day.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, bi o ba wi fun ọ pe, Emi ki yio jade lọ kuro lọdọ rẹ; nitoriti o fẹ́ ọ ati ile rẹ, nitoriti o dara fun u lọdọ rẹ;
entries.en: And it shall be, if he say unto thee, I will not go away from thee; because he loveth thee and thine house, because he is well with thee;

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ki iwọ ki o mú olu kan, ki iwọ ki o si fi lu u li etí mọ́ ara ilẹkun, ki on ki o si ma ṣe ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ lailai. Ati ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ obinrin ni ki iwọ ki o ṣe bẹ̃ si gẹgẹ.
entries.en: Then thou shalt take an aul, and thrust it through his ear unto the door, and he shall be thy servant for ever. And also unto thy maidservant thou shalt do likewise.

entries.yo: Ki o máṣe ro ọ loju, nigbati iwọ ba rán a li ominira lọ kuro lọdọ rẹ; nitoriti o ní iye lori to alagbaṣe meji ni sísìn ti o sìn ọ li ọdún mẹfa: OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ yio si busi i fun ọ ninu gbogbo ohun ti iwọ nṣe.
entries.en: It shall not seem hard unto thee, when thou sendest him away free from thee; for he hath been worth a double hired servant to thee, in serving thee six years: and the LORD thy God shall bless thee in all that thou doest.

entries.yo: Gbogbo akọ́bi akọ ti o ti inu ọwọ-ẹran rẹ ati inu agbo-eran rẹ wá, ni ki iwọ ki o yàsi-mimọ́, fun OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ: iwọ kò gbọdọ fi akọ́bi ninu akọmalu rẹ ṣe iṣẹ kan, bẹ̃ni iwọ kò gbọdọ rẹrun akọ́bi agutan rẹ,
entries.en: All the firstling males that come of thy herd and of thy flock thou shalt sanctify unto the LORD thy God: thou shalt do no work with the firstling of thy bullock, nor shear the firstling of thy sheep.

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o ma jẹ ẹ niwaju OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ li ọdọdún, ni ibi ti OLUWA yio yàn, iwọ, ati awọn ara ile rẹ.
entries.en: Thou shalt eat it before the LORD thy God year by year in the place which the LORD shall choose, thou and thy household.

entries.yo: Bi abùku kan ba si wà lara rẹ̀, bi o mukun ni, bi o fọju ni, tabi bi o ni abùku buburu kan, ki iwọ ki o máṣe fi rubọ si OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ.
entries.en: And if there be any blemish therein, as if it be lame, or blind, or have any ill blemish, thou shalt not sacrifice it unto the LORD thy God.

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o jẹ ẹ ninu ibode rẹ: alaimọ́ ati ẹni ti o mọ́ ni ki o jẹ ẹ bakanna, bi esuwo, ati bi agbọnrin.
entries.en: Thou shalt eat it within thy gates: the unclean and the clean person shall eat it alike, as the roebuck, and as the hart.

entries.yo: Kìki iwọ kò gbọdọ jẹ ẹ̀jẹ rẹ̀; ki iwọ ki o dà a silẹ bi omi.
entries.en: Only thou shalt not eat the blood thereof; thou shalt pour it upon the ground as water.

entries.yo: IWỌ ma kiyesi oṣù Abibu, ki o si ma pa ajọ irekọja mọ́ si OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ: nitoripe li oṣù Abibu ni OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ mú ọ lati ilẹ Egipti jade wa li oru.
entries.en: Observe the month of Abib, and keep the passover unto the LORD thy God: for in the month of Abib the LORD thy God brought thee forth out of Egypt by night.

entries.yo: Nitorina ki iwọ ki o ma pa ẹran irekọja si OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ, ninu agbo-ẹran ati ninu ọwọ́-ẹran, ni ibi ti OLUWA yio yàn lati fi orukọ rẹ̀ si.
entries.en: Thou shalt therefore sacrifice the passover unto the LORD thy God, of the flock and the herd, in the place which the LORD shall choose to place his name there.

entries.yo: Iwọ kò gbọdọ jẹ àkara wiwu pẹlu rẹ̀; ijọ́ meje ni iwọ o fi jẹ àkara alaiwu pẹlu rẹ̀, ani onjẹ ipọnju; nitoripe iwọ ti ilẹ Egipti jade wá ni kanjukanju: ki iwọ ki o le ma ranti ọjọ́ ti iwọ ti ilẹ Egipti jade wa, li ọjọ́ aiye rẹ gbogbo.
entries.en: Thou shalt eat no leavened bread with it; seven days shalt thou eat unleavened bread therewith, even the bread of affliction; for thou camest forth out of the land of Egypt in haste: that thou mayest remember the day when thou camest forth out of the land of Egypt all the days of thy life.

entries.yo: Ki a má si ṣe ri àkara wiwu lọdọ rẹ li àgbegbe rẹ gbogbo ni ijọ́ meje; bẹ̃ni ki ohun kan ninu ẹran ti iwọ o fi rubọ li ọjọ́ kini li aṣalẹ, ki o máṣe kù di owurọ̀.
entries.en: And there shall be no leavened bread seen with thee in all thy coast seven days; neither shall there anything of the flesh, which thou sacrificedst the first day at even, remain all night until the morning.

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o máṣe pa ẹran irekọja na ninu ibode rẹ kan, ti OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ fi fun ọ:
entries.en: Thou mayest not sacrifice the passover within any of thy gates, which the LORD thy God giveth thee:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bikoṣe ni ibi ti OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ yio yàn lati fi orukọ rẹ̀ si, nibẹ̀ ni ki iwọ ki o pa ẹran irekọja na li aṣalẹ, nigba ìwọ-õrùn, li akokò ti iwọ ti ilẹ Egipti jade wá.
entries.en: But at the place which the LORD thy God shall choose to place his name in, there thou shalt sacrifice the passover at even, at the going down of the sun, at the season that thou camest forth out of Egypt.

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o si sun u, ki iwọ ki o si jẹ ẹ ni ibi ti OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ yio yàn: ki iwọ ki o si pada li owurọ̀, ki o si lọ sinu agọ́ rẹ.
entries.en: And thou shalt roast and eat it in the place which the LORD thy God shall choose: and thou shalt turn in the morning, and go unto thy tents.

entries.yo: Ijọ́ mẹfa ni iwọ o fi jẹ àkara alaiwu: ati ni ijọ́ keje ki ajọ kan ki o wà fun OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ; ninu rẹ̀ iwọ kò gbọdọ ṣe iṣẹ́ kan.
entries.en: Six days thou shalt eat unleavened bread: and on the seventh day shall be a solemn assembly to the LORD thy God: thou shalt do no work therein.

entries.yo: Ọsẹ meje ni ki iwọ ki o kà fun ara rẹ: bẹ̀rẹsi ati kà ọ̀sẹ meje na lati ìgba ti iwọ ba tẹ̀ doje bọ̀ ọkà.
entries.en: Seven weeks shalt thou number unto thee: begin to number the seven weeks from such time as thou beginnest to put the sickle to the corn.

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o si pa ajọ ọ̀sẹ mọ́ si OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ pẹlu ọrẹ ifẹ́-atinuwa ọwọ́ rẹ, ti iwọ o fi fun u, gẹgẹ bi OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ ti busi i fun ọ:
entries.en: And thou shalt keep the feast of weeks unto the LORD thy God with a tribute of a freewill offering of thine hand, which thou shalt give unto the LORD thy God, according as the LORD thy God hath blessed thee:

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o si ma yọ̀ niwaju OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ, iwọ, ati ọmọ rẹ ọkunrin, ati ọmọ rẹ obinrin, ati ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ ọkunrin, ati ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ obinrin, ati ọmọ Lefi ti mbẹ ninu ibode rẹ, ati alejò, ati alainibaba, ati opó, ti mbẹ lãrin rẹ, ni ibi ti OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ yio gbé yàn, lati fi orukọ rẹ̀ si.
entries.en: And thou shalt rejoice before the LORD thy God, thou, and thy son, and thy daughter, and thy manservant, and thy maidservant, and the Levite that is within thy gates, and the stranger, and the fatherless, and the widow, that are among you, in the place which the LORD thy God hath chosen to place his name there.

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o si ma ranti pe, ẹrú ni iwọ ti jẹ́ ni Egipti: ki iwọ ki o si ma kiyesi ati ṣe ìlana wọnyi.
entries.en: And thou shalt remember that thou wast a bondman in Egypt: and thou shalt observe and do these statutes.

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o si ma pa ajọ agọ́ mọ́ li ọjọ́ meje, lẹhin ìgba ti iwọ ba ṣe ipalẹmọ ilẹ-ipakà rẹ ati ibi-ifunti rẹ.
entries.en: Thou shalt observe the feast of tabernacles seven days, after that thou hast gathered in thy corn and thy wine:

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o si ma yọ̀ ninu ajọ rẹ, iwọ, ati ọmọ rẹ ọkunrin, ati ọmọ rẹ obinrin, ati ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ ọkunrin, ati ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ obinrin, ati ọmọ Lefi, ati alejò, ati alainibaba, ati opó, ti mbẹ ninu ibode rẹ.
entries.en: And thou shalt rejoice in thy feast, thou, and thy son, and thy daughter, and thy manservant, and thy maidservant, and the Levite, the stranger, and the fatherless, and the widow, that are within thy gates.

entries.yo: Ijọ́ meje ni ki iwọ ki o fi ṣe ajọ si OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ ni ibi ti OLUWA yio yàn: nitoriti OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ yio busi i fun ọ ni gbogbo asunkún rẹ, ati ninu gbogbo iṣẹ ọwọ́ rẹ, nitorina ki iwọ ki o ma yọ̀ nitõtọ.
entries.en: Seven days shalt thou keep a solemn feast unto the LORD thy God in the place which the LORD shall choose: because the LORD thy God shall bless thee in all thine increase, and in all the works of thine hands, therefore thou shalt surely rejoice.

entries.yo: Lẹ̃mẹta li ọdún ni ki gbogbo awọn ọkunrin rẹ ki o farahàn niwaju OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ, ni ibi ti on o gbé yàn; ni ajọ àkara alaiwu, ati ni ajọ ọ̀sẹ, ati ni ajọ agọ́: ki nwọn ki o má si ṣe ṣánwọ wá iwaju OLUWA:
entries.en: Three times in a year shall all thy males appear before the LORD thy God in the place which he shall choose; in the feast of unleavened bread, and in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of tabernacles: and they shall not appear before the LORD empty:

entries.yo: Ki olukuluku ki o mú ọrẹ wá bi agbara rẹ̀ ti to, gẹgẹ bi ibukún OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ ti o fi fun ọ.
entries.en: Every man shall give as he is able, according to the blessing of the LORD thy God which he hath given thee.

entries.yo: Awọn onidajọ ati awọn ijoye ni ki iwọ ki o fi jẹ ninu ibode rẹ gbogbo, ti OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ fi fun ọ, gẹgẹ bi ẹ̀ya rẹ: ki nwọn ki o si ma ṣe idajọ awọn enia na li ododo.
entries.en: Judges and officers shalt thou make thee in all thy gates, which the LORD thy God giveth thee, throughout thy tribes: and they shall judge the people with just judgment.

entries.yo: Iwọ kò gbọdọ lọ́ idajọ; iwọ kò gbọdọ ṣe ojuṣaju enia: bẹ̃ni iwọ kò gbọdọ gbà ẹ̀bun; nitoripe ẹ̀bun ni ifọ́ ọlọgbọ́n li oju, on a si yi ọ̀rọ olododo po.
entries.en: Thou shalt not wrest judgment; thou shalt not respect persons, neither take a gift: for a gift doth blind the eyes of the wise, and pervert the words of the righteous.

entries.yo: Eyiti iṣe ododo patapata ni ki iwọ ki o ma tọ̀ lẹhin, ki iwọ ki o le yè, ki iwọ ki o si ní ilẹ na ti OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ fi fun ọ.
entries.en: That which is altogether just shalt thou follow, that thou mayest live, and inherit the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.

entries.yo: Iwọ kò gbọdọ rì igi oriṣa kan sunmọ pẹpẹ OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ, ti iwọ o mọ fun ara rẹ.
entries.en: Thou shalt not plant thee a grove of any trees near unto the altar of the LORD thy God, which thou shalt make thee.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni iwọ kò gbọdọ gbé ọwọ̀n kan kalẹ fun ara rẹ: ti OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ korira.
entries.en: Neither shalt thou set thee up any image; which the LORD thy God hateth.

entries.yo: IWỌ kò gbọdọ fi akọmalu, tabi agutan, ti o lí àbuku, tabi ohun buburu kan rubọ si OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ: nitoripe irira ni si OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ.
entries.en: Thou shalt not sacrifice unto the LORD thy God any bullock, or sheep, wherein is blemish, or any evilfavouredness: for that is an abomination unto the LORD thy God.

entries.yo: Bi a ba ri lãrin nyin, ninu ibode rẹ kan ti OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ fi fun ọ, ọkunrin tabi obinrin ti nṣe nkan buburu li oju OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ, ni rire majẹmu rẹ̀ kọja,
entries.en: If there be found among you, within any of thy gates which the LORD thy God giveth thee, man or woman, that hath wrought wickedness in the sight of the LORD thy God, in transgressing his covenant,

entries.yo: Ti o si lọ ti o nsìn ọlọrun miran, ti o si mbọ wọn, iba ṣe õrùn, tabi oṣupa, tabi ọkan ninu ogun ọrun, ti emi kò palaṣẹ;
entries.en: And hath gone and served other gods, and worshipped them, either the sun, or moon, or any of the host of heaven, which I have not commanded;

entries.yo: Ti a ba si wi fun ọ, ti iwọ si ti gbọ́, ti iwọ si wádi rẹ̀ rere, si kiyesi i, ti o jasi otitọ, ti ohun na si daniloju pe, a ṣe irú irira yi ni Israeli;
entries.en: And it be told thee, and thou hast heard of it, and inquired diligently, and, behold, it be true, and the thing certain, that such abomination is wrought in Israel:

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ki iwọ ki o mú ọkunrin tabi obinrin na, ti o ṣe ohun buburu yi jade wá, si ibode rẹ, ani ọkunrin tabi obinrin na, ki iwọ ki o si sọ wọn li okuta pa.
entries.en: Then shalt thou bring forth that man or that woman, which have committed that wicked thing, unto thy gates, even that man or that woman, and shalt stone them with stones, till they die.

entries.yo: Li ẹnu ẹlẹri meji, tabi ẹlẹri mẹta, li a o pa ẹniti o yẹ si ikú; ṣugbọn li ẹnu ẹlẹri kan, a ki yio pa a.
entries.en: At the mouth of two witnesses, or three witnesses, shall he that is worthy of death be put to death; but at the mouth of one witness he shall not be put to death.

entries.yo: Ọwọ́ awọn ẹlẹri ni yio tète wà lara rẹ̀ lati pa a, lẹhin na ọwọ́ gbogbo enia. Bẹ̃ni iwọ o si mú ìwabuburu kuro lãrin nyin.
entries.en: The hands of the witnesses shall be first upon him to put him to death, and afterward the hands of all the people. So thou shalt put the evil away from among you.

entries.yo: Bi ẹjọ́ kan ba ṣoro jù fun ọ lati dá, lãrin èjẹ on ẹ̀jẹ, lãrin ọ̀ran on ọ̀ran, ati lãrin ìluni ati ìluni, ti iṣe ọ̀ran iyàn ninu ibode rẹ, nigbana ni ki iwọ ki o dide, ki o si gòke lọ si ibi ti OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ yio yàn;
entries.en: If there arise a matter too hard for thee in judgment, between blood and blood, between plea and plea, and between stroke and stroke, being matters of controversy within thy gates: then shalt thou arise, and get thee up into the place which the LORD thy God shall choose;

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o si tọ̀ awọn alufa, awọn ọmọ Lefi lọ, ati onidajọ ti yio wà li ọjọ́ wọnni: ki o si bère; nwọn o si fi ọ̀rọ idajọ hàn ọ:
entries.en: And thou shalt come unto the priests the Levites, and unto the judge that shall be in those days, and inquire; and they shall shew thee the sentence of judgment:

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o si ṣe bi ọ̀rọ idajọ, ti awọn ará ibi ti OLUWA yio yàn na yio fi hàn ọ; ki iwọ ki o si ma kiyesi ati ma ṣe gẹgẹ bi gbogbo eyiti nwọn kọ́ ọ:
entries.en: And thou shalt do according to the sentence, which they of that place which the LORD shall choose shall shew thee; and thou shalt observe to do according to all that they inform thee:

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ ofin ti nwọn o kọ́ ọ, ati gẹgẹ bi idajọ ti nwọn o wi fun ọ, ni ki iwọ ki o ṣe: ki iwọ ki o máṣe yà si ọwọ́ ọtún, tabi si òsi, kuro li ọ̀rọ ti nwọn o fi hàn ọ.
entries.en: According to the sentence of the law which they shall teach thee, and according to the judgment which they shall tell thee, thou shalt do: thou shalt not decline from the sentence which they shall shew thee, to the right hand, nor to the left.

entries.yo: Ọkunrin na ti o ba si fi igberaga ṣe e, ti kò fẹ́ gbọ́ ti alufa na, ti o duro lati ma ṣe iṣẹ alufa nibẹ̀ niwaju OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ, tabi lati gbọ́ ti onidajọ na, ani ọkunrin na yio kú: iwọ o si mú ìwabuburu kuro ni Israeli.
entries.en: And the man that will do presumptuously, and will not hearken unto the priest that standeth to minister there before the LORD thy God, or unto the judge, even that man shall die: and thou shalt put away the evil from Israel.

entries.yo: Gbogbo enia yio si gbọ́, nwọn o si bẹ̀ru, nwọn ki yio si gberaga mọ́.
entries.en: And all the people shall hear, and fear, and do no more presumptuously.

entries.yo: Nigbati iwọ ba dé ilẹ na ti OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ fi fun ọ, ti iwọ ba si gbà a, ti iwọ ba si joko ninu rẹ̀, ti iwọ o si wipe, Emi o fi ọba jẹ lori mi, gẹgẹ bi gbogbo awọn orilẹ-ède ti o yi mi ká;
entries.en: When thou art come unto the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee, and shalt possess it, and shalt dwell therein, and shalt say, I will set a king over me, like as all the nations that are about me;

entries.yo: Kìki ẹniti OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ yio yàn, ni ki iwọ ki o fi jọba lori rẹ: ọkan ninu awọn arakunrin rẹ ni ki iwọ ki o fi jọba lori rẹ: ki iwọ ki o máṣe fi alejò ṣe olori rẹ, ti ki iṣe arakunrin rẹ.
entries.en: Thou shalt in any wise set him king over thee, whom the LORD thy God shall choose: one from among thy brethren shalt thou set king over thee: thou mayest not set a stranger over thee, which is not thy brother.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn on kò gbọdọ kó ẹṣin jọ fun ara rẹ̀, bẹ̃ni ki o máṣe mu awọn enia pada lọ si Egipti, nitori ki o ba le kó ẹṣin jọ: nitori OLUWA ti wi fun nyin pe, Ẹnyin kò gbọdọ tun pada lọ li ọ̀na na mọ́.
entries.en: But he shall not multiply horses to himself, nor cause the people to return to Egypt, to the end that he should multiply horses: forasmuch as the LORD hath said unto you, Ye shall henceforth return no more that way.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni ki o máṣe kó obinrin jọ fun ara rẹ̀, ki àiya rẹ̀ ki o má ba yipada: bẹ̃ni ki o máṣe kó fadakà tabi wurá jọ fun ara rẹ̀ li ọ̀pọlọpọ.
entries.en: Neither shall he multiply wives to himself, that his heart turn not away: neither shall he greatly multiply to himself silver and gold.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, nigbati o ba joko lori itẹ́ ijọba rẹ̀, ki on ki o si kọ iwé ofin yi sinu iwé kan fun ara rẹ̀, lati inu eyiti mbẹ niwaju awọn alufa awọn ọmọ Lefi:
entries.en: And it shall be, when he sitteth upon the throne of his kingdom, that he shall write him a copy of this law in a book out of that which is before the priests the Levites:

entries.yo: Yio si wà lọdọ rẹ̀, on o si ma kà ninu rẹ̀ li ọjọ́ aiye rẹ̀ gbogbo: ki o le ma kọ́ ati bẹ̀ru OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ̀, lati ma pa gbogbo ọ̀rọ ofin yi mọ́ ati ilana wọnyi, lati ma ṣe wọn:
entries.en: And it shall be with him, and he shall read therein all the days of his life: that he may learn to fear the LORD his God, to keep all the words of this law and these statutes, to do them:

entries.yo: Ki àiya rẹ̀ ki o má ba gbega jù awọn arakunrin rẹ̀ lọ, ati ki o má ba yipada kuro ninu ofin na, si ọwọ́ ọtún, tabi si òsi: ki on ki o le mu ọjọ́ rẹ̀ pẹ ni ijọba rẹ̀, on, ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, lãrin Israeli.
entries.en: That his heart be not lifted up above his brethren, and that he turn not aside from the commandment, to the right hand, or to the left: to the end that he may prolong his days in his kingdom, he, and his children, in the midst of Israel.

entries.yo: AWỌN alufa, awọn ọmọ Lefi, ani gbogbo ẹ̀ya Lefi, ki yio ní ipín tabi iní pẹlu Israeli: ki nwọn ki o ma jẹ ẹbọ OLUWA ti a fi iná ṣe, ati iní rẹ̀ ni ki nwọn ki o ma jẹ.
entries.en: The priests the Levites, and all the tribe of Levi, shall have no part nor inheritance with Israel: they shall eat the offerings of the LORD made by fire, and his inheritance.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni nwọn ki yio ṣe ni iní lãrin awọn arakunrin wọn: OLUWA ni iní wọn, bi o ti wi fun wọn.
entries.en: Therefore shall they have no inheritance among their brethren: the LORD is their inheritance, as he hath said unto them.

entries.yo: Eyi ni yio si ma jẹ́ ipín awọn alufa lati ọdọ awọn enia wá, lati ọdọ awọn ti o ru ẹbọ, iba ṣe akọ-malu tabi agutan, ki nwọn ki o si fi apa fun alufa, ati ẹrẹkẹ mejeji ati àpo.
entries.en: And this shall be the priest's due from the people, from them that offer a sacrifice, whether it be ox or sheep; and they shall give unto the priest the shoulder, and the two cheeks, and the maw.

entries.yo: Akọ́so ọkà rẹ pẹlu, ati ti ọti-waini rẹ, ati ti oróro rẹ, ati akọ́rẹ irun agutan rẹ, ni ki iwọ ki o fi fun u.
entries.en: The firstfruit also of thy corn, of thy wine, and of thine oil, and the first of the fleece of thy sheep, shalt thou give him.

entries.yo: Nitori OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ li o yàn a ninu gbogbo awọn ẹ̀ya rẹ, lati ma duro ṣe iṣẹ-ìsin li orukọ OLUWA, on ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ lailai.
entries.en: For the LORD thy God hath chosen him out of all thy tribes, to stand to minister in the name of the LORD, him and his sons for ever.

entries.yo: Ati bi ọmọ Lefi kan ba ti inu ibode rẹ kan wá, ni gbogbo Israeli, nibiti o gbé nṣe atipo, ti o si fi gbogbo ifẹ́ inu rẹ̀ wá si ibi ti OLUWA yio yàn;
entries.en: And if a Levite come from any of thy gates out of all Israel, where he sojourned, and come with all the desire of his mind unto the place which the LORD shall choose;

entries.yo: Njẹ ki o ma ṣe iṣẹ-ìsin li orukọ OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ̀, bi gbogbo awọn arakunrin rẹ̀ awọn ọmọ Lefi, ti nduro nibẹ̀ niwaju OLUWA.
entries.en: Then he shall minister in the name of the LORD his God, as all his brethren the Levites do, which stand there before the LORD.

entries.yo: Ipín kanna ni ki nwọn ki o ma jẹ, làika eyiti o ní nipa tità ogún baba rẹ̀.
entries.en: They shall have like portions to eat, beside that which cometh of the sale of his patrimony.

entries.yo: Nigbati iwọ ba dé ilẹ na ti OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ fi fun ọ, ki iwọ ki o máṣe kọ́ ati ṣe gẹgẹ bi ìwa-irira awọn orilẹ-ède wọnni.
entries.en: When thou art come into the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee, thou shalt not learn to do after the abominations of those nations.

entries.yo: Ki a máṣe ri ninu nyin ẹnikan ti nmu ọmọ rẹ̀ ọkunrin, tabi ọmọ rẹ̀ obinrin là iná já, tabi ti nfọ̀ afọ̀ṣẹ, tabi alakiyesi-ìgba, tabi aṣefàiya, tabi ajẹ́,
entries.en: There shall not be found among you any one that maketh his son or his daughter to pass through the fire, or that useth divination, or an observer of times, or an enchanter, or a witch,

entries.yo: Tabi atuju, tabi aba-iwin-gbìmọ, tabi oṣó, tabi abokulò.
entries.en: Or a charmer, or a consulter with familiar spirits, or a wizard, or a necromancer.

entries.yo: Nitoripe gbogbo awọn ti nṣe nkan wọnyi irira ni si OLUWA: ati nitori irira wọnyi ni OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ ṣe lé wọn jade kuro niwaju rẹ.
entries.en: For all that do these things are an abomination unto the LORD: and because of these abominations the LORD thy God doth drive them out from before thee.

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o pé lọdọ OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ.
entries.en: Thou shalt be perfect with the LORD thy God.

entries.yo: Nitori orilẹ-ède wọnyi ti iwọ o gbà, nwọn fetisi awọn alakiyesi-ìgba, ati si awọn alafọ̀ṣẹ: ṣugbọn bi o ṣe tirẹ ni, OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ kò gbà fun ọ bẹ̃.
entries.en: For these nations, which thou shalt possess, hearkened unto observers of times, and unto diviners: but as for thee, the LORD thy God hath not suffered thee so to do.

entries.yo: OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ yio gbé wolĩ kan dide fun ọ lãrin rẹ, ninu awọn arakunrin rẹ, bi emi; on ni ki ẹnyin ki o fetisi;
entries.en: The LORD thy God will raise up unto thee a Prophet from the midst of thee, of thy brethren, like unto me; unto him ye shall hearken;

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi gbogbo eyiti iwọ bère lọwọ OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ ni Horebu li ọjọ́ ajọ nì, wipe, Máṣe jẹ ki emi tun gbọ́ ohùn OLUWA Ọlọrun mi mọ́, bẹ̃ni ki emi ki o má tun ri iná nla yi mọ́; ki emi ki o mà ba kú.
entries.en: According to all that thou desiredst of the LORD thy God in Horeb in the day of the assembly, saying, Let me not hear again the voice of the LORD my God, neither let me see this great fire any more, that I die not.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun mi pe, Nwọn wi rere li eyiti nwọn sọ.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto me, They have well spoken that which they have spoken.

entries.yo: Emi o gbé wolĩ kan dide fun wọn lãrin awọn arakunrin wọn, bi iwọ; emi o si fi ọ̀rọ mi si i li ẹnu, on o si sọ fun wọn gbogbo eyiti mo palaṣẹ.
entries.en: I will raise them up a Prophet from among their brethren, like unto thee, and will put my words in his mouth; and he shall speak unto them all that I shall command him.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, ẹniti kò ba fetisi ọ̀rọ mi ti on o ma sọ li orukọ mi, emi o bère lọwọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass, that whosoever will not hearken unto my words which he shall speak in my name, I will require it of him.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn wolĩ na, ti o kùgbu sọ ọ̀rọ kan li orukọ mi, ti emi kò fi fun u li aṣẹ lati sọ, tabi ti o sọ̀rọ li orukọ ọlọrun miran, ani wolĩ na yio kú.
entries.en: But the prophet, which shall presume to speak a word in my name, which I have not commanded him to speak, or that shall speak in the name of other gods, even that prophet shall die.

entries.yo: Bi iwọ ba si wi li ọkàn rẹ pe, Bawo li awa o ṣe mọ̀ ọ̀rọ ti OLUWA kò sọ?
entries.en: And if thou say in thine heart, How shall we know the word which the LORD hath not spoken?

entries.yo: Nigbati wolĩ kan ba sọ̀rọ li orukọ OLUWA, bi ohun na kò ba ri bẹ̃, ti kò ba si ṣẹ, eyinì li ohun ti OLUWA kò sọ: wolĩ na li o fi ikùgbu sọ̀rọ: ki iwọ ki o máṣe bẹ̀ru rẹ̀.
entries.en: When a prophet speaketh in the name of the LORD, if the thing follow not, nor come to pass, that is the thing which the LORD hath not spoken, but the prophet hath spoken it presumptuously: thou shalt not be afraid of him.

entries.yo: NIGBATI OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ ba ke awọn orilẹ-ède wọnni kuro, ilẹ ẹniti OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ fi fun ọ, ti iwọ si rọpò wọn, ti iwọ si joko ni ilu wọn, ati ni ile wọn;
entries.en: When the LORD thy God hath cut off the nations, whose land the LORD thy God giveth thee, and thou succeedest them, and dwellest in their cities, and in their houses;

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o yà ilu mẹta sọ̀tọ fun ara rẹ lãrin ilẹ rẹ, ti OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ fi fun ọ lati ní.
entries.en: Thou shalt separate three cities for thee in the midst of thy land, which the LORD thy God giveth thee to possess it.

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o là ọ̀na kan fun ara rẹ, ki iwọ ki o si pín àgbegbe ilẹ rẹ si ipa mẹta, ti OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ fi fun ọ lati ní, ki gbogbo apania ki o ma sá sibẹ̀.
entries.en: Thou shalt prepare thee a way, and divide the coasts of thy land, which the LORD thy God giveth thee to inherit, into three parts, that every slayer may flee thither.

entries.yo: Eyi si ni ọ̀ran apania, ti yio ma sá sibẹ̀, ki o le yè: ẹnikẹni ti o ba ṣeṣi pa ẹnikeji rẹ̀, ti on kò korira rẹ̀ tẹlẹrí;
entries.en: And this is the case of the slayer, which shall flee thither, that he may live: Whoso killeth his neighbour ignorantly, whom he hated not in time past;

entries.yo: Bi nigbati enia ba wọ̀ inu igbó lọ pélu ẹnikeji rẹ̀ lati ke igi, ti o si fi ọwọ́ rẹ̀ gbé ãke lati fi ke igi na lulẹ, ti ãke si yọ kuro ninu erú, ti o si bà ẹnikeji rẹ̀, ti on kú; ki o salọ si ọkan ninu ilu wọnni, ki o si yè:
entries.en: As when a man goeth into the wood with his neighbour to hew wood, and his hand fetcheth a stroke with the axe to cut down the tree, and the head slippeth from the helve, and lighteth upon his neighbour, that he die; he shall flee unto one of those cities, and live:

entries.yo: Ki agbẹsan ẹ̀jẹ ki o má ba lepa apania na, nigbati ọkàn rẹ̀ gboná, ki o si lé e bá, nitoriti ọ̀na na jìn, a si pa a; nigbati o jẹ pe kò yẹ lati kú, niwọnbi on kò ti korira rẹ̀ tẹlẹrí.
entries.en: Lest the avenger of the blood pursue the slayer, while his heart is hot, and overtake him, because the way is long, and slay him; whereas he was not worthy of death, inasmuch as he hated him not in time past.

entries.yo: Nitorina emi fi aṣẹ fun ọ, wipe, Ki iwọ ki o yà ilu mẹta sọ̀tọ fun ara rẹ.
entries.en: Wherefore I command thee, saying, Thou shalt separate three cities for thee.

entries.yo: Ati bi OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ ba sọ àgbegbe rẹ di nla, ti on ti bura fun awọn baba rẹ, ti o sì fun ọ ni gbogbo ilẹ na, ti o si ṣe ileri fun awọn baba rẹ;
entries.en: And if the LORD thy God enlarge thy coast, as he hath sworn unto thy fathers, and give thee all the land which he promised to give unto thy fathers;

entries.yo: Bi iwọ ba pa gbogbo ofin yi mọ́ lati ma ṣe e, ti mo filelẹ li aṣẹ fun ọ li oni, lati ma fẹ́ OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ, ati lati ma rìn titi li ọ̀na rẹ̀; nigbana ni ki iwọ ki o fi ilu mẹta kún u si i fun ara rẹ, pẹlu mẹta wọnyi;
entries.en: If thou shalt keep all these commandments to do them, which I command thee this day, to love the LORD thy God, and to walk ever in his ways; then shalt thou add three cities more for thee, beside these three:

entries.yo: Ki a má ba tà ẹ̀jẹ alaiṣẹ̀ silẹ ninu ilẹ rẹ, ti OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ fi fun ọ ni iní, ki ẹ̀jẹ ki o má ba wà li ọrùn rẹ.
entries.en: That innocent blood be not shed in thy land, which the LORD thy God giveth thee for an inheritance, and so blood be upon thee.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi ọkunrin kan ba korira ẹnikeji rẹ̀, ti o si ba dè e, ti o si dide si i, ti o si lù u li alupa, ti o si kú, ti on si salọ sinu ọkan ninu ilu wọnyi:
entries.en: But if any man hate his neighbour, and lie in wait for him, and rise up against him, and smite him mortally that he die, and fleeth into one of these cities:

entries.yo: Njẹ ki awọn àgba ilu rẹ̀ ki o ránni ki nwọn ki o si mú u ti ibẹ̀ wá, ki nwọn ki o si fà a lé agbẹsan ẹ̀jẹ lọwọ ki o ba le kú.
entries.en: Then the elders of his city shall send and fetch him thence, and deliver him into the hand of the avenger of blood, that he may die.

entries.yo: Ki oju rẹ ki o máṣe ṣãnu fun u, ṣugbọn ki iwọ ki o mú ẹ̀jẹ alaiṣẹ̀ kuro lori Israeli, ki o si le dara fun ọ.
entries.en: Thine eye shall not pity him, but thou shalt put away the guilt of innocent blood from Israel, that it may go well with thee.
