entries.en: And among these nations shalt thou find no ease, neither shall the sole of thy foot have rest: but the LORD shall give thee there a trembling heart, and failing of eyes, and sorrow of mind:

entries.yo: Ẹmi rẹ yio sọrọ̀ ni iyemeji li oju rẹ; iwọ o si ma bẹ̀ru li oru ati li ọsán, iwọ ki yio si ní idaniloju ẹmi rẹ.
entries.en: And thy life shall hang in doubt before thee; and thou shalt fear day and night, and shalt have none assurance of thy life:

entries.yo: Li owurọ̀ iwọ o wipe, Alẹ iba jẹ́ lẹ! ati li alẹ iwọ o wipe, Ilẹ iba jẹ́ mọ́! nitori ibẹ̀ru àiya rẹ ti iwọ o ma bẹ̀ru, ati nitori iran oju rẹ ti iwọ o ma ri.
entries.en: In the morning thou shalt say, Would God it were even! and at even thou shalt say, Would God it were morning! for the fear of thine heart wherewith thou shalt fear, and for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see.

entries.yo: OLUWA yio si fi ọkọ̀ tun mú ọ pada lọ si Egipti, li ọ̀na ti mo ti sọ fun ọ pe, Iwọ ki yio si tun ri i mọ́: nibẹ̀ li ẹnyin o si ma tà ara nyin fun awọn ọtá nyin li ẹrú ọkunrin ati ẹrú obinrin, ki yio si sí ẹniti yio rà nyin.
entries.en: And the LORD shall bring thee into Egypt again with ships, by the way whereof I spake unto thee, Thou shalt see it no more again: and there ye shall be sold unto your enemies for bondmen and bondwomen, and no man shall buy you.

entries.yo: WỌNYI li ọ̀rọ majẹmu ti OLUWA palaṣẹ fun Mose lati bá awọn ọmọ Israeli dá ni ilẹ Moabu, lẹhin majẹmu ti o ti bá wọn dá ni Horebu.
entries.en: These are the words of the covenant, which the LORD commanded Moses to make with the children of Israel in the land of Moab, beside the covenant which he made with them in Horeb.

entries.yo: Mose si pè gbogbo awọn ọmọ Israeli, o si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹnyin ti ri ohun gbogbo ti OLUWA ṣe li oju nyin ni ilẹ Egipti si Farao, ati si gbogbo awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀ ati si ilẹ rẹ̀ gbogbo.
entries.en: And Moses called unto all Israel, and said unto them, Ye have seen all that the LORD did before your eyes in the land of Egypt unto Pharaoh, and unto all his servants, and unto all his land;

entries.yo: Idanwò nla ti oju rẹ ti ri, iṣẹ-àmi, ati iṣẹ-iyanu nla wọnni:
entries.en: The great temptations which thine eyes have seen, the signs, and those great miracles:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn OLUWA kò fun nyin li àiya lati mọ̀, ati oju lati ri, ati etí lati gbọ́ titi di oni yi.
entries.en: Yet the LORD hath not given you an heart to perceive, and eyes to see, and ears to hear, unto this day.

entries.yo: Emi si ti mu nyin rìn li ogoji ọdún li aginjù: aṣọ nyin kò gbó mọ́ nyin li ara, bàta nyin kò si gbó mọ́ nyin ni ẹsẹ̀.
entries.en: And I have led you forty years in the wilderness: your clothes are not waxen old upon you, and thy shoe is not waxen old upon thy foot.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin kò jẹ àkara, bẹ̃li ẹnyin kò mu ọti-waini, tabi ọti lile: ki ẹnyin ki o le mọ̀ pe emi li OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin.
entries.en: Ye have not eaten bread, neither have ye drunk wine or strong drink: that ye might know that I am the LORD your God.

entries.yo: Nigbati ẹnyin ti dé ihinyi, Sihoni ọba Hesboni, ati Ogu ọba Baṣani, jade ogun si wa, awa si kọlù wọn:
entries.en: And when ye came unto this place, Sihon the king of Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, came out against us unto battle, and we smote them:

entries.yo: Awa si gbà ilẹ wọn, a si fi i fun awọn ọmọ Reubeni, ati awọn ọmọ Gadi, ati àbọ ẹ̀ya Manasse ni iní.
entries.en: And we took their land, and gave it for an inheritance unto the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to the half tribe of Manasseh.

entries.yo: Nitorina, ẹ pa ọ̀rọ majẹmu yi mọ́, ki ẹ si ma ṣe wọn, ki ẹnyin ki o le ma ri ire ninu ohun gbogbo ti ẹnyin nṣe.
entries.en: Keep therefore the words of this covenant, and do them, that ye may prosper in all that ye do.

entries.yo: Gbogbo nyin li o duro li oni niwaju OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin; awọn olori nyin, awọn ẹ̀ya nyin, awọn àgba nyin, ati awọn ijoye nyin, ani gbogbo awọn ọkunrin Israeli,
entries.en: Ye stand this day all of you before the LORD your God; your captains of your tribes, your elders, and your officers, with all the men of Israel,

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ wẹ́wẹ nyin, awọn aya nyin, ati alejò rẹ, ti mbẹ lãrin ibudó rẹ, lati aṣẹgi rẹ dé apọnmi rẹ:
entries.en: Your little ones, your wives, and thy stranger that is in thy camp, from the hewer of thy wood unto the drawer of thy water:

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o le wọ̀ inu majẹmu OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ, ati ibura rẹ̀, ti OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ bá ọ ṣe li oni:
entries.en: That thou shouldest enter into covenant with the LORD thy God, and into his oath, which the LORD thy God maketh with thee this day:

entries.yo: Ki o le fi idi rẹ kalẹ li oni li enia kan fun ara rẹ̀, ati ki on ki o le ma ṣe Ọlọrun rẹ, bi o ti sọ fun ọ, ati bi o ti bura fun awọn baba rẹ, fun Abrahamu, fun Isaaki, ati fun Jakobu.
entries.en: That he may establish thee to day for a people unto himself, and that he may be unto thee a God, as he hath said unto thee, and as he hath sworn unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.

entries.yo: Ki si iṣe ẹnyin nikan ni mo bá ṣe majẹmu yi ati ibura yi;
entries.en: Neither with you only do I make this covenant and this oath;

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹniti o bá wa duro nihin li oni niwaju OLUWA Ọlọrun wa, ẹniti kò sí nihin pẹlu wa li oni:
entries.en: But with him that standeth here with us this day before the LORD our God, and also with him that is not here with us this day:

entries.yo: (Nitoripe ẹnyin mọ̀ bi awa ti gbé ilẹ Egipti; ati bi awa ti kọja lãrin orilẹ-ède ti ẹnyin là kọja;
entries.en: (For ye know how we have dwelt in the land of Egypt; and how we came through the nations which ye passed by;

entries.yo: Ẹnyin si ti ri ohun irira wọn, ati ere wọn, igi ati okuta, fadakà ati wurà, ti o wà lãrin wọn.)
entries.en: And ye have seen their abominations, and their idols, wood and stone, silver and gold, which were among them:)

entries.yo: Ki ẹnikẹni ki o má ba wà ninu nyin, ọkunrin, tabi obinrin, tabi idile, tabi ẹ̀ya, ti àiya rẹ̀ ṣí kuro lọdọ OLUWA Ọlọrun wa li oni, lati lọ isìn oriṣa awọn orilẹ-ède wọnyi; ki gbòngbo ti nyọ orõro ati iwọ, ki o má ba wà ninu nyin;
entries.en: Lest there should be among you man, or woman, or family, or tribe, whose heart turneth away this day from the LORD our God, to go and serve the gods of these nations; lest there should be among you a root that beareth gall and wormwood;

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, nigbati o ba gbọ́ ọ̀rọ egún yi, ti o sure fun ara rẹ̀ ninu àiya rẹ̀, wipe, Emi o ní alafia, bi emi tilẹ nrìn ninu agídi ọkàn mi, lati run tutù pẹlu gbigbẹ:
entries.en: And it come to pass, when he heareth the words of this curse, that he bless himself in his heart, saying, I shall have peace, though I walk in the imagination of mine heart, to add drunkenness to thirst:

entries.yo: OLUWA ki yio darijì i, ṣugbọn nigbana ni ibinu OLUWA ati owú rẹ̀ yio gbona si ọkunrin na, ati gbogbo egún wọnyi ti a kọ sinu iwé yi ni yio bà lé e, OLUWA yio si nù orukọ rẹ̀ kuro labẹ ọrun.
entries.en: The LORD will not spare him, but then the anger of the LORD and his jealousy shall smoke against that man, and all the curses that are written in this book shall lie upon him, and the LORD shall blot out his name from under heaven.

entries.yo: OLUWA yio si yà a si ibi kuro ninu gbogbo ẹ̀ya Israeli, gẹgẹ bi gbogbo egún majẹmu, ti a kọ sinu iwé ofin yi.
entries.en: And the LORD shall separate him unto evil out of all the tribes of Israel, according to all the curses of the covenant that are written in this book of the law:

entries.yo: Ati iran ti mbọ̀, awọn ọmọ nyin ti yio dide lẹhin nyin, ati alejò ti yio ti ilẹ jijìn wá, yio si wi, nigbati nwọn ba ri iyọnu ilẹ na, ati àrun na, ti OLUWA mu bá a;
entries.en: So that the generation to come of your children that shall rise up after you, and the stranger that shall come from a far land, shall say, when they see the plagues of that land, and the sicknesses which the LORD hath laid upon it;

entries.yo: Ati pe gbogbo ilẹ rẹ̀ di imi-õrùn, ati iyọ̀, ati ijóna, ti a kò le gbìn nkan si, tabi ti kò le seso, tabi ti koriko kò le hù ninu rẹ̀, bi ibìṣubu Sodomu, ati Gomorra, Adma, ati Seboiimu, ti OLUWA bìṣubu ninu ibinu rẹ̀, ati ninu ikannu rẹ̀:
entries.en: And that the whole land thereof is brimstone, and salt, and burning, that it is not sown, nor beareth, nor any grass groweth therein, like the overthrow of Sodom, and Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboim, which the LORD overthrew in his anger, and in his wrath:

entries.yo: Ani gbogbo orilẹ-ède yio ma wipe, Ẽṣe ti OLUWA fi ṣe bayi si ilẹ yi? Kili a le mọ̀ õru ibinu nla yi si?
entries.en: Even all nations shall say, Wherefore hath the LORD done thus unto this land? what meaneth the heat of this great anger?

entries.yo: Nwọn o si wipe, Nitoriti nwọn kọ̀ majẹmu OLUWA, Ọlọrun awọn baba wọn silẹ, ti o ti bá wọn dá nigbati o mú wọn lati ilẹ Egipti jade wá.
entries.en: Then men shall say, Because they have forsaken the covenant of the LORD God of their fathers, which he made with them when he brought them forth out of the land of Egypt:

entries.yo: Nitoriti nwọn lọ, nwọn si bọ oriṣa, nwọn si tẹriba fun wọn, oriṣa ti nwọn kò mọ̀ rí, ti on kò si fi fun wọn.
entries.en: For they went and served other gods, and worshipped them, gods whom they knew not, and whom he had not given unto them:

entries.yo: Ibinu OLUWA si rú si ilẹ na, lati mú gbogbo egún ti a kọ sinu iwé yi wá sori rẹ̀:
entries.en: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against this land, to bring upon it all the curses that are written in this book:

entries.yo: OLUWA si fà wọn tu kuro ni ilẹ wọn ni ibinu, ati ni ikannu, ati ni irunu nla, o si lé wọn lọ si ilẹ miran, bi o ti ri li oni yi.
entries.en: And the LORD rooted them out of their land in anger, and in wrath, and in great indignation, and cast them into another land, as it is this day.

entries.yo: Ti OLUWA Ọlọrun wa ni ohun ìkọkọ: ṣugbọn ohun ti afihàn ni tiwa ati ti awọn ọmọ wa lailai, ki awa ki o le ma ṣe gbogbo ọ̀rọ ofin yi.
entries.en: The secret things belong unto the LORD our God: but those things which are revealed belong unto us and to our children for ever, that we may do all the words of this law.

entries.yo: YIO si ṣe, nigbati gbogbo nkan wọnyi ba dé bá ọ, ibukún ati egún, ti mo filelẹ niwaju rẹ, ti iwọ o ba si ranti ninu gbogbo orilẹ-ède, nibiti OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ ti tu ọ ká si,
entries.en: And it shall come to pass, when all these things are come upon thee, the blessing and the curse, which I have set before thee, and thou shalt call them to mind among all the nations, whither the LORD thy God hath driven thee,

entries.yo: Ti iwọ ba si yipada si OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ, ti iwọ ba si gbà ohùn rẹ̀ gbọ́, gẹgẹ bi gbogbo eyiti mo filelẹ li aṣẹ fun ọ li oni, iwọ ati awọn ọmọ rẹ, pẹlu àiya rẹ gbogbo, ati pẹlu ọkàn rẹ gbogbo;
entries.en: And shalt return unto the LORD thy God, and shalt obey his voice according to all that I command thee this day, thou and thy children, with all thine heart, and with all thy soul;

entries.yo: Nigbana ni OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ yio yi oko-ẹrú rẹ pada, yio si ṣãnu fun ọ, yio si pada, yio si kó ọ jọ kuro ninu gbogbo orilẹ-ède wọnni nibiti OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ ti tu ọ ká si.
entries.en: That then the LORD thy God will turn thy captivity, and have compassion upon thee, and will return and gather thee from all the nations, whither the LORD thy God hath scattered thee.

entries.yo: Bi a ba si lé ẹni rẹ kan lọ si ìha opin ọrun, lati ibẹ̀ ni OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ yio kó ọ jọ, lati ibẹ̀ ni yio si mú ọ wá:
entries.en: If any of thine be driven out unto the outmost parts of heaven, from thence will the LORD thy God gather thee, and from thence will he fetch thee:

entries.yo: OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ yio si mú ọ wá sinu ilẹ na ti awọn baba rẹ ti ní, iwọ o si ní i; on o si ṣe ọ li ore, yio si mu ọ bisi i jù awọn baba rẹ lọ.
entries.en: And the LORD thy God will bring thee into the land which thy fathers possessed, and thou shalt possess it; and he will do thee good, and multiply thee above thy fathers.

entries.yo: OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ yio si kọ àiya rẹ nilà, ati àiya irú-ọmọ rẹ, lati ma fẹ́ OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ pẹlu àiya rẹ gbogbo, ati pẹlu ọkàn rẹ gbogbo, ki iwọ ki o le yè.
entries.en: And the LORD thy God will circumcise thine heart, and the heart of thy seed, to love the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, that thou mayest live.

entries.yo: OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ yio si fi gbogbo egún wọnyi lé awọn ọtá rẹ lori, ati lori awọn ti o korira rẹ, ti nṣe inunibini si ọ.
entries.en: And the LORD thy God will put all these curses upon thine enemies, and on them that hate thee, which persecuted thee.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si pada, iwọ o si gbà ohùn OLUWA gbọ́, iwọ o si ma ṣe gbogbo ofin rẹ̀ ti mo palaṣẹ fun ọ li oni.
entries.en: And thou shalt return and obey the voice of the LORD, and do all his commandments which I command thee this day.

entries.yo: OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ yio si sọ ọ di pupọ̀ ninu gbogbo iṣẹ ọwọ́ rẹ, ninu ọmọ inu rẹ, ati ninu ohunọ̀sin rẹ, ati ninu eso ilẹ rẹ, fun rere: nitoriti OLUWA yio pada wa yọ̀ sori rẹ fun rere, bi o ti yọ̀ sori awọn baba rẹ:
entries.en: And the LORD thy God will make thee plenteous in every work of thine hand, in the fruit of thy body, and in the fruit of thy cattle, and in the fruit of thy land, for good: for the LORD will again rejoice over thee for good, as he rejoiced over thy fathers:

entries.yo: Bi iwọ ba gbà ohùn OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ gbọ́, lati pa aṣẹ rẹ̀ ati ìlana rẹ̀ mọ́, ti a kọ sinu iwé ofin yi; bi iwọ ba si fi gbogbo àiya rẹ, ati gbogbo ọkàn rẹ, yipada si OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ.
entries.en: If thou shalt hearken unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to keep his commandments and his statutes which are written in this book of the law, and if thou turn unto the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul.

entries.yo: Nitori aṣẹ yi ti mo pa fun ọ li oni, kò ṣoro jù fun ọ, bẹ̃ni kò jìna rere si ọ.
entries.en: For this commandment which I command thee this day, it is not hidden from thee, neither is it far off.

entries.yo: Kò sí li ọrun, ti iwọ iba fi wipe, Tani yio gòke lọ si ọrun fun wa, ti yio si mú u wá fun wa, ki awa ki o le gbọ́ ọ, ki a si le ṣe e?
entries.en: It is not in heaven, that thou shouldest say, Who shall go up for us to heaven, and bring it unto us, that we may hear it, and do it?

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni kò sí ni ìha keji okun, ti iwọ iba fi wipe, Tani yio rekọja okun lọ fun wa, ti yio si mú u fun wa wá, ki awa ki o le gbọ́ ọ, ki a si le ṣe e?
entries.en: Neither is it beyond the sea, that thou shouldest say, Who shall go over the sea for us, and bring it unto us, that we may hear it, and do it?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ọ̀rọ na li o wà nitosi rẹ girigiri yi, li ẹnu rẹ, ati li àiya rẹ, ki iwọ ki o le ma ṣe e.
entries.en: But the word is very nigh unto thee, in thy mouth, and in thy heart, that thou mayest do it.

entries.yo: Wò o, emi fi ìye ati ire, ati ikú ati ibi, siwaju rẹ li oni;
entries.en: See, I have set before thee this day life and good, and death and evil;

entries.yo: Li eyiti mo palaṣẹ fun ọ li oni lati ma fẹ́ OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ, lati ma rìn li ọ̀na rẹ̀, ati lati ma pa aṣẹ rẹ̀, ati ìlana rẹ̀, ati idajọ rẹ̀ mọ́, ki iwọ ki o le yè, ki o si ma bisi i, ki OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ ki o le busi i fun ọ ni ilẹ na, nibiti iwọ nlọ lati gbà a.
entries.en: In that I command thee this day to love the LORD thy God, to walk in his ways, and to keep his commandments and his statutes and his judgments, that thou mayest live and multiply: and the LORD thy God shall bless thee in the land whither thou goest to possess it.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi àiya rẹ ba pada, ti iwọ kò ba si gbọ́, ṣugbọn ti iwọ di ẹni fifà lọ, ti iwọ si mbọ oriṣa, ti iwọ si nsìn wọn;
entries.en: But if thine heart turn away, so that thou wilt not hear, but shalt be drawn away, and worship other gods, and serve them;

entries.yo: Emi sọ fun nyin li oni, pe ṣiṣegbé li ẹnyin o ṣegbé; ẹnyin ki yio mu ọjọ́ nyin pẹ lori ilẹ, nibiti iwọ ngòke Jordani lọ lati gbà a.
entries.en: I denounce unto you this day, that ye shall surely perish, and that ye shall not prolong your days upon the land, whither thou passest over Jordan to go to possess it.

entries.yo: Emi pè ọrun ati ilẹ jẹri tì nyin li oni pe, emi fi ìye ati ikú, ibukún ati egún siwaju rẹ: nitorina yàn ìye, ki iwọ ki o le yè, iwọ ati irú-ọmọ rẹ:
entries.en: I call heaven and earth to record this day against you, that I have set before you life and death, blessing and cursing: therefore choose life, that both thou and thy seed may live:

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o le ma fẹ́ OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ, ati ki iwọ ki o le ma gbà ohùn rẹ̀ gbọ́, ati ki iwọ ki o le ma faramọ́ ọ: nitoripe on ni ìye rẹ, ati gigùn ọjọ́ rẹ: ki iwọ ki o le ma gbé inu ilẹ na ti OLUWA ti bura fun awọn baba rẹ, fun Abrahamu, ati fun Isaaki, ati fun Jakobu, lati fi fun wọn.
entries.en: That thou mayest love the LORD thy God, and that thou mayest obey his voice, and that thou mayest cleave unto him: for he is thy life, and the length of thy days: that thou mayest dwell in the land which the LORD sware unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give them.

entries.yo: MOSE si lọ, o si sọ ọ̀rọ wọnyi fun gbogbo Israeli.
entries.en: And Moses went and spake these words unto all Israel.

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Emi di ẹni ọgọfa ọdún li oni; emi kò le ma jade ki nsi ma wọle mọ́: OLUWA si ti wi fun mi pe, Iwọ ki yio gòke Jordani yi mọ́.
entries.en: And he said unto them, I am an hundred and twenty years old this day; I can no more go out and come in: also the LORD hath said unto me, Thou shalt not go over this Jordan.

entries.yo: OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ, on ni yio rekọja ṣaju rẹ, on ni yio si run orilẹ-ède wọnyi kuro niwaju rẹ, iwọ o si gbà wọn: ati Joṣua, on ni yio gòke ṣaju rẹ, bi OLUWA ti wi.
entries.en: The LORD thy God, he will go over before thee, and he will destroy these nations from before thee, and thou shalt possess them: and Joshua, he shall go over before thee, as the LORD hath said.

entries.yo: OLUWA yio si ṣe si wọn bi o ti ṣe si Sihoni ati si Ogu, ọba awọn Amori, ati si ilẹ wọn; awọn ẹniti o run.
entries.en: And the LORD shall do unto them as he did to Sihon and to Og, kings of the Amorites, and unto the land of them, whom he destroyed.

entries.yo: OLUWA yio si fi wọn tọrẹ niwaju nyin, ki ẹnyin ki o le fi wọn ṣe gẹgẹ bi gbogbo aṣẹ ti mo pa fun nyin.
entries.en: And the LORD shall give them up before your face, that ye may do unto them according unto all the commandments which I have commanded you.

entries.yo: Ẹ ṣe giri ki ẹ si mu àiya le, ẹ máṣe bẹ̀ru, ẹ má si ṣe fòya wọn: nitoripe OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ, on li o mbá ọ lọ; on ki yio fi ọ silẹ, bẹ̃ni ki yio kọ̀ ọ.
entries.en: Be strong and of a good courage, fear not, nor be afraid of them: for the LORD thy God, he it is that doth go with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.

entries.yo: Mose si pè Joṣua, o si wi fun u li oju gbogbo Israeli pe, Ṣe giri ki o si mu àiya le: nitoripe iwọ ni yio bá awọn enia yi lọ si ilẹ na, ti OLUWA ti bura fun awọn baba wọn, lati fi fun wọn; iwọ o si mu wọn gbà a.
entries.en: And Moses called unto Joshua, and said unto him in the sight of all Israel, Be strong and of a good courage: for thou must go with this people unto the land which the LORD hath sworn unto their fathers to give them; and thou shalt cause them to inherit it.

entries.yo: Ati OLUWA on li o nlọ ṣaju rẹ; on ni yio pẹlu rẹ, on ki yio fi ọ silẹ, bẹ̃ni ki yio kọ̀ ọ: máṣe bẹ̀ru, bẹ̃ni ki àiya ki o máṣe fò ọ.
entries.en: And the LORD, he it is that doth go before thee; he will be with thee, he will not fail thee, neither forsake thee: fear not, neither be dismayed.

entries.yo: Mose si kọwe ofin yi, o si fi i fun awọn alufa awọn ọmọ Lefi, ti ima rù apoti majẹmu OLUWA, ati fun gbogbo awọn àgba Israeli.
entries.en: And Moses wrote this law, and delivered it unto the priests the sons of Levi, which bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and unto all the elders of Israel.

entries.yo: Mose si paṣẹ fun wọn, wipe, Li opin ọdún meje meje li akokò ọdún idasilẹ, ni ajọ agọ́.
entries.en: And Moses commanded them, saying, At the end of every seven years, in the solemnity of the year of release, in the feast of tabernacles,

entries.yo: Nigbati gbogbo Israeli ba wá farahàn niwaju OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ ni ibi ti on o gbé yàn, ki iwọ ki o kà ofin yi niwaju gbogbo Israeli li etí wọn.
entries.en: When all Israel is come to appear before the LORD thy God in the place which he shall choose, thou shalt read this law before all Israel in their hearing.

entries.yo: Kó awọn enia na jọ, awọn ọkunrin ati awọn obinrin ati awọn ọmọde, ati alejò rẹ ti mbẹ ninu ibode rẹ, ki nwọn ki o le gbọ́, ati ki nwọn ki o le kọ ati ma bẹ̀ru OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin, ati ki nwọn ki o ma kiyesi ati ṣe gbogbo ọ̀rọ ofin yi;
entries.en: Gather the people together, men, and women, and children, and thy stranger that is within thy gates, that they may hear, and that they may learn, and fear the LORD your God, and observe to do all the words of this law:

entries.yo: Ati ki awọn ọmọ wọn, ti kò mọ̀, ki o le gbọ́, ki nwọn si kọ́ ati bẹ̀ru OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin, ni gbogbo ọjọ́ ti ẹnyin o wà ni ilẹ na nibiti ẹnyin ngóke Jordani lọ lati gbà a.
entries.en: And that their children, which have not known any thing, may hear, and learn to fear the LORD your God, as long as ye live in the land whither ye go over Jordan to possess it.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe, Kiyesi i, ọjọ́ rẹ sunmọ-etile ti iwọ o kú: pè Joṣua, ki ẹ si fara nyin hàn ninu agọ́ ajọ, ki emi ki o le fi aṣẹ lé e lọwọ. Mose ati Joṣua si lọ, nwọn si fara wọn hàn ninu agọ́ ajọ.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Behold, thy days approach that thou must die: call Joshua, and present yourselves in the tabernacle of the congregation, that I may give him a charge. And Moses and Joshua went, and presented themselves in the tabernacle of the congregation.

entries.yo: OLUWA si yọ si wọn ninu agọ́ na ninu ọwọ̀n awọsanma: ọwọ̀n awọsanma na si duro loke ẹnu-ọ̀na agọ́ na.
entries.en: And the LORD appeared in the tabernacle in a pillar of a cloud: and the pillar of the cloud stood over the door of the tabernacle.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose pe, Kiyesi i, iwọ o sùn pẹlu awọn baba rẹ; awọn enia yi yio si dide, nwọn o si ma ṣe àgbere tọ̀ awọn oriṣa ilẹ na lẹhin, nibiti nwọn nlọ lati gbé inu wọn, nwọn o si kọ̀ mi silẹ, nwọn o si dà majẹmu mi ti mo bá wọn dá.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Behold, thou shalt sleep with thy fathers; and this people will rise up, and go a whoring after the gods of the strangers of the land, whither they go to be among them, and will forsake me, and break my covenant which I have made with them.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ibinu mi yio rú si wọn li ọjọ́ na, emi o si kọ̀ wọn silẹ, emi o si pa oju mi mọ́ kuro lara wọn, a o si jẹ wọn run, ati ibi pupọ̀ ati iyọnu ni yio bá wọn; tobẹ̃ ti nwọn o si wi li ọjọ́ na pe, Kò ha jẹ́ pe nitoriti Ọlọrun wa kò sí lãrin wa ni ibi wọnyi ṣe bá wa?
entries.en: Then my anger shall be kindled against them in that day, and I will forsake them, and I will hide my face from them, and they shall be devoured, and many evils and troubles shall befall them; so that they will say in that day. Are not these evils come upon us, because our God is not among us?

entries.yo: Emi o fi oju mi pamọ́ patapata li ọjọ́ na, nitori gbogbo ìwabuburu ti nwọn o ti hù, nitori nwọn yipada si oriṣa.
entries.en: And I will surely hide my face in that day for all the evils which they shall have wrought, in that they are turned unto other gods.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, kọwe orin yi fun ara nyin, ki ẹ fi kọ́ awọn ọmọ Israeli: fi i si wọn li ẹnu, ki orin yi ki o le ma jẹ́ ẹrí fun mi si awọn ọmọ Israeli.
entries.en: Now therefore write ye this song for you, and teach it the children of Israel: put it in their mouths, that this song may be a witness for me against the children of Israel.

entries.yo: Nitoripe nigbati emi ba mú wọn wá si ilẹ na, ti mo bura fun awọn baba wọn, ilẹ ti nṣàn fun warà ati fun oyin; ti nwọn ba si jẹ ajẹyo tán, ti nwọn si sanra; nigbana ni nwọn o yipada si oriṣa, nwọn a si ma sìn wọn, nwọn a si kẹ́gan mi, nwọn a si dà majẹmu mi.
entries.en: For when I shall have brought them into the land which I sware unto their fathers, that floweth with milk and honey; and they shall have eaten and filled themselves, and waxen fat; then will they turn unto other gods, and serve them, and provoke me, and break my covenant.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, nigbati ibi pupọ̀ ati iyọnu ba bá wọn, ki orin yi ki o jẹri tì wọn bi ẹlẹri; nitoripe a ki yio gbagbé rẹ̀ lati ẹnu awọn ọmọ wọn: nitori mo mọ̀ ìro inu wọn, ti nwọn nrò, ani nisisiyi, ki emi ki o to mú wọn wá sinu ilẹ na ti mo bura si.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass, when many evils and troubles are befallen them, that this song shall testify against them as a witness; for it shall not be forgotten out of the mouths of their seed: for I know their imagination which they go about, even now, before I have brought them into the land which I sware.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni Mose ṣe kọwe orin yi li ọjọ́ na gan, o si fi kọ́ awọn ọmọ Israeli.
entries.en: Moses therefore wrote this song the same day, and taught it the children of Israel.

entries.yo: O si paṣẹ fun Joṣua ọmọ Nuni, o si wipe, Ṣe giri, ki o si mu àiya le: nitoripe iwọ ni yio mú awọn ọmọ Israeli lọ sinu ilẹ na ti mo bura fun wọn: Emi o si wà pẹlu rẹ.
entries.en: And he gave Joshua the son of Nun a charge, and said, Be strong and of a good courage: for thou shalt bring the children of Israel into the land which I sware unto them: and I will be with thee.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati Mose pari kikọ ọ̀rọ ofin yi tán sinu iwé, titi nwọn fi pari,
entries.en: And it came to pass, when Moses had made an end of writing the words of this law in a book, until they were finished,

entries.yo: Mose si paṣẹ fun awọn ọmọ Lefi, ti nrù apoti majẹmu OLUWA, wipe,
entries.en: That Moses commanded the Levites, which bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD, saying,

entries.yo: Gbà iwé ofin yi, ki o si fi i sapakan apoti majẹmu OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ, ki o ma wà nibẹ̀ fun ẹrí si ọ.
entries.en: Take this book of the law, and put it in the side of the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God, that it may be there for a witness against thee.

entries.yo: Nitoripe mo mọ̀ ọ̀tẹ rẹ, ati lile ọrùn rẹ: kiyesi i, nigbati emi wà lãye sibẹ̀ pẹlu nyin li oni, ọlọtẹ̀ li ẹnyin ti nṣe si OLUWA; melomelo si ni lẹhin ikú mi?
entries.en: For I know thy rebellion, and thy stiff neck: behold, while I am yet alive with you this day, ye have been rebellious against the LORD; and how much more after my death?

entries.yo: Pè gbogbo awọn àgba ẹ̀ya nyin jọ sọdọ mi, ati awọn ijoye nyin, ki emi ki o le sọ ọ̀rọ wọnyi li etí wọn ki emi ki o si pè ọrun ati aiye jẹri tì wọn.
entries.en: Gather unto me all the elders of your tribes, and your officers, that I may speak these words in their ears, and call heaven and earth to record against them.

entries.yo: Nitori mo mọ̀ pe lẹhin ikú mi ẹnyin o bà ara nyin jẹ́ patapata, ati pe ẹnyin o yipada kuro li ọ̀na ti mo palaṣẹ fun nyin; ibi yio si bá nyin li ọjọ́ ikẹhin; nitoriti ẹnyin o ma ṣe buburu li oju OLUWA, lati fi iṣẹ ọwọ́ nyin mu u binu.
entries.en: For I know that after my death ye will utterly corrupt yourselves, and turn aside from the way which I have commanded you; and evil will befall you in the latter days; because ye will do evil in the sight of the LORD, to provoke him to anger through the work of your hands.

entries.yo: Mose si sọ ọ̀rọ orin yi li etí gbogbo ijọ Israeli, titi nwọn fi pari.
entries.en: And Moses spake in the ears of all the congregation of Israel the words of this song, until they were ended.

entries.yo: FETISILẸ, ẹnyin ọrun, emi o si sọ̀rọ; si gbọ́ ọ̀rọ ẹnu mi, iwọ aiye:
entries.en: Give ear, O ye heavens, and I will speak; and hear, O earth, the words of my mouth.

entries.yo: Ẹkọ́ mi yio ma kán bi ojò ohùn mi yio ma sẹ̀ bi ìri; bi òjo winiwini sara eweko titun, ati bi ọ̀wara òjo sara ewebẹ̀:
entries.en: My doctrine shall drop as the rain, my speech shall distil as the dew, as the small rain upon the tender herb, and as the showers upon the grass:

entries.yo: Nitoriti emi o kokikí orukọ OLUWA kiri: ẹ fi ọlá fun Ọlọrun wa.
entries.en: Because I will publish the name of the LORD: ascribe ye greatness unto our God.

entries.yo: Apata na, pipé ni iṣẹ rẹ̀; nitoripe idajọ ni gbogbo ọ̀na rẹ̀: Ọlọrun otitọ ati alàiṣegbe, ododo ati otitọ li on.
entries.en: He is the Rock, his work is perfect: for all his ways are judgment: a God of truth and without iniquity, just and right is he.

entries.yo: Nwọn ti bà ara wọn jẹ́ lọdọ rẹ̀, nwọn ki iṣe ọmọ rẹ̀, àbuku wọn ni; iran arekereke ati wiwọ́ ni nwọn.
entries.en: They have corrupted themselves, their spot is not the spot of his children: they are a perverse and crooked generation.

entries.yo: Bayi li ẹnyin o ha san ẹsan fun OLUWA, ẹnyin aṣiwere enia ati alaigbọn? On ha kọ́ ni baba rẹ ti o rà ọ? on li o dá ọ, on li o si fi ẹsẹ̀ rẹ mulẹ?
entries.en: Do ye thus requite the LORD, O foolish people and unwise? is not he thy father that hath bought thee? hath he not made thee, and established thee?

entries.yo: Ranti ọjọ́ igbãni, ronu ọdún iraniran: bi baba rẹ lere yio si fihàn ọ; bi awọn àgba rẹ, nwọn o si sọ fun ọ.
entries.en: Remember the days of old, consider the years of many generations: ask thy father, and he will shew thee; thy elders, and they will tell thee.

entries.yo: Nigbati Ọga-ogo pín iní fun awọn orilẹ-ède, nigbati o tu awọn ọmọ enia ká, o pàla awọn enia na gẹgẹ bi iye awọn ọmọ Israeli.
entries.en: When the most High divided to the nations their inheritance, when he separated the sons of Adam, he set the bounds of the people according to the number of the children of Israel.

entries.yo: Nitoripe ipín ti OLUWA li awọn enia rẹ̀; Jakobu ni ipín iní rẹ̀.
entries.en: For the LORD's portion is his people; Jacob is the lot of his inheritance.

entries.yo: O ri i ni ilẹ aṣalẹ̀, ati ni aginjù nibiti ẹranko nke; o yi i ká, o tọju rẹ̀, o pa a mọ́ bi ẹyin oju rẹ̀:
entries.en: He found him in a desert land, and in the waste howling wilderness; he led him about, he instructed him, he kept him as the apple of his eye.

entries.yo: Bi idì ti irú itẹ́ rẹ̀, ti iràbaba sori ọmọ rẹ̀, ti inà iyẹ́-apa rẹ̀, ti igbé wọn, ti ima gbé wọn lọ lori iyẹ́-apa rẹ̀:
entries.en: As an eagle stirreth up her nest, fluttereth over her young, spreadeth abroad her wings, taketh them, beareth them on her wings:

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni OLUWA nikan ṣamọ̀na rẹ̀, kò si sí oriṣa pẹlu rẹ̀.
entries.en: So the LORD alone did lead him, and there was no strange god with him.

entries.yo: O mu u gùn ibi giga aiye, ki o le ma jẹ eso oko; o si jẹ ki o mu oyin lati inu apata wá, ati oróro lati inu okuta akọ wá;
entries.en: He made him ride on the high places of the earth, that he might eat the increase of the fields; and he made him to suck honey out of the rock, and oil out of the flinty rock;

entries.yo: Ori-amọ́ malu, ati warà agutan, pẹlu ọrá ọdọ-agutan, ati àgbo irú ti Baṣani, ati ewurẹ, ti on ti ọrá iwe alikama; iwọ si mu ẹ̀jẹ eso-àjara, ani ọti-waini.
entries.en: Butter of kine, and milk of sheep, with fat of lambs, and rams of the breed of Bashan, and goats, with the fat of kidneys of wheat; and thou didst drink the pure blood of the grape.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Jeṣuruni sanra tán, o si tapa: iwọ sanra tán, iwọ kì tan, ọrá bò ọ tán: nigbana li o kọ̀ Ọlọrun ti o dá a, o si gàn Apata ìgbala rẹ̀.
entries.en: But Jeshurun waxed fat, and kicked: thou art waxen fat, thou art grown thick, thou art covered with fatness; then he forsook God which made him, and lightly esteemed the Rock of his salvation.

entries.yo: Nwọn fi oriṣa mu u jowú, ohun irira ni nwọn fi mu u binu.
entries.en: They provoked him to jealousy with strange gods, with abominations provoked they him to anger.

entries.yo: Nwọn rubọ si iwin-buburu ti ki iṣe Ọlọrun, si oriṣa ti nwọn kò mọ̀ rí, si oriṣa ti o hù ni titun, ti awọn baba nyin kò bẹ̀ru.
entries.en: They sacrificed unto devils, not to God; to gods whom they knew not, to new gods that came newly up, whom your fathers feared not.

entries.yo: Apata ti o bi ọ ni iwọ kò ranti, iwọ si ti gbagbé Ọlọrun ti o dá ọ.
entries.en: Of the Rock that begat thee thou art unmindful, and hast forgotten God that formed thee.

entries.yo: OLUWA si ri i, o si korira wọn, nitori ìwa-imunibinu awọn ọmọkunrin rẹ̀, ati ti awọn ọmọbinrin rẹ̀.
entries.en: And when the LORD saw it, he abhorred them, because of the provoking of his sons, and of his daughters.

entries.yo: O si wipe, Emi o pa oju mi mọ́ kuro lara wọn, emi o si ma wò bi igbẹhin wọn yio ti ri; nitori iran alagídi ni nwọn, awọn ọmọ ninu ẹniti kò sí igbagbọ.
entries.en: And he said, I will hide my face from them, I will see what their end shall be: for they are a very froward generation, children in whom is no faith.

entries.yo: Nwọn ti fi ohun ti ki iṣe Ọlọrun mu mi jowú; nwọn si fi ohun asan wọn mu mi binu: emi o si fi awọn ti ki iṣe enia mu wọn jowú; emi o si fi aṣiwere orilẹ-ède mu wọn binu.
entries.en: They have moved me to jealousy with that which is not God; they have provoked me to anger with their vanities: and I will move them to jealousy with those which are not a people; I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation.

entries.yo: Nitoripe iná kan ràn ninu ibinu mi, yio si jó dé ipò-okú ni isalẹ, yio si run aiye pẹlu asunkún rẹ̀, yio si tinabọ ipilẹ awọn okenla.
entries.en: For a fire is kindled in mine anger, and shall burn unto the lowest hell, and shall consume the earth with her increase, and set on fire the foundations of the mountains.

entries.yo: Emi o kó ohun buburu jọ lé wọn lori; emi o si lò ọfà mi tán si wọn lara:
entries.en: I will heap mischiefs upon them; I will spend mine arrows upon them.

entries.yo: Ebi yio mu wọn gbẹ, oru gbigbona li a o fi run wọn, ati iparun kikorò; emi o si rán ehín ẹranko si wọn, pẹlu oró ohun ti nrakò ninu erupẹ.
entries.en: They shall be burnt with hunger, and devoured with burning heat, and with bitter destruction: I will also send the teeth of beasts upon them, with the poison of serpents of the dust.

entries.yo: Idà li ode, ati ipàiya ninu iyẹwu, ni yio run ati ọmọkunrin ati wundia, ọmọ ẹnu-ọmu, ati ọkunrin arugbo elewu irun pẹlu.
entries.en: The sword without, and terror within, shall destroy both the young man and the virgin, the suckling also with the man of gray hairs.

entries.yo: Mo wipe, Emi o tu wọn ká patapata, emi o si mu iranti wọn dá kuro ninu awọn enia:
entries.en: I said, I would scatter them into corners, I would make the remembrance of them to cease from among men:

entries.yo: Bikoṣepe bi mo ti bẹ̀ru ibinu ọtá, ki awọn ọtá wọn ki o má ba ṣe alaimọ̀, ati ki nwọn ki o má ba wipe, Ọwọ́ wa leke ni, ki isi ṣe OLUWA li o ṣe gbogbo eyi.
entries.en: Were it not that I feared the wrath of the enemy, lest their adversaries should behave themselves strangely, and lest they should say, Our hand is high, and the LORD hath not done all this.

entries.yo: Nitori orilẹ-ède ti kò ní ìmọ ni nwọn, bẹ̃ni kò sí òye ninu wọn.
entries.en: For they are a nation void of counsel, neither is there any understanding in them.

entries.yo: Ibaṣepe nwọn gbọ́n, ki òye eyi ki o yé wọn, nwọn iba rò igbẹhin wọn!
entries.en: O that they were wise, that they understood this, that they would consider their latter end!

entries.yo: Ẹnikan iba ti ṣe lé ẹgbẹrun, ti ẹni meji iba si lé ẹgbãrun sá, bikoṣepe bi Apata wọn ti tà wọn, ti OLUWA si fi wọn tọrẹ?
entries.en: How should one chase a thousand, and two put ten thousand to flight, except their Rock had sold them, and the LORD had shut them up?

entries.yo: Nitoripe apata wọn kò dabi Apata wa, ani awọn ọtá wa tikalawọn ni nṣe onidajọ.
entries.en: For their rock is not as our Rock, even our enemies themselves being judges.

entries.yo: Nitoripe igi-àjara wọn, ti igi-àjara Sodomu ni, ati ti igbẹ́ Gomorra: eso-àjara wọn li eso-àjara orõro, ìdi wọn korò:
entries.en: For their vine is of the vine of Sodom, and of the fields of Gomorrah: their grapes are grapes of gall, their clusters are bitter:

entries.yo: Ọti-waini wọn iwọ ti dragoni ni, ati oró mimu ti pamọlẹ̀.
entries.en: Their wine is the poison of dragons, and the cruel venom of asps.

entries.yo: Eyi ki a tojọ sọdọ mi ni ile iṣura, ti a si fi èdidi dì ninu iṣura mi?
entries.en: Is not this laid up in store with me, and sealed up among my treasures?

entries.yo: Ti emi ni igbẹsan, ati ẹsan, li akokò ti ẹsẹ̀ wọn yio yọ́: nitoriti ọjọ́ idamu wọn sunmọtosi, ohun ti o si mbọ̀ wa bá wọn nyára wá.
entries.en: To me belongeth vengeance, and recompence; their foot shall slide in due time: for the day of their calamity is at hand, and the things that shall come upon them make haste.

entries.yo: Nitoripe OLUWA yio ṣe idajọ awọn enia rẹ̀, yio si kãnu awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀; nigbati o ba ri pe agbara wọn lọ tán, ti kò si sí ẹnikan ti a sé mọ́, tabi ti o kù.
entries.en: For the LORD shall judge his people, and repent himself for his servants, when he seeth that their power is gone, and there is none shut up, or left.

entries.yo: On o si wipe, Nibo li oriṣa wọn gbé wà, apata ti nwọn gbẹkẹle:
entries.en: And he shall say, Where are their gods, their rock in whom they trusted,

entries.yo: Ti o ti jẹ ọrá ẹbọ wọn, ti o ti mu ọti-waini ẹbọ ohunmimu wọn? jẹ ki nwọn dide ki nwọn si ràn nyin lọwọ, ki nwọn ṣe àbo nyin.
entries.en: Which did eat the fat of their sacrifices, and drank the wine of their drink offerings? let them rise up and help you, and be your protection.

entries.yo: Wò o nisisiyi pe Emi, ani Emi ni, kò si sí ọlọrun pẹlu mi: mo pa, mo si sọ di ãye; mo ṣalọgbẹ, mo si mu jiná; kò si sí ẹnikan ti o le gbà silẹ li ọwọ́ mi.
entries.en: See now that I, even I, am he, and there is no god with me: I kill, and I make alive; I wound, and I heal: neither is there any that can deliver out of my hand.

entries.yo: Nitoripe mo gbé ọwọ́ mi soke ọrun, mo si wipe, Bi Emi ti wà titilai.
entries.en: For I lift up my hand to heaven, and say, I live for ever.

entries.yo: Bi mo ba si pọ́n idà didan mi, ti mo ba si fi ọwọ́ mi lé idajọ; emi o san ẹsan fun awọn ọtá mi, emi o radi i fun awọn ti o korira mi.
entries.en: If I whet my glittering sword, and mine hand take hold on judgment; I will render vengeance to mine enemies, and will reward them that hate me.

entries.yo: Emi o mu ọfà mi rin fun ẹ̀jẹ, idà mi o si jẹ ẹran; ninu ẹ̀jẹ ẹni pipa ati ti igbekun, lati ori awọn aṣaju ọtá.
entries.en: I will make mine arrows drunk with blood, and my sword shall devour flesh; and that with the blood of the slain and of the captives, from the beginning of revenges upon the enemy.

entries.yo: Ẹ ma yọ̀, ẹnyin orilẹ-ède, pẹlu awọn enia rẹ̀: nitoripe on o gbẹsan ẹ̀jẹ awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀, yio si gbẹsan lara awọn ọtá rẹ̀, yio si ṣètutu fun ilẹ rẹ̀, ati fun awọn enia rẹ̀.
entries.en: Rejoice, O ye nations, with his people: for he will avenge the blood of his servants, and will render vengeance to his adversaries, and will be merciful unto his land, and to his people.

entries.yo: Mose si wá o si sọ gbogbo ọ̀rọ ofin yi li etí awọn enia na, on, ati Hoṣea ọmọ Nuni.
entries.en: And Moses came and spake all the words of this song in the ears of the people, he, and Hoshea the son of Nun.

entries.yo: Mose si pari sisọ gbogbo ọ̀rọ wọnyi fun gbogbo Israeli:
entries.en: And Moses made an end of speaking all these words to all Israel:

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ gbé ọkàn nyin lé gbogbo ọ̀rọ ti mo sọ lãrin nyin li oni; ti ẹnyin o palaṣẹ fun awọn ọmọ nyin lati ma kiyesi ati ṣe gbogbo ọ̀rọ ofin yi.
entries.en: And he said unto them, Set your hearts unto all the words which I testify among you this day, which ye shall command your children to observe to do, all the words of this law.

entries.yo: Nitoripe ki iṣe ohun asan fun nyin; nitoripe ìye nyin ni, ati nipa eyi li ẹnyin o mu ọjọ́ nyin pẹ ni ilẹ na, nibiti ẹnyin ngòke Jordani lọ lati gbà a.
entries.en: For it is not a vain thing for you; because it is your life: and through this thing ye shall prolong your days in the land, whither ye go over Jordan to possess it.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Mose li ọjọ́ na gan, wipe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses that selfsame day, saying,

entries.yo: Gùn òke Abarimu yi lọ, si òke Nebo, ti mbẹ ni ilẹ Moabu, ti o kọjusi Jeriko; ki o si wò ilẹ Kenaani, ti mo fi fun awọn ọmọ Israeli ni iní.
entries.en: Get thee up into this mountain Abarim, unto mount Nebo, which is in the land of Moab, that is over against Jericho; and behold the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel for a possession:

entries.yo: Ki o si kú lori òke na, nibiti iwọ ngùn lọ, ki a si kó ọ jọ sọdọ awọn enia rẹ; bi Aaroni arakunrin rẹ ti kú li òke Horu, ti a si kó o jọ sọdọ awọn enia rẹ̀:
entries.en: And die in the mount whither thou goest up, and be gathered unto thy people; as Aaron thy brother died in mount Hor, and was gathered unto his people:

entries.yo: Nitoriti ẹnyin ṣẹ̀ si mi lãrin awọn ọmọ Israeli ni ibi omi Meriba-Kadeṣi, li aginjù Sini; nitoriti ẹnyin kò yà mi simimọ́ lãrin awọn ọmọ Israeli.
entries.en: Because ye trespassed against me among the children of Israel at the waters of Meribah-Kadesh, in the wilderness of Zin; because ye sanctified me not in the midst of the children of Israel.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn iwọ o ri ilẹ na niwaju rẹ; ṣugbọn iwọ ki yio lọ sibẹ̀, si ilẹ na ti mo fi fun awọn ọmọ Israeli.
entries.en: Yet thou shalt see the land before thee; but thou shalt not go thither unto the land which I give the children of Israel.

entries.yo: EYI si ni ire, ti Mose enia Ọlọrun su fun awọn ọmọ Israeli ki o to kú.
entries.en: And this is the blessing, wherewith Moses the man of God blessed the children of Israel before his death.

entries.yo: O si wipe, OLUWA ti Sinai wá, o si yọ si wọn lati Seiri wá; o tàn imọlẹ jade lati òke Parani wá, o ti ọdọ ẹgbẹgbãrun awọn mimọ́ wá: lati ọwọ́ ọtún rẹ̀ li ofin kan amubĩná ti jade fun wọn wá.
entries.en: And he said, The LORD came from Sinai, and rose up from Seir unto them; he shined forth from mount Paran, and he came with ten thousands of saints: from his right hand went a fiery law for them.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ, o fẹ́ awọn enia na; gbogbo awọn enia mimọ́ rẹ̀ wà li ọwọ́ rẹ. Nwọn si joko li ẹsẹ̀ rẹ; olukuluku ni yio gbà ninu ọ̀rọ rẹ.
entries.en: Yea, he loved the people; all his saints are in thy hand: and they sat down at thy feet; every one shall receive of thy words.

entries.yo: Mose fi ofin kan lelẹ li aṣẹ fun wa, iní ti ijọ enia Jakobu.
entries.en: Moses commanded us a law, even the inheritance of the congregation of Jacob.

entries.yo: O si jẹ́ ọba ni Jeṣuruni, nigbati olori awọn enia, awọn ẹ̀ya Israeli pejọ pọ̀.
entries.en: And he was king in Jeshurun, when the heads of the people and the tribes of Israel were gathered together.

entries.yo: Ki Reubeni ki o yè, ki o máṣe kú; ki enia rẹ̀ ki o máṣe mọniwọn.
entries.en: Let Reuben live, and not die; and let not his men be few.

entries.yo: Eyi si ni ti Judah: o si wipe, OLUWA, gbọ́ ohùn Judah, ki o si mú u tọ̀ awọn enia rẹ̀ wá: ki ọwọ́ rẹ̀ ki o to fun u; ki iwọ ki o si ṣe iranlọwọ fun u lọwọ awọn ọtá rẹ̀.
entries.en: And this is the blessing of Judah: and he said, Hear, LORD, the voice of Judah, and bring him unto his people: let his hands be sufficient for him; and be thou an help to him from his enemies.

entries.yo: Ati niti Lefi o wipe, Jẹ ki Tummimu ati Urimu rẹ ki o wà pẹlu ẹni mimọ́ rẹ, ẹniti iwọ danwò ni Massa, ati ẹniti iwọ bá jà li omi Meriba;
entries.en: And of Levi he said, Let thy Thummim and thy Urim be with thy holy one, whom thou didst prove at Massah, and with whom thou didst strive at the waters of Meribah;

entries.yo: Ẹniti o wi niti baba rẹ̀, ati niti iya rẹ̀ pe, Emi kò ri i; bẹ̃ni kò si jẹwọ awọn arakunrin rẹ̀, bẹ̃ni kò si mọ̀ awọn ọmọ rẹ̀: nitoriti nwọn kiyesi ọ̀rọ rẹ, nwọn si pa majẹmu rẹ mọ́.
entries.en: Who said unto his father and to his mother, I have not seen him; neither did he acknowledge his brethren, nor knew his own children: for they have observed thy word, and kept thy covenant.

entries.yo: Nwọn o ma kọ́ Jakobu ni idajọ rẹ, ati Israeli li ofin rẹ: nwọn o ma mú turari wá siwaju rẹ, ati ọ̀tọtọ ẹbọ sisun sori pẹpẹ rẹ.
entries.en: They shall teach Jacob thy judgments, and Israel thy law: they shall put incense before thee, and whole burnt sacrifice upon thine altar.

entries.yo: OLUWA, busi ohun-iní rẹ̀, ki o si tẹwọgbà iṣẹ ọwọ́ rẹ̀: lù ẹgbẹ́ awọn ti o dide si i, ati ti awọn ti o korira rẹ̀, ki nwọn ki o máṣe dide mọ́.
entries.en: Bless, LORD, his substance, and accept the work of his hands: smite through the loins of them that rise against him, and of them that hate him, that they rise not again.

entries.yo: Ati niti Benjamini o wipe, Olufẹ OLUWA yio ma gbé li alafia lọdọ rẹ̀; on a ma bò o li ọjọ́ gbogbo, on a si ma gbé lãrin ejika rẹ̀.
entries.en: And of Benjamin he said, The beloved of the LORD shall dwell in safety by him; and the LORD shall cover him all the day long, and he shall dwell between his shoulders.

entries.yo: Ati niti Josefu o wipe, Ibukún OLUWA ni ilẹ rẹ̀, fun ohun iyebiye ọrun, fun ìri, ati fun ibú ti o ba nisalẹ,
entries.en: And of Joseph he said, Blessed of the LORD be his land, for the precious things of heaven, for the dew, and for the deep that coucheth beneath,

entries.yo: Ati fun eso iyebiye ti õrùn múwa, ati fun ohun iyebiye ti ndàgba li oṣoṣù,
entries.en: And for the precious fruits brought forth by the sun, and for the precious things put forth by the moon,

entries.yo: Ati fun ohun pàtaki okenla igbãni, ati fun ohun iyebiye òke aiyeraiye,
entries.en: And for the chief things of the ancient mountains, and for the precious things of the lasting hills,

entries.yo: Ati fun ohun iyebiye aiye ati ẹkún rẹ̀, ati fun ifẹ́ inurere ẹniti o gbé inu igbẹ́: jẹ ki ibukún ki o wá si ori Josefu, ati si atari ẹniti a yàsọtọ lãrin awọn arakunrin rẹ̀.
entries.en: And for the precious things of the earth and fulness thereof, and for the good will of him that dwelt in the bush: let the blessing come upon the head of Joseph, and upon the top of the head of him that was separated from his brethren.

entries.yo: Akọ́bi akọmalu rẹ̀, tirẹ̀ li ọlánla; iwo rẹ̀ iwo agbanrere ni: on ni yio fi tì awọn enia, gbogbo wọn, ani opin ilẹ: awọn si ni ẹgbẹgbãrun Efraimu, awọn si ni ẹgbẹgbẹrun Manasse.
entries.en: His glory is like the firstling of his bullock, and his horns are like the horns of unicorns: with them he shall push the people together to the ends of the earth: and they are the ten thousands of Ephraim, and they are the thousands of Manasseh.

entries.yo: Ati niti Sebuluni o wipe, Sebuluni, ma yọ̀ ni ijade rẹ; ati Issakari, ninu agọ́ rẹ.
entries.en: And of Zebulun he said, Rejoice, Zebulun, in thy going out; and, Issachar, in thy tents.

entries.yo: Nwọn o pè awọn enia na sori òke; nibẹ̀ ni nwọn o ru ẹbọ ododo: nitoripe nwọn o ma mu ninu ọ̀pọlọpọ okun, ati ninu iṣura ti a pamọ́ ninu iyanrin.
entries.en: They shall call the people unto the mountain; there they shall offer sacrifices of righteousness: for they shall suck of the abundance of the seas, and of treasures hid in the sand.

entries.yo: Ati niti Gadi o wipe, Ibukún ni fun ẹniti o mu Gadi gbilẹ: o ba bi abo-kiniun, o si fà apa ya, ani atari.
entries.en: And of Gad he said, Blessed be he that enlargeth Gad: he dwelleth as a lion, and teareth the arm with the crown of the head.

entries.yo: O si yàn apá ikini fun ara rẹ̀, nitoripe nibẹ̀ li a fi ipín olofin pamọ́ si; o si wá pẹlu awọn olori enia na, o si mú ododo OLUWA ṣẹ, ati idajọ rẹ̀ pẹlu Israeli.
entries.en: And he provided the first part for himself, because there, in a portion of the lawgiver, was he seated; and he came with the heads of the people, he executed the justice of the LORD, and his judgments with Israel.

entries.yo: Ati niti Dani o wipe, Ọmọ kiniun ni Dani: ti nfò lati Baṣani wá.
entries.en: And of Dan he said, Dan is a lion's whelp: he shall leap from Bashan.

entries.yo: Ati niti Naftali o wipe, Iwọ Naftali, ti ojurere tẹ́lọrùn, ti o si kún fun ibukún OLUWA: gbà ìha ìwọ-õrùn ati gusù.
entries.en: And of Naphtali he said, O Naphtali, satisfied with favour, and full with the blessing of the LORD: possess thou the west and the south.

entries.yo: Ati niti Aṣeri o wipe, Ibukún ọmọ niti Aṣeri; ki on ki o si jẹ́ itẹwọgba fun awọn arakunrin rẹ̀, ki on ki o si ma rì ẹsẹ̀ rẹ̀ sinu oróro.
entries.en: And of Asher he said, Let Asher be blessed with children; let him be acceptable to his brethren, and let him dip his foot in oil.

entries.yo: Bàta rẹ yio jasi irin ati idẹ; ati bi ọjọ́ rẹ, bẹ̃li agbara rẹ yio ri.
entries.en: Thy shoes shall be iron and brass; and as thy days, so shall thy strength be.

entries.yo: Kò sí ẹniti o dabi Ọlọrun, iwọ Jeṣuruni, ti ngùn ọrun fun iranlọwọ rẹ, ati ninu ọlanla rẹ̀ li oju-ọrun.
entries.en: There is none like unto the God of Jeshurun, who rideth upon the heaven in thy help, and in his excellency on the sky.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun aiyeraiye ni ibugbé rẹ, ati nisalẹ li apa aiyeraiye wà: on si tì ọtá kuro niwaju rẹ, o si wipe, Ma parun.
entries.en: The eternal God is thy refuge, and underneath are the everlasting arms: and he shall thrust out the enemy from before thee; and shall say, Destroy them.

entries.yo: Israeli si joko li alafia, orisun Jakobu nikan, ni ilẹ ọkà ati ti ọti-waini; pẹlupẹlu ọrun rẹ̀ nsẹ̀ ìri silẹ.
entries.en: Israel then shall dwell in safety alone: the fountain of Jacob shall be upon a land of corn and wine; also his heavens shall drop down dew.

entries.yo: Alafia ni fun iwọ, Israeli: tali o dabi rẹ, iwọ enia ti a ti ọwọ́ OLUWA gbàla, asà iranlọwọ rẹ, ati ẹniti iṣe idà ọlanla rẹ! awọn ọtá rẹ yio si tẹriba fun ọ; iwọ o si ma tẹ̀ ibi giga wọn mọlẹ.
entries.en: Happy art thou, O Israel: who is like unto thee, O people saved by the LORD, the shield of thy help, and who is the sword of thy excellency! and thine enemies shall be found liars unto thee; and thou shalt tread upon their high places.

entries.yo: MOSE si gòke lati pẹtẹlẹ̀ Moabu lọ si òke Nebo, si ori Pisga, ti o dojukọ Jeriko. OLUWA si fi gbogbo ilẹ Gileadi dé Dani hàn a;
entries.en: And Moses went up from the plains of Moab unto the mountain of Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, that is over against Jericho. And the LORD shewed him all the land of Gilead, unto Dan,

entries.yo: Ati gbogbo Naftali, ati ilẹ Efraimu, ati ti Manasse, ati gbogbo ilẹ Juda, dé okun ìwọ-õrùn;
entries.en: And all Naphtali, and the land of Ephraim, and Manasseh, and all the land of Judah, unto the utmost sea,

entries.yo: Ati gusù, ati pẹtẹlẹ̀ afonifoji Jeriko, ilu ọlọpẹ dé Soari.
entries.en: And the south, and the plain of the valley of Jericho, the city of palm trees, unto Zoar.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun u pe, Eyi ni ilẹ ti mo bura fun Abrahamu, fun Isaaki, ati fun Jakobu, wipe, Emi o fi i fun irú-ọmọ rẹ: emi mu ọ fi oju rẹ ri i, ṣugbọn iwọ ki yio rekọja lọ sibẹ̀.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto him, This is the land which I sware unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob, saying, I will give it unto thy seed: I have caused thee to see it with thine eyes, but thou shalt not go over thither.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Mose iranṣẹ OLUWA kú nibẹ̀ ni ilẹ Moabu, gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ OLUWA.
entries.en: So Moses the servant of the LORD died there in the land of Moab, according to the word of the LORD.

entries.yo: O si sin i ninu afonifoji ni ilẹ Moabu, ti o kọjusi Beti-peori; ṣugbọn kò sí ẹnikan ti o mọ̀ iboji rẹ̀ titi di oni-oloni.
entries.en: And he buried him in a valley in the land of Moab, over against Beth-peor: but no man knoweth of his sepulchre unto this day.

entries.yo: Mose si jẹ́ ẹni ọgọfa ọdún nigbati o kú: oju rẹ̀ kò ṣe baìbai, bẹ̃li agbara rẹ̀ kò dinku.
entries.en: And Moses was an hundred and twenty years old when he died: his eye was not dim, nor his natural force abated.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Israeli si sọkun Mose ni pẹtẹlẹ̀ Moabu li ọgbọ̀n ọjọ́: bẹ̃li ọjọ́ ẹkún ati ọ̀fọ Mose pari.
entries.en: And the children of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days: so the days of weeping and mourning for Moses were ended.

entries.yo: Joṣua ọmọ Nuni si kún fun ẹmi ọgbọ́n; nitoripe Mose ti fi ọwọ́ rẹ̀ lé e lori: awọn ọmọ Israeli si gbà tirẹ̀ gbọ́, nwọn si ṣe bi OLUWA ti paṣẹ fun Mose.
entries.en: And Joshua the son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom; for Moses had laid his hands upon him: and the children of Israel hearkened unto him, and did as the LORD commanded Moses.

entries.yo: Wolĩ kan kò si hù mọ́ ni Israeli bi Mose, ẹniti OLUWA mọ̀ li ojukoju,
entries.en: And there arose not a prophet since in Israel like unto Moses, whom the LORD knew face to face,

entries.yo: Ni gbogbo iṣẹ-àmi ati iṣẹ-iyanu, ti OLUWA rán a lati ṣe ni ilẹ Egipti, si Farao, ati si gbogbo awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀, ati si gbogbo ilẹ rẹ̀;
entries.en: In all the signs and the wonders, which the LORD sent him to do in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all his land,

entries.yo: Ati ni gbogbo ọwọ́ agbara, ati ni gbogbo ẹ̀ru nla ti Mose fihàn li oju gbogbo Israeli.
entries.en: And in all that mighty hand, and in all the great terror which Moses shewed in the sight of all Israel.

entries.yo: O si ṣe lẹhin ikú Mose iranṣẹ OLUWA, li OLUWA sọ fun Joṣua ọmọ Nuni, iranṣẹ Mose, wipe,
entries.en: Now after the death of Moses the servant of the LORD it came to pass, that the LORD spake unto Joshua the son of Nun, Moses' minister, saying,

entries.yo: Mose iranṣẹ mi kú; njẹ iwọ, dide, gòke Jordani yi, iwọ, ati gbogbo enia yi, si ilẹ ti mo fi fun wọn, ani fun awọn ọmọ Israeli.
entries.en: Moses my servant is dead; now therefore arise, go over this Jordan, thou, and all this people, unto the land which I do give to them, even to the children of Israel.

entries.yo: Ibi gbogbo ti atẹlẹsẹ̀ nyin ba tẹ̀, ẹnyin ni mo fi fun, gẹgẹ bi mo ti sọ fun Mose.
entries.en: Every place that the sole of your foot shall tread upon, that have I given unto you, as I said unto Moses.

entries.yo: Lati aginjù, ati Lebanoni yi, ani titi dé odò nla nì, odò Euferate, gbogbo ilẹ awọn Hitti, ati titi dé okun nla ni ìwọ-õrùn, eyi ni yio ṣe opin ilẹ nyin.
entries.en: From the wilderness and this Lebanon even unto the great river, the river Euphrates, all the land of the Hittites, and unto the great sea toward the going down of the sun, shall be your coast.

entries.yo: Ki yio sí ọkunrin kan ti yio le duro niwaju rẹ li ọjọ́ aiye rẹ gbogbo: gẹgẹ bi mo ti wà pẹlu Mose, bẹ̃li emi o si wà pẹlu rẹ: Emi ki yio fi ọ silẹ, bẹ̃li emi ki yio kọ̀ ọ.
entries.en: There shall not any man be able to stand before thee all the days of thy life: as I was with Moses, so I will be with thee: I will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.

entries.yo: Ṣe giri, ki o si mu àiya le: nitori iwọ ni yio pín ilẹ na fun awọn enia yi, ilẹ ti mo ti bura fun awọn baba wọn lati fi fun wọn.
entries.en: Be strong and of a good courage: for unto this people shalt thou divide for an inheritance the land, which I sware unto their fathers to give them.

entries.yo: Sá ṣe giri ki o si mu àiya le gidigidi, ki iwọ ki o le kiyesi ati ṣe gẹgẹ bi gbogbo ofin ti Mose iranṣẹ mi ti palaṣẹ fun ọ: má ṣe yà kuro ninu rẹ̀ si ọtún tabi si òsi, ki o le dara fun ọ nibikibi ti iwọ ba lọ.
entries.en: Only be thou strong and very courageous, that thou mayest observe to do according to all the law, which Moses my servant commanded thee: turn not from it to the right hand or to the left, that thou mayest prosper whithersoever thou goest.

entries.yo: Iwé ofin yi kò gbọdọ kuro li ẹnu rẹ, ṣugbọn iwọ o ma ṣe àṣaro ninu rẹ̀ li ọsán ati li oru, ki iwọ ki o le kiyesi ati ṣe gẹgẹ bi gbogbo eyiti a kọ sinu rẹ̀: nitori nigbana ni iwọ o ṣe ọ̀na rẹ ni rere, nigbana ni yio si dara fun ọ.
entries.en: This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth; but thou shalt meditate therein day and night, that thou mayest observe to do according to all that is written therein: for then thou shalt make thy way prosperous, and then thou shalt have good success.

entries.yo: Emi kò ha paṣẹ fun ọ bi? Ṣe giri ki o si mu àiya le; máṣe bẹ̀ru, bẹ̃ni ki àiya ki o máṣe fò ọ: nitoripe OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ wà pẹlu rẹ nibikibi ti iwọ ba nlọ.
entries.en: Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Joṣua paṣẹ fun awọn olori awọn enia wipe,
entries.en: Then Joshua commanded the officers of the people, saying,

entries.yo: Ẹ là ãrin ibudó já, ki ẹ si paṣẹ fun awọn enia, wipe, Ẹ pèse onjẹ; nitoripe ni ijọ́ mẹta oni ẹnyin o gòke Jordani yi, lati lọ gbà ilẹ ti OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin fi fun nyin lati ní.
entries.en: Pass through the host, and command the people, saying, Prepare you victuals; for within three days ye shall pass over this Jordan, to go in to possess the land, which the LORD your God giveth you to possess it.

entries.yo: Ati fun awọn ọmọ Reubeni, ati fun awọn ọmọ Gadi, ati fun àbọ ẹ̀ya Manasse, ni Joṣua wipe,
entries.en: And to the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to half the tribe of Manasseh, spake Joshua, saying,

entries.yo: Ranti ọ̀rọ ti Mose iranṣẹ OLUWA palaṣẹ fun nyin pe, OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin nfun nyin ni isimi, on o si fun nyin ni ilẹ yi.
entries.en: Remember the word which Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you, saying, The LORD your God hath given you rest, and hath given you this land.

entries.yo: Awọn obinrin nyin, ati awọn ọmọ wẹrẹ nyin, ati ohunọ̀sin nyin, yio joko ni ilẹ ti Mose fi fun nyin ni ìha ihin Jordani; ṣugbọn ẹnyin o gòke lọ niwaju awọn arakunrin nyin ni ihamọra, gbogbo awọn alagbara akọni, ẹnyin o si ràn wọn lọwọ,
entries.en: Your wives, your little ones, and your cattle, shall remain in the land which Moses gave you on this side Jordan; but ye shall pass before your brethren armed, all the mighty men of valour, and help them;

entries.yo: Titi OLUWA yio fi fun awọn arakunrin nyin ni isimi, gẹgẹ bi o ti fi fun nyin, ati ti awọn pẹlu yio fi gbà ilẹ na ti OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin fi fun wọn: nigbana li ẹnyin o pada si ilẹ iní nyin, ti Mose iranṣẹ OLUWA fi fun nyin ni ìha ihin Jordani ni ìha ìla-õrùn, ẹnyin o si ní i.
entries.en: Until the LORD have given your brethren rest, as he hath given you, and they also have possessed the land which the LORD your God giveth them: then ye shall return unto the land of your possession, and enjoy it, which Moses the LORD's servant gave you on this side Jordan toward the sunrising.

entries.yo: Nwọn si da Joṣua lohùn, wipe, Gbogbo ohun ti iwọ palaṣẹ fun wa li awa o ṣe, ibikibi ti iwọ ba rán wa lọ, li awa o lọ.
entries.en: And they answered Joshua, saying, All that thou commandest us we will do, and whithersoever thou sendest us, we will go.

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi awa ti gbọ́ ti Mose li ohun gbogbo, bẹ̃li awa o gbọ́ tirẹ: kìki ki OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ ki o wà pẹlu rẹ, gẹgẹ bi o ti wà pẹlu Mose.
entries.en: According as we hearkened unto Moses in all things, so will we hearken unto thee: only the LORD thy God be with thee, as he was with Moses.

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni ti o wù ki o ṣe ti o ba tapá si ofin rẹ, ti ki yio si gbọ́ ọ̀rọ rẹ li ohun gbogbo ti iwọ palaṣẹ fun u, pipa li a o pa a: kìki ki iwọ ṣe giri ki o si mu àiya le.
entries.en: Whosoever he be that doth rebel against thy commandment, and will not hearken unto thy words in all that thou commandest him, he shall be put to death: only be strong and of a good courage.

entries.yo: JOṢUA ọmọ Nuni si rán ọkunrin meji jade lati Ṣittimu yọ lọ ṣe amí, wipe, Ẹ lọ iwò ilẹ na, ati Jeriko. Nwọn si lọ, nwọn si dé ile panṣaga kan, ti a npè ni Rahabu, nwọn si wọ̀ nibẹ̀.
entries.en: And Joshua the son of Nun sent out of Shittim two men to spy secretly, saying, Go view the land, even Jericho. And they went, and came into an harlot's house, named Rahab, and lodged there.

entries.yo: A si sọ fun ọba Jeriko pe, Kiyesi i, awọn ọkunrin kan ninu awọn ọmọ Israeli dé ihinyi li alẹ yi lati rìn ilẹ yi wò.
entries.en: And it was told the king of Jericho, saying, Behold, there came men in hither to night of the children of Israel to search out the country.

entries.yo: Ọba Jeriko si ranṣẹ si Rahabu, wipe, Mú awọn ọkunrin nì ti o tọ̀ ọ wá, ti o wọ̀ inu ile rẹ jade wá: nitori nwọn wá lati rìn gbogbo ilẹ yi wò.
entries.en: And the king of Jericho sent unto Rahab, saying, Bring forth the men that are come to thee, which are entered into thine house: for they be come to search out all the country.

entries.yo: Obinrin na si mú awọn ọkunrin meji na, o si fi wọn pamọ́; o si wi bayi pe, Awọn ọkunrin kan wá sọdọ mi, ṣugbọn emi kò mọ̀ ibi ti nwọn ti wá.
entries.en: And the woman took the two men, and hid them, and said thus, There came men unto me, but I wist not whence they were:

entries.yo: O si ṣe li akokò ati tì ilẹkun ẹnubode, nigbati ilẹ ṣú, awọn ọkunrin na si jade lọ: ibi ti awọn ọkunrin na gbé lọ, emi kò mọ̀: ẹ lepa wọn kánkán; nitori ẹnyin o bá wọn.
entries.en: And it came to pass about the time of shutting of the gate, when it was dark, that the men went out: whither the men went I wot not: pursue after them quickly; for ye shall overtake them.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn o ti mú wọn gòke àja ile, o si fi poroporo ọ̀gbọ ti o ti tòjọ soke àja bò wọn mọlẹ.
entries.en: But she had brought them up to the roof of the house, and hid them with the stalks of flax, which she had laid in order upon the roof.

entries.yo: Awọn ọkunrin na lepa wọn li ọ̀na ti o lọ dé iwọ̀do Jordani: bi awọn ti nlepa wọn si ti jade lọ, nwọn tì ilẹkun ẹnubode.
entries.en: And the men pursued after them the way to Jordan unto the fords: and as soon as they which pursued after them were gone out, they shut the gate.

entries.yo: Ki nwọn ki o tó dubulẹ, o gòke tọ̀ wọn lọ loke àja;
entries.en: And before they were laid down, she came up unto them upon the roof;

entries.yo: O si wi fun awọn ọkunrin na pe, Emi mọ̀ pe OLUWA ti fun nyin ni ilẹ yi, ati pe ẹ̀ru nyin bà ni, ati pe ọkàn gbogbo awọn ara ilẹ yi di omi nitori nyin.
entries.en: And she said unto the men, I know that the LORD hath given you the land, and that your terror is fallen upon us, and that all the inhabitants of the land faint because of you.

entries.yo: Nitoripe awa ti gbọ́ bi OLUWA ti mu omi Okun Pupa gbẹ niwaju nyin, nigbati ẹnyin jade ni Egipti; ati ohun ti ẹnyin ṣe si awọn ọba meji ti awọn Amori, ti mbẹ ni ìha keji Jordani, Sihoni ati Ogu, ti ẹnyin parun tútu.
entries.en: For we have heard how the LORD dried up the water of the Red sea for you, when ye came out of Egypt; and what ye did unto the two kings of the Amorites, that were on the other side Jordan, Sihon and Og, whom ye utterly destroyed.

entries.yo: Lọgán bi awa ti gbọ́ nkan wọnyi, àiya wa já, bẹ̃ni kò si sí agbara kan ninu ọkunrin kan mọ́ nitori nyin; nitoripe OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin, on li Ọlọrun loke ọrun, ati nisalẹ aiye.
entries.en: And as soon as we had heard these things, our hearts did melt, neither did there remain any more courage in any man, because of you: for the LORD your God, he is God in heaven above, and in earth beneath.

entries.yo: Njẹ nitorina, emi bẹ̀ nyin, ẹ fi OLUWA bura fun mi, bi mo ti ṣe nyin li ore, ẹnyin o ṣe ore pẹlu fun ile baba mi, ẹnyin o si fun mi li àmi otitọ:
entries.en: Now therefore, I pray you, swear unto me by the LORD, since I have shewed you kindness, that ye will also shew kindness unto my father's house, and give me a true token:

entries.yo: Ati pe ẹnyin o pa baba mi mọ́ lãye, ati iya mi, ati awọn arakunrin mi, ati awọn arabinrin mi, ati ohun gbogbo ti nwọn ní, ki ẹnyin si gbà ẹmi wa lọwọ ikú.
entries.en: And that ye will save alive my father, and my mother, and my brethren, and my sisters, and all that they have, and deliver our lives from death.

entries.yo: Awọn ọkunrin na da a lohùn pe, Ẹmi wa ni yio dipò ti nyin, bi ẹnyin kò ba fi ọ̀ran wa yi hàn; yio si ṣe, nigbati OLUWA ba fun wa ni ilẹ na, awa o ṣe ore ati otitọ fun ọ.
entries.en: And the men answered her, Our life for yours, if ye utter not this our business. And it shall be, when the LORD hath given us the land, that we will deal kindly and truly with thee.

entries.yo: Nigbana li o fi okùn sọ̀ wọn kalẹ li oju-ferese: nitoriti ile rẹ̀ wà lara odi ilu, on a si ma gbé ori odi na.
entries.en: Then she let them down by a cord through the window: for her house was upon the town wall, and she dwelt upon the wall.

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ bọ sori òke, ki awọn alepa ki o má ba le nyin bá; ki ẹnyin si fara nyin pamọ́ nibẹ̀ ni ijọ́ mẹta, titi awọn alepa yio fi pada: lẹhin na ẹ ma ba ọ̀na ti nyin lọ.
entries.en: And she said unto them, Get you to the mountain, lest the pursuers meet you; and hide yourselves there three days, until the pursuers be returned: and afterward may ye go your way.

entries.yo: Awọn ọkunrin na wi fun u pe, Ara wa o dá niti ibura rẹ yi, ti iwọ mu wa bú.
entries.en: And the men said unto her, We will be blameless of this thine oath which thou hast made us swear.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, nigbati awa ba dé inu ilẹ na, iwọ o so okùn owú ododó yi si oju-ferese ti iwọ fi sọ̀ wa kalẹ: iwọ o si mú baba rẹ, ati iya rẹ, ati awọn arakunrin rẹ, ati gbogbo ara ile baba rẹ, wá ile sọdọ rẹ.
entries.en: Behold, when we come into the land, thou shalt bind this line of scarlet thread in the window which thou didst let us down by: and thou shalt bring thy father, and thy mother, and thy brethren, and all thy father's household, home unto thee.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, ẹnikẹni ti o ba jade lati inu ilẹkun ile rẹ lọ si ode, ẹ̀jẹ rẹ̀ yio wà li ori ara rẹ̀, awa o si wà li aijẹbi: ati ẹnikẹni ti o ba wà pẹlu rẹ ni ile, ẹ̀jẹ rẹ̀ yio wà li ori wa, bi ẹnikẹni ba fọwọkàn a.
entries.en: And it shall be, that whosoever shall go out of the doors of thy house into the street, his blood shall be upon his head, and we will be guiltless: and whosoever shall be with thee in the house, his blood shall be on our head, if any hand be upon him.

entries.yo: Bi o ba si sọ ọ̀ran wa yi, nigbana ni ara wa o dá niti ibura rẹ ti iwọ mu wa bú yi.
entries.en: And if thou utter this our business, then we will be quit of thine oath which thou hast made us to swear.

entries.yo: O si wipe, Gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ nyin, bẹ̃ni ki o ri. O si rán wọn lọ, nwọn si lọ: o si so okùn ododó na si oju-ferese.
entries.en: And she said, According unto your words, so be it. And she sent them away, and they departed: and she bound the scarlet line in the window.

entries.yo: Nwọn si lọ, nwọn si dé ori òke, nwọn si gbé ibẹ̀ ni ijọ́ mẹta, titi awọn alepa fi pada: awọn alepa wá wọn ni gbogbo ọ̀na, ṣugbọn nwọn kò ri wọn.
entries.en: And they went, and came unto the mountain, and abode there three days, until the pursuers were returned: and the pursuers sought them throughout all the way, but found them not.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li awọn ọkunrin meji na pada, nwọn si sọkalẹ lori òke, nwọn si kọja, nwọn si tọ̀ Joṣua ọmọ Nuni wá; nwọn si sọ ohun gbogbo ti o bá wọn fun u.
entries.en: So the two men returned, and descended from the mountain, and passed over, and came to Joshua the son of Nun, and told him all things that befell them:

entries.yo: Nwọn si wi fun Joṣua pe, Nitõtọ li OLUWA ti fi gbogbo ilẹ na lé wa lọwọ; nitoripe ọkàn gbogbo awọn ara ilẹ yi di omi nitori wa.
entries.en: And they said unto Joshua, Truly the LORD hath delivered into our hands all the land; for even all the inhabitants of the country do faint because of us.

entries.yo: JOṢUA si dide ni kùtukutu owurọ̀, nwọn si ṣí kuro ni Ṣittimu, nwọn si dé Jordani, on ati gbogbo awọn ọmọ Israeli; nwọn si sùn sibẹ̀ ki nwọn ki o to gòke odò.
entries.en: And Joshua rose early in the morning; and they removed from Shittim, and came to Jordan, he and all the children of Israel, and lodged there before they passed over.

entries.yo: O si ṣe lẹhin ijọ́ mẹta, ni awọn olori là ãrin ibudó já;
entries.en: And it came to pass after three days, that the officers went through the host;

entries.yo: Nwọn si paṣẹ fun awọn enia, wipe, Nigbati ẹnyin ba ri apoti majẹmu OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin, ti ẹ ba si ri awọn alufa awọn ọmọ Lefi rù u, nigbana li ẹnyin o ṣí kuro ni ipò nyin, ẹnyin o si ma tọ̀ ọ lẹhin.
entries.en: And they commanded the people, saying, When ye see the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God, and the priests the Levites bearing it, then ye shall remove from your place, and go after it.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn alafo yio wà li agbedemeji ti ẹnyin tirẹ̀, to bi ìwọn ẹgba igbọnwọ: ẹ má ṣe sunmọ ọ, ki ẹnyin ki o le mọ̀ ọ̀na ti ẹnyin o gbà; nitoriti ẹnyin kò gbà ọ̀na yi rí.
entries.en: Yet there shall be a space between you and it, about two thousand cubits by measure: come not near unto it, that ye may know the way by which ye must go: for ye have not passed this way heretofore.

entries.yo: Joṣua si wi fun awọn enia pe, Ẹ yà ara nyin simimọ́: nitori li ọla OLUWA yio ṣe ohuniyanu lãrin nyin.
entries.en: And Joshua said unto the people, Sanctify yourselves: for to morrow the LORD will do wonders among you.

entries.yo: Joṣua si wi fun awọn alufa pe, Ẹ gbé apoti majẹmu na, ki ẹ si kọja siwaju awọn enia. Nwọn si gbé apoti majẹmu na, nwọn si ṣaju awọn enia.
entries.en: And Joshua spake unto the priests, saying, Take up the ark of the covenant, and pass over before the people. And they took up the ark of the covenant, and went before the people.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun Joṣua pe, Li oni yi li emi o bẹ̀rẹsi gbé ọ ga li oju gbogbo Israeli, ki nwọn ki o le mọ̀ pe, gẹgẹ bi mo ti wà pẹlu Mose, bẹ̃li emi o wà pẹlu rẹ.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Joshua, This day will I begin to magnify thee in the sight of all Israel, that they may know that, as I was with Moses, so I will be with thee.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si paṣẹ fun awọn alufa ti o rù apoti majẹmu na pe, Nigbati ẹnyin ba dé eti odò Jordani, ki ẹnyin ki o duro jẹ ni Jordani.
entries.en: And thou shalt command the priests that bear the ark of the covenant, saying, When ye are come to the brink of the water of Jordan, ye shall stand still in Jordan.

entries.yo: Joṣua si wi fun awọn ọmọ Israeli pe, Ẹ sunmọ ihin, ki ẹ si gbọ́ ọ̀rọ OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin.
entries.en: And Joshua said unto the children of Israel, Come hither, and hear the words of the LORD your God.

entries.yo: Joṣua si wipe, Nipa eyi li ẹnyin o mọ̀ pe Ọlọrun alãye mbẹ lãrin nyin, ati pe dajudaju on o lé awọn ara Kenaani, ati awọn Hitti, ati awọn Hifi, ati awọn Perissi, ati awọn Girgaṣi ati awọn Amori, ati awọn Jebusi, kuro niwaju nyin.
entries.en: And Joshua said, Hereby ye shall know that the living God is among you, and that he will without fail drive out from before you the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Hivites, and the Perizzites, and the Girgashites, and the Amorites, and the Jebusites.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, apoti majẹmu OLUWA gbogbo aiye ngòke lọ ṣaju nyin lọ si Jordani.
entries.en: Behold, the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth passeth over before you into Jordan.

entries.yo: Njẹ nitorina, ẹ mu ọkunrin mejila ninu awọn ẹ̀ya Israeli, ọkunrin kan ninu olukuluku ẹ̀ya.
entries.en: Now therefore take you twelve men out of the tribes of Israel, out of every tribe a man.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, lojukanna bi atẹlẹsẹ̀ awọn alufa ti o rù apoti OLUWA, Oluwa gbogbo aiye, ba ti tẹ̀ omi Jordani, omi Jordani yio ke kuro, ani omi ti nti òke ṣànwá; yio si duro bi òkiti kan.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass, as soon as the soles of the feet of the priests that bear the ark of the LORD, the Lord of all the earth, shall rest in the waters of Jordan, that the waters of Jordan shall be cut off from the waters that come down from above; and they shall stand upon an heap.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati awọn enia ṣí kuro ninu agọ́ wọn, lati gòke Jordani, ti awọn alufa si rù apoti majẹmu wà niwaju awọn enia;
entries.en: And it came to pass, when the people removed from their tents, to pass over Jordan, and the priests bearing the ark of the covenant before the people;

entries.yo: Bi awọn ti o rù apoti si ti dé Jordani, ti awọn alufa ti o rù apoti na si tẹ̀ ẹsẹ̀ wọn bọ̀ eti omi na, (nitoripe odò Jordani a ma kún bò gbogbo bèbe rẹ̀ ni gbogbo akokò ikore,)
entries.en: And as they that bare the ark were come unto Jordan, and the feet of the priests that bare the ark were dipped in the brim of the water, (for Jordan overfloweth all his banks all the time of harvest,)

entries.yo: Ni omi ti nti oke ṣàn wá duro, o si ga jìna rére bi òkiti li ọnà ni ilu Adamu, ti o wà lẹba Saretani: eyiti o si ṣàn sodò si ìha okun pẹtẹlẹ̀, ani Okun Iyọ̀, a ke wọn kuro patapata: awọn enia si gòke tàra si Jeriko.
entries.en: That the waters which came down from above stood and rose up upon an heap very far from the city Adam, that is beside Zaretan: and those that came down toward the sea of the plain, even the salt sea, failed, and were cut off: and the people passed over right against Jericho.

entries.yo: Awọn alufa ti o rù apoti majẹmu OLUWA, si duro ṣinṣin lori ilẹ gbigbẹ lãrin Jordani, ati gbogbo awọn enia Israeli kọja lori ilẹ gbigbẹ, titi gbogbo awọn enia na fi gòke Jordani tán.
entries.en: And the priests that bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD stood firm on dry ground in the midst of Jordan, and all the Israelites passed over on dry ground, until all the people were passed clean over Jordan.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati gbogbo awọn enia rekọja Jordani tán, ni OLUWA wi fun Joṣua pe,
entries.en: And it came to pass, when all the people were clean passed over Jordan, that the LORD spake unto Joshua, saying,

entries.yo: Mú ọkunrin mejila ninu awọn enia, ọkunrin kan ninu olukuluku ẹ̀ya,
entries.en: Take you twelve men out of the people, out of every tribe a man,

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin si paṣẹ fun wọn pe. Ẹ gbé okuta mejila lati ihin lọ lãrin Jordani, ni ibi ti ẹsẹ̀ awọn alufa gbé duro ṣinṣin nì, ki ẹnyin ki o si rù wọn kọja pẹlu nyin, ẹ si fi wọn si ibùsun, ni ibi ti ẹnyin o sùn li alẹ yi.
entries.en: And command ye them, saying, Take you hence out of the midst of Jordan, out of the place where the priests' feet stood firm, twelve stones, and ye shall carry them over with you, and leave them in the lodging place, where ye shall lodge this night.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Joṣua pè awọn ọkunrin mejila, ti o ti pèse silẹ ninu awọn ọmọ Israeli, ọkunrin kan ninu olukuluku ẹ̀ya:
entries.en: Then Joshua called the twelve men, whom he had prepared of the children of Israel, out of every tribe a man:

entries.yo: Joṣua si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ kọja lọ niwaju apoti OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin si ãrin Jordani, ki olukuluku ninu nyin ki o gbé okuta kọkan lé ejika rẹ̀, gẹgẹ bi iye ẹ̀ya awọn ọmọ Israeli:
entries.en: And Joshua said unto them, Pass over before the ark of the LORD your God into the midst of Jordan, and take ye up every man of you a stone upon his shoulder, according unto the number of the tribes of the children of Israel:

entries.yo: Ki eyi ki o le jẹ́ àmi lãrin nyin, nigbati awọn ọmọ nyin ba bère lọwọ awọn baba wọn lẹhin ọ̀la, wipe, Èredi okuta wọnyi?
entries.en: That this may be a sign among you, that when your children ask their fathers in time to come, saying, What mean ye by these stones?

entries.yo: Nigbana li ẹnyin o da wọn lohùn pe, Nitori a ke omi Jordani niwaju apoti majẹmu OLUWA; nigbati o rekọja Jordani, a ke omi Jordani kuro: okuta wọnyi yio si jasi iranti fun awọn ọmọ Israeli lailai.
entries.en: Then ye shall answer them, That the waters of Jordan were cut off before the ark of the covenant of the LORD; when it passed over Jordan, the waters of Jordan were cut off: and these stones shall be for a memorial unto the children of Israel for ever.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Israeli si ṣe gẹgẹ bi Joṣua ti paṣẹ, nwọn si gbé okuta mejila lati inu ãrin Jordani lọ, bi OLUWA ti wi fun Joṣua, gẹgẹ bi iye ẹ̀ya awọn ọmọ Israeli; nwọn si rù wọn kọja pẹlu wọn lọ si ibùsun, nwọn si gbé wọn kalẹ nibẹ̀.
entries.en: And the children of Israel did so as Joshua commanded, and took up twelve stones out of the midst of Jordan, as the LORD spake unto Joshua, according to the number of the tribes of the children of Israel, and carried them over with them unto the place where they lodged, and laid them down there.

entries.yo: Joṣua si tò okuta mejila jọ lãrin Jordani, ni ibi ti ẹsẹ̀ awọn alufa ti o rù apoti majẹmu na gbé duro: nwọn si mbẹ nibẹ̀ titi di oni-oloni.
entries.en: And Joshua set up twelve stones in the midst of Jordan, in the place where the feet of the priests which bare the ark of the covenant stood: and they are there unto this day.

entries.yo: Nitoriti awọn alufa ti o rù apoti na duro lãrin Jordani, titi ohun gbogbo fi pari ti OLUWA palaṣẹ fun Joṣua lati sọ fun awọn enia, gẹgẹ bi gbogbo eyiti Mose palaṣẹ fun Joṣua: awọn enia na si yára nwọn si rekọja.
entries.en: For the priests which bare the ark stood in the midst of Jordan, until everything was finished that the LORD commanded Joshua to speak unto the people, according to all that Moses commanded Joshua: and the people hasted and passed over.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati gbogbo awọn enia na rekọja tán, ni apoti OLUWA rekọja, ati awọn alufa, li oju awọn enia.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when all the people were clean passed over, that the ark of the LORD passed over, and the priests, in the presence of the people.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Reubeni, ati awọn ọmọ Gadi, ati àbọ ẹ̀ya Manasse, si rekọja ni ihamọra niwaju awọn ọmọ Israeli, gẹgẹ bi Mose ti sọ fun wọn:
entries.en: And the children of Reuben, and the children of Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh, passed over armed before the children of Israel, as Moses spake unto them:

entries.yo: Ìwọn ọkẹ meji enia ti o mura ogun, rekọja niwaju OLUWA fun ogun, si pẹtẹlẹ̀ Jeriko.
entries.en: About forty thousand prepared for war passed over before the LORD unto battle, to the plains of Jericho.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ́ na OLUWA gbé Joṣua ga li oju gbogbo Israeli: nwọn si bẹ̀ru rẹ̀, gẹgẹ bi nwọn ti bẹ̀ru Mose li ọjọ́ aiye rẹ̀ gbogbo.
entries.en: On that day the LORD magnified Joshua in the sight of all Israel; and they feared him, as they feared Moses, all the days of his life.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun Joṣua pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Joshua, saying,

entries.yo: Paṣẹ fun awọn alufa ti o rù apoti ẹri nì pe, ki nwọn ki o ti inu Jordani jade.
entries.en: Command the priests that bear the ark of the testimony, that they come up out of Jordan.

entries.yo: Nitorina Joṣua paṣẹ fun awọn alufa wipe, Ẹ ti inu Jordani jade.
entries.en: Joshua therefore commanded the priests, saying, Come ye up out of Jordan.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati awọn alufa ti o rù apoti majẹmu OLUWA ti ãrin Jordani jade, ti awọn alufa si gbé atẹlẹsẹ̀ wọn soke si ilẹ gbigbẹ, ni omi Jordani pada si ipò rẹ̀, o si ṣàn bò gbogbo bèbe rẹ̀, gẹgẹ bi ti iṣaju.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when the priests that bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD were come up out of the midst of Jordan, and the soles of the priests' feet were lifted up unto the dry land, that the waters of Jordan returned unto their place, and flowed over all his banks, as they did before.

entries.yo: Awọn enia si ti inu Jordani gòke ni ijọ́ kẹwa oṣù kini, nwọn si dó ni Gilgali, ni ìha ìla-õrùn Jeriko.
entries.en: And the people came up out of Jordan on the tenth day of the first month, and encamped in Gilgal, in the east border of Jericho.

entries.yo: Ati okuta mejila wọnni ti nwọn gbé ti inu Jordani lọ, ni Joṣua tòjọ ni Gilgali.
entries.en: And those twelve stones, which they took out of Jordan, did Joshua pitch in Gilgal.

entries.yo: O si wi fun awọn ọmọ Israeli pe, Nigbati awọn ọmọ nyin yio bère lọwọ awọn baba wọn lẹhin ọ̀la wipe, Ẽredi okuta wọnyi?
entries.en: And he spake unto the children of Israel, saying, When your children shall ask their fathers in time to come, saying, What mean these stones?

entries.yo: Nigbana li ẹnyin o jẹ ki awọn ọmọ nyin ki o mọ̀ pe, Israeli là Jordani yi kọja ni ilẹ gbigbẹ.
entries.en: Then ye shall let your children know, saying, Israel came over this Jordan on dry land.

entries.yo: Nitoriti OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin mu omi Jordani gbẹ kuro niwaju nyin, titi ẹnyin fi là a kọja, gẹgẹ bi OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin ti ṣe si Okun Pupa, ti o mu gbẹ kuro niwaju wa, titi awa fi là a kọja:
