entries.en: For the LORD your God dried up the waters of Jordan from before you, until ye were passed over, as the LORD your God did to the Red sea, which he dried up from before us, until we were gone over:

entries.yo: Ki gbogbo enia aiye ki o le mọ ọwọ́ OLUWA, pe o lagbara; ki nwọn ki o le ma bẹ̀ru OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin lailai.
entries.en: That all the people of the earth might know the hand of the LORD, that it is mighty: that ye might fear the LORD your God for ever.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati gbogbo awọn ọba Amori, ti o wà ni ìha keji Jordani ni ìwọ-õrùn, ati gbogbo awọn ọba Kenaani ti mbẹ leti okun, gbọ́ pe OLUWA ti mu omi Jordani gbẹ kuro niwaju awọn ọmọ Israeli, titi awa fi là a kọja, ni àiya wọn já, bẹ̃li ẹmi kò sí ninu wọn mọ́, nitori awọn ọmọ Israeli.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when all the kings of the Amorites, which were on the side of Jordan westward, and all the kings of the Canaanites, which were by the sea, heard that the LORD had dried up the waters of Jordan from before the children of Israel, until we were passed over, that their heart melted, neither was there spirit in them any more, because of the children of Israel.

entries.yo: Nigbana li OLUWA wi fun Joṣua pe, Fi okuta ṣe abẹ ki iwọ ki o si tun kọ awọn ọmọ Israeli nilà lẹ̃keji.
entries.en: At that time the LORD said unto Joshua, Make thee sharp knives, and circumcise again the children of Israel the second time.

entries.yo: Joṣua si ṣe abẹ okuta, o si kọ awọn ọmọ Israeli nilà, ni Gibeati-haaralotu.
entries.en: And Joshua made him sharp knives, and circumcised the children of Israel at the hill of the foreskins.

entries.yo: Idí rẹ̀ li eyi ti Joṣua fi kọ wọn nilà: gbogbo awọn enia ti o ti Egipti jade wá, ti o ṣe ọkunrin, ani gbogbo awọn ọmọ-ogun, nwọn kú li aginjù, li ọ̀na, lẹhin igbati nwọn jade kuro ni Egipti.
entries.en: And this is the cause why Joshua did circumcise: All the people that came out of Egypt, that were males, even all the men of war, died in the wilderness by the way, after they came out of Egypt.

entries.yo: Nitori gbogbo awọn enia ti o jade ti ibẹ̀ wà, a kọ wọn nilà: ṣugbọn gbogbo awọn enia ti a bi li aginjù li ọ̀na, bi nwọn ti jade kuro ni Egipti, awọn ni a kò kọnilà.
entries.en: Now all the people that came out were circumcised: but all the people that were born in the wilderness by the way as they came forth out of Egypt, them they had not circumcised.

entries.yo: Nitoriti awọn ọmọ Israeli rìn li ogoji ọdún li aginjù, titi gbogbo iran na, ani awọn ologun, ti o jade ti Egipti wá fi run, nitoriti nwọn kò gbà ohùn OLUWA gbọ́: awọn ti OLUWA bura fun pe, on ki yio jẹ ki wọn ri ilẹ na, ti OLUWA bura fun awọn baba wọn lati fi fun wa, ilẹ ti nṣàn fun warà ati fun oyin.
entries.en: For the children of Israel walked forty years in the wilderness, till all the people that were men of war, which came out of Egypt, were consumed, because they obeyed not the voice of the LORD: unto whom the LORD sware that he would not shew them the land, which the LORD sware unto their fathers that he would give us, a land that floweth with milk and honey.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ wọn, ti o gbé dide ni ipò wọn, awọn ni Joṣua kọnilà: nitoriti nwọn wà li alaikọlà, nitoriti a kò kọ wọn nilà li ọ̀na.
entries.en: And their children, whom he raised up in their stead, them Joshua circumcised: for they were uncircumcised, because they had not circumcised them by the way.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati nwọn kọ gbogbo awọn enia na nilà tán, nwọn joko ni ipò wọn ni ibudó, titi ara wọn fi dá.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when they had done circumcising all the people, that they abode in their places in the camp, till they were whole.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun Joṣua pe, Li oni ni mo yi ẹ̀gan Egipti kuro lori nyin. Nitorina li a ṣe npè orukọ ibẹ̀ ni Gilgali titi o fi di oni yi.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Joshua, This day have I rolled away the reproach of Egypt from off you. Wherefore the name of the place is called Gilgal unto this day.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Israeli si dó ni Gilgali; nwọn si ṣe ajọ irekọja li ọjọ́ kẹrinla oṣù li ọjọ́ alẹ, ni pẹtẹlẹ̀ Jeriko.
entries.en: And the children of Israel encamped in Gilgal, and kept the passover on the fourteenth day of the month at even in the plains of Jericho.

entries.yo: Nwọn si jẹ ọkà gbigbẹ ilẹ na ni ijọ́ keji lẹhin irekọja, àkara alaiwu, ọkà didin li ọjọ̀ na gan.
entries.en: And they did eat of the old corn of the land on the morrow after the passover, unleavened cakes, and parched corn in the selfsame day.

entries.yo: Manna si dá ni ijọ́ keji lẹhin igbati nwọn ti jẹ okà gbigbẹ ilẹ na; awọn ọmọ Israeli kò si ri manna mọ́; ṣugbọn nwọn jẹ eso ilẹ Kenaani li ọdún na.
entries.en: And the manna ceased on the morrow after they had eaten of the old corn of the land; neither had the children of Israel manna any more; but they did eat of the fruit of the land of Canaan that year.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati Joṣua wà leti Jeriko, o gbé oju rẹ̀ soke o si wò, si kiyesi i, ọkunrin kan duro niwaju rẹ̀ pẹlu idà fifayọ li ọwọ́ rẹ̀: Joṣua si tọ̀ ọ lọ, o si wi fun u pe, Ti wa ni iwọ nṣe, tabi ti ọtá wa?
entries.en: And it came to pass, when Joshua was by Jericho, that he lifted up his eyes and looked, and, behold, there stood a man over against him with his sword drawn in his hand: and Joshua went unto him, and said unto him, Art thou for us, or for our adversaries?

entries.yo: O si wipe, Bẹ̃kọ; ṣugbọn bi olori ogun OLUWA ni mo wá si nisisiyi. Joṣua si wolẹ niwaju rẹ̀, o si foribalẹ, o si wi fun pe, Kili oluwa mi ni isọ fun iranṣẹ rẹ̀?
entries.en: And he said, Nay; but as captain of the host of the LORD am I now come. And Joshua fell on his face to the earth, and did worship, and said unto him, What saith my lord unto his servant?

entries.yo: Olori-ogun OLUWA si wi fun Joṣua pe, Bọ́ salubata rẹ kuro li ẹsẹ̀ rẹ; nitoripe ibi ti iwọ gbé duro nì ibi mimọ́ ni. Joṣua si ṣe bẹ̃.
entries.en: And the captain of the LORD's host said unto Joshua, Loose thy shoe from off thy foot; for the place whereon thou standest is holy. And Joshua did so.

entries.yo: (NJẸ a há Jeriko mọ́ gága nitori awọn ọmọ Israeli: ẹnikẹni kò jade, ẹnikẹni kò si wọle.)
entries.en: Now Jericho was straitly shut up because of the children of Israel: none went out, and none came in.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun Joṣua pe, Wò o, mo ti fi Jeriko lé ọ lọwọ, ati ọba rẹ̀, ati awọn alagbara akọni.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Joshua, See, I have given into thine hand Jericho, and the king thereof, and the mighty men of valour.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin o si ká ilu na mọ́, gbogbo ẹnyin ologun, ẹnyin o si yi ilu na ká lẹ̃kan. Bayi ni iwọ o ṣe ni ijọ́ mẹfa.
entries.en: And ye shall compass the city, all ye men of war, and go round about the city once. Thus shalt thou do six days.

entries.yo: Alufa meje yio gbé ipè jubeli meje niwaju apoti na: ni ijọ́ keje ẹnyin o si yi ilu na ká lẹ̃meje, awọn alufa yio si fọn ipè wọnni.
entries.en: And seven priests shall bear before the ark seven trumpets of rams' horns: and the seventh day ye shall compass the city seven times, and the priests shall blow with the trumpets.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, nigbati nwọn ba fọn ipè jubeli kikan, nigbati ẹnyin ba si gbọ́ iró ipè na, gbogbo awọn enia yio si hó kũ; odi ilu na yio si wó lulẹ, bẹrẹ, awọn enia yio si gòke lọ tàra, olukuluku niwaju rẹ̀.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass, that when they make a long blast with the ram's horn, and when ye hear the sound of the trumpet, all the people shall shout with a great shout; and the wall of the city shall fall down flat, and the people shall ascend up every man straight before him.

entries.yo: Joṣua ọmọ Nuni si pè awọn alufa, o si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ gbé apoti majẹmu na, ki alufa meje ki o gbé ipè jubeli meje nì niwaju apoti OLUWA.
entries.en: And Joshua the son of Nun called the priests, and said unto them, Take up the ark of the covenant, and let seven priests bear seven trumpets of rams' horns before the ark of the LORD.

entries.yo: O si wi fun awọn enia pe, Ẹ kọja, ki ẹ si yi ilu na ká, ki awọn ti o hamọra ki o si kọja niwaju apoti OLUWA.
entries.en: And he said unto the people, Pass on, and compass the city, and let him that is armed pass on before the ark of the LORD.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati Joṣua wi fun awọn enia tán, awọn alufa meje ti o gbé ipè jubeli meje, kọja niwaju OLUWA nwọn si fọn ipè wọnni: apoti majẹmu OLUWA si tẹle wọn.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when Joshua had spoken unto the people, that the seven priests bearing the seven trumpets of rams' horns passed on before the LORD, and blew with the trumpets: and the ark of the covenant of the LORD followed them.

entries.yo: Awọn ti o hamọra si lọ niwaju awọn alufa, ti nfọn ipè, ogun-ẹhin si ntọ̀ apoti lẹhin, awọn alufa nlọ nwọn si nfọn ipè.
entries.en: And the armed men went before the priests that blew with the trumpets, and the rereward came after the ark, the priests going on, and blowing with the trumpets.

entries.yo: Joṣua si paṣẹ fun awọn enia wipe, Ẹ kò gbọdọ hó bẹ̃li ẹ kò gbọdọ pariwo, bẹ̃li ọ̀rọ kan kò gbọdọ jade li ẹnu nyin, titi ọjọ́ ti emi o wi fun nyin pe, ẹ hó; nigbana li ẹnyin o hó.
entries.en: And Joshua had commanded the people, saying, Ye shall not shout, nor make any noise with your voice, neither shall any word proceed out of your mouth, until the day I bid you shout; then shall ye shout.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li o mu ki apoti OLUWA ki o yi ilu na ká, o yi i ká lẹ̃kan: nwọn si lọ si ibudó, nwọn si wọ̀ ni ibudó.
entries.en: So the ark of the LORD compassed the city, going about it once: and they came into the camp, and lodged in the camp.

entries.yo: Joṣua si dide ni kùtukutu owurọ̀, awọn alufa si gbé apoti OLUWA.
entries.en: And Joshua rose early in the morning, and the priests took up the ark of the LORD.

entries.yo: Awọn alufa meje ti o gbé ipè jubeli meje niwaju apoti OLUWA nlọ titi, nwọn si nfọn ipè wọnni: awọn ti o hamọra-ogun nlọ niwaju wọn; ogun-ẹhin si ntọ̀ apoti OLUWA lẹhin, awọn alufa si nfọn ipè bi nwọn ti nlọ.
entries.en: And seven priests bearing seven trumpets of rams' horns before the ark of the LORD went on continually, and blew with the trumpets: and the armed men went before them; but the rereward came after the ark of the LORD, the priests going on, and blowing with the trumpets.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ́ keji nwọn yi ilu na ká lẹ̃kan, nwọn si pada si ibudó: bẹ̃ni nwọn ṣe ni ijọ́ mẹfa.
entries.en: And the second day they compassed the city once, and returned into the camp: so they did six days.

entries.yo: O si ṣe ni ijọ́ keje, nwọn dide ni kùtukutu li afẹmọjumọ́, nwọn si yi ilu na ká gẹgẹ bi ti iṣaju lẹ̃meje: li ọjọ́ na nikanṣoṣo ni nwọn yi ilu na ká lẹ̃meje.
entries.en: And it came to pass on the seventh day, that they rose early about the dawning of the day, and compassed the city after the same manner seven times: only on that day they compassed the city seven times.

entries.yo: O si ṣe ni ìgba keje, nigbati awọn alufa fọn ipè, ni Joṣua wi fun awọn enia pe, Ẹ hó; nitoriti OLUWA ti fun nyin ni ilu na.
entries.en: And it came to pass at the seventh time, when the priests blew with the trumpets, Joshua said unto the people, Shout; for the LORD hath given you the city.

entries.yo: Ilu na yio si jẹ́ ìyasọtọ si OLUWA, on ati gbogbo ohun ti mbẹ ninu rẹ̀: kìki Rahabu panṣaga ni yio là, on ati gbogbo awọn ti mbẹ ni ile pẹlu rẹ̀, nitoriti o pa awọn onṣẹ ti a rán mọ́.
entries.en: And the city shall be accursed, even it, and all that are therein, to the LORD: only Rahab the harlot shall live, she and all that are with her in the house, because she hid the messengers that we sent.

entries.yo: Ati ẹnyin, bi o ti wù ki o ri, ẹ pa ara nyin mọ́ kuro ninu ohun ìyasọtọ, ki ẹ má ba yà a sọ̀tọ tán ki ẹ si mú ninu ohun ìyasọtọ na; ẹnyin a si sọ ibudó Israeli di ifibu, ẹnyin a si mu iyọnu bá a.
entries.en: And ye, in any wise keep yourselves from the accursed thing, lest ye make yourselves accursed, when ye take of the accursed thing, and make the camp of Israel a curse, and trouble it.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn gbogbo fadakà, ati wurà, ati ohunèlo idẹ ati ti irin, mimọ́ ni fun OLUWA: nwọn o wá sinu iṣura OLUWA.
entries.en: But all the silver, and gold, and vessels of brass and iron, are consecrated unto the LORD: they shall come into the treasury of the LORD.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li awọn enia na hó, nigbati awọn alufa fọn ipè: o si ṣe, nigbati awọn enia gbọ́ iró ipè, ti awọn enia si hó kũ, odi na wólulẹ bẹrẹ, bẹ̃li awọn enia wọ̀ inu ilu na lọ, olukuluku tàra niwaju rẹ̀, nwọn si kó ilu na.
entries.en: So the people shouted when the priests blew with the trumpets: and it came to pass, when the people heard the sound of the trumpet, and the people shouted with a great shout, that the wall fell down flat, so that the people went up into the city, every man straight before him, and they took the city.

entries.yo: Nwọn si fi oju idà pa gbogbo ohun ti o wà ni ilu na run, ati ọkunrin ati obinrin, ati ewe ati àgba, ati akọ-mãlu, ati agutan, ati kẹtẹkẹtẹ.
entries.en: And they utterly destroyed all that was in the city, both man and woman, young and old, and ox, and sheep, and ass, with the edge of the sword.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Joṣua sọ fun awọn ọkunrin meji ti o ti ṣe amí ilẹ na pe, Ẹ lọ si ile panṣaga nì, ki ẹ si mú obinrin na jade nibẹ̀, ati ohun gbogbo ti o ní, gẹgẹ bi ẹnyin ti bura fun u.
entries.en: But Joshua had said unto the two men that had spied out the country, Go into the harlot's house, and bring out thence the woman, and all that she hath, as ye sware unto her.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọkunrin ti o ṣamí si wọle, nwọn si mú Rahabu jade, ati baba rẹ̀, ati iya rẹ̀, ati awọn arakunrin rẹ̀, ati ohun gbogbo ti o ní, nwọn si mú gbogbo awọn ibatan rẹ̀ jade; nwọn si fi wọn si ẹhin ibudó Israeli.
entries.en: And the young men that were spies went in, and brought Rahab, and her father, and her mother, and her brethren, and all that she had; and they brought out all her kindred, and left them without the camp of Israel.

entries.yo: Nwọn si fi iná kun ilu na ati ohun gbogbo ti mbẹ ninu rẹ̀; kìki fadakà, ati wurà, ati ohunèlo idẹ ati irin, ni nwọn fi sinu iṣura ile OLUWA.
entries.en: And they burnt the city with fire, and all that was therein: only the silver, and the gold, and the vessels of brass and of iron, they put into the treasury of the house of the LORD.

entries.yo: Joṣua si gbà Rahabu panṣaga là, ati ara ile baba rẹ̀, ati ohun gbogbo ti o ní; o si joko lãrin Israeli titi di oni-oloni; nitoriti o pa awọn onṣẹ mọ́ ti Joṣua rán lọ ṣamí Jeriko.
entries.en: And Joshua saved Rahab the harlot alive, and her father's household, and all that she had; and she dwelleth in Israel even unto this day; because she hid the messengers, which Joshua sent to spy out Jericho.

entries.yo: Joṣua si gégun li akokò na wipe, Egún ni fun ọkunrin na niwaju OLUWA ti yio dide, ti yio si kọ ilu Jeriko yi: pẹlu ikú akọ́bi rẹ̀ ni yio fi pilẹ rẹ̀, ati pẹlu ikú abikẹhin rẹ̀ ni yio fi gbé ilẹkun ibode rẹ̀ ró.
entries.en: And Joshua adjured them at that time, saying, Cursed be the man before the LORD, that riseth up and buildeth this city Jericho: he shall lay the foundation thereof in his firstborn, and in his youngest son shall he set up the gates of it.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni OLUWA wà pẹlu Joṣua; okikí rẹ̀ si kàn ká gbogbo ilẹ na.
entries.en: So the LORD was with Joshua; and his fame was noised throughout all the country.

entries.yo: ṢUGBỌN awọn ọmọ Israeli dẹ́ṣẹ kan niti ohun ìyasọtọ: nitoriti Akani, ọmọ Karmi, ọmọ Sabdi, ọmọ Sera, ẹ̀ya Juda, mú ninu ohun ìyasọtọ: ibinu OLUWA si rú si awọn ọmọ Israeli.
entries.en: But the children of Israel committed a trespass in the accursed thing: for Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, took of the accursed thing: and the anger of the LORD was kindled against the children of Israel.

entries.yo: Joṣua si rán enia lati Jeriko lọ si Ai, ti mbẹ lẹba Beti-afeni, ni ìla-õrùn Beti-eli, o si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ gòke lọ ki ẹ si ṣamí ilẹ na. Awọn enia na gòke lọ nwọn si ṣamí Ai.
entries.en: And Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai, which is beside Beth-aven, on the east side of Bethel, and spake unto them, saying, Go up and view the country. And the men went up and viewed Ai.

entries.yo: Nwọn si pada tọ̀ Joṣua wá, nwọn si wi fun u pe, Má ṣe jẹ ki gbogbo enia ki o gòke lọ; ṣugbọn jẹ ki ìwọn ẹgba tabi ẹgbẹdogun enia ki o gòke lọ ki nwọn si kọlù Ai; má ṣe jẹ ki gbogbo enia lọ ṣiṣẹ́ nibẹ̀; nitori diẹ ni nwọn.
entries.en: And they returned to Joshua, and said unto him, Let not all the people go up; but let about two or three thousand men go up and smite Ai; and make not all the people to labour thither; for they are but few.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni ìwọn ẹgbẹdogun enia gòke lọ sibẹ̀: nwọn si sá niwaju awọn enia Ai.
entries.en: So there went up thither of the people about three thousand men: and they fled before the men of Ai.

entries.yo: Awọn enia Ai pa enia mẹrindilogoji ninu wọn: nwọn si lepa wọn lati ẹnubode titi dé Ṣebarimu, nwọn si pa wọn bi nwọn ti nsọkalẹ: àiya awọn enia na já, o si di omi.
entries.en: And the men of Ai smote of them about thirty and six men: for they chased them from before the gate even unto Shebarim, and smote them in the going down: wherefore the hearts of the people melted, and became as water.

entries.yo: Joṣua si fà aṣọ rẹ̀ ya, o si dojubolẹ niwaju apoti OLUWA titi di aṣalẹ, on ati awọn àgba Israeli; nwọn si bù ekuru si ori wọn.
entries.en: And Joshua rent his clothes, and fell to the earth upon his face before the ark of the LORD until the eventide, he and the elders of Israel, and put dust upon their heads.

entries.yo: Joṣua si wipe, Yẽ, Oluwa ỌLỌRUN, nitori kini iwọ fi mú awọn enia yi kọja Jordani, lati fi wa lé ọwọ́ awọn Amori, lati pa wa run? awa iba mọ̀ ki a joko ni ìha keji ọhún Jordani!
entries.en: And Joshua said, Alas, O Lord GOD, wherefore hast thou at all brought this people over Jordan, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us? would to God we had been content, and dwelt on the other side Jordan!

entries.yo: A, Oluwa, kili emi o wi, nigbati Israeli pa ẹhin wọn dà niwaju awọn ọtá wọn!
entries.en: O Lord, what shall I say, when Israel turneth their backs before their enemies!

entries.yo: Nitoriti awọn ara Kenaani ati gbogbo awọn ara ilẹ na yio gbọ́, nwọn o si yi wa ká, nwọn o si ke orukọ wa kuro li aiye: kini iwọ o ha ṣe fun orukọ nla rẹ?
entries.en: For the Canaanites and all the inhabitants of the land shall hear of it, and shall environ us round, and cut off our name from the earth: and what wilt thou do unto thy great name?

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun Joṣua pe, Dide; ẽṣe ti iwọ fi doju rẹ bolẹ bayi?
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Joshua, Get thee up; wherefore liest thou thus upon thy face?

entries.yo: Israeli ti dẹ̀ṣẹ, nwọn si ti bà majẹmu mi jẹ́ ti mo palaṣẹ fun wọn: ani nwọn ti mú ninu ohun ìyasọtọ nì; nwọn si jale, nwọn si ṣe agabagebe pẹlu, ani nwọn si fi i sinu ẹrù wọn.
entries.en: Israel hath sinned, and they have also transgressed my covenant which I commanded them: for they have even taken of the accursed thing, and have also stolen, and dissembled also, and they have put it even among their own stuff.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni awọn ọmọ Israeli kò ṣe le duro niwaju awọn ọtá wọn, nwọn pẹhinda niwaju awọn ọtá wọn, nitoriti nwọn di ẹni ifibu: emi ki yio wà pẹlu nyin mọ́, bikoṣepe ẹnyin pa ohun ìyasọtọ run kuro lãrin nyin.
entries.en: Therefore the children of Israel could not stand before their enemies, but turned their backs before their enemies, because they were accursed: neither will I be with you any more, except ye destroy the accursed from among you.

entries.yo: Dide, yà awọn enia na simimọ́, ki o si wipe, Ẹ yà ara nyin simimọ́ fun ọla: nitori bayi li OLUWA, Ọlọrun Israeli wipe; Ohun ìyasọtọ kan mbẹ ninu rẹ, iwọ Israeli: iwọ ki yio le duro niwaju awọn ọtá rẹ, titi ẹnyin o fi mú ohun ìyasọtọ na kuro ninu nyin.
entries.en: Up, sanctify the people, and say, Sanctify yourselves against to morrow: for thus saith the LORD God of Israel, There is an accursed thing in the midst of thee, O Israel: thou canst not stand before thine enemies, until ye take away the accursed thing from among you.

entries.yo: Nitorina li owurọ̀ a o mú nyin wá gẹgẹ bi ẹ̀ya nyin: yio si ṣe, ẹ̀ya ti OLUWA ba mú yio wá gẹgẹ ni idile idile: ati idile ti OLUWA ba mú yio wá li agbagbole; ati agbole ti OLUWA ba mú yio wá li ọkunrin kọkan.
entries.en: In the morning therefore ye shall be brought according to your tribes: and it shall be, that the tribe which the LORD taketh shall come according to the families thereof; and the family which the LORD shall take shall come by households; and the household which the LORD shall take shall come man by man.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, ẹniti a ba mú pẹlu ohun ìyasọtọ na, a o fi iná sun u, on ati ohun gbogbo ti o ní: nitoriti o rú ofin OLUWA, ati nitoriti o si hù ìwakiwa ni Israeli.
entries.en: And it shall be, that he that is taken with the accursed thing shall be burnt with fire, he and all that he hath: because he hath transgressed the covenant of the LORD, and because he hath wrought folly in Israel.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Joṣua dide ni kùtukutu owurọ̀, o si mú Israeli wá gẹgẹ bi ẹ̀ya wọn; a si mú ẹ̀ya Juda:
entries.en: So Joshua rose up early in the morning, and brought Israel by their tribes; and the tribe of Judah was taken:

entries.yo: O si mú idile Juda wá; a si mu idile Sera: o si mú idile Sera wá li ọkunrin kọkan; a si mú Sabdi:
entries.en: And he brought the family of Judah; and he took the family of the Zarhites: and he brought the family of the Zarhites man by man; and Zabdi was taken:

entries.yo: O si mú ara ile rẹ̀ li ọkunrin kọkan; a si mú Akani ọmọ Karmi, ọmọ Sabdi, ọmọ Sera ninu, ẹ̀ya Judah.
entries.en: And he brought his household man by man; and Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, was taken.

entries.yo: Joṣua si wi fun Akani pe, Ọmọ mi, mo bẹ̀ ọ, fi ogo fun OLUWA, Ọlọrun Israeli, ki o si jẹwọ fun u; ki o si sọ fun mi nisisiyi, ohun ti iwọ se; má ṣe pa a mọ́ fun mi.
entries.en: And Joshua said unto Achan, My son, give, I pray thee, glory to the LORD God of Israel, and make confession unto him; and tell me now what thou hast done; hide it not from me.

entries.yo: Akani si da Joṣua lohùn, o si wipe, Nitõtọ ni mo ṣẹ̀ si OLUWA, Ọlọrun Israeli, bayi bayi ni mo ṣe:
entries.en: And Achan answered Joshua, and said, Indeed I have sinned against the LORD God of Israel, and thus and thus have I done:

entries.yo: Nigbati mo ri ẹ̀wu Babeli kan daradara ninu ikogun, ati igba ṣekeli fadakà, ati dindi wurà kan oloṣuwọn ãdọta ṣekeli, mo ṣojukokoro wọn, mo si mú wọn; sawò o, a fi wọn pamọ́ ni ilẹ lãrin agọ́ mi, ati fadakà na labẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: When I saw among the spoils a goodly Babylonish garment, and two hundred shekels of silver, and a wedge of gold of fifty shekels weight, then I coveted them, and took them; and, behold, they are hid in the earth in the midst of my tent, and the silver under it.

entries.yo: Joṣua si rán onṣẹ, nwọn si sare wọ̀ inu agọ́ na; si kiyesi i, a fi i pamọ́ ninu agọ́ rẹ̀, ati fadakà labẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: So Joshua sent messengers, and they ran unto the tent; and, behold, it was hid in his tent, and the silver under it.

entries.yo: Nwọn si mú wọn jade lãrin agọ́ na, nwọn si mú wọn wá sọdọ Joṣua, ati sọdọ gbogbo awọn ọmọ Israeli, nwọn si fi wọn lelẹ niwaju OLUWA.
entries.en: And they took them out of the midst of the tent, and brought them unto Joshua, and unto all the children of Israel, and laid them out before the LORD.

entries.yo: Joṣua, ati gbogbo Israeli pẹlu rẹ̀, si mú Akani ọmọ Sera, ati fadakà na, ati ẹ̀wu na, ati dindi wurà na, ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ ọkunrin, ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ obinrin, ati akọ-mãlu rẹ̀, ati kẹtẹkẹtẹ rẹ̀, ati agutan rẹ̀, ati agọ́ rẹ̀, ati ohun gbogbo ti o ní; nwọn si mú wọn lọ si ibi afonifoji Akoru.
entries.en: And Joshua, and all Israel with him, took Achan the son of Zerah, and the silver, and the garment, and the wedge of gold, and his sons, and his daughters, and his oxen, and his asses, and his sheep, and his tent, and all that he had: and they brought them unto the valley of Achor.

entries.yo: Joṣua si wipe, Ẽṣe ti iwọ fi yọ wa lẹnu? OLUWA yio yọ iwọ na lẹnu li oni yi. Gbogbo Israeli si sọ ọ li okuta pa; nwọn si dánasun wọn, nwọn sọ wọn li okuta.
entries.en: And Joshua said, Why hast thou troubled us? the LORD shall trouble thee this day. And all Israel stoned him with stones, and burned them with fire, after they had stoned them with stones.

entries.yo: Nwọn si kó òkiti okuta nla kan lé e lori titi di oni-oloni; OLUWA si yipada kuro ninu imuna ibinu rẹ̀. Nitorina li a ṣe npè orukọ ibẹ̀ li Afonifoji Akoru, titi di oni-oloni.
entries.en: And they raised over him a great heap of stones unto this day. So the LORD turned from the fierceness of his anger. Wherefore the name of that place was called, The valley of Achor, unto this day.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun Joṣua pe, Má ṣe bẹ̀ru, bẹ̃ni ki àiya ki o má ṣe fò ọ: mú gbogbo awọn ọmọ-ogun pẹlu rẹ ki iwọ ki o si dide, ki o si gòke lọ si Ai: kiyesi i, emi ti fi ọba Ai, ati awọn enia rẹ̀, ati ilunla rẹ̀, ati ilẹ rẹ̀ lé ọ lọwọ:
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Joshua, Fear not, neither be thou dismayed: take all the people of war with thee, and arise, go up to Ai: see, I have given into thy hand the king of Ai, and his people, and his city, and his land:

entries.yo: Iwọ o si ṣe si Ai ati si ọba rẹ̀ gẹgẹ bi iwọ ti ṣe si Jeriko ati si ọba rẹ̀: kìki ikogun rẹ̀, ati ohun-ọ̀sin rẹ̀, li ẹnyin o mú ni ikogun fun ara nyin: rán enia lọ iba lẹhin ilu na.
entries.en: And thou shalt do to Ai and her king as thou didst unto Jericho and her king: only the spoil thereof, and the cattle thereof, shall ye take for a prey unto yourselves: lay thee an ambush for the city behind it.

entries.yo: Joṣua si dide, ati gbogbo awọn ọmọ-ogun, lati gòke lọ si Ai: Joṣua si yàn ẹgba mẹdogun, alagbara akọni, o si rán wọn lo li oru.
entries.en: So Joshua arose, and all the people of war, to go up against Ai: and Joshua chose out thirty thousand mighty men of valour, and sent them away by night.

entries.yo: O si paṣẹ fun wọn pe, Wò o, ẹnyin o ba tì ilu na, ani lẹhin ilu na: ẹ má ṣe jìna pupọ̀ si ilu na, ṣugbọn ki gbogbo nyin ki o murasilẹ.
entries.en: And he commanded them, saying, Behold, ye shall lie in wait against the city, even behind the city: go not very far from the city, but be ye all ready:

entries.yo: Ati emi, ati gbogbo awọn enia ti o wà pẹlu mi, yio sunmọ ilu na: yio si ṣe, nigbati nwọn ba jade si wa, gẹgẹ bi ti ìgba iṣaju, awa o si sá niwaju wọn;
entries.en: And I, and all the people that are with me, will approach unto the city: and it shall come to pass, when they come out against us, as at the first, that we will flee before them,

entries.yo: Nitoriti nwọn o jade si wa, titi awa o fi fà wọn jade kuro ni ilu; nitoriti nwọn o wipe, Nwọn sá niwaju wa, gẹgẹ bi ti ìgba iṣaju; nitorina li awa o sá niwaju wọn:
entries.en: (For they will come out after us) till we have drawn them from the city; for they will say, They flee before us, as at the first: therefore we will flee before them.

entries.yo: Nigbana li ẹnyin o dide ni buba, ẹnyin o si gbà ilu na: nitoriti OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin yio fi i lé nyin lọwọ.
entries.en: Then ye shall rise up from the ambush, and seize upon the city: for the LORD your God will deliver it into your hand.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, nigbati ẹnyin ba gbà ilu na tán, ki ẹnyin ki o si tinabọ ilu na; gẹgẹ bi aṣẹ OLUWA ni ki ẹnyin ki o ṣe: wò o, mo ti fi aṣẹ fun nyin na.
entries.en: And it shall be, when ye have taken the city, that ye shall set the city on fire: according to the commandment of the LORD shall ye do. See, I have commanded you.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni Joṣua ṣe rán wọn lọ: nwọn lọ iba, nwọn si joko li agbedemeji Beti-eli ati Ai, ni ìha ìwọ-õrùn Ai: ṣugbọn Joṣua dó li oru na lãrin awọn enia.
entries.en: Joshua therefore sent them forth: and they went to lie in ambush, and abode between Bethel and Ai, on the west side of Ai: but Joshua lodged that night among the people.

entries.yo: Joṣua si dide ni kùtukutu owurọ̀, o si kà awọn enia, o si gòke lọ si Ai, on, ati awọn àgba Israeli niwaju awọn enia.
entries.en: And Joshua rose up early in the morning, and numbered the people, and went up, he and the elders of Israel, before the people to Ai.

entries.yo: Ati gbogbo awọn enia, ani awọn ọmọ-ogun ti mbẹ pẹlu rẹ̀, nwọn gòke lọ, nwọn si sunmọtosi, nwọn si wá siwaju ilu na, nwọn si dó ni ìha ariwa Ai; afonifoji si mbẹ li agbedemeji wọn ati Ai.
entries.en: And all the people, even the people of war that were with him, went up, and drew nigh, and came before the city, and pitched on the north side of Ai: now there was a valley between them and Ai.

entries.yo: O si mú to bi ẹgbẹdọgbọ̀n enia, o si fi wọn si ibuba li agbedemeji Betieli ati Ai, ni ìha ìwọ-õrùn ilu na.
entries.en: And he took about five thousand men, and set them to lie in ambush between Bethel and Ai, on the west side of the city.

entries.yo: Nwọn si yàn awọn enia si ipò, ani gbogbo ogun ti mbẹ ni ìha ariwa ilu na, ati awọn enia ti o ba ni ìha ìwọ-õrùn ilu na; Joṣua si lọ li oru na sãrin afonifoji na.
entries.en: And when they had set the people, even all the host that was on the north of the city, and their liers in wait on the west of the city, Joshua went that night into the midst of the valley.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati ọba Ai ri i, nwọn yára nwọn si dide ni kùtukutu, awọn ọkunrin ilu na si jade si Israeli lati jagun, ati on ati gbogbo awọn enia rẹ̀, niwaju pẹtẹlẹ̀, ibi ti a ti yàn tẹlẹ; ṣugbọn on kò mọ̀ pe awọn ti o ba dè e mbẹ lẹhin ilu.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when the king of Ai saw it, that they hasted and rose up early, and the men of the city went out against Israel to battle, he and all his people, at a time appointed, before the plain; but he wist not that there were liers in ambush against him behind the city.

entries.yo: Joṣua ati gbogbo awọn Israeli si ṣe bi ẹniti a lé niwaju wọn, nwọn si sá gbà ọ̀na aginjú.
entries.en: And Joshua and all Israel made as if they were beaten before them, and fled by the way of the wilderness.

entries.yo: A si pe gbogbo enia ti mbẹ ni Ai jọ lati lepa wọn: nwọn si lepa Joṣua, a si fà wọn jade kuro ni ilu.
entries.en: And all the people that were in Ai were called together to pursue after them: and they pursued after Joshua, and were drawn away from the city.

entries.yo: Kò si kù ọkunrin kan ni Ai tabi Beti-eli, ti kò jade tọ̀ Israeli: nwọn si fi ilú nla silẹ ni ṣíṣí nwọn si lepa Israeli.
entries.en: And there was not a man left in Ai or Bethel, that went not out after Israel: and they left the city open, and pursued after Israel.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun Joṣua pe, Nà ọ̀kọ ti mbẹ li ọwọ́ rẹ nì si Ai; nitoriti emi o fi i lé ọ lọwọ. Joṣua si nà ọ̀kọ na ti o ni li ọwọ́ rẹ̀ si ilu na.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Joshua, Stretch out the spear that is in thy hand toward Ai; for I will give it into thine hand. And Joshua stretched out the spear that he had in his hand toward the city.

entries.yo: Awọn ti o ba si dide kánkan kuro ni ipò wọn, bi o si ti nàwọ́ rẹ̀, nwọn sare, nwọn si wọ̀ ilu na lọ, nwọn si gbà a; nwọn si yára tinabọ ilu na.
entries.en: And the ambush arose quickly out of their place, and they ran as soon as he had stretched out his hand: and they entered into the city, and took it, and hasted and set the city on fire.

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn ọkunrin Ai boju wo ẹhin wọn, kiyesi i, nwọn ri ẹ̃fi ilu na ngòke lọ si ọrun, nwọn kò si lí agbara lati gbà ihin tabi ọhún sálọ: awọn enia ti o sá lọ si aginjù si yipada si awọn ti nlepa.
entries.en: And when the men of Ai looked behind them, they saw, and, behold, the smoke of the city ascended up to heaven, and they had no power to flee this way or that way: and the people that fled to the wilderness turned back upon the pursuers.

entries.yo: Nigbati Joṣua ati gbogbo Israeli ri bi awọn ti o ba ti gbà ilu, ti ẹ̃fi ilu na si gòke, nwọn si yipada, nwọn si pa awọn ọkunrin Ai.
entries.en: And when Joshua and all Israel saw that the ambush had taken the city, and that the smoke of the city ascended, then they turned again, and slew the men of Ai.

entries.yo: Awọn ti ara keji si yọ si wọn lati ilu na wá; bẹ̃ni nwọn wà li agbedemeji Israeli, awọn miran li apa ihin, awọn miran li apa ọhún: nwọn si pa wọn, bẹ̃ni nwọn kò si jẹ ki ọkan ki o kù tabi ki o sálọ ninu wọn.
entries.en: And the other issued out of the city against them; so they were in the midst of Israel, some on this side, and some on that side: and they smote them, so that they let none of them remain or escape.

entries.yo: Nwọn si mú ọba Ai lãye, nwọn si mú u wá sọdọ Joṣua.
entries.en: And the king of Ai they took alive, and brought him to Joshua.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati Israeli pari pipa gbogbo awọn ara ilu Ai ni igbẹ́, ati ni aginjù ni ibi ti nwọn lé wọn si, ti gbogbo wọn si ti oju idà ṣubu, titi a fi run wọn, ni gbogbo awọn ọmọ Israeli pada si Ai, nwọn si fi oju idà kọlù u.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when Israel had made an end of slaying all the inhabitants of Ai in the field, in the wilderness wherein they chased them, and when they were all fallen on the edge of the sword, until they were consumed, that all the Israelites returned unto Ai, and smote it with the edge of the sword.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, gbogbo awọn ti o ṣubu ni ijọ́ na, ati ọkunrin ati obinrin, jẹ́ ẹgba mẹfa, ani gbogbo ọkunrin Ai.
entries.en: And so it was, that all that fell that day, both of men and women, were twelve thousand, even all the men of Ai.

entries.yo: Nitoriti Joṣua kò fà ọwọ́ rẹ̀ ti o fi nà ọ̀kọ sẹhin, titi o fi run gbogbo awọn ara ilu Ai tútu.
entries.en: For Joshua drew not his hand back, wherewith he stretched out the spear, until he had utterly destroyed all the inhabitants of Ai.

entries.yo: Kìki ohun-ọ̀sin ati ikogun ilu na ni Israeli kó fun ara wọn, gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ OLUWA ti o palaṣẹ fun Joṣua.
entries.en: Only the cattle and the spoil of that city Israel took for a prey unto themselves, according unto the word of the LORD which he commanded Joshua.

entries.yo: Joṣua si kun Ai, o sọ ọ di òkiti lailai, ani ahoro titi di oni-oloni.
entries.en: And Joshua burnt Ai, and made it an heap for ever, even a desolation unto this day.

entries.yo: Ọba Ai li o si so rọ̀ lori igi titi di aṣalẹ: bi õrùn si ti wọ̀, Joṣua paṣẹ ki a sọ okú rẹ̀ kuro lori igi kalẹ, ki a si wọ́ ọ jù si atiwọ̀ ibode ilu na, ki a si kó òkiti nla okuta lé e lori, ti mbẹ nibẹ̀ titi di oni-oloni.
entries.en: And the king of Ai he hanged on a tree until eventide: and as soon as the sun was down, Joshua commanded that they should take his carcase down from the tree, and cast it at the entering of the gate of the city, and raise thereon a great heap of stones, that remaineth unto this day.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Joṣua tẹ́ pẹpẹ kan fun OLUWA, Ọlọrun Israeli, li òke Ebali,
entries.en: Then Joshua built an altar unto the LORD God of Israel in mount Ebal,

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi Mose iranṣẹ OLUWA ti paṣẹ fun awọn ọmọ Israeli, gẹgẹ bi a ti kọ ọ ninu iwé ofin Mose, pẹpẹ odidi okuta, lara eyiti ẹnikan kò fi irin kan: nwọn si ru ẹbọ sisun lori rẹ̀ si OLUWA, nwọn si ru ẹbọ alafia.
entries.en: As Moses the servant of the LORD commanded the children of Israel, as it is written in the book of the law of Moses, an altar of whole stones, over which no man hath lift up any iron: and they offered thereon burnt offerings unto the LORD, and sacrificed peace offerings.

entries.yo: O si kọ apẹrẹ ofin Mose sara okuta na, ti o kọ niwaju awọn ọmọ Israeli.
entries.en: And he wrote there upon the stones a copy of the law of Moses, which he wrote in the presence of the children of Israel.

entries.yo: Ati gbogbo Israeli, ati awọn àgba wọn, ati awọn olori, ati awọn onidajọ wọn, duro li apa ihin ati li apa ọhún apoti ẹrí niwaju awọn alufa awọn ọmọ Lefi, ti o rù apoti majẹmu OLUWA, ati alejò ati ibilẹ; àbọ wọn kọjusi òke Gerisimu; ati àbọ wọn kọjusi òke Ebali, gẹgẹ bi Mose iranṣẹ OLUWA ti paṣẹ rí, pe ki nwọn ki o sure fun awọn enia Israeli.
entries.en: And all Israel, and their elders, and officers, and their judges, stood on this side the ark and on that side before the priests the Levites, which bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD, as well the stranger, as he that was born among them; half of them over against mount Gerizim, and half of them over against mount Ebal; as Moses the servant of the LORD had commanded before, that they should bless the people of Israel.

entries.yo: Lẹhin eyi o si kà gbogbo ọ̀rọ ofin, ibukún ati egún, gẹgẹ bi gbogbo eyiti a kọ ninu iwé ofin.
entries.en: And afterward he read all the words of the law, the blessings and cursings, according to all that is written in the book of the law.

entries.yo: Kò kù ọ̀rọ kan ninu gbogbo eyiti Mose palaṣẹ, ti Joṣua kò kà niwaju gbogbo ijọ Israeli, ati awọn obinrin, ati awọn ọmọ wẹrẹ, ati awọn alejò ti nrìn lãrin wọn.
entries.en: There was not a word of all that Moses commanded, which Joshua read not before all the congregation of Israel, with the women, and the little ones, and the strangers that were conversant among them.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati gbogbo awọn ọba ti mbẹ li apa ihin Jordani, li ori òke, ati li afonifoji, ati ni gbogbo àgbegbe okun nla ti o kọjusi Lebanoni, awọn Hitti, ati awọn Amori, awọn Kenaani, awọn Perissi, awọn Hifi, ati awọn Jebusi, gbọ́ ọ;
entries.en: And it came to pass, when all the kings which were on this side Jordan, in the hills, and in the valleys, and in all the coasts of the great sea over against Lebanon, the Hittite, and the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, heard thereof;

entries.yo: Nwọn si kó ara wọn jọ, lati fi ìmọ kan bá Joṣua ati Israeli jà.
entries.en: That they gathered themselves together, to fight with Joshua and with Israel, with one accord.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati awọn ara Gibeoni gbọ́ ohun ti Joṣua ṣe si Jeriko ati si Ai,
entries.en: And when the inhabitants of Gibeon heard what Joshua had done unto Jericho and to Ai,

entries.yo: Nwọn ṣe ẹ̀tan, nwọn si lọ nwọn si ṣe bi ẹnipe onṣẹ ni nwọn, nwọn si mú ogbologbo àpo kà ori kẹtẹkẹtẹ wọn, ati ìgo-awọ ọti-waini ti lailai, ti o ya, ti a si dì;
entries.en: They did work wilily, and went and made as if they had been ambassadors, and took old sacks upon their asses, and wine bottles, old, and rent, and bound up;

entries.yo: Ati bàta gbigbo ati lilẹ̀ li ẹsẹ̀ wọn, ati ẹ̀wu gbigbo li ara wọn; ati gbogbo àkara èse wọn o gbẹ o si hùkasi.
entries.en: And old shoes and clouted upon their feet, and old garments upon them; and all the bread of their provision was dry and mouldy.

entries.yo: Nwọn si tọ̀ Joṣua lọ ni ibudó ni Gilgali, nwọn si wi fun u, ati fun awọn ọkunrin Israeli pe, Ilu òkere li awa ti wá; njẹ nitorina ẹ bá wa dá majẹmu.
entries.en: And they went to Joshua unto the camp at Gilgal, and said unto him, and to the men of Israel, We be come from a far country: now therefore make ye a league with us.

entries.yo: Awọn ọkunrin Israeli si wi fun awọn Hifi pe, Bọya ẹnyin ngbé ãrin wa; awa o ti ṣe bá nyin dá majẹmu?
entries.en: And the men of Israel said unto the Hivites, Peradventure ye dwell among us; and how shall we make a league with you?

entries.yo: Nwọn si wi fun Joṣua pe, Iranṣẹ rẹ li awa iṣe. Joṣua si wi fun wọn pe, Tali ẹnyin? nibo li ẹnyin si ti wá?
entries.en: And they said unto Joshua, We are thy servants. And Joshua said unto them, Who are ye? and from whence come ye?

entries.yo: Nwọn si wi fun u pe, Ni ilu òkere rére li awọn iranṣẹ rẹ ti wá, nitori orukọ OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ: nitoriti awa ti gbọ́ okikí rẹ̀, ati ohun gbogbo ti o ṣe ni Egipti,
entries.en: And they said unto him, From a very far country thy servants are come because of the name of the LORD thy God: for we have heard the fame of him, and all that he did in Egypt,

entries.yo: Ati ohun gbogbo ti o ṣe si awọn ọba awọn Amori meji, ti mbẹ ni òke Jordani, si Sihoni ọba Heṣboni, ati si Ogu ọba Baṣani, ti mbẹ ni Aṣtarotu.
entries.en: And all that he did to the two kings of the Amorites, that were beyond Jordan, to Sihon king of Heshbon, and to Og king of Bashan, which was at Ashtaroth.

entries.yo: Awọn àgba wa ati gbogbo awọn ara ilu wa sọ fun wa pe, Ẹ mú onjẹ li ọwọ́ nyin fun àjo na, ki ẹ si lọ ipade wọn, ki ẹ si wi fun wọn pe, Iranṣẹ nyin li awa iṣe: njẹ nitorina, ẹ bá wa dá majẹmu.
entries.en: Wherefore our elders and all the inhabitants of our country spake to us, saying, Take victuals with you for the journey, and go to meet them, and say unto them, We are your servants: therefore now make ye a league with us.

entries.yo: Àkara wa yi ni gbigbona li a mú u fun èse wa, lati ile wa wá, li ọjọ́ ti a jade lati tọ̀ nyin wá; ṣugbọn nisisiyi, kiyesi i, o gbẹ, o si bu:
entries.en: This our bread we took hot for our provision out of our houses on the day we came forth to go unto you; but now, behold, it is dry, and it is mouldy:

entries.yo: Ìgo-awọ waini wọnyi, ti awa kún, titun ni nwọn; kiyesi i, nwọn fàya: ati ẹ̀wu wa wọnyi ati bàta wa di gbigbo nitori ọ̀na ti o jìn jù.
entries.en: And these bottles of wine, which we filled, were new; and, behold, they be rent: and these our garments and our shoes are become old by reason of the very long journey.

entries.yo: Awọn ọkunrin si gbà ninu onjẹ wọn, nwọn kò si bère li ẹnu OLUWA.
entries.en: And the men took of their victuals, and asked not counsel at the mouth of the LORD.

entries.yo: Joṣua si bá wọn ṣọrẹ, o si bá wọn dá majẹmu lati da wọn si: awọn olori ijọ enia fi OLUWA Ọlọrun Israeli bura fun wọn.
entries.en: And Joshua made peace with them, and made a league with them, to let them live: and the princes of the congregation sware unto them.

entries.yo: O si ṣe li opin ijọ́ mẹta, lẹhin ìgbati nwọn bá wọn dá majẹmu, ni nwọn gbọ́ pe aladugbo wọn ni nwọn, ati pe làrin wọn ni nwọn gbé wà.
entries.en: And it came to pass at the end of three days after they had made a league with them, that they heard that they were their neighbours, and that they dwelt among them.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Israeli si dide, nwọn si dé ilu wọn ni ijọ́ kẹta. Njẹ ilu wọn ni Gibeoni, ati Kefira, ati Beerotu, ati Kiriati-jearimu.
entries.en: And the children of Israel journeyed, and came unto their cities on the third day. Now their cities were Gibeon, and Chephirah, and Beeroth, and Kirjath-jearim.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Israeli kò pa wọn, nitoriti awọn olori ijọ awọn enia ti fi OLUWA, Ọlọrun Israeli, bura fun wọn. Gbogbo ijọ awọn enia si kùn si awọn olori.
entries.en: And the children of Israel smote them not, because the princes of the congregation had sworn unto them by the LORD God of Israel. And all the congregation murmured against the princes.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn gbogbo awọn olori wi fun gbogbo ijọ pe, Awa ti fi OLUWA, Ọlọrun Israeli, bura fun wọn: njẹ nitorina awa kò le fọwọkàn wọn.
entries.en: But all the princes said unto all the congregation, We have sworn unto them by the LORD God of Israel: now therefore we may not touch them.

entries.yo: Eyi li awa o ṣe si wọn, ani awa o da wọn si, ki ibinu ki o má ba wà lori wa, nitori ibura ti a bura fun wọn.
entries.en: This we will do to them; we will even let them live, lest wrath be upon us, because of the oath which we sware unto them.

entries.yo: Awọn olori si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ da wọn si: nwọn si di aṣẹ́gi ati apọnmi fun gbogbo ijọ; gẹgẹ bi awọn olori ti sọ fun wọn.
entries.en: And the princes said unto them, Let them live; but let them be hewers of wood and drawers of water unto all the congregation; as the princes had promised them.

entries.yo: Joṣua si pè wọn, o si wi fun wọn pe, Ẽṣe ti ẹnyin fi tàn wa wipe, Awa jìna rére si nyin; nigbati o jẹ́ pe lãrin wa li ẹnyin ngbé?
entries.en: And Joshua called for them, and he spake unto them, saying, Wherefore have ye beguiled us, saying, We are very far from you; when ye dwell among us?

entries.yo: Njẹ nitorina ẹnyin di ẹni egún, ẹrú li ẹnyin o si ma jẹ́ titi, ati aṣẹ́gi ati apọnmi fun ile Ọlọrun mi.
entries.en: Now therefore ye are cursed, and there shall none of you be freed from being bondmen, and hewers of wood and drawers of water for the house of my God.

entries.yo: Nwọn si da Joṣua lohùn wipe, Nitoriti a sọ fun awọn iranṣẹ rẹ dajudaju, bi OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ ti paṣẹ fun Mose iranṣẹ rẹ̀, lati fun nyin ni gbogbo ilẹ na, ati lati pa gbogbo awọn ara ilẹ na run kuro niwaju nyin; nitorina awa bẹ̀ru nyin gidigidi nitori ẹmi wa, a si ṣe nkan yi.
entries.en: And they answered Joshua, and said, Because it was certainly told thy servants, how that the LORD thy God commanded his servant Moses to give you all the land, and to destroy all the inhabitants of the land from before you, therefore we were sore afraid of our lives because of you, and have done this thing.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, kiyesi i, li ọwọ́ rẹ li awa wà: bi o ti dara si ati bi o ti tọ́ si li oju rẹ lati ṣe wa, ni ki iwọ ki o ṣe.
entries.en: And now, behold, we are in thine hand: as it seemeth good and right unto thee to do unto us, do.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li o si ṣe wọn, o si gbà wọn li ọwọ́ awọn ọmọ Israeli, nwọn kò si pa wọn.
entries.en: And so did he unto them, and delivered them out of the hand of the children of Israel, that they slew them not.

entries.yo: Joṣua si ṣe wọn li aṣẹ́gi ati apọnmi fun ijọ, ati fun pẹpẹ OLUWA li ọjọ́ na, ani titi di oni-oloni, ni ibi ti o ba yàn.
entries.en: And Joshua made them that day hewers of wood and drawers of water for the congregation, and for the altar of the LORD, even unto this day, in the place which he should choose.

entries.yo: O SI ṣe, nigbati Adoni-sedeki ọba Jerusalemu gbọ́ pe Joṣua ti kó Ai, ti o si pa a run patapata; bi o ti ṣe si Jeriko ati si ọba rẹ̀, bẹ̃li o si ṣe si Ai ati si ọba rẹ̀; ati bi awọn ara Gibeoni ti bá Israeli ṣọrẹ, ti nwọn si ngbé ãrin wọn;
entries.en: Now it came to pass, when Adoni-zedek king of Jerusalem had heard how Joshua had taken Ai, and had utterly destroyed it; as he had done to Jericho and her king, so he had done to Ai and her king; and how the inhabitants of Gibeon had made peace with Israel, and were among them;

entries.yo: Nwọn bẹ̀ru pipọ̀, nitoriti Gibeoni ṣe ilu nla, bi ọkan ninu awọn ilu ọba, ati nitoriti o tobi jù Ai lọ, ati gbogbo ọkunrin inu rẹ̀ jẹ́ alagbara.
entries.en: That they feared greatly, because Gibeon was a great city, as one of the royal cities, and because it was greater than Ai, and all the men thereof were mighty.

entries.yo: Nitorina Adoni-sedeki ọba Jerusalemu ranṣẹ si Hohamu ọba Hebroni, ati si Piramu ọba Jarmutu, ati si Jafia ọba Lakiṣi, ati si Debiri ọba Egloni, wipe,
entries.en: Wherefore Adoni-zedek king of Jerusalem sent unto Hoham king of Hebron, and unto Piram king of Jarmuth, and unto Japhia king of Lachish, and unto Debir king of Eglon, saying,

entries.yo: Ẹ gòke tọ̀ mi wá, ki ẹ si ràn mi lọwọ, ki awa ki o le kọlù Gibeoni: nitoriti o bá Joṣua ati awọn ọmọ Israeli ṣọrẹ.
entries.en: Come up unto me, and help me, that we may smite Gibeon: for it hath made peace with Joshua and with the children of Israel.

entries.yo: Awọn ọba Amori mararun, ọba Jerusalemu, ọba Hebroni, ọba Jarmutu, ọba Lakiṣi, ati ọba Egloni, kó ara wọn jọ, nwọn si gòke, awọn ati gbogbo ogun wọn, nwọn si dótì Gibeoni, nwọn si fi ìja fun u.
entries.en: Therefore the five kings of the Amorites, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, the king of Eglon, gathered themselves together, and went up, they and all their hosts, and encamped before Gibeon, and made war against it.

entries.yo: Awọn ọkunrin Gibeoni si ranṣẹ si Joṣua ni ibudó ni Gilgali, wipe, Má ṣe fà ọwọ́ rẹ sẹhin kuro lọdọ awọn iranṣẹ rẹ; gòke tọ̀ wa wá kánkán, ki o si gbà wa, ki o si ràn wa lọwọ: nitoriti gbogbo awọn ọba Amori ti ngbé ori òke kójọ pọ̀ si wa.
entries.en: And the men of Gibeon sent unto Joshua to the camp to Gilgal, saying, Slack not thy hand from thy servants; come up to us quickly, and save us, and help us: for all the kings of the Amorites that dwell in the mountains are gathered together against us.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Joṣua gòke lati Gilgali lọ, on ati gbogbo awọn ọmọ-ogun pẹlu rẹ̀, ati gbogbo awọn alagbara akọni.
entries.en: So Joshua ascended from Gilgal, he, and all the people of war with him, and all the mighty men of valour.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun Joṣua pe, Má ṣe bẹ̀ru wọn: nitoriti mo ti fi wọn lé ọ lọwọ; ki yio sí ọkunrin kan ninu wọn ti yio le duro niwaju rẹ.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Joshua, Fear them not: for I have delivered them into thine hand; there shall not a man of them stand before thee.

entries.yo: Joṣua si yọ si wọn lojijì; o si gòke lati Gilgali lọ ni gbogbo oru na.
entries.en: Joshua therefore came unto them suddenly, and went up from Gilgal all night.

entries.yo: OLUWA si fọ́ wọn niwaju Israeli, o si pa wọn ni ipakupa ni Gibeoni, o si lepa wọn li ọ̀na òke Beti-horoni, o si pa wọn dé Aseka, ati dé Makkeda.
entries.en: And the LORD discomfited them before Israel, and slew them with a great slaughter at Gibeon, and chased them along the way that goeth up to Beth-horon, and smote them to Azekah, and unto Makkedah.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, bi nwọn ti nsá niwaju Israeli, ti nwọn dé gẹrẹgẹrẹ Beti-horoni, OLUWA rọ̀ yinyin nla si wọn lati ọrun wá titi dé Aseka, nwọn si kú: awọn ti o ti ipa yinyin kú, o pọ̀ju awọn ti awọn ọmọ Israeli fi idà pa lọ.
entries.en: And it came to pass, as they fled from before Israel, and were in the going down to Beth-horon, that the LORD cast down great stones from heaven upon them unto Azekah, and they died: they were more which died with hailstones than they whom the children of Israel slew with the sword.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Joṣua wi fun OLUWA li ọjọ́ ti OLUWA fi awọn Amori fun awọn ọmọ Israeli, o si wi li oju Israeli pe, Iwọ, Õrùn, duro jẹ lori Gibeoni; ati Iwọ, Oṣupa, li afonifoji Aijaloni.
entries.en: Then spake Joshua to the LORD in the day when the LORD delivered up the Amorites before the children of Israel, and he said in the sight of Israel, Sun, stand thou still upon Gibeon; and thou, Moon, in the valley of Ajalon.

entries.yo: Õrùn si duro jẹ, oṣupa si duro, titi awọn enia fi gbẹsan lara awọn ọtá wọn. A kò ha kọ eyi nã sinu iwé Jaṣeri? Bẹ̃li õrùn duro li agbedemeji ọrun, kò si yára lati wọ̀ nìwọn ọjọ́ kan tọ̀tọ.
entries.en: And the sun stood still, and the moon stayed, until the people had avenged themselves upon their enemies. Is not this written in the book of Jasher? So the sun stood still in the midst of heaven, and hasted not to go down about a whole day.

entries.yo: Kò sí ọjọ́ ti o dabi rẹ̀ ṣaju rẹ̀ tabi lẹhin rẹ̀, ti OLUWA gbọ́ ohùn enia: nitoriti OLUWA jà fun Israeli.
entries.en: And there was no day like that before it or after it, that the LORD hearkened unto the voice of a man: for the LORD fought for Israel.

entries.yo: Joṣua si pada, ati gbogbo Israeli pẹlu rẹ̀, si ibudó ni Gilgali.
entries.en: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, unto the camp to Gilgal.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn ọba marun nì sá, nwọn si fara wọn pamọ́ ni ihò kan ni Makkeda.
entries.en: But these five kings fled, and hid themselves in a cave at Makkedah.

entries.yo: A si sọ fun Joṣua pe, A ri awọn ọba marun ni ifarapamọ́ ni ihò ni Makkeda.
entries.en: And it was told Joshua, saying, The five kings are found hid in a cave at Makkedah.

entries.yo: Joṣua si wipe, Ẹ yí okuta nla di ẹnu ihò na, ki ẹ si yàn enia sibẹ̀ lati ṣọ́ wọn:
entries.en: And Joshua said, Roll great stones upon the mouth of the cave, and set men by it for to keep them:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹnyin, ẹ má ṣe duro, ẹ lepa awọn ọtá nyin, ki ẹ si kọlù wọn lẹhin; ẹ máṣe jẹ ki nwọn ki o wọ̀ ilu wọn lọ: nitoriti OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin ti fi wọn lé nyin lọwọ.
entries.en: And stay ye not, but pursue after your enemies, and smite the hindmost of them; suffer them not to enter into their cities: for the LORD your God hath delivered them into your hand.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati Joṣua ati awọn ọmọ Israeli pa wọn ni ipakupa tán, titi a fi run wọn, ti awọn ti o kù ninu wọn wọ̀ inu ilu olodi lọ,
entries.en: And it came to pass, when Joshua and the children of Israel had made an end of slaying them with a very great slaughter, till they were consumed, that the rest which remained of them entered into fenced cities.

entries.yo: Gbogbo enia si pada si ibudó sọdọ Joṣua ni Makkeda li alafia: kò sí ẹni kan ti o yọ ahọn rẹ̀ si awọn ọmọ Israeli.
entries.en: And all the people returned to the camp to Joshua at Makkedah in peace: none moved his tongue against any of the children of Israel.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Joṣua wipe, Ẹ ṣi ẹnu ihò na, ki ẹ si mú awọn ọba mararun na jade kuro ninu ihò tọ̀ mi wá.
entries.en: Then said Joshua, Open the mouth of the cave, and bring out those five kings unto me out of the cave.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣe bẹ̃, nwọn si mú awọn ọba mararun nì jade lati inu ihò na tọ̀ ọ wá, ọba Jerusalemu, ọba Hebroni, ọba Jarmutu, ọba Lakiṣi, ati ọba Egloni.
entries.en: And they did so, and brought forth those five kings unto him out of the cave, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati nwọn mú awọn ọba na tọ̀ Joṣua wá, ni Joṣua pè gbogbo awọn ọkunrin Israeli, o si wi fun awọn olori awọn ọmọ-ogun ti o bá a lọ pe, Ẹ sunmọ ihin, ẹ si fi ẹsẹ̀ nyin lé ọrùn awọn ọba wọnyi. Nwọn si sunmọ wọn, nwọn si gbé ẹsẹ̀ wọn lé wọn li ọrùn.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when they brought out those kings unto Joshua, that Joshua called for all the men of Israel, and said unto the captains of the men of war which went with him, Come near, put your feet upon the necks of these kings. And they came near, and put their feet upon the necks of them.

entries.yo: Joṣua si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ má ṣe bẹ̀ru, ẹ má si ṣe fòya; ẹ ṣe giri, ki ẹ si mu àiya le: nitoripe bayi li OLUWA yio ṣe si awọn ọtá nyin gbogbo ti ẹnyin mbájà.
entries.en: And Joshua said unto them, Fear not, nor be dismayed, be strong and of good courage: for thus shall the LORD do to all your enemies against whom ye fight.

entries.yo: Lẹhin na ni Joṣua si kọlù wọn, o si pa wọn, o si so wọn rọ̀ lori igi marun: nwọn si sorọ̀ lori igi titi di aṣalẹ.
entries.en: And afterward Joshua smote them, and slew them, and hanged them on five trees: and they were hanging upon the trees until the evening.

entries.yo: O si ṣe li akokò ìwọ-õrùn, Joṣua paṣẹ, nwọn si sọ̀ wọn kalẹ kuro lori igi, nwọn si gbé wọn s sinu ihò na ninu eyiti nwọn ti sapamọ́ si, nwọn si fi okuta nla di ẹnu ihò na, ti o wà titi di oni-oloni.
entries.en: And it came to pass at the time of the going down of the sun, that Joshua commanded, and they took them down off the trees, and cast them into the cave wherein they had been hid, and laid great stones in the cave's mouth, which remain until this very day.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ́ na ni Joṣua kó Makkeda, o si fi oju idà kọlù u, ati ọba rẹ̀; o pa wọn run patapata, ati gbogbo ọkàn ti mbẹ ninu rẹ̀, kò kù ẹnikan silẹ: o si ṣe si ọba Makkeda gẹgẹ bi o ti ṣe si ọba Jeriko.
entries.en: And that day Joshua took Makkedah, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and the king thereof he utterly destroyed, them, and all the souls that were therein; he let none remain: and he did to the king of Makkedah as he did unto the king of Jericho.

entries.yo: Joṣua si kọja lati Makkeda lọ si Libna, ati gbogbo Israeli pẹlu rẹ̀, o si fi ijà fun Libna:
entries.en: Then Joshua passed from Makkedah, and all Israel with him, unto Libnah, and fought against Libnah:

entries.yo: OLUWA si fi i lé Israeli lọwọ pẹlu, ati ọba rẹ̀: o si fi oju idà kọlù u, ati gbogbo ọkàn ti o wà ninu rẹ̀; kò kù ẹnikan ninu rẹ̀; o si ṣe si ọba rẹ̀ gẹgẹ bi o ti ṣe si ọba Jeriko.
entries.en: And the LORD delivered it also, and the king thereof, into the hand of Israel; and he smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that were therein; he let none remain in it; but did unto the king thereof as he did unto the king of Jericho.

entries.yo: Joṣua si kọja lati Libna lọ si Lakiṣi, ati gbogbo Israeli pẹlu rẹ̀, o si dótì i, o si fi ìja fun u.
entries.en: And Joshua passed from Libnah, and all Israel with him, unto Lachish, and encamped against it, and fought against it:

entries.yo: OLUWA si fi Lakiṣi lé Israeli lọwọ, o si kó o ni ijọ́ keji, o si fi oju idà kọlù u, ati gbogbo ọkàn ti o wà ninu rẹ̀, gẹgẹ bi gbogbo eyiti o ṣe si Libna.
entries.en: And the LORD delivered Lachish into the hand of Israel, which took it on the second day, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that were therein, according to all that he had done to Libnah.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Horamu ọba Geseri gòke lati ràn Lakiṣi lọwọ; Joṣua si kọlù u ati awọn enia rẹ̀, tobẹ̃ ti kò fi kù ẹnikan silẹ fun u.
entries.en: Then Horam king of Gezer came up to help Lachish; and Joshua smote him and his people, until he had left him none remaining.

entries.yo: Lati Lakiṣi Joṣua kọja lọ si Egloni, ati gbogbo Israeli pẹlu rẹ̀; nwọn si dótì i, nwọn si fi ijà fun u;
entries.en: And from Lachish Joshua passed unto Eglon, and all Israel with him; and they encamped against it, and fought against it:

entries.yo: Nwọn si kó o li ọjọ́ na, nwọn si fi oju idà kọlù u, ati gbogbo ọkàn ti mbẹ ninu rẹ̀ li o parun patapata li ọjọ́ na, gẹgẹ bi gbogbo eyiti o ṣe si Lakiṣi.
entries.en: And they took it on that day, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that were therein he utterly destroyed that day, according to all that he had done to Lachish.

entries.yo: Joṣua si gòke lati Egloni lọ si Hebroni, ati gbogbo Israeli pẹlu rẹ̀; nwọn si fi ijà fun u:
entries.en: And Joshua went up from Eglon, and all Israel with him, unto Hebron; and they fought against it:

entries.yo: Nwọn si kó o, nwọn si fi oju idà kọlù u, ati ọba rẹ̀, ati gbogbo ilu rẹ̀, ati gbogbo ọkàn ti o wà ninu rẹ̀; kò kù enikan silẹ, gẹgẹ bi gbogbo eyiti o ṣe si Egloni; o si pa a run patapata, ati gbogbo ọkàn ti o wà ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And they took it, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and the king thereof, and all the cities thereof, and all the souls that were therein; he left none remaining, according to all that he had done to Eglon; but destroyed it utterly, and all the souls that were therein.

entries.yo: Joṣua si pada lọ si Debiri, ati gbogbo Israeli pẹlu rẹ̀; o si fi ijà fun u:
entries.en: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to Debir; and fought against it:

entries.yo: O si kó o, ati ọba rẹ̀, ati gbogbo ilu rẹ̀; nwọn si fi oju idà kọlù wọn; nwọn si pa gbogbo ọkàn ti mbẹ ninu rẹ̀ run patapata; kò si kù ẹnikan silẹ: gẹgẹ bi o ti ṣe si Hebroni, bẹ̃li o ṣe si Debiri, ati ọba rẹ̀; ati gẹgẹ bi o ti ṣe si Libna, ati ọba rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he took it, and the king thereof, and all the cities thereof; and they smote them with the edge of the sword, and utterly destroyed all the souls that were therein; he left none remaining: as he had done to Hebron, so he did to Debir, and to the king thereof; as he had done also to Libnah, and to her king.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Joṣua kọlù gbogbo ilẹ, ilẹ òke, ati ti Gusù, ati ti pẹtẹlẹ̀, ati ti ẹsẹ̀-òke, ati awọn ọba wọn gbogbo; kò kù ẹnikan silẹ: ṣugbọn o pa ohun gbogbo ti nmí run patapata, gẹgẹ bi OLUWA, Ọlọrun Israeli, ti pa a laṣẹ.
entries.en: So Joshua smote all the country of the hills, and of the south, and of the vale, and of the springs, and all their kings: he left none remaining, but utterly destroyed all that breathed, as the LORD God of Israel commanded.

entries.yo: Joṣua si kọlù wọn lati Kadeṣi-barnea lọ titi dé Gasa, ati gbogbo ilẹ Goṣeni, ani titi dé Gibeoni.
entries.en: And Joshua smote them from Kadesh-barnea even unto Gaza, and all the country of Goshen, even unto Gibeon.

entries.yo: Ati gbogbo awọn ọba wọnyi ati ilẹ wọn, ni Joṣua kó ni ìgba kanna, nitoriti OLUWA, Ọlọrun Israeli, jà fun Israeli.
entries.en: And all these kings and their land did Joshua take at one time, because the LORD God of Israel fought for Israel.

entries.yo: Joṣua si pada, ati gbogbo Israeli pẹlu rẹ̀, si ibudó ni Gilgali.
entries.en: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, unto the camp to Gilgal.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati Jabini ọba Hasoru gbọ́ nkan wọnyi, o ranṣẹ si Jobabu ọba Madoni, ati si ọba Ṣimroni, ati si ọba Akṣafu,
entries.en: And it came to pass, when Jabin king of Hazor had heard those things, that he sent to Jobab king of Madon, and to the king of Shimron, and to the king of Achshaph,

entries.yo: Ati si awọn ọba ti mbẹ ni ìha ariwa, lori òke, ati ti pẹtẹlẹ̀ ni ìha gusù ti Kinnerotu, ati ni ilẹ titẹju, ati ni ilẹ òke Doru ni ìha ìwọ-õrùn,
entries.en: And to the kings that were on the north of the mountains, and of the plains south of Chinneroth, and in the valley, and in the borders of Dor on the west,

entries.yo: Ati si awọn ara Kenaani ni ìha ìla-õrùn ati ni ìha ìwọ-õrùn, ati awọn Amori, ati si awọn Hitti, ati si awọn Perissi, ati si awọn Jebusi lori òke, ati si awọn Hifi nisalẹ Hermoni ni ilẹ Mispa.
entries.en: And to the Canaanite on the east and on the west, and to the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Jebusite in the mountains, and to the Hivite under Hermon in the land of Mizpeh.

entries.yo: Nwọn si jade, awọn ati gbogbo ogun wọn pẹlu wọn, ọ̀pọlọpọ enia, bi yanrin ti mbẹ li eti okun fun ọ̀pọ, ati ẹṣin ati kẹkẹ́ pipọ̀pipọ.
entries.en: And they went out, they and all their hosts with them, much people, even as the sand that is upon the sea shore in multitude, with horses and chariots very many.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn ọba wọnyi si pejọ pọ̀, nwọn wá nwọn si dó ṣọkan ni ibi omi Meromu, lati fi ijà fun Israeli.
entries.en: And when all these kings were met together, they came and pitched together at the waters of Merom, to fight against Israel.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun Joṣua pe, Má ṣe bẹ̀ru nitori wọn: nitori li ọla li akokò yi emi o fi gbogbo wọn tọrẹ niwaju Israeli ni pipa: iwọ o já patì ẹṣin wọn, iwọ o si fi iná sun kẹkẹ́ wọn.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Joshua, Be not afraid because of them: for to morrow about this time will I deliver them up all slain before Israel: thou shalt hough their horses, and burn their chariots with fire.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Joṣua, ati gbogbo awọn ọmọ-ogun pẹlu rẹ̀, yọ si wọn lojijì ni ibi omi Meromu, nwọn si kọlù wọn.
entries.en: So Joshua came, and all the people of war with him, against them by the waters of Merom suddenly; and they fell upon them.

entries.yo: OLUWA si fi wọn lé Israeli lọwọ, nwọn si kọlù wọn, nwọn si lé wọn titi dé Sidoni nla ati titi dé Misrefoti-maimu, ati dé afonifoji Mispa ni ìha ìla-õrùn; nwọn si pa wọn tobẹ̃ ti kò kù ẹnikan silẹ fun wọn.
entries.en: And the LORD delivered them into the hand of Israel, who smote them, and chased them unto great Zidon, and unto Misrephoth-maim, and unto the valley of Mizpeh eastward; and they smote them, until they left them none remaining.

entries.yo: Joṣua si ṣe si wọn gẹgẹ bi OLUWA ti paṣẹ fun u: o já patì ẹṣin wọn, o si fi iná sun kẹkẹ́ wọn.
entries.en: And Joshua did unto them as the LORD bade him: he houghed their horses, and burnt their chariots with fire.

entries.yo: Joṣua si pada li akokò na, o si kó Hasoru, o si fi idà pa ọba rẹ̀: nitori li atijọ́ rí Hasoru li olori gbogbo ilẹ-ọba wọnni.
entries.en: And Joshua at that time turned back, and took Hazor, and smote the king thereof with the sword: for Hazor beforetime was the head of all those kingdoms.

entries.yo: Nwọn si fi oju idà pa gbogbo ọkàn ti mbẹ ninu rẹ̀, nwọn run wọn patapata: a kò kù ẹnikan ti nmí silẹ: o si fi iná kun Hasoru.
entries.en: And they smote all the souls that were therein with the edge of the sword, utterly destroying them: there was not any left to breathe: and he burnt Hazor with fire.

entries.yo: Ati gbogbo ilu awọn ọba wọnni, ati gbogbo ọba wọn, ni Joṣua kó, o si fi oju idà kọlù wọn, o si pa wọn run patapata, gẹgẹ bi Mose iranṣẹ OLUWA ti palaṣẹ.
entries.en: And all the cities of those kings, and all the kings of them, did Joshua take, and smote them with the edge of the sword, and he utterly destroyed them, as Moses the servant of the LORD commanded.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn ilu ti o duro lori òke wọn, Israeli kò sun ọkan ninu wọn, bikoṣe Hasoru nikan; eyi ni Joṣua fi iná sun.
entries.en: But as for the cities that stood still in their strength, Israel burned none of them, save Hazor only; that did Joshua burn.

entries.yo: Ati gbogbo ikogun ilu wonyi, ati ohunọ̀sin, ni awọn ọmọ Israeli kó fun ara wọn; ṣugbọn gbogbo awọn ọkunrin ni nwọn fi oju kọlù, titi nwọn fi pa wọn run, nwọn kò kù ẹnikan silẹ ti nmí.
entries.en: And all the spoil of these cities, and the cattle, the children of Israel took for a prey unto themselves; but every man they smote with the edge of the sword, until they had destroyed them, neither left they any to breathe.

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi OLUWA ti paṣẹ fun Mose iranṣẹ rẹ̀, bẹ̃ni Mose paṣẹ fun Joṣua: bẹ̃ni Joṣua si ṣe; on kò kù ohun kan silẹ ninu gbogbo ohun ti OLUWA palaṣẹ fun Mose.
entries.en: As the LORD commanded Moses his servant, so did Moses command Joshua, and so did Joshua; he left nothing undone of all that the LORD commanded Moses.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Joṣua gbà gbogbo ilẹ na, ilẹ òke, ati gbogbo ilẹ Gusù, ati gbogbo ilẹ Goṣeni, ati ilẹ titẹju, ati pẹtẹlẹ̀, ati ilẹ òke Israeli, ati ilẹ titẹju rẹ̀;
entries.en: So Joshua took all that land, the hills, and all the south country, and all the land of Goshen, and the valley, and the plain, and the mountain of Israel, and the valley of the same;

entries.yo: Lati òke Halaki lọ, ti o lọ soke Seiri, ani dé Baali-gadi ni afonifoji Lebanoni nisalẹ òke Hermoni: ati gbogbo awọn ọba wọn li o kó, o si kọlù wọn, o si pa wọn.
entries.en: Even from the mount Halak, that goeth up to Seir, even unto Baal-gad in the valley of Lebanon under mount Hermon: and all their kings he took, and smote them, and slew them.

entries.yo: Joṣua si bá gbogbo awọn ọba wọnni jagun li ọjọ́ pipọ̀.
entries.en: Joshua made war a long time with all those kings.

entries.yo: Kò sí ilu kan ti o bá awọn ọmọ Israeli ṣọrẹ, bikoṣe awọn Hifi awọn ara ilu Gibeoni: gbogbo wọn ni nwọn fi ogun gbà.
entries.en: There was not a city that made peace with the children of Israel, save the Hivites the inhabitants of Gibeon: all other they took in battle.

entries.yo: Nitori lati ọdọ OLUWA li a ti mu ọkàn wọn le, ki nwọn ki o le jade ogun tọ̀ Israeli wá, ki o le pa wọn run patapata, ki nwọn ki o má si ṣe ri ojurere, ṣugbọn ki o le pa wọn run, gẹgẹ bi OLUWA ti paṣẹ fun Mose.
entries.en: For it was of the LORD to harden their hearts, that they should come against Israel in battle, that he might destroy them utterly, and that they might have no favour, but that he might destroy them, as the LORD commanded Moses.

entries.yo: Li akokò na ni Joṣua wá, ti o si ke awọn ọmọ Anaki kuro ni ilẹ òke, kuro ni Hebroni, kuro ni Debiri, kuro ni Anabu, ati kuro ni gbogbo ilẹ òke Juda, ati kuro ni gbogbo ilẹ òke Israeli: Joṣua run wọn patapata pẹlu ilu wọn.
entries.en: And at that time came Joshua, and cut off the Anakims from the mountains, from Hebron, from Debir, from Anab, and from all the mountains of Judah, and from all the mountains of Israel: Joshua destroyed them utterly with their cities.

entries.yo: Kò kù ẹnikan ninu awọn ọmọ Anaki ni ilẹ awọn ọmọ Israeli: bikoṣe ni Gasa, ni Gati, ati ni Aṣdodu, ni nwọn kù si.
entries.en: There was none of the Anakims left in the land of the children of Israel: only in Gaza, in Gath, and in Ashdod, there remained.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Joṣua gbà gbogbo ilẹ na, gẹgẹ bi ohun gbogbo ti OLUWA ti wi fun Mose; Joṣua si fi i fun Israeli ni ilẹ-iní, gẹgẹ bi ipín wọn nipa ẹ̀ya wọn. Ilẹ na si simi lọwọ ogun.
entries.en: So Joshua took the whole land, according to all that the LORD said unto Moses; and Joshua gave it for an inheritance unto Israel according to their divisions by their tribes. And the land rested from war.

entries.yo: NJẸ wọnyi ni awọn ọba ilẹ na, ti awọn ọmọ Israeli pa, ti nwọn si gbà ilẹ wọn li apa keji Jordani, ni ìha ìla-õrùn, lati odò Arnoni lọ titi dé òke Hermoni, ati gbogbo pẹtẹlẹ̀ ni ìha ìla-õrun:
entries.en: Now these are the kings of the land, which the children of Israel smote, and possessed their land on the other side Jordan toward the rising of the sun, from the river Arnon unto mount Hermon, and all the plain on the east:

entries.yo: Sihoni ọba Amori, ti ngbé Heṣboni, ti o si jọba lati Aroeri, ti mbẹ leti odò Arnoni, ati ilu ti o wà lãrin afonifoji na, ati àbọ Gileadi, ani titi dé odò Jaboku, àgbegbe awọn ọmọ Ammoni;
entries.en: Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt in Heshbon, and ruled from Aroer, which is upon the bank of the river Arnon, and from the middle of the river, and from half Gilead, even unto the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;

entries.yo: Ati ni pẹtẹlẹ̀ lọ dé okun Kinnerotu ni ìha ìla-õrùn, ati titi dé okun pẹtẹlẹ̀, ani Okun Iyọ̀ ni ìha ìla-õrun, li ọ̀na Beti-jeṣimotu; ati lati gusù lọ nisalẹ ẹsẹ̀-òke Pisga:
entries.en: And from the plain to the sea of Chinneroth on the east, and unto the sea of the plain, even the salt sea on the east, the way to Beth-jeshimoth; and from the south, under Ashdoth-pisgah:

entries.yo: Ati àgbegbe Ogu ọba Baṣani, ọkan ninu awọn ti o kù ninu awọn Refaimu, èniti ngbé Aṣtarotu ati Edrei,
entries.en: And the coast of Og king of Bashan, which was of the remnant of the giants, that dwelt at Ashtaroth and at Edrei,

entries.yo: O si jọba li òke Hermoni, ati ni Saleka, ati ni gbogbo Baṣani, titi o fi dé àgbegbe awọn Geṣuri ati awọn Maakati, ati àbọ Gileadi, àla Sihoni ọba Heṣboni.
entries.en: And reigned in mount Hermon, and in Salcah, and in all Bashan, unto the border of the Geshurites and the Maachathites, and half Gilead, the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.

entries.yo: Mose iranṣẹ OLUWA ati awọn ọmọ Israeli kọlù wọn: Mose iranṣẹ OLUWA si fi i fun awọn ọmọ Reubeni ni ilẹ-iní, ati fun awọn ọmọ Gadi, ati fun àbọ ẹ̀ya Manasse.
entries.en: Them did Moses the servant of the LORD and the children of Israel smite: and Moses the servant of the LORD gave it for a possession unto the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh.

entries.yo: Wọnyi li awọn ọba ilẹ na, ti Joṣua ati awọn ọmọ Israeli pa li apa ihin Jordani, ni ìwọ-õrùn, lati Baali-gadi li afonifoji Lebanoni ani titidé òke Halaki, li ọ̀na òke Seiri; ti Joṣua fi fun awọn ẹ̀ya Israeli ni ilẹ-iní gẹgẹ bi ipín wọn.
entries.en: And these are the kings of the country which Joshua and the children of Israel smote on this side Jordan on the west, from Baal-gad in the valley of Lebanon even unto the mount Halak, that goeth up to Seir; which Joshua gave unto the tribes of Israel for a possession according to their divisions;

entries.yo: Ni ilẹ òke, ati ni ilẹ titẹju, ati ni pẹtẹlẹ̀, ati li ẹsẹ̀-òke, ati li aginjù, ati ni Gusù; awọn Hitti, awọn Amori, ati awọn ara Kenaani, awọn Perissi, awọn Hifi, ati awọn Jebusi:
entries.en: In the mountains, and in the valleys, and in the plains, and in the springs, and in the wilderness, and in the south country; the Hittites, the Amorites, and the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites:

entries.yo: Ọba Jeriko, ọkan; ọba Ai, ti o wà lẹba Beti-eli, ọkan.
entries.en: The king of Jericho, one; the king of Ai, which is beside Bethel, one;

entries.yo: Ọba Jerusalemu, ọkan; ọba Hebroni, ọkan;
entries.en: The king of Jerusalem, one; the king of Hebron, one;

entries.yo: Ọba Jarmutu, ọkan; ọba Lakiṣi, ọkan;
entries.en: The king of Jarmuth, one; the king of Lachish, one;

entries.yo: Ọba Egloni, ọkan; ọba Geseri, ọkan;
entries.en: The king of Eglon, one; the king of Gezer, one;

entries.yo: Ọba Debiri, ọkan; ọba Gederi, ọkan;
entries.en: The king of Debir, one; the king of Geder, one;

entries.yo: Ọba Horma, ọkan; ọba Aradi, ọkan;
entries.en: The king of Hormah, one; the king of Arad, one;

entries.yo: Ọba Libna, ọkan; ọba Adullamu, ọkan;
entries.en: The king of Libnah, one; the king of Adullam, one;

entries.yo: Ọba Makkeda, ọkan; ọba Betieli, ọkan;
entries.en: The king of Makkedah, one; the king of Bethel, one;

entries.yo: Ọba Tappua, ọkan; ọba Heferi, ọkan;
entries.en: The king of Tappuah, one; the king of Hepher, one;

entries.yo: Ọba Afeki, ọkan; ọba Laṣaroni, ọkan;
entries.en: The king of Aphek, one; the king of Lasharon, one;

entries.yo: Ọba Madoni, ọkan; ọba Hasoru, ọkan;
entries.en: The king of Madon, one; the king of Hazor, one;

entries.yo: Ọba Ṣimroni-meroni, ọkan; ọba Akṣafu, ọkan;
entries.en: The king of Shimron-meron, one; the king of Achshaph, one;

entries.yo: Ọba Taanaki, ọkan; ọba Megiddo, ọkan;
entries.en: The king of Taanach, one; the king of Megiddo, one;

entries.yo: Ọba Kedeṣi, ọkan; ọba Jokneamu ti Karmeli, ọkan;
entries.en: The king of Kedesh, one; the king of Jokneam of Carmel, one;

entries.yo: Ọba Doru, li òke Doru, ọkan; ọba awọn orilẹ-ède Gilgali, ọkan;
entries.en: The king of Dor in the coast of Dor, one; the king of the nations of Gilgal, one;

entries.yo: Ọba Tirsa, ọkan; gbogbo awọn ọba na jẹ́ mọkanlelọgbọ̀n.
entries.en: The king of Tirzah, one: all the kings thirty and one.

entries.yo: JOṢUA si gbó o si pọ̀ li ọjọ́; OLUWA si wi fun u pe, Iwọ gbó, iwọ si pọ̀ li ọjọ́, ilẹ pipọ̀pipọ si kù lati gbà.
entries.en: Now Joshua was old and stricken in years; and the LORD said unto him, Thou art old and stricken in years, and there remaineth yet very much land to be possessed.

entries.yo: Eyi ni ilẹ ti o kù; gbogbo ilẹ awọn Filistini, ati gbogbo Geṣuri;
entries.en: This is the land that yet remaineth: all the borders of the Philistines, and all Geshuri,

entries.yo: Lati Ṣihori, ti mbẹ niwaju Egipti, ani titi dé àgbegbe Ekroni ni ìha ariwa, ti a kà kún awọn ara Kenaani: awọn ijoye Filistia marun; awọn ara Gasa, ati awọn ara Aṣdodi, awọn ara Aṣkeloni, awọn Gitti, ati awọn ara Ekroni; awọn Affimu pẹlu ni gusù:
entries.en: From Sihor, which is before Egypt, even unto the borders of Ekron northward, which is counted to the Canaanite: five lords of the Philistines; the Gazathites, and the Ashdothites, the Eshkalonites, the Gittites, and the Ekronites; also the Avites:

entries.yo: Gbogbo ilẹ awọn ara Kenaani, ati Meara ti awọn ara Sidoni, dé Afeki, titi dé àgbegbe awọn Amori:
entries.en: From the south, all the land of the Canaanites, and Mearah that is beside the Sidonians, unto Aphek, to the borders of the Amorites:

entries.yo: Ati ilẹ awọn Gebali, ati gbogbo Lebanoni ni ìha ìla-õrùn, lati Baali-gadi nisalẹ òke Hermoni titi o fi dé atiwọ̀ Hamati:
entries.en: And the land of the Giblites, and all Lebanon, toward the sunrising, from Baal-gad under mount Hermon unto the entering into Hamath.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn ara ilẹ òke lati Lebanoni titi dé Misrefoti-maimu, ani gbogbo awọn ara Sidoni; awọn li emi o lé jade kuro niwaju awọn ọmọ Israeli: kìki ki iwọ ki o fi keké pín i fun Israeli ni ilẹ-iní, gẹgẹ bi mo ti paṣẹ fun ọ.
entries.en: All the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon unto Misrephoth-maim, and all the Sidonians, them will I drive out from before the children of Israel: only divide thou it by lot unto the Israelites for an inheritance, as I have commanded thee.

entries.yo: Njẹ nitorina pín ilẹ yi ni ilẹ-iní fun awọn ẹ̀ya mẹsan, ati fun àbọ ẹ̀ya Manasse.
entries.en: Now therefore divide this land for an inheritance unto the nine tribes, and the half tribe of Manasseh,

entries.yo: Pẹlu rẹ̀ awọn ọmọ Reubeni ati awọn ọmọ Gadi ti gbà ilẹ-iní wọn, ti Mose fi fun wọn ni ìha keji Jordani ni ìha ìla õrùn, bi Mose iranṣẹ OLUWA ti fi fun wọn;
entries.en: With whom the Reubenites and the Gadites have received their inheritance, which Moses gave them, beyond Jordan eastward, even as Moses the servant of the LORD gave them;

entries.yo: Lati Aroeri lọ, ti mbẹ leti afonifoji Arnoni, ati ilu ti mbẹ lãrin afonifoji na, ati gbogbo pẹtẹlẹ̀ Medeba titi dé Diboni;
entries.en: From Aroer, that is upon the bank of the river Arnon, and the city that is in the midst of the river, and all the plain of Medeba unto Dibon;

entries.yo: Ati gbogbo ilu Sihoni ọba awọn Amori, ti o jọba ni Heṣboni, titi dé àgbegbe awọn ọmọ Ammoni:
entries.en: And all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites, which reigned in Heshbon, unto the border of the children of Ammon;

entries.yo: Ati Gileadi, ati àgbegbe awọn Geṣuri ati awọn Maakati, ati gbogbo òke Hermoni, ati gbogbo Baṣani dé Saleka;
entries.en: And Gilead, and the border of the Geshurites and Maachathites, and all mount Hermon, and all Bashan unto Salcah;

entries.yo: Gbogbo ilẹ ọba Ogu ni Baṣani, ti o jọba ni Aṣtarotu ati ni Edrei, ẹniti o kù ninu awọn Refaimu iyokù: nitori awọn wọnyi ni Mose kọlù, ti o si lé jade.
entries.en: All the kingdom of Og in Bashan, which reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei, who remained of the remnant of the giants: for these did Moses smite, and cast them out.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn ọmọ Israeli kò lé awọn Geṣuri, tabi awọn Maakati jade: ṣugbọn awọn Geṣuri ati awọn Maakati ngbé ãrin awọn ọmọ Israeli titi di oni.
entries.en: Nevertheless the children of Israel expelled not the Geshurites, nor the Maachathites: but the Geshurites and the Maachathites dwell among the Israelites until this day.

entries.yo: Kìki ẹ̀ya Lefi ni on kò fi ilẹ-iní fun; ẹbọ OLUWA, Ọlọrun Israeli, ti a fi iná ṣe ni iní wọn, gẹgẹ bi o ti wi fun wọn.
entries.en: Only unto the tribe of Levi he gave none inheritance; the sacrifices of the LORD God of Israel made by fire are their inheritance, as he said unto them.

entries.yo: Mose si fi fun ẹ̀ya awọn ọmọ Reubeni, gẹgẹ bi idile wọn.
entries.en: And Moses gave unto the tribe of the children of Reuben inheritance according to their families.

entries.yo: Àla wọn bẹ̀rẹ lati Aroeri lọ, ti mbẹ leti afonifoji Arnoni, ati ilu ti mbẹ lãrin afonifoji nì, ati gbogbo pẹtẹlẹ̀ ti mbẹ ni ìha Medeba;
entries.en: And their coast was from Aroer, that is on the bank of the river Arnon, and the city that is in the midst of the river, and all the plain by Medeba;

entries.yo: Heṣboni, ati gbogbo ilu rẹ̀ ti mbẹ ni pẹtẹlẹ̀; Diboni, ati Bamoti-baali, ati Beti-baali-meoni;
entries.en: Heshbon, and all her cities that are in the plain; Dibon, and Bamoth-baal, and Beth-baal-meon,

entries.yo: Ati Jahasa, ati Kedemoti, ati Mefaati;
entries.en: And Jahazah, and Kedemoth, and Mephaath,

entries.yo: Ati Kiriataimu, ati Sibma, ati Sareti-ṣahari ni òke afonifoji na;
entries.en: And Kirjathaim, and Sibmah, and Zareth-shahar in the mount of the valley,

entries.yo: Ati Beti-peori, ati orisun Pisga, ati Beti-jeṣimotu;
entries.en: And Beth-peor, and Ashdoth-pisgah, and Beth-jeshimoth,

entries.yo: Ati gbogbo ilu pẹtẹlẹ̀ na, ati gbogbo ilẹ-ọba Sihoni ọba awọn Amori, ti o jọba ni Heṣboni, ti Mose kọlù pẹlu awọn ọmọ alade Midiani, Efi, ati Rekemu, ati Suri, ati Huri, ati Reba, awọn ọmọ alade Sihoni, ti ngbé ilẹ na.
entries.en: And all the cities of the plain, and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, which reigned in Heshbon, whom Moses smote with the princes of Midian, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, which were dukes of Sihon, dwelling in the country.

entries.yo: Ati Balaamu ọmọ Beori, alafọṣẹ, ni awọn ọmọ Israeli fi idà pa pẹlu awọn ti nwọn pa.
entries.en: Balaam also the son of Beor, the soothsayer, did the children of Israel slay with the sword among them that were slain by them.

entries.yo: Ati àla awọn ọmọ Reubeni ni Jordani, ati àgbegbe rẹ̀. Eyi ni ilẹ iní awọn ọmọ Reubeni gẹgẹ bi idile wọn, awọn ilu ati ileto wọn.
entries.en: And the border of the children of Reuben was Jordan, and the border thereof. This was the inheritance of the children of Reuben after their families, the cities and the villages thereof.

entries.yo: Mose si fi ilẹ fun ẹ̀ya Gadi, ani fun awọn ọmọ Gadi, gẹgẹ bi idile wọn.
entries.en: And Moses gave inheritance unto the tribe of Gad, even unto the children of Gad according to their families.

entries.yo: Àla wọn bẹ̀rẹ ni Jaseri, ati gbogbo ilu Gileadi, ati àbọ ilẹ awọn ọmọ Ammoni, titi dé Aroeri ti mbẹ niwaju Rabba;
entries.en: And their coast was Jazer, and all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the children of Ammon, unto Aroer that is before Rabbah;
