entries.yo: Ati lati Heṣboni titi dé Ramatu-mispe, ati Betonimu; ati lati Mahanaimu titi dé àgbegbe Debiri;
entries.en: And from Heshbon unto Ramath-mizpeh, and Betonim; and from Mahanaim unto the border of Debir;

entries.yo: Ati ni afonifoji, Beti-haramu, ati Beti-nimra, ati Sukkotu, ati Safoni, iyokù ilẹ-ọba Sihoni ọba Heṣboni, Jordani ati àgbegbe rẹ̀, titi dé ìha opín okun Kinnereti ni ìha keji Jordani ni ìha ìla-õrùn.
entries.en: And in the valley, Beth-aram, and Beth-nimrah, and Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, Jordan and his border, even unto the edge of the sea of Chinnereth on the other side Jordan eastward.

entries.yo: Eyi ni ilẹ-iní awọn ọmọ Gadi gẹgẹ bi idile wọn, ilu wọn ati ileto wọn.
entries.en: This is the inheritance of the children of Gad after their families, the cities, and their villages.

entries.yo: Mose si fi ilẹ-iní fun àbọ ẹ̀ya Manasse: o si jẹ́ ti àbọ ẹ̀ya awọn ọmọ Manasse gẹgẹ bi idile wọn.
entries.en: And Moses gave inheritance unto the half tribe of Manasseh: and this was the possession of the half tribe of the children of Manasseh by their families.

entries.yo: Àla wọn si bẹ̀rẹ lati Mahanaimu lọ, gbogbo Baṣani, gbogbo ilẹ-ọba Ogu ọba Baṣani, ati gbogbo ilu Jairi, ti mbẹ ni Baṣani, ọgọta ilu:
entries.en: And their coast was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all the towns of Jair, which are in Bashan, threescore cities:

entries.yo: Ati àbọ Gileadi, ati Aṣtarotu, ati Edrei, ilu ilẹ-ọba Ogu ni Baṣani, jẹ́ ti awọn ọmọ Makiri, ọmọ Manasse, ani ti àbọ awọn ọmọ Makiri, gẹgẹ bi idile wọn.
entries.en: And half Gilead, and Ashtaroth, and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, were pertaining unto the children of Machir the son of Manasseh, even to the one half of the children of Machir by their families.

entries.yo: Wọnyi li awọn ilẹ-iní na ti Mose pín ni iní ni pẹtẹlẹ̀ Moabu, li apa keji Jordani, lẹba Jeriko ni ìha ìla-õrùn.
entries.en: These are the countries which Moses did distribute for inheritance in the plains of Moab, on the other side Jordan, by Jericho, eastward.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹ̀ya Lefi ni Mose kò fi ilẹ-iní fun: OLUWA, Ọlọrun Israeli, ni iní wọn, gẹgẹ bi o ti wi fun wọn.
entries.en: But unto the tribe of Levi Moses gave not any inheritance: the LORD God of Israel was their inheritance, as he said unto them.

entries.yo: WỌNYI si ni ilẹ-iní ti awọn ọmọ Israeli gbà ni iní ni ilẹ Kenaani, ti Eleasari alufa, ati Joṣua ọmọ Nuni, ati awọn olori awọn baba ẹ̀ya awọn ọmọ Israeli pín fun wọn,
entries.en: And these are the countries which the children of Israel inherited in the land of Canaan, which Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel, distributed for inheritance to them.

entries.yo: Keké ni nwọn fi ní ilẹ-iní wọn, gẹgẹ bi OLUWA ti palaṣẹ lati ọwọ́ Mose wá, fun awọn ẹ̀ya mẹsan, ati àbọ ẹ̀ya ni.
entries.en: By lot was their inheritance, as the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses, for the nine tribes, and for the half tribe.

entries.yo: Nitori Mose ti fi ilẹ-iní fun awọn ẹ̀ya meji ati àbọ ẹ̀ya li apa keji Jordani: ṣugbọn awọn ọmọ Lefi ni on kò fi ilẹ-iní fun lãrin wọn.
entries.en: For Moses had given the inheritance of two tribes and an half tribe on the other side Jordan: but unto the Levites he gave none inheritance among them.

entries.yo: Nitoripe ẹ̀ya meji ni ẹ̀ya awọn ọmọ Josefu, Manasse ati Efraimu: nitorina nwọn kò si fi ipín fun awọn ọmọ Lefi ni ilẹ na, bikoṣe ilu lati ma gbé, pẹlu àgbegbe ilu wọn fun ohunọ̀sin wọn ati ohun-iní wọn.
entries.en: For the children of Joseph were two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim: therefore they gave no part unto the Levites in the land, save cities to dwell in, with their suburbs for their cattle and for their substance.

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi OLUWA ti paṣẹ fun Mose, bẹ̃ni awọn ọmọ Israeli ṣe, nwọn si pín ilẹ na.
entries.en: As the LORD commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did, and they divided the land.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni awọn ọmọ Juda wá sọdọ Joṣua ni Gilgali: Kalebu ọmọ Jefunne ti Kenissi si wi fun u pe, Iwọ mọ̀ ohun ti OLUWA wi fun Mose enia Ọlọrun nipa temi tirẹ ni Kadeṣi-barnea.
entries.en: Then the children of Judah came unto Joshua in Gilgal: and Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite said unto him, Thou knowest the thing that the LORD said unto Moses the man of God concerning me and thee in Kadesh-barnea.

entries.yo: Ẹni ogoji ọdún ni mi nigbati Mose iranṣẹ OLUWA rán mi lati Kadeṣi-barnea lọ ṣamí ilẹ na; mo si mú ìhin fun u wá gẹgẹ bi o ti wà li ọkàn mi.
entries.en: Forty years old was I when Moses the servant of the LORD sent me from Kadesh-barnea to espy out the land; and I brought him word again as it was in mine heart.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn arakunrin mi ti o gòke lọ já awọn enia li àiya: ṣugbọn emi tọ̀ OLUWA Ọlọrun mi lẹhin patapata.
entries.en: Nevertheless my brethren that went up with me made the heart of the people melt: but I wholly followed the LORD my God.

entries.yo: Mose si bura li ọjọ́ na wipe, Nitõtọ ilẹ ti ẹsẹ̀ rẹ ti tẹ̀ nì, ilẹ-iní rẹ ni yio jẹ́, ati ti awọn ọmọ rẹ lailai, nitoriti iwọ tọ̀ OLUWA Ọlọrun mi lẹhin patapata.
entries.en: And Moses sware on that day, saying, Surely the land whereon thy feet have trodden shall be thine inheritance, and thy children's for ever, because thou hast wholly followed the LORD my God.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, kiyesi i, OLUWA da mi si gẹgẹ bi o ti wi, lati ọdún marunlelogoji yi wá, lati ìgba ti OLUWA ti sọ ọ̀rọ yi fun Mose, nigbati Israeli nrìn kiri li aginjù: si kiyesi i nisisiyi, emi di ẹni arundilãdọrun ọdún li oni.
entries.en: And now, behold, the LORD hath kept me alive, as he said, these forty and five years, even since the LORD spake this word unto Moses, while the children of Israel wandered in the wilderness: and now, lo, I am this day fourscore and five years old.

entries.yo: Sibẹ̀ emi lí agbara li oni gẹgẹ bi mo ti ní li ọjọ́ ti Mose rán mi lọ: gẹgẹ bi agbara mi ti ri nigbana, ani bẹ̃li agbara mi ri nisisiyi, fun ogun, ati lati jade ati lati wọle.
entries.en: As yet I am as strong this day as I was in the day that Moses sent me: as my strength was then, even so is my strength now, for war, both to go out, and to come in.

entries.yo: Njẹ nitorina fi òke yi fun mi, eyiti OLUWA wi li ọjọ́ na; nitoriti iwọ gbọ́ li ọjọ́ na bi awọn ọmọ Anaki ti wà nibẹ̀, ati ilu ti o tobi, ti o si ṣe olodi: bọya OLUWA yio wà pẹlu mi, emi o si lé wọn jade, gẹgẹ bi OLUWA ti wi.
entries.en: Now therefore give me this mountain, whereof the LORD spake in that day; for thou heardest in that day how the Anakims were there, and that the cities were great and fenced: if so be the LORD will be with me, then I shall be able to drive them out, as the LORD said.

entries.yo: Joṣua si sure fun u; o si fi Hebroni fun Kalebu ọmọ Jefunne ni ilẹ-iní.
entries.en: And Joshua blessed him, and gave unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh Hebron for an inheritance.

entries.yo: Nitorina Hebroni di ilẹ-iní Kalebu ọmọ Jefunne ti Kenissi titi di oni-oloni; nitoriti o tọ̀ OLUWA Ọlọrun Israeli lẹhin patapata.
entries.en: Hebron therefore became the inheritance of Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite unto this day, because that he wholly followed the LORD God of Israel.

entries.yo: Orukọ Hebroni lailai rí a ma jẹ́ Kiriati-arba; Arba jẹ́ enia nla kan ninu awọn ọmọ Anaki. Ilẹ na si simi lọwọ ogun.
entries.en: And the name of Hebron before was Kirjath-arba; which Arba was a great man among the Anakims. And the land had rest from war.

entries.yo: ILẸ ẹ̀ya awọn ọmọ Juda gẹgẹ bi idile wọn si dé àgbegbe Edomu, ni aginjù Sini, ni ìha gusù, ni apa ipẹkun gusù.
entries.en: This then was the lot of the tribe of the children of Judah by their families; even to the border of Edom the wilderness of Zin southward was the uttermost part of the south coast.

entries.yo: Ati àla gusù wọn ni lati eti Okun Iyọ̀ lọ, lati ibi kọ̀rọ omi nì lọ ti o dojukọ ìha gusù:
entries.en: And their south border was from the shore of the salt sea, from the bay that looketh southward:

entries.yo: O si lọ si apa gusù òke Akrabbimu, o si lọ si Sini, o si gòke lọ ni ìha gusù Kadeṣi-barnea, o si lọ ni ìha Hesroni, o si gòke lọ si Adari, o si yiká lọ dé Karka:
entries.en: And it went out to the south side to Maaleh-acrabbim, and passed along to Zin, and ascended up on the south side unto Kadesh-barnea, and passed along to Hezron, and went up to Adar, and fetched a compass to Karkaa:

entries.yo: Lati ibẹ̀ o lọ dé Asmoni, o si nà lọ si odò Egipti; opín ilẹ na si yọ si okun: eyi ni yio jẹ́ àla ni gusù nyin.
entries.en: From thence it passed toward Azmon, and went out unto the river of Egypt; and the goings out of that coast were at the sea: this shall be your south coast.

entries.yo: Ati àla ìha ìla-õrùn ni Okun Iyọ̀, ani titi dé ipẹkun Jordani. Ati àla apa ariwa ni lati kọ̀rọ okun nì wá dé ipẹkun Jordani:
entries.en: And the east border was the salt sea, even unto the end of Jordan. And their border in the north quarter was from the bay of the sea at the uttermost part of Jordan:

entries.yo: Àla na si gòke lọ si Beti-hogla, o si kọja lọ ni ìha ariwa Beti-araba; àla na si gòke lọ si okuta Bohani ọmọ Reubeni:
entries.en: And the border went up to Beth-hogla, and passed along by the north of Beth-arabah; and the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben:

entries.yo: Àla na si gòke lọ si Debiri lati afonifoji Akoru, ati bẹ̃ lọ si ìha ariwa, ti o dojukọ Gilgali, ti mbẹ niwaju òke Adummimu, ti mbẹ ni ìha gusù odò na: àla si kọja si apa omi Eni-ṣemeṣi, o si yọ si Eni-rogeli:
entries.en: And the border went up toward Debir from the valley of Achor, and so northward, looking toward Gilgal, that is before the going up to Adummim, which is on the south side of the river: and the border passed toward the waters of En-shemesh, and the goings out thereof were at En-rogel:

entries.yo: Àla na si gòke lọ si ìha afonifoji ọmọ Hinnomu si ìha gusù ti Jebusi (ti iṣe Jerusalemu): àla na si gòke lọ si ori òke nla ti mbẹ niwaju afonifoji Hinnomu ni ìha ìwọ-õrùn, ti mbẹ ni ipẹkun afonifoji Refaimu ni ìha ariwa:
entries.en: And the border went up by the valley of the son of Hinnom unto the south side of the Jebusite; the same is Jerusalem: and the border went up to the top of the mountain that lieth before the valley of Hinnom westward, which is at the end of the valley of the giants northward:

entries.yo: A si fà àla na lati ori òke lọ si isun omi Neftoa, o si nà lọ si ilu òke Efroni; a si fà àla na lọ si Baala, (ti iṣe Kirjati-jearimu:)
entries.en: And the border was drawn from the top of the hill unto the fountain of the water of Nephtoah, and went out to the cities of mount Ephron; and the border was drawn to Baalah, which is Kirjath-jearim:

entries.yo: Àla na yi lati Baala lọ si ìha ìwọ-õrùn si òke Seiri, o si kọja lọ si ẹba òke Jearimu (ti ṣe Kesaloni), ni ìha ariwa, o si sọkalẹ lọ si Beti-ṣemeṣi, o si kọja lọ si Timna:
entries.en: And the border compassed from Baalah westward unto mount Seir, and passed along unto the side of mount Jearim, which is Chesalon, on the north side, and went down to Beth-shemesh, and passed on to Timnah:

entries.yo: Àla na si kọja lọ si ẹba Ekroni si ìha ariwa: a si fà àla na lọ dé Ṣikroni, o si kọja lọ si òke Baala, o si yọ si Jabneeli; àla na si yọ si okun.
entries.en: And the border went out unto the side of Ekron northward: and the border was drawn to Shicron, and passed along to mount Baalah, and went out unto Jabneel; and the goings out of the border were at the sea.

entries.yo: Àla ìwọ-õrùn si dé okun nla, ati àgbegbe rẹ̀. Eyi ni àla awọn ọmọ Juda yiká kiri gẹgẹ bi idile wọn.
entries.en: And the west border was to the great sea, and the coast thereof. This is the coast of the children of Judah round about according to their families.

entries.yo: Ati fun Kalebu ọmọ Jefunne li o fi ipín fun lãrin awọn ọmọ Juda, gẹgẹ bi aṣẹ OLUWA fun Joṣua, ani Kiriati-arba (ti iṣe Hebroni); Arba si ni baba Anaki.
entries.en: And unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh he gave a part among the children of Judah, according to the commandment of the LORD to Joshua, even the city of Arba the father of Anak, which city is Hebron.

entries.yo: Kalebu si lé awọn ọmọ Anaki mẹta kuro nibẹ̀, Ṣeṣai, ati Ahimani, ati Talmai, awọn ọmọ Anaki.
entries.en: And Caleb drove thence the three sons of Anak, Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.

entries.yo: O si gòke lati ibẹ̀ tọ̀ awọn ara Debiri lọ: orukọ Debiri lailai rí ni Kiriati-seferi.
entries.en: And he went up thence to the inhabitants of Debir: and the name of Debir before was Kirjath-sepher.

entries.yo: Kalebu si wipe, Ẹniti o ba kọlù Kiriati-seferi, ti o sì kó o, on li emi o fi Aksa ọmọbinrin mi fun li aya.
entries.en: And Caleb said, He that smiteth Kirjath-sepher, and taketh it, to him will I give Achsah my daughter to wife.

entries.yo: Otnieli ọmọ Kenasi, arakunrin Kalebu, si kó o: o si fi Aksa ọmọbinrin rẹ̀ fun u li aya.
entries.en: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, bi Aksa ti dé ọdọ rẹ̀, o mu u bère ọ̀rọ kan lọwọ baba rẹ̀: Aksa si sọkalẹ lori kẹtẹkẹtẹ rẹ̀; Kalebu si wi fun u pe, Kini iwọ nfẹ́?
entries.en: And it came to pass, as she came unto him, that she moved him to ask of her father a field: and she lighted off her ass; and Caleb said unto her, What wouldest thou?

entries.yo: On si dahùn pe, Ta mi li ọrẹ kan; nitoriti iwọ ti fun mi ni ilẹ Gusù, fun mi ni isun omi pẹlu. O si fi isun òke ati isun isalẹ fun u.
entries.en: Who answered, Give me a blessing; for thou hast given me a south land; give me also springs of water. And he gave her the upper springs, and the nether springs.

entries.yo: Eyi ni ilẹ-iní ẹ̀ya awọn ọmọ Juda gẹgẹ bi idile wọn.
entries.en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families.

entries.yo: Ilu ipẹkun ẹ̀ya awọn ọmọ Juda li àgbegbe Edomu ni Gusù ni Kabseeli, ati Ederi, ati Jaguri;
entries.en: And the uttermost cities of the tribe of the children of Judah toward the coast of Edom southward were Kabzeel, and Eder, and Jagur,

entries.yo: Ati Kina, ati Dimona, ati Adada;
entries.en: And Kinah, and Dimonah, and Adadah,

entries.yo: Ati Kedeṣi, ati Hasori, ati Itnani;
entries.en: And Kedesh, and Hazor, and Ithnan,

entries.yo: Sifu, ati Telemu, ati Bealotu;
entries.en: Ziph, and Telem, and Bealoth,

entries.yo: Ati Haṣori-hadatta, ati Keriotu-hesroni (ti iṣe Hasori);
entries.en: And Hazor, Hadattah, and Kerioth, and Hezron, which is Hazor,

entries.yo: Amamu, ati Ṣema, ati Molada;
entries.en: Amam, and Shema, and Moladah,

entries.yo: Ati Hasari-gada, ati Heṣmoni, ati Beti-peleti;
entries.en: And Hazar-gaddah, and Heshmon, and Beth-palet,

entries.yo: Ati Hasari-ṣuali, ati Beeri-ṣeba, ati Bisi-otia;
entries.en: And Hazar-shual, and Beer-sheba, and Bizjothjah,

entries.yo: Baala, ati Iimu, ati Esemu;
entries.en: Baalah, and Iim, and Azem,

entries.yo: Ati Eltoladi, ati Kesili, ati Horma;
entries.en: And Eltolad, and Chesil, and Hormah,

entries.yo: Ati Siklagi, ati Madmanna, ati Sansanna;
entries.en: And Ziklag, and Madmannah, and Sansannah,

entries.yo: Ati Lebaotu, ati Ṣilhimu, ati Aini, ati Rimmoni: gbogbo ilu na jasi mọkandilọgbọ̀n, pẹlu ileto wọn.
entries.en: And Lebaoth, and Shilhim, and Ain, and Rimmon: all the cities are twenty and nine, with their villages:

entries.yo: Ni pẹtẹlẹ̀, Eṣtaoli, ati Sora, ati Aṣna;
entries.en: And in the valley, Eshtaol, and Zoreah, and Ashnah,

entries.yo: Ati Sanoa, ati Eni-gannimu Tappua, ati Enamu;
entries.en: And Zanoah, and En-gannim, Tappuah, and Enam,

entries.yo: Jarmutu, ati Adullamu, Soko, ati Aseka;
entries.en: Jarmuth, and Adullam, Socoh, and Azekah,

entries.yo: Ati Ṣaaraimu, ati Aditaimu, ati Gedera, ati Gederotaimu; ilu mẹrinla pẹlu ileto wọn.
entries.en: And Sharaim, and Adithaim, and Gederah, and Gederothaim; fourteen cities with their villages:

entries.yo: Senani, ati Hadaṣa, ati Migdali-gadi;
entries.en: Zenan, and Hadashah, and Migdal-gad,

entries.yo: Ati Dilani, ati Mispe, ati Jokteeli;
entries.en: And Dilean, and Mizpeh, and Joktheel,

entries.yo: Lakiṣi, ati Boskati, ati Egloni;
entries.en: Lachish, and Bozkath, and Eglon,

entries.yo: Ati Kabboni, ati Lamamu, ati Kitliṣi;
entries.en: And Cabbon, and Lahmam, and Kithlish,

entries.yo: Ati Gederotu, Beti-dagoni, ati Naama, ati Makkeda; ilu mẹrindilogun pẹlu ileto wọn.
entries.en: And Gederoth, Beth-dagon, and Naamah, and Makkedah; sixteen cities with their villages:

entries.yo: Libna, ati Eteri, ati Aṣani;
entries.en: Libnah, and Ether, and Ashan,

entries.yo: Ati Ifta, ati Aṣna, ati Nesibu;
entries.en: And Jiphtah, and Ashnah, and Nezib,

entries.yo: Ati Keila, ati Aksibu, ati Mareṣa; ilu mẹsan pẹlu ileto wọn.
entries.en: And Keilah, and Achzib, and Mareshah; nine cities with their villages:

entries.yo: Ekroni, pẹlu awọn ilu rẹ̀ ati awọn ileto rẹ̀:
entries.en: Ekron, with her towns and her villages:

entries.yo: Lati Ekroni lọ ani titi dé okun, gbogbo eyiti mbẹ leti Aṣdodu, pẹlu ileto wọn.
entries.en: From Ekron even unto the sea, all that lay near Ashdod, with their villages:

entries.yo: Aṣdodu, pẹlu ilu rẹ̀ ati ileto rẹ̀; Gasa, pẹlu ilu rẹ̀ ati ileto rẹ̀; dé odò Egipti, ati okun nla, ati àgbegbe rẹ̀.
entries.en: Ashdod with her towns and her villages, Gaza with her towns and her villages, unto the river of Egypt, and the great sea, and the border thereof:

entries.yo: Ati ni ilẹ òke, Ṣamiri, ati Jattiri, ati Soko;
entries.en: And in the mountains, Shamir, and Jattir, and Socoh,

entries.yo: Ati Dana, ati Kiriati-sana (ti ṣe Debiri);
entries.en: And Dannah, and Kirjath-sannah, which is Debir,

entries.yo: Ati Anabu, ati Eṣtemo, ati Animu;
entries.en: And Anab, and Eshtemoh, and Anim,

entries.yo: Ati Goṣeni, ati Holoni, ati Gilo; ilu mọkanla pẹlu ileto wọn.
entries.en: And Goshen, and Holon, and Giloh; eleven cities with their villages:

entries.yo: Arabu, ati Duma, ati Eṣani;
entries.en: Arab, and Dumah, and Eshean,

entries.yo: Ati Janimu, ati Beti-tappua, ati Afeka;
entries.en: And Janum, and Beth-tappuah, and Aphekah,

entries.yo: Ati Humta, ati Kiriati-arba (ti iṣe Hebroni), ati Siori; ilu meṣan pẹlu ileto wọn.
entries.en: And Humtah, and Kirjath-arba, which is Hebron, and Zior; nine cities with their villages:

entries.yo: Maoni, Karmeli, ati Sifu, ati Juta;
entries.en: Maon, Carmel, and Ziph, and Juttah,

entries.yo: Ati Jesreeli, ati Jokdeamu, ati Sanoa;
entries.en: And Jezreel, and Jokdeam, and Zanoah,

entries.yo: Kaini, Gibea, ati Timna; ilu mẹwa pẹlu ileto wọn.
entries.en: Cain, Gibeah, and Timnah; ten cities with their villages:

entries.yo: Halhulu, Beti-suru, ati Gedori;
entries.en: Halhul, Beth-zur, and Gedor,

entries.yo: Ati Maarati, ati Beti-anotu, ati Eltekoni; ilu mẹfa pẹlu ileto wọn.
entries.en: And Maarath, and Beth-anoth, and Eltekon; six cities with their villages:

entries.yo: Kiriati-baali (ti iṣe Kiriati-jearimu), ati Rabba; ilu meji pẹlu ileto wọn.
entries.en: Kirjath-baal, which is Kirjath-jearim, and Rabbah; two cities with their villages:

entries.yo: Li aginjù, Beti-araba, Middini, ati Sekaka;
entries.en: In the wilderness, Beth-arabah, Middin, and Secacah,

entries.yo: Ati Nibṣani, ati Ilu Iyọ̀, ati Eni-gedi; ilu mẹfa pẹlu ileto wọn.
entries.en: And Nibshan, and the city of Salt, and En-gedi; six cities with their villages.

entries.yo: Bi o si ṣe ti awọn Jebusi nì, awọn ara Jerusalemu, awọn ọmọ Juda kò le lé wọn jade: ṣugbọn awọn Jebusi mbá awọn ọmọ Juda gbé ni Jerusalemu, titi di oni-oloni.
entries.en: As for the Jebusites the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the children of Judah could not drive them out: but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Judah at Jerusalem unto this day.

entries.yo: IPÍN awọn ọmọ Josefu yọ lati Jordani lọ ni Jeriko, ni omi Jeriko ni ìha ìla-õrùn, ani aginjù, ti o gòke lati Jeriko lọ dé ilẹ òke Beti-eli;
entries.en: And the lot of the children of Joseph fell from Jordan by Jericho, unto the water of Jericho on the east, to the wilderness that goeth up from Jericho throughout mount Bethel,

entries.yo: O si ti Beti-eli yọ si Lusi, o si kọja lọ si àgbegbe Arki dé Atarotu;
entries.en: And goeth out from Bethel to Luz, and passeth along unto the borders of Archi to Ataroth,

entries.yo: O si sọkalẹ ni ìha ìwọ-õrùn si àgbegbe Jafleti, dé àgbegbe Beti-horoni isalẹ, ani dé Geseri: o si yọ si okun.
entries.en: And goeth down westward to the coast of Japhleti, unto the coast of Beth-horon the nether, and to Gezer: and the goings out thereof are at the sea.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li awọn ọmọ Josefu, Manasse ati Efraimu, gbà ilẹ-iní wọn.
entries.en: So the children of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, took their inheritance.

entries.yo: Àla awọn ọmọ Efraimu gẹgẹ bi idile wọn li eyi: ani àla ilẹ-iní wọn ni ìha ìla-õrùn ni Atarotu-adari, dé Beti-horoni òke;
entries.en: And the border of the children of Ephraim according to their families was thus: even the border of their inheritance on the east side was Ataroth-addar, unto Beth-horon the upper;

entries.yo: Àla na si lọ si ìha ìwọ-õrùn si ìha ariwa Mikmeta; àla na si yi lọ si ìha ìla-õrùn dé Taanati-ṣilo, o si kọja lẹba rẹ̀ lọ ni ìha ìla-õrùn Janoha;
entries.en: And the border went out toward the sea to Michmethah on the north side; and the border went about eastward unto Taanath-shiloh, and passed by it on the east to Janohah;

entries.yo: O si sọkalẹ lati Janoha lọ dé Atarotu, ati dé Naara, o si dé Jeriko, o si yọ si Jordani.
entries.en: And it went down from Janohah to Ataroth, and to Naarath, and came to Jericho, and went out at Jordan.

entries.yo: Àla na jade lọ lati Tappua si ìha ìwọ-õrùn titi dé odò Kana; o si yọ si okun. Eyi ni ilẹ-iní ẹ̀ya awọn ọmọ Efraimu gẹgẹ bi idile wọn;
entries.en: The border went out from Tappuah westward unto the river Kanah; and the goings out thereof were at the sea. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Ephraim by their families.

entries.yo: Pẹlu ilu ti a yàsọtọ fun awọn ọmọ Efraimu lãrin ilẹ-iní awọn ọmọ Manasse, gbogbo ilu na pẹlu ileto wọn.
entries.en: And the separate cities for the children of Ephraim were among the inheritance of the children of Manasseh, all the cities with their villages.

entries.yo: Nwọn kò si lé awọn ara Kenaani ti ngbé Geseri jade: ṣugbọn awọn ara Kenaani joko lãrin Efraimu titi di oni yi, nwọn si di ẹrú lati ma sìnru.
entries.en: And they drave not out the Canaanites that dwelt in Gezer: but the Canaanites dwell among the Ephraimites unto this day, and serve under tribute.

entries.yo: EYI si ni ipín ẹ̀ya Manasse; nitori on li akọ́bi Josefu. Bi o ṣe ti Makiri akọ́bi Manasse, baba Gileadi, nitori on ṣe ologun, nitorina li o ṣe ní Gileadi ati Baṣani.
entries.en: There was also a lot for the tribe of Manasseh; for he was the firstborn of Joseph; to wit, for Machir the firstborn of Manasseh, the father of Gilead: because he was a man of war, therefore he had Gilead and Bashan.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Manasse iyokù si ní ilẹ-iní gẹgẹ bi idile wọn; awọn ọmọ Abieseri, ati awọn ọmọ Heleki, ati awọn ọmọ Asrieli, ati awọn ọmọ Ṣekemu, ati awọn ọmọ Heferi, ati awọn ọmọ Ṣemida: awọn wọnyi ni awọn ọmọ Manasse ọmọ Josefu gẹgẹ bi idile wọn.
entries.en: There was also a lot for the rest of the children of Manasseh by their families; for the children of Abiezer, and for the children of Helek, and for the children of Asriel, and for the children of Shechem, and for the children of Hepher, and for the children of Shemida: these were the male children of Manasseh the son of Joseph by their families.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Selofehadi, ọmọ Heferi, ọmọ Gileadi, ọmọ Makiri, ọmọ Manasse, kò ní ọmọkunrin, bikoṣe ọmọbinrin: awọn wọnyi si li orukọ awọn ọmọbinrin rẹ̀, Mala, ati Noa, Hogla, Milka, ati Tirsa.
entries.en: But Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons, but daughters: and these are the names of his daughters, Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

entries.yo: Nwọn si wá siwaju Eleasari alufa, ati siwaju Joṣua ọmọ Nuni, ati siwaju awọn olori, wipe, OLUWA fi aṣẹ fun Mose lati fun wa ni ilẹ-iní lãrin awọn arakunrin wa: nitorina o fi ilẹ-iní fun wọn lãrin awọn arakunrin baba wọn, gẹgẹ bi aṣẹ OLUWA.
entries.en: And they came near before Eleazar the priest, and before Joshua the son of Nun, and before the princes, saying, The LORD commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brethren. Therefore according to the commandment of the LORD he gave them an inheritance among the brethren of their father.

entries.yo: Ipín mẹwa si bọ́ sọdọ Manasse, làika ilẹ Gileadi ati Baṣani, ti mbẹ ni ìha keji Jordani;
entries.en: And there fell ten portions to Manasseh, beside the land of Gilead and Bashan, which were on the other side Jordan;

entries.yo: Nitoriti awọn ọmọbinrin Manasse ní ilẹ-iní lãrin awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ ọkunrin: awọn ọmọ Manasse ọkunrin iyokù si ní ilẹ Gileadi.
entries.en: Because the daughters of Manasseh had an inheritance among his sons: and the rest of Manasseh's sons had the land of Gilead.

entries.yo: Àla Manasse si lọ lati Aṣeri dé Mikmeta, ti mbẹ niwaju Ṣekemu; àla na si lọ titi ni ìha ọtún, sọdọ awọn ara Eni-tappua.
entries.en: And the coast of Manasseh was from Asher to Michmethah, that lieth before Shechem; and the border went along on the right hand unto the inhabitants of En-tappuah.

entries.yo: Manasse li o ní ilẹ Tappua: ṣugbọn Tappua li àla Manasse jẹ́ ti awọn ọmọ Efraimu.
entries.en: Now Manasseh had the land of Tappuah: but Tappuah on the border of Manasseh belonged to the children of Ephraim;

entries.yo: Àla rẹ̀ si sọkalẹ lọ si odò Kana, ni ìha gusù odò na: ilu Efraimu wọnyi wà lãrin awọn ilu Manasse: àla Manasse pẹlu si wà ni ìha ariwa odò na, o si yọ si okun:
entries.en: And the coast descended unto the river Kanah, southward of the river: these cities of Ephraim are among the cities of Manasseh: the coast of Manasseh also was on the north side of the river, and the outgoings of it were at the sea:

entries.yo: Ni ìha gusù ti Efraimu ni, ati ni ìha ariwa ti Manasse ni, okun si ni àla rẹ̀; nwọn si dé Aṣeri ni ìha ariwa, ati Issakari ni ìha ìla-õrùn.
entries.en: Southward it was Ephraim's, and northward it was Manasseh's, and the sea is his border; and they met together in Asher on the north, and in Issachar on the east.

entries.yo: Manasse si ní ni Issakari ati ni Aṣeri, Beti-ṣeani ati awọn ilu rẹ̀, ati Ibleamu ati awọn ilu rẹ̀, ati awọn ara Dori ati awọn ilu rẹ̀, ati awọn ara Enidori ati awọn ilu rẹ̀, ati awọn ara Taanaki ati awọn ilu rẹ̀, ati awọn ara Megiddo ati awọn ilu rẹ̀, ani òke mẹta na.
entries.en: And Manasseh had in Issachar and in Asher Beth-shean and her towns, and Ibleam and her towns, and the inhabitants of Dor and her towns, and the inhabitants of Endor and her towns, and the inhabitants of Taanach and her towns, and the inhabitants of Megiddo and her towns, even three countries.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn ọmọ Manasse kò le gbà ilu wọnyi; awọn ara Kenaani si ngbé ilẹ na.
entries.en: Yet the children of Manasseh could not drive out the inhabitants of those cities; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati awọn ọmọ Israeli ndi alagbara, nwọn mu awọn ara Kenaani sìn, ṣugbọn nwọn kò lé wọn jade patapata.
entries.en: Yet it came to pass, when the children of Israel were waxen strong, that they put the Canaanites to tribute; but did not utterly drive them out.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Josefu si wi fun Joṣua pe, Ẽṣe ti iwọ fi fun mi ni ilẹ kan, ati ipín kan ni ilẹ-iní, bẹ̃ni enia nla ni mi, niwọnbi OLUWA ti bukún mi titi di isisiyi?
entries.en: And the children of Joseph spake unto Joshua, saying, Why hast thou given me but one lot and one portion to inherit, seeing I am a great people, forasmuch as the LORD hath blessed me hitherto?

entries.yo: Joṣua si da wọn lohùn pe, Bi iwọ ba jẹ́ enia nla, gòke lọ si igbó, ki o si ṣanlẹ fun ara rẹ nibẹ̀ ni ilẹ awọn Perissi ati ti Refaimu; bi òke Efraimu ba há jù fun ọ.
entries.en: And Joshua answered them, If thou be a great people, then get thee up to the wood country, and cut down for thyself there in the land of the Perizzites and of the giants, if mount Ephraim be too narrow for thee.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Josefu si wipe, Òke na kò to fun wa: gbogbo awọn ara Kenaani ti ngbé ilẹ afonifoji si ní kẹkẹ́ irin, ati awọn ti mbẹ ni Beti-ṣeani, ati awọn ilu rẹ̀, ati awọn ti mbẹ ni afonifoji Jesreeli.
entries.en: And the children of Joseph said, The hill is not enough for us: and all the Canaanites that dwell in the land of the valley have chariots of iron, both they who are of Beth-shean and her towns, and they who are of the valley of Jezreel.

entries.yo: Joṣua si wi fun ile Josefu, ani fun Efraimu ati fun Manasse pe, Enia nla ni iwọ, iwọ si lí agbara pipọ̀: iwọ ki yio ní ipín kanṣoṣo:
entries.en: And Joshua spake unto the house of Joseph, even to Ephraim and to Manasseh, saying, Thou art a great people, and hast great power: thou shalt not have one lot only:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ilẹ òke yio jẹ́ tirẹ; nitoriti iṣe igbó, iwọ o si ṣán a, ati ìna rẹ̀ yio jẹ́ tirẹ: nitoriti iwọ o lé awọn ara Kenaani jade, bi o ti jẹ́ pe nwọn ní kẹkẹ́ irin nì, ti o si jẹ́ pe nwọn lí agbara.
entries.en: But the mountain shall be thine; for it is a wood, and thou shalt cut it down: and the outgoings of it shall be thine: for thou shalt drive out the Canaanites, though they have iron chariots, and though they be strong.

entries.yo: GBOGBO ijọ awọn ọmọ Israeli si pejọ ni Ṣilo, nwọn si gbé agọ́ ajọ ró nibẹ̀: a si ṣẹgun ilẹ na niwaju wọn.
entries.en: And the whole congregation of the children of Israel assembled together at Shiloh, and set up the tabernacle of the congregation there. And the land was subdued before them.

entries.yo: Ẹ̀ya meje si kù ninu awọn ọmọ Israeli, ti kò ti igbà ilẹ-iní wọn.
entries.en: And there remained among the children of Israel seven tribes, which had not yet received their inheritance.

entries.yo: Joṣua si wi fun awọn ọmọ Israeli pe, Ẹnyin o ti lọra pẹ to lati lọ igbà ilẹ na, ti OLUWA, Ọlọrun awọn baba nyin, ti fi fun nyin?
entries.en: And Joshua said unto the children of Israel, How long are ye slack to go to possess the land, which the LORD God of your fathers hath given you?

entries.yo: Ẹ yàn ọkunrin mẹta fun ẹ̀ya kọkan: emi o si rán wọn, nwọn o si dide, nwọn o si là ilẹ na já, nwọn o si ṣe apejuwe rẹ̀ gẹgẹ bi ilẹ-iní wọn; ki nwọn ki o si pada tọ̀ mi wá.
entries.en: Give out from among you three men for each tribe: and I will send them, and they shall rise, and go through the land, and describe it according to the inheritance of them; and they shall come again to me.

entries.yo: Nwọn o si pín i si ọ̀na meje: Juda yio ma gbé ilẹ rẹ̀ ni gusù, ile Josefu yio si ma gbé ilẹ wọn ni ariwa.
entries.en: And they shall divide it into seven parts: Judah shall abide in their coast on the south, and the house of Joseph shall abide in their coasts on the north.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin o si ṣe apejuwe ilẹ na li ọ̀na meje, ẹnyin o si mú apejuwe tọ̀ mi wá nihin, ki emi ki o le ṣẹ́ keké rẹ̀ fun nyin nihin niwaju OLUWA Ọlọrun wa.
entries.en: Ye shall therefore describe the land into seven parts, and bring the description hither to me, that I may cast lots for you here before the LORD our God.

entries.yo: Nitoriti awọn ọmọ Lefi kò ní ipín lãrin nyin; nitori iṣẹ-alufa OLUWA ni iní wọn: ati Gadi, ati Reubeni, ati àbọ ẹ̀ya Manasse, ti gbà ilẹ-iní wọn na ni ìha keji Jordani ni ìha ìla-õrùn, ti Mose iranṣẹ OLUWA fi fun wọn.
entries.en: But the Levites have no part among you; for the priesthood of the LORD is their inheritance: and Gad, and Reuben, and half the tribe of Manasseh, have received their inheritance beyond Jordan on the east, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave them.

entries.yo: Awọn ọkunrin na si dide, nwọn si lọ: Joṣua si paṣẹ fun awọn ti o lọ ṣe apejuwe ilẹ na, wipe, Ẹ lọ, ki ẹ si rìn ilẹ na já, ki ẹ si ṣe apejuwe rẹ̀, ki ẹ si pada tọ̀ mi wá, ki emi ki o le ṣẹ́ keké fun nyin niwaju OLUWA ni Ṣilo.
entries.en: And the men arose, and went away: and Joshua charged them that went to describe the land, saying, Go and walk through the land, and describe it, and come again to me, that I may here cast lots for you before the LORD in Shiloh.

entries.yo: Awọn ọkunrin na si lọ, nwọn si là ilẹ na já, nwọn si ṣe apejuwe rẹ̀ sinu iwé ni ilu ilu li ọ̀na meje, nwọn si pada tọ̀ Joṣua wá, si ibudó ni Ṣilo.
entries.en: And the men went and passed through the land, and described it by cities into seven parts in a book, and came again to Joshua to the host at Shiloh.

entries.yo: Joṣua si ṣẹ́ keké fun wọn ni Ṣilo niwaju OLUWA: nibẹ̀ ni Joṣua si pín ilẹ na fun awọn ọmọ Israeli gẹgẹ bi ipín wọn.
entries.en: And Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before the LORD: and there Joshua divided the land unto the children of Israel according to their divisions.

entries.yo: Ilẹ ẹ̀ya awọn ọmọ Benjamini yọ jade, gẹgẹ bi idile wọn: àla ipín wọn si yọ si agbedemeji awọn ọmọ Juda ati awọn ọmọ Josefu.
entries.en: And the lot of the tribe of the children of Benjamin came up according to their families: and the coast of their lot came forth between the children of Judah and the children of Joseph.

entries.yo: Àla wọn ni ìha ariwa si ti Jordani lọ; àla na si gòke lọ si ìha Jeriko ni ìha ariwa, o si là ilẹ òke lọ ni iwọ-õrùn; o si yọ si aginjù Beti-afeni.
entries.en: And their border on the north side was from Jordan; and the border went up to the side of Jericho on the north side, and went up through the mountains westward; and the goings out thereof were at the wilderness of Beth-aven.

entries.yo: Àla na si ti ibẹ̀ lọ si Lusi, si ìha Lusi (ti ṣe Beti-eli), ni ìha gusù; àla na si sọkale lọ si Atarotu-adari, lẹba òke ti mbẹ ni gusù Beti-horoni isalẹ.
entries.en: And the border went over from thence toward Luz, to the side of Luz, which is Bethel, southward; and the border descended to Ataroth-adar, near the hill that lieth on the south side of the nether Beth-horon.

entries.yo: A si fà àla na lọ, o si yi si ìha ìwọ-õrùn lọ si gusù, lati òke ti mbẹ niwaju Beti-horoni ni ìha gusù; o si yọ si Kiriati-baali (ti ṣe Kiriati-jearimu), ilu awọn ọmọ Juda kan: eyi ni apa ìwọ-õrùn.
entries.en: And the border was drawn thence, and compassed the corner of the sea southward, from the hill that lieth before Beth-horon southward; and the goings out thereof were at Kirjath-baal, which is Kirjath-jearim, a city of the children of Judah: this was the west quarter.

entries.yo: Ati apa gusù ni lati ipẹkun Kiriati-jearimu, àla na si yọ ìwọ-õrùn, o si yọ si isun omi Neftoa:
entries.en: And the south quarter was from the end of Kirjath-jearim, and the border went out on the west, and went out to the well of waters of Nephtoah:

entries.yo: Àla na si sọkalẹ lọ si ipẹkun òke ti mbẹ niwaju afonifoji ọmọ Hinnomu, ti o si mbẹ ni afonifoji Refaimu ni ìha ariwa; o si sọkalẹ lọ si afonifoji Hinnomu, si apa Jebusi ni ìha gusù, o si sọkalẹ lọ si Eni-rogeli;
entries.en: And the border came down to the end of the mountain that lieth before the valley of the son of Hinnom, and which is in the valley of the giants on the north, and descended to the valley of Hinnom, to the side of Jebusi on the south, and descended to En-rogel,

entries.yo: A si fà a lati ariwa lọ, o si yọ si Eni-ṣemeṣi, o si yọ si Gelilotu, ti o kọjusi òke Adummimu; o si sọkalẹ lọ si okuta Bohani ọmọ Reubeni;
entries.en: And was drawn from the north, and went forth to En-shemesh, and went forth toward Geliloth, which is over against the going up of Adummim, and descended to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben,

entries.yo: O si kọja lọ si apa ibi ti o kọjusi Araba ni ìha ariwa, o si sọkalẹ lọ si Araba:
entries.en: And passed along toward the side over against Arabah northward, and went down unto Arabah:

entries.yo: Àla na si kọja lọ dé apa Beti-hogla ni ìha ariwa: àla na si yọ ni ìha ariwa si kọ̀rọ Okun Iyọ̀, ni ipẹkun gusù ti Jordani: eyi ni àla gusù.
entries.en: And the border passed along to the side of Beth-hoglah northward: and the outgoings of the border were at the north bay of the salt sea at the south end of Jordan: this was the south coast.

entries.yo: Jordani si ni àla rẹ̀ ni ìha ìla-õrùn. Eyi ni ilẹ-iní awọn ọmọ Benjamini, li àgbegbe rẹ̀ kakiri, gẹgẹ bi idile wọn.
entries.en: And Jordan was the border of it on the east side. This was the inheritance of the children of Benjamin, by the coasts thereof round about, according to their families.

entries.yo: Njẹ ilu ẹ̀ya awọn ọmọ Benjamini gẹgẹ bi idile wọn, ni Jeriko, ati Beti-hogla, ati Emekikesisi;
entries.en: Now the cities of the tribe of the children of Benjamin according to their families were Jericho, and Beth-hoglah, and the valley of Keziz,

entries.yo: Ati Beti-araba, ati Semaraimu, ati Beti-eli;
entries.en: And Beth-arabah, and Zemaraim, and Bethel,

entries.yo: Ati Affimu, ati Para, ati Ofra;
entries.en: And Avim, and Parah, and Ophrah,

entries.yo: Ati Kefari-ammoni, ati Ofni, ati Geba; ilu mejila pẹlu ileto wọn:
entries.en: And Chephar-haammonai, and Ophni, and Gaba; twelve cities with their villages:

entries.yo: Gibeoni, ati Rama, ati Beerotu;
entries.en: Gibeon, and Ramah, and Beeroth,

entries.yo: Ati Mispe, ati Kefira, ati Mosa;
entries.en: And Mizpeh, and Chephirah, and Mozah,

entries.yo: Ati Rekemu, ati Irpeeli, ati Tarala;
entries.en: And Rekem, and Irpeel, and Taralah,

entries.yo: Ati Sela, Elefu, ati Jebusi (ti iṣe Jerusalemu), Gibeati, ati Kitiria; ilu mẹrinla pẹlu ileto wọn. Eyi ni ilẹ-iní awọn ọmọ Benjamini gẹgẹ bi idile wọn.
entries.en: And Zelah, Eleph, and Jebusi, which is Jerusalem, Gibeath, and Kirjath; fourteen cities with their villages. This is the inheritance of the children of Benjamin according to their families.

entries.yo: IPÍN keji yọ fun Simeoni, ani fun ẹ̀ya awọn ọmọ Simeoni gẹgẹ bi idile wọn; ilẹ-iní wọn si wà lãrin ilẹ-iní awọn ọmọ Juda.
entries.en: And the second lot came forth to Simeon, even for the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families: and their inheritance was within the inheritance of the children of Judah.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ní Beeri-ṣeba, tabi Ṣeba, ati Molada, ni ilẹ-iní wọn;
entries.en: And they had in their inheritance Beer-sheba, or Sheba, and Moladah,

entries.yo: Ati Hasari-ṣuali, ati Bala, ati Esemu;
entries.en: And Hazar-shual, and Balah, and Azem,

entries.yo: Ati Eltoladi, ati Bẹtulu, ati Horma;
entries.en: And Eltolad, and Bethul, and Hormah,

entries.yo: Ati Siklagi, ati Beti-markabotu, ati Hasari-susa;
entries.en: And Ziklag, and Beth-marcaboth, and Hazar-susah,

entries.yo: Ati Beti-lebaotu, ati Ṣaruheni; ilu mẹtala pẹlu ileto wọn:
entries.en: And Beth-lebaoth, and Sharuhen; thirteen cities and their villages:

entries.yo: Aini, Rimmoni, ati Eteri, ati Aṣani; ilu mẹrin pẹlu ileto wọn:
entries.en: Ain, Remmon, and Ether, and Ashan; four cities and their villages:

entries.yo: Ati gbogbo ileto ti o yi ilu wọnyi ká dé Baalati-beeri, Rama ti Gusù. Eyi ni ilẹ-iní ẹ̀ya awọn ọmọ Simeoni gẹgẹ bi idile wọn.
entries.en: And all the villages that were round about these cities to Baalath-beer, Ramath of the south. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families.

entries.yo: Ninu ipín awọn ọmọ Juda ni awọn ọmọ Simeoni ni ilẹ-iní: nitori ipín awọn ọmọ Juda pọ̀ju fun wọn: nitorina ni awọn ọmọ Simeoni fi ní ilẹ-iní lãrin ilẹ-iní wọn.
entries.en: Out of the portion of the children of Judah was the inheritance of the children of Simeon: for the part of the children of Judah was too much for them: therefore the children of Simeon had their inheritance within the inheritance of them.

entries.yo: Ilẹ kẹta yọ fun awọn ọmọ Sebuluni gẹgẹ bi idile wọn: àla ilẹ-iní wọn si dé Saridi:
entries.en: And the third lot came up for the children of Zebulun according to their families: and the border of their inheritance was unto Sarid:

entries.yo: Àla wọn gòke lọ si ìha ìwọ-õrùn, ani titi o fi dé Marala, o si dé Dabaṣeti; o si dé odò ti mbẹ niwaju Jokneamu;
entries.en: And their border went up toward the sea, and Maralah, and reached to Dabbasheth, and reached to the river that is before Jokneam;

entries.yo: O si ṣẹri lati Saridi lọ ni ìha ìla-õrùn si ìla-õrùn dé àla Kisloti-tabori; o si yọ si Daberati; o si jade lọ si Jafia;
entries.en: And turned from Sarid eastward toward the sunrising unto the border of Chisloth-tabor, and then goeth out to daberath, and goeth up to Japhia,

entries.yo: Ati lati ibẹ̀ o kọja ni ìha ìla-õrùn si Gati-heferi, dé Ẹti-kasini; o si yọ si Rimmoni titi o fi dé Nea;
entries.en: And from thence passeth on along on the east to Gittah-hepher, to Ittah-kazin, and goeth out to Remmon-methoar to Neah;

entries.yo: Àla na si yi i ká ni ìha ariwa dé Hannatoni: o si yọ si afonifoji Ifta-eli;
entries.en: And the border compasseth it on the north side to Hannathon: and the outgoings thereof are in the valley of Jiphthah-el:

entries.yo: Ati Katati, ati Nahalali, ati Ṣimroni, ati Idala, ati Beti-lehemu: ilu mejila pẹlu ileto wọn.
entries.en: And Kattath, and Nahallal, and Shimron, and Idalah, and Bethlehem: twelve cities with their villages.

entries.yo: Eyi ni ilẹ-iní awọn ọmọ Sebuluni gẹgẹ bi idile wọn, ilu wọnyi pẹlu ileto wọn.
entries.en: This is the inheritance of the children of Zebulun according to their families, these cities with their villages.

entries.yo: Ipín kẹrin yọ fun Issakari, ani fun awọn ọmọ Issakari gẹgẹ bi idile wọn.
entries.en: And the fourth lot came out to Issachar, for the children of Issachar according to their families.

entries.yo: Àla wọn si dé Jesreeli, ati Kesuloti, ati Ṣunemu;
entries.en: And their border was toward Jezreel, and Chesulloth, and Shunem,

entries.yo: Ati Hafaraimu, ati Ṣihoni, ati Anaharati;
entries.en: And Hapharaim, and Shion, and Anaharath,

entries.yo: Ati Rabbiti, Kiṣioni, ati Ebesi;
entries.en: And Rabbith, and Kishion, and Abez,

entries.yo: Ati Remeti, ati Eni-gannimu, ati Enhadda, ati Beti-passesi;
entries.en: And Remeth, and En-gannim, and En-haddah, and Beth-pazzez;

entries.yo: Àla na si dé Tabori, ati Ṣahasuma, ati Beti-ṣemeṣi; àla wọn yọ si Jordani: ilu mẹrindilogun pẹlu ileto wọn.
entries.en: And the coast reacheth to Tabor, and Shahazimah, and Beth-shemesh; and the outgoings of their border were at Jordan: sixteen cities with their villages.

entries.yo: Eyi ni ilẹ-iní ẹ̀ya awọn ọmọ Issakari gẹgẹ bi idile wọn, ilu wọnyi ati ileto wọn.
entries.en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Issachar according to their families, the cities and their villages.

entries.yo: Ipín karun yọ fun ẹ̀ya awọn ọmọ Aṣeri gẹgẹ bi idile wọn.
entries.en: And the fifth lot came out for the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families.

entries.yo: Àla wọn si ni Helkati, ati Hali, ati Beteni, ati Akṣafu;
entries.en: And their border was Helkath, and Hali, and Beten, and Achshaph,

entries.yo: Ati Allammeleki, ati Amadi, ati Miṣali; o si dé Karmeli ni ìha ìwọ-õrùn, ati Ṣihorilibnati;
entries.en: And Alammelech, and Amad, and Misheal; and reacheth to Carmel westward, and to Shihor-libnath;

entries.yo: O si ṣẹri lọ si ìha ìla-õrùn dé Beti-dagoni, o si dé Sebuluni, ati afonifoji Ifta-eli ni ìha ariwa dé Betemeki, ati Neieli; o si yọ si Kabulu li apa òsi,
entries.en: And turneth toward the sunrising to Beth-dagon, and reacheth to Zebulun, and to the valley of Jiphthah-el toward the north side of Beth-emek, and Neiel, and goeth out to Cabul on the left hand,

entries.yo: Ati Ebroni, ati Rehobu, ati Hammoni, ati Kana, ani titi dé Sidoni nla;
entries.en: And Hebron, and Rehob, and Hammon, and Kanah, even unto great Zidon;

entries.yo: Àla na si ṣẹri lọ si Rama, ati si Tire ilu olodi; àla na si ṣẹri lọ si Hosa; o si yọ si okun ni ìha Aksibu:
entries.en: And then the coast turneth to Ramah, and to the strong city Tyre; and the coast turneth to Hosah; and the outgoings thereof are at the sea from the coast to Achzib:

entries.yo: Ati Umma, ati Afeki, ati Rehobu: ilu mejilelogun pẹlu ileto wọn.
entries.en: Ummah also, and Aphek, and Rehob: twenty and two cities with their villages.

entries.yo: Eyi ni ilẹ-iní ẹ̀ya awọn ọmọ Aṣeri gẹgẹ bi idile wọn, ilu wọnyi pẹlu ileto wọn.
entries.en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families, these cities with their villages.

entries.yo: Ipín kẹfa yọ fun awọn ọmọ Naftali, ani fun awọn ọmọ Naftali gẹgẹ bi idile wọn.
entries.en: The sixth lot came out to the children of Naphtali, even for the children of Naphtali according to their families.

entries.yo: Àla wọn si bẹ̀rẹ lati Helefu, lati igi-oaku Saanannimu, ati Adami-nekebu, ati Jabneeli dé Lakkumu; o si yọ si Jordani.
entries.en: And their coast was from Heleph, from Allon to Zaanannim, and Adami, Nekeb, and Jabneel, unto Lakum; and the outgoings thereof were at Jordan:

entries.yo: Àla na si ṣẹri lọ sí ìha ìwọ-õrùn si Asnoti-taboru, o si ti ibẹ̀ lọ si Hukkoki; o si dé Sebuluni ni gusù, o si dé Aṣeri ni ìwọ-õrùn, ati Juda ni Jordani ni ìha ìla-õrùn.
entries.en: And then the coast turneth westward to Aznoth-tabor, and goeth out from thence to Hukkok, and reacheth to Zebulun on the south side, and reacheth to Asher on the west side, and to Judah upon Jordan toward the sunrising.

entries.yo: Awọn ilu olodi si ni Siddimu, Seri, ati Hammati, Rakkati, ati Kinnereti;
entries.en: And the fenced cities are Ziddim, Zer, and Hammath, Rakkath, and Chinnereth,

entries.yo: Ati Adama, ati Rama, ati Hasoru;
entries.en: And Adamah, and Ramah, and Hazor,

entries.yo: Ati Kedeṣi, ati Edrei, ati Eni-hasoru;
entries.en: And Kedesh, and Edrei, and En-hazor,

entries.yo: Ati Ironi, ati Migdali-eli, Horemu, ati Beti-anati, ati Beti-ṣemeṣi; ilu mọkandilogun pẹlu ileto wọn.
entries.en: And Iron, and Migdal-el, Horem, and Beth-anath, and Beth-shemesh; nineteen cities with their villages.

entries.yo: Eyi ni ilẹ-iní ẹ̀ya awọn ọmọ Naftali gẹgẹ bi idile wọn, ilu wọnyi pẹlu ileto wọn.
entries.en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Naphtali according to their families, the cities and their villages.

entries.yo: Ilẹ keje yọ fun ẹ̀ya awọn ọmọ Dani gẹgẹ bi idile wọn.
entries.en: And the seventh lot came out for the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families.

entries.yo: Àla ilẹ-iní wọn si ni Sora, ati Eṣtaolu, ati Iri-ṣemeṣi;
entries.en: And the coast of their inheritance was Zorah, and Eshtaol, and Ir-shemesh,

entries.yo: Ati Ṣaalabbini, ati Aijaloni, ati Itla;
entries.en: And Shaalabbin, and Ajalon, and Jethlah,

entries.yo: Ati Eloni, ati Timna, ati Ekroni;
entries.en: And Elon, and Thimnathah, and Ekron,

entries.yo: Ati Elteke, ati Gibbetoni, ati Baalati;
entries.en: And Eltekeh, and Gibbethon, and Baalath,

entries.yo: Ati Jehudi, ati Bene-beraki, ati Gati-rimmọni;
entries.en: And Jehud, and Bene-berak, and Gath-rimmon,

entries.yo: Ati Me-jarkoni, ati Rakkoni, pẹlu àla ti mbẹ kọjusi Jọppa.
entries.en: And Me-jarkon, and Rakkon, with the border before Japho.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Dani si gbọ̀n àla wọn lọ: awọn ọmọ Dani si gòke lọ ibá Leṣemu jà, nwọn si kó o, nwọn si fi oju idà kọlù u, nwọn si gbà a, nwọn si ngbé inu rẹ̀, nwọn si pè Leṣemu ni Dani, gẹgẹ bi orukọ Dani baba wọn.
entries.en: And the coast of the children of Dan went out too little for them: therefore the children of Dan went up to fight against Leshem, and took it, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and possessed it, and dwelt therein, and called Leshem, Dan, after the name of Dan their father.

entries.yo: Eyi ni ilẹ-iní ẹ̀ya ọmọ Dani gẹgẹ bi idile wọn, ilu wọnyi pẹlu ileto wọn.
entries.en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families, these cities with their villages.

entries.yo: Nwọn si pari pipín ilẹ na fun ilẹ-iní gẹgẹ bi àla rẹ̀; awọn ọmọ Israeli si fi ilẹ-iní kan fun Joṣua ọmọ Nuni lãrin wọn:
entries.en: When they had made an end of dividing the land for inheritance by their coasts, the children of Israel gave an inheritance to Joshua the son of Nun among them:

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi aṣẹ OLUWA, nwọn fun u ni ilu ti o bère, ani Timnati-sera li òke Efraimu: o si kọ ilu na, o si ngbé inu rẹ̀.
entries.en: According to the word of the LORD they gave him the city which he asked, even Timnath-serah in mount Ephraim: and he built the city, and dwelt therein.

entries.yo: Wọnyi ni ilẹ-iní ti Eleasari alufa, ati Joṣua ọmọ Nuni, ati awọn olori awọn baba ẹ̀ya awọn ọmọ Israeli fi keké pín ni ilẹ-iní ni Ṣilo niwaju OLUWA li ẹnu-ọ̀na agọ ajọ. Bẹ̃ni nwọn pari pipín ilẹ na.
entries.en: These are the inheritances which Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel, divided for an inheritance by lot in Shiloh before the LORD, at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation. So they made an end of dividing the country.

entries.yo: OLUWA si sọ fun Joṣua pe,
entries.en: The LORD also spake unto Joshua, saying,

entries.yo: Wi fun awọn ọmọ Israeli pe, Ẹ yàn ilu àbo fun ara nyin, ti mo ti sọ fun nyin lati ọwọ́ Mose wa:
entries.en: Speak to the children of Israel, saying, Appoint out for you cities of refuge, whereof I spake unto you by the hand of Moses:

entries.yo: Ki apania ti o ba ṣeṣì pa ẹnikan li aimọ̀ ki o le salọ sibẹ̀: nwọn o si jẹ́ àbo fun nyin lọwọ olugbẹsan ẹ̀jẹ.
entries.en: That the slayer that killeth any person unawares and unwittingly may flee thither: and they shall be your refuge from the avenger of blood.

entries.yo: On o si salọ si ọkan ninu ilu wọnni, yio si duro li ẹnu-ọ̀na ibode ilu na, yio si rò ẹjọ́ rẹ̀ li etí awọn àgba ilu na, nwọn o si gbà a sọdọ sinu ilu na, nwọn o si fun u ni ibi kan, ki o le ma bá wọn gbé.
entries.en: And when he that doth flee unto one of those cities shall stand at the entering of the gate of the city, and shall declare his cause in the ears of the elders of that city, they shall take him into the city unto them, and give him a place, that he may dwell among them.

entries.yo: Bi olugbẹsan ẹ̀jẹ ba lepa rẹ̀, njẹ ki nwọn ki o má ṣe fi apania na lé e lọwọ; nitoriti o pa aladugbo rẹ̀ li aimọ̀, ti kò si korira rẹ̀ tẹlẹrí.
entries.en: And if the avenger of blood pursue after him, then they shall not deliver the slayer up into his hand; because he smote his neighbour unwittingly, and hated him not beforetime.

entries.yo: On o si ma gbé inu ilu na, titi yio fi duro niwaju ijọ fun idajọ, titi ikú olori alufa o wà li ọjọ́ wọnni: nigbana ni apania na yio pada, on o si wá si ilu rẹ̀, ati si ile rẹ̀, si ilu na lati ibiti o gbé ti salọ.
entries.en: And he shall dwell in that city, until he stand before the congregation for judgment, and until the death of the high priest that shall be in those days: then shall the slayer return, and come unto his own city, and unto his own house, unto the city from whence he fled.

entries.yo: Nwọn si yàn Kedeṣi ni Galili ni ilẹ òke Naftali, ati Ṣekemu ni ilẹ òke Efraimu, ati Kiriati-arba (ti iṣe Hebroni) ni ilẹ òke Juda.
entries.en: And they appointed Kedesh in Galilee in mount Naphtali, and Shechem in mount Ephraim, and Kirjath-arba, which is Hebron, in the mountain of Judah.

entries.yo: Ati ni ìha keji Jordani lẹba Jeriko ni ìla-õrùn, nwọn yàn Beseri li aginjù ni pẹtẹlẹ̀ ninu ẹ̀ya Reubeni, ati Ramotu ni Gileadi ninu ẹ̀ya Gadi, ati Golani ni Baṣani ninu ẹ̀ya Manasse.
entries.en: And on the other side Jordan by Jericho eastward, they assigned Bezer in the wilderness upon the plain out of the tribe of Reuben, and Ramoth in Gilead out of the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan out of the tribe of Manasseh.

entries.yo: Wọnyi ni awọn ilu ti a yàn fun gbogbo awọn ọmọ Israeli, ati fun alejò ti nṣe atipo lãrin wọn, ki ẹnikẹni ti o ba ṣeṣì pa ẹnikan, ki o le salọ sibẹ̀, ki o má ba si ti ọwọ́ olugbẹsan ẹ̀jẹ ku, titi on o fi duro niwaju ijọ.
entries.en: These were the cities appointed for all the children of Israel, and for the stranger that sojourneth among them, that whosoever killeth any person at unawares might flee thither, and not die by the hand of the avenger of blood, until he stood before the congregation.

entries.yo: NIGBANA ni awọn olori awọn baba awọn ọmọ Lefi sunmọ Eleasari alufa, ati Joṣua ọmọ Nuni, ati awọn olori awọn baba ẹ̀ya awọn ọmọ Israeli;
entries.en: Then came near the heads of the fathers of the Levites unto Eleazar the priest, and unto Joshua the son of Nun, and unto the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel;

entries.yo: Nwọn si wi fun wọn ni Ṣilo ni ilẹ Kenaani pe, OLUWA palaṣẹ lati ọwọ́ Mose wá lati fun wa ni ilu lati ma gbé, ati àgbegbe wọn fun ohun-ọ̀sin wa.
entries.en: And they spake unto them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, saying, The LORD commanded by the hand of Moses to give us cities to dwell in, with the suburbs thereof for our cattle.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Israeli si fi ilu wọnyi pẹlu àgbegbe wọn fun awọn ọmọ Lefi ninu ilẹ-iní wọn, nipa aṣẹ OLUWA.
entries.en: And the children of Israel gave unto the Levites out of their inheritance, at the commandment of the LORD, these cities and their suburbs.

entries.yo: Ipín si yọ fun idile awọn ọmọ Kohati: ati awọn ọmọ Aaroni alufa, ti mbẹ ninu awọn ọmọ Lefi, fi keké gbà ilu mẹtala, lati inu ẹ̀ya Juda, ati lati inu ẹ̀ya Simeoni, ati lati inu ẹ̀ya Benjamini.
entries.en: And the lot came out for the families of the Kohathites: and the children of Aaron the priest, which were of the Levites, had by lot out of the tribe of Judah, and out of the tribe of Simeon, and out of the tribe of Benjamin, thirteen cities.

entries.yo: Awọn ti o kù ninu awọn ọmọ Kohati, fi keké gbà ilu mẹwa lati inu idile ẹ̀ya Efraimu, ati lati inu ẹ̀ya Dani, ati lati inu àbọ ẹ̀ya Manasse.
entries.en: And the rest of the children of Kohath had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Ephraim, and out of the tribe of Dan, and out of the half tribe of Manasseh, ten cities.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Gerṣoni si fi keké gbà ilu mẹtala, lati inu idile ẹ̀ya Issakari, ati ninu ẹ̀ya Aṣeri, ati lati inu ẹ̀ya Naftali, ati inu àbọ ẹ̀ya Manasse ni Baṣani.
entries.en: And the children of Gershon had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the half tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Merari gẹgẹ bi idile wọn, ní ilu mejila, lati inu ẹ̀ya Reubeni, ati inu ẹ̀ya Gadi, ati lati inu ẹ̀ya Sebuluni.
entries.en: The children of Merari by their families had out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Israeli fi keké fun awọn ọmọ Lefi ni ilu wọnyi pẹlu àgbegbe wọn, gẹgẹ bi OLUWA ti palaṣẹ lati ọwọ́ Mose wá.
entries.en: And the children of Israel gave by lot unto the Levites these cities with their suburbs, as the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses.

entries.yo: Nwọn si fi ilu ti a darukọ wọnyi fun wọn, lati inu ẹ̀ya awọn ọmọ Juda, ati lati inu ẹ̀ya awọn ọmọ Simeoni wá:
entries.en: And they gave out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, these cities which are here mentioned by name,

entries.yo: Nwọn si jẹ́ ti awọn ọmọ Aaroni, ni idile awọn ọmọ Kohati, ti mbẹ ninu awọn ọmọ Lefi, nitoriti nwọn ní ipín ikini.
entries.en: Which the children of Aaron, being of the families of the Kohathites, who were of the children of Levi, had: for theirs was the first lot.

entries.yo: Nwọn si fi Kiriati-arba, ti iṣe Hebroni fun wọn, (Arba ni baba Anaki ni ilẹ òke Juda,) pẹlu àgbegbe rẹ̀ yi i kakiri.
entries.en: And they gave them the city of Arba the father of Anak, which city is Hebron, in the hill country of Judah, with the suburbs thereof round about it.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn pápa ilu na, ati ileto rẹ̀, ni nwọn fi fun Kalebu ọmọ Jefunne ni ilẹ-iní rẹ̀.
entries.en: But the fields of the city, and the villages thereof, gave they to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for his possession.

entries.yo: Nwọn si fi Hebroni ilu àbo fun apania pẹlu àgbegbe rẹ̀, ati Libna pẹlu àgbegbe rẹ̀, fun awọn ọmọ Aaroni alufa;
entries.en: Thus they gave to the children of Aaron the priest Hebron with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Libnah with her suburbs,

entries.yo: Ati Jatiri pẹlu àgbegbe rẹ̀, ati Eṣtemoa pẹlu àgbegbe rẹ̀;
entries.en: And Jattir with her suburbs, and Eshtemoa with her suburbs,

entries.yo: Ati Holoni pẹlu àgbegbe rẹ̀, ati Debiri pẹlu àgbegbe rẹ̀;
entries.en: And Holon with her suburbs, and Debir with her suburbs,

entries.yo: Ati Aini pẹlu àgbegbe rẹ̀, ati Jutta pẹlu àgbegbe rẹ̀, ati Beti-ṣemeṣi pẹlu àgbegbe rẹ̀; ilu mẹsan ninu awọn ẹ̀ya meji wọnni.
entries.en: And Ain with her suburbs, and Juttah with her suburbs, and Beth-shemesh with her suburbs; nine cities out of those two tribes.

entries.yo: Ati lati inu ẹ̀ya Benjamini, Gibeoni pẹlu àgbegbe rẹ̀, Geba pẹlu àgbegbe rẹ̀;
entries.en: And out of the tribe of Benjamin, Gibeon with her suburbs, Geba with her suburbs,

entries.yo: Anatotu pẹlu àgbegbe rẹ̀, ati Almoni pelu àgbegbe rẹ̀; ilu mẹrin.
entries.en: Anathoth with her suburbs, and Almon with her suburbs; four cities.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ilu awọn ọmọ Aaroni, awọn alufa, jẹ́ ilu mẹtala pẹlu àgbegbe wọn.
entries.en: All the cities of the children of Aaron, the priests, were thirteen cities with their suburbs.

entries.yo: Ati idile awọn ọmọ Kohati, awọn ọmọ Lefi, ani awọn ọmọ Kohati ti o kù, nwọn ní ilu ti iṣe ipín ti wọn lati inu ẹ̀ya Efraimu.
entries.en: And the families of the children of Kohath, the Levites which remained of the children of Kohath, even they had the cities of their lot out of the tribe of Ephraim.

entries.yo: Nwọn si fi Ṣekemu fun wọn pẹlu àgbegbe rẹ̀, ni ilẹ òke Efraimu, ilu àbo fun apania, ati Geseri pẹlu àgbegbe rẹ̀;
entries.en: For they gave them Shechem with her suburbs in mount Ephraim, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Gezer with her suburbs,

entries.yo: Ati Kibsaimu pẹlu àgbegbe rẹ̀, ati Beti-horoni pẹlu àgbegbe rẹ̀; ilu mẹrin.
entries.en: And Kibzaim with her suburbs, and Beth-horon with her suburbs; four cities.

entries.yo: Ati ninu ẹ̀ya Dani, Elteke pẹlu àgbegbe rẹ̀, Gibbetoni pẹlu àgbegbe rẹ̀;
entries.en: And out of the tribe of Dan, Eltekeh with her suburbs, Gibbethon with her suburbs,

entries.yo: Aijaloni pẹlu àgbegbe rẹ̀, Gati-rimmoni pẹlu àgbegbe rẹ̀; ilu mẹrin.
entries.en: Aijalon with her suburbs, Gath-rimmon with her suburbs; four cities.

entries.yo: Ati ninu àbọ ẹ̀ya Manasse, Taanaki pẹlu àgbegbe rẹ̀, ati Gati-rimmoni pẹlu àgbegbe rẹ̀; ilu meji.
entries.en: And out of the half tribe of Manasseh, Tanach with her suburbs, and Gath-rimmon with her suburbs; two cities.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ilu na jasi mẹwa pẹlu àgbegbe wọn fun idile awọn ọmọ Kohati ti o kù.
entries.en: All the cities were ten with their suburbs for the families of the children of Kohath that remained.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Gerṣoni, idile awọn ọmọ Lefi, ni nwọn fi Golani ni Baṣani fun pẹlu àgbegbe rẹ̀, ilu àbo fun apania; lati inu ẹ̀ya Manasse, ati Be-eṣtera pẹlu àgbegbe rẹ̀; ilu meji.
entries.en: And unto the children of Gershon, of the families of the Levites, out of the other half tribe of Manasseh they gave Golan in Bashan with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Beesh-terah with her suburbs; two cities.

entries.yo: Ati ninu ẹ̀ya Issakari, Kiṣioni pẹlu àgbegbe rẹ̀, Dabarati pẹlu àgbegbe rẹ̀;
entries.en: And out of the tribe of Issachar, Kishon with her suburbs, Dabareh with her suburbs,

entries.yo: Jarmutu pẹlu àgbegbe rẹ̀, Engannimu pẹlu àgbegbe rẹ̀; ilu mẹrin.
entries.en: Jarmuth with her suburbs, En-gannim with her suburbs; four cities.

entries.yo: Ati ninu ẹ̀ya Aṣeri, Miṣali pẹlu àgbegbe rẹ̀, Abdoni pẹlu àgbegbe rẹ̀;
entries.en: And out of the tribe of Asher, Mishal with her suburbs, Abdon with her suburbs,

entries.yo: Helkati pẹlu àgbegbe rẹ̀, ati Rehobu pẹlu àgbegbe rẹ̀; ilu mẹrin.
entries.en: Helkath with her suburbs, and Rehob with her suburbs; four cities.

entries.yo: Ati lati inu ẹ̀ya Naftali, Kedeṣi ni Galili pẹlu àgbegbe rẹ̀, ilu àbo fun apania; ati Hammotu-dori pẹlu àgbegbe rẹ̀, ati Kartani pẹlu àgbegbe rẹ̀; ilu mẹta.
entries.en: And out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Hammoth-dor with her suburbs, and Kartan with her suburbs; three cities.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ilu awọn ọmọ Gerṣoni gẹgẹ bi idile wọn, jẹ́ ilu mẹtala pẹlu ileto wọn.
entries.en: All the cities of the Gershonites according to their families were thirteen cities with their suburbs.

entries.yo: Ati fun idile awọn ọmọ Merari, awọn ọmọ Lefi ti o kù, ni Jokneamu pẹlu àgbegbe rẹ̀, ati Karta pẹlu àgbegbe rẹ̀, lati inu ẹ̀ya Sebuluni,
entries.en: And unto the families of the children of Merari, the rest of the Levites, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Jokneam with her suburbs, and Kartah with her suburbs,

entries.yo: Dimna pẹlu àgbegbe rẹ̀, Nahalali pẹlu àgbegbe rẹ̀; ilu mẹrin.
entries.en: Dimnah with her suburbs, Nahalal with her suburbs; four cities.

entries.yo: Ati ninu ẹ̀ya Reubeni, Beseri pẹlu àgbegbe rẹ̀, ati Jahasi pẹlu àgbegbe rẹ̀,
entries.en: And out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer with her suburbs, and Jahazah with her suburbs,

entries.yo: Kedemotu pẹlu àgbegbe rẹ̀, ati Mefaati pẹlu àgbegbe rẹ̀; ilu mẹrin.
entries.en: Kedemoth with her suburbs, and Mephaath with her suburbs; four cities.

entries.yo: Ati ninu ẹ̀ya Gadi, Ramotu ni Gileadi pẹlu àgbegbe rẹ̀, ilu àbo fun apania; ati Mahanaimu pẹlu àgbegbe rẹ̀.
entries.en: And out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Mahanaim with her suburbs,

entries.yo: Heṣboni pẹlu àgbegbe rẹ̀, Jaseri pẹlu àgbegbe rẹ̀; ilu mẹrin ni gbogbo rẹ̀.
entries.en: Heshbon with her suburbs, Jazer with her suburbs; four cities in all.

entries.yo: Gbogbo wọnyi ni ilu awọn ọmọ Merari, gẹgẹ bi idile wọn, ani awọn ti o kù ni idile awọn ọmọ Lefi; ipín wọn si jẹ́ ilu mejila.
entries.en: So all the cities for the children of Merari by their families, which were remaining of the families of the Levites, were by their lot twelve cities.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ilu awọn ọmọ Lefi ti mbẹ lãrin ilẹ-iní awọn ọmọ Israeli jẹ́ ilu mejidilãdọta pẹlu àgbegbe wọn.
entries.en: All the cities of the Levites within the possession of the children of Israel were forty and eight cities with their suburbs.

entries.yo: Olukuluku ilu wọnyi li o ní àgbegbe wọn yi wọn ká: bayi ni gbogbo ilu wọnyi ri.
entries.en: These cities were every one with their suburbs round about them: thus were all these cities.

entries.yo: OLUWA si fun Israeli ni gbogbo ilẹ na, ti o bura lati fi fun awọn baba wọn; nwọn si gbà a, nwọn si ngbé inu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the LORD gave unto Israel all the land which he sware to give unto their fathers; and they possessed it, and dwelt therein.

entries.yo: OLUWA si fun wọn ni isimi yiká kiri, gẹgẹ bi gbogbo eyiti o bura fun awọn baba wọn: kò si sí ọkunrin kan ninu gbogbo awọn ọtá wọn ti o duro niwaju wọn; OLUWA fi gbogbo awọn ọtá wọn lé wọn lọwọ.
entries.en: And the LORD gave them rest round about, according to all that he sware unto their fathers: and there stood not a man of all their enemies before them; the LORD delivered all their enemies into their hand.

entries.yo: Ohunkohun kò tase ninu ohun rere ti OLUWA ti sọ fun ile Israeli; gbogbo rẹ̀ li o ṣẹ.
entries.en: There failed not ought of any good thing which the LORD had spoken unto the house of Israel; all came to pass.

entries.yo: NIGBANA ni Joṣua pè awọn ọmọ Reubeni, ati awọn ọmọ Gadi, ati àbọ ẹ̀ya Manasse,
entries.en: Then Joshua called the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh,

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹnyin ti ṣe gbogbo eyiti Mose iranṣẹ OLUWA palaṣẹ fun nyin, ẹnyin si gbọ́ ohùn mi ni gbogbo eyiti mo palaṣẹ fun nyin:
entries.en: And said unto them, Ye have kept all that Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you, and have obeyed my voice in all that I commanded you:

entries.yo: Ẹnyin kò fi awọn arakunrin nyin silẹ lati ọjọ́ pipọ̀ wọnyi wá titi o fi di oni, ṣugbọn ẹnyin ṣe afiyesi ìlo ofin OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin.
entries.en: Ye have not left your brethren these many days unto this day, but have kept the charge of the commandment of the LORD your God.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin ti fi isimi fun awọn arakunrin nyin, gẹgẹ bi o ti sọ fun wọn: njẹ nisisiyi ẹ pada, ki ẹ si lọ sinu agọ́ nyin, ati si ilẹ-iní nyin, ti Mose iranṣẹ OLUWA ti fun nyin ni ìha keji Jordani.
entries.en: And now the LORD your God hath given rest unto your brethren, as he promised them: therefore now return ye, and get you unto your tents, and unto the land of your possession, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave you on the other side Jordan.

entries.yo: Kìki ki ẹ kiyesara gidigidi lati pa aṣẹ ati ofin mọ́, ti Mose iranṣẹ OLUWA fi fun nyin, lati fẹ́ OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin, ati lati ma rìn ni gbogbo ọ̀na rẹ̀, ati lati ma pa aṣẹ rẹ̀ mọ́, ati lati faramọ́ ọ, ati lati sìn i pẹlu àiya nyin gbogbo ati pẹlu ọkàn nyin gbogbo.
entries.en: But take diligent heed to do the commandment and the law, which Moses the servant of the LORD charged you, to love the LORD your God, and to walk in all his ways, and to keep his commandments, and to cleave unto him, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Joṣua sure fun wọn, o si rán wọn lọ: nwọn si lọ sinu agọ́ wọn.
entries.en: So Joshua blessed them, and sent them away: and they went unto their tents.

entries.yo: Njẹ fun àbọ ẹ̀ya Manasse ni Mose ti fi ilẹ-iní wọn fun ni Baṣani: ṣugbọn fun àbọ ẹ̀ya ti o kù ni Joṣua fi ilẹ-iní fun pẹlu awọn arakunrin wọn ni ìha ihin Jordani ni ìwọ-õrùn. Nigbati Joṣua si rán wọn pada lọ sinu agọ́ wọn, o sure fun wọn pẹlu,
entries.en: Now to the one half of the tribe of Manasseh Moses had given possession in Bashan: but unto the other half thereof gave Joshua among their brethren on this side Jordan westward. And when Joshua sent them away also unto their tents, then he blessed them,

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ pada lọ pẹlu ọrọ̀ pipọ̀ si agọ́ nyin, ati pẹlu ohunọ̀sin pipọ̀, pẹlu fadakà, ati pẹlu wurà, ati pẹlu idẹ ati pẹlu irin, ati pẹlu aṣọ pipọ̀pipọ: ẹ bá awọn arakunrin nyin pín ikogun awọn ọtá nyin.
entries.en: And he spake unto them, saying, Return with much riches unto your tents, and with very much cattle, with silver, and with gold, and with brass, and with iron, and with very much raiment: divide the spoil of your enemies with your brethren.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Reubeni, ati awọn ọmọ Gadi, ati àbọ ẹ̀ya Manasse si pada, nwọn si lọ kuro lọdọ awọn ọmọ Israeli lati Ṣilo, ti mbẹ ni ilẹ Kenaani, lati lọ si ilẹ Gileadi, si ilẹ iní wọn, eyiti nwọn ti gbà, gẹgẹ bi aṣẹ OLUWA lati ọwọ́ Mose wá.
entries.en: And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh returned, and departed from the children of Israel out of Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan, to go unto the country of Gilead, to the land of their possession, whereof they were possessed, according to the word of the LORD by the hand of Moses.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si dé eti Jordani, ti mbẹ ni ilẹ Kenaani, awọn ọmọ Reubeni, ati awọn ọmọ Gadi, ati àbọ ẹ̀ya Manasse mọ pẹpẹ kan lẹba Jordani, pẹpẹ ti o tobi lati wò.
entries.en: And when they came unto the borders of Jordan, that are in the land of Canaan, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh built there an altar by Jordan, a great altar to see to.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Israeli si gbọ́ pe, Kiyesi i, awọn ọmọ Reubeni, ati awọn ọmọ Gadi, ati àbọ ẹ̀ya Manasse mọ pẹpẹ kan dojukọ ilẹ Kenaani, lẹba Jordani ni ìha keji awọn ọmọ Israeli.
entries.en: And the children of Israel heard say, Behold, the chidren of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh have built an altar over against the land of Canaan, in the borders of Jordan, at the passage of the children of Israel.

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn ọmọ Israeli gbọ́ ọ, gbogbo ijọ awọn ọmọ Israeli kó ara wọn jọ ni Ṣilo, lati gòke lọ ibá wọn jagun.
entries.en: And when the children of Israel heard of it, the whole congregation of the children of Israel gathered themselves together at Shiloh, to go up to war against them.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Israeli si rán Finehasi ọmọ Eleasari alufa si awọn ọmọ Reubeni, ati si awọn ọmọ Gadi, ati si àbọ ẹ̀ya Manasse ni ilẹ Gileadi;
entries.en: And the children of Israel sent unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half tribe of Manasseh, into the land of Gilead, Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest,

entries.yo: Ati awọn olori mẹwa pẹlu rẹ̀, olori ile baba kọkan fun gbogbo ẹ̀ya Israeli; olukuluku si ni olori ile baba wọn ninu ẹgbẹgbẹrun Israeli.
entries.en: And with him ten princes, of each chief house a prince throughout all the tribes of Israel; and each one was an head of the house of their fathers among the thousands of Israel.

entries.yo: Nwọn si dé ọdọ awọn ọmọ Reubeni, ati ọdọ awọn ọmọ Gadi, ati ọdọ àbọ ẹ̀ya Manasse, ni ilẹ Gileadi, nwọn si bá wọn sọ̀rọ pe,
entries.en: And they came unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half tribe of Manasseh, unto the land of Gilead, and they spake with them, saying,

entries.yo: Bayi ni gbogbo ijọ OLUWA wi, Ẹ̀ṣẹ kili eyiti ẹnyin da si Ọlọrun Israeli, lati pada li oni kuro lẹhin OLUWA, li eyiti ẹnyin mọ pẹpẹ kan fun ara nyin, ki ẹnyin ki o le ṣọ̀tẹ si OLUWA li oni?
entries.en: Thus saith the whole congregation of the LORD, What trespass is this that ye have committed against the God of Israel, to turn away this day from following the LORD, in that ye have builded you an altar, that ye might rebel this day against the LORD?

entries.yo: Ẹ̀ṣẹ ti Peori kò to fun wa kọ́, ti a kò ti iwẹ̀mọ́ ninu rẹ̀ titi di oni, bi o tilẹ ṣe pe ajakalẹ-àrun wà ninu ijọ OLUWA,
entries.en: Is the iniquity of Peor too little for us, from which we are not cleansed until this day, although there was a plague in the congregation of the LORD,

entries.yo: Ti ẹnyin fi pada kuro lẹhin OLUWA li oni? Yio si ṣe, bi ẹnyin ti ṣọ̀tẹ si OLUWA li oni, li ọla, on o binu si gbogbo ijọ Israeli.
entries.en: But that ye must turn away this day from following the LORD? and it will be, seeing ye rebel to day against the LORD, that to morrow he will be wroth with the whole congregation of Israel.

entries.yo: Njẹ bi o ba ṣepe ilẹ iní nyin kò ba mọ́, ẹ rekọja si ilẹ iní OLUWA, nibiti agọ́ OLUWA ngbé, ki ẹ si gbà ilẹ-iní lãrin wa: ṣugbọn ẹnyin má ṣe ṣọ̀tẹ si OLUWA, bẹ̃ni ki ẹ má ṣe ṣọ̀tẹ si wa, ni mimọ pẹpẹ miran fun ara nyin lẹhin pẹpẹ OLUWA Ọlọrun wa.
entries.en: Notwithstanding, if the land of your possession be unclean, then pass ye over unto the land of the possession of the LORD, wherein the LORD's tabernacle dwelleth, and take possession among us: but rebel not against the LORD, nor rebel against us, in building you an altar beside the altar of the LORD our God.

entries.yo: Ṣe bẹ̃ni Akani ọmọ Sera da ẹ̀ṣẹ niti ohun ìyasọtọ, ti ibinu si dé sori gbogbo ijọ Israeli? ọkunrin na kò nikan ṣegbé ninu ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Did not Achan the son of Zerah commit a trespass in the accursed thing, and wrath fell on all the congregation of Israel? and that man perished not alone in his iniquity.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni awọn ọmọ Reubeni, ati awọn ọmọ Gadi, ati àbọ ẹ̀ya Manasse dahùn, nwọn si wi fun awọn olori ẹgbẹgbẹrun Israeli pe,
entries.en: Then the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh answered, and said unto the heads of the thousands of Israel,

entries.yo: OLUWA, Ọlọrun awọn ọlọrun, OLUWA Ọlọrun awọn ọlọrun, On mọ̀, Israeli pẹlu yio si mọ̀; bi o ba ṣepe ni ìṣọtẹ ni, tabi bi ni irekọja si OLUWA, (má ṣe gbà wa li oni,)
entries.en: The LORD God of gods, the LORD God of gods, he knoweth, and Israel he shall know; if it be in rebellion, or if in transgression against the LORD, (save us not this day,)

entries.yo: Ni awa fi mọ pẹpẹ fun ara wa, lati yipada kuro lẹhin OLUWA; tabi bi o ba ṣe pe lati ru ẹbọ sisun, tabi ẹbọ ohunjijẹ, tabi ẹbọ alafia lori rẹ̀, ki OLUWA tikala rẹ̀ ki o bère rẹ̀.
entries.en: That we have built us an altar to turn from following the LORD, or if to offer thereon burnt offering or meat offering, or if to offer peace offerings thereon, let the LORD himself require it;

entries.yo: Bi o ba ṣepe awa kò kuku ṣe e nitori aniyàn, ati nitori nkan yi pe, Lẹhinọla awọn ọmọ nyin le wi fun awọn ọmọ wa pe, Kili o kàn nyin niti OLUWA, Ọlọrun Israeli?
entries.en: And if we have not rather done it for fear of this thing, saying, In time to come your children might speak unto our children, saying, What have ye to do with the LORD God of Israel?

entries.yo: Nitoriti Ọlọrun ti fi Jordani pàla li agbedemeji awa ati ẹnyin, ẹnyin ọmọ Reubeni, ati awọn ọmọ Gadi; ẹnyin kò ní ipín niti OLUWA: bẹ̃li awọn ọmọ nyin yio mu ki awọn ọmọ wa ki o dẹkun ati ma bẹ̀ru OLUWA.
entries.en: For the LORD hath made Jordan a border between us and you, ye children of Reuben and children of Gad; ye have no part in the LORD: so shall your children make our children cease from fearing the LORD.

entries.yo: Nitorina li a ṣe wipe, Ẹ jẹ ki a mura nisisiyi lati mọ pẹpẹ kan, ki iṣe fun ẹbọ sisun, tabi fun ẹbọ kan:
entries.en: Therefore we said, Let us now prepare to build us an altar, not for burnt offering, nor for sacrifice:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹrí ni li agbedemeji awa ati ẹnyin, ati awọn iran wa lẹhin wa, ki awa ki o le ma fi ẹbọ sisun wa, ati ẹbọ wa, pẹlu ẹbọ alafia wa jọsìn fun OLUWA niwaju rẹ̀; ki awọn ọmọ nyin ki o má ba wi fun awọn ọmọ wa lẹhinọla pe, Ẹnyin kò ní ipín niti OLUWA.
entries.en: But that it may be a witness between us, and you, and our generations after us, that we might do the service of the LORD before him with our burnt offerings, and with our sacrifices, and with our peace offerings; that your children may not say to our children in time to come, Ye have no part in the LORD.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni awa ṣe wipe, Yio si ṣe, nigbati nwọn ba wi bẹ̃ fun wa, tabi fun awọn iran wa lẹhinọla, awa o si wipe, Ẹ wò apẹrẹ pẹpẹ OLUWA, ti awọn baba wa mọ, ki iṣe fun ẹbọ sisun, bẹ̃ni ki iṣe fun ẹbọ; ṣugbọn o jasi ẹrí li agbedemeji awa ati ẹnyin.
entries.en: Therefore said we, that it shall be, when they should so say to us or to our generations in time to come, that we may say again, Behold the pattern of the altar of the LORD, which our fathers made, not for burnt offerings, nor for sacrifices; but it is a witness between us and you.

entries.yo: Ki Ọlọrun má jẹ ki awa ki o ṣọ̀tẹ si OLUWA, ki awa si pada li oni kuro lẹhin OLUWA, lati mọ pẹpẹ fun ẹbọ sisun, fun ẹbọ ohunjije, tabi fun ẹbọ kan, lẹhin pẹpẹ OLUWA Ọlọrun wa ti mbẹ niwaju agọ́ rẹ̀.
entries.en: God forbid that we should rebel against the LORD, and turn this day from following the LORD, to build an altar for burnt offerings, for meat offerings, or for sacrifices, beside the altar of the LORD our God that is before his tabernacle.

entries.yo: Nigbati Finehasi alufa, ati awọn olori ijọ, ati awọn olori ẹgbẹgbẹrun Israeli ti o wà pẹlu rẹ̀, gbọ́ ọ̀rọ ti awọn ọmọ Reubeni, ati awọn ọmọ Gadi, ati awọn ọmọ Manasse sọ, o dùnmọ́ wọn.
entries.en: And when Phinehas the priest, and the princes of the congregation and heads of the thousands of Israel which were with him, heard the words that the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the children of Manasseh spake, it pleased them.

entries.yo: Finehasi ọmọ Eleasari alufa si wi fun awọn ọmọ Reubeni, ati fun awọn ọmọ Gadi, ati fun awọn ọmọ Manasse pe, Li oni li awa mọ̀ pe OLUWA wà lãrin wa, nitoriti ẹnyin kò dẹ̀ṣẹ yi si OLUWA: nisisiyi ẹnyin yọ awọn ọmọ Israeli kuro lọwọ OLUWA.
entries.en: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest said unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the children of Manasseh, This day we perceive that the LORD is among us, because ye have not committed this trespass against the LORD: now ye have delivered the children of Israel out of the hand of the LORD.

entries.yo: Finehasi ọmọ Eleasari alufa, ati awọn olori, si pada lati ọdọ awọn ọmọ Reubeni, ati lati ọdọ awọn ọmọ Gadi, ni ilẹ Gileadi, si ilẹ Kenaani, sọdọ awọn ọmọ Israeli, nwọn si mú ìhin pada tọ̀ wọn wá.
entries.en: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, and the princes, returned from the children of Reuben, and from the children of Gad, out of the land of Gilead, unto the land of Canaan, to the children of Israel, and brought them word again.

entries.yo: Ohun na si dùnmọ́ awọn ọmọ Israeli; awọn ọmọ Israeli si fi ibukún fun Ọlọrun, nwọn kò si sọ ti ati gòke tọ̀ wọn lọ ijà, lati run ilẹ na ninu eyiti awọn ọmọ Reubeni ati awọn ọmọ Gadi ngbé.
entries.en: And the thing pleased the children of Israel; and the children of Israel blessed God, and did not intend to go up against them in battle, to destroy the land wherein the children of Reuben and Gad dwelt.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Reubeni ati awọn ọmọ Gadi si sọ pẹpẹ na ni Edi: nwọn wipe, Nitori ẹrí ni li agbedemeji awa ati ẹnyin pe OLUWA on li Ọlọrun.
entries.en: And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad called the altar Ed: for it shall be a witness between us that the LORD is God.

entries.yo: O si ṣe li ọjọ́ pipọ̀ lẹhin ti OLUWA ti fi isimi fun Israeli lọwọ gbogbo awọn ọtá wọn yiká, ti Joṣua di arugbó, ti o si pọ̀ li ọjọ́;
entries.en: And it came to pass a long time after that the LORD had given rest unto Israel from all their enemies round about, that Joshua waxed old and stricken in age.

entries.yo: Joṣua si pè gbogbo Israeli, ati awọn àgba wọn, ati awọn olori wọn, ati awọn onidajọ wọn, ati awọn ijoye wọn, o si wi fun wọn pe, Emi di arugbó tán, emi si pọ̀ li ọjọ́:
entries.en: And Joshua called for all Israel, and for their elders, and for their heads, and for their judges, and for their officers, and said unto them, I am old and stricken in age:

entries.yo: Ẹnyin si ti ri ohun gbogbo ti OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin ti ṣe si gbogbo orilẹ-ède wọnyi nitori nyin; nitori OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin, on li ẹniti o ti jà fun nyin.
entries.en: And ye have seen all that the LORD your God hath done unto all these nations because of you; for the LORD your God is he that hath fought for you.

entries.yo: Wò o, emi ti pín awọn orilẹ-ède wọnyi ti o kù fun nyin, ni ilẹ-iní fun awọn ẹ̀ya nyin, lati Jordani lọ, pẹlu gbogbo awọn orilẹ-ède ti mo ti ke kuro, ani titi dé okun nla ni ìha ìwọ-õrùn.
entries.en: Behold, I have divided unto you by lot these nations that remain, to be an inheritance for your tribes, from Jordan, with all the nations that I have cut off, even unto the great sea westward.

entries.yo: OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin, on ni yio tì wọn jade kuro niwaju nyin, yio si lé wọn kuro li oju nyin; ẹnyin o si ní ilẹ wọn, gẹgẹ bi OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin ti sọ fun nyin.
entries.en: And the LORD your God, he shall expel them from before you, and drive them from out of your sight; and ye shall possess their land, as the LORD your God hath promised unto you.

entries.yo: Nitorina ẹ mura gidigidi lati tọju ati lati ṣe ohun gbogbo ti a kọ sinu iwé ofin Mose, ki ẹnyin ki o má ṣe yipada kuro ninu rẹ̀ si ọwọ́ ọtún tabi si ọwọ́ òsi;
entries.en: Be ye therefore very courageous to keep and to do all that is written in the book of the law of Moses, that ye turn not aside therefrom to the right hand or to the left;

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o má ṣe wá sãrin awọn orilẹ-ède wọnyi, awọn wọnyi ti o kù pẹlu nyin; ki ẹnyin má ṣe da orukọ oriṣa wọn, bẹ̃ni ki ẹ má ṣe fi wọn bura, ẹ má ṣe sìn wọn, bẹ̃ni ki ẹ má ṣe tẹriba fun wọn:
entries.en: That ye come not among these nations, these that remain among you; neither make mention of the name of their gods, nor cause to swear by them, neither serve them, nor bow yourselves unto them:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ki ẹnyin faramọ́ OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin, gẹgẹ bi ẹnyin ti nṣe titi di oni.
entries.en: But cleave unto the LORD your God, as ye have done unto this day.

entries.yo: Nitoriti OLUWA ti lé awọn orilẹ-ède nla ati alagbara kuro niwaju nyin; ṣugbọn bi o ṣe ti nyin ni, kò sí ọkunrin kan ti o ti iduro niwaju nyin titi di oni.
