entries.en: For the LORD hath driven out from before you great nations and strong: but as for you, no man hath been able to stand before you unto this day.

entries.yo: ọkunrin kan ninu nyin yio lé ẹgbẹrun: nitoripe OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin, on li ẹniti njà fun nyin, gẹgẹ bi o ti sọ fun nyin.
entries.en: One man of you shall chase a thousand: for the LORD your God, he it is that fighteth for you, as he hath promised you.

entries.yo: Nitorina ẹ kiyesara nyin gidigidi, ki ẹ fẹ́ OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin.
entries.en: Take good heed therefore unto yourselves, that ye love the LORD your God.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi ẹ ba daṣà ati pada, ti ẹ si faramọ́ iyokù awọn orile-ède wọnyi, ani awọn wọnyi ti o kù lãrin nyin, ti ẹ si bá wọn gbeyawo, ti ẹ si nwọle tọ̀ wọn, ti awọn si nwọle tọ̀ nyin:
entries.en: Else if ye do in any wise go back, and cleave unto the remnant of these nations, even these that remain among you, and shall make marriages with them, and go in unto them, and they to you:

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o mọ̀ dajudaju pe OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin ki yio lé awọn orilẹ-ède wọnyi jade mọ́ kuro niwaju nyin; ṣugbọn nwọn o jẹ́ okùn-didẹ ati ẹgẹ́ fun nyin, ati paṣán ni ìha nyin, ati ẹgún li oju nyin, titi ẹ o fi ṣegbé kuro ni ilẹ daradara yi ti OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin ti fi fun nyin.
entries.en: Know for a certainty that the LORD your God will no more drive out any of these nations from before you; but they shall be snares and traps unto you, and scourges in your sides, and thorns in your eyes, until ye perish from off this good land which the LORD your God hath given you.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin kiyesi i, li oni emi nlọ si ọ̀na gbogbo aiye: ényin si mọ̀ li àiya nyin gbogbo, ati li ọkàn nyin gbogbo pe, kò sí ohun kan ti o tase ninu ohun rere gbogbo ti OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin ti sọ niti nyin; gbogbo rẹ̀ li o ṣẹ fun nyin, kò si sí ohun ti o tase ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And, behold, this day I am going the way of all the earth: and ye know in all your hearts and in all your souls, that not one thing hath failed of all the good things which the LORD your God spake concerning you; all are come to pass unto you, and not one thing hath failed thereof.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, gẹgẹ bi ohun rere gbogbo ti ṣẹ fun nyin, ti OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin ti sọ fun nyin; bẹ̃ni OLUWA yio mú ibi gbogbo bá nyin, titi yio fi pa nyin run kuro ni ilẹ daradara yi ti OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin ti fi fun nyin.
entries.en: Therefore it shall come to pass, that as all good things are come upon you, which the LORD your God promised you; so shall the LORD bring upon you all evil things, until he have destroyed you from off this good land which the LORD your God hath given you.

entries.yo: Nigbati ẹnyin ba re majẹmu OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin kọja, ti o palaṣẹ fun nyin, ti ẹ ba si lọ, ti ẹ ba nsìn oriṣa ti ẹnyin ba tẹ̀ ori nyin bà fun wọn; nigbana ni ibinu OLUWA yio rú si nyin, ẹnyin o si ṣegbé kánkan kuro ni ilẹ daradara ti o ti fi fun nyin.
entries.en: When ye have transgressed the covenant of the LORD your God, which he commanded you, and have gone and served other gods, and bowed yourselves to them; then shall the anger of the LORD be kindled against you, and ye shall perish quickly from off the good land which he hath given unto you.

entries.yo: JOṢUA si pè gbogbo awọn ẹ̀ya Israeli jọ si Ṣekemu, o si pè awọn àgba Israeli, ati awọn olori wọn, ati awọn onidajọ wọn, ati awọn ijoye wọn; nwọn si fara wọn hàn niwaju Ọlọrun.
entries.en: And Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel to Shechem, and called for the elders of Israel, and for their heads, and for their judges, and for their officers; and they presented themselves before God.

entries.yo: Joṣua si wi fun gbogbo awọn enia pe, Bayi ni OLUWA, Ọlọrun Israeli wi, Awọn baba nyin ti gbé ìha keji Odò nì li atijọ rí, ani Tera, baba Abrahamu, ati baba Nahori: nwọn si sìn oriṣa.
entries.en: And Joshua said unto all the people, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Your fathers dwelt on the other side of the flood in old time, even Terah, the father of Abraham, and the father of Nachor: and they served other gods.

entries.yo: Emi si mú Abrahamu baba nyin lati ìha keji Odò na wá, mo si ṣe amọ̀na rẹ̀ là gbogbo ilẹ Kenaani já, mo si sọ irú-ọmọ rẹ̀ di pipọ̀, mo si fun u ni Isaaki.
entries.en: And I took your father Abraham from the other side of the flood, and led him throughout all the land of Canaan, and multiplied his seed, and gave him Isaac.

entries.yo: Emi si fun Isaaki ni Jakobu ati Esau: mo si fun Esau li òke Seiri lati ní i; Jakobu pẹlu awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ si sọkalẹ lọ si Egipti.
entries.en: And I gave unto Isaac Jacob and Esau: and I gave unto Esau mount Seir, to possess it; but Jacob and his children went down into Egypt.

entries.yo: Mo si rán Mose ati Aaroni, mo si yọ Egipti lẹnu, gẹgẹ bi eyiti mo ṣe lãrin rẹ̀: lẹhin na mo si mú nyin jade.
entries.en: I sent Moses also and Aaron, and I plagued Egypt, according to that which I did among them: and afterward I brought you out.

entries.yo: Emi si mú awọn baba nyin jade kuro ni Egipti: ẹnyin si dé okun; awọn ara Egipti si lepa awọn baba nyin ti awọn ti kẹkẹ́ ati ẹlẹṣin dé Okun Pupa.
entries.en: And I brought your fathers out of Egypt: and ye came unto the sea; and the Egyptians pursued after your fathers with chariots and horsemen unto the Red sea.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn kigbepè OLUWA, o fi òkunkun si agbedemeji ẹnyin ati awọn ara Egipti, o si mú okun ya lù wọn, o si bò wọn mọlẹ; oju nyin si ti ri ohun ti mo ṣe ni Egipti: ẹnyin si gbé inu aginjù li ọjọ́ pipọ̀.
entries.en: And when they cried unto the LORD, he put darkness between you and the Egyptians, and brought the sea upon them, and covered them; and your eyes have seen what I have done in Egypt: and ye dwelt in the wilderness a long season.

entries.yo: Emi si mú nyin wá si ilẹ awọn Amori, ti ngbé ìha keji Jordani; nwọn si bá nyin jà: emi si fi wọn lé nyin lọwọ ẹnyin si ní ilẹ wọn; emi si run wọn kuro niwaju nyin.
entries.en: And I brought you into the land of the Amorites, which dwelt on the other side Jordan; and they fought with you: and I gave them into your hand, that ye might possess their land; and I destroyed them from before you.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Balaki ọmọ Sipporu, ọba Moabu dide, o si ba Israeli jagun; o si ranṣẹ pè Balaamu ọmọ Beori lati fi nyin bú:
entries.en: Then Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, arose and warred against Israel, and sent and called Balaam the son of Beor to curse you:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi kò fẹ́ fetisi ti Balaamu; nitorina o nsure fun nyin ṣá: mo si gbà nyin kuro li ọwọ́ rẹ̀.
entries.en: But I would not hearken unto Balaam; therefore he blessed you still: so I delivered you out of his hand.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin si gòke Jordani, ẹ si dé Jeriko: awọn ọkunrin Jeriko si fi ìja fun nyin, awọn Amori, ati awọn Perissi, ati awọn ara Kenaani, ati awọn Hitti, ati awọn Girgaṣi, awọn Hifi, ati awọn Jebusi; emi si fi wọn lé nyin lọwọ.
entries.en: And ye went over Jordan, and came unto Jericho: and the men of Jericho fought against you, the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Girgashites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites; and I delivered them into your hand.

entries.yo: Emi si rán agbọ́n siwaju nyin, ti o lé wọn kuro niwaju nyin, ani awọn ọba Amori meji; ki iṣe pẹlu idà rẹ, bẹ̃ni ki iṣe pẹlu ọrun rẹ.
entries.en: And I sent the hornet before you, which drave them out from before you, even the two kings of the Amorites; but not with thy sword, nor with thy bow.

entries.yo: Emi si fun nyin ni ilẹ ti iwọ kò ṣe lãla si, ati ilu ti ẹnyin kò tẹ̀dó, ẹnyin si ngbé inu wọn; ninu ọgbà-àjara ati ọgbà-igi-olifi ti ẹnyin kò gbìn li ẹnyin njẹ.
entries.en: And I have given you a land for which ye did not labour, and cities which ye built not, and ye dwell in them; of the vineyards and oliveyards which ye planted not do ye eat.

entries.yo: Njẹ nitorina ẹ bẹ̀ru OLUWA, ki ẹ si ma sìn i li ododo ati li otitọ: ki ẹ si mu oriṣa wọnni kuro ti awọn baba nyin sìn ni ìha keji Odò nì, ati ni Egipti; ki ẹ si ma sìn OLUWA.
entries.en: Now therefore fear the LORD, and serve him in sincerity and in truth: and put away the gods which your fathers served on the other side of the flood, and in Egypt; and serve ye the LORD.

entries.yo: Bi o ba si ṣe buburu li oju nyin lati sìn OLUWA, ẹ yàn ẹniti ẹnyin o ma sìn li oni; bi oriṣa wọnni ni ti awọn baba nyin ti o wà ni ìha keji Odò ti nsìn, tabi awọn oriṣa awọn Amori, ni ilẹ ẹniti ẹnyin ngbé: ṣugbọn bi o ṣe ti emi ati ile mi ni, OLUWA li awa o ma sìn.
entries.en: And if it seem evil unto you to serve the LORD, choose you this day whom ye will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were on the other side of the flood, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD.

entries.yo: Awọn enia na dahùn, nwọn si wipe, Ki a má ri ti awa o fi kọ̀ OLUWA silẹ, lati sìn oriṣa;
entries.en: And the people answered and said, God forbid that we should forsake the LORD, to serve other gods;

entries.yo: Nitori OLUWA Ọlọrun wa, on li ẹniti o mú wa, ati awọn baba wa gòke lati ilẹ Egipti wá, kuro li oko-ẹrú, ti o si ṣe iṣẹ-iyanu nla wọnni li oju wa, ti o si pa wa mọ́ ni gbogbo ọ̀na ti awa rìn, ati lãrin gbogbo enia ti awa là kọja:
entries.en: For the LORD our God, he it is that brought us up and our fathers out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage, and which did those great signs in our sight, and preserved us in all the way wherein we went, and among all the people through whom we passed:

entries.yo: OLUWA si lé gbogbo awọn enia na jade kuro niwaju wa, ani awọn Amori ti ngbé ilẹ na: nitorina li awa pẹlu o ṣe ma sìn OLUWA; nitori on li Ọlọrun wa.
entries.en: And the LORD drave out from before us all the people, even the Amorites which dwelt in the land: therefore will we also serve the LORD; for he is our God.

entries.yo: Joṣua si wi fun awọn enia na pe, Enyin kò le sìn OLUWA; nitoripe Ọlọrun mimọ́ li on; Ọlọrun owú li on; ki yio dari irekọja ati ẹ̀ṣẹ nyin jì nyin.
entries.en: And Joshua said unto the people, Ye cannot serve the LORD: for he is an holy God; he is a jealous God; he will not forgive your transgressions nor your sins.

entries.yo: Bi ẹnyin ba kọ̀ OLUWA silẹ, ti ẹ ba si sìn ọlọrun ajeji, nigbana ni on o pada yio si ṣe nyin ni ibi, yio si run nyin, lẹhin ti o ti ṣe nyin li ore tán.
entries.en: If ye forsake the LORD, and serve strange gods, then he will turn and do you hurt, and consume you, after that he hath done you good.

entries.yo: Awọn enia na si wi fun Joṣua pe, Rárá o; ṣugbọn OLUWA li awa o sìn.
entries.en: And the people said unto Joshua, Nay; but we will serve the LORD.

entries.yo: Joṣua si wi fun awọn enia na pe, Ẹnyin li ẹlẹri si ara nyin pe, ẹnyin yàn OLUWA fun ara nyin, lati ma sìn i. Nwọn si wipe, Awa ṣe ẹlẹri.
entries.en: And Joshua said unto the people, Ye are witnesses against yourselves that ye have chosen you the LORD, to serve him. And they said, We are witnesses.

entries.yo: Njẹ nitorina ẹ mu ọlọrun ajeji ti mbẹ lãrin nyin kuro, ki ẹnyin si yi ọkàn nyin si OLUWA Ọlọrun Israeli.
entries.en: Now therefore put away, said he, the strange gods which are among you, and incline your heart unto the LORD God of Israel.

entries.yo: Awọn enia na si wi fun Joṣua pe, OLUWA Ọlọrun wa li awa o ma sìn, ohùn rẹ̀ li awa o si ma gbọ́.
entries.en: And the people said unto Joshua, The LORD our God will we serve, and his voice will we obey.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Joṣua bá awọn enia na dá majẹmu li ọjọ́ na, o si fi ofin ati ìlana fun wọn ni Ṣekemu.
entries.en: So Joshua made a covenant with the people that day, and set them a statute and an ordinance in Shechem.

entries.yo: Joṣua si kọ ọ̀rọ wọnyi sinu iwé ofin Ọlọrun, o si mú okuta nla kan, o si gbé e kà ibẹ̀ labẹ igi-oaku kan, ti o wà ni ibi-mimọ́ OLUWA.
entries.en: And Joshua wrote these words in the book of the law of God, and took a great stone, and set it up there under an oak, that was by the sanctuary of the LORD.

entries.yo: Joṣua si wi fun gbogbo awọn enia pe, Ẹ kiyesi i, okuta yi ni ẹlẹri fun wa; nitori o ti gbọ́ gbogbo ọ̀rọ OLUWA ti o bá wa sọ: nitorina yio ṣe ẹlẹri si nyin, ki ẹnyin má ba sẹ́ Ọlọrun nyin.
entries.en: And Joshua said unto all the people, Behold, this stone shall be a witness unto us; for it hath heard all the words of the LORD which he spake unto us: it shall be therefore a witness unto you, lest ye deny your God.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Joṣua jọwọ awọn enia na lọwọ lọ, olukuluku si ilẹ-iní rẹ̀.
entries.en: So Joshua let the people depart, every man unto his inheritance.

entries.yo: O si ṣe lẹhin nkan wọnyi, ni Joṣua ọmọ Nuni, iranṣẹ OLUWA kú, o jẹ́ ẹni ãdọfa ọdún.
entries.en: And it came to pass after these things, that Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died, being an hundred and ten years old.

entries.yo: Nwọn si sin i ni àla ilẹ-iní rẹ̀ ni Timnatisera, ti mbẹ ni ilẹ òke Efraimu, ni ìha ariwa òke Gaaṣi.
entries.en: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnath-serah, which is in mount Ephraim, on the north side of the hill of Gaash.

entries.yo: Israeli si sìn OLUWA ni gbogbo ọjọ́ Joṣua, ati ni gbogbo ọjọ́ awọn àgba ti o wà lẹhin Joṣua, ti o si mọ̀ gbogbo iṣẹ OLUWA, ti o ṣe fun Israeli.
entries.en: And Israel served the LORD all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders that overlived Joshua, and which had known all the works of the LORD, that he had done for Israel.

entries.yo: Egungun Josefu, ti awọn ọmọ Israeli gbé gòke lati Egipti wá, ni nwọn si sin ni Ṣekemu, ni ipín ilẹ ti Jakobu rà lọwọ awọn ọmọ Hamori baba Ṣekemu li ọgọrun owo: o si di ilẹ-iní awọn ọmọ Josefu.
entries.en: And the bones of Joseph, which the children of Israel brought up out of Egypt, buried they in Shechem, in a parcel of ground which Jacob bought of the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for an hundred pieces of silver: and it became the inheritance of the children of Joseph.

entries.yo: Eleasari ọmọ Aaroni si kú; nwọn si sin i li òke Finehasi ọmọ rẹ̀, ti a fi fun u li òke Efraimu.
entries.en: And Eleazar the son of Aaron died; and they buried him in a hill that pertained to Phinehas his son, which was given him in mount Ephraim.

entries.yo: O si ṣe lẹhin ikú Joṣua, ni awọn ọmọ Israeli bère lọdọ OLUWA wipe, Tani yio tète gòke tọ̀ awọn ara Kenaani lọ fun wa, lati bá wọn jà?
entries.en: Now after the death of Joshua it came to pass, that the children of Israel asked the LORD, saying, Who shall go up for us against the Canaanites first, to fight against them?

entries.yo: OLUWA si wipe, Juda ni yio gòke lọ: kiyesi i, emi fi ilẹ̀ na lé e lọwọ.
entries.en: And the LORD said, Judah shall go up: behold, I have delivered the land into his hand.

entries.yo: Juda si wi fun Simeoni arakunrin rẹ̀ pe, Bá mi gòke lọ si ilẹ mi, ki awa ki o le bá awọn ara Kenaani jà; emi na pẹlu yio si bá ọ lọ si ilẹ rẹ. Simeoni si bá a lọ.
entries.en: And Judah said unto Simeon his brother, Come up with me into my lot, that we may fight against the Canaanites; and I likewise will go with thee into thy lot. So Simeon went with him.

entries.yo: Juda si gòke lọ; OLUWA si fi awọn ara Kenaani ati awọn Perissi lé wọn lọwọ: nwọn si pa ẹgbarun ọkunrin ninu wọn ni Beseki.
entries.en: And Judah went up; and the LORD delivered the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hand: and they slew of them in Bezek ten thousand men.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ri Adoni-beseki ni Beseki: nwọn si bá a jà, nwọn si pa awọn ara Kenaani ati awọn Perissi.
entries.en: And they found Adoni-bezek in Bezek: and they fought against him, and they slew the Canaanites and the Perizzites.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Adoni-beseki sá; nwọn si lepa rẹ̀, nwọn si mú u, nwọn si ke àtampako ọwọ́ rẹ̀, ati ti ẹsẹ̀ rẹ̀.
entries.en: But Adoni-bezek fled; and they pursued after him, and caught him, and cut off his thumbs and his great toes.

entries.yo: Adoni-beseki si wipe, Adọrin ọba li emi ke li àtampako ọwọ́ wọn ati ti ẹsẹ̀ wọn, ti nwọn nṣà onjẹ wọn labẹ tabili mi: gẹgẹ bi emi ti ṣe, bẹ̃li Ọlọrun si san a fun mi. Nwọn si mú u wá si Jerusalemu, o si kú sibẹ̀.
entries.en: And Adoni-bezek said, Threescore and ten kings, having their thumbs and their great toes cut off, gathered their meat under my table: as I have done, so God hath requited me. And they brought him to Jerusalem, and there he died.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Juda si bá Jerusalemu jà, nwọn si kó o, nwọn si fi oju idà kọlù u, nwọn si tinabọ ilu na.
entries.en: Now the children of Judah had fought against Jerusalem, and had taken it, and smitten it with the edge of the sword, and set the city on fire.

entries.yo: Lẹhin na awọn ọmọ Juda si sọkalẹ lọ lati bá awọn ara Kenaani jà, ti ngbé ilẹ òke, ati ni Gusù, ati ni afonifoji nì.
entries.en: And afterward the children of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites, that dwelt in the mountain, and in the south, and in the valley.

entries.yo: Juda si tọ̀ awọn ara Kenaani ti ngbé Hebroni lọ: (orukọ Hebroni ni ìgba iṣaju si ni Kiriati-arba:) nwọn si pa Ṣeṣai, ati Ahimani, ati Talmai.
entries.en: And Judah went against the Canaanites that dwelt in Hebron: (now the name of Hebron before was Kirjath-arba:) and they slew Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai.

entries.yo: Lati ibẹ̀ o si gbé ogun tọ̀ awọn ara Debiri lọ. (Orukọ Debiri ni ìgba atijọ si ni Kiriati-seferi.)
entries.en: And from thence he went against the inhabitants of Debir: and the name of Debir before was Kirjath-sepher:

entries.yo: Kalebu si wipe, Ẹniti o ba kọlù Kiriati-seferi, ti o si kó o, on li emi o fi Aksa ọmọbinrin mi fun li aya.
entries.en: And Caleb said, He that smiteth Kirjath-sepher, and taketh it, to him will I give Achsah my daughter to wife.

entries.yo: Otnieli ọmọ Kenasi, aburò Kalebu, si kó o: o si fi Aksa ọmọbinrin rẹ̀ fun u li aya.
entries.en: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb's younger brother, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati Aksa dé ọdọ rẹ̀, o si rọ̀ ọ lati bère oko kan lọdọ baba rẹ̀: Aksa si sọkalẹ kuro lori kẹtẹkẹtẹ rẹ̀; Kalebu si wi fun u pe, Kini iwọ nfẹ́?
entries.en: And it came to pass, when she came to him, that she moved him to ask of her father a field: and she lighted from off her ass; and Caleb said unto her, What wilt thou?

entries.yo: On si wi fun u pe, Ta mi lọrẹ kan; nitoriti iwọ ti fun mi ni ilẹ Gusù, fi isun omi fun mi pẹlu. Kalebu si fi ìsun òke ati isun isalẹ fun u.
entries.en: And she said unto him, Give me a blessing: for thou hast given me a south land; give me also springs of water. And Caleb gave her the upper springs and the nether springs.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Keni, ana Mose, si bá awọn ọmọ Juda gòke lati ilu ọpẹ lọ si aginjù Juda, ni gusù Aradi; nwọn si lọ, nwọn si mbá awọn enia na gbé.
entries.en: And the children of the Kenite, Moses' father in law, went up out of the city of palm trees with the children of Judah into the wilderness of Judah, which lieth in the south of Arad; and they went and dwelt among the people.

entries.yo: Juda si bá Simeoni arakunrin rẹ̀ lọ, nwọn si pa awọn ara Kenaani ti ngbé Sefati, nwọn si pa a run patapata. A si pè orukọ ilu na ni Horma.
entries.en: And Judah went with Simeon his brother, and they slew the Canaanites that inhabited Zephath, and utterly destroyed it. And the name of the city was called Hormah.

entries.yo: Juda si kó Gasa pẹlu àgbegbe rẹ̀, ati Aṣkeloni pẹlu àgbegbe rẹ̀, ati Ekroni pẹlu àgbegbe rẹ̀.
entries.en: Also Judah took Gaza with the coast thereof, and Askelon with the coast thereof, and Ekron with the coast thereof.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wà pẹlu Juda; o si gbà ilẹ òke; nitori on kò le lé awọn enia ti o wà ni pẹtẹlẹ̀ jade, nitoriti nwọn ní kẹkẹ́ irin.
entries.en: And the LORD was with Judah; and he drave out the inhabitants of the mountain; but could not drive out the inhabitants of the valley, because they had chariots of iron.

entries.yo: Nwọn si fi Hebroni fun Kalebu, gẹgẹ bi Mose ti wi: on si lé awọn ọmọ Anaki mẹtẹta jade kuro nibẹ̀.
entries.en: And they gave Hebron unto Caleb, as Moses said: and he expelled thence the three sons of Anak.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Benjamini kò si lé awọn Jebusi ti ngbé Jerusalemu jade; ṣugbọn awọn Jebusi mbá awọn ọmọ Benjamini gbé ni Jerusalemu titi di oni.
entries.en: And the children of Benjamin did not drive out the Jebusites that inhabited Jerusalem; but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Benjamin in Jerusalem unto this day.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ara ile Josefu, awọn pẹlu si gòke lọ bá Beti-eli jà: OLUWA si wà pẹlu wọn.
entries.en: And the house of Joseph, they also went up against Bethel: and the LORD was with them.

entries.yo: Awọn ara ile Josefu rán amí lọ si Beti-eli. (Orukọ ilu na ni ìgba atijọ rí si ni Lusi.)
entries.en: And the house of Joseph sent to descry Bethel. (Now the name of the city before was Luz.)

entries.yo: Awọn amí na si ri ọkunrin kan ti o ti inu ilu na jade wá, nwọn si wi fun u pe, Awa bẹ̀ ọ, fi ọ̀na atiwọ̀ ilu yi hàn wa, awa o si ṣãnu fun ọ.
entries.en: And the spies saw a man come forth out of the city, and they said unto him, Shew us, we pray thee, the entrance into the city, and we will shew thee mercy.

entries.yo: O si fi ọ̀na atiwọ̀ ilu na hàn wọn, nwọn si fi oju idà kọlù ilu na; ṣugbọn nwọn jọwọ ọkunrin na ati gbogbo awọn ara ile rẹ̀ lọwọ lọ.
entries.en: And when he shewed them the entrance into the city, they smote the city with the edge of the sword; but they let go the man and all his family.

entries.yo: Ọkunrin na si lọ si ilẹ awọn Hitti, o si tẹ̀ ilu kan dó, o si pè orukọ rẹ̀ ni Lusi: eyi si li orukọ rẹ̀ titi di oni.
entries.en: And the man went into the land of the Hittites, and built a city, and called the name thereof Luz: which is the name thereof unto this day.

entries.yo: Manasse kò si lé awọn ara Beti-seani ati ilu rẹ̀ wọnni jade, tabi awọn ara Taanaki ati ilu rẹ̀ wọnni, tabi awọn ara Dori ati ilu rẹ̀ wọnni, tabi awọn ara Ibleamu ati ilu rẹ̀ wọnni, tabi awọn ara Megiddo ati ilu rẹ̀ wọnni: ṣugbọn awọn ara Kenaani ngbé ilẹ na.
entries.en: Neither did Manasseh drive out the inhabitants of Beth-shean and her towns, nor Taanach and her towns, nor the inhabitants of Dor and her towns, nor the inhabitants of Ibleam and her towns, nor the inhabitants of Megiddo and her towns: but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati Israeli di alagbara tán, nwọn si mu awọn ara Kenaani sìn, nwọn kò si lé wọn jade patapata.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when Israel was strong, that they put the Canaanites to tribute, and did not utterly drive them out.

entries.yo: Efraimu kò si lé awọn ara Kenaani ti ngbé Geseri jade; ṣugbọn awọn ara Kenaani ngbé ãrin wọn ni Geseri.
entries.en: Neither did Ephraim drive out the Canaanites that dwelt in Gezer; but the Canaanites dwelt in Gezer among them.

entries.yo: Sebuluni kò lé awọn ara Kitroni jade, tabi awọn ara Nahalolu; ṣugbọn awọn ara Kenaani ngbé ãrin wọn, nwọn si nsìn.
entries.en: Neither did Zebulun drive out the inhabitants of Kitron, nor the inhabitants of Nahalol; but the Canaanites dwelt among them, and became tributaries.

entries.yo: Aṣeri kò lé awọn ara Akko jade, tabi awọn ara Sidoni, tabi awọn ara Alabu, tabi awọn ara Aksibu, tabi awọn ara Helba, tabi awọn ara Afiki, tabi awọn ara Rehobu:
entries.en: Neither did Asher drive out the inhabitants of Accho, nor the inhabitants of Zidon, nor of Ahlab, nor of Achzib, nor of Helbah, nor of Aphik, nor of Rehob:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn ọmọ Aṣeri ngbé ãrin awọn ara Kenaani, ti ngbé ilẹ na: nitoriti nwọn kò lé wọn jade.
entries.en: But the Asherites dwelt among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land: for they did not drive them out.

entries.yo: Naftali kò lé awọn ara Beti-ṣemeṣi jade, tabi awọn ara Beti-anati; ṣugbọn on ngbé ãrin awọn ara Kenaani, ti ngbé ilẹ na: ṣugbọn awọn ara Beti-ṣemeṣi ati Beti-anati di ẹniti nsìn wọn.
entries.en: Neither did Naphtali drive out the inhabitants of Beth-shemesh, nor the inhabitants of Beth-anath; but he dwelt among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land: nevertheless the inhabitants of Beth-shemesh and of Beth-anath became tributaries unto them.

entries.yo: Awọn Amori si fi agbara tì awọn ọmọ Dani sori òke: nitoripe nwọn kò jẹ ki nwọn ki o sọkalẹ wá si afonifoji.
entries.en: And the Amorites forced the children of Dan into the mountain: for they would not suffer them to come down to the valley:

entries.yo: Awọn Amori si ngbé òke Heresi, ni Aijaloni, ati ni Ṣaalbimu: ọwọ́ awọn ara ile Josefu bori, nwọn si di ẹniti nsìn.
entries.en: But the Amorites would dwell in mount Heres in Aijalon, and in Shaalbim: yet the hand of the house of Joseph prevailed, so that they became tributaries.

entries.yo: Àla awọn Amori si ni lati ìgoke lọ si Akrabbimu, lati ibi apata lọ si òke.
entries.en: And the coast of the Amorites was from the going up to Akrabbim, from the rock, and upward.

entries.yo: ANGELI OLUWA si ti Gilgali gòke wá si Bokimu. O si wipe, Emi mu nyin gòke lati Egipti wá, emi si mú nyin wá si ilẹ ti emi ti bura fun awọn baba nyin; emi si wipe, Emi ki yio dà majẹmu mi pẹlu nyin lailai:
entries.en: And an angel of the LORD came up from Gilgal to Bochim, and said, I made you to go up out of Egypt, and have brought you unto the land which I sware unto your fathers; and I said, I will never break my covenant with you.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin kò si gbọdọ bá awọn ara ilẹ yi dá majẹmu; ẹnyin o wó pẹpẹ wọn lulẹ: ṣugbọn ẹnyin kò gbọ́ ohùn mi: Ẽha ti ṣe ti ẹnyin fi ṣe yi?
entries.en: And ye shall make no league with the inhabitants of this land; ye shall throw down their altars: but ye have not obeyed my voice: why have ye done this?

entries.yo: Nitorina emi pẹlu wipe, Emi ki yio lé wọn jade kuro niwaju nyin; ṣugbọn nwọn o jẹ́ ẹgún ni ìha nyin, ati awọn oriṣa wọn yio di ikẹkun fun nyin.
entries.en: Wherefore I also said, I will not drive them out from before you; but they shall be as thorns in your sides, and their gods shall be a snare unto you.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati angeli OLUWA sọ ọ̀rọ wọnyi fun gbogbo awọn ọmọ Israeli, awọn enia na si gbé ohùn wọn soke, nwọn si sọkun.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when the angel of the LORD spake these words unto all the children of Israel, that the people lifted up their voice, and wept.

entries.yo: Nwọn si pè orukọ ibẹ̀ na ni Bokimu: nwọn si ru ẹbọ nibẹ̀ si OLUWA.
entries.en: And they called the name of that place Bochim: and they sacrificed there unto the LORD.

entries.yo: Nigbati Joṣua si ti jọwọ awọn enia lọwọ lọ, olukuluku awọn ọmọ Israeli si lọ sinu ilẹ-iní rẹ̀ lati gba ilẹ̀ na.
entries.en: And when Joshua had let the people go, the children of Israel went every man unto his inheritance to possess the land.

entries.yo: Awọn enia na si sìn OLUWA ni gbogbo ọjọ́ Joṣua, ati ni gbogbo ọjọ́ awọn àgba ti o wà lẹhin Joṣua, awọn ẹniti o ri gbogbo iṣẹ nla OLUWA, ti o ṣe fun Israeli.
entries.en: And the people served the LORD all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders that outlived Joshua, who had seen all the great works of the LORD, that he did for Israel.

entries.yo: Joṣua ọmọ Nuni, iranṣẹ OLUWA si kú, nigbati o di ẹni ãdọfa ọdún.
entries.en: And Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died, being an hundred and ten years old.

entries.yo: Nwọn si sinkú rẹ̀ li àla ilẹ-iní rẹ̀ ni Timnati-heresi, ni ilẹ òke Efraimu, li ariwa oke Gaaṣi.
entries.en: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnath-heres, in the mount of Ephraim, on the north side of the hill Gaash.

entries.yo: Ati pẹlu a si kó gbogbo iran na jọ sọdọ awọn baba wọn: iran miran si hù lẹhin wọn, ti kò mọ̀ OLUWA, tabi iṣẹ ti o ṣe fun Israeli.
entries.en: And also all that generation were gathered unto their fathers: and there arose another generation after them, which knew not the LORD, nor yet the works which he had done for Israel.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Israeli si ṣe buburu niwaju OLUWA, nwọn si nsìn Baalimu:
entries.en: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the LORD, and served Baalim:

entries.yo: Nwọn si kọ̀ OLUWA, Ọlọrun awọn baba wọn silẹ, ti o mú wọn jade lati ilẹ Egipti wá, nwọn si ntọ̀ ọlọrun miran lẹhin, ninu oriṣa awọn enia ti o yi wọn ká kiri, nwọn si nfi ori wọn balẹ fun wọn, nwọn si bi OLUWA ninu.
entries.en: And they forsook the LORD God of their fathers, which brought them out of the land of Egypt, and followed other gods, of the gods of the people that were round about them, and bowed themselves unto them, and provoked the LORD to anger.

entries.yo: Nwọn si kọ̀ OLUWA silẹ, nwọn si nsìn Baali ati Aṣtarotu.
entries.en: And they forsook the LORD, and served Baal and Ashtaroth.

entries.yo: Ibinu OLUWA si rú si Israeli, o si fi wọn lé awọn akonilohun lọwọ, ti o kó wọn lẹrù, o si tà wọn si ọwọ́ awọn ọtá wọn yiká kiri, tobẹ̃ ti nwọn kò le duro mọ́ niwaju awọn ọtá wọn.
entries.en: And the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel, and he delivered them into the hands of spoilers that spoiled them, and he sold them into the hands of their enemies round about, so that they could not any longer stand before their enemies.

entries.yo: Nibikibi ti nwọn ba jade lọ, ọwọ́ OLUWA wà lara wọn fun buburu, gẹgẹ bi OLUWA ti wi, ati gẹgẹ bi OLUWA ti bura fun wọn: oju si pọ́n wọn pupọ̀pupọ̀.
entries.en: Whithersoever they went out, the hand of the LORD was against them for evil, as the LORD had said, and as the LORD had sworn unto them: and they were greatly distressed.

entries.yo: OLUWA si gbé awọn onidajọ dide, ti o gbà wọn li ọwọ́ awọn ẹniti nkó wọn lẹrù.
entries.en: Nevertheless the LORD raised up judges, which delivered them out of the hand of those that spoiled them.

entries.yo: Sibẹ̀sibẹ nwọn kò fetisi ti awọn onidajọ wọn, nitoriti nwọn ṣe panṣaga tọ̀ ọlọrun miran lẹhin, nwọn si fi ori wọn balẹ fun wọn: nwọn yipada kánkan kuro li ọ̀na ti awọn baba wọn ti rìn, ni gbigbà ofin OLUWA gbọ́; awọn kò ṣe bẹ̃.
entries.en: And yet they would not hearken unto their judges, but they went a whoring after other gods, and bowed themselves unto them: they turned quickly out of the way which their fathers walked in, obeying the commandments of the LORD; but they did not so.

entries.yo: Nigbati OLUWA ba si gbé awọn onidajọ dide fun wọn, OLUWA a si wà pẹlu onidajọ na, on a si gbà wọn kuro li ọwọ́ awọn ọtá wọn ni gbogbo ọjọ́ onidajọ na: nitoriti OLUWA kãnu, nitori ikerora wọn nitori awọn ti npọ́n wọn loju, ti nwọn si nni wọn lara.
entries.en: And when the LORD raised them up judges, then the LORD was with the judge, and delivered them out of the hand of their enemies all the days of the judge: for it repented the LORD because of their groanings by reason of them that oppressed them and vexed them.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati onidajọ na ba kú, nwọn a si pada, nwọn a si bà ara wọn jẹ́ jù awọn baba wọn lọ, ni titọ̀ ọlọrun miran lẹhin lati ma sìn wọn, ati lati ma fi ori balẹ fun wọn; nwọn kò dẹkun iṣe wọn, ati ìwa-agidi wọn.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when the judge was dead, that they returned, and corrupted themselves more than their fathers, in following other gods to serve them, and to bow down unto them; they ceased not from their own doings, nor from their stubborn way.

entries.yo: Ibinu OLUWA si rú si Israeli; o si wipe, Nitoriti orilẹ-ède yi ti re majẹmu mi kọja eyiti mo ti palaṣẹ fun awọn baba wọn, ti nwọn kò si gbọ́ ohùn mi;
entries.en: And the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel; and he said, Because that this people hath transgressed my covenant which I commanded their fathers, and have not hearkened unto my voice;

entries.yo: Emi pẹlu ki yio lé ọkan jade mọ́ kuro niwaju wọn ninu awọn orilẹ-ède, ti Joṣua fisilẹ nigbati o kú:
entries.en: I also will not henceforth drive out any from before them of the nations which Joshua left when he died:

entries.yo: Ki emi ki o le ma fi wọn dan Israeli wò, bi nwọn o ma ṣe akiyesi ọ̀na OLUWA lati ma rìn ninu rẹ̀, bi awọn baba wọn ti ṣe akiyesi rẹ̀, tabi bi nwọn ki yio ṣe e.
entries.en: That through them I may prove Israel, whether they will keep the way of the LORD to walk therein, as their fathers did keep it, or not.

entries.yo: OLUWA si fi orilẹ-ède wọnni silẹ, li ailé wọn jade kánkan; bẹ̃ni kò si fi wọn lé Joṣua lọwọ.
entries.en: Therefore the LORD left those nations, without driving them out hastily; neither delivered he them into the hand of Joshua.

entries.yo: NJẸ wọnyi li awọn orilẹ-ède ti OLUWA fisilẹ, lati ma fi wọn dan Israeli wò, ani iye awọn ti kò mọ̀ gbogbo ogun Kenaani;
entries.en: Now these are the nations which the LORD left, to prove Israel by them, even as many of Israel as had not known all the wars of Canaan;

entries.yo: Nitori idí yi pe, ki iran awọn ọmọ Israeli ki o le mọ̀, lati ma kọ́ wọn li ogun, ani irú awọn ti kò ti mọ̀ ọ niṣaju rí;
entries.en: Only that the generations of the children of Israel might know, to teach them war, at the least such as before knew nothing thereof;

entries.yo: Awọn ijoye Filistini marun, ati gbogbo awọn Kenaani, ati awọn ara Sidoni, ati awọn Hifi ti ngbé òke Lebanoni, lati òke Baali-hermoni lọ dé atiwọ̀ Hamati.
entries.en: Namely, five lords of the Philistines, and all the Canaanites, and the Sidonians, and the Hivites that dwelt in mount Lebanon, from mount Baal-hermon unto the entering in of Hamath.

entries.yo: Wọnyi li a o si ma fi dan Israeli wò, lati mọ̀ bi nwọn o fetisi ofin OLUWA, ti o fi fun awọn baba wọn lati ọwọ́ Mose wá.
entries.en: And they were to prove Israel by them, to know whether they would hearken unto the commandments of the LORD, which he commanded their fathers by the hand of Moses.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Israeli si joko lãrin awọn ara Kenaani; ati awọn Hitti, ati awọn Amori, ati awọn Perissi, ati awọn Hifi, ati awọn Jebusi:
entries.en: And the children of Israel dwelt among the Canaanites, Hittites, and Amorites, and Perizzites, and Hivites, and Jebusites:

entries.yo: Nwọn si fẹ́ awọn ọmọbinrin wọn li aya, nwọn si fi awọn ọmọbinrin wọn fun awọn ọmọkunrin wọn, nwọn si nsìn awọn oriṣa wọn.
entries.en: And they took their daughters to be their wives, and gave their daughters to their sons, and served their gods.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Israeli si ṣe eyiti o buru li oju OLUWA, nwọn si gbàgbé OLUWA Ọlọrun wọn, nwọn si nsìn Baalimu ati Aṣerotu.
entries.en: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the LORD, and forgat the LORD their God, and served Baalim and the groves.

entries.yo: Nitori na ibinu OLUWA ru si Israeli, o si tà wọn si ọwọ́ Kuṣani-riṣataimu ọba Mesopotamia: awọn ọmọ Israeli si sìn Kuṣani-riṣataimu li ọdún mẹjọ.
entries.en: Therefore the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel, and he sold them into the hand of Chushan-rishathaim king of Mesopotamia: and the children of Israel served Chushan-rishathaim eight years.

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn ọmọ Israeli si kigbepè OLUWA, OLUWA si gbé olugbala kan dide fun awọn ọmọ Israeli, ẹniti o gbà wọn, ani Otnieli ọmọ Kenasi, aburò Kalebu.
entries.en: And when the children of Israel cried unto the LORD, the LORD raised up a deliverer to the children of Israel, who delivered them, even Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb's younger brother.

entries.yo: Ẹmi OLUWA si wà lara rẹ̀, on si ṣe idajọ Israeli, o si jade ogun, OLUWA si fi Kuṣani-riṣataimu ọba Mesopotamia lé e lọwọ: ọwọ́ rẹ̀ si bori Kuṣani-riṣataimu.
entries.en: And the Spirit of the LORD came upon him, and he judged Israel, and went out to war: and the LORD delivered Chushan-rishathaim king of Mesopotamia into his hand; and his hand prevailed against Chushan-rishathaim.

entries.yo: Ilẹ na si simi li ogoji ọdún. Otnieli ọmọ Kenasi si kú.
entries.en: And the land had rest forty years. And Othniel the son of Kenaz died.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Israeli si tun ṣe eyiti o buru loju OLUWA: OLUWA si fi agbara fun Egloni ọba Moabu si Israeli, nitoripe nwọn ti ṣe eyiti o buru li oju OLUWA.
entries.en: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the LORD: and the LORD strengthened Eglon the king of Moab against Israel, because they had done evil in the sight of the LORD.

entries.yo: O si kó awọn ọmọ Ammoni ati ti Amaleki mọra rẹ̀; o si lọ o kọlù Israeli, nwọn si gbà ilu ọpẹ.
entries.en: And he gathered unto him the children of Ammon and Amalek, and went and smote Israel, and possessed the city of palm trees.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Israeli si sìn Egloni ọba Moabu li ọdún mejidilogun.
entries.en: So the children of Israel served Eglon the king of Moab eighteen years.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati awọn ọmọ Israeli kigbepè OLUWA, OLUWA si gbé olugbala kan dide fun wọn, Ehudu ọmọ Gera, ẹ̀ya Benjamini, ọlọwọ́-òsi: awọn ọmọ Israeli si fi ẹ̀bun rán a si Egloni ọba Moabu.
entries.en: But when the children of Israel cried unto the LORD, the LORD raised them up a deliverer, Ehud the son of Gera, a Benjamite, a man lefthanded: and by him the children of Israel sent a present unto Eglon the king of Moab.

entries.yo: Ehudu si rọ idà kan olojumeji, igbọnwọ kan ni gigùn; on si sán a si abẹ aṣọ rẹ̀ ni itan ọtún.
entries.en: But Ehud made him a dagger which had two edges, of a cubit length; and he did gird it under his raiment upon his right thigh.

entries.yo: O si mú ọrẹ na wá fun Egloni ọba Moabu; Egloni si jẹ́ ọkunrin ti o sanra pupọ̀.
entries.en: And he brought the present unto Eglon king of Moab: and Eglon was a very fat man.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si fi ọrẹ na fun u tán, o rán awọn enia ti o rù ọrẹ na pada lọ.
entries.en: And when he had made an end to offer the present, he sent away the people that bare the present.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn on tikara rẹ̀ pada lati ibi ere finfin ti o wà leti Gilgali, o si wipe, Ọba, mo lí ọ̀rọ ìkọkọ kan ibá ọ sọ. On si wipe, Ẹ dakẹ. Gbogbo awọn ẹniti o duro tì i si jade kuro lọdọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: But he himself turned again from the quarries that were by Gilgal, and said, I have a secret errand unto thee, O king: who said, Keep silence. And all that stood by him went out from him.

entries.yo: Ehudu si tọ̀ ọ wá; on si nikan joko ninu yará itura rẹ̀. Ehudu si wipe, Mo lí ọ̀rọ kan lati ọdọ Ọlọrun wá fun ọ. On si dide kuro ni ibujoko rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Ehud came unto him; and he was sitting in a summer parlour, which he had for himself alone. And Ehud said, I have a message from God unto thee. And he arose out of his seat.

entries.yo: Ehudu si nà ọwọ́ òsi rẹ̀, o si yọ idà na kuro ni itan ọtún rẹ̀, o si fi gún u ni ikùn:
entries.en: And Ehud put forth his left hand, and took the dagger from his right thigh, and thrust it into his belly:

entries.yo: Ati idà ati ekù si wọle; ọrá si bò idà na nitoriti kò fà idà na yọ kuro ninu ikun rẹ̀; o si yọ lẹhin.
entries.en: And the haft also went in after the blade; and the fat closed upon the blade, so that he could not draw the dagger out of his belly; and the dirt came out.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Ehudu si ba ti iloro lọ, o si se ilẹkun gbọngan na mọ́ ọ, o si tì wọn.
entries.en: Then Ehud went forth through the porch, and shut the doors of the parlour upon him, and locked them.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si jade lọ tán, awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀ dé; nigbati nwọn wò, si kiyesi i, awọn ilẹkun gbọngan tì; nwọn wipe, Li aisí aniani o bò ẹsẹ̀ rẹ̀ ninu yará itura rẹ̀.
entries.en: When he was gone out, his servants came; and when they saw that, behold, the doors of the parlour were locked, they said, Surely he covereth his feet in his summer chamber.

entries.yo: Nwọn si duro titi o fi di itiju fun wọn: kiyesi i on kò si ṣí ilẹkun gbọngan na silẹ; nitorina nwọn mú ọmọlẹkun, nwọn si ṣí i: si kiyesi i, oluwa wọn ti ṣubu lulẹ kú.
entries.en: And they tarried till they were ashamed: and, behold, he opened not the doors of the parlour; therefore they took a key, and opened them: and, behold, their lord was fallen down dead on the earth.

entries.yo: Ehudu si sálọ nigbati nwọn nduro, o si kọja ibi ere finfin, o si sálọ si Seira.
entries.en: And Ehud escaped while they tarried, and passed beyond the quarries, and escaped unto Seirath.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati o dé, o fọn ipè ni ilẹ òke Efraimu, awọn ọmọ Israeli si bá a sọkalẹ lọ lati òke na wá, on si wà niwaju wọn.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when he was come, that he blew a trumpet in the mountain of Ephraim, and the children of Israel went down with him from the mount, and he before them.

entries.yo: On si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ ma tọ̀ mi lẹhin: nitoriti OLUWA ti fi awọn ọtá nyin awọn ara Moabu lé nyin lọwọ. Nwọn si sọkalẹ tọ̀ ọ lẹhin lọ, nwọn si gbà ìwọdo Jordani, ti o wà ni ìha Moabu, nwọn kò si jẹ ki ẹnikan ki o kọja mọ̀.
entries.en: And he said unto them, Follow after me: for the LORD hath delivered your enemies the Moabites into your hand. And they went down after him, and took the fords of Jordan toward Moab, and suffered not a man to pass over.

entries.yo: Nwọn si pa ìwọn ẹgba marun ọkunrin ninu awọn ara Moabu ni ìgba na, gbogbo awọn ti o sigbọnlẹ, ati gbogbo awọn akọni ọkunrin; kò sí ọkunrin kanṣoṣo ti o sálà.
entries.en: And they slew of Moab at that time about ten thousand men, all lusty, and all men of valour; and there escaped not a man.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li a tẹ̀ ori Moabu ba ni ijọ́ na li abẹ ọwọ́ Israeli. Ilẹ na si simi li ọgọrin ọdún.
entries.en: So Moab was subdued that day under the hand of Israel. And the land had rest fourscore years.

entries.yo: Lẹhin rẹ̀ ni Ṣamgari ọmọ Anati, ẹniti o fi ọpá ti a fi ndà akọmalu pa ẹgbẹta ọkunrin ninu awọn ara Filistini, on pẹlu si gbà Israeli.
entries.en: And after him was Shamgar the son of Anath, which slew of the Philistines six hundred men with an ox goad: and he also delivered Israel.

entries.yo: AWỌN ọmọ Israeli si tun ṣe eyiti o buru li oju OLUWA, nigbati Ehudu kú tán.
entries.en: And the children of Israel again did evil in the sight of the LORD, when Ehud was dead.

entries.yo: OLUWA si tà wọn si ọwọ́ Jabini ọba Kenaani, ẹniti o jọba ni Hasori; olori ogun ẹniti iṣe Sisera, ẹniti ngbé Haroṣeti ti awọn orilẹ-ède.
entries.en: And the LORD sold them into the hand of Jabin king of Canaan, that reigned in Hazor; the captain of whose host was Sisera, which dwelt in Harosheth of the Gentiles.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Israeli si kigbepè OLUWA: nitoriti o ní ẹdẹgbẹrun kẹkẹ́ irin; ogun ọdún li o si fi pọ́n awọn ọmọ Israeli loju gidigidi.
entries.en: And the children of Israel cried unto the LORD: for he had nine hundred chariots of iron; and twenty years he mightily oppressed the children of Israel.

entries.yo: Ati Debora, wolĩ-obinrin, aya Lappidotu, o ṣe idajọ Israeli li akokò na.
entries.en: And Deborah, a prophetess, the wife of Lapidoth, she judged Israel at that time.

entries.yo: On si ngbé abẹ igi-ọpẹ Debora li agbedemeji Rama ati Beti-eli ni ilẹ òke Efraimu: awọn ọmọ Israeli a si ma wá sọdọ rẹ̀ fun idajọ.
entries.en: And she dwelt under the palm tree of Deborah between Ramah and Bethel in mount Ephraim: and the children of Israel came up to her for judgment.

entries.yo: On si ranṣẹ pè Baraki ọmọ Abinoamu lati Kedeṣi-naftali jade wá, o si wi fun u pe, OLUWA, Ọlọrun Israeli kò ha ti paṣẹ pe, Lọ sunmọ òke Tabori, ki o si mú ẹgba marun ọkunrin ninu awọn ọmọ Naftali, ati ninu awọn ọmọ Sebuluni pẹlu rẹ.
entries.en: And she sent and called Barak the son of Abinoam out of Kedesh-naphtali, and said unto him, Hath not the LORD God of Israel commanded, saying, Go and draw toward mount Tabor, and take with thee ten thousand men of the children of Naphtali and of the children of Zebulun?

entries.yo: Emi o si fà Sisera, olori ogun Jabini, pẹlu kẹkẹ́ rẹ̀ ati ogun rẹ̀, sọdọ rẹ si odò Kiṣoni; emi o si fi i lé ọ lọwọ.
entries.en: And I will draw unto thee to the river Kishon Sisera, the captain of Jabin's army, with his chariots and his multitude; and I will deliver him into thine hand.

entries.yo: Baraki si wi fun u pe, Bi iwọ o ba bá mi lọ, njẹ emi o lọ: ṣugbọn bi iwọ ki yio ba bá mi lọ, emi ki yio lọ.
entries.en: And Barak said unto her, If thou wilt go with me, then I will go: but if thou wilt not go with me, then I will not go.

entries.yo: On si wipe, Ni lilọ emi o bá ọ lọ: ṣugbọn ọlá ọ̀na ti iwọ nlọ nì ki yio jẹ́ tirẹ; nitoriti OLUWA yio tà Sisera si ọwọ́ obinrin. Debora si dide, o si bá Baraki lọ si Kedeṣi.
entries.en: And she said, I will surely go with thee: notwithstanding the journey that thou takest shall not be for thine honour; for the LORD shall sell Sisera into the hand of a woman. And Deborah arose, and went with Barak to Kedesh.

entries.yo: Baraki si pè Sebuluni ati Naftali si Kedeṣi; on si lọ pẹlu ẹgba marun ọkunrin lẹhin rẹ̀: Debora si gòke lọ pẹlu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Barak called Zebulun and Naphtali to Kedesh; and he went up with ten thousand men at his feet: and Deborah went up with him.

entries.yo: Njẹ Heberi ọmọ Keni, ti yà ara rẹ̀ kuro lọdọ awọn ọmọ Keni, ani awọn ọmọ Hobabu, ana Mose, o si pa agọ́ rẹ̀ titi dé igi-oaku Saanannimu, ti o wà li àgbegbe Kedeṣi.
entries.en: Now Heber the Kenite, which was of the children of Hobab the father in law of Moses, had severed himself from the Kenites, and pitched his tent unto the plain of Zaanaim, which is by Kedesh.

entries.yo: Nwọn si sọ fun Sisera pe, Baraki ọmọ Abinoamu ti lọ si òke Tabori.
entries.en: And they shewed Sisera that Barak the son of Abinoam was gone up to mount Tabor.

entries.yo: Sisera si kó gbogbo kẹkẹ́ rẹ̀ jọ, ẹdẹgbẹrun kẹkẹ́ irin, ati gbogbo awọn enia ti o wà pẹlu rẹ̀, lati Haroṣeti awọn orilẹ-ède wá si odò Kiṣoni.
entries.en: And Sisera gathered together all his chariots, even nine hundred chariots of iron, and all the people that were with him, from Harosheth of the Gentiles unto the river of Kishon.

entries.yo: Debora si wi fun Baraki pe, Dide; nitoripe oni li ọjọ́ ti OLUWA fi Sisera lé ọ lọwọ: OLUWA kò ha ti ṣaju rẹ lọ bi? Bẹ̃ni Baraki sọkalẹ lati òke Tabori lọ, ẹgba marun ọkunrin si tẹle e lẹhin.
entries.en: And Deborah said unto Barak, Up; for this is the day in which the LORD hath delivered Sisera into thine hand: is not the LORD gone out before thee? So Barak went down from mount Tabor, and ten thousand men after him.

entries.yo: OLUWA si fi oju idà ṣẹgun Sisera, ati gbogbo kẹkẹ́ rẹ̀, ati gbogbo ogun rẹ̀, niwaju Baraki; Sisera si sọkalẹ kuro li ori kẹkẹ́ rẹ̀, o si fi ẹsẹ̀ rẹ̀ sálọ.
entries.en: And the LORD discomfited Sisera, and all his chariots, and all his host, with the edge of the sword before Barak; so that Sisera lighted down off his chariot, and fled away on his feet.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Baraki lepa awọn kẹkẹ́, ati ogun na, titi dé Haroṣeti awọn orilẹ-ède: gbogbo ogun Sisera si ti oju idà ṣubu; ọkunrin kanṣoṣo kò si kù.
entries.en: But Barak pursued after the chariots, and after the host, unto Harosheth of the Gentiles: and all the host of Sisera fell upon the edge of the sword; and there was not a man left.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Sisera ti fi ẹsẹ̀ rẹ̀ sálọ si agọ́ Jaeli aya Heberi ọmọ Keni: nitoriti alafia wà lãrin Jabini ọba Hasori ati ile Heberi ọmọ Keni.
entries.en: Howbeit Sisera fled away on his feet to the tent of Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite: for there was peace between Jabin the king of Hazor and the house of Heber the Kenite.

entries.yo: Jaeli si jade lọ ipade Sisera, o si wi fun u pe, Yà wá, oluwa mi, yà sọdọ mi; má bẹ̀ru. On si yà sọdọ rẹ̀ sinu agọ́, o si fi kubusu bò o.
entries.en: And Jael went out to meet Sisera, and said unto him, Turn in, my lord, turn in to me; fear not. And when he had turned in unto her into the tent, she covered him with a mantle.

entries.yo: On si wi fun u pe, Emi bẹ̀ ọ, fun mi li omi diẹ mu; nitoriti ongbẹ ngbẹ mi. O si ṣí igo warà kan, o si fi fun u mu, o si bò o lara.
entries.en: And he said unto her, Give me, I pray thee, a little water to drink; for I am thirsty. And she opened a bottle of milk, and gave him drink, and covered him.

entries.yo: On si wi fun u pe, Duro li ẹnu-ọ̀na agọ́, yio si ṣe, bi ẹnikan ba wá, ti o si bi ọ lère pe, ọkunrin kan wà nihin bi? ki iwọ wipe, Kò sí.
entries.en: Again he said unto her, Stand in the door of the tent, and it shall be, when any man doth come and inquire of thee, and say, Is there any man here? that thou shalt say, No.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Jaeli aya Heberi mú iṣo-agọ́ kan, o si mú õlù li ọwọ́ rẹ̀, o si yọ́ tọ̀ ọ, o si kàn iṣo na mọ́ ẹbati rẹ̀, o si wọ̀ ilẹ ṣinṣin; nitoriti o sùn fọnfọn; bẹ̃ni o daku, o si kú.
entries.en: Then Jael Heber's wife took a nail of the tent, and took an hammer in her hand, and went softly unto him, and smote the nail into his temples, and fastened it into the ground: for he was fast asleep and weary. So he died.

entries.yo: Si kiyesi i, bi Baraki ti nlepa Sisera, Jaeli wá pade, rẹ̀, o si wi fun u pe, Wá, emi o si fi ọkunrin ti iwọ nwá hàn ọ. O si wá sọdọ rẹ̀; si kiyesi i, Sisera dubulẹ li okú, iṣo-agọ́ na si wà li ẹbati rẹ̀.
entries.en: And, behold, as Barak pursued Sisera, Jael came out to meet him, and said unto him, Come, and I will shew thee the man whom thou seekest. And when he came into her tent, behold, Sisera lay dead, and the nail was in his temples.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li Ọlọrun si tẹ̀ ori Jabini ọba Kenaani ba li ọjọ́ na niwaju awọn ọmọ Israeli.
entries.en: So God subdued on that day Jabin the king of Canaan before the children of Israel.

entries.yo: Ọwọ́ awọn ọmọ Israeli si le siwaju ati siwaju si Jabini ọba Kenaani, titi nwọn fi run Jabini ọba Kenaani.
entries.en: And the hand of the children of Israel prospered, and prevailed against Jabin the king of Canaan, until they had destroyed Jabin king of Canaan.

entries.yo: NIGBANA ni Debora on Baraki ọmọ Abinoamu kọrin li ọjọ́ na, wipe,
entries.en: Then sang Deborah and Barak the son of Abinoam on that day, saying,

entries.yo: Nitori bi awọn olori ti ṣaju ni Israeli, nitori bi awọn enia ti fi tinutinu wá, ẹ fi ibukún fun OLUWA.
entries.en: Praise ye the LORD for the avenging of Israel, when the people willingly offered themselves.

entries.yo: Ẹ gbọ́, ẹnyin ọba; ẹ feti nyin silẹ, ẹnyin ọmọ alade; emi, ani emi, o kọrin si OLUWA; emi o kọrin iyìn si OLUWA, Ọlọrun Israeli.
entries.en: Hear, O ye kings; give ear, O ye princes; I, even I, will sing unto the LORD; I will sing praise to the LORD God of Israel.

entries.yo: OLUWA, nigbati iwọ jade kuro ni Seiri, nigbati iwọ nyan jade lati pápa Edomu wá, ilẹ mìtiti, awọn ọrun si kánsilẹ, ani awọsanma pẹlu kán omi silẹ.
entries.en: LORD, when thou wentest out of Seir, when thou marchedst out of the field of Edom, the earth trembled, and the heavens dropped, the clouds also dropped water.

entries.yo: Awọn òke nla yọ́ niwaju OLUWA, ani Sinai yọ́ niwaju OLUWA; Ọlọrun Israeli.
entries.en: The mountains melted from before the LORD, even that Sinai from before the LORD God of Israel.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ́ Ṣamgari ọmọ Anati, li ọjọ́ Jaeli, awọn ọ̀na opópo da, awọn èro si nrìn li ọ̀na ìkọ̀kọ̀.
entries.en: In the days of Shamgar the son of Anath, in the days of Jael, the highways were unoccupied, and the travellers walked through byways.

entries.yo: Awọn olori tán ni Israeli, nwọn tán, titi emi Debora fi dide, ti emi dide bi iya ni Israeli.
entries.en: The inhabitants of the villages ceased, they ceased in Israel, until that I Deborah arose, that I arose a mother in Israel.

entries.yo: Nwọn ti yàn ọlọrun titun; nigbana li ogun wà ni ibode: a ha ri asà tabi ọ̀kọ kan lãrin ẹgba ogún ni Israeli bi?
entries.en: They chose new gods; then was war in the gates: was there a shield or spear seen among forty thousand in Israel?

entries.yo: Àiya mi fà si awọn alaṣẹ Israeli, awọn ti nwọn fi tinutinu wá ninu awọn enia: ẹ fi ibukún fun OLUWA.
entries.en: My heart is toward the governors of Israel, that offered themselves willingly among the people. Bless ye the LORD.

entries.yo: Ẹ sọ ọ, ẹnyin ti ngùn kẹtẹkẹtẹ funfun, ẹnyin ti njoko lori ẹni daradara, ati ẹnyin ti nrìn li ọ̀na.
entries.en: Speak, ye that ride on white asses, ye that sit in judgment, and walk by the way.

entries.yo: Li ọ̀na jijìn si ariwo awọn tafàtafa nibiti a gbé nfà omi, nibẹ̀ ni nwọn o gbé sọ iṣẹ ododo OLUWA, ani iṣẹ ododo ijọba rẹ̀ ni Israeli. Nigbana ni awọn enia OLUWA sọkalẹ lọ si ibode.
entries.en: They that are delivered from the noise of archers in the places of drawing water, there shall they rehearse the righteous acts of the LORD, even the righteous acts toward the inhabitants of his villages in Israel: then shall the people of the LORD go down to the gates.

entries.yo: Jí, jí, Debora; Jí, jí, kọ orin: dide, Baraki, ki o si ma kó awọn igbekun rẹ ni igbekun, iwọ ọmọ Abinoamu.
entries.en: Awake, awake, Deborah: awake, awake, utter a song: arise, Barak, and lead thy captivity captive, thou son of Abinoam.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni iyokù ninu awọn ọlọ̀tọ ati awọn enia sọkalẹ; OLUWA sọkalẹ sori awọn alagbara fun mi.
entries.en: Then he made him that remaineth have dominion over the nobles among the people: the LORD made me have dominion over the mighty.

entries.yo: Lati Efraimu ni nwọn ti wá awọn ti gbongbo wọn wà ni Amaleki; lẹhin rẹ, Benjamini, lãrin awọn enia rẹ; lati Makiri ni awọn alaṣẹ ti sọkalẹ wá, ati lati Sebuluni li awọn ẹniti nmú ọ̀pá-oyè lọwọ.
entries.en: Out of Ephraim was there a root of them against Amalek; after thee, Benjamin, among thy people; out of Machir came down governors, and out of Zebulun they that handle the pen of the writer.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ-alade Issakari wà pẹlu Debora; bi Issakari ti ri, bẹ̃ni Baraki; nwọn sure li ẹsẹ̀ lọ si afonifoji na. Ni ipadò Reubeni ni ìgbero pupọ̀ wà.
entries.en: And the princes of Issachar were with Deborah; even Issachar, and also Barak: he was sent on foot into the valley. For the divisions of Reuben there were great thoughts of heart.

entries.yo: Ẽṣe ti iwọ fi joko lãrin agbo-agutan lati ma gbọ́ fere oluṣọ-agutan? Ni ipadò Reubeni ni ìgbero pupọ̀ wà.
entries.en: Why abodest thou among the sheepfolds, to hear the bleatings of the flocks? For the divisions of Reuben there were great searchings of heart.

entries.yo: Gileadi joko loke odò Jordani: ẽṣe ti Dani fi joko ninu ọkọ̀? Aṣeri joko leti okun, o si ngbé ebute rẹ̀.
entries.en: Gilead abode beyond Jordan: and why did Dan remain in ships? Asher continued on the sea shore, and abode in his breaches.

entries.yo: Sebuluni li awọn enia, ti o fi ẹmi wọn wewu ikú, ati Naftali, ni ibi giga pápa.
entries.en: Zebulun and Naphtali were a people that jeoparded their lives unto the death in the high places of the field.

entries.yo: Awọn ọba wá nwọn jà; nigbana li awọn ọba Kenaani jà ni Taanaki leti odò Megiddo: nwọn kò si gbà ère owo.
entries.en: The kings came and fought, then fought the kings of Canaan in Taanach by the waters of Megiddo; they took no gain of money.

entries.yo: Nwọn jà lati ọrun wá, awọn irawọ ni ipa wọn bá Sisera jà.
entries.en: They fought from heaven; the stars in their courses fought against Sisera.

entries.yo: Odò Kiṣoni gbá wọn lọ, odò igbani, odò Kiṣoni. Hã ọkàn mi, ma yan lọ ninu agbara.
entries.en: The river of Kishon swept them away, that ancient river, the river Kishon. O my soul, thou hast trodden down strength.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni patako ẹsẹ̀ ẹṣin kì ilẹ, nitori ire-sisá, iré-sisá awọn alagbara wọn.
entries.en: Then were the horsehoofs broken by the means of the pransings, the pransings of their mighty ones.

entries.yo: Ẹ fi Merosi bú, bẹ̃li angeli OLUWA wi, ẹ fi awọn ara inu rẹ̀ bú ibú kikorò; nitoriti nwọn kò wá si iranlọwọ OLUWA, si iranlọwọ OLUWA si awọn alagbara.
entries.en: Curse ye Meroz, said the angel of the LORD, curse ye bitterly the inhabitants thereof; because they came not to the help of the LORD, to the help of the LORD against the mighty.

entries.yo: Ibukún ni fun Jaeli aya Heberi ọmọ Keni jù awọn obinrin lọ, ibukún ni fun u jù awọn obinrin lọ ninu agọ́.
entries.en: Blessed above women shall Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite be, blessed shall she be above women in the tent.

entries.yo: O bère omi, o fun u ni warà; o mu ori-amọ tọ̀ ọ wá ninu awo iyebiye.
entries.en: He asked water, and she gave him milk; she brought forth butter in a lordly dish.

entries.yo: O nà ọwọ́ rẹ̀ mú iṣo, ati ọwọ́ ọtún rẹ̀ mú òlu awọn ọlọnà; òlu na li o si fi lù Sisera, o gba mọ́ ọ li ori, o si gún o si kàn ẹbati rẹ̀ mọlẹ ṣinṣin.
entries.en: She put her hand to the nail, and her right hand to the workmen's hammer; and with the hammer she smote Sisera, she smote off his head, when she had pierced and stricken through his temples.

entries.yo: Li ẹsẹ̀ rẹ̀ o wolẹ, o ṣubu, o dubulẹ: li ẹsẹ̀ rẹ̀ o wolẹ, o ṣubu: ni ibi ti o gbè wolẹ, nibẹ̀ na li o ṣubu kú.
entries.en: At her feet he bowed, he fell, he lay down: at her feet he bowed, he fell: where he bowed, there he fell down dead.

entries.yo: Iya Sisera nwò oju-ferese, o si kigbe, o kigbe li oju-ferese ọlọnà pe; Ẽṣe ti kẹkẹ́ rẹ̀ fi pẹ bẹ̃ lati dé? Ẽṣe ti ẹsẹ̀ kẹkẹ̀ rẹ̀ fi duro lẹhin?
entries.en: The mother of Sisera looked out at a window, and cried through the lattice, Why is his chariot so long in coming? why tarry the wheels of his chariots?

entries.yo: Awọn obinrin rẹ̀ amoye da a lohùn, ani, on si ti da ara rẹ̀ lohùn pe,
entries.en: Her wise ladies answered her, yea, she returned answer to herself,

entries.yo: Nwọn kò ha ti ri, nwọn kò ha ti pín ikogun bi? fun olukuluku ọkunrin wundia kan tabi meji; fun Sisera ikogun-aṣọ alarabara, ikógun-aṣọ alarabara oniṣẹ-abẹ́rẹ, aṣọ alarabara oniṣẹ-abẹ́rẹ ni ìha mejeji, li ọrùn awọn ti a kó li ogun.
entries.en: Have they not sped? have they not divided the prey; to every man a damsel or two; to Sisera a prey of divers colours, a prey of divers colours of needlework, of divers colours of needlework on both sides, meet for the necks of them that take the spoil?

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni ki o jẹ ki gbogbo awọn ọtá rẹ ki o ṣegbé OLUWA: ṣugbọn jẹ ki awọn ẹniti o fẹ́ ẹ ki o dabi õrùn nigbati o ba yọ ninu agbara rẹ̀. Ilẹ na si simi li ogoji ọdún.
entries.en: So let all thine enemies perish, O LORD: but let them that love him be as the sun when he goeth forth in his might. And the land had rest forty years.

entries.yo: AWỌN ọmọ Israeli si ṣe buburu loju OLUWA: OLUWA si fi wọn lé Midiani lọwọ li ọdún meje.
entries.en: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the LORD: and the LORD delivered them into the hand of Midian seven years.

entries.yo: Ọwọ́ Midiani si le si Israeli: ati nitori Midiani awọn ọmọ Israeli wà ihò wọnni fun ara wọn, ti o wà ninu òke, ati ninu ọgbun, ati ni ibi-agbara wọnni.
entries.en: And the hand of Midian prevailed against Israel: and because of the Midianites the children of Israel made them the dens which are in the mountains, and caves, and strong holds.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, bi Israeli ba gbìn irugbìn, awọn Midiani a si gòke wá, ati awọn Amaleki, ati awọn ọmọ ìha ìla-õrùn; nwọn a si gòke tọ̀ wọn wá;
entries.en: And so it was, when Israel had sown, that the Midianites came up, and the Amalekites, and the children of the east, even they came up against them;

entries.yo: Nwọn a si dótì wọn, nwọn a si run eso ilẹ na, titi iwọ o fi dé Gasa, nwọn ki isi fi onjẹ silẹ ni Israeli, tabi agutan, tabi akọ-malu, tabi kẹtẹkẹtẹ.
entries.en: And they encamped against them, and destroyed the increase of the earth, till thou come unto Gaza, and left no sustenance for Israel, neither sheep, nor ox, nor ass.

entries.yo: Nitoriti nwọn gòke wá ti awọn ti ohunọ̀sin wọn ati agọ́ wọn, nwọn si wá bi eṣú li ọ̀pọlọpọ; awọn ati awọn ibakasiẹ wọn jẹ́ ainiye: nwọn si wọ̀ inu ilẹ na lati jẹ ẹ run.
entries.en: For they came up with their cattle and their tents, and they came as grasshoppers for multitude; for both they and their camels were without number: and they entered into the land to destroy it.

entries.yo: Oju si pọ́n Israeli gidigidi nitori awọn Midiani; awọn ọmọ Israeli si kigbepè OLUWA.
entries.en: And Israel was greatly impoverished because of the Midianites; and the children of Israel cried unto the LORD.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati awọn ọmọ Israeli kigbepè OLUWA nitori awọn Midiani,
entries.en: And it came to pass, when the children of Israel cried unto the LORD because of the Midianites,

entries.yo: OLUWA si rán wolĩ kan si awọn ọmọ Israeli: ẹniti o wi fun wọn pe, Bayi li OLUWA, Ọlọrun Israeli wi, Emi mú nyin gòke ti Egipti wá, mo si mú nyin jade kuro li oko-ẹrú;
entries.en: That the LORD sent a prophet unto the children of Israel, which said unto them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, I brought you up from Egypt, and brought you forth out of the house of bondage;

entries.yo: Emi si gbà nyin li ọwọ́ awọn ara Egipti, ati li ọwọ́ gbogbo awọn ti npọ́n nyin loju, mo si lé wọn kuro niwaju nyin, mo si fi ilẹ wọn fun nyin;
entries.en: And I delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of all that oppressed you, and drave them out from before you, and gave you their land;

entries.yo: Mo si wi fun nyin pe, Emi li OLUWA Ọlọrun nyin; ẹ máṣe bẹ̀ru oriṣa awọn Amori, ilẹ ẹniti ẹnyin ngbé: ṣugbọn ẹnyin kò gbà ohùn mi gbọ́.
entries.en: And I said unto you, I am the LORD your God; fear not the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but ye have not obeyed my voice.

entries.yo: Angeli OLUWA kan si wá, o si joko labẹ igi-oaku kan ti o wà ni Ofra, ti iṣe ti Joaṣi ọmọ Abieseri: Gideoni ọmọ rẹ̀ si npakà nibi ifọnti, lati fi i pamọ́ kuro loju awọn Midiani.
entries.en: And there came an angel of the LORD, and sat under an oak which was in Ophrah, that pertained unto Joash the Abi-ezrite: and his son Gideon threshed wheat by the winepress, to hide it from the Midianites.

entries.yo: Angeli OLUWA na si farahàn a, o si wi fun u pe, OLUWA wà pẹlu rẹ, iwọ ọkunrin alagbara.
entries.en: And the angel of the LORD appeared unto him, and said unto him, The LORD is with thee, thou mighty man of valour.

entries.yo: Gideoni si wi fun u pe, Yẽ oluwa mi, ibaṣepe OLUWA wà pẹlu wa, njẹ ẽṣe ti gbogbo eyi fi bá wa? nibo ni gbogbo iṣẹ-iyanu rẹ̀ ti awọn baba wa ti sọ fun wa gbé wà, wipe, OLUWA kò ha mú wa gòke lati Egipti wá? ṣugbọn nisisiyi OLUWA ti kọ̀ wa silẹ, o si ti fi wa lé Midiani lọwọ.
entries.en: And Gideon said unto him, Oh my Lord, if the LORD be with us, why then is all this befallen us? and where be all his miracles which our fathers told us of, saying, Did not the LORD bring us up from Egypt? but now the LORD hath forsaken us, and delivered us into the hands of the Midianites.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wò o, o si wipe, Lọ ninu agbara rẹ yi, ki iwọ ki ó si gbà Israeli là kuro lọwọ Midiani: Emi kọ ha rán ọ bi?
entries.en: And the LORD looked upon him, and said, Go in this thy might, and thou shalt save Israel from the hand of the Midianites: have not I sent thee?

entries.yo: O si wi fun u pe, Yẽ oluwa mi, ọ̀na wo li emi o fi gbà Israeli là? kiyesi i, talakà ni idile mi ni Manasse, emi li o si jẹ́ ẹni ikẹhin ni ile baba mi.
entries.en: And he said unto him, Oh my Lord, wherewith shall I save Israel? behold, my family is poor in Manasseh, and I am the least in my father's house.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun u pe, Nitõtọ emi o wà pẹlu rẹ, iwọ o si kọlù awọn Midiani bi ọkunrin kan.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto him, Surely I will be with thee, and thou shalt smite the Midianites as one man.

entries.yo: On si wi fun u pe, Bi o ba ṣepe mo ri ore-ọfẹ gbà li oju rẹ, njẹ fi àmi kan hàn mi pe iwọ bá mi sọ̀rọ.
entries.en: And he said unto him, If now I have found grace in thy sight, then shew me a sign that thou talkest with me.

entries.yo: Máṣe lọ kuro nihin, emi bẹ̀ ọ, titi emi o fi tọ̀ ọ wá, ti emi o si fi mú ọrẹ mi fun ọ wá, ati ti emi o si fi gbé e kalẹ niwaju rẹ. On si wipe, Emi o duro titi iwọ o si fi pada wá.
entries.en: Depart not hence, I pray thee, until I come unto thee, and bring forth my present, and set it before thee. And he said, I will tarry until thou come again.

entries.yo: Gideoni si wọ̀ inu ilé lọ, o si pèse ọmọ ewurẹ kan, ati àkara alaiwu ti iyẹfun òṣuwọn efa kan: ẹran na li o fi sinu agbọ̀n, omi rẹ̀ li o si fi sinu ìkoko, o si gbé e jade tọ̀ ọ wá labẹ igi-oaku na, o si gbé e siwaju rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Gideon went in, and made ready a kid, and unleavened cakes of an ephah of flour: the flesh he put in a basket, and he put the broth in a pot, and brought it out unto him under the oak, and presented it.

entries.yo: Angeli Ọlọrun na si wi fun u pe, Mú ẹran na, ati àkara alaiwu na, ki o si fi wọn lé ori okuta yi, ki o si dà omi ẹran na silẹ. On si ṣe bẹ̃.
entries.en: And the angel of God said unto him, Take the flesh and the unleavened cakes, and lay them upon this rock, and pour out the broth. And he did so.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni angeli OLUWA nà ọpá ti o wà li ọwọ rẹ̀, o si fi ori rẹ̀ kàn ẹran na ati àkara alaiwu na; iná si là lati inu okuta na jade, o si jó ẹran na, ati àkara alaiwu; angeli OLUWA na si lọ kuro niwaju rẹ̀.
entries.en: Then the angel of the LORD put forth the end of the staff that was in his hand, and touched the flesh and the unleavened cakes; and there rose up fire out of the rock, and consumed the flesh and the unleavened cakes. Then the angel of the LORD departed out of his sight.

entries.yo: Gideoni si ri pe angeli OLUWA ni; Gideoni si wipe, Mo gbé, OLUWA Ọlọrun! nitoriti emi ri angeli OLUWA li ojukoju.
entries.en: And when Gideon perceived that he was an angel of the LORD, Gideon said, Alas, O Lord GOD! for because I have seen an angel of the LORD face to face.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun u pe, Alafia fun ọ; má ṣe bẹ̀ru: iwọ́ ki yio kú.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto him, Peace be unto thee; fear not: thou shalt not die.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Gideoni mọ pẹpẹ kan nibẹ̀ fun OLUWA, o si pè orukọ rẹ̀ ni Jehofa-ṣalomu: o wà ni Ofra ti awọn Abiesri sibẹ̀ titi di oni.
entries.en: Then Gideon built an altar there unto the LORD, and called it Jehovah-shalom: unto this day it is yet in Ophrah of the Abi-ezrites.

entries.yo: O si ṣe li oru ọjọ́ kanna, li OLUWA wi fun u pe, Mú akọ-malu baba rẹ, ani akọ-malu keji ọlọdún meje, ki o si wó pẹpẹ Baali ti baba rẹ ní lulẹ ki o si bẹ́ igi-oriṣa ti o wà lẹba rẹ̀ lulẹ:
entries.en: And it came to pass the same night, that the LORD said unto him, Take thy father's young bullock, even the second bullock of seven years old, and throw down the altar of Baal that thy father hath, and cut down the grove that is by it:

entries.yo: Ki o si mọ pẹpẹ kan fun OLUWA Ọlọrun rẹ lori ibi agbara yi, bi o ti yẹ, ki o si mú akọ-malu keji, ki o si fi igi-oriṣa ti iwọ bẹ́ lulẹ ru ẹbọ sisun.
entries.en: And build an altar unto the LORD thy God upon the top of this rock, in the ordered place, and take the second bullock, and offer a burnt sacrifice with the wood of the grove which thou shalt cut down.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Gideoni mú ọkunrin mẹwa ninu awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀, o si ṣe bi OLUWA ti sọ fun u: o si ṣe, nitoripe o bẹ̀ru ile baba rẹ̀ ati awọn ọkunrin ilu na, tobẹ̃ ti kò fi le ṣe e li ọsán, ti o si fi ṣe e li oru.
entries.en: Then Gideon took ten men of his servants, and did as the LORD had said unto him: and so it was, because he feared his father's household, and the men of the city, that he could not do it by day, that he did it by night.

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn ọkunrin ilu na si dide ni kùtukutu, si wò o, a ti wó pẹpẹ Baali lulẹ, a si bẹ́ igi-oriṣa lulẹ ti o wà lẹba rẹ̀, a si ti pa akọ-malu keji rubọ lori pẹpẹ ti a mọ.
entries.en: And when the men of the city arose early in the morning, behold, the altar of Baal was cast down, and the grove was cut down that was by it, and the second bullock was offered upon the altar that was built.

entries.yo: Nwọn si sọ fun ara wọn pe, Tali o ṣe nkan yi? Nigbati nwọn tọ̀sẹ̀, ti nwọn si bère, nwọn si wipe, Gideoni ọmọ Joaṣi li o ṣe nkan yi.
entries.en: And they said one to another, Who hath done this thing? And when they inquired and asked, they said, Gideon the son of Joash hath done this thing.

entries.yo: Nigbana li awọn ọkunrin ilu na wi fun Joaṣi pe, Mú ọmọ rẹ jade wá ki o le kú: nitoripe o wó pẹpẹ Baali lulẹ, ati nitoriti o bẹ́ igi-oriṣa ti o wà lẹba rẹ̀ lulẹ.
entries.en: Then the men of the city said unto Joash, Bring out thy son, that he may die: because he hath cast down the altar of Baal, and because he hath cut down the grove that was by it.

entries.yo: Joaṣi si wi fun gbogbo awọn ti o duro tì i pe, Ẹnyin o gbèja Baali bi? tabi ẹnyin o gbà a là bi? ẹniti o ba ngbèja rẹ̀, ẹ jẹ ki a lù oluwarẹ̀ pa ni kùtukutu owurọ yi: bi on ba ṣe ọlọrun, ẹ jẹ ki o gbèja ara rẹ̀, nitoriti ẹnikan wó pẹpẹ rẹ̀ lulẹ.
entries.en: And Joash said unto all that stood against him, Will ye plead for Baal? will ye save him? he that will plead for him, let him be put to death whilst it is yet morning: if he be a god, let him plead for himself, because one hath cast down his altar.

entries.yo: Nitorina li ọjọ́ na, o pè orukọ rẹ̀ ni Jerubbaali, wipe, Jẹ ki Baali ki o bá a jà, nitoriti o wó pẹpẹ rẹ̀ lulẹ.
entries.en: Therefore on that day he called him Jerubbaal, saying, Let Baal plead against him, because he hath thrown down his altar.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni gbogbo awọn Midiani ati awọn Amaleki, ati awọn ọmọ ìha ìla-õrùn kó ara wọn jọ pọ̀; nwọn rekọja, nwọn si dó li afonifoji Jesreeli.
entries.en: Then all the Midianites and the Amalekites and the children of the east were gathered together, and went over, and pitched in the valley of Jezreel.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹmi OLUWA bà lé Gideoni, on si fun ipè; Abieseri si kójọ sẹhin rẹ̀.
entries.en: But the Spirit of the LORD came upon Gideon, and he blew a trumpet; and Abi-ezer was gathered after him.

entries.yo: On si rán onṣẹ si gbogbo Manasse; awọn si kójọ sẹhin rẹ̀ pẹlu: o si rán onṣẹ si Aṣeri, ati si Sebuluni, ati si Naftali; nwọn si gòke wá lati pade wọn.
entries.en: And he sent messengers throughout all Manasseh; who also was gathered after him: and he sent messengers unto Asher, and unto Zebulun, and unto Naphtali; and they came up to meet them.

entries.yo: Gideoni si wi fun Ọlọrun pe, Bi iwọ o ba ti ọwọ́ mi gbà Israeli là, bi iwọ ti wi,
entries.en: And Gideon said unto God, If thou wilt save Israel by mine hand, as thou hast said,

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, emi o fi irun agutan le ilẹ-pakà; bi o ba ṣepe ìri sẹ̀ sara kìki irun nikan, ti gbogbo ilẹ si gbẹ, nigbana li emi o mọ̀ pe iwọ o ti ọwọ́ mi gbà Israeli là, gẹgẹ bi iwọ ti wi.
entries.en: Behold, I will put a fleece of wool in the floor; and if the dew be on the fleece only, and it be dry upon all the earth beside, then shall I know that thou wilt save Israel by mine hand, as thou hast said.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li o si ri: nitoriti on dide ni kùtukutu ijọ́ keji, o si fọ́n irun agutan na, o si fọ́n ìri na kuro lara rẹ̀, ọpọ́n kan si kún fun omi.
entries.en: And it was so: for he rose up early on the morrow, and thrust the fleece together, and wringed the dew out of the fleece, a bowl full of water.

entries.yo: Gideoni si wi fun Ọlọrun pe, Má ṣe jẹ ki ibinu rẹ ki o rú si mi, emi o sọ̀rọ lẹ̃kanṣoṣo yi: emi bẹ̀ ọ, jẹ ki emi ki o fi irun na ṣe idanwò lẹ̃kan yi; jẹ ki irun agutan nikan ki o gbẹ, ṣugbọn ki ìri ki o wà lori gbogbo ilẹ.
entries.en: And Gideon said unto God, Let not thine anger be hot against me, and I will speak but this once: let me prove, I pray thee, but this once with the fleece; let it now be dry only upon the fleece, and upon all the ground let there be dew.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si ṣe bẹ̃ li oru na: nitoriti irun agutan na gbẹ, ìri si wà lori gbogbo ilẹ na.
entries.en: And God did so that night: for it was dry upon the fleece only, and there was dew on all the ground.

entries.yo: NIGBANA ni Jerubbaali, ti iṣe Gideoni, ati gbogbo awọn enia ti o wà pẹlu rẹ̀, dide ni kùtukutu, nwọn si dó lẹba orisun Harodu: ibudó Midiani si wà ni ìha ariwa wọn, nibi òke More, li afonifoji.
entries.en: Then Jerubbaal, who is Gideon, and all the people that were with him, rose up early, and pitched beside the well of Harod: so that the host of the Midianites were on the north side of them, by the hill of Moreh, in the valley.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun Gideoni pe, Awọn enia ti o wà lọdọ rẹ pọ̀ju fun mi lati fi awọn Midiani lé wọn lọwọ, ki Israeli ki o má ba gbé ara wọn ga si mi, pe, Ọwọ́ mi li o gbà mi là.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Gideon, The people that are with thee are too many for me to give the Midianites into their hands, lest Israel vaunt themselves against me, saying, Mine own hand hath saved me.

entries.yo: Njẹ nitorina, lọ kede li etí awọn enia na, wipe, Ẹnikẹni ti o ba nfòya ti ẹ̀ru ba si mbà, ki o pada lati òke Gileadi ki o si lọ. Ẹgbã mọkanla si pada ninu awọn enia na; awọn ti o kù si jẹ́ ẹgba marun.
entries.en: Now therefore go to, proclaim in the ears of the people, saying, Whosoever is fearful and afraid, let him return and depart early from mount Gilead. And there returned of the people twenty and two thousand; and there remained ten thousand.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun Gideoni pe, Awọn enia na pọ̀ju sibẹ̀; mú wọn sọkalẹ wá si odò, nibẹ̀ li emi o gbé dan wọn wò fun ọ: yio si ṣe, ẹniti mo ba wi fun ọ pe, Eyi ni yio bá ọ lọ, on na ni yio bá ọ lọ; ẹnikẹni ti mo ba si wi fun ọ pe, Eyi ki yio bá ọ lọ, on na ni ki yio si bá ọ lọ.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Gideon, The people are yet too many; bring them down unto the water, and I will try them for thee there: and it shall be, that of whom I say unto thee, This shall go with thee, the same shall go with thee; and of whomsoever I say unto thee, This shall not go with thee, the same shall not go.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li o mú awọn enia na wá si odò: OLUWA si wi fun Gideoni pe, Olukuluku ẹniti o ba fi ahọn rẹ̀ lá omi, bi ajá ti ma lá omi, on na ni ki iwọ ki o fi si apakan fun ara rẹ̀; bẹ̃ si li olukuluku ẹniti o kunlẹ li ẽkun rẹ̀ lati mu omi.
entries.en: So he brought down the people unto the water: and the LORD said unto Gideon, Every one that lappeth of the water with his tongue, as a dog lappeth, him shalt thou set by himself; likewise every one that boweth down upon his knees to drink.

entries.yo: Iye awọn ẹniti o lá omi, ti nwọn fi ọwọ́ wọn si ẹnu wọn, jẹ́ ọdunrun ọkunrin: ṣugbọn gbogbo awọn enia iyokù kunlẹ li ẽkun wọn lati mu omi.
entries.en: And the number of them that lapped, putting their hand to their mouth, were three hundred men: but all the rest of the people bowed down upon their knees to drink water.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun Gideoni pe, Nipaṣe ọdunrun ọkunrin wọnyi ti o lá omi li emi o gbà nyin, emi o si fi awọn Midiani lé ọ lọwọ: jẹ ki gbogbo awọn iyokù lọ olukuluku si ipò rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Gideon, By the three hundred men that lapped will I save you, and deliver the Midianites into thine hand: and let all the other people go every man unto his place.

entries.yo: Awọn enia na si mu onjẹ ati ipè li ọwọ́ wọn: on si rán gbogbo Israeli lọ, olukuluku sinu agọ́ rẹ̀, o si da ọdunrun ọkunrin nì duro: ibudó Midiani si wà nisalẹ rẹ̀ li afonifoji.
entries.en: So the people took victuals in their hand, and their trumpets: and he sent all the rest of Israel every man unto his tent, and retained those three hundred men: and the host of Midian was beneath him in the valley.

entries.yo: O si ṣe li oru na, ni OLUWA wi fun u pe, Dide, sọkalẹ lọ si ibudó; nitoriti mo ti fi i lé ọ lọwọ.
entries.en: And it came to pass the same night, that the LORD said unto him, Arise, get thee down unto the host; for I have delivered it into thine hand.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi iwọ ba mbẹ̀ru lati sọkalẹ lọ, ki iwọ ati Pura iranṣẹ rẹ sọkalẹ lọ si ibudo:
entries.en: But if thou fear to go down, go thou with Phurah thy servant down to the host:

entries.yo: Iwọ o si gbọ́ ohun ti nwọn nwi; lẹhin eyi ni ọwọ́ rẹ yio lí agbara lati sọkalẹ lọ si ibudó. Nigbana ni ti on ti Pura iranṣẹ rẹ̀ sọkalẹ lọ si ìha opin awọn ti o hamora, ti o wà ni ibudó.
entries.en: And thou shalt hear what they say; and afterward shall thine hands be strengthened to go down unto the host. Then went he down with Phurah his servant unto the outside of the armed men that were in the host.

entries.yo: Awọn Midiani ati awọn Amaleki, ati gbogbo awọn ọmọ ìha ìla-õrùn tò lọ titi li afonifoji gẹgẹ bi eṣú li ọ̀pọlọpọ; ibakasiẹ wọn kò si ní iye, bi iyanrin ti mbẹ leti okun li ọ̀pọlọpọ.
entries.en: And the Midianites and the Amalekites and all the children of the east lay along in the valley like grasshoppers for multitude; and their camels were without number, as the sand by the sea side for multitude.

entries.yo: Nigbati Gideoni si dé, kiyesi i, ọkunrin kan nrọ́ alá fun ẹnikeji rẹ̀, o si wipe, Kiyesi i, emi lá alá kan, si wò o, àkara ọkà-barle kan ṣubu si ibudó Midiani, o si bọ́ sinu agọ́ kan, o si kọlù u tobẹ̃ ti o fi ṣubu, o si doju rẹ̀ de, agọ́ na si ṣubu.
entries.en: And when Gideon was come, behold, there was a man that told a dream unto his fellow, and said, Behold, I dreamed a dream, and, lo, a cake of barley bread tumbled into the host of Midian, and came unto a tent, and smote it that it fell, and overturned it, that the tent lay along.

entries.yo: Ekeji rẹ̀ si da a lohùn, wipe, Eyiyi ki iṣe ohun miran bikoṣe idà Gideoni ọmọ Joaṣi, ọkunrin kan ni Israeli: nitoripe Ọlọrun ti fi Midiani ati gbogbo ibudo lé e lọwọ.
entries.en: And his fellow answered and said, This is nothing else save the sword of Gideon the son of Joash, a man of Israel: for into his hand hath God delivered Midian, and all the host.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati Gideoni gbọ́ rirọ́ alá na, ati itumọ̀ rẹ̀, o tẹriba; o si pada si ibudó Israeli, o si wipe, Ẹ dide; nitoriti OLUWA ti fi ogun Midiani lé nyin lọwọ.
entries.en: And it was so, when Gideon heard the telling of the dream, and the interpretation thereof, that he worshipped, and returned into the host of Israel, and said, Arise; for the LORD hath delivered into your hand the host of Midian.

entries.yo: On si pín ọdunrun ọkunrin na si ẹgbẹ mẹta, o si fi ipè lé olukuluku wọn lọwọ, pẹlu ìṣa ofo, òtufu si wà ninu awọn ìṣa na.
entries.en: And he divided the three hundred men into three companies, and he put a trumpet in every man's hand, with empty pitchers, and lamps within the pitchers.

entries.yo: On si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ wò mi, ki ẹnyin ki o si ṣe bẹ̃ gẹgẹ: si kiyesi i, nigbati mo ba dé opin ibudó na, yio si ṣe bi emi ba ti ṣe, bẹ̃ni ki ẹnyin ki o ṣe.
entries.en: And he said unto them, Look on me, and do likewise: and, behold, when I come to the outside of the camp, it shall be that, as I do, so shall ye do.

entries.yo: Nigbati mo ba fun ìpe, emi ati gbogbo awọn ti mbẹ lọdọ mi, nigbana ni ki ẹnyin pẹlu ki o fun ìpe yiká gbogbo ibudó na, ki ẹnyin ki o si wi pe, Fun OLUWA, ati fun Gideoni.
entries.en: When I blow with a trumpet, I and all that are with me, then blow ye the trumpets also on every side of all the camp, and say, The sword of the LORD, and of Gideon.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Gideoni, ati ọgọrun ọkunrin ti mbẹ lọdọ rẹ̀, wá si opin ibudó, ni ibẹ̀rẹ iṣọ́ ãrin, nigbati nwọn ṣẹṣẹ yàn iṣọ́ sode: nwọn fun ipè, nwọn si fọ́ ìṣa ti o wà li ọwọ́ wọn.
entries.en: So Gideon, and the hundred men that were with him, came unto the outside of the camp in the beginning of the middle watch; and they had but newly set the watch: and they blew the trumpets, and brake the pitchers that were in their hands.

entries.yo: Ẹgbẹ mẹtẹta na si fun ipè wọn, nwọn si fọ́ ìṣa wọn, nwọn si mú awọn òtufu li ọwọ́ òsi wọn, ati ipè li ọwọ́ ọtún lati fun: nwọn si kigbe li ohùn rara pe, Idà OLUWA, ati ti Gideoni.
entries.en: And the three companies blew the trumpets, and brake the pitchers, and held the lamps in their left hands, and the trumpets in their right hands to blow withal: and they cried, The sword of the LORD, and of Gideon.

entries.yo: Olukuluku ọkunrin si duro ni ipò rẹ̀ yi ibudó na ká: gbogbo ogun na si sure, nwọn si kigbe, nwọn si sá.
entries.en: And they stood every man in his place round about the camp: and all the host ran, and cried, and fled.

entries.yo: Awọn ọkunrin na fun ọdunrun ipè, OLUWA si yí idà olukuluku si ẹnikeji rẹ̀, ati si gbogbo ogun na: ogun na si sá titi dé Beti-ṣita ni ìha Serera, dé àgbegbe Abeli-mehola, leti Tabati.
entries.en: And the three hundred blew the trumpets, and the LORD set every man's sword against his fellow, even throughout all the host: and the host fled to Beth-shittah in Zererath, and to the border of Abel-meholah, unto Tabbath.

entries.yo: Awọn ọkunrin Israeli si kó ara wọn jọ lati Naftali, ati lati Aṣeri ati lati gbogbo Manasse wá, nwọn si lepa awọn Midiani.
entries.en: And the men of Israel gathered themselves together out of Naphtali, and out of Asher, and out of all Manasseh, and pursued after the Midianites.
