entries.yo: Gideoni si rán onṣẹ lọ si gbogbo òke Efraimu, wipe, Ẹ sọkalẹ wá pade awọn Midiani, ki ẹ si tète gbà omi wọnni dé Beti-bara ani Jordani. Nigbana ni gbogbo awọn ọkunrin Efraimu kó ara wọn jọ, nwọn si gbà omi wọnni, titi dé Beti-bara ani Jordani.
entries.en: And Gideon sent messengers throughout all mount Ephraim, saying, Come down against the Midianites, and take before them the waters unto Beth-barah and Jordan. Then all the men of Ephraim gathered themselves together, and took the waters unto Beth-barah and Jordan.

entries.yo: Nwọn si mú meji ninu awọn ọmọ-alade Midiani, Orebu ati Seebu; Orebu ni nwọn si pa lori apata Orebu, ati Seebu ni nwọn si pa ni ibi-ifọnti Seebu, nwọn si lepa awọn ara Midiani, nwọn si mú ori Orebu ati Seebu wá fi fun Gideoni li apa keji odò Jordani.
entries.en: And they took two princes of the Midianites, Oreb and Zeeb; and they slew Oreb upon the rock Oreb, and Zeeb they slew at the winepress of Zeeb, and pursued Midian, and brought the heads of Oreb and Zeeb to Gideon on the other side Jordan.

entries.yo: AWỌN ọkunrin Efraimu si wi fun u pe, Kili eyiti iwọ ṣe si wa bayi, ti iwọ kò fi pè wa, nigbati iwọ nlọ bá awọn ara Midiani jà? Nwọn si bá a sọ̀ gidigidi.
entries.en: And the men of Ephraim said unto him, Why hast thou served us thus, that thou calledst us not, when thou wentest to fight with the Midianites? And they did chide with him sharply.

entries.yo: On si wi fun wọn pe, Kini mo ha ṣe nisisiyi ti a le fiwe ti nyin? Ẽṣẹ́ àjara Efraimu kò ha san jù ikore-àjara Abieseri lọ?
entries.en: And he said unto them, What have I done now in comparison of you? Is not the gleaning of the grapes of Ephraim better than the vintage of Abi-ezer?

entries.yo: Ọlọrun sá ti fi awọn ọmọ-alade Midiani lé nyin lọwọ, Orebu ati Seebu: kini mo si le ṣe bi nyin? Nigbana ni inu wọn tutù si i, nigbati o ti wi eyinì.
entries.en: God hath delivered into your hands the princes of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb: and what was I able to do in comparison of you? Then their anger was abated toward him, when he had said that.

entries.yo: Gideoni si dé odò Jordani, o si rekọja, on ati ọdunrun ọkunrin ti o wà lọdọ rẹ̀, o di ãrẹ, ṣugbọn nwọn nlepa sibẹ̀.
entries.en: And Gideon came to Jordan, and passed over, he, and the three hundred men that were with him, faint, yet pursuing them.

entries.yo: On si wi fun awọn ọkunrin Sukkotu pe, Emi bẹ̀ nyin, ẹ fi ìṣu-àkara melokan fun awọn enia wọnyi ti ntọ̀ mi lẹhin: nitoriti o di ãrẹ fun wọn, emi si nlepa Seba ati Salmunna, awọn ọba Midiani.
entries.en: And he said unto the men of Succoth, Give, I pray you, loaves of bread unto the people that follow me; for they be faint, and I am pursuing after Zebah and Zalmunna, kings of Midian.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ-alade Sukkotu si wi pe, ọwọ́ rẹ ha ti ítẹ Seba on Salmunna na, ti awa o fi fun awọn ogun rẹ li onjẹ?
entries.en: And the princes of Succoth said, Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in thine hand, that we should give bread unto thine army?

entries.yo: Gideoni si wipe, Nitorina nigbati OLUWA ba fi Seba ati Salmunna lé mi lọwọ, nigbana li emi o fi ẹgún ijù, ati oṣuṣu yà ẹran ara nyin.
entries.en: And Gideon said, Therefore when the LORD hath delivered Zebah and Zalmunna into mine hand, then I will tear your flesh with the thorns of the wilderness and with briers.

entries.yo: On si gòke lati ibẹ̀ lọ si Penueli, o si sọ fun wọn bẹ̃ gẹgẹ: awọn ọkunrin Penueli si da a lohùn gẹgẹ bi awọn ara Sukkotu si ti da a lohùn.
entries.en: And he went up thence to Penuel, and spake unto them likewise: and the men of Penuel answered him as the men of Succoth had answered him.

entries.yo: On si wi fun awọn ọkunrin Penueli pẹlu pe, Nigbati mo ba pada dé li alafia, emi o wó ile-ẹṣọ́ yi lulẹ̀.
entries.en: And he spake also unto the men of Penuel, saying, When I come again in peace, I will break down this tower.

entries.yo: Njẹ Seba ati Salmunna wà ni Karkori, ogun wọn si wà pẹlu wọn, o to ìwọn ẹdẹgbajọ ọkunrin, iye awọn ti o kù ninu gbogbo ogun awọn ọmọ ìha ìla-õrùn: nitoripe ẹgba ọgọta ọkunrin ti o lo idà ti ṣubu.
entries.en: Now Zebah and Zalmunna were in Karkor, and their hosts with them, about fifteen thousand men, all that were left of all the hosts of the children of the east: for there fell an hundred and twenty thousand men that drew sword.

entries.yo: Gideoni si gbà ọ̀na awọn ti ngbé inú agọ́ ni ìha ìla-õrùn Noba ati Jogbeha gòke lọ, o si kọlù ogun na; nitoriti ogun na ti sọranù.
entries.en: And Gideon went up by the way of them that dwelt in tents on the east of Nobah and Jogbehah, and smote the host: for the host was secure.

entries.yo: Seba ati Salmunna si sá; on si lepa wọn; o si mù awọn ọba Midiani mejeji na, Seba ati Salmunna, o si damu gbogbo ogun na.
entries.en: And when Zebah and Zalmunna fled, he pursued after them, and took the two kings of Midian, Zebah and Zalmunna, and discomfited all the host.

entries.yo: Gideoni ọmọ Joaṣi si pada lẹhin ogun na, ni ibi ati gòke Heresi.
entries.en: And Gideon the son of Joash returned from battle before the sun was up,

entries.yo: O si mú ọmọkunrin kan ninu awọn ọkunrin Sukkotu, o si bère lọwọ rẹ̀: on si ṣe apẹrẹ awọn ọmọ-alade Sukkotu fun u, ati awọn àgba ti o wà nibẹ̀, mẹtadilọgọrin ọkunrin.
entries.en: And caught a young man of the men of Succoth, and inquired of him: and he described unto him the princes of Succoth, and the elders thereof, even threescore and seventeen men.

entries.yo: On si tọ̀ awọn ọkunrin Sukkotu na wá, o si wi fun wọn pe, Wò Seba ati Salmunna, nitori awọn ẹniti ẹnyin fi gàn mi pe, Ọwọ́ rẹ ha ti tẹ Seba ati Salmunna na, ti awa o fi fun awọn ọkunrin rẹ ti ãrẹ mu li onjẹ?
entries.en: And he came unto the men of Succoth, and said, Behold Zebah and Zalmunna, with whom ye did upbraid me, saying, Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in thine hand, that we should give bread unto thy men that are weary?

entries.yo: On si mú awọn àgbagba ilu na, ati ẹgún ijù ati oṣuṣu, o si fi kọ́ awọn ọkunrin Sukkotu li ọgbọ́n.
entries.en: And he took the elders of the city, and thorns of the wilderness and briers, and with them he taught the men of Succoth.

entries.yo: On si wó ile-ẹṣọ́ Penueli, o si pa awọn ọkunrin ilu na.
entries.en: And he beat down the tower of Penuel, and slew the men of the city.

entries.yo: Nigbana li o sọ fun Seba ati Salmunna, wipe, Irú ọkunrin wo li awọn ẹniti ẹnyin pa ni Taboru? Nwọn si dahùn, Bi iwọ ti ri, bẹ̃ni nwọn ri; olukuluku nwọn dabi awọn ọmọ ọba.
entries.en: Then said he unto Zebah and Zalmunna, What manner of men were they whom ye slew at Tabor? And they answered, As thou art, so were they; each one resembled the children of a king.

entries.yo: On si wipe, Arakunrin mi ni nwọn, ọmọ iya mi ni nwọn iṣe: bi OLUWA ti wà, ibaṣepe ẹnyin da wọn si, emi kì ba ti pa nyin.
entries.en: And he said, They were my brethren, even the sons of my mother: as the LORD liveth, if ye had saved them alive, I would not slay you.

entries.yo: On si wi fun Jeteri arẹmọ rẹ̀ pe, Dide, ki o si pa wọn. Ṣugbọn ọmọkunrin na kò fà idà rẹ̀ yọ: nitori ẹ̀ru bà a, nitoripe ọmọde ni iṣe.
entries.en: And he said unto Jether his firstborn, Up, and slay them. But the youth drew not his sword: for he feared, because he was yet a youth.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Seba ati Salmunna wipe, Iwọ dide, ki o si kọlù wa: nitoripe bi ọkunrin ti ri, bẹ̃li agbara rẹ̀ ri. Gideoni si dide, o si pa Seba ati Salmunna, o si bọ́ ohun ọṣọ́ wọnni kuro li ọrùn ibakasiẹ wọn.
entries.en: Then Zebah and Zalmunna said, Rise thou, and fall upon us: for as the man is, so is his strength. And Gideon arose, and slew Zebah and Zalmunna, and took away the ornaments that were on their camels' necks.

entries.yo: Nigbana li awọn ọkunrin Israeli wi fun Gideoni pe, Iwọ ma ṣe olori wa, iwọ, ati ọmọ rẹ, ati ọmọ ọmọ rẹ pẹlu: nitoripe o gbà wa lọwọ awọn ara Midiani.
entries.en: Then the men of Israel said unto Gideon, Rule thou over us, both thou, and thy son, and thy son's son also: for thou hast delivered us from the hand of Midian.

entries.yo: Gideoni si wi fun wọn pe, Emi ki yio ṣe olori nyin, bẹ̃ni ọmọ mi ki yio ṣe olori nyin: OLUWA ni yio ma ṣe alaṣẹ nyin.
entries.en: And Gideon said unto them, I will not rule over you, neither shall my son rule over you: the LORD shall rule over you.

entries.yo: Gideoni si wi fun wọn pe, Emi o bère nkan lọwọ nyin, pe ki olukuluku nyin ki o le fi oruka-etí ti mbẹ ninu ikogun rẹ̀ fun mi. (Nitoriti nwọn ní oruka-etí ti wurà, nitoripe ọmọ Iṣmaeli ni nwọn iṣe.)
entries.en: And Gideon said unto them, I would desire a request of you, that ye would give me every man the earrings of his prey. (For they had golden earrings, because they were Ishmaelites.)

entries.yo: Nwọn si dahùn wipe, Tinutinu li awa o fi mú wọn wá. Nwọn si tẹ́ aṣọ kan, olukuluku nwọn si sọ oruka-etí ikogun rẹ̀ si i.
entries.en: And they answered, We will willingly give them. And they spread a garment, and did cast therein every man the earrings of his prey.

entries.yo: Ìwọn oruka-etí wurà na ti o bère lọwọ wọn jẹ́ ẹdẹgbẹsan ṣekeli wurà: làika ohun ọṣọ́ wọnni, ati ohun sisorọ̀, ati aṣọ elesè-àluko ti o wà lara awọn ọba Midiani, ati li àika ẹ̀wọn ti o wà li ọrùn ibakasiẹ wọn.
entries.en: And the weight of the golden earrings that he requested was a thousand and seven hundred shekels of gold; beside ornaments, and collars, and purple raiment that was on the kings of Midian, and beside the chains that were about their camels' necks.

entries.yo: Gideoni si fi i ṣe ẹ̀wu-efodu kan, o si fi i si ilu rẹ̀, ni Ofra: gbogbo Israeli si ṣe àgbere tọ̀ ọ lẹhin nibẹ̀: o si wa di idẹkun fun Gideoni, ati fun ile rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Gideon made an ephod thereof, and put it in his city, even in Ophrah: and all Israel went thither a whoring after it: which thing became a snare unto Gideon, and to his house.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li a si tẹ̀ ori Midiani ba niwaju awọn ọmọ Israeli, nwọn kò si gbé ori wọn soke mọ́. Ilẹ na si simi ni ogoji ọdún li ọjọ́ Gideoni.
entries.en: Thus was Midian subdued before the children of Israel, so that they lifted up their heads no more. And the country was in quietness forty years in the days of Gideon.

entries.yo: Jerubbaali ọmọ Joaṣi si lọ o si ngbe ile rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Jerubbaal the son of Joash went and dwelt in his own house.

entries.yo: Gideoni si ní ãdọrin ọmọkunrin ti o bi fun ara rẹ̀: nitoripe o lí obinrin pupọ̀.
entries.en: And Gideon had threescore and ten sons of his body begotten: for he had many wives.

entries.yo: Ale rẹ̀ ti o wà ni Ṣekemu, on pẹlu bi ọmọkunrin kan fun u, orukọ ẹniti a npè ni Abimeleki.
entries.en: And his concubine that was in Shechem, she also bare him a son, whose name he called Abimelech.

entries.yo: Gideoni ọmọ Joaṣi si kú li ọjọ́ ogbó, a si sin i si ibojì Joaṣi baba rẹ̀, ni Ofra ti awọn Abieseri.
entries.en: And Gideon the son of Joash died in a good old age, and was buried in the sepulchre of Joash his father, in Ophrah of the Abi-ezrites.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, lojukanna ti Gideoni kú, li awọn ọmọ Israeli pada, nwọn si ṣe panṣaga tọ̀ Baalimu lọ, nwọn si fi Baaliberiti ṣe oriṣa wọn.
entries.en: And it came to pass, as soon as Gideon was dead, that the children of Israel turned again, and went a whoring after Baalim, and made Baal-berith their god.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Israeli kò si ranti OLUWA Ọlọrun wọn, ẹniti o gbà wọn lọwọ gbogbo awọn ọtá wọn ni ìha gbogbo:
entries.en: And the children of Israel remembered not the LORD their God, who had delivered them out of the hands of all their enemies on every side:

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni nwọn kò si ṣe ore fun ile Jerubbaali, ti iṣe Gideoni, gẹgẹ bi gbogbo ire ti o ti ṣe fun Israeli.
entries.en: Neither shewed they kindness to the house of Jerubbaal, namely, Gideon, according to all the goodness which he had shewed unto Israel.

entries.yo: ABIMELEKI ọmọ Jerubbaali si lọ si Ṣekemu sọdọ awọn arakunrin iya rẹ̀, o si bá wọn sọ̀rọ, ati gbogbo idile ile baba iya rẹ̀, wipe,
entries.en: And Abimelech the son of Jerubbaal went to Shechem unto his mother's brethren, and communed with them, and with all the family of the house of his mother's father, saying,

entries.yo: Emi bẹ̀ nyin, ẹ sọ li etí gbogbo awọn ọkunrin Ṣekemu pe, Ẽwo li o rọ̀run fun nyin, ki gbogbo awọn ọmọ Jerubbaali, ãdọrin enia, ki o ṣe olori nyin, tabi ki ẹnikan ki o ṣe olori nyin? ki ẹnyin ki o ranti pẹlu pe, emi li egungun nyin, ati ẹran ara nyin.
entries.en: Speak, I pray you, in the ears of all the men of Shechem, Whether is better for you, either that all the sons of Jerubbaal, which are threescore and ten persons, reign over you, or that one reign over you? remember also that I am your bone and your flesh.

entries.yo: Awọn arakunrin iya rẹ̀ si sọ gbogbo ọ̀rọ wọnyi nitori rẹ̀ li etí gbogbo awọn ọkunrin Ṣekemu: àiya wọn si tẹ̀ si ti Abimeleki; nitori nwọn wipe, Arakunrin wa ni iṣe.
entries.en: And his mother's brethren spake of him in the ears of all the men of Shechem all these words: and their hearts inclined to follow Abimelech; for they said, He is our brother.

entries.yo: Nwọn si fun u li ãdọrin owo fadakà lati inu ile Baali-beriti wá, Abimeleki si fi i bẹ̀ awọn enia lasan ati alainilari li ọ̀wẹ, nwọn si ntẹ̀le e.
entries.en: And they gave him threescore and ten pieces of silver out of the house of Baal-berith, wherewith Abimelech hired vain and light persons, which followed him.

entries.yo: On si lọ si ile baba rẹ̀ ni Ofra, o si pa awọn arakunrin rẹ̀ awọn ọmọ Jerubbaali, ãdọrin enia, lori okuta kan: ṣugbọn o kù Jotamu abikẹhin ọmọ Jerubbaali; nitoriti o sapamọ́.
entries.en: And he went unto his father's house at Ophrah, and slew his brethren the sons of Jerubbaal, being threescore and ten persons, upon one stone: notwithstanding yet Jotham the youngest son of Jerubbaal was left; for he hid himself.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn ọkunrin Ṣekemu si kó ara wọn jọ, ati gbogbo awọn ara ile Millo, nwọn lọ nwọn si fi Abimeleki jẹ́ ọba, ni ibi igi-oaku ile-ẹṣọ́ ti mbẹ ni Ṣekemu.
entries.en: And all the men of Shechem gathered together, and all the house of Millo, and went, and made Abimelech king, by the plain of the pillar that was in Shechem.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si sọ fun Jotamu, on si lọ o si duro lori òke Gerisimu, o si gbé ohùn rẹ̀ soke, o kigbe, o si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ fetisi ti emi, ẹnyin ọkunrin Ṣekemu, ki Ọlọrun ki o le fetisi ti nyin.
entries.en: And when they told it to Jotham, he went and stood in the top of mount Gerizim, and lifted up his voice, and cried, and said unto them, Hearken unto me, ye men of Shechem, that God may hearken unto you.

entries.yo: Awọn igi lọ li akokò kan ki nwọn ki o le fi ọba jẹ́ lori wọn; nwọn si wi fun igi olifi pe, Wá jọba lori wa.
entries.en: The trees went forth on a time to anoint a king over them; and they said unto the olive tree, Reign thou over us.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn igi olifi wi fun wọn pe, Emi ha le fi ọrá mi silẹ, nipa eyiti nwọn nfi mi bù ọlá fun Ọlọrun ati enia, ki emi ki o si wá ṣe olori igi?
entries.en: But the olive tree said unto them, Should I leave my fatness, wherewith by me they honour God and man, and go to be promoted over the trees?

entries.yo: Awọn igi si wi fun igi ọpọtọ́ pe, Iwọ wá jọba lori wa.
entries.en: And the trees said to the fig tree, Come thou, and reign over us.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn igi ọpọtọ́ wi fun wọn pe, Emi le fi adùn mi silẹ, ati eso mi daradara, ki emi ki o si wá ṣe olori awọn igi?
entries.en: But the fig tree said unto them, Should I forsake my sweetness, and my good fruit, and go to be promoted over the trees?

entries.yo: Awọn igi si wi fun àjara pe, Iwọ wá jọba lori wa.
entries.en: Then said the trees unto the vine, Come thou, and reign over us.

entries.yo: Àjara si wi fun wọn pe, Ki emi ki o fi ọti-waini mi silẹ, eyiti nmu inu Ọlọrun ati enia dùn, ki emi ki o si wá ṣe olori awọn igi?
entries.en: And the vine said unto them, Should I leave my wine, which cheereth God and man, and go to be promoted over the trees?

entries.yo: Nigbana ni gbogbo igi si wi fun igi-ẹgún pe, Iwọ wá jọba lori wa.
entries.en: Then said all the trees unto the bramble, Come thou, and reign over us.

entries.yo: Igi-ẹgún si wi fun awọn igi pe, Bi o ba ṣepe nitõtọ li ẹnyin fi emi jẹ́ ọba lori nyin, njẹ ẹ wá sá si abẹ ojiji mi: bi kò ba si ṣe bẹ̃, jẹ ki iná ki o ti inu igi-ẹgún jade wá, ki o si jó awọn igi-kedari ti Lebanoni run.
entries.en: And the bramble said unto the trees, If in truth ye anoint me king over you, then come and put your trust in my shadow: and if not, let fire come out of the bramble, and devour the cedars of Lebanon.

entries.yo: Njẹ nitorina, bi ẹnyin ba ṣe otitọ, ati eyiti o pé, ni ti ẹnyin fi Abimeleki jẹ ọba, ati bi ẹnyin ba si ṣe rere si Jerubbaali ati si ile rẹ̀, ti ẹnyin si ṣe si i gẹgẹ bi iṣẹ́ ọwọ́ rẹ̀;
entries.en: Now therefore, if ye have done truly and sincerely, in that ye have made Abimelech king, and if ye have dealt well with Jerubbaal and his house, and have done unto him according to the deserving of his hands;

entries.yo: (Nitoriti baba mi jà fun nyin, o si fi ẹmi rẹ̀ wewu, o si gbà nyin kuro li ọwọ Midiani:
entries.en: (For my father fought for you, and adventured his life far, and delivered you out of the hand of Midian:

entries.yo: Ẹnyin si dide si ile baba mi li oni, ẹnyin si pa awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ ọkunrin, ãdọrin enia, lori okuta kan, ẹnyin si fi Abimeleki, ọmọ iranṣẹbinrin rẹ̀ jẹ́ ọba lori awọn Ṣekemu, nitoriti arakunrin nyin ni iṣe;)
entries.en: And ye are risen up against my father's house this day, and have slain his sons, threescore and ten persons, upon one stone, and have made Abimelech, the son of his maidservant, king over the men of Shechem, because he is your brother;)

entries.yo: Njẹ bi ẹnyin ba ṣe otitọ, ati eyiti o pé si Jerubbaali ati si ile rẹ̀ li oni yi, njẹ ki ẹnyin ki o ma yọ̀ si Abimeleki, ki on pẹlu si ma yọ̀ si nyin:
entries.en: If ye then have dealt truly and sincerely with Jerubbaal and with his house this day, then rejoice ye in Abimelech, and let him also rejoice in you:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi kò ba si ri bẹ̃, jẹ ki iná ki o ti ọdọ Abimeleki jade wá, ki o si jó awọn ọkunrin Ṣekemu run, ati ile Millò: jẹ ki iná ki o si ti ọdọ awọn ọkunrin Ṣekemu ati ile Millo jade wá, ki o si jó Abimeleki run.
entries.en: But if not, let fire come out from Abimelech, and devour the men of Shechem, and the house of Millo; and let fire come out from the men of Shechem, and from the house of Millo, and devour Abimelech.

entries.yo: Jotamu si ṣí, o sálọ, o si lọ si Beeri, o si joko sibẹ̀, nitori ìbẹru Abimeleki arakunrin rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Jotham ran away, and fled, and went to Beer, and dwelt there, for fear of Abimelech his brother.

entries.yo: Abimeleki sí ṣe olori awọn ọmọ Israeli li ọdún mẹta.
entries.en: When Abimelech had reigned three years over Israel,

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si rán ẹmi buburu sãrin Abimeleki ati awọn ọkunrin Ṣekemu; awọn ọkunrin Ṣekemu si fi arekereke bá Abimeleki lò:
entries.en: Then God sent an evil spirit between Abimelech and the men of Shechem; and the men of Shechem dealt treacherously with Abimelech:

entries.yo: Ki ìwa-ìka ti a ti hù si awọn ãdọrin ọmọ Jerubbaali ki o le wá, ati ẹ̀jẹ wọn sori Abimeleki arakunrin wọn, ẹniti o pa wọn; ati sori awọn ọkunrin Ṣekemu, awọn ẹniti o ràn a lọwọ lati pa awọn arakunrin rẹ̀.
entries.en: That the cruelty done to the threescore and ten sons of Jerubbaal might come, and their blood be laid upon Abimelech their brother, which slew them; and upon the men of Shechem, which aided him in the killing of his brethren.

entries.yo: Awọn ọkunrin Ṣekemu si yàn awọn enia ti o ba dè e lori òke, gbogbo awọn ti nkọja lọdọ wọn ni nwọn si njà a li ole: nwọn si sọ fun Abimeleki.
entries.en: And the men of Shechem set liers in wait for him in the top of the mountains, and they robbed all that came along that way by them: and it was told Abimelech.

entries.yo: Gaali ọmọ Ebedi si wá ti on ti awọn arakunrin rẹ̀, nwọn si kọja lọ si Ṣekemu: awọn ọkunrin Ṣekemu si gbẹkẹ wọn le e.
entries.en: And Gaal the son of Ebed came with his brethren, and went over to Shechem: and the men of Shechem put their confidence in him.

entries.yo: Nwọn si jade lọ si oko, nwọn si ká eso-àjara wọn, nwọn si fọ́n eso na, nwọn si nṣe ariya, nwọn si lọ si ile oriṣa wọn, nwọn si jẹ, nwọn si mu, nwọn si fi Abimeleki ré.
entries.en: And they went out into the fields, and gathered their vineyards, and trode the grapes, and made merry, and went into the house of their god, and did eat and drink, and cursed Abimelech.

entries.yo: Gaali ọmọ Ebedi si wipe, Tani Abimeleki? ta si ni Ṣekemu, ti awa o fi ma sìn i? Ṣe ọmọ Jerubbaali ni iṣe? ati Sebulu ijoye rẹ̀? ẹ mã sìn awọn ọkunrin Hamoru baba Ṣekemu: ṣugbọn nitori kili awa o ha ṣe ma sìn on?
entries.en: And Gaal the son of Ebed said, Who is Abimelech, and who is Shechem, that we should serve him? is not he the son of Jerubbaal? and Zebul his officer? serve the men of Hamor the father of Shechem: for why should we serve him?

entries.yo: Awọn enia wọnyi iba wà ni ikawọ mi! nigbana ni emi iba ṣí Abimeleki ni ipò. On si wi fun Abimeleki pe, Gbá ogun kún ogun rẹ, ki o si jade.
entries.en: And would to God this people were under my hand! then would I remove Abimelech. And he said to Abimelech, Increase thine army, and come out.

entries.yo: Nigbati Sebulu alaṣẹ ilu na si gbọ́ ọ̀rọ Gaali ọmọ Ebedi, o binu gidigidi.
entries.en: And when Zebul the ruler of the city heard the words of Gaal the son of Ebed, his anger was kindled.

entries.yo: On si rán awọn onṣẹ ìkọkọ si Abimeleki, wipe, Kiyesi i, Gaali ọmọ Ebedi ati awọn arakunrin rẹ̀ wá si Ṣekemu; si kiyesi i, nwọn rú ilú na sokè si ọ.
entries.en: And he sent messengers unto Abimelech privily, saying, Behold, Gaal the son of Ebed and his brethren be come to Shechem; and, behold, they fortify the city against thee.

entries.yo: Njẹ nitorina, dide li oru, iwọ ati awọn enia ti o wà pẹlu rẹ, ki ẹnyin ki o si ba sinu oko:
entries.en: Now therefore up by night, thou and the people that is with thee, and lie in wait in the field:

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, li owurọ̀, lojukanna bi õrùn ba si ti là, ki iwọ ki o dide ni kùtukutu owurọ̀, ki iwọ ki o si kọlù ilu na: si kiyesi i, nigbati on ati awọn enia ti mbẹ lọdọ rẹ̀ ba jade tọ̀ ọ, nigbana ni ki iwọ ki o ṣe si wọn bi iwọ ba ti ri pe o yẹ.
entries.en: And it shall be, that in the morning, as soon as the sun is up, thou shalt rise early, and set upon the city: and, behold, when he and the people that is with him come out against thee, then mayest thou do to them as thou shalt find occasion.

entries.yo: Abimeleki si dide, ati gbogbo awọn enia ti o wà lọdọ rẹ̀ li oru, nwọn si ba ni ipa mẹrin leti Ṣekemu.
entries.en: And Abimelech rose up, and all the people that were with him, by night, and they laid wait against Shechem in four companies.

entries.yo: Gaali ọmọ Ebedi si jade, o si duro li ẹnu-ọ̀na ibode ilu na: Abimeleki si dide, ati awọn enia ti o wà lọdọ rẹ̀, kuro ni ibùba.
entries.en: And Gaal the son of Ebed went out, and stood in the entering of the gate of the city: and Abimelech rose up, and the people that were with him, from lying in wait.

entries.yo: Nigbati Gaali si ri awọn enia na, o wi fun Sebulu pe, Wò o, awọn enia nti ori òke sọkalẹ wa. Sebulu si wi fun u pe, Ojiji òke wọnni ni iwọ ri bi ẹnipe enia.
entries.en: And when Gaal saw the people, he said to Zebul, Behold, there come people down from the top of the mountains. And Zebul said unto him, Thou seest the shadow of the mountains as if they were men.

entries.yo: Gaali si tun wipe, Wò o, awọn enia nti òke sọkalẹ li agbedemeji ilẹ wá, ẹgbẹ kan si nti ọ̀na igi-oaku Meonenimu wá.
entries.en: And Gaal spake again and said, See there come people down by the middle of the land, and another company come along by the plain of Meonenim.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Sebulu wi fun u pe, Nibo li ẹnu rẹ wà nisisiyi, ti iwọ fi wipe, Tani Abimeleki, ti awa o fi ma sìn i? awọn enia ti iwọ ti gàn kọ́ ni iwọnyi? jọwọ jade lọ, nisisiyi, ki o si bà wọn jà.
entries.en: Then said Zebul unto him, Where is now thy mouth, wherewith thou saidst, Who is Abimelech, that we should serve him? is not this the people that thou hast despised? go out, I pray now, and fight with them.

entries.yo: Gaali si jade niwaju awọn ọkunrin Ṣekemu, o si bá Abimeleki jà.
entries.en: And Gaal went out before the men of Shechem, and fought with Abimelech.

entries.yo: Abimeleki si lé e, on si sá niwaju rẹ̀, ọ̀pọlọpọ ninu nwọn ti o gbọgbẹ si ṣubu, titi dé ẹnu-ọ̀na ibode.
entries.en: And Abimelech chased him, and he fled before him, and many were overthrown and wounded, even unto the entering of the gate.

entries.yo: Abimeleki si joko ni Aruma: Sebulu si tì Gaali ati awọn arakunrin rẹ̀ jade, ki nwọn ki o má ṣe joko ni Ṣekemu.
entries.en: And Abimelech dwelt at Arumah: and Zebul thrust out Gaal and his brethren, that they should not dwell in Shechem.

entries.yo: O si ṣe ni ijọ keji, ti awọn enia si jade lọ sinu oko; nwọn si sọ fun Abimeleki.
entries.en: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the people went out into the field; and they told Abimelech.

entries.yo: On si mu awọn enia, o si pín wọn si ipa mẹta, o si ba ninu oko: o si wò, si kiyesi i, awọn enia nti ilu jade wá; on si dide si wọn, o si kọlù wọn.
entries.en: And he took the people, and divided them into three companies, and laid wait in the field, and looked, and, behold, the people were come forth out of the city; and he rose up against them, and smote them.

entries.yo: Abimeleki, ati ẹgbẹ́ ti o wà lọdọ rẹ̀ sure siwaju, nwọn si duro li ẹnu-ọ̀na ibode ilu na: ẹgbẹ meji si sure si gbogbo awọn enia na ti o wà ninu oko, nwọn si kọlù wọn.
entries.en: And Abimelech, and the company that was with him, rushed forward, and stood in the entering of the gate of the city: and the two other companies ran upon all the people that were in the fields, and slew them.

entries.yo: Abimeleki si bá ilu na jà ni gbogbo ọjọ́ na; on si kó ilu na, o si pa awọn enia ti o wà ninu rẹ̀, o si wó ilu na palẹ, o si fọn iyọ̀ si i.
entries.en: And Abimelech fought against the city all that day; and he took the city, and slew the people that was therein, and beat down the city, and sowed it with salt.

entries.yo: Nigbati gbogbo awọn ọkunrin ile-ẹṣọ́ Ṣekemu gbọ́, nwọn si wọ̀ inu ile-ẹṣọ́ oriṣa Eliberiti lọ.
entries.en: And when all the men of the tower of Shechem heard that, they entered into an hold of the house of the god Berith.

entries.yo: A si sọ fun Abimeleki pe, gbogbo awọn ọkunrin ile-ẹṣọ́ Ṣekemu kó ara wọn jọ pọ̀.
entries.en: And it was told Abimelech, that all the men of the tower of Shechem were gathered together.

entries.yo: Abimeleki si gùn ori òke Salmoni lọ, on ati gbogbo enia ti o wà pẹlu rẹ̀; Abimeleki si mu ãke kan li ọwọ́ rẹ̀, o si ke ẹka kan kuro lara igi, o si mú u, o si gbé e lé èjika rẹ̀, o si wi fun awọn enia ti o wà lọdọ rẹ̀ pe, Ohun ti ẹnyin ri ti emi ṣe, ẹ yára, ki ẹ si ṣe bi emi ti ṣe.
entries.en: And Abimelech gat him up to mount Zalmon, he and all the people that were with him; and Abimelech took an axe in his hand, and cut down a bough from the trees, and took it, and laid it on his shoulder, and said unto the people that were with him, What ye have seen me do, make haste, and do as I have done.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn enia na pẹlu, olukuluku si ke ẹka tirẹ̀, nwọn si ntọ̀ Abimeleki lẹhin, nwọn si fi wọn sinu ile-ẹṣọ́ na, nwọn si tinabọ ile na mọ́ wọn lori, tobẹ̃ ti gbogbo awọn ọkunrin ile-ẹṣọ́ Ṣekemu fi kú pẹlu, ìwọn ẹgbẹrun enia, ọkunrin ati obinrin.
entries.en: And all the people likewise cut down every man his bough, and followed Abimelech, and put them to the hold, and set the hold on fire upon them; so that all the men of the tower of Shechem died also, about a thousand men and women.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Abimeleki lọ si Tebesi, o si dótì Tebesi, o si kó o.
entries.en: Then went Abimelech to Thebez, and encamped against Thebez, and took it.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ile-ẹṣọ́ ti o lagbara wà ninu ilu na, nibẹ̀ ni gbogbo awọn ọkunrin ati awọn obinrin, ati gbogbo awọn ẹniti o wà ni ilu na gbé sá si, nwọn si fara wọn mọ́ ibẹ̀; nwọn si gòke ile-ẹṣọ́ na lọ.
entries.en: But there was a strong tower within the city, and thither fled all the men and women, and all they of the city, and shut it to them, and gat them up to the top of the tower.

entries.yo: Abimeleki si wá si ibi ile-ẹṣọ́ na, o si bá a jà, o si sunmọ ẹnu-ọ̀na ile-ẹṣọ na lati fi iná si i.
entries.en: And Abimelech came unto the tower, and fought against it, and went hard unto the door of the tower to burn it with fire.

entries.yo: Obinrin kan si sọ ọlọ lù Abimeleki li ori, o si fọ́ ọ li agbári.
entries.en: And a certain woman cast a piece of a millstone upon Abimelech's head, and all to brake his skull.

entries.yo: Nigbana li o pè ọmọkunrin ti nrù ihamọra rẹ̀ kánkan, o si wi fun u pe, Fà idà rẹ yọ, ki o si pa mi, ki awọn enia ki o má ba wi nipa ti emi pe, Obinrin li o pa a. Ọmọkunrin rẹ̀ si gún u, bẹ̃li o si kú.
entries.en: Then he called hastily unto the young man his armourbearer, and said unto him, Draw thy sword, and slay me, that men say not of me, A woman slew him. And his young man thrust him through, and he died.

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn ọkunrin Israeli si ri pe, Abimeleki kú, nwọn si lọ olukuluku si ipò rẹ̀.
entries.en: And when the men of Israel saw that Abimelech was dead, they departed every man unto his place.

entries.yo: Bayi li Ọlọrun san ìwa buburu Abimeleki, ti o ti hù si baba rẹ̀, niti pe, o pa ãdọrin awọn arakunrin rẹ̀:
entries.en: Thus God rendered the wickedness of Abimelech, which he did unto his father, in slaying his seventy brethren:

entries.yo: Ati gbogbo ìwa buburu awọn ọkunrin Ṣekemu li Ọlọrun si múpada sori wọn: egún Jotamu ọmọ Jerubbaali si ṣẹ sori wọn.
entries.en: And all the evil of the men of Shechem did God render upon their heads: and upon them came the curse of Jotham the son of Jerubbaal.

entries.yo: LẸHIN Abimeleki li ẹnikan si dide lati gbà Israeli là, Tola ọmọ Pua, ọmọ Dodo, ọkunrin Issakari kan; o si ngbé Ṣamiri li òke Efraimu.
entries.en: And after Abimelech there arose to defend Israel Tola the son of Puah, the son of Dodo, a man of Issachar; and he dwelt in Shamir in mount Ephraim.

entries.yo: On si ṣe idajọ Israeli li ọdún mẹtalelogun o si kú, a si sin i ni Ṣamiri.
entries.en: And he judged Israel twenty and three years, and died, and was buried in Shamir.

entries.yo: Lẹhin rẹ̀ ni Jairi dide, ara Gileadi; o si ṣe idajọ Israeli li ọdún mejilelogun.
entries.en: And after him arose Jair, a Gileadite, and judged Israel twenty and two years.

entries.yo: On si ní ọgbọ̀n ọmọkunrin ti ngùn ọgbọ̀n ọmọ kẹtẹkẹtẹ, nwọn si ní ọgbọ̀n ilu ti a npè ni Haffoti-jairi titi o fi di oni, eyiti o wà ni ilẹ Gileadi.
entries.en: And he had thirty sons that rode on thirty ass colts, and they had thirty cities, which are called Havoth-jair unto this day, which are in the land of Gilead.

entries.yo: Jairi si kú, a si sin i ni Kamoni.
entries.en: And Jair died, and was buried in Camon.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Israeli si tun ṣe eyiti iṣe buburu li oju OLUWA, nwọn si nsìn Baalimu, ati Aṣtarotu, ati awọn oriṣa Siria, ati awọn oriṣa Sidoni, ati awọn oriṣa Moabu, ati awọn oriṣa awọn ọmọ Ammoni, ati awọn oriṣa awọn Filistini; nwọn si kọ̀ OLUWA silẹ, nwọn kò si sìn i.
entries.en: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the LORD, and served Baalim, and Ashtaroth, and the gods of Syria, and the gods of Zidon, and the gods of Moab, and the gods of the children of Ammon, and the gods of the Philistines, and forsook the LORD, and served not him.

entries.yo: Ibinu OLUWA si rú si Israeli, o si tà wọn si ọwọ́ awọn Filistini, ati si ọwọ́ awọn ọmọ Ammoni.
entries.en: And the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel, and he sold them into the hands of the Philistines, and into the hands of the children of Ammon.

entries.yo: Li ọdún na nwọn ni awọn ọmọ Israeli lara, nwọn si pọ́n wọn loju: ọdún mejidilogun ni nwọn fi ni gbogbo awọn ọmọ Israeli ti o wà ni ìha keji Jordani ni ilẹ awọn Amori, ti o wà ni Gileadi, lara.
entries.en: And that year they vexed and oppressed the children of Israel: eighteen years, all the children of Israel that were on the other side Jordan in the land of the Amorites, which is in Gilead.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Ammoni si gòke odò Jordani lati bá Juda jà pẹlu, ati Benjamini, ati ile Efraimu; a si ni Israeli lara gidigidi.
entries.en: Moreover the children of Ammon passed over Jordan to fight also against Judah, and against Benjamin, and against the house of Ephraim; so that Israel was sore distressed.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Israeli si kepè OLUWA wipe, Awa ti ṣẹ̀ si ọ, nitoriti awa ti kọ̀ Ọlọrun wa silẹ, a si nsín Baalimu.
entries.en: And the children of Israel cried unto the LORD, saying, We have sinned against thee, both because we have forsaken our God, and also served Baalim.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun awọn ọmọ Israeli pe, Emi kò ti gbà nyin kuro lọwọ awọn ara Egipti, ati lọwọ awọn ọmọ Amori, ati lọwọ awọn ọmọ Ammoni, ati lọwọ awọn Filistini?
entries.en: And the LORD said unto the children of Israel, Did not I deliver you from the Egyptians, and from the Amorites, from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines?

entries.yo: Awọn ara Sidoni pẹlu, ati awọn Amaleki, ati awọn Maoni si ti npọ́n nyin loju; ẹnyin kepè mi, emi si gbà nyin lọwọ wọn.
entries.en: The Zidonians also, and the Amalekites, and the Maonites, did oppress you; and ye cried to me, and I delivered you out of their hand.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹnyin kọ̀ mi silẹ, ẹ si nsìn ọlọrun miran: nitorina emi ki yio tun gbà nyin mọ́.
entries.en: Yet ye have forsaken me, and served other gods: wherefore I will deliver you no more.

entries.yo: Ẹ lọ kigbepè awọn oriṣa ti ẹnyin ti yàn; jẹ ki nwọn ki o gbà nyin li akokò wahalà nyin.
entries.en: Go and cry unto the gods which ye have chosen; let them deliver you in the time of your tribulation.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Israeli si wi fun OLUWA pe, Awa ti ṣẹ̀: ohunkohun ti o ba tọ́ li oju rẹ ni ki o fi wa ṣe; sá gbà wa li oni yi, awa bẹ̀ ọ.
entries.en: And the children of Israel said unto the LORD, We have sinned: do thou unto us whatsoever seemeth good unto thee; deliver us only, we pray thee, this day.

entries.yo: Nwọn si kó ajeji ọlọrun wọnni ti o wà lọdọ wọn kuro, nwọn si nsìn OLUWA: ọkàn rẹ̀ kò si gbà òṣi Israeli mọ́.
entries.en: And they put away the strange gods from among them, and served the LORD: and his soul was grieved for the misery of Israel.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni awọn ọmọ Ammoni kó ara wọn jọ nwọn si dó si Gileadi. Awọn ọmọ Israeli si kó ara wọn jọ, nwọn si dó si Mispa.
entries.en: Then the children of Ammon were gathered together, and encamped in Gilead. And the children of Israel assembled themselves together, and encamped in Mizpeh.

entries.yo: Awọn enia na, awọn olori Gileadi si wi fun ara wọn pe, ọkunrin wo ni yio bẹ̀rẹsi bá awọn ọmọ Ammoni jà? on na ni yio ṣe olori gbogbo awọn ara Gileadi.
entries.en: And the people and princes of Gilead said one to another, What man is he that will begin to fight against the children of Ammon? he shall be head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.

entries.yo: JEFTA ara Gileadi si jẹ́ akọni ọkunrin, on si jẹ́ ọmọ panṣaga obinrin kan: Gileadi si bi Jefta.
entries.en: Now Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty man of valour, and he was the son of an harlot: and Gilead begat Jephthah.

entries.yo: Aya Gileadi si bi awọn ọmọkunrin fun u; nigbati awọn ọmọ aya na si dàgba, nwọn si lé Jefta jade, nwọn si wi fun u pe, Iwọ ki yio jogún ni ile baba wa; nitoripe ọmọ ajeji obinrin ni iwọ iṣe.
entries.en: And Gilead's wife bare him sons; and his wife's sons grew up, and they thrust out Jephthah, and said unto him, Thou shalt not inherit in our father's house; for thou art the son of a strange woman.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Jefta sá kuro lọdọ awọn arakunrin rẹ̀, on si joko ni ile Tobu: awọn enia lasan si kó ara wọn jọ sọdọ Jefta, nwọn si bá a jade lọ,
entries.en: Then Jephthah fled from his brethren, and dwelt in the land of Tob: and there were gathered vain men to Jephthah, and went out with him.

entries.yo: O si ṣe lẹhin ijọ́ melokan, awọn ọmọ Ammoni bá Israeli jagun.
entries.en: And it came to pass in process of time, that the children of Ammon made war against Israel.

entries.yo: O si ṣe nigbati awọn Ammoni bá Israeli jagun, awọn àgba Gileadi si lọ mú Jefta lati ilẹ Tobu wa.
entries.en: And it was so, that when the children of Ammon made war against Israel, the elders of Gilead went to fetch Jephthah out of the land of Tob:

entries.yo: Nwọn si wi fun Jefta pe, Wá, jẹ́ olori wa, ki awa ki o le bá awọn ọmọ Ammoni jà.
entries.en: And they said unto Jephthah, Come, and be our captain, that we may fight with the children of Ammon.

entries.yo: Jefta si wi fun awọn àgba Gileadi pe, Ẹnyin kò ha ti korira mi, ẹnyin kò ha ti lé mi kuro ni ile baba mi? ẽ si ti ṣe ti ẹnyin fi tọ̀ mi wá nisisiyi nigbati ẹnyin wà ninu ipọnju?
entries.en: And Jephthah said unto the elders of Gilead, Did not ye hate me, and expel me out of my father's house? and why are ye come unto me now when ye are in distress?

entries.yo: Awọn àgba Gileadi si wi fun Jefta pe, Nitorina li awa ṣe pada tọ̀ ọ nisisiyi, ki iwọ ki o le bá wa lọ, ki o si bá awọn ọmọ Ammoni jà, ki o si jẹ́ olori wa ati ti gbogbo awọn ara Gileadi.
entries.en: And the elders of Gilead said unto Jephthah, Therefore we turn again to thee now, that thou mayest go with us, and fight against the children of Ammon, and be our head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.

entries.yo: Jefta si wi fun awọn àgba Gileadi pe, Bi ẹnyin ba mú mi pada lati bá awọn ọmọ Ammoni jà, ti OLUWA ba si fi wọn fun mi, emi o ha jẹ́ olori nyin bi?
entries.en: And Jephthah said unto the elders of Gilead, If ye bring me home again to fight against the children of Ammon, and the LORD deliver them before me, shall I be your head?

entries.yo: Awọn àgba Gileadi si wi fun Jefta pe, Jẹ ki OLUWA ki o ṣe ẹlẹri lãrin wa, lõtọ gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ rẹ bẹ̃li awa o ṣe.
entries.en: And the elders of Gilead said unto Jephthah, The LORD be witness between us, if we do not so according to thy words.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Jefta bá awọn àgba Gileadi lọ, awọn enia na si fi i jẹ́ olori ati balogun wọn: Jefta si sọ gbogbo ọ̀rọ rẹ̀ niwaju OLUWA ni Mispa.
entries.en: Then Jephthah went with the elders of Gilead, and the people made him head and captain over them: and Jephthah uttered all his words before the LORD in Mizpeh.

entries.yo: Jefta si rán onṣẹ si ọba awọn ọmọ Ammoni, wipe, Kili o ṣe temi tirẹ, ti iwọ fi tọ̀ mi wá, lati jà ni ilẹ mi?
entries.en: And Jephthah sent messengers unto the king of the children of Ammon, saying, What hast thou to do with me, that thou art come against me to fight in my land?

entries.yo: Ọba awọn ọmọ Ammoni si da awọn onṣẹ Jefta lohùn pe, Nitoriti Israeli ti gbà ilẹ mi, nigbati nwọn gòke ti Egipti wá, lati Arnoni titi dé Jaboku, ati titi dé Jordani: njẹ́ nisisiyi fi ilẹ wọnni silẹ li alafia.
entries.en: And the king of the children of Ammon answered unto the messengers of Jephthah, Because Israel took away my land, when they came up out of Egypt, from Arnon even unto Jabbok, and unto Jordan: now therefore restore those lands again peaceably.

entries.yo: Jefta si tun rán onṣẹ si ọba awọn ọmọ Ammoni:
entries.en: And Jephthah sent messengers again unto the king of the children of Ammon:

entries.yo: O si wi fun u pe, Bayi ni Jefta wi, Israeli kò gbà ilẹ Moabu, tabi ilẹ awọn ọmọ Ammoni:
entries.en: And said unto him, Thus saith Jephthah, Israel took not away the land of Moab, nor the land of the children of Ammon:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati Israeli gòke ti Egipti wá, ti nwọn si nrìn li aginjù, titi dé Okun Pupa, ti nwọn si dé Kadeṣi;
entries.en: But when Israel came up from Egypt, and walked through the wilderness unto the Red sea, and came to Kadesh;

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Israeli rán onṣẹ si ọba Edomu, wipe, Mo bẹ̀ ọ, jẹ ki emi ki o kọja ni ilẹ rẹ: ṣugbọn ọba Edomu kò gbọ́. Bẹ̃ gẹgẹ o si ranṣẹ si ọba Moabu pẹlu: ṣugbọn kò fẹ́: Israeli si joko ni Kadeṣi.
entries.en: Then Israel sent messengers unto the king of Edom, saying, Let me, I pray thee, pass through thy land: but the king of Edom would not hearken thereto. And in like manner they sent unto the king of Moab: but he would not consent: and Israel abode in Kadesh.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni o rìn lãrin aginjù o si yi ilẹ Edomu, ati ilẹ Moabu ká, o si yọ ni ìha ìla-õrùn ilẹ Moabu, nwọn si dó si ìha keji Arnoni, ṣugbọn nwọn kò wá sinu àla Moabu, nitoripe Arnoni ni àla Moabu.
entries.en: Then they went along through the wilderness, and compassed the land of Edom, and the land of Moab, and came by the east side of the land of Moab, and pitched on the other side of Arnon, but came not within the border of Moab: for Arnon was the border of Moab.

entries.yo: Israeli si rán onṣẹ si Sihoni ọba awọn Amori, ọba Heṣboni; Israeli si wi fun u pe, Awa bẹ̀ ọ, jẹ ki awa ki o kọja lãrin ilẹ rẹ si ipò mi.
entries.en: And Israel sent messengers unto Sihon king of the Amorites, the king of Heshbon; and Israel said unto him, Let us pass, we pray thee, through thy land into my place.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Sihoni kò gbẹkẹle Israeli lati kọja li àgbegbe rẹ̀: ṣugbọn Sihoni kó gbogbo enia rẹ̀ jọ, nwọn si dó ni Jahasi, nwọn si bá Israeli jagun.
entries.en: But Sihon trusted not Israel to pass through his coast: but Sihon gathered all his people together, and pitched in Jahaz, and fought against Israel.

entries.yo: OLUWA, Ọlọrun Israeli, si fi Sihoni, ati gbogbo enia rẹ̀ lé Israeli lọwọ, nwọn si kọlù wọn: Israeli si gbà gbogbo ilẹ awọn Amori, awọn enia ilẹ na.
entries.en: And the LORD God of Israel delivered Sihon and all his people into the hand of Israel, and they smote them: so Israel possessed all the land of the Amorites, the inhabitants of that country.

entries.yo: Nwọn si gbà gbogbo àgbegbe awọn Amori, lati Arnoni titi dé Jaboku, ati lati aginjù titi dé Jordani.
entries.en: And they possessed all the coasts of the Amorites, from Arnon even unto Jabbok, and from the wilderness even unto Jordan.

entries.yo: Njẹ bẹ̃ni OLUWA, Ọlọrun Israeli, lé awọn Amori kuro niwaju Israeli awọn enia rẹ̀, iwọ o ha gbà a bi?
entries.en: So now the LORD God of Israel hath dispossessed the Amorites from before his people Israel, and shouldest thou possess it?

entries.yo: Iwọ ki yio ha gbà eyiti Kemoṣu oriṣa rẹ fi fun ọ lati ní? Bẹ̃li ẹnikẹni ti OLUWA Ọlọrun wa ba lé kuro niwaju wa, ilẹ wọn ni awa o gbà.
entries.en: Wilt not thou possess that which Chemosh thy god giveth thee to possess? So whomsoever the LORD our God shall drive out from before us, them will we possess.

entries.yo: Njẹ iwọ ha san jù Balaki ọmọ Sipporu, ọba Moabu? on ha bá Israeli ṣe gbolohùn asọ̀ rí, tabi o ha bá wọn jà rí?
entries.en: And now art thou any thing better than Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab? did he ever strive against Israel, or did he ever fight against them,

entries.yo: Nigbati Israeli fi joko ni Heṣboni ati awọn ilu rẹ̀, ati ni Aroeri ati awọn ilu rẹ̀, ati ni gbogbo awọn ilu ti o wà lọ titi de ẹba Arnoni, li ọdunrun ọdún; ẽṣe ti ẹnyin kò fi gbà a li akokò na?
entries.en: While Israel dwelt in Heshbon and her towns, and in Aroer and her towns, and in all the cities that be along by the coasts of Arnon, three hundred years? why therefore did ye not recover them within that time?

entries.yo: Nitorina emi kò ṣẹ̀ ọ, ṣugbọn iwọ li o ṣẹ̀ mi ni bibá mi jà: ki OLUWA, Onidajọ, ki o ṣe idajọ li oni lãrin awọn ọmọ Israeli ati awọn ọmọ Ammoni.
entries.en: Wherefore I have not sinned against thee, but thou doest me wrong to war against me: the LORD the Judge be judge this day between the children of Israel and the children of Ammon.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ọba awọn ọmọ Ammoni kò fetisi ọ̀rọ Jefta, ti o rán si i.
entries.en: Howbeit the king of the children of Ammon hearkened not unto the words of Jephthah which he sent him.

entries.yo: Nigbana li ẹmi OLUWA bà lé Jefta, on si kọja Gileadi ati Manasse, o si kọja Mispa ti Gileadi, ati lati Mispa ti Gileadi o si kọja lọ sọdọ awọn ọmọ Ammoni.
entries.en: Then the Spirit of the LORD came upon Jephthah, and he passed over Gilead, and Manasseh, and passed over Mizpeh of Gilead, and from Mizpeh of Gilead he passed over unto the children of Ammon.

entries.yo: Jefta si jẹ́ ẹjẹ́ fun Ọlọrun, o si wi pe, Bi iwọ ba jẹ fi awọn ọmọ Ammoni lé mi lọwọ,
entries.en: And Jephthah vowed a vow unto the LORD, and said, If thou shalt without fail deliver the children of Ammon into mine hands,

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, ohunkohun ti o ba ti oju-ilẹkun ile mi wá ipade mi, nigbati emi ba ti ọdọ awọn Ammoni pada bọ̀ li alafia, ti OLUWA ni yio jẹ́, emi o si fi i ru ẹbọ sisun.
entries.en: Then it shall be, that whatsoever cometh forth of the doors of my house to meet me, when I return in peace from the children of Ammon, shall surely be the LORD's, and I will offer it up for a burnt offering.

entries.yo: Jefta si kọja lọ sọdọ awọn ọmọ Ammoni, lati bá wọn jà; OLUWA si fi nwọn lé e lọwọ.
entries.en: So Jephthah passed over unto the children of Ammon to fight against them; and the LORD delivered them into his hands.

entries.yo: On si pa wọn ni ipakupa lati Aroeri lọ, titi dé atiwọ̀ Miniti, ani ogún ilu, titi o fi dé Abeli-kiramimu. Bẹ̃li a ṣẹgun awọn ọmọ Ammoni niwaju awọn ọmọ Israeli.
entries.en: And he smote them from Aroer, even till thou come to Minnith, even twenty cities, and unto the plain of the vineyards, with a very great slaughter. Thus the children of Ammon were subdued before the children of Israel.

entries.yo: Jefta si bọ̀ si ile rẹ̀ ni Mispa, si kiyesi i, ọmọbinrin rẹ̀ si jade wá ipade rẹ̀ ti on ti timbrili ati ijó: on nikan si li ọmọ rẹ̀; lẹhin rẹ̀ kò ní ọmọkunrin tabi ọmọbinrin.
entries.en: And Jephthah came to Mizpeh unto his house, and, behold, his daughter came out to meet him with timbrels and with dances: and she was his only child; beside her he had neither son nor daughter.

entries.yo: O si ṣe nigbati o ri i, o fà aṣọ rẹ̀ ya, o si wipe, Yẽ, ọmọ mi! iwọ rẹ̀ mi silẹ gidigidi, iwọ si li ọkan ninu awọn ti nyọ mi lẹnu: nitori emi ti yà ẹnu mi si OLUWA, emi kò si le pada.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when he saw her, that he rent his clothes, and said, Alas, my daughter! thou hast brought me very low, and thou art one of them that trouble me: for I have opened my mouth unto the LORD, and I cannot go back.

entries.yo: On si wi fun u pe, Baba mi, iwọ ti yà ẹnu rẹ si OLUWA; ṣe si mi gẹgẹ bi eyiti o ti ẹnu rẹ jade; niwọnbi OLUWA ti gbẹsan fun ọ lara awọn ọtá rẹ, ani lara awọn ọmọ Ammoni.
entries.en: And she said unto him, My father, if thou hast opened thy mouth unto the LORD, do to me according to that which hath proceeded out of thy mouth; forasmuch as the LORD hath taken vengeance for thee of thine enemies, even of the children of Ammon.

entries.yo: On si wi fun baba rẹ̀ pe, Jẹ ki a ṣe nkan yi fun mi: jọwọ mi jẹ li oṣù meji, ki emi ki o lọ ki emi si sọkalẹ sori òke, ki emi ki o le sọkun nitori ìwa-wundia mi, emi ati awọn ẹgbẹ mi.
entries.en: And she said unto her father, Let this thing be done for me: let me alone two months, that I may go up and down upon the mountains, and bewail my virginity, I and my fellows.

entries.yo: On si wipe, Lọ. O si rán a lọ niwọn oṣù meji: o si lọ, ati on ati awọn ẹgbẹ rẹ̀, o si sọkun nitori ìwa-wundia rẹ̀ lori òke wọnni.
entries.en: And he said, Go. And he sent her away for two months: and she went with her companions, and bewailed her virginity upon the mountains.

entries.yo: O si ṣe li opin oṣù keji, o si pada wá sọdọ baba rẹ̀, ẹniti o ṣe si i gẹgẹ bi ẹjẹ́ rẹ̀ ti o jẹ́: on kò si mọ̀ ọkunrin. O si di ìlana ni Israeli pe,
entries.en: And it came to pass at the end of two months, that she returned unto her father, who did with her according to his vow which he had vowed: and she knew no man. And it was a custom in Israel,

entries.yo: Ki awọn ọmọbinrin Israeli ma lọ li ọdọdún lati pohunrere ọmọbinrin Jefta ara Gileadi li ọjọ́ mẹrin li ọdún.
entries.en: That the daughters of Israel went yearly to lament the daughter of Jephthah the Gileadite four days in a year.

entries.yo: AWỌN ọkunrin Efraimu si kó ara wọn jọ, nwọn si kọja si ìha ariwa; nwọn si wi fun Jefta pe, Ẽṣe ti iwọ fi rekọja lati bá awọn ọmọ Ammoni jà, ti iwọ kò si pè wa ki awa ki o le bá ọ lọ? awa o fi iná kun ile rẹ mọ́ ọ lori.
entries.en: And the men of Ephraim gathered themselves together, and went northward, and said unto Jephthah, Wherefore passedst thou over to fight against the children of Ammon, and didst not call us to go with thee? we will burn thine house upon thee with fire.

entries.yo: Jefta si wi fun wọn pe, Emi ati awọn enia mi ti mbá awọn ọmọ Ammoni jà gidigidi; nigbati emi kepè nyin, ẹnyin kò si gbà mi li ọwọ́ wọn.
entries.en: And Jephthah said unto them, I and my people were at great strife with the children of Ammon; and when I called you, ye delivered me not out of their hands.

entries.yo: Nigbati emi si ri pe ẹnyin kò gbà mi, mo fi ẹmi mi wewu, emi si rekọja sọdọ awọn ọmọ Ammoni, OLUWA si fi nwọn lé mi li ọwọ́: nitori kini ẹnyin ha ṣe gòke tọ̀ mi wá li oni, lati bá mi jà?
entries.en: And when I saw that ye delivered me not, I put my life in my hands, and passed over against the children of Ammon, and the LORD delivered them into my hand: wherefore then are ye come up unto me this day, to fight against me?

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Jefta kó gbogbo awọn ọkunrin Gileadi jọ, o si bá Efraimu jà: awọn ọkunrin Gileadi si kọlù Efraimu, nitoriti nwọn wipe, Isansa Efraimu li ẹnyin ara Gileadi iṣe, lãrin Efraimu, ati lãrin Manasse,
entries.en: Then Jephthah gathered together all the men of Gilead, and fought with Ephraim: and the men of Gilead smote Ephraim, because they said, Ye Gileadites are fugitives of Ephraim among the Ephraimites, and among the Manassites.

entries.yo: Awọn ara Gileadi si gbà iwọdo Jordani ṣiwaju Efraimu: o si ṣe, nigbati awọn isansa Efraimu ba wipe, Jẹ ki emi ki o rekọja, awọn ọkunrin Gileadi a si wi fun u pe, Efraimu ki iwọ iṣe? Bi on ba si wipe, Rárá o!
entries.en: And the Gileadites took the passages of Jordan before the Ephraimites: and it was so, that when those Ephraimites which were escaped said, Let me go over; that the men of Gilead said unto him, Art thou an Ephraimite? If he said, Nay;

entries.yo: Nwọn a si wi fun u pe, Njẹ wi pe Ṣibboleti; on si wi pe Sibboleti, nitoripe on kò le pè e rere; nwọn a si mú u, nwọn a si pa a si iwọdo Jordani: awọn ti o si ṣubu li akokò na ninu awọn Efraimu jẹ́ ẹgbã mọkanlelogun enia.
entries.en: Then said they unto him, Say now Shibboleth: and he said Sibboleth: for he could not frame to pronounce it right. Then they took him, and slew him at the passages of Jordan: and there fell at that time of the Ephraimites forty and two thousand.

entries.yo: Jefta si ṣe idajọ Israeli li ọdún mẹfa. Jefta ara Gileadi si kú, a si sin i si ọ̀kan ninu awọn ilú Gileadi.
entries.en: And Jephthah judged Israel six years. Then died Jephthah the Gileadite, and was buried in one of the cities of Gilead.

entries.yo: Lẹhin rẹ̀ ni Ibsani ara Beti-lehemu ṣe idajọ Israeli.
entries.en: And after him Ibzan of Bethlehem judged Israel.

entries.yo: O si lí ọgbọ̀n ọmọkunrin, ati ọgbọ̀n ọmọbinrin ti on rán lọ si ode, o si fẹ́ ọgbọ̀n ọmọbinrin lati ode wá fi fun awọn ọmọkunrin rẹ̀. On si ṣe idajọ Israeli li ọdún meje.
entries.en: And he had thirty sons, and thirty daughters, whom he sent abroad, and took in thirty daughters from abroad for his sons. And he judged Israel seven years.

entries.yo: Ibsani si kú, a si sin i ni Beti-lehemu.
entries.en: Then died Ibzan, and was buried at Bethlehem.

entries.yo: Lẹhin rẹ̀ ni Eloni ti ẹ̀ya Sebuluni ṣe idajọ Israeli; on si ṣe idajọ Israeli li ọdún mẹwa.
entries.en: And after him Elon, a Zebulonite, judged Israel; and he judged Israel ten years.

entries.yo: Eloni ti ẹ̀ya Sebuluni si kú, a si sin i ni Aijaloni ni ilẹ Sebuluni.
entries.en: And Elon the Zebulonite died, and was buried in Aijalon in the country of Zebulun.

entries.yo: Lẹhin rẹ̀ ni Abdoni ọmọ Hilleli, ti Piratoni, ṣe idajọ Israeli.
entries.en: And after him Abdon the son of Hillel, a Pirathonite, judged Israel.

entries.yo: On si lí ogoji ọmọkunrin, ati ọgbọ̀n ọmọ ọmọ ti ngùn ãdọrin ọmọ kẹtẹkẹtẹ: on si ṣe idajọ Israeli li ọdún mẹjọ.
entries.en: And he had forty sons and thirty nephews, that rode on threescore and ten ass colts: and he judged Israel eight years.

entries.yo: Abdoni ọmọ Hilleli ti Piratoni si kú, a si sin i ni Piratoni ni ilẹ Efraimu, li òke awọn Amaleki.
entries.en: And Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite died, and was buried in Pirathon in the land of Ephraim, in the mount of the Amalekites.

entries.yo: AWỌN ọmọ Israeli si tun ṣe eyiti iṣe buburu li oju OLUWA; OLUWA si fi wọn lé awọn Filistini li ọwọ́ li ogoji ọdún.
entries.en: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the LORD; and the LORD delivered them into the hand of the Philistines forty years.

entries.yo: Ọkunrin kan ara Sora si wà, ti iṣe idile Dani, orukọ rẹ̀ si ni Manoa, obinrin rẹ̀ si yàgan, kò si bimọ.
entries.en: And there was a certain man of Zorah, of the family of the Danites, whose name was Manoah; and his wife was barren, and bare not.

entries.yo: Angeli OLUWA si farahàn obinrin na, o si wi fun u pe, Sá kiyesi i, iwọ yàgan, iwọ kò si bimọ: ṣugbọn iwọ o lóyun, iwọ o si bi ọmọkunrin kan.
entries.en: And the angel of the LORD appeared unto the woman, and said unto her, Behold now, thou art barren, and bearest not: but thou shalt conceive, and bear a son.

entries.yo: Njẹ nitorina kiyesara, emi bẹ̀ ọ, máṣe mu ọti-waini tabi ọti lile, má si ṣe jẹ ohun aimọ́ kan:
entries.en: Now therefore beware, I pray thee, and drink not wine nor strong drink, and eat not any unclean thing:

entries.yo: Nitori kiyesi i, iwọ o lóyun, iwọ o si bi ọmọkunrin kan; ki abẹ ki o má ṣe kàn a lori: nitori Nasiri Ọlọrun li ọmọ na o jẹ́ lati inu wá: on o bẹ̀rẹsi gbà Israeli li ọwọ́ awọn Filistini.
entries.en: For, lo, thou shalt conceive, and bear a son; and no rasor shall come on his head: for the child shall be a Nazarite unto God from the womb: and he shall begin to deliver Israel out of the hand of the Philistines.

entries.yo: Nigbana obinrin na wá, o si rò fun ọkọ rẹ̀, wipe, Enia Ọlọrun kan wá sọdọ mi, irí rẹ̀ si dabi irí angeli Ọlọrun, o ní ẹ̀ru gidigidi; ṣugbọn emi kò bilère ibiti o ti wá, bẹ̃li on kò si sọ orukọ rẹ̀ fun mi:
entries.en: Then the woman came and told her husband, saying, A man of God came unto me, and his countenance was like the countenance of an angel of God, very terrible: but I asked him not whence he was, neither told he me his name:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn on sọ fun mi pe, Kiyesi i, iwọ o lóyun, iwọ o si bi ọmọkunrin kan; nitorina má ṣe mu ọti-waini tabi ọti lile, bẹ̃ni ki o má ṣe jẹ ohun aimọ́ kan: nitori Nasiri Ọlọrun li ọmọ na o jẹ́ lati inu wá titi di ọjọ́ ikú rẹ̀.
entries.en: But he said unto me, Behold, thou shalt conceive, and bear a son; and now drink no wine nor strong drink, neither eat any unclean thing: for the child shall be a Nazarite to God from the womb to the day of his death.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Manoa bẹ̀ OLUWA, o si wipe, OLUWA, emi bẹ̀ ọ, jẹ ki enia Ọlọrun, ti iwọ rán tun tọ̀ wa wá, ki o le kọ́ wa li ohun ti awa o ṣe si ọmọ na ti a o bi.
entries.en: Then Manoah intreated the LORD, and said, O my Lord, let the man of God which thou didst send come again unto us, and teach us what we shall do unto the child that shall be born.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si gbọ ohùn Manoa; angeli Ọlọrun na si tun tọ̀ obinrin na wá, bi on ti joko ninu oko; ṣugbọn Manoa ọkọ rẹ̀ kò sí nibẹ̀ pẹlu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And God hearkened to the voice of Manoah; and the angel of God came again unto the woman as she sat in the field: but Manoah her husband was not with her.

entries.yo: Obinrin na si yara kánkán, o si sure, o si sọ fun ọkọ rẹ̀, o si wi fun u pe, Kiyesi i, ọkunrin ti o tọ̀ mi wá ni ijelo farahàn mi.
entries.en: And the woman made haste, and ran, and shewed her husband, and said unto him, Behold, the man hath appeared unto me, that came unto me the other day.

entries.yo: Manoa si dide, o si tẹle aya rẹ̀, o si wá sọdọ ọkunrin na, o si bi i pe, Iwọ li ọkunrin na ti o bá obinrin na sọ̀rọ? On si wipe, Emi ni.
entries.en: And Manoah arose, and went after his wife, and came to the man, and said unto him, Art thou the man that spakest unto the woman? And he said, I am.

entries.yo: Manoa si wipe, Njẹ ki ọ̀rọ rẹ ki o ṣẹ: ìwa ọmọ na yio ti jẹ́, iṣẹ rẹ̀ yio ti jẹ́?
entries.en: And Manoah said, Now let thy words come to pass. How shall we order the child, and how shall we do unto him?

entries.yo: Angeli OLUWA si wi fun Manoa pe, Ni gbogbo eyiti mo sọ fun obinrin na ni ki o kiyesi.
entries.en: And the angel of the LORD said unto Manoah, Of all that I said unto the woman let her beware.

entries.yo: Ki o má ṣe jẹ ohun kan ti o ti inu àjara wá, ki o má ṣe mu ọti-waini tabi ọti lile, bẹ̃ni kò gbọdọ jẹ ohun aimọ́ kan; gbogbo eyiti mo palaṣẹ fun u ni ki o kiyesi.
entries.en: She may not eat of any thing that cometh of the vine, neither let her drink wine or strong drink, nor eat any unclean thing: all that I commanded her let her observe.

entries.yo: Manoa si wi fun angeli OLUWA na pe, Emi bẹ̀ ọ, jẹ ki awa ki o da ọ duro, titi awa o si fi pèse ọmọ ewurẹ kan fun ọ.
entries.en: And Manoah said unto the angel of the LORD, I pray thee, let us detain thee, until we shall have made ready a kid for thee.

entries.yo: Angeli OLUWA na si wi fun Manoa pe, Bi iwọ tilẹ da mi duro, emi ki yio jẹ ninu àkara rẹ: bi iwọ o ba si ru ẹbọ sisun kan, OLUWA ni ki iwọ ki o ru u si. Nitori Manoa kò mọ̀ pe angeli OLUWA ni iṣe.
entries.en: And the angel of the LORD said unto Manoah, Though thou detain me, I will not eat of thy bread: and if thou wilt offer a burnt offering, thou must offer it unto the LORD. For Manoah knew not that he was an angel of the LORD.

entries.yo: Manoa si wi fun angeli OLUWA na pe, Orukọ rẹ, nitori nigbati ọ̀rọ rẹ ba ṣẹ ki awa ki o le bọlá fun ọ?
entries.en: And Manoah said unto the angel of the LORD, What is thy name, that when thy sayings come to pass we may do thee honour?

entries.yo: Angeli OLUWA na si wi fun u pe, Ẽṣe ti iwọ fi mbère orukọ mi, kiyesi i, Iyanu ni.
entries.en: And the angel of the LORD said unto him, Why askest thou thus after my name, seeing it is secret?

entries.yo: Manoa si mú ọmọ ewurẹ kan pẹlu ẹbọ ohunjijẹ, o si ru u lori apata kan si OLUWA: angeli na si ṣe ohun iyanu, Manoa ati obinrin rẹ̀ si nwò o.
entries.en: So Manoah took a kid with a meat offering, and offered it upon a rock unto the LORD: and the angel did wondrously; and Manoah and his wife looked on.

entries.yo: O si ṣe ti ọwọ́-iná na nlọ soke ọrun lati ibi-pẹpẹ na wá, angeli OLUWA na si gòke ninu ọwọ́-iná ti o ti ibi-pẹpẹ jade wá. Manoa ati aya rẹ̀ si nwò o; nwọn si dojubolẹ.
entries.en: For it came to pass, when the flame went up toward heaven from off the altar, that the angel of the LORD ascended in the flame of the altar. And Manoah and his wife looked on it, and fell on their faces to the ground.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn angeli OLUWA na kò si tun farahàn fun Manoa tabi aya rẹ̀ mọ́. Nigbana ni Manoa to wa mọ̀ pe, angeli OLUWA ni iṣe.
entries.en: But the angel of the LORD did no more appear to Manoah and to his wife. Then Manoah knew that he was an angel of the LORD.

entries.yo: Manoa si wi fun aya rẹ̀ pe, Kikú li awa o kú yi, nitoriti awa ti ri Ọlọrun.
entries.en: And Manoah said unto his wife, We shall surely die, because we have seen God.

entries.yo: Aya rẹ̀ si wi fun u pe, Ibaṣepe o wù OLUWA lati pa wa, on kì ba ti gbà ẹbọ sisun ati ẹbọ ohunjijẹ li ọwọ́ wa, bẹ̃li on kì ba ti fi gbogbo nkan wọnyi hàn wa, bẹ̃li on kì ba ti sọ̀rọ irú nkan wọnyi fun wa li akokò yi.
entries.en: But his wife said unto him, If the LORD were pleased to kill us, he would not have received a burnt offering and a meat offering at our hands, neither would he have shewed us all these things, nor would as at this time have told us such things as these.

entries.yo: Obinrin na si bi ọmọkunrin kan, o si sọ orukọ rẹ̀ ni Samsoni: ọmọ na si dàgba, OLUWA si bukún u.
entries.en: And the woman bare a son, and called his name Samson: and the child grew, and the LORD blessed him.

entries.yo: Ẹmi OLUWA si bẹ̀rẹsi ṣiṣẹ ninu rẹ̀ ni Mahane-dani, li agbedemeji Sora ati Eṣtaolu.
entries.en: And the Spirit of the LORD began to move him at times in the camp of Dan between Zorah and Eshtaol.

entries.yo: SAMSONI si sọkalẹ lọ si Timna, o si ri obinrin kan ni Timna ọkan ninu awọn ọmọbinrin awọn Filistini.
entries.en: And Samson went down to Timnath, and saw a woman in Timnath of the daughters of the Philistines.

entries.yo: O si gòke wá, o si sọ fun baba on iya rẹ̀, o si wipe, Emi ri obinrin kan ni Timna ninu awọn ọmọbinrin awọn Filistini: njẹ nitorina ẹ fẹ́ ẹ fun mi li aya.
entries.en: And he came up, and told his father and his mother, and said, I have seen a woman in Timnath of the daughters of the Philistines: now therefore get her for me to wife.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni baba on iya rẹ̀ wi fun u pe, Kò sí obinrin kan ninu awọn ọmọbinrin awọn arakunrin rẹ, tabi ninu gbogbo awọn enia mi, ti iwọ fi nlọ ní obinrin ninu awọn alaikọlà Filistini? Samsoni si wi fun baba rẹ̀ pe, Fẹ́ ẹ fun mi; nitoripe o wù mi gidigidi.
entries.en: Then his father and his mother said unto him, Is there never a woman among the daughters of thy brethren, or among all my people, that thou goest to take a wife of the uncircumcised Philistines? And Samson said unto his father, Get her for me; for she pleaseth me well.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn baba ati iya rẹ̀ kò mọ̀ pe ati ọwọ́ OLUWA wá ni, nitoripe on nwá ọ̀na lati bá awọn Filistini jà. Nitoripe li akokò na awọn Filistini li alaṣẹ ni Israeli.
entries.en: But his father and his mother knew not that it was of the LORD, that he sought an occasion against the Philistines: for at that time the Philistines had dominion over Israel.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Samsoni sọkalẹ lọ si Timna, ati baba rẹ̀ ati iya rẹ̀, o si dé ibi ọgbà-àjara ti o wà ni Timna: si kiyesi i, ẹgbọrọ kiniun kan nke ramuramu si i.
entries.en: Then went Samson down, and his father and his mother, to Timnath, and came to the vineyards of Timnath: and, behold, a young lion roared against him.

entries.yo: Ẹmi OLUWA si bà lé e, o si fà a ya bi iba ti fà ọmọ-ewurẹ ya, bẹ̃ni kò sí nkan li ọwọ́ rẹ̀: on kò si sọ fun baba tabi iya rẹ̀ li ohun ti o ṣe.
entries.en: And the Spirit of the LORD came mightily upon him, and he rent him as he would have rent a kid, and he had nothing in his hand: but he told not his father or his mother what he had done.

entries.yo: On si sọkalẹ lọ, o si bá obinrin na sọ̀rọ; on si wù Samsoni gidigidi.
entries.en: And he went down, and talked with the woman; and she pleased Samson well.

entries.yo: Lẹhin ijọ́ melokan o si tun pada lati mú obinrin na, o si yà lati wò okú kiniun na: si kiyesi i, ìṣu-ọ̀pọ oyin wà ninu okú kiniun na, ati oyin.
entries.en: And after a time he returned to take her, and he turned aside to see the carcase of the lion: and, behold, there was a swarm of bees and honey in the carcase of the lion.

entries.yo: O si bù ninu rẹ̀ si ọwọ́ rẹ̀, o si njẹ ẹ li ajẹrìn, titi o si fi dé ọdọ baba ati iya rẹ̀, o si fi fun wọn, nwọn si jẹ: ṣugbọn on kò sọ fun wọn pe ninu okú kiniun li on ti mú oyin na wá.
entries.en: And he took thereof in his hands, and went on eating, and came to his father and mother, and he gave them, and they did eat: but he told not them that he had taken the honey out of the carcase of the lion.

entries.yo: Baba rẹ̀ si sọkalẹ tọ̀ obinrin na lọ: Samsoni si sè àse nibẹ̀; nitoripe bẹ̃li awọn ọmọkunrin ima ṣe.
entries.en: So his father went down unto the woman: and Samson made there a feast; for so used the young men to do.

entries.yo: O si ṣe nigbati nwọn ri i, nwọn si mú ọgbọ̀n enia wa bá a kẹgbẹ.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when they saw him, that they brought thirty companions to be with him.

entries.yo: Samsoni si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ jẹ ki npa alọ́ kan fun nyin: bi ẹnyin ba le já a fun mi titi ijọ́ meje àse yi, ti ẹnyin ba si mọ̀ ọ, njẹ emi o fun nyin li ọgbọ̀n ẹ̀wu, ati ọgbọ̀n ìparọ aṣọ:
entries.en: And Samson said unto them, I will now put forth a riddle unto you: if ye can certainly declare it me within the seven days of the feast, and find it out, then I will give you thirty sheets and thirty change of garments:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi ẹnyin kò ba le já a fun mi, njẹ ẹnyin o fun mi li ọgbọ̀n ẹ̀wu, ati ọgbọ̀n ìparọ aṣọ. Nwọn si wi fun u pe, Pa alọ́ rẹ ki awa ki o gbọ́.
entries.en: But if ye cannot declare it me, then shall ye give me thirty sheets and thirty change of garments. And they said unto him, Put forth thy riddle, that we may hear it.

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Lati inu ọjẹun li onjẹ ti jade wá, ati lati inu alagbara li adùn ti jade wá. Nwọn kò si le já alọ́ na nìwọn ijọ́ mẹta.
entries.en: And he said unto them, Out of the eater came forth meat, and out of the strong came forth sweetness. And they could not in three days expound the riddle.

entries.yo: O si ṣe ni ijọ́ keje, nwọn si wi fun obinrin Samsoni pe, Tàn ọkọ rẹ, ki o le já alọ́ na fun wa, ki awa ki o má ba fi iná sun iwọ ati ile baba rẹ: ẹnyin pè wa ki ẹnyin ki o le gbà ohun-iní wa ni? bẹ̃ ha kọ?
entries.en: And it came to pass on the seventh day, that they said unto Samson's wife, Entice thy husband, that he may declare unto us the riddle, lest we burn thee and thy father's house with fire: have ye called us to take that we have? is it not so?

entries.yo: Obinrin Samsoni si sọkun niwaju rẹ̀, o si wipe, Iwọ korira mi ni, iwọ kò si fẹràn mi: iwọ pa alọ́ kan fun awọn ọmọ enia mi, iwọ kò si já a fun mi. On si wi fun u pe, Kiyesi i, emi kò já a fun baba ati iya mi, emi o ha já a fun ọ bi?
entries.en: And Samson's wife wept before him, and said, Thou dost but hate me, and lovest me not: thou hast put forth a riddle unto the children of my people, and hast not told it me. And he said unto her, Behold, I have not told it my father nor my mother, and shall I tell it thee?

entries.yo: O si sọkun niwaju rẹ̀ titi ijọ́ meje ti àse na gbà: O si ṣe ni ijọ́ keje, o si já a fun u, nitoripe on ṣe e li aisimi pupọ̀, on si já alọ́ na fun awọn ọmọ enia rẹ̀.
entries.en: And she wept before him the seven days, while their feast lasted: and it came to pass on the seventh day, that he told her, because she lay sore upon him: and she told the riddle to the children of her people.

entries.yo: Awọn ọkunrin ilunla na si wi fun u ni ijọ́ keje ki õrùn ki o to wọ̀ pe, Kili o dùn jù oyin lọ? kili o si lí agbara jù kiniun lọ? On si wi fun wọn pe, Ibaṣepe ẹnyin kò fi ẹgbọrọ abo-malu mi tulẹ, ẹnyin kì ba ti mọ̀ alọ́ mi.
entries.en: And the men of the city said unto him on the seventh day before the sun went down, What is sweeter than honey? and what is stronger than a lion? And he said unto them, If ye had not plowed with my heifer, ye had not found out my riddle.

entries.yo: Ẹmi OLUWA si bà lé e, o si sọkalẹ lọ si Aṣkeloni, o si pa ọgbọ̀n ọkunrin ninu wọn, o si kò ẹrù wọn, o si fi ìparọ aṣọ fun awọn ti o já alọ́ na. Ibinu rẹ̀ si rú, on si gòke lọ si ile baba rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the Spirit of the LORD came upon him, and he went down to Ashkelon, and slew thirty men of them, and took their spoil, and gave change of garments unto them which expounded the riddle. And his anger was kindled, and he went up to his father's house.

entries.yo: Nwọn si fi obinrin Samsoni fun ọkan ninu awọn ẹgbẹ rẹ̀, ti iṣe ọrẹ́ rẹ̀.
entries.en: But Samson's wife was given to his companion, whom he had used as his friend.

entries.yo: O SI ṣe lẹhin ìgba diẹ, li akokò ikore alikama, Samsoni mú ọmọ ewurẹ kan lọ bẹ̀ aya rẹ̀ wò; on si wipe, Emi o wọle tọ̀ aya mi lọ ni iyẹwu. Ṣugbọn baba obinrin rẹ̀ kò jẹ ki o wọle.
entries.en: But it came to pass within a while after, in the time of wheat harvest, that Samson visited his wife with a kid; and he said, I will go in to my wife into the chamber. But her father would not suffer him to go in.

entries.yo: Baba aya rẹ̀ si wipe, Nitõtọ emi ṣebi iwọ korira rẹ̀ patapata ni; nitorina ni mo ṣe fi i fun ẹgbẹ rẹ: aburò rẹ̀ kò ha ṣe arẹwà enia jù on lọ? mo bẹ̀ ọ, mú u dipò rẹ̀.
entries.en: And her father said, I verily thought that thou hadst utterly hated her; therefore I gave her to thy companion: is not her younger sister fairer than she? take her, I pray thee, instead of her.

entries.yo: Samsoni si wi fun wọn pe, Nisisiyi emi o jẹ́ alaijẹbi lọdọ awọn Filistini, bi mo tilẹ ṣe wọn ni ibi.
entries.en: And Samson said concerning them, Now shall I be more blameless than the Philistines, though I do them a displeasure.

entries.yo: Samsoni si lọ o mú ọdunrun kọ̀lọkọlọ, o si mú ètufu, o si fi ìru wọn kò ìru, o si fi ètufu kan sãrin ìru meji.
entries.en: And Samson went and caught three hundred foxes, and took firebrands, and turned tail to tail, and put a firebrand in the midst between two tails.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si ti fi iná si ètufu na, o jọwọ wọn lọ sinu oko-ọkà awọn Filistini, o si kun ati eyiti a dì ni ití, ati eyiti o wà li oró, ati ọgbà-olifi pẹlu.
entries.en: And when he had set the brands on fire, he let them go into the standing corn of the Philistines, and burnt up both the shocks, and also the standing corn, with the vineyards and olives.

entries.yo: Nigbana li awọn Filistini wipe, Tani ṣe eyi? Nwọn si dahùn pe, Samsoni, ana ara Timna ni, nitoriti o gbà obinrin rẹ̀, o si fi i fun ẹgbẹ rẹ̀. Awọn Filistini si gòke wá, nwọn si fi iná sun obinrin na ati baba rẹ̀.
entries.en: Then the Philistines said, Who hath done this? And they answered, Samson, the son in law of the Timnite, because he had taken his wife, and given her to his companion. And the Philistines came up, and burnt her and her father with fire.

entries.yo: Samsoni si wi fun wọn pe, Bi ẹnyin ba ṣe irú eyi, dajudaju emi o gbẹsan lara nyin, lẹhin na emi o si dẹkun.
entries.en: And Samson said unto them, Though ye have done this, yet will I be avenged of you, and after that I will cease.

entries.yo: On si kọlù wọn, o si pa wọn ni ipakupa: o si sọkalẹ o si joko ni pàlàpálá apata Etamu.
entries.en: And he smote them hip and thigh with a great slaughter: and he went down and dwelt in the top of the rock Etam.

entries.yo: Nigbana li awọn Filistini gòke lọ, nwọn si dótì Juda, nwọn si tẹ́ ara wọn lọ bẹrẹ ni Lehi.
entries.en: Then the Philistines went up, and pitched in Judah, and spread themselves in Lehi.

entries.yo: Awọn ọkunrin Juda si wipe, Nitori kili ẹnyin ṣe gòke tọ̀ wa wá? Nwọn si dahùn wipe, Lati dè Samsoni li awa ṣe wá, lati ṣe si i gẹgẹ bi on ti ṣe si wa.
entries.en: And the men of Judah said, Why are ye come up against us? And they answered, To bind Samson are we come up, to do to him as he hath done to us.

entries.yo: Nigbana li ẹgbẹdogun ọkunrin Juda sọkalẹ lọ si palapala apata Etamu, nwọn si wi fun Samsoni, pe, Iwọ kò mọ̀ pe awọn Filistini li alaṣẹ lori wa? kili eyiti iwọ ṣe si wa yi? On si wi fun wọn pe, Gẹgẹ bi nwọn ti ṣe si mi, bẹ̃li emi ṣe si wọn.
entries.en: Then three thousand men of Judah went to the top of the rock Etam, and said to Samson, Knowest thou not that the Philistines are rulers over us? what is this that thou hast done unto us? And he said unto them, As they did unto me, so have I done unto them.

entries.yo: Nwọn si wi fun u pe, Awa sọkalẹ wá lati dè ọ, ki awa ki o le fi ọ lé awọn Filistini lọwọ. Samsoni si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ bura fun mi, pe ẹnyin tikara nyin ki yio pa mi.
entries.en: And they said unto him, We are come down to bind thee, that we may deliver thee into the hand of the Philistines. And Samson said unto them, Swear unto me, that ye will not fall upon me yourselves.

entries.yo: Nwọn si wi fun u pe, Rárá o; didè li awa o dè ọ, a o si fi ọ lé wọn lọwọ: ṣugbọn niti pipa awa ki yio pa ọ. Nwọn si fi okùn titun meji dè e, nwọn si mú u gòke lati ibi apata na wá.
entries.en: And they spake unto him, saying, No; but we will bind thee fast, and deliver thee into their hand: but surely we will not kill thee. And they bound him with two new cords, and brought him up from the rock.

entries.yo: Nigbati o dé Lehi, awọn Filistini hó bò o: ẹmi OLUWA si bà lé e, okùn ti o si wà li apa rẹ̀ si wa dabi okùn-ọ̀gbọ ti o ti jóna, ìde rẹ̀ si tú kuro li ọwọ́ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And when he came unto Lehi, the Philistines shouted against him: and the Spirit of the LORD came mightily upon him, and the cords that were upon his arms became as flax that was burnt with fire, and his bands loosed from off his hands.

entries.yo: O si ri pari-ẹrẹkẹ kẹtẹkẹtẹ titun kan, o si nà ọwọ́ rẹ̀, o si mú u, o si fi i pa ẹgbẹrun ọkunrin.
entries.en: And he found a new jawbone of an ass, and put forth his hand, and took it, and slew a thousand men therewith.

entries.yo: Samsoni si wipe, Pari-ẹrẹkẹ kan ni mo fi pa òkiti kan, òkiti meji; pari-ẹrẹkẹ kẹtẹkẹtẹ kan ni mo fi pa ẹgbẹrun ọkunrin.
entries.en: And Samson said, With the jawbone of an ass, heaps upon heaps, with the jaw of an ass have I slain a thousand men.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati o pari ọ̀rọ isọ tán, o sọ pari-ẹrẹkẹ na nù, o si pè ibẹ̀ na ni Ramati-lehi.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when he had made an end of speaking, that he cast away the jawbone out of his hand, and called that place Ramath-lehi.

entries.yo: Ongbẹ si ngbẹ ẹ gidigidi, o si kepè OLUWA, wipe, Iwọ ti fi ìgbala nla yi lé ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ lọwọ: nisisiyi emi o kú nitori ongbẹ, emi o si bọ́ si ọwọ́ awọn alaikọlà.
entries.en: And he was sore athirst, and called on the LORD, and said, Thou hast given this great deliverance into the hand of thy servant: and now shall I die for thirst, and fall into the hand of the uncircumcised?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Ọlọrun si là ibi kòto kan ti o wà ni Lehi, nibẹ̀ li omi si sun jade; nigbati on si mu u tán ẹmi rẹ̀ si tun pada, o si sọjí: nitorina ni a ṣe pè orukọ ibẹ̀ na ni Eni-hakkore, ti o wà ni Lehi, titi o fi di oni-oloni.
entries.en: But God clave an hollow place that was in the jaw, and there came water thereout; and when he had drunk, his spirit came again, and he revived: wherefore he called the name thereof En-hakkore, which is in Lehi unto this day.

entries.yo: On si ṣe idajọ Israeli li ọjọ́ awọn Filistini li ogún ọdún.
entries.en: And he judged Israel in the days of the Philistines twenty years.

entries.yo: SAMSONI si lọ si Gasa, o si ri obinrin panṣaga kan nibẹ̀, o si wọle tọ̀ ọ.
entries.en: Then went Samson to Gaza, and saw there an harlot, and went in unto her.

entries.yo: Awọn ara Gasa si gbọ́ pe, Samsoni wá si ihin. Nwọn si yi i ká, nwọn lùmọ́ ni gbogbo oru na li ẹnu-bode ilu na, nwọn si dakẹ jẹ ni gbogbo oru na, wipe, Li owurọ̀ nigbati ilẹ ba mọ́, li awa a pa a.
entries.en: And it was told the Gazites, saying, Samson is come hither. And they compassed him in, and laid wait for him all night in the gate of the city, and were quiet all the night, saying, In the morning, when it is day, we shall kill him.

entries.yo: Samsoni si dubulẹ titi o fi di ãrin ọganjọ, o si dide lãrin ọganjọ, o si gbé ilẹkun-ibode ilu na, ati opó mejeji, o si fà wọn tu pẹlu idabu-ilẹ̀kùn, o gbé wọn lé ejika rẹ̀, o si rù wọn lọ si ori òke kan ti o wà niwaju Hebroni.
entries.en: And Samson lay till midnight, and arose at midnight, and took the doors of the gate of the city, and the two posts, and went away with them, bar and all, and put them upon his shoulders, and carried them up to the top of an hill that is before Hebron.

entries.yo: O si ṣe lẹhin eyinì, o si fẹ́ obinrin kan li afonifoji Soreki, a si ma pè orukọ rẹ̀ ni Delila.
entries.en: And it came to pass afterward, that he loved a woman in the valley of Sorek, whose name was Delilah.

entries.yo: Awọn ijoye Filistini tọ̀ ọ wá, nwọn si wi fun u pe, Tàn a, ki o si mọ̀ ibiti agbara nla rẹ̀ gbé wà, ati bi awa o ti ṣe le bori rẹ̀, ki awa ki o le dè e lati jẹ ẹ niyà: olukuluku wa yio si fun ọ ni ẹdẹgbẹfa owo fadakà.
entries.en: And the lords of the Philistines came up unto her, and said unto her, Entice him, and see wherein his great strength lieth, and by what means we may prevail against him, that we may bind him to afflict him: and we will give thee every one of us eleven hundred pieces of silver.

entries.yo: Delila si wi fun Samsoni pe, Emi bẹ̀ ọ, wi fun mi, nibo li agbara nla rẹ gbé wà, ati kili a le fi dè ọ lati jẹ ọ niyà.
entries.en: And Delilah said to Samson, Tell me, I pray thee, wherein thy great strength lieth, and wherewith thou mightest be bound to afflict thee.

entries.yo: Samsoni si wi fun u pe, Bi a ba fi okùn tutù meje ti a kò ságbẹ dè mi, nigbana li emi o di alailera, emi o si dabi ọkunrin miran.
entries.en: And Samson said unto her, If they bind me with seven green withs that were never dried, then shall I be weak, and be as another man.

entries.yo: Nigbana li awọn ijoye Filistini mú okùn tutù meje tọ̀ ọ wá ti a kò ságbẹ, o si fi okùn wọnni dè e.
entries.en: Then the lords of the Philistines brought up to her seven green withs which had not been dried, and she bound him with them.

entries.yo: Obinrin na si ní awọn kan, ti nwọn lumọ́ ninu yará. On si wi fun u pe, Awọn Filistini dé, Samsoni. On si já okùn na, gẹgẹ bi owú ti ijá nigbati o ba kan iná. Bẹ̃li a kò mọ̀ agbara rẹ̀.
entries.en: Now there were men lying in wait, abiding with her in the chamber. And she said unto him, The Philistines be upon thee, Samson. And he brake the withs, as a thread of tow is broken when it toucheth the fire. So his strength was not known.

entries.yo: Delila si wi fun Samsoni pe, Kiyesi i, iwọ tàn mi jẹ, o si purọ́ fun mi: wi fun mi, emi bẹ̀ ọ, kili a le fi dè ọ.
entries.en: And Delilah said unto Samson, Behold, thou hast mocked me, and told me lies: now tell me, I pray thee, wherewith thou mightest be bound.

entries.yo: On si wi fun u pe, Bi nwọn ba le fi okùn titun ti a kò ti lò rí dè mi le koko, nigbana li emi o di alailera, emi o si dabi ọkunrin miran.
entries.en: And he said unto her, If they bind me fast with new ropes that never were occupied, then shall I be weak, and be as another man.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Delila mú okùn titun, o si fi dè e, o si wi fun u pe, Awọn Filistini dé, Samsoni. Awọn ti o lumọ́ dè e wà ninu yará. On si já wọn kuro li apa rẹ̀ bi owu.
entries.en: Delilah therefore took new ropes, and bound him therewith, and said unto him, The Philistines be upon thee, Samson. And there were liers in wait abiding in the chamber. And he brake them from off his arms like a thread.

entries.yo: Delila si wi fun Samsoni pe, Titi di isisiyi iwọ ntàn mi ni, iwọ si npurọ́ fun mi: sọ fun mi, kili a le fi dè ọ. On si wi fun u pe, Bi iwọ ba wun ìdi irun meje ti o wà li ori mi.
entries.en: And Delilah said unto Samson, Hitherto thou hast mocked me, and told me lies: tell me wherewith thou mightest be bound. And he said unto her, If thou weavest the seven locks of my head with the web.

entries.yo: On si fi ẽkàn dè e, o si wi fun u pe, Awọn Filistini dé, Samsoni. O si jí kuro li oju orun rẹ̀, o si fà ẽkàn ìti na pẹlu ihunṣọ rẹ̀ lọ.
entries.en: And she fastened it with the pin, and said unto him, The Philistines be upon thee, Samson. And he awaked out of his sleep, and went away with the pin of the beam, and with the web.

entries.yo: On si wi fun u pe, Iwọ ha ti ṣe wipe, Emi fẹ́ ọ, nigbati ọkàn rẹ kò ṣedede pẹlu mi? iwọ ti tàn mi ni ìgba mẹta yi, iwọ kò si sọ ibiti agbara nla rẹ gbé wà fun mi.
entries.en: And she said unto him, How canst thou say, I love thee, when thine heart is not with me? thou hast mocked me these three times, and hast not told me wherein thy great strength lieth.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati o fi ọ̀rọ rẹ̀ rọ̀ ọ li ojojumọ́, ti o si ṣe e laisimi, tobẹ̃ ti sũru fi tan ọkàn rẹ̀ dé ikú.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when she pressed him daily with her words, and urged him, so that his soul was vexed unto death;

entries.yo: Li on si sọ gbogbo eyiti o wà li ọkàn rẹ̀ fun u, o si wi fun u pe, Abẹ kò kàn ori mi rí; nitoripe Nasiri Ọlọrun li emi iṣe lati inu iya mi wá: bi a ba fá ori mi, nigbana li agbara mi yio lọ kuro lọdọ mi, emi o si di alailera, emi o si dabi ọkunrin miran.
