entries.yo: Nitorina awọn ọkunrin Jabeṣi wi pe, lọla awa o jade tọ nyin wá, ẹnyin o si fi wa, ṣe bi gbogbo eyi ti o tọ loju nyin.
entries.en: Therefore the men of Jabesh said, To morrow we will come out unto you, and ye shall do with us all that seemeth good unto you.

entries.yo: O si ri bẹ̃ lọla na, Saulu si ya awọn enia na si ẹgbẹ mẹta; nwọn si wá ãrin ogun na ni iṣọ owurọ̀, nwọn si pa awọn ara Ammoni titi o fi di igba imoru ọjọ: o si ṣe awọn iyoku fọnka, tobẹ̃ ti meji wọn ko kù ni ibi kan.
entries.en: And it was so on the morrow, that Saul put the people in three companies; and they came into the midst of the host in the morning watch, and slew the Ammonites until the heat of the day: and it came to pass, that they which remained were scattered, so that two of them were not left together.

entries.yo: Awọn enia na si wi fun Samueli, pe, Tani wipe, Saulu yio ha jọba lori wa? mu awọn ọkunrin na wá, a o si pa wọn.
entries.en: And the people said unto Samuel, Who is he that said, Shall Saul reign over us? bring the men, that we may put them to death.

entries.yo: Saulu si wi pe, a kì yio pa ẹnikẹni loni yi; nitoripe loni li Oluwa ṣiṣẹ igbala ni Israeli.
entries.en: And Saul said, There shall not a man be put to death this day: for to day the LORD hath wrought salvation in Israel.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Samueli wi fun awọn enia na pe, Wá, ki a lọ si Gilgali, ki a le tun ijọba na ṣe nibẹ.
entries.en: Then said Samuel to the people, Come, and let us go to Gilgal, and renew the kingdom there.

entries.yo: Gbogbo enia na si lọ si Gilgali; nibẹ ni nwọn gbe fi Saulu jọba niwaju Oluwa ni Gilgali: nibẹ ni nwọn gbe ru ẹbọ irẹpọ̀ niwaju Oluwa; nibẹ ni Saulu ati gbogbo awọn ọkunrin Israeli si yọ ayọ̀ nlanla.
entries.en: And all the people went to Gilgal; and there they made Saul king before the LORD in Gilgal; and there they sacrificed sacrifices of peace offerings before the LORD; and there Saul and all the men of Israel rejoiced greatly.

entries.yo: SAMUELI wi fun gbogbo Israeli pe, Kiye si i, emi ti gbọ́ ohùn nyin, ninu gbogbo eyi ti ẹnyin wi fun mi, emi si ti fi ẹnikan jọba lori nyin.
entries.en: And Samuel said unto all Israel, Behold, I have hearkened unto your voice in all that ye said unto me, and have made a king over you.

entries.yo: Si wõ, nisisiyi, ọba na nrìn niwaju nyin: emi si ti di arugbo, mo si hewu; si wõ, awọn ọmọ mi si mbẹ lọdọ nyin: emi ti nrìn niwaju nyìn lati igba ewe mi wá titi o fi di oni yi.
entries.en: And now, behold, the king walketh before you: and I am old and grayheaded; and, behold, my sons are with you: and I have walked before you from my childhood unto this day.

entries.yo: Wõ, emi nĩ, jẹri si mi niwaju Oluwa, ati niwaju ẹni ami-ororo rẹ̀: malu tani mo gbà ri? tabi kẹtẹkẹtẹ tani mo gbà ri? tani mo rẹjẹ ri? tani mo jẹ ni ìya ri? tabi lọwọ́ tali emi gbà owo abẹtẹlẹ kan ri lati fi bo ara mi loju? emi o si sãn pada fun nyin.
entries.en: Behold, here I am: witness against me before the LORD, and before his anointed: whose ox have I taken? or whose ass have I taken? or whom have I defrauded? whom have I oppressed? or of whose hand have I received any bribe to blind mine eyes therewith? and I will restore it you.

entries.yo: Nwọn si wipe, Iwọ kò rẹ́ wa jẹ ri, bẹ̃ni iwọ kò jẹ ni ni ìya ri, bẹ̃ni iwọ ko gbà nkan lọwọ́ ẹnikẹni wa ri.
entries.en: And they said, Thou hast not defrauded us, nor oppressed us, neither hast thou taken ought of any man's hand.

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Oluwa li ẹlẹri si nyin, ati ẹni ami-ororo rẹ̀ ni ẹlẹri loni pe, ẹnyin kò rí nkan lọwọ́ mi. Nwọn si dahùn wipe, On li ẹlẹri.
entries.en: And he said unto them, The LORD is witness against you, and his anointed is witness this day, that ye have not found ought in my hand. And they answered, He is witness.

entries.yo: Samueli si wi fun awọn enia na pe, Oluwa li ẹniti o ti yan Mose ati Aaroni, on li ẹni ti o si mu awọn baba nyin goke ti ilẹ Egipti wá.
entries.en: And Samuel said unto the people, It is the LORD that advanced Moses and Aaron, and that brought your fathers up out of the land of Egypt.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi ẹ duro jẹ, ki emi ki o le ba nyin sọ̀rọ niwaju Oluwa niti gbogbo iṣẹ ododo Oluwa, eyi ti on ti ṣe fun nyin ati fun awọn baba nyin.
entries.en: Now therefore stand still, that I may reason with you before the LORD of all the righteous acts of the LORD, which he did to you and to your fathers.

entries.yo: Nigbati Jakobu wá si Egipti, ti awọn baba kigbe pe Oluwa, Oluwa si rán Mose ati Aaroni, awọn ẹniti o mu awọn baba nyin ti ilẹ Egypti jade wá, o si mu wọn joko nihinyi.
entries.en: When Jacob was come into Egypt, and your fathers cried unto the LORD, then the LORD sent Moses and Aaron, which brought forth your fathers out of Egypt, and made them dwell in this place.

entries.yo: Nwọn si gbagbe Oluwa Ọlọrun wọn, o si tà wọn si ọwọ́ Sisera, olori ogun Hasori, ati si ọwọ́ awọn Filistini, ati si ọwọ́ ọba Moabu, nwọn si ba wọn jà.
entries.en: And when they forgat the LORD their God, he sold them into the hand of Sisera, captain of the host of Hazor, and into the hand of the Philistines, and into the hand of the king of Moab, and they fought against them.

entries.yo: Nwọn si kigbe pe Oluwa, nwọn si wipe, Awa ti dẹsẹ̀, nitoripe awa ti kọ̀ Oluwa silẹ, awa si ti nsin Baalimu ati Aṣtaroti: ṣugbọn nisisiyi, gba wa lọwọ́ awọn ọta wa, awa o si sìn ọ.
entries.en: And they cried unto the LORD, and said, We have sinned, because we have forsaken the LORD, and have served Baalim and Ashtaroth: but now deliver us out of the hand of our enemies, and we will serve thee.

entries.yo: Oluwa si ran Jerubbaali, ati Bedani, ati Jefta ati Samueli, nwọn si gbà nyin lọwọ́ awọn ọta nyin niha gbogbo, ẹnyin si joko li alafia.
entries.en: And the LORD sent Jerubbaal, and Bedan, and Jephthah, and Samuel, and delivered you out of the hand of your enemies on every side, and ye dwelled safe.

entries.yo: Nigbati ẹnyin si ri pe Nahaṣi ọba awọn ọmọ Ammoni tọ̀ nyin wá, ẹnyin wi fun mi pe, Bẹ̃kọ, ṣugbọn ọba yio jẹ lori wa: nigbati Oluwa Ọlọrun nyin jẹ ọba nyin.
entries.en: And when ye saw that Nahash the king of the children of Ammon came against you, ye said unto me, Nay; but a king shall reign over us: when the LORD your God was your king.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi wo ọba na ti ẹnyin yàn, ati ti ẹnyin fẹ, kiye si i, Oluwa fi ọba jẹ fun nyin.
entries.en: Now therefore behold the king whom ye have chosen, and whom ye have desired! and, behold, the LORD hath set a king over you.

entries.yo: Bi ẹnyin ba bẹ̀ru Oluwa, ti ẹnyin si sin i, ti ẹnyin si gbọ́ ohùn rẹ̀, ti ẹnyin ko si tapa si ọ̀rọ Oluwa, ẹnyin ati ọba nyin ti o jẹ lori nyin yio ma wà lẹhin Oluwa Ọlọrun nyin.
entries.en: If ye will fear the LORD, and serve him, and obey his voice, and not rebel against the commandment of the LORD, then shall both ye and also the king that reigneth over you continue following the LORD your God:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi ẹnyin ko ba gbà ohun Oluwa gbọ́, ti ẹ ba si tàpá si ọ̀rọ Oluwa, ọwọ́ Oluwa yio wà lara nyin si ibi, bi o ti wà lara baba nyin.
entries.en: But if ye will not obey the voice of the LORD, but rebel against the commandment of the LORD, then shall the hand of the LORD be against you, as it was against your fathers.

entries.yo: Nitorina nisisiyi ẹ duro ki ẹ si wo nkan nla yi, ti Oluwa yio ṣe li oju nyin.
entries.en: Now therefore stand and see this great thing, which the LORD will do before your eyes.

entries.yo: Oni ki ọjọ ikore ọka bi? emi o kepe Oluwa, yio si ran ãra ati ojò; ẹnyin o si mọ̀, ẹnyin o si ri pe iwabuburu nyin pọ̀, ti ẹnyin ṣe li oju Oluwa ni bibere ọba fun ara nyin.
entries.en: Is it not wheat harvest to day? I will call unto the LORD, and he shall send thunder and rain; that ye may perceive and see that your wickedness is great, which ye have done in the sight of the LORD, in asking you a king.

entries.yo: Samueli si kepe Oluwa, Oluwa si ran ãra ati ojò ni ọjọ na: gbogbo enia si bẹru Oluwa pupọ ati Samueli.
entries.en: So Samuel called unto the LORD; and the LORD sent thunder and rain that day: and all the people greatly feared the LORD and Samuel.

entries.yo: Gbogbo enia si wi fun Samueli pe, Gbadura si Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ fun awọn iranṣẹ rẹ, ki awa ki o má ba kú: nitori ti awa ti fi buburu yi kun gbogbo ẹṣẹ wa ni bibere ọba fun ara wa.
entries.en: And all the people said unto Samuel, Pray for thy servants unto the LORD thy God, that we die not: for we have added unto all our sins this evil, to ask us a king.

entries.yo: Samueli si wi fun awọn enia na pe, Ẹ má bẹ̀ru: ẹnyin ti ṣe gbogbo buburu yi: sibẹ ẹ má pada lẹhin Oluwa, ẹ ma fi gbogbo ọkàn nyin sin Oluwa.
entries.en: And Samuel said unto the people, Fear not: ye have done all this wickedness: yet turn not aside from following the LORD, but serve the LORD with all your heart;

entries.yo: Ẹ máṣe yipada; nitori yio jasi itẹle ohun asan lẹhin, eyi ti kì yio ni ere; bẹ̃ni kì yio si gbanila; nitori asan ni nwọn.
entries.en: And turn ye not aside: for then should ye go after vain things, which cannot profit nor deliver; for they are vain.

entries.yo: Nitoriti Oluwa kì yio kọ̀ awọn enia rẹ̀ silẹ nitori orukọ rẹ̀ nla: nitoripe o wu Oluwa lati fi nyin ṣe enia rẹ̀.
entries.en: For the LORD will not forsake his people for his great name's sake: because it hath pleased the LORD to make you his people.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu bi o ṣe ti emi ni, ki a má ri i pe emi si dẹṣẹ̀ si Oluwa ni didẹkun gbadura fun nyin: emi o si kọ́ nyin li ọ̀na rere ati titọ.
entries.en: Moreover as for me, God forbid that I should sin against the LORD in ceasing to pray for you: but I will teach you the good and the right way:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹ bẹ̀ru Oluwa, ki ẹ si fi gbogbo ọkàn nyin sin i lododo: njẹ, ẹ ronu ohun nlanla ti o ṣe fun nyin.
entries.en: Only fear the LORD, and serve him in truth with all your heart: for consider how great things he hath done for you.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi ẹnyin ba hu ìwa buburu sibẹ, ẹnyin o ṣegbé t'ẹnyin t'ọba nyin.
entries.en: But if ye shall still do wickedly, ye shall be consumed, both ye and your king.

entries.yo: SAULU jọba li ọdun kan; nigbati o si jọba ọdun meji lori Israeli,
entries.en: Saul reigned one year; and when he had reigned two years over Israel,

entries.yo: Saulu si yan ẹgbẹ̃dogun ọmọkunrin fun ara rẹ̀ ni Israeli; ẹgbã si wà lọdọ Saulu ni Mikmaṣi ati li oke-nla Beteli; ẹgbẹrun si wà lọdọ Jonatani ni Gibea ti Benjamini; o si rán awọn enia ti o kù olukuluku si agọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Saul chose him three thousand men of Israel; whereof two thousand were with Saul in Michmash and in mount Bethel, and a thousand were with Jonathan in Gibeah of Benjamin: and the rest of the people he sent every man to his tent.

entries.yo: Jonatani si pa ẹgbẹ ogun awọn Filistini ti o wà ninu ile olodi ni Geba, awọn Filistini si gbọ́. Saulu fun ipè yi gbogbo ilẹ na ka, wipe, Jẹ ki awọn Heberu gbọ́.
entries.en: And Jonathan smote the garrison of the Philistines that was in Geba, and the Philistines heard of it. And Saul blew the trumpet throughout all the land, saying, Let the Hebrews hear.

entries.yo: Gbogbo Israeli si gbọ́ pe Saulu pa ẹgbẹ ogun awọn Filistini, Israeli si di irira fun awọn Filistini. Awọn enia na si pejọ lẹhin Saulu lati lọ si Gilgali.
entries.en: And all Israel heard say that Saul had smitten a garrison of the Philistines, and that Israel also was had in abomination with the Philistines. And the people were called together after Saul to Gilgal.

entries.yo: Awọn Filistini kó ara wọn jọ lati ba Israeli jà, ẹgbã-mẹ̃dogun kẹkẹ, ẹgbãta ọkunrin ẹlẹṣin, enia si pọ̀ bi yanrin leti okun; nwọn si goke, nwọn do ni Mikmaṣi ni iha ila õrun Bet-Afeni.
entries.en: And the Philistines gathered themselves together to fight with Israel, thirty thousand chariots, and six thousand horsemen, and people as the sand which is on the sea shore in multitude: and they came up, and pitched in Michmash, eastward from Beth-aven.

entries.yo: Awọn ọkunrin Israeli si ri pe, nwọn wà ninu ipọnju (nitoripe awọn enia na wà ninu ìhamọ) nigbana ni awọn enia na fi ara pamọ ninu iho, ati ninu panti, ninu apata, ni ibi giga, ati ninu kanga gbigbẹ.
entries.en: When the men of Israel saw that they were in a strait, (for the people were distressed,) then the people did hide themselves in caves, and in thickets, and in rocks, and in high places, and in pits.

entries.yo: Omiran ninu awọn Heberu goke odo Jordani si ilẹ Gadi ati Gileadi. Bi o ṣe ti Saulu, on wà ni Gilgali sibẹ, gbogbo enia na si nwariri lẹhin rẹ̀.
entries.en: And some of the Hebrews went over Jordan to the land of Gad and Gilead. As for Saul, he was yet in Gilgal, and all the people followed him trembling.

entries.yo: O si duro ni ijọ meje, de akoko ti Samueli dá fun u; ṣugbọn Samueli kò wá si Gilgali, awọn enia si tuka kuro li ọdọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he tarried seven days, according to the set time that Samuel had appointed: but Samuel came not to Gilgal; and the people were scattered from him.

entries.yo: Saulu si wipe, Mu ẹbọ sisun ati ẹbọ irẹpọ̀ na fun mi wá, o si ru ẹbọ sisun na.
entries.en: And Saul said, Bring hither a burnt offering to me, and peace offerings. And he offered the burnt offering.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, bi o ti ṣe ẹbọ ọrẹ ati ẹbọ sisun wọnni pari, si kiye si i, Samueli de; Saulu si jade lati lọ pade rẹ̀, ki o le ki i.
entries.en: And it came to pass, that as soon as he had made an end of offering the burnt offering, behold, Samuel came; and Saul went out to meet him, that he might salute him.

entries.yo: Samueli si bi i pe, Kini iwọ ṣe yi? Saulu si dahùn pe, Nitoriti emi ri pe awọn enia na ntuka kuro lọdọ mi, iwọ kò si wá li akoko ọjọ ti o dá, awọn Filistini si ko ara wọn jọ ni Mikmaṣi.
entries.en: And Samuel said, What hast thou done? And Saul said, Because I saw that the people were scattered from me, and that thou camest not within the days appointed, and that the Philistines gathered themselves together at Michmash;

entries.yo: Nitorina li emi ṣe wipe, Nisisiyi li awọn Filistini yio sọkalẹ tọ mi wá si Gilgali, bẹ̃li emi ko iti tù Oluwa loju; emi si tì ara mi si i, mo si ru ẹbọ sisun na.
entries.en: Therefore said I, The Philistines will come down now upon me to Gilgal, and I have not made supplication unto the LORD: I forced myself therefore, and offered a burnt offering.

entries.yo: Samueli si wi fun Saulu pe, iwọ kò hu iwà ọlọgbọ́n: iwọ ko pa ofin Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ mọ, ti on ti pa li aṣẹ fun ọ: nitori nisisiyi li Oluwa iba fi idi ijọba rẹ kalẹ̀ lori Israeli lailai.
entries.en: And Samuel said to Saul, Thou hast done foolishly: thou hast not kept the commandment of the LORD thy God, which he commanded thee: for now would the LORD have established thy kingdom upon Israel for ever.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nisisiyi ijọba rẹ kì yio duro pẹ: Oluwa ti wá fun ara rẹ̀ ọkunrin ti o wù u li ọkàn rẹ̀, Oluwa paṣẹ fun u ki o ṣe olori fun awọn enia rẹ̀, nitoripe iwọ kò pa aṣẹ ti Oluwa fi fun ọ mọ.
entries.en: But now thy kingdom shall not continue: the LORD hath sought him a man after his own heart, and the LORD hath commanded him to be captain over his people, because thou hast not kept that which the LORD commanded thee.

entries.yo: Samueli si dide, o si lọ lati Gilgali si Gibea ti Benjamini. Saulu si ka awọn enia ti o wà lọdọ rẹ̀, o jẹ iwọ̀n ẹgbẹta ọkunrin.
entries.en: And Samuel arose, and gat him up from Gilgal unto Gibeah of Benjamin. And Saul numbered the people that were present with him, about six hundred men.

entries.yo: Saulu, ati Jonatani ọmọ rẹ̀, ati awọn enia na ti o wà lọdọ wọn si joko ni Gibea ti Benjamini, ṣugbọn awọn Filistini do ni Mikmaṣi.
entries.en: And Saul, and Jonathan his son, and the people that were present with them, abode in Gibeah of Benjamin: but the Philistines encamped in Michmash.

entries.yo: Ẹgbẹ awọn onisùmọ̀mi mẹta jade ni ibudo awọn Filistini: ẹgbẹ kan gbà ọ̀na ti Ofra, si ilẹ Ṣuali.
entries.en: And the spoilers came out of the camp of the Philistines in three companies: one company turned unto the way that leadeth to Ophrah, unto the land of Shual:

entries.yo: Ẹgbẹ kan si gba ọ̀na Bet-horoni: ati ẹgbẹ kan si gbà ọ̀na agbegbe nì ti o kọju si afonifoji Seboimu ti o wà ni iha iju.
entries.en: A nd anot her company turned the way to Beth-horon: and another company turned to the way of the border that looketh to the valley of Zeboim toward the wilderness.

entries.yo: Kò si alagbẹdẹ ninu gbogbo ilẹ Israeli: nitori ti awọn Filistini wipe, Ki awọn Heberu ki o má ba rọ idà tabi ọ̀kọ.
entries.en: Now there was no smith found throughout all the land of Israel: for the Philistines said, Lest the Hebrews make them swords or spears:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn gbogbo Israeli a ma tọ̀ awọn Filistini lọ, olukuluku lati pọ́n doje rẹ̀, ati ọ̀kọ rẹ̀, ati ãke rẹ̀, ati ọ̀ṣọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: But all the Israelites went down to the Philistines, to sharpen every man his share, and his coulter, and his axe, and his mattock.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nwọn ni ayùn fun ọ̀ṣọ, ati fun ọ̀kọ, ati fun òya-irin ti ilẹ, ati fun ãke, ati lati pọn irin ọpa oluṣọ malu.
entries.en: Yet they had a file for the mattocks, and for the coulters, and for the forks, and for the axes, and to sharpen the goads.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li o si ṣe li ọjọ ijà, ti a kò ri idà, tabi ọ̀kọ lọwọ ẹnikẹni ninu awọn enia ti o wà lọdọ Saulu ati Jonatani; lọdọ Saulu ati Jonatani ọmọ rẹ̀ li a ri.
entries.en: So it came to pass in the day of battle, that there was neither sword nor spear found in the hand of any of the people that were with Saul and Jonathan: but with Saul and with Jonathan his son was there found.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ-ogun Filistini jade lọ si ikọja Mikmaṣi.
entries.en: And the garrison of the Philistines went out to the passage of Michmash.

entries.yo: O si ṣe li ọjọ kan, Jonatani ọmọ Saulu si wi fun ọdọmọkunrin ti o nru ihamọra rẹ̀, pe, Wá, jẹ ki a rekọja lọ si ibudo-ogun awọn Filistini ti o wà niha keji. Ṣugbọn on kò sọ fun baba rẹ̀.
entries.en: Now it came to pass upon a day, that Jonathan the son of Saul said unto the young man that bare his armour, Come, and let us go over to the Philistines' garrison, that is on the other side. But he told not his father.

entries.yo: Saulu si duro ni iha ipinlẹ Gibea labẹ igi ìbo eyi ti o wà ni Migronu: awọn enia ti o wà lọdọ rẹ̀ to iwọn ẹgbẹta ọkunrin.
entries.en: And Saul tarried in the uttermost part of Gibeah under a pomegranate tree which is in Migron: and the people that were with him were about six hundred men;

entries.yo: Ahia ọmọ Ahitubu, arakunrin Ikabodu ọmọ Finehasi, ọmọ Eli, alufa Oluwa ni Ṣilo, ti nwọ̀ Efodu. Awọn enia na kò si mọ̀ pe Jonatani ti lọ.
entries.en: And Ahiah, the son of Ahitub, I-chabod's brother, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eli, the LORD's priest in Shiloh, wearing an ephod. And the people knew not that Jonathan was gone.

entries.yo: Larin meji ọ̀na wọnni, eyi ti Jonatani ti nwá lati lọ si ile ọmọ-ogun olodi ti Filistini, okuta mimú kan wà li apa kan, okuta mímú kan si wà li apa keji: orukọ ekini si njẹ Bosesi, orukọ ekeji si njẹ Sene.
entries.en: And between the passages, by which Jonathan sought to go over unto the Philistines' garrison, there was a sharp rock on the one side and a sharp rock on the other side: and the name of the one was Bozez, and the name of the other Seneh.

entries.yo: Ṣonṣo okuta ọkan wà ni ariwa kọju si Mikmaṣi, ti ekeji si wà ni gusù niwaju Gibea.
entries.en: The forefront of the one was situate northward over against Michmash, and the other southward over against Gibeah.

entries.yo: Jonatani wi fun ọdọmọdekunrin ti o rù ihamọra rẹ̀ pe, Wá, si jẹ ki a lọ si budo-ogun awọn alaikọla yi: bọya Oluwa yio ṣiṣẹ fun wa: nitoripe kò si idiwọ fun Oluwa lati fi pipọ tabi diẹ gba là.
entries.en: And Jonathan said to the young man that bare his armour, Come, and let us go over unto the garrison of these uncircumcised: it may be that the LORD will work for us: for there is no restraint to the LORD to save by many or by few.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o rù ihamọra rẹ̀ na wi fun u pe, Ṣe gbogbo eyi ti o mbẹ li ọkàn rẹ: ṣe bi o ti tọ́ li ọkàn rẹ; wõ, emi wà pẹlu rẹ gẹgẹ bi ti ọkàn rẹ.
entries.en: And his armourbearer said unto him, Do all that is in thine heart: turn thee; behold, I am with thee according to thy heart.

entries.yo: Jonatani si wi pe, Kiye si i, awa o rekọja sọdọ awọn ọkunrin wọnyi, a o si fi ara wa hàn fun wọn.
entries.en: Then said Jonathan, Behold, we will pass over unto these men, and we will discover ourselves unto them.

entries.yo: Bi nwọn ba wi fun wa pe, Ẹ duro titi awa o fi tọ̀ nyin wá; awa o si duro, awa kì yio si goke tọ̀ wọn lọ.
entries.en: If they say thus unto us, Tarry until we come to you; then we will stand still in our place, and will not go up unto them.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi nwọn ba wi pe, Goke tọ̀ wa wá; a o si goke lọ: nitori pe Oluwa ti fi wọn le wa lọwọ́; eyi ni o si jẹ àmi fun wa.
entries.en: But if they say thus, Come up unto us; then we will go up: for the LORD hath delivered them into our hand: and this shall be a sign unto us.

entries.yo: Awọn mejeji fi ara wọn hàn fun ogun Filistini: awọn Filistini si wipe, Wõ, awọn Heberu ti inu iho wọn jade wá, nibiti nwọn ti fi ara pamọ si.
entries.en: And both of them discovered themselves unto the garrison of the Philistines: and the Philistines said, Behold, the Hebrews come forth out of the holes where they had hid themselves.

entries.yo: Awọn ọkunrin ile olodi na si da Jonatani ati ẹniti o rù ihamọra rẹ̀ lohùn, nwọn si wipe, Goke tọ̀ wa wá, awa o si fi nkan hàn nyin; Jonatani si wi fun ẹniti o rù ihamọra rẹ̀ pe, Ma tọ̀ mi lẹhìn; nitoripe Oluwa ti fi wọn le awọn enia Israeli lọwọ.
entries.en: And the men of the garrison answered Jonathan and his armourbearer, and said, Come up to us, and we will shew you a thing. And Jonathan said unto his armourbearer, Come up after me: for the LORD hath delivered them into the hand of Israel.

entries.yo: Jonatani rakò goke, ati ẹniti o rù ihamọra rẹ̀ lẹhin rẹ̀; awọn Filistini si subu niwaju Jonatani; ati ẹniti o rù ihamọra rẹ̀ npa lẹhin rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Jonathan climbed up upon his hands and upon his feet, and his armourbearer after him: and they fell before Jonathan; and his armourbearer slew after him.

entries.yo: Pipa ikini, eyi ti Jonatani ati ẹniti o rù ihamọra rẹ̀ ṣe, o jasi iwọn ogún ọkunrin ninu abọ iṣẹko kan ti malu meji iba tú.
entries.en: And that first slaughter, which Jonathan and his armourbearer made, was about twenty men, within as it were an half acre of land, which a yoke of oxen might plow.

entries.yo: Ibẹ̀ru si wà ninu ogun na, ni pápá, ati ninu gbogbo awọn enia na; ile ọmọ-ogun olodi, ati awọn ti iko ikogun, awọn pẹlu bẹ̀ru; ilẹ sì mi: bẹ̃li o si jasi ọwáriri nlanla.
entries.en: And there was trembling in the host, in the field, and among all the people: the garrison, and the spoilers, they also trembled, and the earth quaked: so it was a very great trembling.

entries.yo: Awọn ọkunrin ti nṣọ́na fun Saulu ni Gibea ti Benjamini wò; nwọn si ri ọpọlọpọ awọn enia na tuka, nwọn si npa ara wọn bi nwọn ti nlọ.
entries.en: And the watchmen of Saul in Gibeah of Benjamin looked; and, behold, the multitude melted away, and they went on beating down one another.

entries.yo: Saulu si wi fun awọn enia ti o wà lọdọ rẹ̀ pe, Njẹ ẹ kà awọn enia na ki ẹ si mọ̀ ẹniti o jade kuro ninu wa. Nwọn si kà, si kiye si i, Jonatani ati ẹniti o rù ihamọra rẹ̀ kò si si.
entries.en: Then said Saul unto the people that were with him, Number now, and see who is gone from us. And when they had numbered, behold, Jonathan and his armourbearer were not there.

entries.yo: Saulu si wi fun Ahia pe, Gbe apoti Ọlọrun na wá nihinyi. Nitoripe apoti Ọlọrun wà lọdọ awọn ọmọ Israeli li akokò na.
entries.en: And Saul said unto Ahiah, Bring hither the ark of God. For the ark of God was at that time with the children of Israel.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, bi Saulu ti mba alufa na sọ̀rọ, ariwo ti o wà ni budo awọn Filistini si npọ̀ si i: Saulu si wi fun alufa na pe, dawọ́ duro.
entries.en: And it came to pass, while Saul talked unto the priest, that the noise that was in the host of the Philistines went on and increased: and Saul said unto the priest, Withdraw thine hand.

entries.yo: Saulu ati gbogbo enia ti o wà lọdọ rẹ̀ ko ara wọn jọ pọ̀, nwọn wá si oju ija: kiye si i, ida olukuluku si wà li ara ọmọnikeji rẹ̀, rudurudu na si pọ̀ gidigidi.
entries.en: And Saul and all the people that were with him assembled themselves, and they came to the battle: and, behold, every man's sword was against his fellow, and there was a very great discomfiture.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu awọn Heberu ti o wà lọdọ awọn Filistini nigba atijọ, ti o si ti goke ba wọn lọ si budo lati ilu ti o wà yikakiri, awọn na pẹlu si yipada lati dapọ̀ mọ awọn Israeli ti o wà lọdọ Saulu ati Jonatani.
entries.en: Moreover the Hebrews that were with the Philistines before that time, which went up with them into the camp from the country round about, even they also turned to be with the Israelites that were with Saul and Jonathan.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ gẹgẹ nigbati gbogbo awọn ọkunrin Israeli ti o ti pa ara wọn mọ ninu okenla Efraimu gbọ́ pe awọn Filistini sa, awọn na pẹlu tẹle wọn lẹhin kikan ni ijà na.
entries.en: Likewise all the men of Israel which had hid themselves in mount Ephraim, when they heard that the Philistines fled, even they also followed hard after them in the battle.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li Oluwa si gbà Israeli là lọjọ na: ija na si rekọja si Bet-afeni.
entries.en: So the LORD saved Israel that day: and the battle passed over unto Beth-aven.

entries.yo: Awọn ọkunrin Israeli si ri ipọnju gidigidi ni ijọ na: nitoriti Saulu fi awọn enia na bu pe, Ifibu ni fun ẹniti o jẹ onjẹ titi di alẹ titi emi o si fi gbẹsan lara awọn ọta mi. Bẹ̃ni kò si ẹnikan ninu awọn enia na ti o fi ẹnu kan onjẹ.
entries.en: And the men of Israel were distressed that day: for Saul had adjured the people, saying, Cursed be the man that eateth any food until evening, that I may be avenged on mine enemies. So none of the people tasted any food.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn ara ilẹ na si de igbo kan, oyin sì wà lori ilẹ na.
entries.en: And all they of the land came to a wood; and there was honey upon the ground.

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn enia si wọ inu igbo na, si kiye si i oyin na nkán; ṣugbọn kò si ẹnikan ti o mu ọwọ́ rẹ̀ re ẹnu rẹ̀: nitoripe awọn enia bẹ̀ru ifibu na.
entries.en: And when the people were come into the wood, behold, the honey dropped; but no man put his hand to his mouth: for the people feared the oath.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Jonatani kò gbọ́ nigbati baba rẹ̀ fi ifibu kilọ fun awọn enia na: o si tẹ ori ọpa ti mbẹ lọwọ rẹ̀ bọ afara oyin na, o si fi i si ẹnu rẹ̀, oju rẹ̀ mejeji si walẹ.
entries.en: But Jonathan heard not when his father charged the people with the oath: wherefore he put forth the end of the rod that was in his hand, and dipped it in an honeycomb, and put his hand to his mouth; and his eyes were enlightened.

entries.yo: Nigbana li ọkan ninu awọn enia na dahùn wipe, baba rẹ ti fi ifibu kilọ fun awọn enia na, pe, ifibu li ọkunrin na ti o jẹ onjẹ li oni. Arẹ̀ si mu awọn enia na.
entries.en: Then answered one of the people, and said, Thy father straitly charged the people with an oath, saying, Cursed be the man that eateth any food this day. And the people were faint.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Jonatani wipe, baba mi yọ ilu li ẹnu, sa wo bi oju mi ti walẹ, nitori ti emi tọ diẹ wò ninu oyin yi.
entries.en: Then said Jonathan, My father hath troubled the land: see, I pray you, how mine eyes have been enlightened, because I tasted a little of this honey.

entries.yo: A! nitotọ, ibaṣepe awọn enia na ti jẹ ninu ikogun awọn ọta wọn ti nwọn ri, pipa awọn Filistini iba ti pọ to?
entries.en: How much more, if haply the people had eaten freely to day of the spoil of their enemies which they found? for had there not been now a much greater slaughter among the Philistines?

entries.yo: Nwọn pa ninu awọn Filistini li ọjọ na, lati Mikmaṣi de Aijaloni: o si rẹ̀ awọn enia na gidigidi.
entries.en: And they smote the Philistines that day from Michmash to Aijalon: and the people were very faint.

entries.yo: Awọn enia sare si ikogun na, nwọn si mu agutan, ati malu, ati ọmọ-malu, nwọn si pa wọn sori ilẹ: awọn enia na si jẹ wọn t'ẹjẹ t'ẹjẹ.
entries.en: And the people flew upon the spoil, and took sheep, and oxen, and calves, and slew them on the ground: and the people did eat them with the blood.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni nwọn wi fun Saulu pe, kiye si i, awọn enia na dẹ̀ṣẹ si Oluwa, li eyi ti nwọn jẹ ẹjẹ. On si wipe, Ẹnyin ṣẹ̀ kọja: yi okuta nla fun mi wá loni.
entries.en: Then they told Saul, saying, Behold, the people sin against the LORD, in that they eat with the blood. And he said, Ye have transgressed: roll a great stone unto me this day.

entries.yo: Saulu si wipe, Ẹ tu ara nyin ka sarin awọn enia na ki ẹ si wi fun wọn pe, Ki olukuluku ọkunrin mu malu tirẹ̀ tọ̀ mi wá, ati olukuluku ọkunrin agutan rẹ̀, ki ẹ si pa wọn nihin, ki ẹ si jẹ, ki ẹ má si ṣẹ̀ si Oluwa, ni jijẹ ẹjẹ. Gbogbo enia olukuluku ọkunrin mu malu rẹ̀ wá li alẹ na, nwọn si pa wọn ni ibẹ̀.
entries.en: And Saul said, Disperse yourselves among the people, and say unto them, Bring me hither every man his ox, and every man his sheep, and slay them here, and eat; and sin not against the LORD in eating with the blood. And all the people brought every man his ox with him that night, and slew them there.

entries.yo: Saulu si tẹ pẹpẹ kan fun Oluwa; eyi ni pẹpẹ ti o kọ ṣe fun Oluwa.
entries.en: And Saul built an altar unto the LORD: the same was the first altar that he built unto the LORD.

entries.yo: Saulu wipe, Ẹ jẹ ki a sọkalẹ tọ̀ awọn Filistini lọ li oru, ki a ba wọn ja titi di imọlẹ owurọ̀, ẹ má jẹ ki a fi ọkunrin kan silẹ ninu wọn. Nwọn si wipe, Ṣe gbogbo eyi ti o tọ loju rẹ. Nigbana ni alufa ni si wipe, Ẹ jẹ ki a sunmọ ihinyi si Ọlọrun.
entries.en: And Saul said, Let us go down after the Philistines by night, and spoil them until the morning light, and let us not leave a man of them. And they said, Do whatsoever seemeth good unto thee. Then said the priest, Let us draw near hither unto God.

entries.yo: Saulu si bere lọdọ Ọlọrun pe, ki emi ki o sọkalẹ tọ̀ awọn Filistini lọ bi? Iwọ o fi wọn lé Israeli lọwọ́ bi? ṣugbọn kò da a lohùn li ọjọ na.
entries.en: And Saul asked counsel of God, Shall I go down after the Philistines? wilt thou deliver them into the hand of Israel? But he answered him not that day.

entries.yo: Saulu si wipe Mu gbogbo awọn àgba enia sunmọ ihinyi, ki ẹ mọ̀, ki ẹ si ri ibiti ẹ̀ṣẹ yi wà loni.
entries.en: And Saul said, Draw ye near hither, all the chief of the people: and know and see wherein this sin hath been this day.

entries.yo: Nitoripe gẹgẹ bi Oluwa ti wà ti o ti gbà Israeli là bi o tilẹ ṣepe a ri i lara Jonatani ọmọ mi, nitõtọ yio kú. Ṣugbọn ninu gbogbo enia na, kò si ẹniti o da a lohùn.
entries.en: For, as the LORD liveth, which saveth Israel, though it be in Jonathan my son, he shall surely die. But there was not a man among all the people that answered him.

entries.yo: Saulu si wi fun gbogbo awọn Israeli pe, Ẹnyin lọ si apakan, emi ati Jonatani ọmọ mi a si lọ si apakan. Gbogbo enia si wi fun Saulu pe, Ṣe eyi ti o tọ ni oju rẹ.
entries.en: Then said he unto all Israel, Be ye on one side, and I and Jonathan my son will be on the other side. And the people said unto Saul, Do what seemeth good unto thee.

entries.yo: Saulu si wi fun Oluwa Ọlọrun Israeli pe, fun mi ni ibò ti o pé. A si mu Saulu ati Jonatani: ṣugbọn awọn enia na yege.
entries.en: Therefore Saul said unto the LORD God of Israel, Give a perfect lot. And Saul and Jonathan were taken: but the people escaped.

entries.yo: Saulu si wipe, Di ibò ti emi ati ti Jonatani ọmọ mi. Ibò na si mu Jonatani.
entries.en: And Saul said, Cast lots between me and Jonathan my son. And Jonathan was taken.

entries.yo: Saulu si wi fun Jonatani pe, Sọ nkan ti o ṣe fun mi. Jonatani si sọ fun u, o si wipe, Nitõtọ mo fi ori ọ̀pá ti mbẹ li ọwọ́ mi tọ́ oyin diẹ wò, wõ emi mura ati kú.
entries.en: Then Saul said to Jonathan, Tell me what thou hast done. And Jonathan told him, and said, I did but taste a little honey with the end of the rod that was in mine hand, and, lo, I must die.

entries.yo: Saulu si wipe, ki Ọlọrun ki o ṣe bẹ̃ ati ju bẹ̃ lọ pẹlu: nitoripe iwọ Jonatani yio sa kú dandan.
entries.en: And Saul answered, God do so and more also: for thou shalt surely die, Jonathan.

entries.yo: Awọn enia si wi fun Saulu pe, Jonatani yio kú, ti o ṣe igbala nla yi ni Israeli? ki a má ri i; bi Oluwa ti wà, ọkan ninu irun ori rẹ̀ kì yio bọ́ silẹ; nitoripe o ba Ọlọrun ṣiṣẹ pọ̀ loni. Bẹ̃li awọn enia si gbà Jonatani silẹ, kò si kú.
entries.en: And the people said unto Saul, Shall Jonathan die, who hath wrought this great salvation in Israel? God forbid: as the LORD liveth, there shall not one hair of his head fall to the ground; for he hath wrought with God this day. So the people rescued Jonathan, that he died not.

entries.yo: Saulu si ṣiwọ ati ma lepa awọn Filistini: Awọn Filistini si lọ si ilu wọn.
entries.en: Then Saul went up from following the Philistines: and the Philistines went to their own place.

entries.yo: Saulu si jọba lori Israeli; o si bá gbogbo awọn ọta rẹ̀ jà yika, eyini ni Moabu ati awọn ọmọ Ammoni, ati Edomu, ati awọn ọba Soba ati awọn Filistini: ati ibikibi ti o yi si, a bà wọn ninu jẹ.
entries.en: So Saul took the kingdom over Israel, and fought against all his enemies on every side, against Moab, and against the children of Ammon, and against Edom, and against the kings of Zobah, and against the Philistines: and whithersoever he turned himself, he vexed them.

entries.yo: O si ko ogun jọ, o si kọlu awọn Amaleki, o si gbà Israeli silẹ lọwọ awọn ti o nkó wọn.
entries.en: And he gathered an host, and smote the Amalekites, and delivered Israel out of the hands of them that spoiled them.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Saulu si ni Jonatani, ati Iṣui, ati Malkiṣua; ati orukọ ọmọbinrin rẹ̀ mejeji si ni wọnyi; orukọ akọbi ni Merabu, ati orukọ aburo ni Mikali:
entries.en: Now the sons of Saul were Jonathan, and Ishui, and Melchi-shua: and the names of his two daughters were these; the name of the firstborn Merab, and the name of the younger Michal:

entries.yo: Ati orukọ aya Saulu ni Ahinoamu, ọmọbinrin Ahimaasi, ati orukọ olori ogun rẹ̀ ni Abneri ọmọ Neri arakunrin baba Saulu.
entries.en: And the name of Saul's wife was Ahinoam, the daughter of Ahimaaz: and the name of the captain of his host was Abner, the son of Ner, Saul's uncle.

entries.yo: Kiṣi si ni baba Saulu; ati Neri ni baba Abneri ọmọ Abieli.
entries.en: And Kish was the father of Saul; and Ner the father of Abner was the son of Abiel.

entries.yo: Ogun na si le si awọn Filistini ni gbogbo ọjọ Saulu: bi Saulu ba ri ẹnikan ti o li agbara, tabi akikanju ọkunrin, a mu u sọdọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And there was sore war against the Philistines all the days of Saul: and when Saul saw any strong man, or any valiant man, he took him unto him.

entries.yo: SAMUELI si wi fun Saulu pe, Oluwa rán mi lati fi ami ororo yàn ọ li ọba, lori enia rẹ̀, lori Israeli, nitorina nisisiyi iwọ fetisi ohùn ọ̀rọ Oluwa.
entries.en: Samuel also said unto Saul, The LORD sent me to anoint thee to be king over his people, over Israel: now therefore hearken thou unto the voice of the words of the LORD.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi, emi ranti eyi ti Amaleki ti ṣe si Israeli, bi o ti lumọ dè e li ọ̀na, nigbati on goke ti Egipti jade wá.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, I remember that which Amalek did to Israel, how he laid wait for him in the way, when he came up from Egypt.

entries.yo: Lọ nisisiyi ki o si kọlu Amaleki, ki o si pa gbogbo nkan wọn li aparun, má si ṣe da wọn si; ṣugbọn pa ati ọkunrin ati obinrin wọn, ọmọ kekere ati awọn ti o wà li ẹnu ọmu, malu ati agutan, ibakasiẹ ati kẹtẹkẹtẹ.
entries.en: Now go and smite Amalek, and utterly destroy all that they have, and spare them not; but slay both man and woman, infant and suckling, ox and sheep, camel and ass.

entries.yo: Saulu si ko awọn enia na jọ pọ̀ o si ka iye wọn ni Telaimu, nwọn si jẹ ogun ọkẹ awọn ọkunrin ogun ẹlẹsẹ, pẹlu ẹgbarun awọn ọkunrin Juda.
entries.en: And Saul gathered the people together, and numbered them in Telaim, two hundred thousand footmen, and ten thousand men of Judah.

entries.yo: Saulu si wá si ilu-nla kan ti awọn ara Amaleki, o si ba dè wọn li afonifoji kan.
entries.en: And Saul came to a city of Amalek, and laid wait in the valley.

entries.yo: Saulu si wi fun awọn Keniti pe, Ẹ lọ, yẹra kuro larin awọn ara Amaleki, ki emi ki o má ba run nyin pẹlu wọn: nitoripe ẹnyin ṣe ore fun gbogbo awọn ọmọ Israeli nigbati nwọn goke ti Egipti wá. Awọn Keniti yẹra kuro larin Amaleki.
entries.en: And Saul said unto the Kenites, Go, depart, get you down from among the Amalekites, lest I destroy you with them: for ye shewed kindness to all the children of Israel, when they came up out of Egypt. So the Kenites departed from among the Amalekites.

entries.yo: Saulu si kọlu Amaleki lati Hafila titi iwọ o fi de Ṣuri, ti o wà li apa keji Egipti.
entries.en: And Saul smote the Amalekites from Havilah until thou comest to Shur, that is over against Egypt.

entries.yo: O si mu Agagi Ọba Amaleki lãye, o si fi oju ida run gbogbo awọn enia na.
entries.en: And he took Agag the king of the Amalekites alive, and utterly destroyed all the people with the edge of the sword.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Saulu ati awọn enia na da Agagi si, ati eyi ti o dara julọ ninu agutan ati ninu malu, ati ohun eyi ti o dara tobẹ̃ ninu wọn, ati ọdọ-agutan abọpa, ati gbogbo nkan ti o dara; nwọn kò si fẹ pa wọn run: ṣugbọn gbogbo nkan ti kò dara ti kò si nilari ni nwọn parun patapata.
entries.en: But Saul and the people spared Agag, and the best of the sheep, and of the oxen, and of the fatlings, and the lambs, and all that was good, and would not utterly destroy them: but every thing that was vile and refuse, that they destroyed utterly.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ọ̀rọ Oluwa tọ Samueli wá wipe,
entries.en: Then came the word of the LORD unto Samuel, saying,

entries.yo: Emi kãnu gidigidi ti emi fi Saulu jọba: nitoriti o ti yipada lẹhin mi, kò si mu ọ̀rọ mi ṣẹ. O si ba Samueli ninu jẹ gidigidi; on si kepe Oluwa ni gbogbo oru na.
entries.en: It repenteth me that I have set up Saul to be king: for he is turned back from following me, and hath not performed my commandments. And it grieved Samuel; and he cried unto the LORD all night.

entries.yo: Nigbati Samueli si dide ni kutukutu owurọ̀ lati pade Saulu, nwọn si sọ fun Samueli pe, Saulu ti wá si Karmeli, sa wõ, on kọ ibi kan fun ara rẹ̀ o si ti lọ, o si kọja siwaju, o si sọkalẹ lọ si Gilgali.
entries.en: And when Samuel rose early to meet Saul in the morning, it was told Samuel, saying, Saul came to Carmel, and, behold, he set him up a place, and is gone about, and passed on, and gone down to Gilgal.

entries.yo: Samueli si tọ Saulu wá: Saulu si wi fun u pe, Alabukún ni ọ lati ọdọ Oluwa wá: emi ti ṣe eyi ti Oluwa ran mi.
entries.en: And Samuel came to Saul: and Saul said unto him, Blessed be thou of the LORD: I have performed the commandment of the LORD.

entries.yo: Samueli si wipe, njẹ ewo ni igbe agutan ti emi ngbọ́ li eti mi, ati igbe malu ti emi ngbọ́?
entries.en: And Samuel said, What meaneth then this bleating of the sheep in mine ears, and the lowing of the oxen which I hear?

entries.yo: Saulu si wi fun u pe, eyi ti nwọn mu ti Amaleki wá ni, ti awọn enia dasi ninu awọn agutan ton ti malu ti o dara julọ lati fi rubọ si Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ; a si pa eyi ti o kù run.
entries.en: And Saul said, They have brought them from the Amalekites: for the people spared the best of the sheep and of the oxen, to sacrifice unto the LORD thy God; and the rest we have utterly destroyed.

entries.yo: Samueli si wi fun Saulu pe, Duro, emi o si sọ eyi ti Oluwa wi fun mi li alẹ yi. On si wi fun u pe, Ma wi.
entries.en: Then Samuel said unto Saul, Stay, and I will tell thee what the LORD hath said to me this night. And he said unto him, Say on.

entries.yo: Samueli si wipe, Iwọ kò ha kere loju ara rẹ nigbati a fi ọ ṣe olori ẹya Israeli, ti Oluwa fi àmi ororo sọ ọ di ọba Israeli?
entries.en: And Samuel said, When thou wast little in thine own sight, wast thou not made the head of the tribes of Israel, and the LORD anointed thee king over Israel?

entries.yo: Oluwa si rán ọ ni iṣẹ, o si wipe, Lọ, ki o si pa awọn ẹlẹṣẹ ara Amaleki run, ki o si ba wọn jà titi o fi run wọn.
entries.en: And the LORD sent thee on a journey, and said, Go and utterly destroy the sinners the Amalekites, and fight against them until they be consumed.

entries.yo: Eha si ti ṣe ti iwọ kò fi gbọ́ ohùn Oluwa ṣugbọn iwọ si sare si ikogun, ti iwọ si ṣe buburu li oju Oluwa.
entries.en: Wherefore then didst thou not obey the voice of the LORD, but didst fly upon the spoil, and didst evil in the sight of the LORD?

entries.yo: Saulu si wi fun Samueli pe, Nitotọ, emi gbà ohùn Oluwa gbọ́, emi si ti lọ li ọ̀na ti Oluwa ran mi, emi si ti mu Agagi ọba Amaleki wá, emi si ti pa ara Amaleki run.
entries.en: And Saul said unto Samuel, Yea, I have obeyed the voice of the LORD, and have gone the way which the LORD sent me, and have brought Agag the king of Amalek, and have utterly destroyed the Amalekites.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn enia na ti mu ninu ikogun, agutan ati malu, pàtaki nkan wọnni ti a ba pa run, lati fi rubọ si Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ ni Gilgali.
entries.en: But the people took of the spoil, sheep and oxen, the chief of the things which should have been utterly destroyed, to sacrifice unto the LORD thy God in Gilgal.

entries.yo: Samueli si wipe, Oluwa ha ni inu-didun si ọrẹ sisun ati ẹbọ bi pe ki a gbà ohùn Oluwa gbọ́? kiye si i, igbọran sàn jù ẹbọ lọ, ifetisilẹ̀ si sàn jù ọra àgbo lọ.
entries.en: And Samuel said, Hath the LORD as great delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices, as in obeying the voice of the LORD? Behold, to obey is better than sacrifice, and to hearken than the fat of rams.

entries.yo: Nitoripe iṣọtẹ dabi ẹ̀ṣẹ afọṣẹ, ati agidi gẹgẹ bi ìwa buburu ati ibọriṣa. Nitoripe iwọ kọ̀ ọ̀rọ Oluwa, on si kọ̀ ọ li ọba.
entries.en: For rebellion is as the sin of witchcraft, and stubbornness is as iniquity and idolatry. Because thou hast rejected the word of the LORD, he hath also rejected thee from being king.

entries.yo: Saulu si wi fun Samueli pe, Emi ti ṣẹ̀: nitoriti emi ti re ofin Oluwa kọja, ati ọ̀rọ rẹ̀: nitori emi bẹ̀ru awọn enia, emi si gbà ohùn wọn gbọ́.
entries.en: And Saul said unto Samuel, I have sinned: for I have transgressed the commandment of the LORD, and thy words: because I feared the people, and obeyed their voice.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nisisiyi, emi bẹ̀ ọ, dari ẹ̀ṣẹ mi jì mi, ki o sì yipada pẹlu mi, ki emi ki o le tẹriba niwaju Oluwa.
entries.en: Now therefore, I pray thee, pardon my sin, and turn again with me, that I may worship the LORD.

entries.yo: Samueli si wi fun Saulu pe, emi kì yio tun yipada pẹlu rẹ mọ nitoriti iwọ ti kọ̀ ọ̀rọ Oluwa, Oluwa si ti kọ̀ iwọ lati ma jẹ ọba lori Israeli.
entries.en: And Samuel said unto Saul, I will not return with thee: for thou hast rejected the word of the LORD, and the LORD hath rejected thee from being king over Israel.

entries.yo: Bi Samueli si ti yipada lati lọ, o si di ẹ̀wu ileke rẹ̀ mu, o si faya mọ̃ lọwọ́.
entries.en: And as Samuel turned about to go away, he laid hold upon the skirt of his mantle, and it rent.

entries.yo: Samueli si wi fun u pe, Oluwa fa ijọba Israeli ya kuro lọwọ rẹ loni, o si fi fun aladugbo rẹ kan, ti o sàn ju ọ lọ.
entries.en: And Samuel said unto him, The LORD hath rent the kingdom of Israel from thee this day, and hath given it to a neighbour of thine, that is better than thou.

entries.yo: Agbara Israeli kì yio ṣeke bẹ̃ni kì yio si ronupiwada: nitoripe ki iṣe ẹda ti yio fi ronupiwada.
entries.en: And also the Strength of Israel will not lie nor repent: for he is not a man, that he should repent.

entries.yo: O si wipe, emi ti dẹ̀ṣẹ: ṣugbọn bu ọlá fun mi, jọwọ, niwaju awọn agbãgbà enia mi, ati niwaju Israeli, ki o si tun yipada pẹlu mi, ki emi ki o le tẹriba niwaju Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ.
entries.en: Then he said, I have sinned: yet honour me now, I pray thee, before the elders of my people, and before Israel, and turn again with me, that I may worship the LORD thy God.

entries.yo: Samueli si yipada, o si tẹle Saulu; Saulu si tẹriba niwaju Oluwa.
entries.en: So Samuel turned again after Saul; and Saul worshipped the LORD.

entries.yo: Samueli si wipe, Mu Agagi ọba awọn ara Amaleki na tọ̀ mi wá nihinyi. Agagi si tọ̀ ọ wá ni idaraya. Agagi si wipe, Nitotọ ikoro ikú ti kọja.
entries.en: Then said Samuel, Bring ye hither to me Agag the king of the Amalekites. And Agag came unto him delicately. And Agag said, Surely the bitterness of death is past.

entries.yo: Samueli si wipe, Gẹgẹ bi idà rẹ ti sọ awọn obinrin di alaili ọmọ, bẹ̃ gẹgẹ ni iya rẹ yio si di alaili ọmọ larin obinrin. Samueli si pa Agagi niwaju Oluwa ni Gilgali.
entries.en: And Samuel said, As thy sword hath made women childless, so shall thy mother be childless among women. And Samuel hewed Agag in pieces before the LORD in Gilgal.

entries.yo: Samueli si lọ si Rama; Saulu si goke lọ si ile rẹ̀ ni Gibea ti Saulu.
entries.en: Then Samuel went to Ramah; and Saul went up to his house to Gibeah of Saul.

entries.yo: Samueli kò si tun pada wá mọ lati wo Saulu titi o fi di ọjọ ikú rẹ̀: ṣugbọn Samueli kãnu fun Saulu: o si dùn Oluwa nitori on fi Saulu jẹ ọba lori Israeli.
entries.en: And Samuel came no more to see Saul until the day of his death: nevertheless Samuel mourned for Saul: and the LORD repented that he had made Saul king over Israel.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun Samueli pe, Yio ti pẹ to ti iwọ o fi ma kãnu Saulu, nigbati o jẹ pe, mo ti kọ̀ ọ lati ma jọba lori Israeli? Fi ororo kún iwo rẹ, ki o si lọ, emi o rán ọ tọ̀ Jesse ara Betlehemu: nitoriti emi ti ri ọba kan fun ara mi ninu awọn ọmọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Samuel, How long wilt thou mourn for Saul, seeing I have rejected him from reigning over Israel? fill thine horn with oil, and go, I will send thee to Jesse the Bethlehemite: for I have provided me a king among his sons.

entries.yo: Samueli si wi pe, Emi o ti ṣe lọ? bi Saulu ba gbọ́ yio si pa mi. Oluwa si wi fun u pe, mu ọdọ-malu kan li ọwọ́ rẹ, ki o si wipe, Emi wá rubọ si Oluwa.
entries.en: And Samuel said, How can I go? if Saul hear it, he Will kill me. And the LORD said, Take an heifer with thee, and say, I am come to sacrifice to the LORD.

entries.yo: Ki o si pe Jesse si ibi ẹbọ na, emi o si fi ohun ti iwọ o ṣe hàn ọ: iwọ o si ta ororo si ori ẹniti emi o da orukọ fun ọ.
entries.en: And call Jesse to the sacrifice, and I will shew thee what thou shalt do: and thou shalt anoint unto me him whom I name unto thee.

entries.yo: Samueli si ṣe eyi ti Oluwa wi fun u, o sì wá si Betlehemu. Awọn agbà ilu na si bẹ̀ru nitori wiwá rẹ̀, nwọn si wipe, Alafia ki iwọ ba wá si bi?
entries.en: And Samuel did that which the LORD spake, and came to Bethlehem. And the elders of the town trembled at his coming, and said, Comest thou peaceably?

entries.yo: On si dahùn wipe, Alafia ni: emi wá rubọ si Oluwa; ẹ ṣe ara nyin ni mimọ́, ki ẹ si wá pẹlu mi si ibi ẹbọ na. On si yà Jesse sí mimọ́, ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, o si pe wọn si ẹbọ na.
entries.en: And he said, Peaceably: I am come to sacrifice unto the LORD: sanctify yourselves, and come with me to the sacrifice. And he sanctified Jesse and his sons, and called them to the sacrifice.

entries.yo: O si ṣe nigbati nwọn de, o ri Eliabu, o si wipe, nitotọ ẹni-àmi-ororo Oluwa mbẹ niwaju rẹ̀.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when they were come, that he looked on Eliab, and said, Surely the LORD's anointed is before him.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Oluwa wi fun Samueli pe, máṣe wo oju rẹ̀, tabi giga rẹ̀; nitoripe emi kọ̀ ọ: nitoriti Oluwa kì iwò bi enia ti nwò; enia a ma wò oju, Oluwa a ma wò ọkàn.
entries.en: But the LORD said unto Samuel, Look not on his countenance, or on the height of his stature; because I have refused him: for the LORD seeth not as man seeth; for man looketh on the outward appearance, but the LORD looketh on the heart.

entries.yo: Jesse si pe Abinadabu, o si mu ki o kọja niwaju Samueli. On si wipe, Oluwa kò si yan eleyi.
entries.en: Then Jesse called Abinadab, and made him pass before Samuel. And he said, Neither hath the LORD chosen this.

entries.yo: Jesse si mu ki Ṣamma ki o kọja. On si wipe, Oluwa kò si yàn eyi.
entries.en: Then Jesse made Shammah to pass by. And he said, Neither hath the LORD chosen this.

entries.yo: Jesse si tun mu ki awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ mejeje kọja niwaju Samueli. Samueli si wi fun Jesse pe, Oluwa kò yan awọn wọnyi.
entries.en: Again, Jesse made seven of his sons to pass before Samuel. And Samuel said unto Jesse, The LORD hath not chosen these.

entries.yo: Samueli si bi Jesse lere pe, gbogbo awọn ọmọ rẹ li o wà nihin bi? On si dahun wipe, abikẹhin wọn li o kù, sa wõ, o nṣọ agutan. Samueli si wi fun Jesse pe, Ranṣẹ ki o si mu u wá: nitoripe awa kì yio joko titi on o fi dé ihinyi.
entries.en: And Samuel said unto Jesse, Are here all thy children? And he said, There remaineth yet the youngest, and, behold, he keepeth the sheep. And Samuel said unto Jesse, Send and fetch him: for we will not sit down till he come hither.

entries.yo: O si ranṣẹ, o si mu u wá. On si jẹ ẹnipupa, ti o lẹwà loju, o si dara lati ma wò. Oluwa si wi fun u pe, Dide, ki o si fi ororo sà a li àmi: nitoripe on na li eyi.
entries.en: And he sent, and brought him in. Now he was ruddy, and withal of a beautiful countenance, and goodly to look to. And the LORD said, Arise, anoint him: for this is he.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Samueli mu iwo ororo, o si fi yà a si ọ̀tọ larin awọn arakunrin rẹ̀; Ẹmi Oluwa si bà le Dafidi lati ọjọ na lọ, Samueli si dide, o si lọ si Rama.
entries.en: Then Samuel took the horn of oil, and anointed him in the midst of his brethren: and the Spirit of the LORD came upon David from that day forward. So Samuel rose up, and went to Ramah.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Ẹmi Oluwa fi Saulu silẹ, ẹmi buburu lati ọdọ Oluwa si nyọ ọ li ẹnu.
entries.en: But the Spirit of the LORD departed from Saul, and an evil spirit from the LORD troubled him.

entries.yo: Awọn iranṣẹ Saulu si wi fun u pe, Jọwọ, sa wõ ẹmi buburu lati ọdọ Ọlọrun nyọ ọ li ẹnu.
entries.en: And Saul's servants said unto him, Behold now, an evil spirit from God troubleth thee.

entries.yo: Njẹ ki oluwa wa fi aṣẹ fun awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀ ti o wà niwaju rẹ̀ lati wá ọkunrin kan ti o mọ̀ ifi duru kọrin: yio si ṣe nigbati ẹmi buburu na lati ọdọ̀ Ọlọrun wá ba de si ọ, yio si fi ọwọ́ rẹ̀ kọrin lara dùru, iwọ o si sàn.
entries.en: Let our lord now command thy servants, which are before thee, to seek out a man, who is a cunning player on an harp: and it shall come to pass, when the evil spirit from God is upon thee, that he shall play with his hand, and thou shalt be well.

entries.yo: Saulu si wi fun awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀ pe, Njẹ ẹ ba mi wá ọkunrin kan, ti o mọ̀ iṣẹ́ orin daju, ki ẹ si mu u tọ̀ mi wá.
entries.en: And Saul said unto his servants, Provide me now a man that can play well, and bring him to me.

entries.yo: Ọkan ninu iranṣẹ wọnni si dahùn wipe, Wõ emi ri ọmọ Jesse kan ti Betlehemu ti o mọ̀ iṣẹ orin, o si jẹ ẹni ti o li agbara gidigidi, ati ologun, ati ẹni ti o ni ọgbọ́n ọ̀rọ isọ, ati arẹwa, Oluwa si wà pẹlu rẹ̀.
entries.en: Then answered one of the servants, and said, Behold, I have seen a son of Jesse the Bethlehemite, that is cunning in playing, and a mighty valiant man, and a man of war, and prudent in matters, and a comely person, and the LORD is with him.

entries.yo: Saulu si ran iranṣẹ si Jesse wipe, ran Dafidi ọmọ rẹ si mi, ẹniti o nṣọ agutan.
entries.en: Wherefore Saul sent messengers unto Jesse, and said, Send me David thy son, which is with the sheep.

entries.yo: Jesse si mu kẹtẹkẹtẹ, o si di ẹrù akara le e, ati igò ọti-waini, ati ọmọ ewurẹ; o si ran wọn nipa ọwọ Dafidi ọmọ rẹ̀ si Saulu.
entries.en: And Jesse took an ass laden with bread, and a bottle of wine, and a kid, and sent them by David his son unto Saul.

entries.yo: Dafidi si tọ Saulu lọ, o si duro niwaju rẹ̀: on si fẹ ẹ gidigidi; Dafidi si wa di ẹniti nrù ihamọra rẹ̀.
entries.en: And David came to Saul, and stood before him: and he loved him greatly; and he became his armourbearer.

entries.yo: Saulu si ranṣẹ si Jesse pe, Jẹ ki Dafidi, emi bẹ ọ, duro niwaju mi; nitori ti o wù mi.
entries.en: And Saul sent to Jesse, saying, Let David, I pray thee, stand before me; for he hath found favour in my sight.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati ẹmi buburu lati ọdọ Ọlọrun wá ba de si Saulu, Dafidi a si fi ọwọ́ rẹ̀ kọrin lara duru: a si san fun Saulu, ara rẹ̀ a si da; ẹmi buburu na, a si fi i silẹ.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when the evil spirit from God was upon Saul, that David took an harp, and played with his hand: so Saul was refreshed, and was well, and the evil spirit departed from him.

entries.yo: AWỌN Filistini si gbá ogun wọn jọ si oju ijà, nwọn si gba ara wọn jọ si Ṣoko, ti iṣe ti Juda, nwọn si do si Ṣoko ati Aseka, ni Efesdammimi.
entries.en: Now the Philistines gathered together their armies to battle, and were gathered together at Shochoh, which belongeth to Judah, and pitched between Shochoh and Azekah, in Ephes-dammim.

entries.yo: Saulu ati awọn enia Israeli si gbá ara wọn jọ pọ̀, nwọn si do ni afonifoji Ela, nwọn si tẹ́ ogun de awọn Filistini.
entries.en: And Saul and the men of Israel were gathered together, and pitched by the valley of Elah, and set the battle in array against the Philistines.

entries.yo: Awọn Filistini si duro lori oke kan li apa kan, Israeli si duro lori oke kan li apa keji: afonifoji kan sì wa larin wọn.
entries.en: And the Philistines stood on a mountain on the one side, and Israel stood on a mountain on the other side: and there was a valley between them.

entries.yo: Akikanju kan si jade lati ibudo awọn Filistini wá, orukọ rẹ̀ ama jẹ Goliati, ara Gati, ẹniti giga rẹ̀ jẹ igbọnwọ mẹfa ati ibu atẹlẹwọ kan.
entries.en: And there went out a champion out of the camp of the Philistines, named Goliath, of Gath, whose height was six cubits and a span.

entries.yo: On si ni akoro idẹ kan li ori rẹ̀, o si wọ̀ ẹ̀wu kan ti a fi idẹ pẹlẹbẹ pẹlẹbẹ ṣe, ìwọn ẹwu na si jẹ ẹgbẹdọgbọn Ṣekeli idẹ.
entries.en: And he had an helmet of brass upon his head, and he was armed with a coat of mail; and the weight of the coat was five thousand shekels of brass.

entries.yo: On si ni kobita idẹ li ẹsẹ rẹ̀, ati apata idẹ kan larin ejika rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he had greaves of brass upon his legs, and a target of brass between his shoulders.

entries.yo: Ọpa ọ̀kọ rẹ̀ si dabi igi awọn awunṣọ, ati ori ọ̀kọ rẹ̀ si jẹ ẹgbẹta oṣuwọn sekeli irin: ẹnikan ti o ru awà kan si nrin niwaju rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the staff of his spear was like a weaver's beam; and his spear's head weighed six hundred shekels of iron: and one bearing a shield went before him.

entries.yo: O si duro o si kigbe si ogun Israeli, o si wi fun wọn pe, Ẽṣe ti ẹnyin jade lati tẹgun? ṣe Filistini kan li emi iṣe? ẹnyin si jẹ ẹrú Saulu. Ẹnyin yan ọkunrin kan fun ara nyin, ki ẹnyin si jẹ ki o sọkale tọ̀ mi wá.
entries.en: And he stood and cried unto the armies of Israel, and said unto them, Why are ye come out to set your battle in array? am not I a Philistine, and ye servants to Saul? choose you a man for you, and let him come down to me.

entries.yo: Bi on ba le ba mi ja, ki o si pa mi, nigbana li awa o di ẹrú nyin: ṣugbọn bi emi ba le ṣẹgun rẹ̀, ti emi si pa a, nigbana ni ẹnyin a si di ẹrú wa, ẹnyin o si ma sìn wa.
entries.en: If he be able to fight with me, and to kill me, then will we be your servants: but if I prevail against him, and kill him, then shall ye be our servants, and serve us.

entries.yo: Filistini na si wipe, Emi fi ija lọ̀ ogun Israeli li oni: fi ọkunrin kan fun mi, ki awa mejeji jumọ ba ara wa jà.
entries.en: And the Philistine said, I defy the armies of Israel this day; give me a man, that we may fight together.

entries.yo: Nigbati Saulu ati gbogbo Israeli gbọ́ ọ̀rọ Filistini na, nwọn damu, ẹ̀ru nlanla si ba wọn.
entries.en: When Saul and all Israel heard those words of the Philistine, they were dismayed, and greatly afraid.

entries.yo: Dafidi si jẹ ọmọ ara Efrata na ti Betlehemu Juda, orukọ ẹniti ijẹ Jesse; o si ni ọmọ mẹjọ, o si jẹ arugbo larin enia li ọjọ Saulu.
entries.en: Now David was the son of that Ephrathite of Bethlehemjudah, whose name was Jesse; and he had eight sons: and the man went among men for an old man in the days of Saul.

entries.yo: Awọn mẹta ti o dàgba ninu awọn ọmọ Jesse, si tọ Saulu lẹhin lọ si oju ijà: orukọ awọn ọmọ mẹtẹta ti o lọ si ibi ijà si ni Eliabu, akọbi, atẹle rẹ̀ si ni Abinadabu, ẹkẹta si ni Ṣamma.
entries.en: And the three eldest sons of Jesse went and followed Saul to the battle: and the names of his three sons that went to the battle were Eliab the firstborn, and next unto him Abinadab, and the third Shammah.

entries.yo: Dafidi si ni abikẹhin: awọn ẹgbọ́n iwaju rẹ̀ mẹtẹta ntọ̀ Saulu lẹhin.
entries.en: And David was the youngest: and the three eldest followed Saul.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Dafidi lọ, o si yipada lẹhin Saulu, lati ma tọju agutan baba rẹ̀ ni Betlehemu.
entries.en: But David went and returned from Saul to feed his father's sheep at Bethlehem.

entries.yo: Filistini na a si ma sunmọ itosi li owurọ ati li alẹ, on si fi ara rẹ̀ han li ogoji ọjọ.
entries.en: And the Philistine drew near morning and evening, and presented himself forty days.

entries.yo: Jesse si wi fun Dafidi ọmọ rẹ̀ pe, Jọwọ, mu agbado didin yi ti ẹfa kan, ati iṣu akara mẹwa yi fun awọn ẹgbọn rẹ, ki o si sure tọ awọn ẹgbọn rẹ ni ibudo;
entries.en: And Jesse said unto David his son, Take now for thy brethren an ephah of this parched corn, and these ten loaves, and run to the camp to thy brethren;

entries.yo: Ki o si mu warakasi mẹwa wọnyi fun oloriogun ẹgbẹrun wọn, ki o si wo bi awọn ẹgbọn rẹ ti nṣe, ki o si gbà nkan àmi wọn wá.
entries.en: And carry these ten cheeses unto the captain of their thousand, and look how thy brethren fare, and take their pledge.

entries.yo: Saulu, ati awọn, ati gbogbo ọkunrin Israeli si wà ni afonifoji Ela, nwọn mba awọn Filistini jà.
entries.en: Now Saul, and they, and all the men of Israel, were in the valley of Elah, fighting with the Philistines.

entries.yo: Dafidi si dide ni kutukutu owurọ, o si fi agutan wọnni le olutọju kan lọwọ, o si mura, o si lọ, gẹgẹ bi Jesse ti fi aṣẹ fun u; on si de ibi yàra, ogun na si nlọ si oju ijà, nwọn hó iho ogun.
entries.en: And David rose up early in the morning, and left the sheep with a keeper, and took, and went, as Jesse had commanded him; and he came to the trench, as the host was going forth to the fight, and shouted for the battle.

entries.yo: Israeli ati Filistini si tẹgun, ogun si pade ogun.
entries.en: For Israel and the Philistines had put the battle in array, army against army.

entries.yo: Dafidi si fi nkan ti o nmu lọ le ọkan ninu awọn olutọju nkan gbogbo lọwọ, o si sare si ogun, o tọ awọn ẹgbọn rẹ̀ lọ, o si ki wọn.
entries.en: And David left his carriage in the hand of the keeper of the carriage, and ran into the army, and came and saluted his brethren.

entries.yo: Bi on si ti mba wọn sọ̀rọ, sa wõ, akikanju ọkunrin na, Filistini ti Gati, ti orukọ rẹ̀ njẹ Goliati si goke wá, lati ogun awọn Filistini, o si sọ gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ ti o ti nsọ ri: Dafidi si gbọ́.
entries.en: And as he talked with them, behold, there came up the champion, the Philistine of Gath, Goliath by name, out of the armies of the Philistines, and spake according to the same words: and David heard them.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ọkunrin Israeli, nigbati nwọn si ri ọkunrin na, nwọn si sa niwaju rẹ̀, ẹ̀ru si ba wọn gidigidi.
entries.en: And all the men of Israel, when they saw the man, fled from him, and were sore afraid.

entries.yo: Awọn ọkunrin Israeli si wipe, Ẹnyin kò ri ọkunrin yi ti o goke wá ihin? lati pe Israeli ni ijà li o ṣe wá: yio si ṣe pe, ẹniti o ba pa ọkunrin na, ọba yio si fi ọrọ̀ pipọ fun u, yio si fun u li ọmọ rẹ̀ obinrin, yio si sọ ile baba rẹ di omnira ni Israeli.
entries.en: And the men of Israel said, Have ye seen this man that is come up? surely to defy Israel is he come up: and it shall be, that the man who killeth him, the king will enrich him with great riches, and will give him his daughter, and make his father's house free in Israel.

entries.yo: Dafidi si wi fun awọn ọkunrin ti o duro li ọdọ rẹ̀ pe, Kili a o ṣe fun ọkunrin na ti o ba pa Filistini yi, ti o si mu ẹgàn na kuro li ara Israeli? tali alaikọla Filistini yi iṣe, ti yio fi ma gan ogun Ọlọrun alãye?
entries.en: And David spake to the men that stood by him, saying, What shall be done to the man that killeth this Philistine, and taketh away the reproach from Israel? for who is this uncircumcised Philistine, that he should defy the armies of the living God?

entries.yo: Awọn enia na si da a li ohùn gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ yi pe, Bayi ni nwọn o ṣe fun ọkunrin ti o ba pa a.
entries.en: And the people answered him after this manner, saying, So shall it be done to the man that killeth him.

entries.yo: Eliabu ẹgbọn rẹ̀ si gbọ́ nigbati on ba awọn ọkunrin na sọ̀rọ; Eliabu si binu si Dafidi, o si wipe, Ẽ ti ṣe ti iwọ fi sọkalẹ wá ihinyi, tani iwọ ha fi agutan diẹ nì le lọwọ́ li aginju? emi mọ̀ igberaga rẹ, ati buburu ọkàn rẹ; nitori lati ri ogun ni iwọ ṣe sọkalẹ wá.
entries.en: And Eliab his eldest brother heard when he spake unto the men; and Eliab's anger was kindled against David, and he said, Why camest thou down hither? and with whom hast thou left those few sheep in the wilderness? I know thy pride, and the naughtiness of thine heart; for thou art come down that thou mightest see the battle.

entries.yo: Dafidi si dahùn wipe, Kini mo ṣe nisisiyi? ko ha ni idi bi?
entries.en: And David said, What have I now done? Is there not a cause?

entries.yo: On si yipada kuro lọdọ rẹ̀ si ẹlomiran, o si sọ bakanna: awọn enia na si fi esì fun u gegẹ bi ọ̀rọ iṣaju.
entries.en: And he turned from him toward another, and spake after the same manner: and the people answered him again after the former manner.

entries.yo: Nwọn si gbọ́ ọ̀rọ ti Dafidi sọ, nwọn si sọ gbogbo wọn li oju Saulu: on si ranṣẹ pè e.
entries.en: And when the words were heard which David spake, they rehearsed them before Saul: and he sent for him.

entries.yo: Dafidi si wi fun Saulu pe, Ki aiya ki o máṣe fò ẹnikẹni nitori rẹ̀; iranṣẹ rẹ yio lọ, yio si ba Filistini yi jà.
entries.en: And David said to Saul, Let no man's heart fail because of him; thy servant will go and fight with this Philistine.

entries.yo: Saulu si wi fun Dafidi pe, Iwọ kò le tọ Filistini yi lọ lati ba a jà: nitoripe ọdọmọde ni iwọ, on si jẹ jagunjagun lati igba ewe rẹ̀ wá.
entries.en: And Saul said to David, Thou art not able to go against this Philistine to fight with him: for thou art but a youth, and he a man of war from his youth.

entries.yo: Dafidi si wi fun Saulu pe, Nigbati iranṣẹ rẹ nṣọ agutan baba rẹ̀, kiniun kan si wá, ati amọtẹkun kan, o si gbe ọdọ agutan kan lati inu agbo.
entries.en: And David said unto Saul, Thy servant kept his father's sheep, and there came a lion, and a bear, and took a lamb out of the flock:

entries.yo: Mo si jade tọ̀ ọ, mo si lù u, mo si gbà a kuro li ẹnu rẹ̀: nigbati o si dide si mi, mo gbá irugbọ̀n rẹ̀ mu, mo si lù u, mo si pa a.
entries.en: And I went out after him, and smote him, and delivered it out of his mouth: and when he arose against me, I caught him by his beard, and smote him, and slew him.

entries.yo: Iranṣẹ rẹ pa ati kiniun ati amọtẹkun na: alaikọla Filistini yi yio si dabi ọkan ninu wọn, nitoripe on ti pe ogun Ọlọrun alãye ni ijà.
entries.en: Thy servant slew both the lion and the bear: and this uncircumcised Philistine shall be as one of them, seeing he hath defied the armies of the living God.

entries.yo: Dafidi si wipe, Oluwa ti o gbà mi lọwọ́ kiniun ati lọwọ́ amọtẹkun, on na ni yio gbà mi lọwọ́ Filistini yi. Saulu si wi fun Dafidi pe, Lọ, Oluwa yio si pẹlu rẹ.
entries.en: David said moreover, The LORD that delivered me out of the paw of the lion, and out of the paw of the bear, he will deliver me out of the hand of this Philistine. And Saul said unto David, Go, and the LORD be with thee.

entries.yo: Saulu si fi gbogbo ihamọra ogun rẹ̀ wọ̀ Dafidi, o si fi ibori idẹ kan bò o li ori; o si fi ẹwu ti a fi irin adarọ pẹlẹbẹ-pẹlẹbẹ ṣe wọ̀ ọ.
entries.en: And Saul armed David with his armour, and he put an helmet of brass upon his head; also he armed him with a coat of mail.

entries.yo: Dafidi si di ida rẹ̀ mọ ihamọra rẹ̀, on si gbiyanju lati lọ, on kò sa iti dan a wò. Dafidi si wi fun Saulu pe, Emi kò le ru wọnyi lọ, nitoripe emi kò idan a wò. Dafidi si tu wọn kuro li ara rẹ̀.
entries.en: And David girded his sword upon his armour, and he assayed to go; for he had not proved it. And David said unto Saul, I cannot go with these; for I have not proved them. And David put them off him.

entries.yo: On si mu ọpa rẹ̀ li ọwọ́ rẹ̀, o si ṣà okuta marun ti o jọlọ̀ ninu odò, o si fi wọn sinu apò oluṣọ agutan ti o ni, ani sinu asùwọn: kànakana rẹ̀ si wà li ọwọ́ rẹ̀; o si sunmọ Filistini na.
entries.en: And he took his staff in his hand, and chose him five smooth stones out of the brook, and put them in a shepherd's bag which he had, even in a scrip; and his sling was in his hand: and he drew near to the Philistine.

entries.yo: Filistini na si mbọ̀, o si nsunmọ Dafidi; ati ọkunrin ti o rù awà rẹ̀ si mbọ̀ niwaju rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the Philistine came on and drew near unto David; and the man that bare the shield went before him.

entries.yo: Nigbati Filistini na si wò, ti o si ri Dafidi, o ṣata rẹ̀: nitoripe ọdọmọdekunrin ni iṣe, o pọn, o si ṣe arẹwa enia.
entries.en: And when the Philistine looked about, and saw David, he disdained him: for he was but a youth, and ruddy, and of a fair countenance.

entries.yo: Filistini na si wi fun Dafidi pe, Emi ha nṣe aja bi, ti iwọ fi mu ọpá tọ̀ mi wá? Filistini na si fi Dafidi re nipa awọn ọlọrun rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the Philistine said unto David, Am I a dog, that thou comest to me with staves? And the Philistine cursed David by his gods.

entries.yo: Filistini na si wi fun Dafidi pe, Mã bọ̀; emi o si fi ẹran ara rẹ fun awọn ẹiyẹ oju ọrun, ati fun awọn ẹranko papa.
entries.en: And the Philistine said to David, Come to me, and I will give thy flesh unto the fowls of the air, and to the beasts of the field.

entries.yo: Dafidi si wi fun Filistini na pe, Iwọ mu idà, ati ọ̀kọ, ati awà tọ̀ mi wá; ṣugbọn emi tọ̀ ọ wá li orukọ Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun, Ọlọrun ogun Israeli ti iwọ ti gàn.
entries.en: Then said David to the Philistine, Thou comest to me with a sword, and with a spear, and with a shield: but I come to thee in the name of the LORD of hosts, the God of the armies of Israel, whom thou hast defied.

entries.yo: Loni yi li Oluwa yio fi iwọ le mi lọwọ́, emi o pa ọ, emi o si ke ori rẹ kuro li ara rẹ; emi o si fi okú ogun Filistini fun ẹiyẹ oju ọrun loni yi, ati fun ẹranko igbẹ; gbogbo aiye yio si mọ̀ pe, Ọlọrun wà fun Israeli.
entries.en: This day will the LORD deliver thee into mine hand; and I will smite thee, and take thine head from thee; and I will give the carcases of the host of the Philistines this day unto the fowls of the air, and to the wild beasts of the earth; that all the earth may know that there is a God in Israel.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ijọ enia yio si mọ̀ daju pe, Oluwa kò fi ida on ọ̀kọ gbà ni la: nitoripe ogun na ti Oluwa ni, yio si fi ọ le wa lọwọ.
entries.en: And all this assembly shall know that the LORD saveth not with sword and spear: for the battle is the LORD's, and he will give you into our hands.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati Filistini na dide, ti o nrìn, ti o si nsunmọ tosí lati pade Dafidi, Dafidi si yara, o si sure si ogun lati pade Filistini na.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when the Philistine arose, and came and drew nigh to meet David, that David hasted, and ran toward the army to meet the Philistine.

entries.yo: Dafidi si fi ọwọ́ rẹ̀ si inu apò, o si mu okuta kan lati ibẹ̀ wá, o si fì i, o si bà Filistini na niwaju, okuta na si wọ inu agbari rẹ̀ lọ, o si ṣubu dojubolẹ.
entries.en: And David put his hand in his bag, and took thence a stone, and slang it, and smote the Philistine in his forehead, that the stone sunk into his forehead; and he fell upon his face to the earth.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Dafidi si fi kànakàna on okuta ṣẹgun Filistini na, o si bori Filistini na, o si pa a; ṣugbọn idà ko si lọwọ Dafidi.
entries.en: So David prevailed over the Philistine with a sling and with a stone, and smote the Philistine, and slew him; but there was no sword in the hand of David.

entries.yo: Dafidi si sure, o si duro lori Filistini na, o si mu ida rẹ̀, o si fà a yọ ninu akọ̀ rẹ̀, o si pa a, o si fi idà na bẹ́ ẹ li ori. Nigbati awọn Filistini si ri pe akikanju wọn kú, nwọn si sa.
entries.en: Therefore David ran, and stood upon the Philistine, and took his sword, and drew it out of the sheath thereof, and slew him, and cut off his head therewith. And when the Philistines saw their champion was dead, they fled.

entries.yo: Awọn ọkunrin Israeli ati ti Juda si dide, nwọn si ho yè, nwọn si nle awọn Filistini lọ, titi nwọn fi de afonifoji kan, ati si ojubode Ekronu. Awọn ti o gbọgbẹ ninu awọn Filistini si ṣubu lulẹ li ọ̀na Ṣaaraimu, ati titi de Gati, ati Ekronu.
entries.en: And the men of Israel and of Judah arose, and shouted, and pursued the Philistines, until thou come to the valley, and to the gates of Ekron. And the wounded of the Philistines fell down by the way to Shaaraim, even unto Gath, and unto Ekron.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Israeli si pada lati ma lepa awọn Filistini, nwọn si ba budo wọn jẹ.
entries.en: And the children of Israel returned from chasing after the Philistines, and they spoiled their tents.

entries.yo: Dafidi si gbe ori Filistini na, o si mu u wá si Jerusalemu; ṣugbọn o fi ihamọra rẹ̀ si inu agọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And David took the head of the Philistine, and brought it to Jerusalem; but he put his armour in his tent.

entries.yo: Nigbati Saulu si ri Dafidi ti nlọ pade Filistini na, o si bi Abneri oloriogun pe, Abneri, ọmọ tani ọmọde yi iṣe? Abneri si dahun pe, bi ọkàn rẹ ti wà lãye, ọba, emi kò mọ̀.
entries.en: And when Saul saw David go forth against the Philistine, he said unto Abner, the captain of the host, Abner, whose son is this youth? And Abner said, As thy soul liveth, O king, I cannot tell.

entries.yo: Ọba si wipe, Iwọ bere ọmọ tali ọmọde na iṣe?
entries.en: And the king said, Inquire thou whose son the stripling is.

entries.yo: Bi Dafidi si ti ti ibi ti o gbe pa Filistini na bọ̀, Abneri si mu u wá siwaju Saulu, ti on ti ori Filistini na lọwọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And as David returned from the slaughter of the Philistine, Abner took him, and brought him before Saul with the head of the Philistine in his hand.

entries.yo: Saulu si bi i lere pe, Ọmọ tani iwọ ọmọde yi iṣe? Dafidi si da a li ohùn pe, Emi li ọmọ Jesse iranṣẹ rẹ ara Betlehemu.
entries.en: And Saul said to him, Whose son art thou, thou young man? And David answered, I am the son of thy servant Jesse the Bethlehemite.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati o ba Saulu sọ̀rọ tan, ọkàn Jonatani si fà mọ ọkàn Dafidi, Jonatani si fẹ ẹ bi ontikararẹ̀.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when he had made an end of speaking unto Saul, that the soul of Jonathan was knit with the soul of David, and Jonathan loved him as his own soul.

entries.yo: Saulu si mu u sọdọ lọjọ na, ko si jẹ ki o lọ sọdọ baba rẹ̀ mọ.
entries.en: And Saul took him that day, and would let him go no more home to his father's house.

entries.yo: Jonatani on Dafidi si ba ara wọn mulẹ; nitoripe o fẹ ẹ gẹgẹ bi o ti fẹ ọkàn ara rẹ̀.
entries.en: Then Jonathan and David made a covenant, because he loved him as his own soul.

entries.yo: Jonatani si bọ aṣọ ileke ti o wà li ara rẹ̀ o si fi i fun Dafidi, ati ihamọra rẹ̀, titi de idà rẹ̀, ọrun rẹ̀, ati amure rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Jonathan stripped himself of the robe that was upon him, and gave it to David, and his garments, even to his sword, and to his bow, and to his girdle.

entries.yo: Dafidi a si ma lọ si ibikibi ti Saulu rán a, a ma huwa ọlọgbọ́n: Saulu si fi i jẹ olori ogun, o si dara loju gbogbo awọn enia, ati pẹlupẹlu loju awọn iranṣẹ Saulu.
entries.en: And David went out whithersoever Saul sent him, and behaved himself wisely: and Saul set him over the men of war, and he was accepted in the sight of all the people, and also in the sight of Saul's servants.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, bi nwọn ti de, nigbati Dafidi ti ibi ti o gbe pa Filistini na bọ̀, awọn obinrin si ti gbogbo ilu Israeli jade wá, nwọn nkọrin nwọn si njo lati wá ipade Saulu ọba, ti awọn ti ilù, ati ayọ̀, ati duru.
entries.en: And it came to pass as they came, when David was returned from the slaughter of the Philistine, that the women came out of all cities of Israel, singing and dancing, to meet king Saul, with tabrets, with joy, and with instruments of musick.

entries.yo: Awọn obinrin si ndá, nwọn si ngbe orin bi nwọn ti nṣire, nwọn si nwipe, Saulu pa ẹgbẹgbẹrun tirẹ̀, Dafidi si pa ẹgbẹgbarun tirẹ̀.
entries.en: And the women answered one another as they played, and said, Saul hath slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands.

entries.yo: Saulu si binu gidigidi, ọ̀rọ na si buru loju rẹ̀ o si wipe, Nwọn fi ẹgbẹgbarun fun Dafidi, nwọn si fi ẹgbẹgbẹrun fun mi, kili o si kù fun u bikoṣe ijọba.
entries.en: And Saul was very wroth, and the saying displeased him; and he said, They have ascribed unto David ten thousands, and to me they have ascribed but thousands: and what can he have more but the kingdom?

entries.yo: Saulu si nfi oju ilara wo Dafidi lati ọjọ na lọ.
entries.en: And Saul eyed David from that day and forward.

entries.yo: O si ṣe ni ijọ keji, ti ẹmi buburu lati ọdọ Ọlọrun wá si ba le Saulu, on si sọtẹlẹ li arin ile; Dafidi si fi ọwọ́ rẹ̀ ṣire lara duru bi igba atẹhinwa; ẹṣín kan mbẹ lọwọ Saulu.
entries.en: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the evil spirit from God came upon Saul, and he prophesied in the midst of the house: and David played with his hand, as at other times: and there was a javelin in Saul's hand.

entries.yo: Saulu si sọ ẹṣín ti o wà lọwọ rẹ̀ na; o si wipe, Emi o pa Dafidi li apa mọ́ ogiri. Dafidi si yẹra kuro niwaju rẹ lẹ̃meji.
entries.en: And Saul cast the javelin; for he said, I will smite David even to the wall with it. And David avoided out of his presence twice.

entries.yo: Saulu si bẹ̀ru Dafidi, nitoripe Oluwa wà pẹlu rẹ̀, ṣugbọn Oluwa kọ̀ Saulu.
entries.en: And Saul was afraid of David, because the LORD was with him, and was departed from Saul.

entries.yo: Nitorina Saulu si mu u kuro lọdọ rẹ̀, o si fi i jẹ olori ogun ẹgbẹrun kan, o si nlọ, o si mbọ̀ niwaju awọn enia na.
entries.en: Therefore Saul removed him from him, and made him his captain over a thousand; and he went out and came in before the people.

entries.yo: Dafidi si ṣe ọlọgbọ́n ni gbogbo iṣe rẹ̀; Oluwa si wà pẹlu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And David behaved himself wisely in all his ways; and the LORD was with him.

entries.yo: Nigbati Saulu ri pe, o nhuwa ọgbọ́n gidigidi, o si mbẹ̀ru rẹ̀.
entries.en: Wherefore when Saul saw that he behaved himself very wisely, he was afraid of him.

entries.yo: Gbogbo Israeli ati Juda si fẹ Dafidi, nitoripe a ma lọ a si ma bọ̀ niwaju wọn.
entries.en: But all Israel and Judah loved David, because he went out and came in before them.

entries.yo: Saulu si wi fun Dafidi pe, Wo Merabu ọmọbinrin mi, eyi agbà, on li emi o fi fun ọ li aya: ṣugbọn ki iwọ ki o ṣe alagbara fun mi, ki o si ma ja ija Oluwa. Nitoriti Saulu ti wi bayi pe, Màṣe jẹ ki ọwọ́ mi ki o wà li ara rẹ̀; ṣugbọn jẹ ki ọwọ́ awọn Filistini ki o wà li ara rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Saul said to David, Behold my elder daughter Merab, her will I give thee to wife: only be thou valiant for me, and fight the LORD's battles. For Saul said, Let not mine hand be upon him, but let the hand of the Philistines be upon him.

entries.yo: Dafidi si wi fun Saulu pe, Tali emi, ati ki li ẹmi mi, tabi idile baba mi ni Israeli, ti emi o fi wa di ana ọba.
entries.en: And David said unto Saul, Who am I? and what is my life, or my father's family in Israel, that I should be son in law to the king?

entries.yo: O si ṣe, li akoko ti a ba fi Merabu ọmọbinrin Saulu fun Dafidi, li a si fi i fun Adrieli ara Meholati li aya.
entries.en: But it came to pass at the time when Merab Saul's daughter should have been given to David, that she was given unto Adriel the Meholathite to wife.

entries.yo: Mikali ọmọbinrin Saulu si fẹran Dafidi, nwọn si wi fun Saulu: nkan na si tọ li oju rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Michal Saul's daughter loved David: and they told Saul, and the thing pleased him.

entries.yo: Saulu si wipe, Emi o fi i fun u, yio si jẹ idẹkùn fun u, ọwọ́ awọn Filistini yio si wà li ara rẹ̀. Saulu si wi fun Dafidi pe, Iwọ o wà di ana mi loni, ninu mejeji.
entries.en: And Saul said, I will give him her, that she may be a snare to him, and that the hand of the Philistines may be against him. Wherefore Saul said to David, Thou shalt this day be my son in law in the one of the twain.

entries.yo: Saulu si paṣẹ fun awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀ pe, Ẹ lọ ba Dafidi sọ̀rọ kẹlẹkẹlẹ pe, Kiyesi i, inu ọba dùn si ọ jọjọ, ati gbogbo awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀ li o si fẹ ọ, njẹ nitorina jẹ ana ọba.
entries.en: And Saul commanded his servants, saying, Commune with David secretly, and say, Behold, the king hath delight in thee, and all his servants love thee: now therefore be the king's son in law.

entries.yo: Awọn iranṣẹ Saulu si sọ̀rọ wọnni li eti Dafidi. Dafidi si wipe, O ha ṣe nkan ti o fẹrẹ loju nyin lati jẹ ana ọba? Talaka li emi ati ẹni ti a kò kà si.
entries.en: And Saul's servants spake those words in the ears of David. And David said, Seemeth it to you a light thing to be a king's son in law, seeing that I am a poor man, and lightly esteemed?

entries.yo: Awọn iranṣẹ Saulu si wa irò fun u, pe, Ọrọ bayi ni Dafidi sọ.
entries.en: And the servants of Saul told him, saying, On this manner spake David.

entries.yo: Saulu si wipe, Bayi li ẹnyin o sọ fun Dafidi, ọba kò sa fẹ ohun-ana kan bikoṣe ọgọrun ẹfa abẹ Filistini, ati lati gbẹsan lara awọn ọta ọba; ṣugbọn Saulu rò ikú Dafidi lati ọwọ́ awọn Filistini wá.
entries.en: And Saul said, Thus shall ye say to David, The king desireth not any dowry, but an hundred foreskins of the Philistines, to be avenged of the king's enemies. But Saul thought to make David fall by the hand of the Philistines.

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀ si sọ̀rọ wọnyi fun Dafidi, ohun na si dara li oju Dafidi lati di ana ọba: ọjọ kò si iti pe.
entries.en: And when his servants told David these words, it pleased David well to be the king's son in law: and the days were not expired.

entries.yo: Dafidi si dide, o lọ, on ati awọn ọmọkunrin rẹ̀, o si pa igba ọmọkunrin ninu awọn Filistini; Dafidi si mu ẹfa abẹ wọn wá, nwọn si kà wọn pe fun ọba, ki on ki o le jẹ ana ọba. Saulu si fi Mikali ọmọ rẹ obinrin fun u li aya.
entries.en: Wherefore David arose and went, he and his men, and slew of the Philistines two hundred men; and David brought their foreskins, and they gave them in full tale to the king, that he might be the king's son in law. And Saul gave him Michal his daughter to wife.

entries.yo: Saulu si ri o si mọ̀ pe, Oluwa wà pẹlu Dafidi, Mikali ọmọbinrin Saulu si fẹ ẹ.
entries.en: And Saul saw and knew that the LORD was with David, and that Michal Saul's daughter loved him.

entries.yo: Saulu si bẹ̀ru Dafidi siwaju ati siwaju: Saulu si wa di ọtá Dafidi titi.
entries.en: And Saul was yet the more afraid of David; and Saul became David's enemy continually.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ-alade Filistini si jade lọ: o si ṣe, lẹhin igbati nwọn lọ, Dafidi si huwa ọlọgbọ́n ju gbogbo awọn iranṣẹ Saulu lọ; orukọ rẹ̀ si ni iyìn jọjọ.
entries.en: Then the princes of the Philistines went forth: and it came to pass, after they went forth, that David behaved himself more wisely than all the servants of Saul; so that his name was much set by.

entries.yo: SAULU si sọ fun Jonatani ọmọ rẹ̀, ati fun gbogbo awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀, pe, ki nwọn ki o pa Dafidi.
