entries.en: Then said Saul unto his servants, Seek me a woman that hath a familiar spirit, that I may go to her, and inquire of her. And his servants said to him, Behold, there is a woman that hath a familiar spirit at Endor.

entries.yo: Saulu si pa ara dà, o si mu aṣọ miran wọ̀, o si lọ, awọn ọmọkunrin meji si pẹlu rẹ̀, nwọn si wá si ọdọ obinrin na li oru: on si wipe, emi bẹ̀ ọ, fi ẹmi abokusọ̀rọ da nkan fun mi, ki o si mu ẹniti emi o darukọ rẹ̀ fun ọ wá oke fun mi.
entries.en: And Saul disguised himself, and put on other raiment, and he went, and two men with him, and they came to the woman by night: and he said, I pray thee, divine unto me by the familiar spirit, and bring me him up, whom I shall name unto thee.

entries.yo: Obinrin na si da a lohùn pe, Wõ, iwọ sa mọ̀ ohun ti Saulu ṣe, bi on ti ke awọn abokusọ̀rọ obinrin, ati awọn abokusọ̀rọ ọkunrin kuro ni ilẹ na; njẹ eha ṣe ti iwọ dẹkùn fun ẹmi mi, lati mu ki nwọn pa mi?
entries.en: And the woman said unto him, Behold, thou knowest what Saul hath done, how he hath cut off those that have familiar spirits, and the wizards, out of the land: wherefore then layest thou a snare for my life, to cause me to die?

entries.yo: Saulu si bura fun u nipa Oluwa, pe, Bi Oluwa ti mbẹ lãye, ìya kan ki yio jẹ ọ nitori nkan yi.
entries.en: And Saul sware to her by the LORD, saying, As the LORD liveth, there shall no punishment happen to thee for this thing.

entries.yo: Obinrin na si bi i pe, Tali emi o mu wá soke fun ọ? on si wipe, Mu Samueli goke fun mi wá.
entries.en: Then said the woman, Whom shall I bring up unto thee? And he said, Bring me up Samuel.

entries.yo: Nigbati obinrin na si ri Samueli, o kigbe lohùn rara: obinrin na si ba Saulu sọrọ pe, Ẽṣe ti iwọ fi tan mi jẹ? nitoripe Saulu ni iwọ iṣe.
entries.en: And when the woman saw Samuel, she cried with a loud voice: and the woman spake to Saul, saying, Why hast thou deceived me? for thou art Saul.

entries.yo: Ọba si wi fun u pe, Máṣe bẹ̀ru; kini iwọ ri? obinrin na si wi fun Saulu pe, Emi ri ọlọrun kan nṣẹ́ ti ilẹ wá.
entries.en: And the king said unto her, Be not afraid: for what sawest thou? And the woman said unto Saul, I saw gods ascending out of the earth.

entries.yo: O si bi i pe, Ẽ ti ri? o si wipe, Ọkunrin arugbo kan li o nṣẹ́ bọ̀; o si fi agbada bora. Saulu si mọ̀ pe, Samueli ni; o si tẹriba, o si wolẹ.
entries.en: And he said unto her, What form is he of? And she said, An old man cometh up; and he is covered with a mantle. And Saul perceived that it was Samuel, and he stooped with his face to the ground, and bowed himself.

entries.yo: Samueli si wi fun Saulu pe, Eṣe ti iwọ fi yọ mi lẹnu lati mu mi wá oke? Saulu si dahun o si wipe, Ipọnju nla ba mi; nitoriti awọn Filistini mba mi jagun, Ọlọrun si kọ̀ mi silẹ, kò si da mi lohùn mọ, nipa ọwọ́ awọn woli, tabi nipa alá; nitorina li emi si ṣe pè ọ, ki iwọ ki ole fi ohun ti emi o ṣe hàn mi.
entries.en: And Samuel said to Saul, Why hast thou disquieted me, to bring me up? And Saul answered, I am sore distressed; for the Philistines make war against me, and God is departed from me, and answereth me no more, neither by prophets, nor by dreams: therefore I have called thee, that thou mayest make known unto me what I shall do.

entries.yo: Samueli si wipe, O ti ṣe bi mi lere nigbati o jẹ pe, Oluwa ti kọ̀ ọ silẹ, o si wa di ọta rẹ?
entries.en: Then said Samuel, Wherefore then dost thou ask of me, seeing the LORD is departed from thee, and is become thine enemy?

entries.yo: Oluwa si ṣe fun ara rẹ̀ gẹgẹ bi o ti ti ipa ọwọ́ mi sọ: Oluwa si yà ijọba na kuro li ọwọ́ rẹ, o si fi fun aladugbo rẹ, ani Dafidi.
entries.en: And the LORD hath done to him, as he spake by me: for the LORD hath rent the kingdom out of thine hand, and given it to thy neighbour, even to David:

entries.yo: Nitoripe iwọ kò gbọ́ ohùn Oluwa, iwọ kò si ṣe iṣẹ ibinu rẹ̀ si Amaleki, nitorina li Oluwa si ṣe nkan yi si ọ loni yi:
entries.en: Because thou obeyedst not the voice of the LORD, nor executedst his fierce wrath upon Amalek, therefore hath the LORD done this thing unto thee this day.

entries.yo: Oluwa yio si fi Israeli pẹlu iwọ le awọn Filistini lọwọ: li ọla ni iwọ ati awọn ọmọ rẹ ọkunrin yio pẹlu mi: Oluwa yio si fi ogun Israeli le awọn Filistini lọwọ́.
entries.en: Moreover the LORD will also deliver Israel with thee into the hand of the Philistines: and to morrow shalt thou and thy sons be with me: the LORD also shall deliver the host of Israel into the hand of the Philistines.

entries.yo: Lojukanna ni Saulu ṣubu lulẹ gbọrọ bi o ti gùn, ẹ̀ru si bà a gidigidi, nitori ọ̀rọ Samueli; agbara kò si si fun u: nitoripe kò jẹun li ọjọ na t'ọsan t'oru.
entries.en: Then Saul fell straightway all along on the earth, and was sore afraid, because of the words of Samuel: and there was no strength in him; for he had eaten no bread all the day, nor all the night.

entries.yo: Obinrin na si tọ Saulu wá, o si ri i pe o wà ninu ibanujẹ pupọ, o si wi fun u pe, Wõ, iranṣẹbinrin rẹ ti gbọ́ ohùn rẹ, emi si ti fi ẹmi mi si ọwọ́ mi, emi si ti gbọ́ ọ̀rọ ti iwọ sọ fun mi.
entries.en: And the woman came unto Saul, and saw that he was sore troubled, and said unto him, Behold, thine handmaid hath obeyed thy voice, and I have put my life in my hand, and have hearkened unto thy words which thou spakest unto me.

entries.yo: Njẹ, nisisiyi, emi bẹ ọ, gbọ́ ohùn iranṣẹbinrin rẹ, emi o si fi onjẹ diẹ siwaju rẹ; si jẹun, iwọ o si li agbara, nigbati iwọ ba nlọ li ọ̀na.
entries.en: Now therefore, I pray thee, hearken thou also unto the voice of thine handmaid, and let me set a morsel of bread before thee; and eat, that thou mayest have strength, when thou goest on thy way.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn on kọ̀, o si wipe, Emi kì yio jẹun. Ṣugbọn awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀, pẹlu obinrin na si rọ̀ ọ; on si gbọ́ ohùn wọn. O si dide kuro ni ilẹ, o si joko lori akete.
entries.en: But he refused, and said, I will not eat. But his servants, together with the woman, compelled him; and he hearkened unto their voice. So he arose from the earth, and sat upon the bed.

entries.yo: Obinrin na si ni ẹgbọrọ malu kan ti o sanra ni ile; o si yara, o pa a o si mu iyẹfun, o si pò o, o si fi ṣe akara aiwu.
entries.en: And the woman had a fat calf in the house; and she hasted, and killed it, and took flour, and kneaded it, and did bake unleavened bread thereof:

entries.yo: On si mu u wá siwaju Saulu, ati siwaju awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀; nwọn si jẹun. Nwọn si dide, nwọn lọ li oru na.
entries.en: And she brought it before Saul, and before his servants; and they did eat. Then they rose up, and went away that night.

entries.yo: AWỌN Filistini si ko gbogbo ogun wọn jọ si Afeki: Israeli si do ni ibi isun omi ti o wà ni Jesreeli.
entries.en: Now the Philistines gathered together all their armies to Aphek: and the Israelites pitched by a fountain which is in Jezreel.

entries.yo: Awọn ijoye Filistini si kọja li ọrọrun ati li ẹgbẹgbẹrun; Dafidi ati awọn ọmọkunrin rẹ̀ pẹlu Akiṣi si kẹhin.
entries.en: And the lords of the Philistines passed on by hundreds, and by thousands: but David and his men passed on in the rereward with Achish.

entries.yo: Awọn ijoye Filistini si bere wipe, Kini awọn Heberu nṣe nihinyi? Akiṣi si wi fun awọn ijoye Filistini pe, Dafidi kọ yi, iranṣẹ Saulu ọba Israeli, ti o wà lọdọ mi lati ọjọ wọnyi tabi lati ọdun wọnyi, emi ko iti ri iṣiṣe kan li ọwọ́ rẹ̀ lati ọjọ ti o ti de ọdọ mi titi di oni yi.
entries.en: Then said the princes of the Philistines, What do these Hebrews here? And Achish said unto the princes of the Philistines, Is not this David, the servant of Saul the king of Israel, which hath been with me these days, or these years, and I have found no fault in him since he fell unto me unto this day?

entries.yo: Awọn ijoye Filistini si binu si i; awọn ijoye Filistini si wi fun u pe, jẹ ki ọkunrin yi pada ki o si lọ si ipò rẹ̀ ti o fi fun u, ki o má si jẹ ki o ba wa sọkalẹ lọ si ogun, ki o má ba jasi ọta fun wa li ogun; Kini on o fi ba oluwa rẹ̀ laja, ori awọn enia wọnyi kọ?
entries.en: And the princes of the Philistines were wroth with him; and the princes of the Philistines said unto him, Make this fellow return, that he may go again to his place which thou hast appointed him, and let him not go down with us to battle, lest in the battle he be an adversary to us: for wherewith should he reconcile himself unto his master? should it not be with the heads of these men?

entries.yo: Ṣe eyi ni Dafidi ti nwọn tori rẹ̀ gberin ara wọn ninu ijo wipe, Saulu pa ẹgbẹgbẹrun rẹ̀, Dafidi si pa ẹgbẹgbãrun tirẹ̀?
entries.en: Is not this David, of whom they sang one to another in dances, saying, Saul slew his thousands, and David his ten thousands?

entries.yo: Akiṣi si pe Dafidi, o si wi fun u pe, Bi Oluwa ti mbẹ lãye, iwọ jẹ olõtọ ati ẹni ìwa rere loju mi, ni alọ rẹ ati abọ̀ rẹ pẹlu mi li ogun; nitoripe emi ko iti ri buburu kan lọwọ rẹ lati ọjọ ti iwọ ti tọ̀ mi wá, titi o fi di oni yi: ṣugbọn loju awọn ijoye iwọ kò ṣe ẹni ti o tọ́.
entries.en: Then Achish called David, and said unto him, Surely, as the LORD liveth, thou hast been upright, and thy going out and thy coming in with me in the host is good in my sight: for I have not found evil in thee since the day of thy coming unto me unto this day: nevertheless the lords favour thee not.

entries.yo: Njẹ yipada ki o si ma lọ li alafia, ki iwọ ki o má ba ṣe ibanujẹ fun awọn Filistini.
entries.en: Wherefore now return, and go in peace, that thou displease not the lords of the Philistines.

entries.yo: Dafidi si wi fun Akiṣi pe, Kili emi ṣe? kini iwọ si ri lọwọ iranṣẹ rẹ lati ọjọ ti emi ti gbe niwaju rẹ titi di oni yi, ti emi kì yio fi lọ ba awọn ọta ọba ja?
entries.en: And David said unto Achish, But what have I done? and what hast thou found in thy servant so long as I have been with thee unto this day, that I may not go fight against the enemies of my lord the king?

entries.yo: Akiṣi si dahun o si wi fun Dafidi pe, Emi mọ̀ pe iwọ ṣe ẹni-rere loju mi, bi angeli Ọlọrun: ṣugbọn awọn ijoye Filistini wi pe, On kì yio ba wa lọ si ogun.
entries.en: And Achish answered and said to David, I know that thou art good in my sight, as an angel of God: notwithstanding the princes of the Philistines have said, He shall not go up with us to the battle.

entries.yo: Njẹ, nisisiyi dide li owurọ pẹlu awọn iranṣẹ oluwa rẹ ti o ba ọ wá: ki ẹ si dide li owurọ nigbati ilẹ ba mọ́, ki ẹ si ma lọ.
entries.en: Wherefore now rise up early in the morning with thy master's servants that are come with thee: and as soon as ye be up early in the morning, and have light, depart.

entries.yo: Dafidi ati awọn ọmọkunrin rẹ̀ si dide li owurọ lati pada lọ si ilẹ awọn Filistini. Awọn Filistini si goke lọ si Jesreeli.
entries.en: So David and his men rose up early to depart in the morning, to return into the land of the Philistines. And the Philistines went up to Jezreel.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati Dafidi ati awọn ọmọkunrin rẹ̀ si bọ̀ si Siklagi ni ijọ kẹta, awọn ara Amaleki si ti kọlu iha ariwa, ati Siklagi, nwọn si ti kun u;
entries.en: And it came to pass, when David and his men were come to Ziklag on the third day, that the Amalekites had invaded the south, and Ziklag, and smitten Ziklag, and burned it with fire;

entries.yo: Nwọn si ko awọn obinrin ti mbẹ ninu rẹ̀ ni igbekun, nwọn kò si pa ẹnikan, ọmọde tabi agbà, ṣugbọn nwọn ko nwọn lọ, nwọn si ba ọ̀na ti nwọn lọ.
entries.en: And had taken the women captives, that were therein: they slew not any, either great or small, but carried them away, and went on their way.

entries.yo: Dafidi ati awọn ọmọkunrin si wọ ilu, si wõ, a ti kun u; ati obinrin wọn, ati ọmọkunrin wọn ati ọmọbinrin wọn li a kó ni igbèkun lọ.
entries.en: So David and his men came to the city, and, behold, it was burned with fire; and their wives, and their sons, and their daughters, were taken captives.

entries.yo: Dafidi ati awọn enia ti o wà lọdọ rẹ̀ si gbe ohùn wọn soke, nwọn si sọkun titi agbara kò si si fun wọn mọ lati sọkun.
entries.en: Then David and the people that were with him lifted up their voice and wept, until they had no more power to weep.

entries.yo: A si kó awọn aya Dafidi mejeji nigbèkun lọ, Ahinoamu ara Jesreeli, ati Abigaili aya, Nabali ara Karmeli.
entries.en: And David's two wives were taken captives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite.

entries.yo: Dafidi si banujẹ gidigidi, nitoripe awọn enia na si nsọ̀rọ lati sọ ọ li okuta, nitoriti inu gbogbo awọn enia na si bajẹ, olukuluku ọkunrin nitori ọmọ rẹ̀ ọkunrin, ati nitori ọmọ rẹ̀ obinrin: ṣugbọn Dafidi mu ara rẹ̀ li ọkàn le ninu Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ̀.
entries.en: And David was greatly distressed; for the people spake of stoning him, because the soul of all the people was grieved, every man for his sons and for his daughters: but David encouraged himself in the LORD his God.

entries.yo: Dafidi si wi fun Abiatari alufa, ọmọ Ahimeleki pe, Emi bẹ̀ ọ, mu efodu fun mi wá nihinyi. Abiatari si mu efodu na wá fun Dafidi.
entries.en: And David said to Abiathar the priest, Ahimelech's son, I pray thee, bring me hither the ephod. And Abiathar brought thither the ephod to David.

entries.yo: Dafidi si bere lọdọ Oluwa wipe, Ki emi ki o lepa ogun yi bi? emi le ba wọn? O si da a lohùn pe, Lepa: nitoripe ni biba iwọ o ba wọn, ni gbigba iwọ o si ri wọn gbà.
entries.en: And David inquired at the LORD, saying, Shall I pursue after this troop? shall I overtake them? And he answered him, Pursue: for thou shalt surely overtake them, and without fail recover all.

entries.yo: Bẹni Dafidi ati ẹgbẹta ọmọkunrin ti mbẹ lọdọ rẹ̀ si lọ, nwọn si wá si ibi odo Besori, apakan si duro.
entries.en: So David went, he and the six hundred men that were with him, and came to the brook Besor, where those that were left behind stayed.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Dafidi ati irinwo ọmọkunrin lepa wọn: igba enia ti ãrẹ̀ mu, ti nwọn kò le kọja odò Besori si duro lẹhin.
entries.en: But David pursued, he and four hundred men: for two hundred abode behind, which were so faint that they could not go over the brook Besor.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ri ara Egipti kan li oko, nwọn si mu u tọ̀ Dafidi wá, nwọn si fun u li onjẹ, o si jẹ; nwọn si fun u li omi mu;
entries.en: And they found an Egyptian in the field, and brought him to David, and gave him bread, and he did eat; and they made him drink water;

entries.yo: Nwọn si bùn u li akara eso ọpọtọ ati ṣiri ajara gbigbẹ meji: nigbati o si jẹ ẹ tan, ẹmi rẹ̀ si sọji: nitoripe ko jẹ onjẹ, bẹ̃ni kò si mu omi ni ijọ mẹta li ọsan, ati li oru.
entries.en: And they gave him a piece of a cake of figs, and two clusters of raisins: and when he had eaten, his spirit came again to him: for he had eaten no bread, nor drunk any water, three days and three nights.

entries.yo: Dafidi si bi i lere pe, Ọmọ tani iwọ iṣe? ati nibo ni iwọ ti wá? On si wipe, ọmọ ara Egipti li emi iṣe, ọmọ-ọdọ ọkunrin kan ara Amaleki; oluwa mi si fi mi silẹ, nitoripe lati ijọ mẹta li emi ti ṣe aisan.
entries.en: And David said unto him, To whom belongest thou? and whence art thou? And he said, I am a young man of Egypt, servant to an Amalekite; and my master left me, because three days agone I fell sick.

entries.yo: Awa si gbe ogun lọ siha gusu ti ara Keriti, ati si apa ti iṣe ti Juda, ati si iha gusu ti Kelebu; awa si kun Siklagi.
entries.en: We made an invasion upon the south of the Cherethites, and upon the coast which belongeth to Judah, and upon the south of Caleb; and we burned Ziklag with fire.

entries.yo: Dafidi si bi i lere pe, Iwọ le mu mi sọkalẹ tọ̀ ẹgbẹ ogun yi lọ bi? On si wipe, Fi Ọlọrun bura fun mi, pe, iwọ kì yio pa mi, bẹ̃ni iwọ kì yio si fi mi le oluwa mi lọwọ; emi o si mu ọ sọkalẹ tọ̀ ẹgbẹ ogun na lọ.
entries.en: And David said to him, Canst thou bring me down to this company? And he said, Swear unto me by God, that thou wilt neither kill me, nor deliver me into the hands of my master, and I will bring thee down to this company.

entries.yo: O si mu u sọkalẹ, si wõ, nwọn si tànka ilẹ, nwọn njẹ, nwọn nmu, nwọn si njo, nitori ikogun pupọ ti nwọn ko lati ilẹ awọn Filistini wá, ati lati ilẹ Juda.
entries.en: And when he had brought him down, behold, they were spread abroad upon all the earth, eating and drinking, and dancing, because of all the great spoil that they had taken out of the land of the Philistines, and out of the land of Judah.

entries.yo: Dafidi si pa wọn lati afẹmọjumọ titi o fi di aṣalẹ ijọ keji: kò si si ẹnikan ti o là ninu wọn, bikoṣe irinwo ọmọkunrin ti nwọn gun ibakasiẹ ti nwọn si sa.
entries.en: And David smote them from the twilight even unto the evening of the next day: and there escaped not a man of them, save four hundred young men, which rode upon camels, and fled.

entries.yo: Dafidi si gba gbogbo nkan ti awọn ara Amaleki ti ko: Dafidi si gbà awọn obinrin rẹ̀ mejeji.
entries.en: And David recovered all that the Amalekites had carried away: and David rescued his two wives.

entries.yo: Kò si si nkan ti o kù fun wọn, kekere tabi nla, ọmọkunrin tabi ọmọbinrin, tabi ikogun, tabi gbogbo nkan ti nwọn ti ko: Dafidi si gbà gbogbo wọn.
entries.en: And there was nothing lacking to them, neither small nor great, neither sons nor daughters, neither spoil, nor any thing that they had taken to them: David recovered all.

entries.yo: Dafidi si ko gbogbo agutan, ati malu, nwọn si dà wọn ṣaju nkan miran ti nwọn gbà, nwọn si wipe, Eyiyi ni ikogun ti Dafidi.
entries.en: And David took all the flocks and the herds, which they drave before those other cattle, and said, This is David's spoil.

entries.yo: Dafidi si ba igba ọkunrin ti o ti rẹ̀ jù ati tọ̀ Dafidi lẹhin, ti on ti fi silẹ li odò Besori: nwọn si lọ ipade Dafidi, ati lati pade awọn enia ti o pẹlu rẹ̀: Dafidi si pade awọn enia na, o si ki wọn.
entries.en: And David came to the two hundred men, which were so faint that they could not follow David, whom they had made also to abide at the brook Besor: and they went forth to meet David, and to meet the people that were with him: and when David came near to the people, he saluted them.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn enia buburu ati awọn ọmọ Beliali ninu awọn ti o ba Dafidi lọ si dahun, nwọn si wipe, Bi nwọn kò ti ba wa lọ, a kì yio fi nkan kan fun wọn ninu ikogun ti awa rí gbà bikoṣe obinrin olukuluku wọn, ati ọmọ wọn; ki nwọn ki o si mu wọn, ki nwọn si ma lọ.
entries.en: Then answered all the wicked men and men of Belial, of those that went with David, and said, Because they went not with us, we will not give them ought of the spoil that we have recovered, save to every man his wife and his children, that they may lead them away, and depart.

entries.yo: Dafidi si wipe, Ẹ má ṣe bẹ̃, enyin ará mi: Oluwa li o fi nkan yi fun wa, on li o si pa wa mọ, on li o si fi ẹgbẹ-ogun ti o dide si wa le wa lọwọ.
entries.en: Then said David, Ye shall not do so, my brethren, with that which the LORD hath given us, who hath preserved us, and delivered the company that came against us into our hand.

entries.yo: Tani yio gbọ́ ti nyin ninu ọ̀ran yi? ṣugbọn bi ipin ẹniti o sọkalẹ lọ si ìja ti ri, bẹ̃ni ipin ẹniti o duro ti ẹrù; nwọn o si pin i bakanna.
entries.en: For who will hearken unto you in this matter? but as his part is that goeth down to the battle, so shall his part be that tarrieth by the stuff: they shall part alike.

entries.yo: Lati ọjọ na lọ, o si pa a li aṣẹ, o si sọ ọ li ofin fun Israeli titi di oni yi.
entries.en: And it was so from that day forward, that he made it a statute and an ordinance for Israel unto this day.

entries.yo: Dafidi si bọ̀ si Siklagi, o si rán ninu ikogun na si awọn agbà Juda, ati si awọn ọrẹ́ rẹ̀, o si wipe, Wõ, eyi li ẹ̀bun fun nyin, lati inu ikogun awọn ọta Oluwa wá.
entries.en: And when David came to Ziklag, he sent of the spoil unto the elders of Judah, even to his friends, saying, Behold a present for you of the spoil of the enemies of the LORD;

entries.yo: O si rán a si awọn ti o wà ni Beteli ati si awọn ti o wà ni gusu Ramoti, ati si awọn ti o wà ni Jattiri.
entries.en: To them which were in Bethel, and to them which were in south Ramoth, and to them which were in Jattir,

entries.yo: Ati si awọn ti o wà ni Aroeri, ati si awọn ti o wà ni Sifmoti, ati si awọn ti o wà ni Eṣtemoa.
entries.en: And to them which were in Aroer, and to them which were in Siphmoth, and to them which were in Eshtemoa,

entries.yo: Ati si awọn ti o wà ni Rakali, ati si awọn ti o wà ni ilu awọn Jerameeli, ati si awọn ti o wà ni ilu awọn ara Keni,
entries.en: And to them which were in Rachal, and to them which were in the cities of the Jerahmeelites, and to them which were in the cities of the Kenites,

entries.yo: Ati si awọn ti o wà ni Homa, ati si awọn ti o wà ni Koraṣani, ati si awọn ti o wà ni Ataki.
entries.en: And to them which were in Hormah, and to them which were in Chor-ashan, and to them which were in Athach,

entries.yo: Ati si awọn ti o wà ni Hebroni, ati si gbogbo ilu wọnni ti Dafidi tikararẹ̀ ati awọn ọmọkunrin rẹ̀ ima rin kiri.
entries.en: And to them which were in Hebron, and to all the places where David himself and his men were wont to haunt.

entries.yo: AWỌN Filistini si ba Israeli jà: awọn ọkunrin Israeli si sa niwaju awọn Filistini, awọn ti o fi ara pa sì ṣubu li oke Gilboa.
entries.en: Now the Philistines fought against Israel: and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain in mount Gilboa.

entries.yo: Awọn Filistini si nlepa Saulu ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ kikan; awọn Filistini si pa Jonatani, ati Abinadabu, ati Melkiṣua, awọn ọmọ Saulu.
entries.en: And the Philistines followed hard upon Saul and upon his sons; and the Philistines slew Jonathan, and Abinadab, and Malchi-shua, Saul's sons.

entries.yo: Ijà na si buru fun Saulu gidigidi, awọn tafàtafa si ta a li ọfà, o si fi ara pa pupọ li ọwọ́ awọn tafàtafa.
entries.en: And the battle went sore against Saul, and the archers hit him; and he was sore wounded of the archers.

entries.yo: Saulu si wi fun ẹniti o rù ihamọra rẹ̀ pe, Fa ìda rẹ yọ, ki o si fi i gún mi, ki awọn alaikọla wọnyi ki o má bà wá gún mi, ati ki wọn ki o má ba fi mi ṣe ẹlẹya. Ṣugbọn ẹniti o ru ihamọra rẹ̀ ko fẹ ṣe bẹ̃, nitoripe ẹrù ba a gidigidi. Saulu si mu idà na o si fi pa ara rẹ̀.
entries.en: Then said Saul unto his armourbearer, Draw thy sword, and thrust me through therewith; lest these uncircumcised come and thrust me through, and abuse me. But his armourbearer would not; for he was sore afraid. Therefore Saul took a sword, and fell upon it.

entries.yo: Nigbati ẹniti o rù ihamọra rẹ̀ si ri pe Saulu kú, on na si fi idà rẹ̀ pa ara rẹ̀, o si kú pẹlu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And when his armourbearer saw that Saul was dead, he fell likewise upon his sword, and died with him.

entries.yo: Saulu si kú, ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ mẹta, ati ẹni ti o rù ihamọra rẹ̀, ati gbogbo awọn ọmọkunrin rẹ̀ li ọjọ kanna.
entries.en: So Saul died, and his three sons, and his armourbearer, and all his men, that same day together.

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn ọkunrin Israeli ti o wà li apa keji afonifoji na, ati awọn ẹniti o wà li apa keji Jordani, ri pe awọn ọkunrin Israeli sa, ati pe Saulu ati awọn ọmọbibi rẹ̀ si kú, nwọn si fi ilu silẹ, nwọn si sa; awọn Filistini si wá, nwọn si joko si ilu wọn.
entries.en: And when the men of Israel that were on the other side of the valley, and they that were on the other side Jordan, saw that the men of Israel fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, they forsook the cities, and fled; and the Philistines came and dwelt in them.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, li ọjọ keji, nigbati awọn Filistini de lati bọ́ nkan ti mbẹ lara awọn ti o kú, nwọn si ri pe, Saulu ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ mẹta ṣubu li oke Gilboa,
entries.en: And it came to pass on the morrow, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, that they found Saul and his three sons fallen in mount Gilboa.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ke ori rẹ̀, nwọn si bọ́ ihamọra rẹ̀, nwọn si ranṣẹ lọ si ilẹ Filistini ka kiri, lati ma sọ ọ nigbangba ni ile oriṣa wọn, ati larin awọn enia.
entries.en: And they cut off his head, and stripped off his armour, and sent into the land of the Philistines round about, to publish it in the house of their idols, and among the people.

entries.yo: Nwọn si fi ihamọra rẹ̀ si ile Aṣtaroti: nwọn si kàn okú rẹ̀ mọ odi Betṣani.
entries.en: And they put his armour in the house of Ashtaroth: and they fastened his body to the wall of Beth-shan.

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn ara Jabeṣi-Gileadi si gbọ́ eyiti awọn Filistini ṣe si Saulu;
entries.en: And when the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead heard of that which the Philistines had done to Saul;

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn ọkunrin alagbara si dide, nwọn si fi gbogbo oru na rìn, nwọn si gbe okú Saulu, ati okú awọn ọmọbibi rẹ̀ kuro lara odi Betṣani, nwọn si wá si Jabeṣi, nwọn si sun wọn nibẹ.
entries.en: All the valiant men arose, and went all night, and took the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons from the wall of Beth-shan, and came to Jabesh, and burnt them there.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ko egungun wọn, nwọn si sin wọn li abẹ igi kan ni Jabeṣi, nwọn si gbawẹ ni ijọ meje.
entries.en: And they took their bones, and buried them under a tree at Jabesh, and fasted seven days.

entries.yo: O si ṣe lẹhin ikú Saulu, Dafidi si ti ibi iparun awọn ara Amaleki bọ̀, Dafidi si joko nijọ meji ni Siklagi;
entries.en: Now it came to pass after the death of Saul, when David was returned from the slaughter of the Amalekites, and David had abode two days in Ziklag;

entries.yo: O si ṣe ni ijọ kẹta, si wõ, ọkunrin kan si ti ibudo wá lati ọdọ Saulu; aṣọ rẹ̀ si faya, erupẹ si mbẹ li ori rẹ̀: o si ṣe, nigbati on si de ọdọ Dafidi, o wolẹ, o si tẹriba.
entries.en: It came even to pass on the third day, that, behold, a man came out of the camp from Saul with his clothes rent, and earth upon his head: and so it was, when he came to David, that he fell to the earth, and did obeisance.

entries.yo: Dafidi si bi i lere pe, Nibo ni iwọ ti wá? o si wi fun u pe, Lati ibudo Israeli li emi ti sa wá.
entries.en: And David said unto him, From whence comest thou? And he said unto him, Out of the camp of Israel am I escaped.

entries.yo: Dafidi si tun bi lere wipe, Ọràn na ti ri? emi bẹ ọ, sọ fun mi. On si dahun pe, Awọn enia na sa loju ijà, ọ̀pọlọpọ ninu awọn enia na pẹlu si ṣubu; nwọn si kú, Saulu ati Jonatani ọmọ rẹ̀ si kú pẹlu.
entries.en: And David said unto him, How went the matter? I pray thee, tell me. And he answered, That the people are fled from the battle, and many of the people also are fallen and dead; and Saul and Jonathan his son are dead also.

entries.yo: Dafidi si bi ọmọdekunrin na ti o sọ fun u lere pe, Iwọ ti ṣe mọ̀ pe, Saulu ati Jonatani ọmọ rẹ̀ kú?
entries.en: And David said unto the young man that told him, How knowest thou that Saul and Jonathan his son be dead?

entries.yo: Ọmọdekunrin na ti o sọ fun u wipe, Bi emi ti ṣe alabapade lori oke Gilboa, si wõ, Saulu fi ara tì ọkọ̀ rẹ̀, si wõ, kẹkẹ́ ati ẹlẹṣin nlepa rẹ̀ kikan.
entries.en: And the young man that told him said, As I happened by chance upon mount Gilboa, behold, Saul leaned upon his spear; and, lo, the chariots and horsemen followed hard after him.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si yi oju wo ẹhin rẹ̀, ti o si ri mi, o pè mi, Emi si da a lohùn pe, Emi nĩ.
entries.en: And when he looked behind him, he saw me, and called unto me. And I answered, Here am I.

entries.yo: On si bi mi pe, Iwọ tani? Emi si da a lohùn pe, ara Amaleki li emi.
entries.en: And he said unto me, Who art thou? And I answered him, I am an Amalekite.

entries.yo: On si tun wi fun mi pe, Duro le mi, emi bẹ ọ ki o si pa mi: nitoriti wahala ba mi, ẹmi mi si wà sibẹ.
entries.en: And he said unto me again, Stand, I pray thee, upon me, and slay me: for anguish is come upon me, because my life is yet whole in me.

entries.yo: Emi si duro le e, mo si pa a, nitori ti o da mi loju pe, kò si tun le là mọ lẹhin igbati o ti ṣubu: emi si mu ade ti o wà li ori rẹ̀, ati ibọwọ ti o mbẹ li apa rẹ̀, emi si mu wọn wá ihinyi sọdọ oluwa mi.
entries.en: So I stood upon him, and slew him, because I was sure that he could not live after that he was fallen: and I took the crown that was upon his head, and the bracelet that was on his arm, and have brought them hither unto my lord.

entries.yo: Dafidi si di aṣọ rẹ̀ mu, o si fà wọn ya, gbogbo awọn ọkunrin ti o wà lọdọ rẹ̀ si ṣe bẹ̃ gẹgẹ.
entries.en: Then David took hold on his clothes, and rent them; and likewise all the men that were with him:

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣọfọ, nwọn si sọkun, nwọn si gbawẹ titi di aṣalẹ fun Saulu, ati fun Jonatani ọmọ rẹ̀, ati fun awọn enia Oluwa, ati fun ile Israeli; nitoripe nwọn ti ipa idà ṣubu.
entries.en: And they mourned, and wept, and fasted until even, for Saul, and for Jonathan his son, and for the people of the LORD, and for the house of Israel; because they were fallen by the sword.

entries.yo: Dafidi si bi ọmọdekunrin na ti o rò fun u wipe, Nibo ni iwọ ti wá? On si da a li ohùn pe, Ọmọ alejo kan, ara Amaleki li emi iṣe.
entries.en: And David said unto the young man that told him, Whence art thou? And he answered, I am the son of a stranger, an Amalekite.

entries.yo: Dafidi si wi fun u pe, E ti ri ti iwọ kò fi bẹ̀ru lati nà ọwọ́ rẹ lati fi pa ẹni-àmi-ororo Oluwa?
entries.en: And David said unto him, How wast thou not afraid to stretch forth thine hand to destroy the LORD's anointed?

entries.yo: Dafidi si pe ọkan ninu awọn ọmọdekunrin, o si wipe, Sunmọ ọ, ki o si kọ lu u. O si kọ lu u, on si kú.
entries.en: And David called one of the young men, and said, Go near, and fall upon him. And he smote him that he died.

entries.yo: Dafidi si wi fun u pe Ẹjẹ rẹ mbẹ li ori ara rẹ; nitoripe ẹnu rẹ li o fi jẹwọ pe, Emi li o pa ẹni-àmi-ororo Oluwa.
entries.en: And David said unto him, Thy blood be upon thy head; for thy mouth hath testified against thee, saying, I have slain the LORD's anointed.

entries.yo: Dafidi si fi orin ọ̀fọ yi ṣọ̀fọ̀ lori Saulu ati lori Jonatani ọmọ rẹ̀:
entries.en: And David lamented with this lamentation over Saul and over Jonathan his son:

entries.yo: O si pa aṣẹ lati kọ́ awọn ọmọ Juda ni ilò ọrun: wõ, a ti kọ ọ sinu iwe Jaṣeri.
entries.en: (Also he bade them teach the children of Judah the use of the bow: behold, it is written in the book of Jasher.)

entries.yo: Ẹwà rẹ Israeli li a pa li oke giga rẹ: wò bi awọn alagbara ti ṣubu!
entries.en: The beauty of Israel is slain upon thy high places: how are the mighty fallen!

entries.yo: Ẹ máṣe sọ ọ ni Gati, ẹ má si ṣe kokiki rẹ̀ ni igboro Aṣkeloni; ki awọn ọmọbinrin Filistini ki o má ba yọ̀, ki ọmọbinrin awọn alaikọla ki o má ba yọ̀.
entries.en: Tell it not in Gath, publish it not in the streets of Askelon; lest the daughters of the Philistines rejoice, lest the daughters of the uncircumcised triumph.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin oke Gilboa, ki ìri ki o má si, ati ki ojò ki o má rọ̀ si nyin, ki ẹ má si ni oko ọrẹ ẹbọ: nitori nibẹ li a gbe sọ asà awọn alagbara nu, asà Saulu, bi ẹnipe a ko fi ororo yàn a.
entries.en: Ye mountains of Gilboa, let there be no dew, neither let there be rain, upon you, nor fields of offerings: for there the shield of the mighty is vilely cast away, the shield of Saul, as though he had not been anointed with oil.

entries.yo: Ọrun Jonatani ki ipada, ati idà Saulu ki ipada lasan lai kan ẹjẹ awọn ti a pa, ati ọra awọn alagbara.
entries.en: From the blood of the slain, from the fat of the mighty, the bow of Jonathan turned not back, and the sword of Saul returned not empty.

entries.yo: Saulu ati Jonatani ni ifẹni si ara wọn, nwọn si dùn li ọjọ aiye wọn, ati ni ikú wọn, nwọn kò ya ara wọn: nwọn yara ju idì lọ, nwọn si li agbara ju kiniun lọ.
entries.en: Saul and Jonathan were lovely and pleasant in their lives, and in their death they were not divided: they were swifter than eagles, they were stronger than lions.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin ọmọbinrin Israeli, ẹ sọkun lori Saulu, ti o fi aṣọ òdodó ati ohun ọṣọ́ wọ̀ nyin, ti o fi ohun ọṣọ́ wura si ara aṣọ nyin.
entries.en: Ye daughters of Israel, weep over Saul, who clothed you in scarlet, with other delights, who put on ornaments of gold upon your apparel.

entries.yo: Wo bi awọn alagbara ti ṣubu larin ogun! A Jonatani! iwọ ti a pa li oke giga rẹ!
entries.en: How are the mighty fallen in the midst of the battle! O Jonathan, thou was slain in thine high places.

entries.yo: Wahala ba mi nitori rẹ, Jonatani, arakunrin mi: didùn jọjọ ni iwọ jẹ fun mi: ifẹ rẹ si mi jasi iyanu, o jù ifẹ obinrin lọ.
entries.en: I am distressed for thee, my brother Jonathan: very pleasant hast thou been unto me: thy love to me was wonderful, passing the love of women.

entries.yo: Wo bi awọn alagbara ti ṣubu, ati bi ohun ija ti ṣegbe!
entries.en: How are the mighty fallen, and the weapons of war perished!

entries.yo: O si ṣe lẹhin eyi, Dafidi si bere lọwọ Oluwa, pe, Ki emi ki o goke lọ si ọkan ni ilu Juda wọnni bi? Oluwa si wi fun u pe, Goke lọ: Dafidi si wipe, niha ibo ni ki emi ki o lọ? On si wipe, Ni Hebroni.
entries.en: And it came to pass after this, that David inquired of the LORD, saying, Shall I go up into any of the cities of Judah? And the LORD said unto him, Go up. And David said, Whither shall I go up? And he said, Unto Hebron.

entries.yo: Dafidi si goke lọ si ibẹ ati awọn obinrin rẹ̀ mejeji pẹlu, Ahinoamu ara Jesreeli ati Abigaili obinrin Nabali ara Karmeli.
entries.en: So David went up thither, and his two wives also, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail Nabal's wife the Carmelite.

entries.yo: Dafidi si mu awọn ọmọkunrin rẹ̀ ti o wà lọdọ rẹ̀ goke, olukuluku ton ti ara ile rẹ̀: nwọn si joko ni ilu Hebroni wọnni.
entries.en: And his men that were with him did David bring up, every man with his household: and they dwelt in the cities of Hebron.

entries.yo: Awọn ọkunrin Juda si wá, nwọn si fi Dafidi jọba nibẹ lori ile Juda. Nwọn si sọ fun Dafidi pe, Awọn ọkunrin Jabeṣi Gileadi li o sinkú Saulu.
entries.en: And the men of Judah came, and there they anointed David king over the house of Judah. And they told David, saying, That the men of Jabesh-gilead were they that buried Saul.

entries.yo: Dafidi si ran onṣẹ si awọn ọkunrin Jabeṣi-Gileadi o si wi fun wọn pe, Alabukun fun li ẹnyin lati ọwọ́ Oluwa wá, bi ẹnyin ti ṣe õre yi si oluwa nyin, si Saulu, ani ti ẹ fi sinkú rẹ̀.
entries.en: And David sent messengers unto the men of Jabesh-gilead, and said unto them, Blessed be ye of the LORD, that ye have shewed this kindness unto your lord, even unto Saul, and have buried him.

entries.yo: Njẹ ki Oluwa ki o ṣe ore ati otitọ fun nyin: emi na yio si san ore yi fun nyin, nitori ti ẹnyin ṣe nkan yi.
entries.en: And now the LORD shew kindness and truth unto you: and I also will requite you this kindness, because ye have done this thing.

entries.yo: Njẹ ẹ si mu ọwọ́ nyin le, ki ẹ si jẹ ẹni-alagbara: nitoripe Saulu oluwa nyin ti kú, ile Juda si ti fi àmi-ororo yàn mi li ọba wọn.
entries.en: Therefore now let your hands be strengthened, and be ye valiant: for your master Saul is dead, and also the house of Judah have anointed me king over them.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Abneri ọmọ Neri olori ogun Saulu si mu Iṣboṣeti ọmọ Saulu, o si mu u kọja si Mahanaimu;
entries.en: But Abner the son of Ner, captain of Saul's host, took Ish-bosheth the son of Saul, and brought him over to Mahanaim;

entries.yo: On si fi i jọba lori Gileadi, ati lori awọn ọmọ Aṣuri, ati lori Jesreeli, ati lori Efraimu, ati lori Benjamini, ati lori gbogbo Israeli.
entries.en: And made him king over Gilead, and over the Ashurites, and over Jezreel, and over Ephraim, and over Benjamin, and over all Israel.

entries.yo: Iṣboṣeti ọmọ Saulu si jẹ ẹni ogoji ọdun nigbati o bẹrẹ si ijọba lori Israeli, o si jọba li ọdun meji. Ṣugbọn idile Juda ntọ̀ Dafidi lẹhin.
entries.en: Ish-bosheth Saul's son was forty years old when he began to reign over Israel, and reigned two years. But the house of Judah followed David.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ọjọ ti Dafidi fi jọba ni Hebroni lori ile Juda jẹ ọdun meje pẹlu oṣù mẹfa.
entries.en: And the time that David was king in Hebron over the house of Judah was seven years and six months.

entries.yo: Abneri ọmọ Neri, ati awọn iranṣẹ Iṣboṣeti ọmọ Saulu si jade kuro ni Mahanaimu lọ si Gibeoni.
entries.en: And Abner the son of Ner, and the servants of Ish-bosheth the son of Saul, went out from Mahanaim to Gibeon.

entries.yo: Joabu ọmọ Seruia, ati awọn iranṣẹ Dafidi si jade, nwọn si jọ pade nibi adagun Gibeoni: nwọn si joko, ẹgbẹ kan li apa ihin adagun, ẹgbẹ keji li apa keji adagun.
entries.en: And Joab the son of Zeruiah, and the servants of David, went out, and met together by the pool of Gibeon: and they sat down, the one on the one side of the pool, and the other on the other side of the pool.

entries.yo: Abneri si wi fun Joabu pe, Jẹ ki awọn ọmọkunrin dide nisisiyi, ki nwọn ki o si ta pọrọ́ niwaju wa. Joabu si wipe, Jẹ ki wọn ki o dide.
entries.en: And Abner said to Joab, Let the young men now arise, and play before us. And Joab said, Let them arise.

entries.yo: Nigbana li awọn mejila ninu ẹya Benjamini ti iṣe ti Iṣboṣeti ọmọ Saulu dide, nwọn si kọja siha keji; mejila ninu awọn ọmọ Dafidi si dide.
entries.en: Then there arose and went over by number twelve of Benjamin, which pertained to Ish-bosheth the son of Saul, and twelve of the servants of David.

entries.yo: Olukuluku wọn si di ọmọnikeji rẹ̀ li ori mu, olukuluku si tẹ idà rẹ̀ bọ ẹnikeji rẹ̀ ni ihà: nwọn si jọ ṣubu lulẹ: nitorina li a si ṣe npe orukọ ibẹ na ni Helkatihassurimu, ti o wà ni Gibeoni.
entries.en: And they caught every one his fellow by the head, and thrust his sword in his fellow's side; so they fell down together: wherefore that place was called Helkath-hazzurim, which is in Gibeon.

entries.yo: Ijà na si kan gidigidi ni ijọ na, a si le Abneri ati awọn ọkunrin Israeli niwaju awọn ọmọ Dafidi.
entries.en: And there was a very sore battle that day; and Abner was beaten, and the men of Israel, before the servants of David.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Seruia mẹtẹta si mbẹ nibẹ, Joabu, Abiṣai, ati Asaheli: ẹsẹ Asaheli si fẹrẹ bi ẹsẹ agbọnrin ti o wà ni pápa.
entries.en: And there were three sons of Zeruiah there, Joab, and Abishai, and Asahel: and Asahel was as light of foot as a wild roe.

entries.yo: Asaheli si nlepa Abneri; bi on ti nlọ kò si yipada si ọwọ ọtun, tabi si ọwọ́ osì lati ma tọ Abneri lẹhin.
entries.en: And Asahel pursued after Abner; and in going he turned not to the right hand nor to the left from following Abner.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Abneri boju wo ẹhin rẹ̀, o si bere pe, Iwọ Asaheli ni? On si dahùn pe, Emi ni.
entries.en: Then Abner looked behind him, and said, Art thou Asahel? And he answered, I am.

entries.yo: Abneri si wi fun u pe, Iwọ yipada si apakan si ọwọ́ ọtun rẹ, tabi si osì rẹ, ki iwọ ki o si di ọkan mu ninu awọn ọmọkunrin, ki o si mu ihamọra rẹ̀. Ṣugbọn Asaheli kọ̀ lati pada lẹhin rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Abner said to him, Turn thee aside to thy right hand or to thy left, and lay thee hold on one of the young men, and take thee his armour. But Asahel would not turn aside from following of him.

entries.yo: Abneri si tun wi fun Asaheli pe, Pada lẹhin mi, ẽṣe ti emi o fi lu ọ bolẹ? bawo li emi o ti ṣe gbe oju soke si Joabu arakunrin rẹ?
entries.en: And Abner said again to Asahel, Turn thee aside from following me: wherefore should I smite thee to the ground? how then should I hold up my face to Joab thy brother?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn o si kọ̀ lati pada: Abneri si fi òdi ọ̀kọ gun u labẹ inu, ọ̀kọ na si jade li ẹhin rẹ̀: on si ṣubu lulẹ nibẹ, o si kú ni ibi kanna; o si ṣe, gbogbo enia ti o de ibiti Asaheli gbe ṣubu si, ti o si kú, si duro jẹ.
entries.en: Howbeit he refused to turn aside: wherefore Abner with the hinder end of the spear smote him under the fifth rib, that the spear came out behind him; and he fell down there, and died in the same place: and it came to pass, that as many as came to the place where Asahel fell down and died stood still.

entries.yo: Joabu ati Abiṣai si lepa Abneri: õrun si wọ̀, nwọn si de oke ti Amma ti o wà niwaju Gia li ọ̀na iju Gibeoni.
entries.en: Joab also and Abishai pursued after Abner: and the sun went down when they were come to the hill of Ammah, that lieth before Giah by the way of the wilderness of Gibeon.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Benjamini si ko ara wọn jọ nwọn tẹle Abneri, nwọn si wa di ẹgbẹ kan, nwọn si duro lori oke kan.
entries.en: And the children of Benjamin gathered themselves together after Abner, and became one troop, and stood on the top of an hill.

entries.yo: Abneri si pe Joabu, o si bi i lere pe, Idà yio ma parun titi lailai bi? njẹ iwọ kò iti mọ̀ pe yio koro nikẹhin? njẹ yio ha ti pẹ to ki iwọ ki o to sọ fun awọn enia na, ki nwọn ki o dẹkun lati ma lepa ará wọn?
entries.en: Then Abner called to Joab, and said, Shall the sword devour for ever? knowest thou not that it will be bitterness in the latter end? how long shall it be then, ere thou bid the people return from following their brethren?

entries.yo: Joabu si wipe, Bi Ọlọrun ti mbẹ, bikoṣe bi iwọ ti wi, nitotọ, li owurọ̀ li awọn enia na iba ti goke lọ, olukuluku iba ti pada lẹhin arakunrin rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Joab said, As God liveth, unless thou hadst spoken, surely then in the morning the people had gone up every one from following his brother.

entries.yo: Joabu si fún ipè, gbogbo enia si duro jẹ, nwọn kò si lepa Israeli mọ, bẹ̃ni nwọn kò si tun jà mọ.
entries.en: So Joab blew a trumpet, and all the people stood still, and pursued after Israel no more, neither fought they any more.

entries.yo: Abneri ati awọn ọmọkunrin rẹ̀ si fi gbogbo oru na rìn ni pẹtẹlẹ, nwọn si kọja Jordani, nwọn si rìn ni gbogbo Bitroni, nwọn si wá si Mahanaimu.
entries.en: And Abner and his men walked all that night through the plain, and passed over Jordan, and went through all Bithron, and they came to Mahanaim.

entries.yo: Joabu si dẹkun ati ma tọ Abneri lẹhin: o si ko gbogbo awọn enia na jọ, enia mọkandi-logun li o kú pẹlu Asaheli ninu awọn iranṣẹ Dafidi.
entries.en: And Joab returned from following Abner: and when he had gathered all the people together, there lacked of David's servants nineteen men and Asahel.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn iranṣẹ Dafidi si lù bolẹ ninu awọn enia Benjamini; ati ninu awọn ọmọkunrin Abneri; ojì-di-ni-irin-wo enia li o kú.
entries.en: But the servants of David had smitten of Benjamin, and of Abner's men, so that three hundred and threescore men died.

entries.yo: Nwọn si gbe Asaheli, nwọn si sin i sinu ibojì baba rẹ̀ ti o wà ni Betlehemu. Joabu ati awọn ọmọkunrin rẹ̀ fi gbogbo oru na rin, ilẹ si mọ́ wọn si Hebroni.
entries.en: And they took up Asahel, and buried him in the sepulchre of his father, which was in Bethlehem. And Joab and his men went all night, and they came to Hebron at break of day.

entries.yo: OGUN na si pẹ titi larin idile Saulu ati idile Dafidi: agbara Dafidi si npọ̀ si i, ṣugbọn idile Saulu nrẹ̀hin si i.
entries.en: Now there was long war between the house of Saul and the house of David: but David waxed stronger and stronger, and the house of Saul waxed weaker and weaker.

entries.yo: Dafidi si bi ọmọkunrin ni Hebroni: Ammoni li akọbi rẹ̀ ti Ahinoamu ara Jesreeli bi fun u.
entries.en: And unto David were sons born in Hebron: and his firstborn was Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess;

entries.yo: Ekeji rẹ̀ si ni Kileabu, ti Abigaili aya Nabali ara Karmeli nì bi fun u; ẹkẹta si ni Absalomu ọmọ ti Maaka ọmọbinrin Talmai ọba Geṣuri bi fun u.
entries.en: And his second, Chileab, of Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite; and the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur;

entries.yo: Ẹkẹrin si ni Adonija ọmọ Haggiti; ati ikarun ni Ṣefatia ọmọ Abitali;
entries.en: And the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith; and the fifth, Shephatiah the son of Abital;

entries.yo: Ẹkẹfa si ni Itreamu, ti Egla aya Dafidi bi fun u. Wọnyi li a bi fun Dafidi ni Hebroni.
entries.en: And the sixth, Ithream, by Eglah David's wife. These were born to David in Hebron.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati ogun wà larin idile Saulu ati idile Dafidi, Abneri si di alagbara ni idile Saulu.
entries.en: And it came to pass, while there was war between the house of Saul and the house of David, that Abner made himself strong for the house of Saul.

entries.yo: Saulu ti ni àle kan, orukọ rẹ̀ si njẹ Rispa, ọmọbinrin Aia: Iṣboṣeti si bi Abneri lere pe, Ẽṣe ti iwọ fi wọle tọ àle baba mi lọ?
entries.en: And Saul had a concubine, whose name was Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah: and Ish-bosheth said to Abner, Wherefore hast thou gone in unto my father's concubine?

entries.yo: Abneri si binu gidigidi nitori ọ̀rọ wọnyi ti Iṣboṣeti sọ fun u, o si wipe, Emi iṣe ori aja bi? emi ti mo mba Juda jà, ti mo si ṣanu loni fun idile Saulu baba rẹ, ati fun ará rẹ̀, ati awọn ọrẹ rẹ̀, ti emi kò si fi iwọ le Dafidi lọwọ, iwọ si ka ẹ̀ṣẹ si mi lọrùn nitori obinrin yi loni?
entries.en: Then was Abner very wroth for the words of Ish-bosheth, and said, Am I a dog's head, which against Judah do shew kindness this day unto the house of Saul thy father, to his brethren, and to his friends, and have not delivered thee into the hand of David, that thou chargest me to day with a fault concerning this woman?

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni ki Ọlọrun ki o ṣe si Abneri, ati jù bẹ̃ lọ pẹlu, bi Oluwa ti bura fun Dafidi, bi emi kò ni ṣe bẹ fun u.
entries.en: So do God to Abner, and more also, except, as the LORD hath sworn to David, even so I do to him;

entries.yo: Lati mu ijọba na kuro ni idile Saulu, ati lati gbe itẹ Dafidi kalẹ lori Israeli, ati lori Juda, lati Dani titi o fi de Beerṣeba.
entries.en: To translate the kingdom from the house of Saul, and to set up the throne of David over Israel and over Judah, from Dan even to Beer-sheba.

entries.yo: On kò si le da Abneri lohùn kan nitoriti o bẹ̀ru rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he could not answer Abner a word again, because he feared him.

entries.yo: Abneri si ran awọn oniṣẹ si Dafidi nitori rẹ̀, wipe, Ti tani ilẹ na iṣe? ati pe, Ba mi ṣe adehun, si wõ, ọwọ́ mi o wà pẹlu rẹ, lati yi gbogbo Israeli sọdọ rẹ.
entries.en: And Abner sent messengers to David on his behalf, saying, Whose is the land? saying also, Make thy league with me, and, behold, my hand shall be with thee, to bring about all Israel unto thee.

entries.yo: On si wi pe, O dara, emi o ba ọ ṣe adehun: ṣugbọn nkan kan li emi o bere lọwọ rẹ, eyini ni, Iwọ ki yio ri oju mi, afi bi iwọ ba mu Mikali ọmọbinrin Saulu wá, nigbati iwọ ba mbọ, lati ri oju mi.
entries.en: And he said, Well; I will make a league with thee: but one thing I require of thee, that is, Thou shalt not see my face, except thou first bring Michal Saul's daughter, when thou comest to see my face.

entries.yo: Dafidi si ran awọn iranṣẹ si Iṣboṣeti ọmọ Saulu pe, Fi Mikali obinrin mi le mi lọwọ, ẹniti emi ti fi ọgọrun ẹfa abẹ awọn Filistini fẹ.
entries.en: And David sent messengers to Ish-bosheth Saul's son, saying, Deliver me my wife Michal, which I espoused to me for an hundred foreskins of the Philistines.

entries.yo: Iṣboṣeti si ranṣẹ, o si gbà a lọwọ ọkunrin ti a npè ni Faltieli ọmọ Laiṣi.
entries.en: And Ish-bosheth sent, and took her from her husband, even from Phaltiel the son of Laish.

entries.yo: Ọkọ rẹ̀ si mba a lọ, o nrin, o si nsọkun lẹhin rẹ̀ titi o fi de Bahurimu. Abneri si wi fun u pe, Pada lọ. On si pada.
entries.en: And her husband went with her along weeping behind her to Bahurim. Then said Abner unto him, Go, return. And he returned.

entries.yo: Abneri si ba awọn agbà Israeli sọ̀rọ, pe, Ẹnyin ti nṣe afẹri Dafidi ni igbà atijọ́, lati jọba lori nyin.
entries.en: And Abner had communication with the elders of Israel, saying, Ye sought for David in times past to be king over you:

entries.yo: Njẹ, ẹ ṣe e: nitoriti Oluwa ti sọ fun Dafidi pe, Lati ọwọ́ Dafidi iranṣẹ mi li emi o gbà Israeli enia mi là kuro lọwọ awọn Filistini ati lọwọ gbogbo awọn ọta wọn.
entries.en: Now then do it: for the LORD hath spoken of David, saying, By the hand of my servant David I will save my people Israel out of the hand of the Philistines, and out of the hand of all their enemies.

entries.yo: Abneri si wi leti Benjamini: Abneri si lọ isọ leti Dafidi ni Hebroni gbogbo eyiti o dara loju Israeli, ati loju gbogbo ile Benjamini.
entries.en: And Abner also spake in the ears of Benjamin: and Abner went also to speak in the ears of David in Hebron all that seemed good to Israel, and that seemed good to the whole house of Benjamin.

entries.yo: Abneri si tọ̀ Dafidi wá ni Hebroni, ogún ọmọkunrin si pẹlu rẹ̀. Dafidi si se ase fun Abneri ati fun awọn ọmọkunrin ti o wà pẹlu rẹ̀.
entries.en: So Abner came to David to Hebron, and twenty men with him. And David made Abner and the men that were with him a feast.

entries.yo: Abneri si wi fun Dafidi pe, Emi o dide, emi o si lọ, emi o si ko gbogbo Israeli jọ sọdọ ọba oluwa mi, nwọn o si ba ọ ṣe adehun, iwọ o si jọba gbogbo wọn bi ọkàn rẹ ti nfẹ. Dafidi si rán Abneri lọ; on si lọ li alafia.
entries.en: And Abner said unto David, I will arise and go, and will gather all Israel unto my lord the king, that they may make a league with thee, and that thou mayest reign over all that thine heart desireth. And David sent Abner away; and he went in peace.

entries.yo: Si wõ, awọn iranṣẹ Dafidi ati Joabu si ti ibi ilepa ẹgbẹ ogun kan bọ̀, nwọn si mu ikogun pupọ bọ̀; ṣugbọn Abneri ko si lọdọ Dafidi ni Hebroni; nitoriti on ti rán a lọ: on si ti lọ li alafia.
entries.en: And, Behold, the servants of David and Joab came from pursuing a troop, and brought in a great spoil with them: but Abner was not with David in Hebron; for he had sent him away, and he was gone in peace.

entries.yo: Nigbati Joabu ati gbogbo ogun ti o pẹlu rẹ̀ si de, nwọn si sọ fun Joabu pe, Abneri, ọmọ Neri ti tọ̀ ọba wá, on si ti rán a lọ, o si ti lọ li alafia.
entries.en: When Joab and all the host that was with him were come, they told Joab, saying, Abner the son of Ner came to the king, and he hath sent him away, and he is gone in peace.

entries.yo: Joabu si tọ̀ ọba wá, o si wipe, Kini iwọ ṣe nì? wõ, Abneri tọ̀ ọ wá; ehatiṣe ti iwọ si fi rán a lọ? on si ti lọ.
entries.en: Then Joab came to the king, and said, What hast thou done? behold, Abner came unto thee; why is it that thou hast sent him away, and he is quite gone?

entries.yo: Iwọ mọ̀ Abneri ọmọ Neri, pe, o wá lati tàn ọ jẹ, ati lati mọ̀ ijadelọ rẹ, ati ibọsile rẹ, ati lati mọ̀ gbogbo eyi ti iwọ nṣe.
entries.en: Thou knowest Abner the son of Ner, that he came to deceive thee, and to know thy going out and thy coming in, and to know all that thou doest.

entries.yo: Nigbati Joabu si jade kuro lọdọ Dafidi, o si ran awọn iranṣẹ lepa Abneri, nwọn si pè e pada lati ibi kanga Sira: Dafidi kò si mọ̀.
entries.en: And when Joab was come out from David, he sent messengers after Abner, which brought him again from the well of Sirah: but David knew it not.

entries.yo: Abneri si pada si Hebroni, Joabu si ba a tẹ̀ larin oju ọ̀na lati ba a sọ̀rọ li alafia, o si gún u nibẹ labẹ inu, o si kú, nitori ẹjẹ Asaheli arakunrin rẹ̀.
entries.en: And when Abner was returned to Hebron, Joab took him aside in the gate to speak with him quietly, and smote him there under the fifth rib, that he died, for the blood of Asahel his brother.

entries.yo: Lẹhin igbati Dafidi si gbọ́ ọ, o si wipe, emi ati ijọba mi si jẹ alaiṣẹ niwaju Oluwa titi lai ni ẹjẹ Abneri ọmọ Neri:
entries.en: And afterward when David heard it, he said, I and my kingdom are guiltless before the LORD for ever from the blood of Abner the son of Ner:

entries.yo: Jẹ ki o wà li ori Joabu, ati li ori gbogbo idile baba rẹ̀; ki a má si fẹ ẹni ti o li arùn isun, tabi adẹtẹ, tabi ẹni ti ntẹ̀ ọpá, tabi, ẹniti a o fi idà pa, tabi ẹniti o ṣe alaili onjẹ kù ni ile Joabu.
entries.en: Let it rest on the head of Joab, and on all his father's house; and let there not fail from the house of Joab one that hath an issue, or that is a leper, or that leaneth on a staff, or that falleth on the sword, or that lacketh bread.

entries.yo: Joabu ati Abiṣai arakunrin rẹ̀ si pa Abneri, nitoripe on ti pa Asaheli arakunrin wọn ni Gibeoni li ogun.
entries.en: So Joab and Abishai his brother slew Abner, because he had slain their brother Asahel at Gibeon in the battle.

entries.yo: Dafidi si wi fun Joabu ati fun gbogbo enia ti mbẹ lọdọ rẹ̀ pe, Ẹ fa aṣọ nyin ya, ki ẹnyin ki o si mu aṣọ-ọ̀fọ, ki ẹnyin ki o si sọkun niwaju Abneri. Dafidi ọba tikararẹ̀ si tẹle posi rẹ̀.
entries.en: And David said to Joab, and to all the people that were with him, Rend your clothes, and gird you with sackcloth, and mourn before Abner. And king David himself followed the bier.

entries.yo: Nwọn si sin Abneri ni Hebroni: ọba si gbe ohùn rẹ̀ soke, o si sọkun ni iboji Abneri; gbogbo awọn enia na si sọkun.
entries.en: And they buried Abner in Hebron: and the king lifted up his voice, and wept at the grave of Abner; and all the people wept.

entries.yo: Ọba si sọkun lori Abneri, o si wipe, Abneri iba ku iku aṣiwere?
entries.en: And the king lamented over Abner, and said, Died Abner as a fool dieth?

entries.yo: A kò sa dè ọ li ọwọ́, bẹ̃ li a kò si kàn ẹsẹ rẹ li abà: gẹgẹ bi enia iti ṣubu niwaju awọn ikà enia, bẹ̃ni iwọ ṣubu. Gbogbo awọn enia na si tun sọkun lori rẹ̀.
entries.en: Thy hands were not bound, nor thy feet put into fetters: as a man falleth before wicked men, so fellest thou. And all the people wept again over him.

entries.yo: Nigbati gbogbo enia si wá lati gbà Dafidi ni iyanju ki o jẹun nigbati ọjọ si mbẹ, Dafidi si bura wipe, Bẹ̃ni ki Ọlọrun ki o ṣe si mi, ati ju bẹ̃ lọ, bi emi ba tọ onjẹ wò, tabi nkan miran, titi õrun yio fi wọ̀.
entries.en: And when all the people came to cause David to eat meat while it was yet day, David sware, saying, So do God to me, and more also, if I taste bread, or ought else, till the sun be down.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn enia si kiyesi i, o si dara loju wọn: gbogbo eyi ti ọba ṣe si dara loju gbogbo awọn enia na.
entries.en: And all the people took notice of it, and it pleased them: as whatsoever the king did pleased all the people.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn enia na ati gbogbo Israeli si mọ̀ lọjọ na pe, ki iṣe ifẹ ọba lati pa Abneri ọmọ Neri.
entries.en: For all the people and all Israel understood that day that it was not of the king to slay Abner the son of Ner.

entries.yo: Ọba si wi fun awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀ pe, Ẹnyin kò mọ̀ pe olori ati ẹni-nla kan li o ṣubu li oni ni Israeli?
entries.en: And the king said unto his servants, Know ye not that there is a prince and a great man fallen this day in Israel?

entries.yo: Emi si ṣe alailagbara loni, bi o tilẹ jẹ pe a fi emi jọba; awọn ọkunrin wọnyi ọmọ Seruia si le jù mi lọ: Oluwa ni yio san a fun ẹni ti o ṣe ibi gẹgẹ bi ìwa buburu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And I am this day weak, though anointed king; and these men the sons of Zeruiah be too hard for me: the LORD shall reward the doer of evil according to his wickedness.

entries.yo: NIGBATI ọmọ Saulu si gbọ́ pe Abneri kú ni Hebroni, ọwọ́ rẹ̀ si rọ, gbogbo Israeli si rẹ̀wẹsi.
entries.en: And when Saul's son heard that Abner was dead in Hebron, his hands were feeble, and all the Israelites were troubled.

entries.yo: Ọmọ Saulu si ni ọkunrin meji ti iṣe olori ẹgbẹ ogun: a npe orukọ ọkan ni Baana, ati orukọ keji ni Rekabu, awọn ọmọ Rimmoni ara Beeroti ti awọn ọmọ Benjamini: (nitoripe a si ka Beeroti pẹlu Benjamini:
entries.en: And Saul's son had two men that were captains of bands: the name of the one was Baanah, and the name of the other Rechab, the sons of Rimmon a Beerothite, of the children of Benjamin: (for Beeroth also was reckoned to Benjamin:

entries.yo: Awọn ara Beeroti si ti sa lọ si Gittaimu, nwọn si ṣe atipo nibẹ titi o fi di ọjọ oni yi.)
entries.en: And the Beerothites fled to Gittaim, and were sojourners there until this day.)

entries.yo: Jonatani ọmọ Saulu si ti bi ọmọkunrin kan ti ẹsẹ rẹ̀ rọ. On si jẹ ọdun marun, nigbati ihìn de niti Saulu ati Jonatani lati Jesreeli wá, olutọ́ rẹ̀ si gbe e, o si sa lọ: o si ṣe, bi o si ti nyara lati sa lọ, on si ṣubu, o si ya arọ. Orukọ rẹ̀ a ma jẹ Mefiboṣeti.
entries.en: And Jonathan, Saul's son, had a son that was lame of his feet. He was five years old when the tidings came of Saul and Jonathan out of Jezreel, and his nurse took him up, and fled: and it came to pass, as she made haste to flee, that he fell, and became lame. And his name was Mephibosheth.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Rimmoni, ara Beeroti, Rekabu ati Baana si lọ, nwọn si wá si ile Iṣboṣeti li ọsangangan, on si dubulẹ lori ibusun kan li ọjọkanri.
entries.en: And the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, Rechab and Baanah, went, and came about the heat of the day to the house of Ish-bosheth, who lay on a bed at noon.

entries.yo: Si wõ, nwọn si wá si arin ile na, nwọn si ṣe bi ẹnipe nwọn nfẹ mu alikama; nwọn si gun u labẹ inu: Rekabu ati Baana arakunrin rẹ̀ si sa lọ.
entries.en: And they came thither into the midst of the house, as though they would have fetched wheat; and they smote him under the fifth rib: and Rechab and Baanah his brother escaped.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn wọ ile na lọ, on si dubulẹ lori ibusun rẹ̀ ninu iyẹwu rẹ̀, nwọn si lu u pa, nwọn si bẹ ẹ li ori, nwọn gbe ori rẹ̀, nwọn si fi gbogbo oru rìn ni pẹtẹlẹ na.
entries.en: For when they came into the house, he lay on his bed in his bedchamber, and they smote him, and slew him, and beheaded him, and took his head, and gat them away through the plain all night.

entries.yo: Nwọn si gbe ori Iṣboṣeti tọ̀ Dafidi wá ni Hebroni, nwọn si wi fun ọba pe, Wõ, ori Iṣboṣeti ọmọ Saulu ọta rẹ, ti o ti nwá ẹmi rẹ kiri; Oluwa ti gbẹ̀san fun ọba oluwa mi loni lara Saulu ati lara iru-ọmọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And they brought the head of Ish-bosheth unto David to Hebron, and said to the king, Behold the head of Ish-bosheth the son of Saul thine enemy, which sought thy life; and the LORD hath avenged my lord the king this day of Saul, and of his seed.

entries.yo: Dafidi si da Rekabu ati Baana arakunrin rẹ̀, awọn ọmọ Rimmoni ara Beeroti lohùn, o si wi fun wọn pe, Bi Oluwa ti mbẹ, ẹniti o gbà ẹmi mi lọwọ gbogbo ipọnju,
entries.en: And David answered Rechab and Baanah his brother, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, and said unto them, As the LORD liveth, who hath redeemed my soul out of all adversity,

entries.yo: Nigbati ẹnikan rò fun mi pe, Wõ, Saulu ti kú, li oju ara rẹ̀ on si jasi ẹni ti o mu ihin rere wá, emi si mu u, mo si pa a ni Siklagi, ẹniti o ṣebi on o ri nkan gbà nitori ihin rere rẹ̀.
entries.en: When one told me, saying, Behold, Saul is dead, thinking to have brought good tidings, I took hold of him, and slew him in Ziklag, who thought that I would have given him a reward for his tidings:

entries.yo: Melomelo ni, nigbati awọn ikà enia pa olododo enia kan ni ile rẹ̀ lori ibusun rẹ̀? njẹ emi ha si le ṣe alaibere ẹjẹ rẹ̀ lọwọ nyin bi? ki emi si mu nyin kuro laiye?
entries.en: How much more, when wicked men have slain a righteous person in his own house upon his bed? shall I not therefore now require his blood of your hand, and take you away from the earth?

entries.yo: Dafidi si fi aṣẹ fun awọn ọdọmọkunrin rẹ̀, nwọn si pa wọn, nwọn si ke ọwọ́ ati ẹṣẹ wọn, a si fi wọn ha lori igi ni Hebroni. Ṣugbọn nwọn mu ori Iṣboṣeti, nwọn si sin i ni iboji Abneri ni Hebroni.
entries.en: And David commanded his young men, and they slew them, and cut off their hands and their feet, and hanged them up over the pool in Hebron. But they took the head of Ish-bosheth, and buried it in the sepulchre of Abner in Hebron.

entries.yo: GBOGBO ẹya Israeli si tọ̀ Dafidi wá ni Hebroni, nwọn si wipe, Wõ, egungun rẹ ati ẹran ara rẹ li awa iṣe.
entries.en: Then came all the tribes of Israel to David unto Hebron, and spake, saying, Behold, we are thy bone and thy flesh.

entries.yo: Ati nigba atijọ, nigbati Saulu fi jọba lori wa, iwọ ni ẹniti ima ko Israeli jade, iwọ ni si ma mu wọn bọ̀ wá ile: Oluwa si wi fun ọ pe, Iwọ o bọ́ Israeli awọn enia mi, iwọ o si jẹ olori fun Israeli.
entries.en: Also in time past, when Saul was king over us, thou wast he that leddest out and broughtest in Israel: and the LORD said to thee, Thou shalt feed my people Israel, and thou shalt be a captain over Israel.

entries.yo: Gbogbo agba Israeli si tọ ọba wá ni Hebroni, Dafidi ọba si ba wọn ṣe adehun kan ni Hebroni, niwaju Oluwa: nwọn si fi ororo yan Dafidi li ọba Israeli.
entries.en: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron; and king David made a league with them in Hebron before the LORD: and they anointed David king over Israel.

entries.yo: Dafidi si jẹ ẹni ọgbọn ọdun nigbati o jọba; on si jọba li ogoji ọdun.
entries.en: David was thirty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years.

entries.yo: O jọba ni Hebroni li ọdun meje on oṣu mẹfa lori Juda: o si jọba ni Jerusalemu li ọdun mẹtalelọgbọn lori gbogbo Israeli ati Juda.
entries.en: In Hebron he reigned over Judah seven years and six months: and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years over all Israel and Judah.

entries.yo: Ati ọba ati awọn ọmọkunrin rẹ̀ si lọ Jerusalemu sọdọ awọn ara Jebusi, awọn enia ilẹ na: awọn ti o si ti wi fun Dafidi pe, Bikoṣepe iwọ ba mu awọn afọju ati awọn arọ kuro, iwọ ki yio wọ ìhin wá: nwọn si wipe, Dafidi ki yio lè wá sihin.
entries.en: And the king and his men went to Jerusalem unto the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land: which spake unto David, saying, Except thou take away the blind and the lame, thou shalt not come in hither: thinking, David cannot come in hither.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Dafidi si fi agbara gbà ilu odi Sioni: eyi na ni iṣe ilu Dafidi.
entries.en: Nevertheless David took the strong hold of Zion: the same is the city of David.

entries.yo: Dafidi si sọ lọjọ na pe, Ẹnikẹni ti yio kọlu awọn ara Jebusi, jẹ ki o gbà oju àgbàrá, ki o si kọlu awọn arọ ati awọn afọju ti ọkàn Dafidi korira. Nitorina ni nwọn ṣe wipe, Afọju ati arọ wà nibẹ, kì yio le wọle.
entries.en: And David said on that day, Whosoever getteth up to the gutter, and smiteth the Jebusites, and the lame and the blind, that are hated of David's soul, he shall be chief and captain. Wherefore they said, The blind and the lame shall not come into the house.

entries.yo: Dafidi si joko ni ile awọn ọmọ-ogun ti o ni odi, a si npè e ni ilu Dafidi. Dafidi mọ ògiri yi i ka lati Millo wá, o si kọ ile ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: So David dwelt in the fort, and called it the city of David. And David built round about from Millo and inward.

entries.yo: Dafidi si npọ̀ si i, Oluwa Ọlọrun awọn ọmọ-ogun si wà pẹlu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And David went on, and grew great, and the LORD God of hosts was with him.

entries.yo: Hiramu ọba Tire si rán awọn iranṣẹ si Dafidi, ati igi kedari, ati awọn gbẹnàgbẹnà, ati awọn ti ngbẹ́ okuta ogiri: nwọn si kọ́ ile kan fun Dafidi.
entries.en: And Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and cedar trees, and carpenters, and masons: and they built David an house.

entries.yo: Dafidi si kiyesi i pe, Oluwa ti fi idi on mulẹ lati jọba lori Israeli, ati pe, o gbe ijọba rẹ̀ ga nitori Israeli awọn enia rẹ̀.
entries.en: And David perceived that the LORD had established him king over Israel, and that he had exalted his kingdom for his people Israel's sake.

entries.yo: Dafidi si tun mu awọn alè ati aya si i lati Jerusalemu wá, lẹhin igbati o ti Hebroni bọ̀: nwọn si bi ọmọkunrin ati ọmọbinrin fun Dafidi.
entries.en: And David took him more concubines and wives out of Jerusalem, after he was come from Hebron: and there were yet sons and daughters born to David.

entries.yo: Eyi si ni orukọ awọn ti a bi fun u ni Jerusalemu, Ṣammua ati Ṣobabu, ati Natani, ati Solomoni,
entries.en: And these be the names of those that were born unto him in Jerusalem; Shammua, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon,

entries.yo: Ati Ibehari, ati Eliṣua, ati Nefegi, ati Jafia,
entries.en: Ibhar also, and Elishua, and Nepheg, and Japhia,

entries.yo: Ati Eliṣama, ati Eliada, ati Elifaleti,
entries.en: And Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphalet.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati awọn Filistini gbọ́ pe, nwọn ti fi Dafidi jọba lori Israeli, gbogbo awọn Filistini si goke wá lati wa Dafidi; Dafidi si gbọ́, o si sọkalẹ lọ si ilu odi.
entries.en: But when the Philistines heard that they had anointed David king over Israel, all the Philistines came up to seek David; and David heard of it, and went down to the hold.

entries.yo: Awọn Filistini si wá, nwọn si tẹ́ ara wọn li afonifoji Refaimu.
entries.en: The Philistines also came and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.

entries.yo: Dafidi si bere lọdọ Oluwa, pe, Ki emi ki o goke tọ̀ awọn Filistini bi? iwọ o fi wọn le mi lọwọ bi? Oluwa si wi fun Dafidi pe, Goke lọ: nitoripe, dajudaju emi o fi awọn Filistini le ọ lọwọ.
entries.en: And David inquired of the LORD, saying, Shall I go up to the Philistines? wilt thou deliver them into mine hand? And the LORD said unto David, Go up: for I will doubtless deliver the Philistines into thine hand.

entries.yo: Dafidi si de Baal-perasimu, Dafidi si pa wọn nibẹ, o si wipe, Oluwa ti ya lù awọn ọtá mi niwaju mi, gẹgẹ bi omi iti ya. Nitorina li on ṣe pe orukọ ibẹ na ni Baal-perasimu.
entries.en: And David came to Baal-perazim, and David smote them there, and said, The LORD hath broken forth upon mine enemies before me, as the breach of waters. Therefore he called the name of that place Baal-perazim.

entries.yo: Nwọn si fi oriṣa wọn silẹ nibẹ, Dafidi ati awọn ọmọkunrin rẹ̀ si ko wọn.
entries.en: And there they left their images, and David and his men burned them.

entries.yo: Awọn Filistini si tún goke wá, nwọn si tàn ara wọn kalẹ ni afonifoji Refaimu.
entries.en: And the Philistines came up yet again, and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.

entries.yo: Dafidi si bere lọdọ Oluwa, on si wipe, Máṣe goke lọ; ṣugbọn bù wọn lẹhin, ki o si kọlu wọn niwaju awọn igi Baka.
entries.en: And when David inquired of the LORD, he said, Thou shalt not go up; but fetch a compass behind them, and come upon them over against the mulberry trees.

entries.yo: Yìo si ṣe, nigbati iwọ ba gbọ́ iro ẹsẹ lori awọn igi Baka na, nigbana ni iwọ o si yara, nitoripe nigbana li Oluwa yio jade lọ niwaju rẹ, lati kọlu ogun awọn Filistini.
entries.en: And let it be, when thou hearest the sound of a going in the tops of the mulberry trees, that then thou shalt bestir thyself: for then shall the LORD go out before thee, to smite the host of the Philistines.

entries.yo: Dafidi si ṣe bẹ̃, gẹgẹ bi Oluwa ti paṣẹ fun u; o si kọlu awọn Filistini lati Geba titi o fi de Gaseri.
entries.en: And David did so, as the LORD had commanded him; and smote the Philistines from Geba until thou come to Gazer.

entries.yo: DAFIDI si tun ko gbogbo awọn akọni ọkunrin ni Israeli jọ, nwọn si jẹ ẹgbã mẹ̃dogun.
entries.en: Again, David gathered together all the chosen men of Israel, thirty thousand.

entries.yo: Dafidi si dide, o si lọ, ati gbogbo awọn enia ti mbẹ lọdọ rẹ̀, lati Baale ti Juda wá, lati mu apoti-ẹri Ọlọrun ti ibẹ wá, eyi ti a npè orukọ rẹ̀ ni orukọ Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun ti o joko lãrin awọn Kerubu.
entries.en: And David arose, and went with all the people that were with him from Baale of Judah, to bring up from thence the ark of God, whose name is called by the name of the LORD of hosts that dwelleth between the cherubims.

entries.yo: Nwọn si gbe apoti-ẹri Ọlọrun na gun kẹkẹ́ titun kan, nwọn si mu u lati ile Abinadabu wá, eyi ti o wà ni Gibea: Ussa ati Ahio, awọn ọmọ Abinadabu si ndà kẹkẹ́ titun na.
entries.en: And they set the ark of God upon a new cart, and brought it out of the house of Abinadab that was in Gibeah: and Uzzah and Ahio, the sons of Abinadab, drave the new cart.

entries.yo: Nwọn si mu u lati ile Abinadabu jade wá, ti o wà ni Gibea, pẹlu apoti-ẹri Ọlọrun; Ahio si nrìn niwaju apoti-ẹri na.
entries.en: And they brought it out of the house of Abinadab which was at Gibeah, accompanying the ark of God: and Ahio went before the ark.

entries.yo: Dafidi ati gbogbo ile Israeli si ṣire niwaju Oluwa lara gbogbo oniruru elò orin ti a fi igi arere ṣe, ati lara duru, ati lara psalteri, ati lara timbreli, ati lara korneti, ati lara aro.
entries.en: And David and all the house of Israel played before the LORD on all manner of instruments made of fir wood, even on harps, and on psalteries, and on timbrels, and on cornets, and on cymbals.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si de ibi ipakà Nakoni, Ussa si nà ọwọ́ rẹ̀ si apoti-ẹri Ọlọrun, o si dì i mu, nitoriti malu kọsẹ.
entries.en: And when they came to Nachon's threshingfloor, Uzzah put forth his hand to the ark of God, and took hold of it; for the oxen shook it.

entries.yo: Ibinu Oluwa si ru si Ussa; Ọlọrun si pa a nibẹ nitori iṣiṣe rẹ̀; nibẹ li o si kú li ẹba apoti-ẹri Ọlọrun.
entries.en: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Uzzah; and God smote him there for his error; and there he died by the ark of God.

entries.yo: Inu Dafidi si bajẹ nitoriti Oluwa ke Ussa kuro: o si pe orukọ ibẹ na ni Peresi-Ussa titi o fi di oni yi.
entries.en: And David was displeased, because the LORD had made a breach upon Uzzah: and he called the name of the place Perez-uzzah to this day.

entries.yo: Dafidi si bẹru Oluwa ni ijọ na, o si wipe, Apoti-ẹri Oluwa yio ti ṣe tọ̀ mi wá?
entries.en: And David was afraid of the LORD that day, and said, How shall the ark of the LORD come to me?

entries.yo: Dafidi kò si fẹ mu apoti-ẹri Oluwa sọdọ rẹ̀ si ilu Dafidi: ṣugbọn Dafidi si mu u yà si ile Obedi-Edomu ara Gati.
entries.en: So David would not remove the ark of the LORD unto him into the city of David: but David carried it aside into the house of Obed-edom the Gittite.

entries.yo: Apoti-ẹri Oluwa si gbe ni ile Obedi-Edomu ara Gati li oṣu mẹta: Oluwa si bukún fun Obedi-Edomu, ati gbogbo ile rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the ark of the LORD continued in the house of Obed-edom the Gittite three months: and the LORD blessed Obed-edom, and all his household.

entries.yo: A si rò fun Dafidi ọba, pe, Oluwa ti bukún fun ile Obedi-Edomu, ati gbogbo eyi ti iṣe tirẹ̀, nitori apoti-ẹri Ọlọrun. Dafidi si lọ, o si mu apoti-ẹri Ọlọrun na goke lati ile Obedi-Edomu wá si ilu Dafidi ton ti ayọ̀.
entries.en: And it was told king David, saying, The LORD hath blessed the house of Obed-edom, and all that pertaineth unto him, because of the ark of God. So David went and brought up the ark of God from the house of Obed-edom into the city of David with gladness.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati awọn enia ti o rù apoti-ẹri Oluwa ba si ṣi ẹsẹ mẹfa, on a si fi malu ati ẹran abọpa rubọ.
entries.en: And it was so, that when they that bare the ark of the LORD had gone six paces, he sacrificed oxen and fatlings.

entries.yo: Dafidi si fi gbogbo agbara rẹ̀ jó niwaju Oluwa; Dafidi si wọ̀ efodu ọgbọ̀.
entries.en: And David danced before the LORD with all his might; and David was girded with a linen ephod.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Dafidi ati gbogbo ile Israeli si gbe apoti-ẹri Oluwa goke wá, ti awọn ti iho ayọ̀, ati pẹlu iro ipè.
entries.en: So David and all the house of Israel brought up the ark of the LORD with shouting, and with the sound of the trumpet.

entries.yo: Bi apoti-ẹri Oluwa si ti wọ̀ ilu Dafidi wá; Mikali ọmọbinrin Saulu si wò lati oju ferese, o si ri Dafidi ọba nfò soke o si njo niwaju Oluwa; on si kẹgàn rẹ̀ li ọkàn rẹ̀.
entries.en: And as the ark of the LORD came into the city of David, Michal Saul's daughter looked through a window, and saw king David leaping and dancing before the LORD; and she despised him in her heart.

entries.yo: Nwọn si mu apoti-ẹri Oluwa na wá, nwọn si gbe e kalẹ sipò rẹ̀ larin agọ na ti Dafidi pa fun u: Dafidi si rubọ sisun ati ẹbọ irẹpọ̀ niwaju Oluwa.
entries.en: And they brought in the ark of the LORD, and set it in his place, in the midst of the tabernacle that David had pitched for it: and David offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the LORD.

entries.yo: Dafidi si pari iṣẹ ẹbọ sisun ati ẹbọ irẹpọ̀ na, o si sure fun awọn enia na li orukọ Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun.
entries.en: And as soon as David had made an end of offering burnt offerings and peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the LORD of hosts.

entries.yo: O si pin fun gbogbo awọn enia na, ani fun gbogbo ọpọ enia Israeli, ati ọkunrin ati obinrin; fun olukuluku iṣu akara kan ati ẹkirí ẹran kan, ati akara didun kan. Gbogbo awọn enia na si tuka lọ, olukuluku si ile rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he dealt among all the people, even among the whole multitude of Israel, as well to the women as men, to every one a cake of bread, and a good piece of flesh, and a flagon of wine. So all the people departed every one to his house.

entries.yo: Dafidi si yipada lati sure fun awọn ara ile rẹ̀, Mikali ọmọbinrin Saulu si jade lati wá pade Dafidi, o si wipe, Bi o ti ṣe ohun ogo to loni fun ọba Israeli, ti o bọ ara rẹ̀ silẹ loni loju awọn iranṣẹbinrin awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀, gẹgẹ bi ọkan ninu awọn enia asan iti bọra rẹ̀ silẹ!
entries.en: Then David returned to bless his household. And Michal the daughter of Saul came out to meet David, and said, How glorious was the king of Israel to day, who uncovered himself to day in the eyes of the handmaids of his servants, as one of the vain fellows shamelessly uncovereth himself!

entries.yo: Dafidi si wi fun Mikali pe, Niwaju Oluwa ni, ẹniti o yàn mi fẹ jù baba rẹ lọ, ati ju gbogbo idile rẹ̀ lọ, lati fi emi ṣe olori awọn enia Oluwa, ani lori Israeli, emi o si ṣire niwaju Oluwa.
entries.en: And David said unto Michal, It was before the LORD, which chose me before thy father, and before all his house, to appoint me ruler over the people of the LORD, over Israel: therefore will I play before the LORD.

entries.yo: Emi o si tun rẹ̀ ara mi silẹ jù bẹ̃ lọ, emi o si ṣe alainiyìn loju ara mi, ati loju awọn iranṣẹbinrin wọnni ti iwọ wi, lọdọ wọn na li emi o si li ogo.
entries.en: And I will yet be more vile than thus, and will be base in mine own sight: and of the maidservants which thou hast spoken of, of them shall I be had in honour.

entries.yo: Mikali ọmọbinrin Saulu kò si bi ọmọ, titi o fi di ọjọ ikú rẹ̀.
entries.en: Therefore Michal the daughter of Saul had no child unto the day of her death.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati ọba si joko ni ile rẹ̀, ti Oluwa si fun u ni isimi yika kiri kuro lọwọ gbogbo awọn ọta rẹ̀.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when the king sat in his house, and the LORD had given him rest round about from all his enemies;

entries.yo: Ọba si wi fun Natani woli pe, Sa wõ, emi ngbe inu ile ti a fi kedari kọ, ṣugbọn apoti-ẹri Ọlọrun ngbe inu ibi ti a fi aṣọ ke.
entries.en: That the king said unto Nathan the prophet, See now, I dwell in an house of cedar, but the ark of God dwelleth within curtains.

entries.yo: Natani si wi fun ọba pe, Lọ, ki o si ṣe gbogbo eyi ti o wà li ọkàn rẹ, nitoripe Oluwa wà pẹlu rẹ.
entries.en: And Nathan said to the king, Go, do all that is in thine heart; for the LORD is with thee.

entries.yo: O si ṣe li oru na, ọ̀rọ Oluwa tọ̀ Natani wá, pe,
entries.en: And it came to pass that night, that the word of the LORD came unto Nathan, saying,

entries.yo: Lọ, sọ fun iranṣẹ mi, fun Dafidi, pe, Bayi li Oluwa wi, iwọ o ha kọ ile fun mi ti emi o gbe?
entries.en: Go and tell my servant David, Thus saith the LORD, Shalt thou build me an house for me to dwell in?

entries.yo: Nitoripe, emi ko iti gbe inu ile kan lati ọjọ ti emi ti mu awọn ọmọ Israeli goke ti ilẹ Egipti wá, titi di oni yi, ṣugbọn emi ti nrin ninu agọ, ati ninu agberin.
entries.en: Whereas I have not dwelt in any house since the time that I brought up the children of Israel out of Egypt, even to this day, but have walked in a tent and in a tabernacle.

entries.yo: Ni ibi gbogbo ti emi ti nrin larin gbogbo awọn ọmọ Israeli, emi ko ti iba ọkan ninu ẹya Israeli, ti emi pa aṣẹ fun lati ma bọ awọn enia mi ani Israeli sọ̀rọ pe, Ẽṣe ti ẹnyin kò fi kedari kọ ile fun mi?
entries.en: In all the places wherein I have walked with all the children of Israel spake I a word with any of the tribes of Israel, whom I commanded to feed my people Israel, saying, Why build ye not me an house of cedar?

entries.yo: Njẹ, nitorina, bayi ni iwọ o si wi fun iranṣẹ mi ani Dafidi pe, Bayi ni Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi, emi ti mu iwọ kuro lati inu agbo agutan wá, lati má mã tẹle awọn agutan, mo si fi ọ jẹ olori awọn enia mi, ani Israeli.
entries.en: Now therefore so shalt thou say unto my servant David, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, I took thee from the sheepcote, from following the sheep, to be ruler over my people, over Israel:

entries.yo: Emi si wà pẹlu rẹ nibikibi ti iwọ nlọ, emi sa ke gbogbo awọn ọta rẹ kuro niwaju rẹ, emi si ti sọ orukọ rẹ di nla, gẹgẹ bi orukọ awọn enia nla ti o wà li aiye.
entries.en: And I was with thee whithersoever thou wentest, and have cut off all thine enemies out of thy sight, and have made thee a great name, like unto the name of the great men that are in the earth.

entries.yo: Emi o si yàn ibi kan fun awọn enia mi, ani Israeli, emi o si gbìn wọn, nwọn o si ma joko ni ibujoko ti wọn, nwọn kì yio si ṣipo pada mọ; awọn ọmọ enia buburu kì yio si pọn wọn loju mọ, bi igba atijọ.
entries.en: Moreover I will appoint a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, that they may dwell in a place of their own, and move no more; neither shall the children of wickedness afflict them any more, as beforetime,

entries.yo: Ati gẹgẹ bi akoko igba ti emi ti fi aṣẹ fun awọn onidajọ lori awọn enia mi, ani Israeli, emi fi isimi fun ọ lọwọ gbogbo awọn ọta rẹ. Oluwa si wi fun ọ pe, Oluwa yio kọ ile kan fun ọ.
entries.en: And as since the time that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel, and have caused thee to rest from all thine enemies. Also the LORD telleth thee that he will make thee an house.

entries.yo: Nigbati ọjọ rẹ ba pe, ti iwọ o si sùn pẹlu awọn baba rẹ, emi o si gbe iru-ọmọ rẹ leke lẹhin rẹ, eyi ti o ti inu rẹ jade wá, emi o si fi idi ijọba rẹ kalẹ.
entries.en: And when thy days be fulfilled, and thou shalt sleep with thy fathers, I will set up thy seed after thee, which shall proceed out of thy bowels, and I will establish his kingdom.

entries.yo: On o si kọ ile fun orukọ mi, emi o si fi idi itẹ ijọba rẹ̀ kalẹ lailai.
entries.en: He shall build an house for my name, and I will stablish the throne of his kingdom for ever.

entries.yo: Emi o ma ṣe baba fun u, on o si ma jẹ ọmọ mi. Bi on ba dẹṣẹ, emi o si fi ọpá enia nà a, ati inà awọn ọmọ enia.
entries.en: I will be his father, and he shall be my son. If he commit iniquity, I will chasten him with the rod of men, and with the stripes of the children of men:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ãnu mi kì yio yipada kuro lọdọ rẹ̀, gẹgẹ bi emi ti mu u kuro lọdọ Saulu, ti emi ti mu kuro niwaju rẹ.
entries.en: But my mercy shall not depart away from him, as I took it from Saul, whom I put away before thee.

entries.yo: A o si fi idile rẹ ati ijọba rẹ mulẹ niwaju rẹ titi lai: a o si fi idi itẹ rẹ mulẹ titi lai.
entries.en: And thine house and thy kingdom shall be established for ever before thee: thy throne shall be established for ever.

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi gbogbo ọ̀rọ wọnyi, ati gẹgẹ bi gbogbo iran yi, bẹ̃ni Natani si sọ fun Dafidi.
entries.en: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so did Nathan speak unto David.

entries.yo: Dafidi ọba si wọle lọ, o si duro niwaju Oluwa, o si wipe, Oluwa Ọlọrun, tali emi, ati ki si ni idile mi, ti iwọ fi mu mi di isisiyi?
entries.en: Then went king David in, and sat before the LORD, and he said, Who am I, O Lord GOD? and what is my house, that thou hast brought me hitherto?

entries.yo: Nkan kekere li eyi sa jasi li oju rẹ, Oluwa Ọlọrun; iwọ si sọ ti idile iranṣẹ rẹ pẹlu ni ti akoko ti o jina. Eyi ha ṣe ìwa enia bi, Oluwa Ọlọrun?
entries.en: And this was yet a small thing in thy sight, O Lord GOD; but thou hast spoken also of thy servant's house for a great while to come. And is this the manner of man, O Lord GOD?

entries.yo: Kini Dafidi iba si ma wi si i fun ọ? Iwọ, Oluwa Ọlọrun mọ̀ iranṣẹ rẹ.
entries.en: And what can David say more unto thee? for thou, Lord GOD, knowest thy servant.

entries.yo: Nitori ọ̀rọ rẹ, ati gẹgẹ bi ifẹ ọkàn rẹ, ni iwọ ṣe gbogbo nkan nla wọnyi, ki iranṣẹ rẹ ki o le mọ̀.
entries.en: For thy word's sake, and according to thine own heart, hast thou done all these great things, to make thy servant know them.

entries.yo: Iwọ si tobi, Oluwa Ọlọrun: kò si si ẹniti o dabi rẹ, kò si si Ọlọrun kan lẹhin rẹ, gẹgẹ bi gbogbo eyi ti awa fi eti wa gbọ́.
