entries.en: Wherefore thou art great, O LORD God: for there is none like thee, neither is there any God beside thee, according to all that we have heard with our ears.

entries.yo: Orilẹ-ède kan wo li o si mbẹ li aiye ti o dabi awọn enia rẹ, ani Israeli, awọn ti Ọlọrun lọ ràpada lati sọ wọn di enia rẹ̀, ati lati sọ wọn li orukọ, ati lati ṣe nkan nla fun nyin, ati nkan iyanu fun ilẹ rẹ, niwaju awọn enia rẹ, ti iwọ ti ràpada fun ara rẹ lati Egipti wá, ani awọn orilẹ-ède ati awọn oriṣa wọn.
entries.en: And what one nation in the earth is like thy people, even like Israel, whom God went to redeem for a people to himself, and to make him a name, and to do for you great things and terrible, for thy land, before thy people, which thou redeemedst to thee from Egypt, from the nations and their gods?

entries.yo: Iwọ si fi idi awọn enia rẹ, ani Israeli, kalẹ fun ara rẹ lati sọ wọn di enia rẹ titi lai: iwọ Oluwa si wa di Ọlọrun fun wọn.
entries.en: For thou hast confirmed to thyself thy people Israel to be a people unto thee for ever: and thou, LORD, art become their God.

entries.yo: Njẹ, Oluwa Ọlọrun, jẹ ki ọ̀rọ na ti iwọ sọ niti iranṣẹ rẹ, ati niti idile rẹ̀, ki o duro titi lai, ki o si ṣe bi iwọ ti wi.
entries.en: And now, O LORD God, the word that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant, and concerning his house, establish it for ever, and do as thou hast said.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki orukọ rẹ ki o ga titi lai, pe, Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun li Ọlọrun lori Israeli: si jẹ ki a fi idile Dafidi iranṣẹ rẹ mulẹ niwaju rẹ.
entries.en: And let thy name be magnified for ever, saying, The LORD of hosts is the God over Israel: and let the house of thy servant David be established before thee.

entries.yo: Nitoripe iwọ, Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun, Ọlọrun Israeli ti sọ li eti iranṣẹ rẹ, pe, emi o ṣe idile kan fun ọ: nitorina ni iranṣẹ rẹ si ṣe ni i li ọkàn rẹ̀ lati gbadura yi si ọ.
entries.en: For thou, O LORD of hosts, God of Israel, hast revealed to thy servant, saying, I will build thee an house: therefore hath thy servant found in his heart to pray this prayer unto thee.

entries.yo: Njẹ, Oluwa Ọlọrun, iwọ li Ọlọrun na, ọrọ rẹ wọnni yio si jasi otitọ, iwọ si jẹ'jẹ nkan rere yi fun iranṣẹ rẹ:
entries.en: And now, O Lord GOD, thou art that God, and thy words be true, and thou hast promised this goodness unto thy servant:

entries.yo: Njẹ, jẹ ki o wù ọ lati bukún idile iranṣẹ rẹ, ki o wà titi lai niwaju rẹ: nitori iwọ, Oluwa Ọlọrun, li o ti sọ ọ: si jẹ ki ibukún ki o wà ni idile iranṣẹ rẹ titi lai, nipasẹ ibukún rẹ.
entries.en: Therefore now let it please thee to bless the house of thy servant, that it may continue for ever before thee: for thou, O Lord GOD, hast spoken it: and with thy blessing let the house of thy servant be blessed for ever.

entries.yo: O SI ṣe, lẹhin eyi, Dafidi si kọlu awọn Filistini, o si tẹri wọn ba: Dafidi si gbà Metegamma lọwọ awọn Filistini.
entries.en: And after this it came to pass, that David smote the Philistines, and subdued them: and David took Metheg-ammah out of the hand of the Philistines.

entries.yo: O si kọlu Moabu, a si fi okùn tita kan diwọ̀n wọn, o si da wọn bu'lẹ; o si ṣe oṣuwọn okun meji ni iye awọn ti on o pa, ati ẹkún oṣuwọn okùn kan ni iye awọn ti yio dá si. Awọn ara Moabu si nsìn Dafidi, nwọn a si ma mu ẹbùn wá.
entries.en: And he smote Moab, and measured them with a line, casting them down to the ground; even with two lines measured he to put to death, and with one full line to keep alive. And so the Moabites became David's servants, and brought gifts.

entries.yo: Dafidi si kọlu Hadadeseri ọmọ Rehobu, ọba Soba, bi on si ti nlọ lati gbà ilẹ rẹ̀ pada ti o gbè odo Eufrate.
entries.en: David smote also Hadadezer, the son of Rehob, king of Zobah, as he went to recover his border at the river Euphrates.

entries.yo: Dafidi si gbà ẹgbẹrun kẹkẹ lọwọ rẹ̀, ati ẹ̃dẹgbẹrin ẹlẹṣin, ati ẹgbãwa awọn ẹlẹsẹ: Dafidi si ja gbogbo ẹṣin kẹkẹ́ wọn wọnni ni pátì, ṣugbọn o da ọgọrun kẹkẹ́ si ninu wọn.
entries.en: And David took from him a thousand chariots, and seven hundred horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen: and David houghed all the chariot horses, but reserved of them for an hundred chariots.

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn ara Siria ti Damasku si wá lati ran Hadadeseri ọba Soba lọwọ, Dafidi si pa ẹgbãmọkanla enia ninu awọn ara Siria.
entries.en: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to succour Hadadezer king of Zobah, David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men.

entries.yo: Dafidi si fi awọn ologun si Siria ti Damasku: awọn ara Siria si wa sìn Dafidi, nwọn a si ma mu ẹbùn wá. Oluwa si pa Dafidi mọ nibikibi ti o nlọ.
entries.en: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus: and the Syrians became servants to David, and brought gifts. And the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went.

entries.yo: Dafidi si gbà aṣà wura ti o wà lara awọn iranṣẹ Hadadeseri, o si ko wọn wá si Jerusalemu.
entries.en: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Lati Beta, ati lati Berotai, awọn ilú Hadadeseri, ni Dafidi ọba si ko ọ̀pọlọpọ idẹ wá.
entries.en: And from Betah, and from Berothai, cities of Hadadezer, king David took exceeding much brass.

entries.yo: Nigbati Toi ọba Hamati si gbọ́ pe Dafidi ti pa gbogbo ogun Hadadeseri,
entries.en: When Toi king of Hamath heard that David had smitten all the host of Hadadezer,

entries.yo: Toi si ran Joramu ọmọ rẹ̀ si Dafidi ọba, lati ki i, ati lati sure fun u, nitoripe o ti ba Hadadeseri jagun, o si ti pa a: nitoriti Hadadeseri sa ti ba Toi jagun. Joramu si ni ohun elo fadaka, ati ohun elo wura, ati ohun elo idẹ li ọwọ́ rẹ̀:
entries.en: Then Toi sent Joram his son unto king David, to salute him, and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer, and smitten him: for Hadadezer had wars with Toi. And Joram brought with him vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and vessels of brass:

entries.yo: Dafidi ọba si fi wọn fun Oluwa, pẹlu fadaka, ati wura ti o ti yà si mimọ́, eyi ti o ti gbà lọwọ awọn orilẹ-ède ti o ti ṣẹgun;
entries.en: Which also king David did dedicate unto the LORD, with the silver and gold that he had dedicated of all nations which he subdued;

entries.yo: Lọwọ Siria ati lọwọ Moabu, ati lọwọ awọn ọmọ Ammoni, ati lọwọ awọn Filistini, ati lọwọ Amaleki, ati ninu ikogun Hadadeseri ọmọ Rehobu ọba Soba.
entries.en: Of Syria, and of Moab, and of the children of Ammon, and of the Philistines, and of Amalek, and of the spoil of Hadadezer, son of Rehob, king of Zobah.

entries.yo: Dafidi si ni asiki gidigidi nigbati o pada wá ile lati ibi pipa awọn ara Siria li afonifoji iyọ̀, awọn ti o pa jẹ ẹgbãsan enia.
entries.en: And David gat him a name when he returned from smiting of the Syrians in the valley of salt, being eighteen thousand men.

entries.yo: O si fi awọn ologun si Edomu; ati ni gbogbo Edomu yika li on si fi ologun si, gbogbo awọn ti o wà ni Edomu si wá sin Dafidi. Oluwa si pa Dafidi mọ nibikibi ti o nlọ.
entries.en: And he put garrisons in Edom; throughout all Edom put he garrisons, and all they of Edom became David's servants. And the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went.

entries.yo: Dafidi si jọba lori gbogbo Israeli; Dafidi si ṣe idajọ ati otitọ fun awọn enia rẹ̀.
entries.en: And David reigned over all Israel; and David executed judgment and justice unto all his people.

entries.yo: Joabu ọmọ Seruia li o si nṣe olori ogun; Jehoṣafati ọmọ Ahiludi si nṣe akọwe.
entries.en: And Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the host; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder;

entries.yo: Ati Sadoku ọmọ Ahitubu, ati Ahimeleki ọmọ Abiatari, li awọn alufa; Seruia a si ma ṣe akọwe.
entries.en: And Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, were the priests; and Seraiah was the scribe;

entries.yo: Benaiah ọmọ Jehoiada li o si nṣe olori awọn Kereti, ati awọn Peleti; awọn ọmọ Dafidi si jẹ alaṣẹ.
entries.en: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over both the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and David's sons were chief rulers.

entries.yo: DAFIDI si bere pe, ọkan ninu awọn ẹniti iṣe idile Saulu kù sibẹ bi? ki emi ki o le ṣe ore fun u nitori Jonatani.
entries.en: And David said, Is there yet any that is left of the house of Saul, that I may shew him kindness for Jonathan's sake?

entries.yo: Iranṣẹ kan si ti wà ni idile Saulu, orukọ rẹ̀ a ma jẹ Siba. Nwọn si pè e wá sọdọ Dafidi, ọba si bere lọwọ rẹ̀ pe, Iwọ ni Siba bi? O si dahùn wipe, Iranṣẹ rẹ ni.
entries.en: And there was of the house of Saul a servant whose name was Ziba. And when they had called him unto David, the king said unto him, Art thou Ziba? And he said, Thy servant is he.

entries.yo: Ọba si wipe, Kò ha si ọkan ninu idile Saulu sibẹ, ki emi ki o ṣe ore Ọlọrun fun u? Siba si wi fun ọba pe, Jonatani ní ọmọ kan sibẹ ti o ya arọ.
entries.en: And the king said, Is there not yet any of the house of Saul, that I may shew the kindness of God unto him? And Ziba said unto the king, Jonathan hath yet a son, which is lame on his feet.

entries.yo: Ọba si wi fun u pe, Nibo li o gbe wà? Siba si wi fun ọba pe, Wõ, on wà ni ile Makiri, ọmọ Ammieli, ni Lodebari.
entries.en: And the king said unto him, Where is he? And Ziba said unto the king, Behold, he is in the house of Machir, the son of Ammiel, in Lo-debar.

entries.yo: Dafidi ọba si ranṣẹ, o si mu u lati ile Makiri ọmọ Ammieli lati Lodebari wá.
entries.en: Then king David sent, and fetched him out of the house of Machir, the son of Ammiel, from Lo-debar.

entries.yo: Mefiboṣeti ọmọ Jonatani ọmọ Saulu si tọ̀ Dafidi wá, o si wolẹ niwaju rẹ̀, o si bu ọla fun u. Dafidi si wipe, Mefiboṣeti. On si dahùn wipe, Wo iranṣẹ rẹ!
entries.en: Now when Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, was come unto David, he fell on his face, and did reverence. And David said, Mephibosheth. And he answered, Behold thy servant!

entries.yo: Dafidi si wi fun u pe, Máṣe bẹ̀ru: nitoripe nitotọ emi o ṣe ore fun ọ nitori Jonatani baba rẹ, emi o si tun fi gbogbo ilẹ Saulu baba rẹ fun ọ: iwọ o si ma ba mi jẹun nigbagbogbo ni ibi onjẹ mi.
entries.en: And David said unto him, Fear not: for I will surely shew thee kindness for Jonathan thy father's sake, and will restore thee all the land of Saul thy father; and thou shalt eat bread at my table continually.

entries.yo: On si tẹriba, o si wipe, Kini iranṣẹ rẹ jasi, ti iwọ o fi ma wo okú aja bi emi?
entries.en: And he bowed himself, and said, What is thy servant, that thou shouldest look upon such a dead dog as I am?

entries.yo: Ọba si pe Siba iranṣẹ Saulu, o si wi fun u pe, Gbogbo nkan ti iṣe ti Saulu, ati gbogbo eyi ti iṣe ti idile rẹ̀ li emi fi fun ọmọ oluwa rẹ.
entries.en: Then the king called to Ziba, Saul's servant, and said unto him, I have given unto thy master's son all that pertained to Saul and to all his house.

entries.yo: Iwọ, ati awọn ọmọ rẹ, ati awọn iranṣẹ rẹ ni yio si ma ro ilẹ na fun u, iwọ ni yio si ma mu ikore wá, ọmọ oluwa rẹ yio si ma ri onjẹ jẹ: ṣugbọn Mefiboṣeti ọmọ oluwa rẹ̀ yio si ma ba mi jẹun nigbagbogbo ni ibi onjẹ mi. Siba si ni ọmọ mẹ̃dogun ati ogún iranṣẹkunrin.
entries.en: Thou therefore, and thy sons, and thy servants, shall till the land for him, and thou shalt bring in the fruits, that thy master's son may have food to eat: but Mephibosheth thy master's son shall eat bread alway at my table. Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants.

entries.yo: Siba si wi fun ọba pe, Gẹgẹ bi gbogbo eyi ti oluwa mi ọba ti pa li aṣẹ fun iranṣẹ rẹ, bẹ̃na ni iranṣẹ rẹ o si ṣe. Ọba si wi pe, Niti Mefiboṣeti, yio ma jẹun ni ibi onjẹ mi, gẹgẹ bi ọkan ninu awọn ọmọ ọba.
entries.en: Then said Ziba unto the king, According to all that my lord the king hath commanded his servant, so shall thy servant do. As for Mephibosheth, said the king, he shall eat at my table, as one of the king's sons.

entries.yo: Mefiboṣeti si ni ọmọ kekere kan, orukọ rẹ̀ njẹ Mika. Gbogbo awọn ti ngbe ni ile Siba li o si nṣe iranṣẹ fun Mefiboṣeti.
entries.en: And Mephibosheth had a young son, whose name was Micha. And all that dwelt in the house of Ziba were servants unto Mephibosheth.

entries.yo: Mefiboṣeti si ngbe ni Jerusalemu: on a si ma jẹun nigbagbogbo ni ibi onjẹ ọba; on si yarọ li ẹsẹ rẹ̀ mejeji.
entries.en: So Mephibosheth dwelt in Jerusalem: for he did eat continually at the king's table; and was lame on both his feet.

entries.yo: O si ṣe lẹhin eyi, ọba awọn ọmọ Ammoni si kú, Hanuni ọmọ rẹ̀ si jọba ni ipò rẹ̀.
entries.en: And it came to pass after this, that the king of the children of Ammon died, and Hanun his son reigned in his stead.

entries.yo: Dafidi si wipe, Emi o ṣe ore fun Hanuni ọmọ Nahaṣi gẹgẹ bi baba rẹ̀ si ti ṣe ore fun mi. Dafidi si ranṣẹ lati tù u ninu lati ọwọ́ awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀ wá, nitori ti baba rẹ̀. Awọn iranṣẹ Dafidi si wá si ilẹ awọn ọmọ Ammoni.
entries.en: Then said David, I will shew kindness unto Hanun the son of Nahash, as his father shewed kindness unto me. And David sent to comfort him by the hand of his servants for his father. And David's servants came into the land of the children of Ammon.

entries.yo: Awọn olori awọn ọmọ Ammoni si wi fun Hanuni oluwa wọn pe, Li oju rẹ, ọlá ni Dafidi mbù fun baba rẹ, ti o fi ran awọn olutùnú si ọ? ko ha se pe, Dafidi ran awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀ si ọ, lati wa wò ilu, ati lati ṣe alami rẹ̀, ati lati bà a jẹ?
entries.en: And the princes of the children of Ammon said unto Hanun their lord, Thinkest thou that David doth honour thy father, that he hath sent comforters unto thee? hath not David rather sent his servants unto thee, to search the city, and to spy it out, and to overthrow it?

entries.yo: Hanuni si mu awọn iranṣẹ Dafidi, o fá apakan irungbọ̀n wọn, o si ke abọ̀ kuro ni agbáda wọn, titi o fi de idi wọn, o si rán wọn lọ.
entries.en: Wherefore Hanun took David's servants, and shaved off the one half of their beards, and cut off their garments in the middle, even to their buttocks, and sent them away.

entries.yo: Nwọn si sọ fun Dafidi, o si ranṣẹ lọ ipade wọn, nitoriti oju tì awọn ọkunrin na pupọ̀: ọba si wipe. Ẹ duro ni Jeriko titi irungbọ̀n nyin yio fi hù, nigbana ni ki ẹ padà bọ̀.
entries.en: When they told it unto David, he sent to meet them, because the men were greatly ashamed: and the king said, Tarry at Jericho until your beards be grown, and then return.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Ammoni si ri pe, nwọn di ẹni irira niwaju Dafidi, awọn ọmọ Ammoni si ranṣẹ, nwọn si fi owo bẹ̀ ogun awọn ara Siria ti Betrehobu; ati Siria ti Soba, ẹgbãwa ẹlẹsẹ ati ti ọba Maaka, ẹgbẹrun ọkunrin, ati ti Iṣtobu ẹgbãfa ọkunrin.
entries.en: And when the children of Ammon saw that they stank before David, the children of Ammon sent and hired the Syrians of Beth-rehob, and the Syrians of Zoba, twenty thousand footmen, and of king Maacah a thousand men, and of Ish-tob twelve thousand men.

entries.yo: Dafidi si gbọ́, o si rán Joabu, ati gbogbo ogun awọn ọkunrin alagbara.
entries.en: And when David heard of it, he sent Joab, and all the host of the mighty men.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Ammoni si jade, nwọn si tẹ́ ogun li ẹnu odi; ara Siria ti Soba, ati ti Rehobu, ati Iṣtobu, ati Maaka, nwọn si tẹ́ ogun ni papa fun ara wọn.
entries.en: And the children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array at the entering in of the gate: and the Syrians of Zoba, and of Rehob, and Ish-tob, and Maacah, were by themselves in the field.

entries.yo: Nigbati Joabu si ri i pe ogun na doju kọ on niwaju ati lẹhin, o si yàn ninu gbogbo awọn akikanju ọkunrin ni Israeli, o si tẹ́ ogun kọju si awọn ara Siria.
entries.en: When Joab saw that the front of the battle was against him before and behind, he chose of all the choice men of Israel, and put them in array against the Syrians:

entries.yo: O si fi awọn enia ti o kù le Abiṣai aburo rẹ̀ lọwọ, ki o le tẹ́ ogun kọju si awọn ọmọ Ammoni.
entries.en: And the rest of the people he delivered into the hand of Abishai his brother, that he might put them in array against the children of Ammon.

entries.yo: O si wipe, Bi agbara awọn ara Siria ba si pọ̀ jù emi lọ, iwọ o si wá ràn mi lọwọ: ṣugbọn bi ọwọ́ awọn ọmọ Ammoni ba si pọ̀ jù ọ lọ, emi o si wá ràn ọ lọwọ.
entries.en: And he said, If the Syrians be too strong for me, then thou shalt help me: but if the children of Ammon be too strong for thee, then I will come and help thee.

entries.yo: Mu ọkàn le, jẹ ki a ṣe onigboya nitori awọn enia wa, ati nitori awọn ilu Ọlọrun wa; Oluwa o si ṣe eyi ti o dara li oju rẹ̀.
entries.en: Be of good courage, and let us play the men for our people, and for the cities of our God: and the LORD do that which seemeth him good.

entries.yo: Joabu ati awọn enia ti mbẹ lọdọ rẹ̀ si ba awọn ara Siria pade ijà: nwọn si sa niwaju rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Joab drew nigh, and the people that were with him, unto the battle against the Syrians: and they fled before him.

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn ọmọ Ammoni si ri pe awọn ara Siria sá, awọn si sá niwaju Abiṣai, nwọn si wọ inu ilu lọ. Joabu si pada kuro lẹhin awọn ọmọ Ammoni, o si pada wá si Jerusalemu.
entries.en: And when the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians were fled, then fled they also before Abishai, and entered into the city. So Joab returned from the children of Ammon, and came to Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn ara Siria si ri pe nwọn di bibì ṣubu niwaju Israeli, nwọn si ko ara wọn jọ.
entries.en: And when the Syrians saw that they were smitten before Israel, they gathered themselves together.

entries.yo: Hadareseri si ranṣẹ, o si mu awọn ara Siria ti o wà li oke odo jade wá: nwọn si wá si Helami; Ṣobaki olori ogun ti Hadareseri si ṣolori wọn.
entries.en: And Hadarezer sent, and brought out the Syrians that were beyond the river: and they came to Helam; and Shobach the captain of the host of Hadarezer went before them.

entries.yo: Nigbati a sọ fun Dafidi, o si ko gbogbo Israeli jọ, nwọn si kọja Jordani, nwọn si wá si Helami. Awọn ara Siria si tẹ́ ogun kọju si Dafidi, nwọn si ba a jà.
entries.en: And when it was told David, he gathered all Israel together, and passed over Jordan, and came to Helam. And the Syrians set themselves in array against David, and fought with him.

entries.yo: Awọn ara Siria si sa niwaju Israeli; Dafidi si pa ninu awọn ara Siria ẽdẹgbẹrin awọn onikẹkẹ́, ati ọkẹ meji ẹlẹṣin, nwọn si kọlu Ṣobaki olori ogun wọn, o si kú nibẹ.
entries.en: And the Syrians fled before Israel; and David slew the men of seven hundred chariots of the Syrians, and forty thousand horsemen, and smote Shobach the captain of their host, who died there.

entries.yo: Nigbati gbogbo awọn ọba ti o wà labẹ Hadareseri si ri pe nwọn di bibì ṣubu niwaju Israeli, nwọn si ba Israeli lajà, nwọn si nsìn wọn. Awọn ara Siria si bẹ̀ru lati ràn awọn ọmọ Ammoni lọwọ mọ.
entries.en: And when all the kings that were servants to Hadarezer saw that they were smitten before Israel, they made peace with Israel, and served them. So the Syrians feared to help the children of Ammon any more.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, lẹhin igbati ọdun yipo, li akoko igbati awọn ọba ima jade ogun, Dafidi si rán Joabu, ati awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀ pẹlu rẹ̀, ati gbogbo Israeli; nwọn si pa awọn ọmọ Ammoni, nwọn si dó ti Rabba. Dafidi si joko ni Jerusalemu.
entries.en: And it came to pass, after the year was expired, at the time when kings go forth to battle, that David sent Joab, and his servants with him, and all Israel; and they destroyed the children of Ammon, and besieged Rabbah. But David tarried still at Jerusalem.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, ni igbà aṣalẹ kan, Dafidi si dide ni ibusùn rẹ̀, o si nrìn lori orule ile ọba, lati ori orule na li o si ri obinrin kan ti o nwẹ̀ ara rẹ̀; obinrin na si ṣe arẹwa jọjọ lati wò.
entries.en: And it came to pass in an eveningtide, that David arose from off his bed, and walked upon the roof of the king's house: and from the roof he saw a woman washing herself; and the woman was very beautiful to look upon.

entries.yo: Dafidi si ranṣẹ, o si bere obinrin na. Ẹnikan si wipe, Eyi kọ Batṣeba, ọmọbinrin Eliami, aya Uria ará Hitti?
entries.en: And David sent and inquired after the woman. And one said, Is not this Bath-sheba, the daughter of Eliam, the wife of Uriah the Hittite?

entries.yo: Dafidi si rán awọn iranṣẹ, o si mu u; on si wọ inu ile tọ̀ ọ lọ, on si ba a dapọ̀: nigbati o si wẹ ara rẹ̀ mọ́ tan, o si pada lọ si ile rẹ̀.
entries.en: And David sent messengers, and took her; and she came in unto him, and he lay with her; for she was purified from her uncleanness: and she returned unto her house.

entries.yo: Obinrin na si fẹra kù, o si ranṣẹ o si sọ fun Dafidi, o si wipe, Emi fẹra kù.
entries.en: And the woman conceived, and sent and told David, and said, I am with child.

entries.yo: Dafidi si ranṣẹ si Joabu, pe, Ran Uria ará Hitti si mi. Joabu si ran Uria si Dafidi.
entries.en: And David sent to Joab, saying, Send me Uriah the Hittite. And Joab sent Uriah to David.

entries.yo: Nigbati Uria si de ọdọ rẹ̀, Dafidi si bi i li ere alafia Joabu, ati alafia awọn enia na, ati bi ogun na ti nṣe.
entries.en: And when Uriah was come unto him, David demanded of him how Joab did, and how the people did, and how the war prospered.

entries.yo: Dafidi si wi fun Uria pe, Sọkalẹ lọ si ile rẹ, ki o si wẹ ẹsẹ rẹ. Uria si jade kuro ni ile ọba, onjẹ lati ọdọ ọba wá si tọ̀ ọ lẹhin.
entries.en: And David said to Uriah, Go down to thy house, and wash thy feet. And Uriah departed out of the king's house, and there followed him a mess of meat from the king.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Uria sùn li ẹnu-ọ̀na ile ọba lọdọ gbogbo iranṣẹ oluwa rẹ̀, kò si sọkalẹ lọ si ile rẹ̀.
entries.en: But Uriah slept at the door of the king's house with all the servants of his lord, and went not down to his house.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si sọ fun Dafidi pe, Uria kò sọkalẹ lọ si ile rẹ̀, Dafidi si wi fun Uria pe, Ṣe ọ̀na àjo ni iwọ ti wá? eha ti ṣe ti iwọ kò fi sọkalẹ lọ si ile rẹ?
entries.en: And when they had told David, saying, Uriah went not down unto his house, David said unto Uriah, Camest thou not from thy journey? why then didst thou not go down unto thine house?

entries.yo: Uria si wi fun Dafidi pe, Apoti-ẹri, ati Israeli, ati Juda joko ninu agọ; ati Joabu oluwa mi, ati awọn iranṣẹ oluwa mi wà ni ibudo ni pápa: emi o ha lọ si ile mi, lati jẹ ati lati mu, ati lati ba obinrin mi sùn? bi iwọ ba wà lãye, ati bi ẹmi rẹ si ti mbẹ lãye, emi kì yio ṣe nkan yi.
entries.en: And Uriah said unto David, The ark, and Israel, and Judah, abide in tents; and my lord Joab, and the servants of my lord, are encamped in the open fields; shall I then go into mine house, to eat and to drink, and to lie with my wife? as thou livest, and as thy soul liveth, I will not do this thing.

entries.yo: Dafidi si wi fun Uria pe, Si duro nihin loni, li ọla emi o si jẹ ki iwọ ki o lọ. Uria si duro ni Jerusalemu li ọjọ na, ati ijọ keji.
entries.en: And David said to Uriah, Tarry here to day also, and to morrow I will let thee depart. So Uriah abode in Jerusalem that day, and the morrow.

entries.yo: Dafidi si pè e, o si jẹ, o si mu niwaju rẹ̀; o si mu ki ọti ki o pa a: on si jade li alẹ lọ si ibusùn rẹ̀ lọdọ awọn iranṣẹ oluwa rẹ̀, kò si sọkalẹ lọ si ile rẹ̀.
entries.en: And when David had called him, he did eat and drink before him; and he made him drunk: and at even he went out to lie on his bed with the servants of his lord, but went not down to his house.

entries.yo: O si ṣe li owurọ Dafidi si kọwe si Joabu, o fi rán Uria.
entries.en: And it came to pass in the morning, that David wrote a letter to Joab, and sent it by the hand of Uriah.

entries.yo: O si kọ sinu iwe pe, Fi Uria siwaju ibi tí ogun gbe le, ki ẹ si bó o silẹ, ki nwọn le kọ lù u, ki o si kú.
entries.en: And he wrote in the letter, saying, Set ye Uriah in the forefront of the hottest battle, and retire ye from him, that he may be smitten, and die.

entries.yo: O si ṣe nigbati Joabu ṣe akiyesi ilu na, o si yàn Uria si ibi kan ni ibi ti on mọ̀ pe awọn alagbara ọkunrin mbẹ nibẹ.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when Joab observed the city, that he assigned Uriah unto a place where he knew that valiant men were.

entries.yo: Awọn ọkunrin ilu na si jade wá, nwọn si ba Joabu jà: diẹ si ṣubu ninu awọn enia na ninu awọn iranṣẹ Dafidi; Uria ará Hitti si kú pẹlu.
entries.en: And the men of the city went out, and fought with Joab: and there fell some of the people of the servants of David; and Uriah the Hittite died also.

entries.yo: Joabu si ranṣẹ o si rò gbogbo nkan ogun na fun Dafidi.
entries.en: Then Joab sent and told David all the things concerning the war;

entries.yo: O si paṣẹ fun iranṣẹ na pe, Nigbati iwọ ba si pari ati ma rò gbogbo nkan ogun na fun ọba,
entries.en: And charged the messenger, saying, When thou hast made an end of telling the matters of the war unto the king,

entries.yo: Bi o ba ṣe pe, ibinu ọba ba fàru, ti on si wi fun ọ pe, Ẽṣe ti ẹnyin fi sunmọ ilu na lati ba wọn jà, ẹnyin kò mọ̀ pe nwọn o tafà lati ori odi wá?
entries.en: And if so be that the king's wrath arise, and he say unto thee, Wherefore approached ye so nigh unto the city when ye did fight? knew ye not that they would shoot from the wall?

entries.yo: Tali o pa Abimeleki ọmọ Jerubbeṣeti? Ki iṣe obinrin li o yi okuta ọlọ lù u lati ori odi wá, ti o si kú ni Tebeṣi? ẽha ti ri ti ẹnyin fi sunmọ odi na? Iwọ o si wi fun u pe, Uria iranṣẹ rẹ ará Hitti kú pẹlu.
entries.en: Who smote Abimelech the son of Jerubbesheth? did not a woman cast a piece of a millstone upon him from the wall, that he died in Thebez? why went ye nigh the wall? then say thou, Thy servant Uriah the Hittite is dead also.

entries.yo: Iranṣẹ na si lọ, o si wá, o si jẹ gbogbo iṣẹ ti Joabu ran a fun Dafidi.
entries.en: So the messenger went, and came and shewed David all that Joab had sent him for.

entries.yo: Iranṣẹ na si wi fun Dafidi pe, Nitõtọ awọn ọkunrin na lagbara jù wa lọ, nwọn si jade tọ̀ wa wá ni pápa, awa si tẹle wọn titi nwọn fi de ẹhìn odi.
entries.en: And the messenger said unto David, Surely the men prevailed against us, and came out unto us into the field, and we were upon them even unto the entering of the gate.

entries.yo: Awọn tafàtafa si ta si iranṣẹ rẹ lati ori odi wá, diẹ ninu awọn iranṣẹ ọba si kú, iranṣẹ rẹ Uria ará Hitti si kú pẹlu.
entries.en: And the shooters shot from off the wall upon thy servants; and some of the king's servants be dead, and thy servant Uriah the Hittite is dead also.

entries.yo: Dafidi si wi fun iranṣẹ na pe, Bayi ni iwọ o wi fun Joabu pe, Máṣe jẹ ki nkan yi ki o buru li oju rẹ, nitoripe idà a ma jẹ li ọtun li òsi, mu ijà rẹ le si ilu na, ki o si bì i ṣubu: ki iwọ ki o si mu u lọkàn le.
entries.en: Then David said unto the messenger, Thus shalt thou say unto Joab, Let not this thing displease thee, for the sword devoureth one as well as another: make thy battle more strong against the city, and overthrow it: and encourage thou him.

entries.yo: Nigbati aya Uria si gbọ́ pe Uria ọkọ rẹ̀ kú, o si gbawẹ̀ nitori ọkọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And when the wife of Uriah heard that Uriah her husband was dead, she mourned for her husband.

entries.yo: Nigbati awẹ̀ na si kọja tan, Dafidi si ranṣẹ, o si mu u wá si ile rẹ̀, on si wa di aya rẹ̀, o si bi ọmọkunrin kan fun u. Ṣugbọn nkan na ti Dafidi ṣe buru niwaju Oluwa.
entries.en: And when the mourning was past, David sent and fetched her to his house, and she became his wife, and bare him a son. But the thing that David had done displeased the LORD.

entries.yo: OLUWA si ran Natani si Dafidi. On si tọ̀ ọ wá, o si wi fun u pe, Ọkunrin meji mbẹ ni ilu kan; ọkan jẹ ọlọrọ̀, ekeji si jẹ talaka.
entries.en: And the LORD sent Nathan unto David. And he came unto him, and said unto him, There were two men in one city; the one rich, and the other poor.

entries.yo: Ọkunrin ọlọrọ̀ na si ni agutan ati malu li ọ̀pọlọpọ,
entries.en: The rich man had exceeding many flocks and herds:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ọkunrin talaka na kò si ni nkan, bikoṣe agutan kekere kan, eyi ti o ti rà ti o si ntọ́: o si dagba li ọwọ́ rẹ̀ pẹlu awọn ọmọ rẹ̀; a ma jẹ ninu onjẹ rẹ̀, a si ma mu ninu ago rẹ̀, a si ma dubulẹ li aiya rẹ̀, o si dabi ọmọbinrin kan fun u.
entries.en: But the poor man had nothing, save one little ewe lamb, which he had bought and nourished up: and it grew up together with him, and with his children; it did eat of his own meat, and drank of his own cup, and lay in his bosom, and was unto him as a daughter.

entries.yo: Alejo kan si tọ̀ ọkunrin ọlọrọ̀ na wá, on kò si fẹ mu ninu agutàn rẹ̀, ati ninu malu rẹ̀, lati fi ṣe alejo fun ẹni ti o tọ̀ ọ wá: o si mu agutan ọkunrin talaka na fi ṣe alejo fun ọkunrin ti o tọ̀ ọ wá.
entries.en: And there came a traveller unto the rich man, and he spared to take of his own flock and of his own herd, to dress for the wayfaring man that was come unto him; but took the poor man's lamb, and dressed it for the man that was come to him.

entries.yo: Ibinu Dafidi si fàru gidigidi si ọkunrin na; o si wi fun Natani pe, Bi Oluwa ti mbẹ lãye, ọkunrin na ti o ṣe nkan yi, kikú ni yio kú.
entries.en: And David's anger was greatly kindled against the man; and he said to Nathan, As the LORD liveth, the man that hath done this thing shall surely die:

entries.yo: On o si san agutan na pada ni ìlọ́po mẹrin, nitoriti o ṣe nkan yi, ati nitoriti kò ni ãnu.
entries.en: And he shall restore the lamb fourfold, because he did this thing, and because he had no pity.

entries.yo: Natani si wi fun Dafidi pe, Iwọ li ọkunrin na. Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun Israeli wi, Emi fi ọ jọba lori Israeli, emi si gbà ọ lọwọ Saulu;
entries.en: And Nathan said to David, Thou art the man. Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, I anointed thee king over Israel, and I delivered thee out of the hand of Saul;

entries.yo: Emi si fi ile oluwa rẹ fun ọ, ati awọn obinrin oluwa rẹ si aiyà rẹ, emi si fi idile Israeli ati ti Juda fun ọ; iba tilẹ ṣepe eyini kere jù, emi iba si fun ọ ni nkan bayi bayi.
entries.en: And I gave thee thy master's house, and thy master's wives into thy bosom, and gave thee the house of Israel and of Judah; and if that had been too little, I would moreover have given unto thee such and such things.

entries.yo: Eṣe ti iwọ fi kẹgàn ọ̀rọ Oluwa, ti iwọ fi ṣe nkan ti o buru li oju rẹ̀, ani ti iwọ fi fi idà pa Uria ará Hitti, ati ti iwọ fi mu obinrin rẹ̀ lati fi ṣe obinrin rẹ, o si fi idà awọn ọmọ Ammoni pa a.
entries.en: Wherefore hast thou despised the commandment of the LORD, to do evil in his sight? thou hast killed Uriah the Hittite with the sword, and hast taken his wife to be thy wife, and hast slain him with the sword of the children of Ammon.

entries.yo: Njẹ nitorina idà kì yio kuro ni ile rẹ titi lai; nitoripe iwọ gàn mi, iwọ si mu aya Uria ará Hitti lati fi ṣe aya rẹ.
entries.en: Now therefore the sword shall never depart from thine house; because thou hast despised me, and hast taken the wife of Uriah the Hittite to be thy wife.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa wi, Kiye si i, Emi o jẹ ki ibi ki o dide si ọ lati inu ile rẹ wá, emi o si gbà awọn obinrin rẹ loju rẹ, emi o si fi wọn fun aladugbo rẹ, on o si ba awọn obinrin rẹ sùn niwaju õrun yi.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will raise up evil against thee out of thine own house, and I will take thy wives before thine eyes, and give them unto thy neighbour, and he shall lie with thy wives in the sight of this sun.

entries.yo: Ati pe iwọ ṣe e ni ikọ̀kọ: ṣugbọn emi o ṣe nkan yi niwaju gbogbo Israeli, ati niwaju õrun.
entries.en: For thou didst it secretly: but I will do this thing before all Israel, and before the sun.

entries.yo: Dafidi si wi fun Natani pe, Emi ṣẹ̀ si Oluwa. Natani si wi fun Dafidi pe, Oluwa pẹlu si ti mu ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ kuro; iwọ kì yio kú.
entries.en: And David said unto Nathan, I have sinned against the LORD. And Nathan said unto David, The LORD also hath put away thy sin; thou shalt not die.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nitori nipa iwa yi, iwọ fi aye silẹ fun awọn ọta Oluwa lati sọ ọ̀rọ òdi, ọmọ na ti a o bi fun ọ, kiku ni yio ku.
entries.en: Howbeit, because by this deed thou hast given great occasion to the enemies of the LORD to blaspheme, the child also that is born unto thee shall surely die.

entries.yo: Natani si lọ si ile rẹ̀. Oluwa si fi arùn kọlù ọmọ na ti obinrin Uria bi fun Dafidi, o si ṣe aisàn pupọ.
entries.en: And Nathan departed unto his house. And the LORD struck the child that Uriah's wife bare unto David, and it was very sick.

entries.yo: Dafidi si bẹ̀ Ọlọrun nitori ọmọ na, Dafidi si gbàwẹ, o si wọ inu ile lọ, o si dubulẹ lori ilẹ li oru na.
entries.en: David therefore besought God for the child; and David fasted, and went in, and lay all night upon the earth.

entries.yo: Awọn agbà ile rẹ̀ si dide tọ̀ ọ lọ, lati gbe e dide lori ilẹ: o si kọ̀, kò si ba wọn jẹun.
entries.en: And the elders of his house arose, and went to him, to raise him up from the earth: but he would not, neither did he eat bread with them.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, ni ijọ keje, ọmọ na si kú. Awọn iranṣẹ Dafidi si bẹ̀ru lati wi fun u pe, ọmọ na kú: nitori ti nwọn wipe, Kiye si i, nigbati ọmọ na mbẹ lãye, awa sọ̀rọ fun u, on kò si gbọ́ ohùn wa: njẹ yio ti ṣẹ́ ara rẹ̀ ni iṣẹ́ to, bi awa ba wi fun u pe, ọmọ na kú?
entries.en: And it came to pass on the seventh day, that the child died. And the servants of David feared to tell him that the child was dead: for they said, Behold, while the child was yet alive, we spake unto him, and he would not hearken unto our voice: how will he then vex himself, if we tell him that the child is dead?

entries.yo: Nigbati Dafidi si ri pe awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀ nsọ̀rọ kẹlẹkẹlẹ, Dafidi si kiye si i pe ọmọ na kú: Dafidi si bere lọwọ awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀ pe, Ọmọ na kú bi? nwọn si da a li ohùn pe, O kú.
entries.en: But when David saw that his servants whispered, David perceived that the child was dead: therefore David said unto his servants, Is the child dead? And they said, He is dead.

entries.yo: Dafidi si dide ni ilẹ, o si wẹ̀, o fi ororo pa ara, o si parọ̀ aṣọ rẹ̀, o si wọ inu ile Oluwa lọ, o si wolẹ sìn: o si wá si ile rẹ̀ o si bere, nwọn si gbe onjẹ kalẹ niwaju rẹ̀, o si jẹun.
entries.en: Then David arose from the earth, and washed, and anointed himself, and changed his apparel, and came into the house of the LORD, and worshipped: then he came to his own house; and when he required, they set bread before him, and he did eat.

entries.yo: Awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀ si bi li ere pe, Ki li eyi ti iwọ ṣe yi? nitori ọmọ na nigbati o mbẹ lãye iwọ gbawẹ, o si sọkun; ṣugbọn nigbati ọmọ na kú, o dide o si jẹun.
entries.en: Then said his servants unto him, What thing is this that thou hast done? thou didst fast and weep for the child, while it was alive; but when the child was dead, thou didst rise and eat bread.

entries.yo: O si wipe, nigbati ọmọ na mbẹ lãye, emi gbawẹ, emi si sọkun: nitoriti emi wipe, Tali o mọ̀ bi Ọlọrun o ṣãnu mi, ki ọmọ na ki o le yè.
entries.en: And he said, While the child was yet alive, I fasted and wept: for I said, Who can tell whether GOD will be gracious to me, that the child may live?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nisisiyi o ti kú, nitori kili emi o ṣe ma gbawẹ? emi le mu u pada wá mọ bi? emi ni yio tọ̀ ọ lọ, on ki yio si tun tọ̀ mi wá.
entries.en: But now he is dead, wherefore should I fast? can I bring him back again? I shall go to him, but he shall not return to me.

entries.yo: Dafidi si ṣipẹ fun Batṣeba aya rẹ̀, o si wọle tọ̀ ọ, o si ba a dapọ̀: on si bi ọmọkunrin kan, Dafidi si sọ orukọ rẹ̀ ni Solomoni: Oluwa si fẹ ẹ.
entries.en: And David comforted Bath-sheba his wife, and went in unto her, and lay with her: and she bare a son, and he called his name Solomon: and the LORD loved him.

entries.yo: O si rán Natani woli, o si pe orukọ rẹ̀ ni Jedidiah nitori ti Oluwa.
entries.en: And he sent by the hand of Nathan the prophet; and he called his name Jedidiah, because of the LORD.

entries.yo: Joabu si ba Rabba ti awọn ọmọ Ammoni jagun, o si gbà ilu ọba wọn.
entries.en: And Joab fought against Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and took the royal city.

entries.yo: Joabu si ran awọn iranṣẹ si Dafidi, o si wipe, emi ti ba Rabba jà, emi si ti gbà ilu olomi wọnni.
entries.en: And Joab sent messengers to David, and said, I have fought against Rabbah, and have taken the city of waters.

entries.yo: Njẹ nitorina kó awọn enia iyokù jọ, ki o si do ti ilu na, ki o si gbà a, ki emi ki o má ba gbà ilu na, ki a ma ba pè e li orukọ mi.
entries.en: Now therefore gather the rest of the people together, and encamp against the city, and take it: lest I take the city, and it be called after my name.

entries.yo: Dafidi si kó gbogbo enia na jọ, o si lọ si Rabba, o si ba a jà, o si gbà a.
entries.en: And David gathered all the people together, and went to Rabbah, and fought against it, and took it.

entries.yo: On si gba adé ọba wọn kuro li ori rẹ̀, wuwo rẹ̀ si jẹ talenti wura kan, o si ni okuta oniyebiye lara rẹ̀: a si fi i de Dafidi li ori. On si kó ikogun ilu na li ọ̀pọlọpọ.
entries.en: And he took their king's crown from off his head, the weight whereof was a talent of gold with the precious stones: and it was set on David's head. And he brought forth the spoil of the city in great abundance.

entries.yo: On si kó awọn enia na ti o wà ninu rẹ̀, o si fi wọn si iṣẹ ayùn, ati si iṣẹ nkan iwọlẹ ti a fi irin ṣe, ati si iṣẹ ãke irin, o si fi wọn si iṣẹ biriki mímọ: bẹ̃na li on si ṣe si gbogbo ilu awọn ọmọ Ammoni. Dafidi ati gbogbo awọn enia na si pada si Jerusalemu.
entries.en: And he brought forth the people that were therein, and put them under saws, and under harrows of iron, and under axes of iron, and made them pass through the brickkiln: and thus did he unto all the cities of the children of Ammon. So David and all the people returned unto Jerusalem.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, lẹhin eyi, Absalomu ọmọ Dafidi ni aburo obinrin kan ti o ṣe arẹwà, orukọ rẹ̀ a si ma jẹ́ Tamari; Amnoni ọmọ Dafidi si fẹràn rẹ̀.
entries.en: And it came to pass after this, that Absalom the son of David had a fair sister, whose name was Tamar; and Amnon the son of David loved her.

entries.yo: Amnoni si banujẹ titi o fi ṣe aisan nitori Tamari aburo rẹ̀ obinrin; nitoripe wundia ni; o si ṣe ohun ti o ṣoro li oju Amnoni lati ba a ṣe nkan kan.
entries.en: And Amnon was so vexed, that he fell sick for his sister Tamar; for she was a virgin; and Amnon thought it hard for him to do any thing to her.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Amnoni ni ọrẹ́ kan, orukọ rẹ̀ a si ma jẹ Jonadabu, ọmọ Ṣimea ẹgbọ́n Dafidi: Jonadabu si jẹ alarekereke enia gidigidi.
entries.en: But Amnon had a friend, whose name was Jonadab, the son of Shimeah David's brother: and Jonadab was a very subtil man.

entries.yo: O si wi fun u pe, ẽṣe ti iwọ ọmọ ọba nfi nrù lojojumọ bayi? o kì yio ha sọ fun mi? Amnoni si wi fun u pe, emi fẹ Tamari aburo Absalomu arakunrin mi.
entries.en: And he said unto him, Why art thou, being the king's son, lean from day to day? wilt thou not tell me? And Amnon said unto him, I love Tamar, my brother Absalom's sister.

entries.yo: Jonadabu si wi fun u pe, dubulẹ ni ibusùn rẹ ki iwọ ki o si ṣe bi ẹnipe ara rẹ kò yá: baba rẹ yio si wá iwò ọ, iwọ o si wi fun u pe, Jọ̀wọ jẹ ki Tamari aburo mi ki o wá ki o si fun mi li onjẹ ki o si se onjẹ na niwaju mi ki emi ki o ri i, emi o si jẹ ẹ li ọwọ́ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Jonadab said unto him, Lay thee down on thy bed, and make thyself sick: and when thy father cometh to see thee, say unto him, I pray thee, let my sister Tamar come, and give me meat, and dress the meat in my sight, that I may see it, and eat it at her hand.

entries.yo: Amnoni si dubulẹ, o si ṣe bi ẹnipe on ṣaisan: ọba si wá iwò o, Amnoni si wi fun ọba pe, Jọwọ, jẹ ki Tamari aburo mi ki o wá, ki o si din akarà meji li oju mi, emi o si jẹ li ọwọ́ rẹ̀.
entries.en: So Amnon lay down, and made himself sick: and when the king was come to see him, Amnon said unto the king, I pray thee, let Tamar my sister come, and make me a couple of cakes in my sight, that I may eat at her hand.

entries.yo: Dafidi si ranṣẹ si Tamari ni ile pe, Lọ si ile Amnoni ẹgbọ́n rẹ, ki o si ṣe ti onjẹ fun u.
entries.en: Then David sent home to Tamar, saying, Go now to thy brother Amnon's house, and dress him meat.

entries.yo: Tamari si lọ si ile Amnoni ẹgbọ́n rẹ̀, on si mbẹ ni ibulẹ. Tamari si mu iyẹfun, o si pò o, o si fi ṣe akara li oju rẹ̀, o si din akara na.
entries.en: So Tamar went to her brother Amnon's house; and he was laid down. And she took flour, and kneaded it, and made cakes in his sight, and did bake the cakes.

entries.yo: On si mu awo na, o si dà a sinu awo miran niwaju rẹ̀; ṣugbọn o kọ̀ lati jẹ. Amnoni si wipe, jẹ ki gbogbo ọkunrin jade kuro lọdọ mi. Nwọn si jade olukuluku ọkunrin kuro lọdọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And she took a pan, and poured them out before him; but he refused to eat. And Amnon said, Have out all men from me. And they went out every man from him.

entries.yo: Amnoni si wi fun Tamari pe, mu onjẹ na wá si yara, emi o si jẹ lọwọ rẹ. Tamari si mu akara ti o ṣe, o si mu u tọ̀ Amnoni ẹgbọ́n rẹ̀ ni iyẹwu.
entries.en: And Amnon said unto Tamar, Bring the meat into the chamber, that I may eat of thine hand. And Tamar took the cakes which she had made, and brought them into the chamber to Amnon her brother.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si sunmọ ọ lati fi onjẹ fun u, on si di i mu, o si wi fun u pe, wá dubulẹ tì mi, aburo mi.
entries.en: And when she had brought them unto him to eat, he took hold of her, and said unto her, Come lie with me, my sister.

entries.yo: On si da a lohùn wipe, Bẹ̃kọ ẹgbọ́n mi, máṣe tẹ́ mi; nitoripe ko tọ́ ki a ṣe iru nkan bẹ̃ ni Israeli, iwọ máṣe huwa were yi.
entries.en: And she answered him, Nay, my brother, do not force me; for no such thing ought to be done in Israel: do not thou this folly.

entries.yo: Ati emi, nibo li emi o gbe itiju mi wọ̀? iwọ o si dabi ọkan ninu awọn aṣiwere ni Israeli. Njẹ nitorina, emi bẹ̀ ọ, sọ fun ọba; nitoripe on kì yio kọ̀ lati fi mi fun ọ.
entries.en: And I, whither shall I cause my shame to go? and as for thee, thou shalt be as one of the fools in Israel. Now therefore, I pray thee, speak unto the king; for he will not withhold me from thee.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn o kọ̀ lati gbọ́ ohùn rẹ̀; o si fi agbara mu u, o si ṣẹgun rẹ̀, o si ba a dapọ̀.
entries.en: Howbeit he would not hearken unto her voice: but, being stronger than she, forced her, and lay with her.

entries.yo: Amnoni si korira rẹ̀ gidigidi, irira na si wá jù ifẹ ti on ti ni si i ri lọ. Amnoni si wi fun u pe, Dide, ki o si ma lọ.
entries.en: Then Amnon hated her exceedingly; so that the hatred wherewith he hated her was greater than the love wherewith he had loved her. And Amnon said unto her, Arise, be gone.

entries.yo: On si wi fun u pe, Ko ha ni idi bi; lilé ti iwọ nlé mi yi buru jù eyi ti iwọ ti ṣe si mi lọ. Ṣugbọn on ko fẹ gbọ́ tirẹ̀.
entries.en: And she said unto him, There is no cause: this evil in sending me away is greater than the other that thou didst unto me. But he would not hearken unto her.

entries.yo: On si pe ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ̀ ti iṣe iranṣẹ rẹ̀, o si wi fun u pe, Jọwọ, tì obinrin yi sode fun mi, ki o si ti ilẹkùn mọ ọ.
entries.en: Then he called his servant that ministered unto him, and said, Put now this woman out from me, and bolt the door after her.

entries.yo: On si ni aṣọ alaràbara kan li ara rẹ̀: nitori iru aṣọ awọ̀leke bẹ̃ li awọn ọmọbinrin ọba ti iṣe wundia ima wọ̀. Iranṣẹ rẹ̀ si mu u jade, o si ti ilẹkun mọ ọ.
entries.en: And she had a garment of divers colours upon her: for with such robes were the king's daughters that were virgins apparelled. Then his servant brought her out, and bolted the door after her.

entries.yo: Tamari si bu ẽru si ori rẹ̀, o si fa aṣọ alaràbara ti mbẹ lara rẹ̀ ya, o si ka ọwọ́ rẹ̀ le ori, o si nkigbe bi o ti nlọ.
entries.en: And Tamar put ashes on her head, and rent her garment of divers colours that was on her, and laid her hand on her head, and went on crying.

entries.yo: Absalomu ẹgbọ́n rẹ̀ si bi i lere pe, Amnoni ẹgbọ́n rẹ ba ọ ṣe bi? njẹ aburo mi, dakẹ; ẹgbọ́n rẹ ni iṣe; má fi nkan yi si ọkàn rẹ. Tamari si joko ni ibanujẹ ni ile Absalomu ẹgbọ́n rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Absalom her brother said unto her, Hath Amnon thy brother been with thee? but hold now thy peace, my sister: he is thy brother; regard not this thing. So Tamar remained desolate in her brother Absalom's house.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati Dafidi ọba gbọ́ gbogbo nkan wọnyi, inu rẹ̀ bajẹ gidigidi.
entries.en: But when king David heard of all these things, he was very wroth.

entries.yo: Absalomu ko si ba Amnoni sọ nkan, rere, tabi buburu: nitoripe Absalomu korira Amnoni nitori eyi ti o ṣe, ani ti o fi agbara mu Tamari aburo rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Absalom spake unto his brother Amnon neither good nor bad: for Absalom hated Amnon, because he had forced his sister Tamar.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, lẹhin ọdun meji, Absalomu si ni olurẹrun agutan ni Baal-hasori, eyiti o gbè Efraimu: Absalomu si pe gbogbo awọn ọmọ ọba.
entries.en: And it came to pass after two full years, that Absalom had sheepshearers in Baal-hazor, which is beside Ephraim: and Absalom invited all the king's sons.

entries.yo: Absalomu si tọ̀ ọba wá, o si wipe, Wõ, jọwọ, iranṣẹ rẹ ni olurẹrun agutan, emi bẹ̀ ọ, jẹ ki ọba, ati awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀ ba iranṣẹ rẹ lọ.
entries.en: And Absalom came to the king, and said, Behold now, thy servant hath sheepshearers; let the king, I beseech thee, and his servants go with thy servant.

entries.yo: Ọba si wi fun Absalomu pe, Bẹ̃kọ, ọmọ mi, mo bẹ̀ ọ, má jẹ ki gbogbo wa lọ, ki a má mu ọ nawo pupọ. O si rọ̀ ọ gidigidi, ṣugbọn on kò fẹ lọ, o si sure fun u.
entries.en: And the king said to Absalom, Nay, my son, let us not all now go, lest we be chargeable unto thee. And he pressed him: howbeit he would not go, but blessed him.

entries.yo: Absalomu si wi pe, Bi kò ba le ri bẹ̃, emi bẹ̀ ọ, jẹ ki Amnoni ẹgbọ́n mi ba wa lọ. Ọba si wipe, Idi rẹ̀ ti yio fi ba ọ lọ?
entries.en: Then said Absalom, If not, I pray thee, let my brother Amnon go with us. And the king said unto him, Why should he go with thee?

entries.yo: Absalomu si rọ̀ ọ, on si jẹ ki Amnoni ati gbogbo awọn ọmọ ọba ba a lọ.
entries.en: But Absalom pressed him, that he let Amnon and all the king's sons go with him.

entries.yo: Absalomu si fi aṣẹ fun awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀ pe, Ki ẹnyin ki o ma kiyesi akoko ti ọti-waini yio mu ọkàn Amnoni dùn, emi o si wi fun nyin pe, Kọlu Amnoni; ki ẹ si pa a: ẹ má bẹ̀ru: ṣe emi li o fi aṣẹ fun nyin? ẹ ṣe giri, ki ẹ ṣe bi alagbara ọmọ.
entries.en: Now Absalom had commanded his servants, saying, Mark ye now when Amnon's heart is merry with wine, and when I say unto you, Smite Amnon; then kill him, fear not: have not I commanded you? be courageous and be valiant.

entries.yo: Awọn iranṣẹ Absalomu si ṣe si Amnoni gẹgẹ bi Absalomu ti paṣẹ. Gbogbo awọn ọmọ ọba si dide, olukuluku gun ibaka rẹ̀, nwọn si sa.
entries.en: And the servants of Absalom did unto Amnon as Absalom had commanded. Then all the king's sons arose, and every man gat him up upon his mule, and fled.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati nwọn mbẹ li ọ̀na, ihìn si de ọdọ Dafidi pe, Absalomu pa gbogbo awọn ọmọ ọba, ọkan kò si kù ninu wọn.
entries.en: And it came to pass, while they were in the way, that tidings came to David, saying, Absalom hath slain all the king's sons, and there is not one of them left.

entries.yo: Ọba si dide, o si fa aṣọ rẹ̀ ya, o si dubulẹ ni ilẹ; gbogbo awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀ ti nwọn duro tì i si fa aṣọ wọn ya.
entries.en: Then the king arose, and tare his garments, and lay on the earth; and all his servants stood by with their clothes rent.

entries.yo: Jonadabu ọmọ Ṣimea arakonrin Dafidi si dahùn o si wipe, Ki oluwa mi ọba ki o máṣe rò pe nwọn ti pa gbogbo awọn ọdọmọde-kọnrin awọn ọmọ ọba; nitoripe Amnoni nikanṣoṣo li o kú: nitori lati ẹnu Absalomu wá li a ti pinnu rẹ̀ lati ọjọ ti o ti fi agbara mu Tamari aburo rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Jonadab, the son of Shimeah David's brother, answered and said, Let not my lord suppose that they have slain all the young men the king's sons; for Amnon only is dead: for by the appointment of Absalom this hath been determined from the day that he forced his sister Tamar.

entries.yo: Njẹ ki oluwa mi ọba ki o máṣe fi nkan yi si ọkàn pe, gbogbo awọn ọmọ ọba li o kú: nitori Amnoni nikanṣoṣo li o kú.
entries.en: Now therefore let not my lord the king take the thing to his heart, to think that all the king's sons are dead: for Amnon only is dead.

entries.yo: Absalomu si sa. Ọdọmọkunrin na ti nṣọ̀na si gbe oju rẹ̀ soke, o si ri pe, ọ̀pọ enia mbọ̀ li ọ̀na lẹhin rẹ̀ lati iha oko wá.
entries.en: But Absalom fled. And the young man that kept the watch lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, there came much people by the way of the hill side behind him.

entries.yo: Jonadabu si wi fun ọba pe, Wõ, awọn ọmọ ọba mbọ̀: gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ iranṣẹ rẹ, bẹ̃ li o ri.
entries.en: And Jonadab said unto the king, Behold, the king's sons come: as thy servant said, so it is.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati o ti pari ọ̀rọ isọ, si wõ, awọn ọmọ ọba de, nwọn si gbe ohùn wọn soke, nwọn si sọkun: ọba ati gbogbo awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀ pẹlu si sọkun nlanla.
entries.en: And it came to pass, as soon as he had made an end of speaking, that, behold, the king's sons came, and lifted up their voice and wept: and the king also and all his servants wept very sore.

entries.yo: Absalomu si sa, o si tọ̀ Talmai lọ, ọmọ Ammihudu, ọba Geṣuri. Dafidi si nkãnu nitori ọmọ rẹ̀ lojojumọ.
entries.en: But Absalom fled, and went to Talmai, the son of Ammihud, king of Geshur. And David mourned for his son every day.

entries.yo: Absalomu si sa, o si lọ si Geṣuri, o si gbe ibẹ li ọdun mẹta.
entries.en: So Absalom fled, and went to Geshur, and was there three years.

entries.yo: Ọkàn Dafidi ọba si fà gidigidi si Absalomu: nitoriti o ti gbà ipẹ̀ niti Amnoni: o sa ti kú.
entries.en: And the soul of king David longed to go forth unto Absalom: for he was comforted concerning Amnon, seeing he was dead.

entries.yo: JOABU ọmọ Seruia si kiyesi i pe, ọkàn ọba si fà si Absalomu.
entries.en: Now Joab the son of Zeruiah perceived that the king's heart was toward Absalom.

entries.yo: Joabu si ranṣẹ si Tekoa, o si mu ọlọgbọn obinrin kan lati ibẹ̀ wá, o si wi fun u pe, Emi bẹ̀ ọ, ṣe bi ẹniti nṣọfọ, ki o si fi aṣọ ọfọ sara, ki o má si ṣe fi ororo pa ara, ki o si dabi obinrin ti o ti nṣọ̀fọ fun okú li ọjọ pupọ̀.
entries.en: And Joab sent to Tekoah, and fetched thence a wise woman, and said unto her, I pray thee, feign thyself to be a mourner, and put on now mourning apparel, and anoint not thyself with oil, but be as a woman that had a long time mourned for the dead:

entries.yo: Ki o si tọ̀ ọba wá, ki o si sọ fun u gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ yi. Joabu si fi ọ̀rọ si i li ẹnu.
entries.en: And come to the king, and speak on this manner unto him. So Joab put the words in her mouth.

entries.yo: Nigbati obinrin ará Tekoa na si nfẹ sọ̀rọ fun ọba, o wolẹ, o dojubolẹ, o si bu ọla fun u, o si wipe, Ọba, gbà mi.
entries.en: And when the woman of Tekoah spake to the king, she fell on her face to the ground, and did obeisance, and said, Help, O king.

entries.yo: Ọba si bi i lere pe, Ki li o ṣe ọ? on si dahùn wipe, Nitõtọ, opó li emi iṣe, ọkọ mi si kú.
entries.en: And the king said unto her, What aileth thee? And she answered, I am indeed a widow woman, and mine husband is dead.

entries.yo: Iranṣẹbinrin rẹ si ti li ọmọkunrin meji, awọn mejeji si jọ jà li oko, kò si si ẹniti yio là wọn, ekini si lu ekeji, o si pa a.
entries.en: And thy handmaid had two sons, and they two strove together in the field, and there was none to part them, but the one smote the other, and slew him.

entries.yo: Si wõ, gbogbo idile dide si iranṣẹbinrin rẹ, nwọn si wipe, Fi ẹni ti o pa ẹnikeji rẹ̀ fun wa, awa o si pa a ni ipo ẹmi ẹnikeji rẹ̀ ti o pa, awa o si pa arole na run pẹlu: nwọn o si pa iná mi ti o kù, nwọn kì yio si fi orukọ tabi ẹni ti o kù silẹ fun ọkọ mi li aiye.
entries.en: And, behold, the whole family is risen against thine handmaid, and they said, Deliver him that smote his brother, that we may kill him, for the life of his brother whom he slew; and we will destroy the heir also: and so they shall quench my coal which is left, and shall not leave to my husband neither name nor remainder upon the earth.

entries.yo: Ọba si wi fun obinrin na pe, Lọ si ile rẹ. emi o si kilọ nitori rẹ.
entries.en: And the king said unto the woman, Go to thine house, and I will give charge concerning thee.

entries.yo: Obinrin ara Tekoa na si wi fun ọba pe, Oluwa mi, ọba, jẹ ki ẹ̀ṣẹ na ki o wà lori mi, ati lori idile baba mi; ki ọba ati itẹ rẹ̀ ki o jẹ́ alailẹbi.
entries.en: And the woman of Tekoah said unto the king, My lord, O king, the iniquity be on me, and on my father's house: and the king and his throne be guiltless.

entries.yo: Ọba si wipe, Ẹnikẹni ti o ba sọ̀rọ si ọ, mu oluwa rẹ̀ tọ̀ mi wá, on kì yio si tọ́ ọ mọ.
entries.en: And the king said, Whosoever saith ought unto thee, bring him to me, and he shall not touch thee any more.

entries.yo: O si wipe, Emi bẹ̀ ọ, jẹ ki ọba ki o ranti Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ̀, ki olugbẹsan ẹjẹ ki o máṣe ni ipa lati ṣe iparun, ki nwọn ki o má bà pa ọmọ mi; on si wipe, Bi Oluwa ti mbẹ lãye, ọkan ninu irun ori ọmọ rẹ ki yio bọ́ silẹ,
entries.en: Then said she, I pray thee, let the king remember the LORD thy God, that thou wouldest not suffer the revengers of blood to destroy any more, lest they destroy my son. And he said, As the LORD liveth, there shall not one hair of thy son fall to the earth.

entries.yo: Obinrin na si wipe, Emi bẹ̀ ọ, jẹ ki iranṣẹbinrin rẹ ki o sọ̀rọ kan fun oluwa mi ọba; on si wipe, Ma wi.
entries.en: Then the woman said, Let thine handmaid, I pray thee, speak one word unto my lord the king. And he said, Say on.

entries.yo: Obinrin na si wipe, Nitori kini iwọ si ṣe ro iru nkan yi si awọn enia Ọlọrun? nitoripe ọba si sọ nkan yi bi ẹniti o jẹbi, nitipe ọba kò mu isánsa rẹ̀ bọ̀ wá ile.
entries.en: And the woman said, Wherefore then hast thou thought such a thing against the people of God? for the king doth speak this thing as one which is faulty, in that the king doth not fetch home again his banished.

entries.yo: Nitoripe awa o sa kú, a o si dabi omi ti a tú silẹ ti a kò si le ṣajọ mọ; nitori bi Ọlọrun kò ti gbà ẹmi rẹ̀, o si ti ṣe ọna ki a má bà lé isánsa rẹ̀ kuro lọdọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: For we must needs die, and are as water spilt on the ground, which cannot be gathered up again; neither doth God respect any person: yet doth he devise means, that his banished be not expelled from him.

entries.yo: Njẹ nitorina li emi si ṣe wá isọ nkan yi fun oluwa mi ọba, bi o jẹpe awọn enia ti dẹrubà mi; iranṣẹbinrin rẹ si wi pe, Njẹ emi o sọ fun ọba; o le ri bẹ̃ pe ọba yio ṣe ifẹ iranṣẹbinrin rẹ̀ fun u.
entries.en: Now therefore that I am come to speak of this thing unto my lord the king, it is because the people have made me afraid: and thy handmaid said, I will now speak unto the king; it may be that the king will perform the request of his handmaid.

entries.yo: Nitoripe ọba o gbọ́, lati gbà iranṣẹbinrin rẹ̀ silẹ lọwọ ọkunrin na ti o nfẹ ke emi ati ọmọ mi pẹlu kuro ninu ilẹ ini Ọlọrun.
entries.en: For the king will hear, to deliver his handmaid out of the hand of the man that would destroy me and my son together out of the inheritance of God.

entries.yo: Iranṣẹbinrin rẹ si wipe, Njẹ ọ̀rọ ọba oluwa mi yio si jasi itùnu: nitori bi angeli Ọlọrun bẹ̃ ni oluwa mi ọba lati mọ̀ rere ati buburu: Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ yio si wà pẹlu rẹ.
entries.en: Then thine handmaid said, The word of my lord the king shall now be comfortable: for as an angel of God, so is my lord the king to discern good and bad: therefore the LORD thy God will be with thee.

entries.yo: Ọba si dahùn, o si wi fun obinrin na pe, Máṣe fi nkan ti emi o bere lọwọ rẹ pamọ fun mi, emi bẹ̀ ọ. Obinrin na si wipe, Jẹ ki oluwa mi ọba ki o mã wi.
entries.en: Then the king answered and said unto the woman, Hide not from me, I pray thee, the thing that I shall ask thee. And the woman said, Let my lord the king now speak.

entries.yo: Ọba si wipe, Ọwọ́ Joabu kò ha wà pẹlu rẹ ninu gbogbo eyi? obinrin na si dahun o si wipe, Bi ẹmi rẹ ti mbẹ lãye, oluwa mi ọba, kò si iyipada si ọwọ́ ọtun, tabi si ọwọ́ osi ninu gbogbo eyi ti oluwa mi ọba ti wi: nitoripe Joabu iranṣẹ rẹ, on li o rán mi, on li o si fi gbogbo ọ̀rọ wọnyi si iranṣẹbinrin rẹ li ẹnu.
entries.en: And the king said, Is not the hand of Joab with thee in all this? And the woman answered and said, As thy soul liveth, my lord the king, none can turn to the right hand or to the left from ought that my lord the king hath spoken: for thy servant Joab, he bade me, and he put all these words in the mouth of thine handmaid:

entries.yo: Lati mu iru ọ̀rọ wọnyi wá ni Joabu iranṣẹ rẹ si ṣe nkan yi: oluwa mi si gbọ́n, gẹgẹ bi ọgbọ́n angeli Ọlọrun, lati mọ̀ gbogbo nkan ti mbẹ li aiye.
entries.en: To fetch about this form of speech hath thy servant Joab done this thing: and my lord is wise, according to the wisdom of an angel of God, to know all things that are in the earth.

entries.yo: Ọba si wi fun Joabu pe, Wõ, emi o ṣe nkan yi: nitorina lọ, ki o si mu ọmọdekunrin na Absalomu pada wá.
entries.en: And the king said unto Joab, Behold now, I have done this thing: go therefore, bring the young man Absalom again.

entries.yo: Joabu si wolẹ o doju rẹ̀ bolẹ, o si tẹriba fun u, o si sure fun ọba: Joabu si wipe, Loni ni iranṣẹ rẹ mọ̀ pe, emi ri ore-ọfẹ gbà li oju rẹ, oluwa mi, ọba, nitoripe ọba ṣe ifẹ iranṣẹ rẹ.
entries.en: And Joab fell to the ground on his face, and bowed himself, and thanked the king: and Joab said, To day thy servant knoweth that I have found grace in thy sight, my lord, O king, in that the king hath fulfilled the request of his servant.

entries.yo: Joabu si dide, o si lọ si Geṣuri, o si mu Absalomu wá si Jerusalemu.
entries.en: So Joab arose and went to Geshur, and brought Absalom to Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Ọba si wipe, Jẹ ki o yipada lọ si ile rẹ̀, má si ṣe jẹ ki o ri oju mi. Absalomu si yipada si ile rẹ̀, kò si ri oju ọba.
entries.en: And the king said, Let him turn to his own house, and let him not see my face. So Absalom returned to his own house, and saw not the king's face.

entries.yo: Kò si si arẹwà kan ni gbogbo Israeli ti a ba yìn bi Absalomu: lati atẹlẹsẹ rẹ̀ titi de atari rẹ̀ kò si abùkun kan lara rẹ̀.
entries.en: But in all Israel there was none to be so much praised as Absalom for his beauty: from the sole of his foot even to the crown of his head there was no blemish in him.

entries.yo: Nigbati o ba si rẹ́ irun ori rẹ̀ (nitoripe li ọdọdun li on ima rẹ́ ẹ nitoriti o wuwo fun u, on a si ma rẹ́ ẹ) on si wọ̀n irun ori rẹ̀, o si jasi igba ṣekeli ninu òṣuwọn ọba.
entries.en: And when he polled his head, (for it was at every year's end that he polled it: because the hair was heavy on him, therefore he polled it:) he weighed the hair of his head at two hundred shekels after the king's weight.

entries.yo: A si bi ọmọkunrin mẹta fun Absalomu ati ọmọbinrin kan, orukọ rẹ̀ a si ma jẹ́ Tamari: on si jẹ obinrin ti o li ẹwà loju.
entries.en: And unto Absalom there were born three sons, and one daughter, whose name was Tamar: she was a woman of a fair countenance.

entries.yo: Absalomu si joko li ọdun meji ni Jerusalemu kò si ri oju ọba.
entries.en: So Absalom dwelt two full years in Jerusalem, and saw not the king's face.

entries.yo: Absalomu si ranṣẹ si Joabu, lati rán a si ọba; ṣugbọn on kò fẹ wá sọdọ rẹ̀; o si ranṣẹ lẹ̃keji on kò si fẹ wá.
entries.en: Therefore Absalom sent for Joab, to have sent him to the king; but he would not come to him: and when he sent again the second time, he would not come.

entries.yo: O si wi fun awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀ pe, Wõ, oko Joabu gbè ti emi, o si ni ọkà nibẹ; ẹ lọ ki ẹ si tinabọ̀ ọ. Awọn iranṣẹ Absalomu si tinabọ oko na.
entries.en: Therefore he said unto his servants, See, Joab's field is near mine, and he hath barley there; go and set it on fire. And Absalom's servants set the field on fire.

entries.yo: Joabu si dide, o si tọ Absalomu wá ni ile, o si wi fun u pe, Ẽṣe ti awọn iranṣẹ rẹ fi tinabọ oko mi?
entries.en: Then Joab arose, and came to Absalom unto his house, and said unto him, Wherefore have thy servants set my field on fire?

entries.yo: Absalomu si da Joabu lohùn pe, Wõ, emi ranṣẹ si ọ, wipe, Wá nihinyi, emi o si rán ọ lọ sọdọ ọba, lati wi pe, Kili emi ti Geṣuri wá si? iba sàn fun mi bi o ṣepe emi wà nibẹ̀ sibẹ. Njẹ emi nfẹ ri oju ọba; bi o ba si ṣe pe ẹ̀ṣẹ mbẹ li ara mi, ki o pa mi.
entries.en: And Absalom answered Joab, Behold, I sent unto thee, saying, Come hither, that I may send thee to the king, to say, Wherefore am I come from Geshur? it had been good for me to have been there still: now therefore let me see the king's face; and if there be any iniquity in me, let him kill me.

entries.yo: Joabu si tọ̀ ọba wá, o si rò fun u: o si ranṣẹ pe Absalomu, on si wá sọdọ ọba, o tẹriba fun u, o si doju rẹ̀ bolẹ niwaju ọba; ọba si fi ẹnu ko Absalomu li ẹnu.
entries.en: So Joab came to the king, and told him: and when he had called for Absalom, he came to the king, and bowed himself on his face to the ground before the king: and the king kissed Absalom.

entries.yo: O si ṣe lẹhin eyi, Absalomu si pèse kẹkẹ́ ati ẹṣin fun ara rẹ̀, ati adọta ọmọkunrin ti yio ma sare niwaju rẹ̀.
entries.en: And it came to pass after this, that Absalom prepared him chariots and horses, and fifty men to run before him.

entries.yo: Absalomu si dide ni kutukutu, o si duro li apakan ọ̀na ẹnu ibode: o si ṣe, bi ẹnikan ba ni ẹjọ ti o nfẹ mu tọ̀ ọba wá fun idajọ, a si pè e sọdọ rẹ̀, a si bi i pe, Ara ilu wo ni iwọ? on a si dahùn pe, Iranṣẹ rẹ ti inu ọkan ninu ẹya Israeli wá.
entries.en: And Absalom rose up early, and stood beside the way of the gate: and it was so, that when any man that had a controversy came to the king for judgment, then Absalom called unto him, and said, Of what city art thou? And he said, Thy servant is of one of the tribes of Israel.

entries.yo: Absalomu a si wi fun u pe Wõ, ọ̀ran rẹ sa dara, o si tọ: ṣugbọn ko si ẹnikan ti ọba fi aṣẹ fun lati yẹ ọ̀ran rẹ wò.
entries.en: And Absalom said unto him, See, thy matters are good and right; but there is no man deputed of the king to hear thee.

entries.yo: Absalomu a si wipe, A ba jẹ fi mi ṣe onidajọ ni ilẹ yi! ki olukuluku ẹniti o ni ẹjọ tabi ọ̀ran kan ba le ma tọ̀ mi wa, emi iba si ṣe idajọ otitọ fun u.
entries.en: Absalom said moreover, Oh that I were made judge in the land, that every man which hath any suit or cause might come unto me, and I would do him justice!

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni bi ẹnikan ba si sunmọ ọ lati tẹriba fun u, on a si nawọ́ rẹ̀, a si dì i mu, a si fi ẹnu kò o li ẹnu.
entries.en: And it was so, that when any man came nigh to him to do him obeisance, he put forth his hand, and took him, and kissed him.

entries.yo: Iru iwà bayi ni Absalomu a ma hù si gbogbo Israeli ti o tọ̀ ọba wá nitori idajọ: Absalomu si fa ọkàn awọn enia Israeli sọdọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And on this manner did Absalom to all Israel that came to the king for judgment: so Absalom stole the hearts of the men of Israel.

entries.yo: O si ṣe lẹhin ogoji ọdun, Absalomu si wi fun ọba pe, Emi bẹ̀ ọ, jẹ ki emi ki o lọ, ki emi o si san ileri mi ti emi ti ṣe fun Oluwa, ni Hebroni.
entries.en: And it came to pass after forty years, that Absalom said unto the king, I pray thee, let me go and pay my vow, which I have vowed unto the LORD, in Hebron.

entries.yo: Nitori ti iranṣẹ rẹ ti jẹ'jẹ kan nigbati emi mbẹ ni Geṣuri ni Siria, pe, Bi Oluwa ba mu mi pada wá si Jerusalemu, nitotọ, emi o si sin Oluwa.
entries.en: For thy servant vowed a vow while I abode at Geshur in Syria, saying, If the LORD shall bring me again indeed to Jerusalem, then I will serve the LORD.

entries.yo: Ọba si wi fun u pe, Ma lọ li alafia. O si dide, o si lọ si Hebroni.
entries.en: And the king said unto him, Go in peace. So he arose, and went to Hebron.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Absalomu rán amí sarin gbogbo ẹyà Israeli pe, Nigbati ẹnyin ba gbọ́ iró ipè, ki ẹnyin si wipe, Absalomu jọba ni Hebroni.
entries.en: But Absalom sent spies throughout all the tribes of Israel, saying, As soon as ye hear the sound of the trumpet, then ye shall say, Absalom reigneth in Hebron.

entries.yo: Igba ọkunrin si bá Absalomu ti Jerusalemu jade, ninu awọn ti a ti pè; nwọn si lọ ninu aimọ̀kan wọn, nwọn kò si mọ nkankan.
entries.en: And with Absalom went two hundred men out of Jerusalem, that were called; and they went in their simplicity, and they knew not any thing.

entries.yo: Absalomu si ranṣẹ pè Ahitofeli ara Giloni, igbimọ̀ Dafidi, lati ilu rẹ̀ wá, ani lati Gilo, nigbati o nrú ẹbọ. Idìtẹ̀ na si le; awọn enia si npọ̀ sọdọ Absalomu.
entries.en: And Absalom sent for Ahithophel the Gilonite, David's counseller, from his city, even from Giloh, while he offered sacrifices. And the conspiracy was strong; for the people increased continually with Absalom.

entries.yo: Ẹnikan si wá rò fun Dafidi pe, Ọkàn awọn ọkunrin Israeli ṣi si Absalomu.
entries.en: And there came a messenger to David, saying, The hearts of the men of Israel are after Absalom.

entries.yo: Dafidi si wi fun gbogbo awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀ ti o wà lọdọ rẹ̀ ni Jerusalemu pe, Ẹ dide, ẹ jẹ ki a salọ, nitoripe kò si ẹniti yio gbà wa lọwọ Absalomu: ẹ yara, ki a lọ kuro, ki on má ba yara le wa ba, ki o má si mu ibi ba wa, ki o má si fi oju idà pa ilu run.
entries.en: And David said unto all his servants that were with him at Jerusalem, Arise, and let us flee; for we shall not else escape from Absalom: make speed to depart, lest he overtake us suddenly, and bring evil upon us, and smite the city with the edge of the sword.

entries.yo: Awọn iranṣẹ ọba si wi fun ọba pe, Gẹgẹ bi gbogbo eyi ti oluwa wa ọba nfẹ, wõ, awa iranṣẹ rẹ ti mura.
entries.en: And the king's servants said unto the king, Behold, thy servants are ready to do whatsoever my lord the king shall appoint.

entries.yo: Ọba si jade, gbogbo ile rẹ̀ si tẹle e. Ọba si fi mẹwa ninu awọn obinrin rẹ̀ silẹ lati ma ṣọ ile.
entries.en: And the king went forth, and all his household after him. And the king left ten women, which were concubines, to keep the house.

entries.yo: Ọba si jade, gbogbo enia si tẹle e, nwọn si duro ni ibikan ti o jina.
entries.en: And the king went forth, and all the people after him, and tarried in a place that was far off.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀ si kọja li ọtún li osì rẹ̀, ati gbogbo awọn Kereti, ati gbogbo awọn Peleti, ati gbogbo awọn Giti, ẹgbẹta ọmọkunrin ti ntọ̀ ọ lẹhin lati Gati wá, si kọja niwaju ọba.
entries.en: And all his servants passed on beside him; and all the Cherethites, and all the Pelethites, and all the Gittites, six hundred men which came after him from Gath, passed on before the king.

entries.yo: Ọba si wi fun Ittai, ara Giti nì pe, Ẽṣe ti iwọ fi mba wa lọ pẹlu? pada, ki o si ba ọba joko: nitoripe alejo ni iwọ, iwọ si ti fi ilu rẹ silẹ.
entries.en: Then said the king to Ittai the Gittite, Wherefore goest thou also with us? return to thy place, and abide with the king: for thou art a stranger, and also an exile.

entries.yo: Lana yi ni iwọ de, emi ha si le mu ki iwọ ma ba wa lọ kakiri loni bi? emi nlọ si ibikibi ti mo ba ri: pada, ki o si mu awọn arakunrin rẹ pada, ki ãnu ati otitọ ki o pẹlu rẹ.
entries.en: Whereas thou camest but yesterday, should I this day make thee go up and down with us? seeing I go whither I may, return thou, and take back thy brethren: mercy and truth be with thee.

entries.yo: Ittai si da ọba lohùn, o si wipe, Bi Oluwa ti mbẹ lãye, ati bi oluwa mi ọba ti mbẹ lãye, nitotọ nibikibi ti oluwa mi ọba ba gbe wà, ibakàn ṣe ninu ikú, tabi ninu ìye, nibẹ pẹlu ni iranṣẹ rẹ yio gbe wà.
entries.en: And Ittai answered the king, and said, As the LORD liveth, and as my lord the king liveth, surely in what place my lord the king shall be, whether in death or life, even there also will thy servant be.

entries.yo: Dafidi si wi fun Ittai pe, Lọ ki o si rekọja. Ittai ará Giti nì si rekọja, ati gbogbo awọn ọmọkunrin rẹ̀, ati gbogbo awọn ọmọ kekeke ti o wà lọdọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And David said to Ittai, Go and pass over. And Ittai the Gittite passed over, and all his men, and all the little ones that were with him.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ilu na si fi ohùn rara sọkun, gbogbo enia si rekọja; ọba si rekọja odo Kidroni, gbogbo awọn enia na si rekọja, si ihà ọ̀na iju.
entries.en: And all the country wept with a loud voice, and all the people passed over: the king also himself passed over the brook Kidron, and all the people passed over, toward the way of the wilderness.

entries.yo: Si wõ, Sadoku pẹlu ati gbogbo awọn ọmọ Lefi ti o wà lọdọ rẹ̀ si nru apoti-ẹri Ọlọrun: nwọn si gbe apoti-ẹri Ọlọrun na kalẹ; Abiatari si goke, titi gbogbo awọn enia si fi dẹkun ati ma kọja lati ilu wá.
entries.en: And lo Zadok also, and all the Levites were with him, bearing the ark of the covenant of God: and they set down the ark of God; and Abiathar went up, until all the people had done passing out of the city.

entries.yo: Ọba si wi fun Sadoku pe, Si tun gbe apoti-ẹri Ọlọrun na pada si ilu: bi emi ba ri oju rere gbà lọdọ Oluwa, yio si tun mu mi pada wá, yio si fi apoti-ẹri na hàn mi ati ibugbe rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the king said unto Zadok, Carry back the ark of God into the city: if I shall find favour in the eyes of the LORD, he will bring me again, and shew me both it, and his habitation:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi on ba si wi pe, Emi kò ni inu didùn si ọ; wõ, emi niyi, jẹ ki on ki o ṣe si mi gẹgẹ bi o ti tọ́ li oju rẹ̀.
entries.en: But if he thus say, I have no delight in thee; behold, here am I, let him do to me as seemeth good unto him.

entries.yo: Ọba si wi fun Sadoku alufa pe, Iwọ kọ́ ariran? pada si ilu li alafia, ati awọn ọmọ rẹ mejeji pẹlu rẹ, Ahimaasi ọmọ rẹ, ati Jonatani ọmọ Abiatari.
entries.en: The king said also unto Zadok the priest, Art not thou a seer? return into the city in peace, and your two sons with you, Ahimaaz thy son, and Jonathan the son of Abiathar.

entries.yo: Wõ, emi o duro ni pẹtẹlẹ iju nì, titi ọ̀rọ o fi ti ọdọ rẹ wá lati sọ fun mi.
entries.en: See, I will tarry in the plain of the wilderness, until there come word from you to certify me.

entries.yo: Sadoku ati Abiatari si gbe apoti-ẹri Ọlọrun pada si Jerusalemu: nwọn si gbe ibẹ̀.
entries.en: Zadok therefore and Abiathar carried the ark of God again to Jerusalem: and they tarried there.

entries.yo: Dafidi si ngoke lọ ni oke Igi ororo, o si nsọkun bi on ti ngoke lọ, o si bò ori rẹ̀, o nlọ laini bata li ẹsẹ: gbogbo enia ti o wà lọdọ rẹ̀, olukuluku ọkunrin si bò ori rẹ̀, nwọn si ngoke, nwọn si nsọkun bi nwọn ti ngoke lọ.
entries.en: And David went up by the ascent of mount Olivet, and wept as he went up, and had his head covered, and he went barefoot: and all the people that was with him covered every man his head, and they went up, weeping as they went up.

entries.yo: Ẹnikan si sọ fun Dafidi pe, Ahitofeli wà ninu awọn ọlọ̀tẹ̀ Absalomu. Dafidi si wipe, Oluwa, emi bẹ̀ ọ, sọ ìmọ Ahitofeli di asan.
entries.en: And one told David, saying, Ahithophel is among the conspirators with Absalom. And David said, O LORD, I pray thee, turn the counsel of Ahithophel into foolishness.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, Dafidi de ori oke, nibiti o gbe wolẹ̀ sin Ọlọrun, si wõ, Huṣai ara Arki nì si wá lati pade rẹ̀ ti on ti aṣọ rẹ̀ yiya, ati erupẹ, li ori rẹ̀.
entries.en: And it came to pass, that when David was come to the top of the mount, where he worshipped God, behold, Hushai the Archite came to meet him with his coat rent, and earth upon his head:

entries.yo: Dafidi si wi fun u pe, bi iwọ ba bá mi kọja, iwọ o si jẹ idiwọ fun mi.
entries.en: Unto whom David said, If thou passest on with me, then thou shalt be a burden unto me:

entries.yo: Bi iwọ ba si pada si ilu, ti o si wi fun Absalomu pe, Emi o ṣe iranṣẹ rẹ, ọba, gẹgẹ bi emi ti ṣe iranṣẹ baba rẹ nigba atijọ, bẹ̃li emi o si jẹ iranṣẹ rẹ nisisiyi: ki iwọ ki o si bà ìmọ Ahitofeli jẹ.
entries.en: But if thou return to the city, and say unto Absalom, I will be thy servant, O king; as I have been thy father's servant hitherto, so will I now also be thy servant: then mayest thou for me defeat the counsel of Ahithophel.

entries.yo: Ṣe Sadoku ati Abiatari awọn alufa wà nibẹ pẹlu rẹ? yio si ṣe, ohunkohun ti iwọ ba gbọ́ lati ile ọba wá, iwọ o si sọ fun Sadoku ati Abiatari awọn alufa.
entries.en: And hast thou not there with thee Zadok and Abiathar the priests? therefore it shall be, that what thing soever thou shalt hear out of the king's house, thou shalt tell it to Zadok and Abiathar the priests.

entries.yo: Wõ, nwọn si ni ọmọ wọn mejeji nibẹ pẹlu wọn, Ahimaasi ọmọ Sadoku, ati Jonatani ọmọ Abiatari; lati ọwọ́ wọn li ẹnyin o si rán ohunkohun ti ẹnyin ba gbọ́ si mi.
entries.en: Behold, they have there with them their two sons, Ahimaaz Zadok's son, and Jonathan Abiathar's son; and by them ye shall send unto me every thing that ye can hear.

entries.yo: Huṣai ọrẹ Dafidi si wá si ilu, Absalomu si wá si Jerusalemu.
entries.en: So Hushai David's friend came into the city, and Absalom came into Jerusalem.

entries.yo: NIGBATI Dafidi si fi diẹ kọja ori oke na, si wõ, Siba iranṣẹ Mefiboṣeti si mbọ̀ wá ipade rẹ̀, ti on ti kẹtẹkẹtẹ́ meji ti a ti dì li asá, ati igba iṣu akara li ori wọn, ati ọgọrun ṣiri ajara gbigbẹ, ati ọgọrun eso ẹrùn, ati igò ọti-waini kan.
entries.en: And when David was a little past the top of the hill, behold, Ziba the servant of Mephibosheth met him, with a couple of asses saddled, and upon them two hundred loaves of bread, and an hundred bunches of raisins, and an hundred of summer fruits, and a bottle of wine.

entries.yo: Ọba si wi fun Siba pe, Kini wọnyi? Siba si wipe, Kẹtẹkẹtẹ wọnyi ni fun awọn ara ile ọba lati ma gùn; ati akara yi, ati eso ẹrùn yi ni fun awọn ọdọmọdekunrin lati jẹ; ati ọti-waini yi ni fun awọn alãrẹ ni ijù lati mu.
entries.en: And the king said unto Ziba, What meanest thou by these? And Ziba said, The asses be for the king's household to ride on; and the bread and summer fruit for the young men to eat; and the wine, that such as be faint in the wilderness may drink.

entries.yo: Ọba si wipe, Ọmọ oluwa rẹ da? Siba si wi fun ọba pe, Wõ, o joko ni Jerusalemu; nitoriti o wipe, Loni ni idile Israeli yio mu ijọba baba mi pada fun mi wá.
entries.en: And the king said, And where is thy master's son? And Ziba said unto the king, Behold, he abideth at Jerusalem: for he said, To day shall the house of Israel restore me the kingdom of my father.

entries.yo: Ọba si wi fun Siba pe, Wõ, gbogbo nkan ti iṣe ti Mefiboṣeti jẹ tirẹ. Siba si wipe, Mo tũba, jẹki nri ore-ọfẹ loju rẹ, oluwa mi, Ọba.
entries.en: Then said the king to Ziba, Behold, thine are all that pertained unto Mephibosheth. And Ziba said, I humbly beseech thee that I may find grace in thy sight, my lord, O king.

entries.yo: Dafidi ọba si de Bahurimu, si wõ, ọkunrin kan ti ibẹ̀ jade wá, lati idile Saulu wá, orukọ rẹ̀ a ma jẹ Ṣimei, ọmọ Gera: o si nyan ẹ̃bu bi o ti mbọ̀.
entries.en: And when king David came to Bahurim, behold, thence came out a man of the family of the house of Saul, whose name was Shimei, the son of Gera: he came forth, and cursed still as he came.

entries.yo: O si sọ okuta si Dafidi, ati si gbogbo iranṣẹ Dafidi ọba, ati si gbogbo awọn enia, gbogbo awọn alagbara ọkunrin si wà lọwọ ọtún rẹ̀ ati lọwọ osì rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he cast stones at David, and at all the servants of king David: and all the people and all the mighty men were on his right hand and on his left.

entries.yo: Bayi ni Ṣimei si wi nigbati o nyan ẽbu, Jade, jade, iwọ ọkunrin ẹjẹ, iwọ ọkunrin Beliali.
entries.en: And thus said Shimei when he cursed, Come out, come out, thou bloody man, and thou man of Belial:

entries.yo: Oluwa mu gbogbo ẹjẹ idile Saulu pada wá si ori rẹ, ni ipo ẹniti iwọ jọba; Oluwa ti fi ijọba na le Absalomu ọmọ rẹ lọwọ: si wõ, ìwa buburu rẹ li o mu eyi wá ba ọ, nitoripe ọkunrin ẹjẹ ni iwọ.
entries.en: The LORD hath returned upon thee all the blood of the house of Saul, in whose stead thou hast reigned; and the LORD hath delivered the kingdom into the hand of Absalom thy son: and, behold, thou art taken in thy mischief, because thou art a bloody man.

entries.yo: Abiṣai ọmọ Seruia si wi fun ọba pe, Ẽṣe ti okú ajá yi fi mbu oluwa mi ọba? jẹ ki emi kọja, emi bẹ̀ ọ, ki emi si bẹ́ ẹ li ori.
entries.en: Then said Abishai the son of Zeruiah unto the king, Why should this dead dog curse my lord the king? let me go over, I pray thee, and take off his head.

entries.yo: Ọba si wipe, Kili emi ni fi nyin ṣe, ẹnyin ọmọ Seruia? jẹ ki o ma bu bẹ̃, nitoriti Oluwa ti wi fun u pe: Bu Dafidi. Tani yio si wipe, Nitori kini iwọ fi ṣe bẹ̃?
entries.en: And the king said, What have I to do with you, ye sons of Zeruiah? so let him curse, because the LORD hath said unto him, Curse David. Who shall then say, Wherefore hast thou done so?

entries.yo: Dafidi si wi fun Abiṣai, ati fun gbogbo awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀ pe, Wõ, ọmọ mi ti o ti inu mi wá, nwá ẹmi mi kiri: njẹ melomelo ni ara Benjamini yi yio si ṣe? jọwọ rẹ̀, si jẹ ki o ma yan ẽbu; nitoripe Oluwa li o fi rán an.
entries.en: And David said to Abishai, and to all his servants, Behold, my son, which came forth of my bowels, seeketh my life: how much more now may this Benjamite do it? let him alone, and let him curse; for the LORD hath bidden him.

entries.yo: Bọ́ya Oluwa yio wo ipọnju mi, Oluwa yio si fi ire san a fun mi ni ipo ẽbu rẹ̀ loni.
entries.en: It may be that the LORD will look on mine affliction, and that the LORD will requite me good for his cursing this day.

entries.yo: Dafidi ati awọn ọmọkunrin rẹ̀ si nlọ li ọ̀na, Ṣimei si nrìn li ẹba oke ti o wà li ẹgbẹ rẹ̀, o si nyan ẽbu bi o ti nlọ, o si nsọ ọ li okuta, o si nfún erupẹ.
entries.en: And as David and his men went by the way, Shimei went along on the hill's side over against him, and cursed as he went, and threw stones at him, and cast dust.

entries.yo: Ọba, ati gbogbo awọn enia ti o mbẹ lọdọ rẹ̀ si wá ti awọn ti ãrẹ̀, nwọn si simi nibẹ.
entries.en: And the king, and all the people that were with him, came weary, and refreshed themselves there.

entries.yo: Absalomu ati gbogbo awọn enia, awọn ọkunrin Israeli si wá si Jerusalemu, Ahitofeli si wà pẹlu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Absalom, and all the people the men of Israel, came to Jerusalem, and Ahithophel with him.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati Huṣai ará Arki, ọrẹ Dafidi tọ Absalomu wá, Huṣai si wi fun Absalomu pe, Ki ọba ki o pẹ, ki ọba ki o pẹ.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when Hushai the Archite, David's friend, was come unto Absalom, that Hushai said unto Absalom, God save the king, God save the king.

entries.yo: Absalomu si wi fun Huṣai pe, Ore rẹ si ọ̀rẹ rẹ ni eyi? ẽṣe ti iwọ kò ba ọrẹ rẹ lọ?
entries.en: And Absalom said to Hushai, Is this thy kindness to thy friend? why wentest thou not with thy friend?

entries.yo: Huṣai si wi fun Absalomu pe, Bẹ̃kọ nitori ẹniti Oluwa, ati gbogbo awọn enia yi, ati gbogbo awọn ọkunrin Israeli ba yàn, tirẹ̀ li emi o jẹ, on li emi o si ba joko.
entries.en: And Hushai said unto Absalom, Nay; but whom the LORD, and this people, and all the men of Israel, choose, his will I be, and with him will I abide.

entries.yo: Ẹwẹ̀, tani emi o si sìn? kò ha yẹ ki emi ki o ma sìn niwaju ọmọ rẹ̀? gẹgẹ bi emi ti nsìn ri niwaju baba rẹ, bẹ̃li emi o ri niwaju rẹ.
entries.en: And again, whom should I serve? should I not serve in the presence of his son? as I have served in thy father's presence, so will I be in thy presence.

entries.yo: Absalomu si wi fun Ahitofeli pe, Ẹ ba ara nyin gbìmọ ohun ti awa o ṣe.
entries.en: Then said Absalom to Ahithophel, Give counsel among you what we shall do.

entries.yo: Ahitofeli si wi fun Absalomu pe, Wọle tọ awọn obinrin baba rẹ lọ, awọn ti o fi silẹ lati ma ṣọ ile, gbogbo Israeli yio si gbọ́ pe, iwọ di ẹni-irira si baba rẹ, ọwọ́ gbogbo awọn ti o wà lọdọ rẹ yio si le.
entries.en: And Ahithophel said unto Absalom, Go in unto thy father's concubines, which he hath left to keep the house; and all Israel shall hear that thou art abhorred of thy father: then shall the hands of all that are with thee be strong.

entries.yo: Nwọn si tẹ agọ kan fun Absalomu li orile; Absalomu si wọle tọ awọn obinrin baba rẹ̀ li oju gbogbo Israeli.
