entries.en: So they spread Absalom a tent upon the top of the house; and Absalom went in unto his father's concubines in the sight of all Israel.

entries.yo: Imọ̀ Ahitofeli ti ima gbà nijọ wọnni, o dabi ẹnipe enia mbere nkan li ọwọ́ Ọlọrun: bẹ̃ni gbogbo ìmọ Ahitofeli fun Dafidi ati fun Absalomu si ri.
entries.en: And the counsel of Ahithophel, which he counselled in those days, was as if a man had inquired at the oracle of God: so was all the counsel of Ahithophel both with David and with Absalom.

entries.yo: AHITOFELI si wi fun Absalomu pe, Emi o si yan ẹgbãfa ọkunrin emi o si dide, emi o si lepa Dafidi li oru yi.
entries.en: Moreover Ahithophel said unto Absalom, Let me now choose out twelve thousand men, and I will arise and pursue after David this night:

entries.yo: Emi o si yọ si i nigbati ãrẹ̀ ba mu u ti ọwọ́ rẹ̀ si ṣe alaile, emi o si dá ipaiya bá a; gbogbo awọn enia ti o wà lọdọ rẹ̀ yio si sa, emi o si kọlu ọba nikanṣoṣo:
entries.en: And I will come upon him while he is weary and weak handed, and will make him afraid: and all the people that are with him shall flee; and I will smite the king only:

entries.yo: Emi o si mu gbogbo awọn enia pada sọdọ rẹ; ọkunrin na ti iwọ nwá si ri gẹgẹ bi ẹnipe gbogbo wọn ti pada: gbogbo awọn enia yio si wà li alafia.
entries.en: And I will bring back all the people unto thee: the man whom thou seekest is as if all returned: so all the people shall be in peace.

entries.yo: Ọrọ na si tọ loju Absalomu, ati li oju gbogbo awọn agbà Israeli.
entries.en: And the saying pleased Absalom well, and all the elders of Israel.

entries.yo: Absalomu si wipe, Njẹ̀ pe Huṣai ará Arki, awa o si gbọ́ eyi ti o wà li ẹnu rẹ̀ pẹlu.
entries.en: Then said Absalom, Call now Hushai the Archite also, and let us hear likewise what he saith.

entries.yo: Huṣai si de ọdọ Absalomu, Absalomu si wi fun u pe, Bayi ni Ahitofeli wi, ki awa ki o ṣe bi ọ̀rọ rẹ̀ bi? bi kò ba si tọ bẹ̃, iwọ wi.
entries.en: And when Hushai was come to Absalom, Absalom spake unto him, saying, Ahithophel hath spoken after this manner: shall we do after his saying? if not; speak thou.

entries.yo: Huṣai si wi fun Absalomu pe, Imọ̀ ti Ahitofeli gbà nì, ko dara nisisiyi.
entries.en: And Hushai said unto Absalom, The counsel that Ahithophel hath given is not good at this time.

entries.yo: Huṣai si wipe, Iwọ mọ̀ baba rẹ ati awọn ọmọkunrin rẹ̀ pe alagbara ni nwọn, nwọn si wà ni kikoro ọkàn bi amọ̀tẹkun ti a gbà li ọmọ ni igbẹ: baba rẹ si jẹ jagunjagun ọkunrin, kì yio ba awọn enia na gbe pọ̀ li oru.
entries.en: For, said Hushai, thou knowest thy father and his men, that they be mighty men, and they be chafed in their minds, as a bear robbed of her whelps in the field: and thy father is a man of war, and will not lodge with the people.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i o ti fi ara rẹ̀ pamọ nisisiyi ni iho kan, tabi ni ibomiran: yio si ṣe, nigbati diẹ ninu wọn ba kọ ṣubu, ẹnikẹni ti o ba gbọ́ yio si wipe, Iparun si mbẹ ninu awọn enia ti ntọ̀ Absalomu lẹhin.
entries.en: Behold, he is hid now in some pit, or in some other place: and it will come to pass, when some of them be overthrown at the first, that whosoever heareth it will say, There is a slaughter among the people that follow Absalom.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o si ṣe alagbara, ti ọkàn rẹ̀ si dabi ọkàn kiniun, yio si rẹ̀ ẹ: nitori gbogbo Israeli ti mọ̀ pe alagbara ni baba rẹ, ati pe, awọn ti mbẹ lọdọ rẹ̀ jẹ alagbara.
entries.en: And he also that is valiant, whose heart is as the heart of a lion, shall utterly melt: for all Israel knoweth that thy father is a mighty man, and they which be with him are valiant men.

entries.yo: Nitorina emi damọ̀ran pe, Ki gbogbo Israeli wọjọ pọ̀ sọ̀dọ rẹ, lati Dani titi dé Beerṣeba, gẹgẹ bi yanrin ti o wà leti okun fun ọ̀pọlọpọ; ati pe, ki iwọ tikararẹ ki o lọ si ogun na.
entries.en: Therefore I counsel that all Israel be generally gathered unto thee, from Dan even to Beer-sheba, as the sand that is by the sea for multitude; and that thou go to battle in thine own person.

entries.yo: Awa o si yọ si i nibikibi ti awa o gbe ri i, awa o si yi i ka bi irì iti sẹ̀ si ilẹ̀: ani ọkan kì yio kù pẹlu rẹ̀ ninu gbogbo awọn ọmọkunrin ti o wà lọdọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: So shall we come upon him in some place where he shall be found, and we will light upon him as the dew falleth on the ground: and of him and of all the men that are with him there shall not be left so much as one.

entries.yo: Bi o ba si bọ si ilu kan, gbogbo Israeli yio si mu okùn wá si ilu na, awa o si fà a lọ si odo, titi a kì yio fi ri okuta kekeke kan nibẹ.
entries.en: Moreover, if he be gotten into a city, then shall all Israel bring ropes to that city, and we will draw it into the river, until there be not one small stone found there.

entries.yo: Absalomu ati gbogbo ọkunrin Israeli si wipe, Ìmọ Huṣai ara Arki sàn jù ìmọ Ahitofeli lọ. Nitori Oluwa fẹ lati yi ìmọ rere ti Ahitofeli po, nitori ki Oluwa ki o le mu ibi wá sori Absalomu.
entries.en: And Absalom and all the men of Israel said, The counsel of Hushai the Archite is better than the counsel of Ahithophel. For the LORD had appointed to defeat the good counsel of Ahithophel, to the intent that the LORD might bring evil upon Absalom.

entries.yo: Huṣai si wi fun Sadoku ati fun Abiatari awọn alufa pe, Bayi bayi ni Ahitofeli ti ba Absalomu ati awọn agbà Israeli dámọran; bayi bayi li emi si damọràn.
entries.en: Then said Hushai unto Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, Thus and thus did Ahithophel counsel Absalom and the elders of Israel; and thus and thus have I counselled.

entries.yo: Nitorina yara ranṣẹ nisisiyi ki o si sọ fun Dafidi pe, Máṣe duro ni pẹtẹlẹ ijù nì li alẹ yi, ṣugbọn yara rekọja, ki a má ba gbe ọba mì, ati gbogbo awọn enia ti o mbẹ lọdọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Now therefore send quickly, and tell David, saying, Lodge not this night in the plains of the wilderness, but speedily pass over; lest the king be swallowed up, and all the people that are with him.

entries.yo: Jonatani ati Ahimaasi si duro ni Enrogeli; ọdọmọdebirin kan si lọ, o si sọ fun wọn; awọn si lọ nwọn sọ fun Dafidi ọba nitoripe ki a má ba ri wọn pe nwọn wọ ilu.
entries.en: Now Jonathan and Ahimaaz stayed by En-rogel; for they might not be seen to come into the city: and a wench went and told them; and they went and told king David.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ọdọmọdekunrin kan ri wọn, o si wi fun Absalomu: ṣugbọn awọn mejeji si yara lọ kuro, nwọn si wá si ile ọkunrin kan ni Bahurimu, ẹniti o ni kanga kan li ọgbà rẹ̀, nwọn si sọkalẹ si ibẹ.
entries.en: Nevertheless a lad saw them, and told Absalom: but they went both of them away quickly, and came to a man's house in Bahurim, which had a well in his court; whither they went down.

entries.yo: Obinrin rẹ̀ si mu nkan o fi bo kanga na, o si sa agbado sori rẹ̀; a kò si mọ̀.
entries.en: And the woman took and spread a covering over the well's mouth, and spread ground corn thereon; and the thing was not known.

entries.yo: Awọn iranṣẹ Absalomu si tọ obinrin na wá ni ile na, nwọn si bere pe, Nibo ni Ahimaasi ati Jonatani gbe wà? obinrin na si wi fun wọn pe, Nwọn ti goke rekọja iṣan odo nì. Nwọn si wá wọn kiri, nwọn kò si ri wọn, nwọn si yipada si Jerusalemu.
entries.en: And when Absalom's servants came to the woman to the house, they said, Where is Ahimaaz and Jonathan? And the woman said unto them, They be gone over the brook of water. And when they had sought and could not find them, they returned to Jerusalem.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, lẹhin igbati nwọn yẹra kuro tan, awọn si jade kuro ninu kanga, nwọn si lọ, nwọn si rò fun Dafidi ọba, nwọn si wi fun Dafidi pe, Dide ki o si goke odo kánkán: nitoripe bayi ni Ahitofeli gbìmọ si ọ.
entries.en: And it came to pass, after they were departed, that they came up out of the well, and went and told king David, and said unto David, Arise, and pass quickly over the water: for thus hath Ahithophel counselled against you.

entries.yo: Dafidi si dide, ati gbogbo awọn enia ti mbẹ lọdọ rẹ̀, nwọn si goke odo Jordani: ki ilẹ to mọ́, ẹnikan kò kù ti kò goke odo Jordani.
entries.en: Then David arose, and all the people that were with him, and they passed over Jordan: by the morning light there lacked not one of them that was not gone over Jordan.

entries.yo: Nigbati Ahitofeli si ri pe nwọn kò fi ìmọ tirẹ̀ ṣe, o si di kẹtẹkẹtẹ rẹ̀ ni gãri, o si dide, o lọ ile rẹ̀, o si palẹ ile rẹ̀ mọ, o si pokùnso, o si kú, a si sin i si iboji baba rẹ̀.
entries.en: And when Ahithophel saw that his counsel was not followed, he saddled his ass, and arose, and gat him home to his house, to his city, and put his household in order, and hanged himself, and died, and was buried in the sepulchre of his father.

entries.yo: Dafidi si wá si Mahanaimu. Absalomu si goke odo Jordani, on, ati gbogbo awọn ọkunrin Israeli pẹlu rẹ̀.
entries.en: Then David came to Mahanaim. And Absalom passed over Jordan, he and all the men of Israel with him.

entries.yo: Absalomu si fi Amasa ṣe olori ogun ni ipò Joabu: Amasa ẹniti iṣe ọmọ ẹnikan, orukọ ẹniti a npè ni Itra, ara Israeli, ti o wọle tọ Abigaili ọmọbinrin Nahaṣi, arabinrin Seruia, iyá Joabu.
entries.en: And Absalom made Amasa captain of the host instead of Joab: which Amasa was a man's son, whose name was Ithra an Israelite, that went in to Abigail the daughter of Nahash, sister to Zeruiah Joab's mother.

entries.yo: Israeli ati Absalomu si do ni ilẹ Gileadi.
entries.en: So Israel and Absalom pitched in the land of Gilead.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati Dafidi si wá si Mahanaimu, Ṣobi ọmọ Nahaṣi ti Rabba ti awọn ọmọ Ammoni, ati Makiri ọmọ Ammieli ti Lodebari, ati Barsillai ara Gileadi ti Rogelimu,
entries.en: And it came to pass, when David was come to Mahanaim, that Shobi the son of Nahash of Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and Machir the son of Ammiel of Lo-debar, and Barzillai the Gileadite of Rogelim,

entries.yo: Mu akete, ati ago, ati ohun-elo amọ̀, ati alikama, ati ọkà, ati iyẹfun, ati agbado didin, ati ẹ̀wa, ati erẽ, ati ẹ̀wa didin.
entries.en: Brought beds, and basons, and earthen vessels, and wheat, and barley, and flour, and parched corn, and beans, and lentiles, and parched pulse,

entries.yo: Ati oyin, ati ori-amọ, ati agutan, ati wàrakasi malu, wá fun Dafidi, ati fun awọn enia ti mbẹ lọdọ rẹ̀ lati jẹ: nitoriti nwọn wi pe, ebi npa awọn enia, o si rẹ̀ wọn, orungbẹ si ngbẹ wọn li aginju.
entries.en: And honey, and butter, and sheep, and cheese of kine, for David, and for the people that were with him, to eat: for they said, The people is hungry, and weary, and thirsty, in the wilderness.

entries.yo: DAFIDI si kà awọn enia ti mbẹ lọdọ rẹ̀, o si mu wọn jẹ balogun ẹgbẹgbẹrun, ati balogun ọrọrun lori wọn.
entries.en: And David numbered the people that were with him, and set captains of thousands and captains of hundreds over them.

entries.yo: Dafidi si fi idamẹta awọn enia na le Joabu lọwọ, o si ran wọn lọ, ati idamẹta le Abiṣai ọmọ Seruia aburo Joabu lọwọ, ati idamẹta le Ittai ara Giti lọwọ. Ọba si wi fun awọn enia na pe, nitotọ emi tikara mi o si ba nyin lọ pẹlu.
entries.en: And David sent forth a third part of the people under the hand of Joab, and a third part under the hand of Abishai the son of Zeruiah, Joab's brother, and a third part under the hand of Ittai the Gittite. And the king said unto the people, I will surely go forth with you myself also.

entries.yo: Awọn enia na si wipe, Iwọ ki yio ba wa lọ: nitoripe bi awa ba sa, nwọn kì yio nani wa, tabi bi o tilẹ ṣepe idajì wa kú, nwọn ki yio nani wa, nitoripe iwọ nikan to ẹgbãrun wa: nitorina, o si dara ki iwọ ki o ma ràn wa lọwọ lati ilu wá.
entries.en: But the people answered, Thou shalt not go forth: for if we flee away, they will not care for us; neither if half of us die, will they care for us: but now thou art worth ten thousand of us: therefore now it is better that thou succour us out of the city.

entries.yo: Ọba si wi fun wọn pe, Eyi ti o ba tọ́ loju nyin li emi o ṣe. Ọba si duro li apakan ẹnu odi, gbogbo awọn enia na si jade ni ọ̀rọrún ati ni ẹgbẹgbẹrun.
entries.en: And the king said unto them, What seemeth you best I will do. And the king stood by the gate side, and all the people came out by hundreds and by thousands.

entries.yo: Ọba si paṣẹ fun Joabu ati Abiṣai ati Ittai pe, Ẹ tọju ọdọmọkunrin na Absalomu fun mi. Gbogbo awọn enia na si gbọ́ nigbati ọba paṣẹ fun gbogbo awọn balogun nitori Absalomu.
entries.en: And the king commanded Joab and Abishai and Ittai, saying, Deal gently for my sake with the young man, even with Absalom. And all the people heard when the king gave all the captains charge concerning Absalom.

entries.yo: Awọn enia na si jade lati pade Israeli ni pápá; ni igbó Efraimu ni nwọn gbe pade ijà na.
entries.en: So the people went out into the field against Israel: and the battle was in the wood of Ephraim;

entries.yo: Nibẹ li a gbe pa awọn enia Israeli niwaju awọn iranṣẹ Dafidi, ọ̀pọlọpọ enia lo ṣubu li ọjọ na, ani ẹgbãwa enia.
entries.en: Where the people of Israel were slain before the servants of David, and there was there a great slaughter that day of twenty thousand men.

entries.yo: Ogun na si fọ́n ka kiri lori gbogbo ilẹ na: igbógàn na si pa ọ̀pọ enia jù eyi ti idà pa lọ li ọjọ na.
entries.en: For the battle was there scattered over the face of all the country: and the wood devoured more people that day than the sword devoured.

entries.yo: Absalomu si pade awọn iranṣẹ Dafidi. Absalomu si gun ori ibaka kan, ibaka na si gba abẹ ẹka nla igi pọ́nhan kan ti o tobi lọ, ori rẹ̀ si kọ́ igi pọ́nhan na, on si rọ̀ soke li agbedemeji ọrun on ilẹ; ibaka na ti o wà labẹ rẹ̀ si lọ kuro.
entries.en: And Absalom met the servants of David. And Absalom rode upon a mule, and the mule went under the thick boughs of a great oak, and his head caught hold of the oak, and he was taken up between the heaven and the earth; and the mule that was under him went away.

entries.yo: Ọkunrin kan si ri i, o si wi fun Joabu pe, Wõ, emi ri Absalomu rọ̀ lãrin igi pọ́nhan kan.
entries.en: And a certain man saw it, and told Joab, and said, Behold, I saw Absalom hanged in an oak.

entries.yo: Joabu si wi fun ọkunrin na ti o sọ fun u pe, Sa wõ, iwọ ri i, eha ti ṣe ti iwọ kò fi lù u bolẹ nibẹ? emi iba si fun ọ ni ṣekeli fadaka mẹwa, ati amure kan.
entries.en: And Joab said unto the man that told him, And, behold, thou sawest him, and why didst thou not smite him there to the ground? and I would have given thee ten shekels of silver, and a girdle.

entries.yo: Ọkunrin na si wi fun Joabu pe, Biotilẹṣepe emi o gba ẹgbẹrun ṣekeli fadaka si ọwọ́ mi, emi kì yio fi ọwọ́ mi kan ọmọ ọba: nitoripe awa gbọ́ nigbati ọba kilọ fun iwọ ati Abiṣai, ati Ittai, pe, Ẹ kiye si i, ki ẹnikẹni ki o má fi ọwọ́ kan ọdọmọkunrin na Absalomu.
entries.en: And the man said unto Joab, Though I should receive a thousand shekels of silver in mine hand, yet would I not put forth mine hand against the king's son: for in our hearing the king charged thee and Abishai and Ittai, saying, Beware that none touch the young man Absalom.

entries.yo: Bi o ba ṣe bẹ̃ emi iba ṣe ibi si ara mi: nitoripe kò si ọran kan ti o pamọ fun ọba, iwọ tikararẹ iba si kọju ijà si mi pẹlu.
entries.en: Otherwise I should have wrought falsehood against mine own life: for there is no matter hid from the king, and thou thyself wouldest have set thyself against me.

entries.yo: Joabu si wipe, emi kì yio duro bẹ̃ niwaju rẹ. O si mu ọ̀kọ mẹta lọwọ rẹ̀, o si fi wọn gun Absalomu li ọkàn, nigbati o si wà lãye li agbedemeji igi pọ́nhan na.
entries.en: Then said Joab, I may not tarry thus with thee. And he took three darts in his hand, and thrust them through the heart of Absalom, while he was yet alive in the midst of the oak.

entries.yo: Awọn ọdọmọdekunrin mẹwa ti ima ru ihamọra Joabu si yi Absalomu ka, nwọn si kọlù u, nwọn si pa a.
entries.en: And ten young men that bare Joab's armour compassed about and smote Absalom, and slew him.

entries.yo: Joabu si fún ipè, awọn enia na si yipada ati mã lepa Israeli: nitori Joabu ti pe awọn enia na pada.
entries.en: And Joab blew the trumpet, and the people returned from pursuing after Israel: for Joab held back the people.

entries.yo: Nwọn si gbe Absalomu, nwọn si sọ ọ sinu iho nla kan ni igbogàn na, nwọn si papó okuta pupọ jọ si i lori, gbogbo Israeli si sa, olukuluku si inu agọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And they took Absalom, and cast him into a great pit in the wood, and laid a very great heap of stones upon him: and all Israel fled every one to his tent.

entries.yo: Absalomu li ọjọ aiye rẹ̀ si mu, o si mọ ọwọ̀n kan fun ara rẹ̀, ti mbẹ li afonifoji ọba: nitoriti o wipe, Emi kò ni ọmọkunrin ti yio pa orukọ mi mọ ni iranti: on si pe ọwọ̀n na nipa orukọ rẹ̀: a si npè e titi di oni, ni ọwọ̀n Absalomu.
entries.en: Now Absalom in his lifetime had taken and reared up for himself a pillar, which is in the king's dale: for he said, I have no son to keep my name in remembrance: and he called the pillar after his own name: and it is called unto this day, Absalom's place.

entries.yo: Ahimaasi ọmọ Sadoku si wipe, Jẹ ki emi ki o sure nisisiyi, ki emi ki o si mu ihìn tọ̀ ọba lọ, bi Oluwa ti gbẹsan rẹ̀ li ara awọn ọta rẹ̀.
entries.en: Then said Ahimaaz the son of Zadok, Let me now run, and bear the king tidings, how that the LORD hath avenged him of his enemies.

entries.yo: Joabu si wi fun u pe, Iwọ ki yio mu ìhin lọ loni, ṣugbọn iwọ o mu ìhin lọ ni ijọ miran: ṣugbọn loni yi iwọ kì yio mu ìhin kan lọ, nitoriti ọmọ ọba ṣe alaisi.
entries.en: And Joab said unto him, Thou shalt not bear tidings this day, but thou shalt bear tidings another day: but this day thou shalt bear no tidings, because the king's son is dead.

entries.yo: Joabu si wi fun Kuṣi pe, Lọ, ki iwọ ki o rò ohun ti iwọ ri fun ọba. Kuṣi si wolẹ fun Joabu, o si sare.
entries.en: Then said Joab to Cushi, Go tell the king what thou hast seen. And Cushi bowed himself unto Joab, and ran.

entries.yo: Ahimaasi ọmọ Sadoku si tun wi fun Joabu pe, Jọwọ, bi o ti wu ki o ri, emi o sare tọ Kuṣi lẹhin. Joabu si bi i pe, Nitori kini iwọ o ṣe sare, ọmọ mi, iwọ kò ri pe kò si ihìn rere kan ti iwọ o mu lọ?
entries.en: Then said Ahimaaz the son of Zadok yet again to Joab, But howsoever, let me, I pray thee, also run after Cushi. And Joab said, Wherefore wilt thou run, my son, seeing that thou hast no tidings ready?

entries.yo: O si wi pe, Bi o ti wu ki o ri, emi o sare. On si wi fun u pe, Sare. Ahimaasi si sare li ọ̀na pẹtẹlẹ, o si sare kọja Kuṣi.
entries.en: But howsoever, said he, let me run. And he said unto him, Run. Then Ahimaaz ran by the way of the plain, and overran Cushi.

entries.yo: Dafidi si joko li ẹnu odi lãrin ilẹkun meji: alore si goke orule bode lori odi, o si gbe oju rẹ̀ soke, o si wò, wõ, ọkunrin kan nsare on nikan.
entries.en: And David sat between the two gates: and the watchman went up to the roof over the gate unto the wall, and lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold a man running alone.

entries.yo: Alore na si kigbe, o si wi fun ọba; ọba si wi pe, Bi o ba ṣe on nikan ni, ihìn rere mbẹ li ẹnu rẹ̀. On si nsunmọ tosi.
entries.en: And the watchman cried, and told the king. And the king said, If he be alone, there is tidings in his mouth. And he came apace, and drew near.

entries.yo: Alore na si ri ọkunrin miran ti nsare: alore si kọ si ẹniti nṣọ bode, o si wi pe, Wõ, ọkunrin kan nsare on nikan, ọba si wipe, Eyi na pẹlu nmu ihìn rere wá.
entries.en: And the watchman saw another man running: and the watchman called unto the porter, and said, Behold another man running alone. And the king said, He also bringeth tidings.

entries.yo: Alore na si wipe, Emi wo isare ẹniti o wà niwaju o dabi isare Ahimaasi ọmọ Sadoku. Ọba si wi pe, Enia rere ni, o si nmu ihìn rere wá.
entries.en: And the watchman said, Me thinketh the running of the foremost is like the running of Ahimaaz the son of Zadok. And the king said, He is a good man, and cometh with good tidings.

entries.yo: Ahimaasi si pè, o si wi fun ọba pe, Alafia. On si wolẹ fun ọba, o dojubolẹ o si wi pe, Alabukun fun li Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ, ẹniti o fi awọn ọkunrin ti o gbe ọwọ́ wọn soke si oluwa mi ọba le ọ lọwọ.
entries.en: And Ahimaaz called, and said unto the king, All is well. And he fell down to the earth upon his face before the king, and said, Blessed be the LORD thy God, which hath delivered up the men that lifted up their hand against my lord the king.

entries.yo: Ọba si bere pe, Alafia fun Absalomu ọmọdekunrin nì bi? Ahimaasi si dahun pe, Nigbati Joabu rán iranṣẹ ọba, ati emi iranṣẹ rẹ, mo ri ọ̀pọ enia, ṣugbọn emi kò mọ̀ idi rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the king said, Is the young man Absalom safe? And Ahimaaz answered, When Joab sent the king's servant, and me thy servant, I saw a great tumult, but I knew not what it was.

entries.yo: Ọba si wi fun u pe, Yipada ki o si duro nihin: On si yipada, o si duro jẹ.
entries.en: And the king said unto him, Turn aside, and stand here. And he turned aside, and stood still.

entries.yo: Si wõ, Kuṣi de; Kuṣi si wi pe, Ihin rere fun oluwa mi ọba: nitoriti Oluwa ti gbẹsan rẹ loni lara gbogbo awọn ti o dide si ọ.
entries.en: And, behold, Cushi came; and Cushi said, Tidings, my lord the king: for the LORD hath avenged thee this day of all them that rose up against thee.

entries.yo: Ọba si bi Kuṣi pe, Alafia kọ Absalomu ọdọmọdekunrin na wà bi? Kuṣi si dahun pe, Ki awọn ọta oluwa mi ọba, ati gbogbo awọn ti o dide si ọ ni ibi, ri bi ọdọmọdekunrin na.
entries.en: And the king said unto Cushi, Is the young man Absalom safe? And Cushi answered, The enemies of my lord the king, and all that rise against thee to do thee hurt, be as that young man is.

entries.yo: Ọba si kẹdùn pupọ̀, o si goke lọ si iyẹwu ti o wà lori oke bode, o si sọkun; bayi li o si nwi bi o ti nlọ, ọmọ mi Absalomu, ọmọ mi, ọmọ mi Absalomu! Ã! Ibaṣepe emi li o kú ni ipò rẹ, Absalomu ọmọ mi, ọmọ mi!
entries.en: And the king was much moved, and went up to the chamber over the gate, and wept: and as he went, thus he said, O my son Absalom, my son, my son Absalom! would God I had died for thee, O Absalom, my son, my son!

entries.yo: A si rò fun Joabu pe, Wõ, ọba nsọkun, o si ngbawẹ fun Absalomu.
entries.en: And it was told Joab, Behold, the king weepeth and mourneth for Absalom.

entries.yo: Iṣẹgun ijọ na si di awẹ̀ fun gbogbo awọn enia na, nitori awọn enia na gbọ́ ni ijọ na bi inu ọba ti bajẹ nitori ọmọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the victory that day was turned into mourning unto all the people: for the people heard say that day how the king was grieved for his son.

entries.yo: Awọn enia na si yọ́ lọ si ilu ni ijọ na gẹgẹ bi awọn enia ti a dojuti a ma yọ́ lọ nigbati nwọn nsá loju ijà.
entries.en: And the people gat them by stealth that day into the city, as people being ashamed steal away when they flee in battle.

entries.yo: Ọba si bo oju rẹ̀, ọba si kigbe li ohùn rara pe, A! ọmọ mi Absalomu, Absalomu ọmọ mi, ọmọ mi!
entries.en: But the king covered his face, and the king cried with a loud voice, O my son Absalom, O Absalom, my son, my son!

entries.yo: Joabu si wọ inu ile tọ ọba lọ, o si wipe, Iwọ dojuti gbogbo awọn iranṣẹ rẹ loni, awọn ti o gbà ẹmi rẹ là loni, ati ẹmi awọn ọmọkunrin rẹ, ati ti awọn ọmọbinrin rẹ, ati ẹmi awọn aya rẹ, ati ẹmi awọn obinrin rẹ.
entries.en: And Joab came into the house to the king, and said, Thou hast shamed this day the faces of all thy servants, which this day have saved thy life, and the lives of thy sons and of thy daughters, and the lives of thy wives, and the lives of thy concubines;

entries.yo: Nitoripe iwọ fẹ awọn ọta rẹ, iwọ si korira awọn ọrẹ rẹ. Nitoriti iwọ wi loni pe, Iwọ kò nani awọn ọmọ ọba, tabi awọn iranṣẹ: emi si ri loni pe, ibaṣepe Absalomu wà lãye, ki gbogbo wa si kú loni, njẹ iba dùnmọ ọ gidigidi.
entries.en: In that thou lovest thine enemies, and hatest thy friends. For thou hast declared this day, that thou regardest neither princes nor servants: for this day I perceive, that if Absalom had lived, and all we had died this day, then it had pleased thee well.

entries.yo: Si dide nisisiyi, lọ, ki o si sọ̀rọ itùnú fun awọn iranṣẹ rẹ: nitoripe emi fi Oluwa bura, bi iwọ kò ba lọ, ẹnikan kì yio ba ọ duro li alẹ yi: ati eyini yio si buru fun ọ jù gbogbo ibi ti oju rẹ ti nri lati igbà ewe rẹ wá titi o fi di isisiyi.
entries.en: Now therefore arise, go forth, and speak comfortably unto thy servants: for I swear by the LORD, if thou go not forth, there will not tarry one with thee this night: and that will be worse unto thee than all the evil that befell thee from thy youth until now.

entries.yo: Ọba si dide, o si joko li ẹnu ọ̀na. Nwọn si wi fun gbogbo awọn enia na pe, Wõ, ọba joko li ẹnu ọ̀na. Gbogbo enia si wá si iwaju ọba: nitoripe, Israeli ti sa, olukuluku si àgọ́ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Then the king arose, and sat in the gate. And they told unto all the people, saying, Behold, the king doth sit in the gate. And all the people came before the king: for Israel had fled every man to his tent.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn enia na si mba ara wọn jà ninu gbogbo ẹya Israeli, pe, Ọba ti gbà wa là lọwọ awọn ọta wa, o si ti gbà wa kuro lọwọ awọn Filistini; on si wa sa kuro ni ilu nitori Absalomu.
entries.en: And all the people were at strife throughout all the tribes of Israel, saying, The king saved us out of the hand of our enemies, and he delivered us out of the hand of the Philistines; and now he is fled out of the land for Absalom.

entries.yo: Absalomu, ti awa fi jọba lori wa si kú li ogun: njẹ ẽṣe ti ẹnyin fi dakẹ ti ẹnyin kò si sọ̀rọ kan lati mu ọba pada wá?
entries.en: And Absalom, whom we anointed over us, is dead in battle. Now therefore why speak ye not a word of bringing the king back?

entries.yo: Dafidi ọba si ranṣẹ si Sadoku, ati si Abiatari awọn alufa pe, Sọ fun awọn agbà Juda, pe, Ẽṣe ti ẹnyin fi kẹhin lati mu ọba pada wá si ile rẹ̀? ọ̀rọ gbogbo Israeli si ti de ọdọ ọba ani ni ile rẹ̀.
entries.en: And king David sent to Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, saying, Speak unto the elders of Judah, saying, Why are ye the last to bring the king back to his house? seeing the speech of all Israel is come to the king, even to his house.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin li ará mi, ẹnyin li egungun mi, ati ẹran ara mi: ẹ̃si ti ṣe ti ẹnyin fi kẹhìn lati mu ọba pada wá?
entries.en: Ye are my brethren, ye are my bones and my flesh: wherefore then are ye the last to bring back the king?

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o si wi fun Amasa pe, Egungun ati ẹran ara mi ki iwọ iṣe bi? ki Ọlọrun ki o ṣe bẹ̃ si mi ati ju bẹ̃ lọ pẹlu, bi iwọ kò ba ṣe olori ogun niwaju mi titi, ni ipò Joabu.
entries.en: And say ye to Amasa, Art thou not of my bone, and of my flesh? God do so to me, and more also, if thou be not captain of the host before me continually in the room of Joab.

entries.yo: On si yi ọkàn gbogbo awọn ọkunrin Juda, ani bi ọkàn enia kan; nwọn si ranṣẹ si ọba, pe, Iwọ pada ati gbogbo awọn iranṣẹ rẹ.
entries.en: And he bowed the heart of all the men of Judah, even as the heart of one man; so that they sent this word unto the king, Return thou, and all thy servants.

entries.yo: Ọba si pada, o si wá si odo Jordani. Juda si wá si Gilgali, lati lọ ipade ọba, ati lati mu ọba kọja odo Jordani.
entries.en: So the king returned, and came to Jordan. And Judah came to Gilgal, to go to meet the king, to conduct the king over Jordan.

entries.yo: Ṣimei ọmọ Gera, ara Benjamini ti Bahurimu, o yara o si ba awọn ọkunrin Juda sọkalẹ lati pade Dafidi ọba.
entries.en: And Shimei the son of Gera, a Benjamite, which was of Bahurim, hasted and came down with the men of Judah to meet king David.

entries.yo: Ẹgbẹrun ọmọkunrin si wà lọdọ rẹ̀ ninu awọn ọmọkunrin Benjamini, Siba iranṣẹ ile Saulu, ati awọn ọmọkunrin rẹ̀ mẹ̃dogun ati ogún iranṣẹ si pẹlu rẹ̀; nwọn si goke odo Jordani ṣaju ọba.
entries.en: And there were a thousand men of Benjamin with him, and Ziba the servant of the house of Saul, and his fifteen sons and his twenty servants with him; and they went over Jordan before the king.

entries.yo: Ọkọ̀ èro kan ti rekọja lati kó awọn enia ile ọba si oke, ati lati ṣe eyiti o tọ li oju rẹ̀. Ṣimei ọmọ Gera wolẹ, o si dojubolẹ niwaju ọba, bi o ti goke odo Jordani.
entries.en: And there went over a ferry boat to carry over the king's household, and to do what he thought good. And Shimei the son of Gera fell down before the king, as he was come over Jordan;

entries.yo: O si wi fun ọba pe, Ki oluwa mi ki o máṣe ka ẹ̀ṣẹ si mi li ọrùn, má si ṣe ranti afojudi ti iranṣẹ rẹ ṣe li ọjọ ti oluwa mi ọba jade ni Jerusalemu, ki ọba ki o má si fi si inu.
entries.en: And said unto the king, Let not my lord impute iniquity unto me, neither do thou remember that which thy servant did perversely the day that my lord the king went out of Jerusalem, that the king should take it to his heart.

entries.yo: Nitoripe iranṣẹ rẹ mọ̀ pe on ti ṣẹ̀; si wõ, ni gbogbo idile Josefu emi li o kọ́ wá loni lati sọkalẹ wá pade oluwa mi ọba.
entries.en: For thy servant doth know that I have sinned: therefore, behold, I am come the first this day of all the house of Joseph to go down to meet my lord the king.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Abiṣai ọmọ Seruia dahùn o si wipe, Kò ha tọ́ ki a pa Ṣimei nitori eyi? nitoripe on ti bú ẹni-àmi-ororo Oluwa.
entries.en: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah answered and said, Shall not Shimei be put to death for this, because he cursed the LORD's anointed?

entries.yo: Dafidi si wipe, Ki li o wà lãrin emi ati ẹnyin, ẹnyin ọmọ Seruia, ti ẹ fi di ọta si mi loni? a ha le pa enia kan loni ni Israeli? o le ṣe pe emi kò mọ̀ pe, loni emi li ọba Israeli?
entries.en: And David said, What have I to do with you, ye sons of Zeruiah, that ye should this day be adversaries unto me? shall there any man be put to death this day in Israel? for do not I know that I am this day king over Israel?

entries.yo: Ọba si wi fun Ṣimei pe, Iwọ kì yio kú. Ọba si bura fun u.
entries.en: Therefore the king said unto Shimei, Thou shalt not die. And the king sware unto him.

entries.yo: Mefiboṣeti ọmọ Saulu si sọkalẹ lati wá pade ọba, kò wẹ ẹsẹ rẹ̀, kò si fá irungbọ̀n rẹ̀, bẹ̃ni kò si fọ aṣọ rẹ̀ lati ọjọ ti ọba ti jade titi o fi di ọjọ ti o fi pada li alafia.
entries.en: And Mephibosheth the son of Saul came down to meet the king, and had neither dressed his feet, nor trimmed his beard, nor washed his clothes, from the day the king departed until the day he came again in peace.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati on si wá si Jerusalemu lati pade ọba, ọba si wi fun u pe, Ẽṣe ti iwọ kò fi ba mi lọ, Mefiboṣeti?
entries.en: And it came to pass, when he was come to Jerusalem to meet the king, that the king said unto him, Wherefore wentest not thou with me, Mephibosheth?

entries.yo: On si dahùn wipe, Oluwa mi, ọba, iranṣẹ mi li o tàn mi jẹ; nitoriti iranṣẹ rẹ ti wipe, Emi o di kẹtẹkẹtẹ ni gãri, emi o gùn u, emi o si tọ̀ ọba lọ, nitoriti iranṣẹ rẹ yarọ.
entries.en: And he answered, My lord, O king, my servant deceived me: for thy servant said, I will saddle me an ass, that I may ride thereon, and go to the king; because thy servant is lame.

entries.yo: O si sọ̀rọ ibajẹ si iranṣẹ rẹ, fun oluwa mi ọba, ṣugbọn bi angeli Ọlọrun li oluwa mi ọba ri: nitorina ṣe eyi ti o dara loju rẹ.
entries.en: And he hath slandered thy servant unto my lord the king; but my lord the king is as an angel of God: do therefore what is good in thine eyes.

entries.yo: Nitoripe gbogbo ile baba mi bi okú enia ni nwọn sa ri niwaju oluwa mi ọba: iwọ si fi ipò fun iranṣẹ rẹ larin awọn ti o njẹun ni ibi onjẹ rẹ. Nitorina are kili emi ni ti emi o fi ma ke pe ọba sibẹ.
entries.en: For all of my father's house were but dead men before my lord the king: yet didst thou set thy servant among them that did eat at thine own table. What right therefore have I yet to cry any more unto the king?

entries.yo: Ọba si wi fun u pe, Ẽṣe ti iwọ fi nsọ ọràn rẹ siwaju mọ? emi sa ti wipe, Ki iwọ ati Siba pin ilẹ na.
entries.en: And the king said unto him, Why speakest thou any more of thy matters? I have said, Thou and Ziba divide the land.

entries.yo: Mefiboṣeti si wi fun ọba pe, Si jẹ ki o mu gbogbo rẹ̀, bi oluwa mi ọba ba ti pada bọ̀ wá ile rẹ̀ li alafia.
entries.en: And Mephibosheth said unto the king, Yea, let him take all, forasmuch as my lord the king is come again in peace unto his own house.

entries.yo: Barsillai ara Gileadi si sọkalẹ lati Rogelimu wá, o si ba ọba goke odo Jordani, lati ṣe ikẹ́ rẹ̀ si ikọja odo Jordani.
entries.en: And Barzillai the Gileadite came down from Rogelim, and went over Jordan with the king, to conduct him over Jordan.

entries.yo: Barsillai si jẹ arugbo ọkunrin gidigidi, ẹni ogbó ọgọrin ọdun si ni: o si pese ohun jijẹ fun ọba nigbati o ti wà ni Mahanaimu; nitoripe ọkunrin ọlọla li on iṣe.
entries.en: Now Barzillai was a very aged man, even fourscore years old: and he had provided the king of sustenance while he lay at Mahanaim; for he was a very great man.

entries.yo: Ọba si wi fun Barsillai pe, Iwọ wá ba mi goke odo, emi o si ma bọ́ ọ ni Jerusalemu.
entries.en: And the king said unto Barzillai, Come thou over with me, and I will feed thee with me in Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Barsillai si wi fun ọba pe, Ọjọ melo ni ọdun ẹmi mi kù, ti emi o fi ba ọba goke lọ si Jerusalemu?
entries.en: And Barzillai said unto the king, How long have I to live, that I should go up with the king unto Jerusalem?

entries.yo: Ẹni ogbó ọgọrin ọdun sa li emi loni: emi le mọ̀ iyatọ ninu rere ati buburu? iranṣẹ rẹ le mọ̀ adùn ohun ti emi njẹ tabi ohun ti emi nmu bi? emi tun le mọ̀ adùn ohùn awọn ọkunrin ti nkọrin, ati awọn obinrin ti nkọrin bi? njẹ nitori kili iranṣẹ rẹ yio ṣe jẹ́ iyọnu sibẹ fun oluwa mi ọba?
entries.en: I am this day fourscore years old: and can I discern between good and evil? can thy servant taste what I eat or what I drink? can I hear any more the voice of singing men and singing women? wherefore then should thy servant be yet a burden unto my lord the king?

entries.yo: Iranṣẹ rẹ yio si sin ọba lọ diẹ goke odo Jordani; ẽsi ṣe ti ọba yio fi san ẹsan yi fun mi?
entries.en: Thy servant will go a little way over Jordan with the king: and why should the king recompense it me with such a reward?

entries.yo: Emi bẹ̀ ọ, jẹ ki iranṣẹ rẹ pada, emi o si kú ni ilu mi, a o si sin mi ni iboji baba ati iya mi. Si wo Kimhamu iranṣẹ rẹ, yio ba oluwa mi ọba goke; iwọ o si ṣe ohun ti o ba tọ li oju rẹ fun u.
entries.en: Let thy servant, I pray thee, turn back again, that I may die in mine own city, and be buried by the grave of my father and of my mother. But behold thy servant Chimham; let him go over with my lord the king; and do to him what shall seem good unto thee.

entries.yo: Ọba si dahùn wipe, Kimhamu yio ba mi goke, emi o si ṣe eyi ti o tọ loju rẹ fun u; ohunkohun ti iwọ ba si bere lọwọ mi, emi o ṣe fun ọ.
entries.en: And the king answered, Chimham shall go over with me, and I will do to him that which shall seem good unto thee: and whatsoever thou shalt require of me, that will I do for thee.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn enia si goke odo Jordani. Ọba si goke; ọba si fi ẹnu kò Barsillai li ẹnu, o si sure fun u; on si pada si ile rẹ̀.
entries.en: And all the people went over Jordan. And when the king was come over, the king kissed Barzillai, and blessed him; and he returned unto his own place.

entries.yo: Ọba si nlọ si Gilgali, Kimhamu si mba a lọ, gbogbo awọn enia Juda si nṣe ikẹ ọba, ati ãbọ awọn enia Israeli.
entries.en: Then the king went on to Gilgal, and Chimham went on with him: and all the people of Judah conducted the king, and also half the people of Israel.

entries.yo: Si wõ, gbogbo awọn ọkunrin Israeli si tọ ọba wá, nwọn si wi fun ọba pe, Ẽṣe ti awọn arakunrin wa awọn ọkunrin Juda fi ji ọ kuro, ti nwọn si fi mu ọba ati awọn ara ile rẹ̀ goke odo Jordani, ati gbogbo awọn enia Dafidi pẹlu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And, behold, all the men of Israel came to the king, and said unto the king, Why have our brethren the men of Judah stolen thee away, and have brought the king, and his household, and all David's men with him, over Jordan?

entries.yo: Gbogbo ọkunrin Juda si da awọn ọkunrin Israeli li ohùn pe, Nitoripe ọba bá wa tan ni; ẽṣe ti ẹnyin fi binu nitori ọran yi? awa jẹ ninu onjẹ ọba rara bi? tabi o fi ẹ̀bun kan fun wa bi?
entries.en: And all the men of Judah answered the men of Israel, Because the king is near of kin to us: wherefore then be ye angry for this matter? have we eaten at all of the king's cost? or hath he given us any gift?

entries.yo: Awọn ọkunrin Israeli si da awọn ọkunrin Juda li ohùn pe, Awa ni ipa mẹwa ninu ọba, awa si ni ninu Dafidi jù nyin lọ, ẽṣe ti ẹnyin kò fi kà wa si, ti ìmọ wa kò fi ṣaju lati mu ọba wa pada? ọ̀rọ awọn ọkunrin Juda si le jù ọ̀rọ awọn ọkunrin Israeli lọ.
entries.en: And the men of Israel answered the men of Judah, and said, We have ten parts in the king, and we have also more right in David than ye: why then did ye despise us, that our advice should not be first had in bringing back our king? And the words of the men of Judah were fiercer than the words of the men of Israel.

entries.yo: Ọkunrin Beliali kan si mbẹ nibẹ orukọ rẹ̀ si njẹ Ṣeba ọmọ Bikri ara Benjamini; o si fún ipè o si wipe, Awa kò ni ipa ni Dafidi, bẹ̃li awa kò ni ini ni ọmọ Jesse: ki olukuluku ọkunrin lọ si agọ rẹ̀, ẹnyin Israeli.
entries.en: And there happened to be there a man of Belial, whose name was Sheba, the son of Bichri, a Benjamite: and he blew a trumpet, and said, We have no part in David, neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse: every man to his tents, O Israel.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn ọkunrin Israeli si lọ kuro lẹhin Dafidi, nwọn si ntọ Ṣeba ọmọ Bikri lẹhin: ṣugbọn awọn ọkunrin Juda si fi ara mọ́ ọba wọn lati odo Jordani wá titi o fi de Jerusalemu.
entries.en: So every man of Israel went up from after David, and followed Sheba the son of Bichri: but the men of Judah clave unto their king, from Jordan even to Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Dafidi si wá si ile rẹ̀ ni Jerusalemu; ọba si mu awọn obinrin mẹwa ti iṣe alè rẹ̀, awọn ti o ti fi silẹ lati ma ṣọ́ ile. O si há wọn mọ ile, o si mbọ́ wọn, ṣugbọn kò si tun wọle tọ̀ wọn mọ a si se wọn mọ titi di ọjọ ikú wọn, nwọn si wà bi opo.
entries.en: And David came to his house at Jerusalem; and the king took the ten women his concubines, whom he had left to keep the house, and put them in ward, and fed them, but went not in unto them. So they were shut up unto the day of their death, living in widowhood.

entries.yo: Ọba si wi fun Amasa pe, Pe awọn ọkunrin Juda fun mi niwọn ijọ mẹta oni, ki iwọ na ki o si wá nihinyi.
entries.en: Then said the king to Amasa, Assemble me the men of Judah within three days, and be thou here present.

entries.yo: Amasa si lọ lati pe awọn ọkunrin Juda: ṣugbọn o si duro pẹ jù akoko ti o fi fun u.
entries.en: So Amasa went to assemble the men of Judah: but he tarried longer than the set time which he had appointed him.

entries.yo: Dafidi si wi fun Abiṣai pe, Nisisiyi Ṣeba ọmọ Bikri yio ṣe wa ni ibi jù ti Absalomu lọ; iwọ mu awọn iranṣẹ Oluwa rẹ, ki o si lepa rẹ̀, ki o ma ba ri ilu olodi wọ̀, ki o si bọ́ lọwọ wa,
entries.en: And David said to Abishai, Now shall Sheba the son of Bichri do us more harm than did Absalom: take thou thy lord's servants, and pursue after him, lest he get him fenced cities, and escape us.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọkunrin Joabu si jade tọ̀ ọ lọ, ati awọn Kereti, ati awọn Peleti, ati gbogbo awọn ọkunrin alagbara: nwọn si ti Jerusalemu jade lọ, lati lepa Ṣeba ọmọ Bikri.
entries.en: And there went out after him Joab's men, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, and all the mighty men: and they went out of Jerusalem, to pursue after Sheba the son of Bichri.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn de ibi okuta nla ti o wà ni Gibeoni, Amasa si ṣaju wọn. Joabu si di amùre si agbada rẹ̀ ti o wọ̀, o si sán idà rẹ̀ mọ idi, ninu akọ̀ rẹ̀, bi o si ti nlọ, o yọ jade.
entries.en: When they were at the great stone which is in Gibeon, Amasa went before them. And Joab's garment that he had put on was girded unto him, and upon it a girdle with a sword fastened upon his loins in the sheath thereof; and as he went forth it fell out.

entries.yo: Joabu si bi Amasa lere pe, Ara rẹ ko le bi, iwọ arakunrin mi? Joabu si na ọwọ́ ọtún rẹ̀ di Amasa ni irungbọ̀n mu lati fi ẹnu kò o li ẹnu.
entries.en: And Joab said to Amasa, Art thou in health, my brother? And Joab took Amasa by the beard with the right hand to kiss him.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Amasa ko si kiyesi idà ti mbẹ li ọwọ́ Joabu: bẹ̃li on si fi gun u li ẽgun ìha ikarun, ifun rẹ̀ si tú dá silẹ, on kò si tun gún u mọ́; o si kú. Joabu ati Abiṣai arakunrin rẹ̀ si lepa Ṣeba ọmọ Bikri.
entries.en: But Amasa took no heed to the sword that was in Joab's hand: so he smote him therewith in the fifth rib, and shed out his bowels to the ground, and struck him not again; and he died. So Joab and Abishai his brother pursued after Sheba the son of Bichri.

entries.yo: Ọkan ninu awọn ọdọmọdekunrin ti o wà lọdọ Joabu si duro tì i, o si wipe, Tali ẹni ti o ba fẹran Joabu? tali o si nṣe ti Dafidi, ki o ma tọ̀ Joabu lẹhin.
entries.en: And one of Joab's men stood by him, and said, He that favoureth Joab, and he that is for David, let him go after Joab.

entries.yo: Amasa si nyira ninu ẹ̀jẹ larin ọ̀na. ọkunrin na si ri pe gbogbo enia si duro tì i, o si gbe Amasa kuro loju ọ̀na lọ sinu ìgbẹ́, o si fi aṣọ bò o, nigbati o ti ri pe ẹnikẹni ti o ba de ọdọ rẹ̀, a duro.
entries.en: And Amasa wallowed in blood in the midst of the highway. And when the man saw that all the people stood still, he removed Amasa out of the highway into the field, and cast a cloth upon him, when he saw that every one that came by him stood still.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si gbe e kuro li oju ọ̀na, gbogbo enia si tọ̀ Joabu lẹhin lati lepa Ṣeba ọmọ Bikri.
entries.en: When he was removed out of the highway, all the people went on after Joab, to pursue after Sheba the son of Bichri.

entries.yo: On kọja ninu gbogbo ẹya Israeli si Abeli ati si Betmaaka, ati gbogbo awọn ara Beriti; nwọn si kó ara wọn jọ, nwọn si tọ̀ ọ lẹhin pẹlu.
entries.en: And he went through all the tribes of Israel unto Abel, and to Beth-maachah, and all the Berites: and they were gathered together, and went also after him.

entries.yo: Nwọn wá, nwọn si do tì i ni Abeli ti Betmaaka, nwọn si mọdi tì ilu na, odi na si duro ti odi ilu na: gbogbo enia ti mbẹ lọdọ Joabu si ngbiyanju lati wó ogiri na lulẹ.
entries.en: And they came and besieged him in Abel of Beth-maachah, and they cast up a bank against the city, and it stood in the trench: and all the people that were with Joab battered the wall, to throw it down.

entries.yo: Obinrin ọlọgbọ́n kan si kigbe soke lati ilu na wá, pe, Fetisilẹ, fetisilẹ, emi bẹ̀ nyin, sọ fun Joabu pe, Sunmọ ihinyi emi o si ba ọ sọ̀rọ.
entries.en: Then cried a wise woman out of the city, Hear, hear; say, I pray you, unto Joab, Come near hither, that I may speak with thee.

entries.yo: Nigbati on si sunmọ ọdọ rẹ̀, obinrin na si wipe, Iwọ ni Joabu bi? on si dahùn wipe, Emi na ni. Obinrin na si wi fun u pe, Gbọ́ ọ̀rọ iranṣẹbinrin rẹ. On si dahun wipe, Emi ngbọ́.
entries.en: And when he was come near unto her, the woman said, Art thou Joab? And he answered, I am he. Then she said unto him, Hear the words of thine handmaid. And he answered, I do hear.

entries.yo: O si sọ̀rọ, wipe, Nwọn ti nwi ṣaju pe niti bibere, nwọn o bere ni Abeli: bẹ̃ni nwọn si pari ọ̀ran na.
entries.en: Then she spake, saying, They were wont to speak in old time, saying, They shall surely ask counsel at Abel: and so they ended the matter.

entries.yo: Emi li ọkan ninu awọn ẹni alafia ati olõtọ ni Israeli: iwọ nwá ọ̀na lati pa ilu kan run ti o jẹ iyá ni Israeli: ẽṣe ti iwọ o fi gbe ini Oluwa mì?
entries.en: I am one of them that are peaceable and faithful in Israel: thou seekest to destroy a city and a mother in Israel: why wilt thou swallow up the inheritance of the LORD?

entries.yo: Joabu si dahùn wipe, Ki a má ri i, ki a má ri i lọdọ mi pe emi gbé mì tabi emi sì parun.
entries.en: And Joab answered and said, Far be it, far be it from me, that I should swallow up or destroy.

entries.yo: Ọràn na kò ri bẹ̃; ṣugbọn ọkunrin kan lati oke Efraimu, ti orukọ rẹ̀ njẹ Ṣeba, ọmọ Bikri, li o gbe ọwọ́ rẹ̀ soke si ọba, ani si Dafidi: fi on nikanṣoṣo le wa lọwọ, emi o si fi ilu silẹ. Obinrin na si wi fun Joabu pe, Wõ, ori rẹ̀ li a o si sọ si ọ lati inu odi wá.
entries.en: The matter is not so: but a man of mount Ephraim, Sheba the son of Bichri by name, hath lifted up his hand against the king, even against David: deliver him only, and I will depart from the city. And the woman said unto Joab, Behold, his head shall be thrown to thee over the wall.

entries.yo: Obinrin na si mu ìmọran rẹ̀ tọ gbogbo awọn enia na. Nwọn si bẹ́ Ṣeba ọmọ Bikri li ori, nwọn si sọ ọ si Joabu. On si fún ipè, nwọn si tuka kuro ni ilu na, olukuluku si agọ rẹ̀. Joabu si pada lọ si Jerusalemu ati sọdọ ọba.
entries.en: Then the woman went unto all the people in her wisdom. And they cut off the head of Sheba the son of Bichri, and cast it out to Joab. And he blew a trumpet, and they retired from the city, every man to his tent. And Joab returned to Jerusalem unto the king.

entries.yo: Joabu si li olori gbogbo ogun Israeli: Benaiah ọmọ Jehoiada si jẹ olori awọn Kereti, ati olori awọn Peleti:
entries.en: Now Joab was over all the host of Israel: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and over the Pelethites:

entries.yo: Adoramu si jẹ olori awọn agbowodè: Jehoṣafati ọmọ Ahiludi si jẹ akọwe nkan ti o ṣe ni ilu:
entries.en: And Adoram was over the tribute: and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder:

entries.yo: Ṣefa si jẹ akọwe: Sadoku ati Abiatari si li awọn alufa.
entries.en: And Sheva was scribe: and Zadok and Abiathar were the priests:

entries.yo: Ira pẹlu, ara Jairi ni nṣe alufa lọdọ Dafidi.
entries.en: And Ira also the Jairite was a chief ruler about David.

entries.yo: IYAN kan si mu ni ọjọ Dafidi li ọdun mẹta, lati ọdun de ọdun; Dafidi si bere lọdọ Oluwa, Oluwa si wipe, Nitori ti Saulu ni, ati nitori ile rẹ̀ ti o kún fun ẹ̀jẹ̀, nitoripe o pa awọn ara Gibeoni.
entries.en: Then there was a famine in the days of David three years, year after year; and David inquired of the LORD. And the LORD answered, It is for Saul, and for his bloody house, because he slew the Gibeonites.

entries.yo: Ọba si pe awọn ara Gibeoni, o si ba wọn sọ̀rọ: awọn ara Gibeoni ki iṣe ọkan ninu awọn ọmọ Israeli, ṣugbọn nwọn jẹ awọn ti o kù ninu awọn ọmọ Amori; awọn ọmọ Israeli si ti bura fun wọn: Saulu si nwá ọ̀na ati pa wọn ni itara rẹ̀ fun awọn ọmọ Israeli ati Juda.
entries.en: And the king called the Gibeonites, and said unto them; (now the Gibeonites were not of the children of Israel, but of the remnant of the Amorites; and the children of Israel had sworn unto them: and Saul sought to slay them in his zeal to the children of Israel and Judah.)

entries.yo: Dafidi si bi awọn ara Gibeoni lere pe, Kili emi o ṣe fun nyin? ati kili emi o fi ṣe etutu, ki ẹnyin ki o le sure fun ilẹ ini Oluwa?
entries.en: Wherefore David said unto the Gibeonites, What shall I do for you? and wherewith shall I make the atonement, that ye may bless the inheritance of the LORD?

entries.yo: Awọn ara Gibeoni si wi fun u pe, Awa kò ni fi fadaka tabi wura ti Saulu ati ti idile rẹ̀ ṣe, bẹ̃ni a kò si fẹ ki ẹ pa ẹnikan ni Israeli. O si wipe, eyi ti ẹnyin ba wi li emi o ṣe.
entries.en: And the Gibeonites said unto him, We will have no silver nor gold of Saul, nor of his house; neither for us shalt thou kill any man in Israel. And he said, What ye shall say, that will I do for you.

entries.yo: Nwọn si wi fun ọba pe, ọkunrin ti o run wa, ti o si rò lati pa wa rẹ́ ki a má kù nibikibi ninu gbogbo agbegbe Israeli.
entries.en: And they answered the king, The man that consumed us, and that devised against us that we should be destroyed from remaining in any of the coasts of Israel,

entries.yo: Mu ọkunrin meje ninu awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ fun wa, awa o si so wọn rọ̀ fun Oluwa ni Gibea ti Saulu ẹniti Oluwa ti yàn. Ọba si wipe, Emi o fi wọn fun nyin.
entries.en: Let seven men of his sons be delivered unto us, and we will hang them up unto the LORD in Gibeah of Saul, whom the LORD did choose. And the king said, I will give them.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Ọba dá Mefiboṣeti si, ọmọ Jonatani, ọmọ Saulu, nitori ibura Oluwa ti o wà larin wọn, lãrin Dafidi ati Jonatani ọmọ Saulu.
entries.en: But the king spared Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan the son of Saul, because of the LORD's oath that was between them, between David and Jonathan the son of Saul.

entries.yo: Ọba si mu awọn ọmọkunrin mejeji ti Rispa ọmọbinrin Aia bi fun Saulu, ani Armoni ati Mefiboṣeti: ati awọn ọmọkunrin mararun ti Merabu, ọmọbinrin Saulu, awọn ti o bi fun Adrieli ọmọ Barsillai ara Meholati.
entries.en: But the king took the two sons of Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, whom she bare unto Saul, Armoni and Mephibosheth; and the five sons of Michal the daughter of Saul, whom she brought up for Adriel the son of Barzillai the Meholathite:

entries.yo: On si fi wọn le awọn ara Gibea lọwọ, nwọn si so wọn rọ̀ lori oke niwaju Oluwa: awọn mejeje si ṣubu lẹ̃kan, a si pa wọn ni igbà ikore, ni ibẹrẹ ikore ọka-barle.
entries.en: And he delivered them into the hands of the Gibeonites, and they hanged them in the hill before the LORD: and they fell all seven together, and were put to death in the days of harvest, in the first days, in the beginning of barley harvest.

entries.yo: Rispa ọmọbinrin Aia si mu aṣọ ọfọ̀ kan, o si tẹ́ ẹ fun ara rẹ̀ lori àpata, ni ibẹrẹ ikore, titi omi fi dà si wọn lara lati ọrun wá, kò si jẹ ki awọn ẹiyẹ oju ọrun bà le wọn li ọsan, tabi awọn ẹranko igbẹ li oru.
entries.en: And Rizpah the daughter of Aiah took sackcloth, and spread it for her upon the rock, from the beginning of harvest until water dropped upon them out of heaven, and suffered neither the birds of the air to rest on them by day, nor the beasts of the field by night.

entries.yo: A si rò eyi, ti Rispa ọmọbinrin Aia obinrin Saulu ṣe, fun Dafidi.
entries.en: And it was told David what Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, the concubine of Saul, had done.

entries.yo: Dafidi si lọ o si ko egungun Saulu, ati egungun Jonatani ọmọ rẹ̀ kuro lọdọ awọn ọkunrin Jabeṣi-gileadi, awọn ti o ti ji wọn kuro ni ita Betṣani, nibiti awọn Filistini gbe so wọn rọ̀, nigbati awọn Filistini pa Saulu ni Gilboa.
entries.en: And David went and took the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son from the men of Jabesh-gilead, which had stolen them from the street of Beth-shan, where the Philistines had hanged them, when the Philistines had slain Saul in Gilboa:

entries.yo: On si mu egungun Saulu ati egungun Jonatani ọmọ rẹ̀ lati ibẹ na wá; nwọn si ko egungun awọn ti a ti so rọ̀ jọ.
entries.en: And he brought up from thence the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son; and they gathered the bones of them that were hanged.

entries.yo: Nwọn si sin egungun Saulu ati ti Jonatani ọmọ rẹ̀ ni ilẹ Benjamini, ni Sela, ninu iboji Kiṣi baba rẹ̀: nwọn si ṣe gbogbo eyi ti ọba pa li aṣẹ: lẹhin eyini Ọlọrun si gbà ẹbẹ nitori ilẹ na.
entries.en: And the bones of Saul and Jonathan his son buried they in the country of Benjamin in Zelah, in the sepulchre of Kish his father: and they performed all that the king commanded. And after that God was intreated for the land.

entries.yo: Ogun si tun wà larin awọn Filistini ati Israeli; Dafidi si sọkalẹ, ati awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀ pẹlu rẹ̀, o si ba awọn Filistini jà: o si rẹ̀ Dafidi.
entries.en: Moreover the Philistines had yet war again with Israel; and David went down, and his servants with him, and fought against the Philistines: and David waxed faint.

entries.yo: Iṣbi-benobu si jẹ ọkan ninu awọn òmirán, ẹniti òṣuwọn ọ̀kọ rẹ̀ jẹ ọdunrun ṣekeli idẹ, on si sán idà titun, o si gbero lati pa Dafidi.
entries.en: And Ishbi-benob, which was of the sons of the giant, the weight of whose spear weighed three hundred shekels of brass in weight, he being girded with a new sword, thought to have slain David.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Abiṣai ọmọ Seruia si ràn a lọwọ, o si kọlu Filistini na, o si pa a. Nigbana ni awọn iranṣẹ Dafidi si bura fun u, pe, Iwọ kì yio si tun ba wa jade lọ si ibi ija mọ, ki iwọ ki o máṣe pa iná Israeli.
entries.en: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah succoured him, and smote the Philistine, and killed him. Then the men of David sware unto him, saying, Thou shalt go no more out with us to battle, that thou quench not the light of Israel.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, lẹhin eyi, ija kan si tun wà lãrin awọn Israeli ati awọn Filistini ni Gobu: nigbana ni Sibbekai ara Huṣa pa Safu, ẹniti iṣe ọkan ninu awọn òmirán.
entries.en: And it came to pass after this, that there was again a battle with the Philistines at Gob: then Sibbechai the Hushathite slew Saph, which was of the sons of the giant.

entries.yo: Ija kan si tun wà ni Gobu lãrin awọn Israeli ati awọn Filistini, Elhanani ọmọ Jairi ara Betlehemu si pa arakunrin Goliati ara Gati, ẹniti ọpá ọ̀kọ rẹ̀ dabi idabú igi ti a fi hun aṣọ.
entries.en: And there was again a battle in Gob with the Philistines, where Elhanan the son of Jaare-oregim, a Bethlehemite, slew the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver's beam.

entries.yo: Ija kan si tun wà ni Gati, ọkunrin kan si wà ti o gùn pupọ, o si ni ika mẹfa li ọwọ́ kan, ati ọmọ-ẹsẹ mẹfa li ẹsẹ kan, apapọ̀ rẹ̀ si jẹ mẹrinlelogun; a si bi on na li òmirán.
entries.en: And there was yet a battle in Gath, where was a man of great stature, that had on every hand six fingers, and on every foot six toes, four and twenty in number; and he also was born to the giant.

entries.yo: Nigbati on si pe Israeli ni ijà, Jonatani ọmọ Ṣimei arakunrin Dafidi si pa a.
entries.en: And when he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea the brother of David slew him.

entries.yo: Awọn mẹrẹrin wọnyi li a bi li òmirán ni Gati, nwọn si ti ọwọ́ Dafidi ṣubu, ati ọwọ́ awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: These four were born to the giant in Gath, and fell by the hand of David, and by the hand of his servants.

entries.yo: DAFIDI si sọ ọ̀rọ orin yi si Oluwa li ọjọ ti Oluwa gbà a kuro li ọwọ́ gbogbo awọn ọta rẹ̀, ati kuro li ọwọ́ Saulu.
entries.en: And David spake unto the LORD the words of this song in the day that the LORD had delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies, and out of the hand of Saul:

entries.yo: O si wipe, Oluwa li apata mi; ati odi mi, ati olugbala mi;
entries.en: And he said, The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer;

entries.yo: Ọlọrun apata mi; emi o gbẹkẹle e: asà mi, ati iwo igbala mi, ibi isadi giga mi, ati ibi ãbò mi, olugbala mi; iwọ li o ti gbà mi kuro lọwọ agbara.
entries.en: The God of my rock; in him will I trust: he is my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower, and my refuge, my saviour; thou savest me from violence.

entries.yo: Emi o kepe Oluwa, ti o yẹ lati ma yìn: a o si gbà mi lọwọ awọn ọta mi.
entries.en: I will call on the LORD, who is worthy to be praised: so shall I be saved from mine enemies.

entries.yo: Nigbati ibilu irora ikú yi mi ka kiri, ti awọn iṣàn enia buburu dẹruba mi;
entries.en: When the waves of death compassed me, the floods of ungodly men made me afraid;

entries.yo: Ọjá ipo-okú yi mi ka kiri; ikẹkun ikú ti ṣaju mi.
entries.en: The sorrows of hell compassed me about; the snares of death prevented me;

entries.yo: Ninu ipọnju mi emi ke pe Oluwa, emi si gbe ohùn mi soke si Ọlọrun mi: o si gbohùn mi lati tempili rẹ̀ wá, igbe mi si wọ̀ eti rẹ̀.
entries.en: In my distress I called upon the LORD, and cried to my God: and he did hear my voice out of his temple, and my cry did enter into his ears.

entries.yo: Ilẹ si mì, o si wariri; ipilẹ ọrun wariri, o si mì, nitoriti o binu.
entries.en: Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations of heaven moved and shook, because he was wroth.

entries.yo: Ẽfin si jade lati iho-imu rẹ̀ wa, ina lati ẹnu rẹ̀ wa si njonirun, ẹyín si nràn nipasẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it.

entries.yo: O tẹ ori ọrun ba pẹlu, o si sọkalẹ; okunkun biri-biri si mbẹ li atẹlẹsẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: He bowed the heavens also, and came down; and darkness was under his feet.

entries.yo: O si gun ori kerubu, o si fò: a si ri i lori iyẹ afẹfẹ.
entries.en: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: and he was seen upon the wings of the wind.

entries.yo: O si fi okunkun ṣe ibujoko yi ara rẹ̀ ka, ati agbajọ omi, ani iṣududu awọ sanma.
entries.en: And he made darkness pavilions round about him, dark waters, and thick clouds of the skies.

entries.yo: Nipasẹ imọlẹ iwaju rẹ̀ ẹyin-iná ràn.
entries.en: Through the brightness before him were coals of fire kindled.

entries.yo: Oluwa san ãra lati ọrun wá, ọga-ogo julọ si fọhùn rẹ̀.
entries.en: The LORD thundered from heaven, and the most High uttered his voice.

entries.yo: O si ta ọfà, o si tú wọn ka; o kọ màna-mána, o si ṣẹ wọn.
entries.en: And he sent out arrows, and scattered them; lightning, and discomfited them.

entries.yo: Iṣàn ibu okun si fi ara hàn, ipilẹ aiye fi ara hàn, nipa ibawi Oluwa, nipa fifún ẽmi ihò imu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the channels of the sea appeared, the foundations of the world were discovered, at the rebuking of the LORD, at the blast of the breath of his nostrils.

entries.yo: O ranṣẹ lati oke wá, o mu mi; o fà mi jade lati inu omi nla wá.
entries.en: He sent from above, he took me; he drew me out of many waters;

entries.yo: O gbà mi lọwọ ọta mi alagbara, lọwọ awọn ti o korira mi: nitoripe nwọn li agbara jù mi lọ.
entries.en: He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them that hated me: for they were too strong for me.

entries.yo: Nwọn ṣaju mi li ọjọ ipọnju mi; ṣugbọn Oluwa li alafẹhinti mi.
entries.en: They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but the LORD was my stay.

entries.yo: O si mu mi wá si àye nla: o gbà mi, nitoriti inu rẹ̀ dùn si mi.
entries.en: He brought me forth also into a large place: he delivered me, because he delighted in me.

entries.yo: Oluwa san a fun mi gẹgẹ bi ododo mi: o si san a fun mi gẹgẹ bi mimọ́ ọwọ́ mi.
entries.en: The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness: according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.

entries.yo: Nitoripe emi pa ọ̀na Oluwa mọ, emi kò si fi ìwa buburu yapa kuro lọdọ Ọlọrun mi.
entries.en: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and have not wickedly departed from my God.

entries.yo: Nitoripe gbogbo idajọ rẹ̀ li o wà niwaju mi: ati niti ofin rẹ̀, emi kò si yapa kuro ninu wọn.
entries.en: For all his judgments were before me: and as for his statutes, I did not depart from them.

entries.yo: Emi si wà ninu iwà-titọ si i, emi si pa ara mi mọ kuro ninu ẹ̀ṣẹ mi.
entries.en: I was also upright before him, and have kept myself from mine iniquity.

entries.yo: Oluwa si san a fun mi gẹgẹ bi ododo mi, gẹgẹ bi ìwa-mimọ́ mi niwaju rẹ̀.
entries.en: Therefore the LORD hath recompensed me according to my righteousness; according to my cleanness in his eye sight.

entries.yo: Fun alãnu ni iwọ o fi ara rẹ hàn li alãnu, ati fun ẹni-iduro-ṣinṣin li ododo ni iwọ o fi ara rẹ hàn ni iduro-ṣinṣin li ododo.
entries.en: With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful, and with the upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright.

entries.yo: Fun oninu-funfun ni iwọ o fi ara rẹ hàn ni funfun: ati fun ẹni-wiwọ ni iwọ o fi ara rẹ hàn ni wiwọ.
entries.en: With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure; and with the froward thou wilt shew thyself unsavoury.

entries.yo: Awọn enia ti o wà ninu iyà ni iwọ o si gbàla: ṣugbọn oju rẹ wà lara awọn agberaga, lati rẹ̀ wọn silẹ.
entries.en: And the afflicted people thou wilt save: but thine eyes are upon the haughty, that thou mayest bring them down.

entries.yo: Nitori iwọ ni imọlẹ mi, Oluwa: Oluwa yio si sọ okunkun mi di imọlẹ.
entries.en: For thou art my lamp, O LORD: and the LORD will lighten my darkness.

entries.yo: Nitori nipa rẹ li emi ti là arin ogun kọja: nipa Ọlọrun mi emi ti fò odi kan.
entries.en: For by thee I have run through a troop: by my God have I leaped over a wall.

entries.yo: Pipe li Ọlọrun li ọ̀na rẹ̀; ọ̀rọ Oluwa li a ti dan wò: on si ni asà fun gbogbo awọn ti o gbẹkẹle e.
entries.en: As for God, his way is perfect; the word of the LORD is tried: he is a buckler to all them that trust in him.

entries.yo: Nitori tani iṣe Ọlọrun, bikoṣe Oluwa? tabi tani iṣe apáta, bikoṣe Ọlọrun wa?
entries.en: For who is God, save the LORD? and who is a rock, save our God?

entries.yo: Ọlọrun alagbara li o fun mi li agbara, o si sọ ọ̀na mi di titọ́.
entries.en: God is my strength and power: and he maketh my way perfect.

entries.yo: O ṣe ẹsẹ mi bi ẹsẹ agbọnrin: o si mu mi duro ni ibi giga mi.
entries.en: He maketh my feet like hinds' feet: and setteth me upon my high places.

entries.yo: O kọ ọwọ́ mi ni ogun jijà; tobẹ̃ ti apá mi fà ọrun idẹ.
entries.en: He teacheth my hands to war; so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms.

entries.yo: Iwọ si ti fun mi li asà igbala rẹ: irẹlẹ rẹ si ti sọ mi di nla.
entries.en: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy gentleness hath made me great.

entries.yo: Iwọ si sọ itẹlẹ mi di nla li abẹ mi; tobẹ̃ ti ẹsẹ mi kò fi yọ̀.
entries.en: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me; so that my feet did not slip.

entries.yo: Emi ti lepa awọn ọta mi, emi si ti run wọn; emi kò pẹhinda titi emi fi run wọn.
entries.en: I have pursued mine enemies, and destroyed them; and turned not again until I had consumed them.

entries.yo: Emi ti pa wọn run, emi si ti fọ́ wọn, nwọn kò si le dide mọ: nwọn ṣubu labẹ ẹsẹ mi.
entries.en: And I have consumed them, and wounded them, that they could not arise: yea, they are fallen under my feet.

entries.yo: Iwọ si ti fi agbara di mi li amure fun ijà: awọn ti o ti dide si mi ni iwọ si ti tẹ̀ li ori ba fun mi.
entries.en: For thou hast girded me with strength to battle: them that rose up against me hast thou subdued under me.

entries.yo: Iwọ si mu awọn ọta mi pẹhindà fun mi, emi si pa awọn ti o korira mi run.
entries.en: Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies, that I might destroy them that hate me.

entries.yo: Nwọn wò, ṣugbọn kò si ẹnikan lati gbà wọn; nwọn wò Oluwa, ṣugbọn kò da wọn lohùn.
entries.en: They looked, but there was none to save; even unto the LORD, but he answered them not.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni emi si gun wọn wẹwẹ bi erupẹ ilẹ, emi si tẹ̀ wọn mọlẹ bi ẹrẹ̀ ita, emi si tẹ wọn gbọrọ.
entries.en: Then did I beat them as small as the dust of the earth, I did stamp them as the mire of the street, and did spread them abroad.

entries.yo: Iwọ si gbà mi kuro lọwọ ijà awọn enia mi, iwọ pa mi mọ ki emi ki o le ṣe olori awọn ajeji orilẹ-ède: awọn enia ti emi kò ti mọ̀ yio ma sìn mi.
entries.en: Thou also hast delivered me from the strivings of my people, thou hast kept me to be head of the heathen: a people which I knew not shall serve me.

entries.yo: Awọn alejo yio fi ẹ̀tan tẹriba fun mi: bi nwọn ba ti gbọ́ iró mi, nwọn o si gbọ́ ti emi.
entries.en: Strangers shall submit themselves unto me: as soon as they hear, they shall be obedient unto me.

entries.yo: Ìpaiyà yio dé bá awọn alejo, nwọn o si ma bẹ̀ru nibi kọ́lọfin wọn.
entries.en: Strangers shall fade away, and they shall be afraid out of their close places.

entries.yo: Oluwa mbẹ; olubukun si ni apata mi: gbigbega si li Ọlọrun apata igbala mi.
entries.en: The LORD liveth; and blessed be my rock; and exalted be the God of the rock of my salvation.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun li ẹniti ngbẹsan mi, ati ẹniti nrẹ̀ awọn enia silẹ labẹ mi.
entries.en: It is God that avengeth me, and that bringeth down the people under me,

entries.yo: On ni o gbà mi kuro lọwọ awọn ọta mi: iwọ si gbe mi soke ju awọn ti o dide si mi lọ: iwọ si gbà mi kuro lọwọ ọkunrin ìwa agbara.
entries.en: And that bringeth me forth from mine enemies: thou also hast lifted me up on high above them that rose up against me: thou hast delivered me from the violent man.

entries.yo: Nitorina emi o fi ọpẹ fun ọ. Oluwa, larin awọn ajeji orilẹ-ède: emi o si kọrin si orukọ rẹ.
entries.en: Therefore I will give thanks unto thee, O LORD, among the heathen, and I will sing praises unto thy name.

entries.yo: On ni ile-iṣọ igbala fun ọba rẹ̀: o si fi ãnu hàn fun ẹni-ami-ororo rẹ̀; fun Dafidi, ati fun iru-ọmọ rẹ̀ titi lailai.
entries.en: He is the tower of salvation for his king: and sheweth mercy to his anointed, unto David, and to his seed for evermore.

entries.yo: WỌNYI si li ọ̀rọ ikẹhin Dafidi. Dafidi ọmọ Jesse, ani ọkunrin ti a ti gbega, ẹni-ami-ororo Ọlọrun Jakobu, ati olorin didùn Israeli wi pe,
entries.en: Now these be the last words of David. David the son of Jesse said, and the man who was raised up on high, the anointed of the God of Jacob, and the sweet psalmist of Israel, said,

entries.yo: Ẹmi Oluwa sọ ọ̀rọ nipa mi, ọ̀rọ rẹ̀ si mbẹ li ahọn mi.
entries.en: The Spirit of the LORD spake by me, and his word was in my tongue.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun Israeli ní, Apata Israeli sọ fun mi pe, Ẹnikan ti nṣe alakoso enia lododo, ti nṣakoso ni ibẹru Ọlọrun.
entries.en: The God of Israel said, the Rock of Israel spake to me, He that ruleth over men must be just, ruling in the fear of God.

entries.yo: Yio si dabi imọlẹ owurọ nigbati õrun ba là, owurọ ti kò ni ikũku, nigbati koriko tutu ba hù lati ilẹ wa nipa itanṣan lẹhin òjo.
entries.en: And he shall be as the light of the morning, when the sun riseth, even a morning without clouds; as the tender grass springing out of the earth by clear shining after rain.

entries.yo: Lõtọ ile mi kò ri bẹ niwaju Ọlọrun, ṣugbọn o ti ba mi da majẹmu ainipẹkun, ti a tunṣe ninu ohun gbogbo, ti a si pamọ: nitoripe gbogbo eyi ni igbala mi, ati gbogbo ifẹ mi, ile mi kò le ṣe ki o ma dagbà?
entries.en: Although my house be not so with God; yet he hath made with me an everlasting covenant, ordered in all things, and sure: for this is all my salvation, and all my desire, although he make it not to grow.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn gbogbo awọn ọmọ Beliali yio dabi ẹgún ẹ̀wọn ti a ṣatì, nitoripe a kò le fi ọwọ́ kó wọn.
entries.en: But the sons of Belial shall be all of them as thorns thrust away, because they cannot be taken with hands:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ọkunrin ti yio tọ́ wọn yio fi irin ati ọpa ọ̀kọ sagbàra yi ara rẹ̀ ka: nwọn o si jona lulu nibi kanna.
entries.en: But the man that shall touch them must be fenced with iron and the staff of a spear; and they shall be utterly burned with fire in the same place.

entries.yo: Wọnyi si li orukọ awọn ọkunrin alagbara ti Dafidi ni: ẹniti o joko ni ibujoko Takmoni ni olori awọn balogun, on si ni Adino Esniti ti o pa ẹgbẹ̀rin enia lẹ̃kan.
entries.en: These be the names of the mighty men whom David had: The Tachmonite that sat in the seat, chief among the captains; the same was Adino the Eznite: he lift up his spear against eight hundred, whom he slew at one time.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o tẹ̀le e ni Eleasari ọmọ Dodo ara Ahohi, ọkan ninu awọn alagbara ọkunrin mẹta ti o wà pẹlu Dafidi, nigbati nwọn pe awọn Filistini ni ijà, awọn ti o kó ara wọn jọ si ibẹ lati jà, awọn ọmọkunrin Israeli si ti lọ kuro:
entries.en: And after him was Eleazar the son of Dodo the Ahohite, one of the three mighty men with David, when they defied the Philistines that were there gathered together to battle, and the men of Israel were gone away:

entries.yo: On si dide, o si kọlù awọn Filistini titi ọwọ́ fi kún u, ọwọ́ rẹ̀ si lẹ̀ mọ idà: Oluwa si ṣiṣẹ igbala nla li ọjọ na; awọn enia si yipada lẹhin rẹ̀ lati ko ikogun.
entries.en: He arose, and smote the Philistines until his hand was weary, and his hand clave unto the sword: and the LORD wrought a great victory that day; and the people returned after him only to spoil.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o tẹ̀le e ni Samma ọmọ Agee ará Harari. Awọn Filistini si ko ara wọn jọ lati piyẹ, oko kan si wà nibẹ ti o kún fun ẹwẹ: awọn enia si sa kuro niwaju awọn Filistini.
entries.en: And after him was Shammah the son of Agee the Hararite. And the Philistines were gathered together into a troop, where was a piece of ground full of lentiles: and the people fled from the Philistines.

entries.yo: O si duro lagbedemeji ilẹ na, o si gbà a silẹ, o si pa awọn Filistini: Oluwa si ṣe igbala nla kan.
entries.en: But he stood in the midst of the ground, and defended it, and slew the Philistines: and the LORD wrought a great victory.

entries.yo: Awọn mẹta ninu ọgbọ̀n olori si sọkalẹ, nwọn si tọ Dafidi wá li akoko ikore ninu iho Adullamu: ọ̀wọ́ awọn Filistini si do ni afonifoji Refaimu.
entries.en: And three of the thirty chief went down, and came to David in the harvest time unto the cave of Adullam: and the troop of the Philistines pitched in the valley of Rephaim.

entries.yo: Dafidi si wà ninu odi, ibudo awọn Filistini si wà ni Betlehemu nigbana.
entries.en: And David was then in an hold, and the garrison of the Philistines was then in Bethlehem.

entries.yo: Dafidi si k'ongbẹ, o wi bayi pe, Tani yio fun mi mu ninu omi kanga ti mbẹ ni Betlehemu, eyi ti o wà ni ihà ẹnu-bodè?
entries.en: And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me drink of the water of the well of Bethlehem, which is by the gate!

entries.yo: Awọn ọkunrin alagbara mẹta si la ogun awọn Filistini lọ, nwọn si fa omi lati inu kanga Betlehemu wá, eyi ti o wà ni iha ẹnu-bode, nwọn si mu tọ Dafidi wá: on kò si fẹ mu ninu rẹ̀, ṣugbọn o tú u silẹ fun Oluwa.
entries.en: And the three mighty men brake through the host of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem, that was by the gate, and took it, and brought it to David: nevertheless he would not drink thereof, but poured it out unto the LORD.

entries.yo: On si wipe, Ki a ma ri, Oluwa, ti emi o fi ṣe eyi; ṣe eyi li ẹ̀jẹ awọn ọkunrin ti o lọ ti awọn ti ẹmi wọn li ọwọ́? nitorina on kò si fẹ mu u. Nkan wọnyi li awọn ọkunrin alagbara mẹtẹta yi ṣe.
entries.en: And he said, Be it far from me, O LORD, that I should do this: is not this the blood of the men that went in jeopardy of their lives? therefore he would not drink it. These things did these three mighty men.

entries.yo: Abiṣai, arakunrin Joabu, ọmọ Seruia, on na ni pataki ninu awọn mẹta. On li o si gbe ọ̀kọ rẹ̀ soke si ọ̃dunrun enia, o si pa wọn, o si ni orukọ ninu awọn mẹtẹta.
entries.en: And Abishai, the brother of Joab, the son of Zeruiah, was chief among three. And he lifted up his spear against three hundred, and slew them, and had the name among three.

entries.yo: Ọlọlajulọ li on iṣe ninu awọn mẹtẹta: o si jẹ olori fun wọn: ṣugbọn on kò to awọn mẹta iṣaju.
entries.en: Was he not most honourable of three? therefore he was their captain: howbeit he attained not unto the first three.

entries.yo: Benaiah, ọmọ Jehoiada, ọmọ akọni ọkunrin kan ti Kabseeli, ẹniti o pọ̀ ni iṣe agbara, on pa awọn ọmọ Arieli meji ti Moabu; o sọkalẹ pẹlu o si pa kiniun kan ninu iho lakoko sno.
entries.en: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man, of Kabzeel, who had done many acts, he slew two lionlike men of Moab: he went down also and slew a lion in the midst of a pit in time of snow:

entries.yo: O si pa ara Egipti kan, ọkunrin ti o tó wò: ara Egipti na si ni ọ̀kọ kan li ọwọ́ rẹ̀: ṣugbọn on si sọkalẹ tọ̀ ọ lọ, ton ti ọ̀pá li ọwọ́, o si gba ọ̀kọ na lọwọ ara Egipti na, o si fi ọ̀kọ tirẹ̀ pa a.
entries.en: And he slew an Egyptian, a goodly man: and the Egyptian had a spear in his hand; but he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian's hand, and slew him with his own spear.

entries.yo: Nkan wọnyi ni Benaia ọmọ Jehoiada ṣe, o si li orukọ ninu awọn ọkunrin alagbara mẹta nì.
entries.en: These things did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and had the name among three mighty men.

entries.yo: Ninu awọn ọgbọ̀n na, on ṣe ọlọlajulọ, ṣugbọn on kò to awọn mẹta ti iṣaju. Dafidi si fi i ṣe igbimọ̀ rẹ̀.
entries.en: He was more honourable than the thirty, but he attained not to the first three. And David set him over his guard.

entries.yo: Asaheli arakunrin Joabu si jasi ọkan ninu awọn ọgbọ̀n na; Elhanani ọmọ Dodo ti Betlehemu.
entries.en: Asahel the brother of Joab was one of the thirty; Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,

entries.yo: Ṣamma ara Harodi, Elika ara Harodi.
entries.en: Shammah the Harodite, Elika the Harodite,

entries.yo: Helesi ara Palti, Ira ọmọ Ikkeṣi ara Tekoa,
entries.en: Helez the Paltite, Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite,

entries.yo: Abieseri ara Anetoti, Mebunnai Huṣatiti,
entries.en: Abiezer the Anethothite, Mebunnai the Hushathite,

entries.yo: Salmoni Ahohiti, Maharai ara Netofa,
entries.en: Zalmon the Ahohite, Maharai the Netophathite,

entries.yo: Helebu ọmọ Baana, ara Netofa, Ittai ọmọ Ribai ti Gibea ti awọn ọmọ Benjamini,
entries.en: Heleb the son of Baanah, a Netophathite, Ittai the son of Ribai out of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin,

entries.yo: Benaia ara Piratoni, Hiddai ti afonifoji,
entries.en: Benaiah the Pirathonite, Hiddai of the brooks of Gaash,

entries.yo: Abialboni ara Arba Asmafeti Barhumiti,
entries.en: Abi-albon the Arbathite, Azmaveth the Barhumite,

entries.yo: Eliahba ara Saalboni, Jaṣeni Gisoniti, Jonatani,
entries.en: Eliahba the Shaalbonite, of the sons of Jashen, Jonathan,

entries.yo: Ṣamma Harariti, Ahiamu ọmọ Ṣarari Harariti,
entries.en: Shammah the Hararite, Ahiam the son of Sharar the Hararite,

entries.yo: Elifeleti ọmọ Ahasbai, ọmọ ara Maakha, Eliamu ọmọ Ahitofeli ara Giloni,
entries.en: Eliphelet the son of Ahasbai, the son of the Maachathite, Eliam the son of Ahithophel the Gilonite,

entries.yo: Hesrai ara Kermeli, Paari ara Arba,
entries.en: Hezrai the Carmelite, Paarai the Arbite,

entries.yo: Igali ọmọ Natani ti Soba, Bani ara Gadi,
entries.en: Igal the son of Nathan of Zobah, Bani the Gadite,

entries.yo: Sekeli ara Ammoni, Nahari ara Beeroti, ẹniti o nru ihamọra Joabu ọmọ Seruia.
entries.en: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Beerothite, armourbearer to Joab the son of Zeruiah,

entries.yo: Ira ara Jattiri, Garebu ara Jattiri.
entries.en: Ira an Ithrite, Gareb an Ithrite,

entries.yo: Uria ara Hitti: gbogbo wọn jẹ mẹtadilogoji.
entries.en: Uriah the Hittite: thirty and seven in all.

entries.yo: IBINU Oluwa si ru si Israeli, o si tì Dafidi si wọn, pe, Lọ kà iye Israeli ati Juda.
entries.en: And again the anger of the LORD was kindled against Israel, and he moved David against them to say, Go, number Israel and Judah.

entries.yo: Ọba si wi fun Joabu olori ogun, ti mbẹ lọdọ rẹ̀ pe, Lọ nisisiyi si gbogbo ẹyà Israeli lati Dani titi de Beerṣeba, ki ẹ si kà iye awọn enia, ki emi le mọ̀ iye awọn enia na.
entries.en: For the king said to Joab the captain of the host, which was with him, Go now through all the tribes of Israel, from Dan even to Beer-sheba, and number ye the people, that I may know the number of the people.

entries.yo: Joabu si wi fun ọba pe, Ki Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ ki o fi kún iye awọn enia na, iyekiye ki o wu ki wọn jẹ, li ọrọrún; oju oluwa mi ọba yio si ri i: ṣugbọn ẽtiṣe ti oluwa mi ọba fi fẹ nkan yi?
entries.en: And Joab said unto the king, Now the LORD thy God add unto the people, how many soever they be, an hundredfold, and that the eyes of my lord the king may see it: but why doth my lord the king delight in this thing?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ọ̀rọ ọba si bori ti Joabu, ati ti awọn olori ogun. Joabu ati awọn olori ogun si jade lọ kuro niwaju ọba, lati lọ ika awọn enia Israeli.
entries.en: Notwithstanding the king's word prevailed against Joab, and against the captains of the host. And Joab and the captains of the host went out from the presence of the king, to number the people of Israel.

entries.yo: Nwọn si kọja odo Jordani, nwọn si pagọ ni Aroeri, ni iha apá ọtún ilu ti o wà lagbedemeji afonifoji Gadi, ati si iha Jaseri:
entries.en: And they passed over Jordan, and pitched in Aroer, on the right side of the city that lieth in the midst of the river of Gad, and toward Jazer:

entries.yo: Nwọn si wá si Gileadi, ati si ilẹ Tatimhodṣi; nwọn si wá si Dan-jaani ati yikakiri si Sidoni,
entries.en: Then they came to Gilead, and to the land of Tahtim-hodshi; and they came to Dan-jaan, and about to Zidon,

entries.yo: Nwọn si wá si ilu olodi Tire, ati si gbogbo ilu awọn Hifi, ati ti awọn ara Kenaani: nwọn si jade lọ siha gusu ti Juda, ani si Beerṣeba.
entries.en: And came to the strong hold of Tyre, and to all the cities of the Hibites, and of the Canaanites: and they went out to the south of Judah, even to Beer-sheba.

entries.yo: Nwọn si la gbogbo ilẹ na ja, nwọn si wá si Jerusalemu li opin oṣù kẹsan ati ogunjọ.
entries.en: So when they had gone through all the land, they came to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days.

entries.yo: Joabu si fi iye ti awọn enia na jasi le ọba lọwọ: o si jẹ oji ọkẹ ọkunrin alagbara ní Israeli, awọn onidà: awọn ọkunrin Juda si jẹ ọkẹ mẹ̃dọgbọn enia.
entries.en: And Joab gave up the sum of the number of the people unto the king: and there were in Israel eight hundred thousand valiant men that drew the sword; and the men of Judah were five hundred thousand men.

entries.yo: Ẹ̀rí ọkàn si bẹrẹ si da Dafidi lãmú lẹhin igbati o kà awọn enia na tan. Dafidi si wi fun Oluwa pe, Emi ṣẹ̀ gidigidi li eyi ti emi ṣe: ṣugbọn, emi bẹ̀ ọ, Oluwa, fi ẹ̀ṣẹ iranṣẹ rẹ jì i, nitoripe emi huwà aṣiwere gidigidi.
entries.en: And David's heart smote him after that he had numbered the people. And David said unto the LORD, I have sinned greatly in that I have done: and now, I beseech thee, O LORD, take away the iniquity of thy servant; for I have done very foolishly.

entries.yo: Dafidi si dide li owurọ, ọ̀rọ Oluwa si tọ Gadi wolĩ wá, ariran Dafidi, wipe,
entries.en: For when David was up in the morning, the word of the LORD came unto the prophet Gad, David's seer, saying,

entries.yo: Lọ, ki o si wi fun Dafidi pe, Bayi li Oluwa wi, emi fi nkan mẹta lọ̀ ọ; yàn ọkan ninu wọn, emi o si ṣe e si ọ.
entries.en: Go and say unto David, Thus saith the LORD, I offer thee three things; choose thee one of them, that I may do it unto thee.

entries.yo: Gadi si tọ Dafidi wá, o si bi i lere pe, Ki iyàn ọdun meje ki o tọ̀ ọ wá ni ilẹ rẹ bi? tabi ki iwọ ki o ma sá li oṣu mẹta niwaju awọn ọta rẹ, nigbati nwọn o ma le ọ? tabi ki arùn iparun ijọ mẹta ki o wá si ilẹ rẹ? rõ nisisiyi, ki o si mọ̀ èsi ti emi o mu pada tọ̀ ẹniti o rán mi.
entries.en: So Gad came to David, and told him, and said unto him, Shall seven years of famine come unto thee in thy land? or wilt thou flee three months before thine enemies, while they pursue thee? or that there be three days' pestilence in thy land? now advise, and see what answer I shall return to him that sent me.

entries.yo: Dafidi si wi fun Gadi pe, Iyọnu nla ba mi: jẹ ki a fi ara wa le Oluwa li ọwọ́; nitoripe ãnu rẹ̀ pọ̀: ki o má si ṣe fi mi le enia li ọwọ́.
entries.en: And David said unto Gad, I am in a great strait: let us fall now into the hand of the LORD; for his mercies are great: and let me not fall into the hand of man.

entries.yo: Oluwa si rán arùn iparun si Israeli lati owurọ̀ titi de akoko ti a da: ẹgbã marundilogoji enia si kú ninu awọn enia na lati Dani titi fi de Beerṣeba.
entries.en: So the LORD sent a pestilence upon Israel from the morning even to the time appointed: and there died of the people from Dan even to Beer-sheba seventy thousand men.

entries.yo: Nigbati angeli na si nawọ́ rẹ̀ si Jerusalemu lati pa a run, Oluwa si kãnu nitori ibi na, o si sọ fun angeli ti npa awọn enia na run pe, O to: da ọwọ́ rẹ duro wayi. Angeli Oluwa na si wà nibi ipaka Arauna ara Jebusi.
entries.en: And when the angel stretched out his hand upon Jerusalem to destroy it, the LORD repented him of the evil, and said to the angel that destroyed the people, It is enough: stay now thine hand. And the angel of the LORD was by the threshingplace of Araunah the Jebusite.

entries.yo: Dafidi si wi fun Oluwa nigbati o ri angeli ti nkọlu awọn enia pe, Wõ, emi ti ṣẹ̀, emi si ti huwà buburu: ṣugbọn awọn agutan wọnyi, kini nwọn ha ṣe? jẹ ki ọwọ́ rẹ, emi bẹ̀ ọ, ki o wà li ara mi, ati li ara idile baba mi.
entries.en: And David spake unto the LORD when he saw the angel that smote the people, and said, Lo, I have sinned, and I have done wickedly: but these sheep, what have they done? let thine hand, I pray thee, be against me, and against my father's house.
