entries.yo: Gadi si tọ Dafidi wá li ọjọ na, o si wi fun u pe, Goke, tẹ́ pẹpẹ kan fun Oluwa nibi ipaka Arauna ara Jebusi.
entries.en: And Gad came that day to David, and said unto him, Go up, rear an altar unto the LORD in the threshingfloor of Araunah the Jebusite.

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ Gadi, Dafidi si goke lọ gẹgẹ bi Oluwa ti pa a li aṣẹ.
entries.en: And David, according to the saying of Gad, went up as the LORD commanded.

entries.yo: Arauna si wò, o si ri ọba ati awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀ mbọ̀ wá ọdọ rẹ̀: Arauna si jade, o si wolẹ niwaju ọba o si doju rẹ̀ bolẹ.
entries.en: And Araunah looked, and saw the king and his servants coming on toward him: and Araunah went out, and bowed himself before the king on his face upon the ground.

entries.yo: Arauna si wipe, Nitori kili oluwa mi ọba ṣe tọ iranṣẹ rẹ̀ wá? Dafidi si dahùn pe, Lati rà ibi ipaka nì lọwọ rẹ, lati tẹ́ pẹpẹ kan fun Oluwa, ki arùn iparun ki o le da li ara awọn enia na.
entries.en: And Araunah said, Wherefore is my lord the king come to his servant? And David said, To buy the threshingfloor of thee, to build an altar unto the LORD, that the plague may be stayed from the people.

entries.yo: Arauna si wi fun Dafidi pe, Jẹ ki oluwa mi ọba ki o mu eyi ti o dara li oju rẹ̀, ki o si fi i rubọ: wõ, malu niyi lati fi ṣe ẹbọ sisun, ati ohun elo ipaka, ati ohun elo miran ti malu fun igi.
entries.en: And Araunah said unto David, Let my lord the king take and offer up what seemeth good unto him: behold, here be oxen for burnt sacrifice, and threshing instruments and other instruments of the oxen for wood.

entries.yo: Gbogbo nkan wọnyi ni Arauna fi fun ọba, bi ọba. Arauna si wi fun ọba pe, Ki Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ ki o gbà ọrẹ rẹ.
entries.en: All these things did Araunah, as a king, give unto the king. And Araunah said unto the king, The LORD thy God accept thee.

entries.yo: Ọba si wi fun Arauna pe, Bẹ̃kọ; ṣugbọn emi o rà a ni iye kan lọwọ rẹ, bi o ti wù ki o ṣe; bẹ̃li emi kì yio fi eyiti emi kò nawo fun, rú ẹbọ sisun si Oluwa Ọlọrun mi. Dafidi si rà ibi ipaka na, ati awọn malũ na li ãdọta ṣekeli fadaka.
entries.en: And the king said unto Araunah, Nay; but I will surely buy it of thee at a price: neither will I offer burnt offerings unto the LORD my God of that which doth cost me nothing. So David bought the threshingfloor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver.

entries.yo: Dafidi si tẹ́ pẹpẹ kan nibẹ si Oluwa, o si rú ẹbọ sisun ati ti ìlaja. Oluwa si gbọ́ ẹbẹ fun ilẹ na, arùn na si da kuro ni Ìsraeli.
entries.en: And David built there an altar unto the LORD, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings. So the LORD was intreated for the land, and the plague was stayed from Israel.

entries.yo: DAFIDI ọba si di arugbo, ọjọ rẹ̀ si pọ̀; nwọn si fi aṣọ bò o lara, ṣugbọn kò mõru.
entries.en: Now king David was old and stricken in years; and they covered him with clothes, but he gat no heat.

entries.yo: Awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀ si wi fun u pe, Jẹ ki a wá ọmọbinrin kan, wundia, fun Oluwa mi, ọba: ki o si duro niwaju ọba, ki o si ṣikẹ́ rẹ̀, ki o si dubulẹ li õkan-aiya rẹ̀, oluwa mi, ọba yio si mõru.
entries.en: Wherefore his servants said unto him, Let there be sought for my lord the king a young virgin: and let her stand before the king, and let her cherish him, and let her lie in thy bosom, that my lord the king may get heat.

entries.yo: Nwọn si wá ọmọbinrin arẹwà kan ka gbogbo agbegbe Israeli, nwọn si ri Abiṣagi, ara Ṣunemu, nwọn si mu u tọ̀ ọba wá.
entries.en: So they sought for a fair damsel throughout all the coasts of Israel, and found Abishag a Shunammite, and brought her to the king.

entries.yo: Ọmọbinrin na si ṣe arẹwà gidigidi, o si nṣikẹ́ ọba, o si nṣe iranṣẹ fun u; ṣugbọn ọba kò si mọ̀ ọ.
entries.en: And the damsel was very fair, and cherished the king, and ministered to him: but the king knew her not.

entries.yo: Adonijah, ọmọ Haggiti, si gbe ara rẹ̀ ga, wipe, emi ni yio jọba: o si mura kẹkẹ́ ati awọn ẹlẹṣin, ati ãdọta ọkunrin lati sare niwaju rẹ̀.
entries.en: Then Adonijah the son of Haggith exalted himself, saying, I will be king: and he prepared him chariots and horsemen, and fifty men to run before him.

entries.yo: Baba rẹ̀ kò si bà a ninu jẹ rí, pe, Ẽṣe ti iwọ fi ṣe bayi? On si ṣe enia ti o dara gidigidi: iya rẹ̀ si bi i le Absalomu.
entries.en: And his father had not displeased him at any time in saying, Why hast thou done so? and he also was a very goodly man; and his mother bare him after Absalom.

entries.yo: O si ba Joabu, ọmọ Seruiah, ati Abiatari, alufa gbèro: nwọn si nràn Adonijah lọwọ.
entries.en: And he conferred with Joab the son of Zeruiah, and with Abiathar the priest: and they following Adonijah helped him.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Sadoku alufa, ati Benaiah, ọmọ Jehoiada, ati Natani woli, ati Ṣimei, ati Rei, ati awọn ọkunrin alagbara ti mbẹ lọdọ Dafidi, kò wà pẹlu Adonijah.
entries.en: But Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and Nathan the prophet, and Shimei, and Rei, and the mighty men which belonged to David, were not with Adonijah.

entries.yo: Adonijah si pa agutan ati malu ati ẹran ọ̀sin ti o sanra nibi okuta Soheleti, ti mbẹ lẹba Enrogeli, o si pè gbogbo awọn arakunrin rẹ̀, awọn ọmọ ọba, ati gbogbo ọkunrin Juda, iranṣẹ ọba:
entries.en: And Adonijah slew sheep and oxen and fat cattle by the stone of Zoheleth, which is by En-rogel, and called all his brethren the king's sons, and all the men of Judah the king's servants:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Natani, alufa, ati Benaiah ati awọn ọkunrin alagbara, ati Solomoni arakunrin rẹ̀ ni kò pè.
entries.en: But Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah, and the mighty men, and Solomon his brother, he called not.

entries.yo: Natani si wi fun Batṣeba, iya Solomoni pe, Iwọ kò gbọ́ pe, Adonijah, omọ Haggiti jọba, Dafidi, oluwa wa, kò si mọ̀?
entries.en: Wherefore Nathan spake unto Bath-sheba the mother of Solomon, saying, Hast thou not heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith doth reign, and David our lord knoweth it not?

entries.yo: Nitorina, wá nisisiyi, emi bẹ̀ ọ, emi o si fun ọ ni ìmọ, ki iwọ ki o le gbà ẹmi rẹ là, ati ẹmi Solomoni ọmọ rẹ.
entries.en: Now therefore come, let me, I pray thee, give thee counsel, that thou mayest save thine own life, and the life of thy son Solomon.

entries.yo: Lọ, ki o si tọ̀ Dafidi, ọba lọ, ki o si wi fun u pe, Ọba, oluwa mi, ṣe iwọ li o bura fun ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ obinrin, pe, nitõtọ Solomoni, ọmọ rẹ, ni yio jọba lẹhin mi, on ni o si joko lori itẹ mi? ẽṣe ti Adonijah fi jọba?
entries.en: Go and get thee in unto king David, and say unto him, Didst not thou, my lord, O king, swear unto thine handmaid, saying, Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne? why then doth Adonijah reign?

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, bi iwọ ti mba ọba sọ̀rọ lọwọ, emi o si tẹle ọ, emi o si wá ikún ọ̀rọ rẹ.
entries.en: Behold, while thou yet talkest there with the king, I also will come in after thee, and confirm thy words.

entries.yo: Batṣeba si tọ̀ ọba lọ ni iyẹ̀wu: ọba si gbó gidigidi: Abiṣagi, ara Ṣunemu, si nṣe iranṣẹ fun ọba.
entries.en: And Bath-sheba went in unto the king into the chamber: and the king was very old; and Abishag the Shunammite ministered unto the king.

entries.yo: Batṣeba si tẹriba, o si wolẹ fun ọba. Ọba si wipe, Kini iwọ nfẹ?
entries.en: And Bath-sheba bowed, and did obeisance unto the king. And the king said, What wouldest thou?

entries.yo: On si wi fun u pe, oluwa mi, iwọ fi Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ bura fun ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ obinrin pe, nitõtọ Solomoni, ọmọ rẹ, yio jọba lẹhin mi, on o si joko lori itẹ mi.
entries.en: And she said unto him, My lord, thou swarest by the LORD thy God unto thine handmaid, saying, Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne.

entries.yo: Sa wò o, nisisiyi, Adonijah jọba; iwọ, oluwa mi ọba, kò si mọ̀.
entries.en: And now, behold, Adonijah reigneth; and now, my lord the king, thou knowest it not:

entries.yo: O si pa malu ati ẹran ti o li ọra, ati agùtan li ọ̀pọlọpọ, o si pe gbogbo awọn ọmọ ọba, ati Abiatari alufa, ati Joabu balogun: ṣugbọn Solomoni iranṣẹ rẹ ni kò pè.
entries.en: And he hath slain oxen and fat cattle and sheep in abundance, and hath called all the sons of the king, and Abiathar the priest, and Joab the captain of the host: but Solomon thy servant hath he not called.

entries.yo: Ati iwọ, oluwa mi, ọba, oju gbogbo Israeli mbẹ lara rẹ, ki iwọ ki o sọ fun wọn, tani yio joko lori itẹ oluwa mi ọba lẹhin rẹ̀?
entries.en: And thou, my lord, O king, the eyes of all Israel are upon thee, that thou shouldest tell them who shall sit on the throne of my lord the king after him.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, nigbati oluwa mi ọba ba sùn pẹlu awọn baba rẹ̀, a o si kà emi ati Solomoni ọmọ mi si ẹlẹṣẹ̀.
entries.en: Otherwise it shall come to pass, when my lord the king shall sleep with his fathers, that I and my son Solomon shall be counted offenders.

entries.yo: Si wò o, bi o si ti mba ọba sọ̀rọ lọwọ, Natani woli si wọle.
entries.en: And, lo, while she yet talked with the king, Nathan the prophet also came in.

entries.yo: Nwọn si sọ fun ọba pe, Wò o, Natani woli. Nigbati o si wá siwaju ọba, o wolẹ̀, o si dojubolẹ.
entries.en: And they told the king, saying, Behold Nathan the prophet. And when he was come in before the king, he bowed himself before the king with his face to the ground.

entries.yo: Natani si wipe, oluwa mi, ọba! iwọ ha wipe, Adonijah ni yio jọba lẹhin mi ati pe, on o si joko lori itẹ mi bi?
entries.en: And Nathan said, My lord, O king, hast thou said, Adonijah shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne?

entries.yo: Nitori o sọkalẹ lọ loni, o si pa malu ati ẹran ọlọra, ati agùtan li ọ̀pọ-lọpọ, o si pè gbogbo awọn ọmọ ọba, ati awọn balogun, ati Abiatari alufa; si wò o, nwọn njẹ, nwọn si nmu niwaju rẹ̀, nwọn si nwipe, Ki Adonijah ọba ki o pẹ.
entries.en: For he is gone down this day, and hath slain oxen and fat cattle and sheep in abundance, and hath called all the king's sons, and the captains of the host, and Abiathar the priest; and, behold, they eat and drink before him, and say, God save king Adonijah.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi, emi iranṣẹ rẹ, ati Sadoku alufa, ati Benaiah ọmọ Jehoiada, ati Solomoni, iranṣẹ rẹ, ni kò pè.
entries.en: But me, even me thy servant, and Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and thy servant Solomon, hath he not called.

entries.yo: Nkan yi ti ọdọ oluwa mi ọba wá bi? iwọ kò si fi ẹniti yio joko lori itẹ oluwa mi ọba lẹhin rẹ̀ hàn iranṣẹ rẹ?
entries.en: Is this thing done by my lord the king, and thou hast not shewed it unto thy servant, who should sit on the throne of my lord the king after him?

entries.yo: Dafidi, ọba si dahùn o si wipe, Ẹ pè Batṣeba fun mi. On si wá siwaju ọba, o si duro niwaju ọba,
entries.en: Then king David answered and said, Call me Bath-sheba. And she came into the king's presence, and stood before the king.

entries.yo: Ọba si bura, o si wipe, Bi Oluwa ti wà, ẹniti o ti rà ọkàn mi pada kuro ninu gbogbo ìṣẹ́.
entries.en: And the king sware, and said, As the LORD liveth, that hath redeemed my soul out of all distress,

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi mo ti fi Oluwa, Ọlọrun Israeli bura fun ọ, wipe, Nitõtọ Solomoni, ọmọ rẹ, yio jọba lẹhin mi, on o si joko lori itẹ mi ni ipò mi, bẹ̃ni emi o ṣe loni yi dandan.
entries.en: Even as I sware unto thee by the LORD God of Israel, saying, Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne in my stead; even so will I certainly do this day.

entries.yo: Batṣeba si foribalẹ, o si bọ̀wọ fun ọba, o si wipe, Ki oluwa mi, Dafidi ọba ki o pẹ titi lai.
entries.en: Then Bath-sheba bowed with her face to the earth, and did reverence to the king, and said, Let my lord king David live for ever.

entries.yo: Dafidi ọba wipe, Ẹ pè Sadoku alufa fun mi, ati Natani woli, ati Benaiah ọmọ Jehoiada. Nwọn si wá siwaju ọba.
entries.en: And king David said, Call me Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada. And they came before the king.

entries.yo: Ọba si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ mu awọn iranṣẹ oluwa nyin, ki ẹ si mu ki Solomoni ọmọ mi ki o gùn ibãka mi, ki ẹ si mu sọkalẹ wá si Gihoni.
entries.en: The king also said unto them, Take with you the servants of your lord, and cause Solomon my son to ride upon mine own mule, and bring him down to Gihon:

entries.yo: Ki ẹ si jẹ ki Sadoku, alufa, ati Natani woli, fi ororo yàn a nibẹ̀ li ọba lori Israeli: ki ẹ si fun fère, ki ẹ si wipe; Ki Solomoni ọba ki o pẹ!
entries.en: And let Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet anoint him there king over Israel: and blow ye with the trumpet, and say, God save king Solomon.

entries.yo: Ki ẹ si goke tọ̀ ọ lẹhin, ki o si wá, ki o si joko lori itẹ mi; on o si jọba ni ipò mi: emi si pa a laṣẹ lati jẹ olori Israeli ati Juda.
entries.en: Then ye shall come up after him, that he may come and sit upon my throne; for he shall be king in my stead: and I have appointed him to be ruler over Israel and over Judah.

entries.yo: Benaiah ọmọ Jehoiada, si da ọba lohùn, o si wipe, Amin: Oluwa, Ọlọrun ọba oluwa mi, wi bẹ̃ pẹlu.
entries.en: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada answered the king, and said, Amen: the LORD God of my lord the king say so too.

entries.yo: Bi Oluwa ti wà pẹlu oluwa mi ọba, gẹgẹ bẹ̃ni ki o wà pẹlu Solomoni, ki o si ṣe itẹ rẹ̀ ki o pọ̀ jù itẹ oluwa mi, Dafidi ọba lọ.
entries.en: As the LORD hath been with my lord the king, even so be he with Solomon, and make his throne greater than the throne of my lord king David.

entries.yo: Sadoku alufa, ati Natani woli, ati Benaiah, ọmọ Jehoiada, ati awọn ara Kereti ati Peleti si sọkalẹ, nwọn si mu ki Solomoni ki o gùn ibãka Dafidi ọba, nwọn si mu u wá si Gihoni,
entries.en: So Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, went down, and caused Solomon to ride upon king David's mule, and brought him to Gihon.

entries.yo: Sadoku alufa si mu iwo ororo lati inu agọ, o si dà a si Solomoni lori; nwọn si fun fère; gbogbo enia si wipe, Ki Solomoni ọba ki o pẹ.
entries.en: And Zadok the priest took an horn of oil out of the tabernacle, and anointed Solomon. And they blew the trumpet; and all the people said, God save king Solomon.

entries.yo: Gbogbo enia si goke tọ̀ ọ lẹhin, awọn enia si fun ipè, nwọn si yọ̀ ayọ̀ nlanla, tobẹ̃ ti ilẹ mì fun iró wọn.
entries.en: And all the people came up after him, and the people piped with pipes, and rejoiced with great joy, so that the earth rent with the sound of them.

entries.yo: Ati Adonijah ati gbogbo awọn ti o pè sọdọ rẹ̀ si gbọ́, nigbati nwọn jẹun tan, Joabu si gbọ́ iró ipè o si wipe: eredi ariwo ilu ti nrọkẹkẹ yi?
entries.en: And Adonijah and all the guests that were with him heard it as they had made an end of eating. And when Joab heard the sound of the trumpet, he said, Wherefore is this noise of the city being in an uproar?

entries.yo: Bi o si ti nsọ lọwọ, kiyesi i, Jonatani, ọmọ Abiatari, alufa de; Adonijah si wi fun u pe, Mã wolẹ̀; nitoripe alagbara ọkunrin ni iwọ, ati ẹniti nmu ihin-rere wá.
entries.en: And while he yet spake, behold, Jonathan the son of Abiathar the priest came: and Adonijah said unto him, Come in; for thou art a valiant man, and bringest good tidings.

entries.yo: Jonatani si dahùn o si wi fun Adonijah pe, Lõtọ ni, oluwa wa, Dafidi ọba, fi Solomoni jọba.
entries.en: And Jonathan answered and said to Adonijah, Verily our lord king David hath made Solomon king.

entries.yo: Ọba si ti rán Sadoku alufa, ati Natani woli, ati Benaiah, ọmọ Jehoiada, ati awọn ara Kereti ati Peleti pẹlu rẹ̀, nwọn si ti mu u ki o gùn ibãka ọba.
entries.en: And the king hath sent with him Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, and they have caused him to ride upon the king's mule:

entries.yo: Sadoku, alufa ati Natani, woli si ti fi ororo yàn a li ọba ni Gihoni: nwọn si fi ayọ̀ goke lati ibẹ wá, tobẹ̃ ti ilu si nho. Eyi ni ariwo ti ẹ ti gbọ́.
entries.en: And Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king in Gihon: and they are come up from thence rejoicing, so that the city rang again. This is the noise that ye have heard.

entries.yo: Solomoni si joko lori itẹ ijọba pẹlu.
entries.en: And also Solomon sitteth on the throne of the kingdom.

entries.yo: Awọn iranṣẹ ọba si wá lati sure fun oluwa wa, Dafidi ọba, pe, Ki Ọlọrun ki o mu orukọ Solomoni ki o sàn jù orukọ rẹ lọ, ki o si ṣe itẹ rẹ̀ ki o pọ̀ jù itẹ rẹ lọ. Ọba si gbadura lori akete.
entries.en: And moreover the king's servants came to bless our lord king David, saying, God make the name of Solomon better than thy name, and make his throne greater than thy throne. And the king bowed himself upon the bed.

entries.yo: Ọba si wi bayi pẹlu, Olubukun li Oluwa, Ọlọrun Israeli, ti o fun mi li ẹnikan ti o joko lori itẹ mi loni, oju mi si ri i.
entries.en: And also thus said the king, Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, which hath given one to sit on my throne this day, mine eyes even seeing it.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn ti a pè, ti nwọn wà li ọdọ Adonijah si bẹ̀ru, nwọn si dide, nwọn si lọ olukuluku si ọ̀na rẹ̀.
entries.en: And all the guests that were with Adonijah were afraid, and rose up, and went every man his way.

entries.yo: Adonijah si bẹ̀ru Solomoni, o si dide, o si lọ, o si di iwo pẹpẹ mu.
entries.en: And Adonijah feared because of Solomon, and arose, and went, and caught hold on the horns of the altar.

entries.yo: Nwọn si wi fun Solomoni pe, Wò o, Adonijah bẹ̀ru Solomoni ọba: si kiyesi i, o di iwo pẹpẹ mu, o nwipe, Ki Solomoni ọba ki o bura fun mi loni pe, On kì yio fi idà pa iranṣẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And it was told Solomon, saying, Behold, Adonijah feareth king Solomon: for, lo, he hath caught hold on the horns of the altar, saying, Let king Solomon swear unto me to day that he will not slay his servant with the sword.

entries.yo: Solomoni si wipe, Bi o ba jẹ fi ara rẹ̀ si ọ̀wọ, irun ori rẹ̀ kan kì yio bọ́ silẹ: ṣugbọn bi a ba ri buburu lọwọ rẹ̀, on o kú.
entries.en: And Solomon said, If he will shew himself a worthy man, there shall not an hair of him fall to the earth: but if wickedness shall be found in him, he shall die.

entries.yo: Solomoni ọba si ranṣẹ, nwọn mu u sọkalẹ lori pẹpẹ. On si wá, o si foribalẹ̀ fun Solomoni ọba: Solomoni si wi fun u pe, Mã lọ ile rẹ.
entries.en: So king Solomon sent, and they brought him down from the altar. And he came and bowed himself to king Solomon: and Solomon said unto him, Go to thine house.

entries.yo: ỌJỌ Dafidi si sunmọ etile ti yio kú: o si paṣẹ fun Solomoni, ọmọ rẹ̀ pe:
entries.en: Now the days of David drew nigh that he should die; and he charged Solomon his son, saying,

entries.yo: Emi nlọ si ọ̀na gbogbo aiye: nitorina mu ara rẹ le, ki o si fi ara rẹ̀ hàn bi ọkunrin.
entries.en: I go the way of all the earth: be thou strong therefore, and shew thyself a man;

entries.yo: Ki o si pa ilana Oluwa, Ọlọrun rẹ mọ, lati ma rin li ọ̀na rẹ̀, lati pa aṣẹ rẹ̀ mọ, ati ofin rẹ̀, ati idajọ, rẹ̀ ati ẹri rẹ̀ gẹgẹ bi a ti kọ ọ ni ofin Mose, ki iwọ ki o lè ma pọ̀ si i ni ohun gbogbo ti iwọ o ṣe, ati nibikibi ti iwọ ba yi ara rẹ si.
entries.en: And keep the charge of the LORD thy God, to walk in his ways, to keep his statutes, and his commandments, and his judgments, and his testimonies, as it is written in the law of Moses, that thou mayest prosper in all that thou doest, and whithersoever thou turnest thyself:

entries.yo: Ki Oluwa ki o le mu ọ̀rọ rẹ̀ duro ti o ti sọ niti emi pe: Bi awọn ọmọ rẹ ba kiyesi ọ̀na wọn, lati mã fi gbogbo aiya wọn, ati gbogbo ọkàn wọn, rìn niwaju mi li otitọ, (o wipe), a kì yio fẹ ọkunrin kan kù fun ọ lori itẹ Israeli.
entries.en: That the LORD may continue his word which he spake concerning me, saying, If thy children take heed to their way, to walk before me in truth with all their heart and with all their soul, there shall not fail thee (said he) a man on the throne of Israel.

entries.yo: Iwọ si mọ̀ pẹlu, ohun ti Joabu, ọmọ Seruiah, ṣe si mi, ati ohun ti o ṣe si balogun meji ninu awọn ọgagun Israeli, si Abneri, ọmọ Neri, ati si Amasa, ọmọ Jeteri, o si pa wọn, o si ta ẹ̀jẹ ogun silẹ li alafia, o si fi ẹ̀jẹ ogun si ara àmure rẹ̀ ti mbẹ li ẹ̀gbẹ rẹ̀, ati si ara salubata rẹ̀ ti mbẹ li ẹsẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Moreover thou knowest also what Joab the son of Zeruiah did to me, and what he did to the two captains of the hosts of Israel, unto Abner the son of Ner, and unto Amasa the son of Jether, whom he slew, and shed the blood of war in peace, and put the blood of war upon his girdle that was about his loins, and in his shoes that were on his feet.

entries.yo: Nitorina, ki o ṣe gẹgẹ bi ọgbọ́n rẹ, ki o má si jẹ ki ewu ori rẹ̀ ki o sọkalẹ lọ si isa-okú li alafia.
entries.en: Do therefore according to thy wisdom, and let not his hoar head go down to the grave in peace.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ki o ṣe ore fun awọn ọmọ Barsillai, ara Gileadi, ki o si jẹ ki nwọn ki o wà ninu awọn ti o jẹun lori tabili rẹ: nitori bẹ̃ni nwọn ṣe tọ̀ mi wá nigbati mo sá kuro niwaju Absalomu, arakunrin rẹ.
entries.en: But shew kindness unto the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, and let them be of those that eat at thy table: for so they came to me when I fled because of Absalom thy brother.

entries.yo: Si wò o, Ṣimei, ọmọ Gera, ẹyà Benjamimi ti Bahurimu, wà pelu rẹ ti o bú mi ni ẽbu ti o burujù, ni ọjọ́ ti mo lọ si Mahanaimu: ṣugbọn o sọkalẹ wá pade mi ni Jordani, mo si fi Oluwa bura fun u pe, Emi kì yio fi idà pa ọ.
entries.en: And, behold, thou hast with thee Shimei the son of Gera, a Benjamite of Bahurim, which cursed me with a grievous curse in the day when I went to Mahanaim: but he came down to meet me at Jordan, and I sware to him by the LORD, saying, I will not put thee to death with the sword.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nisisiyi, máṣe jẹ ki o ṣe alaijiya, nitori ọlọgbọ́n enia ni iwọ, iwọ si mọ̀ ohun ti iwọ o ṣe si i; ṣugbọn ewú ori rẹ̀ ni ki o mu sọkalẹ pẹlu ẹjẹ sinu isa-okú.
entries.en: Now therefore hold him not guiltless: for thou art a wise man, and knowest what thou oughtest to do unto him; but his hoar head bring thou down to the grave with blood.

entries.yo: Dafidi si sùn pẹlu awọn baba rẹ̀, a si sin i ni ilu Dafidi.
entries.en: So David slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David.

entries.yo: Ọjọ ti Dafidi jọba lori Israeli jẹ ogoji ọdun: ni Hebroni o jọba li ọdun meje, ni Jerusalemu o si jọba li ọdun mẹtalelọgbọn.
entries.en: And the days that David reigned over Israel were forty years: seven years reigned he in Hebron, and thirty and three years reigned he in Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Solomoni si joko lori itẹ Dafidi baba rẹ̀; a si fi idi ijọba rẹ̀ kalẹ gidigidi.
entries.en: Then sat Solomon upon the throne of David his father; and his kingdom was established greatly.

entries.yo: Adonijah, ọmọ Haggiti si tọ Batṣeba, iya Solomoni wá, Batṣeba si wipe; Alafia li o ba wá bi? On si wipe, alafia ni.
entries.en: And Adonijah the son of Haggith came to Bath-sheba the mother of Solomon. And she said, Comest thou peaceably? And he said, Peaceably.

entries.yo: On si wipe, emi ni ọ̀rọ kan ba ọ sọ. On si wipe, Mã wi:
entries.en: He said moreover, I have somewhat to say unto thee. And she said, Say on.

entries.yo: On si wipe, Iwọ mọ̀ pe, ijọba na ti emi ni ri, ati pe, gbogbo Israeli li o fi oju wọn si mi lara pe, emi ni o jọba: ṣugbọn ijọba na si yí, o si di ti arakunrin mi; nitori tirẹ̀ ni lati ọwọ́ Oluwa wá.
entries.en: And he said, Thou knowest that the kingdom was mine, and that all Israel set their faces on me, that I should reign: howbeit the kingdom is turned about, and is become my brother's: for it was his from the LORD.

entries.yo: Nisisiyi, ibere kan ni mo wá bere lọwọ rẹ, máṣe dù mi: O si wi fun u pe, Mã wi.
entries.en: And now I ask one petition of thee, deny me not. And she said unto him, Say on.

entries.yo: O si wi pe, Mo bẹ ọ, sọ fun Solomoni ọba (nitori kì yio dù ọ,) ki o fun mi ni Abiṣagi, ara Ṣunemu li aya.
entries.en: And he said, Speak, I pray thee, unto Solomon the king, (for he will not say thee nay,) that he give me Abishag the Shunammite to wife.

entries.yo: Batṣeba si wipe, o dara; emi o ba ọba sọrọ nitori rẹ.
entries.en: And Bath-sheba said, Well; I will speak for thee unto the king.

entries.yo: Batṣeba si tọ Solomoni ọba lọ, lati sọ fun u nitori Adonijah. Ọba si dide lati pade rẹ̀, o si tẹ ara rẹ̀ ba fun u, o si joko lori itẹ́ rẹ̀ o si tẹ́ itẹ fun iya ọba, on si joko lọwọ ọtun rẹ̀.
entries.en: Bath-sheba therefore went unto king Solomon, to speak unto him for Adonijah. And the king rose up to meet her, and bowed himself unto her, and sat down on his throne, and caused a seat to be set for the king's mother; and she sat on his right hand.

entries.yo: On si wipe, Ibere kekere kan li emi ni ibere lọwọ rẹ; máṣe dù mi. On si wipe, mã tọrọ, iya mi; nitoriti emi kì yio dù ọ.
entries.en: Then she said, I desire one small petition of thee; I pray thee, say me not nay. And the king said unto her, Ask on, my mother: for I will not say thee nay.

entries.yo: On si wipe, jẹ ki a fi Abiṣagi, ara Ṣunemu, fun Adonijah, arakunrin rẹ, li aya.
entries.en: And she said, Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to Adonijah thy brother to wife.

entries.yo: Solomoni ọba si dahùn, o si wi fun iya rẹ̀ pe, Ẽṣe ti iwọ fi mbere Abiṣagi, ara Ṣunemu, fun Adonijah, kuku bere ijọba fun u pẹlu; nitori ẹgbọ́n mi ni iṣe; fun on pãpa, ati fun Abiatari, alufa, ati fun Joabu, ọmọ Seruiah.
entries.en: And king Solomon answered and said unto his mother, And why dost thou ask Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? ask for him the kingdom also; for he is mine elder brother; even for him, and for Abiathar the priest, and for Joab the son of Zeruiah.

entries.yo: Solomoni, ọba si fi Oluwa bura pe, Bayi ni ki Ọlọrun ki o ṣe si mi, ati jubẹ pẹlu, nitori Adonijah sọ̀rọ yi si ẹmi ara rẹ̀.
entries.en: Then king Solomon sware by the LORD, saying, God do so to me, and more also, if Adonijah have not spoken this word against his own life.

entries.yo: Ati nisisiyi bi Oluwa ti wà, ti o ti fi idi mi mulẹ̀, ti o si mu mi joko lori itẹ́ baba mi, ti o si ti kọ́ ile fun mi, gẹgẹ bi o ti wi, loni ni a o pa Adonijah.
entries.en: Now therefore, as the LORD liveth, which hath established me, and set me on the throne of David my father, and who hath made me an house, as he promised, Adonijah shall be put to death this day.

entries.yo: Solomoni, ọba si rán Benaiah, ọmọ Jehoiada, o si kọlu u, o si kú.
entries.en: And king Solomon sent by the hand of Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; and he fell upon him that he died.

entries.yo: Ati fun Abiatari, alufa, ọba wipe, Lọ si Anatoti, si oko rẹ; nitori iwọ yẹ si ikú: ṣugbọn loni emi kì yio pa ọ, nitori iwọ li o ti ngbe apoti Oluwa Ọlọrun niwaju Dafidi baba mi, ati nitori iwọ ti jẹ ninu gbogbo iyà ti baba mi ti jẹ.
entries.en: And unto Abiathar the priest said the king, Get thee to Anathoth, unto thine own fields; for thou art worthy of death: but I will not at this time put thee to death, because thou barest the ark of the Lord GOD before David my father, and because thou hast been afflicted in all wherein my father was afflicted.

entries.yo: Solomoni si le Abiatari kuro ninu iṣẹ alufa Oluwa; ki o le mu ọ̀rọ Oluwa ṣẹ, ti o ti sọ nipa ile Eli ni Ṣilo.
entries.en: So Solomon thrust out Abiathar from being priest unto the LORD; that he might fulfil the word of the LORD, which he spake concerning the house of Eli in Shiloh.

entries.yo: Ihin si de ọdọ Joabu: nitori Joabu ti tọ̀ Adonijah lẹhin, ṣugbọn kò tọ̀ Absalomu lẹhin: Joabu si sá sinu agọ Oluwa, o si di iwo pẹpẹ mu.
entries.en: Then tidings came to Joab: for Joab had turned after Adonijah, though he turned not after Absalom. And Joab fled unto the tabernacle of the LORD, and caught hold on the horns of the altar.

entries.yo: A si sọ fun Solomoni ọba pe, Joabu ti sá sinu agọ Oluwa; si wò o, o sunmọ pẹpẹ, Solomoni si rán Benaiah, ọmọ Jehoiada, pe, Lọ, ki o si kọlù u.
entries.en: And it was told king Solomon that Joab was fled unto the tabernacle of the LORD; and, behold, he is by the altar. Then Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, saying, Go, fall upon him.

entries.yo: Benaiah si wá sinu agọ Oluwa, o si wi fun u pe, Bayi li ọba wi, pe, Jade wá. On si wipe, Bẹ̃kọ̀; ṣugbọn nihinyi li emi o kú. Benaiah si mu èsi fun ọba wá pe, Bayi ni Joabu wi, bayi ni o si dá mi lohùn.
entries.en: And Benaiah came to the tabernacle of the LORD, and said unto him, Thus saith the king, Come forth. And he said, Nay; but I will die here. And Benaiah brought the king word again, saying, Thus said Joab, and thus he answered me.

entries.yo: Ọba si wi fun u pe, Ṣe gẹgẹ bi o ti wi ki o si kọlù u, ki o si sin i, ki iwọ ki o le mu ẹ̀jẹ alaiṣẹ̀ kuro lọdọ mi ati kuro lọdọ ile baba mi, ti Joabu ti ta silẹ.
entries.en: And the king said unto him, Do as he hath said, and fall upon him, and bury him; that thou mayest take away the innocent blood, which Joab shed, from me, and from the house of my father.

entries.yo: Oluwa yio si yi ẹ̀jẹ rẹ̀ pada sori rẹ̀, nitoriti o kọlù ọkunrin meji ti o ṣe olododo, ti o sàn jù on tikararẹ̀ lọ, o si fi idà pa wọn. Dafidi baba mi kò si mọ̀, ani, Abneri, ọmọ Neri, olori ogun, ati Amasa, ọmọ Jeteri, olori ogun Juda.
entries.en: And the LORD shall return his blood upon his own head, who fell upon two men more righteous and better than he, and slew them with the sword, my father David not knowing thereof, to wit, Abner the son of Ner, captain of the host of Israel, and Amasa the son of Jether, captain of the host of Judah.

entries.yo: Ẹ̀jẹ wọn yio si pada sori Joabu, ati sori iru-ọmọ rẹ̀ lailai: ṣugbọn si Dafidi ati si iru-ọmọ rẹ̀, ati si ile rẹ̀, ati si itẹ́ rẹ̀, alafia yio wà lati ọdọ Oluwa wá,
entries.en: Their blood shall therefore return upon the head of Joab, and upon the head of his seed for ever: but upon David, and upon his seed, and upon his house, and upon his throne, shall there be peace for ever from the LORD.

entries.yo: Benaiah, ọmọ Jehoiada, si goke, o si kọlù u, ó si pa a: a si sin i ni ile rẹ̀ li aginju.
entries.en: So Benaiah the son of Jehoiada went up, and fell upon him, and slew him: and he was buried in his own house in the wilderness.

entries.yo: Ọba si fi Benaiah, ọmọ Jehoiada, jẹ olori-ogun ni ipò rẹ̀, ati Sadoku alufa ni ọba fi si ipò Abiatari.
entries.en: And the king put Benaiah the son of Jehoiada in his room over the host: and Zadok the priest did the king put in the room of Abiathar.

entries.yo: Ọba si ranṣẹ, o si pe Ṣimei, o si wi fun u pe, Kọ́ ile fun ara rẹ ni Jerusalemu, ki o si ma gbe ibẹ̀, ki o má si ṣe jade lati ibẹ lọ si ibikibi.
entries.en: And the king sent and called for Shimei, and said unto him, Build thee an house in Jerusalem, and dwell there, and go not forth thence any whither.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe li ọjọ ti iwọ ba jade, ti iwọ ba si kọja odò Kidroni, ki iwọ mọ̀ dajudaju pe, Kikú ni iwọ o kú; ẹ̀jẹ rẹ yio wà lori ara rẹ.
entries.en: For it shall be, that on the day thou goest out, and passest over the brook Kidron, thou shalt know for certain that thou shalt surely die: thy blood shall be upon thine own head.

entries.yo: Ṣimei si wi fun ọba pe, Ọrọ na dara, gẹgẹ bi oluwa mi ọba ti wi, bẹ̃ gẹgẹ ni iranṣẹ rẹ yio ṣe. Ṣimei si gbe Jerusalemu li ọjọ pupọ.
entries.en: And Shimei said unto the king, The saying is good: as my lord the king hath said, so will thy servant do. And Shimei dwelt in Jerusalem many days.

entries.yo: O si ṣe lẹhin ọdun mẹta, awọn ọmọ-ọdọ Ṣimei meji si lọ sọdọ Akiṣi ọmọ Maaka, ọba Gati. Nwọn si rò fun Ṣimei pe, Wo o, awọn ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ mbẹ ni Gati.
entries.en: And it came to pass at the end of three years, that two of the servants of Shimei ran away unto Achish son of Maachah king of Gath. And they told Shimei, saying, Behold, thy servants be in Gath.

entries.yo: Ṣimei si dide, o si di kẹtẹkẹtẹ ni gari, o si lọ, o si mu awọn ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ̀ bọ̀ lati Gati.
entries.en: And Shimei arose, and saddled his ass, and went to Gath to Achish to seek his servants: and Shimei went, and brought his servants from Gath.

entries.yo: A si rò fun Solomoni pe, Ṣimei ti lọ lati Jerusalemu si Gati, o si pada bọ̀.
entries.en: And it was told Solomon that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath, and was come again.

entries.yo: Ọba si ranṣẹ, o si pè Ṣimei, o si wi fun u pe, emi kò ti mu ọ fi Oluwa bura, emi kò si ti fi ọ ṣe ẹlẹri, pe, Li ọjọ ti iwọ ba jade, ti iwọ ba si rìn jade lọ nibikibi, ki iwọ ki o mọ̀ dajudaju pe, kikú ni iwọ o kú? iwọ si wi fun mi pe, Ọrọ na ti mo gbọ́, o dara.
entries.en: And the king sent and called for Shimei, and said unto him, Did I not make thee to swear by the LORD, and protested unto thee, saying, Know for a certain, on the day thou goest out, and walkest abroad any wither, that thou shalt surely die? and thou saidst unto me, The word that I have heard is good.

entries.yo: Ẽ si ti ṣe ti iwọ kò pa ibura Oluwa mọ, ati aṣẹ ti mo pa fun ọ?
entries.en: Why then hast thou not kept the oath of the LORD, and the commandment that I have charged thee with?

entries.yo: Ọba si wi fun Ṣimei pe, Iwọ mọ̀ gbogbo buburu ti ọkàn rẹ njẹ ọ lẹri, ti iwọ ti ṣe si Dafidi, baba mi: Oluwa yio si yi buburu rẹ si ori ara rẹ.
entries.en: The king said moreover to Shimei, Thou knowest all the wickedness which thine heart is privy to, that thou didst to David my father: therefore the LORD shall return thy wickedness upon thine own head;

entries.yo: A o si bukun Solomoni ọba, a o si fi idi itẹ́ Dafidi mulẹ niwaju Oluwa lailai.
entries.en: And king Solomon shall be blessed, and the throne of David shall be established before the LORD for ever.

entries.yo: Ọba si paṣẹ fun Benaiah ọmọ Jehoiada, o si jade lọ, o si kọlù u, o si kú. A si fi idi ijọba mulẹ li ọwọ́ Solomoni.
entries.en: So the king commanded Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; which went out, and fell upon him, that he died. And the kingdom was established in the hand of Solomon.

entries.yo: SOLOMONI si ba Farao ọba Egipti da ana, o si gbe ọmọbinrin Farao ni iyawo, o si mu u wá si ilu Dafidi, titi o fi pari iṣẹ ile rẹ̀, ati ile Oluwa, ati odi Jerusalemu yika.
entries.en: And Solomon made affinity with Pharaoh king of Egypt, and took Pharaoh's daughter, and brought her into the city of David, until he had made an end of building his own house, and the house of the LORD, and the wall of Jerusalem round about.

entries.yo: Kiki pe, awọn enia nrubọ ni ibi giga, nitori a kò ti ikọ́ ile kan fun orukọ Oluwa, titi di ọjọ wọnnì.
entries.en: Only the people sacrificed in high places, because there was no house built unto the name of the LORD, until those days.

entries.yo: Solomoni si fẹ Oluwa, o si nrin nipa aṣẹ Dafidi baba rẹ̀: ṣugbọn kiki pe, o nrubọ, o si nfi turari jona ni ibi-giga.
entries.en: And Solomon loved the LORD, walking in the statutes of David his father: only he sacrificed and burnt incense in high places.

entries.yo: Ọba si lọ si Gibeoni lati rubọ nibẹ; nitori ibẹ ni ibi-giga nlanla: ẹgbẹrun ọrẹ ẹbọ-sisun ni Solomoni ru lori pẹpẹ na.
entries.en: And the king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there; for that was the great high place: a thousand burnt offerings did Solomon offer upon that altar.

entries.yo: Ni Gibeoni ni Oluwa fi ara rẹ̀ hàn Solomoni loju alá li oru: Ọlọrun si wipe, Bère ohun ti emi o fi fun ọ.
entries.en: In Gibeon the LORD appeared to Solomon in a dream by night: and God said, Ask what I shall give thee.

entries.yo: Solomoni si wipe, Iwọ ti ṣe ore nla fun iranṣẹ rẹ, Dafidi baba mi, gẹgẹ bi o ti rin niwaju rẹ li otitọ ati li ododo, ati ni iduro-ṣinṣin ọkàn pẹlu rẹ, iwọ si pa ore nla yi mọ fun u lati fun u li ọmọkunrin ti o joko lori itẹ rẹ̀, gẹgẹ bi o ti ri loni yi.
entries.en: And Solomon said, Thou hast shewed unto thy servant David my father great mercy, according as he walked before thee in truth, and in righteousness, and in uprightness of heart with thee; and thou hast kept for him this great kindness, that thou hast given him a son to sit on his throne, as it is this day.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, Oluwa Ọlọrun mi, iwọ ti fi iranṣẹ rẹ jẹ ọba ni ipo Dafidi, baba mi: ati emi, ọmọ kekere ni mi, emi kò si mọ̀ jijade ati wiwọle.
entries.en: And now, O LORD my God, thou hast made thy servant king instead of David my father: and I am but a little child: I know not how to go out or come in.

entries.yo: Iranṣẹ rẹ si mbẹ lãrin awọn enia rẹ ti iwọ ti yàn, enia pupọ, ti a kò le moye, ti a kò si lè kà fun ọ̀pọlọpọ.
entries.en: And thy servant is in the midst of thy people which thou hast chosen, a great people, that cannot be numbered nor counted for multitude.

entries.yo: Nitorina, fi ọkàn imoye fun iranṣẹ rẹ lati ṣe idajọ awọn enia rẹ, lati mọ̀ iyatọ rere ati buburu; nitori tali o le ṣe idajọ awọn enia rẹ yi ti o pọ̀ to yi?
entries.en: Give therefore thy servant an understanding heart to judge thy people, that I may discern between good and bad: for who is able to judge this thy so great a people?

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ na si dara loju Oluwa, nitoriti Solomoni bère nkan yi.
entries.en: And the speech pleased the Lord, that Solomon had asked this thing.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si wi fun u pe, Nitoriti iwọ bère nkan yi, ti iwọ kò si bère ẹmi gigun fun ara rẹ, bẹ̃ni iwọ kò bère ọlá fun ara rẹ, bẹ̃ni iwọ kò bère ẹmi awọn ọta rẹ; ṣugbọn iwọ bère oye fun ara rẹ lati mọ̀ ẹjọ-idá;
entries.en: And God said unto him, Because thou hast asked this thing, and hast not asked for thyself long life; neither hast asked riches for thyself, nor hast asked the life of thine enemies; but hast asked for thyself understanding to discern judgment;

entries.yo: Wò o, emi ti ṣe gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ rẹ, wò o, emi fun ọ ni ọkàn ọgbọ́n ati imoye; tobẹ̃ ti kò ti isi ẹnikan ti o dabi rẹ ṣãju rẹ, bẹ̃ni lẹhin rẹ ẹnikan kì yio dide ti yio dabi rẹ.
entries.en: Behold, I have done according to thy words: lo, I have given thee a wise and an understanding heart; so that there was none like thee before thee, neither after thee shall any arise like unto thee.

entries.yo: Ati eyiti iwọ kò bere, emi o fun ọ pẹlu ati ọrọ̀ ati ọlá: tobẹ̃ ti kì yio si ọkan ninu awọn ọba ti yio dabi rẹ.
entries.en: And I have also given thee that which thou hast not asked, both riches, and honour: so that there shall not be any among the kings like unto thee all thy days.

entries.yo: Bi iwọ o ba si rìn ni ọ̀na mi lati pa aṣẹ ati ofin mi mọ, gẹgẹ bi Dafidi baba rẹ ti rìn, emi o si sún ọjọ rẹ siwaju.
entries.en: And if thou wilt walk in my ways, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as thy father David did walk, then I will lengthen thy days.

entries.yo: Solomoni si jí; si wò o, alá ni. On si wá si Jerusalemu, o si duro niwaju apoti majẹmu Oluwa, o si rubọ ọrẹ sisun, o si ru ẹbọ-alafia, o si se àse fun gbogbo awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Solomon awoke; and, behold, it was a dream. And he came to Jerusalem, and stood before the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and offered up burnt offerings, and offered peace offerings, and made a feast to all his servants.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni obinrin meji, ti iṣe àgbere, wá sọdọ ọba nwọn si duro niwaju rẹ̀.
entries.en: Then came there two women, that were harlots, unto the king, and stood before him.

entries.yo: Ọkan ninu wọn si wipe, Jọwọ, oluwa mi, emi ati obinrin yi ngbe ile kan; emi si bi ọmọ ni ile pẹlu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the one woman said, O my lord, I and this woman dwell in one house; and I was delivered of a child with her in the house.

entries.yo: O si ṣe ni ọjọ kẹta lẹhin igbati mo bimọ tan, obinrin yi si bimọ pẹlu: awa si jumọ ngbé pọ: kò si si alejo pẹlu wa ni ile bikoṣe awa mejeji ni ile.
entries.en: And it came to pass the third day after that I was delivered, that this woman was delivered also: and we were together; there was no stranger with us in the house, save we two in the house.

entries.yo: Ọmọ obinrin yi si kú li oru; nitoriti o sun le e.
entries.en: And this woman's child died in the night; because she overlaid it.

entries.yo: O si dide li ọ̀ganjọ, o si gbe ọmọ mi lati iha mi, nigbati iranṣẹ-birin rẹ sun, o si tẹ́ ẹ si aiya rẹ̀, o si tẹ́ okú ọmọ tirẹ̀ si aiya mi.
entries.en: And she arose at midnight, and took my son from beside me, while thine handmaid slept, and laid it in her bosom, and laid her dead child in my bosom.

entries.yo: Mo si dide li owurọ lati fi ọmú fun ọmọ mi, si wò o, o ti kú: ṣugbọn nigbati mo wò o fin li owurọ̀, si wò o, kì iṣe ọmọ mi ti mo bí.
entries.en: And when I rose in the morning to give my child suck, behold, it was dead: but when I had considered it in the morning, behold, it was not my son, which I did bear.

entries.yo: Obinrin keji si wipe, Bẹ̃kọ; ṣugbọn eyi alãye ni ọmọ mi, eyi okú li ọmọ rẹ, eyi si wipe, Bẹ̃kọ; ṣugbọn eyi okú li ọmọ rẹ, eyi alãye si li ọmọ mi. Bayi ni nwọn nsọ niwaju ọba.
entries.en: And the other woman said, Nay; but the living is my son, and the dead is thy son. And this said, No; but the dead is thy son, and the living is my son. Thus they spake before the king.

entries.yo: Ọba si wipe, Ọkan wipe, eyi li ọmọ mi ti o wà lãye, ati okú li ọmọ rẹ; ekeji si wipe, Bẹ̃kọ; ṣugbọn eyi okú li ọmọ rẹ, eyi alãye li ọmọ mi.
entries.en: Then said the king, The one saith, This is my son that liveth, and thy son is the dead: and the other saith, Nay; but thy son is the dead, and my son is the living.

entries.yo: Ọba si wipe, Ẹ mu idà fun mi wá. Nwọn si mu idà wá siwaju ọba.
entries.en: And the king said, Bring me a sword. And they brought a sword before the king.

entries.yo: Ọba si wipe, Ẹ là eyi alãye ọmọ si meji, ki ẹ si mu idaji fun ọkan ati idaji fun ekeji.
entries.en: And the king said, Divide the living child in two, and give half to the one, and half to the other.

entries.yo: Obinrin ti eyi alãye ọmọ iṣe tirẹ̀ si wi fun ọba, nitori ti inu rẹ̀ yọ́ si ọmọ rẹ̀, o si wipe, Jọwọ, oluwa mi, ẹ fun u ni eyi alãye ọmọ, ki a máṣe pa a rara. Ṣugbọn eyi ekeji si wipe, kì yio jẹ temi tabi tirẹ, ẹ là a.
entries.en: Then spake the woman whose the living child was unto the king, for her bowels yearned upon her son, and she said, O my lord, give her the living child, and in no wise slay it. But the other said, Let it be neither mine nor thine, but divide it.

entries.yo: Ọba si dahùn o si wipe, ẹ fi alãye ọmọ fun u, ki ẹ má si ṣe pa a: on ni iya rẹ̀.
entries.en: Then the king answered and said, Give her the living child, and in no wise slay it: she is the mother thereof.

entries.yo: Gbogbo Israeli si gbọ́ idajọ ti ọba ṣe; nwọn si bẹ̀ru niwaju ọba: nitoriti nwọn ri i pe, ọgbọ́n Ọlọrun wà ninu rẹ̀, lati ṣe idajọ.
entries.en: And all Israel heard of the judgment which the king had judged; and they feared the king: for they saw that the wisdom of God was in him, to do judgment.

entries.yo: SOLOMONI ọba si jẹ ọba lori gbogbo Israeli.
entries.en: So king Solomon was king over all Israel.

entries.yo: Awọn wọnyi ni awọn ijoye ti o ni; Asariah, ọmọ Sadoku alufa,
entries.en: And these were the princes which he had; Azariah the son of Zadok the priest,

entries.yo: Elihorefu ati Ahiah, awọn ọmọ Ṣiṣa li akọwe, Jehoṣafati ọmọ Ahiludi li akọwe ilu.
entries.en: Elihoreph and Ahiah, the sons of Shisha, scribes; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, the recorder.

entries.yo: Ati Benaiah, ọmọ Jehoiada, li olori-ogun: ati Sadoku ati Abiatari ni awọn alufa:
entries.en: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the host: and Zadok and Abiathar were the priests:

entries.yo: Ati Asariah, ọmọ Natani, li olori awọn ọgagun: Sabudu, ọmọ Natani, alufa, si ni ọrẹ ọba:
entries.en: And Azariah the son of Nathan was over the officers: and Zabud the son of Nathan was principal officer, and the king's friend:

entries.yo: Ati Ahiṣari li o ṣe olori agbo-ile: ati Adoniramu, ọmọ Abda li o nṣe olori iṣẹ-irú.
entries.en: And Ahishar was over the household: and Adoniram the son of Abda was over the tribute.

entries.yo: Solomoni si ni ijoye mejila lori gbogbo Israeli, ti o npèse onjẹ fun ọba ati agbo-ile rẹ̀; olukuluku li oṣu tirẹ̀ li ọdun ni npese.
entries.en: And Solomon had twelve officers over all Israel, which provided victuals for the king and his household: each man his month in a year made provision.

entries.yo: Orukọ wọn si ni wọnyi: Benhuri li oke Efraimu.
entries.en: And these are their names: The son of Hur, in mount Ephraim:

entries.yo: Bendekari ni Makasi, ati ni Ṣaalbimu ati Betṣemeṣi, ati Elonibethanani:
entries.en: The son of Dekar, in Makaz, and in Shaalbim, and Beth-shemesh, and Elon-beth-hanan:

entries.yo: Benhesedi, ni Aruboti; tirẹ̀ ni Soko iṣe ati gbogbo ilẹ Heferi:
entries.en: The son of Hesed, in Aruboth; to him pertained Sochoh, and all the land of Hepher:

entries.yo: Ọmọ Abinadabu, ni gbogbo agbègbe Dori: ti o ni Tafati, ọmọbinrin Solomoni, li aya.
entries.en: The son of Abinadab, in all the region of Dor; which had Taphath the daughter of Solomon to wife:

entries.yo: Baana ọmọ Ahiludi, tirẹ̀ ni Taanaki iṣe, ati Megiddo, ati gbogbo Betṣeani ti mbẹ niha Sartana nisalẹ Jesreeli, lati Betṣeani de Abelmehola, ani titi de ibi ti mbẹ ni ikọja Jokneamu;
entries.en: Baana the son of Ahilud; to him pertained Taanach and Megiddo, and all Beth-shean, which is by Zartanah beneath Jezreel, from Beth-shean to Abel-meholah, even unto the place that is beyond Jokneam:

entries.yo: Ọmọ Geberi ni Ramoti-Gileadi; tirẹ̀ ni awọn ileto Jairi, ọmọ Manasse, ti mbẹ ni Gileadi; tirẹ̀ si ni apa Argobu, ti mbẹ ni Baṣani, ọgọta ilu ti o tobi, ti o li odi ati ọpa-idabu idẹ.
entries.en: The son of Geber, in Ramoth-gilead; to him pertained the towns of Jair the son of Manasseh, which are in Gilead; to him also pertained the region of Argob, which is in Bashan, threescore great cities with walls and brasen bars:

entries.yo: Ahinadabu, ọmọ Iddo, li o ni Mahanaimu
entries.en: Ahinadab the son of Iddo had Mahanaim:

entries.yo: Ahimaasi wà ni Naftali; on pẹlu li o ni Basmati, ọmọbinrin Solomoni, li aya.
entries.en: Ahimaaz was in Naphtali; he also took Basmath the daughter of Solomon to wife:

entries.yo: Baana, ọmọ Huṣai wà ni Aṣeri ati ni Aloti.
entries.en: Baanah the son of Hushai was in Asher and in Aloth:

entries.yo: Jehoṣafati, ọmọ Paruha, ni Issakari:
entries.en: Jehoshaphat the son of Paruah, in Issachar:

entries.yo: Ṣimei, ọmọ Ela, ni Benjamini.
entries.en: Shimei the son of Elah, in Benjamin:

entries.yo: Geberi, ọmọ Uri wà ni ilẹ Gileadi ni ilẹ Sihoni, ọba awọn ara Amori, ati Ogu, ọba Baṣani: ijoye kan li o si wà ni ilẹ na.
entries.en: Geber the son of Uri was in the country of Gilead, in the country of Sihon king of the Amorites, and of Og king of Bashan; and he was the only officer which was in the land.

entries.yo: Juda ati Israeli pọ̀ gẹgẹ bi iyanrin ti mbẹ li eti okun ni ọ̀pọlọpọ, nwọn njẹ, nwọn si nmu, nwọn si nṣe ariya.
entries.en: Judah and Israel were many, as the sand which is by the sea in multitude, eating and drinking, and making merry.

entries.yo: Solomoni si jọba lori gbogbo awọn ọba lati odò titi de ilẹ awọn ara Filistia, ati titi de eti ilẹ Egipti: nwọn nmu ọrẹ wá, nwọn si nsìn Solomoni ni gbogbo ọjọ aiye rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Solomon reigned over all kingdoms from the river unto the land of the Philistines, and unto the border of Egypt: they brought presents, and served Solomon all the days of his life.

entries.yo: Onjẹ Solomoni fun ijọ kan jasi ọgbọ̀n iyẹ̀fun kikunna ati ọgọta oṣuwọn iyẹ̀fun iru miran.
entries.en: And Solomon's provision for one day was thirty measures of fine flour, and threescore measures of meal,

entries.yo: Malu mẹwa ti o sanra, ati ogún malu lati inu papa wá, ati ọgọrun agutan, laika agbọ̀nrin, ati egbin, ati ogbúgbu, ati ẹiyẹ ti o sanra.
entries.en: Ten fat oxen, and twenty oxen out of the pastures, and an hundred sheep, beside harts, and roebucks, and fallowdeer, and fatted fowl.

entries.yo: Nitori on li o ṣe alaṣẹ lori gbogbo agbègbe ni iha ihin odò, lati Tifsa titi de Gasa, lori gbogbo awọn ọba ni iha ihin odò: o si ni alafia ni iha gbogbo yi i kakiri.
entries.en: For he had dominion over all the region on this side the river, from Tiphsah even to Azzah, over all the kings on this side the river: and he had peace on all sides round about him.

entries.yo: Juda ati Israeli ngbe li alafia, olukuluku labẹ àjara rẹ̀ ati labẹ igi ọpọtọ́ rẹ̀, lati Dani titi de Beerṣeba, ni gbogbo ọjọ Solomoni.
entries.en: And Judah and Israel dwelt safely, every man under his vine and under his fig tree, from Dan even to Beer-sheba, all the days of Solomon.

entries.yo: Solomoni si ni ẹgbãji ile-ẹṣin fun kẹkẹ́ rẹ̀, ati ẹgbãfa ẹlẹṣin.
entries.en: And Solomon had forty thousand stalls of horses for his chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen.

entries.yo: Awọn ijoye na si pesè onjẹ fun Solomoni ọba, ati fun gbogbo awọn ti o wá sibi tabili Solomoni ọba, olukuluku li oṣu tirẹ̀: nwọn kò fẹ nkankan kù.
entries.en: And those officers provided victual for king Solomon, and for all that came unto king Solomon's table, every man in his month: they lacked nothing.

entries.yo: Ọkà barle pẹlu, ati koriko fun ẹṣin ati fun ẹṣin sisare ni nwọn mu wá sibiti o gbe wà, olukuluku gẹgẹ bi ilana tirẹ̀.
entries.en: Barley also and straw for the horses and dromedaries brought they unto the place where the officers were, every man according to his charge.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si fun Solomoni li ọgbọ́n ati oye li ọ̀pọlọpọ, ati oye gbigboro, gẹgẹ bi iyanrin ti o wà leti okun.
entries.en: And God gave Solomon wisdom and understanding exceeding much, and largeness of heart, even as the sand that is on the sea shore.

entries.yo: Ọgbọ́n Solomoni si bori ọgbọ́n gbogbo awọn ọmọ ila-õrun, ati gbogbo ọgbọ́n Egipti.
entries.en: And Solomon's wisdom excelled the wisdom of all the children of the east country, and all the wisdom of Egypt.

entries.yo: On si gbọ́n jù gbogbo enia; jù Etani, ara Esra, ati Hemani, ati Kalkoli, ati Dara, awọn ọmọ Maholi: okiki rẹ̀ si kàn ni gbogbo orilẹ-ède yíka.
entries.en: For he was wiser than all men; than Ethan the Ezrahite, and Heman, and Chalcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol: and his fame was in all nations round about.

entries.yo: O si pa ẹgbẹdọgbọn owe: orin rẹ̀ si jẹ ẹgbẹrun o le marun.
entries.en: And he spake three thousand proverbs: and his songs were a thousand and five.

entries.yo: O si sọ̀rọ ti igi, lati kedari ti mbẹ ni Lebanoni, ani titi de hissopu ti nhu lara ogiri: o si sọ̀ ti ẹranko pẹlu, ati ti ẹiyẹ, ati ohun ti nrako, ati ti ẹja.
entries.en: And he spake of trees, from the cedar tree that is in Lebanon even unto the hyssop that springeth out of the wall: he spake also of beasts, and of fowl, and of creeping things, and of fishes.

entries.yo: Ẹni pupọ si wá lati gbogbo orilẹ-ède lati gbọ́ ọgbọ́n Solomoni; ani lati ọdọ gbogbo awọn ọba aiye, ti o gburo ọgbọ́n rẹ̀.
entries.en: And there came of all people to hear the wisdom of Solomon, from all kings of the earth, which had heard of his wisdom.

entries.yo: HIRAMU, ọba Tire, si rán awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀ si Solomoni; nitoriti o ti gbọ́ pe, a ti fi ororo yàn a li ọba ni ipò baba rẹ̀: nitori Hiramu ti fẹràn Dafidi li ọjọ rẹ̀ gbogbo.
entries.en: And Hiram king of Tyre sent his servants unto Solomon; for he had heard that they had anointed him king in the room of his father: for Hiram was ever a lover of David.

entries.yo: Solomoni si ranṣẹ si Hiramu wipe,
entries.en: And Solomon sent to Hiram, saying,

entries.yo: Iwọ mọ̀ bi Dafidi, baba mi, kò ti le kọ́ ile fun orukọ Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ̀ nitori ogun ti o wà yi i ka kiri, titi Oluwa fi fi wọn sabẹ atẹlẹsẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Thou knowest how that David my father could not build an house unto the name of the LORD his God for the wars which were about him on every side, until the LORD put them under the soles of his feet.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nisisiyi Oluwa Ọlọrun mi ti fun mi ni isimi niha gbogbo, bẹ̃ni kò si si ọta tabi ibi kan ti o ṣẹ̀.
entries.en: But now the LORD my God hath given me rest on every side, so that there is neither adversary nor evil occurrent.

entries.yo: Si kiye si i, mo gbèro lati kọ́ ile kan fun orukọ Oluwa Ọlọrun mi, gẹgẹ bi Oluwa ti sọ fun Dafidi, baba mi pe, Ọmọ rẹ, ti emi o gbe kà ori itẹ́ rẹ ni ipò rẹ, on ni yio kọ́ ile na fun orukọ mi.
entries.en: And, behold, I purpose to build an house unto the name of the LORD my God, as the LORD spake unto David my father, saying, Thy son, whom I will set upon thy throne in thy room, he shall build an house unto my name.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, paṣẹ ki nwọn ki o ke igi kedari fun mi lati Lebanoni wá, awọn ọmọ ọdọ mi yio si wà pẹlu awọn ọmọ ọdọ rẹ, iwọ ni emi o si sanwo ọyà awọn ọmọ ọdọ rẹ fun, gẹgẹ bi gbogbo eyi ti iwọ o wi: nitoriti iwọ mọ̀ pe, kò si ẹnikan ninu wa ti o mọ̀ bi a ti ike igi bi awọn ara Sidoni.
entries.en: Now therefore command thou that they hew me cedar trees out of Lebanon; and my servants shall be with thy servants: and unto thee will I give hire for thy servants according to all that thou shalt appoint: for thou knowest that there is not among us any that can skill to hew timber like unto the Sidonians.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati Hiramu gbọ́ ọ̀rọ Solomoni, o yọ̀ pipọ, o si wipe, Olubukún li Oluwa loni, ti o fun Dafidi ni ọmọ ọlọgbọ́n lori awọn enia pupọ yi.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when Hiram heard the words of Solomon, that he rejoiced greatly, and said, Blessed be the LORD this day, which hath given unto David a wise son over this great people.

entries.yo: Hiramu si ranṣẹ si Solomoni pe, Emi ti gbọ́ eyi ti iwọ ránṣẹ si mi, emi o ṣe gbogbo ifẹ rẹ niti igi kedari ati niti igi firi.
entries.en: And Hiram sent to Solomon, saying, I have considered the things which thou sentest to me for: and I will do all thy desire concerning timber of cedar, and concerning timber of fir.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ ọdọ mi yio mu igi na sọkalẹ lati Lebanoni wá si okun: emi o si fi wọn ṣọwọ si ọ ni fifó li omi okun titi de ibi ti iwọ o nà ika si fun mi, emi o si mu ki nwọn ki o ko wọn sibẹ, iwọ o si ko wọn lọ: iwọ o si ṣe ifẹ mi, lati fi onjẹ fun ile mi.
entries.en: My servants shall bring them down from Lebanon unto the sea: and I will convey them by sea in floats unto the place that thou shalt appoint me, and will cause them to be discharged there, and thou shalt receive them: and thou shalt accomplish my desire, in giving food for my household.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Hiramu fun Solomoni ni igi kedari ati igi firi gẹgẹ bi gbogbo ifẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: So Hiram gave Solomon cedar trees and fir trees according to all his desire.

entries.yo: Solomoni si fun Hiramu ni ẹgbãwa oṣuwọ̀n ọkà ni onjẹ fun ile rẹ̀, ati ogún oṣuwọ̀n ororo daradara; bẹ̃ni Solomoni nfi fun Hiramu li ọdọdun.
entries.en: And Solomon gave Hiram twenty thousand measures of wheat for food to his household, and twenty measures of pure oil: thus gave Solomon to Hiram year by year.

entries.yo: Oluwa si fun Solomoni li ọgbọ́n gẹgẹ bi o ti wi fun u: alafia si wà lãrin Hiramu ati Solomoni; awọn mejeji si ṣe adehùn.
entries.en: And the LORD gave Solomon wisdom, as he promised him: and there was peace between Hiram and Solomon; and they two made a league together.

entries.yo: Solomoni ọba, si ṣà asìnrú enia jọ ni gbogbo Israeli; awọn asìnrú na jẹ ẹgbã mẹdogun enia.
entries.en: And king Solomon raised a levy out of all Israel; and the levy was thirty thousand men.

entries.yo: O si ràn wọn lọ si Lebanoni, ẹgbarun loṣoṣu, li ọwọ̀-ọwọ́; nwọn wà ni Lebanoni loṣu kan, nwọn a si gbe ile li oṣu meji: Adoniramu li o si ṣe olori awọn alasìnru na.
entries.en: And he sent them to Lebanon ten thousand a month by courses: a month they were in Lebanon, and two months at home: and Adoniram was over the levy.

entries.yo: Solomoni si ni ẹgbã marundilogoji enia ti nru ẹrù, ọkẹ mẹrin gbẹnagbẹna lori oke;
entries.en: And Solomon had threescore and ten thousand that bare burdens, and fourscore thousand hewers in the mountains;

entries.yo: Laikà awọn ijoye ninu awọn ti a fi ṣe olori iṣẹ Solomoni, ẹgbẹrindilogun o le ọgọrun enia, ti o nṣe alaṣẹ awọn enia ti nṣisẹ na.
entries.en: Beside the chief of Solomon's officers which were over the work, three thousand and three hundred, which ruled over the people that wrought in the work.

entries.yo: Ọba si paṣẹ, nwọn si mu okuta wá, okuta iyebiye, ati okuta gbígbẹ lati fi ipilẹ ile na le ilẹ.
entries.en: And the king commanded, and they brought great stones, costly stones, and hewed stones, to lay the foundation of the house.

entries.yo: Awọn akọle Solomoni, ati awọn akọle Hiramu si gbẹ́ wọn, ati awọn ara Gebali: nwọn si pèse igi ati okuta lati kọ́ ile na.
entries.en: And Solomon's builders and Hiram's builders did hew them, and the stonesquarers: so they prepared timber and stones to build the house.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, ni ọrinlenirinwo ọdun, lẹhin igbati awọn ọmọ Israeli jade kuro ni ilẹ Egipti, li ọdun kẹrin ijọba Solomoni lori Israeli, li oṣu Sifi ti iṣe oṣu keji, li o bẹ̀rẹ si ikọ́ ile fun Oluwa.
entries.en: And it came to pass in the four hundred and eightieth year after the children of Israel were come out of the land of Egypt, in the fourth year of Solomon's reign over Israel, in the month Zif, which is the second month, that he began to build the house of the LORD.

entries.yo: Ile na ti Solomoni ọba kọ́ fun Oluwa, gigun rẹ̀ jẹ ọgọta igbọnwọ, ibú rẹ̀, ogun igbọnwọ, ati giga rẹ̀, ọgbọn igbọnwọ.
entries.en: And the house which king Solomon built for the LORD, the length thereof was threescore cubits, and the breadth thereof twenty cubits, and the height thereof thirty cubits.

entries.yo: Ati ọ̀dẹdẹ niwaju tempili ile na, ogún igbọnwọ ni gigùn rẹ̀, gẹgẹ bi ibú ile na: igbọnwọ mẹwa si ni ibú rẹ̀ niwaju ile na.
entries.en: And the porch before the temple of the house, twenty cubits was the length thereof, according to the breadth of the house; and ten cubits was the breadth thereof before the house.

entries.yo: Ati fun ile na ni a ṣe ferese fun síse.
entries.en: And for the house he made windows of narrow lights.

entries.yo: Lara ogiri ile na li o bù yàra yika; ati tempili, ati ibi-mimọ́-julọ, li o si ṣe yara yika.
entries.en: And against the wall of the house he built chambers round about, against the walls of the house round about, both of the temple and of the oracle: and he made chambers round about:

entries.yo: Yara isalẹ, igbọnwọ marun ni gbigbòro rẹ̀, ti ãrin, igbọnwọ mẹfa ni gbigbòro rẹ̀, ati ẹkẹta, igbọnwọ meje ni gbigbòro rẹ̀, nitori lode ogiri ile na li o dín igbọnwọ kọ̃kan kakiri, ki igi-àja ki o má ba wọ inu ogiri ile na.
entries.en: The nethermost chamber was five cubits broad, and the middle was six cubits broad, and the third was seven cubits broad: for without in the wall of the house he made narrowed rests round about, that the beams should not be fastened in the walls of the house.

entries.yo: Ile na, nigbati a nkọ́ ọ, okuta ti a ti gbẹ́ silẹ ki a to mu u wá ibẹ li a fi kọ́ ọ, bẹ̃ni a kò si gburo mataka, tabi ãke, tabi ohun-elo irin kan nigbati a nkọ́ ọ lọwọ.
entries.en: And the house, when it was in building, was built of stone made ready before it was brought thither: so that there was neither hammer nor axe nor any tool of iron heard in the house, while it was in building.

entries.yo: Ilẹkun yara ãrin mbẹ li apa ọtún ile na: nwọn si fi àtẹgun ti o lọ́ri goke sinu yàra ãrin, ati lati yara ãrin bọ sinu ẹkẹta.
entries.en: The door for the middle chamber was in the right side of the house: and they went up with winding stairs into the middle chamber, and out of the middle into the third.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li o kọ́ ile na, ti o si pari rẹ̀: o si fi gbelerù ati apako kedari bò ile na.
entries.en: So he built the house, and finished it; and covered the house with beams and boards of cedar.

entries.yo: O si kọ́ yara gbè gbogbo ile na, igbọnwọ marun ni giga: o fi ìti kedari mú wọn fi ara ti ile na.
entries.en: And then he built chambers against all the house, five cubits high: and they rested on the house with timber of cedar.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ Oluwa si tọ Solomoni wá wipe,
entries.en: And the word of the LORD came to Solomon, saying,

entries.yo: Nipa ti ile yi ti iwọ nkọ́ lọwọ nì, bi iwọ o ba rin ninu aṣẹ mi, ti iwọ o si ṣe idajọ mi, ati ti iwọ o si pa gbogbo ofin mi mọ lati ma rin ninu wọn, nigbana ni emi o mu ọ̀rọ mi ṣẹ pẹlu rẹ, ti mo ti sọ fun Dafidi, baba rẹ;
entries.en: Concerning this house which thou art in building, if thou wilt walk in my statutes, and execute my judgments, and keep all my commandments to walk in them; then will I perform my word with thee, which I spake unto David thy father:

entries.yo: Emi o si ma gbe ãrin awọn ọmọ Israeli, emi kì o si kọ̀ Israeli, enia mi.
entries.en: And I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will not forsake my people Israel.

entries.yo: Solomoni si kọ́ ile na, o si pari rẹ̀.
entries.en: So Solomon built the house, and finished it.

entries.yo: O si fi apako kedari tẹ́ ogiri ile na ninu, lati ilẹ ile na de àja rẹ̀; o fi igi bò wọn ninu, o si fi apako firi tẹ́ ilẹ ile na.
entries.en: And he built the walls of the house within with boards of cedar, both the floor of the house, and the walls of the cieling: and he covered them on the inside with wood, and covered the floor of the house with planks of fir.

entries.yo: O si kọ́ ogún igbọnwọ ni ikangun ile na, lati ilẹ de àja ile na li o fi apako kedari kọ́, o tilẹ kọ́ eyi fun u ninu, fun ibi-idahùn, ani ibi-mimọ́-julọ.
entries.en: And he built twenty cubits on the sides of the house, both the floor and the walls with boards of cedar: he even built them for it within, even for the oracle, even for the most holy place.

entries.yo: Ati ile na, eyini ni Tempili niwaju rẹ̀, jẹ ogoji igbọnwọ ni gigùn.
entries.en: And the house, that is, the temple before it, was forty cubits long.

entries.yo: Ati kedari ile na ninu ile li a fi irudi ati itanna ṣe iṣẹ ọnà rẹ̀: gbogbo rẹ̀ kiki igi kedari; a kò ri okuta kan.
entries.en: And the cedar of the house within was carved with knops and open flowers: all was cedar; there was no stone seen.

entries.yo: Ibi-mimọ́-julọ na li o mura silẹ ninu ile lati gbe apoti majẹmu Oluwa kà ibẹ.
entries.en: And the oracle he prepared in the house within, to set there the ark of the covenant of the LORD.

entries.yo: Ibi-mimọ́-julọ na si jasi ogún igbọnwọ ni gigùn, li apa ti iwaju, ati ogún igbọnwọ ni ibú, ati ogún igbọnwọ ni giga rẹ̀; o si fi wura ailadàlu bò o, bẹ̃li o si fi igi kedari bò pẹpẹ.
entries.en: And the oracle in the forepart was twenty cubits in length, and twenty cubits in breadth, and twenty cubits in the height thereof: and he overlaid it with pure gold; and so covered the altar which was of cedar.

entries.yo: Solomoni si fi wura ailadàlu bò ile na ninu: o si fi ẹwọ́n wura ṣe oju ibi-mimọ́-julọ, o si fi wura bò o.
entries.en: So Solomon overlaid the house within with pure gold: and he made a partition by the chains of gold before the oracle; and he overlaid it with gold.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ile na li o si fi wura bò titi o fi pari gbogbo ile na; ati gbogbo pẹpẹ ti o wà niha ibi-mimọ́-julọ li o fi wura bò.
entries.en: And the whole house he overlaid with gold, until he had finished all the house: also the whole altar that was by the oracle he overlaid with gold.

entries.yo: Ati ninu ibi-mimọ́-julọ li o fi igi olifi ṣe kerubu meji, ọkọkan jẹ igbọnwọ mẹwa ni giga.
entries.en: And within the oracle he made two cherubims of olive tree, each ten cubits high.

entries.yo: Ati igbọnwọ marun ni apa kerubu kan, ati igbọnwọ marun ni apa kerubu keji; lati igun apakan titi de igun apa-keji jẹ igbọnwọ mẹwa.
entries.en: And five cubits was the one wing of the cherub, and five cubits the other wing of the cherub: from the uttermost part of the one wing unto the uttermost part of the other were ten cubits.

entries.yo: Igbọnwọ mẹwa si ni kerubu keji: kerubu mejeji jẹ ìwọn kanna ati titobi kanna.
entries.en: And the other cherub was ten cubits: both the cherubims were of one measure and one size.

entries.yo: Giga kerubu kan jẹ igbọnwọ mẹwa, bẹ̃ni ti kerubu keji.
entries.en: The height of the one cherub was ten cubits, and so was it of the other cherub.

entries.yo: O si fi awọn kerubu sinu ile ti inu lọhun, nwọn si nà iyẹ-apa kerubu na, tobẹ̃ ti iyẹ-apa ọkan si kàn ogiri kan, ati iyẹ-apa kerubu keji si kàn ogiri keji: iyẹ-apa wọn si kàn ara wọn larin ile na.
entries.en: And he set the cherubims within the inner house: and they stretched forth the wings of the cherubims, so that the wing of the one touched the one wall, and the wing of the other cherub touched the other wall; and their wings touched one another in the midst of the house.

entries.yo: O si fi wura bò awọn kerubu na.
entries.en: And he overlaid the cherubims with gold.

entries.yo: O si yá aworan awọn kerubu lara gbogbo ogiri ile na yikakiri ati ti igi-ọpẹ, ati ti itanna eweko, ninu ati lode.
entries.en: And he carved all the walls of the house round about with carved figures of cherubims and palm trees and open flowers, within and without.

entries.yo: Ilẹ ile na li o fi wura tẹ́ ninu ati lode.
entries.en: And the floor of the house he overlaid with gold, within and without.

entries.yo: Ati fun oju-ọ̀na ibi-mimọ́-julọ li o ṣe ilẹkùn igi olifi: itẹrigbà ati opó ihà jẹ idamarun ogiri.
entries.en: And for the entering of the oracle he made doors of olive tree: the lintel and side posts were a fifth part of the wall.

entries.yo: Ilẹkùn mejeji na li o si fi igi olifi ṣe; o si yá aworan awọn kerubu ati ti igi-ọpẹ, ati ti itanna eweko sara wọn, o si fi wura bò wọn, o si nà wura si ara awọn kerubu, ati si ara igi-ọpẹ.
entries.en: The two doors also were of olive tree; and he carved upon them carvings of cherubims and palm trees and open flowers, and overlaid them with gold, and spread gold upon the cherubims, and upon the palm trees.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li o si ṣe opó igi olifi olorigun mẹrin fun ilẹkun tempili na.
entries.en: So also made he for the door of the temple posts of olive tree, a fourth part of the wall.

entries.yo: Ilẹkun mejeji si jẹ ti igi firi: awẹ́ meji ilẹkun kan jẹ iṣẹ́po, ati awẹ́ meji ilẹkun keji si jẹ iṣẹ́po.
entries.en: And the two doors were of fir tree: the two leaves of the one door were folding, and the two leaves of the other door were folding.

entries.yo: O si yá awọn kerubu, ati igi-ọpẹ, ati itanna eweko si ara wọn: o si fi wura bò o, eyi ti o tẹ́ sori ibi ti o gbẹ́.
entries.en: And he carved thereon cherubims and palm trees and open flowers: and covered them with gold fitted upon the carved work.

entries.yo: O si fi ẹsẹsẹ mẹta okuta gbigbẹ́, ati ẹsẹ kan ìti kedari kọ́ agbala ti inu ọhun.
entries.en: And he built the inner court with three rows of hewed stone, and a row of cedar beams.

entries.yo: Li ọdun kẹrin li a fi ipilẹ ile Oluwa le ilẹ̀, li oṣu Sifi.
entries.en: In the fourth year was the foundation of the house of the LORD laid, in the month Zif:

entries.yo: Ati li ọdun kọkanla, li oṣu Bulu, ti iṣe oṣu kẹjọ, ni ile na pari jalẹ-jalẹ, pẹlu gbogbo ipin rẹ̀, gẹgẹ bi gbogbo eyi ti o yẹ: o si fi ọdun meje kọ́ ọ.
entries.en: And in the eleventh year, in the month Bul, which is the eighth month, was the house finished throughout all the parts thereof, and according to all the fashion of it. So was he seven years in building it.

entries.yo: ṢUGBỌN Solomoni fi ọdun mẹtala kọ́ ile on tikararẹ̀, o si pari gbogbo iṣẹ ile rẹ̀.
entries.en: But Solomon was building his own house thirteen years, and he finished all his house.

entries.yo: O kọ́ ile-igbó Lebanoni pẹlu; gigùn rẹ̀ jasi ọgọrun igbọnwọ, ati ibú rẹ̀ adọta igbọnwọ, ati giga rẹ̀ ọgbọ̀n igbọnwọ, lori ọ̀wọ́ mẹrin opó igi kedari, ati idabu igi kedari lori awọn opó na.
entries.en: He built also the house of the forest of Lebanon; the length thereof was an hundred cubits, and the breadth thereof fifty cubits, and the height thereof thirty cubits, upon four rows of cedar pillars, with cedar beams upon the pillars.

entries.yo: A si fi igi kedari tẹ́ ẹ loke lori iyara ti o joko lori ọwọ̀n marunlelogoji, mẹdogun ni ọ̀wọ́.
entries.en: And it was covered with cedar above upon the beams, that lay on forty five pillars, fifteen in a row.

entries.yo: Ferese si wà ni ọ̀wọ́ mẹta, oju si ko oju ni ọ̀na mẹta.
entries.en: And there were windows in three rows, and light was against light in three ranks.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ilẹkun ati opó si dọgba ni igun mẹrin; oju si ko oju ni ọ̀na mẹta.
entries.en: And all the doors and posts were square, with the windows: and light was against light in three ranks.

entries.yo: O si fi ọwọ̀n ṣe iloro: gigùn rẹ̀ jẹ adọta igbọnwọ, ibú rẹ̀ si jẹ ọgbọ̀n igbọnwọ, iloro kan si wà niwaju rẹ̀: ani ọwọ̀n miran, igi itẹsẹ ti o nipọn si mbẹ niwaju wọn.
entries.en: And he made a porch of pillars; the length thereof was fifty cubits, and the breadth thereof thirty cubits: and the porch was before them: and the other pillars and the thick beam were before them.

entries.yo: O si ṣe iloro itẹ nibiti yio ma ṣe idajọ, ani iloro idajọ: a si fi igi kedari tẹ ẹ lati iha kan de keji.
entries.en: Then he made a porch for the throne where he might judge, even the porch of judgment: and it was covered with cedar from one side of the floor to the other.

entries.yo: Ile rẹ̀ nibiti o ngbe, ni agbala lẹhin ile titi de ọ̀dẹdẹ, si jẹ iṣẹ kanna. Solomoni si kọ́ ile fun ọmọbinrin Farao, ti o ni li aya, bi iloro yi.
entries.en: And his house where he dwelt had another court within the porch, which was of the like work. Solomon made also an house for Pharaoh's daughter, whom he had taken to wife, like unto this porch.

entries.yo: Gbogbo wọnyi jẹ okuta iyebiye gẹgẹ bi iwọn okuta gbigbẹ́, ti a fi ayùn rẹ́ ninu ati lode, ani lati ipilẹ de ibori-oke ile, bẹ̃ si ni lode si apa agbala nla.
entries.en: All these were of costly stones, according to the measures of hewed stones, sawed with saws, within and without, even from the foundation unto the coping, and so on the outside toward the great court.

entries.yo: Ipilẹ na jẹ okuta iyebiye, ani okuta nlanla, okuta igbọnwọ mẹwa, ati okuta igbọnwọ mẹjọ.
entries.en: And the foundation was of costly stones, even great stones, stones of ten cubits, and stones of eight cubits.

entries.yo: Ati okuta iyebiye wà loke nipa iwọ̀n okuta ti a gbẹ́, ati igi kedari.
entries.en: And above were costly stones, after the measures of hewed stones, and cedars.

entries.yo: Ati agbàla nla yikakiri pẹlu jẹ ọ̀wọ́ mẹta okuta gbigbẹ́, ati ọ̀wọ́ kan igi idabu ti kedari, ati fun agbala ile Oluwa ti inu lọhun, ati fun iloro ile na.
entries.en: And the great court round about was with three rows of hewed stones, and a row of cedar beams, both for the inner court of the house of the LORD, and for the porch of the house.

entries.yo: Solomoni ọba si ranṣẹ, o si mu Hiramu lati Tire wá.
entries.en: And king Solomon sent and fetched Hiram out of Tyre.

entries.yo: Ọmọkunrin opó kan ni, lati inu ẹya Naftali, baba rẹ̀ si ṣe ara Tire, alagbẹdẹ idẹ: on si kún fun ọgbọ́n, ati oye, ati ìmọ lati ṣe iṣẹkiṣẹ ni idẹ. O si tọ̀ Solomoni ọba wá, o si ṣe gbogbo iṣẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: He was a widow's son of the tribe of Naphtali, and his father was a man of Tyre, a worker in brass: and he was filled with wisdom, and understanding, and cunning to work all works in brass. And he came to king Solomon, and wrought all his work.

entries.yo: O si dà ọwọ̀n idẹ meji, igbọnwọ mejidilogun ni giga ọkọkan: okùn igbọnwọ mejila li o si yi ọkọkan wọn ka.
entries.en: For he cast two pillars of brass, of eighteen cubits high apiece: and a line of twelve cubits did compass either of them about.

entries.yo: O si ṣe ipari meji ti idẹ didà lati fi soke awọn ọwọ̀n na: giga ipari kan jẹ igbọnwọ marun, ati giga ipari keji jẹ igbọnwọ marun:
entries.en: And he made two chapiters of molten brass, to set upon the tops of the pillars: the height of the one chapiter was five cubits, and the height of the other chapiter was five cubits:

entries.yo: Ati oniruru iṣẹ, ati ohun wiwun iṣẹ ẹ̀wọn fun awọn ipari ti mbẹ lori awọn ọwọ̀n na; meje fun ipari kan, ati meje fun ipari keji.
entries.en: And nets of checker work, and wreaths of chain work, for the chapiters which were upon the top of the pillars; seven for the one chapiter, and seven for the other chapiter.

entries.yo: O si ṣe awọn pomegranate ani ọ̀wọ́ meji yikakiri lara iṣẹ àwọn na, lati fi bò awọn ipari ti mbẹ loke: bẹ̃li o si ṣe fun ipari keji.
entries.en: And he made the pillars, and two rows round about upon the one network, to cover the chapiters that were upon the top, with pomegranates: and so did he for the other chapiter.

entries.yo: Ati ipari ti mbẹ li oke awọn ọwọ̀n ti mbẹ ni ọ̀dẹdẹ na ti iṣẹ lili, ni igbọnwọ mẹrin.
entries.en: And the chapiters that were upon the top of the pillars were of lily work in the porch, four cubits.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ipari lori ọwọ̀n meji na wà loke: nwọn si sunmọ ibi ti o yọ lara ọwọ̀n ti o wà nibi iṣẹ àwọn: awọn pomegranate jẹ igba ni ọ̀wọ́ yikakiri, lori ipari keji.
entries.en: And the chapiters upon the two pillars had pomegranates also above, over against the belly which was by the network: and the pomegranates were two hundred in rows round about upon the other chapiter.

entries.yo: O si gbe awọn ọwọ̀n na ro ni iloro tempili: o si gbe ọwọ̀n ọ̀tun ró, o si pe orukọ rẹ̀ ni Jakini: o si gbe ọwọ̀n òsi ró, o si pe orukọ rẹ̀ ni Boasi.
entries.en: And he set up the pillars in the porch of the temple: and he set up the right pillar, and called the name thereof Jachin: and he set up the left pillar, and he called the name thereof Boaz.

entries.yo: Lori oke awọn ọwọ̀n na ni iṣẹ lili wà; bẽni iṣẹ ti awọn ọwọ̀n si pari.
entries.en: And upon the top of the pillars was lily work: so was the work of the pillars finished.

entries.yo: O si ṣe agbada nla didà igbọnwọ mẹwa lati eti kan de ekeji: o ṣe birikiti, giga rẹ̀ si jẹ igbọnwọ marun: okùn ọgbọ̀n igbọnwọ li o si yi i kakiri.
entries.en: And he made a molten sea, ten cubits from the one brim to the other: it was round all about, and his height was five cubits: and a line of thirty cubits did compass it round about.

entries.yo: Ati nisalẹ eti rẹ̀ yikakiri kóko wà yi i ka, mẹwa ninu igbọnwọ kan, o yi agbada nla na kakiri: a dà kóko na ni ẹsẹ meji, nigbati a dà a.
entries.en: And under the brim of it round about there were knops compassing it, ten in a cubit, compassing the sea round about: the knops were cast in two rows, when it was cast.

entries.yo: O duro lori malu mejila, mẹta nwo iha ariwa, mẹta si nwo iwọ-õrun, mẹ̃ta si nwo gusu, mẹta si nwo ila-õrun; agbada nla na si joko lori wọn, gbogbo apa ẹhin wọn si mbẹ ninu.
entries.en: It stood upon twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east: and the sea was set above upon them, and all their hinder parts were inward.

entries.yo: O si nipọn to ibú atẹlẹwọ, a si fi itanna lili ṣiṣẹ eti rẹ̀ gẹgẹ bi eti ago, o si gbà ẹgbã iwọ̀n Bati.
entries.en: And it was an hand breadth thick, and the brim thereof was wrought like the brim of a cup, with flowers of lilies: it contained two thousand baths.

entries.yo: O si ṣe ijoko idẹ mẹwa; igbọnwọ mẹrin ni gigùn ijoko kọkan, igbọnwọ mẹrin si ni ibú rẹ̀, ati igbọnwọ mẹta ni giga rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he made ten bases of brass; four cubits was the length of one base, and four cubits the breadth thereof, and three cubits the height of it.

entries.yo: Iṣẹ awọn ijoko na ri bayi: nwọn ni alafo ọ̀na arin, alafo ọ̀na arin na si wà lagbedemeji ipade eti.
entries.en: And the work of the bases was on this manner: they had borders, and the borders were between the ledges:

entries.yo: Ati lara alafo ọ̀na arin ti mbẹ lagbedemeji ni aworan kiniun, malu, ati awọn kerubu wà; ati lori ipade eti, ijoko kan wà loke: ati labẹ awọn kiniun, ati malu ni iṣẹ ọṣọ́ wà.
entries.en: And on the borders that were between the ledges were lions, oxen, and cherubims: and upon the ledges there was a base above: and beneath the lions and oxen were certain additions made of thin work.

entries.yo: Olukuluku ijoko li o ni ayika kẹkẹ́ idẹ mẹrin, ati ọpa kẹkẹ́ idẹ: igun mẹrẹrin rẹ̀ li o ni ifẹsẹtẹ labẹ; labẹ agbada na ni ifẹsẹtẹ didà wà, ni iha gbogbo iṣẹ ọṣọ́ na.
entries.en: And every base had four brasen wheels, and plates of brass: and the four corners thereof had undersetters: under the laver were undersetters molten, at the side of every addition.

entries.yo: Ẹnu rẹ̀ ninu ipari na ati loke jẹ igbọnwọ kan: ṣugbọn ẹnu rẹ̀ yika gẹgẹ bi iṣẹ ijoko na, si jẹ igbọnwọ kan on àbọ: ati li ẹnu rẹ̀ ni ohun ọnà gbigbẹ́ wà pẹlu alafo ọ̀na arin wọn, nwọn si dọgba ni igun mẹrẹrin, nwọn kò yika.
entries.en: And the mouth of it within the chapiter and above was a cubit: but the mouth thereof was round after the work of the base, a cubit and an half: and also upon the mouth of it were gravings with their borders, foursquare, not round.

entries.yo: Ati nisalẹ alafo ọ̀na arin, ayika-kẹkẹ́ mẹrin li o wà: a si so ọpa ayika-kẹkẹ́ na mọ ijoko na; giga ayika-kẹkẹ́ kan si jẹ igbọnwọ kan pẹlu àbọ.
entries.en: And under the borders were four wheels; and the axletrees of the wheels were joined to the base: and the height of a wheel was a cubit and a half a cubit.

entries.yo: Iṣẹ ayika-kẹkẹ́ na si dabi iṣẹ kẹkẹ́; igi idalu wọn, ati ibi iho, ati ibi ipade, ati abukala wọn, didà ni gbogbo wọn.
entries.en: And the work of the wheels was like the work of a chariot wheel: their axletrees, and their naves, and their felloes, and their spokes, were all molten.

entries.yo: Ifẹsẹtẹ mẹrin li o wà fun igun mẹrin ijoko na: ifẹsẹtẹ na si jẹ ti ijoko tikararẹ̀ papã.
entries.en: And there were four undersetters to the four corners of one base: and the undersetters were of the very base itself.

entries.yo: Ati loke ijoko na, ayika kan wà ti àbọ igbọnwọ: ati loke ijoko na ẹgbẹgbẹti rẹ̀ ati alafo ọ̀na arin rẹ̀ jẹ bakanna.
entries.en: And in the top of the base was there a round compass of half a cubit high: and on the top of the base the ledges thereof and the borders thereof were of the same.

entries.yo: Ati lara iha ẹgbẹti rẹ̀, ati leti rẹ̀, li o gbẹ́ aworan kerubu, kiniun, ati igi-ọpẹ gẹgẹ bi aye olukuluku, ati iṣẹ ọṣọ yikakiri.
entries.en: For on the plates of the ledges thereof, and on the borders thereof, he graved cherubims, lions, and palm trees, according to the proportion of every one, and additions round about.

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bayi li o si ṣe awọn ijoko mẹwẹwa: gbogbo wọn li o si ni didà kanna, iwọ̀n kanna ati titobi kanna.
entries.en: After this manner he made the ten bases: all of them had one casting, one measure, and one size.

entries.yo: O si ṣe agbada idẹ mẹwa: agbada kan gbà to òji iwọn Bati: agbada kọ̃kan si jẹ igbọnwọ mẹrin: lori ọkọ̃kan ijoko mẹwẹwa na ni agbada kọ̃kan wà.
entries.en: Then made he ten lavers of brass: one laver contained forty baths: and every laver was four cubits: and upon every one of the ten bases one laver.

entries.yo: O si fi ijoko marun si apa ọtún ile na, ati marun si apa òsi ile na: o si gbe agbada-nla ka apa ọ̀tún ile na, si apa ila-õrun si idojukọ gusu:
entries.en: And he put five bases on the right side of the house, and five on the left side of the house: and he set the sea on the right side of the house eastward over against the south.

entries.yo: Hiramu si ṣe ikoko ati ọkọ́, ati awo-koto. Bẹ̃ni Hiramu si pari gbogbo iṣẹ ti o ṣe fun ile Oluwa fun Solomoni ọba:
entries.en: And Hiram made the lavers, and the shovels, and the basons. So Hiram made an end of doing all the work that he made king Solomon for the house of the LORD:

entries.yo: Ọwọ̀n meji, ati ọpọ́n meji ipari ti mbẹ loke awọn ọwọ̀n meji; ati iṣẹ àwọ̀n meji lati bò ọpọ́n meji ipari ti mbẹ loke awọn ọwọ̀n;
entries.en: The two pillars, and the two bowls of the chapiters that were on the top of the two pillars; and the two networks, to cover the two bowls of the chapiters which were upon the top of the pillars;

entries.yo: Ati irinwo pomegranate fun iṣẹ àwọ̀n meji, ọ̀wọ́ meji pomegranate fun iṣẹ àwọ̀n kan, lati bò awọn ọpọ́n meji ipari ti mbẹ loke awọn ọwọ̀n;
entries.en: And four hundred pomegranates for the two networks, even two rows of pomegranates for one network, to cover the two bowls of the chapiters that were upon the pillars;

entries.yo: Ati ijoko mẹwa, ati agbada mẹwa lori awọn ijoko na.
entries.en: And the ten bases, and ten lavers on the bases;

entries.yo: Agbada nla kan, ati malu mejila labẹ agbada nla.
entries.en: And one sea, and twelve oxen under the sea;
