entries.yo: Ati ikoko, ati ọkọ́, ati awo-koto; ati gbogbo ohun-elo wọnyi ti Hiramu ṣe fun ile Oluwa fun Solomoni ọba, jẹ ti idẹ didan.
entries.en: And the pots, and the shovels, and the basons: and all these vessels, which Hiram made to king Solomon for the house of the LORD, were of bright brass.

entries.yo: Ni pẹtẹlẹ Jordani ni ọba dà wọn, ni ilẹ amọ̀ ti mbẹ lagbedemeji Sukkoti on Sartani.
entries.en: In the plain of Jordan did the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zarthan.

entries.yo: Solomoni si jọwọ gbogbo ohun-elo na silẹ li alaiwọ̀n, nitori ti nwọn papọju: bẹ̃ni a kò si mọ̀ iwọ̀n idẹ na.
entries.en: And Solomon left all the vessels unweighed, because they were exceeding many: neither was the weight of the brass found out.

entries.yo: Solomoni si ṣe gbogbo ohun-elo ti iṣe ti ile Oluwa: pẹpẹ wura, ati tabili wura, lori eyi ti akara ifihan gbe wà.
entries.en: And Solomon made all the vessels that pertained unto the house of the LORD: the altar of gold, and the table of gold, whereupon the shewbread was,

entries.yo: Ati ọpa fitila wura daradara, marun li apa ọtún ati marun li apa òsi, niwaju ibi mimọ́-julọ, pẹlu itanna eweko, ati fitila, ati ẹ̀mú wura.
entries.en: And the candlesticks of pure gold, five on the right side, and five on the left, before the oracle, with the flowers, and the lamps, and the tongs of gold,

entries.yo: Ati ọpọ́n, ati alumagaji-fitila, ati awo-koto, ati ṣibi, ati awo turari ti wura daradara; ati agbekọ wura, fun ilẹkun inu ile, ibi mimọ́-julọ, ati fun ilẹkun ile na, ani ti tempili.
entries.en: And the bowls, and the snuffers, and the basons, and the spoons, and the censers of pure gold; and the hinges of gold, both for the doors of the inner house, the most holy place, and for the doors of the house, to wit, of the temple.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni gbogbo iṣẹ ti Solomoni ọba ṣe fun ile Oluwa pari. Solomoni si mu gbogbo nkan ti Dafidi baba rẹ̀ ti yà si mimọ́ wá; fadaka, ati wura, ati ohun-elo, o si fi wọn sinu iṣura ile Oluwa.
entries.en: So was ended all the work that king Solomon made for the house of the LORD. And Solomon brought in the things which David his father had dedicated; even the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, did he put among the treasures of the house of the LORD.

entries.yo: NIGBANA ni Solomoni papejọ awọn agba Israeli, ati gbogbo awọn olori awọn ẹ̀ya, awọn olori awọn baba awọn ọmọ Israeli, si ọdọ Solomoni ọba ni Jerusalemu, ki nwọn ki o lè gbe apoti-ẹri majẹmu Oluwa wá lati ilu Dafidi, ti iṣe Sioni.
entries.en: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel, and all the heads of the tribes, the chief of the fathers of the children of Israel, unto king Solomon in Jerusalem, that they might bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of the city of David, which is Zion.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn ọkunrin Israeli si pe ara wọn jọ si ọdọ Solomoni ọba ni ajọ ọdun ni oṣu Etanimu, ti iṣe oṣu keje.
entries.en: And all the men of Israel assembled themselves unto king Solomon at the feast in the month Ethanim, which is the seventh month.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn agbàgba Israeli si wá, awọn alufa si gbe apoti-ẹri.
entries.en: And all the elders of Israel came, and the priests took up the ark.

entries.yo: Nwọn si gbe apoti-ẹ̀ri Oluwa wá soke, ati agọ ajọ enia, ati gbogbo ohun-elo mimọ́ ti o wà ninu agọ ani nkan wọnni ni awọn alufa ati awọn ọmọ Lefi gbe goke wá.
entries.en: And they brought up the ark of the LORD, and the tabernacle of the congregation, and all the holy vessels that were in the tabernacle, even those did the priests and the Levites bring up.

entries.yo: Ati Solomoni ọba, ati gbogbo ijọ enia Israeli ti o pejọ si ọdọ rẹ̀ wà pẹlu rẹ̀ niwaju apoti-ẹri, nwọn nfi agutan ati malu ti a kò le mọ̀ iye, ti a kò le kà fun ọ̀pọlọpọ rubọ.
entries.en: And king Solomon, and all the congregation of Israel, that were assembled unto him, were with him before the ark, sacrificing sheep and oxen, that could not be told nor numbered for multitude.

entries.yo: Awọn alufa si gbe apoti-ẹri majẹmu Oluwa wá si ipò rẹ̀ sinu ibi-idahùn ile na, ni ibi mimọ́-julọ labẹ iyẹ awọn kerubu.
entries.en: And the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of the LORD unto his place, into the oracle of the house, to the most holy place, even under the wings of the cherubims.

entries.yo: Nitori awọn kerubu nà iyẹ wọn mejeji si ibi apoti-ẹri, awọn kerubu na si bò apọti-ẹri ati awọn ọpá rẹ̀ lati oke wá.
entries.en: For the cherubims spread forth their two wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubims covered the ark and the staves thereof above.

entries.yo: Nwọn si fa awọn ọpá na jade tobẹ̃ ti a nfi ri ori awọn ọpá na lati ibi mimọ́ niwaju ibi-idahùn, a kò si ri wọn lode: nibẹ ni awọn si wà titi di oni yi.
entries.en: And they drew out the staves, that the ends of the staves were seen out in the holy place before the oracle, and they were not seen without: and there they are unto this day.

entries.yo: Kò si nkankan ninu apoti-ẹri bikoṣe tabili okuta meji, ti Mose ti fi si ibẹ ni Horebu nigbati Oluwa ba awọn ọmọ Israeli dá majẹmu, nigbati nwọn ti ilẹ Egipti jade.
entries.en: There was nothing in the ark save the two tables of stone, which Moses put there at Horeb, when the LORD made a covenant with the children of Israel, when they came out of the land of Egypt.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati awọn alufa jade lati ibi mimọ́ wá, awọsanma si kún ile Oluwa.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when the priests were come out of the holy place, that the cloud filled the house of the LORD,

entries.yo: Awọn alufa kò si le duro ṣiṣẹ nitori awọsanma na: nitori ogo Oluwa kún ile Oluwa.
entries.en: So that the priests could not stand to minister because of the cloud: for the glory of the LORD had filled the house of the LORD.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Solomoni sọ pe: Oluwa ti wi pe, on o mã gbe inu okùnkun biribiri.
entries.en: Then spake Solomon, The LORD said that he would dwell in thick darkness.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ emi ti kọ́ ile kan fun ọ lati mã gbe inu rẹ̀, ibukojo kan fun ọ lati mã gbe inu rẹ̀ titi lai.
entries.en: I have surely built thee an house to dwell in, a settled place for thee to abide in for ever.

entries.yo: Ọba si yi oju rẹ̀, o si fi ibukún fun gbogbo ijọ enia Israeli: gbogbo ijọ enia Israeli si dide duro;
entries.en: And the king turned his face about, and blessed all the congregation of Israel: (and all the congregation of Israel stood;)

entries.yo: O si wipe, Ibukún ni fun Oluwa, Ọlọrun Israeli, ti o fi ẹnu rẹ̀ sọ̀rọ fun Dafidi, baba mi, ti o si fi ọwọ́ rẹ̀ mu u ṣẹ, wipe,
entries.en: And he said, Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, which spake with his mouth unto David my father, and hath with his hand fulfilled it, saying,

entries.yo: Lati ọjọ ti emi ti mu Israeli, awọn enia mi jade kuro ni Egipti, emi kò yàn ilu kan ninu gbogbo ẹyà Israeli lati kọ́ ile kan, ki orukọ mi ki o le mã gbe inu rẹ̀: ṣugbọn emi yàn Dafidi ṣe olori Israeli, awọn enia mi.
entries.en: Since the day that I brought forth my people Israel out of Egypt, I chose no city out of all the tribes of Israel to build an house, that my name might be therein; but I chose David to be over my people Israel.

entries.yo: O si wà li ọkàn Dafidi, baba mi, lati kọ́ ile kan fun orukọ Oluwa, Ọlọrun Israeli.
entries.en: And it was in the heart of David my father to build an house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.

entries.yo: Oluwa si wi fun Dafidi baba mi pe, Bi o tijẹpe o wà li ọkàn rẹ lati kọ́ ile kan fun orukọ mi, iwọ ṣe rere ti o fi wà li ọkàn rẹ.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto David my father, Whereas it was in thine heart to build an house unto my name, thou didst well that it was in thine heart.

entries.yo: Ṣibẹ̀ iwọ kì yio kọ́ ile na, ṣugbọn ọmọ rẹ ti yio ti inu rẹ jade, on ni yio kọ́ ile na fun orukọ mi.
entries.en: Nevertheless thou shalt not build the house; but thy son that shall come forth out of thy loins, he shall build the house unto my name.

entries.yo: Oluwa si mu ọ̀rọ rẹ̀ ṣẹ ti o ti sọ, emi si dide ni ipò Dafidi, baba mi, mo si joko lori itẹ́ Israeli, gẹgẹ bi Oluwa ti sọ, emi si kọ́ ile kan fun orukọ Oluwa, Ọlọrun Israeli.
entries.en: And the LORD hath performed his word that he spake, and I am risen up in the room of David my father, and sit on the throne of Israel, as the LORD promised, and have built an house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.

entries.yo: Emi si ti ṣe àye kan nibẹ̀ fun apoti-ẹri, ninu eyiti majẹmu Oluwa gbe wà, ti o ti ba awọn baba wa dá, nigbati o mu wọn jade lati ilẹ Egipti wá.
entries.en: And I have set there a place for the ark, wherein is the covenant of the LORD, which he made with our fathers, when he brought them out of the land of Egypt.

entries.yo: Solomoni si duro niwaju pẹpẹ Oluwa, loju gbogbo ijọ enia Israeli, o si nà ọwọ́ rẹ̀ mejeji soke ọrun:
entries.en: And Solomon stood before the altar of the LORD in the presence of all the congregation of Israel, and spread forth his hands toward heaven:

entries.yo: O si wipe, Oluwa Ọlọrun Israeli, kò si Ọlọrun ti o dabi rẹ loke ọrun, tabi ni isalẹ ilẹ, ti ipa majẹmu ati ãnu mọ pẹlu awọn iranṣẹ rẹ ti nfi gbogbo ọkàn wọn rin niwaju rẹ:
entries.en: And he said, LORD God of Israel, there is no God like thee, in heaven above, or on earth beneath, who keepest covenant and mercy with thy servants that walk before thee with all their heart:

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ti ba iranṣẹ rẹ Dafidi, baba mi pa ohun ti iwọ ti ṣe ileri fun u mọ: iwọ fi ẹnu rẹ sọ pẹlu, o si ti fi ọwọ́ rẹ mu u ṣẹ, gẹgẹ bi o ti ri loni.
entries.en: Who hast kept with thy servant David my father that thou promisedst him: thou spakest also with thy mouth, and hast fulfilled it with thine hand, as it is this day.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, Oluwa Ọlọrun Israeli, ba iranṣẹ rẹ Dafidi, baba mi pa ohun ti iwọ ti ṣe ileri fun u mọ́ wipe, A kì yio fẹ ọkunrin kan kù li oju mi lati joko lori itẹ Israeli; kiki bi awọn ọmọ rẹ ba le kiyesi ọ̀na wọn, ki nwọn ki o mã rìn niwaju mi gẹgẹ bi iwọ ti rìn niwaju mi.
entries.en: Therefore now, LORD God of Israel, keep with thy servant David my father that thou promisedst him, saying, There shall not fail thee a man in my sight to sit on the throne of Israel; so that thy children take heed to their way, that they walk before me as thou hast walked before me.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, Ọlọrun Israeli, jẹ ki a mu ọ̀rọ rẹ ṣẹ, emi bẹ̀ ọ, ti iwọ ti sọ fun iranṣẹ rẹ, Dafidi baba mi.
entries.en: And now, O God of Israel, let thy word, I pray thee, be verified, which thou spakest unto thy servant David my father.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nitõtọ Ọlọrun yio ha mã gbe aiye bi? wò o, ọrun ati ọrun awọn ọrun kò le gbà ọ; ambọ̀sì ile yi ti mo kọ́?
entries.en: But will God indeed dwell on the earth? behold, the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot contain thee; how much less this house that I have builded?

entries.yo: Sibẹ̀ iwọ ṣe afiyèsi adura iranṣẹ rẹ, ati si ẹbẹ rẹ̀, Oluwa Ọlọrun mi, lati tẹtisilẹ si ẹkun ati si adura, ti iranṣẹ rẹ ngbà niwaju rẹ loni:
entries.en: Yet have thou respect unto the prayer of thy servant, and to his supplication, O LORD my God, to hearken unto the cry and to the prayer, which thy servant prayeth before thee to day:

entries.yo: Ki oju rẹ lè ṣi si ile yi li ọsan ati li oru, ani si ibi ti iwọ ti wipe: Orukọ mi yio wà nibẹ: ki iwọ ki o lè tẹtisilẹ si adura ti iranṣẹ rẹ yio gbà si ibi yi.
entries.en: That thine eyes may be open toward this house night and day, even toward the place of which thou hast said, My name shall be there: that thou mayest hearken unto the prayer which thy servant shall make toward this place.

entries.yo: Ki o si tẹtisilẹ si ẹ̀bẹ iranṣẹ rẹ ati ti Israeli, enia rẹ, ti nwọn o gbadura siha ibi yi: ki o si gbọ́ li ọrun, ibugbe rẹ! gbọ́, ki o si darijì.
entries.en: And hearken thou to the supplication of thy servant, and of thy people Israel, when they shall pray toward this place: and hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place: and when thou hearest, forgive.

entries.yo: Bi ẹnikan ba ṣẹ̀ si ẹnikeji rẹ̀, ti a si fi ibura le e lati mu u bura, bi ibura na ba si de iwaju pẹpẹ rẹ ni ile yi:
entries.en: If any man trespass against his neighbour, and an oath be laid upon him to cause him to swear, and the oath come before thine altar in this house:

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ki o gbọ́ li ọrun, ki o si ṣe, ki o si dajọ awọn iranṣẹ rẹ, ni didẹbi fun enia buburu, lati mu ọ̀na rẹ̀ wá si ori rẹ̀; ati ni didare fun olõtọ, lati fun u gẹgẹ bi ododo rẹ̀.
entries.en: Then hear thou in heaven, and do, and judge thy servants, condemning the wicked, to bring his way upon his head; and justifying the righteous, to give him according to his righteousness.

entries.yo: Nigbati a ba lù Israeli, enia rẹ bòlẹ niwaju awọn ọ̀ta, nitoriti nwọn dẹṣẹ si ọ, ti nwọn ba si yipada si ọ, ti nwọn si jẹwọ orukọ rẹ, ti nwọn si gbadura, ti nwọn si bẹ̀bẹ lọdọ rẹ ni ile yi:
entries.en: When thy people Israel be smitten down before the enemy, because they have sinned against thee, and shall turn again to thee, and confess thy name, and pray, and make supplication unto thee in this house:

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ki o gbọ́ li ọrun, ki o si dari ẹ̀ṣẹ Israeli, enia rẹ jì, ki o si mu wọn pada wá si ilẹ ti iwọ ti fi fun awọn baba wọn.
entries.en: Then hear thou in heaven, and forgive the sin of thy people Israel, and bring them again unto the land which thou gavest unto their fathers.

entries.yo: Nigbati a ba sé ọrun mọ, ti kò si òjo, nitoriti nwọn ti dẹṣẹ si ọ: bi nwọn ba gbadura si iha ibi yi, ti nwọn si jẹwọ orukọ rẹ, bi nwọn ba si yipada kuro ninu ẹ̀ṣẹ wọn, nigbati iwọ ba pọ́n wọn li oju.
entries.en: When heaven is shut up, and there is no rain, because they have sinned against thee; if they pray toward this place, and confess thy name, and turn from their sin, when thou afflictest them:

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ki o gbọ́ li ọrun, ki o si dari ẹ̀ṣẹ awọn iranṣẹ rẹ jì, ati ti Israeli, enia rẹ, nigbati o kọ́ wọn li ọ̀na rere ninu eyiti nwọn iba mã rin, ki o si rọ̀ òjo si ilẹ rẹ, ti iwọ ti fi fun enia rẹ ni ilẹ-ini.
entries.en: Then hear thou in heaven, and forgive the sin of thy servants, and of thy people Israel, that thou teach them the good way wherein they should walk, and give rain upon thy land, which thou hast given to thy people for an inheritance.

entries.yo: Bi iyàn ba mu ni ilẹ, bi ajakalẹ-arùn ni, tabi ìrẹdanu, tabi bibu, tabi bi ẽṣu tabi bi kòkorò ti njẹrun ba wà; bi ọtá wọn ba dó tì wọn ni ilẹ ilu wọn; ajakalẹ-arùn gbogbo, arùn-ki-arun gbogbo.
entries.en: If there be in the land famine, if there be pestilence, blasting, mildew, locust, or if there be caterpiller; if their enemy besiege them in the land of their cities; whatsoever plague, whatsoever sickness there be;

entries.yo: Adura ki adura, ati ẹ̀bẹ ki ẹ̀bẹ, ti a ba ti ọdọ ẹnikan tabi lati ọdọ gbogbo Israeli, enia rẹ gbà, ti olukuluku yio mọ̀ ibanujẹ ọkàn ara rẹ̀, bi o ba si tẹ́ ọwọ́ rẹ̀ mejeji si iha ile yi!
entries.en: What prayer and supplication soever be made by any man, or by all thy people Israel, which shall know every man the plague of his own heart, and spread forth his hands toward this house:

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ki iwọ ki o gbọ́ li ọrun, ibugbe rẹ, ki o si darijì, ki o si ṣe ki o si fun olukulùku enia gẹgẹ bi ọ̀na rẹ̀, ọkàn ẹniti iwọ mọ̀; nitoriti iwọ, iwọ nikanṣoṣo li o mọ̀ ọkàn gbogbo awọn ọmọ enia;
entries.en: Then hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place, and forgive, and do, and give to every man according to his ways, whose heart thou knowest; (for thou, even thou only, knowest the hearts of all the children of men;)

entries.yo: Ki nwọn ki o lè mã bẹ̀ru rẹ ni gbogbo ọjọ ti nwọn wà ni ilẹ ti iwọ fi fun awọn baba wa.
entries.en: That they may fear thee all the days that they live in the land which thou gavest unto our fathers.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu, niti alejò, ti kì iṣe ti inu Israeli enia rẹ, ṣugbọn ti o ti ilẹ okerè jade wá nitori orukọ rẹ.
entries.en: Moreover concerning a stranger, that is not of thy people Israel, but cometh out of a far country for thy name's sake;

entries.yo: Nitoriti nwọn o gbọ́ orukọ nla rẹ, ati ọwọ́ agbára rẹ, ati ninà apa rẹ; nigbati on o wá, ti yio si gbadura si iha ile yi;
entries.en: (For they shall hear of thy great name, and of thy strong hand, and of thy stretched out arm;) when he shall come and pray toward this house;

entries.yo: Iwọ gbọ́ li ọrun, ibùgbe rẹ, ki o si ṣe gẹgẹ bi gbogbo eyiti alejò na yio ke pè ọ si: ki gbogbo aiye ki o lè mọ̀ orukọ rẹ, ki nwọn ki o lè mã bẹ̀ru rẹ, gẹgẹ bi Israeli, enia rẹ, ki nwọn ki o si lè mọ̀ pe: orukọ rẹ li a fi npè ile yi ti mo kọ́.
entries.en: Hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place, and do according to all that the stranger calleth to thee for: that all people of the earth may know thy name, to fear thee, as do thy people Israel; and that they may know that this house, which I have builded, is called by thy name.

entries.yo: Bi enia rẹ ba jade lọ si ogun si ọtá wọn, li ọ̀na ti iwọ o rán wọn, bi nwọn ba si gbadura si Oluwa siha ilu ti iwọ ti yàn, ati siha ile ti mo kọ́ fun orukọ rẹ.
entries.en: If thy people go out to battle against their enemy, whithersoever thou shalt send them, and shall pray unto the LORD toward the city which thou hast chosen, and toward the house that I have built for thy name:

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ki o gbọ́ adura wọn, ati ẹ̀bẹ wọn li ọrun, ki o si mu ọràn wọn duro.
entries.en: Then hear thou in heaven their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.

entries.yo: Bi nwọn ba ṣẹ̀ si ọ, nitoriti kò si enia kan ti kì iṣẹ̀, bi iwọ ba si binu si wọn, ti o si fi wọn le ọwọ́ ọta, tobẹ̃ ti a si kó wọn lọ ni igbèkun si ilẹ ọta, jijìna tabi nitosi;
entries.en: If they sin against thee, (for there is no man that sinneth not,) and thou be angry with them, and deliver them to the enemy, so that they carry them away captives unto the land of the enemy, far or near;

entries.yo: Bi nwọn ba rò inu ara wọn wò ni ilẹ nibiti a gbe kó wọn ni igbèkun lọ, ti nwọn ba si ronupiwàda, ti nwọn ba si bẹ̀ ọ ni ilẹ awọn ti o kó wọn ni igbèkun lọ, wipe, Awa ti dẹṣẹ, awa ti ṣe ohun ti kò tọ, awa ti ṣe buburu;
entries.en: Yet if they shall bethink themselves in the land whither they were carried captives, and repent, and make supplication unto thee in the land of them that carried them captives, saying, We have sinned, and have done perversely, we have committed wickedness;

entries.yo: Bi nwọn ba si fi gbogbo àiya ati gbogbo ọkàn wọn yipada si ọ ni ilẹ awọn ọta wọn, ti o kó wọn ni igbèkun lọ, ti nwọn si gbadura si ọ siha ilẹ wọn, ti iwọ ti fi fun awọn baba wọn, ilu ti iwọ ti yàn, ati ile ti emi kọ́ fun orukọ rẹ:
entries.en: And so return unto thee with all their heart, and with all their soul, in the land of their enemies, which led them away captive, and pray unto thee toward their land, which thou gavest unto their fathers, the city which thou hast chosen, and the house which I have built for thy name:

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ki iwọ ki o gbọ́ adura wọn ati ẹ̀bẹ wọn li ọrun ibugbe rẹ, ki o si mu ọ̀ran wọn duro:
entries.en: Then hear thou their prayer and their supplication in heaven thy dwelling place, and maintain their cause,

entries.yo: Ki o si darijì awọn enia rẹ ti o ti dẹṣẹ si ọ, ati gbogbo irekọja wọn ninu eyiti nwọn ṣẹ̀ si ọ, ki o si fun wọn ni ãnu niwaju awọn ti o kó wọn ni igbèkun lọ, ki nwọn ki o le ṣãnu fun wọn.
entries.en: And forgive thy people that have sinned against thee and all their transgressions wherein they have transgressed against thee, and give them compassion before them who carried them captive, that they may have compassion on them:

entries.yo: Nitori enia rẹ ati ini rẹ ni nwọn, ti iwọ mu ti Egipti jade wá, lati inu ileru irin:
entries.en: For they be thy people, and thine inheritance, which thou broughtest forth out of Egypt, from the midst of the furnace of iron:

entries.yo: Ki oju rẹ ki o le ṣi si ẹ̀bẹ iranṣẹ rẹ, ati si ẹ̀bẹ Israeli enia rẹ, lati tẹtisilẹ si wọn ninu ohun gbogbo ti nwọn o ke pè ọ si.
entries.en: That thine eyes may be open unto the supplication of thy servant, and unto the supplication of thy people Israel, to hearken unto them in all that they call for unto thee.

entries.yo: Nitoriti iwọ ti yà wọn kuro ninu gbogbo orilẹ-ède aiye, lati mã jẹ ini rẹ, bi iwọ ti sọ lati ọwọ Mose iranṣẹ rẹ, nigbati iwọ mu awọn baba wa ti Egipti jade wá, Oluwa Ọlọrun.
entries.en: For thou didst separate them from among all the people of the earth, to be thine inheritance, as thou spakest by the hand of Moses thy servant, when thou broughtest our fathers out of Egypt, O Lord GOD.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, bi Solomoni ti pari gbigbà gbogbo adura ati ẹ̀bẹ yi si Oluwa, o dide kuro lori ikunlẹ ni ẽkún rẹ̀ niwaju pẹpẹ Oluwa pẹlu titẹ́ ọwọ rẹ̀ si oke ọrun.
entries.en: And it was so, that when Solomon had made an end of praying all this prayer and supplication unto the LORD, he arose from before the altar of the LORD, from kneeling on his knees with his hands spread up to heaven.

entries.yo: O si dide duro, o si fi ohùn rara sure fun gbogbo ijọ enia Israeli wipe,
entries.en: And he stood, and blessed all the congregation of Israel with a loud voice, saying,

entries.yo: Ibukún ni fun Oluwa ti o ti fi isimi fun Israeli enia rẹ̀, gẹgẹ bi gbogbo eyiti o ti ṣe ileri: kò kù ọ̀rọ kan ninu gbogbo ileri rere rẹ̀ ti o ti ṣe lati ọwọ Mose, iranṣẹ rẹ̀ wá.
entries.en: Blessed be the LORD, that hath given rest unto his people Israel, according to all that he promised: there hath not failed one word of all his good promise, which he promised by the hand of Moses his servant.

entries.yo: Oluwa Ọlọrun wa ki o wà pẹlu wa, bi o ti wà pẹlu awọn baba wa: ki o má fi wa silẹ, ki o má si ṣe kọ̀ wa silẹ;
entries.en: The LORD our God be with us, as he was with our fathers: let him not leave us, nor forsake us:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ki o fa ọkàn wa si ọdọ ara rẹ̀, lati ma rin ninu gbogbo ọ̀na rẹ̀, ati lati pa ofin rẹ̀ mọ́, ati aṣẹ rẹ̀, ati idajọ rẹ̀, ti o ti paṣẹ fun awọn baba wa.
entries.en: That he may incline our hearts unto him, to walk in all his ways, and to keep his commandments, and his statutes, and his judgments, which he commanded our fathers.

entries.yo: Ki o si jẹ ki ọ̀rọ mi wọnyi, ti mo fi bẹ̀bẹ niwaju Oluwa, ki o wà nitosi, Oluwa Ọlọrun wa, li ọsan ati li oru, ki o le mu ọ̀ran iranṣẹ rẹ duro, ati ọ̀ran ojojumọ ti Israeli, enia rẹ̀.
entries.en: And let these my words, wherewith I have made supplication before the LORD, be nigh unto the LORD our God day and night, that he maintain the cause of his servant, and the cause of his people Israel at all times, as the matter shall require:

entries.yo: Ki gbogbo enia aiye le mọ̀ pe, Oluwa on li Ọlọrun, kò si ẹlomiran.
entries.en: That all the people of the earth may know that the LORD is God, and that there is none else.

entries.yo: Nitorina, ẹ jẹ ki aìya nyin ki o pé pẹlu Oluwa Ọlọrun wa, lati mã rìn ninu aṣẹ rẹ̀, ati lati pa ofin rẹ̀ mọ́, bi ti oni yi.
entries.en: Let your heart therefore be perfect with the LORD our God, to walk in his statutes, and to keep his commandments, as at this day.

entries.yo: Ati ọba, ati gbogbo Israeli pẹlu rẹ̀, ru ẹbọ niwaju Oluwa.
entries.en: And the king, and all Israel with him, offered sacrifice before the LORD.

entries.yo: Solomoni si ru ẹbọ ọrẹ-alafia, ti o ru si Oluwa, ẹgbã-mọkanla malu, ati ọkẹ mẹfa àgutan. Bẹ̃ni ọba ati gbogbo awọn ọmọ Israeli yà ile Oluwa si mimọ́.
entries.en: And Solomon offered a sacrifice of peace offerings, which he offered unto the LORD, two and twenty thousand oxen, and an hundred and twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the children of Israel dedicated the house of the LORD.

entries.yo: Li ọ̀jọ na ni ọba yà agbàla ãrin ti mbẹ niwaju ile Oluwa si mimọ́: nitori nibẹ ni o ru ẹbọ ọrẹ-sisun, ati ọrẹ-onjẹ, ati ẹbọ-ọpẹ: nitori pẹpẹ idẹ ti mbẹ niwaju Oluwa kere jù lati gba ọrẹ-sisun ati ọrẹ-ọnjẹ, ati ọ̀ra ẹbọ-ọpẹ.
entries.en: The same day did the king hallow the middle of the court that was before the house of the LORD: for there he offered burnt offerings, and meat offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings: because the brasen altar that was before the LORD was too little to receive the burnt offerings, and meat offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings.

entries.yo: Ati li àkoko na, Solomoni papejọ kan, ati gbogbo Israeli pẹlu rẹ̀, ajọ nla-nlã ni, lati iwọ Hamati titi de odò Egipti, niwaju Oluwa Ọlọrun wa, ijọ meje on ijọ meje, ani ijọ mẹrinla.
entries.en: And at that time Solomon held a feast, and all Israel with him, a great congregation, from the entering in of Hamath unto the river of Egypt, before the LORD our God, seven days and seven days, even fourteen days.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ kẹjọ o rán awọn enia na lọ: nwọn si sure fun ọba, nwọn si lọ sinu agọ wọn pẹlu ayọ̀ ati inu-didun, nitori gbogbo ore ti Oluwa ti ṣe fun Dafidi, iranṣẹ rẹ̀, ati fun Israeli, enia rẹ̀.
entries.en: On the eighth day he sent the people away: and they blessed the king, and went unto their tents joyful and glad of heart for all the goodness that the LORD had done for David his servant, and for Israel his people.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, bi Solomoni ti pari kikọ́ ile Oluwa, ati ile ọba, ati gbogbo ifẹ Solomoni ti o wù u lati ṣe,
entries.en: And it came to pass, when Solomon had finished the building of the house of the LORD, and the king's house, and all Solomon's desire which he was pleased to do,

entries.yo: Oluwa fi ara hàn Solomoni li ẹrinkeji, gẹgẹ bi o ti fi ara hàn a ni Gibeoni.
entries.en: That the LORD appeared to Solomon the second time, as he had appeared unto him at Gibeon.

entries.yo: Oluwa si wi fun u pe, Mo ti gbọ́ adura rẹ ati ẹ̀bẹ rẹ, ti iwọ ti bẹ̀ niwaju mi, mo ti ya ile yi si mimọ́, ti iwọ ti kọ́, lati fi orukọ mi sibẹ titi lai; ati oju mi ati ọkàn mi yio wà nibẹ titi lai.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto him, I have heard thy prayer and thy supplication, that thou hast made before me: I have hallowed this house, which thou hast built, to put my name there for ever; and mine eyes and mine heart shall be there perpetually.

entries.yo: Bi iwọ o ba rìn niwaju mi: bi Dafidi baba rẹ ti rìn, ni otitọ ọkàn, ati ni iduroṣinṣin, lati ṣe gẹgẹ bi gbogbo eyiti mo ti pa li aṣẹ fun ọ, ti iwọ o si pa aṣẹ mi ati idajọ mi mọ́:
entries.en: And if thou wilt walk before me, as David thy father walked, in integrity of heart, and in uprightness, to do according to all that I have commanded thee, and wilt keep my statutes and my judgments:

entries.yo: Nigbana li emi o fi idi itẹ́ ijọba rẹ mulẹ lori Israeli titi lai, bi mo ti ṣe ileri fun Dafidi baba rẹ, wipe, Iwọ kì yio fẹ ọkunrin kan kù lori itẹ́ Israeli.
entries.en: Then I will establish the throne of thy kingdom upon Israel for ever, as I promised to David thy father, saying, There shall not fail thee a man upon the throne of Israel.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi ẹnyin o ba yipada lati mã tọ̀ mi lẹhin, ẹnyin, tabi awọn ọmọ nyin, bi ẹnyin kò si pa ofin mi mọ́, ati aṣẹ mi ti mo ti fi si iwaju nyin, ṣugbọn bi ẹ ba lọ ti ẹ si sìn awọn ọlọrun miran, ti ẹ si bọ wọn:
entries.en: But if ye shall at all turn from following me, ye or your children, and will not keep my commandments and my statutes which I have set before you, but go and serve other gods, and worship them:

entries.yo: Nigbana ni emi o ké Israeli kuro ni ilẹ ti emi fi fun wọn; ati ile yi, ti mo ti yà si mimọ́ fun orukọ mi li emi o gbe sọnù kuro niwaju mi; Israeli yio si di owe ati ifiṣẹsin lãrin gbogbo orilẹ-ède.
entries.en: Then will I cut off Israel out of the land which I have given them; and this house, which I have hallowed for my name, will I cast out of my sight; and Israel shall be a proverb and a byword among all people:

entries.yo: Ati ile yi, ti o ga, ẹnu o si ya olukuluku ẹniti o kọja lẹba rẹ̀, yio si pòṣe: nwọn o si wipe; ẽṣe ti Oluwa fi ṣe bayi si ilẹ yi ati si ile yi?
entries.en: And at this house, which is high, every one that passeth by it shall be astonished, and shall hiss; and they shall say, Why hath the LORD done thus unto this land, and to this house?

entries.yo: Nwọn o si dahùn wipe, Nitoriti nwọn kọ̀ Oluwa Ọlọrun wọn silẹ, ẹniti o mu awọn baba wọn jade ti ilẹ Egipti wá, nwọn gbá awọn ọlọrun miran mú, nwọn si bọ wọn, nwọn si sìn wọn: nitorina ni Oluwa ṣe mu gbogbo ibi yi wá sori wọn.
entries.en: And they shall answer, Because they forsook the LORD their God, who brought forth their fathers out of the land of Egypt, and have taken hold upon other gods, and have worshipped them, and served them: therefore hath the LORD brought upon them all this evil.

entries.yo: O si ṣe lẹhin ogún ọdun, nigbati Solomoni ti kọ́ ile mejeji tan, ile Oluwa, ati ile ọba.
entries.en: And it came to pass at the end of twenty years, when Solomon had built the two houses, the house of the LORD, and the king's house,

entries.yo: Hiramu, ọba Tire ti ba Solomoni wá igi kedari ati igi firi, ati wura gẹgẹ bi gbogbo ifẹ rẹ̀, nigbana ni Solomoni ọba fun Hiramu ni ogún ilu ni ilẹ Galili.
entries.en: (Now Hiram the king of Tyre had furnished Solomon with cedar trees and fir trees, and with gold, according to all his desire,) that then king Solomon gave Hiram twenty cities in the land of Galilee.

entries.yo: Hiramu si jade lati Tire wá lati wò ilu ti Solomoni fi fun u: nwọn kò si wù u.
entries.en: And Hiram came out from Tyre to see the cities which Solomon had given him; and they pleased him not.

entries.yo: On si wipe, Ilu kini wọnyi ti iwọ fi fun mi, arakunrin mi? O si pè wọn ni ilẹ Kabulu titi fi di oni yi.
entries.en: And he said, What cities are these which thou hast given me, my brother? And he called them the land of Cabul unto this day.

entries.yo: Hiramu si fi ọgọta talenti wura ranṣẹ si ọba.
entries.en: And Hiram sent to the king sixscore talents of gold.

entries.yo: Idi awọn asìnru ti Solomoni kojọ ni eyi; lati kọ́ ile Oluwa, ati ile on tikararẹ̀, ati Millo, ati odi Jerusalemu, ati Hasori ati Megiddo, ati Geseri.
entries.en: And this is the reason of the levy which king Solomon raised; for to build the house of the LORD, and his own house, and Millo, and the wall of Jerusalem, and Hazor, and Megiddo, and Gezer.

entries.yo: Farao, ọba Egipti ti goke lọ, o si ti kó Geseri, o si ti fi iná sun u, o si ti pa awọn ara Kenaani ti ngbe ilu na, o si fi ta ọmọbinrin rẹ̀, aya Solomoni li ọrẹ.
entries.en: For Pharaoh king of Egypt had gone up, and taken Gezer, and burnt it with fire, and slain the Canaanites that dwelt in the city, and given it for a present unto his daughter, Solomon's wife.

entries.yo: Solomoni si kọ́ Geseri, ati Bethoroni-isalẹ.
entries.en: And Solomon built Gezer, and Beth-horon the nether,

entries.yo: Ati Baalati, ati Tadmori ni aginju, ni ilẹ na.
entries.en: and Baalath, and Tadmor in the wilderness, in the land,

entries.yo: Ati gbogbo ilu iṣura ti Solomoni ni, ati ilu kẹkẹ́ rẹ̀, ati ilu fun awọn ẹlẹsin rẹ̀, ati eyiti Solomoni nfẹ lati kọ́ ni Jerusalemu, ati ni Lebanoni, ati ni gbogbo ilẹ ijọba rẹ̀.
entries.en: And all the cities of store that Solomon had, and cities for his chariots, and cities for his horsemen, and that which Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and in all the land of his dominion.

entries.yo: Gbogbo enia ti o kù ninu awọn ara Amori, ara Hitti, Perisi, Hifi ati Jebusi, ti kì iṣe ti inu awọn ọmọ Israeli.
entries.en: And all the people that were left of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites, which were not of the children of Israel,

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ wọn ti o kù lẹhin wọn ni ilẹ na, ti awọn ọmọ Israeli kò le parun tũtu, awọn ni Solomoni bù iṣẹ-iru fun titi di oni yi.
entries.en: Their children that were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel also were not able utterly to destroy, upon those did Solomon levy a tribute of bondservice unto this day.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ninu awọn ọmọ Israeli, Solomoni kò fi ṣe ẹrú, ṣugbọn nwọn jẹ awọn ologun ati awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀, ati awọn ijoye rẹ̀, ati awọn balogun rẹ̀, ati awọn olori kẹkẹ́ rẹ̀ ati ti awọn ẹlẹsin rẹ̀.
entries.en: But of the children of Israel did Solomon make no bondmen: but they were men of war, and his servants, and his princes, and his captains, and rulers of his chariots, and his horsemen.

entries.yo: Awọn wọnyi ni awọn olori olutọju ti mbẹ lori iṣẹ Solomoni, ãdọta-dilẹgbẹta, ti nṣe akoso lori awọn enia ti nṣe iṣẹ na.
entries.en: These were the chief of the officers that were over Solomon's work, five hundred and fifty, which bare rule over the people that wrought in the work.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ọmọbinrin Farao goke lati ilu Dafidi wá si ile rẹ̀, ti Solomoni kọ́ fun u: nigbana ni o kọ́ Millo.
entries.en: But Pharaoh's daughter came up out of the city of David unto her house which Solomon had built for her: then did he build Millo.

entries.yo: Ati nigba mẹta li ọdun ni Solomoni iru ẹbọ ọrẹ-sisun, ati ẹbọ-ọpẹ lori pẹpẹ ti o tẹ́ fun Oluwa, o si sun turari lori eyi ti mbẹ niwaju Oluwa. Bẹ̃li o pari ile na.
entries.en: And three times in a year did Solomon offer burnt offerings and peace offerings upon the altar which he built unto the LORD, and he burnt incense upon the altar that was before the LORD. So he finished the house.

entries.yo: Solomoni ọba si sẹ ọ̀wọ-ọkọ̀ ni Esioni-Geberi, ti mbẹ li ẹba Eloti, leti Okun-pupa ni ilẹ Edomu.
entries.en: And king Solomon made a navy of ships in Ezion-geber, which is beside Eloth, on the shore of the Red sea, in the land of Edom.

entries.yo: Hiramu si rán awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀, awọn atukọ ti o ni ìmọ okun, pẹlu awọn iranṣẹ Solomoni ninu ọ̀wọ-ọkọ̀ na.
entries.en: And Hiram sent in the navy his servants, shipmen that had knowledge of the sea, with the servants of Solomon.

entries.yo: Nwọn si de Ofiri, nwọn si mu wura lati ibẹ wá, irinwo talenti o le ogun, nwọn si mu u fun Solomoni ọba wá.
entries.en: And they came to Ophir, and fetched from thence gold, four hundred and twenty talents, and brought it to king Solomon.

entries.yo: NIGBATI ayaba Ṣeba si gbọ́ okiki Solomoni niti orukọ Oluwa, o wá lati fi àlọ dán a wò.
entries.en: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon concerning the name of the LORD, she came to prove him with hard questions.

entries.yo: O si wá si Jerusalemu pẹlu ẹgbẹ nlanla, ibakasiẹ ti o ru turari, ati ọ̀pọlọpọ wura, ati okuta oniyebiye: nigbati o si de ọdọ Solomoni o ba a sọ gbogbo eyiti mbẹ li ọkàn rẹ̀.
entries.en: And she came to Jerusalem with a very great train, with camels that bare spices, and very much gold, and precious stones: and when she was come to Solomon, she communed with him of all that was in her heart.

entries.yo: Solomoni si fi èsi si gbogbo ọ̀rọ rẹ̀, kò si ibère kan ti o pamọ fun ọba ti kò si sọ fun u.
entries.en: And Solomon told her all her questions: there was not any thing hid from the king, which he told her not.

entries.yo: Nigbati ayaba Ṣeba si ti ri gbogbo ọgbọ́n Solomoni, ati ile ti o ti kọ́.
entries.en: And when the queen of Sheba had seen all Solomon's wisdom, and the house that he had built,

entries.yo: Ati onjẹ tabili rẹ̀, ati ijoko awọn ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ̀, ati iduro awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀, ati iwọṣọ wọn, ati awọn agbọti rẹ̀, ati ọna ti o mba goke lọ si ile Oluwa; kò kù agbara kan fun u mọ.
entries.en: And the meat of his table, and the sitting of his servants, and the attendance of his ministers, and their apparel, and his cupbearers, and his ascent by which he went up unto the house of the LORD; there was no more spirit in her.

entries.yo: O si wi fun ọba pe, Otitọ li ọ̀rọ ti mo gbọ́ ni ilẹ mi niti iṣe rẹ ati niti ọgbọ́n rẹ.
entries.en: And she said to the king, It was a true report that I heard in mine own land of thy acts and of thy wisdom.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi kò gba ọ̀rọ na gbọ́, titi mo fi de, ti oju mi si ti ri: si kiyesi i, a kò sọ idajì wọn fun mi: iwọ si ti fi ọgbọ́n ati irọra kún okiki ti mo gbọ́.
entries.en: Howbeit I believed not the words, until I came, and mine eyes had seen it: and, behold, the half was not told me: thy wisdom and prosperity exceedeth the fame which I heard.

entries.yo: Ibukún ni fun awọn enia rẹ, ibukún ni fun awọn iranṣẹ rẹ wọnyi, ti nduro niwaju rẹ nigbagbogbo, ti ngbọ́ ọgbọ́n rẹ.
entries.en: Happy are thy men, happy are these thy servants, which stand continually before thee, and that hear thy wisdom.

entries.yo: Alabukún fun li Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ, ti o ni inu-didùn si ọ lati gbe ọ ka ori itẹ́ Israeli: nitoriti Oluwa fẹràn Israeli titi lai, nitorina li o ṣe fi ọ jọba, lati ṣe idajọ ati otitọ.
entries.en: Blessed be the LORD thy God, which delighted in thee, to set thee on the throne of Israel: because the LORD loved Israel for ever, therefore made he thee king, to do judgment and justice.

entries.yo: On si fun ọba li ọgọfa talenti wura, ati turari lọ́pọlọpọ ati okuta iyebiye: iru ọ̀pọlọpọ turari bẹ̃ kò de mọ bi eyiti ayaba Ṣeba fi fun Solomoni, ọba.
entries.en: And she gave the king an hundred and twenty talents of gold, and of spices very great store, and precious stones: there came no more such abundance of spices as these which the queen of Sheba gave to king Solomon.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu awọn ọ̀wọ-ọkọ̀ Hiramu ti o mu wura lati Ofiri wá, mu igi Algumu, (igi Sandali) lọpọlọpọ ati okuta oniyebiye lati Ofiri wá.
entries.en: And the navy also of Hiram, that brought gold from Ophir, brought in from Ophir great plenty of almug trees, and precious stones.

entries.yo: Ọba si fi igi Algumu na ṣe opó fun ile Oluwa, ati fun ile ọba dùru pẹlu ati ohun-elo orin miran fun awọn akọrin: iru igi Algumu bẹ̃ kò de mọ, bẹ̃ni a kò ri wọn titi di oni yi.
entries.en: And the king made of the almug trees pillars for the house of the LORD, and for the king's house, harps also and psalteries for singers: there came no such almug trees, nor were seen unto this day.

entries.yo: Solomoni ọba si fun ayaba Ṣeba ni gbogbo ifẹ rẹ̀, ohunkohun ti o bère, li aika eyiti a fi fun u lati ọwọ Solomoni ọba wá. Bẹ̃li o si yipada, o si lọ si ilu rẹ̀, on, ati awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And king Solomon gave unto the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatsoever she asked, beside that which Solomon gave her of his royal bounty. So she turned and went to her own country, she and her servants.

entries.yo: Njẹ ìwọn wura ti o nde ọdọ Solomoni li ọdun kan, jẹ ọtalelẹgbẹta o le mẹfa talenti wura,
entries.en: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred threescore and six talents of gold.

entries.yo: Laika eyi ti o ngbà lọwọ awọn ajẹlẹ ati awọn oniṣowo, ati ti gbogbo awọn ọba Arabia, ati ti awọn bãlẹ ilẹ.
entries.en: Beside that he had of the merchantmen, and of the traffick of the spice merchants, and of all the kings of Arabia, and of the governors of the country.

entries.yo: Solomoni ọba si ṣe igba asà wura lilù: ẹgbẹta ṣekeli wura li o tán si asà kan.
entries.en: And king Solomon made two hundred targets of beaten gold: six hundred shekels of gold went to one target.

entries.yo: O si ṣe ọdunrun apata wura lilù, oṣuwọn wura mẹta li o tán si apata kan: ọba si ko wọn si ile igbo Lebanoni.
entries.en: And he made three hundred shields of beaten gold; three pound of gold went to one shield: and the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.

entries.yo: Ọba si ṣe itẹ́ ehin-erin kan nla, o si fi wura didara julọ bò o.
entries.en: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with the best gold.

entries.yo: Itẹ́ na ni atẹgùn mẹfa, oke itẹ́ na yi okiribiti lẹhin: irọpá si wà niha kini ati ekeji ni ibi ijoko na, kiniun meji si duro lẹba na.
entries.en: The throne had six steps, and the top of the throne was round behind: and there were stays on either side on the place of the seat, and two lions stood beside the stays.

entries.yo: Kiniun mejila duro nibẹ niha ekini ati ekeji lori atẹgùn mẹfa na: a kò ṣe iru rẹ̀ ni ijọba kan.
entries.en: And twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps: there was not the like made in any kingdom.

entries.yo: Ati gbogbo ohun-elo mimu Solomoni ọba jẹ wura, ati gbogbo ohun-elo ile igbo Lebanoni jẹ wura daradara; kò si fadaka; a kò kà a si nkankan li ọjọ Solomoni.
entries.en: And all king Solomon's drinking vessels were of gold, and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were of pure gold; none were of silver: it was nothing accounted of in the days of Solomon.

entries.yo: Nitori ọba ni ọkọ̀ Tarṣiṣi kan pẹlu ọkọ̀ Hiramu li okun: ẹ̃kan li ọdun mẹta li ọkọ̀ Tarṣiṣi idé, ti imu wura ati fadaka, ehin-erin ati inakí ati ẹiyẹ-ologe wá.
entries.en: For the king had at sea a navy of Tharshish with the navy of Hiram: once in three years came the navy of Tharshish, bringing gold, and silver, ivory, and apes, and peacocks.

entries.yo: Solomoni ọba si pọ̀ jù gbogbo awọn ọba aiye lọ, li ọrọ̀ ati li ọgbọ́n.
entries.en: So king Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth for riches and for wisdom.

entries.yo: Gbogbo aiye si nwá oju Solomoni, lati gbọ́ ọgbọ́n rẹ̀, ti Ọlọrun ti fi si i li ọkàn.
entries.en: And all the earth sought to Solomon, to hear his wisdom, which God had put in his heart.

entries.yo: Olukuluku nwọn si mu ọrẹ tirẹ̀ wá, ohun-elo fadaka, ati ohun-elo wura, ati ẹ̀wu, ati turari, ẹṣin ati ibãka, iye kan lọdọdun.
entries.en: And they brought every man his present, vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and garments, and armour, and spices, horses, and mules, a rate year by year.

entries.yo: Solomoni si ko kẹkẹ́ ati èṣin jọ: o si ni egbeje kẹkẹ́ ati ẹgbãfa ẹlẹsin, o si fi wọn si ilu kẹkẹ́, ati pẹlu ọba ni Jerusalemu.
entries.en: And Solomon gathered together chariots and horsemen: and he had a thousand and four hundred chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen, whom he bestowed in the cities for chariots, and with the king at Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Ọba si ṣe ki fadakà ki o wà ni Jerusalemu bi okuta, ati igi kedari li o ṣe ki o dabi igi sikamore ti mbẹ ni afonifoji fun ọ̀pọlọpọ.
entries.en: And the king made silver to be in Jerusalem as stones, and cedars made he to be as the sycomore trees that are in the vale, for abundance.

entries.yo: A si mu ẹṣin wá fun Solomoni lati Egipti li ọwọ́wọ, oniṣowo ọba nmu wọn wá fun owo.
entries.en: And Solomon had horses brought out of Egypt, and linen yarn: the king's merchants received the linen yarn at a price.

entries.yo: Kẹkẹ́ kan ngoke o si njade lati Egipti wá fun ẹgbẹta ṣekeli fadakà, ati ẹṣin kan fun ãdọjọ: bẹ̃ni nwọn si nmu wá pẹlu nipa ọwọ wọn fun gbogbo awọn ọba awọn ọmọ Hiti ati fun awọn ọba Siria.
entries.en: And a chariot came up and went out of Egypt for six hundred shekels of silver, and an horse for an hundred and fifty: and so for all the kings of the Hittites, and for the kings of Syria, did they bring them out by their means.

entries.yo: ṢUGBỌN Solomoni ọba fẹràn ọ̀pọ ajeji obinrin, pẹlu ọmọbinrin Farao, awọn obinrin ara Moabu, ti Ammoni, ti Edomu, ti Sidoni ati ti awọn ọmọ Hitti.
entries.en: But king Solomon loved many strange women, together with the daughter of Pharaoh, women of the Moabites, Ammonites, Edomites, Zidonians, and Hittites;

entries.yo: Awọn orilẹ-ède ti Oluwa wi fun awọn ọmọ-Israeli pe, Ẹnyin kò gbọdọ wọle tọ̀ wọn, bẹ̃ni awọn kò gbọdọ wọle tọ̀ nyin: nitõtọ nwọn o yi nyin li ọkàn pada si oriṣa wọn: Solomoni fà mọ awọn wọnyi ni ifẹ.
entries.en: Of the nations concerning which the LORD said unto the children of Israel, Ye shall not go in to them, neither shall they come in unto you: for surely they will turn away your heart after their gods: Solomon clave unto these in love.

entries.yo: O si ni ẽdẹgbẹrin obinrin, awọn ọmọ ọba, ati ọ̃dunrun alè, awọn aya rẹ̀ si yi i li ọkàn pada.
entries.en: And he had seven hundred wives, princesses, and three hundred concubines: and his wives turned away his heart.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati Solomoni di arugbo, awọn obinrin rẹ̀ yi i li ọkàn pada si ọlọrun miran: ọkàn rẹ̀ kò si ṣe dede pẹlu Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ̀, gẹgẹ bi ọkàn Dafidi, baba rẹ̀.
entries.en: For it came to pass, when Solomon was old, that his wives turned away his heart after other gods: and his heart was not perfect with the LORD his God, as was the heart of David his father.

entries.yo: Nitori Solomoni tọ Aṣtoreti lẹhin, oriṣa awọn ara Sidoni, ati Milkomu, irira awọn ọmọ Ammoni.
entries.en: For Solomon went after Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians, and after Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites.

entries.yo: Solomoni si ṣe buburu niwaju Oluwa, kò si tọ̀ Oluwa lẹhin ni pipé gẹgẹ bi Dafidi baba rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Solomon did evil in the sight of the LORD, and went not fully after the LORD, as did David his father.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Solomoni kọ́ ibi giga kan fun Kemoṣi, irira Moabu, lori oke ti mbẹ niwaju Jerusalemu, ati fun Moleki, irira awọn ọmọ Ammoni.
entries.en: Then did Solomon build an high place for Chemosh, the abomination of Moab, in the hill that is before Jerusalem, and for Molech, the abomination of the children of Ammon.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li o si ṣe fun gbogbo awọn ajeji obinrin rẹ̀, awọn ti nsun turari, ti nwọn si nrubọ fun oriṣa wọn.
entries.en: And likewise did he for all his strange wives, which burnt incense and sacrificed unto their gods.

entries.yo: Oluwa si binu si Solomoni, nitori ọkàn rẹ̀ yipada kuro lọdọ Oluwa Ọlọrun Israeli, ti o ti fi ara hàn a lẹrinmeji.
entries.en: And the LORD was angry with Solomon, because his heart was turned from the LORD God of Israel, which had appeared unto him twice,

entries.yo: Ti o si paṣẹ fun u nitori nkan yi pe, Ki o má ṣe tọ̀ awọn ọlọrun miran lẹhin: ṣugbọn kò pa eyiti Oluwa fi aṣẹ fun u mọ́.
entries.en: And had commanded him concerning this thing, that he should not go after other gods: but he kept not that which the LORD commanded.

entries.yo: Nitorina Oluwa wi fun Solomoni pe, Nitori bi iwọ ti ṣe nkan yi, ti iwọ kò si pa majẹmu mi, ati aṣẹ mi mọ́, ti mo ti pa laṣẹ fun ọ, ni yiya emi o fà ijọba rẹ ya kuro lọwọ rẹ, emi o si fi i fun iranṣẹ rẹ.
entries.en: Wherefore the LORD said unto Solomon, Forasmuch as this is done of thee, and thou hast not kept my covenant and my statutes, which I have commanded thee, I will surely rend the kingdom from thee, and will give it to thy servant.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi ki yio ṣe e li ọjọ rẹ, nitori Dafidi baba rẹ; emi o fà a ya kuro lọwọ ọmọ rẹ.
entries.en: Notwithstanding in thy days I will not do it for David thy father's sake: but I will rend it out of the hand of thy son.

entries.yo: Kiki pe emi kì yio fà gbogbo ijọba na ya; emi o fi ẹyà kan fun ọmọ rẹ, nitori Dafidi iranṣẹ mi, ati nitori Jerusalemu ti mo ti yàn.
entries.en: Howbeit I will not rend away all the kingdom; but will give one tribe to thy son for David my servant's sake, and for Jerusalem's sake which I have chosen.

entries.yo: Oluwa si gbe ọta kan dide si Solomoni, Hadadi, ara Edomu: iru-ọmọ ọba li on iṣe ni Edomu.
entries.en: And the LORD stirred up an adversary unto Solomon, Hadad the Edomite: he was of the king's seed in Edom.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati Dafidi wà ni Edomu, ati ti Joabu olori-ogun goke lọ lati sìn awọn ti a pa, nigbati o pa gbogbo ọkunrin ni Edomu.
entries.en: For it came to pass, when David was in Edom, and Joab the captain of the host was gone up to bury the slain, after he had smitten every male in Edom;

entries.yo: Nitori oṣù mẹfa ni Joabu fi joko nibẹ ati gbogbo Israeli, titi o fi ké gbogbo ọkunrin kuro ni Edomu:
entries.en: (For six months did Joab remain there with all Israel, until he had cut off every male in Edom:)

entries.yo: Hadadi si sá, on ati awọn ara Edomu ninu awọn iranṣẹ baba rẹ̀ pẹlu rẹ̀, lati lọ si Egipti; ṣugbọn Hadadi wà li ọmọde.
entries.en: That Hadad fled, he and certain Edomites of his father's servants with him, to go into Egypt; Hadad being yet a little child.

entries.yo: Nwọn si dide kuro ni Midiani, nwọn si wá si Parani; nwọn si mu enia pẹlu wọn lati Parani wá: nwọn si wá si Egipti, sọdọ Farao ọba Egipti, o si fun u ni ile kan, o si yàn onjẹ fun u, o si fun u ni ilẹ.
entries.en: And they arose out of Midian, and came to Paran: and they took men with them out of Paran, and they came to Egypt, unto Pharaoh king of Egypt; which gave him an house, and appointed him victuals, and gave him land.

entries.yo: Hadadi si ri oju-rere pupọ̀ niwaju Farao, o si fun u li arabinrin aya rẹ̀, li aya, arabinrin Tapenesi, ayaba.
entries.en: And Hadad found great favour in the sight of Pharaoh, so that he gave him to wife the sister of his own wife, the sister of Tahpenes the queen.

entries.yo: Arabinrin Tapenesi si bi Genubati ọmọ rẹ̀ fun u, Tapenesi si já a li ẹnu ọmu ni ile Farao: Genubati si wà ni ile Farao lãrin awọn ọmọ Farao,
entries.en: And the sister of Tahpenes bare him Genubath his son, whom Tahpenes weaned in Pharaoh's house: and Genubath was in Pharaoh's household among the sons of Pharaoh.

entries.yo: Nigbati Hadadi si gbọ́ ni Egipti pe, Dafidi sùn pẹlu awọn baba rẹ̀, ati pe Joabu olori-ogun si kú, Hadadi si wi fun Farao pe, rán mi lọ, ki emi ki o le lọ si ilu mi.
entries.en: And when Hadad heard in Egypt that David slept with his fathers, and that Joab the captain of the host was dead, Hadad said to Pharaoh, Let me depart, that I may go to mine own country.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Farao wi fun u pe, ṣugbọn kini iwọ ṣe alaini lọdọ mi, si kiyesi i, iwọ nwá ọ̀na lati lọ si ilu rẹ? O si wipe: Kò si nkan: ṣugbọn sa jẹ ki emi ki o lọ.
entries.en: Then Pharaoh said unto him, But what hast thou lacked with me, that, behold, thou seekest to go to thine own country? And he answered, Nothing: howbeit let me go in any wise.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu Ọlọrun gbe ọta dide si i; ani Resoni, ọmọ Eliada, ti o ti sá kuro lọdọ Hadadeseri oluwa rẹ̀, ọba Soba:
entries.en: And God stirred him up another adversary, Rezon the son of Eliadah, which fled from his lord Hadadezer king of Zobah:

entries.yo: On si ko enia jọ sọdọ ara rẹ̀, o si di olori-ogun ẹgbẹ́ kan, nigbati Dafidi fi pa wọn, nwọn si lọ si Damasku, nwọn ngbe ibẹ, nwọn si jọba ni Damasku.
entries.en: And he gathered men unto him, and became captain over a band, when David slew them of Zobah: and they went to Damascus, and dwelt therein, and reigned in Damascus.

entries.yo: On si ṣe ọta si Israeli ni gbogbo ọjọ Solomoni, lẹhin ibi ti Hadadi ṣe: Resoni si korira Israeli, o si jọba lori Siria.
entries.en: And he was an adversary to Israel all the days of Solomon, beside the mischief that Hadad did: and he abhorred Israel, and reigned over Syria.

entries.yo: Ati Jeroboamu, ọmọ Nebati, ara Efrati ti Sereda, iranṣẹ Solomoni, orukọ iya ẹniti ijẹ Serua, obinrin opó kan, on pẹlu gbe ọwọ soke si ọba.
entries.en: And Jeroboam the son of Nebat, an Ephrathite of Zereda, Solomon's servant, whose mother's name was Zeruah, a widow woman, even he lifted up his hand against the king.

entries.yo: Eyi si ni idi ohun ti o ṣe gbe ọwọ soke si ọba: Solomoni kọ́ Millo, o si di ẹya ilu Dafidi baba rẹ̀.
entries.en: And this was the cause that he lifted up his hand against the king: Solomon built Millo, and repaired the breaches of the city of David his father.

entries.yo: Ọkunrin na, Jeroboamu, ṣe alagbara akọni: nigbati Solomoni si ri ọdọmọkunrin na pe, oṣiṣẹ enia ni, o fi i ṣe olori gbogbo iṣẹ-iru ile Josefu.
entries.en: And the man Jeroboam was a mighty man of valour: and Solomon seeing the young man that he was industrious, he made him ruler over all the charge of the house of Joseph.

entries.yo: O si ṣe li àkoko na, nigbati Jeroboamu jade kuro ni Jerusalemu, woli Ahijah ara Ṣilo ri i loju ọ̀na; o si wọ̀ agbáda titun; awọn meji pere li o si mbẹ ni oko:
entries.en: And it came to pass at that time when Jeroboam went out of Jerusalem, that the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite found him in the way; and he had clad himself with a new garment; and they two were alone in the field:

entries.yo: Ahijah si gbà agbáda titun na ti o wà lara rẹ̀, o si fà a ya si ọ̀na mejila:
entries.en: And Ahijah caught the new garment that was on him, and rent it in twelve pieces:

entries.yo: O si wi fun Jeroboamu pe, Iwọ mu ẹya mẹwa: nitori bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun Israeli wi pe, Wò o, emi o fa ijọba na ya kuro li ọwọ Solomoni, emi o si fi ẹya mẹwa fun ọ.
entries.en: And he said to Jeroboam, Take thee ten pieces: for thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel, Behold, I will rend the kingdom out of the hand of Solomon, and will give ten tribes to thee:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn on o ni ẹya kan nitori Dafidi iranṣẹ mi, ati nitori Jerusalemu, ilu ti mo ti yàn ninu gbogbo ẹya Israeli:
entries.en: (But he shall have one tribe for my servant David's sake, and for Jerusalem's sake, the city which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel:)

entries.yo: Nitori ti nwọn ti kọ̀ mi silẹ, nwọn si mbọ Astoreti, oriṣa awọn ara Sidoni, ati Kemoṣi, oriṣa awọn ara Moabu, ati Milkomu, oriṣa awọn ọmọ Ammoni, nwọn kò si rin li ọ̀na mi, lati ṣe eyiti o tọ́ li oju mi, ati lati pa aṣẹ mi ati idajọ mi mọ́, gẹgẹ bi Dafidi baba rẹ̀.
entries.en: Because that they have forsaken me, and have worshipped Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians, Chemosh the god of the Moabites, and Milcom the god of the children of Ammon, and have not walked in my ways, to do that which is right in mine eyes, and to keep my statutes and my judgments, as did David his father.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi kì yio gba gbogbo ijọba na lọwọ rẹ̀, ṣugbọn emi o ṣe e li ọmọ-alade ni gbogbo ọjọ aiye rẹ̀, nitori Dafidi, iranṣẹ mi, ẹniti mo yàn, nitori o ti pa ofin mi ati aṣẹ mi mọ́:
entries.en: Howbeit I will not take the whole kingdom out of his hand: but I will make him prince all the days of his life for David my servant's sake, whom I chose, because he kept my commandments and my statutes:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi o gba ijọba na li ọwọ ọmọ rẹ̀, emi o si fi i fun ọ, ani ẹya mẹwa.
entries.en: But I will take the kingdom out of his son's hand, and will give it unto thee, even ten tribes.

entries.yo: Emi o si fi ẹya kan fun ọmọ rẹ̀, ki Dafidi iranṣẹ mi ki o le ni imọlẹ niwaju mi nigbagbogbo, ni Jerusalemu, ilu ti mo ti yàn fun ara mi lati fi orukọ mi sibẹ.
entries.en: And unto his son will I give one tribe, that David my servant may have a light alway before me in Jerusalem, the city which I have chosen me to put my name there.

entries.yo: Emi o si mu ọ, iwọ o si jọba gẹgẹ bi gbogbo eyiti ọkàn rẹ nfẹ, iwọ o si jẹ ọba lori Israeli.
entries.en: And I will take thee, and thou shalt reign according to all that thy soul desireth, and shalt be king over Israel.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, bi iwọ o ba tẹtisilẹ si gbogbo eyiti mo paṣẹ fun ọ, ti iwọ o mã rin li ọ̀na mi, ti iwọ o si mã ṣe eyiti o tọ́ loju mi, lati pa aṣẹ mi ati ofin mi mọ́, gẹgẹ bi Dafidi iranṣẹ mi ti ṣe; emi o si wà pẹlu rẹ, emi o si kọ́ ile otitọ fun ọ, gẹgẹ bi emi ti kọ́ fun Dafidi, emi o si fi Israeli fun ọ.
entries.en: And it shall be, if thou wilt hearken unto all that I command thee, and wilt walk in my ways, and do that is right in my sight, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as David my servant did; that I will be with thee, and build thee a sure house, as I built for David, and will give Israel unto thee.

entries.yo: Emi o si pọ́n iru-ọmọ Dafidi loju nitori eyi, ṣugbọn kì iṣe titi lai.
entries.en: And I will for this afflict the seed of David, but not for ever.

entries.yo: Nitorina Solomoni wá ọ̀na lati pa Jeroboamu. Jeroboamu si dide, o si sá lọ si Egipti si ọdọ Ṣiṣaki ọba Egipti, o si wà ni Egipti titi ikú Solomoni.
entries.en: Solomon sought therefore to kill Jeroboam. And Jeroboam arose, and fled into Egypt, unto Shishak king of Egypt, and was in Egypt until the death of Solomon.

entries.yo: Ati iyokù iṣe Solomoni ati gbogbo eyiti o ṣe, ati ọgbọ́n rẹ̀, a kò ha kọ wọn sinu iwe iṣe Solomoni bi?
entries.en: And the rest of the acts of Solomon, and all that he did, and his wisdom, are they not written in the book of the acts of Solomon?

entries.yo: Ọjọ ti Solomoni jọba ni Jerusalemu lori gbogbo Israeli jẹ ogoji ọdun.
entries.en: And the time that Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel was forty years.

entries.yo: Solomoni si sùn pẹlu awọn baba rẹ̀, a si sìn i ni ilu Dafidi baba rẹ̀: Rehoboamu, ọmọ rẹ̀ si jọba ni ipò rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Solomon slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David his father: and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead.

entries.yo: REHOBOAMU si lọ si Ṣekemu, nitori gbogbo Israeli li o wá si Ṣekemu lati fi i jẹ ọba.
entries.en: And Rehoboam went to Shechem: for all Israel were come to Shechem to make him king.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati Jeroboamu, ọmọ Nebati, ti o wà ni Egipti sibẹ gbọ́, nitori ti o ti sá kuro niwaju Solomoni ọba, Jeroboamu si joko ni Egipti.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who was yet in Egypt, heard of it, (for he was fled from the presence of king Solomon, and Jeroboam dwelt in Egypt;)

entries.yo: Nwọn si ranṣẹ pè e, ati Jeroboamu ati gbogbo ijọ Israeli wá, nwọn si sọ fun Rehoboamu wipe,
entries.en: That they sent and called him. And Jeroboam and all the congregation of Israel came, and spake unto Rehoboam, saying,

entries.yo: Baba rẹ sọ àjaga wa di wuwo: njẹ nitorina, ṣe ki ìsin baba rẹ ti o le, ati àjaga rẹ̀ ti o wuwo, ti o fi si wa li ọrùn, ki o fẹrẹ̀ diẹ, awa o si sìn ọ.
entries.en: Thy father made our yoke grievous: now therefore make thou the grievous service of thy father, and his heavy yoke which he put upon us, lighter, and we will serve thee.

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ lọ na titi di ijọ mẹta, nigbana ni ki ẹ pada tọ̀ mi wá. Awọn enia na si lọ.
entries.en: And he said unto them, Depart yet for three days, then come again to me. And the people departed.

entries.yo: Rehoboamu ọba si ba awọn àgbagba, ti imã duro niwaju Solomoni, baba rẹ̀, nigbati o wà lãye, gbimọ̀ wipe, Imọran kili ẹnyin dá, ki emi ki o lè da awọn enia yi lohùn?
entries.en: And king Rehoboam consulted with the old men, that stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, and said, How do ye advise that I may answer this people?

entries.yo: Nwọn si wi fun u pe, Bi iwọ o ba jẹ iranṣẹ fun awọn enia yi loni, ti iwọ o si sin wọn, ti iwọ o si da wọn lohùn, ati ti iwọ o sọ̀rọ rere fun wọn, nwọn o ṣe iranṣẹ rẹ titi lai.
entries.en: And they spake unto him, saying, If thou wilt be a servant unto this people this day, and wilt serve them, and answer them, and speak good words to them, then they will be thy servants for ever.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn o kọ̀ ìmọran awọn àgbagba ti nwọn ba a dá, o si ba awọn ipẹrẹ ti nwọn dagba pẹlu rẹ̀, ti nwọn si duro niwaju rẹ̀ gbimọ̀.
entries.en: But he forsook the counsel of the old men, which they had given him, and consulted with the young men that were grown up with him, and which stood before him:

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Imọran kini ẹnyin dá ki awa ki o le dá awọn enia yi lohùn, ti nwọn ba mi sọ wipe, Ṣe ki àjaga ti baba rẹ fi si wa lọrùn ki o fuyẹ diẹ?
entries.en: And he said unto them, What counsel give ye that we may answer this people, who have spoken to me, saying, Make the yoke which thy father did put upon us lighter?

entries.yo: Awọn ipẹrẹ ti o dagba pẹlu rẹ̀ wi fun u pe, Bayi ni ki iwọ ki o wi fun awọn enia yi ti nwọn ba ọ sọ wipe, Baba rẹ mu ki àjaga wa di wuwo, sugbọn iwọ mu ki o fuyẹ diẹ fun wa; bayi ni ki iwọ ki o sọ fun wọn: ọmọdirin mi yio nipọn jù ẹgbẹ́ baba mi lọ.
entries.en: And the young men that were grown up with him spake unto him, saying, Thus shalt thou speak unto this people that spake unto thee, saying, Thy father made our yoke heavy, but make thou it lighter unto us; thus shalt thou say unto them, My little finger shall be thicker than my father's loins.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, baba mi ti gbe àjaga wuwo kà nyin, emi o si fi kún àjaga nyin: baba mi ti fi paṣan nà nyin, sugbọn emi o fi akẽke nà nyin.
entries.en: And now whereas my father did lade you with a heavy yoke, I will add to your yoke: my father hath chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Jeroboamu ati gbogbo awọn enia na wá sọdọ Rehoboamu ni ijọ kẹta, gẹgẹ bi ọba ti dá wipe, Ẹ pada tọ̀ mi wá ni ijọ kẹta.
entries.en: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day, as the king had appointed, saying, Come to me again the third day.

entries.yo: Ọba si da awọn enia li ohùn akọ, o si kọ̀ ìmọran awọn àgbagba ti nwọn ba a dá.
entries.en: And the king answered the people roughly, and forsook the old men's counsel that they gave him;

entries.yo: O si sọ fun wọn gẹgẹ bi ìmọran awọn ipẹrẹ wipe, Baba mi mu ki àjaga nyin ki o wuwo, emi o si bù kún àjaga nyin: baba mi fi paṣan nà nyin, ṣugbọn akẽke li emi o fi nà nyin,
entries.en: And spake to them after the counsel of the young men, saying, My father made your yoke heavy, and I will add to your yoke: my father also chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.

entries.yo: Ọba kò si fi eti si ti awọn enia na; nitoriti ọ̀ran na ati ọwọ Oluwa wá ni, ki o le mu ọ̀rọ rẹ̀ ṣẹ, ti Oluwa ti ọwọ Ahijah, ara Ṣilo, sọ fun Jeroboamu, ọmọ Nebati.
entries.en: Wherefore the king hearkened not unto the people; for the cause was from the LORD, that he might perform his saying, which the LORD spake by Ahijah the Shilonite unto Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni nigbati gbogbo Israeli ri pe, ọba kò fetisi ti wọn, awọn enia na da ọba li ohùn wipe: Ipin kini awa ni ninu Dafidi? bẹ̃ni awa kò ni iní ninu ọmọ Jesse: Israeli, ẹ pada si agọ nyin: njẹ mã bojuto ile rẹ, Dafidi! Bẹ̃ni Israeli pada sinu agọ wọn.
entries.en: So when all Israel saw that the king hearkened not unto them, the people answered the king, saying, What portion have we in David? neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse: to your tents, O Israel: now see to thine own house, David. So Israel departed unto their tents.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn ọmọ Israeli ti ngbe inu ilu Juda wọnni, Rehoboamu jọba lori wọn.
entries.en: But as for the children of Israel which dwelt in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Rehoboamu ọba, ran Adoramu ẹniti iṣe olori iṣẹ-iru; gbogbo Israeli si sọ ọ li okuta, o si kú. Nitorina Rehoboamu, ọba yara lati gun kẹkẹ́ rẹ̀, lati sá lọ si Jerusalemu.
entries.en: Then king Rehoboam sent Adoram, who was over the tribute; and all Israel stoned him with stones, that he died. Therefore king Rehoboam made speed to get him up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Israeli ṣọtẹ̀ si ile Dafidi titi di oni yi.
entries.en: So Israel rebelled against the house of David unto this day.

entries.yo: O si ṣe nigbati gbogbo Israeli gbọ́ pe Jeroboamu tun pada bọ̀, ni nwọn ranṣẹ, nwọn si pè e wá si ajọ, nwọn si fi i jọba lori gbogbo Israeli: kò si ẹnikan ti o tọ̀ ile Dafidi lẹhin, bikoṣe kiki ẹya Juda.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when all Israel heard that Jeroboam was come again, that they sent and called him unto the congregation, and made him king over all Israel: there was none that followed the house of David, but the tribe of Judah only.

entries.yo: Nigbati Rehoboamu si wá si Jerusalemu, o ko gbogbo ile Juda jọ, pẹlu ẹya Benjamini, ọkẹ mẹsan enia ti a yàn, ti nwọn iṣe ologun, lati ba ile Israeli ja, lati mu ijọba na pada bọ̀ sọdọ Rehoboamu, ọmọ Solomoni.
entries.en: And when Rehoboam was come to Jerusalem, he assembled all the house of Judah, with the tribe of Benjamin, an hundred and fourscore thousand chosen men, which were warriors, to fight against the house of Israel, to bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam the son of Solomon.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ọ̀rọ Ọlọrun tọ̀ Ṣemaiah, enia Ọlọrun wá wipe,
entries.en: But the word of God came unto Shemaiah the man of God, saying,

entries.yo: Sọ fun Rehoboamu, ọmọ Solomoni, ọba Juda, ati fun gbogbo ile Juda ati Benjamini, ati fun iyokù awọn enia wipe,
entries.en: Speak unto Rehoboam, the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and unto all the house of Judah and Benjamin, and to the remnant of the people, saying,

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa wi, Ẹnyin kò gbọdọ goke bẹ̃li ẹnyin kò gbọdọ ba awọn arakunrin nyin jà: ẹ pada olukuluku si ile rẹ̀; nitori nkan yi ati ọdọ mi wá ni. Nwọn si gbọ́ ọ̀rọ Oluwa, nwọn si pada lati lọ, gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ Oluwa.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD, Ye shall not go up, nor fight against your brethren the children of Israel: return every man to his house; for this thing is from me. They hearkened therefore to the word of the LORD, and returned to depart, according to the word of the LORD.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Jeroboamu kọ́ Ṣekemu li oke Efraimu o si ngbe inu rẹ̀; o si jade lati ibẹ lọ, o si kọ́ Penueli.
entries.en: Then Jeroboam built Shechem in mount Ephraim, and dwelt therein; and went out from thence, and built Penuel.

entries.yo: Jeroboamu si wi li ọkàn rẹ̀ pe, Nisisiyi ni ijọba na yio pada si ile Dafidi:
entries.en: And Jeroboam said in his heart, Now shall the kingdom return to the house of David:

entries.yo: Bi awọn enia wọnyi ba ngoke lọ lati ṣe irubọ ni ile Oluwa ni Jerusalemu, nigbana li ọkàn awọn enia yi yio tun yipada sọdọ oluwa wọn, ani sọdọ Rehoboamu, ọba Juda, nwọn o si pa mi, nwọn o si tun pada tọ̀ Rehoboamu, ọba Juda lọ.
entries.en: If this people go up to do sacrifice in the house of the LORD at Jerusalem, then shall the heart of this people turn again unto their lord, even unto Rehoboam king of Judah, and they shall kill me, and go again to Rehoboam king of Judah.

entries.yo: Ọba si gbìmọ, o si ya ẹgbọ̀rọ malu wura meji, o si wi fun wọn pe, O pọ̀ju fun nyin lati mã goke lọ si Jerusalemu: Israeli, wò awọn ọlọrun rẹ, ti o mu ọ lati ilẹ Egipti wá!
entries.en: Whereupon the king took counsel, and made two calves of gold, and said unto them, It is too much for you to go up to Jerusalem: behold thy gods, O Israel, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.

entries.yo: O si gbe ọkan kalẹ ni Beteli, ati ekeji li o fi si Dani.
entries.en: And he set the one in Bethel, and the other put he in Dan.

entries.yo: Nkan yi si di ẹ̀ṣẹ: nitori ti awọn enia lọ lati sìn niwaju ọkan, ani titi de Dani.
entries.en: And this thing became a sin: for the people went to worship before the one, even unto Dan.

entries.yo: O si kọ́ ile ibi giga wọnni, o si ṣe alufa lati inu awọn enia, ti kì iṣe inu awọn ọmọ Lefi.
entries.en: And he made an house of high places, and made priests of the lowest of the people, which were not of the sons of Levi.

entries.yo: Jeroboamu si dá àse silẹ li oṣu kẹjọ, li ọjọ Kẹdogun oṣu, gẹgẹ bi àse ti o wà ni Juda, o si gun ori pẹpẹ na lọ: bẹ̃ni o si ṣe ni Beteli, o rubọ si awọn ọmọ-malu ti o ṣe: o si fi awọn alufa ibi giga wọnni ti o ti ṣe si Beteli.
entries.en: And Jeroboam ordained a feast in the eighth month, on the fifteenth day of the month, like unto the feast that is in Judah, and he offered upon the altar. So did he in Bethel, sacrificing unto the calves that he had made: and he placed in Bethel the priests of the high places which he had made.

entries.yo: O si gun ori pẹpẹ na lọ ti o ti ṣe ni Beteli li ọjọ kẹdogun oṣu kẹjọ, li oṣu ti o rò li ọkàn ara rẹ̀; o si da àse silẹ fun awọn ọmọ Israeli; o si gun ori pẹpẹ na lọ, lati fi turari jona.
entries.en: So he offered upon the altar which he had made in Bethel the fifteenth day of the eighth month, even in the month which he had devised of his own heart; and ordained a feast unto the children of Israel: and he offered upon the altar, and burnt incense.

entries.yo: SI kiyesi i, enia Ọlọrun kan lati Juda wá si Beteli nipa ọ̀rọ Oluwa: Jeroboamu duro lẹba pẹpẹ lati fi turari jona.
entries.en: And, behold, there came a man of God out of Judah by the word of the LORD unto Bethel: and Jeroboam stood by the altar to burn incense.

entries.yo: O si kigbe si pẹpẹ na nipa ọ̀rọ Oluwa, o si wipe, Pẹpẹ! pẹpẹ! bayi li Oluwa wi, Kiyesi i, a o bi ọmọ kan ni ile Dafidi, Josiah li orukọ rẹ̀; lori rẹ ni yio si fi awọn alufa ibi giga wọnni ti nfi turari jona lori rẹ rubọ, a o si sun egungun enia lori rẹ.
entries.en: And he cried against the altar in the word of the LORD, and said, O altar, altar, thus saith the LORD; Behold, a child shall be born unto the house of David, Josiah by name; and upon thee shall he offer the priests of the high places that burn incense upon thee, and men's bones shall be burnt upon thee.

entries.yo: O si fun wọn li àmi kan li ọjọ kanna wipe, Eyi li àmi ti Oluwa ti ṣe; Kiyesi i, pẹpẹ na yio ya, ẽru ti mbẹ lori rẹ̀ yio si danu.
entries.en: And he gave a sign the same day, saying, This is the sign which the LORD hath spoken; Behold, the altar shall be rent, and the ashes that are upon it shall be poured out.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati Jeroboamu, ọba gbọ́ ọ̀rọ enia Ọlọrun, ti o ti kigbe si pẹpẹ na, o wipe, Ẹ mu u. Ọwọ́ rẹ̀ ti o nà si i, si gbẹ, bẹ̃ni kò si le fa a pada sọdọ rẹ̀ mọ.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when king Jeroboam heard the saying of the man of God, which had cried against the altar in Bethel, that he put forth his hand from the altar, saying, Lay hold on him. And his hand, which he put forth against him, dried up, so that he could not pull it in again to him.

entries.yo: Pẹpẹ na si ya, ẽru na si danù kuro ninu pẹpẹ na, gẹgẹ bi àmi ti enia Ọlọrun ti fi fun u nipa ọ̀rọ Oluwa.
entries.en: The altar also was rent, and the ashes poured out from the altar, according to the sign which the man of God had given by the word of the LORD.

entries.yo: Ọba si dahùn, o si wi fun enia Ọlọrun na pe, Tù Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ loju nisisiyi, ki o si gbadura fun mi, ki a ba le tun mu ọwọ́ mi bọ̀ sipo fun mi. Enia Ọlọrun na si tù Ọlọrun loju, a si tun mu ọwọ́ ọba bọ̀ sipo fun u, o si dàbi o ti wà ri.
entries.en: And the king answered and said unto the man of God, Intreat now the face of the LORD thy God, and pray for me, that my hand may be restored me again. And the man of God besought the LORD, and the king's hand was restored him again, and became as it was before.

entries.yo: Ọba si wi fun enia Ọlọrun na pe, Wá ba mi lọ ile, ki o si tù ara rẹ lara, emi o si ta ọ li ọrẹ.
entries.en: And the king said unto the man of God, Come home with me, and refresh thyself, and I will give thee a reward.

entries.yo: Enia Ọlọrun na si wi fun ọba pe, Bi iwọ o ba fun mi ni idaji ile rẹ, emi kì yio ba ọ lọ ile, emi kì yio si jẹ onjẹ, bẹ̃ni emi kì yio si mu omi nihin yi.
entries.en: And the man of God said unto the king, If thou wilt give me half thine house, I will not go in with thee, neither will I eat bread nor drink water in this place:

entries.yo: Nitori bẹ̃ li a pa a laṣẹ fun mi nipa ọ̀rọ Oluwa wipe, Máṣe jẹ onjẹ, má si ṣe mu omi, bẹ̃ni ki o má si ṣe pada li ọ̀na kanna ti o ba wá.
entries.en: For so was it charged me by the word of the LORD, saying, Eat no bread, nor drink water, nor turn again by the same way that thou camest.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ li o si ba ọ̀na miran lọ, kò si pada li ọ̀na na ti o gbà wá si Beteli.
entries.en: So he went another way, and returned not by the way that he came to Bethel.

entries.yo: Woli àgba kan si ngbe Beteli: ọmọ rẹ̀ de, o si rohin gbogbo iṣẹ ti enia Ọlọrun na ti ṣe li ọjọ na ni Beteli fun u: ọ̀rọ ti o sọ fun ọba nwọn si sọ fun baba wọn.
entries.en: Now there dwelt an old prophet in Bethel; and his sons came and told him all the works that the man of God had done that day in Bethel: the words which he had spoken unto the king, them they told also to their father.

entries.yo: Baba wọn si wi fun wọn pe, Ọna wo li o gbà? Nitori awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ ti ri ọ̀na ti enia Ọlọrun na gbà, ti o ti Juda wá.
entries.en: And their father said unto them, What way went he? For his sons had seen what way the man of God went, which came from Judah.

entries.yo: O si wi fun awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ pe, Ẹ di kẹtẹkẹtẹ ni gari fun mi. Nwọn si di kẹtẹkẹtẹ ni gari fun u o si gùn u.
entries.en: And he said unto his sons, Saddle me the ass. So they saddled him the ass: and he rode thereon,

entries.yo: O si tẹ̀le enia Ọlọrun na lẹhin, o si ri i, o joko labẹ igi nla kan: o si wi fun u pe, Iwọ enia Ọlọrun na ti o ti Juda wá? On si wipe, Emi ni.
entries.en: And went after the man of God, and found him sitting under an oak: and he said unto him, Art thou the man of God that camest from Judah? And he said, I am.

entries.yo: O si wi fun u pe, Ba mi lọ ile, ki o si jẹ onjẹ.
entries.en: Then he said unto him, Come home with me, and eat bread.

entries.yo: On si wipe, Emi kò lè pada lọ pẹlu rẹ, bẹ̃ni emi kò lè ba ọ lọ: bẹ̃ni emi kì o jẹ onjẹ, emi kì o si mu omi pẹlu rẹ nihin yi.
entries.en: And he said, I may not return with thee, nor go in with thee: neither will I eat bread nor drink water with thee in this place:

entries.yo: Nitori ti a sọ fun mi nipa ọ̀rọ Oluwa pe, Iwọ kò gbọdọ jẹ onjẹ, iwọ kò si gbọdọ mu omi nibẹ, bẹ̃ni iwọ kò gbọdọ tun pada lọ nipa ọ̀na ti iwọ ba wá.
entries.en: For it was said to me by the word of the LORD, Thou shalt eat no bread nor drink water there, nor turn again to go by the way that thou camest.

entries.yo: O si wi fun u pe, Woli li emi pẹlu gẹgẹ bi iwọ; angeli si sọ fun mi nipa ọ̀rọ Oluwa wipe, Mu u ba ọ pada sinu ile rẹ, ki o le jẹ onjẹ ki o si le mu omi. Ṣugbọn o purọ fun u.
entries.en: He said unto him, I am a prophet also as thou art; and an angel spake unto me by the word of the LORD, saying, Bring him back with thee into thine house, that he may eat bread and drink water. But he lied unto him.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ li o si ba a pada lọ, o si jẹ onjẹ ni ile rẹ̀, o si mu omi.
entries.en: So he went back with him, and did eat bread in his house, and drank water.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, bi nwọn ti joko ti tabili, li ọ̀rọ Oluwa tọ woli na wá ti o mu u padà bọ̀:
entries.en: And it came to pass, as they sat at the table, that the word of the LORD came unto the prophet that brought him back:

entries.yo: O si kigbe si enia Ọlọrun ti o ti Juda wá wipe, bayi li Oluwa wi: Niwọn bi iwọ ti ṣe aigbọran si ẹnu Oluwa, ti iwọ kò si pa aṣẹ na mọ ti Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ pa fun ọ.
entries.en: And he cried unto the man of God that came from Judah, saying, Thus saith the LORD, Forasmuch as thou hast disobeyed the mouth of the LORD, and hast not kept the commandment which the LORD thy God commanded thee,

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn iwọ pada, iwọ si ti jẹ onjẹ, iwọ si ti mu omi ni ibi ti Oluwa sọ fun ọ pe, Máṣe jẹ onjẹ, ki o má si ṣe mu omi; okú rẹ kì yio wá sinu iboji awọn baba rẹ.
entries.en: But camest back, and hast eaten bread and drunk water in the place, of the which the LORD did say to thee, Eat no bread, and drink no water; thy carcase shall not come unto the sepulchre of thy fathers.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, lẹhin igbati o ti jẹ onjẹ, ati lẹhin igbati o ti mu, li o di kẹtẹkẹtẹ ni gari fun u, eyini ni, fun woli ti o ti mu pada bọ̀.
entries.en: And it came to pass, after he had eaten bread, and after he had drunk, that he saddled for him the ass, to wit, for the prophet whom he had brought back.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si lọ tan, kiniun kan pade rẹ̀ li ọ̀na, o si pa a: a si gbe okú rẹ̀ sọ si oju ọ̀na, kẹtẹkẹtẹ si duro tì i, kiniun pẹlu duro tì okú na.
entries.en: And when he was gone, a lion met him by the way, and slew him: and his carcase was cast in the way, and the ass stood by it, the lion also stood by the carcase.

entries.yo: Si kiyesi i, awọn enia nkọja, nwọn ri pe, a gbe okú na sọ si oju ọ̀na, kiniun na si duro tì okú na: nwọn si wá, nwọn si sọ ọ ni ilu ti woli àgba na ngbe.
entries.en: And, behold, men passed by, and saw the carcase cast in the way, and the lion standing by the carcase: and they came and told it in the city where the old prophet dwelt.

entries.yo: Nigbati woli ti o mu u lati ọ̀na pada bọ̀ gbọ́, o wipe, Enia Ọlọrun na ni, ti o ṣọ̀tẹ si Oluwa: nitorina li Oluwa fi i le kiniun lọwọ, ti o si fà a ya, ti o si pa a, gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ Oluwa, ti o ti sọ fun u.
entries.en: And when the prophet that brought him back from the way heard thereof, he said, It is the man of God, who was disobedient unto the word of the LORD: therefore the LORD hath delivered him unto the lion, which hath torn him, and slain him, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake unto him.

entries.yo: O si wi fun awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ pe, Ẹ di kẹtẹkẹtẹ ni gari fun mi. Nwọn si di i ni gari.
entries.en: And he spake to his sons, saying, Saddle me the ass. And they saddled him.

entries.yo: O si lọ, o si ri, a gbé okú rẹ̀ sọ si oju ọ̀na, ati kẹtẹkẹtẹ, ati kiniun duro ti okú na, kiniun kò jẹ okú na, bẹ̃ni kò fà kẹtẹkẹtẹ na ya.
entries.en: And he went and found his carcase cast in the way, and the ass and the lion standing by the carcase: the lion had not eaten the carcase, nor torn the ass.

entries.yo: Woli na mu okú enia Ọlọrun na, o si gbé e lori kẹtẹkẹtẹ na, o si mu u pada bọ̀: woli àgba na si wá si ilu, lati ṣọ̀fọ, ati lati sin i.
entries.en: And the prophet took up the carcase of the man of God, and laid it upon the ass, and brought it back: and the old prophet came to the city, to mourn and to bury him.

entries.yo: O si tẹ okú rẹ̀ sinu iboji ara rẹ̀: nwọn si sọ̀fọ lori rẹ̀, pe: O ṣe, arakunrin mi!
entries.en: And he laid his carcase in his own grave; and they mourned over him, saying, Alas, my brother!

entries.yo: O si ṣe, lẹhin igbati o ti sinkú rẹ̀ tan, o si sọ fun awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ wipe, Nigbati mo ba kú, nigbana ni ki ẹ sinkú mi ni iboji ninu eyiti a sin enia Ọlọrun; ẹ tẹ́ egungun mi lẹba egungun rẹ̀:
entries.en: And it came to pass, after he had buried him, that he spake to his sons, saying, When I am dead, then bury me in the sepulchre wherein the man of God is buried; lay my bones beside his bones:

entries.yo: Nitori ni ṣiṣẹ, ọ̀rọ ti o kigbe nipa ọ̀rọ Oluwa si pẹpẹ na ni Beteli, ati si gbogbo ile ibi giga ti mbẹ ni gbogbo ilu Samaria, yio ṣẹ dandan.
entries.en: For the saying which he cried by the word of the LORD against the altar in Bethel, and against all the houses of the high places which are in the cities of Samaria, shall surely come to pass.

entries.yo: Lẹhin nkan yi, Jeroboamu kò pada kuro ninu ọ̀na ibi rẹ̀, ṣugbọn o tun mu ninu awọn enia ṣe alufa ibi giga wọnni: ẹnikẹni ti o ba fẹ, a yà a sọtọ̀ on a si di alufa ibi giga wọnni.
entries.en: After this thing Jeroboam returned not from his evil way, but made again of the lowest of the people priests of the high places: whosoever would, he consecrated him, and he became one of the priests of the high places.

entries.yo: Nkan yi si di ẹ̀ṣẹ ile Jeroboamu, ani lati ke e kuro, ati lati pa a run kuro lori ilẹ.
entries.en: And this thing became sin unto the house of Jeroboam, even to cut it off, and to destroy it from off the face of the earth.

entries.yo: Li àkoko na, Abijah ọmọ Jeroboamu ṣàisan.
entries.en: At that time Abijah the son of Jeroboam fell sick.

entries.yo: Jeroboamu si wi fun aya rẹ̀ pe, Dide, emi bẹ̀ ọ, si pa ara rẹ dà, ki a má ba le mọ̀ ọ li aya Jeroboamu; ki o si lọ si Ṣilo: kiyesi i, nibẹ li Ahijah, woli wà, ti o sọ fun mi pe, emi o jọba lori enia yi.
entries.en: And Jeroboam said to his wife, Arise, I pray thee, and disguise thyself, that thou be not known to be the wife of Jeroboam; and get thee to Shiloh: behold, there is Ahijah the prophet, which told me that I should be king over this people.

entries.yo: Ki o si mu ìṣu àkara mẹwa li ọwọ́ rẹ, ati akara wẹwẹ, ati igo oyin, ki o si lọ sọdọ rẹ̀: on o si wi fun ọ bi yio ti ri fun ọmọde na.
entries.en: And take with thee ten loaves, and cracknels, and a cruse of honey, and go to him: he shall tell thee what shall become of the child.

entries.yo: Aya Jeroboamu si ṣe bẹ̃, o si dide, o si lọ si Ṣilo, o si wá si ile Ahijah. Ṣugbọn Ahijah kò riran; nitoriti oju rẹ̀ fọ́ nitori ogbó rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Jeroboam's wife did so, and arose, and went to Shiloh, and came to the house of Ahijah. But Ahijah could not see; for his eyes were set by reason of his age.

entries.yo: Oluwa si wi fun Ahijah, pe, Kiyesi i, aya Jeroboamu mbọ̀ wá bère ohun kan lọwọ rẹ niti ọmọ rẹ̀: nitori ti o ṣàisan: bayi bayi ni ki iwọ ki o wi fun u: yio si ṣe, nigbati o ba wọle, yio ṣe ara rẹ̀ bi ẹlomiran.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Ahijah, Behold, the wife of Jeroboam cometh to ask a thing of thee for her son; for he is sick: thus and thus shalt thou say unto her: for it shall be, when she cometh in, that she shall feign herself to be another woman.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ li o si ri, nigbati Ahijah gbọ́ iró ẹsẹ rẹ̀, bi o ti mbọ̀ wá li ẹnu ọ̀na, on si wipe, Wọle wá, iwọ, aya Jeroboamu, ẽṣe ti iwọ fi ṣe ara rẹ bi ẹlomiran? nitori iṣẹ wuwo li a fi rán mi si ọ.
entries.en: And it was so, when Ahijah heard the sound of her feet as she came in at the door, that he said, Come in, thou wife of Jeroboam; why feignest thou thyself to be another? for I am sent to thee with heavy tidings.
