entries.yo: Lọ, sọ fun Jeroboamu, pe, Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun Israeli wi, Nitori bi mo ti gbé ọ ga lati inu awọn enia, ti mo si fi ọ jẹ olori Israeli enia mi.
entries.en: Go, tell Jeroboam, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Forasmuch as I exalted thee from among the people, and made thee prince over my people Israel,

entries.yo: Ti mo si fà ijọba ya kuro ni ile Dafidi, mo si fi i fun ọ: sibẹ iwọ kò ri bi Dafidi iranṣẹ mi, ẹniti o pa ofin mi mọ, ti o si tọ̀ mi lẹhin tọkàntọkàn rẹ̀, lati ṣe kiki eyi ti o tọ li oju mi:
entries.en: And rent the kingdom away from the house of David, and gave it thee: and yet thou hast not been as my servant David, who kept my commandments, and who followed me with all his heart, to do that only which was right in mine eyes;

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn iwọ ti ṣe buburu jù gbogbo awọn ti o ti wà ṣaju rẹ: nitori iwọ ti lọ, iwọ si ti ṣe awọn ọlọrun miran, ati ere didà, lati ru ibinu mi, ti iwọ si ti gbé mi sọ si ẹhin rẹ:
entries.en: But hast done evil above all that were before thee: for thou hast gone and made thee other gods, and molten images, to provoke me to anger, and hast cast me behind thy back:

entries.yo: Nitorina, kiyesi i, emi o mu ibi wá si ile Jeroboamu, emi o ke gbogbo ọdọmọkunrin kuro lọdọ Jeroboamu, ati ọmọ-ọdọ ati omnira ni Israeli, emi o si mu awọn ti o kù ni ile Jeroboamu kuro, gẹgẹ bi enia ti ikó igbẹ kuro, titi gbogbo rẹ̀ yio fi tan.
entries.en: Therefore, behold, I will bring evil upon the house of Jeroboam, and will cut off from Jeroboam him that pisseth against the wall, and him that is shut up and left in Israel, and will take away the remnant of the house of Jeroboam, as a man taketh away dung, till it be all gone.

entries.yo: Ẹni Jeroboamu ti o ba kú ni ilu li awọn ajá yio jẹ: ati ẹniti o ba kú ni igbẹ li awọn ẹiyẹ oju-ọrun yio jẹ: nitori Oluwa ti sọ ọ.
entries.en: Him that dieth of Jeroboam in the city shall the dogs eat; and him that dieth in the field shall the fowls of the air eat: for the LORD hath spoken it.

entries.yo: Nitorina, iwọ dide, lọ si ile rẹ: nigbati ẹsẹ rẹ ba si wọ̀ ilu, ọmọ na yio kú.
entries.en: Arise thou therefore, get thee to thine own house: and when thy feet enter into the city, the child shall die.

entries.yo: Gbogbo Israeli yio si ṣọ̀fọ rẹ̀, nwọn o si sin i; nitori kiki on nikan li ẹniti yio wá si isa-okú ninu ẹniti iṣe ti Jeroboamu, nitori lọdọ rẹ̀ li a ri ohun rere diẹ sipa Oluwa, Ọlọrun Israeli, ni ile Jeroboamu.
entries.en: And all Israel shall mourn for him, and bury him: for he only of Jeroboam shall come to the grave, because in him there is found some good thing toward the LORD God of Israel in the house of Jeroboam.

entries.yo: Oluwa yio si gbé ọba kan dide lori Israeli, ti yio ke ile Jeroboamu kuro li ọjọ na: ṣugbọn kini? ani nisisiyi!
entries.en: Moreover the LORD shall raise him up a king over Israel, who shall cut off the house of Jeroboam that day: but what? even now.

entries.yo: Nitoriti Oluwa yio kọlu Israeli bi a ti imì iye ninu omi, yio si fa Israeli tu kuro ni ilẹ rere yi, ti o ti fi fun awọn baba wọn, yio si fọ́n wọn ka kọja odò na, nitoriti nwọn ṣe ere oriṣa wọn, nwọn si nru ibinu Oluwa.
entries.en: For the LORD shall smite Israel, as a reed is shaken in the water, and he shall root up Israel out of this good land, which he gave to their fathers, and shall scatter them beyond the river, because they have made their groves, provoking the LORD to anger.

entries.yo: Yio si kọ̀ Israeli silẹ nitori ẹ̀ṣẹ Jeroboamu, ẹniti o ṣẹ̀, ti o si mu Israeli dẹṣẹ.
entries.en: And he shall give Israel up because of the sins of Jeroboam, who did sin, and who made Israel to sin.

entries.yo: Aya Jeroboamu si dide, o si lọ, o si de Tira: nigbati o si wọ̀ iloro ile, ọmọde na si kú;
entries.en: And Jeroboam's wife arose, and departed, and came to Tirzah: and when she came to the threshold of the door, the child died;

entries.yo: Nwọn si sin i; gbogbo Israeli si sọ̀fọ rẹ̀, gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ Oluwa, ti o sọ nipa ọwọ́ iranṣẹ rẹ̀, Ahijah woli.
entries.en: And they buried him; and all Israel mourned for him, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake by the hand of his servant Ahijah the prophet.

entries.yo: Ati iyokù iṣe Jeroboamu, bi o ti jagun, ati bi o ti jọba, kiyesi i, a kọ wọn sinu iwe ọ̀rọ ọjọ awọn ọba Israeli.
entries.en: And the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, how he warred, and how he reigned, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

entries.yo: Awọn ọjọ ti Jeroboamu jọba jẹ ọdun mejilelogun, o si sùn pẹlu awọn baba rẹ̀. Nadabu ọmọ rẹ̀ si jọba ni ipò rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the days which Jeroboam reigned were two and twenty years: and he slept with this fathers, and Nadab his son reigned in his stead.

entries.yo: Rehoboamu, ọmọ Solomoni, si jọba ni Juda: Rehoboamu jẹ ẹni ọdun mọkanlelogun nigbati o bẹ̀rẹ si ijọba, o si jọba li ọdun mọkanlelogun ni Jerusalemu, ilu ti Oluwa ti yàn ninu gbogbo ẹya Israeli, lati fi orukọ rẹ̀ sibẹ. Orukọ iya rẹ̀ si ni Naama, ara Ammoni.
entries.en: And Rehoboam the son of Solomon reigned in Judah. Rehoboam was forty and one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which the LORD did choose out of all the tribes of Israel, to put his name there. And his mother's name was Naamah an Ammonitess.

entries.yo: Juda si ṣe buburu niwaju Oluwa, nwọn si fi ẹ̀ṣẹ wọn mu u jowu jù gbogbo eyiti baba wọn ti ṣe, ti nwọn si ti dá.
entries.en: And Judah did evil in the sight of the LORD, and they provoked him to jealousy with their sins which they had committed, above all that their fathers had done.

entries.yo: Nitori awọn pẹlu kọ́ ibi giga fun ara wọn, ati ere, ati igbo-oriṣa lori gbogbo oke giga, ati labẹ gbogbo igi tutu.
entries.en: For they also built them high places, and images, and groves, on every high hill, and under every green tree.

entries.yo: Awọn ti nhùwa panṣaga mbẹ ni ilẹ na: nwọn si ṣe gẹgẹ bi gbogbo ohun irira awọn orilẹ-ède ti Oluwa lé jade kuro niwaju awọn ọmọ Israeli.
entries.en: And there were also sodomites in the land: and they did according to all the abominations of the nations which the LORD cast out before the children of Israel.

entries.yo: O si ṣe li ọdun karun Rehoboamu ọba, Ṣiṣaki, ọba Egipti goke wá si Jerusalemu:
entries.en: And it came to pass in the fifth year of king Rehoboam, that Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem:

entries.yo: O si kó iṣura ile Oluwa lọ, ati iṣura ile ọba; ani gbogbo rẹ̀ li o kó lọ: o si kó gbogbo asà wura ti Solomoni ti ṣe lọ.
entries.en: And he took away the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king's house; he even took away all: and he took away all the shields of gold which Solomon had made.

entries.yo: Rehoboamu ọba si ṣe asà idẹ ni ipò wọn, o si fi wọn si ọwọ́ olori awọn oluṣọ ti nṣọ ilẹkun ile ọba.
entries.en: And king Rehoboam made in their stead brasen shields, and committed them unto the hands of the chief of the guard, which kept the door of the king's house.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li o si ri, nigbati ọba ba nlọ si ile Oluwa, nwọn a rù wọn, nwọn a si mu wọn pada sinu yara oluṣọ.
entries.en: And it was so, when the king went into the house of the LORD, that the guard bare them, and brought them back into the guard chamber.

entries.yo: Iyokù iṣe Rehoboamu, ati gbogbo ohun ti o ṣe, a kò ha kọ wọn sinu iwe ọ̀rọ ọjọ awọn ọba Juda?
entries.en: Now the rest of the acts of Rehoboam, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

entries.yo: Ogun si wà lãrin Rehoboamu ati Jeroboamu li ọjọ wọn gbogbo.
entries.en: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all their days.

entries.yo: Rehoboamu si sùn pẹlu awọn baba rẹ̀, a si sin i pẹlu awọn baba rẹ̀ ni ilu Dafidi. Orukọ iya rẹ̀ si ni Naama, ara Ammoni. Abijah, ọmọ rẹ̀ si jọba ni ipò rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David. And his mother's name was Naamah an Ammonitess. And Abijam his son reigned in his stead.

entries.yo: NJẸ li ọdun kejidilogun Jeroboamu ọba, ọmọ Nebati, Abijah jọba lori Juda.
entries.en: Now in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam the son of Nebat reigned Abijam over Judah.

entries.yo: Ọdun mẹta li o jọba ni Jerusalemu: orukọ iya rẹ̀ si ni Maaka, ọmọbinrin Abiṣalomu.
entries.en: Three years reigned he in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Maachah, the daughter of Abishalom.

entries.yo: O si rin ninu gbogbo ẹ̀ṣẹ baba rẹ̀, ti o ti dá niwaju rẹ̀: ọkàn rẹ̀ kò si pé pẹlu Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ̀ gẹgẹ bi ọkàn Dafidi baba rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he walked in all the sins of his father, which he had done before him: and his heart was not perfect with the LORD his God, as the heart of David his father.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nitori Dafidi li Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ̀ fun u ni imọlẹ kan ni Jerusalemu, lati gbé ọmọ rẹ̀ ró lẹhin rẹ̀, ati lati fi idi Jerusalemu mulẹ:
entries.en: Nevertheless for David's sake did the LORD his God give him a lamp in Jerusalem, to set up his son after him, and to establish Jerusalem:

entries.yo: Nitori Dafidi ṣe eyi ti o tọ li oju Oluwa, kò si yipada kuro ninu gbogbo eyiti o paṣẹ fun u li ọjọ aiye rẹ̀ gbogbo, bikoṣe ni kiki ọ̀ran Uriah, ara Hitti.
entries.en: Because David did that which was right in the eyes of the LORD, and turned not aside from any thing that he commanded him all the days of his life, save only in the matter of Uriah the Hittite.

entries.yo: Ogun si wà lãrin Rehoboamu ati Jeroboamu li ọjọ aiye rẹ̀ gbogbo.
entries.en: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days of his life.

entries.yo: Njẹ iyokù iṣe Abijah ati gbogbo eyiti o ṣe, a kò ha kọ wọn sinu iwe ọ̀rọ ọjọ awọn ọba Juda? Ogun si wà lãrin Abijah ati Jeroboamu.
entries.en: Now the rest of the acts of Abijam, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? And there was war between Abijam and Jeroboam.

entries.yo: Abijah si sùn pẹlu awọn baba rẹ̀; nwọn si sin i ni ilu Dafidi: Asa, ọmọ rẹ̀, si jọba ni ipò rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Abijam slept with his fathers; and they buried him in the city of David: and Asa his son reigned in his stead.

entries.yo: Ati li ogun ọdun Jeroboamu ọba Israeli, ni Asa jọba lori Juda.
entries.en: And in the twentieth year of Jeroboam king of Israel reigned Asa over Judah.

entries.yo: Ọdun mọkanlelogoji li o jọba ni Jerusalemu, orukọ iya nla rẹ̀ si ni Maaka, ọmọbinrin Abiṣalomu.
entries.en: And forty and one years reigned he in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Maachah, the daughter of Abishalom.

entries.yo: Asa si ṣe eyiti o tọ loju Oluwa, bi Dafidi baba rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Asa did that which was right in the eyes of the LORD, as did David his father.

entries.yo: O si mu awọn ti nṣe panṣaga kuro ni ilẹ na, o si kó gbogbo ere ti awọn baba rẹ̀ ti ṣe kuro.
entries.en: And he took away the sodomites out of the land, and removed all the idols that his fathers had made.

entries.yo: Ati Maaka iya rẹ̀ papã, li o si mu kuro lati ma ṣe ayaba, nitori ti o yá ere kan fun oriṣa rẹ̀; Asa si ke ere na kuro; o si daná sun u nibi odò Kidroni.
entries.en: And also Maachah his mother, even her he removed from being queen, because she had made an idol in a grove; and Asa destroyed her idol, and burnt it by the brook Kidron.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ibi giga wọnnì ni a kò mu kuro; sibẹ ọkàn Asa pé pẹlu Oluwa li ọjọ aiye rẹ̀ gbogbo.
entries.en: But the high places were not removed: nevertheless Asa's heart was perfect with the LORD all his days.

entries.yo: O si mu ohun-mimọ́ wọnnì ti baba rẹ̀, ati ohun-mimọ́ wọnnì ti on tikararẹ̀ wọ ile Oluwa, fadaka ati wura, ati ohun-elo wọnnì,
entries.en: And he brought in the things which his father had dedicated, and the things which himself had dedicated, into the house of the LORD, silver, and gold, and vessels.

entries.yo: Ogun si wà lãrin Asa ati Baaṣa, ọba Israeli ni gbogbo ọjọ wọn.
entries.en: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.

entries.yo: Baaṣa, ọba Israeli, si goke lọ si Juda, o si kọ́ Rama, nitori ki o má le jẹ ki ẹnikẹni ki o jade tabi ki o wọle tọ Asa ọba lọ.
entries.en: And Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah, and built Ramah, that he might not suffer any to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Asa mu gbogbo fadaka, ati wura ti o kù ninu iṣura ile Oluwa, ati iṣura ile ọba, o si fi wọn si ọwọ́ awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀: Asa ọba si rán wọn si ọdọ Benhadadi, ọmọ Tabrimoni, ọmọ Hesioni, ọba Siria, ti o ngbe Damasku, wipe,
entries.en: Then Asa took all the silver and the gold that were left in the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king's house, and delivered them into the hand of his servants: and king Asa sent them to Ben-hadad, the son of Tabrimon, the son of Hezion, king of Syria, that dwelt at Damascus, saying,

entries.yo: Jẹ ki majẹmu ki o wà lãrin emi ati iwọ, lãrin baba mi ati baba rẹ, kiye si i, emi ran ọrẹ fadaka ati wura si ọ; wá, ki o si dà majẹmu rẹ pẹlu Baaṣa, ọba Israeli, ki o le lọ kuro lọdọ mi.
entries.en: There is a league between me and thee, and between my father and thy father: behold, I have sent unto thee a present of silver and gold; come and break thy league with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Benhadadi fi eti si ti Asa ọba, o si rán awọn alagbara olori-ogun ti o ni, si ilu Israeli wọnnì, o si kọlu Ijoni, ati Dani ati Abel-bet-maaka, ati gbogbo Kenneroti pẹlu gbogbo ilẹ Naftali.
entries.en: So Ben-hadad hearkened unto king Asa, and sent the captains of the hosts which he had against the cities of Israel, and smote Ijon, and Dan, and Abel-beth-maachah, and all Cinneroth, with all the land of Naphtali.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati Baaṣa gbọ́, o si ṣiwọ ati kọ́ Rama, o si ngbe Tirsa.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when Baasha heard thereof, that he left off building of Ramah, and dwelt in Tirzah.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Asa ọba kede ká gbogbo Juda, kò da ẹnikan si: nwọn si kó okuta Rama kuro, ati igi rẹ̀, ti Baaṣa fi kọle: Asa ọba si fi wọn kọ́ Geba ti Benjamini, ati Mispa.
entries.en: Then king Asa made a proclamation throughout all Judah; none was exempted: and they took away the stones of Ramah, and the timber thereof, wherewith Baasha had builded; and king Asa built with them Geba of Benjamin, and Mizpah.

entries.yo: Iyokù gbogbo iṣe Asa, ati gbogbo agbara rẹ̀ ati gbogbo ohun ti o ṣe, ati ilu wọnnì ti o kọ́, a kò ha kọ wọn sinu iwe ọ̀rọ ọjọ awọn ọba Juda? Ṣugbọn li akoko ogbó rẹ̀, àrun ṣe e li ẹsẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: The rest of all the acts of Asa, and all his might, and all that he did, and the cities which he built, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? Nevertheless in the time of his old age he was diseased in his feet.

entries.yo: Asa si sùn pẹlu awọn baba rẹ̀, a si sin i pẹlu awọn baba rẹ̀ ni ilu Dafidi baba rẹ̀. Jehoṣafati, ọmọ rẹ̀, si jọba ni ipò rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Asa slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead.

entries.yo: Nadabu ọmọ Jeroboamu si bẹ̀rẹ si ijọba lori Israeli li ọdun keji Asa, ọba Juda, o si jọba lori Israeli li ọdun meji.
entries.en: And Nadab the son of Jeroboam began to reign over Israel in the second year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned over Israel two years.

entries.yo: O si ṣe buburu niwaju Oluwa, o si rìn li ọ̀na baba rẹ̀, ati ninu ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ̀ eyiti o mu Israeli ṣẹ̀.
entries.en: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, and walked in the way of his father, and in his sin wherewith he made Israel to sin.

entries.yo: Baaṣa ọmọ Ahijah ti ile Issakari, si dìtẹ si i; Baaṣa kọlu u ni Gibbetoni ti awọn ara Filistia: nitori Nadabu ati gbogbo Israeli dó ti Gibbetoni.
entries.en: And Baasha the son of Ahijah, of the house of Issachar, conspired against him; and Baasha smote him at Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines; for Nadab and all Israel laid siege to Gibbethon.

entries.yo: Ani li ọdun kẹta ti Asa ọba Juda, ni Baaṣa pa a, o si jọba ni ipò rẹ̀.
entries.en: Even in the third year of Asa king of Judah did Baasha slay him, and reigned in his stead.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati o jọba, o kọlu gbogbo ile Jeroboamu; kò kù fun Jeroboamu ẹniti nmí, titi o fi run u, gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ Ọluwa, ti o sọ nipa ọwọ́ iranṣẹ rẹ̀, Ahijah ara Ṣilo:
entries.en: And it came to pass, when he reigned, that he smote all the house of Jeroboam; he left not to Jeroboam any that breathed, until he had destroyed him, according unto the saying of the LORD, which he spake by his servant Ahijah the Shilonite:

entries.yo: Nitori ẹ̀ṣẹ Jeroboamu ti o ṣẹ̀, ti o si mu ki Israeli ṣẹ̀, nipa imunibinu rẹ̀, eyiti o fi mu ki Oluwa Ọlọrun Israeli ki o binu.
entries.en: Because of the sins of Jeroboam which he sinned, and which he made Israel sin, by his provocation wherewith he provoked the LORD God of Israel to anger.

entries.yo: Ati iyokù iṣe Nadabu, ati gbogbo ohun ti o ṣe, a kò ha kọ wọn sinu iwe ọ̀rọ ọjọ awọn ọba Israeli.
entries.en: Now the rest of the acts of Nadab, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

entries.yo: Ogun si wà, lãrin Asa ati Baaṣa ọba Israeli ni gbogbo ọjọ wọn.
entries.en: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.

entries.yo: Li ọdun kẹta Asa, ọba Juda, ni Baaṣa, ọmọ Ahijah bẹ̀rẹ si ijọba lori gbogbo Israeli ni Tirsa, li ọdun mẹrinlelogun.
entries.en: In the third year of Asa king of Judah began Baasha the son of Ahijah to reign over all Israel in Tirzah, twenty and four years.

entries.yo: O si ṣe buburu niwaju Oluwa, o si rìn li ọ̀na Jeroboamu, ati ninu ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ̀, eyiti o mu Israeli ṣẹ̀.
entries.en: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, and walked in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin wherewith he made Israel to sin.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, ọ̀rọ Oluwa tọ Jehu, ọmọ Hanani wá, si Baaṣa wipe,
entries.en: Then the word of the LORD came to Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha, saying,

entries.yo: Bi o ti ṣepe mo gbé ọ ga lati inu ẽkuru wá, ti mo si ṣe ọ li olori Israeli, enia mi; iwọ si rìn li ọ̀na Jeroboamu, iwọ si ti mu ki Israeli enia mi ki o ṣẹ̀, lati fi ẹ̀ṣẹ wọn mu mi binu;
entries.en: Forasmuch as I exalted thee out of the dust, and made thee prince over my people Israel; and thou hast walked in the way of Jeroboam, and hast made my people Israel to sin, to provoke me to anger with their sins;

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, emi o mu iran Baaṣa, ati iran ile rẹ̀ kuro; emi o si ṣe ile rẹ̀ bi ile Jeroboamu, ọmọ Nebati.
entries.en: Behold, I will take away the posterity of Baasha, and the posterity of his house; and will make thy house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

entries.yo: Ẹni Baaṣa ti o ba kú ni ilu li awọn ajá yio jẹ; ati ẹni rẹ̀ ti o kú ni oko li ẹiyẹ oju-ọrun o jẹ.
entries.en: Him that dieth of Baasha in the city shall the dogs eat; and him that dieth of his in the fields shall the fowls of the air eat.

entries.yo: Ati iyokù iṣe Baaṣa, ati ohun ti o ṣe, ati agbara rẹ̀, a kò ha kọ wọn sinu iwe ọ̀rọ ọjọ awọn ọba Israeli.
entries.en: Now the rest of the acts of Baasha, and what he did, and his might, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

entries.yo: Baaṣa si sùn pẹlu awọn baba rẹ̀, a si sin i ni Tirsa: Ela, ọmọ rẹ̀, si jọba ni ipò rẹ̀.
entries.en: So Baasha slept with his fathers, and was buried in Tirzah: and Elah his son reigned in his stead.

entries.yo: Ati pẹlu nipa ọwọ́ Jehu woli, ọmọ Hanani, li ọ̀rọ Oluwa de si Baaṣa, ati si ile rẹ̀, ani nitori gbogbo ibi ti o ṣe niwaju Oluwa, ni fifi iṣẹ ọwọ́ rẹ̀ mu u binu, ati wiwà bi ile Jeroboamu, ati nitori ti o pa a.
entries.en: And also by the hand of the prophet Jehu the son of Hanani came the word of the LORD against Baasha, and against his house, even for all the evil that he did in the sight of the LORD, in provoking him to anger with the work of his hands, in being like the house of Jeroboam; and because he killed him.

entries.yo: Li ọdun kẹrindilọgbọn Asa, ọba Juda, ni Ela, ọmọ Baaṣa, bẹ̀rẹ si ijọba lori Israeli ni Tirsa li ọdun meji.
entries.en: In the twenty and sixth year of Asa king of Judah began Elah the son of Baasha to reign over Israel in Tirzah, two years.

entries.yo: Ati iranṣẹ rẹ̀ Simri, olori idaji kẹkẹ́ rẹ̀, dìtẹ rẹ̀, nigbati o ti wà ni Tirsa, o si mu amupara ni ile Arsa, iriju ile rẹ̀ ni Tirsa.
entries.en: And his servant Zimri, captain of half his chariots, conspired against him, as he was in Tirzah, drinking himself drunk in the house of Arza steward of his house in Tirzah.

entries.yo: Simri si wọle o si kọlù u, o si pa a, li ọdun kẹtadilọgbọn Asa, ọba Juda, o si jọba ni ipò rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Zimri went in and smote him, and killed him, in the twenty and seventh year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned in his stead.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati o bẹ̀rẹ si ijọba, bi o ti joko li ori itẹ rẹ̀, o lù gbogbo ile Baaṣa pa: kò kù ọmọde ọkunrin kan silẹ, ati awọn ibatan rẹ̀ ati awọn ọrẹ́ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when he began to reign, as soon as he sat on his throne, that he slew all the house of Baasha: he left him not one that pisseth against a wall, neither of his kinsfolks, nor of his friends.

entries.yo: Bayi ni Simri pa gbogbo ile Baaṣa run, gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ Oluwa, ti o sọ si Baaṣa nipa ọwọ́ Jehu woli,
entries.en: Thus did Zimri destroy all the house of Baasha, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake against Baasha by Jehu the prophet,

entries.yo: Nitori gbogbo ẹ̀ṣẹ Baaṣa, ati Ela, ọmọ rẹ̀, nipa eyiti nwọn ṣẹ̀, ati nipa eyiti nwọn mu Israeli ṣẹ̀, ni fifi ohun-asán wọn wọnnì mu ki Oluwa, Ọlọrun Israeli binu.
entries.en: For all the sins of Baasha, and the sins of Elah his son, by which they sinned, and by which they made Israel to sin, in provoking the LORD God of Israel to anger with their vanities.

entries.yo: Ati iyokù iṣe Ela, ati gbogbo ohun ti o ṣe, a kò ha kọ wọn sinu iwe ọ̀rọ ọjọ awọn ọba Israeli?
entries.en: Now the rest of the acts of Elah, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

entries.yo: Li ọdun kẹtadilọgbọn Asa, ọba Juda, ni Simri jọba ijọ meje ni Tirsa. Awọn enia si do tì Gibbetoni, ti awọn ara Filistia.
entries.en: In the twenty and seventh year of Asa king of Judah did Zimri reign seven days in Tirzah. And the people were encamped against Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines.

entries.yo: Awọn enia ti o dotì gbọ́ wipe, Simri ditẹ̀ o si ti pa ọba pẹlu: nitorina gbogbo Israeli fi Omri, olori ogun, jẹ ọba lori Israeli li ọjọ na ni ibudo.
entries.en: And the people that were encamped heard say, Zimri hath conspired, and hath also slain the king: wherefore all Israel made Omri, the captain of the host, king over Israel that day in the camp.

entries.yo: Omri si goke lati Gibbetoni lọ, ati gbogbo Israeli pẹlu rẹ̀, nwọn si do tì Tirsa.
entries.en: And Omri went up from Gibbethon, and all Israel with him, and they besieged Tirzah.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati Simri mọ̀ pe a gba ilu, o wọ inu ãfin ile ọba lọ, o si tẹ iná bọ ile ọba lori ara rẹ̀, o si kú.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when Zimri saw that the city was taken, that he went into the palace of the king's house, and burnt the king's house over him with fire, and died,

entries.yo: Nitori ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ̀ wọnni ti o da, ni ṣiṣe buburu niwaju Oluwa, ni rirìn li ọ̀na Jeroboamu ati ninu ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ̀ ti o da, lati mu ki Israeli ki o ṣẹ̀.
entries.en: For his sins which he sinned in doing evil in the sight of the LORD, in walking in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin which he did, to make Israel to sin.

entries.yo: Ati iyokù iṣe Simri, ati ọtẹ rẹ̀ ti o dì, a kò ha kọ wọn sinu iwe ọ̀rọ ọjọ awọn ọba Israeli?
entries.en: Now the rest of the acts of Zimri, and his treason that he wrought, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

entries.yo: Nigbana li awọn enia Israeli da meji; apakan awọn enia ntọ̀ Tibni, ọmọ Ginati lẹhin, lati fi i jọba, apakan si ntọ̀ Omri lẹhin.
entries.en: Then were the people of Israel divided into two parts: half of the people followed Tibni the son of Ginath, to make him king; and half followed Omri.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn enia ti ntọ̀ Omri lẹhin bori awọn ti ntọ̀ Tibni, ọmọ Ginati lẹhin: bẹ̃ni Tibni kú, Omri si jọba.
entries.en: But the people that followed Omri prevailed against the people that followed Tibni the son of Ginath: so Tibni died, and Omri reigned.

entries.yo: Li ọdun kọkanlelọgbọn Asa, ọba Juda, ni Omri bẹ̀rẹ si ijọba lori Israeli fun ọdun mejila: ọdun mẹfa li o jọba ni Tirsa.
entries.en: In the thirty and first year of Asa king of Judah began Omri to reign over Israel, twelve years: six years reigned he in Tirzah.

entries.yo: O si rà oke Samaria lọwọ Semeri ni talenti meji fadaka, o si tẹdo lori oke na, o si pe orukọ ilu na ti o tẹ̀do ni Samaria nipa orukọ Semeri, oluwa oke Samaria.
entries.en: And he bought the hill Samaria of Shemer for two talents of silver, and built on the hill, and called the name of the city which he built, after the name of Shemer, owner of the hill, Samaria.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Omri ṣe buburu li oju Oluwa, o si ṣe buburu jù gbogbo awọn ti o wà ṣãju rẹ̀.
entries.en: But Omri wrought evil in the eyes of the LORD, and did worse than all that were before him.

entries.yo: Nitori ti o rìn ni gbogbo ọ̀na Jeroboamu, ọmọ Nebati, ati ninu ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ̀, eyiti o mu Israeli ṣẹ̀, lati fi ohun-asán wọn wọnni mu Oluwa, Ọlọrun Israeli binu.
entries.en: For he walked in all the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and in his sin wherewith he made Israel to sin, to provoke the LORD God of Israel to anger with their vanities.

entries.yo: Ati iyokù iṣe Omri ti o ṣe, ati agbara rẹ̀ ti o fi hàn, a kò ha kọ wọn sinu iwe ọ̀rọ ọjọ awọn ọba Israeli?
entries.en: Now the rest of the acts of Omri which he did, and his might that he shewed, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

entries.yo: Omri si sùn pẹlu awọn baba rẹ̀, a si sin i ni Samaria: Ahabu ọmọ rẹ̀ si jọba ni ipò rẹ̀.
entries.en: So Omri slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria: and Ahab his son reigned in his stead.

entries.yo: Ati li ọdun kejidilogoji Asa, ọba Juda, ni Ahabu, ọmọ Omri, bẹ̀rẹ si jọba lori Israeli: Ahabu, ọmọ Omri, si jọba lori Israeli ni Samaria li ọdun mejilelogun,
entries.en: And in the thirty and eighth year of Asa king of Judah began Ahab the son of Omri to reign over Israel: and Ahab the son of Omri reigned over Israel in Samaria twenty and two years.

entries.yo: Ahabu, ọmọ Omri, si ṣe buburu li oju Oluwa jù gbogbo awọn ti o wà ṣaju rẹ̀ lọ.
entries.en: And Ahab the son of Omri did evil in the sight of the LORD above all that were before him.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, bi ẹnipe o ṣe ohun kekere fun u lati ma rìn ninu ẹ̀ṣẹ Jeroboamu, ọmọ Nebati, o si mu Jesebeli, ọmọbinrin Etbaali, ọba awọn ara Sidoni li aya, o si lọ, o si sin Baali, o si bọ ọ,
entries.en: And it came to pass, as if it had been a light thing for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, that he took to wife Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal king of the Zidonians, and went and served Baal, and worshipped him.

entries.yo: O si tẹ pẹpẹ kan fun Baali ninu ile Baali, ti o kọ́ ni Samaria.
entries.en: And he reared up an altar for Baal in the house of Baal, which he had built in Samaria.

entries.yo: Ahabu si ṣe ere oriṣa kan; Ahabu si ṣe jù gbogbo awọn ọba Israeli lọ, ti o wà ṣaju rẹ̀, lati mu ki Oluwa Ọlọrun Israeli binu.
entries.en: And Ahab made a grove; and Ahab did more to provoke the LORD God of Israel to anger than all the kings of Israel that were before him.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ rẹ̀ ni Hieli, ara Beteli, kọ́ Jeriko: o fi ipilẹ rẹ̀ le ilẹ ni Abiramu, akọbi rẹ̀, o si gbé awọn ilẹkun ibode rẹ̀ kọ́ ni Segubu abikẹhin rẹ̀, gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ Oluwa, ti o ti ipa Joṣua, ọmọ Nuni sọ.
entries.en: In his days did Hiel the Bethelite build Jericho: he laid the foundation thereof in Abiram his firstborn, and set up the gates thereof in his youngest son Segub, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake by Joshua the son of Nun.

entries.yo: ELIJAH ara Tiṣbi, lati inu awọn olugbe Gileadi, wi fun Ahabu pe, Bi Oluwa Ọlọrun ti wà, niwaju ẹniti emi duro, kì yio si ìri tabi òjo li ọdun wọnyi, ṣugbọn gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ mi.
entries.en: And Elijah the Tishbite, who was of the inhabitants of Gilead, said unto Ahab, As the LORD God of Israel liveth, before whom I stand, there shall not be dew nor rain these years, but according to my word.

entries.yo: Ọrọ Oluwa si tọ̀ ọ wá wipe:
entries.en: And the word of the LORD came unto him, saying,

entries.yo: Kuro nihin, ki o si kọju siha ila-õrun, ki o si fi ara rẹ pamọ nibi odò Keriti, ti mbẹ niwaju Jordani.
entries.en: Get thee hence, and turn thee eastward, and hide thyself by the brook Cherith, that is before Jordan.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, iwọ o mu ninu odò na; mo si ti paṣẹ fun awọn ẹiyẹ iwò lati ma bọ́ ọ nibẹ.
entries.en: And it shall be, that thou shalt drink of the brook; and I have commanded the ravens to feed thee there.

entries.yo: O si lọ, o si ṣe gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ Oluwa: o si lọ, o si ngbe ẹ̀ba odò Keriti, ti mbẹ niwaju Jordani.
entries.en: So he went and did according unto the word of the LORD: for he went and dwelt by the brook Cherith, that is before Jordan.

entries.yo: Awọn ẹiyẹ iwò si mu akara pẹlu ẹran fun u wá li owurọ, ati akara ati ẹran li alẹ: on si mu ninu odò na.
entries.en: And the ravens brought him bread and flesh in the morning, and bread and flesh in the evening; and he drank of the brook.

entries.yo: O si ṣe lẹhin ọjọ wọnni, odò na si gbẹ, nitoriti kò si òjo ni ilẹ na.
entries.en: And it came to pass after a while, that the brook dried up, because there had been no rain in the land.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ Oluwa tọ̀ ọ wá wipe,
entries.en: And the word of the LORD came unto him, saying,

entries.yo: Dide, lọ si Sarefati ti Sidoni, ki o si ma gbe ibẹ: kiyesi i, emi ti paṣẹ fun obinrin opó kan nibẹ lati ma bọ́ ọ.
entries.en: Arise, get thee to Zarephath, which belongeth to Zidon, and dwell there: behold, I have commanded a widow woman there to sustain thee.

entries.yo: On si dide, o si lọ si Sarefati. Nigbati o si de ibode ilu na, kiyesi i, obinrin opó kan nṣa igi jọ nibẹ: o si ke si i, o si wipe, Jọ̃, bu omi diẹ fun mi wá ninu ohun-elo, ki emi ki o le mu.
entries.en: So he arose and went to Zarephath. And when he came to the gate of the city, behold, the widow woman was there gathering of sticks: and he called to her, and said, Fetch me, I pray thee, a little water in a vessel, that I may drink.

entries.yo: Bi o si ti nlọ bù u wá, o ke si i, o si wipe, Jọ̃, mu okele onjẹ diẹ fun mi wá lọwọ rẹ.
entries.en: And as she was going to fetch it, he called to her, and said, Bring me, I pray thee, a morsel of bread in thine hand.

entries.yo: On si wipe, Bi Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ ti wà, emi kò ni àkara, ṣugbọn ikunwọ iyẹfun ninu ìkoko, ati ororo diẹ ninu kòlobo: si kiyesi i, emi nṣa igi meji jọ, ki emi ki o le wọle lọ, ki emi ki o si peṣe rẹ̀ fun mi, ati fun ọmọ mi, ki awa le jẹ ẹ, ki a si kú.
entries.en: And she said, As the LORD thy God liveth, I have not a cake, but an handful of meal in a barrel, and a little oil in a cruse: and, behold, I am gathering two sticks, that I may go in and dress it for me and my son, that we may eat it, and die.

entries.yo: Elijah si wi fun u pe, Má bẹ̀ru; lọ, ki o si ṣe gẹgẹ bi o ti wi; ṣugbọn ki o tètekọ ṣe àkara kekere kan fun mi ninu rẹ̀ na, ki o si mu u fun mi wá, lẹhin na, ki o ṣe tirẹ ati ti ọmọ rẹ:
entries.en: And Elijah said unto her, Fear not; go and do as thou hast said: but make me thereof a little cake first, and bring it unto me, and after make for thee and for thy son.

entries.yo: Nitori bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun Israeli wi: Ikoko iyẹfun na kì yio ṣòfo, bẹni kólobo ororo na kì yio gbẹ, titi di ọjọ ti Oluwa yio rọ̀ òjo si ori ilẹ.
entries.en: For thus saith the LORD God of Israel, The barrel of meal shall not waste, neither shall the cruse of oil fail, until the day that the LORD sendeth rain upon the earth.

entries.yo: O si lọ, o ṣe gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ Elijah: ati on ati obinrin na, ati ile rẹ̀ jẹ li ọjọ pupọ̀.
entries.en: And she went and did according to the saying of Elijah: and she, and he, and her house, did eat many days.

entries.yo: Ikoko iyẹfun na kò ṣòfo, bẹ̃ni kólobo ororo na kò gbẹ, gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ Oluwa, ti o ti ipa Elijah sọ.
entries.en: And the barrel of meal wasted not, neither did the cruse of oil fail, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake by Elijah.

entries.yo: O si ṣe lẹhin nkan wọnyi, ni ọmọ obinrin na, iya ile na, ṣe aisàn; aisàn rẹ̀ na si le to bẹ̃, ti kò kù ẹmi ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And it came to pass after these things, that the son of the woman, the mistress of the house, fell sick; and his sickness was so sore, that there was no breath left in him.

entries.yo: On si wi fun Elijah pe, Kili o ṣe mi ṣe ọ, Iwọ enia Ọlọrun? iwọ ha tọ̀ mi wá lati mu ẹ̀ṣẹ mi wá si iranti, ati lati pa mi li ọmọ?
entries.en: And she said unto Elijah, What have I to do with thee, O thou man of God? art thou come unto me to call my sin to remembrance, and to slay my son?

entries.yo: On si wi fun u pe, Gbé ọmọ rẹ fun mi. Elijah si yọ ọ jade li aiya rẹ̀, o si gbé e lọ si iyara-òke ile nibiti on ngbe, o si tẹ́ ẹ si ori akete tirẹ̀.
entries.en: And he said unto her, Give me thy son. And he took him out of her bosom, and carried him up into a loft, where he abode, and laid him upon his own bed.

entries.yo: O si kepe OLUWA, o si wipe, OLUWA Ọlọrun mi, iwọ ha mu ibi wá ba opó na pẹlu lọdọ ẹniti emi nṣe atipo, ni pipa ọmọ rẹ̀?
entries.en: And he cried unto the LORD, and said, O LORD my God, hast thou also brought evil upon the widow with whom I sojourn, by slaying her son?

entries.yo: On si nà ara rẹ̀ lori ọmọde na li ẹrinmẹta, o si kepe Oluwa, o si wipe, Oluwa Ọlọrun mi, emi bẹ̀ ọ, jẹ ki ẹmi ọmọde yi ki o tun padà wá sinu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he stretched himself upon the child three times, and cried unto the LORD, and said, O LORD my God, I pray thee, let this child's soul come into him again.

entries.yo: Oluwa si gbọ́ ohùn Elijah; ẹmi ọmọde na si tun padà wá sinu rẹ̀, o si sọji.
entries.en: And the LORD heard the voice of Elijah; and the soul of the child came into him again, and he revived.

entries.yo: Elijah si mu ọmọde na, o si mu u sọkalẹ lati inu iyara-òke na wá sinu ile, o si fi i le iya rẹ̀ lọwọ: Elijah si wipe, Wò o, ọmọ rẹ yè.
entries.en: And Elijah took the child, and brought him down out of the chamber into the house, and delivered him unto his mother: and Elijah said, See, thy son liveth.

entries.yo: Obinrin na si wi fun Elijah pe, nisisiyi nipa eyi li emi mọ̀ pe, enia Ọlọrun ni iwọ iṣe, ati pe, ọ̀rọ Oluwa li ẹnu rẹ, otitọ ni.
entries.en: And the woman said to Elijah, Now by this I know that thou art a man of God, and that the word of the LORD in thy mouth is truth.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, lẹhin ọjọ pupọ, ọ̀rọ Oluwa tọ Elijah wá lọdun kẹta, wipe, Lọ, fi ara rẹ hàn Ahabu; emi o si rọ̀ òjo sori ilẹ.
entries.en: And it came to pass after many days, that the word of the LORD came to Elijah in the third year, saying, Go, shew thyself unto Ahab; and I will send rain upon the earth.

entries.yo: Elijah si lọ ifi ara rẹ̀ han Ahabu. Iyan nla si mu ni Samaria.
entries.en: And Elijah went to shew himself unto Ahab. And there was a sore famine in Samaria.

entries.yo: Ahabu si pe Obadiah, ti iṣe olori ile rẹ̀. Njẹ Obadiah bẹ̀ru Oluwa gidigidi:
entries.en: And Ahab called Obadiah, which was the governor of his house. (Now Obadiah feared the LORD greatly:

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati Jesebeli ke awọn woli Oluwa kuro, ni Obadiah mu ọgọrun woli, o si fi wọn pamọ li aradọta ni iho okuta; o si fi àkara pẹlu omi bọ́ wọn.
entries.en: For it was so, when Jezebel cut off the prophets of the LORD, that Obadiah took an hundred prophets, and hid them by fifty in a cave, and fed them with bread and water.)

entries.yo: Ahabu si wi fun Obadiah pe, Rin ilẹ lọ, si orisun omi gbogbo, ati si odò gbogbo: bọya awa le ri koriko lati gbà awọn ẹṣin ati awọn ibãka là, ki a má ba ṣòfo awọn ẹranko patapata.
entries.en: And Ahab said unto Obadiah, Go into the land, unto all fountains of water, and unto all brooks: peradventure we may find grass to save the horses and mules alive, that we lose not all the beasts.

entries.yo: Nwọn si pin ilẹ na lãrin ara wọn, lati là a ja: Ahabu gba ọ̀na kan lọ fun ara rẹ̀, Obadiah si gba ọ̀na miran lọ fun ara rẹ̀.
entries.en: So they divided the land between them to pass throughout it: Ahab went one way by himself, and Obadiah went another way by himself.

entries.yo: Nigbati Obadiah si wà li ọ̀na, kiyesi i, Elijah pade rẹ̀: nigbati o mọ̀ ọ, o si doju rẹ̀ bolẹ, o si wipe, Ṣé iwọ oluwa mi Elijah nìyí?
entries.en: And as Obadiah was in the way, behold, Elijah met him: and he knew him, and fell on his face, and said, Art thou that my lord Elijah?

entries.yo: O si da a lohùn pe, Emi ni: lọ, sọ fun oluwa rẹ pe, Wò o, Elijah mbẹ nihin.
entries.en: And he answered him, I am: go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah is here.

entries.yo: On si wipe, Ẹ̀ṣẹ kini mo ha dá, ti iwọ fẹ fi iranṣẹ rẹ le Ahabu lọwọ lati pa mi?
entries.en: And he said, What have I sinned, that thou wouldest deliver thy servant into the hand of Ahab, to slay me?

entries.yo: Bi Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ ti wà, kò si orilẹ-ède tabi ijọba kan, nibiti oluwa mi kò ranṣẹ de lati wò ọ: nigbati nwọn ba si wipe, Kò si; on a mu ki ijọba tabi orilẹ-ède na bura pe: awọn kò ri ọ.
entries.en: As the LORD thy God liveth, there is no nation or kingdom, whither my lord hath not sent to seek thee: and when they said, He is not there; he took an oath of the kingdom and nation, that they found thee not.

entries.yo: Nisisiyi iwọ si wipe, Lọ, sọ fun oluwa rẹ pe, Wò o, Elijah mbẹ nihin;
entries.en: And now thou sayest, Go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah is here.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe bi emi o ti lọ kuro li ọdọ rẹ, Ẹmi Oluwa yio si gbe ọ lọ si ibi ti emi kò mọ̀; nigbati mo ba si de, ti mo si wi fun Ahabu, ti kò ba si ri ọ, on o pa mi: ṣugbọn emi, iranṣẹ rẹ, bẹ̀ru Oluwa lati igba ewe mi wá.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass, as soon as I am gone from thee, that the Spirit of the LORD shall carry thee whither I know not; and so when I come and tell Ahab, and he cannot find thee, he shall slay me: but I thy servant fear the LORD from my youth.

entries.yo: A kò ha sọ fun oluwa mi, ohun ti mo ṣe nigbati Jesebeli pa awọn woli Oluwa, bi mo ti pa ọgọrun enia mọ ninu awọn woli Oluwa li aradọta ninu ihò-okuta, ti mo si fi àkara pẹlu omi bọ́ wọn?
entries.en: Was it not told my lord what I did when Jezebel slew the prophets of the LORD, how I hid an hundred men of the LORD's prophets by fifty in a cave, and fed them with bread and water?

entries.yo: Nisisiyi, iwọ si wipe, Lọ sọ fun oluwa rẹ pe, Wò o, Elijah mbẹ nihin! on o si pa mi.
entries.en: And now thou sayest, Go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah is here: and he shall slay me.

entries.yo: Elijah si wipe, Bi Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun ti wà, niwaju ẹniti emi duro, nitõtọ, emi o fi ara mi han fun u loni yi.
entries.en: And Elijah said, As the LORD of hosts liveth, before whom I stand, I will surely shew myself unto him to day.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Obadiah lọ lati pade Ahabu, o si sọ fun u: Ahabu si lọ lati pade Elijah.
entries.en: So Obadiah went to meet Ahab, and told him: and Ahab went to meet Elijah.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, bi Ahabu ti ri Elijah, Ahabu si wi fun u pe, Iwọ li ẹniti nyọ Israeli li ẹnu!
entries.en: And it came to pass, when Ahab saw Elijah, that Ahab said unto him, Art thou he that troubleth Israel?

entries.yo: On sì dahùn pe, Emi kò yọ Israeli li ẹnu; bikoṣe iwọ ati ile baba rẹ, ninu eyiti ẹnyin ti kọ̀ ofin Oluwa silẹ, ti iwọ si ti ntọ̀ Baalimu lẹhin.
entries.en: And he answered, I have not troubled Israel; but thou, and thy father's house, in that ye have forsaken the commandments of the LORD, and thou hast followed Baalim.

entries.yo: Nitorina, ranṣẹ nisisiyi, ki o si kó gbogbo Israeli jọ sọdọ mi si oke Karmeli ati awọn woli Baali ãdọtalenirinwo, ati awọn woli ere-oriṣa irinwo, ti njẹun ni tabili Jesebeli.
entries.en: Now therefore send, and gather to me all Israel unto mount Carmel, and the prophets of Baal four hundred and fifty, and the prophets of the groves four hundred, which eat at Jezebel's table.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Ahabu ranṣẹ si gbogbo awọn ọmọ Israeli, o si kó awọn woli jọ si oke Karmeli.
entries.en: So Ahab sent unto all the children of Israel, and gathered the prophets together unto mount Carmel.

entries.yo: Elijah si tọ gbogbo awọn enia na wá, o si wipe, Yio ti pẹ to ti ẹnyin o ma ṣiyemeji? Bi Oluwa ba ni Ọlọrun, ẹ mã tọ̀ ọ lẹhin: ṣugbọn bi Baali ba ni ẹ mã tọ̀ ọ lẹhin! Awọn enia na kò si da a li ohùn ọ̀rọ kan.
entries.en: And Elijah came unto all the people, and said, How long halt ye between two opinions? if the LORD be God, follow him: but if Baal, then follow him. And the people answered him not a word.

entries.yo: Elijah si wi fun awọn enia na pe, Emi, ani emi nikanṣoṣo li o kù ni woli Oluwa; ṣugbọn awọn woli Baali ãdọta-lenirinwo ọkunrin,
entries.en: Then said Elijah unto the people, I, even I only, remain a prophet of the LORD; but Baal's prophets are four hundred and fifty men.

entries.yo: Nitorina jẹ ki nwọn ki o fun wa li ẹgbọrọ akọ-malu meji; ki nwọn ki o si yàn ẹgbọrọ akọ-malu kan fun ara wọn, ki nwọn ki o si ke e, ki nwọn ki o si tò o si ori igi, ki nwọn ki o má ṣe fi iná si i: emi o si tun ẹgbọrọ akọ-malu keji ṣe, emi o si tò o sori igi, emi kì o si fi iná si i.
entries.en: Let them therefore give us two bullocks; and let them choose one bullock for themselves, and cut it in pieces, and lay it on wood, and put no fire under: and I will dress the other bullock, and lay it on wood, and put no fire under:

entries.yo: Ki ẹ si kepe orukọ awọn ọlọrun nyin, emi o si kepè orukọ Oluwa: Ọlọrun na ti o ba fi iná dahùn on na li Ọlọrun. Gbogbo awọn enia na si dahùn, nwọn si wipe, O wi i re.
entries.en: And call ye on the name of your gods, and I will call on the name of the LORD: and the God that answereth by fire, let him be God. And all the people answered and said, It is well spoken.

entries.yo: Elijah si wi fun awọn woli Baali pe, Ẹ yàn ẹgbọrọ akọ-malu kan fun ara nyin, ki ẹ si tètekọ ṣe e: nitori ẹnyin pọ̀: ki ẹ si kepè orukọ awọn ọlọrun nyin, ṣugbọn ẹ máṣe fi iná si i,
entries.en: And Elijah said unto the prophets of Baal, Choose you one bullock for yourselves, and dress it first; for ye are many; and call on the name of your gods, but put no fire under.

entries.yo: Nwọn si mu ẹgbọrọ akọ-malu na ti a fi fun wọn, nwọn si ṣe e, nwọn si kepè orukọ Baali lati owurọ titi di ọ̀sangangan wipe, Baali! da wa lohùn. Ṣugbọn kò si ohùn, bẹ̃ni kò si idahùn. Nwọn si jó yi pẹpẹ na ka, eyiti nwọn tẹ́.
entries.en: And they took the bullock which was given them, and they dressed it, and called on the name of Baal from morning even until noon, saying, O Baal, hear us. But there was no voice, nor any that answered. And they leaped upon the altar which was made.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, li ọ̀sangangan ni Elijah fi wọn ṣe ẹlẹya o si wipe, Ẹ kigbe lohùn rara, ọlọrun sa li on; bọya o nṣe àṣaro, tabi on nlepa, tabi o re àjo, bọya o sùn, o yẹ ki a ji i.
entries.en: And it came to pass at noon, that Elijah mocked them, and said, Cry aloud: for he is a god; either he is talking, or he is pursuing, or he is in a journey, or peradventure he sleepeth, and must be awaked.

entries.yo: Nwọn si kigbe lohùn rara, nwọn si fi ọbẹ ati ọ̀kọ ya ara wọn gẹgẹ bi iṣe wọn, titi ẹ̀jẹ fi tu jade li ara wọn.
entries.en: And they cried aloud, and cut themselves after their manner with knives and lancets, till the blood gushed out upon them.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati ọjọ kan atarí, nwọn si nfi were sọtẹlẹ titi di akoko irubọ aṣalẹ, kò si ohùn, bẹ̃ni kò si idahùn, tabi ẹniti o kà a si.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when midday was past, and they prophesied until the time of the offering of the evening sacrifice, that there was neither voice, nor any to answer, nor any that regarded.

entries.yo: Njẹ Elijah wi fun gbogbo awọn enia na pe, Ẹ sunmọ mi. Gbogbo awọn enia na si sunmọ ọ. On si tun pẹpẹ Oluwa ti o ti wo lulẹ ṣe.
entries.en: And Elijah said unto all the people, Come near unto me. And all the people came near unto him. And he repaired the altar of the LORD that was broken down.

entries.yo: Elijah si mu okuta mejila, gẹgẹ bi iye ẹ̀ya ọmọ Jakobu, ẹniti ọ̀rọ Oluwa tọ̀ wá, wipe, Israeli li orukọ rẹ yio ma jẹ:
entries.en: And Elijah took twelve stones, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob, unto whom the word of the LORD came, saying, Israel shall be thy name:

entries.yo: Okuta wọnyi li o fi tẹ́ pẹpẹ kan li orukọ Oluwa, o si wà kòtò yi pẹpẹ na ka, ti o le gba iwọn oṣùwọn irugbin meji.
entries.en: And with the stones he built an altar in the name of the LORD: and he made a trench about the altar, as great as would contain two measures of seed.

entries.yo: O si to igi na daradara, o si ke ẹgbọrọ akọ-malu na, o si tò o sori igi, o si wipe, fi omi kún ikoko mẹrin, ki ẹ si tú u sori ẹbọ sisun ati sori igi na.
entries.en: And he put the wood in order, and cut the bullock in pieces, and laid him on the wood, and said, Fill four barrels with water, and pour it on the burnt sacrifice, and on the wood.

entries.yo: O si wipe, Ṣe e nigba keji. Nwọn si ṣe e nigba keji. O si wipe, Ṣe e nigba kẹta. Nwọn si ṣe e nigba kẹta.
entries.en: And he said, Do it the second time. And they did it the second time. And he said, Do it the third time. And they did it the third time.

entries.yo: Omi na si ṣàn yi pẹpẹ na ka, o si fi omi kún kòtò na pẹlu.
entries.en: And the water ran round about the altar; and he filled the trench also with water.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, ni irubọ aṣalẹ, ni Elijah woli sunmọ tòsi, o si wipe, Oluwa Ọlọrun Abrahamu, Isaaki, ati Israeli, jẹ ki o di mimọ̀ loni pe, iwọ li Ọlọrun ni Israeli, emi si ni iranṣẹ rẹ, ati pe mo ṣe gbogbo nkan wọnyi nipa ọ̀rọ rẹ.
entries.en: And it came to pass at the time of the offering of the evening sacrifice, that Elijah the prophet came near, and said, LORD God of Abraham, Isaac, and of Israel, let it be known this day that thou art God in Israel, and that I am thy servant, and that I have done all these things at thy word.

entries.yo: Gbọ́ ti emi, Oluwa, gbọ́ ti emi, ki awọn enia yi ki o le mọ̀ pe, Iwọ Oluwa li Ọlọrun, ati pe, Iwọ tún yi ọkàn wọn pada.
entries.en: Hear me, O LORD, hear me, that this people may know that thou art the LORD God, and that thou hast turned their heart back again.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni iná Oluwa bọ́ silẹ, o si sun ẹbọsisun na ati igi, ati okuta wọnnì, ati erupẹ o si lá omi ti mbẹ ninu yàra na.
entries.en: Then the fire of the LORD fell, and consumed the burnt sacrifice, and the wood, and the stones, and the dust, and licked up the water that was in the trench.

entries.yo: Nigbati gbogbo awọn enia ri i, nwọn da oju wọn bolẹ: nwọn si wipe, Oluwa, on li Ọlọrun; Oluwa, on li Ọlọrun!
entries.en: And when all the people saw it, they fell on their faces: and they said, The LORD, he is the God; the LORD, he is the God.

entries.yo: Elijah si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ mu awọn woli Baali; máṣe jẹ ki ọkan ninu wọn ki o salà. Nwọn si mu wọn: Elijah si mu wọn sọkalẹ si odò Kiṣoni, o si pa wọn nibẹ.
entries.en: And Elijah said unto them, Take the prophets of Baal; let not one of them escape. And they took them: and Elijah brought them down to the brook Kishon, and slew them there.

entries.yo: Elijah si wi fun Ahabu pe, Goke lọ, jẹ, ki o si mu; nitori iró ọ̀pọlọpọ òjo mbẹ.
entries.en: And Elijah said unto Ahab, Get thee up, eat and drink; for there is a sound of abundance of rain.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Ahabu goke lọ lati jẹ ati lati mu. Elijah si gun ori oke Karmeli lọ; o si tẹriba o si fi oju rẹ̀ si agbedemeji ẽkun rẹ̀,
entries.en: So Ahab went up to eat and to drink. And Elijah went up to the top of Carmel; and he cast himself down upon the earth, and put his face between his knees,

entries.yo: O si wi fun ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ̀ pe, Goke lọ nisisiyi, ki o si wò iha okun. On si goke lọ, o si wò, o si wipe, Kò si nkan. O si wipe, Tun lọ nigba meje.
entries.en: And said to his servant, Go up now, look toward the sea. And he went up, and looked, and said, There is nothing. And he said, Go again seven times.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, ni igba keje, o si wipe, Kiyesi i, awọsanmọ kekere kan dide lati inu okun, gẹgẹ bi ọwọ́ enia. On si wipe, Goke lọ, wi fun Ahabu pe, Di kẹkẹ́ rẹ, ki o si sọkalẹ, ki òjo ki o má ba da ọ duro.
entries.en: And it came to pass at the seventh time, that he said, Behold, there ariseth a little cloud out of the sea, like a man's hand. And he said, Go up, say unto Ahab, Prepare thy chariot, and get thee down, that the rain stop thee not.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigba diẹ si i, ọrun si ṣu fun awọsanmọ on iji, òjo pupọ si rọ̀. Ahabu si gun kẹkẹ́, o si lọ si Jesreeli.
entries.en: And it came to pass in the mean while, that the heaven was black with clouds and wind, and there was a great rain. And Ahab rode, and went to Jezreel.

entries.yo: Ọwọ́ Oluwa si mbẹ lara Elijah: o si di amure ẹ̀gbẹ rẹ̀, o si sare niwaju Ahabu titi de Jesreeli.
entries.en: And the hand of the LORD was on Elijah; and he girded up his loins, and ran before Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel.

entries.yo: AHABU si sọ ohun gbogbo, ti Elijah ti ṣe, fun Jesebeli, ati pẹlu bi o ti fi idà pa gbogbo awọn woli.
entries.en: And Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done, and withal how he had slain all the prophets with the sword.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Jesebeli rán onṣẹ kan si Elijah, wipe, Bẹ̃ni ki awọn òriṣa ki o ṣe si mi ati jù bẹ̃ lọ pẹlu, bi emi kò ba ṣe ẹmi rẹ dabi ọkan ninu wọn ni iwoyi ọla.
entries.en: Then Jezebel sent a messenger unto Elijah, saying, So let the gods do to me, and more also, if I make not thy life as the life of one of them by to morrow about this time.

entries.yo: O si bẹ̀ru, o si dide, o si lọ fun ẹmi rẹ̀, o si de Beerṣeba ti Juda, o si fi ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ̀ silẹ nibẹ.
entries.en: And when he saw that, he arose, and went for his life, and came to Beer-sheba, which belongeth to Judah, and left his servant there.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn on tikararẹ̀ lọ ni irin ọjọ kan si aginju, o si wá, o si joko labẹ igi juniperi kan, o si tọrọ fun ara rẹ̀ ki on ba le kú; o si wipe, O to; nisisiyi, Oluwa, gba ẹmi mi kuro nitori emi kò sàn jù awọn baba mi lọ!
entries.en: But he himself went a day's journey into the wilderness, and came and sat down under a juniper tree: and he requested for himself that he might die; and said, It is enough; now, O LORD, take away my life; for I am not better than my fathers.

entries.yo: Bi o si ti dùbulẹ ti o si sùn labẹ igi juniperi kan, si wò o, angeli fi ọwọ́ tọ́ ọ, o si wi fun u pe, Dide, jẹun.
entries.en: And as he lay and slept under a juniper tree, behold, then an angel touched him, and said unto him, Arise and eat.

entries.yo: O si wò, si kiyesi i, àkara ti a din lori ẹyin iná, ati orù-omi lẹba ori rẹ̀: o si jẹ, o si mu, o si tun dùbulẹ.
entries.en: And he looked, and, behold, there was a cake baken on the coals, and a cruse of water at his head. And he did eat and drink, and laid him down again.

entries.yo: Angeli Oluwa si tun pada wá lẹrinkeji, o si fi ọwọ́ tọ́ ọ, o si wipe, Dide, jẹun; nitoriti ọ̀na na jìn fun ọ.
entries.en: And the angel of the LORD came again the second time, and touched him, and said, Arise and eat; because the journey is too great for thee.

entries.yo: O si dide, o si jẹ, o mu, o si lọ li agbara onjẹ yi li ogoji ọsan ati ogoji oru si Horebu, oke Ọlọrun.
entries.en: And he arose, and did eat and drink, and went in the strength of that meat forty days and forty nights unto Horeb the mount of God.

entries.yo: O si de ibẹ̀, si ibi ihò okuta, o si wọ̀ sibẹ, si kiyesi i, ọ̀rọ Oluwa tọ̀ ọ wá, o si wi fun u pe, Kini iwọ nṣe nihinyi, Elijah?
entries.en: And he came thither unto a cave, and lodged there; and, behold, the word of the LORD came to him, and he said unto him, What doest thou here, Elijah?

entries.yo: On si wipe, Ni jijowu emi ti njowu fun Oluwa Ọlọrun awọn ọmọ-ogun: nitoriti awọn ọmọ Israeli ti kọ̀ majẹmu rẹ silẹ, nwọn ti wó awọn pẹpẹ rẹ lulẹ, nwọn si ti fi idà pa awọn woli rẹ: ati emi, ani emi nikanṣoṣo li o kù, nwọn si nwá ẹmi mi lati gba a kuro.
entries.en: And he said, I have been very jealous for the LORD God of hosts: for the children of Israel have forsaken thy covenant, thrown down thine altars, and slain thy prophets with the sword; and I, even I only, am left; and they seek my life, to take it away.

entries.yo: O si wipe, Jade lọ, ki o si duro lori oke niwaju Oluwa. Si kiyesi i, Oluwa kọja, ìji nla ati lile si fà awọn oke nla ya, o si fọ́ awọn apata tũtu niwaju Oluwa; ṣugbọn Oluwa kò si ninu iji na: ati lẹhin iji na, isẹlẹ; ṣugbọn Oluwa kò si ninu isẹlẹ na.
entries.en: And he said, Go forth, and stand upon the mount before the LORD. And, behold, the LORD passed by, and a great and strong wind rent the mountains, and brake in pieces the rocks before the LORD; but the LORD was not in the wind: and after the wind an earthquake; but the LORD was not in the earthquake:

entries.yo: Ati lẹhin isẹlẹ na, iná; ṣugbọn Oluwa kò si ninu iná na, ati lẹhin iná na, ohùn kẹ́lẹ kekere.
entries.en: And after the earthquake a fire; but the LORD was not in the fire: and after the fire a still small voice.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati Elijah gbọ́, o si fi agbáda rẹ̀ bo oju rẹ̀, o si jade lọ, o duro li ẹnu iho okuta na. Si kiyesi i, ohùn kan tọ̀ ọ wá wipe, Kini iwọ nṣe nihinyi Elijah?
entries.en: And it was so, when Elijah heard it, that he wrapped his face in his mantle, and went out, and stood in the entering in of the cave. And, behold, there came a voice unto him, and said, What doest thou here, Elijah?

entries.yo: On si wipe, Ni jijowu, emi ti njowu fun Oluwa Ọlọrun awọn ọmọ-ogun: nitoriti awọn ọmọ Israeli ti kọ̀ majẹmu rẹ silẹ, nwọn si ti wó awọn pẹpẹ rẹ lulẹ, nwọn si ti fi idà pa awọn woli rẹ; ati emi, ani emi nikanṣoṣo li o kù; nwọn si nwá ẹmi mi lati gba a kuro.
entries.en: And he said, I have been very jealous for the LORD God of hosts: because the children of Israel have forsaken thy covenant, thrown down thine altars, and slain thy prophets with the sword; and I, even I only, am left; and they seek my life, to take it away.

entries.yo: Oluwa si wi fun u pe, Lọ, pada li ọ̀na rẹ, kọja li aginju si Damasku: nigbati iwọ ba de ibẹ, ki o si fi ororo yan Hasaeli li ọba lori Siria.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto him, Go, return on thy way to the wilderness of Damascus: and when thou comest, anoint Hazael to be king over Syria:

entries.yo: Ati Jehu, ọmọ Nimṣi ni iwọ o fi ororo yàn li ọba lori Israeli: ati Eliṣa, ọmọ Ṣafati, ara Abel-Mehola ni iwọ o fi ororo yan ni woli ni ipò rẹ.
entries.en: And Jehu the son of Nimshi shalt thou anoint to be king over Israel: and Elisha the son of Shaphat of Abel-meholah shalt thou anoint to be prophet in thy room.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, ẹniti o ba sala kuro lọwọ idà Hasaeli ni Jehu yio pa, ati ẹniti o ba sala kuro lọwọ idà Jehu ni Eliṣa yio pa.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass, that him that escapeth the sword of Hazael shall Jehu slay: and him that escapeth from the sword of Jehu shall Elisha slay.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi ti kù ẹ̃dẹgbarin enia silẹ fun ara mi ni Israeli, gbogbo ẽkun ti kò tii kunlẹ fun Baali, ati gbogbo ẹnu ti kò iti fi ẹnu kò o li ẹnu.
entries.en: Yet I have left me seven thousand in Israel, all the knees which have not bowed unto Baal, and every mouth which hath not kissed him.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni o pada kuro nibẹ, o si ri Eliṣa, ọmọ Ṣafati o nfi àjaga malu mejila tulẹ niwaju rẹ̀, ati on na pẹlu ikejila: Elijah si kọja tọ̀ ọ lọ, o si da agbáda rẹ̀ bò o.
entries.en: So he departed thence, and found Elisha the son of Shaphat, who was plowing with twelve yoke of oxen before him, and he with the twelfth: and Elijah passed by him, and cast his mantle upon him.

entries.yo: O si fi awọn malu silẹ o si sare tọ̀ Elijah lẹhin o si wipe, Emi bẹ̀ ọ, jẹ ki emi lọ ifi ẹnu kò baba ati iya mi li ẹnu, nigbana ni emi o tọ̀ ọ lẹhin. O si wi fun u pe, Lọ, pada, nitori kini mo fi ṣe ọ?
entries.en: And he left the oxen, and ran after Elijah, and said, Let me, I pray thee, kiss my father and my mother, and then I will follow thee. And he said unto him, Go back again: for what have I done to thee?

entries.yo: O si pada lẹhin rẹ̀, o si mu àjaga malu kan, o si pa wọn, o si fi ohun-elo awọn malu na bọ̀ ẹran wọn, o si fi fun awọn enia, nwọn si jẹ. On si dide, o si tẹle Elijah lẹhin, o si ṣe iranṣẹ fun u.
entries.en: And he returned back from him, and took a yoke of oxen, and slew them, and boiled their flesh with the instruments of the oxen, and gave unto the people, and they did eat. Then he arose, and went after Elijah, and ministered unto him.

entries.yo: BENHADADI, oba Siria si gbá gbogbo ogun rẹ̀ jọ: ọba mejilelọgbọn si mbẹ pẹlu rẹ̀ ati ẹṣin ati kẹkẹ́: o si gokè lọ, o si dóti Samaria, o ba a jagun.
entries.en: And Ben-hadad the king of Syria gathered all his host together: and there were thirty and two kings with him, and horses, and chariots: and he went up and besieged Samaria, and warred against it.

entries.yo: O si rán awọn onṣẹ sinu ilu, sọdọ Ahabu, ọba Ìsraeli, o si wi fun u pe, Bayi ni Benhadadi wi.
entries.en: And he sent messengers to Ahab king of Israel into the city, and said unto him, Thus saith Ben-hadad,

entries.yo: Fadaka rẹ ati wura rẹ ti emi ni; awọn aya rẹ pẹlu ati awọn ọmọ rẹ, ani awọn ti o dara jùlọ, temi ni nwọn.
entries.en: Thy silver and thy gold is mine; thy wives also and thy children, even the goodliest, are mine.

entries.yo: Ọba Israeli si dahùn o si wipe, oluwa mi, ọba, gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ rẹ tirẹ li emi, ati ohun gbogbo ti mo ni.
entries.en: And the king of Israel answered and said, My lord, O king, according to thy saying, I am thine, and all that I have.

entries.yo: Awọn onṣẹ si tun padà wá, nwọn si wipe, Bayi ni Benhadadi sọ wipe, Mo tilẹ ranṣẹ si ọ wipe, Ki iwọ ki o fi fadaka rẹ ati wura rẹ, ati awọn aya rẹ, ati awọn ọmọ rẹ le mi lọwọ;
entries.en: And the messengers came again, and said, Thus speaketh Ben-hadad, saying, Although I have sent unto thee, saying, Thou shalt deliver me thy silver, and thy gold, and thy wives, and thy children;

entries.yo: Nigbati emi ba rán awọn iranṣẹ mi si ọ ni iwòyi ọla, nigbana ni nwọn o wá ile rẹ wò, ati ile awọn iranṣẹ rẹ; yio si ṣe, ohunkohun ti o ba dara loju rẹ, on ni nwọn o fi si ọwọ́ wọn, nwọn o si mu u lọ.
entries.en: Yet I will send my servants unto thee to morrow about this time, and they shall search thine house, and the houses of thy servants; and it shall be, that whatsoever is pleasant in thine eyes, they shall put it in their hand, and take it away.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ọba Israeli pè gbogbo awọn àgba ilu, o si wipe, Ẹ fiyèsi i, emi bẹ̀ nyin, ki ẹ si wò bi ọkunrin yi ti nfẹ́ ẹ̀fẹ: nitoriti o ranṣẹ si mi fun awọn aya mi, ati fun awọn ọmọ mi, ati fun fadaka mi, ati fun wura mi, emi kò si fi dù u.
entries.en: Then the king of Israel called all the elders of the land, and said, Mark, I pray you, and see how this man seeketh mischief: for he sent unto me for my wives, and for my children, and for my silver, and for my gold; and I denied him not.

entries.yo: Ati gbogbo awọn àgba ati gbogbo awọn enia wi fun u pe, Máṣe fi eti si tirẹ̀, bẹ̃ni ki o máṣe gbà fun u.
entries.en: And all the elders and all the people said unto him, Hearken not unto him, nor consent.

entries.yo: Nitorina li o sọ fun awọn onṣẹ Benhadadi pe, Wi fun oluwa mi ọba pe, ohun gbogbo ti iwọ ranṣẹ fun, sọdọ iranṣẹ rẹ latetekọṣe li emi o ṣe: ṣugbọn nkan yi li emi kò le ṣe. Awọn onṣẹ na pada lọ, nwọn si tun mu èsi fun u wá.
entries.en: Wherefore he said unto the messengers of Ben-hadad, Tell my lord the king, All that thou didst send for to thy servant at the first I will do: but this thing I may not do. And the messengers departed, and brought him word again.

entries.yo: Benhadadi si ranṣẹ si i, o si wipe, Ki awọn oriṣa ki o ṣe bẹ̃ si mi, ati jù bẹ̃ lọ pẹlu bi ẽkuru Samaria yio to fun ikunwọ fun gbogbo enia ti ntẹle mi.
entries.en: And Ben-hadad sent unto him, and said, The gods do so unto me, and more also, if the dust of Samaria shall suffice for handfuls for all the people that follow me.

entries.yo: Ọba Israeli si dahùn, o si wipe, Wi fun u pe, Má jẹ ki ẹniti nhamọra, ki o halẹ bi ẹniti mbọ́ ọ silẹ,
entries.en: And the king of Israel answered and said, Tell him, Let not him that girdeth on his harness boast himself as he that putteth it off.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati Benhadadi gbọ́ ọ̀rọ yi, bi o ti nmuti, on ati awọn ọba ninu agọ, li o sọ fun awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀ pe, Ẹ tẹ́gun si ilu na.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when Ben-hadad heard this message, as he was drinking, he and the kings in the pavilions,that he said unto his servants, Set yourselves in array. And they set themselves in array against the city.

entries.yo: Si kiyesi i, woli kan tọ̀ Ahabu, ọba Israeli wá, wipe, Bayi li Oluwa wi, Iwọ ri gbogbo ọ̀pọlọpọ yi? kiyesi i, emi o fi wọn le ọ lọwọ loni; iwọ o si mọ̀ pe, Emi li Oluwa.
entries.en: And, behold, there came a prophet unto Ahab king of Israel, saying, Thus saith the LORD, Hast thou seen all this great multitude? behold, I will deliver it in to thine hand this day; and thou shalt know that I am the LORD.

entries.yo: Ahabu wipe, Nipa tani? On si wipe, Bayi li Oluwa wi, Nipa awọn ipẹrẹ̀ awọn ijoye igberiko. Nigbana li o wipe, Tani yio wé ogun na? On si dahùn pe: Iwọ.
entries.en: And Ahab said, By whom? And he said, Thus saith the LORD, Even by the young men of the princes of the provinces. Then he said, Who shall order the battle? And he answered, Thou.

entries.yo: Nigbana li o kà awọn ipẹrẹ̀ awọn ijoye igberiko, nwọn si jẹ igba o le mejilelọgbọn: lẹhin wọn li o si kà gbogbo awọn enia, ani gbogbo awọn ọmọ Israeli jẹ ẹdẹgbarin.
entries.en: Then he numbered the young men of the princes of the provinces, and they were two hundred and thirty two: and after them he numbered all the people, even all the children of Israel, being seven thousand.

entries.yo: Nwọn si jade lọ li ọjọ-kanri. Ṣugbọn Benhadadi mu amupara ninu agọ, on, ati awọn ọba, awọn ọba mejilelọgbọn ti nràn a lọwọ.
entries.en: And they went out at noon. But Ben-hadad was drinking himself drunk in the pavilions, he and the kings, the thirty and two kings that helped him.

entries.yo: Awọn ipẹrẹ̀ awọn ijoye igberiko tètekọ jade lọ: Benhadadi si ranṣẹ jade, nwọn si sọ fun u wipe, awọn ọkunrin nti Samaria jade wá.
entries.en: And the young men of the princes of the provinces went out first; and Ben-hadad sent out, and they told him, saying, There are men come out of Samaria.

entries.yo: On si wipe, Bi nwọn ba bá ti alafia jade, ẹ mu wọn lãye; tabi bi ti ogun ni nwọn ba bá jade, ẹ mu wọn lãye.
entries.en: And he said, Whether they be come out for peace, take them alive; or whether they be come out for war, take them alive.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni awọn ipẹrẹ̀ wọnyi ti awọn ijoye igberiko jade ti ilu wá, ati ogun ti o tẹle wọn.
entries.en: So these young men of the princes of the provinces came out of the city, and the army which followed them.

entries.yo: Nwọn si pa, olukuluku ọkunrin kọkan; awọn ara Siria sa; Israeli si lepa wọn: Benhadadi, ọba Siria si sala lori ẹṣin pẹlu awọn ẹlẹṣin.
entries.en: And they slew every one his man: and the Syrians fled; and Israel pursued them: and Ben-hadad the king of Syria escaped on an horse with the horsemen.

entries.yo: Ọba Israeli si jade lọ, o si kọlu awọn ẹṣin ati kẹkẹ́, o pa awọn ara Siria li ọ̀pọlọpọ.
entries.en: And the king of Israel went out, and smote the horses and chariots, and slew the Syrians with a great slaughter.

entries.yo: Woli na si wá sọdọ ọba Israeli, o si wi fun u pe, Lọ, mu ara rẹ giri, ki o si mọ̀, ki o si wò ohun ti iwọ nṣe: nitori li amọdun, ọba Siria yio goke tọ̀ ọ wá.
entries.en: And the prophet came to the king of Israel, and said unto him, Go, strengthen thy self, and mark, and see what thou doest: for at the return of the year the king of Syria will come up against thee.

entries.yo: Awọn iranṣẹ ọba Siria si wi fun u pe, ọlọrun wọn, ọlọrun oke ni; nitorina ni nwọn ṣe li agbara jù wa lọ; ṣugbọn jẹ ki a ba wọn jà ni pẹtẹlẹ, awa o si li agbara jù wọn lọ nitõtọ.
entries.en: And the servants of the king of Syria said unto him, Their gods are gods of the hills; therefore they were stronger than we; but let us fight against them in the plain, and surely we shall be stronger than they.

entries.yo: Nkan yi ni ki o si ṣe, mu awọn ọba kuro, olukuluku kuro ni ipò rẹ̀, ki o si fi olori-ogun si ipò wọn.
entries.en: And do this thing, Take the kings away, every man out of his place, and put captains in their rooms:

entries.yo: Ki o si kà iye ogun fun ara rẹ gẹgẹ bi ogun ti o ti fọ́, ẹṣin fun ẹṣin, ati kẹkẹ́ fun kẹkẹ́: awa o si ba wọn jà ni pẹ̀tẹlẹ, nitõtọ awa o li agbara jù wọn lọ. O si fi eti si ohùn wọn, o si ṣe bẹ̃.
entries.en: And number thee an army, like the army that thou hast lost, horse for horse, and chariot for chariot: and we will fight against them in the plain, and surely we shall be stronger than they. And he hearkened unto their voice, and did so.

entries.yo: O si ṣe li amọdun, ni Benhadadi kà iye awọn ara Siria, nwọn si goke lọ si Afeki, lati bá Israeli jagun.
entries.en: And it came to pass at the return of the year, that Ben-hadad numbered the Syrians, and went up to Aphek, to fight against Israel.

entries.yo: A si ka iye awọn ọmọ Israeli, nwọn si pese onjẹ, nwọn si lọ ipade wọn: awọn ọmọ Israeli si dó niwaju wọn gẹgẹ bi agbo ọmọ ewurẹ kekere meji: ṣugbọn awọn ara Siria kún ilẹ na.
entries.en: And the children of Israel were numbered, and were all present, and went against them: and the children of Israel pitched before them like two little flocks of kids; but the Syrians filled the country.

entries.yo: Enia Ọlọrun kan si wá, o si sọ fun ọba Israeli, o si wipe, Bayi li Oluwa wi, Nitoriti awọn ara Siria wipe, Oluwa, Ọlọrun oke ni, ṣugbọn on kì iṣe Ọlọrun afonifoji, nitorina emi o fi gbogbo ọ̀pọlọpọ enia yi le ọ lọwọ́, ẹnyin o si mọ̀ pe, Emi li Oluwa.
entries.en: And there came a man of God, and spake unto the king of Israel, and said, Thus saith the LORD, Because the Syrians have said, The LORD is God of the hills, but he is not God of the valleys, therefore will I deliver all this great multitude into thine hand, and ye shall know that I am the LORD.

entries.yo: Nwọn si dó, ekini tì ekeji ni ijọ meje. O si ṣe, li ọjọ keje, nwọn padegun, awọn ọmọ Israeli si pa ọkẹ marun ẹlẹsẹ̀ ninu awọn ara Siria li ọjọ kan.
entries.en: And they pitched one over against the other seven days. And so it was, that in the seventh day the battle was joined: and the children of Israel slew of the Syrians an hundred thousand footmen in one day.

entries.yo: Sugbọn awọn iyokù salọ si Afeki, sinu ilu; odi si wolu ẹgbamẹtala-le-ẹgbẹrun ninu awọn enia ti o kù. Benhadadi si sa lọ, o si wá sinu ilu lati iyẹwu de iyẹwu.
entries.en: But the rest fled to Aphek, into the city; and there a wall fell upon twenty and seven thousand of the men that were left. And Ben-hadad fled, and came into the city, into an inner chamber.

entries.yo: Awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀ si wi fun u pe, Kiyesi i, nisisiyi, awa ti gbọ́ pe, awọn ọba ile Israeli, alãnu ọba ni nwọn: mo bẹ ọ, jẹ ki awa ki o fi aṣọ-ọ̀fọ si ẹgbẹ wa, ati ijará yi ori wa ka, ki a si jade tọ̀ ọba Israeli lọ: bọya on o gba ẹmi rẹ là.
entries.en: And his servants said unto him, Behold now, we have heard that the kings of the house of Israel are merciful kings: let us, I pray thee, put sackcloth on our loins, and ropes upon our heads, and go out to the king of Israel: peradventure he will save thy life.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni nwọn di aṣọ ọ̀fọ mọ ẹgbẹ wọn, nwọn si fi ijara yi ori wọn ka, nwọn si tọ̀ ọba Israeli wá, nwọn si wipe, Benhadadi, iranṣẹ rẹ, wipe, Emi bẹ ọ, jẹ ki ẹmi mi ki o yè. On si wipe, O mbẹ lãye sibẹ? arakunrin mi li on iṣe.
entries.en: So they girded sackcloth on their loins, and put ropes on their heads, and came to the king of Israel, and said, Thy servant Ben-hadad saith, I pray thee, let me live. And he said, Is he yet alive? he is my brother.

entries.yo: Awọn ọkunrin na si ṣe akiyesi gidigidi, nwọn si yara gbá ohun ti o ti ọdọ rẹ̀ wá mu: nwọn si wipe, Benhadadi arakunrin rẹ! Nigbana li o wipe, Ẹ lọ mu u wá. Nigbana ni Benhadadi jade tọ̀ ọ wá; o si mu u goke wá sinu kẹkẹ́.
entries.en: Now the men did diligently observe whether any thing would come from him, and did hastily catch it: and they said, Thy brother Ben-hadad. Then he said, Go ye, bring him. Then Ben-hadad came forth to him; and he caused him to come up into the chariot.

entries.yo: On si wi fun u pe, Awọn ilu ti baba mi gbà lọwọ baba rẹ, emi o mu wọn pada: iwọ o si là ọ̀na fun ara rẹ ni Damasku, bi baba mi ti ṣe ni Samaria. Nigbana ni Ahabu wipe, Emi o rán ọ lọ pẹlu majẹmu yi. Bẹ̃ li o ba a dá majẹmu, o si rán a lọ.
entries.en: And Ben-hadad said unto him, The cities, which my father took from thy father, I will restore; and thou shalt make streets for thee in Damascus, as my father made in Samaria. Then said Ahab, I will send thee away with this covenant. So he made a covenant with him, and sent him away.

entries.yo: Ọkunrin kan ninu awọn ọmọ awọn woli si wi fun ẹnikeji rẹ̀ nipa ọ̀rọ Oluwa pe, Jọ̃, lù mi. Ọkunrin na si kọ̀ lati lù u.
entries.en: And a certain man of the sons of the prophets said unto his neighbour in the word of the LORD, Smite me, I pray thee. And the man refused to smite him.

entries.yo: Nigbana li o wi pe, Nitoriti iwọ kò gbà ohùn Oluwa gbọ́, kiyesi i, bi iwọ ba ti ọdọ mi kuro, kiniun yio pa ọ. Bi o si ti jade lọ lọdọ rẹ̀, kiniun kan ri i o si pa a.
entries.en: Then said he unto him, Because thou hast not obeyed the voice of the LORD, behold, as soon as thou art departed from me, a lion shall slay thee. And as soon as he was departed from him, a lion found him, and slew him.

entries.yo: Nigbana li o si ri ọkunrin miran, o si wipe, Jọ̃, lù mi. Ọkunrin na si lù u, ni lilu ti o lù u, o pa a lara.
entries.en: Then he found another man, and said, Smite me, I pray thee. And the man smote him, so that in smiting he wounded him.

entries.yo: Woli na si lọ, o si duro de ọba loju ọ̀na, o pa ara rẹ̀ da, ni fifi ẽru ba oju.
entries.en: So the prophet departed, and waited for the king by the way, and disguised himself with ashes upon his face.

entries.yo: Bi ọba si ti nkọja lọ, o ke si ọba o si wipe, iranṣẹ rẹ jade wọ arin ogun lọ; si kiyesi i, ọkunrin kan yà sapakan, o si mu ọkunrin kan fun mi wá o si wipe: Pa ọkunrin yi mọ; bi a ba fẹ ẹ kù, nigbana ni ẹmi rẹ yio lọ fun ẹmi rẹ̀, bi bẹ̃ kọ, iwọ o san talenti fadaka kan.
entries.en: And as the king passed by, he cried unto the king: and he said, Thy servant went out into the midst of the battle; and, behold, a man turned aside, and brought a man unto me, and said, Keep this man: if by any means he be missing, then shall thy life be for his life, or else thou shalt pay a talent of silver.

entries.yo: Bi iranṣẹ rẹ si ti ni iṣe nihin ati lọhun, a fẹ ẹ kù. Ọba Israeli si wi fun u pe, Bẹ̃ni idajọ rẹ yio ri: iwọ tikararẹ ti dá a.
entries.en: And as thy servant was busy here and there, he was gone. And the king of Israel said unto him, So shall thy judgment be; thyself hast decided it.

entries.yo: O si yara, o si mu ẹ̃ru kuro li oju rẹ̀; ọba Israeli si ri i daju pe, ọkan ninu awọn woli ni on iṣe.
entries.en: And he hasted, and took the ashes away from his face; and the king of Israel discerned him that he was of the prophets.

entries.yo: O si wi fun u pe, Bayi li Oluwa wi, nitoriti iwọ jọwọ rẹ̀ lọwọ lọ, ọkunrin ti emi ti yàn si iparun patapata, ẹmi rẹ yio lọ fun ẹmi rẹ̀, ati enia rẹ fun enia rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he said unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Because thou hast let go out of thy hand a man whom I appointed to utter destruction, therefore thy life shall go for his life, and thy people for his people.

entries.yo: Ọba Israeli si lọ si ile rẹ̀, o wugbọ, inu rẹ̀ si bajẹ o si wá si Samaria.
entries.en: And the king of Israel went to his house heavy and displeased, and came to Samaria.

entries.yo: O si ṣe lẹhin nkan wọnyi, Naboti, ara Jesreeli, ni ọgba-ajara ti o wà ni Jesreeli, ti o sunmọ ãfin Ahabu, ọba Samaria girigiri.
entries.en: And it came to pass after these things, that Naboth the Jezreelite had a vineyard, which was in Jezreel, hard by the palace of Ahab king of Samaria.

entries.yo: Ahabu si ba Naboti sọ wipe, Fun mi ni ọgba-ajara rẹ, ki emi ki o fi ṣe ọgba-ewebẹ̀, nitori ti o sunmọ ile mi: emi o si fun ọ li ọgba-ajara ti o san jù u lọ dipò rẹ̀; bi o ba si dara li oju rẹ, emi o fi iye-owo rẹ̀ fun ọ.
entries.en: And Ahab spake unto Naboth, saying, Give me thy vineyard, that I may have it for a garden of herbs, because it is near unto my house: and I will give thee for it a better vineyard than it; or, if it seem good to thee, I will give thee the worth of it in money.

entries.yo: Naboti si wi fun Ahabu pe, Oluwa má jẹ ki emi fi ogún awọn baba mi fun ọ.
entries.en: And Naboth said to Ahab, The LORD forbid it me, that I should give the inheritance of my fathers unto thee.

entries.yo: Ahabu si wá si ile rẹ̀, o wugbọ, inu rẹ̀ si bajẹ nitori ọ̀rọ ti Naboti, ara Jesreeli, sọ fun u: nitoriti on ti wipe, emi kì o fun ọ ni ogún awọn baba mi. On si dubulẹ lori akete rẹ̀, o si yi oju rẹ̀ padà, kò si fẹ ijẹun.
entries.en: And Ahab came into his house heavy and displeased because of the word which Naboth the Jezreelite had spoken to him: for he had said, I will not give thee the inheritance of my fathers. And he laid him down upon his bed, and turned away his face, and would eat no bread.

entries.yo: Jesebeli, aya rẹ̀ si tọ̀ ọ wá o si wi fun u pe, Ẽṣe ti inu rẹ fi bajẹ́ ti iwọ kò fi jẹun?
entries.en: But Jezebel his wife came to him, and said unto him, Why is thy spirit so sad, that thou eatest no bread?

entries.yo: O si wi fun u pe, Nitoriti mo ba Naboti, ara Jesreeli sọ, mo si wi fun u pe, Fun mi ni ọgba-àjara rẹ fun owo; tabi bi o ba wù ọ, emi o fun ọ ni ọgba-àjara miran ni ipò rẹ̀: o si dahùn wipe, Emi kì o fun ọ ni ọgba-àjara mi.
entries.en: And he said unto her, Because I spake unto Naboth the Jezreelite, and said unto him, Give me thy vineyard for money; or else, if it please thee, I will give thee another vineyard for it: and he answered, I will not give thee my vineyard.

entries.yo: Jesebeli, aya rẹ̀ si wi fun u pe, iwọ kò ha jọba lori Israeli nisisiyi? Dide, jẹun, ki o si jẹ ki inu rẹ ki o dùn! emi o fun ọ ni ọgba-àjara Nãboti ara Jesreeli.
entries.en: And Jezebel his wife said unto him, Dost thou now govern the kingdom of Israel? arise, and eat bread, and let thine heart be merry: I will give thee the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni o kọwe li orukọ Ahabu, o si fi èdidi rẹ̀ di i, o si fi iwe na ṣọwọ sọdọ awọn àgbagba ati awọn ọlọla ti mbẹ ni ilu rẹ̀, ti o si mba Naboti gbe.
entries.en: So she wrote letters in Ahab's name, and sealed them with his seal, and sent the letters unto the elders and to the nobles that were in his city, dwelling with Naboth.

entries.yo: O si kọ sinu iwe na pe, Ẹ kede àwẹ, ki ẹ si fi Naboti si ipò ọla lãrin awọn enia.
entries.en: And she wrote in the letters, saying, Proclaim a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people:

entries.yo: Ki ẹ fi enia meji, ẹni buburu, siwaju rẹ̀ lati jẹri pa a, wipe, Iwọ bu Ọlọrun ati ọba. Ẹ mu u jade, ki ẹ si sọ ọ li okuta ki o le kú.
entries.en: And set two men, sons of Belial, before him, to bear witness against him, saying, Thou didst blaspheme God and the king. And then carry him out, and stone him, that he may die.

entries.yo: Awọn ọkunrin ilu rẹ̀, ati awọn àgbagba, ati awọn ọlọla ti nwọn iṣe ara-ilu rẹ̀, ṣe bi Jesebeli ti ranṣẹ si wọn, gẹgẹ bi a ti kọ ọ sinu iwe ti o ti fi ranṣẹ si wọn.
entries.en: And the men of his city, even the elders and the nobles who were the inhabitants in his city, did as Jezebel had sent unto them, and as it was written in the letters which she had sent unto them.

entries.yo: Nwọn si kede àwẹ, nwọn si fi Naboti si ipò ọla lãrin awọn enia.
entries.en: They proclaimed a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people.

entries.yo: Ọkunrin meji si de, awọn ẹni buburu, nwọn si joko niwaju rẹ̀: awọn ọkunrin buburu si jẹri pa a, ani si Naboti, niwaju awọn enia wipe: Naboti bu Ọlọrun ati ọba. Nigbana ni nwọn mu u jade kuro ni ilu, nwọn si sọ ọ li okuta, o si kú.
entries.en: And there came in two men, children of Belial, and sat before him: and the men of Belial witnessed against him, even against Naboth, in the presence of the people, saying, Naboth did blaspheme God and the king. Then they carried him forth out of the city, and stoned him with stones, that he died.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni nwọn ranṣẹ si Jesebeli wipe, A sọ Naboti li okuta, o si kú.
entries.en: Then they sent to Jezebel, saying, Naboth is stoned, and is dead.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati Jesebeli gbọ́ pe, a sọ Naboti li okuta, o si kú, Jesebeli sọ fun Ahabu pe, Dide! ki o si jogun ọgba-ajara Naboti, ara Jesreeli, ti o kọ̀ lati fi fun ọ fun owo; nitori Naboti kò si lãye ṣugbọn o kú.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when Jezebel heard that Naboth was stoned, and was dead, that Jezebel said to Ahab, Arise, take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, which he refused to give thee for money: for Naboth is not alive, but dead.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati Ahabu gbọ́ pe, Naboti kú, ni Ahabu dide lati sọkalẹ lọ si ọgba-ajara Naboti, ara Jesreeli lati jogun rẹ̀.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when Ahab heard that Naboth was dead, that Ahab rose up to go down to the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, to take possession of it.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ Oluwa si tọ̀ Elijah, ara Tiṣbi wá wipe,
entries.en: And the word of the LORD came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,

entries.yo: Dide, sọkalẹ, lọ ipade Ahabu, ọba Israeli, ti o wà ni Samaria: wò o, o wà ni ọgba-ajara Naboti, nibiti o sọkalẹ lọ lati jogun rẹ̀.
entries.en: Arise, go down to meet Ahab king of Israel, which is in Samaria: behold, he is in the vineyard of Naboth, whither he is gone down to possess it.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si wi fun u pe, Bayi li Oluwa wi: Iwọ ti pa, iwọ si ti jogun pẹlu? Iwọ o si wi fun u pe, Bayi li Oluwa wi pe, Ni ibi ti ajá gbe lá ẹ̀jẹ Naboti, ni awọn ajá yio lá ẹ̀jẹ rẹ, ani tirẹ.
entries.en: And thou shalt speak unto him, saying, Thus saith the LORD, Hast thou killed, and also taken possession? And thou shalt speak unto him, saying, Thus saith the LORD, In the place where dogs licked the blood of Naboth shall dogs lick thy blood, even thine.

entries.yo: Ahabu si wi fun Elijah pe, Iwọ ri mi, Iwọ ọta mi? O si dahùn wipe, Emi ri ọ; nitoriti iwọ ti tà ara rẹ lati ṣiṣẹ buburu niwaju Oluwa.
entries.en: And Ahab said to Elijah, Hast thou found me, O mine enemy? And he answered, I have found thee: because thou hast sold thyself to work evil in the sight of the LORD.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, Emi o mu ibi wá si ori rẹ, emi o si mu iran rẹ kuro, emi o si ke kuro lọdọ Ahabu, gbogbo ọmọde ọkunrin, ati ọmọ-ọdọ, ati omnira ni Israeli.
entries.en: Behold, I will bring evil upon thee, and will take away thy posterity, and will cut off from Ahab him that pisseth against the wall, and him that is shut up and left in Israel,

entries.yo: Emi o si ṣe ile rẹ bi ile Jeroboamu, ọmọ Nebati, ati bi ile Baaṣa, ọmọ Ahijah, nitori imunibinu ti iwọ ti mu mi binu, ti iwọ si mu ki Israeli ki o dẹ̀ṣẹ.
entries.en: And will make thine house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah, for the provocation wherewith thou hast provoked me to anger, and made Israel to sin.

entries.yo: Ati niti Jesebeli pẹlu Oluwa sọ wipe, Awọn ajá yio jẹ Jesebeli ninu yàra Jesreeli.
entries.en: And of Jezebel also spake the LORD, saying, The dogs shall eat Jezebel by the wall of Jezreel.

entries.yo: Ẹni Ahabu ti o kú ni ilu, ni awọn ajá o jẹ; ati ẹniti o kú ni igbẹ ni awọn ẹiyẹ oju-ọrun o jẹ.
entries.en: Him that dieth of Ahab in the city the dogs shall eat; and him that dieth in the field shall the fowls of the air eat.
