entries.yo: Ṣugbọn kò si ẹnikan bi Ahabu ti o tà ara rẹ̀ lati ṣiṣẹ buburu niwaju Oluwa, ẹniti Jesebeli aya rẹ̀ ntì.
entries.en: But there was none like unto Ahab, which did sell himself to work wickedness in the sight of the LORD, whom Jezebel his wife stirred up.

entries.yo: O si ṣe ohun irira gidigidi ni titọ̀ oriṣa lẹhin, gẹgẹ bi gbogbo ohun ti awọn ara Amori ti ṣe, ti Oluwa ti le jade niwaju awọn ọmọ Israeli.
entries.en: And he did very abominably in following idols, according to all things as did the Amorites, whom the LORD cast out before the children of Israel.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati Ahabu gbọ́ ọ̀rọ wọnyi, o si fa aṣọ rẹ̀ ya, o si fi aṣọ ọ̀fọ si ara rẹ̀, o si gbàwẹ, o si dubulẹ ninu aṣọ ọ̀fọ, o si nlọ jẹ́.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when Ahab heard those words, that he rent his clothes, and put sackcloth upon his flesh, and fasted, and lay in sackcloth, and went softly.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ Oluwa si tọ̀ Elijah, ara Tiṣbi wá wipe,
entries.en: And the word of the LORD came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,

entries.yo: Iwọ ri bi Ahabu ti rẹ̀ ara rẹ̀ silẹ niwaju mi? Nitori ti o rẹ̀ ara rẹ̀ silẹ niwaju mi, emi kì yio mu ibi na wá li ọjọ rẹ̀: li ọjọ ọmọ rẹ̀ li emi o mu ibi na wá sori ile rẹ̀.
entries.en: Seest thou how Ahab humbleth himself before me? because he humbleth himself before me, I will not bring the evil in his days: but in his son's days will I bring the evil upon his house.

entries.yo: ỌDUN mẹta si rekọja laisi ogun lãrin Siria ati lãrin Israeli.
entries.en: And they continued three years without war between Syria and Israel.

entries.yo: O si ṣe li ọdun kẹta, Jehoṣafati, ọba Juda sọkalẹ tọ ọba Israeli wá.
entries.en: And it came to pass in the third year, that Jehoshaphat the king of Judah came down to the king of Israel.

entries.yo: Ọba Israeli si wi fun awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀ pe, Ẹnyin ha mọ̀ pe, tiwa ni Ramoti-Gileadi, awa si dakẹ, a kò si gbà a kuro lọwọ ọba Siria?
entries.en: And the king of Israel said unto his servants, Know ye that Ramoth in Gilead is ours, and we be still, and take it not out of the hand of the king of Syria?

entries.yo: O si wi fun Jehoṣafati pe, Iwọ o ha bá mi lọ si ogun Ramoti-Gileadi bi? Jehoṣafati si wi fun ọba Israeli pe, Emi bi iwọ, enia mi bi enia rẹ, ẹṣin mi bi ẹṣin rẹ.
entries.en: And he said unto Jehoshaphat, Wilt thou go with me to battle to Ramoth-gilead? And Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, I am as thou art, my people as thy people, my horses as thy horses.

entries.yo: Jehoṣafati si wi fun ọba Israeli pe, Mo bẹ̀ ọ, bère ọ̀rọ Oluwa li oni yi.
entries.en: And Jehoshaphat said unto the king of Israel, Inquire, I pray thee, at the word of the LORD to day.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ọba Israeli kó awọn woli jọ, bi irinwo ọkunrin, o si wi fun wọn pe, Ki emi ki o ha lọ si Ramoti-Gileadi lọ ijagun, tabi ki emi ki o jọwọ rẹ̀? Nwọn si wipe, Goke lọ: nitoriti Oluwa yio fi i le ọba lọwọ.
entries.en: Then the king of Israel gathered the prophets together, about four hundred men, and said unto them, Shall I go against Ramoth-gilead to battle, or shall I forbear? And they said, Go up; for the Lord shall deliver it into the hand of the king.

entries.yo: Jehoṣafati si wipe, Kò si woli Oluwa kan nihin pẹlu, ti awa iba bère lọwọ rẹ̀?
entries.en: And Jehoshaphat said, Is there not here a prophet of the LORD besides, that we might inquire of him?

entries.yo: Ọba Israeli si wi fun Jehoṣafati pe, ọkunrin kan Mikaiah, ọmọ Imla, mbẹ sibẹ, lọdọ ẹniti awa iba bère lọwọ Oluwa: ṣugbọn emi korira rẹ̀, nitori kì isọ asọtẹlẹ ire si mi, bikoṣe ibi. Jehoṣafati si wipe, Ki ọba má sọ bẹ̃.
entries.en: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, There is yet one man, Micaiah the son of Imlah, by whom we may inquire of the LORD: but I hate him; for he doth not prophesy good concerning me, but evil. And Jehoshaphat said, Let not the king say so.

entries.yo: Ọba Israeli si pè iwẹfa kan, o si wipe, Mu ki Mikaiah, ọmọ Imla, ki o yara wá.
entries.en: Then the king of Israel called an officer, and said, Hasten hither Micaiah the son of Imlah.

entries.yo: Ọba Israeli ati Jehoṣafati, ọba Juda joko olukulùku lori itẹ́ rẹ̀, nwọn wọ̀ aṣọ igunwa wọn ni ita ẹnu-bode Samaria, gbogbo awọn woli na si nsọtẹlẹ niwaju wọn.
entries.en: And the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah sat each on his throne, having put on their robes, in a void place in the entrance of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets prophesied before them.

entries.yo: Sedekiah, ọmọ Kenaana si ṣe iwo irin fun ara rẹ̀, o si wipe: Bayi li Oluwa wi, Wọnyi ni iwọ o fi kàn ara Siria titi iwọ o fi run wọn.
entries.en: And Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made him horns of iron: and he said, Thus saith the LORD, With these shalt thou push the Syrians, until thou have consumed them.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn woli si nsọtẹlẹ bẹ̃ wipe: Goke lọ si Ramoti-Gileadi, ki o si ṣe rere: nitoriti Oluwa yio fi i le ọba lọwọ.
entries.en: And all the prophets prophesied so, saying, Go up to Ramoth-gilead, and prosper: for the LORD shall deliver it into the king's hand.

entries.yo: Onṣẹ ti o lọ ipè Mikaiah wi fun u pe, Kiyesi i nisisiyi, ẹnu kanna ni ọ̀rọ awọn woli fi jẹ rere fun ọba: emi bẹ̀ ọ, jẹ ki ọ̀rọ rẹ ki o dabi ọ̀rọ ọkan ninu wọn, ki o si sọ rere.
entries.en: And the messenger that was gone to call Micaiah spake unto him, saying, Behold now, the words of the prophets declare good unto the king with one mouth: let thy word, I pray thee, be like the word of one of them, and speak that which is good.

entries.yo: Mikaiah si wipe, Bi Oluwa ti wà, ohun ti Oluwa ba sọ fun mi li emi o sọ.
entries.en: And Micaiah said, As the LORD liveth, what the LORD saith unto me, that will I speak.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni o de ọdọ ọba. Ọba si wi fun u pe, Mikaiah, ki awa o ha lọ si Ramoti-Gileadi lọ ijagun, tabi ki a jọwọ rẹ̀? O si da a lohùn pe, Lọ, ki o si ṣe rere: nitori Oluwa yio fi i le ọba lọwọ.
entries.en: So he came to the king. And the king said unto him, Micaiah, shall we go against Ramoth-gilead to battle, or shall we forbear? And he answered him, Go, and prosper: for the LORD shall deliver it into the hand of the king.

entries.yo: Ọba si wi fun u pe, Igba melo li emi o fi ọ bu pe, ki iwọ ki o máṣe sọ ohun kan fun mi bikoṣe otitọ li orukọ Oluwa?
entries.en: And the king said unto him, How many times shall I adjure thee that thou tell me nothing but that which is true in the name of the LORD?

entries.yo: On si wipe, Mo ri gbogbo Israeli tukakiri lori awọn oke bi agutan ti kò ni oluṣọ: Oluwa si wipe, Awọn wọnyi kò ni oluwa, jẹ ki nwọn ki o pada olukuluku si ile rẹ̀ li alafia.
entries.en: And he said, I saw all Israel scattered upon the hills, as sheep that have not a shepherd: and the LORD said, These have no master: let them return every man to his house in peace.

entries.yo: Ọba Israeli si wi fun Jehoṣafati pe, Emi kò sọ fun ọ, pe on kì o fọ̀ ire si mi, bikoṣe ibi?
entries.en: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, Did I not tell thee that he would prophesy no good concerning me, but evil?

entries.yo: On si wipe, Nitorina, iwọ gbọ́ ọ̀rọ Oluwa: Mo ri Oluwa joko lori itẹ́ rẹ̀, ati gbogbo ogun-ọrun duro li apa ọtun ati li apa òsi rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he said, Hear thou therefore the word of the LORD: I saw the LORD sitting on his throne, and all the host of heaven standing by him on his right hand and on his left.

entries.yo: Oluwa si wipe, Tani yio tàn Ahabu, ki o le goke lọ, ki o si le ṣubu ni Ramoti-Gileadi? Ẹnikan si wi bayi, ẹlomiran si sọ miran.
entries.en: And the LORD said, Who shall persuade Ahab, that he may go up and fall at Ramoth-gilead? And one said on this manner, and another said on that manner.

entries.yo: Ẹmi kan si jade wá, o si duro niwaju Oluwa, o si wipe, Emi o tàn a.
entries.en: And there came forth a spirit, and stood before the LORD, and said, I will persuade him.

entries.yo: Oluwa si wi fun u pe, Bawo? O si wipe, Emi o jade lọ, emi o si di ẹmi-eke li ẹnu gbogbo awọn woli rẹ̀. On si wipe, Iwọ o tàn a, iwọ o si bori pẹlu: jade lọ, ki o si ṣe bẹ̃.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto him, Wherewith? And he said, I will go forth, and I will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets. And he said, Thou shalt persuade him, and prevail also: go forth, and do so.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, kiyesi i, Oluwa ti fi ẹmi-eke si ẹnu gbogbo awọn woli rẹ wọnyi, Oluwa si ti sọ ibi si ọ.
entries.en: Now therefore, behold, the LORD hath put a lying spirit in the mouth of all these thy prophets, and the LORD hath spoken evil concerning thee.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Sedekiah, ọmọ Kenaana sunmọ ọ, o si lu Mikaiah li ẹ̀rẹkẹ, o si wipe, Ọ̀na wo li ẹmi Oluwa gbà lọ kuro lọdọ mi lati ba ọ sọ̀rọ?
entries.en: But Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah went near, and smote Micaiah on the cheek, and said, Which way went the Spirit of the LORD from me to speak unto thee?

entries.yo: Mikaiah si wipe, Kiyesi i, iwọ o ri i li ọjọ na, nigbati iwọ o lọ lati inu iyẹwu de iyẹwu lati fi ara rẹ pamọ.
entries.en: And Micaiah said, Behold, thou shalt see in that day, when thou shalt go into an inner chamber to hide thyself.

entries.yo: Ọba Israeli si wipe, Mu Mikaiah, ki ẹ si mu u pada sọdọ Amoni, olori ilu, ati sọdọ Joaṣi, ọmọ ọba:
entries.en: And the king of Israel said, Take Micaiah, and carry him back unto Amon the governor of the city, and to Joash the king's son;

entries.yo: Ki ẹ si wipe, Bayi li ọba wi: Ẹ fi eleyi sinu tubu, ki ẹ si fi onjẹ ipọnju ati omi ipọnju bọ́ ọ, titi emi o fi pada bọ̀ li alafia.
entries.en: And say, Thus saith the king, Put this fellow in the prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction, until I come in peace.

entries.yo: Mikaiah si wipe, Ni pipada bi iwọ ba pada bọ̀ li alafia, njẹ Oluwa kò ti ipa mi sọ̀rọ. O si wipe, Ẹ gbọ́, ẹnyin enia gbogbo!
entries.en: And Micaiah said, If thou return at all in peace, the LORD hath not spoken by me. And he said, Hearken, O people, every one of you.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni ọba Israeli ati Jehoṣafati, ọba Juda, goke lọ si Ramoti-Gileadi.
entries.en: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramoth-gilead.

entries.yo: Ọba Israeli si wi fun Jehoṣafati pe, Emi o pa aṣọ dà, emi o si lọ si oju ija; ṣugbọn iwọ gbé aṣọ igunwà rẹ wọ̀. Ọba Israeli si pa aṣọ dà, o si lọ si oju ijà.
entries.en: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, I will disguise myself, and enter into the battle; but put thou on thy robes. And the king of Israel disguised himself, and went into the battle.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ọba Siria paṣẹ fun awọn olori-kẹkẹ́ rẹ̀, mejilelọgbọn, ti o ni aṣẹ lori kẹkẹ́ rẹ̀ wipe, Máṣe ba ẹni-kekere tabi ẹni-nla jà, bikoṣe ọba Israeli nikan.
entries.en: But the king of Syria commanded his thirty and two captains that had rule over his chariots, saying, Fight neither with small nor great, save only with the king of Israel.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, bi awọn olori-kẹkẹ́ ti ri Jehoṣafati, nwọn si wipe, ọba Israeli li eyi. Nwọn si yà sapakan lati ba a jà: Jehoṣafati si kigbe.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, that they said, Surely it is the king of Israel. And they turned aside to fight against him: and Jehoshaphat cried out.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati awọn olori kẹkẹ́ woye pe, kì iṣe ọba Israeli li eyi, nwọn si pada kuro lẹhin rẹ̀.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots perceived that it was not the king of Israel, that they turned back from pursuing him.

entries.yo: Ọkunrin kan si fà ọrun rẹ̀ laipete, o si ta ọba Israeli lãrin ipade ẹwu-irin; nitorina li o ṣe wi fun olutọju-kẹkẹ́ rẹ̀ pe, Yi ọwọ́ rẹ dà, ki o si mu mi jade kuro ninu ogun; nitoriti emi gbọgbẹ.
entries.en: And a certain man drew a bow at a venture, and smote the king of Israel between the joints of the harness: wherefore he said unto the driver of his chariot, Turn thine hand, and carry me out of the host; for I am wounded.

entries.yo: Ogun na si le li ọjọ na: a si dá ọba duro ninu kẹkẹ́ kọju si awọn ara Siria, o si kú li aṣalẹ, ẹ̀jẹ si ṣàn jade lati inu ọgbẹ na si ãrin kẹkẹ́ na.
entries.en: And the battle increased that day: and the king was stayed up in his chariot against the Syrians, and died at even: and the blood ran out of the wound into the midst of the chariot.

entries.yo: A si kede la ibudo já li akokò iwọ̀ õrun wipe, Olukuluku si ilu rẹ̀, ati olukuluku si ilẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And there went a proclamation throughout the host about the going down of the sun, saying, Every man to his city, and every man to his own country.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni ọba kú, a si gbe e wá si Samaria; nwọn si sin ọba ni Samaria.
entries.en: So the king died, and was brought to Samaria; and they buried the king in Samaria.

entries.yo: Ẹnikan si wẹ kẹkẹ́ na ni adagun Samaria, awọn ajá si la ẹ̀jẹ rẹ̀; awọn àgbere si wẹ ara wọn ninu rẹ̀ gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ Oluwa ti o sọ,
entries.en: And one washed the chariot in the pool of Samaria; and the dogs licked up his blood; and they washed his armour; according unto the word of the LORD which he spake.

entries.yo: Ati iyokù iṣe Ahabu, ati gbogbo eyi ti o ṣe, ati ile ehin-erin ti o kọ́, ati gbogbo ilu ti o tẹ̀do, a kò ha kọ wọn sinu iwe ọ̀rọ ọjọ awọn ọba Israeli?
entries.en: Now the rest of the acts of Ahab, and all that he did, and the ivory house which he made, and all the cities that he built, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

entries.yo: Ahabu si sùn pẹlu awọn baba rẹ̀; Ahasiah, ọmọ rẹ̀ si jọba ni ipò rẹ̀.
entries.en: So Ahab slept with his fathers; and Ahaziah his son reigned in his stead.

entries.yo: Jehoṣafati, ọmọ Asa, si bẹ̀rẹ si ijọba lori Juda li ọdun kẹrin Ahabu, ọba Israeli.
entries.en: And Jehoshaphat the son of Asa began to reign over Judah in the fourth year of Ahab king of Israel.

entries.yo: Jehoṣafati si to ẹni ọdun marundilogoji nigbati o bẹ̀rẹ si ijọba; o si jọba ọdun mẹ̃dọgbọn ni Jerusalẹmu. Orukọ iya rẹ̀ ni Asuba ọmọbinrin Ṣilhi.
entries.en: Jehoshaphat was thirty and five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty and five years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.

entries.yo: O si rin ni gbogbo ọ̀na Asa baba rẹ̀; kò yipada kuro ninu rẹ̀, o nṣe eyiti o tọ li oju Oluwa: kiki a kò mu awọn ibi giga kuro; awọn enia si nrú ẹbọ, nwọn si nsun turari sibẹ̀ ni ibi giga wọnni.
entries.en: And he walked in all the ways of Asa his father; he turned not aside from it, doing that which was right in the eyes of the LORD: nevertheless the high places were not taken away; for the people offered and burnt incense yet in the high places.

entries.yo: Jehoṣafati si wà li alafia pẹlu ọba Israeli.
entries.en: And Jehoshaphat made peace with the king of Israel.

entries.yo: Ati iyokù iṣe Jehoṣafati ati iṣe agbara rẹ̀ ti o ṣe, ati bi o ti jagun si, a kò ha kọ wọn sinu iwe ọ̀rọ ọjọ awọn ọba Juda?
entries.en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, and his might that he shewed, and how he warred, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

entries.yo: Iyokù awọn ti nhuwà panṣaga ti o kù li ọjọ Asa baba rẹ̀, li o parun kuro ni ilẹ na.
entries.en: And the remnant of the sodomites, which remained in the days of his father Asa, he took out of the land.

entries.yo: Nigbana kò si ọba ni Edomu: adelé kan li ọba.
entries.en: There was then no king in Edom: a deputy was king.

entries.yo: Jehoṣafati kàn ọkọ̀ Tarṣiṣi lati lọ si Ofiri fun wura; ṣugbọn nwọn kò lọ: nitori awọn ọkọ̀ na fọ́ ni Esion-Geberi.
entries.en: Jehoshaphat made ships of Tharshish to go to Ophir for gold: but they went not; for the ships were broken at Ezion-geber.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Ahasiah, ọmọ Ahabu, wi fun Jehoṣafati pe, Jẹ ki awọn iranṣẹ mi ba awọn iranṣẹ rẹ lọ ninu ọkọ̀. Ṣugbọn Jehoṣafati kọ̀.
entries.en: Then said Ahaziah the son of Ahab unto Jehoshaphat, Let my servants go with thy servants in the ships. But Jehoshaphat would not.

entries.yo: Jehoṣafati si sùn pẹlu awọn baba rẹ̀, a si sin i pẹlu awọn baba rẹ̀ ni ilu Dafidi, baba rẹ̀: Jehoramu, ọmọ rẹ̀, si jọba ni ipò rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Jehoram his son reigned in his stead.

entries.yo: Ahasiah, ọmọ Ahabu, bẹ̀rẹ si ijọba lori Israeli ni Samaria li ọdun kẹtadilogun Jehoṣafati, ọba Juda, o si jọba li ọdun meji lori Israeli.
entries.en: Ahaziah the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and reigned two years over Israel.

entries.yo: O si ṣe ibi niwaju Oluwa, o si rìn li ọ̀na baba rẹ̀, ati li ọ̀na iya rẹ̀, ati li ọ̀na Jeroboamu, ọmọ Nebati, ti o mu Israeli dẹ̀ṣẹ:
entries.en: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, and walked in the way of his father, and in the way of his mother, and in the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin:

entries.yo: Nitoriti o sin Baali, o si mbọ ọ, o si mu Oluwa, Ọlọrun Israeli binu, gẹgẹ bi gbogbo eyiti baba rẹ̀ ti ṣe.
entries.en: For he served Baal, and worshipped him, and provoked to anger the LORD God of Israel, according to all that his father had done.

entries.yo: NIGBANA ni Moabu ṣọ̀tẹ si Israeli lẹhin ikú Ahabu.
entries.en: Then Moab rebelled against Israel after the death of Ahab.

entries.yo: Ahasiah si ṣubu lãrin fèrese ọlọnà kan ni iyara òke rẹ̀ ti o wà ni Samaria, o si ṣàisan: o si rán awọn onṣẹ o si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ lọ, ẹ bère lọwọ Baalsebubu, oriṣa Ekroni, bi emi o là ninu aisan yi.
entries.en: And Ahaziah fell down through a lattice in his upper chamber that was in Samaria, and was sick: and he sent messengers, and said unto them, Go, inquire of Baal-zebub the god of Ekron whether I shall recover of this disease.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn angeli Oluwa wi fun Elijah, ara Tiṣbi pe, Dide, gòke lọ ipade awọn onṣẹ ọba Samaria, ki o si wi fun wọn pe, Kò ṣe pe nitoriti kò si Ọlọrun ni Israeli, ni ẹnyin fi nlọ ibère lọwọ Baalsebubu oriṣa Ekroni?
entries.en: But the angel of the LORD said to Elijah the Tishbite, Arise, go up to meet the messengers of the king of Samaria, and say unto them, Is it not because there is not a God in Israel, that ye go to inquire of Baal-zebub the god of Ekron?

entries.yo: Njẹ nitorina bayi li Oluwa wi, Iwọ kì o sọ̀kalẹ kuro lori akete nì lori eyiti iwọ ti gùn, ṣugbọn kikú ni iwọ o kú. Elijah si lọ kuro.
entries.en: Now therefore thus saith the LORD, Thou shalt not come down from that bed on which thou art gone up, but shalt surely die. And Elijah departed.

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn onṣẹ si pada si ọdọ rẹ̀, o wi fun wọn pe, Ẽṣe ti ẹnyin fi pada sẹhin?
entries.en: And when the messengers turned back unto him, he said unto them, Why are ye now turned back?

entries.yo: Nwọn si wi fun u pe, Ọkunrin kan li o gòke lati pade wa, o si wi fun wa pe, Ẹ lọ, ẹ pada tọ̀ ọba ti o rán nyin, ki ẹ si wi fun u pe, Bayi li Oluwa wi, kò ṣepe nitoriti kò si Ọlọrun ni Israeli, ni iwọ fi ranṣẹ lọ ibère lọwọ Baalsebubu oriṣa Ekroni? nitorina, iwọ kì o sọ̀kalẹ kuro lori akete nì ti iwọ ti gùn, ṣugbọn kikú ni iwọ o kú.
entries.en: And they said unto him, There came a man up to meet us, and said unto us, Go, turn again unto the king that sent you, and say unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Is it not because there is not a God in Israel, that thou sendest to inquire of Baal-zebub the god of Ekron? therefore thou shalt not come down from that bed on which thou art gone up, but shalt surely die.

entries.yo: On si wi fun wọn pe, Iru ọkunrin wo li ẹniti o gòke lati pade nyin, ti o si sọ̀rọ wọnyi fun nyin?
entries.en: And he said unto them, What manner of man was he which came up to meet you, and told you these words?

entries.yo: Nwọn si da a li ohùn pe, Ọkunrin Onirum li ara ni; o si dì àmure awọ mọ́ ẹgbẹ́ rẹ̀. On si wipe, Elijah ara Tiṣbi ni.
entries.en: And they answered him, He was an hairy man, and girt with a girdle of leather about his loins. And he said, It is Elijah the Tishbite.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ọba rán olori-ogun ãdọta kan pẹlu ãdọta rẹ̀. O si gòke tọ̀ ọ lọ: si kiyesi i, o joko lori òke kan. On si wi fun u pe, Iwọ enia Ọlọrun, ọba wipe, Sọ̀kalẹ.
entries.en: Then the king sent unto him a captain of fifty with his fifty. And he went up to him: and, behold, he sat on the top of an hill. And he spake unto him, Thou man of God, the king hath said, Come down.

entries.yo: Elijah si dahùn, o si wi fun olori-ogun ãdọta na pe, Bi emi ba ṣe enia Ọlọrun, jẹ ki iná ki o sọ̀kalẹ lati ọrun wá, ki o run ọ ati ãdọta rẹ. Iná si sọ̀kalẹ ti ọrun wá, o si run u ati ãdọta rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Elijah answered and said to the captain of fifty, If I be a man of God, then let fire come down from heaven, and consume thee and thy fifty. And there came down fire from heaven, and consumed him and his fifty.

entries.yo: On si tun rán olori-ogun ãdọta miran pẹlu ãdọta rẹ̀. On si dahùn o si wi fun u pe, Iwọ enia Ọlọrun, Bayi li ọba wi, yara sọ̀kalẹ.
entries.en: Again also he sent unto him another captain of fifty with his fifty. And he answered and said unto him, O man of God, thus hath the king said, Come down quickly.

entries.yo: Elijah si dahùn, o si wi fun wọn pe, Bi emi ba ṣe enia Ọlọrun, jẹ ki iná ki o sọ̀kalẹ lati ọrun wá, ki o si run ọ ati ãdọta rẹ. Iná Ọlọrun si sọ̀kalẹ lati ọrun wá, o si run u ati ãdọta rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Elijah answered and said unto them, If I be a man of God, let fire come down from heaven, and consume thee and thy fifty. And the fire of God came down from heaven, and consumed him and his fifty.

entries.yo: O si tun rán olori-ogun ãdọta ekẹta pẹlu ãdọta rẹ̀. Olori-ogun ãdọta kẹta si gòke, o si wá, o si wolẹ lori ẽkún rẹ̀ niwaju Elijah, o si bẹ̀ ẹ, o si wi fun u pe, Iwọ, enia Ọlọrun, emi bẹ̀ ọ́, jẹ ki ẹmi mi ati ẹmi awọn ãdọta ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ wọnyi, ki o ṣọwọn li oju rẹ.
entries.en: And he sent again a captain of the third fifty with his fifty. And the third captain of fifty went up, and came and fell on his knees before Elijah, and besought him, and said unto him, O man of God, I pray thee, let my life, and the life of these fifty thy servants, be precious in thy sight.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, iná sọ̀kalẹ lati ọrun wá, o si run olori-ogun meji arãdọta iṣãju pẹlu arãdọta wọn: njẹ nisisiyi, jẹ ki ẹmi mi ki o ṣọwọn li oju rẹ.
entries.en: Behold, there came fire down from heaven, and burnt up the two captains of the former fifties with their fifties: therefore let my life now be precious in thy sight.

entries.yo: Angeli Oluwa si wi fun Elijah pe, Ba a sọ̀kalẹ lọ: máṣe bẹ̀ru rẹ̀. On si dide, o si ba a sọ̀kalẹ lọ sọdọ ọba.
entries.en: And the angel of the LORD said unto Elijah, Go down with him: be not afraid of him. And he arose, and went down with him unto the king.

entries.yo: On si wi fun u pe, Bayi li Oluwa wi, nitoriti iwọ ran onṣẹ lọ ibère lọwọ Baalsebubu oriṣa Ekroni, kò ṣepe nitoriti kò si Ọlọrun ni Israeli lati bère ọ̀rọ rẹ̀? nitorina iwọ kì o sọ̀kalẹ kuro lori akete nì ti iwọ ti gùn, ṣugbọn kikú ni iwọ o kú;
entries.en: And he said unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Forasmuch as thou hast sent messengers to inquire of Baal-zebub the god of Ekron, is it not because there is no God in Israel to inquire of his word? therefore thou shalt not come down off that bed on which thou art gone up, but shalt surely die.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni o kú gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ Oluwa ti Elijah ti sọ. Jehoramu si jọba ni ipò rẹ̀, li ọdun keji Jehoramu ọmọ Jehoṣafati, ọba Juda, nitoriti kò ni ọmọkunrin.
entries.en: So he died according to the word of the LORD which Elijah had spoken. And Jehoram reigned in his stead in the second year of Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah; because he had no son.

entries.yo: Ati iyokù iṣe Ahasiah ti o ṣe, a kò ha kọ wọn sinu iwe ọ̀rọ ọjọ awọn ọba Israeli?
entries.en: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaziah which he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati Oluwa nfẹ lati fi ãjà gbé Elijah lọ si òke ọrun, ni Elijah ati Eliṣa lọ kuro ni Gilgali.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when the LORD would take up Elijah into heaven by a whirlwind, that Elijah went with Elisha from Gilgal.

entries.yo: Elijah si wi fun Eliṣa pe, Emi bẹ̀ ọ, joko nihinyi; nitoriti Oluwa rán mi si Beteli. Eliṣa si wi fun u pe, Bi Oluwa ti mbẹ, ati bi ẹmi rẹ ti mbẹ, emi kì o fi ọ silẹ. Bẹ̃ni nwọn sọ̀kalẹ lọ si Beteli.
entries.en: And Elijah said unto Elisha, Tarry here, I pray thee; for the LORD hath sent me to Bethel. And Elisha said unto him, As the LORD liveth, and as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. So they went down to Bethel.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ awọn woli ti mbẹ ni Beteli jade tọ̀ Eliṣa wá, nwọn si wi fun u pe, Iwọ ha mọ̀ pe Oluwa yio mu oluwa rẹ lọ kuro li ori rẹ loni? On si wipe, Bẹ̃ni, emi mọ̀, ẹ pa ẹnu nyin mọ́.
entries.en: And the sons of the prophets that were at Bethel came forth to Elisha, and said unto him, Knowest thou that the LORD will take away thy master from thy head to day? And he said, Yea, I know it; hold ye your peace.

entries.yo: Elijah si wi fun u pe, Eliṣa, emi bẹ̀ ọ, joko nihinyi; nitori ti Oluwa rán mi si Jeriko. On si wipe, Bi Oluwa ti mbẹ, ati bi ẹmi rẹ ti mbẹ, emi kì o fi ọ silẹ. Bẹ̃ni nwọn de Jeriko.
entries.en: And Elijah said unto him, Elisha, tarry here, I pray thee; for the LORD hath sent me to Jericho. And he said, As the LORD liveth, and as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. So they came to Jericho.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ awọn woli ti mbẹ ni Jeriko tọ̀ Eliṣa wá, nwọn si wi fun u pe, Iwọ ha mọ̀ pe Oluwa yio mu oluwa rẹ lọ kuro li ori rẹ loni? On si dahùn wipe, Bẹ̃ni, emi mọ̀, ẹ pa ẹnu nyin mọ́.
entries.en: And the sons of the prophets that were at Jericho came to Elisha, and said unto him, Knowest thou that the LORD will take away thy master from thy head to day? And he answered, Yea, I know it; hold ye your peace.

entries.yo: Elijah si wi fun u pe, Emi bẹ̀ ọ, joko nihinyi; nitoriti Oluwa rán mi si Jordani. On si wipe, Bi Oluwa ti mbẹ, ati bi ẹmi rẹ ti mbẹ, emi kì o fi ọ silẹ. Awọn mejeji si jùmọ nlọ.
entries.en: And Elijah said unto him, Tarry, I pray thee, here; for the LORD hath sent me to Jordan. And he said, As the LORD liveth, and as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. And they two went on.

entries.yo: Adọta ọkunrin ninu awọn ọmọ awọn woli si lọ, nwọn si duro lati wò lòkere rére: awọn mejeji si duro li ẹba Jordani.
entries.en: And fifty men of the sons of the prophets went, and stood to view afar off: and they two stood by Jordan.

entries.yo: Elijah si mu agbáda rẹ̀, o si lọ́ ọ lù, o si lù omi na, o si pin wọn ni iyà sihin ati sọhun, bẹ̃ni awọn mejeji si kọja ni ilẹ gbigbẹ.
entries.en: And Elijah took his mantle, and wrapped it together, and smote the waters, and they were divided hither and thither, so that they two went over on dry ground.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati nwọn kọja tan, ni Elijah wi fun Eliṣa pe, Bère ohun ti emi o ṣe fun ọ, ki a to gbà mi kuro lọwọ rẹ. Eliṣa si wipe, Emi bẹ̀ ọ, jẹ ki ìlọ́po meji ẹmi rẹ ki o bà le mi.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when they were gone over, that Elijah said unto Elisha, Ask what I shall do for thee, before I be taken away from thee. And Elisha said, I pray thee, let a double portion of thy spirit be upon me.

entries.yo: On si wipe, Iwọ bère ohun ti o ṣoro: ṣugbọn, bi iwọ ba ri mi nigbati a ba gbà mi kuro lọdọ rẹ, yio ri bẹ̃ fun ọ; ṣugbọn bi bẹ̃ kọ, kì yio ri bẹ̃.
entries.en: And he said, Thou hast asked a hard thing: nevertheless, if thou see me when I am taken from thee, it shall be so unto thee; but if not, it shall not be so.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, bi nwọn ti nlọ, ti nwọn nsọ̀rọ, si kiyesi i, kẹkẹ́ iná ati ẹṣin iná si là ãrin awọn mejeji; Elijah si ba ãjà gòke re ọrun.
entries.en: And it came to pass, as they still went on, and talked, that, behold, there appeared a chariot of fire, and horses of fire, and parted them both asunder; and Elijah went up by a whirlwind into heaven.

entries.yo: Eliṣa si ri i, o si kigbe pe, Baba mi, baba mi! kẹkẹ́ Israeli, ati awọn ẹlẹṣin rẹ̀. On kò si ri i mọ: o si di aṣọ ara rẹ̀ mu, o si fà wọn ya si meji.
entries.en: And Elisha saw it, and he cried, My father, my father, the chariot of Israel, and the horsemen thereof. And he saw him no more: and he took hold of his own clothes, and rent them in two pieces.

entries.yo: On si mu agbáda Elijah ti o bọ́ lọwọ rẹ̀, o si pada sẹhin, o si duro ni bèbe Jordani.
entries.en: He took up also the mantle of Elijah that fell from him, and went back, and stood by the bank of Jordan;

entries.yo: On si mu agbáda Elijah ti o bọ́ lọwọ rẹ̀, o si lù omi na, o si wipe, Nibo ni Oluwa Ọlọrun Elijah wà? Nigbati on pẹlu si lù omi na, nwọn si pinyà sihin ati sọhun: Eliṣa si rekọja.
entries.en: And he took the mantle of Elijah that fell from him, and smote the waters, and said, Where is the LORD God of Elijah? and when he also had smitten the waters, they parted hither and thither: and Elisha went over.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ awọn woli ti o wà ni Jeriko nihà keji si ri i, nwọn si wipe, Ẹmi Elijah bà le Eliṣa. Nwọn si wá ipade rẹ̀; nwọn si tẹ̀ ara wọn ba silẹ niwaju rẹ̀.
entries.en: And when the sons of the prophets which were to view at Jericho saw him, they said, The spirit of Elijah doth rest on Elisha. And they came to meet him, and bowed themselves to the ground before him.

entries.yo: Nwọn si wi fun u pe, Wò o na, ãdọta ọkunrin alagbara mbẹ pẹlu awọn iranṣẹ rẹ; awa bẹ̀ ọ, jẹ ki nwọn ki o lọ, ki nwọn ki o si wá oluwa rẹ lọ: bọya Ẹmi Oluwa ti gbé e sokè, o si ti sọ ọ sori ọkan ninu òke nla wọnni, tabi sinu afonifojì kan. On si wipe, Ẹ máṣe ranṣẹ.
entries.en: And they said unto him, Behold now, there be with thy servants fifty strong men; let them go, we pray thee, and seek thy master: lest peradventure the Spirit of the LORD hath taken him up, and cast him upon some mountain, or into some valley. And he said, Ye shall not send.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si rọ̀ ọ titi oju fi tì i, o wi fun wọn pe, Ranṣẹ. Nitorina nwọn rán ãdọta ọkunrin, nwọn si wá a ni ijọ mẹta, ṣugbọn nwọn kò ri i.
entries.en: And when they urged him till he was ashamed, he said, Send. They sent therefore fifty men; and they sought three days, but found him not.

entries.yo: Nwọn si tun pada tọ̀ ọ wá, (nitori ni Jeriko li o joko,) o wi fun wọn pe, Emi kò ti wi fun nyin pe, Ẹ máṣe lọ?
entries.en: And when they came again to him, (for he tarried at Jericho,) he said unto them, Did I not say unto you, Go not?

entries.yo: Awọn ọkunrin ilu na si wi fun Eliṣa pe, Kiyesi i, itẹ̀do ilu yi dara, bi oluwa mi ti ri i: ṣugbọn omi buru, ilẹ si ṣá.
entries.en: And the men of the city said unto Elisha, Behold, I pray thee, the situation of this city is pleasant, as my lord seeth: but the water is naught, and the ground barren.

entries.yo: On si wipe, Mu àwokóto titun kan fun mi wá, si fi iyọ̀ sinu rẹ̀; nwọn si mu u tọ̀ ọ wá.
entries.en: And he said, Bring me a new cruse, and put salt therein. And they brought it to him.

entries.yo: On si jade lọ si ibi orisun omi na, o si dà iyọ na sibẹ, o si wipe, Bayi li Oluwa wi, Emi ṣe àwotan omi wọnyi; lati ihin lọ, kì yio si ikú mọ, tabi aṣálẹ.
entries.en: And he went forth unto the spring of the waters, and cast the salt in there, and said, Thus saith the LORD, I have healed these waters; there shall not be from thence any more death or barren land.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni a ṣe àwotan omi na titi di oni oloni, gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ Eliṣa ti o sọ.
entries.en: So the waters were healed unto this day, according to the saying of Elisha which he spake.

entries.yo: O si gòke lati ibẹ lọ si Beteli: bi o si ti ngòke lọ li ọ̀na, awọn ọmọ kekeke jade lati ilu wá, nwọn si nfi ṣe ẹlẹyà, nwọn si wi fun u pe, Gòke lọ, apari! gòke lọ, apari!
entries.en: And he went up from thence unto Bethel: and as he was going up by the way, there came forth little children out of the city, and mocked him, and said unto him, Go up, thou bald head; go up, thou bald head.

entries.yo: O si yipada, o si wò wọn, o si fi wọn bú li orukọ Oluwa. Abo-beari meji si jade lati inu igbó wá, nwọn si fà mejilelogoji ya ninu wọn.
entries.en: And he turned back, and looked on them, and cursed them in the name of the LORD. And there came forth two she bears out of the wood, and tare forty and two children of them.

entries.yo: O si ti ibẹ lọ si òke Karmeli; ati lati ibẹ o pada si Samaria.
entries.en: And he went from thence to mount Carmel, and from thence he returned to Samaria.

entries.yo: JEHORAMU, ọmọ Ahabu si bẹ̀rẹ si ijọba lori Israeli ni Samaria li ọdun kejidilogun Jehoṣafati, ọba Juda, o si jọba li ọdun mejila.
entries.en: Now Jehoram the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria the eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and reigned twelve years.

entries.yo: O si ṣe buburu li oju Oluwa; ṣugbọn kì iṣe bi baba rẹ̀, ati bi iya rẹ̀: nitoriti o mu ere Baali ti baba rẹ̀ ti ṣe kuro.
entries.en: And he wrought evil in the sight of the LORD; but not like his father, and like his mother: for he put away the image of Baal that his father had made.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn o fi ara mọ ẹ̀ṣẹ Jeroboamu, ọmọ Nebati, ti o mu Israeli dẹ̀ṣẹ; kò si lọ kuro ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: Nevertheless he cleaved unto the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, which made Israel to sin; he departed not therefrom.

entries.yo: Meṣa, ọba Moabu si nsìn agutan, o si nsan ọkẹ marun ọdọ-agutan, ati ọkẹ marun àgbo irun fun ọba Israeli.
entries.en: And Mesha king of Moab was a sheepmaster, and rendered unto the king of Israel an hundred thousand lambs, and an hundred thousand rams, with the wool.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati Ahabu kú, ọba Moabu si ṣọ̀tẹ si ọba Israeli.
entries.en: But it came to pass, when Ahab was dead, that the king of Moab rebelled against the king of Israel.

entries.yo: Jehoramu ọba si jade lọ kuro ni Samaria li akoko na, o si ka iye gbogbo Israeli.
entries.en: And king Jehoram went out of Samaria the same time, and numbered all Israel.

entries.yo: O si lọ, o ranṣẹ si Jehoṣafati ọba Juda, wipe, Ọba Moabu ti ṣọ̀tẹ si mi: iwọ o ha bá mi lọ si Moabu lati jagun? On si wipe, Emi o gòke lọ: emi bi iwọ, enia mi bi enia rẹ, ati ẹṣin mi bi ẹṣin rẹ.
entries.en: And he went and sent to Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, saying, The king of Moab hath rebelled against me: wilt thou go with me against Moab to battle? And he said, I will go up: I am as thou art, my people as thy people, and my horses as thy horses.

entries.yo: On si wipe, Ọ̀na wo li awa o gbà gòke lọ? On si dahùn wipe, Ọ̀na aginju Edomu.
entries.en: And he said, Which way shall we go up? And he answered, The way through the wilderness of Edom.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni ọba Israeli lọ, ati ọba Juda, ati ọba Edomu: nigbati nwọn rìn àrinyika ijọ meje, omi kò si si nibẹ fun awọn ogun, ati fun ẹranko ti ntọ̀ wọn lẹhin.
entries.en: So the king of Israel went, and the king of Judah, and the king of Edom: and they fetched a compass of seven days' journey: and there was no water for the host, and for the cattle that followed them.

entries.yo: Ọba Israeli si wipe, O ṣe! ti Oluwa fi pè awọn ọba mẹtẹta wọnyi jọ, lati fi wọn le Moabu lọwọ!
entries.en: And the king of Israel said, Alas! that the LORD hath called these three kings together, to deliver them into the hand of Moab!

entries.yo: Jehoṣafati si wipe, Kò ha si woli Oluwa kan nihin, ti awa iba ti ọdọ rẹ̀ bère lọwọ Oluwa? Ọkan ninu awọn iranṣẹ ọba Israeli dahùn wipe, Eliṣa, ọmọ Ṣafati ti ntú omi si ọwọ Elijah mbẹ nihinyi.
entries.en: But Jehoshaphat said, Is there not here a prophet of the LORD, that we may inquire of the LORD by him? And one of the king of Israel's servants answered and said, Here is Elisha the son of Shaphat, which poured water on the hands of Elijah.

entries.yo: Jehoṣafati si wipe, Ọ̀rọ Oluwa mbẹ pẹlu rẹ̀. Bẹ̃ni ọba Israeli ati Jehoṣafati ati ọba Edomu sọ̀kalẹ tọ̀ ọ lọ.
entries.en: And Jehoshaphat said, The word of the LORD is with him. So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat and the king of Edom went down to him.

entries.yo: Eliṣa si wi fun ọba Israeli pe, Kini o ṣe mi ṣe ọ? Ba ara rẹ lọ sọdọ awọn woli baba rẹ, ati awọn woli iya rẹ. Ọba Israeli si wi fun u pe, Bẹ̃kọ: nitori ti Oluwa ti pè awọn ọba mẹtẹta wọnyi jọ, lati fi wọn le Moabu lọwọ.
entries.en: And Elisha said unto the king of Israel, What have I to do with thee? get thee to the prophets of thy father, and to the prophets of thy mother. And the king of Israel said unto him, Nay: for the LORD hath called these three kings together, to deliver them into the hand of Moab.

entries.yo: Eliṣa si wipe, Bi Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun ti mbẹ, niwaju ẹniti emi duro, iba má ṣepe mo bu ọwọ Jehoṣafati ọba Juda, nitõtọ emi kì ba ti bẹ̀ ọ wò, bẹ̃ni emi kì ba ti ri ọ.
entries.en: And Elisha said, As the LORD of hosts liveth, before whom I stand, surely, were it not that I regard the presence of Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, I would not look toward thee, nor see thee.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹ mu akọrin kan fun mi wá nisisiyi. O si ṣe, nigbati akọrin na nkọrin, ọwọ Oluwa si bà le e.
entries.en: But now bring me a minstrel. And it came to pass, when the minstrel played, that the hand of the LORD came upon him.

entries.yo: On si wipe, Bayi li Oluwa wi, Wà iho pupọ li afonifojì yi.
entries.en: And he said, Thus saith the LORD, Make this valley full of ditches.

entries.yo: Nitori bayi li Oluwa wi, pe, Ẹnyin kì o ri afẹfẹ, bẹ̃ni ẹnyin kì o ri òjo; ṣugbọn afonifojì na yio kún fun omi, ki ẹnyin ki o le mu, ati ẹnyin, ati awọn ẹran-ọ̀sin nyin, ati ẹran nyin.
entries.en: For thus saith the LORD, Ye shall not see wind, neither shall ye see rain; yet that valley shall be filled with water, that ye may drink, both ye, and your cattle, and your beasts.

entries.yo: Ohun kikini si li eyi loju Oluwa: on o fi awọn ara Moabu le nyin lọwọ pẹlu.
entries.en: And this is but a light thing in the sight of the LORD: he will deliver the Moabites also into your hand.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin o si kọlù gbogbo ilu olodi, ati gbogbo ãyò ilu, ẹnyin o si ké gbogbo igi rere lulẹ, ẹnyin o si dí gbogbo kanga omi, ẹnyin o si fi okuta bà gbogbo oko rere jẹ.
entries.en: And ye shall smite every fenced city, and every choice city, and shall fell every good tree, and stop all wells of water, and mar every good piece of land with stones.

entries.yo: O si ṣe li owurọ, bi a ti nta ọrẹ-ẹbọ onjẹ, si kiyesi i, omi ti ọ̀na Edomu wá, ilẹ na si kún fun omi.
entries.en: And it came to pass in the morning, when the meat offering was offered, that, behold, there came water by the way of Edom, and the country was filled with water.

entries.yo: Nigbati gbogbo ara Moabu gbọ́ pe, awọn ọba gòke wá lati ba wọn jà, nwọn kó gbogbo awọn ti o le hamọra ogun jọ, ati awọn ti o dagba jù wọn lọ, nwọn si duro li eti ilẹ wọn.
entries.en: And when all the Moabites heard that the kings were come up to fight against them, they gathered all that were able to put on armour, and upward, and stood in the border.

entries.yo: Nwọn si dide li owurọ̀, õrùn si ràn si oju omi na, awọn ara Moabu si ri omi na li apakeji, o pọn bi ẹ̀jẹ:
entries.en: And they rose up early in the morning, and the sun shone upon the water, and the Moabites saw the water on the other side as red as blood:

entries.yo: Nwọn si wipe, Ẹ̀jẹ li eyi: awọn ọba na run: nwọn si ti pa ara wọn; njẹ nisisiyi, Moabu, dide si ikogun.
entries.en: And they said, This is blood: the kings are surely slain, and they have smitten one another: now therefore, Moab, to the spoil.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si de ibùdo Israeli, awọn ọmọ Israeli dide, nwọn si kọlù awọn ara Moabu, nwọn si sa kuro niwaju wọn: nwọn si wọ inu rẹ̀, nwọn si pa Moabu run.
entries.en: And when they came to the camp of Israel, the Israelites rose up and smote the Moabites, so that they fled before them: but they went forward smiting the Moabites, even in their country.

entries.yo: Nwọn si wó gbogbo ilu, olukulùku si jù okuta tirẹ̀ si gbogbo oko rere, nwọn si kún wọn; nwọn si dí gbogbo kanga omi, nwọn si bẹ́ gbogbo igi rere: ni Kirharaseti ni nwọn fi kiki awọn okuta rẹ̀ silẹ ṣugbọn awọn oni-kànakana yi i ka, nwọn si kọlù u.
entries.en: And they beat down the cities, and on every good piece of land cast every man his stone, and filled it; and they stopped all the wells of water, and felled all the good trees: only in Kir-haraseth left they the stones thereof; howbeit the slingers went about it, and smote it.

entries.yo: Nigbati ọba Moabu ri i pe ogun na le jù fun on, o mu ẹ̃dẹgbẹrin ọkunrin ti o fà idà yọ pẹlu rẹ̀, lati là ogun ja si ọdọ ọba Edomu: ṣugbọn nwọn kò le ṣe e.
entries.en: And when the king of Moab saw that the battle was too sore for him, he took with him seven hundred men that drew swords, to break through even unto the king of Edom: but they could not.

entries.yo: Nigbana li o mu akọbi ọmọ rẹ̀ ti iba jọba ni ipò rẹ̀, o si fi i rubọ sisun li ori odi. Ibinu nla si wà si Israeli: nwọn si lọ kuro lọdọ rẹ̀, nwọn si pada si ilẹ wọn.
entries.en: Then he took his eldest son that should have reigned in his stead, and offered him for a burnt offering upon the wall. And there was great indignation against Israel: and they departed from him, and returned to their own land.

entries.yo: OBIRIN kan ninu awọn obinrin ọmọ awọn woli ke ba Eliṣa wipe, Iranṣẹ rẹ, ọkọ mi kú; iwọ si mọ̀ pe iranṣẹ rẹ bẹ̀ru Oluwa: awọn onigbèse si wá lati mu awọn ọmọ mi mejeji li ẹrú.
entries.en: Now there cried a certain woman of the wives of the sons of the prophets unto Elisha, saying, Thy servant my husband is dead; and thou knowest that thy servant did fear the LORD: and the creditor is come to take unto him my two sons to be bondmen.

entries.yo: Eliṣa si wi fun u pe, Kini emi o ṣe fun ọ? Wi fun mi, kini iwọ ni ninu ile? On si wipe, Iranṣẹbinrin rẹ kò ni nkankan ni ile, bikòṣe ikòko ororo kan.
entries.en: And Elisha said unto her, What shall I do for thee? tell me, what hast thou in the house? And she said, Thine handmaid hath not any thing in the house, save a pot of oil.

entries.yo: On si wipe, Lọ, ki iwọ ki o yá ikòko lọwọ awọn aladugbò rẹ kakiri, ani ikòko ofo; yá wọn, kì iṣe diẹ.
entries.en: Then he said, Go, borrow thee vessels abroad of all thy neighbours, even empty vessels; borrow not a few.

entries.yo: Nigbati iwọ ba si wọle, ki iwọ ki o se ilẹ̀kun mọ ara rẹ, ati mọ awọn ọmọ rẹ, ki o si dà a sinu gbogbo ikòko wọnni, ki iwọ ki o si fi eyiti o kún si apakan.
entries.en: And when thou art come in, thou shalt shut the door upon thee and upon thy sons, and shalt pour out into all those vessels, and thou shalt set aside that which is full.

entries.yo: O si lọ kuro lọdọ rẹ̀, o si se ilẹ̀kun mọ ara rẹ̀ ati mọ awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, ti ngbe ikòko fun u wá; on si dà a.
entries.en: So she went from him, and shut the door upon her and upon her sons, who brought the vessels to her; and she poured out.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati awọn ikòko kún, o wi fun ọmọ rẹ̀ pe, Tun mu ikòko kan fun mi wá. On si wi fun u pe, Kò si ikòko kan mọ. Ororo na si da.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when the vessels were full, that she said unto her son, Bring me yet a vessel. And he said unto her, There is not a vessel more. And the oil stayed.

entries.yo: Nigbana li o wá, o si sọ fun enia Ọlọrun na. On si wipe, Lọ, tà ororo na, ki o si san gbèse rẹ, ki iwọ ati awọn ọmọ rẹ ki o si jẹ eyi ti o kù.
entries.en: Then she came and told the man of God. And he said, Go, sell the oil, and pay thy debt, and live thou and thy children of the rest.

entries.yo: O si di ọjọ kan, Eliṣa si kọja si Ṣunemu, nibiti obinrin ọlọla kan wà; on si rọ̀ ọ lati jẹ onjẹ. O si ṣe, nigbakugba ti o ba nkọja lọ, on a yà si ibẹ lati jẹ onjẹ.
entries.en: And it fell on a day, that Elisha passed to Shunem, where was a great woman; and she constrained him to eat bread. And so it was, that as oft as he passed by, he turned in thither to eat bread.

entries.yo: On si wi fun ọkọ rẹ̀ pe, Sa wò o na, emi woye pe, enia mimọ́ Ọlọrun li eyi ti ngbà ọdọ wa kọja nigbakugba.
entries.en: And she said unto her husband, Behold now, I perceive that this is an holy man of God, which passeth by us continually.

entries.yo: Emi bẹ̀ ọ, jẹ ki a ṣe yàrá kekere kan lara ogiri; si jẹ ki a gbe ibùsùn kan sibẹ fun u, ati tabili kan, ati ohun-ijoko kan, ati ọpá-fitila kan: yio si ṣe, nigbati o ba tọ̀ wa wá, ki on ma wọ̀ sibẹ.
entries.en: Let us make a little chamber, I pray thee, on the wall; and let us set for him there a bed, and a table, and a stool, and a candlestick: and it shall be, when he cometh to us, that he shall turn in thither.

entries.yo: O si di ọjọ kan, ti o wá ibẹ̀, o si yà sinu yàrá na, o si dubulẹ nibẹ.
entries.en: And it fell on a day, that he came thither, and he turned into the chamber, and lay there.

entries.yo: On si wi fun Gehasi iranṣẹ rẹ̀ pe, Pè ara Ṣunemu yi. Nigbati o si pè e, o duro niwaju rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he said to Gehazi his servant, Call this Shunammite. And when he had called her, she stood before him.

entries.yo: On si wi fun u pe, nisisiyi, sọ fun u pe, Kiyesi i, iwọ ti fi gbogbo itọju yi ṣe aniyàn wa; kini a ba ṣe fun ọ? Iwọ nfẹ́ ki a sọ̀rọ rẹ fun ọba bi? tabi fun olori-ogun? On si dahùn wipe, Emi ngbe lãrin awọn enia mi.
entries.en: And he said unto him, Say now unto her, Behold, thou hast been careful for us with all this care; what is to be done for thee? wouldest thou be spoken for to the king, or to the captain of the host? And she answered, I dwell among mine own people.

entries.yo: On si wipe, Njẹ kini a ba ṣe fun u? Gehasi si dahùn pe, Nitõtọ, on kò li ọmọ, ọkọ rẹ̀ si di arugbo.
entries.en: And he said, What then is to be done for her? And Gehazi answered, Verily she hath no child, and her husband is old.

entries.yo: On si wipe, Pè e wá, nigbati o si ti pè e de, o duro li ẹnu-ọ̀na.
entries.en: And he said, Call her. And when he had called her, she stood in the door.

entries.yo: On si wipe, Li akokò yi gẹgẹ bi igba aiye, iwọ gbé ọmọkunrin kan mọra. On si wipe, Bẹ̃kọ̀, oluwa mi, iwọ enia Ọlọrun, má ṣe purọ fun iranṣẹbinrin rẹ.
entries.en: And he said, About this season, according to the time of life, thou shalt embrace a son. And she said, Nay, my lord, thou man of God, do not lie unto thine handmaid.

entries.yo: Obinrin na si loyun, o si bi ọmọkunrin kan li akokò na ti Eliṣa ti sọ fun u, gẹgẹ bi igba aiye.
entries.en: And the woman conceived, and bare a son at that season that Elisha had said unto her, according to the time of life.

entries.yo: Nigbati ọmọ na si dagba, o di ọjọ kan, ti o jade tọ̀ baba rẹ̀ lọ si ọdọ awọn olukore.
entries.en: And when the child was grown, it fell on a day, that he went out to his father to the reapers.

entries.yo: O si wi fun baba rẹ̀ pe, Ori mi, ori mi! On si sọ fun ọmọ-ọdọ̀ kan pe, Gbé e tọ̀ iya rẹ̀ lọ.
entries.en: And he said unto his father, My head, my head. And he said to a lad, Carry him to his mother.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si gbé e, ti o mu u tọ̀ iya rẹ̀ wá, o joko li ẽkun rẹ̀ titi di ọjọ kanri, o si kú.
entries.en: And when he had taken him, and brought him to his mother, he sat on her knees till noon, and then died.

entries.yo: On si gòke, o si tẹ́ ẹ sori ibùsun enia Ọlọrun na, o si sé ilẹ̀kun mọ ọ, o si jade lọ.
entries.en: And she went up, and laid him on the bed of the man of God, and shut the door upon him, and went out.

entries.yo: On si ke si ọkọ rẹ̀, o si wipe, Emi bẹ̀ ọ, rán ọkan ninu awọn ọdọmọkunrin si mi, ati ọkan ninu awọn kẹtẹkẹtẹ, emi o si sare tọ̀ enia Ọlọrun lọ, emi o si tun pada.
entries.en: And she called unto her husband, and said, Send me, I pray thee, one of the young men, and one of the asses, that I may run to the man of God, and come again.

entries.yo: On si wipe, Ẽṣe ti iwọ o fi tọ̀ ọ lọ loni? kì isa ṣe oṣù titun, bẹ̃ni kì iṣe ọjọ isimi. On sì wipe, Alafia ni.
entries.en: And he said, Wherefore wilt thou go to him to day? it is neither new moon, nor sabbath. And she said, It shall be well.

entries.yo: Nigbana li o di kẹtẹkẹtẹ ni gãri, o si wi fun iranṣẹ rẹ̀ pe, Mã le e, ki o si ma nṣo; máṣe dẹ̀ ire fun mi, bikòṣepe mo sọ fun ọ.
entries.en: Then she saddled an ass, and said to her servant, Drive, and go forward; slack not thy riding for me, except I bid thee.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li o lọ, o si de ọdọ enia Ọlọrun na li òke Karmeli. O si ṣe, nigbati enia Ọlọrun na ri i li okère, o si sọ fun Gehasi ọmọ ọdọ rẹ̀ pe, Wò ara Ṣunemu nì:
entries.en: So she went and came unto the man of God to mount Carmel. And it came to pass, when the man of God saw her afar off, that he said to Gehazi his servant, Behold, yonder is that Shunammite:

entries.yo: Emi bẹ̀ ọ, sure nisisiyi ki o pade rẹ̀, ki o si wi fun u pe, Alafia ki o wà bi? alafia ki ọkọ rẹ̀ wà bi? alafia ki ọmọde wà bi? On si dahùn wipe, Alafia ni.
entries.en: Run now, I pray thee, to meet her, and say unto her, Is it well with thee? is it well with thy husband? is it well with the child? And she answered, It is well.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si de ọdọ enia Ọlọrun li ori òke, o gbá a li ẹsẹ̀ mu: ṣugbọn Gehasi sunmọ ọ lati tì i kurò. Enia Ọlọrun na si wipe, Jọwọ rẹ̀ nitori ọkàn rẹ̀ bajẹ ninu rẹ̀, Oluwa si pa a mọ́ fun mi, kò si sọ fun mi.
entries.en: And when she came to the man of God to the hill, she caught him by the feet: but Gehazi came near to thrust her away. And the man of God said, Let her alone; for her soul is vexed within her: and the LORD hath hid it from me, and hath not told me.

entries.yo: Nigbana li o wipe, Mo ha tọrọ ọmọ li ọwọ oluwa mi bi? Emi kò ha wipe, Máṣe tàn mi jẹ?
entries.en: Then she said, Did I desire a son of my lord? did I not say, Do not deceive me?

entries.yo: O si wi fun Gehasi pe, Di àmure rẹ, ki o si mu ọpa mi li ọwọ rẹ, ki o si lọ, bi iwọ ba ri ẹnikẹni li ọ̀na, máṣe ki i; bi ẹnikeni ba si kí ọ, máṣe da a li ohùn: ki o si fi ọpá mi le iwaju ọmọ na.
entries.en: Then he said to Gehazi, Gird up thy loins, and take my staff in thine hand, and go thy way: if thou meet any man, salute him not; and if any salute thee, answer him not again: and lay my staff upon the face of the child.

entries.yo: Iya ọmọ na si wipe, Bi Oluwa ti mbẹ, ati bi ẹmi rẹ ti mbẹ, emi kì o fi ọ silẹ. On si dide, o si ntọ̀ ọ lẹhin.
entries.en: And the mother of the child said, As the LORD liveth, and as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. And he arose, and followed her.

entries.yo: Gehasi si kọja siwaju wọn, o si fi ọpá na le ọmọ na ni iwaju, ṣugbọn kò si ohùn, tabi afiyesi: nitorina o si tun pada lati lọ ipade rẹ̀, o si wi fun u pe, Ọmọ na kò ji.
entries.en: And Gehazi passed on before them, and laid the staff upon the face of the child; but there was neither voice, nor hearing. Wherefore he went again to meet him, and told him, saying, The child is not awaked.

entries.yo: Nigbati Eliṣa si wọ̀ inu ile, kiyesi i, ọmọ na ti kú, a si tẹ́ ẹ sori ibùsun rẹ̀.
entries.en: And when Elisha was come into the house, behold, the child was dead, and laid upon his bed.

entries.yo: O si wọ̀ inu ile lọ, o si se ilẹ̀kun mọ awọn mejeji, o si gbadura si Oluwa.
entries.en: He went in therefore, and shut the door upon them twain, and prayed unto the LORD.

entries.yo: On si gòke, o si dubulẹ le ọmọ na, o si fi ẹnu rẹ̀ le ẹnu rẹ̀, ati oju rẹ̀ le oju rẹ̀, ati ọwọ rẹ̀ le ọwọ rẹ̀: on si nà ara rẹ̀ le ọmọ na, ara ọmọ na si di gbigboná.
entries.en: And he went up, and lay upon the child, and put his mouth upon his mouth, and his eyes upon his eyes, and his hands upon his hands: and he stretched himself upon the child; and the flesh of the child waxed warm.

entries.yo: O si pada, o si rìn lọ, rìn bọ̀ ninu ile lẹ̃kan; o si gòke, o si nà ara rẹ̀ le e; ọmọ na si sín nigba meje; ọmọ na si là oju rẹ̀.
entries.en: Then he returned, and walked in the house to and fro; and went up, and stretched himself upon him: and the child sneezed seven times, and the child opened his eyes.

entries.yo: O si pè Gehasi, o si wipe, Pè ara Ṣunemu yi wá. O si pè e. Nigbati o si wọle tọ̀ ọ wá, o ni, Gbé ọmọ rẹ.
entries.en: And he called Gehazi, and said, Call this Shunammite. So he called her. And when she was come in unto him, he said, Take up thy son.

entries.yo: Nigbana li o wọ̀ inu ile, o si wolẹ li ẹba ẹṣẹ̀ rẹ̀, o si dojubolẹ, o si gbé ọmọ rẹ̀, o si jade lọ.
entries.en: Then she went in, and fell at his feet, and bowed herself to the ground, and took up her son, and went out.

entries.yo: Eliṣa si tun pada wá si Gilgali, iyàn si mu ni ilẹ na; awọn ọmọ awọn woli joko niwaju rẹ̀: on si wi fun iranṣẹ rẹ̀ pe, Gbe ìkoko nla ka iná, ki ẹ si pa ipẹ̀tẹ fun awọn ọmọ awọn woli.
entries.en: And Elisha came again to Gilgal: and there was a dearth in the land; and the sons of the prophets were sitting before him: and he said unto his servant, Set on the great pot, and seethe pottage for the sons of the prophets.

entries.yo: Ẹnikan si jade lọ si igbẹ lati fẹ́ ewebẹ̀, o si ri ajara-igbẹ kan, o si ka eso rẹ̀ kún aṣọ rẹ̀, o si rẹ́ ẹ wẹwẹ, o dà wọn sinu ikoko ipẹ̀tẹ na: nitoripe nwọn kò mọ̀ wọn.
entries.en: And one went out into the field to gather herbs, and found a wild vine, and gathered thereof wild gourds his lap full, and came and shred them into the pot of pottage: for they knew them not.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni nwọn si dà a fun awọn ọkunrin na lati jẹ. O si ṣe bi nwọn ti njẹ ipẹ̀tẹ na, nwọn si kigbe, nwọn si wipe, Iwọ enia Ọlọrun, ikú mbẹ ninu ikoko na! Nwọn kò si le jẹ ẹ.
entries.en: So they poured out for the men to eat. And it came to pass, as they were eating of the pottage, that they cried out, and said, O thou man of God, there is death in the pot. And they could not eat thereof.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn on wipe, Njẹ, ẹ mu iyẹ̀fun wá. O si dà a sinu ikoko na, o si wipe, Dà a fun awọn enia, ki nwọn ki o le jẹ. Kò si si jamba ninu ikoko mọ.
entries.en: But he said, Then bring meal. And he cast it into the pot; and he said, Pour out for the people, that they may eat. And there was no harm in the pot.

entries.yo: Ọkunrin kan si ti Baali-Ṣaliṣa wá, o si mu àkara akọso-eso, ogun iṣu àkara barle, ati ṣiri ọkà titun ninu àpo rẹ̀ wá fun enia Ọlọrun na. On si wipe, Fi fun awọn enia, ki nwọn ki o le jẹ.
entries.en: And there came a man from Baal-shalisha, and brought the man of God bread of the firstfruits, twenty loaves of barley, and full ears of corn in the husk thereof. And he said, Give unto the people, that they may eat.

entries.yo: Iranṣẹ rẹ̀ si wipe, Kinla, ki emi ki o gbé eyi kà iwaju ọgọrun enia? On si tun wipe, Fi fun awọn enia, ki nwọn ki o le jẹ: nitori bayi li Oluwa wi pe, Nwọn o jẹ, nwọn o si kù silẹ.
entries.en: And his servitor said, What, should I set this before an hundred men? He said again, Give the people, that they may eat: for thus saith the LORD, They shall eat, and shall leave thereof.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li o gbe e kà iwaju wọn, nwọn si jẹ, nwọn si kù silẹ, gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ Oluwa.
entries.en: So he set it before them, and they did eat, and left thereof, according to the word of the LORD.

entries.yo: NJẸ Naamani, olori-ogun ọba Siria, jẹ enia nla niwaju oluwa rẹ̀, ati ọlọla, nitori nipa rẹ̀ ni Oluwa ti fi iṣẹgun fun Siria: on si jẹ alagbara akọni ọkunrin ṣugbọn adẹtẹ̀ ni.
entries.en: Now Naaman, captain of the host of the king of Syria, was a great man with his master, and honourable, because by him the LORD had given deliverance unto Syria: he was also a mighty man in valour, but he was a leper.

entries.yo: Awọn ara Siria si ti jade lọ ni ẹgbẹ́-ẹgbẹ́, nwọn si ti mu ọmọbinrin kekere kan ni igbèkun lati ilẹ Israeli wá; on si duro niwaju obinrin Naamani.
entries.en: And the Syrians had gone out by companies, and had brought away captive out of the land of Israel a little maid; and she waited on Naaman's wife.

entries.yo: On si wi fun iya rẹ̀ pe, oluwa mi iba wà niwaju woli ti mbẹ ni Samaria! nitõtọ on iba wò o sàn kuro ninu ẹ̀tẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And she said unto her mistress, Would God my lord were with the prophet that is in Samaria! for he would recover him of his leprosy.

entries.yo: On si wọle, o si sọ fun oluwa rẹ̀ pe, Bayi bayi li ọmọdebinrin ti o ti ilẹ Israeli wá wi.
entries.en: And one went in, and told his lord, saying, Thus and thus said the maid that is of the land of Israel.

entries.yo: Ọba Siria si wipe, Wá na, lọ, emi o si fi iwe ranṣẹ si ọba Israeli. On si jade lọ, o si mu talenti fàdakà mẹwa lọwọ, ati ẹgbãta iwọ̀n wurà, ati ipãrọ aṣọ mẹwa.
entries.en: And the king of Syria said, Go to, go, and I will send a letter unto the king of Israel. And he departed, and took with him ten talents of silver, and six thousand pieces of gold, and ten changes of raiment.

entries.yo: On si mu iwe na tọ̀ ọba Israeli wá, wipe, Njẹ nisisiyi nigbati iwe yi ba de ọdọ rẹ, kiyesi i, emi rán Naamani iranṣẹ mi si ọ, ki iwọ ki o le wò o sàn kuro ninu ẹ̀tẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he brought the letter to the king of Israel, saying, Now when this letter is come unto thee, behold, I have therewith sent Naaman my servant to thee, that thou mayest recover him of his leprosy.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati ọba Israeli kà iwe na tan, o si fà aṣọ rẹ̀ ya, o si wipe, Emi ha iṣe Ọlọrun, lati pa ati lati sọ di ãyè, ti eleyi fi ranṣẹ si mi lati ṣe awòtan enia kan kuro ninu ẹ̀tẹ rẹ̀? nitorina, ẹ rò o wò, mo bẹ̀ nyin, ki ẹ si wò o bi on ti nwá mi ni ijà.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when the king of Israel had read the letter, that he rent his clothes, and said, Am I God, to kill and to make alive, that this man doth send unto me to recover a man of his leprosy? wherefore consider, I pray you, and see how he seeketh a quarrel against me.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati Eliṣa enia Ọlọrun gbọ́ pe, ọba Israeli fà aṣọ rẹ̀ ya, o si ranṣẹ si ọba wipe, Ẽṣe ti iwọ fi fà aṣọ rẹ ya? jẹ ki o tọ̀ mi wá nisisiyi, on o si mọ̀ pe, woli kan mbẹ ni Israeli.
entries.en: And it was so, when Elisha the man of God had heard that the king of Israel had rent his clothes, that he sent to the king, saying, Wherefore hast thou rent thy clothes? let him come now to me, and he shall know that there is a prophet in Israel.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Naamani de pẹlu awọn ẹṣin rẹ̀ ati pẹlu kẹkẹ́ rẹ̀, o si duro li ẹnu-ọ̀na ile Eliṣa.
entries.en: So Naaman came with his horses and with his chariot, and stood at the door of the house of Elisha.

entries.yo: Eliṣa si ràn iranṣẹ kan si i wipe, Lọ, ki o si wẹ̀ ni Jordani nigba meje, ẹran-ara rẹ yio si tun bọ̀ sipò fun ọ, iwọ o si mọ́.
entries.en: And Elisha sent a messenger unto him, saying, Go and wash in the Jordan seven times, and thy flesh shall come again to thee, and thou shalt be clean.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Naamani binu, o si pada lọ, o si wipe, Kiyesi, i, mo rò ninu mi pe, dajudaju on o jade tọ̀ mi wá, yio si duro, yio si kepè orukọ Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ̀, yio si fi ọwọ rẹ̀ pa ibẹ̀ na, yio si ṣe awòtan ẹ̀tẹ na.
entries.en: But Naaman was wroth, and went away, and said, Behold, I thought, He will surely come out to me, and stand, and call on the name of the LORD his God, and strike his hand over the place, and recover the leper.

entries.yo: Abana ati Farpari, awọn odò Damasku kò ha dara jù gbogbo awọn omi Israeli lọ? emi kì iwẹ̀ ninu wọn ki emi si mọ́? Bẹ̃li o yipada, o si jade lọ ni irúnu.
entries.en: Are not Abana and Pharpar, rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel? may I not wash in them, and be clean? So he turned and went away in a rage.

entries.yo: Awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀ si sunmọ ọ, nwọn si ba a sọ̀rọ, nwọn si wipe, Baba mi, woli iba wi fun ọ pe, ki o ṣe ohun nla kan, iwọ kì ba ti ṣe e bi? melomelo, nigbati o wi fun ọ pe, Wẹ̀, ki o si mọ́?
entries.en: And his servants came near, and spake unto him, and said, My father, if the prophet had bid thee do some great thing, wouldest thou not have done it? how much rather then, when he saith to thee, Wash, and be clean?

entries.yo: Nigbana ni o sọ̀kalẹ, o si tẹ̀ ara rẹ̀ bọ inu Jordani nigba meje, gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ enia Ọlọrun: ẹran-ara rẹ̀ si tún pada bọ̀ gẹgẹ bi ẹran-ara ọmọ kekere, on si mọ́.
entries.en: Then went he down, and dipped himself seven times in Jordan, according to the saying of the man of God: and his flesh came again like unto the flesh of a little child, and he was clean.

entries.yo: O si pada tọ̀ enia Ọlọrun na lọ, on, ati gbogbo ẹgbẹ́ rẹ̀, nwọn si wá, nwọn duro niwaju rẹ̀: on si wipe, wõ, nisisiyi ni mo to mọ̀ pe, Kò si Ọlọrun ni gbogbo aiye, bikòṣe ni Israeli: njẹ nisisiyi, emi bẹ̀ ọ, gbà ẹbun lọwọ iranṣẹ rẹ.
entries.en: And he returned to the man of God, he and all his company, and came, and stood before him: and he said, Behold, now I know that there is no God in all earth, but in Israel: now therefore, I pray thee, take a blessing of thy servant.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn on wipe, Bi Oluwa ti mbẹ, niwaju ẹniti emi duro, emi kì yio gbà nkan. O si rọ̀ ọ ki o gbà, ṣugbọn on kọ̀.
entries.en: But he said, As the LORD liveth, before whom I stand, I will receive none. And he urged him to take it; but he refused.

entries.yo: Naamani si wipe, Njẹ, emi bẹ̀ ọ, a kì yio ha fi erupẹ ẹrù ibàka meji fun iranṣẹ rẹ? nitori lati oni lọ iranṣẹ rẹ kì yio rubọ sisun, bẹ̃ni kì yio rubọ si awọn ọlọrun miran, bikòṣe si Oluwa.
entries.en: And Naaman said, Shall there not then, I pray thee, be given to thy servant two mules' burden of earth? for thy servant will henceforth offer neither burnt offering nor sacrifice unto other gods, but unto the LORD.

entries.yo: Ninu nkan yi ni ki Oluwa ki o darijì iranṣẹ rẹ, nigbati oluwa mi ba lọ si ile Rimmoni lati foribalẹ nibẹ, ti on ba si fi ara tì ọwọ mi, ti emi tẹ̀ ara mi ba ni ile Rimmoni: nigbati mo ba tẹ̀ ara mi ba ni ile Rimmoni, ki Oluwa ki o darijì iranṣẹ rẹ ninu nkan yi.
entries.en: In this thing the LORD pardon thy servant, that when my master goeth into the house of Rimmon to worship there, and he leaneth on my hand, and I bow myself in the house of Rimmon: when I bow down myself in the house of Rimmon, the LORD pardon thy servant in this thing.

entries.yo: On si wi fun u pe, Mã lọ ni alãfia. Bẹ̃ni o si jade lọ jinà diẹ kuro lọdọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he said unto him, Go in peace. So he departed from him a little way.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Gehasi, iranṣẹ Eliṣa enia Ọlọrun na wipe, Kiyesi i, oluwa mi ti dá Naamani ara Siria yi si, niti kò gbà nkan ti o mu wá lọwọ rẹ̀: ṣugbọn, bi Oluwa ti mbẹ, emi o sare bá a, emi o si gbà nkan lọwọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: But Gehazi, the servant of Elisha the man of God, said, Behold, my master hath spared Naaman this Syrian, in not receiving at his hands that which he brought: but, as the LORD liveth, I will run after him, and take somewhat of him.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Gehasi lepa Naamani. Nigbati Naamani ri ti nsare bọ̀ lẹhin on, o sọ̀kalẹ kuro ninu kẹkẹ́ lati pade rẹ̀, o si wipe, Alafia kọ?
entries.en: So Gehazi followed after Naaman. And when Naaman saw him running after him, he lighted down from the chariot to meet him, and said, Is all well?

entries.yo: On si wipe, Alafia ni. Oluwa mi rán mi, wipe, Kiyesi i, nisisiyi ni ọdọmọkunrin meji ninu awọn ọmọ woli ti òke Efraimu wá ọdọ mi; emi bẹ̀ o, fun wọn ni talenti fadakà kan, ati ipàrọ aṣọ meji.
entries.en: And he said, All is well. My master hath sent me, saying, Behold, even now there be come to me from mount Ephraim two young men of the sons of the prophets: give them, I pray thee, a talent of silver, and two changes of garments.

entries.yo: Naamani si wipe, Fi ara balẹ, gbà talenti meji. O si rọ̀ ọ, o si dì talenti fadakà meji sinu apò meji, pẹlu ipàrọ aṣọ meji, o si gbé wọn rù ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ̀ meji; nwọn si rù wọn niwaju rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Naaman said, Be content, take two talents. And he urged him, and bound two talents of silver in two bags, with two changes of garments, and laid them upon two of his servants; and they bare them before him.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si de ibi ile ìṣọ, o gbà wọn lọwọ wọn, o si tò wọn sinu ile: o si jọ̀wọ awọn ọkunrin na lọwọ lọ, nwọn si jade lọ.
entries.en: And when he came to the tower, he took them from their hand, and bestowed them in the house: and he let the men go, and they departed.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn on wọ̀ inu ile lọ, o si duro niwaju oluwa rẹ̀. Eliṣa si wi fun u pe, Gehasi, nibo ni iwọ ti mbọ̀? On si wipe, Iranṣẹ rẹ kò lọ ibikibi.
entries.en: But he went in, and stood before his master. And Elisha said unto him, Whence comest thou, Gehazi? And he said, Thy servant went no whither.

entries.yo: On si wi fun u pe, Ọkàn mi kò ha ba ọ lọ, nigbati ọkunrin na fi yipada kuro ninu kẹkẹ́ rẹ̀ lati pade rẹ? Eyi ha iṣe akokò ati gbà fadakà, ati lati gbà aṣọ, ati ọgbà-olifi ati ọgbà-ajara, ati àgutan, ati malu, ati iranṣékunrin ati iranṣẹbinrin?
entries.en: And he said unto him, Went not mine heart with thee, when the man turned again from his chariot to meet thee? Is it a time to receive money, and to receive garments, and oliveyards, and vineyards, and sheep, and oxen, and menservants, and maidservants?

entries.yo: Nitorina ẹ̀tẹ Naamani yio lẹ mọ ọ, ati iru-ọmọ rẹ titi lai. On si jade kuro niwaju rẹ̀, li adẹtẹ̀ ti o funfun bi ojodidì.
entries.en: The leprosy therefore of Naaman shall cleave unto thee, and unto thy seed for ever. And he went out from his presence a leper as white as snow.

entries.yo: AWỌN ọmọ awọn woli wi fun Eliṣa pe, Sa wò o na, ibiti awa gbe njoko niwaju rẹ, o há jù fun wa.
entries.en: And the sons of the prophets said unto Elisha, Behold now, the place where we dwell with thee is too strait for us.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki awa ki o lọ, awa bẹ̀ ọ, si Jordani, ki olukulùku wa ki o mu iti igi kọ̃kan wá, si jẹ ki awa ki o ṣe ibikan, ti awa o ma gbe. On si dahùn wipe, Ẹ mã lọ.
entries.en: Let us go, we pray thee, unto Jordan, and take thence every man a beam, and let us make us a place there, where we may dwell. And he answered, Go ye.

entries.yo: Ẹnikan si wipe, Ki o wu ọ, emi bẹ̀ ọ, lati ba awọn iranṣẹ rẹ lọ. On si dahùn pe, Emi o lọ.
entries.en: And one said, Be content, I pray thee, and go with thy servants. And he answered, I will go.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li o ba wọn lọ. Nigbati nwọn si de Jordani, nwọn ké igi.
entries.en: So he went with them. And when they came to Jordan, they cut down wood.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, bi ẹnikan ti nké iti-igi, ãke yọ sinu omi: o si kigbe, o si wipe, Yẽ! oluwa mi, a tọrọ rẹ̀ ni.
entries.en: But as one was felling a beam, the axe head fell into the water: and he cried, and said, Alas, master! for it was borrowed.

entries.yo: Enia Ọlọrun si wipe, Nibo li o bọ́ si? O si fi ibẹ hàn a. On si ké igi kan, o si sọ́ ọ sinu rẹ̀; irin na si fó soke.
entries.en: And the man of God said, Where fell it? And he shewed him the place. And he cut down a stick, and cast it in thither; and the iron did swim.

entries.yo: Nitorina o wipe, Mu u. On si nà ọwọ rẹ̀, o si mu u.
entries.en: Therefore said he, Take it up to thee. And he put out his hand, and took it.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ọba Siria mba Israeli jagun, o si ba awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀ gbèro wipe, Ni ibi bayibayi ni ibùba mi yio gbe wà.
entries.en: Then the king of Syria warred against Israel, and took counsel with his servants, saying, In such and such a place shall be my camp.

entries.yo: Enia Ọlọrun si ranṣẹ si ọba Israeli wipe Kiye sara, ki iwọ ki o máṣe kọja si ibi bayi; nitori nibẹ ni awọn ara Siria ba si.
entries.en: And the man of God sent unto the king of Israel, saying, Beware that thou pass not such a place; for thither the Syrians are come down.

entries.yo: Ọba Israeli si ranṣẹ si ibẹ na ti enia Ọlọrun ti sọ fun u, ti o si ti kilọ fun u, o si gbà ara rẹ̀ nibẹ, kì iṣe nigbà kan tabi nigba meji.
entries.en: And the king of Israel sent to the place which the man of God told him and warned him of, and saved himself there, not once nor twice.

entries.yo: Nitorina li ọkàn ọba Siria bajẹ gidigidi nitori nkan yi: o si pè awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀, o si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹnyin kì yio ha fihan mi, tani ninu wa ti o nṣe ti ọba Israeli?
entries.en: Therefore the heart of the king of Syria was sore troubled for this thing; and he called his servants, and said unto them, Will ye not shew me which of us is for the king of Israel?

entries.yo: Ọkan ninu awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀ si wipe, Kò si ẹnikan, oluwa mi, ọba; bikoṣe Eliṣa, woli ti mbẹ ni Israeli, ni nsọ fun ọba Israeli gbogbo ọ̀rọ ti iwọ nsọ ninu iyẹ̀wu rẹ.
entries.en: And one of his servants said, None, my lord, O king: but Elisha, the prophet that is in Israel, telleth the king of Israel the words that thou speakest in thy bedchamber.

entries.yo: On si wipe, Ẹ lọ iwò ibi ti on gbe wà, ki emi o le ranṣẹ lọ mu u wá. A si sọ fun u, wipe, Wò o, o wà ni Dotani.
entries.en: And he said, Go and spy where he is, that I may send and fetch him. And it was told him, saying, Behold, he is in Dothan.

entries.yo: Nitorina li o ṣe rán awọn ẹṣin ati kẹkẹ́ ati ogun nla sibẹ: nwọn si de li oru, nwọn si yi ilu na ka.
entries.en: Therefore sent he thither horses, and chariots, and a great host: and they came by night, and compassed the city about.

entries.yo: Nigbati iranṣẹ enia Ọlọrun na si dide ni kùtukutu ti o si jade lọ, wõ, ogun yi ilu na ka, ati ẹṣin ati kẹkẹ́. Iranṣẹ rẹ̀ si wi fun u pe, Yẽ! baba mi, awa o ti ṣe?
entries.en: And when the servant of the man of God was risen early, and gone forth, behold, an host compassed the city both with horses and chariots. And his servant said unto him, Alas, my master! how shall we do?

entries.yo: On si dahùn wipe, Má bẹ̀ru: nitori awọn ti o wà pẹlu wa, jù awọn ti o wà pẹlu wọn lọ.
entries.en: And he answered, Fear not: for they that be with us are more than they that be with them.

entries.yo: Eliṣa si gbadura, o si wipe, Oluwa, emi bẹ̀ ọ, là a li oju, ki o lè riran. Oluwa si là oju ọdọmọkunrin na; on si riran: si wò o, òke na kún fun ẹṣin ati kẹkẹ́-iná yi Eliṣa ka.
entries.en: And Elisha prayed, and said, LORD, I pray thee, open his eyes, that he may see. And the LORD opened the eyes of the young man; and he saw: and, behold, the mountain was full of horses and chariots of fire round about Elisha.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si sọ̀kalẹ tọ̀ ọ wá, Eliṣa gbadura si Oluwa, o si wipe, Emi bẹ̀ ọ, bù ifọju lù awọn enia yi. On si bù ifọju lù wọn gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ Eliṣa.
entries.en: And when they came down to him, Elisha prayed unto the LORD, and said, Smite this people, I pray thee, with blindness. And he smote them with blindness according to the word of Elisha.

entries.yo: Eliṣa si wi fun wọn pe, Eyi kì iṣe ọ̀na, bẹ̃ni eyi kì iṣe ilu na: ẹ ma tọ̀ mi lẹhin, emi o si mu nyin wá ọdọ ọkunrin ti ẹnyin nwá. O si ṣe amọ̀na wọn lọ si Samaria.
entries.en: And Elisha said unto them, This is not the way, neither is this the city: follow me, and I will bring you to the man whom ye seek. But he led them to Samaria.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati nwọn de Samaria ni Eliṣa wipe, Oluwa la oju awọn enia wọnyi, ki nwọn ki o lè riran. Oluwa si là oju wọn; nwọn si riran; si kiyesi i, nwọn mbẹ li ãrin Samaria.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when they were come into Samaria, that Elisha said, LORD, open the eyes of these men, that they may see. And the LORD opened their eyes, and they saw; and, behold, they were in the midst of Samaria.

entries.yo: Ọba Israeli si wi fun Eliṣa, nigbati o ri wọn pe, Baba mi, ki emi ki o mã pa wọn bi? ki emi ki o mã pa wọn bi?
entries.en: And the king of Israel said unto Elisha, when he saw them, My father, shall I smite them? shall I smite them?

entries.yo: On si dahùn pe, Iwọ kò gbọdọ pa wọn: iwọ jẹ pa awọn ti iwọ fi idà rẹ ati ọrun rẹ kó ni igbèkun? Gbe onjẹ ati omi kalẹ niwaju wọn, ki nwọn ki o jẹ, ki nwọn ki o si mu, ki nwọn ki o si tọ̀ oluwa wọn lọ.
entries.en: And he answered, Thou shalt not smite them: wouldest thou smite those whom thou hast taken captive with thy sword and with thy bow? set bread and water before them, that they may eat and drink, and go to their master.

entries.yo: On si pèse ọ̀pọlọpọ onjẹ fun wọn; nigbati nwọn si ti jẹ, ti nwọn si ti mu tan, o rán wọn lọ, nwọn si tọ̀ oluwa wọn lọ. Bẹ̃ni ẹgbẹ́ ogun Siria kò tun wá si ilẹ Israeli mọ.
entries.en: And he prepared great provision for them: and when they had eaten and drunk, he sent them away, and they went to their master. So the bands of Syria came no more into the land of Israel.

entries.yo: O si ṣe lẹhìn eyi, ni Benhadadi ọba Siria ko gbogbo ogun rẹ̀ jọ, nwọn si gòke, nwọn si dó tì Samaria.
entries.en: And it came to pass after this, that Ben-hadad king of Syria gathered all his host, and went up, and besieged Samaria.

entries.yo: Iyàn nla kan si mu ni Samaria: si kiyesi i, nwọn dó tì i, tobẹ̃ ti a si fi ntà ori kẹtẹkẹtẹ kan ni ọgọrun iwọ̀n fadakà, ati idamẹrin oṣuwọn kabu imi ẹiyẹle, ni iwọ̀n fàdakà marun.
entries.en: And there was a great famine in Samaria: and, behold, they besieged it, until an ass's head was sold for fourscore pieces of silver, and the fourth part of a cab of dove's dung for five pieces of silver.

entries.yo: O si ṣe ti ọba Israeli nkọja lọ lori odi, obinrin kan sọkún tọ̀ ọ wá wipe, Gbà mi, oluwa mi, ọba!
entries.en: And as the king of Israel was passing by upon the wall, there cried a woman unto him, saying, Help, my lord, O king.

entries.yo: On si wipe, Bi Oluwa kò ba gbà ọ, nibo li emi o gbe ti gbà ọ? Lati inu ilẹ-ipakà, tabi lati inu ibi ifunti?
entries.en: And he said, If the LORD do not help thee, whence shall I help thee? out of the barnfloor, or out of the winepress?

entries.yo: Ọba si wi fun u pe, Ẽṣe ọ? On si dahùn wipe, Obinrin yi wi fun mi pe, Mu ọmọkunrin rẹ wá, ki awa ki o le jẹ ẹ loni, awa o si jẹ ọmọ ti emi li ọla.
entries.en: And the king said unto her, What aileth thee? And she answered, This woman said unto me, Give thy son, that we may eat him to day, and we will eat my son to morrow.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni awa sè ọmọ mi, awa si jẹ ẹ́: emi si wi fun u ni ijọ keji pe, Mu ọmọ rẹ wá ki awa ki o jẹ́ ẹ; on si ti fi ọmọ rẹ̀ pamọ́.
entries.en: So we boiled my son, and did eat him: and I said unto her on the next day, Give thy son, that we may eat him: and she hath hid her son.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati ọba gbọ́ ọ̀rọ obinrin na, o fà aṣọ rẹ̀ ya; o si kọja lọ lori odi, awọn enia si wò, si kiyesi i, o ni aṣọ-ọfọ̀ labẹ aṣọ rẹ̀ li ara rẹ̀.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when the king heard the words of the woman, that he rent his clothes; and he passed by upon the wall, and the people looked, and, behold, he had sackcloth within upon his flesh.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni o wipe, Ki Ọlọrun ki o ṣe bayi ati jù bẹ̃ lọ si mi, bi ori Eliṣa ọmọ Ṣafati yio duro li ọrùn rẹ̀ li oni.
entries.en: Then he said, God do so and more also to me, if the head of Elisha the son of Shaphat shall stand on him this day.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Eliṣa joko ninu ile rẹ̀, ati awọn àgbagba joko pẹlu rẹ̀; ọba si rán ọkunrin kan ṣãju rẹ̀ lọ: ṣugbọn ki iranṣẹ na ki o to dé ọdọ rẹ̀, on wi fun awọn àgbagba pe, Ẹ wò bi ọmọ apania yi ti ranṣẹ lati mu ori mi kuro? ẹ wò, nigbati iranṣẹ na ba de, ẹ tì ilẹ̀kun, ki ẹ si dì i mu ṣinṣin li ẹnu-ọ̀na: iro-ẹsẹ̀ oluwa rẹ̀ kò ha wà lẹhin rẹ̀?
entries.en: But Elisha sat in his house, and the elders sat with him; and the king sent a man from before him: but ere the messenger came to him, he said to the elders, See ye how this son of a murderer hath sent to take away mine head? look, when the messenger cometh, shut the door, and hold him fast at the door: is not the sound of his master's feet behind him?

entries.yo: Bi on ti mba wọn sọ̀rọ lọwọ, kiyesi i, iranṣẹ na sọ̀kalẹ tọ̀ ọ wá: on si wipe, Wò o, lati ọwọ Oluwa ni ibi yi ti wá, kili emi o ha duro dè Oluwa mọ si?
entries.en: And while he yet talked with them, behold, the messenger came down unto him: and he said, Behold, this evil is of the LORD; what should I wait for the LORD any longer?

entries.yo: NIGBANA ni Eliṣa wipe, Ẹ gbọ́ ọ̀rọ Oluwa: Bayi li Oluwa wi, Ni iwòyi ọla li a o ta oṣùwọn iyẹ̀fun kikuna kan ni ṣekeli kan ni ẹnu bode Samaria.
entries.en: Then Elisha said, Hear ye the word of the LORD; Thus saith the LORD, To morrow about this time shall a measure of fine flour be sold for a shekel, and two measures of barley for a shekel, in the gate of Samaria.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ijòye kan li ọwọ ẹniti ọba nfi ara tì dá enia Ọlọrun li ohùn, o si wipe, Kiyesi i, bi Oluwa tilẹ sé ferese li ọrun, nkan yi ha le ri bẹ̃? On si wipe, Kiyesi i, iwọ o fi oju rẹ ri i, ṣugbọn iwọ kì yio jẹ ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: Then a lord on whose hand the king leaned answered the man of God, and said, Behold, if the LORD would make windows in heaven, might this thing be? And he said, Behold, thou shalt see it with thine eyes, but shalt not eat thereof.

entries.yo: Adẹtẹ̀ mẹrin kan si wà ni atiwọ̀ bodè; nwọn si wi fun ara wọn pe, Ẽṣe ti awa fi joko nihinyi titi awa o fi kú?
entries.en: And there were four leprous men at the entering in of the gate: and they said one to another, Why sit we here until we die?

entries.yo: Bi awa ba wipe, Awa o wọ̀ ilu lọ, iyàn si mbẹ ni ilu, awa o si kú nibẹ: bi awa ba si joko jẹ nihinyi, awa o kú pẹlu. Njẹ nisisiyi ẹ wá, ẹ jẹ ki awa ki o ṣubu si ọwọ ogun awọn ara Siria: bi nwọn ba dá wa si, awa o yè: bi nwọn ba si pa wa, awa o kú na ni.
entries.en: If we say, We will enter into the city, then the famine is in the city, and we shall die there: and if we sit still here, we die also. Now therefore come, and let us fall unto the host of the Syrians: if they save us alive, we shall live; and if they kill us, we shall but die.

entries.yo: Nwọn si dide li afẹ̀mọjumọ lati lọ si ibùdo awọn ara Siria: nigbati nwọn si de apa ti o kangun ibùdo Siria, kiyesi i, kò si ọkunrin kan nibẹ.
entries.en: And they rose up in the twilight, to go unto the camp of the Syrians: and when they were come to the uttermost part of the camp of Syria, behold, there was no man there.

entries.yo: Nitori ti Oluwa ṣe ki ogun awọn ara Siria ki o gbọ́ ariwo kẹkẹ́, ati ariwo ẹṣin, ariwo ogun nla: nwọn si wi fun ara wọn pe, Kiyesi i, ọba Israeli ti bẹ̀ ogun awọn ọba Hitti, ati awọn ọba Egipti si wa, lati wá bò wa mọlẹ.
entries.en: For the Lord had made the host of the Syrians to hear a noise of chariots, and a noise of horses, even the noise of a great host: and they said one to another, Lo, the king of Israel hath hired against us the kings of the Hittites, and the kings of the Egyptians, to come upon us.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni nwọn dide, nwọn si salọ ni afẹ̀mọjumọ, nwọn si fi agọ wọn silẹ, ati ẹṣin wọn, ati kẹtẹkẹtẹ wọn, ani, ibùdo wọn gẹgẹ bi o ti wà, nwọn si salọ fun ẹmi wọn.
entries.en: Wherefore they arose and fled in the twilight, and left their tents, and their horses, and their asses, even the camp as it was, and fled for their life.

entries.yo: Nigbati adẹtẹ̀ wọnyi de apa ikangun bùdo, nwọn wọ inu agọ kan lọ, nwọn jẹ, nwọn si mu, nwọn sì kó fadakà ati wura ati agbáda lati ibẹ lọ, nwọn si lọ, nwọn si pa a mọ́; nwọn si tún pada wá, nwọn si wọ̀ inu agọ miran lọ, nwọn si kó lati ibẹ lọ pẹlu, nwọn si lọ, nwọn si pa a mọ́.
entries.en: And when these lepers came to the uttermost part of the camp, they went into one tent, and did eat and drink, and carried thence silver, and gold, and raiment, and went and hid it; and came again, and entered into another tent, and carried thence also, and went and hid it.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni nwọn wi fun ara wọn pe, Awa kò ṣe rere: oni yi, ọjọ ihinrere ni, awa si dakẹ: bi awa ba duro titi di afẹmọjumọ, iyà yio jẹ wa: njẹ nisisiyi ẹ wá, ẹ jẹ ki a si lọ isọ fun awọn ara ile ọba.
entries.en: Then they said one to another, We do not well: this day is a day of good tidings, and we hold our peace: if we tarry till the morning light, some mischief will come upon us: now therefore come, that we may go and tell the king's household.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni nwọn wá, nwọn si ke si awọn onibodè ilu; nwọn si wi fun wọn pe, Awa de bùdo awọn ara Siria, si kiyesi i, kò si ọkunrin kan nibẹ, bẹ̃ni kò si ohùn enia kan, bikòṣe ẹṣin ti a so, ati kẹtẹkẹtẹ ti a so, ati agọ bi nwọn ti wà.
entries.en: So they came and called unto the porter of the city: and they told them, saying, We came to the camp of the Syrians, and, behold, there was no man there, neither voice of man, but horses tied, and asses tied, and the tents as they were.

entries.yo: Ẹnikan si pè awọn onibodè; nwọn si sọ ninu ile ọba.
entries.en: And he called the porters; and they told it to the king's house within.

entries.yo: Ọba si dide li oru, o si wi fun awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀ pe, Emi o fi hàn nyin nisisiyi eyiti awọn ara Siria ti ṣe si wa. Nwọn mọ̀ pe, ebi npa wa; nitorina nwọn jade lọ ni bùdo lati fi ara wọn pamọ́ ni igbẹ wipe, Nigbati nwọn ba jade ni ilu, awa o mu wọn lãyè, awa o si wọ̀ inu ilu lọ.
entries.en: And the king arose in the night, and said unto his servants, I will now shew you what the Syrians have done to us.
