entries.en: In the seventeenth year of Pekah the son of Remaliah Ahaz the son of Jotham king of Judah began to reign.

entries.yo: Ẹni ogún ọdun ni Ahasi nigbati o bẹ̀rẹ si ijọba, o si jọba ọdun mẹrindilogun ni Jerusalemu, kò si ṣe eyiti o tọ́ li oju Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ̀, gẹgẹ bi Dafidi baba rẹ̀.
entries.en: Twenty years old was Ahaz when he began to reign, and reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem, and did not that which was right in the sight of the LORD his God, like David his father.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn o rìn li ọ̀na awọn ọba Israeli, nitõtọ, o si mu ki ọmọ rẹ̀ ki o kọja lãrin iná pẹlu, gẹgẹ bi iṣe irira awọn keferi, ti Oluwa le jade niwaju awọn ọmọ Israeli.
entries.en: But he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, yea, and made his son to pass through the fire, according to the abominations of the heathen, whom the LORD cast out from before the children of Israel.

entries.yo: O si rubọ, o si sun turari ni ibi giga wọnni, ati lori awọn òke kekeke, ati labẹ gbogbo igi tutu.
entries.en: And he sacrificed and burnt incense in the high places, and on the hills, and under every green tree.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Resini ọba Siria ati Peka ọmọ Remaliah ọba Israeli gòke wá si Jerusalemu lati jagun: nwọn si do tì Ahasi, ṣugbọn nwọn kò le bori rẹ̀.
entries.en: Then Rezin king of Syria and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel came up to Jerusalem to war: and they besieged Ahaz, but could not overcome him.

entries.yo: Li akokò na, Resini ọba Siria gbà Elati pada fun Siria, o si lé awọn enia Juda kuro ni Elati: awọn ara Siria si wá si Elati, nwọn si ngbe ibẹ titi di oni yi.
entries.en: At that time Rezin king of Syria recovered Elath to Syria, and drave the Jews from Elath: and the Syrians came to Elath, and dwelt there unto this day.

entries.yo: Ahasi si rán onṣẹ si ọdọ Tiglat-pileseri ọba Assiria wipe, Iranṣẹ rẹ li emi, ati ọmọ rẹ; gòke wá, ki o si gbà mi lọwọ ọba Siria, ati lọwọ ọba Israeli, ti o dide si mi.
entries.en: So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria, saying, I am thy servant and thy son: come up, and save me out of the hand of the king of Syria, and out of the hand of the king of Israel, which rise up against me.

entries.yo: Ahasi si mu fadakà ati wura ti a ri ni ile Oluwa, ati ninu iṣura ile ọba, o si rán a li ọrẹ si ọba Assiria.
entries.en: And Ahaz took the silver and gold that was found in the house of the LORD, and in the treasures of the king's house, and sent it for a present to the king of Assyria.

entries.yo: Ọba Assiria si gbọ́ tirẹ̀: nitoriti ọba Assiria gòke wá si Damasku, o si kó o, o si mu u ni igbèkun lọ si Kiri, o si pa Resini.
entries.en: And the king of Assyria hearkened unto him: for the king of Assyria went up against Damascus, and took it, and carried the people of it captive to Kir, and slew Rezin.

entries.yo: Ahasi ọba si lọ si Damasku lati pade Tiglat-pileseri, ọba Assiria, o si ri pẹpẹ kan ti o wà ni Damasku: Ahasi ọba si rán awòran pẹpẹ na, ati apẹrẹ rẹ̀ si Urijah alufa, gẹgẹ bi gbogbo iṣẹ ọnà rẹ̀.
entries.en: And king Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria, and saw an altar that was at Damascus: and king Ahaz sent to Urijah the priest the fashion of the altar, and the pattern of it, according to all the workmanship thereof.

entries.yo: Urijah alufa si ṣe pẹpẹ kan gẹgẹ bi gbogbo eyiti Ahasi ọba fi ranṣẹ si i lati Damasku wá; bẹ̃ni Urijah alufa ṣe e de atibọ̀ Ahasi ọba lati Damasku wá.
entries.en: And Urijah the priest built an altar according to all that king Ahaz had sent from Damascus: so Urijah the priest made it against king Ahaz came from Damascus.

entries.yo: Nigbati ọba si ti Damasku de, ọba si ri pẹpẹ na: ọba si sunmọ pẹpẹ na, o si rubọ lori rẹ̀.
entries.en: And when the king was come from Damascus, the king saw the altar: and the king approached to the altar, and offered thereon.

entries.yo: O si sun ẹbọ ọrẹ-sisun rẹ̀ ati ọrẹ-jijẹ rẹ̀, o si ta ohun-mimu rẹ̀ silẹ, o si wọ́n ẹ̀jẹ ọrẹ-alafia rẹ̀ si ara pẹpẹ na.
entries.en: and he burnt his burnt offering and his meat offering, and poured his drink offering, and sprinkled the blood of his peace offerings, upon the altar.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn o mu pẹpẹ idẹ ti o wà niwaju Oluwa kuro lati iwaju ile na, lati agbedemeji pẹpẹ na, ati ile Oluwa, o si fi i si apa ariwa pẹpẹ na.
entries.en: And he brought also the brasen altar, which was before the LORD, from the forefront of the house, from between the altar and the house of the LORD, and put it on the north side of the altar.

entries.yo: Ahasi ọba si paṣẹ fun Urijah alufa, wipe, Lori pẹpẹ nla ni ki o mã sun ọrẹ-sisun orowurọ̀ ati ọrẹ-jijẹ alalẹ, ati ẹbọ-sisun ti ọba, ati ọrẹ-jijẹ rẹ̀, pẹlu ọrẹ-sisun ti gbogbo awọn enia ilẹ na, ati ọrẹ-jijẹ wọn, ati ọrẹ ohun-mimu wọn; ki o si wọ́n gbogbo ẹ̀jẹ ọrẹ-sisun na lori rẹ̀, ati gbogbo ẹ̀jẹ ẹbọ miran: ṣugbọn niti pẹpẹ idẹ na emi o mã gbero ohun ti emi o fi i ṣe.
entries.en: And king Ahaz commanded Urijah the priest, saying, Upon the great altar burn the morning burnt offering, and the evening meat offering, and the king's burnt sacrifice, and his meat offering, with the burnt offering of all the people of the land, and their meat offering, and their drink offerings; and sprinkle upon it all the blood of the burnt offering, and all the blood of the sacrifice: and the brasen altar shall be for me to inquire by.

entries.yo: Bayi ni Urijah alufa ṣe, gẹgẹ bi gbogbo eyiti Ahasi ọba pa li aṣẹ.
entries.en: Thus did Urijah the priest, according to all that king Ahaz commanded.

entries.yo: Ahasi ọba si ké alafo ọnà arin awọn ijoko na, o si ṣi agbada na kuro lara wọn; o si gbé agbada-nla na kalẹ kuro lara awọn malu idẹ ti mbẹ labẹ rẹ̀, o si gbé e kà ilẹ ti a fi okuta tẹ́.
entries.en: And king Ahaz cut off the borders of the bases, and removed the laver from off them; and took down the sea from off the brasen oxen that were under it, and put it upon a pavement of stones.

entries.yo: Ibi ãbò fun ọjọ isimi ti a kọ́ ninu ile na, ati ọ̀na ijade si ode ti ọba, ni o yipada kuro ni ile Oluwa nitori ọba Assiria.
entries.en: And the covert for the sabbath that they had built in the house, and the king's entry without, turned he from the house of the LORD for the king of Assyria.

entries.yo: Ati iyokù iṣe Ahasi ti o ṣe, a kò ha kọ wọn sinu iwe ọ̀rọ ọjọ awọn ọba Juda?
entries.en: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaz which he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

entries.yo: Ahasi si sùn pẹlu awọn baba rẹ̀, a si sin i pẹlu awọn baba rẹ̀ ni ilu Dafidi: Hesekiah ọmọ rẹ̀ si jọba ni ipò rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Ahaz slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David: and Hezekiah his son reigned in his stead.

entries.yo: LI ọdun kejila Ahasi ọba Juda ni Hoṣea ọmọ Ela bẹ̀rẹ si ijọba ni Samaria, lori Israeli li ọdun mẹsan.
entries.en: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah began Hoshea the son of Elah to reign in Samaria over Israel nine years.

entries.yo: O si ṣe eyiti o buru li oju Oluwa, ṣugbọn kì iṣe bi awọn ọba Israeli ti o ti wà ṣãju rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, but not as the kings of Israel that were before him.

entries.yo: On ni Ṣalamaneseri ọba Assiria gòke tọ̀ wá; Hoṣea si di iranṣẹ rẹ̀, o si ta a li ọrẹ.
entries.en: Against him came up Shalmaneser king of Assyria; and Hoshea became his servant, and gave him presents.

entries.yo: Ọba Assiria si ri ọ̀tẹ ninu Hoṣea: nitoriti o ti rán onṣẹ sọdọ So ọba Egipti, kò si mu ọrẹ fun ọba Assiria wá bi iti mã iṣe li ọdọdun; nitorina ni ọba Assiria há a mọ, o si dè e ni ile tubu.
entries.en: And the king of Assyria found conspiracy in Hoshea: for he had sent messengers to So king of Egypt, and brought no present to the king of Assyria, as he had done year by year: therefore the king of Assyria shut him up, and bound him in prison.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ọba Assiria gòke wá si gbogbo ilẹ na, o si gòke lọ si Samaria, o si dotì i li ọdun mẹta.
entries.en: Then the king of Assyria came up throughout all the land, and went up to Samaria, and besieged it three years.

entries.yo: Li ọdun kẹsan Hoṣea, ni ọba Assiria kó Samaria, o si kó Israeli lọ si Assiria, o si fi wọn si Hala ati si Habori, leti odò Gosani, ati si ilu awọn ara Media.
entries.en: In the ninth year of Hoshea the king of Assyria took Samaria, and carried Israel away into Assyria, and placed them in Halah and in Habor by the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nitoriti awọn ọmọ Israeli dẹṣẹ si Oluwa Ọlọrun wọn, ti o ti mu wọn gòke lati ilẹ Egipti wá, kuro labẹ ọwọ Farao ọba Egipti, ti nwọn si mbẹ̀ru ọlọrun miran.
entries.en: For so it was, that the children of Israel had sinned against the LORD their God, which had brought them up out of the land of Egypt, from under the hand of Pharoah king of Egypt, and had feared other gods,

entries.yo: Ti nwọn si nrìn ninu ilana awọn keferi, ti Oluwa ti le jade kuro niwaju awọn ọmọ Israeli, ati ti awọn ọba Israeli, ti nwọn ti ṣe.
entries.en: And walked in the statutes of the heathen, whom the LORD cast out from before the children of Israel, and of the kings of Israel, which they had made.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Israeli si ṣe ohun ikọ̀kọ ti kò tọ́ si Oluwa Ọlọrun wọn, nwọn si kọ́ ibi giga fun ara wọn ni gbogbo ilu wọn, lati ile-iṣọ awọn olùṣọ titi de ilu olodi.
entries.en: And the children of Israel did secretly those things that were not right against the LORD their God, and they built them high places in all their cities, from the tower of the watchmen to the fenced city.

entries.yo: Nwọn si gbé awọn ere kalẹ, nwọn si dá ere oriṣa si lori òke giga gbogbo, ati labẹ igi tutu gbogbo:
entries.en: And they set them up images and groves in every high hill, and under every green tree:

entries.yo: Nibẹ ni nwọn si sun turari ni gbogbo ibi giga wọnni, bi awọn keferi ti Oluwa kó lọ niwaju wọn ti ṣe; nwọn si ṣe ohun buburu lati rú ibinu Oluwa soke.
entries.en: And there they burnt incense in all the high places, as did the heathen whom the LORD carried away before them; and wrought wicked things to provoke the LORD to anger:

entries.yo: Nitoriti nwọn sìn oriṣa wọnni, eyiti Oluwa ti wi fun wọn pe, Ẹnyin kò gbọdọ ṣe nkan yi.
entries.en: For they served idols, whereof the LORD had said unto them, Ye shall not do this thing.

entries.yo: Sibẹ Oluwa jẹri si Israeli, ati si Juda, nipa ọwọ gbogbo awọn woli, ati gbogbo awọn ariran, wipe, Ẹ yipada kuro ninu ọ̀na buburu nyin, ki ẹ si pa ofin mi ati ilana mi mọ́, gẹgẹ bi gbogbo ofin ti mo pa li aṣẹ fun awọn baba nyin, ti mo rán si nyin nipa ọwọ awọn woli iranṣẹ mi.
entries.en: Yet the LORD testified against Israel, and against Judah, by all the prophets, and by all the seers, saying, Turn ye from your evil ways, and keep my commandments and my statutes, according to all the law which I commanded your fathers, and which I sent to you by my servants the prophets.

entries.yo: Sibẹ nwọn kò fẹ igbọ́, ṣugbọn nwọn mu ọrùn wọn le, gẹgẹ bi ọrùn awọn baba wọn, ti kò gbà Oluwa Ọlọrun wọn gbọ́.
entries.en: Notwithstanding they would not hear, but hardened their necks, like to the neck of their fathers, that did not believe in the LORD their God.

entries.yo: Nwọn si kọ̀ ilana rẹ̀, ati majẹmu rẹ̀ silẹ, ti o ba awọn baba wọn dá, ati ẹri rẹ̀ ti o jẹ si wọn: nwọn si ntọ̀ ohun asan lẹhin, nwọn si huwa asan, nwọn si ntọ̀ awọn keferi lẹhin ti o yi wọn ka, niti ẹniti Oluwa ti kilọ fun wọn pe, ki nwọn ki o máṣe ṣe bi awọn.
entries.en: And they rejected his statutes, and his covenant that he made with their fathers, and his testimonies which he testified against them; and they followed vanity, and became vain, and went after the heathen that were round about them, concerning whom the LORD had charged them, that they should not do like them.

entries.yo: Nwọn si kọ̀ gbogbo ofin Oluwa Ọlọrun wọn silẹ, nwọn si ṣe ere didà fun ara wọn, ani, ẹgbọ̀rọ malu meji, nwọn si ṣe ere oriṣa, nwọn si mbọ gbogbo ogun ọrun, nwọn si sìn Baali.
entries.en: And they left all the commandments of the LORD their God, and made them molten images, even two calves, and made a grove, and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served Baal.

entries.yo: Nwọn si mu ki awọn ọmọkunrin wọn ati ọmọbinrin wọn ki o kọja lãrin iná, nwọn si nfọ̀ afọ̀ṣẹ, nwọn si nṣe alupayida, nwọn si tà ara wọn lati ṣe ibi niwaju Oluwa, lati mu u binu.
entries.en: And they caused their sons and their daughters to pass through the fire, and used divination and enchantments, and sold themselves to do evil in the sight of the LORD, to provoke him to anger.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni Oluwa ṣe binu si Israeli gidigidi, o si mu wọn kuro niwaju rẹ̀: ọkan kò kù bikòṣe ẹ̀ya Juda nikanṣoṣo.
entries.en: Therefore the LORD was very angry with Israel, and removed them out of his sight: there was none left but the tribe of Judah only.

entries.yo: Juda pẹlu kò pa aṣẹ Oluwa Ọlọrun wọn mọ́, ṣugbọn nwọn rìn ninu ilana Israeli ti nwọn ṣe.
entries.en: Also Judah kept not the commandments of the LORD their God, but walked in the statutes of Israel which they made.

entries.yo: Oluwa si kọ̀ gbogbo iru-ọmọ Israeli silẹ, o si wahala wọn, o si fi wọn le awọn akoni lọwọ, titi o si fi ta wọn nù kuro niwaju rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the LORD rejected all the seed of Israel, and afflicted them, and delivered them into the hand of spoilers, until he had cast them out of his sight.

entries.yo: Nitori ti o yà Israeli kuro ni idile Dafidi; nwọn si fi Jeroboamu ọmọ Nebati jọba: Jeroboamu si tì Israeli kuro lati má tọ̀ Oluwa lẹhin, o si mu wọn ṣẹ̀ ẹ̀ṣẹ nla.
entries.en: For he rent Israel from the house of David; and they made Jeroboam the son of Nebat king: and Jeroboam drave Israel from following the LORD, and made them sin a great sin.

entries.yo: Nitoriti awọn ọmọ Israeli rìn ninu gbogbo ẹ̀ṣẹ Jeroboamu ti o ṣẹ̀; nwọn kò lọ kuro ninu wọn;
entries.en: For the children of Israel walked in all the sins of Jeroboam which he did; they departed not from them;

entries.yo: Titi Oluwa fi mu Israeli kuro niwaju rẹ̀, bi o ti sọ nipa gbogbo awọn woli iranṣẹ rẹ̀. Bẹ̃li a kó Israeli kuro ni ilẹ wọn lọ si Assiria, titi di oni yi.
entries.en: Until the LORD removed Israel out of his sight, as he had said by all his servants the prophets. So was Israel carried away out of their own land to Assyria unto this day.

entries.yo: Ọba Assiria si kó enia lati Babeli wá, ati lati Kuta, ati lati Afa, ati lati Hamati, ati lati Sefarfaimi, o si fi wọn sinu ilu Samaria wọnni, ni ipò awọn ọmọ Israeli; nwọn si ni Samaria, nwọn si ngbe inu rẹ̀ wọnni.
entries.en: And the king of Assyria brought men from Babylon, and from Cuthah, and from Ava, and from Hamath, and from Sepharvaim, and placed them in the cities of Samaria instead of the children of Israel: and they possessed Samaria, and dwelt in the cities thereof.

entries.yo: O si ṣe li atètekọ-gbé ibẹ wọn, nwọn kò bẹ̀ru Oluwa: nitorina ni Oluwa ṣe rán awọn kiniun sãrin wọn, ti o pa ninu wọn.
entries.en: And so it was at the beginning of their dwelling there, that they feared not the LORD: therefore the LORD sent lions among them, which slew some of them.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni nwọn ṣe sọ fun ọba Assiria wipe, Awọn orilẹ-ède ti iwọ ṣi kuro, ti o si fi sinu ilu Samaria wọnni, kò mọ̀ iṣe Ọ̀lọrun ilẹ na: nitorina li on ṣe rán awọn kiniun sãrin wọn, si kiyesi i, nwọn pa wọn, nitoriti nwọn kò mọ̀ iṣe Ọlọrun ilẹ na.
entries.en: Wherefore they spake to the king of Assyria, saying, The nations which thou hast removed, and placed in the cities of Samaria, know not the manner of the God of the land: therefore he hath sent lions among them, and, behold, they slay them, because they know not the manner of the God of the land.

entries.yo: Nigbana li ọba Assiria paṣẹ, wipe, Ẹ mu ọkan ninu awọn alufa ti ẹnyin ti kó ti ọhún wá lọ sibẹ; ẹ si jẹ ki wọn ki o lọ igbe ibẹ, ki ẹ si jẹ ki o ma kọ́ wọn ni iṣe Ọlọrun ilẹ na.
entries.en: Then the king of Assyria commanded, saying, Carry thither one of the priests whom ye brought from thence; and let them go and dwell there, and let him teach them the manner of the God of the land.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ọkan ninu awọn alufa ti nwọn ti kó ti Samaria lọ, wá, o si joko ni Beteli, o si kọ́ wọn bi nwọn o ti mã bẹ̀ru Oluwa.
entries.en: Then one of the priests whom they had carried away from Samaria came and dwelt in Bethel, and taught them how they should fear the LORD.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn olukuluku orilẹ-ède ṣe oriṣa tirẹ̀, nwọn si fi wọn sinu ile ibi giga wọnni ti awọn ara Samaria ti ṣe, olukuluku orilẹ-ède ninu ilu ti nwọn ngbe.
entries.en: Howbeit every nation made gods of their own, and put them in the houses of the high places which the Samaritans had made, every nation in their cities wherein they dwelt.

entries.yo: Awọn enia Babeli ṣe agọ awọn wundia, ati awọn enia Kuti ṣe oriṣa Nergali, ati awọn enia Hamati ṣe ti Aṣima,
entries.en: And the men of Babylon made Succoth-benoth, and the men of Cuth made Nergal, and the men of Hamath made Ashima,

entries.yo: Ati awọn ara Afa ṣe ti Nibhasi ati ti Tartaki, ati awọn ara Sefarfaimu sun awọn ọmọ wọn ninu iná fun Adrammeleki ati Anammeleki awọn òriṣa Sefarfaimu.
entries.en: And the Avites made Nibhaz and Tartak, and the Sepharvites burnt their children in fire to Adrammelech and Anammelech, the gods of Sepharvaim.

entries.yo: Nwọn bẹ̀ru Oluwa pẹlu, nwọn si ṣe alufa ibi giga wọnni fun ara wọn, ninu awọn enia lasan, ti nrubọ fun wọn ni ile ibi giga wọnni.
entries.en: So they feared the LORD, and made unto themselves of the lowest of them priests of the high places, which sacrificed for them in the houses of the high places.

entries.yo: Nwọn bẹ̀ru Oluwa, nwọn si nsìn oriṣa wọn gẹgẹ bi iṣe awọn orilẹ-ède, ti nwọn kó lati ibẹ lọ.
entries.en: They feared the LORD, and served their own gods, after the manner of the nations whom they carried away from thence.

entries.yo: Titi di oni yi nwọn nṣe bi iṣe wọn atijọ: nwọn kò bẹ̀ru Oluwa, bẹ̃ni nwọn kò ṣe bi idasilẹ wọn, tabi ilàna wọn, tabi ofin ati aṣẹ ti Oluwa pa fun awọn ọmọ Jakobu, ti o sọ ni Israeli;
entries.en: Unto this day they do after the former manners: they fear not the LORD, neither do they after their statutes, or after their ordinances, or after the law and commandment which the LORD commanded the children of Jacob, whom he named Israel;

entries.yo: Awọn ẹniti Oluwa ti ba dá majẹmu, ti o si ti kilọ fun wọn, wipe, Ẹnyin kò gbọdọ bẹ̀ru awọn ọlọrun miran, bẹ̃ni ẹnyin kò gbọdọ tẹ̀ ara nyin ba fun wọn, tabi ki ẹ sìn wọn, tabi ki ẹ rubọ si wọn:
entries.en: With whom the LORD had made a covenant, and charged them saying, Ye shall not fear other gods, nor bow yourselves to them, nor serve them, nor sacrifice to them:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Oluwa ti o mu nyin gòke ti ilẹ Egipti wá, pẹlu agbara nla ati ninà apá, on ni ki ẹ mã bẹ̀ru, on ni ki ẹ si mã tẹriba fun, on ni ki ẹ sì mã rubọ si.
entries.en: But the LORD, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt with great power and a stretched out arm, him shall ye fear, and him shall ye worship, and to him shall ye do sacrifice.

entries.yo: Ati idasilẹ wọnni, ati ilàna wọnni, ati ofin ati aṣẹ ti o ti kọ fun nyin, li ẹnyin o mã kiyesi lati mã ṣe li ọjọ gbogbo; ẹnyin kò si gbọdọ bẹ̀ru awọn ọlọrun miràn.
entries.en: And the statutes, and the ordinances, and the law, and the commandment, which he wrote for you, ye shall observe to do for evermore; and ye shall not fear other gods.

entries.yo: Ati majẹmu ti mo ti ba nyin dá ni ẹnyin kò gbọdọ gbàgbe; bẹ̃ni ẹnyin kò gbọdọ bẹ̀ru awọn ọlọrun miran.
entries.en: And the covenant that I have made with you ye shall not forget; neither shall ye fear other gods.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Oluwa Ọlọrun nyin ni ẹnyin o mã bẹ̀ru; on ni yio si gbà nyin lọwọ awọn ọta nyin gbogbo.
entries.en: But the LORD your God ye shall fear; and he shall deliver you out of the hand of all your enemies.

entries.yo: Nwọn kò si gbọ́, ṣugbọn nwọn ṣe bi iṣe wọn atijọ.
entries.en: Howbeit they did not hearken, but they did after their former manner.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li awọn orilẹ-ède wọnyi bẹ̀ru Oluwa, ṣugbọn nwọn tun sin awọn ere fifin wọn pẹlu; awọn ọmọ wọn, ati awọn ọmọ-ọmọ wọn, bi awọn baba wọn ti ṣe, bẹ̃li awọn na nṣe titi fi di oni yi.
entries.en: So these nations feared the LORD, and served their graven images, both their children, and their children's children: as did their fathers, so do they unto this day.

entries.yo: O si ṣe li ọdun kẹta Hoṣea ọmọ Ela ọba Israeli ni Hesekiah ọmọ Ahasi ọba Juda bẹ̀rẹ si ijọba.
entries.en: Now it came to pass in the third year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel, that Hezekiah the son of Ahaz king of Judah began to reign.

entries.yo: Ẹni ọdun mẹ̃dọgbọ̀n li on nigbati o bẹ̀rẹ si ijọba; o si jọba li ọdun mọkandilọgbọ̀n ni Jerusalemu. Orukọ iya rẹ̀ ni Abi ọmọbinrin Sakariah.
entries.en: Twenty and five years old was he when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem. His mother's name also was Abi, the daughter of Zachariah.

entries.yo: O si ṣe eyiti o tọ́ li oju Oluwa, gẹgẹ bi gbogbo eyiti Dafidi baba rẹ̀ ti ṣe.
entries.en: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that David his father did.

entries.yo: On mu ibi giga wọnni kuro, o si fọ́ awọn ere, o si wó awọn ere oriṣa lulẹ, o si fọ́ ejò idẹ na tútu ti Mose ti ṣe: nitori titi di ọjọ wọnni, awọn ọmọ Israeli nsun turari si i: a si pè e ni Nehuṣtani.
entries.en: He removed the high places, and brake the images, and cut down the groves, and brake in pieces the brasen serpent that Moses had made: for unto those days the children of Israel did burn incense to it: and he called it Nehushtan.

entries.yo: O gbẹkẹle Oluwa Ọlọrun Israeli; ati lẹhin rẹ̀ kò si ẹniti o dabi rẹ̀ ninu gbogbo awọn ọba Juda, bẹ̃ni ṣãju rẹ̀ kò si ẹnikan.
entries.en: He trusted in the LORD God of Israel; so that after him was none like him among all the kings of Judah, nor any that were before him.

entries.yo: Nitoriti o faramọ Oluwa, kò si lọ kuro lẹhin rẹ̀, ṣugbọn o pa ofin rẹ̀ wọnni mọ, ti Oluwa ti pa li aṣẹ fun Mose.
entries.en: For he clave to the LORD, and departed not from following him, but kept his commandments, which the LORD commanded Moses.

entries.yo: Oluwa si wà pẹlu rẹ̀; o si ṣe rere nibikibi ti o ba jade lọ: o si ṣọ̀tẹ si ọba Assiria, kò si sìn i mọ.
entries.en: And the LORD was with him; and he prospered whithersoever he went forth: and he rebelled against the king of Assyria, and served him not.

entries.yo: On kọlù awọn ara Filistia, ani titi de Gasa, ati agbègbe rẹ̀, lati ile iṣọ awọn olùṣọ titi de ilu olodi.
entries.en: He smote the Philistines, even unto Gaza, and the borders thereof, from the tower of the watchmen to the fenced city.

entries.yo: O si ṣe li ọdun kẹrin Hesekiah ọba, ti iṣe ọdun keje Hoṣea ọmọ Ela ọba Israeli, ni Ṣalmaneseri ọba Assiria gòke wá si Samaria, o si dotì i.
entries.en: And it came to pass in the fourth year of king Hezekiah, which was the seventh year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel, that Shalmaneser king of Assyria came up against Samaria, and besieged it.

entries.yo: Lẹhin ọdun mẹta nwọn kó o; ani li ọdun kẹfa Hesekiah, eyini ni ọdun kẹsan Hoṣea ọba Israeli li a kó Samaria.
entries.en: And at the end of three years they took it: even in the sixth year of Hezekiah, that is the ninth year of Hoshea king of Israel, Samaria was taken.

entries.yo: Ọba Assiria si kó Israeli lọ si Assiria, o si fi wọn si Hala ati si Habori leti odò Gosani, ati si ilẹ awọn ara Media wọnni:
entries.en: And the king of Assyria did carry away Israel unto Assyria, and put them in Halah and in Habor by the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes:

entries.yo: Nitoriti nwọn kò gbà ohùn Oluwa Ọlọrun wọn gbọ́, ṣugbọn nwọn dà majẹmu rẹ̀, ati ohun gbogbo ti Mose iranṣẹ Oluwa pa li aṣẹ, nwọn kò si fi eti si wọn, bẹ̃ni nwọn kò si ṣe wọn.
entries.en: Because they obeyed not the voice of the LORD their God, but transgressed his covenant, and all that Moses the servant of the LORD commanded, and would not hear them, nor do them.

entries.yo: Li ọdun kẹrinla Hesekiah ọba, ni Sennakeribu ọba Assiria gòke wá si gbogbo awọn ilu olodi Juda, o si kó wọn.
entries.en: Now in the fourteenth year of king Hezekiah did Sennacherib king of Assyria come up against all the fenced cities of Judah, and took them.

entries.yo: Hesekiah ọba Juda si ranṣẹ si ọba Assiria ni Lakiṣi, wipe, Mo ti ṣẹ̀; padà lẹhin mi: eyiti iwọ ba bù fun mi li emi o rù. Ọba Assiria si bù ọ̃dunrun talenti fadakà, ati ọgbọ̀n talenti wura fun Hesekiah ọba Juda.
entries.en: And Hezekiah king of Judah sent to the king of Assyria to Lachish, saying, I have offended; return from me: that which thou puttest on me will I bear. And the king of Assyria appointed unto Hezekiah king of Judah three hundred talents of silver and thirty talents of gold.

entries.yo: Hesekiah si fun u ni gbogbo fadakà ti a ri ni ile Oluwa, ati ninu iṣura ile ọba.
entries.en: And Hezekiah gave him all the silver that was found in the house of the LORD, and in the treasures of the king's house.

entries.yo: Li akòko na ni Hesekiah ké gbogbo wura kuro lara awọn ilẹ̀kun ile Oluwa, ati kuro lara ọwọ̀n wọnni ti Hesekiah ọba Juda ti fi wura bò, o si fi wọn fun ọba Assiria.
entries.en: At that time did Hezekiah cut off the gold from the doors of the temple of the LORD, and from the pillars which Hezekiah king of Judah had overlaid, and gave it to the king of Assyria.

entries.yo: Ọba Assiria si rán Tartani, ati Rabsarisi, ati Rabṣake, lati Lakiṣi lọ si ọdọ Hesekiah ọba pẹlu ogun nla si Jerusalemu. Nwọn si gòke wá, nwọn si de Jerusalemu. Nwọn si gòke wá, nwọn de, nwọn si duro leti idari omi abàta òke, ti mbẹ li eti òpopo pápa afọṣọ.
entries.en: And the king of Assyria sent Tartan and Rabsaris and Rab-shakeh from Lachish to king Hezekiah with a great host against Jerusalem. And they went up and came to Jerusalem. And when they were come up, they came and stood by the conduit of the upper pool, which is in the highway of the fuller's field.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si ké si ọba, Eliakimu ọmọ Hilkiah ti iṣe olori ile na si jade tọ̀ wọn wá, ati Ṣebna akọwe, ati Joa ọmọ Asafu akọwe-iranti.
entries.en: And when they had called to the king, there came out to them Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, which was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder.

entries.yo: Rabṣake si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ sọ fun Hesekiah nisisiyi pe, Bayi ni ọba nla, ọba Assiria wi pe, Kini igbẹkẹle yi ti iwọ gbẹkẹle?
entries.en: And Rab-shakeh said unto them, Speak ye now to Hezekiah, Thus saith the great king, the king of Assyria, What confidence is this wherein thou trustest?

entries.yo: Iwọ wipe (ṣugbọn ọ̀rọ ète lasan ni nwọn), emi ni ìmọ ati agbara lati jagun. Njẹ tani iwọ gbẹkẹle, ti iwọ fi ṣọ̀tẹ si mi?
entries.en: Thou sayest, (but they are but vain words,) I have counsel and strength for the war. Now on whom dost thou trust, that thou rebellest against me?

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, nisisiyi, iwọ gbẹkẹle ọ̀pa iyè fifọ yi, ani le Egipti, lara ẹniti bi ẹnikan ba fi ara tì, yio wọ̀ ọ li ọwọ lọ, yio si gun u: bẹ̃ni Farao ọba Egipti ri fun gbogbo awọn ti o gbẹkẹ wọn le e.
entries.en: Now, behold, thou trustest upon the staff of this bruised reed, even upon Egypt, on which if a man lean, it will go into his hand, and pierce it: so is Pharoah king of Egypt unto all that trust on him.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi ẹnyin ba wi fun mi pe, Awa gbẹkẹle Oluwa Ọlọrun wa: on ha kọ li ẹniti Hesekiah ti mu awọn ibi giga rẹ̀, ati awọn pẹpẹ rẹ̀ kuro, ti o si wi fun Juda ati Jerusalemu pe, Ẹnyin o ma sìn niwaju pẹpẹ yi ni Jerusalemu?
entries.en: But if ye say unto me, We trust in the LORD our God: is not that he, whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah hath taken away, and hath said to Judah and Jerusalem, Ye shall worship before this altar in Jerusalem?

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, Mo bẹ̀ ọ, ba oluwa mi ọba Assiria ṣe adehun, emi o si fun ọ li ẹgbã ẹṣin, bi iwọ nipa tirẹ ba lè ni enia to lati gùn wọn.
entries.en: Now therefore, I pray thee, give pledges to my lord the king of Assyria, and I will deliver thee two thousand horses, if thou be able on thy part to set riders upon them.

entries.yo: Njẹ bawo ni iwọ o ha ti ṣe le yi oju balogun kan ti o kere jùlọ pada ninu awọn iranṣẹ oluwa mi, ti iwọ si gbẹkẹ rẹ le Egipti fun kẹkẹ́ ati fun ẹlẹṣin?
entries.en: How then wilt thou turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master's servants, and put thy trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?

entries.yo: Emi ha dẹhin Oluwa gòke wá nisisiyi si ibi yi lati pa a run? Oluwa wi fun mi pe, Gòke lọ si ilẹ yi, ki o si pa a run.
entries.en: Am I now come up without the LORD against this place to destroy it? The LORD said to me, Go up against this land, and destroy it.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Eliakimu ọmọ Hilkiah, ati Ṣebna, ati Joa wi fun Rabṣake pe, Emi bẹ̀ ọ, ba awọn iranṣẹ rẹ sọ̀rọ li ède Siria; nitoriti awa gbọ́ ọ: ki o má si ṣe ba wa sọ̀rọ li ède Juda li leti awọn enia ti mbẹ lori odi.
entries.en: Then said Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, and Shebna, and Joah, unto Rab-shakeh, Speak, I pray thee, to thy servants in the Syrian language; for we understand it: and talk not with us in the Jews' language in the ears of the people that are on the wall.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Rabṣake sọ fun wọn pe, Oluwa mi ha rán mi si oluwa rẹ, ati si ọ, lati sọ ọ̀rọ wọnyi bi? kò ṣepe awọn ọkunrin ti o joko lori odi li o rán mi si, ki nwọn ki o le jẹ igbẹ́ ara wọn, ati ki nwọn ki o le mu ìtọ ara wọn pẹlu nyin?
entries.en: But Rab-shakeh said unto them, Hath my master sent me to thy master, and to thee, to speak these words? hath he not sent me to the men which sit on the wall, that they may eat their own dung, and drink their own piss with you.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Rabṣake duro, o si kigbe li ohùn rara li ède Juda o si sọ wipe, Ẹ gbọ́ ọ̀rọ ọba nla, ọba Assiria:
entries.en: Then Rab-shakeh stood and cried with a loud voice in the Jews' language, and spake, saying, Hear the word of the great king, the king of Assyria:

entries.yo: Bayi li ọba wi pe, Ẹ máṣe jẹ ki Hesekiah tàn nyin jẹ: nitori kì yio le gbà nyin kuro lọwọ rẹ̀:
entries.en: Thus saith the king, Let not Hezekiah deceive you: for he shall not be able to deliver you out of his hand:

entries.yo: Ẹ máṣe jẹ ki Hesekiah mu nyin gbẹkẹle Oluwa, wipe, Ni gbigbà Oluwa yio gbà wa, a kì yio si fi ilu yi le ọba Assiria lọwọ.
entries.en: Neither let Hezekiah make you trust in the LORD, saying, The LORD will surely deliver us, and this city shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.

entries.yo: Ẹ máṣe fi eti si ti Hesekiah: nitori bayi li ọba Assiria wi pe, Fi ẹbùn wá oju rere mi, ki ẹ si jade tọ̀ mi wá, ki olukuluku nyin ki o si mã jẹ ninu àjarà rẹ̀, ati olukuluku ninu igi ọ̀pọtọ rẹ̀, ki olukuluku nyin ki o si mu omi ninu àmu rẹ̀:
entries.en: Hearken not to Hezekiah: for thus saith the king of Assyria, Make an agreement with me by a present, and come out to me, and then eat ye every man of his own vine, and every one of his fig tree, and drink ye every one the waters of his cistern:

entries.yo: Titi emi o fi wá mu nyin kuro lọ si ilẹ bi ti ẹnyin tikara nyin, si ilẹ ọkà ati ọti-waini, ilẹ onjẹ ati ọgbà ajara, ilẹ ororo olifi ati ti oyin, ki ẹnyin ki o le yè, ki ẹ má ba kú: ki ẹ má si fi eti si ti Hesekiah, nigbati o ba ntàn nyin wipe, Oluwa yio gbà wa.
entries.en: Until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of corn and wine, a land of bread and vineyards, a land of oil olive and of honey, that ye may live, and not die: and hearken not unto Hezekiah, when he persuadeth you, saying, The LORD will deliver us.

entries.yo: Ọkan ninu awọn oriṣa awọn orilẹ-ède ti igbà ilẹ rẹ̀ kuro lọwọ ọba Assiria ri bi?
entries.en: Hath any of the gods of the nations delivered at all his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria?

entries.yo: Nibo li awọn oriṣa Hamati, ati Arpadi gbe wà? Nibo li awọn oriṣa Sefarfaimu, Hena, ati Ifa gbe wà? Nwọn ha gbà Samaria kuro lọwọ mi bi?
entries.en: Where are the gods of Hamath, and of Arpad? where are the gods of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivah? have they delivered Samaria out of mine hand?

entries.yo: Tani ninu gbogbo awọn oriṣa ilẹ wọnni ti o gbà ilẹ wọn kuro lọwọ mi, ti Oluwa yio fi gbà Jerusalemu kuro lọwọ mi?
entries.en: Who are they among all the gods of the countries, that have delivered their country out of mine hand, that the LORD should deliver Jerusalem out of mine hand?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn enia pa ẹnu wọn mọ́, nwọn kò si da a li ohun ọ̀rọ kan: nitori aṣẹ ọba ni, pe, Ẹ máṣe da a li ohùn.
entries.en: But the people held their peace, and answered him not a word: for the king's commandment was, saying, Answer him not.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Eliakimu ọmọ Hilkiah ti iṣe olori ile, ati Ṣebna akọwe, ati Joa ọmọ Asafu akọwe-iranti wá sọdọ Hesekiah, ti awọn, ti aṣọ wọn ni fifàya, nwọn si sọ ọ̀rọ Rabṣake fun u.
entries.en: Then came Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, which was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder, to Hezekiah with their clothes rent, and told him the words of Rab-shakeh.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati Hesekiah ọba gbọ́, o si fà aṣọ rẹ̀ ya, o si fi aṣọ ọ̀fọ bò ara rẹ̀, o si lọ sinu ile Oluwa.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when king Hezekiah heard it, that he rent his clothes, and covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the house of the LORD.

entries.yo: O si rán Eliakimu, ti iṣe olori ile, ati Ṣebna akọwe, ati awọn àgba alufa, ti nwọn fi aṣọ ọ̀fọ bò ara, sọdọ Isaiah woli ọmọ Amosi.
entries.en: And he sent Eliakim, which was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests, covered with sackcloth, to Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz.

entries.yo: Nwọn si wi fun u pe, Bayi ni Hesekiah wi, Ọjọ oni ọjọ wàhala ni, ati ti ibawi, ati ẹgàn: nitoriti awọn ọmọ de oju-ibí, kò si si agbara lati bi.
entries.en: And they said unto him, Thus saith Hezekiah, This day is a day of trouble, and of rebuke, and blasphemy: for the children are come to the birth, and there is not strength to bring forth.

entries.yo: Bọya Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ yio gbọ́ gbogbo ọ̀rọ Rabṣake ẹniti ọba Assiria oluwa rẹ̀ ti rán lati kẹgàn Ọlọrun alãyè, yio si ba a wi nitori ọ̀rọ ti Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ ti gbọ́: njẹ nitorina, gbé adura rẹ soke fun awọn iyokù ti o kù.
entries.en: It may be the LORD thy God will hear all the words of Rab-shakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master hath sent to reproach the living God; and will reprove the words which the LORD thy God hath heard: wherefore lift up thy prayer for the remnant that are left.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li awọn iranṣẹ Hesekiah ọba wá sọdọ Isaiah.
entries.en: So the servants of king Hezekiah came to Isaiah.

entries.yo: Isaiah si wi fun wọn pe, Bayi ni ki ẹ sọ fun oluwa nyin, Bayi li Oluwa wi pe, Máṣe bẹ̀ru ọ̀rọ wọnni, ti o ti gbọ́, ti awọn iranṣẹ ọba Assiria fi sọ ọ̀rọ odi si mi.
entries.en: And Isaiah said unto them, Thus shall ye say to your master, Thus saith the LORD, Be not afraid of the words which thou hast heard, with which the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, emi o rán ẽmi kan si i, on o si gbọ́ ariwo, yio si pada si ilẹ on tikalarẹ̀; emi o si mu u ti ipa idà ṣubu ni ilẹ on tikalarẹ̀.
entries.en: Behold, I will send a blast upon him, and he shall hear a rumour, and shall return to his own land; and I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Rabṣake pada, o si ba ọba Assiria mba Libna jagun: nitoriti o ti gbọ́ pe o ti lọ kuro ni Lakiṣi.
entries.en: So Rab-shakeh returned, and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah: for he had heard that he was departed from Lachish.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si gburo Tirhaka ọba Etiopia, pe, Kiyesi i, o jade wá lati ba ọ jagun; o si tun rán awọn onṣẹ si ọdọ Hesekiah wipe,
entries.en: And when he heard say of Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, Behold, he is come out to fight against thee: he sent messengers again unto Hezekiah, saying,

entries.yo: Bayi li ẹnyin o sọ fun Hesekiah ọba Juda, wipe, Máṣe jẹ ki Ọlọrun rẹ, ẹniti iwọ gbẹkẹle ki o tàn ọ jẹ, wipe, A kì yio fi Jerusalemu le ọwọ ọba Assiria.
entries.en: Thus shall ye speak to Hezekiah king of Judah, saying, Let not thy God in whom thou trustest deceive thee, saying, Jerusalem shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, iwọ ti gbọ́ ohun ti awọn ọba Assiria ti ṣe si gbogbo ilẹ, ni pipa wọn run patapata: a o ha si gbà iwọ bi?
entries.en: Behold, thou hast heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands, by destroying them utterly: and shalt thou be delivered?

entries.yo: Oriṣa awọn orilẹ-ède ha gbà awọn ti awọn baba mi ti parun; bi Gosani, ati Harani, ati Resefu, ati awọn ọmọ Edeni ti o wà ni Telassari?
entries.en: Have the gods of the nations delivered them which my fathers have destroyed; as Gozan, and Haran, and Rezeph, and the children of Eden which were in Thelasar?

entries.yo: Nibo li ọba Hamati, ati ọba Arpadi, ati ọba ilu Sefarfaimu, ti Hena, ati Ifa gbe wà?
entries.en: Where is the king of Hamath, and the king of Arpad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, of Hena, and Ivah?

entries.yo: Hesekiah si gbà iwe na lọwọ awọn onṣẹ na, o si kà a: Hesekiah si gòke lọ sinu ile Oluwa, o si tẹ́ ẹ siwaju Oluwa.
entries.en: And Hezekiah received the letter of the hand of the messengers, and read it: and Hezekiah went up into the house of the LORD, and spread it before the LORD.

entries.yo: Hesekiah si gbadura niwaju Oluwa, o si wipe: Oluwa Ọlọrun Israeli, ti ngbe ãrin awọn kerubu, iwọ li Ọlọrun, ani iwọ nikanṣoṣo, ninu gbogbo awọn ilẹ-ọba aiye; iwọ li o dá ọrun on aiye.
entries.en: And Hezekiah prayed before the LORD, and said, O LORD God of Israel, which dwellest between the cherubims, thou art the God, even thou alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth: thou hast made heaven and earth.

entries.yo: Dẹti rẹ silẹ Oluwa, ki o si gbọ́; ṣi oju rẹ, Oluwa, ki o si wò: ki o si gbọ́ ọ̀rọ Sennakeribu ti o rán lati kẹgàn Ọlọrun alãyè.
entries.en: LORD, bow down thine ear, and hear: open, LORD, thine eyes, and see: and hear the words of Sennacherib, which hath sent him to reproach the living God.

entries.yo: Lõtọ ni, Oluwa, awọn ọba Assiria ti pa awọn orilẹ-ède run ati ilẹ wọn.
entries.en: Of a truth, LORD, the kings of Assyria have destroyed the nations and their lands,

entries.yo: Nwọn si ti gbe òriṣa wọn sọ sinu iná; nitoriti nwọn kì iṣe ọlọrun, bikòṣe iṣẹ ọwọ enia, igi ati okuta: nitorina ni nwọn ṣe pa wọn run.
entries.en: And have cast their gods into the fire: for they were no gods, but the work of men's hands, wood and stone: therefore they have destroyed them.

entries.yo: Njẹ nitorina, Oluwa Ọlọrun wa, emi mbẹ̀ ọ, gbà wa lọwọ rẹ̀, ki gbogbo ilẹ ọba aiye le mọ̀ pe iwọ Oluwa iwọ nikanṣoṣo ni Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Now therefore, O LORD our God, I beseech thee, save thou us out of his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that thou art the LORD God, even thou only.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Isaiah ọmọ Amosi ranṣẹ si Hesekiah wipe, Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun Israeli wi pe, adura ti iwọ ti gbà si mi si Sennakeribu ọba Assiria emi ti gbọ́.
entries.en: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent to Hezekiah, saying, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, That which thou hast prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria I have heard.

entries.yo: Eyi li ọ̀rọ ti Oluwa ti sọ niti rẹ̀; Wundia ọmọbinrin Sioni ti kẹgàn rẹ, o si ti fi ọ rẹrin ẹlẹyà; ọmọbinrin Jerusalemu ti mì ori rẹ̀ si ọ.
entries.en: This is the word that the LORD hath spoken concerning him; The virgin the daughter of Zion hath despised thee, and laughed thee to scorn; the daughter of Jerusalem hath shaken her head at thee.

entries.yo: Tani iwọ sọ̀rọ buburu si ti iwọ si kẹgàn? ati tani iwọ gbé ohùn rẹ si òke si, ti iwọ gbé oju rẹ ga si òke? ani si Ẹni-Mimọ Israeli.
entries.en: Whom hast thou reproached and blasphemed? and against whom hast thou exalted thy voice, and lifted up thine eyes on high? even against the Holy One of Israel.

entries.yo: Nipa awọn onṣẹ rẹ, iwọ ti sọ̀rọ buburu si Oluwa, ti nwọn si wipe, Ọpọlọpọ kẹkẹ́ mi li emi fi de ori awọn òke-nla, si ori Lebanoni, emi o si ké igi kedari giga rẹ̀ lulẹ, ati ãyò igi firi rẹ̀; emi o si lọ si ori òke ibùwọ rẹ̀, sinu igbó Karmeli rẹ̀.
entries.en: By the messengers thou hast reproached the Lord, and hast said, With the multitude of my chariots I am come up to the height of the mountains, to the sides of Lebanon, and will cut down the tall cedar trees thereof, and the choice fir trees thereof: and I will enter into the lodgings of his borders, and into the forest of his Carmel.

entries.yo: Emi ti wà kànga, emi si ti mu ajèji omi, atẹlẹsẹ̀ mi li emi si ti fi gbẹ gbogbo odò Egipti.
entries.en: I have digged and drunk strange waters, and with the sole of my feet have I dried up all the rivers of besieged places.

entries.yo: Iwọ kò ti gbọ́, lailai ri emi ti ṣe e, nigba atijọ emi si ti mura tẹlẹ nisisiyi emi ti mu u ṣẹ, ki iwọ ki o le mã sọ ilu olodi wọnni di ahoro, ani di òkiti àlapa.
entries.en: Hast thou not heard long ago how I have done it, and of ancient times that I have formed it? now have I brought it to pass, that thou shouldest be to lay waste fenced cities into ruinous heaps.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni awọn olugbe wọn fi ṣe alainipa, a daiyàfo wọn nwọn si dãmu; nwọn dàbi koriko igbẹ́, ati bi ewebẹ̀ tutù, bi koriko li ori ile, ati bi ọkà ti o rẹ̀ danù ki o to dàgba soke.
entries.en: Therefore their inhabitants were of small power, they were dismayed and confounded; they were as the grass of the field, and as the green herb, as the grass on the housetops, and as corn blasted before it be grown up.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi mọ̀ ijoko rẹ, ati ijadelọ rẹ, ati bibọ̀ rẹ, ati ikannu rẹ si mi.
entries.en: But I know thy abode, and thy going out, and thy coming in, and thy rage against me.

entries.yo: Nitori ikánnu rẹ si mi ati irera rẹ de eti mi, nitorina li emi o fi ìwọ̀ mi kọ́ ọ ni imu, ati ijanu mi si ẹnu rẹ, emi o si yi ọ pada si ọ̀na na ti iwọ ti ba wá.
entries.en: Because thy rage against me and thy tumult is come up into mine ears, therefore I will put my hook in thy nose, and my bridle in thy lips, and I will turn thee back by the way by which thou camest.

entries.yo: Eyi ni yio si ṣe àmi fun ọ, Ẹ jẹ ilalẹ̀hu li ọdun ni, ati li ọdun keji eyiti o hù ninu ọkanna; ati li ọdun kẹta ẹ fun irúgbìn, ki ẹ si kore, ki ẹ si gbìn ọgba ajara, ki ẹ si jẹ eso rẹ̀.
entries.en: And this shall be a sign unto thee, Ye shall eat this year such things as grow of themselves, and in the second year that which springeth of the same; and in the third year sow ye, and reap, and plant vineyards, and eat the fruits thereof.

entries.yo: Iyokù ile Juda ti o salà yio si tún ta gbòngbo si isàlẹ, yio si so eso li òke.
entries.en: And the remnant that is escaped of the house of Judah shall yet again take root downward, and bear fruit upward.

entries.yo: Nitori lati Jerusalemu li awọn iyokù yio jade lọ, ati awọn ti o salà lati oke Sioni jade: itara Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun ni yio ṣe eyi.
entries.en: For out of Jerusalem shall go forth a remnant, and they that escape out of mount Zion: the zeal of the LORD of hosts shall do this.

entries.yo: Nitori bayi li Oluwa wi niti ọba Assiria, On kì yio wá si ilu yi, bẹ̃ni kì yio ta ọfà kan sibẹ, kì yio mu asà wá iwaju rẹ̀, bẹ̃ni kì yio mọ odi tì i yika.
entries.en: Therefore thus saith the LORD concerning the king of Assyria, He shall not come into this city, nor shoot an arrow there, nor come before it with shield, nor cast a bank against it.

entries.yo: Ọna na ti o ba wá, ọkanna ni yio ba pada lọ, kì yio si wá si ilu yi, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: By the way that he came, by the same shall he return, and shall not come into this city, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Nitori emi o da abò bò ilu yi, lati gbà a, nitori ti emi tikara mi, ati nitori ti Dafidi iranṣẹ mi.
entries.en: For I will defend this city, to save it, for mine own sake, and for my servant David's sake.

entries.yo: O si ṣe li oru na ni angeli Oluwa jade lọ, o si pa ọkẹ́ mẹsan le ẹgbẹ̃dọgbọn enia ni ibùbo awọn ara Assiria: nigbati nwọn si dide ni kutukutu owurọ, kiyesi i, okú ni gbogbo wọn jasi.
entries.en: And it came to pass that night, that the angel of the LORD went out, and smote in the camp of the Assyrians an hundred fourscore and five thousand: and when they arose early in the morning, behold, they were all dead corpses.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Sennakeribu ọba Assiria mu ọ̀na rẹ̀ pọ̀n, o si lọ, o si pada, o si joko ni Ninefe.
entries.en: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, and went and returned, and dwelt at Nineveh.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, bi o ti mbọ̀riṣa ni ile Nisroku oriṣa rẹ̀, ni Adrammeleki ati Ṣareseri awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ fi idà pa a: nwọn si sa lọ si ilẹ Armenia. Esarhaddoni ọmọ rẹ̀ sì jọba ni ipò rẹ̀.
entries.en: And it came to pass, as he was worshipping in the house of Nisroch his god, that Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons smote him with the sword: and they escaped into the land of Armenia. And Esar-haddon his son reigned in his stead.

entries.yo: LI ọjọ wọnni ni Hesekiah ṣe aisàn de oju-ikú. Isaiah woli ọmọ Amosi si tọ̀ ọ wá, o si wi fun u pe, Bayi li Oluwa wi, Palẹ ile rẹ mọ́; nitoriti iwọ o kú, iwọ kì yio si yè.
entries.en: In those days was Hezekiah sick unto death. And the prophet Isaiah the son of Amoz came to him, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Set thine house in order; for thou shalt die, and not live.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni o yi oju rẹ̀ pada si ogiri, o si gbadura si Oluwa, wipe,
entries.en: Then he turned his face to the wall, and prayed unto the LORD, saying,

entries.yo: Emi bẹ̀ ọ, Oluwa, ranti nisisiyi bi emi ti rìn niwaju rẹ ninu otitọ ati ninu aiya pipe, ti mo si ti ṣe eyiti o dara li oju rẹ. Hesekiah si sọkún gidigidi.
entries.en: I beseech thee, O LORD, remember now how I have walked before thee in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done that which is good in thy sight. And Hezekiah wept sore.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, ki Isaiah ki o to jade si ãrin agbalá-ãfin, li ọ̀rọ Oluwa tọ̀ ọ wá wipe,
entries.en: And it came to pass, afore Isaiah was gone out into the middle court, that the word of the LORD came to him, saying,

entries.yo: Tun pada, ki o si wi fun Hesekiah olori awọn enia mi pe, Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun Dafidi baba rẹ wi pe, Emi ti gbọ́ adura rẹ, emi si ti ri omije rẹ: kiyesi i, emi o wò ọ sàn: ni ijọ kẹta iwọ o gòke lọ si ile Oluwa.
entries.en: Turn again, and tell Hezekiah the captain of my people, Thus saith the LORD, the God of David thy father, I have heard thy prayer, I have seen thy tears: behold, I will heal thee: on the third day thou shalt go up unto the house of the LORD.

entries.yo: Emi o si bù ọdun mẹ̃dogun kún ọjọ rẹ: emi o si gbà ọ ati ilu yi lọwọ ọba Assiria, emi o si dãbò bò ilu yi, nitori ti emi tikara mi, ati nitori ti Dafidi iranṣẹ mi.
entries.en: And I will add unto thy days fifteen years; and I will deliver thee and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria; and I will defend this city for mine own sake, and for my servant David's sake.

entries.yo: Isaiah si wipe, Mu odidi ọ̀pọtọ. Nwọn si mu u, nwọn si fi le õwo na, ara rẹ̀ si da.
entries.en: And Isaiah said, Take a lump of figs. And they took and laid it on the boil, and he recovered.

entries.yo: Hesekiah si wi fun Isaiah pe, Kini yio ṣe àmi pe Oluwa yio wò mi sàn, ati pe emi o gòke lọ si ile Oluwa ni ijọ kẹta?
entries.en: And Hezekiah said unto Isaiah, What shall be the sign that the LORD will heal me, and that I shall go up into the house of the LORD the third day?

entries.yo: Isaiah si wipe, Àmi yi ni iwọ o ni lati ọdọ Oluwa wá, pe, Oluwa yio ṣe nkan yi ti on ti sọ: ki ojiji ki o lọ siwaju ni iṣisẹ̀ mẹwa ni, tabi ki o pada sẹhin ni iṣisẹ̀ mẹwa?
entries.en: And Isaiah said, This sign shalt thou have of the LORD, that the LORD will do the thing that he hath spoken: shall the shadow go forth ten degrees, or go back ten degrees?

entries.yo: Hesekiah si dahùn wipe, Ohun ti o rọrùn ni fun ojiji ki o lọ siwaju ni iṣisẹ̀ mẹwa: bẹ̃kọ, ṣugbọn jẹ ki ojiji ki o pada sẹhin ni iṣisẹ̀ mẹwa.
entries.en: And Hezekiah answered, It is a light thing for the shadow to go down ten degrees: nay, but let the shadow return backward ten degrees.

entries.yo: Isaiah woli si kepè Oluwa; on si mu ojiji pada sẹhin ni iṣisẹ̀ mẹwa, nipa eyiti o ti sọ̀kalẹ ninu agogo-õrùn Ahasi.
entries.en: And Isaiah the prophet cried unto the LORD: and he brought the shadow ten degrees backward, by which it had gone down in the dial of Ahaz.

entries.yo: Li akokò na ni Berodaki-Baladani, ọmọ Baladani, ọba Babeli, rán iwe ati ọrẹ si Hesekiah: nitoriti o ti gbọ́ pe Hesekiah ti ṣe aisàn.
entries.en: At that time Berodach-baladan, the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present unto Hezekiah: for he had heard that Hezekiah had been sick.

entries.yo: Hesekiah si fi eti si ti wọn, o si fi gbogbo ile iṣura ohun iyebiye rẹ̀ hàn wọn, fadakà, ati wura, ati turari, ati ororo iyebiye, ati gbogbo ile ohun ihamọra rẹ̀, ati gbogbo eyiti a ri ninu iṣura rẹ̀: kò si nkan ni ile rẹ̀, tabi ni gbogbo ijọba rẹ̀, ti Hesekiah kò fi hàn wọn.
entries.en: And Hezekiah hearkened unto them, and shewed them all the house of his precious things, the silver, and the gold, and the spices, and the precious ointment, and all the house of his armour, and all that was found in his treasures: there was nothing in his house, nor in all his dominion, that Hezekiah shewed them not.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Isaiah woli wá si ọdọ Hesekiah ọba, o si wi fun u pe, Kili awọn ọkunrin wọnyi wi? ati nibo ni nwọn ti wá si ọdọ rẹ? Hesekiah si wipe, Ilu òkere ni nwọn ti wá, ani lati Babeli:
entries.en: Then came Isaiah the prophet unto king Hezekiah, and said unto him, What said these men? and from whence came they unto thee? And Hezekiah said, They are come from a far country, even from Babylon.

entries.yo: On si wipe, Kini nwọn ri ni ile rẹ? Hesekiah si dahùn wipe, Gbogbo nkan ti mbẹ ni ile mi ni nwọn ti ri: kò si nkan ninu iṣura mi ti emi kò fi hàn wọn.
entries.en: And he said, What have they seen in thine house? And Hezekiah answered, All the things that are in mine house have they seen: there is nothing among my treasures that I have not shewed them.

entries.yo: Isaiah si wi fun Hesekiah pe, Gbọ́ ọ̀rọ Oluwa.
entries.en: And Isaiah said unto Hezekiah, Hear the word of the LORD.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, ọjọ mbọ̀, ti a o kó gbogbo nkan ti mbẹ ninu ile rẹ, ati eyiti awọn baba rẹ ti tò jọ titi di oni, lọ si Babeli: ohun kan kì yio kù, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: Behold, the days come, that all that is in thine house,and that which thy fathers have laid up in store unto this day, shall be carried into Babylon: nothing shall be left, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Ati ninu awọn ọmọ rẹ ọkunrin ti yio ti inu rẹ jade wá, ti iwọ o bi, ni nwọn o kó lọ; nwọn o si mã ṣe iwẹ̀fa li ãfin ọba Babeli.
entries.en: And of thy sons that shall issue from thee, which thou shalt beget, shall they take away; and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Hesekiah wi fun Isaiah pe, Rere li ọ̀rọ Oluwa ti iwọ sọ. On si wipe, kò ha dara bi alafia ati otitọ ba wà lọjọ mi?
entries.en: Then said Hezekiah unto Isaiah, Good is the word of the LORD which thou hast spoken. And he said, Is it not good, if peace and truth be in my days?

entries.yo: Ati iyokù iṣe Hesekiah ati gbogbo agbara rẹ̀, ati bi o ti ṣe adagun omi, ati ọ̀na omi na, ti o si mu omi wá sinu ilu, a kò ha kọ wọn sinu iwe ọ̀rọ ọjọ awọn ọba Juda?
entries.en: And the rest of the acts of Hezekiah, and all his might, and how he made a pool, and a conduit, and brought water into the city, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

entries.yo: Hesekiah si sùn pẹlu awọn baba rẹ̀: Manasse ọmọ rẹ̀ si jọba ni ipò rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Hezekiah slept with his fathers: and Manasseh his son reigned in his stead.

entries.yo: ẸNI ọdun mejila ni Manasse nigbati o bẹ̀rẹ si ijọba, o si jọba li ọdun marundilọgọta ni Jerusalemu. Orukọ iya rẹ̀ ni Hefsiba.
entries.en: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign, and reigned fifty and five years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Hephzi-bah.

entries.yo: O si ṣe eyiti o buru li oju Oluwa, bi iṣe-irira ti awọn keferi, ti Oluwa tì jade niwaju awọn ọmọ Israeli.
entries.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, after the abominations of the heathen, whom the LORD cast out before the children of Israel.

entries.yo: Nitoriti o tun kọ́ ibi giga wọnni ti Hesekiah baba rẹ̀ ti parun; o si tẹ́ pẹpẹ fun Baali o si ṣe ere-oriṣa, bi Ahabu, ọba Israeli ti ṣe, o si mbọ gbogbo ogun ọrun, o si nsìn wọn.
entries.en: For he built up again the high places which Hezekiah his father had destroyed; and he reared up altars for Baal, and made a grove, as did Ahab king of Israel; and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served them.

entries.yo: O si tẹ́ pẹpẹ ni ile Oluwa, eyiti Oluwa ti sọ pe, Ni Jerusalemu li emi o fi orukọ mi si.
entries.en: And he built altars in the house of the LORD, of which the LORD said, In Jerusalem will I put my name.

entries.yo: On si tẹ́ pẹpẹ fun gbogbo ogun ọrun li agbalá mejeji ile Oluwa.
entries.en: And he built altars for all the host of heaven in the two courts of the house of the LORD.

entries.yo: On si mu ki ọmọ rẹ̀ ki o kọja lãrin iná, a si mã ṣe akiyesi afọṣẹ, a si mã ṣe alupàyida, a si mã bá awọn okú ati awọn oṣó lò: o hùwa buburu pupọ̀ li oju Oluwa lati mu u binu.
entries.en: And he made his son pass through the fire, and observed times, and used enchantments, and dealt with familiar spirits and wizards: he wrought much wickedness in the sight of the LORD, to provoke him to anger.

entries.yo: O si gbé ere oriṣa fifin kalẹ ti o ti ṣe ni ile na ti Oluwa sọ fun Dafidi ati Solomoni ọmọ rẹ̀ pe, Ni ile yi, ati ni Jerusalemu, ti mo ti yàn ninu gbogbo awọn ẹ̀ya Israeli, li emi o fi orukọ mi si lailai:
entries.en: And he set a graven image of the grove that he had made in the house, of which the LORD said to David, and to Solomon his son, In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all tribes of Israel, will I put my name for ever:

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni emi kì yio si jẹ ki ẹsẹ̀ Israeli ki o yẹ̀ kuro mọ ni ilẹ ti mo fi fun awọn baba wọn; kiki bi nwọn o ba ṣe akiyesi lati ṣe gẹgẹ bi gbogbo eyiti mo pa li aṣẹ fun wọn, ati gẹgẹ bi gbogbo ofin ti Mose iranṣẹ mi pa li aṣẹ fun wọn.
entries.en: Neither will I make the feet of Israel move any more out of the land which I gave their fathers; only if they will observe to do according to all that I have commanded them, and according to all the law that my servant Moses commanded them.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nwọn kò feti silẹ: Manasse si tàn wọn lati ṣe buburu jù eyiti awọn orilẹ-ède ti Oluwa ti parun niwaju awọn ọmọ Israeli ti ṣe.
entries.en: But they hearkened not: and Manasseh seduced them to do more evil than did the nations whom the LORD destroyed before the children of Israel.

entries.yo: Oluwa si wi nipa awọn woli iranṣẹ rẹ̀ pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake by his servants the prophets, saying,

entries.yo: Nitoriti Manasse ọba Juda ti ṣe ohun-irira wọnyi, ti o si ti ṣe buburu jù gbogbo eyiti awọn ọmọ Amori ti ṣe, ti o ti wà ṣãju rẹ̀, ti o si mu ki Juda pẹlu ki o fi awọn ere rẹ̀ dẹṣẹ:
entries.en: Because Manasseh king of Judah hath done these abominations, and hath done wickedly above all that the Amorites did, which were before him, and hath made Judah also to sin with his idols:

entries.yo: Nitorina bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun Israeli wi, Kiyesi i, emi nmu iru ibi bayi wá sori Jerusalemu ati Juda, ti ẹnikẹni ti o ba gbọ́ ọ, eti rẹ̀ mejeji yio ho.
entries.en: Therefore thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Behold, I am bringing such evil upon Jerusalem and Judah, that whosoever heareth of it, both his ears shall tingle.

entries.yo: Emi o si nà okùn Samaria lori Jerusalemu, ati òjé-idiwọ̀n ile Ahabu: emi o si nù Jerusalemu bi enia ti nnù awokoto, o nnù u, o si ndori rẹ̀ kodò.
entries.en: And I will stretch over Jerusalem the line of Samaria, and the plummet of the house of Ahab: and I will wipe Jerusalem as a man wipeth a dish, wiping it, and turning it upside down.

entries.yo: Emi o si kọ̀ iyokù awọn ini mi silẹ, emi o si fi wọn le awọn ọ̀ta wọn lọwọ; nwọn o si di ikogun ati ijẹ fun gbogbo awọn ọ̀ta wọn.
entries.en: And I will forsake the remnant of mine inheritance, and deliver them into the hand of their enemies; and they shall become a prey and a spoil to all their enemies;

entries.yo: Nitori nwọn ti ṣe eyiti o buru li oju mi, ti nwọn si ti mu mi binu, lati ọjọ ti awọn baba wọn ti jade kuro ni Egipti, ani titi di oni yi.
entries.en: Because they have done that which was evil in my sight,and have provoked me to anger, since the day their fathers came forth out of Egypt, even unto this day.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu Manasse ta ẹ̀jẹ alaiṣẹ̀ silẹ pupọjù, titi o fi kún Jerusalemu lati ikangun ikini de ekeji; lẹhin ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ̀ ti o mu Juda ṣẹ̀, ni ṣiṣe buburu li oju Oluwa.
entries.en: Moreover Manasseh shed innocent blood very much, till he had filled Jerusalem from one end to another; beside his sin wherewith he made Judah to sin, in doing that which was evil in the sight of the LORD.

entries.yo: Ati iyokù iṣe Manasse, ati gbogbo eyiti o ṣe, ati ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ̀ ti o ṣẹ̀, a kò ha kọ wọn sinu iwe ọ̀rọ ọjọ awọn ọba Juda?
entries.en: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and all that he did, and his sin that he sinned, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

entries.yo: Manasse si sùn pẹlu awọn baba rẹ̀, a si sin i ninu ọgba-ile rẹ̀, ninu ọgba Ussa: Amoni ọmọ rẹ̀ si jọba ni ipò rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Manasseh slept with his fathers, and was buried in the garden of his own house, in the garden of Uzza: and Amon his son reigned in his stead.

entries.yo: Ẹni ọdun mejilelogun ni Amoni nigbati o bẹ̀rẹ si ijọba, o si jọba li ọdun meji ni Jerusalemu. Orukọ iya rẹ̀ ni Mesullemeti, ọmọbinrin Harusi ti Jotba.
entries.en: Amon was twenty and two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned two years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Meshullemeth, the daughter of Haruz of Jotbah.

entries.yo: On si ṣe eyiti o buru li oju Oluwa, bi baba rẹ̀ Manasse ti ṣe.
entries.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, as his father Manasseh did.

entries.yo: O si rìn li ọ̀na gbogbo ti baba rẹ̀ rìn, o si sìn awọn ere ti baba rẹ̀ sìn, o si bọ wọn:
entries.en: And he walked in all the way that his father walked in, and served the idols that his father served, and worshipped them:

entries.yo: On si kọ̀ OLUWA Ọlọrun awọn baba rẹ̀ silẹ, kò si rìn li ọ̀na Oluwa.
entries.en: And he forsook the LORD God of his fathers, and walked not in the way of the LORD.

entries.yo: Awọn iranṣẹ Amoni si dìtẹ si i, nwọn si pa ọba ni ile rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the servants of Amon conspired against him, and slew the king in his own house.

entries.yo: Awọn enia ilẹ na si pa gbogbo awọn ti o dìtẹ si Amoni ọba: awọn enia ilẹ na si fi Josiah ọmọ rẹ̀ jọba ni ipò rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the people of the land slew all them that had conspired against king Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his stead.

entries.yo: Ati iyokù iṣe Amoni ti o ti ṣe, a kò ha kọ wọn sinu iwe ọ̀rọ ọjọ awọn ọba Juda?
entries.en: Now the rest of the acts of Amon which he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

entries.yo: A si sìn i ni isà okú rẹ̀ ninu ọgba Ussa: Josiah ọmọ rẹ̀ si jọba ni ipò rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he was buried in his sepulchre in the garden of Uzza: and Josiah his son reigned in his stead.

entries.yo: ẸNI ọdun mẹjọ ni Josiah nigbati o bẹ̀rẹ si ijọba; o si jọba li ọdun mọkanlelọgbọ̀n ni Jerusalemu, Orukọ iya rẹ̀ ni Jedida, ọmọbinrin Adaiah ti Boskati.
entries.en: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned thirty and one years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Jedidah, the daughter of Adaiah of Boscath.

entries.yo: On si ṣe eyiti o tọ́ li oju Oluwa o si rìn li ọ̀na Dafidi baba rẹ̀ gbogbo, kò si yipada si apa ọ̀tún tabi si apa òsi.
entries.en: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD, and walked in all the way of David his father, and turned not aside to the right hand or to the left.

entries.yo: O si ṣe li ọdun kejidilogun Josiah ọba li ọba rán Ṣafani ọmọ Asaliah ọmọ Mesullamu, akọwe, si ile Oluwa, wipe,
entries.en: And it came to pass in the eighteenth year of king Josiah, that the king sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah, the son of Meshullam, the scribe, to the house of the LORD, saying,

entries.yo: Gòke tọ̀ Hilkiah olori alufa lọ, ki o le ṣirò iye fadakà ti a mu wá sinu ile Oluwa, ti awọn olùtọju iloro ti kojọ lọwọ awọn enia:
entries.en: Go up to Hilkiah the high priest, that he may sum the silver which is brought into the house of the LORD, which the keepers of the door have gathered of the people:

entries.yo: Ẹ si jẹ ki wọn ki o fi le awọn olùṣe iṣẹ na lọwọ, ti nṣe alabojuto ile Oluwa: ki ẹ si jẹ ki wọn ki o fi fun awọn olùṣe iṣẹ na ti mbẹ ninu ile Oluwa, lati tun ibi ẹya ile na ṣe.
entries.en: And let them deliver it into the hand of the doers of the work, that have the oversight of the house of the LORD: and let them give it to the doers of the work which is in the house of the LORD, to repair the breaches of the house,

entries.yo: Fun awọn gbẹnagbẹna, ati fun awọn akọle, ati awọn ọ̀mọle, lati rà ìti-igi ati okuta gbígbẹ lati tún ile na ṣe.
entries.en: Unto carpenters, and builders, and masons, and to buy timber and hewn stone to repair the house.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn a kò ba wọn ṣe iṣirò owo ti a fi le wọn lọwọ, nitoriti nwọn ṣe otitọ.
entries.en: Howbeit there was no reckoning made with them of the money that was delivered into their hand, because they dealt faithfully.

entries.yo: Hilkiah olori alufa si sọ fun Ṣafani akọwe pe, Emi ri iwe ofin ni ile Oluwa. Hilkiah si fi iwe na fun Ṣafani, on si kà a.
entries.en: And Hilkiah the high priest said unto Shaphan the scribe, I have found the book of the law in the house of the LORD. And Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan, and he read it.

entries.yo: Ṣafani akọwe si wá sọdọ ọba, o si tún mu èsi pada fun ọba wá, o si wipe, Awọn iranṣẹ rẹ ti kó owo na jọ ti a ri ni ile na, nwọn si ti fi le ọwọ awọn ti o nṣiṣẹ na, ti nṣe alabojuto ile Oluwa.
entries.en: And Shaphan the scribe came to the king, and brought the king word again, and said, Thy servants have gathered the money that was found in the house, and have delivered it into the hand of them that do the work, that have the oversight of the house of the LORD.

entries.yo: Ṣafani akọwe si fi hàn ọba, pe, Hilkiah alufa fi iwe kan le mi lọwọ. Ṣafani si kà a niwaju ọba.
entries.en: And Shaphan the scribe shewed the king, saying, Hilkiah the priest hath delivered me a book. And Shaphan read it before the king.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati ọba gbọ́ ọ̀rọ inu iwe ofin na, o si fà aṣọ rẹ̀ ya.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when the king had heard the words of the book of the law, that he rent his clothes.

entries.yo: Ọba si paṣẹ fun Hilkiah alufa, ati Ahikamu ọmọ Ṣafani, ati Akbori ọmọ Mikaiah, ati Ṣafani akọwe, ati Asahiah iranṣẹ ọba wipe,
entries.en: And the king commanded Hilkiah the priest, and Ahikam the son of Shaphan, and Achbor the son of Michaiah, and Shaphan the scribe, and Asahiah a servant of the king's, saying,

entries.yo: Ẹ lọ, ẹ bère lọwọ Oluwa fun mi, ati fun awọn enia, ati fun gbogbo Juda, niti ọ̀rọ iwe yi ti a ri: nitori titobi ni ibinu Oluwa ti o rú si wa, nitori awọn baba wa kò fi eti si ọ̀rọ iwe yi, lati ṣe gẹgẹ bi gbogbo eyiti a kọwe silẹ fun wa.
entries.en: Go ye, inquire of the LORD for me, and for the people, and for all Judah, concerning the words of this book that is found: for great is the wrath of the LORD that is kindled against us, because our fathers have not hearkened unto the words of this book, to do according unto all that which is written concerning us.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Hilkiah alufa, ati Ahikamu, ati Akbori, ati Ṣafani, ati Asahiah tọ̀ Hulda woli obinrin lọ, aya Ṣallumu, ọmọ Tikfa, ọmọ Harhasi, alabojuto aṣọ (njẹ on ngbe Jerusalemu niha keji); nwọn si ba a sọ̀rọ.
entries.en: So Hilkiah the priest, and Ahikam, and Achbor, and Shaphan, and Asahiah, went unto Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvah, the son of Harhas, keeper of the wardrobe; (now she dwelt in Jerusalem in the college;) and they communed with her.

entries.yo: On si wi fun wọn pe, Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun Israeli wi, Sọ fun ọkunrin ti o rán nyin si mi pe,
entries.en: And she said unto them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Tell the man that sent you to me,

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa wi, Kiyesi i, emi o mu ibi bá ibiyi, ati bá awọn ara ilu na, ani gbogbo ọ̀rọ iwe na ti ọba Juda ti kà.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, and upon the inhabitants thereof, even all the words of the book which the king of Judah hath read:

entries.yo: Nitoriti nwọn ti kọ̀ mi silẹ, nwọn si ti nsun turari fun awọn ọlọrun miran, ki nwọn ki o le fi gbogbo iṣẹ ọwọ wọn mu mi binu; nitorina ibinu mi yio rú si ibi yi, kì yio si rọlẹ.
entries.en: Because they have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other gods, that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands; therefore my wrath shall be kindled against this place, and shall not be quenched.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn fun ọba Juda ti o rán nyin wá ibère lọdọ Oluwa, bayi li ẹnyin o sọ fun u, Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun Israeli wi, niti ọ̀rọ wọnni ti iwọ ti gbọ́:
entries.en: But to the king of Judah which sent you to inquire of the LORD, thus shall ye say to him, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, As touching the words which thou hast heard;

entries.yo: Nitoriti ọkàn rẹ rọ̀, ti iwọ si ti rẹ̀ ara rẹ silẹ niwaju Oluwa, nigbati iwọ gbọ́ eyiti mo sọ si ibi yi, ati si awọn ara ilu na pe, nwọn o di ahoro ati ẹni-ègun, ti iwọ si fà aṣọ rẹ ya, ti o si sọkun niwaju mi; emi pẹlu ti gbọ́ tirẹ, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: Because thine heart was tender, and thou hast humbled thyself before the LORD, when thou heardest what I spake against this place, and against the inhabitants thereof, that they should become a desolation and a curse, and hast rent thy clothes, and wept before me; I also have heard thee, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Nitorina kiyesi i, emi o kó ọ jọ sọdọ awọn baba rẹ, a o si kó ọ jọ sinu isà-okú rẹ li alafia; oju rẹ kì o si ri gbogbo ibi ti emi o mu wá bá ibi yi. Nwọn si tún mu èsi fun ọba wá.
entries.en: Behold therefore, I will gather thee unto thy fathers, and thou shalt be gathered into thy grave in peace; and thine eyes shall not see all the evil which I will bring upon this place. And they brought the king word again.

entries.yo: ỌBA si ranṣẹ, nwọn si pè gbogbo awọn àgba Juda ati Jerusalemu jọ sọdọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the king sent, and they gathered unto him all the elders of Judah and of Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Ọba si gòke lọ sinu ile Oluwa, ati gbogbo awọn enia Juda ati gbogbo olugbe Jerusalemu pẹlu rẹ̀, ati awọn alufa, ati awọn woli ati gbogbo enia, ati ewe ati àgba: o si kà gbogbo ọ̀rọ inu iwe majẹmu na ti a ri ninu ile Oluwa li eti wọn.
entries.en: And the king went up into the house of the LORD, and all the men of Judah and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem with him, and the priests, and the prophets, and all the people, both small and great: and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant which was found in the house of the LORD.

entries.yo: Ọba si duro ni ibuduro na, o si dá majẹmu niwaju Oluwa, lati mã fi gbogbo aìya ati gbogbo ọkàn rìn tọ̀ Oluwa lẹhin, ati lati pa ofin rẹ̀ mọ́, ati ẹri rẹ̀, ati aṣẹ rẹ̀, lati mu ọ̀rọ majẹmu yi ṣẹ, ti a ti kọ ninu iwe yi. Gbogbo awọn enia si duro si majẹmu na.
entries.en: And the king stood by a pillar, and made a covenant before the LORD, to walk after the LORD, and to keep his commandments and his testimonies and his statutes with all their heart and all their soul, to perform the words of this covenant that were written in this book. And all the people stood to the covenant.

entries.yo: Ọba si paṣẹ fun Hilkiah olori alufa, ati awọn alufa ẹgbẹ keji, ati awọn alabojuto iloro, lati kó gbogbo ohun-èlo ti a ṣe fun Baali, ati fun ere òriṣa, ati fun gbogbo ogun ọrun jade kuro ni tempili Oluwa: o si sun wọn lẹhin ode Jerusalemu ninu pápa Kidroni, o si kó ẽru wọn lọ si Beteli.
entries.en: And the king commanded Hilkiah the high priest, and the priests of the second order, and the keepers of the door, to bring forth out of the temple of the LORD all the vessels that were made for Baal, and for the grove, and for all the host of heaven: and he burned them without Jerusalem in the fields of Kidron, and carried the ashes of them unto Bethel.

entries.yo: O si dá awọn baba-loriṣa lẹkun, ti awọn ọba Juda ti yàn lati ma sun turari ni ibi giga ni ilu Juda wọnni, ati ni ibi ti o yi Jerusalemu ka; awọn pẹlu ti nsun turari fun Baali, fun õrùn, ati fun òṣupa, ati fun awọn àmi mejila ìrawọ, ati fun gbogbo ogun ọrun.
entries.en: And he put down the idolatrous priests, whom the kings of Judah had ordained to burn incense in the high places in the cities of Judah, and in the places round about Jerusalem; them also that burned incense unto Baal, to the sun, and to the moon, and to the planets, and to all the host of heaven.

entries.yo: O si gbé ere-oriṣa jade kuro ni ile Oluwa, sẹhin ode Jerusalemu lọ si odò Kidroni, o si sun u nibi odò Kidroni, o si lọ̀ ọ lũlu, o si dà ẽrú rẹ̀ sori isà-okú awọn ọmọ enia na.
entries.en: And he brought out the grove from the house of the LORD, without Jerusalem, unto the brook Kidron, and burned it at the brook Kidron, and stamped it small to powder, and cast the powder thereof upon the graves of the children of the people.

entries.yo: O si wó ile awọn ti nhù ìwa panṣaga, ti mbẹ leti ile Oluwa, nibiti awọn obinrin wun aṣọ-agọ fun ere-oriṣa.
entries.en: And he brake down the houses of the sodomites, that were by the house of the LORD, where the women wove hangings for the grove.

entries.yo: O si kó gbogbo awọn alufa jade kuro ni ilu Juda wọnni, o si sọ ibi giga wọnni di ẽri nibiti awọn alufa ti sun turari, lati Geba titi de Beer-ṣeba, o si wó ibi giga ẹnu-ibodè wọnni ti mbẹ ni atiwọ̀ ẹnu-ibodè Joṣua bãlẹ ilu, ti mbẹ lapa osi ẹni, ni atiwọ̀ ẹnu-ibode ilu.
entries.en: And he brought all the priests out of the cities of Judah, and defiled the high places where the priests had burned incense, from Geba to Beer-sheba, and brake down the high places of the gates that were in the entering in of the gate of Joshua the governor of the city, which were on a man's left hand at the gate of the city.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn alufa ibi giga wọnni kò gòke wá si ibi pẹpẹ Oluwa ni Jerusalemu, ṣugbọn nwọn jẹ ninu àkara alaiwu lãrin awọn arakunrin wọn.
entries.en: Nevertheless the priests of the high places came not up to the altar of the LORD in Jerusalem, but they did eat of the unleavened bread among their brethren.

entries.yo: On si sọ Tofeti di ẽri, ti mbẹ ni afonifojì awọn ọmọ Hinnomu, ki ẹnikan ki o máṣe mu ọmọ rẹ̀ ọkunrin, tabi ọmọ rẹ̀ obinrin là ãrin iná kọja fun Moleki.
entries.en: And he defiled Topheth, which is in the valley of the children of Hinnom, that no man might make his son or his daughter to pass through the fire to Molech.

entries.yo: O si mu ẹṣin wọnni kuro ti awọn ọba Juda ti fi fun õrun, ni atiwọ̀ inu ile Oluwa lẹba iyẹ̀wu Natan-meleki iwẹ̀fa, ti o ti wà ni agbegbe tempili, o si fi iná sun kẹkẹ́ õrun wọnni.
entries.en: And he took away the horses that the kings of Judah had given to the sun, at the entering in of the house of the LORD, by the chamber of Nathan-melech the chamberlain, which was in the suburbs, and burned the chariots of the sun with fire.

entries.yo: Ati pẹpẹ wọnni ti mbẹ lori iyara òke Ahasi, ti awọn ọba Juda ti tẹ́, ati pẹpẹ wọnni ti Manasse ti tẹ́ li ãfin mejeji ile Oluwa ni ọba wó lulẹ, o si yara lati ibẹ, o si da ekuru wọn sinu odò Kidroni.
entries.en: And the altars that were on the top of the upper chamber of Ahaz, which the kings of Judah had made, and the altars which Manasseh had made in the two courts of the house of the LORD, did the king beat down, and brake them down from thence, and cast the dust of them into the brook Kidron.

entries.yo: Ati ibi giga wọnni ti o wà niwaju Jerusalemu, ti o wà li ọwọ ọtún òke idibàjẹ, ti Solomoni ọba Israeli ti kọ́ fun Aṣtoreti ohun irira awọn ara Sidoni, ati fun Kemoṣi ohun irira awọn ara Moabu, ati fun Milkomu ohun-irira awọn ọmọ Ammoni li ọba sọ di ẽri.
entries.en: And the high places that were before Jerusalem, which were on the right hand of the mount of corruption, which Solomon the king of Israel had builded for Ashtoreth the abomination of the Zidonians, and for Chemosh the abomination of the Moabites, and for Milcom the abomination of the children of Ammon, did the king defile.

entries.yo: O si fọ́ awọn ere na tũtu, o si wó awọn ere-oriṣa lulẹ, o si fi egungun enia kún ipò wọn.
entries.en: And he brake in pieces the images, and cut down the groves, and filled their places with the bones of men.

entries.yo: Ati pẹlu, pẹpẹ ti o ti wà ni Beteli, ati ibi giga ti Jeroboamu ọmọ Nebati, ẹniti o mu Israeli ṣẹ̀, ti tẹ́, ati pẹpẹ na, ati ibi giga na ni o wó lulẹ, o si sun ibi giga na, o si lọ̀ ọ lũlu, o si sun ere-oriṣa na.
entries.en: Moreover the altar that was at Bethel, and the high place which Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin, had made, both that altar and the high place he brake down, and burned the high place, and stamped it small to powder, and burned the grove.

entries.yo: Bi Josiah si ti yira pada, o ri awọn isà-okú ti o wà lori òke, o si ranṣẹ, o si kó awọn egungun lati inu isà wọnni kuro, o si sun wọn lori pẹpẹ na, o si sọ ọ di ẽri, gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ Oluwa, ti enia Ọlọrun nì ti kede, ẹniti o kede ọ̀ro wọnyi.
entries.en: And as Josiah turned himself, he spied the sepulchres that were there in the mount, and sent, and took the bones out of the sepulchres, and burned them upon the altar, and polluted it, according to the word of the LORD which the man of God proclaimed, who proclaimed these words.

entries.yo: Nigbana li o wipe, Ọwọ̀n isa-okú wo li eyi ti mo ri nì? Awọn enia ilu na si sọ fun u pe, Isà-okú enia Ọlọrun nì ni, ti o ti Juda wá, ti o si kede nkan wọnyi ti iwọ ti ṣe si pẹpẹ Beteli.
entries.en: Then he said, What title is that that I see? And the men of the city told him, It is the sepulchre of the man of God, which came from Judah, and proclaimed these things that thou hast done against the altar of Bethel.

entries.yo: On si wipe, Jọwọ rẹ̀; máṣe jẹ ki ẹnikan ki o mu egungun rẹ̀ kuro. Bẹ̃ni nwọn jọwọ egungun rẹ̀ lọwọ, pẹlu egungun woli ti o ti Samaria wá.
entries.en: And he said, Let him alone; let no man move his bones. So they let his bones alone, with the bones of the prophet that came out of Samaria.

entries.yo: Ati pẹlu gbogbo ile ibi-giga wọnni ti o wà ni ilu Samaria wọnni, ti awọn ọba Israeli ti kọ́ lati rú ibinu Oluwa soke ni Josiah mu kuro, o si ṣe si wọn gẹgẹ bi gbogbo iṣe ti o ṣe ni Beteli.
entries.en: And all the houses also of the high places that were in the cities of Samaria, which the kings of Israel had made to provoke the LORD to anger, Josiah took away, and did to them according to all the acts that he had done in Bethel.

entries.yo: O si pa gbogbo awọn alufa ibi-giga wọnni ti o wà nibẹ lori awọn pẹpẹ na, o si sun egungun enia lori wọn, o si pada si Jerusalemu.
entries.en: And he slew all the priests of the high places that were there upon the altars, and burned men's bones upon them, and returned to Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Ọba si paṣẹ fun gbogbo enia, wipe, Pa irekọja mọ́ fun Oluwa Ọlọrun nyin, bi a ti kọ ọ ninu iwe majẹmu yi.
entries.en: And the king commanded all the people, saying, Keep the passover unto the LORD your God, as it is written in the book of this covenant.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ a kò ṣe iru irekọja bẹ̃ lati ọjọ awọn onidajọ ti ndajọ ni Israeli, tabi ni gbogbo ọjọ awọn ọba Israeli tabi awọn ọba Juda;
entries.en: Surely there was not holden such a passover from the days of the judges that judged Israel, nor in all the days of the kings of Israel, nor of the kings of Judah;

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn li ọdun kejidilogun Josiah ọba, ni a pa irekọja yi mọ́ fun Oluwa ni Jerusalemu.
entries.en: But in the eighteenth year of king Josiah, wherein this passover was holden to the LORD in Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Ati pẹlu awọn ti mba awọn okú lò, ati awọn oṣo, ati awọn ere, ati awọn oriṣa, ati gbogbo irira ti a ri ni ilẹ Juda ati ni Jerusalemu ni Josiah kó kuro, ki o le mu ọ̀rọ ofin na ṣẹ ti a ti kọ sinu iwe ti Hilkiah alufa ri ni ile Oluwa.
entries.en: Moreover the workers with familiar spirits, and the wizards, and the images, and the idols, and all the abominations that were spied in the land of Judah and in Jerusalem, did Josiah put away, that he might perform the words of the law which were written in the book that Hilkiah the priest found in the house of the LORD.

entries.yo: Kò si si ọba kan ṣãju rẹ̀, ti o dabi rẹ̀, ti o yipada si Oluwa tinutinu ati tọkàntọkàn ati pẹlu gbogbo agbara rẹ̀, gẹgẹ bi gbogbo ofin Mose; bẹ̃ni lẹhin rẹ̀, kò si ẹnikan ti o dide ti o dàbi rẹ̀.
entries.en: And like unto him was there no king before him, that turned to the LORD with all his heart, and with all his soul, and with all his might, according to all the law of Moses; neither after him arose there any like him.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Oluwa kò yipada kuro ninu mimuná ibinu nla rẹ̀, eyiti ibinu rẹ̀ fi ràn si Juda, nitori gbogbo imunibinu ti Manasse ti fi mu u binu.
entries.en: Notwithstanding the LORD turned not from the fierceness of his great wrath, wherewith his anger was kindled against Judah, because of all the provocations that Manasseh had provoked him withal.

entries.yo: Oluwa si wipe, Emi o si mu Juda kuro loju mi pẹlu, bi mo ti mu Israeli kuro, emi o si ta ilu Jerusalemu yi nù, ti mo ti yàn, ati ile eyiti mo wipe, Orukọ mi yio wà nibẹ.
entries.en: And the LORD said, I will remove Judah also out of my sight, as I have removed Israel, and will cast off this city Jerusalem which I have chosen, and the house of which I said, My name shall be there.

entries.yo: Ati iyokù iṣe Josiah ati gbogbo eyiti o ṣe, a kò ha kọ wọn sinu iwe ọ̀rọ ọjọ awọn ọba Juda?
entries.en: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

entries.yo: Li ọjọ rẹ̀ ni Farao-Neko ọba Egipti dide ogun si ọba Assiria li odò Euferate: Josiah ọba si dide si i; on si pa a ni Megiddo, nigbati o ri i.
entries.en: In his days Pharaoh-nechoh king of Egypt went up against the king of Assyria to the river Euphrates: and king Josiah went against him; and he slew him at Megiddo, when he had seen him.

entries.yo: Awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀ si gbé e li okú ninu kẹkẹ́ lati Megiddo lọ, nwọn si mu u wá si Jerusalemu, nwọn si sìn i ni isà-okú on tikalarẹ̀. Awọn enia ilẹ na si mu Jehoahasi ọmọ Josiah, nwọn si fi ororo yàn a, nwọn si fi i jọba ni ipò baba rẹ̀.
entries.en: And his servants carried him in a chariot dead from Megiddo, and brought him to Jerusalem, and buried him in his own sepulchre. And the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and anointed him, and made him king in his father's stead.

entries.yo: Ẹni ọdun mẹtalelogun ni Jehoahasi nigbati o bẹ̀rẹ si ijọba; o si jọba li oṣù mẹta ni Jerusalemu. Orukọ iya rẹ̀ ni Hamutali, ọmọbinrin Jeremiah ti Libna,
entries.en: Jehoahaz was twenty and three years old when he began to reign; and he reigned three months in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

entries.yo: On si ṣe eyiti o buru li oju Oluwa, gẹgẹ bi gbogbo eyiti awọn baba rẹ̀ ti ṣe.
entries.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his fathers had done.

entries.yo: Farao-Neko si fi i sinu idè ni Ribla, ni ilẹ Hamati, ki o má ba jọba ni Jerusalemu; o si fi ilẹ na si abẹ isìn li ọgọrun talenti fadakà, ati talenti wura.
