entries.en: And Pharaoh-nechoh put him in bands at Riblah in the land of Hamath, that he might not reign in Jerusalem; and put the land to a tribute of an hundred talents of silver, and a talent of gold.

entries.yo: Farao-Neko si fi Eliakimu ọmọ Josiah jẹ ọba ni ipò Josiah baba rẹ̀, o si pa orukọ rẹ̀ dà si Jehoiakimu, o si mu Jehoahasi kuro; on si wá si Egipti, o si kú nibẹ.
entries.en: And Pharaoh-nechoh made Eliakim the son of Josiah king in the room of Josiah his father, and turned his name to Jehoiakim, and took Jehoahaz away: and he came to Egypt, and died there.

entries.yo: Jehoiakimu si fi fadakà ati wura na fun Farao; ṣugbọn o bu owo-odè fun ilẹ na lati san owo na gẹgẹ bi ofin Farao: o fi agbara gbà fadakà ati wurà na lọwọ awọn enia ilẹ na, lọwọ olukuluku gẹgẹ bi owo ti a bù fun u, lati fi fun Farao-Neko.
entries.en: And Jehoiakim gave the silver and the gold to Pharaoh; but he taxed the land to give the money according to the commandment of Pharaoh: he exacted the silver and the gold of the people of the land, of every one according to his taxation, to give it unto Pharaoh-nechoh.

entries.yo: Ẹni ọdun mẹ̃dọgbọ̀n ni Jehoiakimu nigbati o bẹ̀rẹ si ijọba; o si jọba ọdun mọkanla ni Jerusalemu. Orukọ iya rẹ̀ ni Sebuda, ọmọbinrin Bedaiah ti Ruma.
entries.en: Jehoiakim was twenty and five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Zebudah, the daughter of Pedaiah of Rumah.

entries.yo: On si ṣe eyiti o buru li oju Oluwa, gẹgẹ bi gbogbo eyiti awọn baba rẹ̀ ti ṣe.
entries.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his fathers had done.

entries.yo: LI ọjọ rẹ̀ ni Nebukadnessari ọba Babeli gòke wá, Jehoiakimu si di iranṣẹ rẹ̀ li ọdun mẹta: nigbana li o pada o si ṣọ̀tẹ si i.
entries.en: In his days Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up, and Jehoiakim became his servant three years: then he turned and rebelled against him.

entries.yo: Oluwa si rán ẹgbẹ́ ogun awọn ara Kaldea si i, ati ẹgbẹ́ ogun awọn ara Siria, ati ẹgbẹ́ ogun awọn ara Moabu, ati ẹgbẹ́ ogun awọn ọmọ Ammoni, o si rán wọn si Juda lati pa a run, gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ Oluwa, ti o ti sọ nipa awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀ awọn woli.
entries.en: And the LORD sent against him bands of the Chaldees, and bands of the Syrians, and bands of the Moabites, and bands of the children of Ammon, and sent them against Judah to destroy it, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake by his servants the prophets.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ lati ẹnu Oluwa li eyi ti wá sori Juda, lati mu wọn kuro niwaju rẹ̀, nitori ẹ̀ṣẹ Manasse, gẹgẹ bi gbogbo eyiti o ṣe;
entries.en: Surely at the commandment of the LORD came this upon Judah, to remove them out of his sight, for the sins of Manasseh, according to all that he did;

entries.yo: Ati nitori ẹ̀jẹ alaiṣẹ̀ ti o ta silẹ pẹlu: nitoriti o fi ẹ̀jẹ alaiṣẹ̀ kún Jerusalemu; ti Oluwa kò fẹ darijì.
entries.en: And also for the innocent blood that he shed: for he filled Jerusalem with innocent blood; which the LORD would not pardon.

entries.yo: Ati iyokù iṣe Jehoiakimu, ati gbogbo eyiti o ṣe, a kò ha kọ wọn sinu iwe ọ̀rọ ọjọ awọn ọba Juda?
entries.en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Jehoiakimu sùn pẹlu awọn baba rẹ̀: Jehoiakini ọmọ rẹ̀ si jọba ni ipò rẹ̀.
entries.en: So Jehoiakim slept with his fathers: and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his stead.

entries.yo: Ọba Egipti kò si tun jade kuro ni ilẹ rẹ̀ mọ; nitori ọba Babeli ti gbà gbogbo eyiti iṣe ti ọba Egipti lati odò Egipti wá titi de odò Euferate.
entries.en: And the king of Egypt came not again any more out of his land: for the king of Babylon had taken from the river of Egypt unto the river Euphrates all that pertained to the king of Egypt.

entries.yo: Ẹni ọdun mejidilogun ni Jehoiakini nigbati o bẹ̀rẹ si ijọba, o si jọba li oṣù mẹta ni Jerusalemu. Orukọ iya rẹ̀ ni Nehuṣta, ọmọbinrin Elnatani ti Jerusalemu.
entries.en: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months. And his mother's name was Nehushta, the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem.

entries.yo: On si ṣe eyiti o buru li oju Oluwa, gẹgẹ bi gbogbo eyiti baba rẹ̀ ti ṣe.
entries.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his father had done.

entries.yo: Li akokò na, awọn iranṣẹ Nebukadnessari ọba Babeli gbé ogun wá si Jerusalemu, a si dotì ilu na.
entries.en: At that time the servants of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up against Jerusalem, and the city was besieged.

entries.yo: Nebukadnessari ọba Babeli si de si ilu na, nigbati awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀ si dotì i.
entries.en: And Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came against the city, and his servants did besiege it.

entries.yo: Jehoiakini ọba Juda si jade tọ̀ ọba Babeli lọ, on, ati iya rẹ̀, ati awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀, ati awọn ijoye rẹ̀, ati awọn iwẹfa rẹ̀: ọba Babeli si mu u li ọdun kẹjọ ijọba rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Jehoiachin the king of Judah went out to the king of Babylon, he, and his mother, and his servants, and his princes, and his officers: and the king of Babylon took him in the eighth year of his reign.

entries.yo: O si kó gbogbo iṣura ile Oluwa lọ kuro nibẹ, ati iṣura ile ọba, o si ké gbogbo ohun-èlo wura wẹwẹ ti Solomoni ọba Israeli ti ṣe ni tempili Oluwa, bi Oluwa ti sọ.
entries.en: And he carried out thence all the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king's house, and cut in pieces all the vessels of gold which Solomon king of Israel had made in the temple of the LORD, as the LORD had said.

entries.yo: O si kó gbogbo Jerusalemu lọ, ati gbogbo awọn ijoye, ati gbogbo awọn alagbara akọni enia, ani ẹgbãrun igbèkun, ati gbogbo awọn oniṣọnà ati awọn alagbẹ̀dẹ: kò kù ẹnikan, bikòṣe iru awọn ti o jẹ talakà ninu awọn enia ilẹ na.
entries.en: And he carried away all Jerusalem, and all the princes, and all the mighty men of valour, even ten thousand captives, and all the craftsmen and smiths: none remained, save the poorest sort of the people of the land.

entries.yo: O si mu Jehoiakini lọ si Babeli, ati iya ọba, ati awọn obinrin ọba, ati awọn iwẹ̀fa rẹ̀, ati awọn alagbara ilẹ na, awọn wọnyi li o kó ni igbèkun lati Jerusalemu lọ si Babeli.
entries.en: And he carried away Jehoiachin to Babylon, and the king's mother, and the king's wives, and his officers, and the mighty of the land, those carried he into captivity from Jerusalem to Babylon.

entries.yo: Ati gbogbo awọn ọkunrin ọlọla, ẹ̃dẹgbãrin, ati awọn oniṣọnà ati awọn alagbẹdẹ ẹgbẹrun, gbogbo awọn ti o li agbara ti o si yẹ fun ogun, ani awọn li ọba Babeli kó ni igbèkun lọ si Babeli.
entries.en: And all the men of might, even seven thousand, and craftsmen and smiths a thousand, all that were strong and apt for war, even them the king of Babylon brought captive to Babylon.

entries.yo: Ọba Babeli si fi Mattaniah arakunrin baba rẹ̀ jọba ni ipò rẹ̀, o si pa orukọ rẹ̀ dà si Sedekiah.
entries.en: And the king of Babylon made Mattaniah his father's brother king in his stead, and changed his name to Zedekiah.

entries.yo: Ẹni ọdun mọkanlelogun ni Sedekiah nigbati o bẹ̀rẹ si ijọba, o si jọba li ọdun mọkanla ni Jerusalemu. Orukọ iya rẹ̀ ni Hamutali, ọmọbinrin Jeremiah ti Libna.
entries.en: Zedekiah was twenty and one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

entries.yo: O si ṣe eyiti o buru li oju Oluwa, gẹgẹ bi gbogbo eyiti Jehoiakimu ti ṣe.
entries.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.

entries.yo: Nitori nipa ibinu Oluwa li o ṣẹ si Jerusalemu ati Juda, titi o fi ta wọn nù kuro niwaju rẹ̀; Sedekiah si ṣọ̀tẹ si ọba Babeli.
entries.en: For through the anger of the LORD it came to pass in Jerusalem and Judah, until he had cast them out from his presence, that Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.

entries.yo: O si ṣe li ọdun kẹsan ijọba rẹ̀, li oṣù kẹwa, li ọjọ kẹwa oṣù, ni Nebukadnessari ọba Babeli de, on, ati gbogbo ogun rẹ̀, si Jerusalemu, o si dotì i; nwọn si mọdi tì i yika kiri.
entries.en: And it came to pass in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, he, and all his host, against Jerusalem, and pitched against it; and they built forts against it round about.

entries.yo: A si dotì ilu na titi di ọdun ikọkanla Sedekiah.
entries.en: And the city was besieged unto the eleventh year of king Zedekiah.

entries.yo: Ati li ọjọ kẹsan oṣù kẹrin, iyàn mu gidigidi ni ilu, kò si si onjẹ fun awọn enia ilẹ na.
entries.en: And on the ninth day of the fourth month the famine prevailed in the city, and there was no bread for the people of the land.

entries.yo: Ilu na si fọ́, gbogbo awọn ọkunrin ologun si gbà ọ̀na bodè lãrin odi meji, ti o wà leti ọgbà ọba, salọ li oru; (awọn ara Kaldea si yi ilu na kakiri;) ọba si ba ọ̀na pẹ̀tẹlẹ lọ.
entries.en: And the city was broken up, and all the men of war fled by night by the way of the gate between two walls, which is by the king's garden: (now the Chaldees were against the city round about:) and the king went the way toward the plain.

entries.yo: Ogun awọn ara Kaldea si lepa ọba, nwọn si ba a ni pẹ̀tẹlẹ Jeriko: gbogbo ogun rẹ̀ si tuka kuro lọdọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the army of the Chaldees pursued after the king, and overtook him in the plains of Jericho: and all his army were scattered from him.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni nwọn mu ọba, nwọn si mu u gòke lọ si ọdọ ọba Babeli ni Ribla; nwọn si sọ ọ̀rọ idajọ lori rẹ̀.
entries.en: So they took the king, and brought him up to the king of Babylon to Riblah; and they gave judgment upon him.

entries.yo: Nwọn si pa awọn ọmọ Sedekiah li oju rẹ̀, nwọn si fọ Sedekiah li oju, nwọn si fi ẹwọn idẹ dè e, nwọn si mu u lọ si Babeli.
entries.en: And they slew the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes, and put out the eyes of Zedekiah, and bound him with fetters of brass, and carried him to Babylon.

entries.yo: Ati li oṣù karun, li ọjọ keje oṣù, ti iṣe ọdun ikọkandilogun Nebukadnessari ọba, ọba Babeli, ni Nebusaradani olori ẹ̀ṣọ, iranṣẹ ọba Babeli, wá si Jerusalemu:
entries.en: And in the fifth month, on the seventh day of the month, which is the nineteenth year of king Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, came Nebuzar-adan, captain of the guard, a servant of the king of Babylon, unto Jerusalem:

entries.yo: O si fi ile Oluwa joná, ati ile ọba, ati gbogbo ile Jerusalemu, ati gbogbo ile enia nla li o fi iná sun.
entries.en: And he burnt the house of the LORD, and the king's house, and all the houses of Jerusalem, and every great man's house burnt he with fire.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ogun awọn ara Kaldea ti o wà lọdọ olori ẹ̀ṣọ, si wó odi Jerusalemu palẹ yika kiri.
entries.en: And all the army of the Chaldees, that were with the captain of the guard, brake down the walls of Jerusalem round about.

entries.yo: Ati iyokù awọn enia ti o kù ni ilu ati awọn isansa ti o ya tọ̀ ọba, Babeli lọ, pẹlu ọ̀pọlọpọ enia ti o kù, ni Nebusaradani olori ẹ̀ṣọ kó lọ.
entries.en: Now the rest of the people that were left in the city, and the fugitives that fell away to the king of Babylon, with the remnant of the multitude, did Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard carry away.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn olori ẹ̀ṣọ fi awọn talakà ilẹ na silẹ, lati mã ṣe alabojuto àjara ati lati mã ṣe aroko.
entries.en: But the captain of the guard left of the poor of the land to be vinedressers and husbandmen.

entries.yo: Ati ọwọ̀n idẹ wọnni ti mbẹ ni ile Oluwa, ati ijoko wọnni, ati agbada-nla idẹ ti o wà ni ile Oluwa, li awọn ara Kaldea fọ tũtu, nwọn si kó idẹ wọn lọ si Babeli.
entries.en: And the pillars of brass that were in the house of the LORD, and the bases, and the brasen sea that was in the house of the LORD, did the Chaldees break in pieces, and carried the brass of them to Babylon.

entries.yo: Ati ikòko wọnni, ati ọkọ wọnni, ati alumagàji fitila wọnni, ati ṣibi wọnni, ati gbogbo ohun-èlo wọnni ti nwọn fi nṣiṣẹ, ni nwọn kó lọ.
entries.en: And the pots, and the shovels, and the snuffers, and the spoons, and all the vessels of brass wherewith they ministered, took they away.

entries.yo: Ati ohun ifọnná wọnni, ati ọpọ́n wọnni, eyi ti iṣe ti wura, ni wura, ati eyi ti iṣe ti fadakà ni fadakà, ni olori ẹ̀ṣọ kó lọ.
entries.en: And the firepans, and the bowls, and such things as were of gold, in gold, and of silver, in silver, the captain of the guard took away.

entries.yo: Awọn ọ̀wọn meji, agbada-nla kan, ati ijoko wọnni ti Solomoni ti ṣe fun ile Oluwa; idẹ ni gbogbo ohun-èlo wọnyi, alaini ìwọn ni.
entries.en: The two pillars, one sea, and the bases which Solomon had made for the house of the LORD; the brass of all these vessels was without weight.

entries.yo: Giga ọwọ̀n kan ni igbọ̀nwọ mejidilogun, ati ọnà-ori rẹ̀ idẹ ni: ati giga ọnà-ori na ni igbọ̀nwọ mẹta; ati iṣẹ wiwun na, ati awọn pomegranate ti o wà lori ọnà-ori na yika kiri, gbogbo rẹ̀ ti idẹ ni: gẹgẹ bi awọn wọnyi si ni ọwọ̀n keji pẹlu iṣẹ wiwun.
entries.en: The height of the one pillar was eighteen cubits, and the chapiter upon it was brass: and the height of the chapiter three cubits; and the wreathen work, and pomegranates upon the chapiter round about, all of brass: and like unto these had the second pillar with wreathen work.

entries.yo: Olori ẹ̀ṣọ si mu Seraiah olori ninu awọn alufa, ati Sefaniah alufa keji, ati awọn olùṣọ iloro mẹta.
entries.en: And the captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, and Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the door:

entries.yo: Ati lati inu ilu, o mu iwẹ̀fa kan ti a fi ṣe olori awọn ologun, ati ọkunrin marun ninu awọn ti o wà niwaju ọba, ti a ri ni ilu, ati akọwe olori ogun, ti ntò awọn enia ilẹ na, ati ọgọta ọkunrin ninu awọn enia ilẹ na ti a ri ni ilu.
entries.en: And out of the city he took an officer that was set over the men of war, and five men of them that were in the king's presence, which were found in the city, and the principal scribe of the host, which mustered the people of the land, and threescore men of the people of the land that were found in the city:

entries.yo: Nebusaradani olori ẹ̀ṣọ si kó awọn wọnyi, o si mu wọn tọ̀ ọba Babeli wá si Ribla.
entries.en: And Nebuzar-adan captain of the guard took these, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah:

entries.yo: Ọba Babeli si kọlù wọn, o si pa wọn ni Ribla ni ilẹ Hamati. Bẹ̃li a mu Juda kuro ni ilẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the king of Babylon smote them, and slew them at Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Judah was carried away out of their land.

entries.yo: Ati awọn enia ti o kù ni ilẹ Juda, ti Nebukadnessari ọba Babeli fi silẹ, ani, o fi Gedaliah ọmọ Ahikamu, ọmọ Ṣafani, jẹ bãlẹ wọn.
entries.en: And as for the people that remained in the land of Judah, whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had left, even over them he made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, ruler.

entries.yo: Nigbati gbogbo awọn olori ogun, awọn ati awọn ọkunrin wọn, si gbọ́ pe ọba Babeli ti fi Gedaliah jẹ bãlẹ, nwọn tọ̀ Gedaliah wá ni Mispa, ani Iṣmaeli ọmọ Netaniah, ati Johanani ọmọ Karea, ati Seraiah ọmọ Tanhumeti ara Netofati, ati Jaasaniah ọmọ ara Maaka, awọn ati awọn ọkunrin wọn.
entries.en: And when all the captains of the armies, they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah governor, there came to Gedaliah to Mizpah, even Ishmael the son of Nethahiah, and Johanan the son of Careah, and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, and Jaazaniah the son of a Maachathite, they and their men.

entries.yo: Gedaliah si bura fun wọn, ati fun awọn ọkunrin wọn, o si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ má bẹ̀ru lati sìn awọn ara Kaldea: ẹ mã gbe ilẹ na, ki ẹ si mã sìn ọba Babeli; yio si dara fun nyin.
entries.en: And Gedaliah sware to them, and to their men, and said unto them, Fear not to be the servants of the Chaldees: dwell in the land, and serve the king of Babylon; and it shall be well with you.

entries.yo: O si ṣe li oṣù keje, ni Iṣmaeli ọmọ Netaniah, ọmọ Eliṣama ninu iru ọmọ ọba, wá ati ọkunrin mẹwa pẹlu rẹ̀, o si kọlù Gedaliah, o si kú, ati awọn ara Juda ati awọn ara Kaldea ti o wà pẹlu rẹ̀ ni Mispa.
entries.en: But it came to pass in the seventh month, that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, of the seed royal, came, and ten men with him, and smote Gedaliah, that he died, and the Jews and the Chaldees that were with him at Mizpah.

entries.yo: Ati gbogbo enia, ti ewe ti àgba, ati awọn olori ogun, si dide, nwọn si wá si Egipti: nitoriti nwọn bẹ̀ru ara Kaldea.
entries.en: And all the people, both small and great, and the captains of the armies, arose, and came to Egypt: for they were afraid of the Chaldees.

entries.yo: O si ṣe li ọdun kẹtadilogoji igbèkun Jehoiakini ọba Juda, li oṣù kejila, li ọjọ kẹtadilọgbọn oṣù, Efil-merodaki ọba Babeli, li ọdun ti o bẹ̀rẹ si ijọba, o gbé ori Jehoiakini ọba Juda soke kuro ninu tubu;
entries.en: And it came to pass in the seven and thirtieth year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, on the seven and twentieth day of the month, that Evil-merodach king of Babylon in the year that he began to reign did lift up the head of Jehoiachin king of Judah out of prison;

entries.yo: O si sọ̀rọ rere fun u, o si gbé ìtẹ rẹ̀ ga jù ìtẹ awọn ọba ti o wà pẹlu rẹ̀ ni Babeli.
entries.en: And he spake kindly to him, and set his throne above the throne of the kings that were with him in Babylon;

entries.yo: O si pàrọ awọn aṣọ tubu rẹ̀: o si njẹun nigbagbogbo niwaju rẹ̀ ni gbogbo ọjọ aiye rẹ̀.
entries.en: And changed his prison garments: and he did eat bread continually before him all the days of his life.

entries.yo: Ati ipin onjẹ tirẹ̀, jẹ ipin onjẹ ti ọba nfi fun u nigbagbogbo, iye kan li ojojumọ, ni gbogbo ọjọ aiye rẹ̀.
entries.en: And his allowance was a continual allowance given him of the king, a daily rate for every day, all the days of his life.

entries.yo: ADAMU, Seti, Enoṣi,
entries.en: Adam, Sheth, Enosh,

entries.yo: Kenani, Mahalaleeli, Jeredi,
entries.en: Kenan, Mahalaleel, Jered,

entries.yo: Henoki, Metusela, Lameki,
entries.en: Henoch, Methuselah, Lamech,

entries.yo: Noa, Ṣemu, Hamu, ati Jafeti,
entries.en: Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Jafeti; Gomeri, ati Magogu, ati Madai, ati Jafani, ati Tubali, ati Meṣeki, ati Tirasi,
entries.en: The sons of Japheth; Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Gomeri; Aṣkenasi, ati Rifati, ati Togarma.
entries.en: And the sons of Gomer; Ashchenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Jafani; Eliṣa, ati Tarṣiṣi, Kittimu, ati Dodanimu.
entries.en: And the sons of Javan; Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Hamu; Kuṣi, ati Misraimu, Puti, ati Kenaani.
entries.en: The sons of Ham; Cush, and Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Kuṣi; Ṣeba, ati Hafila, ati Sabta, ati Raama, ati Sabteka. Ati awọn ọmọ Raama; Ṣeba ati Dedani.
entries.en: And the sons of Cush; Seba, and Havilah, and Sabta, and Raamah, and Sabtecha. And the sons of Raamah; Sheba, and Dedan.

entries.yo: Kuṣi si bi Nimrodu: on bẹ̀rẹ si di alagbara li aiye.
entries.en: And Cush begat Nimrod: he began to be mighty upon the earth.

entries.yo: Misraimu si bi Ludimu, ati Anamimu, ati Lehabimu, ati Naftuhimu,
entries.en: And Mizraim begat Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,

entries.yo: Ati Patrusimu, ati Kasluhimu, (lọdọ ẹniti awọn ara Filistia ti wá,) ati Kaftorimu.
entries.en: And Pathrusim, and Casluhim, (of whom came the Philistines,) and Caphthorim.

entries.yo: Kenaani si bi Sidoni akọbi rẹ̀, ati Heti,
entries.en: And Canaan begat Zidon his firstborn, and Heth,

entries.yo: Ati awọn ara Jebusi, ati awọn ara Amori, ati awọn ara Girgaṣi,
entries.en: The Jebusite also, and the Amorite, and the Girgashite,

entries.yo: Ati awọn ara Hifi, ati awọn ara Arki, ati awọn ara Sini,
entries.en: And the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,

entries.yo: Ati awọn ara Arfadi, ati awọn ara Semari, ati awọn ara Hamati.
entries.en: And the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Ṣemu; Elamu, ati Assuri, ati Arfaksadi, ati Ludi, ati Aramu, ati Usi, ati Huli, ati Geteri, ati Meṣeki.
entries.en: The sons of Shem; Elam, and Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram, and Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Meshech.

entries.yo: Arfaksadi si bi Ṣela; Ṣela si bi Eberi.
entries.en: And Arphaxad begat Shelah, and Shelah begat Eber.

entries.yo: Ati fun Eberi li a bi ọmọkunrin meji: orukọ ọkan ni Pelegi; nitori li ọjọ rẹ̀ li a pin aiye niya: orukọ arakunrin rẹ̀ si ni Joktani.
entries.en: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg; because in his days the earth was divided: and his brother's name was Joktan.

entries.yo: Joktani si bi Almodadi, ati Ṣelefi, ati Hasarmafeti, ati Jera,
entries.en: And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,

entries.yo: Ati Hadoramu, ati Usali, ati Dikla,
entries.en: Hadoram also, and Uzal, and Diklah,

entries.yo: Ati Ebali, ati Abimaeli, ati Ṣeba,
entries.en: And Ebal, and Abimael, and Sheba,

entries.yo: Ati Ofiri, ati Hafila, ati Jobabu. Gbogbo wọnyi li awọn ọmọ Joktani.
entries.en: And Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.

entries.yo: Ṣemu, Arfaksadi, Ṣela,
entries.en: Shem, Arphaxad, Shelah,

entries.yo: Eberi, Pelegi, Reu,
entries.en: Eber, Peleg, Reu,

entries.yo: Serugu, Nahori, Tera,
entries.en: Serug, Nahor, Terah,

entries.yo: Abramu; on na ni Abrahamu,
entries.en: Abram; the same is Abraham.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Abrahamu; Isaaki, ati Iṣmaeli.
entries.en: The sons of Abraham; Isaac, and Ishmael.

entries.yo: Wọnyi ni iran wọn: akọbi Iṣmaeli, Nebaioti; ati Kedari, ati Adbeeli, ati Mibsamu,
entries.en: These are their generations: The firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth; then Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,

entries.yo: Miṣma, ati Duma, Massa, Hadadi, ati Tema,
entries.en: Mishma and Dumah, Massa, Hadad, and Tema,

entries.yo: Jeturi, Nafiṣi, ati Kedema. Wọnyi li awọn ọmọ Iṣmaeli.
entries.en: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Ketura, obinrin Abrahamu: on bi Simrani, ati Jokṣani, ati Medani, ati Midiani, ati Iṣbaki, ati Ṣua. Ati awọn ọmọ Jokṣani: Ṣeba, ati Dedani.
entries.en: Now the sons of Keturah, Abraham's concubine: she bare Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah. And the sons of Jokshan; Sheba, and Dedan.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Midiani: Efa, ati Eferi, ati Henoki, ati Abida, ani Eldaa. Gbogbo wọnyi li awọn ọmọ Ketura.
entries.en: And the sons of Midian; Ephah, and Epher, and Henoch, and Abida, and Eldaah. All these are the sons of Keturah.

entries.yo: Abrahamu si bi Isaaki. Awọn ọmọ Isaaki; Esau ati Israeli.
entries.en: And Abraham begat Isaac. The sons of Isaac; Esau and Israel.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Esau; Elifasi, Reueli, ati Jeusi, ati Jaalamu, ati Kora.
entries.en: The sons of Esau; Eliphaz, Reuel, and Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Elifasi; Temani, ati Omari, Sefi, ati Gatamu, Kenasi, ati Timna, ati Amaleki.
entries.en: The sons of Eliphaz; Teman, and Omar, Zephi, and Gatam, Kenaz, and Timna, and Amalek.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Reueli: Nahati, Sera, Ṣamma, ati Missa.
entries.en: The sons of Reuel; Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Seiri; Lotani, ati Ṣobali, ati Sibeoni, ati Ana, ati Diṣoni, ati Esari, ati Diṣani.
entries.en: And the sons of Seir; Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah, and Dishon, and Ezer, and Dishan.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Lotani; Hori, ati Homamu: Timna si ni arabinrin Lotani.
entries.en: And the sons of Lothan; Hori, and Homam: and Timna was Lotan's sister.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Ṣobali; Aliani, ati Manahati, ati Ebali, Ṣefi, ati Onamu. Ati awọn ọmọ Sibeoni; Aiah, ati Ana.
entries.en: The sons of Shobal; Alian, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. And the sons of Zibeon; Aiah, and Anah.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Ana; Diṣoni. Ati awọn ọmọ Diṣoni; Amrani, ati Eṣbani, ati Itrani, ati Kerani.
entries.en: The sons of Anah; Dishon. And the sons of Dishon; Amram, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Eseri; Bilhani, ati Safani, ati Jakani. Awọn ọmọ Diṣani; Usi, ati Arani.
entries.en: The sons of Ezer; Bilhan, and Zavan, and Jakan. The sons of Dishan; Uz, and Aran.

entries.yo: Wọnyi si ni awọn ọba ti o jẹ ni ilẹ Edomu, ki ọba kan to jẹ lori awọn ọmọ Israeli: Bela ọmọ Beori: orukọ ilu rẹ̀ si ni Dinhaba.
entries.en: Now these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned over the children of Israel; Bela the son of Beor: and the name of his city was Dinhabah.

entries.yo: Nigbati Bela si kú, Jobabu ọmọ Sera ti Bosra si jọba ni ipò rẹ̀.
entries.en: And when Bela was dead, Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.

entries.yo: Nigbati Jobabu kú, Huṣamu ti ilẹ awọn ara Temani si jọba ni ipò rẹ̀.
entries.en: And when Jobab was dead, Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his stead.

entries.yo: Nigbati Huṣamu kú, Hadadi ọmọ Bedadi, ti o kọlu Midiani ni ìgbẹ Moabu, jọba ni ipò rẹ̀: orukọ ilu rẹ̀ ni Afiti.
entries.en: And when Husham was dead, Hadad the son of Bedad, which smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Avith.

entries.yo: Nigbati Hadadi kú, Samla ti Masreka jọba ni ipò rẹ̀.
entries.en: And when Hadad was dead, Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.

entries.yo: Nigbati Samla kú, Ṣaulu ti Rehoboti leti odò jọba ni ipò rẹ̀.
entries.en: And when Samlah was dead, Shaul of Rehoboth by the river reigned in his stead.

entries.yo: Nigbati Ṣaulu kú, Baal-hanani, ọmọ Akbori, jọba ni ipò rẹ̀.
entries.en: And when Shaul was dead, Baal-hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.

entries.yo: Nigbati Baal-hanani kú, Hadadi si jọba ni ipò rẹ̀: orukọ ilu rẹ̀ ni Pai; orukọ aya rẹ̀ si ni Mehetabeeli, ọmọbinrin Matredi, ọmọbinrin Mesahabu.
entries.en: And when Baal-hanan was dead, Hadad reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Pai; and his wife's name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.

entries.yo: Hadadi si kú. Awọn bãlẹ Edomu ni; Timna bãlẹ, Aliah bãlẹ, Jeteti bãlẹ.
entries.en: Hadad died also. And the dukes of Edom were; duke Timnah, duke Aliah, duke Jetheth,

entries.yo: Aholibama bãlẹ, Ela bãlẹ, Pinoni bãlẹ,
entries.en: Duke Aholibamah, duke Elah, duke Pinon,

entries.yo: Kenasi bãlẹ, Temani bãlẹ, Mibsari bãlẹ,
entries.en: Duke Kenaz, duke Teman, duke Mibzar,

entries.yo: Magdieli bãlẹ, Iramu bãlẹ. Wọnyi ni awọn bãlẹ Edomu.
entries.en: Duke Magdiel, duke Iram. These are the dukes of Edom.

entries.yo: WỌNYI ni awọn ọmọ Israeli; Rubeni, Simeoni, Lefi, ati Juda, Issakari, ati Sebuluni,
entries.en: These are the sons of Israel; Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun,

entries.yo: Dani, Josefu, ati Benjamini, Naftali, Gadi, ati Aṣeri.
entries.en: Dan, Joseph, and Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Juda; Eri, ati Onani, ati Ṣela; awọn mẹta yi ni Batṣua, ara Kenaani, bi fun u. Eri, akọbi Juda, si buru loju Oluwa; on si pa a.
entries.en: The sons of Judah; Er, and Onan, and Shelah: which three were born unto him of the daughter of Shua the Canaanitess. And Er, the firstborn of Judah, was evil in the sight of the LORD; and he slew him.

entries.yo: Tamari aya-ọmọ rẹ̀ si bi Faresi ati Sera fun u. Gbogbo awọn ọmọ Juda jẹ marun.
entries.en: And Tamar his daughter in law bare him Pharez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah were five.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Faresi; Hesroni; ati Hamuli.
entries.en: The sons of Pharez; Hezron, and Hamul.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Sera; Simri, ati Etani, ati Hemani, ati Kalkoli, ati Dara: gbogbo wọn jẹ marun.
entries.en: And the sons of Zerah; Zimri, and Ethan, and Heman, and Calcol, and Dara: five of them in all.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Karmi; Akari, oniyọnu Israeli, ẹniti o dẹṣẹ niti ohun iyasọtọ̀.
entries.en: And the sons of Carmi; Achar, the troubler of Israel, who transgressed in the thing accursed.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Etani; Asariah.
entries.en: And the sons of Ethan; Azariah.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Hesroni pẹlu ti a bi fun u; Jerahmeeli, ati Ramu, ati Kelubai.
entries.en: The sons also of Hezron, that were born unto him; Jerahmeel, and Ram, and Chelubai.

entries.yo: Ramu si bi Amminadabu; Amminadabu si bi Naṣoni, ijoye awọn ọmọ Juda;
entries.en: And Ram begat Amminadab; and Amminadab begat Nahshon, prince of the children of Judah;

entries.yo: Naṣoni si bi Salma, Salma si bi Boasi.
entries.en: And Nahshon begat Salma, and Salma begat Boaz,

entries.yo: Boasi si bi Obedi, Obedi si bi Jesse,
entries.en: And Boaz begat Obed, and Obed begat Jesse,

entries.yo: Jesse si bi Eliabu akọbi rẹ̀, ati Abinadabu àtẹle, ati Ṣimma ẹkẹta.
entries.en: And Jesse begat his firstborn Eliab, and Abinadab the second, and Shimma the third,

entries.yo: Netanneeli ẹkẹrin, Raddai ẹkarun,
entries.en: Nethaneel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,

entries.yo: Osemu ẹkẹfa, Dafidi ekeje:
entries.en: Ozem the sixth, David the seventh:

entries.yo: Awọn arabinrin wọn ni Seruiah ati Abigaili. Ati awọn ọmọ Seruiah; Abiṣai, ati Joabu, ati Asaeli, mẹta.
entries.en: Whose sisters were Zeruiah, and Abigail. And the sons of Zeruiah; Abishai, and Joab, and Asahel, three.

entries.yo: Abigaili si bi Amasa: baba Amasa si ni Jeteri ara Iṣmeeli.
entries.en: And Abigail bare Amasa: and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmeelite.

entries.yo: Kalebu ọmọ Hesroni si bi ọmọ lati ọdọ Asuba aya rẹ̀, ati lati ọdọ Jeriotu: awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ ni wọnyi; Jeṣeri, ati Ṣohabu, ati Ardoni.
entries.en: And Caleb the son of Hezron begat children of Azubah his wife, and of Jerioth: her sons are these; Jesher, and Shobab, and Ardon.

entries.yo: Nigbati Asuba kú, Kalebu mu Efrati, ẹniti o bi Huri fun u.
entries.en: And when Azubah was dead, Caleb took unto him Ephrath, which bare him Hur.

entries.yo: Huri si bi Uru, Uru si bi Besaleeli.
entries.en: And Hur begat Uri, and Uri begat Bezaleel.

entries.yo: Lẹhin na Hesroni si wọle tọ̀ ọmọ Makiri obinrin baba Gileadi, on gbe e ni iyawo nigbati o di ẹni ọgọta ọdun, on si bi Segubu fun u.
entries.en: And afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he married when he was threescore years old; and she bare him Segub.

entries.yo: Segubu si bi Jairi, ti o ni ilu mẹtalelogun ni ilẹ Gileadi.
entries.en: And Segub begat Jair, who had three and twenty cities in the land of Gilead.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Geṣuri, ati Aramu, gbà ilu Jairi lọwọ wọn, pẹlu Kenati, ati ilu rẹ̀: ani ọgọta ilu. Gbogbo wọnyi ni awọn ọmọ Makiri baba Gileadi.
entries.en: And he took Geshur, and Aram, with the towns of Jair, from them, with Kenath, and the towns thereof, even threescore cities. All these belonged to the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.

entries.yo: Ati lẹhin igbati Hesroni kú ni ilu Kaleb-Efrata, ni Abiah aya Hesroni bi Aṣuri baba Tekoa fun u.
entries.en: And after that Hezron was dead in Caleb-ephratah, then Abiah Hezron's wife bare him Ashur the father of Tekoa.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Jerahmeeli, akọbi Hesroni, ni Rama akọbi, ati Buna, ati Oreni, ati Osemu, ati Ahijah.
entries.en: And the sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron were, Ram the firstborn, and Bunah, and Oren, and Ozem, and Ahijah.

entries.yo: Jerahmeeli si ni obinrin miran pẹlu, orukọ ẹniti ijẹ Atara; on ni iṣe iya Onamu.
entries.en: Jerahmeel had also another wife, whose name was Atarah; she was the mother of Onam.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Ramu akọbi Jerahmeeli ni, Maasi, ati Jamini, ati Ekeri.
entries.en: And the sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel were, Maaz, and Jamin, and Eker.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Onamu si ni, Ṣammai, ati Jada. Awọn ọmọ Ṣammai ni; Nadabu ati Abiṣuri.
entries.en: And the sons of Onam were, Shammai, and Jada. And the sons of Shammai; Nadab, and Abishur.

entries.yo: Orukọ aya Abiṣuri si njẹ Abihaili, on si bi Abani, ati Molidi fun u.
entries.en: And the name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail, and she bare him Ahban, and Molid.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Nadabu; Seledi, ati Appaimu: ṣugbọn Seledi kú laini ọmọ.
entries.en: And the sons of Nadab; Seled, and Appaim: but Seled died without children.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Appaimu; Iṣi. Ati awọn ọmọ Iṣi; Ṣeṣani. Ati awọn ọmọ Ṣeṣani. Ahlai.
entries.en: And the sons of Appaim; Ishi. And the sons of Ishi; Sheshan. And the children of Sheshan; Ahlai.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Jada arakunrin Ṣammai; Jeteri, ati Jonatani; Jeteri si kú laini ọmọ.
entries.en: And the sons of Jada the brother of Shammai; Jether and Jonathan: and Jether died without children.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Jonatani; Peleti, ati Sasa. Wọnyi ni awọn ọmọ Jerahmeeli.
entries.en: And the sons of Jonathan; Peleth, and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.

entries.yo: Ṣeṣani kò si ni ọmọkunrin, bikọṣe ọmọbinrin. Ṣeṣani si ni iranṣẹ kan, ara Egipti, orukọ, ẹniti ijẹ Jarha.
entries.en: Now Sheshan had no sons, but daughters. And Sheshan had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Jarha.

entries.yo: Ṣeṣani si fi ọmọbinrin rẹ̀ fun Jarha iranṣẹ rẹ̀ li aya; on si bi Attai fun u.
entries.en: And Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant to wife; and she bare him Attai.

entries.yo: Attai si bi Natani, Natani si bi Sabadi,
entries.en: And Attai begat Nathan, and Nathan begat Zabad,

entries.yo: Sabadi si bi Eflali, Eflali si bi Obedi,
entries.en: And Zabad begat Ephlal, and Ephlal begat Obed,

entries.yo: Obedi si bi Jehu, Jehu si bi Asariah,
entries.en: And Obed begat Jehu, and Jehu begat Azariah,

entries.yo: Asariah si bi Helesi, Helesi si bi Elasa,
entries.en: And Azariah begat Helez, and Helez begat Eleasah,

entries.yo: Elasa si bi Sisamai, Sisamai si bi Ṣallumu,
entries.en: And Eleasah begat Sisamai, and Sisamai begat Shallum,

entries.yo: Ṣallumu si bi Jekamiah, Jekamiah si bi Eliṣama.
entries.en: And Shallum begat Jekamiah, and Jekamiah begat Elishama.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Kalebu arakunrin Jerahmeeli si ni Meṣa akọbi rẹ̀, ti iṣe baba Sifi; ati awọn ọmọ Mareṣa baba Hebroni.
entries.en: Now the sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were, Mesha his firstborn, which was the father of Ziph; and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Hebroni; Kora, ati Tappua, ati Rekemu, ati Ṣema.
entries.en: And the sons of Hebron; Korah, and Tappuah, and Rekem, and Shema.

entries.yo: Ṣema si bi Rahamu, baba Jorkeamu: Rekemu si bi Ṣammai.
entries.en: And Shema begat Raham, the father of Jorkoam: and Rekem begat Shammai.

entries.yo: Ati ọmọ Ṣammai ni Maoni: Maoni si ni baba Bet-suri.
entries.en: And the son of Shammai was Maon: and Maon was the father of Beth-zur.

entries.yo: Efa obinrin Kalebu si bi Harani, ati Mosa, ati Gasesi: Harani si bi Gasesi.
entries.en: And Ephah, Caleb's concubine, bare Haran, and Moza, and Gazez: and Haran begat Gazez.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Jahdai; Regemu, ati Jotamu, ati Geṣamu, ati Peleti, ati Efa, ati Ṣaafu.
entries.en: And the sons of Jahdai; Regem, and Jotham, and Geshan, and Pelet, and Ephah, and Shaaph.

entries.yo: Maaka obinrin Kalebu bi Ṣeberi, ati Tirhana.
entries.en: Maachah, Caleb's concubine, bare Sheber, and Tirhanah.

entries.yo: On si bi Ṣaafa baba Madmana, Ṣefa baba Makbena, ati baba Gibea: ọmọbinrin Kalebu si ni Aksa.
entries.en: She bare also Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbenah, and the father of Gibea: and the daughter of Caleb was Achsah.

entries.yo: Wọnyi li awọn ọmọ Kalebu ọmọ Huri, akọbi Efrata; Ṣobali baba Kirjat-jearimu,
entries.en: These were the sons of Caleb the son of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah; Shobal the father of Kirjath-jearim,

entries.yo: Salma baba Bet-lehemu, Harefu baba Bet-gaderi.
entries.en: Salma the father of Bethlehem, Hareph the father of Beth-gader.

entries.yo: Ati Ṣobali baba Kirjat-jearimu ni ọmọ; Haroe, ati idaji awọn ara Manaheti.
entries.en: And Shobal the father of Kirjath-jearim had sons; Haroeh, and half of the Manahethites.

entries.yo: Ati awọn idile Kirjat-jearimu; awọn ara Itri, ati awọn ara Puti, ati awọn ara Ṣummati, ati awọn ara Misrai; lọdọ wọn li awọn ara Sareati, ati awọn ara Ẹstauli ti wá.
entries.en: And the families of Kirjath-jearim; the Ithrites, and the Puhites, and the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; of them came the Zareathites, and the Eshtaulites.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Salma; Betlehemu, ati awọn ara Netofati, Ataroti, ile Joabu, ati idaji awọn ara Manahati, awọn ara Sori.
entries.en: The sons of Salma; Bethlehem, and the Netophathites, Ataroth, the house of Joab, and half of the Manahethites, the Zorites.

entries.yo: Ati idile awọn akọwe ti ngbe Jabesi; awọn ara Tira, awọn ara Ṣimeati, ati awọn ara Sukati. Wọnyi li awọn ara Keni ti o ti ọdọ Hemati wá, baba ile Rekabu.
entries.en: And the families of the scribes which dwelt at Jabez; the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and Suchathites. These are the Kenites that came of Hemath, the father of the house of Rechab.

entries.yo: WỌNYI li awọn ọmọ Dafidi, ti a bi fun u ni Hebroni; akọbi Amnoni, lati ọdọ Ahinoamu ara Jesreeli; ekeji Danieli, lati ọdọ Abigaili ara Karmeli;
entries.en: Now these were the sons of David, which were born unto him in Hebron; the firstborn Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second Daniel, of Abigail the Carmelitess:

entries.yo: Ẹkẹta, Absalomu ọmọ Maaka ọmọbinrin Talmai ọba Gesuri; ẹkẹrin, Adonijah ọmọ Haggiti.
entries.en: The third, Absalom the son of Maachah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur: the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith:

entries.yo: Ẹkarun, Ṣefatiah lati ọdọ Abitali; ẹkẹfa Itreamu lati ọdọ Ẹgla aya rẹ̀.
entries.en: The fifth, Shephatiah of Abital: the sixth, Ithream by Eglah his wife.

entries.yo: Awọn mẹfa wọnyi li a bi fun u ni Hebroni; nibẹ li o si jọba li ọdun meje on oṣù mẹfa: ati ni Jerusalemu li o jọba li ọdun mẹtalelọgbọn.
entries.en: These six were born unto him in Hebron; and there he reigned seven years and six months: and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years.

entries.yo: Wọnyi li a si bi fun u ni Jerusalemu; Ṣimea, ati Ṣobabu, ati Natani, ati Solomoni, mẹrin, lati ọdọ Batṣua ọmọbinrin Ammieli:
entries.en: And these were born unto him in Jerusalem; Shimea, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon, four, of Bath-shua the daughter of Ammiel:

entries.yo: Abhari pẹlu, ati Eliṣama, ati Elifeleti,
entries.en: Ibhar also, and Elishama, and Eliphelet,

entries.yo: Ati Noga, ati Nefegi, ati Jafia,
entries.en: And Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,

entries.yo: Ati Eliṣama, ati Eliada, ati Elifeleti mẹsan.
entries.en: And Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine.

entries.yo: Wọnyi ni gbogbo awọn ọmọ Dafidi, laika awọn ọmọ àle rẹ̀, ati Tamari arabinrin wọn.
entries.en: These were all the sons of David, beside the sons of the concubines, and Tamar their sister.

entries.yo: Ọmọ Solomoni si ni Rehoboamu, Abia ọmọ rẹ̀, Asa ọmọ rẹ̀, Jehoṣafati ọmọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Solomon's son was Rehoboam, Abia his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,

entries.yo: Joramu ọmọ rẹ̀, Ahasiah ọmọ rẹ̀, Joaṣi ọmọ rẹ̀,
entries.en: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,

entries.yo: Amasiah ọmọ rẹ̀, Asariah ọmọ rẹ̀, Jotamu ọmọ rẹ̀,
entries.en: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,

entries.yo: Ahasi ọmọ rẹ̀, Hesekiah ọmọ rẹ̀, Manasse ọmọ rẹ̀,
entries.en: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,

entries.yo: Amoni ọmọ rẹ̀, Josiah ọmọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Amon his son, Josiah his son.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Josiah; akọbi Johanani, ekeji Jehoiakimu, ẹkẹta Sedekiah, ẹkẹrin Ṣallumu.
entries.en: And the sons of Josiah were, the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, the fourth Shallum.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Jehoiakimu: Jekoniah ọmọ rẹ̀, Sedekiah ọmọ rẹ̀,
entries.en: And the sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, Zedekiah his son.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Jekoniah; Assiri, Salatieli ọmọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the sons of Jeconiah; Assir, Salathiel his son,

entries.yo: Malkiramu pẹlu, ati Pedaiah, ati Ṣenasari, Jekamiah, Hoṣama ati Nehabiah,
entries.en: Malchiram also, and Pedaiah, and Shenazar, Jecamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Pedaiah; Serubbabeli; ati Ṣimei; ati awọn ọmọ Serubbabeli; Meṣullamu, ati Hananiah, ati Ṣelomiti arabinrin wọn:
entries.en: And the sons of Pedaiah were, Zerubbabel, and Shimei: and the sons of Zerubbabel; Meshullam, and Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister:

entries.yo: Ati Haṣuba, ati Oheli, ati Berekiah, ati Hasadiah, Juṣab-hesedi, marun.
entries.en: And Hashubah, and Ohel, and Berechiah, and Hasadiah, Jushab-hesed, five.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Hananiah; Pelatiah, ati Jesaiah: awọn ọmọ Refaiah, awọn ọmọ Arnani, awọn ọmọ Obadiah, awọn ọmọ Ṣekaniah.
entries.en: And the sons of Hananiah; Pelatiah, and Jesaiah: the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shechaniah.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Ṣekaniah; Ṣemaiah; ati awọn ọmọ Ṣemaiah; Hettuṣi, ati Igeali, ati Bariah, ati Neariah, ati Ṣafati, mẹfa.
entries.en: And the sons of Shechaniah; Shemaiah; and the sons of Shemaiah; Hattush, and Igeal, and Bariah, and Neariah, and Shaphat, six.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Neariah; Elioenai, ati Hesekiah, ati Asrikamu, meta.
entries.en: And the sons of Neariah; Elioenai, and Hezekiah, and Azrikam, three.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Elioenai ni, Hodaiah, ati Eliaṣibu, ati Pelaiah, ti Akkubu, ati Johanani, ati Dalaiah, ati Anani, meje.
entries.en: And the sons of Elioenai were, Hodaiah, and Eliashib, and Pelaiah, and Akkub, and Johanan, and Dalaiah, and Anani, seven.

entries.yo: AWỌN ọmọ Juda; Faresi, Hesroni, ati Karmi, ati Huri, ati Ṣobali.
entries.en: The sons of Judah; Pharez, Hezron, and Carmi, and Hur, and Shobal.

entries.yo: Reaiah ọmọ Ṣobali si bi Jahati; Jahati si bi Ahumai, ati Lahadi. Wọnyi ni idile awọn ara Sora.
entries.en: And Reaiah the son of Shobal begat Jahath; and Jahath begat Ahumai and Lahad. These are the families of the Zorathites.

entries.yo: Awọn wọnyi li o ti ọdọ baba Etamu wá; Jesreeli ati Jisma, ati Jidbaṣi: orukọ arabinrin wọn si ni Selelponi:
entries.en: And these were of the father of Etam; Jezreel, and Ishma, and Idbash: and the name of their sister was Hazelelponi:

entries.yo: Ati Penueli ni baba Gedori, ati Eseri baba Huṣa. Wọnyi ni awọn ọmọ Huri, akọbi Efrata, baba Betlehemu.
entries.en: And Penuel the father of Gedor and Ezer the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah, the father of Bethlehem.

entries.yo: Aṣuri baba Tekoa si li aya meji, Hela ati Naara.
entries.en: And Ashur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.

entries.yo: Naara si bi Ahusamu, ati Heferi, ati Temeni, ati Ahaṣtari fun u. Wọnyi li awọn ọmọ Naara.
entries.en: And Naarah bare him Ahuzam, and Hepher, and Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Hela ni Sereti, ati Jesoari, ati Etnani.
entries.en: And the sons of Helah were, Zereth, and Jezoar, and Ethnan.

entries.yo: Kosi si bi Anubu, ati Sobeba, ati awọn idile Aharheli, ọmọ Harumu.
entries.en: And Coz begat Anub, and Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.

entries.yo: Jabesi si ṣe ọlọla jù awọn arakunrin rẹ̀ lọ: iya rẹ̀ si pe orukọ rẹ̀ ni Jabesi, wipe, Nitoriti mo bi i pẹlu ibanujẹ.
entries.en: And Jabez was more honourable than his brethren: and his mother called his name Jabez, saying, Because I bare him with sorrow.

entries.yo: Jabesi si ké pè Ọlọrun Israeli, wipe, Iwọ iba jẹ bukún mi nitõtọ, ki o si sọ àgbegbe mi di nla, ki ọwọ rẹ ki o si wà pẹlu mi, ati ki iwọ ki o má si jẹ ki emi ri ibi, ki emi má si ri ibinujẹ! Ọlọrun si mu ohun ti o tọrọ ṣẹ.
entries.en: And Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, Oh that thou wouldest bless me indeed, and enlarge my coast, and that thine hand might be with me, and that thou wouldest keep me from evil, that it may not grieve me! And God granted him that which he requested.

entries.yo: Kelubu arakunrin Ṣua si bi Mehiri, ti iṣe baba Eṣtoni.
entries.en: And Chelub the brother of Shuah begat Mehir, which was the father of Eshton.

entries.yo: Eṣtoni si bi Bet-rafa, ati Pasea, ati Tehinna baba ilu Nahaṣi. Wọnyi li awọn ọkunrin Reka,
entries.en: And Eshton begat Beth-rapha, and Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Ir-nahash. These are the men of Rechah.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Kenasi; Otnieli, ati Seraiah: ati awọn ọmọ Otnieli; Hatati.
entries.en: And the sons of Kenaz; Othniel, and Seraiah: and the sons of Othniel; Hathath.

entries.yo: Meonotai si bi Ofra: Seraiah si bi Joabu, baba Geharasimu; nitori oniṣọnà ni nwọn.
entries.en: And Meonothai begat Ophrah: and Seraiah begat Joab, the father of the valley of Charashim; for they were craftsmen.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Kalebu ọmọ Jefunne; Iru, Ela, ati Naamu: ati awọn ọmọ Ela, ani Kenasi.
entries.en: And the sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh; Iru, Elah, and Naam: and the sons of Elah, even Kenaz.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Jehaleleeli; Sifu, ati Sifa, Tiria, ati Asareeli.
entries.en: And the sons of Jehaleleel; Ziph, and Ziphah, Tiria, and Asareel.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Esra ni Jeteri, ati Meredi, ati Eferi, ati Jaloni: on si bi Miriamu, ati Ṣammai, ati Iṣba baba Eṣtemoa.
entries.en: And the sons of Ezra were, Jether, and Mered, and Epher, and Jalon: and she bare Miriam, and Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.

entries.yo: Aya rẹ̀ Jehudijah si bi Jeredi baba Gedori, ati Heberi baba Soke, ati Jekutieli baba Sanoa. Wọnyi si li awọn ọmọ Bitiah ọmọbinrin Farao ti Meredi mu li aya.
entries.en: And his wife Jehudiajah bare Jered the father of Gedor, and Heber the father of Socho, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. And these are the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharoah, which Mered took.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ aya Hodiah, arabinrin Nahamu, baba Keila, ara Garmi, ati Eṣtemoa ara Maaka:
entries.en: And the sons of his wife Hodiah the sister of Naham, the father of Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maachathite.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Ṣimoni si ni Amnoni, ati Rinna, Benhanani, ati Tiloni. Ati awọn ọmọ Iṣi ni, Soheti, ati Bensoheti,
entries.en: And the sons of Shimon were, Amnon, and Rinnah, Ben-hanan, and Tilon. And the sons of Ishi were, Zoheth, and Ben-zoheth.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Ṣela, ọmọ Juda ni, Eri baba Leka, ati Laada baba Mareṣa ati idile ile awọn ti nwọn nwun aṣọ ọ̀gbọ daradara, ti ile Aṣbea,
entries.en: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah were, Er the father of Lecah, and Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of them that wrought fine linen, of the house of Ashbea,

entries.yo: Ati Jokimu, ati awọn ọkunrin Koseba, ati Joaṣi, ati Sarafu, ti o ni ijọba ni Moabu, ati Jaṣubilehemu. Iwe iranti atijọ ni wọnyi.
entries.en: And Jokim, and the men of Chozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who had the dominion in Moab, and Jashubi-lehem. And these are ancient things.

entries.yo: Wọnyi li awọn amọkoko, ati awọn ti ngbe ãrin ọgba ti odi yika; nibẹ ni nwọn ngbe pẹlu ọba fun iṣẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: These were the potters, and those that dwelt among plants and hedges: there they dwelt with the king for his work.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Simeoni ni, Nemueli, ati Jamini, Jaribi, Sera, Ṣauli:
entries.en: The sons of Simeon were, Nemuel, and Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, and Shaul:

entries.yo: Ṣallumu ọmọ rẹ̀, Mibsamu ọmọ rẹ̀, Miṣma ọmọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, Mishma his son.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Miṣma; Hammueli ọmọ rẹ̀, Sakkuri ọmọ rẹ̀, Ṣimei ọmọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the sons of Mishma; Hamuel his son, Zachur his son, Shimei his son.

entries.yo: Ṣimei si ni ọmọkunrin mẹrindilogun, ati ọmọbinrin mẹfa; ṣugbọn awọn arakunrin rẹ̀ kò ni ọmọkunrin pupọ, bẹ̃ni kì iṣe idile wọn gbogbo li o rẹ̀ gẹgẹ bi awọn ọmọ Juda.
entries.en: And Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brethren had not many children, neither did all their family multiply, like to the children of Judah.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ngbe Beerṣeba, ati Molada, ati Haṣari-ṣuali,
entries.en: And they dwelt at Beer-sheba, and Moladah, and Hazar-shual,

entries.yo: Ati ni Bilha, ati ni Esemu, ati ni Toladi,
entries.en: And at Bilhah, and at Ezem, and at Tolad,

entries.yo: Ati ni Betueli, ati ni Horma, ati ni Siklagi,
entries.en: And at Bethuel, and at Hormah, and at Ziklag,

entries.yo: Ati ni Bet-markaboti, ati ni Hasar-susimu, ati ni Bet-birei, ati Ṣaaraimu. Awọn wọnyi ni ilu wọn, titi di ijọba Dafidi.
entries.en: And at Beth-marcaboth, and Hazar-susim, and at Beth-birei, and at Shaaraim. These were their cities unto the reign of David.

entries.yo: Ileto wọn si ni, Etamu, ati Aini, Rimmoni, ati Tokeni, ati Aṣani, ilu marun:
entries.en: And their villages were, Etam, and Ain, Rimmon, and Tochen, and Ashan, five cities:

entries.yo: Ati gbogbo ileto wọn, ti o wà yi ilu na ka, de Baali. Wọnyi ni ibugbe wọn, ati itan idile wọn.
entries.en: And all their villages that were round about the same cities, unto Baal. These were their habitations, and their genealogy.

entries.yo: Ati Meṣobabu ati Jamleki, ati Joṣa ọmọ Amasiah.
entries.en: And Meshobab, and Jamlech, and Joshah the son of Amaziah,

entries.yo: Ati Joeli, ati Jehu ọmọ Josibiah, ọmọ Seraiah, ọmọ Asieli,
entries.en: And Joel, and Jehu the son of Josibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,

entries.yo: Ati Elioenai, ati Jaakoba, ati Jeṣohaiah, ati Asaiah, ati Adieli, ati Jesimieli, ati Benaiah,
entries.en: And Elioenai, and Jaakobah, and Jeshohaiah, and Asaiah, and Adiel, and Jesimiel, and Benaiah,

entries.yo: Ati Sisa ọmọ Ṣifi, ọmọ Alloni, ọmọ Jedaiah, ọmọ Ṣimri ọmọ Ṣemaiah;
entries.en: And Ziza the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah;

entries.yo: Awọn ti a darukọ wọnyi, ìjoye ni wọn ni idile wọn: ile baba wọn si tan kalẹ gidigidi.
entries.en: These mentioned by their names were princes in their families: and the house of their fathers increased greatly.

entries.yo: Nwọn si wọ̀ oju-ọ̀na Gedori lọ, titi de apa ariwa afonifoji na, lati wá koriko fun agbo ẹran wọn.
entries.en: And they went to the entrance of Gedor, even unto the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ri koriko tutù ti o si dara; ilẹ na si gbàye, o si gbe jẹ, o si wà li alafia: nitori awọn ọmọ Hamu li o ti ngbe ibẹ li atijọ.
entries.en: And they found fat pasture and good, and the land was wide, and quiet, and peaceable; for they of Ham had dwelt there of old.

entries.yo: Ati awọn wọnyi ti a kọ orukọ wọn, dé li ọjọ Hesekiah ọba Juda, nwọn si kọlu agọ wọn, ati pẹlu awọn ara Mehuni ti a ri nibẹ, nwọn si bà wọn jẹ patapata titi di oni yi, nwọn si ngbe ipò wọn: nitori koriko mbẹ nibẹ fun agbo ẹran wọn.
entries.en: And these written by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and smote their tents, and the habitations that were found there, and destroyed them utterly unto this day, and dwelt in their rooms: because there was pasture there for their flocks.

entries.yo: Omiran ninu wọn, ani ninu awọn ọmọ Simeoni, ẹ̃dẹgbẹta ọkunrin, lọ si òke Seiri, nwọn ni Pelatiah, ati Neariah, ati Refaiah ati Ussieli, awọn ọmọ Iṣi li olori wọn.
entries.en: And some of them, even of the sons of Simeon, five hundred men, went to mount Seir, having for their captains Pelatiah, and Neariah, and Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.

entries.yo: Nwọn si kọlù iyokù awọn ara Amaleki, ti nwọn salà, nwọn si ngbe ibẹ titi di oni yi.
entries.en: And they smote the rest of the Amalekites that were escaped, and dwelt there unto this day.

entries.yo: NJẸ awọn ọmọ Reubeni, akọbi Israeli, (nitori on li akọbi; ṣugbọn, bi o ti ṣepe o ba ẹní baba rẹ̀ jẹ, a fi ogun ibi rẹ̀ fun awọn ọmọ Josefu ọmọ Israeli: a kì yio si ka itan-idile na gẹgẹ bi ipò ibi.
entries.en: Now the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel, (for he was the firstborn; but, forasmuch as he defiled his father's bed, his birthright was given unto the sons of Joseph the son of Israel: and the genealogy is not to be reckoned after the birthright.

entries.yo: Nitori Juda bori awọn arakunrin rẹ̀, ati lọdọ rẹ̀ ni alaṣẹ ti jade wá; ṣugbọn ogún ibi jẹ ti Josefu:)
entries.en: For Judah prevailed above his brethren, and of him came the chief ruler; but the birthright was Joseph's:)

entries.yo: Mo ni, awọn ọmọ Rubeni akọbi Israeli ni Hanoku, ati Pallu, Hesroni, ati Karmi.
entries.en: The sons, I say, of Reuben the firstborn of Israel were, Hannoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Joeli; Ṣemaiah ọmọ rẹ̀, Gogu ọmọ rẹ̀, Ṣimei ọmọ rẹ̀,
entries.en: The sons of Joel; Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,

entries.yo: Mika ọmọ rẹ̀, Reaiah ọmọ rẹ̀, Baali ọmọ rẹ̀,
entries.en: Micah his son, Reaia his son, Baal his son,

entries.yo: Beera ọmọ rẹ̀, ti Tiglat-pilneseri ọba Assiria kò ni ìgbekun lọ; ijoye awọn ọmọ Rubeni ni iṣe.
entries.en: Beerah his son, whom Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria carried away captive: he was prince of the Reubenites.

entries.yo: Ati awọn arakunrin rẹ̀ nipa idile wọn, nigbati a nkà itàn-idile iran wọn, Jeieli, ati Sekariah ni olori.
entries.en: And his brethren by their families, when the genealogy of their generations was reckoned, were the chief, Jeiel, and Zechariah,

entries.yo: Ati Bela ọmọ Asasi, ọmọ Ṣema, ọmọ Joeli, ti ngbe Aroeri, ani titi de Nebo ati Baalmeoni:
entries.en: And Bela the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, who dwelt in Aroer, even unto Nebo and Baal-meon:

entries.yo: Ati niha ariwa, o tẹ̀do lọ titi de ati-wọ̀ aginju lati odò Eufrate; nitoriti ẹran ọ̀sin wọn pọ̀ si i ni ilẹ Gileadi.
entries.en: And eastward he inhabited unto the entering in of the wilderness from the river Euphrates: because their cattle were multiplied in the land of Gilead.

entries.yo: Ati li ọjọ Saulu, nwọn ba awọn ọmọ Hagari jagun, ẹniti o ṣubu nipa ọwọ wọn: nwọn si ngbe inu agọ wọn ni gbogbo ilẹ ariwa Gileadi.
entries.en: And in the days of Saul they made war with the Hagarites, who fell by their hand: and they dwelt in their tents throughout all the east land of Gilead.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Gadi ngbe ọkánkan wọn, ni ilẹ Baṣani titi de Salka:
entries.en: And the children of Gad dwelt over against them, in the land of Bashan unto Salchah:

entries.yo: Joeli olori, ati Ṣafamu àtẹle, ati Jaanai, ati Ṣafati ni Baṣani.
entries.en: Joel the chief, and Shapham the next, and Jaanai, and Shaphat in Bashan.

entries.yo: Ati awọn arakunrin wọn ti ile awọn baba wọn ni Mikaeli, ati Meṣullamu, ati Ṣeba, ati Jorai, ati Jakani, ati Sia, ati Heberi, meje.
entries.en: And their brethren of the house of their fathers were, Michael, and Meshullam, and Sheba, and Jorai, and Jachan, and Zia, and Heber, seven.

entries.yo: Wọnyi li awọn ọmọ Abihaili, ọmọ Huri, ọmọ Jaroa, ọmọ Gileadi, ọmọ Mikaeli, ọmọ Jeṣiṣai, ọmọ Jado, ọmọ Busi;
entries.en: These are the children of Abihail the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz;

entries.yo: Adi, ọmọ Abdieli, ọmọ Guni, olori ile awọn baba wọn.
entries.en: Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, chief of the house of their fathers.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ngbe Gileadi ni Baṣani, ati ninu awọn ilu rẹ̀, ati ninu gbogbo igberiko Ṣaroni, li àgbegbe wọn.
entries.en: And they dwelt in Gilead in Bashan, and in her towns, and in all the suburbs of Sharon, upon their borders.

entries.yo: Gbogbo wọnyi li a kà nipa itan-idile, li ọjọ Jotamu ọba Juda, ati li ọjọ Jeroboamu ọba Israeli,
entries.en: All these were reckoned by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Rubeni, ati awọn ọmọ Gadi, ati àbọ ẹ̀ya Manasse, ninu awọn ọkunrin alagbara ti nwọn ngbé asà ati idà, ti nwọn si nfi ọrun tafà, ti nwọn si mòye ogun, jẹ ọkẹ meji enia o le ẹgbẹrinlelogún o di ogoji, ti o jade lọ si ogun na.
entries.en: The sons of Reuben, and the Gadites, and half the tribe of Manasseh, of valiant men, men able to bear buckler and sword, and to shoot with bow, and skilful in war, were four and forty thousand seven hundred and threescore, that went out to the war.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ba awọn ọmọ Hagari jagun, pẹlu Jeturi, ati Nefiṣi ati Nadabu.
entries.en: And they made war with the Hagarites, with Jetur, and Nephish, and Nodab.

entries.yo: A si ràn wọn lọwọ si wọn, a si fi awọn ọmọ Hagari le wọn lọwọ, ati gbogbo awọn ti o wà pẹlu wọn: nitoriti nwọn kepè Ọlọrun li ogun na, on si gbọ́ ẹ̀bẹ wọn: nitoriti nwọn gbẹkẹ wọn le e.
entries.en: And they were helped against them, and the Hagarites were delivered into their hand, and all that were with them: for they cried to God in the battle, and he was intreated of them; because they put their trust in him.

entries.yo: Nwọn si kó ẹran ọ̀sin wọn lọ; ibakasiẹ ẹgbãmẹ̃dọgbọ̀n ati àgutan ọkẹ mejila o le ẹgbãrun, ati kẹtẹkẹtẹ ẹgbã, ati enia ọkẹ marun.
entries.en: And they took away their cattle; of their camels fifty thousand, and of sheep two hundred and fifty thousand, and of asses two thousand, and of men an hundred thousand.

entries.yo: Nitori ọ̀pọlọpọ li o ṣubu ti a pa, nitori lati ọdọ Ọlọrun li ogun na. Nwọn si joko ni ipò wọn titi di igbà ikolọ si ìgbekun.
entries.en: For there fell down many slain, because the war was of God. And they dwelt in their steads until the captivity.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọkunrin àbọ ẹ̀ya Manasse joko ni ilẹ na: nwọn bi si i lati Baṣani titi de Baal-hermoni, ati Seniri, ati titi de òke Hermoni.
entries.en: And the children of the half tribe of Manasseh dwelt in the land: they increased from Bashan unto Baal-hermon and Senir, and unto mount Hermon.

entries.yo: Wọnyi si li awọn olori ile awọn baba wọn, Eferi, ati Iṣi, ati Elieli, ati Asrieli, ati Jeremiah, ati Hodafiah, ati Jahdieli, awọn alagbara akọni ọkunrin, ọkunrin olokiki, ati olori ile awọn baba wọn.
entries.en: And these were the heads of the house of their fathers, even Epher, and Ishi, and Eliel, and Azriel, and Jeremiah, and Hodaviah, and Jahdiel, mighty men of valour, famous men, and heads of the house of their fathers.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣẹ̀ si Ọlọrun awọn baba wọn, nwọn si ṣe àgbere tọ awọn ọlọrun enia ilẹ na lẹhin, ti Ọlọrun ti parun ni iwaju wọn.
entries.en: And they transgressed against the God of their fathers, and went a whoring after the gods of the people of the land, whom God destroyed before them.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun Israeli rú ẹmi Pulu ọba Assiria soke, ati ẹmi Tiglat-pilneseri ọba Assiria, on si kó wọn lọ, ani awọn ọmọ Rubeni ati awọn ọmọ Gadi, ati àbọ ẹ̀ya Manasse, o si kó wọn wá si Hala, ati Habori, ati Hara, ati si odò Goṣani, titi di oni yi.
entries.en: And the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria, and he carried them away, even the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh, and brought them unto Halah, and Habor, and Hara, and to the river Gozan, unto this day.

entries.yo: AWỌN ọmọ Lefi; Gerṣoni, Kohati, ati Merari.
entries.en: The sons of Levi; Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

entries.yo: Ati awọn Kohati; Amramu, Ishari, ati Hebroni, ati Ussieli.
entries.en: And the sons of Kohath; Amram, Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.

entries.yo: Ati awọn Amramu; Aaroni, ati Mose, ati Miriamu. Awọn ọmọ Aaroni; Nadabu, ati Abihu, Eleasari, ati Itamari.
entries.en: And the children of Amram; Aaron, and Moses, and Miriam. The sons also of Aaron; Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

entries.yo: Eleasari bi Finehasi, Finehasi si bi Abiṣua,
entries.en: Eleazar begat Phinehas, Phinehas begat Abishua,

entries.yo: Abiṣua si bi Bukki, Bukki si bi Ussi,
entries.en: And Abishua begat Bukki, and Bukki begat Uzzi,

entries.yo: Ussi si bi Serahiah, Serahiah si bi Meraioti,
entries.en: And Uzzi begat Zerahiah, and Zerahiah begat Meraioth,

entries.yo: Meraioti bi Amariah, Amariah si bi Ahitubu.
entries.en: Meraioth begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,

entries.yo: Ahitubu si bi Sadoku, Sadoku si bi Ahimaasi,
entries.en: And Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Ahimaaz,

entries.yo: Ahimaasi si bi Asariah, Asariah si bi Johanani,
entries.en: And Ahimaaz begat Azariah, and Azariah begat Johanan,

entries.yo: Johanani si bi Asariah (on na li ẹniti nṣiṣẹ alufa ni tempili ti Solomoni kọ́ ni Jerusalemu;)
entries.en: And Johanan begat Azariah, (he it is that executed the priest's office in the temple that Solomon built in Jerusalem:)

entries.yo: Asariah si bi Amariah, Amariah si bi Ahitubu,
entries.en: And Azariah begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,

entries.yo: Ahitubu si bi Sadoki, Sadoki si bi Ṣallumu,
entries.en: And Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Shallum,

entries.yo: Ṣallumu si bi Hilkiah, Hilkiah si bi Asariah,
entries.en: And Shallum begat Hilkiah, and Hilkiah begat Azariah,

entries.yo: Asariah si bi Seraiah, Seraiah si bi Jehosadaki,
entries.en: And Azariah begat Seraiah, and Seraiah begat Jehozadak,

entries.yo: Jehosadaki si lọ si oko ẹrú, nigbati Oluwa kó Juda ati Jerusalemu lọ nipa ọwọ Nebukadnessari.
entries.en: And Jehozadak went into captivity, when the LORD carried away Judah and Jerusalem by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Lefi; Gersọmu, Kohati, ati Merari.
entries.en: The sons of Levi; Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.

entries.yo: Wọnyi si li orukọ awọn ọmọ Gerṣomu, Libni, ati Ṣimei.
entries.en: And these be the names of the sons of Gershom; Libni, and Shimei.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Kohati ni, Amramu, ati Ishari, ati Hebroni, ati Ussieli.
entries.en: And the sons of Kohath were, Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Merari; Mahli ati Muṣi. Wọnyi si ni idile awọn ọmọ Lefi, gẹgẹ bi awọn baba wọn.
entries.en: The sons of Merari; Mahli, and Mushi. And these are the families of the Levites according to their fathers.

entries.yo: Ti Gerṣomu; Libni ọmọ rẹ̀, Jahati ọmọ rẹ̀, Simma ọmọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Of Gershom; Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,

entries.yo: Joa ọmọ rẹ̀, Iddo ọmọ rẹ̀, Sera ọmọ rẹ̀, Jeaterai ọmọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, Jeaterai his son.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Kohati; Amminadabu ọmọ rẹ̀, Kora ọmọ rẹ̀, Assiri ọmọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: The sons of Kohath; Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,

entries.yo: Elkana ọmọ rẹ̀, ati Ebiasafu ọmọ rẹ̀, ati Assiri ọmọ rẹ̀,
entries.en: Elkanah his son, and Ebiasaph his son, and Assir his son,

entries.yo: Tahati ọmọ rẹ̀, Urieli ọmọ rẹ̀, Ussiah ọmọ rẹ̀, ati Ṣaulu ọmọ rẹ̀,
entries.en: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Elkana; Amasai, ati Ahimoti.
entries.en: And the sons of Elkanah; Amasai, and Ahimoth.

entries.yo: Niti Elkana: awọn ọmọ Elkana; Sofai ọmọ rẹ̀, ati Nahati ọmọ rẹ̀,
entries.en: As for Elkanah: the sons of Elkanah; Zophai his son, and Nahath his son,

entries.yo: Eliabu ọmọ rẹ̀, Jerohamu ọmọ rẹ̀, Elkana ọmọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elkanah his son.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Samueli; akọbi Faṣni, ati Abiah.
entries.en: And the sons of Samuel; the firstborn Vashni, and Abiah.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Merari; Mahli, Libni, ọmọ rẹ̀, Ṣimei ọmọ rẹ̀, Ussa ọmọ rẹ̀,
entries.en: The sons of Merari; Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzza his son,

entries.yo: Ṣimea ọmọ rẹ̀, Haggiah ọmọ rẹ̀, Asaiah ọmọ rẹ̀,
entries.en: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.

entries.yo: Wọnyi si ni awọn ti Dafidi yàn ṣe olori iṣẹ orin ni ile Oluwa, lẹhin igbati apoti-ẹ̀ri Oluwa ti ni isimi.
entries.en: And these are they whom David set over the service of song in the house of the LORD, after that the ark had rest.

entries.yo: Nwọn si nfi orin ṣe isin niwaju ibugbe agọ ajọ, titi Solomoni fi kọ́ ile Oluwa ni Jerusalemu tan: nwọn si duro ti iṣẹ óye wọn gẹgẹ bi ipa wọn.
entries.en: And they ministered before the dwelling place of the tabernacle of the congregation with singing, until Solomon had built the house of the LORD in Jerusalem: and then they waited on their office according to their order.

entries.yo: Wọnyi si li awọn ti o duro pẹlu awọn ọmọ wọn. Ninu awọn ọmọ Kohati: Hemani akọrin, ọmọ Joeli, ọmọ Samueli,
entries.en: And these are they that waited with their children. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman a singer, the son of Joel, the son of Shemuel,

entries.yo: Ọmọ Elkana, ọmọ Jerohamu, ọmọ Elieli, ọmọ Toha,
entries.en: The son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,

entries.yo: Ọmọ Sufu, ọmọ Elkana, ọmọ Mahati, ọmọ Amasai,
entries.en: The son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,

entries.yo: Ọmọ Elkana, ọmọ Joeli, ọmọ Asariah, ọmọ Sefaniah,
entries.en: The son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,

entries.yo: Ọmọ Tahati, ọmọ Assiri, ọmọ Ebiasafu, ọmọ Kora,
entries.en: The son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,

entries.yo: Ọmọ Ishari, ọmọ Kohati, ọmọ Lefi, ọmọ Israeli.
entries.en: The son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.

entries.yo: Ati arakunrin rẹ̀ Asafu, ti o duro li ọwọ ọ̀tun rẹ̀, ani Asafu, ọmọ Berakiah, ọmọ Ṣimea,
entries.en: And his brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand, even Asaph the son of Berachiah, the son of Shimea,

entries.yo: Ọmọ Mikaeli, ọmọ Baaseiah, ọmọ Malkiah.
entries.en: The son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchiah,

entries.yo: Ọmọ Etni, ọmọ Sera, ọmọ Adaiah,
entries.en: The son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,

entries.yo: Ọmọ Etani, ọmọ Simma, ọmọ Ṣimei,
entries.en: The son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,

entries.yo: Ọmọ Jahati, ọmọ Gerṣomu, ọmọ Lefi.
entries.en: The son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.

entries.yo: Awọn arakunrin wọn, awọn ọmọ Merari duro lọwọ osi: Etani ọmọ Kiṣi, ọmọ Abdi, ọmọ Malluku,
entries.en: And their brethren the sons of Merari stood on the left hand: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,

entries.yo: Ọmọ Haṣabiah, ọmọ Amasiah, ọmọ Hilkiah,
entries.en: The son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,

entries.yo: Ọmọ Amsi, ọmọ Bani, ọmọ Ṣameri.
entries.en: The son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shamer,

entries.yo: Ọmọ Mahli, ọmọ Muṣi ọmọ Merari, ọmọ Lefi,
entries.en: The son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.

entries.yo: Arakunrin wọn pẹlu, awọn ọmọ Lefi, li a yàn si oniruru iṣẹ gbogbo ti agọ ile Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Their brethren also the Levites were appointed unto all manner of service of the tabernacle of the house of God.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Aaroni ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ nrubọ lori pẹpẹ ẹbọ sisun, ati lori pẹpẹ turari, a si yàn wọn si gbogbo iṣẹ ibi mimọ́-jùlọ, ati lati ṣe ètutu fun Israeli, gẹgẹ bi gbogbo eyi ti Mose, iranṣẹ Ọlọrun, ti pa li aṣẹ.
entries.en: But Aaron and his sons offered upon the altar of the burnt offering, and on the altar of incense, and were appointed for all the work of the place most holy, and to make an atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.

entries.yo: Wọnyi si li awọn ọmọ Aaroni; Eleasari ọmọ rẹ̀, Finehasi ọmọ rẹ̀, Abiṣua ọmọ rẹ̀,
entries.en: And these are the sons of Aaron; Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,

entries.yo: Bukki ọmọ rẹ̀, Ussi ọmọ rẹ̀, Serahiah ọmọ rẹ̀,
entries.en: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,

entries.yo: Meraioti ọmọ rẹ̀, Amariah ọmọ rẹ̀, Ahitubu ọmọ rẹ̀,
entries.en: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,

entries.yo: Sadoku ọmọ rẹ̀, Ahimaasi ọmọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Zadok his son, Ahimaaz his son.

entries.yo: Wọnyi si ni ibùgbe wọn gẹgẹ bi budo wọn li àgbegbe wọn, ti awọn ọmọ Aaroni, ti idile awọn ọmọ Kohati: nitori ti wọn ni ipin ikini.
entries.en: Now these are their dwelling places throughout their castles in their coasts, of the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites: for theirs was the lot.

entries.yo: Nwọn si fun wọn ni Hebroni ni ilẹ Juda, ati ìgberiko rẹ̀ yi i kakiri.
entries.en: And they gave them Hebron in the land of Judah, and the suburbs thereof round about it.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn oko ilu na, ati ileto wọn, ni nwọn fun Kalebu ọmọ Jefunne.
entries.en: But the fields of the city, and the villages thereof, they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

entries.yo: Nwọn si fi ilu Juda fun awọn ọmọ Aaroni, ani Hebroni, ilu àbo ati Libna pẹlu ìgberiko rẹ̀, ati Jattiri, ati Eṣtemoa, pẹlu ìgberiko wọn,
entries.en: And to the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of Judah, namely, Hebron, the city of refuge, and Libnah with her suburbs, and Jattir, and Eshtemoa, with their suburbs,

entries.yo: Ati Hileni pẹlu ìgberiko rẹ̀, Debiri pẹlu ìgberiko rẹ̀,
entries.en: And Hilen with her suburbs, Debir with her suburbs,

entries.yo: Ati Aṣani pẹlu ìgberiko rẹ̀, ati Bet-ṣemeṣi pẹlu ìgberiko rẹ̀:
entries.en: And Ashan with her suburbs, and Beth-shemesh with her suburbs:

entries.yo: Ati lati inu ẹ̀ya Benjamini; Geba pẹlu ìgberiko rẹ̀, ati Alemeti pẹlu ìgberiko rẹ̀, ati Anatoti pẹlu ìgberiko rẹ̀. Gbogbo ilu wọn ni idile wọn jẹ ilu mẹtala.
entries.en: And out of the tribe of Benjamin; Geba with her suburbs, and Alemeth with her suburbs, and Anathoth with her suburbs. All their cities throughout their families were thirteen cities.

entries.yo: Ati fun awọn ọmọ Kohati, ti o kù ni idile ẹ̀ya na, li a fi keke fi ilu mẹwa fun, ninu àbọ ẹ̀ya, ani lati inu àbọ ẹ̀ya Manasse.
entries.en: And unto the sons of Kohath, which were left of the family of that tribe, were cities given out of the half tribe, namely, out of the half tribe of Manasseh, by lot, ten cities.

entries.yo: Ati fun awọn ọmọ Gerṣomu ni idile wọn, lati inu ẹ̀ya Issakari, ati inu ẹ̀ya Aṣeri, ati lati inu ẹ̀ya Naftali, ati lati inu ẹ̀ya Manasse ni Baṣani, ilu mẹtala.
entries.en: And to the sons of Gershom throughout their families out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.

entries.yo: Fun awọn ọmọ Merari ni idile wọn li a fi keké fi ilu mejila fun, lati inu ẹ̀ya Reubeni, ati lati inu ẹ̀ya Gadi, ati lati inu ẹ̀ya Sebuluni,
entries.en: Unto the sons of Merari were given by lot, throughout their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Israeli fi ilu wọnyi fun awọn ọmọ Lefi pẹlu ìgberiko wọn.
entries.en: And the children of Israel gave to the Levites these cities with their suburbs.

entries.yo: Nwọn si fi keké fi ilu wọnyi ti a da orukọ wọn fun ni lati inu ẹ̀ya awọn ọmọ Juda, ati lati inu ẹ̀ya awọn ọmọ Simeoni, ati lati inu ẹ̀ya awọn ọmọ Benjamini.
entries.en: And they gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these cities, which are called by their names.

entries.yo: Ati iyokù ninu idile awọn ọmọ Kohati ni ilu li àgbegbe wọn lati inu ẹ̀ya Efraimu.
entries.en: And the residue of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their coasts out of the tribe of Ephraim.

entries.yo: Nwọn si fi ninu ilu àbo fun wọn, Ṣekemu li òke Efraimu pẹlu ìgberiko rẹ̀; Geseri pẹlu ìgberiko rẹ̀,
entries.en: And they gave unto them, of the cities of refuge, Shechem in mount Ephraim with her suburbs; they gave also Gezer with her suburbs,

entries.yo: Ati Jokneamu pẹlu ìgberiko rẹ̀, ati Bet-horoni pẹlu ìgberiko rẹ̀,
entries.en: And Jokmeam with her suburbs, and Beth-horon with her suburbs,

entries.yo: Ati Aijaloni pẹlu ìgberiko rẹ̀, ati Gatrimmoni pẹlu ìgberiko rẹ̀:
entries.en: And Aijalon with her suburbs, and Gath-rimmon with her suburbs:

entries.yo: Ati lati inu àbọ ẹ̀ya Manasse; Aneri pẹlu ìgberiko rẹ̀, ati Bileamu pẹlu ìgberiko rẹ̀, fun idile awọn ọmọ Kohati iyokù.
entries.en: And out of the half tribe of Manasseh; Aner with her suburbs, and Bileam with her suburbs, for the family of the remnant of the sons of Kohath.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Gerṣomu lati inu idile àbọ ẹ̀ya Manasse li a fi Golani ni Baṣani fun pẹlu ìgberiko rẹ̀; ati Aṣtaroti pẹlu ìgberiko rẹ̀,
entries.en: Unto the sons of Gershom were given out of the family of the half tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with her suburbs, and Ashtaroth with her suburbs:

entries.yo: Ati lati inu ẹ̀ya Issakari; Kadeṣi pẹlu ìgberiko rẹ̀; Daberati pẹlu ìgberiko rẹ̀,
entries.en: And out of the tribe of Issachar; Kedesh with her suburbs, Daberath with her suburbs,

entries.yo: Ati Ramoti pẹlu ìgberiko rẹ̀, ati Anemu pẹlu ìgberiko rẹ̀:
entries.en: And Ramoth with her suburbs, and Anem with her suburbs:

entries.yo: Ati lati inu ẹ̀ya Aṣeri; Maṣali pẹlu ìgberiko rẹ̀, ati Abdoni pẹlu ìgberiko rẹ̀.
entries.en: And out of the tribe of Asher; Mashal with her suburbs, and Abdon with her suburbs,

entries.yo: Ati Hakoku pẹlu ìgberiko rẹ̀, ati Rehobu pẹlu ìgberiko rẹ̀:
entries.en: And Hukok with her suburbs, and Rehob with her suburbs:

entries.yo: Ati lati inu ẹ̀ya Naftali; Kedeṣi ni Galili pẹlu ìgberiko rẹ̀, ati Hammoni pẹlu ìgberiko rẹ̀, ati Kirjataimu pẹlu ìgberiko rẹ̀.
entries.en: And out of the tribe of Naphtali; Kedesh in Galilee with her suburbs, and Hammon with her suburbs, and Kirjathaim with her suburbs.

entries.yo: Fun iyokù awọn ọmọ Merari li a fi Rimmoni pẹlu ìgberiko rẹ̀ fun, Tabori pẹlu ìgberiko rẹ̀, lati inu ẹ̀ya Sebuluni:
entries.en: Unto the rest of the children of Merari were given out of the tribe of Zebulun. Rimmon with her suburbs, Tabor with her suburbs:

entries.yo: Ati li apa keji Jordani leti Jeriko, ni iha ariwa Jordani, li a fi Beseri li aginju pẹlu ìgberiko rẹ̀, ati Jasa pẹlu ìgberiko rẹ̀ fun wọn, lati inu ẹ̀ya Rubeni,
entries.en: And on the other side Jordan by Jericho, on the east side of Jordan, were given them out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer in the wilderness with her suburbs, and Jahzah with her suburbs,

entries.yo: Ati Kedemoti pẹlu ìgberiko rẹ̀, ati Mefaati pẹlu ìgberiko rẹ̀:
entries.en: Kedemoth also with her suburbs, and Mephaath with her suburbs:

entries.yo: Ati lati inu ẹ̀ya Gadi, Ramoti ni Gileadi pẹlu ìgberiko rẹ̀, ati Mahanaimu pẹlu ìgberiko rẹ̀.
entries.en: And out of the tribe of Gad; Ramoth in Gilead with her suburbs, and Mahanaim with her suburbs,

entries.yo: Ati Heṣboni pẹlu ìgberiko rẹ̀, ati Jaseri pẹlu ìgberiko rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Heshbon with her suburbs, and Jazer with her suburbs.

entries.yo: AWỌN ọmọ Issakari si ni, Tola, ati Pua, Jaṣubu, ati Ṣimroni, mẹrin.
entries.en: Now the sons of Issachar were, Tola, and Puah, Jashub, and Shimron, four.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Tola; Ussi, ati Refaiah, ati Jerieli, ati Jamai, ati Jibsamu ati Samueli, awọn olori ile baba wọn, eyini ni ti Tola: akọni alagbara enia ni wọn ni iran wọn; iye awọn ẹniti o jẹ ẹgbã mọkanla o le ẹgbẹta li ọjọ Dafidi.
entries.en: And the sons of Tola; Uzzi, and Rephaiah, and Jeriel, and Jahmai, and Jibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their father's house, to wit, of Tola: they were valiant men of might in their generations; whose number was in the days of David two and twenty thousand and six hundred.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Ussi: Israhiah ati awọn ọmọ Israhiah; Mikaeli, ati Obadiah, ati Joeli, ati Iṣiah, marun: gbogbo wọn li olori.
entries.en: And the sons of Uzzi; Izrahiah: and the sons of Izrahiah; Michael, and Obadiah, and Joel, Ishiah, five: all of them chief men.

entries.yo: Ati pẹlu wọn, nipa iran wọn, gẹgẹ bi ile baba wọn, ni awọn ẹgbẹ ọmọ-ogun fun ogun, ẹgbã mejidilogun enia: nitoriti nwọn ni ọ̀pọlọpọ obinrin ati ọmọ ọkunrin.
entries.en: And with them, by their generations, after the house of their fathers, were bands of soldiers for war, six and thirty thousand men: for they had many wives and sons.

entries.yo: Ati awọn arakunrin wọn ninu gbogbo idile Issakari jẹ akọni alagbara enia, ni kikaye gbogbo wọn nipa iran wọn, nwọn jẹ ẹgbamẹtalelogoji o le ẹgbẹrun.
entries.en: And their brethren among all the families of Issachar were valiant men of might, reckoned in all by their genealogies fourscore and seven thousand.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Benjamini: Bela, ati Bekeri, ati Jediaeli, mẹta.
entries.en: The sons of Benjamin; Bela, and Becher, and Jediael, three.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Bela; Esboni, ati Ussi, ati Ussieli ati Jerimoti ati Iri, marun; awọn olori ile baba wọn, akọni alagbara enia; a si kaye wọn nipa iran wọn si ẹgbãmọkanla enia o le mẹrinlelọgbọ̀n.
entries.en: And the sons of Bela; Ezbon, and Uzzi, and Uzziel, and Jerimoth, and Iri, five; heads of the house of their fathers, mighty men of valour; and were reckoned by their genealogies twenty and two thousand and thirty and four.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Bekeri: Semira, ati Joaṣi, ati Elieseri, ati Elioeni, ati Omri, ati Jeremotu, ati Abiah, ati Anatoti, ati Alameti. Gbogbo wọnyi li awọn ọmọ Bekeri.
entries.en: And the sons of Becher; Zemira, and Joash, and Eliezer, and Elioenai, and Omri, and Jerimoth, and Abiah, and Anathoth, and Alameth. All these are the sons of Becher.

entries.yo: Ati iye wọn, ni idile wọn nipa iran wọn, awọn olori ile baba wọn, akọni alagbara enia, jẹ ẹgbawa o le igba.
entries.en: And the number of them, after their genealogy by their generations, heads of the house of the fathers, mighty men of valour, was twenty thousand and two hundred.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Jediaeli; Bilhani: ati awọn ọmọ Bilhani: Jeuṣi, ati Benjamini, ati Ehudi, ati Kenaana, ati Setani, ati Tarṣiṣi ati Ahisahari.
entries.en: The sons also of Jediael; Bilhan: and the sons of Bilhan; Jeush, and Benjamin, and Ehud, and Chenaanah, and Zethan, and Tharshish, and Ahishahar.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn wọnyi ọmọ Jediaeli, nipa olori awọn baba wọn, akọni alagbara enia, jẹ ẹgbãjọ o le ẹgbẹfa ọmọ-ogun, ti o le jade lọ si ogun.
entries.en: All these the sons of Jediael, by the heads of their fathers, mighty men of valour, were seventeen thousand and two hundred soldiers, fit to go out for war and battle.

entries.yo: Ati Ṣuppimu, ati Huppimu, awọn ọmọ Iri, ati Huṣimu, awọn ọmọ Aheri.
entries.en: Shuppim also, and Huppim, the children of Ir, and Hushim, the sons of Aher.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Naftali: Jasieli, ati Guni, ati Jeseri, ati Ṣallumu, awọn ọmọ Bilha.
entries.en: The sons of Naphtali; Jahziel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shallum, the sons of Bilhah.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Manasse; Aṣrieli, ti aya rẹ̀ bi: (ṣugbọn obinrin rẹ̀, ara Aramu, bi Makiri baba Gileadi:
entries.en: The sons of Manasseh; Ashriel, whom she bare: (but his concubine the Aramitess bare Machir the father of Gilead:

entries.yo: Makiri si mu arabinrin Huppimu, ati Ṣuppimu li aya, orukọ arabinrin ẹniti ijẹ Maaka,) ati orukọ ekeji ni Selofehadi: Selofehadi si ni awọn ọmọbinrin.
entries.en: And Machir took to wife the sister of Huppim and Shuppim, whose sister's name was Maachah;) and the name of the second was Zelophehad: and Zelophehad had daughters.

entries.yo: Maaka, obinrin Makiri, bi ọmọ, on si pè orukọ rẹ̀ ni Pereṣi: orukọ arakunrin rẹ̀ ni Ṣereṣi; ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ ni Ulamu ati Rakemu.
entries.en: And Maachah the wife of Machir bare a son, and she called his name Peresh; and the name of his brother was Sheresh; and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Ulamu: Bedani. Awọn wọnyi li awọn ọmọ Gileadi, ọmọ Makiri, ọmọ Manasse.
entries.en: And the sons of Ulam; Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.

entries.yo: Arabinrin rẹ̀, Hammoleketi, bi Iṣodi, ati Abieseri, ati Mahala.
entries.en: And his sister Hammoleketh bare Ishod, and Abiezer, and Mahalah.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Ṣemida ni, Ahiani, ati Ṣekemu, ati Likki, ati Aniamu.
entries.en: And the sons of Shemida were, Ahian, and Shechem, and Likhi, and Aniam.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Efraimu: Ṣutela, ati Beredi ọmọ rẹ̀, ati Tahati, ọmọ rẹ̀, ati Elada, ọmọ rẹ̀, ati Tahati ọmọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the sons of Ephraim; Shuthelah, and Bered his son, and Tahath his son, and Eladah his son, and Tahath his son,

entries.yo: Ati Sabadi ọmọ rẹ̀, ati Ṣutela ọmọ rẹ̀, ati Eseri, ati Eleadi, ẹniti awọn ọkunrin Gati, ti a bi ni ilẹ na, pa, nitori nwọn sọkalẹ wá lati kó ẹran ọ̀sin wọn lọ.
