entries.en: And Zabad his son, and Shuthelah his son, and Ezer, and Elead, whom the men of Gath that were born in that land slew, because they came down to take away their cattle.

entries.yo: Efraimu baba wọn si ṣọ̀fọ li ọjọ pupọ, awọn arakunrin rẹ̀ si wá lati tù u ninu.
entries.en: And Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brethren came to comfort him.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si wọle tọ̀ aya rẹ̀ lọ, o loyun o si bi ọmọ kan, on si pè orukọ rẹ̀ ni Beria, nitoriti ibi ba ile rẹ̀.
entries.en: And when he went in to his wife, she conceived, and bare a son, and he called his name Beriah, because it went evil with his house.

entries.yo: Ọmọ rẹ̀ obinrin ni Sera, ẹniti o tẹ̀ Bet-horoni dó, ti isalẹ ati ti òke, ati Usseni Ṣera.
entries.en: (And his daughter was Sherah, who built Beth-horon the nether, and the upper, and Uzzen-sherah.)

entries.yo: Refa si ni ọmọ rẹ̀ ọkunrin, Reṣefu pẹlu, ati Tela ọmọ rẹ̀, ati Tahani ọmọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Rephah was his son, also Resheph, and Telah his son, and Tahan his son,

entries.yo: Laadani ọmọ rẹ̀, Ammihudi ọmọ rẹ̀, Eliṣama ọmọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Laadan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,

entries.yo: Nuni ọmọ rẹ̀, Joṣua ọmọ rẹ̀,
entries.en: Non his son, Jehoshua his son.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ini ati ibugbe wọn ni Beteli, ati ilu rẹ̀, ati niha ìla-õrùn Naarani, niha ìwọ-õrùn Geseri pẹlu ilu rẹ̀: Ṣekemu pẹlu ati ilu rẹ̀, titi de Gasa ilu rẹ̀:
entries.en: And their possessions and habitations were, Bethel and the towns thereof, and eastward Naaran, and westward Gezer, with the towns thereof; Shechem also and the towns thereof, unto Gaza and the towns thereof:

entries.yo: Ati leti ilu awọn ọmọ Manasse, Betṣeani, ati ilu rẹ̀, Taanaki ati ilu rẹ̀, Megiddo ati ilu rẹ̀, Dori ati ilu rẹ̀. Ninu awọn wọnyi li awọn ọmọ Josefu, ọmọ Israeli, ngbe.
entries.en: And by the borders of the children of Manasseh, Beth-shean and her towns, Taanach and her towns, Megiddo and her towns, Dor and her towns. In these dwelt the children of Joseph the son of Israel.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Aṣeri: Imna, ati Iṣua, ati Iṣuai, ati Beria, ati Sera, arabinrin wọn.
entries.en: The sons of Asher; Imnah, and Isuah, and Ishuai, and Beriah, and Serah their sister.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Beria: Heberi, ati Malkieli, ti iṣe baba Birsafiti.
entries.en: And the sons of Beriah; Heber, and Malchiel, who is the father of Birzavith.

entries.yo: Heberi si bi Jafleti, ati Ṣomeri, ati Hotamu, ati Ṣua, arabinrin wọn.
entries.en: And Heber begat Japhlet, and Shomer, and Hotham, and Shua their sister.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Jafleti: Pasaki, ati Bimhali, ati Aṣfati. Wọnyi li awọn omọ Jafleti.
entries.en: And the sons of Japhlet; Pasach, and Bimhal, and Ashvath. These are the children of Japhlet.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Ṣameri: Ahi, ati Roga, Jehubba, ati Aramu.
entries.en: And the sons of Shamer; Ahi, and Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ arakunrin rẹ̀ Helemu: Sofa, ati Imna, ati Ṣeleṣi, ati Amali.
entries.en: And the sons of his brother Helem; Zophah, and Imna, and Shelesh, and Amal.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Sofa; Sua, ati Harneferi, ati Ṣuali, ati Beri, ati Imra,
entries.en: The sons of Zophah; Suah, and Harnepher, and Shual, and Beri, and Imrah,

entries.yo: Beseri, ati Hodi, ati Ṣamma, ati Ṣilṣa, ati Itrani, ati Beera.
entries.en: Bezer, and Hod, and Shamma and Shilshah, and Ithran, and Beera.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Jeteri: Jefunne, ati Pispa, ati Ara.
entries.en: And the sons of Jether; Jephunneh, and Pispah, and Ara.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Ulla: Ara, ati Hanieli, ati Resia.
entries.en: And the sons of Ulla; Arah, and Haniel, and Rezia.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn wọnyi li awọn ọmọ Aṣeri, awọn olori ile baba wọn, aṣayan alagbara akọni enia, olori ninu awọn ijoye. Iye awọn ti a kà yẹ fun ogun, ati fun ijà ni idile wọn jẹ, ẹgbã mẹtala ọkunrin.
entries.en: All these were the children of Asher, heads of their father's house, choice and mighty men of valour, chief of the princes. And the number throughout the genealogy of them that were apt to the war and to battle was twenty and six thousand men.

entries.yo: BENJAMINI si bi Bela, akọbi rẹ̀, Aṣbeli ekeji, ati Ahara ẹkẹta,
entries.en: Now Benjamin begat Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, and Aharah the third,

entries.yo: Noha ẹkẹrin, ati Rafa ẹkarun.
entries.en: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Bela ni Addari, ati Gera, ati Abihudi,
entries.en: And the sons of Bela were, Addar, and Gera, and Abihud,

entries.yo: Ati Abiṣua, ati Naamani, ati Ahoa,
entries.en: And Abishua, and Naaman, and Ahoah,

entries.yo: Ati Gera, ati Ṣefufani, ati Huramu,
entries.en: And Gera, and Shephuphan, and Huram.

entries.yo: Wọnyi si li awọn ọmọ Ehudi: wọnyi li awọn olori baba wọn, ti nwọn ngbe Geba, nwọn si ko wọn lọ si Mahanati ni igbekun.
entries.en: And these are the sons of Ehud: these are the heads of the fathers of the inhabitants of Geba, and they removed them to Manahath:

entries.yo: Ati Naamani, ati Ahiah, ati Gera, o si ko wọn kuro, o si bi Ussa ati Ahihudi.
entries.en: And Naaman, and Ahiah, and Gera, he removed them, and begat Uzza, and Ahihud.

entries.yo: Ṣaharaimu si bi ọmọ ni ilẹ Moabu; lẹhin igbati o ti ran wọn lọ tan; Huṣimu ati Baera si li awọn aya rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Shaharaim begat children in the country of Moab, after he had sent them away; Hushim and Baara were his wives.

entries.yo: Hodeṣi, aya rẹ̀ si bi, Jobabu, ati Sibia, ati Meṣa, ati Malkama fun u,
entries.en: And he begat of Hodesh his wife, Jobab, and Zibia, and Mesha, and Malcham,

entries.yo: Ati Jeusi, ati Ṣokia, ati Mirma. Wọnyi li awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, olori awọn baba.
entries.en: And Jeuz, and Shachia, and Mirma. These were his sons, heads of the fathers.

entries.yo: Huṣimu si bi Ahitubu ati Elpaali fun u.
entries.en: And of Hushim he begat Abitub, and Elpaal.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Elpaali, Eberi, ati Miṣamu ati Ṣameri, ẹniti o kọ́ Ono ati Lodi pẹlu ilu wọn:
entries.en: The sons of Elpaal; Eber, and Misham, and Shamed, who built Ono, and Lod, with the towns thereof:

entries.yo: Beria pẹlu, ati Ṣema, ti nwọn iṣe olori awọn baba awọn ara Ajaloni, awọn ti o le awọn ara Gati kuro.
entries.en: Beriah also, and Shema, who were heads of the fathers of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who drove away the inhabitants of Gath:

entries.yo: Ati Ahio, Ṣaṣaki, Jerimotu,
entries.en: And Ahio, Shashak, and Jeremoth,

entries.yo: Ati Sebadiah, ati Aradi, ati Aderi,
entries.en: And Zebadiah, and Arad, and Ader,

entries.yo: Ati Mikaeli, ati Ispa, ati Joha, ni awọn ọmọ Beria;
entries.en: And Michael, and Ispah, and Joha, the sons of Beriah;

entries.yo: Ati Sobadiah, ati Meṣullamu, ati Heseki, ati Heberi.
entries.en: And Zebadiah, and Meshullam, and Hezeki, and Heber,

entries.yo: Iṣmeri pẹlu, ati Jeslia, ati Jobabu, ni awọn ọmọ Elpaali.
entries.en: Ishmerai also, and Jezliah, and Jobab, the sons of Elpaal;

entries.yo: Ati Jakimu, ati Sikri, ati Sabdi,
entries.en: And Jakim, and Zichri, and Zabdi,

entries.yo: Ati Elienai, ati Siltai, ati Elieli,
entries.en: And Elienai, and Zilthai, and Eliel,

entries.yo: Ati Adaiah, ati Beraiah, ati Ṣimrati ni awọn ọmọ Ṣimhi;
entries.en: And Adaiah, and Beraiah, and Shimrath, the sons of Shimhi;

entries.yo: Ati Iṣpani, ati Eberi, ati Elieli,
entries.en: And Ishpan, and Heber, and Eliel,

entries.yo: Ati Abdoni, ati Sikri, ati Hanani,
entries.en: And Abdon, and Zichri, and Hanan,

entries.yo: Ati Hananiah, ati Elamu, ati Antotiah,
entries.en: And Hananiah, and Elam, and Antothijah,

entries.yo: Ati Ifediah, ati Penueli, ni awọn ọmọ Ṣaṣaki;
entries.en: And Iphedeiah, and Penuel, the sons of Shashak;

entries.yo: Ati Samṣerai, ati Sehariah, ati Ataliah,
entries.en: And Shamsherai, and Shehariah, and Athaliah,

entries.yo: Ati Jaresiah, ati Eliah, ati Sikri, ni awọn ọmọ Jerohamu.
entries.en: And Jaresiah, and Eliah, and Zichri, the sons of Jeroham.

entries.yo: Wọnyi li olori awọn baba, nipa iran wọn, awọn olori. Awọn wọnyi ni ngbe Jerusalemu.
entries.en: These were heads of the fathers, by their generations, chief men. These dwelt in Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Ni Gibeoni ni baba Gibeoni si ngbe; orukọ aya ẹniti ijẹ Maaka:
entries.en: And at Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon; whose wife's name was Maachah:

entries.yo: Ọmọ rẹ̀ akọbi si ni Abdoni, ati Suri, ati Kiṣi, ati Baali, ati Nadabu,
entries.en: And his firstborn son Abdon, and Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Nadab,

entries.yo: Ati Gedori, ati Ahio, ati Sakeri,
entries.en: And Gedor, and Ahio, and Zacher.

entries.yo: Mikloti si bi Ṣimea. Awọn wọnyi pẹlu si mba awọn arakunrin wọn gbe Jerusalemu, nwọn kọju si ara wọn.
entries.en: And Mikloth begat Shimeah. And these also dwelt with their brethren in Jerusalem, over against them.

entries.yo: Neri si bi Kiṣi, ati Kiṣi si bi Saulu, ati Saulu si bi Jonatani, ati Milkiṣua, ati Abinadabu, ati Esbaali.
entries.en: And Ner begat Kish, and Kish begat Saul, and Saul begat Jonathan, and Malchi-shua, and Abinadab, and Esh-baal.

entries.yo: Ọmọ Jonatani si ni Meribaali; Meribaali si bi Mika.
entries.en: And the son of Jonathan was Merib-baal; and Merib-baal begat Micah.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Mika ni Pitoni ati Meleki, ati Tarea, ati Ahasi.
entries.en: And the sons of Micah were, Pithon, and Melech, and Tarea, and Ahaz.

entries.yo: Ahasi si bi Jehoadda; ati Jehoadda si bi Alemeti, ati Asmafeti, ati Simri: Simri si bi Mosa;
entries.en: And Ahaz begat Jehoadah; and Jehoadah begat Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begat Moza,

entries.yo: Mosa si bi Binea, Rafa ọmọ rẹ̀, Eleasari ọmọ rẹ̀, Aseli ọmọ rẹ̀:
entries.en: And Moza begat Binea: Rapha was his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son:

entries.yo: Aseli si ni ọmọkunrin mẹfa, orukọ wọn ni wọnyi, Asrikamu, Bokeru, ati Iṣmaeli, ati Seraiah, ati Obadiah, ati Hanani. Gbogbo awọn wọnyi li ọmọ Aseli.
entries.en: And Azel had six sons, whose names are these, Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Eṣeki arakunrin rẹ̀ si ni Ulamu akọbi rẹ̀, Jehuṣi ekeji, ati Elifeleti ẹkẹta.
entries.en: And the sons of Eshek his brother were, Ulam his firstborn, Jehush the second, and Eliphelet the third.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Ulamu si jẹ alagbara akọni ọkunrin, tafatafa, nwọn si li ọmọ pupọ ati ọmọ ọmọ adọjọ. Gbogbo wọnyi li awọn ọmọ Benjamini.
entries.en: And the sons of Ulam were mighty men of valour, archers, and had many sons, and sons' sons, an hundred and fifty. All these are of the sons of Benjamin.

entries.yo: A si ka iye gbogbo Israeli ni idile idile wọn; si kiyesi i, a kọ wọn sinu iwe awọn ọba Israeli: Juda li a si kó lọ si Babiloni nitori ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: So all Israel were reckoned by genealogies; and, behold, they were written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah, who were carried away to Babylon for their transgression.

entries.yo: Awọn ti o tetekọ gbe ilẹ ini wọn, ati ilu wọn li awọn ọmọ Israeli, awọn alufa, ati awọn ọmọ Lefi ati awọn Netinimu.
entries.en: Now the first inhabitants that dwelt in their possessions in their cities were, the Israelites, the priests, Levites, and the Nethinims.

entries.yo: Ni Jerusalemu ni, ninu awọn ọmọ Juda, ati ninu awọn ọmọ Benjamini, ati ninu awọn ọmọ Efraimu, ati Manasse ngbe;
entries.en: And in Jerusalem dwelt of the children of Judah, and of the children of Benjamin, and of the children of Ephraim, and Manasseh;

entries.yo: Utai ọmọ Ammihudi, ọmọ Omri, ọmọ Imri, ọmọ Bani, ninu awọn ọmọ Faresi ọmọ Juda.
entries.en: Uthai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the children of Pharez the son of Judah.

entries.yo: Ati ninu awọn ara Ṣilo, Asaiah akọbi, ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And of the Shilonites; Asaiah the firstborn, and his sons.

entries.yo: Ati ninu awọn ọmọ Sera, Jegueli, ati awọn arakunrin wọn, ẹdẹgbẹrin o di mẹwa.
entries.en: And of the sons of Zerah; Jeuel, and their brethren, six hundred and ninety.

entries.yo: Ati ninu awọn ọmọ Benjamini; Sallu, ọmọ Meṣullamu, ọmọ Hodafiah, ọmọ Senua.
entries.en: And of the sons of Benjamin; Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hasenuah,

entries.yo: Ati Ibneiah ọmọ Jerohamu, ati Ela ọmọ Ussi, ọmọ Mikri, ati Meṣullamu ọmọ Ṣefatiah, ọmọ Regueli, ọmọ Ibniah;
entries.en: And Ibneiah the son of Jeroham, and Elah the son of Uzzi, the son of Michri, and Meshullam the son of Shephathiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah;

entries.yo: Ati awọn arakunrin wọn, gẹgẹ bi idile wọn ẹgbẹrun o din mẹrinlelogoji. Gbogbo awọn ọkunrin wọnyi ni olori ninu awọn baba ni ile baba wọn.
entries.en: And their brethren, according to their generations, nine hundred and fifty and six. All these men were chief of the fathers in the house of their fathers.

entries.yo: Ati ninu awọn alufa; Jedaiah, ati Jehoiaribu ati Jakini,
entries.en: And of the priests; Jedaiah, and Jehoiarib, and Jachin,

entries.yo: Ati Asariah ọmọ Hilkiah, ọmọ Meṣullamu, ọmọ Sadoku, ọmọ Meraiotu, ọmọ Ahitubu olori ile Ọlọrun;
entries.en: And Azariah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of the house of God;

entries.yo: Ati Adaiah ọmọ Jerohamu, ọmọ Paṣuri, ọmọ Malkijah, ati Maasai ọmọ Adieli, ọmọ Jasera, ọmọ Meṣullamu, ọmọ Meṣillemiti, ọmọ Immeri;
entries.en: And Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashur, the son of Malchijah, and Maasiai the son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;

entries.yo: Ati awọn arakunrin wọn olori ile baba wọn, ẹgbẹsan o din ogoji; awọn alagbara akọni ọkunrin fun iṣẹ ìsin ile Ọlọrun.
entries.en: And their brethren, heads of the house of their fathers, a thousand and seven hundred and threescore; very able men for the work of the service of the house of God.

entries.yo: Ati ninu awọn ọmọ Lefi; Ṣemaiah ọmọ Haṣubu, ọmọ Asrikamu, ọmọ Haṣabiah, ninu awọn ọmọ Merari;
entries.en: And of the Levites; Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;

entries.yo: Ati Bakbakkari, Hereṣi, ati Galali, ati Mattaniah ọmọ Mika, ọmọ Sikri, ọmọ Asafu;
entries.en: And Bakbakkar, Heresh, and Galal, and Mattaniah the son of Micah, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph;

entries.yo: Ati Obadiah ọmọ Ṣemaiah, ọmọ Galali, ọmọ Jedutuni, ati Berekiah ọmọ Asa, ọmọ Elkanah, ti ngbe ileto awọn ara Netofa.
entries.en: And Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun, and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, that dwelt in the villages of the Netophathites.

entries.yo: Awọn adena si ni Ṣallumu, ati Akkubu, ati Talmoni, ati Ahimani, ati awọn arakunrin wọn; Ṣallumu li olori;
entries.en: And the porters were, Shallum, and Akkub, and Talmon, and Ahiman, and their brethren: Shallum was the chief;

entries.yo: Titi di isisiyi awọn ti o duro li oju-ọ̀na ọba niha ilà-õrùn; adena ni wọn li ẹgbẹ awọn ọmọ Lefi.
entries.en: Who hitherto waited in the king's gate eastward: they were porters in the companies of the children of Levi.

entries.yo: Ati Ṣallumu ọmọ Kore, ọmọ Ebiasafu, ọmọ Kora, ati awọn arakunrin rẹ̀, ti ile baba rẹ̀, awọn ọmọ Kora, ni mbẹ lori iṣẹ ìsin na, olutọju iloro agọ na; awọn baba wọn ti mbẹ lori ibudo Oluwa ti nwọn ima ṣọ atiwọ̀le na.
entries.en: And Shallum the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brethren, of the house of his father, the Korahites, were over the work of the service, keepers of the gates of the tabernacle: and their fathers, being over the host of the LORD, were keepers of the entry.

entries.yo: Ati Finehasi ọmọ Eleasari ni olori lori wọn ni igba atijọ, Oluwa si wà pẹlu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar was the ruler over them in time past, and the Lord was with him.

entries.yo: Sekariah ọmọ Meṣelemiah ni adena ilẹkun agọ ajọ enia.
entries.en: And Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was porter of the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

entries.yo: Gbogbo wọnyi ti a ti yàn lati ṣe adena loju iloro, jẹ igba o le mejila. A ka awọn wọnyi nipa idile wọn ni ileto wọn, awọn ẹniti Dafidi ati Samueli, ariran, ti yàn nitori otitọ wọn.
entries.en: All these which were chosen to be porters in the gates were two hundred and twelve. These were reckoned by their genealogy in their villages, whom David and Samuel the seer did ordain in their set office.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li awọn wọnyi ati awọn ọmọ wọn nṣẹ abojuto iloro ile Oluwa, eyini ni ile agọ na fun iṣọ.
entries.en: So they and their children had the oversight of the gates of the house of the Lord, namely, the house of the tabernacle, by wards.

entries.yo: Ni igun mẹrẹrin ni awọn adena mbẹ, niha ilà-õrùn, ìwọ-õrún, ariwa ati gusu.
entries.en: In four quarters were the porters, toward the east, west, north, and south.

entries.yo: Ati awọn arakunrin wọn ngbe ileto wọn, lati ma wá pẹlu wọn ni ijọ ekeje lati igba de igba.
entries.en: And their brethren, which were in their villages, were to come after seven days from time to time with them.

entries.yo: Nitoriti awọn ọmọ Lefi wọnyi jẹ awọn olori adena mẹrin, nwọn si wà ninu iṣẹ na, nwọn si wà lori iyara ati ibi iṣura ile Ọlọrun.
entries.en: For these Levites, the four chief porters, were in their set office, and were over the chambers and treasuries of the house of God.

entries.yo: Nwọn a si ma sùn yi ile Ọlọrun ka, nitori ti nwọn ni itọju na, ati ṣiṣi rẹ̀ li orowurọ jẹ ti wọn.
entries.en: And they lodged round about the house of God, because the charge was upon them, and the opening thereof every morning pertained to them.

entries.yo: Ati awọn kan ninu wọn ni itọju ohun elo ìsin, lati ma kó wọn sinu ile ati si ode ni iye.
entries.en: And certain of them had the charge of the ministering vessels, that they should bring them in and out by tale.

entries.yo: Ninu wọn li a yàn lati ma bojuto ohun elo, ati gbogbo ohun elo ibi mimọ́, ati iyẹfun kikunna, ati ọti-waini, ati ororo, ati ojia, ati turari.
entries.en: Some of them also were appointed to oversee the vessels, and all the instruments of the sanctuary, and the fine flour, and the wine, and the oil, and the frankincense, and the spices.

entries.yo: Ati omiran ninu awọn ọmọ awọn alufa si fi turari ṣe ororo.
entries.en: And some of the sons of the priests made the ointment of the spices.

entries.yo: Ati Mattitiah, ọkan ninu awọn ọmọ Lefi, ti iṣe akọbi Ṣallumu ọmọ Kora, li o nṣe alabojuto iṣẹ ohun ti a ndín.
entries.en: And Mattithiah, one of the Levites, who was the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, had the set office over the things that were made in the pans.

entries.yo: Ati ninu awọn arakunrin wọn ninu awọn ọmọ Kohati li o nṣe itọju akara-ifihan, lati mã pese rẹ̀ li ọjọjọ isimi.
entries.en: And other of their brethren, of the sons of the Kohathites, were over the shewbread, to prepare it every sabbath.

entries.yo: Wọnyi si li awọn akọrin, olori awọn baba awọn ọmọ Lefi, nwọn kò ni iṣẹ ninu iyara wọnni; nitori ti nwọn wà lẹnu iṣẹ wọn lọsan ati loru.
entries.en: And these are the singers, chief of the fathers of the Levites, who remaining in the chambers were free: for they were employed in that work day and night.

entries.yo: Awọn wọnyi ni olori baba awọn ọmọ Lefi, ni iran wọn, olori ni nwọn: awọn wọnyi ni ngbe Jerusalemu.
entries.en: These chief fathers of the Levites were chief throughout their generations; these dwelt at Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Ati ni Gibeoni ni baba Gibeoni ngbe, Jegieli, orukọ aya ẹniti ijẹ Maaka.
entries.en: And in Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon, Jehiel, whose wife's name was Maachah:

entries.yo: Akọbi ọmọ rẹ̀ si ni Abdoni, ati Suri ati Kiṣi, ati Baali, ati Neri, ati Nadabu,
entries.en: And his firstborn son Abdon, then Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Ner, and Nadab,

entries.yo: Ati Gedori, ati Ahio, ati Sekariah ati Mikloti.
entries.en: And Gedor, and Ahio, and Zechariah, and Mikloth.

entries.yo: Mikloti si bi Ṣimeamu. Awọn wọnyi si mba awọn arakunrin wọn gbe ni Jerusalemu, kọju si awọn arakunrin wọn.
entries.en: And Mikloth begat Shimeam. And they also dwelt with their brethren at Jerusalem, over against their brethren.

entries.yo: Neri si bi Kiṣi, Kiṣi si bi Saulu, Saulu si bi Jonatani, ati Malkiṣua, ati Abinadabu, ati Eṣbaali.
entries.en: And Ner begat Kish; and Kish begat Saul; and Saul begat Jonathan, and Malchi-shua, and Abinadab, and Esh-baal.

entries.yo: Ati ọmọ Jonatani ni Merib-baali; Merib-baali si bi Mika.
entries.en: And the son of Jonathan was Merib-baal: and Merib-baal begat Micah.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Mika ni Pitoni, ati Meleki, ati Tarea, ati Ahasi.
entries.en: And the sons of Micah were, Pithon, and Melech, and Tahrea, and Ahaz.

entries.yo: Ahasi si bi Jara; Jara si bi Alemeti, ati Asmafeti, ati Simri, Simri si bi Mosa,
entries.en: And Ahaz begat Jarah; and Jarah begat Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begat Moza;

entries.yo: Mosa si bi Binea, ati Refaiah ọmọ rẹ̀, Eleasa ọmọ rẹ̀, Aseli ọmọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Moza begat Binea; and Rephaiah his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.

entries.yo: Aseli si bi ọmọ mẹfa, orukọ wọn ni wọnyi; Asrikamu, Bokeru, ati Iṣmaeli, ati Ṣeariah, ati Obadiah ati Hanani. Wọnyi li awọn ọmọ Aseli.
entries.en: And Azel had six sons, whose names are these, Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan: these were the sons of Azel.

entries.yo: AWỌN ara Filistia si ba Israeli jagun, awọn ọkunrin Israeli si sá niwaju awọn ara Filistia, nwọn fi ara pa, nwọn si ṣubu li òke Gilboa.
entries.en: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain in mount Gilboa.

entries.yo: Awọn ara Filistia si lepa Saulu kikan, ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀: awọn ara Filistia si pa Jonatani, ati Abinadabu, ati Melkiṣua, awọn ọmọ Saulu.
entries.en: And the Philistines followed hard after Saul, and after his sons; and the Philistines slew Jonathan, and Abinadab, and Malchi-shua, the sons of Saul.

entries.yo: Ogun na si le fun Saulu, awọn tafàtafà si ba a, on si damu nitori awọn tafàtafà.
entries.en: And the battle went sore against Saul, and the archers hit him, and he was wounded of the archers.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Saulu wi fun ẹniti o ru ihamọra rẹ̀ pe, Fa idà rẹ yọ, ki o si fi gun mi, ki awọn alaikọla wọnyi ki o má ba wá fi mi ṣẹsin. Ṣugbọn ẹniti o ru ihamọra rẹ̀ kọ̀, nitori ẹ̀ru ba a gidigidi. Bẹ̃ni Saulu si mu idà, o si ṣubu le e.
entries.en: Then said Saul to his armourbearer, Draw thy sword, and thrust me through therewith; lest these uncircumcised come and abuse me. But his armourbearer would not; for he was sore afraid. So Saul took a sword, and fell upon it.

entries.yo: Nigbati ẹniti o ru ihamọra rẹ̀ si ri pe Saulu kú, on na pẹlu si ṣubu le idà rẹ̀, o si kú.
entries.en: And when his armourbearer saw that Saul was dead, he fell likewise on the sword, and died.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Saulu kú, ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ mẹtẹta, gbogbo ile rẹ̀ si kú ṣọkan.
entries.en: So Saul died, and his three sons, and all his house died together.

entries.yo: Nigbati gbogbo awọn ọkunrin Israeli ti o wà ni pẹtẹlẹ ri pe nwọn sá, ati pe Saulu ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ kú, nwọn fi ilu wọn silẹ, nwọn si sá: awọn ara Filistia si wá; nwọn si joko ninu wọn.
entries.en: And when all the men of Israel that were in the valley saw that they fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, then they forsook their cities, and fled: and the Philistines came and dwelt in them.

entries.yo: O si ṣe ni ijọ keji, nigbati awọn ara Filistia de lati wá bọ́ awọn okú li aṣọ, nwọn si ri Saulu pẹlu, ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ pe; nwọn ṣubu li òke Gilboa.
entries.en: And it came to pass on the morrow, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, that they found Saul and his sons fallen in mount Gilboa.

entries.yo: Nwọn si bọ́ ọ li aṣọ, nwọn si gbé ori rẹ̀ ati ihamọra rẹ̀, nwọn si ranṣẹ si awọn ara Filistia yika, lati mu ihin lọ irò fun awọn ere wọn, ati fun awọn enia.
entries.en: And when they had stripped him, they took his head, and his armour, and sent into the land of the Philistines round about, to carry tidings unto their idols, and to the people.

entries.yo: Nwọn si fi ihamọra rẹ̀ sinu ile oriṣa wọn, nwọn si kan agbari rẹ̀ mọ ile Dagoni.
entries.en: And they put his armour in the house of their gods, and fastened his head in the temple of Dagon.

entries.yo: Nigbati gbogbo Jabeṣ-gileadi gbọ́ gbogbo eyi ti awọn ara Filistia ti ṣe si Saulu,
entries.en: And when all Jabesh-gilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul,

entries.yo: Nwọn dide, gbogbo awọn ọkunrin ogun, nwọn si gbé okú Saulu lọ, ati okú awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, nwọn wá si Jabeṣi, nwọn si sìn egungun wọn labẹ igi oaku ni Jabeṣi, nwọn si gbawẹ ni ijọ meje.
entries.en: They arose, all the valiant men, and took away the body of Saul, and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh, and buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Saulu kú ninu ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ̀ ti o da si Oluwa, nitori ọ̀rọ Oluwa, ti on kò kiyesi, ati pẹlu nitori o lọ bère ọ̀ràn lọwọ abokusọrọ, lati ṣe ibere.
entries.en: So Saul died for his transgression which he committed against the LORD, even against the word of the LORD, which he kept not, and also for asking counsel of one that had a familiar spirit, to inquire of it;

entries.yo: Kò si bère lọwọ Oluwa; nitorina li o ṣe pa a, o si yi ijọba na pada sọdọ Dafidi ọmọ Jesse.
entries.en: And inquired not of the LORD: therefore he slew him, and turned the kingdom unto David the son of Jesse.

entries.yo: NIGBANA ni gbogbo Israeli ko ara wọn jọ si ọdọ Dafidi ni Hebroni, wipe, Kiyesi i, egungun rẹ ati ẹran ara rẹ li awa iṣe.
entries.en: Then all Israel gathered themselves to David unto Hebron, saying, Behold, we are thy bone and thy flesh.

entries.yo: Ati pẹlu li atijọ, ani nigbati Saulu jẹ ọba, iwọ li o nmu Israeli jade ti o si nmu u wá ile: Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ si wi fun ọ pe, Ki iwọ ki o bọ Israeli, enia mi, ki iwọ ki o si ṣe ọmọ-alade lori Israeli enia mi.
entries.en: And moreover in time past, even when Saul was king, thou wast he that leddest out and broughtest in Israel: and the LORD thy God said unto thee, Thou shalt feed my people Israel, and thou shalt be ruler over my people Israel, and thou shalt be ruler over my people Israel.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni gbogbo awọn agbagba Israeli ṣe tọ ọba wá ni Hebroni; Dafidi si ba wọn da majẹmu ni Hebroni niwaju Oluwa; nwọn si fi ororo yan Dafidi li ọba lori Israeli, gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ Oluwa nipa ọwọ Samueli.
entries.en: Therefore came all the elders of Israel to the king to Hebron; and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before the LORD; and they anointed David king over Israel, according to the word of the LORD by Samuel.

entries.yo: Ati Dafidi ati gbogbo Israeli jade lọ si Jerusalemu, ti iṣe Jebusi; awọn Jebusi ara ilẹ na ngbe ibẹ̀.
entries.en: And David and all Israel went to Jerusalem, which is Jebus; where the Jebusites were, the inhabitants of the land.

entries.yo: Awọn ara ilu Jebusi si wi fun Dafidi pe, Iwọ kò gbọdọ wọ̀ ihinyi wa. Ṣugbọn Dafidi kó ilu odi Sioni ti iṣe ilu Dafidi.
entries.en: And the inhabitants of Jebus said to David, Thou shalt not come hither. Nevertheless David took the castle of Zion, which is the city of David.

entries.yo: Dafidi si wipe, Ẹnikẹni ti o ba tetekọ kọlù awọn ara Jebusi ni yio ṣe olori ati balogun. Bẹ̃ni Joabu ọmọ Seruiah si tetekọ gòke lọ, o si jẹ olori.
entries.en: And David said, Whosoever smiteth the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain. So Joab the son of Zeruiah went first up, and was chief.

entries.yo: Dafidi si ngbe inu ilu odi, nitorina ni nwọn fi npè e ni ilu Dafidi.
entries.en: And David dwelt in the castle; therefore they called it the city of David.

entries.yo: O si kọ́ ilu na yikakiri; ani lati Millo yikakiri: Joabu si tun iyokù ilu na ṣe.
entries.en: And he built the city round about, even from Millo round about: and Joab repaired the rest of the city.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Dafidi nga, o si npọ̀ si i: nitori ti Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wà pẹlu rẹ̀.
entries.en: So David waxed greater and greater: for the LORD of hosts was with him.

entries.yo: Wọnyi si ni olori awọn ọkunrin akọni ti Dafidi ni; awọn ti o fi ara wọn mọ ọ girigiri ni ijọba rẹ̀, pẹlu gbogbo Israeli, lati fi i jọba, gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ Oluwa fun Israeli.
entries.en: These also are the chief of the mighty men whom David had, who strengthened themselves with him in his kingdom, and with all Israel, to make him king, according to the word of the LORD concerning Israel.

entries.yo: Eyi ni iye awọn ọkunrin akọni ti Dafidi ni; Jaṣobeamu ọmọ Hakmoni, olori ninu awọn ọgbọ̀n balogun: on li o gbé ọ̀kọ rẹ̀ soke si ọ̃dunrun enia ti o pa lẹrikan.
entries.en: And this is the number of the mighty men whom David had; Jashobeam, and Hachmonite, the chief of the captains: he lifted up his spear against three hundred slain by him at one time.

entries.yo: Lẹhin rẹ̀ ni Eleaseri ọmọ Dodo, ara Ahohi, ẹniti iṣe ọkan ninu awọn akọni mẹta.
entries.en: And after him was Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, who was one of the three mighties.

entries.yo: On wà pẹlu Dafidi ni Pasdammimu, nigbati awọn ara Filistia ko ara wọn jọ lati jagun, nibiti ilẹ-bĩri kan wà ti o kún fun ọkà barli; awọn enia si salọ kuro niwaju awọn ara Filistia.
entries.en: He was with David at Pas-dammim, and there the Philistines were gathered together to battle, where was a parcel of ground full of barley; and the people fled from before the Philistines.

entries.yo: Nwọn si duro jẹ li ãrin ilẹ-bĩri na, nwọn si gbà a, nwọn si pa awọn ara Filistia; Oluwa si fi igbala nla gbà wọn.
entries.en: And they set themselves in the midst of that parcel, and delivered it, and slew the Philistines; and the LORD saved them by a great deliverance.

entries.yo: Awọn mẹta ninu awọn ọgbọ̀n balogun si sọ̀kalẹ tọ̀ Dafidi lọ sibi apata na, ninu iho Adullamu; ogun ara Filistia si do li afonifoji Refaimu.
entries.en: Now three of the thirty captains went down to the rock to David, into the cave of Adullam; and the host of the Philistines encamped in the valley of Rephaim.

entries.yo: Dafidi si mbẹ ninu ilu odi nigbana, ẹgbẹ-ogun awọn ara Filistia si mbẹ ni Betlehemu li akoko na.
entries.en: And David was then in the hold, and the Philistines' garrison was then at Bethlehem.

entries.yo: Dafidi si pòngbẹ, o si wipe, Emi iba ri ẹni fun mi mu ninu omi kanga Betlehemu ti mbẹ leti ẹnu-bodè!
entries.en: And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me drink of the water of the well of Bethlehem, that is at the gate!

entries.yo: Awọn mẹta na si la inu ogun awọn ara Filistia kọja, nwọn si fa omi jade lati inu kanga Betlehemu, lati ẹnu-bodè, nwọn gbé e, nwọn si mu u tọ̀ Dafidi wá: Dafidi kò si fẹ mu u, ṣugbọn o tu u silẹ fun Oluwa,
entries.en: And the three brake through the host of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem, that was by the gate, and took it, and brought it to David: but David would not drink of it, but poured it out to the LORD,

entries.yo: O si wipe, Ki Ọlọrun mi má jẹ ki emi ki o ṣe eyi: ki emi ki o ha mu ẹ̀jẹ awọn ọkunrin wọnyi, ti nwọn fi ẹmi wọn wewu? nipa ẹmi wọn ni nwọn fi mu u wá. Nitorina ni on kò ṣe fẹ mu u, nkan wọnyi li awọn akọni mẹta wọnyi ṣe.
entries.en: And said, My God forbid it me, that I should do this thing: shall I drink the blood of these men that have put their lives in jeopardy? for with the jeopardy of their lives they brought it. Therefore he would not drink it. These things did these three mightiest.

entries.yo: Ati Abiṣai arakunrin Joabu, on li olori ninu awọn mẹta: nitoriti o gbé ọ̀kọ rẹ̀ soke si ọ̃dunrun o pa wọn, o si ni orukọ ninu awọn mẹta.
entries.en: And Abishai the brother of Joab, he was chief of the three: for lifting up his spear against three hundred, he slew them, and had a name among the three.

entries.yo: O ni ọla jù awọn mẹta ẹgbẹ ekeji lọ o si jẹ olori wọn: ṣugbọn kò to awọn mẹta iṣaju.
entries.en: Of the three, he was more honourable than the two; for he was their captain: howbeit he attained not to the first three.

entries.yo: Benaiah, ọmọ Jehoiada, ọmọ akọni ọkunrin kan ti Kabseeli, ẹniti o pọ̀ ni iṣe agbara, o pa awọn ọmọ Arieli meji ti Moabu; on sọkalẹ, o si pa kiniun kan ninu iho lakoko sno.
entries.en: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done many acts; he slew two lionlike men of Moab: also he went down and slew a lion in a pit in a snowy day.

entries.yo: O si pa ara Egipti kan, ọkunrin ti o si sigbọnlẹ igbọnwọ marun ni gigun rẹ̀; ati li ọwọ ara Egipti na ni ọ̀kọ kan wà bi idubu igi awunṣọ; o si sọ̀kalẹ tọ ọ lọ pẹlu ọpa, a si já ọ̀kọ li ọwọ ara Egipti na, o si fi ọ̀kọ rẹ̀ pa a.
entries.en: And he slew an Egyptian, a man of great stature, five cubits high; and in the Egyptian's hand was a spear like a weaver's beam; and he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian's hand, and slew him with his own spear.

entries.yo: Nkan wọnyi ni Benaiah ọmọ Jehoiada ṣe, o si li orukọ ninu awọn akọni mẹta.
entries.en: These things did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and had the name among the three mighties.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, o li ọla jù awọn ọ̀gbọn lọ, ṣugbọn kò to awọn mẹta iṣaju. Dafidi si fi ṣe olori awọn igbimọ ile rẹ̀.
entries.en: Behold, he was honourable among the thirty, but attained not to the first three: and David set him over his guard.

entries.yo: Awọn akọni ọkunrin ọmọ ogun rẹ̀ ni Asaheli arakunrin Joabu, Elhanani, ọmọ Dodo, ara Betlehemu.
entries.en: Also the valiant men of the armies were, Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,

entries.yo: Sammotu, ara Harori, Helesi, ara Peloni,
entries.en: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,

entries.yo: Ira, ọmọ Ikkeṣi, ara Tekoa, Abieseri ara Anatoti,
entries.en: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abi-ezer the Antothite,

entries.yo: Sibbekai, ara Husa, Ilai, ara Ahohi,
entries.en: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,

entries.yo: Maharai, ara Netofa, Heledi ọmọ Baana, ara Netofa.
entries.en: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite,

entries.yo: Itai ọmọ Ribai ti Gibea, ti awọn ọmọ Benjamini, Benaiah ara Piratoni,
entries.en: Ithai the son of Ribai of Gibeah, that pertained to the children of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,

entries.yo: Hurai ti odò Gaaṣi, Abieli ara Arbati,
entries.en: Hurai of the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,

entries.yo: Asmafeti ara Baharumi, Eliaba ara Ṣaalboni.
entries.en: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Haṣemu ara Gisoni, Jonatani ọmọ Sage, ara Harari.
entries.en: The sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan the son of Shage the Hararite,

entries.yo: Ahihamu ọmọ Sakari, ara Harari, Elifali ọmọ Uri,
entries.en: Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal the son of Ur,

entries.yo: Heferi ara Mekerati, Ahijah ara Peloni,
entries.en: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,

entries.yo: Hesro ara Karmeli, Naari ọmọ Esbai,
entries.en: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai the son of Ezbai,

entries.yo: Joeli arakunrin Natani, Mibhari ọmọ Haggeri,
entries.en: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar the son of Haggeri,

entries.yo: Saleki ara Ammoni, Naharai ara Beroti, ẹniti nru ihamọra Joabu ọmọ Seruiah,
entries.en: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite, the armourbearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah,

entries.yo: Ira ara Itri, Garobu ara Itri,
entries.en: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,

entries.yo: Uriah ara Heti, Sabadi ọmọ Ahalai,
entries.en: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai,

entries.yo: Adina ọmọ Ṣisa ara Reubeni, olori awọn ara Reubeni, ati ọgbọ̀n enia pẹlu rẹ̀.
entries.en: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite, a captain of the Reubenites, and thirty with him,

entries.yo: Hanani ọmọ Maaka, ati Jehoṣafati ara Mitini,
entries.en: Hanan the son of Maachah, and Joshaphat the Mithnite,

entries.yo: Ussia ara Aslerati, Ṣama ati Jegieli, awọn ọmọ Hotani, ara Aroeri,
entries.en: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jehiel the sons of Hothan the Aroerite,

entries.yo: Jediaeli ọmọ Simri, ati Joha arakunrin rẹ̀ ara Tisi,
entries.en: Jediael the son of Shimri, and Joha his brother, the Tizite,

entries.yo: Elieli ara Mahafi, ati Jeribai, ati Joṣafia, awọn ọmọ Elnaamu, ati Tima ara Moabu.
entries.en: Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai, and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite,

entries.yo: Elieli, ati Obedi, ati Jasieli ara Mesobah.
entries.en: Eliel, and Obed, and Jasiel the Mesobaite.

entries.yo: WỌNYI si li awọn ti o tọ̀ Dafidi wá si Siklagi, nigbati o fi ara rẹ̀ pamọ, nitori Saulu ọmọ Kiṣi: awọn wọnyi si wà ninu awọn akọni ti nṣe oluranlọwọ ogun na.
entries.en: Now these are they that came to David to Ziklag, while he yet kept himself close because of Saul the son of Kish: and they were among the mighty men, helpers of the war.

entries.yo: Nwọn le tafa, nwọn si le fi ọwọ ọtún ati ọwọ ọ̀si sọ okuta, ati fi ọrun tafa, ani ninu awọn arakunrin Saulu ti Benjamini.
entries.en: They were armed with bows, and could use both the right hand and the left in hurling stones and shooting arrows out of a bow, even of Saul's brethren of Benjamin.

entries.yo: Ahieseri ni olori, ati Joaṣi, awọn ọmọ Ṣemaa ara Gibea; ati Jesieli ati Peleti, awọn ọmọ Asmafeti; ati Beraka, ati Jehu ara Anatoti,
entries.en: The chief was Ahiezer, then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; and Jeziel, and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; and Berachah, and Jehu the Antothite,

entries.yo: Ati Ismaiah ara Gibeoni, akọni ninu awọn ọgbọ̀n, ati lori ọgbọ̀n (enia) ati Jeremiah, ati Jahasieli, ati Johanani, ati Josabadi ara Gedera.
entries.en: And Ismaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the thirty, and over the thirty; and Jeremiah, and Jahaziel, and Johanan, and Josabad the Gederathite,

entries.yo: Elusai ati Jeremoti, ati Bealiah, ati Ṣemariah, ati Ṣefatiah ara Harofi,
entries.en: Eluzai, and Jerimoth, and Bealiah, and Shemariah, and Shephatiah the Haruphite,

entries.yo: Elkana, ati Jesiah, ati Asareelti ati Joeseri, ati Jaṣobeamu, awọn ara Kora,
entries.en: Elkanah, and Jesiah, and Azareel, and Joezer, and Jashobeam, the Korhites,

entries.yo: Ati Joela, ati Sebadiah, awọn ọmọ Jerohamu ti Gedori.
entries.en: And Joelah, and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.

entries.yo: Ati ninu awọn ara Gadi, awọn ọkunrin akọni kan ya ara wọn sọdọ Dafidi ninu iho ni iju, awọn ọkunrin ogun ti o yẹ fun ija ti o le di asà on ọ̀kọ mu, oju awọn ẹniti o dabi oju kiniun, nwọn si yara bi agbọnrin lori awọn òke nla;
entries.en: And of the Gadites there separated themselves unto David into the hold to the wilderness men of might, and men of war fit for the battle, that could handle shield and buckler, whose faces were like the faces of lions, and were as swift as the roes upon the mountains;

entries.yo: Eseri ekini, Obadiah ekeji, Eliobu ẹkẹta,
entries.en: Ezer the first, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,

entries.yo: Miṣmanna ẹkẹrin, Jeremiah ẹkarun,
entries.en: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,

entries.yo: Attai ẹkẹfa, Elieli ekeje,
entries.en: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,

entries.yo: Johanani ẹkẹjọ, Elsabadi ẹkẹsan,
entries.en: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,

entries.yo: Jeremiah ẹkẹwa, Makbanai ẹkọkanla.
entries.en: Jeremiah the tenth, Machbanai the eleventh.

entries.yo: Awọn wọnyi li awọn ọmọ Gadi, awọn olori ogun: ẹniti o kere jù to fun ọgọrun enia, ati ẹniti o pọ̀ju to fun ẹgbẹrun.
entries.en: These were of the sons of Gad, captains of the host: one of the least was over an hundred, and the greatest over a thousand.

entries.yo: Wọnyi li awọn ti o gòke odò Jordani li oṣù ekini, nigbati o kún bò gbogbo bèbe rẹ̀; nwọn si le gbogbo awọn ti o wà li afonifoji ninu ila-õrùn, ati niha iwọ-õrùn.
entries.en: These are they that went over Jordan in the first month, when it had overflown all his banks; and they put to flight all them of the valleys, both toward the east, and toward the west.

entries.yo: Ninu awọn ọmọ Benjamini ati Juda si tọ Dafidi wá lori òke.
entries.en: And there came of the children of Benjamin and Judah to the hold unto David.

entries.yo: Dafidi si jade lọ ipade wọn, o si dahun o si wi fun wọn pe, Bi o ba ṣepe ẹnyin tọ̀ mi wá li alafia lati ràn mi lọwọ, ọkàn mi yio ṣọkan pẹlu nyin: ṣugbọn bi o ba ṣepe ẹnyin wá lati fi mi hàn fun awọn ọta mi, nigbati ẹbi kò si lọwọ mi, ki Ọlọrun awọn baba wa ki o wò o, ki o si ṣe idajọ.
entries.en: And David went out to meet them, and answered and said unto them, If ye be come peaceably unto me to help me, mine heart shall be knit unto you: but if ye be come to betray me to mine enemies, seeing there is no wrong in mine hands, the God of our fathers look thereon, and rebuke it.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ẹmi bà lé Amasai, ti iṣe olori awọn ọgbọn na, wipe, Tirẹ li awa, Dafidi, tirẹ li a si nṣe, iwọ ọmọ Jesse: alafia! alafia ni fun ọ! alafia si ni fun awọn oluranlọwọ rẹ; nitori Ọlọrun rẹ ni nràn ọ lọwọ. Dafidi si gbà wọn, o si fi wọn jẹ olori ẹgbẹ-ogun.
entries.en: Then the spirit came upon Amasai, who was chief of the captains, and he said, Thine are we, David, and on thy side, thou son of Jesse: peace, peace be unto thee, and peace be to thine helpers; for thy God helpeth thee. Then David received them, and made them captains of the band.

entries.yo: Ninu ẹyà Manasse si ya si ọdọ Dafidi, nigbati o ba awọn ara Filistia wá lati ba Saulu jagun, ṣugbọn nwọn kò ràn wọn lọwọ: nitori awọn olori awọn ara Filistia, nigbati nwọn gbero, rán a lọ wipe, Ti on ti ori wa ni on o fi pada lọ si ọdọ Saulu oluwa rẹ̀.
entries.en: And there fell some of Manasseh to David, when he came with the Philistines against Saul to battle: but they helped them not: for the lords of the Philistines upon advisement sent him away, saying, He will fall to his master Saul to the jeopardy of our heads.

entries.yo: Bi on ti lọ si Siklagi, ninu awọn ẹya Manasse ya si ọdọ rẹ̀, Adna, ati Josabadi, Jediaeli, ati Mikaeli, ati Josabadi ati Elihu, ati Sittai, awọn olori ẹgbẹgbẹrun ti iṣe ti Manasse.
entries.en: As he went to Ziklag, there fell to him of Manasseh, Adnah, and Jozabad, and Jediael, and Michael, and Jozabad, and Elihu, and Zilthai, captains of the thousands that were of Manasseh.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ràn Dafidi lọwọ si ẹgbẹ ogun na; nitori gbogbo wọn ni akọni enia, nwọn si jẹ olori ninu awọn ọmọ-ogun.
entries.en: And they helped David against the band of the rovers: for they were all mighty men of valour, and were captains in the host.

entries.yo: Nitori li akokò na li ojojumọ ni nwọn ntọ Dafidi wá lati ran a lọwọ, titi o fi di ogun nla, gẹgẹ bi ogun Ọlọrun.
entries.en: For at that time day by day there came to David to help him, until it was a great host, like the host of God.

entries.yo: Eyi ni iye awọn enia na ti o hamọra tan fun ogun, ti nwọn si tọ̀ Dafidi wá si Hebroni, lati pa ijọba Saulu da si ọdọ rẹ̀ gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ Oluwa.
entries.en: And these are the numbers of the bands that were ready armed to the war, and came to David to Hebron, to turn the kingdom of Saul to him, according to the word of the LORD.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Juda ti ngbe asa ati ọ̀kọ, jẹ ẹgbãta enia o le ẹgbẹrin, ti o hamọra tan fun ogun.
entries.en: The children of Judah that bare shield and spear were six thousand and eight hundred, ready armed to the war.

entries.yo: Ninu awọn ọmọ Simeoni, akọni enia fun ogun ẹ̃dẹgbarin o le ọgọrun.
entries.en: Of the children of Simeon, mighty men of valour for the war, seven thousand and one hundred.

entries.yo: Ninu awọn ọmọ Lefi, ẹgbãji o le ẹgbẹta.
entries.en: Of the children of Levi four thousand and six hundred.

entries.yo: Jehoiada olori fun Aaroni, ẹgbẹ̃dogun enia o le ẽdẹgbẹrin si wà pẹlu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Jehoiada was the leader of the Aaronites, and with him were three thousand and seven hundred;

entries.yo: Ati Sadoku, akọni ọdọmọkunrin, ati ninu ile baba rẹ̀ olori mejilelogun.
entries.en: And Zadok, a young man mighty of valour, and of his father's house twenty and two captains.

entries.yo: Ati ninu awọn ọmọ Benjamini, awọn arakunrin Saulu ẹgbẹ̃dogun: nitori titi di isisiyi, ọ̀pọlọpọ ninu wọn li o ti ntọju iṣọ ile Saulu.
entries.en: And of the children of Benjamin, the kindred of Saul, three thousand: for hitherto the greatest part of them had kept the ward of the house of Saul.

entries.yo: Ati ninu awọn ọmọ Efraimu ẹgbãwa o le ẹgbẹrin, akọni ọkunrin, enia olorukọ ni nwọn ni ile baba wọn.
entries.en: And of the children of Ephraim twenty thousand and eight hundred, mighty men of valour, famous throughout the house of their fathers.

entries.yo: Ati àbọ ẹ̀ya Manasse ẹgbãsan, ti a yan nipa orukọ, lati lọ fi Dafidi jẹ ọba.
entries.en: And of the half tribe of Manasseh eighteen thousand, which were expressed by name, to come and make David king.

entries.yo: Ati ninu awọn ọmọ Issakari, ti o ni oye akoko, lati mọ̀ ohun ti Israeli iba ma ṣe; olori wọn jẹ igba; ati gbogbo awọn arakunrin wọn mbẹ ni ikawọ wọn.
entries.en: And of the children of Issachar, which were men that had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do; the heads of them were two hundred; and all their brethren were at their commandment.

entries.yo: Ninu ti Sebuluni, iru awọn ti o jade lọ si ogun ti o mọ̀ ogun iwé, pẹlu gbogbo ohun èlo ogun, ẹgbamẹ̃dọgbọn; ti nwọn kì ifi iye-meji tẹgun.
entries.en: Of Zebulun, such as went forth to battle, expert in war, with all instruments of war, fifty thousand, which could keep rank: they were not of double heart.

entries.yo: Ati ninu ti Naftali ẹgbẹrun olori ogun, ati pẹlu wọn ti awọn ti asa ati ọ̀kọ ẹgbã mejidilogun o le ẹgbẹrun.
entries.en: And of Naphtali a thousand captains, and with them with shield and spear thirty and seven thousand.

entries.yo: Ati ninu awọn ọmọ Dani ti o mọ̀ ogun iwé, ẹgbã mẹtala o le ẹgbẹta.
entries.en: And of the Danites expert in war twenty and eight thousand and six hundred.

entries.yo: Ati ninu ti Aṣeri, iru awọn ti njade lọ si ogun, ti o mọ̀ ogun iwé, ọkẹ meje.
entries.en: And of Asher, such as went forth to battle, expert in war, forty thousand.

entries.yo: Ati li apa keji odò Jordani, ninu ti awọn ọmọ Reubeni, ati awọn ọmọ Gadi, ati abọ ẹya Manasse, pẹlu gbogbo onirũru ohun elo ogun fun ogun ọ̀kọ, ọkẹ mẹfa.
entries.en: And on the other side of Jordan, of the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and of the half tribe of Manasseh, with all manner of instruments of war for the battle, an hundred and twenty thousand.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn ọkunrin ogun wọnyi ti nwọn mọ̀ bi a iti itẹ ogun, nwọn fi ọkàn pipe wá si Hebroni, lati fi Dafidi jọba lori Israeli: gbogbo awọn iyokù ninu Israeli si jẹ oninu kan pẹlu lati fi Dafidi jẹ ọba.
entries.en: All these men of war, that could keep rank, came with a perfect heart to Hebron, to make David king over all Israel: and all the rest also of Israel were of one heart to make David king.

entries.yo: Nibẹ, ni nwọn si wà pẹlu Dafidi ni ijọ mẹta, nwọn njẹ, nwọn si nmu, nitoriti awọn ará wọn ti pèse fun wọn.
entries.en: And there they were with David three days, eating and drinking: for their brethren had prepared for them.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu awọn ti o sunmọ wọn, ani titi de ọdọ Issakari, ati Sebuluni, ati Naftali, mu akara wá lori kẹtẹkẹtẹ, ati lori ibakasiẹ, ati lori ibãka, ati lori malu, ani onjẹ ti iyẹfun, eso ọ̀pọtọ, ati eso àjara gbigbẹ, ati ọti-waini, ati ororo, ati malu, ati agutan li ọ̀pọlọpọ: nitori ti ayọ̀ wà ni Israeli.
entries.en: Moreover they that were nigh them, even unto Issachar and Zebulun and Naphtali, brought bread on asses, and on camels, and on mules, and on oxen, and meat, meal, cakes of figs, and bunches of raisins, and wine, and oil, and oxen, and sheep abundantly: for there was joy in Israel.

entries.yo: DAFIDI si ba awọn olori ogun ẹgbẹgbẹrun ati ọrọrun ati olukuluku olori gbèro.
entries.en: And David consulted with the captains of thousands and hundreds, and with every leader.

entries.yo: Dafidi si wi fun gbogbo ijọ Israeli pe, Bi o ba dara loju nyin, bi o ba si ti ọwọ Oluwa Ọlọrun wa wá, jẹ ki a ranṣẹ kiri sọdọ awọn arakunrin wa ni ibi gbogbo, ti o kù ni gbogbo ilẹ Israeli, ati pẹlu wọn si alufa ati awọn ọmọ Lefi ti mbẹ ni ilu agbegbe wọn, ki nwọn ki o le ko ara wọn jọ sọdọ wa:
entries.en: And David said unto all the congregation of Israel, If it seem good unto you, and that it be of the LORD our God, let us send abroad unto our brethren every where, that are left in all the land of Israel, and with them also to the priests and Levites which are in their cities and suburbs, that they may gather themselves unto us:

entries.yo: Ẹ jẹ ki a si tun mu apoti ẹri Ọlọrun wa wa si ọdọ wa: nitoriti awa kò ṣafẹri rẹ̀ li ọjọ Saulu.
entries.en: And let us bring again the ark of our God to us: for we inquired not at it in the days of Saul.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ijọ na si wipe, ẹ jẹ ki a ṣe bẹ̃: nitori ti nkan na tọ loju gbogbo enia.
entries.en: And all the congregation said that they would do so: for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Dafidi ko gbogbo Israeli jọ lati odò Egipti ani titi de Hemati, lati mu apoti ẹri Ọlọrun lati Kirjat-jearimu wá.
entries.en: So David gathered all Israel together, from Shihor of Egypt even unto the entering of Hamath, to bring the ark of God from Kirjath-jearim.

entries.yo: Dafidi si gòke ati gbogbo Israeli si Baala, si Kirjat-jearimu, ti iṣe ti Juda, lati mu apoti ẹ̀ri Ọlọrun Oluwa gòke lati ibẹ wá, ti ngbe arin Kerubimu, nibiti a npe orukọ Ọlọrun.
entries.en: And David went up, and all Israel, to Baalah, that is, to Kirjath-jearim, which belonged to Judah, to bring up thence the ark of God the LORD, that dwelleth between the cherubims, whose name is called on it.

entries.yo: Nwọn si gbé apoti ẹri Ọlọrun ka kẹkẹ́ titun lati inu ile Abinadabu wá, ati Ussa ati Ahio ntọ́ kẹkẹ́ na.
entries.en: And they carried the ark of God in a new cart out of the house of Abinadab: and Uzza and Ahio drave the cart.

entries.yo: Ati Dafidi ati gbogbo Israeli fi gbogbo agbara wọn ṣire niwaju Ọlọrun, pẹlu orin, ati pẹlu duru, ati pẹlu psalteri, ati pẹlu timbreli, ati pẹlu simbali, ati pẹlu ipè.
entries.en: And David and all Israel played before God with all their might, and with singing, and with harps, and with psalteries, and with timbrels, and with cymbals, and with trumpets.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si de ilẹ ipaka Kidroni, Ussa nà ọwọ rẹ̀ lati di apoti ẹri na mu; nitoriti awọn malu kọsẹ.
entries.en: And when they came unto the threshingfloor of Chidon, Uzza put forth his hand to hold the ark; for the oxen stumbled.

entries.yo: Ibinu Oluwa si ru si Ussa, o si lù, nibẹ li o si kú niwaju Ọlọrun.
entries.en: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Uzza, and he smote him, because he put his hand to the ark: and there he died before God.

entries.yo: Dafidi si binu nitori ti Oluwa ké Ussa kuro: nitorina ni a ṣe pè ibẹ na ni Peres-Ussa titi di oni.
entries.en: And David was displeased, because the LORD had made a breach upon Uzza: wherefore that place is called Perez-uzza to this day.

entries.yo: Dafidi si bẹ̀ru Ọlọrun li ọjọ na wipe, Emi o ha ṣe mu apoti ẹri Ọlọrun wá sọdọ mi?
entries.en: And David was afraid of God that day, saying, How shall I bring the ark of God home to me?

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Dafidi kò mu apoti ẹri na bọ̀ si ọdọ ara rẹ̀ si ilu Dafidi, ṣugbọn o gbé e ya si ile Obed-Edomu ara Gitti.
entries.en: So David brought not the ark home to himself to the city of David, but carried it aside into the house of Obed-edom the Gittite.

entries.yo: Apoti ẹri Ọlọrun si ba awọn ara ile Obed-Edomu gbe ni ile rẹ̀ li oṣu mẹta. Oluwa si bukún ile Obed-Edomu ati ohun gbogbo ti o ni.
entries.en: And the ark of God remained with the family of Obed-edom in his house three months. And the LORD blessed the house of Obed-edom, and all that he had.

entries.yo: HIRAMU ọba Tire si ran onṣẹ si Dafidi, ati igi Kedari, pẹlu awọn ọmọle ati gbẹnagbẹna, lati kọ́le fun u.
entries.en: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and timber of cedars, with masons and carpenters, to build him an house.

entries.yo: Dafidi si woye pe, Oluwa ti fi idi on joko li ọba lori Israeli, nitori a gbé ijọba rẹ̀ ga nitori ti awọn enia rẹ̀, Israeli.
entries.en: And David perceived that the LORD had confirmed him king over Israel, for his kingdom was lifted up on high, because of his people Israel.

entries.yo: Dafidi si mu awọn aya si i ni Jerusalemu: Dafidi si bi ọmọkunrin ati ọmọbinrin si i.
entries.en: And David took more wives at Jerusalem: and David begat more sons and daughters.

entries.yo: Wọnyi si li orukọ awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ ti o ni ni Jerusalemu; Ṣammua ati Ṣobabu, Natani, ati Solomoni,
entries.en: Now these are the names of his children which he had in Jerusalem; Shammua, and Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon,

entries.yo: Ati Ibhari, ati Eliṣua, ati Elpaleti,
entries.en: And Ibhar, and Elishua, and Elpalet,

entries.yo: Ati Noga, ati Nefegi, ati Jafia,
entries.en: And Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,

entries.yo: Ati Eliṣama, ati Beeliada, ati Elifaleti.
entries.en: And Elishama, and Beeliada, and Eliphalet.

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn ara Filistia si gbọ́ pe, a fi ororo yan Dafidi li ọba lori gbogbo Israeli, gbogbo awọn ara Filistia gòke lọ iwá Dafidi: Dafidi si gbọ́, o si jade tọ̀ wọn.
entries.en: And when the Philistines heard that David was anointed king over all Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David. And David heard of it, and went out against them.

entries.yo: Awọn ara Filistia si wá, nwọn si tẹ ara wọn ni afonifoji Refaimu.
entries.en: And the Philistines came and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.

entries.yo: Dafidi si bere lọdọ Ọlọrun wipe, Ki emi ki o gòke tọ awọn ara Filistia lọ? Iwọ o ha fi wọn le mi lọwọ? Oluwa si wi fun u pe, Gòke lọ, emi o si fi wọn le ọ lọwọ.
entries.en: And David inquired of God, saying, Shall I go up against the Philistines? and wilt thou deliver them into mine hand? And the LORD said unto him, Go up; for I will deliver them into thine hand.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni nwọn gòke lọ si Baal-perasimu; Dafidi si kọlù wọn nibẹ. Dafidi si wipe, Ọlọrun ti ti ọwọ mi yà lu awọn ọta mi bi yiya omi: nitorina ni nwọn ṣe npè ibẹ na ni Baal-perasimu.
entries.en: So they came up to Baal-perazim; and David smote them there. Then David said, God hath broken in upon mine enemies by mine hand like the breaking forth of waters: therefore they called the name of that place Baal-perazim.

entries.yo: Nwọn si fi awọn orisa wọn silẹ nibẹ, Dafidi si wipe, ki a fi iná sun wọn.
entries.en: And when they had left their gods there, David gave a commandment, and they were burned with fire.

entries.yo: Awọn ara Filistia si tun tẹ ara wọn kakiri ni afonifoji.
entries.en: And the Philistines yet again spread themselves abroad in the valley.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni Dafidi tun bère lọwọ Ọlọrun: Ọlọrun si wi fun u pe, Máṣe gòke tọ̀ wọn; yipada kuro lọdọ wọn, ki o si ja lu wọn niwaju igi mulberi.
entries.en: Therefore David inquired again of God; and God said unto him, Go not up after them; turn away from them, and come upon them over against the mulberry trees.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, nigbati iwọ ba gbọ́ iro ẹsẹ lòke igi mulberi, nigbana ni ki iwọ ki o gbogun jade: nitori Ọlọrun jade ṣaju rẹ lọ lati kọlù ogun awọn ara Filistia.
entries.en: And it shall be, when thou shalt hear a sound of going in the tops of the mulberry trees, that then thou shalt go out to battle: for God is gone forth before thee to smite the host of the Philistines.

entries.yo: Dafidi si ṣe gẹgẹ bi Ọlọrun ti paṣẹ fun u: nwọn si kọlù ogun awọn ara Filistia lati Gibeoni titi de Gaseri.
entries.en: David therefore did as God commanded him: and they smote the host of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gazer.

entries.yo: Okiki Dafidi si kan yi gbogbo ilẹ ka. Oluwa si mu ki ẹ̀ru rẹ̀ ki o ba gbogbo orilẹ-ède.
entries.en: And the fame of David went out into all lands; and the LORD brought the fear of him upon all nations.

entries.yo: DAFIDI si kọ́ ile fun ara rẹ̀ ni ilu Dafidi, o si pese ipò kan fun apoti ẹri Ọlọrun, o si pa agọ kan fun u.
entries.en: And David made him houses in the city of David, and prepared a place for the ark of God, and pitched for it a tent.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Dafidi wipe, Ẹnikan kò yẹ lati rù apoti ẹri Ọlọrun bikoṣe awọn ọmọ Lefi; nitori awọn ni Oluwa ti yàn lati ma gbé apoti ẹri Ọlọrun, ati lati ma ṣe iranṣẹ fun u titi lai.
entries.en: Then David said, None ought to carry the ark of God but the Levites: for them hath the LORD chosen to carry the ark of God, and to minister unto him for ever.

entries.yo: Dafidi si ko gbogbo Israeli jọ si Jerusalemu, lati gbé apoti ẹri Oluwa gòke lọ si ipò rẹ̀ ti o ti pese fun u.
entries.en: And David gathered all Israel together to Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the LORD unto his place, which he had prepared for it.

entries.yo: Dafidi si pè awọn ọmọ Aaroni, ati awọn ọmọ Lefi jọ.
entries.en: And David assembled the children of Aaron, and the Levites:

entries.yo: Ninu awọn ọmọ Kohati; Urieli olori, ati awọn arakunrin rẹ̀ ọgọfa:
entries.en: Of the sons of Kohath; Uriel the chief, and his brethren an hundred and twenty:

entries.yo: Ninu awọn ọmọ Merari; Asaiah olori, ati awọn arakunrin rẹ̀ igba o le ogun:
entries.en: Of the sons of Merari; Asaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred and twenty:

entries.yo: Ninu awọn ọmọ Gerṣomu; Joeli olori, ati awọn arakunrin rẹ̀ ãdoje:
entries.en: Of the sons of Gershom; Joel the chief, and his brethren an hundred and thirty:

entries.yo: Ninu awọn ọmọ Elisafani; Ṣemaiah olori, ati awọn arakunrin rẹ̀ igba.
entries.en: Of the sons of Elizaphan; Shemaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred:

entries.yo: Ninu awọn ọmọ Hebroni; Elieli olori, ati awọn arakunrin rẹ̀ ọgọrin:
entries.en: Of the sons of Hebron; Eliel the chief, and his brethren fourscore:

entries.yo: Ninu awọn ọmọ Ussieli; Aminadabu olori, ati awọn arakunrin rẹ̀ mejilelãdọfa.
entries.en: Of the sons of Uzziel; Amminadab the chief, and his brethren an hundred and twelve.

entries.yo: Dafidi si ranṣẹ pè Sadoku ati Abiatari awọn alufa; ati awọn ọmọ Lefi, Urieli, Asaiah, ati Joeli, Ṣemaiah, ati Elieli, ati Aminadabu;
entries.en: And David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites, for Uriel, Asaiah, and Joel, Shemaiah, and Eliel, and Amminadab,

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹnyin li olori awọn baba awọn ọmọ Lefi: ẹ ya ara nyin si mimọ́, ẹnyin ati awọn arakunrin nyin, ki ẹnyin ki o le gbé apoti ẹri Oluwa Ọlọrun Israeli gòke lọ si ibi ti mo ti pèse fun u.
entries.en: And said unto them, Ye are the chief of the fathers of the Levites: sanctify yourselves, both ye and your brethren, that ye may bring up the ark of the LORD God of Israel unto the place that I have prepared for it.

entries.yo: Nitoriti ẹnyin kò rù u li akọṣe, ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wa fi ṣe ẹ̀ya si wa li ara, nitori awa kò wá a bi o ti yẹ.
entries.en: For because ye did it not at the first, the LORD our God made a breach upon us, for that we sought him not after the due order.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ li awọn alufa ati awọn ọmọ Lefi ya ara wọn si mimọ́ lati gbe apoti ẹri Oluwa Ọlọrun Israeli gòke wá.
entries.en: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of the LORD God of Israel.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Lefi si rù apoti ẹri Ọlọrun bi Mose ti pa a li aṣẹ gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ Oluwa, nwọn fi ọpa rù u li ejika wọn.
entries.en: And the children of the Levites bare the ark of God upon their shoulders with the staves thereon, as Moses commanded according to the word of the LORD.

entries.yo: Dafidi si wi fun olori awọn ọmọ Lefi pe ki nwọn yàn awọn arakunrin wọn, awọn akọrin pẹlu ohun èlo orin, psalteri ati duru, ati kimbali; ti ndún kikan ti o si nfi ayọ gbé ohùn soke.
entries.en: And David spake to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brethren to be the singers with instruments of musick, psalteries and harps and cymbals, sounding, by lifting up the voice with joy.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ li awọn ọmọ Lefi yan Hemani ọmọ Joeli; ati ninu awọn arakunrin rẹ̀, Asafu ọmọ Berekiah; ati ninu awọn ọmọ Merari arakunrin wọn, Etani ọmọ Kuṣaiah;
entries.en: So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel; and of his brethren, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari their brethren, Ethan the son of Kushaiah;

entries.yo: Ati pẹlu wọn awọn arakunrin wọn li ọwọ́ keji; Sekariah, Beni, ati Jaasieli, ati Ṣemiramotu, ati Jehieli, ati Unni, Eliabu, ati Benaiah, ati Maaseiah, ati Obed-Edomu, ati Jeieli awọn adena.
entries.en: And with them their brethren of the second degree, Zechariah, Ben, and Jaaziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, Eliab, and Benaiah, and Maaseiah, and Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obed-edom, and Jeiel, the porters.

entries.yo: Awọn akọrin si ni Hemani, Asafu, ati Etani, ti awọn ti kimbali ti ndun kikan;
entries.en: So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were appointed to sound with cymbals of brass;

entries.yo: Ati Sekariah, ati Asieli, ati Ṣemiramotu, ati Jelieli, ati Unni, ati Eliabu, ati Maaseiah, ati Benaiah, ti awọn ti psaltiri olohùn òke;
entries.en: And Zechariah, and Aziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, and Eliab, and Maaseiah, and Benaiah, with psalteries on Alamoth;

entries.yo: Ati Mattitiah, ati Elifeleti, ati Mikneiah, lati fi duru olokun mẹjọ ṣaju orin.
entries.en: And Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obed-edom, and Jeiel, and Azaziah, with harps on the Sheminith to excel.

entries.yo: Ati Kenaniah, olori awọn ọmọ Lefi ni ọ̀ga orin: on ni nkọni li orin, nitoriti o moye rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, was for song: he instructed about the song, because he was skilful.

entries.yo: Ati Berekiah, ati Elkana li awọn adena fun apoti ẹri na.
entries.en: And Berechiah and Elkanah were doorkeepers for the ark.

entries.yo: Ati Ṣebaniah, ati Jehoṣafati, ati Netaneeli, ati Amasai, ati Sekariah, ati Benaiah, ati Elieseri, awọn alufa, li o nfun ipè niwaju apoti ẹri Ọlọrun: ati Obed-Edomu, ati Jehiah li awọn adena fun apoti ẹri na.
entries.en: And Shebaniah, and Jehoshaphat, and Nethaneel, and Amasai, and Zechariah, and Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, did blow with the trumpets before the ark of God: and Obed-edom and Jehiah were doorkeepers for the ark.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Dafidi ati awọn agbagba Israeli, ati awọn olori ẹgbẹgbẹrun, lọ lati gbe apoti ẹri majẹmu Oluwa jade ti ile Obed-Edomu gòke wá pẹlu ayọ̀.
entries.en: So David, and the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands, went to bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of the house of Obed-edom with joy.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati Ọlọrun ràn awọn ọmọ Lefi lọwọ ti o rù apoti ẹri majẹmu Oluwa, ni nwọn fi malu meje ati àgbo meje rubọ.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when God helped the Levites that bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD, that they offered seven bullocks and seven rams.

entries.yo: Dafidi si wọ̀ aṣọ igunwa ọ̀gbọ daradara, ati gbogbo awọn ọmọ Lefi ti nrù apoti ẹri na, ati awọn akọrin, ati Kenaniah olori orin pẹlu awọn akọrin: efodu ọ̀gbọ si wà lara Dafidi.
entries.en: And David was clothed with a robe of fine linen, and all the Levites that bare the ark, and the singers, and Chenaniah the master of the song with the singers: David also had upon him an ephod of linen.

entries.yo: Bayi ni gbogbo Israeli gbé apoti ẹri majẹmu Oluwa gòke wá pẹlu iho ayọ̀, ati iró fère, ati pẹlu ipè, ati kimbali, psalteri ati duru si ndún kikankikan.
entries.en: Thus all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the LORD with shouting, and with sound of the cornet, and with trumpets, and with cymbals, making a noise with psalteries and harps.

entries.yo: O si ṣe bi apoti ẹri majẹmu Oluwa na ti de ilu Dafidi ni Mikali ọmọ Saulu obinrin yọju wode ni fèrese, o ri Dafidi ọba njó, o si nṣire; o si kẹgan rẹ̀ li ọkàn rẹ̀.
entries.en: And it came to pass, as the ark of the covenant of the LORD came to the city of David, that Michal the daughter of Saul looking out at a window saw king David dancing and playing: and she despised him in her heart.

entries.yo: BẸ̀NI nwọn mu apoti ẹri Ọlọrun wá, nwọn si fi si arin agọ na ti Dafidi pa fun u: nwọn si ru ẹbọ sisun ati ẹbọ alafia niwaju Ọlọrun,
entries.en: So they brought the ark of God, and set it in the midst of the tent that David had pitched for it: and they offered burnt sacrifices and peace offerings before God.

entries.yo: Nigbati Dafidi si ti pari riru ẹbọ sisun ati ẹbọ alafia tan, o sure fun awọn enia li orukọ Oluwa.
entries.en: And when David had made an end of offering the burnt offerings and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the LORD.

entries.yo: O si fi fun gbogbo enia Israeli, ati ọkunrin ati obinrin fun olukulùku iṣu akara kan, ati ekiri ẹran kan, ati akara didùn kan.
entries.en: And he dealt to every one of Israel, both man and woman, to every one a loaf of bread, and a good piece of flesh, and a flagon of wine.

entries.yo: O si yan ninu awọn ọmọ Lefi lati ma jọsin niwaju apoti ẹri Oluwa, ati lati ṣe iranti, ati lati dupẹ, ati lati yìn Oluwa Ọlọrun Israeli:
entries.en: And he appointed certain of the Levites to minister before the ark of the LORD, and to record, and to thank and praise the LORD God of Israel:

entries.yo: Asafu ni olori, ati atẹle rẹ̀ ni Sekariah, Jeieli, ati Ṣemiramotu, ati Jehieli, ati Mattitiah, ati Eliabu, ati Benaiah, ati Obed-Edomu: ati Jeieli pẹlu psalteri ati pẹlu duru; ṣugbọn Asafu li o nlù kimbali kikan;
entries.en: Asaph the chief, and next to him Zechariah, Jeiel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Mattithiah, and Eliab, and Benaiah, and Obed-edom: and Jeiel with psalteries and with harps; but Asaph made a sound with cymbals;

entries.yo: Benaiah pẹlu ati Jahasieli awọn alufa pẹlu ipè nigbagbogbo niwaju apoti ẹri ti majẹmu Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Benaiah also and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually before the ark of the covenant of God.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ na ni Dafidi kọ́ fi orin mimọ́ yi le Asafu lọwọ lati dupẹ lọwọ Oluwa.
entries.en: Then on that day David delivered first this psalm to thank the LORD into the hand of Asaph and his brethren.

entries.yo: Ẹ fi ọpẹ fun Oluwa, ẹ pè orukọ rẹ̀, ẹ fi iṣẹ rẹ̀ hàn ninu awọn enia.
entries.en: Give thanks unto the LORD, call upon his name, make known his deeds among the people.

entries.yo: Ẹ kọrin si i, ẹ kọ́ orin mimọ́ si i, ẹ ma sọ̀rọ gbogbo iṣẹ iyanu rẹ̀.
entries.en: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him, talk ye of all his wondrous works.

entries.yo: Ẹ ma ṣogo li orukọ rẹ̀ mimọ́; jẹ ki ọkàn awọn ti nwá Oluwa ki o yọ̀.
entries.en: Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek the LORD.

entries.yo: Ẹ ma wá Oluwa, ati ipa rẹ̀, ma wá oju rẹ̀ nigbagbogbo.
entries.en: Seek the LORD and his strength, seek his face continually.

entries.yo: Ẹ ma ranti iṣẹ iyanu rẹ̀ ti o ti ṣe, iṣẹ àmi rẹ̀, ati idajọ ẹnu rẹ̀;
entries.en: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done, his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;

entries.yo: Ẹnyin iru-ọmọ Israeli iranṣẹ rẹ̀, ẹnyin ọmọ Jakobu ayanfẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: O ye seed of Israel his servant, ye children of Jacob, his chosen ones.

entries.yo: On ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wa, idajọ rẹ̀ mbẹ ni gbogbo aiye.
entries.en: He is the LORD our God; his judgments are in all the earth.

entries.yo: Ẹ ma ṣe iranti majẹmu rẹ̀ titi lai, ọ̀rọ ti o ti pa li aṣẹ fun ẹgbẹrun iran;
entries.en: Be ye mindful always of his covenant; the word which he commanded to a thousand generations;

entries.yo: Majẹmu ti o ba Abrahamu da, ati ibura rẹ̀ fun Isaaki;
entries.en: Even of the covenant which he made with Abraham, and of his oath unto Isaac;

entries.yo: A si tẹnumọ eyi li ofin fun Jakobu, ati fun Israeli ni majẹmu aiyeraiye:
entries.en: And hath confirmed the same to Jacob for a law, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant,

entries.yo: Wipe, Iwọ li emi o fi ilẹ Kenaani fun, ipin ilẹ-ini nyin.
entries.en: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance;

entries.yo: Nigbati ẹnyin wà ni kiun ni iye, ani diẹ kiun, ati atipo ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: When ye were but few, even a few, and strangers in it.

entries.yo: Nwọn si nlọ lati orilẹ-ède de orilẹ-ède, ati lati ijọba kan de ọdọ enia miran;
entries.en: And when they went from nation to nation, and from one kingdom to another people;

entries.yo: On kò jẹ ki ẹnikẹni ki o ṣe wọn ni ìwọsi, nitõtọ, o ba awọn ọba wi nitori wọn,
entries.en: He suffered no man to do them wrong: yea, he reproved kings for their sakes,

entries.yo: Wipe, Ẹ má ṣe fi ọwọ kan ẹni-ororo mi, ẹ má si ṣe awọn woli mi ni ibi.
entries.en: Saying, Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm.

entries.yo: Ẹ kọrin titun si Oluwa gbogbo aiye; ẹ ma fi igbala rẹ̀ hàn lati ọjọ de ọjọ.
entries.en: Sing unto the LORD, all the earth; shew forth from day to day his salvation.

entries.yo: Ẹ sọ̀rọ ogo rẹ̀ ninu awọn keferi; ati iṣẹ-iyanu rẹ̀ ninu gbogbo enia.
entries.en: Declare his glory among the heathen; his marvellous works among all nations.

entries.yo: Nitori titobi li Oluwa, o si ni iyìn gidigidi: on li o si ni ibẹ̀ru jù gbogbo oriṣa lọ.
entries.en: For great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised: he also is to be feared above all gods.

entries.yo: Nitori pe gbogbo oriṣa awọn enia, ere ni nwọ́n: ṣugbọn Oluwa li o da awọn ọrun.
entries.en: For all the gods of the people are idols: but the LORD made the heavens.

entries.yo: Ogo on ọlá wà niwaju rẹ̀; agbara ati ayọ̀ mbẹ ni ipò rẹ̀.
entries.en: Glory and honour are in his presence; strength and gladness are in his place.

entries.yo: Ẹ fi fun Oluwa, ẹnyin ibatan enia, ẹ fi ogo ati ipa fun Oluwa.
entries.en: Give unto the LORD, ye kindreds of the people, give unto the LORD glory and strength.

entries.yo: Ẹ fi ogo fun Oluwa ti o yẹ fun orukọ rẹ̀: mu ọrẹ wá, ki ẹ si wá siwaju rẹ̀: ẹ sin Oluwa ninu ẹwà ìwa-mimọ́.
entries.en: Give unto the LORD the glory due unto his name: bring an offering, and come before him: worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness.

entries.yo: Ẹ warìri niwaju rẹ̀, gbogbo aiye aiye pẹlu si fi idi mulẹ ti kì o fi le yi.
entries.en: Fear before him, all the earth: the world also shall be stable, that it be not moved.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki awọn ọrun ki o yọ̀, si jẹ ki inu aiye ki o dùn; si jẹ ki a wi ninu awọn orilẹ-ède pe, Oluwa jọba.
entries.en: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice: and let men say among the nations, The LORD reigneth.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki okun ki o ma ho, ati ẹkún rẹ̀: jẹ ki papa-oko tùtu ki o yọ̀, ati ohun gbogbo ti mbẹ ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof: let the fields rejoice, and all that is therein.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni awọn igi igbo yio ma ho niwaju Oluwa, nitori ti o mbọ wá ṣe idajọ aiye.
entries.en: Then shall the trees of the wood sing out at the presence of the LORD, because he cometh to judge the earth.

entries.yo: Ẹ fi ọpẹ fun Oluwa, nitori ti o ṣeun: nitoriti ãnu rẹ̀ duro lailai.
entries.en: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever.

entries.yo: Ki ẹ si wipe, Gbà wa Ọlọrun igbala wa, si gbá wa jọ, ki o si gbà wa lọwọ awọn keferi, ki awa ki o le ma fi ọpẹ fun orukọ rẹ mimọ́, ki a si le ma ṣogo ninu iyin rẹ.
entries.en: And say ye, Save us, O God of our salvation, and gather us together, and deliver us from the heathen, that we may give thanks to thy holy name, and glory in thy praise.

entries.yo: Olubukún li Oluwa Ọlọrun Israeli lai ati lailai. Gbogbo awọn enia si wipe, Amin, nwọn si yìn Oluwa.
entries.en: Blessed be the LORD God of Israel for ever and ever. And all the people said, Amen, and praised the LORD.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ li o fi Asafu ati awọn arakunrin rẹ̀ silẹ nibẹ niwaju apoti ẹri majẹmu Oluwa lati ma jọsìn niwaju apoti ẹri na nigbagbogbo, bi iṣẹ ojojumọ ti nfẹ.
entries.en: So he left there before the ark of the covenant of the LORD Asaph and his brethren, to minister before the ark continually, as every day's work required:

entries.yo: Ati Obed-Edomu pẹlu awọn arakunrin wọn, enia mejidilãdọrin; ati Obed-Edomu ọmọ Jedutuni, ati Hosa lati ma ṣe adena:
entries.en: And Obed-edom with their brethren, threescore and eight; Obed-edom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah to be porters:

entries.yo: Sadoku alufa, ati awọn arakunrin rẹ̀, awọn alufa, niwaju agọ Oluwa, ni ibi giga ti o wà ni Gibeoni,
entries.en: And Zadok the priest, and his brethren the priests, before the tabernacle of the LORD in the high place that was at Gibeon,

entries.yo: Lati ma ru ẹbọ sisun si Oluwa lori pẹpẹ ẹbọ sisun nigbagbogbo li owurọ ati li alẹ, gẹgẹ bi gbogbo eyi ti a kọ ninu ofin Oluwa, ti o pa li aṣẹ fun Israeli;
entries.en: To offer burnt offerings unto the LORD upon the altar of the burnt offering continually morning and evening, and to do according to all that is written in the law of the LORD, which he commanded Israel;

entries.yo: Ati pẹlu wọn Hemani ati Jedutuni, ati awọn iyokù ti a yàn, ti a si pe li orukọ, lati ma fi ìyin fun Oluwa, nitori ti ãnu rẹ̀ duro lailai;
entries.en: And with them Heman and Jeduthun, and the rest that were chosen, who were expressed by name, to give thanks to the LORD, because his mercy endureth for ever;

entries.yo: Ati pẹlu wọn Hemani ati Jedutuni pẹlu ipè ati kimbali fun awọn ti yio ma pariwo, ati pẹlu ohun èlo orin Ọlọrun. Awọn ọmọ Jedutuni li awọn adena.
entries.en: And with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should make a sound, and with musical instruments of God. And the sons of Jeduthun were porters.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn enia si lọ olukuluku si ile rẹ̀: Dafidi yipada lati sure fun ile rẹ̀.
entries.en: And all the people departed every man to his house: and David returned to bless his house.

entries.yo: O SI ṣe, bi Dafidi ti joko ninu ile rẹ̀, ni Dafidi sọ fun Natani woli pe, Wò o, emi ngbe inu ile kedari, ṣugbọn apoti ẹri majẹmu Oluwa ngbe abẹ aṣọ-tita.
entries.en: Now it came to pass, as David sat in his house, that David said to Nathan the prophet, Lo, I dwell in an house of cedars, but the ark of the covenant of the LORD remaineth under curtains.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Natani wi fun Dafidi pe, Ṣe ohun gbogbo ti mbẹ ni inu rẹ; nitoriti Ọlọrun wà pẹlu rẹ.
entries.en: Then Nathan said unto David, Do all that is in thine heart; for God is with thee.

entries.yo: O si ṣe li oru kanna ni ọ̀rọ Ọlọrun tọ Natani wá, wipe,
entries.en: And it came to pass the same night, that the word of God came to Nathan, saying,

entries.yo: Lọ, si sọ fun Dafidi iranṣẹ mi pe, Bayi li Oluwa wi, Iwọ kò gbọdọ kọ́ ile fun mi lati ma gbe.
entries.en: Go and tell David my servant, Thus saith the LORD, Thou shalt not build me an house to dwell in:

entries.yo: Nitori emi kò ti igbe inu ile lati ọjọ ti mo ti mu Israeli gòke wá titi fi di oni yi; ṣugbọn emi nlọ lati agọ de agọ, ati lati ibugbe kan de keji.
entries.en: For I have not dwelt in an house since the day that I brought up Israel unto this day; but have gone from tent to tent, and from one tabernacle to another.

entries.yo: Nibikibi ti mo ti nrin larin gbogbo Israeli, emi ha sọ̀rọ kan fun ọkan ninu awọn onidajọ Israeli, ti emi ti paṣẹ fun lati ma bọ awọn enia mi, emi ha ti wipe, Ẽṣe ti ẹnyin kò fi kọ́ ile igi kedari fun mi bi?
entries.en: Wheresoever I have walked with all Israel, spake I a word to any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to feed my people, saying, Why have ye not built me an house of cedars?

entries.yo: Njẹ nitorina bayi ni iwọ o wi fun Dafidi iranṣẹ mi, Bayi li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi, Emi mu ọ kuro ni pápá oko-tutu, ani kuro lati ma tọ agutan lẹhin, ki iwọ ki o le ma ṣe olori awọn enia mi Israeli.
entries.en: Now therefore thus shalt thou say unto my servant David, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, I took thee from the sheepcote, even from following the sheep, that thou shouldest be ruler over my people Israel:

entries.yo: Emi si ti wà pẹlu rẹ ni ibikibi ti iwọ ba lọ, emi si ti ké gbogbo awọn ọta rẹ kuro niwaju rẹ, emi o si ṣe ọ li olorukọ kan, bi orukọ awọn enia nla ti o ti wà li aiye.
entries.en: And I have been with thee whithersoever thou hast walked, and have cut off all thine enemies from before thee, and have made thee a name like the name of the great men that are in the earth.

entries.yo: Emi o si yan ibi kan fun Israeli awọn enia mi, emi o si gbìn wọn, ki nwọn le má gbe ipò wọn, a kì yio si ṣì wọn mọ; bẹ̃ni ọmọ buburu kì yio yọ wọn lẹnu mọ, bi ti atijọ;
entries.en: Also I will ordain a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, and they shall dwell in their place, and shall be moved no more; neither shall the children of wickedness waste them any more, as at the beginning,

entries.yo: Ati bi igba ti emi ti fi enia jẹ onidajọ lori awọn enia mi Israeli. Ati pẹlu emi o ṣẹgun gbogbo awọn ọta rẹ. Pẹlupẹlu mo ti sọ fun ọ pe, Oluwa yio kọle kan fun ọ.
entries.en: And since the time that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel. Moreover I will subdue all thine enemies. Furthermore I tell thee that the LORD will build thee an house.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, nigbati ọjọ rẹ ba pe, ti iwọ o lọ pẹlu awọn baba rẹ, ni emi o gbé iru-ọmọ rẹ dide lẹhin rẹ, ti yio jẹ ọkan ninu awọn ọmọ rẹ ọkunrin; emi o si fi idi ijọba rẹ̀ mulẹ.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass, when thy days be expired that thou must go to be with thy fathers, that I will raise up thy seed after thee, which shall be of thy sons; and I will establish his kingdom.

entries.yo: On o kọ́ ile fun mi, emi o si fi idi itẹ rẹ̀ mulẹ lailai.
entries.en: He shall build me an house, and I will stablish his throne for ever.

entries.yo: Emi o jẹ baba fun u, on o si jẹ ọmọ fun mi; emi kì yio si gbà ãnu mi kuro lọdọ rẹ̀, bi mo ti gbà a lọwọ ẹniti o ti wà ṣaju rẹ:
entries.en: I will be his father, and he shall be my son: and I will not take my mercy away from him, as I took it from him that was before thee:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi o fi idi rẹ̀ kalẹ ninu ile mi ati ninu ijọba mi lailai, a o si fi idi itẹ rẹ̀ mulẹ lailai.
entries.en: But I will settle him in mine house and in my kingdom for ever: and his throne shall be established for evermore.

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi gbogbo ọ̀rọ wọnyi, ati gẹgẹ bi gbogbo iran yi, bẹ̃ni Natani sọ fun Dafidi.
entries.en: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so did Nathan speak unto David.

entries.yo: Dafidi ọba si wá, o si joko niwaju Oluwa, o si wipe, Tali emi Oluwa Ọlọrun, ati kini ile mi, ti iwọ si mu mi de ihinyi?
entries.en: And David the king came and sat before the LORD, and said, Who am I, O LORD God, and what is mine house, that thou hast brought me hitherto?

entries.yo: Ohun kekere si li eyi li oju rẹ, Ọlọrun: iwọ si ti sọ pẹlu sipa ile iranṣẹ rẹ fun akokò jijin ti mbọ, o si ka mi si bi iṣe enia giga, Oluwa Ọlọrun.
entries.en: And yet this was a small thing in thine eyes, O God; for thou hast also spoken of thy servant's house for a great while to come, and hast regarded me according to the estate of a man of high degree, O LORD God.

entries.yo: Kini Dafidi le tun ma sọ pẹlu fun ọ niti ọlá ti a bù fun iranṣẹ rẹ? iwọ sa mọ̀ iranṣẹ rẹ.
entries.en: What can David speak more to thee for the honour of thy servant? for thou knowest thy servant.

entries.yo: Oluwa, nitoriti iranṣẹ rẹ, ati gẹgẹ bi ti inu rẹ, ni iwọ ti ṣe gbogbo ohun nlanla yi, ni sisọ gbogbo nkan nla wọnyi di mimọ̀.
entries.en: O LORD, for thy servant's sake, and according to thine own heart, hast thou done all this greatness, in making known all these great things.

entries.yo: Oluwa, kò si ẹniti o dabi rẹ bẹ̃ni kò si Ọlọrun miran lẹhin rẹ, gẹgẹ bi gbogbo eyi ti awa ti fi eti wa gbọ́.
entries.en: O LORD, there is none like thee, neither is there any God beside thee, according to all that we have heard with our ears.

entries.yo: Orilẹ-ède kan wo li o wà li aiye ti o dabi enia rẹ, Israeli, ti Ọlọrun lọ irapada lati ṣe enia on tikararẹ, lati ṣe orukọ fun ara rẹ nipa ohun ti o tobi ti o si lẹ̀ru, ni lile awọn orilẹ-ède jade kuro niwaju awọn enia rẹ, ti iwọ ti rapada lati Egipti jade wá?
entries.en: And what one nation in the earth is like thy people Israel, whom God went to redeem to be his own people, to make thee a name of greatness and terribleness, by driving out nations from before thy people, whom thou hast redeemed out of Egypt?

entries.yo: Nitori awọn enia rẹ Israeli li o ti ṣe li enia rẹ titi lai; iwọ Oluwa, si di Ọlọrun wọn.
