entries.en: For thy people Israel didst thou make thine own people for ever; and thou, LORD, becamest their God.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, Oluwa! jẹ ki ọ̀rọ ti iwọ ti sọ niti iranṣẹ rẹ, ati niti ile rẹ̀ ki o fi idi mulẹ lailai, ki iwọ ki o si ṣe bi iwọ ti wi.
entries.en: Therefore now, LORD, let the thing that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant and concerning his house be established for ever, and do as thou hast said.

entries.yo: Ani, jẹ ki o fi idi mulẹ, ki a le ma gbé orukọ rẹ ga lailai, wipe, Oluwa awọn ọmọ ogun li Ọlọrun Israeli, ani Ọlọrun fun Israeli; si jẹ ki ile Dafidi iranṣẹ rẹ ki o fi idi mulẹ niwaju rẹ.
entries.en: Let it even be established, that thy name may be magnified for ever, saying, The LORD of hosts is the God of Israel, even a God to Israel: and let the house of David thy servant be established before thee.

entries.yo: Nitori iwọ, Ọlọrun mi, ti ṣi iranṣẹ rẹ li eti pe, Iwọ o kọ́ ile kan fun u: nitorina ni iranṣẹ rẹ ri i lati gbadua niwaju rẹ.
entries.en: For thou, O my God, hast told thy servant that thou wilt build him an house: therefore thy servant hath found in his heart to pray before thee.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi Oluwa, Iwọ li Ọlọrun, iwọ si ti sọ ọ̀rọ ore yi fun iranṣẹ rẹ;
entries.en: And now, LORD, thou art God, and hast promised this goodness unto thy servant:

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi jẹ ki o wù ọ lati bukún ile iranṣẹ rẹ, ki o le ma wà niwaju rẹ lailai: nitori iwọ Oluwa, ẹniti o sure fun, ire ni o si ma jẹ lailai.
entries.en: Now therefore let it please thee to bless the house of thy servant, that it may be before thee for ever: for thou blessest, O LORD, and it shall be blessed for ever.

entries.yo: O SI ṣe lẹhin eyi, ni Dafidi kọlu awọn ara Filistia, o si ṣẹ́ wọn, o si gbà Gati ati ilu rẹ̀ lọwọ awọn ara Filistia.
entries.en: Now after this it came to pass, that David smote the Philistines, and subdued them, and took Gath and her towns out of the hand of the Philistines.

entries.yo: O si kọlu Moabu, awọn ara Moabu si di iranṣẹ Dafidi, nwọn si mu ọrẹ wá.
entries.en: And he smote Moab; and the Moabites became David's servants, and brought gifts.

entries.yo: Dafidi si kọlu Hadareseri ọba Soba ni Hamati bi o ti nlọ lati fi idi ijọba rẹ̀ mulẹ leti odò Euferate.
entries.en: And David smote Hadarezer king of Zobah unto Hamath, as he went to stablish his dominion by the river Euphrates.

entries.yo: Dafidi si gbà ẹgbẹrun kẹkẹ́, ati ẹ̃dẹgbarun ẹlẹṣin, ati ẹgbãwa ẹlẹsẹ lọwọ rẹ̀: Dafidi si ja iṣan ẹsẹ gbogbo awọn ẹṣin kẹkẹ́ na, ṣugbọn o pa ọgọrun ẹṣin kẹkẹ́ mọ ninu wọn.
entries.en: And David took from him a thousand chariots, and seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen: David also houghed all the chariot horses, but reserved of them an hundred chariots.

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn ara Siria ti Damasku wá lati ran Hadareseri ọba Soba lọwọ, Dafidi pa ẹgbã mọkanla enia ninu awọn ara Siria.
entries.en: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadarezer king of Zobah, David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men.

entries.yo: Dafidi si fi ẹgbẹ-ogun si Siria ti Damasku; awọn ara Siria si di iranṣẹ Dafidi, nwọn si mu ọrẹ wá. Bayi li Oluwa gbà Dafidi nibikibi ti o ba nlọ.
entries.en: Then David put garrisons in Syria-damascus; and the Syrians became David's servants, and brought gifts. Thus the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went.

entries.yo: Dafidi si gbà awọn asa wura ti mbẹ lara awọn iranṣẹ Hadareseri, o si mu wọn wá si Jerusalemu.
entries.en: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadarezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Lati Tibhati pẹlu ati lati Kuni, ilu Hadareseri ni Dafidi ko ọ̀pọlọpọ idẹ, eyiti Solomoni fi ṣe okun idẹ, ọwọn wọnni, ati ohun elo idẹ wọnni.
entries.en: Likewise from Tibhath, and from Chun, cities of Hadarezer, brought David very much brass, wherewith Solomon made the brasen sea, and the pillars, and the vessels of brass.

entries.yo: Nigbati Tou ọba Hamati gbọ́ pe Dafidi ti pa gbogbo ogun Hadareseri ọba Soba.
entries.en: Now when Tou king of Hamath heard how David had smitten all the host of Hadarezer king of Zobah;

entries.yo: O ran Hadoramu ọmọ rẹ̀ si Dafidi ọba lati ki i ati lati yọ̀ fun u, nitoriti o ti ba Hadareseri jà o si ti ṣẹgun rẹ̀; (nitori Tou ti jẹ ọta Hadareseri) o si ni oniruru ohun elo wura ati ti fadakà ati idẹ pẹ̀lu rẹ̀.
entries.en: He sent Hadoram his son to king David, to inquire of his welfare, and to congratulate him, because he had fought against Hadarezer, and smitten him; (for Hadarezer had war with Tou;) and with him all manner of vessels of gold and silver and brass.

entries.yo: Awọn pẹlu ni Dafidi yà si mimọ́ fun Oluwa pẹlu fadakà ati wura ti o ko lati ọdọ gbogbo orilẹ-ède wọnni wá; lati Edomu, ati lati Moabu, ati lati ọdọ awọn ọmọ Ammoni, ati lati ọdọ awọn ara Filistia, ati lati Amaleki wá,
entries.en: Them also king David dedicated unto the LORD, with the silver and the gold that he brought from all these nations; from Edom, and from Moab, and from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines, and from Amalek.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu Abiṣai ọmọ Seruiah pa ẹgbãsan ninu awọn ara Edomu li afonifoji Iyọ̀.
entries.en: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah slew of the Edomites in the valley of salt eighteen thousand.

entries.yo: O si fi ẹgbẹ-ogun si Edomu: ati gbogbo awọn ara Edomu si di iranṣẹ Dafidi. Bayi li Oluwa ngbà Dafidi nibikibi ti o ba nlọ.
entries.en: And he put garrisons in Edom; and all the Edomites became David's servants. Thus the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ ni Dafidi jọba lori gbogbo Israeli, o si ṣe idajọ ati otitọ larin awọn enia rẹ̀.
entries.en: So David reigned over all Israel, and executed judgment and justice among all his people.

entries.yo: Joabu ọmọ Seruiah si wà lori ogun; ati Jehoṣafati ọmọ Ahiludi ni akọwe-iranti.
entries.en: And Joab the son Zeruiah was over the host; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, recorder.

entries.yo: Sadoku ọmọ Ahitubu, ati Abimeleki ọmọ Abiatari, li awọn alufa; ati Ṣafṣa ni akọwe;
entries.en: And Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Abimelech the son of Abiathar, were the priests; and Shavsha was scribe;

entries.yo: Benaiah ọmọ Jehoiada li o si wà lori awọn Kereti ati awọn Peleti; awọn ọmọ Dafidi si li olori lọdọ ọba.
entries.en: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethiten of Ahitub, and Abimelech the son of Abiathar, were the priests; and Shavsha was scribe;
And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David were chief about the king.

entries.yo: O SI ṣe lẹhin eyi, ni Nahaṣi ọba awọn ọmọ Ammoni kú, ọmọ rẹ̀ si jọba ni ipò rẹ̀.
entries.en: Now it came to pass after this, that Nahash the king of the children of Ammon died, and his son reigned in his stead.

entries.yo: Dafidi si wipe, Emi o ṣe ore fun Hanuni ọmọ Nahaṣi, nitoriti baba rẹ̀ ṣe ore fun mi. Dafidi si ran onṣẹ lati tù u ninu nitori baba rẹ̀. Bẹ̃ni awọn iranṣẹ Dafidi wá si ilẹ awọn ọmọ Ammoni, si ọdọ Hanuni lati tù u ninu.
entries.en: And David said, I will shew kindness unto Hanun the son of Nahash, because his father shewed kindness to me. And David sent messengers  to comfort him concerning his fatthou that David doth honour thy father, that he hath sent comforters unto thee? are not his servants come unto thee for to search, and to overthrow, and to spy out the land?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn ijoye awọn ọmọ Ammoni wi fun Hanuni pe, Iwọ rò pe Dafidi bu ọlá fun baba rẹ nitori ti o ran awọn olutunu si ọ? Kò ṣepe awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀ wá si ọdọ rẹ lati rin wò, ati lati bi ṣubu ati lati ṣe ami ilẹ na?
entries.en: Wherefore Hanun took David's servants, and shaved them, and cut off their garments in the midst hard by their buttocks, and sent them away.

entries.yo: Nitorina Hanuni kó awọn iranṣẹ Dafidi, o si fa irungbọn wọn, o si ké agbáda wọn sunmọ ibadi wọn, o ran wọn lọ.
entries.en: Then there went certain, and told David how the men were served. And he sent to meet them: for the men were greatly ashamed. And the king said, Tarry at Jericho until your beards be grown, and then return.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni awọn kan lọ, nwọn si sọ fun Dafidi bi a ti ṣe awọn ọkunrin na: on si ranṣẹ lọ ipade wọn: nitori oju tì awọn ọkunrin na gidigidi. Ọba si wipe, Ẹ duro ni Jeriko titi irungbọn nyin yio fi hù, nigbana ni ki ẹ si pada wá.
entries.en: And when the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves odious to David, Hanun and the children of Ammon sent a thousand talents of silver to hire them chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia, and out of Syria-maachah, and out of Zobah.

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn ọmọ Ammoni ri pe nwọn ti ba ara wọn jẹ lọdọ Dafidi, Hanuni ati awọn ọmọ Ammoni ran ẹgbẹrun talenti fadakà lati bẹ̀wẹ kẹkẹ́ ati ẹlẹsin lati Siria ni Mesopotamia wá, ati lati Siria-Maaka wá, ati lati Soba wá.
entries.en: So they hired thirty and two thousand chariots, and the king of Maachah and his people; who came and pitched before Medeba. And the children of Ammon gathered themselves together from their cities, and came to battle.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni nwọn bẹwẹ ẹgbã mẹrindilogun kẹkẹ́ ati ọba Maaka ati awọn enia rẹ̀; nwọn si wá nwọn si do niwaju Medeba. Awọn ọmọ Ammoni si ko ara wọn jọ lati ilu wọn, nwọn si wá si ogun.
entries.en: And when David heard of it, he sent Joab, and all the host of the mighty men.

entries.yo: Nigbati Dafidi gbọ́, o ran Joabu ati gbogbo ogun awọn akọni enia.
entries.en: And the children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array before the gate of the city: and the kings that were come were by themselves in the field.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Ammoni si jade wá, nwọn si tẹ ogun niwaju ẹnu-ibode ilu na: awọn ọba ti o wá si wà li ọtọ̀ ni igbẹ.
entries.en: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind, he chose out of all the choice of Israel, and put them in array against the Syrians.

entries.yo: Nigbati Joabu ri pe a doju ija kọ on, niwaju ati lẹhin, o yàn ninu gbogbo ãyo Israeli, o si tẹ ogun wọn si awọn ara Siria.
entries.en: And the rest of the people he delivered unto the hand of Abishai his brother, and they set themselves in array against the children of Ammon.

entries.yo: O si fi iyokù awọn enia le Abiṣai arakunrin rẹ̀ lọwọ, nwọn si tẹ ogun si awọn ọmọ Ammoni.
entries.en: And he said, If the Syrians be too strong for me, then thou shalt help me: but if the children of Ammon be too strong for thee, then I will help thee.

entries.yo: On si wipe, Bi awọn ara Siria ba le jù fun mi, nigbana ni iwọ o ran mi lọwọ: ṣugbọn bi awọn ọmọ Ammoni ba le jù fun ọ, nigbana li emi o ràn ọ lọwọ.
entries.en: Be of good courage, and let us behave ourselves valiantly for our people, and for the cities of our God: and let the LORD do that which is good in his sight.

entries.yo: Ṣe giri ki o si jẹ ki a huwa akọni fun enia wa ati fun ilu Ọlọrun wa: ki Oluwa ki o si ṣe eyi ti o dara loju rẹ̀.
entries.en: So Joab and the people that were with him drew nigh before the Syrians unto the battle; and they fled before him.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Joabu ati awọn enia ti o wà pẹlu rẹ̀ sún siwaju awọn ara Siria si ibi ija: nwọn si sá niwaju rẹ̀.
entries.en: And when the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians were fled, they likewise fled before Abishai his brother, and entered into the city. Then Joab came to Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn ọmọ Ammoni si ri pe awọn ara Siria sá, awọn pẹlu sá niwaju Abiṣai arakunrin rẹ̀, nwọn si wọ̀ ilu lọ. Nigbana ni Joabu wá si Jerusalemu.
entries.en: And when the Syrians saw that they were put to the worse before Israel, they sent messengers, and drew forth the Syrians that were beyond the river: and Shophach the captain of the host of Hadarezer went before them.

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn ara Siria ri pe a le wọn niwaju Israeli, nwọn ran onṣẹ, nwọn si fà awọn ara Siria ti mbẹ lòke odò: Ṣofaki olori ogun Hadareseri sì ṣiwaju wọn.
entries.en: And it was told David; and he gathered all Israel, and passed over Jordan, and came upon them, and set the battle in array against them. So when David had put the battle in array against the Syrians, they fought with him.

entries.yo: A si sọ fun Dafidi; on si ko gbogbo Israeli jọ, o si gòke odò Jordani o si yọ si wọn, o si tẹ ogun si wọn. Bẹ̃ni nigbati Dafidi tẹ ogun si awọn ara Siria, nwọn ba a jà.
entries.en: But the Syrians fled before Israel; and David slew of the Syrians seven thousand men which fought in chariots, and forty thousand footmen, and killed Shophach the captain of the host.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn ara Siria sá niwaju Israeli, Dafidi si pa ẹ̃dẹgbarin enia ninu awọn ara Siria ti o wà ninu kẹkẹ́, ati ọkẹ-meji ẹlẹsẹ, o si pa Ṣofaki olori ogun na.
entries.en: And when the servants of Hadarezer saw that they were put to the worse before Israel, they made peace with David, and became his servants: neither would the Syrians help the children of Ammon any more.

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn iranṣẹ Hadareseri ri pe a le wọn niwaju Israeli, nwọn ba Dafidi làja, nwọn si nsìn i: bẹ̃ni awọn ara Siria kò jẹ ràn awọn ọmọ Ammoni lọwọ mọ.

O SI ṣe lẹhin igbati ọdun yipo, li akokò ti awọn ọba lọ si ogun; Joabu si gbé agbara ogun jade, o si ba ilu awọn ọmọ Ammoni jẹ, nwọn si wá, nwọn si do tì Rabba. Ṣugbọn Dafidi duro ni Jerusalemu. Joabu si kọlù Rabba o si pa a run.
entries.en: And it came to pass, that after the year was expired, at the time that kings go out to battle, Joab led forth the power of the army, and wasted the country of the children of Ammon, and came and besieged Rabbah. But David tarried at Jerusalem. And Joab smote Rabbah, and destroyed it.

entries.yo: Dafidi si gbà ade ọba wọn kuro lori rẹ̀, o si ri i pe o wọ̀n talenti wura kan, okuta iyebiye si wà lara rẹ̀; a si fi de Dafidi li ori: o si kó ikogun pipọpipọ lati inu ilu na wá.
entries.en: And David took the crown of their king from off his head, and found it to weigh a talent of gold, and there were precious stones in it; and it was set upon David's head: and he brought also exceeding much spoil out of the city.

entries.yo: O si kó awọn enia ti o wà nibẹ jade wá, o si fi ayùn ati irin mimu ati ãke ké wọn. Aní bayi ni Dafidi ṣe si gbogbo ilu awọn ọmọ Ammoni. Ati Dafidi ati gbogbo awọn enia pada bọ̀ si Jerusalemu.
entries.en: And he brought out the people that were in it, and cut them with saws, and with harrows of iron, and with axes. Even so dealt David with all the cities of the children of Ammon. And David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.

entries.yo: O si ṣe lẹhin eyi li ogun si de ni Geseri pẹlu awọn ara Filistia; li akokò na ni Sibbekai ara Huṣa pa Sippai, ti inu awọn ọmọ òmiran: a si tẹ ori wọn ba.
entries.en: And it came to pass after this, that there arose war at Gezer with the Philistines; at which time Sibbechai the Hushathite slew Sippai, that was of the children of the giant: and they were subdued.

entries.yo: Ogun si tun wà pẹlu awọn ara Filistia; Elhanani ọmọ Jairi si pa Lahamu arakunrin Goliati ara Gati, igi ọ̀kọ rẹ̀ si dabi ìti awunṣọ.
entries.en: And there was war again with the Philistines; and Elhanan the son of Jair slew Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, whose spear staff was like a weaver's beam.

entries.yo: Ogun si tun wà ni Gati, nibiti ọkunrin gigun kan gbe wà, ika ati ọmọ-ẹsẹ ẹniti o jẹ mẹrinlelogun, mẹfa li ọwọ kọkan, ati mẹfa li ẹṣẹ kọkan, a si bi i pẹlu fun òmiran.
entries.en: And yet again there was war at Gath, where was a man of great stature, whose fingers and toes were four and twenty, six on each hand, and six on each foot: and he also was the son of the giant.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati o pe Israeli ni ija, Jonatani ọmọ Ṣimea arakunrin Dafidi pa a.
entries.en: But when he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea David's brother slew him.

entries.yo: Awọn wọnyi li a bi fun òmiran ni Gati; nwọn si tipa ọwọ Dafidi ṣubu, ati ipa ọwọ awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: These were born unto the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David, and by the hand of his servants.

entries.yo: SATANI si duro tì Israeli, o si tì Dafidi lati ka iye Israeli.
entries.en: And Satan stood up against Israel, and provoked David to number Israel.

entries.yo: Dafidi si wi fun Joabu ati awọn olori enia pe, Lọ ikaye Israeli lati Beerṣeba titi de Dani; ki o si mu iye wọn fun mi wá, ki emi ki o le mọ̀ iye wọn.
entries.en: And David said to Joab and to the rulers of the people, Go, number Israel from Beer-sheba even to Dan; and bring the number of them to me, that I may know it.

entries.yo: Joabu si wipe, Ki Oluwa ki o mu awọn enia rẹ pọ̀ si i ni igba ọgọrun jù bi wọn ti wà: ọba, oluwa mi, gbogbo wọn kì iha ṣe iranṣẹ oluwa mi? ẽṣe ti oluwa mi fi mbère nkan yi? ẽṣe ti on o fi mu Israeli jẹbi.
entries.en: And Joab answered, The LORD make his people an hundred times so many more as they be: but, my lord the king, are they not all my lord's servants? why then doth my lord require this thing? why will he be a cause of trespass to Israel?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ọ̀rọ ọba bori ti Joabu, nitorina Joabu jade lọ, o si la gbogbo Israeli ja, o si de Jerusalemu.
entries.en: Nevertheless the king's word prevailed against Joab. Wherefore Joab departed, and went throughout all Israel, and came to Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Joabu si fi apapọ iye awọn enia na fun Dafidi. Gbogbo Israeli jasi ẹgbẹrun ẹgbẹrun ati ọke marun enia ti nkọ idà: Juda si jasi ọkẹ mẹtalelogun le ẹgbãrun ọkunrin ti nkọ idà.
entries.en: And Joab gave the sum of the number of the people unto David. And all they of Israel were a thousand thousand and an hundred thousand men that drew sword: and Judah was four hundred threescore and ten thousand men that drew sword.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Lefi ati Benjamini ni kò kà pẹlu wọn: nitori ọ̀rọ ọba jẹ irira fun Joabu.
entries.en: But Levi and Benjamin counted he not among them: for the king's word was abominable to Joab.

entries.yo: Nkan yi si buru loju Ọlọrun; o si kọlù Israeli.
entries.en: And God was displeased with this thing; therefore he smote Israel.

entries.yo: Dafidi si wi fun Ọlọrun pe, Emi ti ṣẹ̀ gidigidi ni ṣiṣe nkan yi: ṣugbọn nisisiyi, emi bẹ̀ ọ, mu ẹ̀ṣẹ iranṣẹ rẹ kuro; nitoriti mo hùwa wère gidigidi.
entries.en: And David said unto God, I have sinned greatly, because I have done this thing: but now, I beseech thee, do away the iniquity of thy servant; for I have done very foolishly.

entries.yo: Oluwa si wi fun Gadi, ariran Dafidi pe,
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto Gad, David's seer, saying,

entries.yo: Lọ ki o si wi fun Dafidi pe, Bayi li Oluwa wi, mo fi nkan mẹta lọ̀ ọ: yàn ọkan ninu wọn ki emi ki o le ṣe e si ọ.
entries.en: Go and tell David, saying, Thus saith the LORD, I offer thee three things: choose thee one of them, that I may do it unto thee.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Gadi tọ Dafidi wá, o si wi fun u pe, Bayi li Oluwa wi, yan fun ara rẹ,
entries.en: So Gad came to David, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Choose thee

entries.yo: Yala ọdun mẹta iyan, tabi iparun li oṣù mẹta niwaju awọn ọta rẹ, ti idà awọn ọta rẹ nle ọ ba; tabi idà Oluwa, ni ijọ mẹta, ani ajakalẹ àrun ni ilẹ na, ti angeli Oluwa o ma pani ja gbogbo àgbegbe Israeli. Njẹ nisisiyi rò o wò, esi wo ni emi o mu pada tọ̀ ẹniti o ran mi.
entries.en: Either three years' famine; or three months to be destroyed before thy foes, while that the sword of thine enemies overtaketh thee; or else three days the sword of the LORD, even the pestilence, in the land, and the angel of the LORD destroying throughout all the coasts of Israel. Now therefore advise thyself what word I shall bring again to him that sent me.

entries.yo: Dafidi si wi fun Gadi pe, iyọnu nla ba mi: jẹ ki emi ki o ṣubu si ọwọ Oluwa nisisiyi: nitori ãnu rẹ̀ pọ̀; ṣugbọn má jẹ ki emi ṣubu si ọwọ ẹnia.
entries.en: And David said unto Gad, I am in a great strait: let me fall now into the hand of the LORD; for very great are his mercies: but let me not fall into the hand of man.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ li Oluwa ran ajakalẹ arun si Israeli: awọn ti o ṣubu ni Israeli jẹ ẹgbã marundilogoji enia.
entries.en: So the LORD sent pestilence upon Israel: and there fell of Israel seventy thousand men.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si ran angeli kan si Jerusalemu lati run u: bi o si ti nrun u, Oluwa wò, o si kãnu nitori ibi na, o si wi fun angeli na ti nrun u pe; O to, da ọwọ rẹ duro. Angeli Oluwa na si duro nibi ilẹ-ipaka Ornani, ara Jebusi.
entries.en: And God sent an angel unto Jerusalem to destroy it: and as he was destroying, the LORD beheld, and he repented him of the evil, and said to the angel that destroyed, It is enough, stay now thine hand. And the angel of the LORD stood by the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.

entries.yo: Dafidi si gbé oju rẹ̀ soke, o si ri angeli Oluwa na duro lagbedemeji aiye ati ọrun, o ni idà fifayọ lọwọ rẹ̀ ti o si nà sori Jerusalemu. Nigbana ni Dafidi ati awọn àgbagba Israeli, ti o wọ aṣọ ọ̀fọ, da oju wọn bolẹ.
entries.en: And David lifted up his eyes, and saw the angel of the LORD stand between the earth and the heaven, having a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem. Then David and the elders of Israel, who were clothed in sackcloth, fell upon their faces.

entries.yo: Dafidi si wi fun Ọlọrun pe, Emi kọ́ ha paṣẹ lati kaye awọn enia? ani emi li ẹniti o ṣẹ̀ ti mo si ṣe buburu pãpã; ṣugbọn bi o ṣe ti agutan wọnyi, kini nwọn ṣe? Emi bẹ̀ ọ, Oluwa Ọlọrun mi, jẹ ki ọwọ rẹ ki o wà li ara mi, ati lara ile baba mi; ṣugbọn ki o máṣe li ara awọn enia rẹ ti a o fi arùn kọlu wọn.
entries.en: And David said unto God, Is it not I that commanded the people to be numbered? even I it is that have sinned and done evil indeed; but as for these sheep, what have they done? let thine hand, I pray thee, O LORD my God, be on me, and on my father's house; but not on thy people, that they should be plagued.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni angeli Oluwa na paṣẹ fun Gadi lati sọ fun Dafidi pe, ki Dafidi ki o gòke lọ ki o si tẹ pẹpẹ kan fun Oluwa, ni ilẹ ipaka Ornani, ara Jebusi.
entries.en: Then the angel of the LORD commanded Gad to say to David, that David should go up, and set up an altar unto the LORD in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.

entries.yo: Dafidi si gòke lọ nipa ọ̀rọ Gadi, ti o sọ li orukọ Oluwa.
entries.en: And David went up at the saying of Gad, which he spake in the name of the LORD.

entries.yo: Ornani si yipada, o si ri angeli na; ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ mẹrin pẹlu rẹ̀ pa ara wọn mọ́. Njẹ Ornani npa ọka lọwọ.
entries.en: And Ornan turned back, and saw the angel; and his four sons with him hid themselves. Now Ornan was threshing wheat.

entries.yo: Bi Dafidi si ti de ọdọ Ornani, Ornani si wò, o si ri Dafidi, o si ti ibi ilẹ ipaka rẹ̀ jade, o si wolẹ, o dojubolẹ fun Dafidi.
entries.en: And as David came to Ornan, Ornan looked and saw David, and went out of the threshingfloor, and bowed himself to David with his face to the ground.

entries.yo: Dafidi si wi fun Ornani pe, Fun mi ni ibi ipaka yi, ki emi ki o le tẹ pẹpẹ kan nibẹ fun Oluwa; iwọ o si fi fun mi ni iye owo rẹ̀ pipe; ki a le da ajakalẹ arun duro lọdọ awọn enia.
entries.en: Then David said to Ornan, Grant me the place of this threshingfloor, that I may build an altar therein unto the LORD: thou shalt grant it me for the full price: that the plague may be stayed from the people.

entries.yo: Ornani si wi fun Dafidi pe, Mu u fun ra rẹ, si jẹ ki oluwa mi ọba ki o ṣe eyiti o dara loju rẹ̀: wò o mo fi awọn malu pẹlu fun ẹbọ-ọrẹ-sisun, ati ohun èlo ipaka fun igi, ati ọka fun ọrẹ onjẹ; mo fi gbogbo rẹ̀ fun ọ.
entries.en: And Ornan said unto David, Take it to thee, and let my lord the king do that which is good in his eyes: lo,I give thee the oxen also for burnt offerings, and the threshing instruments for wood, and the wheat for the meat offering; I give it all.

entries.yo: Dafidi ọba si wi fun Ornani pe, Bẹ̃kọ; ṣugbọn emi a rà a ni iye owo rẹ̀ pipe nitõtọ, nitoriti emi kì o mu eyi ti iṣe tirẹ fun Oluwa, bẹ̃ni emi kì o ru ẹbọ-ọrẹ sisun laiṣe inawo.
entries.en: And king David said to Ornan, Nay; but I will verily buy it for the full price: for I will not take that which is thine for the LORD, nor offer burnt offerings without cost.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Dafidi fi ẹgbẹta ṣekeli wura nipa iwọn fun Ornani fun ibẹ na.
entries.en: So David gave to Ornan for the place six hundred shekels of gold by weight.

entries.yo: Dafidi si tẹ pẹpẹ kan nibẹ fun Oluwa, o si ru ẹbọ ọrẹ-sisun ati ẹbọ ọpẹ, o si kepe Oluwa; on si fi iná da a li ohùn lati ọrun wá lori pẹpẹ ẹbọ-ọrẹ sisun na.
entries.en: And David built there an altar unto the LORD, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings, and called upon the LORD; and he answered him from heaven by fire upon the altar of burnt offering.

entries.yo: Oluwa si paṣẹ fun angeli na; on si tun tẹ ida rẹ̀ bọ inu akọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the LORD commanded the angel; and he put up his sword again into the sheath thereof.

entries.yo: Li akokò na nigbati Dafidi ri pe Oluwa ti da on li ohùn ni ibi ilẹ-ipaka Ornani, ara Jebusi, o si rubọ nibẹ.
entries.en: At that time when David saw that the LORD had answered him in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite, then he sacrificed there.

entries.yo: Nitori agọ Oluwa ti Mose pa li aginju, ati pẹpẹ ọrẹ sisun, mbẹ ni ibi giga ni Gibeoni li akokò na.
entries.en: For the tabernacle of the LORD, which Moses made in the wilderness, and the altar of the burnt offering, were at that season in the high place at Gibeon.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Dafidi kò le lọ siwaju rẹ̀ lati bere lọwọ Ọlọrun: nitoriti ẹ̀ru idà angeli Oluwa na ba a.
entries.en: But David could not go before it to inquire of God: for he was afraid because of the sword of the angel of the LORD.

entries.yo: NIGBANA ni Dafidi wipe, Eyi ni ile Oluwa Ọlọrun, eyi si ni pẹpẹ ọrẹ-sisun fun Israeli.
entries.en: Then David said, This is the house of the LORD God, and this is the altar of the burnt offering for Israel.

entries.yo: Dafidi si paṣẹ lati ko awọn alejo ti mbẹ ni ilẹ Israeli jọ; o si yan awọn agbẹkuta lati gbẹ okuta lati fi kọ́le Ọlọrun.
entries.en: And David commanded to gather together the strangers that were in the land of Israel; and he set masons to hew wrought stones to build the house of God.

entries.yo: Dafidi si pese irin li ọ̀pọlọpọ fun iṣo fun ilẹkun ẹnu-ọ̀na, ati fun ìde; ati idẹ li ọ̀pọlọpọ li aini iwọn;
entries.en: And David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates, and for the joinings; and brass in abundance without weight;

entries.yo: Igi kedari pẹlu li ainiye: nitori awọn ara Sidoni, ati awọn ti Tire mu ọ̀pọlọpọ igi kedari wá fun Dafidi.
entries.en: Also cedar trees in abundance: for the Zidonians and they of Tyre brought much cedar wood to David.

entries.yo: Dafidi si wipe, Solomoni ọmọ mi, ọdọmọde ni, o si rọ̀, ile ti a o si kọ́ fun Oluwa, a o si ṣe e tobi jọjọ, fun okiki ati ogo ka gbogbo ilẹ: nitorina emi o pese silẹ fun u. Bẹ̃ni Dafidi si pese silẹ lọ̀pọlọpọ, ki o to kú.
entries.en: And David said, Solomon my son is young and tender, and the house that is to be builded for the LORD must be exceeding magnifical, of fame and of glory throughout all countries: I will therefore now make preparation for it. So David prepared abundantly before his death.

entries.yo: Nigbana li o pe Solomoni ọmọ rẹ̀, o si fi aṣẹ fun u lati kọ́le kan fun Oluwa Ọlọrun Israeli.
entries.en: Then he called for Solomon his son, and charged him to build an house for the LORD God of Israel.

entries.yo: Dafidi si wi fun Solomoni pe, Ọmọ mi, bi o ṣe ti emi ni, o ti wà li ọkàn mi lati kọ́le kan fun orukọ Oluwa Ọlọrun mi:
entries.en: And David said to Solomon, My son, as for me, it was in my mind to build an house unto the name of the LORD my God:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ọ̀rọ Oluwa tọ̀ mi wá, wipe, Iwọ ti ta ẹ̀jẹ silẹ li ọ̀pọlọpọ, iwọ si ti ja ogun nlanla: iwọ kò gbọdọ kọ́ ile fun orukọ mi, nitoriti iwọ ta ẹ̀jẹ pipọ̀ silẹ niwaju mi.
entries.en: But the word of the LORD came to me, saying, Thou hast shed blood abundantly, and hast made great wars: thou shalt not build an house unto my name, because thou hast shed much blood upon the earth in my sight.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, a o bi ọmọ kan fun ọ, ẹniti yio ṣe enia isimi; emi o si fun u ni isimi lọdọ gbogbo awọn ọta rẹ̀ yika kiri: nitori orukọ rẹ̀ yio ma jẹ Solomoni, emi o si fi alafia ati idakẹjẹ fun Israeli li ọjọ aiye rẹ̀.
entries.en: Behold, a son shall be born to thee, who shall be a man of rest; and I will give him rest from all his enemies round about: for his name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quietness unto Israel in his days.

entries.yo: On o kọ ile kan fun orukọ mi; on o si jẹ ọmọ mi; emi o si jẹ baba fun u; emi o si fi idi itẹ ijọba rẹ̀ mulẹ lori Israeli lailai.
entries.en: He shall build an house for my name; and he shall be my son, and I will be his father; and I will establish throne of his kingdom over Israel for ever.

entries.yo: Njẹ ọmọ mi, ki Oluwa ki o pẹlu rẹ; iwọ si ma pọ̀ si i, ki o si kọ́ ile Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ, bi o ti sọ nipa tirẹ.
entries.en: Now, my son, the LORD be with thee; and prosper thou, and build the house of the LORD thy God, as he hath said of thee.

entries.yo: Kiki ki Oluwa ki o fun ọ li ọgbọ́n ati oye, ki o si fun ọ li aṣẹ niti Israeli, ki iwọ ki o le pa ofin Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ mọ́.
entries.en: Only the LORD give thee wisdom and understanding, and give thee charge concerning Israel, that thou mayest keep the law of the LORD thy God.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni iwọ o ma pọ̀ si i, bi iwọ ba ṣe akiyesi lati mu aṣẹ ati idajọ ti Oluwa pa fun Mose ṣẹ niti Israeli: mura giri ki o si ṣe onigboya, má bẹ̀ru bẹ̃ni ki aiya ki o máṣe fò ọ.
entries.en: Then shalt thou prosper, if thou takest heed to fulfil the statutes and judgments which the LORD charged Moses with concerning Israel: be strong, and of good courage; dread not, nor be dismayed.

entries.yo: Si kiyesi i, ninu ipọnju mi, emi ti pèse fun ile Oluwa na, ọkẹ marun talenti wura, ati ẹgbẹrun ẹgbẹrun talenti fadakà; ati ti idẹ, ati ti irin, laini ìwọn; nitori ọ̀pọlọpọ ni: ati ìti-igi ati okuta ni mo ti pèse; iwọ si le wá kún u.
entries.en: Now, behold, in my trouble I have prepared for the house of the LORD an hundred thousand talents of gold, and a thousand thousand talents of silver; and of brass and iron without weight; for it is in abundance: timber also and stone have I prepared; and thou mayest add thereto.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu awọn oniṣẹ mbẹ fun ọ lọpọlọpọ, awọn gbẹnagbẹna ati awọn oniṣọna okuta ati igi ati onirũru ọlọgbọ́n enia fun onirũru iṣẹ.
entries.en: Moreover there are workmen with thee in abundance, hewers and workers of stone and timber, and all manner of cunning men for every manner of work.

entries.yo: Niti wura, fadakà ati idẹ, ati irin, kò ni ìwọn. Nitorina dide ki o si ma ṣiṣẹ, ki Oluwa ki o si pẹlu rẹ.
entries.en: Of the gold, the silver, and the brass, and the iron, there is no number. Arise therefore, and be doing, and the LORD be with thee.

entries.yo: Dafidi paṣẹ pẹlu fun gbogbo awọn ijoye Israeli lati ran Solomoni ọmọ rẹ̀ lọwọ pe:
entries.en: David also commanded all the princes of Israel to help Solomon his son, saying,

entries.yo: Oluwa Ọlọrun nyin kò ha wà pẹlu nyin? on kò ha ti fi isimi fun nyin niha gbogbo? on sa ti fi awọn ti ngbe ilẹ na le mi li ọwọ; a si ṣẹgun ilẹ na niwaju Oluwa ati niwaju enia rẹ̀.
entries.en: Is not the LORD your God with you? and hath he not given you rest on every side? for he hath given the inhabitants of the land into mine hand; and the land is subdued before the LORD, and before his people.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi ẹ fi aiya nyin ati ọkàn nyin si atiwá Oluwa Ọlọrun nyin; nitorina dide ki ẹ si kọ́ ibi mimọ́ Oluwa Ọlọrun, lati mu apoti ẹri ti majẹmu Oluwa wọ̀ inu rẹ̀, ati ohun èlo mimọ́ Ọlọrun, sinu ile na ti a o kọ́ fun orukọ Oluwa.
entries.en: Now set your heart and your soul to seek the LORD your God; arise therefore, and build ye the sanctuary of the LORD God, to bring the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and the holy vessels of God, into the house that is to be built to the name of the LORD.

entries.yo: NIGBATI Dafidi gbó, ti o si kún fun ọjọ, o fi Solomoni ọmọ rẹ̀ jẹ ọba lori Israeli.
entries.en: So when David was old and full of days, he made Solomon his son king over Israel.

entries.yo: O si kó gbogbo awọn ijoye Israeli jọ, ati awọn alufa ati awọn ọmọ Lefi.
entries.en: And he gathered together all the princes of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.

entries.yo: A si ka awọn ọmọ Lefi lati ẹni ọgbọ̀n ọdun ati jù bẹ̃ lọ: iye wọn nipa ori wọn, ọkunrin kọkan sí jẹ ẹgbã mọkandilogun.
entries.en: Now the Levites were numbered from the age of thirty years and upward: and their number by their polls, man by man, was thirty and eight thousand.

entries.yo: Ninu wọnyi, ẹgbã mejila ni lati ma bojuto iṣẹ ile Oluwa; ẹgbãta si nṣe olori ati onidajọ:
entries.en: Of which, twenty and four thousand were to set forward the work of the house of the LORD; and six thousand were officers and judges:

entries.yo: Ẹgbaji si jẹ adena: ẹgbaji si fi ohun-elo ti mo ṣe lati buyìn, yìn Oluwa.
entries.en: Moreover four thousand were porters; and four thousand praised the LORD with the instruments which I made, said David, to praise therewith.

entries.yo: Dafidi si pín wọn ni ẹgbẹgbẹ lãrin awọn ọmọ Lefi, eyini ni Gerṣoni, Kohati, ati Merari.
entries.en: And David divided them into courses among the sons of Levi, namely, Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

entries.yo: Ninu awọn ọmọ Gerṣoni ni Laadani, ati Ṣimei.
entries.en: Of the Gershonites were, Laadan, and Shimei.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Laadani: Jehieli ni olori, ati Setamu, ati Joeli, mẹta.
entries.en: The sons of Laadan; the chief was Jehiel, and Zetham, and Joel, three.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Ṣimei; Ṣelomiti, ati Hasieli, ati Harani, mẹta. Awọn wọnyi li olori awọn baba Laadani.
entries.en: The sons of Shimei; Shelomith, and Haziel, and Haran, three. These were the chief of the fathers of Laadan.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Ṣimei ni Jahati, Sina, ati Jeuṣi, ati Beriah. Awọn mẹrin wọnyi li ọmọ Ṣimei.
entries.en: And the sons of Shimei were, Jahath, Zina, and Jeush, and Beriah. These four were the sons of Shimei.

entries.yo: Jahati si li olori, ati Sisa ibikeji: ṣugbọn Jeuṣi ati Beriah kò li ọmọ pipọ; nitorina ni nwọn ṣe wà ni iṣiro kan, gẹgẹ bi ile baba wọn.
entries.en: And Jahath was the chief, and Zizah the second: but Jeush and Beriah had not many sons; therefore they were in one reckoning, according to their father's house.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Kohati; Amramu, Ishari, Hebroni ati Ussieli, mẹrin.
entries.en: The sons of Kohath; Amram, Ishar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Amramu; Aaroni ati Mose: a si ya Aaroni si ọ̀tọ, ki o le ma sọ awọn ohun mimọ́ jùlọ di mimọ́, on ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ lailai, lati ma jo turari niwaju Oluwa, lati ma ṣe iranṣẹ fun u, ati lati ma sure li orukọ rẹ̀ lailai.
entries.en: The sons of Amram; Aaron and Moses: and Aaron was separated, that he should sanctify the most holy things, he and his sons for ever, to burn incense before the LORD, to minister unto him, and to bless in his name for ever.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn niti Mose enia Ọlọrun, a kà awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ pọ̀ mọ ẹ̀ya Lefi.
entries.en: Now concerning Moses the man of God, his sons were named of the tribe of Levi.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Mose ni, Gerṣomu ati Elieseri.
entries.en: The sons of Moses were, Gershom, and Eliezer.

entries.yo: Ninu awọn ọmọ Gerṣomu, Sebueli li olori.
entries.en: Of the sons of Gershom, Shebuel was the chief.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Elieseri ni Rehabiah olori. Elieseri kò si li ọmọ miran; ṣugbọn awọn ọmọ Rehabiah pọ̀ gidigidi.
entries.en: And the sons of Eliezer were, Rehabiah the chief. And Eliezer had none other sons; but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.

entries.yo: Ninu awọn ọmọ Ishari; Ṣelomiti li olori.
entries.en: Of the sons of Izhar; Shelomith the chief.

entries.yo: Ninu awọn ọmọ Hebroni: Jeriah ekini, Amariah ekeji, Jahasieli ẹkẹta, ati Jekamami ẹkẹrin.
entries.en: Of the sons of Hebron; Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.

entries.yo: Ninu awọn ọmọ Ussieli: Mika ekini, ati Jesiah ekeji.
entries.en: Of the sons of Uzziel; Michah the first, and Jesiah the second.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Merari; Mali ati Muṣi. Awọn ọmọ Mali; Eleasari ati Kiṣi.
entries.en: The sons of Merari; Mahli, and Mushi. The sons of Mahli; Eleazar, and Kish.

entries.yo: Eleasari kú, kò si li ọmọkunrin bikòṣe ọmọbinrin: awọn arakunrin wọn awọn ọmọ Kiṣi si fẹ wọn li aiya.
entries.en: And Eleazar died, and had no sons, but daughters: and their brethren the sons of Kish took them.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Muṣi; Mali, ati Ederi, ati Jeremoti, mẹta.
entries.en: The sons of Mushi; Mahli, and Eder, and Jeremoth, three.

entries.yo: Wọnyi ni awọn ọmọ Lefi, bi ile baba wọn; ani olori awọn baba, bi a ti ka wọn ni iye orukọ, nipa ori wọn, awọn ti o ṣiṣẹ ìsin ile Oluwa, lati iwọn ogun ọdun ati jù bẹ̃ lọ.
entries.en: These were the sons of Levi after the house of their fathers; even the chief of the fathers, as they were counted by number of names by their polls, that did the work for the service of the house of the LORD, from the age of twenty years and upward.

entries.yo: Nitori Dafidi wipe, Oluwa Ọlọrun Israeli ti fi isimi fun awọn enia rẹ̀, on si ngbé Jerusalemu lailai:
entries.en: For David said, The LORD God of Israel hath given rest unto his people, that they may dwell in Jerusalem for ever:

entries.yo: Ati pẹlu awọn ọmọ Lefi: nwọn kì yio si tun rù ibugbe na mọ, ati gbogbo ohun elo rẹ̀ fun ìsin rẹ̀.
entries.en: And also unto the Levites; they shall no more carry the tabernacle, nor any vessels of it for the service thereof.

entries.yo: Nitori nipa ọ̀rọ ikẹhin Dafidi, ni kika iye awọn ọmọ Lefi lati ìwọn ogun ọdun ati jù bẹ̃ lọ:
entries.en: For by the last words of David the Levites were numbered from twenty years old and above:

entries.yo: Nitori iṣẹ wọn ni lati duro tì awọn ọmọ Aaroni, fun ìsin ile Oluwa, niti àgbala, ati niti iyẹwu, ati niti ṣiṣe ohun èlo wọnni ni mimọ́, ati iṣẹ ìsin ile Ọlọrun;
entries.en: Because their office was to wait on the sons of Aaron for the service of the house of the LORD, in the courts, and in the chambers, and in the purifying of all holy things, and the work of the service of the house of God;

entries.yo: Ati fun àkara ifihàn, ati fun iyẹfun kikuna fun ẹbọ ọrẹ, ati fun àkara alaiwu, ati fun eyi ti a yan ninu awo pẹtẹ, ati fun eyi ti a dín, ati fun gbogbo oniruru òṣuwọn ati ìwọn;
entries.en: Both for the shewbread, and for the fine flour for meat offering, and for the unleavened cakes, and for that which is baked in the pan, and for that which is fried, and for all manner of measure and size;

entries.yo: Ati lati duro li orowurọ lati dupẹ ati lati yin Oluwa, ati bẹ̃ gẹgẹ li aṣalẹ;
entries.en: And to stand every morning to thank and praise the LORD, and likewise at even;

entries.yo: Ati lati ru gbogbo ẹbọ ọrẹ sisun fun Oluwa li ọjọjọ isimi, ati li oṣù titun ati li ọjọ wọnni ti a pa li aṣẹ, ni iye, li ẹsẹsẹ gẹgẹ bi aṣẹ ti a pa fun wọn nigbagbogbo niwaju Oluwa:
entries.en: And to offer all burnt sacrifices unto the LORD in the sabbaths, in the new moons, and on the set feasts, by number, according to the order commanded unto them, continually before the LORD:

entries.yo: Ati ki nwọn ki o ma tọju ẹṣọ agọ ajọ enia, ati ẹṣọ ibi mimọ́, ati ẹṣọ awọn ọmọ Aaroni arakunrin wọn, ni ìsin ile Oluwa.
entries.en: And that they should keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the charge of the holy place, and the charge of the sons of Aaron their brethren, in the service of the house of the LORD.

entries.yo: NJẸ bi a ti pín awọn ọmọ Aaroni ni wọnyi. Awọn ọmọ Aaroni; Nadabu ati Abihu, Eleasari, ati Itamari.
entries.en: Now these are the divisions of the sons of Aaron. The sons of Aaron; Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Nadabu ati Abihu kú ṣaju baba wọn, nwọn kò si li ọmọ: nitorina ni Eleasari ati Itamari fi ṣiṣẹ alufa.
entries.en: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no children: therefore Elezar and Ithamar executed the priest's office.

entries.yo: Dafidi si pin wọn, ati Sadoku ninu awọn ọmọ Eleasari, ati Ahimeleki ninu awọn ọmọ Itamari, gẹgẹ bi iṣẹ wọn ninu ìsin wọn.
entries.en: And David distributed them, both Zadok of the sons of Eleazar, and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, according to their offices in their service.

entries.yo: A si ri awọn ọkunrin ti o nṣe olori ninu awọn ọmọ Eleasari jù ti inu awọn ọmọ Itamari lọ, bayi li a si pin wọn. Ninu awọn ọmọ Eleasari, ọkunrin mẹrindilogun li o nṣe olori ni ile baba wọn, ati mẹjọ ninu awọn ọmọ Itamari, gẹgẹ bi ile baba wọn.
entries.en: And there were more chief men found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar; and thus were they divided. Among the sons of Eleazar there were sixteen chief men of the house of their fathers, and eight among the sons of Ithamar according to the house of their fathers.

entries.yo: Bayi li a fi iṣẹkeké pin wọn, iru kan mọ ikeji pẹlu; nitori awọn olori ibi mimọ́, ati olori ti Ọlọrun wà ninu awọn ọmọ Eleasari, ati ninu awọn ọmọ Itamari.
entries.en: Thus were they divided by lot, one sort with another; for the governors of the sanctuary, and governors of the house of God, were of the sons of Eleazar, and of the sons of Ithamar.

entries.yo: Ati Ṣemaiah ọmọ Nataneeli akọwe, ọkan ninu awọn ọmọ Lefi kọ wọn niwaju ọba, ati awọn olori, ati Sadoku alufa, ati Ahimeleki, ọmọ Abiatari, ati niwaju olori awọn baba awọn alufa, ati awọn ọmọ Lefi: a mu ile baba kan fun Eleasari, a si mu ọkan fun Itamari.
entries.en: And Shemaiah the son of Nethaneel the scribe, one of the Levites, wrote them before the king, and the princes, and Zadok the priest, and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and before the chief of the fathers of the priests and Levites: one principal household being taken for Eleazar, and one taken for Ithamar.

entries.yo: Njẹ iṣẹkeké ekini jade fun Jehoiaribu, ekeji fun Jedaiah,
entries.en: Now the first lot came forth to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,

entries.yo: Ẹkẹta fun Harimu, ẹkẹrin fun Seorimu,
entries.en: The third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,

entries.yo: Ẹkarun fun Malkijah, ẹkẹfa fun Mijamini,
entries.en: The fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,

entries.yo: Ekeje fun Hakkosi, ẹkẹjọ fun Abijah,
entries.en: The seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,

entries.yo: Ẹkẹsan fun Jeṣua, ẹkẹwa fun Ṣekaniah,
entries.en: The ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shecaniah,

entries.yo: Ẹkọkanla fun Eliaṣibu, ekejila fun Jakimu,
entries.en: The eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,

entries.yo: Ẹkẹtala fun Huppa, ẹkẹrinla fun Jeṣebeabu,
entries.en: The thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,

entries.yo: Ẹkẹdogun fun Bilga, ẹkẹrindilogun fun Immeri,
entries.en: The fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,

entries.yo: Ẹkẹtadilogun fun Heṣiri, ekejidilogun fun Afisesi,
entries.en: The seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Aphses,

entries.yo: Ẹkọkandilogun fun Petahiah, ogun fun Jehesekeli,
entries.en: The nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezekel,

entries.yo: Ẹkọkanlelogun fun Jakini, ekejilelogun fun Gamuli,
entries.en: The one and twentieth to Jachin, the two and twentieth to Gamul,

entries.yo: Ẹkẹtalelogun fun Delaiah, ẹkẹrinlelogun fun Maasiah.
entries.en: The three and twentieth to Delaiah, the four and twentieth to Maaziah.

entries.yo: Wọnyi ni itò wọn ni ìsin wọn lati lọ sinu ile Oluwa, gẹgẹ bi iṣe wọn nipa ọwọ Aaroni baba wọn, bi Oluwa Ọlọrun Israeli ti paṣẹ fun u.
entries.en: These were the orderings of them in their service to come into the house of the LORD, according to their manner, under Aaron their father, as the LORD God of Israel had commanded him.

entries.yo: Iyokù awọn ọmọ Lefi ni wọnyi: Ninu awọn ọmọ Amramu; Ṣubaeli: ninu awọn ọmọ Ṣubaeli; Jehediah.
entries.en: And the rest of the sons of Levi were these: Of the sons of Amram; Shubael: of the sons of Shubael; Jehdeiah.

entries.yo: Nipa ti Rehabiah; ninu awọn ọmọ Rehabiah, ekini Iṣṣiah.
entries.en: Concerning Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, the first was Isshiah.

entries.yo: Ninu awọn Ishari; Ṣelomoti; ninu awọn ọmọ Ṣelomoti; Jahati.
entries.en: Of the Izharites; Shelomoth: of the sons of Shelomoth; Jahath.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Hebroni: Jeriah ikini; Amariah ekeji, Jahasieli ẹkẹta, Jekamamu ẹkẹrin.
entries.en: And the sons of Hebron; Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, Jekameam the fourth.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Ussieli; Mika: awọn ọmọ Mika; Ṣamiri.
entries.en: Of the sons of Uzziel; Michah: of the sons of Michah; Shamir.

entries.yo: Arakunrin Mika ni Iṣṣiah; ninu awọn ọmọ Iṣṣiah; Sekariah.
entries.en: The brother of Michah was Isshiah: of the sons of Isshiah; Zechariah.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Merari ni Mali ati Muṣi: awọn ọmọ Jaasiah; Beno;
entries.en: The sons of Merari were Mahli and Mushi: the sons of Jaaziah; Beno.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Merari nipa Jaasiah; Beno ati Ṣohamu, ati Sakkuri, ati Ibri.
entries.en: The sons of Merari by Jaaziah; Beno, and Shoham, and Zaccur, and Ibri.

entries.yo: Lati ọdọ Mali ni Eleasari ti wá, ẹniti kò li ọmọkunrin.
entries.en: Of Mahli came Eleazar, who had no sons.

entries.yo: Nipa ti Kiṣi: ọmọ Kiṣi ni Jerameeli.
entries.en: Concerning Kish: the son of Kish was Jerahmeel.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Muṣi pẹlu; Mali, ati Ederi, ati Jerimoti. Wọnyi li ọmọ awọn ọmọ Lefi nipa ile baba wọn.
entries.en: The sons also of Mushi; Mahli, and Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites after the house of their fathers.

entries.yo: Awọn wọnyi pẹlu ṣẹ keké gẹgẹ bi awọn arakunrin wọn awọn ọmọ Aaroni niwaju Dafidi ọba ati Sadoku, ati Ahimeleki, ati awọn olori awọn baba awọn alufa ati awọn ọmọ Lefi: olori awọn baba gẹgẹ bi aburo rẹ̀.
entries.en: These likewise cast lots over against their brethren the sons of Aaron in the presence of David the king, and Zadok, and Ahimelech, and the chief of the fathers of the priests and Levites, even the principal fathers over against their younger brethren.

entries.yo: PẸLUPẸLU Dafidi ati awọn olori ogun yà ninu awọn ọmọkunrin Asafu, ati Hemani, ati Jedutuni, fun ìsin yi, awọn ẹniti o ma fi duru ati psalteri, ati kimbali kọrin: ati iye awọn oniṣẹ gẹgẹ bi ìsin wọn jẹ:
entries.en: Moreover David and the captains of the host separated to the service of the sons of Asaph, and of Heman, and of Jeduthun, who should prophesy with harps, with psalteries, and with cymbals: and the number of the workmen according to their service was:

entries.yo: Ninu awọn ọmọ Asafu, Sakkuri, ati Josefu, ati Netaniah, ati Asarela, awọn ọmọ Asafu labẹ ọwọ Asafu, ti o kọrin gẹgẹ bi aṣẹ ọba.
entries.en: Of the sons of Asaph; Zaccur, and Joseph, and Nethaniah, and Asarelah, the sons of Asaph under the hands of Asaph, which prophesied according to the order of the king.

entries.yo: Ti Jedutuni: awọn ọmọ Jedutuni; Gedaliah, ati Seri, ati Jeṣaiah, Haṣabiah, ati Mattitiah, ati Ṣimei, mẹfa, labẹ ọwọ baba wọn Jedutuni, ẹniti o fi duru kọrin, lati ma dupẹ fun ati lati ma yìn Oluwa.
entries.en: Of Jeduthun: the sons of Jeduthun; Gedaliah, and Zeri, and Jeshaiah, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the hands of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied with a harp, to give thanks and to praise the LORD.

entries.yo: Ti Hemani: awọn ọmọ Hemani; Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Ussieli, Ṣebueli, ati Jerimotu, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliata, Giddalti, ati Romamtieseri, Joṣbekaṣa, Malloti, Hotiri, Mahasiotu:
entries.en: Of Heman: the sons of Heman; Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, and Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, and Romamti-ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, and Mahazioth:

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn wọnyi li awọn ọmọ Hemani, woli ọba ninu ọ̀rọ Ọlọrun, lati ma gbé iwo na soke. Ọlọrun si fun Hemani li ọmọkunrin mẹrinla ati ọmọbinrin mẹta.
entries.en: All these were the sons of Heman the king's seer in the words of God, to lift up the horn. And God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn wọnyi li o wà labẹ ọwọ baba wọn, fun orin ile Oluwa, pẹlu kimbali, psalteri ati duru, fun ìsin ile Ọlọrun: labẹ ọwọ ọba, ni Asafu, Jedutuni, ati Hemani wà.
entries.en: All these were under the hands of their father for song in the house of the LORD, with cymbals, psalteries, and harps, for the service of the house of God, according to the king's order to Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni iye wọn, pẹlu awọn arakunrin wọn ti a kọ́ li orin Oluwa, ani gbogbo awọn ti o moye, jasi ọrinlugba o le mẹjọ.
entries.en: So the number of them, with their brethren that were instructed in the songs of the LORD, even all that were cunning, was two hundred fourscore and eight.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣẹ keké fun iṣẹ; gbogbo wọn bakanna bi ti ẹni-kekere bẹ̃ni ti ẹni-nla, ti olukọ bi ti ẹniti a nkọ́.
entries.en: And they cast lots, ward against ward, as well the small as the great, the teacher as the scholar.

entries.yo: Iṣẹkeké ekini si jade wá fun Asafu si Josefu: ekeji si Gedaliah, ẹniti on pẹlu awọn arakunrin rẹ̀ ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, jẹ mejila:
entries.en: Now the first lot came forth for Asaph to Joseph: the second to Gedaliah, who with his brethren and sons were twelve:

entries.yo: Ẹkẹta si Sakkuri, awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ ati awọn arakunrin rẹ̀, jẹ mejila:
entries.en: The third to Zaccur, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

entries.yo: Ẹkẹrin si Isri, awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, ati awọn arakunrin rẹ̀, jẹ mejila:
entries.en: The fourth to Izri, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

entries.yo: Ẹkarun si Netaniah, awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, ati awọn arakunrin rẹ̀, jẹ mejila:
entries.en: The fifth to Nethaniah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

entries.yo: Ẹkẹfa si Bukkiah, awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, ati awọn arakunrin rẹ̀, jẹ mejila:
entries.en: The sixth to Bukkiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

entries.yo: Ekeje si Jeṣarela, awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, ati awọn arakunrin rẹ̀, jẹ mejila:
entries.en: The seventh to Jesharelah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

entries.yo: Ẹkẹjọ si Jeṣaiah, awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, ati awọn arakunrin rẹ̀, jẹ mejila:
entries.en: The eighth to Jeshaiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

entries.yo: Ẹkẹsan si Mattaniah, awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, ati awọn arakunrin rẹ̀, jẹ mejila:
entries.en: The ninth to Mattaniah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

entries.yo: Ẹkẹwa si Ṣimei, awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, ati awọn arakunrin rẹ̀, jẹ mejila:
entries.en: The tenth to Shimei, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

entries.yo: Ẹkọkanla si Asareeli, awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, ati awọn arakunrin rẹ̀, jẹ mejila:
entries.en: The eleventh to Azareel, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

entries.yo: Ekejila si Haṣabiah, awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, ati awọn arakunrin rẹ̀, jẹ mejila:
entries.en: The twelfth to Hashabiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

entries.yo: Ẹkẹtala si Ṣubaeli, awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, ati awọn arakunrin rẹ̀, jẹ mejila:
entries.en: The thirteenth to Shubael, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

entries.yo: Ẹkẹrinla si Mattitiah, awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, ati awọn arakunrin rẹ̀, jẹ mejila:
entries.en: The fourteenth to Mattithiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

entries.yo: Ẹkẹ̃dogun si Jeremoti, awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, ati awọn arakunrin rẹ̀, jẹ mejila:
entries.en: The fifteenth to Jeremoth, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

entries.yo: Ẹkẹrindilogun si Hananiah, awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, ati awọn arakunrin rẹ̀, jẹ mejila:
entries.en: The sixteenth to Hananiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

entries.yo: Ẹkẹtadilogun si Joṣbekaṣa awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, ati awọn arakunrin rẹ̀, jẹ mejila:
entries.en: The seventeenth to Joshbekashah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

entries.yo: Ekejidilogun si Hanani, awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, ati awọn arakunrin rẹ̀, jẹ mejila:
entries.en: The eighteenth to Hanani, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

entries.yo: Ẹkọkandilogun si Malloti, awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, ati awọn arakunrin rẹ̀, jẹ mejila:
entries.en: The nineteenth to Mallothi, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

entries.yo: Ogun si Eliata, awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, ati awọn arakunrin rẹ̀, jẹ mejila:
entries.en: The twentieth to Eliathah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

entries.yo: Ẹkọkanlelogun si Hotiri, awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, ati awọn arakunrin rẹ̀, jẹ mejila:
entries.en: The one and twentieth to Hothir, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

entries.yo: Ekejilelogun si Giddalti, awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, ati awọn arakunrin rẹ̀, jẹ mejila:
entries.en: The two and twentieth to Giddalti, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

entries.yo: Ẹkẹtalelogun si Mahasioti, awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, ati awọn arakunrin rẹ̀, jẹ mejila:
entries.en: The three and twentieth to Mahazioth, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

entries.yo: Ẹkẹrinlelogun si Romamti-eseri, awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, ati awọn arakunrin rẹ̀, jẹ mejila.
entries.en: The four and twentieth to Romamti-ezer, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve.

entries.yo: NITI ipin awọn adena: niti awọn ọmọ Kosa ni Meṣelemiah ọmọ Kore, ninu awọn ọmọ Asafu.
entries.en: Concerning the divisions of the porters: Of the Korhites was Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Meṣelemiah ni Sekariah akọbi, Jediaeli ekeji, Sebadiah ẹkẹta, Jatnieli ẹkẹrin,
entries.en: And the sons of Meshelemiah were, Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,

entries.yo: Elamu ẹkarun, Johanani ẹkẹfa, Elioenai ekeje.
entries.en: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, Elioenai the seventh.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Obed-Edomu si ni Ṣemaiah akọbi, Jehosabadi ekeji, Joa ẹkẹta, ati Sakari ẹkẹrin, ati Netaneeli ẹkarun,
entries.en: Moreover the sons of Obed-edom were, Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, and Sacar the fourth, and Nethaneel the fifth,

entries.yo: Ammieli ẹkẹfa, Issakari ekeje, Peulltai ẹkẹjọ: Ọlọrun sa bukún u.
entries.en: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, Peulthai the eighth: for God blessed him.

entries.yo: Ati fun Ṣemaiah ọmọ rẹ̀ li a bi awọn ọmọ ti nṣe olori ni ile baba wọn: nitori alagbara akọni enia ni nwọn.
entries.en: Also unto Shemaiah his son were sons born, that ruled throughout the house of their father: for they were mighty men of valour.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Ṣemaiah; Otni, ati Refaeli, ati Obedi, Elsabadi, arakunrin ẹniti iṣe alagbara enia, Elihu, ati Semakiah.
entries.en: The sons of Shemaiah; Othni, and Rephael, and Obed, Elzabad, whose brethren were strong men, Elihu, and Semachiah.

entries.yo: Gbogbo wọnyi ti inu awọn ọmọ Obed-Edomu, ni: awọn, ati awọn ọmọ wọn, ati awọn arakunrin wọn, akọni enia ati alagbara fun ìsin na, jẹ mejilelọgọta lati ọdọ Obed-Edomu;
entries.en: All these of the sons of Obed-edom: they and their sons and their brethren, able men for strength for the service, were threescore and two of Obed-edom.

entries.yo: Meṣelemiah si ni awọn ọmọ ati arakunrin, alagbara enia, mejidilogun.
entries.en: And Meshelemiah had sons and brethren, strong men, eighteen.

entries.yo: Hosa pẹlu, ninu awọn ọmọ Merari, ni ọmọ; Simri olori (nitori bi on kì iti iṣe akọbi ṣugbọn baba rẹ̀ fi jẹ olori),
entries.en: Also Hosah, of the children of Merari, had sons; Simri the chief, (for though he was not the firstborn, yet his father made him the chief;)

entries.yo: Hilkiah ekeji, Tebaliah ẹkẹta, Sekariah ẹkẹrin: gbogbo awọn ọmọ ati awọn arakunrin Hosa jẹ mẹtala.
entries.en: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, Zechariah the fourth: all the sons and brethren of Hosah were thirteen.

entries.yo: Ninu awọn wọnyi ni ipin awọn adena, ani ninu awọn olori ọkunrin, ti nwọn ni iṣẹ gẹgẹ bi awọn arakunrin wọn, lati ṣe iranṣẹ ni ile Oluwa.
entries.en: Among these were the divisions of the porters, even among the chief men, having wards one against another, to minister in the house of the LORD.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣẹ keké, bi ti ẹni-kekere bẹ̃ni ti ẹni-nla, gẹgẹ bi ile baba wọn, fun olukuluku ẹnu-ọ̀na.
entries.en: And they cast lots, as well the small as the great, according to the house of their fathers, for every gate.

entries.yo: Iṣẹ keké iha ila-õrun bọ̀ sọdọ Ṣelemiah. Nigbana ni nwọn ṣẹ keké fun Sekariah ọmọ rẹ̀, ọlọgbọ́n igbimọ; iṣẹ keké rẹ̀ si bọ si iha ariwa.
entries.en: And the lot eastward fell to Shelemiah. Then for Zechariah his son, a wise counseller, they cast lots; and his lot came out northward.

entries.yo: Sọdọ Obed-Edomu niha gusù; ati sọdọ awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ niha ile Asuppimu (yara iṣura).
entries.en: To Obed-edom southward; and to his sons the house of Asuppim.

entries.yo: Ti Suppimu ati Hosa niha iwọ-õrun li ẹnu-ọ̀na Ṣalleketi, nibi ọ̀na igòke lọ, iṣọ kọju si iṣọ.
entries.en: To Shuppim and Hosah the lot came forth westward, with the gate Shallecheth, by the causeway of the going up, ward against ward.

entries.yo: Niha ìla-õrùn awọn ọmọ Lefi mẹfa (nṣọ), niha ariwa mẹrin li ojojumọ, niha gusù mẹrin li ojojumọ, ati ninu Asuppimu (ile iṣura) mejimeji.
entries.en: Eastward were six Levites, northward four a day, southward four a day, and toward Asuppim two and two.

entries.yo: Ni ibasa niha iwọ-õrùn, mẹrin li ọ̀na igòke-lọ ati meji ni ibasa.
entries.en: At Parbar westward, four at the causeway, and two at Parbar.

entries.yo: Wọnyi ni ipin awọn adena lati inu awọn ọmọ Kore, ati lati inu awọn ọmọ Merari.
entries.en: These are the divisions of the porters among the sons of Kore, and among the sons of Merari.

entries.yo: Lati inu awọn ọmọ Lefi, Ahijah li o wà lori iṣura ile Ọlọrun, ati lori iṣura nkan wọnni ti a yà si mimọ́.
entries.en: And of the Levites, Ahijah was over the treasures of the house of God, and over the treasures of the dedicated things.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Laadani; awọn ọmọ Laadani ara Gerṣoni, awọn olori baba, ani ti Laadani ara Gerṣoni ni Jehieli.
entries.en: As concerning the sons of Laadan; the sons of the Gershonite Laadan, chief fathers, even of Laadan the Gershonite, were Jehieli.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Jehieli; Setamu, ati Joeli arakunrin rẹ̀, ti o wà lori iṣura ile Oluwa.
entries.en: The sons of Jehieli; Zetham, and Joel his brother, which were over the treasures of the house of the LORD.

entries.yo: Ninu ọmọ Amramu, ati ọmọ Ishari, ara Hebroni, ati ọmọ Ussieli:
entries.en: Of the Amramites, and the Izharites, the Hebronites, and the Uzzielites:

entries.yo: Ati Ṣebueli ọmọ Gerṣomu, ọmọ Mose, ni onitọju iṣura.
entries.en: And Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was ruler of the treasures.

entries.yo: Ati awọn arakunrin rẹ̀ nipa Elieseri, Rehabiah ọmọ rẹ̀, ati Jesaiah ọmọ rẹ̀, ati Joramu, ọmọ rẹ̀, ati Sikri ọmọ rẹ̀, ati Ṣelomiti ọmọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And his brethren by Eliezer; Rehabiah his son, and Jeshaiah his son, and Joram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomith his son.

entries.yo: Ṣelomiti yi ati awọn arakunrin rẹ̀ li o wà lori iṣura ohun iyà-si-mimọ́, ti Dafidi ọba ati awọn olori baba, awọn ijoye lori ẹgbẹgbẹrun, ati ọrọrun, ati awọn olori ogun ti yà-si-mimọ́.
entries.en: Which Shelomith and his brethren were over all the treasures of the dedicated things, which David the king, and the chief fathers, the captains over thousands and hundreds, and the captains of the host, had dedicated.

entries.yo: Lati inu ikogun ti a kó li ogun, ni nwọn yà si mimọ́ lati ma fi ṣe itọju ile Oluwa.
entries.en: Out of the spoils won in battles did they dedicate to maintain the house of the LORD.

entries.yo: Ati gbogbo eyiti Samueli, ariran, ati Saulu, ọmọ Kiṣi, ati Abneri ọmọ Neri, ati Joabu ọmọ Seruiah, yà si mimọ́; gbogbo ohun ti a ba ti yà si mimọ́, ohun na mbẹ li ọwọ Ṣelomiti, ati awọn arakunrin rẹ̀.
entries.en: And all that Samuel the seer, and Saul the son of Kish, and Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah, had dedicated; and whosoever had dedicated any thing, it was under the hand of Shelomith, and of his brethren.

entries.yo: Ninu awọn ọmọ Ishari, Kenaniah ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ li o jẹ ijoye ati onidajọ fun iṣẹ ilu lori Israeli.
entries.en: Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons were for the outward business over Israel, for officers and judges.

entries.yo: Ninu awọn ọmọ Hebroni, Hasabiah ati awọn arakunrin rẹ̀, awọn akọni enia, ẽdẹgbẹsan li awọn alabojuto Israeli nihahin Jordani niha iwọ-õrun, fun gbogbo iṣẹ Oluwa, ati fun ìsin ọba.
entries.en: And of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brethren, men of valour, a thousand and seven hundred, were officers among them of Israel on this side Jordan westward in all the business of the LORD, and in the service of the king.

entries.yo: Ninu awọn ọmọ Hebroni ni Jerijah olori, ani ninu awọn ọmọ Hebroni, gẹgẹ bi idile ati iran awọn baba rẹ̀. Li ogoji ọdun ijọba Dafidi, a wá wọn, a si ri ninu wọn, awọn alagbara akọni enia ni Jaseri ti Gileadi.
entries.en: Among the Hebronites was Jerijah the chief, even among the Hebronites, according to the generations of his fathers. In the fortieth year of the reign of David they were sought for, and there were found among them mighty men of valour at Jazer of Gilead.

entries.yo: Ati awọn arakunrin rẹ̀, awọn akọni enia, jẹ ẹgbã o le ẽdẹgbẹrin: gbogbo wọn jẹ awọn olori baba ti Dafidi ọba fi ṣe olori lori awọn ọmọ Rubeni, ati awọn ọmọ Gadi, ati àbọ ẹ̀ya Manasse, fun gbogbo ọ̀ran ti Ọlọrun ati ti ọba.
entries.en: And his brethren, men of valour, were two thousand and seven hundred chief fathers, whom king David made rulers over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh, for every matter pertaining to God, and affairs of the king.

entries.yo: NJẸ awọn ọmọ Israeli nipa iye wọn, eyini ni, awọn olori baba, ati awọn balogun ẹgbẹgbẹrun, ati ọrọrun, ati awọn ijoye wọn ti nsìn ọba ni olukuluku ọ̀na li ẹgbẹgbẹ, ti nwọle ti si njade li oṣoṣù ni gbogbo oṣù ọdun, jẹ́ ẹgbã mejila.
entries.en: Now the children of Israel after their number, to wit, the chief fathers and captains of thousands and hundreds, and their officers that served the king in any matter of the courses, which came in and went out month by month throughout all the months of the year, of every course were twenty and four thousand.

entries.yo: Lori ẹgbẹ kini ti oṣù kini ni Jaṣobeamu ọmọ Sabdieli: ẹgbã mejila li o si wà ninu ẹgbẹ tirẹ̀.
entries.en: Over the first course for the first month was Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

entries.yo: Ninu awọn ọmọ Peresi on ni olori fun gbogbo awọn olori ogun ti oṣù ekini.
entries.en: Of the children of Perez was the chief of all the captains of the host for the first month.

entries.yo: Ati lori ẹgbẹ ti oṣù keji ni Dodai ara Ahohi, ati ẹgbẹ tirẹ̀; Mikloti pẹlu nṣe balogun: ẹgbã mejila li o wà ninu ẹgbẹ tirẹ̀ pẹlu.
entries.en: And over the course of the second month was Dodai an Ahohite, and of his course was Mikloth also the ruler: in his course likewise were twenty and four thousand.

entries.yo: Olori ogun kẹta fun oṣù kẹta ni Benaiah ọmọ Jehoiada alufa, olori kan: ẹgbã mejila li o si wà ninu ẹgbẹ tirẹ̀.
entries.en: The third captain of the host for the third month was Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, a chief priest: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

entries.yo: Eyini ni Benaiah na, akọni enia, ninu awọn ọgbọ̀n, o si jẹ olori awọn ọgbọ̀n: Amisabadi ọmọ rẹ̀ si wà ninu ẹgbẹ tirẹ̀.
entries.en: This is that Benaiah, who was mighty among the thirty, and above the thirty: and in his course was Ammizabad his son.

entries.yo: Olori ogun kẹrin fun oṣù kẹrin ni Asaheli arakunrin Joabu, ati Sebadiah ọmọ rẹ̀ lẹhin rẹ̀: ẹgbã mejila li o si wà ninu ẹgbẹ tirẹ̀.
entries.en: The fourth captain for the fourth month was Asahel the brother of Joab, and Zebadiah his son after him: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

entries.yo: Olori ogun karun fun oṣù karun ni Ṣamhuti ara Israhi: ẹgbã mejila li o si wà ninu ẹgbẹ tirẹ̀.
entries.en: The fifth captain for the fifth month was Shamhuth the Izrahite: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

entries.yo: Olori ogun kẹfa fun oṣù kẹfa ni Ira ọmọ Ikkeṣi ara Tekoi: ẹgbã mejila li o si wà ninu ẹgbẹ tirẹ̀.
entries.en: The sixth captain for the sixth month was Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

entries.yo: Olori ogun keje fun oṣù keje ni Heleṣi ara Peloni, ninu awọn ọmọ Efraimu: ẹgbã mejila li o si wà ninu ẹgbẹ tirẹ̀.
entries.en: The seventh captain for the seventh month was Helez the Pelonite, of the children of Ephraim: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

entries.yo: Olori ogun kẹjọ fun oṣù kẹjọ ni Sibbekai ara Huṣati ti awọn ara Sarehi: ẹgbã mejila li o si wà ninu ẹgbẹ tirẹ̀.
entries.en: The eighth captain for the eighth month was Sibbecai the Hushathite, of the Zarhites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

entries.yo: Olori ogun kẹsan fun oṣù kẹsan ni Abieseri ara Anatoti ti awọn ara Benjamini: ẹgbã mejila li o si wà ninu ẹgbẹ tirẹ̀.
entries.en: The ninth captain for the ninth month was Abiezer the Anetothite, of the Benjamites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

entries.yo: Olori ogun kẹwa fun oṣù kẹwa ni Maharai ara Netofa, ti awọn ara Sarehi: ẹgbã mejila li o si wà ninu ẹgbẹ tirẹ̀.
entries.en: The tenth captain for the tenth month was Maharai the Netophathite, of the Zarhites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

entries.yo: Olori ogun kọkanla fun oṣù kọkanla ni Benaiah ara Peratoni, ti awọn ọmọ Efraimu: ẹgbã mejila li o si wà ninu ẹgbẹ tirẹ̀.
entries.en: The eleventh captain for the eleventh month was Benaiah the Pirathonite, of the children of Ephraim: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

entries.yo: Olori ogun kejila fun oṣù kejila ni Heldai ara Netofa, ti Otnieli: ẹgbã mejila li o si wà ninu ẹgbẹ tirẹ̀.
entries.en: The twelfth captain for the twelfth month was Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

entries.yo: Ati lori awọn ẹ̀ya Israeli: ijoye lori awọn ọmọ Reubeni ni Elieseri ọmọ Sikri: lori awọn ọmọ Simeoni, Ṣefatiah ọmọ Maaka:
entries.en: Furthermore over the tribes of Israel: the ruler of the Reubenites was Eliezer the son of Zichri: of the Simeonites, Shephatiah the son of Maachah:

entries.yo: Lori awọn ọmọ Lefi, Haṣabiah ọmọ Kemueli: lori awọn ọmọ Aaroni, Sadoku:
entries.en: Of the Levites, Hashabiah the son of Kemuel: of the Aaronites, Zadok:

entries.yo: Lori Juda, Elihu, ọkan ninu awọn arakunrin Dafidi: lori Issakari, Omri ọmọ Mikaeli:
entries.en: Of Judah, Elihu, one of the brethren of David: of Issachar, Omri the son of Michael:

entries.yo: Lori Sebuloni, Iṣmaiah ọmọ Obadiah: lori Naftali, Jerimoti ọmọ Asrieli:
entries.en: Of Zebulun, Ishmaiah the son of Obadiah: of Naphtali, Jerimoth the son of Azriel:

entries.yo: Lori awọn ọmọ Efraimu, Hoṣea ọmọ Asasiah: lori àbọ ẹ̀ya Manasse, Joeli ọmọ Pedaiah.
entries.en: Of the children of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Azaziah: of the half tribe of Manasseh, Joel the son of Pedaiah:

entries.yo: Lori àbọ ẹ̀ya Manasse ni Gileadi, Iddo ọmọ Sekariah: lori Benjamini, Jaasieli ọmọ Abneri.
entries.en: Of the half tribe of Manasseh in Gilead, Iddo the son of Zechariah: of Benjamin, Jaasiel the son of Abner:

entries.yo: Lori Dani, Asareeli ọmọ Jerohamu Awọn wọnyi li olori awọn ẹ̀ya Israeli.
entries.en: Of Dan, Azareel the son of Jeroham. These were the princes of the tribes of Israel.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Dafidi kò ka iye awọn ti o wà lati ogun ọdun ati awọn ti kò to bẹ̃; nitori ti Oluwa ti wipe on o mu Israeli pọ̀ si i bi irawọ oju ọrun.
entries.en: But David took not the number of them from twenty years old and under: because the LORD had said he would increase Israel like to the stars of the heavens.

entries.yo: Joabu ọmọ Seruiah bẹ̀rẹ si ikà wọn, ṣugbọn kò kà wọn tan, nitori ibinu ṣubu lu Israeli nitori na; bẹ̃ni a kò fi iye na sinu iwe Kronika ti Dafidi ọba.
entries.en: Joab the son of Zeruiah began to number, but he finished not, because there fell wrath for it against Israel; neither was the number put in the account of the chronicles of king David.

entries.yo: Lori awọn iṣura ọba ni Asmafeti ọmọ Adieli wà: ati lori iṣura oko, ni ilu, ati ni ileto, ati ninu odi ni Jonatani ọmọ Ussiah wà:
entries.en: And over the king's treasures was Azmaveth the son of Adiel: and over the storehouses in the fields, in the cities, and in the villages, and in the castles, was Jehonathan the son of Uzziah:

entries.yo: Ati lori awọn ti nro oko, lati ma ro ilẹ ni Esri ọmọ Kelubi wà:
entries.en: And over them that did the work of the field for tillage of the ground was Ezri the son of Chelub:

entries.yo: Ati lori awọn ọgba-àjara ni Ṣimei ara Ramoti wà: lori eso ọgba-àjara fun iṣura ati ọti-waini ni Sabdi ọmọ Ṣifmi wà:
entries.en: And over the vineyards was Shimei the Ramathite: over the increase of the vineyards for the wine cellars was Zabdi the Shiphmite:

entries.yo: Ati lori igi-olifi, ati igi-sikamore ti mbẹ ni pẹ̀tẹlẹ ni Baal-hanani ara Gederi wà; ati lori iṣura ororo ni Joaṣi wà.
entries.en: And over the olive trees and the sycomore trees that were in the low plains was Baal-hanan the Gederite: and over the cellars of oil was Joash:

entries.yo: Ati lori awọn agbo malu ti njẹ̀ ni Ṣaroni ni Ṣitrai ara Ṣaroni wà: ati lori agbo malu ti o wà li afonifoji ni Ṣafati ọmọ Adlai wà:
entries.en: And over the herds that fed in Sharon was Shitrai the Sharonite: and over the herds that were in the valleys was Shaphat the son of Adlai:

entries.yo: Ati lori ibakasiẹ ni Obili ara Iṣmaeli wà: ati lori abo kẹtẹkẹtẹ ni Jehodaiah ara Meronoti wà:
entries.en: Over the camels also was Obil the Ishmaelite: and over the asses was Jehdeiah the Meronothite:

entries.yo: Ati lori agbo agutan ni Jasisi ara Hageri wà. Gbogbo awọn wọnyi ni ijoye ohun ini ti iṣe ti Dafidi ọba.
entries.en: And over the flocks was Jaziz the Hagerite. All these were the rulers of the substance which was king David's.

entries.yo: Jonatani ẹgbọn Dafidi pẹlu ni ìgbimọ ọlọgbọ́n enia ati akọwe: ati Jehueli ọmọ Hakmoni wà pẹlu awọn ọmọ ọba.
entries.en: Also Jonathan David's uncle was a counseller, a wise man, and a scribe: and Jehiel the son of Hachmoni was with the king's sons:

entries.yo: Ahitofeli si jẹ ìgbimọ ọba: ati Huṣai ara Arki ni ọrẹ ọba.
entries.en: And Ahithophel was the king's counseller: and Hushai the Archite was the king's companion:

entries.yo: Ati lẹhin Ahitofeli ni Jehoiada ọmọ Benaiah, ati Abiatari: Joabu si ni arẹ-balogun ogun ọba.
entries.en: And after Ahithophel was Jehoiada the son of Benaiah, and Abiathar: and the general of the king's army was Joab.

entries.yo: DAFIDI si kó gbogbo ijoye Israeli jọ, awọn ijoye ẹ̀ya, ati awọn ijoye awọn ẹgbẹ ti nṣe iranṣẹ fun ọba, ati awọn ijoye lori ẹgbẹgbẹrun, ati awọn ijoye lori ọrọrun, ati awọn ijoye lori gbogbo ọrọ̀ ati ini ọba, ati ti awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ pẹlu awọn balogun, ati pẹlu awọn alagbara enia, ati gbogbo akọni enia si Jerusalemu.
entries.en: And David assembled all the princes of Israel, the princes of the tribes, and the captains of the companies that ministered to the king by course, and the captains over the thousands, and captains over the hundreds, and the stewards over all the substance and possession of the king, and of his sons, with the officers, and with the mighty men, and with all the valiant men, unto Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Dafidi ọba dide duro li ẹsẹ rẹ̀, o si wipe, Ẹ gbọ́ ti emi, ẹnyin arakunrin mi ati enia mi: emi fẹ li ọkàn mi lati kọ́ ile isimi kan fun apoti ẹri majẹmu Oluwa, ati fun itisẹ Ọlọrun wa, mo si ti mura tan fun kikọ́le na:
entries.en: Then David the king stood up upon his feet, and said, Hear me, my brethren, and my people: As for me, I had in mine heart to build an house of rest for the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and for the footstool of our God, and had made ready for the building:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Ọlọrun sọ fun mi pe, Iwọ kò gbọdọ kọ́ ile fun orukọ mi, nitori ologun ni iwọ, o si ti ta ẹ̀jẹ silẹ.
entries.en: But God said unto me, Thou shalt not build an house for my name, because thou hast been a man of war, and hast shed blood.

entries.yo: Oluwa Ọlọrun Israeli si yàn mi lati inu gbogbo ile baba mi lati jẹ ọba lori Israeli lailai: nitori ti o ti yàn Juda li olori; ati ninu ile Juda, ile baba mi: ati larin awọn ọmọ baba mi o fẹ mi lati jẹ ọba gbogbo Israeli.
entries.en: Howbeit the LORD God of Israel chose me before all the house of my father to be king over Israel for ever: for he hath chosen Judah to be the ruler; and of the house of Judah, the house of my father; and among the sons of my father he liked me to make me king over all Israel:

entries.yo: Ati ninu gbogbo ọmọ mi ọkunrin (nitori ti Oluwa ti fun mi li ọmọkunrin pupọ), o ti yàn Solomoni ọmọ mi lati joko lori itẹ ijọba Oluwa lori Israeli.
entries.en: And of all my sons, (for the LORD hath given me many sons,) he hath chosen Solomon my son to sit upon the throne of the kingdom of the LORD over Israel.

entries.yo: On si wi fun mi pe, Solomoni ọmọ rẹ, on yio kọ́ ile mi ati agbala mi: nitori emi ti yàn a li ọmọ mi, emi o si jẹ baba fun u.
entries.en: And he said unto me, Solomon thy son, he shall build my house and my courts: for I have chosen him to be my son, and I will be his father.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu emi o fi idi ijọba rẹ̀ mulẹ lailai, bi o ba murale lati ṣe ofin mi ati idajọ mi bi li oni yi.
entries.en: Moreover I will establish his kingdom for ever, if he be constant to do my commandments and my judgments, as at this day.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi li oju gbogbo Israeli ijọ enia Oluwa, ati li eti Ọlọrun wa, ẹ ma pamọ́ ki ẹ si ma ṣafẹri gbogbo ofin Oluwa Ọlọrun nyin: ki ẹ le ni ilẹ rere yi, ki ẹ si le fi i silẹ li ogún fun awọn ọmọ nyin lẹhin nyin lailai.
entries.en: Now therefore in the sight of all Israel the congregation of the LORD, and in the audience of our God, keep and seek for all the commandments of the LORD your God: that ye may possess this good land, and leave it for an inheritance for your children after you for ever.

entries.yo: Ati iwọ, Solomoni ọmọ mi, mọ̀ Ọlọrun baba rẹ, ki o si fi aiya pipé ati fifẹ ọkàn sìn i: nitori Oluwa a ma wá gbogbo aiya, o si mọ̀ gbogbo ete ironu: bi iwọ ba ṣafẹri rẹ̀, iwọ o ri i; ṣugbọn bi iwọ ba kọ̀ ọ silẹ on o ta ọ nù titi lai.
entries.en: And thou, Solomon my son, know thou the God of thy father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind: for the LORD searcheth all hearts, and understandeth all the imaginations of the thoughts: if thou seek him, he will be found of thee; but if thou forsake him, he will cast thee off for ever.

entries.yo: Wò o nisisiyi: nitori Oluwa ti yàn ọ lati kọ́ ile kan fun ibi mimọ́, mura le, ki iwọ si ṣe e.
entries.en: Take heed now; for the LORD hath chosen thee to build an house for the sanctuary: be strong, and do it.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Dafidi fi apẹrẹ fun Solomoni ọmọ rẹ̀ ti iloro, ati ti ile rẹ̀, ati ti ibi iṣura rẹ̀, ati ti iyara-òke rẹ̀, ati ti gbangan inu rẹ̀ ati ti ibi ibujoko ãnu,
entries.en: Then David gave to Solomon his son the pattern of the porch, and of the houses thereof, and of the treasuries thereof, and of the upper chambers thereof, and of the inner parlours thereof, and of the place of the mercy seat,

entries.yo: Ati apẹrẹ gbogbo eyi ti o ni ni inu rẹ̀ pẹlu rẹ̀ niti agbala ile Oluwa, ati ti gbogbo iyara yikakiri, niti ibi iṣura ile Ọlọrun, ati niti ibi iṣura ohun ti a yà-si-mimọ́:
entries.en: And the pattern of all that he had by the spirit, of the courts of the house of the LORD, and of all the chambers round about, of the treasuries of the house of God, and of the treasuries of the dedicated things:

entries.yo: Niti ipin awọn alufa pẹlu ati ti awọn ọmọ Lefi, ati niti gbogbo iṣẹ ìsin ile Oluwa, ati niti gbogbo ohun èlo ìsin ni ile Oluwa.
entries.en: Also for the courses of the priests and the Levites, and for all the work of the service of the house of the LORD, and for all the vessels of service in the house of the LORD.

entries.yo: Niti wura nipa ìwọn ti wura, niti gbogbo ohun èlo oniruru ìsin; niti gbogbo ohun èlo fadakà nipa ìwọn, niti gbogbo ohun èlo fun oniruru ìsin:
entries.en: He gave of gold by weight for things of gold, for all instruments of all manner of service; silver also for all instruments of silver by weight, for all instruments of every kind of service:

entries.yo: Ati ìwọn ọpa fitila wura, ati fitila wura wọn, nipa ìwọn fun olukuluku ọpa fitila ati ti fitila rẹ̀: ati niti ọpa fitila fadakà nipa ìwọn, ti olukuluku ọpa fitila ati ti fitila rẹ̀, gẹgẹ bi ìlo olukuluku ọpa fitila.
entries.en: Even the weight for the candlesticks of gold, and for their lamps of gold, by weight for every candlestick, and for the lamps thereof: and for the candlesticks of silver by weight, both for the candlestick, and also for the lamps thereof, according to the use of every candlestick.

entries.yo: Ati wura nipa ìwọn fun tabili àkara ifihan, fun olukuluku tabili; ati fadakà fun tabili fadakà:
entries.en: And by weight he gave gold for the tables of shewbread, for every table; and likewise silver for the tables of silver:

entries.yo: Ati wura didara fun pàlaka mimu ẹran, ati ọpọn, ati ago: ati fun awo-koto wura nipa ìwọn fun olukuluku awo-koto; ati nipa ìwọn fun olukuluku awo-koto fadakà:
entries.en: Also pure gold for the fleshhooks, and the bowls, and the cups: and for the golden basons he gave gold by weight for every bason; and likewise silver by weight for every bason of silver:

entries.yo: Ati fun pẹpẹ turari, wura daradara nipa ìwọn; ati apẹrẹ iduro awọn kerubu ti wura, ti nwọn nà iyẹ wọn, ti nwọn si bo apoti ẹri majẹmu Oluwa mọlẹ
entries.en: And for the altar of incense refined gold by weight; and gold for the pattern of the chariot of the cherubims, that spread out their wings, and covered the ark of the covenant of the LORD.

entries.yo: Gbogbo eyi wà ninu iwe lati ọwọ Oluwa ẹniti o kọ́ mi niti gbogbo iṣẹ apẹrẹ wọnyi.
entries.en: All this, said David, the LORD made me understand in writing by his hand upon me, even all the works of this pattern.

entries.yo: Dafidi si sọ fun Solomoni ọmọ rẹ̀ pe, murale ki o si gboyà, ki o si ṣiṣẹ: má bẹ̀ru, bẹ̃ni ki o máṣe dãmu: nitori Oluwa Ọlọrun, ani Ọlọrun mi wà pẹlu rẹ; on kì yio yẹ̀ ọ, bẹ̃ni kì yio kọ̀ ọ silẹ titi iwọ o fi pari gbogbo iṣẹ fun ìsin ile Oluwa.
entries.en: And David said to Solomon his son, Be strong and of good courage, and do it: fear not, nor be dismayed: for the LORD God, even my God, will be with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee, until thou hast finished all the work for the service of the house of the LORD.

entries.yo: Si kiyesi i, ipin awọn alufa ati awọn ọmọ Lefi, wà pẹlu rẹ fun oniruru ìsin ile Ọlọrun: iwọ ni pẹlu rẹ oniruru enia, ọlọkàn fifẹ, ẹniti o ni oye gbogbo iṣẹ fun oniruru iṣẹ: pẹlupẹlu awọn ijoye ati gbogbo awọn enia wà pẹlu rẹ fun gbogbo ọ̀ran rẹ.
entries.en: And, behold, the courses of the priests and the Levites, even they shall be with thee for all the service of the house of God: and there shall be with thee for all manner of workmanship every willing skilful man, for any manner of service: also the princes and all the people will be wholly at thy commandment.

entries.yo: DAFIDI ọba si wi fun gbogbo ijọ enia pe, Solomoni ọmọ mi, on nikan ti Ọlọrun ti yàn, jẹ ọmọde o si rọ̀, iṣẹ na si tobi: nitori ti ãfin na kì iṣe fun enia, ṣugbọn fun Ọlọrun Oluwa.
entries.en: Furthermore David the king said unto all the congregation, Solomon my son, whom alone God hath chosen, is yet young and tender, and the work is great: for the palace is not for man, but for the LORD God.

entries.yo: Ati pẹlu gbogbo ipa mi ni mo ti fi pèse silẹ fun ile Ọlọrun mi, wura fun ohun ti wura, ati fadakà fun ti fadakà, ati idẹ fun ti idẹ, irin fun ti irin, ati igi fun ti igi; okuta oniki ti a o tẹ̀ bọ okuta lati fi ṣe ọṣọ, ati okuta oniruru àwọ, ati oniruru okuta iyebiye, ati okuta marbili li ọ̀pọlọpọ.
entries.en: Now I have prepared with all my might for the house of my God the gold for things to be made of gold, and the silver for things of silver, and the brass for things of brass, the iron for things of iron, and wood for things of wood; onyx stones, and stones to be set, glistering stones, and of divers colours, and all manner of precious stones, and marble stones in abundance.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu, nitori ni didùn inu mi si ile Ọlọrun mi, mo fi ohun ini mi, eyinì ni wura ati fadakà, fun ile Ọlọrun mi, jù gbogbo eyi ti mo ti pèse silẹ fun ile mimọ́ na,
