entries.en: Moreover, because I have set my affection to the house of my God, I have of mine own proper good, of gold and silver, which I have given to the house of my God, over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house,

entries.yo: Ẹgbẹ̃dogun talenti wura, ti wura Ofiri, ati ẹ̃dẹgbarin talenti fadakà didara, lati fi bo ogiri ile na:
entries.en: Even three thousand talents of gold, of the gold of Ophir, and seven thousand talents of refined silver, to overlay the walls of the houses withal:

entries.yo: Wura fun ohun èlo wura, ati fadakà fun ohun èlo fadakà, ati fun oniruru iṣẹ nipa ọwọ awọn ọlọnà. Tani si nfẹ loni lati yà ara rẹ̀ si mimọ fun Oluwa?
entries.en: The gold for things of gold, and the silver for things of silver, and for all manner of work to be made by the hands of artificers. And who then is willing to consecrate his service this day unto the LORD?

entries.yo: Nigbana ni awọn olori awọn baba ati awọn ijoye ẹ̀ya Israeli, ati awọn balogun ẹgbẹgbẹrun ati ọrọrun, pẹlu awọn ijoye iṣẹ ọba fi tinutinu ṣe iranlọwọ,
entries.en: Then the chief of the fathers and princes of the tribes of Israel, and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, with the rulers of the king's work, offered willingly,

entries.yo: Nwọn si fi fun iṣẹ ile Ọlọrun, ti wura ẹgbẹ̃dọgbọ̀n talenti ati ẹgbãrun dramu, ati ti fadakà ẹgbãrun talenti, ati ti bàba ẹgbãsan talenti, ati ọkẹ marun talenti irin.
entries.en: And gave for the service of the house of God of gold five thousand talents and ten thousand drams, and of silver ten thousand talents, and of brass eighteen thousand talents, and one hundred thousand talents of iron.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ti a ri okuta iyebiye lọdọ wọn fi i sinu iṣura ile Oluwa, nipa ọwọ Jehieli ara Gerṣoni.
entries.en: And they with whom precious stones were found gave them to the treasure of the house of the LORD, by the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite.

entries.yo: Awọn enia si yọ̀, nitori nwọn fi tinutinu ṣe iranlọwọ nitori pẹlu ọkàn pipe ni nwọn fi tinutinu ṣe iranlọwọ fun Oluwa: pẹlupẹlu Dafidi ọba si yọ̀ gidigidi.
entries.en: Then the people rejoiced, for that they offered willingly, because with perfect heart they offered willingly to the LORD: and David the king also rejoiced with great joy.

entries.yo: Nitorina Dafidi fi iyìn fun Oluwa li oju gbogbo ijọ: Dafidi si wipe, Olubukún ni Iwọ Oluwa Ọlọrun Israeli baba wa lai ati lailai!
entries.en: Wherefore David blessed the LORD before all the congregation: and David said, Blessed be thou, LORD God of Israel our father, for ever and ever.

entries.yo: Tirẹ Oluwa ni titobi, ati agbara, ati ogo, ati iṣẹgun, ati ọlá-nla: nitori ohun gbogbo li ọrun ati li aiye tirẹ ni; ijọba ni tirẹ, Oluwa, a si gbé ọ leke li ori fun ohun gbogbo.
entries.en: Thine, O LORD, is the greatness, and the power, and the glory, and the victory, and the majesty: for all that is in the heaven and in the earth is thine; thine is the kingdom, O LORD, and thou art exalted as head above all.

entries.yo: Ọrọ̀ pẹlu ati ọlá ọdọ rẹ ni ti iwá, iwọ si jọba lori ohun gbogbo; li ọwọ rẹ ni agbara ati ipá wà; ati li ọwọ rẹ ni sisọ ni di nla wà, ati fifi agbara fun ohun gbogbo.
entries.en: Both riches and honour come of thee, and thou reignest over all; and in thine hand is power and might; and in thine hand it is to make great, and to give strength unto all.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, Ọlọrun wa, awa dupẹ lọwọ rẹ, a si yìn orukọ ogo rẹ.
entries.en: Now therefore, our God, we thank thee, and praise thy glorious name.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn tali emi, ati kili awọn enia mi, ti a fi le ṣe iranlọwọ tinutinu bi iru eyi? nitori ohun gbogbo ọdọ rẹ ni ti wá, ati ninu ohun ọwọ rẹ li awa ti fi fun ọ.
entries.en: But who am I, and what is my people, that we should be able to offer so willingly after this sort? for all things come of thee, and of thine own have we given thee.

entries.yo: Nitori alejo ni awa niwaju rẹ, ati atipo bi gbogbo awọn baba wa: ọjọ wa li aiye dabi ojiji, kò si si ireti.
entries.en: For we are strangers before thee, and sojourners, as were all our fathers: our days on the earth are as a shadow, and there is none abiding.

entries.yo: Oluwa Ọlọrun wa, gbogbo ohun ọ̀pọlọpọ yi ti awa ti pèse silẹ lati kọ ile fun ọ fun orukọ rẹ mimọ́, lati ọwọ rẹ wá ni, ati gbogbo rẹ̀ jẹ tirẹ.
entries.en: O LORD our God, all this store that we have prepared to build thee an house for thine holy name cometh of thine hand, and is all thine own.

entries.yo: Emi mọ̀ pẹlu, Ọlọrun mi, pe iwọ ndan ọkàn wò, iwọ si ni inudidún si ododo. Bi o ṣe ti emi, ninu ododo ọkàn mi li emi ti fi tinutinu ṣe iranlọwọ gbogbo nkan wọnyi; ati nisisiyi pẹlu ayọ̀ ni mo ti ri awọn enia rẹ ti o wá nihin, lati fi tinutinu ṣe iranlọwọ fun ọ.
entries.en: I know also, my God, that thou triest the heart, and hast pleasure in uprightness. As for me, in the uprightness of mine heart I have willingly offered all these things: and now have I seen with joy thy people, which are present here, to offer willingly unto thee.

entries.yo: Oluwa Ọlọrun Abrahamu, Isaaki ati Israeli, awọn baba wa, pa eyi mọ́ lailai sinu ete ironu ọkàn awọn enia rẹ, si fi idi ọkàn wọn mulẹ si ọdọ rẹ:
entries.en: O LORD God of Abraham, Isaac, and of Israel, our fathers, keep this for ever in the imagination of the thoughts of the heart of thy people, and prepare their heart unto thee:

entries.yo: Si fi ọkàn pipe fun Solomoni ọmọ mi lati pa ofin rẹ, ẹri rẹ, ati ilana rẹ mọ́, ati lati ṣe ohun gbogbo, ati lati kọ́ ãfin, fun eyi ti mo ti pèse silẹ.
entries.en: And give unto Solomon my son a perfect heart, to keep thy commandments, thy testimonies, and thy statutes, and to do all these things, and to build the palace, for the which I have made provision.

entries.yo: Dafidi si sọ fun gbogbo ijọ enia pe, Nisisiyi ẹ fi iyìn fun Oluwa Ọlọrun nyin. Gbogbo enia si fi iyìn fun Oluwa Ọlọrun awọn baba wọn, nwọn si tẹ ori wọn ba, nwọn wolẹ fun Oluwa ati ọba.
entries.en: And David said to all the congregation, Now bless the LORD your God. And all the congregation blessed the LORD God of their fathers, and bowed down their heads, and worshipped the LORD, and the king.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ru ẹbọ si Oluwa, nwọn si ru ẹbọ sisun si Oluwa, li ọjọ keji lẹhin ọjọ na, ẹgbẹrun akọmalu, ẹgbẹrun àgbo, ẹgbẹrun ọdọ-agutan, pẹlu ọrẹ mimu wọn, ati ẹbọ miran li ọ̀pọlọpọ fun gbogbo Israeli:
entries.en: And they sacrificed sacrifices unto the LORD, and offered burnt offerings unto the LORD, on the morrow after that day, even a thousand bullocks, a thousand rams, and a thousand lambs, with their drink offerings, and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel:

entries.yo: Nwọn si jẹ nwọn si mu niwaju Oluwa li ọjọ na pẹlu ayọ̀ nla. Nwọn si tun fi Solomoni ọmọ Dafidi jọba li ẹ̃keji, a si fi ororo yàn a li ọba, ati Sadoku li alufa.
entries.en: And did eat and drink before the LORD on that day with great gladness. And they made Solomon the son of David king the second time, and anointed him unto the LORD to be the chief governor, and Zadok to be priest.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Solomoni joko lori itẹ Oluwa bi ọba ni ipò Dafidi baba rẹ̀, o si pọ̀ si i; gbogbo Israeli si gba tirẹ̀ gbọ́.
entries.en: Then Solomon sat on the throne of the LORD as king instead of David his father, and prospered; and all Israel obeyed him.

entries.yo: Ati gbogbo awọn ijoye, ati awọn alagbara, ati pẹlu gbogbo awọn ọmọ Dafidi ọba tẹri wọn ba fun Solomoni ọba.
entries.en: And all the princes, and the mighty men, and all the sons likewise of king David, submitted themselves unto Solomon the king.

entries.yo: Oluwa si gbé Solomoni ga gidigidi li oju gbogbo Israeli, o si fi ọlá nla ọba fun u bi iru eyi ti kò wà fun ọba kan ṣaju rẹ̀ lori Israeli.
entries.en: And the LORD magnified Solomon exceedingly in the sight of all Israel, and bestowed upon him such royal majesty as had not been on any king before him in Israel.

entries.yo: Dafidi ọmọ Jesse si jọba lori gbogbo Israeli.
entries.en: Thus David the son of Jesse reigned over all Israel.

entries.yo: Akokò ti o si fi jọba lori Israeli jẹ ogoji ọdun; ọdun meje li o jọba ni Hebroni, ati mẹtalelọgbọn li o jọba ni Jerusalemu.
entries.en: And the time that he reigned over Israel was forty years; seven years reigned he in Hebron, and thirty and three years reigned he in Jerusalem.

entries.yo: On si darugbó, o kú rere, o kún fun ọjọ, ọrọ̀ ati ọlá; Solomoni ọmọ rẹ̀ si jọba ni ipò rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he died in a good old age, full of days, riches, and honour: and Solomon his son reigned in his stead.

entries.yo: Njẹ iṣe Dafidi ọba, ibẹ̀rẹ ati ikẹhin, kiyesi i, a kọ ọ sinu iwe Samueli ariran, ati sinu iwe itan Natani woli, ati sinu iwe itan Gadi ariran.
entries.en: Now the acts of David the king, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of Samuel the seer, and in the book of Nathan the prophet, and in the book of Gad the seer,

entries.yo: Pẹlu gbogbo jijọba ati ipá rẹ̀, ati ìgba ti o kọja lori rẹ̀, ati lori Israeli, ati lori gbogbo ijọba ilẹ wọnni.
entries.en: With all his reign and his might, and the times that went over him, and over Israel, and over all the kingdoms of the countries.

entries.yo: A si mu Solomoni, ọmọ Dafidi, lagbara lori ijọba rẹ̀, Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ̀ si wà pẹlu rẹ̀, o si gbé e ga gidigidi.
entries.en: And Solomon the son of David was strengthened in his kingdom, and the LORD his God was with him, and magnified him exceedingly.

entries.yo: Solomoni si sọ fun gbogbo Israeli, fun awọn balogun ẹgbẹgbẹrun, ati ọrọrun, ati fun awọn onidajọ, ati fun gbogbo awọn bãlẹ ni gbogbo Israeli, awọn olori awọn baba.
entries.en: Then Solomon spake unto all Israel, to the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and to the judges, and to every governor in all Israel, the chief of the fathers.

entries.yo: Solomoni ati gbogbo awọn ijọ enia pẹlu rẹ̀, lọ si ibi giga ti o wà ni Gibeoni; nitori nibẹ ni agọ ajọ enia Ọlọrun gbe wà, ti Mose, iranṣẹ Oluwa ti pa ni aginju.
entries.en: So Solomon, and all the congregation with him, went to the high place that was at Gibeon; for there was the tabernacle of the congregation of God, which Moses the servant of the LORD had made in the wilderness.

entries.yo: Apoti-ẹri Ọlọrun ni Dafidi ti gbé lati Kirjat-jearimu wá si ibi ti Dafidi ti pese silẹ fun u, nitoriti o ti pa agọ kan silẹ fun u ni Jerusalemu.
entries.en: But the ark of God had David brought up from Kirjath-jearim to the place which David had prepared for it: for he had pitched a tent for it at Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn pẹpẹ idẹ ti Besaleeli, ọmọ Uri, ọmọ Huri, ti ṣe, wà nibẹ niwaju agọ Oluwa: Solomoni ati ijọ enia si wá a ri.
entries.en: Moreover the brasen altar, that Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, had made, he put before the tabernacle of the LORD: and Solomon and the congregation sought unto it.

entries.yo: Solomoni si lọ si ibi pẹpẹ idẹ niwaju Oluwa, ti o ti wà nibi agọ ajọ, o si rú ẹgbẹrun ẹbọ-sisun lori rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Solomon went up thither to the brasen altar before the LORD, which was at the tabernacle of the congregation, and offered a thousand burnt offerings upon it.

entries.yo: Li oru na li Oluwa fi ara hàn Solomoni, o si wi fun u pe, Bère ohun ti emi o fi fun ọ.
entries.en: In that night did God appear unto Solomon, and said unto him, Ask what I shall give thee.

entries.yo: Solomoni si wi fun Ọlọrun pe, Iwọ ti fi ãnu nla hàn baba mi, o si ti mu mi jọba ni ipò rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Solomon said unto God, Thou hast shewed great mercy unto David my father, and hast made me to reign in his stead.

entries.yo: Nisisiyi Oluwa Ọlọrun, jẹ ki a mu ọ̀rọ rẹ fun Dafidi baba mi ṣẹ: nitoriti iwọ ti fi mi jọba lori awọn enia ti o pọ̀ bi erupẹ ilẹ.
entries.en: Now , O LORD God, let thy promise unto David my father be established: for thou hast made me king over a people like the dust of the earth in multitude.

entries.yo: Fun mi li ọgbọ́n ati ìmọ nisisiyi, ki emi le ma wọ ile, ki nsi ma jade niwaju enia yi: nitoripe, tani le ṣe idajọ enia rẹ yi ti o pọ̀ to yi.
entries.en: Give me now wisdom and knowledge, that I may go out and come in before this people: for who can judge this thy people, that is so great?

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si wi fun Solomoni pe, Nitoriti eyi wà li aiya rẹ, ti iwọ kò si bère ọrọ̀, ọlà, tabi ọlá, tabi ẹmi awọn ọta rẹ, bẹ̃ni o kò tilẹ bère ẹmi gigun, ṣugbọn o bère ọgbọ́n fun ara rẹ, ki o le ma ṣe idajọ enia mi, lori ẹniti mo fi ọ jọba:
entries.en: And God said to Solomon, Because this was in thine heart, and thou hast not asked riches, wealth, or honour, nor the life of thine enemies, neither yet hast asked long life; but hast asked wisdom and knowledge for thyself, that thou mayest judge my people, over whom I have made thee king:

entries.yo: Nitorina a fi ọgbọ́n on ìmọ fun ọ, Emi o si fun ọ ni ọrọ̀, ọlá, tabi ọlà, iru eyiti ọba kan ninu awọn ti nwọn wà ṣaju rẹ kò ni ri, bẹ̃ni lẹhin rẹ kì yio si ẹniti yio ni iru rẹ̀.
entries.en: Wisdom and knowledge is granted unto thee; and I will give thee riches, and wealth, and honour, such as none of the kings have had that have been before thee, neither shall there any after thee have the like.

entries.yo: Solomoni si pada lati ibi giga ti o wà ni Gibeoni wá si Jerusalemu, lati iwaju agọ ajọ awọn enia, o si jọba lori Israeli.
entries.en: Then Solomon came from his journey to the high place that was at Gibeon to Jerusalem, from before the tabernacle of the congregation, and reigned over Israel.

entries.yo: Solomoni ko kẹkẹ́ ati awọn ẹlẹṣin jọ: o si ni ẹgbãje kẹkẹ́ ati ẹgbãfa ẹlẹṣin, ti o fi sinu ilu kẹkẹ́ ati pẹlu ọba ni Jerusalemu.
entries.en: And Solomon gathered chariots and horsemen: and he had a thousand and four hundred chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen, which he placed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Ọba si ṣe ki fadakà ati wura ki o wà ni Jerusalemu bi okuta, ati igi kedari li o ṣe ki o dabi igi sikamore ti o wà ni afonifoji fun ọ̀pọlọpọ.
entries.en: And the king made silver and gold at Jerusalem as plenteous as stones, and cedar trees made he as the sycomore trees that are in the vale for abundance.

entries.yo: A si mu ẹṣin wá fun Solomoni lati Egipti, ati okùn-ọ̀gbọ: awọn oniṣowo ọba ngbà okùn-ọ̀gbọ na ni iye kan.
entries.en: And Solomon had horses brought out of Egypt, and linen yarn: the king's merchants received the linen yarn at a price.

entries.yo: Nwọn si gòke, nwọn si mu kẹkẹ́ kan lati Egipti wá fun ẹgbẹta ṣekeli fadakà, ati ẹṣin kan fun ãdọjọ: bẹ̃ni nwọn si nmu ẹṣin jade fun gbogbo awọn ọba ara Hitti, ati fun awọn ọba Siria nipa wọn.
entries.en: And they fetched up, and brought forth out of Egypt a chariot for six hundred shekels of silver, and an horse for an hundred and fifty: and so brought they out horses for all the kings of the Hittites, and for the kings of Syria, by their means.

entries.yo: SOLOMONI si pinnu rẹ̀ lati kọ́ ile kan fun orukọ Oluwa, ati ile kan fun ijọba rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Solomon determined to build an house for the name of the LORD, and an house for his kingdom.

entries.yo: Solomoni si yàn ẹgbã marundilogoji ọkunrin lati ru ẹrù, ati ọkẹ mẹrin lati ké igi li ori òke, ati egbejidilogun lati bojuto wọn.
entries.en: And Solomon told out threescore and ten thousand men to bear burdens, and fourscore thousand to hew in the mountain, and three thousand and six hundred to oversee them.

entries.yo: Solomoni si ranṣẹ si Huramu, ọba Tire, wipe, Gẹgẹ bi iwọ ti ba Dafidi, baba mi lò, ti iwọ fi igi kedari ṣọwọ si i lati kọ́ ile kan fun u lati ma gbe inu rẹ̀, bẹni ki o ba mi lò.
entries.en: And Solomon sent to Huram the king of Tyre, saying, As thou didst deal with David my father, and didst send him cedars to build him an house to dwell therein, even so deal with me.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, emi nkọ́ ile kan fun orukọ Oluwa, Ọlọrun mi, lati yà a si mimọ́ fun u, ati lati sun turari niwaju rẹ̀, ati fun àkara-ifihan igbakugba, ati fun ẹbọsisun li ọwurọ ati li alẹ, li ọjọjọ isimi ati li oṣoṣù titun, ati li apejọ Oluwa Ọlọrun wa; eyi ni aṣẹ fun Israeli titi lai.
entries.en: Behold, I build an house to the name of the LORD my God, to dedicate it to him, and to burn before him sweet incense, and for the continual shewbread, and for the burnt offerings morning and evening, on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the solemn feasts of the LORD our God. This is an ordinance for ever to Israel.

entries.yo: Ile ti emi nkọ́ yio si tobi; nitori titobi ni Ọlọrun wa jù gbogbo awọn ọlọrun lọ.
entries.en: And the house which I build is great: for great is our God above all gods.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn tani to lati kọ́ ile fun u, nitori ọrun ati ọrun awọn ọrun kò le gbà a? tali emi ti emi iba kọ́le fun u, bikòṣe kiki ati sun ẹbọ niwaju rẹ̀?
entries.en: But who is able to build him an house, seeing the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot contain him? who am I then, that I should build him an house, save only to burn sacrifice before him?

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi rán ọkunrin kan si mi ti o gbọ́n lati ṣiṣẹ ni wura, fadakà, ati ni idẹ, ati ni irin, ati ni èse aluko, ati òdodó ati alaró, ti o si le gbọ́ngbọn ati gbẹgi pẹlu awọn ọkunrin ọlọgbọ́n ti o wà lọdọ mi ni Juda ati Jerusalemu, awọn ẹniti Dafidi baba mi ti pese silẹ.
entries.en: Send me now therefore a man cunning to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass, and in iron, and in purple, and crimson, and blue, and that can skill to grave with the cunning men that are with me in Judah and in Jerusalem, whom David my father did provide.

entries.yo: Fi ìti-igi kedari, ati firi, ati algumu ranṣẹ si mi pẹlu, lati Lebanoni wá: emi sa mọ̀ pe awọn iranṣẹ rẹ le gbọ́ngbọn ati ké igi ni Lebanoni; si kiyesi i, awọn ọmọ-ọdọ mi yio wà pẹlu awọn ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ:
entries.en: Send me also cedar trees, fir trees, and algum trees, out of Lebanon: for I know that thy servants can skill to cut timber in Lebanon; and, behold, my servants shall be with thy servants,

entries.yo: Ani lati pèse ìti-igi lọpọlọpọ silẹ fun mi: nitori ile na ti emi mura lati kọ́ tobi, o si ya ni lẹnu.
entries.en: Even to prepare me timber in abundance: for the house which I am about to build shall be wonderful great.

entries.yo: Si wò o, emi o fi fun ilo awọn akégi, ti nké ìti-igi, lọwọ awọn ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ, ẹgbãwa òṣuwọn alikama fun onjẹ, ati ẹgbãwa òṣuwọn barli ati ẹgbãwa bati ọti-waini, ati ẹgbãwa bati ororo.
entries.en: And, behold, I will give to thy servants, the hewers that cut timber, twenty thousand measures of beaten wheat, and twenty thousand measures of barley, and twenty thousand baths of wine, and twenty thousand baths of oil.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Huramu, ọba Tire, kọwe dahùn o si ranṣẹ si Solomoni pe, Nitori ti Oluwa fẹran awọn enia rẹ̀ li o ṣe fi ọ jọba lori wọn.
entries.en: Then Huram the king of Tyre answered in writing, which he sent to Solomon, Because the LORD hath loved his people, he hath made thee king over them.

entries.yo: Huramu si wipe, Alabukún fun li Oluwa Ọlọrun Israeli, ti o da ọrun on aiye, ẹniti o fun Dafidi ọba ni ọlọgbọ́n ọmọ, ti o mọ̀ ọgbọ́n ati oye, ti o le kọ́ ile fun Oluwa, ati ile fun ijọba rẹ̀.
entries.en: Huram said moreover, Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, that made heaven and earth, who hath given to David the king a wise son, endued with prudence and understanding, that might build an house for the LORD, and an house for his kingdom.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi emi rán ọkunrin ọlọgbọ́n kan, ti o mọ̀ oye, ani Huramu-Abi,
entries.en: And now I have sent a cunning man, endued with understanding, of Huram my father's,

entries.yo: Ọmọ obinrin kan ninu awọn ọmọbinrin Dani: baba rẹ̀ si ṣe ọkunrin ara Tire ti o gbọ́ngbọn ati ṣiṣẹ ni wura, ati ni fadakà, ni idẹ, ni irin, ni okuta, ati ni ìti-igi, ni èse-aluko, ni alaró, ati ni ọ̀gbọ daradara, ati òdodó, lati gbẹ́ oniruru ohun gbigbẹ́ pẹlu, ati lati ṣe awari ìmọ ẹrọ gbogbo ti a o fi fun u ṣe, pẹlu awọn ọlọgbọ́n rẹ, ati pẹlu awọn ọlọgbọ́n oluwa mi Dafidi, baba rẹ.
entries.en: The son of a woman of the daughters of Dan, and his father was a man of Tyre, skilful to work in gold, and in silver, in brass, in iron, in stone, and in timber, in purple, in blue, and in fine linen, and in crimson; also to grave any manner of graving, and to find out every device which shall be put to him, with thy cunning men, and with the cunning men of my lord David thy father.

entries.yo: Njẹ nitorina alikama ati ọkà barli, ororo, ati ọti-waini na ti oluwa mi ti sọ, jẹ ki o fi ranṣẹ si awọn ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Now therefore the wheat, and the barley, the oil, and the wine, which my lord hath spoken of, let him send unto his servants:

entries.yo: Awa o si ké igi lati Lebanoni wá, iyekiye ti iwọ o fẹ; awa o si mu wọn fun ọ wá ni fifó li okun si Joppa; iwọ o si rù wọn gòke lọ si Jerusalemu.
entries.en: And we will cut wood out of Lebanon, as much as thou shalt need: and we will bring it to thee in floats by sea to Joppa; and thou shall carry it up to Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Solomoni si kaye gbogbo awọn ajeji ọkunrin ti o wà ni ilẹ Israeli, gẹgẹ bi kikà ti Dafidi, baba rẹ̀ ti kà wọn; a si ri pe, nwọn jẹ ọkẹ-mẹjọ o di-egbejilelọgbọ̀n.
entries.en: And Solomon numbered all the strangers that were in the land of Israel, after the numbering wherewith David his father had numbered them; and they were found an hundred and fifty thousand and three thousand and six hundred.

entries.yo: O si yàn ẹgbã marundilogoji ninu wọn lati ru ẹrù, ati ọkẹ mẹrin lati ṣe aké-okuta li ori òke, ati egbejidilogun alabojuto lati kó awọn enia ṣiṣẹ.
entries.en: And he set threescore and ten thousand of them to be bearers of burdens, and fourscore thousand to be hewers in the mountain, and three thousand and six hundred overseers to set the people a work.

entries.yo: SOLOMONI si bẹ̀rẹ si ikọ́ ile Oluwa ni Jerusalemu li òke Moriah nibiti Ọlọrun farahàn Dafidi baba rẹ̀, ti Dafidi ti pèse, nibi ilẹ-ipaka Ornani, ara Jebusi.
entries.en: Then Solomon began to build the house of the LORD at Jerusalem in mount Moriah, where the LORD appeared unto David his father, in the place that David had prepared in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.

entries.yo: On si bẹ̀rẹ si ikọ́ ile ni ọjọ keji oṣù keji, li ọdun kẹrin ijọba rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he began to build in the second day of the second month, in the fourth year of his reign.

entries.yo: Eyi si ni ìwọn ti Solomoni fi lelẹ fun kikọ́ ile Ọlọrun. Gigùn rẹ̀ ni igbọnwọ gẹgẹ bi ìwọn igbãni li ọgọta igbọnwọ, ati ibu rẹ̀, ogún igbọnwọ.
entries.en: Now these are the things wherein Solomon was instructed for the building of the house of God. The length by cubits after the first measure was threescore cubits, and the breadth twenty cubits.

entries.yo: Ati iloro ti mbẹ niwaju ile na, gigùn rẹ̀ ri gẹgẹ bi ibu ile na, ogún igbọnwọ, ati giga rẹ̀ ọgọfa; o si fi kiki wura bò o ninu.
entries.en: And the porch that was in the front of the house, the length of it was according to the breadth of the house, twenty cubits, and the height was an hundred and twenty: and he overlaid it within with pure gold.

entries.yo: O si fi igi-firi bò ile ti o tobi, o si fi wura daradara bò o, o si gbẹ́ àworan igi-ọpẹ ati ẹ̀wọn si i.
entries.en: And the greater house he cieled with fir tree, which he overlaid with fine gold, and set thereon palm trees and chains.

entries.yo: O si fi okuta iyebiye ṣe ile na li ọṣọ́ fun ẹwà: wura na si jasi wura Parfaimu.
entries.en: And he garnished the house with precious stones for beauty: and the gold was gold of Parvaim.

entries.yo: O si fi wura bò ile na pẹlu, ati ìti, opó, ati ogiri rẹ̀ wọnni, ati ilẹkun rẹ̀ mejeji; o si gbẹ́ àworan awọn kerubu si ara ogiri na.
entries.en: He overlaid also the house, the beams, the posts, and the walls thereof, and the doors thereof, with gold; and graved cherubims on the walls.

entries.yo: O si ṣe ile mimọ́-jùlọ na, gigùn eyiti o wà gẹgẹ bi ibu ile na, ogún igbọnwọ: ati ibu rẹ̀, ogún igbọnwọ: o si fi wura daradara bò o, ti o to ẹgbẹta talenti.
entries.en: And he made the most holy house, the length whereof was according to the breadth of the house, twenty cubits, and the breadth thereof twenty cubits: and he overlaid it with fine gold, amounting to six hundred talents.

entries.yo: Oṣuwọn iṣó si jasi ãdọta ṣekeli wura. On si fi wura bò iyara òke wọnni.
entries.en: And the weight of the nails was fifty shekels of gold. And he overlaid the upper chambers with gold.

entries.yo: Ati ninu ile mimọ́-jùlọ na, o ṣe kerubu meji ti iṣẹ ọnà finfin, o si fi wura bò wọn.
entries.en: And in the most holy house he made two cherubims of image work, and overlaid them with gold.

entries.yo: Iyẹ awọn kerubu na si jẹ ogún igbọnwọ ni gigùn: iyẹ kan jẹ igbọnwọ marun, ti o kan ogiri ile na, iyẹ keji si jẹ igbọnwọ marun, ti o kan iyẹ kerubu keji.
entries.en: And the wings of the cherubims were twenty cubits long: one wing of the one cherub was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house: and the other wing was likewise five cubits, reaching to the wing of the other cherub.

entries.yo: Ati iyẹ kerubu keji jẹ igbọnwọ marun ti o kan ogiri ile na: ati iyẹ keji jẹ igbọnwọ marun ti o kan iyẹ kerubu keji.
entries.en: And one wing of the other cherub was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house: and the other wing was five cubits also, joining to the wing of the other cherub.

entries.yo: Iyẹ kerubu wọnyi nà jade ni ogún igbọnwọ: nwọn si duro li ẹsẹ wọn, oju wọn si wà kọju si ile.
entries.en: The wings of these cherubims spread themselves forth twenty cubits: and they stood on their feet, and their faces were inward.

entries.yo: O si ṣe iboju alaro, ati elése aluko ati òdodó, ati ọ̀gbọ daradara, o si ṣiṣẹ awọn kerubu lara wọn.
entries.en: And he made the vail of blue, and purple, and crimson, and fine linen, and wrought cherubims thereon.

entries.yo: O si ṣe ọwọ̀n meji igbọnwọ marundilogoji ni giga niwaju ile na, ati ipari ti mbẹ lori ọkọkan wọn si jẹ igbọnwọ marun.
entries.en: Also he made before the house two pillars of thirty and five cubits high, and the chapiter that was on the top of each of them was five cubits.

entries.yo: O si ṣe ẹ̀wọn ninu ibi-idahùn na, o si fi wọn si ori awọn ọwọ̀n na: o si ṣe awọn pomegranate ọgọrun, o si fi wọn si ara ẹ̀wọn na.
entries.en: And he made chains, as in the oracle, and put them on the heads of the pillars; and made an hundred pomegranates, and put them on the chains.

entries.yo: O si gbé awọn ọwọ̀n na ro niwaju ile Ọlọrun, ọkan li apa ọtún, ati ekeji li apa òsi, o si pe orukọ eyi ti mbẹ li apa ọtún ni Jakini, ati orukọ eyi ti mbẹ li apa òsi ni Boasi.
entries.en: And he reared up the pillars before the temple, one on the right hand, and the other on the left; and called the name of that on the right hand Jachin, and the name of that on the left Boaz.

entries.yo: O si ṣe pẹpẹ idẹ kan, ogún igbọnwọ ni gigùn rẹ̀, ogún igbọnwọ si ni ibu rẹ̀, ati igbọnwọ mẹwa ni giga rẹ̀.
entries.en: Moreover he made an altar of brass, twenty cubits the length thereof, and twenty cubits the breadth thereof, and ten cubits the height thereof.

entries.yo: O si ṣe agbada didà nla, igbọnwọ mẹwa lati eti kan de eti ekeji, o ṣe birikiti, igbọnwọ marun si ni giga rẹ̀; okùn ọgbọ̀n igbọ̀nwọ li o si yi i kakiri:
entries.en: Also he made a molten sea of ten cubits from brim to brim, round in compass, and five cubits the height thereof; and a line of thirty cubits did compass it round about.

entries.yo: Aworan malu si wà labẹ rẹ̀ yi i kakiri, nwọn si lọ yi agbada nla na kakiri: igbọnwọ mẹwa yi i ka, ọwọ́ meji malu li a dà ni didà wọn kan.
entries.en: And under it was the similitude of oxen, which did compass it round about: ten in a cubit, compassing the sea round about. Two rows of oxen were cast, when it was cast.

entries.yo: O duro lori malu mejila wọnni, mẹta nwò iha ariwa, ati mẹta nwò iwọ-õrun, ati mẹta nwò gusu ati mẹta nwò iha ilà-orun: a si gbé agbada na ka ori wọn, gbogbo iha ẹhin wọn si wà ninu.
entries.en: It stood upon twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east: and the sea was set above upon them, and all their hinder parts were inward.

entries.yo: O si nipọn to ibu atẹlẹwọ, a si fi itanna lili ṣiṣẹ eti rẹ̀ gẹgẹ bi eti ago, o si gbà, o si da ẹgbẹdogun ìwọn bati duro.
entries.en: And the thickness of it was an handbreadth, and the brim of it like the work of the brim of a cup, with flowers of lilies; and it received and held three thousand baths.

entries.yo: O ṣe agbada mẹwa pẹlu, o si fi marun si apa ọtún, ati marun si apa òsi, lati wẹ̀ ninu wọn: iru nkan ti nwọn fi nrubọ sisun ni nwọn nwẹ̀ ninu wọn; ṣugbọn agbada na ni fun awọn alufa lati ma wẹ̀.
entries.en: He made also ten lavers, and put five on the right hand,and five on the left, to wash in them: such things as they offered for the burnt offering they washed in them; but the sea was for the priests to wash in.

entries.yo: O si ṣe ọpa-fitila wura mẹwa gẹgẹ bi apẹrẹ wọn, o si fi wọn sinu tempili, marun li apa ọtún, ati marun li apa òsi.
entries.en: And he made ten candlesticks of gold according to their form, and set them in the temple, five on the right hand, and five on the left.

entries.yo: O si ṣe tabili mẹwa, o si fi sinu tempili, marun li apa ọtún, ati marun li apa òsi. O si ṣe ọgọrun ọpọ́n wura.
entries.en: He made also ten tables, and placed them in the temple, five on the right side, and five on the left. And he made an hundred basons of gold.

entries.yo: O ṣe agbala awọn alufa pẹlu, ati agbala nla, ati ilẹkun fun agbala nla na, o si fi idẹ bo awẹ meji ilẹkun wọn.
entries.en: Furthermore he made the court of the priests, and the great court, and doors for the court, and overlaid the doors of them with brass.

entries.yo: O si fi agbada na si apa ọtún igun ile ila-õrun, si idojukọ gusu.
entries.en: And he set the sea on the right side of the east end, over against the south.

entries.yo: Huramu si ṣe ikoko, ati ọkọ́ ati ọpọ́n. Huramu si pari iṣẹ na ti o ni iṣe fun Solomoni ọba ni ile Ọlọrun;
entries.en: And Huram made the pots, and the shovels, and the basons. And Huram finished the work that he was to make for king Solomon for the house of God;

entries.yo: Ọwọ̀n meji ati ọta, ati ọpọ́n ti o wà li ori ọwọ̀n mejeji na, ati iṣẹ ẹ̀wọn meji lati bo ọta meji ti ọpọ́n na, ti o wà li ori awọn ọwọ̀n na;
entries.en: To wit, the two pillars, and the pommels, and the chapiters which were on the top of the two pillars, and the two wreaths to cover the two pommels of the chapiters which were on the top of the pillars;

entries.yo: Ati irinwo pomegranate li ara iṣẹ ẹ̀wọn meji na, ẹsẹ meji pomegranate li ara iṣẹ ẹ̀wọn kan, lati bo ọta meji na ti ọpọ́n ti o wà lori awọn ọwọ̀n na.
entries.en: And four hundred pomegranates on the two wreaths; two rows of pomegranates on each wreath, to cover the two pommels of the chapiters which were upon the pillars.

entries.yo: O si ṣe ijoko, o si ṣe agbada li ori awọn ijoko na.
entries.en: He made also bases, and lavers made he upon the bases;

entries.yo: Agbada nla kan, ati malu mejila labẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: One sea, and twelve oxen under it.

entries.yo: Ati ikoko ati ọkọ́, ati kọkọrọ-ẹran, ati gbogbo ohun-elo ni Huramu-Abi fi idẹ didan ṣe fun Solomoni ọba, fun ile Oluwa.
entries.en: The pots also, and the shovels, and the fleshhooks, and all their instruments, did Huram his father make to king Solomon for the house of the LORD of bright brass.

entries.yo: Ni pẹtẹlẹ Jordani ni ọba dà wọn, ni ilẹ amọ̀ li agbedemeji Sukkoti ati Seredata.
entries.en: In the plain of Jordan did the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zeredathah.

entries.yo: Bayi ni Solomoni ṣe gbogbo ohun-elo wọnyi li ọ̀pọlọpọ: nitori ti a kò le mọ̀ ìwọn idẹ na.
entries.en: Thus Solomon made all these vessels in great abundance: for the weight of the brass could not be found out.

entries.yo: Solomoni si ṣe gbogbo ohun-elo ti iṣe ti ile Ọlọrun, pẹpẹ wura pẹlu, ati awọn tabili lori eyi ti akara ifihan wà;
entries.en: And Solomon made all the vessels that were for the house of God, the golden altar also, and the tables whereon the shewbread was set;

entries.yo: Ọpa-fitila pẹlu ati fitila wọn, ki nwọn ki o ma jo gẹgẹ bi aṣẹ niwaju ibi-mimọ́-jùlọ, jẹ wura daradara.
entries.en: Moreover the candlesticks with their lamps, that they should burn after the manner before the oracle, of pure gold;

entries.yo: Ati itanna, ati fitila ati ẹ̀mu li o fi wura ṣe; gbogbo eyi ni wura daradara;
entries.en: And the flowers, and the lamps, and the tongs, made he of gold, and that perfect gold;

entries.yo: Ati alumagaji fitila, ati awo-koto, ati ṣibi ati awo-koto turari, wura daradara ni: ati ọ̀na iwọle, awẹ ilẹkun rẹ̀ ti inu lọhun fun ibi-mimọ́-jùlọ, ati awọn ilẹkun fun ile na, ani tempili, wura ni.
entries.en: And the snuffers, and the basons, and the spoons, and the censers, of pure gold: and the entry of the house, the inner doors thereof for the most holy place, and the doors of the house of the temple, were of gold.

entries.yo: BAYI ni gbogbo iṣẹ ti Solomoni ṣe fun ile Oluwa pari: Solomoni si mu gbogbo nkan ti Dafidi baba rẹ̀ ti yà si mimọ́ wá sinu rẹ̀; ati fadakà, ati wura, ati gbogbo ohun-elo, li o fi sinu iṣura ile Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Thus all the work that Solomon made for the house of the LORD was finished: and Solomon brought in all the things that David his father had dedicated; and the silver, and the gold, and all the instruments, put he among the treasures of the house of God.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Solomoni pe awọn àgbagba Israeli jọ, ati gbogbo olori awọn baba awọn ọmọ Israeli si Jerusalemu, lati mu apoti-ẹri majẹmu Oluwa gòke lati ilu Dafidi wá, ti iṣe Sioni.
entries.en: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel, and all the heads of the tribes, the chief of the fathers of the children of Israel, unto Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of the city of David, which is Zion.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn ọkunrin Israeli si pejọ sọdọ ọba li ajọ, eyi ni oṣù keji.
entries.en: Wherefore all the men of Israel assembled themselves unto the king in the feast which was in the seventh month.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn àgbagba Israeli si wá; awọn ọmọ Lefi si gbé apoti-ẹri na.
entries.en: And all the elders of Israel came; and the Levites took up the ark.

entries.yo: Nwọn si gbé apoti-ẹri na gòke, ati agọ ajọ, ati gbogbo ohun-elo mimọ́ ti o wà ninu agọ, wọnyi ni awọn alufa ati awọn ọmọ Lefi mu gòke wá.
entries.en: And they brought up the ark, and the tabernacle of the congregation, and all the holy vessels that were in the tabernacle, these did the priests and the Levites bring up.

entries.yo: Solomoni ọba, ati gbogbo ijọ enia Israeli ti o pejọ si ọdọ rẹ̀, wà niwaju apoti-ẹrí na, nwọn si fi agutan ati malu rubọ, ti a kò le kà, bẹ̃ni a kò le mọ̀ iye wọn fun ọ̀pọlọpọ.
entries.en: Also king Solomon, and all the congregation of Israel that were assembled unto him before the ark, sacrificed sheep and oxen, which could not be told nor numbered for multitude.

entries.yo: Awọn alufa si gbé apoti-ẹri ti majẹmu Oluwa wá si ipò rẹ̀, si ibi-idahùn ile na, sinu ibi-mimọ́-jùlọ, labẹ iyẹ awọn kerubu:
entries.en: And the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of the LORD unto his place, to the oracle of the house, into the most holy place, even under the wings of the cherubims:

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni awọn kerubu nà iyẹ wọn bò ibi apoti-ẹri na, awọn kerubu si bò apoti-ẹri na, ati awọn ọpa rẹ̀ lati òke wá.
entries.en: For the cherubims spread forth their wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubims covered the ark and the staves thereof above.

entries.yo: Ọpa rẹ̀ wọnni si gùn tobẹ̃, ti a fi ri ori awọn ọpa na lati ibi apoti-ẹri na niwaju ibi mimọ́-jùlọ na, ṣugbọn a kò ri wọn li ode. Nibẹ li o si wà titi di oni yi.
entries.en: And they drew out the staves of the ark, that the ends of the staves were seen from the ark before the oracle; but they were not seen without. And there it is unto this day.

entries.yo: Kò si ohun kan ninu apoti-ẹri na bikòṣe walã meji ti Mose fi sinu rẹ̀ ni Horebu, nigbati Oluwa fi ba awọn ọmọ Israeli dá majẹmu, nigbati nwọn ti Egipti jade wá.
entries.en: There was nothing in the ark save the two tables which Moses put therein at Horeb, when the LORD made a covenant with the children of Israel, when they came out of Egypt.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati awọn alufa ti ibi mimọ́ jade wá; (nitori gbogbo awọn alufa ti a ri li a yà si mimọ́, nwọn kò si kiyesi ipa wọn nigbana:
entries.en: And it came to pass, when the priests were come out of the holy place: (for all the priests that were present were sanctified, and did not then wait by course:

entries.yo: Awon ọmọ Lefi pẹlu ti iṣe akọrin, gbogbo wọn ti Asafu, ti Hemani, ti Jedutuni, pẹlu awọn ọmọ wọn ati awọn arakunrin wọn, nwọn wọ ọ̀gbọ funfun, nwọn ni kimbali, ati ohun-elo orin, ati duru, nwọn si duro ni igun ila-õrun pẹpẹ na, ati pẹlu wọn, ìwọn ọgọfa alufa ti nwọn nfún ipè:)
entries.en: Also the Levites which were the singers, all of them of Asaph, of Heman, of Jeduthun, with their sons and their brethren, being arrayed in white linen, having cymbals and psalteries and harps, stood at the east end of the altar, and with them an hundred and twenty priests sounding with trumpets:)

entries.yo: O si ṣe bi ẹnipe ẹnikan, nigbati a gbọ́ ohùn awọn afunpè ati awọn akọrin, bi ohùn kan lati ma yìn, ati lati ma dupẹ fun Oluwa; nigbati nwọn si gbé ohùn wọn soke pẹlu ipè ati kimbali, ati ohun-elo orin, lati ma yìn Oluwa pe, O ṣeun; ãnu rẹ̀ si duro lailai: nigbana ni ile na kún fun awọsanmọ, ani ile Oluwa;
entries.en: It came even to pass, as the trumpeters and singers were as one, to make one sound to be heard in praising and thanking the LORD; and when they lifted up their voice with the trumpets and cymbals and instruments of musick, and praised the LORD, saying, For he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever: that then the house was filled with a cloud, even the house of the LORD;

entries.yo: Tobẹ̃ ti awọn alufa kò le duro lati ṣiṣẹ ìsin nitori awọsanmọ na: nitori ogo Oluwa kún ile Ọlọrun.
entries.en: So that the priests could not stand to minister by reason of the cloud: for the glory of the LORD had filled the house of God.

entries.yo: NIGBANA ni Solomoni wipe, Oluwa ti wipe, on o ma gbe inu òkunkun biribiri.
entries.en: Then said Solomon, The LORD hath said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi ti kọ́ ile ibugbe kan fun ọ, ati ibi kan fun ọ lati ma gbe titi lai.
entries.en: But I have built an house of habitation for thee, and a place for thy dwelling for ever.

entries.yo: Ọba si yi oju Rẹ̀, o si fi ibukún fun gbogbo ijọ awọn enia Israeli; gbogbo ijọ awọn enia Israeli si dide duro.
entries.en: And the king turned his face, and blessed the whole congregation of Israel: and all the congregation of Israel stood.

entries.yo: O si wipe, Olubukún li Oluwa Ọlọrun Israeli, ti o ti fi ọwọ rẹ̀ mu eyi ti o ti fi ẹnu rẹ̀ sọ fun Dafidi baba mi ṣẹ, wipe,
entries.en: And he said, Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, who hath with his hands fulfilled that which he spake with his mouth to my father David, saying,

entries.yo: Lati ọjọ ti emi ti mu awọn enia mi jade kuro ni ilẹ Egipti, emi kò yàn ilu kan ninu gbogbo ẹ̀ya Israeli lati kọ́ ile, ki orukọ mi ki o wà nibẹ; bẹ̃ni emi kò yàn ọkunrin kan lati ṣe olori Israeli awọn enia mi:
entries.en: Since the day that I brought forth my people out of the land of Egypt I chose no city among all the tribes of Israel to build an house in, that my name might be there; neither chose I any man to be a ruler over my people Israel:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi ti yàn Jerusalemu, ki orukọ mi ki o le wà nibẹ; mo si ti yàn Dafidi lati wà lori Israeli, enia mi.
entries.en: But I have chosen Jerusalem, that my name might be there; and have chosen David to be over my people Israel.

entries.yo: O si ti wà li ọkàn Dafidi, baba mi, lati kọ́ ile fun orukọ Oluwa Ọlọrun Israeli:
entries.en: Now it was in the heart of David my father to build an house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.

entries.yo: Oluwa si sọ fun Dafidi baba mi pe, nitoriti o wà li ọkàn rẹ lati kọ́ ile fun orukọ mi, iwọ ṣeun li eyiti o wà li ọkàn rẹ.
entries.en: But the LORD said to David my father, Forasmuch as it was in thine heart to build an house for my name, thou didst well in that it was in thine heart:

entries.yo: Sibẹ iwọ kò gbọdọ kọ́ ile na; ṣugbọn ọmọ rẹ ti yio jade ti inu rẹ wá ni yio kọ́ ile na fun orukọ mi.
entries.en: Notwithstanding thou shalt not build the house; but thy son which shall come forth out of thy loins, he shall build the house for my name.

entries.yo: Oluwa si ti mu ọ̀rọ rẹ̀ ṣẹ ti o ti sọ; emi si dide ni ipò Dafidi baba mi, a si gbé mi ka itẹ́ Israeli bi Oluwa ti ṣe ileri, emi si ti kọ́ ile na fun orukọ Oluwa Ọlọrun Israeli.
entries.en: The LORD therefore hath performed his word that he hath spoken: for I am risen up in the room of David my father, and am set on the throne of Israel, as the LORD promised, and have built the house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.

entries.yo: Ati ninu rẹ̀ ni mo fi apoti-ẹri na si, ninu eyiti majẹmu Oluwa wà, ti o ba awọn ọmọ Israeli dá.
entries.en: And in it have I put the ark, wherein is the covenant of the LORD, that he made with the children of Israel.

entries.yo: On si duro niwaju pẹpẹ Oluwa, niwaju gbogbo ijọ enia Israeli, o si tẹ ọwọ rẹ̀ mejeji.
entries.en: And he stood before the altar of the LORD in the presence of all the congregation of Israel, and spread forth his hands:

entries.yo: Nitori Solomoni ṣe aga idẹ kan, igbọnwọ marun ni gigùn, ati igbọnwọ marun ni gbigboro, ati igbọnwọ mẹta ni giga, o si gbé e si ãrin agbala na; lori rẹ̀ li o duro, o si kunlẹ lori ẽkun rẹ̀ niwaju gbogbo ijọ enia Israeli, o si tẹ́ ọwọ rẹ̀ mejeji soke ọrun,
entries.en: For Solomon had made a brasen scaffold, of five cubits long, and five cubits broad, and three cubits high, and had set it in the midst of the court: and upon it he stood, and kneeled down upon his knees before all the congregation of Israel, and spread forth his hands toward heaven,

entries.yo: O si wipe, Oluwa Ọlọrun Israeli, kò si Ọlọrun ti o dabi rẹ li ọrun tabi li aiye: ti npa majẹmu mọ́, ati ãnu fun awọn iranṣẹ rẹ, ti nfi tọkàntọkan wọn rìn niwaju rẹ.
entries.en: And said, O LORD God of Israel, there is no God like thee in the heaven, nor in the earth; which keepest covenant, and shewest mercy unto thy servants, that walk before thee with all their hearts:

entries.yo: Iwọ ti o ti ba iranṣẹ rẹ Dafidi baba mi, pa eyi ti iwọ ti ṣe ileri fun u mọ́; ti iwọ si ti fi ẹnu rẹ sọ, ti iwọ si ti fi ọwọ rẹ mu u ṣẹ, bi o ti ri loni yi.
entries.en: Thou which hast kept with thy servant David my father that which thou hast promised him; and spakest with thy mouth, and hast fulfilled it with thine hand, as it is this day.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, Oluwa, Ọlọrun Israeli, ba iranṣẹ rẹ Dafidi, baba mi pa eyi ti iwọ ti ṣe ileri fun u mọ́, wipe, A kì yio fẹ ọkunrin kan kù li oju mi lati joko lori itẹ́ Israeli: kiki bi awọn ọmọ rẹ ba kiyesi ọ̀na wọn, lati ma rìn ninu ofin mi, bi iwọ ti rìn niwaju mi.
entries.en: Now therefore, O LORD God of Israel, keep with thy servant David my father that which thou hast promised him, saying, There shall not fail thee a man in my sight to sit upon the throne of Israel; yet so that thy children take heed to their way to walk in my law, as thou hast walked before me.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, Oluwa Ọlọrun Israeli, jẹ ki ọ̀rọ rẹ ki o ṣẹ, ti iwọ ti sọ fun Dafidi, iranṣẹ rẹ,
entries.en: Now then, O LORD God of Israel, let thy word be verified, which thou hast spoken unto thy servant David.

entries.yo: Ni otitọ ni Ọlọrun yio ha ma ba enia gbe li aiye? Kiyesi i, ọrun ati ọrun awọn ọrun kò le gbà ọ; ambọsi ile yi ti emi kọ́!
entries.en: But will God in very deed dwell with men on the earth? behold, heaven and the heaven of heavens cannot contain thee; how much less this house which I have built!

entries.yo: Sibẹ, iwọ ṣe afiyesi adura iranṣẹ rẹ, ati ẹ̀bẹ rẹ̀, Oluwa Ọlọrun mi, lati tẹtisilẹ si ẹkun ati adura ti iranṣẹ rẹ ngbà niwaju rẹ:
entries.en: Have respect therefore to the prayer of thy servant, and to his supplication, O LORD my God, to hearken unto the cry and the prayer which thy servant prayeth before thee:

entries.yo: Ki oju rẹ ki o le ṣí si ile yi lọsan ati loru, ani si ibi ti iwọ ti wipe, iwọ o fi orukọ rẹ sibẹ; lati tẹtisilẹ si adura ti iranṣẹ rẹ ngbà si ibi yi.
entries.en: That thine eyes may be open upon this house day and night, upon the place whereof thou hast said that thou wouldest put thy name there; to hearken unto the prayer which thy servant prayeth toward this place.

entries.yo: Nitorina gbọ́ ẹ̀bẹ iranṣẹ rẹ, ati ti Israeli enia rẹ ti nwọn o ma gbà si ibi yi: iwọ gbọ́ lati ibugbe rẹ wá, ani lati ọrun wá, nigbati iwọ ba gbọ́, ki o si dariji.
entries.en: Hearken therefore unto the supplications of thy servant, and of thy people Israel, which they shall make toward this place: hear thou from thy dwelling place, even from heaven; and when thou hearest, forgive.

entries.yo: Bi ọkunrin kan ba ṣẹ̀ si ẹnikeji rẹ̀, ti a si fi ibura le e lati mu u bura, ti ibura na ba si de iwaju pẹpẹ rẹ ni ile yi;
entries.en: If a man sin against his neighbour, and an oath be laid upon him to make him swear, and the oath come before thine altar in this house;

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ki o gbọ́ lati ọrun wá, ki o si ṣe, ki o si dajọ awọn iranṣẹ rẹ, ni sisan a fun enia buburu, lati mu ọ̀na rẹ̀ pada sori on tikararẹ̀; ati ni didare fun olododo, lati fifun u gẹgẹ bi ododo rẹ̀.
entries.en: Then hear thou from heaven, and do, and judge thy servants, by requiting the wicked, by recompensing his way upon his own head; and by justifying the righteous, by giving him according to his righteousness.

entries.yo: Bi a ba si fọ́ awọn enia rẹ Israeli bajẹ niwaju ọta, nitori ti nwọn ti dẹṣẹ si ọ; ti nwọn ba si pada ti nwọn si jẹwọ orukọ rẹ, ti nwọn si gbadura, ti nwọn si bẹ̀bẹ niwaju rẹ ni ile yi;
entries.en: And if thy people Israel be put to the worse before the enemy, because they have sinned against thee; and shall return and confess thy name, and pray and make supplication before thee in this house;

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ki o gbọ́ lati ọrun wá, ki o si dari ẹ̀ṣẹ Israeli enia rẹ jì, ki o si mu wọn pada wá si ilẹ ti iwọ ti fi fun wọn ati fun awọn baba wọn.
entries.en: Then hear thou from the heavens, and forgive the sin of thy people Israel, and bring them again unto the land which thou gavest to them and to their fathers.

entries.yo: Nigbati a ba se ọrun mọ́ ti kò si sí òjo, nitoriti nwọn ti dẹṣẹ si ọ; ṣugbọn bi nwọn ba gbadura si ibi yi, ti nwọn ba jẹwọ orukọ rẹ, ti nwọn ba yipada kuro ninu ẹ̀ṣẹ wọn, nitoriti iwọ pọn wọn loju.
entries.en: When the heaven is shut up, and there is no rain, because they have sinned against thee; yet if they pray toward this place, and confess thy name, and turn from their sin, when thou dost afflict them;

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ki o gbọ́ li ọrun, ki o si dari ẹ̀ṣẹ awọn iranṣẹ rẹ ji, ati ti Israeli enia rẹ, nigbati iwọ ba ti kọ́ wọn li ọ̀na rere na, ninu eyiti nwọn o ma rìn: ki o si rọ òjo si ilẹ rẹ, ti iwọ ti fi fun awọn enia rẹ ni ini.
entries.en: Then hear thou from heaven, and forgive the sin of thy servants, and of thy people Israel, when thou hast taught them the good way, wherein they should walk; and send rain upon thy land, which thou hast given unto thy people for an inheritance.

entries.yo: Bi ìyan ba mu ni ilẹ, bi àjakalẹ-arun ba wà, bi irẹ̀danu ba wà, tabi eṣú ti njẹrun, bi awọn ọta wọn ba yọ wọn li ẹnu ni ilẹ ilu wọn; oniruru ipọnju tabi oniruru àrun.
entries.en: If there be dearth in the land, if there be pestilence, if there be blasting, or mildew, locusts, or caterpillers; if their enemies besiege them in the cities of their land; whatsoever sore or whatsoever sickness there be:

entries.yo: Adura ki adura, tabi ẹ̀bẹ ki ẹ̀bẹ ti a ba ti ọdọ ẹnikẹni gbà, tabi ọdọ gbogbo Israeli enia rẹ, nigbati olukuluku ba mọ̀ ipọnju rẹ̀, ati ibanujẹ rẹ̀, ti o ba si tẹ́ ọwọ rẹ̀ mejeji siha ile yi:
entries.en: Then what prayer or what supplication soever shall be made of any man, or of all thy people Israel, when every one shall know his own sore and his own grief, and shall spread forth his hands in this house:

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o gbọ́ lati ọrun, ibugbe rẹ wá, ki o si dariji, ki o si san a fun olukuluku gẹgẹ bi gbogbo ọ̀na rẹ̀, bi iwọ ti mọ̀ ọkàn rẹ̀; (nitori iwọ nikanṣoṣo li o mọ̀ ọkàn awọn ọmọ enia:)
entries.en: Then hear thou from heaven thy dwelling place, and forgive, and render unto every man according unto all his ways, whose heart thou knowest; (for thou only knowest the hearts of the children of men:)

entries.yo: Ki nwọn ki o le bẹ̀ru rẹ, lati ma rìn li ọ̀na rẹ, li ọjọ gbogbo ti nwọn o wà ni ilẹ ti iwọ fi fun awọn baba wa.
entries.en: That they may fear thee, to walk in thy ways, so long as they live in the land which thou gavest unto our fathers.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu niti alejo, ti kì iṣe inu Israeli, enia rẹ, ṣugbọn ti o ti ilẹ òkere jade wá nitori orukọ nla rẹ, ati ọwọ agbara rẹ ati ninà apa rẹ; bi nwọn ba wá ti nwọn ba si gbadura siha ile yi:
entries.en: Moreover concerning the stranger, which is not of thy people Israel, but is come from a far country for thy great name's sake, and thy mighty hand, and thy stretched out arm; if they come and pray in this house;

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o gbọ́ lati ọrun, ani lati ibugbe rẹ wá, ki o si ṣe gẹgẹ bi gbogbo eyiti alejo na kepe ọ si; ki gbogbo enia aiye ki o le mọ̀ orukọ rẹ, ki nwọn ki o si le ma bẹ̀ru rẹ̀, bi Israeli enia rẹ, ki nwọn ki o le mọ̀ pe orukọ rẹ li a npè mọ ile yi ti emi kọ́.
entries.en: Then hear thou from the heavens, even from thy dwelling place, and do according to all that the stranger calleth to thee for; that all people of the earth may know thy name, and fear thee, as doth thy people Israel, and may know that this house which I have built is called by thy name.

entries.yo: Bi awọn enia rẹ ba jade lọ si ogun si ọta wọn li ọ̀na ti iwọ o rán wọn, ti nwọn ba si gbadura si ọ, siha ilu yi, ti iwọ ti yàn, ati ile ti emi ti kọ́ fun orukọ rẹ:
entries.en: If thy people go out to war against their enemies by the way that thou shalt send them, and they pray unto thee toward this city which thou hast chosen, and the house which I have built for thy name;

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o gbọ́ adura wọn ati ẹ̀bẹ wọn lati ọrun wa, ki o si mu ọ̀ran wọn duro.
entries.en: Then hear thou from the heavens their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.

entries.yo: Bi nwọn ba ṣẹ̀ si ọ (nitoriti kò si enia kan ti kì iṣẹ̀,) bi iwọ ba si binu si wọn, ti o si fi wọn le awọn ọta lọwọ, ti nwọn ba si kó wọn ni igbekun lọ si ilẹ ti o jìna rére, tabi ti o wà nitosi.
entries.en: If they sin against thee, (for there is no man which sinneth not,) and thou be angry with them, and deliver them over before their enemies, and they carry them away captives unto a land far off or near;

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn, bi nwọn ba rò inu ara wọn wò, ni ilẹ nibiti a gbe kó wọn ni igbekun lọ, ti nwọn ba si yipada, ti nwọn ba si gbadura si ọ li oko ẹrú wọn, wipe, Awa ti dẹṣẹ, awa ti ṣìṣe, awa si ti ṣe buburu;
entries.en: Yet if they bethink themselves in the land whither they are carried captive, and turn and pray unto thee in the land of their captivity, saying, We have sinned, we have done amiss, and have dealt wickedly;

entries.yo: Bi nwọn ba si fi gbogbo aiya ati gbogbo ọkàn wọn yipada si ọ li oko ẹrú wọn, si ibi ti a gbe kó wọn lọ, ti nwọn ba si gbadura siha ilẹ wọn, ti iwọ ti fi fun awọn baba wọn, ati siha ilu na ti iwọ ti yàn, ati siha ile na ti emi ti kọ́ fun orukọ rẹ:
entries.en: If they return to thee with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their captivity, whither they have carried them captives, and pray toward their land, which thou gavest unto their fathers, and toward the city which thou hast chosen, and toward the house which I have built for thy name:

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o gbọ́ adura wọn ati ẹ̀bẹ wọn lati ọrun wá, ani lati ibugbe rẹ wá, ki o si mu ọ̀ran wọn duro, ki o si dari ẹ̀ṣẹ awọn enia rẹ jì ti nwọn ti da si ọ.
entries.en: Then hear thou from the heavens, even from thy dwelling place, their prayer and their supplications, and maintain their cause, and forgive thy people which have sinned against thee.

entries.yo: Nisisiyi Ọlọrun mi, jẹ ki oju rẹ ki o ṣí, ki o si tẹtisilẹ si adura si ihinyi.
entries.en: Now, my God, let, I beseech thee, thine eyes be open, and let thine ears be attent unto the prayer that is made in this place.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, dide, Oluwa Ọlọrun si ibi isimi rẹ, iwọ ati apoti agbara rẹ; jẹ ki a fi igbala wọ̀ awọn alufa rẹ, Oluwa Ọlọrun, ki o si jẹ ki awọn enia ayanfẹ rẹ ki o ma yọ̀ ninu ire.
entries.en: Now therefore arise, O LORD God, into thy resting place, thou, and the ark of thy strength: let thy priests, O LORD God, be clothed with salvation, and let thy saints rejoice in goodness.

entries.yo: Oluwa Ọlọrun, máṣe yi oju ẹni ororo rẹ pada: ranti ãnu fun Dafidi, iranṣẹ rẹ.
entries.en: O LORD God, turn not away the face of thine anointed: remember the mercies of David thy servant.

entries.yo: BI Solomoni si ti pari adura igbà, iná bọ́ lati ọrun wá, o si jo ọrẹ sisun ati ẹbọ na run; ogo Oluwa si kún ile na.
entries.en: Now when Solomon had made an end of praying, the fire came down from heaven, and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices; and the glory of the LORD filled the house.

entries.yo: Awọn alufa kò le wọ̀ inu ile Oluwa, nitori ogo Oluwa kún ile Oluwa.
entries.en: And the priests could not enter into the house of the LORD, because the glory of the LORD had filled the LORD's house.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn ọmọ Israeli si ri bi iná na ti bọ́ silẹ, ati ogo Oluwa sori ile na, nwọn doju wọn bò ilẹ ti a fi okuta tẹ́, nwọn si tẹriba, nwọn si yìn Oluwa, wipe, Nitoriti o ṣeun; nitoriti ãnu rẹ̀ duro lailai.
entries.en: And when all the children of Israel saw how the fire came down, and the glory of the LORD upon the house, they bowed themselves with their faces to the ground upon the pavement, and worshipped, and praised the LORD, saying, For he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever.

entries.yo: Ọba ati awọn enia si rubọ niwaju Oluwa.
entries.en: Then the king and all the people offered sacrifices before the LORD.

entries.yo: Solomoni ọba si rubọ ẹgbã-mọkanla malu ati ọkẹ mẹfa agutan: bẹ̃ni ọba, ati gbogbo awọn enia yà ile Ọlọrun na si mimọ́.
entries.en: And king Solomon offered a sacrifice of twenty and two thousand oxen, and an hundred and twenty thousand sheep: so the king and all the people dedicated the house of God.

entries.yo: Awọn alufa duro lẹnu iṣẹ wọn; awọn ọmọ Lefi pẹlu ohun-ọnà orin Oluwa, ti Dafidi ọba ti ṣe lati yìn Oluwa, nitori ti ãnu rẹ̀ duro lailai, nigbati Dafidi nkọrin iyìn nipa ọwọ wọn; awọn alufa si fùn ipè niwaju wọn, gbogbo Israeli si dide duro.
entries.en: And the priests waited on their offices: the Levites also with instruments of musick of the LORD, which David the king had made to praise the LORD, because his mercy endureth for ever, when David praised by their ministry; and the priests sounded trumpets before them, and all Israel stood.

entries.yo: Solomoni si yà arin agbala na si mimọ́ ti mbẹ niwaju ile Oluwa: nitori nibẹ li o ru ẹbọ ọrẹ sisun, ati ọra ẹbọ alafia, nitori pẹpẹ idẹ ti Solomoni ti ṣe kò le gbà ọrẹ sisun, ati ọrẹ onjẹ ati ọ̀ra na.
entries.en: Moreover Solomon hallowed the middle of the court that was before the house of the LORD: for there he offered burnt offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings, because the brasen altar which Solomon had made was not able to receive the burnt offerings, and the meat offerings, and the fat.

entries.yo: Li akokò na pẹlu Solomoni se àse na ni ijọ meje, ati gbogbo Israeli pẹlu rẹ̀, ijọ enia nlanla, lati ìwọ Hamati titi de odò Egipti.
entries.en: Also at the same time Solomon kept the feast seven days, and all Israel with him, a very great congregation, from the entering in of Hamath unto the river of Egypt.

entries.yo: Ati li ọjọ kẹjọ nwọn ṣe apejọ mimọ́; nitori ti nwọn ṣe ìyasi-mimọ́ pẹpẹ na li ọjọ meje, ati àse na, ọjọ meje.
entries.en: And in the eighth day they made a solemn assembly: for they kept the dedication of the altar seven days, and the feast seven days.

entries.yo: Ati li ọjọ kẹtalelogun oṣù keje, o rán awọn enia pada lọ sinu agọ wọn, pẹlu ayọ̀ ati inudidùn nitori ore-ọfẹ ti Oluwa ti fi hàn fun Dafidi, ati fun Solomoni, ati fun Israeli, enia rẹ̀.
entries.en: And on the three and twentieth day of the seventh month he sent the people away into their tents, glad and merry in heart for the goodness that the LORD had shewed unto David, and to Solomon, and to Israel his people.

entries.yo: Solomoni si pari ile Oluwa, ati ile ọba, ati gbogbo ohun ti o wá si ọkàn Solomoni lati ṣe ninu ile Oluwa, ati ninu ile on tikararẹ̀, o si ṣe e jalẹ.
entries.en: Thus Solomon finished the house of the LORD, and the king's house: and all that came into Solomon's heart to make in the house of the LORD, and in his own house, he prosperously effected.

entries.yo: Oluwa si fi ara hàn Solomoni li oru, o si wi fun u pe, Emi ti gbọ́ adura rẹ, emi si ti yàn ihinyi fun ara mi, fun ile ẹbọ.
entries.en: And the LORD appeared to Solomon by night, and said unto him, I have heard thy prayer, and have chosen this place to myself for an house of sacrifice.

entries.yo: Bi mo ba sé ọrun ti kò ba si òjo, tabi bi emi ba paṣẹ fun eṣú lati jẹ ilẹ na run, tabi bi mo ba rán àjakalẹ-arun si ãrin awọn enia mi;
entries.en: If I shut up heaven that there be no rain, or if I command the locusts to devour the land, or if I send pestilence among my people;

entries.yo: Bi awọn enia mi ti a npè orukọ mi mọ́, ba rẹ̀ ara wọn silẹ, ti nwọn ba si gbadura, ti nwọn ba si wá oju mi, ti nwọn ba si yipada kuro ninu ọ̀na buburu wọn; nigbana ni emi o gbọ́ lati ọrun wá, emi o si dari ẹ̀ṣẹ wọn jì, emi o si wò ilẹ wọn sàn.
entries.en: If my people, which are called by my name, shall humble themselves, and pray, and seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways; then will I hear from heaven, and will forgive their sin, and will heal their land.

entries.yo: Nisisiyi oju mi yio ṣí, eti mi yio si tẹ́ si adura ibi yi.
entries.en: Now mine eyes shall be open, and mine ears attent unto the prayer that is made in this place.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi emi ti yàn, emi si ti yà ile yi si mimọ́, ki orukọ mi ki o le ma wà nibẹ lailai: ati oju mi ati ọkàn mi yio ma wà nibẹ nigbagbogbo.
entries.en: For now have I chosen and sanctified this house, that my name may be there for ever: and mine eyes and mine heart shall be there perpetually.

entries.yo: Ati iwọ, bi iwọ o ba rìn niwaju mi bi Dafidi, baba rẹ ti rìn, ki o si ṣe gẹgẹ bi gbogbo eyiti mo ti pa li aṣẹ fun ọ, bi iwọ o ba si ṣe akiyesi aṣẹ mi ati idajọ mi;
entries.en: And as for thee, if thou wilt walk before me, as David thy father walked, and do according to all that I have commanded thee, and shalt observe my statues and my judgments;

entries.yo: Nigbana ni emi o fi idi itẹ ijọba rẹ múlẹ̀, gẹgẹ bi emi ti ba Dafidi, baba rẹ dá majẹmu, wipe, a kì yio fẹ ẹnikan kù fun ọ ti yio ma ṣe akoso ni Israeli.
entries.en: Then will I stablish the throne of thy kingdom, according as I have covenanted with David thy father, saying, There shall not fail thee a man to be ruler in Israel.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi ẹnyin ba yipada, ti ẹ ba si kọ̀ aṣẹ mi ati ofin mi silẹ, ti emi ti gbé kalẹ niwaju nyin, ti ẹnyin ba si sin ọlọrun miran, ti ẹ si bọ wọn;
entries.en: But if ye turn away, and forsake my statutes and my commandments, which I have set before you, and shall go and serve other gods, and worship them;

entries.yo: Nigbana ni emi o fà wọn tu ti-gbongbo-ti-gbongbo kuro ni ilẹ ti emi ti fi fun wọn; ati ile yi, ti emi ti yà si mimọ́ fun orukọ mi, li emi o ta nù kuro niwaju mi, emi o si sọ ọ di owe, ati ọ̀rọ-ẹgan larin gbogbo orilẹ-ède.
entries.en: Then will I pluck them up by the roots out of my land which I have given them; and this house, which I have sanctified for my name, will I cast out of my sight, and will make it to be a proverb and a byword among all nations.

entries.yo: Ati ile yi, ti o ga, yio di ohun iyanu fun gbogbo ẹni ti o gba ibẹ kọja; tobẹ̃ ti yio si wipe, ẽṣe ti Oluwa fi ṣe bayi si ilẹ yi, ati si ile yi?
entries.en: And this house, which is high, shall be an astonishment to every one that passeth by it; so that he shall say, Why hath the LORD done thus unto this land, and unto this house?

entries.yo: A o si dahùn wipe, Nitori ti nwọn kọ̀ Oluwa Ọlọrun awọn baba wọn silẹ, Ẹniti o mu wọn ti ilẹ Egipti jade wá, ti nwọn si di ọlọrun miran mu, ti nwọn si bọ wọn, ti nwọn si sìn wọn: nitorina li o ṣe mu gbogbo ibi yi ba wọn.
entries.en: And it shall be answered, Because they forsook the LORD God of their fathers, which brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, and laid hold on other gods, and worshipped them, and served them: therefore hath he brought all this evil upon them.

entries.yo: O si ṣe lẹhin ogun ọdun ninu eyi ti Solomoni kọ́ ile Oluwa, ati ile on tikararẹ̀.
entries.en: And it came to pass at the end of twenty years, wherein Solomon had built the house of the LORD, and his own house,

entries.yo: Ni Solomoni kọ́ ilu wọnni ti Huramu fi fun Solomoni, o si mu ki awọn ọmọ Israeli ki o ma gbe ibẹ.
entries.en: That the cities which Huram had restored to Solomon, Solomon built them, and caused the children of Israel to dwell there.

entries.yo: Solomoni si lọ si Hamati-Soba, o si bori rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Solomon went to Hamath-zobah, and prevailed against it.

entries.yo: O si kọ́ Tadmori li aginju, ati gbogbo ilu iṣura ti o kọ́ ni Hamati.
entries.en: And he built Tadmor in the wilderness, and all the store cities, which he built in Hamath.

entries.yo: O kọ́ Bet-Horoni ti òke pẹlu, ati Bet-Horoni ti isalẹ, ilu odi, pẹlu ogiri, ilẹkun, ati ọpa-idabu;
entries.en: Also he built Beth-horon the upper, and Beth-horon the nether, fenced cities, with walls, gates, and bars;

entries.yo: Ati Baalati, ati gbogbo ilu iṣura ti Solomoni ni, ati gbogbo ilu kẹkẹ́, ati ilu ẹlẹṣin, ati gbogbo eyiti Solomoni fẹ lati kọ́ ni Jerusalemu, ati ni Lebanoni ati ni gbogbo ilẹ ijọba rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Baalath, and all the store cities that Solomon had, and all the chariot cities, and the cities of the horsemen, and all that Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and throughout all the land of his dominion.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn enia ti o kù ninu awọn ara Hitti, ati awọn Amori, ati awọn Peresi, ati awọn Hifi ati awọn Jebusi, ti kì iṣe ti inu ọmọ Israeli.
entries.en: As for all the people that were left of the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, which were not of Israel,

entries.yo: Ninu awọn ọmọ wọn, ti a ṣẹkù silẹ lẹhin wọn ni ilẹ na, ti awọn ọmọ Israeli kò run kuro, awọn ni Solomoni bu iṣẹ-ìrú fun titi o fi di oni yi.
entries.en: But of their children, who were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel consumed not, them did Solomon make to pay tribute until this day.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ninu awọn ọmọ Israeli ni Solomoni kò fi ṣe ọmọ-ọdọ fun iṣẹ rẹ̀; nitori awọn li ọga-ogun ati olori awọn onikẹkẹ́ rẹ̀ ati awọn kẹkẹ́ rẹ̀, ati awọn ẹlẹṣin rẹ̀.
entries.en: But of the children of Israel did Solomon make no servants for his work; but they were men of war, and chief of his captains, and captains of his chariots and horsemen.

entries.yo: Awọn wọnyi li olori awọn alaṣẹ Solomoni ọba, adọtalerugba ti nṣakoso lori awọn enia.
entries.en: And these were the chief of king Solomon's officers, even two hundred and fifty, that bare rule over the people.

entries.yo: Solomoni si mu ọmọbinrin Farao gòke lati ilu Dafidi wá si ile ti o kọ́ fun u; nitori ti o wipe, Ni temi, obinrin kan kì yio gbe inu ile Dafidi, ọba Israeli, nitori mimọ́ ni ibi ti apoti-ẹri Oluwa ti de.
entries.en: And Solomon brought up the daughter of Pharaoh out of the city of David unto the house that he had built for her: for he said, My wife shall not dwell in the house of David king of Israel, because the places are holy, whereunto the ark of the LORD hath come.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Solomoni ru ẹbọ ọrẹ-sisun si Oluwa lori pẹpẹ Oluwa, ti o ti tẹ niwaju iloro na.
entries.en: Then Solomon offered burnt offerings unto the LORD on the altar of the LORD, which he had built before the porch,

entries.yo: Ani nipa ilana ojojumọ, lati ma rubọ gẹgẹ bi aṣẹ Mose, li ọjọjọ isimi, ati li oṣoṣu titun, ati ajọ mimọ́, lẹ̃mẹta li ọdun, ani li ajọ aiwukara, li ajọ ọsẹ-meje, ati li ajọ ipagọ.
entries.en: Even after a certain rate every day, offering according to the commandment of Moses, on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the solemn feasts, three times in the year, even in the feast of unleavened bread, and in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of tabernacles.

entries.yo: O si yàn ipa awọn alufa, gẹgẹ bi ilana Dafidi baba rẹ̀, si ìsin wọn, ati awọn ọmọ Lefi si iṣẹ wọn, lati ma yìn, ati lati ma ṣe iranṣẹ niwaju awọn alufa, bi ilana ojojumọ: ati awọn adèna pẹlu ni ipa ti wọn li olukuluku ẹnu-ọ̀na: nitori bẹ̃ni Dafidi, enia Ọlọrun, ti pa a li aṣẹ.
entries.en: And he appointed, according to the order of David his father, the courses of the priests to their service, and the Levites to their charges, to praise and minister before the priests, as the duty of every day required: the porters also by their courses at every gate: for so had David the man of God commanded.

entries.yo: Nwọn kò si yà kuro ninu ilana ọba nipa ti awọn alufa, ati awọn ọmọ Lefi niti olukuluku ọ̀ran, ati niti iṣura.
entries.en: And they departed not from the commandment of the king unto the priests and Levites concerning any matter, or concerning the treasures.

entries.yo: Gbogbo iṣẹ Solomoni li a ti pese silẹ bayi de ọjọ ifi-ipilẹ ile Oluwa le ilẹ titi o fi pari. A si pari ile Oluwa.
entries.en: Now all the work of Solomon was prepared unto the day of the foundation of the house of the LORD, and until it was finished. So the house of the LORD was perfected.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Solomoni lọ si Esion-Geberi, ati si Eloti, ati si eti okun ni ilẹ Edomu.
entries.en: Then went Solomon to Ezion-geber, and to Eloth, at the sea side in the land of Edom.

entries.yo: Huramu si fi ọkọ̀ ranṣẹ si i, nipa ọwọ awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀, ati awọn iranṣẹ ti o moye okun; nwọn si ba awọn iranṣẹ Solomoni lọ si Ofiri, lati ibẹ ni nwọn mu ãdọta-le-ni-irinwo talenti wura wá, nwọn si mu wọn tọ̀ Solomoni ọba wá.
entries.en: And Huram sent him by the hands of his servants ships, and servants that had knowledge of the sea; and they went with the servants of Solomon to Ophir, and took thence four hundred and fifty talents of gold, and brought them to king Solomon.

entries.yo: NIGBATI ayaba Ṣeba gbọ́ òkiki Solomoni, o wá lati fi àlọ dan Solomoni wò ni Jerusalemu, pẹlu ẹgbẹ́ nlanla, ati ibakasiẹ ti o ru turari, ati wura li ọ̀pọlọpọ ati okuta iyebiye; nigbati o si de ọdọ Solomoni, o ba a sọ ohun gbogbo ti o wà li ọkàn rẹ̀.
entries.en: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon, she came to prove Solomon with hard questions at Jerusalem, with a very great company, and camels that bare spices, and gold in abundance, and precious stones: and when she was come to Solomon, she communed with him of all that was in her heart.

entries.yo: Solomoni si dahùn gbogbo ibère rẹ̀: kò si si ohun kan ti o pamọ fun Solomoni ti kò sọ fun u,
entries.en: And Solomon told her all her questions: and there was nothing hid from Solomon which he told her not.

entries.yo: Nigbati ayaba Ṣeba si ti ri ọgbọ́n Solomoni, ati ile ti o ti kọ́,
entries.en: And when the queen of Sheba had seen the wisdom of Solomon, and the house that he had built,

entries.yo: Ati onjẹ tabili rẹ̀, ati ijoko awọn ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ̀, ati iduro awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀, ati aṣọ-wiwọ̀ wọn; ati awọn agbọti rẹ̀ pẹlu aṣọ-wiwọ̀ wọn, ati àtẹgun ti o mba gòke lọ si ile Oluwa; kò si kù agbara kan ninu rẹ̀ mọ.
entries.en: And the meat of his table, and the sitting of his servants, and the attendance of his ministers, and their apparel; his cupbearers also, and their apparel; and his ascent by which he went up into the house of the LORD; there was no more spirit in her.

entries.yo: O si wi fun ọba pe, otitọ ni ọ̀rọ ti mo gbọ́ ni ilẹ mi niti iṣe rẹ, ati ọgbọ́n rẹ:
entries.en: And she said to the king, It was a true report which I heard in mine own land of thine acts, and of thy wisdom:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi kò gba ọ̀rọ wọn gbọ́, titi mo fi de, ti oju mi si ti ri i; si kiyesi i, a kò rò idaji titobi ọgbọ́n rẹ fun mi; nitori ti iwọ kọja òkiki ti mo ti gbọ́.
entries.en: Howbeit I believed not their words, until I came, and mine eyes had seen it: and, behold, the one half of the greatness of thy wisdom was not told me: for thou exceedest the fame that I heard.

entries.yo: Ibukún ni fun awọn enia rẹ, ibukún si ni fun awọn iranṣẹ rẹ wọnyi, ti nduro nigbagbogbo niwaju rẹ, ti o si ngbọ́ ọgbọ́n rẹ.
entries.en: Happy are thy men, and happy are these thy servants, which stand continually before thee, and hear thy wisdom.

entries.yo: Olubukún li Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ, ti o fẹran rẹ lati gbé ọ ka ori itẹ́ rẹ̀ lati ṣe ọba fun Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ: nitoriti Ọlọrun rẹ fẹran Israeli lati fi idi wọn kalẹ lailai, nitorina ni o ṣe fi ọ jọba lori wọn, lati ṣe idajọ ati otitọ.
entries.en: Blessed be the LORD thy God, which delighted in thee to set thee on his throne, to be king for the LORD thy God: because thy God loved Israel, to establish them for ever, therefore made he thee king over them, to do judgment and justice.

entries.yo: O si fun ọba li ọgọfa talenti wura, ati turari lọpọlọpọ, ati okuta iyebiye: bẹ̃ni kò ti isi iru turari gẹgẹ bi eyiti ayaba Ṣeba fun Solomoni ọba.
entries.en: And she gave the king an hundred and twenty talents of gold, and of spices great abundance, and precious stones: neither was there any such spice as the queen of Sheba gave king Solomon.

entries.yo: Awọn iranṣẹ Huramu pẹlu, ati awọn iranṣẹ Solomoni ti o mu wura Ofiri wá, si mu igi-algumu, ati okuta iyebiye wá pẹlu.
entries.en: And the servants also of Huram, and the servants of Solomon, which brought gold from Ophir, brought algum trees and precious stones.

entries.yo: Ọba si fi igi-algumu na ṣe àtẹgun ni ile Oluwa, ati ni ile ọba, ati duru ati ohun ọ̀na-orin fun awọn akọrin: a kò si ri iru bẹ̃ ri ni ilẹ Juda.
entries.en: And the king made of the algum trees terraces to the house of the LORD, and to the king's palace, and harps and psalteries for singers: and there were none such seen before in the land of Judah.

entries.yo: Solomoni ọba si fun ayaba Ṣeba li ohun gbogbo ti o wù u, ohunkohun ti o bère, li aika eyiti o mu wa fun ọba. Bẹ̃ni o yipada, o si lọ si ilẹ rẹ̀, ati on ati awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And king Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatsoever she asked, beside that which she had brought unto the king. So she turned, and went away to her own land, she and her servants.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi ìwọn wura ti o de fun Solomoni li ọdun kan ni ọtalelẹgbẹta o le mẹfa talenti wura.
entries.en: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred and threescore and six talents of gold;

entries.yo: Laika eyiti awọn oniṣowo ati awọn èro mu wá. Ati awọn ọba Arabia, ati awọn bãlẹ ilẹ na nmu wura ati fadakà tọ̀ Solomoni wá.
entries.en: Beside that which chapmen and merchants brought. And all the kings of Arabia and governors of the country brought gold and silver to Solomon.

entries.yo: Solomoni ọba si ṣe igba asà wura lilù: asà kan gba ẹgbẹta ṣekeli wura lilù.
entries.en: And king Solomon made two hundred targets of beaten gold: six hundred shekels of beaten gold went to one target.

entries.yo: Ọdunrun apata wura lilù li o si ṣe; apata kan gbà ọ̃dunrun ṣekeli wura: ọba si fi wọn sinu ile igbo Lebanoni.
entries.en: And three hundred shields made he of beaten gold: three hundred shekels of gold went to one shield. And the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.

entries.yo: Ọba si ṣe itẹ́ ehin-erin nla kan, o si fi wura daradara bò o.
entries.en: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with pure gold.

entries.yo: Àtẹgun mẹfa ni itẹ́ na ni, pẹlu apoti-itisẹ wura kan, ti a dè mọ itẹ́ na, ati irọpa ni iha mejeji ibi ijoko na, kiniun meji si duro lẹba awọn irọpa na.
entries.en: And there were six steps to the throne, with a footstool of gold, which were fastened to the throne, and stays on each side of the sitting place, and two lions standing by the stays:

entries.yo: Kiniun mejila si duro lori atẹgun mẹfẹfa na, ni iha ekini ati ni iha ekeji. A kò ṣe iru rẹ̀ ri ni gbogbo ijọba.
entries.en: And twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps. There was not the like made in any kingdom.

entries.yo: Ati gbogbo ohun-elo mimu Solomoni ọba jẹ wura, ati gbogbo ohun-elo ile igbo Lebanoni, wura daradara ni: kò si ti fadakà; a kò kà fadakà si nkankan li ọjọ Solomoni.
entries.en: And all the drinking vessels of king Solomon were of gold, and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were of pure gold: none were of silver; it was not any thing accounted of in the days of Solomon.

entries.yo: Nitori awọn ọkọ̀ ọba nlọ si Tarṣiṣi pẹlu awọn iranṣẹ Huramu; ẹ̃kan li ọdun mẹta li awọn ọkọ̀ Tarṣiṣi ide, nwọn nmu wura, ati fadakà, ati ehin-erin, ati inaki, ati ẹiyẹ-ologe wá.
entries.en: For the king's ships went to Tarshish with the servants of Huram: every three years once came the ships of Tarshish bringing gold, and silver, ivory, and apes, and peacocks.

entries.yo: Solomoni ọba si tobi jù gbogbo ọba aiye lọ li ọrọ̀ ati li ọgbọn.
entries.en: And king Solomon passed all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn ọba aiye si nwá oju Solomoni, lati gbọ́ ọgbọ́n rẹ̀ ti Ọlọrun ti fi si i li ọkàn.
entries.en: And all the kings of the earth sought the presence of Solomon, to hear his wisdom, that God had put in his heart.

entries.yo: Olukuluku si mu ọrẹ tirẹ̀ wá, ohun-elo fadakà ati ohun-elo wura, ati aṣọ ibora, ihamọra, ati turari, ẹṣin, ati ibaka, iye kan li ọdọdun.
entries.en: And they brought every man his present, vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and raiment, harness, and spices, horses, and mules, a rate year by year.

entries.yo: Solomoni si ni ẹgbaji ile fun ẹṣin ati kẹkẹ́, ati ẹgbafa ẹlẹṣin, ti o fi si awọn ilu kẹkẹ́, ati ọdọ ọba ni Jerusalemu.
entries.en: And Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen; whom he bestowed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.

entries.yo: O si jọba lori gbogbo awọn ọba lati odò (Euferate) titi de ilẹ awọn ara Filistia ati de àgbegbe Egipti.
entries.en: And he reigned over all the kings from the river even unto the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Egypt.

entries.yo: Ọba si sọ fadakà dabi okuta ni Jerusalemu, ati igi-kedari li o si ṣe bi sikamore, ti o wà ni pẹtẹlẹ li ọ̀pọlọpọ.
entries.en: And the king made silver in Jerusalem as stones, and cedar trees made he as the sycomore trees that are in the low plains in abundance.

entries.yo: Nwon si mu ẹṣin tọ̀ Solomoni lati Egipti wá, ati lati ilẹ gbogbo.
entries.en: And they brought unto Solomon horses out of Egypt, and out of all lands.

entries.yo: Ati iyokù iṣe Solomoni ti iṣaju ati ti ikẹhin, a kọ ha kọ wọn sinu iwe Natani woli, ati sinu asọtẹlẹ Ahijah, ara Ṣilo, ati sinu iran Iddo, ariran, sipa Jeroboamu, ọmọ Nebati.
entries.en: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, first and last, are they not written in the book of Nathan the prophet, and in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite, and in the visions of Iddo the seer against Jeroboam the son of Nebat?

entries.yo: Solomoni si jọba ni Jerusalemu lori gbogbo Israeli li ogoji ọdun.
entries.en: And Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years.

entries.yo: Solomoni si sùn pẹlu awọn baba rẹ̀, a si sìn i ni ilu Dafidi baba rẹ̀: Rehoboamu, ọmọ rẹ̀ si jọba ni ipò rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Solomon slept with his fathers, and he was buried in the city of David his father: and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead.

entries.yo: REHOBOAMU si lọ si Ṣekemu: nitori gbogbo Israeli wá si Ṣekemu lati fi i jẹ ọba.
entries.en: And Rehoboam went to Shechem: for to Shechem were all Israel come to make him king.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati Jeroboamu, ọmọ Nebati gbọ́, on si wà ni Egipti nibiti o ti salọ kuro niwaju Solomoni ọba, ni Jeroboamu pada ti Egipti wá.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who was in Egypt, whither he had fled from the presence of Solomon the king, heard it, that Jeroboam returned out of Egypt.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ranṣẹ pè e. Bẹ̃ni Jeroboamu ati gbogbo Israeli wá, nwọn si ba Rehoboamu sọ̀rọ, wipe,
entries.en: And they sent and called him. So Jeroboam and all Israel came and spake to Rehoboam, saying,

entries.yo: Baba rẹ mu ki àjaga wa ki o wuwo: njẹ nisisiyi iwọ ṣẹkù kuro ninu ìsin baba rẹ ti o nira, ati àjaga wuwo rẹ̀ ti o fi bọ̀ wa lọrùn, awa o si ma sìn ọ.
entries.en: Thy father made our yoke grievous: now therefore ease thou somewhat the grievous servitude of thy father, and his heavy yoke that he put upon us, and we will serve thee.

entries.yo: On si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ tun pada tọ̀ mi wá lẹhin ijọ mẹta. Awọn enia na si lọ.
entries.en: And he said unto them, Come again unto me after three days. And the people departed.

entries.yo: Rehoboamu ọba si ba awọn àgbagba ti o ti nduro niwaju Solomoni baba rẹ̀; nigbati o wà lãye dá imọran, wipe, imọran kili ẹnyin dá lati da awọn enia yi lohùn?
entries.en: And king Rehoboam took counsel with the old men that had stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, saying, What counsel give ye me to return answer to this people?

entries.yo: Nwọn si ba a sọ̀rọ pe, bi iwọ ba ṣe ire fun enia yi, ti iwọ ba ṣe ohun ti o wù wọn, ti o ba si sọ̀rọ rere fun wọn, nwọn o ma ṣe iranṣẹ rẹ nigbagbogbo.
entries.en: And they spake unto him, saying, If thou be kind to this people, and please them, and speak good words to them, they will be thy servants for ever.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn o kọ̀ imọran awọn àgbagba ti nwọn ba a dá, o si ba awọn ipẹrẹ ti o dàgba pẹlu rẹ̀ damọran, ti o duro niwaju rẹ̀.
entries.en: But he forsook the counsel which the old men gave him, and took counsel with the young men that were brought up with him, that stood before him.

entries.yo: On si wi fun wọn pe, Imọran kili ẹnyin dá, ki awa ki o le da awọn enia yi lohùn, ti o ba mi sọ̀rọ, wipe, Ṣe ki àjaga ti baba rẹ fi bọ̀ wa lọrùn ki o fuyẹ diẹ?
entries.en: And he said unto them, What advice give ye that we may return answer to this people, which have spoken to me, saying, Ease somewhat the yoke that thy father did put upon us?

entries.yo: Awọn ipẹrẹ ti a tọ́ pẹlu rẹ̀ si sọ fun u wipe, Bayi ni iwọ o da awọn enia na li ohùn ti o sọ fun ọ, wipe, Baba rẹ mu àjaga wa di wuwo, ṣugbọn iwọ ṣe e ki o fẹrẹ diẹ fun wa; bayi ni ki iwọ ki o wi fun wọn, Ọmọdirin mi yio nipọn jù ẹgbẹ́ baba mi lọ.
entries.en: And the young men that were brought up with him spake unto him, saying, Thus shalt thou answer the people that spake unto thee, saying, Thy father made our yoke heavy, but make thou it somewhat lighter for us; thus shalt thou say unto them, My little finger shall be thicker than my father's loins.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi baba mi ti fi àjaga wuwo bọ̀ nyin lọrùn, emi o si fi kún àjaga nyin: baba mi fi paṣan nà nyin, ṣugbọn akẽke li emi o fi nà nyin.
entries.en: For whereas my father put a heavy yoke upon you, I will put more to your yoke: my father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.

entries.yo: Jeroboamu ati gbogbo awọn enia si tọ̀ Rehoboamu wá ni ijọ kẹta gẹgẹ bi ọba ti dá, wipe, Ẹ pada tọ̀ mi wá ni ijọ kẹta.
entries.en: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam on the third day, as the king bade, saying, Come again to me on the third day.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ọba da wọn li ohùn akọ; Rehoboamu ọba si kọ̀ imọran awọn àgbagba silẹ.
entries.en: And the king answered them roughly; and king Rehoboam forsook the counsel of the old men,
