entries.yo: O si da wọn li ohùn gẹgẹ bi imọran awọn ipẹrẹ, wipe, Baba mi mu àjaga nyin ki o wuwo, ṣugbọn emi o fi kún u; baba mi ti fi paṣan nà nyin, ṣugbọn emi o fi akẽke nà nyin.
entries.en: And answered them after the advice of the young men, saying, My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add thereto: my father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni ọba kò si fetisi ti awọn enia na: nitori ṣiṣẹ ọ̀ran na lati ọwọ Ọlọrun wá ni, ki Oluwa ki o le mu ọ̀rọ rẹ̀ ṣẹ, ti o sọ nipasẹ Ahijah, ara Ṣilo fun Jeroboamu, ọmọ Nebati.
entries.en: So the king hearkened not unto the people: for the cause was of God, that the LORD might perform his word, which he spake by the hand of Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

entries.yo: Nigbati gbogbo Israeli ri pe, ọba kọ̀ lati fetisi ti wọn, awọn enia na da ọba lohùn, wipe, Ipin kili a ni ninu Dafidi? awa kò si ni ini kan ninu ọmọ Jesse: Israeli, olukuluku sinu agọ rẹ̀: nisisiyi Dafidi, mã bojuto ile rẹ. Bẹ̃ni gbogbo Israeli lọ sinu agọ wọn,
entries.en: And when all Israel saw that the king would not hearken unto them, the people answered the king, saying, What portion have we in David? and we have none inheritance in the son of Jesse: every man to your tents, O Israel: and now, David, see to thine own house. So all Israel went to their tents.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn ọmọ Israeli ti ngbe ilu Juda wọnni, Rehoboamu jọba lori wọn.
entries.en: But as for the children of Israel that dwelt in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Rehoboamu ọba ran Hadoramu ti iṣe olori iṣẹ-irú; awọn ọmọ Israeli si sọ ọ li okuta, o si kú. Ṣugbọn Rehoboamu ọba yara lati gun kẹkẹ́ rẹ̀ lati salọ si Jerusalemu.
entries.en: Then king Rehoboam sent Hadoram that was over the tribute; and the children of Israel stoned him with stones, that he died. But king Rehoboam made speed to get him up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Israeli si ya kuro lọdọ ile Dafidi titi o fi di oni yi.
entries.en: And Israel rebelled against the house of David unto this day.

entries.yo: NIGBATI Rehoboamu si de Jerusalemu o kó ile Juda ati Benjamini jọ, ọkẹ mẹsan enia ti a yàn, ti nwọn iṣe ologun, lati ba Israeli jà, ki o le mu ijọba na pada bọ̀ sọdọ Rehoboamu.
entries.en: And when Rehoboam was come to Jerusalem, he gathered of the house of Judah and Benjamin an hundred and fourscore thousand chosen men, which were warriors, to fight against Israel, that he might bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ọ̀rọ Oluwa tọ Ṣemaiah, enia Ọlọrun, wá, wipe,
entries.en: But the word of the LORD came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,

entries.yo: Sọ fun Rehoboamu ọmọ Solomoni, ọba Juda, ati fun gbogbo Israeli ni Juda ati Benjamini, wipe,
entries.en: Speak unto Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all Israel in Judah and Benjamin, saying,

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa wi, ẹnyin kò gbọdọ gòke lọ, bẹ̃li ẹnyin kò gbọdọ ba awọn arakunrin nyin jà: ki olukuluku pada si ile rẹ̀: nitori ọ̀ran yi lati ọdọ mi wá ni. Nwọn si gbà ọ̀rọ Oluwa gbọ́, nwọn si yipada kuro lati lọ iba Jeroboamu.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD, Ye shall not go up, nor fight against your brethren: return every man to his house: for this thing is done of me. And they obeyed the words of the LORD, and returned from going against Jeroboam.

entries.yo: Rehoboamu si ngbe Jerusalemu, o si kọ́ ilu olodi ni Juda.
entries.en: And Rehoboam dwelt in Jerusalem, and built cities for defence in Judah.

entries.yo: O kọ́ Betlehemu pẹlu, ati Etamu, ati Tekoa,
entries.en: He built even Bethlehem, and Etam, and Tekoa,

entries.yo: Ati Bet-Suri, ati Soko, ati Adullamu,
entries.en: And Beth-zur, and Shoco, and Adullam,

entries.yo: Ati Gati, ati Mareṣa, ati Sifu,
entries.en: And Gath, and Mareshah, and Ziph,

entries.yo: Ati Adoraimu, ati Lakiṣi, ati Aseki,
entries.en: And Adoraim, and Lachish, and Azekah,

entries.yo: Ati Sora, ati Aijaloni, ati Hebroni, ti o wà ni Juda ati ni Benjamini, awọn ilu olodi.
entries.en: And Zorah, and Aijalon, and Hebron, which are in Judah and in Benjamin fenced cities.

entries.yo: O si mu awọn ilu olodi lagbara, o si fi awọn balogun sinu wọn ati akojọ onjẹ, ati ororo ati ọti-waini.
entries.en: And he fortified the strong holds, and put captains in them, and store of victual, and of oil and wine.

entries.yo: Ati ni olukuluku ilu li o fi asà ati ọ̀kọ si, o si mu wọn lagbara gidigidi, o si ni Juda ati Benjamini labẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And in every several city he put shields and spears, and made them exceeding strong, having Judah and Benjamin on his side.

entries.yo: Ati awọn alufa ati awọn ọmọ Lefi, ti o wà ni gbogbo Israeli, tọ̀ ọ lọ lati gbogbo ibugbe wọn wá.
entries.en: And the priests and the Levites that were in all Israel resorted to him out of all their coasts.

entries.yo: Nitori ti awọn ọmọ Lefi fi ìgberiko wọn silẹ, ati ini wọn, nwọn si lọ si Juda ati Jerusalemu: nitori Jeroboamu ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ ti le wọn kuro lati ma ṣiṣẹ alufa fun Oluwa.
entries.en: For the Levites left their suburbs and their possession, and came to Judah and Jerusalem: for Jeroboam and his sons had cast them off from executing the priest's office unto the LORD:

entries.yo: O si yàn awọn alufa fun ibi-giga wọnni, ati fun awọn ere-obukọ ati fun ẹ̀gbọrọ-malu ti o ti ṣe.
entries.en: And he ordained him priests for the high places, and for the devils, and for the calves which he had made.

entries.yo: Lẹhin wọn iru awọn ti o fi ọkàn wọn si ati wá Oluwa Ọlọrun Israeli lati inu gbogbo awọn ẹ̀ya Israeli wá, si wá si Jerusalemu, lati ṣe irubọ si Oluwa Ọlọrun awọn baba wọn.
entries.en: And after them out of all the tribes of Israel such as set their hearts to seek the LORD God of Israel came to Jerusalem, to sacrifice unto the LORD God of their fathers.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni nwọn si mu ijọba Juda lagbara, nwọn mu ki Rehoboamu, ọmọ Solomoni ki o lagbara li ọdun mẹta: nitori li ọdun mẹta ni nwọn rìn li ọ̀na Dafidi ati Solomoni.
entries.en: So they strengthened the kingdom of Judah, and made Rehoboam the son of Solomon strong, three years: for three years they walked in the way of David and Solomon.

entries.yo: Rehoboamu si mu Mahalati, ọmọbinrin Jerimoti, ọmọ Dafidi, li aya, ati Abihaili, ọmọbinrin Eliabi, ọmọ Jesse:
entries.en: And Rehoboam took him Mahalath the daughter of Jerimoth the son of David to wife, and Abihail the daughter of Eliab the son of Jesse;

entries.yo: Ẹniti o bi ọmọkunrin wọnyi fun u; Jeuṣi, ati Ṣamariah, ati Sahamu.
entries.en: Which bare him children; Jeush, and Shamariah, and Zaham.

entries.yo: Ati lẹhin rẹ̀, o mu Maaka, ọmọbinrin Absalomu ti o bi Abijah fun u, ati Attai, ati Sisa, ati Ṣelomiti.
entries.en: And after her he took Maachah the daughter of Absalom; which bare him Abijah, and Attai, and Ziza, and Shelomith.

entries.yo: Rehoboamu si fẹran Maaka ọmọbinrin Absalomu, jù gbogbo awọn aya rẹ̀ ati àle rẹ̀ lọ: (nitoriti o ni aya mejidilogun, ati ọgọta àle: o si bi ọmọkunrin mejidilọgbọn ati ọgọta ọmọbinrin).
entries.en: And Rehoboam loved Maachah the daughter of Absalom above all his wives and his concubines: (for he took eighteen wives, and threescore concubines; and begat twenty and eight sons, and threescore daughters.)

entries.yo: Rehoboamu si ṣe Abijah, ọmọ Maaka, li olori lati ṣe olori ninu awọn arakunrin rẹ̀: nitori ti o rò lati fi i jọba.
entries.en: And Rehoboam made Abijah the son of Maachah the chief, to be ruler among his brethren: for he thought to make him king.

entries.yo: On si huwà ọlọgbọ́n, o si tú ninu gbogbo awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ ka si gbogbo ilẹ Juda ati Benjamini, si olukuluku ilu olodi: o si fun wọn li onjẹ li ọ̀pọlọpọ. O si fẹran ọ̀pọlọpọ obinrin.
entries.en: And he dealt wisely, and dispersed of all his children throughout all the countries of Judah and Benjamin, unto every fenced city: and he gave them victual in abundance. And he desired many wives.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati Rehoboamu ti fi idi ijọba rẹ̀ mulẹ ti o si ti mu ara rẹ̀ le, o kọ̀ ofin Oluwa silẹ, ati gbogbo Israeli pẹlu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when Rehoboam had established the kingdom, and had strengthened himself, he forsook the law of the LORD, and all Israel with him.

entries.yo: O si ṣe ni ọdun karun Rehoboamu ọba, ni Ṣiṣaki, ọba Egipti, gòke wá si Jerusalemu, nitoriti nwọn ti dẹṣẹ si Oluwa.
entries.en: And it came to pass, that in the fifth year of king Rehoboam Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, because they had transgressed against the LORD,

entries.yo: Pẹlu ẹgbẹfa kẹkẹ́, ati ọkẹ́ mẹta ẹlẹṣin: awọn enia ti o ba a ti Egipti wá kò niye; awọn ara Libia, awọn ara Sukki, ati awọn ara Etiopia.
entries.en: With twelve hundred chariots, and threescore thousand horsemen: and the people were without number that came with him out of Egypt; the Lubims, the Sukkiims, and the Ethiopians.

entries.yo: O si kọ́ awọn ilu olodi ti iṣe ti Juda, o si wá si Jerusalemu.
entries.en: And he took the fenced cities which pertained to Judah, and came to Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Ṣemaiah, woli, tọ̀ Rehoboamu wá, ati awọn ijoye Juda, ti o kojọ pọ̀ si Jerusalemu nitori Ṣiṣaki, o si wi fun wọn pe, Bayi li Oluwa wi, enyin ti kọ̀ mi silẹ, nitorina li emi si ṣe fi nyin silẹ si ọwọ Ṣiṣaki.
entries.en: Then came Shemaiah the prophet to Rehoboam, and to the princes of Judah, that were gathered together to Jerusalem because of Shishak, and said unto them, Thus saith the LORD, Ye have forsaken me, and therefore have I also left you in the hand of Shishak.

entries.yo: Nigbana li awọn ijoye Israeli ati ọba rẹ̀ ara wọn silẹ; nwọn si wipe: Oluwa li olododo!
entries.en: Whereupon the princes of Israel and the king humbled themselves; and they said, The LORD is righteous.

entries.yo: Nigbati Oluwa ri pe nwọn rẹ̀ ara wọn silẹ, ọ̀rọ Oluwa tọ̀ Ṣemaiah wá, wipe, Nwọn ti rẹ̀ ara wọn silẹ; nitorina emi kì o run wọn, ṣugbọn emi o fun wọn ni igbala diẹ: a kì yio dà ibinu mi sori Jerusalemu nipa ọwọ Ṣiṣaki.
entries.en: And when the LORD saw that they humbled themselves, the word of the LORD came to Shemaiah, saying, They have humbled themselves; therefore I will not destroy them, but I will grant them some deliverance; and my wrath shall not be poured out upon Jerusalem by the hand of Shishak.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nwọn o ma ṣe iranṣẹ rẹ̀: ki nwọn ki o le mọ̀ ìsin mi, ati ìsin ijọba ilẹ wọnni.
entries.en: Nevertheless they shall be his servants; that they may know my service, and the service of the kingdoms of the countries.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Ṣiṣaki, ọba Egipti, goke wá si Jerusalemu, o si kó iṣura ile Oluwa lọ, ati iṣura ile ọba; o kó gbogbo rẹ̀: o kó awọn asà wura lọ pẹlu ti Solomoni ti ṣe.
entries.en: So Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, and took away the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king's house; he took all: he carried away also the shields of gold which Solomon had made.

entries.yo: Rehoboamu ọba si ṣe asà idẹ ni ipò wọn, o si fi wọn le ọwọ olori ẹṣọ ti ntọju ọ̀na ile ọba.
entries.en: Instead of which king Rehoboam made shields of brass, and committed them to the hands of the chief of the guard, that kept the entrance of the king's house.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbakugba ti ọba ba si wọ̀ ile Oluwa lọ, awọn ẹṣọ a de, nwọn a si kó wọn wá, nwọn a si kó wọn pada sinu iyara ẹṣọ.
entries.en: And when the king entered into the house of the LORD, the guard came and fetched them, and brought them again into the guard chamber.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si rẹ̀ ara rẹ̀ silẹ, ibinu Oluwa yipada kuro lọdọ rẹ̀, ti kò fi run u patapata: ni Juda pẹlu, ohun rere si mbẹ.
entries.en: And when he humbled himself, the wrath of the LORD turned from him that he would not destroy him altogether: and also in Judah things went well.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Rehoboamu ọba mu ara rẹ̀ le ni Jerusalemu, o si jọba: nitori Rehoboamu jẹ ẹni ọdun mọkanlelogoji nigbati o bẹ̀rẹ si ijọba, o si jọba li ọdun mẹtadinlogun ni Jerusalemu, ilu ti Oluwa ti yàn lati inu gbogbo ẹ̀ya Israeli, lati fi orukọ rẹ̀ sibẹ. Orukọ iya rẹ̀ si ni Naama, ara Ammoni.
entries.en: So king Rehoboam strengthened himself in Jerusalem, and reigned: for Rehoboam was one and forty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which the LORD had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, to put his name there. And his mother's name was Naamah an Ammonitess.

entries.yo: O si ṣe buburu, nitori ti kò mura ọkàn rẹ̀ lati wá Oluwa.
entries.en: And he did evil, because he prepared not his heart to seek the LORD.

entries.yo: Njẹ iṣe Rehoboamu, ti iṣaju ati ti ikẹhin, a kò ha kọ wọn sinu iwe Ṣemaiah, woli, ati ti Iddo, ariran, nipa iwe itan idile? Ọtẹ si wà lãrin Rehoboamu ati Jeroboamu nigbagbogbo.
entries.en: Now the acts of Rehoboam, first and last, are they not written in the book of Shemaiah the prophet, and of Iddo the seer concerning genealogies? And there were wars between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually.

entries.yo: Rehoboamu si sùn pẹlu awọn baba rẹ̀, a si sìn i ni ilu Dafidi: Abijah ọmọ rẹ̀ si jọba ni ipò rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David: and Abijah his son reigned in his stead.

entries.yo: LI ọdun kejidilogun Jeroboamu, ọba, ni Abijah bẹ̀rẹ si ijọba lori Juda.
entries.en: Now in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam began Abijah to reign over Judah.

entries.yo: O jọba li ọdun mẹta ni Jerusalemu. Orukọ iya rẹ̀ si ni Mikaiah ọmọbinrin Urieli ti Gibea, ọtẹ si wà lãrin Abijah ati Jeroboamu.
entries.en: He reigned three years in Jerusalem. His mother's name also was Michaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. And there was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.

entries.yo: Abijah si fi awọn alagbara akọni ologun dì ogun na, ani ogún ọkẹ́ enia ti a yàn, Jeroboamu pẹlu si fi ogoji ọkẹ enia ti a yàn, awọn alagbara akọni enia tẹ́ ogun si i.
entries.en: And Abijah set the battle in array with an army of valiant men of war, even four hundred thousand chosen men: Jeroboam also set the battle in array against him with eight hundred thousand chosen men, being mighty men of valour.

entries.yo: Abijah si duro lori oke Semaraimu, ti o wà li òke Efraimu, o si wipe, Ẹ gbọ́ temi, Jeroboamu ati gbogbo Israeli!
entries.en: And Abijah stood up upon mount Zemaraim, which is in mount Ephraim, and said, Hear me, thou Jeroboam, and all Israel;

entries.yo: Kò ha tọ́ ki ẹnyin ki o mọ̀ pe: Oluwa Ọlọrun Israeli fi ijọba lori Israeli fun Dafidi lailai, ani fun u, ati fun awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ nipa majẹmu iyọ̀?
entries.en: Ought ye not to know that the LORD God of Israel gave the kingdom over Israel to David for ever, even to him and to his sons by a covenant of salt?

entries.yo: Jeroboamu, ọmọ Nebati, iranṣẹ Solomoni, ọmọ Dafidi dide, o si ṣọ̀tẹ si oluwa rẹ̀.
entries.en: Yet Jeroboam the son of Nebat, the servant of Solomon the son of David, is risen up, and hath rebelled against his lord.

entries.yo: Awọn enia lasan si ko ara wọn jọ si ọdọ rẹ̀, awọn ọmọ ẹni buburu, nwọn si mu ara wọn le si Rehoboamu, ọmọ Solomoni, nigbati Rehoboamu wà li ọdọmọde ti inu rẹ̀ si rọ̀, ti kò si le kò wọn loju.
entries.en: And there are gathered unto him vain men, the children of Belial, and have strengthened themselves against Rehoboam the son of Solomon, when Rehoboam was young and tenderhearted, and could not withstand them.

entries.yo: Ati nisisiyi ẹnyin rò lati kò ijọba Oluwa loju li ọwọ ọmọ Dafidi; ọ̀pọlọpọ si li ẹnyin, ati pẹlu nyin awọn ẹgbọrọmalu wura ti Jeroboamu ṣe li ọlọrun fun nyin.
entries.en: And now ye think to withstand the kingdom of the LORD in the hand of the sons of David; and ye be a great multitude, and there are with you golden calves, which Jeroboam made you for gods.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin kò ha ti lé awọn alufa Oluwa jade, awọn ọmọ Aaroni, ati awọn ọmọ Lefi, ẹnyin si ti ṣe awọn alufa fun ara nyin, gẹgẹ bi iṣe awọn orilẹ-ède ilẹ miran? bẹ̃ni ẹnikẹni ti o ba wá, ti ọwọ rẹ kún pẹlu ọdọ-akọ-malu ati àgbo meje, on na le ma ṣe alufa awọn ti kì iṣe ọlọrun.
entries.en: Have ye not cast out the priests of the LORD, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites, and have made you priests after the manner of the nations of other lands? so that whosoever cometh to consecrate himself with a young bullock and seven rams, the same may be a priest of them that are no gods.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi o ṣe ti wa ni, Oluwa li Ọlọrun wa, awa kò si kọ̀ ọ silẹ ati awọn alufa, ti nṣe iranṣẹ fun Oluwa, ani awọn ọmọ Aaroni ati awọn ọmọ Lefi ninu iṣẹ wọn.
entries.en: But as for us, the LORD is our God, and we have not forsaken him; and the priests, which minister unto the LORD, are the sons of Aaron, and the Levites wait upon their business:

entries.yo: Nwọn si nsun ọrẹ-ẹbọ sisun ati turari didùn li orowurọ ati li alalẹ si Oluwa: àkara ifihan pẹlu ni nwọn si ntò lori tabili mimọ́; ati ọpa fitila wura pẹlu fitila wọn, lati ma jó lalalẹ; nitori ti awa npa aṣẹ Oluwa Ọlọrun wa mọ́; ṣugbọn ẹnyin kọ̀ ọ silẹ.
entries.en: And they burn unto the LORD every morning and every evening burnt sacrifices and sweet incense: the shewbread also set they in order upon the pure table; and the candlestick of gold with the lamps thereof, to burn every evening: for we keep the charge of the LORD our God; but ye have forsaken him.

entries.yo: Si kiyesi i, Ọlọrun tikararẹ̀ si wà pẹlu wa li Olori wa, ati awọn alufa rẹ̀ pẹlu ipè didún ijaiya lati dún si nyin, Ẹnyin ọmọ Israeli, ẹ máṣe ba Oluwa Ọlọrun awọn baba nyin jà; nitori ẹ kì yio ṣe rere.
entries.en: And, behold, God himself is with us for our captain, and his priests with sounding trumpets to cry alarm against you. O children of Israel, fight ye not against the LORD God of your fathers; for ye shall not prosper.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Jeroboamu mu ki ogun-ẹ̀hin ki o bù wọn li ẹhin: bẹ̃ni nwọn mbẹ niwaju Juda, ati ogun-ẹhin na si mbẹ lẹhin wọn.
entries.en: But Jeroboam caused an ambushment to come about behind them: so they were before Judah, and the ambushment was behind them.

entries.yo: Nigbati Juda si bojuwo ẹhin, si kiyesi i, ogun mbẹ niwaju ati lẹhin: nwọn si ke pè Oluwa, awọn alufa si fún ipè.
entries.en: And when Judah looked back, behold, the battle was before and behind: and they cried unto the LORD, and the priests sounded with the trumpets.

entries.yo: Olukuluku, ọkunrin Juda si hó: o si ṣe, bi awọn ọkunrin Juda si ti hó, ni Ọlọrun kọlu Jeroboamu ati gbogbo Israeli niwaju Abijah ati Juda.
entries.en: Then the men of Judah gave a shout: and as the men of Judah shouted, it came to pass, that God smote Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and Judah.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Israeli si sa niwaju Juda: Ọlọrun si fi wọn le wọn lọwọ.
entries.en: And the children of Israel fled before Judah: and God delivered them into their hand.

entries.yo: Abijah ati awọn enia rẹ̀ si pa ninu wọn li ọ̀pọlọpọ: bẹ̃ni ọkẹ mẹdọgbọn ọkunrin ti a yàn ṣubu ni pipa ninu Israeli.
entries.en: And Abijah and his people slew them with a great slaughter: so there fell down slain of Israel five hundred thousand chosen men.

entries.yo: Bayi li a rẹ̀ awọn ọmọ Israeli silẹ li akoko na, awọn ọmọ Juda si bori nitori ti nwọn gbẹkẹle Oluwa Ọlọrun awọn baba wọn.
entries.en: Thus the children of Israel were brought under at that time, and the children of Judah prevailed, because they relied upon the LORD God of their fathers.

entries.yo: Abijah si lepa Jeroboamu, o si gbà ilu lọwọ rẹ̀, Beteli pẹlu awọn ilu rẹ̀, ati Jeṣana pẹlu awọn ilu rẹ̀, ati Efraimu pẹlu awọn ilu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Abijah pursued after Jeroboam, and took cities from him, Bethel with the towns thereof, and Jeshnah with the towns thereof, and Ephrain with the towns thereof.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Jeroboamu kò si tun li agbara mọ li ọjọ Abijah: Oluwa si lù u, o si kú.
entries.en: Neither did Jeroboam recover strength again in the days of Abijah: and the LORD struck him, and he died.

entries.yo: Abijah si di alagbara, o si gbe obinrin mẹtala ni iyawo, o si bi ọmọkunrin mejilelogun, ati ọmọbinrin mẹrindilogun.
entries.en: But Abijah waxed mighty, and married fourteen wives, and begat twenty and two sons, and sixteen daughters.

entries.yo: Ati iyokù iṣe Abijah, ati iwà rẹ̀, ati iṣẹ rẹ̀, a kọ wọn sinu iwe-itumọ Iddo, woli.
entries.en: And the rest of the acts of Abijah, and his ways, and his sayings, are written in the story of the prophet Iddo.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Abijah sùn pẹlu awọn baba rẹ̀, nwọn si sìn i ni ilu Dafidi: Asa ọmọ rẹ̀ si jọba ni ipò rẹ̀. Li ọjọ rẹ̀, ilẹ na wà li alafia li ọdun mẹwa.
entries.en: So Abijah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of David: and Asa his son reigned in his stead. In his days the land was quiet ten years.

entries.yo: Asa si ṣe eyi ti o dara, ti o si tọ́ li oju Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Asa did that which was good and right in the eyes of the LORD his God:

entries.yo: Nitori ti o mu pẹpẹ awọn ajeji oriṣa kuro, ati ibi giga wọnni, o si wó awọn ere palẹ, o si bẹ ere-oriṣa wọn lulẹ:
entries.en: For he took away the altars of the strange gods, and the high places, and brake down the images, and cut down the groves:

entries.yo: O si paṣẹ fun Juda lati ma wá Oluwa Ọlọrun awọn baba wọn, ati lati ma pa aṣẹ ati ofin rẹ̀ mọ́.
entries.en: And commanded Judah to seek the LORD God of their fathers, and to do the law and the commandment.

entries.yo: O si mu ibi giga wọnni ati ọwọ̀n-õrun wọnni kuro lati inu gbogbo ilu Juda: ijọba na si wà li alafia niwaju rẹ̀.
entries.en: Also he took away out of all the cities of Judah the high places and the images: and the kingdom was quiet before him.

entries.yo: O si kọ́ ilu olodi wọnni ni Juda, nitoriti ilẹ na ni isimi, on kò si ni ogun li ọdun wọnni; nitori Oluwa ti fun wọn ni isimi.
entries.en: And he built fenced cities in Judah: for the land had rest, and he had no war in those years; because the LORD had given him rest.

entries.yo: O si sọ fun Juda pe, Ẹ jẹ ki a kọ́ ilu wọnni, ki a si mọdi yi wọn ka, ati ile-iṣọ, ilẹkun ati ọpa-idabu, nigbati ilẹ na si wà niwaju wa, nitori ti awa ti wá Oluwa Ọlọrun wa, awa ti wá a, on si ti fun wa ni isimi yikakiri. Bẹ̃ni nwọn kọ́ wọn, nwọn si ṣe rere.
entries.en: Therefore he said unto Judah, Let us build these cities, and make about them walls, and towers, gates, and bars, while the land is yet before us; because we have sought the LORD our God, we have sought him, and he hath given us rest on every side. So they built and prospered.

entries.yo: Asa si ni ogun ti ngbé asà ati ọ̀kọ, ọkẹ mẹdogun lati inu Juda wá, ati lati inu Benjamini wá, ọkẹ mẹrinla ti ngbé apata ati ti nfa ọrun: gbogbo wọnyi si ni akọni ogun.
entries.en: And Asa had an army of men that bare targets and spears, out of Judah three hundred thousand; and out of Benjamin, that bare shields and drew bows, two hundred and fourscore thousand: all these were mighty men of valour.

entries.yo: Sera, ara Etiopia, si jade si wọn, pẹlu ãdọta ọkẹ enia, ati ọ̃dunrun kẹkẹ́; nwọn wá si Mareṣa.
entries.en: And there came out against them Zerah the Ethiopian with an host of a thousand thousand, and three hundred chariots; and came unto Mareshah.

entries.yo: Asa si jade tọ̀ ọ, nwọn si tẹ ogun li afonifoji Sefata lẹba Mareṣa.
entries.en: Then Asa went out against him, and they set the battle in array in the valley of Zephathah at Mareshah.

entries.yo: Asa si ke pe Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ̀, o si wipe, Oluwa! lọdọ rẹ bakanna ni fun ọ lati ràn alagbara enia lọwọ, tabi ẹniti kò li agbara: ràn wa lọwọ, Oluwa Ọlọrun wa; nitori ti awa gbẹkẹ le ọ, li orukọ rẹ li awa ntọ ọ̀pọlọpọ yi lọ, Oluwa, iwọ li Ọlọrun wa; máṣe jẹ ki enia ki o bori rẹ,
entries.en: And Asa cried unto the LORD his God, and said, LORD, it is nothing with thee to help, whether with many, or with them that have no power: help us, O LORD our God; for we rest on thee, and in thy name we go against this multitude. O LORD, thou art our God; let not man prevail against thee.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li Oluwa kọlù awọn ara Etiopia niwaju Asa, ati niwaju Juda: awọn ara Etiopia si sa.
entries.en: So the LORD smote the Ethiopians before Asa and before Judah; and the Ethiopians fled.

entries.yo: Ati Asa ati awọn enia ti o wà lọdọ rẹ̀ lepa wọn de Gerari: a si bi awọn ara Etiopia ṣubu ti ẹnikan kò tun wà li ãye; nitori ti a ṣẹ́ wọn niwaju Oluwa ati niwaju ogun rẹ̀; nwọn si kó ọ̀pọlọpọ ikogun lọ.
entries.en: And Asa and the people that were with him pursued them unto Gerar: and the Ethiopians were overthrown, that they could not recover themselves; for they were destroyed before the LORD, and before his host; and they carried away very much spoil.

entries.yo: Nwọn si kọlu gbogbo ilu yikakiri Gerari: nitori ti ẹ̀ru Oluwa bà wọn, nwọn si kó gbogbo ilu na, nitori ikógun pọ̀ rekọja ninu wọn.
entries.en: And they smote all the cities round about Gerar; for the fear of the LORD came upon them: and they spoiled all the cities; for there was exceeding much spoil in them.

entries.yo: Nwọn si kọlù awọn agbo-ẹran-ọsin, nwọn si kó ọ̀pọlọpọ agutan ati ibakasiẹ lọ, nwọn si pada wá si Jerusalemu.
entries.en: They smote also the tents of cattle, and carried away sheep and camels in abundance, and returned to Jerusalem.

entries.yo: ẸMI Ọlọrun si wá si ara Asariah, ọmọ Odedi:
entries.en: And the Spirit of God came upon Azariah the son of Oded:

entries.yo: O si jade lọ ipade Asa, o si wi fun u pe, Ẹ gbọ́ temi, Asa, ati gbogbo Juda ati Benjamini! Oluwa pẹlu nyin, nitori ti ẹnyin ti wà pẹlu rẹ̀; bi ẹnyin ba si ṣafẹri rẹ̀, ẹnyin o ri i; ṣugbọn bi ẹnyin ba kọ̀ ọ, on o si kọ̀ nyin.
entries.en: And he went out to meet Asa, and said unto him, Hear ye me, Asa, and all Judah and Benjamin; The LORD is with you, while ye be with him; and if ye seek him, he will be found of you; but if ye forsake him, he will forsake you.

entries.yo: Njẹ ọjọ pupọ ni Israeli ti wà laisìn Ọlọrun otitọ, ati laini alufa ti nkọni, ati laini ofin.
entries.en: Now for a long season Israel hath been without the true God, and without a teaching priest, and without law.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nwọn yipada si Oluwa. Ọlọrun Israeli, ninu wahala wọn, nwọn si ṣe awari rẹ̀, nwọn si ri i.
entries.en: But when they in their trouble did turn unto the LORD God of Israel, and sought him, he was found of them.

entries.yo: Ati li ọjọ wọnni alafia kò si fun ẹniti o njade, tabi fun ẹniti nwọle, ṣugbọn ibanujẹ pupọ li o wà lori gbogbo awọn olugbe ilẹ wọnni.
entries.en: And in those times there was no peace to him that went out, nor to him that came in, but great vexations were upon all the inhabitants of the countries.

entries.yo: Orilẹ-ède si kọlù orilẹ-ède, ati ilu si ilu: nitori ti Ọlọrun fi oniruru ipọnju bà wọn ninu jẹ.
entries.en: And nation was destroyed of nation, and city of city: for God did vex them with all adversity.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹnyin mu ara le, ki ẹ má si dẹ ọwọ nyin: nitori iṣẹ nyin yio ni ère.
entries.en: Be ye strong therefore, and let not your hands be weak: for your work shall be rewarded.

entries.yo: Nigbati Asa gbọ́ ọ̀rọ wọnyi, ati asọtẹlẹ Odedi woli, o mu ara le, o si mu awọn ohun irira kuro lati inu gbo-gbo ilẹ Juda ati Benjamini, ati lati inu ilu ti o ti gbà lati oke Efraimu, o si tun pẹpẹ Oluwa ṣe, ti o wà niwaju iloro Oluwa.
entries.en: And when Asa heard these words, and the prophecy of Oded the prophet, he took courage, and put away the abominable idols out of all the land of Judah and Benjamin, and out of the cities which he had taken from mount Ephraim, and renewed the altar of the LORD, that was before the porch of the LORD.

entries.yo: O si kó gbogbo Juda ati Benjamini jọ, ati awọn alejo ti o pẹlu wọn lati inu Efraimu ati Manasse, ati lati inu Simeoni wá: nitori ti nwọn ya li ọ̀pọlọpọ sọdọ rẹ̀ lati inu Israeli wá, nigbati nwọn ri pe, Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ̀ wà pẹlu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he gathered all Judah and Benjamin, and the strangers with them out of Ephraim and Manasseh, and out of Simeon: for they fell to him out of Israel in abundance, when they saw that the LORD his God was with him.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni nwọn kó ara wọn jọ si Jerusalemu, li oṣù kẹta, li ọdun kẹdogun ijọba Asa.
entries.en: So they gathered themselves together at Jerusalem in the third month, in the fifteenth year of the reign of Asa.

entries.yo: Nwọn si fi ninu ikógun ti nwọn kó wá, rubọ si Oluwa li ọjọ na, ẹ̃dẹgbãrin akọ-malu ati ẹ̃dẹgbãrin agutan.
entries.en: And they offered unto the LORD the same time, of the spoil which they had brought, seven hundred oxen and seven thousand sheep.

entries.yo: Nwọn si tun dá majẹmu lati wá Oluwa Ọlọrun awọn baba wọn, tinutinu wọn ati tọkàntọkàn wọn.
entries.en: And they entered into a covenant to seek the LORD God of their fathers with all their heart and with all their soul;

entries.yo: Pe, ẹnikẹni ti kò ba wá Oluwa Ọlọrun Israeli, pipa li a o pa a, lati ẹni-kekere de ẹni-nla, ati ọkunrin ati obinrin.
entries.en: That whosoever would not seek the LORD God of Israel should be put to death, whether small or great, whether man or woman.

entries.yo: Nwọn si fi ohùn rara bura fun Oluwa, ati pẹlu ariwo, ati pẹlu ipè ati pẹlu fère.
entries.en: And they sware unto the LORD with a loud voice, and with shouting, and with trumpets, and with cornets.

entries.yo: Gbogbo Juda si yọ̀ si ibura na: nitoriti nwọn fi tinu-tinu wọn bura, nwọn si fi gbogbo ifẹ inu wọn wá a; nwọn si ri i: Oluwa si fun wọn ni isimi yikakiri.
entries.en: And all Judah rejoiced at the oath: for they had sworn with all their heart, and sought him with their whole desire; and he was found of them: and the LORD gave them rest round about.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu Maaka, iya Asa, li ọba mu u kuro lati má ṣe ayaba, nitoriti o yá ere fun oriṣa rẹ̀: Asa si ké ere rẹ̀ lulẹ, o si tẹ̀ ẹ mọlẹ, o si sun u nibi odò Kidroni.
entries.en: And also concerning Maachah the mother of Asa the king, he removed her from being queen, because she had made an idol in a grove: and Asa cut down her idol, and stamped it, and burnt it at the brook Kidron.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn a kò mu ibi giga wọnni kuro ni Israeli: kiki ọkàn Asa wà ni pipé li ọjọ rẹ̀ gbogbo.
entries.en: But the high places were not taken away out of Israel: nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect all his days.

entries.yo: O si mu ohun mimọ́ wọnni ti baba rẹ̀, ati ohun mimọ́ wọnni ti on tikararẹ̀ wá sinu ile Ọlọrun, fadakà, wura, ati ohun-elo wọnni.
entries.en: And he brought into the house of God the things that his father had dedicated, and that he himself had dedicated, silver, and gold, and vessels.

entries.yo: Ogun kò si mọ titi di ọdun karundilogoji ọba Asa.
entries.en: And there was no more war unto the five and thirtieth year of the reign of Asa.

entries.yo: LI ọdun kẹrindilogoji ijọba Asa, Baaṣa, ọba Israeli, gòke wá si Juda, o si kọ́ Rama, nitori ki o má ba jẹ ki ẹnikan ki o jade, tabi ki o wọle tọ̀ Asa, ọba Juda lọ.
entries.en: In the six and thirtieth year of the reign of Asa Baasha king of Israel came up against Judah, and built Ramah, to the intent that he might let none go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Asa mu fadakà ati wura jade lati inu iṣura ile Oluwa wá, ati ile ọba, o si ranṣẹ si Benhadadi, ọba Siria, ti ngbe Damasku, wipe,
entries.en: Then Asa brought out silver and gold out of the treasures of the house of the LORD and of the king's house, and sent to Ben-hadad king of Syria, that dwelt at Damascus, saying,

entries.yo: Majẹmu kan wà larin temi tirẹ, bi o ti wà lãrin baba mi ati baba rẹ; kiyesi i, mo fi fadakà ati wura ranṣẹ si ọ; lọ, bà majẹmu ti o ba Baaṣa, ọba Israeli dá jẹ, ki o le lọ kuro lọdọ mi.
entries.en: There is a league between me and thee, as there was between my father and thy father: behold, I have sent thee silver and gold; go, break thy league with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.

entries.yo: Benhadadi si gbọ́ ti Asa ọba, o si rán awọn olori ogun rẹ̀ si ilu Israeli wọnni, nwọn si kọlù Ijoni, ati Dani, ati Abel-Maimu, ati gbogbo ilu iṣura Naftali.
entries.en: And Ben-hadad hearkened unto king Asa, and sent the captains of his armies against the cities of Israel; and they smote Ijon, and Dan, and Abel-maim, and all the store cities of Naphtali.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati Baaṣa gbọ́, o ṣiwọ atikọ́ Rama, o si dá iṣẹ rẹ̀ duro.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when Baasha heard it, that he left off building of Ramah, and let his work cease.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Asa ọba kó gbogbo Juda jọ; nwọn si kó okuta ati igi Rama lọ, eyiti Baaṣa nfi kọ́le; o si fi kọ́ Geba ati Mispa.
entries.en: Then Asa the king took all Judah; and they carried away the stones of Ramah, and the timber thereof, wherewith Baasha was building; and he built therewith Geba and Mizpah.

entries.yo: Li àkoko na Hanani, ariran, wá sọdọ Asa, ọba Juda, o si wi fun u pe, Nitoriti iwọ gbẹkẹle ọba Siria, iwọ kò si gbẹkẹle Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ, nitorina ni ogun ọba Siria ṣe bọ́ lọwọ rẹ.
entries.en: And at that time Hanani the seer came to Asa king of Judah, and said unto him, Because thou hast relied on the king of Syria, and not relied on the LORD thy God, therefore is the host of the king of Syria escaped out of thine hand.

entries.yo: Awọn ara Etiopia ati awọn ara Libia kì iha ise ogun nla, pẹlu ọ̀pọlọpọ kẹkẹ́ ati ẹlẹṣin? ṣugbọn nitoriti iwọ gbẹkẹle Oluwa, on fi wọn le ọ lọwọ.
entries.en: Were not the Ethiopians and the Lubims a huge host, with very many chariots and horsemen? yet, because thou didst rely on the LORD, he delivered them into thine hand.

entries.yo: Nitoriti oju Oluwa nlọ siwa sẹhin ni gbogbo aiye, lati fi agbara fun awọn ẹni ọlọkàn pípe si ọdọ rẹ̀. Ninu eyi ni iwọ hùwa aṣiwere: nitorina lati isisiyi lọ ogun yio ma ba ọ jà.
entries.en: For the eyes of the LORD run to and fro throughout the whole earth, to shew himself strong in the behalf of them whose heart is perfect toward him. Herein thou hast done foolishly: therefore from henceforth thou shalt have wars.

entries.yo: Asa si binu si ariran na, o si fi i sinu tubu; nitoriti o binu si i niti eyi na. Asa si ni ninu awọn enia na lara li akokò na.
entries.en: Then Asa was wroth with the seer, and put him in a prison house; for he was in a rage with him because of this thing. And Asa oppressed some of the people the same time.

entries.yo: Si kiyesi i, iṣe Asa ti iṣaju ati ti ikẹhin, wò o, a kọ wọn sinu iwe awọn ọba Juda ati Israeli.
entries.en: And, behold, the acts of Asa, first and last, lo, they are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

entries.yo: Ati li ọdun kọkandilogoji ijọba rẹ̀, Asa ṣe aisan li ẹsẹ rẹ̀, titi àrun rẹ̀ fi pọ̀ gidigidi: sibẹ ninu aisan rẹ̀ on kò wá Oluwa, bikòṣe awọn oniṣegun.
entries.en: And Asa in the thirty and ninth year of his reign was diseased in his feet, until his disease was exceeding great: yet in his disease he sought not to the LORD, but to the physicians.

entries.yo: Asa si sùn pẹlu awọn baba rẹ̀, o si kú li ọdun kọkanlelogoji ijọba rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Asa slept with his fathers, and died in the one and fortieth year of his reign.

entries.yo: Nwọn si sìn i sinu isa-okú, ti o gbẹ́ fun ara rẹ̀ ni ilu Dafidi, nwọn si tẹ́ ẹ lori àkete ti a fi õrun-didùn kùn, ati oniruru turari ti a fi ọgbọ́n awọn alapolu pèse: nwọn si ṣe ijona nlanla fun u.
entries.en: And they buried him in his own sepulchres, which he had made for himself in the city of David, and laid him in the bed which was filled with sweet odours and divers kinds of spices prepared by the apothecaries' art: and they made a very great burning for him.

entries.yo: JEHOṢAFATI, ọmọ rẹ̀ si jọba ni ipò rẹ̀, o si mu ara rẹ̀ le si Israeli.
entries.en: And Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead, and strengthened himself against Israel.

entries.yo: O si fi ogun sinu gbogbo ilu olodi Juda, o si fi ẹgbẹ-ogun si ilẹ Juda ati sinu ilu Efraimu wọnni, ti Asa baba rẹ̀ ti gbà.
entries.en: And he placed forces in all the fenced cities of Judah, and set garrisons in the land of Judah, and in the cities of Ephraim, which Asa his father had taken.

entries.yo: Oluwa si wà pẹlu Jehoṣafati, nitoriti o rìn ninu ọ̀na iṣaju Dafidi, baba rẹ̀, kò si wá Baalimu:
entries.en: And the LORD was with Jehoshaphat, because he walked in the first ways of his father David, and sought not unto Baalim;

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn o wá Ọlọrun baba rẹ̀, o si rìn ninu ofin rẹ̀, ki iṣe bi iṣe Israeli.
entries.en: But sought to the LORD God of his father, and walked in his commandments, and not after the doings of Israel.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni Oluwa fi idi ijọba na mulẹ li ọwọ rẹ̀; gbogbo Juda si ta Jehoṣafati li ọrẹ, on si li ọrọ̀ ati ọlá li ọ̀pọlọpọ.
entries.en: Therefore the LORD stablished the kingdom in his hand; and all Judah brought to Jehoshaphat presents; and he had riches and honour in abundance.

entries.yo: Ọkàn rẹ̀ si gbé soke li ọ̀na Oluwa: pẹlupẹlu o si mu ibi giga wọnni ati ere-oriṣa kuro ni Juda.
entries.en: And his heart was lifted up in the ways of the LORD: moreover he took away the high places and groves out of Judah.

entries.yo: Ati li ọdun kẹta ijọba rẹ̀, o ranṣẹ si awọn ijoye rẹ̀, ani si Benhaili ati si Obadiah ati Sekariah, ati si Netaneeli, ati si Mikaiah, lati ma kọ́ni ninu ilu Juda wọnni.
entries.en: Also in the third year of his reign he sent to his princes, even to Ben-hail, and to Obadiah, and to Zechariah, and to Nethaneel, and to Michaiah, to teach in the cities of Judah.

entries.yo: Ati pẹlu wọn, o rán awọn ọmọ Lefi, ani Ṣemaiah, ati Netaniah, ati Sebadiah, ati Asaheli, ati Ṣemiramotu, ati Jehonatani, ati Adonijah, ati Tobijah, ati Tob-Adonijah, awọn ọmọ Lefi; ati pẹlu wọn Eliṣama, ati Jehoramu, awọn alufa.
entries.en: And with them he sent Levites, even Shemaiah, and Nethaniah, and Zebadiah, and Asahel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehonathan, and Adonijah, and Tobijah, and Tob-adonijah, Levites; and with them Elishama and Jehoram, priests.

entries.yo: Nwọn si kọ́ni ni Juda, nwọn si ni ofin Oluwa pẹlu wọn, nwọn si lọ kakiri ja gbogbo ilu Juda, nwọn si kọ́ awọn enia.
entries.en: And they taught in Judah, and had the book of the law of the LORD with them, and went about throughout all the cities of Judah, and taught the people.

entries.yo: Ẹ̀ru Oluwa si ba gbogbo ijọba ilẹ na, ti o wà yikakiri Juda, tobẹ̃ ti nwọn kò ba Jehoṣafati jagun kan.
entries.en: And the fear of the LORD fell upon all the kingdoms of the lands that were round about Judah, so that they made no war against Jehoshaphat.

entries.yo: Ati ninu awọn ara Filistia mu ọrẹ fun Jehoṣafati wá, ati fadakà owo ọba: awọn ara Arabia si mu ọwọ́-ẹran fun u wá, ẹgbãrin àgbo o di ọ̃dunrun, ati ẹgbãrin obukọ di ọ̃dunrun.
entries.en: Also some of the Philistines brought Jehoshaphat presents, and tribute silver; and the Arabians brought him flocks, seven thousand and seven hundred rams, and seven thousand and seven hundred he goats.

entries.yo: Jehoṣafati si npọ̀ si i gidigidi: o si kọ́ ile olodi, ati ilu iṣura ni Juda.
entries.en: And Jehoshaphat waxed great exceedingly; and he built in Judah castles, and cities of store.

entries.yo: O si ni iṣura pupọ ni ilu Juda; ati awọn jagunjagun, awọn alagbara akọni ọkunrin ti o wà ni Jerusalemu.
entries.en: And he had much business in the cities of Judah: and the men of war, mighty men of valour, were in Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Wọnyi ni iye wọn gẹgẹ bi ile baba wọn: Ninu Juda, awọn olori ẹgbẹgbẹrun; Adna, olori, ati pẹlu rẹ̀, ọkẹ́ mẹ̃dogun alagbara akọni ọkunrin.
entries.en: And these are the numbers of them according to the house of their fathers: Of Judah, the captains of thousands; Adnah the chief, and with him mighty men of valour three hundred thousand.

entries.yo: Ati atẹle rẹ̀ ni Jehohanani olori, ati pẹlu rẹ̀ ọkẹ mẹrinla ọkunrin.
entries.en: And next to him was Jehohanan the captain, and with him two hundred and fourscore thousand.

entries.yo: Ati atẹle rẹ̀ ni Amasiah, ọmọ Sikri, ti o fi tinutinu fi ara rẹ̀ fun Oluwa; ati pẹlu rẹ̀ ọkẹ mẹwa alagbara akọni ọkunrin.
entries.en: And next him was Amasiah the son of Zichri, who willingly offered himself unto the LORD; and with him two hundred thousand mighty men of valour.

entries.yo: Ati ninu Benjamini; Eliada alagbara akọni ọkunrin, ati pẹlu rẹ̀ awọn enia ti nfi ọrun ati apata hamọra, ọkẹ mẹwa.
entries.en: And of Benjamin; Eliada a mighty man of valour, and with him armed men with bow and shield two hundred thousand.

entries.yo: Ati atẹle rẹ̀ ni Jehosabadi, ati pẹlu rẹ̀ ọkẹ mẹsan, ti o mura silẹ de ogun.
entries.en: And next him was Jehozabad, and with him an hundred and fourscore thousand ready prepared for the war.

entries.yo: Wọnyi nduro tì ọba, li aika awọn ti ọba fi sinu ilu olodi ni gbogbo Juda.
entries.en: These waited on the king, beside those whom the king put in the fenced cities throughout all Judah.

entries.yo: JEHOṢAFATI si li ọrọ̀ ati ọlá li ọ̀pọlọpọ, o si ba Ahabu dá ana.
entries.en: Now Jehoshaphat had riches and honour in abundance, and joined affinity with Ahab.

entries.yo: Lẹhin ọdun melokan, on sọ̀kalẹ tọ Ahabu lọ si Samaria. Ahabu si pa agutan ati malu fun u li ọ̀pọlọpọ ati fun awọn enia ti o pẹlu rẹ̀, o si rọ̀ ọ lati ba a gòke lọ si Ramoti-Gileadi.
entries.en: And after certain years he went down to Ahab to Samaria. And Ahab killed sheep and oxen for him in abundance, and for the people that he had with him, and persuaded him to go up with him to Ramoth-gilead.

entries.yo: Ahabu ọba Israeli si wi fun Jehoṣafati ọba Juda pe, Iwọ o ha ba mi lọ si Ramoti-Gileadi bi? On si da a li ohùn wipe, Emi bi iwọ, ati enia mi bi enia rẹ; awa o pẹlu rẹ li ogun na.
entries.en: And Ahab king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat king of Judah, Wilt thou go with me to Ramoth-gilead? And he answered him, I am as thou art, and my people as thy people; and we will be with thee in the war.

entries.yo: Jehoṣafati si wi fun ọba Israeli pe, Emi bẹ̀ ọ, bère ọ̀rọ Oluwa loni.
entries.en: And Jehoshaphat said unto the king of Israel, Inquire, I pray thee, at the word of the LORD to day.

entries.yo: Nitorina ọba Israeli kó awọn woli jọ, irinwo ọkunrin, o si wi fun wọn pe, Ki awa ki o ha lọ si Ramoti-Gileadi lọ ijagun, tabi ki emi ki o jọwọ rẹ̀? Nwọn si wipe, Gòke lọ; Ọlọrun yio si fi i le ọba lọwọ.
entries.en: Therefore the king of Israel gathered together of prophets four hundred men, and said unto them, Shall we go to Ramoth-gilead to battle, or shall I forbear? And they said, Go up; for God will deliver it into the king's hand.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Jehoṣafati wipe, kò si woli Oluwa nihin pẹlu, ti awa ìba bère lọwọ rẹ̀?
entries.en: But Jehoshaphat said, Is there not here a prophet of the LORD besides, that we might inquire of him?

entries.yo: Ọba Israeli si wi fun Jehoṣafati pe, ọkunrin kan mbẹ sibẹ lọdọ ẹniti awa iba bère lọwọ Oluwa: ṣugbọn emi korira rẹ̀: nitoriti kò jẹ sọ asọtẹlẹ rere si mi lai, bikòṣe ibi nigbagbogbo: eyini ni Mikaiah, ọmọ Imla. Jehoṣafati si wipe, Ki ọba ki o má sọ bẹ̃.
entries.en: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, There is yet one man, by whom we may inquire of the LORD: but I hate him; for he never prophesied good unto me, but always evil: the same is Micaiah the son of Imla. And Jehoshaphat said, Let not the king say so.

entries.yo: Ọba Israeli si pè ìwẹfa kan, o si wipe, Mu ki Mikaiah ọmọ Imla, ki o yara wá.
entries.en: And the king of Israel called for one of his officers, and said, Fetch quickly Micaiah the son of Imla.

entries.yo: Ati ọba Israeli, ati Jehoṣafati, ọba Juda joko, olukuluku lori itẹ rẹ̀, nwọn si wọ aṣọ igunwa wọn, nwọn si joko ni ita ẹnubọde Samaria; gbogbo awọn woli si nsọ asọtẹlẹ niwaju wọn.
entries.en: And the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah sat either of them on his throne, clothed in their robes, and they sat in a void place at the entering in of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets prophesied before them.

entries.yo: Sedekiah ọmọ Kenaana si ṣe iwo irin o si wipe, Bayi li Oluwa wi, Wọnyi ni iwọ o fi kàn awọn ara Siria titi iwọ o fi run wọn.
entries.en: And Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah had made him horns of iron, and said, Thus saith the LORD, With these thou shalt push Syria until they be consumed.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn woli si nsọtẹlẹ bẹ̃ wipe, Gòke lọ si Ramoti-Gileadi, iwọ o ṣe rere; Oluwa yio si fi i le ọba lọwọ.
entries.en: And all the prophets prophesied so, saying, Go up to Ramoth-gilead, and prosper: for the LORD shall deliver it into the hand of the king.

entries.yo: Onṣẹ ti o lọ ipè Mikaiah si wi fun u pe, Kiye si i, awọn woli fi ẹnu kan sọ rere fun ọba: Njẹ emi bẹ̀ ọ, jẹ ki ọ̀rọ rẹ ki o dabi ọkan ninu ti wọn, ki o si sọ rere.
entries.en: And the messenger that went to call Micaiah spake to him, saying, Behold, the words of the prophets declare good to the king with one assent; let thy word therefore, I pray thee, be like one of theirs, and speak thou good.

entries.yo: Mikaiah si wipe, Bi Oluwa ti mbẹ, ani, eyiti Ọlọrun mi ba wi li emi o sọ.
entries.en: And Micaiah said, As the LORD liveth, even what my God saith, that will I speak.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si tọ̀ ọba wá, ọba sọ fun u pe, Mikaiah, ki awa ki o lọ si Ramoti-Gileadi lọ ijagun, tabi ki emi ki o jọwọ rẹ̀? O si wipe, Ẹ lọ, ẹnyin o si ṣe rere, a o si fi wọn le nyin lọwọ.
entries.en: And when he was come to the king, the king said unto him, Micaiah, shall we go to Ramoth-gilead to battle, or shall I forbear? And he said, Go ye up, and prosper, and they shall be delivered into your hand.

entries.yo: Ọba si wi fun u pe, Igba melo li emi o fi ọ bú ki iwọ ki o máṣe sọ ohun kan fun mi bikòṣe ọ̀rọ otitọ li orukọ Oluwa?
entries.en: And the king said to him, How many times shall I adjure thee that thou say nothing but the truth to me in the name of the LORD?

entries.yo: On si wipe, Emi ri gbogbo Israeli fọnka kiri lori awọn òke, bi agutan ti kò ni oluṣọ: Oluwa si wipe, Awọn wọnyi kò ni oluwa: jẹ ki nwọn ki o pada, olukuluku si ile rẹ̀ li alafia.
entries.en: Then he said, I did see all Israel scattered upon the mountains, as sheep that have no shepherd: and the LORD said, These have no master; let them return therefore every man to his house in peace.

entries.yo: Ọba Israeli si wi fun Jehoṣafati pe, Emi kò ti wi fun ọ pe: on kì isọtẹlẹ rere si mi, bikòṣe ibi?
entries.en: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, Did I not tell thee that he would not prophesy good unto me, but evil?

entries.yo: Mikaiah si wipe, Nitorina, gbọ́ ọ̀rọ Oluwa: mo ri Oluwa joko lori itẹ́ rẹ̀, ati gbogbo ogun ọrun duro lapa ọtún ati lapa òsi rẹ̀.
entries.en: Again he said, Therefore hear the word of the LORD; I saw the LORD sitting upon his throne, and all the host of heaven standing on his right hand and on his left.

entries.yo: Oluwa si wipe, Tani yio tàn Ahabu, ọba Israeli, ki o le gòke lọ ki o si le ṣubu ni Ramoti-Gileadi? Ekini si sọ bayi, ekeji si sọ miran.
entries.en: And the LORD said, Who shall entice Ahab king of Israel, that he may go up and fall at Ramoth-gilead? And one spake saying after this manner, and another saying after that manner.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ẹmi na jade wá, o si duro niwaju Oluwa, o si wipe, Emi o tàn a. Oluwa si wi fun u pe, Bawo?
entries.en: Then there came out a spirit, and stood before the LORD, and said, I will entice him. And the LORD said unto him, Wherewith?

entries.yo: On si wipe, Emi o jade lọ, emi o si di ẹmi eke li ẹnu gbogbo awọn woli rẹ̀. Oluwa si wipe, Iwọ o tàn a, iwọ o si bori pẹlu: jade lọ, ki o si ṣe bẹ̃ na.
entries.en: And he said, I will go out, and be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets. And the LORD said, Thou shalt entice him, and thou shalt also prevail: go out, and do even so.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, kiyesi i, Oluwa ti fi ẹmi eke si ẹnu gbogbo awọn woli rẹ wọnyi, Oluwa si ti sọ ibi si ọ.
entries.en: Now therefore, behold, the LORD hath put a lying spirit in the mouth of these thy prophets, and the LORD hath spoken evil against thee.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Sedekiah, ọmọ Kenaana, sunmọ ọ, o si lù Mikaiah li ẹ̀rẹkẹ, o si wipe, Ọ̀na wo li ẹmi Oluwa gbà kọja lọ kuro lọdọ mi lati ba ọ sọ̀rọ.
entries.en: Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah came near, and smote Micaiah upon the cheek, and said, Which way went the Spirit of the LORD from me to speak unto thee?

entries.yo: Mikaiah si wipe, Kiyesi i, iwọ o ri i li ọjọ na, nigbati iwọ o wọ inu iyẹwu de inu iyẹwu lọ ifi ara rẹ pamọ́,
entries.en: And Micaiah said, Behold, thou shalt see on that day when thou shalt go into an inner chamber to hide thyself.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ọba Israeli wipe, Ẹ mu Mikaiah, ki ẹ si mu u pada sọdọ Amoni, olori ilu, ati sọdọ Joaṣi, ọmọ ọba.
entries.en: Then the king of Israel said, Take ye Micaiah, and carry him back to Amon the governor of the city, and to Joash the king's son;

entries.yo: Ki ẹ si wipe, Bayi li ọba wi, ẹ fi eleyi sinu tubu, ki ẹ si fi ọnjẹ ipọnju ati omi ipọnju bọ́ ọ, titi emi o fi pada bọ̀ li alafia.
entries.en: And say, Thus saith the king, Put this fellow in the prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction, until I return in peace.

entries.yo: Mikaiah si wipe, Ni pipada bi iwọ ba pada bọ̀ li alafia, njẹ Oluwa kò ti ọdọ mi sọ̀rọ. O si wipe, Ẹ gbọ́, ẹnyin enia gbogbo!
entries.en: And Micaiah said, If thou certainly return in peace, then hath not the LORD spoken by me. And he said, Hearken, all ye people.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li ọba Israeli ati Jehoṣafati, ọba Juda, si gòke lọ si Ramoti-Gileadi.
entries.en: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramoth-gilead.

entries.yo: Ọba Israeli si wi fun Jehoṣafati pe, emi o pa aṣọ dà, emi o si lọ si oju ìja; ṣugbọn iwọ gbé aṣọ igunwà rẹ wọ̀. Bẹ̃li ọba Israeli si pa aṣọ dà: nwọn si lọ si oju ìja.
entries.en: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, I will disguise myself, and will go to the battle; but put thou on thy robes. So the king of Israel disguised himself; and they went to the battle.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ọba Siria ti paṣẹ fun awọn olori kẹkẹ́ ti o wà lọdọ rẹ̀, pe, Ẹ máṣe ba ewe tabi àgba jà, bikòṣe ọba Israeli nikan.
entries.en: Now the king of Syria had commanded the captains of the chariots that were with him, saying, Fight ye not with small or great, save only with the king of Israel.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati awọn olori kẹkẹ́ ri Jehoṣafati, ni nwọn wipe eyi li ọba Israeli, nitorina nwọn yi i ka lati ba a jà: ṣugbọn Jehoṣafati kigbe, Oluwa si ràn a lọwọ: Ọlọrun si yi wọn pada kuro lọdọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, that they said, It is the king of Israel. Therefore they compassed about him to fight: but Jehoshaphat cried out, and the LORD helped him; and God moved them to depart from him.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, bi awọn olori kẹkẹ́ ti woye pe kì iṣe ọba Israeli, nwọn yipada kuro lẹhin rẹ̀.
entries.en: For it came to pass, that, when the captains of the chariots perceived that it was not the king of Israel, they turned back again from pursuing him.

entries.yo: Ọkunrin kan si fa ọrun rẹ̀ laipete, o si ta ọba Israeli lãrin ipade ẹwu-irin, o si wi fun olutọju kẹkẹ́ rẹ̀ pe, Yi ọwọ rẹ pada, ki o mu mi jade kuro loju ìja; nitoriti mo gbọgbẹ́.
entries.en: And a certain man drew a bow at a venture, and smote the king of Israel between the joints of the harness: therefore he said to his chariot man, Turn thine hand, that thou mayest carry me out of the host; for I am wounded.

entries.yo: Ija na si pọ̀ li ọjọ na: pẹlupẹlu ọba Israeli duro ninu kẹkẹ́ rẹ̀ kọju si awọn ara Siria titi di aṣãlẹ: o si kú li akokò ìwọ õrun.
entries.en: And the battle increased that day: howbeit the king of Israel stayed himself up in his chariot against the Syrians until the even: and about the time of the sun going down he died.

entries.yo: JEHOṢAFATI, ọba Juda, si pada lọ si ile rẹ̀ ni Jerusalemu li alafia.
entries.en: And Jehoshaphat the king of Judah returned to his house in peace to Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Jehu, ọmọ Hanani, ariran, si jade lọ ipade rẹ̀, o si wi fun Jehoṣafati pe, iwọ o ha ma ràn enia buburu lọwọ, iwọ o si fẹran awọn ti o korira Oluwa? njẹ nitori eyi ni ibinu ṣe de si ọ lati ọdọ Oluwa.
entries.en: And Jehu the son of Hanani the seer went out to meet him, and said to king Jehoshaphat, Shouldest thou help the ungodly, and love them that hate the LORD? therefore is wrath upon thee from before the LORD.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn a ri ohun rere ninu rẹ, pe, nitori ti iwọ ti mu awọn ere-oriṣa kuro ni ilẹ na, ti o si mura ọkàn rẹ lati wá Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Nevertheless there are good things found in thee, in that thou hast taken away the groves out of the land, and hast prepared thine heart to seek God.

entries.yo: Jehoṣafati si ngbe Jerusalemu: o nlọ, o mbọ̀ lãrin awọn enia lati Beerṣeba de òke Efraimu, o si mu wọn pada sọdọ Oluwa, Ọlọrun awọn baba wọn.
entries.en: And Jehoshaphat dwelt at Jerusalem: and he went out again through the people from Beer-sheba to mount Ephraim, and brought them back unto the LORD God of their fathers.

entries.yo: O si fi awọn onidajọ si ilẹ na, ninu gbogbo ilu olodi Juda, lati ilu de ilu,
entries.en: And he set judges in the land throughout all the fenced cities of Judah, city by city,

entries.yo: O si wi fun awọn onidajọ pe, Ẹ kiyesi ohun ti ẹnyin nṣe! nitori ti ẹnyin kò dajọ fun enia bikòṣe fun Oluwa, ti o wà pẹlu nyin ninu ọ̀ran idajọ.
entries.en: And said to the judges, Take heed what ye do: for ye judge not for man, but for the LORD, who is with you in the judgment.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, jẹ ki ẹ̀ru Oluwa ki o wà lara nyin, ẹ ma ṣọra, ki ẹ si ṣe e; nitoriti kò si aiṣedede kan lọdọ Oluwa Ọlọrun wa, tabi ojuṣaju enia, tabi gbigba abẹtẹlẹ.
entries.en: Wherefore now let the fear of the LORD be upon you; take heed and do it: for there is no iniquity with the LORD our God, nor respect of persons, nor taking of gifts.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu ni Jerusalemu, Jehoṣafati yàn ninu awọn ọmọ Lefi, ati ninu awọn alufa, ati ninu awọn olori awọn baba Israeli, fun idajọ Oluwa, ati fun ẹjọ; nwọn si ngbe Jerusalemu.
entries.en: Moreover in Jerusalem did Jehoshaphat set of the Levites, and of the priests, and of the chief of the fathers of Israel, for the judgment of the LORD, and for controversies, when they returned to Jerusalem.

entries.yo: O si kilọ fun wọn, wipe, Bayi ni ki ẹnyin ki o mã ṣe, ni ibẹ̀ru Oluwa, li otitọ, ati pẹlu ọkàn pipé.
entries.en: And he charged them, saying, Thus shall ye do in the fear of the LORD, faithfully, and with a perfect heart.

entries.yo: Ẹjọ ki ẹjọ ti o ba si de ọdọ nyin lati ọdọ awọn arakunrin nyin ti ngbe ilu wọn, lãrin ẹ̀jẹ on ẹ̀jẹ, lãrin ofin pẹlu aṣẹ, ìlana ati ẹtọ́, ki ẹnyin ki o kilọ fun wọn, ki nwọn ki o máṣe dẹṣẹ si Oluwa, ibinu a si wá sori nyin, ati sori awọn arakunrin nyin: ẹ ṣe bẹ̃ gẹgẹ, ẹnyin kì yio si jẹbi.
entries.en: And what cause soever shall come to you of your brethren that dwell in their cities, between blood and blood, between law and commandment, statutes and judgments, ye shall even warn them that they trespass not against the LORD, and so wrath come upon you, and upon your brethren: this do, and ye shall not trespass.

entries.yo: Si wõ, Amariah, alufa ni olori lori nyin ni gbogbo ọ̀ran Oluwa; ati Sebadiah, ọmọ Iṣmaeli, alakoso ile Juda, fun ọ̀ran ọba; pẹlupẹlu ẹnyin ni olutọju awọn ọmọ Lefi pẹlu nyin. Ẹ mu ara le, ki ẹ si ṣe, Oluwa yio pẹlu ẹni-rere.
entries.en: And, behold, Amariah the chief priest is over you in all matters of the LORD; and Zebadiah the son of Ishmael, the ruler of the house of Judah, for all the king's matters: also the Levites shall be officers before you. Deal courageously, and the LORD shall be with the good.

entries.yo: O SI ṣe, lẹhin eyi li awọn ọmọ Moabu, ati awọn ọmọ Ammoni, ati ninu awọn ọmọ Edomu pẹlu wọn, gbé ogun tọ Jehoṣafati wá.
entries.en: It came to pass after this also, that the children of Moab, and the children of Ammon, and with them other beside the Ammonites, came against Jehoshaphat to battle.

entries.yo: Nigbana li awọn kan wá, nwọn si wi fun Jehoṣafati pe, Ọ̀pọlọpọ enia mbo wá ba ọ lati apakeji okun lati Siria, si kiyesi i, nwọn wà ni Hasason-Tamari ti iṣe Engedi.
entries.en: Then there came some that told Jehoshaphat, saying, There cometh a great multitude against thee from beyond the sea on this side Syria; and, behold, they be Hazazon-tamar, which is En-gedi.

entries.yo: Jehoṣafati si bẹ̀ru, o si fi ara rẹ̀ si ati wá Oluwa, o si kede àwẹ ja gbogbo Juda.
entries.en: And Jehoshaphat feared, and set himself to seek the LORD, and proclaimed a fast throughout all Judah.

entries.yo: Juda si kó ara wọn jọ, lati wá iranlọwọ lọwọ Oluwa: pẹlupẹlu nwọn wá lati inu gbogbo ilu Juda lati wá Oluwa,
entries.en: And Judah gathered themselves together, to ask help of the LORD: even out of all the cities of Judah they came to seek the LORD.

entries.yo: Jehoṣafati si duro ninu apejọ enia Juda ati Jerusalemu, ni ile Oluwa, niwaju àgbala titun.
entries.en: And Jehoshaphat stood in the congregation of Judah and Jerusalem, in the house of the LORD, before the new court,

entries.yo: O si wipe, Oluwa, Ọlọrun awọn baba wa, iwọ kọ́ ha ni Ọlọrun li ọrun? Iwọ kọ́ ha nṣakoso lori gbogbo ijọba awọn orilẹ-ède? lọwọ rẹ ki agbara ati ipá ha wà, ti ẹnikan kò si, ti o le kò ọ loju?
entries.en: And said, O LORD God of our fathers, art not thou God in heaven? and rulest not thou over all the kingdoms of the heathen? and in thine hand is there not power and might, so that none is able to withstand thee?

entries.yo: Iwọ ha kọ́ Ọlọrun wa, ti o ti le awọn ara ilẹ yi jade niwaju Israeli enia rẹ, ti o si fi fun iru-ọmọ Abrahamu, ọrẹ rẹ lailai?
entries.en: Art not thou our God, who didst drive out the inhabitants of this land before thy people Israel, and gavest it to the seed of Abraham thy friend for ever?

entries.yo: Nwọn si ngbe inu rẹ̀, nwọn si kọ́ ibi-mimọ́ fun ọ ninu rẹ̀ fun orukọ rẹ, pe,
entries.en: And they dwelt therein, and have built thee a sanctuary therein for thy name, saying,

entries.yo: Bi ibi ba de si wa, bi idà, ijiya tabi àjakalẹ-àrun, tabi ìyan, bi awa ba duro niwaju ile yi, ati niwaju rẹ, (nitori orukọ rẹ wà ni ile yi): bi a ba ke pè ọ ninu wàhala wa, nigbana ni iwọ o gbọ́, iwọ o si ṣe iranlọwọ.
entries.en: If, when evil cometh upon us, as the sword, judgment, or pestilence, or famine, we stand before this house, and in thy presence, (for thy name is in this house,) and cry unto thee in our affliction, then thou wilt hear and help.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, kiyesi i, awọn ọmọ Ammoni ati Moabu, ati awọn ara òke Seiri, ti iwọ kò jẹ ki Israeli gbogun si nigbati nwọn jade ti ilẹ Egipti wá, ṣugbọn nwọn yipada kuro lọdọ wọn, nwọn kò si run wọn;
entries.en: And now, behold, the children of Ammon and Moab and mount Seir, whom thou wouldest not let Israel invade, when they came out of the land of Egypt, but they turned from them, and destroyed them not;

entries.yo: Si kiyesi i, bi nwọn ti san a pada fun wa; lati wá le wa jade kuro ninu ini rẹ, ti iwọ ti fi fun wa lati ni.
entries.en: Behold, I say, how they reward us, to come to cast us out of thy possession, which thou hast given us to inherit.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun wa! Iwọ kì o ha da wọn lẹjọ? nitori awa kò li agbara niwaju ọ̀pọlọpọ nla yi, ti mbọ̀ wá ba wa; awa kò si mọ̀ eyi ti awa o ṣe: ṣugbọn oju wa mbẹ lara rẹ.
entries.en: O our God, wilt thou not judge them? for we have no might against this great company that cometh against us; neither know we what to do: but our eyes are upon thee.

entries.yo: Gbogbo Juda si duro niwaju Oluwa, pẹlu awọn ọmọ wẹrẹ wọn, obinrin wọn, ati ọmọ wọn.
entries.en: And all Judah stood before the LORD, with their little ones, their wives, and their children.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn lori Jahasieli, ọmọ Sekariah, ọmọ Benaiah, ọmọ Jeieli, ọmọ Mattaniah, ọmọ Lefi kan ninu awọn ọmọ Asafu, ni ẹmi Oluwa wá li ãrin apejọ enia na.
entries.en: Then upon Jahaziel the son of Zechariah, the son of Benaiah, the son of Jeiel, the son of Mattaniah, a Levite of the sons of Asaph, came the Spirit of the LORD in the midst of the congregation;

entries.yo: O si wipe, Ẹ tẹti silẹ, gbogbo Judah, ati ẹnyin olugbe Jerusalemu, ati iwọ Jehoṣafati ọba; Bayi li Oluwa wi fun nyin, Ẹ máṣe bẹ̀ru, bẹ̃ni ki ẹ má si ṣe fòya nitori ọ̀pọlọpọ enia yi; nitori ogun na kì iṣe ti nyin bikòṣe ti Ọlọrun.
entries.en: And he said, Hearken ye, all Judah, and ye inhabitants of Jerusalem, and thou king Jehoshaphat, Thus saith the LORD unto you, Be not afraid nor dismayed by reason of this great multitude; for the battle is not yours, but God's.

entries.yo: Lọla sọ̀kalẹ tọ̀ wọn: kiyesi i, nwọn o gbà ibi igòke Sisi wá; ẹnyin o si ri wọn ni ipẹkun odò na, niwaju aginju Jerueli.
entries.en: To morrow go ye down against them: behold, they come up by the cliff of Ziz; and ye shall find them at the end of the brook, before the wilderness of Jeruel.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin kò ni ijà li ọ̀ran yi; ẹ tẹgun, ẹ duro jẹ, ki ẹ si ri igbala Oluwa lọdọ nyin, iwọ Juda ati Jerusalemu: ẹ máṣe bẹ̀ru, bẹ̃ni ki ẹ má si ṣe fòya: lọla, ẹ jade tọ̀ wọn: Oluwa yio si pẹlu nyin.
entries.en: Ye shall not need to fight in this battle: set yourselves, stand ye still, and see the salvation of the LORD with you, O Judah and Jerusalem: fear not, nor be dismayed; to morrow go out against them: for the LORD will be with you.

entries.yo: Jehoṣafati tẹ ori rẹ̀ ba silẹ: ati gbogbo Juda, ati awọn olugbe Jerusalemu wolẹ niwaju Oluwa lati sìn Oluwa.
entries.en: And Jehoshaphat bowed his head with his face to the ground: and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem fell before the LORD, worshipping the LORD.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Lefi, ninu awọn ọmọ Kohati ati ninu awọn ọmọ Kori si dide duro, lati fi ohùn rara kọrin iyìn soke si Oluwa Ọlọrun Israeli.
entries.en: And the Levites, of the children of the Kohathites, and of the children of the Korhites, stood up to praise the LORD God of Israel with a loud voice on high.

entries.yo: Nwọn si dide ni kutukutu owurọ, nwọn si jade lọ si aginju Tekoa: bi nwọn si ti jade lọ, Jehoṣafati duro, o si wipe, Ẹ gbọ́ temi, ẹnyin ará Juda, ati ẹnyin olugbe Jerusalemu. Ẹ gbà Oluwa Ọlọrun nyin gbọ́, bẹ̃li a o fi ẹsẹ nyin mulẹ; ẹ gbà awọn woli rẹ̀ gbọ́, bẹ̃li ẹnyin o ṣe rere.
entries.en: And they rose early in the morning, and went forth into the wilderness of Tekoa: and as they went forth, Jehoshaphat stood and said, Hear me, O Judah, and ye inhabitants of Jerusalem; Believe in the LORD your God, so shall ye be established; believe his prophets, so shall ye prosper.

entries.yo: O si ba awọn enia na gbero, o yàn awọn akọrin si Oluwa, ti yio ma yìn ẹwa ìwa-mimọ́ bi nwọn ti njade lọ niwaju ogun na, ati lati ma wipe, Ẹ yìn Oluwa: nitoriti ãnu rẹ̀ duro lailai.
entries.en: And when he had consulted with the people, he appointed singers unto the LORD, and that should praise the beauty of holiness, as they went out before the army, and to say, Praise the LORD; for his mercy endureth for ever.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn bẹ̀rẹ si ikọrin ati si iyìn, Oluwa yàn ogun-ẹhin si awọn ọmọ Ammoni, Moabu ati awọn ara òke Seiri, ti o wá si Juda, a si kọlù wọn.
entries.en: And when they began to sing and to praise, the LORD set ambushments against the children of Ammon, Moab, and mount Seir, which were come against Judah; and they were smitten.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Ammoni ati Moabu si dide si awọn ti ngbe òke Seiri, lati pa, ati lati run wọn tũtu: nigbati nwọn si pa awọn ti ngbe òke Seiri run tan, ẹnikini nṣe iranlọwọ lati run ẹnikeji.
entries.en: For the children of Ammon and Moab stood up against the inhabitants of mount Seir, utterly to slay and destroy them: and when they had made an end of the inhabitants of Seir, every one helped to destroy another.

entries.yo: Nigbati Juda si de iha ile-iṣọ li aginju, nwọn wò awọn ọ̀pọlọpọ enia, si kiyesi i, okú ti o ṣubu lulẹ ni nwọn, ẹnikan kò sá asalà.
entries.en: And when Judah came toward the watch tower in the wilderness, they looked unto the multitude, and, behold, they were dead bodies fallen to the earth, and none escaped.

entries.yo: Nigbati Jehoṣafati ati awọn enia rẹ̀ de lati kó ikogun wọn, nwọn ri lara wọn ọ̀pọlọpọ ọrọ̀, ati okú, ati ohun-elo iyebiye, nwọn si kójọ fun ara wọn, jù eyiti nwọn le kó lọ: nwọn si kó ikogun wọn jọ ni ijọ mẹta, nitoriti o sa papọ̀ju.
entries.en: And when Jehoshaphat and his people came to take away the spoil of them, they found among them in abundance both riches with the dead bodies, and precious jewels, which they stripped off for themselves, more than they could carry away: and they were three days in gathering of the spoil, it was so much.

entries.yo: Ati li ọjọ kẹrin nwọn kó ara wọn jọ li afonifoji Ibukún, nitori nibẹ ni nwọn fi ibukún fun Oluwa, nitorina ni a ṣe npe orukọ ibẹ na ni, Afonifoji Ibukún, titi di oni.
entries.en: And on the fourth day they assembled themselves in the valley of Berachah; for there they blessed the LORD: therefore the name of the same place was called, The valley of Berachah, unto this day.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni nwọn yipada, gbogbo awọn ọkunrin Juda ati Jerusalemu, ati Jehoṣafati niwaju wọn lati pada lọ si Jerusalemu pẹlu ayọ̀; nitori ti Oluwa ti mu wọn yọ̀ lori awọn ọta wọn.
entries.en: Then they returned, every man of Judah and Jerusalem, and Jehoshaphat in the forefront of them, to go again to Jerusalem with joy; for the LORD had made them to rejoice over their enemies.

entries.yo: Nwọn si wá si Jerusalemu pẹlu ohun-elo orin, ati duru ati ipè si ile Oluwa.
entries.en: And they came to Jerusalem with psalteries and harps and trumpets unto the house of the LORD.

entries.yo: Ibẹ̀ru Ọlọrun si wà lara gbogbo ijọba ilẹ wọnni, nigbati nwọn gbọ́ pe Oluwa ti ba awọn ọta Israeli jà.
entries.en: And the fear of God was on all the kingdoms of those countries, when they had heard that the LORD fought against the enemies of Israel.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni ijọba Jehoṣafati wà li alafia: nitoriti Ọlọrun rẹ̀ fun u ni isimi yikakiri.
entries.en: So the realm of Jehoshaphat was quiet: for his God gave him rest round about.

entries.yo: Jehoṣafati si jọba lori Juda: o si wà li ẹni ọdun marundilogoji, nigbati o bẹ̀rẹ si ijọba, o si jọba ọdun mẹdọgbọn ni Jerusalemu. Orukọ iya rẹ̀ si ni Asuba, ọmọbinrin Ṣilhi.
entries.en: And Jehoshaphat reigned over Judah: he was thirty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty and five years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.

entries.yo: O si rìn li ọ̀na Asa, baba rẹ̀, kò si yà kuro ninu rẹ̀, o nṣe eyi ti o tọ́ li oju Oluwa.
entries.en: And he walked in the way of Asa his father, and departed not from it, doing that which was right in the sight of the LORD.

entries.yo: Sibẹ kò mu ibi giga wọnni kuro: pẹlupẹlu awọn enia na kò si fi ọkàn wọn fun Ọlọrun awọn baba wọn rara.
entries.en: Howbeit the high places were not taken away: for as yet the people had not prepared their hearts unto the God of their fathers.

entries.yo: Ati iyokù iṣe Jehoṣafati, ti iṣaju ati ti ikẹhin, kiyẹsi i, a kọ wọn sinu iwe Jehu, ọmọ Hanani, a si ti fi i sinu iwe awọn ọba Israeli.
entries.en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of Jehu the son of Hanani, who is mentioned in the book of the kings of Israel.

entries.yo: Ati lẹhin eyi ni Jehoṣafati, ọba Juda, dà ara rẹ̀ pọ̀ mọ́ Ahasiah, ọba Israeli, ẹniti o ṣe buburu gidigidi:
entries.en: And after this did Jehoshaphat king of Judah join himself with Ahaziah king of Israel, who did very wickedly:

entries.yo: O si dà ara rẹ̀ pọ̀ mọ ọ lati kan ọkọ̀ lati lọ si Tarṣiṣi: nwọn si kàn ọkọ̀ ni Esion-Geberi.
entries.en: And he joined himself with him to make ships to go to Tarshish: and they made the ships in Ezion-geber.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Elieseri ọmọ Dodafah ti Mareṣa sọtẹlẹ si Jehoṣafati wipe, Nitori ti iwọ ti dá ara rẹ pọ̀ mọ Ahasiah, Oluwa ti ba iṣẹ rẹ jẹ. Awọn ọkọ̀ na si fọ́, nwọn kò si le lọ si Tarṣiṣi.
entries.en: Then Eliezer the son of Dodavah of Mareshah prophesied against Jehoshaphat, saying, Because thou hast joined thyself with Ahaziah, the LORD hath broken thy works. And the ships were broken, that they were not able to go to Tarshish.

entries.yo: JEHOṢAFATI si sùn pẹlu awọn baba rẹ̀, a si sìn i pẹlu awọn baba rẹ̀ ni ilu Dafidi: Jehoramu ọmọ rẹ̀ si jọba ni ipò rẹ̀.
entries.en: Now Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David. And Jehoram his son reigned in his stead.

entries.yo: O si ni awọn arakunrin, awọn ọmọ Jehoṣafati, Asariah, ati Jehieli, ati Sekariah, ati Asariah ati Mikaeli, ati Ṣefatiah: gbogbo awọn wọnyi li awọn ọmọ Jehoṣafati, ọba Juda.
entries.en: And he had brethren the sons of Jehoshaphat, Azariah, and Jehiel, and Zechariah, and Azariah, and Michael, and Shephatiah: all these were the sons of Jehoshaphat king of Israel.

entries.yo: Baba wọn si bun wọn li ẹ̀bun pupọ, ni fadakà ati ni wura, ati ohun iyebiye, pẹlu ilu olodi ni Juda, ṣugbọn o fi ijọba fun Jehoramu: nitori on li akọbi.
entries.en: And their father gave them great gifts of silver, and of gold, and of precious things, with fenced cities in Judah: but the kingdom gave he to Jehoram; because he was the firstborn.

entries.yo: Nigbati Jehoramu si dide si ijọba baba rẹ̀, o mu ara rẹ̀ le, o si fi idà pa gbogbo awọn arakunrin rẹ̀, ati ninu awọn ijoye Israeli.
entries.en: Now when Jehoram was risen up to the kingdom of his father, he strengthened himself, and slew all his brethren with the sword, and divers also of the princes of Israel.

entries.yo: Jehoramu jẹ ẹni ọdun mejilelọgbọ̀n nigbati o bẹ̀rẹ si ijọba, o si jọba li ọdun mẹjọ ni Jerusalemu.
entries.en: Jehoram was thirty and two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem.

entries.yo: O si rìn li ọ̀na awọn ọba Israeli, gẹgẹ bi ile Ahabu ti ṣe: nitoriti o ni ọmọbinrin Ahabu li aya: o si ṣe eyiti o buru li oju Oluwa.
entries.en: And he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, like as did the house of Ahab: for he had the daughter of Ahab to wife: and he wrought that which was evil in the eyes of the LORD.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Oluwa kò fẹ ipa ile Dafidi run, nitori majẹmu ti o ti ba Dafidi da, ati bi o ti ṣe ileri lati fun u ni imọlẹ kan ati fun awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ lailai.
entries.en: Howbeit the LORD would not destroy the house of David, because of the covenant that he had made with David, and as he promised to give a light to him and to his sons for ever.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ rẹ̀ li awọn ara Edomu ṣọ̀tẹ kuro labẹ ọwọ Juda, nwọn si jẹ ọba fun ara wọn.
entries.en: In his days the Edomites revolted from under the dominion of Judah, and made themselves a king.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Jehoramu rekọja lọ pẹlu awọn ijoye rẹ̀, ati gbogbo kẹkẹ́ rẹ̀ pẹlu rẹ̀: o si dide li oru, o si kọlù awọn ara Edomu ti o ká a mọ, ati awọn olori kẹkẹ́.
entries.en: Then Jehoram went forth with his princes, and all his chariots with him: and he rose up by night, and smote the Edomites which compassed him in, and the captains of the chariots.

entries.yo: Sibẹ awọn ara Edomu ṣọ̀tẹ kuro labẹ ọwọ Juda, titi di oni yi. Akokò na pẹlu ni Libna ṣọ̀tẹ kuro labẹ ọwọ rẹ̀; nitoriti o ti kọ̀ Oluwa, Ọlọrun awọn baba rẹ̀ silẹ.
entries.en: So the Edomites revolted from under the hand of Judah unto this day. The same time also did Libnah revolt from under his hand; because he had forsaken the LORD God of his fathers.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu o ṣe ibi giga wọnni lori òke Judah, o si mu ki awọn olugbe Jerusalemu ki o ṣe àgbere, o si mu Juda ṣẹ̀.
entries.en: Moreover he made high places in the mountains of Judah, and caused the inhabitants of Jerusalem to commit fornication, and compelled Judah thereto.

entries.yo: Iwe kan si ti ọdọ Elijah, woli, wá si ọdọ rẹ̀ wipe: Bayi li Oluwa, Ọlọrun Dafidi baba rẹ wi, nitoriti iwọ kò rìn li ọ̀na Jehoṣafati, baba rẹ, tabi li ọ̀na Asa, ọba Juda;
entries.en: And there came a writing to him from Elijah the prophet, saying, Thus saith the LORD God of David thy father, Because thou hast not walked in the ways of Jehoshaphat thy father, nor in the ways of Asa king of Judah,

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ti iwọ rìn li ọ̀na awọn ọba Israeli, iwọ si ti mu Juda ati awọn olugbe Jerusalemu tọ ọ̀na panṣaga, gẹgẹ bi panṣaga ile Ahabu, ati ti iwọ si pa awọn arakunrin ile baba rẹ ti o jẹ ẹni-rere jù iwọ lọ:
entries.en: But hast walked in the way of the kings of Israel, and hast made Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to go a whoring, like to the whoredoms of the house of Ahab, and also hast slain thy brethren of thy father's house, which were better than thyself:

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, Oluwa yio fi àjakalẹ-arun nla kọlù awọn enia rẹ, ati awọn ọmọ rẹ, ati awọn obinrin rẹ, ati gbogbo ọrọ̀ rẹ:
entries.en: Behold, with a great plague will the LORD smite thy people, and thy children, and thy wives, and all thy goods:

entries.yo: Iwọ o ṣe aisan pupọ, àrun nla ninu ifun rẹ, titi ifun rẹ yio fi tu jade nitori àrun ọjọ pupọ.
entries.en: And thou shalt have great sickness by disease of thy bowels, until thy bowels fall out by reason of the sickness day by day.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu, Oluwa ru ẹmi awọn ara Filistia, ati ti awọn ara Arabia, ti o sunmọ awọn ara Etiopia, soke si Jehoramu.
entries.en: Moreover the LORD stirred up against Jehoram the spirit of the Philistines, and of the Arabians, that were near the Ethiopians:

entries.yo: Nwọn si gòke wá si Juda, nwọn si ya wọle, nwọn si kó gbogbo ọrọ̀ ti a ri ni ile ọba ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ pẹlu, ati awọn obinrin rẹ̀, ni igbekun lọ; tobẹ̃ ti a kò ṣẹ́ku ọkunrin kan silẹ fun u, bikòṣe Jehoahasi, abikẹhin ninu awọn ọmọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And they came up into Judah, and brake into it, and carried away all the substance that was found in the king's house, and his sons also, and his wives; so that there was never a son left him, save Jehoahaz, the youngest of his sons.

entries.yo: Lẹhin gbogbo eyi Oluwa fi àrun, ti a kò le wòsan, kọlù u ni ifun.
entries.en: And after all this the LORD smote him in his bowels with an incurable disease.

entries.yo: O si ṣe bẹ̃ bi akokò ti nlọ ati lẹhin ọdun meji, ni ifun rẹ̀ tu jade nitori aìsan rẹ̀, o si kú ninu irora buburu na: awọn enia rẹ̀ kò si ṣe ijona fun u gẹgẹ bi ijona ti awọn baba rẹ̀.
entries.en: And it came to pass, that in process of time, after the end of two years, his bowels fell out by reason of his sickness: so he died of sore diseases. And his people made no burning for him, like the burning of his fathers.

entries.yo: Ẹni ọdun mejilelọgbọn ni nigbati o bẹ̀rẹ si ijọba, o si jọba ọdun mẹjọ ni Jerusalemu, o si fi ilẹ silẹ laiwu ni: nwọn si sìn i ni ilu Dafidi; ṣugbọn kì iṣe ninu iboji awọn ọba.
entries.en: Thirty and two years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years, and departed without being desired. Howbeit they buried him in the city of David, but not in the sepulchres of the kings.

entries.yo: AWỌN olugbe Jerusalemu, si fi Ahasiah, ọmọ rẹ̀ abikẹhin, jọba ni ipò rẹ̀: nitori awọn ẹgbẹ́ ogun, ti o ba awọn ara Arabia wá ibudo, ti pa gbogbo awọn ẹgbọn. Bẹ̃ni Ahasiah, ọmọ Jehoramu, ọba Juda, jọba.
entries.en: And the inhabitants of Jerusalem made Ahaziah his youngest son king in his stead: for the band of men that came with the Arabians to the camp had slain all the eldest. So Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah reigned.

entries.yo: Ẹni ọdun mejilelogun ni Ahasiah, nigbati o bẹ̀rẹ si ijọba, o si jọba ọdun kan ni Jerusalemu. Orukọ iya rẹ̀ si ni Ataliah, ọmọbinrin Omri.
entries.en: Forty and two years old was Ahaziah when he began to reign, and he reigned one year in Jerusalem. His mother's name also was Athaliah the daughter of Omri.

entries.yo: On pẹlu rìn li ọ̀na Ahabu: nitori iya rẹ̀ ni igbimọ̀ rẹ̀ lati ṣe buburu.
entries.en: He also walked in the ways of the house of Ahab: for his mother was his counseller to do wickedly.

entries.yo: O si ṣe buburu loju Oluwa bi ile Ahabu: nitori awọn wọnyi li o nṣe igbimọ̀ rẹ̀ lẹhin ikú baba rẹ̀ si iparun rẹ̀.
entries.en: Wherefore he did evil in the sight of the LORD like the house of Ahab: for they were his counsellers after the death of his father to his destruction.

entries.yo: O tẹle imọ̀ran wọn pẹlu; o si ba Jehoramu, ọmọ Ahabu, ọba Israeli, lọ iba Hasaeli, ọba Siria jagun, ni Ramoti-Gileadi: awọn ara Siria si ṣá Jehoramu li ọgbẹ.
entries.en: He walked also after their counsel, and went with Jehoram the son of Ahab king of Israel to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramoth-gilead: and the Syrians smote Joram.

entries.yo: O si pada lọ iwora ni Jesreeli, nitori ọgbẹ ti a ṣá a ni Rama, nigbati o fi ba Hasaeli, ọba Siria jà. Ahasiah, ọmọ Jehoramu, ọba Juda, si sọ̀kalẹ lọ iwò Jehoramu, ọmọ Ahabu, ni Jesreeli, nitoriti o ṣaisan.
entries.en: And he returned to be healed in Jezreel because of the wounds which were given him at Ramah, when he fought with Hazael king of Syria. And Azariah the son of Jehoram king of Judah went down to see Jehoram the son of Ahab at Jezreel, because he was sick.

entries.yo: Iparun Ahasiah lati ọwọ Ọlọrun wá ni, nipa wiwá sọdọ Jehoramu: nigbati o si de, o si ba Jehoramu jade tọ̀ Jehu, ọmọ Nimṣi, ẹniti Oluwa fi ororo yàn lati ké ile Ahabu kuro.
entries.en: And the destruction of Ahaziah was of God by coming to Joram: for when he was come, he went out with Jehoram against Jehu the son of Nimshi, whom the LORD had anointed to cut off the house of Ahab.

entries.yo: O si ṣe nigbati Jehu nmu idajọ ṣẹ sori ile Ahabu, o si ri awọn ijoye Juda, ati awọn ọmọ awọn arakunrin Ahasiah, ti nṣe iranṣẹ fun Ahasiah, o si pa wọn.
entries.en: And it came to pass, that, when Jehu was executing judgment upon the house of Ahab, and found the princes of Judah, and the sons of the brethren of Ahaziah, that ministered to Ahaziah, he slew them.

entries.yo: O si wá Ahasiah: nwọn si mu u, (on sa ti fi ara pamọ́ ni Samaria,) nwọn si mu u tọ̀ Jehu wá: nigbati nwọn si pa a tan, nwọn sìn i: nitori ti nwọn wipe, ọmọ Jehoṣafati ni, ẹniti o wá Oluwa tọkàntọkan rẹ̀. Bẹ̃ni kò si ẹnikan ni ile Ahasiah ti o yẹ fun ijọba.
entries.en: And he sought Ahaziah: and they caught him, (for he was hid in Samaria,) and brought him to Jehu: and when they had slain him, they buried him: Because, said they, he is the son of Jehoshaphat, who sought the LORD with all his heart. So the house of Ahaziah had no power to keep still the kingdom.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati Ataliah, iya Ahasiah, ri pe ọmọ on kú, o dide o si run gbogbo iru ọmọ ijọba ile Judah.
entries.en: But when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the seed royal of the house of Judah.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Jehoṣabeati, ọmọbinrin ọba, mu Joaṣi, ọmọ Ahasiah, o ji i kuro ninu awọn ọmọ ọba ti a pa, o fi on ati olutọ rẹ̀ sinu yẹwu Ibusùn. Bẹ̃ni Jehoṣabeati, ọmọbinrin Jehoramu ọba, aya Jehoiada, alufa, (nitori arabinrin Ahasiah li on) o pa a mọ́ kuro lọdọ Ataliah ki o má ba pa a.
entries.en: But Jehoshabeath, the daughter of the king, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stole him from among the king's sons that were slain, and put him and his nurse in a bedchamber. So Jehoshabeath, the daughter of king Jehoram, the wife of Jehoiada the priest, (for she was the sister of Ahaziah,) hid him from Athaliah, so that she slew him not.

entries.yo: O si wà pẹlu wọn ni pipamọ́ ninu ile Ọlọrun li ọdun mẹfa: Ataliah si jọba lori ilẹ na.
entries.en: And he was with them hid in the house of God six years: and Athaliah reigned over the land.

entries.yo: ATI li ọdun keje, Jehoiada mu ọkàn le, o si ba awọn olori ọrọrún dá majẹmu pẹlu, ani Asariah, ọmọ Jerohamu ati Iṣmaeli, ọmọ Jehohanani, ati Asariah ọmọ Obedi, ati Maaseiah, ọmọ Adaiah, ati Eliṣafati ọmọ Sikri.
entries.en: And in the seventh year Jehoiada strengthened himself, and took the captains of hundreds, Azariah the son of Jeroham, and Ishmael the son of Jehohanan, and Azariah the son of Obed, and Maaseiah the son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat the son of Zichri, into covenant with him.

entries.yo: Nwọn si lọ kakiri ni Juda, nwọn si kó awọn ọmọ Lefi jọ lati inu gbogbo ilu Juda, ati olori awọn baba ni Israeli, nwọn si wá si Jerusalemu.
entries.en: And they went about in Judah, and gathered the Levites out of all the cities of Judah, and the chief of the fathers of Israel, and they came to Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ijọ enia si ba ọba dá majẹmu ni ile Ọlọrun. O si wi fun wọn pe, Kiyesi i, ọmọ ọba ni yio jọba, gẹgẹ bi Oluwa ti wi niti awọn ọmọ Dafidi.
