entries.en: After this did Sennacherib king of Assyria send his servants to Jerusalem, (but he himself laid siege against Lachish, and all his power with him,) unto Hezekiah king of Judah, and unto all Judah that were at Jerusalem, saying,

entries.yo: Bayi ni Sennakeribu, ọba Assiria, wi pe, Kili ẹnyin gbẹkẹle, ti ẹnyin joko ninu odi agbara ni Jerusalemu?
entries.en: Thus saith Sennacherib king of Assyria, Whereon do ye trust, that ye abide in the siege in Jerusalem?

entries.yo: Kò ṣepe Hesekiah ntàn nyin lati fi ara nyin fun ikú, nipa ìyan, ati nipa ongbẹ, o nwipe, Oluwa, Ọlọrun wa, yio gbà wa lọwọ ọba Assiria?
entries.en: Doth not Hezekiah persuade you to give over yourselves to die by famine and by thirst, saying, The LORD our God shall deliver us out of the hand of the king of Assyria?

entries.yo: Kò ṣepe Hesekiah kanna li o mu ibi giga rẹ̀ wọnni kuro, ati pẹpẹ rẹ̀, ti o si paṣẹ fun Juda ati Jerusalemu, wipe, Ki ẹnyin ki o mã sìn niwaju pẹpẹ kan, ki ẹnyin ki o mã sun turari lori rẹ̀?
entries.en: Hath not the same Hezekiah taken away his high places and his altars, and commanded Judah and Jerusalem, saying, Ye shall worship before one altar, and burn incense upon it?

entries.yo: Enyin kò ha mọ̀ ohun ti emi ati awọn baba mi ti ṣe si gbogbo enia ilẹ miran? awọn oriṣa awọn orilẹ-ède ilẹ wọnni ha le gbà ilẹ wọn lọwọ mi rara?
entries.en: Know ye not what I and my fathers have done unto all the people of other lands? were the gods of the nations of those lands any ways able to deliver their lands out of mine hand?

entries.yo: Tani ninu gbogbo awọn oriṣa orilẹ-ède wọnni, ti awọn baba mi parun tũtu, ti o le gbà enia rẹ̀ lọwọ mi, ti Ọlọrun nyin yio fi le gbà nyin lọwọ mi?
entries.en: Who was there among all the gods of those nations that my fathers utterly destroyed, that could deliver his people out of mine hand, that your God should be able to deliver you out of mine hand?

entries.yo: Njẹ nitorina, ẹ máṣe jẹ ki Hesekiah ki o tàn nyin jẹ, bẹ̃ni ki o máṣe rọ̀ nyin bi iru eyi, bẹ̃ni ki ẹ máṣe gbà a gbọ́: nitoriti kò si oriṣa orilẹ-ède tabi ijọba kan ti o le gbà enia rẹ̀ lọwọ mi, ati lọwọ awọn baba mi: ambọtori Ọlọrun nyin ti yio fi gbà nyin lọwọ mi?
entries.en: Now therefore let not Hezekiah deceive you, nor persuade you on this manner, neither yet believe him: for no god of any nation or kingdom was able to deliver his people out of mine hand, and out of the hand of my fathers: how much less shall your God deliver you out of mine hand?

entries.yo: Awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀ si sọ jù bẹ̃ lọ si Oluwa Ọlọrun, ati si iranṣẹ rẹ̀, Hesekiah.
entries.en: And his servants spake yet more against the LORD God, and against his servant Hezekiah.

entries.yo: O kọ iwe pẹlu lati kẹgan Oluwa, Ọlọrun Israeli, ati lati sọ̀rọ òdi si i, wipe, Gẹgẹ bi awọn oriṣa orilẹ-ède ilẹ miran kò ti gbà awọn enia wọn lọwọ mi, bẹ̃li Ọlọrun Hesekiah kì yio gbà awọn enia rẹ̀ lọwọ mi.
entries.en: He wrote also letters to rail on the LORD God of Israel, and to speak against him, saying, As the gods of the nations of other lands have not delivered their people out of mine hand, so shall not the God of Hezekiah deliver his people out of mine hand.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni nwọn kigbe li ohùn rara li ède Juda si awọn enia Jerusalemu ti mbẹ lori odi, lati dẹruba wọn, ati lati dãmu wọn; ki nwọn ki o le kó ilu na.
entries.en: Then they cried with a loud voice in the Jews' speech unto the people of Jerusalem that were on the wall, to affright them, and to trouble them; that they might take the city.

entries.yo: Nwọn si sọ̀rọ òdi si Ọlọrun Jerusalemu, bi ẹnipe si awọn oriṣa enia ilẹ aiye, ti iṣe iṣẹ ọwọ enia.
entries.en: And they spake against the God of Jerusalem, as against the gods of the people of the earth, which were the work of the hands of man.

entries.yo: Ati nitori eyi ni Hesekiah, ọba, ati Isaiah woli, ọmọ Amosi, gbadura, nwọn si kigbe si ọrun.
entries.en: And for this cause Hezekiah the king, and the prophet Isaiah the son of Amoz, prayed and cried to heaven.

entries.yo: Oluwa si rán Angeli kan, ẹniti o pa gbogbo awọn alagbara ogun, ati awọn aṣãju, ati awọn balogun ni ibudo ọba Assiria. Bẹ̃li o fi itiju pada si ilẹ on tikararẹ̀. Nigbati o si wá sinu ile oriṣa rẹ̀, awọn ti o ti inu ara rẹ̀ jade si fi idà pa a nibẹ.
entries.en: And the LORD sent an angel, which cut off all the mighty men of valour, and the leaders and captains in the camp of the king of Assyria. So he returned with shame of face to his own land. And when he was come into the house of his god, they that came forth of his own bowels slew him there with the sword.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa gbà Hesekiah ati awọn ti ngbe Jerusalemu lọwọ Sennakeribu ọba Assiria, ati lọwọ gbogbo awọn omiran, o si ṣọ́ wọn ni iha gbogbo.
entries.en: Thus the LORD saved Hezekiah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem from the hand of Sennacherib the king of Assyria, and from the hand of all other, and guided them on every side.

entries.yo: Ọ̀pọlọpọ si mu ẹ̀bun fun Oluwa wá si Jerusalemu, ati ọrẹ fun Hesekiah, ọba Juda: a si gbé e ga loju gbogbo orilẹ-ède lẹhin na.
entries.en: And many brought gifts unto the LORD to Jerusalem, and presents to Hezekiah king of Judah: so that he was magnified in the sight of all nations from thenceforth.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ wọnni, Hesekiah ṣe aisan de oju ikú, o si gbadura si Oluwa; O si da a lohùn, O si fi àmi kan fun u.
entries.en: In those days Hezekiah was sick to the death, and prayed unto the LORD: and he spake unto him, and he gave him a sign.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Hesekiah kò si tun pada san gẹgẹ bi ore ti a ṣe fun u: nitoriti ọkàn rẹ̀ gbega: nitorina ni ibinu ṣe wà lori rẹ̀, lori Juda, ati lori Jerusalemu.
entries.en: But Hezekiah rendered not again according to the benefit done unto him; for his heart was lifted up: therefore there was wrath upon him, and upon Judah and Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Hesekiah rẹ̀ ara rẹ̀ silẹ, niti igberaga ọkàn rẹ̀, ati on ati awọn ti ngbe Jerusalemu, bẹ̃ni ibinu Oluwa kò wá sori wọn li ọjọ Hesekiah.
entries.en: Notwithstanding Hezekiah humbled himself for the pride of his heart, both he and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, so that the wrath of the LORD came not upon them in the days of Hezekiah.

entries.yo: Hesekiah si li ọrọ̀ li ọ̀pọlọpọ ati ọlá: o si ṣe ibi-iṣura fun ara rẹ̀ fun fadakà, ati fun wura, ati fun okuta iyebiye, ati fun turari ati fun apata, ati fun oniruru ohun-elo iyebiye.
entries.en: And Hezekiah had exceeding much riches and honour: and he made himself treasuries for silver, and for gold, and for precious stones, and for spices, and for shields, and for all manner of pleasant jewels;

entries.yo: Ile-iṣura pẹlu fun ibisi ọkà, ati ọti-waini; ati ororo; ati ile fun gbogbo oniruru ẹran, ati ọgbà fun agbo-ẹran.
entries.en: Storehouses also for the increase of corn, and wine, and oil; and stalls for all manner of beasts, and cotes for flocks.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu o ṣe ilu fun ara rẹ̀, ati agbo agutan ati agbo malu li ọ̀pọlọpọ: nitoriti Ọlọrun fun u li ọrọ̀ li ọ̀pọlọpọ.
entries.en: Moreover he provided him cities, and possessions of flocks and herds in abundance: for God had given him substance very much.

entries.yo: Hesekiah kanna yi li o dí ipa-omi ti o wà li òke Gihoni pẹlu, o si mu u wá isalẹ tara si iha iwọ-õrun ilu Dafidi. Hesekiah si ṣe rere ni gbogbo iṣẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: This same Hezekiah also stopped the upper watercourse of Gihon, and brought it straight down to the west side of the city of David. And Hezekiah prospered in all his works.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn niti awọn ikọ̀ awọn ọmọ-alade Babeli, ti nwọn ranṣẹ si i, lati bère ohun-iyanu ti a ṣe ni ilẹ na, Ọlọrun fi i silẹ lati dán a wò, ki o le mọ̀ ohun gbogbo ti o wà li ọkàn rẹ̀.
entries.en: Howbeit in the business of the ambassadors of the princes of Babylon, who sent unto him to inquire of the wonder that was done in the land, God left him, to try him, that he might know all that was in his heart.

entries.yo: Ati iyokù iṣe Hesekiah ati iṣẹ rere rẹ̀, kiyesi i, a kọ wọn sinu iwe iran Isaiah woli, ọmọ Amosi, ani ninu iwe awọn ọba Juda ati Israeli.
entries.en: Now the rest of the acts of Hezekiah, and his goodness, behold, they are written in the vision of Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, and in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

entries.yo: Hesekiah si sùn pẹlu awọn baba rẹ̀, nwọn si sin i ninu iboji awọn ọmọ Dafidi: ati gbogbo Juda ati awọn ti ngbe Jerusalemu ṣe ẹyẹ fun u ni iku rẹ̀. Manasse ọmọ rẹ̀, si jọba ni ipò rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Hezekiah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the chiefest of the sepulchres of the sons of David: and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem did him honour at his death. And Manasseh his son reigned in his stead.

entries.yo: ẸNI ọdun mejila ni Manasse, nigbati o bẹ̀rẹ si ijọba, o si jọba ọdun marundilọgọta ni Jerusalemu:
entries.en: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty and five years in Jerusalem:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn o ṣe buburu li oju Oluwa, bi irira awọn orilẹ-ède, ti Oluwa le jade niwaju awọn ọmọ Israeli.
entries.en: But did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, like unto the abominations of the heathen, whom the LORD had cast out before the children of Israel.

entries.yo: Nitori ti o tun kọ́ ibi giga wọnni ti Hesekiah baba rẹ̀, ti wó lulẹ, o si gbé pẹpẹ wọnni soke fun Baalimu, o si ṣe ere oriṣa, o si mbọ gbogbo ogun ọrun, o si nsìn wọn.
entries.en: For he built again the high places which Hezekiah his father had broken down, and he reared up altars for Baalim, and made groves, and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served them.

entries.yo: O tẹ́ pẹpẹ pẹlu ni ile Oluwa, niti eyiti Oluwa ti sọ pe; Ni Jerusalemu li orukọ mi yio wà lailai.
entries.en: Also he built altars in the house of the LORD, whereof the LORD had said, In Jerusalem shall my name be for ever.

entries.yo: O si tẹ́ pẹpẹ fun gbogbo ogun ọrun li àgbala mejeji ile Oluwa.
entries.en: And he built altars for all the host of heaven in the two courts of the house of the LORD.

entries.yo: O si mu ki awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ ki o kọja lãrin iná àfonifoji ọmọ Hinnomu: ati pẹlu o nṣe akiyesi afọṣẹ, o si nlò alupayida, o si nṣe ajẹ́, o si mba okú lò, ati pẹlu oṣó: o ṣe buburu pupọ̀ li oju Oluwa lati mu u binu.
entries.en: And he caused his children to pass through the fire in the valley of the son of Hinnom: also he observed times, and used enchantments, and used witchcraft, and dealt with a familiar spirit, and with wizards: he wrought much evil in the sight of the LORD, to provoke him to anger.

entries.yo: O si gbé ere gbigbẹ kalẹ, ere ti o ti yá sinu ile Ọlọrun, niti eyiti Ọlọrun ti sọ fun Dafidi ati Solomoni, ọmọ rẹ̀, pe, Ninu ile yi, ati ni Jerusalemu ti emi ti yàn ninu gbogbo ẹ̀ya Israeli, li emi o fi orukọ mi si lailai:
entries.en: And he set a carved image, the idol which he had made, in the house of God, of which God had said to David and to Solomon his son, In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen before all the tribes of Israel, will I put my name for ever:

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li emi kì yio ṣi ẹsẹ Israeli mọ kuro ni ilẹ na ti emi ti yàn fun awọn baba nyin; kiki bi nwọn ba ṣe akiyesi lati ṣe gbogbo eyiti emi ti pa li aṣẹ fun wọn, gẹgẹ bi gbogbo ofin ati aṣẹ ati ilana lati ọwọ Mose wá.
entries.en: Neither will I any more remove the foot of Israel from out of the land which I have appointed for your fathers; so that they will take heed to do all that I have commanded them, according to the whole law and the statutes and the ordinances by the hand of Moses.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Manasse mu ki Judah ati awọn ti ngbe Jerusalemu ki o yapa, ati lati ṣe buburu jù awọn orilẹ-ède lọ, awọn ẹniti Oluwa ti parun niwaju awọn ọmọ Israeli.
entries.en: So Manasseh made Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to err, and to do worse than the heathen, whom the LORD had destroyed before the children of Israel.

entries.yo: Oluwa si ba Manasse wi ati awọn enia rẹ̀; ṣugbọn nwọn kò kiyesi i.
entries.en: And the LORD spake to Manasseh, and to his people: but they would not hearken.

entries.yo: Nitorina li Oluwa mu awọn balogun ogun Assiria wá ba wọn, ti nwọn fi ìwọ mu Manasse, nwọn si de e li ẹ̀wọn, nwọn mu u lọ si Babeli.
entries.en: Wherefore the LORD brought upon them the captains of the host of the king of Assyria, which took Manasseh among the thorns, and bound him with fetters, and carried him to Babylon.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si wà ninu wahala, o bẹ̀ Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ̀, o si rẹ̀ ara rẹ̀ silẹ gidigidi niwaju Ọlọrun awọn baba rẹ̀,
entries.en: And when he was in affliction, he besought the LORD his God, and humbled himself greatly before the God of his fathers,

entries.yo: O si gbadura si i: Ọlọrun si gbọ́ ẹ̀bẹ rẹ̀, o si tun mu u pada wá si Jerusalemu sinu ijọba rẹ̀. Nigbana ni Manasse mọ̀ pe: Oluwa, On li Ọlọrun.
entries.en: And prayed unto him: and he was intreated of him, and heard his supplication, and brought him again to Jerusalem into his kingdom. Then Manasseh knew that the LORD he was God.

entries.yo: Njẹ lẹhin eyi, o mọ odi kan lẹhin ilu Dafidi, niha ìwọ-õrun Gihoni, li àfonifoji, ani li atiwọ ẹnu-bode ẹja, o si yi Ofeli ka, o si mọ ọ ga soke gidigidi, o si fi balogun sinu gbogbo ilú olodi Juda wọnni.
entries.en: Now after this he built a wall without the city of David, on the west side of Gihon, in the valley, even to the entering in at the fish gate, and compassed about Ophel, and raised it up a very great height, and put captains of war in all the fenced cities of Judah.

entries.yo: O si kó awọn àjeji ọlọrun ati ere kuro ni ile Oluwa, ati gbogbo pẹpẹ ti o ti tẹ́ lori òke ile Oluwa ati ni Jerusalemu, o si kó wọn danu kuro ni ilu.
entries.en: And he took away the strange gods, and the idol out of the house of the LORD, and all the altars that he had built in the mount of the house of the LORD, and in Jerusalem, and cast them out of the city.

entries.yo: O si tun pẹpẹ Oluwa ṣe, o si rú ẹbọ alafia ati ẹbọ ọpẹ lori rẹ̀, o si paṣẹ fun Juda lati ma sìn Oluwa Ọlọrun Israeli.
entries.en: And he repaired the altar of the LORD, and sacrificed thereon peace offerings and thank offerings, and commanded Judah to serve the LORD God of Israel.

entries.yo: Sibẹ awọn enia nṣe irubọ ni ibi giga wọnni, kiki si Oluwa, Ọlọrun wọn nikan ni.
entries.en: Nevertheless the people did sacrifice still in the high places, yet unto the LORD their God only.

entries.yo: Ati iyokù iṣe Manasse, ati adura rẹ̀ si Ọlọrun rẹ̀, ati ọ̀rọ awọn ariran ti o ba a sọ̀rọ li orukọ Oluwa Ọlọrun Israeli, kiye si i, o wà ninu iwe ọba Israeli.
entries.en: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and his prayer unto his God, and the words of the seers that spake to him in the name of the LORD God of Israel, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel.

entries.yo: Adura rẹ̀ na pẹlu, bi Ọlọrun ti gbọ́ ẹ̀bẹ rẹ̀, ati gbogbo ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ̀, ati irekọja rẹ̀ ati ibi ti o gbe kọ́ ibi giga wọnni ti o si gbé ere-oriṣa kalẹ, ati awọn ere yiyá, ki a to rẹ̀ ẹ silẹ, kiye si i, a kọ wọn sinu iwe itan Hosai.
entries.en: His prayer also, and how God was intreated of him, and all his sin, and his trespass, and the places wherein he built high places, and set up groves and graven images, before he was humbled: behold, they are written among the sayings of the seers.

entries.yo: Manasse si sùn pẹlu awọn baba rẹ̀, nwọn si sìn i si ile on tikalarẹ̀: Amoni, ọmọ rẹ̀, si jọba ni ipò rẹ̀.
entries.en: So Manasseh slept with his fathers, and they buried him in his own house: and Amon his son reigned in his stead.

entries.yo: Ẹni ọdun mejidilogun ni Amoni, nigbati o bẹ̀rẹ si ijọba, o si jọba ọdun meji ni Jerusalemu.
entries.en: Amon was two and twenty years old when he began to reign, and reigned two years in Jerusalem.

entries.yo: O si ṣe eyi ti o buru li oju Oluwa, bi Manasse, baba rẹ̀ ti ṣe, nitori Amoni rubọ si gbogbo awọn ere yiyá, ti Manasse baba rẹ̀ ti ṣe, o si sìn wọn:
entries.en: But he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, as did Manasseh his father: for Amon sacrificed unto all the carved images which Manasseh his father had made, and served them;

entries.yo: Kò si rẹ̀ ara rẹ̀ silẹ niwaju Oluwa bi Manasse, baba rẹ̀, ti rẹ̀ ara rẹ̀ silẹ; ṣugbọn Amoni dẹṣẹ pupọpupọ.
entries.en: And humbled not himself before the LORD, as Manasseh his father had humbled himself; but Amon trespassed more and more.

entries.yo: Awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀ si di rikiṣi si i, nwọn si pa a ni ile rẹ̀.
entries.en: And his servants conspired against him, and slew him in his own house.

entries.yo: Awọn enia ilẹ na si pa gbogbo awọn ti o ti di rikiṣi si Amoni, ọba; awọn enia ilẹ na si fi Josiah, ọmọ rẹ̀, jọba ni ipò rẹ̀.
entries.en: But the people of the land slew all them that had conspired against king Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his stead.

entries.yo: ẸNI ọdun mẹjọ, ni Josiah, nigbati o bẹ̀rẹ si ijọba, o si jọba ọdun mọkanlelọgbọn ni Jerusalemu.
entries.en: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem one and thirty years.

entries.yo: O si ṣe eyiti o tọ́ li oju Oluwa, o si rìn li ọ̀na Dafidi, baba rẹ̀, kò si yà si ọwọ ọtún tabi si òsi.
entries.en: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD, and walked in the ways of David his father, and declined neither to the right hand, nor to the left.

entries.yo: Nitori li ọdun kẹjọ ijọba rẹ̀, nigbati o si wà li ọdọmọde sibẹ, o bẹ̀rẹ si iwá Ọlọrun Dafidi, baba rẹ̀; ati li ọdun kejila, o bẹ̀rẹ si iwẹ̀ Juda ati Jerusalemu mọ́ kuro ninu ibi giga wọnni, ati ere-oriṣa, ati ere yiyá, ati ere didà.
entries.en: For in the eighth year of his reign, while he was yet young, he began to seek after the God of David his father: and in the twelfth year he began to purge Judah and Jerusalem from the high places, and the groves, and the carved images, and the molten images.

entries.yo: Nwọn si wó pẹpẹ Baalimu lulẹ niwaju rẹ̀; ati awọn ere õrun ti o wà lori wọn li o ké lulẹ; ati awọn ere-oriṣa, ati awọn ere yiyá, ati awọn ere didà, li o fọ tũtu, o sọ wọn di ekuru, o si gbọ̀n ọ sori isa-okú awọn ti o ti nrubọ́ si wọn.
entries.en: And they brake down the altars of Baalim in his presence; and the images, that were on high above them, he cut down; and the groves, and the carved images, and the molten images, he brake in pieces, and made dust of them, and strowed it upon the graves of them that had sacrificed unto them.

entries.yo: O si sun egungun awọn alufa-oriṣa lori pẹpẹ wọn; o si wẹ Juda ati Jerusàlemu mọ́.
entries.en: And he burnt the bones of the priests upon their altars, and cleansed Judah and Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li o si ṣe ni ilu Manasse wọnni ati ti Efraimu, ati ti Simeoni, ani titi de Naftali, o tú ile wọn yikakiri.
entries.en: And so did he in the cities of Manasseh, and Ephraim, and Simeon, even unto Naphtali, with their mattocks round about.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si fọ́ awọn pẹpẹ ati ère-oriṣa dilẹ, ti o si ti gún awọn ere yiyá di ẹ̀tu, ti o si ti ké gbogbo awọn ère-õrun lulẹ ni gbogbo ilẹ Israeli, o pada si Jerusalemu.
entries.en: And when he had broken down the altars and the groves, and had beaten the graven images into powder, and cut down all the idols throughout all the land of Israel, he returned to Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Njẹ li ọdun kejidilogun ijọba rẹ̀, nigbati o ti wẹ̀ ilẹ na mọ́, ati ile na, o rán Ṣafani, ọmọ Asaliah, ati Maaseiah, olori ilu na, ati Joa, ọmọ Joahasi, akọwe iranti, lati tun ile Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ̀ ṣe.
entries.en: Now in the eighteenth year of his reign, when he had purged the land, and the house, he sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah, and Maaseiah the governor of the city, and Joah the son of Joahaz the recorder, to repair the house of the LORD his God.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si de ọdọ Hilkiah, olori alufa, nwọn fi owo na ti a mu wá sinu ile Ọlọrun le e lọwọ, ti awọn ọmọ Lefi, ti o ntọju ilẹkun, ti kójọ lati ọwọ Manasse ati Efraimu, ati lati ọdọ gbogbo awọn iyokù Israeli, ati lati gbogbo Juda ati Benjamini: nwọn si pada si Jerusalemu.
entries.en: And when they came to Hilkiah the high priest, they delivered the money that was brought into the house of God, which the Levites that kept the doors had gathered of the hand of Manasseh and Ephraim, and of all the remnant of Israel, and of all Judah and Benjamin; and they returned to Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Nwọn si fi i le ọwọ awọn ti nṣiṣẹ na, ti nṣe alabojuto iṣẹ ile Oluwa, nwọn si fi i fun awọn aṣiṣẹ ti nṣiṣẹ ile Oluwa, lati tun ile na ṣe:
entries.en: And they put it in the hand of the workmen that had the oversight of the house of the LORD, and they gave it to the workmen that wrought in the house of the LORD, to repair and amend the house:

entries.yo: Awọn ọlọnà ati awọn kọlekọle ni nwọn fifun lati ra okuta gbigbẹ́, ati ìti-igi fun isopọ̀, ati lati tẹ́ ile wọnni ti awọn ọba Juda ti bajẹ.
entries.en: Even to the artificers and builders gave they it, to buy hewn stone, and timber for couplings, and to floor the houses which the kings of Judah had destroyed.

entries.yo: Awọn ọkunrin na fi otitọ ṣiṣẹ na: awọn alabojuto wọn ni Jahati ati Obadiah, awọn ọmọ Lefi, ninu awọn ọmọ Merari; ati Sekariah ati Meṣullamu, ninu awọn ọmọ Kohati, lati mu iṣẹ lọ; ati gbogbo awọn ọmọ Lefi, ti o ni ọgbọ́n ohun-elo orin.
entries.en: And the men did the work faithfully: and the overseers of them were Jahath and Obadiah, the Levites, of the sons of Merari; and Zechariah and Meshullam, of the sons of the Kohathites, to set it forward; and other of the Levites, all that could skill of instruments of musick.

entries.yo: Nwọn si wà lori awọn alãru, ati awọn alabojuto gbogbo awọn ti nṣiṣẹ, ninu ìsinkisin ati ninu awọn ọmọ Lefi ni akọwe, ati olutọju ati adèna.
entries.en: Also they were over the bearers of burdens, and were overseers of all that wrought the work in any manner of service: and of the Levites there were scribes, and officers, and porters.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si mu owo na ti a mu wá sinu ile Oluwa jade wá, Hilkiah alufa, ri iwe ofin Oluwa ti a ti ọwọ Mose kọ.
entries.en: And when they brought out the money that was brought into the house of the LORD, Hilkiah the priest found a book of the law of the LORD given by Moses.

entries.yo: Hilkiah si dahùn o si wi fun Ṣafani, akọwe, pe, Emi ri iwe ofin ninu ile Oluwa, Hilkiah si fi iwe na le Ṣafani lọwọ.
entries.en: And Hilkiah answered and said to Shaphan the scribe, I have found the book of the law in the house of the LORD. And Hilkiah delivered the book to Shaphan.

entries.yo: Ṣafani si mu iwe na tọ̀ ọba lọ, o si mu èsi pada fun ọba wá wipe, Gbogbo eyi ti a fi le awọn iranṣẹ rẹ lọwọ, nwọn ṣe e.
entries.en: And Shaphan carried the book to the king, and brought the king word back again, saying, All that was committed to thy servants, they do it.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ti kó gbogbo owo ti a ri ni ile Oluwa jọ, nwọn si ti fi le ọwọ awọn alabojuto, ati le ọwọ awọn ti nṣiṣẹ.
entries.en: And they have gathered together the money that was found in the house of the LORD, and have delivered it into the hand of the overseers, and to the hand of the workmen.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Ṣafani, akọwe, wi fun ọba pe, Hilkiah alufa, fun mi ni iwe kan. Ṣafani si kà a niwaju ọba.
entries.en: Then Shaphan the scribe told the king, saying, Hilkiah the priest hath given me a book. And Shaphan read it before the king.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati ọba gbọ́ ọ̀rọ ofin na, o si fa aṣọ rẹ̀ ya.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when the king had heard the words of the law, that he rent his clothes.

entries.yo: Ọba si paṣẹ fun Hilkiah ati Ahikamu, ọmọ Ṣafani, ati Abdoni, ọmọ Mika, ati Ṣafani, akọwe, ati Asaiah, iranṣẹ ọba, wipe,
entries.en: And the king commanded Hilkiah, and Ahikam the son of Shaphan, and Abdon the son of Micah, and Shaphan the scribe, and Asaiah a servant of the king's, saying,

entries.yo: Ẹ lọ, ẹ bere lọwọ Oluwa fun mi, ati fun awọn ti o kù ni Israeli ati ni Juda, niti ọ̀rọ iwe ti a ri: nitori titobi ni ibinu Oluwa ti a tú jade sori wa, nítori awọn bàba wa kò pa ọ̀rọ Oluwa mọ́, lati ṣe gẹgẹ bi gbogbo eyiti a kọ sinu iwe yi.
entries.en: Go, inquire of the LORD for me, and for them that are left in Israel and in Judah, concerning the words of the book that is found: for great is the wrath of the LORD that is poured out upon us, because our fathers have not kept the word of the LORD, to do after all that is written in this book.

entries.yo: Ati Hilkiah, ati awọn ti ọba ti yàn tọ̀ Hulda, woli obinrin, lọ, aya Ṣallumu, ọmọ Tikehati, ọmọ Hasra, olutọju aṣọ (njẹ, o ngbe Jerusalemu, niha keji;) nwọn si ba a sọ̀rọ na.
entries.en: And Hilkiah, and they that the king had appointed, went to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvath, the son of Hasrah, keeper of the wardrobe; (now she dwelt in Jerusalem in the college:) and they spake to her to that effect.

entries.yo: O si dá wọn lohùn pe, Bayi li Oluwa, Ọlọrun Israeli wi, Ẹ sọ fun ọkunrin na ti o rán nyin si mi pe,
entries.en: And she answered them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Tell ye the man that sent you to me,

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa wi, Kiyesi i, emi o mu ibi wá si ihinyi ati si awọn ti ngbe ibẹ na, ani gbogbo egún ti a kọ sinu iwe ti nwọn ti kà niwaju ọba Juda:
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, and upon the inhabitants thereof, even all the curses that are written in the book which they have read before the king of Judah:

entries.yo: Nitoriti nwọn ti kọ̀ mi silẹ, nwọn si ti sun turari fun awọn ọlọrun miran, ki nwọn ki o le fi gbogbo iṣẹ ọwọ wọn mu mi binu; nitorina li a o ṣe tú ibinu mi sori ihinyi, a kì yio si paná rẹ̀.
entries.en: Because they have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other gods, that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands; therefore my wrath shall be poured out upon this place, and shall not be quenched.

entries.yo: Bi o si ṣe ti ọba Juda nì, ẹniti o rán nyin lati bère lọwọ Oluwa, Bayi ni ki ẹnyin ki o wi fun u, Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi niti ọ̀rọ wọnni ti iwọ ti gbọ́:
entries.en: And as for the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of the LORD, so shall ye say unto him, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel concerning the words which thou hast heard;

entries.yo: Nitoriti ọkàn rẹ rọ̀, ti iwọ si rẹ̀ ara rẹ silẹ niwaju Ọlọrun, nigbati iwọ gbọ́ ọ̀rọ rẹ̀ si ihinyi, ati si awọn ti ngbe ibẹ, ti iwọ si rẹ̀ ara rẹ silẹ niwaju mi, ti iwọ si fa aṣọ rẹ ya, ti iwọ si sọkun niwaju mi; ani emi ti gbọ́ tirẹ pẹlu, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: Because thine heart was tender, and thou didst humble thyself before God, when thou heardest his words against this place, and against the inhabitants thereof, and humbledst thyself before me, and didst rend thy clothes, and weep before me; I have even heard thee also, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, emi o kó ọ jọ sọdọ awọn baba rẹ, a o si kó ọ jọ si isa-okú rẹ li alafia, bẹ̃ni oju rẹ kì yio ri gbogbo ibi ti emi o mu wá si ihinyi, ati sori awọn ti ngbe ibẹ. Bẹ̃ni nwọn mu èsi pada fun ọba wá.
entries.en: Behold, I will gather thee to thy fathers, and thou shalt be gathered to thy grave in peace, neither shall thine eyes see all the evil that I will bring upon this place, and upon the inhabitants of the same. So they brought the king word again.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ọba ranṣẹ, nwọn si kó gbogbo awọn àgba Juda ati Jerusalemu jọ.
entries.en: Then the king sent and gathered together all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Ọba si gòke lọ sinu ile Oluwa, ati gbogbo ọkunrin Juda, ati awọn ti ngbe Jerusalemu, ati awọn alufa, ati awọn ọmọ Lefi, ati gbogbo enia ati ẹni-nla ati ẹni-kekere: o si kà gbogbo ọ̀rọ inu iwe majẹmu na ti a ri ninu ile Oluwa li eti wọn.
entries.en: And the king went up into the house of the LORD, and all the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and the priests, and the Levites, and all the people, great and small: and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant that was found in the house of the LORD.

entries.yo: Ọba si duro ni ipò rẹ̀, o si dá majẹmu niwaju Oluwa lati ma fi gbogbo aiya ati gbogbo ọkàn rìn tọ̀ Oluwa lẹhin, ati lati pa ofin rẹ̀ mọ́, ati ẹri rẹ̀, ati aṣẹ rẹ̀, lati ṣe ọ̀rọ majẹmu na ti a kọ sinu iwe yi.
entries.en: And the king stood in his place, and made a covenant before the LORD, to walk after the LORD, and to keep his commandments, and his testimonies, and his statutes, with all his heart, and with all his soul, to perform the words of the covenant which are written in this book.

entries.yo: O si mu ki gbogbo awọn ti o wà ni Jerusalemu ati Benjamini duro ninu rẹ̀, awọn ti ngbe Jerusalemu si ṣe gẹgẹ bi majẹmu Ọlọrun, Ọlọrun awọn baba wọn.
entries.en: And he caused all that were present in Jerusalem and Benjamin to stand to it. And the inhabitants of Jerusalem did according to the covenant of God, the God of their fathers.

entries.yo: Josiah si kó gbogbo ohun-irira kuro ninu gbogbo ilu ti iṣe ti awọn ọmọ Israeli, o si mu ki gbogbo awọn ti o wà ni Israeli ki o sìn, ani ki nwọn sìn Oluwa Ọlọrun wọn. Ati li ọjọ rẹ̀ gbogbo nwọn kò yà kuro lati ma tọ Oluwa, Ọlọrun awọn baba wọn, lẹhin.
entries.en: And Josiah took away all the abominations out of all the countries that pertained to the children of Israel, and made all that were present in Israel to serve, even to serve the LORD their God. And all his days they departed not from following the LORD, the God of their fathers.

entries.yo: JOSIAH si pa irekọja kan mọ́ si Oluwa ni Jerusalemu: nwọn si pa ẹran irekọja na li ọjọ kẹrinla oṣù kini.
entries.en: Moreover Josiah kept a passover unto the LORD in Jerusalem: and they killed the passover on the fourteenth day of the first month.

entries.yo: O si yàn awọn alufa si iṣẹ wọn, o si gbà wọn ni iyanju si ìsin ile Oluwa.
entries.en: And he set the priests in their charges, and encouraged them to the service of the house of the LORD,

entries.yo: O si wi fun awọn ọmọ Lefi ti nkọ́ gbogbo Israeli, ti iṣe mimọ́ si Oluwa pe, Ẹ gbé apoti-ẹri mimọ́ nì lọ sinu ile na ti Solomoni, ọmọ Dafidi, ọba Israeli, ti kọ́; kì yio jẹ ẹrù li ejika mọ́: ẹ sìn Oluwa Ọlọrun nyin nisisiyi, ati Israeli, awọn enia rẹ̀;
entries.en: And said unto the Levites that taught all Israel, which were holy unto the LORD, Put the holy ark in the house which Solomon the son of David king of Israel did build; it shall not be a burden upon your shoulders: serve now the LORD your God, and his people Israel,

entries.yo: Ẹ si mura nipa ile awọn baba nyin, li ẹsẹsẹ nyin, gẹgẹ bi iwe Dafidi, ọba Israeli, ati gẹgẹ bi iwe Solomoni, ọmọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And prepare yourselves by the houses of your fathers, after your courses, according to the writing of David king of Israel, and according to the writing of Solomon his son.

entries.yo: Ẹ si duro ni ibi mimọ́ na, gẹgẹ bi ipin idile awọn baba arakunrin nyin, awọn enia na, ati bi ipin idile awọn ọmọ Lefi.
entries.en: And stand in the holy place according to the divisions of the families of the fathers of your brethren the people, and after the division of the families of the Levites.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni ki ẹ pa ẹran irekọja na, ki ẹ si yà ara nyin si mimọ́, ki ẹ si mura fun awọn arakunrin nyin, ki nwọn ki o le mã ṣe gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ Oluwa nipa ọwọ Mose.
entries.en: So kill the passover, and sanctify yourselves, and prepare your brethren, that they may do according to the word of the LORD by the hand of Moses.

entries.yo: Josiah si fun awọn enia na, ni ọdọ-agutan ati ọmọ ewurẹ, lati inu agbo-ẹran, gbogbo rẹ̀ fun ẹbọ irekọja na, fun gbogbo awọn ti o wà nibẹ, iye rẹ̀ ẹgbã mẹdogun, ati ẹgbẹdogun akọmalu: lati inu ini ọba ni wọnyi.
entries.en: And Josiah gave to the people, of the flock, lambs and kids, all for the passover offerings, for all that were present, to the number of thirty thousand, and three thousand bullocks: these were of the king's substance.

entries.yo: Awọn ijoye rẹ̀ si fi tinutinu ta awọn enia li ọrẹ, fun awọn alufa, ati fun awọn ọmọ Lefi: Hilkiah ati Sekariah ati Jehieli, awọn olori ile Ọlọrun, si fun awọn alufa fun ẹbọ irekọja na ni ẹgbẹtala ẹran-ọ̀sin kekeke, ati ọ̃dunrun malu.
entries.en: And his princes gave willingly unto the people, to the priests, and to the Levites: Hilkiah and Zechariah and Jehiel, rulers of the house of God, gave unto the priests for the passover offerings two thousand and six hundred small cattle, and three hundred oxen.

entries.yo: Koniah ati Ṣemaiah ati Netaneeli, awọn arakunrin rẹ̀, ati Hasabiah ati Jehieli ati Josabadi, olori awọn ọmọ Lefi, si fun awọn ọmọ Lefi fun ẹbọ irekọja na ni ẹgbẹdọgbọn ọdọ-agutan, ati ẹ̃dẹgbẹta malu.
entries.en: Conaniah also, and Shemaiah and Nethaneel, his brethren, and Hashabiah and Jeiel and Jozabad, chief of the Levites, gave unto the Levites for passover offerings five thousand small cattle, and five hundred oxen.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li a si mura ìsin na, awọn alufa si duro ni ipò wọn, ati awọn ọmọ Lefi ni ipa iṣẹ wọn gẹgẹ bi aṣẹ ọba.
entries.en: So the service was prepared, and the priests stood in their place, and the Levites in their courses, according to the king's commandment.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Lefi si pa ẹran irekọja na, awọn alufa si wọ́n ẹ̀jẹ na lati ọwọ wọn wá, awọn ọmọ Lefi si bó wọn.
entries.en: And they killed the passover, and the priests sprinkled the blood from their hands, and the Levites flayed them.

entries.yo: Nwọn si yà awọn ẹbọ-sisun sapakan, ki nwọn ki o le pin wọn funni gẹgẹ bi ipin idile awọn enia, lati rubọ si Oluwa, bi a ti kọ ọ ninu iwe Mose. Bẹ̃ni nwọn si ṣe awọn malu pelu.
entries.en: And they removed the burnt offerings, that they might give according to the divisions of the families of the people, to offer unto the LORD, as it is written in the book of Moses. And so did they with the oxen.

entries.yo: Nwọn si fi iná sun irekọja na gẹgẹ bi ilana na: ṣugbọn awọn ẹbọ mimọ́ iyokù ni nwọn bọ̀ ninu ìkoko, ati ninu òdu ati ninu agbada, nwọn si pin i kankan fun gbogbo enia.
entries.en: And they roasted the passover with fire according to the ordinance: but the other holy offerings sod they in pots, and in caldrons, and in pans, and divided them speedily among all the people.

entries.yo: Lẹhin na nwọn mura silẹ fun ara wọn, ati fun awọn alufa; nitoriti awọn alufa, awọn ọmọ Aaroni, wà ni riru ẹbọ sisun ati ọ̀ra titi di alẹ; nitorina awọn ọmọ Lefi mura silẹ fun ara wọn ati fun awọn alufa, awọn ọmọ Aaroni.
entries.en: And afterward they made ready for themselves, and for the priests: because the priests the sons of Aaron were busied in offering of burnt offerings and the fat until night; therefore the Levites prepared for themselves, and for the priests the sons of Aaron.

entries.yo: Awọn akọrin, awọn ọmọ Asafu duro ni ipò wọn, gẹgẹ bi ofin Dafidi, ati ti Asafu, ati ti Hemani, ati ti Jedutuni, ariran ọba; awọn adèna si duro ni olukuluku ẹnu-ọ̀na; nwọn kò gbọdọ lọ kuro li ọ̀na-iṣẹ wọn, nitoriti awọn arakunrin wọn, awọn ọmọ Lefi, ti mura silẹ dè wọn.
entries.en: And the singers the sons of Asaph were in their place, according to the commandment of David, and Asaph, and Heman, and Jeduthun the king's seer; and the porters waited at every gate; they might not depart from their service; for their brethren the Levites prepared for them.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni a si mura gbogbo ìsin Oluwa li ọjọ kanna, lati pa irekọja mọ́, ati lati ru ẹbọ sisun lori pẹpẹ Oluwa, gẹgẹ bi ofin Josiah, ọba.
entries.en: So all the service of the LORD was prepared the same day, to keep the passover, and to offer burnt offerings upon the altar of the LORD, according to the commandment of king Josiah.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Israeli ti a ri nibẹ, pa irekọja na mọ́ li akoko na, ati ajọ aiwukara li ọjọ meje.
entries.en: And the children of Israel that were present kept the passover at that time, and the feast of unleavened bread seven days.

entries.yo: Kò si si irekọja kan ti o dabi rẹ̀ ti a ṣe ni Israeli lati igba ọjọ Samueli woli; bẹ̃ni gbogbo awọn ọba Israeli kò pa iru irekọja bẹ̃ mọ́, bi eyi ti Josiah ṣe, ati awọn alufa, ati awọn ọmọ Lefi, ati gbogbo Juda ati Israeli ti a ri nibẹ, ati awọn ti ngbe Jerusalemu.
entries.en: And there was no passover like to that kept in Israel from the days of Samuel the prophet; neither did all the kings of Israel keep such a passover as Josiah kept, and the priests, and the Levites, and all Judah and Israel that were present, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Li ọdun kejidilogun ijọba Josiah li a pa irekọja yi mọ́.
entries.en: In the eighteenth year of the reign of Josiah was this passover kept.

entries.yo: Lẹhin gbogbo eyi, ti Josiah ti tun ile na ṣe tan, Neko, ọba Egipti, gòke wá, si Karkemiṣi lẹba odò Euferate: Josiah si jade tọ̀ ọ.
entries.en: After all this, when Josiah had prepared the temple, Necho king of Egypt came up to fight against Carchemish by Euphrates: and Josiah went out against him.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn o rán ikọ̀ si i, wipe, Kini ṣe temi tirẹ, iwọ ọba Juda? Emi kò tọ̀ ọ wá loni, bikòṣe si ile ti mo ba ni ijà: Ọlọrun sa pa aṣẹ fun mi lati yara: kuro lọdọ Ọlọrun, ẹniti o wà pẹlu mi, ki on má ba pa ọ run.
entries.en: But he sent ambassadors to him, saying, What have I to do with thee, thou king of Judah? I come not against thee this day, but against the house wherewith I have war: for God commanded me to make haste: forbear thee from meddling with God, who is with me, that he destroy thee not.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Josiah kò yi oju rẹ̀ pada kuro lọdọ rẹ̀, ṣugbọn o pa aṣọ ara rẹ dà, ki o le ba a jà, kò si fi eti si ọ̀rọ Neko lati ẹnu Ọlọrun wá, o si wá ijagun li àfonifoji Megiddo.
entries.en: Nevertheless Josiah would not turn his face from him, but disguised himself, that he might fight with him, and hearkened not unto the words of Necho from the mouth of God, and came to fight in the valley of Megiddo.

entries.yo: Awọn tafatafa si ta Josiah, ọba: ọba si wi fun awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀ pe, Ẹ gbé mi kuro; nitoriti mo gbà ọgbẹ gidigidi.
entries.en: And the archers shot at king Josiah; and the king said to his servants, Have me away; for I am sore wounded.

entries.yo: Nitorina awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀ gbé e kuro ninu kẹkẹ́ na, nwọn si fi i sinu kẹkẹ́ rẹ̀ keji; nwọn si mu u wá si Jerusalemu, o si kú, a si sìn i ninu ọkan ninu awọn iboji awọn baba rẹ̀. Gbogbo Juda ati Jerusalemu si ṣọ̀fọ Josiah.
entries.en: His servants therefore took him out of that chariot, and put him in the second chariot that he had; and they brought him to Jerusalem, and he died, and was buried in one of the sepulchres of his fathers. And all Judah and Jerusalem mourned for Josiah.

entries.yo: Jeremiah si pohùn rere ẹkún fun Josiah, ati gbogbo awọn akọrin ọkunrin, ati awọn akọrin obinrin, si nsọ ti Josiah ninu orin-ẹkún wọn titi di oni yi, nwọn si sọ wọn di àṣa kan ni Israeli; si kiyesi i, a kọ wọn ninu awọn orin-ẹkún.
entries.en: And Jeremiah lamented for Josiah: and all the singing men and the singing women spake of Josiah in their lamentations to this day, and made them an ordinance in Israel: and, behold, they are written in the lamentations.

entries.yo: Ati iyokú iṣe Josiah, ati ìwa rere rẹ̀, gẹgẹ bi eyiti a ti kọ ninu ofin Oluwa,
entries.en: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah, and his goodness, according to that which was written in the law of the LORD,

entries.yo: Ati iṣe rẹ̀, ti iṣaju ati ti ikẹhin, kiyesi i, a kọ wọn sinu iwe awọn ọba Israeli ati Judah.
entries.en: And his deeds, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.

entries.yo: NIGBANA ni awọn enia ilẹ na mu Jehoahasi, ọmọ Josiah, nwọn si fi i jọba ni ipò baba rẹ̀ ni Jerusalemu.
entries.en: Then the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and made him king in his father's stead in Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Ẹni ọdun mẹtalelogun ni Jehoahasi, nigbati o bẹ̀rẹ si ijọba, o si jọba oṣu mẹta ni Jerusalemu.
entries.en: Jehoahaz was twenty and three years old when he began to reign, and he reigned three months in Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Ọba Egipti si mu u kuro ni Jerusalemu, o si bù ọgọrun fadakà ati talenti wura kan fun ilẹ na.
entries.en: And the king of Egypt put him down at Jerusalem, and condemned the land in an hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.

entries.yo: Ọba Egipti si fi Eliakimu, arakunrin rẹ̀, jọba lori Juda ati Jerusalemu, o si pa orukọ rẹ̀ dà si Jehoiakimu; Neko si mu Jehoahasi, arakunrin rẹ̀, o si mu u lọ si Egipti.
entries.en: And the king of Egypt made Eliakim his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem, and turned his name to Jehoiakim. And Necho took Jehoahaz his brother, and carried him to Egypt.

entries.yo: Ẹni ọdun mẹdọgbọn ni Jehoiakimu, nigbati o bẹ̀rẹ si ijọba, o si jọba ọdun mọkanla ni Jerusalemu; o si ṣe eyi ti o buru li oju Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ̀,
entries.en: Jehoiakim was twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem: and he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD his God.

entries.yo: Nebukadnessari, ọba Babeli, gòke wá, o si dè e ni ẹ̀won, lati mu u lọ si Babeli.
entries.en: Against him came up Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and bound him in fetters, to carry him to Babylon.

entries.yo: Nebukadnessari kó ninu ohun-elo ile Oluwa lọ si Babeli pẹlu, o si fi wọn sinu ãfin rẹ̀ ni Babeli.
entries.en: Nebuchadnezzar also carried of the vessels of the house of the LORD to Babylon, and put them in his temple at Babylon.

entries.yo: Ati iyokù iṣe Jehoiakimu ati awọn ohun-irira rẹ̀ ti o ti ṣe, ti a si ri ninu rẹ̀, kiyesi i, a kọ wọn sinu iwe awọn ọba Israeli ati Juda: Jehoiakini, ọmọ rẹ̀, si jọba ni ipò rẹ̀.
entries.en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and his abominations which he did, and that which was found in him, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah: and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his stead.

entries.yo: Ẹni ọdun mejidilogun ni Jehoiakini nigbati o bẹ̀rẹ si ijọba, o si jọba oṣù mẹta ati ijọ mẹwa ni Jerusalemu: o si ṣe eyiti o buru li oju Oluwa.
entries.en: Jehoiachin was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned three months and ten days in Jerusalem: and he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD.

entries.yo: Ati li amọdun, Nebukadnessari ranṣẹ, a si mu u wá si Babeli, pẹlu ohun-elo daradara ile Oluwa, o si fi Sedekiah, arakunrin rẹ̀, jọba lori Juda ati Jerusalemu.
entries.en: And when the year was expired, king Nebuchadnezzar sent, and brought him to Babylon, with the goodly vessels of the house of the LORD, and made Zedekiah his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Ẹni ọdun mọkanlelogun ni Sedekiah, nigbati o bẹ̀rẹ si ijọba, o si jọba ọdun mọkanla ni Jerusalemu.
entries.en: Zedekiah was one and twenty years old when he began to reign, and reigned eleven years in Jerusalem.

entries.yo: O si ṣe eyi ti o buru li oju Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ̀, kò si rẹ̀ ara rẹ̀ silẹ niwaju Jeremiah, woli, ti o sọ̀rọ lati ẹnu Oluwa wá.
entries.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD his God, and humbled not himself before Jeremiah the prophet speaking from the mouth of the LORD.

entries.yo: On pẹlu si ṣọ̀tẹ si Nebukadnessari ọba, ẹniti o ti mu u fi Ọlọrun bura; ṣugbọn o wà ọrùn rẹ̀ kì, o si mu aiya rẹ̀ le lati má yipada si Oluwa Ọlọrun Israeli.
entries.en: And he also rebelled against king Nebuchadnezzar, who had made him swear by God: but he stiffened his neck, and hardened his heart from turning unto the LORD God of Israel.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu, gbogbo awọn olori awọn alufa ati awọn enia dẹṣẹ gidigidi bi gbogbo irira awọn orilẹ-ède, nwọn si sọ ile Oluwa di ẽri, ti on ti yà si mimọ́ ni Jerusalemu.
entries.en: Moreover all the chief of the priests, and the people, transgressed very much after all the abominations of the heathen; and polluted the house of the LORD which he had hallowed in Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Oluwa Ọlọrun awọn baba wọn si ranṣẹ si wọn lati ọwọ awọn onṣẹ rẹ̀, o ndide ni kùtukutu o si nranṣẹ, nitori ti o ni iyọ́nu si awọn enia rẹ̀, ati si ibugbe rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the LORD God of their fathers sent to them by his messengers, rising up betimes, and sending; because he had compassion on his people, and on his dwelling place:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nwọn fi awọn onṣẹ Ọlọrun ṣe ẹlẹya, nwọn si kẹgan ọ̀rọ rẹ̀, nwọn si fi awọn woli rẹ̀ ṣẹsin, titi ibinu Oluwa fi ru si awọn enia rẹ̀, ti kò fi si atunṣe.
entries.en: But they mocked the messengers of God, and despised his words, and misused his prophets, until the wrath of the LORD arose against his people, till there was no remedy.

entries.yo: Nitorina li o ṣe mu ọba awọn ara Kaldea wá ba wọn, ẹniti o fi idà pa awọn ọdọmọkunrin wọn ni ile ibi-mimọ́ wọn, kò si ni iyọ́nu si ọdọmọkunrin tabi wundia, arugbo, tabi ẹniti o bà fun ogbó: on fi gbogbo wọn le e li ọwọ.
entries.en: Therefore he brought upon them the king of the Chaldees, who slew their young men with the sword in the house of their sanctuary, and had no compassion upon young man or maiden, old man, or him that stooped for age: he gave them all into his hand.

entries.yo: Ati gbogbo ohun-elo ile Ọlọrun, nla ati kekere, ati iṣura ile Oluwa ati iṣura ọba, ati ti awọn ijoye rẹ̀; gbogbo wọn li o mu wá si Babeli.
entries.en: And all the vessels of the house of God, great and small, and the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king, and of his princes; all these he brought to Babylon.

entries.yo: Nwọn si kun ile Ọlọrun, nwọn si wó odi Jerusalemu palẹ, nwọn si fi iná sun ãfin rẹ̀, nwọn si fọ́ gbogbo ohun-elo daradara rẹ̀ tũtu.
entries.en: And they burnt the house of God, and brake down the wall of Jerusalem, and burnt all the palaces thereof with fire, and destroyed all the goodly vessels thereof.

entries.yo: Awọn ti o ṣikù lọwọ idà li o kó lọ si Babeli; nibiti nwọn jẹ́ iranṣẹ fun u, ati fun awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ titi di ijọba awọn ara Persia:
entries.en: And them that had escaped from the sword carried he away to Babylon; where they were servants to him and his sons until the reign of the kingdom of Persia:

entries.yo: Lati mu ọ̀rọ Oluwa ṣẹ lati ẹnu Jeremiah wá, titi ilẹ na yio fi san ọdun isimi rẹ̀; ani ni gbogbo ọjọ idahoro on nṣe isimi titi ãdọrin ọdun yio fi pé.
entries.en: To fulfil the word of the LORD by the mouth of Jeremiah, until the land had enjoyed her sabbaths: for as long as she lay desolate she kept sabbath, to fulfil threescore and ten years.

entries.yo: Li ọdun kini Kirusi, ọba Persia, ki ọ̀rọ Oluwa lati ẹnu Jeremiah wá ki o le ṣẹ, Oluwa ru ẹmi Kirusi, ọba Persia, soke, ti o si ṣe ikede ni gbogbo ijọba rẹ̀, o si kọ iwe pẹlu, wipe,
entries.en: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that the word of the LORD spoken by the mouth of Jeremiah might be accomplished, the LORD stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and put it also in writing, saying,

entries.yo: Bayi ni Kirusi, ọba Persia, wi pe, Gbogbo ijọba aiye li Oluwa Ọlọrun fi fun mi, o si ti paṣẹ fun mi lati kọ́ ile kan fun on ni Jerusalemu, ti mbẹ ni Juda. Tani ninu nyin ninu gbogbo awọn enia rẹ̀? Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ̀ ki o pẹlu rẹ̀, ki o si gòke lọ.
entries.en: Thus saith Cyrus king of Persia, All the kingdoms of the earth hath the LORD God of heaven given me; and he hath charged me to build him an house in Jerusalem, which is in Judah. Who is there among you of all his people? The LORD his God be with him, and let him go up.

entries.yo: LI ọdun ekini Kirusi, ọba Persia, ki ọ̀rọ OLUWA lati ẹnu Jeremiah wá ki o le ṣẹ, OLUWA rú ẹmi Kirusi, ọba Persia soke, ti o mu ki a kede yi gbogbo ijọba rẹ̀ ka, a si kọwe rẹ̀ pẹlu wipe,
entries.en: Now when Ezra had prayed, and when he had confessed, weeping and casting himself down before the house of God, there assembled unto him out of Israel a very great congregation of men and women and children: for the people wept very sore.

entries.yo: Bayi ni Kirusi ọba Persia wi pe, OLUWA, Ọlọrun ọrun, ti fi gbogbo ijọba aiye fun mi; o si ti pa a li aṣẹ lati kọ ile fun on ni Jerusalemu ti o wà ni Juda.
entries.en: And Shechaniah the son of Jehiel, one of the sons of Elam, answered and said unto Ezra, We have trespassed against our God, and have taken strange wives of the people of the land: yet now there is hope in Israel concerning this thing.

entries.yo: Tani ninu nyin ninu gbogbo enia rẹ̀? ki Ọlọrun rẹ̀ ki o wà pẹlu rẹ̀, ki o si goke lọ si Jerusalemu, ti o wà ni Juda, ki o si kọ ile OLUWA Ọlọrun Israeli, on li Ọlọrun, ti o wà ni Jerusalemu.
entries.en: Now therefore let us make a covenant with our God to put away all the wives, and such as are born of them, according to the counsel of my lord, and of those that tremble at the commandment of our God; and let it be done according to the law.

entries.yo: Ati ẹnikẹni ti o kù lati ibikibi ti o ti ngbe, ki awọn enia ibugbe rẹ̀ ki o fi fadaka ràn a lọwọ, pẹlu wura, ati pẹlu ẹrù, ati pẹlu ẹran-ọ̀sin, pẹlu ọrẹ atinuwa fun ile Ọlọrun ti o wà ni Jerusalemu.
entries.en: Arise; for this matter belongeth unto thee: we also will be with thee: be of good courage, and do it.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni awọn olori awọn baba Juda ati Benjamini dide, ati awọn alufa, ati awọn ọmọ Lefi, pẹlu gbogbo awọn ẹniti Ọlọrun rú ẹmi wọn soke, lati goke lọ, lati kọ́ ile OLUWA ti o wà ni Jerusalemu.
entries.en: Then arose Ezra, and made the chief priests, the Levites, and all Israel, to swear that they should do according to this word. And they sware.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn ti o wà li agbegbe wọn si fi ohun-èlo fadaka ràn wọn lọwọ, pẹlu wura, pẹlu ẹrù ati pẹlu ẹran-ọ̀sin, ati pẹlu ohun iyebiye, li aika gbogbo ọrẹ atinuwa.
entries.en: Then Ezra rose up from before the house of God, and went into the chamber of Johanan the son of Eliashib: and when he came thither, he did eat no bread, nor drink water: for he mourned because of the transgression of them that had been carried away.

entries.yo: Kirusi ọba si ko ohun èlo ile OLUWA jade, ti Nebukadnessari ti ko jade lọ lati Jerusalemu, ti o si fi sinu ile ọlọrun rẹ̀;
entries.en: And they made proclamation throughout Judah and Jerusalem unto all the children of the captivity, that they should gather themselves together unto Jerusalem;

entries.yo: Kirusi ọba Persia si ko wọnyi jade nipa ọwọ Mitredati, oluṣọ iṣura, o si ka iye wọn fun Ṣeṣbassari (Serubbabeli) bãlẹ Juda.
entries.en: And that whosoever would not come within three days, according to the counsel of the princes and the elders, all his substance should be forfeited, and himself separated from the congregation of those that had been carried away.

entries.yo: Iye wọn si li eyi: ọgbọn awo-pọ̀kọ wura, ẹgbẹrun awo-pọ̀kọ fadaka, ọbẹ mọkandilọgbọn,
entries.en: Then all the men of Judah and Benjamin gathered themselves together unto Jerusalem within three days. It was the ninth month, on the twentieth day of the month; and all the people sat in the street of the house of God, trembling because of this matter, and for the great rain.

entries.yo: Ọgbọn ago wura, ago fadaka iru ekeji, irinwo o le mẹwa, ohun èlo miran si jẹ ẹgbẹrun.
entries.en: And Ezra the priest stood up, and said unto them, Ye have transgressed, and have taken strange wives, to increase the trespass of Israel.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ohun-èlo wura ati ti fadaka jẹ ẹgbẹtadilọgbọn. Gbogbo wọnyi ni Ṣeṣbassari mu goke wá pẹlu awọn igbekun ti a mu goke lati Babiloni wá si Jerusalemu.
entries.en: Now therefore make confession unto the LORD God of your fathers, and do his pleasure: and separate yourselves from the people of the land, and from the strange wives.
Then all the congregation answered and said with a loud voice, As thou hast said, so must we do.
But the people are many, and it is a time of much rain, and we are not able to stand without, neither is this a work of one day or two: for we are many that have transgressed in this thing.

Let now our rulers of all the congregation stand, and let all them which have taken strange wives in our cities come at appointed times, and with them the elders of every city, and the judges thereof, until the fierce wrath of our God for this matter be turned from us.
Only Jonathan the son of Asahel and Jahaziah the son of Tikvah were employed about this matter: and Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite helped them.

And the children of the captivity did so. And Ezra the priest, with certain chief of the fathers, after the house of their fathers, and all of them by their names, were separated, and sat down in the first day of the tenth month to examine the matter.
And they made an end with all the men that had taken strange wives by the first day of the first month.
And among the sons of the priests there were found that had taken strange wives: namely, of the sons of Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and his brethren; Maaseiah, and Eliezer, and Jarib, and Gedaliah.
And they gave their hands that they would put away their wives; and being guilty, they offered a ram of the flock for their trespass.
And of the sons of Immer; Hanani, and Zebadiah.
And of the sons of Harim; Maaseiah, and Elijah, and Shemaiah, and Jehiel, and Uzziah.
And of the sons of Pashur; Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethaneel, Jozabad, and Elasah.
Also of the Levites; Jozabad, and Shimei, and Kelaiah, (the same is Kelita,) Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.
Of the singers also; Eliashib: and of the porters; Shallum, and Telem, and Uri.
Moreover of Israel: of the sons of Parosh; Ramiah, and Jeziah, and Malchiah, and Miamin, and Eleazar, and Malchijah, and Benaiah.
And of the sons of Elam; Mattaniah, Zechariah, and Jehiel, and Abdi, and Jeremoth, and Eliah.
And of the sons of Zattu; Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, and Jeremoth, and Zabad, and Aziza.
Of the sons also of Bebai; Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, and Athlai.
And of the sons of Bani; Meshullam, Malluch, and Adaiah, Jashub, and Sheal, and Ramoth.
And of the sons of Pahath-moab; Adna, and Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezaleel, and Binnui, and Manasseh.
And of the sons of Harim; Eliezer, Ishijah, Malchiah, Shemaiah, Shimeon,
Benjamin, Malluch, and Shemariah.
Of the sons of Hashum; Mattenai, Mattathah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, and Shimei.
Of the sons of Bani; Maadai, Amram, and Uel,
Benaiah, Bedeiah, Chelluh,
Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib,
Mattaniah, Mattenai, and Jaasau,
And Bani, and Binnui, Shimei,
And Shelemiah, and Nathan, and Adaiah,
Machnadebai, Shashai, Sharai,
Azareel, and Shelemiah, Shemariah,
Shallum, Amariah, and Joseph.
Of the sons of Nebo; Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Jadau, and Joel, Benaiah.
All these had taken strange wives: and some of them had wives by whom they had children.

entries.yo: WỌNYI li awọn ọmọ igberiko Juda ti o goke wa, lati inu igbèkun awọn ti a ti ko lọ, ti Nebukadnessari, ọba Babiloni, ti ko lọ si Babiloni, ti nwọn si pada wá si Jerusalemu ati Juda, olukuluku si ilu rẹ̀:
entries.en: Now these are the children of the province that went up out of the captivity, of those which had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away unto Babylon, and came again unto Jerusalem and Judah, every one unto his city;

entries.yo: Awọn ti o ba Serubbabeli wá, Jeṣua, Nehemiah, Seraiah, Reelaiah, Mordekai, Bilṣani, Mispari, Bigfai, Rehumu, Baana. Iye awọn ọkunrin ninu awọn enia Israeli:
entries.en: Which came with Zerubbabel: Jeshua, Nehemiah, Seraiah, Reelaiah, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispar, Bigvai, Rehum, Baanah. The number of the men of the people of Israel:

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Paroṣi, ẹgbọkanla o din mejidilọgbọn.
entries.en: The children of Parosh, two thousand an hundred seventy and two.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Ṣefatiah, irinwo o din mejidilọgbọn.
entries.en: The children of Shephatiah, three hundred seventy and two.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Ara, ẹgbẹrin o din mẹ̃dọgbọn.
entries.en: The children of Arah, seven hundred seventy and five.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Pahati-Moabu ninu awọn ọmọ Jeṣua, ati Joabu, ẹgbẹrinla o le mejila.
entries.en: The children of Pahath-moab, of the children of Jeshua and Joab, two thousand eight hundred and twelve.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Elamu, adọtalelẹgbẹfa o le mẹrin.
entries.en: The children of Elam, a thousand two hundred fifty and four.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Sattu, ọtadilẹgbẹ̀run, o le marun.
entries.en: The children of Zattu, nine hundred forty and five.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Sakkai, ojidilẹgbẹrin.
entries.en: The children of Zaccai, seven hundred and threescore.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Bani, ojilelẹgbẹta, o le meji.
entries.en: The children of Bani, six hundred forty and two.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Bebai, ẹgbẹta o le mẹtalelogun.
entries.en: The children of Bebai, six hundred twenty and three.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Asgadi, ẹgbẹfa, o le mejilelogun.
entries.en: The children of Azgad, a thousand two hundred twenty and two.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Adonikami ọtalelẹgbẹta o le mẹfa.
entries.en: The children of Adonikam, six hundred sixty and six.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Bigfai, ẹgbã o le mẹrindilọgọta.
entries.en: The children of Bigvai, two thousand fifty and six.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Adini, adọtalenirinwo o le mẹrin.
entries.en: The children of Adin, four hundred fifty and four.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Ateri ti Hesekiah, mejidilọgọrun.
entries.en: The children of Ater of Hezekiah, ninety and eight.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Besai, ọrindinirinwo o le mẹta.
entries.en: The children of Bezai, three hundred twenty and three.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Jora, mejilelãdọfa.
entries.en: The children of Jorah, an hundred and twelve.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Haṣumu igba o le mẹtalelogun.
entries.en: The children of Hashum, two hundred twenty and three.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Gibbari, marundilọgọrun.
entries.en: The children of Gibbar, ninety and five.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Betlehemu, mẹtalelọgọfa.
entries.en: The children of Bethlehem, an hundred twenty and three.

entries.yo: Awọn enia Netofa, mẹrindilọgọta.
entries.en: The men of Netophah, fifty and six.

entries.yo: Awọn enia Anatotu, mejidilãdọje.
entries.en: The men of Anathoth, an hundred twenty and eight.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Asmafeti, mejilelogoji.
entries.en: The children of Azmaveth, forty and two.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Kirjat-arimu, Kefira ati Beeroti ọtadilẹgbẹrin o le mẹta.
entries.en: The children of Kirjath-arim, Chephirah, and Beeroth, seven hundred and forty and three.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Rama ati Gaba, ẹgbẹta o le mọkanlelogun.
entries.en: The children of Ramah and Geba, six hundred twenty and one.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Mikmasi, mejilelọgọfa.
entries.en: The men of Michmas, an hundred twenty and two.

entries.yo: Awọn enia Beteli ati Ai, igba o le mẹtalelogun.
entries.en: The men of Bethel and Ai, two hundred twenty and three.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Nebo, mejilelãdọta.
entries.en: The children of Nebo, fifty and two.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Magbiṣi mẹrindilọgọjọ.
entries.en: The children of Magbish, an hundred fifty and six.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Elamu ekeji, ãdọtalelẹgbẹfa o le mẹrin.
entries.en: The children of the other Elam, a thousand two hundred fifty and four.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Harimu, ọrindinirinwo.
entries.en: The children of Harim, three hundred and twenty.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Lodi, Hadidi ati Ono, ọrindilẹgbẹrin o le marun,
entries.en: The children of Lod, Hadid, and Ono, seven hundred twenty and five.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Jeriko, ọtadinirinwo o le marun.
entries.en: The children of Jericho, three hundred forty and five.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Sanaa, egbejidilogun o le ọgbọn.
entries.en: The children of Senaah, three thousand and six hundred and thirty.

entries.yo: Awọn alufa; awọn ọmọ Jedaiah, ti idile Jeṣua, ogúndilẹgbẹrun o din meje.
entries.en: The priests: the children of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua, nine hundred seventy and three.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Immeri, ãdọtalelẹgbẹrun o le meji.
entries.en: The children of Immer, a thousand fifty and two.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Paṣuri, ojilelẹgbẹfa o le meje.
entries.en: The children of Pashur, a thousand two hundred forty and seven.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Harimu, ẹgbẹrun o le mẹtadilogun.
entries.en: The children of Harim, a thousand and seventeen.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Lefi: awọn ọmọ Jeṣua ati Kadmieli ti awọn ọmọ Hodafiah, mẹrinlelãdọrin.
entries.en: The Levites: the children of Jeshua and Kadmiel, of the children of Hodaviah, seventy and four.

entries.yo: Awọn akọrin: awọn ọmọ Asafu, mejidilãdoje.
entries.en: The singers: the children of Asaph, an hundred twenty and eight.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ awọn adena: awọn ọmọ Ṣalumu, awọn ọmọ Ateri, awọn ọmọ Talmoni, awọn ọmọ Akkubu, awọn ọmọ Hatita, awọn ọmọ Ṣobai, gbogbo wọn jẹ, mọkandilogoje.
entries.en: The children of the porters: the children of Shallum, the children of Ater, the children of Talmon, the children of Akkub, the children of Hatita, the children of Shobai, in all an hundred thirty and nine.

entries.yo: Awọn Netinimu: awọn ọmọ Siha, awọn ọmọ Hasufa, awọn ọmọ Tabbaoti.
entries.en: The Nethinims: the children of Ziha, the children of Hasupha, the children of Tabbaoth,

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Kerosi, awọn ọmọ Siha, awọn ọmọ Padoni.
entries.en: The children of Keros, the children of Siaha, the children of Padon,

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Lebana, awọn ọmọ Hagaba, awọn ọmọ Akkubu,
entries.en: The children of Lebanah, the children of Hagabah, the children of Akkub,

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Hagabu, awọn ọmọ Ṣalmai, awọn ọmọ Hanani;
entries.en: The children of Hagab, the children of Shalmai, the children of Hanan,

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Giddeli, awọn ọmọ Gahari, awọn ọmọ Reaiah,
entries.en: The children of Giddel, the children of Gahar, the children of Reaiah,

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Resini, awọn ọmọ Nekoda, awọn ọmọ Gassamu,
entries.en: The children of Rezin, the children of Nekoda, the children of Gazzam,

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Ussa, awọn ọmọ Pasea, awọn ọmọ Besai,
entries.en: The children of Uzza, the children of Paseah, the children of Besai,

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Asna, awọn ọmọ Mehunimi, awọn ọmọ Nefusimi,
entries.en: The children of Asnah, the children of Mehunim, the children of Nephusim,

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Bakbuki, awọn ọmọ Hakufa, awọn ọmọ Har-huri,
entries.en: The children of Bakbuk, the children of Hakupha, the children of Harhur,

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Basluti, awọn ọmọ Mehida, awọn ọmọ Harṣa,
entries.en: The children of Bazluth, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha,

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Barkosi, awọn ọmọ Sisera, awọn ọmọ Tama,
entries.en: The children of Barkos, the children of Sisera, the children of Thamah,

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Nesia, awọn ọmọ Hatifa,
entries.en: The children of Neziah, the children of Hatipha.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ awọn iranṣẹ Solomoni: awọn ọmọ Sotai, awọn ọmọ Sofereti, awọn ọmọ Peruda,
entries.en: The children of Solomon's servants: the children of Sotai, the children of Sophereth, the children of Peruda,

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Jaala, awọn ọmọ Darkoni, awọn ọmọ Giddeli,
entries.en: The children of Jaalah, the children of Darkon, the children of Giddel,

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Ṣefatiah, awọn ọmọ Hattili, awọn ọmọ Pokereti ti Sebaimu, awọn ọmọ Ami.
entries.en: The children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth of Zebaim, the children of Ami.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn Netinimu, ati awọn ọmọ awọn iranṣẹ Solomoni, jẹ irinwo o din mẹjọ.
entries.en: All the Nethinims, and the children of Solomon's servants, were three hundred ninety and two.

entries.yo: Awọn wọnyi li o si goke wá lati Telmela, Telkarsa, Kerubu, Addani, ati Immeri: ṣugbọn nwọn kò le fi idile baba wọn hàn, ati iru ọmọ wọn, bi ti inu Israeli ni nwọn iṣe:
entries.en: And these were they which went up from Tel-melah, Tel-harsa, Cherub, Addan, and Immer: but they could not shew their father's house, and their seed, whether they were of Israel:

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Delaiah, awọn ọmọ Tobiah, awọn ọmọ Nekoda, ãdọtalelẹgbẹta o le meji.
entries.en: The children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda, six hundred fifty and two.

entries.yo: Ati ninu awọn ọmọ awọn alufa: awọn ọmọ Habaiah, awọn ọmọ Hakosi, awọn ọmọ Barsillai, ti o fẹ ọkan ninu awọn ọmọ Barsillai obinrin, ara Gileadi li aya, a si pè e nipa orukọ wọn;
entries.en: And of the children of the priests: the children of Habaiah, the children of Koz, the children of Barzillai; which took a wife of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and was called after their name:

entries.yo: Awọn wọnyi li o wá iwe itan wọn ninu awọn ti a ṣiro nipa itan idile, ṣugbọn a kò ri wọn, nitori na li a ṣe yọ wọn kuro ninu oye alufa.
entries.en: These sought their register among those that were reckoned by genealogy, but they were not found: therefore were they, as polluted, put from the priesthood.

entries.yo: Balẹ si wi fun wọn pe, ki nwọn ki o má jẹ ninu ohun mimọ́ julọ, titi alufa kan yio fi dide pẹlu Urimu ati pẹlu Tummimu.
entries.en: And the Tirshatha said unto them, that they should not eat of the most holy things, till there stood up a priest with Urim and with Thummim.

entries.yo: Apapọ gbogbo ijọ na, jẹ ẹgbã mọkanlelogun o le ojidinirinwo.
entries.en: The whole congregation together was forty and two thousand three hundred and threescore,

entries.yo: Li aika iranṣẹkunrin wọn ati iranṣẹbinrin wọn, ti o jẹ ẹgbẹrindilẹgbãrin o din mẹtalelọgọta: igba akọrin ọkunrin ati akọrin obinrin li o si wà ninu wọn.
entries.en: Beside their servants and their maids, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred thirty and seven: and there were among them two hundred singing men and singing women.

entries.yo: Ẹṣin wọn jẹ, ọtadilẹgbẹrin o din mẹrin; ibaka wọn, ojilugba o le marun.
entries.en: Their horses were seven hundred thirty and six; their mules, two hundred forty and five;

entries.yo: Ibakasiẹ wọn, irinwo o le marundilogoji; kẹtẹkẹtẹ wọn, ẹgbẹrinlelọgbọn o din ọgọrin.
entries.en: Their camels, four hundred thirty and five; their asses, six thousand seven hundred and twenty.

entries.yo: Ati ninu awọn olori awọn baba, nigbati nwọn de ile Oluwa ti o wà ni Jerusalemu, nwọn si ta ọrẹ atinuwa fun ile Ọlọrun, lati gbe e duro ni ipò rẹ̀.
entries.en: And some of the chief of the fathers, when they came to the house of the LORD which is at Jerusalem, offered freely for the house of God to set it up in his place:

entries.yo: Nwọn fi sinu iṣura iṣẹ na gẹgẹ bi agbara wọn, ọkẹ mẹta ìwọn dramu wura, o le ẹgbẹrun, ẹgbẹdọgbọn mina fadaka, ati ọgọrun ẹ̀wu alufa.
entries.en: They gave after their ability unto the treasure of the work threescore and one thousand drams of gold, and five thousand pound of silver, and one hundred priests' garments.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li awọn alufa, ati awọn ọmọ Lefi, ati omiran ninu awọn enia, ati awọn akọrin, ati awọn adèna, ati awọn Netinimu ngbe ilu wọn, gbogbo Israeli si ngbe ilu wọn.
entries.en: So the priests, and the Levites, and some of the people, and the singers, and the porters, and the Nethinims, dwelt in their cities, and all Israel in their cities.

entries.yo: NIGBATI oṣu keje si pé, ti awọn ọmọ Israeli si wà ninu ilu wọnni, awọn enia na ko ara wọn jọ pọ̀ bi ẹnikan si Jerusalemu.
entries.en: And when the seventh month was come, and the children of Israel were in the cities, the people gathered themselves together as one man to Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Jeṣua ọmọ Jehosadaki si dide pẹlu awọn arakunrin rẹ̀ awọn alufa, ati Serubbabeli ọmọ Ṣealtieli, ati awọn arakunrin rẹ̀, nwọn si tẹ́ pẹpẹ Ọlọrun Israeli, lati ma ru ẹbọ ọrẹ sisun lori rẹ̀, gẹgẹ bi a ti kọ ọ ninu ofin Mose, enia Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Then stood up Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and his brethren the priests, and Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and his brethren, and builded the altar of the God of Israel, to offer burnt offerings thereon, as it is written in the law of Moses the man of God.

entries.yo: Nwọn si gbe pẹpẹ na ka ipilẹ rẹ̀; nitori ẹ̀ru bà wọn nitori awọn enia ilẹ wọnni. Nwọn si rú ẹbọ ọrẹ sisun si Oluwa, ọrẹ ẹbọ sisun li owurọ ati li aṣalẹ.
entries.en: And they set the altar upon his bases; for fear was upon them because of the people of those countries: and they offered burnt offerings thereon unto the LORD, even burnt offerings morning and evening.

entries.yo: Nwọn si pa àse agọ mọ pẹlu, gẹgẹ bi a ti kọ ọ, nwọn si rú ẹbọ sisun ojojumọ pẹlu nipa iye ti a pa li aṣẹ, gẹgẹ bi isin ojojumọ;
entries.en: They kept also the feast of tabernacles, as it is written, and offered the daily burnt offerings by number, according to the custom, as the duty of every day required;

entries.yo: Lẹhin na nwọn si ru ẹbọ sisun igbagbogbo ati ti oṣu titun, ati ti gbogbo ajọ Oluwa, ti a si yà si mimọ́, ati ti olukuluku ti o fi tinu-tinu ru ẹbọ atinuwa si Oluwa.
entries.en: And afterward offered the continual burnt offering, both of the new moons, and of all the set feasts of the LORD that were consecrated, and of every one that willingly offered a freewill offering unto the LORD.

entries.yo: Lati ọjọ ikini oṣu keje ni nwọn bẹ̀rẹ lati ma rú ẹbọ sisun si Oluwa. Ṣugbọn a kò ti ifi ipilẹ tempili Oluwa lelẹ.
entries.en: From the first day of the seventh month began they to offer burnt offerings unto the LORD. But the foundation of the temple of the LORD was not yet laid.

entries.yo: Nwọn si fi owo fun awọn ọmọle pẹlu, ati fun awọn gbẹna-gbẹna, pẹlu onjẹ, ati ohun mimu, ati ororo, fun awọn ara Sidoni, ati fun awọn ara Tire, lati mu igi kedari ti Lebanoni wá si okun Joppa, gẹgẹ bi aṣẹ ti nwọn gbà lati ọwọ Kirusi ọba Persia.
entries.en: They gave money also unto the masons, and to the carpenters; and meat, and drink, and oil, unto them of Zidon, and to them of Tyre, to bring cedar trees from Lebanon to the sea of Joppa, according to the grant that they had of Cyrus king of Persia.

entries.yo: Li ọdun keji ti nwọn wá si ile Ọlọrun ni Jerusalemu, li oṣu keji, ni Serubbabeli, ọmọ Ṣealtieli bẹ̀rẹ, ati Jeṣua ọmọ Josadaki, ati iyokù awọn arakunrin wọn, awọn alufa ati awọn ọmọ Lefi, ati gbogbo awọn ti o ti ìgbekun jade wá si Jerusalemu, nwọn si yan awọn ọmọ Lefi lati ẹni ogun ọdun ati jù bẹ̃ lọ lati ma tọju iṣẹ ile Oluwa.
entries.en: Now in the second year of their coming unto the house of God at Jerusalem, in the second month, began Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and the remnant of their brethren the priests and the Levites, and all they that were come out of the captivity unto Jerusalem; and appointed the Levites, from twenty years old and upward, to set forward the work of the house of the LORD.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Jeṣua pẹlu awọn ọmọkunrin rẹ̀ ati awọn arakunrin rẹ̀, Kadmieli ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, awọn ọmọ Juda, jumọ dide bi ẹnikanṣoṣo lati ma tọju awọn oniṣẹ ninu ile Ọlọrun; awọn ọmọ Henadadi, pẹlu awọn ọmọ wọn, ati arakunrin wọn, awọn ọmọ Lefi.
entries.en: Then stood Jeshua with his sons and his brethren, Kadmiel and his sons, the sons of Judah, together, to set forward the workmen in the house of God: the sons of Henadad, with their sons and their brethren the Levites.

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn ọmọle si fi ipilẹ tempili Oluwa lelẹ, nwọn mu awọn alufa duro ninu aṣọ wọn, nwọn mu ipè lọwọ, ati awọn ọmọ Lefi, awọn ọmọ Asafu mu kimbali lọwọ, lati ma yìn Oluwa gẹgẹ bi ìlana Dafidi ọba Israeli.
entries.en: And when the builders laid the foundation of the temple of the LORD, they set the priests in their apparel with trumpets, and the Levites the sons of Asaph with cymbals, to praise the LORD, after the ordinance of David king of Israel.

entries.yo: Nwọn si jùmọ kọrin lẹsẹsẹ lati yìn ati lati dupẹ fun Oluwa, nitoripe o ṣeun, ati pe anu rẹ̀ si duro lailai lori Israeli. Gbogbo enia si ho iho nla, nigbati nwọn nyìn Oluwa, nitoriti a fi ipilẹ ile Oluwa lelẹ.
entries.en: And they sang together by course in praising and giving thanks unto the LORD; because he is good, for his mercy endureth for ever toward Israel. And all the people shouted with a great shout, when they praised the LORD, because the foundation of the house of the LORD was laid.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn pupọ ninu awọn alufa ati awọn ọmọ Lefi, pẹlu awọn olori awọn baba ti iṣe alàgba, ti nwọn ti ri ile atetekọṣe, nwọn fi ohùn rara sọkun, nigbati a fi ipilẹ ile yi lelẹ li oju wọn, ṣugbọn awọn pupọ si ho iho nla fun ayọ̀:
entries.en: But many of the priests and Levites and chief of the fathers, who were ancient men, that had seen the first house, when the foundation of this house was laid before their eyes, wept with a loud voice; and many shouted aloud for joy:

entries.yo: Tobẹ̃ ti awọn enia kò le mọ̀ iyatọ ariwo ayọ̀ kuro ninu ariwo ẹkun awọn enia; nitori awọn enia ho iho nla, a si gbọ́ ariwo na li okere rére.
entries.en: So that the people could not discern the noise of the shout of joy from the noise of the weeping of the people: for the people shouted with a loud shout, and the noise was heard afar off.

entries.yo: NIGBATI awọn ọta Juda ati Benjamini gbọ́ pe awọn ọmọ-igbekun nkọ́ tempili fun Oluwa Ọlọrun Israeli;
entries.en: Now when the adversaries of Judah and Benjamin heard that the children of the captivity builded the temple unto the LORD God of Israel;

entries.yo: Nigbana ni nwọn tọ̀ Serubbabeli wá, ati awọn olori awọn baba, nwọn si wi fun wọn pe, ẹ jẹ ki awa ki o ba nyin kọle, nitoriti awa nṣe afẹri Ọlọrun nyin, gẹgẹ bi ẹnyin; awa si nru ẹbọ si ọdọ rẹ̀, lati ọjọ Esarhaddoni, ọba Assuri, ẹniti o mu wa gòke wá ihinyi.
entries.en: Then they came to Zerubbabel, and to the chief of the fathers, and said unto them, Let us build with you: for we seek your God, as ye do; and we do sacrifice unto him since the days of Esar-haddon king of Assur, which brought us up hither.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Serubbabeli, ati Jeṣua ati iyokù ninu awọn olori awọn baba Israeli wi fun wọn pe, Kì iṣe fun awa pẹlu ẹnyin, lati jumọ kọ ile fun Ọlọrun wa; ṣugbọn awa tikarawa ni yio jùmọ kọle fun Oluwa Ọlọrun Israeli gẹgẹ bi Kirusi ọba, ọba Persia, ti paṣẹ fun wa,
entries.en: But Zerubbabel, and Jeshua, and the rest of the chief of the fathers of Israel, said unto them, Ye have nothing to do with us to build an house unto our God; but we ourselves together will build unto the LORD God of Israel, as king Cyrus the king of Persia hath commanded us.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni awọn enia ilẹ na mu ọwọ awọn enia Juda rọ, nwọn si yọ wọn li ẹnu ninu kikọle na.
entries.en: Then the people of the land weakened the hands of the people of Judah, and troubled them in building,

entries.yo: Nwọn si bẹ̀ awọn ìgbimọ li ọ̀wẹ si wọn, lati sọ ipinnu wọn di asan, ni gbogbo ọjọ Kirusi, ọba Persia, ani titi di ijọba Dariusi, ọba Persia.
entries.en: And hired counsellers against them, to frustrate their purpose, all the days of Cyrus king of Persia, even until the reign of Darius king of Persia.

entries.yo: Ati ni ijọba Ahasuerusi, ni ibẹ̀rẹ ijọba rẹ̀, ni nwọn kọwe ẹ̀sun lati fi awọn ara Juda ati Jerusalemu sùn.
entries.en: And in the reign of Ahasuerus, in the beginning of his reign, wrote they unto him an accusation against the inhabitants of Judah and Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Ati li ọjọ Artasasta ni Biṣlami, Mitredati, Tabeeli ati awọn ẹgbẹ rẹ̀ iyokù kọwe si Artasasta, ọba Persia: a si kọ iwe na li ède Siria, a si ṣe itumọ rẹ̀ li ède Siria.
entries.en: And in the days of Artaxerxes wrote Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel, and the rest of their companions, unto Artaxerxes king of Persia; and the writing of the letter was written in the Syrian tongue, and interpreted in the Syrian tongue.

entries.yo: Rehumu, adele ọba, ati Ṣimṣai, akọwe, kọ iwe ẹ̀sun Jerusalemu si Artasasta ọba, bi iru eyi:
entries.en: Rehum the chancellor and Shimshai the scribe wrote a letter against Jerusalem to Artaxerxes the king in this sort:

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Rehumu, adele-ọba, ati Ṣimṣai akọwe, ati awọn ẹgbẹ wọn iyokù: awọn ara Dina, ti Afarsatki, ti Tarpeli, ti Afarsi, ti Arkefi, ti Babiloni, ti Susanki, ti Dehafi ati ti Elamu,
entries.en: Then wrote Rehum the chancellor, and Shimshai the scribe, and the rest of their companions; the Dinaites, the Apharsathchites, the Tarpelites, the Apharsites, the Archevites, the Babylonians, the Susanchites, the Dehavites, and the Elamites,

entries.yo: Ati awọn orilẹ-ède iyokù ti Asnapperi, ọlọla ati ẹni-nla nì, kó rekọja wá, ti o si fi wọn do si ilu Samaria, ati awọn iyokù ti o wà ni ihahin odò, ati ẹlomiran.
entries.en: And the rest of the nations whom the great and noble Asnappar brought over, and set in the cities of Samaria, and the rest that are on this side the river, and at such a time.

entries.yo: Eyi ni atunkọ iwe na ti nwọn fi ranṣẹ si i, ani si Artasasta ọba: Iranṣẹ rẹ, awọn enia ihahin odò ati ẹlomiran.
entries.en: This is the copy of the letter that they sent unto him, even unto Artaxerxes the king; Thy servants the men on this side the river, and at such a time.

entries.yo: Ki ọba ki o mọ̀ pe, awọn Ju ti o ti ọdọ rẹ wá si ọdọ wa, nwọn de Jerusalemu, nwọn nkọ́ ọlọtẹ ilu ati ilu buburu, nwọn si ti fi odi rẹ̀ lelẹ, nwọn si ti so ipilẹ rẹ̀ mọra pọ̀.
entries.en: Be it known unto the king, that the Jews which came up from thee to us are come unto Jerusalem, building the rebellious and the bad city, and have set up the walls thereof, and joined the foundations.

entries.yo: Ki ọba ki o mọ̀ nisisiyi pe, bi a ba kọ ilu yi, ti a si tun odi rẹ̀ gbe soke tan, nigbana ni nwọn kì o san owo ori, owo-bode, ati owo odè, ati bẹ̃ni nikẹhin yio si pa awọn ọba li ara.
entries.en: Be it known now unto the king, that, if this city be builded, and the walls set up again, then will they not pay toll, tribute, and custom, and so thou shalt endamage the revenue of the kings.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi lati ãfin ọba wá li a sa ti mbọ́ wa, kò si yẹ fun wa lati ri àbuku ọba, nitorina li awa ṣe ranṣẹ lati wi fun ọba daju;
entries.en: Now because we have maintenance from the king's palace, and it was not meet for us to see the king's dishonour, therefore have we sent and certified the king;

entries.yo: Ki a le wá inu iwe-iranti awọn baba rẹ: bẹ̃ni iwọ o ri ninu iwe-iranti, iwọ o si mọ̀ pe, ọlọtẹ ni ilu yi, ti o si pa awọn ọba ati igberiko li ara, ati pe, nwọn ti ṣọtẹ ninu ikanna lati atijọ wá, nitori eyi li a fi fọ ilu na.
entries.en: That search may be made in the book of the records of thy fathers: so shalt thou find in the book of the records, and know that this city is a rebellious city, and hurtful unto kings and provinces, and that they have moved sedition within the same of old time: for which cause was this city destroyed.

entries.yo: Awa mu u da ọba li oju pe, bi a ba tun ilu yi kọ, ti a si pari odi rẹ̀ nipa ọ̀na yi, iwọ kì o ni ipin mọ ni ihahin odò.
entries.en: We certify the king that, if this city be builded again, and the walls thereof set up, by this means thou shalt have no portion on this side the river.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ọba fi èsi ranṣẹ si Rehumu, adele-ọba, ati si Ṣimṣai, akọwe, pẹlu awọn ẹgbẹ wọn iyokù ti ngbe Samaria, ati si awọn iyokù li oke odò: Alafia! ati kiki miran.
entries.en: Then sent the king an answer unto Rehum the chancellor, and to Shimshai the scribe, and to the rest of their companions that dwell in Samaria, and unto the rest beyond the river, Peace, and at such a time.

entries.yo: A kà iwe ti ẹnyin fi ranṣẹ si wa dajudaju niwaju mi.
entries.en: The letter which ye sent unto us hath been plainly read before me.

entries.yo: Mo si paṣẹ, a si ti wá, a si ri pe, lati atijọ wá, ilu yi a ti ma ṣọ̀tẹ si awọn ọba, ati pe irukerudo ati ọ̀tẹ li a ti nṣe ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And I commanded, and search hath been made, and it is found that this city of old time hath made insurrection against kings, and that rebellion and sedition have been made therein.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu awọn ọba alagbara li o ti wà lori Jerusalemu, awọn ti o jọba lori gbogbo ilu oke-odò; owo ori, owo odè, ati owo bodè li a ti nsan fun wọn.
entries.en: There have been mighty kings also over Jerusalem, which have ruled over all countries beyond the river; and toll, tribute, and custom, was paid unto them.

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o paṣẹ nisisiyi lati mu awọn ọkunrin wọnyi ṣiwọ, ki a má si kọ ilu na mọ, titi aṣẹ yio fi jade lati ọdọ mi wá.
entries.en: Give ye now commandment to cause these men to cease, and that this city be not builded, until another commandment shall be given from me.

entries.yo: Ẹ kiyesi ara nyin, ki ẹnyin ki o má jafara lati ṣe eyi: ẽṣe ti ìbajẹ yio fi ma dàgba si ipalara awọn ọba?
entries.en: Take heed now that ye fail not to do this: why should damage grow to the hurt of the kings?
