entries.yo: Mo bẹ̀ nyin, ẹ fi oko wọn, ọgbà-ajarà wọn, ọgbà-olifi wọn, ati ile wọn, ida-ọgọrun owo na pẹlu, ati ti ọkà, ọti-waini, ati ororo wọn, ti ẹ fi agbara gbà, fun wọn padà loni yi.
entries.en: Restore, I pray you, to them, even this day, their lands, their vineyards, their oliveyards, and their houses, also the the hundredth part of the money, and of the corn, the wine, and the oil, that ye exact of them.

entries.yo: Nwọn si wipe, Awa o fi fun wọn pada, awa kì yio si bere nkankan lọwọ wọn; bẹ̃li awa o ṣe bi iwọ ti wi. Nigbana ni mo pe awọn alufa, mo si mu wọn bura pe, nwọn o ṣe gẹgẹ bi ileri yi.
entries.en: Then said they, We will restore them, and will require nothing of them; so will we do as thou sayest. Then I called the priests, and took an oath of them, that they should do according to this promise.

entries.yo: Mo si gbọ̀n apo aṣọ mi, mo si wipe, Bayi ni ki Ọlọrun ki o gbọ̀n olukuluku enia kuro ni ile rẹ̀, ati kuro ninu iṣẹ rẹ̀, ti kò mu ileri yi ṣẹ, ani bayi ni ki a gbọ̀n ọ kuro, ki o si di ofo. Gbogbo ijọ si wipe, Amin! nwọn si fi iyìn fun Oluwa. Awọn enia na si ṣe gẹgẹ bi ileri yi.
entries.en: Also I shook my lap, and said, So God shake out every man from his house, and from his labour, that performeth not this promise, even thus be he shaken out, and emptied. And all the congregation said, Amen, and praised the LORD. And the people did according to this promise.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu lati akoko ti a ti yàn mi lati jẹ bãlẹ wọn ni ilẹ Juda, lati ogún ọdun titi de ọdun kejilelọgbọn Artasasta ọba, eyinì ni, ọdun mejila, emi ati awọn arakunrin mi kò jẹ onjẹ bãlẹ.
entries.en: Moreover from the time that I was appointed to be their governor in the land of Judah, from the twentieth year even unto the two and thirtieth year of Artaxerxes the king, that is, twelve years, I and my brethren have not eaten the bread of the governor.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn bãlẹ iṣaju, ti o ti wà, ṣaju mi, di ẹrù wiwo le lori awọn enia, nwọn si ti gbà akara ati ọti-waini, laika ogoji ṣekeli fadaka; pẹlupẹlu awọn ọmọkunrin wọn tilẹ lo agbara lori enia na: ṣugbọn emi kò ṣe bẹ̃ nitori ibẹ̀ru Ọlọrun.
entries.en: But the former governors that had been before me were chargeable unto the people, and had taken of them bread and wine, beside forty shekels of silver; yea, even their servants bare rule over the people: but so did not I, because of the fear of God.

entries.yo: Mo si mba iṣẹ odi yi lọ pẹlu, awa kò si rà oko kan: gbogbo awọn ọmọkunrin mi li o si gbajọ sibẹ si iṣẹ na.
entries.en: Yea, also I continued in the work of this wall, neither bought we any land: and all my servants were gathered thither unto the work.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu awọn ti o joko ni tabili mi jẹ ãdọjọ enia ninu awọn ara Juda ati ninu awọn ijoye, laika awọn ti o wá sọdọ wa lati ãrin awọn keferi ti o wà yi wa ka.
entries.en: Moreover there were at my table an hundred and fifty of the Jews and rulers, beside those that came unto us from among the heathen that are about us.

entries.yo: Njẹ ẹran ti a pese fun mi jẹ malũ kan ati ãyo agutan mẹfa; fun ijọ kan ni a pese adiẹ fun mi pẹlu, ati lẹ̃kan ni ijọ mẹwa onirũru ọti-waini: ṣugbọn fun gbogbo eyi emi kò bere onjẹ bãlẹ, nitori iṣẹ na wiwo lori awọn enia yi.
entries.en: Now that which was prepared for me daily was one ox and six choice sheep; also fowls were prepared for me, and once in ten days store of all sorts of wine: yet for all this required not I the bread of the governor, because the bondage was heavy upon this people.

entries.yo: Ranti mi, Ọlọrun mi, fun rere, gẹgẹ bi gbogbo eyi ti mo ti ṣe fun enia yi.
entries.en: Think upon me, my God, for good, according to all that I have done for this people.

entries.yo: O SI ṣe, nigbati Sanballati, ati Tobiah, ati Geṣemu, ara Arabia, ati awọn ọta wa iyokù, gbọ́ pe, mo ti mọ odi na, ati pe, kò kù ibi yiya kan ninu rẹ̀, (bi emi kò tilẹ iti gbe ilẹkùn wọnni ro ni ibode li akoko na;)
entries.en: Now it came to pass, when Sanballat, and Tobiah, and Geshem the Arabian, and the rest of our enemies, heard that I had builded the wall, and that there was no breach left therein; (though at that time I had not set up the doors upon the gates;)

entries.yo: Ni Sanballati ati Geṣemu ranṣẹ si mi, wipe, Wá, jẹ ki a jọ pade ninu ọkan ninu awọn ileto ni pẹtẹlẹ Ono. Ṣugbọn nwọn ngbero ati ṣe mi ni ibi.
entries.en: That Sanballat and Geshem sent unto me, saying, Come, let us meet together in some one of the villages in the plain of Ono. But they thought to do me mischief.

entries.yo: Mo si ran onṣẹ si wọn pe, Emi nṣe iṣẹ nla kan, emi kò le sọkalẹ wá: ẽṣe ti iṣẹ na yio fi duro nigbati mo ba fi i silẹ, ti mo ba si sọkalẹ tọ̀ nyin wá?
entries.en: And I sent messengers unto them, saying, I am doing a great work, so that I cannot come down: why should the work cease, whilst I leave it, and come down to you?

entries.yo: Sibẹ nwọn ranṣẹ si mi nigba mẹrin bayi; mo si da wọn lohùn bakanna.
entries.en: Yet they sent unto me four times after this sort; and I answered them after the same manner.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Sanballati rán ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ̀ si mi bakanna nigba karun ti on ti iwe ṣíṣi lọwọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Then sent Sanballat his servant unto me in like manner the fifth time with an open letter in his hand;

entries.yo: Ninu rẹ̀ li a kọ pe, A nrohin lãrin awọn keferi, Gaṣimu si wi pe, iwọ ati awọn ara Juda rò lati ṣọ̀tẹ: nitori idi eyi ni iwọ ṣe mọ odi na, ki iwọ le jẹ ọba wọn, gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ wọnyi.
entries.en: Wherein was written, It is reported among the heathen, and Gashmu saith it, that thou and the Jews think to rebel: for which cause thou buildest the wall, that thou mayest be their king, according to these words.

entries.yo: Iwọ pẹlu si ti yan awọn woli lati kede rẹ ni Jerusalemu wipe, Ọba wà ni Juda: nisisiyi ni a o si rò o fun ọba gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ wọnyi. Njẹ wá nisisiyi, ki a jọ gbimọ̀ pọ̀.
entries.en: And thou hast also appointed prophets to preach of thee at Jerusalem, saying, There is a king in Judah: and now shall it be reported to the king according to these words. Come now therefore, and let us take counsel together.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni mo ranṣẹ si i wipe, A kò ṣe iru eyi, ti iwọ sọ, ṣugbọn iwọ rò wọn li ọkàn ara rẹ ni.
entries.en: Then I sent unto him, saying, There are no such things done as thou sayest, but thou feignest them out of thine own heart.

entries.yo: Nitori gbogbo wọn mu wa bẹ̀ru, wipe, Ọwọ wọn yio rọ ninu iṣẹ na, ki a má le ṣe e. Njẹ nisisiyi, Ọlọrun, mu ọwọ mi le.
entries.en: For they all made us afraid, saying, Their hands shall be weakened from the work, that it be not done. Now therefore, O God, strengthen my hands.

entries.yo: Mo si wá si ile Ṣemaiah ọmọ Delaiah ọmọ Mehetabeeli, ti a há mọ, o si wipe, Jẹ ki a pejọ ni ile Ọlọrun ni inu tempili ki a si tì ilẹkùn tempili; nitori nwọn o wá lati pa ọ; nitõtọ, li oru ni nwọn o wá lati pa ọ.
entries.en: Afterward I came unto the house of Shemaiah the son of Delaiah the son of Mehetabeel, who was shut up; and he said, Let us meet together in the house of God, within the temple, and let us shut the doors of the temple: for they will come to slay thee; yea, in the night will they come to slay thee.

entries.yo: Mo si wipe, Enia bi emi a ma sa? Tali o si dabi emi, ti o jẹ wọ inu tempili lọ lati gba ẹmi rẹ̀ là? Emi kì yio wọ̀ ọ lọ.
entries.en: And I said, Should such a man as I flee? and who is there, that, being as I am, would go into the temple to save his life? I will not go in.

entries.yo: Sa kiyesi i, mo woye pe, Ọlọrun kò rán a, ṣugbọn pe, o nsọ asọtẹlẹ yi si mi: nitori Tobiah ati Sanballati ti bẹ̀ ẹ li ọ̀wẹ.
entries.en: And, lo, I perceived that God had not sent him; but that he pronounced this prophecy against me: for Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him.

entries.yo: Nitorina li o ṣe bẹ̀ ẹ li ọ̀wẹ, ki emi ba foya, ki emi ṣe bẹ̃, ki emi si ṣẹ̀, ki nwọn le ri ihìn buburu rò, ki nwọn le kẹgàn mi.
entries.en: Therefore was he hired, that I should be afraid, and do so, and sin, and that they might have matter for an evil report, that they might reproach me.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun mi, rò ti Tobiah ati Sanballati gẹgẹ bi iṣẹ wọn wọnyi, ati ti Noadiah, woli obinrin, ati awọn woli iyokù ti nwọn fẹ mu mi bẹ̀ru,
entries.en: My God, think thou upon Tobiah and Sanballat according to these their works, and on the prophetess Noadiah, and the rest of the prophets, that would have put me in fear.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li a pari odi na li ọjọ kẹ̃dọgbọn oṣù Eluli, ni ọjọ mejilelãdọta.
entries.en: So the wall was finished in the twenty and fifth day of the month Elul, in fifty and two days.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati gbogbo awọn ọta wa gbọ́, gbogbo awọn keferi àgbegbe wa si bẹ̀ru, nwọn si rẹ̀wẹsi pupọ li oju ara wọn, nitori nwọn woye pe, lati ọwọ Ọlọrun wá li a ti ṣe iṣẹ wọnyi.
entries.en: And it came to pass, that when all our enemies heard thereof, and all the heathen that were about us saw these things, they were much cast down in their own eyes: for they perceived that this work was wrought of our God.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu li ọjọ wọnni, awọn ijòye Juda ran iwe pupọ si Tobiah, iwe Tobiah si de ọdọ wọn.
entries.en: Moreover in those days the nobles of Judah sent many letters unto Tobiah, and the letters of Tobiah came unto them.

entries.yo: Nitori ọ̀pọlọpọ ni Juda ti ba a mulẹ nitori ti o jẹ ana Sekaniah ọmọ Ara; ọmọ rẹ̀ Johanani si ti fẹ ọmọ Meṣullamu, ọmọ Berekiah.
entries.en: For there were many in Judah sworn unto him, because he was the son in law of Shechaniah the son of Arah; and his son Johanan had taken the daughter of Meshullam the son of Berechiah.

entries.yo: Nwọn sọ̀rọ rere rẹ̀ pẹlu niwaju mi, nwọn si sọ ọ̀rọ mi fun u. Tobiah rán iwe lati da aiya já mi.
entries.en: Also they reported his good deeds before me, and uttered my words to him. And Tobiah sent letters to put me in fear.

entries.yo: O SI ṣe, nigbati a mọ odi na tan, ti mo si gbe ilẹkùn ro, ti a si yan awọn oludena ati awọn akọrin, ati awọn ọmọ Lefi,
entries.en: Now it came to pass, when the wall was built, and I had set up the doors, and the porters and the singers and the Levites were appointed,

entries.yo: Mo si fun Hanani arakunrin mi, ati Hananiah ijòye ãfin, li aṣẹ lori Jerusalemu: nitori olododo enia li o ṣe, o si bẹ̀ru Ọlọrun jù enia pupọ lọ.
entries.en: That I gave my brother Hanani, and Hananiah the ruler of the palace, charge over Jerusalem: for he was a faithful man, and feared God above many.

entries.yo: Mo si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ má jẹ ki ilẹkùn odi Jerusalemu ṣi titi õrùn o fi mú; bi nwọn si ti duro, jẹ ki wọn se ilẹkùn, ki nwọn si há wọn, ki nwọn si yan ẹ̀ṣọ ninu awọn ti ngbe Jerusalemu, olukuluku ninu iṣọ rẹ̀, ati olukuluku ninu ile rẹ̀.
entries.en: And I said unto them, Let not the gates of Jerusalem be opened until the sun be hot; and while they stand by, let them shut the doors, and bar them: and appoint watches of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, every one in his watch, and every one to be over against his house.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ilu na gbõrò, o si tobi, awọn enia inu rẹ̀ si kere, a kò si kọ́ ile tan.
entries.en: Now the city was large and great: but the people were few therein, and the houses were not builded.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun mi si fi si mi li ọkàn lati ko awọn ijòye jọ, ati awọn olori, ati awọn enia, ki a le kà wọn nipa idile wọn. Mo si ri iwe idile awọn ti o kọ́ goke wá, mo ri pe, a kọ ọ sinu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And my God put into mine heart to gather together the nobles, and the rulers, and the people, that they might be reckoned by genealogy. And I found a register of the genealogy of them which came up at the first, and found written therein,

entries.yo: Wọnyi ni awọn ọmọ igberiko, ti o gòke wá lati ìgbekun ninu awọn ti a ti ko lọ, ti Nebukadnesari ọba Babiloni ti ko lọ, ti nwọn tun padà wá si Jerusalemu, ati si Juda, olukuluku si ilu rẹ̀.
entries.en: These are the children of the province, that went up out of the captivity, of those that had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away, and came again to Jerusalem and to Judah, every one unto his city;

entries.yo: Awọn ti o ba Serubbabeli wá, Jeṣua, Nehemia, Asariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordikai, Bilṣani, Mispereti, Bigfai, Nehumu, Baana. Iye awọn ọkunrin enia Israeli li eyi;
entries.en: Who came with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, Baanah. The number, I say, of the men of the people of Israel was this;

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Paroṣi, ẹgbã o le mejilelãdọsan.
entries.en: The children of Parosh, two thousand an hundred seventy and two.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Ṣefatiah, ojidinirinwo o le mejila.
entries.en: The children of Shephatiah, three hundred seventy and two.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Ara, adọtalelẹgbẹta o le meji.
entries.en: The children of Arah, six hundred fifty and two.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Pahat-moabu, ti awọn ọmọ Jeṣua, ati Joabu, ẹgbẹrinla o le mejidilogun.
entries.en: The children of Pahath-moab, of the children of Jeshua and Joab, two thousand and eight hundred and eighteen.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Elamu, ẹgbẹfa o le mẹrinlelãdọta.
entries.en: The children of Elam, a thousand two hundred fifty and four.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Sattu, ojilelẹgbẹrin o le marun.
entries.en: The children of Zattu, eight hundred forty and five.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Sakkai, ojidilẹgbẹrin.
entries.en: The children of Zaccai, seven hundred and threescore.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Binnui, ojilelẹgbẹta o le mẹjọ.
entries.en: The children of Binnui, six hundred forty and eight.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Bebai, ẹgbẹta o le mejidilọgbọn.
entries.en: The children of Bebai, six hundred twenty and eight.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Asgadi, egbejila o di mejidilọgọrin.
entries.en: The children of Azgad, two thousand three hundred twenty and two.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Adonikamu ọtalelẹgbẹta o le meje.
entries.en: The children of Adonikam, six hundred threescore and seven.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Bigfai, ẹgbã o le mẹtadilãdọrin.
entries.en: The children of Bigvai, two thousand threescore and seven.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Adini, ãdọtalelẹgbẹta o le marun.
entries.en: The children of Adin, six hundred fifty and five.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Ateri, ti Hesekiah mejidilọgọrun.
entries.en: The children of Ater of Hezekiah, ninety and eight.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Haṣamu, ọrindinirinwo o le mẹjọ.
entries.en: The children of Hashum, three hundred twenty and eight.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Besai, ọrindinirinwo o le mẹrin.
entries.en: The children of Bezai, three hundred twenty and four.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Harifu mejilelãdọfa.
entries.en: The children of Hariph, an hundred and twelve.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Gibioni, marundilọgọrun.
entries.en: The children of Gibeon, ninety and five.

entries.yo: Awọn ọkunrin Betlehemu ati Netofa, ọgọsan o le mẹjọ.
entries.en: The men of Bethlehem and Netophah, an hundred fourscore and eight.

entries.yo: Awọn ọkunrin Anatoti, mejidilãdoje.
entries.en: The men of Anathoth, an hundred twenty and eight.

entries.yo: Awọn ọkunrin Bet-asmafeti, mejilelogoji.
entries.en: The men of Beth-azmaveth, forty and two.

entries.yo: Awọn ọkunrin Kiriat-jearimu, Kefira, ati Beeroti, ọtadilẹgbẹrin o le mẹta,
entries.en: The men of Kirjath-jearim, Chephirah, and Beeroth, seven hundred forty and three.

entries.yo: Awọn ọkunrin Rama ati Gaba, ẹgbẹta o le mọkanlelogun.
entries.en: The men of Ramah and Geba, six hundred twenty and one.

entries.yo: Awọn ọkunrin Mikmasi, mejilelọgọfa.
entries.en: The men of Michmas, an hundred and twenty and two.

entries.yo: Awọn ọkunrin Beteli ati Ai, mẹtalelọgọfa.
entries.en: The men of Bethel and Ai, an hundred twenty and three.

entries.yo: Awọn ọkunrin Nebo miran mejilelãdọta.
entries.en: The men of the other Nebo, fifty and two.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Elamu miran ẹgbẹfa o le mẹrinlelãdọta.
entries.en: The children of the other Elam, a thousand two hundred fifty and four.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Harimu, ọrindinirinwo.
entries.en: The children of Harim, three hundred and twenty.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Jeriko, ọtadinirinwo o le marun.
entries.en: The children of Jericho, three hundred forty and five.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Lodi, Hadidi, ati Ono, ọrindilẹgbẹrin o le ọkan.
entries.en: The children of Lod, Hadid, and Ono, seven hundred twenty and one.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Senaah ẹgbãji o di ãdọrin.
entries.en: The children of Senaah, three thousand nine hundred and thirty.

entries.yo: Awọn alufa: awọn ọmọ Jedaiah ti ile Jeṣua, ẹgbã o di mẹtadilọgbọn.
entries.en: The priests: the children of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua, nine hundred seventy and three.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Immeri, ẹgbẹrun o le mejilelãdọta.
entries.en: The children of Immer, a thousand fifty and two.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Paṣuri, ẹgbẹfa o le mẹtadiladọta.
entries.en: The children of Pashur, a thousand two hundred forty and seven.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Harimu ẹgbẹrun o le mẹtadilogun.
entries.en: The children of Harim, a thousand and seventeen.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Lefi: awọn ọmọ Jeṣua, ti Kadmieli, ninu ọmọ Hodafa, mẹrinlelãdọrin.
entries.en: The Levites: the children of Jeshua, of Kadmiel, and of the children of Hodevah, seventy and four.

entries.yo: Awọn akọrin: awọn ọmọ Asafu, mejidilãdọjọ.
entries.en: The singers: the children of Asaph, an hundred forty and eight.

entries.yo: Awọn oludena: awọn ọmọ Ṣallumu, awọn ọmọ Ateri, awọn ọmọ Talmoni, awọn ọmọ Akkubu, awọn ọmọ Hatita, awọn ọmọ Ṣobai, mejidilogoje.
entries.en: The porters: the children of Shallum, the children of Ater, the children of Talmon, the children of Akkub, the children of Hatita, the children of Shobai, an hundred thirty and eight.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Netinimu: awọn ọmọ Siha, awọn ọmọ Haṣufa, awọn ọmọ Tabbaoti,
entries.en: The Nethinims: the children of Ziha, the children of Hashupha, the children of Tabbaoth,

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Kerosi, awọn ọmọ Sia, awọn ọmọ Padoni,
entries.en: The children of Keros, the children of Sia, the children of Padon,

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Lebana, awọn ọmọ Hagaba, awọn ọmọ Salmai,
entries.en: The children of Lebana, the children of Hagaba, the children of Shalmai,

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Hanani, awọn ọmọ Giddeli, awọn ọmọ Gahari,
entries.en: The children of Hanan, the children of Giddel, the children of Gahar,

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Reaiah, awọn ọmọ Resini, awọn ọmọ Nekoda,
entries.en: The children of Reaiah, the children of Rezin, the children of Nekoda,

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Gassamu, awọn ọmọ Ussa, awọn ọmọ Fasea,
entries.en: The children of Gazzam, the children of Uzza, the children of Phaseah,

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Besai, awọn ọmọ Meunimu, awọn ọmọ Nefiṣesimu,
entries.en: The children of Besai, the children of Meunim, the children of Nephishesim,

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Bakbuku, awọn ọmọ Hakufa, awọn ọmọ Harhuri,
entries.en: The children of Bakbuk, the children of Hakupha, the children of Harhur,

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Basliti, awọn ọmọ Mehida, awọn ọmọ Harsa,
entries.en: The children of Bazlith, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha,

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Barkosi, awọn ọmọ Sisera, awọn ọmọ Tama,
entries.en: The children of Barkos, the children of Sisera, the children of Tamah,

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Nesia, awọn ọmọ Hatifa.
entries.en: The children of Neziah, the children of Hatipha.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ awọn iranṣẹ Solomoni: awọn ọmọ Sotai, awọn ọmọ Sofereti, awọn ọmọ Perida,
entries.en: The children of Solomon's servants: the children of Sotai, the children of Sophereth, the children of Perida,

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Jaala, awọn ọmọ Darkoni, awọn ọmọ Giddeli,
entries.en: The children of Jaala, the children of Darkon, the children of Giddel,

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Ṣefatiah, awọn ọmọ Hattili, awọn ọmọ Pokereti ti Sebaimu, awọn ọmọ Amoni.
entries.en: The children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth of Zebaim, the children of Amon.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn Netinimu, ati awọn ọmọ awọn iranṣẹ Solomoni jẹ irinwo din mẹjọ.
entries.en: All the Nethinims, and the children of Solomon's servants, were three hundred ninety and two.

entries.yo: Awọn wọnyi li o si goke lati Telhariṣa, Kerubu, Addoni, ati Immeri wá: ṣugbọn nwọn kò le fi ile baba wọn hàn, tabi iran wọn, bi nwọn iṣe ti Israeli.
entries.en: And these were they which went up also from Telmelah, Telharesha, Cherub, Addon, and Immer: but they could not shew their father's house, nor their seed, whether they were of Israel.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Delaiah, awọn ọmọ Tobiah, awọn ọmọ Nekoda, ojilelẹgbẹta ole meji.
entries.en: The children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda, six hundred forty and two.

entries.yo: Ati ninu awọn alufa: awọn ọmọ Habaiah, awọn ọmọ Kosi, awọn ọmọ Barsillai, ti o ni ọkan ninu awọn ọmọbinrin Barsillai, ara Gileadi, li aya, a si npè e nipa orukọ wọn.
entries.en: And of the priests: the children of Habaiah, the children of Koz, the children of Barzillai, which took one of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite to wife, and was called after their name.

entries.yo: Awọn wọnyi wá iwe orukọ wọn ninu awọn wọnyi ti a kọ orukọ wọn nipa idile ṣugbọn a kò ri i: nitorina li a ṣe yà wọn kurò ninu oyè alufa.
entries.en: These sought their register among those that were reckoned by genealogy, but it was not found: therefore were they, as polluted, put from the priesthood.

entries.yo: Bãlẹ na si wi fun wọn pe, ki nwọn máṣe jẹ ninu ohun mimọ́ julọ, titi alufa kan yio fi duro pẹlu Urimu, ati Tummimu,
entries.en: And the Tirshatha said unto them, that they should not eat of the most holy things, till there stood up a priest with Urim and Thummim.

entries.yo: Iye gbogbo ijọ jasi ẹgbãmọkanlelogun o le ojidinirinwo.
entries.en: The whole congregation together was forty and two thousand three hundred and threescore,

entries.yo: Laikà awọn iranṣẹkunrin wọn ati iranṣẹ-binrin wọn, iye wọn jẹ ẹgbẹtadilẹgbãrin o di ẹtalelọgọta: nwọn si ni ojilugba o le marun akọni ọkunrin ati akọni obinrin.
entries.en: Beside their manservants and their maidservants, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred thirty and seven: and they had two hundred forty and five singing men and singing women.

entries.yo: Ẹṣin wọn jẹ ọtadilẹgbẹrin o di mẹrin: ibaka nwọn jẹ ojilugba o le marun:
entries.en: Their horses, seven hundred thirty and six: their mules, two hundred forty and five:

entries.yo: Rakumi jẹ ojilenirinwo o di marun: kẹtẹkẹtẹ jẹ ẹgbẹrinlelọgbọn o di ọgọrin.
entries.en: Their camels, four hundred thirty and five: six thousand seven hundred and twenty asses.

entries.yo: Omiran ninu awọn olori ninu awọn baba fi nkan si iṣẹ na. Bãlẹ fi ẹgbẹrun dramu wura, ãdọta awokoto, ọrindilẹgbẹta le mẹwa ẹwu alufa sinu iṣura na.
entries.en: And some of the chief of the fathers gave unto the work. The Tirshatha gave to the treasure a thousand drams of gold, fifty basons, five hundred and thirty priests' garments.

entries.yo: Ninu awọn olori ninu awọn baba fi ọkẹ meji dramu wura, ati ẹgbọkanla mina fadaka si iṣura iṣẹ na.
entries.en: And some of the chief of the fathers gave to the treasure of the work twenty thousand drams of gold, and two thousand and two hundred pound of silver.

entries.yo: Ati eyiti awọn enia iyokù mu wá jẹ ọkẹ meji dramu wura, ati ẹgbã mina fadaka, ati ẹwu alufa mẹtadilãdọrin.
entries.en: And that which the rest of the people gave was twenty thousand drams of gold, and two thousand pound of silver, and threescore and seven priests' garments.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni awọn alufa, ati awọn ọmọ Lefi, ati awọn oludena, ati awọn akọrin, ati ninu awọn enia, ati awọn Netinimu, ati gbogbo Israeli, ngbe ilu wọn; nigbati oṣu keje si pé, awọn ọmọ Israeli wà ni ilu wọn.
entries.en: So the priests, and the Levites, and the porters, and the singers, and some of the people, and the Nethinims, and all Israel, dwelt in their cities; and when the seventh month came, the children of Israel were in their cities.

entries.yo: NIGBANA ni gbogbo awọn enia ko ara wọn jọ bi enia kan si ita ti o wà niwaju ẹnu-bode omi; nwọn si sọ fun Esra akọwe lati mu iwe ofin Mose wá, ti Oluwa ti paṣẹ fun Israeli.
entries.en: And all the people gathered themselves together as one man into the street that was before the water gate; and they spake unto Ezra the scribe to bring the book of the law of Moses, which the LORD had commanded to Israel.

entries.yo: Esra alufa si mu ofin na wá iwaju ijọ t'ọkunrin t'obinrin, ati gbogbo awọn ti o le fi oye gbọ́, li ọjọ kini oṣu ekeje.
entries.en: And Ezra the priest brought the law before the congregation both of men and women, and all that could hear with understanding, upon the first day of the seventh month.

entries.yo: O si kà ninu rẹ̀ niwaju ita ti o wà niwaju ẹnu-bode omi lati owurọ titi di idaji ọjọ, niwaju awọn ọkunrin ati awọn obinrin, ati awọn ti o le ye; gbogbo enia si tẹtisilẹ si iwe ofin.
entries.en: And he read therein before the street that was before the water gate from the morning until midday, before the men and the women, and those that could understand; and the ears of all the people were attentive unto the book of the law.

entries.yo: Esra akọwe si duro lori aga iduro sọ̀rọ, ti nwọn ṣe nitori eyi na: lẹba ọdọ rẹ̀ ni Mattitiah si duro, ati Ṣema, ati Anaiah, ati Urijah, ati Hilkiah, ati Maaseiah, li ọwọ ọtun rẹ̀; ati li ọwọ òsi rẹ̀ ni Pedaiah, ati Miṣaeli, ati Malkiah, ati Haṣumu, ati Haṣbadana, Sekariah, ati Meṣullamu.
entries.en: And Ezra the scribe stood upon a pulpit of wood, which they had made for the purpose; and beside him stood Mattithiah, and Shema, and Anaiah, and Urijah, and Hilkiah, and Maaseiah, on his right hand; and on his left hand, Pedaiah, and Mishael, and Malchiah, and Hashum, and Hashbadana, Zechariah, and Meshullam.

entries.yo: Esra si ṣi iwe na li oju gbogbo enia; (nitori on ga jù gbogbo enia) nigbati o si ṣi i, gbogbo enia dide duro:
entries.en: And Ezra opened the book in the sight of all the people; (for he was above all the people;) and when he opened it, all the people stood up:

entries.yo: Esra si fi ibukun fun Oluwa Ọlọrun, ti o tobi. Gbogbo enia si dahun pe, Amin, Amin! pẹlu gbigbe ọwọ wọn soke: nwọn si tẹ̀ ori wọn ba, nwọn si sìn Oluwa ni idojubòlẹ̀.
entries.en: And Ezra blessed the LORD, the great God. And all the people answered, Amen, Amen, with lifting up their hands: and they bowed their heads, and worshipped the LORD with their faces to the ground.

entries.yo: Jeṣua pẹlu ati Bani, ati Ṣerebiah, Jamini, Akkubu, Ṣabbetai, Hodijah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Asariah, Josabadi, Hanani, Pelaiah, ati awọn ọmọ Lefi, mu ki ofin ye awọn enia: awọn enia si duro ni ipò wọn.
entries.en: Also Jeshua, and Bani, and Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodijah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, Pelaiah, and the Levites, caused the people to understand the law: and the people stood in their place.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni nwọn kà ninu iwe ofin Ọlọrun ketekete, nwọn tumọ rẹ̀, nwọn si mu ki iwe kikà na ye wọn.
entries.en: So they read in the book in the law of God distinctly, and gave the sense, and caused them to understand the reading.

entries.yo: Ati Nehemiah ti iṣe bãlẹ, ati Esra alufa, akọwe, ati awọn ọmọ Lefi, ti o kọ́ awọn enia wi fun gbogbo enia pe, Ọjọ yi jẹ mimọ́ fun Oluwa Ọlọrun nyin; ẹ má ṣọ̀fọ ki ẹ má si sọkún. Nitori gbogbo awọn enia sọkún, nigbati nwọn gbọ́ ọ̀rọ ofin.
entries.en: And Nehemiah, which is the Tirshatha, and Ezra the priest the scribe, and the Levites that taught the people, said unto all the people, This day is holy unto the LORD your God; mourn not, nor weep. For all the people wept, when they heard the words of the law.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni o wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ lọ, ẹ jẹ ọ̀ra ki ẹ si mu ohun didùn, ki ẹ si fi apakan ipin ranṣẹ si awọn ti a kò pèse fun: nitori mimọ́ ni ọjọ yi fun Oluwa: ẹ máṣe banujẹ; nitori ayọ̀ Oluwa on li agbàra nyin.
entries.en: Then he said unto them, Go your way, eat the fat, and drink the sweet, and send portions unto them for whom nothing is prepared: for this day is holy unto our Lord: neither be ye sorry; for the joy of the LORD is your strength.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni awọn ọmọ Lefi mu gbogbo enia dakẹ jẹ, wipe, ẹ dakẹ, nitori mimọ́ ni ọjọ yi; ẹ má si ṣe banujẹ.
entries.en: So the Levites stilled all the people, saying, Hold your peace, for the day is holy; neither be ye grieved.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn enia lọ lati jẹ ati lati mu ati lati fi ipin ranṣẹ, ati lati yọ ayọ̀ nla, nitoriti ọ̀rọ ti a sọ fun wọn ye wọn.
entries.en: And all the people went their way to eat, and to drink, and to send portions, and to make great mirth, because they had understood the words that were declared unto them.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ keji awọn olori awọn baba gbogbo awọn enia, awọn alufa, ati awọn ọmọ Lefi pejọ si ọdọ Esra akọwe, ki o le fi ọ̀rọ ofin ye wọn.
entries.en: And on the second day were gathered together the chief of the fathers of all the people, the priests, and the Levites, unto Ezra the scribe, even to understand the words of the law.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ri a kọ sinu iwe-ofin, ti Oluwa ti pa li aṣẹ nipa ọwọ Mose pe, ki awọn ọmọ Israeli gbe inu agọ ni àse oṣu keje:
entries.en: And they found written in the law which the LORD had commanded by Moses, that the children of Israel should dwell in booths in the feast of the seventh month:

entries.yo: Pe, ki nwọn funrere, ki nwọn kede ni gbogbo ilu wọn, ati ni Jerusalemu, wipe, Ẹ jade lọ si òke, ki ẹ si mu ẹka igi olifi, ẹka igi pine, ati ẹka igi matili (myrtle) imọ ọpẹ, ati ẹka igi ti o tobi, lati ṣe agọ gẹgẹ bi a ti kọ ọ.
entries.en: And that they should publish and proclaim in all their cities, and in Jerusalem, saying, Go forth unto the mount, and fetch olive branches, and pine branches, and myrtle branches, and palm branches, and branches of thick trees, to make booths, as it is written.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni awọn enia na jade lọ, nwọn si mu wọn wá, nwọn pa agọ fun ara wọn, olukuluku lori orule ile rẹ̀, ati li àgbala wọn, ati li àgbala ile Ọlọrun, ati ni ita ẹnu-bode omi, ati ni ita ẹnu-bode Efraimu.
entries.en: So the people went forth, and brought them, and made themselves booths, every one upon the roof of his house, and in their courts, and in the courts of the house of God, and in the street of the water gate, and in the street of the gate of Ephraim.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ijọ enia ninu awọn ti o pada bọ̀ lati oko-ẹrú si pa agọ, nwọn si gbe abẹ awọn agọ na: nitori lati akokò Joṣua ọmọ Nuni wá, titi di ọjọ na awọn ọmọ Israeli kò ṣe bẹ̃. Ayọ̀ nlanla si wà.
entries.en: And all the congregation of them that were come again out of the captivity made booths, and sat under the booths: for since the days of Jeshua the son of Nun unto that day had not the children of Israel done so. And there was very great gladness.

entries.yo: Esra si kà ninu iwe ofin Ọlọrun li ojojumọ, lati ọjọ kini titi de ọjọ ikẹhin. Nwọn si pa àse na mọ li ọjọ meje, ati lọjọ kẹjọ, nwọn ni apejọ ti o ni ìronu gẹgẹ bi iṣe wọn.
entries.en: Also day by day, from the first day unto the last day, he read in the book of the law of God. And they kept the feast seven days; and on the eighth day was a solemn assembly, according unto the manner.

entries.yo: LI ọjọ kẹrinlelogun oṣu yi, awọn ọmọ Israeli pejọ ninu àwẹ ati aṣọ ọ̀fọ, ati erupẹ lori wọn.
entries.en: Now in the twenty and fourth day of this month the children of Israel were assembled with fasting, and with sackclothes, and earth upon them.

entries.yo: Awọn iru-ọmọ Israeli si ya ara wọn kuro ninu awọn ọmọ alejo, nwọn si duro, nwọn jẹwọ ẹ̀ṣẹ wọn, ati aiṣedede awọn baba wọn.
entries.en: And the seed of Israel separated themselves from all strangers, and stood and confessed their sins, and the iniquities of their fathers.

entries.yo: Nwọn si dide duro ni ipò wọn, nwọn si fi idamẹrin ọjọ kà ninu iwe ofin Oluwa Ọlọrun wọn; nwọn si fi idamẹrin jẹwọ, nwọn si sìn Oluwa Ọlọrun wọn.
entries.en: And they stood up in their place, and read in the book of the law of the LORD their God one fourth part of the day; and another fourth part they confessed, and worshipped the LORD their God.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Jeṣua, ati Bani, Kadmieli, Ṣebaniah, Bunni, Ṣerebiah, Bani ati Kenani duro lori pẹtẹsì awọn ọmọ Lefi, nwọn si fi ohun rara kigbe si Oluwa Ọlọrun wọn.
entries.en: Then stood up upon the stairs, of the Levites, Jeshua, and Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, and Chenani, and cried with a loud voice unto the LORD their God.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Lefi, Jeṣua, Kadmieli, Bani, Haṣabaiah, Ṣerebiah, Hodijah, Sebaniah, ati Pelaniah, si wipe: Ẹ dide, ki ẹ fi iyìn fun Oluwa Ọlọrun nyin lai ati lailai: ibukun si ni fun orukọ rẹ ti o li ogo, ti o ga jù gbogbo ibukun ati iyìn lọ.
entries.en: Then the Levites, Jeshua, and Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabniah, Sherebiah, Hodijah, Shebaniah, and Pethahiah, said, Stand up and bless the LORD your God for ever and ever: and blessed be thy glorious name, which is exalted above all blessing and praise.

entries.yo: Iwọ, ani iwọ nikanṣoṣo li Oluwa; iwọ li o ti dá ọrun, ọrun awọn ọrun pẹlu gbogbo ogun wọn, aiye, ati ohun gbogbo ti mbẹ ninu rẹ̀, okun, ati ohun gbogbo ti mbẹ̀ ninu rẹ̀, iwọ si pa gbogbo wọn mọ́ lãyè, ogun ọrun si nsìn ọ.
entries.en: Thou, even thou, art LORD alone; thou hast made heaven, the heaven of heavens, with all their host, the earth, and all things that are therein, the seas, and all that is therein, and thou preservest them all; and the host of heaven worshippeth thee.

entries.yo: Iwọ ni Oluwa Ọlọrun, ti o ti yan Abramu, ti o si mu u jade lati Uri ti Kaldea wá, iwọ si sọ orukọ rẹ̀ ni Abrahamu;
entries.en: Thou art the LORD the God, who didst choose Abram, and broughtest him forth out of Ur of the Chaldees, and gavest him the name of Abraham;

entries.yo: Iwọ si ri pe ọkàn rẹ̀ jẹ olõtọ niwaju rẹ, iwọ si ba a dá majẹmu lati fi ilẹ awọn ara Kenaani, awọn ara Hitti, awọn ara Amori, ati awọn ara Perisi, ati awọn ara Jebusi, ati awọn ara Girgasi fun u, lati fi fun iru-ọmọ rẹ̀, iwọ si ti mu ọ̀rọ rẹ ṣẹ; nitori olododo ni iwọ:
entries.en: And foundest his heart faithful before thee, and madest a covenant with him to give the land of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Jebusites, and the Girgashites, to give it, I say, to his seed, and hast performed thy words; for thou art righteous:

entries.yo: Iwọ si ri ipọnju awọn baba wa ni Egipti, o si gbọ́ igbe wọn lẹba Okun Pupa;
entries.en: And didst see the affliction of our fathers in Egypt, and heardest their cry by the Red sea;

entries.yo: O si fi ami, ati iṣẹ-iyanu hàn li ara Farao, ati li ara gbogbo iranṣẹ rẹ̀, ati li ara gbogbo enia ilẹ rẹ̀: nitori iwọ mọ̀ pe, nwọn hu ìwa igberaga si wọn. Iwọ si fi orukọ fun ara rẹ bi ti oni yi.
entries.en: And shewedst signs and wonders upon Pharoah, and on all his servants, and on all the people of his land: for thou knewest that they dealt proudly against them. So didst thou get thee a name, as it is this day.

entries.yo: Iwọ si ti pin okun niwaju wọn, nwọn si la arin okun ja li ori ilẹ gbigbẹ; iwọ sọ awọn oninunibini wọn sinu ibú, bi okuta sinu omi lile.
entries.en: And thou didst divide the sea before them, so that they went through the midst of the sea on the dry land; and their persecutors thou threwest into the deeps, as a stone into the mighty waters.

entries.yo: Iwọ si fi ọwọ̀n awọ-sanma ṣe amọ̀na wọn li ọsan, ati li oru, ọwọ̀n iná, lati fun wọn ni imọlẹ li ọ̀na ninu eyiti nwọn o rin.
entries.en: Moreover thou leddest them in the day by a cloudy pillar; and in the night by a pillar of fire, to give them light in the way wherein they should go.

entries.yo: Iwọ si sọkalẹ wá si ori òke Sinai, o si bá wọn sọ̀rọ lati ọrun wá, o fun wọn ni idajọ titọ, ofin otitọ, ilana ati ofin rere.
entries.en: Thou camest down also upon mount Sinai, and spakest with them from heaven, and gavest them right judgments, and true laws, good statutes and commandments:

entries.yo: Iwọ si mu ọjọ isimi mimọ rẹ di mimọ̀ fun wọn, o si paṣẹ ẹkọ́, ilana, ati ofin fun wọn, nipa ọwọ Mose iranṣẹ rẹ.
entries.en: And madest known unto them thy holy sabbath, and commandedst them precepts, statutes, and laws, by the hand of Moses thy servant:

entries.yo: O si fun wọn li onjẹ lati ọrun wá fun ebi wọn, o si mu omi lati inu apata wá fun orungbẹ wọn, o si ṣe ileri fun wọn pe, ki nwọn lọ ijogun ilẹ na ti iwọ ti bura lati fi fun wọn.
entries.en: And gavest them bread from heaven for their hunger, and broughtest forth water for them out of the rock for their thirst, and promisedst them that they should go in to possess the land which thou hadst sworn to give them.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn ati awọn baba wa hu ìwa igberaga, nwọn si mu ọrùn wọn le, nwọn kò si gba ofin rẹ gbọ́.
entries.en: But they and our fathers dealt proudly, and hardened their necks, and hearkened not to thy commandments,

entries.yo: Nwọn si kọ̀ lati gbọràn, bẹ̃ni nwọn kò ranti iṣẹ iyanu ti iwọ ṣe li ãrin wọn; ṣugbọn nwọn mu ọrùn wọn le, ninu ìṣọtẹ wọn, nwọn yan olori lati pada si oko-ẹrú wọn: ṣugbọn iwọ li Ọlọrun ti o mura lati dariji, olore ọfẹ, ati alãnu, o lọra lati binu, o si ṣeun pipọ̀, o kò si kọ̀ wọn silẹ.
entries.en: And refused to obey, neither were mindful of thy wonders that thou didst among them; but hardened their necks, and in their rebellion appointed a captain to return to their bondage: but thou art a God ready to pardon, gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and forsookest them not.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ nigbati nwọn ṣe ẹgbọrọ-malu didà, ti nwọn si wipe, Eyi li Ọlọrun rẹ ti o mu ọ gòke ti Egipti jade wá, nwọn si ṣe imunibinu nla.
entries.en: Yea, when they had made them a molten calf, and said, This is thy God that brought thee up out of Egypt, and had wrought great provocations;

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn iwọ, ninu ọ̀pọlọpọ ãnu rẹ, kò kọ̀ wọn silẹ li aginju, ọwọ̀n kũkũ kò kuro lọdọ wọn lojojumọ lati ṣe amọna wọn, bẹ̃ si li ọwọ̀n iná lati fun wọn ni imọlẹ li oru li ọ̀na ti nwọn iba rìn.
entries.en: Yet thou in thy manifold mercies forsookest them not in the wilderness: the pillar of the cloud departed not from them by day, to lead them in the way; neither the pillar of fire by night, to shew them light, and the way wherein they should go.

entries.yo: Iwọ fun wọn li ẹmi rere rẹ pẹlu lati kọ́ wọn, iwọ kò si gba manna rẹ kuro li ẹnu wọn, iwọ si fun wọn li omi fun orungbẹ wọn.
entries.en: Thou gavest also thy good spirit to instruct them, and withheldest not thy manna from their mouth, and gavest them water for their thirst.

entries.yo: Nitotọ, ogoji ọdun ni iwọ fi bọ́ wọn li aginju, nwọn kò si ṣe alaini; aṣọ wọn kò gbó, ẹsẹ wọn kò si wú.
entries.en: Yea, forty years didst thou sustain them in the wilderness, so that they lacked nothing; their clothes waxed not old, and their feet swelled not.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu iwọ fi ijọba ati orilẹ-ède fun wọn, o si pin wọn si ìha gbogbo, bẹ̃ni nwọn jogun ilẹ Sihoni, ati ilẹ ọba Heṣboni, ati ilẹ Ogu, ọba Baṣani.
entries.en: Moreover thou gavest them kingdoms and nations, and didst divide them into corners: so they possessed the land of Sihon, and the land of the king of Heshbon, and the land of Og king of Bashan.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ wọn pẹlu ni iwọ sọ di pipọ bi irawọ ọrun, o si mu wọn wá ilẹ na sipa eyiti o ti leri fun awọn baba wọn pe: ki nwọn lọ sinu rẹ̀ lati gbà a.
entries.en: Their children also multipliedst thou as the stars of heaven, and broughtest them into the land, concerning which thou hadst promised to their fathers, that they should go in to possess it.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li awọn ọmọ na wọ inu rẹ̀ lọ, nwọn si gbà ilẹ na, iwọ si tẹ ori awọn ara ilẹ na ba niwaju wọn, awọn ara Kenaani, o si fi wọn le ọwọ wọn, pẹlu ọba wọn, ati awọn enia ilẹ na, ki nwọn ki o le fi wọn ṣe bi o ti wù wọn.
entries.en: So the children went in and possessed the land, and thou subduedst before them the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, and gavest them into their hands, with their kings, and the people of the land, that they might do with them as they would.

entries.yo: Nwọn si gbà ilu alagbara, ati ilẹ ọlọra, nwọn si gbà ilẹ ti o kún fun ohun rere, kanga, ọgba-ajara, ọgba-olifi, ati igi eleso, li ọ̀pọlọpọ: bẹ̃ni nwọ́n jẹ, nwọn si yo, nwọ́n sanra, nwọn si ni inu-didùn ninu ore rẹ nla.
entries.en: And they took strong cities, and a fat land, and possessed houses full of all goods, wells digged, vineyards, and oliveyards, and fruit trees in abundance: so they did eat, and were filled, and became fat, and delighted themselves in thy great goodness.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nwọn ṣe alaigbọràn, nwọn si ṣọ̀tẹ si ọ, nwọn si gbe ofin rẹ sọ si ẹ̀hin wọn, nwọn si pa awọn woli rẹ ti nsọ fun wọn lati yipada si ọ, nwọn si ṣe imunibinu nla.
entries.en: Nevertheless they were disobedient, and rebelled against thee, and cast thy law behind their backs, and slew thy prophets which testified against them to turn them to thee, and they wrought great provocations.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni iwọ fi wọn le ọwọ awọn ọta wọn, ti o pọn wọn loju, ati li akoko ipọnju wọn, nigbati nwọn kigbe pè ọ, iwọ gbọ́ lati ọrun wá; ati gẹgẹ bi ọ̀pọlọpọ ãnu rẹ, iwọ fun wọn li olugbala, ti nwọn gbà wọn kuro lọwọ awọn ọta wọn.
entries.en: Therefore thou deliveredst them into the hand of their enemies, who vexed them: and in the time of their trouble, when they cried unto thee, thou heardest them from heaven; and according to thy manifold mercies thou gavest them saviours, who saved them out of the hand of their enemies.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn li ẹhin ti nwọn ni isimi, nwọn si tun ṣe buburu niwaju rẹ: nitorina ni iwọ fi wọn le ọwọ awọn ọta wọn, tobẹ̃ ti nwọn jọba li ori wọn: ṣugbọn nigbati nwọn pada, ti nwọn si kigbe pè ọ, iwọ gbọ́ lati ọrun wá, ọ̀pọlọpọ ìgba ni iwọ si gbà wọn gẹgẹ bi ãnu rẹ.
entries.en: But after they had rest, they did evil again before thee: therefore leftest thou them in the hand of their enemies, so that they had the dominion over them: yet when they returned, and cried unto thee, thou heardest them from heaven; and many times didst thou deliver them according to thy mercies;

entries.yo: Iwọ si jẹri gbè wọn ki iwọ ki o le tun mu wọn wá sinu ofin rẹ, ṣugbọn nwọn hu ìwa igberaga, nwọn kò si fi eti si ofin rẹ, nwọn si ṣẹ̀ si idajọ rẹ (eyiti bi enia ba ṣe on o yè ninu wọn), nwọn si gún èjika, nwọn mu ọrùn wọn le, nwọn kò si fẹ igbọ́.
entries.en: And testifiedst against them, that thou mightest bring them again unto thy law: yet they dealt proudly, and hearkened not unto thy commandments, but sinned against thy judgments, (which if a man do, he shall live in them;) and withdrew the shoulder, and hardened their neck, and would not hear.

entries.yo: Sibẹ ọ̀pọlọpọ ọdun ni iwọ fi mu suru fun wọn ti o si fi ẹmi rẹ jẹri gbè wọn ninu awọn woli rẹ: sibẹ̀ nwọn kò fi eti silẹ: nitorina ni iwọ ṣe fi wọn le ọwọ awọn enia ilẹ wọnni.
entries.en: Yet many years didst thou forbear them, and testifiedst against them by thy spirit in thy prophets: yet would they not give ear: therefore gavest thou them into the hand of the people of the lands.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nitori ãnu rẹ nla iwọ kò run wọn patapata, bẹ̃ni iwọ kò kọ̀ wọn silẹ; nitori iwọ li Ọlọrun olore-ọfẹ ati alãnu.
entries.en: Nevertheless for thy great mercies' sake thou didst not utterly consume them, nor forsake them; for thou art a gracious and merciful God.

entries.yo: Njẹ nitorina, Ọlọrun wa, Ọlọrun ti o tobi, ti o li agbara, ti o si li ẹ̀ru, ẹniti npa majẹmu ati ãnu mọ, má jẹ ki gbogbo iyọnu na dabi ohun kekere niwaju rẹ, o de bá wa, awọn ọba wa, awọn ijoye wa, ati awọn alufa wa, ati awọn woli wa, ati awọn baba wa, ati gbogbo awọn enia rẹ lati akoko ọba Assiria wá, titi o fi di oni yi.
entries.en: Now therefore, our God, the great, the mighty, and the terrible God, who keepest covenant and mercy, let not all the trouble seem little before thee, that hath come upon us, on our kings, on our princes, and on our priests, and on our prophets, and on our fathers, and on all thy people, since the time of the kings of Assyria unto this day.

entries.yo: Sibẹ, iwọ ṣe olododo ninu ohun gbogbo ti o de ba wa, iwọ si ti ṣe otitọ, ṣugbọn awa ti ṣe buburu:
entries.en: Howbeit thou art just in all that is brought upon us; for thou hast done right, but we have done wickedly:

entries.yo: Awọn ọba wa, awọn ijoye wa, awọn alufa wa, ati awọn baba wa, kò pa ofin rẹ mọ, bẹ̃ni nwọn kò fi eti si aṣẹ rẹ, ati ẹri rẹ, ti iwọ fi jẹri gbè wọn.
entries.en: Neither have our kings, our princes, our priests, nor our fathers, kept thy law, nor hearkened unto thy commandments and thy testimonies, wherewith thou didst testify against them.

entries.yo: Nitori ti nwọn kò sin ọ ninu ijọba wọn, ati ninu ore rẹ nla ti iwọ fi fun wọn, ati ninu ilẹ nla ati ọlọra ti o fi si iwaju wọn, bẹ̃ni nwọn kò pada kuro ninu iṣẹ buburu wọn.
entries.en: For they have not served thee in their kingdom, and in thy great goodness that thou gavest them, and in the large and fat land which thou gavest before them, neither turned they from their wicked works.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, ẹrú li awa iṣe li oni yi, ati ilẹ ti iwọ fi fun awọn baba wa lati ma jẹ eso rẹ̀, ati ire rẹ̀, kiyesi i, awa jẹ ẹrú ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: Behold, we are servants this day, and for the land that thou gavest unto our fathers to eat the fruit thereof and the good thereof, behold, we are servants in it:

entries.yo: Ilẹ na si mu ohun ọ̀pọlọpọ wá fun awọn ọba, ti iwọ ti fi ṣe olori wa nitori ẹ̀ṣẹ wa: nwọn ni aṣẹ lori ara wa pẹlu, ati lori ẹran-nla wa, bi o ti wù wọn, awa si wà ninu wàhala nla.
entries.en: And it yieldeth much increase unto the kings whom thou hast set over us because of our sins: also they have dominion over our bodies, and over our cattle, at their pleasure, and we are in great distress.

entries.yo: Ati nitori gbogbo eyi awa dá majẹmu ti o daju, a si kọwe rẹ̀; awọn ìjoye wa, awọn ọmọ Lefi, ati awọn alufa si fi èdidi di i.
entries.en: And because of all this we make a sure covenant, and write it; and our princes, Levites, and priests, seal unto it.

entries.yo: AWỌN ti o fi èdidi di i ni Nehemiah, bãlẹ, ọmọ Hakaliah, ati Sidkijah.
entries.en: Now those that sealed were, Nehemiah, the Tirshatha, the son of Hachaliah, and Zidkijah,

entries.yo: Seraiah, Asariah, Jeremiah,
entries.en: Seraiah, Azariah, Jeremiah,

entries.yo: Paṣuri, Amariah, Malkijah,
entries.en: Pashur, Amariah, Malchijah,

entries.yo: Hattuṣi, Ṣebaniah, Malluki,
entries.en: Hattush, Shebaniah, Malluch,

entries.yo: Harimu, Meremoti, Obadiah,
entries.en: Harim, Meremoth, Obadiah,

entries.yo: Danieli, Ginnetoni, Baruki,
entries.en: Daniel, Ginnethon, Baruch,

entries.yo: Meṣullamu, Abijah, Mijamini,
entries.en: Meshullam, Abijah, Mijamin,

entries.yo: Maaṣiah, Bilgai, Ṣemaiah: alufa li awọn wọnyi.
entries.en: Maaziah, Bilgai, Shemaiah: these were the priests.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Lefi: ati Jeṣua ọmọ Asaniah, Binnui, ọkan ninu awọn ọmọ Henadadi, Kadmieli;
entries.en: And the Levites: both Jeshua the son of Azaniah, Binnui of the sons of Henadad, Kadmiel;

entries.yo: Ati awọn arakunrin wọn, Ṣebaniah, Hodijah, Kelita, Pelaiah, Hanani,
entries.en: And their brethren, Shebaniah, Hodijah, Kelita, Pelaiah, Hanan,

entries.yo: Mika, Rehobu, Haṣabiah,
entries.en: Micha, Rehob, Hashabiah,

entries.yo: Sakkuri, Ṣerebiah, Ṣebaniah,
entries.en: Zaccur, Sherebiah, Shebaniah,

entries.yo: Hodijah, Bani, Beninu.
entries.en: Hodijah, Bani, Beninu.

entries.yo: Awọn olori awọn enia; Paroṣi, Pahati-moabu, Elamu, Sattu, Bani.
entries.en: The chief of the people; Parosh, Pahath-moab, Elam, Zatthu, Bani,

entries.yo: Bunni, Asgadi, Bebai,
entries.en: Bunni, Azgad, Bebai,

entries.yo: Adonijah, Bigfai, Adini,
entries.en: Adonijah, Bigvai, Adin,

entries.yo: Ateri, Hiskijah, Assuri,
entries.en: Ater, Hizkijah, Azzur,

entries.yo: Hodijah, Haṣumu, Besai,
entries.en: Hodijah, Hashum, Bezai,

entries.yo: Harifi, Anatoti, Nebai,
entries.en: Hariph, Anathoth, Nebai,

entries.yo: Magpiaṣi, Meṣullamu, Hasiri,
entries.en: Magpiash, Meshullam, Hezir,

entries.yo: Meṣesabeeli, Sadoku, Jaddua,
entries.en: Meshezabeel, Zadok, Jaddua,

entries.yo: Pelatiah, Hanani, Anaiah,
entries.en: Pelatiah, Hanan, Anaiah,

entries.yo: Hoṣea, Hananiah, Haṣubu,
entries.en: Hoshea, Hananiah, Hashub,

entries.yo: Halloheṣi, Pileha, Ṣobeki,
entries.en: Hallohesh, Pileha, Shobek,

entries.yo: Rehumu, Hasabna, Maaseiah,
entries.en: Rehum, Hashabnah, Maaseiah,

entries.yo: Ati Ahijah, Hanani, Anani,
entries.en: And Ahijah, Hanan, Anan,

entries.yo: Malluku, Harimu, Baana.
entries.en: Malluch, Harim, Baanah.

entries.yo: Ati awọn enia iyokù, awọn alufa, awọn ọmọ Lefi, awọn adèna, awọn akọrin, awọn Netinimu, ati gbogbo awọn ti o ya ara wọn kuro lọdọ awọn enia ilẹ na si ofin Ọlọrun, aya wọn, awọn ọmọ wọn ọkunrin, ati awọn ọmọ wọn obinrin, gbogbo ẹniti o ni ìmọ ati oye;
entries.en: And the rest of the people, the priests, the Levites, the porters, the singers, the Nethinims, and all they that had separated themselves from the people of the lands unto the law of God, their wives, their sons, and their daughters, every one having knowledge, and having understanding;

entries.yo: Nwọn faramọ awọn arakunrin wọn, awọn ijoye wọn, nwọn si wọ inu èpe ati ibura, lati ma rìn ninu ofin Ọlọrun, ti a fi lelẹ nipa ọwọ Mose iranṣẹ Ọlọrun, lati kiyesi, ati lati ṣe gbogbo aṣẹ Jehofah, Oluwa wa, ati idajọ rẹ̀, ati ilana rẹ̀;
entries.en: They clave to their brethren, their nobles, and entered into a curse, and into an oath, to walk in God's law, which was given by Moses the servant of God, and to observe and do all the commandments of the LORD our Lord, and his judgments and his statutes;

entries.yo: Ati pe awa kì yio fi awọn ọmọbinrin wa fun awọn enia ilẹ na, bẹ̃li awa kì yio fẹ ọmọbinrin wọn fun awọn ọmọ wa.
entries.en: And that we would not give our daughters unto the people of the land, nor take their daughters for our sons:

entries.yo: Bi awọn enia ilẹ na ba mu ọjà tabi ohun jijẹ wa li ọjọ isimi lati tà, awa kì yio rà a li ọwọ wọn li ọjọ isimi, tabi li ọjọ mimọ́: awa o si fi ọdun keje silẹ, ati ifi-agbara-gba gbèse.
entries.en: And if the people of the land bring ware or any victuals on the sabbath day to sell, that we would not buy it of them on the sabbath, or on the holy day: and that we would leave the seventh year, and the exaction of every debt.

entries.yo: Awa si ṣe ilàna fun ara wa pe, ki olukuluku ma san idamẹta ṣekeli li ọdọdun fun iṣẹ ile Ọlọrun wa.
entries.en: Also we made ordinances for us, to charge ourselves yearly with the third part of a shekel for the service of the house of our God;

entries.yo: Nitori àkara ifihàn, ati nitori ẹbọ ohun jijẹ igbagbogbo, ati nitori ẹbọ sisun igbagbogbo, ti ọjọ isimi, ti oṣù titun, ti àse ti a yàn, ati nitori ohun mimọ́, ati nitori ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ lati ṣe ètutu fun Israeli, ati fun gbogbo iṣẹ ile Ọlọrun wa.
entries.en: For the shewbread, and for the continual meat offering, and for the continual burnt offering, of the sabbaths, of the new moons, for the set feasts, and for the holy things, and for the sin offerings to make an atonement for Israel, and for all the work of the house of our God.

entries.yo: Awa si dìbo larin awọn alufa awọn ọmọ Lefi, ati awọn enia, fun ọrẹ igi, lati mu u wá si ile Ọlọrun wa, gẹgẹ bi idile awọn baba wa li akoko ti a yàn li ọdọdun, lati fi daná li ori pẹpẹ Oluwa Ọlọrun wa, gẹgẹ bi a ti kọ ọ ninu ofin.
entries.en: And we cast the lots among the priests, the Levites, and the people, for the wood offering, to bring it into the house of our God, after the houses of our fathers, at times appointed year by year, to burn upon the altar of the LORD our God, as it is written in the law:

entries.yo: Ati lati mu akọso ilẹ wa wá, ati gbogbo akọso eso igi gbogbo, li ọdọdun si ile Oluwa wa:
entries.en: And to bring the firstfruits of our ground, and the firstfruits of all fruit of all trees, year by year, unto the house of the LORD:

entries.yo: Pẹlu akọbi awọn ọmọ wa ọkunrin, ati ti ohun ọ̀sin wa, gẹgẹ bi ati kọ ninu ofin, akọbi awọn ẹran-nla wa, ati ti agutan wa, lati mu wọn wá si ile Ọlọrun wa, fun awọn alufa ti nṣiṣẹ ni ile Ọlọrun wa.
entries.en: Also the firstborn of our sons, and of our cattle, as it is written in the law, and the firstlings of our herds and of our flocks, to bring to the house of our God, unto the priests that minister in the house of our God:

entries.yo: Ki awa si mu akọso iyẹfun pipò wa wá, ati ọrẹ wa, ati eso oniruru igi wa, ti ọti-waini ati ti ororo fun awọn alufa, si iyẹwu ile Ọlọrun wa, ati idamẹwa ilẹ wa fun awọn ọmọ Lefi, ki awọn ọmọ Lefi ki o le ni idamẹwa ninu gbogbo ilu arọko wa.
entries.en: And that we should bring the firstfruits of our dough, and our offerings, and the fruit of all manner of trees, of wine and of oil, unto the priests, to the chambers of the house of our God; and the tithes of our ground unto the Levites, that the same Levites might have the tithes in all the cities of our tillage.

entries.yo: Alufa ọmọ Aaroni yio si wà pẹlu awọn ọmọ Lefi, nigbati awọn ọmọ Lefi yio gba idamẹwa: awọn ọmọ Lefi yio si mu idamẹwa ti idamẹwa na wá si ile Ọlọrun wa, sinu iyẹwu, sinu ile iṣura.
entries.en: And the priest the son of Aaron shall be with the Levites, when the Levites take tithes: and the Levites shall bring up the tithe of the tithes unto the house of our God, to the chambers, into the treasure house.

entries.yo: Nitori awọn ọmọ Israeli ati awọn ọmọ Lefi ni yio mu ọrẹ ọkà wá, ti ọti-waini titun, ati ororo, sinu iyẹwu, nibiti ohun èlo ibi mimọ́ gbe wà, ati awọn alufa ti nṣiṣẹ, ati awọn adèna, ati awọn akọrin: awa kì yio si kọ̀ ile Ọlọrun wa silẹ.
entries.en: For the children of Israel and the children of Levi shall bring the offering of the corn, of the new wine, and the oil, unto the chambers, where are the vessels of the sanctuary, and the priests that minister, and the porters, and the singers: and we will not forsake the house of our God.

entries.yo: AWỌN olori awọn enia si ngbe Jerusalemu: awọn enia iyokù si dìbo lati mu ẹnikan ninu ẹnimẹwa lati ma gbe Jerusalemu, ilu mimọ́, ati mẹsan iyokù lati ma gbe ilu miran.
entries.en: And the rulers of the people dwelt at Jerusalem: the rest of the people also cast lots, to bring one of ten to dwell in Jerusalem the holy city, and nine parts to dwell in other cities.

entries.yo: Awọn enia si sure fun gbogbo awọn ọkunrin na ti nwọn yan ara wọn lati gbe Jerusalemu.
entries.en: And the people blessed all the men, that willingly offered themselves to dwell at Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Wọnyi si ni awọn olori igberiko ti ngbe Jerusalemu, ṣugbọn ninu ilu Juda, olukuluku ngbe inu ilẹ ìni rẹ̀ ninu ilu wọn, eyini ni: awọn ọmọ Israeli, awọn alufa, ati awọn ọmọ Lefi, ati awọn Netinimu, ati awọn ọmọ awọn iranṣẹ Solomoni.
entries.en: Now these are the chief of the province that dwelt in Jerusalem: but in the cities of Judah dwelt every one in his possession in their cities, to wit, Israel, the priests, and the Levites, and the Nethinims, and the children of Solomon's servants.

entries.yo: Ati ninu awọn ọmọ Juda ngbe Jerusalemu, ati ninu awọn ọmọ Benjamini. Ninu awọn ọmọ Juda, Ataiah ọmọ Ussiah, ọmọ Sekariah, ọmọ Amariah, ọmọ Ṣefatiah, ọmọ Mahalaleeli, ninu awọn ọmọ Peresi;
entries.en: And at Jerusalem dwelt certain of the children of Judah, and of the children of Benjamin. Of the children of Judah; Athaiah the son of Uzziah, the son of Zechariah, the son of Amariah, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Mahalaleel, of the children of Perez;

entries.yo: Ati Maaseiah ọmọ Baruku, ọmọ Kol-hose, ọmọ Hasaiah, ọmọ Adaiah, ọmọ Joiaribu, ọmọ Sekariah, ọmọ Ṣiloni.
entries.en: And Maaseiah the son of Baruch, the son of Col-hozeh, the son of Hazaiah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Joiarib, the son of Zechariah, the son of Shiloni.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ọmọ Peresi ti ngbe Jerusalemu jẹ adọrinlenirinwo o di meji, alagbara ọkunrin.
entries.en: All the sons of Perez that dwelt at Jerusalem were four hundred threescore and eight valiant men.

entries.yo: Wọnyi li awọn ọmọ Benjamini; Sallu ọmọ Meṣullamu ọmọ Joedi, ọmọ Pedaiah, ọmọ Kolaiah, ọmọ Maaseiah, ọmọ Itieli, ọmọ Jesaiah.
entries.en: And these are the sons of Benjamin; Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jesaiah.

entries.yo: Ati lẹhin rẹ̀ Gabbai, Sallai, ọrindilẹgbẹrun o le mẹjọ.
entries.en: And after him Gabbai, Sallai, nine hundred twenty and eight.

entries.yo: Joeli ọmọ Sikri si ni alabojuto wọn; ati Juda ọmọ Senua ni igbakeji ni ilu.
entries.en: And Joel the son of Zichri was their overseer: and Judah the son of Senuah was second over the city.

entries.yo: Ninu awọn alufa: Jedaiah ọmọ Joiaribu, Jakini.
entries.en: Of the priests: Jedaiah the son of Joiarib, Jachin.

entries.yo: Seraiah ọmọ Hilkiah, ọmọ Meṣullamu, ọmọ Sadoku, ọmọ Meraioti, ọmọ Ahitibu, ni olori ile Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Seraiah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, was the ruler of the house of God.

entries.yo: Awọn arakunrin wọn ti o ṣe iṣẹ ile na jẹ, ẹgbẹrin o le mejilelogun: ati Adaiah ọmọ Jerohamu, ọmọ Pelaliah, ọmọ Amsi, ọmọ Sekariah, ọmọ Paṣuri, ọmọ Malkiah,
entries.en: And their brethren that did the work of the house were eight hundred twenty and two: and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, the son of Zechariah, the son of Pashur, the son of Malchiah,

entries.yo: Ati awọn arakunrin rẹ̀, awọn olori awọn baba, ojilugba o le meji: ati Amaṣai ọmọ Asareeli, ọmọ Ahasai, ọmọ Meṣillemoti, ọmọ Immeri,
entries.en: And his brethren, chief of the fathers, two hundred forty and two: and Amashai the son of Azareel, the son of Ahasai, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer,

entries.yo: Ati awọn arakunrin wọn, alagbara li ogun, mejidilãdoje: ati olori wọn ni Sabdieli ọmọ ọkan ninu awọn enia nla.
entries.en: And their brethren, mighty men of valour, an hundred twenty and eight: and their overseer was Zabdiel, the son of one of the great men.

entries.yo: Ninu awọn ọmọ Lefi pẹlu: Ṣemaiah, ọmọ Haṣubu, ọmọ Asrikamu, ọmọ Haṣabiah, ọmọ Bunni;
entries.en: Also of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hashub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni;

entries.yo: Ati Ṣabbetai ati Josabadi, ninu olori awọn ọmọ Lefi ni alabojuto iṣẹ ode ile Ọlọrun.
entries.en: And Shabbethai and Jozabad, of the chief of the Levites, had the oversight of the outward business of the house of God.

entries.yo: Ati Mattaniah ọmọ Mika, ọmọ Sabdi, ọmọ Asafu, ni olori lati bẹ̀rẹ idupẹ ninu adura: ati Bakbukiah ẹnikeji ninu awọn arakunrin rẹ̀, ati Abda ọmọ Ṣammua, ọmọ Galali, ọmọ Jedutuni.
entries.en: And Mattaniah the son of Micha, the son of Zabdi, the son of Asaph, was the principal to begin the thanksgiving in prayer: and Bakbukiah the second among his brethren, and Abda the son of Shammua, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn ọmọ Lefi ninu ilu mimọ́ jẹ ọrinlugba o le mẹrin.
entries.en: All the Levites in the holy city were two hundred fourscore and four.

entries.yo: Ati awọn adèna, Akkubu, Talmoni, ati awọn arakunrin wọn ti nṣọ ẹnu ọ̀na jẹ mejilelãdọsan.
entries.en: Moreover the porters, Akkub, Talmon, and their brethren that kept the gates, were an hundred seventy and two.

entries.yo: Ati iyokù Israeli, ti awọn alufa, ati ti awọn ọmọ Lefi, wà ni gbogbo ilu Juda, olukuluku ninu ilẹ ìni rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the residue of Israel, of the priests, and the Levites, were in all the cities of Judah, every one in his inheritance.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn Netinimu ngbe Ofeli: ati Siha, ati Gispa wà li olori awọn Netinimu.
entries.en: But the Nethinims dwelt in Ophel: and Ziha and Gispa were over the Nethinims.

entries.yo: Ati alabojuto awọn ọmọ Lefi ni Jerusalemu ni Ussi ọmọ Bani, ọmọ Haṣabiah, ọmọ Mattaniah, ọmọ Mika. Ninu awọn ọmọ Asafu, awọn akọrin wà lori iṣẹ ile Ọlọrun.
entries.en: The overseer also of the Levites at Jerusalem was Uzzi the son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Micha. Of the sons of Asaph, the singers were over the business of the house of God.

entries.yo: Nitori o jẹ aṣẹ ọba nipa ti wọn, pe ki ipin kan ti o yẹ ki o jẹ ti awọn akọrin, li ojojumọ.
entries.en: For it was the king's commandment concerning them, that a certain portion should be for the singers, due for every day.

entries.yo: Ati Petahiah ọmọ Meṣesabeeli ninu awọn ọmọ Serah ọmọ Juda wà li ọwọ ọba ninu gbogbo awọn enia.
entries.en: And Pethahiah the son of Meshezabeel, of the children of Zerah the son of Judah, was at the king's hand in all matters concerning the people.

entries.yo: Ati fun ileto, pẹlu oko wọn, ninu awọn ọmọ Juda ngbe Kirjat-arba, ati ileto rẹ̀, ati ni Diboni, ati ileto rẹ̀, ati ni Jekabseeli, ati ileto rẹ̀,
entries.en: And for the villages, with their fields, some of the children of Judah dwelt at Kirjath-arba, and in the villages thereof, and at Dibon, and in the villages thereof, and at Jekabzeel, and in the villages thereof,

entries.yo: Ati ni Jeṣua, ati ni Molada, ati ni Bet-feleti,
entries.en: And at Jeshua, and at Moladah, and at Beth-phelet,

entries.yo: Ati ni Hasar-ṣuali, ati ni Beerṣeba, ati ileto rẹ̀,
entries.en: And at Hazar-shual, and at Beer-sheba, and in the villages thereof,

entries.yo: Ati ni Siklagi, ati ni Mekona, ati ninu ileto rẹ̀,
entries.en: And at Ziklag, and at Mekonah, and in the villages thereof,

entries.yo: Ati ni En-rimmoni, ati ni Sarea, ati Jarmuti,
entries.en: And at En-rimmon, and at Zareah, and at Jarmuth,

entries.yo: Sanoa, Adullamu, ati ileto wọn, ni Lakiṣi, ati oko rẹ̀, ni Aseka, ati ileto rẹ̀. Nwọn si ngbe lati Beerṣeba titi de afonifoji Hinnomu.
entries.en: Zanoah, Adullam, and in their villages, at Lachish, and the fields thereof, at Azekah, and in the villages thereof. And they dwelt from Beer-sheba unto the valley of Hinnom.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Benjamini lati Geba de Mikmaṣi, ati Aija, ati Beteli, ati ileto wọn.
entries.en: The children also of Benjamin from Geba dwelt at Michmash, and Aija, and Bethel, and in their villages,

entries.yo: Ni Anatotu, Nobu, Ananiah,
entries.en: And at Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah,

entries.yo: Hasori, Rama, Gittaimu,
entries.en: Hazor, Ramah, Gittaim,

entries.yo: Hadidi, Seboimu, Neballati,
entries.en: Hadid, Zeboim, Neballat,

entries.yo: Lodi, ati Ono, afonifoji awọn oniṣọnà,
entries.en: Lod, and Ono, the valley of craftsmen.

entries.yo: Ati ninu awọn ọmọ Lefi, awọn ìpín Juda si ngbe ilẹ Benjamini.
entries.en: And of the Levites were divisions in Judah, and in Benjamin.

entries.yo: WỌNYI si ni awọn alufa ati awọn ọmọ Lefi ti o ba Serubbabeli ọmọ Ṣealtieli goke lọ, ati Jeṣua: Seraiah Jeremiah, Esra,
entries.en: Now these are the priests and the Levites that went up with Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua: Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra,

entries.yo: Amariah, Malluki, Hattuṣi,
entries.en: Amariah, Malluch, Hattush,

entries.yo: Ṣekaniah, Rehumu, Meremoti,
entries.en: Shechaniah, Rehum, Meremoth,

entries.yo: Iddo, Ginneto, Abijah,
entries.en: Iddo, Ginnetho, Abijah,

entries.yo: Miamini, Maadiah, Bilga,
entries.en: Miamin, Maadiah, Bilgah,

entries.yo: Ṣemaiah, ati Joiaribu, Jodaiah,
entries.en: Shemaiah, and Joiarib, Jediah,

entries.yo: Sallu, Amoku, Hilkiah, Jedaiah. Wọnyi li olori awọn alufa, ati ti awọn arakunrin wọn li ọjọ Jeṣua.
entries.en: Sallu, Amok, Hilkiah, Jedaiah. These were the chief of the priests and of their brethren in the days of Jeshua.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Lefi: Jeṣua, Binnui, Kadmieli, Ṣerebiah, Juda, ati Mattaniah, ti o wà lori orin idupẹ, on ati awọn arakunrin rẹ̀.
entries.en: Moreover the Levites: Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, and Mattaniah, which was over the thanksgiving, he and his brethren.

entries.yo: Bakbukiah pẹlu ati Unni, awọn arakunrin wọn, li o kọju si wọn ninu iṣọ.
entries.en: Also Bakbukiah and Unni, their brethren, were over against them in the watches.

entries.yo: Jeṣua si bi Joiakimu, Joiakimu si bi Eliaṣibu, Eliaṣibu si bi Joiada,
entries.en: And Jeshua begat Joiakim, Joiakim also begat Eliashib, and Eliashib begat Joiada,

entries.yo: Joiada si bi Jonatani, Jonatani si bi Jaddua.
entries.en: And Joiada begat Jonathan, and Jonathan begat Jaddua.

entries.yo: Ninu awọn alufa li ọjọ Joiakimu li awọn olori awọn baba wà: ti Seraiah, Meraiah; ti Jeremiah, Hananiah;
entries.en: And in the days of Joiakim were priests, the chief of the fathers: of Seraiah, Meraiah; of Jeremiah, Hananiah;

entries.yo: Ti Esra, Meṣullamu; ti Amariah, Jehohanani;
entries.en: Of Ezra, Meshullam; of Amariah, Jehohanan;

entries.yo: Ti Meliku, Jonatani; ti Ṣebaniah, Josefu;
entries.en: Of Melicu, Jonathan; of Shebaniah, Joseph;

entries.yo: Ti Harimu, Adna; ti Meraioti, Helkai;
entries.en: Of Harim, Adna; of Meraioth, Helkai;

entries.yo: Ti Iddo, Sekariah; ti Ginnetoni, Meṣullamu;
entries.en: Of Iddo, Zechariah; of Ginnethon, Meshullam;

entries.yo: Ti Abijah, Sikri; ti Miniamini, ti Moadiah, Piltai:
entries.en: Of Abijah, Zichri; of Miniamin, of Moadiah, Piltai;

entries.yo: Ti Bilga, Sammua; ti Ṣemaiah, Jehonatani;
entries.en: Of Bilgah, Shammua; of Shemaiah, Jehonathan;

entries.yo: Ati ti Joaribu, Mattenai; ti Jedaiah, Ussi;
entries.en: And of Joiarib, Mattenai; of Jedaiah, Uzzi;

entries.yo: Ti Sallai, Killai; ti Amoku, Eberi;
entries.en: Of Sallai, Kallai; of Amok, Eber;

entries.yo: Ti Hilkiah, Haṣhabiah; ti Jedaiah, Netaneeli;
entries.en: Of Hilkiah, Hashabiah; of Jedaiah, Nethaneel.

entries.yo: Ninu awọn ọmọ Lefi li ọjọ Eliaṣibu, Joiada, ati Johanani, ati Jaddua, awọn olori awọn baba: li a kọ sinu iwe pẹlu awọn alufa, titi di ijọba Dariusi ara Perṣia.
entries.en: The Levites in the days of Eliashib, Joiada, and Johanan, and Jaddua, were recorded chief of the fathers: also the priests, to the reign of Darius the Persian.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Lefi, olori awọn baba li a kọ sinu iwe itan titi di ọjọ Johanani ọmọ Eliaṣibu.
entries.en: The sons of Levi, the chief of the fathers, were written in the book of the chronicles, even until the days of Johanan the son of Eliashib.

entries.yo: Awọn olori awọn ọmọ Lefi si ni Haṣabiah, Ṣerebiah, ati Jeṣua ọmọ Kadmieli, pẹlu awọn arakunrin wọn kọju si ara wọn, lati yìn ati lati dupẹ, gẹgẹ bi aṣẹ Dafidi enia Ọlọrun, li ẹgbẹgbẹ ẹṣọ.
entries.en: And the chief of the Levites: Hashabiah, Sherebiah, and Jeshua the son of Kadmiel, with their brethren over against them, to praise and to give thanks, according to the commandment of David the man of God, ward over against ward.

entries.yo: Mattaniah, ati Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meṣullamu, Talmoni, Akkubu, jẹ adèna lati ma ṣọ ìloro ẹnu-ọ̀na.
entries.en: Mattaniah, and Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, Akkub, were porters keeping the ward at the thresholds of the gates.

entries.yo: Wọnyi wà li ọjọ Joiakimu, ọmọ Jeṣua, ọmọ Josadaki, ati li ọjọ Nehemiah bãlẹ, ati Esra alufa, ti iṣe akọwe.
entries.en: These were in the days of Joiakim the son of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and in the days of Nehemiah the governor, and of Ezra the priest, the scribe.

entries.yo: Ati nigba yiya odi Jerusalemu si mimọ́, nwọn wá awọn ọmọ Lefi kiri ninu gbogbo ibugbe wọn, lati mu wọn wá si Jerusalemu lati fi ayọ̀ ṣe iyà si mimọ́ na pẹlu idupẹ ati orin, pẹlu simbali, psalteri, ati pẹlu dùru.
entries.en: And at the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem they sought the Levites out of all their places, to bring them to Jerusalem, to keep the dedication with gladness, both with thanksgivings, and with singing, with cymbals, psalteries, and with harps.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ awọn akọrin si ko ara wọn jọ lati pẹ̀tẹlẹ yi Jerusalemu ka, ati lati ileto Netofati wá;
entries.en: And the sons of the singers gathered themselves together, both out of the plain country round about Jerusalem, and from the villages of Netophathi;

entries.yo: Lati ile Gilgali wá pẹlu, ati lati inu ilẹ Geba ati Asmafeti, nitori awọn akọrin ti kọ ileto fun ara wọn yi Jerusalemu kakiri.
entries.en: Also from the house of Gilgal, and out of the fields of Geba and Azmaveth: for the singers had builded them villages round about Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Ati awọn alufa ati awọn ọmọ Lefi wẹ̀ ara wọn mọ́, nwọn si wẹ̀ awọn enia mọ́, ati ẹnu-bode, ati odi.
entries.en: And the priests and the Levites purified themselves, and purified the people, and the gates, and the wall.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni mo mu awọn ijoye Juda wá si ori odi, mo si yàn ẹgbẹ nla meji, ninu awọn ti ndupẹ, ẹgbẹ kan lọ si apa ọtun li ori odi, siha ẹnu-bode àtan.
entries.en: Then I brought up the princes of Judah upon the wall, and appointed two great companies of them that gave thanks, whereof one went on the right hand upon the wall toward the dung gate:

entries.yo: Hoṣaiah si lọ tẹle wọn ati idaji awọn ijoye Juda.
entries.en: And after them went Hoshaiah, and half of the princes of Judah,

entries.yo: Ati Asariah, Esra, ati Meṣullamu,
entries.en: And Azariah, Ezra, and Meshullam,

entries.yo: Juda, ati Benjamini, ati Ṣemaiah ati Jeremiah.
entries.en: Judah, and Benjamin, and Shemaiah, and Jeremiah,

entries.yo: Ati ninu awọn ọmọ awọn alufa mu fère lọwọ, Sekariah, ọmọ Jonatani, ọmọ Ṣemaiah, ọmọ Mattaniah, ọmọ Mikaiah, ọmọ Sakkuri, ọmọ Asafu:
entries.en: And certain of the priests' sons with trumpets; namely, Zechariah the son of Jonathan, the son of Shemaiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Michaiah, the son of Zaccur, the son of Asaph:

entries.yo: Ati awọn arakunrin rẹ̀, Ṣemaiah, ati Asaraeli, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Netaneeli, ati Juda, Hanani, pẹlu ohun èlo orin Dafidi, enia Ọlọrun, ati Esra akọwe niwaju wọn.
entries.en: And his brethren, Shemaiah, and Azarael, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethaneel, and Judah, Hanani, with the musical instruments of David the man of God, and Ezra the scribe before them.

entries.yo: Ati ni ẹnu-bode orisun eyi ni ibi ti o kọju si i, nwọn ba àtẹgun ilu Dafidi goke lọ, ni ibi odi ti o goke lọ, ni ikọja ile Dafidi, titi de ẹnu-bode omi, niha ila õrùn.
entries.en: And at the fountain gate, which was over against them, they went up by the stairs of the city of David, at the going up of the wall, above the house of David, even unto the water gate eastward.

entries.yo: Ati ẹgbẹ keji awọn ti ndupẹ, lọ li odi keji si wọn, ati emi lẹhin wọn, pẹlu idaji awọn enia lori odi, lati ikọja ile iṣọ ileru, titi de odi gbigboro.
entries.en: And the other company of them that gave thanks went over against them, and I after them, and the half of the people upon the wall, from beyond the tower of the furnaces even unto the broad wall;

entries.yo: Nwọn si rekọja oke ẹnu-bode Efraimu wá, ati lati oke ẹnu-bode lailai ati li oke ẹnu-bode ẹja, ati ile-iṣọ Hananieli, ati ile-iṣọ Mea, titi de ẹnu-bode agutan, nwọn si duro li ẹnu-bode tubu.
entries.en: And from above the gate of Ephraim, and above the old gate, and above the fish gate, and the tower of Hananeel, and the tower of Meah, even unto the sheep gate: and they stood still in the prison gate.

entries.yo: Bayi ni awọn ẹgbẹ meji ti ndupẹ ninu ile Ọlọrun duro, ati emi ati idaji awọn ijoye pẹlu mi.
entries.en: So stood the two companies of them that gave thanks in the house of God, and I, and the half of the rulers with me:

entries.yo: Ati awọn alufa: Eliakimu, Maaseiah, Miniamini Mikaiah, Elioenai, Sekariah, Hananiah mu fère lọwọ;
entries.en: And the priests; Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Michaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah, and Hananiah, with trumpets;

entries.yo: Ati Maaseiah, ati Ṣemaiah, ati Eleasari, ati Ussi, ati Jehohanani, ati Malkijah, ati Elamu, ati Eseri, awọn akọrin kọrin soke, pẹlu Jesrahiah alabojuto.
entries.en: And Maaseiah, and Shemaiah, and Eleazar, and Uzzi, and Jehohanan, and Malchijah, and Elam, and Ezer. And the singers sang loud, with Jezrahiah their overseer.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ na pẹlu nwọn ṣe irubọ nla, nwọn si yọ̀ nitori Ọlọrun ti mu wọn yọ̀ ayọ̀ nla, aya wọn ati awọn ọmọde yọ̀ pẹlu, tobẹ̃ ti a si gbọ́ ayọ̀ Jerusalemu li okere reré.
entries.en: Also that day they offered great sacrifices, and rejoiced: for God had made them rejoice with great joy: the wives also and the children rejoiced: so that the joy of Jerusalem was heard even afar off.

entries.yo: Li akoko na li a si yàn awọn kan ṣe olori yara iṣura, fun ọrẹ-ẹbọ, fun akọso, ati fun idamẹwa, lati ma ko ipin ti a yàn jọ lati oko ilu wọnni wá, ti ofin fun awọn alufa ati awọn ọmọ Lefi: nitoriti Juda yọ̀ fun awọn ọmọ Lefi ti o duro.
entries.en: And at that time were some appointed over the chambers for the treasures, for the offerings, for the firstfruits, and for the tithes, to gather into them out of the fields of the cities the portions of the law for the priests and Levites: for Judah rejoiced for the priests and for the Levites that waited.

entries.yo: Ati awọn akọrin, ati adèna npa ẹṣọ Ọlọrun wọn mọ, ati ẹṣọ iwẹnumọ́, gẹgẹ bi aṣẹ Dafidi; ati ti Solomoni ọmọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And both the singers and the porters kept the ward of their God, and the ward of the purification, according to the commandment of David, and of Solomon his son.

entries.yo: Nitori li ọjọ Dafidi ati Asafu nigbani awọn olori awọn akọrin wà, ati orin iyìn, ati ọpẹ fun Ọlọrun.
entries.en: For in the days of David and Asaph of old there were chief of the singers, and songs of praise and thanksgiving unto God.

entries.yo: Gbogbo Israeli li ọjọ Serubbabeli, ati li ọjọ Nehemiah si fi ipin awọn akọrin, ati ti awọn adèna fun wọn olukuluku ni ipin tirẹ̀ li ojojumọ, nwọn si ya ohun mimọ́ awọn ọmọ Lefi si ọ̀tọ, awọn ọmọ Lefi si yà wọn si ọ̀tọ fun awọn ọmọ Aaroni.
entries.en: And all Israel in the days of Zerubbabel, and in the days of Nehemiah, gave the portions of the singers and the porters, every day his portion: and they sanctified holy things unto the Levites; and the Levites sanctified them unto the children of Aaron.

entries.yo: LI ọjọ na, a kà ninu iwe Mose li eti gbogbo enia, ati ninu rẹ̀ li a ri pe, ki ara Ammoni ati ara Moabu ki o má wá sinu ijọ Ọlọrun lailai;
entries.en: On that day they read in the book of Moses in the audience of the people; and therein was found written, that the Ammonite and the Moabite should not come into the congregation of God for ever;

entries.yo: Nitoriti nwọn kò fi onjẹ ati omi ko awọn ọmọ Israeli lọna, ṣugbọn nwọn bẹ̀ Balaamu lọwẹ si wọn, lati fi wọn gegun: ṣugbọn Ọlọrun wa sọ egun na di ibukun.
entries.en: Because they met not the children of Israel with bread and with water, but hired Balaam against them, that he should curse them: howbeit our God turned the curse into a blessing.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati nwọn ti gbọ́ ofin na, ni nwọn yà gbogbo awọn ọ̀pọ enia ti o darapọ̀ mọ Israeli kuro.
entries.en: Now it came to pass, when they had heard the law, that they separated from Israel all the mixed multitude.

entries.yo: Ati ṣaju eyi, Eliaṣibu alufa, ti o jẹ alabojuto iyẹwu ile Ọlọrun wa jẹ ana Tobiah.
entries.en: And before this, Eliashib the priest, having the oversight of the chamber of the house of our God, was allied unto Tobiah:

entries.yo: O si ti pèse iyẹwu nla kan fun u, nibiti nwọn ima fi ẹbọ ohun jijẹ, turari, ati ohun èlo, ati idamẹwa agbado, ọti-waini titun, ati ororo si nigba atijọ, eyi ti a pa li aṣẹ lati fi fun awọn ọmọ Lefi, ati awọn akọrin, ati awọn adèna: ati ẹbọ ọrẹ awọn alufa.
entries.en: And he had prepared for him a great chamber, where aforetime they laid the meat offerings, the frankincense, and the vessels, and the tithes of the corn, the new wine, and the oil, which was commanded to be given to the Levites, and the singers, and the porters; and the offerings of the priests.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ni gbogbo àkoko yi, emi kò si ni Jerusalemu: nitori li ọdun kejilelọgbọn ti Artasasta ọba Babiloni, mo wá si ọdọ ọba, ati li opin ọjọ wọnni, mo gba àye lati ọdọ ọba.
entries.en: But in all this time was not I at Jerusalem: for in the two and thirtieth year of Artaxerxes king of Babylon came I unto the king, and after certain days obtained I leave of the king:

entries.yo: Mo si wá si Jerusalemu, mo si mọ̀ buburu ti Eliaṣibu ṣe nitori Tobiah, ni pipèse iyẹwu fun u, ninu àgbala ile Ọlọrun.
entries.en: And I came to Jerusalem, and understood of the evil that Eliashib did for Tobiah, in preparing him a chamber in the courts of the house of God.

entries.yo: O si bà mi ninu jẹ gidigidi, nitorina mo da gbogbo ohun èlo Tobiah jade kuro ninu iyẹwu na.
entries.en: And it grieved me sore: therefore I cast forth all the household stuff of Tobiah out of the chamber.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni mo paṣẹ, nwọn si wẹ̀ iyẹwu na mọ: si ibẹ ni mo si tun mu ohun èlo ile Ọlọrun wá, pẹlu ẹbọ ohun jijẹ ati turari.
entries.en: Then I commanded, and they cleansed the chambers: and thither brought I again the vessels of the house of God, with the meat offering and the frankincense.

entries.yo: Mo si mọ̀ pe, a kò ti fi ipin awọn ọmọ Lefi fun wọn; awọn ọmọ Lefi ati awọn akọrin, ti nṣe iṣẹ, si ti salọ olukuluku si oko rẹ̀.
entries.en: And I perceived that the portions of the Levites had not been given them: for the Levites and the singers, that did the work, were fled every one to his field.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni mo si ba awọn ijoye jà, mo si wipe, Ẽṣe ti a fi kọ̀ ile Ọlọrun silẹ? Mo si ko wọn jọ, mo si fi wọn si ipò wọn.
entries.en: Then contended I with the rulers, and said, Why is the house of God forsaken? And I gathered them together, and set them in their place.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni gbogbo Juda mu idamẹwa ọka ati ọti-waini titun ati ororo wá si ile iṣura.
entries.en: Then brought all Judah the tithe of the corn and the new wine and the oil unto the treasuries.

entries.yo: Mo si yàn olupamọ si ile iṣura, Ṣelemiah alufa ati Sadoku akọwẹ, ati ninu awọn ọmọ Lefi, Pedaiah: ati lọwọkọwọ wọn ni Hanani ọmọ Sakkuri, ọmọ Mattaniah: nitoriti a kà wọn si olõtọ, iṣẹ́ wọn si ni lati ma pin fun awọn arakunrin wọn.
entries.en: And I made treasurers over the treasuries, Shelemiah the priest, and Zadok the scribe, and of the Levites, Pedaiah: and next to them was Hanan the son of Zaccur, the son of Mattaniah: for they were counted faithful, and their office was to distribute unto their brethren.

entries.yo: Ranti mi, Ọlọrun mi, nitori eyi, ki o má si nu iṣẹ rere ti mo ti ṣe fun ile Ọlọrun mi, nu kuro, ati fun akiyesi rẹ̀.
entries.en: Remember me, O my God, concerning this, and wipe not out my good deeds that I have done for the house of my God, and for the offices thereof.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ wọnni ni mo ri awọn kan ti nfunti ni Juda li ọjọ isimi, awọn ti nmu iti ọka wale, ti ndi ẹrù rù kẹtẹkẹtẹ; ti ọti-waini, pẹlu eso àjara, ati eso ọ̀pọtọ, ati gbogbo oniruru ẹrù ti nwọn nmu wá si Jerusalemu li ọjọ isimi: mo si jẹri gbè wọn li ọjọ ti nwọn ntà ohun jijẹ.
entries.en: In those days saw I in Judah some treading wine presses on the sabbath, and bringing in sheaves, and lading asses; as also wine, grapes, and figs, and all manner of burdens, which they brought into Jerusalem on the sabbath day: and I testified against them in the day wherein they sold victuals.

entries.yo: Awọn ara Tire ngbe ibẹ pẹlu, ti nwọn mu ẹja, ati oniruru ohun èlo wá, nwọn si ntà li ọjọ isimi fun awọn ọmọ Juda, ati ni Jerusalemu.
entries.en: There dwelt men of Tyre also therein, which brought fish, and all manner of ware, and sold on the sabbath unto the children of Judah, and in Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni mo ba awọn ijoye Juda jà, mo si wi fun wọn pe, ohun buburu kili ẹnyin nṣe yi, ti ẹ si mba ọjọ isimi jẹ.
entries.en: Then I contended with the nobles of Judah, and said unto them, What evil thing is this that ye do, and profane the sabbath day?

entries.yo: Bayi ha kọ́ awọn baba nyin ṣe, Ọlọrun kò ha mu ki gbogbo ibi yi wá sori wa, ati sori ilu yi? ṣugbọn ẹnyin mu ibinu ti o pọ̀ju wá sori Israeli nipa biba ọjọ isimi jẹ.
entries.en: Did not your fathers thus, and did not our God bring all this evil upon us, and upon this city? yet ye bring more wrath upon Israel by profaning the sabbath.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati ẹnu-bode Jerusalemu bẹ̀rẹ si iṣu okunkun ṣaju ọjọ isimi, mo paṣẹ pe, ki a tì ilẹkun, ki ẹnikẹni má ṣi i titi di ẹhin ọjọ isimi, ninu awọn ọmọkunrin mi ni mo fi si ẹnu-bode, ki a má ba mu ẹrù wọle wá li ọjọ isimi.
entries.en: And it came to pass, that when the gates of Jerusalem began to be dark before the sabbath, I commanded that the gates should be shut, and charged that they should not be opened till after the sabbath: and some of my servants set I at the gates, that there should no burden be brought in on the sabbath day.
