entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni awọn oniṣòwo ati awọn ti ntà oniruru nkan sùn lẹhin odi Jerusalemu li ẹrinkan tabi ẹrinmeji.
entries.en: So the merchants and sellers of all kind of ware lodged without Jerusalem once or twice.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni mo jẹri gbè wọn, mo si wi fun wọn pe, Ẽṣe ti ẹnyin fi sùn lẹhin odi, bi ẹnyin ba tun ṣe bẹ̃, emi o fọwọ bà nyin. Lati àkoko na lọ ni nwọn kò si wá lọjọ isimi mọ.
entries.en: Then I testified against them, and said unto them, Why lodge ye about the wall? if ye do so again, I will lay hands on you. From that time forth came they no more on the sabbath.

entries.yo: Mo si paṣẹ fun awọn ọmọ Lefi, ki nwọn ya ara wọn si mimọ, ki nwọn si wa ṣọ ẹnu-bode lati pa ọjọ isimi mọ. Ranti mi Ọlọrun mi nitori eyi pẹlu, ki o si da mi si gẹgẹ bi ọ̀pọ ãnu rẹ.
entries.en: And I commanded the Levites that they should cleanse themselves, and that they should come and keep the gates, to sanctify the sabbath day. Remember me, O my God, concerning this also, and spare me according to the greatness of thy mercy.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu li ọjọ wọnni, mo ri ara Juda ti mba obinrin awọn ara Aṣdodi, Ammoni, ati ti Moabu gbe:
entries.en: In those days also saw I Jews that had married wives of Ashdod, of Ammon, and of Moab:

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ wọn si nsọ apakan ède Aṣdodi, nwọn kò si le sọ̀rọ li ède awọn ara Juda, ṣugbọn gẹgẹ bi ède olukuluku.
entries.en: And their children spake half in the speech of Ashdod, and could not speak in the Jews' language, but according to the language of each people.

entries.yo: Mo si ba wọn jà, mo gàn wọn, mo lù ninu wọn, mo tu irun wọn, mo mu wọn fi Ọlọrun bura pe, Ẹnyin kì yio fi ọmọbinrin nyin fun ọmọkunrin nwọn, tabi ọmọbinrin nwọn fun ọmọkunrin nyin tabi fun ara nyin.
entries.en: And I contended with them, and cursed them, and smote certain of them, and plucked off their hair, and made them swear by God, saying, Ye shall not give your daughters unto their sons, nor take their daughters unto your sons, or for yourselves.

entries.yo: Solomoni ọba Israeli kò ha dẹṣẹ nipa nkan wọnyi? Bẹ̃ni li ãrin orilẹ-ède pupọ, kò si ọba kan bi on ti Ọlọrun rẹ̀ fẹràn; Ọlọrun si fi jẹ ọba li ori gbogbo Israeli, bẹ̃ni on li awọn àjeji obinrin mu ki o ṣẹ̀.
entries.en: Did not Solomon king of Israel sin by these things? yet among many nations was there no king like him, who was beloved of his God, and God made him king over all Israel: nevertheless even him did outlandish women cause to sin.

entries.yo: Njẹ ki awa ha gbọ́ ti nyin, lati ṣe gbogbo buburu nla yi, lati ṣẹ̀ si Ọlọrun sa, ni gbigbe awọn àjeji obinrin ni iyawo?
entries.en: Shall we then hearken unto you to do all this great evil, to transgress against our God in marrying strange wives?

entries.yo: Ati ọkan ninu awọn ọmọ Jehoiada, ọmọ Eliaṣibu olori alufa, jẹ ana Sanballati, ara Horoni, nitori na mo le e kuro lọdọ mi.
entries.en: And one of the sons of Joiada, the son of Eliashib the high priest, was son in law to Sanballat the Horonite: therefore I chased him from me.

entries.yo: Ranti wọn, Ọlọrun mi, nitoriti nwọn ti ba oyè alufa jẹ, pẹlu majẹmu oyè-alufa, ati ti awọn ọmọ Lefi.
entries.en: Remember them, O my God, because they have defiled the priesthood, and the covenant of the priesthood, and of the Levites.

entries.yo: Bayi ni mo wẹ̀ wọn nù kuro ninu gbogbo awọn alejo, mo si yan ẹ̀ṣọ awọn alufa, ati ti awọn ọmọ Lefi, olukuluku ninu iṣẹ tirẹ̀.
entries.en: Thus cleansed I them from all strangers, and appointed the wards of the priests and the Levites, every one in his business;

entries.yo: Ati fun ẹ̀bun igi li àkoko ti a yàn, ati fun akọso. Ranti mi, Ọlọrun mi, fun rere.
entries.en: And for the wood offering, at times appointed, and for the firstfruits. Remember me, O my God, for good.

entries.yo: O si ṣe li ọjọ Ahaswerusi, (eyi ni Ahaswerusi ti o jọba lati India, ani titi o fi de Etiopia, lori ẹtadiladoje ìgberiko:)
entries.en: Now it came to pass in the days of Ahasuerus, (this is Ahasuerus which reigned, from India even unto Ethiopia, over an hundred and seven and twenty provinces:)

entries.yo: Li ọjọ wọnni, nigbati Ahaswerusi, ọba, joko lori itẹ ijọba rẹ̀, ti o wà ni Ṣuṣani, ãfin.
entries.en: That in those days, when the king Ahasuerus sat on the throne of his kingdom, which was in Shushan the palace,

entries.yo: Li ọdun kẹta ijọba rẹ̀, o sè àse kan fun gbogbo awọn ijoye ati awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀; awọn balogun Persia ati Media, awọn ọlọla, ati awọn olori ìgberiko wọnni wà niwaju rẹ̀:
entries.en: In the third year of his reign, he made a feast unto all his princes and his servants; the power of Persia and Media, the nobles and princes of the provinces, being before him:

entries.yo: Nigbati o fi ọrọ̀ ijọba rẹ̀ ti o logo, ati ọṣọ iyebiye ọlanla rẹ̀ han lọjọ pipọ̀, ani li ọgọsan ọjọ.
entries.en: When he shewed the riches of his glorious kingdom and the honour of his excellent majesty many days, even an hundred and fourscore days.

entries.yo: Nigbati ọjọ wọnyi si pari, ọba sè àse kan li ọjọ meje fun gbogbo awọn enia ti a ri ni Ṣuṣani ãfin, ati àgba ati ewe ni agbala ọgba ãfin ọba.
entries.en: And when these days were expired, the king made a feast unto all the people that were present in Shushan the palace, both unto great and small, seven days, in the court of the garden of the king's palace;

entries.yo: Nibiti a gbe ta aṣọ àla daradara, aṣọ alaro, ati òféfe, ti a fi okùn ọ̀gbọ daradara, ati elesè aluko dimu mọ oruka fadaka, ati ọwọ̀n okuta marbili: wura ati fadaka ni irọgbọku, ti o wà lori ilẹ ti a fi okuta alabastari, marbili, ilẹkẹ daradara, ati okuta dudu tẹ́.
entries.en: Where were white, green, and blue, hangings, fastened with cords of fine linen and purple to silver rings and pillars of marble: the beds were of gold and silver, upon a pavement of red, and blue, and white, and black, marble.

entries.yo: Ninu ago wura li a si nfun wọn mu, (awọn ohun elo na si yatọ si ara wọn) ati ọti-waini ọba li ọ̀pọlọpọ gẹgẹ bi ọwọ ọba ti to.
entries.en: And they gave them drink in vessels of gold, (the vessels being diverse one from another,) and royal wine in abundance, according to the state of the king.

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi aṣẹ si ni mimu na; ẹnikẹni kò fi ipa rọ̀ ni: nitori bẹ̃ni ọba ti fi aṣẹ fun gbogbo awọn olori ile rẹ̀, ki nwọn ki o le ṣe gẹgẹ bi ifẹ olukuluku.
entries.en: And the drinking was according to the law; none did compel: for so the king had appointed to all the officers of his house, that they should do according to every man's pleasure.

entries.yo: Faṣti ayaba sè àse pẹlu fun gbogbo awọn obinrin ni ile ọba ti iṣe ti Ahaswerusi.
entries.en: Also Vashti the queen made a feast for the women in the royal house which belonged to king Ahasuerus.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ keje, nigbati ọti-waini mu inu ọba dùn, o paṣẹ fun Mehumani, Bista, Harbona, Bigta ati Abagta, Ṣetari ati Karkasi, awọn iwẹfa meje ti njiṣẹ niwaju Ahaswerusi ọba.
entries.en: On the seventh day, when the heart of the king was merry with wine, he commanded Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha, and Abagtha, Zethar, and Carcas, the seven chamberlains that served in the presence of Ahasuerus the king,

entries.yo: Lati mu Faṣti, ayaba wá siwaju ọba, ti on ti ade ọba, lati fi ẹwà rẹ̀ hàn awọn enia, ati awọn ijoye: nitori arẹwà obinrin ni.
entries.en: To bring Vashti the queen before the king with the crown royal, to shew the people and the princes her beauty: for she was fair to look on.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Faṣti ayaba kọ̀ lati wá nipa aṣẹ ọba lati ọwọ awọn ìwẹfa rẹ̀: nitorina ni ọba binu gidigidi, ibinu rẹ̀ si gbiná ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: But the queen Vashti refused to come at the king's commandment by his chamberlains: therefore was the king very wroth, and his anger burned in him.

entries.yo: Ọba si bi awọn ọlọgbọ́n, ti nwọn moye akokò, (nitori bẹ̃ni ìwa ọba ri si gbogbo awọn ti o mọ̀ ofin ati idajọ:
entries.en: Then the king said to the wise men, which knew the times, (for so was the king's manner toward all that knew law and judgment:

entries.yo: Awọn ti o sunmọ ọ ni Karṣina, Ṣetari, Admata, Tarṣiṣi, Meresi, Marsena, ati Memukani, awọn ijoye Persia ati Media mejeje, ti nri oju ọba, ti nwọn si joko ni ipò ikini ni ijọba).
entries.en: And the next unto him was Carshena, Shethar, Admatha, Tarshish, Meres, Marsena, and Memucan, the seven princes of Persia and Media, which saw the king's face, and which sat the first in the kingdom;)

entries.yo: Pe, gẹgẹ bi ofin, Kini ki a ṣe si Faṣti ayaba, nitoriti on kò ṣe bi Ahaswerusi ọba ti paṣẹ fun u, lati ọwọ awọn ìwẹfa rẹ̀ wá?
entries.en: What shall we do unto the queen Vashti according to law, because she hath not performed the commandment of the king Ahasuerus by the chamberlains?

entries.yo: Memukani si dahùn niwaju ọba ati awọn ijoye pe, Faṣti ayaba kò ṣẹ̀ si ọba nikan, ṣugbọn si gbogbo awọn ijoye, ati si gbogbo awọn enia ti o wà ni ìgberiko Ahaswerusi ọba.
entries.en: And Memucan answered before the king and the princes, Vashti the queen hath not done wrong to the king only, but also to all the princes, and to all the people that are in all the provinces of the king Ahasuerus.

entries.yo: Nitori ìwa ayaba yi yio tàn de ọdọ gbogbo awọn obinrin, tobẹ̃ ti ọkọ wọn yio di gigàn loju wọn, nigbati a o sọ ọ wi pe, Ahaswerusi ọba paṣẹ pe, ki a mu Faṣti ayaba wá siwaju rẹ̀, ṣugbọn on kò wá.
entries.en: For this deed of the queen shall come abroad unto all women, so that they shall despise their husbands in their eyes, when it shall be reported, The king Ahasuerus commanded Vashti the queen to be brought in before him, but she came not.

entries.yo: Awọn ọlọla-obinrin Persia ati Media yio si ma wi bakanna li oni yi fun gbogbo awọn ijoye ọba ti nwọn gbọ́ ìwa ti ayaba hù. Bayi ni ẹ̀gan pipọ̀-pipọ̀, ati ibinu yio dide.
entries.en: Likewise shall the ladies of Persia and Media say this day unto all the king's princes, which have heard of the deed of the queen. Thus shall there arise too much contempt and wrath.

entries.yo: Bi o ba dara loju ọba, ki aṣẹ ọba ki o ti ọdọ rẹ̀ lọ, ki a si kọ ọ pẹlu awọn ofin Persia ati Media, ki a má ṣe le pa a dà, pe, ki Faṣti ki o máṣe wá siwaju Ahaswerusi ọba mọ, ki ọba ki o si fi oyè ayaba rẹ̀ fun ẹgbẹ rẹ̀ ti o san jù u lọ.
entries.en: If it please the king, let there go a royal commandment from him, and let it be written among the laws of the Persians and the Medes, that it be not altered, That Vashti come no more before king Ahasuerus; and let the king give her royal estate unto another that is better than she.

entries.yo: Ati nigbati a ba si kede aṣẹ ọba ti on o pa yi gbogbo ijọba rẹ̀ ka, (nitori on sa pọ̀) nigbana ni gbogbo awọn obinrin yio ma bọ̀wọ fun ọkọ wọn, ati àgba ati ewe.
entries.en: And when the king's decree which he shall make shall be published throughout all his empire, (for it is great,) all the wives shall give to their husbands honour, both to great and small.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ na si dara loju ọba ati awọn ijoye; ọba si ṣe gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ Memukani:
entries.en: And the saying pleased the king and the princes; and the king did according to the word of Memucan:

entries.yo: Nitori on ran ìwe si gbogbo ìgberiko ọba, si olukulùku ìgberiko gẹgẹ bi ikọwe rẹ̀, ati si olukulùku enia gẹgẹ bi ède rẹ̀, ki olukulùku ọkunrin ki o le ṣe olori ni ile tirẹ̀, ati ki a le kede rẹ̀ gẹgẹ bi ède enia rẹ̀.
entries.en: For he sent letters into all the king's provinces, into every province according to the writing thereof, and to every people after their language, that every man should bear rule in his own house, and that it should be published according to the language of every people.

entries.yo: LẸHIN nkan wọnyi, nigbati ibinu Ahaswerusi ọba wa tuka, o ranti Faṣti, ati ohun ti o ti ṣe, ati aṣẹ ti a ti pa nitori rẹ̀.
entries.en: After these things, when the wrath of king Ahasuerus was appeased, he remembered Vashti, and what she had done, and what was decreed against her.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni awọn ọmọ-ọdọ ọba, ti nṣe iranṣẹ fun u, wi pe, jẹ ki a wá awọn wundia ti o li ẹwà fun ọba.
entries.en: Then said the king's servants that ministered unto him, Let there be fair young virgins sought for the king:

entries.yo: Ki ọba ki o si yàn olori ni gbogbo ìgberiko ijọba rẹ̀, ki nwọn ki o le ṣà awọn wundia ti o li ẹwà jọ wá si Ṣuṣani ãfin, si ile awọn obinrin, si ọdọ Hegai, ìwẹfa ọba olutọju awọn obinrin; ki a si fi elo ìwẹnumọ́ wọn fun wọn:
entries.en: And let the king appoint officers in all the provinces of his kingdom, that they may gather together all the fair young virgins unto Shushan the palace, to the house of the women unto the custody of Hege the king's chamberlain, keeper of the women; and let their things for purification be given them:

entries.yo: Ki wundia na ti o ba wù ọba ki o jẹ ayaba ni ipò Faṣti. Nkan na si dara loju ọba, o si ṣe bẹ̃.
entries.en: And let the maiden which pleaseth the king be queen instead of Vashti. And the thing pleased the king; and he did so.

entries.yo: Ọkunrin ara Juda kan wà ni Ṣuṣani ãfin, orukọ ẹniti ijẹ Mordekai, ọmọ Jairi, ọmọ Ṣemei, ọmọ Kisi, ara Benjamini.
entries.en: Now in Shushan the palace there was a certain Jew, whose name was Mordecai, the son of Jair, the son of Shimei, the son of Kish, a Benjamite;

entries.yo: Ẹniti a ti mu lọ lati Jerusalemu pẹlu ìgbekun ti a kó lọ pẹlu Jekoniah, ọba Juda, ti Nebukadnessari, ọba Babeli ti kó lọ.
entries.en: Who had been carried away from Jerusalem with the captivity which had been carried away with Jeconiah king of Judah, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away.

entries.yo: On li o si tọ́ Hadassa dagba, eyini ni Esteri, ọmọbinrin arakunrin baba rẹ̀: nitori kò ni baba, bẹ̃ni kò si ni iya, wundia na si li ẹwà, o si dara lati wò; ẹniti, nigbati baba ati iya rẹ̀ ti kú tan, Mordekai mu u ṣe ọmọbinrin ontikalarẹ̀,
entries.en: And he brought up Hadassah, that is, Esther, his uncle's daughter: for she had neither father nor mother, and the maid was fair and beautiful; whom Mordecai, when her father and mother were dead, took for his own daughter.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati a gbọ́ ofin ọba, ati aṣẹ rẹ̀, nigbati a si ṣà ọ̀pọlọpọ wundia jọ si Ṣuṣani ãfin, si ọwọ Hegai, a si mu Esteri wá si ile ọba pẹlu si ọwọ Hegai, olutọju awọn obinrin.
entries.en: So it came to pass, when the king's commandment and his decree was heard, and when many maidens were gathered together unto Shushan the palace, to the custody of Hegai, that Esther was brought also unto the king's house, to the custody of Hegai, keeper of the women.

entries.yo: Wundia na si wù u, o si ri ojurere gbà lọdọ rẹ̀; o si yara fi elo ìwẹnumọ́ rẹ̀ fun u, ati ipin onjẹ ti o jẹ tirẹ̀, ati obinrin meje ti a yàn fun u lati ile ọba wá: on si ṣi i lọ ati awọn wundia rẹ̀ si ibi ti o dara jù ni ile awọn obinrin.
entries.en: And the maiden pleased him, and she obtained kindness of him; and he speedily gave her her things for purification, with such things as belonged to her, and seven maidens, which were meet to be given her, out of the king's house: and he preferred her and her maids unto the best place of the house of the women.

entries.yo: Esteri kò ti ifi awọn enia rẹ̀, tabi awọn ibatan rẹ̀ hàn; nitori Mordekai paṣẹ fun u ki o máṣe fi hàn.
entries.en: Esther had not shewed her people nor her kindred: for Mordecai had charged her that she should not shew it.

entries.yo: Mordekai a si ma rìn lojojumọ niwaju àgbala ile awọn obinrin, lati mọ̀ alafia Esteri, ati bi yio ti ri fun u.
entries.en: And Mordecai walked every day before the court of the women's house, to know how Esther did, and what should become of her.

entries.yo: Njẹ nigbati o kan olukuluku wundia lati wọ̀ ile tọ̀ Ahaswerusi ọba lọ, lẹhin igbati on ba ti gbe oṣù mejila, gẹgẹ bi iṣe awọn obinrin, (nitori bayi ni ọjọ ìwẹnumọ́ wọn pari, oṣù mẹfa ni nwọn fi ikùn òroro ojiá, ati oṣù mẹfa òroro olõrùn didùn, ati pẹlu ohun elo ìwẹnumọ́ awọn obinrin):
entries.en: Now when every maid's turn was come to go in to king Ahasuerus, after that she had been twelve months, according to the manner of the women, (for so were the days of their purifications accomplished, to wit, six months with oil of myrrh, and six months with sweet odours, and with other things for the purifying of the women;)

entries.yo: Bayi ni wundia na iwá si ọdọ ọba; ohunkohun ti o ba bère li a si ifi fun u lati ba a lọ, lati ile awọn obinrin lọ si ile ọba.
entries.en: Then thus came every maiden unto the king; whatsoever she desired was given her to go with her out of the house of the women unto the king's house.

entries.yo: Li aṣãlẹ on a lọ, ni õrọ ijọ keji on a si pada si ile keji ti awọn obinrin, si ọwọ Ṣaaṣgasi, ìwẹfa, ọba, ti nṣe olutọju awọn obinrin, on kò si gbọdọ wọle tọ̀ ọba wá mọ, bikoṣepe inu ọba ba dùn si i, ti a ba si pè e li orukọ.
entries.en: In the evening she went, and on the morrow she returned into the second house of the women, to the custody of Shaashgaz, the king's chamberlain, which kept the concubines: she came in unto the king no more, except the king delighted in her, and that she were called by name.

entries.yo: Njẹ nigbati o kan Esteri, ọmọ Abihaili, arakunrin Mordekai, ẹniti o mu u ṣe ọmọ ara rẹ̀, lati wọle tọ̀ ọba lọ, on kò bère ohunkohun, bikoṣe ohun ti Hegai, ìwẹfa ọba, olutọju awọn obinrin paṣẹ. Esteri si ri ojurere lọdọ gbogbo ẹniti nwò o.
entries.en: Now when the turn of Esther, the daughter of Abihail the uncle of Mordecai, who had taken her for his daughter, was come to go in unto the king, she required nothing but what Hegai the king's chamberlain, the keeper of the women, appointed. And Esther obtained favour in the sight of all them that looked upon her.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li a mu Esteri wá si ọdọ Ahaswerusi ọba, sinu ile ọba, li oṣù kẹwa, ti iṣe oṣù Tibeti, li ọdun keje ijọba rẹ̀.
entries.en: So Esther was taken unto king Ahasuerus into his house royal in the tenth month, which is the month Tebeth, in the seventh year of his reign.

entries.yo: Ọba si fẹràn Esteri jù gbogbo awọn obinrin lọ, on si ri ore-ọfẹ ati ojurere lọdọ rẹ̀ jù gbogbo awọn wundia na lọ; tobẹ̃ ti o fi gbe ade ọba kà a li ori, o si fi i ṣe ayaba ni ipò Faṣti.
entries.en: And the king loved Esther above all the women, and she obtained grace and favour in his sight more than all the virgins; so that he set the royal crown upon her head, and made her queen instead of Vashti.

entries.yo: Ọba si sè àse nla kan fun gbogbo awọn olori rẹ̀, ati awọn ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ̀, ani àse ti Esteri; o si fi isimi fun awọn ìgberiko rẹ̀, o si ṣe itọrẹ gẹgẹ bi ọwọ ọba ti to.
entries.en: Then the king made a great feast unto all his princes and his servants, even Esther's feast; and he made a release to the provinces, and gave gifts, according to the state of the king.

entries.yo: Nigbati a si kó awọn wundia na jọ li ẹrinkeji, nigbana ni Mordekai joko li ẹnu ọ̀na ile ọba.
entries.en: And when the virgins were gathered together the second time, then Mordecai sat in the king's gate.

entries.yo: Esteri kò ti ifi awọn ibatan, tabi awọn enia rẹ̀ hàn titi disisiyi bi Mordekai ti paṣẹ fun u: nitori Esteri npa ofin Mordekai mọ́, bi igba ti o wà li abẹ itọ́ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Esther had not yet shewed her kindred nor her people; as Mordecai had charged her: for Esther did the commandment of Mordecai, like as when she was brought up with him.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ wọnni, nigbati Mordekai njoko li ẹnu ọ̀na ile ọba, meji ninu awọn iwẹfa ọba, Bigtani ati Tereṣi, ninu awọn ti nṣọ iloro, nwọn binu, nwọn si nwá ọ̀na lati gbe ọwọ le Ahaswerusi ọba.
entries.en: In those days, while Mordecai sat in the king's gate, two of the king's chamberlains, Bigthan and Teresh, of those which kept the door, were wroth, and sought to lay hand on the king Ahasuerus.

entries.yo: Nkan na si di mimọ̀ fun Mordekai, o si sọ fun Esteri ayaba; Esteri si fi ọ̀ran na hàn ọba li orukọ Mordekai.
entries.en: And the thing was known to Mordecai, who told it unto Esther the queen; and Esther certified the king thereof in Mordecai's name.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si wadi ọ̀ran na, nwọn ri idi rẹ̀; nitorina a so awọn mejeji rọ̀ sori igi; a si kọ ọ sinu iwé-iranti niwaju ọba.
entries.en: And when inquisition was made of the matter, it was found out; therefore they were both hanged on a tree: and it was written in the book of the chronicles before the king.

entries.yo: LẸHIN nkan wọnyi ni Ahaswerusi ọba gbe Hamani, ọmọ Medata, ara Agagi ga, o si gbe e lekè, o si fi ijoko rẹ̀ lekè gbogbo awọn ijoye ti o wà pẹlu rẹ̀.
entries.en: After these things did king Ahasuerus promote Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, and advanced him, and set his seat above all the princes that were with him.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn iranṣẹ ọba, ti nwọn wà li ẹnu ọ̀na ọba, kunlẹ nwọn si wolẹ fun Hamani: nitori ọba ti paṣẹ bẹ̃ nitori rẹ̀. Ṣugbọn Mordekai kò kunlẹ, bẹ̃ni kò si wolẹ fun u.
entries.en: And all the king's servants, that were in the king's gate, bowed, and reverenced Haman: for the king had so commanded concerning him. But Mordecai bowed not, nor did him reverence.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni awọn iranṣẹ ọba, ti nwọn wà li ẹnu ọ̀na ọba, wi fun Mordekai pe, ẽṣe ti iwọ fi nré ofin ọba kọja?
entries.en: Then the king's servants, which were in the king's gate, said unto Mordecai, Why transgressest thou the king's commandment?

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati nwọn wi fun u lojojumọ, ti on kò si gbọ́ ti wọn, nwọn sọ fun Hamani, lati wò bi ọ̀ran Mordekai yio ti le ri: nitori on ti wi fun wọn pe, enia Juda ni on.
entries.en: Now it came to pass, when they spake daily unto him, and he hearkened not unto them, that they told Haman, to see whether Mordecai's matters would stand: for he had told them that he was a Jew.

entries.yo: Nigbati Hamani si ri pe, Mordekai kò kunlẹ, bẹ̃ni kò wolẹ fun on, nigbana ni Hamani kún fun ibinu.
entries.en: And when Haman saw that Mordecai bowed not, nor did him reverence, then was Haman full of wrath.

entries.yo: O si jẹ abùku loju rẹ̀ lati gbe ọwọ le Mordekai nikan; nitori nwọn ti fi awọn enia Mordekai hàn a: nitorina gbogbo awọn Ju ti o wà ni gbogbo ijọba Ahaswerusi, ni Hamani wá ọ̀na lati parun, ani awọn enia Mordekai.
entries.en: And he thought scorn to lay hands on Mordecai alone; for they had shewed him the people of Mordecai: wherefore Haman sought to destroy all the Jews that were throughout the whole kingdom of Ahasuerus, even the people of Mordecai.

entries.yo: Li oṣù kini, eyinì ni oṣù Nisani, li ọdun kejila ijọba Ahaswerusi, nwọn da purimu, eyinì ni, ìbo, niwaju Hamani, lati ọjọ de ọjọ, ati lati oṣù de oṣù lọ ide oṣù kejila, eyinì ni oṣù Adari.
entries.en: In the first month, that is, the month Nisan, in the twelfth year of king Ahasuerus, they cast Pur, that is, the lot, before Haman from day to day, and from month to month, to the twelfth month, that is, the month Adar.

entries.yo: Hamani si sọ fun Ahaswerusi ọba pe, awọn enia kan fọn kakiri, nwọn si tuka lãrin awọn enia ni gbogbo ìgberiko ijọba rẹ, ofin wọn si yatọ si ti gbogbo enia; bẹ̃ni nwọn kò si pa ofin ọba mọ́; nitorina kò yẹ fun ọba lati da wọn si.
entries.en: And Haman said unto king Ahasuerus, There is a certain people scattered abroad and dispersed among the people in all the provinces of thy kingdom; and their laws are diverse from all people; neither keep they the king's laws: therefore it is not for the king's profit to suffer them.

entries.yo: Bi o ba wù ọba, jẹ ki a kọwe rẹ̀ pe, ki a run wọn: emi o si wọ̀n ẹgbãrun talenti fadaka fun awọn ti a fi iṣẹ na rán, ki nwọn ki o le mu u wá sinu ile iṣura ọba.
entries.en: If it please the king, let it be written that they may be destroyed: and I will pay ten thousand talents of silver to the hands of those that have the charge of the business, to bring it into the king's treasuries.

entries.yo: Ọba si bọ́ oruka rẹ̀ kuro li ọwọ rẹ̀, o si fi fun Hamani, ọmọ Medata, ara Agagi, ọta awọn Ju.
entries.en: And the king took his ring from his hand, and gave it unto Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, the Jews' enemy.

entries.yo: Ọba si wi fun Hamani pe, a fi fadaka na bùn ọ, ati awọn enia na pẹlu, lati fi wọn ṣe bi o ti dara loju rẹ.
entries.en: And the king said unto Haman, The silver is given to thee, the people also, to do with them as it seemeth good to thee.

entries.yo: Nigbana li a pè awọn akọwe ọba ni ọjọ kẹtala, oṣù kini, a si kọwe gẹgẹ bi gbogbo ohun ti Hamani ti pa li aṣẹ fun awọn bãlẹ ọba, ati fun awọn onidajọ ti o njẹ olori gbogbo ìgberiko, ati fun awọn olori olukuluku enia ìgberiko gbogbo, gẹgẹ bi ikọwe rẹ̀, ati fun olukuluku enià gẹgẹ bi ède rẹ̀, li orukọ Ahaswerusi ọba li a kọ ọ, a si fi oruka ọba ṣe edidi rẹ̀.
entries.en: Then were the king's scribes called on the thirteenth day of the first month, and there was written according to all that Haman had commanded unto the king's lieutenants, and to the governors that were over every province, and to the rulers of every people of every province according to the writing thereof, and to every people after their language; in the name of king Ahasuerus was it written, and sealed with the king's ring.

entries.yo: A si fi iwe na rán awọn òjiṣẹ si gbogbo ìgberiko ọba, lati parun, lati pa, ati lati mu ki gbogbo enia Juda, ati ọ̀dọ ati arugbo, awọn ọmọde, ati awọn obinrin ki o ṣegbe ni ọjọ kan, ani li ọjọ kẹtala, oṣù kejila, ti iṣe oṣù Adari, ati lati kó ohun iní wọn fun ijẹ.
entries.en: And the letters were sent by posts into all the king's provinces, to destroy, to kill, and to cause to perish, all Jews, both young and old, little children and women, in one day, even upon the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, which is the month Adar, and to take the spoil of them for a prey.

entries.yo: Ọ̀ran iwe na ni lati paṣẹ ni gbogbo igberiko, lati kede rẹ̀ fun gbogbo enia, ki nwọn ki o le mura de ọjọ na.
entries.en: The copy of the writing for a commandment to be given in every province was published unto all people, that they should be ready against that day.

entries.yo: Awọn ojiṣẹ na jade lọ, nwọn si yara, nitori aṣẹ ọba ni, a si pa aṣẹ na ni Ṣuṣani ãfin. Ati ọba ati Hamani joko lati mu ọti; ṣugbọn ilu Ṣuṣani dãmu.
entries.en: The posts went out, being hastened by the king's commandment, and the decree was given in Shushan the palace. And the king and Haman sat down to drink; but the city Shushan was perplexed.

entries.yo: Nigbati Mordekai mọ̀ gbogbo ohun ti a ṣe, Mordekai fa aṣọ rẹ̀ ya, o si fi aṣọ-ọ̀fọ on ẽru bò ara, o si jade lọ si ãrin ilu na, o si sọkun kikan ati kikoro.
entries.en: When Mordecai perceived all that was done, Mordecai rent his clothes, and put on sackcloth with ashes, and went out into the midst of the city, and cried with a loud and a bitter cry;

entries.yo: O tilẹ wá siwaju ẹnu-ọna ile ọba: nitori kò si ẹnikan ti o fi aṣọ-ọfọ si ara ti o gbọdọ wọ̀ ẹnu-ọ̀na ile ọba.
entries.en: And came even before the king's gate: for none might enter into the king's gate clothed with sackcloth.

entries.yo: Ati ni gbogbo ìgberiko, nibiti ofin ọba, ati aṣẹ rẹ̀ ba de, ọ̀fọ nla ba gbogbo awọn Ju; ati ãwẹ, ati ẹkún, ati ipohùnrere; ọ̀pọlọpọ li o si dubulẹ ninu aṣọ-ọ̀fọ, ati ninu ẽru.
entries.en: And in every province, whithersoever the king's commandment and his decree came, there was great mourning among the Jews, and fasting, and weeping, and wailing; and many lay in sackcloth and ashes.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li awọn iranṣẹbinrin Esteri ati awọn ìwẹfa rẹ̀ wá, nwọn si sọ fun u. Nigbana ni inu ayaba bajẹ gidigidi; o si fi aṣọ ranṣẹ lati fi wọ̀ Mordekai, ati lati mu aṣọ-ọ̀fọ rẹ̀ kuro lara rẹ̀, ṣugbọn on kò gbà a.
entries.en: So Esther's maids and her chamberlains came and told it her. Then was the queen exceedingly grieved; and she sent raiment to clothe Mordecai, and to take away his sackcloth from him: but he received it not.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Esteri pè Hataki, ọkan ninu awọn ìwẹfa ọba, ẹniti o ti yàn lati duro niwaju rẹ̀, o si rán a si Mordekai lati mọ̀ ohun ti o ṣe, ati nitori kini?
entries.en: Then called Esther for Hatach, one of the king's chamberlains, whom he had appointed to attend upon her, and gave him a commandment to Mordecai, to know what it was, and why it was.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Hataki jade tọ̀ Mordekai lọ si ita ilu niwaju ẹnu-ọ̀na ile ọba.
entries.en: So Hatach went forth to Mordecai unto the street of the city, which was before the king's gate.

entries.yo: Mordekai si sọ ohun gbogbo ti o ri to fun u, ati ti iye owo fadaka ti Hamani ti ṣe ileri lati san si ile iṣura ọba, nitori awọn Ju, lati pa wọn run.
entries.en: And Mordecai told him of all that had happened unto him, and of the sum of the money that Haman had promised to pay to the king's treasuries for the Jews, to destroy them.

entries.yo: Ati pẹlu, o fi iwe aṣẹ na pãpã, ti a pa ni Ṣuṣani lati pa awọn Ju run, le e lọwọ, lati fi hàn Esteri, ati lati sọ fun u, ati lati paṣẹ fun u ki on ki o wọle tọ̀ ọba lọ, lati bẹ̀bẹ lọwọ rẹ̀, ati lati bẹ̀bẹ niwaju rẹ̀, nitori awọn enia rẹ̀.
entries.en: Also he gave him the copy of the writing of the decree that was given at Shushan to destroy them, to shew it unto Esther, and to declare it unto her, and to charge her that she should go in unto the king, to make supplication unto him, and to make request before him for her people.

entries.yo: Hataki si wá o si sọ gbogbo ọ̀rọ Mordekai fun Esteri.
entries.en: And Hatach came and told Esther the words of Mordecai.

entries.yo: Esteri si tun sọ fun Hataki, o si rán a si Mordekai.
entries.en: Again Esther spake unto Hatach, and gave him commandment unto Mordecai;

entries.yo: Pe, gbogbo awọn iranṣẹ ọba, ati awọn enia ìgberiko ọba li o mọ̀ pe, ẹnikẹni ibaṣe ọkunrin tabi obinrin, ti o ba tọ̀ ọba wá sinu àgbala ti inu, ti a kò ba pè, ofin rẹ̀ kan ni, ki a pa a, bikoṣe iru ẹniti ọba ba nà ọpá alade wura si, ki on ki o le yè: ṣugbọn a kò ti ipè mi lati wọ̀ ile tọ̀ ọba lọ lati ìwọn ọgbọn ọjọ yi wá.
entries.en: All the king's servants, and the people of the king's provinces, do know, that whosoever, whether man or woman, shall come unto the king into the inner court, who is not called, there is one law of his to put him to death, except such to whom the king shall hold out the golden sceptre, that he may live: but I have not been called to come in unto the king these thirty days.

entries.yo: Nwọn si sọ ọ̀rọ Esteri fun Mordekai.
entries.en: And they told to Mordecai Esther's words.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Mordekai sọ ki a da Esteri lohùn pe, Máṣe rò ninu ara rẹ pe, iwọ o là ninu ile ọba jù gbogbo awọn Ju lọ.
entries.en: Then Mordecai commanded to answer Esther, Think not with thyself that thou shalt escape in the king's house, more than all the Jews.

entries.yo: Nitori bi iwọ ba pa ẹnu rẹ mọ́ patapata li akokò yi, nigbana ni iranlọwọ ati igbala awọn Ju yio dide lati ibomiran wá; ṣugbọn iwọ ati ile baba rẹ li a o parun: tali o si mọ̀ bi nitori iru akokò bayi ni iwọ ṣe de ijọba?
entries.en: For if thou altogether holdest thy peace at this time, then shall there enlargement and deliverance arise to the Jews from another place; but thou and thy father's house shall be destroyed: and who knoweth whether thou art come to the kingdom for such a time as this?

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Esteri rán wọn lọ ifi èsi yi fun Mordekai pe,
entries.en: Then Esther bade them return Mordecai this answer,

entries.yo: Lọ, pè awọn Ju ti a le ri ni Ṣuṣani jọ, ki ẹnyin si ma gbãwẹ, fun mi, ki ẹnyin ki o máṣe jẹun, bẹ̃ni ki ẹnyin ki o máṣe mu ni ijọ mẹta t'ọsan t'oru: emi pẹlu ati awọn iranṣẹbinrin mi yio gbãwẹ bẹ̃ gẹgẹ; bẹ̃li emi o si wọ̀ ile tọ̀ ọba lọ, ti o lòdi si ofin; bi mo ba ṣègbe, mo ṣègbe.
entries.en: Go, gather together all the Jews that are present in Shushan, and fast ye for me, and neither eat nor drink three days, night or day: I also and my maidens will fast likewise; and so will I go in unto the king, which is not according to the law: and if I perish, I perish.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Mordekai ba ọ̀na rẹ̀ lọ, o si ṣe gẹgẹ bi gbogbo eyiti Esteri ti paṣẹ fun u.
entries.en: So Mordecai went his way, and did according to all that Esther had commanded him.

entries.yo: O si ṣe li ọjọ kẹta, ni Esteri wọ̀ aṣọ ayaba rẹ̀, o si duro ni àgbala ile ọba ti o wà ninu, lọgangan ile ọba: ọba si joko lori ìtẹ ijọba rẹ̀ ni ile ọba, ti o kọjusi ẹnu-ọ̀na ile na.
entries.en: Now it came to pass on the third day, that Esther put on her royal apparel, and stood in the inner court of the king's house, over against the king's house: and the king sat upon his royal throne in the royal house, over against the gate of the house.

entries.yo: O si ṣe nigbati ọba ri ti Esteri ayaba duro ni àgbala, on si ri ore-ọfẹ loju rẹ̀: ọba si nà ọ̀pá alade wura ti o wà lọwọ rẹ̀ si Esteri. Esteri si sunmọ ọ, o si fi ọwọ kàn ori ọpá alade na.
entries.en: And it was so, when the king saw Esther the queen standing in the court, that she obtained favour in his sight: and the king held out to Esther the golden sceptre that was in his hand. So Esther drew near, and touched the top of the sceptre.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ọba bi i pe, kini iwọ nfẹ́, Esteri ayaba? ati kini ẹ̀bẹ rẹ̀? ani de idajì ijọba li a o si fi fun ọ.
entries.en: Then said the king unto her, What wilt thou, queen Esther? and what is thy request? it shall be even given thee to the half of the kingdom.

entries.yo: Esteri si dahùn pe, bi o ba dara loju ọba, jẹ ki ọba ati Hamani ki o wá loni si àse mi, ti mo ti mura silẹ fun u.
entries.en: And Esther answered, If it seem good unto the king, let the king and Haman come this day unto the banquet that I have prepared for him.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ọba wi pe, ẹ mu ki Hamani ki o yara, ki on ki o le ṣe bi Esteri ti wi. Bẹ̃ni ọba ati Hamani wá si àse na ti Esteri ti sè silẹ.
entries.en: Then the king said, Cause Haman to make haste, that he may do as Esther hath said. So the king and Haman came to the banquet that Esther had prepared.

entries.yo: Ọba si wi fun Esteri nibiti nwọn gbe nmu ọti-waini pe, kini ibere rẹ? a o si fi fun ọ: ki si ni ẹ̀bẹ rẹ? ani de idajì ijọba, a o si ṣe e.
entries.en: And the king said unto Esther at the banquet of wine, What is thy petition? and it shall be granted thee: and what is thy request? even to the half of the kingdom it shall be performed.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Esteri dahùn, o si wi pe, ẹ̀bẹ mi ati ibère mi ni pe,
entries.en: Then answered Esther, and said, My petition and my request is;

entries.yo: Bi mo ba ri ore-ọfẹ loju ọba, bi o ba si wù ọba lati fi ohun ti emi ntọrọ fun mi, ati lati ṣe ohun ti emi mbère fun mi, jẹ ki ọba ati Hamani ki o wá si àse ti emi o si tun sè fun wọn, emi o si ṣe li ọla bi ọba ti wi.
entries.en: If I have found favour in the sight of the king, and if it please the king to grant my petition, and to perform my request, let the king and Haman come to the banquet that I shall prepare for them, and I will do tomorrow as the king hath said.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Hamani jade lọ li ọjọ na tayọ̀tayọ̀, ati pẹlu inu didùn: ṣugbọn nigbati Hamani ri Mordekai li ẹnu ọ̀na ile ọba pe, kò dide duro, bẹ̃ni kò pa ara rẹ̀ da fun on, Hamani kún fun ibinu si Mordekai.
entries.en: Then went Haman forth that day joyful and with a glad heart: but when Haman saw Mordecai in the king's gate, that he stood not up, nor moved for him, he was full of indignation against Mordecai.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Hamani kó ara rẹ̀ ni ijanu: nigbati o si de ile, o ranṣẹ lọ ipè awọn ọrẹ rẹ̀, ati Sereṣi aya rẹ̀.
entries.en: Nevertheless Haman refrained himself: and when he came home, he sent and called for his friends, and Zeresh his wife.

entries.yo: Hamani si ròhin ogo ọrọ̀ rẹ̀, ati ọ̀pọlọpọ awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, ati ninu ohun gbogbo ti ọba fi gbe e ga, ati bi o ti gbe on ga jù awọn ijoye, ati awọn ọmọ-ọdọ ọba lọ.
entries.en: And Haman told them of the glory of his riches, and the multitude of his children, and all the things wherein the king had promoted him, and how he had advanced him above the princes and servants of the king.

entries.yo: Hamani si wi pẹlu pe, ani Esteri ayaba kò mu ki ẹnikẹni ki o ba ọba wá si ibi àse ti o ti sè bikoṣe emi nikan; li ọla ẹ̀wẹ li a si tun pè mi pẹlu ọba lati wá si ọdọ rẹ̀,
entries.en: Haman said moreover, Yea, Esther the queen did let no man come in with the king unto the banquet that she had prepared but myself; and to morrow am I invited unto her also with the king.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn gbogbo wọnyi kò di nkankan fun mi, niwọ̀n igbati mo ba ri Mordekai, ara Juda nì, ti o joko li ẹnu ọ̀na ile ọba.
entries.en: Yet all this availeth me nothing, so long as I see Mordecai the Jew sitting at the king's gate.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Sereṣi aya rẹ̀, ati gbogbo awọn ọrẹ rẹ̀ wi fun u pe, Jẹ ki a rì igi kan, ki o ga ni ãdọta igbọnwọ, ati li ọla ni ki o ba ọba sọ ọ ki a so Mordekai rọ̀ nibẹ: iwọ̀ o si fi ayọ̀ ba ọba lọ si ibi àse. Nkan yi dùn mọ Hamani, o si rì igi na.
entries.en: Then said Zeresh his wife and all his friends unto him, Let a gallows be made of fifty cubits high, and tomorrow speak thou unto the king that Mordecai may be hanged thereon: then go thou in merrily with the king unto the banquet. And the thing pleased Haman; and he caused the gallows to be made.

entries.yo: Li oru na ọba kò le sùn, o si paṣẹ pe, ki a mu iwe iranti, ani irohin awọn ọjọ wá, a si kà wọn niwaju ọba.
entries.en: On that night could not the king sleep, and he commanded to bring the book of records of the chronicles; and they were read before the king.

entries.yo: A si ri pe, ati kọ ọ pe, Mordekai ti sọ ti Bigtani, ati Tereṣi, awọn ìwẹfa ọba meji, oluṣọ iloro, awọn ẹniti nwá ọ̀na lati gbe ọwọ le Ahaswerusi ọba.
entries.en: And it was found written, that Mordecai had told of Bigthana and Teresh, two of the king's chamberlains, the keepers of the door, who sought to lay hand on the king Ahasuerus.

entries.yo: Ọba si wi pe, Iyìn ati ọlá wo li a fi fun Mordekai nitori eyi? Nigbana ni awọn ọmọ-ọdọ ọba ti nṣe iranṣẹ fun u wi pe, a kò ṣe nkankan fun u.
entries.en: And the king said, What honour and dignity hath been done to Mordecai for this? Then said the king's servants that ministered unto him, There is nothing done for him.

entries.yo: Ọba si wi pe, Tani mbẹ ni àgbala? Hamani si ti de àgbala akọkàn ile ọba, lati ba ọba sọ ọ lati so Mordekai rọ̀ sori igi giga ti o ti rì fun u.
entries.en: And the king said, Who is in the court? Now Haman was come into the outward court of the king's house, to speak unto the king to hang Mordecai on the gallows that he had prepared for him.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ-ọdọ ọba si wi fun u pe, Sa wò o, Hamani duro ni agbala, Ọba si wi pe, jẹ ki o wọle.
entries.en: And the king's servants said unto him, Behold, Haman standeth in the court. And the king said, Let him come in.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Hamani si wọle wá, Ọba si wi fun u pe, kini a o ṣe fun ọkunrin na ẹniti inu ọba dùn si lati bù ọlá fun? Njẹ Hamani rò ninu ọkàn ara rẹ̀ pe, Tani inu ọba le dùn si lati bù ọlá fun jù emi tikalami lọ?
entries.en: So Haman came in. And the king said unto him, What shall be done unto the man whom the king delighteth to honour? Now Haman thought in his heart, To whom would the king delight to do honour more than to myself?

entries.yo: Hamani si da ọba lohùn pe, ọkunrin na ẹniti inu ọba dùn si lati bù ọlá fun.
entries.en: And Haman answered the king, For the man whom the king delighteth to honour,

entries.yo: Jẹ ki a mu aṣọ ọba ti ọba ima wọ̀, ati ẹṣin ti ọba ima gùn, ati ade ọba ti ima gbe kà ori rẹ̀ wá;
entries.en: Let the royal apparel be brought which the king useth to wear, and the horse that the king rideth upon, and the crown royal which is set upon his head:

entries.yo: Ki a si fi ẹ̀wu ati ẹṣin yi le ọwọ ọkan ninu awọn ijoye ọba ti o lọlajùlọ, ki nwọn fi ṣe ọṣọ fun ọkunrin na, ẹniti inu ọba dùn si lati bù ọlá fun, ki o si mu u gẹṣin là igboro ilu, ki o si ma kigbe niwaju rẹ̀ pe, Bayi li a o ṣe fun ọkunrin na, ẹniti inu ọba dùn si lati bù ọlá fun.
entries.en: And let this apparel and horse be delivered to the hand of one of the king's most noble princes, that they may array the man withal whom the king delighteth to honour, and bring him on horseback through the street of the city, and proclaim before him, Thus shall it be done to the man whom the king delighteth to honour.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ọba wi fun Hamani pe, yara kánkán, mu ẹ̀wu ati ẹṣin na, bi iwọ ti wi, ki o si ṣe bẹ̃ gẹgẹ fun Mordekai, ara Juda nì, ti njoko li ẹnu ọ̀na ile ọba: ohunkohun kò gbọdọ yẹ̀ ninu ohun ti iwọ ti sọ.
entries.en: Then the king said to Haman, Make haste, and take the apparel and the horse, as thou hast said, and do even so to Mordecai the Jew, that sitteth at the king's gate: let nothing fail of all that thou has spoken.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Hamani mu aṣọ ati ẹṣin na, o si ṣe Mordekai li ọṣọ́, o si mu u là igboro ilu lori ẹṣin, o si kigbe niwaju rẹ̀ pe, Bayi li a o ṣe fun ọkunrin na ẹniti inu ọba dùn si lati bù ọlá fun.
entries.en: Then took Haman the apparel and the horse, and arrayed Mordecai, and brought him on horseback through the street of the city, and proclaimed before him, Thus shall it be done unto the man whom the king delighteth to honour.

entries.yo: Mordekai si tun pada wá si ẹnu-ọ̀na ile ọba, ṣugbọn Hamani yara lọ si ile rẹ̀ ti on ti ibinujẹ, o si bò ori rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Mordecai came again to the king's gate. But Haman hasted to his house mourning, and having his head covered.

entries.yo: Hamani si sọ gbogbo ohun ti o ba a, fun Sereṣi obinrin rẹ̀, ati gbogbo awọn ọrẹ rẹ̀. Nigbana ni awọn enia rẹ̀, amoye, ati Sereṣi obinrin rẹ̀, wi fun u pe, Bi Mordekai ba jẹ iru-ọmọ awọn Ju, niwaju ẹniti iwọ ti bẹ̀rẹ si iṣubu na, iwọ, kì yio le bori rẹ̀, ṣugbọn iwọ o ṣubu niwaju rẹ̀ dandan.
entries.en: And Haman told Zeresh his wife and all his friends every thing that had befallen him. Then said his wise men and Zeresh his wife unto him, If Mordecai be of the seed of the Jews, before whom thou hast begun to fall, thou shalt not prevail against him, but shalt surely fall before him.

entries.yo: Bi nwọn si ti mba a sọ̀rọ lọwọ, awọn ìwẹfa ọba de, lati wá mu Hamani yára wá si ibi àse ti Esteri sè.
entries.en: And while they were yet talking with him, came the king's chamberlains, and hasted to bring Haman unto the banquet that Esther had prepared.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni ọba ati Hamani wá iba Esteri ayaba jẹ àse.
entries.en: So the king and Haman came to banquet with Esther the queen.

entries.yo: Ọba si tun wi fun Esteri ni ijọ keji ni ibi àse ti nwọn nmu ọti-waini pe, kini ẹbẹ rẹ, Esteri ayaba? a o si fi fun ọ: ki si ni ibère rẹ? a o si ṣe e, ani lọ ide idaji ijọba.
entries.en: And the king said again unto Esther on the second day at the banquet of wine, What is thy petition, queen Esther? and it shall be granted thee: and what is thy request? and it shall be performed, even to the half of the kingdom.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Esteri ayaba dahùn wi pe, bi mo ba ri ore-ọfẹ loju rẹ ọba, bi o ba si wù ọba, mo bẹbẹ ki a fi ẹmi mi bùn mi nipa ẹbẹ mi, ati awọn enia mi nipa ibère mi.
entries.en: Then Esther the queen answered and said, If I have found favour in thy sight, O king, and if it please the king, let my life be given me at my petition, and my people at my request:

entries.yo: Nitori a ti tà wa, emi ati awọn enia mi, lati run wa, lati pa wa, ki a le parun. Ṣugbọn bi o ṣe pe, a ti tà wa fun ẹrúkunrin, ati ẹrúbirin ni, emi iba pa ẹnu mi mọ́, bi o tilẹ jẹ pe ọta na kò le di ofò ọba.
entries.en: For we are sold, I and my people, to be destroyed, to be slain, and to perish. But if we had been sold for bondmen and bondwomen, I had held my tongue, although the enemy could not countervail the king's damage.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Ahaswerusi ọba dahùn, o si wi fun Esteri ayaba pe, Tali oluwa rẹ̀ na, nibo li o si wà, ti o jẹ gbe e le ọkàn rẹ̀ lati ṣe bẹ̃?
entries.en: Then the king Ahasuerus answered and said unto Esther the queen, Who is he, and where is he, that durst presume in his heart to do so?

entries.yo: Esteri si wi pe, ọlọtẹ enia ati ọta na ni Hamani, ẹni buburu yi. Nigbana ni ẹ̀ru ba Hamani niwaju ọba ati ayaba.
entries.en: And Esther said, The adversary and enemy is this wicked Haman. Then Haman was afraid before the king and the queen.

entries.yo: Ọba si dide ni ibinu rẹ̀ kuro ni ibi àse ti nwọn nmu ọti-waini, o bọ́ si àgbala ãfin. Hamani si dide duro lati tọrọ ẹmi rẹ̀ lọwọ Esteri ayaba; nitori o ti ri pe ọba ti pinnu ibi si on.
entries.en: And the king arising from the banquet of wine in his wrath went into the palace garden: and Haman stood up to make request for his life to Esther the queen; for he saw that there was evil determined against him by the king.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ọba pẹhinda lati inu àgbala ãfin sinu ibiti nwọn ti nmu ọti-waini, Hamani si ṣubu le ibi ìrọgbọkú lori eyi ti Esteri joko; nigbana ni ọba wi pe, yio ha tẹ́ ayaba lọdọ mi ninu ile bi? Bi ọ̀rọ na ti ti ẹnu ọba jade, nwọn bò oju Hamani.
entries.en: Then the king returned out of the palace garden into the place of the banquet of wine; and Haman was fallen upon the bed whereon Esther was. Then said the king, Will he force the queen also before me in the house? As the word went out of the king's mouth, they covered Haman's face.

entries.yo: Harbona ọkan ninu awọn ìwẹfa si wi niwaju ọba pe, Sa wò o, igi ti o ga ni ãdọta igbọnwọ ti Hamani ti rì nitori Mordekai ti o ti sọ ọ̀rọ rere fun ọba, o wà li oró ni ile Hamani. Ọba si wi pe, Ẹ so o rọ̀ lori rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Harbonah, one of the chamberlains, said before the king, Behold also, the gallows fifty cubits high, which Haman had made for Mordecai, who had spoken good for the king, standeth in the house of Haman. Then the king said, Hang him thereon.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni nwọn so Hamani rọ̀ sori igi ti o ti rì fun Mordekai; ibinu ọba si rọ̀.
entries.en: So they hanged Haman on the gallows that he had prepared for Mordecai. Then was the king's wrath pacified.

entries.yo: Ni ijọ na ni Ahaswerusi ọba fi ile Hamani ọta awọn Ju, jìn Esteri, ayaba; Mordekai si wá siwaju ọba; nitori Esteri ti sọ bi o ti ri si on.
entries.en: On that day did the king Ahasuerus give the house of Haman the Jews' enemy unto Esther the queen. And Mordecai came before the king; for Esther had told what he was unto her.

entries.yo: Ọba si bọ́ oruka rẹ̀, ti o ti gbà lọwọ Hamani, o si fi i fun Mordekai. Esteri si fi Mordekai ṣe olori ile Hamani.
entries.en: And the king took off his ring, which he had taken from Haman, and gave it unto Mordecai. And Esther set Mordecai over the house of Haman.

entries.yo: Esteri si tun sọ niwaju ọba, o wolẹ lẹba ẹsẹ̀ rẹ̀, o si fi omijé bẹ̀ ẹ pe, ki o mu buburu Hamani, ara Agagi kuro, ati ete ti o ti pa si awọn Ju.
entries.en: And Esther spake yet again before the king, and fell down at his feet, and besought him with tears to put away the mischief of Haman the Agagite, and his device that he had devised against the Jews.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ọba nà ọpá-alade wura si Esteri. Bẹ̃ni Esteri dide, o si duro niwaju ọba.
entries.en: Then the king held out the golden sceptre toward Esther. So Esther arose, and stood before the king,

entries.yo: O si wi pe, bi o ba wù ọba, bi mo ba si ri ore-ọfẹ loju rẹ̀, ti nkan na ba si tọ́ loju ọba, bi mo ba si wù ọba, jẹ ki a kọwe lati yí iwe ete Hamani, ọmọ Medata, ara Agagi nì pada, ti o ti kọ lati pa awọn Ju run, ti o wà ni gbogbo ìgberiko ọba.
entries.en: And said, If it please the king, and if I have found favour in his sight, and the thing seem right before the king, and I be pleasing in his eyes, let it be written to reverse the letters devised by Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, which he wrote to destroy the Jews which are in all the king's provinces:

entries.yo: Nitori pe, emi ti ṣe le ri ibi ti yio wá ba awọn enia mi? tabi emi ti ṣe le ri iparun awọn ibatan mi?
entries.en: For how can I endure to see the evil that shall come unto my people? or how can I endure to see the destruction of my kindred?

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Ahaswerusi ọba wi fun Esteri ayaba, ati fun Mordekai ara Juda na pe, Sa wò o, emi ti fi ile Hamani fun Esteri; on ni nwọn si ti so rọ̀ lori igi, nitoripe o ti gbe ọwọ le awọn Ju.
entries.en: Then the king Ahasuerus said unto Esther the queen and to Mordecai the Jew, Behold, I have given Esther the house of Haman, and him they have hanged upon the gallows, because he laid his hand upon the Jews.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin kọwe ẹ̀wẹ li orukọ ọba, nitori awọn Ju bi ẹnyin ti fẹ́, ki ẹ si fi oruka ọba ṣe edidi rẹ̀: nitori iwe ti a ba fi orukọ ọba kọ, ti a ba si fi òruka ọba ṣe edidi, ẹnikan kò le yi i pada.
entries.en: Write ye also for the Jews, as it liketh you, in the king's name, and seal it with the king's ring: for the writing which is written in the king's name, and sealed with the king's ring, may no man reverse.

entries.yo: Nigbana li a si pè awọn akọwe ọba li akokò na ni oṣù kẹta, eyini ni oṣù Sifani, li ọjọ kẹtalelogun rẹ̀; a si kọ ọ gẹgẹ bi Mordekai ti paṣẹ si awọn Ju, ati si awọn bãlẹ, ati awọn onidajọ, ati olori awọn ìgberiko metadilãdoje, si olukulùku ìgberiko gẹgẹ bi ikọwe rẹ̀, ati si olukulùku enia gẹgẹ bi ède wọn ati si awọn Ju gẹgẹ bi ikọwe wọn, ati gẹgẹ bi ède wọn.
entries.en: Then were the king's scribes called at that time in the third month, that is, the month Sivan, on the three and twentieth day thereof; and it was written according to all that Mordecai commanded unto the Jews, and to the lieutenants, and the deputies and rulers of the provinces which are from India unto Ethiopia, an hundred twenty and seven provinces, unto every province according to the writing thereof, and unto every people after their language, and to the Jews according to their writing, and according to their language.

entries.yo: Orukọ Ahaswerusi ọba li a fi kọ ọ, a si fi oruka ọba ṣe edidi rẹ̀; o si fi iwe wọnni rán awọn ojiṣẹ lori ẹṣin, ti o gùn ẹṣin yiyara, ani ibãka, ọmọ awọn abo ẹṣin.
entries.en: And he wrote in the king Ahasuerus' name, and sealed it with the king's ring, and sent letters by posts on horseback, and riders on mules, camels, and young dromedaries:

entries.yo: Ninu eyiti ọba fi aṣẹ fun gbogbo awọn Ju, ti o wà ni ilu gbogbo, lati kó ara wọn jọ, ati lati duro gbà ẹmi ara wọn là, lati parun, lati pa, ati lati mu ki gbogbo agbara awọn enia, ati ìgberiko na, ti o ba fẹ kọlu wọn, pẹlu awọn ọmọ wẹwẹ ati awọn obinrin ki o ṣegbe; ki nwọn ki o si kó ìni wọn fun ara wọn,
entries.en: Wherein the king granted the Jews which were in every city to gather themselves together, and to stand for their life, to destroy, to slay, and to cause to perish, all the power of the people and province that would assault them, both little ones and women, and to take the spoil of them for a prey,

entries.yo: Li ọjọ kanṣoṣo ni gbogbo ìgberiko Ahaswerusi ọba, li ọjọ kẹtala, oṣù kejila ti iṣe oṣù Adari.
entries.en: Upon one day in all the provinces of king Ahasuerus, namely, upon the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, which is the month Adar.

entries.yo: Ọ̀ran inu iwe na ni lati paṣẹ ni gbogbo ìgberiko lati kede rẹ̀ fun gbogbo enia, ki awọn Ju ki o le mura de ọjọ na, lati gbẹsan ara wọn lara awọn ọta wọn.
entries.en: The copy of the writing for a commandment to be given in every province was published unto all people, and that the Jews should be ready against that day to avenge themselves on their enemies.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni awọn ojiṣẹ́ ti nwọn gun ẹṣin yiyara ati ibãka jade lọ, nitori aṣẹ ọba, nwọn yara, nwọn sare. A si pa aṣẹ yi ni Ṣuṣani ãfin.
entries.en: So the posts that rode upon mules and camels went out, being hastened and pressed on by the king's commandment. And the decree was given at Shushan the palace.

entries.yo: Mordekai si jade kuro niwaju ọba, ninu aṣọ ọba, alaro ati funfun, ati ade wura nla, ati ẹ̀wu okùn ọ̀gbọ kikuná, ati elese aluko; ayọ̀ ati inu didùn si wà ni ilu Ṣuṣani.
entries.en: And Mordecai went out from the presence of the king in royal apparel of blue and white, and with a great crown of gold, and with a garment of fine linen and purple: and the city of Shushan rejoiced and was glad.

entries.yo: Awọn Ju si ni imọlẹ, ati inu didùn, ati ayọ̀ ati ọlá.
entries.en: The Jews had light, and gladness, and joy, and honour.

entries.yo: Ati ni olukulùku ìgberiko, ati ni olukuluku ilu nibikibi ti ofin ọba, ati aṣẹ rẹ̀ ba de, awọn Ju ni ayọ̀ ati inu-didùn, àse, ati ọjọ rere. Ọ̀pọlọpọ awọn enia ilẹ na si di enia Juda; nitori ẹ̀ru awọn Ju ba wọn.
entries.en: And in every province, and in every city, whithersoever the king's commandment and his decree came, the Jews had joy and gladness, a feast and a good day. And many of the people of the land became Jews; for the fear of the Jews fell upon them.

entries.yo: Njẹ li oṣù kejila, eyini ni oṣù Adari, li ọjọ kẹtala rẹ̀, ti ofin ọba ati aṣẹ rẹ̀ sunmọle lati mu u ṣẹ, li ọjọ ti awọn ọta awọn Ju ti rò pe, awọn o bori wọn, (bi o tilẹ ti jẹ pe, ati yi i pada pe, ki awọn Ju ki o bori awọn ti o korira wọn;)
entries.en: Now in the twelfth month, that is, the month Adar, on the thirteenth day of the same, when the king's commandment and his decree drew near to be put in execution, in the day that the enemies of the Jews hoped to have power over them, (though it was turned to the contrary, that the Jews had rule over them that hated them;)

entries.yo: Awọn Ju kó ara wọn jọ ninu ilu wọn ninu gbogbo ìgberiko Ahaswerusi ọba, lati gbe ọwọ le iru awọn ti o nwá ifarapa wọn: ẹnikẹni kò si le kò wọn loju; nitori ẹ̀ru wọn bà gbogbo enia.
entries.en: The Jews gathered themselves together in their cities throughout all the provinces of the king Ahasuerus, to lay hand on such as sought their hurt: and no man could withstand them; for the fear of them fell upon all people.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn olori ìgberiko, ati awọn bãlẹ, ati awọn onidajọ, ati awọn ti nṣe iṣẹ ọba, ràn awọn Ju lọwọ, nitori ẹ̀ru Mordekai bà wọn.
entries.en: And all the rulers of the provinces, and the lieutenants, and the deputies, and officers of the king, helped the Jews; because the fear of Mordecai fell upon them.

entries.yo: Nitori Mordekai tobi ni ile ọba, okiki rẹ̀ si kàn ja gbogbo ìgberiko: nitori ọkunrin yi Mordekai ntobi siwaju ati siwaju.
entries.en: For Mordecai was great in the king's house, and his fame went out throughout all the provinces: for this man Mordecai waxed greater and greater.

entries.yo: Bayi ni awọn Ju a fi idà ṣá gbogbo awọn ọta wọn pa, ni pipa ati piparun, nwọn si ṣe awọn ọta ti o korira wọn bi nwọn ti fẹ.
entries.en: Thus the Jews smote all their enemies with the stroke of the sword, and slaughter, and destruction, and did what they would unto those that hated them.

entries.yo: Ati ni Ṣuṣani ãfin awọn Ju pa ẹ̃dẹgbẹta ọkunrin run.
entries.en: And in Shushan the palace the Jews slew and destroyed five hundred men.

entries.yo: Ati Farṣandata, ati Dalfoni, ati Aspata,
entries.en: And Parshandatha, and Dalphon, and Aspatha,

entries.yo: Ati Porata, ati Adalia, ati Aridata,
entries.en: And Poratha, and Adalia, and Aridatha,

entries.yo: Ati Farmaṣta, ati Arisai, ati Aridai, ati Faisata,
entries.en: And Parmashta, and Arisai, and Aridai, and Vajezatha,

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Hamani, ọmọ Medata, mẹwẹwa, ọta awọn Ju ni nwọn pa; ṣugbọn nwọn kò fi ọwọ kàn nkan wọn.
entries.en: The ten sons of Haman the son of Hammedatha, the enemy of the Jews, slew they; but on the spoil laid they not their hand.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ na a mu iye awọn ti a pa ni Ṣuṣani ãfin wá siwaju ọba.
entries.en: On that day the number of those that were slain in Shushan the palace was brought before the king.

entries.yo: Ọba si wi fun Esteri ayaba pe, Awọn Ju pa, nwọn si ti pa ẹ̃dẹgbẹta enia run ni Ṣuṣani ãfin, ati awọn ọmọ Hamani mẹwẹwa: kini nwọn ha ṣe ni gbogbo ìgberiko ọba iyokù? nisisiyi kini ẹbẹ rẹ? a o si fi fun ọ tabi kini iwọ o si tun bère si i? a o si ṣe e.
entries.en: And the king said unto Esther the queen, The Jews have slain and destroyed five hundred men in Shushan the palace, and the ten sons of Haman; what have they done in the rest of the king's provinces? now what is thy petition? and it shall be granted thee: or what is thy request further? and it shall be done.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Esteri wipe, Bi o ba wù ọba, jẹ ki a fi aṣẹ fun awọn Ju ti o wà ni Ṣuṣani ki nwọn ki o ṣe li ọ̀la pẹlu gẹgẹ bi aṣẹ ti oni, ki a si so awọn ọmọ Hamani mẹwẹwa rọ̀ lori igi.
entries.en: Then said Esther, If it please the king, let it be granted to the Jews which are in Shushan to do tomorrow also according unto this day's decree, and let Haman's ten sons be hanged upon the gallows.

entries.yo: Ọba si paṣẹ pe, ki a ṣe bẹ̃; a si pa aṣẹ na ni Ṣuṣani; a si so awọn ọmọ Hamani mẹwẹwa rọ̀.
entries.en: And the king commanded it so to be done: and the decree was given at Shushan; and they hanged Haman's ten sons.

entries.yo: Nitorina awọn Ju ti o wà ni Ṣuṣani kó ara wọn jọ li ọjọ kẹrinla oṣù Adari pẹlu, nwọn si pa ọ̃durun ọkunrin ni Ṣuṣani; ṣugbọn nwọn kò fi ọwọ kàn nkan wọn.
entries.en: For the Jews that were in Shushan gathered themselves together on the fourteenth day also of the month Adar, and slew three hundred men at Shushan; but on the prey they laid not their hand.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn Ju miran, ti o wà ni ìgberiko ọba, kó ara wọn jọ, nwọn dide duro lati gbà ẹmi ara wọn là, nwọn si simi kuro lọwọ awọn ọta wọn, nwọn si pa ẹgbã mẹtadilogoji enia o le ẹgbẹrin ninu awọn ọta wọn, ṣugbọn nwọn kò fi ọwọ kan nkan wọn.
entries.en: But the other Jews that were in the king's provinces gathered themselves together, and stood for their lives, and had rest from their enemies, and slew of their foes seventy and five thousand, but they laid not their hands on the prey,

entries.yo: Li ọjọ kẹtala oṣù Adari, ati li ọjọ kẹrinla rẹ̀ ni nwọn simi, nwọn si ṣe e li ọjọ àse ati ayọ̀.
entries.en: On the thirteenth day of the month Adar; and on the fourteenth day of the same rested they, and made it a day of feasting and gladness.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn Ju ti mbẹ ni Ṣuṣani kó ara wọn jọ li ọjọ kẹtala rẹ̀, ati li ọjọ kẹrinla rẹ̀; ati li ọjọ kẹ̃dogun rẹ̀ nwọn simi, nwọn si ṣe e li ọjọ àse ati inu didùn.
entries.en: But the Jews that were at Shushan assembled together on the thirteenth day thereof; and on the fourteenth thereof; and on the fifteenth day of the same they rested, and made it a day of feasting and gladness.

entries.yo: Nitorina awọn Ju ti o wà ni iletò wọnni, ti nwọn ngbe ilu ti kò li odi, nwọn ṣe ọjọ kẹrinla oṣù Adari li ọjọ inu-didùn, ati àse, ati ọjọ rere, ati ọjọ ti olukulùku nfi ipin onjẹ ranṣẹ si ẹnikeji rẹ̀.
entries.en: Therefore the Jews of the villages, that dwelt in the unwalled towns, made the fourteenth day of the month Adar a day of gladness and feasting, and a good day, and of sending portions one to another.

entries.yo: Mordekai si kọwe nkan wọnyi, o si fi iwe ranṣẹ si gbogbo awọn Ju ti o wà ni gbogbo ìgberiko Ahaswerusi ọba, si awọn ti o sunmọ etile, ati awọn ti o jina.
entries.en: And Mordecai wrote these things, and sent letters unto all the Jews that were in all the provinces of the king Ahasuerus, both nigh and far,

entries.yo: Lati fi eyi lelẹ larin wọn, ki nwọn ki o le ma pa ọjọ kẹrinla oṣù Adari, ati ọjọ kẹ̃dogun rẹ̀ mọ́ li ọdọdun.
entries.en: To stablish this among them, that they should keep the fourteenth day of the month Adar, and the fifteenth day of the same, yearly,

entries.yo: Bi ọjọ lọwọ eyiti awọn Ju simi kuro ninu awọn ọta wọn, ati oṣù ti a sọ ibanujẹ wọn di ayọ̀, ati ọjọ ọ̀fọ di ọjọ rere; ki nwọn ki o le sọ wọn di ọjọ àse, ati ayọ̀, ati ọjọ ti olukuluku nfi ipin onjẹ ranṣẹ si ẹnikeji rẹ̀, ati ẹbun fun awọn talaka.
entries.en: As the days wherein the Jews rested from their enemies, and the month which was turned unto them from sorrow to joy, and from mourning into a good day: that they should make them days of feasting and joy, and of sending portions one to another, and gifts to the poor.

entries.yo: Awọn Ju si gbà lati ṣe bi nwọn ti bẹ̀rẹ si iṣe, ati bi Mordekai si ti kọwe si wọn.
entries.en: And the Jews undertook to do as they had begun, and as Mordecai had written unto them;

entries.yo: Pe, Hamani ọmọ Medata, ara Agagi nì, ọta gbogbo awọn Ju ti gbiro lati pa awọn Ju run, o si ti da Puri, eyinì ni ibo, lati pa wọn, ati lati run wọn;
entries.en: Because Haman the son of Hammedatha, the Agagite, the enemy of all the Jews, had devised against the Jews to destroy them, and had cast Pur, that is, the lot, to consume them, and to destroy them;

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati Esteri tọ̀ ọba wá, o fi iwe paṣẹ pe, ki ete buburu ti a ti pa si awọn Ju ki o le pada si ori on tikalarẹ̀, ati ki a so ati on ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ rọ̀ sori igi.
entries.en: But when Esther came before the king, he commanded by letters that his wicked device, which he devised against the Jews, should return upon his own head, and that he and his sons should be hanged on the gallows.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni nwọn ṣe npè ọjọ wọnni ni Purimu bi orukọ Puri. Nitorina gẹgẹ bi gbogbo ọ̀rọ inu iwe yi, ati nitori gbogbo eyi ti oju wọn ti ri nitori ọ̀ran yi, ati eyiti o ti ba wọn,
entries.en: Wherefore they called these days Purim after the name of Pur. Therefore for all the words of this letter, and of that which they had seen concerning this matter, and which had come unto them,

entries.yo: Awọn Ju lanà rẹ̀, nwọn si gbà a kanri wọn, ati fun iru-ọmọ wọn, ati fun gbogbo awọn ti o dà ara wọn pọ̀ mọ wọn, pe ki o máṣe yẹ̀, ki nwọn ki o ma pa ọjọ mejeji wọnyi mọ́ gẹgẹ bi ikọwe wọn, ati gẹgẹ bi akokò wọn ti a yàn lọdọdun.
entries.en: The Jews ordained, and took upon them, and upon their seed, and upon all such as joined themselves unto them, so as it should not fail, that they would keep these two days according to their writing, and according to their appointed time every year;

entries.yo: Ati pe, ki nwọn ma ranti ọjọ wọnyi, ki nwọn si ma kiyesi i ni irandiran wọn gbogbo; olukuluku idile, olukuluku ìgberiko, ati olukuluku ilu; ati pe, ki Purimu wọnyi ki o máṣe yẹ̀ larin awọn Ju, tabi ki iranti wọn ki o máṣe parun ninu iru-ọmọ wọn.
entries.en: And that these days should be remembered and kept throughout every generation, every family, every province, and every city; and that these days of Purim should not fail from among the Jews, nor the memorial of them perish from their seed.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Esteri ayaba, ọmọbinrin Abihaili, ati Mordekai, ara Juda, fi ọlá gbogbo kọwe, lati fi idi iwe keji ti Purimu yi mulẹ.
entries.en: Then Esther the queen, the daughter of Abihail, and Mordecai the Jew, wrote with all authority, to confirm this second letter of Purim.

entries.yo: O si fi iwe ranṣẹ si gbogbo awọn Ju, si ẹtadilãdoje ìgberiko ijọba Ahaswerusi, ọ̀rọ alafia ati otitọ.
entries.en: And he sent the letters unto all the Jews, to the hundred twenty and seven provinces of the kingdom of Ahasuerus, with words of peace and truth,

entries.yo: Lati fi idi ọjọ Purimu wọnyi mulẹ, li akokò wọn ti a yàn gẹgẹ bi Mordekai, ara Juda, ati Esteri ayaba ti paṣẹ fun wọn, ati bi nwọn ti pinnu rẹ̀ fun ara wọn, ati fun iru-ọmọ wọn, ọ̀ran ãwẹ ati ẹkún wọn.
entries.en: To confirm these days of Purim in their times appointed, according as Mordecai the Jew and Esther the queen had enjoined them, and as they had decreed for themselves and for their seed, the matters of the fastings and their cry.

entries.yo: Aṣẹ Esteri si fi idi ọ̀ran Purimu yi mulẹ; a si kọ ọ sinu iwe.
entries.en: And the decree of Esther confirmed these matters of Purim; and it was written in the book.

entries.yo: AHASWERUSI ọba si fi owo ọba le ilẹ fun gbogbo ilẹ, ati gbogbo erekùṣu okun.
entries.en: And the king Ahasuerus laid a tribute upon the land, and upon the isles of the sea.

entries.yo: Ati gbogbo iṣe agbara rẹ̀, ati ti ipa rẹ̀, ati ìrohin titobi Mordekai, bi ọba ti sọ ọ di nla, a kò ha kọ wọn sinu iwe ọ̀rọ ọjọ awọn ọba Media ati Persia?
entries.en: And all the acts of his power and of his might, and the declaration of the greatness of Mordecai, whereunto the king advanced him, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Media and Persia?

entries.yo: Nitori Mordekai ara Juda li o ṣe igbakeji Ahaswerusi ọba, o si tobi ninu awọn Ju, o si ṣe itẹwọgbà lọdọ ọ̀pọlọpọ ninu awọn arakunrin rẹ̀, o nwá ire awọn enia rẹ̀, o si nsọ̀rọ alafia fun gbogbo awọn iru-ọmọ rẹ̀
entries.en: For Mordecai the Jew was next unto king Ahasuerus, and great among the Jews, and accepted of the multitude of his brethren, seeking the wealth of his people, and speaking peace to all his seed.

entries.yo: ỌKUNRIN kan wà ni ilẹ Usi, orukọ ẹniti ijẹ Jobu; ọkunrin na si ṣe olõtọ, o duro ṣinṣin, ẹniti o si bẹ̀ru Ọlọrun, ti o si korira ìwa buburu.
entries.en: There was a man in the land of Uz, whose name was Job; and that man was perfect and upright, and one that feared God, and eschewed evil.

entries.yo: A si bi ọmọkunrin meje ati ọmọbinrin mẹta fun u.
entries.en: And there were born unto him seven sons and three daughters.

entries.yo: Ohunọ̀sin rẹ̀ si jẹ ẹdẹgbarin agutan, ati ẹgbẹdogun ibakasiẹ, ati ẹdẹgbẹta ajaga ọdámalu, ati ẹdẹgbẹta abokẹtẹkẹtẹ, o si pọ̀; bẹ̃li ọkunrin yi si pọ̀ jù gbogbo awọn ọmọ ara ila-õrun lọ.
entries.en: His substance also was seven thousand sheep, and three thousand camels, and five hundred yoke of oxen, and five hundred she asses, and a very great household; so that this man was the greatest of all the men of the east.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ a si ma lọ ijẹun àse ninu ile ara wọn, olukuluku li ọjọ rẹ̀; nwọn a si ma ranṣẹ pe arabinrin wọn mẹtẹta lati jẹun ati lati mu pẹlu wọn.
entries.en: And his sons went and feasted in their houses, every one his day; and sent and called for their three sisters to eat and to drink with them.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati ọjọ àse wọn pé yika, ni Jobu ranṣẹ lọ iyà wọn si mimọ, o si dide ni kùtukutu owurọ, o si rú ẹbọ sisun niwọn iye gbogbo wọn; nitoriti Jobu wipe: bọya awọn ọmọ mi ti ṣẹ̀, nwọn kò si ṣọpẹ́ fun Ọlọrun lọkàn wọn. Bẹ̃ni Jobu imaṣe nigbagbogbo.
entries.en: And it was so, when the days of their feasting were gone about, that Job sent and sanctified them, and rose up early in the morning, and offered burnt offerings according to the number of them all: for Job said, It may be that my sons have sinned, and cursed God in their hearts. Thus did Job continually.

entries.yo: Njẹ, o di ọjọ kan, nigbati awọn ọmọ Ọlọrun wá ipé niwaju Oluwa, Satani si wá pẹlu wọn.
entries.en: Now there was a day when the sons of God came to present themselves before the LORD, and Satan came also among them.

entries.yo: Oluwa si bi Satani wipe: nibo ni iwọ ti wá? nigbana ni Satani da Oluwa lohùn wipe: ni ilọ siwá sẹhin lori ilẹ aiye, ati ni irinkerindo ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Satan, Whence comest thou? Then Satan answered the LORD, and said, From going to and fro in the earth, and from walking up and down in it.

entries.yo: Oluwa si sọ fun Satani pe, Iwọ ha kiyesi Jobu iranṣẹ mi, pe, kò si ekeji rẹ̀ li aiye, ọkunrin ti iṣe olõtọ, ti o si duro ṣinṣin, ẹniti o bẹ̀ru Ọlọrun, ti o si korira ìwa buburu.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Satan, Hast thou considered my servant Job, that there is none like him in the earth, a perfect and an upright man, one that feareth God, and escheweth evil?

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Satani dá Oluwa lohùn wipe: Jobu ha bẹ̀ru Oluwa li asan bi?
entries.en: Then Satan answered the LORD, and said, Doth Job fear God for nought?

entries.yo: Iwọ kò ha ti sọgbà yi i ká, ati yi ile rẹ̀ ati yi ohun ti o ni ká ni iha gbogbo? Iwọ busi iṣẹ ọwọ rẹ̀, ohunọ̀sin rẹ̀ si npọsi i ni ilẹ.
entries.en: Hast not thou made an hedge about him, and about his house, and about all that he hath on every side? thou hast blessed the work of his hands, and his substance is increased in the land.

entries.yo: Njẹ nawọ rẹ nisisiyi, ki o si fi tọ́ ohun gbogbo ti o ni; bi kì yio si bọhùn li oju rẹ.
entries.en: But put forth thine hand now, and touch all that he hath, and he will curse thee to thy face.

entries.yo: Oluwa si dá Satani lohùn wipe: kiyesi i, ohun gbogbo ti o ni mbẹ ni ikawọ rẹ, kìki on tikara rẹ̀ ni iwọ kò gbọdọ̀ fi ọwọ rẹ kàn: bẹ̃ni Satani jade lọ kuro niwaju Oluwa.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Satan, Behold, all that he hath is in thy power; only upon himself put not forth thine hand. So Satan went forth from the presence of the LORD.

entries.yo: O si di ọjọ kan, nigbati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ ọkunrin ati obinrin njẹ, ti nwọn nmu ọti-waini ninu ile ẹgbọn wọn ọkunrin:
entries.en: And there was a day when his sons and his daughters were eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother's house:

entries.yo: Onṣẹ kan si tọ̀ Jobu wá wipe: awọn ọda-malu ntulẹ, awọn kẹtẹkẹtẹ si njẹ li ẹba wọn;
entries.en: And there came a messenger unto Job, and said, The oxen were plowing, and the asses feeding beside them:

entries.yo: Awọn ara Saba si kọlu wọn, nwọn si nkó wọn lọ, pẹlupẹlu nwọn ti fi idà ṣá awọn iranṣẹ pa, emi nikanṣoṣo li o sa asalà lati ròhin fun ọ.
entries.en: And the Sabeans fell upon them, and took them away; yea, they have slain the servants with the edge of the sword; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.

entries.yo: Bi o ti nsọ li ẹnu; ẹnikan de pẹlu ti o si wipe: iná nla Ọlọrun ti ọrun bọ́ si ilẹ, o si jó awọn agutan ati awọn iranṣẹ ni ajorun; emi nikanṣoṣo li o salà lati rohin fun ọ.
entries.en: While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and said, The fire of God is fallen from heaven, and hath burned up the sheep, and the servants, and consumed them; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.

entries.yo: Bi o si ti nsọ li ẹnu, ẹnikan si de pẹlu ti o wipe: awọn ara Kaldea pingun si ọ̀na mẹta, nwọn si kọlu awọn ibakasiẹ, nwọn si kó wọn lọ, pẹlupẹlu nwọn si fi idà ṣá awọn iranṣẹ pa; emi nikanṣoṣo li o sa asalà lati rohin fun ọ.
entries.en: While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and said, The Chaldeans made out three bands, and fell upon the camels, and have carried them away, yea, and slain the servants with the edge of the sword; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.

entries.yo: Bi o ti nsọ li ẹnu, ẹnikan de pẹlu ti o si wipe: awọn ọmọ rẹ ọkunrin ati ọmọ rẹ obinrin njẹ nwọn nmu ọti-waini ninu ile ẹgbọn wọn ọkunrin.
entries.en: While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and said, Thy sons and thy daughters were eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother's house:

entries.yo: Si kiyesi i, ẹfufu nlanla ti iha ijù fẹ wá ikọlu igun mẹrẹrin ile, o si wolù awọn ọdọmọkunrin na, nwọn si kú, emi nikanṣoṣo li o yọ lati rohin fun ọ.
entries.en: And, behold, there came a great wind from the wilderness, and smote the four corners of the house, and it fell upon the young men, and they are dead; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Jobu dide, o si fa aṣọ igunwa rẹ̀ ya, o si fari rẹ̀, o wolẹ, o si gbadura.
entries.en: Then Job arose, and rent his mantle, and shaved his head, and fell down upon the ground, and worshipped,

entries.yo: Wipe, Nihoho ni mo ti inu iya mi jade wá, nihoho ni emi o si tun pada lọ sibẹ: Oluwa fifunni Oluwa si gbà lọ, ibukun li orukọ Oluwa.
entries.en: And said, Naked came I out of my mother's womb, and naked shall I return thither: the LORD gave, and the LORD hath taken away; blessed be the name of the LORD.

entries.yo: Ninu gbogbo eyi Jobu kò ṣẹ̀, bẹ̃ni kò si fi were pè Ọlọrun lẹjọ.
entries.en: In all this Job sinned not, nor charged God foolishly.

entries.yo: O si tun di ijọ kan nigbati awọn ọmọ Ọlọrun wá ipé niwaju Oluwa, Satani si wá pẹlu wọn, lati pé niwaju Oluwa.
entries.en: Again there was a day when the sons of God came to present themselves before the LORD, and Satan came also among them to present himself before the LORD.

entries.yo: Oluwa si bi Satani pe, nibo ni iwọ ti wá? Satani si dá Oluwa lohùn pe, lati ilọ siwá sẹhin lori ilẹ aiye ati ni irinkerindo ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Satan, From whence comest thou? And Satan answered the LORD, and said, From going to and fro in the earth, and from walking up and down in it.

entries.yo: Oluwa si wi fun Satani pe, iwọ ha kiyesi Jobu iranṣẹ mi, pe, kò si ekeji rẹ̀ li aiye, ọkunrin ti iṣe olõtọ ti o si duro ṣinṣin, ẹniti o bẹ̀ru Ọlọrun ti o si korira ìwa buburu, bẹ̃li o si di ìwa otitọ rẹ̀ mu ṣinṣin, bi iwọ tilẹ ti dẹ mi si i lati run u lainidi.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Satan, Hast thou considered my servant Job, that there is none like him in the earth, a perfect and an upright man, one that feareth God, and escheweth evil? and still he holdeth fast his integrity, although thou movedst me against him, to destroy him without cause.

entries.yo: Satani si dá Oluwa lohùn wipe, awọ fun awọ; ani ohun gbogbo ti enia ni, on ni yio fi rà ẹmi rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Satan answered the LORD, and said, Skin for skin, yea, all that a man hath will he give for his life.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nawọ rẹ nisisiyi, ki o si fi tọ́ egungun rẹ̀ ati ara rẹ̀, bi kì yio si bọhùn li oju rẹ.
entries.en: But put forth thine hand now, and touch his bone and his flesh, and he will curse thee to thy face.

entries.yo: Oluwa si wi fun Satani pe, Wõ, o mbẹ ni ikawọ rẹ, ṣugbọn dá ẹmi rẹ̀ si.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Satan, Behold, he is in thine hand; but save his life.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Satani jade lọ kuro niwaju Oluwa, o si sọ Jobu li õwo kikankikan lati atẹlẹsẹ rẹ̀ lọ de atari rẹ̀.
entries.en: So went Satan forth from the presence of the LORD, and smote Job with sore boils from the sole of his foot unto his crown.

entries.yo: O si mu apadì o fi nhá ara rẹ̀, o si joko ninu ẽru.
entries.en: And he took him a potsherd to scrape himself withal; and he sat down among the ashes.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni aya rẹ̀ wi fun u pe, iwọ di ìwa otitọ rẹ mu sibẹ! bu Ọlọrun, ki o si kú.
entries.en: Then said his wife unto him, Dost thou still retain thine integrity? curse God, and die.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn on da a lohùn pe, iwọ sọ̀rọ bi ọkan ninu awọn obinrin alaimoye ti isọ̀rọ; kinla! awa o ha gba ire lọwọ Ọlọrun, ki a má si gba ibi! Ninu gbogbo eyi Jobu kò fi ète rẹ̀ ṣẹ̀.
entries.en: But he said unto her, Thou speakest as one of the foolish women speaketh. What? shall we receive good at the hand of God, and shall we not receive evil? In all this did not Job sin with his lips.

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn ọrẹ Jobu mẹta gburo gbogbo ibi ti o ba a, nwọn wá, olukuluku lati ibujoko rẹ̀ wá; Elifasi, ara Tema, a si Bildadi, ara Ṣua, ati Sofari, ara Naama: nitoripe nwọn ti dajọ ipade pọ̀ lati ba a ṣọ̀fọ on ati ṣipẹ fun u.
entries.en: Now when Job's three friends heard of all this evil that was come upon him, they came every one from his own place; Eliphaz the Temanite, and Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite: for they had made an appointment together to come to mourn with him and to comfort him.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si gboju wọn wò li òkere rére, ti nwọn kò si mọ̀ ọ, nwọn gbe ohùn wọn soke, nwọn sọkun: olukuluku si fa aṣọ igunwa rẹ̀ ya, nwọn si kù erupẹ si oju ọrun si ara wọn lori.
entries.en: And when they lifted up their eyes afar off, and knew him not, they lifted up their voice, and wept; and they rent every one his mantle, and sprinkled dust upon their heads toward heaven.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni nwọn joko tì i ni ilẹyilẹ ni ijọ meje ti ọ̀san ti oru, ẹnikẹni kò si ba a dá ọ̀rọ kan sọ nitoriti nwọn ri pe, ibinujẹ rẹ̀ pọ̀ gidigidi.
entries.en: So they sat down with him upon the ground seven days and seven nights, and none spake a word unto him: for they saw that his grief was very great.

entries.yo: LẸHIN eyi ni Jobu yanu o si fi ọjọ ibi rẹ̀ ré.
entries.en: After this opened Job his mouth, and cursed his day.

entries.yo: Jobu sọ, o si wipe,
entries.en: And Job spake, and said,

entries.yo: Ki ọjọ ti a bi mi ki o di igbagbe, ati oru nì, ninu eyi ti a wipe; a loyun ọmọkunrin kan.
entries.en: Let the day perish wherein I was born, and the night in which it was said, There is a man child conceived.

entries.yo: Ki ọjọ na ki o jasi òkunkun, ki Ọlọrun ki o má ṣe kà a si lati ọrun wá, bẹ̃ni ki imọlẹ ki o máṣe mọ́ si i.
entries.en: Let that day be darkness; let not God regard it from above, neither let the light shine upon it.

entries.yo: Ki òkunkun ati ojiji ikú fi ṣe ti ara wọn: ki awọsanma ki o bà le e, ki iṣúdùdu ọjọ na ki o pa a laiya.
entries.en: Let darkness and the shadow of death stain it; let a cloud dwell upon it; let the blackness of the day terrify it.

entries.yo: Ki òkunkun ki o ṣúbo oru na biribiri, ki o má ṣe yọ̀ pẹlu ọjọ ọdun na: ki a má ṣe kà a mọ iye ọjọ oṣù.
entries.en: As for that night, let darkness seize upon it; let it not be joined unto the days of the year, let it not come into the number of the months.

entries.yo: Ki oru na ki o yàgan; ki ohùn ayọ̀ kan ki o má ṣe wọnu rẹ̀ lọ.
entries.en: Lo, let that night be solitary, let no joyful voice come therein.

entries.yo: Ki awọn ti ifi ọjọ gegun ki o fi i gegun, ti nwọn muratan lati rú Lefiatani soke.
entries.en: Let them curse it that curse the day, who are ready to raise up their mourning.

entries.yo: Ki irawọ̀ ofẽfe ọjọ rẹ̀ ki o ṣokùnkun; ki o ma wá imọlẹ, ṣugbọn ki o má si, bẹ̃ni ki o má ṣe ri afẹmọjumọ́.
entries.en: Let the stars of the twilight thereof be dark; let it look for light, but have none; neither let it see the dawning of the day:

entries.yo: Nitoriti kò se ilẹkun inu iya mi, bẹ̃ni kó si pa ibinujẹ mọ́ kuro li oju mi.
entries.en: Because it shut not up the doors of my mother's womb, nor hid sorrow from mine eyes.

entries.yo: Ẽṣe ti emi kò fi kú lati inu wá, tabi ti emi kò fi pin ẹmi nigbati mo ti inu jade wá?
entries.en: Why died I not from the womb? why did I not give up the ghost when I came out of the belly?

entries.yo: Ẽṣe ti ẽkun wá pade mi, tabi ọmu ti emi o mu?
entries.en: Why did the knees prevent me? or why the breasts that I should suck?

entries.yo: Njẹ! nisisiyi, emi iba ti dubulẹ̀ jẹ, emi a si dakẹ, emi iba ti sùn: njẹ emi iba ti simi!
entries.en: For now should I have lain still and been quiet, I should have slept: then had I been at rest,

entries.yo: Pẹlu awọn ọba ati igbimọ aiye, ti o mọle takete fun ara wọn.
entries.en: With kings and counsellers of the earth, which built desolate places for themselves;

entries.yo: Tabi pẹlu awọn ọmọ-alade ti o ni wura, ti nwọn si fi fadakà kún inu ile wọn.
entries.en: Or with princes that had gold, who filled their houses with silver:

entries.yo: Tabi bi ọlẹ̀ ti a sin, emi kì ba ti si; bi ọmọ iṣẹnu ti kò ri imọlẹ.
entries.en: Or as an hidden untimely birth I had not been; as infants which never saw light.

entries.yo: Nibẹ ni ẹni-buburu ṣiwọ iyọnilẹnu, nibẹ ẹni-ãrẹ̀ wà ninu isimi.
entries.en: There the wicked cease from troubling; and there the weary be at rest.

entries.yo: Nibẹ ni awọn ìgbekun simi pọ̀, nwọn kò si gbohùn amunisìn mọ́.
entries.en: There the prisoners rest together; they hear not the voice of the oppressor.

entries.yo: Ati ewe ati àgba wà nibẹ, ẹru si di omnira kuro lọwọ olowo rẹ̀.
entries.en: The small and great are there; and the servant is free from his master.

entries.yo: Nitori kili a ṣe fi imọlẹ fun otoṣi, ati ìye fun ọlọkàn kikoro.
entries.en: Wherefore is light given to him that is in misery, and life unto the bitter in soul;

entries.yo: Ti nwọn duro de ikú, ṣugbọn on kò wá, ti nwọn wàlẹ wá a jù fun iṣura ti a bò mọlẹ pamọ.
entries.en: Which long for death, but it cometh not; and dig for it more than for hid treasures;

entries.yo: Ẹniti o yọ̀ gidigidi, ti inu wọn si dùn nigbati nwọn ba le wá isa-okú ri.
entries.en: Which rejoice exceedingly, and are glad, when they can find the grave?

entries.yo: Kili a fi imọlẹ fun ẹniti ọ̀na rẹ̀ lumọ si, ti Ọlọrun si sọgba di mọ ká?
entries.en: Why is light given to a man whose way is hid, and whom God hath hedged in?

entries.yo: Nitoripe imi-ẹ̀dun mi ṣaju ki nto jẹun, ikerora mi si tú jade bi omi.
entries.en: For my sighing cometh before I eat, and my roarings are poured out like the waters.

entries.yo: Nitoripe ohún na ti mo bẹ̀ru gidigidi li o de ba mi yi, ẹ̀ru ohun ti mo bà li o si de si mi yi.
entries.en: For the thing which I greatly feared is come upon me, and that which I was afraid of is come unto me.

entries.yo: Emi kò wà lailewu rí, bẹ̃li emi kò ni isimi, bẹ̃li emi kò ni ìfaiyabalẹ, asiwá-asibọ̀ iyọnu de.
entries.en: I was not in safety, neither had I rest, neither was I quiet; yet trouble came.

entries.yo: NIGBANA ni Elifasi, ara Tema, dahùn wipe,
entries.en: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,

entries.yo: Bi awa ba fi ẹnu le e, lati ba ọ sọrọ, iwọ o ha binujẹ? ṣugbọn tali o le pa ọ̀rọ mọ ẹnu laisọ?
