entries.en: If we assay to commune with thee, wilt thou be grieved? but who can withhold himself from speaking?

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, iwọ sa ti kọ́ ọ̀pọ enia, iwọ sa ti mu ọwọ alailera le.
entries.en: Behold, thou hast instructed many, and thou hast strengthened the weak hands.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ rẹ ti gbe awọn ti nṣubu lọ duro, iwọ si ti mu ẽkun awọn ti nwarirì lera.
entries.en: Thy words have upholden him that was falling, and thou hast strengthened the feeble knees.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nisisiyi o de ba ọ, o si rẹ̀ ọ, o kọlu ọ, ara rẹ kò lelẹ̀.
entries.en: But now it is come upon thee, and thou faintest; it toucheth thee, and thou art troubled.

entries.yo: Ibẹru Ọlọrun rẹ kò ha jẹ igbẹkẹle rẹ? ati iduro ṣinṣin si ìwa ọ̀na rẹ kò ha si jẹ abá rẹ?
entries.en: Is not this thy fear, thy confidence, thy hope, and the uprightness of thy ways?

entries.yo: Emi bẹ̀ ọ ranti, tali o ṣegbe ri laiṣẹ̀, tabi nibo li a gbe ké olododo kuro ri?
entries.en: Remember, I pray thee, who ever perished, being innocent? or where were the righteous cut off?

entries.yo: Ani bi emi ti ri rí pe: awọn ti nṣe itulẹ ẹ̀ṣẹ, ti nwọn si fọ́n irugbin ìwa buburu, nwọn a si ká eso rẹ̀ na.
entries.en: Even as I have seen, they that plow iniquity, and sow wickedness, reap the same.

entries.yo: Nipa ifẹsi Ọlọrun nwọn a ṣegbe, nipa ẽmi ibinu rẹ̀ nwọn a parun.
entries.en: By the blast of God they perish, and by the breath of his nostrils are they consumed.

entries.yo: Bibu ramuramu kiniun ati ohùn onroró kiniun ati ehin awọn ẹ̀gbọrọ kiniun li a ka.
entries.en: The roaring of the lion, and the voice of the fierce lion, and the teeth of the young lions, are broken.

entries.yo: Ogbo kiniun kígbe, nitori airi ohun-ọdẹ, awọn ẹ̀gbọrọ kiniun sisanra li a tukakiri.
entries.en: The old lion perisheth for lack of prey, and the stout lion's whelps are scattered abroad.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi a fi ohun lilumọ́ kan hàn fun mi, eti mi si gbà diẹ ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: Now a thing was secretly brought to me, and mine ear received a little thereof.

entries.yo: Ni iro inu loju iran oru, nigbati orun ìjika kun enia.
entries.en: In thoughts from the visions of the night, when deep sleep falleth on men,

entries.yo: Ẹ̀ru bà mi ati iwarirì ti o mu gbogbo egungun mi wá pepé.
entries.en: Fear came upon me, and trembling, which made all my bones to shake.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni iwin kan kọja lọ niwaju mi, irun ara mi dide ró ṣanṣan.
entries.en: Then a spirit passed before my face; the hair of my flesh stood up:

entries.yo: On duro jẹ, ṣugbọn emi kò le iwò apẹrẹ irí rẹ̀, àworan kan hàn niwaju mi, idakẹ rọrọ wà, mo si gbohùn kan wipe:
entries.en: It stood still, but I could not discern the form thereof: an image was before mine eyes, there was silence, and I heard a voice, saying,

entries.yo: Ẹni kikú le jẹ olododo niwaju Ọlọrun, enia ha le mọ́ ju Ẹlẹda rẹ̀ bi?
entries.en: Shall mortal man be more just than God? shall a man be more pure than his maker?

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, on kò gbẹkẹle awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀, ninu awọn angeli rẹ̀ ni o si ri ẹ̀ṣẹ.
entries.en: Behold, he put no trust in his servants; and his angels he charged with folly:

entries.yo: Ambọtori awọn ti ngbe inu ile amọ̀, ẹniti ipilẹ wọn jasi erupẹ ti yio di rirun kòkoro.
entries.en: How much less in them that dwell in houses of clay, whose foundation is in the dust, which are crushed before the moth?

entries.yo: A npa wọn run lati òwurọ di alẹ́, nwọn gbe lailai lairi ẹni kà a si.
entries.en: They are destroyed from morning to evening: they perish for ever without any regarding it.

entries.yo: A kò ha ke okùn iye wọn kuro bi? nwọn ku, ani lailọgbọn.
entries.en: Doth not their excellency which is in them go away? they die, even without wisdom.

entries.yo: NJẸ pè nisisiyi! bi ẹnikan ba wà ti yio da ọ lohùn, tabi tani ninu awọn ẹni-mimọ́ ti iwọ o wò?
entries.en: Call now, if there be any that will answer thee; and to which of the saints wilt thou turn?

entries.yo: Nitoripe ibinu pa alaimoye, irúnu a si pa òpe enia.
entries.en: For wrath killeth the foolish man, and envy slayeth the silly one.

entries.yo: Emi ti ri alaimoye ti o ta gbongbò mulẹ̀, ṣugbọn lojukanna mo fi ibujoko rẹ̀ bú.
entries.en: I have seen the foolish taking root: but suddenly I cursed his habitation.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ kò jina sinu ewu, a si tẹ̀ wọn mọlẹ loju ibode, bẹ̃ni kò si alãbò kan.
entries.en: His children are far from safety, and they are crushed in the gate, neither is there any to deliver them.

entries.yo: Ikore oko ẹniti awọn ẹniti ebi npa jẹrun, ti nwọn si wọnú ẹ̀gun lọ ikó, awọn igara si gbe ohùn ini wọn mì.
entries.en: Whose harvest the hungry eateth up, and taketh it even out of the thorns, and the robber swalloweth up their substance.

entries.yo: Bi ipọnju kò tilẹ̀ tinu erupẹ jade wá nì, ti iyọnu kò si tinu ilẹ hù jade wá.
entries.en: Although affliction cometh not forth of the dust, neither doth trouble spring out of the ground;

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn a bi enia sinu wàhala, gẹgẹ bi ìpẹpẹ iná ti ima ta sokè.
entries.en: Yet man is born unto trouble, as the sparks fly upward.

entries.yo: Sọdọ Ọlọrun li emi lè ma ṣe awári, li ọwọ Ọlọrun li emi lè ma fi ọ̀ran mi le.
entries.en: I would seek unto God, and unto God would I commit my cause:

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ṣe ohun ti o tobi, ti a kò lè iṣe awári, ohun iyanu laini iye.
entries.en: Which doeth great things and unsearchable; marvellous things without number:

entries.yo: Ti nrọ̀jo si ilẹ aiye, ti o si nrán omi sinu ilẹ̀kilẹ.
entries.en: Who giveth rain upon the earth, and sendeth waters upon the fields:

entries.yo: Lati gbe awọn onirẹlẹ leke, ki a le igbé awọn ẹni ibinujẹ ga si ibi ailewu.
entries.en: To set up on high those that be low; that those which mourn may be exalted to safety.

entries.yo: O yi ìmọ awọn alarekerekè po, bẹ̃li ọwọ wọn kò lè imu idawọle wọn ṣẹ.
entries.en: He disappointeth the devices of the crafty, so that their hands cannot perform their enterprise.

entries.yo: O mu awọn ọlọgbọ́n ninu arekereke ara wọn, ati ìmọ awọn onroro li o tãri ṣubu li ògedengbè.
entries.en: He taketh the wise in their own craftiness: and the counsel of the froward is carried headlong.

entries.yo: Nwọn sure wọ inu òkunkun li ọ̀san, nwọn si nfọwọ talẹ̀ li ọ̀sangangan bi ẹnipe li oru.
entries.en: They meet with darkness in the daytime, and grope in the noonday as in the night.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn o gba talakà là kuro li ọwọ idà, lọwọ ẹnu wọn, ati lọwọ awọn alagbara.
entries.en: But he saveth the poor from the sword, from their mouth, and from the hand of the mighty.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni abá wà fun talaka, aiṣotitọ si pa ẹnu rẹ̀ mọ.
entries.en: So the poor hath hope, and iniquity stoppeth her mouth.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, ibukún ni fun ẹniti Ọlọrun bawi, nitorina má ṣe gan ìbawi Olodumare.
entries.en: Behold, happy is the man whom God correcteth: therefore despise not thou the chastening of the Almighty:

entries.yo: Nitoripe on a mu ni lara kan, a si di idi itura, o ṣa lọgbẹ, ọwọ rẹ̀ a si mu jina.
entries.en: For he maketh sore, and bindeth up: he woundeth, and his hands make whole.

entries.yo: Yio gbà ọ ninu ipọnju mẹfa, ani ninu meje ibi kan kì yio ba ọ.
entries.en: He shall deliver thee in six troubles: yea, in seven there shall no evil touch thee.

entries.yo: Ninu ìyan yio gbà ọ lọwọ ikú, ati ninu ogun yio gbà ọ lọwọ idà.
entries.en: In famine he shall redeem thee from death: and in war from the power of the sword.

entries.yo: A o pa ọ mọ kuro lọwọ ìna ahọn, bẹ̃ni iwọ kì yio bẹ̀ru iparun nigbati o ba dé.
entries.en: Thou shalt be hid from the scourge of the tongue: neither shalt thou be afraid of destruction when it cometh.

entries.yo: Ẹrin iparun ati ti iyàn ni iwọ o rín, bẹ̃ni iwọ kì yio bẹ̀ru ẹranko ilẹ aiye.
entries.en: At destruction and famine thou shalt laugh: neither shalt thou be afraid of the beasts of the earth.

entries.yo: Nitoripe iwọ o ba okuta ìgbẹ mulẹ̀, awọn ẹranko ìgbẹ yio wà pẹlu rẹ li alafia.
entries.en: For thou shalt be in league with the stones of the field: and the beasts of the field shall be at peace with thee.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si mọ̀ pe alafia ni ibujoko rẹ wà, iwọ o si ma ṣe ibẹ̀wo ibujoko rẹ, iwọ kì yio ṣìna.
entries.en: And thou shalt know that thy tabernacle shall be in peace; and thou shalt visit thy habitation, and shalt not sin.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si mọ̀ pẹlu pe iru-ọmọ rẹ yio si pọ̀, ati awọn ọmọ-ọmọ rẹ yio ri bi koriko ìgbẹ.
entries.en: Thou shalt know also that thy seed shall be great, and thine offspring as the grass of the earth.

entries.yo: Iwọ o wọ isa-okú rẹ lọ li ògbologbo ọjọ bi apo-ọka ti o gbó, ti a si nko ni igbà ikore rẹ̀.
entries.en: Thou shalt come to thy grave in a full age, like as a shock of corn cometh in in his season.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, awa ti nwadi rẹ̀, bẹ̃li o ri! gbà a gbọ́, ki o si mọ̀ pe fun ire ara rẹ ni!
entries.en: Lo this, we have searched it, so it is; hear it, and know thou it for thy good.

entries.yo: JOBU si dahùn o si wipe,
entries.en: But Job answered and said,

entries.yo: A! a ba le iwọ̀n ibinujẹ mi ninu òṣuwọn, ki a si le igbe ọ̀fọ mi le ori òṣuwọn ṣọkan pọ̀!
entries.en: Oh that my grief were throughly weighed, and my calamity laid in the balances together!

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, iba wuwo jù iyanrin okun lọ: nitorina li ọ̀rọ mi ṣe ntàse.
entries.en: For now it would be heavier than the sand of the sea: therefore my words are swallowed up.

entries.yo: Nitoripe ọfa Olodumare wọ̀ mi ninu, oró eyiti ọkàn mi mu; ipaiya-ẹ̀ru Ọlorun dotì mi.
entries.en: For the arrows of the Almighty are within me, the poison whereof drinketh up my spirit: the terrors of God do set themselves in array against me.

entries.yo: Kẹtẹkẹtẹ ìgbẹ a ma dún, nigbati o ba ni koriko, tabi ọdá-malu a ma dún sori ijẹ rẹ̀?
entries.en: Doth the wild ass bray when he hath grass? or loweth the ox over his fodder?

entries.yo: A le jẹ ohun ti kò li adùn li aini iyọ̀, tabi adùn wà ninu funfun ẹyin?
entries.en: Can that which is unsavoury be eaten without salt? or is there any taste in the white of an egg?

entries.yo: Ohun ti ọkàn mi kọ̀ lati tọ́, on li o dàbi onjẹ mi ti kò ni adùn.
entries.en: The things that my soul refused to touch are as my sorrowful meat.

entries.yo: A! emi iba lè ri iberè mi gbà; ati pe, ki Ọlọrun le fi ohun ti emi ṣafẹri fun mi.
entries.en: Oh that I might have my request; and that God would grant me the thing that I long for!

entries.yo: Ani, Ọlọrun iba jẹ pa mi run, ti on iba jẹ ṣiwọ rẹ̀ ki o si ké mi kuro.
entries.en: Even that it would please God to destroy me; that he would let loose his hand, and cut me off!

entries.yo: Nigbana ni emi iba ni itunú sibẹ, ani emi iba mu ọkàn mi le ninu ibinujẹ mi ti kò da ni si: nitori emi kò fi ọ̀rọ Ẹni Mimọ́ nì sin ri.
entries.en: Then should I yet have comfort; yea, I would harden myself in sorrow: let him not spare; for I have not concealed the words of the Holy One.

entries.yo: Kili agbara mi ti emi o fi dabá? ki si li opin mi ti emi o fi fà ẹmi mi gùn?
entries.en: What is my strength, that I should hope? and what is mine end, that I should prolong my life?

entries.yo: Agbara mi iṣe agbara okuta bi, tabi ẹran ara mi iṣe idẹ?
entries.en: Is my strength the strength of stones? or is my flesh of brass?

entries.yo: Iranlọwọ mi kò ha wà ninu mi: ọgbọn ha ti salọ kuro lọdọ mi bi?
entries.en: Is not my help in me? and is wisdom driven quite from me?

entries.yo: Ẹniti aya rẹ̀ yọ́ danu tan ni a ba ma ṣãnu fun lati ọdọ ọrẹ rẹ̀ wá, ki o má kọ̀ ibẹru Olodumare silẹ̀.
entries.en: To him that is afflicted pity should be shewed from his friend; but he forsaketh the fear of the Almighty.

entries.yo: Awọn ará mi ṣẹ̀tan bi odò ṣolõ, bi iṣàn gburu omi odò ṣolõ, nwọn ṣàn kọja lọ.
entries.en: My brethren have dealt deceitfully as a brook, and as the stream of brooks they pass away;

entries.yo: Ti o dúdu nitori omi didì, ati nibiti òjo didì gbe lùmọ si.
entries.en: Which are blackish by reason of the ice, and wherein the snow is hid:

entries.yo: Nigbakũgba ti nwọn ba gboná, nwọn a si yọ́ ṣanlọ, nigbati õrùn ba mú, nwọn si gbẹ kurò ni ipò wọn.
entries.en: What time they wax warm, they vanish: when it is hot, they are consumed out of their place.

entries.yo: Iya ọ̀na wọn a si yipada sapakan, nwọn goke si ibi asan, nwọn si run.
entries.en: The paths of their way are turned aside; they go to nothing, and perish.

entries.yo: Ẹgbẹ ogun Tema nwoye, awọn ọwọ́-èro Seba duro de wọn.
entries.en: The troops of Tema looked, the companies of Sheba waited for them.

entries.yo: Nwọn dãmu, nitoriti nwọn ni abá; nwọn debẹ̀, nwọn si dãmu.
entries.en: They were confounded because they had hoped; they came thither, and were ashamed.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, ẹnyin dabi wọn; ẹnyin ri irẹ̀silẹ mi, aiya si fò nyin.
entries.en: For now ye are nothing; ye see my casting down, and are afraid.

entries.yo: Emi ha wipe, ẹ mu ohun fun mi wá, tabi pe, ẹ bun mi ni ẹ̀bun ninu ohun ini nyin?
entries.en: Did I say, Bring unto me? or, Give a reward for me of your substance?

entries.yo: Tabi, ẹ gbà mi li ọwọ ọ̀ta nì, tabi, ẹ rà mi padà kuro lọwọ alagbara nì!
entries.en: Or, Deliver me from the enemy's hand? or, Redeem me from the hand of the mighty?

entries.yo: Ẹ kọ́ mi, emi o si pa ẹnu mi mọ́; ki ẹ si mu mi moye ibiti mo gbe ti ṣìna.
entries.en: Teach me, and I will hold my tongue: and cause me to understand wherein I have erred.

entries.yo: Wo! bi ọ̀rọ otitọ ti li agbara to! ṣugbọn kini aròye ibawi nyin jasi?
entries.en: How forcible are right words! but what doth your arguing reprove?

entries.yo: Ẹnyin ṣebi ẹ o ba ọ̀rọ ati ohùn ẹnu ẹniti o taku wi, ti o dabi afẹfẹ.
entries.en: Do ye imagine to reprove words, and the speeches of one that is desperate, which are as wind?

entries.yo: Ani ẹnyin ṣẹ́ gege fun alainibaba, ẹnyin si da iye le ọrẹ nyin.
entries.en: Yea, ye overwhelm the fatherless, and ye dig a pit for your friend.

entries.yo: Nitorina ki eyi ki o tó fun nyin: ẹ ma wò mi! nitoripe o hàn gbangba pe: li oju nyin ni emi kì yio ṣeke.
entries.en: Now therefore be content, look upon me; for it is evident unto you if I lie.

entries.yo: Emi bẹ̀ nyin, ẹ pada, ki o má ṣe jasi ẹ̀ṣẹ: ani ẹ si tun pada, are mi mbẹ ninu ọ̀ran yi.
entries.en: Return, I pray you, let it not be iniquity; yea, return again, my righteousness is in it.

entries.yo: Aiṣedede ha wà li ahọn mi? njẹ itọwò ẹnu mi kò kuku le imọ̀ ohun ti o burujù?
entries.en: Is there iniquity in my tongue? cannot my taste discern perverse things?

entries.yo: NJẸ ija kan kò ha si fun enia lori ilẹ, ọjọ rẹ̀ pẹlu kò dabi ọjọ alagbaṣe?
entries.en: Is there not an appointed time to man upon earth? are not his days also like the days of an hireling?

entries.yo: Bi ọmọ-ọdọ ti ima kanju bojuwo ojiji, ati bi alagbaṣe ti ima kanju wọ̀na owo iṣẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: As a servant earnestly desireth the shadow, and as an hireling looketh for the reward of his work:

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li a mu mi ni oṣoṣu asan, oru idanilagãra ni a si là silẹ fun mi.
entries.en: So am I made to possess months of vanity, and wearisome nights are appointed to me.

entries.yo: Nigbati mo dubulẹ̀, emi wipe, nigbawo ni emi o dide, ti oru yio si kọja? o si tó fun mi lati yi sihin yi sọhun titi yio fi di afẹmọ́jumọ.
entries.en: When I lie down, I say, When shall I arise, and the night be gone? and I am full of tossings to and fro unto the dawning of the day.

entries.yo: Kòkoro ati ogulùtu erupẹ li a fi wọ̀ mi li aṣọ, àwọ mi bù, o si di sisun ni.
entries.en: My flesh is clothed with worms and clods of dust; my skin is broken, and become loathsome.

entries.yo: Ọjọ mi yara jù ọkọ̀ iwunṣọ lọ, o si di lilò li ainireti.
entries.en: My days are swifter than a weaver's shuttle, and are spent without hope.

entries.yo: A! ranti pe afẹfẹ li ẹmi mi; oju mi kì yio pada ri rere mọ.
entries.en: O remember that my life is wind: mine eye shall no more see good.

entries.yo: Oju ẹniti o ri mi, kì yio ri mi mọ; oju rẹ tẹ mọra mi, emi kò sí mọ́!
entries.en: The eye of him that hath seen me shall see me no more: thine eyes are upon me, and I am not.

entries.yo: Bi awọ-sanma ti iparun, ti isi fò lọ, bẹ̃li ẹniti nlọ si ipò-okú, ti kì yio pada wá mọ.
entries.en: As the cloud is consumed and vanisheth away: so he that goeth down to the grave shall come up no more.

entries.yo: Kì yio pada sinu ile rẹ̀ mọ, bẹ̃ni ipò rẹ̀ kì yio mọ̀ ọ mọ.
entries.en: He shall return no more to his house, neither shall his place know him any more.

entries.yo: Nitorina emi kì yio pa ẹnu mi mọ, emi o ma sọ ninu irora ọkàn mi, emi o ma ṣe irahùn ninu kikoro ọkàn mi.
entries.en: Therefore I will not refrain my mouth; I will speak in the anguish of my spirit; I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.

entries.yo: Emi ama iṣe ejo okun tabi erinmi, ti iwọ fi yàn oluṣọ tì mi?
entries.en: Am I a sea, or a whale, that thou settest a watch over me?

entries.yo: Nigbati mo wipe, ibusùn mi yio tù mi lara, itẹ mi yio gbé ẹrù irahùn mi pẹlu.
entries.en: When I say, My bed shall comfort me, my couch shall ease my complaint;

entries.yo: Nigbana ni iwọ fi alá da mi niji, iwọ si fi iran oru dẹrubà mi.
entries.en: Then thou scarest me with dreams, and terrifiest me through visions:

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li ọkàn mi yan isà okú jù aye, ikú jù egungun mi lọ.
entries.en: So that my soul chooseth strangling, and death rather than my life.

entries.yo: O su mi, emi kò le wà titi: jọwọ mi jẹ, nitoripe asan li ọjọ mi.
entries.en: I loathe it; I would not live alway: let me alone; for my days are vanity.

entries.yo: Kili enia ti iwọ o ma kokìki rẹ̀? ati ti iwọ iba fi gbe ọkàn rẹ le e?
entries.en: What is man, that thou shouldest magnify him? and that thou shouldest set thine heart upon him?

entries.yo: Ati ti iwọ o fi ma wa ibẹ̀ ẹ wò li orowurọ̀, ti iwọ o si ma dán a wò nigbakũgba!
entries.en: And that thou shouldest visit him every morning, and try him every moment?

entries.yo: Yio ti pẹ́ to ki iwọ ki o to fi mi silẹ̀ lọ, ti iwọ o fi jọ mi jẹ titi emi o fi le dá itọ mi mì.
entries.en: How long wilt thou not depart from me, nor let me alone till I swallow down my spittle?

entries.yo: Emi ti ṣẹ̀, kili emi o ṣe si ọ, iwọ Olùtọju enia? ẽṣe ti iwọ fi fi mi ṣe àmi itasi niwaju rẹ, bẹ̃li emi si di ẹrù-wuwo si ara rẹ?
entries.en: I have sinned; what shall I do unto thee, O thou preserver of men? why hast thou set me as a mark against thee, so that I am a burden to myself?

entries.yo: Ẽṣe ti iwọ kò si dari irekọja mi jì, ki iwọ ki o si mu aiṣedede mi kuro? njẹ nisisiyi li emi iba sùn ninu erupẹ, iwọ iba si wá mi kiri li owurọ̀, emi ki ba ti si.
entries.en: And why dost thou not pardon my transgression, and take away mine iniquity? for now shall I sleep in the dust; and thou shalt seek me in the morning, but I shall not be.

entries.yo: NIGBANA ni Bildadi, ara Ṣua, dahùn wipe,
entries.en: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,

entries.yo: Iwọ o ti ma sọ nkan wọnyi pẹ to? ti ọ̀rọ ẹnu rẹ yio si ma dabi ẹfufu nla?
entries.en: How long wilt thou speak these things? and how long shall the words of thy mouth be like a strong wind?

entries.yo: Ọlọrun a ha ma yi idajọ po bi, tabi Olodumare a ma fi otitọ ṣẹ̀ bi?
entries.en: Doth God pervert judgment? or doth the Almighty pervert justice?

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn ọmọ rẹ ṣẹ̀ si i, o si gbá wọn kuro nitori irekọja wọn.
entries.en: If thy children have sinned against him, and he have cast them away for their transgression;

entries.yo: Bi iwọ ba si kepe Ọlọrun ni igba akokò, ti iwọ bá si gbadura ẹ̀bẹ si Olodumare.
entries.en: If thou wouldest seek unto God betimes, and make thy supplication to the Almighty;

entries.yo: Iwọ iba mọ́, ki o si duro ṣinṣin: njẹ nitõtọ nisisiyi on o tají fun ọ, on a si sọ ibujoko ododo rẹ di pipọ.
entries.en: If thou wert pure and upright; surely now he would awake for thee, and make the habitation of thy righteousness prosperous.

entries.yo: Ipilẹṣẹ rẹ iba tilẹ kere ri, bẹ̃ni igbẹhin rẹ iba pọ̀ si i gidigidi.
entries.en: Though thy beginning was small, yet thy latter end should greatly increase.

entries.yo: Emi bẹ̀ ọ njẹ, bere lọwọ awọn ara igbãni, ki o si kiyesi iwádi awọn baba wọn.
entries.en: For inquire, I pray thee, of the former age, and prepare thyself to the search of their fathers:

entries.yo: Nitoripe ọmọ-àná li awa, a kò si mọ̀ nkan, nitoripe òjiji li ọjọ wa li aiye.
entries.en: (For we are but of yesterday, and know nothing, because our days upon earth are a shadow:)

entries.yo: Awọn kì yio ha kọ́ ọ, nwọn kì yio si sọ fun ọ, nwọn kì yio si sọ̀rọ lati inu ọkàn wọn jade wá?
entries.en: Shall not they teach thee, and tell thee, and utter words out of their heart?

entries.yo: Koriko odò ha le dàgba laini ẹrẹ̀, tabi ẽsú ha le dàgba lailomi?
entries.en: Can the rush grow up without mire? can the flag grow without water?

entries.yo: Nigbati o wà ni tutù, ti a kò ke e lulẹ̀, o rọ danu sin eweko miran gbogbo.
entries.en: Whilst it is yet in his greenness, and not cut down, it withereth before any other herb.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni ipa ọ̀na gbogbo awọn ti o gbagbe Ọlọrun, abá awọn àgabàgebe yio di ofo.
entries.en: So are the paths of all that forget God; and the hypocrite's hope shall perish:

entries.yo: Abá ẹniti a o ke kuro, ati igbẹkẹle ẹniti o dàbi ile alantakùn.
entries.en: Whose hope shall be cut off, and whose trust shall be a spider's web.

entries.yo: Yio fi ara tì ile rẹ̀, ṣugbọn kì yio le iduro, yio fi di ara rẹ̀ mu ṣinṣin ṣugbọn kì yio le iduro pẹ.
entries.en: He shall lean upon his house, but it shall not stand: he shall hold it fast, but it shall not endure.

entries.yo: O tutù niwaju õrùn, ẹka rẹ̀ si yọ jade ninu ọgbà rẹ̀.
entries.en: He is green before the sun, and his branch shooteth forth in his garden.

entries.yo: Gbòngbo rẹ̀ ta yi ebè ka, o si wò ibi okuta wọnni.
entries.en: His roots are wrapped about the heap, and seeth the place of stones.

entries.yo: Bi o ba si pa a run kuro ni ipò rẹ̀, nigbana ni ipò na yio sẹ ẹ pe: emi kò ri ọ ri!
entries.en: If he destroy him from his place, then it shall deny him, saying, I have not seen thee.

entries.yo: Kiyesi eyi ni ayọ̀ ọ̀na rẹ̀ ati lati inu ilẹ li omiran yio ti hù jade wá.
entries.en: Behold, this is the joy of his way, and out of the earth shall others grow.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, Ọlọrun kì yio ta ẹni-otitọ nù, bẹ̃ni kì yio ràn oniwa-buburu lọwọ.
entries.en: Behold, God will not cast away a perfect man, neither will he help the evil doers:

entries.yo: Titi yio fi fi ẹ̀rin kún ọ li ẹnu, ati ète rẹ pẹlu iho ayọ̀.
entries.en: Till he fill thy mouth with laughing, and thy lips with rejoicing.

entries.yo: Itiju li a o fi bò awọn ti o korira rẹ, ati ibujoko enia buburu kì yio si mọ.
entries.en: They that hate thee shall be clothed with shame; and the dwelling place of the wicked shall come to nought.

entries.yo: JOBU si dahùn o si wipe,
entries.en: Then Job answered and said,

entries.yo: Emi mọ̀ pe bẹ̃ni nitõtọ! bawo li enia yio ha ti ṣe alare niwaju Ọlọrun?
entries.en: I know it is so of a truth: but how should man be just with God?

entries.yo: Bi o ba ṣepe yio ba a jà, on kì yio lè idá a lohùn kan ninu ẹgbẹrun ọ̀ran.
entries.en: If he will contend with him, he cannot answer him one of a thousand.

entries.yo: Ọlọgbọ́n-ninu ati alagbara ni ipá li on; tali o ṣagidi si i, ti o si gbè fun u ri?
entries.en: He is wise in heart, and mighty in strength: who hath hardened himself against him, and hath prospered?

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ṣi okè ni idi, ti nwọn kò si mọ̀: ti o tari wọn ṣubu ni ibinu rẹ̀.
entries.en: Which removeth the mountains, and they know not: which overturneth them in his anger.

entries.yo: Ti o mì ilẹ aiye tìti kuro ni ipò rẹ̀, ọwọ̀n rẹ̀ si mì tìti.
entries.en: Which shaketh the earth out of her place, and the pillars thereof tremble.

entries.yo: Ti o paṣẹ fun õrùn, ti on kò si là, ti o si dí irawọ̀ mọ́.
entries.en: Which commandeth the sun, and it riseth not; and sealeth up the stars.

entries.yo: On nikanṣoṣo li o na oju ọrun lọ, ti o si nrìn lori ìgbì okun.
entries.en: Which alone spreadeth out the heavens, and treadeth upon the waves of the sea.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o da irawọ̀ Arketuru, Orioni ati Pleiade ati iyàra pipọ ti gusu.
entries.en: Which maketh Arcturus, Orion, and Pleiades, and the chambers of the south.

entries.yo: Ẹniti nṣe ohun ti o tobi jù awari lọ, ani ohun iyanu laini iye.
entries.en: Which doeth great things past finding out; yea, and wonders without number.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, on kọja lọ li ẹ̀ba ọdọ mi, emi kò si ri i, o si kọja siwaju, bẹ̃li emi kò ri oju rẹ̀.
entries.en: Lo, he goeth by me, and I see him not: he passeth on also, but I perceive him not.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, o jãgbà lọ, tani yio fa a pada? tani yio bi i pe, kini iwọ nṣe nì?
entries.en: Behold, he taketh away, who can hinder him? who will say unto him, What doest thou?

entries.yo: Ọlọrun kò ni fà ibinu rẹ̀ sẹhin, awọn oniranlọwọ ìgberaga a si tẹriba labẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: If God will not withdraw his anger, the proud helpers do stoop under him.

entries.yo: Ambọtori emi ti emi o fi dá a lohùn, ti emi o fi má ṣa ọ̀rọ awawì mi ba a ṣawiye?
entries.en: How much less shall I answer him, and choose out my words to reason with him?

entries.yo: Bi o tilẹ ṣepe mo ṣe olododo, emi kò gbọdọ̀ da a lohùn, ṣugbọn emi o gbadura ẹ̀bẹ mi sọdọ onidajọ mi.
entries.en: Whom, though I were righteous, yet would I not answer, but I would make supplication to my judge.

entries.yo: Bi emi ba si kepè e, ti on si da mi lohùn, emi kì yio si gbagbọ pe, on ti feti si ohùn mi.
entries.en: If I had called, and he had answered me; yet would I not believe that he had hearkened unto my voice.

entries.yo: Nitoripe o fi ẹ̀fufu nla ṣẹ mi tutu, o sọ ọgbẹ mi di pipọ lainidi.
entries.en: For he breaketh me with a tempest, and multiplieth my wounds without cause.

entries.yo: On kì yio jẹ ki emi ki o fà ẹmi mi, ṣugbọn o fi ohun kikorò kún u fun mi.
entries.en: He will not suffer me to take my breath, but filleth me with bitterness.

entries.yo: Bi mo ba sọ ti agbara, wò o! alagbara ni, tabi niti idajọ, tani yio da akoko fun mi lati rò?
entries.en: If I speak of strength, lo, he is strong: and if of judgment, who shall set me a time to plead?

entries.yo: Bi mo tilẹ da ara mi lare, ẹnu ara mi ni yio dá mi lẹbi; bi mo wipe, olododo li emi, yio si fi mi hàn ni ẹni-òdi.
entries.en: If I justify myself, mine own mouth shall condemn me: if I say, I am perfect, it shall also prove me perverse.

entries.yo: Olõtọ ni mo ṣe, sibẹ emi kò kiyesi ẹmi mi, ìwa mi li emi iba ma gàn.
entries.en: Though I were perfect, yet would I not know my soul: I would despise my life.

entries.yo: Ohun kanna ni, nitorina ni emi ṣe sọ ọ: on a pa ẹni-otitọ ati enia buburu pẹlu.
entries.en: This is one thing, therefore I said it, He destroyeth the perfect and the wicked.

entries.yo: Bi jamba ba pa ni lojijì, yio rẹrin idanwo alaiṣẹ̀.
entries.en: If the scourge slay suddenly, he will laugh at the trial of the innocent.

entries.yo: A fi aiye le ọwọ enia buburu; o si bò awọn onidajọ rẹ̀ li oju; bi kò ba ri bẹ̃, njẹ tani?
entries.en: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked: he covereth the faces of the judges thereof; if not, where, and who is he?

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi ọjọ mi yara jù onṣẹ lọ, nwọn fò lọ, nwọn kò ri ire.
entries.en: Now my days are swifter than a post: they flee away, they see no good.

entries.yo: Nwọn kọja lọ bi ọkọ-ẽsú ti nsure lọ; bi idì ti o nyara si ohun ọdẹ.
entries.en: They are passed away as the swift ships: as the eagle that hasteth to the prey.

entries.yo: Bi emi ba wipe, emi o gbagbe aro ibinujẹ mi, emi o fi ọkàn lelẹ̀, emi o si rẹ̀ ara mi lẹkun.
entries.en: If I say, I will forget my complaint, I will leave off my heaviness, and comfort myself:

entries.yo: Ẹ̀ru ibinujẹ mi gbogbo bà mi, emi mọ̀ pe iwọ kì yio mu mi bi alaiṣẹ̀.
entries.en: I am afraid of all my sorrows, I know that thou wilt not hold me innocent.

entries.yo: Bi o ba ṣepe enia buburu li emi, njẹ kili emi nṣe lãlã lasan si!
entries.en: If I be wicked, why then labour I in vain?

entries.yo: Bi mo tilẹ fi omi òjo didì wẹ̀ ara mi, ti mo fi omi-aró wẹ̀ ọwọ mi mọ́,
entries.en: If I wash myself with snow water, and make my hands never so clean;

entries.yo: Sibẹ iwọ o gbe mi bọ̀ inu ihò ọ̀gọdọ, aṣọ ara mi yio sọ mi di ẹni-irira.
entries.en: Yet shalt thou plunge me in the ditch, and mine own clothes shall abhor me.

entries.yo: Nitori on kì iṣe enia bi emi, ti emi o fi da a lohùn ti awa o fi pade ni idajọ.
entries.en: For he is not a man, as I am, that I should answer him, and we should come together in judgment.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni kò si alatunṣe kan lagbedemeji wa, ti iba fi ọwọ rẹ̀ le awa mejeji lara.
entries.en: Neither is there any daysman betwixt us, that might lay his hand upon us both.

entries.yo: Ki on sa mu ọ̀pa rẹ̀ kuro lara mi, ki ìbẹru rẹ̀ ki o má si ṣe daiya fò mi.
entries.en: Let him take his rod away from me, and let not his fear terrify me:

entries.yo: Nigbana ni emi iba sọ̀rọ, emi kì ba si bẹ̀ru rẹ̀; ṣugbọn kò ri bẹ̃ fun mi.
entries.en: Then would I speak, and not fear him; but it is not so with me.

entries.yo: AGARA ìwa aiye mi da mi tan, emi o tú aroye mi sode lọdọ mi, emi o ma sọ ninu kikorò ibinujẹ ọkàn mi.
entries.en: My soul is weary of my life; I will leave my complaint upon myself; I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.

entries.yo: Emi o wi fun Ọlọrun pe, o jare! máṣe dá mi lẹbi; fi hàn mi nitori idi ohun ti iwọ fi mba mi jà.
entries.en: I will say unto God, Do not condemn me; shew me wherefore thou contendest with me.

entries.yo: O ha tọ́ si ọ ti iwọ iba ma tẹ̀mọlẹ̀, ti iwọ iba fi ma gan iṣẹ ọwọ rẹ, ti iwọ o fi ma tan imọlẹ si ìmọ enia buburu?
entries.en: Is it good unto thee that thou shouldest oppress, that thou shouldest despise the work of thine hands, and shine upon the counsel of the wicked?

entries.yo: Oju rẹ iha ṣe oju enia bi? tabi iwọ a ma riran bi enia ti iriran?
entries.en: Hast thou eyes of flesh? or seest thou as man seeth?

entries.yo: Ọjọ rẹ ha dabi ọjọ enia, ọdun rẹ ha dabi ọdun enia?
entries.en: Are thy days as the days of man? are thy years as man's days,

entries.yo: Ti iwọ fi mbere aiṣedẽde mi, ti iwọ si fi wa ẹ̀ṣẹ mi ri?
entries.en: That thou inquirest after mine iniquity, and searchest after my sin?

entries.yo: Iwọ mọ̀ pe emi kì iṣe oniwa-buburu, kò si sí ẹniti igbà kuro li ọwọ rẹ.
entries.en: Thou knowest that I am not wicked; and there is none that can deliver out of thine hand.

entries.yo: Ọwọ rẹ li o ti dá mi, ti o si mọ mi pọ̀ yikakiri; sibẹ iwọ si mbà mi jẹ́.
entries.en: Thine hands have made me and fashioned me together round about; yet thou dost destroy me.

entries.yo: Emi bẹ̀ ọ ranti pe iwọ ti mọ mi bi amọ̀; iwọ o ha si tun mu mi pada lọ sinu erupẹ?
entries.en: Remember, I beseech thee, that thou hast made me as the clay; and wilt thou bring me into dust again?

entries.yo: Iwọ kò ha ti tu mi dà jade bi wàra, iwọ kò si mu mi dipọ̀ bi wàrakasi?
entries.en: Hast thou not poured me out as milk, and curdled me like cheese?

entries.yo: Iwọ sa ti fi awọ ati ẹran-ara wọ̀ mi, iwọ si fi egungun ati iṣan ṣọgbà yi mi ká.
entries.en: Thou hast clothed me with skin and flesh, and hast fenced me with bones and sinews.

entries.yo: Iwọ ti fun mi li ẹmi ati oju rere, ibẹ̀wo rẹ si pa ọkàn mi mọ́.
entries.en: Thou hast granted me life and favour, and thy visitation hath preserved my spirit.

entries.yo: Nkan wọnyi ni iwọ si ti fi pamọ ninu rẹ; emi mọ̀ pe, eyi mbẹ lọdọ rẹ.
entries.en: And these things hast thou hid in thine heart: I know that this is with thee.

entries.yo: Bi mo ba ṣẹ̀, nigbana ni iwọ sàmi si mi, iwọ kì yio si dari aiṣedede mi ji.
entries.en: If I sin, then thou markest me, and thou wilt not acquit me from mine iniquity.

entries.yo: Bi mo ba ṣe ẹni-buburu, egbé ni fun mi! bi mo ba si ṣe ẹni-rere, bẹ̃li emi kò si le igbe ori mi soke. Emi damu, mo si wo ipọnju mi.
entries.en: If I be wicked, woe unto me; and if I be righteous, yet will I not lift up my head. I am full of confusion; therefore see thou mine affliction;

entries.yo: Nitoriti npọ̀ si i: iwọ ndẹ mi kiri bi kiniun; ati pẹlu, iwọ a si fi ara rẹ hàn fun mi ni iyanju.
entries.en: For it increaseth. Thou huntest me as a fierce lion: and again thou shewest thyself marvellous upon me.

entries.yo: Iwọ si tun sọ awọn ẹlẹri rẹ si mi di ọtun, iwọ si sọ irunu rẹ di pipọ si mi, ayipada ati ogun dó tì mi.
entries.en: Thou renewest thy witnesses against me, and increasest thine indignation upon me; changes and war are against me.

entries.yo: Njẹ nitorina iwọ ha ṣe bí mi jade lati inu wá? A! emi iba kúku ti kú, ojukoju kì ba ti ri mi!
entries.en: Wherefore then hast thou brought me forth out of the womb? Oh that I had given up the ghost, and no eye had seen me!

entries.yo: Emi iba dabi ẹniti kò si ri, a ba ti gbe mi lati inu lọ si isà-okú.
entries.en: I should have been as though I had not been; I should have been carried from the womb to the grave.

entries.yo: Ọjọ mi kò ha kuru bi? dawọ duro, ki o si jọwọ mi jẹ ki emi fi aiya balẹ diẹ.
entries.en: Are not my days few? cease then, and let me alone, that I may take comfort a little,

entries.yo: Ki emi ki o to lọ sibi ti emi kì yio pada sẹhin mọ́, ani si ilẹ òkunkun ati ojiji ikú.
entries.en: Before I go whence I shall not return, even to the land of darkness and the shadow of death;

entries.yo: Ilẹ òkunkun bi òkunkun tikararẹ̀, ati ti ojiji ikú, laini èto, nibiti imọlẹ dabi òkunkun.
entries.en: A land of darkness, as darkness itself; and of the shadow of death, without any order, and where the light is as darkness.

entries.yo: NIGBANA ni Sofari, ara Naama, dahùn o si wipe,
entries.en: Then answered Zophar the Naamathite, and said,

entries.yo: A le iṣe ki a má ṣe dahùn si ọ̀pọlọpọ ọ́rọ, a ha si le dare fun ẹniti ẹnu rẹ̃ kún fun ọ̀rọ sisọ?
entries.en: Should not the multitude of words be answered? and should a man full of talk be justified?

entries.yo: Amọ̀tan rẹ le imu enia pa ẹnu wọn mọ bi? bi iwọ ba yọṣuti si ni, ki ẹnikẹni ki o má si doju tì ọ bi?
entries.en: Should thy lies make men hold their peace? and when thou mockest, shall no man make thee ashamed?

entries.yo: Nitori iwọ sa ti wipe, ọ̀rọ ẹkọ́ mi mọ́, emi si mọ́ li oju rẹ.
entries.en: For thou hast said, My doctrine is pure, and I am clean in thine eyes.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn o ṣe! Ọlọrun iba jẹ sọ̀rọ, ki o si ya ẹnu rẹ̀ si ọ lara.
entries.en: But oh that God would speak, and open his lips against thee;

entries.yo: Ki o si fi aṣiri ọgbọ́n hàn ọ pe, o pọ̀ jù oye enia lọ; nitorina mọ̀ pe: Ọlọrun kò bere to bi ẹbi rẹ.
entries.en: And that he would shew thee the secrets of wisdom, that they are double to that which is! Know therefore that God exacteth of thee less than thine iniquity deserveth.

entries.yo: Iwọ ha le fi awari ri idi Ọlọrun? iwọ le ri idi Olodumare de pipé rẹ̀?
entries.en: Canst thou by searching find out God? canst thou find out the Almighty unto perfection?

entries.yo: O dabi giga ọrun, kini iwọ le iṣe? o jinlẹ jù ipo-okú lọ, kini iwọ le imọ̀?
entries.en: It is as high as heaven; what canst thou do? deeper than hell; what canst thou know?

entries.yo: Ìwọn rẹ̀ gùn jù aiye lọ, o si ni ìbu jù okun lọ.
entries.en: The measure thereof is longer than the earth, and broader than the sea.

entries.yo: Bi on ba rekọja, ti o si sénà, tabi ti o si ṣe ikojọpọ, njẹ tani yio da a pada kuro?
entries.en: If he cut off, and shut up, or gather together, then who can hinder him?

entries.yo: On sa mọ̀ enia asan, o ri ìwa-buburu pẹlu, on kò si ni ṣe lãlã lati ṣà a rò.
entries.en: For he knoweth vain men: he seeth wickedness also; will he not then consider it?

entries.yo: Enia lasan a sa ma fẹ iṣe ọlọgbọ́n, bi a tilẹ ti bi enia bi ọmọ kẹtẹkẹtẹ.
entries.en: For vain man would be wise, though man be born like a wild ass's colt.

entries.yo: Bi iwọ ba tun ọkàn rẹ ṣe, ti iwọ si nawọ rẹ sọdọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: If thou prepare thine heart, and stretch out thine hands toward him;

entries.yo: Bi aiṣedede kan ba mbẹ lọwọ rẹ, mu u kuro si ọ̀na jijin rére, máṣe jẹ ki iwàkiwa kó wà ninu agọ rẹ.
entries.en: If iniquity be in thine hand, put it far away, and let not wickedness dwell in thy tabernacles.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni iwọ o gbe oju rẹ soke laini abawọn, ani iwọ o duro ṣinṣin, iwọ kì yio si bẹ̀ru.
entries.en: For then shalt thou lift up thy face without spot; yea, thou shalt be stedfast, and shalt not fear:

entries.yo: Nitoripe iwọ o gbagbe òṣi rẹ, iwọ o si ranti rẹ̀ bi omi ti o ti ṣàn kọja lọ.
entries.en: Because thou shalt forget thy misery, and remember it as waters that pass away:

entries.yo: Ọjọ aiye rẹ yio si mọlẹ jù ọsan gangan lọ, bi okunkun tilẹ bò ọ mọlẹ nisisiyi, iwọ o dabi owurọ̀.
entries.en: And thine age shall be clearer than the noonday; thou shalt shine forth, thou shalt be as the morning.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si wà lailewu, nitoripe ireti wà, ani iwọ o rin ilẹ rẹ wò, iwọ o si simi li alafia.
entries.en: And thou shalt be secure, because there is hope; yea, thou shalt dig about thee, and thou shalt take thy rest in safety.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si dubulẹ pẹlu kì yio si sí ẹniti yio dẹ̀ruba ọ, ani ọ̀pọ enia yio ma wá oju-rere rẹ.
entries.en: Also thou shalt lie down, and none shall make thee afraid; yea, many shall make suit unto thee.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn oju eniakenia yio mófo, nwọn kì yio le sala, ireti wọn a si dabi ẹniti o jọwọ ẹmi rẹ̀ lọwọ.
entries.en: But the eyes of the wicked shall fail, and they shall not escape, and their hope shall be as the giving up of the ghost.

entries.yo: JOBU si dahùn o si wipe,
entries.en: And Job answered and said,

entries.yo: Kò si ani-ani nibẹ̀, ṣugbọn ẹnyin li awọn enia na, ọgbọ́n yio si kú pẹlu nyin.
entries.en: No doubt but ye are the people, and wisdom shall die with you.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi ni iyè ninu gẹgẹ bi ẹnyin: emi kì iṣe ọmọ-ẹhin nyin: ani, tani kò mọ̀ nkan bi iru wọnyi?
entries.en: But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you: yea, who knoweth not such things as these?

entries.yo: Emi dabi ẹniti a nfi ṣe ẹlẹya lọdọ aladugbo rẹ̀, ti o kepe Ọlọrun, ti o si da a lohùn: a nfi olõtọ ẹni-iduro-ṣinṣin rẹrin ẹlẹyà.
entries.en: I am as one mocked of his neighbour, who calleth upon God, and he answereth him: the just upright man is laughed to scorn.

entries.yo: Ẹgan ni ẹni-òtoṣi, ti ẹsẹ rẹ̀ mura tan lati yọ́ ninu ìro ẹniti ara rọ̀.
entries.en: He that is ready to slip with his feet is as a lamp despised in the thought of him that is at ease.

entries.yo: Agọ awọn igara ngberú, awọn ti o si nmu Ọlọrun binu wà lailewu, awọn ẹniti o si gbá oriṣa mu li ọwọ wọn.
entries.en: The tabernacles of robbers prosper, and they that provoke God are secure; into whose hand God bringeth abundantly.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nisisiyi, bi awọn ẹranko lere, nwọn o kọ́ ọ li ẹkọ́, ati ẹiyẹ oju ọrun, nwọn o si sọ fun ọ.
entries.en: But ask now the beasts, and they shall teach thee; and the fowls of the air, and they shall tell thee:

entries.yo: Tabi, ba ilẹ aiye sọ̀rọ, yio si kọ́ ọ, awọn ẹja inu okun yio si sọ fun ọ.
entries.en: Or speak to the earth, and it shall teach thee: and the fishes of the sea shall declare unto thee.

entries.yo: Tani kò mọ̀ ninu gbogbo wọnyi pe, ọwọ Oluwa li o ṣe nkan yi?
entries.en: Who knoweth not in all these that the hand of the LORD hath wrought this?

entries.yo: Lọwọ ẹniti ẹmi ohun alãye gbogbo gbé wà, ati ẹmi gbogbo araiye.
entries.en: In whose hand is the soul of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind.

entries.yo: Eti ki idán ọ̀rọ wò bi? tabi adùn ẹnu ki isi tọ onjẹ rẹ̀ wò?
entries.en: Doth not the ear try words? and the mouth taste his meat?

entries.yo: Awọn arugbo li ọgbọ́n wà fun, ati ninu gigùn ọjọ li oye.
entries.en: With the ancient is wisdom; and in length of days understanding.

entries.yo: Pẹlu rẹ̀ (Ọlọrun) li ọgbọ́n ati agbarà, on ni ìmọ ati oye,
entries.en: With him is wisdom and strength, he hath counsel and understanding.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, o biwó, a kò si le igbe ró mọ́, o se enia mọ́, kò si sí iṣisilẹ̀ kan.
entries.en: Behold, he breaketh down, and it cannot be built again: he shutteth up a man, and there can be no opening.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, o da awọn omi duro, nwọn si gbẹ, o si rán wọn jade, nwọn si ṣẹ bo ilẹ aiye yipo.
entries.en: Behold, he withholdeth the waters, and they dry up: also he sendeth them out, and they overturn the earth.

entries.yo: Pẹlu rẹ̀ li agbara ati ọgbọ́n, ẹniti nṣìna ati ẹniti imu ni ṣìna tirẹ̀ ni nwọn iṣe.
entries.en: With him is strength and wisdom: the deceived and the deceiver are his.

entries.yo: O mu awọn igbimọ̀ lọ nihoho, a si sọ awọn onidajọ di wère.
entries.en: He leadeth counsellers away spoiled, and maketh the judges fools.

entries.yo: O tu ide ọba, o si fi àmure gbà wọn li ọ̀ja.
entries.en: He looseth the bond of kings, and girdeth their loins with a girdle.

entries.yo: O mu awọn alufa lọ nihoho, o si tẹ ori awọn alagbara bá.
entries.en: He leadeth princes away spoiled, and overthroweth the mighty.

entries.yo: O mu ọ̀rọ-ẹnu ẹni-igbẹkẹle kuro, o si ra awọn àgbàgbà ni iye.
entries.en: He removeth away the speech of the trusty, and taketh away the understanding of the aged.

entries.yo: O bù ẹ̀gan lu awọn ọmọ-alade, o si tú àmure awọn alagbara.
entries.en: He poureth contempt upon princes, and weakeneth the strength of the mighty.

entries.yo: O hudi ohun ti o sigbẹ jade lati inu òkunkun wá, o si mu ojiji ikú jade wá sinu imọlẹ̀.
entries.en: He discovereth deep things out of darkness, and bringeth out to light the shadow of death.

entries.yo: On a mu orilẹ-ède bi si i, a si run wọn, on a sọ orilẹ-ède di nla, a si tun ṣẹ́ wọn kù.
entries.en: He increaseth the nations, and destroyeth them: he enlargeth the nations, and straiteneth them again.

entries.yo: On a gbà aiya olú awọn enia aiye, a si ma mu wọn wọ́ kakiri ninu iju nibiti ọ̀na kò si.
entries.en: He taketh away the heart of the chief of the people of the earth, and causeth them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way.

entries.yo: Nwọn a ma fi ọwọ ta ilẹ ninu òkunkun laisi imọlẹ, on a si ma mu wọn tàse irin bi ọmuti.
entries.en: They grope in the dark without light, and he maketh them to stagger like a drunken man.

entries.yo: Wò o, oju mi ti ri gbogbo eyi ri, eti mi si gbọ́ o si ti ye e.
entries.en: Lo, mine eye hath seen all this, mine ear hath heard and understood it.

entries.yo: Ohun ti ẹnyin mọ̀, emi mọ̀ pẹlu, emi kì iṣe ọmọ-ẹhin nyin.
entries.en: What ye know, the same do I know also: I am not inferior unto you.

entries.yo: Nitotọ emi o ba Olodumare sọ̀rọ, emi si nfẹ ba Ọlọrun sọ asọye.
entries.en: Surely I would speak to the Almighty, and I desire to reason with God.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin ni onihumọ eke, oniṣegun lasan ni gbogbo nyin.
entries.en: But ye are forgers of lies, ye are all physicians of no value.

entries.yo: O ṣe! ẹ ba kuku pa ẹnu nyin mọ patapata! eyini ni iba si ṣe ọgbọ́n nyin.
entries.en: O that ye would altogether hold your peace! and it should be your wisdom.

entries.yo: Ẹ gbọ́ awiye mi nisisiyi, ẹ si fetisilẹ si aroye ẹnu mi.
entries.en: Hear now my reasoning, and hearken to the pleadings of my lips.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin fẹ sọ isọkusọ fun Ọlọrun? ki ẹ si fi ẹ̀tan sọ̀rọ gbè e?
entries.en: Will ye speak wickedly for God? and talk deceitfully for him?

entries.yo: Ẹnyin fẹ ṣojusaju rẹ̀, ẹnyin fẹ igbìjà fun Ọlọrun?
entries.en: Will ye accept his person? will ye contend for God?

entries.yo: O ha dara ti yio fi hudi nyin silẹ, tabi ki ẹnyin tàn a bi ẹnikan ti itan ẹnikeji.
entries.en: Is it good that he should search you out? or as one man mocketh another, do ye so mock him?

entries.yo: Yio ma ba nyin wi nitotọ, bi ẹnyin ba ṣojusaju enia nikọ̀kọ.
entries.en: He will surely reprove you, if ye do secretly accept persons.

entries.yo: Iwa ọlá rẹ̀ ki yio bà nyin lẹ̃ru bi? ipaiya rẹ̀ ki yio pá nyin laiya?
entries.en: Shall not his excellency make you afraid? and his dread fall upon you?

entries.yo: Iranti nyin dabi ẽru, ilu-odi nyin dabi ilu-odi amọ̀.
entries.en: Your remembrances are like unto ashes, your bodies to bodies of clay.

entries.yo: Ẹ pa ẹnu nyin mọ kuro lara mi, ki emi ki o le sọ̀rọ, ohun ti mbọ̀ wá iba mi, ki o ma bọ̀.
entries.en: Hold your peace, let me alone, that I may speak, and let come on me what will.

entries.yo: Njẹ nitori kili emi ṣe nfi ehin mi bù ẹran ara mi jẹ, ti mo si gbe ẹmi mi le ara mi lọwọ?
entries.en: Wherefore do I take my flesh in my teeth, and put my life in mine hand?

entries.yo: Bi o tilẹ pa mi, sibẹ emi o ma gbẹkẹle e, ṣugbọn emi o ma tẹnumọ ọ̀na mi niwaju rẹ̀.
entries.en: Though he slay me, yet will I trust in him: but I will maintain mine own ways before him.

entries.yo: Eyi ni yio si ṣe igbala mi pe: àgabagebe kì yio wá siwaju rẹ̀.
entries.en: He also shall be my salvation: for an hypocrite shall not come before him.

entries.yo: Ẹ gbọ́ ọ̀rọ ẹnu mi ni ifaiyabalẹ, ati asọpe mi li eti nyin.
entries.en: Hear diligently my speech, and my declaration with your ears.

entries.yo: Wò o nisisiyi emi ti ladi ọ̀ran mi silẹ; emi mọ̀ pe a ó da mi lare.
entries.en: Behold now, I have ordered my cause; I know that I shall be justified.

entries.yo: Tani on ti yio ba mi ṣàroye? njẹ nisisiyi, emi fẹ pa ẹnu mi mọ, emi o si jọwọ ẹmi mi lọwọ.
entries.en: Who is he that will plead with me? for now, if I hold my tongue, I shall give up the ghost.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ọkan ni, máṣe ṣe ohun meji yi si mi, nigbana ni emi kì yio si fi ara mi pamọ, kuro fun ọ,
entries.en: Only do not two things unto me: then will I not hide myself from thee.

entries.yo: Fa ọwọ rẹ sẹhin kuro lara mi; má si jẹ ki ẹ̀ru rẹ ki o pá mi laiya.
entries.en: Withdraw thine hand far from me: and let not thy dread make me afraid.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ki iwọ ki o pè, emi o si dahùn, tabi jẹ ki nma sọ̀rọ, ki iwọ ki o si da mi lohùn.
entries.en: Then call thou, and I will answer: or let me speak, and answer thou me.

entries.yo: Melo li aiṣedede ati ẹ̀ṣẹ mi, mu mi mọ̀ irekọja ati ẹ̀ṣẹ mi!
entries.en: How many are mine iniquities and sins? make me to know my transgression and my sin.

entries.yo: Nitori kini iwọ ṣe pa oju rẹ mọ́, ti o si yàn mi li ọta rẹ?
entries.en: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, and holdest me for thine enemy?

entries.yo: Iwọ o fa ewe ya ti afẹfẹ nfẹ sihin sọhun: iwọ a si ma lepa akemọlẹ poroporo gbigbẹ!
entries.en: Wilt thou break a leaf driven to and fro? and wilt thou pursue the dry stubble?

entries.yo: Nitoripe iwọ kọwe ohun kikoro si mi, o si mu mi ni aiṣedede ewe mi.
entries.en: For thou writest bitter things against me, and makest me to possess the iniquities of my youth.

entries.yo: Iwọ kàn àba mọ mi lẹsẹ pẹlu, iwọ si nwò ipa ọ̀na irin mi li awofin, iwọ si nfi ãlà yi gigisẹ mi ka.
entries.en: Thou puttest my feet also in the stocks, and lookest narrowly unto all my paths; thou settest a print upon the heels of my feet.

entries.yo: Ani, yi ẹniti a ti run ka, bi ohun ti o bu, bi aṣọ ti kòkoro jẹ bajẹ.
entries.en: And he, as a rotten thing, consumeth, as a garment that is moth eaten.

entries.yo: ENIA ti a bi ninu obinrin ọlọjọ diẹ ni, o si kún fun ipọnju.
entries.en: Man that is born of a woman is of few days, and full of trouble.

entries.yo: O jade wá bi itana eweko, a si ke e lulẹ, o si nfò lọ bi ojiji, kò si duro pẹ́.
entries.en: He cometh forth like a flower, and is cut down: he fleeth also as a shadow, and continueth not.

entries.yo: Iwọ si nṣiju rẹ wò iru eyinì, iwọ si mu mi wá sinu idajọ pẹlu rẹ.
entries.en: And dost thou open thine eyes upon such an one, and bringest me into judgment with thee?

entries.yo: Tali o le mu ohun mimọ́ lati inu aimọ́ jade wá? kò si ẹnikan!
entries.en: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? not one.

entries.yo: Njẹ ati pinnu ọjọ rẹ̀, iye oṣu rẹ̀ mbẹ li ọwọ rẹ, iwọ ti pàla rẹ̀, bẹ̃li on kò le ikọja rẹ̀.
entries.en: Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months are with thee, thou hast appointed his bounds that he cannot pass;

entries.yo: Yipada kuro lọdọ rẹ̀, ki o le simi titi yio fi pé ọjọ rẹ̀ bi alagbaṣe.
entries.en: Turn from him, that he may rest, till he shall accomplish, as an hireling, his day.

entries.yo: Nitoripe abá wà fun igi, bi a ba ke e lulẹ, pe yio si tun sọ, ati pe ẹka rẹ̀ titun, kì yio dá.
entries.en: For there is hope of a tree, if it be cut down, that it will sprout again, and that the tender branch thereof will not cease.

entries.yo: Bi gbongbo rẹ̀ tilẹ di ogbó ninu ilẹ, ti kukute rẹ̀ si kú ni ilẹ.
entries.en: Though the root thereof wax old in the earth, and the stock thereof die in the ground;

entries.yo: Sibẹ nigbati o ba gbõrùn omi, yio sọ, yio si yọ ẹka jade bi eweko.
entries.en: Yet through the scent of water it will bud, and bring forth boughs like a plant.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn enia kú, a si ṣàn danu; ani enia jọwọ ẹmi rẹ̀ lọwọ, on ha da?
entries.en: But man dieth, and wasteth away: yea, man giveth up the ghost, and where is he?

entries.yo: Bi omi ti itán ninu ipa odò, ti odò si ifà ti si igbẹ.
entries.en: As the waters fail from the sea, and the flood decayeth and drieth up:

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li enia dubulẹ ti kò si dide mọ́, titi ọrun kì yio fi si mọ́, nwọn kì yio ji, a kì yio ji wọn kuro loju orun wọn.
entries.en: So man lieth down, and riseth not: till the heavens be no more, they shall not awake, nor be raised out of their sleep.

entries.yo: A! iwọ iba fi mi pamọ ni ipo-okú, ki iwọ ki o fi mi pamọ ni ìkọkọ, titi ibinu rẹ yio fi rekọja, iwọ iba lana igba kan silẹ fun mi, ki o si ranti mi.
entries.en: O that thou wouldest hide me in the grave, that thou wouldest keep me secret, until thy wrath be past, that thou wouldest appoint me a set time, and remember me!

entries.yo: Bi enia ba kú yio si tun yè bi? gbogbo ọjọ igba ti a là silẹ fun mi li emi o duro dè, titi amudọtun mi yio fi de.
entries.en: If a man die, shall he live again? all the days of my appointed time will I wait, till my change come.

entries.yo: Iwọ iba pè, emi iba si da ọ lohùn, iwọ o si ni ifẹ si iṣẹ ọwọ rẹ.
entries.en: Thou shalt call, and I will answer thee: thou wilt have a desire to the work of thine hands.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nisisiyi iwọ nkaye iṣisẹ mi, iwọ kò fà ọwọ rẹ kuro nitori ẹ̀ṣẹ mi.
entries.en: For now thou numberest my steps: dost thou not watch over my sin?

entries.yo: A fi edidi di irekọja mi sinu àpo, iwọ si rán aiṣedede mi pọ̀.
entries.en: My transgression is sealed up in a bag, and thou sewest up mine iniquity.

entries.yo: Ati nitotọ oke nla ti o ṣubu, o dasan, a si ṣi apata kuro ni ipo rẹ̀.
entries.en: And surely the mountain falling cometh to nought, and the rock is removed out of his place.

entries.yo: Omi a ma yinrin okuta, iwọ a si mu omi ṣàn bo ohun ti o hù jade lori ilẹ, iwọ si sọ ireti enia di ofo.
entries.en: The waters wear the stones: thou washest away the things which grow out of the dust of the earth; and thou destroyest the hope of man.

entries.yo: Iwọ si ṣẹgun rẹ̀ lailai, on si kọja lọ iwọ pa awọ oju rẹ̀ dà, o si ran a lọ kuro.
entries.en: Thou prevailest for ever against him, and he passeth: thou changest his countenance, and sendest him away.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ bọ́ si ipo ọlá, on kò si mọ̀, nwọn si rẹ̀ silẹ, on kò si kiyesi i lara wọn.
entries.en: His sons come to honour, and he knoweth it not; and they are brought low, but he perceiveth it not of them.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹran-ara rẹ̀ ni yio ri irora, ọkàn rẹ̀ ni yio si ma ni ibinujẹ ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: But his flesh upon him shall have pain, and his soul within him shall mourn.

entries.yo: NIGBANA ni Elifasi, ara Tema, dahùn wipe,
entries.en: Then answered Eliphaz the Temanite, and said,

entries.yo: Ọlọgbọ́n a ma sọ̀rọ ìmọ asan, ki o si ma fi afẹfẹ ila õrùn kún ara rẹ̀ ninu:
entries.en: Should a wise man utter vain knowledge, and fill his belly with the east wind?

entries.yo: On le ma fi aroye sọ̀rọ ti kò li ère, tabi pẹlu ọ̀rọ ninu eyiti kò le fi ṣe rere?
entries.en: Should he reason with unprofitable talk? or with speeches wherewith he can do no good?

entries.yo: Ani iwọ ṣa ìbẹru tì, iwọ si dí adura lọna niwaju Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Yea, thou castest off fear, and restrainest prayer before God.

entries.yo: Nitoripe ẹnu ara rẹ li o jẹwọ ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ, iwọ si yàn ahọn alarekereke li ãyò.
entries.en: For thy mouth uttereth thine iniquity, and thou choosest the tongue of the crafty.

entries.yo: Ẹnu ara rẹ li o da ọ lẹbi, kì iṣe emi, ani ète ara rẹ li o jẹri tì ọ.
entries.en: Thine own mouth condemneth thee, and not I: yea, thine own lips testify against thee.

entries.yo: Iwọ́ ha iṣe ọkunrin ti a kọ́ bi? tabi a ha dá ọ ṣaju awọn oke?
entries.en: Art thou the first man that was born? or wast thou made before the hills?

entries.yo: Iwọ gburo aṣiri Ọlọrun ri, tabi iwọ ha dá ọgbọ́n duro sọdọ ara rẹ?
entries.en: Hast thou heard the secret of God? and dost thou restrain wisdom to thyself?

entries.yo: Kini iwọ mọ̀ ti awa kò mọ̀, oye kili o ye ọ ti kò si ninu wa.
entries.en: What knowest thou, that we know not? what understandest thou, which is not in us?

entries.yo: Elewú ogbó ati ògbologbo enia wà pẹlu wa, ti nwọn gbó jù baba rẹ lọ.
entries.en: With us are both the grayheaded and very aged men, much elder than thy father.

entries.yo: Itunu Ọlọrun ha kere lọdọ rẹ, ọ̀rọ kan si ṣe jẹjẹ jù lọdọ rẹ.
entries.en: Are the consolations of God small with thee? is there any secret thing with thee?

entries.yo: Ẽṣe ti aiya rẹ fi ndà ọ kiri, tabi kini iwọ tẹjumọ wofin.
entries.en: Why doth thine heart carry thee away? and what do thy eyes wink at,

entries.yo: Ti iwọ fi yi ẹmi rẹ pada lodi si Ọlọrun, ti o fi njẹ ki ọ̀rọkọrọ ki o ma bọ li ẹnu rẹ bẹ̃?
entries.en: That thou turnest thy spirit against God, and lettest such words go out of thy mouth?

entries.yo: Kili enia ti o fi mọ́? ati ẹniti a tinu obinrin bi ti yio fi ṣe olododo?
entries.en: What is man, that he should be clean? and he which is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, on (Ọlọrun) kò gbẹkẹle awọn ẹni-mimọ́ rẹ̀, ani awọn ọrun kò mọ́ li oju rẹ̀.
entries.en: Behold, he putteth no trust in his saints; yea, the heavens are not clean in his sight.

entries.yo: Ambọtori enia, ẹni irira ati elẽri, ti nmu ẹ̀ṣẹ bi ẹni mu omi.
entries.en: How much more abominable and filthy is man, which drinketh iniquity like water?

entries.yo: Emi o fi hàn ọ, gbọ́ ti emi, eyi ti emi si ri, on li emi o si sọ.
entries.en: I will shew thee, hear me; and that which I have seen I will declare;

entries.yo: Ti awọn ọlọgbọ́n ti pa ni ìtan lati ọdọ awọn baba wọn wá, ti nwọn kò si fi pamọ́.
entries.en: Which wise men have told from their fathers, and have not hid it:

entries.yo: Awọn ti a fi ilẹ aiye fun nikan, alejo kan kò si là wọn kọja.
entries.en: Unto whom alone the earth was given, and no stranger passed among them.

entries.yo: Enia buburu nṣe lãlã, pẹlu irora li ọjọ rẹ̀ gbogbo, ati iye ọdun li a dá silẹ fun aninilara.
entries.en: The wicked man travaileth with pain all his days, and the number of years is hidden to the oppressor.

entries.yo: Iró ìbẹru mbẹ li eti rẹ̀, ninu irora ni alaparun a dide si i.
entries.en: A dreadful sound is in his ears: in prosperity the destroyer shall come upon him.

entries.yo: O kò gbagbọ pe on o jade kuro ninu okunkun; a si ṣa a sapakan fun idà.
entries.en: He believeth not that he shall return out of darkness, and he is waited for of the sword.

entries.yo: O nwò kakiri fun onjẹ, wipe, nibo li o wà, o mọ̀ pe ọjọ òkunkun sunmọ tosi.
entries.en: He wandereth abroad for bread, saying, Where is it? he knoweth that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.

entries.yo: Ipọnju pẹlu irora ọkàn yio mu u bẹ̀ru, nwọn o si ṣẹgun rẹ̀ bi ọba ti imura ogun.
entries.en: Trouble and anguish shall make him afraid; they shall prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle.

entries.yo: Nitoripe o ti nawọ rẹ̀ jade lodi si Ọlọrun, o si mura rẹ̀ le lodi si Olodumare.
entries.en: For he stretcheth out his hand against God, and strengtheneth himself against the Almighty.

entries.yo: O sure, o si fi ẹhin giga kọlu u, ani fi ike-koko apata rẹ̀ ti o nipọn.
entries.en: He runneth upon him, even on his neck, upon the thick bosses of his bucklers:

entries.yo: Nitoriti on fi ọra rẹ̀ bo ara rẹ̀ loju, o si ṣe jabajába ọra si ẹgbẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Because he covereth his face with his fatness, and maketh collops of fat on his flanks.

entries.yo: On si gbe inu ahoro ilu itakété, ati ninu ileyile ti enia kò gbe mọ́, ti o mura tan lati di àlapa.
entries.en: And he dwelleth in desolate cities, and in houses which no man inhabiteth, which are ready to become heaps.

entries.yo: On kò le ilà, bẹ̃ni ohun ini rẹ̀ kò le iduro pẹ, bẹ̃ni kò le imu pipé rẹ̀ duro pẹ lori aiye.
entries.en: He shall not be rich, neither shall his substance continue, neither shall he prolong the perfection thereof upon the earth.

entries.yo: On kì yio jade kuro ninu okunkun, ọ̀wọ-iná ni yio jo ẹká rẹ̀, ati nipasẹ ẹmi ẹnu rẹ̀ ni yio ma kọja lọ kuro.
entries.en: He shall not depart out of darkness; the flame shall dry up his branches, and by the breath of his mouth shall he go away.

entries.yo: Ki on ki o má ṣe gbẹkẹle asan, o tan ara rẹ̀ jẹ; nitoripe asan ni yio jasi ère rẹ̀.
entries.en: Let not him that is deceived trust in vanity: for vanity shall be his recompence.

entries.yo: A o mu u ṣẹ ṣaju pipe ọjọ rẹ̀, ẹka rẹ̀ kì yio si tutu.
entries.en: It shall be accomplished before his time, and his branch shall not be green.

entries.yo: Yio si gbòn talubọ eso rẹ̀ dànu bi àjara, yio si rẹ̀ itana rẹ̀ nù bi ti igi olifi.
entries.en: He shall shake off his unripe grape as the vine, and shall cast off his flower as the olive.

entries.yo: Nitoripe ajọ awọn àgabagebe yio tuka, iná ni yio si jo agọ abẹtẹlẹ.
entries.en: For the congregation of hypocrites shall be desolate, and fire shall consume the tabernacles of bribery.

entries.yo: Nwọn loyun ìwa-ika, nwọn si bi ẹ̀ṣẹ, ikùn wọn si pèse ẹ̀tan.
entries.en: They conceive mischief, and bring forth vanity, and their belly prepareth deceit.

entries.yo: NIGBANA ni Jobu dahùn o si wipe,
entries.en: Then Job answered and said,

entries.yo: Emi ti gbọ́ iru ohun pipọ bẹ̃ ri; ayọnilẹnu onitunu enia ni gbogbo nyin.
entries.en: I have heard many such things: miserable comforters are ye all.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ asan lè ni opin? tabi kili o gbó ọ laiya ti iwọ fi dahùn.
entries.en: Shall vain words have an end? or what emboldeneth thee that thou answerest?

entries.yo: Emi pẹlu le isọ bi ẹnyin, bi ọkàn nyin ba wà ni ipò ọkàn mi, emi le iko ọ̀rọ pọ̀ si nyin li ọrùn, emi a si mì ori mi si nyin.
entries.en: I also could speak as ye do: if your soul were in my soul's stead, I could heap up words against you, and shake mine head at you.

entries.yo: Emi iba fi ọ̀rọ ẹnu mi gbà nyin ni iyanju, ati ṣiṣi ète mi iba si tu ibinujẹ nyin.
entries.en: But I would strengthen you with my mouth, and the moving of my lips should asswage your grief.

entries.yo: Bi emi tilẹ sọ̀rọ ibinujẹ mi kò rù; bi mo si tilẹ dakẹ, nibo li itunu mi de?
entries.en: Though I speak, my grief is not asswaged: and though I forbear, what am I eased?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nisisiyi, o da mi lagara, iwọ (Ọlọrun) mu gbogbo ẹgbẹ mi takete.
entries.en: But now he hath made me weary: thou hast made desolate all my company.

entries.yo: Iwọ si fi ikiweje kún mi lara, ti o jẹri tì mi; ati rirù ti o yọ lara mi, o jẹri tì mi li oju.
entries.en: And thou hast filled me with wrinkles, which is a witness against me: and my leanness rising up in me beareth witness to my face.

entries.yo: Ibinu rẹ̀ li o fà mi ya, o si ṣọta mi; o pa ehin rẹ̀ keke si mi, ọta mi si gboju rẹ̀ si mi.
entries.en: He teareth me in his wrath, who hateth me: he gnasheth upon me with his teeth; mine enemy sharpeneth his eyes upon me.

entries.yo: Nwọn ti fi ẹnu wọn yán si mi, nwọn gbá mi li ẹrẹkẹ ni igbá ẹ̀gan, nwọn kó ara wọn jọ pọ̀ si mi.
entries.en: They have gaped upon me with their mouth; they have smitten me upon the cheek reproachfully; they have gathered themselves together against me.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun ti fi mi le ọwọ ẹni-buburu, o si mu mi ṣubu si ọwọ enia ẹlẹṣẹ.
entries.en: God hath delivered me to the ungodly, and turned me over into the hands of the wicked.

entries.yo: Mo ti joko jẹ, ṣugbọn o fa mi já o si dì mi li ọrùn mu, o si gbọ̀n mi tutu, o si gbe mi kalẹ ṣe àmi itasi rẹ̀.
entries.en: I was at ease, but he hath broken me asunder: he hath also taken me by my neck, and shaken me to pieces, and set me up for his mark.

entries.yo: Awọn tafatafa rẹ̀ duro yi mi kakiri; o là mi laiya pẹ̀rẹ kò si dasi, o si tú orõrò ara mi dà silẹ.
entries.en: His archers compass me round about, he cleaveth my reins asunder, and doth not spare; he poureth out my gall upon the ground.

entries.yo: Ibajẹ lori ibajẹ li o fi ba mi jẹ; o sure kọlù mi bi òmirán.
entries.en: He breaketh me with breach upon breach, he runneth upon me like a giant.

entries.yo: Mo rán aṣọ-apo bò ara mi, mo si rẹ̀ iwo mi silẹ ninu erupẹ.
entries.en: I have sewed sackcloth upon my skin, and defiled my horn in the dust.

entries.yo: Oju mi ti pọ́n fun ẹkún, ojiji ikú si ṣẹ si ipenpeju mi.
entries.en: My face is foul with weeping, and my eyelids is the shadow of death;

entries.yo: Kì iṣe nitori aiṣotitọ kan li ọwọ mi, adura mi si mọ́ pẹlu.
entries.en: Not for any injustice in mine hands: also my prayer is pure.

entries.yo: A! ilẹ aiye, iwọ máṣe bò ẹ̀jẹ mi, ki ẹkún mi máṣe ni ipò kan.
entries.en: O earth, cover not thou my blood, and let my cry have no place.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi kiyesi i! ẹlẹri mi mbẹ li ọrun, ẹri mi si mbẹ loke ọrun.
entries.en: Also now, behold, my witness is in heaven, and my record is on high.

entries.yo: Awọn ọre mi nfi mi ṣẹ̀sin, ṣugbọn oju mi ndà omije sọdọ Ọlọrun.
entries.en: My friends scorn me: but mine eye poureth out tears unto God.

entries.yo: Ibaṣepe ẹnikan le ma ṣe alagbawi fun ẹnikeji lọdọ Ọlọrun, bi enia kan ti iṣe alagbawi fun ẹnikeji rẹ̀.
entries.en: O that one might plead for a man with God, as a man pleadeth for his neighbour!

entries.yo: Nitori nigbati iye ọdun diẹ rekọja tan, nigbana ni emi o lọ si ibi ti emi kì yio pada bọ̀.
entries.en: When a few years are come, then I shall go the way whence I shall not return.

entries.yo: EMI mi bajẹ, ọjọ mi parun, isa-okú duro dè mi.
entries.en: My breath is corrupt, my days are extinct, the graves are ready for me.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ! awọn ẹlẹya wà lọdọ mi, oju mi si tẹmọ́ imunibinu wọn.
entries.en: Are there not mockers with me? and doth not mine eye continue in their provocation?

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, fi lelẹ! yàn onigbọwọ fun mi lọdọ rẹ; tani oluwa rẹ̀ ti yio ba mi so ọwọ pọ̀?
entries.en: Lay down now, put me in a surety with thee; who is he that will strike hands with me?

entries.yo: Nitoripe iwọ ti sé wọn laiya kuro ninu oye, nitorina iwọ kì yio gbé wọn leke.
entries.en: For thou hast hid their heart from understanding: therefore shalt thou not exalt them.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o fi awọn ọrẹ hàn fun igára, on ni oju awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ yio mu ofo.
entries.en: He that speaketh flattery to his friends, even the eyes of his children shall fail.

entries.yo: O si sọ mi di ẹni-owe fun awọn enia, niwaju wọn ni mo dabi ẹni itutọ́ si li oju.
entries.en: He hath made me also a byword of the people; and aforetime I was as a tabret.

entries.yo: Oju mi ṣú baibai pẹlu nitori ibinujẹ, gbogbo ẹ̀ya ara mi si dabi ojiji.
entries.en: Mine eye also is dim by reason of sorrow, and all my members are as a shadow.

entries.yo: Awọn olododo yio yanu si eyi, ẹni alaiṣẹ̀ si binu si awọn àgabagebe.
entries.en: Upright men shall be astonied at this, and the innocent shall stir up himself against the hypocrite.

entries.yo: Olododo pẹlu yio di ọ̀na rẹ̀ mu, ati ọlọwọ mimọ́ yio ma lera siwaju.
entries.en: The righteous also shall hold on his way, and he that hath clean hands shall be stronger and stronger.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi o ṣe ti gbogbo nyin, ẹ yipada, ki ẹ si tun bọ̀ nisisiyi, emi kò le ri ọlọgbón kan ninu nyin.
entries.en: But as for you all, do ye return, and come now: for I cannot find one wise man among you.

entries.yo: Ọjọ ti emi ti kọja, iro mi ti fà já, ani iro inu mi.
entries.en: My days are past, my purposes are broken off, even the thoughts of my heart.

entries.yo: A sọ oru di ọ̀san; nwọn ni, imọlẹ sunmọ ibiti òkunkun de.
entries.en: They change the night into day: the light is short because of darkness.

entries.yo: Bi mo tilẹ ni ireti, ipo-okú ni ile mi, mo ti tẹ bùsun mi sinu òkunkun.
entries.en: If I wait, the grave is mine house: I have made my bed in the darkness.

entries.yo: Emi ti wi fun idibajẹ pe, Iwọ ni baba mi, ati fun kòkoro pe, Iwọ ni iya mi ati arabinrin mi.
entries.en: I have said to corruption, Thou art my father: to the worm, Thou are my mother, and my sister.

entries.yo: Ireti mi ha dà nisisiyi? bi o ṣe ti ireti mi ni, tani yio ri i?
entries.en: And where is now my hope? as for my hope, who shall see it?

entries.yo: O sọkalẹ lọ sinu ọgbun ipo-okú, nigbati a jumọ simi pọ̀ ninu erupẹ ilẹ.
entries.en: They shall go down to the bars of the pit, when our rest together is in the dust.

entries.yo: NIGBANA ni Bildadi, ara Ṣua, dahùn o si wipe,
entries.en: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,

entries.yo: Nigba wo li ẹnyin o to fi idi ọ̀rọ tì; ẹ rò o, nigbẹhin rẹ̀ li awa o to ma sọ.
entries.en: How long will it be ere ye make an end of words? mark, and afterwards we will speak.

entries.yo: Nitori kili a ṣe nkà wa si bi ẹranko, ti a si nkà wa si bi ẹni ẹ̀gan li oju nyin!
entries.en: Wherefore are we counted as beasts, and reputed vile in your sight?

entries.yo: Iwọ nfa ara rẹ ya pẹrẹpẹrẹ ninu ibinu rẹ, ki a ha kọ̀ aiye silẹ nitori rẹ bi? tabi ki a ṣi apata kuro ni ipo rẹ̀?
entries.en: He teareth himself in his anger: shall the earth be forsaken for thee? and shall the rock be removed out of his place?

entries.yo: Nitotọ imọlẹ enia buburu li a o pa kuro, ọ̀wọ-iná rẹ̀ kì yio si tan imọlẹ:
entries.en: Yea, the light of the wicked shall be put out, and the spark of his fire shall not shine.

entries.yo: Imọlẹ yio ṣokunkun ninu agọ rẹ̀, fitila rẹ̀ li a o si pa pẹlu rẹ̀.
entries.en: The light shall be dark in his tabernacle, and his candle shall be put out with him.

entries.yo: Irin ẹsẹ agbara rẹ̀ yio di fifọn, ìmọ on tikararẹ ni yio bi i ṣubu.
entries.en: The steps of his strength shall be straitened, and his own counsel shall cast him down.

entries.yo: Nipa ẹsẹ on tikararẹ̀ o ti bọ́ sinu àwọn, o si rìn lori okùn didẹ.
entries.en: For he is cast into a net by his own feet, and he walketh upon a snare.

entries.yo: Okùn ẹgẹ́ ni yio mu u ni gigĩsẹ, awọn igara yio si ṣẹgun rẹ̀.
entries.en: The gin shall take him by the heel, and the robber shall prevail against him.

entries.yo: A dẹkùn silẹ fun u lori ilẹ, a si wà ọ̀fin fun u loju ọ̀na.
entries.en: The snare is laid for him in the ground, and a trap for him in the way.

entries.yo: Ẹ̀ru nla yio bà a ni iha gbogbo, yio si le e de ẹsẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Terrors shall make him afraid on every side, and shall drive him to his feet.

entries.yo: Ailera rẹ̀ yio di pipa fun ebi, iparun yio dide duro si i ni iha rẹ̀.
entries.en: His strength shall be hungerbitten, and destruction shall be ready at his side.

entries.yo: Yio jẹ ẹ̀ya ara rẹ̀, akọbi ikú ni yio jẹ agbara rẹ̀ run.
entries.en: It shall devour the strength of his skin: even the firstborn of death shall devour his strength.

entries.yo: Eyi ti o ti gbẹkẹle ni a o fàtu kuro ninu agọ rẹ̀, yio si tọ̀ ọba ẹ̀ru nla nì lọ.
entries.en: His confidence shall be rooted out of his tabernacle, and it shall bring him to the king of terrors.

entries.yo: Yio si ma joko ninu agọ rẹ̀ eyi ti kì iṣe tirẹ̀, imi-õrùn li a ọ fún kakiri si ara ile rẹ̀.
entries.en: It shall dwell in his tabernacle, because it is none of his: brimstone shall be scattered upon his habitation.

entries.yo: Gbongbo rẹ̀ yio gbẹ nisalẹ, a o si ke ẹ̀ka rẹ̀ kuro loke.
entries.en: His roots shall be dried up beneath, and above shall his branch be cut off.

entries.yo: Iranti rẹ̀ yio parun kuro li aiye, kì yio si orukọ rẹ̀ ni igboro ilu.
entries.en: His remembrance shall perish from the earth, and he shall have no name in the street.

entries.yo: A o si le e lati inu imọlẹ sinu òkunkun, a o si le e kuro li aiye.
entries.en: He shall be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.

entries.yo: Kì yio ni ọmọ bibikunrin tabi ajọbi-kunrin ninu awọn enia rẹ̀, bẹ̃ni kò si ẹnikan ti o kù ninu agbo ile rẹ̀.
entries.en: He shall neither have son nor nephew among his people, nor any remaining in his dwellings.

entries.yo: Ẹnu yio ya awọn iran ti ìwọ-õrùn si igba ọjọ rẹ̀, gẹgẹ bi ẹ̀ru iwariri ti ba awọn iran ti ila-õrùn.
entries.en: They that come after him shall be astonied at his day, as they that went before were affrighted.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ iru-bẹ̃ ni ibujoko awọn enia buburu, eyi si ni ipo ẹni ti kò mọ̀ Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Surely such are the dwellings of the wicked, and this is the place of him that knoweth not God.

entries.yo: NIGBANA ni Jobu dahùn o si wipe,
entries.en: Then Job answered and said,

entries.yo: Yio ti pẹ to ti ẹnyin o fi ma bà mi ninu jẹ, ti ẹnyin o fi ma fi ọ̀rọ kun mi ni ìjanja?
entries.en: How long will ye vex my soul, and break me in pieces with words?

entries.yo: Igba mẹwa li ẹnyin ti ngàn mi, oju kò tì nyin ti ẹ fi jẹ mi niya.
entries.en: These ten times have ye reproached me: ye are not ashamed that ye make yourselves strange to me.

entries.yo: Ki a fi sí bẹ̃ pe, mo ṣìna nitõtọ, ìṣina mi wà lara emi tikarami.
entries.en: And be it indeed that I have erred, mine error remaineth with myself.

entries.yo: Bi o tilẹ ṣepe ẹnyin o ṣogo si mi lori nitõtọ, ti ẹ o si ma fi ẹ̀gan mi gun mi loju.
entries.en: If indeed ye will magnify yourselves against me, and plead against me my reproach:

entries.yo: Ki ẹ mọ̀ nisisiyi pe: Ọlọrun li o bì mi ṣubu, o si nà àwọn rẹ̀ yi mi ka.
entries.en: Know now that God hath overthrown me, and hath compassed me with his net.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, emi nkigbe pe, Ọwọ́ alagbara! ṣugbọn a kò gbọ́ ti emi; mo kigbe soke, bẹ̃ni kò si idajọ.
entries.en: Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard: I cry aloud, but there is no judgment.

entries.yo: O sọ̀gba di ọ̀na mi ti emi kò le kọja, o si mu òkunkun ṣú si ipa ọ̀na mi:
entries.en: He hath fenced up my way that I cannot pass, and he hath set darkness in my paths.

entries.yo: O ti bọ́ ogo mi, o si ṣi ade kuro li ori mi.
entries.en: He hath stripped me of my glory, and taken the crown from my head.

entries.yo: O ti bà mi jẹ ni iha gbogbo, ẹmi si pin; ireti mi li a o si fatu bi igi:
entries.en: He hath destroyed me on every side, and I am gone: and mine hope hath he removed like a tree.

entries.yo: O si tinabọ ibinu rẹ̀ si mi, o si kà mi si bi ọkan ninu awọn ọta rẹ̀.
entries.en: He hath also kindled his wrath against me, and he counteth me unto him as one of his enemies.

entries.yo: Ẹgbẹ́ ogun rẹ̀ si dàpọ si mi, nwọn si tẹgun si mi, nwọn si dó yi agọ mi ka.
entries.en: His troops come together, and raise up their way against me, and encamp round about my tabernacle.

entries.yo: O mu awọn arakunrin mi jina si mi rére, ati awọn ojulumọ mi di ajeji si mi nitõtọ.
entries.en: He hath put my brethren far from me, and mine acquaintance are verily estranged from me.

entries.yo: Awọn ajọbi mi fà sẹhin, awọn afaramọ́ ọrẹ mi si di onigbagbe mi.
entries.en: My kinsfolk have failed, and my familiar friends have forgotten me.

entries.yo: Awọn ara inu ile mi ati awọn ọmọbinrin iranṣẹ mi kà mi si ajeji, emi jasi ajeji enia li oju wọn.
entries.en: They that dwell in mine house, and my maids, count me for a stranger: I am an alien in their sight.

entries.yo: Mo pè iranṣẹ mi, on kò si da mi lohùn, mo fi ẹnu mi bẹ̀ ẹ.
entries.en: I called my servant, and he gave me no answer; I intreated him with my mouth.

entries.yo: Ẹmi mi sú aya mi, ati õrùn mi sú awọn ọmọ inu iya mi.
entries.en: My breath is strange to my wife, though I intreated for the children's sake of mine own body.

entries.yo: Ani awọn ọmọde fi mi ṣẹsin: mo dide, nwọn si sọ̀rọ ẹ̀gan si mi.
entries.en: Yea, young children despised me; I arose, and they spake against me.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn ọrẹ idimọpọ mi korira mi, awọn olufẹ mi si kẹ̀hinda mi.
entries.en: All my inward friends abhorred me: and they whom I loved are turned against me.

entries.yo: Egungun mi lẹ mọ́ awọ ara mi ati mọ́ ẹran ara mi, mo si bọ́ pẹlu awọ ehin mi.
entries.en: My bone cleaveth to my skin and to my flesh, and I am escaped with the skin of my teeth.

entries.yo: Ẹ ṣãnu fun mi, ẹ ṣãnu fun mi, ẹnyin ọrẹ mi, nitori ọwọ Ọlọrun ti bà mi.
entries.en: Have pity upon me, have pity upon me, O ye my friends; for the hand of God hath touched me.

entries.yo: Nitori kili ẹnyin ṣe lepa mi bi Ọlọrun, ti ẹran ara mi kò tẹ́ nyin lọrùn!
entries.en: Why do ye persecute me as God, and are not satisfied with my flesh?

entries.yo: A! Ibaṣepe a le kọwe ọ̀rọ mi nisisiyi, ibaṣepe a le dà a sinu iwe!
entries.en: Oh that my words were now written! oh that they were printed in a book!

entries.yo: Ki a fi kalamu irin ati ti ojé kọ́ wọn sinu apata fun lailai.
entries.en: That they were graven with an iron pen and lead in the rock for ever!

entries.yo: Ati emi, emi mọ̀ pe Oludande mi mbẹ li ãyè, ati pe on bi Ẹni-ikẹhin ni yio dide soke lori erupẹ ilẹ.
entries.en: For I know that my redeemer liveth, and that he shall stand at the latter day upon the earth:

entries.yo: Ati lẹhin igba awọ ara mi, ti a ti ke e kuro bi iru eyi, ati laili ẹran ara mi li emi o ri Ọlọrun,
entries.en: And though after my skin worms destroy this body, yet in my flesh shall I see God:

entries.yo: Ẹniti emi o ri fun ara mi, ti oju mi o si wò, kì si iṣe ti ẹlomiran; ọkàn mi si dáku ni inu mi.
entries.en: Whom I shall see for myself, and mine eyes shall behold, and not another; though my reins be consumed within me.

entries.yo: Bi ẹnyin ba wipe, Awa o ti lepa rẹ̀ to! ati pe, gbongbo ọ̀rọ na li a sa ri li ọwọ mi,
entries.en: But ye should say, Why persecute we him, seeing the root of the matter is found in me?

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o bẹ̀ru idà; nitoripe ibinu ni imu ijiya idà wá: ki ẹnyin ki o lè imọ̀ pe idajọ kan mbẹ.
entries.en: Be ye afraid of the sword: for wrath bringeth the punishments of the sword, that ye may know there is a judgment.

entries.yo: NIGBANA ni Sofari, ara Naama, dahùn o si wipe,
entries.en: Then answered Zophar the Naamathite, and said,
Therefore do my thoughts cause me to answer, and for this I make haste.
I have heard the check of my reproach, and the spirit of my understanding causeth me to answer.
Knowest thou not this of old, since man was placed upon earth,
That the triumphing of the wicked is short, and the joy of the hypocrite but for a moment?
Though his excellency mount up to the heavens, and his head reach unto the clouds;
Yet he shall perish for ever like his own dung: they which have seen him shall say, Where is he?
He shall fly away as a dream, and shall not be found: yea, he shall be chased away as a vision of the night.
The eye also which saw him shall see him no more; neither shall his place any more behold him.
His children shall seek to please the poor, and his hands shall restore their goods.
His bones are full of the sin of his youth, which shall lie down with him in the dust.
Though wickedness be sweet in his mouth, though he hide it under his tongue;
Though he spare it, and forsake it not; but keep it still within his mouth:
Yet his meat in his bowels is turned, it is the gall of asps within him.
He hath swallowed down riches, and he shall vomit them up again: God shall cast them out of his belly.
He shall suck the poison of asps: the viper's tongue shall slay him.
He shall not see the rivers, the floods, the brooks of honey and butter.
That which he laboured for shall he restore, and shall not swallow it down: according to his substance shall the restitution be, and he shall not rejoice therein.
Because he hath oppressed and hath forsaken the poor; because he hath violently taken away an house which he builded not;
Surely he shall not feel quietness in his belly, he shall not save of that which he desired.
There shall none of his meat be left; therefore shall no man look for his goods.
In the fulness of his sufficiency he shall be in straits: every hand of the wicked shall come upon him.
When he is about to fill his belly, God shall cast the fury of his wrath upon him, and shall rain it upon him while he is eating.
He shall flee from the iron weapon, and the bow of steel shall strike him through.
It is drawn, and cometh out of the body; yea, the glittering sword cometh out of his gall: terrors are upon him.
All darkness shall be hid in his secret places: a fire not blown shall consume him; it shall go ill with him that is left in his tabernacle.
The heaven shall reveal his iniquity; and the earth shall rise up against him.
The increase of his house shall depart, and his goods shall flow away in the day of his wrath.
This is the portion of a wicked man from God, and the heritage appointed unto him by God.

entries.yo: SUGBỌN Jobu dahùn, o si wipe,
entries.en: But Job answered and said,

entries.yo: Ẹ tẹti silẹ dẹdẹ si ohùn mi, ki eyi ki o jasi itunu nyin.
entries.en: Hear diligently my speech, and let this be your consolations.

entries.yo: Ẹ jọwọ mi ki emi sọ̀rọ, lẹhin igbati mo ba sọ tan, iwọ ma fi ṣẹsin nṣo.
entries.en: Suffer me that I may speak; and after that I have spoken, mock on.

entries.yo: Bi o ṣe ti emi ni, aroye mi iṣe si enia bi, tabi ẽtiṣe ti ọkàn mi kì yio fi ṣe aibalẹ?
entries.en: As for me, is my complaint to man? and if it were so, why should not my spirit be troubled?

entries.yo: Ẹ wò mi fin, ki ẹnu ki o si yà nyin, ki ẹ si fi ọwọ le ẹnu nyin.
entries.en: Mark me, and be astonished, and lay your hand upon your mouth.

entries.yo: Ani nigbati mo ranti, ẹ̀ru bà mi, iwarìri si mu mi lara.
entries.en: Even when I remember I am afraid, and trembling taketh hold on my flesh.

entries.yo: Nitori kini enia buburu fi wà li ãyè, ti nwọn gbọ́, ani ti nwọn di alagbara ni ipa!
entries.en: Wherefore do the wicked live, become old, yea, are mighty in power?

entries.yo: Iru-ọmọ wọn fi idi kalẹ li oju wọn pẹlu wọn, ati ọmọ-ọmọ wọn li oju wọn.
entries.en: Their seed is established in their sight with them, and their offspring before their eyes.

entries.yo: Ile wọn wà laini ewu, bẹ̃ni ọpa-ìna Ọlọrun kò si lara wọn.
entries.en: Their houses are safe from fear, neither is the rod of God upon them.

entries.yo: Akọ-malu wọn a ma gùn, kì isi isé, abomalu wọn a ma bi, ki isi iṣẹnu;
entries.en: Their bull gendereth, and faileth not; their cow calveth, and casteth not her calf.

entries.yo: Nwọn a ma rán awọn ọmọ wọn wẹwẹ jade bi agbo ẹran, awọn ọmọ wọn a si ma jó.
entries.en: They send forth their little ones like a flock, and their children dance.

entries.yo: Nwọn mu ohun ọnà orin timbreli ati dùru, nwọn si nyọ̀ si ohùn ifère.
entries.en: They take the timbrel and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the organ.

entries.yo: Nwọn lo ọjọ wọn ninu ọrọ̀; ni iṣẹjukan nwọn a lọ si ipo-okú.
entries.en: They spend their days in wealth, and in a moment go down to the grave.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni nwọn ṣe wi fun Ọlọrun pe, Lọ kuro lọdọ wa, nitoripe awa kò fẹ ìmọ ipa ọ̀na rẹ!
entries.en: Therefore they say unto God, Depart from us; for we desire not the knowledge of thy ways.

entries.yo: Kini Olodumare ti awa o fi ma sin i? ere kili a o si jẹ bi awa ba gbadura si i!
entries.en: What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? and what profit should we have, if we pray unto him?

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, alafia wọn kò si nipa ọwọ wọn, ìmọ enia buburu jina si mi rére.
entries.en: Lo, their good is not in their hand: the counsel of the wicked is far from me.

entries.yo: Igba melomelo ni a npa fitila enia buburu kú? igba melomelo ni iparun wọn de ba wọn, ti Ọlọrun isi ma pin ibinujẹ ninu ibinu rẹ̀.
entries.en: How oft is the candle of the wicked put out! and how oft cometh their destruction upon them! God distributeth sorrows in his anger.

entries.yo: Nwọn dabi akeku oko niwaju afẹfẹ, ati bi iyangbo, ti ẹfufu-nla fẹ lọ.
entries.en: They are as stubble before the wind, and as chaff that the storm carrieth away.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun to ìya-ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ̀ jọ fun awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, o san a fun u, yio si mọ̀ ọ.
entries.en: God layeth up his iniquity for his children: he rewardeth him, and he shall know it.
