entries.yo: Oju rẹ̀ yio ri iparun ara rẹ̀, yio si ma mu ninu riru ibinu Olodumare.
entries.en: His eyes shall see his destruction, and he shall drink of the wrath of the Almighty.

entries.yo: Nitoripe alafia kili o ni ninu ile rẹ̀ lẹhin rẹ̀, nigbati a ba ke iye oṣù rẹ̀ kuro li agbedemeji?
entries.en: For what pleasure hath he in his house after him, when the number of his months is cut off in the midst?

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni le ikọ́ Ọlọrun ni ìmọ? on ni sa nṣe idajọ ẹni ibi giga.
entries.en: Shall any teach God knowledge? seeing he judgeth those that are high.

entries.yo: Ẹnikan a kú ninu pipé agbara rẹ̀, ti o wà ninu irọra ati idakẹ patapata.
entries.en: One dieth in his full strength, being wholly at ease and quiet.

entries.yo: Ọpọ́n rẹ̀ kún fun omi-ọmú, egungun rẹ̀ si tutu fun ọra.
entries.en: His breasts are full of milk, and his bones are moistened with marrow.

entries.yo: Ẹlomiran a si kú ninu kikoro ọkàn rẹ̀, ti kò si fi inu didun jẹun.
entries.en: And another dieth in the bitterness of his soul, and never eateth with pleasure.

entries.yo: Nwọn o dubulẹ bakanna ninu erupẹ, kòkoro yio si ṣùbo wọn.
entries.en: They shall lie down alike in the dust, and the worms shall cover them.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, emi mọ̀ iro inu nyin ati arekereke ti ẹnyin fi gba dulumọ si mi.
entries.en: Behold, I know your thoughts, and the devices which ye wrongfully imagine against me.

entries.yo: Nitoriti ẹnyin wipe, nibo ni ile awọn ọmọ alade, ati nibo ni agọ awọn enia buburu nì gbe wà?
entries.en: For ye say, Where is the house of the prince? and where are the dwelling places of the wicked?

entries.yo: Ẹnyin kò bere lọwọ awọn ti nkọja lọ li ọ̀na, ẹnyin kò mọ̀ àmi wọn? pe,
entries.en: Have ye not asked them that go by the way? and do ye not know their tokens,

entries.yo: Enia buburu ni a fi pamọ fun ọjọ iparun, a o si mu wọn jade li ọjọ riru ibinu.
entries.en: That the wicked is reserved to the day of destruction? they shall be brought forth to the day of wrath.

entries.yo: Tani yio sọ ipa-ọ̀na rẹ̀ kò o li oju, tani yio si san pada fun u li eyi ti o ti ṣe?
entries.en: Who shall declare his way to his face? and who shall repay him what he hath done?

entries.yo: Sibẹ a o si sin i li ọ̀na ipo-okú, yio si ma ṣọ́ ororì okú.
entries.en: Yet shall he be brought to the grave, and shall remain in the tomb.

entries.yo: Ogulutu ọfin yio dùn mọ ọ, gbogbo enia yio si ma tọ̀ ọ lẹhin, bi enia ainiye ti lọ ṣiwaju rẹ̀.
entries.en: The clods of the valley shall be sweet unto him, and every man shall draw after him, as there are innumerable before him.

entries.yo: E ha ti ṣe ti ẹnyin fi ntù mi ninu lasan! bi o ṣepe ni idahùn nyin eké kù nibẹ.
entries.en: How then comfort ye me in vain, seeing in your answers there remaineth falsehood?

entries.yo: NIGBANA ni Elifasi, ara Tema, dahùn wipe,
entries.en: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,

entries.yo: Enia le iṣe rere fun Ọlọrun, bi ọlọgbọ́n ti iṣe rere fun ara rẹ̀.
entries.en: Can a man be profitable unto God, as he that is wise may be profitable unto himself?

entries.yo: Ohun ayọ̀ ha ni fun Olodumare pe, olododo ni iwọ? tabi ere ni fun u, ti iwọ mu ọ̀na rẹ pé?
entries.en: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty, that thou art righteous? or is it gain to him that thou makest thy ways perfect?

entries.yo: Yio ha ba ọ wi bi nitori ìbẹru Ọlọrun rẹ, yio ha ba ọ lọ sinu idajọ bi?
entries.en: Will he reprove thee for fear of thee? will he enter with thee into judgment?

entries.yo: Iwa-buburu rẹ kò ha tobi, ati ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ lainiye?
entries.en: Is not thy wickedness great? and thine iniquities infinite?

entries.yo: Nitõtọ iwọ gbà ohun ẹri li ọwọ arakunrin rẹ lainidi, iwọ si tú onihoho li aṣọ wọn.
entries.en: For thou hast taken a pledge from thy brother for nought, and stripped the naked of their clothing.

entries.yo: Iwọ kò fi omi fun alãrẹ mu, iwọ si hawọ onjẹ fun ẹniti ebi npa.
entries.en: Thou hast not given water to the weary to drink, and thou hast withholden bread from the hungry.

entries.yo: Bi o ṣe ti alagbara nì ni, on li o ni aiye, ọlọla si tẹdo sinu rẹ̀.
entries.en: But as for the mighty man, he had the earth; and the honourable man dwelt in it.

entries.yo: Iwọ ti rán awọn opó pada lọ li ọwọ ofo, apa awọn ọmọ alainibaba ti di ṣiṣẹ́.
entries.en: Thou has sent widows away empty, and the arms of the fatherless have been broken.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni idẹkun ṣe yi ọ kakiri, ati ìbẹru ojiji nyọ ọ lẹnu.
entries.en: Therefore snares are round about thee, and sudden fear troubleth thee;

entries.yo: Tabi iwọ kò ha ri okunkun, ati ọ̀pọlọpọ omi ti o bò ọ mọlẹ?
entries.en: Or darkness, that thou canst not see; and abundance of waters cover thee.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun kò ha jẹ Ẹni giga ọrun? sa wò ori awọn ìrawọ̀ bi nwọn ti ga tó!
entries.en: Is not God in the height of heaven? and behold the height of the stars, how high they are!

entries.yo: Iwọ si wipe, Ọlọrun ti ṣe mọ̀, on ha le iṣe idajọ lati inu awọsanma dudu wá bi?
entries.en: And thou sayest, How doth God know? can he judge through the dark cloud?

entries.yo: Awọsanma ti o nipọn ni ibora fun u, ti kò fi le riran; o si rin ninu ayika ọrun.
entries.en: Thick clouds are a covering to him, that he seeth not; and he walketh in the circuit of heaven.

entries.yo: Iwọ fẹ rìn ipa-ọ̀na igbani ti awọn enia buburu ti rìn.
entries.en: Hast thou marked the old way which wicked men have trodden?

entries.yo: Ti a ke lulẹ kuro ninu aiye laipé ọjọ wọn, ipilẹ wọn ti de bi odò ṣiṣàn.
entries.en: Which were cut down out of time, whose foundation was overflown with a flood:

entries.yo: Awọn ẹniti o wi fun Ọlọrun pe, Lọ kuro lọdọ wa! Kini Olodumare yio ṣe fun wọn.
entries.en: Which said unto God, Depart from us: and what can the Almighty do for them?

entries.yo: Sibẹ o fi ohun rere kún ile wọn! ṣugbọn ìmọ enia-buburu jìna si mi!
entries.en: Yet he filled their houses with good things: but the counsel of the wicked is far from me.

entries.yo: Awọn olododo ri i, nwọn si yọ̀, awọn alailẹ̀ṣẹ si fi wọn rẹrin ẹlẹya pe:
entries.en: The righteous see it, and are glad: and the innocent laugh them to scorn.

entries.yo: Lotitọ awọn ọta wa ni a ke kuro, iná yio si jó iyokù wọn run.
entries.en: Whereas our substance is not cut down, but the remnant of them the fire consumeth.

entries.yo: Fa ara rẹ sunmọ Ọlọrun, iwọ o si ri alafia; nipa eyinì rere yio wá ba ọ.
entries.en: Acquaint now thyself with him, and be at peace: thereby good shall come unto thee.

entries.yo: Emi bẹ̀ ọ, gba ofin lati ẹnu rẹ̀ wá, ki o si tò ọ̀rọ rẹ̀ si aiya rẹ.
entries.en: Receive, I pray thee, the law from his mouth, and lay up his words in thine heart.

entries.yo: Bi iwọ ba yipada sọdọ Olodumare, a si gbe ọ ró, bi iwọ ba si mu ẹ̀ṣẹ jina rére kuro ninu agọ rẹ.
entries.en: If thou return to the Almighty, thou shalt be built up, thou shalt put away iniquity far from thy tabernacles.

entries.yo: Ti iwọ ba tẹ wura daradara silẹ lori erupẹ ati wura ófiri labẹ okuta odò.
entries.en: Then shalt thou lay up gold as dust, and the gold of Ophir as the stones of the brooks.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Olodumare yio jẹ iṣura rẹ, ani yio si jẹ fadaka fun ọ ni ọ̀pọlọpọ.
entries.en: Yea, the Almighty shall be thy defence, and thou shalt have plenty of silver.

entries.yo: Lotitọ nigbana ni iwọ o ni inu didùn ninu Olodumare, iwọ o si gbe oju rẹ soke sọdọ Ọlọrun.
entries.en: For then shalt thou have thy delight in the Almighty, and shalt lift up thy face unto God.

entries.yo: Bi iwọ ba gbadura rẹ sọdọ rẹ̀, yio si gbọ́ tirẹ, iwọ o si san ẹ̀jẹ́ rẹ.
entries.en: Thou shalt make thy prayer unto him, and he shall hear thee, and thou shalt pay thy vows.

entries.yo: Iwọ si gbimọ ohun kan pẹlu, yio si fi idi mulẹ fun ọ; imọlẹ yio si mọ́ sipa ọ̀na rẹ.
entries.en: Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee: and the light shall shine upon thy ways.

entries.yo: Nigbati ipa-ọ̀na rẹ ba lọ sisalẹ, nigbana ni iwọ o wipe, Igbesoke mbẹ! Ọlọrun yio si gba onirẹlẹ là!
entries.en: When men are cast down, then thou shalt say, There is lifting up; and he shall save the humble person.

entries.yo: Yio gba ẹniti kì iṣe alaijẹbi là, a o si gbà a nipa mimọ́ ọwọ rẹ.
entries.en: He shall deliver the island of the innocent: and it is delivered by the pureness of thine hands.

entries.yo: NIGBANA ni Jobu si dahùn wipe,
entries.en: Then Job answered and said,

entries.yo: Ani loni ni ọ̀ran mi korò; ọwọ mi si wuwo si ikerora mi.
entries.en: Even to day is my complaint bitter: my stroke is heavier than my groaning.

entries.yo: A! emi iba mọ̀ ibi ti emi iba wá Ọlọrun ri! ki emi ki o tọ̀ ọ lọ si ibujoko rẹ̀,
entries.en: Oh that I knew where I might find him! that I might come even to his seat!

entries.yo: Emi iba si tò ọran na niwaju rẹ̀, ẹnu mi iba si kún fun aroye.
entries.en: I would order my cause before him, and fill my mouth with arguments.

entries.yo: Emi iba si mọ̀ ọ̀rọ ti on iba fi da mi lohùn, oye ohun ti iba wi a si ye mi.
entries.en: I would know the words which he would answer me, and understand what he would say unto me.

entries.yo: Yio ha fi agbara nla ba mi wijọ bi? agbẹdọ̀! kiki on o si kiyesi mi:
entries.en: Will he plead against me with his great power? No; but he would put strength in me.

entries.yo: Nibẹ li olododo le iba a wijọ, bẹ̃li emi o si bọ́ li ọwọ onidajọ mi lailai.
entries.en: There the righteous might dispute with him; so should I be delivered for ever from my judge.

entries.yo: Si wò! bi emi ba lọ si iha ila-õrùn, on kò si nibẹ, ati si iwọ-õrùn ni, emi kò si roye rẹ̀:
entries.en: Behold, I go forward, but he is not there; and backward, but I cannot perceive him:

entries.yo: Niha ariwa bi o ba ṣiṣẹ nibẹ, emi kò ri i, o fi ara rẹ̀ pamọ niha gusu, ti emi kò le ri i.
entries.en: On the left hand, where he doth work, but I cannot behold him: he hideth himself on the right hand, that I cannot see him:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn on mọ̀ ọ̀na ti emi ntọ̀, nigbati o ba dan mi wò, emi o jade bi wura.
entries.en: But he knoweth the way that I take: when he hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold.

entries.yo: Ẹsẹ mi ti tẹle ipasẹ irin rẹ, ọ̀na rẹ̀ ni mo ti kiyesi, ti nkò si yà kuro.
entries.en: My foot hath held his steps, his way have I kept, and not declined.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni emi kò pada sẹhin kuro ninu ofin ẹnu rẹ̀, emi si pa ọ̀rọ ẹnu rẹ̀ mọ́ jù ofin inu mi lọ.
entries.en: Neither have I gone back from the commandment of his lips; I have esteemed the words of his mouth more than my necessary food.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn oninukan li on, tani yio si yi i pada? Eyiti ọkàn rẹ̀ si ti fẹ, eyi na ni iṣe.
entries.en: But he is in one mind, and who can turn him? and what his soul desireth, even that he doeth.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ ohun ti ati yàn silẹ fun mi ni nṣe, ọ̀pọlọpọ iru bẹ li o wà li ọwọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: For he performeth the thing that is appointed for me: and many such things are with him.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni ara ko ṣe rọ̀ mi niwaju rẹ̀, nigbati mo ba rò o, ẹ̀ru a ba mi.
entries.en: Therefore am I troubled at his presence: when I consider, I am afraid of him.

entries.yo: Nitoripe Ọlọrun ti pá mi li aiya, Olodumare si ndamu mi.
entries.en: For God maketh my heart soft, and the Almighty troubleth me:

entries.yo: Nitoriti a kò ti ke mi kuro niwaju òkunkun, bẹ̃ni kò pa òkùnkùn-biribiri mọ kuro niwaju mi.
entries.en: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, neither hath he covered the darkness from my face.

entries.yo: ẼṢE bi igba-igba kò pamọ lọdọ Olodumare; ti awọn ojulumọ rẹ̀ kò ri ọjọ rẹ̀?
entries.en: Why, seeing times are not hidden from the Almighty, do they that know him not see his days?

entries.yo: Nwọn a ṣi àmi àla ilẹ, nwọn a fi agbara ko agbo ẹran lọ, nwọn si bọ́ wọn.
entries.en: Some remove the landmarks; they violently take away flocks, and feed thereof.

entries.yo: Nwọn a si dà kẹtẹkẹtẹ alainibaba lọ, nwọn a si gba ọdá-malu opó li ohun ògo.
entries.en: They drive away the ass of the fatherless, they take the widow's ox for a pledge.

entries.yo: Nwọn a bì alaini kuro loju ọ̀na, awọn talaka aiye a sa pamọ́ pọ̀.
entries.en: They turn the needy out of the way: the poor of the earth hide themselves together.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, bi kẹtẹkẹtẹ igbẹ ninu ijù ni nwọn ijade lọ si iṣẹ wọn; nwọn a tete dide lati wá ohun ọdẹ; ijù pese onjẹ fun wọn ati fun awọn ọmọ wọn.
entries.en: Behold, as wild asses in the desert, go they forth to their work; rising betimes for a prey: the wilderness yieldeth food for them and for their children.

entries.yo: Olukuluku a si ṣa ọka onjẹ-ẹran rẹ̀ ninu oko, nwọn a si ká ọgba-ajara enia buburu.
entries.en: They reap every one his corn in the field: and they gather the vintage of the wicked.

entries.yo: Nihoho ni nwọn ma sùn laini aṣọ, ti nwọn kò ni ibora ninu otutu.
entries.en: They cause the naked to lodge without clothing, that they have no covering in the cold.

entries.yo: Ọwara ojo oke-nla si pa wọn, nwọn si lẹ̀mọ apata nitoriti kò si abo.
entries.en: They are wet with the showers of the mountains, and embrace the rock for want of a shelter.

entries.yo: Nwọn ja ọmọ-alainibaba kuro li ẹnu-ọmu, nwọn si gbà ohun ẹ̀ri li ọwọ talaka.
entries.en: They pluck the fatherless from the breast, and take a pledge of the poor.

entries.yo: Nwọn rìn kiri nihoho laili aṣọ, awọn ti ebi npa rẹrù ìdi-ọka.
entries.en: They cause him to go naked without clothing, and they take away the sheaf from the hungry;

entries.yo: Awọn ẹniti nfún ororo ninu agbala wọn, ti nwọn si ntẹ ifunti àjara, ongbẹ si ngbẹ wọn.
entries.en: Which make oil within their walls, and tread their winepresses, and suffer thirst.

entries.yo: Awọn enia nkerora lati ilu wá, ọkàn awọn ẹniti o gbọgbẹ kigbe soke; sibẹ Ọlọrun kò kiyesi iwère na.
entries.en: Men groan from out of the city, and the soul of the wounded crieth out: yet God layeth not folly to them.

entries.yo: Awọn li o wà ninu awọn ti o kọ̀ imọlẹ, nwọn kò mọ̀ ipa ọ̀na rẹ̀, bẹni nwọn kò duro nipa ọ̀na rẹ̀.
entries.en: They are of those that rebel against the light; they know not the ways thereof, nor abide in the paths thereof.

entries.yo: Panipani a dide li afẹmọ́jumọ pa talaka ati alaini, ati li oru a di olè.
entries.en: The murderer rising with the light killeth the poor and needy, and in the night is as a thief.

entries.yo: Oju àlagbere pẹlu duro de ofefe ọjọ, o ni, Oju ẹnikan kì yio ri mi, o si fi iboju boju rẹ̀.
entries.en: The eye also of the adulterer waiteth for the twilight, saying, No eye shall see me: and disguiseth his face.

entries.yo: Li òkunkun nwọn a runlẹ wọle, ti nwọn ti fi oju sọ fun ara wọn li ọsan, nwọn kò mọ̀ imọlẹ.
entries.en: In the dark they dig through houses, which they had marked for themselves in the daytime: they know not the light.

entries.yo: Nitoripe bi oru dudu ni owurọ̀ fun gbogbo wọn; nitoriti nwọn si mọ̀ ibẹru oru dudu.
entries.en: For the morning is to them even as the shadow of death: if one know them, they are in the terrors of the shadow of death.

entries.yo: O yara lọ bi ẹni loju omi; ifibu ni ipin wọn li aiye, on kò rìn lọ mọ li ọ̀na ọgba-ajara.
entries.en: He is swift as the waters; their portion is cursed in the earth: he beholdeth not the way of the vineyards.

entries.yo: Ọdá ati õru ni imu omi ojo-didi gbẹ, bẹ̃ni isa-okú irun awọn ẹ̀lẹṣẹ.
entries.en: Drought and heat consume the snow waters: so doth the grave those which have sinned.

entries.yo: Inu ibímọ yio gbagbe rẹ̀, kokoro ni yio ma fi adun jẹun lara rẹ̀, a kì yio ranti rẹ̀ mọ́; bẹ̃ni a o si ṣẹ ìwa-buburu bi ẹni ṣẹ igi.
entries.en: The womb shall forget him; the worm shall feed sweetly on him; he shall be no more remembered; and wickedness shall be broken as a tree.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o hù ìwa-buburu si agàn ti kò bí ri, ti kò ṣe rere si opó.
entries.en: He evil entreateth the barren that beareth not: and doeth not good to the widow.

entries.yo: O fi ipá rẹ̀ fà alagbara lọ pẹlu; o dide, kò si ẹniti ẹmi rẹ̀ da loju.
entries.en: He draweth also the mighty with his power: he riseth up, and no man is sure of life.

entries.yo: On si fi ìwa ailewu fun u, ati ninu eyi ni a o si tì i lẹhin, oju rẹ̀ si wà ni ipa-ọna wọn.
entries.en: Though it be given him to be in safety, whereon he resteth; yet his eyes are upon their ways.

entries.yo: A gbe wọn lekè nigba diẹ, nwọn kọja lọ, a si rẹ̀ wọn silẹ, a si mu wọn kuro li ọ̀na, bi awọn ẹlomiran, a si ke wọn kuro bi ori ṣiri itú ọkà bàbà.
entries.en: They are exalted for a little while, but are gone and brought low; they are taken out of the way as all other, and cut off as the tops of the ears of corn.

entries.yo: Njẹ, bi kò ba ri bẹ̃ nisisiyi, tani yio mu mi li eké, ti yio si fi ọ̀rọ mi ṣe alainidi?
entries.en: And if it be not so now, who will make me a liar, and make my speech nothing worth?

entries.yo: NIGBANA ni Bildadi, ara Ṣua, dahùn wipe,
entries.en: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,

entries.yo: Ijọba ati ẹ̀ru mbẹ lọdọ rẹ̀, on ni iṣe ilaja ni ibi gigagiga rẹ̀.
entries.en: Dominion and fear are with him, he maketh peace in his high places.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ-ogun rẹ̀ ha ni iye bi, tabi ara tani imọlẹ rẹ̀ kò mọ́ si?
entries.en: Is there any number of his armies? and upon whom doth not his light arise?

entries.yo: Eha ti ṣe ti a o fi da enia lare lọdọ Ọlọrun, tabi ẹniti a bi lati inu obinrin wá yio ha ṣe mọ́?
entries.en: How then can man be justified with God? or how can he be clean that is born of a woman?

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, òṣupa kò si le itan imọlẹ, ani awọn ìrawọ kò mọlẹ li oju rẹ̀.
entries.en: Behold even to the moon, and it shineth not; yea, the stars are not pure in his sight.

entries.yo: Ambọtori enia ti iṣe idin, ati ọmọ enia, ti iṣe kòkoro!
entries.en: How much less man, that is a worm? and the son of man, which is a worm?

entries.yo: ṢUGBỌN Jobu si dahùn wipe,
entries.en: But Job answered and said,

entries.yo: Bawo ni iwọ nṣe iranlọwọ ẹniti kò ni ipá, bawo ni iwọ nṣe gbà apa ẹniti kò li agbara?
entries.en: How hast thou helped him that is without power? how savest thou the arm that hath no strength?

entries.yo: Bawo ni iwọ nṣe ìgbimọ ẹniti kò li ọgbọ́n, tabi bawo ni iwọ nsọdi ọ̀ran li ọ̀pọlọpọ bi o ti ri?
entries.en: How hast thou counselled him that hath no wisdom? and how hast thou plentifully declared the thing as it is?

entries.yo: Tani iwọ mbà sọ̀rọ, ati ẹmi tani o ti ọdọ rẹ wá?
entries.en: To whom hast thou uttered words? and whose spirit came from thee?

entries.yo: Awọn alailagbara ti isa-okú wáriri; labẹ omi pẹlu awọn ti ngbe inu rẹ̀.
entries.en: Dead things are formed from under the waters, and the inhabitants thereof.

entries.yo: Ihoho ni ipo-okú niwaju rẹ̀, ibi iparun kò si ni iboju.
entries.en: Hell is naked before him, and destruction hath no covering.

entries.yo: On ni o nà ìha ariwa ọrun ni ibi ofurufu, o si fi aiye rọ̀ li oju ofo.
entries.en: He stretcheth out the north over the empty place, and hangeth the earth upon nothing.

entries.yo: O di omiyomi pọ̀ ninu awọsanma rẹ̀ ti o nipọn; awọsanma kò si ya nisalẹ wọn.
entries.en: He bindeth up the waters in his thick clouds; and the cloud is not rent under them.

entries.yo: O si fa oju itẹ rẹ̀ sẹhin, o si tẹ awọ sanma rẹ̀ si i lori.
entries.en: He holdeth back the face of his throne, and spreadeth his cloud upon it.

entries.yo: O fi ìde yi omi-okun ka, titi de ala imọlẹ ati òkunkun.
entries.en: He hath compassed the waters with bounds, until the day and night come to an end.

entries.yo: Ọwọn òpo ọrun wáriri, ẹnu si yà wọn si ibawi rẹ̀.
entries.en: The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his reproof.

entries.yo: O fi ipa rẹ̀ damu omi-okun, nipa oye rẹ̀ o lu agberaga jalẹjalẹ.
entries.en: He divideth the sea with his power, and by his understanding he smiteth through the proud.

entries.yo: Nipa ẹmi rẹ li o ti ṣe ọrun li ọ̀ṣọ, ọwọ rẹ̀ li o ti da ejo-wiwọ́ nì.
entries.en: By his spirit he hath garnished the heavens; his hand hath formed the crooked serpent.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, eyi ni opin ọ̀na rẹ̀, ohùn eyiti a gbọ́ ti kere tó! ṣugbọn ãra ipá rẹ̀ tali oye rẹ̀ le iye?
entries.en: Lo, these are parts of his ways: but how little a portion is heard of him? but the thunder of his power who can understand?

entries.yo: PẸLUPẸLU Jobu si tun sọ kún ọ̀rọ owe rẹ̀ o si wipe,
entries.en: Moreover Job continued his parable, and said,

entries.yo: Bi Ọlọrun ti mbẹ ẹniti o gba idajọ mi lọ, ati Olodumare ti o bà mi li ọkàn jẹ.
entries.en: As God liveth, who hath taken away my judgment; and the Almighty, who hath vexed my soul;

entries.yo: Niwọn igba ti ẹmi mi mbẹ ninu mi, ati ti ẹmi Ọlọrun mbẹ ni iho imú mi.
entries.en: All the while my breath is in me, and the spirit of God is in my nostrils;

entries.yo: Ete mi kì yio sọ̀rọ eké, bẹ̃li ahọn mi kì yio sọ̀rọ ẹ̀tan.
entries.en: My lips shall not speak wickedness, nor my tongue utter deceit.

entries.yo: Ki a ma ri pe emi ndá nyin li are, titi emi o fi kú emi kì yio ṣi ìwa otitọ mi kuro lọdọ mi.
entries.en: God forbid that I should justify you: till I die I will not remove mine integrity from me.

entries.yo: Ododo mi li emi dimú ṣinṣin, emi kì yio si jọwọ rẹ̀ lọwọ; aiya mi kì yio si gan ọjọ kan ninu ọjọ aiye mi.
entries.en: My righteousness I hold fast, and will not let it go: my heart shall not reproach me so long as I live.

entries.yo: Ki ọta mi ki o dàbi enia buburu, ati ẹniti ndide si mi ki o dàbi ẹni alaiṣododo.
entries.en: Let mine enemy be as the wicked, and he that riseth up against me as the unrighteous.

entries.yo: Nitoripe kini ireti àgabagebe, nigbati Ọlọrun ba ke ẹmi rẹ̀ kuro, nigbati o si fà a jade.
entries.en: For what is the hope of the hypocrite, though he hath gained, when God taketh away his soul?

entries.yo: Ọlọrun yio ha gbọ́ adura rẹ̀, nigbati ipọnju ba de si i?
entries.en: Will God hear his cry when trouble cometh upon him?

entries.yo: On ha le ni inu-didùn si Olodumare, on ha le ma kepe Ọlọrun nigbagbogbo?
entries.en: Will he delight himself in the Almighty? will he always call upon God?

entries.yo: Emi o kọ́ nyin li ẹkọ́ niti ọwọ Ọlọrun: eyi ti mbẹ lọdọ Olodumare li emi kì yio fi pamọ.
entries.en: I will teach you by the hand of God: that which is with the Almighty will I not conceal.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, gbogbo nyin li o ti ri i, nitori kili ẹnyin ṣe jasi asan pọ̀ bẹ̃?
entries.en: Behold, all ye yourselves have seen it; why then are ye thus altogether vain?

entries.yo: Eyi ni ipín enia buburu lọdọ Ọlọrun, ati ogún awọn aninilara, ti nwọn o gbà lọwọ Olodumare.
entries.en: This is the portion of a wicked man with God, and the heritage of oppressors, which they shall receive of the Almighty.

entries.yo: Bi awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ ba di pupọ̀, fun idà ni, awọn ọmọ-ọmọ rẹ̀ kì yio yo fun onjẹ.
entries.en: If his children be multiplied, it is for the sword: and his offspring shall not be satisfied with bread.

entries.yo: Awọn ti o kù ninu tirẹ̀ li a o sinkú ninu ajakalẹ àrun: awọn opó rẹ̀ kì yio si sọkún.
entries.en: Those that remain of him shall be buried in death: and his widows shall not weep.

entries.yo: Bi o tilẹ kó fàdaka jọ bi erupẹ, ti o si da aṣọ jọ bi amọ̀.
entries.en: Though he heap up silver as the dust, and prepare raiment as the clay;

entries.yo: Ki o ma dá a, ṣugbọn awọn olõtọ ni yio lò o; awọn alaiṣẹ̀ ni yio si pin fadaka na.
entries.en: He may prepare it, but the just shall put it on, and the innocent shall divide the silver.

entries.yo: On kọ́ ile rẹ̀ bi kòkoro aṣọ, ati bi agọbukà ti oluṣọ pa.
entries.en: He buildeth his house as a moth, and as a booth that the keeper maketh.

entries.yo: Ọlọrọ̀ yio dubulẹ, ṣugbọn on kì o tùn ṣe bẹ̃ mọ́, o ṣiju rẹ̀, on kò sì si.
entries.en: The rich man shall lie down, but he shall not be gathered: he openeth his eyes, and he is not.

entries.yo: Ẹ̀ru nla bà a bi omi ṣiṣan, ẹ̀fufu nla ji i gbe lọ li oru.
entries.en: Terrors take hold on him as waters, a tempest stealeth him away in the night.

entries.yo: Ẹfufu ila-õrùn gbe e lọ, on si lọ; ati bi iji nla o si fà a kuro ni ipo rẹ̀.
entries.en: The east wind carrieth him away, and he departeth: and as a storm hurleth him out of his place.

entries.yo: Nitoripe Olodumare yio kọlù u, kì o sì dasi; on iba yọ̀ lati sá kuro li ọwọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: For God shall cast upon him, and not spare: he would fain flee out of his hand.

entries.yo: Awọn enia yio si ṣapẹ si i lori, nwọn o si ṣe ṣiọ si i kuro ni ipò rẹ̀.
entries.en: Men shall clap their hands at him, and shall hiss him out of his place.

entries.yo: NITOTỌ ipa-ilẹ fàdaka mbẹ, ati ibi ti nwọn a ma idà wura.
entries.en: Surely there is a vein for the silver, and a place for gold where they fine it.

entries.yo: Ninu ilẹ li a gbe nwà irin, bàba li a si ndà lati inu okuta wá.
entries.en: Iron is taken out of the earth, and brass is molten out of the stone.

entries.yo: Enia li o pari òkunkun, o si ṣe awari okuta òkunkun ati ti inu ojiji ikú si iha gbogbo.
entries.en: He setteth an end to darkness, and searcheth out all perfection: the stones of darkness, and the shadow of death.

entries.yo: Nwọn wá iho ilẹ ti o jìn si awọn ti o ngbe oke, awọn ti ẹsẹ enia gbagbe nwọn rọ si isalẹ, nwọn rọ si isalẹ jina si awọn enia.
entries.en: The flood breaketh out from the inhabitant; even the waters forgotten of the foot: they are dried up, they are gone away from men.

entries.yo: Bi o ṣe ti ilẹ ni, ninu rẹ̀ ni onjẹ ti ijade wá, ati ohun ti o wà nisalẹ li o yi soke bi ẹnipe iná.
entries.en: As for the earth, out of it cometh bread: and under it is turned up as it were fire.

entries.yo: Okuta ibẹ ni ibi okuta Safiri, o si ni erupẹ wura.
entries.en: The stones of it are the place of sapphires: and it hath dust of gold.

entries.yo: Ipa ọ̀na na ni ẹiyẹ kò mọ̀, ati oju gunugun kò ri i ri.
entries.en: There is a path which no fowl knoweth, and which the vulture's eye hath not seen:

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ kiniun kò rin ibẹ rí, bẹ̃ni kiniun ti nké ramuramu kò kọja nibẹ rí.
entries.en: The lion's whelps have not trodden it, nor the fierce lion passed by it.

entries.yo: O fi ọwọ rẹ̀ le akọ apata, o yi oke-nla po lati idi rẹ̀ wá.
entries.en: He putteth forth his hand upon the rock; he overturneth the mountains by the roots.

entries.yo: O si la ipa-odò ṣiṣàn ninu apata, oju rẹ̀ si ri ohun iyebiye gbogbo.
entries.en: He cutteth out rivers among the rocks; and his eye seeth every precious thing.

entries.yo: O si sé iṣàn odò ki o má ṣe kún akunya, o si mu ohun ti o lumọ hàn jade wá si imọlẹ.
entries.en: He bindeth the floods from overflowing; and the thing that is hid bringeth he forth to light.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nibo li a o gbe wá ọgbọ́n ri, nibo si ni ibi oye?
entries.en: But where shall wisdom be found? and where is the place of understanding?

entries.yo: Enia kò mọ̀ iye rẹ̀, bẹ̃li a kò le iri i ni ilẹ awọn alãyè.
entries.en: Man knoweth not the price thereof; neither is it found in the land of the living.

entries.yo: Ọgbun wipe, kò si ninu mi, omi-okun si wipe, kò si ninu mi.
entries.en: The depth saith, It is not in me: and the sea saith, It is not with me.

entries.yo: A kò le fi wura rà a, bẹ̃li a kò le ifi òṣuwọn wọ̀n fadaka ni iye rẹ̀.
entries.en: It cannot be gotten for gold, neither shall silver be weighed for the price thereof.

entries.yo: A kò le fi wura Ofiri diyele e, pẹlu okuta oniksi iyebiye, ati okuta Safiri.
entries.en: It cannot be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire.

entries.yo: Wura ati okuta kristali kò to ẹgbẹ́ rẹ̀, bẹ̃li a kò le fi ohun èlo wura ṣe paṣiparọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: The gold and the crystal cannot equal it: and the exchange of it shall not be for jewels of fine gold.

entries.yo: A kò le idarukọ iyun tabi okuta perli; iye ọgbọ́n si jù okuta rubi lọ.
entries.en: No mention shall be made of coral, or of pearls: for the price of wisdom is above rubies.

entries.yo: Okuta topasi ti Etiopia kò tó ẹgbẹ́ rẹ̀, bẹ̃li a kò le ifi wura daradara diye le e.
entries.en: The topaz of Ethiopia shall not equal it, neither shall it be valued with pure gold.

entries.yo: Nibo ha li ọgbọn ti jade wá; tabi nibo ni ibi oye?
entries.en: Whence then cometh wisdom? and where is the place of understanding?

entries.yo: A ri pe, o lumọ kuro li oju awọn alãyè gbogbo, o si fara sin fun ẹiyẹ oju ọrun.
entries.en: Seeing it is hid from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the fowls of the air.

entries.yo: Ibi iparun (Abaddoni) ati ikú wipe, Awa ti fi etí wa gburo rẹ̀.
entries.en: Destruction and death say, We have heard the fame thereof with our ears.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun li o moye ipa ọ̀na rẹ̀, o si mọ̀ ipo rẹ̀,
entries.en: God understandeth the way thereof, and he knoweth the place thereof.

entries.yo: Nitoripe o woye de opin aiye, o si ri gbogbo isalẹ ọrun.
entries.en: For he looketh to the ends of the earth, and seeth under the whole heaven;

entries.yo: Lati dà òṣuwọn fun afẹfẹ, o si fi òṣuwọn wọ̀n omiyomi.
entries.en: To make the weight for the winds; and he weigheth the waters by measure.

entries.yo: Nigbati o paṣẹ fun òjo, ti o si la ọ̀na fun mànamana ãrá:
entries.en: When he made a decree for the rain, and a way for the lightning of the thunder:

entries.yo: Nigbana li o ri i, o si sọ ọ jade, o pèse rẹ̀ silẹ, ani o si wadi rẹ̀ ri.
entries.en: Then did he see it, and declare it; he prepared it, yea, and searched it out.

entries.yo: Ati fun enia li o wipe, kiyesi i; Ẹru Oluwa, eyi li ọgbọ́n, ati lati jade kuro ninu ìwa-buburu eyi li oye!
entries.en: And unto man he said, Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom; and to depart from evil is understanding.

entries.yo: PẸLUPẸLU Jobu si tun gbẹnu le ọ̀rọ rẹ̀ o si wipe,
entries.en: Moreover Job continued his parable, and said,

entries.yo: A! ibaṣepe emi wà bi igba oṣu ti o kọja, bi ọjọ ti Ọlọrun pa mi mọ́!
entries.en: Oh that I were as in months past, as in the days when God preserved me;

entries.yo: Nigbati fitila rẹ̀ tàn si mi li ori, ati nipa imọlẹ rẹ̀ emi rìn ninu òkunkun ja.
entries.en: When his candle shined upon my head, and when by his light I walked through darkness;

entries.yo: Bi mo ti ri nigba ọ̀dọ́ mi, nigbati aṣiri Ọlọrun wà ninu agọ mi.
entries.en: As I was in the days of my youth, when the secret of God was upon my tabernacle;

entries.yo: Nigbati Olodumare wà sibẹ pẹlu mi, nigbati awọn ọmọ mi wà yi mi ka.
entries.en: When the Almighty was yet with me, when my children were about me;

entries.yo: Nigbati emi nfi ori-amọ wẹ̀ iṣisẹ mi, ati ti apata ntú iṣàn ororo jade fun mi wá.
entries.en: When I washed my steps with butter, and the rock poured me out rivers of oil;

entries.yo: Nigbati mo jade là arin ilu lọ si ẹnu ibode, nigbati mo tẹ ìtẹ mi ni igboro.
entries.en: When I went out to the gate through the city, when I prepared my seat in the street!

entries.yo: Nigbana ni awọn ọdọmọkunrin ri mi, nwọn si sapamọ́, awọn àgba dide duro.
entries.en: The young men saw me, and hid themselves: and the aged arose, and stood up.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ-alade dakẹ ọ̀rọ sisọ, nwọn a si fi ọwọ wọn le ẹnu.
entries.en: The princes refrained talking, and laid their hand on their mouth.

entries.yo: Awọn ọlọla dakẹ, ahọn wọn si lẹmọ èrigi ẹnu wọn.
entries.en: The nobles held their peace, and their tongue cleaved to the roof of their mouth.

entries.yo: Nitoripe eti gbọ́ ti emi, a si sure fun mi, oju si ri mi, on a jẹri mi.
entries.en: When the ear heard me, then it blessed me; and when the eye saw me, it gave witness to me:

entries.yo: Nitoriti mo gba talaka ti nsọkun, ati alainibaba, ati alaini oluranlọwọ.
entries.en: Because I delivered the poor that cried, and the fatherless, and him that had none to help him.

entries.yo: Isure ẹniti o fẹrẹ iṣegbe wa si ori mi, emi si mu aiya opo kọrin fun ayọ̀.
entries.en: The blessing of him that was ready to perish came upon me: and I caused the widow's heart to sing for joy.

entries.yo: Emi si mu ododo wọ̀, o si bò mi lara; idajọ mi dabi aṣọ igunwa ati ade ọba.
entries.en: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me: my judgment was as a robe and a diadem.

entries.yo: Mo ṣe oju fun afọju, ati ẹsẹ̀ fun amọkún.
entries.en: I was eyes to the blind, and feet was I to the lame.

entries.yo: Mo ṣe baba fun talaka, ati ọ̀ran ti emi kò mọ̀, mo wadi rẹ̀ ri.
entries.en: I was a father to the poor: and the cause which I knew not I searched out.

entries.yo: Mo si ká ehin ẹ̀rẹkẹ enia buburu, mo si ja ohun ọdẹ na kuro li ehin rẹ̀.
entries.en: And I brake the jaws of the wicked, and plucked the spoil out of his teeth.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni mo wipe, emi o kú ninu itẹ mi, emi o si mu ọjọ mi pọ̀ si i bi iyanrin. (bi ọjọ ti ẹiyẹ Feniksi.)
entries.en: Then I said, I shall die in my nest, and I shall multiply my days as the sand.

entries.yo: Gbongbo mi ta lọ si ibi omi, ìri si sẹ̀ si ara ẹká mi titi li oru.
entries.en: My root was spread out by the waters, and the dew lay all night upon my branch.

entries.yo: Ogo mi gberu lọdọ mi, ọrun mi si pada di titun li ọwọ mi.
entries.en: My glory was fresh in me, and my bow was renewed in my hand.

entries.yo: Emi li enia ndẹti silẹ si, nwọn a si duro, nwọn a si dakẹ ninu ìgbimọ mi.
entries.en: Unto me men gave ear, and waited, and kept silence at my counsel.

entries.yo: Lẹhin ọ̀rọ mi nwọn kò si tun sọ mọ́, ọ̀rọ mi bọ́ si wọn li eti.
entries.en: After my words they spake not again; and my speech dropped upon them.

entries.yo: Nwọn a si duro dè mi bi ẹnipe fun ojo; nwọn si yanu wọn gboro bi ẹnipe fun ojo àrọ-kuro.
entries.en: And they waited for me as for the rain; and they opened their mouth wide as for the latter rain.

entries.yo: Emi si rẹrin si wọn nigbati nwọn kò ba gba a gbọ́; imọlẹ oju mi ni nwọn kò le imu rẹ̀wẹsi.
entries.en: If I laughed on them, they believed it not; and the light of my countenance they cast not down.

entries.yo: Mo la ọ̀na silẹ fun wọn, mo si joko bi Olu, mo si joko bi ọba ninu ogun, bi ẹniti ntù aṣọ̀fọ̀ ninu.
entries.en: I chose out their way, and sat chief, and dwelt as a king in the army, as one that comforteth the mourners.

entries.yo: ṢUGBỌN nisisiyi awọn ti mo gbà li aburo nfi mi ṣẹ̀sin, baba ẹniti emi kẹgàn lati tò pẹlu awọn ajá agbo-ẹran mi.
entries.en: But now they that are younger than I have me in derision, whose fathers I would have disdained to have set with the dogs of my flock.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu agbara ọwọ wọn kini o le igbè fun mi, awọn ẹniti kikún ọjọ wọn kò si.
entries.en: Yea, whereto might the strength of their hands profit me, in whom old age was perished?

entries.yo: Nitori aini ati ìyan nwọn di ẹni itakete, nwọn si girijẹ ohun jijẹ iju, ti o wà ni isọdahoro ati òfo lati lailai.
entries.en: For want and famine they were solitary; fleeing into the wilderness in former time desolate and waste.

entries.yo: Awọn ẹniti njá ewe-iyọ li ẹ̀ba igbẹ, gbongbo igikigi li ohun jijẹ wọn.
entries.en: Who cut up mallows by the bushes, and juniper roots for their meat.

entries.yo: A le wọn jade kuro lãrin enia, nwọn si ho le wọn bi ẹnipe si olè.
entries.en: They were driven forth from among men, (they cried after them as after a thief;)

entries.yo: Lati gbé inu pàlapala okuta afonifoji, ninu iho ilẹ ati ti okuta.
entries.en: To dwell in the clifts of the valleys, in caves of the earth, and in the rocks.

entries.yo: Ninu igbẹ ni nwọn ndún, nwọn ko ara wọn jọ pọ̀ labẹ ẹgun neteli.
entries.en: Among the bushes they brayed; under the nettles they were gathered together.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ ẹniti oye kò ye, ani ọmọ awọn enia lasan, a si le wọn kuro ninu ilẹ.
entries.en: They were children of fools, yea, children of base men: they were viler than the earth.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi emi di ẹni-orin fun wọn, ani emi di ẹni-asọrọsi fun wọn.
entries.en: And now am I their song, yea, I am their byword.

entries.yo: Nwọn korira mi, nwọn sa kuro jina si mi, nwọn kò si dá si lati tutọ́ si mi loju.
entries.en: They abhor me, they flee far from me, and spare not to spit in my face.

entries.yo: Nitoriti Ọlọrun ti tu okun-ìye mi, o si pọn mi loju; awọn pẹlu si dẹ̀ ijanu niwaju mi.
entries.en: Because he hath loosed my cord, and afflicted me, they have also let loose the bridle before me.

entries.yo: Awọn enia lasan dide li apa ọ̀tun mi, nwọn tì mi li ẹsẹ kuro, nwọn si là ipa-ọ̀na iparun silẹ dè mi.
entries.en: Upon my right hand rise the youth; they push away my feet, and they raise up against me the ways of their destruction.

entries.yo: Nwọn dà ipa-ọ̀na mi rú, nwọn ran jàmba mi lọwọ, awọn ti kò li oluranlọwọ;
entries.en: They mar my path, they set forward my calamity, they have no helper.

entries.yo: Nwọn de si mi bi yiya omi gburu, ni ariwo nla ni nwọn ko ara wọn kátì si mi.
entries.en: They came upon me as a wide breaking in of waters: in the desolation they rolled themselves upon me.

entries.yo: Ẹ̀ru nla yipada bà mi, nwọn lepa ọkàn mi bi ẹfùfù, alafia mi si kọja lọ bi awọsanma.
entries.en: Terrors are turned upon me: they pursue my soul as the wind: and my welfare passeth away as a cloud.

entries.yo: Ati nisisiyi ọkàn mi si dà jade si mi, ọjọ ipọnju dì mi mu.
entries.en: And now my soul is poured out upon me; the days of affliction have taken hold upon me.

entries.yo: Oru gùn mi ninu egungun mi, eyiti o bù mi jẹ kò si simi.
entries.en: My bones are pierced in me in the night season: and my sinews take no rest.

entries.yo: Nipa agbara nla aṣọ mi di pipada, o si lẹmọ́ mi li ara yika bi ọrùn aṣọ ileke mi.
entries.en: By the great force of my disease is my garment changed: it bindeth me about as the collar of my coat.

entries.yo: O ti mu mi lọ sinu ẹrẹ̀, emi si dabi ekuru ati ẽru,
entries.en: He hath cast me into the mire, and I am become like dust and ashes.

entries.yo: Emi kepè ọ, iwọ kò si gbọ́ ti emi, emi dide duro, iwọ si fi oju lile wò mi.
entries.en: I cry unto thee, and thou dost not hear me: I stand up, and thou regardest me not.

entries.yo: Iwọ pada di ẹni-ìka si mi, ọwọ agbara rẹ ni iwọ fi de ara rẹ li ọ̀na si mi.
entries.en: Thou art become cruel to me: with thy strong hand thou opposest thyself against me.

entries.yo: Iwọ gbe mi soke si ẹ̀fufu, iwọ mu mi fò lọ, bẹ̃ni iwọ si sọ mi di asan patapata.
entries.en: Thou liftest me up to the wind; thou causest me to ride upon it, and dissolvest my substance.

entries.yo: Emi sa mọ̀ pe iwọ o mu mi lọ sinu ikú, ati si ile-apejọ fun gbogbo alãye.
entries.en: For I know that thou wilt bring me to death, and to the house appointed for all living.

entries.yo: Bi o ti wu ki o ṣe, ẹnikan kì yio ha nawọ rẹ̀ ni igba iṣubu rẹ̀, tabi kì yio ké ninu iparun rẹ̀.
entries.en: Howbeit he will not stretch out his hand to the grave, though they cry in his destruction.

entries.yo: Emi kò ha sọkun bi fun ẹniti o wà ninu iṣẹ, ọkàn mi kò ha bajẹ fun talaka bi?
entries.en: Did not I weep for him that was in trouble? was not my soul grieved for the poor?

entries.yo: Nigbati mo fojusọna fun alafia, ibi si de, nigbati emi duro de imọlẹ, òkunkun si de.
entries.en: When I looked for good, then evil came unto me: and when I waited for light, there came darkness.

entries.yo: Ikùn mi nru, kò si simi, ọjọ ipọnju ti bá mi.
entries.en: My bowels boiled, and rested not: the days of affliction prevented me.

entries.yo: Emi nṣọ̀fọ lọ rinkiri laisi õrùn, emi dide duro ni awujọ, mo si kigbe.
entries.en: I went mourning without the sun: I stood up, and I cried in the congregation.

entries.yo: Emi jasi arakunrin ajáko, emi di ẹgbẹ́ awọn abo-ogongo.
entries.en: I am a brother to dragons, and a companion to owls.

entries.yo: Àwọ mi di dudu li ara mi, egungun mi si jórun fun õru.
entries.en: My skin is black upon me, and my bones are burned with heat.

entries.yo: Dùru mi pẹlu si di ti ọ̀fọ, ati ohun-ọnà orin mi si di ohùn awọn ti nsọkún.
entries.en: My harp also is turned to mourning, and my organ into the voice of them that weep.

entries.yo: EMI ti bá oju mi da majẹmu, njẹ emi o ha ṣe tẹjumọ wundia?
entries.en: I made a covenant with mine eyes; why then should I think upon a maid?

entries.yo: Nitoripe kini ipin Ọlọrun lati ọrun wá, tabi kini ogún Olodumare lati oke ọrun wá?
entries.en: For what portion of God is there from above? and what inheritance of the Almighty from on high?

entries.yo: Kò ṣepe awọn enia buburu ni iparun wà fun, ati ìṣẹniṣẹ fun awọn oniṣẹ ẹ̀ṣẹ?
entries.en: Is not destruction to the wicked? and a strange punishment to the workers of iniquity?

entries.yo: On kò ha ri ipa-ọ̀na mi, on kò ha si ka gbogbo iṣiṣe mi?
entries.en: Doth not he see my ways, and count all my steps?

entries.yo: Bi o ba ṣepe emi ba fi aiṣotitọ rìn, tabi ti ẹsẹ mi si yara si ẹ̀tan.
entries.en: If I have walked with vanity, or if my foot hath hasted to deceit;

entries.yo: Ki a diwọn mi ninu iwọ̀n ododo, ki Ọlọrun le imọ̀ iduroṣinṣin mi.
entries.en: Let me be weighed in an even balance, that God may know mine integrity.

entries.yo: Bi ẹsẹ mi ba yà kuro loju ọ̀na, ti aiya mi si tẹ̀le ipa oju mi, bi àbawọn kan ba si lẹmọ́ mi li ọwọ.
entries.en: If my step hath turned out of the way, and mine heart walked after mine eyes, and if any blot hath cleaved to mine hands;

entries.yo: Njẹ ki emi ki o gbìn ki ẹlomiran ki o si mu u jẹ, ani ki a fà iru-ọmọ mi tu.
entries.en: Then let me sow, and let another eat; yea, let my offspring be rooted out.

entries.yo: Bi aiya mi ba di fifa sipasẹ obinrin kan, tabi bi mo ba lọ ibadeni li ẹnu-ọ̀na ile aladugbo mi,
entries.en: If mine heart have been deceived by a woman, or if I have laid wait at my neighbour's door;

entries.yo: Njẹ ki aya mi ki o lọ ọlọ fun ẹlomiran, ki awọn ẹlomiran ki o tẹ̀ ara wọn li ara rẹ̀.
entries.en: Then let my wife grind unto another, and let others bow down upon her.

entries.yo: Nitoripe ẹ̀ṣẹ buburu li eyi; ani ẹ̀ṣẹ ìṣẹniṣẹ ni lọdọ awọn onidajọ.
entries.en: For this is an heinous crime; yea, it is an iniquity to be punished by the judges.

entries.yo: Nitoripe iná ni eyi ti o jo de iparun, ti iba si fà gbongbo ohun ibisi mi gbogbo tu.
entries.en: For it is a fire that consumeth to destruction, and would root out all mine increase.

entries.yo: Bi mo ba si ṣe aikà ọ̀ran iranṣẹkunrin mi tabi iranṣẹbinrin mi si, nigbati nwọn ba mba mi jà;
entries.en: If I did despise the cause of my manservant or of my maidservant, when they contended with me;

entries.yo: Kili emi o ha ṣe nigbati Ọlọrun ba dide; nigbati o ba si ṣe ibẹwo, ohùn kili emi o dá?
entries.en: What then shall I do when God riseth up? and when he visiteth, what shall I answer him?

entries.yo: Ẹniti o dá mi ni inu kọ li o da a? ẹnikanna ki o mọ wa ni inu?
entries.en: Did not he that made me in the womb make him? and did not one fashion us in the womb?

entries.yo: Bi mo ba fà ọwọ sẹhin fun ifẹ-inu talaka, tabi bi mo ba si mu oju opó mofo;
entries.en: If I have withheld the poor from their desire, or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail;

entries.yo: Tabi ti mo ba nikan bu òkele mi jẹ, ti alainibaba kò jẹ ninu rẹ̀;
entries.en: Or have eaten my morsel myself alone, and the fatherless hath not eaten thereof;

entries.yo: Nitoripe lati igba ewe mi wá li a ti tọ́ ọ dàgba pẹlu mi bi ẹnipe baba, emi si nṣe itọju rẹ̀ (opó) lati inu iya mi wá.
entries.en: (For from my youth he was brought up with me, as with a father, and I have guided her from my mother's womb;)

entries.yo: Bi emi ba ri olupọnju laini aṣọ, tabi talaka kan laini ibora;
entries.en: If I have seen any perish for want of clothing, or any poor without covering;

entries.yo: Bi ẹgbẹ rẹ̀ kò ba sure fun mi, tabi bi ara rẹ̀ kò si gbona nipasẹ irun agutan mi.
entries.en: If his loins have not blessed me, and if he were not warmed with the fleece of my sheep;

entries.yo: Bi mo ba si gbe ọwọ mi soke si alainibaba, nitoripe mo ri iranlọwọ mi li ẹnu-bode,
entries.en: If I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless, when I saw my help in the gate:

entries.yo: Njẹ ki apá mi ki o wọ́n kuro li ọkọ́ ejika rẹ̀, ki apá mi ki o si ṣẹ́ lati egungun rẹ̀ wá.
entries.en: Then let mine arm fall from my shoulder blade, and mine arm be broken from the bone.

entries.yo: Nitoripe iparun lati ọdọ Ọlọrun wá ni ẹ̀ru-nla fun mi, ati nitori Ọlanla rẹ̀ emi kò le iduro.
entries.en: For destruction from God was a terror to me, and by reason of his highness I could not endure.

entries.yo: Bi o ba ṣepe mo fi wura ṣe igbẹkẹle mi, tabi bi mo ba wi fun wura didara pe, iwọ ni igbẹkẹle mi;
entries.en: If I have made gold my hope, or have said to the fine gold, Thou art my confidence;

entries.yo: Bi mo ba yọ̀ nitori ọrọ̀ mi pọ̀, ati nitori ọwọ mi dẹ̀ lọpọlọpọ;
entries.en: If I rejoiced because my wealth was great, and because mine hand had gotten much;

entries.yo: Bi mo ba bojuwo õrùn nigbati nràn, tabi òṣupa ti nrin ninu itan-imọlẹ,
entries.en: If I beheld the sun when it shined, or the moon walking in brightness;

entries.yo: Ti aiya mi si di titan, lati fi ẹnu mi kò ọwọ mi:
entries.en: And my heart hath been secretly enticed, or my mouth hath kissed my hand:

entries.yo: Eyi pẹlu li ẹ̀ṣẹ ìṣẹniṣẹ lọdọ awọn onidajọ, nitoripe emi iba sẹ́ Ọlọrun ti o wà loke.
entries.en: This also were an iniquity to be punished by the judge: for I should have denied the God that is above.

entries.yo: Bi o ba ṣepe mo yọ̀ si iparun ẹniti o korira mi, tabi bi mo ba si gbera soke, nigbati ibi bá a.
entries.en: If I rejoiced at the destruction of him that hated me, or lifted up myself when evil found him:

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li emi kò si jẹ ki ẹnu mi ki o ṣẹ̀ nipa fifẹ egún si ọkàn rẹ̀.
entries.en: Neither have I suffered my mouth to sin by wishing a curse to his soul.

entries.yo: Bi awọn enia inu agọ mi kò ba le wipe, Tali o le ri ẹniti agbo-ẹran rẹ̀ kò tẹlọrùn?
entries.en: If the men of my tabernacle said not, Oh that we had of his flesh! we cannot be satisfied.

entries.yo: Alejo kò wọ̀ ni igboro ri, emi ṣi ilẹkun mi silẹ fun èro.
entries.en: The stranger did not lodge in the street: but I opened my doors to the traveller.

entries.yo: Bi mo ba bò irekọja mi mọlẹ bi Adamu, ni pipa ẹbi mi mọ́ li aiya mi:
entries.en: If I covered my transgressions as Adam, by hiding mine iniquity in my bosom:

entries.yo: Ọ̀pọlọpọ enia ni mo ha bẹ̀ru bi, tabi ẹ̀gan awọn idile ni mba mi li ẹ̀ru? ti mo fi pa ẹnu mọ́, ti emi kò si fi jade sode?
entries.en: Did I fear a great multitude, or did the contempt of families terrify me, that I kept silence, and went not out of the door?

entries.yo: Ibaṣepe ẹnikan le gbọ́ ti emi! kiyesi i, àmi mi! ki Olodumare ki o da mi lohùn! ki emi ki o si ri iwe na ti ọta mi ti kọ!
entries.en: Oh that one would hear me! behold, my desire is, that the Almighty would answer me, and that mine adversary had written a book.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ emi iba gbe e le ejika mi, emi iba si dì i bi ade mọ́ ori mi.
entries.en: Surely I would take it upon my shoulder, and bind it as a crown to me.

entries.yo: Emi iba si sọ iye ìṣisẹ mi fun u, bi ọmọ-alade li emi iba sunmọ ọdọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: I would declare unto him the number of my steps; as a prince would I go near unto him.

entries.yo: Bi ilẹ mi ba si ke fi mi sùn, tabi ti aporo rẹ̀ pẹlu si sọkun,
entries.en: If my land cry against me, or that the furrows likewise thereof complain;

entries.yo: Bi mo ba jẹ eso oko mi lainawo si i, tabi ti mo si mu ọkàn oluwa rẹ̀ fò lọ,
entries.en: If I have eaten the fruits thereof without money, or have caused the owners thereof to lose their life:

entries.yo: Ki ẹgun òṣuṣu ki o hù nipo alikama, ati wèpe nipo ọka-bàba. (Ọ̀rọ Jobu pari.)
entries.en: Let thistles grow instead of wheat, and cockle instead of barley. The words of Job are ended.

entries.yo: BẸ̃NI awọn ọkunrin mẹtẹta wọnyi dakẹ lati da Jobu lohùn, nitori o ṣe olododo loju ara rẹ̀.
entries.en: So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni inu bi Elihu, ọmọ Barakeli, ara Busi, lati ibatan idile Ramu; o binu si Jobu, nitoriti o da ara rẹ̀ lare kàka ki o da Ọlọrun lare.
entries.en: Then was kindled the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite, of the kindred of Ram: against Job was his wrath kindled, because he justified himself rather than God.

entries.yo: Inu rẹ̀ si bi si awọn ọ̀rẹ rẹ̀ mẹtẹta, nitoriti nwọn kò ni idahùn, bẹ̃ni nwọn dá Jobu lẹbi.
entries.en: Also against his three friends was his wrath kindled, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.

entries.yo: Njẹ Elihu ti duro titi Jobu fi sọ̀rọ tan, nitoriti awọn wọnyi dàgba jù on lọ ni iye ọjọ.
entries.en: Now Elihu had waited till Job had spoken, because they were elder than he.

entries.yo: Nigbati Elihu ri pe idahùn ọ̀rọ kò si li ẹnu awọn ọkunrin mẹtẹta wọnyi, nigbana ni o binu.
entries.en: When Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men, then his wrath was kindled.

entries.yo: Elihu, ọmọ Barakeli, ara Busi, dahùn o si wipe, Ọmọde li emi, àgba si li ẹnyin; njẹ nitorina ni mo duro, mo si mbẹ̀ru lati fi ìmọ mi hàn nyin.
entries.en: And Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered and said, I am young, and ye are very old; wherefore I was afraid, and durst not shew you mine opinion.

entries.yo: Emi wipe, ọjọ-jọjọ ni iba sọ̀rọ, ati ọ̀pọlọpọ ọdun ni iba ma kọ́ni li ọgbọ́n.
entries.en: I said, Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹmi kan ni o wà ninu enia, ati imisi Olodumare ni isi ma fun wọn li oye.
entries.en: But there is a spirit in man: and the inspiration of the Almighty giveth them understanding.

entries.yo: Enia nlanla kì iṣe ọlọgbọ́n, bẹ̃ni awọn àgba li oye idajọ kò ye.
entries.en: Great men are not always wise: neither do the aged understand judgment.

entries.yo: Nitorina li emi ṣe wipe, ẹ dẹtisilẹ si mi, emi pẹlu yio fi ìmọ mi hàn.
entries.en: Therefore I said, Hearken to me; I also will shew mine opinion.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, emi ti duro de ọ̀rọ nyin, emi fetisi aroye nyin, nigbati ẹnyin nwá ọ̀rọ ti ẹnyin o sọ.
entries.en: Behold, I waited for your words; I gave ear to your reasons, whilst ye searched out what to say.

entries.yo: Ani mo fiyesi nyin tinutinu, si kiyesi i, kò si ẹnikan ninu nyin ti o le já Jobu li irọ́, tabi ti o lè ida a lohùn ọ̀rọ rẹ̀!
entries.en: Yea, I attended unto you, and, behold, there was none of you that convinced Job, or that answered his words:

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o má ba wipe, awa wá ọgbọ́n li awari: Ọlọrun li o lè bi i ṣubu, kì iṣe enia.
entries.en: Lest ye should say, We have found out wisdom: God thrusteth him down, not man.

entries.yo: Bi on kò ti sọ̀rọ si mi, bẹ̃li emi kì yio fi ọ̀rọ nyin da a lohùn.
entries.en: Now he hath not directed his words against me: neither will I answer him with your speeches.

entries.yo: Ẹnu si yà wọn, nwọn kò si dahùn mọ́, nwọn ṣiwọ ọ̀rọ isọ.
entries.en: They were amazed, they answered no more: they left off speaking.

entries.yo: Mo si reti, nitoriti nwọn kò si fọhùn, nwọn dakẹ jẹ, nwọn kò si dahùn mọ́.
entries.en: When I had waited, (for they spake not, but stood still, and answered no more;)

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li emi o si dahùn nipa ti emi, emi pẹlu yio si fi ìmọ mi hàn.
entries.en: I said, I will answer also my part, I also will shew mine opinion.

entries.yo: Nitoripe emi kún fun ọ̀rọ sisọ, ẹmi nrọ̀ mi ni inu mi.
entries.en: For I am full of matter, the spirit within me constraineth me.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, ikùn mi dabi ọti-waini, ti kò ni oju-iho; o mura tan lati bẹ́ bi igo-awọ titun.
entries.en: Behold, my belly is as wine which hath no vent; it is ready to burst like new bottles.

entries.yo: Emi o sọ, ki ara ki o le rọ̀ mi, emi o ṣi ète mi, emi o si dahùn.
entries.en: I will speak, that I may be refreshed: I will open my lips and answer.

entries.yo: Lotitọ emi kì yio ṣe ojusaju enia, bẹ̃li emi kì yio si ṣe ipọnni fun ẹnikan.
entries.en: Let me not, I pray you, accept any man's person, neither let me give flattering titles unto man.

entries.yo: Nitoripe emi kò mọ̀ ọ̀rọ ipọnni sọ, ni ṣiṣe bẹ̃ Ẹlẹda mi yio mu mi kuro lọgan.
entries.en: For I know not to give flattering titles; in so doing my maker would soon take me away.

entries.yo: NJẸ nitorina, Jobu, emi bẹ̀ ọ, gbọ́ ọ̀rọ mi, ki o si fetisi ọ̀rọ mi!
entries.en: Wherefore, Job, I pray thee, hear my speeches, and hearken to all my words.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i nisisiyi, emi ya ẹnu mi, ahọn mi si sọ̀rọ li ẹnu mi.
entries.en: Behold, now I have opened my mouth, my tongue hath spoken in my mouth.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ mi yio si jasi iduroṣinṣin ọkàn mi, ete mi yio si sọ ìmọ mi jade dajudaju.
entries.en: My words shall be of the uprightness of my heart: and my lips shall utter knowledge clearly.

entries.yo: Ẹmi Ọlọrun li o ti da mi, ati imisi Olodumare li o ti fun mi ni ìye.
entries.en: The Spirit of God hath made me, and the breath of the Almighty hath given me life.

entries.yo: Bi iwọ ba le da mi lohùn, tò ọ̀rọ rẹ lẹsẹsẹ niwaju mi, dide duro!
entries.en: If thou canst answer me, set thy words in order before me, stand up.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, bi iwọ jẹ ti Ọlọrun, bẹ̃li emi na; lati erupẹ wá ni a si ti dá mi pẹlu.
entries.en: Behold, I am according to thy wish in God's stead: I also am formed out of the clay.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, ẹ̀ru nla mi kì yio bà ọ, bẹ̃li ọwọ mi kì yio wuwo si ọ lara.
entries.en: Behold, my terror shall not make thee afraid, neither shall my hand be heavy upon thee.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ iwọ sọ li eti mi, emi si gbọ́ ọ̀rọ rẹ wipe,
entries.en: Surely thou hast spoken in mine hearing, and I have heard the voice of thy words, saying,

entries.yo: Emi mọ́, laini irekọja, alaiṣẹ li emi, bẹ̃li aiṣedede kò si li ọwọ mi.
entries.en: I am clean without transgression, I am innocent; neither is there iniquity in me.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, ẹ̀fẹ li o fẹ si mi, o kà mi si ọ̀ta rẹ̀.
entries.en: Behold, he findeth occasions against me, he counteth me for his enemy,

entries.yo: O kàn ẹsẹ mi sinu àba, o kiyesi ipa-irin mi gbogbo.
entries.en: He putteth my feet in the stocks, he marketh all my paths.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, ninu eyi iwọ ṣìna! emi o da ọ lohùn pe: Ọlọrun tobi jù enia lọ!
entries.en: Behold, in this thou art not just: I will answer thee, that God is greater than man.

entries.yo: Nitori kini iwọ ṣe mba a jà pe: on kì isọrọ̀kọrọ kan nitori iṣẹ rẹ̀?
entries.en: Why dost thou strive against him? for he giveth not account of any of his matters.

entries.yo: Nitoripe Ọlọrun sọ̀rọ lẹkan, ani lẹkeji ṣugbọn enia kò roye rẹ̀.
entries.en: For God speaketh once, yea twice, yet man perceiveth it not.

entries.yo: Ninu àla, li ojuran oru, nigbati orun ìjika ba kùn enia lọ, ni isunyẹ lori bùsun.
entries.en: In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falleth upon men, in slumberings upon the bed;

entries.yo: Nigbana ni iṣi eti enia, a si fi èdidi di ẹkọ wọn.
entries.en: Then he openeth the ears of men, and sealeth their instruction,

entries.yo: Ki o lè ifa enia sẹhin kuro ninu ete rẹ̀, ki o si pa igberaga mọ́ kuro lọdọ enia.
entries.en: That he may withdraw man from his purpose, and hide pride from man.

entries.yo: O si fa ọkàn rẹ̀ pada kuro ninu iho, ati ẹmi rẹ̀ lati ṣègbe lọwọ idà.
entries.en: He keepeth back his soul from the pit, and his life from perishing by the sword.

entries.yo: A si fi irora nà a lori ibùsun rẹ̀, pẹlupẹlu a fi ijà egungun rẹ̀ ti o duro pẹ́, nà a.
entries.en: He is chastened also with pain upon his bed, and the multitude of his bones with strong pain:

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li ẹmi rẹ̀ kọ̀ onjẹ, ati ọkàn rẹ̀ kọ̀ onjẹ didùn.
entries.en: So that his life abhorreth bread, and his soul dainty meat.

entries.yo: Ẹran ara rẹ̀ rùn, titi a kò si fi lè ri i mọ́; egungun rẹ̀ ti a kò ri, si ta jade.
entries.en: His flesh is consumed away, that it cannot be seen; and his bones that were not seen stick out.

entries.yo: Ani ọkàn rẹ̀ sunmọ isa-okú, ati ẹmi rẹ̀ sunmọ ọdọ awọn iranṣẹ ikú.
entries.en: Yea, his soul draweth near unto the grave, and his life to the destroyers.

entries.yo: Bi onṣẹ kan ba wà lọdọ rẹ̀, ẹniti nṣe alagbawi, ọkan ninu ẹgbẹrun lati fi ọ̀na pipé han ni:
entries.en: If there be a messenger with him, an interpreter, one among a thousand, to shew unto man his uprightness:

entries.yo: Nigbana ni o ṣore-ọfẹ fun u, o si wipe, Gbà a kuro ninu ilọ sinu ihò, emi ti ri irapada!
entries.en: Then he is gracious unto him, and saith, Deliver him from going down to the pit: I have found a ransom.

entries.yo: Ara rẹ̀ yio si já yọ̀yọ̀ jù ti ọmọ kekere, yio si tún pada si ọjọ igba ewe rẹ̀.
entries.en: His flesh shall be fresher than a child's: he shall return to the days of his youth:

entries.yo: O gbadura sọdọ Ọlọrun, on o si ṣe oju rere si i, o si mu enia ri oju rẹ̀ pẹlu ayọ̀, on o san ododo rẹ̀ pada fun enia.
entries.en: He shall pray unto God, and he will be favourable unto him: and he shall see his face with joy: for he will render unto man his righteousness.

entries.yo: O bojuwo enia, bi ẹnikan ba si wipe, Emi ṣẹ̀, mo si ti yi eyi ti o tọ́ po, a kò si sẹsan rẹ̀ fun mi;
entries.en: He looketh upon men, and if any say, I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, and it profited me not;

entries.yo: O ti gba ọkàn mi kuro ninu ilọ sinu ihò, ẹmi mi yio si ri imọlẹ!
entries.en: He will deliver his soul from going into the pit, and his life shall see the light.

entries.yo: Wò o! nkan wọnyi li Ọlọrun imaṣe fun enia nigba meji, ati nigba mẹta,
entries.en: Lo, all these things worketh God oftentimes with man,

entries.yo: Lati mu ọkàn rẹ̀ pada kuro ninu ihò, lati fi imọlẹ alãyè mọ́ si i.
entries.en: To bring back his soul from the pit, to be enlightened with the light of the living.

entries.yo: Jobu! kiyesi i gidigidi, ki o si fetisilẹ si mi; pa ẹnu rẹ mọ́, emi o si ma sọ!
entries.en: Mark well, O Job, hearken unto me: hold thy peace, and I will speak.

entries.yo: Bi iwọ ba si ni ohun iwi, da mi lohùn, mã sọ, nitoripe emi nfẹ da ọ lare.
entries.en: If thou hast any thing to say, answer me: speak, for I desire to justify thee.

entries.yo: Bi bẹ̃ kọ̀, gbọ temi, pa ẹnu rẹ mọ́; emi o si kọ́ ọ li ọgbọ́n.
entries.en: If not, hearken unto me: hold thy peace, and I shall teach thee wisdom.

entries.yo: PẸLUPẸLU Elihu dahùn o si wipe,
entries.en: Furthermore Elihu answered and said,

entries.yo: Ẹnyin ọlọgbọ́n, ẹ gbọ́ ọ̀rọ mi, ki ẹ si dẹtisilẹ si mi, ẹnyin ti ẹ ni ìmoye.
entries.en: Hear my words, O ye wise men; and give ear unto me, ye that have knowledge.

entries.yo: Nitoripe eti a ma dán ọ̀rọ wò, bi adùn ẹnu ti itọ onjẹ wò.
entries.en: For the ear trieth words, as the mouth tasteth meat.

entries.yo: Ẹ jẹ ki a ṣà idajọ yàn fun ara wa; ẹ jẹ ki a mọ̀ ohun ti o dara larin wa.
entries.en: Let us choose to us judgment: let us know among ourselves what is good.

entries.yo: Nitoripe Jobu wipe, Olododo li emi; Ọlọrun si ti gbà idajọ mi lọ.
entries.en: For Job hath said, I am righteous: and God hath taken away my judgment.

entries.yo: Emi ha lè ipurọ si itọsí mi bi, ọfa mi kò ni awọtan, laiṣẹ ni.
entries.en: Should I lie against my right? my wound is incurable without transgression.

entries.yo: Ọkunrin wo li o dabi Jobu, ti nmu ẹ̀gan bi ẹni mu omi.
entries.en: What man is like Job, who drinketh up scorning like water?

entries.yo: Ti mba awọn oniṣẹ ẹ̀ṣẹ kẹgbẹ, ti o si mba awọn enia buburu rin.
entries.en: Which goeth in company with the workers of iniquity, and walketh with wicked men.

entries.yo: Nitori o sa ti wipe, Ère kan kò si fun enia, ti yio fi ma ṣe inu didun si Ọlọrun,
entries.en: For he hath said, It profiteth a man nothing that he should delight himself with God.

entries.yo: Njẹ nitorina, ẹ fetisilẹ si mi, ẹnyin enia amoye: odõdi fun Ọlọrun ti iba fi huwa buburu, ati fun Olodumare, ti yio fi ṣe aiṣedede!
entries.en: Therefore hearken unto me, ye men of understanding: far be it from God, that he should do wickedness; and from the Almighty, that he should commit iniquity.

entries.yo: Nitoripe ẹsan iṣẹ enia ni yio san fun u, yio si mu olukuluku ki o ri gẹgẹ bi ipa-ọ̀na rẹ̀.
entries.en: For the work of a man shall he render unto him, and cause every man to find according to his ways.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ Ọlọrun kì yio hùwakiwa, bẹ̃ni Olodumare kì yio yi idajọ po.
entries.en: Yea, surely God will not do wickedly, neither will the Almighty pervert judgment.

entries.yo: Tani o fi itọju aiye lé e lọwọ, tabi tali o to gbogbo aiye lẹsẹlẹsẹ?
entries.en: Who hath given him a charge over the earth? or who hath disposed the whole world?

entries.yo: Bi o ba gbe aiya rẹ̀ le kiki ara rẹ̀, ti o si gba ọkàn rẹ̀ ati ẹmi rẹ̀ sọdọ ara rẹ̀,
entries.en: If he set his heart upon man, if he gather unto himself his spirit and his breath;

entries.yo: Gbogbo enia ni yio parun pọ̀, enia a si tun pada di erupẹ.
entries.en: All flesh shall perish together, and man shall turn again unto dust.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, bi iwọ ba ni oye, gbọ́ eyi, fetisi ohùn ẹnu mi.
entries.en: If now thou hast understanding, hear this: hearken to the voice of my words.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o korira otitọ le iṣe olori bi? iwọ o ha si da olõtọ-ntọ̀ lẹbi?
entries.en: Shall even he that hateth right govern? and wilt thou condemn him that is most just?

entries.yo: O ha tọ́ lati wi fun ọba pe, Enia buburu ni iwọ, tabi fun awọn ọmọ-alade pe, Alaimọ-lọrun li ẹnyin?
entries.en: Is it fit to say to a king, Thou art wicked? and to princes, Ye are ungodly?

entries.yo: Ambọtori fun ẹniti kì iṣojuṣaju awọn ọmọ-alade, tabi ti kò kà ọlọrọ̀ si jù talaka lọ, nitoripe iṣẹ ọwọ rẹ̀ ni gbogbo wọn iṣe.
entries.en: How much less to him that accepteth not the persons of princes, nor regardeth the rich more than the poor? for they all are the work of his hands.

entries.yo: Ni iṣẹju kan ni nwọn o kú, awọn enia a si di yiyọ lẹnu larin ọganjọ, nwọn a si kọja lọ; a si mu awọn alagbara kuro laifi ọwọ́ ṣe.
entries.en: In a moment shall they die, and the people shall be troubled at midnight, and pass away: and the mighty shall be taken away without hand.

entries.yo: Nitoripe oju rẹ̀ mbẹ ni ipa-ọ̀na enia, on si ri irin rẹ̀ gbogbo.
entries.en: For his eyes are upon the ways of man, and he seeth all his goings.

entries.yo: Kò si òkunkun, tabi ojiji ikú, nibiti awọn oniṣẹ ẹ̀ṣẹ yio gbe sapamọ si.
entries.en: There is no darkness, nor shadow of death, where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.

entries.yo: Nitoripe on kò pẹ ati kiyesi ẹnikan, ki on ki o si mu u lọ sinu idajọ niwaju Ọlọrun.
entries.en: For he will not lay upon man more than right; that he should enter into judgment with God.

entries.yo: On o fọ awọn alagbara tútu laini-iwadi, a si fi ẹlomiran dipo wọn,
entries.en: He shall break in pieces mighty men without number, and set others in their stead.

entries.yo: Nitoripe o mọ̀ iṣẹ wọn, o si yi wọn po di oru, bẹ̃ni nwọn di itẹrẹ́ pọ̀.
entries.en: Therefore he knoweth their works, and he overturneth them in the night, so that they are destroyed.

entries.yo: O kọlu wọn bi enia buburu, nibiti awọn ẹlomiran ri i.
entries.en: He striketh them as wicked men in the open sight of others;

entries.yo: Nitorina ni nwọn pada kẹhinda si i, nwọn kò si ti fiyesi ipa-ọ̀na rẹ̀ gbogbo.
entries.en: Because they turned back from him, and would not consider any of his ways:

entries.yo: Ki nwọn ki o si mu igbe ẹkún awọn talaka lọ de ọdọ rẹ̀, on si gbọ́ igbe ẹkún olupọnju.
entries.en: So that they cause the cry of the poor to come unto him, and he heareth the cry of the afflicted.

entries.yo: Nigbati o ba fun ni ni irọra, tani yio da a lẹbi, nigbati o ba pa oju rẹ̀ mọ, tani yio le iri i? bẹ̃ni o ṣe e si orilẹ-ède tabi si enia kanṣoṣo.
entries.en: When he giveth quietness, who then can make trouble? and when he hideth his face, who then can behold him? whether it be done against a nation, or against a man only:

entries.yo: Ki agabagebe ki o má ba jọba, ki nwọn ki o má di idẹwo fun enia.
entries.en: That the hypocrite reign not, lest the people be ensnared.

entries.yo: Nitoripe ẹnikan ha le wi fun Ọlọrun pe, emi jiya laiṣẹ̀?
entries.en: Surely it is meet to be said unto God, I have borne chastisement, I will not offend any more:

entries.yo: Eyi ti emi kò ri, iwọ fi kọ́ mi, bi mo ba si dẹṣẹ, emi kì yio ṣe bẹ̃ mọ́.
entries.en: That which I see not teach thou me: if I have done iniquity, I will do no more.

entries.yo: Iṣe bi ti inu rẹ pe, on o san ẹ̀san pada? njẹ on yio san a pada, iwọ iba kọ̀ ọ tabi iwọ iba fẹ ẹ, kì iṣe emi, pẹlupẹlu kili iwọ mọ̀, sọ ọ!
entries.en: Should it be according to thy mind? he will recompense it, whether thou refuse, or whether thou choose; and not I: therefore speak what thou knowest.

entries.yo: Awọn enia amoye yio wi fun mi, ati pẹlupẹlu ẹnikẹni ti nṣe ọlọgbọ́n, ti o si gbọ́ mi.
entries.en: Let men of understanding tell me, and let a wise man hearken unto me.

entries.yo: Jobu ti fi aimọ̀ sọ̀rọ, ọ̀rọ rẹ̀ si ṣe alaigbọ́n.
entries.en: Job hath spoken without knowledge, and his words were without wisdom.

entries.yo: Ifẹ mi ni ki a dán Jobu wò de opin, nitori idahùn rẹ̀ nipa ọ̀na enia buburu;
entries.en: My desire is that Job may be tried unto the end because of his answers for wicked men.

entries.yo: Nitoripe o fi iṣọtẹ kún ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ̀, o papẹ́ li awujọ wa, o si sọ ọ̀rọ pupọ si Ọlọrun.
entries.en: For he addeth rebellion unto his sin, he clappeth his hands among us, and multiplieth his words against God.

entries.yo: ELIHU sọ pẹlu o si wipe,
entries.en: Elihu spake moreover, and said,

entries.yo: Iwọ rò pe eyi ha tọ́, ti iwọ wipe, ododo mi ni eyi niwaju Ọlọrun pe,
entries.en: Thinkest thou this to be right, that thou saidst, My righteousness is more than God's?

entries.yo: Nitoriti iwọ wipe, Ère kini yio jasi fun ọ, tabi ère kili emi o fi jẹ jù ère ẹ̀ṣẹ mi lọ?
entries.en: For thou saidst, What advantage will it be unto thee? and, What profit shall I have, if I be cleansed from my sin?

entries.yo: Emi o da ọ lohùn ati awọn ẹgbẹ rẹ pẹlu rẹ.
entries.en: I will answer thee, and thy companions with thee.

entries.yo: Ṣiju wò ọrun, ki o ri i, ki o si bojuwo awọsanma ti o ga jù ọ lọ.
entries.en: Look unto the heavens, and see; and behold the clouds which are higher than thou.

entries.yo: Bi iwọ ba ṣẹ̀ kini iwọ fi ṣe si i? tabi bi irekọja rẹ di pupọ, kini iwọ fi eyini ṣe si i?
entries.en: If thou sinnest, what doest thou against him? or if thy transgressions be multiplied, what doest thou unto him?

entries.yo: Bi iwọ ba si ṣe olododo, kini iwọ fi bùn u, tabi kili on ri gbà lati ọwọ rẹ wá?
entries.en: If thou be righteous, what givest thou him? or what receiveth he of thine hand?

entries.yo: Ìwa buburu rẹ ni fun enia bi iwọ; ododo rẹ si ni fun ọmọ enia.
entries.en: Thy wickedness may hurt a man as thou art; and thy righteousness may profit the son of man.

entries.yo: Nipa ọ̀pọlọpọ ininilara nwọn mu ni kigbe, nwọn kigbe nitori apá awọn alagbara.
entries.en: By reason of the multitude of oppressions they make the oppressed to cry: they cry out by reason of the arm of the mighty.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn kò si ẹniti o wipe, Nibo ni Ọlọrun Ẹlẹda mi wà, ti o fi orin fun mi li oru?
entries.en: But none saith, Where is God my maker, who giveth songs in the night;

entries.yo: Ti on kọ́ wa li ẹkọ́ jù awọn ẹranko aiye lọ, ti o si mu wa gbọ́n jù awọn ẹiyẹ oju ọrun lọ.
entries.en: Who teacheth us more than the beasts of the earth, and maketh us wiser than the fowls of heaven?

entries.yo: Nigbana ni nwọn ke, ṣugbọn Ọlọrun kò dahùn nitori igberaga awọn enia buburu.
entries.en: There they cry, but none giveth answer, because of the pride of evil men.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ Ọlọrun kì yio gbọ́ asan, bẹ̃ni Olodumare kì yio kà a si.
entries.en: Surely God will not hear vanity, neither will the Almighty regard it.

entries.yo: Bi o tilẹ ṣepe iwọ wipe, iwọ kì iri i, ọran idajọ mbẹ niwaju rẹ̀, ẹniti iwọ si gbẹkẹle.
entries.en: Although thou sayest thou shalt not see him, yet judgment is before him; therefore trust thou in him.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nisisiyi nitoriti ibinu rẹ̀ kò ti ṣẹ́ ọ niṣẹ, on kò ha le imọ̀ ọ̀pọlọpọ ẹ̀ṣẹ bi?
entries.en: But now, because it is not so, he hath visited in his anger; yet he knoweth it not in great extremity:

entries.yo: Nitorina ni Jobu ṣe ya ẹnu rẹ̀ lasan, o sọ ọ̀rọ di pupọ laisi ìmọ.
entries.en: Therefore doth Job open his mouth in vain; he multiplieth words without knowledge.

entries.yo: ELIHU si sọ si i lọ wipe,
entries.en: Elihu also proceeded, and said,

entries.yo: Bùn mi laye diẹ, emi o si fi hàn ọ, nitori ọ̀rọ sisọ ni o kù fun Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Suffer me a little, and I will shew thee that I have yet to speak on God's behalf.

entries.yo: Emi o mu ìmọ mi ti ọ̀na jijin wá, emi o si fi ododo fun Ẹlẹda mi.
entries.en: I will fetch my knowledge from afar, and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.

entries.yo: Nitoripe ọ̀rọ mi kì yio ṣeke nitõtọ, ẹniti o pé ni ìmọ wà pẹlu rẹ.
entries.en: For truly my words shall not be false: he that is perfect in knowledge is with thee.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, Ọlọrun li agbara, kò si gàn ẹnikẹni, o li agbara ni ipá ati oye.
entries.en: Behold, God is mighty, and despiseth not any: he is mighty in strength and wisdom.

entries.yo: On kì ida ẹmi enia buburu sí, ṣugbọn o fi otitọ fun awọn talaka.
entries.en: He preserveth not the life of the wicked: but giveth right to the poor.

entries.yo: On kì imu oju rẹ̀ kuro lara olododo, ṣugbọn pẹlu awọn ọba ni nwọn wà lori itẹ; ani o fi idi wọn mulẹ lailai, a si gbe wọn lekè.
entries.en: He withdraweth not his eyes from the righteous: but with kings are they on the throne; yea, he doth establish them for ever, and they are exalted.

entries.yo: Bi a ba si dè wọn ninu àba, ti a si fi okun ipọnju dè wọn,
entries.en: And if they be bound in fetters, and be holden in cords of affliction;

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ifi iṣẹ wọn hàn fun wọn, ati irekọja wọn ti nwọn fi gbe ara wọn ga.
entries.en: Then he sheweth them their work, and their transgressions that they have exceeded.

entries.yo: O ṣi wọn leti pẹlu si ọ̀na ẹkọ́, o si paṣẹ ki nwọn ki o pada kuro ninu aiṣedede.
entries.en: He openeth also their ear to discipline, and commandeth that they return from iniquity.

entries.yo: Bi nwọn ba gbagbọ, ti nwọn si sin i, nwọn o lò ọjọ wọn ninu ìrọra, ati ọdun wọn ninu afẹ́.
entries.en: If they obey and serve him, they shall spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi nwọn kò ba gbagbọ, nwọn o ti ọwọ idà ṣègbe, nwọn a si kú laini oye.
entries.en: But if they obey not, they shall perish by the sword, and they shall die without knowledge.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn àgabagebe li aiya kó ibinu jọ; nwọn kò kigbe nigbati o ba dè wọn.
entries.en: But the hypocrites in heart heap up wrath: they cry not when he bindeth them.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ọkàn wọn yio kú li ewe, ẹmi wọn a si wà ninu awọn oniwa Sodomu.
entries.en: They die in youth, and their life is among the unclean.

entries.yo: On gba otoṣi ninu ipọnju rẹ̀, a si ṣi wọn li eti ninu inilara.
entries.en: He delivereth the poor in his affliction, and openeth their ears in oppression.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni pẹlupẹlu o si dẹ̀ ọ lọ lati inu ihagaga si ibi gbõrò, ti kò ni wahala ninu rẹ̀; ati ohun ti a si gbe kalẹ ni tabeli rẹ, a jẹ kiki ọ̀ra.
entries.en: Even so would he have removed thee out of the strait into a broad place, where there is no straitness; and that which should be set on thy table should be full of fatness.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn iwọ kún fun idajọ awọn enia buburu; idajọ ati otitọ di ọ mu.
entries.en: But thou hast fulfilled the judgment of the wicked: judgment and justice take hold on thee.

entries.yo: Nitori ibinu mbẹ, ṣọra ki titó rẹ ma bà tàn ọ lọ; má si ṣe jẹ ki titobi irapada mu ọ ṣìna.
entries.en: Because there is wrath, beware lest he take thee away with his stroke: then a great ransom cannot deliver thee.

entries.yo: Ọrọ̀ rẹ pọ̀ to, ti wahala kì yio fi de ba ọ bi? tabi ipá agbara rẹ?
entries.en: Will he esteem thy riches? no, not gold, nor all the forces of strength.

entries.yo: Má ṣe ifẹ oru, nigbati a nke awọn orilẹ-ède kuro ni ipo wọn.
entries.en: Desire not the night, when people are cut off in their place.

entries.yo: Ma ṣọra ki iwọ ki o má yi ara rẹ pada si asan, nitori eyi ni iwọ ti ṣàyan jù sũru lọ.
entries.en: Take heed, regard not iniquity: for this hast thou chosen rather than affliction.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, Ọlọrun a gbeni ga nipa agbara rẹ̀, tani jẹ olukọni bi on?
entries.en: Behold, God exalteth by his power: who teacheth like him?

entries.yo: Tali o là ọ̀na-iṣẹ rẹ̀ silẹ fun u, tabi tali o lè wipe, Iwọ ti nṣe aiṣedede?
entries.en: Who hath enjoined him his way? or who can say, Thou hast wrought iniquity?

entries.yo: Ranti ki iwọ ki o gbe iṣẹ́ rẹ̀ ga, ti enia ima kọrin si.
entries.en: Remember that thou magnify his work, which men behold.

entries.yo: Olukuluku enia a ma ri i, ẹni-ikú a ma wò o li okere.
entries.en: Every man may see it; man may behold it afar off.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, Ọlọrun tobi, awa kò si mọ̀ bi o ti tobi to! bẹ̃ni a kò le wadi iye ọdun rẹ̀ ri.
entries.en: Behold, God is great, and we know him not, neither can the number of his years be searched out.

entries.yo: Nitoripe on li o fa ikán omi ojo silẹ, ki nwọn ki o kán bi ojo ni ikuku rẹ̀.
entries.en: For he maketh small the drops of water: they pour down rain according to the vapour thereof:

entries.yo: Ti awọsanma nrọ̀, ti o si nfi sẹ̀ lọpọlọpọ lori enia.
entries.en: Which the clouds do drop and distil upon man abundantly.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu ẹnikẹni le imọ̀ itanká awọsanma, tabi ariwo agọ rẹ̀?
entries.en: Also can any understand the spreadings of the clouds, or the noise of his tabernacle?

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, o tàn imọlẹ yi ara rẹ̀ ka, o si fi isalẹ omi okun bò ara rẹ̀ mọlẹ.
entries.en: Behold, he spreadeth his light upon it, and covereth the bottom of the sea.

entries.yo: Nitoripe nipa wọn ni nṣe idajọ enia, o fun ni li onjẹ li ọ̀pọlọpọ.
entries.en: For by them judgeth he the people; he giveth meat in abundance.

entries.yo: O fi imọlẹ̀ bò ọwọ rẹ̀ mejeji, o si ran a si ẹni olodi.
entries.en: With clouds he covereth the light; and commandeth it not to shine by the cloud that cometh betwixt.

entries.yo: Ariwo ãrá rẹ̀ fi i han ni, ọ̀wọ-ẹran pẹlu wipe, O sunmọ etile!
entries.en: The noise thereof sheweth concerning it, the cattle also concerning the vapour.

entries.yo: AIYA si fò mi si eyi pẹlu, o si ṣi kuro ni ipò rẹ̀.
entries.en: At this also my heart trembleth, and is moved out of his place.

entries.yo: Fetisilẹ dãda, ki ẹ si gbọ́ iró ohùn rẹ̀, ati iró ti o ti ẹnu rẹ̀ jade wá.
entries.en: Hear attentively the noise of his voice, and the sound that goeth out of his mouth.

entries.yo: O ṣe ilana rẹ̀ nisalẹ abẹ ọrun gbogbo, manamana rẹ̀ ni o si jọwọ rẹ̀ lọwọ de opin ilẹ aiye.
entries.en: He directeth it under the whole heaven, and his lightning unto the ends of the earth.

entries.yo: Lẹhin manamana ohùn kan fọ̀ ramuramu, o fi ohùn ọlanla rẹ̀ sán ãrá: on kì yio si da ãrá duro nigbati a ba ngbọ́ ohùn rẹ̀.
entries.en: After it a voice roareth: he thundereth with the voice of his excellency; and he will not stay them when his voice is heard.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun fi ohùn rẹ̀ sán ãrá iyanilẹnu, ohun nlanla ni iṣe ti awa kò le imọ̀.
entries.en: God thundereth marvellously with his voice; great things doeth he, which we cannot comprehend.

entries.yo: Nitoriti o wi fun ojo didì pe, Iwọ rọ̀ silẹ aiye, ati pẹlu fun ọwọ ojo, ati fun ojo nla agbara rẹ̀.
entries.en: For he saith to the snow, Be thou on the earth; likewise to the small rain, and to the great rain of his strength.

entries.yo: O fi edidi di gbogbo enia, ki gbogbo wọn ki o le imọ̀ iṣẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: He sealeth up the hand of every man; that all men may know his work.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni awọn ẹranko iwọnu ihò lọ, nwọn a si wà ni ipò wọn.
entries.en: Then the beasts go into dens, and remain in their places.

entries.yo: Lati iha gusu ni ìji ajayika ti ijade wá, ati otutu lati inu afẹfẹ ti tu awọsanma ká.
entries.en: Out of the south cometh the whirlwind: and cold out of the north.

entries.yo: Nipa ẹmi Ọlọrun a fi ìdi-omi funni, ibu-omi a si sunkì.
entries.en: By the breath of God frost is given: and the breadth of the waters is straitened.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu o fi omi pupọ mu awọsanma wuwo, a si tú awọsanma imọlẹ rẹ̀ ká.
entries.en: Also by watering he wearieth the thick cloud: he scattereth his bright cloud:

entries.yo: Awọn wọnyi ni a si yi kakiri nipa ilana rẹ̀, ki nwọn ki o le iṣe ohunkohun ti o pa fun wọn li aṣẹ loju aiye lori ilẹ.
entries.en: And it is turned round about by his counsels: that they may do whatsoever he commandeth them upon the face of the world in the earth.

entries.yo: O mu u wá ibãṣe fun ikilọ̀ ni, tabi fun rere ilẹ rẹ̀, tabi fun ãnu.
entries.en: He causeth it to come, whether for correction, or for his land, or for mercy.

entries.yo: Jobu dẹtisilẹ si eyi, duro jẹ, ki o si rò iṣẹ iyanu Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Hearken unto this, O Job: stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.

entries.yo: Iwọ mọ̀ akoko ìgba ti Ọlọrun sọ wọn lọjọ̀, ti o si mu imọlẹ awọsanma rẹ̀ dán?
entries.en: Dost thou know when God disposed them, and caused the light of his cloud to shine?

entries.yo: Iwọ mọ̀ ọ̀na ti awọsanma ifo lọ; iṣẹ iyanu ẹniti o pé ni ìmọ?
entries.en: Dost thou know the balancings of the clouds, the wondrous works of him which is perfect in knowledge?

entries.yo: Aṣọ rẹ̀ ti ma gbona, nigbati o mu aiye dakẹ lati gusu wá.
entries.en: How thy garments are warm, when he quieteth the earth by the south wind?

entries.yo: Iwọ ha ba a tẹ pẹpẹ oju-ọrun, ti o duro ṣinṣin, ti o si dabi digi ti o yọ́ dà.
entries.en: Hast thou with him spread out the sky, which is strong, and as a molten looking glass?

entries.yo: Kọ́ wa li eyi ti a le iwi fun u; nitoripe awa kò le iladi ọ̀rọ nitori òkunkun.
entries.en: Teach us what we shall say unto him; for we cannot order our speech by reason of darkness.

entries.yo: A o ha wi fun u pe, Emi fẹ sọ̀rọ? tabi ẹnikan wipe, Ifẹ mi ni pe ki a gbe mi mì?
entries.en: Shall it be told him that I speak? if a man speak, surely he shall be swallowed up.

entries.yo: Sibẹ nisisiyi enia kò ri imọlẹ ti ndán ninu awọsanma, ṣugbọn afẹfẹ kọja, a si gbá wọn mọ́.
entries.en: And now men see not the bright light which is in the clouds: but the wind passeth, and cleanseth them.

entries.yo: Wura didan ti inu iha ariwa jade wá, lọdọ Ọlọrun li ọlanla ẹ̀ru-nla.
entries.en: Fair weather cometh out of the north: with God is terrible majesty.

entries.yo: Nipa ti Olodumare awa kò le iwadi rẹ̀ ri, o rekọja ni ipá, on kì iba idajọ ati ọ̀pọlọpọ otitọ jẹ.
entries.en: Touching the Almighty, we cannot find him out: he is excellent in power, and in judgment, and in plenty of justice: he will not afflict.

entries.yo: Nitorina enia a ma bẹ̀ru rẹ̀, on kì iṣojusaju ẹnikẹni ti o gbọ́n ni inu.
entries.en: Men do therefore fear him: he respecteth not any that are wise of heart.

entries.yo: NIGBANA ni OLUWA da Jobu lohùn lati inu ìji ajayika wá o si wipe,
entries.en: Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind, and said,

entries.yo: Tani eyi ti nfi ọ̀rọ aini igbiro ṣú ìmọ li òkunkun.
entries.en: Who is this that darkeneth counsel by words without knowledge?

entries.yo: Di ẹgbẹ ara rẹ li amure bi ọkunrin nisisiyi, nitoripe emi o bère lọwọ rẹ ki o si da mi lohùn.
entries.en: Gird up now thy loins like a man; for I will demand of thee, and answer thou me.

entries.yo: Nibo ni iwọ wà nigbati mo fi ipilẹ aiye sọlẹ? wi bi iwọ ba moye!
entries.en: Where wast thou when I laid the foundations of the earth? declare, if thou hast understanding.

entries.yo: Tali o fi ìwọn rẹ̀ lelẹ, bi iwọ ba mọ̀, tabi tani o ta okun wiwọn sori rẹ̀.
entries.en: Who hath laid the measures thereof, if thou knowest? or who hath stretched the line upon it?

entries.yo: Lori ibo ni a gbe kan ipilẹ rẹ̀ mọ́, tabi tali o fi okuta igun rẹ̀ le ilẹ?
entries.en: Whereupon are the foundations thereof fastened? or who laid the corner stone thereof;

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn irawọ owurọ jumọ kọrin pọ̀, ti gbogbo awọn ọmọ Ọlọrun nhó iho ayọ̀?
entries.en: When the morning stars sang together, and all the sons of God shouted for joy?

entries.yo: Tabi tali o fi ilẹkun sé omi okun mọ́, nigbati o ya jade bi ẹnipe o ti inu tu jade wá?
entries.en: Or who shut up the sea with doors, when it brake forth, as if it had issued out of the womb?

entries.yo: Nigbati mo fi awọsanma ṣe aṣọ rẹ̀, ati òkunkun ṣiṣu ṣe ọ̀ja igbanu rẹ̀?
entries.en: When I made the cloud the garment thereof, and thick darkness a swaddlingband for it,

entries.yo: Ti mo ti paṣẹ ipinnu mi fun u, ti mo si ṣe bèbe ati ilẹkun.
entries.en: And brake up for it my decreed place, and set bars and doors,

entries.yo: Ti mo si wipe, Nihinyi ni iwọ o dé, ki o má si rekọja, nihinyi si ni igberaga riru omi rẹ yio gbe duro mọ.
