entries.en: And said, Hitherto shalt thou come, but no further: and here shall thy proud waves be stayed?

entries.yo: Iwọ paṣẹ fun owurọ lati igba ọjọ rẹ̀ wá, iwọ si mu ila-õrun mọ̀ ipo rẹ̀?
entries.en: Hast thou commanded the morning since thy days; and caused the dayspring to know his place;

entries.yo: Ki o le idi opin ilẹ aiye mu, ki a le gbọ̀n awọn enia buburu kuro ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: That it might take hold of the ends of the earth, that the wicked might be shaken out of it?

entries.yo: Ki o yipada bi amọ fun edidi amọ, ki gbogbo rẹ̀ ki o si fi ara rẹ̀ hàn bi ẹnipe ninu aṣọ igunwa.
entries.en: It is turned as clay to the seal; and they stand as a garment.

entries.yo: A si fa imọlẹ wọn sẹhin kuro lọdọ enia buburu, apa giga li o si ṣẹ́.
entries.en: And from the wicked their light is withholden, and the high arm shall be broken.

entries.yo: Iwọ ha wọ inu isun okun lọ ri bi? iwọ si rin lori isalẹ ibú nla?
entries.en: Hast thou entered into the springs of the sea? or hast thou walked in the search of the depth?

entries.yo: A ha ṣilẹkun ikú silẹ fun ọ ri bi, iwọ si ri ilẹkun ojiji ikú?
entries.en: Have the gates of death been opened unto thee? or hast thou seen the doors of the shadow of death?

entries.yo: Iwọ̀ moye ibú aiye bi? sọ bi iwọ ba mọ̀ gbogbo rẹ̀?
entries.en: Hast thou perceived the breadth of the earth? declare if thou knowest it all.

entries.yo: Ọ̀na wo ni imọlẹ igbé, bi o ṣe ti òkunkun, nibo ni ipò rẹ̀?
entries.en: Where is the way where light dwelleth? and as for darkness, where is the place thereof,

entries.yo: Ti iwọ o fi mu u lọ si ibi àla rẹ̀, ti iwọ o si le imọ̀ ipa-ọ̀na lọ sinu ile rẹ̀?
entries.en: That thou shouldest take it to the bound thereof, and that thou shouldest know the paths to the house thereof?

entries.yo: Iwọ mọ̀ eyi, nitoriti ni igbana ni a bi ọ? ati iye ọjọ rẹ si pọ!
entries.en: Knowest thou it, because thou wast then born? or because the number of thy days is great?

entries.yo: Iwọ ha wọ inu iṣura ojò-dídì lọ ri bí, iwọ si ri ile iṣura yinyin ri?
entries.en: Hast thou entered into the treasures of the snow? or hast thou seen the treasures of the hail,

entries.yo: Ti mo ti fi pamọ de igba iyọnu, de ọjọ ogun ati ijà.
entries.en: Which I have reserved against the time of trouble, against the day of battle and war?

entries.yo: Ọ̀na wo ni imọlẹ fi nyà, ti afẹfẹ ila-orun tàn kakiri lori ilẹ aiye?
entries.en: By what way is the light parted, which scattereth the east wind upon the earth?

entries.yo: Tali o la ipado fun ẹkún iṣan omi, ati ọ̀na fun manamana ãrá?
entries.en: Who hath divided a watercourse for the overflowing of waters, or a way for the lightning of thunder;

entries.yo: Lati mu u rọ̀jo sori aiye, nibiti enia kò si, ni aginju nibiti enia kò si.
entries.en: To cause it to rain on the earth, where no man is; on the wilderness, wherein there is no man;

entries.yo: Lati mu ilẹ tutù, ijù ati alairo, ati lati mu irudi ọmudún eweko ru jade?
entries.en: To satisfy the desolate and waste ground; and to cause the bud of the tender herb to spring forth?

entries.yo: Ojo ha ni baba bi, tabi tali o bi ikán ìsẹ-iri?
entries.en: Hath the rain a father? or who hath begotten the drops of dew?

entries.yo: Lati inu tani ìdi omi ti jade wá, ati ìri didi ọrun tali o bi i?
entries.en: Out of whose womb came the ice? and the hoary frost of heaven, who hath gendered it?

entries.yo: Omi bò o mọlẹ bi ẹnipe labẹ okuta, oju ibú nla si dìlupọ̀.
entries.en: The waters are hid as with a stone, and the face of the deep is frozen.

entries.yo: Iwọ le ifi ọja de awọn irawọ meje [Pleyade] tabi iwọ le itudi irawọ Orionu?
entries.en: Canst thou bind the sweet influences of Pleiades, or loose the bands of Orion?

entries.yo: Iwọ le imu awọn ami mejejila irawọ [Massaroti] jade wá ni igba akoko wọn? tabi iwọ le iṣe àmọna Arketuru pẹlu awọn ọmọ rẹ̀?
entries.en: Canst thou bring forth Mazzaroth in his season? or canst thou guide Arcturus with his sons?

entries.yo: Iwọ mọ̀ ilana-ilana ọrun, iwọ le ifi ijọba rẹ̀ lelẹ li aiye?
entries.en: Knowest thou the ordinances of heaven? canst thou set the dominion thereof in the earth?

entries.yo: Iwọ le igbé ohùn rẹ soke de awọsanma, ki ọ̀pọlọpọ omi ki o le bò ọ?
entries.en: Canst thou lift up thy voice to the clouds, that abundance of waters may cover thee?

entries.yo: Iwọ le iran mànamána ki nwọn ki o le ilọ, ki nwọn ki o si wi fun ọ pe, Awa nĩ!
entries.en: Canst thou send lightnings, that they may go, and say unto thee, Here we are?

entries.yo: Tali o fi ọgbọ́n si odo-inu, tabi tali o fi oye sinu aiya?
entries.en: Who hath put wisdom in the inward parts? or who hath given understanding to the heart?

entries.yo: Tali o fi ọgbọ́n ka iye awọsanma, tali o si mu igo ọrun dàjade.
entries.en: Who can number the clouds in wisdom? or who can stay the bottles of heaven,

entries.yo: Nigbati erupẹ di lile, ati ogulutu dipọ̀?
entries.en: When the dust groweth into hardness, and the clods cleave fast together?

entries.yo: Iwọ o ha dẹ ọdẹ fun abo kiniun bi, iwọ o si tẹ́ ebi ẹgbọrọ kiniun lọrun?
entries.en: Wilt thou hunt the prey for the lion? or fill the appetite of the young lions,

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn ba mọlẹ ninu iho wọn, ti nwọn si ba ni ibuba de ohun ọdẹ.
entries.en: When they couch in their dens, and abide in the covert to lie in wait?

entries.yo: Tani npese ohun jijẹ fun ìwo? nigbati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ nkepe Ọlọrun, nwọn a ma fò kiri nitori aili ohun jijẹ.
entries.en: Who provideth for the raven his food? when his young ones cry unto God, they wander for lack of meat.

entries.yo: IWỌ mọ̀ akoko igbati awọn ewurẹ ori apata ibimọ, iwọ si le ikiyesi igba ti abo-agbọnrin ibimọ?
entries.en: Knowest thou the time when the wild goats of the rock bring forth? or canst thou mark when the hinds do calve?

entries.yo: Iwọ le ika iye oṣu ti nwọn npé, iwọ si mọ̀ àkoko igba ti nwọn ibi?
entries.en: Canst thou number the months that they fulfil? or knowest thou the time when they bring forth?

entries.yo: Nwọn tẹ ara wọn ba, nwọn bimọ wọn, nwọn si mu ikãnu wọn jade.
entries.en: They bow themselves, they bring forth their young ones, they cast out their sorrows.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ wọn ri daradara, nwọn dagba ninu ọ̀dan, nwọn jade lọ, nwọn kò si tun pada wá mọ́ sọdọ wọn.
entries.en: Their young ones are in good liking, they grow up with corn; they go forth, and return not unto them.

entries.yo: Tali o jọ̃ kẹtẹkẹtẹ-oko lọwọ, tabi tali o tú ide kẹtẹkẹtẹ igbẹ́?
entries.en: Who hath sent out the wild ass free? or who hath loosed the bands of the wild ass?

entries.yo: Eyi ti mo fi aginju ṣe ile fun, ati ilẹ iyọ̀ ni ibugbe rẹ̀.
entries.en: Whose house I have made the wilderness, and the barren land his dwellings.

entries.yo: O rẹrin si ariwo ilu, bẹ̃ni on kò si gbọ́ igbe darandaran.
entries.en: He scorneth the multitude of the city, neither regardeth he the crying of the driver.

entries.yo: Ori àtòle oke-nla ni ibujẹ oko rẹ̀, on a si ma wá ewe tutu gbogbo ri.
entries.en: The range of the mountains is his pasture, and he searcheth after every green thing.

entries.yo: Agbanrere ha jẹ sìn ọ bi, tabi o jẹ duro ni ibujẹ ẹran rẹ?
entries.en: Will the unicorn be willing to serve thee, or abide by thy crib?

entries.yo: Iwọ le ifi kátà dè agbanrere ninu aporo, tabi o jẹ ma fà itulẹ ninu aporo oko tọ̀ ọ lẹhin?
entries.en: Canst thou bind the unicorn with his band in the furrow? or will he harrow the valleys after thee?

entries.yo: Iwọ o gbẹkẹlẹ e, nitori agbara rẹ̀ pọ̀, iwọ o si fi iṣẹ rẹ le e li ọwọ?
entries.en: Wilt thou trust him, because his strength is great? or wilt thou leave thy labour to him?

entries.yo: Iwọ le igbẹkẹle e pe, yio mu eso oko rẹ wá sile; pe, yio si ko o jọ sinu àka rẹ̀?
entries.en: Wilt thou believe him, that he will bring home thy seed, and gather it into thy barn?

entries.yo: Iyẹ abo-ogongo nfi ayọ̀ fì, iyẹ ati ihuhu rẹ̀ daradara ni bi?
entries.en: Gavest thou the goodly wings unto the peacocks? or wings and feathers unto the ostrich?

entries.yo: Kò ri bẹ̃? o fi ẹyin rẹ̀ silẹ-yilẹ, a si mu wọn gbona ninu ekuru.
entries.en: Which leaveth her eggs in the earth, and warmeth them in dust,

entries.yo: Ti o si gbagbe pe, ẹsẹ le itẹ wọn fọ, tabi pe, ẹranko igbẹ le itẹ wọn fọ:
entries.en: And forgetteth that the foot may crush them, or that the wild beast may break them.

entries.yo: Kò ni ãjo si awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ bi ẹnipe nwọn kì iṣe tirẹ̀, asan ni iṣẹ rẹ̀ laibẹru:
entries.en: She is hardened against her young ones, as though they were not hers: her labour is in vain without fear;

entries.yo: Nitoripe Ọlọrun dù u li ọgbọ́n, bẹ̃ni kò si fi ipin oye fun u.
entries.en: Because God hath deprived her of wisdom, neither hath he imparted to her understanding.

entries.yo: Nigbati o gbe ara soke, o gàn ẹṣin ati ẹlẹṣin.
entries.en: What time she lifteth up herself on high, she scorneth the horse and his rider.

entries.yo: Iwọ li o fi agbara fun ẹṣin, iwọ li o fi gọ̀gọ wọ ọrùn rẹ̀ li aṣọ?
entries.en: Hast thou given the horse strength? hast thou clothed his neck with thunder?

entries.yo: Iwọ le imu u fò soke bi ẹlẹnga, ogo ẽmi imu rẹ̀ ni ẹ̀ru-nla.
entries.en: Canst thou make him afraid as a grasshopper? the glory of his nostrils is terrible.

entries.yo: O fi ẹsẹ halẹ ninu aporo, o si yọ̀ si agbara rẹ̀; o nlọ jade lati pade awọn ahamọra ogun.
entries.en: He paweth in the valley, and rejoiceth in his strength: he goeth on to meet the armed men.

entries.yo: O fi oju kekere wò ẹ̀ru, aiya kò si fò o; bẹ̃ni kì isi ipada sẹhin kuro lọwọ idà.
entries.en: He mocketh at fear, and is not affrighted; neither turneth he back from the sword.

entries.yo: Lọdọ rẹ̀ ni apo-ọfa nmi pẹkẹpẹkẹ, ati ọ̀kọ didan ati apata.
entries.en: The quiver rattleth against him, the glittering spear and the shield.

entries.yo: On fi kikoro oju ati ibinu nla gbe ilẹ mì, bẹ̃li on kò si gbagbọ pe, iro ipè ni.
entries.en: He swalloweth the ground with fierceness and rage: neither believeth he that it is the sound of the trumpet.

entries.yo: O wi ni igba ipè pe, Ha! Ha! o si gborùn ogun lokere rere: ãrá awọn balogun ati ihó àyọ wọn.
entries.en: He saith among the trumpets, Ha, ha; and he smelleth the battle afar off, the thunder of the captains, and the shouting.

entries.yo: Awodi a ma ti ipa ọgbọ́n rẹ fò soke, ti o si nà iyẹ apa rẹ̀ siha gusu?
entries.en: Doth the hawk fly by thy wisdom, and stretch her wings toward the south?

entries.yo: Idì a ma fi aṣẹ rẹ fò lọ soke, ki o si lọ itẹ ìtẹ rẹ̀ si oke giga?
entries.en: Doth the eagle mount up at thy command, and make her nest on high?

entries.yo: O ngbe o si wọ̀ li ori apata, lori palapala okuta ati ibi ori oke.
entries.en: She dwelleth and abideth on the rock, upon the crag of the rock, and the strong place.

entries.yo: Lati ibẹ lọ ni ima wá ọdẹ kiri, oju rẹ̀ si riran li òkere rere.
entries.en: From thence she seeketh the prey, and her eyes behold afar off.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ pẹlu a ma mu ẹ̀jẹ, nibiti okú ba gbe wà, nibẹ li on wà pẹlu.
entries.en: Her young ones also suck up blood: and where the slain are, there is she.

entries.yo: OLUWA da Jobu lohùn si i pẹlu, o si wipe,
entries.en: Moreover the LORD answered Job, and said,

entries.yo: Ẹniti mba Olodumare jà, yio ha kọ́ ọ li ẹkọ́? ẹniti mba Ọlọrun wi, jẹ ki o dahùn!
entries.en: Shall he that contendeth with the Almighty instruct him? he that reproveth God, let him answer it.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Jobu da Oluwa lohùn, o si wipe:
entries.en: Then Job answered the LORD, and said,

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, ẹgbin li emi; ohùn kili emi o da? emi o fi ọwọ mi le ẹnu mi.
entries.en: Behold, I am vile; what shall I answer thee? I will lay mine hand upon my mouth.

entries.yo: Ẹ̃kan ni mo sọ̀rọ̀, ṣugbọn emi kì yio si tun sọ mọ, lẹ̃meji ni, emi kò si le iṣe e mọ́.
entries.en: Once have I spoken; but I will not answer: yea, twice; but I will proceed no further.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni OLUWA da Jobu lohùn lati inu ìji ajayika wá o si wipe:
entries.en: Then answered the LORD unto Job out of the whirlwind, and said,

entries.yo: Di àmure giri li ẹgbẹ rẹ bi ọkunrin, emi o bi ọ lere, ki iwọ ki o si kọ́ mi li ẹkọ́.
entries.en: Gird up thy loins now like a man: I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto me.

entries.yo: Iwọ ha fẹ imu idajọ mi di asan? iwọ o si da mi lẹbi, ki iwọ ki o le iṣe olododo?
entries.en: Wilt thou also disannul my judgment? wilt thou condemn me, that thou mayest be righteous?

entries.yo: Iwọ ni apá bi Ọlọrun, tabi iwọ le ifi ohùn san ãrá bi on?
entries.en: Hast thou an arm like God? or canst thou thunder with a voice like him?

entries.yo: Fi ọlanla ati ọla-itayọ ṣe ara rẹ li ọṣọ, ki o si fi ogo ati ẹwa ọṣọ bò ara rẹ li aṣọ.
entries.en: Deck thyself now with majesty and excellency; and array thyself with glory and beauty.

entries.yo: Mu irunu ibinu rẹ jade, kiyesi gbogbo ìwa igberaga, ki o si rẹ̀ ẹ silẹ.
entries.en: Cast abroad the rage of thy wrath: and behold every one that is proud, and abase him.

entries.yo: Wò gbogbo ìwa igberaga, ki o si rẹ̀ ẹ silẹ, ki o si tẹ enia buburu mọlẹ ni ipo wọn.
entries.en: Look on every one that is proud, and bring him low; and tread down the wicked in their place.

entries.yo: Fi wọn sin pọ̀ ninu erupẹ, ki o si di oju wọn ni ikọkọ.
entries.en: Hide them in the dust together; and bind their faces in secret.

entries.yo: Nigbana li emi o yìn ọ pe, ọwọ ọ̀tun ara rẹ le igba ọ la.
entries.en: Then will I also confess unto thee that thine own right hand can save thee.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi kiyesi Behemotu ti mo da pẹlu rẹ, on a ma jẹ koriko bi ọ̀da-malu.
entries.en: Behold now behemoth, which I made with thee; he eateth grass as an ox.

entries.yo: Wò o nisisiyi, agbara rẹ̀ wà li ẹgbẹ́ rẹ̀, ati ipa rẹ̀ ninu iṣan ikún rẹ̀.
entries.en: Lo now, his strength is in his loins, and his force is in the navel of his belly.

entries.yo: On a ma jù ìru rẹ̀ bi igi kedari, iṣan itan rẹ̀ dijọ pọ̀.
entries.en: He moveth his tail like a cedar: the sinews of his stones are wrapped together.

entries.yo: Egungun rẹ̀ ni ogusọ idẹ, egungun rẹ̀ dabi ọpa irin.
entries.en: His bones are as strong pieces of brass; his bones are like bars of iron.

entries.yo: On ni olu nipa ọ̀na Ọlọrun; ẹniti o da a o fi idà rẹ̀ le e lọwọ.
entries.en: He is the chief of the ways of God: he that made him can make his sword to approach unto him.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ oke nlanla ni imu ohun jijẹ fun u wá, nibiti gbogbo ẹranko igbẹ ima ṣire.
entries.en: Surely the mountains bring him forth food, where all the beasts of the field play.

entries.yo: O dubulẹ labẹ igi Lotosi, ninu ifefe bibò ati ẹrẹ.
entries.en: He lieth under the shady trees, in the covert of the reed, and fens.

entries.yo: Igi Lotosi ṣiji wọn bò o, igi arọrọ odò yi i kakiri.
entries.en: The shady trees cover him with their shadow; the willows of the brook compass him about.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, odò nla ṣan jọjọ, on kò salọ, o wà lailewu bi o ba ṣe odò Jordani ti ṣan lọ si ẹnu rẹ̀.
entries.en: Behold, he drinketh up a river, and hasteth not: he trusteth that he can draw up Jordan into his mouth.

entries.yo: Ẹnikan ha le imu u li oju rẹ̀ tabi a ma fi ọkọ gun imú rẹ̀?
entries.en: He taketh it with his eyes: his nose pierceth through snares.

entries.yo: IWỌ le ifi ìwọ fa Lefiatani [ọni nla] jade, tabi iwọ le imu ahọn rẹ̀ ninu okùn?
entries.en: Canst thou draw out leviathan with an hook? or his tongue with a cord which thou lettest down?

entries.yo: Iwọ le ifi ìwọ bọ̀ ọ ni imu, tabi o le ifi ẹgun lu u li ẹrẹkẹ?
entries.en: Canst thou put an hook into his nose? or bore his jaw through with a thorn?

entries.yo: On o ha jẹ bẹ ẹ̀bẹ lọdọ rẹ li ọ̀pọlọpọ bi, on o ha ba ọ sọ̀rọ pẹlẹ?
entries.en: Will he make many supplications unto thee? will he speak soft words unto thee?

entries.yo: On o ha ba ọ dá majẹmu bi, iwọ o ha ma mu u ṣe iranṣẹ lailai bi?
entries.en: Will he make a covenant with thee? wilt thou take him for a servant for ever?

entries.yo: Iwọ ha le ba a ṣire bi ẹnipe ẹiyẹ ni, tabi iwọ o dè e fun awọn ọmọbinrin iranṣẹ rẹ?
entries.en: Wilt thou play with him as with a bird? or wilt thou bind him for thy maidens?

entries.yo: Ẹgbẹ awọn apẹja yio ha ma tà a bi, nwọn o ha pin i lãrin awọn oniṣowo?
entries.en: Shall the companions make a banquet of him? shall they part him among the merchants?

entries.yo: Iwọ le isọ awọ rẹ̀ kun fun irin abeti, tabi iwọ o sọ ori rẹ̀ kún fun ẹṣín apẹja.
entries.en: Canst thou fill his skin with barbed iron? or his head with fish spears?

entries.yo: Fi ọwọ rẹ le e lara, iwọ o ranti ìja na, iwọ kì yio ṣe bẹ̃ mọ.
entries.en: Lay thine hand upon him, remember the battle, do no more.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, abá nipasẹ rẹ̀ ni asan, ni kìki ìri rẹ̀ ara kì yio ha rọ̀ ọ wẹsi?
entries.en: Behold, the hope of him is in vain: shall not one be cast down even at the sight of him?

entries.yo: Kò si ẹni-alaiya lile ti o le iru u soke; njẹ tali o le duro niwaju rẹ̀?
entries.en: None is so fierce that dare stir him up: who then is able to stand before me?

entries.yo: Tani o ṣaju ṣe fun mi, ti emi iba fi san fun u? ohunkohun ti mbẹ labẹ ọrun gbogbo ti emi ni.
entries.en: Who hath prevented me, that I should repay him? whatsoever is under the whole heaven is mine.

entries.yo: Emi kì yio fi ipin ara rẹ̀ pamọ, tabi ipá rẹ̀, tabi ihamọra rẹ̀ ti o li ẹwà.
entries.en: I will not conceal his parts, nor his power, nor his comely proportion.

entries.yo: Tani yio le iridi oju aṣọ apata rẹ̀, tabi tani o le isunmọ ọ̀na meji ehin rẹ̀.
entries.en: Who can discover the face of his garment? or who can come to him with his double bridle?

entries.yo: Tani o le iṣi ilẹkun iwaju rẹ̀? ayika ehin rẹ̀ ni ìbẹru nla.
entries.en: Who can open the doors of his face? his teeth are terrible round about.

entries.yo: Ipẹ lile ni igberaga rẹ̀, o pade pọ mọtimọti bi ami edidi,
entries.en: His scales are his pride, shut up together as with a close seal.

entries.yo: Ekini fi ara mọ ekeji tobẹ̃ ti afẹfẹ kò le iwọ̀ arin wọn.
entries.en: One is so near to another, that no air can come between them.

entries.yo: Ekini fi ara mọra ekeji rẹ̀, nwọn lẹmọ pọ̀ ti a kò le iyà wọn.
entries.en: They are joined one to another, they stick together, that they cannot be sundered.

entries.yo: Nipa sísin rẹ̀ imọlẹ a mọ́, oju rẹ̀ a si dabi ipénpeju owurọ.
entries.en: By his neesings a light doth shine, and his eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.

entries.yo: Lati ẹnu rẹ̀ ni ọwọ́-iná ti ijade wá, ipẹpẹ iná a si ta jade.
entries.en: Out of his mouth go burning lamps, and sparks of fire leap out.

entries.yo: Lati iho-imú rẹ̀ li ẽfin ti ijade wá, bi ẹnipe lati inu ikoko ti a fẹ́ iná ifefe labẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Out of his nostrils goeth smoke, as out of a seething pot or caldron.

entries.yo: Ẹmi rẹ̀ tinabọ ẹyin, ọ̀wọ-iná si ti ẹnu rẹ̀ jade.
entries.en: His breath kindleth coals, and a flame goeth out of his mouth.

entries.yo: Li ọrùn rẹ̀ li agbara kù si, ati ibinujẹ aiya si pada di ayọ̀ niwaju rẹ̀.
entries.en: In his neck remaineth strength, and sorrow is turned into joy before him.

entries.yo: Jabajaba ẹran rẹ̀ dijọ pọ̀, nwọn mura giri fun ara wọn, a kò le iṣi wọn ni ipò.
entries.en: The flakes of his flesh are joined together: they are firm in themselves; they cannot be moved.

entries.yo: Aiya rẹ̀ duro gbagigbagi bi okuta, ani o le bi iya-ọlọ.
entries.en: His heart is as firm as a stone; yea, as hard as a piece of the nether millstone.

entries.yo: Nigbati o ba gbe ara rẹ̀ soke, awọn alagbara a bẹ̀ru, nitori ìbẹru nla, nwọn damu.
entries.en: When he raiseth up himself, the mighty are afraid: by reason of breakings they purify themselves.

entries.yo: Idà ẹniti o ṣa a kò le iràn a, ọ̀kọ, ẹṣin tabi ọfa.
entries.en: The sword of him that layeth at him cannot hold: the spear, the dart, nor the habergeon.

entries.yo: O ka irin si bi koriko gbigbẹ, ati idẹ si bi igi hihù.
entries.en: He esteemeth iron as straw, and brass as rotten wood.

entries.yo: Ọfa kò le imu u sá, okuta kànakana lọdọ rẹ̀ dabi akeku koriko.
entries.en: The arrow cannot make him flee: slingstones are turned with him into stubble.

entries.yo: O ka ẹṣin si bi akeku idi koriko, o rẹrin si ìmisi ọ̀kọ.
entries.en: Darts are counted as stubble: he laugheth at the shaking of a spear.

entries.yo: Okuta mimú mbẹ nisalẹ abẹ rẹ̀, o si tẹ́ ohun mimú ṣonṣo sori ẹrẹ.
entries.en: Sharp stones are under him: he spreadeth sharp pointed things upon the mire.

entries.yo: O mu ibu omi hó bi ìkoko, o sọ agbami okun dabi kolobó ìkunra.
entries.en: He maketh the deep to boil like a pot: he maketh the sea like a pot of ointment.

entries.yo: O mu ipa-ọ̀na tàn lẹhin rẹ̀, enia a ma ka ibu si ewú arugbo.
entries.en: He maketh a path to shine after him; one would think the deep to be hoary.

entries.yo: Lori ilẹ aiye kò si iru rẹ̀, ti a da laini ìbẹru.
entries.en: Upon earth there is not his like, who is made without fear.

entries.yo: O bojuwo ohun giga gbogbo, o si nikan jasi ọba lori gbogbo awọn ọmọ igberaga.
entries.en: He beholdeth all high things: he is a king over all the children of pride.

entries.yo: NIGBANA ni Jobu da OLUWA lohùn o si wipe,
entries.en: Then Job answered the LORD, and said,

entries.yo: Emi mọ̀ pe, iwọ le iṣe ohun gbogbo, ati pe, kò si iro-inu ti a le ifasẹhin kuro lọdọ rẹ.
entries.en: I know that thou canst do every thing, and that no thought can be withholden from thee.

entries.yo: Tani ẹniti nfi ìgbimọ pamọ laini ìmọ? nitorina ni emi ṣe nsọ eyi ti emi kò mọ̀, ohun ti o ṣe iyanu jọjọ niwaju mi, ti emi kò moye.
entries.en: Who is he that hideth counsel without knowledge? therefore have I uttered that I understood not; things too wonderful for me, which I knew not.

entries.yo: Emi bẹ̀ ọ, gbọ́, emi o si sọ, emi o bère lọwọ rẹ, ki iwọ ki o si bùn mi ni oye.
entries.en: Hear, I beseech thee, and I will speak: I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto me.

entries.yo: Emi ti fi gbigbọ́ eti gburo rẹ, ṣugbọn nisisiyi oju mi ti ri ọ.
entries.en: I have heard of thee by the hearing of the ear: but now mine eye seeth thee.

entries.yo: Njẹ nitorina emi korira ara mi, mo si ronupiwada ṣe tóto ninu ekuru ati ẽru.
entries.en: Wherefore I abhor myself, and repent in dust and ashes.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li o si ri, lẹhin igbati OLUWA ti sọ ọ̀rọ wọnyi tan fun Jobu, OLUWA si wi fun Elifasi, ara Tema pe, Mo binu si ọ ati si awọn ọrẹ́ rẹ mejeji, nitoripe ẹnyin kò sọ̀rọ niti emi, ohun ti o tọ́ bi Jobu iranṣẹ mi ti sọ.
entries.en: And it was so, that after the LORD had spoken these words unto Job, the LORD said to Eliphaz the Temanite, My wrath is kindled against thee, and against thy two friends: for ye have not spoken of me the thing that is right, as my servant Job hath.

entries.yo: Nitorina ẹ mu akọ ẹgbọrọ malu meje, ati àgbo meje, ki ẹ si tọ̀ Jobu iranṣẹ mi lọ, ki ẹ si fi rú ẹbọ sisun fun ara nyin: Jobu iranṣẹ mi yio si gbadura fun nyin: nitoripe oju rẹ̀ ni mo gbà; ki emi ki o má ba ṣe si nyin bi iṣina nyin, niti ẹnyin kò sọ̀rọ ohun ti o tọ́ si mi bi Jobu iranṣẹ mi.
entries.en: Therefore take unto you now seven bullocks and seven rams, and go to my servant Job, and offer up for yourselves a burnt offering; and my servant Job shall pray for you: for him will I accept: lest I deal with you after your folly, in that ye have not spoken of me the thing which is right, like my servant Job.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Elifasi, ara Tema, ati Bildadi, ara Ṣua, ati Sofari, ara Naama lọ, nwọn si ṣe gẹgẹ bi OLUWA ti paṣẹ fun wọn: OLUWA si gbà oju Jobu.
entries.en: So Eliphaz the Temanite and Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite went, and did according as the LORD commanded them: the LORD also accepted Job.

entries.yo: OLUWA si yi igbekun Jobu pada, nigbati o gbadura fun awọn ọrẹ rẹ̀: OLUWA si busi ohun gbogbo ti Jobu ni rí ni iṣẹpo meji.
entries.en: And the LORD turned the captivity of Job, when he prayed for his friends: also the LORD gave Job twice as much as he had before.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni gbogbo awọn arakunrin rẹ̀, ati gbogbo awọn arabinrin rẹ̀, ati gbogbo awọn ti o ti ṣe ojulumọ rẹ̀ rí, nwọn mba a jẹun ninu ile rẹ̀, nwọn si ṣe idaro rẹ̀, nwọn si ṣipẹ fun nitori ibí gbogbo ti OLUWA ti mu ba a: olukuluku enia pẹlu si bùn u ni ike owo-kọkan ati olukuluku ni oruka wura eti kọ̃kan.
entries.en: Then came there unto him all his brethren, and all his sisters, and all they that had been of his acquaintance before, and did eat bread with him in his house: and they bemoaned him, and comforted him over all the evil that the LORD had brought upon him: every man also gave him a piece of money, and every one an earring of gold.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li OLUWA bukún igbẹhin Jobu jù iṣaju rẹ̀ lọ; o si ni ẹgba-meje agutan, ẹgba-mẹta ibakasiẹ, ati ẹgbẹrun ajaga ọda-malu, ati ẹgbẹrun abo kẹtẹkẹtẹ.
entries.en: So the LORD blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning: for he had fourteen thousand sheep, and six thousand camels, and a thousand yoke of oxen, and a thousand she asses.

entries.yo: O si ni ọmọkunrin meje ati ọmọbinrin mẹta.
entries.en: He had also seven sons and three daughters.

entries.yo: O si sọ orukọ akọbi ni Jemima, ati orukọ ekeji ni Kesia, ati orukọ ẹkẹta ni Keren-happuki.
entries.en: And he called the name of the first, Jemima; and the name of the second, Kezia; and the name of the third, Keren-happuch.

entries.yo: Ati ni gbogbo ilẹ na, a kò ri obinrin ti o li ẹwa bi ọmọbinrin Jobu; baba wọn si pinlẹ fun wọn ninu awọn arakunrin wọn.
entries.en: And in all the land were no women found so fair as the daughters of Job: and their father gave them inheritance among their brethren.

entries.yo: Lẹhin eyi Jobu wà li aiye li ogoje ọdun, o si ri awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ ọkunrin ati awọn ọmọ-ọmọ rẹ̀ ọkunrin, ani iran mẹrin.
entries.en: After this lived Job an hundred and forty years, and saw his sons, and his sons' sons, even four generations.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Jobu kú, o gbó, o si kún fun ọjọ.
entries.en: So Job died, being old and full of days.

entries.yo: IBUKÚN ni fun ọkunrin na ti kò rìn ni ìmọ awọn enia buburu, ti kò duro li ọ̀na awọn ẹlẹṣẹ, ati ti kò si joko ni ibujoko awọn ẹlẹgàn.
entries.en: Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn didùn-inu rẹ̀ wà li ofin Oluwa; ati ninu ofin rẹ̀ li o nṣe aṣaro li ọsan ati li oru.
entries.en: But his delight is in the law of the LORD; and in his law doth he meditate day and night.

entries.yo: Yio si dabi igi ti a gbìn si eti ipa odò, ti nso eso rẹ̀ jade li akokò rẹ̀; ewe rẹ̀ kì yio si rẹ̀; ati ohunkohun ti o ṣe ni yio ma ṣe dede.
entries.en: And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water, that bringeth forth his fruit in his season; his leaf also shall not wither; and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.

entries.yo: Awọn enia buburu kò ri bẹ̃: ṣugbọn nwọn dabi iyangbo ti afẹfẹ nfẹ lọ.
entries.en: The ungodly are not so: but are like the chaff which the wind driveth away.

entries.yo: Nitorina awọn enia buburu kì yio dide duro ni idajọ, bẹ̃li awọn ẹlẹṣẹ kì yio le duro li awujọ awọn olododo.
entries.en: Therefore the ungodly shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.

entries.yo: Nitori Oluwa mọ̀ ọ̀na awọn olododo: ṣugbọn ọ̀na awọn enia buburu ni yio ṣegbe.
entries.en: For the LORD knoweth the way of the righteous: but the way of the ungodly shall perish.

entries.yo: ẼṢE ti awọn orilẹ-ède fi nbinu fùfu, ati ti awọn enia ngbero ohun asan?
entries.en: Why do the heathen rage, and the people imagine a vain thing?

entries.yo: Awọn ọba aiye kẹsẹ jọ, ati awọn ijoye ngbimọ pọ̀ si Oluwa ati si Ẹni-ororo rẹ̀ pe,
entries.en: The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together, against the LORD, and against his anointed, saying,

entries.yo: Ẹ jẹ ki a fa ìde wọn já, ki a si mu okùn wọn kuro li ọdọ wa.
entries.en: Let us break their bands asunder, and cast away their cords from us.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o joko li ọrun yio rẹrin: Oluwa yio yọ ṣùti si wọn.
entries.en: He that sitteth in the heavens shall laugh: the Lord shall have them in derision.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni yio sọ̀rọ si wọn ni ibinu rẹ̀, yio si yọ wọn lẹnu ninu ibinujẹ rẹ̀ kikan.
entries.en: Then shall he speak unto them in his wrath, and vex them in his sore displeasure.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn mo ti fi Ọba mi jẹ lori Sioni, òke mimọ́ mi.
entries.en: Yet have I set my king upon my holy hill of Zion.

entries.yo: Emi o si rohin ipinnu Oluwa: O ti wi fun mi pe, Iwọ li Ọmọ mi, loni ni mo bi ọ.
entries.en: I will declare the decree: the LORD hath said unto me, Thou art my Son; this day have I begotten thee.

entries.yo: Bère lọwọ mi, emi o si fi awọn orilẹ-ède fun ọ ni ini rẹ, ati iha opin ilẹ li ọrọ̀-ilẹ rẹ.
entries.en: Ask of me, and I shall give thee the heathen for thine inheritance, and the uttermost parts of the earth for thy possession.

entries.yo: Ọpá irin ni iwọ o fi fọ́ wọn; iwọ o si rún wọn womuwomu, bi ohun èlo amọ̀.
entries.en: Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron; thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter's vessel.

entries.yo: Njẹ nitorina ki ẹnyin ki o gbọ́n, ẹnyin ọba: ki a si kọ́ nyin, ẹnyin onidajọ aiye.
entries.en: Be wise now therefore, O ye kings: be instructed, ye judges of the earth.

entries.yo: Ẹ fi ìbẹru sìn Oluwa, ẹ si ma yọ̀ ti ẹnyin ti iwarìri.
entries.en: Serve the LORD with fear, and rejoice with trembling.

entries.yo: Fi ẹnu kò Ọmọ na lẹnu, ki o máṣe binu, ẹnyin a si ṣegbe li ọ̀na na, bi inu rẹ̀ ba ru diẹ kiun. Ibukún ni fun gbogbo awọn ti o gbẹkẹ wọn le e.
entries.en: Kiss the Son, lest he be angry, and ye perish from the way, when his wrath is kindled but a little. Blessed are all they that put their trust in him.

entries.yo: OLUWA, awọn ti nyọ mi li ẹnu ti npọ̀ to yi! ọ̀pọlọpọ li awọn ti o dide si mi.
entries.en: LORD, how are they increased that trouble me! many are they that rise up against me.

entries.yo: Ọ̀pọlọpọ li awọn ti o nwi niti ọkàn mi pe, Iranlọwọ kò si fun u nipa ti Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Many there be which say of my soul, There is no help for him in God. Selah.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn iwọ, Oluwa, li asà fun mi; ogo mi; ati olugbe ori mi soke.
entries.en: But thou, O LORD, art a shield for me; my glory, and the lifter up of mine head.

entries.yo: Emi fi ohùn mi kigbe si Oluwa, o si gbohùn mi lati òke mimọ́ rẹ̀ wá.
entries.en: I cried unto the LORD with my voice, and he heard me out of his holy hill. Selah.

entries.yo: Emi dubulẹ, mo si sùn; mo si ji; nitori ti Oluwa tì mi lẹhin,
entries.en: I laid me down and slept; I awaked; for the LORD sustained me.

entries.yo: Emi kì yio bẹ̀ru ọ̀pọlọpọ enia, ti nwọn rọ̀gba yi mi ka.
entries.en: I will not be afraid of ten thousands of people, that have set themselves against me round about.

entries.yo: Dide Oluwa; gbà mi, Ọlọrun mi: nitori iwọ li o lù gbogbo awọn ọta mi li egungun ẹrẹkẹ; iwọ si ká ehin awọn enia buburu.
entries.en: Arise, O LORD; save me, O my God: for thou hast smitten all mine enemies upon the cheek bone; thou hast broken the teeth of the ungodly.

entries.yo: Ti Oluwa ni igbala: ibukún rẹ si mbẹ lara awọn enia rẹ.
entries.en: Salvation belongeth unto the LORD: thy blessing is upon thy people. Selah.

entries.yo: GBOHÙN mi nigbati mo ba npè, Ọlọrun ododo mi: iwọ li o da mi ni ìde ninu ipọnju; ṣe ojurere fun mi, ki o si gbọ́ adura mi.
entries.en: Hear me when I call, O God of my righteousness: thou hast enlarged me when I was in distress; have mercy upon me, and hear my prayer.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin ọmọ enia, ẹ o ti sọ ogo mi di itiju pẹ to? ẹnyin o ti fẹ asan pẹ to, ti ẹ o si ma wá eke iṣe?
entries.en: O ye sons of men, how long will ye turn my glory into shame? how long will ye love vanity, and seek after leasing? Selah.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ki ẹ mọ̀ pe Oluwa yà ẹni ayanfẹ sọ̀tọ fun ara rẹ̀: Oluwa yio gbọ́ nigbati mo ba kepè e.
entries.en: But know that the LORD hath set apart him that is godly for himself: the LORD will hear when I call unto him.

entries.yo: Ẹ duro ninu ẹ̀ru, ẹ má si ṣe ṣẹ̀; ẹ ba ọkàn nyin sọ̀rọ lori ẹní nyin, ki ẹ si duro jẹ.
entries.en: Stand in awe, and sin not: commune with your own heart upon your bed, and be still. Selah.

entries.yo: Ẹ ru ẹbọ ododo, ki ẹ si gbẹkẹ nyin le Oluwa.
entries.en: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness, and put your trust in the LORD.

entries.yo: Ẹni pupọ li o nwipe, Tani yio ṣe rere fun wa? Oluwa, iwọ gbé imọlẹ oju rẹ soke si wa lara.
entries.en: There be many that say, Who will shew us any good? LORD, lift thou up the light of thy countenance upon us.

entries.yo: Iwọ ti fi ayọ̀ si mi ni inu, jù igba na lọ ti ọkà wọn ati ọti-waini wọn di pupọ̀.
entries.en: Thou hast put gladness in my heart, more than in the time that their corn and their wine increased.

entries.yo: Emi o dubulẹ pẹlu li alafia, emi o si sùn; nitori iwọ, Oluwa, nikanṣoṣo li o nmu mi joko li ailewu.
entries.en: I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, LORD, only makest me dwell in safety.

entries.yo: FI eti si ọ̀rọ mi, Oluwa, kiyesi aroye mi.
entries.en: Give ear to my words, O LORD, consider my meditation.

entries.yo: Fi eti si ohùn ẹkún mi, Ọba mi, ati Ọlọrun mi: nitoripe ọdọ rẹ li emi o ma gbadura si.
entries.en: Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my King, and my God: for unto thee will I pray.

entries.yo: Ohùn mi ni iwọ o gbọ́ li owurọ, Oluwa, li owurọ li emi o gbà adura mi si ọ, emi o si ma wòke.
entries.en: My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, O LORD; in the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up.

entries.yo: Nitori ti iwọ kì iṣe Ọlọrun ti iṣe inu-didùn si ìwa buburu: bẹ̃ni ibi kò le ba ọ gbe.
entries.en: For thou art not a God that hath pleasure in wickedness: neither shall evil dwell with thee.

entries.yo: Awọn agberaga kì yio le duro niwaju rẹ: iwọ korira gbogbo awọn oniṣẹ ẹ̀ṣẹ.
entries.en: The foolish shall not stand in thy sight: thou hatest all workers of iniquity.

entries.yo: Iwọ o pa awọn ti nṣe eke run; Oluwa yio korira awọn ẹni-ẹ̀jẹ ati ẹni-ẹ̀tan.
entries.en: Thou shalt destroy them that speak leasing: the LORD will abhor the bloody and deceitful man.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi o ṣe ti emi, emi o wá sinu ile rẹ li ọ̀pọlọpọ ãnu rẹ: ninu ẹ̀ru rẹ li emi o tẹriba si iha tempili mimọ́ rẹ.
entries.en: But as for me, I will come into thy house in the multitude of thy mercy: and in thy fear will I worship toward thy holy temple.

entries.yo: Tọ́ mi, Oluwa, ninu ododo rẹ, nitori awọn ọta mi: mu ọ̀na rẹ tọ́ tàra niwaju mi.
entries.en: Lead me, O LORD, in thy righteousness because of mine enemies; make thy way straight before my face.

entries.yo: Nitori ti otitọ kan kò si li ẹnu ẹnikẹni wọn; ikakika ni iha inu wọn; isa-okú ti o ṣi silẹ li ọfun wọn; ahọn wọn ni nwọn fi npọ́nni.
entries.en: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth; their inward part is very wickedness; their throat is an open sepulchre; they flatter with their tongue.

entries.yo: Iwọ da wọn lẹbi, Ọlọrun; ki nwọn ki o ti ipa ìmọ ara wọn ṣubu; já wọn kuro nitori ọ̀pọlọpọ irekọja wọn; nitori ti nwọn ti ṣọ̀tẹ si ọ.
entries.en: Destroy thou them, O God; let them fall by their own counsels; cast them out in the multitude of their transgressions; for they have rebelled against thee.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni gbogbo awọn ti ngbẹkẹle ọ yio yọ̀; lai nwọn o ma ho fun ayọ̀, nitoriti iwọ dabobo wọn: ati awọn ti o fẹ orukọ rẹ pẹlu yio ma yọ̀ ninu rẹ.
entries.en: But let all those that put their trust in thee rejoice: let them ever shout for joy, because thou defendest them: let them also that love thy name be joyful in thee.

entries.yo: Nitori iwọ, Oluwa, ni yio bukún fun olododo; oju-rere ni iwọ o fi yi i ka bi asà.
entries.en: For thou, LORD, wilt bless the righteous; with favour wilt thou compass him as with a shield.

entries.yo: OLUWA, máṣe ba mi wi ni ibinu rẹ, ki iwọ ki o má ṣe nà mi ni gbigbona ibinujẹ rẹ.
entries.en: O LORD, rebuke me not in thine anger, neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.

entries.yo: Oluwa, ṣãnu fun mi; nitori ailera mi: Oluwa, mu mi lara da; nitori ti ara kan egungun mi.
entries.en: Have mercy upon me, O LORD; for I am weak: O LORD, heal me; for my bones are vexed.

entries.yo: Ara kan ọkàn mi gogo pẹlu: ṣugbọn iwọ, Oluwa, yio ti pẹ to!
entries.en: My soul is also sore vexed: but thou, O LORD, how long?

entries.yo: Pada, Oluwa, gbà ọkàn mi: gbà mi là nitori ãnu rẹ.
entries.en: Return, O LORD, deliver my soul: oh save me for thy mercies' sake.

entries.yo: Nitoriti kò si iranti rẹ ninu okú: ninu isa okú tani yio dupẹ fun ọ?
entries.en: For in death there is no remembrance of thee: in the grave who shall give thee thanks?

entries.yo: Agara ikerora mi da mi: li oru gbogbo li emi nmu ẹní mi fó li oju omi; emi fi omije mi rin ibusùn mi.
entries.en: I am weary with my groaning; all the night make I my bed to swim; I water my couch with my tears.

entries.yo: Oju mi bajẹ tan nitori ibinujẹ; o di ogbó tan nitori gbogbo awọn ọta mi.
entries.en: Mine eye is consumed because of grief; it waxeth old because of all mine enemies.

entries.yo: Ẹ lọ kuro lọdọ mi, gbogbo ẹnyin oniṣẹ ẹ̀ṣẹ; nitori ti Oluwa gbọ́ ohùn ẹkún mi.
entries.en: Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity; for the LORD hath heard the voice of my weeping.

entries.yo: Oluwa gbọ́ ẹ̀bẹ mi; Oluwa yio gbà adura mi.
entries.en: The LORD hath heard my supplication; the LORD will receive my prayer.

entries.yo: Oju yio tì gbogbo awọn ọta mi, ara yio sì kan wọn gogo: nwọn o pada, oju yio tì wọn lojíji.
entries.en: Let all mine enemies be ashamed and sore vexed: let them return and be ashamed suddenly.

entries.yo: OLUWA, Ọlọrun mi, iwọ ni mo gbẹkẹ mi le: gbà mi lọwọ gbogbo awọn ti nṣe inunibini si mi, ki o si yọ mi kuro.
entries.en: O Lord my God, in thee do I put my trust: save me from all them that persecute me, and deliver me:

entries.yo: Ki o má ba fa ọkàn mi ya bi kiniun, a yà a pẹrẹpẹrẹ, nigbati kò si oluranlọwọ.
entries.en: Lest he tear my soul like a lion, rending it in pieces, while there is none to deliver.

entries.yo: Oluwa, Ọlọrun mi, bi mo ba ṣe eyi, bi ẹ̀ṣẹ ba mbẹ li ọwọ mi;
entries.en: O LORD my God, if I have done this; if there be iniquity in my hands;

entries.yo: Bi mo ba fi ibi san a fun ẹniti temi tirẹ̀ wà li alafia; (nitõtọ ẹniti nṣe ọta mi li ainidi, emi tilẹ gbà a là:)
entries.en: If I have rewarded evil unto him that was at peace with me; (yea, I have delivered him that without cause is mine enemy:)

entries.yo: Jẹ ki ọta ki o ṣe inunibini si ọkàn mi, ki o si mu u; ki o tẹ̀ ẹmi mi mọlẹ, ki o si fi ọlá mi le inu ekuru.
entries.en: Let the enemy persecute my soul, and take it; yea, let him tread down my life upon the earth, and lay mine honour in the dust. Selah.

entries.yo: Dide Oluwa, ni ibinu rẹ! gbé ara rẹ soke nitori ikannu awọn ọta mi: ki iwọ ki o si jí fun mi si idajọ ti iwọ ti pa li aṣẹ.
entries.en: Arise, O LORD, in thine anger, lift up thyself because of the rage of mine enemies: and awake for me to the judgment that thou hast commanded.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni ijọ awọn enia yio yi ọ ká kiri; njẹ nitori wọn iwọ pada si òke.
entries.en: So shall the congregation of the people compass thee about: for their sakes therefore return thou on high.

entries.yo: Oluwa yio ṣe idajọ awọn enia: Oluwa ṣe idajọ mi, gẹgẹ bi ododo mi, ati gẹgẹ bi ìwatitọ inu mi.
entries.en: The LORD shall judge the people: judge me, O LORD, according to my righteousness, and according to mine integrity that is in me.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki ìwa-buburu awọn enia buburu ki o de opin: ṣugbọn mu olotitọ duro: nitoriti Ọlọrun olododo li o ndan aiya ati inu wò.
entries.en: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end; but establish the just: for the righteous God trieth the hearts and reins.

entries.yo: Abo mi mbẹ lọdọ Ọlọrun ti o nṣe igbala olotitọ li aiya.
entries.en: My defence is of God, which saveth the upright in heart.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun li onidajọ ododo, Ọlọrun si nbinu si enia buburu lojojumọ:
entries.en: God judgeth the righteous, and God is angry with the wicked every day.

entries.yo: Bi on kò ba yipada, yio si pọ́n idà rẹ̀ mu: o ti fà ọrun rẹ̀ le na, o ti mura rẹ̀ silẹ.
entries.en: If he turn not, he will whet his sword; he hath bent his bow, and made it ready.

entries.yo: O si ti pèse elo ikú silẹ fun u; o ti ṣe awọn ọfa rẹ̀ ni oniná.
entries.en: He hath also prepared for him the instruments of death; he ordaineth his arrows against the persecutors.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, o nrọbi ẹ̀ṣẹ, o si loyun ìwa-ìka, o si bí eké jade.
entries.en: Behold, he travaileth with iniquity, and hath conceived mischief, and brought forth falsehood.

entries.yo: O ti wà ọ̀fin, o gbẹ́ ẹ, o si bọ́ sinu iho ti on na wà.
entries.en: He made a pit, and digged it, and is fallen into the ditch which he made.

entries.yo: Ìwa-ika rẹ̀ yio si pada si ori ara rẹ̀, ati ìwa-agbara rẹ̀ yio si sọ̀kalẹ bọ̀ si atari ara rẹ̀.
entries.en: His mischief shall return upon his own head, and his violent dealing shall come down upon his own pate.

entries.yo: Emi o yìn Oluwa gẹgẹ bi ododo rẹ̀: emi o si kọrin iyìn si orukọ Oluwa Ọga-ogo julọ.
entries.en: I will praise the LORD according to his righteousness: and will sing praise to the name of the LORD most high.

entries.yo: OLUWA, Oluwa wa, orukọ rẹ ti ni iyìn to ni gbogbo aiye! iwọ ti o gbé ogo rẹ kà ori awọn ọrun.
entries.en: O LORD our Lord, how excellent is thy name in all the earth! who hast set thy glory above the heavens.

entries.yo: Lati ẹnu awọn ọmọ-ọwọ ati ọmọ-ọmu ni iwọ ti ṣe ilana agbara, nitori awọn ọta rẹ, nitori ki iwọ ki o le mu ọta olugbẹsan nì dakẹjẹ.
entries.en: Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings hast thou ordained strength because of thine enemies, that thou mightest still the enemy and the avenger.

entries.yo: Nigbati mo rò ọrun rẹ, iṣẹ ika rẹ, oṣupa ati irawọ, ti iwọ ti ṣe ilana silẹ.
entries.en: When I consider thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, the moon and the stars, which thou hast ordained;

entries.yo: Kili enia, ti iwọ fi nṣe iranti rẹ̀? ati ọmọ enia, ti iwọ fi mbẹ̀ ẹ wò.
entries.en: What is man, that thou art mindful of him? and the son of man, that thou visitest him?

entries.yo: Iwọ sa da a li onirẹlẹ diẹ jù awon angeli lọ, iwọ si ti fi ogo ati ọlá de e li ade.
entries.en: For thou hast made him a little lower than the angels, and hast crowned him with glory and honour.

entries.yo: Iwọ mu u jọba iṣẹ ọwọ rẹ; iwọ si ti fi ohun gbogbo sabẹ ẹsẹ rẹ̀;
entries.en: Thou madest him to have dominion over the works of thy hands; thou hast put all things under his feet:

entries.yo: Awọn agutan ati awọn malu pẹlu, ati awọn ẹranko igbẹ;
entries.en: All sheep and oxen, yea, and the beasts of the field;

entries.yo: Awọn ẹiyẹ oju ọrun, ati awọn ẹja okun, ti o nkọja lọ nipa ọ̀na okun.
entries.en: The fowl of the air, and the fish of the sea, and whatsoever passeth through the paths of the seas.

entries.yo: Oluwa, Oluwa wa, orukọ rẹ ti ni iyìn to ni gbogbo aiye!
entries.en: O LORD our Lord, how excellent is thy name in all the earth!

entries.yo: EMI o fi gbogbo aiya mi yìn Oluwa: emi o fi gbogbo iṣẹ iyanu rẹ hàn.
entries.en: I will praise thee, O LORD, with my whole heart; I will shew forth all thy marvellous works.

entries.yo: Emi o yọ̀, emi o si ṣe inu-didùn ninu rẹ, emi o si kọrin iyìn si orukọ rẹ, iwọ Ọga-ogo julọ.
entries.en: I will be glad and rejoice in thee: I will sing praise to thy name, O thou most High.

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn ọta mi ba pẹhinda, nwọn o ṣubu, nwọn o si ṣegbe ni iwaju rẹ.
entries.en: When mine enemies are turned back, they shall fall and perish at thy presence.

entries.yo: Nitori iwọ li o ti mu idajọ mi ati idi ọ̀ran mi duro; iwọ li o joko lori itẹ́, ti o nṣe idajọ ododo.
entries.en: For thou hast maintained my right and my cause; thou satest in the throne judging right.

entries.yo: Iwọ ba awọn orilẹ-ède wi, iwọ pa awọn enia buburu run, iwọ pa orukọ wọn rẹ́ lai ati lailai.
entries.en: Thou hast rebuked the heathen, thou hast destroyed the wicked, thou hast put out their name for ever and ever.

entries.yo: Niti ọta, iparun wọn pari tan lailai: iwọ li o si ti run ilu wọnni; iranti wọn si ti ṣegbe pẹlu wọn.
entries.en: O thou enemy, destructions are come to a perpetual end: and thou hast destroyed cities; their memorial is perished with them.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Oluwa yio wà titi lailai: o ti tẹ́ itẹ́ rẹ̀ silẹ fun idajọ.
entries.en: But the LORD shall endure for ever: he hath prepared his throne for judgment.

entries.yo: On o si ṣe idajọ aiye li ododo, yio ṣe idajọ fun awọn enia li otitọ ìwa.
entries.en: And he shall judge the world in righteousness, he shall minister judgment to the people in uprightness.

entries.yo: Oluwa ni yio ṣe àbo awọn ẹni-inilara, àbo ni igba ipọnju.
entries.en: The LORD also will be a refuge for the oppressed, a refuge in times of trouble.

entries.yo: Awọn ti o si mọ̀ orukọ rẹ o gbẹkẹ le ọ: nitori iwọ, Oluwa, kò ti ikọ̀ awọn ti nṣe afẹri rẹ silẹ.
entries.en: And they that know thy name will put their trust in thee: for thou, LORD, hast not forsaken them that seek thee.

entries.yo: Ẹ kọrin iyìn si Oluwa, ti o joko ni Sioni: ẹ fi iṣẹ rẹ̀ hàn ninu awọn enia.
entries.en: Sing praises to the LORD, which dwelleth in Zion: declare among the people his doings.

entries.yo: Nigbati o wadi ẹjọ-ẹ̀jẹ, o ranti wọn: on kò si gbagbe ẹkún awọn olupọnju.
entries.en: When he maketh inquisition for blood, he remembereth them: he forgetteth not the cry of the humble.

entries.yo: Ṣãnu fun mi, Oluwa; rò iṣẹ́ ti emi nṣẹ́ lọwọ awọn ti o korira mi, iwọ ti o gbé ori mi soke kuro li ẹnu-ọ̀na ikú.
entries.en: Have mercy upon me, O LORD; consider my trouble which I suffer of them that hate me, thou that liftest me up from the gates of death:

entries.yo: Ki emi ki o le ma fi gbogbo iyìn rẹ hàn li ẹnu-ọ̀na ọmọbinrin Sioni, emi o ma yọ̀ ni igbala rẹ.
entries.en: That I may shew forth all thy praise in the gates of the daughter of Zion: I will rejoice in thy salvation.

entries.yo: Awọn orilẹ-ède jìn sinu ọ̀fin ti nwọn wà: ninu àwọn ti nwọn dẹ silẹ li ẹsẹ ara wọn kọ́.
entries.en: The heathen are sunk down in the pit that they made: in the net which they hid is their own foot taken.

entries.yo: A mọ̀ Oluwa, nipa idajọ ti o nṣe: nipa iṣẹ ọwọ enia buburu li a fi ndẹkùn mu u.
entries.en: The LORD is known by the judgment which he executeth: the wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. Higgaion. Selah.

entries.yo: Ori awọn enia buburu li a o dà si ọrun apadi, ati gbogbo orilẹ-ède ti o gbagbe Ọlọrun.
entries.en: The wicked shall be turned into hell, and all the nations that forget God.

entries.yo: Nitori pe a kì yio gbagbe awọn alaini lailai: abá awọn talaka kì yio ṣegbe lailai.
entries.en: For the needy shall not alway be forgotten: the expectation of the poor shall not perish for ever.

entries.yo: Oluwa, dide; máṣe jẹ ki enia ki o bori: jẹ ki a ṣe idajọ awọn orilẹ-ède niwaju rẹ.
entries.en: Arise, O LORD; let not man prevail: let the heathen be judged in thy sight.

entries.yo: Dẹru ba wọn, Oluwa: ki awọn orilẹ-ède ki o le mọ̀ ara wọn pe, enia ṣa ni nwọn.
entries.en: Put them in fear, O LORD: that the nations may know themselves to be but men. Selah.

entries.yo: EṢE ti iwọ fi duro li òkere rere, Oluwa; ẽṣe ti iwọ fi fi ara pamọ́ ni igba ipọnju.
entries.en: Why standest thou afar off, O LORD? why hidest thou thyself in times of trouble?

entries.yo: Ninu igberaga li enia buburu nṣe inunibini si awọn talaka: ninu arekereke ti nwọn rò ni ki a ti mu wọn.
entries.en: The wicked in his pride doth persecute the poor: let them be taken in the devices that they have imagined.

entries.yo: Nitori enia buburu nṣogo ifẹ ọkàn rẹ̀, o si nsure fun olojukokoro, o si nkẹgan Oluwa.
entries.en: For the wicked boasteth of his heart's desire, and blesseth the covetous, whom the LORD abhorreth.

entries.yo: Enia buburu, nipa igberaga oju rẹ̀, kò fẹ ṣe afẹri Ọlọrun: Ọlọrun kò si ni gbogbo ironu rẹ̀.
entries.en: The wicked, through the pride of his countenance, will not seek after God: God is not in all his thoughts.

entries.yo: Ọ̀na rẹ̀ nlọ siwaju nigbagbogbo; idajọ rẹ jina rere kuro li oju rẹ̀; gbogbo awọn ọta rẹ̀ li o nfẹ̀ si.
entries.en: His ways are always grievous; thy judgments are far above out of his sight: as for all his enemies, he puffeth at them.

entries.yo: O ti wi li ọkàn rẹ̀ pe, A kì yio ṣi mi ni ipò: lati irandiran emi kì yio si ninu ipọnju.
entries.en: He hath said in his heart, I shall not be moved: for I shall never be in adversity.

entries.yo: Ẹnu rẹ̀ kún fun egún, ati fun ẹ̀tan, ati fun itanjẹ: ìwa-ìka ati ìwa-asan mbẹ labẹ ahọn rẹ̀.
entries.en: His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and fraud: under his tongue is mischief and vanity.

entries.yo: O joko ni buba ni ileto wọnni: ni ibi ìkọkọ wọnni li o npa awọn alaiṣẹ̀: oju rẹ̀ nṣọ́ awọn talaka nikọkọ.
entries.en: He sitteth in the lurking places of the villages: in the secret places doth he murder the innocent: his eyes are privily set against the poor.

entries.yo: O lùmọ ni ibi ìkọkọ bi kiniun ninu pantiri: o lùmọ lati mu talaka: a si mu talaka, nigbati o ba fà a sinu àwọn rẹ̀.
entries.en: He lieth in wait secretly as a lion in his den: he lieth in wait to catch the poor: he doth catch the poor, when he draweth him into his net.

entries.yo: O ba, o rẹ̀ ara rẹ̀ silẹ, ki talaka ki o le bọ́ si ọwọ agbara rẹ̀.
entries.en: He croucheth, and humbleth himself, that the poor may fall by his strong ones.

entries.yo: O ti wi li ọkàn rẹ̀ pe, Ọlọrun ti gbagbe: o pa oju rẹ̀ mọ́; on kì yio ri i lailai.
entries.en: He hath said in his heart, God hath forgotten: he hideth his face; he will never see it.

entries.yo: Dide, Oluwa; Ọlọrun, gbé ọwọ rẹ soke: máṣe gbagbe olupọnju.
entries.en: Arise, O LORD; O God, lift up thine hand: forget not the humble.

entries.yo: Ẽṣe ti enia buburu fi ngàn Ọlọrun? o wi li ọkàn rẹ̀ pe, Iwọ kì yio bère.
entries.en: Wherefore doth the wicked contemn God? he hath said in his heart, Thou wilt not require it.

entries.yo: Iwọ ti ri i; nitori iwọ nwò ìwa-ìka ati iwọsi, lati fi ọ̀ran na le ọwọ rẹ; talaka fi ara rẹ̀ le ọ lọwọ; iwọ li oluranlọwọ alaini-baba.
entries.en: Thou hast seen it; for thou beholdest mischief and spite, to requite it with thy hand: the poor committeth himself unto thee; thou art the helper of the fatherless.

entries.yo: Ṣẹ́ apa enia buburu, ati ti ọkunrin ibi nì: iwọ wá ìwa-buburu rẹ̀ ri, titi iwọ kì yio fi ri i mọ́.
entries.en: Break thou the arm of the wicked and the evil man: seek out his wickedness till thou find none.

entries.yo: Oluwa li ọba lai ati lailai: awọn keferi run kuro ni ilẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: The LORD is King for ever and ever: the heathen are perished out of his land.

entries.yo: Oluwa, iwọ ti gbọ́ ifẹ onirẹlẹ: iwọ o mu ọkàn wọn duro, iwọ o dẹ eti rẹ si i.
entries.en: LORD, thou hast heard the desire of the humble: thou wilt prepare their heart, thou wilt cause thine ear to hear:

entries.yo: Lati ṣe idajọ alaini-baba ati ẹni-inilara, ki ọkunrin aiye ki o máṣe daiya-fo-ni mọ́.
entries.en: To judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that the man of the earth may no more oppress.

entries.yo: OLUWA ni mo gbẹkẹ mi le: ẹ ha ti ṣe wi fun ọkàn mi pe, sá bi ẹiyẹ lọ si òke nyin?
entries.en: In the LORD put I my trust: How say ye to my soul, Flee as a bird to your mountain?

entries.yo: Sa kiyesi i, awọn enia buburu ti fà ọrun wọn le, nwọn ti fi ọfa sùn li oju ọṣán, ki nwọn ki o le ta a li òkunkun si ọlọkàn diduro.
entries.en: For, lo, the wicked bend their bow, they make ready their arrow upon the string, that they may privily shoot at the upright in heart.

entries.yo: Bi ipilẹ ba bajẹ, kili olododo yio ṣe?
entries.en: If the foundations be destroyed, what can the righteous do?

entries.yo: Oluwa mbẹ ninu tempili mimọ́ rẹ̀, itẹ́ Oluwa mbẹ li ọrun: oju rẹ̀ nwò, ipenpeju rẹ̀ ndán awọn ọmọ enia wò.
entries.en: The LORD is in his holy temple, the LORD's throne is in heaven: his eyes behold, his eyelids try, the children of men.

entries.yo: Oluwa ndán olododo wò: ṣugbọn enia buburu ati ẹniti nfẹ ìwa-agbara, ọkàn rẹ̀ korira.
entries.en: The LORD trieth the righteous: but the wicked and him that loveth violence his soul hateth.

entries.yo: Lori enia buburu ni yio rọjo, ẹyín gbigbona ati imi-ọjọ ati iji gbigbona: eyi ni ipin ago wọn.
entries.en: Upon the wicked he shall rain snares, fire and brimstone, and an horrible tempest: this shall be the portion of their cup.

entries.yo: Nitori olododo li Oluwa, o fẹ ododo; awọn ẹniti o duro-ṣinṣin yio ri oju rẹ̀.
entries.en: For the righteous LORD loveth righteousness; his countenance doth behold the upright.

entries.yo: GBÀ-NI Oluwa; nitori awọn ẹni ìwa-bi-Ọlọrun dasẹ̀; nitori awọn olõtọ dasẹ̀ kuro ninu awọn ọmọ enia.
entries.en: Help, LORD; for the godly man ceaseth; for the faithful fail from among the children of men.

entries.yo: Olukuluku wọn mba ẹnikeji rẹ̀ sọ asan; ète ipọnni ati ọkàn meji ni nwọn fi nsọ.
entries.en: They speak vanity every one with his neighbour: with flattering lips and with a double heart do they speak.

entries.yo: Oluwa yio ké gbogbo ète ipọnni kuro, ati ahọn ti nsọ̀rọ ohun nla.
entries.en: The LORD shall cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that speaketh proud things:

entries.yo: Ti o wipe, Ahọn wa li awa o fi ṣẹgun; ète wa ni ti wa: tani iṣe oluwa wa?
entries.en: Who have said, With our tongue will we prevail; our lips are our own: who is lord over us?

entries.yo: Nitori inira awọn talaka, nitori imi-ẹ̀dun awọn alaini, Oluwa wipe, nigbayi li emi o dide; emi o si yọ ọ si ibi ailewu kuro lọwọ ẹniti nfẹ̀ si i.
entries.en: For the oppression of the poor, for the sighing of the needy, now will I arise, saith the LORD; I will set him in safety from him that puffeth at him.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ Oluwa, ọ̀rọ funfun ni, bi fadaka ti a yọ́ ni ileru erupẹ, ti a dà ni igba meje.
entries.en: The words of the LORD are pure words: as silver tried in a furnace of earth, purified seven times.

entries.yo: Iwọ o pa wọn mọ́, Oluwa, iwọ o pa olukuluku wọn mọ́ kuro lọwọ iran yi lailai.
entries.en: Thou shalt keep them, O LORD, thou shalt preserve them from this generation for ever.

entries.yo: Awọn enia buburu nrìn ni iha gbogbo, nigbati a ba gbé awọn enia-kenia leke.
entries.en: The wicked walk on every side, when the vilest men are exalted.

entries.yo: IWỌ o ti gbagbe mi pẹ to, Oluwa, lailai? iwọ o ti pa oju rẹ mọ́ pẹ to kuro lara mi?
entries.en: How long wilt thou forget me, O LORD? for ever? how long wilt thou hide thy face from me?

entries.yo: Emi o ti ma gbìmọ li ọkàn mi pẹ to? ti emi o ma ni ibinujẹ li ọkàn mi lojojumọ? ọta mi yio ti gberaga sori mi pẹ to?
entries.en: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart daily? how long shall mine enemy be exalted over me?

entries.yo: Rò o, ki o si gbohùn mi, Oluwa Ọlọrun mi: mu oju mi mọlẹ, ki emi ki o má ba sùn orun ikú.
entries.en: Consider and hear me, O LORD my God: lighten mine eyes, lest I sleep the sleep of death;

entries.yo: Ki ọta mi ki o má ba wipe, emi ti ṣẹgun rẹ̀; awọn ti nyọ mi lẹnu a si ma yọ̀, nigbati a ba ṣi mi nipò.
entries.en: Lest mine enemy say, I have prevailed against him; and those that trouble me rejoice when I am moved.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi o gbẹkẹle ãnu rẹ; ọkàn mi yio yọ̀ ni igbala rẹ.
entries.en: But I have trusted in thy mercy; my heart shall rejoice in thy salvation.

entries.yo: Emi o ma kọrin si Oluwa, nitoriti o ṣe fun mi li ọ̀pọlọpọ.
entries.en: I will sing unto the LORD, because he hath dealt bountifully with me.

entries.yo: AṢIWERE wi li ọkàn rẹ̀ pe, Ọlọrun kò si. Nwọn bajẹ, nwọn si nṣe iṣẹ irira, kò si ẹniti nṣe rere.
entries.en: The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God. They are corrupt, they have done abominable works, there is none that doeth good.

entries.yo: Oluwa bojuwò lati ọrun wá sara awọn ọmọ enia, lati wò bi ẹnikan wà ti oye ye, ti o si nwá Ọlọrun.
entries.en: The LORD looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, and seek God.

entries.yo: Gbogbo wọn li o si jumọ yà si apakan, nwọn si di elẽri patapata; kò si ẹniti nṣe rere, kò si ẹnikan.
entries.en: They are all gone aside, they are all together become filthy: there is none that doeth good, no, not one.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn ti nṣiṣẹ ẹ̀ṣẹ kò ha ni ìmọ? awọn ẹniti njẹ enia mi bi ẹni jẹun, nwọn kò si kepè Oluwa.
entries.en: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread, and call not upon the LORD.

entries.yo: Nibẹ ni ẹ̀ru bà wọn gidigidi: nitoriti Ọlọrun mbẹ ninu iran olododo.
entries.en: There were they in great fear: for God is in the generation of the righteous.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin dojutì ìmọ awọn talaka, ṣugbọn Oluwa li àbo rẹ̀.
entries.en: Ye have shamed the counsel of the poor, because the LORD is his refuge.

entries.yo: Tani yio fi igbala fun Israeli lati Sioni jade wá! nigbati Oluwa ba mu ikólọ awọn enia rẹ̀ pada bọ̀, Jakobu yio yọ̀, inu Israeli yio si dùn.
entries.en: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! when the LORD bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

entries.yo: OLUWA, tani yio ma ṣe atipo ninu agọ rẹ? tani yio ma gbe inu òke mimọ́ rẹ?
entries.en: LORD, who shall abide in thy tabernacle? who shall dwell in thy holy hill?

entries.yo: Ẹniti o nrìn dede, ti nṣiṣẹ ododo, ti o si nsọ otitọ inu rẹ̀.
entries.en: He that walketh uprightly, and worketh righteousness, and speaketh the truth in his heart.

entries.yo: Ẹniti kò fi ahọn rẹ̀ sọ̀rọ ẹni lẹhin, ti kò si ṣe ibi si ẹnikeji rẹ̀, ti kò si gbà ọ̀rọ ẹ̀gan si ẹnikeji rẹ̀.
entries.en: He that backbiteth not with his tongue, nor doeth evil to his neighbour, nor taketh up a reproach against his neighbour.

entries.yo: Li oju ẹniti enia-kenia di gigàn; ṣugbọn a ma bu ọla fun awọn ti o bẹ̀ru Oluwa. Ẹniti o bura si ibi ara rẹ̀, ti kò si yipada.
entries.en: In whose eyes a vile person is contemned; but he honoureth them that fear the LORD. He that sweareth to his own hurt, and changeth not.

entries.yo: Ẹniti kò fi owo rẹ̀ gbà èle, ti kò si gbà owo ẹ̀bẹ si alaiṣẹ. Ẹniti o ba ṣe nkan wọnyi kì yio yẹsẹ lailai.
entries.en: He that putteth not out his money to usury, nor taketh reward against the innocent. He that doeth these things shall never be moved.

entries.yo: ỌLỌRUN, pa mi mọ́: nitori iwọ ni mo gbẹkẹ mi le.
entries.en: Preserve me, O God: for in thee do I put my trust.

entries.yo: Ọkàn mi, iwọ ti wi fun Oluwa pe, Iwọ li Oluwa mi: emi kò ni ire kan lẹhin rẹ.
entries.en: O my soul, thou hast said unto the LORD, Thou art my Lord: my goodness extendeth not to thee;

entries.yo: Si awọn enia mimọ́ ti o wà li aiye, ani si awọn ọlọla, lara ẹniti didùn inu mi gbogbo gbe wà.
entries.en: But to the saints that are in the earth, and to the excellent, in whom is all my delight.

entries.yo: Ibinujẹ awọn ti nsare tọ̀ ọlọrun miran lẹhin yio pọ̀: ẹbọ ohun mimu ẹ̀jẹ wọn li emi kì yio ta silẹ, bẹ̃li emi kì yio da orukọ wọn li ẹnu mi.
entries.en: Their sorrows shall be multiplied that hasten after another god: their drink offerings of blood will I not offer, nor take up their names into my lips.

entries.yo: Oluwa ni ipin ini mi, ati ti ago mi: iwọ li o mu ìla mi duro.
entries.en: The LORD is the portion of mine inheritance and of my cup: thou maintainest my lot.

entries.yo: Okùn tita bọ́ sọdọ mi ni ibi daradara; lõtọ, emi ni ogún rere.
entries.en: The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant places; yea, I have a goodly heritage.

entries.yo: Emi o fi ibukún fun Oluwa, ẹniti o ti nfun mi ni ìmọ; ọkàn mi pẹlu nkọ́ mi ni wakati oru.
entries.en: I will bless the LORD, who hath given me counsel: my reins also instruct me in the night seasons.

entries.yo: Emi ti gbé Oluwa kà iwaju mi nigbagbogbo; nitori o wà li ọwọ ọtún mi, a kì yio ṣi mi ni ipò.
entries.en: I have set the LORD always before me: because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni inu mi ṣe dùn, ti ogo mi si nyọ̀; ara mi pẹlu yio simi ni ireti.
entries.en: Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoiceth: my flesh also shall rest in hope.

entries.yo: Nitori iwọ kì yio fi ọkàn mi silẹ ni ipò-okú; bẹ̃ni iwọ kì yio jẹ ki Ẹni Mimọ́ rẹ ki o ri idibajẹ.
entries.en: For thou wilt not leave my soul in hell; neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.

entries.yo: Iwọ o fi ipa ọ̀na ìye hàn mi; ni iwaju rẹ li ẹkún ayọ̀ wà: li ọwọ ọtún rẹ ni didùn-inu wà lailai.
entries.en: Thou wilt shew me the path of life: in thy presence is fulness of joy; at thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore.

entries.yo: GBỌ́ otiọ́, Oluwa, fiyesi igbe mi, fi eti si adura mi, ti kò ti ète ẹ̀tan jade.
entries.en: Hear the right, O LORD, attend unto my cry, give ear unto my prayer, that goeth not out of feigned lips.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki idajọ mi ki o ma ti iwaju rẹ jade wá: jẹ ki oju rẹ ki o ma wò ohun ti o ṣe dẽde.
entries.en: Let my sentence come forth from thy presence; let thine eyes behold the things that are equal.

entries.yo: Iwọ ti dan aiya mi wò; iwọ ti bẹ̀ ẹ wò li oru; iwọ ti wadi mi, iwọ kò ri nkan; emi ti pinnu rẹ̀ pe, ẹnu mi kì yio ṣẹ̀.
entries.en: Thou has proved mine heart; thou hast visited me in the night; thou has tried me, and shalt find nothing; I am purposed that my mouth shall not transgress.

entries.yo: Niti iṣẹ enia, nipa ọ̀rọ ẹnu rẹ̀ emi ti pa ara mi mọ́ kuro ni ipa alaparun.
entries.en: Concerning the works of men, by the word of thy lips I have kept me from the paths of the destroyer.

entries.yo: Fi ìrin mi le ilẹ ni ipa rẹ, ki atẹlẹ ẹsẹ mi ki o máṣe yẹ̀.
entries.en: Hold up my goings in thy paths, that my footsteps slip not.

entries.yo: Emi ti nkepè ọ, nitori pe iwọ o gbohùn mi, Ọlọrun: dẹ eti rẹ si mi, ki o si gbọ́ ọ̀rọ mi:
entries.en: I have called upon thee, for thou wilt hear me, O God: incline thine ear unto me, and hear my speech.

entries.yo: Fi iṣeun ifẹ iyanu rẹ hàn, iwọ ti o fi ọwọ ọtún rẹ gbà awọn ti o gbẹkẹle ọ là, lọwọ awọn ti o dide si wọn.
entries.en: Shew thy marvellous lovingkindness, O thou that savest by thy right hand them which put their trust in thee from those that rise up against them.

entries.yo: Pa mi mọ́ bi ọmọ-oju, pa mi mọ́ labẹ ojiji iyẹ-apá rẹ,
entries.en: Keep me as the apple of the eye, hide me under the shadow of thy wings,

entries.yo: Lọwọ awọn enia buburu ti nfõró mi, lọwọ awọn ọta-iyọta mi, ti o yi mi kakiri.
entries.en: From the wicked that oppress me, from my deadly enemies, who compass me about.

entries.yo: Nwọn fi ọ̀ra sé aiya wọn, ẹnu wọn ni nwọn fi nsọ̀rọ igberaga.
entries.en: They are inclosed in their own fat: with their mouth they speak proudly.

entries.yo: Nwọn ti yi wa ká nisisiyi ninu ìrin wa; nwọn ti gbé oju wọn le ati wọ́ wa silẹ:
entries.en: They have now compassed us in our steps: they have set their eyes bowing down to the earth;

entries.yo: Bi kiniun ti nṣe iwọra si ohun ọdẹ rẹ̀, ati bi ọmọ kiniun ti o mba ni ibi ìkọkọ.
entries.en: Like as a lion that is greedy of his prey, and as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.

entries.yo: Dide, Oluwa, ṣaju rẹ̀, rẹ̀ ẹ silẹ: gbà ọkàn mi lọwọ awọn enia buburu, ti iṣe idà rẹ:
entries.en: Arise, O LORD, disappoint him, cast him down: deliver my soul from the wicked, which is thy sword:

entries.yo: Lọwọ awọn enia nipa ọwọ rẹ, Oluwa, lọwọ awọn enia aiye, ti nwọn ni ipin wọn li aiye yi, ati ikùn ẹniti iwọ fi ohun iṣura rẹ ìkọkọ kún: awọn ọmọ wọn pọ̀n nwọn a si fi iyokù ini wọn silẹ fun awọn ọmọ-ọwọ́ wọn.
entries.en: From men which are thy hand, O LORD, from men of the world, which have their portion in this life, and whose belly thou fillest with thy hid treasure: they are full of children, and leave the rest of their substance to their babes.

entries.yo: Bi o ṣe ti emi ni emi o ma wò oju rẹ li ododo: àworan rẹ yio tẹ mi lọrun nigbati mo ba jí.
entries.en: As for me, I will behold thy face in righteousness: I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with thy likeness.

entries.yo: EMI o fẹ ọ, Oluwa, agbara mi.
entries.en: I will love thee, O LORD, my strength.

entries.yo: Oluwa li apáta mi, ati ilu-olodi mi, ati olugbala mi: Ọlọrun mi, agbara mi, emi o gbẹkẹle e; asà mi, ati iwo igbala mi, ati ile-iṣọ giga mi.
entries.en: The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my strength, in whom I will trust; my buckler, and the horn of my salvation, and my high tower.

entries.yo: Emi o kepè Oluwa, ti o yẹ lati ma yìn; bẹ̃li a o si gbà mi lọwọ awọn ọta mi.
entries.en: I will call upon the LORD, who is worthy to be praised: so shall I be saved from mine enemies.

entries.yo: Irora ikú yi mi ka, ati iṣàn-omi awọn enia buburu dẹ̀ruba mi.
entries.en: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the floods of ungodly men made me afraid.

entries.yo: Irora ipò okú yi mi kakiri: ikẹkun ikú dì mi mu.
entries.en: The sorrows of hell compassed me about: the snares of death prevented me.

entries.yo: Ninu ìṣẹ́ mi emi kepè Oluwa, emi si sọkun pe Ọlọrun mi: o gbohùn mi lati inu tempili rẹ̀ wá, ẹkún mi si wá si iwaju rẹ̀, ani si eti rẹ̀.
entries.en: In my distress I called upon the LORD, and cried unto my God: he heard my voice out of his temple, and my cry came before him, even into his ears.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ilẹ mì, o si wariri: ipilẹ òke pẹlu ṣidi, o si mì, nitoriti o binu.
entries.en: Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations also of the hills moved and were shaken, because he was wroth.

entries.yo: Ẹ̃fin ti iho imu rẹ̀ jade, ati iná lati ẹnu rẹ̀ wá njonirun: ẹyín gbiná nipasẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it.

entries.yo: O tẹri ọrun ba pẹlu, o si sọkalẹ wá: òkunkun si mbẹ li abẹ ẹsẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: He bowed the heavens also, and came down: and darkness was under his feet.

entries.yo: O si gùn ori kerubu o si fò: nitõtọ, o nra lori iyẹ-apa afẹ́fẹ́.
entries.en: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: yea, he did fly upon the wings of the wind.

entries.yo: O fi òkunkun ṣe ibi ìkọkọ rẹ̀: ani agọ́ rẹ̀ yi i ka kiri; omi dudu, ati awọsanma oju-ọrun ṣiṣu dudu.
entries.en: He made darkness his secret place; his pavilion round about him were dark waters and thick clouds of the skies.

entries.yo: Nipa imọlẹ iwaju rẹ̀, awọsanma ṣiṣu dùdu rẹ̀ kọja lọ, yinyín ati ẹyín iná.
entries.en: At the brightness that was before him his thick clouds passed, hail stones and coals of fire.

entries.yo: Oluwa sán ãra pẹlu li ọrun, Ọga-ogo si fọ̀ ohùn rẹ̀: yinyín ati ẹyín iná!
entries.en: The LORD also thundered in the heavens, and the Highest gave his voice; hail stones and coals of fire.

entries.yo: Lõtọ, o rán ọfa rẹ̀ jade, o si tú wọn ká: ọ̀pọlọpọ manamana li o si fi ṣẹ́ wọn tũtu.
entries.en: Yea, he sent out his arrows, and scattered them; and he shot out lightnings, and discomfited them.

entries.yo: Nigbana li awowò omi odò hàn, a si ri ipilẹ aiye nipa ibawi rẹ, Oluwa, nipa fifun ẽmi iho imu rẹ.
entries.en: Then the channels of waters were seen, and the foundations of the world were discovered at thy rebuke, O LORD, at the blast of the breath of thy nostrils.

entries.yo: O ranṣẹ́ lati òke wá, o mu mi, o fà mi jade wá lati inu omi nla.
entries.en: He sent from above, he took me, he drew me out of many waters.

entries.yo: O gbà mi lọwọ ọta mi alagbara, ati lọwọ awọn ti o korira mi; nitori nwọn li agbara jù mi lọ.
entries.en: He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them which hated me: for they were too strong for me.

entries.yo: Nwọn dojukọ mi li ọjọ ipọnju mi: ṣugbọn Oluwa li alafẹhintì mi.
entries.en: They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but the LORD was my stay.

entries.yo: O mu mi jade pẹlu sinu ibi nla; o gbà mi nitori inu rẹ̀ dùn si mi.
entries.en: He brought me forth also into a large place; he delivered me, because he delighted in me.

entries.yo: Oluwa san a fun mi gẹgẹ bi ododo mi; gẹgẹ bi mimọ́ ọwọ mi li o san a fun mi.
entries.en: The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.

entries.yo: Nitori mo ti nkiye si ọ̀na Oluwa, emi kò fi ìka yà kuro lọdọ Ọlọrun mi.
entries.en: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and have not wickedly departed from my God.

entries.yo: Nitori pe gbogbo idajọ rẹ̀ li o wà niwaju mi, bẹ̃li emi kò si yẹ̀ ofin rẹ̀ kuro lọdọ mi.
entries.en: For all his judgments were before me, and I did not put away his statutes from me.

entries.yo: Emi si duro ṣinṣin pẹlu rẹ̀, emi si paramọ kuro lara ẹ̀ṣẹ mi.
entries.en: I was also upright before him, and I kept myself from mine iniquity.

entries.yo: Nitorina li Oluwa ṣe san a fun mi gẹgẹ bi ododo mi, gẹgẹ bi mimọ́ ọwọ mi li oju rẹ̀.
entries.en: Therefore hath the LORD recompensed me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.

entries.yo: Fun alãnu ni iwọ o fi ara rẹ hàn li alãnu; fun ẹniti o duro-ṣinṣin ni iwọ o fi ara rẹ hàn ni diduro-ṣinṣin.
entries.en: With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful; with an upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright;

entries.yo: Fun ọlọkàn-mimọ́ ni iwọ o fi ara rẹ hàn ni ọlọkàn-mimọ́; ati fun ọlọkàn-wiwọ ni iwọ o fi ara rẹ hàn li onroro.
entries.en: With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure; and with the froward thou wilt shew thyself froward.

entries.yo: Nitori iwọ o gbà awọn olupọnju; ṣugbọn iwọ o sọ oju igberaga kalẹ.
entries.en: For thou wilt save the afflicted people; but wilt bring down high looks.

entries.yo: Nitori iwọ ni yio tàn fitila mi: Oluwa Ọlọrun mi yio tàn imọlẹ si òkunkun mi.
entries.en: For thou wilt light my candle: the LORD my God will enlighten my darkness.

entries.yo: Nitori pe pẹlu rẹ emi sure là inu ogun lọ: ati pẹlu Ọlọrun mi emi fò odi kan.
entries.en: For by thee I have run through a troop; and by my God have I leaped over a wall.

entries.yo: Bi o ṣe ti Ọlọrun ni, ọ̀na rẹ̀ pé: a ti ridi ọ̀rọ Oluwa: on li apata fun gbogbo awọn ti o gbẹkẹle e.
entries.en: As for God, his way is perfect: the word of the LORD is tried: he is a buckler to all those that trust in him.

entries.yo: Nitori pe tani iṣe Ọlọrun, bikoṣe Oluwa? tabi tani iṣe apáta bikoṣe Ọlọrun wa?
entries.en: For who is God save the LORD? or who is a rock save our God?

entries.yo: Ọlọrun li o fi agbara dì mi li amure, o si mu ọ̀na mi pé.
entries.en: It is God that girdeth me with strength, and maketh my way perfect.

entries.yo: O ṣe ẹsẹ mi bi ẹsẹ àgbọnrín, o si gbé mi kà ibi giga mi.
entries.en: He maketh my feet like hinds' feet, and setteth me upon my high places.

entries.yo: O kọ́ ọwọ mi li ogun jija, tobẹ̃ ti apa mi fà ọrun idẹ.
entries.en: He teacheth my hands to war, so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms.

entries.yo: Iwọ ti fi asà igbala rẹ fun mi pẹlu: ọwọ ọ̀tun rẹ si gbé mi duro, ati ìwa-pẹlẹ rẹ sọ mi di nla.
entries.en: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy right hand hath holden me up, and thy gentleness hath made me great.

entries.yo: Iwọ sọ ìrin ẹsẹ mi di nla nisalẹ mi, ki kóko-ẹsẹ mi ki o máṣe yẹ̀.
entries.en: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me, that my feet did not slip.

entries.yo: Emi ti le awọn ọta mi, emi si bá wọn: bẹ̃li emi kò pada sẹhin titi a fi run wọn.
entries.en: I have pursued mine enemies, and overtaken them: neither did I turn again till they were consumed.

entries.yo: Emi ṣá wọn li ọgbẹ ti nwọn kò fi le dide, nwọn ṣubu li abẹ ẹsẹ mi.
entries.en: I have wounded them that they were not able to rise: they are fallen under my feet.

entries.yo: Nitoriti iwọ fi agbara di mi li àmure si ogun na: iwọ ti mu awọn ti o dide si mi tẹriba li abẹ ẹsẹ mi.
entries.en: For thou hast girded me with strength unto the battle: thou hast subdued under me those that rose up against me.

entries.yo: Iwọ si yi ẹhin awọn ọta mi pada fun mi pẹlu; emi si pa awọn ti o korira mi run.
entries.en: Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies; that I might destroy them that hate me.

entries.yo: Nwọn kigbe, ṣugbọn kò si ẹniti o gbà wọn; ani si Oluwa, ṣugbọn kò dá wọn li ohùn.
entries.en: They cried, but there was none to save them: even unto the LORD, but he answered them not.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni mo gún wọn kunna bi ekuru niwaju afẹfẹ: mo kó wọn jade bi ohun ẹ̀gbin ni ita.
entries.en: Then did I beat them small as the dust before the wind: I did cast them out as the dirt in the streets.

entries.yo: Iwọ ti yọ mi kuro ninu ìja awọn enia; iwọ fi mi jẹ olori awọn orilẹ-ède: enia ti emi kò ti mọ̀, yio si ma sìn mi.
entries.en: Thou hast delivered me from the strivings of the people; and thou hast made me the head of the heathen: a people whom I have not known shall serve me.

entries.yo: Bi nwọn ti gburo mi, nwọn o gbà mi gbọ́: awọn ọmọ àjeji yio fi ẹ̀tan tẹ̀ ori wọn ba fun mi.
entries.en: As soon as they hear of me, they shall obey me: the strangers shall submit themselves unto me.

entries.yo: Aiya yio pá awọn alejo, nwọn o si fi ibẹ̀ru jade ni ibi kọlọfin wọn.
entries.en: The strangers shall fade away, and be afraid out of their close places.

entries.yo: Oluwa mbẹ; olubukún si li apáta mi; ki a si gbé Ọlọrun igbala mi leke.
entries.en: The LORD liveth; and blessed be my rock; and let the God of my salvation be exalted.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun li o ngbẹsan mi, ti o si nṣẹ́ awọn enia fun mi.
entries.en: It is God that avengeth me, and subdueth the people under me.

entries.yo: O gbà mi lọwọ awọn ọta mi: pẹlupẹlu iwọ gbé mi leke jù awọn ti o dide si mi lọ; iwọ ti gbà mi lọwọ ọkunrin alagbara nì.
entries.en: He delivereth me from mine enemies: yea, thou liftest me up above those that rise up against me: thou hast delivered me from the violent man.

entries.yo: Nitorina li emi ṣe fi iyìn fun ọ, Oluwa, li awujọ awọn orilẹ-ède, emi o si ma kọrin iyìn si orukọ rẹ.
entries.en: Therefore will I give thanks unto thee, O LORD, among the heathen, and sing praises unto thy name.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o fi igbala nla fun Ọba rẹ̀; o si fi ãnu hàn fun Ẹni-ororo rẹ̀, fun Dafidi, ati fun iru-ọmọ rẹ̀ lailai.
entries.en: Great deliverance giveth he to his king; and sheweth mercy to his anointed, to David, and to his seed for evermore.

entries.yo: AWỌN ọrun nsọ̀rọ ogo Ọlọrun; ati ofurufu nfi iṣẹ ọwọ rẹ̀ han.
entries.en: The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork.

entries.yo: Ọjọ de ọjọ nfọhùn, ati oru de oru nfi ìmọ hàn.
entries.en: Day unto day uttereth speech, and night unto night sheweth knowledge.

entries.yo: Kò si ohùn kan tabi ède kan, nibiti a kò gbọ́ iró wọn.
entries.en: There is no speech nor language, where their voice is not heard.

entries.yo: Iró wọn la gbogbo aiye ja, ati ọ̀rọ wọn de opin aiye: ninu wọn li o gbe pagọ fun õrun.
entries.en: Their line is gone out through all the earth, and their words to the end of the world. In them hath he set a tabernacle for the sun,

entries.yo: Ti o dabi ọkọ iyawo ti njade ti iyẹwu rẹ̀ wá, ti o si yọ̀ bi ọkunrin alagbara lati sure ije.
entries.en: Which is as a bridegroom coming out of his chamber, and rejoiceth as a strong man to run a race.

entries.yo: Ijadelọ rẹ̀ ni lati opin ọrun wá, ati ayika rẹ̀ si de ipinlẹ rẹ̀: kò si si ohun ti o fi ara pamọ́ kuro ninu õru rẹ̀.
entries.en: His going forth is from the end of the heaven, and his circuit unto the ends of it: and there is nothing hid from the heat thereof.

entries.yo: Ofin Oluwa pé, o nyi ọkàn pada: ẹri Oluwa daniloju, o nsọ òpè di ọlọgbọ́n.
entries.en: The law of the LORD is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of the LORD is sure, making wise the simple.

entries.yo: Ilana Oluwa tọ́, o nmu ọkàn yọ̀: aṣẹ Oluwa ni mimọ́, o nṣe imọlẹ oju.
entries.en: The statutes of the LORD are right, rejoicing the heart: the commandment of the LORD is pure, enlightening the eyes.

entries.yo: Ẹ̀ru Oluwa mọ́, pipẹ ni titi lai; idajọ Oluwa li otitọ, ododo ni gbogbo wọn.
entries.en: The fear of the LORD is clean, enduring for ever: the judgments of the LORD are true and righteous altogether.

entries.yo: Nwọn jù wura daradara pupọ; nwọn si dùn jù oyin lọ, ati riro afara oyin.
entries.en: More to be desired are they than gold, yea, than much fine gold: sweeter also than honey and the honeycomb.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu nipa wọn li a ti ṣi iranṣẹ rẹ leti; ati ni pipamọ́ wọn ere pipọ̀ mbẹ.
entries.en: Moreover by them is thy servant warned: and in keeping of them there is great reward.

entries.yo: Tali o le mọ̀ iṣina rẹ̀? wẹ̀ mi mọ́ kuro ninu iṣiṣe ìkọkọ mi.
entries.en: Who can understand his errors? cleanse thou me from secret faults.

entries.yo: Fà iranṣẹ rẹ sẹhin pẹlu kuro ninu ẹ̀ṣẹ ikugbu: máṣe jẹ ki nwọn ki o jọba lori mi: nigbana li emi o duro ṣinṣin, emi o si ṣe alaijẹbi kuro ninu ẹ̀ṣẹ nla nì.
entries.en: Keep back thy servant also from presumptuous sins; let them not have dominion over me: then shall I be upright, and I shall be innocent from the great transgression.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki ọ̀rọ ẹnu mi, ati iṣaro ọkàn mi, ki o ṣe itẹwọgba li oju rẹ, Oluwa, agbara mi, ati oludande mi.
entries.en: Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O LORD, my strength, and my redeemer.

entries.yo: KI Oluwa ki o gbohùn rẹ li ọjọ ipọnju; orukọ Ọlọrun Jakobu ki o dàbobo ọ.
entries.en: The LORD hear thee in the day of trouble; the name of the God of Jacob defend thee;

entries.yo: Ki o rán iranlọwọ si ọ lati ibi-mimọ́ wá, ki o si tì ọ lẹhin lati Sioni wá.
entries.en: Send thee help from the sanctuary, and strengthen thee out of Zion;

entries.yo: Ki o ranti ẹbọ-ọrẹ rẹ gbogbo, ki o si gbà ẹbọ sisun rẹ.
entries.en: Remember all thy offerings, and accept thy burnt sacrifice; Selah.

entries.yo: Ki o fi fun ọ gẹgẹ bi ti inu rẹ, ki o si mu gbogbo ìmọ rẹ ṣẹ.
entries.en: Grant thee according to thine own heart, and fulfil all thy counsel.

entries.yo: Awa o ma kọrin ayọ̀ igbala rẹ, ati li orukọ Ọlọrun wa li awa o fi ọpágun wa de ilẹ; ki Oluwa ki o mu gbogbo ibère rẹ ṣẹ.
entries.en: We will rejoice in thy salvation, and in the name of our God we will set up our banners: the LORD fulfil all thy petitions.

entries.yo: Nigbayi ni mo to mọ̀ pe Oluwa gbà Ẹni-ororo rẹ̀ là; yio gbọ́ ọ lati ọrun mimọ́ rẹ̀ wá nipa agbara igbala ọwọ ọ̀tun rẹ̀.
entries.en: Now know I that the LORD saveth his anointed; he will hear him from his holy heaven with the saving strength of his right hand.

entries.yo: Awọn ẹlomiran gbẹkẹle kẹkẹ́, awọn ẹlomiran le ẹṣin; ṣugbọn awa o ranti orukọ Oluwa Ọlọrun wa.
entries.en: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses: but we will remember the name of the LORD our God.

entries.yo: Nwọn wolẹ, nwọn si ṣubu: ṣugbọn awa dide awa si duro ṣinṣin.
entries.en: They are brought down and fallen: but we are risen, and stand upright.

entries.yo: Gbani, Oluwa, ki Ọba ki o gbọ nigbati awa ba nkigbe pe e.
entries.en: Save, LORD: let the king hear us when we call.

entries.yo: ỌBA yio ma yọ̀ li agbara rẹ, Oluwa; ati ni igbala rẹ, yio ti yọ̀ pọ̀ to!
entries.en: The king shall joy in thy strength, O LORD; and in thy salvation how greatly shall he rejoice!

entries.yo: Iwọ ti fi ifẹ ọkàn rẹ̀ fun u, iwọ kò si dù u ni ibère ẹnu rẹ̀.
entries.en: Thou hast given him his heart's desire, and hast not withholden the request of his lips. Selah.

entries.yo: Nitori iwọ ti fi ibukún ore kò o li ọ̀na, iwọ fi ade kiki wura de e li ori.
entries.en: For thou preventest him with the blessings of goodness: thou settest a crown of pure gold on his head.

entries.yo: O tọrọ ẹmi lọwọ rẹ, iwọ si fi fun u, ani ọjọ gigùn lai ati lailai.
entries.en: He asked life of thee, and thou gavest it him, even length of days for ever and ever.

entries.yo: Ogo rẹ̀ pọ̀ ni igbala rẹ: iyìn ati ọlánla ni iwọ fi si i lara.
entries.en: His glory is great in thy salvation: honour and majesty hast thou laid upon him.

entries.yo: Nitori iwọ ti ṣe e li ẹni-ibukún fun jùlọ titi aiye: iwọ si fi oju rẹ mu u yọ̀ gidigidi.
entries.en: For thou hast made him most blessed for ever: thou hast made him exceeding glad with thy countenance.

entries.yo: Nitori ti ọba gbẹkẹle Oluwa, ati nipa ãnu Ọga-ogo kì yio ṣipò pada.
entries.en: For the king trusteth in the LORD, and through the mercy of the most High he shall not be moved.

entries.yo: Ọwọ rẹ yio wá gbogbo awọn ọta rẹ ri: ọwọ ọtún rẹ ni yio wá awọn ti o korira rẹ ri.
entries.en: Thine hand shall find out all thine enemies: thy right hand shall find out those that hate thee.

entries.yo: Iwọ o ṣe wọn bi ileru onina ni igba ibinu rẹ: Oluwa yio gbé wọn mì ni ibinu rẹ̀, iná na yio si jó wọn pa.
