entries.en: Thou shalt make them as a fiery oven in the time of thine anger: the LORD shall swallow them up in his wrath, and the fire shall devour them.

entries.yo: Eso wọn ni iwọ o run kuro ni ilẹ, ati irú-ọmọ wọn kuro ninu awọn ọmọ enia.
entries.en: Their fruit shalt thou destroy from the earth, and their seed from among the children of men.

entries.yo: Nitori ti nwọn nrò ibi si ọ: nwọn ngbìro ete ìwa-ibi, ti nwọn kì yio le ṣe.
entries.en: For they intended evil against thee: they imagined a mischievous device, which they are not able to perform.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni iwọ o ṣe mu wọn pẹhinda, nigbati iwọ ba fi ọfà rẹ kàn ọsán si oju wọn.
entries.en: Therefore shalt thou make them turn their back, when thou shalt make ready thine arrows upon thy strings against the face of them.

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki ó ma leke, Oluwa, li agbara rẹ; bẹ̃li awa o ma kọrin, ti awa o si ma yìn agbara rẹ.
entries.en: Be thou exalted, LORD, in thine own strength: so will we sing and praise thy power.

entries.yo: ỌLỌRUN mi, Ọlọrun mi, ẽṣe ti iwọ fi kọ̀ mi silẹ? ti iwọ si jina si igbala mi, ati si ohùn igbe mi?
entries.en: My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me? why art thou so far from helping me, and from the words of my roaring?

entries.yo: Ọlọrun mi, emi nkigbe li ọsan, ṣugbọn iwọ kò dahùn: ati ni igba oru emi kò dakẹ.
entries.en: O my God, I cry in the daytime, but thou hearest not; and in the night season, and am not silent.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn mimọ́ ni Iwọ, ẹniti o tẹ̀ iyìn Israeli do.
entries.en: But thou art holy, O thou that inhabitest the praises of Israel.

entries.yo: Awọn baba wa gbẹkẹle ọ: nwọn gbẹkẹle, iwọ si gbà wọn.
entries.en: Our fathers trusted in thee: they trusted, and thou didst deliver them.

entries.yo: Nwọn kigbe pè ọ, a si gbà wọn: nwọn gbẹkẹle ọ, nwọn kò si dãmu.
entries.en: They cried unto thee, and were delivered: they trusted in thee, and were not confounded.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn kòkoro li emi, kì isi iṣe enia; ẹ̀gan awọn enia, ati ẹlẹya awọn enia.
entries.en: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised of the people.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn ti o ri mi nfi mi rẹrin ẹlẹya: nwọn nyọ ṣuti ète wọn, nwọn nmì ori pe,
entries.en: All they that see me laugh me to scorn: they shoot out the lip, they shake the head saying,

entries.yo: Jẹ́ ki o gbẹkẹle Oluwa, on o gbà a là; jẹ ki o gbà a là nitori inu rẹ̀ dùn si i.
entries.en: He trusted on the LORD that he would deliver him: let him deliver him, seeing he delighted in him.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn iwọ li ẹniti o mu mi jade lati inu wá: iwọ li o mu mi wà li ailewu, nigbati mo rọ̀ mọ́ ọmu iya mi.
entries.en: But thou art he that took me out of the womb: thou didst make me hope when I was upon my mother's breasts.

entries.yo: Iwọ li a ti fi mi le lọwọ lati inu iya mi wá: iwọ li Ọlọrun mi lati inu iya mi wá.
entries.en: I was cast upon thee from the womb: thou art my God from my mother's belly.

entries.yo: Máṣe jina si mi; nitori ti iyọnu sunmọ etile; nitoriti kò si oluranlọwọ.
entries.en: Be not far from me; for trouble is near; for there is none to help.

entries.yo: Akọ-malu pipọ̀ li o yi mi ka: malu Baṣani ti o lagbara rọ̀gba yi mi ka.
entries.en: Many bulls have compassed me: strong bulls of Bashan have beset me round.

entries.yo: Nwọn yà ẹnu wọn si mi, bi kiniun ti ndọdẹ kiri, ti nké ramuramu.
entries.en: They gaped upon me with their mouths, as a ravening and a roaring lion.

entries.yo: A tú mi danu bi omi, gbogbo egungun mi si yẹ̀ lori ike: ọkàn mi dabi ida; o yọ́ larin inu mi.
entries.en: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint: my heart is like wax; it is melted in the midst of my bowels.

entries.yo: Agbara mi di gbigbẹ bi apãdi: ahọn mi si lẹ̀ mọ́ mi li ẹrẹkẹ; iwọ o mu mi dubulẹ ninu erupẹ ikú.
entries.en: My strength is dried up like a potsherd; and my tongue cleaveth to my jaws; and thou hast brought me into the dust of death.

entries.yo: Nitoriti awọn aja yi mi ka: ijọ awọn enia buburu ti ká mi mọ́: nwọn lu mi li ọwọ, nwọn si lu mi li ẹsẹ.
entries.en: For dogs have compassed me: the assembly of the wicked have inclosed me: they pierced my hands and my feet.

entries.yo: Mo le kaye gbogbo egungun mi: nwọn tẹjumọ mi; nwọn nwò mi sùn.
entries.en: I may tell all my bones: they look and stare upon me.

entries.yo: Nwọn pín aṣọ mi fun ara wọn, nwọn si ṣẹ́ keké le aṣọ-ileke mi.
entries.en: They part my garments among them, and cast lots upon my vesture.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn iwọ máṣe jina si mi, Oluwa: agbara mi, yara lati ràn mi lọwọ.
entries.en: But be not thou far from me, O LORD: O my strength, haste thee to help me.

entries.yo: Gbà ọkàn mi lọwọ idà; ẹni mi kanna lọwọ agbara aja nì.
entries.en: Deliver my soul from the sword; my darling from the power of the dog.

entries.yo: Gbà mi kuro li ẹnu kiniun nì; ki iwọ ki o si gbohùn mi lati ibi iwo awọn agbanrere.
entries.en: Save me from the lion's mouth: for thou hast heard me from the horns of the unicorns.

entries.yo: Emi o sọ̀rọ orukọ rẹ fun awọn arakunrin mi: li awujọ ijọ li emi o ma yìn ọ,
entries.en: I will declare thy name unto my brethren: in the midst of the congregation will I praise thee.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin ti o bẹ̀ru Oluwa, ẹ yìn i; gbogbo ẹnyin iru-ọmọ Jakobu, ẹ yìn i logo: ki ẹ si ma bẹ̀ru rẹ̀ gidigidi, gbogbo ẹnyin irú-ọmọ Israeli.
entries.en: Ye that fear the LORD, praise him; all ye the seed of Jacob, glorify him; and fear him, all ye the seed of Israel.

entries.yo: Nitoriti kò kẹgan, bẹ̃ni kò korira ipọnju awọn olupọnju; bẹ̃ni kò pa oju rẹ̀ mọ́ kuro lara rẹ̀; ṣugbọn nigbati o kigbe pè e, o gbọ́.
entries.en: For he hath not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted; neither hath he hid his face from him; but when he cried unto him, he heard.

entries.yo: Nipa tirẹ ni iyìn mi yio wà ninu ajọ nla, emi o san ẹjẹ́ mi niwaju awọn ti o bẹ̀ru rẹ̀.
entries.en: My praise shall be of thee in the great congregation: I will pay my vows before them that fear him.

entries.yo: Awọn olupọnju yio jẹ, yio tẹ́ wọn lọrun: awọn ti nwá Oluwa yio yìn i: ọkàn nyin yio wà lailai:
entries.en: The meek shall eat and be satisfied: they shall praise the LORD that seek him: your heart shall live for ever.

entries.yo: Gbogbo opin aiye ni yio ranti, nwọn o si yipada si Oluwa: ati gbogbo ibatan orilẹ-ède ni yio wolẹ-sìn niwaju rẹ̀.
entries.en: All the ends of the world shall remember and turn unto the LORD: and all the kindreds of the nations shall worship before thee.

entries.yo: Nitori ijọba ni ti Oluwa; on si ni Bãlẹ ninu awọn orilẹ-ède.
entries.en: For the kingdom is the LORD's: and he is the governor among the nations.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn ti o sanra li aiye yio ma jẹ, nwọn o si ma wolẹ-sìn: gbogbo awọn ti nsọkalẹ lọ sinu erupẹ yio tẹriba niwaju rẹ̀, ati ẹniti kò le pa ọkàn ara rẹ̀ mọ́ li ãye.
entries.en: All they that be fat upon earth shall eat and worship: all they that go down to the dust shall bow before him: and none can keep alive his own soul.

entries.yo: Iru kan yio ma sìn i; a o si kà a ni iran kan fun Oluwa.
entries.en: A seed shall serve him; it shall be accounted to the Lord for a generation.

entries.yo: Nwọn o wá, nwọn o si ma sọ̀rọ ododo rẹ̀ fun awọn enia kan ti a o bí, pe, on li o ṣe eyi.
entries.en: They shall come, and shall declare his righteousness unto a people that shall be born, that he hath done this.

entries.yo: OLUWA li Oluṣọ-agutan mi; emi kì yio ṣe alaini.
entries.en: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.

entries.yo: O mu mi dubulẹ ninu papa-oko tutù; o mu mi lọ si iha omi didakẹ rọ́rọ́.
entries.en: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters.

entries.yo: O tù ọkàn mi lara; o mu mi lọ nipa ọ̀na ododo nitori orukọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: He restoreth my soul: he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name's sake.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ, bi mo tilẹ nrìn larin afonifoji ojiji ikú, emi kì yio bẹ̀ru ibi kan; nitori ti Iwọ pẹlu mi; ọgọ rẹ ati ọpá rẹ nwọn ntù mi ninu.
entries.en: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.

entries.yo: Iwọ tẹ́ tabili onjẹ silẹ niwaju mi li oju awọn ọta mi; iwọ dà ororo si mi li ori; ago mi si kún akúnwọsilẹ.
entries.en: Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies: thou anointest my head with oil; my cup runneth over.

entries.yo: Nitotọ, ire ati ãnu ni yio ma tọ̀ mi lẹhin li ọjọ aiye mi gbogbo; emi o si ma gbe inu ile Oluwa lailai.
entries.en: Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: and I will dwell in the house of the LORD for ever.

entries.yo: TI Oluwa ni ilẹ, ati ẹkún rẹ̀; aiye, ati awọn ti o tẹdo sinu rẹ̀.
entries.en: The earth is the LORD's, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.

entries.yo: Nitoriti o fi idi rẹ̀ sọlẹ lori okun, o si gbé e kalẹ lori awọn iṣan-omi.
entries.en: For he hath founded it upon the seas, and established it upon the floods.

entries.yo: Tani yio gùn ori oke Oluwa lọ? tabi tani yio duro ni ibi-mimọ́ rẹ̀?
entries.en: Who shall ascend into the hill of the LORD? or who shall stand in his holy place?

entries.yo: Ẹniti o li ọwọ mimọ́, ati aiya funfun: ẹniti kò gbé ọkàn rẹ̀ soke si asan, ti kò si bura ẹ̀tan.
entries.en: He that hath clean hands, and a pure heart; who hath not lifted up his soul unto vanity, nor sworn deceitfully.

entries.yo: On ni yio ri ibukún gbà lọwọ Oluwa, ati ododo lọwọ Ọlọrun igbala rẹ̀.
entries.en: He shall receive the blessing from the LORD, and righteousness from the God of his salvation.

entries.yo: Eyi ni iran awọn ti nṣe afẹri rẹ̀, ti nṣe afẹri rẹ, Ọlọrun Jakobu.
entries.en: This is the generation of them that seek him, that seek thy face, O Jacob. Selah.

entries.yo: Ẹ gbé ori nyin soke, ẹnyin ẹnu-ọ̀na; ki a si gbé nyin soke, ẹnyin ilẹkun aiyeraiye: ki Ọba ogo ki o wọ̀ inu ile wa.
entries.en: Lift up your head, O ye gates; and be ye lift up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.

entries.yo: Tali Ọba ogo yi? Oluwa ti o le, ti o si lagbara, Oluwa ti o lagbara li ogun.
entries.en: Who is this King of glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.

entries.yo: Ẹ gbé ori nyin soke, ẹnyin ẹnu-ọ̀na; ani ki ẹ gbé wọn soke, ẹnyin ilẹkun aiyeraiye: ki Ọba ogo ki o wọ̀ inu ile wa.
entries.en: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; even lift them up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.

entries.yo: Tali Ọba ogo yi? Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun; on na li Ọba ogo.
entries.en: Who is this King of glory? The LORD of hosts, he is the King of glory. Selah.

entries.yo: OLUWA, iwọ ni mo gbé ọkàn mi soke si.
entries.en: Unto thee, O LORD, do I lift up my soul.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun mi, emi gbẹkẹle ọ: máṣe jẹ ki oju ki o ti mi, máṣe jẹ ki awọn ọta mi ki o yọ̀ mi.
entries.en: O my God, I trust in thee: let me not be ashamed, let not mine enemies triumph over me.

entries.yo: Lõtọ, maṣe jẹ ki oju ki o tì ẹnikẹni ti o duro tì ọ: awọn ti nṣẹ̀ li ainidi ni oju yio tì.
entries.en: Yea, let none that wait on thee be ashamed: let them be ashamed which transgress without cause.

entries.yo: Fi ọ̀na rẹ hàn mi, Oluwa; kọ́ mi ni ipa tirẹ.
entries.en: Shew me thy ways, O LORD; teach me thy paths.

entries.yo: Sin mi li ọ̀na otitọ rẹ, ki o si kọ́ mi: nitori iwọ li Ọlọrun igbala mi; iwọ ni mo duro tì li ọjọ gbogbo.
entries.en: Lead me in thy truth, and teach me: for thou art the God of my salvation; on thee do I wait all the day.

entries.yo: Oluwa, ranti ãnu ati iṣeun-ifẹ rẹ ti o ni irọnu; nitoriti nwọn ti wà ni igba atijọ.
entries.en: Remember, O LORD, thy tender mercies and thy lovingkindnesses; for they have been ever of old.

entries.yo: Máṣe ranti ẹ̀ṣẹ igba-ewe mi, ati irekọja mi: gẹgẹ bi ãnu rẹ iwọ ranti mi, Oluwa, nitori ore rẹ:
entries.en: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions: according to thy mercy remember thou me for thy goodness' sake, O LORD.

entries.yo: Rere ati diduro-ṣinṣin ni Oluwa: nitorina ni yio ṣe ma kọ́ ẹlẹṣẹ li ọ̀na na.
entries.en: Good and upright is the LORD: therefore will he teach sinners in the way.

entries.yo: Onirẹlẹ ni yio tọ́ li ọ̀na ti ó tọ́, ati onirẹlẹ ni yio kọ́ li ọ̀na rẹ̀.
entries.en: The meek will he guide in judgment: and the meek will he teach his way.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ipa Oluwa li ãnu ati otitọ, fun irú awọn ti o pa majẹmu rẹ̀ ati ẹri rẹ̀ mọ́.
entries.en: All the paths of the LORD are mercy and truth unto such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.

entries.yo: Nitori orukọ rẹ, Oluwa, dari ẹ̀ṣẹ mi jì, nitori ti o tobi.
entries.en: For thy name's sake, O LORD, pardon mine iniquity; for it is great.

entries.yo: Ọkunrin wo li o bẹ̀ru Oluwa? on ni yio kọ́ li ọ̀na ti yio yàn.
entries.en: What man is he that feareth the LORD? him shall he teach in the way that he shall choose.

entries.yo: Ọkàn rẹ̀ yio joko ninu ire, irú-ọmọ rẹ̀ yio si jogun aiye.
entries.en: His soul shall dwell at ease; and his seed shall inherit the earth.

entries.yo: Aṣiri Oluwa wà pẹlu awọn ti o bẹ̀ru rẹ̀, yio si fi wọn mọ̀ majẹmu rẹ̀.
entries.en: The secret of the LORD is with them that fear him; and he will shew them his covenant.

entries.yo: Oju mi gbé soke si Oluwa lai; nitori ti yio fà ẹsẹ mi yọ kuro ninu àwọn na.
entries.en: Mine eyes are ever toward the LORD; for he shall pluck my feet out of the net.

entries.yo: Yipada si mi, ki o si ṣãnu fun mi; nitori ti mo di ofo, mo si di olupọnju.
entries.en: Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me; for I am desolate and afflicted.

entries.yo: Iṣẹ́ aiya mi di pupọ: mu mi jade ninu ipọnju mi.
entries.en: The troubles of my heart are enlarged: O bring thou me out of my distresses.

entries.yo: Wò ipọnju mi ati irora mi; ki o si dari gbogbo ẹ̀ṣẹ mi jì mi.
entries.en: Look upon mine affliction and my pain; and forgive all my sins.

entries.yo: Wò awọn ọta mi, nwọn sá pọ̀; nwọn si korira mi ni irira ìka.
entries.en: Consider mine enemies; for they are many; and they hate me with cruel hatred.

entries.yo: Pa ọkàn mi mọ́, ki o si gbà mi: máṣe jẹ ki oju ki o tì mi; nitori mo gbẹkẹ̀ mi le ọ.
entries.en: O keep my soul, and deliver me: let me not be ashamed; for I put my trust in thee.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki ìwa-titọ ati iduro-ṣinṣin ki o pa mi mọ́: nitoriti mo duro tì ọ.
entries.en: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me; for I wait on thee.

entries.yo: Rà Israeli pada, Ọlọrun, kuro ninu ìṣẹ́ rẹ̀ gbogbo.
entries.en: Redeem Israel, O God, out of all his troubles.

entries.yo: ṢE idajọ mi, Oluwa; nitori ti mo ti nrìn ninu ìwa titọ mi; emi ti gbẹkẹle Oluwa pẹlu; njẹ ẹsẹ mi kì yio yẹ̀.
entries.en: Judge me, O LORD; for I have walked in mine integrity: I have trusted also in the LORD; therefore I shall not slide.

entries.yo: Wadi mi, Oluwa, ki o si ridi mi; dán inu mi ati ọkàn mi wò.
entries.en: Examine me, O LORD, and prove me; try my reins and my heart.

entries.yo: Nitoriti iṣeun-ifẹ rẹ mbẹ niwaju mi: emi si ti nrìn ninu otitọ rẹ.
entries.en: For thy lovingkindness is before mine eyes: and I have walked in thy truth.

entries.yo: Emi kò ba ẹni asan joko, bẹ̃li emi kì yio ba awọn alayidayida wọle.
entries.en: I have not sat with vain persons, neither will I go in with dissemblers.

entries.yo: Emi ti korira ijọ awọn oluṣe-buburu; emi kì yio si ba awọn enia buburu joko.
entries.en: I have hated the congregation of evil doers; and will not sit with the wicked.

entries.yo: Emi o wẹ̀ ọwọ mi li ailẹṣẹ: bẹ̃li emi o si yi pẹpẹ rẹ ká, Oluwa.
entries.en: I will wash mine hands in innocency: so will I compass thine altar, O LORD:

entries.yo: Ki emi ki o le fi ohùn ọpẹ rò kalẹ, ti emi o si ma sọ̀rọ gbogbo iṣẹ iyanu rẹ.
entries.en: That I may publish with the voice of thanksgiving, and tell of all thy wondrous works.

entries.yo: Oluwa, emi ti nfẹ ibujoko ile rẹ, ibi agọ ọlá rẹ.
entries.en: LORD, I have loved the habitation of thy house, and the place where thine honour dwelleth.

entries.yo: Máṣe kó ọkàn mi pọ̀ pẹlu awọn ẹlẹṣẹ, tabi ẹmi mi pẹlu awọn enia-ẹ̀jẹ.
entries.en: Gather not my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloody men:

entries.yo: Li ọwọ ẹniti ìwa-ìka mbẹ, ọwọ ọtún wọn si kún fun abẹtẹlẹ.
entries.en: In whose hands is mischief, and their right hand is full of bribes.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi o ṣe ti emi, emi o ma rìn ninu ìwatitọ mi: rà mi pada, ki o si ṣãnu fun mi.
entries.en: But as for me, I will walk in mine integrity: redeem me, and be merciful unto me.

entries.yo: Ẹsẹ mi duro ni ibi titẹju: ninu awọn ijọ li emi o ma fi ibukún fun Oluwa.
entries.en: My foot standeth in an even place: in the congregations will I bless the LORD.

entries.yo: OLUWA ni imọlẹ mi ati igbala mi; tali emi o bẹ̀ru? Oluwa li agbara ẹmi mi; aiya tali yio fò mi?
entries.en: The LORD is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the LORD is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn enia buburu, ani awọn ọta mi ati awọn abinuku mi sunmọ mi lati jẹ ẹran ara mi, nwọn kọsẹ, nwọn si ṣubu.
entries.en: When the wicked, even mine enemies and my foes, came upon me to eat up my flesh, they stumbled and fell.

entries.yo: Bi ogun tilẹ dótì mi, aiya mi kì yio fò: bi ogun tilẹ dide si mi, ninu eyi li ọkàn mi yio le.
entries.en: Though an host should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear: though war should rise against me, in this will I be confident.

entries.yo: Ohun kan li emi ntọrọ li ọdọ Oluwa, on na li emi o ma wakiri: ki emi ki o le ma gbe inu ile Oluwa li ọjọ aiye mi gbogbo, ki emi ki o le ma wò ẹwà Oluwa, ki emi ki o si ma fi inu-didùn wò tempili rẹ̀.
entries.en: One thing have I desired of the LORD, that will I seek after; that I may dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to behold the beauty of the LORD, and to inquire in his temple.

entries.yo: Nitori pe ni igba ipọnju on o pa mi mọ́ ninu agọ rẹ̀: ni ibi ìkọkọ àgọ́ rẹ̀ ni yio pa mi mọ́; yio si gbé mi soke kà ori apata.
entries.en: For in the time of trouble he shall hide me in his pavilion: in the secret of his tabernacle shall he hide me; he shall set me up upon a rock.

entries.yo: Nigbayi li ori mi yio gbé soke ga jù awọn ọta mi lọ, ti o yi mi ká, nitorina li emi o ṣe rubọ ayọ̀ ninu agọ rẹ̀; emi o kọrin, nitõtọ emi o kọrin iyìn si Oluwa.
entries.en: And now shall mine head be lifted up above mine enemies round about me: therefore will I offer in his tabernacle sacrifices of joy; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises unto the LORD.

entries.yo: Gbọ́, Oluwa, nigbati mo ba fi ohùn mi pè: ṣanu fun mi pẹlu, ki o si da mi li ohùn.
entries.en: Hear, O LORD, when I cry with my voice: have mercy also upon me, and answer me.

entries.yo: Nigbati o wipe, Ẹ ma wa oju mi; ọkàn mi wi fun ọ pe, Oju rẹ, Oluwa, li emi o ma wá.
entries.en: When thou saidst, Seek ye my face; my heart said unto thee, Thy face, LORD, will I seek.

entries.yo: Máṣe pa oju rẹ mọ́ kuro lọdọ mi; máṣe fi ibinu ṣa iranṣẹ rẹ tì: iwọ li o ti nṣe iranlọwọ mi; má fi mi silẹ, bẹ̃ni ki o máṣe kọ̀ mi, Ọlọrun igbala mi.
entries.en: Hide not thy face far from me; put not thy servant away in anger: thou hast been my help; leave me not, neither forsake me, O God of my salvation.

entries.yo: Nigbati baba ati iya mi kọ̀ mi silẹ, nigbana ni Oluwa yio tẹwọgbà mi.
entries.en: When my father and my mother forsake me, then the LORD will take me up.

entries.yo: Kọ́ mi li ọ̀na rẹ, Oluwa, ki o si tọ́ mi li ọ̀na titọ, nitori awọn ọta mi.
entries.en: Teach me thy way, O LORD, and lead me in a plain path, because of mine enemies.

entries.yo: Máṣe fi mi le ifẹ awọn ọta mi lọwọ; nitori awọn ẹlẹri eke dide si mi, ati iru awọn ti nmí imí-ìkà.
entries.en: Deliver me not over unto the will of mine enemies: for false witnesses are risen up against me, and such as breathe out cruelty.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi ti gbagbọ lati ri ire Oluwa ni ilẹ alãye.
entries.en: I had fainted, unless I had believed to see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.

entries.yo: Duro de Oluwa; ki o si tújuka, yio si mu ọ li aiya le: mo ni, duro de Oluwa.
entries.en: Wait on the LORD: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart: wait, I say, on the LORD.

entries.yo: IWỌ, Oluwa, apata mi li emi o kigbe pè, máṣe dakẹ si mi; bi iwọ ba dakẹ si mi, emi o dabi awọn ti o lọ sinu ihò.
entries.en: Unto thee will I cry, O LORD my rock; be not silent to me: lest, if thou be silent to me, I become like them that go down into the pit.

entries.yo: Gbọ́ ohùn ẹ̀bẹ mi, nigbati mo ba nkigbe pè ọ, nigbati mo ba gbé ọwọ mi soke siha ibi-mimọ́ jùlọ rẹ.
entries.en: Hear the voice of my supplications, when I cry unto thee, when I lift up my hands toward thy holy oracle.

entries.yo: Máṣe fà mi lọ pẹlu awọn enia buburu, ati pẹlu awọn oniṣẹ ẹ̀ṣẹ, ti nsọ̀rọ alafia si aladugbo wọn, ṣugbọn ìwa-ìka mbẹ̀ li ọkàn wọn.
entries.en: Draw me not away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity, which speak peace to their neighbours, but mischief is in their hearts.

entries.yo: Fi fun wọn gẹgẹ bi iṣe wọn, ati gẹgẹ bi ìwa buburu ete wọn, fi fun wọn nipa iṣẹ ọwọ wọn, fi ère wọn fun wọn.
entries.en: Give them according to their deeds, and according to the wickedness of their endeavours: give them after the work of their hands; render to them their desert.

entries.yo: Nitori ti nwọn kò kà iṣẹ Oluwa si, tabi iṣẹ ọwọ rẹ̀; on o run wọn, kì yio si gbé wọn ró.
entries.en: Because they regard not the works of the LORD, nor the operation of his hands, he shall destroy them, and not build them up.

entries.yo: Olubukún ni Oluwa, nitoriti o ti gbọ́ ohùn ẹ̀bẹ mi.
entries.en: Blessed be the LORD, because he hath heard the voice of my supplications.

entries.yo: Oluwa li agbara ati asà mi; on li aiya mi gbẹkẹle, a si nràn mi lọwọ: nitorina inu mi dùn jọjọ: emi o si ma fi orin mi yìn i.
entries.en: The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusted in him, and I am helped: therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth; and with my song will I praise him.

entries.yo: Oluwa li agbara wọn, on si li agbara igbala ẹni-ororo rẹ̀.
entries.en: The LORD is their strength, and he is the saving strength of his anointed.

entries.yo: Gbà awọn enia rẹ là, ki o si busi ilẹ-ini rẹ: ma bọ́ wọn pẹlu, ki o si ma gbé wọn leke lailai.
entries.en: Save thy people, and bless thine inheritance: feed them also, and lift them up for ever.

entries.yo: Ẹ FI fun Oluwa, ẹnyin ọmọ awọn alagbara, ẹ fi ogo ati agbara fun Oluwa.
entries.en: Give unto the LORD, O ye mighty, give unto the LORD glory and strength.

entries.yo: Ẹ fi ogo fun Oluwa, ti o yẹ fun orukọ rẹ̀; ẹ ma sìn Oluwa ninu ẹwà ìwa-mimọ́.
entries.en: Give unto the LORD the glory due unto his name; worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness.

entries.yo: Ohùn Oluwa mbẹ lori omi pupọ̀: Ọlọrun ogo nsán ãrá: Oluwa mbẹ lori omi pupọ̀.
entries.en: The voice of the LORD is upon the waters: the God of glory thundereth: the LORD is upon many waters.

entries.yo: Ohùn Oluwa li agbara; ohùn Oluwa ni ọlánla.
entries.en: The voice of the LORD is powerful; the voice of the LORD is full of majesty.

entries.yo: Ohùn Oluwa nfà igi kedari ya; lõtọ, Oluwa nfà igi kedari Lebanoni ya.
entries.en: The voice of the LORD breaketh the cedars; yea, the LORD breaketh the cedars of Lebanon.

entries.yo: O mu wọn fò pẹlu bi ọmọ-malu; Lebanoni on Sirioni bi ọmọ agbanrere.
entries.en: He maketh them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young unicorn.

entries.yo: Ohùn Oluwa nyà ọwọ iná,
entries.en: The voice of the LORD divideth the flames of fire.

entries.yo: Ohùn Oluwa nmì aginju; Oluwa nmì aginju Kadeṣi.
entries.en: The voice of the LORD shaketh the wilderness; the LORD shaketh the wilderness of Kadesh.

entries.yo: Ohùn Oluwa li o nmu abo agbọnrin bi, o si fi igbo didi hàn: ati ninu tempili rẹ̀ li olukuluku nsọ̀rọ ogo rẹ̀.
entries.en: The voice of the LORD maketh the hinds to calve, and discovereth the forests: and in his temple doth every one speak of his glory.

entries.yo: Oluwa joko lori iṣan-omi; nitõtọ, Oluwa joko bi Ọba lailai.
entries.en: The LORD sitteth upon the flood; yea, the LORD sitteth King for ever.

entries.yo: Oluwa yio fi agbara fun awọn enia rẹ̀; Oluwa yio fi alafia busi i fun awọn enia rẹ̀.
entries.en: The LORD will give strength unto his people; the LORD will bless his people with peace.

entries.yo: EMI o kokiki rẹ, Oluwa; nitori iwọ li o gbé mi leke, ti iwọ kò si jẹ ki awọn ọta mi ki ó yọ̀ mi.
entries.en: I will extol thee, O LORD; for thou hast lifted me up, and hast not made my foes to rejoice over me.

entries.yo: Oluwa Ọlọrun mi, emi kigbe pè ọ, iwọ si ti mu mi lara da.
entries.en: O LORD my God, I cried unto thee, and thou hast healed me.

entries.yo: Oluwa, iwọ ti yọ ọkàn mi jade kuro ninu isa-okú: iwọ o si pa mi mọ́ lãye, ki emi ki o má ba lọ sinu iho.
entries.en: O LORD, thou hast brought up my soul from the grave: thou hast kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.

entries.yo: Kọrin si Oluwa, ẹnyin enia rẹ̀ mimọ́, ki ẹ si ma dupẹ ni iranti ìwa-mimọ́ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Sing unto the LORD, O ye saints of his, and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.

entries.yo: Nitoripe, ni iṣẹju kan ni ibinu rẹ̀ ipẹ́, li ojurere rẹ̀ ni ìye gbe wà; bi ẹkun pẹ di alẹ kan, ṣugbọn ayọ̀ mbọ li owurọ.
entries.en: For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.

entries.yo: Ati ninu alafia mi, emi ni, ipò mi kì yio pada lailai.
entries.en: And in my prosperity I said, I shall never be moved.

entries.yo: Oluwa, nipa oju-rere rẹ, iwọ ti mu òke mi duro ṣinṣin: nigbati iwọ pa oju rẹ mọ́, ẹnu yọ mi.
entries.en: LORD, by thy favour thou hast made my mountain to stand strong: thou didst hide thy face, and I was troubled.

entries.yo: Emi kigbe pè ọ, Oluwa; ati si Oluwa li emi mbẹ̀bẹ gidigidi.
entries.en: I cried to thee, O LORD; and unto the LORD I made supplication.

entries.yo: Ere kili o wà li ẹ̀jẹ mi, nigbati mo ba lọ sinu ihò? erupẹ ni yio ma yìn ọ bi? on ni yio ma sọ̀rọ otitọ rẹ bi?
entries.en: What profit is there in my blood, when I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise thee? shall it declare thy truth?

entries.yo: Gbọ́, Oluwa, ki o si ṣãnu fun mi: Oluwa, iwọ ma ṣe oluranlọwọ mi.
entries.en: Hear, O LORD, and have mercy upon me: LORD, be thou my helper.

entries.yo: Iwọ ti sọ ikãnu mi di ijó fun mi; iwọ ti bọ aṣọ-ọ̀fọ mi kuro, iwọ si fi ayọ̀ dì mi li àmure.
entries.en: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing: thou hast put off my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;

entries.yo: Nitori idi eyi ni ki ogo mi ki o le ma kọrin si ọ, ki o má si ṣe dakẹ. Oluwa Ọlọrun mi, emi o ma fi iyìn fun ọ lailai.
entries.en: To the end that my glory may sing praise to thee, and not be silent. O LORD my God, I will give thanks unto thee for ever.

entries.yo: OLUWA, iwọ ni mo gbẹkẹ mi le: máṣe jẹ ki oju ki o tì mi: gbà mi ninu ododo rẹ.
entries.en: In thee, O LORD, do I put my trust; let me never be ashamed: deliver me in thy righteousness.

entries.yo: Dẹ eti rẹ silẹ si mi: gbà mi nisisiyi: iwọ ma ṣe apata agbara mi, ile-ãbò lati gba mi si.
entries.en: Bow down thine ear to me; deliver me speedily: be thou my strong rock, for an house of defence to save me.

entries.yo: Nitori iwọ li apata mi ati odi mi: nitorina nitori orukọ rẹ ma ṣe itọ́ mi, ki o si ma ṣe amọ̀na mi.
entries.en: For thou art my rock and my fortress; therefore for thy name's sake lead me, and guide me.

entries.yo: Yọ mi jade ninu àwọn ti nwọn nà silẹ fun mi ni ìkọkọ: nitori iwọ li ãbo mi.
entries.en: Pull me out of the net that they have laid privily for me: for thou art my strength.

entries.yo: Li ọwọ rẹ ni mo fi ẹmi mi le: iwọ li o ti rà mi pada, Oluwa Ọlọrun otitọ.
entries.en: Into thine hand I commit my spirit: thou hast redeemed me, O LORD God of truth.

entries.yo: Emi ti korira awọn ẹniti nfiyesi eke asan: ṣugbọn emi gbẹkẹle Oluwa.
entries.en: I have hated them that regard lying vanities: but I trust in the LORD.

entries.yo: Emi o yọ̀, inu mi yio si dùn ninu ãnu rẹ: nitori ti iwọ ti rò ti iṣẹ́ mi; iwọ ti mọ̀ ọkàn mi ninu ipọnju;
entries.en: I will be glad and rejoice in thy mercy: for thou hast considered my trouble; thou hast known my soul in adversities;

entries.yo: Iwọ kò si sé mi mọ́ si ọwọ ọta nì: iwọ fi ẹsẹ mi tẹlẹ ni ibi àye nla.
entries.en: And hast not shut me up into the hand of the enemy: thou hast set my feet in a large room.

entries.yo: Ṣãnu fun mi, Oluwa, nitori ti emi wà ninu iṣẹ́: oju mi fi ibinujẹ run, ọkàn mi ati inu mi.
entries.en: Have mercy upon me, O LORD, for I am in trouble: mine eye is consumed with grief, yea, my soul and my belly.

entries.yo: Emi fi ibinujẹ lò ọjọ mi, ati ọdun mi ti on ti imi-ẹ̀dun: agbara mi kú nitori ẹ̀ṣẹ mi, awọn egungun mi si run.
entries.en: For my life is spent with grief, and my years with sighing: my strength faileth because of mine iniquity, and my bones are consumed.

entries.yo: Emi di ẹni-ẹ̀gan lãrin awọn ọta mi gbogbo, pẹlupẹlu lãrin awọn aladugbo mi, mo si di ẹ̀ru fun awọn ojulumọ mi: awọn ti o ri mi lode nyẹra fun mi.
entries.en: I was a reproach among all mine enemies, but especially among my neighbours, and a fear to mine acquaintance: they that did see me without fled from me.

entries.yo: Emi ti di ẹni-igbagbe kuro ni ìye bi okú: emi dabi ohun-elo fifọ́.
entries.en: I am forgotten as a dead man out of mind: I am like a broken vessel.

entries.yo: Nitori ti emi ti ngbọ́ ẹ̀gan ọ̀pọ enia: ẹ̀ru wà niha gbogbo: nigbati nwọn ngbimọ pọ̀ si mi, nwọn gbiro ati gbà ẹmi mi kuro.
entries.en: For I have heard the slander of many: fear was on every side: while they took counsel together against me, they devised to take away my life.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi gbẹkẹle ọ, Oluwa: emi ni, Iwọ li Ọlọrun mi.
entries.en: But I trusted in thee, O LORD: I said, Thou art my God.

entries.yo: Igba mi mbẹ li ọwọ rẹ: gbà mi li ọwọ awọn ọta mi, ati li ọwọ awọn ti nṣe inunibini si mi,
entries.en: My times are in thy hand: deliver me from the hand of mine enemies, and from them that persecute me.

entries.yo: Ṣe oju rẹ ki o mọlẹ si iranṣẹ rẹ lara: gbà mi nitori ãnu rẹ.
entries.en: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant: save me for thy mercies' sake.

entries.yo: Máṣe jẹ ki oju ki o tì mi, Oluwa; nitori ti emi nkepè ọ; enia buburu ni ki oju ki o tì, awọn ni ki a mu dakẹ ni isa-okú.
entries.en: Let me not be ashamed, O LORD; for I have called upon thee: let the wicked be ashamed, and let them be silent in the grave.

entries.yo: Awọn ète eke ni ki a mu dakẹ; ti nsọ̀rọ ohun buburu ni igberaga ati li ẹ̀gan si awọn olododo.
entries.en: Let the lying lips be put to silence; which speak grievous things proudly and contemptuously against the righteous.

entries.yo: Ore rẹ ti tobi to, ti iwọ fi ṣura dè awọn ti o bẹru rẹ: ore ti iwọ ti ṣe fun awọn ti o gbẹkẹle ọ niwaju awọn ọmọ enia!
entries.en: Oh how great is thy goodness, which thou hast laid up for them that fear thee; which thou hast wrought for them that trust in thee before the sons of men!

entries.yo: Iwọ o pa wọn mọ́ ni ibi ìkọkọ iwaju rẹ kuro ninu idimọlu awọn enia; iwọ o pa wọn mọ́ ni ìkọkọ ninu agọ kan kuro ninu ija ahọn.
entries.en: Thou shalt hide them in the secret of thy presence from the pride of man: thou shalt keep them secretly in a pavilion from the strife of tongues.

entries.yo: Olubukún ni Oluwa; nitori ti o ti fi iṣeun-ifẹ iyanu rẹ̀ hàn mi ni ilu olodi.
entries.en: Blessed be the LORD: for he hath shewed me his marvellous kindness in a strong city.

entries.yo: Nitori ti mo ti wi ni ikanju mi pe, A ke mi kuro niwaju rẹ: ṣugbọn iwọ gbọ́ ohùn ẹ̀bẹ mi nigbati mo kepè ọ.
entries.en: For I said in my haste, I am cut off from before thine eyes: nevertheless thou heardest the voice of my supplications when I cried unto thee.

entries.yo: Ẹ fẹ Oluwa, gbogbo ẹnyin enia rẹ̀ mimọ́: Oluwa npa onigbagbọ́ mọ́, o si san a li ọ̀pọlọpọ fun ẹniti nṣe igberaga.
entries.en: O love the LORD, all ye his saints: for the LORD preserveth the faithful, and plentifully rewardeth the proud doer.

entries.yo: Ẹ tujuka, yio si mu nyin li aiya le, gbogbo ẹnyin ti o ni ireti niti Oluwa.
entries.en: Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, all ye that hope in the LORD.

entries.yo: IBUKÚN ni fun awọn ti a dari irekọja wọn jì, ti a bò ẹ̀ṣẹ wọn mọlẹ.
entries.en: Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven, whose sin is covered.

entries.yo: Ibukún ni fun ọkunrin na ẹniti Oluwa kò kà ẹ̀ṣẹ si lọrun, ati ninu ẹmi ẹniti ẹ̀tan kò si.
entries.en: Blessed is the man unto whom the LORD imputeth not iniquity, and in whose spirit there is no guile.

entries.yo: Nigbati mo dakẹ, egungun mi di gbigbo nitori igbe mi ni gbogbo ọjọ.
entries.en: When I kept silence, my bones waxed old through my roaring all the day long.

entries.yo: Nitori li ọsan ati li oru, ọwọ rẹ wuwo si mi lara: omi ara mi si dabi ọdá-ẹ̀run.
entries.en: For day and night thy hand was heavy upon me: my moisture is turned into the drought of summer. Selah.

entries.yo: Emi jẹwọ ẹ̀ṣẹ mi fun ọ, ati ẹ̀ṣẹ mi li emi kò si fi pamọ́. Emi wipe, emi o jẹwọ ìrekọja mi fun Oluwa: iwọ si dari ẹbi ẹ̀ṣẹ mi jì.
entries.en: I acknowledged my sin unto thee, and mine iniquity have I not hid. I said, I will confess my transgressions unto the LORD; and thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin. Selah.

entries.yo: Nitori eyi li olukulùku ẹni ìwa-bi-ọlọrun yio ma gbadura si ọ ni igba ti a le ri ọ: nitõtọ ninu iṣan-omi nla, nwọn kì yio sunmọ ọdọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: For this shall every one that is godly pray unto thee in a time when thou mayest be found: surely in the floods of great waters they shall not come nigh unto him.

entries.yo: Iwọ ni ibi ipamọ́ mi: iwọ o pa mi mọ́ kuro ninu iṣẹ́; iwọ o fi orin igbala yi mi ka kiri.
entries.en: Thou art my hiding place; thou shalt preserve me from trouble; thou shalt compass me about with songs of deliverance. Selah.

entries.yo: Emi o fi ẹsẹ̀ rẹ le ọ̀na, emi o si kọ́ ọ li ọ̀na ti iwọ o rìn: emi o ma fi oju mi tọ́ ọ.
entries.en: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will guide thee with mine eye.

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o máṣe dabi ẹṣin tabi ibaka, ti kò ni iyè ninu: ẹnu ẹniti a kò le ṣe aifi ijanu bọ̀, ki nwọn ki o má ba sunmọ ọ.
entries.en: Be ye not as the horse, or as the mule, which have no understanding: whose mouth must be held in with bit and bridle, lest they come near unto thee.

entries.yo: Ọ̀pọ ikãnu ni yio wà fun enia buburu: ṣugbọn ẹniti o ba gbẹkẹle Oluwa, ãnu ni yio yi i ka kiri.
entries.en: Many sorrows shall be to the wicked: but he that trusteth in the LORD, mercy shall compass him about.

entries.yo: Ki inu nyin ki o dùn niti Oluwa, ẹ si ma yọ̀, ẹnyin olododo; ẹ si ma kọrin fun ayọ̀, gbogbo ẹnyin ti aiya nyin duro ṣinṣin.
entries.en: Be glad in the LORD, and rejoice, ye righteous: and shout for joy, all ye that are upright in heart.

entries.yo: ẸMA yọ̀ niti Oluwa, ẹnyin olododo: nitoriti iyìn yẹ fun ẹni-diduro-ṣinṣin.
entries.en: Rejoice in the LORD, O ye righteous: for praise is comely for the upright.

entries.yo: Ẹ ma fi duru yìn Oluwa: ẹ ma fi ohun-elo olokùn mẹwa kọrin si i.
entries.en: Praise the LORD with harp: sing unto him with the psaltery and an instrument of ten strings.

entries.yo: Ẹ kọ orin titun si i: ẹ ma fi ọgbọngbọn lù ohun ọnà orin pẹlu ariwo.
entries.en: Sing unto him a new song; play skilfully with a loud noise.

entries.yo: Nitori ti ọ̀rọ Oluwa tọ́: ati gbogbo iṣẹ rẹ̀ li a nṣe ninu otitọ.
entries.en: For the word of the LORD is right; and all his works are done in truth.

entries.yo: O fẹ otitọ ati idajọ: ilẹ aiye kún fun ãnu Oluwa.
entries.en: He loveth righteousness and judgment: the earth is full of the goodness of the LORD.

entries.yo: Nipa ọ̀rọ Oluwa li a da awọn ọrun, ati gbogbo ogun wọn nipa ẽmí ẹnu rẹ̀.
entries.en: By the word of the LORD were the heavens made; and all the host of them by the breath of his mouth.

entries.yo: O gbá awọn omi okun jọ bi ẹnipe òkiti kan: o tò ibu jọ ni ile iṣura.
entries.en: He gathereth the waters of the sea together as an heap: he layeth up the depth in storehouses.

entries.yo: Ki gbogbo aiye ki o bẹ̀ru Oluwa: ki gbogbo araiye ki o ma wà ninu ẹ̀ru rẹ̀.
entries.en: Let all the earth fear the LORD: let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.

entries.yo: Nitori ti o sọ̀rọ, o si ti ṣẹ; o paṣẹ, o si duro ṣinṣin.
entries.en: For he spake, and it was done; he commanded, and it stood fast.

entries.yo: Oluwa mu ìmọ awọn orilẹ-ède di asan: o mu arekereke awọn enia ṣaki.
entries.en: The LORD bringeth the counsel of the heathen to nought: he maketh the devices of the people of none effect.

entries.yo: Imọ Oluwa duro lailai, ìro inu rẹ̀ lati irandiran.
entries.en: The counsel of the LORD standeth for ever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.

entries.yo: Ibukún ni fun orilẹ-ède na, Ọlọrun ẹniti Oluwa iṣe; ati awọn enia na ti o ti yàn ṣe ini rẹ̀.
entries.en: Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD: and the people whom he hath chosen for his own inheritance.

entries.yo: Oluwa wò lati ọrun wá, o ri gbogbo ọmọ enia.
entries.en: The LORD looketh from heaven; he beholdeth all the sons of men.

entries.yo: Lati ibujoko rẹ̀ o wò gbogbo araiye.
entries.en: From the place of his habitation he looketh upon all the inhabitants of the earth.

entries.yo: O ṣe aiya wọn bakanna; o kiyesi gbogbo iṣẹ wọn.
entries.en: He fashioneth their hearts alike; he considereth all their works.

entries.yo: Kò si ọba kan ti a ti ọwọ ọ̀pọ ogun gba silẹ: kò si alagbara kan ti a fi agbara pupọ̀ gba silẹ.
entries.en: There is no king saved by the multitude of an host: a mighty man is not delivered by much strength.

entries.yo: Ohun asan li ẹṣin fun igbala: bẹ̃ni kì yio fi agbara nla rẹ̀ gbàni silẹ.
entries.en: An horse is a vain thing for safety: neither shall he deliver any by his great strength.

entries.yo: Kiye si i, oju Oluwa mbẹ lara awọn ti o bẹ̀ru rẹ̀, lara awọn ti nreti ninu ãnu rẹ̀;
entries.en: Behold, the eye of the LORD is upon them that fear him, upon them that hope in his mercy;

entries.yo: Lati gba ọkàn wọn la lọwọ ikú, ati lati pa wọn mọ́ lãye ni igba ìyan.
entries.en: To deliver their soul from death, and to keep them alive in famine.

entries.yo: Ọkàn wa duro de Oluwa: on ni iranlọwọ wa ati asà wa.
entries.en: Our soul waiteth for the LORD: he is our help and our shield.

entries.yo: Nitori ti ọkàn wa yio yọ̀ niti rẹ̀, nitori ti awa ti gbẹkẹle orukọ rẹ̀ mimọ́.
entries.en: For our heart shall rejoice in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.

entries.yo: Ki ãnu rẹ, Oluwa, ki o wà lara wa, gẹgẹ bi awa ti nṣe ireti rẹ.
entries.en: Let thy mercy, O LORD, be upon us, according as we hope in thee.

entries.yo: EMI o ma fi ibukún fun Oluwa nigbagbogbo: Iyìn rẹ̀ yio ma wà li ẹnu mi titi lai.
entries.en: I will bless the LORD at all times: his praise shall continually be in my mouth.

entries.yo: Ọkàn mi yio ma ṣogo rẹ̀ niti Oluwa: awọn onirẹlẹ yio gbọ́, inu wọn yio si ma dùn.
entries.en: My soul shall make her boast in the LORD: the humble shall hear thereof, and be glad.

entries.yo: Gbé Oluwa ga pẹlu mi, ki a si jumọ gbé orukọ rẹ̀ leke.
entries.en: O magnify the LORD with me, and let us exalt his name together.

entries.yo: Emi ṣe afẹri Oluwa, o si gbohùn mi; o si gbà mi kuro ninu gbogbo ìbẹru mi.
entries.en: I sought the LORD, and he heard me, and delivered me from all my fears.

entries.yo: Nwọn wò o, imọlẹ si mọ́ wọn: oju kò si tì wọn.
entries.en: They looked unto him, and were lightened: and their faces were not ashamed.

entries.yo: Ọkunrin olupọnju yi kigbe pè, Oluwa si gbohùn rẹ̀, o si gbà a ninu gbogbo ipọnju rẹ̀:
entries.en: This poor man cried, and the LORD heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.

entries.yo: Angeli Oluwa yi awọn ti o bẹ̀ru rẹ̀ ká, o si gbà wọn.
entries.en: The angel of the LORD encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivereth them.

entries.yo: Tọ́ ọ wò, ki o si ri pe, rere ni Oluwa: alabukún fun li ọkunrin na ti o gbẹkẹle e.
entries.en: O taste and see that the LORD is good: blessed is the man that trusteth in him.

entries.yo: Ẹ bẹ̀ru Oluwa, ẹnyin enia rẹ̀ mimọ́: nitoriti kò si aini fun awọn ti o bẹ̀ru rẹ̀,
entries.en: O fear the LORD, ye his saints: for there is no want to them that fear him.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ kiniun a ma ṣe alaini, ebi a si ma pa wọn: ṣugbọn awọn ti nwá Oluwa, kì yio ṣe alaini ohun ti o dara.
entries.en: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger: but they that seek the LORD shall not want any good thing.

entries.yo: Wá, ẹnyin ọmọ, fi eti si mi: emi o kọ́ nyin li ẹ̀ru Oluwa.
entries.en: Come, ye children, hearken unto me: I will teach you the fear of the LORD.

entries.yo: Ọkunrin wo li o nfẹ ìye, ti o si nfẹ ọjọ pipọ, ki o le ma ri rere?
entries.en: What man is he that desireth life, and loveth many days, that he may see good?

entries.yo: Pa ahọn rẹ mọ́ kuro ninu ibi, ati ète rẹ kuro li ẹ̀tan sisọ.
entries.en: Keep thy tongue from evil, and thy lips from speaking guile.

entries.yo: Lọ kuro ninu ibi, ki o si ma ṣe rere; ma wá alafia, ki o si lepa rẹ̀.
entries.en: Depart from evil, and do good; seek peace, and pursue it.

entries.yo: Oju Oluwa mbẹ lara awọn olododo, eti rẹ̀ si ṣi si igbe wọn.
entries.en: The eyes of the LORD are upon the righteous, and his ears are open unto their cry.

entries.yo: Oju Oluwa kan si awọn ti nṣe buburu, lati ke iranti wọn kuro lori ilẹ.
entries.en: The face of the LORD is against them that do evil, to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.

entries.yo: Awọn olododo nke, Oluwa si gbọ́, o si yọ wọn jade ninu iṣẹ́ wọn gbogbo.
entries.en: The righteous cry, and the LORD heareth, and delivereth them out of all their troubles.

entries.yo: Oluwa mbẹ leti ọdọ awọn ti iṣe onirobinujẹ ọkàn; o si gbà iru awọn ti iṣe onirora ọkàn là.
entries.en: The LORD is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit.

entries.yo: Ọ̀pọlọpọ ni ipọnju olododo; ṣugbọn Oluwa gbà a ninu wọn gbogbo.
entries.en: Many are the afflictions of the righteous: but the LORD delivereth him out of them all.

entries.yo: O pa gbogbo egungun rẹ̀ mọ́; kò si ọkan ti o ṣẹ́ ninu wọn.
entries.en: He keepeth all his bones: not one of them is broken.

entries.yo: Ibi ni yio pa enia buburu; ati awọn ti o korira olododo yio jẹbi.
entries.en: Evil shall slay the wicked: and they that hate the righteous shall be desolate.

entries.yo: Oluwa rà ọkàn awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀; ọkan ninu awọn ti o gbẹkẹle e kì yio jẹbi.
entries.en: The LORD redeemeth the soul of his servants: and none of them that trust in him shall be desolate.

entries.yo: OLUWA gbogun tì awọn ti o gbogun tì mi: fi ìja fun awọn ti mba mi jà.
entries.en: Plead my cause, O LORD, with them that strive with me: fight against them that fight against me.

entries.yo: Di asà on apata mu, ki o si dide fun iranlọwọ mi.
entries.en: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for mine help.

entries.yo: Fa ọ̀kọ yọ pẹlu, ki o si dèna awọn ti nṣe inunibini si mi: wi fun ọkàn mi pe, emi ni igbala rẹ.
entries.en: Draw out also the spear, and stop the way against them that persecute me: say unto my soul, I am thy salvation.

entries.yo: Ki nwọn ki o dãmu, ki a si tì awọn ti nwá ọkàn mi loju: ki a si mu wọn pada, ki a si dãmu awọn ti ngbiro ipalara mi.
entries.en: Let them be confounded and put to shame that seek after my soul: let them be turned back and brought to confusion that devise my hurt.

entries.yo: Ki nwọn ki o dabi iyangbo niwaju afẹfẹ: ki angeli Oluwa ki o ma le wọn.
entries.en: Let them be as chaff before the wind: and let the angel of the LORD chase them.

entries.yo: Ki ọ̀na wọn ki o ṣokunkun ki o si ma yọ́; ki angeli Oluwa ki o si ma lepa wọn.
entries.en: Let their way be dark and slippery: and let the angel of the LORD persecute them.

entries.yo: Nitori pe, li ainidi ni nwọn dẹ àwọn wọn silẹ fun mi, nwọn wà iho silẹ fun ọkàn mi li ainidi.
entries.en: For without cause have they hid for me their net in a pit, which without cause they have digged for my soul.

entries.yo: Ki iparun ki o wá si ori rẹ̀ li ojiji; àwọn rẹ̀ ti o dẹ, ki o mu on tikararẹ̀: iparun na ni ki o ṣubu si.
entries.en: Let destruction come upon him at unawares; and let his net that he hath hid catch himself: into that very destruction let him fall.

entries.yo: Ọkàn mi yio si ma yọ̀ niti Oluwa: yio si ma yọ̀ ninu igbala rẹ̀.
entries.en: And my soul shall be joyful in the LORD: it shall rejoice in his salvation.

entries.yo: Gbogbo egungun mi ni yio wipe, Oluwa, tali o dabi iwọ, ti ngbà talaka lọwọ awọn ti o lagbara jù u lọ, ani talaka ati alaini lọwọ ẹniti nfi ṣe ikogun?
entries.en: All my bones shall say, LORD, who is like unto thee, which deliverest the poor from him that is too strong for him, yea, the poor and the needy from him that spoileth him?

entries.yo: Awọn ẹlẹri eke dide; nwọn mbi mi li ohun ti emi kò mọ̀.
entries.en: False witnesses did rise up; they laid to my charge things that I knew not.

entries.yo: Nwọn fi buburu san ore fun mi, lati sọ ọkàn mi di ofo.
entries.en: They rewarded me evil for good to the spoiling of my soul.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi o ṣe ti emi ni, nigbati ara wọn kò dá, aṣọ àwẹ li aṣọ mi: mo fi àwẹ rẹ̀ ọkàn mi silẹ; adura mi si pada si mi li aiya.
entries.en: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth: I humbled my soul with fasting; and my prayer returned into mine own bosom.

entries.yo: Emi ṣe ara mi bi ẹnipe ọrẹ tabi arakunrin mi tilẹ ni: emi fi ibinujẹ tẹriba, bi ẹniti nṣọ̀fọ iya rẹ̀.
entries.en: I behaved myself as though he had been my friend or brother: I bowed down heavily, as one that mourneth for his mother.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ninu ipọnju mi nwọn yọ̀, nwọn si kó ara wọn jọ: awọn enia-kenia kó ara wọn jọ si mi, emi kò si mọ̀; nwọn fa mi ya, nwọn kò si dakẹ.
entries.en: But in mine adversity they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together: yea, the abjects gathered themselves together against me, and I knew it not; they did tear me, and ceased not:

entries.yo: Pẹlu awọn àgabagebe ti iṣe ẹlẹya li apejẹ, nwọn npa ehin wọn si mi.
entries.en: With hypocritical mockers in feasts, they gnashed upon me with their teeth.

entries.yo: Oluwa iwọ o ti ma wò pẹ to? yọ ọkàn mi kuro ninu iparun wọn, ẹni mi kanna lọwọ awọn kiniun.
entries.en: Lord, how long wilt thou look on? rescue my soul from their destructions, my darling from the lions.

entries.yo: Emi o ṣọpẹ fun ọ ninu ajọ nla: emi o ma yìn ọ li awujọ ọ̀pọ enia.
entries.en: I will give thee thanks in the great congregation: I will praise thee among much people.

entries.yo: Máṣe jẹ ki awọn ti nṣe ọta mi lodi ki o yọ̀ mi; bẹ̃ni ki o má si ṣe jẹ ki awọn ti o korira mi li ainidi ki o ma ṣẹju si mi.
entries.en: Let not them that are mine enemies wrongfully rejoice over me: neither let them wink with the eye that hate me without a cause.

entries.yo: Nitori ti nwọn kò sọ̀rọ alafia: ṣugbọn nwọn humọ ọ̀ran ẹ̀tan si awọn enia jẹjẹ ilẹ na.
entries.en: For they speak not peace: but they devise deceitful matters against them that are quiet in the land.

entries.yo: Nitotọ, nwọn ya ẹnu wọn silẹ si mi, nwọn wipe, A! ã! oju wa ti ri i!
entries.en: Yea, they opened their mouth wide against me, and said, Aha, aha, our eye hath seen it.

entries.yo: Eyi ni iwọ ti ri, Oluwa: máṣe dakẹ: Oluwa máṣe jina si mi.
entries.en: This thou hast seen, O LORD: keep not silence: O Lord, be not far from me.

entries.yo: Rú ara rẹ soke, ki o si ji si idajọ mi, ati si ọ̀ran mi, Ọlọrun mi ati Oluwa mi.
entries.en: Stir up thyself, and awake to my judgment, even unto my cause, my God and my Lord.

entries.yo: Ṣe idajọ mi, Oluwa Ọlọrun mi, gẹgẹ bi ododo rẹ, ki o má si ṣe jẹ ki nwọn ki o yọ̀ mi.
entries.en: Judge me, O LORD my God, according to thy righteousness; and let them not rejoice over me.

entries.yo: Máṣe jẹ ki nwọn kí o wi ninu ọkàn wọn pe, A! bẹ̃li awa nfẹ ẹ: máṣe jẹ ki nwọn ki o wipe, Awa ti gbé e mì.
entries.en: Let them not say in their hearts, Ah, so would we have it: let them not say, We have swallowed him up.

entries.yo: Ki oju ki o tì wọn, ki nwọn ki o si dãmu pọ̀, ti nyọ̀ si ifarapa mi: ki a fi itiju ati àbuku wọ̀ wọn ni aṣọ, ti ngberaga si mi.
entries.en: Let them be ashamed and brought to confusion together that rejoice at mine hurt: let them be clothed with shame and dishonour that magnify themselves against me.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki nwọn ki o ma hó fun ayọ̀, ki nwọn ki o si ma ṣe inu-didùn, ti nṣe oju-rere si ododo mi: lõtọ ki nwọn ki o ma wi titi pe, Oluwa ni ki a ma gbega, ti o ni inu-didùn si alafia iranṣẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Let them shout for joy, and be glad, that favour my righteous cause: yea, let them say continually, Let the LORD be magnified, which hath pleasure in the prosperity of his servant.

entries.yo: Ahọn mi yio si ma sọ̀rọ ododo rẹ, ati ti iyìn rẹ ni gbogbo ọjọ.
entries.en: And my tongue shall speak of thy righteousness and of thy praise all the day long.

entries.yo: IREKỌJA enia buburu wi ninu ọkàn mi pe; ẹ̀ru Ọlọrun kò si niwaju rẹ̀.
entries.en: The transgression of the wicked saith within my heart, that there is no fear of God before his eyes.

entries.yo: Nitoriti o npọ́n ara rẹ̀ li oju ara rẹ̀, titi a o fi ri ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ̀ lati korira;
entries.en: For he flattereth himself in his own eyes, until his iniquity be found to be hateful.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ ẹnu rẹ̀ li ẹ̀ṣẹ on ẹ̀tan: o ti fi ọgbọ́n ati iṣe rere silẹ,
entries.en: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit: he hath left off to be wise, and to do good.

entries.yo: O ngbèro ìwa-ika lori ẹni rẹ̀: o gba ọ̀na ti kò dara; on kò korira ibi.
entries.en: He deviseth mischief upon his bed; he setteth himself in a way that is not good; he abhorreth not evil.

entries.yo: Oluwa, ãnu rẹ de ọrun; otitọ rẹ de awọsanma.
entries.en: Thy mercy, O LORD, is in the heavens; and thy faithfulness reacheth unto the clouds.

entries.yo: Ododo rẹ dabi awọn òke Ọlọrun; idajọ rẹ dabi ibu nla: Oluwa, iwọ pa enia ati ẹranko mọ́.
entries.en: Thy righteousness is like the great mountains; thy judgments are a great deep: O LORD, thou preservest man and beast.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun, iṣeun-ifẹ rẹ ti dara to! nitori na li awọn ọmọ enia yio ma gbẹkẹ wọn le abẹ ojiji iyẹ-apa rẹ.
entries.en: How excellent is thy lovingkindness, O God! therefore the children of men put their trust under the shadow of thy wings.

entries.yo: Ororo ile rẹ yio tẹ wọn lọrùn gidigidi; iwọ o si mu wọn mumi ninu odò ifẹ rẹ.
entries.en: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the fatness of thy house; and thou shalt make them drink of the river of thy pleasures.

entries.yo: Nitori pe pẹlu rẹ li orisun ìye wà: ninu imọlẹ rẹ li awa o ma ri imọlẹ.
entries.en: For with thee is the fountain of life: in thy light shall we see light.

entries.yo: Mu iṣeun ifẹ rẹ pẹ si awọn ti o mọ̀ ọ; ati ododo rẹ fun awọn alaiyà diduro.
entries.en: O continue thy lovingkindness unto them that know thee; and thy righteousness to the upright in heart.

entries.yo: Máṣe jẹ ki ẹsẹ agberaga ki o wá si mi, ki o má si jẹ ki ọwọ enia buburu ki o ṣi mi ni ipò.
entries.en: Let not the foot of pride come against me, and let not the hand of the wicked remove me.

entries.yo: Nibẹ li awọn oniṣẹ-ẹ̀ṣẹ gbe ṣubu: a rẹ̀ wọn silẹ, nwọn kì yio si le dide.
entries.en: There are the workers of iniquity fallen: they are cast down, and shall not be able to rise.

entries.yo: MÁṢE ikanra nitori awọn oluṣe-buburu, ki iwọ ki o máṣe ilara nitori awọn oniṣẹ ẹ̀ṣẹ.
entries.en: Fret not thyself because of evildoers, neither be thou envious against the workers of iniquity.

entries.yo: Nitori ti a o ke wọn lulẹ laipẹ bi koriko, nwọn o si rọ bi eweko tutù.
entries.en: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither as the green herb.

entries.yo: Gbẹkẹle Oluwa, ki o si ma ṣe rere; ma gbe ilẹ na, ki o si ma huwa otitọ.
entries.en: Trust in the LORD, and do good; so shalt thou dwell in the land, and verily thou shalt be fed.

entries.yo: Ṣe inu-didùn si Oluwa pẹlu, on o si fi ifẹ inu rẹ̀ fun ọ.
entries.en: Delight thyself also in the LORD; and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart.

entries.yo: Fi ọ̀na rẹ̀ le Oluwa lọwọ; gbẹkẹle e pẹlu; on o si mu u ṣẹ.
entries.en: Commit thy way unto the LORD; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.

entries.yo: Yio si mu ododo rẹ jade bi imọlẹ, ati idajọ rẹ bi ọsángangan.
entries.en: And he shall bring forth thy righteousness as the light, and thy judgment as the noonday.

entries.yo: Iwọ simi ninu Oluwa, ki o si fi sũru duro dè e; máṣe ikanra nitori ẹniti o nri rere li ọ̀na rẹ̀, nitori ọkunrin na ti o nmu èro buburu ṣẹ.
entries.en: Rest in the LORD, and wait patiently for him: fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, because of the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass.

entries.yo: Dakẹ inu-bibi, ki o si kọ̀ ikannu silẹ: máṣe ikanra, ki o má ba ṣe buburu pẹlu.
entries.en: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: fret not thyself in any wise to do evil.

entries.yo: Nitori ti a o ke awọn oluṣe-buburu kuro: ṣugbọn awọn ti o duro de Oluwa ni yio jogun aiye.
entries.en: For evildoers shall be cut off: but those that wait upon the LORD, they shall inherit the earth.

entries.yo: Nitori pe nigba diẹ, awọn enia buburu kì yio si: nitotọ iwọ o fi ara balẹ wò ipò rẹ̀, kì yio si si.
entries.en: For yet a little while, and the wicked shall not be: yea, thou shalt diligently consider his place, and it shall not be.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn ọlọkàn-tutù ni yio jogun aiye; nwọn o si ma ṣe inu didùn ninu ọ̀pọlọpọ alafia.
entries.en: But the meek shall inherit the earth; and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.

entries.yo: Enia buburu di rikiṣi si olõtọ, o si pa ehin rẹ̀ keke si i lara.
entries.en: The wicked plotteth against the just, and gnasheth upon him with his teeth.

entries.yo: Oluwa yio rẹrin rẹ̀; nitori ti o ri pe, ọjọ rẹ̀ mbọ̀.
entries.en: The Lord shall laugh at him: for he seeth that his day is coming.

entries.yo: Awọn enia buburu ti fà idà yọ, nwọn si ti fà ọrun wọn le, lati sọ talaka ati alaini kalẹ, ati lati pa iru awọn ti nrin li ọ̀na titọ.
entries.en: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, and to slay such as be of upright conversation.

entries.yo: Idà wọn yio wọ̀ aiya wọn lọ, ọrun wọn yio si ṣẹ́.
entries.en: Their sword shall enter into their own heart, and their bows shall be broken.

entries.yo: Ohun diẹ ti olododo ni sanju ọrọ̀ ọ̀pọ enia buburu.
entries.en: A little that a righteous man hath is better than the riches of many wicked.

entries.yo: Nitoriti a o ṣẹ́ apa awọn enia buburu: ṣugbọn Oluwa di olododo mu.
entries.en: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken: but the LORD upholdeth the righteous.

entries.yo: Oluwa mọ̀ ọjọ ẹni iduro-ṣinṣin: ati ilẹ-ini wọn yio wà lailai.
entries.en: The LORD knoweth the days of the upright: and their inheritance shall be for ever.

entries.yo: Oju kì yio tì wọn ni igba ibi: ati li ọjọ ìyan a o tẹ́ wọn lọrun.
entries.en: They shall not be ashamed in the evil time: and in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn enia buburu yio ṣegbe, awọn ọta Oluwa yio dabi ẹwà oko-tutu: nwọn o run; ẹ̃fin ni nwọn o run si.
entries.en: But the wicked shall perish, and the enemies of the LORD shall be as the fat of lambs: they shall consume; into smoke shall they consume away.

entries.yo: Awọn enia buburu wín, nwọn kò si pada san: ṣugbọn olododo a ma ṣãnu, a si ma fi funni.
entries.en: The wicked borroweth, and payeth not again: but the righteous sheweth mercy, and giveth.

entries.yo: Nitoriti awọn ẹni-ibukún rẹ̀ ni yio jogun aiye; awọn ẹni-egún rẹ̀ li a o ke kuro.
entries.en: For such as be blessed of him shall inherit the earth; and they that be cursed of him shall be cut off.

entries.yo: A ṣe ìlana ẹsẹ enia lati ọwọ Oluwa wá: o si ṣe inu didùn si ọ̀na rẹ̀.
entries.en: The steps of a good man are ordered by the LORD: and he delighteth in his way.

entries.yo: Bi o tilẹ ṣubu, a kì yio ta a nù kuro patapata; nitoriti Oluwa di ọwọ rẹ̀ mu.
entries.en: Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down: for the LORD upholdeth him with his hand.

entries.yo: Emi ti wà li ewe, emi si dagba; emi kò ti iri ki a kọ̀ olododo silẹ, tabi ki iru-ọmọ rẹ̀ ki o ma ṣagbe onjẹ.
entries.en: I have been young, and now am old; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bread.

entries.yo: Alãnu li on nigbagbogbo, a ma wín ni: a si ma busi i fun iru-ọmọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: He is ever merciful, and lendeth; and his seed is blessed.

entries.yo: Kuro ninu ibi ki o si ma ṣe rere; ki o si ma joko lailai.
entries.en: Depart from evil, and do good; and dwell for evermore.

entries.yo: Nitoriti Oluwa fẹ idajọ, kò si kọ̀ awọn enia mimọ́ rẹ̀ silẹ; a si pa wọn mọ́ lailai: ṣugbọn iru-ọmọ awọn enia buburu li a o ke kuro.
entries.en: For the LORD loveth judgment, and forsaketh not his saints; they are preserved for ever: but the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.

entries.yo: Olododo ni yio jogun aiye, yio si ma gbe inu rẹ̀ lailai.
entries.en: The righteous shall inherit the land, and dwell therein for ever.

entries.yo: Ẹnu olododo ni ima sọ̀rọ ọgbọ́n, ahọn rẹ̀ a si ma sọ̀rọ idajọ.
entries.en: The mouth of the righteous speaketh wisdom, and his tongue talketh of judgment.

entries.yo: Ofin Ọlọrun rẹ̀ mbẹ li aiya rẹ̀; ọkan ninu ìrin rẹ̀ kì yio yẹ̀.
entries.en: The law of his God is in his heart; none of his steps shall slide.

entries.yo: Ẹni buburu nṣọ olododo, o si nwá ọ̀na lati pa a.
entries.en: The wicked watcheth the righteous, and seeketh to slay him.

entries.yo: Oluwa kì yio fi i le e lọwọ, kì yio si da a lẹbi, nigbati a ba nṣe idajọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: The LORD will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.

entries.yo: Duro de Oluwa, ki o si ma pa ọ̀na rẹ̀ mọ́, yio si gbé ọ leke lati jogun aiye: nigbati a ba ké awọn enia buburu kuro, iwọ o ri i.
entries.en: Wait on the LORD, and keep his way, and he shall exalt thee to inherit the land: when the wicked are cut off, thou shalt see it.

entries.yo: Emi ti nri enia buburu, ẹni ìwa-ika, o si fi ara rẹ̀ gbilẹ bi igi tutu nla.
entries.en: I have seen the wicked in great power, and spreading himself like a green bay tree.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn o kọja lọ, si kiyesi i, kò sí mọ: lõtọ emi wá a kiri, ṣugbọn a kò le ri i.
entries.en: Yet he passed away, and, lo, he was not: yea, I sought him, but he could not be found.

entries.yo: Ma kiyesi ẹni pipé, ki o si ma wò ẹni diduro ṣinṣin: nitori alafia li opin ọkunrin na.
entries.en: Mark the perfect man, and behold the upright: for the end of that man is peace.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn alarekọja li a o parun pọ̀; iran awọn enia buburu li a o ké kuro.
entries.en: But the transgressors shall be destroyed together: the end of the wicked shall be cut off.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn lati ọwọ Oluwa wá ni igbala awọn olododo; on li àbo wọn ni igba ipọnju.
entries.en: But the salvation of the righteous is of the LORD: he is their strength in the time of trouble.

entries.yo: Oluwa yio si ràn wọn lọwọ, yio si gbà wọn, yio si gbà wọn lọwọ enia buburu, yio si gbà wọn la, nitoriti nwọn gbẹkẹle e.
entries.en: And the LORD shall help them and deliver them: he shall deliver them from the wicked, and save them, because they trust in him.

entries.yo: OLUWA, máṣe ba mi wi ninu ibinu rẹ: bẹ̃ni ki o máṣe nà mi ni gbigbona ibinujẹ rẹ.
entries.en: O LORD, rebuke me not in thy wrath: neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.

entries.yo: Nitori ti ọfà rẹ kàn mọ́ mi ṣinṣin, ọwọ rẹ si kì mi wọ̀ mọlẹ.
entries.en: For thine arrows stick fast in me, and thy hand presseth me sore.

entries.yo: Kò si ibi yíyè li ara mi nitori ibinu rẹ; bẹ̃ni kò si alafia li egungun mi nitori ẹ̀ṣẹ mi.
entries.en: There is no soundness in my flesh because of thine anger; neither is there any rest in my bones because of my sin.

entries.yo: Nitori ti ẹbi ẹ̀ṣẹ mi bori mi mọlẹ, bi ẹrù wuwo, o wuwo jù fun mi.
entries.en: For mine iniquities are gone over mine head: as an heavy burden they are too heavy for me.

entries.yo: Ọgbẹ mi nrùn, o si dibajẹ nitori were mi.
entries.en: My wounds stink and are corrupt because of my foolishness.

entries.yo: Emi njowere; ori mi tẹ̀ ba gidigidi; emi nṣọ̀fọ kiri li gbogbo ọjọ.
entries.en: I am troubled; I am bowed down greatly; I go mourning all the day long.

entries.yo: Nitoriti iha mi kún fun àrun ẹgbin; kò si si ibi yiyè li ara mi.
entries.en: For my loins are filled with a loathsome disease: and there is no soundness in my flesh.

entries.yo: Ara mi hù, o si kan bajẹ; emi ti nkerora nitori aisimi aiya mi.
entries.en: I am feeble and sore broken: I have roared by reason of the disquietness of my heart.

entries.yo: Oluwa, gbogbo ifẹ mi mbẹ niwaju rẹ; ikerora mi kò si pamọ́ kuro lọdọ rẹ.
entries.en: Lord, all my desire is before thee; and my groaning is not hid from thee.

entries.yo: Aiya mi nmi-hẹlẹ, agbara mi yẹ̀ mi silẹ: bi o ṣe ti imọlẹ oju mi ni, kò si lara mi.
entries.en: My heart panteth, my strength faileth me: as for the light of mine eyes, it also is gone from me.

entries.yo: Awọn olufẹ ati awọn ọrẹ mi duro li òkere kuro ni ìna mi, ati awọn ibatan mi duro li òkere rére.
entries.en: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my sore; and my kinsmen stand afar off.

entries.yo: Awọn pẹlu ti nwá ọkàn mi dẹkùn silẹ fun mi; ati awọn ti nwá ifarapa mi nsọ̀rọ ohun buburu, nwọn si ngbiro ẹ̀tan li gbogbo ọjọ.
entries.en: They also that seek after my life lay snares for me: and they that seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and imagine deceits all the day long.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi, bi aditi, emi kò gbọ́; ati bi odi ti kò ya ẹnu rẹ̀.
entries.en: But I, as a deaf man, heard not; and I was as a dumb man that openeth not his mouth.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni mo dabi ọkunrin ti kò gbọ́ran, ati li ẹnu ẹniti iyàn kò si.
entries.en: Thus I was as a man that heareth not, and in whose mouth are no reproofs.

entries.yo: Nitori, Oluwa, iwọ li emi duro dè, iwọ o gbọ́, Oluwa Ọlọrun mi.
entries.en: For in thee, O LORD, do I hope: thou wilt hear, O Lord my God.

entries.yo: Nitori ti mo wipe, Gbohùn mi, ki nwọn ki o má ba yọ̀ mi; nigbati ẹsẹ mi ba yọ́, nwọn o ma gbé ara wọn ga si mi.
entries.en: For I said, Hear me, lest otherwise they should rejoice over me: when my foot slippeth, they magnify themselves against me.

entries.yo: Emi ti mura ati ṣubu, ikãnu mi si mbẹ nigbagbogbo niwaju mi.
entries.en: For I am ready to halt, and my sorrow is continually before me.

entries.yo: Nitori ti emi o jẹwọ ẹ̀ṣẹ mi; emi o kãnu nitori ẹ̀ṣẹ mi.
entries.en: For I will declare mine iniquity; I will be sorry for my sin.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ara yá awọn ọta mi, ara wọn le; awọn ti o korira mi lodi npọ̀ si i.
entries.en: But mine enemies are lively, and they are strong: and they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied.

entries.yo: Awọn ti o si nfi buburu san rere li ọta mi; nitori emi ntọpa ohun ti iṣe rere.
entries.en: They also that render evil for good are mine adversaries; because I follow the thing that good is.

entries.yo: Oluwa, máṣe kọ̀ mi silẹ; Ọlọrun mi, máṣe jina si mi.
entries.en: Forsake me not, O LORD: O my God, be not far from me.

entries.yo: Yara lati ran mi lọwọ, Oluwa igbala mi.
entries.en: Make haste to help me, O Lord my salvation.

entries.yo: MO ni, emi o ma kiyesi ọ̀na mi, ki emi ki o má fi ahọn mi ṣẹ̀; emi o fi ijanu ko ara mi li ẹnu nigbati enia buburu ba mbẹ niwaju mi.
entries.en: I said, I will take heed to my ways, that I sin not with my tongue: I will keep my mouth with a bridle, while the wicked is before me.

entries.yo: Mo fi idakẹ yadi, mo tilẹ pa ẹnu mi mọ́ kuro li ọ̀rọ rere: ibinujẹ mi si ru soke.
entries.en: I was dumb with silence, I held my peace, even from good; and my sorrow was stirred.

entries.yo: Aiya mi gbona ninu mi, nigbati emi nronu, ina ràn: nigbana ni mo fi ahọn mi sọ̀rọ.
entries.en: My heart was hot within me, while I was musing the fire burned: then spake I with my tongue,

entries.yo: Oluwa, jẹ ki emi ki o mọ̀ opin mi ati ìwọn ọjọ mi, bi o ti ri; ki emi ki o le mọ̀ ìgbà ti mo ni nihin.
entries.en: LORD, make me to know mine end, and the measure of my days, what it is; that I may know how frail I am.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, iwọ ti sọ ọjọ mi dabi ibu atẹlẹwọ; ọjọ ori mi si dabi asan niwaju rẹ: nitõtọ olukuluku enia ninu ijoko rere rẹ̀ asan ni patapata.
entries.en: Behold, thou hast made my days as an handbreadth; and mine age is as nothing before thee: verily every man at his best state is altogether vanity. Selah.

entries.yo: Nitotọ li àworan asan li enia gbogbo nrìn: nitotọ ni nwọn nyọ ara wọn lẹnu li asan: o nkó ọrọ̀ jọ, kò si mọ̀ ẹniti yio kó wọn lọ.
entries.en: Surely every man walketh in a vain shew: surely they are disquieted in vain: he heapeth up riches, and knoweth not who shall gather them.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, Oluwa kini mo duro de? ireti mi mbẹ li ọdọ rẹ.
entries.en: And now, Lord, what wait I for? my hope is in thee.

entries.yo: Gbà mi ninu irekọja mi gbogbo: ki o má si sọ mi di ẹni ẹ̀gan awọn enia buburu.
entries.en: Deliver me from all my transgressions: make me not the reproach of the foolish.

entries.yo: Mo yadi, emi kò ya ẹnu mi; nitoripe iwọ li o ṣe e.
entries.en: I was dumb, I opened not my mouth; because thou didst it.

entries.yo: Mu ọwọ ìna rẹ kuro li ara mi: emi ṣegbe tan nipa ìja ọwọ rẹ.
entries.en: Remove thy stroke away from me: I am consumed by the blow of thine hand.

entries.yo: Nigbati iwọ ba fi ibawi kilọ fun enia nitori ẹ̀ṣẹ, iwọ a ṣe ẹwà rẹ̀ a parun bi kòkoro aṣọ: nitõtọ asan li enia gbogbo.
entries.en: When thou with rebukes dost correct man for iniquity, thou makest his beauty to consume away like a moth: surely every man is vanity. Selah.

entries.yo: Oluwa, gbọ́ adura mi, ki o si fi eti si ẹkún mi, ki o máṣe pa ẹnu rẹ mọ́ si omije mi: nitori alejo li emi lọdọ rẹ, ati atipo, bi gbogbo awọn baba mi ti ri.
entries.en: Hear my prayer, O LORD, and give ear unto my cry; hold not thy peace at my tears: for I am a stranger with thee, and a sojourner, as all my fathers were.

entries.yo: Da mi si, ki emi li agbara, ki emi ki o to lọ kuro nihinyi, ati ki emi ki o to ṣe alaisi.
entries.en: O spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go hence, and be no more.

entries.yo: NI diduro emi duro de Oluwa; o si dẹti si mi, o si gbohun ẹkún mi.
entries.en: I waited patiently for the LORD; and he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.

entries.yo: O si mu mi gòke pẹlu lati inu iho iparun jade wá, lati inu erupẹ ẹrẹ̀, o si fi ẹsẹ mi ka ori apata, o si fi iṣisẹ mi lelẹ.
entries.en: He brought me up also out of an horrible pit, out of the miry clay, and set my feet upon a rock, and established my goings.

entries.yo: O si fi orin titun si mi li ẹnu, ani orin iyìn si Ọlọrun wa: ọ̀pọ enia ni yio ri i, ti yio si bẹ̀ru, ti yio si gbẹkẹle Oluwa.
entries.en: And he hath put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our God: many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in the LORD.

entries.yo: Ibukún ni fun ọkunrin na ti o fi Oluwa ṣe igbẹkẹle rẹ̀, ti kò si ka onirera si, tabi iru awọn ti nyà si iha eke.
entries.en: Blessed is that man that maketh the LORD his trust, and respecteth not the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies.

entries.yo: Oluwa Ọlọrun mi ọ̀pọlọpọ ni iṣẹ iyanu ti iwọ ti nṣe, ati ìro inu rẹ sipa ti wa: a kò le kà wọn fun ọ li ẹsẹ-ẹsẹ: bi emi o wi ti emi o sọ̀rọ wọn, nwọn jù ohun kikà lọ.
entries.en: Many, O LORD my God, are thy wonderful works which thou hast done, and thy thoughts which are to us-ward: they cannot be reckoned up in order unto thee: if I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be numbered.

entries.yo: Ẹbọ ati ọrẹ iwọ kò fẹ: eti mi ni iwọ ti ṣi: ọrẹ-ẹbọ sisun, ati ọrẹ-ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ on ni iwọ kò bère.
entries.en: Sacrifice and offering thou didst not desire; mine ears hast thou opened: burnt offering and sin offering hast thou not required.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni mo wipe, Kiyesi i, emi de: ninu àpo-iwe nì li a gbe kọwe mi pe,
entries.en: Then said I, Lo, I come: in the volume of the book it is written of me,

entries.yo: Inu mi dùn lati ṣe ifẹ rẹ, Ọlọrun mi, nitõtọ, ofin rẹ mbẹ li aiya mi.
entries.en: I delight to do thy will, O my God: yea, thy law is within my heart.

entries.yo: Emi ti wãsu ododo ninu awujọ nla: kiyesi i, emi kò pa ete mi mọ́, Oluwa, iwọ mọ̀.
entries.en: I have preached righteousness in the great congregation: lo, I have not refrained my lips, O LORD, thou knowest.

entries.yo: Emi kò fi ododo rẹ sin li aiya mi, emi o sọ̀rọ otitọ ati igbala rẹ: emi kò si pa iṣeun-ifẹ rẹ ati otitọ rẹ mọ́ kuro lọdọ ijọ nla nì.
entries.en: I have not hid thy righteousness within my heart; I have declared thy faithfulness and thy salvation: I have not concealed thy lovingkindness and thy truth from the great congregation.

entries.yo: Iwọ máṣe fa ãnu rẹ ti o rọnu sẹhin kuro lọdọ mi, Oluwa: ki iṣeun-ifẹ rẹ ati otitọ rẹ ki o ma pa mi mọ́ nigbagbogbo.
entries.en: Withhold not thou thy tender mercies from me, O LORD: let thy lovingkindness and thy truth continually preserve me.

entries.yo: Nitoripe ainiye ibi li o yika kiri: ẹ̀ṣẹ mi dì mọ mi, bẹ̃li emi kò le gbé oju wò oke, nwọn jù irun ori mi lọ: nitorina aiya mi npá mi.
entries.en: For innumerable evils have compassed me about: mine iniquities have taken hold upon me, so that I am not able to look up; they are more than the hairs of mine head: therefore my heart faileth me.

entries.yo: Ki o wù ọ, Oluwa, lati gbà mi: Oluwa, yara lati ràn mi lọwọ,
entries.en: Be pleased, O LORD, to deliver me: O LORD, make haste to help me.

entries.yo: Ki oju ki o tì wọn, ki nwọn ki o si damu pọ̀, awọn ti nwá ọkàn mi lati pa a run; ki a lé wọn pada sẹhin, ki a si dojuti awọn ti nfẹ mi ni ibi.
entries.en: Let them be ashamed and confounded together that seek after my soul to destroy it; let them be driven backward and put to shame that wish me evil.

entries.yo: Ki nwọn ki o di ofo fun ère itiju wọn, awọn ti nwi fun mi pe, A! a!
entries.en: Let them be desolate for a reward of their shame that say unto me, Aha, aha.

entries.yo: Ki gbogbo awọn ti nwá ọ, ki o ma yọ̀, ki inu wọn ki o si ma dùn sipa tirẹ: ki gbogbo awọn ti o si fẹ igbala rẹ ki o ma wi nigbagbogbo pe, Gbigbega li Oluwa.
entries.en: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: let such as love thy salvation say continually, The LORD be magnified.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn talaka ati alaini li emi; Oluwa si nṣe iranti mi; iwọ ni iranlọwọ mi ati olugbala mi: máṣe pẹ titi, Ọlọrun mi.
entries.en: But I am poor and needy; yet the Lord thinketh upon me: thou art my help and my deliverer; make no tarrying, O my God.

entries.yo: IBUKÚN ni fun ẹniti nrò ti awọn alaini, Oluwa yio gbà a ni ìgbà ipọnju.
entries.en: Blessed is he that considereth the poor: the LORD will deliver him in time of trouble.

entries.yo: Oluwa yio pa a mọ́, yio si mu u wà lãye; a o si bukún fun u lori ilẹ: iwọ kì yio si fi i le ifẹ awọn ọta rẹ̀ lọwọ.
entries.en: The LORD will preserve him, and keep him alive; and he shall be blessed upon the earth: and thou wilt not deliver him unto the will of his enemies.

entries.yo: Oluwa yio gbà a ni iyanju lori ẹní àrun: iwọ o tẹ ẹní rẹ̀ gbogbo ni ibulẹ arun rẹ̀.
entries.en: The LORD will strengthen him upon the bed of languishing: thou wilt make all his bed in his sickness.

entries.yo: Emi wipe, Oluwa ṣãnu fun mi: mu ọkàn mi lara da; nitori ti mo ti ṣẹ̀ si ọ.
entries.en: I said, LORD, be merciful unto me: heal my soul; for I have sinned against thee.

entries.yo: Awọn ọta mi nsọ ibi si mi pe, nigbawo ni on o kú, ti orukọ rẹ̀ yio si run?
entries.en: Mine enemies speak evil of me, When shall he die, and his name perish?

entries.yo: Bi o ba si wá wò mi, on a ma sọ̀rọ ẹ̀tan: aiya rẹ̀ kó ẹ̀ṣẹ jọ si ara rẹ̀; nigbati o ba jade lọ, a ma wi i.
entries.en: And if he come to see me, he speaketh vanity: his heart gathereth iniquity to itself; when he goeth abroad, he telleth it.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn ti o korira mi jumọ nsọ̀rọ kẹlẹ́ si mi: emi ni nwọn ngbìmọ ibi si.
entries.en: All that hate me whisper together against me: against me do they devise my hurt.

entries.yo: Pe, ohun buburu li o dì mọ ọ ṣinṣin: ati ibiti o dubulẹ si, kì yio dide mọ.
entries.en: An evil disease, say they, cleaveth fast unto him: and now that he lieth he shall rise up no more.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ ọrẹ-iyọrẹ ara mi, ẹniti mo gbẹkẹle, ẹniti njẹ ninu onjẹ mi, o gbe gigisẹ rẹ̀ si mi.
entries.en: Yea, mine own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, which did eat of my bread, hath lifted up his heel against me.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn iwọ, Oluwa, ṣãnu fun mi, ki o si gbé mi dide, ki emi ki o le san a fun wọn.
entries.en: But thou, O LORD, be merciful unto me, and raise me up, that I may requite them.

entries.yo: Nipa eyi ni mo mọ̀ pe iwọ ṣe oju-rere si mi, nitoriti awọn ọta mi kò yọ̀ mi.
entries.en: By this I know that thou favourest me, because mine enemy doth not triumph over me.

entries.yo: Bi o ṣe ti emi ni, iwọ dì mi mu ninu ìwatitọ mi, iwọ si gbé mi kalẹ niwaju rẹ titi lai.
entries.en: And as for me, thou upholdest me in mine integrity, and settest me before thy face for ever.

entries.yo: Olubukún ni Oluwa, Ọlọrun Israeli, lailai titi lai. Amin, Amin.
entries.en: Blessed be the LORD God of Israel from everlasting, and to everlasting. Amen, and Amen.

entries.yo: BI agbọnrin iti ma mi hẹlẹ si ipadò omi, Ọlọrun, bẹ̃li ọkàn mi nmi hẹlẹ si ọ.
entries.en: As the hart panteth after the water brooks, so panteth my soul after thee, O God.

entries.yo: Ongbẹ Ọlọrun ngbẹ ọkàn mi, ti Ọlọrun alãye: nigbawo li emi o wá, ti emi o si yọju niwaju Ọlọrun.
entries.en: My soul thirsteth for God, for the living God: when shall I come and appear before God?

entries.yo: Omije mi li onjẹ mi li ọsan ati li oru, nigbati nwọn nwi fun mi nigbagbogbo pe, Ọlọrun rẹ dà?
entries.en: My tears have been my meat day and night, while they continually say unto me, Where is thy God?

entries.yo: Nigbati mo ba ranti nkan wọnyi, emi tú ọkàn mi jade ninu mi: emi ti ba ọ̀pọ ijọ enia lọ, emi ba wọn lọ si ile Ọlọrun, pẹlu ohùn ayọ̀ on iyìn, pẹlu ọ̀pọ enia ti npa ọjọ mimọ́ mọ́.
entries.en: When I remember these things, I pour out my soul in me: for I had gone with the multitude, I went with them to the house of God, with the voice of joy and praise, with a multitude that kept holyday.

entries.yo: Ẽṣe ti ori rẹ fi tẹ̀ba, iwọ ọkàn mi? ẽṣe ti ara rẹ kò fi lelẹ ninu mi? iwọ ṣe ireti niti Ọlọrun: nitori emi o sa ma yìn i sibẹ fun iranlọwọ oju rẹ̀.
entries.en: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted in me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him for the help of his countenance.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun mi, ori ọkàn mi tẹ̀ ba ninu mi: nitorina li emi o ṣe ranti rẹ lati ilẹ Jordani wá, ati lati Hermoni, lati òke Misari wá.
entries.en: O my God, my soul is cast down within me: therefore will I remember thee from the land of Jordan, and of the Hermonites, from the hill Mizar.

entries.yo: Ibu omi npè ibu omi nipa hihó ṣiṣan-omi rẹ: gbogbo riru omi ati bibì omi rẹ bò mi mọlẹ.
entries.en: Deep calleth unto deep at the noise of thy waterspouts: all thy waves and thy billows are gone over me.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Oluwa yio paṣẹ iṣeun-ifẹ rẹ̀ nigba ọ̀san, ati li oru orin rẹ̀ yio wà pẹlu mi, ati adura mi si Ọlọrun ẹmi mi.
entries.en: Yet the LORD will command his lovingkindness in the daytime, and in the night his song shall be with me, and my prayer unto the God of my life.

entries.yo: Emi o wi fun Ọlọrun, apata mi pe, Ẽṣe ti iwọ fi gbagbe mi? ẽṣe ti emi fi nrìn ni ìgbawẹ nitori inilara ọta nì.
entries.en: I will say unto God my rock, Why hast thou forgotten me? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

entries.yo: Bi ẹnipe idà ninu egungun mi li ẹ̀gan ti awọn ọta mi ngàn mi; nigbati nwọn nwi fun mi lojojumọ pe, Ọlọrun rẹ dà?
entries.en: As with a sword in my bones, mine enemies reproach me; while they say daily unto me, Where is thy God?

entries.yo: Ẽṣe ti ori rẹ fi tẹ̀ba, iwọ ọkàn mi? ẽṣe ti ara rẹ kò fi lelẹ ninu mi? iwọ ṣe ireti niti Ọlọrun; nitori emi o sa ma yìn i sibẹ, ẹniti iṣe iranlọwọ oju mi ati Ọlọrun mi.
entries.en: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.

entries.yo: ṢE idajọ mi, Ọlọrun, ki o si gbà ọ̀ran mi rò si alailãnu orilẹ-ède: gbà mi lọwọ ẹlẹtan ati ọkunrin alaiṣõtọ nì.
entries.en: Judge me, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation: O deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man.

entries.yo: Nitori iwọ li Ọlọrun agbara mi: ẽṣe ti iwọ fi ṣa mi tì? ẽṣe ti emi fi nrìn ni igbawẹ nitori inilara ọta nì.
entries.en: For thou art the God of my strength: why dost thou cast me off? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

entries.yo: Rán imọlẹ rẹ ati otitọ rẹ jade, ki nwọn ki o ma ṣe amọna mi: ki nwọn ki o mu mi gùn òke mimọ́ rẹ, ati sinu agọ rẹ wọnni.
entries.en: O send out thy light and thy truth: let them lead me; let them bring me unto thy holy hill, and to thy tabernacles.

entries.yo: Nigbana li emi o lọ si ibi pẹpẹ Ọlọrun, sọdọ Ọlọrun ayọ̀ nla mi: nitõtọ, lara duru li emi o ma yìn ọ, Ọlọrun, Ọlọrun mi.
entries.en: Then will I go unto the altar of God, unto God my exceeding joy: yea, upon the harp will I praise thee, O God my God.

entries.yo: Ẽṣe ti ori rẹ fi tẹ̀ba, iwọ ọkàn mi? ẽṣe ti ara rẹ kò fi lelẹ ninu mi? iwọ ṣe ireti niti Ọlọrun: nitoriti emi o sa ma yìn i sibẹ, ẹniti iṣe iranlọwọ oju mi, ati Ọlọrun mi.
entries.en: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.

entries.yo: ỌLỌRUN, awa ti fi eti wa gbọ́, awọn baba wa si ti sọ fun wa ni iṣẹ́ nla ti iwọ ṣe li ọjọ wọn, ni igbà àtijọ́.
entries.en: We have heard with our ears, O God, our fathers have told us, what work thou didst in their days, in the times of old.

entries.yo: Bi iwọ ti fi ọwọ rẹ lé awọn keferi jade, ti iwọ si gbin wọn: bi iwọ ti fõró awọn enia na, ti iwọ si mu wọn gbilẹ.
entries.en: How thou didst drive out the heathen with thy hand, and plantedst them; how thou didst afflict the people, and cast them out.

entries.yo: Nitoriti nwọn kò ni ilẹ na nipa idà ara wọn, bẹ̃ni kì iṣe apá wọn li o gbà wọn; bikoṣe ọwọ ọtún rẹ ati apá rẹ, ati imọlẹ oju rẹ, nitoriti iwọ ni ifẹ rere si wọn.
entries.en: For they got not the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them: but thy right hand, and thine arm, and the light of thy countenance, because thou hadst a favour unto them.

entries.yo: Iwọ li Ọba mi, Ọlọrun: paṣẹ igbala fun Jakobu.
entries.en: Thou art my King, O God: command deliverances for Jacob.

entries.yo: Nipasẹ̀ rẹ li awa o bì awọn ọta wa ṣubu: nipasẹ orukọ rẹ li awa o tẹ̀ awọn ti o dide si wa mọlẹ.
entries.en: Through thee will we push down our enemies: through thy name will we tread them under that rise up against us.

entries.yo: Nitoriti emi kì yio gbẹkẹle ọrun mi, bẹ̃ni idà mi kì yio gbà mi.
entries.en: For I will not trust in my bow, neither shall my sword save me.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn iwọ li o ti gbà wa lọwọ awọn ọta wa, iwọ si ti dojutì awọn ti o korira wa.
entries.en: But thou hast saved us from our enemies, and hast put them to shame that hated us.

entries.yo: Niti Ọlọrun li awa nkọrin iyìn li ọjọ gbogbo, awa si nyìn orukọ rẹ lailai.
entries.en: In God we boast all the day long, and praise thy name for ever. Selah.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn iwọ ti ṣa wa tì, iwọ si ti dojutì wa: iwọ kò si ba ogun wa jade lọ.
entries.en: But thou hast cast off, and put us to shame; and goest not forth with our armies.

entries.yo: Iwọ mu wa pẹhinda fun ọta wa: ati awọn ti o korira wa nṣe ikogun fun ara wọn.
entries.en: Thou makest us to turn back from the enemy: and they which hate us spoil for themselves.

entries.yo: Iwọ ti fi wa fun jijẹ bi ẹran agutan; iwọ si ti tú wa ka ninu awọn keferi.
entries.en: Thou hast given us like sheep appointed for meat; and hast scattered us among the heathen.

entries.yo: Iwọ ti tà awọn enia rẹ li asan, iwọ kò si fi iye-owo wọn sọ ọrọ̀ rẹ di pupọ.
entries.en: Thou sellest thy people for nought, and dost not increase thy wealth by their price.

entries.yo: Iwọ sọ wa di ẹ̀gan si awọn aladugbo wa, ẹlẹya ati iyọṣutì-si, si awọn ti o yi ni ka.
