entries.en: Thou makest us a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and a derision to them that are round about us.

entries.yo: Iwọ sọ wa di ẹni-owe ninu awọn orilẹ-ède, ati imirisi ninu awọn enia.
entries.en: Thou makest us a byword among the heathen, a shaking of the head among the people.

entries.yo: Idamu mi mbẹ niwaju mi nigbagbogbo, itiju mi si bò mi mọlẹ.
entries.en: My confusion is continually before me, and the shame of my face hath covered me,

entries.yo: Nitori ohùn ẹniti ngàn, ti o si nsọ̀rọ buburu; nitori ipa ti ọta olugbẹsan nì.
entries.en: For the voice of him that reproacheth and blasphemeth; by reason of the enemy and avenger.

entries.yo: Gbogbo wọnyi li o de si wa; ṣugbọn awa kò gbagbe rẹ, bẹ̃li awa kò ṣe eke si majẹmu rẹ.
entries.en: All this is come upon us; yet have we not forgotten thee, neither have we dealt falsely in thy covenant.

entries.yo: Aiya wa kò pada sẹhin, bẹ̃ni ìrin wa kò yà kuro ni ipa tirẹ;
entries.en: Our heart is not turned back, neither have our steps declined from thy way;

entries.yo: Bi iwọ tilẹ ti fọ́ wa bajẹ ni ibi awọn ikõkò, ti iwọ si fi ojiji ikú bò wa mọlẹ.
entries.en: Though thou hast sore broken us in the place of dragons, and covered us with the shadow of death.

entries.yo: Bi o ba ṣepe awa gbagbe orukọ Ọlọrun wa, tabi bi awa ba nà ọwọ wa si ọlọrun ajeji;
entries.en: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or stretched out our hands to a strange god;

entries.yo: Njẹ Ọlọrun ki yio ri idi rẹ̀? nitori o mọ̀ ohun ìkọkọ aiya.
entries.en: Shall not God search this out? for he knoweth the secrets of the heart.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ, nitori rẹ li a ṣe npa wa kú ni gbogbo ọjọ; a nkà wa si bi agutan fun pipa.
entries.en: Yea, for thy sake are we killed all the day long; we are counted as sheep for the slaughter.

entries.yo: Ji! ẽṣe ti iwọ nsùn, Oluwa? dide, máṣe ṣa wa tì kuro lailai.
entries.en: Awake, why sleepest thou, O Lord? arise, cast us not off for ever.

entries.yo: Ẽṣe ti iwọ fi pa oju rẹ mọ́, ti iwọ si fi gbagbe ipọnju wa ati inira wa?
entries.en: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, and forgettest our affliction and our oppression?

entries.yo: Nitoriti a tẹri ọkàn wa ba sinu ekuru: inu wa dì mọ erupẹ ilẹ.
entries.en: For our soul is bowed down to the dust: our belly cleaveth unto the earth.

entries.yo: Dide fun iranlọwọ wa, ki o si rà wa pada nitori ãnu rẹ.
entries.en: Arise for our help, and redeem us for thy mercies' sake.

entries.yo: AIYA mi nhumọ̀ ọ̀ran rere: emi nsọ ohun ti mo ti ṣe, fun ọba ni: kalamu ayawọ akọwe li ahọn mi.
entries.en: My heart is inditing a good matter: I speak of the things which I have made touching the king: my tongue is the pen of a ready writer.

entries.yo: Iwọ yanju jù awọn ọmọ enia lọ: a dà ore-ọfẹ si ọ li ète: nitorina li Ọlọrun nbukún fun ọ lailai.
entries.en: Thou art fairer than the children of men: grace is poured into thy lips: therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.

entries.yo: San idà rẹ mọ idi rẹ, Alagbara julọ, ani ogo rẹ ati ọlá-nla rẹ.
entries.en: Gird thy sword upon thy thigh, O most mighty, with thy glory and thy majesty.

entries.yo: Ati ninu ọlánlá rẹ ma gẹṣin lọ li alafia, nitori otitọ ati ìwa-tutu ati ododo; ọwọ ọtún rẹ yio si kọ́ ọ li ohun ẹ̀ru.
entries.en: And in thy majesty ride prosperously because of truth and meekness and righteousness; and thy right hand shall teach thee terrible things.

entries.yo: Ọfa rẹ mu li aiya awọn ọta ọba; awọn enia nṣubu nisalẹ ẹsẹ rẹ.
entries.en: Thine arrows are sharp in the heart of the king's enemies; whereby the people fall under thee.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun, lai ati lailai ni itẹ́ rẹ: ọpá-alade ijọba rẹ, ọpá-alade otitọ ni.
entries.en: Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever: the sceptre of thy kingdom is a right sceptre.

entries.yo: Iwọ fẹ ododo, iwọ korira ìwa-buburu: nitori na li Ọlọrun, Ọlọrun rẹ, ṣe fi àmi ororo ayọ̀ yà ọ ṣolori awọn ọ̀gba rẹ.
entries.en: Thou lovest righteousness, and hatest wickedness: therefore God, thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.

entries.yo: Gbogbo aṣọ rẹ li o nrun turari, ati aloe, ati kassia, lati inu ãfin ehin-erin jade ni nwọn gbe nmu ọ yọ̀.
entries.en: All thy garments smell of myrrh, and aloes, and cassia, out of the ivory palaces, whereby they have made thee glad.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọbinrin awọn alade wà ninu awọn ayanfẹ rẹ: li ọwọ ọtún rẹ li ayaba na gbe duro ninu wura Ofiri.
entries.en: Kings' daughters were among thy honourable women: upon thy right hand did stand the queen in gold of Ophir.

entries.yo: Dẹti silẹ, ọmọbinrin, si ronu, si dẹ eti rẹ silẹ! gbagbe awọn enia rẹ, ati ile baba rẹ!
entries.en: Hearken, O daughter, and consider, and incline thine ear; forget also thine own people, and thy father's house;

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li Ọba yio fẹ ẹwà rẹ gidigidi: nitori on li Oluwa rẹ; ki iwọ ki o si ma sìn i.
entries.en: So shall the king greatly desire thy beauty: for he is thy Lord; and worship thou him.

entries.yo: Ọmọbinrin Tire ti on ti ọrẹ; ati awọn ọlọrọ̀ ninu awọn enia yio ma bẹ̀bẹ oju-rere rẹ.
entries.en: And the daughter of Tyre shall be there with a gift; even the rich among the people shall intreat thy favour.

entries.yo: Ti ogo ti ogo li ọmọbinrin ọba na ninu ile: iṣẹ wura ọnà abẹrẹ li aṣọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: The king's daughter is all glorious within: her clothing is of wrought gold.

entries.yo: Ninu aṣọ iṣẹ ọnà abẹrẹ li a o mu u tọ̀ ọba wá: awọn wundia, ẹgbẹ rẹ̀ ti ntọ̀ ọ lẹhin li a o mu tọ̀ ọ wá.
entries.en: She shall be brought unto the king in raiment of needlework: the virgins her companions that follow her shall be brought unto thee.

entries.yo: Pẹlu inu didùn ati pẹlu ayọ̀ li a o fi mu wọn wá: nwọn o si wọ̀ ãfin ọba lọ.
entries.en: With gladness and rejoicing shall they be brought: they shall enter into the king's palace.

entries.yo: Nipò awọn baba rẹ li awọn ọmọ rẹ yio wà, ẹniti iwọ o ma fi jẹ oye lori ilẹ gbogbo.
entries.en: Instead of thy fathers shall be thy children, whom thou mayest make princes in all the earth.

entries.yo: Emi o ma ṣe orukọ rẹ ni iranti ni iran gbogbo: nitorina li awọn enia yio ṣe ma yìn ọ lai ati lailai.
entries.en: I will make thy name to be remembered in all generations: therefore shall the people praise thee for ever and ever.

entries.yo: ỌLỌRUN li àbo wa ati agbara, lọwọlọwọ iranlọwọ ni igba ipọnju.
entries.en: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

entries.yo: Nitorina li awa kì yio bẹ̀ru, bi a tilẹ ṣi aiye ni idi, ti a si ṣi awọn oke nla nipò lọ si inu okun:
entries.en: Therefore will not we fear, though the earth be removed, and though the mountains be carried into the midst of the sea;

entries.yo: Bi omi rẹ̀ tilẹ nho ti o si nru, bi awọn òke nla tilẹ nmì nipa ọwọ bibì rẹ̀.
entries.en: Though the waters thereof roar and be troubled, though the mountains shake with the swelling thereof. Selah.

entries.yo: Odò nla kan wà, ṣiṣan eyiti yio mu inu ilu Ọlọrun dùn, ibi mimọ́ agọ wọnni ti Ọga-ogo.
entries.en: There is a river, the streams whereof shall make glad the city of God, the holy place of the tabernacles of the most High.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun mbẹ li arin rẹ̀; a kì yio ṣi i ni idi: Ọlọrun yio ràn a lọwọ ni kutukutu owurọ.
entries.en: God is in the midst of her; she shall not be moved: God shall help her, and that right early.

entries.yo: Awọn keferi nbinu, awọn ilẹ ọba ṣidi: o fọhun rẹ̀, aiye yọ́.
entries.en: The heathen raged, the kingdoms were moved: he uttered his voice, the earth melted.

entries.yo: Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wà pẹlu wa; Ọlọrun Jakobu li àbo wa.
entries.en: The LORD of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.

entries.yo: Ẹ wá wò awọn iṣẹ Oluwa, iru ahoro ti o ṣe ni aiye.
entries.en: Come, behold the works of the LORD, what desolations he hath made in the earth.

entries.yo: O mu ọ̀tẹ tan de opin aiye; o ṣẹ́ ọrun, o si ke ọ̀kọ meji; o si fi kẹkẹ́ ogun jona.
entries.en: He maketh wars to cease unto the end of the earth; he breaketh the bow, and cutteth the spear in sunder; he burneth the chariot in the fire.

entries.yo: Ẹ duro jẹ, ki ẹ si mọ̀ pe emi li Ọlọrun, a o gbé mi ga ninu awọn keferi, a o gbé mi ga li aiye.
entries.en: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.

entries.yo: Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wà pẹlu wa; Ọlọrun Jakobu li àbo wa.
entries.en: The LORD of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.

entries.yo: ẸNYIN enia, gbogbo ẹ ṣapẹ; ẹ fi ohùn ayọ̀ hó ihó iṣẹgun si Ọlọrun.
entries.en: O clap your hands, all ye people; shout unto God with the voice of triumph.

entries.yo: Nitori Oluwa Ọga-ogo li ẹ̀ru; on li ọba nla lori ilẹ-aiye gbogbo.
entries.en: For the LORD most high is terrible; he is a great King over all the earth.

entries.yo: On ni yio ṣẹ́ awọn enia labẹ wa, ati awọn orilẹ-ède li atẹlẹsẹ wa.
entries.en: He shall subdue the people under us, and the nations under our feet.

entries.yo: On ni yio yàn ilẹ-ini wa fun wa, ọlá Jakobu, ẹniti o fẹ.
entries.en: He shall choose our inheritance for us, the excellency of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun gòke lọ ti on ti ariwo, Oluwa, ti on ti iró ipè.
entries.en: God is gone up with a shout, the LORD with the sound of a trumpet.

entries.yo: Ẹ kọrin iyìn si Ọlọrun, ẹ kọrin iyìn: ẹ kọrin iyìn si Ọba wa, ẹ kọrin iyìn.
entries.en: Sing praises to God, sing praises: sing praises unto our King, sing praises.

entries.yo: Nitori Ọlọrun li Ọba gbogbo aiye: ẹ fi oye kọrin iyìn.
entries.en: For God is the King of all the earth: sing ye praises with understanding.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun jọba awọn keferi: Ọlọrun joko lori itẹ ìwa-mimọ́ rẹ̀.
entries.en: God reigneth over the heathen: God sitteth upon the throne of his holiness.

entries.yo: Awọn alade awọn enia kó ara wọn jọ, ani awọn enia Ọlọrun Abrahamu: nitori asà aiye ti Ọlọrun ni: on li a gbe leke jọjọ.
entries.en: The princes of the people are gathered together, even the people of the God of Abraham: for the shields of the earth belong unto God: he is greatly exalted.

entries.yo: ẸNI-NLA ni Oluwa, ti ã yìn pupọpupọ, ni ilu Ọlọrun wa, li oke ìwa-mimọ́ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised in the city of our God, in the mountain of his holiness.

entries.yo: Didara ni ipò itẹdo, ayọ̀ gbogbo aiye li òke Sioni, ni iha ariwa, ilu Ọba nla.
entries.en: Beautiful for situation, the joy of the whole earth, is mount Zion, on the sides of the north, the city of the great King.

entries.yo: A mọ̀ Ọlọrun li àbo ninu ãfin rẹ̀.
entries.en: God is known in her palaces for a refuge.

entries.yo: Sa wò o, awọn ọba pejọ pọ̀, nwọn jumọ nkọja lọ.
entries.en: For, lo, the kings were assembled, they passed by together.

entries.yo: Nwọn ri i, bẹ̃li ẹnu yà wọn; a yọ wọn lẹnu, nwọn yara lọ.
entries.en: They saw it, and so they marvelled; they were troubled, and hasted away.

entries.yo: Ẹ̀ru bà wọn nibẹ, ati irora bi obinrin ti nrọbi.
entries.en: Fear took hold upon them there, and pain, as of a woman in travail.

entries.yo: Iwọ fi ẹfufu ila-õrun fọ́ ọkọ Tarṣiṣi.
entries.en: Thou breakest the ships of Tarshish with an east wind.

entries.yo: Bi awa ti gbọ́, bẹ̃li awa ri ni ilu Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun, ni ilu Ọlọrun wa: Ọlọrun yio gbé e kalẹ lailai.
entries.en: As we have heard, so have we seen in the city of the LORD of hosts, in the city of our God: God will establish it for ever. Selah.

entries.yo: Awa ti nrò ti iṣeun-ifẹ rẹ, Ọlọrun, li arin tempili rẹ.
entries.en: We have thought of thy lovingkindness, O God, in the midst of thy temple.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun, gẹgẹ bi orukọ rẹ, bẹ̃ni iyìn rẹ de opin aiye: ọwọ ọtún rẹ kún fun ododo.
entries.en: According to thy name, O God, so is thy praise unto the ends of the earth: thy right hand is full of righteousness.

entries.yo: Ki òke Sioni ki o yọ̀, ki inu awọn ọmọbinrin Juda ki o dùn, nitori idajọ rẹ.
entries.en: Let mount Zion rejoice, let the daughters of Judah be glad, because of thy judgments.

entries.yo: Rìn Sioni kiri, ki o si yi i ka: kà ile-iṣọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Walk about Zion, and go round about her: tell the towers thereof.

entries.yo: Kiyesi odi rẹ̀, kiyesi ãfin rẹ̀ wọnni; ki ẹnyin le ma wi fun iran atẹle nyin.
entries.en: Mark ye well her bulwarks, consider her palaces; that ye may tell it to the generation following.

entries.yo: Nitori Ọlọrun yi Ọlọrun wa ni lai ati lailai: on ni yio ma ṣe amọna wa titi ikú.
entries.en: For this God is our God for ever and ever: he will be our guide even unto death.

entries.yo: ẸGBỌ́ eyi, gbogbo enia; ẹ fi eti si i, gbogbo ẹnyin araiye:
entries.en: Hear this, all ye people; give ear, all ye inhabitants of the world:

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ-ẹhin ati awọn ẹni-ọlá, awọn ọlọrọ̀ ati awọn talaka pẹlu.
entries.en: Both low and high, rich and poor, together.

entries.yo: Ẹnu mi yio sọ̀rọ ọgbọ́n, ati iṣaro aiya mi yio jẹ oye.
entries.en: My mouth shall speak of wisdom; and the meditation of my heart shall be of understanding.

entries.yo: Emi o dẹ eti mi silẹ si owe: emi o ṣi ọ̀rọ ìkọkọ mi silẹ loju okùn dùru.
entries.en: I will incline mine ear to a parable: I will open my dark saying upon the harp.

entries.yo: Ẽṣe ti emi o fi bẹ̀ru li ọjọ ibi, nigbati ẹ̀ṣẹ awọn ajinilẹsẹ mi yi mi ka.
entries.en: Wherefore should I fear in the days of evil, when the iniquity of my heels shall compass me about?

entries.yo: Awọn ti o gbẹkẹle ọrọ̀ wọn, ti nwọn si nṣe ileri li ọ̀pọlọpọ ọrọ̀ wọn;
entries.en: They that trust in their wealth, and boast themselves in the multitude of their riches;

entries.yo: Kò si ẹnikan, bi o ti wù ki o ṣe, ti o le rà arakunrin rẹ̀, bẹ̃ni kò le san owo-irapada fun Ọlọrun nitori rẹ̀.
entries.en: None of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give to God a ransom for him:

entries.yo: Nitori irapada ọkàn wọn iyebiye ni, o si dẹkun lailai:
entries.en: (For the redemption of their soul is precious, and it ceaseth for ever:)

entries.yo: Nipe ki o fi mã wà lailai, ki o má ṣe ri isa-okú.
entries.en: That he should still live for ever, and not see corruption.

entries.yo: Nitori o nri pe awọn ọlọgbọ́n nkú, bẹ̃li aṣiwere ati ẹranko enia nṣegbe, nwọn si nfi ọrọ̀ wọn silẹ fun ẹlomiran.
entries.en: For he seeth that wise men die, likewise the fool and the brutish person perish, and leave their wealth to others.

entries.yo: Ìro inu wọn ni, ki ile wọn ki o pẹ titi lai, ati ibujoko wọn lati irandiran; nwọn sọ ilẹ wọn ní orukọ ara wọn.
entries.en: Their inward thought is, that their houses shall continue for ever, and their dwelling places to all generations; they call their lands after their own names.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn enia ti o wà ninu ọlá kò duro pẹ: o dabi ẹranko ti o ṣegbé.
entries.en: Nevertheless man being in honour abideth not: he is like the beasts that perish.

entries.yo: Ipa ọ̀na wọn yi ni igbẹkẹle wọn: ọ̀rọ wọn si tọ́ li oju awọn ọmọ wọn.
entries.en: This their way is their folly: yet their posterity approve their sayings. Selah.

entries.yo: Bi agutan li a ntẹ wọn si isa-okú: ikú yio jẹun lara wọn; ẹni diduro-ṣinṣin ni yio jọba wọn li owurọ; ẹwà wọn yio si rẹ̀ kuro, isa-okú si ni ibugbe wọn.
entries.en: Like sheep they are laid in the grave; death shall feed on them; and the upright shall have dominion over them in the morning; and their beauty shall consume in the grave from their dwelling.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Ọlọrun ni yio rà ọkàn mi lọwọ isa-okú: nitoripe on o gbà mi.
entries.en: But God will redeem my soul from the power of the grave: for he shall receive me. Selah.

entries.yo: Iwọ máṣe bẹ̀ru, nitori ẹnikan di ọlọrọ̀, nitori iyìn ile rẹ̀ npọ̀ si i.
entries.en: Be not thou afraid when one is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased;

entries.yo: Nitoripe, igbati o ba kú, kì yio kó ohun kan lọ: ogo rẹ̀ kì yio sọkalẹ tọ̀ ọ lẹhin lọ.
entries.en: For when he dieth he shall carry nothing away: his glory shall not descend after him.

entries.yo: Nigbati o wà lãye bi o tilẹ nsure fun ọkàn ara rẹ̀: ti awọn enia nyìn ọ, nigbati iwọ nṣe rere fun ara rẹ.
entries.en: Though while he lived he blessed his soul: and men will praise thee, when thou doest well to thyself.

entries.yo: Ọkàn yio lọ si ọdọ iran awọn baba rẹ̀; nwọn kì yio ri imọlẹ lailai.
entries.en: He shall go to the generation of his fathers; they shall never see light.

entries.yo: Ọkunrin ti o wà ninu ọlá, ti kò moye, o dabi ẹranko ti o ṣegbe.
entries.en: Man that is in honour, and understandeth not, is like the beasts that perish.

entries.yo: ỌLỌRUN Olodumare, ani Oluwa li o ti sọ̀rọ, o si pè aiye lati ìla-õrun wá titi o fi de ìwọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: The mighty God, even the LORD, hath spoken, and called the earth from the rising of the sun unto the going down thereof.

entries.yo: Lati Sioni wá, pipé ẹwà, Ọlọrun ti tan imọlẹ.
entries.en: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God hath shined.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun wa mbọ̀, kì yio si dakẹ; iná yio ma jó niwaju rẹ̀, ẹfufu lile yio si ma ja yi i ka kiri.
entries.en: Our God shall come, and shall not keep silence: a fire shall devour before him, and it shall be very tempestuous round about him.

entries.yo: Yio si kọ si awọn ọrun lati òke wá, ati si aiye, ki o le ma ṣe idajọ awọn enia rẹ̀.
entries.en: He shall call to the heavens from above, and to the earth, that he may judge his people.

entries.yo: Kó awọn enia mimọ́ mi jọ pọ̀ si ọdọ mi: awọn ti o fi ẹbọ ba mi da majẹmu.
entries.en: Gather my saints together unto me; those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.

entries.yo: Awọn ọrun yio si sọ̀rọ ododo rẹ̀: nitori Ọlọrun tikararẹ̀ li onidajọ.
entries.en: And the heavens shall declare his righteousness: for God is judge himself. Selah.

entries.yo: Ẹ gbọ́, ẹnyin enia mi, emi o si sọ̀rọ; Israeli, emi o si jẹri si ọ: emi li Ọlọrun, ani Ọlọrun rẹ.
entries.en: Hear, O my people, and I will speak; O Israel, and I will testify against thee: I am God, even thy God.

entries.yo: Emi kì yio ba ọ wi nitori ẹbọ rẹ, ọrẹ-ẹbọ sisun rẹ wà niwaju mi nigbagbogbo.
entries.en: I will not reprove thee for thy sacrifices or thy burnt offerings, to have been continually before me.

entries.yo: Emi kì yio mu akọ-malu lati ile rẹ jade, tabi obukọ ninu agbo-ẹran rẹ:
entries.en: I will take no bullock out of thy house, nor he goats out of thy folds.

entries.yo: Nitori gbogbo ẹran igbo ni ti emi, ati ẹrankẹran lori ẹgbẹrun òke.
entries.en: For every beast of the forest is mine, and the cattle upon a thousand hills.

entries.yo: Emi mọ̀ gbogbo ẹiyẹ awọn oke nla: ati ẹranko igbẹ ni ti emi.
entries.en: I know all the fowls of the mountains: and the wild beasts of the field are mine.

entries.yo: Bi ebi npa mi, emi kì yio sọ fun ọ: nitori pe aiye ni ti emi, ati ẹkún inu rẹ̀.
entries.en: If I were hungry, I would not tell thee: for the world is mine, and the fulness thereof.

entries.yo: Emi o ha jẹ ẹran malu, tabi emi a ma mu ẹ̀jẹ ewurẹ bi?
entries.en: Will I eat the flesh of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?

entries.yo: Ru ẹbọ-ọpẹ si Ọlọrun, ki o si san ẹjẹ́ rẹ fun Ọga-ogo.
entries.en: Offer unto God thanksgiving; and pay thy vows unto the most High:

entries.yo: Ki o si kepè mi ni ọjọ ipọnju: emi o gbà ọ, iwọ o si ma yìn mi logo.
entries.en: And call upon me in the day of trouble: I will deliver thee, and thou shalt glorify me.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Ọlọrun wi fun enia buburu pe, Kini iwọ ni ifi ṣe lati ma sọ̀rọ ilana mi, tabi ti iwọ fi nmu majẹmu mi li ẹnu rẹ?
entries.en: But unto the wicked God saith, What hast thou to do to declare my statutes, or that thou shouldest take my covenant in thy mouth?

entries.yo: Wò o, iwọ sa korira ẹkọ́, iwọ si ti ṣá ọ̀rọ mi tì lẹhin rẹ.
entries.en: Seeing thou hatest instruction, and castest my words behind thee.

entries.yo: Nigbati iwọ ri olè, nigbana ni iwọ ba a mọ̀ ọ pọ̀, iwọ si ba awọn àgbere ṣe ajọpin.
entries.en: When thou sawest a thief, then thou consentedst with him, and hast been partaker with adulterers.

entries.yo: Iwọ fi ẹnu rẹ fun buburu, ati ahọn rẹ npete ẹ̀tan.
entries.en: Thou givest thy mouth to evil, and thy tongue frameth deceit.

entries.yo: Iwọ joko, iwọ si sọ̀rọ si arakunrin rẹ: iwọ mba orukọ ọmọ iya rẹ jẹ.
entries.en: Thou sittest and speakest against thy brother; thou slanderest thine own mother's son.

entries.yo: Nkan wọnyi ni iwọ ṣe emi si dakẹ; iwọ ṣebi emi tilẹ dabi iru iwọ tikararẹ; emi o ba ọ wi, emi o si kà wọn li ẹsẹ-ẹsẹ ni oju rẹ.
entries.en: These things hast thou done, and I kept silence; thou thoughtest that I was altogether such an one as thyself: but I will reprove thee, and set them in order before thine eyes.

entries.yo: Njẹ rò eyi, ẹnyin ti o gbagbe Ọlọrun, ki emi ki o má ba fà nyin ya pẹ́rẹpẹ̀rẹ, ti kò si olugbala.
entries.en: Now consider this, ye that forget God, lest I tear you in pieces, and there be none to deliver.

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni ti o ba ru ẹbọ iyìn, o yìn mi logo: ati ẹniti o ba mu ọ̀na ọ̀rọ rẹ̀ tọ́ li emi o fi igbala Ọlọrun hàn fun.
entries.en: Whoso offereth praise glorifieth me: and to him that ordereth his conversation aright will I shew the salvation of God.

entries.yo: ỌLỌRUN, ṣãnu fun mi, gẹgẹ bi iṣeun ifẹ rẹ: gẹgẹ bi ìrọnu ọ̀pọ ãnu rẹ, nù irekọja mi nù kuro.
entries.en: Have mercy upon me, O God, according to thy lovingkindness: according unto the multitude of thy tender mercies blot out my transgressions.

entries.yo: Wẹ̀ mi li awẹmọ́ kuro ninu aiṣedede mi, ki o si wẹ̀ mi nù kuro ninu ẹ̀ṣẹ mi.
entries.en: Wash me throughly from mine iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.

entries.yo: Nitori ti mo jẹwọ irekọja mi: nigbagbogbo li ẹ̀ṣẹ mi si mbẹ niwaju mi.
entries.en: For I acknowledge my transgressions: and my sin is ever before me.

entries.yo: Iwọ, iwọ nikanṣoṣo ni mo ṣẹ̀ si, ti mo ṣe buburu yi niwaju rẹ: ki a le da ọ lare, nigbati iwọ ba nsọ̀rọ, ki ara rẹ ki o le mọ́, nigbati iwọ ba nṣe idajọ.
entries.en: Against thee, thee only, have I sinned, and done this evil in thy sight: that thou mightest be justified when thou speakest, and be clear when thou judgest.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, ninu aiṣedede li a gbe bi mi: ati ninu ẹ̀ṣẹ ni iya mi si loyun mi.
entries.en: Behold, I was shapen in iniquity; and in sin did my mother conceive me.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, iwọ fẹ otitọ ni inu: ati niha ìkọkọ ni iwọ o mu mi mọ̀ ọgbọ́n.
entries.en: Behold, thou desirest truth in the inward parts: and in the hidden part thou shalt make me to know wisdom.

entries.yo: Fi ewe-hissopu fọ̀ mi, emi o si mọ́: wẹ̀ mi, emi o si fún jù ẹ̀gbọn-owu lọ.
entries.en: Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean: wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.

entries.yo: Mu mi gbọ́ ayọ̀ ati inu didùn; ki awọn egungun ti iwọ ti rún ki o le ma yọ̀.
entries.en: Make me to hear joy and gladness; that the bones which thou hast broken may rejoice.

entries.yo: Pa oju rẹ mọ́ kuro lara ẹ̀ṣẹ mi, ki iwọ ki o si nù gbogbo aiṣedede mi nù kuro.
entries.en: Hide thy face from my sins, and blot out all mine iniquities.

entries.yo: Da aiya titun sinu mi, Ọlọrun; ki o si tún ọkàn diduroṣinṣin ṣe sinu mi.
entries.en: Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.

entries.yo: Máṣe ṣa mi tì kuro niwaju rẹ; ki o má si ṣe gbà Ẹmi mimọ́ rẹ lọwọ mi.
entries.en: Cast me not away from thy presence; and take not thy holy spirit from me.

entries.yo: Mu ayọ̀ igbala rẹ pada tọ̀ mi wá; ki o si fi ẹmi omnira rẹ gbé mi duro.
entries.en: Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation; and uphold me with thy free spirit.

entries.yo: Nigbana li emi o ma kọ́ awọn olurekọja li ọ̀na rẹ: awọn ẹlẹṣẹ yio si ma yipada si ọ.
entries.en: Then will I teach transgressors thy ways; and sinners shall be converted unto thee.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun, gbà mi lọwọ ẹbi ẹ̀jẹ, iwọ Ọlọrun igbala mi: ahọn mi yio si ma kọrin ododo rẹ kikan.
entries.en: Deliver me from bloodguiltiness, O God, thou God of my salvation: and my tongue shall sing aloud of thy righteousness.

entries.yo: Oluwa, iwọ ṣi mi li ète; ẹnu mi yio si ma fi iyìn rẹ han:
entries.en: O Lord, open thou my lips; and my mouth shall shew forth thy praise.

entries.yo: Nitori iwọ kò fẹ ẹbọ, ti emi iba ru u: inu rẹ kò dùn si ọrẹ-ẹbọ sisun.
entries.en: For thou desirest not sacrifice; else would I give it: thou delightest not in burnt offering.

entries.yo: Ẹbọ Ọlọrun ni irobinujẹ ọkàn: irobinujẹ ati irora aiya, Ọlọrun, on ni iwọ kì yio gàn.
entries.en: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit: a broken and a contrite heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.

entries.yo: Ṣe rere ni didùn inu rẹ si Sioni: iwọ mọ odi Jerusalemu.
entries.en: Do good in thy good pleasure unto Zion: build thou the walls of Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni inu rẹ yio dùn si ẹbọ ododo; pẹlu ọrẹ-ẹbọ sisun ati ọ̀tọtọ ọrẹ-ẹbọ sisun: nigbana ni nwọn o fi akọ-malu rubọ lori pẹpẹ rẹ.
entries.en: Then shalt thou be pleased with the sacrifices of righteousness, with burnt offering and whole burnt offering: then shall they offer bullocks upon thine altar.

entries.yo: ẼṢE ti iwọ fi nṣe-fefe ninu ìwa-ìka, iwọ alagbara ọkunrin? ore Ọlọrun duro pẹ titi.
entries.en: Why boastest thou thyself in mischief, O mighty man? the goodness of God endureth continually.

entries.yo: Ahọn rẹ ngberò ìwa-ìka; bi abẹ mimú o nṣiṣẹ ẹ̀tan.
entries.en: Thy tongue deviseth mischiefs; like a sharp rasor, working deceitfully.

entries.yo: Iwọ fẹ ibi jù ire lọ; ati eke jù ati sọ ododo lọ.
entries.en: Thou lovest evil more than good; and lying rather than to speak righteousness. Selah.

entries.yo: Iwọ fẹ ọ̀rọ ipanirun gbogbo, iwọ ahọn ẹ̀tan.
entries.en: Thou lovest all devouring words, O thou deceitful tongue.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun yio si lù ọ bolẹ lailai, yio si dì ọ mu, yio si ja ọ kuro ni ibujoko rẹ, yio si fà ọ tu kuro lori ilẹ alãye.
entries.en: God shall likewise destroy thee for ever, he shall take thee away, and pluck thee out of thy dwelling place, and root thee out of the land of the living. Selah.

entries.yo: Olododo yio ri i pẹlu, yio si bẹ̀ru, yio si ma rẹrin rẹ̀ pe,
entries.en: The righteous also shall see, and fear, and shall laugh at him:

entries.yo: Kiyesi ọkunrin ti kò fi Ọlọrun ṣe agbara rẹ̀; bikoṣe li ọ̀pọlọpọ ọrọ̀ rẹ̀ li o gbẹkẹle, o si mu ara rẹ̀ le ninu ìwa buburu rẹ̀.
entries.en: Lo, this is the man that made not God his strength; but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and strengthened himself in his wickedness.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi dabi igi olifi tutu ni ile Ọlọrun: emi gbẹkẹle ãnu Ọlọrun lai ati lailai.
entries.en: But I am like a green olive tree in the house of God: I trust in the mercy of God for ever and ever.

entries.yo: Emi o ma yìn ọ lailai nitoripe iwọ li o ṣe e: emi o si ma duro de orukọ rẹ; nitori ti o dara li oju awọn enia mimọ́ rẹ.
entries.en: I will praise thee for ever, because thou hast done it: and I will wait on thy name; for it is good before thy saints.

entries.yo: AṢIWERE wi li ọkàn rẹ̀ pe, Ọlọrun kò si. Nwọn bajẹ nwọn si nṣe irira ẹ̀ṣẹ: kò si ẹniti o nṣe rere.
entries.en: The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God. Corrupt are they, and have done abominable iniquity: there is none that doeth good.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun bojuwo ilẹ lati ọrun wá sara awọn ọmọ enia, lati wò bi ẹnikan wà ti oye ye, ti o si nwá Ọlọrun.
entries.en: God looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, that did seek God.

entries.yo: Gbogbo wọn li o si pada sẹhin, nwọn si di elẽri patapata: kò si ẹniti nṣe rere, kò si ẹnikan.
entries.en: Every one of them is gone back: they are altogether become filthy; there is none that doeth good, no, not one.

entries.yo: Awọn ti nṣiṣẹ ẹ̀ṣẹ ko ha ni ìmọ? awọn ẹniti njẹ enia mi bi ẹni jẹun: nwọn kò si kepe Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread: they have not called upon God.

entries.yo: Nibẹ ni nwọn gbe wà ni ibẹ̀ru nla nibiti ẹ̀ru kò gbe si: nitori Ọlọrun ti fún egungun awọn ti o dótì ọ ka: iwọ ti dojutì wọn, nitori Ọlọrun ti kẹgàn wọn.
entries.en: There were they in great fear, where no fear was: for God hath scattered the bones of him that encampeth against thee: thou hast put them to shame, because God hath despised them.

entries.yo: Tani yio fi igbala fun Israeli lati Sioni jade wá? Nigbati Ọlọrun ba mu igbekun awọn enia rẹ̀ pada wá, Jakobu yio yọ̀, inu Israeli yio si dùn.
entries.en: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! When God bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

entries.yo: ỌLỌRUN gbà mi nipa orukọ rẹ, si ṣe idajọ mi nipa agbara rẹ.
entries.en: Save me, O God, by thy name, and judge me by thy strength.

entries.yo: Gbọ́ adura mi, Ọlọrun; fi eti si ọ̀rọ ẹnu mi.
entries.en: Hear my prayer, O God; give ear to the words of my mouth.

entries.yo: Nitoriti awọn alejò dide si mi, awọn aninilara si nwá ọkàn mi: nwọn kò kà Ọlọrun si li oju wọn.
entries.en: For strangers are risen up against me, and oppressors seek after my soul: they have not set God before them. Selah.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, Ọlọrun li oluranlọwọ mi: Oluwa wà pẹlu awọn ti o gbé ọkàn mi duro.
entries.en: Behold, God is mine helper: the Lord is with them that uphold my soul.

entries.yo: Yio si fi ibi san a fun awọn ọta mi: ke wọn kuro ninu otitọ rẹ.
entries.en: He shall reward evil unto mine enemies: cut them off in thy truth.

entries.yo: Emi o rubọ atinuwa si ọ: Oluwa, emi o yìn orukọ rẹ; nitoriti o dara.
entries.en: I will freely sacrifice unto thee: I will praise thy name, O LORD; for it is good.

entries.yo: Nitori o ti yọ mi kuro ninu iṣẹ́ gbogbo: oju mi si ri ifẹ rẹ̀ lara awọn ọta mi.
entries.en: For he hath delivered me out of all trouble: and mine eye hath seen his desire upon mine enemies.

entries.yo: FETI si adura mi, Ọlọrun; má si ṣe fi ara rẹ pamọ kuro ninu ẹ̀bẹ mi.
entries.en: Give ear to my prayer, O God; and hide not thyself from my supplication.

entries.yo: Fiye si mi, ki o si da mi lohùn: ara mi kò lelẹ ninu aroye mi, emi si npariwo;
entries.en: Attend unto me, and hear me: I mourn in my complaint, and make a noise;

entries.yo: Nitori ohùn ọta nì, nitori inilara enia buburu: nitoriti nwọn mu ibi ba mi, ati ni ibinu, nwọn dẹkun fun mi.
entries.en: Because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked: for they cast iniquity upon me, and in wrath they hate me.

entries.yo: Aiya dùn mi gidigidi ninu mi: ipaiya ikú si ṣubu lù mi.
entries.en: My heart is sore pained within me: and the terrors of death are fallen upon me.

entries.yo: Ibẹ̀ru ati ìwárìrì wá si ara mi, ati ibẹ̀ru ikú bò mi mọlẹ.
entries.en: Fearfulness and trembling are come upon me, and horror hath overwhelmed me.

entries.yo: Emi si wipe, A! iba ṣe pe emi ni iyẹ-apa bi àdaba! emi iba fò lọ, emi a si simi.
entries.en: And I said, Oh that I had wings like a dove! for then would I fly away, and be at rest.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, emi iba rìn lọ si ọ̀na jijin rére, emi a si ma gbe li aginju.
entries.en: Lo, then would I wander far off, and remain in the wilderness. Selah.

entries.yo: Emi iba yara sa asala mi kuro ninu ẹfufu lile ati iji na.
entries.en: I would hasten my escape from the windy storm and tempest.

entries.yo: Oluwa, ṣe iparun, ki o si yà wọn li ahọn: nitori ti mo ri ìwa agbara ati ijà ni ilu na.
entries.en: Destroy, O Lord, and divide their tongues: for I have seen violence and strife in the city.

entries.yo: Ọsan ati oru ni nwọn fi nrìn odi rẹ̀ kiri: ìwa-ika pẹlu ati ikãnu mbẹ li arin rẹ̀.
entries.en: Day and night they go about it upon the walls thereof: mischief also and sorrow are in the midst of it.

entries.yo: Ìwa buburu mbẹ li arin rẹ̀: ẹ̀tan ati eke kò kuro ni igboro rẹ̀.
entries.en: Wickedness is in the midst thereof: deceit and guile depart not from her streets.

entries.yo: Nitoriti kì iṣe ọta li o gàn mi: njẹ emi iba pa a mọra: bẹ̃ni kì iṣe ẹniti o korira mi li o gbé ara rẹ̀ ga si mi; njẹ emi iba fi ara mi pamọ́ kuro lọdọ rẹ̀:
entries.en: For it was not an enemy that reproached me; then I could have borne it: neither was it he that hated me that did magnify himself against me; then I would have hid myself from him:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn iwọ ni, ọkunrin ọ̀gba mi, amọ̀na mi, ati ojulumọ mi.
entries.en: But it was thou, a man mine equal, my guide, and mine acquaintance.

entries.yo: Awa jumọ gbimọ didùn, awa si kẹgbẹ rìn wọ̀ ile Ọlọrun lọ.
entries.en: We took sweet counsel together, and walked unto the house of God in company.

entries.yo: Ki ikú ki o dì wọn mu, ki nwọn ki o si lọ lãye si isa-okú: nitori ti ìwa buburu mbẹ ni ibujoko wọn, ati ninu wọn.
entries.en: Let death seize upon them, and let them go down quick into hell: for wickedness is in their dwellings, and among them.

entries.yo: Bi o ṣe ti emi ni, emi o kepè Ọlọrun; Oluwa yio si gbà mi.
entries.en: As for me, I will call upon God; and the LORD shall save me.

entries.yo: Li alẹ, li owurọ, ati li ọsan, li emi o ma gbadura, ti emi o si ma kigbe kikan: on o si gbohùn mi.
entries.en: Evening, and morning, and at noon, will I pray, and cry aloud: and he shall hear my voice.

entries.yo: O ti gbà ọkàn mi silẹ li alafia lọwọ ogun ti o ti dó tì mi: nitoripe pẹlu ọ̀pọlọpọ enia ni nwọn dide si mi.
entries.en: He hath delivered my soul in peace from the battle that was against me: for there were many with me.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun yio gbọ́, yio si pọ́n wọn loju, ani ẹniti o ti joko lati igbani. Nitoriti nwọn kò ni ayipada, nwọn kò si bẹ̀ru Ọlọrun.
entries.en: God shall hear, and afflict them, even he that abideth of old. Selah. Because they have no changes, therefore they fear not God.

entries.yo: O ti nà ọwọ rẹ̀ si iru awọn ti o wà li alafia pẹlu rẹ̀: o ti dà majẹmu rẹ̀.
entries.en: He hath put forth his hands against such as be at peace with him: he hath broken his covenant.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ ẹnu rẹ̀ kunna jù ori-amọ lọ, ṣugbọn ogun jija li o wà li aiya rẹ̀: ọ̀rọ rẹ̀ kunna jù ororo lọ, ṣugbọn idà fifayọ ni nwọn.
entries.en: The words of his mouth were smoother than butter, but war was in his heart: his words were softer than oil, yet were they drawn swords.

entries.yo: Kó ẹrù rẹ lọ si ara Oluwa, on ni yio si mu ọ duro: on kì yio jẹ ki ẹsẹ olododo ki o yẹ̀ lai.
entries.en: Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn iwọ, Ọlọrun, ni yio mu wọn sọkalẹ lọ si iho iparun: awọn enia ẹ̀jẹ ati enia ẹ̀tan kì yio pe àbọ ọjọ wọn; ṣugbọn emi o gbẹkẹle ọ.
entries.en: But thou, O God, shalt bring them down into the pit of destruction: bloody and deceitful men shall not live out half their days; but I will trust in thee.

entries.yo: ỌLỌRUN, ṣãnu fun mi: nitoriti enia nfẹ gbe mi mì; o mba mi jà lojojumọ, o nni mi lara.
entries.en: Be merciful unto me, O God: for man would swallow me up; he fighting daily oppresseth me.

entries.yo: Awọn ọta mi nfẹ igbe mi mì lojojumọ: nitori awọn ti nfi igberaga ba mi ja pọ̀.
entries.en: Mine enemies would daily swallow me up: for they be many that fight against me, O thou most High.

entries.yo: Nigbati ẹ̀ru ba mbà mi, emi o gbẹkẹle ọ.
entries.en: What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.

entries.yo: Nipa Ọlọrun li emi o ma yìn ọ̀rọ rẹ̀, Ọlọrun li emi o gbẹkẹ mi le, emi kì yio bèru: kili ẹran-ara le ṣe si mi.
entries.en: In God I will praise his word, in God I have put my trust; I will not fear what flesh can do unto me.

entries.yo: Lojojumọ ni nwọn nlọ́ ọ̀rọ mi: ibi ni gbogbo ìro inu wọn si mi:
entries.en: Every day they wrest my words: all their thoughts are against me for evil.

entries.yo: Nwọn kó ara wọn jọ, nwọn ba, nwọn kiyesi ìrin mi, nwọn ti nṣọ̀na ọkàn mi.
entries.en: They gather themselves together, they hide themselves, they mark my steps, when they wait for my soul.

entries.yo: Nwọn ha le ti ipa aiṣedede là? ni ibinu, bi awọn enia na lulẹ̀, Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Shall they escape by iniquity? in thine anger cast down the people, O God.

entries.yo: Iwọ nka ìrìnkiri mi: fi omije mi sinu igo rẹ: nwọn ko ha si ninu iwe rẹ bi?
entries.en: Thou tellest my wanderings: put thou my tears into thy bottle: are they not in thy book?

entries.yo: Li ọjọ ti mo ba kigbe, nigbana li awọn ọta mi yio pẹhinda: eyi li emi mọ̀: nitoripe Ọlọrun wà fun mi.
entries.en: When I cry unto thee, then shall mine enemies turn back: this I know; for God is for me.

entries.yo: Nipa Ọlọrun li emi o ma yìn ọ̀rọ rẹ̀: nipa Oluwa li emi o ma yìn ọ̀rọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: In God will I praise his word: in the LORD will I praise his word.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun li emi gbẹkẹ mi le, emi kì yio bẹ̀ru kili enia le ṣe si mi.
entries.en: In God have I put my trust: I will not be afraid what man can do unto me.

entries.yo: Ẹjẹ́ rẹ mbẹ lara mi, Ọlọrun: emi o fi iyìn fun ọ.
entries.en: Thy vows are upon me, O God: I will render praises unto thee.

entries.yo: Nitoripe iwọ li o ti gbà ọkàn mi lọwọ ikú: iwọ ki yio ha gbà ẹsẹ mi lọwọ iṣubu? ki emi ki o le ma rìn niwaju Ọlọrun ni imọlẹ awọn alãye?
entries.en: For thou hast delivered my soul from death: wilt not thou deliver my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living?

entries.yo: ṢÃNU fun mi: Ọlọrun, ṣãnu fun mi: nitoriti ọkàn mi gbẹkẹle ọ: lõtọ, li ojiji iyẹ-apa rẹ li emi o fi ṣe àbo mi, titi wahala wọnyi yio fi rekọja.
entries.en: Be merciful unto me, O God, be merciful unto me: for my soul trusteth in thee: yea, in the shadow of thy wings will I make my refuge, until these calamities be overpast.

entries.yo: Emi o kigbe pe Ọlọrun Ọga-ogo; si Ọlọrun ti o ṣe ohun gbogbo fun mi.
entries.en: I will cry unto God most high; unto God that performeth all things for me.

entries.yo: On o ranṣẹ lati ọrun wá, yio si gbà mi bi ẹniti nfẹ gbe mi mì tilẹ nkẹgàn mi. Ọlọrun yio rán ãnu rẹ̀ ati otitọ rẹ̀ jade.
entries.en: He shall send from heaven, and save from the reproach of him that would swallow me up. Selah. God shall send forth his mercy and his truth.

entries.yo: Ọkàn mi wà lãrin awọn kiniun: emi tilẹ dubulẹ lãrin awọn ti o gbiná, eyinì ni awọn ọmọ enia, ehín ẹniti iṣe ọ̀kọ ati ọfa, ati ahọn wọn, idà mimú.
entries.en: My soul is among lions: and I lie even among them that are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.

entries.yo: Gbigbega ni ọ, Ọlọrun, jù ọrun lọ; ati ogo rẹ jù gbogbo aiye lọ.
entries.en: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens; let thy glory be above all the earth.

entries.yo: Nwọn ti ta àwọn silẹ fun ẹsẹ mi: nwọn tẹ ori ọkàn mi ba: nwọn ti wà iho silẹ niwaju mi, li ãrin eyina li awọn tikarawọn jìn si.
entries.en: They have prepared a net for my steps; my soul is bowed down: they have digged a pit before me, into the midst whereof they are fallen themselves. Selah.

entries.yo: Ọkàn mi ti mura, Ọlọrun, ọkàn mi ti mura: emi o kọrin, emi o si ma kọrin iyìn.
entries.en: My heart is fixed, O God, my heart is fixed: I will sing and give praise.

entries.yo: Jí, iwọ ogo mi; jí, ohun-èlo orin ati duru: emi tikarami yio si jí ni kutukutu.
entries.en: Awake up, my glory; awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.

entries.yo: Emi o ma yìn ọ, Oluwa lãrin awọn enia: emi o si ma kọrin si ọ lãrin awọn orilẹ-ède.
entries.en: I will praise thee, O Lord, among the people: I will sing unto thee among the nations.

entries.yo: Nitoriti ãnu rẹ pọ̀ de ọrun, ati otitọ rẹ de awọsanma.
entries.en: For thy mercy is great unto the heavens, and thy truth unto the clouds.

entries.yo: Gbigbega ni ọ, Ọlọrun, jù awọn ọrun lọ ati ogo rẹ jù gbogbo aiye lọ.
entries.en: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: let thy glory be above all the earth.

entries.yo: ẸNYIN ha nsọ ododo nitõtọ, ẹnyin ijọ enia? ẹnyin ha nṣe idajọ ti o ṣe titọ, ẹnyin ọmọ enia?
entries.en: Do ye indeed speak righteousness, O congregation? do ye judge uprightly, O ye sons of men?

entries.yo: Nitõtọ, ẹnyin nṣiṣẹ buburu li aiya; ẹnyin nwọ̀n ìwa-agbara ọwọ nyin li aiye.
entries.en: Yea, in heart ye work wickedness; ye weigh the violence of your hands in the earth.

entries.yo: Lati inu iya wọn wá li awọn enia buburu ti ṣe iyapa: nwọn ti ṣina lojukanna ti a ti bi wọn, nwọn a ma ṣeke.
entries.en: The wicked are estranged from the womb: they go astray as soon as they be born, speaking lies.

entries.yo: Oró wọn dabi oró ejò: nwọn dabi aditi ejò pamọlẹ ti o di ara rẹ̀ li eti;
entries.en: Their poison is like the poison of a serpent: they are like the deaf adder that stoppeth her ear;

entries.yo: Ti kò fẹ igbọ́ ohùn awọn atuniloju, bi o ti wù ki o ma fi ọgbọ́n ṣe ituju to.
entries.en: Which will not hearken to the voice of charmers, charming never so wisely.

entries.yo: Ká wọn li ehin, Ọlọrun, li ẹnu wọn: ká ọ̀gan awọn ọmọ kiniun nì, Oluwa.
entries.en: Break their teeth, O God, in their mouth: break out the great teeth of the young lions, O LORD.

entries.yo: Ki nwọn ki o yọ́ danu bi omi ti nṣàn nigbagbogbo: nigbati o ba fa ọrun lati tafà rẹ̀, ki nwọn ki o dabi ẹnipe a ke wọn ni ijanja.
entries.en: Let them melt away as waters which run continually: when he bendeth his bow to shoot his arrows, let them be as cut in pieces.

entries.yo: Bi igbín ti a tẹ̀ rẹ́ ti o si ṣegbe: bi iṣẹnu obinrin, bẹ̃ni ki nwọn ki o má ṣe ri õrùn.
entries.en: As a snail which melteth, let every one of them pass away: like the untimely birth of a woman, that they may not see the sun.

entries.yo: Ki ikoko nyin ki o to mọ̀ igbona ẹgún, iba tutu iba ma jo, yio fi iji gbá wọn lọ.
entries.en: Before your pots can feel the thorns, he shall take them away as with a whirlwind, both living, and in his wrath.

entries.yo: Olododo yio yọ̀ nigbati o ba ri ẹsan na: yio si wẹ̀ ẹsẹ rẹ̀ ninu ẹ̀jẹ awọn enia buburu.
entries.en: The righteous shall rejoice when he seeth the vengeance: he shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li enia o si wipe, Lõtọ, ère mbẹ fun olododo: lõtọ, on li Ọlọrun ti o nṣe idajọ ni aiye.
entries.en: So that a man shall say, Verily there is a reward for the righteous: verily he is a God that judgeth in the earth.

entries.yo: ỌLỌRUN mi, gbà mi lọwọ awọn ọta mi: dãbobo mi lọwọ awọn ti o dide si mi.
entries.en: Deliver me from mine enemies, O my God: defend me from them that rise up against me.

entries.yo: Gbà mi lọwọ awọn oniṣẹ ẹ̀ṣẹ, ki o si gbà mi silẹ lọwọ awọn enia-ẹ̀jẹ.
entries.en: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, and save me from bloody men.

entries.yo: Sa kiyesi i, nwọn ba ni buba fun ọkàn mi, awọn alagbara pejọ si mi; kì iṣe nitori irekọja mi, tabi nitori ẹ̀ṣẹ mi, Oluwa.
entries.en: For, lo, they lie in wait for my soul: the mighty are gathered against me; not for my transgression, nor for my sin, O LORD.

entries.yo: Nwọn sure, nwọn mura li aiṣẹ mi: dide lati pade mi, ki o si kiyesi i.
entries.en: They run and prepare themselves without my fault: awake to help me, and behold.

entries.yo: Nitorina iwọ, Oluwa, Ọlọrun awọn ọmọ-ogun, Ọlọrun Israeli, jí lati bẹ̀ gbogbo awọn keferi wò; máṣe ṣãnu fun olurekọja buburu wọnni.
entries.en: Thou therefore, O LORD God of hosts, the God of Israel, awake to visit all the heathen: be not merciful to any wicked transgressors. Selah.

entries.yo: Nwọn pada li aṣalẹ: nwọn npariwo bi ajá, nwọn nrìn yi ilu na ka.
entries.en: They return at evening: they make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, nwọn nfi ẹnu wọn gùfẹ jade: idà wà li ète wọn: nitoriti nwọn nwipe, tali o gbọ́?
entries.en: Behold, they belch out with their mouth: swords are in their lips: for who, say they, doth hear?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn iwọ, Oluwa, yio rẹrin wọn: iwọ ni yio yọṣuti si gbogbo awọn keferi.
entries.en: But thou, O LORD, shalt laugh at them; thou shalt have all the heathen in derision.

entries.yo: Agbara rẹ̀ li emi o duro tì: nitori Ọlọrun li àbo mi.
entries.en: Because of his strength will I wait upon thee: for God is my defence.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun ãnu mi ni yio ṣaju mi: Ọlọrun yio jẹ ki emi ri ifẹ mi lara awọn ọta mi.
entries.en: The God of my mercy shall prevent me: God shall let me see my desire upon mine enemies.

entries.yo: Máṣe pa wọn, ki awọn enia mi ki o má ba gbagbe: tú wọn ká nipa agbara rẹ; ki o si sọ̀ wọn kalẹ, Oluwa asà wa.
entries.en: Slay them not, lest my people forget: scatter them by thy power; and bring them down, O Lord our shield.

entries.yo: Nitori ẹ̀ṣẹ ẹnu wọn ni ọ̀rọ ète wọn, ki a mu wọn ninu igberaga wọn: ati nitori ẽbu ati èke ti nwọn nṣe.
entries.en: For the sin of their mouth and the words of their lips let them even be taken in their pride: and for cursing and lying which they speak.

entries.yo: Run wọn ni ibinu, run wọn, ki nwọn ki o má ṣe si mọ́: ki o si jẹ ki nwọn ki o mọ̀ pe, Ọlọrun li olori ni Jakobu titi o fi de opin aiye.
entries.en: Consume them in wrath, consume them, that they may not be: and let them know that God ruleth in Jacob unto the ends of the earth. Selah.

entries.yo: Ati li aṣalẹ jẹ ki nwọn ki o pada; ki nwọn ki o pariwo bi ajá, ki nwọn ki o si ma yi ilu na ka kiri.
entries.en: And at evening let them return; and let them make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki nwọn ki o ma rìn soke rìn sodò fun ohun jijẹ, bi nwọn kò ba yó, nwọn o duro ni gbogbo oru na.
entries.en: Let them wander up and down for meat, and grudge if they be not satisfied.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi o kọrin agbara rẹ; nitõtọ, emi o kọrin ãnu rẹ kikan li owurọ: nitori pe iwọ li o ti nṣe àbo ati ibi-asala mi li ọjọ ipọnju mi.
entries.en: But I will sing of thy power; yea, I will sing aloud of thy mercy in the morning: for thou hast been my defence and refuge in the day of my trouble.

entries.yo: Iwọ, agbara mi, li emi o kọrin si: nitori Ọlọrun li àbo mi, Ọlọrun ánu mi!
entries.en: Unto thee, O my strength, will I sing: for God is my defence, and the God of my mercy.

entries.yo: ỌLỌRUN, iwọ ti ṣa wa tì, iwọ ti tú wa ka, inu rẹ ti bajẹ; tún ara rẹ yipada si wa.
entries.en: O God, thou hast cast us off, thou hast scattered us, thou hast been displeased; O turn thyself to us again.

entries.yo: Iwọ ti mu ilẹ warìri; iwọ ti fọ ọ: mu fifọ rẹ̀ bọ̀ sipò: nitoriti o nmì.
entries.en: Thou hast made the earth to tremble; thou hast broken it: heal the breaches thereof; for it shaketh.

entries.yo: Iwọ ti fi ohun ti o ṣoro hàn awọn enia rẹ: iwọ mu wa mu ọti-waini itagbọngbọn.
entries.en: Thou hast shewed thy people hard things: thou hast made us to drink the wine of astonishment.

entries.yo: Iwọ ti fi ọpagun fun awọn ti o bẹ̀ru rẹ, ki a le ma fi i hàn nitori otitọ.
entries.en: Thou hast given a banner to them that fear thee, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.

entries.yo: Ki a le gbà awọn olufẹ rẹ là; fi ọwọ ọtún rẹ ṣe igbala, ki o si gbohùn mi.
entries.en: That thy beloved may be delivered; save with thy right hand, and hear me.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun ti sọ̀rọ ninu ìwa-mimọ́ rẹ̀ pe; Emi o yọ̀, emi o pin Ṣekemu, emi o si wọ̀n afonifoji Sukkotu.
entries.en: God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.

entries.yo: Ti emi ni Gileadi, ti emi ni Manasse; Efraimu pẹlu li agbara ori mi; Juda li olofin mi;
entries.en: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Judah is my lawgiver;

entries.yo: Moabu li ikoko-iwẹsẹ mi; lori Edomu li emi o bọ́ bàta mi si: Filistia ma ho iho ayọ̀ fun mi!
entries.en: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe: Philistia, triumph thou because of me.

entries.yo: Tani yio mu mi wá sinu ilu olodi nì? tani yio sin mi lọ si Edomu?
entries.en: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?

entries.yo: Iwọ ha kọ́, Ọlọrun, ẹniti o ṣa wa tì? ati iwọ, Ọlọrun, ti kò ba ogun wa jade lọ?
entries.en: Wilt not thou, O God, which hadst cast us off? and thou, O God, which didst not go out with our armies?

entries.yo: Fun wa ni iranlọwọ ninu ipọnju: nitori pe asan ni iranlọwọ enia.
entries.en: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.

entries.yo: Nipasẹ Ọlọrun li awa o ṣe akin: nitori on ni yio tẹ̀ awọn ọta wa mọlẹ.
entries.en: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.

entries.yo: GBỌ́ ẹkún mi, Ọlọrun; fiye si adura mi.
entries.en: Hear my cry, O God; attend unto my prayer.

entries.yo: Lati opin aiye wá li emi o kigbe pè ọ, nigbati o rẹ̀ aiya mi, fà mi lọ si apata ti o ga jù mi lọ.
entries.en: From the end of the earth will I cry unto thee, when my heart is overwhelmed: lead me to the rock that is higher than I.

entries.yo: Nitori iwọ li o ti nṣe àbo fun mi, ati ile-iṣọ agbara lọwọ ọta nì.
entries.en: For thou hast been a shelter for me, and a strong tower from the enemy.

entries.yo: Emi o joko ninu agọ rẹ lailai: jẹ ki emi ri àbo ni iyẹ-apa rẹ.
entries.en: I will abide in thy tabernacle for ever: I will trust in the covert of thy wings. Selah.

entries.yo: Nitoripe iwọ, Ọlọrun, li o ti gbọ́ ẹjẹ́ mi: iwọ ti fi ogún awọn ti o bẹ̀ru orukọ rẹ fun mi.
entries.en: For thou, O God, hast heard my vows: thou hast given me the heritage of those that fear thy name.

entries.yo: Iwọ o fa ẹmi ọba gùn: ati ọjọ ọdun rẹ̀ bi atiran-diran.
entries.en: Thou wilt prolong the king's life: and his years as many generations.

entries.yo: On o ma gbe iwaju Ọlọrun lailai; pèse ãnu ati otitọ, ti yio ma ṣe itọju rẹ̀.
entries.en: He shall abide before God for ever: O prepare mercy and truth, which may preserve him.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li emi o ma kọrin iyìn si orukọ rẹ lailai, ki emi ki o le ma san ẹjẹ́ mi li ojojumọ.
entries.en: So will I sing praise unto thy name for ever, that I may daily perform my vows.

entries.yo: ỌLỌRUN nikan li ọkàn mi duro jẹ dè; lati ọdọ rẹ̀ wá ni igbala mi.
entries.en: Truly my soul waiteth upon God: from him cometh my salvation.

entries.yo: On nikan li apata mi ati igbala mi; on li àbo mi, emi kì yio ṣipò pada jọjọ.
entries.en: He only is my rock and my salvation; he is my defence; I shall not be greatly moved.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin o ti ma rọlu enia kan pẹ to? gbogbo nyin li o fẹ pa a: bi ogiri ti o bìwó ati bi ọgbà ti nwó lọ.
entries.en: How long will ye imagine mischief against a man? ye shall be slain all of you: as a bowing wall shall ye be, and as a tottering fence.

entries.yo: Kiki ìro wọn ni lati já a tilẹ kuro ninu ọlá rẹ̀: nwọn nṣe inu didùn ninu eke: nwọn nfi ẹnu wọn sure, ṣugbọn nwọn ngegun ni inu wọn.
entries.en: They only consult to cast him down from his excellency: they delight in lies: they bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah.

entries.yo: Ọkàn mi, iwọ sa duro jẹ de Ọlọrun; nitori lati ọdọ rẹ̀ wá ni ireti mi.
entries.en: My soul, wait thou only upon God; for my expectation is from him.

entries.yo: On nikan li apata mi ati igbala mi: on li àbo mi; a kì yio ṣi mi ni ipò.
entries.en: He only is my rock and my salvation: he is my defence; I shall not be moved.

entries.yo: Nipa Ọlọrun ni igbala mi, ati ogo mi: apata agbara mi, àbo mi si mbẹ ninu Ọlọrun.
entries.en: In God is my salvation and my glory: the rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.

entries.yo: Gbẹkẹle e nigbagbogbo; ẹnyin enia, tú ọkàn nyin jade niwaju rẹ̀; Ọlọrun àbo fun wa.
entries.en: Trust in him at all times; ye people, pour out your heart before him: God is a refuge for us. Selah.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ asan li awọn ọmọ enia, eke si li awọn oloyè. Nwọn gòke ninu ìwọn, bakanna ni nwọn fẹrẹ jù asan lọ.
entries.en: Surely men of low degree are vanity, and men of high degree are a lie: to be laid in the balance, they are altogether lighter than vanity.

entries.yo: Máṣe gbẹkẹle inilara, ki o má si ṣe gberaga li olè jija: bi ọrọ̀ ba npọ̀ si i, máṣe gbe ọkàn nyin le e.
entries.en: Trust not in oppression, and become not vain in robbery: if riches increase, set not your heart upon them.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun ti sọ̀rọ lẹ̃kan; lẹ̃rinkeji ni mo gbọ́ eyi pe: ti Ọlọrun li agbara.
entries.en: God hath spoken once; twice have I heard this; that power belongeth unto God.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu, Oluwa, tirẹ li ãnu: nitoriti iwọ san a fun olukulùku enia gẹgẹ bi iṣẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Also unto thee, O Lord, belongeth mercy: for thou renderest to every man according to his work.

entries.yo: ỌLỌRUN, iwọ li Ọlọrun mi; ni kutukutu li emi o ma ṣafẹri rẹ; ongbẹ rẹ ngbẹ ọkàn mi, ẹran-ara mi fà si ọ ni ilẹ gbigbẹ, ati ilẹ ti npongbẹ, nibiti omi kò gbe si.
entries.en: O God, thou art my God; early will I seek thee: my soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;

entries.yo: Bayi li emi ti wò ọ ninu ibi-mimọ́, lati ri agbara rẹ ati ogo rẹ.
entries.en: To see thy power and thy glory, so as I have seen thee in the sanctuary.

entries.yo: Nitori ti iṣeun-ifẹ rẹ san jù ìye lọ, ète mi yio ma yìn ọ.
entries.en: Because thy lovingkindness is better than life, my lips shall praise thee.

entries.yo: Bayi li emi o ma fi ibukún fun ọ niwọnbi mo ti wà lãye: emi o ma gbé ọwọ mi soke li orukọ rẹ.
entries.en: Thus will I bless thee while I live: I will lift up my hands in thy name.

entries.yo: Bi ẹnipe ijà ati ọ̀ra bẹ̃ni yio tẹ ọkàn mi lọrun; ẹnu mi yio si ma fi ète ayọ̀ yìn ọ:
entries.en: My soul shall be satisfied as with marrow and fatness; and my mouth shall praise thee with joyful lips:

entries.yo: Nigbati mo ba ranti rẹ lori ẹní mi, ti emi si nṣe aṣaro rẹ ni iṣọ oru.
entries.en: When I remember thee upon my bed, and meditate on thee in the night watches.

entries.yo: Nitoripe iwọ li o ti nṣe iranlọwọ mi, nitorina li ojiji iyẹ́-apa rẹ li emi o ma yọ̀.
entries.en: Because thou hast been my help, therefore in the shadow of thy wings will I rejoice.

entries.yo: Ọkàn mi ntọ̀ ọ lẹhin girigiri: ọwọ ọtún rẹ li o gbé mi ró.
entries.en: My soul followeth hard after thee: thy right hand upholdeth me.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn ti nwá ọkàn mi lati pa a run, nwọn o lọ si iha isalẹ-ilẹ.
entries.en: But those that seek my soul, to destroy it, shall go into the lower parts of the earth.

entries.yo: Nwọn o ti ọwọ idà ṣubu: nwọn o si ṣe ijẹ fun kọ̀lọkọlọ.
entries.en: They shall fall by the sword: they shall be a portion for foxes.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ọba yio ma yọ̀ ninu Ọlọrun; olukuluku ẹniti o nfi i bura ni yio ṣogo: ṣugbọn awọn ti nṣeke li a o pa li ẹnu mọ́.
entries.en: But the king shall rejoice in God; every one that sweareth by him shall glory: but the mouth of them that speak lies shall be stopped.

entries.yo: ỌLỌRUN, gbohùn mi ninu aroye mi: pa ẹmi mi mọ́ lọwọ ẹ̀ru ọta nì.
entries.en: Hear my voice, O God, in my prayer: preserve my life from fear of the enemy.

entries.yo: Pa mi mọ́ lọwọ ìmọ ìkọkọ awọn enia buburu: lọwọ irukerudo awọn oniṣẹ-ẹ̀ṣẹ.
entries.en: Hide me from the secret counsel of the wicked; from the insurrection of the workers of iniquity:

entries.yo: Ẹniti npọ̀n ahọn wọn bi ẹnipe idà, ti nwọn si fa ọrun wọn le lati tafa wọn, ani ọ̀rọ kikoro:
entries.en: Who whet their tongue like a sword, and bend their bows to shoot their arrows, even bitter words:

entries.yo: Ki nwọn ki o le ma tafà ni ìkọkọ si awọn ti o pé: lojiji ni nwọn tafa si i, nwọn kò si bẹ̀ru.
entries.en: That they may shoot in secret at the perfect: suddenly do they shoot at him, and fear not.

entries.yo: Nwọn gba ara wọn niyanju li ọ̀ran buburu: nwọn gbìmọ ati dẹkun silẹ nikọ̀kọ; nwọn wipe, Tani yio ri wọn?
entries.en: They encourage themselves in an evil matter: they commune of laying snares privily; they say, Who shall see them?

entries.yo: Nwọn gbero ẹ̀ṣẹ; nwọn wipe, awa ti pari ero ti a gbà tan: ati ìro inu olukuluku wọn, ati aiya wọn, o jinlẹ.
entries.en: They search out iniquities; they accomplish a diligent search: both the inward thought of every one of them, and the heart, is deep.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Ọlọrun yio tafà si wọn lojiji; nwọn o si gbọgbẹ.
entries.en: But God shall shoot at them with an arrow; suddenly shall they be wounded.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni ahọn wọn yio mu wọn ṣubu lu ara wọn: gbogbo ẹniti o ri wọn yio mì ori wọn.
entries.en: So they shall make their own tongue to fall upon themselves: all that see them shall flee away.

entries.yo: Ati gbogbo enia ni yio ma bẹ̀ru, nwọn o si ma sọ̀rọ iṣẹ Ọlọrun; nitoriti nwọn o fi ọgbọ́n rò iṣẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And all men shall fear, and shall declare the work of God; for they shall wisely consider of his doing.

entries.yo: Olododo yio ma yọ̀ nipa ti Oluwa, yio si ma gbẹkẹle e; ati gbogbo ẹni-iduro-ṣinṣin li aiya ni yio ma ṣogo.
entries.en: The righteous shall be glad in the LORD, and shall trust in him; and all the upright in heart shall glory.

entries.yo: ỌLỌRUN, iyìn duro jẹ de ọ ni Sioni: ati si ọ li a o mu ileri ifẹ nì ṣẹ.
entries.en: Praise waiteth for thee, O God, in Sion: and unto thee shall the vow be performed.

entries.yo: Iwọ ti ngbọ́ adura, si ọdọ rẹ ni gbogbo enia mbọ̀.
entries.en: O thou that hearest prayer, unto thee shall all flesh come.

entries.yo: Ọ̀ran aiṣedede bori mi: bi o ṣe ti irekọja wa ni, iwọ ni yio wẹ̀ wọn nù kuro.
entries.en: Iniquities prevail against me: as for our transgressions, thou shalt purge them away.

entries.yo: Alabukún-fun li ẹniti iwọ yàn, ti iwọ si mu lati ma sunmọ ọdọ rẹ, ki o le ma gbe inu agbala rẹ wọnni: ore inu ile rẹ yio tẹ́ wa lọrùn, ani ti tempili mimọ́ rẹ.
entries.en: Blessed is the man whom thou choosest, and causest to approach unto thee, that he may dwell in thy courts: we shall be satisfied with the goodness of thy house, even of thy holy temple.

entries.yo: Ohun iyanu nipa ododo ni iwọ fi da wa lohùn, Ọlọrun igbala wa: ẹniti iṣe igbẹkẹle gbogbo opin aiye, ati awọn ti o jina réré si okun.
entries.en: By terrible things in righteousness wilt thou answer us, O God of our salvation; who art the confidence of all the ends of the earth, and of them that are afar off upon the sea:

entries.yo: Nipa agbara rẹ̀ ẹniti o fi idi òke nla mulẹ ṣinṣin; ti a fi agbara dì li àmure:
entries.en: Which by his strength setteth fast the mountains; being girded with power:

entries.yo: Ẹniti o pa ariwo okun mọ́ rọrọ, ariwo riru-omi wọn, ati gìrìgìrì awọn enia.
entries.en: Which stilleth the noise of the seas, the noise of their waves, and the tumult of the people.

entries.yo: Awọn pẹlu ti ngbe apa ipẹkun mbẹ̀ru nitori àmi rẹ wọnni: iwọ mu ijade owurọ ati ti aṣalẹ yọ̀.
entries.en: They also that dwell in the uttermost parts are afraid at thy tokens: thou makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.

entries.yo: Iwọ bẹ aiye wò, o si bomi rin i: iwọ mu u li ọrọ̀, odò Ọlọrun kún fun omi: iwọ pèse ọkàn wọn, nigbati iwọ ti pèse ilẹ bẹ̃.
entries.en: Thou visitest the earth, and waterest it: thou greatly enrichest it with the river of God, which is full of water: thou preparest them corn, when thou hast so provided for it.

entries.yo: Iwọ fi irinmi si aporo rẹ̀ pipọpìpọ: iwọ si tẹ́ ogulutu rẹ̀: iwọ fi ọwọ òjọ mu ilẹ rẹ̀ rọ̀: iwọ busi hihu rẹ̀.
entries.en: Thou waterest the ridges thereof abundantly: thou settlest the furrows thereof: thou makest it soft with showers: thou blessest the springing thereof.

entries.yo: Iwọ fi ore rẹ de ọdun li ade; ọrá nkán ni ipa-ọ̀na rẹ.
entries.en: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness; and thy paths drop fatness.

entries.yo: Papa-tutù aginju nkán: awọn òke kekèke fi ayọ̀ di ara wọn li àmure.
entries.en: They drop upon the pastures of the wilderness: and the little hills rejoice on every side.

entries.yo: Agbo ẹran li a fi wọ̀ pápá-tútù na li aṣọ: afonifoji li a fi ọka bò mọlẹ: nwọn nhó fun ayọ̀, nwọn nkọrin pẹlu.
entries.en: The pastures are clothed with flocks; the valleys also are covered over with corn; they shout for joy, they also sing.

entries.yo: Ẹ hó iho ayọ̀ si Ọlọrun, ẹnyin ilẹ gbogbo:
entries.en: Make a joyful noise unto God, all ye lands:

entries.yo: Ẹ kọrin ọlá orukọ rẹ̀: ẹ mu iyìn rẹ̀ li ogo.
entries.en: Sing forth the honour of his name: make his praise glorious.

entries.yo: Ẹ wi fun Ọlọrun pe, Iwọ ti li ẹ̀ru to ninu iṣẹ rẹ! nipa ọ̀pọ agbara rẹ li awọn ọta rẹ yio fi ori wọn balẹ fun ọ.
entries.en: Say unto God, How terrible art thou in thy works! through the greatness of thy power shall thine enemies submit themselves unto thee.

entries.yo: Gbogbo aiye ni yio ma sìn ọ, nwọn o si ma kọrin si ọ; nwọn o ma kọrin si orukọ rẹ.
entries.en: All the earth shall worship thee, and shall sing unto thee; they shall sing to thy name. Selah.

entries.yo: Ẹ wá wò iṣẹ Ọlọrun, o li ẹ̀ru ni iṣe rẹ̀ si awọn ọmọ enia.
entries.en: Come and see the works of God: he is terrible in his doing toward the children of men.

entries.yo: O sọ okun di ilẹ gbigbẹ: nwọn fi ẹsẹ là odò já: nibẹ li awa gbe yọ̀ ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: He turned the sea into dry land: they went through the flood on foot: there did we rejoice in him.

entries.yo: O jọba nipa agbara rẹ̀ lailai; oju rẹ̀ nwò awọn orilẹ-ède: ki awọn ọlọtẹ ki o máṣe gbé ara wọn ga.
entries.en: He ruleth by his power for ever; his eyes behold the nations: let not the rebellious exalt themselves. Selah.

entries.yo: Ẹ fi ibukún fun Ọlọrun wa, ẹnyin enia, ki ẹ si mu ni gbọ́ ohùn iyìn rẹ̀.
entries.en: O bless our God, ye people, and make the voice of his praise to be heard:

entries.yo: Ẹniti o mu ẹmi wa wà lãye, ti kò si jẹ ki ẹsẹ wa ki o yẹ̀.
entries.en: Which holdeth our soul in life, and suffereth not our feet to be moved.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun, nitori ti iwọ ti ridi wa: iwọ ti dan wa wò, bi ã ti idan fadaka wò.
entries.en: For thou, O God, hast proved us: thou hast tried us, as silver is tried.

entries.yo: Iwọ mu wa wọ̀ inu àwọn; iwọ fi ipọnju le wa li ẹgbẹ.
entries.en: Thou broughtest us into the net; thou laidst affliction upon our loins.

entries.yo: Iwọ mu awọn enia gùn wa li ori: awa nwọ inu iná ati omi lọ, ṣugbọn iwọ mu wa jade wá si ibi irọra.
entries.en: Thou hast caused men to ride over our heads; we went through fire and through water: but thou broughtest us out into a wealthy place.

entries.yo: Emi o lọ sinu ile rẹ ti emi ti ẹbọ sisun: emi o san ẹjẹ́ mi fun ọ,
entries.en: I will go into thy house with burnt offerings: I will pay thee my vows,

entries.yo: Ti ète mi ti jẹ́, ti ẹnu si ti sọ, nigbati mo wà ninu ipọnju.
entries.en: Which my lips have uttered, and my mouth hath spoken, when I was in trouble.

entries.yo: Emi o ru ẹbọ sisun ọlọra si ọ, pẹlu õrùn ọrá àgbo; emi o rubọ akọ-malu pẹlu ewurẹ.
entries.en: I will offer unto thee burnt sacrifices of fatlings, with the incense of rams; I will offer bullocks with goats. Selah.

entries.yo: Ẹ wá gbọ́, gbogbo ẹnyin ti o bẹ̀ru Ọlọrun, emi o sọ ohun ti o ṣe fun ọkàn mi.
entries.en: Come and hear, all ye that fear God, and I will declare what he hath done for my soul.

entries.yo: Emi fi ẹnu mi kigbe pè e, emi o si fi àhọn mi buyin fun u.
entries.en: I cried unto him with my mouth, and he was extolled with my tongue.

entries.yo: Bi emi ba gbà ẹ̀ṣẹ li aiya mi, Oluwa kì yio gbohùn mi:
entries.en: If I regard iniquity in my heart, the Lord will not hear me:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nitõtọ Ọlọrun ti gbohùn mi: o si ti fi eti si ohùn adura mi.
entries.en: But verily God hath heard me; he hath attended to the voice of my prayer.

entries.yo: Olubukún li Ọlọrun, ti kò yi adura mi pada kuro, tabi ãnu rẹ̀ kuro lọdọ mi.
entries.en: Blessed be God, which hath not turned away my prayer, nor his mercy from me.

entries.yo: KI Ọlọrun ki o ṣãnu fun wa, ki o si busi i fun wa; ki o si ṣe oju rẹ̀ ki o mọlẹ si wa lara,
entries.en: God be merciful unto us, and bless us; and cause his face to shine upon us; Selah.

entries.yo: Ki ọ̀na rẹ ki o le di mimọ̀ li aiye, ati igbala ilera rẹ ni gbogbo orilẹ-ède.
entries.en: That thy way may be known upon earth, thy saving health among all nations.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki awọn enia ki o yìn ọ, Ọlọrun; jẹ ki gbogbo enia ki o yìn ọ.
entries.en: Let the people praise thee, O God; let all the people praise thee.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki inu awọn orilẹ-ède ki o dùn, ki nwọn ki o ma kọrin fun ayọ̀: nitoriti iwọ o fi ododo ṣe idajọ enia, iwọ o si jọba awọn orilẹ-ède li aiye.
entries.en: O let the nations be glad and sing for joy: for thou shalt judge the people righteously, and govern the nations upon earth. Selah.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki awọn enia ki o yìn ọ, Ọlọrun; jẹ ki gbogbo enia ki o yìn ọ.
entries.en: Let the people praise thee, O God; let all the people praise thee.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ilẹ yio to ma mu asunkún rẹ̀ wá; Ọlọrun, Ọlọrun wa tikararẹ̀ yio busi i fun wa.
entries.en: Then shall the earth yield her increase; and God, even our own God, shall bless us.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun yio busi i fun wa; ati gbogbo opin aiye yio si ma bẹ̀ru rẹ̀.
entries.en: God shall bless us; and all the ends of the earth shall fear him.

entries.yo: KI Ọlọrun ki o dide, ki a si tú awọn ọta rẹ̀ ka: ki awọn ti o korira rẹ̀ pẹlu, ki nwọn ki o salọ kuro niwaju rẹ̀.
entries.en: Let God arise, let his enemies be scattered: let them also that hate him flee before him.

entries.yo: Bi ẽfin ti ifẹ lọ, bẹ̃ni ki o fẹ́ wọn lọ; bi ida ti iyọ́ niwaju iná, bẹ̃ni ki enia buburu ki o ṣegbe niwaju Ọlọrun.
entries.en: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away: as wax melteth before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn jẹ ki inu awọn olododo ki o dùn; ki nwọn ki o yọ̀ niwaju Ọlọrun. nitõtọ, ki nwọn ki o yọ̀ gidigidi.
entries.en: But let the righteous be glad; let them rejoice before God: yea, let them exceedingly rejoice.

entries.yo: Ẹ kọrin si Ọlọrun, ẹ kọrin iyin si orukọ rẹ̀: ẹ la ọ̀na fun ẹniti nrekọja li aginju nipa JAH, orukọ rẹ̀, ki ẹ si ma yọ̀ niwaju rẹ̀.
entries.en: Sing unto God, sing praises to his name: extol him that rideth upon the heavens by his name JAH, and rejoice before him.

entries.yo: Baba awọn alainibaba ati onidajọ awọn opó, li Ọlọrun ni ibujoko rẹ̀ mimọ́.
entries.en: A father of the fatherless, and a judge of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun mu ẹni-ofo joko ninu ile: o mu awọn ti a dè li ẹ̀wọn jade wá si irọra: ṣugbọn awọn ọlọtẹ ni ngbe inu ilẹ gbigbẹ.
entries.en: God setteth the solitary in families: he bringeth out those which are bound with chains: but the rebellious dwell in a dry land.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun, nigbati iwọ jade lọ niwaju awọn enia rẹ, nigbati iwọ nrìn lọ larin aginju.
entries.en: O God, when thou wentest forth before thy people, when thou didst march through the wilderness; Selah:

entries.yo: Ilẹ mì, ọrun bọ silẹ niwaju Ọlọrun: ani Sinai tikararẹ̀ mì niwaju Ọlọrun, Ọlọrun Israeli.
entries.en: The earth shook, the heavens also dropped at the presence of God: even Sinai itself was moved at the presence of God, the God of Israel.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun, iwọ li o rán ọ̀pọlọpọ òjo si ilẹ-ini rẹ, nigbati o rẹ̀ ẹ tan, iwọ tù u lara.
entries.en: Thou, O God, didst send a plentiful rain, whereby thou didst confirm thine inheritance, when it was weary.

entries.yo: Ijọ enia rẹ li o tẹ̀do sinu rẹ̀: iwọ Ọlọrun ninu ore rẹ li o ti pèse fun awọn talaka.
entries.en: Thy congregation hath dwelt therein: thou, O God, hast prepared of thy goodness for the poor.

entries.yo: Oluwa ti sọ̀rọ: ọ̀pọlọpọ si li ogun awọn ẹniti nfi ayọ̀ rohin rẹ̀:
entries.en: The Lord gave the word: great was the company of those that published it.

entries.yo: Awọn ọba awọn ẹgbẹ ogun sa, nwọn sa lọ: obinrin ti o si joko ni ile ni npin ikogun na.
entries.en: Kings of armies did flee apace: and she that tarried at home divided the spoil.

entries.yo: Nigbati ẹnyin dubulẹ larin agbo ẹran, nigbana ni ẹnyin o dabi iyẹ adaba ti a bò ni fadaka, ati ìyẹ́ rẹ̀ pẹlu wura pupa.
entries.en: Though ye have lien among the pots, yet shall ye be as the wings of a dove covered with silver, and her feathers with yellow gold.

entries.yo: Nigbati Olodumare tú awọn ọba ká ninu rẹ̀, o dabi òjo-didì ni Salmoni.
entries.en: When the Almighty scattered kings in it, it was white as snow in Salmon.

entries.yo: Òke Ọlọrun li òke Baṣani: òke ti o ni ori pupọ li òke Baṣani.
entries.en: The hill of God is as the hill of Bashan; an high hill as the hill of Bashan.

entries.yo: Ẽṣe ti ẹnyin nfi ilara wò, ẹnyin òke, òke na ti Ọlọrun fẹ lati ma gbe? nitõtọ, Oluwa yio ma gbe ibẹ lailai.
entries.en: Why leap ye, ye high hills? this is the hill which God desireth to dwell in; yea, the LORD will dwell in it for ever.

entries.yo: Ainiye ni kẹkẹ́ ogun Ọlọrun, ani ẹgbẹrun ati ẹgbẹgbẹrun: Oluwa mbẹ larin wọn, ni Sinai ni ibi mimọ́ nì.
entries.en: The chariots of God are twenty thousand, even thousands of angels: the Lord is among them, as in Sinai, in the holy place.

entries.yo: Iwọ ti gòke si ibi giga, iwọ ti di igbekun ni igbekun lọ: iwọ ti gbà ẹ̀bun fun enia: nitõtọ, fun awọn ọlọtẹ̀ pẹlu, ki Oluwa Ọlọrun ki o le ma ba wọn gbe.
entries.en: Thou hast ascended on high, thou hast led captivity captive: thou hast received gifts for men; yea, for the rebellious also, that the LORD God might dwell among them.

entries.yo: Olubukún li Oluwa, ẹni ti o nba wa gbé ẹrù wa lojojumọ; Ọlọrun ni igbala wa.
entries.en: Blessed be the Lord, who daily loadeth us with benefits, even the God of our salvation. Selah.

entries.yo: Ẹniti iṣe Ọlọrun wa li Ọlọrun igbala; ati lọwọ Jehofah Oluwa, li amúwa lọwọ ikú wà.
entries.en: He that is our God is the God of salvation; and unto God the Lord belong the issues from death.

entries.yo: Nitori Ọlọrun yio fọ ori awọn ọta rẹ̀, ati agbari onirun ti iru ẹniti nrìn sibẹ ninu ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: But God shall wound the head of his enemies, and the hairy scalp of such an one as goeth on still in his trespasses.

entries.yo: Oluwa wipe, emi o tun mu pada lati Baṣani wá, emi o tun mu wọn pada lati ibu okun wá.
entries.en: The Lord said, I will bring again from Bashan, I will bring my people again from the depths of the sea:

entries.yo: Ki ẹsẹ rẹ ki o le pọ́n ninu ẹ̀jẹ awọn ọta rẹ, ati àhọn awọn aja rẹ ninu rẹ̀ na.
entries.en: That thy foot may be dipped in the blood of thine enemies, and the tongue of thy dogs in the same.

entries.yo: Nwọn ti ri ìrin rẹ, Ọlọrun; ani ìrin Ọlọrun mi, Ọba mi, ninu ibi mimọ́ nì.
entries.en: They have seen thy goings, O God; even the goings of my God, my King, in the sanctuary.

entries.yo: Awọn akọrin lọ niwaju, awọn olohun-elo orin kẹhin; larin awọn ọmọbinrin ti nwọn nlu ìlu.
entries.en: The singers went before, the players on instruments followed after; among them were the damsels playing with timbrels.

entries.yo: Ẹ fi ibukún fun Ọlọrun li ẹgbẹgbẹ, ani fun Oluwa, ẹnyin ti o ti orisun Israeli wá.
entries.en: Bless ye God in the congregations, even the Lord, from the fountain of Israel.

entries.yo: Nibẹ ni Benjamini kekere wà, pẹlu olori wọn, awọn ọmọ-alade Juda pẹlu awọn igbimọ wọn, awọn ọmọ-alade Sebuloni, ati awọn ọmọ-alade Naftali.
entries.en: There is little Benjamin with their ruler, the princes of Judah and their council, the princes of Zebulun, and the princes of Naphtali.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun rẹ ti paṣẹ agbara rẹ: Ọlọrun fi ẹsẹ eyi ti o ti ṣe fun wa mulẹ.
entries.en: Thy God hath commanded thy strength: strengthen, O God, that which thou hast wrought for us.

entries.yo: Nitori tempili rẹ ni Jerusalemu li awọn ọba yio ma mu ọrẹ fun ọ wá.
entries.en: Because of thy temple at Jerusalem shall kings bring presents unto thee.

entries.yo: Ba awọn ẹranko ẽsu wi, ọ̀pọlọpọ awọn akọ-malu, pẹlu awọn ọmọ-malu enia, titi olukulùku yio fi foribalẹ pẹlu ìwọn fadaka: tú awọn enia ti nṣe inu didùn si ogun ka.
entries.en: Rebuke the company of spearmen, the multitude of the bulls, with the calves of the people, till every one submit himself with pieces of silver: scatter thou the people that delight in war.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ-alade yio ti Egipti jade wá; nisisiyi ni Etiopia yio nà ọwọ rẹ̀ si Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Princes shall come out of Egypt; Ethiopia shall soon stretch out her hands unto God.

entries.yo: Ẹ kọrin si Ọlọrun, ẹnyin ijọba aiye; ẹ kọrin iyìn si Oluwa.
entries.en: Sing unto God, ye kingdoms of the earth; O sing praises unto the Lord; Selah:

entries.yo: Si ẹniti ngùn ati ọrun de ọrun atijọ; wò o, o fọhùn rẹ̀, eyi na li ohùn nla.
entries.en: To him that rideth upon the heavens of heavens, which were of old; lo, he doth send out his voice, and that a mighty voice.

entries.yo: Ẹ jẹwọ agbara fun Ọlọrun; ọlá-nla rẹ̀ wà lori Israeli, ati agbara rẹ̀ mbẹ li awọsanma.
entries.en: Ascribe ye strength unto God: his excellency is over Israel, and his strength is in the clouds.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun, iwọ li ẹ̀ru lati ibi mimọ́ rẹ wọnni wá: Ọlọrun Israeli li On, ti nfi ilera ati agbara fun awọn enia rẹ̀. Olubukún li Ọlọrun!
entries.en: O God, thou art terrible out of thy holy places: the God of Israel is he that giveth strength and power unto his people. Blessed be God.

entries.yo: ỌLỌRUN, gbà mi; nitoriti omi wọnni wọ̀ inu lọ si ọkàn mi.
entries.en: Save me, O God; for the waters are come in unto my soul.

entries.yo: Emi rì ninu irà jijin, nibiti ibuduro kò si, emi de inu omi jijin wọnni, nibiti iṣan-omi ṣàn bò mi lori.
entries.en: I sink in deep mire, where there is no standing: I am come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.

entries.yo: Agara ẹkun mi da mi: ọfun mi gbẹ: oju kún mi nigbati emi duro de Ọlọrun mi.
entries.en: I am weary of my crying: my throat is dried: mine eyes fail while I wait for my God.

entries.yo: Awọn ti o korira mi lainidi jù irun ori mi lọ: awọn ti nṣe ọta mi laiṣẹ, ti iba pa mi run, nwọn lagbara: nigbana ni mo san ohun ti emi kò mu.
entries.en: They that hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of mine head: they that would destroy me, being mine enemies wrongfully, are mighty: then I restored that which I took not away.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun, iwọ mọ̀ wère mi, ẹ̀ṣẹ mi kò si lumọ kuro loju rẹ.
entries.en: O God, thou knowest my foolishness; and my sins are not hid from thee.

entries.yo: Oluwa, Ọlọrun awọn ọmọ-ogun, máṣe jẹ ki oju ki o tì awọn ti o duro de ọ nitori mi: máṣe jẹ ki awọn ti nwá ọ ki o damu nitori mi, Ọlọrun Israeli.
entries.en: Let not them that wait on thee, O Lord GOD of hosts, be ashamed for my sake: let not those that seek thee be confounded for my sake, O God of Israel.

entries.yo: Nitoripe nitori tirẹ li emi ṣe nrù ẹ̀gan; itiju ti bo mi loju.
entries.en: Because for thy sake I have borne reproach; shame hath covered my face.

entries.yo: Emi di àjeji si awọn arakunrin mi, ati alejo si awọn ọmọ iya mi.
entries.en: I am become a stranger unto my brethren, and an alien unto my mother's children.

entries.yo: Nitori ti itara ile rẹ ti jẹ mi tan; ati ẹ̀gan awọn ti o gàn ọ, ṣubu lù mi.
entries.en: For the zeal of thine house hath eaten me up; and the reproaches of them that reproached thee are fallen upon me.

entries.yo: Nigbati mo sọkun, ti mo si nfi àwẹ jẹ ara mi ni ìya, eyi na si di ẹ̀gan mi.
entries.en: When I wept, and chastened my soul with fasting, that was to my reproach.

entries.yo: Emi fi aṣọ ọ̀fọ sẹ aṣọ mi pẹlu: mo si di ẹni-owe fun wọn.
entries.en: I made sackcloth also my garment; and I became a proverb to them.

entries.yo: Awọn ti o joko li ẹnu-bode nsọ̀rọ si mi; emi si di orin awọn ọmuti.
entries.en: They that sit in the gate speak against me; and I was the song of the drunkards.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi o ṣe ti emi ni, iwọ li emi ngbadura mi si, Oluwa, ni igba itẹwọgba: Ọlọrun, ninu ọ̀pọlọpọ ãnu rẹ da mi lohùn, ninu otitọ igbala rẹ.
entries.en: But as for me, my prayer is unto thee, O LORD, in an acceptable time: O God, in the multitude of thy mercy hear me, in the truth of thy salvation.

entries.yo: Yọ mi kuro ninu ẹrẹ̀, má si ṣe jẹ ki emi ki o rì: gbigbà ni ki a gbà mi lọwọ awọn ti o korira mi, ati ninu omi jijìn wọnni.
entries.en: Deliver me out of the mire, and let me not sink: let me be delivered from them that hate me, and out of the deep waters.

entries.yo: Máṣe jẹ ki kikún-omi ki o bò mi mọlẹ, bẹ̃ni ki o máṣe jẹ ki ọgbun ki o gbé mi mì, ki o má si ṣe jẹ ki iho ki o pa ẹnu rẹ̀ de mọ́ mi.
entries.en: Let not the waterflood overflow me, neither let the deep swallow me up, and let not the pit shut her mouth upon me.

entries.yo: Oluwa, da mi lohùn; nitori ti iṣeun ifẹ rẹ dara, yipada si mi gẹgẹ bi ọ̀pọlọpọ irọnu ãnu rẹ.
entries.en: Hear me, O LORD; for thy lovingkindness is good: turn unto me according to the multitude of thy tender mercies.

entries.yo: Ki o má si ṣe pa oju rẹ mọ́ kuro lara iranṣẹ rẹ: emi sa wà ninu ipọnju; yara, da mi lohùn.
entries.en: And hide not thy face from thy servant; for I am in trouble: hear me speedily.

entries.yo: Sunmọ ọkàn mi, si rà a pada: gbà mi nitori awọn ọta mi.
entries.en: Draw nigh unto my soul, and redeem it: deliver me because of mine enemies.

entries.yo: Iwọ ti mọ̀ ẹ̀gan mi ati ìtiju mi, ati alailọla mi: gbogbo awọn ọta mi li o wà niwaju rẹ.
entries.en: Thou hast known my reproach, and my shame, and my dishonour: mine adversaries are all before thee.

entries.yo: Ẹgan ti bà mi ni inu jẹ; emi si kún fun ikãnu: emi si woye fun ẹniti yio ṣãnu fun mi, ṣugbọn kò si; ati fun awọn olutunu, emi kò si ri ẹnikan.
entries.en: Reproach hath broken my heart; and I am full of heaviness: and I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; and for comforters, but I found none.

entries.yo: Nwọn fi orõro fun mi pẹlu li ohun jijẹ mi; ati li ongbẹ mi nwọn fun mi li ọti kikan ni mimu.
entries.en: They gave me also gall for my meat; and in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki tabili wọn ki o di ikẹkun niwaju wọn: fun awọn ti o wà li alafia, ki o si di okùn didẹ.
entries.en: Let their table become a snare before them: and that which should have been for their welfare, let it become a trap.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki oju wọn ki o ṣú, ki nwọn ki o má riran, ki o si ma mu ẹgbẹ́ wọn gbọn nigbagbogbo.
entries.en: Let their eyes be darkened, that they see not; and make their loins continually to shake.

entries.yo: Dà irunu rẹ si wọn lori, si jẹ ki ikannu ibinu rẹ ki o le wọn ba.
entries.en: Pour out thine indignation upon them, and let thy wrathful anger take hold of them.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki ibujoko wọn ki o di ahoro; ki ẹnikẹni ki o máṣe gbe inu agọ wọn.
entries.en: Let their habitation be desolate; and let none dwell in their tents.

entries.yo: Nitori ti nwọn nṣe inunibini si ẹniti iwọ ti lù; nwọn si nsọ̀rọ ibinujẹ ti awọn ti iwọ ti ṣá li ọgbẹ.
entries.en: For they persecute him whom thou hast smitten; and they talk to the grief of those whom thou hast wounded.

entries.yo: Fi ẹ̀ṣẹ kún ẹ̀ṣẹ wọn: ki o má si ṣe jẹ ki nwọn ki o wá sinu ododo rẹ.
entries.en: Add iniquity unto their iniquity: and let them not come into thy righteousness.

entries.yo: Nù wọn kuro ninu iwe awọn alãye, ki a má si kọwe wọn pẹlu awọn olododo.
entries.en: Let them be blotted out of the book of the living, and not be written with the righteous.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn talaka ati ẹni-ikãnu li emi, Ọlọrun jẹ ki igbala rẹ ki o gbé mi leke.
entries.en: But I am poor and sorrowful: let thy salvation, O God, set me up on high.

entries.yo: Emi o fi orin yìn orukọ Ọlọrun, emi o si fi ọpẹ gbé orukọ rẹ̀ ga.
entries.en: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.

entries.yo: Eyi pẹlu ni yio wù Oluwa jù ọda-malu tabi akọ-malu lọ ti o ni iwo ati bàta ẹsẹ.
entries.en: This also shall please the LORD better than an ox or bullock that hath horns and hoofs.

entries.yo: Awọn onirẹlẹ yio ri eyi, inu wọn o si dùn: ọkàn ẹnyin ti nwá Ọlọrun yio si wà lãye.
entries.en: The humble shall see this, and be glad: and your heart shall live that seek God.

entries.yo: Nitoriti Oluwa gbohùn awọn talaka, kò si fi oju pa awọn ara tubu rẹ̀ rẹ́.
entries.en: For the LORD heareth the poor, and despiseth not his prisoners.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki ọrun on aiye ki o yìn i, okun ati ohun gbogbo ti nrakò ninu wọn.
entries.en: Let the heaven and earth praise him, the seas, and everything that moveth therein.

entries.yo: Nitoriti Ọlọrun yio gbà Sioni là, yio si kọ́ ilu Juda wọnni: ki nwọn ki o le ma gbe ibẹ, ki nwọn ki o le ma ni i ni ilẹ-ini.
entries.en: For God will save Zion, and will build the cities of Judah: that they may dwell there, and have it in possession.

entries.yo: Iru-ọmọ awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀ pẹlu ni yio ma jogun rẹ̀: awọn ti o si fẹ orukọ rẹ̀ ni yio ma gbe inu rẹ̀.
entries.en: The seed also of his servants shall inherit it: and they that love his name shall dwell therein.

entries.yo: ỌLỌRUN, yara gbà mi; Oluwa, yara lati ràn mi lọwọ.
entries.en: Make haste, O God, to deliver me; make haste to help me, O LORD.

entries.yo: Ki oju ki o tì awọn ti nwá ọkàn mi, ki nwọn ki o si dãmu: ki nwọn ki o si pada sẹhin, ki a si dãmu awọn ti nwá ifarapa mi.
entries.en: Let them be ashamed and confounded that seek after my soul: let them be turned backward, and put to confusion, that desire my hurt.

entries.yo: Ki a pa wọn li ẹhìn dà fun ère itiju awọn ti nwi pe, A! a!
