entries.en: Let them be turned back for a reward of their shame that say, Aha, aha.

entries.yo: Ki gbogbo awọn ti nwá ọ ki o ma yọ̀, ki inu wọn ki o si ma dùn nipa tirẹ: ki iru awọn ti o si fẹ igbala rẹ ki o ma wi nigbagbogbo pe, Ki a gbé Ọlọrun ga!
entries.en: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: and let such as love thy salvation say continually, Let God be magnified.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn talaka ati alaini li emi: Ọlọrun, yara si mi: iwọ li oluranlọwọ ati olugbala mi: Oluwa, máṣe pẹ́ titi.
entries.en: But I am poor and needy: make haste unto me, O God: thou art my help and my deliverer; O LORD, make no tarrying.

entries.yo: OLUWA, iwọ ni mo gbẹkẹ mi le: lai máṣe jẹ ki a dãmu mi.
entries.en: In thee, O LORD, do I put my trust: let me never be put to confusion.

entries.yo: Gbà mi nipa ododo rẹ, ki o si mu mi yọ̀: dẹ eti rẹ si mi, ki o si gbà mi.
entries.en: Deliver me in thy righteousness, and cause me to escape: incline thine ear unto me, and save me.

entries.yo: Iwọ ni ki o ṣe ibujoko apata mi, nibiti emi o gbe ma rè nigbagbogbo: iwọ ti paṣẹ lati gbà mi; nitori iwọ li apata ati odi agbara mi.
entries.en: Be thou my strong habitation, whereunto I may continually resort: thou hast given commandment to save me; for thou art my rock and my fortress.

entries.yo: Gbà mi, Ọlọrun mi, li ọwọ awọn enia buburu, li ọwọ alaiṣododo ati ìka ọkunrin.
entries.en: Deliver me, O my God, out of the hand of the wicked, out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.

entries.yo: Nitori iwọ ni ireti mi, Oluwa Ọlọrun; iwọ ni igbẹkẹle mi lati igba ewe mi.
entries.en: For thou art my hope, O Lord GOD: thou art my trust from my youth.

entries.yo: Ọwọ rẹ li a ti fi gbé mi duro lati inu wá: iwọ li ẹniti o mu mi jade lati inu iya mi wá: nipasẹ rẹ ni iyìn mi wà nigbagbogbo.
entries.en: By thee have I been holden up from the womb: thou art he that took me out of my mother's bowels: my praise shall be continually of thee.

entries.yo: Emi dabi ẹni-iyanu fun ọ̀pọlọpọ enia, ṣugbọn iwọ li àbo mi ti o lagbara.
entries.en: I am as a wonder unto many; but thou art my strong refuge.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki ẹnu mi ki o kún fun iyìn rẹ ati fun ọlá rẹ li ọjọ gbogbo.
entries.en: Let my mouth be filled with thy praise and with thy honour all the day.

entries.yo: Máṣe ṣa mi ti ni ìgba ogbó; máṣe kọ̀ mi silẹ nigbati agbara mi ba yẹ̀.
entries.en: Cast me not off in the time of old age; forsake me not when my strength faileth.

entries.yo: Nitori awọn ọta mi nsọ̀rọ si mi; awọn ti nṣọ ọkàn mi si gbimọ̀ pọ̀.
entries.en: For mine enemies speak against me; and they that lay wait for my soul take counsel together,

entries.yo: Nwọn wipe, Ọlọrun ti kọ̀ ọ silẹ: ẹ lepa ki ẹ si mu u; nitori ti kò si ẹniti yio gbà a.
entries.en: Saying, God hath forsaken him: persecute and take him; for there is none to deliver him.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun, máṣe jina si mi: Ọlọrun mi, yara si iranlọwọ mi.
entries.en: O God, be not far from me: O my God, make haste for my help.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki nwọn ki o dãmu, ki a si run awọn ti nṣe ọta ọkàn mi, ki a si fi ẹ̀gan ati àbuku bo awọn ti nwá ifarapa mi.
entries.en: Let them be confounded and consumed that are adversaries to my soul; let them be covered with reproach and dishonour that seek my hurt.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi o ma reti nigbagbogbo, emi o si ma fi iyìn kún iyìn rẹ.
entries.en: But I will hope continually, and will yet praise thee more and more.

entries.yo: Ẹnu mi yio ma fi ododo rẹ ati igbala rẹ hàn li ọjọ gbogbo; emi kò sa mọ̀ iye rẹ̀.
entries.en: My mouth shall shew forth thy righteousness and thy salvation all the day; for I know not the numbers thereof.

entries.yo: Emi o wá li agbara Oluwa Ọlọrun; emi o ma da ọ̀rọ ododo rẹ sọ, ani tirẹ nikan.
entries.en: I will go in the strength of the Lord GOD: I will make mention of thy righteousness, even of thine only.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun, iwọ ti kọ́ mi lati igba ewe mi wá: ati di isisiyi li emi ti nsọ̀rọ iṣẹ iyanu rẹ.
entries.en: O God, thou hast taught me from my youth: and hitherto have I declared thy wondrous works.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu, nigbati emi di arugbo tan ti mo hewu, Ọlọrun máṣe kọ̀ mi; titi emi o fi fi ipá rẹ hàn fun iran yi, ati agbara rẹ fun gbogbo awọn ara ẹ̀hin.
entries.en: Now also when I am old and grayheaded, O God, forsake me not; until I have shewed thy strength unto this generation, and thy power to every one that is to come.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun ododo rẹ ga jọjọ pẹlu, ẹniti o ti nṣe nkan nla: Ọlọrun, tali o dabi iwọ!
entries.en: Thy righteousness also, O God, is very high, who hast done great things: O God, who is like unto thee!

entries.yo: Iwọ ti o fi iṣẹ nla ati kikan hàn mi, ni yio si tun mi ji, yio si tun mu mi sọ si òke lati ọgbun ilẹ wá.
entries.en: Thou, which hast shewed me great and sore troubles, shalt quicken me again, and shalt bring me up again from the depths of the earth.

entries.yo: Iwọ o sọ ọlá mi di pupọ̀, iwọ o si tù mi ninu niha gbogbo.
entries.en: Thou shalt increase my greatness, and comfort me on every side.

entries.yo: Emi o si fi ohun-elo orin yìn ọ pẹlu, ani otitọ rẹ, Ọlọrun mi: iwọ li emi o ma fi duru kọrin si, iwọ Ẹni-Mimọ́ Israeli.
entries.en: I will also praise thee with the psaltery, even thy truth, O my God: unto thee will I sing with the harp, O thou Holy One of Israel.

entries.yo: Ete mi yio yọ̀ gidigidi, nigbati mo ba nkọrin si ọ: ati ọkàn mi, ti iwọ ti rapada.
entries.en: My lips shall greatly rejoice when I sing unto thee; and my soul, which thou hast redeemed.

entries.yo: Ahọn mi pẹlu yio si ma sọ̀rọ ododo rẹ titi li ọjọ gbogbo: nitoriti nwọn dãmu, a si doju ti awọn tí nwá ifarapa mi.
entries.en: My tongue also shall talk of thy righteousness all the day long: for they are confounded, for they are brought unto shame, that seek my hurt.

entries.yo: ỌLỌRUN, fi idajọ rẹ fun ọba, ati ododo rẹ fun ọmọ ọba.
entries.en: Give the king thy judgments, O God, and thy righteousness unto the king's son.

entries.yo: On o ma fi ododo ṣe idajọ awọn enia rẹ, yio si ma fi ẹtọ́ ṣe idajọ awọn talaka rẹ.
entries.en: He shall judge thy people with righteousness, and thy poor with judgment.

entries.yo: Awọn òke nla yio ma mu alafia fun awọn enia wá, ati awọn òke kekeke nipa ododo.
entries.en: The mountains shall bring peace to the people, and the little hills, by righteousness.

entries.yo: On o ma ṣe idajọ awọn talaka enia, yio ma gbà awọn ọmọ awọn alaini, yio si fà aninilara ya pẹrẹ-pẹrẹ.
entries.en: He shall judge the poor of the people, he shall save the children of the needy, and shall break in pieces the oppressor.

entries.yo: Nwọn o si ma bẹ̀ru rẹ, niwọ̀n bi õrùn ati oṣupa yio ti pẹ to, lati irandiran.
entries.en: They shall fear thee as long as the sun and moon endure, throughout all generations.

entries.yo: On o rọ̀ si ilẹ bi ojò si ori koriko itẹ̀mọlẹ: bi ọwọ òjo ti o rin ilẹ.
entries.en: He shall come down like rain upon the mown grass: as showers that water the earth.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ rẹ̀ li awọn olododo yio gbilẹ: ati ọ̀pọlopọ alafia niwọn bi òṣupa yio ti pẹ to.
entries.en: In his days shall the righteous flourish; and abundance of peace so long as the moon endureth.

entries.yo: On o si jọba lati okun de okun, ati lati odò nì de opin aiye.
entries.en: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, and from the river unto the ends of the earth.

entries.yo: Awọn ti o joko li aginju yio tẹriba fun u; awọn ọta rẹ̀ yio si lá erupẹ ilẹ.
entries.en: They that dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him; and his enemies shall lick the dust.

entries.yo: Awọn ọba Tarṣiṣi, ati ti awọn erekuṣu yio mu ọrẹ wá: awọn ọba Ṣeba ati ti Seba yio mu ẹ̀bun wá.
entries.en: The kings of Tarshish and of the isles shall bring presents: the kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ, gbogbo awọn ọba ni yio wolẹ niwaju rẹ̀: gbogbo awọn orilẹ-ède ni yio ma sìn i.
entries.en: Yea, all kings shall fall down before him: all nations shall serve him.

entries.yo: Nitori yio gbà alaini nigbati o ba nke: talaka pẹlu, ati ẹniti kò li oluranlọwọ.
entries.en: For he shall deliver the needy when he crieth; the poor also, and him that hath no helper.

entries.yo: On o da talaka ati alaini si, yio si gbà ọkàn awọn alaini là.
entries.en: He shall spare the poor and needy, and shall save the souls of the needy.

entries.yo: On o rà ọkàn wọn pada lọwọ ẹ̀tan ati ìwa-agbara: iyebiye si li ẹ̀jẹ wọn li oju rẹ̀.
entries.en: He shall redeem their soul from deceit and violence: and precious shall their blood be in his sight.

entries.yo: On o si yè, on li a o si fi wura Ṣeba fun: a o si ma gbadura fun u nigbagbogbo: lojojumọ li a o si ma yìn i.
entries.en: And he shall live, and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba: prayer also shall be made for him continually; and daily shall he be praised.

entries.yo: Ikúnwọ ọkà ni yio ma wà lori ilẹ, lori awọn òke nla li eso rẹ̀ yio ma mì bi Lebanoni: ati awọn ti inu ilu yio si ma gbà bi koriko ilẹ.
entries.en: There shall be an handful of corn in the earth upon the top of the mountains; the fruit thereof shall shake like Lebanon: and they of the city shall flourish like grass of the earth.

entries.yo: Orukọ rẹ̀ yio wà titi lai: orukọ rẹ̀ yio ma gbilẹ niwọn bi õrun yio ti pẹ to: nwọn o si ma bukún fun ara wọn nipaṣẹ rẹ̀: gbogbo awọn orilẹ-ède ni yio ma pè e li alabukúnfun.
entries.en: His name shall endure for ever: his name shall be continued as long as the sun: and men shall be blessed in him: all nations shall call him blessed.

entries.yo: Olubukún li Oluwa Ọlọrun, Ọlọrun Israeli, ẹnikanṣoṣo ti nṣe ohun iyanu.
entries.en: Blessed be the LORD God, the God of Israel, who only doeth wondrous things.

entries.yo: Olubukún li orukọ rẹ̀ ti o li ogo titi lai: ki gbogbo aiye ki o si kún fun ogo rẹ̀; Amin Amin.
entries.en: And blessed be his glorious name for ever: and let the whole earth be filled with his glory; Amen, and Amen.

entries.yo: Adura Dafidi ọmọ Jesse pari.
entries.en: The prayers of David the son of Jesse are ended.

entries.yo: NITÕTỌ Ọlọrun ṣeun fun Israeli, fun iru awọn ti iṣe alaiya mimọ́.
entries.en: Truly God is good to Israel, even to such as are of a clean heart.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi o ṣe ti emi ni, ẹsẹ mi fẹrẹ yẹ̀ tan; ìrin mi fẹrẹ yọ́ tan.
entries.en: But as for me, my feet were almost gone; my steps had well nigh slipped.

entries.yo: Nitori ti emi ṣe ilara si awọn aṣe-fefe, nigbati mo ri alafia awọn enia buburu.
entries.en: For I was envious at the foolish, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.

entries.yo: Nitoriti kò si irora ninu ikú wọn: agbara wọn si pọ̀.
entries.en: For there are no bands in their death: but their strength is firm.

entries.yo: Nwọn kò ni ipin ninu iyọnu enia; bẹ̃ni a kò si wahala wọn pẹlu ẹlomiran.
entries.en: They are not in trouble as other men; neither are they plagued like other men.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni igberaga ṣe ká wọn lọrun bi ẹ̀wọn ọṣọ́; ìwa-ipa bò wọn mọlẹ bi aṣọ.
entries.en: Therefore pride compasseth them about as a chain; violence covereth them as a garment.

entries.yo: Oju wọn yọ jade fun isanra: nwọn ní jù bi ọkàn wọn ti nfẹ lọ.
entries.en: Their eyes stand out with fatness: they have more than heart could wish.

entries.yo: Nwọn nṣẹsin, nwọn si nsọ̀rọ buburu niti inilara: nwọn nsọ̀rọ lati ibi giga.
entries.en: They are corrupt, and speak wickedly concerning oppression: they speak loftily.

entries.yo: Nwọn gbé ẹnu wọn le ọrun, ahọn wọn si nrìn ilẹ já.
entries.en: They set their mouth against the heavens, and their tongue walketh through the earth.

entries.yo: Nitorina li awọn enia rẹ̀ ṣe yipada si ihin: ọ̀pọlọpọ omi li a si npọn jade fun wọn.
entries.en: Therefore his people return hither: and waters of a full cup are wrung out to them.

entries.yo: Nwọn si wipe, Ọlọrun ti ṣe mọ̀? ìmọ ha wà ninu Ọga-ogo?
entries.en: And they say, How doth God know? and is there knowledge in the most High?

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, awọn wọnyi li alaìwa-bi-ọlọrun, ẹniti aiye nsan, nwọn npọ̀ li ọrọ̀.
entries.en: Behold, these are the ungodly, who prosper in the world; they increase in riches.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ li asan ni mo wẹ̀ aiya mi mọ́, ti mo si wẹ̀ ọwọ mi li ailẹ̀ṣẹ.
entries.en: Verily I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocency.

entries.yo: Nitoripe ni gbogbo ọjọ li a nyọ mi lẹnu, a si nnà mi li orowurọ.
entries.en: For all the day long have I been plagued, and chastened every morning.

entries.yo: Bi emi ba pe, emi o fọ̀ bayi: kiyesi i, emi o ṣẹ̀ si iran awọn ọmọ rẹ.
entries.en: If I say, I will speak thus; behold, I should offend against the generation of thy children.

entries.yo: Nigbati mo rò lati mọ̀ eyi, o ṣoro li oju mi.
entries.en: When I thought to know this, it was too painful for me;

entries.yo: Titi mo fi lọ sinu ibi-mimọ́ Ọlọrun; nigbana ni mo mọ̀ igbẹhin wọn.
entries.en: Until I went into the sanctuary of God; then understood I their end.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ iwọ gbé wọn ka ibi yiyọ́: iwọ tì wọn ṣubu sinu iparun.
entries.en: Surely thou didst set them in slippery places: thou castedst them down into destruction.

entries.yo: Bawo li a ti mu wọn lọ sinu idahoro yi, bi ẹnipe ni iṣẹju kan! ibẹru li a fi nrun wọn patapata.
entries.en: How are they brought into desolation, as in a moment! they are utterly consumed with terrors.

entries.yo: Bi igbati ẹnikan ba ji li oju alá; bẹ̃ni Oluwa, nigbati iwọ ba ji, iwọ o ṣe àbuku àworan wọn.
entries.en: As a dream when one awaketh; so, O Lord, when thou awakest, thou shalt despise their image.

entries.yo: Bayi ni inu mi bajẹ, ẹgún si gun mi li ọkàn mi.
entries.en: Thus my heart was grieved, and I was pricked in my reins.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni mo ṣiwere, ti emi kò si mọ̀ nkan; mo dabi ẹranko niwaju rẹ.
entries.en: So foolish was I, and ignorant: I was as a beast before thee.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi wà pẹlu rẹ nigbagbogbo: iwọ li o ti di ọwọ ọtún mi mu.
entries.en: Nevertheless I am continually with thee: thou hast holden me by my right hand.

entries.yo: Iwọ o fi ìmọ rẹ tọ́ mi li ọ̀na, ati nigbẹhin iwọ o gbà mi sinu ogo.
entries.en: Thou shalt guide me with thy counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.

entries.yo: Tani mo ni li ọrun bikoṣe iwọ? kò si si ohun ti mo fẹ li aiye pẹlu rẹ.
entries.en: Whom have I in heaven but thee? and there is none upon earth that I desire beside thee.

entries.yo: Ẹran-ara mi ati aiya mi di ãrẹ̀ tan: ṣugbọn Ọlọrun ni apata aiya mi, ati ipin mi lailai.
entries.en: My flesh and my heart faileth: but God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.

entries.yo: Sa wò o, awọn ti o jina si ọ yio ṣegbe: iwọ ti pa gbogbo wọn run ti nṣe àgbere kiri kuro lọdọ rẹ.
entries.en: For, lo, they that are far from thee shall perish: thou hast destroyed all them that go a whoring from thee.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn o dara fun mi lati sunmọ Ọlọrun: emi ti gbẹkẹ mi le Oluwa Ọlọrun, ki emi ki o le ma sọ̀rọ iṣẹ rẹ gbogbo.
entries.en: But it is good for me to draw near to God: I have put my trust in the Lord GOD, that I may declare all thy works.

entries.yo: ỌLỌRUN, ẽṣe ti iwọ fi ta wa nù titi lai! ẽṣe ti ibinu rẹ fi nrú si agutan papa rẹ?
entries.en: O God, why hast thou cast us off for ever? why doth thine anger smoke against the sheep of thy pasture?

entries.yo: Ranti ijọ enia rẹ ti iwọ ti rà nigba atijọ; ilẹ-ini rẹ ti iwọ ti rà pada; òke Sioni yi, ninu eyi ti iwọ ngbe.
entries.en: Remember thy congregation, which thou hast purchased of old; the rod of thine inheritance, which thou hast redeemed; this mount Zion, wherein thou hast dwelt.

entries.yo: Gbé ẹsẹ rẹ soke si ahoro lailai nì; ani si gbogbo eyiti ọta ti fi buburu ṣe ni ibi-mimọ́.
entries.en: Lift up thy feet unto the perpetual desolations; even all that the enemy hath done wickedly in the sanctuary.

entries.yo: Awọn ọta rẹ nke ramu-ramu lãrin ijọ enia rẹ; nwọn gbé asia wọn soke fun àmi.
entries.en: Thine enemies roar in the midst of thy congregations; they set up their ensigns for signs.

entries.yo: Nwọn dabi ọkunrin ti ngbé akeke rẹ̀ soke ninu igbo didi,
entries.en: A man was famous according as he had lifted up axes upon the thick trees.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nisisiyi iṣẹ ọnà finfin ni nwọn fi akeke ati òlu wó lulẹ pọ̀ li ẹ̃kan.
entries.en: But now they break down the carved work thereof at once with axes and hammers.

entries.yo: Nwọn tinabọ ibi-mimọ́ rẹ, ni wiwo ibujoko orukọ rẹ lulẹ, nwọn sọ ọ di ẽri.
entries.en: They have cast fire into thy sanctuary, they have defiled by casting down the dwelling place of thy name to the ground.

entries.yo: Nwọn wi li ọkàn wọn pe, Ẹ jẹ ki a run wọn pọ̀: nwọn ti kun gbogbo ile Ọlọrun ni ilẹ na.
entries.en: They said in their hearts, Let us destroy them together: they have burned up all the synagogues of God in the land.

entries.yo: Awa kò ri àmi wa: kò si woli kan mọ́: bẹ̃ni kò si ẹnikan ninu wa ti o mọ̀ bi yio ti pẹ to.
entries.en: We see not our signs: there is no more any prophet: neither is there among us any that knoweth how long.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun, ọta yio ti kẹgan pẹ to? ki ọta ki o ha ma sọ̀rọ òdi si orukọ rẹ lailai?
entries.en: O God, how long shall the adversary reproach? shall the enemy blaspheme thy name for ever?

entries.yo: Ẽṣe ti iwọ fi fa ọwọ rẹ sẹhin, ani ọwọ ọtún rẹ? fà a yọ jade kuro li õkan aiya rẹ ki o si pa a run.
entries.en: Why withdrawest thou thy hand, even thy right hand? pluck it out of thy bosom.

entries.yo: Nitori Ọlọrun li Ọba mi li atijọ wá, ti nṣiṣẹ igbala lãrin aiye.
entries.en: For God is my King of old, working salvation in the midst of the earth.

entries.yo: Iwọ li o ti yà okun ni meji nipa agbara rẹ: iwọ ti fọ́ ori awọn erinmi ninu omi.
entries.en: Thou didst divide the sea by thy strength: thou brakest the heads of the dragons in the waters.

entries.yo: Iwọ fọ́ ori Lefiatani tũtu, o si fi i ṣe onjẹ fun awọn ti ngbe inu ijù.
entries.en: Thou brakest the heads of leviathan in pieces, and gavest him to be meat to the people inhabiting the wilderness.

entries.yo: Iwọ là orisun ati iṣan-omi: iwọ gbẹ awọn odò nla.
entries.en: Thou didst cleave the fountain and the flood: thou driedst up mighty rivers.

entries.yo: Tirẹ li ọsán, tirẹ li oru pẹlu: iwọ li o ti pèse imọlẹ ati õrun.
entries.en: The day is thine, the night also is thine: thou hast prepared the light and the sun.

entries.yo: Iwọ li o ti pàla eti aiye: iwọ li o ṣe igba ẹ̀run ati igba otutu.
entries.en: Thou hast set all the borders of the earth: thou hast made summer and winter.

entries.yo: Ranti eyi, Oluwa, pe ọta nkẹgàn, ati pe awọn enia buburu nsọ̀rọ odi si orukọ rẹ.
entries.en: Remember this, that the enemy hath reproached, O LORD, and that the foolish people have blasphemed thy name.

entries.yo: Máṣe fi ọkàn àdaba rẹ le ẹranko igbẹ lọwọ: máṣe gbagbe ijọ awọn talaka rẹ lailai.
entries.en: O deliver not the soul of thy turtledove unto the multitude of the wicked: forget not the congregation of thy poor for ever.

entries.yo: Juba majẹmu nì: nitori ibi òkunkun aiye wọnni o kún fun ibugbe ìka.
entries.en: Have respect unto the covenant: for the dark places of the earth are full of the habitations of cruelty.

entries.yo: Máṣe jẹ ki ẹniti a ni lara ki o pada ni ìtiju; jẹ ki talaka ati alaini ki o yìn orukọ rẹ.
entries.en: O let not the oppressed return ashamed: let the poor and needy praise thy name.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun, dide, gbà ẹjọ ara rẹ rò: ranti bi aṣiwere enia ti ngàn ọ lojojumọ.
entries.en: Arise, O God, plead thine own cause: remember how the foolish man reproacheth thee daily.

entries.yo: Máṣe gbagbe ohùn awọn ọta rẹ: irọkẹ̀kẹ awọn ti o dide si ọ npọ̀ si i nigbagbogbo.
entries.en: Forget not the voice of thine enemies: the tumult of those that rise up against thee increaseth continually.

entries.yo: ỌLỌRUN, iwọ li awa fi ọpẹ fun, iwọ li awa fi ọpẹ fun nitori orukọ rẹ sunmọ itosi, iṣẹ iyanu rẹ fi hàn.
entries.en: Unto thee, O God, do we give thanks, unto thee do we give thanks: for that thy name is near thy wondrous works declare.

entries.yo: Nigbati akokò mi ba de, emi o fi otitọ ṣe idajọ.
entries.en: When I shall receive the congregation I will judge uprightly.

entries.yo: Aiye ati gbogbo awọn ti ngbe inu rẹ̀ warìri: emi li o rù ọwọ̀n rẹ̀.
entries.en: The earth and all the inhabitants thereof are dissolved: I bear up the pillars of it. Selah.

entries.yo: Emi wi fun awọn agberaga pe, Ẹ máṣe gbéraga mọ́: ati fun awọn enia buburu pe, Ẹ máṣe gbé iwo nì soke.
entries.en: I said unto the fools, Deal not foolishly: and to the wicked, Lift not up the horn:

entries.yo: Ẹ máṣe gbé iwo nyin ga: ẹ máṣe fi ọrùn lile sọ̀rọ.
entries.en: Lift not up your horn on high: speak not with a stiff neck.

entries.yo: Nitori ti igbega kò ti ìla-õrùn wá, tabi ni ìwọ-õrùn, bẹ̃ni kì iṣe lati gusu wá.
entries.en: For promotion cometh neither from the east, nor from the west, nor from the south.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Ọlọrun li onidajọ: o sọ ọkan kalẹ, o gbé ẹlomiran leke.
entries.en: But God is the judge: he putteth down one, and setteth up another.

entries.yo: Nitoripe li ọwọ Oluwa li ago kan wà, ọti-waini na si pọ́n: o kún fun àdalu: o si dà jade ninu rẹ̀; ṣugbọn gèdẹgẹdẹ rẹ̀, gbogbo awọn enia buburu aiye ni yio fun u li afun-mu.
entries.en: For in the hand of the LORD there is a cup, and the wine is red; it is full of mixture; and he poureth out of the same: but the dregs thereof, all the wicked of the earth shall wring them out, and drink them.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi o ma sọ titi lai, emi o ma kọrin iyìn si Ọlọrun Jakobu.
entries.en: But I will declare for ever; I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.

entries.yo: Gbogbo iwo awọn enia buburu li emi o ke kuro; ṣugbọn iwo awọn olododo li emi o gbé soke.
entries.en: All the horns of the wicked also will I cut off; but the horns of the righteous shall be exalted.

entries.yo: NI Juda li a gbe mọ̀ Ọlọrun: orukọ rẹ̀ si pọ̀ ni Israeli.
entries.en: In Judah is God known: his name is great in Israel.

entries.yo: Ni Salemu pẹlu li agọ rẹ̀ wà, ati ibujoko rẹ̀ ni Sioni.
entries.en: In Salem also is his tabernacle, and his dwelling place in Zion.

entries.yo: Nibẹ li o gbe ṣẹ́ ọfà, ọrun, apata, ati idà, ati ogun na.
entries.en: There brake he the arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the battle. Selah.

entries.yo: Iwọ li ogo ati ọlá jù òke-nla ikogun wọnni lọ.
entries.en: Thou art more glorious and excellent than the mountains of prey.

entries.yo: A kó awọn alaiya lile ni ikogun, nwọn ti sùn orun wọn, gbogbo ọkunrin alagbara kò si ri ọwọ wọn.
entries.en: The stouthearted are spoiled, they have slept their sleep: and none of the men of might have found their hands.

entries.yo: Nipa ibawi rẹ, Ọlọrun Jakobu, ati kẹkẹ́-ogun ati ẹṣin sun orun asunkú.
entries.en: At thy rebuke, O God of Jacob, both the chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.

entries.yo: Iwọ, ani iwọ li o ni ìbẹru: ati tani yio le duro niwaju rẹ, nigbati iwọ ba binu lẹ̃kan?
entries.en: Thou, even thou, art to be feared: and who may stand in thy sight when once thou art angry?

entries.yo: Iwọ mu idajọ di gbigbọ́ lati ọrun wá: ilẹ aiye bẹ̀ru o si duro jẹ.
entries.en: Thou didst cause judgment to be heard from heaven; the earth feared, and was still,

entries.yo: Nigbati Ọlọrun dide si idajọ, lati gbà gbogbo ọlọkan-tutu aiye là.
entries.en: When God arose to judgment, to save all the meek of the earth. Selah.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ ibinu enia yio yìn ọ: nigbati iwọ ba fi ibinu iyokù di ara rẹ li amure.
entries.en: Surely the wrath of man shall praise thee: the remainder of wrath shalt thou restrain.

entries.yo: Ẹ ṣe ileri ifẹ, ki ẹ si san a fun Oluwa, Ọlọrun nyin: jẹ ki gbogbo awọn ti o yi i ka ki o mu ẹ̀bun wá fun ẹniti a ba ma bẹ̀ru.
entries.en: Vow, and pay unto the LORD your God: let all that be round about him bring presents unto him that ought to be feared.

entries.yo: On o ke ẹmi awọn ọmọ alade kuro: on si di ẹ̀ru si awọn ọba aiye.
entries.en: He shall cut off the spirit of princes: he is terrible to the kings of the earth.

entries.yo: EMI fi ohùn mi kigbe si Ọlọrun, ani si Ọlọrun ni mo fi ohùn mi kepè; o si fi eti si mi.
entries.en: I cried unto God with my voice, even unto God with my voice; and he gave ear unto me.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ ipọnju mi emi ṣe afẹri Ọlọrun: ọwọ mi nnà li oru, kò si rẹ̀ silẹ: ọkàn mi kọ̀ ati tù ninu.
entries.en: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord: my sore ran in the night, and ceased not: my soul refused to be comforted.

entries.yo: Emi ranti Ọlọrun, emi kẹdun: emi ṣe aroye, ẹmi mi si rẹ̀wẹsi.
entries.en: I remembered God, and was troubled: I complained, and my spirit was overwhelmed. Selah.

entries.yo: Iwọ kò fẹ ki emi ki o fi oju ba orun: ẹnu yọ mi tobẹ̃ ti emi kò le sọ̀rọ.
entries.en: Thou holdest mine eyes waking: I am so troubled that I cannot speak.

entries.yo: Emi ti nrò ọjọ atijọ, ọdun igbani.
entries.en: I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.

entries.yo: Mo ranti orin mi li oru: emi mba aiya mi sọ̀rọ: ọkàn mi si nṣe awari jọjọ.
entries.en: I call to remembrance my song in the night: I commune with mine own heart: and my spirit made diligent search.

entries.yo: Oluwa yio ha ṣa ni tì lailai? kì o si ṣe oju rere mọ́?
entries.en: Will the Lord cast off for ever? and will he be favourable no more?

entries.yo: Anu rẹ̀ ha lọ lailai? ileri rẹ̀ ha yẹ̀ titi lai?
entries.en: Is his mercy clean gone for ever? doth his promise fail for evermore?

entries.yo: Ọlọrun ha gbagbe lati ṣe oju rere? ninu ibinu rẹ̀ o ha sé irọnu ãnu rẹ̀ mọ́?
entries.en: Hath God forgotten to be gracious? hath he in anger shut up his tender mercies? Selah.

entries.yo: Emi wipe, Eyi li ailera mi! eyi li ọdun ọwọ ọtún Ọga-ogo!
entries.en: And I said, This is my infirmity: but I will remember the years of the right hand of the most High.

entries.yo: Emi o ranti iṣẹ Oluwa: nitõtọ emi o ranti iṣẹ iyanu rẹ atijọ.
entries.en: I will remember the works of the LORD: surely I will remember thy wonders of old.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi o ma ṣe àṣaro gbogbo iṣẹ rẹ pẹlu, emi o si ma sọ̀rọ iṣẹ rẹ.
entries.en: I will meditate also of all thy work, and talk of thy doings.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun, ọ̀na rẹ mbẹ ninu ìwa-mimọ́: tali alagbara ti o tobi bi Ọlọrun?
entries.en: Thy way, O God, is in the sanctuary: who is so great a God as our God?

entries.yo: Iwọ li Alagbara ti nṣe iṣẹ iyanu: iwọ li o ti fi ipá rẹ hàn ninu awọn enia.
entries.en: Thou art the God that doest wonders: thou hast declared thy strength among the people.

entries.yo: Iwọ li o ti fi apá rẹ rà awọn enia rẹ pada, awọn ọmọ Jakobu ati Josefu.
entries.en: Thou hast with thine arm redeemed thy people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.

entries.yo: Omi ri ọ, Ọlọrun, omi ri ọ, ẹ̀ru bà wọn: nitõtọ ara ibú kò balẹ.
entries.en: The waters saw thee, O God, the waters saw thee; they were afraid: the depths also were troubled.

entries.yo: Awọsanma dà omi silẹ: ojusanma rán iró jade: ọfà rẹ jade lọ pẹlu.
entries.en: The clouds poured out water: the skies sent out a sound: thine arrows also went abroad.

entries.yo: Ohùn ãrá rẹ nsan li ọrun: manamana nkọ si aiye, ilẹ nwa-rìri, o si mì.
entries.en: The voice of thy thunder was in the heaven: the lightnings lightened the world: the earth trembled and shook.

entries.yo: Ọ̀na rẹ mbẹ li okun, ati ipa rẹ ninu awọn omi nla, ipasẹ rẹ li a kò si mọ̀.
entries.en: Thy way is in the sea, and thy path in the great waters, and thy footsteps are not known.

entries.yo: Iwọ dà awọn enia rẹ bi ọ̀wọ-ẹran nipa ọwọ Mose ati Aaroni.
entries.en: Thou leddest thy people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.

entries.yo: FI eti silẹ, ẹnyin enia mi, si ofin mi: dẹ eti nyin silẹ si ọ̀rọ ẹnu mi.
entries.en: Give ear, O my people, to my law: incline your ears to the words of my mouth.

entries.yo: Emi o ya ẹnu mi li owe: emi o sọ ọ̀rọ atijọ ti o ṣokunkun jade.
entries.en: I will open my mouth in a parable: I will utter dark sayings of old:

entries.yo: Ti awa ti gbọ́, ti a si ti mọ̀, ti awọn baba wa si ti sọ fun wa.
entries.en: Which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.

entries.yo: Awa kì yio pa wọn mọ́ kuro lọdọ awọn ọmọ wọn, ni fifi iyìn Oluwa, ati ipa rẹ̀, ati iṣẹ iyanu ti o ti ṣe hàn fun iran ti mbọ.
entries.en: We will not hide them from their children, shewing to the generation to come the praises of the LORD, and his strength, and his wonderful works that he hath done.

entries.yo: Nitori ti o gbé ẹri kalẹ ni Jakobu, o si sọ ofin kan ni Israeli, ti o ti pa li aṣẹ fun awọn baba wa pe, ki nwọn ki o le sọ wọn di mimọ̀ fun awọn ọmọ wọn.
entries.en: For he established a testimony in Jacob, and appointed a law in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children:

entries.yo: Ki awọn iran ti mbọ̀ ki o le mọ̀, ani awọn ọmọ ti a o bi: ti yio si dide, ti yio si sọ fun awọn ọmọ wọn:
entries.en: That the generation to come might know them, even the children which should be born; who should arise and declare them to their children:

entries.yo: Ki nwọn ki o le ma gbé ireti wọn le Ọlọrun, ki nwọn ki o má si ṣe gbagbe iṣẹ Ọlọrun, ṣugbọn ki nwọn ki o pa ofin rẹ̀ mọ́.
entries.en: That they might set their hope in God, and not forget the works of God, but keep his commandments:

entries.yo: Ki nwọn ki o máṣe dabi awọn baba wọn, iran alagidi ati ọlọ̀tẹ̀; iran ti kò fi ọkàn wọn le otitọ, ati ẹmi ẹniti kò ba Ọlọrun duro ṣinṣin.
entries.en: And might not be as their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation; a generation that set not their heart aright, and whose spirit was not stedfast with God.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Efraimu ti o hamọra ogun, ti nwọn mu ọrun, nwọn yipada li ọjọ ogun.
entries.en: The children of Ephraim, being armed, and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.

entries.yo: Nwọn kò pa majẹmu Ọlọrun mọ́, nwọn si kọ̀ lati ma rìn ninu ofin rẹ̀.
entries.en: They kept not the covenant of God, and refused to walk in his law;

entries.yo: Nwọn si gbagbe iṣẹ rẹ̀, ati ohun iyanu rẹ̀, ti o ti fi hàn fun wọn.
entries.en: And forgat his works, and his wonders that he had shewed them.

entries.yo: Ohun iyanu ti o ṣe niwaju awọn baba wọn ni ilẹ Egipti, ani ni igbẹ Soani.
entries.en: Marvellous things did he in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.

entries.yo: O pin okun ni ìya, o si mu wọn là a ja; o si mu omi duro bi bèbe.
entries.en: He divided the sea, and caused them to pass through; and he made the waters to stand as an heap.

entries.yo: Li ọsan pẹlu o fi awọsanma ṣe amọna wọn, ati li oru gbogbo pẹlu imọlẹ iná.
entries.en: In the daytime also he led them with a cloud, and all the night with a light of fire.

entries.yo: O sán apata li aginju, o si fun wọn li omi mímu lọpọlọpọ bi ẹnipe lati inu ibú wá.
entries.en: He clave the rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink as out of the great depths.

entries.yo: O si mu iṣàn-omi jade wá lati inu apata, o si mu omi ṣàn silẹ bi odò nla.
entries.en: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.

entries.yo: Nwọn si tún ṣẹ̀ si i; ni ṣiṣọtẹ si Ọga-ogo li aginju.
entries.en: And they sinned yet more against him by provoking the most High in the wilderness.

entries.yo: Nwọn si dán Ọlọrun wò li ọkàn wọn, ni bibère onjẹ fun ifẹkufẹ wọn.
entries.en: And they tempted God in their heart by asking meat for their lust.

entries.yo: Nwọn si sọ̀rọ si Ọlọrun; nwọn wipe, Ọlọrun ha le tẹ́ tabili li aginju?
entries.en: Yea, they spake against God; they said, Can God furnish a table in the wilderness?

entries.yo: Wò o! o lù apata, omi si tú jade, iṣàn-omi si kún pupọ; o ha le funni li àkara pẹlu? o ha le pèse ẹran fun awọn enia rẹ̀?
entries.en: Behold, he smote the rock, that the waters gushed out, and the streams overflowed; can he give bread also? can he provide flesh for his people?

entries.yo: Nitorina, Oluwa gbọ́ eyi, o binu: bẹ̃ni iná ràn ni Jakobu, ibinu si ru ni Israeli;
entries.en: Therefore the LORD heard this, and was wroth: so a fire was kindled against Jacob, and anger also came up against Israel;

entries.yo: Nitori ti nwọn kò gbà Ọlọrun gbọ́, nwọn kò si gbẹkẹle igbala rẹ̀.
entries.en: Because they believed not in God, and trusted not in his salvation:

entries.yo: O paṣẹ fun awọsanma lati òke wá, o si ṣi ilẹkùn ọrun silẹ.
entries.en: Though he had commanded the clouds from above, and opened the doors of heaven,

entries.yo: O si rọ̀jo Manna silẹ fun wọn ni jijẹ, o si fun wọn li ọkà ọrun.
entries.en: And had rained down manna upon them to eat, and had given them of the corn of heaven.

entries.yo: Enia jẹ onjẹ awọn angeli; o rán onjẹ si wọn li ajẹyo.
entries.en: Man did eat angels' food: he sent them meat to the full.

entries.yo: O mu afẹfẹ ìla-õrun fẹ li ọrun, ati nipa agbara rẹ̀ o mu afẹfẹ gusu wá.
entries.en: He caused an east wind to blow in the heaven: and by his power he brought in the south wind.

entries.yo: O rọ̀jo ẹran si wọn pẹlu bi erupẹ ilẹ, ati ẹiyẹ abiyẹ bi iyanrin okun.
entries.en: He rained flesh also upon them as dust, and feathered fowls like as the sand of the sea:

entries.yo: O si jẹ ki o bọ́ si ãrin ibudo wọn, yi agọ wọn ka.
entries.en: And he let it fall in the midst of their camp, round about their habitations.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni nwọn jẹ, nwọn si yo jọjọ: nitoriti o fi ifẹ wọn fun wọn.
entries.en: So they did eat, and were well filled: for he gave them their own desire;

entries.yo: Nwọn kò kuro ninu ifẹkufẹ wọn; nigbati onjẹ wọn si wà li ẹnu wọn.
entries.en: They were not estranged from their lust. But while their meat was yet in their mouths,

entries.yo: Ibinu Ọlọrun de si ori wọn, o pa awọn ti o sanra ninu wọn, o si lù awọn ọdọmọkunrin Israeli bolẹ.
entries.en: The wrath of God came upon them, and slew the fattest of them, and smote down the chosen men of Israel.

entries.yo: Ninu gbogbo wọnyi nwọn nṣẹ̀ siwaju, nwọn kò si gbà iṣẹ iyanu rẹ̀ gbọ́.
entries.en: For all this they sinned still, and believed not for his wondrous works.

entries.yo: Nitorina li o ṣe run ọjọ wọn li asan, ati ọdun wọn ni ijaiya.
entries.en: Therefore their days did he consume in vanity, and their years in trouble.

entries.yo: Nigbati o pa wọn, nigbana ni nwọn wá a kiri: nwọn si pada, nwọn bère Ọlọrun lakokò,
entries.en: When he slew them, then they sought him: and they returned and inquired early after God.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ranti pe, Ọlọrun li apata wọn, ati Ọlọrun Ọga-ogo li Oludande wọn,
entries.en: And they remembered that God was their rock, and the high God their redeemer.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹnu wọn ni nwọn fi pọ́n ọ, nwọn si fi ahọn wọn ṣeke si i.
entries.en: Nevertheless they did flatter him with their mouth, and they lied unto him with their tongues.

entries.yo: Nitori ọkàn wọn kò ṣe dẽde pẹlu rẹ̀, bẹ̃ni nwọn kò si duro ṣinṣin ni majẹmu rẹ̀.
entries.en: For their heart was not right with him, neither were they stedfast in his covenant.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn on, o kún fun iyọ́nu, o fi ẹ̀ṣẹ wọn jì wọn, kò si run wọn: nitõtọ, nigba pupọ̀ li o yi ibinu rẹ̀ pada, ti kò si ru gbogbo ibinu rẹ̀ soke.
entries.en: But he, being full of compassion, forgave their iniquity, and destroyed them not: yea, many a time turned he his anger away, and did not stir up all his wrath.

entries.yo: Nitoriti o ranti pe, enia ṣa ni nwọn; afẹfẹ ti nkọja lọ, ti kò si tun pada wá mọ.
entries.en: For he remembered that they were but flesh; a wind that passeth away, and cometh not again.

entries.yo: Igba melo-melo ni nwọn sọ̀tẹ si i li aginju, ti nwọn si bà a ninu jẹ ninu aṣálẹ!
entries.en: How oft did they provoke him in the wilderness, and grieve him in the desert!

entries.yo: Nitõtọ, nwọn yipada, nwọn si dan Ọlọrun wò, nwọn si ṣe aropin Ẹni-Mimọ́ Israeli.
entries.en: Yea, they turned back and tempted God, and limited the Holy One of Israel.

entries.yo: Nwọn kò ranti ọwọ rẹ̀, tabi ọjọ nì ti o gbà wọn lọwọ ọta.
entries.en: They remembered not his hand, nor the day when he delivered them from the enemy.

entries.yo: Bi o ti ṣe iṣẹ-àmi rẹ̀ ni Egipti, ati iṣẹ iyanu rẹ̀ ni igbẹ Soani.
entries.en: How he had wrought his signs in Egypt, and his wonders in the field of Zoan:

entries.yo: Ti o si sọ odò wọn di ẹ̀jẹ; ati omi ṣiṣan wọn, ti nwọn kò fi le mu u.
entries.en: And had turned their rivers into blood; and their floods, that they could not drink.

entries.yo: O rán eṣinṣin sinu wọn, ti o jẹ wọn; ati ọpọlọ, ti o run wọn.
entries.en: He sent divers sorts of flies among them, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.

entries.yo: O fi eso ilẹ wọn fun kokoro pẹlu, ati iṣẹ wọn fun ẽṣú.
entries.en: He gave also their increase unto the caterpiller, and their labour unto the locust.

entries.yo: O fi yinyin pa àjara wọn, o si fi yinyin nla pa igi sikamore wọn.
entries.en: He destroyed their vines with hail, and their sycomore trees with frost.

entries.yo: O fi ohun ọ̀sin wọn pẹlu fun yinyin, ati agbo-ẹran wọn fun manamana.
entries.en: He gave up their cattle also to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.

entries.yo: O mu kikoro ibinu rẹ̀ wá si wọn lara, irunu ati ikannu, ati ipọnju, nipa riran angeli ibi sinu wọn.
entries.en: He cast upon them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, and indignation, and trouble, by sending evil angels among them.

entries.yo: O ṣina silẹ fun ibinu rẹ̀; kò da ọkàn wọn si lọwọ ikú, ṣugbọn o fi ẹmi wọn fun àjakalẹ-àrun.
entries.en: He made a way to his anger; he spared not their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence;

entries.yo: O si kọlu gbogbo awọn akọbi ni Egipti, olori agbara wọn ninu agọ Hamu:
entries.en: And smote all the firstborn in Egypt; the chief of their strength in the tabernacles of Ham:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn o mu awọn enia tirẹ̀ lọ bi agutan, o si ṣe itọju wọn ni iju bi agbo-ẹran.
entries.en: But made his own people to go forth like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.

entries.yo: O si ṣe amọna wọn li alafia, bẹ̃ni nwọn kò si bẹ̀ru: ṣugbọn okun bò awọn ọta wọn mọlẹ.
entries.en: And he led them on safely, so that they feared not: but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.

entries.yo: O si mu wọn wá si eti ibi-mimọ́ rẹ̀, ani si òke yi ti ọwọ ọtún rẹ̀ ti rà.
entries.en: And he brought them to the border of his sanctuary, even to this mountain, which his right hand had purchased.

entries.yo: O tì awọn keferi jade pẹlu kuro niwaju wọn, o si fi tita okùn pinlẹ fun wọn ni ilẹ-ini, o si mu awọn ẹya Israeli joko ninu agọ wọn.
entries.en: He cast out the heathen also before them, and divided them an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nwọn dan a wò, nwọn si ṣọ̀tẹ si Ọlọrun Ọga-ogo, nwọn kò si pa ẹri rẹ̀ mọ́.
entries.en: Yet they tempted and provoked the most high God, and kept not his testimonies:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nwọn yipada, nwọn ṣe alaiṣotitọ bi awọn baba wọn: nwọn si pẹhinda si apakan bi ọrun ẹ̀tan.
entries.en: But turned back, and dealt unfaithfully like their fathers: they were turned aside like a deceitful bow.

entries.yo: Nitori ti nwọn fi ibi giga wọn bi i ninu, nwọn si fi ere finfin wọn mu u jowu.
entries.en: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their graven images.

entries.yo: Nigbati Ọlọrun gbọ́ eyi, o binu, o si korira Israeli gidigidi.
entries.en: When God heard this, he was wroth, and greatly abhorred Israel:

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li o kọ̀ agọ Ṣilo silẹ, agọ ti o pa ninu awọn enia.
entries.en: So that he forsook the tabernacle of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men;

entries.yo: O si fi agbara rẹ̀ fun igbekun, ati ogo rẹ̀ le ọwọ ọta nì.
entries.en: And delivered his strength into captivity, and his glory into the enemy's hand.

entries.yo: O fi awọn enia rẹ̀ fun idà pẹlu; o si binu si ilẹ-ini rẹ̀.
entries.en: He gave his people over also unto the sword; and was wroth with his inheritance.

entries.yo: Iná run awọn ọdọmọkunrin wọn; a kò si fi orin sin awọn wundia wọn ni iyawo.
entries.en: The fire consumed their young men; and their maidens were not given to marriage.

entries.yo: Awọn alufa wọn ti oju idà ṣubu; awọn opó wọn kò si pohunrere ẹkún.
entries.en: Their priests fell by the sword; and their widows made no lamentation.

entries.yo: Nigbana li Oluwa ji bi ẹnipe loju orun, ati bi alagbara ti o nkọ nitori ọti-waini.
entries.en: Then the Lord awaked as one out of sleep, and like a mighty man that shouteth by reason of wine.

entries.yo: O si kọlu awọn ọta rẹ̀ lẹhin; o sọ wọn di ẹ̀gan titi aiye.
entries.en: And he smote his enemies in the hinder parts: he put them to a perpetual reproach.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu o kọ̀ agọ Josefu, kò si yàn ẹ̀ya Efraimu:
entries.en: Moreover he refused the tabernacle of Joseph, and chose not the tribe of Ephraim:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn o yan ẹ̀ya Juda, òke Sioni ti o fẹ.
entries.en: But chose the tribe of Judah, the mount Zion which he loved.

entries.yo: O si kọ́ ibi-mimọ́ rẹ̀ bi òke-ọrun bi ilẹ ti o ti fi idi rẹ̀ mulẹ lailai.
entries.en: And he built his sanctuary like high palaces, like the earth which he hath established for ever.

entries.yo: O si yàn Dafidi iranṣẹ rẹ̀, o si mu u kuro lati inu agbo-agutan wá:
entries.en: He chose David also his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds:

entries.yo: Lati má tọ̀ awọn agutan lẹhin, ti o tobi fun oyun, o mu u lati ma bọ́ Jakobu, enia rẹ̀, ati Israeli, ilẹ-ini rẹ̀.
entries.en: From following the ewes great with young he brought him to feed Jacob his people, and Israel his inheritance.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li o bọ́ wọn gẹgẹ bi ìwa-titọ inu rẹ̀; o si fi ọgbọ́n ọwọ rẹ̀ ṣe amọna wọn.
entries.en: So he fed them according to the integrity of his heart; and guided them by the skilfulness of his hands.

entries.yo: ỌLỌRUN, awọn keferi wá si ilẹ-ini rẹ; tempili mimọ́ rẹ ni nwọn sọ di ẽri; nwọn sọ Jerusalemu di òkiti-alapa.
entries.en: O God, the heathen are come into thine inheritance; thy holy temple have they defiled; they have laid Jerusalem on heaps.

entries.yo: Okú awọn iranṣẹ rẹ ni nwọn fi fun ẹiyẹ oju-ọrun li onjẹ, ẹran-ara awọn enia mimọ́ rẹ fun ẹranko ilẹ.
entries.en: The dead bodies of thy servants have they given to be meat unto the fowls of the heaven, the flesh of thy saints unto the beasts of the earth.

entries.yo: Ẹ̀jẹ wọn ni nwọn ta silẹ bi omi yi Jerusalemu ka; kò si si ẹniti yio gbé wọn sìn.
entries.en: Their blood have they shed like water round about Jerusalem; and there was none to bury them.

entries.yo: Awa di ẹ̀gan si awọn aladugbo wa, ẹlẹya ati iyọṣuti si awọn ti o yi wa ka.
entries.en: We are become a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and derision to them that are round about us.

entries.yo: Yio ti pẹ to, Oluwa? iwọ o binu titi lailai? owú rẹ yio ha ma jó bi iná?
entries.en: How long, LORD? wilt thou be angry for ever? shall thy jealousy burn like fire?

entries.yo: Dà ibinu rẹ si ori awọn keferi ti kò mọ̀ ọ, ati si ori awọn ijọba ti kò kepè orukọ rẹ.
entries.en: Pour out thy wrath upon the heathen that have not known thee, and upon the kingdoms that have not called upon thy name.

entries.yo: Nitori ti nwọn ti mu Jakobu jẹ, nwọn si sọ ibujoko rẹ̀ di ahoro.
entries.en: For they have devoured Jacob, and laid waste his dwelling place.

entries.yo: Máṣe ranti ẹ̀ṣẹ awọn aṣaju wa si wa: jẹ ki iyọnu rẹ ki o ṣaju wa nisisiyi: nitori ti a rẹ̀ wa silẹ gidigidi.
entries.en: O remember not against us former iniquities: let thy tender mercies speedily prevent us: for we are brought very low.

entries.yo: Ràn wa lọwọ, Ọlọrun igbala wa, nitori ogo orukọ rẹ: ki o si gbà wa, ki o si wẹ̀ ẹ̀ṣẹ wa nù, nitori orukọ rẹ.
entries.en: Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of thy name: and deliver us, and purge away our sins, for thy name's sake.

entries.yo: Nitori kili awọn keferi yio ṣe wipe, Nibo li Ọlọrun wọn wà? jẹ ki a mọ̀ igbẹsan ẹ̀jẹ awọn iranṣẹ rẹ ti a ta silẹ loju wa ninu awọn keferi.
entries.en: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is their God? let him be known among the heathen in our sight by the revenging of the blood of thy servants which is shed.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki imi-ẹdun onde nì ki o wá siwaju rẹ: gẹgẹ bi titobi agbara rẹ, iwọ dá awọn ti a yàn si pipa silẹ:
entries.en: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before thee; according to the greatness of thy power preserve thou those that are appointed to die;

entries.yo: Ki o si san ẹ̀gan wọn nigba meje fun awọn aladugbo wa li aiya wọn, nipa eyiti nwọn ngàn ọ, Oluwa.
entries.en: And render unto our neighbours sevenfold into their bosom their reproach, wherewith they have reproached thee, O Lord.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li awa enia rẹ ati agutan papa rẹ, yio ma fi ọpẹ fun ọ lailai, awa o ma fi iyìn rẹ hàn lati irandiran.
entries.en: So we thy people and sheep of thy pasture will give thee thanks for ever: we will shew forth thy praise to all generations.

entries.yo: FI eti si ni, Oluṣọ-agutan Israeli, iwọ ti o ndà Josefu bi ọwọ́-agutan; iwọ ti o joko lãrin awọn kerubu tàn imọlẹ jade.
entries.en: Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel, thou that leadest Joseph like a flock; thou that dwellest between the cherubims, shine forth.

entries.yo: Niwaju Efraimu ati Benjamini ati Manasse rú ipa rẹ soke ki o si wá fun igbala wa.
entries.en: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh stir up thy strength, and come and save us.

entries.yo: Tún wa yipada, Ọlọrun, ki o si mu oju rẹ tàn imọlẹ; a o si gbà wa là.
entries.en: Turn us again, O God, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.

entries.yo: Oluwa Ọlọrun awọn ọmọ-ogun, iwọ o ti binu pẹ to si adura awọn enia rẹ?
entries.en: O LORD God of hosts, how long wilt thou be angry against the prayer of thy people?

entries.yo: Iwọ fi onjẹ omije bọ́ wọn; iwọ si fun wọn li omije mu li ọ̀pọlọpọ.
entries.en: Thou feedest them with the bread of tears; and givest them tears to drink in great measure.

entries.yo: Iwọ sọ wa di ijà fun awọn aladugbo wa: awọn ọta wa si nrẹrin ninu ara wọn.
entries.en: Thou makest us a strife unto our neighbours: and our enemies laugh among themselves.

entries.yo: Tún wa yipada, Ọlọrun awọn ọmọ-ogun, ki o si mu oju rẹ tàn imọlẹ; a o si gbà wa là.
entries.en: Turn us again, O God of hosts, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.

entries.yo: Iwọ ti mu ajara kan jade ti Egipti wá: iwọ ti tì awọn keferi jade, iwọ si gbin i.
entries.en: Thou hast brought a vine out of Egypt: thou hast cast out the heathen, and planted it.

entries.yo: Iwọ ṣe àye silẹ fun u, iwọ si mu u ta gbòngbo jinlẹ̀, o si kún ilẹ na.
entries.en: Thou preparedst room before it, and didst cause it to take deep root, and it filled the land.

entries.yo: A fi ojiji rẹ̀ bò awọn òke mọlẹ, ati ẹka rẹ̀ dabi igi kedari Ọlọrun.
entries.en: The hills were covered with the shadow of it, and the boughs thereof were like the goodly cedars.

entries.yo: O yọ ẹka rẹ̀ sinu okun, ati ọwọ rẹ̀ si odò nla nì.
entries.en: She sent out her boughs unto the sea, and her branches unto the river.

entries.yo: Ẽṣe ti iwọ ha fi ya ọgbà rẹ̀ bẹ̃, ti gbogbo awọn ẹniti nkọja lọ li ọ̀na nká a?
entries.en: Why hast thou then broken down her hedges, so that all they which pass by the way do pluck her?

entries.yo: Imado lati inu igbo wá mba a jẹ, ati ẹranko igbẹ njẹ ẹ run.
entries.en: The boar out of the wood doth waste it, and the wild beast of the field doth devour it.

entries.yo: Yipada, awa mbẹ ọ, Ọlọrun awọn ọmọ-ogun: wolẹ lati ọrun wá, ki o si wò o, ki o si bẹ àjara yi wò:
entries.en: Return, we beseech thee, O God of hosts: look down from heaven, and behold, and visit this vine;

entries.yo: Ati agbala-àjara ti ọwọ ọtún rẹ ti gbin, ati ọmọ ti iwọ ti mule fun ara rẹ.
entries.en: And the vineyard which thy right hand hath planted, and the branch that thou madest strong for thyself.

entries.yo: O jona, a ke e lulẹ: nwọn ṣegbe nipa ibawi oju rẹ.
entries.en: It is burned with fire, it is cut down: they perish at the rebuke of thy countenance.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki ọwọ rẹ ki o wà lara ọkunrin ọwọ ọtún rẹ nì, lara ọmọ-enia ti iwọ ti mule fun ara rẹ.
entries.en: Let thy hand be upon the man of thy right hand, upon the son of man whom thou madest strong for thyself.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li awa kì yio pada sẹhin kuro lọdọ rẹ: mu wa yè, awa o si ma pè orukọ rẹ.
entries.en: So will not we go back from thee: quicken us, and we will call upon thy name.

entries.yo: Tún wa yipada, Oluwa Ọlọrun awọn ọmọ-ogun, mu oju rẹ tàn imọlẹ; a o si gbà wa là.
entries.en: Turn us again, O LORD God of hosts, cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.

entries.yo: KỌRIN soke si Ọlọrun, ipa wa: ẹ ho iho ayọ̀ si Ọlọrun Jakobu.
entries.en: Sing aloud unto God our strength: make a joyful noise unto the God of Jacob.

entries.yo: Ẹ mu orin mimọ́, ki ẹ si mu ìlu wa, duru didùn pẹlu ohun-elo orin mimọ́.
entries.en: Take a psalm, and bring hither the timbrel, the pleasant harp with the psaltery.

entries.yo: Ẹ fun ipè li oṣù titún, ni ìgbà ti a lana silẹ, li ọjọ ajọ wa ti o ni ironu.
entries.en: Blow up the trumpet in the new moon, in the time appointed, on our solemn feast day.

entries.yo: Nitori eyi li aṣẹ fun Israeli, ati ofin Ọlọrun Jakobu.
entries.en: For this was a statute for Israel, and a law of the God of Jacob.

entries.yo: Eyi li o dasilẹ ni ẹrí fun Josefu, nigbati o là ilẹ Egipti ja; nibiti mo gbe gbọ́ ede ti kò ye mi.
entries.en: This he ordained in Joseph for a testimony, when he went out through the land of Egypt: where I heard a language that I understood not.

entries.yo: Mo gbé ejika rẹ̀ kuro ninu ẹrù: mo si gbà agbọn li ọwọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: I removed his shoulder from the burden: his hands were delivered from the pots.

entries.yo: Iwọ pè ninu ipọnju, emi si gbà ọ; emi da ọ lohùn nibi ìkọkọ ãra: emi ridi rẹ nibi omi ija.
entries.en: Thou calledst in trouble, and I delivered thee; I answered thee in the secret place of thunder: I proved thee at the waters of Meribah. Selah.

entries.yo: Ẹ gbọ́, ẹnyin enia mi, emi o si jẹri si ọ: Israeli, bi iwọ ba fetisi mi.
entries.en: Hear, O my people, and I will testify unto thee: O Israel, if thou wilt hearken unto me;

entries.yo: Kì yio si ọlọrun miran ninu nyin; bẹ̃ni iwọ kì yio sìn ọlọrun àjeji.
entries.en: There shall no strange god be in thee; neither shalt thou worship any strange god.

entries.yo: Emi ni Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ, ti o mu ọ lati ilẹ Egipti jade wá: yà ẹ̀nu rẹ̀ gbòro, emi o si kún u.
entries.en: I am the LORD thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt: open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn enia mi kò fẹ igbọ́ ohùn mi; Israeli kò si fẹ ti emi.
entries.en: But my people would not hearken to my voice; and Israel would none of me.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni mo fi wọn silẹ fun lile aiya wọn: nwọn si nrìn ninu ero ara wọn.
entries.en: So I gave them up unto their own hearts' lust: and they walked in their own counsels.

entries.yo: Ibaṣepe awọn enia mi ti gbọ́ ti emi, ati ki Israeli ki o ma rìn nipa ọ̀na mi!
entries.en: Oh that my people had hearkened unto me, and Israel had walked in my ways!

entries.yo: Emi iba ti ṣẹ́ awọn ọta wọn lọgan, emi iba si ti yi ọwọ mi pada si awọn ọta wọn.
entries.en: I should soon have subdued their enemies, and turned my hand against their adversaries.

entries.yo: Awọn akorira Oluwa iba ti fi ori wọn balẹ fun u; igba wọn iba si duro pẹ titi.
entries.en: The haters of the LORD should have submitted themselves unto him: but their time should have endured for ever.

entries.yo: Alikama daradara ni on iba ma fi bọ́ wọn pẹlu: ati oyin inu apata ni emi iba si ma fi tẹ́ ọ lọrun.
entries.en: He should have fed them also with the finest of the wheat: and with honey out of the rock should I have satisfied thee.

entries.yo: ỌLỌRUN duro ninu ijọ awọn alagbara; o nṣe idajọ ninu awọn ọlọrun.
entries.en: God standeth in the congregation of the mighty; he judgeth among the gods.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin o ti ṣe idajọ aiṣõtọ pẹ to, ti ẹ o si ma ṣe ojuṣaju awọn enia buburu?
entries.en: How long will ye judge unjustly, and accept the persons of the wicked? Selah.

entries.yo: Ṣe idajọ talaka, ati ti alaini-baba: ṣe otitọ si awọn olupọnju ati alaini.
entries.en: Defend the poor and fatherless: do justice to the afflicted and needy.

entries.yo: Gbà talaka ati alaini: yọ wọn li ọwọ awọn enia buburu.
entries.en: Deliver the poor and needy: rid them out of the hand of the wicked.

entries.yo: Nwọn kò mọ̀, bẹ̃ni nwọn kò fẹ ki oye ki o ye wọn; nwọn nrìn li òkunkun; gbogbo ipilẹ aiye yẹ̀ ni ipò wọn.
entries.en: They know not, neither will they understand; they walk on in darkness: all the foundations of the earth are out of course.

entries.yo: Emi ti wipe, ọlọrun li ẹnyin; awọn ọmọ Ọga-ogo si ni gbogbo nyin.
entries.en: I have said, Ye are gods; and all of you are children of the most High.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹnyin o kú bi enia, ẹnyin o si ṣubu bi ọkan ninu awọn ọmọ-alade.
entries.en: But ye shall die like men, and fall like one of the princes.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun, dide, ṣe idajọ aiye: nitori iwọ ni yio ni orilẹ-ède gbogbo.
entries.en: Arise, O God, judge the earth: for thou shalt inherit all nations.

entries.yo: MAṢE dakẹ, Ọlọrun: máṣe pa ẹnu rẹ mọ́, ki o má si ṣe duro jẹ, Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Keep not thou silence, O God: hold not thy peace, and be not still, O God.

entries.yo: Sa wò o, awọn ọta rẹ nrọkẹ̀kẹ: awọn ti o korira rẹ ti gbé ori soke.
entries.en: For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult: and they that hate thee have lifted up the head.

entries.yo: Nwọn ti gbimọ̀ arekereke si awọn enia rẹ, nwọn si ti gbèro si awọn ẹni-ìkọ̀kọ̀ rẹ.
entries.en: They have taken crafty counsel against thy people, and consulted against thy hidden ones.

entries.yo: Nwọn ti wipe, Ẹ wá, ẹ jẹ ki a ke wọn kuro lati má wà li orilẹ-ède; ki orukọ Israeli ki o máṣe si ni iranti mọ́.
entries.en: They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; that the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.

entries.yo: Nitoriti nwọn ti gbimọ̀ pọ̀ ṣọkan: nwọn ti dimọlu si ọ.
entries.en: For they have consulted together with one consent: they are confederate against thee:

entries.yo: Agọ Edomu, ati ti awọn ọmọ Iṣmaeli; ti Moabu, ati awọn ọmọ Hagari.
entries.en: The tabernacles of Edom, and the Ishmaelites; of Moab, and the Hagarenes;

entries.yo: Gebali, ati Ammoni, ati Amaleki: awọn ara Filistia pẹlu awọn ara Tire;
entries.en: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek; the Philistines with the inhabitants of Tyre;

entries.yo: Assuri pẹlu dapọ̀ mọ wọn: nwọn ràn awọn ọmọ Lotu lọwọ.
entries.en: Assur also is joined with them: they have holpen the children of Lot. Selah.

entries.yo: Ṣe wọn bi o ti ṣe awọn ara Midiani; bi Sisera, bi Jabini, li odò Kiṣoni.
entries.en: Do unto them as unto the Midianites; as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the brook of Kison:

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ṣegbe ni Endori: nwọn di àtan fun ilẹ.
entries.en: Which perished at Endor: they became as dung for the earth.

entries.yo: Ṣe awọn ọlọla wọn bi Orebu ati bi Sebu: ani, gbogbo awọn ọmọ-alade wọn bi Seba ati Salmuna.
entries.en: Make their nobles like Oreb, and like Zeeb: yea, all their princes as Zebah, and as Zalmunna:

entries.yo: Awọn ti o wipe, Ẹ jẹ ki a gbà ibugbe Ọlọrun wọnni fun ara wa ni ini.
entries.en: Who said, Let us take to ourselves the houses of God in possession.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun mi, ṣe wọn bi ãjà; bi akeku koriko niwaju afẹfẹ.
entries.en: O my God, make them like a wheel; as the stubble before the wind.

entries.yo: Bi iná ti ijo igbo, ati bi ọwọ́ iná ti imu òke-nla gbiná;
entries.en: As the fire burneth a wood, and as the flame setteth the mountains on fire;

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni ki o fi ẹ̀fufu rẹ ṣe inunibini si wọn, ki o si fi ìji rẹ dẹrubà wọn.
entries.en: So persecute them with thy tempest, and make them afraid with thy storm.

entries.yo: Fi ìtiju kún wọn li oju: ki nwọn o le ma ṣe afẹri orukọ rẹ, Oluwa.
entries.en: Fill their faces with shame; that they may seek thy name, O LORD.

entries.yo: Ki nwọn ki o dãmu ki a si pọ́n wọn loju lailai; nitõtọ, ki a dojutì wọn, ki nwọn ki o ṣegbé.
entries.en: Let them be confounded and troubled for ever; yea, let them be put to shame, and perish:

entries.yo: Ki awọn enia ki o le mọ̀ pe iwọ, orukọ ẹni-kanṣoṣo ti ijẹ Jehofah, iwọ li Ọga-ogo lori aiye gbogbo.
entries.en: That men may know that thou, whose name alone is JEHOVAH, art the most high over all the earth.

entries.yo: AGỌ rẹ wọnni ti li ẹwà to, Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun!
entries.en: How amiable are thy tabernacles, O LORD of hosts!

entries.yo: Ọkàn mi nfà nitõtọ, o tilẹ pe ongbẹ fun agbala Oluwa: aiya mi ati ara mi nkigbe si Ọlọrun alãye.
entries.en: My soul longeth, yea, even fainteth for the courts of the LORD: my heart and my flesh crieth out for the living God.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ, ologoṣẹ ri ile, ati alapandẹdẹ tẹ́ itẹ fun ara rẹ̀, nibiti yio gbe ma pa awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ mọ́ si, ani ni pẹpẹ rẹ wọnni, Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun, Ọba mi ati Ọlọrun mi.
entries.en: Yea, the sparrow hath found an house, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may lay her young, even thine altars, O LORD of hosts, my King, and my God.

entries.yo: Ibukún ni fun awọn ti ngbe inu ile rẹ: nwọn o ma yìn ọ sibẹ.
entries.en: Blessed are they that dwell in thy house: they will be still praising thee. Selah.

entries.yo: Ibukún ni fun enia na, ipá ẹniti o wà ninu rẹ: li ọkàn ẹniti ọ̀na rẹ wà.
entries.en: Blessed is the man whose strength is in thee; in whose heart are the ways of them.

entries.yo: Awọn ti nla afonifoji omije lọ, nwọn sọ ọ di kanga; akọrọ-òjo si fi ibukún bò o.
entries.en: Who passing through the valley of Baca make it a well; the rain also filleth the pools.

entries.yo: Nwọn nlọ lati ipá de ipá, ni Sioni ni awọn yọ niwaju Ọlọrun.
entries.en: They go from strength to strength, every one of them in Zion appeareth before God.

entries.yo: Oluwa Ọlọrun awọn ọmọ-ogun, gbọ́ adura mi; fi eti si i, Ọlọrun Jakobu.
entries.en: O LORD God of hosts, hear my prayer: give ear, O God of Jacob. Selah.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, Ọlọrun asà wa, ki o si ṣiju wò oju Ẹni-ororo rẹ.
entries.en: Behold, O God our shield, and look upon the face of thine anointed.

entries.yo: Nitori pe ọjọ kan ninu agbala rẹ sanju ẹgbẹrun ọjọ lọ. Mo fẹ ki nkuku ma ṣe adena ni ile Ọlọrun mi, jù lati ma gbe agọ ìwa-buburu.
entries.en: For a day in thy courts is better than a thousand. I had rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.

entries.yo: Nitori Oluwa Ọlọrun li õrun ati asà: Oluwa yio fun ni li ore-ọfẹ ati ogo: kò si ohun rere ti yio fà sẹhin lọwọ awọn ti nrìn dede.
entries.en: For the LORD God is a sun and shield: the LORD will give grace and glory: no good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.

entries.yo: Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun, ibukún ni fun oluwarẹ̀ na ti o gbẹkẹle ọ.
entries.en: O LORD of hosts, blessed is the man that trusteth in thee.

entries.yo: OLUWA, iwọ ti nṣe oju rere si ilẹ rẹ: iwọ ti mu igbekun Jakobu pada bọ̀.
entries.en: LORD, thou hast been favourable unto thy land: thou hast brought back the captivity of Jacob.

entries.yo: Iwọ ti dari aiṣedede awọn enia rẹ jì, iwọ ti bò gbogbo ẹ̀ṣẹ wọn mọlẹ.
entries.en: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people, thou hast covered all their sin. Selah.

entries.yo: Iwọ ti mu gbogbo ibinu rẹ kuro: iwọ ti yipada kuro ninu gbigbona ibinu rẹ.
entries.en: Thou hast taken away all thy wrath: thou hast turned thyself from the fierceness of thine anger.

entries.yo: Yi wa pada, Ọlọrun igbala wa, ki o si mu ibinu rẹ si wa ki o dá.
entries.en: Turn us, O God of our salvation, and cause thine anger toward us to cease.

entries.yo: Iwọ o binu si wa titi lai? iwọ o fà ibinu rẹ jade lati irandiran?
entries.en: Wilt thou be angry with us for ever? wilt thou draw out thine anger to all generations?

entries.yo: Iwọ kì yio tun mu wa sọji: ki awọn enia rẹ ki o ma yọ̀ ninu rẹ?
entries.en: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?

entries.yo: Oluwa fi ãnu rẹ hàn fun wa, ki o si fun wa ni igbala rẹ.
entries.en: Shew us thy mercy, O LORD, and grant us thy salvation.

entries.yo: Emi o gbọ́ bi Ọlọrun Oluwa yio ti wi: nitoriti yio sọ alafia si awọn enia rẹ̀, ati si awọn enia mimọ́ rẹ̀: ṣugbọn ki nwọn ki o má tun pada si were.
entries.en: I will hear what God the LORD will speak: for he will speak peace unto his people, and to his saints: but let them not turn again to folly.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ igbala rẹ̀ sunmọ́ awọn ti o bẹ̀ru rẹ̀; ki ogo ki o le ma gbé ilẹ wa.
entries.en: Surely his salvation is nigh them that fear him; that glory may dwell in our land.

entries.yo: Ãnu ati otitọ padera; ododo ati alafia ti fi ẹnu kò ara wọn li ẹnu.
entries.en: Mercy and truth are met together; righteousness and peace have kissed each other.

entries.yo: Otitọ yio rú jade lati ilẹ wá: ododo yio si bojuwò ilẹ lati ọrun wá.
entries.en: Truth shall spring out of the earth; and righteousness shall look down from heaven.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ Oluwa yio funni li eyi ti o dara; ilẹ wa yio si ma mu asunkun rẹ̀ wá.
entries.en: Yea, the LORD shall give that which is good; and our land shall yield her increase.

entries.yo: Ododo yio ṣãju rẹ̀; yio si fi ipasẹ rẹ̀ ṣe ọ̀na.
entries.en: Righteousness shall go before him; and shall set us in the way of his steps.

entries.yo: OLUWA, dẹ eti rẹ silẹ, gbohùn mi: nitori ti emi jẹ́ talaka ati alaini.
entries.en: Bow down thine ear, O LORD, hear me: for I am poor and needy.

entries.yo: Pa ọkàn mi mọ́; nitori emi li ẹniti iwọ ṣe ojurere fun: iwọ, Ọlọrun mi, gbà ọmọ ọdọ rẹ ti o gbẹkẹle ọ.
entries.en: Preserve my soul; for I am holy: O thou my God, save thy servant that trusteth in thee.

entries.yo: Ṣãnu fun mi, Oluwa: nitori iwọ li emi nkepè lojojumọ.
entries.en: Be merciful unto me, O Lord: for I cry unto thee daily.

entries.yo: Mu ọkàn iranṣẹ rẹ yọ̀: Oluwa, nitori iwọ ni mo gbé ọkàn mi soke si.
entries.en: Rejoice the soul of thy servant: for unto thee, O Lord, do I lift up my soul.

entries.yo: Nitori iwọ, Oluwa, o ṣeun, o si mura ati dariji; o si pọ̀ li ãnu fun gbogbo awọn ti nkepè ọ.
entries.en: For thou, Lord, art good, and ready to forgive; and plenteous in mercy unto all them that call upon thee.

entries.yo: Oluwa, fi eti si adura mi; ki o si fiye si ohùn ẹ̀bẹ mi.
entries.en: Give ear, O LORD, unto my prayer; and attend to the voice of my supplications.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ ipọnju mi, emi o kepè ọ: nitori ti iwọ o da mi lohùn.
entries.en: In the day of my trouble I will call upon thee: for thou wilt answer me.

entries.yo: Oluwa, ninu awọn oriṣa kò si ọ̀kan ti o dabi rẹ, bẹ̃ni kò si iṣẹ kan ti o dabi iṣẹ rẹ.
entries.en: Among the gods there is none like unto thee, O Lord; neither are there any works like unto thy works.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn orilẹ-ède ti iwọ da ni yio wá, nwọn o si sìn niwaju rẹ, Oluwa; nwọn o si ma fi ogo fun orukọ rẹ.
entries.en: All nations whom thou hast made shall come and worship before thee, O Lord; and shall glorify thy name.

entries.yo: Nitoripe iwọ pọ̀, iwọ si nṣe ohun iyanu: iwọ nikan li Ọlọrun.
entries.en: For thou art great, and doest wondrous things: thou art God alone.

entries.yo: Oluwa, kọ́ mi li ọ̀na rẹ; emi o ma rìn ninu otitọ rẹ: mu aiya mi ṣọkan lati bẹ̀ru orukọ rẹ.
entries.en: Teach me thy way, O LORD; I will walk in thy truth: unite my heart to fear thy name.

entries.yo: Emi o yìn ọ, Oluwa Ọlọrun mi, tinutinu mi gbogbo: emi o si ma fi ogo fun orukọ rẹ titi lai.
entries.en: I will praise thee, O Lord my God, with all my heart: and I will glorify thy name for evermore.

entries.yo: Nitoripe nla li ãnu rẹ si mi: iwọ si ti gbà ọkàn mi lọwọ isa-okú jijin.
entries.en: For great is thy mercy toward me: and thou hast delivered my soul from the lowest hell.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun, awọn agberaga dide si mi, ati ijọ awọn alagbara nwá ọkàn mi kiri; nwọn kò si fi ọ pè li oju wọn.
entries.en: O God, the proud are risen against me, and the assemblies of violent men have sought after my soul; and have not set thee before them.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn iwọ, Oluwa, li Ọlọrun ti o kún fun iyọ́nu, ati olore-ọfẹ, olupamọra, o si pọ̀ li ãnu ati otitọ.
entries.en: But thou, O Lord, art a God full of compassion, and gracious, longsuffering, and plenteous in mercy and truth.

entries.yo: Yipada si mi ki o si ṣãnu fun mi; fi ipá rẹ fun iranṣẹ rẹ, ki o si gbà ọmọkunrin iranṣẹ-birin rẹ là.
entries.en: O turn unto me, and have mercy upon me; give thy strength unto thy servant, and save the son of thine handmaid.

entries.yo: Fi àmi hàn mi fun rere; ki awọn ti o korira mi ki o le ri i, ki oju ki o le tì wọn, nitori iwọ, Oluwa, li o ti ràn mi lọwọ ti o si tù mi ninu.
entries.en: Shew me a token for good; that they which hate me may see it, and be ashamed: because thou, LORD, hast holpen me, and comforted me.

entries.yo: IPILẸ rẹ̀ mbẹ lori òke mimọ́ wọnni.
entries.en: His foundation is in the holy mountains.

entries.yo: Oluwa fẹ ẹnu-ọ̀na Sioni jù gbogbo ibujoko Jakobu lọ.
entries.en: The LORD loveth the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.

entries.yo: Ohun ogo li a nsọ niti rẹ? Ilu Ọlọrun!
entries.en: Glorious things are spoken of thee, O city of God. Selah.

entries.yo: Emi o da orukọ Rahabu ati Babeli lãrin awọn ti o mọ̀ mi: kiyesi Filistia ati Tire, pẹlu Etiopia: a bi eleyi nibẹ.
entries.en: I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon to them that know me: behold Philistia, and Tyre, with Ethiopia; this man was born there.

entries.yo: Ati ni Sioni li a o wipe: ọkunrin yi ati ọkunrin nì li a bi ninu rẹ̀: ati Ọga-ogo tikararẹ̀ ni yio fi ẹsẹ rẹ̀ mulẹ.
entries.en: And of Zion it shall be said, This and that man was born in her: and the highest himself shall establish her.

entries.yo: Oluwa yio kà, nigbati o ba nkọ orukọ awọn enia, pe, a bi eleyi nibẹ.
entries.en: The LORD shall count, when he writeth up the people, that this man was born there. Selah.

entries.yo: Ati awọn olorin ati awọn ti nlu ohun-elo orin yio wipe: Gbogbo orisun mi mbẹ ninu rẹ.
entries.en: As well the singers as the players on instruments shall be there: all my springs are in thee.

entries.yo: OLUWA Ọlọrun igbala mi, emi nkigbe lọsan ati loru niwaju rẹ.
entries.en: O LORD God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before thee:

entries.yo: Jẹ ki adura mi ki o wá si iwaju rẹ: dẹ eti rẹ silẹ si igbe mi.
entries.en: Let my prayer come before thee: incline thine ear unto my cry;

entries.yo: Nitori ti ọkàn mi kún fun ipọnju, ẹmi mi si sunmọ isa-okú.
entries.en: For my soul is full of troubles: and my life draweth nigh unto the grave.

entries.yo: A kà mi pẹlu kún awọn ti o sọkalẹ lọ si ihò: emi dabi ọkunrin ti kò ni ipá.
entries.en: I am counted with them that go down into the pit: I am as a man that hath no strength:

entries.yo: Ẹniti a kọ̀ silẹ lãrin awọn okú, bi awọn ẹni pipa ti o dubulẹ ni isa-okú, ẹniti iwọ kò ranti mọ́: a si ke wọn kuro nipa ọwọ rẹ.
entries.en: Free among the dead, like the slain that lie in the grave, whom thou rememberest no more: and they are cut off from thy hand.

entries.yo: Iwọ ti fi mi le ibi isalẹ ti o jìn julọ, ninu okunkun, ninu ọgbun.
entries.en: Thou hast laid me in the lowest pit, in darkness, in the deeps.

entries.yo: Ibinu rẹ lẹ̀ mọ mi lara kikan, iwọ si ti fi riru omi rẹ gbogbo ba mi ja.
entries.en: Thy wrath lieth hard upon me, and thou hast afflicted me with all thy waves. Selah.

entries.yo: Iwọ ti mu awọn ojulumọ mi jina si mi; iwọ si sọ mi di irira si wọn; a se mi mọ́, emi kò le jade.
entries.en: Thou hast put away mine acquaintance far from me; thou hast made me an abomination unto them: I am shut up, and I cannot come forth.

entries.yo: Oju mi nkãnu nitori ipọnju: Oluwa, emi ti npè ọ lojojumọ, emi si ti nawọ mi si ọ.
entries.en: Mine eye mourneth by reason of affliction: LORD, I have called daily upon thee, I have stretched out my hands unto thee.

entries.yo: Iwọ o fi iṣẹ iyanu rẹ hàn fun okú bi? awọn okú yio ha dide ki nwọn si ma yìn ọ bi?
entries.en: Wilt thou shew wonders to the dead? shall the dead arise and praise thee? Selah.

entries.yo: A o ha fi iṣeun ifẹ rẹ hàn ni isà-òkú bi? tabi otitọ rẹ ninu iparun?
entries.en: Shall thy lovingkindness be declared in the grave? or thy faithfulness in destruction?

entries.yo: A ha le mọ̀ iṣẹ iyanu rẹ li okunkun bi? ati ododo rẹ ni ilẹ igbagbe?
entries.en: Shall thy wonders be known in the dark? and thy righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn iwọ ni mo kigbe si, Oluwa; ati ni kutukutu owurọ li adura mi yio ṣaju rẹ.
entries.en: But unto thee have I cried, O LORD; and in the morning shall my prayer prevent thee.

entries.yo: Oluwa, ẽṣe ti iwọ fi ṣa ọkàn mi tì? ẽṣe ti iwọ fi pa oju rẹ mọ́ kuro lọdọ mi?
entries.en: LORD, why castest thou off my soul? why hidest thou thy face from me?

entries.yo: Iṣẹ́ nṣẹ mi, emi mura ati kú lati igba ewe mi wá: nigbati ẹ̀ru rẹ ba mbà mi, emi di gbéregbère.
entries.en: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up: while I suffer thy terrors I am distracted.

entries.yo: Ifẹju ibinu rẹ kọja lara mi; ìbẹru rẹ ti ke mi kuro.
entries.en: Thy fierce wrath goeth over me; thy terrors have cut me off.

entries.yo: Nwọn wá yi mi ka li ọjọ gbogbo bi omi: nwọn yi mi kakiri tan.
entries.en: They came round about me daily like water; they compassed me about together.

entries.yo: Olufẹ ati ọrẹ ni iwọ mu jina si mi, ati awọn ojulumọ mi ninu okunkun.
entries.en: Lover and friend hast thou put far from me, and mine acquaintance into darkness.

entries.yo: EMI o ma kọrin ãnu Oluwa lailai: ẹnu mi li emi o ma fi fi otitọ rẹ hàn lati irandiran.
entries.en: I will sing of the mercies of the LORD for ever: with my mouth will I make known thy faithfulness to all generations.

entries.yo: Nitori ti emi ti wipe, A o gbé ãnu ró soke lailai: otitọ rẹ ni iwọ o gbé kalẹ li ọrun.
entries.en: For I have said, Mercy shall be built up for ever: thy faithfulness shalt thou establish in the very heavens.

entries.yo: Emi ti bá ayànfẹ mi da majẹmu, emi ti bura fun Dafidi, iranṣẹ mi,
entries.en: I have made a covenant with my chosen, I have sworn unto David my servant,

entries.yo: Irú-ọmọ rẹ li emi o gbé kalẹ lailai, emi o si ma gbé itẹ́ rẹ ró lati irandiran,
entries.en: Thy seed will I establish for ever, and build up thy throne to all generations. Selah.

entries.yo: Ọrun yio si ma yìn iṣẹ-iyanu rẹ, Oluwa, otitọ rẹ pẹlu ninu ijọ enia mimọ́ rẹ.
entries.en: And the heavens shall praise thy wonders, O LORD: thy faithfulness also in the congregation of the saints.

entries.yo: Nitori pe, tali o wà li ọrun ti a le fi wé Oluwa? tani ninu awọn ọmọ alagbara, ti a le fi wé Oluwa?
entries.en: For who in the heaven can be compared unto the LORD? who among the sons of the mighty can be likened unto the LORD?

entries.yo: Ọlọrun li o ni ìbẹru gidigidi ni ijọ enia mimọ́, o si ni ibuyìn-fun lati ọdọ gbogbo awọn ti o yi i ká.
entries.en: God is greatly to be feared in the assembly of the saints, and to be had in reverence of all them that are about him.

entries.yo: Oluwa, Ọlọrun awọn ọmọ-ogun, tani Oluwa alagbara bi iwọ? tabi bi otitọ rẹ ti o yi ọ ká.
entries.en: O LORD God of hosts, who is a strong LORD like unto thee? or to thy faithfulness round about thee?

entries.yo: Iwọ li o jọba ibinu okun; nigbati riru omi rẹ̀ dide, iwọ mu u pa rọrọ.
entries.en: Thou rulest the raging of the sea: when the waves thereof arise, thou stillest them.

entries.yo: Iwọ li o ti ya Rahabu pẹrẹ-pẹrẹ bi ẹniti a pa; iwọ ti fi apa ọwọ́ agbara rẹ tú awọn ọtá rẹ ká.
entries.en: Thou hast broken Rahab in pieces, as one that is slain; thou hast scattered thine enemies with thy strong arm.

entries.yo: Ọrun ni tirẹ, aiye pẹlu ni tirẹ: aiye ati ẹ̀kun rẹ̀, iwọ li o ti ṣe ipilẹ wọn.
entries.en: The heavens are thine, the earth also is thine: as for the world and the fulness thereof, thou hast founded them.

entries.yo: Ariwa ati gusù iwọ li o ti da wọn: Taboru ati Hermoni yio ma yọ̀ li orukọ rẹ.
entries.en: The north and the south thou hast created them: Tabor and Hermon shall rejoice in thy name.

entries.yo: Iwọ ni apá agbara: agbara li ọwọ́ rẹ, giga li ọwọ ọtún rẹ.
entries.en: Thou hast a mighty arm: strong is thy hand, and high is thy right hand.

entries.yo: Otitọ ati idajọ ni ibujoko itẹ́ rẹ: ãnu ati otitọ ni yio ma lọ siwaju rẹ.
entries.en: Justice and judgment are the habitation of thy throne: mercy and truth shall go before thy face.

entries.yo: Ibukún ni fun awọn enia ti o mọ̀ ohùn ayọ̀ nì: Oluwa, nwọn o ma rìn ni imọlẹ oju rẹ.
entries.en: Blessed is the people that know the joyful sound: they shall walk, O LORD, in the light of thy countenance.

entries.yo: Li orukọ rẹ ni nwọn o ma yọ̀ li ọjọ gbogbo: ati ninu ododo rẹ li a o ma gbé wọn leke.
entries.en: In thy name shall they rejoice all the day: and in thy righteousness shall they be exalted.

entries.yo: Nitori iwọ li ogo agbara wọn: ati ninu ore ojurere rẹ li a o gbé iwo wa soke,
entries.en: For thou art the glory of their strength: and in thy favour our horn shall be exalted.

entries.yo: Nitori Oluwa li asà wa: Ẹni-Mimọ́ Israeli li ọba wa.
entries.en: For the LORD is our defence; and the Holy One of Israel is our king.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni iwọ sọ li oju iran fun ayanfẹ rẹ, o si wipe, Emi ti gbé iranlọwọ ru ẹni-alagbara; emi ti gbé ẹnikan leke ti a yàn ninu awọn enia.
entries.en: Then thou spakest in vision to thy holy one, and saidst, I have laid help upon one that is mighty; I have exalted one chosen out of the people.

entries.yo: Emi ti ri Dafidi, iranṣẹ mi; ororo mi mimọ́ ni mo ta si i li ori:
entries.en: I have found David my servant; with my holy oil have I anointed him:

entries.yo: Nipasẹ ẹniti a o fi ọwọ mi mulẹ: apá mi pẹlu yio ma mu u li ara le.
entries.en: With whom my hand shall be established: mine arm also shall strengthen him.

entries.yo: Ọtá kì yio bère lọdọ rẹ̀; bẹ̃ni awọn ọmọ iwà-buburu kì yio pọ́n ọ loju.
entries.en: The enemy shall not exact upon him; nor the son of wickedness afflict him.

entries.yo: Emi o si lu awọn ọta rẹ̀ bolẹ niwaju rẹ̀, emi o si yọ awọn ti o korira rẹ̀ lẹnu.
entries.en: And I will beat down his foes before his face, and plague them that hate him.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn otitọ mi ati ãnu mi yio wà pẹlu rẹ̀; ati li orukọ mi li a o gbé iwo rẹ̀ soke.
entries.en: But my faithfulness and my mercy shall be with him: and in my name shall his horn be exalted.

entries.yo: Emi o gbé ọwọ rẹ̀ le okun, ati ọwọ ọtún rẹ̀ le odò nla nì.
entries.en: I will set his hand also in the sea, and his right hand in the rivers.

entries.yo: On o kigbe pè mi pe, Iwọ ni baba mi, Ọlọrun mi, ati apata igbala mi.
entries.en: He shall cry unto me, Thou art my father, my God, and the rock of my salvation.

entries.yo: Emi o si ṣe e li akọbi, Ẹni-giga jù awọn ọba aiye lọ.
entries.en: Also I will make him my firstborn, higher than the kings of the earth.

entries.yo: Ãnu mi li emi o pamọ́ fun u lailai, ati majẹmu mi yio si ba a duro ṣinṣin.
entries.en: My mercy will I keep for him for evermore, and my covenant shall stand fast with him.

entries.yo: Irú-ọmọ rẹ̀ pẹlu li emi o mu pẹ titi, ati itẹ́ rẹ̀ bi ọjọ ọrun.
entries.en: His seed also will I make to endure for ever, and his throne as the days of heaven.

entries.yo: Bi awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ ba kọ̀ ofin mi silẹ, ti nwọn kò si rìn nipa idajọ mi;
entries.en: If his children forsake my law, and walk not in my judgments;

entries.yo: Bi nwọn ba bá ilana mi jẹ, ti nwọn kò si pa ofin mi mọ́,
entries.en: If they break my statutes, and keep not my commandments;

entries.yo: Nigbana li emi o fi ọgọ bẹ irekọja wọn wò, ati ẹ̀ṣẹ wọn pẹlu ìna.
entries.en: Then will I visit their transgression with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn iṣeun-ifẹ mi li emi kì yio gbà lọwọ rẹ̀, bẹ̃li emi kì yio jẹ ki otitọ mi ki o yẹ̀.
entries.en: Nevertheless my lovingkindness will I not utterly take from him, nor suffer my faithfulness to fail.

entries.yo: Majẹmu mi li emi kì yio dà, bẹ̃li emi kì yio yi ohun ti o ti ète mi jade pada.
entries.en: My covenant will I not break, nor alter the thing that is gone out of my lips.

entries.yo: Lẹrinkan ni mo ti fi ìwa-mimọ́ mi bura pe, emi kì yio purọ fun Dafidi.
entries.en: Once have I sworn by my holiness that I will not lie unto David.

entries.yo: Iru-ọmọ rẹ̀ yio duro titi lailai, ati itẹ́ rẹ̀ bi õrun niwaju mi.
entries.en: His seed shall endure forever, and his throne as the sun before me.

entries.yo: A o fi idi rẹ̀ mulẹ lailai bi òṣupa, ati bi ẹlẹri otitọ li ọrun.
entries.en: It shall be established for ever as the moon, and as a faithful witness in heaven. Selah.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn iwọ ti ṣa tì, iwọ si korira, iwọ ti binu si Ẹni-ororo rẹ.
entries.en: But thou hast cast off and abhorred, thou hast been wroth with thine anointed.

entries.yo: Iwọ ti sọ majẹmu iranṣẹ rẹ di ofo: iwọ ti sọ ade rẹ̀ si ilẹ.
entries.en: Thou hast made void the covenant of thy servant: thou hast profaned his crown by casting it to the ground.

entries.yo: Iwọ ti fa ọgba rẹ̀ gbogbo ya: iwọ ti mu ilu-olodi rẹ̀ di ahoro.
entries.en: Thou hast broken down all his hedges; thou hast brought his strong holds to ruin.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn ti nkọja lọ li ọ̀na nfi ṣe ijẹ: on si di ẹ̀gan fun awọn aladugbo rẹ̀.
entries.en: All that pass by the way spoil him: he is a reproach to his neighbours.

entries.yo: Iwọ ti gbé ọwọ ọtún awọn ọta rẹ̀ soke; iwọ mu gbogbo awọn ọta rẹ̀ yọ̀.
entries.en: Thou hast set up the right hand of his adversaries; thou hast made all his enemies to rejoice.

entries.yo: Iwọ si ti yi oju idà rẹ̀ pada pẹlu, iwọ kò si mu u duro li oju ogun.
entries.en: Thou hast also turned the edge of his sword, and hast not made him to stand in the battle.

entries.yo: Iwọ ti mu ogo rẹ̀ tẹ́, iwọ si wọ́ itẹ́ rẹ̀ silẹ-yilẹ.
entries.en: Thou hast made his glory to cease, and cast his throne down to the ground.

entries.yo: Ọjọ ewe rẹ̀ ni iwọ ke kuru; iwọ fi itìju bò o.
entries.en: The days of his youth hast thou shortened: thou hast covered him with shame. Selah.

entries.yo: Yio ti pẹ to, Oluwa? iwọ o pa ara rẹ mọ́ lailai? ibinu rẹ yio ha jo bi iná bi?
entries.en: How long, LORD? wilt thou hide thyself for ever? shall thy wrath burn like fire?

entries.yo: Ranti bi ọjọ mi ti kuru to; ẽse ti iwọ ha da gbogbo enia lasan?
entries.en: Remember how short my time is: wherefore hast thou made all men in vain?

entries.yo: Ọkunrin wo li o wà lãye, ti kì yio ri ikú? ti yio gbà ọkàn rẹ̀ lọwọ isa-okú.
entries.en: What man is he that liveth, and shall not see death? shall he deliver his soul from the hand of the grave? Selah.

entries.yo: Oluwa, nibo ni iṣeun-ifẹ rẹ atijọ wà, ti iwọ bura fun Dafidi ninu otitọ rẹ?
entries.en: Lord, where are thy former lovingkindnesses, which thou swarest unto David in thy truth?

entries.yo: Oluwa, ranti ẹ̀gan awọn iranṣẹ rẹ, ti emi nrù li aiya mi lati ọdọ gbogbo ọ̀pọ enia.
entries.en: Remember, Lord, the reproach of thy servants; how I do bear in my bosom the reproach of all the mighty people;

entries.yo: Ti awọn ọta rẹ fi kẹgàn, Oluwa: ti nwọn fi ngàn ipasẹ Ẹni-ororo rẹ.
entries.en: Wherewith thine enemies have reproached, O LORD; wherewith they have reproached the footsteps of thine anointed.

entries.yo: Olubukún ni Oluwa si i titi lailai. Amin ati Amin.
entries.en: Blessed be the LORD for evermore. Amen, and Amen.

entries.yo: OLUWA, iwọ li o ti nṣe ibujoko wa lati irandiran.
entries.en: LORD, thou hast been our dwelling place in all generations.

entries.yo: Ki a to bí awọn òke nla, ati ki iwọ ki o to dá ilẹ on aiye, ani lati aiye-raiye, iwọ li Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Before the mountains were brought forth, or ever thou hadst formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, thou art God.

entries.yo: Iwọ sọ enia di ibajẹ; iwọ si wipe, Ẹ pada wá, ẹnyin ọmọ enia.
entries.en: Thou turnest man to destruction; and sayest, Return, ye children of men.

entries.yo: Nitoripe igbati ẹgbẹrun ọdun ba kọja li oju rẹ, bi aná li o ri, ati bi igba iṣọ́ kan li oru.
entries.en: For a thousand years in thy sight are but as yesterday when it is past, and as a watch in the night.

entries.yo: Iwọ kó wọn lọ bi ẹnipe ni ṣiṣan-omi; nwọn dabi orun; ni kutukutu nwọn dabi koriko ti o dagba soke.
entries.en: Thou carriest them away as with a flood; they are as a sleep: in the morning they are like grass which groweth up.

entries.yo: Ni Kutukutu o li àwọ lara, o si dàgba soke, li asalẹ a ké e lulẹ, o si rọ.
entries.en: In the morning it flourisheth, and groweth up; in the evening it is cut down, and withereth.

entries.yo: Nitori awa di egbé nipa ibinu rẹ, ati nipa ibinu rẹ ara kò rọ̀ wa.
entries.en: For we are consumed by thine anger, and by thy wrath are we troubled.
