entries.yo: Iwọ ti gbé ẹ̀ṣẹ wa ka iwaju rẹ, ohun ìkọkọ wa mbẹ ninu imọlẹ iwaju rẹ.
entries.en: Thou hast set our iniquities before thee, our secret sins in the light of thy countenance.

entries.yo: Nitori ọjọ wa gbogbo nyipo lọ ninu ibinu rẹ: awa nlo ọjọ wa bi alá ti a nrọ́.
entries.en: For all our days are passed away in thy wrath: we spend our years as a tale that is told.

entries.yo: Adọrin ọdun ni iye ọjọ ọdun wa; bi o si ṣepe nipa ti agbara, bi nwọn ba to ọgọrin ọdun, agbara wọn lãla on ibinujẹ ni; nitori pe a kì o pẹ ke e kuro, awa a si fò lọ.
entries.en: The days of our years are threescore years and ten; and if by reason of strength they be fourscore years, yet is their strength labour and sorrow; for it is soon cut off, and we fly away.

entries.yo: Tali o mọ̀ agbara ibinu rẹ? gẹgẹ bi ẹ̀ru rẹ, bẹ̃ni ibinu rẹ.
entries.en: Who knoweth the power of thine anger? even according to thy fear, so is thy wrath.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni ki iwọ ki o kọ́ wa lati ma ka iye ọjọ wa, ki awa ki o le fi ọkàn wa sipa ọgbọ́n.
entries.en: So teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom.

entries.yo: Pada, Oluwa, yio ti pẹ to? yi ọkàn pada nitori awọn ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ.
entries.en: Return, O LORD, how long? and let it repent thee concerning thy servants.

entries.yo: Fi ãnu rẹ tẹ́ wa li ọrùn ni kutukutu; ki awa ki o le ma yọ̀, ati ki inu wa ki o le ma dùn li ọjọ wa gbogbo.
entries.en: O satisfy us early with thy mercy; that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.

entries.yo: Mu inu wa dùn bi iye ọjọ ti iwọ pọ́n wa loju, ati iye ọdun ti awa ti nri buburu.
entries.en: Make us glad according to the days wherein thou hast afflicted us, and the years wherein we have seen evil.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki iṣẹ rẹ ki o hàn si awọn ọmọ-ọ̀dọ rẹ, ati ogo rẹ si awọn ọmọ wọn.
entries.en: Let thy work appear unto thy servants, and thy glory unto their children.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki ẹwà Oluwa Ọlọrun wa ki o wà lara wa: ki iwọ ki o si fi idi iṣẹ ọwọ wa mulẹ lara wa, bẹ̃ni iṣẹ ọwọ wa ni ki iwọ ki o fi idi rẹ̀ mulẹ.
entries.en: And let the beauty of the LORD our God be upon us: and establish thou the work of our hands upon us; yea, the work of our hands establish thou it.

entries.yo: ẸNITI o joko ni ibi ìkọkọ Ọga-ogo ni yio ma gbe abẹ ojiji Olodumare.
entries.en: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.

entries.yo: Emi o wi fun Ọlọrun pe, Iwọ li àbo ati odi mi; Ọlọrun mi, ẹniti emi gbẹkẹle.
entries.en: I will say of the LORD, He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ on o gbà ọ ninu ikẹkun awọn pẹyẹpẹyẹ, ati ninu àjakalẹ-àrun buburu.
entries.en: Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, and from the noisome pestilence.

entries.yo: Yio fi iyẹ́ rẹ̀ bò ọ, abẹ iyẹ́-apa rẹ̀ ni iwọ o si gbẹkẹle: otitọ rẹ̀ ni yio ṣe asà ati apata rẹ.
entries.en: He shall cover thee with his feathers, and under his wings shalt thou trust: his truth shall be thy shield and buckler.

entries.yo: Iwọ kì yio bẹ̀ru nitori ẹ̀ru oru; tabi fun ọfa ti nfo li ọsán;
entries.en: Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night; nor for the arrow that flieth by day;

entries.yo: Tabi fun àjakalẹ-àrun ti nrìn kiri li okunkun, tabi fun iparun ti nrun-ni li ọsángangan.
entries.en: Nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness; nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday.

entries.yo: Ẹgbẹrun yio ṣubu li ẹgbẹ rẹ, ati ẹgbarun li apa ọtún rẹ: ṣugbọn kì yio sunmọ ọdọ rẹ.
entries.en: A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand; but it shall not come nigh thee.

entries.yo: Kiki oju rẹ ni iwọ o ma fi ri, ti o si ma fi wo ère awọn enia buburu.
entries.en: Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked.

entries.yo: Nitori iwọ, Oluwa, ni iṣe ãbo mi, iwọ ti fi Ọga-ogo ṣe ibugbe rẹ.
entries.en: Because thou hast made the LORD, which is my refuge, even the most High, thy habitation;

entries.yo: Buburu kan kì yio ṣubu lu ọ, bẹ̃li arunkarun kì yio sunmọ ile rẹ.
entries.en: There shall no evil befall thee, neither shall any plague come nigh thy dwelling.

entries.yo: Nitori ti yio fi aṣẹ fun awọn angeli rẹ̀ nitori rẹ, lati pa ọ mọ́ li ọ̀na rẹ gbogbo.
entries.en: For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.

entries.yo: Nwọn o gbé ọ soke li ọwọ́ wọn, ki iwọ ki o má ba fi ẹṣẹ rẹ gbun okuta.
entries.en: They shall bear thee up in their hands, lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.

entries.yo: Iwọ o kọja lori kiniun ati pamọlẹ: ẹgbọrọ kiniun ati ejò-nla ni iwọ o fi ẹsẹ tẹ̀-mọlẹ.
entries.en: Thou shalt tread upon the lion and adder: the young lion and the dragon shalt thou trample under feet.

entries.yo: Nitori ti o fẹ ifẹ rẹ̀ si mi, nitorina li emi o ṣe gbà a: emi o gbé e leke, nitori ti o mọ̀ orukọ mi.
entries.en: Because he hath set his love upon me, therefore will I deliver him: I will set him on high, because he hath known my name.

entries.yo: On o pè orukọ mi, emi o si da a lohùn: emi o pẹlu rẹ̀ ninu ipọnju, emi o gbà a, emi o si bu ọlá fun u.
entries.en: He shall call upon me, and I will answer him: I will be with him in trouble; I will deliver him, and honour him.

entries.yo: Ẹmi gigun li emi o fi tẹ́ ẹ lọrun, emi o si fi igbala mi hàn a.
entries.en: With long life will I satisfy him, and shew him my salvation.

entries.yo: OHUN rere ni lati ma fi ọpẹ fun Oluwa, ati lati ma kọrin si orukọ rẹ, Ọga-ogo:
entries.en: It is a good thing to give thanks unto the LORD, and to sing praises unto thy name, O most High:

entries.yo: Lati ma fi iṣeun ifẹ rẹ hàn li owurọ, ati otitọ rẹ li alalẹ.
entries.en: To shew forth thy lovingkindness in the morning, and thy faithfulness every night,

entries.yo: Lara ohun-elo orin olokùn mẹwa, ati lara ohun-elo orin mimọ́: lara duru pẹlu iró ti o ni ironu.
entries.en: Upon an instrument of ten strings, and upon the psaltery; upon the harp with a solemn sound.

entries.yo: Nitori iwọ, Oluwa, li o ti mu mi yọ̀ nipa iṣẹ rẹ: emi o ma kọrin iyìn nitori iṣẹ ọwọ rẹ.
entries.en: For thou, LORD, hast made me glad through thy work: I will triumph in the works of thy hands.

entries.yo: Oluwa, iṣẹ rẹ ti tobi to! ìro-inu rẹ jinlẹ gidigidi.
entries.en: O LORD, how great are thy works! and thy thoughts are very deep.

entries.yo: Ope enia kò mọ̀; bẹ̃li oye eyi kò ye aṣiwere enia.
entries.en: A brutish man knoweth not; neither doth a fool understand this.

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn enia buburu ba rú bi koriko, ati igbati gbogbo awọn oniṣẹ ẹ̀ṣẹ ba ngberú: ki nwọn ki o le run lailai ni:
entries.en: When the wicked spring as the grass, and when all the workers of iniquity do flourish; it is that they shall be destroyed for ever:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn iwọ, Oluwa li ẹniti o ga titi lai.
entries.en: But thou, LORD, art most high for evermore.

entries.yo: Sa wò o, awọn ọta rẹ, Oluwa, sa wò o, awọn ọta rẹ yio ṣegbe; gbogbo oniṣẹ ẹ̀ṣẹ li a o tuka.
entries.en: For, lo, thine enemies, O LORD, for, lo, thine enemies shall perish; all the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn iwo mi ni iwọ o gbé ga bi iwo agbanrere; ororo titun li a o ta si mi lori.
entries.en: But my horn shalt thou exalt like the horn of an unicorn: I shall be anointed with fresh oil.

entries.yo: Oju mi pẹlu yio ri ifẹ mi lara awọn ọta mi, eti mi yio si ma gbọ́ ifẹ mi si awọn enia buburu ti o dide si mi.
entries.en: Mine eye also shall see my desire on mine enemies, and mine ears shall hear my desire of the wicked that rise up against me.

entries.yo: Olododo yio gbà bi igi ọpẹ: yio dàgba bi igi kedari Lebanoni.
entries.en: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree: he shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

entries.yo: Awọn ẹniti a gbin ni ile Oluwa, yio gbà ni agbala Ọlọrun wa.
entries.en: Those that be planted in the house of the LORD shall flourish in the courts of our God.

entries.yo: Nwọn o ma so eso sibẹ ninu ogbó wọn: nwọn o sanra, nwọn o ma tutù nini;
entries.en: They shall still bring forth fruit in old age; they shall be fat and flourishing;

entries.yo: Lati fi hàn pe, Ẹni diduro-ṣinṣin ni Oluwa: on li apata mi, kò si si aiṣododo kan ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: To shew that the LORD is upright: he is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.

entries.yo: OLUWA jọba, ọla-nla li o wọ li aṣọ; agbara ni Oluwa wọ̀ li aṣọ, o fi di ara rẹ̀ li amure: o si fi idi aiye mulẹ, ti kì yio fi le yi.
entries.en: The LORD reigneth, he is clothed with majesty; the LORD is clothed with strength, wherewith he hath girded himself: the world also is stablished, that it cannot be moved.

entries.yo: Lati igba atijọ li a ti fi idi itẹ́ rẹ kalẹ, ati aiye-raiye ni Iwọ.
entries.en: Thy throne is established of old: thou art from everlasting.

entries.yo: Iṣan-omi gbé ohùn wọn soke, Oluwa, iṣan-omi gbé ohùn wọn soke; iṣan-omi gbé riru omi wọn soke.
entries.en: The floods have lifted up, O LORD, the floods have lifted up their voice; the floods lift up their waves.

entries.yo: Oluwa li ologo, o li ogo jù ariwo omi pupọ lọ, jù riru omi nla, ani jù agbara riru omi okun lọ.
entries.en: The LORD on high is mightier than the noise of many waters, yea, than the mighty waves of the sea.

entries.yo: Otitọ li ẹri rẹ: ìwa-mimọ́ li o yẹ ile rẹ lailai, Oluwa.
entries.en: Thy testimonies are very sure: holiness becometh thine house, O LORD, for ever.

entries.yo: OLUWA, Ọlọrun ẹsan; Ọlọrun ẹsan, fi ara rẹ hàn.
entries.en: O LORD God, to whom vengeance belongeth; O God, to whom vengeance belongeth, shew thyself.

entries.yo: Gbé ara rẹ soke, iwọ onidajọ aiye: san ẹsan fun awọn agberaga.
entries.en: Lift up thyself, thou judge of the earth: render a reward to the proud.

entries.yo: Oluwa, yio ti pẹ to ti awọn enia buburu, yio ti pẹ to ti awọn enia buburu yio fi ma leri?
entries.en: LORD, how long shall the wicked, how long shall the wicked triumph?

entries.yo: Nwọn o ti ma dà ọ̀rọ nù ti nwọn o ma sọ ohun lile pẹ to? ti gbogbo oniṣẹ ẹ̀ṣẹ yio fi ma fi ara wọn leri.
entries.en: How long shall they utter and speak hard things? and all the workers of iniquity boast themselves?

entries.yo: Oluwa, nwọn fọ́ awọn enia rẹ tutu, nwọn si nyọ awọn enia-ini rẹ lẹnu.
entries.en: They break in pieces thy people, O LORD, and afflict thine heritage.

entries.yo: Nwọn pa awọn opó ati alejo, nwọn si pa awọn ọmọ alaini-baba.
entries.en: They slay the widow and the stranger, and murder the fatherless.

entries.yo: Sibẹ nwọn wipe, Oluwa kì yio ri i, bẹ̃li Ọlọrun Jakobu kì yio kà a si,
entries.en: Yet they say, The LORD shall not see, neither shall the God of Jacob regard it.

entries.yo: Ki oye ki o ye nyin, ẹnyin ope ninu awọn enia: ati ẹnyin aṣiwere, nigbawo li ẹnyin o gbọ́n?
entries.en: Understand, ye brutish among the people: and ye fools, when will ye be wise?

entries.yo: Ẹniti o gbin eti, o le ṣe alaigbọ́ bi? ẹniti o da oju, o ha le ṣe alairiran?
entries.en: He that planted the ear, shall he not hear? he that formed the eye, shall he not see?

entries.yo: Ẹniti nnà awọn orilẹ-ède, o ha le ṣe alaiṣe olutọ́? on li ẹniti nkọ́ enia ni ìmọ.
entries.en: He that chastiseth the heathen, shall not he correct? he that teacheth man knowledge, shall not he know?

entries.yo: Oluwa mọ̀ ìro-inu enia pe: asan ni nwọn.
entries.en: The LORD knoweth the thoughts of man, that they are vanity.

entries.yo: Ibukún ni fun enia na ẹniti iwọ nà, Oluwa, ti iwọ si kọ́ lati inu ofin rẹ wá;
entries.en: Blessed is the man whom thou chastenest, O LORD, and teachest him out of thy law;

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o le fun u ni isimi kuro li ọjọ ibi, titi a o fi wà iho silẹ fun enia buburu.
entries.en: That thou mayest give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit be digged for the wicked.

entries.yo: Nitoripe Oluwa kì yio ṣa awọn enia rẹ̀ tì, bẹ̃ni kì yio kọ̀ awọn enia-ini rẹ̀ silẹ.
entries.en: For the LORD will not cast off his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn idajọ yio pada si ododo: gbogbo ọlọkàn diduro ni yio si ma tọ̀ ọ lẹhin.
entries.en: But judgment shall return unto righteousness: and all the upright in heart shall follow it.

entries.yo: Tani yio dide si awọn oluṣe buburu fun mi? tabi tani yio dide si awọn oniṣẹ ẹ̀ṣe fun mi?
entries.en: Who will rise up for me against the evildoers? or who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?

entries.yo: Bikoṣe bi Oluwa ti ṣe oluranlọwọ mi; ọkàn mi fẹrẹ joko ni idakẹ.
entries.en: Unless the LORD had been my help, my soul had almost dwelt in silence.

entries.yo: Nigbati mo wipe, Ẹsẹ mi yọ́; Oluwa, ãnu rẹ dì mi mu.
entries.en: When I said, My foot slippeth; thy mercy, O LORD, held me up.

entries.yo: Ninu ọ̀pọlọpọ ibinujẹ mi ninu mi, itunu rẹ li o nmu inu mi dùn.
entries.en: In the multitude of my thoughts within me thy comforts delight my soul.

entries.yo: Itẹ́ ẹ̀ṣẹ ha le ba ọ kẹgbẹ pọ̀, ti nfi ofin dimọ ìwa-ika?
entries.en: Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with thee, which frameth mischief by a law?

entries.yo: Nwọn kó ara wọn jọ pọ̀ si ọkàn olododo, nwọn si da ẹ̀jẹ alaiṣẹ lẹbi.
entries.en: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Oluwa li àbo mi; Ọlọrun mi si li apata àbo mi,
entries.en: But the LORD is my defence; and my God is the rock of my refuge.

entries.yo: On o si mu ẹ̀ṣẹ wọn bọ̀ sori ara wọn, yio si ke wọn kuro ninu ìwa-buburu wọn: Oluwa Ọlọrun wa, yio ke wọn kuro.
entries.en: And he shall bring upon them their own iniquity, and shall cut them off in their own wickedness; yea, the LORD our God shall cut them off.

entries.yo: ẸWÁ, ẹ jẹ ki a kọrin si Oluwa: ẹ jẹ ki a hó iho ayọ̀ si apata igbala wa.
entries.en: O come, let us sing unto the LORD: let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.

entries.yo: Ẹ jẹ ki a fi ọpẹ wá si iwaju rẹ̀, ki a si fi orin mimọ́ hó iho ayọ̀ si ọdọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving, and make a joyful noise unto him with psalms.

entries.yo: Nitori Oluwa, Ọlọrun ti o tobi ni, ati Ọba ti o tobi jù gbogbo oriṣa lọ,
entries.en: For the LORD is a great God, and a great King above all gods.

entries.yo: Ni ikawọ ẹniti ibi ọgbun ilẹ wà: giga awọn òke nla ni tirẹ̀ pẹlu.
entries.en: In his hand are the deep places of the earth: the strength of the hills is his also.

entries.yo: Tirẹ̀ li okun, on li o si dá a: ọwọ rẹ̀ li o si dá iyangbẹ ilẹ.
entries.en: The sea is his, and he made it: and his hands formed the dry land.

entries.yo: Ẹ wá, ẹ jẹ ki a wolẹ, ki a tẹriba: ẹ jẹ ki a kunlẹ niwaju Oluwa, Ẹlẹda wa.
entries.en: O come, let us worship and bow down: let us kneel before the LORD our maker.

entries.yo: Nitori on li Ọlọrun wa; awa si li enia papa rẹ̀, ati agutan ọwọ rẹ̀. Loni bi ẹnyin o ba gbọ́ ohùn rẹ̀,
entries.en: For he is our God; and we are the people of his pasture, and the sheep of his hand. To day if ye will hear his voice,

entries.yo: Ẹ má sé aiya nyin le, bi ti Meriba ati bi ọjọ na ni Massa, li aginju.
entries.en: Harden not your heart, as in the provocation, and as in the day of temptation in the wilderness:

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn baba nyin dan mi wò, ti nwọn wadi mi, ti nwọn si ri iṣẹ mi.
entries.en: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my work.

entries.yo: Ogoji-ọdun tọ̀tọ ni inu mi fi bajẹ si iran na, mo ni, Enia ti o ṣina li aiya ni nwọn, nwọn kò si mọ̀ ọ̀na mi:
entries.en: Forty years long was I grieved with this generation, and said, It is a people that do err in their heart, and they have not known my ways:

entries.yo: Awọn ẹniti mo si bura fun ni ibinu mi pe, nwọn ki yio wọ ibi isimi mi.
entries.en: Unto whom I sware in my wrath that they should not enter into my rest.

entries.yo: Ẹ kọrin titun si Oluwa: ẹ kọrin si Oluwa gbogbo aiye.
entries.en: O sing unto the LORD a new song: sing unto the LORD, all the earth.

entries.yo: Ẹ kọrin si Oluwa, fi ibukún fun orukọ rẹ̀; ẹ ma fi igbala rẹ̀ hàn lati ọjọ de ọjọ.
entries.en: Sing unto the LORD, bless his name; shew forth his salvation from day to day.

entries.yo: Sọ̀rọ ogo rẹ̀ lãrin awọn keferi, ati iṣẹ iyanu rẹ̀ lãrin gbogbo enia.
entries.en: Declare his glory among the heathen, his wonders among all people.

entries.yo: Nitori ti Oluwa tobi, o si ni iyìn pupọ̀pupọ̀: on li o ni ìbẹru jù gbogbo oriṣa lọ.
entries.en: For the LORD is great, and greatly to be praised: he is to be feared above all gods.

entries.yo: Nitori pe gbogbo oriṣa orilẹ-ède asan ni nwọn: ṣugbọn Oluwa li o da ọrun.
entries.en: For all the gods of the nations are idols: but the LORD made the heavens.

entries.yo: Ọlá ati ọla-nla li o wà niwaju rẹ̀: ipa ati ẹwà mbẹ ninu ibi mimọ́ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Honour and majesty are before him: strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.

entries.yo: Ẹ fi fun Oluwa, ẹnyin ibatan enia, ẹ fi ogo ati ipá fun Oluwa.
entries.en: Give unto the LORD, O ye kindreds of the people, give unto the LORD glory and strength.

entries.yo: Ẹ fi ogo fun orukọ Oluwa: mu ọrẹ wá, ki ẹ si wá si agbala rẹ̀.
entries.en: Give unto the LORD the glory due unto his name: bring an offering, and come into his courts.

entries.yo: Ẹ ma sìn Oluwa ninu ẹwà ìwa-mimọ́: ẹ wariri niwaju rẹ̀, gbogbo aiye.
entries.en: O worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness: fear before him, all the earth.

entries.yo: Ẹ wi lãrin awọn keferi pe, Oluwa jọba: nitõtọ a o fi idi aiye mulẹ ti kì yio le yẹ̀: on o fi ododo ṣe idajọ enia.
entries.en: Say among the heathen that the LORD reigneth: the world also shall be established that it shall not be moved: he shall judge the people righteously.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki ọrun ki o yọ̀, jẹ ki inu aiye ki o dùn; jẹ ki okun ki o ma ho pẹlu ikún rẹ̀.
entries.en: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad; let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki oko ki o kún fun ayọ̀, ati ohun gbogbo ti mbẹ ninu rẹ̀: nigbana ni gbogbo igi igbo yio ma yọ̀.
entries.en: Let the field be joyful, and all that is therein: then shall all the trees of the wood rejoice

entries.yo: Niwaju Oluwa: nitoriti mbọwa, nitori ti mbọwa ṣe idajọ aiye: yio fi ododo ṣe idajọ aiye, ati ti enia ni yio fi otitọ rẹ̀ ṣe.
entries.en: Before the LORD: for he cometh, for he cometh to judge the earth: he shall judge the world with righteousness, and the people with his truth.

entries.yo: OLUWA jọba; ki aiye ki o yọ̀; jẹ ki inu ọ̀pọlọpọ erekuṣu ki o dùn.
entries.en: The LORD reigneth; let the earth rejoice; let the multitude of isles be glad thereof.

entries.yo: Awọsanma ati okunkun yi i ka: ododo ati idajọ ni ibujoko itẹ́ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Clouds and darkness are round about him: righteousness and judgment are the habitation of his throne.

entries.yo: Iná ṣaju rẹ̀, o si jo awọn ọta rẹ̀ yika kiri.
entries.en: A fire goeth before him, and burneth up his enemies round about.

entries.yo: Manamana rẹ̀ kọ imọlẹ si aiye: aiye ri i, o si wariri.
entries.en: His lightnings enlightened the world: the earth saw, and trembled.

entries.yo: Awọn òke nyọ́ bi ida niwaju Oluwa, niwaju Oluwa gbogbo aiye:
entries.en: The hills melted like wax at the presence of the LORD, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.

entries.yo: Ọrun fi ododo rẹ̀ hàn, gbogbo orilẹ-ède si ri ogo rẹ̀.
entries.en: The heavens declare his righteousness, and all the people see his glory.

entries.yo: Oju yio tì gbogbo awọn ti nsìn ere fifin, ẹniti nfi ere ṣe ileri ara wọn: ẹ ma sìn i, gbogbo ẹnyin ọlọrun.
entries.en: Confounded be all they that serve graven images, that boast themselves of idols: worship him, all ye gods.

entries.yo: Sioni gbọ́, inu rẹ̀ si dùn; awọn ọmọbinrin Juda si yọ̀, Oluwa, nitori idajọ rẹ.
entries.en: Zion heard, and was glad; and the daughters of Judah rejoiced because of thy judgments, O LORD.

entries.yo: Nitoripe Iwọ Oluwa, li o ga jù gbogbo aiye lọ: Iwọ li a gbé ga jù gbogbo oriṣa lọ.
entries.en: For thou, LORD, art high above all the earth: thou art exalted far above all gods.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin ti o fẹ Oluwa, ẹ korira ibi: o pa ọkàn awọn enia mimọ́ rẹ̀ mọ́: o gbà wọn li ọwọ awọn enia buburu.
entries.en: Ye that love the LORD, hate evil: he preserveth the souls of his saints; he delivereth them out of the hand of the wicked.

entries.yo: A funrugbin imọlẹ fun olododo, ati inu didùn fun alaiya diduro.
entries.en: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.

entries.yo: Ẹ yọ̀ niti Oluwa, ẹnyin olododo; ki ẹ si ma dupẹ ni iranti ìwa-mimọ́ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Rejoice in the LORD, ye righteous; and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.

entries.yo: Ẹ kọrin titun si Oluwa; nitoriti o ti ṣe ohun iyanu: ọwọ ọtún rẹ̀, ati apa rẹ̀ mimọ́ li o ti mu igbala wa fun ara rẹ̀.
entries.en: O sing unto the LORD a new song; for he hath done marvellous things: his right hand, and his holy arm, hath gotten him the victory.

entries.yo: Oluwa ti sọ igbala rẹ̀ di mimọ̀: ododo rẹ̀ li o ti fi hàn nigbangba li ojú awọn keferi.
entries.en: The LORD hath made known his salvation: his righteousness hath he openly shewed in the sight of the heathen.

entries.yo: O ti ranti ãnu rẹ̀ ati otitọ rẹ̀ si awọn ara ile Israeli: gbogbo opin aiye ti ri igbala Ọlọrun wa.
entries.en: He hath remembered his mercy and his truth toward the house of Israel: all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

entries.yo: Ẹ ho iho ayọ̀ si Oluwa, gbogbo aiye: ẹ ho yè, ẹ yọ̀, ki ẹ si ma kọrin iyìn.
entries.en: Make a joyful noise unto the LORD, all the earth: make a loud noise, and rejoice, and sing praise.

entries.yo: Ẹ ma fi duru kọrin si Oluwa, ati duru pẹlu ohùn orin-mimọ́.
entries.en: Sing unto the LORD with the harp; with the harp, and the voice of a psalm.

entries.yo: Pẹlu ipè ati ohùn fere, ẹ ho iho ayọ̀ niwaju Oluwa, Ọba.
entries.en: With trumpets and sound of cornet make a joyful noise before the LORD, the King.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki okun ki o ma ho pẹlu ikún rẹ̀; aiye, ati awọn ti mbẹ ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki odò ki o ma ṣapẹ, ki awọn òke ki o ma ṣe ajọyọ̀.
entries.en: Let the floods clap their hands: let the hills be joyful together

entries.yo: Niwaju Oluwa; nitori ti mbọwa iṣe idajọ aiye: pẹlu ododo ni yio fi ṣe idajọ aiye, ati awọn orilẹ-ède li aiṣègbe.
entries.en: Before the LORD; for he cometh to judge the earth: with righteousness shall he judge the world, and the people with equity.

entries.yo: OLUWA jọba; jẹ ki awọn enia ki o wariri: o joko lori awọn kerubu; ki aiye ki o ta gbọ̀ngbọ́n.
entries.en: The LORD reigneth; let the people tremble: he sitteth between the cherubims; let the earth be moved.

entries.yo: Oluwa tobi ni Sioni: o si ga jù gbogbo orilẹ-ède lọ.
entries.en: The LORD is great in Zion; and he is high above all the people.

entries.yo: Ki nwọn ki o yìn orukọ rẹ ti o tobi, ti o si li ẹ̀ru; mimọ́ li on.
entries.en: Let them praise thy great and terrible name; for it is holy.

entries.yo: Agbara ọba fẹ idajọ pẹlu, iwọ fi idi aiṣegbe mulẹ; iwọ nṣe idajọ ati ododo ni Jakobu.
entries.en: The king's strength also loveth judgment; thou dost establish equity, thou executest judgment and righteousness in Jacob.

entries.yo: Ẹ gbé Oluwa Ọlọrun wa ga, ki ẹ si foribalẹ nibi apoti itisẹ rẹ̀: mimọ́ li on.
entries.en: Exalt ye the LORD our God, and worship at his footstool; for he is holy.

entries.yo: Mose ati Aaroni ninu awọn alufa rẹ̀, ati Samueli ninu awọn ti npè orukọ rẹ̀: nwọn ke pè Oluwa, o si da wọn lohùn.
entries.en: Moses and Aaron among his priests, and Samuel among them that call upon his name; they called upon the LORD, and he answered them.

entries.yo: O ba wọn sọ̀rọ ninu ọwọ̀n awọsanma: nwọn pa ẹri rẹ̀ mọ́ ati ilana ti o fi fun wọn.
entries.en: He spake unto them in the cloudy pillar: they kept his testimonies, and the ordinance that he gave them.

entries.yo: Iwọ da wọn lohùn, Oluwa Ọlọrun wa: iwọ li Ọlọrun ti o dariji wọn, ti o si san ẹsan iṣẹ wọn.
entries.en: Thou answeredst them, O LORD our God: thou wast a God that forgavest them, though thou tookest vengeance of their inventions.

entries.yo: Ẹ gbé Oluwa Ọlọrun wa ga, ki ẹ si ma sìn nibi òke mimọ́ rẹ̀; nitori Oluwa Ọlọrun wa mimọ́ ni.
entries.en: Exalt the LORD our God, and worship at his holy hill; for the LORD our God is holy.

entries.yo: Ẹ ho iho ayọ̀ si Oluwa, ẹnyin ilẹ gbogbo.
entries.en: Make a joyful noise unto the LORD, all ye lands.

entries.yo: Ẹ fi ayọ̀ sìn Oluwa: ẹ wá ti ẹnyin ti orin si iwaju rẹ̀.
entries.en: Serve the LORD with gladness: come before his presence with singing.

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o mọ̀ pe Oluwa, on li Ọlọrun: on li o dá wa, tirẹ̀ li awa; awa li enia rẹ̀, ati agutan papa rẹ̀.
entries.en: Know ye that the LORD he is God: it is he that hath made us, and not we ourselves; we are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.

entries.yo: Ẹ lọ si ẹnu ọ̀na rẹ̀ ti ẹnyin ti ọpẹ, ati si agbala rẹ̀ ti ẹnyin ti iyìn: ẹ ma dupẹ fun u, ki ẹ si ma fi ibukún fun orukọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his name.

entries.yo: Nitori ti Oluwa pọ̀ li ore; ãnu rẹ̀ kò nipẹkun; ati otitọ rẹ̀ lati iran-diran.
entries.en: For the LORD is good; his mercy is everlasting; and his truth endureth to all generations.

entries.yo: EMI o kọrin ãnu ati ti idajọ: Oluwa, si ọ li emi o ma kọrin.
entries.en: I will sing of mercy and judgment: unto thee, O LORD, will I sing.

entries.yo: Emi o ma rìn ìrin mi pẹlu ọgbọ́n li ọ̀na pipé. Nigbawo ni iwọ o tọ̀ mi wá! emi o ma rìn ninu ile mi pẹlu aiya pipé.
entries.en: I will behave myself wisely in a perfect way. O when wilt thou come unto me? I will walk within my house with a perfect heart.

entries.yo: Emi ki yio gbé ohun buburu siwaju mi: emi korira iṣẹ awọn ti o yapa, kì yio fi ara mọ mi.
entries.en: I will set no wicked thing before mine eyes: I hate the work of them that turn aside; it shall not cleave to me.

entries.yo: Aiya ṣiṣo yio kuro lọdọ mi: emi kì yio mọ̀ enia buburu.
entries.en: A froward heart shall depart from me: I will not know a wicked person.

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni ti o ba nsọ̀rọ ẹnikeji rẹ̀ lẹhin, on li emi o ke kuro: ẹniti o ni ìwo giga ati igberaga aiya, on li emi kì yio jẹ fun.
entries.en: Whoso privily slandereth his neighbour, him will I cut off: him that hath an high look and a proud heart will not I suffer.

entries.yo: Oju mi yio wà lara awọn olõtọ, ki nwọn ki o le ma ba mi gbe: ẹniti o ba nrìn li ọ̀na pipé, on ni o ma sìn mi.
entries.en: Mine eyes shall be upon the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me: he that walketh in a perfect way, he shall serve me.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba nṣe ẹ̀tan, kì o gbe inu ile mi: ẹniti o ba nsẹke kì yio duro niwaju mi.
entries.en: He that worketh deceit shall not dwell within my house: he that telleth lies shall not tarry in my sight.

entries.yo: Lojojumọ li emi o ma run gbogbo enia buburu ilẹ na; ki emi ki o le ke gbogbo oluṣe buburu kuro ni ilu Oluwa.
entries.en: I will early destroy all the wicked of the land; that I may cut off all wicked doers from the city of the LORD.

entries.yo: GBỌ adura mi, Oluwa, ki o si jẹ ki igbe mi ki o wá sọdọ rẹ.
entries.en: Hear my prayer, O LORD, and let my cry come unto thee.

entries.yo: Máṣe pa oju rẹ mọ́ kuro lara mi li ọjọ ti emi wà ninu ipọnju; dẹ eti rẹ si mi: li ọjọ ti mo ba pè, da mi lohùn-lọgan.
entries.en: Hide not thy face from me in the day when I am in trouble; incline thine ear unto me: in the day when I call answer me speedily.

entries.yo: Nitori ti ọjọ mi run bi ẹ̃fin, egungun mi si jona bi àro.
entries.en: For my days are consumed like smoke, and my bones are burned as an hearth.

entries.yo: Aiya mi lù, o si rọ bi koriko; tobẹ̃ ti mo gbagbe lati jẹ onjẹ mi.
entries.en: My heart is smitten, and withered like grass; so that I forget to eat my bread.

entries.yo: Nitori ohùn ikerora mi, egungun mi lẹ̀ mọ ẹran-ara mi.
entries.en: By reason of the voice of my groaning my bones cleave to my skin.

entries.yo: Emi dabi ẹiyẹ ofú ni iju: emi dabi owiwi ibi ahoro.
entries.en: I am like a pelican of the wilderness: I am like an owl of the desert.

entries.yo: Emi nṣọra, emi dabi ologoṣẹ nikan ni ori ile.
entries.en: I watch, and am as a sparrow alone upon the house top.

entries.yo: Awọn ọta mi ngàn mi li ọjọ gbogbo; ati awọn ti nṣe ikanra si mi, nwọn fi mi bu.
entries.en: Mine enemies reproach me all the day; and they that are mad against me are sworn against me.

entries.yo: Emi sa jẹ ẽru bi onjẹ, emi si dà ohun mimu mi pọ̀ pẹlu omije.
entries.en: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mingled my drink with weeping,

entries.yo: Nitori ikannu ati ibinu rẹ; nitori iwọ ti gbé mi soke, iwọ si gbé mi ṣanlẹ.
entries.en: Because of thine indignation and thy wrath: for thou hast lifted me up, and cast me down.

entries.yo: Ọjọ mi dabi ojiji ti o nfà sẹhin; emi si nrọ bi koriko.
entries.en: My days are like a shadow that declineth; and I am withered like grass.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn iwọ, Oluwa, ni yio duro lailai; ati iranti rẹ lati iran dé iran.
entries.en: But thou, O LORD, shalt endure for ever; and thy remembrance unto all generations.

entries.yo: Iwọ o dide, iwọ o ṣãnu fun Sioni: nitori igba ati ṣe oju-rere si i, nitõtọ, àkoko na de.
entries.en: Thou shalt arise, and have mercy upon Zion: for the time to favour her, yea, the set time, is come.

entries.yo: Nitori ti awọn iranṣẹ rẹ ṣe inu didùn si okuta rẹ̀, nwọn si kãnu erupẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: For thy servants take pleasure in her stones, and favour the dust thereof.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li awọn keferi yio ma bẹ̀ru orukọ Oluwa, ati gbogbo ọba aiye yio ma bẹ̀ru ogo rẹ.
entries.en: So the heathen shall fear the name of the LORD, and all the kings of the earth thy glory.

entries.yo: Nigbati Oluwa yio gbé Sioni ró, yio farahan ninu ogo rẹ̀.
entries.en: When the LORD shall build up Zion, he shall appear in his glory.

entries.yo: Yio juba adura awọn alaini, kì yio si gàn adura wọn.
entries.en: He will regard the prayer of the destitute, and not despise their prayer.

entries.yo: Eyi li a o kọ fun iran ti mbọ̀; ati awọn enia ti a o da yio ma yìn Oluwa.
entries.en: This shall be written for the generation to come: and the people which shall be created shall praise the LORD.

entries.yo: Nitori ti o wò ilẹ lati òke ibi-mimọ́ rẹ̀ wá; lati ọrun wá ni Oluwa bojuwo aiye;
entries.en: For he hath looked down from the height of his sanctuary; from heaven did the LORD behold the earth;

entries.yo: Lati gbọ́ irora ara-tubu; lati tú awọn ti a yàn si ikú silẹ;
entries.en: To hear the groaning of the prisoner; to loose those that are appointed to death;

entries.yo: Lati sọ orukọ Oluwa ni Sioni, ati iyìn rẹ̀ ni Jerusalemu.
entries.en: To declare the name of the LORD in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem;

entries.yo: Nigbati a kó awọn enia jọ pọ̀ ati awọn ijọba, lati ma sìn Oluwa.
entries.en: When the people are gathered together, and the kingdoms, to serve the LORD.

entries.yo: O rẹ̀ agbara mi silẹ li ọ̀na; o mu ọjọ mi kuru.
entries.en: He weakened my strength in the way; he shortened my days.

entries.yo: Emi si wipe, Ọlọrun mi, máṣe mu mi kuro li agbedemeji ọjọ mi: lati irandiran li ọdun rẹ.
entries.en: I said, O my God, take me not away in the midst of my days: thy years are throughout all generations.

entries.yo: Lati igba atijọ ni iwọ ti fi ipilẹ aiye sọlẹ: ọrun si ni iṣẹ ọwọ rẹ,
entries.en: Of old hast thou laid the foundation of the earth: and the heavens are the work of thy hands.

entries.yo: Nwọn o ṣegbe, ṣugbọn Iwọ o duro; nitõtọ gbogbo wọn ni yio di ogbó bi aṣọ; bi ẹ̀wu ni iwọ o pàrọ wọn, nwọn o si pàrọ.
entries.en: They shall perish, but thou shalt endure: yea, all of them shall wax old like a garment; as a vesture shalt thou change them, and they shall be changed:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bakanna ni Iwọ, ọdun rẹ kò li opin.
entries.en: But thou art the same, and thy years shall have no end.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ awọn iranṣẹ rẹ yio duro pẹ, a o si fi ẹsẹ iru-ọmọ wọn mulẹ niwaju rẹ.
entries.en: The children of thy servants shall continue, and their seed shall be established before thee.

entries.yo: FI ibukún fun Oluwa, iwọ ọkàn mi, ati gbogbo ohun ti o wà ninu mi, fi ibukún fun orukọ rẹ̀ mimọ́.
entries.en: Bless the LORD, O my soul: and all that is within me, bless his holy name.

entries.yo: Fi ibukún fun Oluwa, iwọ ọkàn mi, má si ṣe gbagbe gbogbo ore rẹ̀:
entries.en: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits:

entries.yo: Ẹniti o dari gbogbo ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ jì; ẹniti o si tan gbogbo àrun rẹ,
entries.en: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; who healeth all thy diseases;

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ra ẹmi rẹ kuro ninu iparun; ẹniti o fi iṣeun-ifẹ ati iyọ́nu de ọ li ade:
entries.en: Who redeemeth thy life from destruction; who crowneth thee with lovingkindness and tender mercies;

entries.yo: Ẹniti o fi ohun didara tẹ́ ọ lọrun: bẹ̃ni igba ewe rẹ di ọtun bi ti idì.
entries.en: Who satisfieth thy mouth with good things; so that thy youth is renewed like the eagle's.

entries.yo: Oluwa ṣe ododo ati idajọ fun gbogbo awọn ti a nilara.
entries.en: The LORD executeth righteousness and judgment for all that are oppressed.

entries.yo: O fi ọ̀na rẹ̀ hàn fun Mose, iṣe rẹ̀ fun awọn ọmọ Israeli.
entries.en: He made known his ways unto Moses, his acts unto the children of Israel.

entries.yo: Oluwa li alãnu ati olõre, o lọra ati binu, o si pọ̀ li ãnu.
entries.en: The LORD is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and plenteous in mercy.

entries.yo: On kì ibaniwi nigbagbogbo: bẹ̃ni kì ipa ibinu rẹ̀ mọ́ lailai.
entries.en: He will not always chide: neither will he keep his anger for ever.

entries.yo: On kì iṣe si wa gẹgẹ bi ẹ̀ṣẹ wa; bẹ̃ni kì isan a fun wa gẹgẹ bi aiṣedede wa.
entries.en: He hath not dealt with us after our sins; nor rewarded us according to our iniquities.

entries.yo: Nitori pe, bi ọrun ti ga si ilẹ, bẹ̃li ãnu rẹ̀ tobi si awọn ti o bẹ̀ru rẹ̀.
entries.en: For as the heaven is high above the earth, so great is his mercy toward them that fear him.

entries.yo: Bi ila-õrun ti jina si ìwọ-õrun, bẹ̃li o mu irekọja wa jina kuro lọdọ wa.
entries.en: As far as the east is from the west, so far hath he removed our transgressions from us.

entries.yo: Bi baba ti iṣe iyọ́nu si awọn ọmọ, bẹ̃li Oluwa nṣe iyọ́nu si awọn ti o bẹ̀ru rẹ̀.
entries.en: Like as a father pitieth his children, so the LORD pitieth them that fear him.

entries.yo: Nitori ti o mọ̀ ẹda wa; o ranti pe erupẹ ni wa.
entries.en: For he knoweth our frame; he remembereth that we are dust.

entries.yo: Bi o ṣe ti enia ni, ọjọ rẹ̀ dabi koriko: bi itana eweko igbẹ bẹ̃li o gbilẹ.
entries.en: As for man, his days are as grass: as a flower of the field, so he flourisheth.

entries.yo: Nitori ti afẹfẹ fẹ kọja lọ lori rẹ̀, kò sì si mọ́; ibujoko rẹ̀ kò mọ̀ ọ mọ́.
entries.en: For the wind passeth over it, and it is gone; and the place thereof shall know it no more.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ãnu Oluwa lati aiyeraiye ni lara awọn ti o bẹ̀ru rẹ̀, ati ododo rẹ̀ lati ọmọ de ọmọ:
entries.en: But the mercy of the LORD is from everlasting to everlasting upon them that fear him, and his righteousness unto children's children;

entries.yo: Si awọn ti o pa majẹmu rẹ̀ mọ́, ati si awọn ti o ranti ofin rẹ̀ lati ṣe wọn.
entries.en: To such as keep his covenant, and to those that remember his commandments to do them.

entries.yo: Oluwa ti pèse itẹ́ rẹ̀ ninu ọrun; ijọba rẹ̀ li o si bori ohun gbogbo;
entries.en: The LORD hath prepared his throne in the heavens; and his kingdom ruleth over all.

entries.yo: Ẹ fi ibukún fun Oluwa, ẹnyin angeli rẹ̀, ti o pọ̀ ni ipa ti nṣe ofin rẹ̀, ti nfi eti si ohùn ọ̀rọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Bless the LORD, ye his angels, that excel in strength, that do his commandments, hearkening unto the voice of his word.

entries.yo: Ẹ fi ibukún fun Oluwa, ẹnyin ọmọ-ogun rẹ̀ gbogbo; ẹnyin iranṣẹ rẹ̀, ti nṣe ifẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Bless ye the LORD, all ye his hosts; ye ministers of his, that do his pleasure.

entries.yo: Ẹ fi ibukún fun Oluwa, gbogbo iṣẹ rẹ̀ ni ibi gbogbo ijọba rẹ̀: fi ibukún fun Oluwa, iwọ ọkàn mi.
entries.en: Bless the LORD, all his works in all places of his dominion: bless the LORD, O my soul.

entries.yo: FI ibukún fun Oluwa, iwọ ọkàn mi. Oluwa, Ọlọrun mi, iwọ tobi jọjọ: ọlá ati ọla-nla ni iwọ wọ̀ li aṣọ.
entries.en: Bless the LORD, O my soul. O LORD my God, thou art very great; thou art clothed with honour and majesty.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o fi imọlẹ bora bi aṣọ: ẹniti o ta ọrun bi aṣọ tita:
entries.en: Who coverest thyself with light as with a garment: who stretchest out the heavens like a curtain:

entries.yo: Ẹniti o fi omi ṣe ìti igi-àja iyẹwu rẹ̀: ẹniti o ṣe awọsanma ni kẹkẹ́ rẹ̀, ẹniti o nrìn lori apa iyẹ afẹfẹ:
entries.en: Who layeth the beams of his chambers in the waters: who maketh the clouds his chariot: who walketh upon the wings of the wind:

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ṣe ẹfufu ni onṣẹ rẹ̀; ati ọwọ-iná ni iranṣẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Who maketh his angels spirits; his ministers a flaming fire:

entries.yo: Ẹniti o fi aiye sọlẹ lori ipilẹ rẹ̀, ti kò le ṣipò pada lailai.
entries.en: Who laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be removed for ever.

entries.yo: Iwọ fi ibu omi bò o mọlẹ bi aṣọ: awọn omi duro lori òke nla.
entries.en: Thou coveredst it with the deep as with a garment: the waters stood above the mountains.

entries.yo: Nipa ibawi rẹ nwọn sá; nipa ohùn ãra rẹ, nwọn yara lọ.
entries.en: At thy rebuke they fled; at the voice of thy thunder they hasted away.

entries.yo: Awọn òke nla nru soke; awọn afonifoji nsọkalẹ si ibi ti iwọ ti fi lelẹ fun wọn.
entries.en: They go up by the mountains; they go down by the valleys unto the place which thou hast founded for them.

entries.yo: Iwọ ti pa àla kan ki nwọn ki o má le kọja rẹ̀; ki nwọn ki o má tun pada lati bò aiye mọlẹ.
entries.en: Thou hast set a bound that they may not pass over; that they turn not again to cover the earth.

entries.yo: Iwọ ran orisun si afonifoji, ti nṣàn larin awọn òke.
entries.en: He sendeth the springs into the valleys, which run among the hills.

entries.yo: Awọn ni nfi omi mimu fun gbogbo ẹranko igbẹ: awọn kẹtẹkẹtẹ igbẹ npa ongbẹ wọn;
entries.en: They give drink to every beast of the field: the wild asses quench their thirst.

entries.yo: Lẹba wọn li awọn ẹiyẹ oju-ọrun yio ni ile wọn, ti nkọrin lãrin ẹka igi.
entries.en: By them shall the fowls of the heaven have their habitation, which sing among the branches.

entries.yo: O mbomi rin awọn òke lati iyẹwu rẹ̀ wá: ère iṣẹ ọwọ rẹ tẹ́ aiye lọrun.
entries.en: He watereth the hills from his chambers: the earth is satisfied with the fruit of thy works.

entries.yo: O mu koriko dagba fun ẹran, ati ewebẹ fun ìlo enia: ki o le ma mu onjẹ jade lati ilẹ wá;
entries.en: He causeth the grass to grow for the cattle, and herb for the service of man: that he may bring forth food out of the earth;

entries.yo: Ati ọti-waini ti imu inu enia dùn, ati oróro ti imu oju rẹ̀ dan, ati onjẹ ti imu enia li aiya le.
entries.en: And wine that maketh glad the heart of man, and oil to make his face to shine, and bread which strengtheneth man's heart.

entries.yo: Igi Oluwa kún fun oje, igi kedari Lebanoni, ti o ti gbìn.
entries.en: The trees of the LORD are full of sap; the cedars of Lebanon, which he hath planted;

entries.yo: Nibiti awọn ẹiyẹ ntẹ́ itẹ́ wọn: bi o ṣe ti àkọ ni, igi firi ni ile rẹ̀.
entries.en: Where the birds make their nests: as for the stork, the fir trees are her house.

entries.yo: Awọn òke giga li àbo fun awọn ewurẹ igbẹ: ati awọn apata fun awọn ehoro.
entries.en: The high hills are a refuge for the wild goats; and the rocks for the conies.

entries.yo: O da oṣupa fun akokò: õrùn mọ̀ akokò ìwọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down.

entries.yo: Iwọ ṣe òkunkun, o si di oru: ninu eyiti gbogbo ẹranko igbo nrìn kiri.
entries.en: Thou makest darkness, and it is night: wherein all the beasts of the forest do creep forth.

entries.yo: Awọn ẹgbọrọ kiniun ndún si ohun ọdẹ wọn, nwọn si nwá onjẹ wọn lọwọ Ọlọrun.
entries.en: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their meat from God.

entries.yo: Õrùn là, nwọn kó ara wọn jọ, nwọn dubulẹ ninu iho wọn.
entries.en: The sun ariseth, they gather themselves together, and lay them down in their dens.

entries.yo: Enia jade lọ si iṣẹ rẹ̀ ati si lãla rẹ̀ titi di aṣalẹ.
entries.en: Man goeth forth unto his work and to his labour until the evening.

entries.yo: Oluwa, iṣẹ rẹ ti pọ̀ to! ninu ọgbọ́n ni iwọ ṣe gbogbo wọn: aiye kún fun ẹ̀da rẹ.
entries.en: O LORD, how manifold are thy works! in wisdom hast thou made them all: the earth is full of thy riches.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li okun yi ti o tobi, ti o si ni ibò, nibẹ ni ohun ainiye nrakò, ati ẹran kekere ati nla.
entries.en: So is this great and wide sea, wherein are things creeping innumerable, both small and great beasts.

entries.yo: Nibẹ li ọkọ̀ nrìn: nibẹ ni lefiatani nì wà, ti iwọ da lati ma ṣe ariya ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: There go the ships: there is that leviathan, whom thou hast made to play therein.

entries.yo: Gbogbo wọnyi li o duro tì ọ; ki iwọ ki o le ma fun wọn li onjẹ wọn li akokò wọn.
entries.en: These wait all upon thee; that thou mayest give them their meat in due season.

entries.yo: Eyi ti iwọ fi fun wọn ni nwọn nkó: iwọ ṣí ọwọ rẹ, a si fi ohun rere tẹ́ wọn lọrùn.
entries.en: That thou givest them they gather: thou openest thine hand, they are filled with good.

entries.yo: Iwọ pa oju rẹ mọ́, ara kò rọ̀ wọn: iwọ gbà ẹmi wọn, nwọn kú, nwọn si pada si erupẹ wọn.
entries.en: Thou hidest thy face, they are troubled: thou takest away their breath, they die, and return to their dust.

entries.yo: Iwọ rán ẹmi rẹ jade, a si da wọn: iwọ si sọ oju ilẹ di ọtun.
entries.en: Thou sendest forth thy spirit, they are created: and thou renewest the face of the earth.

entries.yo: Ogo Oluwa yio wà lailai: Oluwa yio yọ̀ ni iṣẹ ọwọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: The glory of the LORD shall endure for ever: the LORD shall rejoice in his works.

entries.yo: O bojuwo aiye, o si warìrì: o fi ọwọ kàn òke, nwọn si ru ẹ̃fin.
entries.en: He looketh on the earth, and it trembleth: he toucheth the hills, and they smoke.

entries.yo: Emi o ma kọrin si Oluwa nigbati mo wà lãye: emi o ma kọrin iyìn si Ọlọrun mi ni igba aiye mi.
entries.en: I will sing unto the LORD as long as I live: I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki iṣaro mi ki o mu inu rẹ̀ dùn: emi o mã yọ̀ ninu Oluwa.
entries.en: My meditation of him shall be sweet: I will be glad in the LORD.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki awọn ẹlẹṣẹ ki o run kuro li aiye, ki awọn enia buburu ki o má si mọ. Fi ibukún fun Oluwa, iwọ ọkàn mi. Ẹ fi iyìn fun Oluwa.
entries.en: Let the sinners be consumed out of the earth, and let the wicked be no more. Bless thou the LORD, O my soul. Praise ye the LORD.

entries.yo: Ẹ fi ọpẹ fun Oluwa? ẹ pè orukọ rẹ̀: ẹ fi iṣẹ rẹ̀ hàn ninu awọn enia.
entries.en: O give thanks unto the LORD; call upon his name: make known his deeds among the people.

entries.yo: Ẹ kọrin si i, ẹ kọ orin mimọ́ si i: ẹ ma sọ̀rọ iṣẹ iyanu rẹ̀ gbogbo.
entries.en: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him: talk ye of all his wondrous works.

entries.yo: Ẹ ma ṣogo li orukọ rẹ̀ mimọ́; jẹ ki aiya awọn ti nwá Oluwa ki o yọ̀.
entries.en: Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek the LORD.

entries.yo: Ẹ ma wá Oluwa ati ipá rẹ̀: ẹ ma wá oju rẹ̀ nigbagbogbo.
entries.en: Seek the LORD, and his strength: seek his face evermore.

entries.yo: Ẹ ma ranti iṣẹ iyanu rẹ̀ ti o ti ṣe; iṣẹ àmi rẹ̀ ati idajọ ẹnu rẹ̀;
entries.en: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done; his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;

entries.yo: Ẹnyin iru-ọmọ Abrahamu iranṣẹ rẹ̀, ẹnyin ọmọ Jakobu, ayanfẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: O ye seed of Abraham his servant, ye children of Jacob his chosen.

entries.yo: Oluwa, on li Ọlọrun wa: idajọ rẹ̀ mbẹ ni gbogbo aiye.
entries.en: He is the LORD our God: his judgments are in all the earth.

entries.yo: O ti ranti majẹmu rẹ̀ lailai, ọ̀rọ ti o ti pa li aṣẹ fun ẹgbẹrun iran.
entries.en: He hath remembered his covenant for ever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations.

entries.yo: Majẹmu ti o ba Abrahamu dá, ati ibura rẹ̀ fun Isaaki;
entries.en: Which covenant he made with Abraham, and his oath unto Isaac;

entries.yo: O si gbé eyi na kalẹ li ofin fun Jakobu, ati fun Israeli ni majẹmu aiyeraiye.
entries.en: And confirmed the same unto Jacob for a law, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant:

entries.yo: Pe, iwọ li emi o fi ilẹ Kenaani fun, ipin ilẹ-ini nyin.
entries.en: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance:

entries.yo: Nigbati o ṣe pe kiun ni nwọn wà ni iye; nitõtọ, diẹ kiun, nwọn si ṣe alejo ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: When they were but a few men in number; yea, very few, and strangers in it.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn nlọ lati orilẹ-ède de orilẹ-ède, lati ijọba kan de ọdọ awọn enia miran;
entries.en: When they went from one nation to another, from one kingdom to another people;

entries.yo: On kò jẹ ki ẹnikẹni ki o ṣe wọn ni iwọsi: Nitõtọ, o ba awọn ọba wi nitori wọn;
entries.en: He suffered no man to do them wrong: yea, he reproved kings for their sakes;

entries.yo: Pe, Ẹ máṣe fi ọwọ kan ẹni-ororo mi ki ẹ má si ṣe awọn woli mi ni ibi,
entries.en: Saying, Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu o pè ìyan wá si ilẹ na: o ṣẹ́ gbogbo ọpá onjẹ.
entries.en: Moreover he called for a famine upon the land: he brake the whole staff of bread.

entries.yo: O rán ọkunrin kan lọ siwaju wọn; ani Josefu ti a tà li ẹrú:
entries.en: He sent a man before them, even Joseph, who was sold for a servant:

entries.yo: Ẹsẹ ẹniti nwọn fi ṣẹkẹṣẹkẹ pa lara: a dè e ninu irin:
entries.en: Whose feet they hurt with fetters: he was laid in iron:

entries.yo: Titi igba ti ọ̀rọ rẹ̀ de: ọ̀rọ Oluwa dan a wò.
entries.en: Until the time that his word came: the word of the LORD tried him.

entries.yo: Ọba ranṣẹ, nwọn si tú u silẹ; ani ijoye awọn enia, o si jọwọ rẹ̀ lọwọ lọ.
entries.en: The king sent and loosed him; even the ruler of the people, and let him go free.

entries.yo: O fi jẹ oluwa ile rẹ̀, ati ijoye gbogbo ini rẹ̀.
entries.en: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all his substance:

entries.yo: Lati ma ṣe akoso awọn ọmọ-alade rẹ̀ nipa ifẹ rẹ̀; ati lati ma kọ́ awọn igbimọ rẹ̀ li ọgbọ́n.
entries.en: To bind his princes at his pleasure; and teach his senators wisdom.

entries.yo: Israeli si wá si Egipti pẹlu; Jakobu si ṣe atipo ni ilẹ Hamu.
entries.en: Israel also came into Egypt; and Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.

entries.yo: O si mu awọn enia rẹ̀ bi si i pipọ̀-pipọ̀; o si mu wọn lagbara jù awọn ọta wọn lọ.
entries.en: And he increased his people greatly; and made them stronger than their enemies.

entries.yo: O yi wọn li aiya pada lati korira awọn enia rẹ̀, lati ṣe arekereke si awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: He turned their heart to hate his people, to deal subtilly with his servants.

entries.yo: O rán Mose iranṣẹ rẹ̀; ati Aaroni, ẹniti o ti yàn.
entries.en: He sent Moses his servant; and Aaron whom he had chosen.

entries.yo: Nwọn fi ọ̀rọ àmi rẹ̀ hán ninu wọn, ati iṣẹ iyanu ni ilẹ Hamu.
entries.en: They shewed his signs among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.

entries.yo: O rán òkunkun, o si mu u ṣú; nwọn kò si ṣaigbọran si ọ̀rọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: He sent darkness, and made it dark; and they rebelled not against his word.

entries.yo: O sọ omi wọn di ẹ̀jẹ, o si pa ẹja wọn.
entries.en: He turned their waters into blood, and slew their fish.

entries.yo: Ilẹ wọn mu ọ̀pọlọ jade wá li ọ̀pọlọpọ, ni iyẹwu awọn ọba wọn.
entries.en: Their land brought forth frogs in abundance, in the chambers of their kings.

entries.yo: O sọ̀rọ, oniruru eṣinṣin si de, ati ina-aṣọ ni gbogbo agbegbe wọn.
entries.en: He spake, and there came divers sorts of flies, and lice in all their coasts.

entries.yo: O fi yinyin fun wọn fun òjo, ati ọwọ iná ni ilẹ wọn.
entries.en: He gave them hail for rain, and flaming fire in their land.

entries.yo: O si lu àjara wọn, ati igi ọ̀pọtọ wọn; o si dá igi àgbegbe wọn.
entries.en: He smote their vines also and their fig trees; and brake the trees of their coasts.

entries.yo: O sọ̀rọ, eṣú si de ati kokoro li ainiye.
entries.en: He spake, and the locusts came, and caterpillers, and that without number,

entries.yo: Nwọn si jẹ gbogbo ewebẹ ilẹ wọn, nwọn si jẹ eso ilẹ wọn run.
entries.en: And did eat up all the herbs in their land, and devoured the fruit of their ground.

entries.yo: O kọlu gbogbo akọbi pẹlu ni ilẹ wọn, ãyo gbogbo ipa wọn.
entries.en: He smote also all the firstborn in their land, the chief of all their strength.

entries.yo: O si mu wọn jade, ti awọn ti fadaka ati wura: kò si si alailera kan ninu ẹ̀ya rẹ̀.
entries.en: He brought them forth also with silver and gold: and there was not one feeble person among their tribes.

entries.yo: Inu Egipti dùn nigbati nwọn lọ: nitoriti ẹ̀ru wọn bà wọn.
entries.en: Egypt was glad when they departed: for the fear of them fell upon them.

entries.yo: O nà awọsanma kan fun ibori; ati iná lati fun wọn ni imọlẹ li oru.
entries.en: He spread a cloud for a covering; and fire to give light in the night.

entries.yo: Nwọn bère o si mu ẹiyẹ aparo wá, o si fi onjẹ ọrun tẹ wọn lọrun.
entries.en: The people asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.

entries.yo: O là apata, omi si tú jade; odò nṣan nibi gbigbẹ.
entries.en: He opened the rock, and the waters gushed out; they ran in the dry places like a river.

entries.yo: Nitoriti o ranti ileri rẹ̀ mimọ́, ati Abrahamu iranṣẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: For he remembered his holy promise, and Abraham his servant.

entries.yo: O si fi ayọ̀ mu awọn enia rẹ̀ jade, ati awọn ayanfẹ rẹ̀ pẹlu orin ayọ̀:
entries.en: And he brought forth his people with joy, and his chosen with gladness:

entries.yo: O si fi ilẹ awọn keferi fun wọn: nwọn si jogun ère iṣẹ awọn enia na.
entries.en: And gave them the lands of the heathen: and they inherited the labour of the people;

entries.yo: Ki nwọn ki o le ma kiye si aṣẹ rẹ̀, ki nwọn ki o si ma pa ofin rẹ̀ mọ́. Ẹ fi iyìn fun Oluwa.
entries.en: That they might observe his statutes, and keep his laws. Praise ye the LORD.

entries.yo: Ẹ fi iyìn fun Oluwa! Ẹ fi ọpẹ fun Oluwa: nitoriti o ṣeun: nitoriti ti ãnu rẹ̀ duro lailai.
entries.en: Praise ye the LORD. O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.

entries.yo: Tali o le sọ̀rọ iṣẹ agbara Oluwa? tali o le fi gbogbo iyìn rẹ̀ hàn?
entries.en: Who can utter the mighty acts of the LORD? who can shew forth all his praise?

entries.yo: Ibukún ni fun awọn ti npa idajọ mọ́, ati ẹniti nṣe ododo ni igbagbogbo.
entries.en: Blessed are they that keep judgment, and he that doeth righteousness at all times.

entries.yo: Oluwa, fi oju-rere ti iwọ ni si awọn enia rẹ ṣe iranti mi: fi igbala rẹ bẹ̀ mi wò.
entries.en: Remember me, O LORD, with the favour that thou bearest unto thy people: O visit me with thy salvation;

entries.yo: Ki emi ki o le ri ire awọn ayanfẹ rẹ, ki emi ki o le yọ̀ ninu ayọ̀ orilẹ-ède rẹ, ki emi ki o le ma ṣogo pẹlu awọn enia ilẹ-ini rẹ.
entries.en: That I may see the good of thy chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of thy nation, that I may glory with thine inheritance.

entries.yo: Awa ti ṣẹ̀ pẹlu awọn baba wa, awa ti dẹṣẹ, awa ti ṣe buburu.
entries.en: We have sinned with our fathers, we have committed iniquity, we have done wickedly.

entries.yo: Iṣẹ iyanu rẹ kò yé awọn baba wa ni Egipti; nwọn kò ranti ọ̀pọlọpọ ãnu rẹ; ṣugbọn nwọn ṣọ̀tẹ si ọ nibi okun, ani nibi Okun pupa.
entries.en: Our fathers understood not thy wonders in Egypt; they remembered not the multitude of thy mercies; but provoked him at the sea, even at the Red sea.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn o gbà wọn là nitori orukọ rẹ̀, ki o le mu agbara rẹ̀ nla di mimọ̀.
entries.en: Nevertheless he saved them for his name's sake, that he might make his mighty power to be known.

entries.yo: O ba Okun pupa wi pẹlu, o si gbẹ: bẹ̃li o sìn wọn là ibu ja bi aginju.
entries.en: He rebuked the Red sea also, and it was dried up: so he led them through the depths, as through the wilderness.

entries.yo: O si gbà wọn là li ọwọ ẹniti o korira wọn, o si rà wọn pada li ọwọ ọta nì.
entries.en: And he saved them from the hand of him that hated them, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.

entries.yo: Omi si bò awọn ọta wọn: ẹnikan wọn kò si kù.
entries.en: And the waters covered their enemies: there was not one of them left.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni nwọn gbà ọ̀rọ rẹ̀ gbọ́: nwọn si kọrin iyìn rẹ̀.
entries.en: Then believed they his words; they sang his praise.

entries.yo: Nwọn kò pẹ igbagbe iṣẹ rẹ̀: nwọn kò si duro de imọ̀ rẹ̀.
entries.en: They soon forgat his works; they waited not for his counsel:

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣe ifẹkufẹ li aginju, nwọn si dan Ọlọrun wò ninu aṣálẹ̀.
entries.en: But lusted exceedingly in the wilderness, and tempted God in the desert.

entries.yo: O si fi ifẹ wọn fun wọn; ṣugbọn o rán rirù si ọkàn wọn.
entries.en: And he gave them their request; but sent leanness into their soul.

entries.yo: Nwọn ṣe ilara Mose pẹlu ni ibudo, ati Aaroni, ẹni-mimọ́ Oluwa.
entries.en: They envied Moses also in the camp, and Aaron the saint of the LORD.

entries.yo: Ilẹ là, o si gbé Datani mì, o si bò ẹgbẹ́ Abiramu mọlẹ.
entries.en: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram.

entries.yo: Iná si ràn li ẹgbẹ́ wọn; ọwọ́ iná na jó awọn enia buburu.
entries.en: And a fire was kindled in their company; the flame burned up the wicked.

entries.yo: Nwọn ṣe ẹgbọrọ malu ni Horebu, nwọn si foribalẹ fun ere didà.
entries.en: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshipped the molten image.

entries.yo: Bayi ni nwọn pa ogo wọn dà si àworan malu ti njẹ koriko.
entries.en: Thus they changed their glory into the similitude of an ox that eateth grass.

entries.yo: Nwọn gbagbe Ọlọrun, Olugbala wọn, ti o ti ṣe ohun nla ni ilẹ Egipti.
entries.en: They forgat God their saviour, which had done great things in Egypt;

entries.yo: Iṣẹ iyanu ni ilẹ Hamu, ati ohun ẹ̀ru lẹba Okun pupa.
entries.en: Wondrous works in the land of Ham, and terrible things by the Red sea.

entries.yo: Nitorina li o ṣe wipe, on o run wọn, iba máṣe pe Mose, ayanfẹ rẹ̀, duro niwaju rẹ̀ li oju-ẹya na, lati yi ibinu rẹ̀ pada, ki o má ba run wọn.
entries.en: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, had not Moses his chosen stood before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath, lest he should destroy them.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ, nwọn kò kà ilẹ didara nì si, nwọn kò gbà ọ̀rọ rẹ̀ gbọ́:
entries.en: Yea, they despised the pleasant land, they believed not his word:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nwọn nkùn ninu agọ wọn, nwọn kò si feti si ohùn Oluwa.
entries.en: But murmured in their tents, and hearkened not unto the voice of the LORD.

entries.yo: Nitorina li o ṣe gbé ọwọ rẹ̀ soke si wọn, lati bì wọn ṣubu li aginju:
entries.en: Therefore he lifted up his hand against them, to overthrow them in the wilderness:

entries.yo: Lati bì iru-ọmọ wọn ṣubu pẹlu lãrin awọn orilẹ-ède, ati lati fún wọn ka kiri ni ilẹ wọnni.
entries.en: To overthrow their seed also among the nations, and to scatter them in the lands.

entries.yo: Nwọn da ara wọn pọ̀ pẹlu mọ Baali-Peoru, nwọn si njẹ ẹbọ okú.
entries.en: They joined themselves also unto Baal-peor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.

entries.yo: Bayi ni nwọn fi iṣẹ wọn mu u binu: àrun nla si fó si arin wọn.
entries.en: Thus they provoked him to anger with their inventions: and the plague brake in upon them.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Finehasi dide duro, o si ṣe idajọ: bẹ̃li àrun nla na si dá.
entries.en: Then stood up Phinehas, and executed judgment: and so the plague was stayed.

entries.yo: A si kà eyi na si fun u li ododo lati irandiran titi lai.
entries.en: And that was counted unto him for righteousness unto all generations for evermore.

entries.yo: Nwọn bi i ninu pẹlu nibi omi Ijà, bẹ̃li o buru fun Mose nitori wọn:
entries.en: They angered him also at the waters of strife, so that it went ill with Moses for their sakes:

entries.yo: Nitori ti nwọn mu ẹmi rẹ̀ binu, bẹ̃li o fi ẹnu rẹ̀ sọ ọ̀rọ aiyẹ.
entries.en: Because they provoked his spirit, so that he spake unadvisedly with his lips.

entries.yo: Nwọn kò run awọn orilẹ-ède na, niti ẹniti Oluwa paṣẹ fun wọn:
entries.en: They did not destroy the nations, concerning whom the LORD commanded them:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nwọn da ara wọn pọ̀ mọ́ awọn keferi, nwọn si kọ́ iṣẹ wọn.
entries.en: But were mingled among the heathen, and learned their works.

entries.yo: Nwọn si sìn ere wọn: ti o di ikẹkun fun wọn.
entries.en: And they served their idols: which were a snare unto them.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ nwọn fi ọmọkunrin wọn ati ọmọbinrin wọn rubọ si oriṣa.
entries.en: Yea, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters unto devils,

entries.yo: Nwọn si ta ẹ̀jẹ alaiṣẹ̀ silẹ, ani ẹ̀jẹ awọn ọmọkunrin wọn ati ti awọn ọmọbinrin wọn, ti nwọn fi rubọ si ere Kenaani: ilẹ na si di aimọ́ fun ẹ̀jẹ.
entries.en: And shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed unto the idols of Canaan: and the land was polluted with blood.

entries.yo: Nwọn si fi iṣẹ ara wọn sọ ara wọn di alaimọ́, nwọn si ṣe panṣaga lọ pẹlu iṣẹ wọn.
entries.en: Thus were they defiled with their own works, and went a whoring with their own inventions.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni ibinu Oluwa ṣe ràn si awọn enia rẹ̀, o si korira awọn enia ini rẹ̀.
entries.en: Therefore was the wrath of the LORD kindled against his people, insomuch that he abhorred his own inheritance.

entries.yo: O si fi wọn le awọn keferi lọwọ; awọn ti o korira wọn si ṣe olori wọn.
entries.en: And he gave them into the hand of the heathen; and they that hated them ruled over them.

entries.yo: Awọn ọta wọn si ni wọn lara, nwọn si mu wọn sìn labẹ ọwọ wọn.
entries.en: Their enemies also oppressed them, and they were brought into subjection under their hand.

entries.yo: Igba pupọ li o gbà wọn; sibẹ nwọn fi ìmọ wọn mu u binu, a si rẹ̀ wọn silẹ nitori ẹ̀ṣẹ wọn.
entries.en: Many times did he deliver them; but they provoked him with their counsel, and were brought low for their iniquity.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ninu ipọnju o kiyesi wọn, nigbati o gbọ́ ẹkún wọn.
entries.en: Nevertheless he regarded their affliction, when he heard their cry:

entries.yo: O si ranti majẹmu rẹ̀ fun wọn, o si yi ọkàn pada gẹgẹ bi ọ̀pọlọpọ ãnu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his mercies.

entries.yo: O si mu wọn ri ãnu loju gbogbo awọn ti o kó wọn ni igbekun.
entries.en: He made them also to be pitied of all those that carried them captives.

entries.yo: Oluwa Ọlọrun wa, gbà wa, ki o si ṣa wa jọ kuro lãrin awọn keferi, lati ma fi ọpẹ fun orukọ mimọ́ rẹ, ati lati ma ṣogo ninu iyìn rẹ.
entries.en: Save us, O LORD our God, and gather us from among the heathen, to give thanks unto thy holy name, and to triumph in thy praise.

entries.yo: Olubukún ni Oluwa, Ọlọrun Israeli, lati aiyeraiye: ki gbogbo enia ki o si ma wipe, Amin. Ẹ fi iyìn fun Oluwa.
entries.en: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel from everlasting to everlasting: and let all the people say, Amen. Praise ye the LORD.

entries.yo: Ẹ fi ọpẹ fun Oluwa, nitori ti o ṣeun: nitori ti ãnu rẹ̀ duro lailai.
entries.en: O give thanks unto the LORD, for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki awọn ẹni-irapada Oluwa ki o wi bẹ̃, ẹniti o rà pada kuro ni ọwọ ọta nì.
entries.en: Let the redeemed of the LORD say so, whom he hath redeemed from the hand of the enemy;

entries.yo: O si kó wọn jọ lati ilẹ wọnnì wá, lati ila-õrun wá, ati lati ìwọ-õrun, lati ariwa, ati lati okun wá.
entries.en: And gathered them out of the lands, from the east, and from the west, from the north, and from the south.

entries.yo: Nwọn nrìn ka kiri li aginju ni ibi ti ọ̀na kò si: nwọn kò ri ilu lati ma gbe.
entries.en: They wandered in the wilderness in a solitary way; they found no city to dwell in.

entries.yo: Ebi pa wọn, ongbẹ si gbẹ wọn, o rẹ̀ ọkàn wọn ninu wọn.
entries.en: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni nwọn kigbe pè Oluwa ninu ipọnju wọn, o si yọ wọn kuro ninu iṣẹ́ wọn,
entries.en: Then they cried unto the LORD in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses.

entries.yo: O si mu wọn jade nipa ọ̀na titọ, ki nwọn ki o le lọ si ilu ti nwọn o ma gbe.
entries.en: And he led them forth by the right way, that they might go to a city of habitation.

entries.yo: Enia iba ma yìn Oluwa nitori ore rẹ̀, ati nitori iṣẹ iyanu rẹ̀ si awọn ọmọ enia!
entries.en: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!

entries.yo: Nitori ti o tẹ́ ifẹ ọkàn lọrun, o si fi ire kún ọkàn ti ebi npa.
entries.en: For he satisfieth the longing soul, and filleth the hungry soul with goodness.

entries.yo: Iru awọn ti o joko li òkunkun ati li ojiji ikú, ti a dè ninu ipọnju ati ni irin;
entries.en: Such as sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron;

entries.yo: Nitori ti nwọn ṣọ̀tẹ si ọ̀rọ Ọlọrun, nwọn si gàn imọ Ọga-ogo:
entries.en: Because they rebelled against the words of God, and contemned the counsel of the most High:

entries.yo: Nitorina o fi lãla rẹ̀ aiya wọn silẹ: nwọn ṣubu, kò si si oluranlọwọ.
entries.en: Therefore he brought down their heart with labour; they fell down, and there was none to help.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni nwọn kigbe pè Oluwa ninu ipọnju wọn, o si gbà wọn ninu iṣẹ́ wọn.
entries.en: Then they cried unto the LORD in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.

entries.yo: O mu wọn jade kuro ninu òkunkun ati ojiji ikú, o si fa ìde wọn ja.
entries.en: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and brake their bands in sunder.

entries.yo: Enia iba ma yìn Oluwa: nitori ore rẹ̀, ati nitori iṣẹ iyanu rẹ̀ si awọn ọmọ enia.
entries.en: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!

entries.yo: Nitori ti o fọ ilẹkun idẹ wọnni, o si ke ọpa-idabu irin wọnni li agbedemeji.
entries.en: For he hath broken the gates of brass, and cut the bars of iron in sunder.

entries.yo: Aṣiwere nitori irekọja wọn, ati nitori ẹ̀ṣẹ wọn, oju npọ́n wọn.
entries.en: Fools because of their transgression, and because of their iniquities, are afflicted.

entries.yo: Ọkàn wọn kọ̀ onjẹ-konjẹ; nwọn si sunmọ́ eti ẹnu-ọ̀na ikú.
entries.en: Their soul abhorreth all manner of meat; and they draw near unto the gates of death.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni nwọn kigbe pè Oluwa ninu ipọnju wọn, o si gbà wọn ninu iṣẹ́ wọn.
entries.en: Then they cry unto the LORD in their trouble, and he saveth them out of their distresses.

entries.yo: O rán ọ̀rọ rẹ̀, o si mu wọn lara da, o si gbà wọn kuro ninu iparun wọn.
entries.en: He sent his word, and healed them, and delivered them from their destructions.

entries.yo: Enia iba ma yìn Oluwa nitori ore rẹ̀, ati nitori iṣẹ iyanu rẹ̀ si awọn ọmọ enia.
entries.en: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!

entries.yo: Si jẹ ki nwọn ki o ru ẹbọ ọpẹ, ki nwọn ki o si fi orin ayọ̀ sọ̀rọ iṣẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And let them sacrifice the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his works with rejoicing.

entries.yo: Awọn ti nsọkalẹ lọ si okun ninu ọkọ̀, ti nwọn nṣiṣẹ ninu omi nla.
entries.en: They that go down to the sea in ships, that do business in great waters;

entries.yo: Awọn wọnyi ri iṣẹ Oluwa, ati iṣẹ iyanu rẹ̀ ninu ibú.
entries.en: These see the works of the LORD, and his wonders in the deep.

entries.yo: Nitori ti o paṣẹ, o si mu ìji fẹ, ti o gbé riru rẹ̀ soke.
entries.en: For he commandeth, and raiseth the stormy wind, which lifteth up the waves thereof.

entries.yo: Nwọn gòke lọ si ọrun, nwọn si tún sọkalẹ lọ si ibú; ọkàn wọn di omi nitori ipọnju.
entries.en: They mount up to the heaven, they go down again to the depths: their soul is melted because of trouble.

entries.yo: Nwọn nta gbọ̀ngbọ́n sihin sọhun, nwọn nta gbọ̀ngbọ́n bi ọmuti enia, ọgbọ́n wọn si de opin.
entries.en: They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits' end.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni nwọn kigbe pè Oluwa ninu ipọnju wọn, o si yọ wọn kuro ninu iṣẹ́ wọn.
entries.en: Then they cry unto the LORD in their trouble, and he bringeth them out of their distresses.

entries.yo: O sọ ìji di idakẹ-rọrọ́, bẹ̃ni riru omi rẹ̀ duro jẹ.
entries.en: He maketh the storm a calm, so that the waves thereof are still.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni nwọn yọ̀, nitori ti ara wọn balẹ; bẹ̃li o mu wọn wá si ebute ifẹ wọn.
entries.en: Then are they glad because they be quiet; so he bringeth them unto their desired haven.

entries.yo: Enia iba ma yìn Oluwa nitori ore rẹ̀, ati nitori iṣẹ iyanu rẹ̀ si awọn ọmọ enia!
entries.en: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!

entries.yo: Ki nwọn ki o gbé e ga pẹlu ni ijọ enia, ki nwọn ki o si yìn i ninu ijọ awọn àgba.
entries.en: Let them exalt him also in the congregation of the people, and praise him in the assembly of the elders.

entries.yo: O sọ odò di aginju, ati orisun omi di ilẹ gbigbẹ;
entries.en: He turneth rivers into a wilderness, and the watersprings into dry ground;

entries.yo: Ilẹ eleso di aṣálẹ̀, nitori ìwa-buburu awọn ti o wà ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: A fruitful land into barrenness, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein.

entries.yo: O sọ aginju di adagun omi, ati ilẹ gbigbẹ di orisun omi.
entries.en: He turneth the wilderness into a standing water, and dry ground into watersprings.

entries.yo: Nibẹ li o si mu awọn ti ebi npa joko, ki nwọn ki o le tẹ ilu do, lati ma gbe.
entries.en: And there he maketh the hungry to dwell, that they may prepare a city for habitation;

entries.yo: Lati fún irugbin si oko, ki nwọn si gbìn àgbala ajara, ti yio ma so eso ọ̀pọlọpọ.
entries.en: And sow the fields, and plant vineyards, which may yield fruits of increase.

entries.yo: O busi i fun wọn pẹlu, bẹ̃ni nwọn si pọ̀ si i gidigidi; kò si jẹ ki ẹran-ọ̀sin wọn ki o fà sẹhin.
entries.en: He blesseth them also, so that they are multiplied greatly; and suffereth not their cattle to decrease.

entries.yo: Ẹ̀wẹ, nwọn bùku, nwọn si fà sẹhin, nipa inira, ipọnju, ati ikãnu.
entries.en: Again, they are minished and brought low through oppression, affliction, and sorrow.

entries.yo: O dà ẹ̀gan lù awọn ọmọ-alade, o si mu wọn rìn kiri ni ijù, nibiti ọ̀na kò si.
entries.en: He poureth contempt upon princes, and causeth them to wander in the wilderness, where there is no way.

entries.yo: Sibẹ o gbé talaka leke kuro ninu ipọnju, o si ṣe idile wọnni bi agbo-ẹran.
entries.en: Yet setteth he the poor on high from affliction, and maketh him families like a flock.

entries.yo: Awọn ẹni diduro-ṣinṣin yio ri i, nwọn o si yọ̀: gbogbo ẹ̀ṣẹ ni yio si pa ẹnu rẹ̀ mọ.
entries.en: The righteous shall see it, and rejoice: and all iniquity shall stop her mouth.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o gbọ́n, yio si kiyesi nkan wọnyi; awọn na li oye iṣeun-ifẹ Oluwa yio ma ye.
entries.en: Whoso is wise, and will observe these things, even they shall understand the lovingkindness of the LORD.

entries.yo: OLỌRUN, ọkàn mi ti mura, emi o ma kọrin, emi o si ma fi ogo mi kọrin iyìn.
entries.en: O God, my heart is fixed; I will sing and give praise, even with my glory.

entries.yo: Ji, ohun-elo orin mimọ́ ati dùrù: emi tikarami yio si ji ni kutukutu.
entries.en: Awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.

entries.yo: Emi o ma yìn ọ, Oluwa, ninu awọn enia: emi o mã kọrin si ọ ninu awọn orilẹ-ède.
entries.en: I will praise thee, O LORD, among the people: and I will sing praises unto thee among the nations.

entries.yo: Nitori ti ãnu rẹ tobi jù ọrun lọ: ati otitọ rẹ titi de awọsanma.
entries.en: For thy mercy is great above the heavens: and thy truth reacheth unto the clouds.

entries.yo: Gbé ara rẹ ga, Ọlọrun, lori awọn ọrun: ati ogo rẹ lori gbogbo aiye.
entries.en: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: and thy glory above all the earth;

entries.yo: Ki a le gbà awọn olufẹ rẹ là: fi ọwọ ọtún rẹ ṣe igbala, ki o si da mi lohùn.
entries.en: That thy beloved may be delivered: save with thy right hand, and answer me.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun ti sọ̀rọ ninu ìwa-mimọ́ rẹ̀ pe; Emi o yọ̀, emi o pin Ṣekemu, emi o si wọ̀n afonifoji Sukkotu.
entries.en: God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.

entries.yo: Ti emi ni Gileadi: ti emi ni Manasse: Efraimu pẹlu li agbara ori mi: Juda li olofin mi:
entries.en: Gilead is mine; Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Judah is my lawgiver;

entries.yo: Moabu ni ikoko-iwẹsẹ mi; lori Edomu li emi o bọ́ bata mi si; lori Filistia li emi o ho iho-ayọ̀.
entries.en: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe; over Philistia will I triumph.

entries.yo: Tani yio mu mi wá sinu ilu olodi ni? tani yio sìn mi lọ si Edomu?
entries.en: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?

entries.yo: Iwọ Ọlọrun ha kọ́, ẹniti o ti ṣa wa tì? Ọlọrun, iwọ kì yio si ba awọn ogun wa jade lọ?
entries.en: Wilt not thou, O God, who hast cast us off? and wilt not thou, O God, go forth with our hosts?

entries.yo: Fun wa ni iranlọwọ ninu ipọnju: nitori asan ni iranlọwọ enia.
entries.en: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.

entries.yo: Nipasẹ Ọlọrun li awa o ṣe akin; nitori on ni yio tẹ̀ awọn ọta wa mọlẹ.
entries.en: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.

entries.yo: MÁṢE pa ẹnu rẹ mọ́, Ọlọrun iyìn mi;
entries.en: Hold not thy peace, O God of my praise;

entries.yo: Nitori ti ẹnu awọn enia buburu, ati ẹnu awọn ẹlẹtan yà silẹ si mi: nwọn ti fi ahọn eke sọ̀rọ si mi.
entries.en: For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful are opened against me: they have spoken against me with a lying tongue.

entries.yo: Nwọn si fi ọ̀rọ irira yi mi ka kiri; nwọn si mba mi ja li ainidi.
entries.en: They compassed me about also with words of hatred; and fought against me without a cause.

entries.yo: Nipo ifẹ mi nwọn nṣe ọta mi: ṣugbọn emi ngba adura.
entries.en: For my love they are my adversaries: but I give myself unto prayer.

entries.yo: Nwọn si fi ibi san ire fun mi, ati irira fun ifẹ mi.
entries.en: And they have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.

entries.yo: Yan enia buburu tì i: jẹ ki Olufisùn ki o duro li ọwọ ọtún rẹ̀.
entries.en: Set thou a wicked man over him: and let Satan stand at his right hand.

entries.yo: Nigbati a o ṣe idajọ rẹ̀, ki a da a lẹbi: ki adura rẹ̀ ki o di ẹ̀ṣẹ;
entries.en: When he shall be judged, let him be condemned: and let his prayer become sin.

entries.yo: Ki ọjọ rẹ̀ ki o kuru; ki ẹlomiran ki o rọpo iṣẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Let his days be few; and let another take his office.

entries.yo: Ki awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ ki o di alainibaba, ki aya rẹ̀ ki o di opó.
entries.en: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ ki o di alarinkiri, ti nṣagbe: ki nwọn ki o ma tọrọ onjẹ jina si ibi ahoro wọn.
entries.en: Let his children be continually vagabonds, and beg: let them seek their bread also out of their desolate places.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki alọnilọwọ-gbà ki o mu ohun gbogbo ti o ni; ki alejo ki o kó èrè iṣẹ́ rẹ̀ lọ.
entries.en: Let the extortioner catch all that he hath; and let the strangers spoil his labour.

entries.yo: Ki ẹnikẹni ki o má wà lati ṣãnu fun u: má si ṣe jẹ ki ẹnikẹni ki o si lati ṣe oju rere fun awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ alainibaba.
entries.en: Let there be none to extend mercy unto him: neither let there be any to favour his fatherless children.

entries.yo: Ki a ke ati ọmọ-de-ọmọ rẹ̀ kuro, ati ni iran ti mbọ̀ ki orukọ wọn ki o parẹ.
entries.en: Let his posterity be cut off; and in the generation following let their name be blotted out.

entries.yo: Ki a ma ranti ẹ̀ṣẹ awọn baba rẹ̀ lọdọ Oluwa; má si jẹ ki a nù ẹ̀ṣẹ iya rẹ̀ nù.
entries.en: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with the LORD; and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki nwọn ki o wà niwaju Oluwa nigbagbogbo, ki o le ke iranti wọn kuro lori ilẹ.
entries.en: Let them be before the LORD continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth.

entries.yo: Nitori ti kò ranti lati ṣãnu, ṣugbọn o ṣe inunibini si ọkunrin talaka ati olupọnju nì, ki o le pa onirobinujẹ-ọkàn.
entries.en: Because that he remembered not to shew mercy, but persecuted the poor and needy man, that he might even slay the broken in heart.

entries.yo: Bi o ti fẹ egun, bẹ̃ni ki o de si i: bi inu rẹ̀ kò ti dùn si ire, bẹ̃ni ki o jina si i.
entries.en: As he loved cursing, so let it come unto him: as he delighted not in blessing, so let it be far from him.

entries.yo: Bi o ti fi egun wọ ara rẹ li aṣọ bi ẹwu rẹ̀, bẹ̃ni ki o wá si inu rẹ̀ bi omi, ati bi orõro sinu egungun rẹ̀.
entries.en: As he clothed himself with cursing like as with his garment, so let it come into his bowels like water, and like oil into his bones.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki o ri fun u bi aṣọ ti o bò o lara, ati fun àmure ti o fi gbajá nigbagbogbo.
entries.en: Let it be unto him as the garment which covereth him, and for a girdle wherewith he is girded continually.

entries.yo: Eyi li ère awọn ọta mi lati ọwọ Oluwa wá, ati ti awọn ti nsọ̀rọ ibi si ọkàn mi.
entries.en: Let this be the reward of mine adversaries from the LORD, and of them that speak evil against my soul.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn iwọ ṣe fun mi, Ọlọrun Oluwa, nitori orukọ rẹ: nitoriti ãnu rẹ dara, iwọ gbà mi.
entries.en: But do thou for me, O GOD the Lord, for thy name's sake: because thy mercy is good, deliver thou me.

entries.yo: Nitoripe talaka ati olupọnju li emi aiya mi si gbọgbẹ ninu mi.
entries.en: For I am poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.

entries.yo: Emi nkọja lọ bi ojiji ti o nfà sẹhin, emi ntì soke tì sodò bi eṣú.
entries.en: I am gone like the shadow when it declineth: I am tossed up and down as the locust.

entries.yo: Ẽkun mi di ailera nitori igbawẹ; ẹran-ara mi si gbẹ nitori ailọra.
entries.en: My knees are weak through fasting; and my flesh faileth of fatness.

entries.yo: Emi di ẹ̀gan fun wọn pẹlu: nigbati nwọn wò mi, nwọn mi ori wọn.
entries.en: I became also a reproach unto them: when they looked upon me they shaked their heads.

entries.yo: Ràn mi lọwọ, Oluwa Ọlọrun mi: gbà mi gẹgẹ bi ãnu rẹ.
entries.en: Help me, O LORD my God: O save me according to thy mercy:

entries.yo: Ki nwọn ki o le mọ̀ pe ọwọ rẹ li eyi; pe Iwọ, Oluwa, li o ṣe e.
entries.en: That they may know that this is thy hand; that thou, LORD, hast done it.

entries.yo: Nwọn o ma gegun, ṣugbọn iwọ ma sure: nigbati nwọn ba dide, ki oju ki o tì wọn; ṣugbọn iranṣẹ rẹ yio yọ̀.
entries.en: Let them curse, but bless thou: when they arise, let them be ashamed; but let thy servant rejoice.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki a fi ìtiju wọ̀ awọn ọta mi li aṣọ, ki nwọn ki o si fi idaru-dapọ̀ wọn bò ara, bi ẹnipe ẹ̀wu.
entries.en: Let mine adversaries be clothed with shame, and let them cover themselves with their own confusion, as with a mantle.

entries.yo: Emi o ma fi ẹnu mi yìn Oluwa gidigidi; nitõtọ, emi o ma yìn i lãrin ọ̀pọ enia.
entries.en: I will greatly praise the LORD with my mouth; yea, I will praise him among the multitude.

entries.yo: Nitori ti yio duro li ọwọ ọtún olupọnju, lati gbà a lọwọ awọn ti o nda ọkàn rẹ̀ lẹbi.
entries.en: For he shall stand at the right hand of the poor, to save him from those that condemn his soul.

entries.yo: OLUWA wi fun Oluwa mi pe, Iwọ joko li ọwọ ọ̀tún mi, titi emi o fi sọ awọn ọta rẹ di apoti-itisẹ rẹ.
entries.en: The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.

entries.yo: Oluwa yio nà ọpá agbara rẹ lati Sioni wá: iwọ jọba larin awọn ọta rẹ.
entries.en: The LORD shall send the rod of thy strength out of Zion: rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.

entries.yo: Awọn enia rẹ yio jẹ ọrẹ atinuwá li ọjọ ijade-ogun rẹ, ninu ẹwà ìwà-mimọ́: lati inu owurọ wá, iwọ ni ìri ewe rẹ.
entries.en: Thy people shall be willing in the day of thy power, in the beauties of holiness from the womb of the morning: thou hast the dew of thy youth.

entries.yo: Oluwa ti bura, kì yio si yi ọkàn pada pe, Iwọ li alufa titi lai nipa ẹsẹ ti Melkisedeki.
entries.en: The LORD hath sworn, and will not repent, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek.

entries.yo: Oluwa li ọwọ ọtún rẹ ni yio lù awọn ọba jalẹ li ọjọ ibinu rẹ̀.
entries.en: The Lord at thy right hand shall strike through kings in the day of his wrath.

entries.yo: Yio ṣe idajọ lãrin awọn keferi, yio fi okú kún ibi wọnni; yio fọ́ ori lori ilẹ pupọ̀.
entries.en: He shall judge among the heathen, he shall fill the places with the dead bodies; he shall wound the heads over many countries.

entries.yo: Yio ma mu ninu odò na li ọ̀na: nitorina ni yio ṣe gbé ori soke.
entries.en: He shall drink of the brook in the way: therefore shall he lift up the head.

entries.yo: Ẹ ma yìn Oluwa. Emi o ma yìn Oluwa tinutinu mi, ninu ijọ awọn ẹni diduro-ṣinṣin, ati ni ijọ enia.
entries.en: Praise ye the LORD. I will praise the LORD with my whole heart, in the assembly of the upright, and in the congregation.

entries.yo: Iṣẹ Oluwa tobi, iwa-kiri ni fun gbogbo awọn ti o ni ifẹ rẹ̀ ninu.
entries.en: The works of the LORD are great, sought out of all them that have pleasure therein.

entries.yo: Iṣe rẹ̀ li ọlá on ogo, ododo rẹ̀ si duro lailai.
entries.en: His work is honourable and glorious: and his righteousness endureth for ever.

entries.yo: O ṣe iṣẹ iyanu rẹ̀ ni iranti: olore-ọfẹ́ li Oluwa o si kún fun ãnu.
entries.en: He hath made his wonderful works to be remembered: the LORD is gracious and full of compassion.

entries.yo: O ti fi onjẹ fun awọn ti o bẹ̀ru rẹ̀: yio ranti majẹmu rẹ̀ lailai.
entries.en: He hath given meat unto them that fear him: he will ever be mindful of his covenant.

entries.yo: O ti fi iṣẹ agbara rẹ̀ hàn awọn enia rẹ̀, ki o le fun wọn ni ilẹ-ini awọn keferi.
entries.en: He hath shewed his people the power of his works, that he may give them the heritage of the heathen.

entries.yo: Otitọ ati idajọ ni iṣẹ ọwọ rẹ̀; gbogbo ofin rẹ̀ li o daniloju.
entries.en: The works of his hands are verity and judgment; all his commandments are sure.

entries.yo: Nwọn duro lai ati lailai, ninu otitọ ati iduro-ṣinṣin li a ṣe wọn.
entries.en: They stand fast for ever and ever, and are done in truth and uprightness.

entries.yo: O rán idande si awọn enia rẹ̀: o ti paṣẹ majẹmu rẹ̀ lailai: mimọ́ ati ọ̀wọ li orukọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: He sent redemption unto his people: he hath commanded his covenant for ever: holy and reverend is his name.

entries.yo: Ibẹru Oluwa ni ipilẹṣẹ ọgbọ́n: oye rere ni gbogbo awọn ti npa ofin rẹ̀ mọ́ ni: iyìn rẹ̀ duro lailai.
entries.en: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom: a good understanding have all they that do his commandments: his praise endureth for ever.

entries.yo: Ẹ ma yìn Oluwa. Ibukún ni fun ẹniti o bẹ̀ru Oluwa, ti inu rẹ̀ dùn jọjọ sí ofin rẹ̀.
entries.en: Praise ye the LORD. Blessed is the man that feareth the LORD, that delighteth greatly in his commandments.

entries.yo: Iru-ọmọ rẹ̀ yio lagbara li aiye: iran ẹni-diduro-ṣinṣin li a o bukún fun.
entries.en: His seed shall be mighty upon earth: the generation of the upright shall be blessed.

entries.yo: Ọlà ati ọrọ̀ yio wà ni ile rẹ̀: ododo rẹ̀ si duro lailai.
entries.en: Wealth and riches shall be in his house: and his righteousness endureth for ever.

entries.yo: Fun ẹni-diduro-ṣinṣin ni imọlẹ mọ́ li òkunkun: olore-ọfẹ, o si kún fun ãnu, o si ṣe olododo.
entries.en: Unto the upright there ariseth light in the darkness: he is gracious, and full of compassion, and righteous.

entries.yo: Enia rere fi oju-rere hàn, a si wínni: imoye ni yio ma fi là ọ̀na iṣẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: A good man sheweth favour, and lendeth: he will guide his affairs with discretion.

entries.yo: Nitoriti a kì yio yi i nipò pada lailai: olododo yio wà ni iranti titi aiye.
entries.en: Surely he shall not be moved for ever: the righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance.
