entries.yo: Kì yio bẹ̀ru ihin buburu: aiya rẹ̀ ti mu ọ̀na kan, o gbẹkẹle Oluwa.
entries.en: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: his heart is fixed, trusting in the LORD.

entries.yo: Aiya rẹ̀ ti mulẹ, kì yio bẹ̀ru, titi yio fi ri ifẹ rẹ̀ lori awọn ọta rẹ̀.
entries.en: His heart is established, he shall not be afraid, until he see his desire upon his enemies.

entries.yo: O ti fún ka, o ti fi fun awọn olupọnju; ododo rẹ̀ duro lailai; ọlá li a o fi gbé iwo rẹ̀ ga.
entries.en: He hath dispersed, he hath given to the poor; his righteousness endureth for ever; his horn shall be exalted with honour.

entries.yo: Awọn enia buburu yio ri i, inu wọn o si bajẹ; yio pa ehin rẹ̀ keke, yio si yọ́ danu: ifẹ awọn enia buburu yio ṣegbe.
entries.en: The wicked shall see it, and be grieved; he shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away: the desire of the wicked shall perish.

entries.yo: Ẹ ma yìn Oluwa! Ẹ ma yìn, ẹnyin iranṣẹ Oluwa, ẹ ma yìn orukọ Oluwa.
entries.en: Praise ye the LORD. Praise, O ye servants of the LORD, praise the name of the LORD.

entries.yo: Ibukún li orukọ Oluwa lati isisiyi lọ ati si i lailai.
entries.en: Blessed be the name of the LORD from this time forth and for evermore.

entries.yo: Lati ila-õrun titi o fi de ìwọ rẹ̀ orukọ Oluwa ni ki a yìn.
entries.en: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same the LORD's name is to be praised.

entries.yo: Oluwa ga lori gbogbo orilẹ-ède, ogo rẹ̀ si wà lori ọrun.
entries.en: The LORD is high above all nations, and his glory above the heavens.

entries.yo: Tali o dabi Oluwa Ọlọrun wa, ti o ngbe ibi giga.
entries.en: Who is like unto the LORD our God, who dwelleth on high,

entries.yo: Ẹniti o rẹ̀ ara rẹ̀ silẹ lati wò ohun ti o wà li ọrun ati li aiye!
entries.en: Who humbleth himself to behold the things that are in heaven, and in the earth!

entries.yo: O gbé talaka soke lati inu erupẹ wá, o si gbé olupọnju soke lati ori àtan wá;
entries.en: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, and lifteth the needy out of the dunghill;

entries.yo: Ki o le mu u joko pẹlu awọn ọmọ-alade, ani pẹlu awọn ọmọ-alade awọn enia rẹ̀.
entries.en: That he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.

entries.yo: O mu àgan obinrin gbe inu ile, lati ma ṣe oninu-didùn iya awọn ọmọ. Ẹ ma yìn Oluwa!
entries.en: He maketh the barren woman to keep house, and to be a joyful mother of children. Praise ye the LORD.

entries.yo: NIGBATI Israeli jade kuro ni Egipti, ti ara-ile Jakobu kuro ninu àjeji ède enia;
entries.en: When Israel went out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of strange language;

entries.yo: Juda di ibi mimọ́ rẹ̀, Israeli di ijọba rẹ̀.
entries.en: Judah was his sanctuary, and Israel his dominion.

entries.yo: Okun ri i, o si sá: Jordani pada sẹhin.
entries.en: The sea saw it, and fled: Jordan was driven back.

entries.yo: Awọn òke nla nfò bi àgbo, ati awọn òke kekèke bi ọdọ-agutan.
entries.en: The mountains skipped like rams, and the little hills like lambs.

entries.yo: Kili o ṣe ọ, iwọ okun, ti iwọ fi sá? iwọ Jordani ti iwọ fi pada sẹhin?
entries.en: What ailed thee, O thou sea, that thou fleddest? thou Jordan, that thou wast driven back?

entries.yo: Ẹnyin òke nla, ti ẹ fi nfò bi àgbo; ati ẹnyin òke kekèke bi ọdọ-agutan?
entries.en: Ye mountains, that ye skipped like rams; and ye little hills, like lambs?

entries.yo: Warìri, iwọ ilẹ, niwaju Oluwa, niwaju Ọlọrun Jakobu.
entries.en: Tremble, thou earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob;

entries.yo: Ẹniti o sọ apata di adagun omi, ati okuta-ibọn di orisun omi.
entries.en: Which turned the rock into a standing water, the flint into a fountain of waters.

entries.yo: KÌ iṣe fun wa, Oluwa, kì iṣe fun wa, bikoṣe orukọ rẹ li a fi ogo fun nitori ãnu rẹ, ati nitori otitọ rẹ.
entries.en: Not unto us, O LORD, not unto us, but unto thy name give glory, for thy mercy, and for thy truth's sake.

entries.yo: Nitori kili awọn keferi yio ṣe wipe, Nibo li Ọlọrun wọn wà nisisiyi?
entries.en: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is now their God?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Ọlọrun wa mbẹ li ọrun: o nṣe ohun-kohun ti o wù u.
entries.en: But our God is in the heavens: he hath done whatsoever he hath pleased.

entries.yo: Fadaka ati wura li ere wọn, iṣẹ ọwọ enia.
entries.en: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men's hands.

entries.yo: Nwọn li ẹnu, ṣugbọn nwọn kò sọ̀rọ: nwọn li oju, ṣugbọn nwọn kò riran.
entries.en: They have mouths, but they speak not: eyes have they, but they see not:

entries.yo: Nwọn li eti, ṣugbọn nwọn kò gbọran: nwọn ni imu, ṣugbọn nwọn kò gbõrun.
entries.en: They have ears, but they hear not: noses have they, but they smell not:

entries.yo: Nwọn li ọwọ, ṣugbọn nwọn kò lò o: nwọn li ẹsẹ, ṣugbọn nwọn kò rìn: bẹ̃ni nwọn kò sọ̀rọ lati ọfun wọn jade.
entries.en: They have hands, but they handle not: feet have they, but they walk not: neither speak they through their throat.

entries.yo: Awọn ti nṣe wọn dabi wọn; bẹ̃li olukuluku ẹniti o gbẹkẹle wọn.
entries.en: They that make them are like unto them; so is every one that trusteth in them.

entries.yo: Israeli, iwọ gbẹkẹle Oluwa: on ni iranlọwọ wọn ati asà wọn.
entries.en: O Israel, trust thou in the LORD: he is their help and their shield.

entries.yo: Ara-ile Aaroni, gbẹkẹle Oluwa, on ni iranlọwọ wọn ati asà wọn.
entries.en: O house of Aaron, trust in the LORD: he is their help and their shield.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin ti o bẹ̀ru Oluwa, gbẹkẹle Oluwa: on ni iranlọwọ wọn ati asà wọn.
entries.en: Ye that fear the LORD, trust in the LORD: he is their help and their shield.

entries.yo: Oluwa ti nṣe iranti wa: yio bùsi i fun wa: yio bùsi i fun ara-ile Israeli; yio bùsi i fun ara-ile Aaroni.
entries.en: The LORD hath been mindful of us: he will bless us; he will bless the house of Israel; he will bless the house of Aaron.

entries.yo: Yio bùsi i fun awọn ti o bẹ̀ru Oluwa, ati ewe ati àgba.
entries.en: He will bless them that fear the LORD, both small and great.

entries.yo: Oluwa yio mu nyin bisi i siwaju ati siwaju, ẹnyin ati awọn ọmọ nyin.
entries.en: The LORD shall increase you more and more, you and your children.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin li ẹni-ibukún Oluwa, ti o da ọrun on aiye.
entries.en: Ye are blessed of the LORD which made heaven and earth.

entries.yo: Ọrun ani ọrun ni ti Oluwa; ṣugbọn aiye li o fi fun awọn ọmọ enia.
entries.en: The heaven, even the heavens, are the LORD's: but the earth hath he given to the children of men.

entries.yo: Okú kò yìn Oluwa, ati gbogbo awọn ti o sọkalẹ lọ sinu idakẹ.
entries.en: The dead praise not the LORD, neither any that go down into silence.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awa o ma fi ibukún fun Oluwa, lati igba yi lọ ati si i lailai. Ẹ yìn Oluwa.
entries.en: But we will bless the LORD from this time forth and for evermore. Praise the LORD.

entries.yo: EMI fẹ Oluwa nitori ti o gbọ́ ohùn mi ati ẹ̀bẹ mi.
entries.en: I love the LORD, because he hath heard my voice and my supplications.

entries.yo: Nitori ti o dẹ eti rẹ̀ si mi, nitorina li emi o ma kepè e niwọn ọjọ mi.
entries.en: Because he hath inclined his ear unto me, therefore will I call upon him as long as I live.

entries.yo: Ikẹkùn ikú yi mi ka, ati irora isà-òkú di mi mu; mo ri iyọnu ati ikãnu.
entries.en: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the pains of hell gat hold upon me: I found trouble and sorrow.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni mo kepè orukọ Oluwa; Oluwa, emi bẹ̀ ọ, gbà ọkàn mi.
entries.en: Then called I upon the name of the LORD; O LORD, I beseech thee, deliver my soul.

entries.yo: Olore-ọfẹ li Oluwa, ati olododo; nitõtọ, alãnu li Ọlọrun wa.
entries.en: Gracious is the LORD, and righteous; yea, our God is merciful.

entries.yo: Oluwa pa awọn alaimọ̀kan mọ́: a rẹ̀ mi silẹ tan, o si ràn mi lọwọ.
entries.en: The LORD preserveth the simple: I was brought low, and he helped me.

entries.yo: Pada si ibi isimi rẹ, iwọ ọkàn mi; nitori ti Oluwa ṣe é lọ́pọlọpọ fun ọ.
entries.en: Return unto thy rest, O my soul; for the LORD hath dealt bountifully with thee.

entries.yo: Nitori ti iwọ gbà ọkàn mi lọwọ ikú, oju mi lọwọ omije, ati ẹsẹ mi lọwọ iṣubu.
entries.en: For thou hast delivered my soul from death, mine eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.

entries.yo: Emi o ma rìn niwaju Oluwa ni ilẹ alãye.
entries.en: I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.

entries.yo: Emi gbagbọ́, nitorina li emi ṣe sọ: mo ri ipọnju gidigidi.
entries.en: I believed, therefore have I spoken: I was greatly afflicted:

entries.yo: Mo wi ni iyara mi pe: Eke ni gbogbo enia.
entries.en: I said in my haste, All men are liars.

entries.yo: Kili emi o san fun Oluwa nitori gbogbo ore rẹ̀ si mi?
entries.en: What shall I render unto the LORD for all his benefits toward me?

entries.yo: Emi o mu ago igbala, emi o si ma kepè orukọ Oluwa.
entries.en: I will take the cup of salvation, and call upon the name of the LORD.

entries.yo: Emi o san ileri ifẹ mi fun Oluwa, nitõtọ li oju gbogbo awọn enia rẹ̀.
entries.en: I will pay my vows unto the LORD now in the presence of all his people.

entries.yo: Iyebiye ni ikú awọn ayanfẹ rẹ̀ li oju Oluwa.
entries.en: Precious in the sight of the LORD is the death of his saints.

entries.yo: Oluwa nitõtọ iranṣẹ rẹ li emi; iranṣẹ rẹ̀ li emi, ati ọmọ iranṣẹ-birin rẹ: iwọ ti tú ìde mi.
entries.en: O LORD, truly I am thy servant; I am thy servant, and the son of thine handmaid: thou hast loosed my bonds.

entries.yo: Emi o ru ẹbọ ọpẹ si ọ, emi o ma ke pè orukọ Oluwa.
entries.en: I will offer to thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call upon the name of the LORD.

entries.yo: Emi o san ileri ifẹ mi fun Oluwa, nitõtọ li oju gbogbo awọn enia rẹ̀.
entries.en: I will pay my vows unto the LORD now in the presence of all his people,

entries.yo: Ninu àgbala ile Oluwa, li arin rẹ, iwọ Jerusalemu. Ẹ yìn Oluwa.
entries.en: In the courts of the LORD's house, in the midst of thee, O Jerusalem. Praise ye the LORD.

entries.yo: Ẹ ma yìn Oluwa, ẹnyin orilẹ-ède gbogbo: ẹ yìn i, ẹnyin enia gbogbo.
entries.en: O praise the LORD, all ye nations: praise him, all ye people.

entries.yo: Nitoriti iṣeun ãnu rẹ̀ pọ̀ si wa: ati otitọ Oluwa duro lailai. Ẹ yìn Oluwa!
entries.en: For his merciful kindness is great toward us: and the truth of the LORD endureth for ever. Praise ye the LORD.

entries.yo: Ẹ fi ọpẹ fun Oluwa; nitoriti o ṣeun, nitoriti ãnu rẹ̀ duro lailai.
entries.en: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: because his mercy endureth for ever.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki Israeli ki o wi nisisiyi pe, ãnu rẹ̀ duro lailai.
entries.en: Let Israel now say, that his mercy endureth for ever.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki ara-ile Aaroni ki o wi nisisiyi pe, ãnu rẹ̀ duro lailai.
entries.en: Let the house of Aaron now say, that his mercy endureth for ever.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki awọn ti o bẹ̀ru Oluwa ki o wi nisisiyi pe, ãnu rẹ̀ duro lailai.
entries.en: Let them now that fear the LORD say, that his mercy endureth for ever.

entries.yo: Mo kepè Oluwa ninu ipọnju: Oluwa si da mi lohùn ni ibi àye nla.
entries.en: I called upon the LORD in distress: the LORD answered me, and set me in a large place.

entries.yo: Oluwa mbẹ fun mi, emi kì yio bẹ̀ru; kili enia le ṣe si mi?
entries.en: The LORD is on my side; I will not fear: what can man do unto me?

entries.yo: Oluwa mbẹ fun mi pẹlu awọn ti nràn mi lọwọ: nitorina li emi o ṣe ri ifẹ mi lori awọn ti o korira mi.
entries.en: The LORD taketh my part with them that help me: therefore shall I see my desire upon them that hate me.

entries.yo: O ya lati gbẹkẹle Oluwa, jù ati gbẹkẹle enia lọ.
entries.en: It is better to trust in the LORD than to put confidence in man.

entries.yo: O ya lati gbẹkẹle Oluwa, jù ati gbẹkẹle awọn ọmọ-alade lọ.
entries.en: It is better to trust in the LORD than to put confidence in princes.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn orilẹ-ède yi mi ka kiri, ṣugbọn li orukọ Oluwa emi o pa wọn run.
entries.en: All nations compassed me about: but in the name of the LORD will I destroy them.

entries.yo: Nwọn yi mi ka kiri; nitõtọ, nwọn yi mi ka kiri, ṣugbọn li orukọ Oluwa emi o pa wọn run.
entries.en: They compassed me about; yea, they compassed me about: but in the name of the LORD I will destroy them.

entries.yo: Nwọn yi mi ka kiri bi oyin; a si pa wọn bi iná ẹgún: li orukọ Oluwa emi o sa pa wọn run.
entries.en: They compassed me about like bees; they are quenched as the fire of thorns: for in the name of the LORD I will destroy them.

entries.yo: Iwọ tì mi gidigidi ki emi ki o le ṣubu; ṣugbọn Oluwa ràn mi lọwọ.
entries.en: Thou hast thrust sore at me that I might fall: but the LORD helped me.

entries.yo: Oluwa li agbara ati orin mi, o si di igbala mi.
entries.en: The LORD is my strength and song, and is become my salvation.

entries.yo: Ìró ayọ̀ ati ti ìṣẹ́gun mbẹ ninu agọ awọn olododo; ọwọ ọtún Oluwa li a gbega: ọwọ ọtún Oluwa nṣe agbara.
entries.en: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tabernacles of the righteous: the right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly.

entries.yo: Ọwọ ọtún Oluwa li a gbega: ọwọ ọtún Oluwa nṣe agbara.
entries.en: The right hand of the LORD is exalted: the right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly.

entries.yo: Emi kì yio kú, bikoṣe yiyè, ki emi ki o si ma rohin iṣẹ Oluwa.
entries.en: I shall not die, but live, and declare the works of the LORD.

entries.yo: Oluwa nà mi gidigidi: ṣugbọn kò fi mi fun ikú.
entries.en: The LORD hath chastened me sore: but he hath not given me over unto death.

entries.yo: Ṣi ilẹkun ẹnu-ọ̀na ododo silẹ fun mi: emi o ba ibẹ wọle, emi o ma yìn Oluwa.
entries.en: Open to me the gates of righteousness: I will go into them, and I will praise the LORD:

entries.yo: Eyi li ẹnu-ọ̀na Oluwa, ti awọn olododo yio ba wọle.
entries.en: This gate of the LORD, into which the righteous shall enter.

entries.yo: Emi o yìn ọ: nitori ti iwọ gbohùn mi, iwọ si di igbala mi.
entries.en: I will praise thee: for thou hast heard me, and art become my salvation.

entries.yo: Okuta ti awọn ọ̀mọle kọ̀ silẹ li o di pataki igun ile.
entries.en: The stone which the builders refused is become the head stone of the corner.

entries.yo: Lati ọdọ Oluwa li eyi: o ṣe iyanu li oju wa.
entries.en: This is the LORD's doing; it is marvellous in our eyes.

entries.yo: Eyi li ọjọ ti Oluwa da: awa o ma yọ̀, inu wa yio si ma dùn ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.

entries.yo: Ṣe igbala nisisiyi, emi mbẹ ọ, Oluwa: Oluwa emi bẹ ọ, rán alafia.
entries.en: Save now, I beseech thee, O LORD: O LORD, I beseech thee, send now prosperity.

entries.yo: Olubukún li ẹniti o mbọ̀ wá li orukọ Oluwa: awa ti fi ibukún fun ọ lati ile Oluwa wá.
entries.en: Blessed be he that cometh in the name of the LORD: we have blessed you out of the house of the LORD.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun li Oluwa, ti o ti fi imọlẹ hàn fun wa: ẹ fi okùn di ẹbọ na mọ́ iwo pẹpẹ na.
entries.en: God is the LORD, which hath shewed us light: bind the sacrifice with cords, even unto the horns of the altar.

entries.yo: Iwọ li Ọlọrun mi, emi o si ma yìn ọ, iwọ li Ọlọrun mi, emi o mã gbé ọ ga.
entries.en: Thou art my God, and I will praise thee: thou art my God, I will exalt thee.

entries.yo: Ẹ fi ọpẹ fun Oluwa; nitori ti o ṣeun: nitori ti ãnu rẹ̀ duro lailai.
entries.en: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.

entries.yo: IBUKÚN ni fun awọn ẹniti o pé li ọ̀na na, ti nrìn ninu ofin Oluwa.
entries.en: Blessed are the undefiled in the way, who walk in the law of the LORD.

entries.yo: Ibukún ni fun awọn ti npa ẹri rẹ̀ mọ́, ti si nwá a kiri tinu-tinu gbogbo.
entries.en: Blessed are they that keep his testimonies, and that seek him with the whole heart.

entries.yo: Nwọn kò dẹṣẹ pẹlu: nwọn nrìn li ọ̀na rẹ̀.
entries.en: They also do no iniquity: they walk in his ways.

entries.yo: Iwọ ti paṣẹ fun wa lati pa ẹkọ́ rẹ mọ́ gidigidi.
entries.en: Thou hast commanded us to keep thy precepts diligently.

entries.yo: Ọ̀na mi iba jẹ là silẹ lati ma pa ilana rẹ mọ́!
entries.en: O that my ways were directed to keep thy statutes!

entries.yo: Nigbana li oju kì yio tì mi, nigbati emi ba njuba aṣẹ rẹ gbogbo.
entries.en: Then shall I not be ashamed, when I have respect unto all thy commandments.

entries.yo: Emi o ma fi aiya diduro-ṣinṣin yìn ọ, nigbati emi ba ti kọ́ idajọ ododo rẹ.
entries.en: I will praise thee with uprightness of heart, when I shall have learned thy righteous judgments.

entries.yo: Emi o pa ilana rẹ mọ́: máṣe kọ̀ mi silẹ patapata.
entries.en: I will keep thy statutes: O forsake me not utterly.

entries.yo: Nipa ewo li ọdọmọkunrin yio fi mu ọ̀na rẹ̀ mọ́? nipa ikiyesi gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ rẹ.
entries.en: Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his way? by taking heed thereto according to thy word.

entries.yo: Tinu-tinu mi gbogbo li emi fi ṣe afẹri rẹ: máṣe jẹ ki emi ṣina kuro ninu aṣẹ rẹ.
entries.en: With my whole heart have I sought thee: O let me not wander from thy commandments.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ rẹ ni mo pamọ́ li aiya mi, ki emi ki o má ba ṣẹ̀ si ọ.
entries.en: Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.

entries.yo: Olubukún ni iwọ, Oluwa: kọ́ mi ni ilana rẹ.
entries.en: Blessed art thou, O LORD: teach me thy statutes.

entries.yo: Ẹnu mi li emi fi nsọ gbogbo idajọ ẹnu rẹ.
entries.en: With my lips have I declared all the judgments of thy mouth.

entries.yo: Emi ti nyọ̀ li ọ̀na ẹri rẹ, bi lori oniruru ọrọ̀.
entries.en: I have rejoiced in the way of thy testimonies, as much as in all riches.

entries.yo: Emi o ma ṣe àṣaro ninu ẹkọ́ rẹ emi o si ma juba ọ̀na rẹ.
entries.en: I will meditate in thy precepts, and have respect unto thy ways.

entries.yo: Emi o ma ṣe inu-didùn ninu ilana rẹ: emi kì yio gbagbe ọ̀rọ rẹ.
entries.en: I will delight myself in thy statutes: I will not forget thy word.

entries.yo: Fi ọ̀pọlọpọ ba iranṣẹ rẹ ṣe, ki emi ki o le wà lãye, ki emi ki o le ma pa ọ̀rọ rẹ mọ́.
entries.en: Deal bountifully with thy servant, that I may live, and keep thy word.

entries.yo: Là mi li oju, ki emi ki o le ma wò ohun iyanu wọnni lati inu ofin rẹ.
entries.en: Open thou mine eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of thy law.

entries.yo: Alejo li emi li aiye: máṣe pa àṣẹ rẹ mọ́ fun mi.
entries.en: I am a stranger in the earth: hide not thy commandments from me.

entries.yo: Aiya mi bù nitori ifojusọna si idajọ rẹ nigbagbogbo.
entries.en: My soul breaketh for the longing that it hath unto thy judgments at all times.

entries.yo: Iwọ ti ba awọn agberaga wi, ti a ti fi gégun, ti o ti ṣina kuro nipa aṣẹ rẹ.
entries.en: Thou hast rebuked the proud that are cursed, which do err from thy commandments.

entries.yo: Mu ẹ̀gan ati àbuku kuro lara mi; nitoriti emi ti pa ẹri rẹ mọ́.
entries.en: Remove from me reproach and contempt; for I have kept thy testimonies.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ-alade joko pẹlu, nwọn nsọ̀rọ mi: ṣugbọn iranṣẹ rẹ nṣe àṣaro ninu ilana rẹ:
entries.en: Princes also did sit and speak against me: but thy servant did meditate in thy statutes.

entries.yo: Ẹri rẹ pẹlu ni didùn-inu mi ati ìgbimọ mi.
entries.en: Thy testimonies also are my delight and my counsellors.

entries.yo: Ọkàn mi lẹ̀ mọ́ erupẹ: iwọ sọ mi di ãye gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ rẹ.
entries.en: My soul cleaveth unto the dust: quicken thou me according to thy word.

entries.yo: Emi ti rohin ọ̀na mi, iwọ si gbohùn mi: mã kọ́ mi ni ilana rẹ.
entries.en: I have declared my ways, and thou heardest me: teach me thy statutes.

entries.yo: Mu oye ọ̀na ẹkọ́ rẹ ye mi: bẹ̃li emi o ma ṣe aṣaro iṣẹ iyanu rẹ.
entries.en: Make me to understand the way of thy precepts: so shall I talk of thy wondrous works.

entries.yo: Ọkàn mi nrọ fun ãrẹ̀: iwọ mu mi lara le gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ rẹ.
entries.en: My soul melteth for heaviness: strengthen thou me according unto thy word.

entries.yo: Mu ọ̀na eke kuro lọdọ mi: ki o si fi ore-ọfẹ fi ofin rẹ fun mi.
entries.en: Remove from me the way of lying: and grant me thy law graciously.

entries.yo: Emi ti yàn ọ̀na otitọ: idajọ rẹ ni mo fi lelẹ niwaju mi.
entries.en: I have chosen the way of truth: thy judgments have I laid before me.

entries.yo: Emi ti faramọ ẹri rẹ: Oluwa, máṣe dojutì mi.
entries.en: I have stuck unto thy testimonies: O LORD, put me not to shame.

entries.yo: Emi o ma sare li ọ̀na aṣẹ rẹ, nitori iwọ bùn aiya mi laye.
entries.en: I will run the way of thy commandments, when thou shalt enlarge my heart.

entries.yo: Oluwa, kọ́ mi li ọ̀na rẹ; emi o si ma pa a mọ́ de opin.
entries.en: Teach me, O LORD, the way of thy statutes; and I shall keep it unto the end.

entries.yo: Fun mi li oye, emi o si pa ofin rẹ mọ́; nitõtọ, emi o ma kiyesi i tinutinu mi gbogbo.
entries.en: Give me understanding, and I shall keep thy law; yea, I shall observe it with my whole heart.

entries.yo: Mu mi rìn ni ipa aṣẹ rẹ; nitori ninu rẹ̀ ni didùn inu mi.
entries.en: Make me to go in the path of thy commandments; for therein do I delight.

entries.yo: Fa aiya mi si ẹri rẹ, ki o má si ṣe si oju-kòkoro.
entries.en: Incline my heart unto thy testimonies, and not to covetousness.

entries.yo: Yi oju mi pada kuro lati ma wò ohun asan; mu mi yè li ọna rẹ.
entries.en: Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity; and quicken thou me in thy way.

entries.yo: Fi ọ̀rọ rẹ mulẹ si iranṣẹ rẹ, ti iṣe ti ìbẹru rẹ̀.
entries.en: Stablish thy word unto thy servant, who is devoted to thy fear.

entries.yo: Yi ẹ̀gan mi pada ti mo bẹ̀ru: nitori ti idajọ rẹ dara.
entries.en: Turn away my reproach which I fear: for thy judgments are good.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, ọkàn mi ti fà si ẹkọ́ rẹ: sọ mi di ãye ninu ododo rẹ.
entries.en: Behold, I have longed after thy precepts: quicken me in thy righteousness.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki ãnu rẹ ki o tọ̀ mi wá pẹlu, Oluwa, ani igbala rẹ gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ rẹ.
entries.en: Let thy mercies come also unto me, O LORD, even thy salvation, according to thy word.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li emi o ni ọ̀rọ ti emi o fi da ẹni ti ngàn mi lohùn; nitori mo gbẹkẹle ọ̀rọ rẹ.
entries.en: So shall I have wherewith to answer him that reproacheth me: for I trust in thy word.

entries.yo: Lõtọ máṣe gbà ọ̀rọ otitọ kuro li ẹnu mi rara; nitori ti mo ti nṣe ireti ni idajọ rẹ.
entries.en: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; for I have hoped in thy judgments.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li emi o ma pa ofin rẹ mọ́ patapata titi lai ati lailai.
entries.en: So shall I keep thy law continually for ever and ever.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li emi o ma rìn ni alafia; nitori ti mo wá ẹkọ́ rẹ.
entries.en: And I will walk at liberty: for I seek thy precepts.

entries.yo: Emi o si ma sọ̀rọ ẹri rẹ niwaju awọn ọba, emi kì yio si tiju.
entries.en: I will speak of thy testimonies also before kings, and will not be ashamed.

entries.yo: Emi o si ma ṣe inu-didùn ninu aṣẹ rẹ, ti emi ti fẹ.
entries.en: And I will delight myself in thy commandments, which I have loved.

entries.yo: Ọwọ mi pẹlu li emi o gbe soke si aṣẹ rẹ, ti emi ti fẹ; emi o si ma ṣe Ìṣàrò-ìlànà rẹ.
entries.en: My hands also will I lift up unto thy commandments, which I have loved; and I will meditate in thy statutes.

entries.yo: Ranti ọ̀rọ nì si ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ, ninu eyiti iwọ ti mu mi ṣe ireti.
entries.en: Remember the word unto thy servant, upon which thou hast caused me to hope.

entries.yo: Eyi ni itunu mi ninu ipọnju mi: nitori ọ̀rọ rẹ li o sọ mi di ãye.
entries.en: This is my comfort in my affliction: for thy word hath quickened me.

entries.yo: Awọn agberaga ti nyọ-ṣuti si mi gidigidi: sibẹ emi kò fa sẹhin kuro ninu ofin rẹ.
entries.en: The proud have had me greatly in derision: yet have I not declined from thy law.

entries.yo: Oluwa, emi ranti idajọ atijọ; emi si tu ara mi ninu.
entries.en: I remembered thy judgments of old, O LORD; and have comforted myself.

entries.yo: Mo ni ibinujẹ nla nitori awọn enia buburu ti o kọ̀ ofin rẹ silẹ.
entries.en: Horror hath taken hold upon me because of the wicked that forsake thy law.

entries.yo: Ilana rẹ li o ti nṣe orin mi ni ile atipo mi.
entries.en: Thy statutes have been my songs in the house of my pilgrimage.

entries.yo: Emi ti ranti orukọ rẹ Oluwa, li oru, emi si ti pa ofin rẹ mọ́.
entries.en: I have remembered thy name, O LORD, in the night, and have kept thy law.

entries.yo: Eyi ni mo ni nitori ti mo pa ẹkọ rẹ mọ́.
entries.en: This I had, because I kept thy precepts.

entries.yo: Oluwa, iwọ ni ipin mi: emi ti wipe, emi o pa ọ̀rọ rẹ mọ́.
entries.en: Thou art my portion, O LORD: I have said that I would keep thy words.

entries.yo: Emi ti mbẹ̀bẹ oju-rere rẹ tinutinu mi gbogbo: ṣãnu fun mi gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ rẹ.
entries.en: I intreated thy favour with my whole heart: be merciful unto me according to thy word.

entries.yo: Emi rò ọ̀na mi, mo si yi ẹsẹ mi pada si ẹri rẹ.
entries.en: I thought on my ways, and turned my feet unto thy testimonies.

entries.yo: Emi yara, emi kò si lọra lati pa ofin rẹ mọ́.
entries.en: I made haste, and delayed not to keep thy commandments.

entries.yo: Okùn awọn enia buburu ti yi mi ka: ṣugbọn emi kò gbagbe ofin rẹ.
entries.en: The bands of the wicked have robbed me: but I have not forgotten thy law.

entries.yo: Lãrin ọganjọ emi o dide lati dupẹ fun ọ nitori ododo idajọ rẹ.
entries.en: At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto thee because of thy righteous judgments.

entries.yo: Ẹgbẹ gbogbo awọn ti o bẹ̀ru rẹ li emi, ati ti awọn ti npa ẹkọ́ rẹ mọ́.
entries.en: I am a companion of all them that fear thee, and of them that keep thy precepts.

entries.yo: Oluwa, aiye kún fun ãnu rẹ: kọ́ mi ni ilana rẹ.
entries.en: The earth, O LORD, is full of thy mercy: teach me thy statutes.

entries.yo: Iwọ ti nṣe rere fun iranṣẹ rẹ Oluwa, gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ rẹ.
entries.en: Thou hast dealt well with thy servant, O LORD, according unto thy word.

entries.yo: Kọ́ mi ni ìwa ati ìmọ̀ rere; nitori ti mo gbà aṣẹ rẹ gbọ́.
entries.en: Teach me good judgment and knowledge: for I have believed thy commandments.

entries.yo: Ki a to pọ́n mi loju emi ti ṣina: ṣugbọn nisisiyi emi ti pa ọ̀rọ rẹ mọ́.
entries.en: Before I was afflicted I went astray: but now have I kept thy word.

entries.yo: Iwọ ṣeun iwọ si nṣe rere; kọ́ mi ni ilana rẹ.
entries.en: Thou art good, and doest good; teach me thy statutes.

entries.yo: Awọn agberaga ti hùmọ eke si mi: ṣugbọn emi o pa ẹkọ́ rẹ mọ́ tinutinu mi gbogbo.
entries.en: The proud have forged a lie against me: but I will keep thy precepts with my whole heart.

entries.yo: Aiya wọn sebọ bi ọrá; ṣugbọn emi o ṣe inu-didùn ninu ofin rẹ.
entries.en: Their heart is as fat as grease; but I delight in thy law.

entries.yo: O dara fun mi ti a pọ́n mi loju; ki emi ki o le kọ́ ilana rẹ.
entries.en: It is good for me that I have been afflicted; that I might learn thy statutes.

entries.yo: Ofin ẹnu rẹ dara fun mi jù ẹgbẹgbẹrun wura ati fadaka lọ.
entries.en: The law of thy mouth is better unto me than thousands of gold and silver.

entries.yo: Ọwọ rẹ li o ti da mi, ti o si ṣe àworan mi: fun mi li oye, ki emi ki o le kọ́ aṣẹ rẹ.
entries.en: Thy hands have made me and fashioned me: give me understanding, that I may learn thy commandments.

entries.yo: Inu awọn ti o bẹ̀ru rẹ yio dùn, nigbati nwọn ba ri mi; nitori ti mo ti reti li ọ̀rọ rẹ.
entries.en: They that fear thee will be glad when they see me; because I have hoped in thy word.

entries.yo: Oluwa, emi mọ̀ pe, ododo ni idajọ rẹ, ati pe li otitọ ni iwọ pọ́n mi loju.
entries.en: I know, O LORD, that thy judgments are right, and that thou in faithfulness hast afflicted me.

entries.yo: Emi bẹ̀ ọ, jẹ ki iṣeun-ãnu rẹ ki o mã ṣe itunu mi gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ rẹ si iranṣẹ rẹ.
entries.en: Let, I pray thee, thy merciful kindness be for my comfort, according to thy word unto thy servant.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki irọnu ãnu rẹ ki o tọ̀ mi wá, ki emi ki o le yè: nitori ofin rẹ ni didùn-inu mi.
entries.en: Let thy tender mercies come unto me, that I may live: for thy law is my delight.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki oju ki o tì agberaga; nitori ti nwọn ṣe arekereke si mi li ainidi: ṣugbọn emi o ma ṣe àṣaro ninu ẹkọ́ rẹ.
entries.en: Let the proud be ashamed; for they dealt perversely with me without a cause: but I will meditate in thy precepts.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki awọn ti o bẹ̀ru rẹ ki o yipada si mi, ati awọn ti o ti mọ̀ ẹri rẹ.
entries.en: Let those that fear thee turn unto me, and those that have known thy testimonies.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki aiya mi ki o pé ni ilana rẹ; ki oju ki o máṣe tì mi.
entries.en: Let my heart be sound in thy statutes; that I be not ashamed.

entries.yo: Ọkàn mi ndaku fun igbala rẹ; ṣugbọn emi ni ireti li ọ̀rọ rẹ.
entries.en: My soul fainteth for thy salvation: but I hope in thy word.

entries.yo: Oju mi ṣofo nitori ọ̀rọ rẹ, wipe, Nigbawo ni iwọ o tù mi ninu?
entries.en: Mine eyes fail for thy word, saying, When wilt thou comfort me?

entries.yo: Nitori ti emi dabi igo-awọ loju ẽfin; ṣugbọn emi kò gbagbe ilana rẹ.
entries.en: For I am become like a bottle in the smoke; yet do I not forget thy statutes.

entries.yo: Ijọ melo li ọjọ iranṣẹ rẹ? nigbawo ni iwọ o ṣe idajọ lara awọn ti nṣe inunibini si mi?
entries.en: How many are the days of thy servant? when wilt thou execute judgment on them that persecute me?

entries.yo: Awọn agberaga ti wà ìho silẹ dè mi, ti kì iṣe gẹgẹ bi ofin rẹ.
entries.en: The proud have digged pits for me, which are not after thy law.

entries.yo: Otitọ li aṣẹ rẹ gbogbo: nwọn fi arekereke ṣe inunibini si mi: iwọ ràn mi lọwọ.
entries.en: All thy commandments are faithful: they persecute me wrongfully; help thou me.

entries.yo: Nwọn fẹrẹ run mi li ori ilẹ; ṣugbọn emi kò kọ ẹkọ́ rẹ silẹ.
entries.en: They had almost consumed me upon earth; but I forsook not thy precepts.

entries.yo: Sọ mi di ãye gẹgẹ bi iṣeun-ãnu rẹ; bẹ̃li emi o pa ẹri ẹnu rẹ mọ́.
entries.en: Quicken me after thy lovingkindness; so shall I keep the testimony of thy mouth.

entries.yo: Oluwa, lai, ọ̀rọ rẹ kalẹ li ọrun.
entries.en: For ever, O LORD, thy word is settled in heaven.

entries.yo: Lati iran-diran li otitọ rẹ; iwọ ti fi idi aiye mulẹ, o si duro.
entries.en: Thy faithfulness is unto all generations: thou hast established the earth, and it abideth.

entries.yo: Nwọn duro di oni nipa idajọ rẹ: nitori pe iranṣẹ rẹ ni gbogbo wọn.
entries.en: They continue this day according to thine ordinances: for all are thy servants.

entries.yo: Bikoṣepe bi ofin rẹ ti ṣe inu-didùn mi, emi iba ti ṣegbe ninu ipọnju mi.
entries.en: Unless thy law had been my delights, I should then have perished in mine affliction.

entries.yo: Lai emi kì yio gbagbe ẹkọ́ rẹ; nitori pe awọn ni iwọ fi sọ mi di ãye.
entries.en: I will never forget thy precepts: for with them thou hast quickened me.

entries.yo: Tirẹ li emi, gbà mi; nitori ti emi wá ẹkọ́ rẹ.
entries.en: I am thine, save me; for I have sought thy precepts.

entries.yo: Awọn enia buburu ti duro dè mi lati pa mi run: ṣugbọn emi o kiyesi ẹri rẹ.
entries.en: The wicked have waited for me to destroy me: but I will consider thy testimonies.

entries.yo: Emi ti ri opin ohun pipé gbogbo: ṣugbọn aṣẹ rẹ gbõro gidigidi.
entries.en: I have seen an end of all perfection: but thy commandment is exceeding broad.

entries.yo: Emi ti fẹ ofin rẹ to! iṣaro mi ni li ọjọ gbogbo.
entries.en: O how love I thy law! it is my meditation all the day.

entries.yo: Nipa aṣẹ rẹ iwọ mu mi gbọ́n jù awọn ọta mi lọ: nitori ti o wà pẹlu mi lailai.
entries.en: Thou through thy commandments hast made me wiser than mine enemies: for they are ever with me.

entries.yo: Emi ni iyè ninu jù gbogbo awọn olukọ mi lọ, nitoripe ẹri rẹ ni iṣaro mi.
entries.en: I have more understanding than all my teachers: for thy testimonies are my meditation.

entries.yo: Oye ye mi jù awọn àgba lọ, nitori ti mo pa ẹkọ́ rẹ mọ́.
entries.en: I understand more than the ancients, because I keep thy precepts.

entries.yo: Mo ti fà ẹsẹ mi sẹhin kuro nipa ọ̀na ibi gbogbo, ki emi ki o le pa ọ̀rọ rẹ mọ́.
entries.en: I have refrained my feet from every evil way, that I might keep thy word.

entries.yo: Emi kò yà kuro ni idajọ rẹ: nitoripe iwọ li o kọ́ mi.
entries.en: I have not departed from thy judgments: for thou hast taught me.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ rẹ ti dùn mọ́ mi li ẹnu to! jù oyin lọ li ẹnu mi!
entries.en: How sweet are thy words unto my taste! yea, sweeter than honey to my mouth!

entries.yo: Nipa ẹkọ́ rẹ emi ni iyè ninu: nitorina mo korira ọ̀na eke gbogbo.
entries.en: Through thy precepts I get understanding: therefore I hate every false way.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ rẹ ni fitila fun ẹsẹ̀ mi, ati imọlẹ si ipa ọ̀na mi.
entries.en: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.

entries.yo: Emi ti bura, emi o si mu u ṣẹ, pe, emi o pa idajọ ododo rẹ mọ́.
entries.en: I have sworn, and I will perform it, that I will keep thy righteous judgments.

entries.yo: A pọ́n mi loju gidigidi: Oluwa sọ mi di ãye, gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ rẹ.
entries.en: I am afflicted very much: quicken me, O LORD, according unto thy word.

entries.yo: Emi bẹ̀ ọ, Oluwa, gbà ọrẹ atinuwa ẹnu mi, ki o si kọ́ mi ni idajọ rẹ.
entries.en: Accept, I beseech thee, the freewill offerings of my mouth, O LORD, and teach me thy judgments.

entries.yo: Ọkàn mi wà li ọwọ mi nigbagbogbo: emi kò si gbagbe ofin rẹ.
entries.en: My soul is continually in my hand: yet do I not forget thy law.

entries.yo: Awọn enia buburu ti dẹkun silẹ fun mi: ṣugbọn emi kò ṣina kuro nipa ẹkọ́ rẹ.
entries.en: The wicked have laid a snare for me: yet I erred not from thy precepts.

entries.yo: Ẹri rẹ ni ogún mi lailai: nitori awọn li ayọ̀ inu mi.
entries.en: Thy testimonies have I taken as an heritage for ever: for they are the rejoicing of my heart.

entries.yo: Emi ti fà aiya mi si ati pa ilana rẹ mọ́ nigbagbogbo, ani de opin.
entries.en: I have inclined mine heart to perform thy statutes alway, even unto the end.

entries.yo: Emi korira oniye meji: ṣugbọn ofin rẹ ni mo fẹ.
entries.en: I hate vain thoughts: but thy law do I love.

entries.yo: Iwọ ni ibi ipamọ́ mi ati asà mi: emi nṣe ireti ninu ọ̀rọ rẹ.
entries.en: Thou art my hiding place and my shield: I hope in thy word.

entries.yo: Kuro lọdọ mi, ẹnyin oluṣe-buburu: emi o si pa ofin Ọlọrun mi mọ́.
entries.en: Depart from me, ye evildoers: for I will keep the commandments of my God.

entries.yo: Gbé mi soke gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ rẹ, ki emi ki o le yè: ki o má si jẹ ki oju ireti mi ki o tì mi.
entries.en: Uphold me according unto thy word, that I may live: and let me not be ashamed of my hope.

entries.yo: Gbé mi soke, emi o si wà li ailewu: emi o si juba ìlana rẹ nigbagbogbo.
entries.en: Hold thou me up, and I shall be safe: and I will have respect unto thy statutes continually.

entries.yo: Iwọ ti tẹ̀ gbogbo awọn ti o ṣina kuro ninu ilana rẹ mọlẹ: nitori pe ẹ̀tan ni ironu wọn.
entries.en: Thou hast trodden down all them that err from thy statutes: for their deceit is falsehood.

entries.yo: Iwọ ṣá gbogbo awọn enia buburu aiye tì bi ìdarọ́: nitorina emi fẹ ẹri rẹ.
entries.en: Thou puttest away all the wicked of the earth like dross: therefore I love thy testimonies.

entries.yo: Ara mi warìri nitori ìbẹru rẹ; emi si bẹ̀ru idajọ rẹ.
entries.en: My flesh trembleth for fear of thee; and I am afraid of thy judgments.

entries.yo: Emi ti ṣe idajọ ati ododo: iwọ kì yio jọwọ mi lọwọ fun awọn aninilara mi.
entries.en: I have done judgment and justice: leave me not to mine oppressors.

entries.yo: Ṣe onigbọwọ fun iranṣẹ rẹ fun rere: máṣe jẹ ki awọn agberaga ki o ni mi lara.
entries.en: Be surety for thy servant for good: let not the proud oppress me.

entries.yo: Oju kún mi nitori igbala rẹ, ati nitori ọ̀rọ ododo rẹ.
entries.en: Mine eyes fail for thy salvation, and for the word of thy righteousness.

entries.yo: Ṣe si iranṣẹ rẹ gẹgẹ bi ãnu rẹ, ki o si kọ́ mi ni ilana rẹ.
entries.en: Deal with thy servant according unto thy mercy, and teach me thy statutes.

entries.yo: Iranṣẹ rẹ li emi: fun mi li oye, emi o si mọ̀ ẹri rẹ.
entries.en: I am thy servant; give me understanding, that I may know thy testimonies.

entries.yo: Oluwa, o to akokò fun ọ lati ṣiṣẹ: nitori ti nwọn ti sọ ofin rẹ di ofo.
entries.en: It is time for thee, LORD, to work: for they have made void thy law.

entries.yo: Nitorina emi fẹ aṣẹ rẹ jù wura, ani, jù wura didara lọ.
entries.en: Therefore I love thy commandments above gold; yea, above fine gold.

entries.yo: Nitorina emi kà gbogbo ẹkọ́ rẹ si otitọ patapata: emi si korira gbogbo ọ̀na eke.
entries.en: Therefore I esteem all thy precepts concerning all things to be right; and I hate every false way.

entries.yo: Iyanu li ẹri rẹ: nitorina li ọkàn mi ṣe pa wọn mọ́.
entries.en: Thy testimonies are wonderful: therefore doth my soul keep them.

entries.yo: Ifihan ọ̀rọ rẹ funni ni imọlẹ; o si fi oye fun awọn òpe.
entries.en: The entrance of thy words giveth light; it giveth understanding unto the simple.

entries.yo: Emi yà ẹnu mi, emi mí hẹlẹ: nitori ti ọkàn mi fà si aṣẹ rẹ.
entries.en: I opened my mouth, and panted: for I longed for thy commandments.

entries.yo: Iwọ bojuwò mi; ki o si ṣãnu fun mi, gẹgẹ bi iṣe rẹ si awọn ti o fẹ orukọ rẹ.
entries.en: Look thou upon me, and be merciful unto me, as thou usest to do unto those that love thy name.

entries.yo: Fi iṣisẹ mi mulẹ ninu ọ̀rọ rẹ: ki o má si jẹ ki ẹ̀ṣẹkẹṣẹ ki o jọba lori mi.
entries.en: Order my steps in thy word: and let not any iniquity have dominion over me.

entries.yo: Gbà mi lọwọ inilara enia; bẹ̃li emi o si ma pa ẹkọ́ rẹ mọ́.
entries.en: Deliver me from the oppression of man: so will I keep thy precepts.

entries.yo: Ṣe oju rẹ ki o mọlẹ si iranṣẹ rẹ lara; ki o si kọ mi ni ilana rẹ.
entries.en: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant; and teach me thy statutes.

entries.yo: Odò omi ṣàn silẹ li oju mi nitori nwọn kò pa ofin rẹ mọ́.
entries.en: Rivers of waters run down mine eyes, because they keep not thy law.

entries.yo: Olododo ni iwọ, Oluwa, ati diduro-ṣinṣin ni idajọ rẹ.
entries.en: Righteous art thou, O LORD, and upright are thy judgments.

entries.yo: Iwọ paṣẹ ẹri rẹ li ododo ati otitọ gidigidi.
entries.en: Thy testimonies that thou hast commanded are righteous and very faithful.

entries.yo: Itara mi ti pa mi run nitori ti awọn ọta mi ti gbagbe ọ̀rọ rẹ.
entries.en: My zeal hath consumed me, because mine enemies have forgotten thy words.

entries.yo: Funfun gbò li ọ̀rọ rẹ: nitorina ni iranṣẹ rẹ ṣe fẹ ẹ.
entries.en: Thy word is very pure: therefore thy servant loveth it.

entries.yo: Emi kere ati ẹni ẹ̀gan ni: ṣugbọn emi kò gbagbe ẹkọ́ rẹ.
entries.en: I am small and despised: yet do not I forget thy precepts.

entries.yo: Ododo rẹ ododo lailai ni, otitọ si li ofin rẹ.
entries.en: Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and thy law is the truth.

entries.yo: Iyọnu ati àrokan dì mi mu: ṣugbọn aṣẹ rẹ ni inu-didùn mi.
entries.en: Trouble and anguish have taken hold on me: yet thy commandments are my delights.

entries.yo: Ododo ẹri rẹ aiye-raiye ni: fun mi li oye, emi o si yè.
entries.en: The righteousness of thy testimonies is everlasting: give me understanding, and I shall live.

entries.yo: Tinu-tinu mi gbogbo ni mo fi kigbe; Oluwa, da mi lohùn; emi o pa ilana rẹ mọ́.
entries.en: I cried with my whole heart; hear me, O LORD: I will keep thy statutes.

entries.yo: Emi kigbe si ọ; gbà mi là, emi o si ma pa ẹri rẹ mọ́.
entries.en: I cried unto thee; save me, and I shall keep thy testimonies.

entries.yo: Emi ṣaju kutukutu owurọ, emi ke: emi nṣe ireti ninu ọ̀rọ rẹ.
entries.en: I prevented the dawning of the morning, and cried: I hoped in thy word.

entries.yo: Oju mi ṣaju iṣọ-oru, ki emi ki o le ma ṣe iṣaro ninu ọ̀rọ rẹ.
entries.en: Mine eyes prevent the night watches, that I might meditate in thy word.

entries.yo: Gbohùn mi gẹgẹ bi ãnu rẹ: Oluwa, sọ mi di ãye gẹgẹ bi idajọ rẹ.
entries.en: Hear my voice according unto thy lovingkindness: O LORD, quicken me according to thy judgment.

entries.yo: Awọn ti nlepa ìwa-ika sunmọ itosi: nwọn jina si ofin rẹ.
entries.en: They draw nigh that follow after mischief: they are far from thy law.

entries.yo: Oluwa, iwọ wà ni itosi: otitọ si ni gbogbo aṣẹ rẹ.
entries.en: Thou art near, O LORD; and all thy commandments are truth.

entries.yo: Lati inu ẹri rẹ, emi ti mọ̀ nigba atijọ pe, iwọ ti fi idi wọn mulẹ lailai.
entries.en: Concerning thy testimonies, I have known of old that thou hast founded them for ever.

entries.yo: Wò ipọnju mi, ki o si gbà mi: nitori ti emi kò gbagbe ofin rẹ.
entries.en: Consider mine affliction, and deliver me: for I do not forget thy law.

entries.yo: Gbà ẹjọ mi rò, ki o rà mi pada: sọ mi di ãye nipa ọ̀rọ rẹ.
entries.en: Plead my cause, and deliver me: quicken me according to thy word.

entries.yo: Igbala jina si awọn enia buburu: nitori ti nwọn kò wá ilana rẹ.
entries.en: Salvation is far from the wicked: for they seek not thy statutes.

entries.yo: Ọ̀pọ ni irọnu ãnu rẹ, Oluwa: sọ mi di ãye gẹgẹ bi idajọ rẹ.
entries.en: Great are thy tender mercies, O LORD: quicken me according to thy judgments.

entries.yo: Ọ̀pọ li awọn oninunibini mi ati awọn ọta mi; ṣugbọn emi kò fà sẹhin kuro ninu ẹri rẹ.
entries.en: Many are my persecutors and mine enemies; yet do I not decline from thy testimonies.

entries.yo: Emi wò awọn ẹlẹtan, inu mi si bajẹ; nitori ti nwọn kò pa ọ̀rọ rẹ mọ́.
entries.en: I beheld the transgressors, and was grieved; because they kept not thy word.

entries.yo: Wò bi emi ti fẹ ẹkọ́ rẹ: Oluwa, sọ mi di ãye gẹgẹ bi ãnu rẹ.
entries.en: Consider how I love thy precepts: quicken me, O LORD, according to thy lovingkindness.

entries.yo: Otitọ ni ipilẹṣẹ ọ̀rọ rẹ; ati olukulùku idajọ ododo rẹ duro lailai.
entries.en: Thy word is true from the beginning: and every one of thy righteous judgments endureth for ever.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ-alade ṣe inunibini si mi li ainidi: ṣugbọn ọkàn mi warìri nitori ọ̀rọ rẹ.
entries.en: Princes have persecuted me without a cause: but my heart standeth in awe of thy word.

entries.yo: Emi yọ̀ si ọ̀rọ rẹ, bi ẹniti o ri ikogun pupọ.
entries.en: I rejoice at thy word, as one that findeth great spoil.

entries.yo: Emi korira, mo si ṣe họ̃ si eke ṣiṣe: ṣugbọn ofin rẹ ni mo fẹ.
entries.en: I hate and abhor lying: but thy law do I love.

entries.yo: Nigba meje li õjọ li emi nyìn ọ nitori ododo idajọ rẹ.
entries.en: Seven times a day do I praise thee because of thy righteous judgments.

entries.yo: Alafia pupọ̀ li awọn ti o fẹ ofin rẹ ni: kò si si ohun ikọsẹ fun wọn.
entries.en: Great peace have they which love thy law: and nothing shall offend them.

entries.yo: Oluwa, emi ti nreti igbala rẹ, emi si ṣe aṣẹ rẹ.
entries.en: LORD, I have hoped for thy salvation, and done thy commandments.

entries.yo: Ọkàn mi ti pa ẹri rẹ mọ́; emi si fẹ wọn gidigidi.
entries.en: My soul hath kept thy testimonies; and I love them exceedingly.

entries.yo: Emi ti npa ẹkọ́ ati ẹri rẹ mọ́; nitori ti gbogbo ọ̀na mi mbẹ niwaju rẹ.
entries.en: I have kept thy precepts and thy testimonies: for all my ways are before thee.

entries.yo: Oluwa, jẹ ki ẹkún mi ki o sunmọ iwaju rẹ: fun mi li oye gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ rẹ.
entries.en: Let my cry come near before thee, O LORD: give me understanding according to thy word.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki ẹ̀bẹ mi ki o wá siwaju rẹ: gbà mi gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ rẹ.
entries.en: Let my supplication come before thee: deliver me according to thy word.

entries.yo: Ete mi yio sọ iyìn jade, nigbati iwọ ba ti kọ́ mi ni ilana rẹ.
entries.en: My lips shall utter praise, when thou hast taught me thy statutes.

entries.yo: Ahọn mi yio sọ niti ọ̀rọ rẹ: nitori pe ododo ni gbogbo aṣẹ rẹ.
entries.en: My tongue shall speak of thy word: for all thy commandments are righteousness.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki ọwọ rẹ ki o ràn mi lọwọ; nitori ti mo ti yàn ẹkọ rẹ.
entries.en: Let thine hand help me; for I have chosen thy precepts.

entries.yo: Oluwa, ọkàn mi ti fà si igbala rẹ; ofin rẹ si ni didùn-inu mi.
entries.en: I have longed for thy salvation, O LORD; and thy law is my delight.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki ọkàn mi ki o wà lãye, yio si ma yìn ọ; si jẹ ki idajọ rẹ ki o ma ràn mi lọwọ.
entries.en: Let my soul live, and it shall praise thee; and let thy judgments help me.

entries.yo: Emi ti ṣina kiri bi agutan ti o nù; wá iranṣẹ rẹ nitori ti emi kò gbagbe aṣẹ rẹ.
entries.en: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek thy servant; for I do not forget thy commandments.

entries.yo: NINU ipọnju mi emi kepè Oluwa, o si da mi lohùn.
entries.en: In my distress I cried unto the LORD, and he heard me.

entries.yo: Oluwa, gbà ọkàn mi, lọwọ ète eke, ati lọwọ ahọn ẹ̀tan?
entries.en: Deliver my soul, O LORD, from lying lips, and from a deceitful tongue.

entries.yo: Kini ki a fi fun ọ? tabi kini ki a ṣe si ọ, ahọn ẹ̀tan.
entries.en: What shall be given unto thee? or what shall be done unto thee, thou false tongue?

entries.yo: Ọfà mimu alagbara, ti on ti ẹyin-iná igi juniperi!
entries.en: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.

entries.yo: Egbe ni fun mi, ti mo ṣe atipo ni Meṣeki, ti mo joko ninu agọ Kedari!
entries.en: Woe is me, that I sojourn in Mesech, that I dwell in the tents of Kedar!

entries.yo: O ti pẹ ti ọkàn mi ti ba ẹniti o korira alafia gbe.
entries.en: My soul hath long dwelt with him that hateth peace.

entries.yo: Alafia ni mo fẹ: ṣugbọn nigbati mo ba sọ̀rọ, ija ni ti wọn.
entries.en: I am for peace: but when I speak, they are for war.

entries.yo: EMI o gbé oju mi si ori oke wọnnì, nibo ni iranlọwọ mi yio ti nwa?
entries.en: I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help.

entries.yo: Iranlọwọ mi yio ti ọwọ Oluwa wá, ti o da ọrun on aiye.
entries.en: My help cometh from the LORD, which made heaven and earth.

entries.yo: On kì yio jẹ́ ki ẹsẹ rẹ ki o yẹ̀; ẹniti npa ọ mọ́ kì yio tõgbe.
entries.en: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: he that keepeth thee will not slumber.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, ẹniti npa Israeli mọ́, kì itõgbe, bẹ̃ni kì isùn.
entries.en: Behold, he that keepeth Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep.

entries.yo: Oluwa li olupamọ́ rẹ: Oluwa li ojiji rẹ li ọwọ ọ̀tún rẹ.
entries.en: The LORD is thy keeper: the LORD is thy shade upon thy right hand.

entries.yo: Orùn kì yio pa ọ nigba ọsan, tabi oṣupa nigba oru.
entries.en: The sun shall not smite thee by day, nor the moon by night.

entries.yo: Oluwa yio pa ọ mọ́ kuro ninu ibi gbogbo: yio pa ọkàn rẹ mọ́.
entries.en: The LORD shall preserve thee from all evil: he shall preserve thy soul.

entries.yo: Oluwa yio pa alọ ati àbọ rẹ mọ́ lati igba yi lọ, ati titi lailai.
entries.en: The LORD shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore.

entries.yo: INU mi dùn nigbati nwọn wi fun mi pe, Ẹ jẹ ki a lọ si ile Oluwa.
entries.en: I was glad when they said unto me, Let us go into the house of the LORD.

entries.yo: Ẹsẹ wa yio duro ni ẹnu-bode rẹ, iwọ Jerusalemu.
entries.en: Our feet shall stand within thy gates, O Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Jerusalemu, iwọ ti a kọ́ bi ilu ti o fi ara mọra pọ̀ ṣọkan.
entries.en: Jerusalem is builded as a city that is compact together:

entries.yo: Nibiti awọn ẹ̀ya ima gòke lọ, awọn ẹ̀ya Oluwa, ẹri fun Israeli, lati ma dupẹ fun orukọ Oluwa.
entries.en: Whither the tribes go up, the tribes of the LORD, unto the testimony of Israel, to give thanks unto the name of the LORD.

entries.yo: Nitori ibẹ li a gbé itẹ́ idajọ kalẹ, awọn itẹ́ ile Dafidi.
entries.en: For there are set thrones of judgment, the thrones of the house of David.

entries.yo: Gbadura fun alafia Jerusalemu: awọn ti o fẹ ọ yio ṣe rere.
entries.en: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: they shall prosper that love thee.

entries.yo: Ki alafia ki o wà ninu odi rẹ, ati ire ninu ãfin rẹ.
entries.en: Peace be within thy walls, and prosperity within thy palaces.

entries.yo: Nitori awọn arakunrin ati awọn ẹgbẹ mi, emi o wi nisisiyi pe, Ki alafia ki o wà ninu rẹ!
entries.en: For my brethren and companions' sakes, I will now say, Peace be within thee.

entries.yo: Nitori ile Oluwa Ọlọrun wa, emi o ma wá ire rẹ.
entries.en: Because of the house of the LORD our God I will seek thy good.

entries.yo: IWỌ ni mo gbé oju mi soke si, iwọ ti ngbe inu ọrun.
entries.en: Unto thee lift I up mine eyes, O thou that dwellest in the heavens.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, bi oju awọn iranṣẹkunrin ti ima wò ọwọ awọn baba wọn, ati bi oju iranṣẹ-birin ti ima wò ọwọ iya rẹ̀; bẹ̃li oju wa nwò Oluwa Ọlọrun wa, titi yio fi ṣãnu fun wa.
entries.en: Behold, as the eyes of servants look unto the hand of their masters, and as the eyes of a maiden unto the hand of her mistress; so our eyes wait upon the LORD our God, until that he have mercy upon us.

entries.yo: Oluwa, ṣãnu fun wa, ṣãnu fun wa: nitori ti a kún fun ẹ̀gan pupọ̀-pupọ̀.
entries.en: Have mercy upon us, O LORD, have mercy upon us: for we are exceedingly filled with contempt.

entries.yo: Ọkàn wa kún pupọ̀-pupọ̀ fun ẹ̀gan awọn onirera, ati fun ẹ̀gan awọn agberaga.
entries.en: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scorning of those that are at ease, and with the contempt of the proud.

entries.yo: IBA máṣe pe Oluwa ti o ti wà fun wa, ki Israeli ki o ma wi nisisiyi;
entries.en: If it had not been the LORD who was on our side, now may Israel say;

entries.yo: Iba máṣe pe Oluwa ti o ti wà fun wa, nigbati awọn enia duro si wa:
entries.en: If it had not been the LORD who was on our side, when men rose up against us:

entries.yo: Nigbana ni nwọn iba gbé wa mì lãye, nigbati ibinu nwọn ru si wa:
entries.en: Then they had swallowed us up quick, when their wrath was kindled against us:

entries.yo: Nigbana li omi wọnni iba bò wa mọlẹ, iṣan omi iba ti bori ọkàn wa:
entries.en: Then the waters had overwhelmed us, the stream had gone over our soul:

entries.yo: Nigbana li agberaga omi iba bori ọkàn wa.
entries.en: Then the proud waters had gone over our soul.

entries.yo: Olubukún li Oluwa, ti kò fi wa fun wọn bi ohun ọdẹ fun ehin wọn.
entries.en: Blessed be the LORD, who hath not given us as a prey to their teeth.

entries.yo: Ọkàn wa yọ bi ẹiyẹ jade kuro ninu okùn apẹiyẹ: okùn já, awa si yọ.
entries.en: Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: the snare is broken, and we are escaped.

entries.yo: Iranlọwọ wa mbẹ li orukọ Oluwa, ti o da ọrun on aiye.
entries.en: Our help is in the name of the LORD, who made heaven and earth.

entries.yo: AWỌN ti o gbẹkẹle Oluwa yio dabi òke Sioni, ti a kò le ṣi ni idi, bikoṣepe o duro lailai.
entries.en: They that trust in the LORD shall be as mount Zion, which cannot be removed, but abideth for ever.

entries.yo: Bi òke nla ti yi Jerusalemu ka, bẹ̃li Oluwa yi awọn enia rẹ̀ ka lati isisiyi lọ ati titi lailai.
entries.en: As the mountains are round about Jerusalem, so the LORD is round about his people from henceforth even for ever.

entries.yo: Nitori ti ọpá awọn enia buburu kì yio bà le ipin awọn olododo: ki awọn olododo ki o má ba fi ọwọ wọn le ẹ̀ṣẹ.
entries.en: For the rod of the wicked shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous; lest the righteous put forth their hands unto iniquity.

entries.yo: Oluwa ṣe rere fun awọn ẹni-rere, ati fun awọn ti aiya wọn duro ṣinṣin.
entries.en: Do good, O LORD, unto those that be good, and to them that are upright in their hearts.

entries.yo: Bi o ṣe ti iru awọn ti nwọn yà si ipa ọ̀na wiwọ wọn: Oluwa yio jẹ ki wọn lọ pẹlu awọn oniṣẹ ẹ̀ṣẹ: ṣugbọn alafia yio wà lori Israeli.
entries.en: As for such as turn aside unto their crooked ways, the LORD shall lead them forth with the workers of iniquity: but peace shall be upon Israel.

entries.yo: NIGBATI Oluwa mu ikólọ Sioni pada, awa dabi ẹniti nla alá.
entries.en: When the LORD turned again the captivity of Zion, we were like them that dream.

entries.yo: Nigbana li ẹnu wa kún fun ẹrin, ati ahọn wa kọ orin: nigbana ni nwọn wi ninu awọn keferi pe, Oluwa ṣe ohun nla fun wọn.
entries.en: Then was our mouth filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing: then said they among the heathen, The LORD hath done great things for them.

entries.yo: Oluwa ṣe ohun nla fun wa: nitorina awa nyọ̀.
entries.en: The LORD hath done great things for us; whereof we are glad.

entries.yo: Oluwa mu ikólọ wa pada, bi iṣan-omi ni gusu.
entries.en: Turn again our captivity, O LORD, as the streams in the south.

entries.yo: Awọn ti nfi omije fún irugbin yio fi ayọ ka.
entries.en: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.

entries.yo: Ẹniti nfi ẹkun rìn lọ, ti o si gbé irugbin lọwọ, lõtọ, yio fi ayọ̀ pada wá, yio si rù iti rẹ̀.
entries.en: He that goeth forth and weepeth, bearing precious seed, shall doubtless come again with rejoicing, bringing his sheaves with him.

entries.yo: BIKOṢEPE Oluwa ba kọ́ ile na, awọn ti nkọ́ ọ nṣiṣẹ lasan: bikoṣepe Oluwa ba pa ilu mọ́, oluṣọ ji lasan.
entries.en: Except the LORD build the house, they labour in vain that build it: except the LORD keep the city, the watchman waketh but in vain.

entries.yo: Asan ni fun ẹnyin ti ẹ dide ni kutukutu lati pẹ iṣiwọ, lati jẹ onjẹ lãlã: bẹ̃li o nfi ire fun olufẹ rẹ̀ loju orun.
entries.en: It is vain for you to rise up early, to sit up late, to eat the bread of sorrows: for so he giveth his beloved sleep.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, awọn ọmọ ni ini Oluwa: ọmọ inu si li ère rẹ̀.
entries.en: Lo, children are an heritage of the LORD: and the fruit of the womb is his reward.

entries.yo: Bi ọfà ti ri li ọwọ alagbara, bẹ̃li awọn ọmọ igbà èwe rẹ.
entries.en: As arrows are in the hand of a mighty man; so are children of the youth.

entries.yo: Ibukún ni fun ọkunrin na ti apo rẹ̀ kún fun wọn: oju kì yio tì wọn, ṣugbọn nwọn o ṣẹgun awọn ọta li ẹnu ọ̀na.
entries.en: Happy is the man that hath his quiver full of them: they shall not be ashamed, but they shall speak with the enemies in the gate.

entries.yo: IBUKÚN ni fun gbogbo ẹniti o bẹ̀ru Oluwa; ti o si nrìn li ọ̀na rẹ̀.
entries.en: Blessed is every one that feareth the LORD; that walketh in his ways.

entries.yo: Nitori ti iwọ o jẹ iṣẹ́ ọwọ rẹ: ibukún ni fun ọ: yio si dara fun ọ.
entries.en: For thou shalt eat the labour of thine hands: happy shalt thou be, and it shall be well with thee.

entries.yo: Obinrin rẹ yio dabi àjara rere eleso pupọ li arin ile rẹ: awọn ọmọ rẹ yio dabi igi olifi yi tabili rẹ ka.
entries.en: Thy wife shall be as a fruitful vine by the sides of thine house: thy children like olive plants round about thy table.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, pe bẹ̃li a o busi i fun ọkunrin na, ti o bẹ̀ru Oluwa.
entries.en: Behold, that thus shall the man be blessed that feareth the LORD.

entries.yo: Ki Oluwa ki o busi i fun ọ lati Sioni wá, ki iwọ ki o si ma ri ire Jerusalemu li ọjọ aiye rẹ gbogbo.
entries.en: The LORD shall bless thee out of Zion: and thou shalt see the good of Jerusalem all the days of thy life.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni ki iwọ ki o si ma ri ati ọmọ-de-ọmọ rẹ: ati alafia lara Israeli.
entries.en: Yea, thou shalt see thy children's children, and peace upon Israel.

entries.yo: IGBA pupọ̀ ni nwọn ti npọ́n mi loju lati igba-ewe mi wá, ni ki Israeli ki o wi nisisiyi.
entries.en: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth, may Israel now say:

entries.yo: Igba pupọ̀ ni nwọn ti npọ́n mi loju lati igba-ewe mi wá: sibẹ nwọn kò ti ibori mi.
entries.en: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth: yet they have not prevailed against me.

entries.yo: Awọn awalẹ̀ walẹ si ẹhin mi: nwọn si la aporo wọn gigun.
entries.en: The plowers plowed upon my back: they made long their furrows.

entries.yo: Olododo li Oluwa: o ti ke okùn awọn enia buburu kuro.
entries.en: The LORD is righteous: he hath cut asunder the cords of the wicked.

entries.yo: Ki gbogbo awọn ti o korira Sioni ki o dãmu, ki nwọn ki o si yi ẹhin pada.
entries.en: Let them all be confounded and turned back that hate Zion.

entries.yo: Ki nwọn ki o dabi koriko ori-ile ti o gbẹ danu, ki o to dagba soke:
entries.en: Let them be as the grass upon the housetops, which withereth afore it groweth up:

entries.yo: Eyi ti oloko pipa kò kún ọwọ rẹ̀; bẹ̃li ẹniti ndi ití, kò kún apa rẹ̀.
entries.en: Wherewith the mower filleth not his hand; nor he that bindeth sheaves his bosom.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li awọn ti nkọja lọ kò wipe, Ibukún Oluwa ki o pẹlu nyin: awa sure fun nyin li orukọ Oluwa.
entries.en: Neither do they which go by say, The blessing of the LORD be upon you: we bless you in the name of the LORD.

entries.yo: LATI inu ibu wá li emi kepe ọ, Oluwa.
entries.en: Out of the depths have I cried unto thee, O LORD.

entries.yo: Oluwa, gbohùn mi, jẹ ki eti rẹ ki o tẹ́ silẹ si ohùn ẹ̀bẹ mi.
entries.en: Lord, hear my voice: let thine ears be attentive to the voice of my supplications.

entries.yo: Oluwa, ibaṣepe iwọ a mã sami ẹ̀ṣẹ, Oluwa, tani iba duro?
entries.en: If thou, LORD, shouldest mark iniquities, O Lord, who shall stand?

entries.yo: Nitori idariji wà lọdọ rẹ, ki a le ma bẹ̀ru rẹ.
entries.en: But there is forgiveness with thee, that thou mayest be feared.

entries.yo: Emi duro dè Oluwa, ọkàn mi duro, ati ninu ọ̀rọ rẹ̀ li emi nṣe ireti.
entries.en: I wait for the LORD, my soul doth wait, and in his word do I hope.

entries.yo: Ọkàn mi duro dè Oluwa, jù awọn ti nṣọ́na owurọ lọ, ani jù awọn ti nṣọ́na owurọ lọ.
entries.en: My soul waiteth for the Lord more than they that watch for the morning: I say, more than they that watch for the morning.

entries.yo: Israeli iwọ ni ireti niti Oluwa: nitori pe lọdọ Oluwa li ãnu wà, ati lọdọ rẹ̀ li ọ̀pọlọpọ idande wà.
entries.en: Let Israel hope in the LORD: for with the LORD there is mercy, and with him is plenteous redemption.

entries.yo: On o si da Israeli nidè kuro ninu ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ̀ gbogbo,
entries.en: And he shall redeem Israel from all his iniquities.

entries.yo: OLUWA, aiya mi kò gbega, bẹ̃li oju mi kò gbé soke: bẹ̃li emi kò fi ọwọ mi le ọ̀ran nla, tabi le ohun ti o ga jù mi lọ.
entries.en: LORD, my heart is not haughty, nor mine eyes lofty: neither do I exercise myself in great matters, or in things too high for me.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ emi mu ọkàn mi simi, mo si mu u dakẹjẹ, bi ọmọ ti a ti ọwọ iya rẹ̀ gbà li ẹnu ọmu: ọkàn mi ri bi ọmọ ti a já li ẹnu ọmu.
entries.en: Surely I have behaved and quieted myself, as a child that is weaned of his mother: my soul is even as a weaned child.

entries.yo: Israeli, iwọ ni ireti lọdọ Oluwa lati isisiyi lọ ati lailai.
entries.en: Let Israel hope in the LORD from henceforth and for ever.

entries.yo: OLUWA, ranti Dafidi ninu gbogbo ipọnju rẹ̀:
entries.en: LORD, remember David, and all his afflictions:

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ti bura fun Oluwa, ti o si ṣe ileri ifẹ fun Alagbara Jakobu pe.
entries.en: How he sware unto the LORD, and vowed unto the mighty God of Jacob;

entries.yo: Nitõtọ, emi kì yio wọ̀ inu agọ ile mi lọ, bẹ̃li emi kì yio gùn ori akete mi;
entries.en: Surely I will not come into the tabernacle of my house, nor go up into my bed;

entries.yo: Emi kì yio fi orun fun oju mi, tabi õgbe fun ipenpeju mi,
entries.en: I will not give sleep to mine eyes, or slumber to mine eyelids,

entries.yo: Titi emi o fi ri ibi fun Oluwa, ibujoko fun Alagbara Jakobu.
entries.en: Until I find out a place for the LORD, an habitation for the mighty God of Jacob.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, awa gburo rẹ̀ ni Efrata: awa ri i ninu oko ẹgàn na.
entries.en: Lo, we heard of it at Ephratah: we found it in the fields of the wood.

entries.yo: Awa o lọ sinu agọ rẹ̀: awa o ma sìn nibi apoti-itisẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: We will go into his tabernacles: we will worship at his footstool.

entries.yo: Oluwa, dide si ibi isimi rẹ; iwọ, ati apoti agbara rẹ.
entries.en: Arise, O LORD, into thy rest; thou, and the ark of thy strength.

entries.yo: Ki a fi ododo wọ̀ awọn alufa rẹ: ki awọn enia mimọ rẹ ki o ma hó fun ayọ̀.
entries.en: Let thy priests be clothed with righteousness; and let thy saints shout for joy.

entries.yo: Nitori ti Dafidi iranṣẹ rẹ, máṣe yi oju ẹni-ororo rẹ pada.
entries.en: For thy servant David's sake turn not away the face of thine anointed.

entries.yo: Oluwa ti bura nitõtọ fun Dafidi; on kì yio yipada kuro ninu rẹ̀, Ninu iru-ọmọ inu rẹ li emi o gbé kalẹ si ori itẹ́ rẹ.
entries.en: The LORD hath sworn in truth unto David; he will not turn from it; Of the fruit of thy body will I set upon thy throne.

entries.yo: Bi awọn ọmọ rẹ yio ba pa majẹmu mi mọ́ ati ẹri mi ti emi o kọ́ wọn, awọn ọmọ wọn pẹlu yio joko lori itẹ́ rẹ lailai.
entries.en: If thy children will keep my covenant and my testimony that I shall teach them, their children shall also sit upon thy throne for evermore.

entries.yo: Nitori ti Oluwa ti yàn Sioni; o ti fẹ ẹ fun ibujoko rẹ̀.
entries.en: For the LORD hath chosen Zion; he hath desired it for his habitation.

entries.yo: Eyi ni ibi isimi mi lailai: nihin li emi o ma gbe; nitori ti mo fẹ ẹ.
entries.en: This is my rest for ever: here will I dwell; for I have desired it.

entries.yo: Emi o bukún onjẹ rẹ̀ pupọ̀-pupọ̀: emi o fi onjẹ tẹ́ awọn talaka rẹ̀ lọrùn.
entries.en: I will abundantly bless her provision: I will satisfy her poor with bread.

entries.yo: Emi o si fi igbala wọ̀ awọn alufa rẹ̀: awọn enia mimọ́ rẹ̀ yio ma hó fun ayọ̀.
entries.en: I will also clothe her priests with salvation: and her saints shall shout aloud for joy.

entries.yo: Nibẹ li emi o gbe mu iwo Dafidi yọ, emi ti ṣe ilana fitila kan fun ẹni-ororo mi.
entries.en: There will I make the horn of David to bud: I have ordained a lamp for mine anointed.

entries.yo: Awọn ọta rẹ̀ li emi o fi itiju wọ̀: ṣugbọn lara on tikararẹ̀ li ade rẹ̀ yio ma gbilẹ.
entries.en: His enemies will I clothe with shame: but upon himself shall his crown flourish.

entries.yo: KIYESI i, o ti dara o si ti dùn to fun awọn ará lati ma jumọ gbe ni irẹpọ̀.
entries.en: Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!

entries.yo: O dabi ororo ikunra iyebiye li ori, ti o ṣàn de irungbọn, ani irungbọn Aaroni: ti o si ṣàn si eti aṣọ rẹ̀;
entries.en: It is like the precious ointment upon the head, that ran down upon the beard, even Aaron's beard: that went down to the skirts of his garments;

entries.yo: Bi ìri Hermoni ti o ṣàn sori òke Sioni: nitori nibẹ ni Oluwa gbe paṣẹ ibukún, ani ìye lailai.
entries.en: As the dew of Hermon, and as the dew that descended upon the mountains of Zion: for there the LORD commanded the blessing, even life for evermore.

entries.yo: Ẹ kiyesi i, ẹ fi ibukún fun Oluwa, gbogbo ẹnyin iranṣẹ Oluwa, ti nduro ni ile Oluwa li oru.
entries.en: Behold, bless ye the LORD, all ye servants of the LORD, which by night stand in the house of the LORD.

entries.yo: Ẹ gbé ọwọ nyin soke si ibi-mimọ́, ki ẹ si fi ibukún fun Oluwa.
entries.en: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary, and bless the LORD.

entries.yo: Oluwa ti o da ọrun on aiye, ki o busi i fun ọ lati Sioni wá.
entries.en: The LORD that made heaven and earth bless thee out of Zion.

entries.yo: Ẹ yìn Oluwa, Ẹ yìn orukọ Oluwa; ẹ yìn i, ẹnyin iranṣẹ Oluwa.
entries.en: Praise ye the LORD. Praise ye the name of the LORD; praise him, O ye servants of the LORD.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin ti nduro ni ile Oluwa, ninu agbalá ile Ọlọrun wa.
entries.en: Ye that stand in the house of the LORD, in the courts of the house of our God,

entries.yo: Ẹ yìn Oluwa: nitori ti Oluwa ṣeun; ẹ kọrin iyìn si orukọ rẹ̀; ni orin ti o dùn.
entries.en: Praise the LORD; for the LORD is good: sing praises unto his name; for it is pleasant.

entries.yo: Nitori ti Oluwa ti yàn Jakobu fun ara rẹ̀; ani Israeli fun iṣura ãyo rẹ̀.
entries.en: For the LORD hath chosen Jacob unto himself, and Israel for his peculiar treasure.

entries.yo: Nitori ti emi mọ̀ pe Oluwa tobi, ati pe Oluwa jù gbogbo oriṣa lọ.
entries.en: For I know that the LORD is great, and that our Lord is above all gods.

entries.yo: Ohunkohun ti o wù Oluwa, on ni iṣe li ọrun, ati li aiye, li okun, ati ni ọgbun gbogbo.
entries.en: Whatsoever the LORD pleased, that did he in heaven, and in earth, in the seas, and all deep places.

entries.yo: O mu ikũku gòke lati opin ilẹ wá: o da manamana fun òjo: o nmu afẹfẹ ti inu ile iṣura rẹ̀ wá.
entries.en: He causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings for the rain; he bringeth the wind out of his treasuries.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o kọlù awọn akọbi Egipti, ati ti enia ati ti ẹranko.
entries.en: Who smote the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and beast.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o rán àmi ati iṣẹ iyanu si ãrin rẹ, iwọ Egipti, si ara Farao, ati si ara awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀ gbogbo.
entries.en: Who sent tokens and wonders into the midst of thee, O Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his servants.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o kọlu awọn orilẹ-ède pupọ̀, ti o si pa awọn alagbara ọba.
entries.en: Who smote great nations, and slew mighty kings;

entries.yo: Sihoni, ọba awọn ara Amori, ati Ogu, ọba Baṣani, ati gbogbo ijọba Kenaani:
entries.en: Sihon king of the Amorites, and Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan:

entries.yo: O si fi ilẹ wọn funni ni ini, ini fun Israeli, enia rẹ̀.
entries.en: And gave their land for an heritage, an heritage unto Israel his people.

entries.yo: Oluwa, orukọ rẹ duro lailai; iranti rẹ Oluwa, lati iran-diran.
entries.en: Thy name, O LORD, endureth for ever; and thy memorial, O LORD, throughout all generations.

entries.yo: Nitori ti Oluwa yio ṣe idajọ awọn enia rẹ̀, yio si ṣe iyọ́nu si awọn ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ̀,
entries.en: For the LORD will judge his people, and he will repent himself concerning his servants.

entries.yo: Fadaka on wura li ere awọn keferi, iṣẹ ọwọ enia.
entries.en: The idols of the heathen are silver and gold, the work of men's hands.

entries.yo: Nwọn li ẹnu, ṣugbọn nwọn kò sọ̀rọ; nwọn li oju, ṣugbọn nwọn kò fi riran.
entries.en: They have mouths, but they speak not; eyes have they, but they see not;

entries.yo: Nwọn li eti, ṣugbọn nwọn kò fi gbọran; bẹ̃ni kò si ẽmi kan li ẹnu wọn.
entries.en: They have ears, but they hear not; neither is there any breath in their mouths.

entries.yo: Awọn ti o ṣe wọn dabi wọn: bẹ̃ si li olukuluku ẹniti o gbẹkẹle wọn.
entries.en: They that make them are like unto them: so is every one that trusteth in them.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin arale Israeli, ẹ fi ibukún fun Oluwa, ẹnyin arale Aaroni, ẹ fi ibukún fun Oluwa.
entries.en: Bless the LORD, O house of Israel: bless the LORD, O house of Aaron:

entries.yo: Ẹnyin arale Lefi, ẹ fi ibukún fun Oluwa; ẹnyin ti o bẹ̀ru Oluwa, ẹ fi ibukún fun Oluwa.
entries.en: Bless the LORD, O house of Levi: ye that fear the LORD, bless the LORD.

entries.yo: Olubukún li Oluwa, lati Sioni wá, ti ngbe Jerusalemu. Ẹ fi iyìn fun Oluwa.
entries.en: Blessed be the LORD out of Zion, which dwelleth at Jerusalem. Praise ye the LORD.

entries.yo: Ẹ fi ọpẹ fun Oluwa: nitoriti o ṣeun; nitori ti ãnu rẹ̀ duro lailai.
entries.en: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.

entries.yo: Ẹ fi ọpẹ fun Ọlọrun awọn ọlọrun: nitori ti ãnu rẹ̀ duro lailai.
entries.en: O give thanks unto the God of gods: for his mercy endureth for ever.

entries.yo: Ẹ fi ọpẹ fun Oluwa awọn oluwa: nitori ti ãnu rẹ̀ duro lailai.
entries.en: O give thanks to the Lord of lords: for his mercy endureth for ever.

entries.yo: Fun on nikan ti nṣe iṣẹ iyanu nla: nitori ti ãnu rẹ̀ duro lailai.
entries.en: To him who alone doeth great wonders: for his mercy endureth for ever.

entries.yo: Fun ẹniti o fi ọgbọ́n da ọrun: nitori ti ãnu rẹ̀ duro lailai.
entries.en: To him that by wisdom made the heavens: for his mercy endureth for ever.

entries.yo: Fun ẹniti o tẹ́ ilẹ lori omi: nitori ti ãnu rẹ̀ duro lailai.
entries.en: To him that stretched out the earth above the waters: for his mercy endureth for ever.

entries.yo: Fun ẹniti o dá awọn imọlẹ nla: nitori ti ãnu rẹ̀ duro lailai.
entries.en: To him that made great lights: for his mercy endureth for ever:

entries.yo: Õrùn lati jọba ọsan: nitori ti ãnu rẹ̀ duro lailai:
entries.en: The sun to rule by day: for his mercy endureth for ever:

entries.yo: Oṣupa ati irawọ lati jọba oru: nitori ti ãnu rẹ̀ duro lailai.
entries.en: The moon and stars to rule by night: for his mercy endureth for ever.

entries.yo: Fun ẹniti o kọlù Egipti lara awọn akọbi wọn: nitori ti ãnu rẹ̀ duro lailai.
entries.en: To him that smote Egypt in their firstborn: for his mercy endureth for ever:

entries.yo: O si mu Israeli jade kuro lãrin wọn: nitori ti ãnu rẹ̀ duro lailai:
entries.en: And brought out Israel from among them: for his mercy endureth for ever:

entries.yo: Pẹlu ọwọ agbara, ati apa ninà: nitori ti ãnu rẹ̀ duro lailai.
entries.en: With a strong hand, and with a stretched out arm: for his mercy endureth for ever.

entries.yo: Fun ẹniti o pin Okun pupa ni ìya: nitori ti ãnu rẹ̀ duro lailai:
entries.en: To him which divided the Red sea into parts: for his mercy endureth for ever:

entries.yo: O si mu Israeli kọja lọ larin rẹ̀: nitori ti ãnu rẹ̀ duro lailai.
entries.en: And made Israel to pass through the midst of it: for his mercy endureth for ever:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn o bi Farao ati ogun rẹ̀ ṣubu ninu Okun pupa: nitori ti ãnu rẹ̀ duro lailai.
entries.en: But overthrew Pharaoh and his host in the Red sea: for his mercy endureth for ever.

entries.yo: Fun ẹniti o sin awọn enia rẹ̀ la aginju ja: nitori ti ãnu rẹ̀ duro lailai.
entries.en: To him which led his people through the wilderness: for his mercy endureth for ever.

entries.yo: Fun ẹniti o kọlù awọn ọba nla: nitori ti ãnu rẹ̀ duro lailai.
entries.en: To him which smote great kings: for his mercy endureth for ever:

entries.yo: O si pa awọn ọba olokiki: nitori ti ãnu rẹ̀ duro lailai.
entries.en: And slew famous kings: for his mercy endureth for ever:

entries.yo: Sihoni, ọba awọn ara Amori: nitori ti ãnu rẹ̀ duro lailai.
entries.en: Sihon king of the Amorites: for his mercy endureth for ever:

entries.yo: Ati Ogu, ọba Baṣani: nitori ti ãnu rẹ̀ duro lailai.
entries.en: And Og the king of Bashan: for his mercy endureth for ever:

entries.yo: O si fi ilẹ wọn funni ni ini, nitori ti ãnu rẹ̀ duro lailai.
entries.en: And gave their land for an heritage: for his mercy endureth for ever:

entries.yo: Ini fun Israeli, iranṣẹ rẹ̀; nitori ti ãnu rẹ̀ duro lailai.
entries.en: Even an heritage unto Israel his servant: for his mercy endureth for ever.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ranti wa ni ìwa irẹlẹ wa; nitori ti ãnu rẹ̀ duro lailai.
entries.en: Who remembered us in our low estate: for his mercy endureth for ever:

entries.yo: O si dá wa ni ìde lọwọ awọn ọta wa; nitori ti ãnu rẹ̀ duro lailai.
entries.en: And hath redeemed us from our enemies: for his mercy endureth for ever.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o nfi onjẹ fun ẹda gbogbo: nitori ti ãnu rẹ̀ duro lailai;
entries.en: Who giveth food to all flesh: for his mercy endureth for ever.

entries.yo: Ẹ fi ọpẹ fun Ọlọrun ọrun; nitori ti ãnu rẹ̀ duro lailai.
entries.en: O give thanks unto the God of heaven: for his mercy endureth for ever.

entries.yo: LI ẹba odò Babeli, nibẹ li awa gbe joko, awa si sọkun nigbati awa ranti Sioni.
entries.en: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down, yea, we wept, when we remembered Zion.

entries.yo: Awa fi duru wa kọ́ si ori igi wíllo ti o wà lãrin rẹ̀.
entries.en: We hanged our harps upon the willows in the midst thereof.

entries.yo: Nitoripe nibẹ li awọn ti o kó wa ni igbekun bère orin lọwọ wa; ati awọn ti o ni wa lara bère idaraya wipe; Ẹ kọ orin Sioni kan fun wa.
entries.en: For there they that carried us away captive required of us a song; and they that wasted us required of us mirth, saying, Sing us one of the songs of Zion.

entries.yo: Awa o ti ṣe kọ orin Oluwa ni ilẹ àjeji?
entries.en: How shall we sing the LORD's song in a strange land?

entries.yo: Jerusalemu, bi emi ba gbagbe rẹ, jẹ ki ọwọ ọtún mi ki o gbagbe ìlò rẹ̀.
entries.en: If I forget thee, O Jerusalem, let my right hand forget her cunning.

entries.yo: Bi emi kò ba ranti rẹ, jẹ ki ahọn mi ki o lẹ̀ mọ èrìgì mi; bi emi kò ba fi Jerusalemu ṣaju olori ayọ̀ mi gbogbo.
entries.en: If I do not remember thee, let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth; if I prefer not Jerusalem above my chief joy.

entries.yo: Oluwa, ranti ọjọ Jerusalemu lara awọn ọmọ Edomu, awọn ẹniti nwipe, Wó o palẹ, wó o palẹ, de ipilẹ rẹ̀!
entries.en: Remember, O LORD, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof.

entries.yo: Iwọ, ọmọbinrin Babeli, ẹniti a o parun; ibukún ni fun ẹniti o san a fun ọ bi iwọ ti hù si wa.
entries.en: O daughter of Babylon, who art to be destroyed; happy shall he be, that rewardeth thee as thou hast served us.

entries.yo: Ibukún li ẹniti o mu, ti o si fi ọmọ wẹwẹ rẹ ṣán okuta.
entries.en: Happy shall he be, that taketh and dasheth thy little ones against the stones.

entries.yo: EMI o ma yìn ọ tinu-tinu mi gbogbo; niwaju awọn oriṣa li emi o ma kọrin iyìn si ọ.
entries.en: I will praise thee with my whole heart: before the gods will I sing praise unto thee.

entries.yo: Emi o ma gbadura siha tempili mimọ́ rẹ, emi o si ma yìn orukọ rẹ nitori iṣeun-ifẹ rẹ ati otitọ rẹ; nitori iwọ gbé ọ̀rọ rẹ ga jù gbogbo orukọ rẹ lọ.
entries.en: I will worship toward thy holy temple, and praise thy name for thy lovingkindness and for thy truth: for thou hast magnified thy word above all thy name.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ ti mo kepè, iwọ da mi lohùn, iwọ si fi ipa mu mi lara le li ọkàn mi.
entries.en: In the day when I cried thou answeredst me, and strengthenedst me with strength in my soul.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn ọba aiye yio yìn ọ, Oluwa, nigbati nwọn ba gbọ́ ọ̀rọ ẹnu rẹ.
entries.en: All the kings of the earth shall praise thee, O LORD, when they hear the words of thy mouth.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ, nwọn o ma kọrin ni ipa-ọ̀na Oluwa: nitori pe nla li ogo Oluwa.
entries.en: Yea, they shall sing in the ways of the LORD: for great is the glory of the LORD.

entries.yo: Bi Oluwa tilẹ ga, sibẹ o juba awọn onirẹlẹ; ṣugbọn agberaga li o mọ̀ li òkere rére.
entries.en: Though the LORD be high, yet hath he respect unto the lowly: but the proud he knoweth afar off.

entries.yo: Bi emi tilẹ nrìn ninu ipọnju, iwọ ni yio sọ mi di ãye: iwọ o nà ọwọ rẹ si ibinu awọn ọta mi, ọwọ ọtún rẹ yio si gbà mi.
entries.en: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, thou wilt revive me: thou shalt stretch forth thine hand against the wrath of mine enemies, and thy right hand shall save me.

entries.yo: Oluwa yio ṣe ohun ti iṣe ti emi li aṣepe: Oluwa, ãnu rẹ duro lailai: máṣe kọ̀ iṣẹ ọwọ ara rẹ silẹ.
entries.en: The LORD will perfect that which concerneth me: thy mercy, O LORD, endureth for ever: forsake not the works of thine own hands.

entries.yo: OLUWA, iwọ ti wadi mi, iwọ si ti mọ̀ mi.
entries.en: O LORD, thou hast searched me, and known me.

entries.yo: Iwọ mọ̀ ijoko mi ati idide mi, iwọ mọ̀ iro mi li ọ̀na jijin rére.
entries.en: Thou knowest my downsitting and mine uprising, thou understandest my thought afar off.

entries.yo: Iwọ yi ipa ọ̀na mi ká ati ibulẹ mi, gbogbo ọ̀na mi si di mimọ̀ fun ọ.
entries.en: Thou compassest my path and my lying down, and art acquainted with all my ways.

entries.yo: Nitori ti kò si ọ̀rọ kan li ahọn mi, kiyesi i, Oluwa, iwọ mọ̀ ọ patapata.
entries.en: For there is not a word in my tongue, but, lo, O LORD, thou knowest it altogether.

entries.yo: Iwọ sé mi mọ lẹhin ati niwaju, iwọ si fi ọwọ rẹ le mi.
entries.en: Thou hast beset me behind and before, and laid thine hand upon me.

entries.yo: Iru ìmọ yi ṣe ohun iyanu fun mi jù; o ga, emi kò le mọ̀ ọ.
entries.en: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me; it is high, I cannot attain unto it.

entries.yo: Nibo li emi o gbe lọ kuro lọwọ ẹmi rẹ? tabi nibo li emi o sárè kuro niwaju rẹ?
entries.en: Whither shall I go from thy spirit? or whither shall I flee from thy presence?

entries.yo: Bi emi ba gòke lọ si ọrun, iwọ wà nibẹ: bi emi ba si tẹ́ ẹni mi ni ipò okú, kiyesi i, iwọ wà nibẹ.
entries.en: If I ascend up into heaven, thou art there: if I make my bed in hell, behold, thou art there.

entries.yo: Emi iba mu iyẹ-apa owurọ, ki emi si lọ joko niha opin okun;
entries.en: If I take the wings of the morning, and dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea;

entries.yo: Ani nibẹ na li ọwọ rẹ yio fà mi, ọwọ ọtún rẹ yio si dì mi mu.
entries.en: Even there shall thy hand lead me, and thy right hand shall hold me.

entries.yo: Bi mo ba wipe, Njẹ ki òkunkun ki o bò mi mọlẹ; ki imọlẹ ki o di oru yi mi ka.
entries.en: If I say, Surely the darkness shall cover me; even the night shall be light about me.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ òkunkun kì iṣu lọdọ rẹ; ṣugbọn oru tàn imọlẹ bi ọsan: ati òkunkun ati ọsan, mejeji bakanna ni fun ọ.
entries.en: Yea, the darkness hideth not from thee; but the night shineth as the day: the darkness and the light are both alike to thee.

entries.yo: Nitori iwọ li o dá ọkàn mi: iwọ li o bò mi mọlẹ ni inu iya mi.
entries.en: For thou hast possessed my reins: thou hast covered me in my mother's womb.

entries.yo: Emi o yìn ọ; nitori tẹ̀ru-tẹ̀ru ati tiyanu-tiyanu li a dá mi: iyanu ni iṣẹ rẹ; eyinì li ọkàn mi si mọ̀ dajudaju.
entries.en: I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well.

entries.yo: Ẹda ara mi kò pamọ kuro lọdọ rẹ, nigbati a da mi ni ìkọkọ, ti a si nṣiṣẹ mi li àrabara niha isalẹ ilẹ aiye.
entries.en: My substance was not hid from thee, when I was made in secret, and curiously wrought in the lowest parts of the earth.

entries.yo: Oju rẹ ti ri ohun ara mi ti o wà laipé: a ti ninu iwe rẹ ni a ti kọ gbogbo wọn si, li ojojumọ li a nda wọn, nigbati ọkan wọn kò ti isi.
entries.en: Thine eyes did see my substance, yet being unperfect; and in thy book all my members were written, which in continuance were fashioned, when as yet there was none of them.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun, ìro inu rẹ ti ṣe iye-biye to fun mi, iye wọn ti pọ̀ to!
entries.en: How precious also are thy thoughts unto me, O God! how great is the sum of them!

entries.yo: Emi iba kà wọn, nwọn jù iyanrin lọ ni iye: nigbati mo ba jí, emi wà lọdọ rẹ sibẹ.
entries.en: If I should count them, they are more in number than the sand: when I awake, I am still with thee.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun iba jẹ pa enia buburu nitõtọ: nitorina kuro lọdọ mi ẹnyin ọkunrin ẹ̀jẹ.
entries.en: Surely thou wilt slay the wicked, O God: depart from me therefore, ye bloody men.

entries.yo: Ẹniti nfi inu buburu sọ̀rọ si ọ, awọn ọta rẹ npè orukọ rẹ li asan!
entries.en: For they speak against thee wickedly, and thine enemies take thy name in vain.

entries.yo: Oluwa, njẹ emi kò korira awọn ti o korira rẹ? njẹ inu mi kò ha si bajẹ si awọn ti o dide si ọ?
entries.en: Do not I hate them, O LORD, that hate thee? and am not I grieved with those that rise up against thee?

entries.yo: Emi korira wọn li àkotan: emi kà wọn si ọta mi.
entries.en: I hate them with perfect hatred: I count them mine enemies.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun, wadi mi, ki o si mọ̀ aiya mi: dán mi wò, ki o si mọ̀ ìro-inu mi:
entries.en: Search me, O God, and know my heart: try me, and know my thoughts:

entries.yo: Ki o si wò bi ipa-ọ̀na buburu kan ba wà ninu mi, ki o si fi ẹsẹ mi le ọ̀na ainipẹkun.
entries.en: And see if there be any wicked way in me, and lead me in the way everlasting.

entries.yo: OLUWA gbà mi lọwọ ọkunrin buburu nì, yọ mi lọwọ ọkunrin ìka nì;
entries.en: Deliver me, O LORD, from the evil man: preserve me from the violent man;

entries.yo: Ẹniti nrò ìwa-buburu ni inu wọn; nigbagbogbo ni nwọn nrú ìja soke si mi.
entries.en: Which imagine mischiefs in their heart; continually are they gathered together for war.

entries.yo: Nwọn ti pọ́n ahọn wọn bi ejo; oro pãmọlẹ mbẹ li abẹ ète wọn.
entries.en: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent; adders' poison is under their lips. Selah.

entries.yo: Oluwa, pa mi mọ́ kuro lọwọ enia buburu; yọ mi kuro lọwọ ọkunrin ìka nì; ẹniti o ti pinnu rẹ̀ lati bì ìrin mi ṣubu.
entries.en: Keep me, O LORD, from the hands of the wicked; preserve me from the violent man; who have purposed to overthrow my goings.

entries.yo: Awọn agberaga dẹ pakute silẹ fun mi, ati okùn; nwọn ti nà àwọn lẹba ọ̀na; nwọn ti kẹkùn silẹ fun mi.
entries.en: The proud have hid a snare for me, and cords; they have spread a net by the wayside; they have set gins for me. Selah.

entries.yo: Emi wi fun Oluwa pe, iwọ li Ọlọrun mi: Oluwa, gbọ́ ohùn ẹ̀bẹ mi.
entries.en: I said unto the LORD, Thou art my God: hear the voice of my supplications, O LORD.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun Oluwa, agbara igbala mi, iwọ li o bò ori mi mọlẹ li ọjọ ìja.
entries.en: O GOD the Lord, the strength of my salvation, thou hast covered my head in the day of battle.

entries.yo: Oluwa, máṣe fi ifẹ enia buburu fun u: máṣe kún ọgbọ́n buburu rẹ̀ lọwọ: ki nwọn ki o má ba gbé ara wọn ga.
