entries.en: Grant not, O LORD, the desires of the wicked: further not his wicked device; lest they exalt themselves. Selah.

entries.yo: Bi o ṣe ti ori awọn ti o yi mi ká kiri ni, jẹ ki ìka ète ara wọn ki o bò wọn mọlẹ.
entries.en: As for the head of those that compass me about, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.

entries.yo: A o da ẹyin iná si wọn lara: on o wọ́ wọn lọ sinu iná, sinu ọgbun omi jijin, ki nwọn ki o má le dide mọ́.
entries.en: Let burning coals fall upon them: let them be cast into the fire; into deep pits, that they rise not up again.

entries.yo: Máṣe jẹ ki alahọn buburu ki o fi ẹsẹ mulẹ li aiye: ibi ni yio ma dọdẹ ọkunrin ìka nì lati bì i ṣubu.
entries.en: Let not an evil speaker be established in the earth: evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow him.

entries.yo: Emi mọ̀ pe, Oluwa yio mu ọ̀ran olupọnju duro, ati are awọn talaka.
entries.en: I know that the LORD will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and the right of the poor.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ awọn olododo yio ma fi ọpẹ fun orukọ rẹ: awọn ẹni diduro-ṣinṣin yio ma gbe iwaju rẹ.
entries.en: Surely the righteous shall give thanks unto thy name: the upright shall dwell in thy presence.

entries.yo: OLUWA, emi kigbe pè ọ: yara si ọdọ mi; fi eti si ohùn mi, nigbati mo ba nkepè ọ.
entries.en: LORD, I cry unto thee: make haste unto me; give ear unto my voice, when I cry unto thee.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki adura mi ki o wá si iwaju rẹ bi ẹbọ turari; ati igbé ọwọ mi soke bi ẹbọ aṣãlẹ.
entries.en: Let my prayer be set forth before thee as incense; and the lifting up of my hands as the evening sacrifice.

entries.yo: Oluwa, fi ẹṣọ́ siwaju ẹnu mi; pa ilẹkun ète mi mọ́.
entries.en: Set a watch, O LORD, before my mouth; keep the door of my lips.

entries.yo: Máṣe fà aiya mi si ohun ibi kan, lati ma ba awọn ti nṣiṣẹ ẹ̀ṣẹ ṣiṣẹ buburu; má si jẹ ki emi ki o jẹ ninu ohun didùn wọn.
entries.en: Incline not my heart to any evil thing, to practise wicked works with men that work iniquity: and let me not eat of their dainties.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki olododo ki o lù mi; iṣeun ni yio jasi: jẹ ki o si ba mi wi; ororo daradara ni yio jasi, ti kì yio fọ́ mi lori: sibẹ adura mi yio sa wà nitori jamba wọn.
entries.en: Let the righteous smite me; it shall be a kindness: and let him reprove me; it shall be an excellent oil, which shall not break my head: for yet my prayer also shall be in their calamities.

entries.yo: Nigbati a ba bì awọn onidajọ wọn ṣubu ni ibi okuta, nwọn o gbọ́ ọ̀rọ mi, nitori ti o dùn.
entries.en: When their judges are overthrown in stony places, they shall hear my words; for they are sweet.

entries.yo: Egungun wa tàn kalẹ li ẹnu isà-òkú, ẹniti o la aporo sori ilẹ.
entries.en: Our bones are scattered at the grave's mouth, as when one cutteth and cleaveth wood upon the earth.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn oju mi mbẹ lara rẹ; Ọlọrun Oluwa, lọdọ rẹ ni igbẹkẹle mi wà; máṣe tú ọkàn mi dà silẹ.
entries.en: But mine eyes are unto thee, O GOD the Lord: in thee is my trust; leave not my soul destitute.

entries.yo: Pa mi mọ́ kuro ninu okùn ti nwọn dẹ silẹ fun mi, ati ikẹkùn awọn oniṣẹ ẹ̀ṣẹ.
entries.en: Keep me from the snares which they have laid for me, and the gins of the workers of iniquity.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki awọn enia buburu ki o bọ́ sinu àwọn ara wọn, nigbati emi ba kọja lọ.
entries.en: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, whilst that I withal escape.

entries.yo: OLUWA ni mo fi ohùn mi kigbe pè; ohùn mi ni mo fi mbẹ̀bẹ mi si Oluwa.
entries.en: I cried unto the LORD with my voice; with my voice unto the LORD did I make my supplication.

entries.yo: Emi tú aroye mi silẹ niwaju rẹ̀; emi fi iṣẹ́ mi hàn niwaju rẹ̀.
entries.en: I poured out my complaint before him; I shewed before him my trouble.

entries.yo: Nigbati ọkàn mi rẹ̀wẹsi ninu mi, nigbana ni iwọ mọ̀ ipa-ọ̀na mi. Li ọ̀na ti emi nrìn ni nwọn dẹkùn silẹ fun mi nikọ̀kọ.
entries.en: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, then thou knewest my path. In the way wherein I walked have they privily laid a snare for me.

entries.yo: Emi wò ọwọ ọtún, mo si ri pe, kò si ẹnikan ti o mọ̀ mi: àbo dẹti fun mi; kò si ẹniti o nãni ọkàn mi.
entries.en: I looked on my right hand, and beheld, but there was no man that would know me: refuge failed me; no man cared for my soul.

entries.yo: Oluwa, iwọ ni mo kigbe pè: emi wipe, iwọ li àbo mi ati ipin mi ni ilẹ alãye.
entries.en: I cried unto thee, O LORD: I said, Thou art my refuge and my portion in the land of the living.

entries.yo: Fiyesi igbe mi: nitori ti a rẹ̀ mi silẹ gidigidi: gbà mi lọwọ awọn oninu-nibini mi. Nitori nwọn lagbara ju mi lọ.
entries.en: Attend unto my cry; for I am brought very low: deliver me from my persecutors; for they are stronger than I.

entries.yo: Mu ọkàn mi jade kuro ninu tubu, ki emi ki o le ma yìn orukọ rẹ; awọn olododo yio yi mi ka kiri; nitori iwọ o fi ọ̀pọlọpọ ba mi ṣe.
entries.en: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may praise thy name: the righteous shall compass me about; for thou shalt deal bountifully with me.

entries.yo: OLUWA, gbọ́ adura mi, fi eti si ẹ̀bẹ mi; ninu otitọ rẹ dá mi lohùn ati ninu ododo rẹ.
entries.en: Hear my prayer, O LORD, give ear to my supplications: in thy faithfulness answer me, and in thy righteousness.

entries.yo: Ki o má si ba ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ lọ sinu idajọ, nitori ti kò si ẹniti o wà lãye ti a o dalare niwaju rẹ.
entries.en: And enter not into judgment with thy servant: for in thy sight shall no man living be justified.

entries.yo: Nitori ti ọta ti ṣe inunibini si ọkàn mi; o ti lù ẹmi mi bolẹ; o ti mu mi joko li òkunkun, bi awọn ti o ti kú pẹ.
entries.en: For the enemy hath persecuted my soul; he hath smitten my life down to the ground; he hath made me to dwell in darkness, as those that have been long dead.

entries.yo: Nitorina li ẹmi mi ṣe rẹ̀wẹsi ninu mi; òfo fò aiya mi ninu mi.
entries.en: Therefore is my spirit overwhelmed within me; my heart within me is desolate.

entries.yo: Emi ranti ọjọ atijọ; emi ṣe àṣaro iṣẹ rẹ gbogbo, emi nronu iṣẹ ọwọ rẹ.
entries.en: I remember the days of old; I meditate on all thy works; I muse on the work of thy hands.

entries.yo: Emi nà ọwọ mi si ọ; ongbẹ rẹ ngbẹ ọkàn mi bi ilẹ gbigbẹ.
entries.en: I stretch forth my hands unto thee: my soul thirsteth after thee, as a thirsty land. Selah.

entries.yo: Oluwa, gbọ́ temi nisisiyi; o rẹ̀ ọkàn mi tan; máṣe pa oju rẹ mọ́ kuro lara mi, ki emi ki o má bà dabi awọn ti o lọ sinu ihò.
entries.en: Hear me speedily, O LORD: my spirit faileth: hide not thy face from me, lest I be like unto them that go down into the pit.

entries.yo: Mu mi gbọ́ iṣeun-ifẹ rẹ li owurọ; nitori iwọ ni mo gbẹkẹle: mu mi mọ̀ ọ̀na ti emi iba ma tọ̀; nitori mo gbé ọkàn mi soke si ọ.
entries.en: Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning; for in thee do I trust: cause me to know the way wherein I should walk; for I lift up my soul unto thee.

entries.yo: Oluwa, gbà mi lọwọ awọn ọta mi: ọdọ rẹ ni mo sa pamọ́ si.
entries.en: Deliver me, O LORD, from mine enemies: I flee unto thee to hide me.

entries.yo: Kọ́ mi lati ṣe ohun ti o wù ọ: nitori iwọ li Ọlọrun mi: jẹ ki ẹmi rẹ didara fà mi lọ ni ilẹ ti o tẹju.
entries.en: Teach me to do thy will; for thou art my God: thy spirit is good; lead me into the land of uprightness.

entries.yo: Oluwa, sọ mi di ãye nitori orukọ rẹ: ninu ododo rẹ mu ọkàn mi jade ninu iṣẹ́.
entries.en: Quicken me, O LORD, for thy name's sake: for thy righteousness' sake bring my soul out of trouble.

entries.yo: Ati ninu ãnu rẹ ke awọn ọta mi kuro, ki o si run gbogbo awọn ti nni ọkàn mi lara: nitori pe iranṣẹ rẹ li emi iṣe.
entries.en: And of thy mercy cut off mine enemies, and destroy all them that afflict my soul: for I am thy servant.

entries.yo: OLUBUKÚN li oluwa apata mi, ẹniti o kọ́ ọwọ mi li ogun, ati ika mi ni ìja:
entries.en: Blessed be the LORD my strength, which teacheth my hands to war, and my fingers to fight:

entries.yo: Õre mi, ati odi-agbara mi; ile-iṣọ giga, ati olugbala mi; asà mi, ati ẹniti mo gbẹkẹle; eniti o tẹri awọn enia mi ba labẹ mi.
entries.en: My goodness, and my fortress; my high tower, and my deliverer; my shield, and he in whom I trust; who subdueth my people under me.

entries.yo: Oluwa, kili enia, ti iwọ fi nkiye si i! tabi ọmọ enia, ti iwọ fi nronú rẹ̀!
entries.en: LORD, what is man, that thou takest knowledge of him! or the son of man, that thou makest account of him!

entries.yo: Enia dabi asan: bi ojìji ti nkọja lọ li ọjọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Man is like to vanity: his days are as a shadow that passeth away.

entries.yo: Oluwa, tẹ̀ ọrun rẹ ba, ki o si sọ̀kalẹ: tọ́ awọn òke nla, nwọn o si ru ẽfin.
entries.en: Bow thy heavens, O LORD, and come down: touch the mountains, and they shall smoke.

entries.yo: Kọ manamana jade, ki o si tú wọn ka: ta ọfà rẹ ki o si dà wọn rú.
entries.en: Cast forth lightning, and scatter them: shoot out thine arrows, and destroy them.

entries.yo: Rán ọwọ rẹ lati òke wá; yọ mi, ki o si gbà mi kuro ninu omi nla, li ọwọ awọn ọmọ àjeji.
entries.en: Send thine hand from above; rid me, and deliver me out of great waters, from the hand of strange children;

entries.yo: Ẹnu ẹniti nsọ̀rọ asan, ọwọ ọtún wọn si jẹ ọwọ ọtún eke.
entries.en: Whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun, emi o kọ orin titun si ọ: lara ohun ọnà orin olokùn mẹwa li emi o kọrin iyìn si ọ.
entries.en: I will sing a new song unto thee, O God: upon a psaltery and an instrument of ten strings will I sing praises unto thee.

entries.yo: On li o nfi igbala fun awọn ọba: ẹniti o gbà Dafidi iranṣẹ rẹ̀ lọwọ idà ipanilara.
entries.en: It is he that giveth salvation unto kings: who delivereth David his servant from the hurtful sword.

entries.yo: Yọ mi, ki o si gbà mi lọwọ awọn ọmọ àjeji, ẹnu ẹniti nsọ̀rọ asan, ati ọwọ ọtún wọn jẹ ọwọ ọtún eke:
entries.en: Rid me, and deliver me from the hand of strange children, whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood:

entries.yo: Ki awọn ọmọkunrin wa, ki o dabi igi gbigbin ti o dagba ni igba-ewe wọn; ki awọn ọmọbinrin wa ki o le dabi ọwọ̀n igun-ile, ti a ṣe lọnà bi afarawe ãfin.
entries.en: That our sons may be as plants grown up in their youth; that our daughters may be as corner stones, polished after the similitude of a palace:

entries.yo: Ki aká wa ki o le kún, ki o ma funni li oniruru iṣura: ki awọn agutan wa ki o ma bi ẹgbẹgbẹrun ati ẹgbẹgbẹrun mẹwa ni igboro wa:
entries.en: That our garners may be full, affording all manner of store: that our sheep may bring forth thousands and ten thousands in our streets:

entries.yo: Ki awọn malu wa ki o le rẹrù; ki o má si ikọlù, tabi ikolọ jade: ki o má si aroye ni igboro wa.
entries.en: That our oxen may be strong to labour; that there be no breaking in, nor going out; that there be no complaining in our streets.

entries.yo: Ibukún ni fun awọn enia, ti o mbẹ ni iru ìwa bẹ̃: nitõtọ, ibukún ni fun awọn enia na, ti ẹniti Ọlọrun Oluwa iṣe.
entries.en: Happy is that people, that is in such a case: yea, happy is that people, whose God is the LORD.

entries.yo: EMI o gbé ọ ga, Ọlọrun mi, ọba mi; emi o si ma fi ibukún fun orukọ rẹ lai ati lailai.
entries.en: I will extol thee, my God, O king; and I will bless thy name for ever and ever.

entries.yo: Li ojojumọ li emi o ma fi ibukún fun ọ; emi o si ma yìn orukọ rẹ lai ati lailai.
entries.en: Every day will I bless thee; and I will praise thy name for ever and ever.

entries.yo: Titobi li Oluwa, o si ni iyìn pupọ̀-pupọ̀; awamaridi si ni titobi rẹ̀.
entries.en: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised; and his greatness is unsearchable.

entries.yo: Iran kan yio ma yìn iṣẹ rẹ de ekeji, yio si ma sọ̀rọ iṣẹ agbara rẹ.
entries.en: One generation shall praise thy works to another, and shall declare thy mighty acts.

entries.yo: Emi o sọ̀rọ iyìn ọla-nla rẹ ti o logo, ati ti iṣẹ iyanu rẹ.
entries.en: I will speak of the glorious honour of thy majesty, and of thy wondrous works.

entries.yo: Enia o si ma sọ̀rọ agbara iṣẹ rẹ ti o li ẹ̀ru; emi o si ma ròhin titobi rẹ.
entries.en: And men shall speak of the might of thy terrible acts: and I will declare thy greatness.

entries.yo: Nwọn o ma sọ̀rọ iranti ore rẹ pupọ̀-pupọ̀, nwọn o si ma kọrin ododo rẹ.
entries.en: They shall abundantly utter the memory of thy great goodness, and shall sing of thy righteousness.

entries.yo: Olore-ọfẹ li Oluwa, o kún fun ãnu; o lọra lati binu, o si li ãnu pupọ̀.
entries.en: The LORD is gracious, and full of compassion; slow to anger, and of great mercy.

entries.yo: Oluwa ṣeun fun ẹni gbogbo; iyọ́nu rẹ̀ si mbẹ lori iṣẹ rẹ̀ gbogbo.
entries.en: The LORD is good to all: and his tender mercies are over all his works.

entries.yo: Oluwa, gbogbo iṣẹ rẹ ni yio ma yìn ọ; awọn enia mimọ́ rẹ yio si ma fi ibukún fun ọ.
entries.en: All thy works shall praise thee, O LORD; and thy saints shall bless thee.

entries.yo: Nwọn o ma sọ̀rọ ogo ijọba rẹ, nwọn o si ma sọ̀rọ agbara rẹ:
entries.en: They shall speak of the glory of thy kingdom, and talk of thy power;

entries.yo: Lati mu iṣẹ agbara rẹ̀ di mimọ̀ fun awọn ọmọ enia, ati ọla-nla ijọba rẹ̀ ti o logo,
entries.en: To make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, and the glorious majesty of his kingdom.

entries.yo: Ijọba rẹ ijọba aiye-raiye ni, ati ijọba rẹ lati iran-diran gbogbo.
entries.en: Thy kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and thy dominion endureth throughout all generations.

entries.yo: Oluwa mu gbogbo awọn ti o ṣubu ró; o si gbé gbogbo awọn ti o tẹriba dide.
entries.en: The LORD upholdeth all that fall, and raiseth up all those that be bowed down.

entries.yo: Oju gbogbo enia nwò ọ; iwọ si fun wọn li onjẹ wọn li akokò rẹ̀.
entries.en: The eyes of all wait upon thee; and thou givest them their meat in due season.

entries.yo: Iwọ ṣi ọwọ rẹ, iwọ si tẹ́ ifẹ gbogbo ohun alãye lọrùn.
entries.en: Thou openest thine hand, and satisfiest the desire of every living thing.

entries.yo: Olododo li Oluwa li ọ̀na rẹ̀ gbogbo, ati alãnu ni iṣẹ rẹ̀ gbogbo.
entries.en: The LORD is righteous in all his ways, and holy in all his works.

entries.yo: Oluwa wà leti ọdọ gbogbo awọn ti nkepè e, leti ọdọ gbogbo ẹniti nkepè e li otitọ.
entries.en: The LORD is nigh unto all them that call upon him, to all that call upon him in truth.

entries.yo: Yio mu ifẹ awọn ti mbẹ̀ru rẹ̀ ṣẹ: yio gbọ́ igbe wọn pẹlu, yio si gbà wọn.
entries.en: He will fulfil the desire of them that fear him: he also will hear their cry, and will save them.

entries.yo: Oluwa da gbogbo awọn ti o fẹ ẹ si: ṣugbọn gbogbo enia buburu ni yio parun.
entries.en: The LORD preserveth all them that love him: but all the wicked will he destroy.

entries.yo: Ẹnu mi yio ma sọ̀rọ iyìn Oluwa: ki gbogbo enia ki o si ma fi ibukún fun orukọ rẹ̀ mimọ́ lai ati lailai.
entries.en: My mouth shall speak the praise of the LORD: and let all flesh bless his holy name for ever and ever.

entries.yo: Ẹ fi iyìn fun Oluwa. Fi iyìn fun Oluwa, iwọ ọkàn mi.
entries.en: Praise ye the LORD. Praise the LORD, O my soul.

entries.yo: Nigbati mo wà lãye li emi o ma fi iyìn fun Oluwa: emi o ma kọrin iyìn si Ọlọrun mi, nigbati mo wà.
entries.en: While I live will I praise the LORD: I will sing praises unto my God while I have any being.

entries.yo: Ẹ máṣe gbẹkẹ nyin le awọn ọmọ-alade, ani le ọmọ-enia, lọwọ ẹniti kò si iranlọwọ.
entries.en: Put not your trust in princes, nor in the son of man, in whom there is no help.

entries.yo: Ẹmi rẹ̀ jade lọ, o pada si erupẹ rẹ̀; li ọjọ na gan, ìro inu rẹ̀ run.
entries.en: His breath goeth forth, he returneth to his earth; in that very day his thoughts perish.

entries.yo: Ibukún ni fun ẹniti o ni Ọlọrun Jakobu fun iranlọwọ rẹ̀, ireti ẹniti mbẹ lọdọ Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ̀:
entries.en: Happy is he that hath the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in the LORD his God:

entries.yo: Ẹniti o da ọrun on aiye, okun ati ohun ti o wà ninu wọn: ẹniti o pa otitọ mọ́ titi aiye:
entries.en: Which made heaven, and earth, the sea, and all that therein is: which keepeth truth for ever:

entries.yo: Ẹniti o nṣe idajọ fun ẹni-inilara: ẹniti o nfi onjẹ fun ẹniti ebi npa. Oluwa tú awọn aratubu silẹ:
entries.en: Which executeth judgment for the oppressed: which giveth food to the hungry. The LORD looseth the prisoners:

entries.yo: Oluwa ṣi oju awọn afọju: Oluwa gbé awọn ti a tẹ̀ lori ba dide; Oluwa fẹ awọn olododo:
entries.en: The LORD openeth the eyes of the blind: the LORD raiseth them that are bowed down: the LORD loveth the righteous:

entries.yo: Oluwa pa awọn alejo mọ́; o tù awọn alainibaba ati opo lara: ṣugbọn ọ̀na awọn enia buburu ni yio darú.
entries.en: The LORD preserveth the strangers; he relieveth the fatherless and widow: but the way of the wicked he turneth upside down.

entries.yo: Oluwa yio jọba lailai, ani Ọlọrun rẹ, iwọ Sioni, lati iran-diran gbogbo. Ẹ fi iyìn fun Oluwa.
entries.en: The LORD shall reign for ever, even thy God, O Zion, unto all generations. Praise ye the LORD.

entries.yo: Ẹ fi iyìn fun Oluwa: nitori ohun rere ni lati ma kọ orin iyìn si Ọlọrun wa: nitori ti o dùn, iyìn si yẹ.
entries.en: Praise ye the LORD: for it is good to sing praises unto our God; for it is pleasant; and praise is comely.

entries.yo: Oluwa li o kọ́ Jerusalemu: on li o kó awọn ifọnkalẹ Israeli jọ.
entries.en: The LORD doth build up Jerusalem: he gathereth together the outcasts of Israel.

entries.yo: O mu awọn onirora aiya lara da: o di ọgbẹ wọn:
entries.en: He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds.

entries.yo: O ka iye awọn ìrawọ; o si sọ gbogbo wọn li orukọ.
entries.en: He telleth the number of the stars; he calleth them all by their names.

entries.yo: Oluwa wa tobi, ati alagbara nla: oye rẹ̀ kò li opin.
entries.en: Great is our Lord, and of great power: his understanding is infinite.

entries.yo: Oluwa gbé awọn onirẹlẹ soke: o rẹ̀ awọn enia buburu si ilẹyilẹ.
entries.en: The LORD lifteth up the meek: he casteth the wicked down to the ground.

entries.yo: Ẹ fi ọpẹ kọrin si Oluwa; kọrin iyìn si Ọlọrun wa lara duru:
entries.en: Sing unto the LORD with thanksgiving; sing praise upon the harp unto our God:

entries.yo: Ẹniti o fi awọsanma bò oju ọrun, ẹniti o pèse òjo fun ilẹ, ti o mu koriko dàgba lori awọn òke nla.
entries.en: Who covereth the heaven with clouds, who prepareth rain for the earth, who maketh grass to grow upon the mountains.

entries.yo: O fi onjẹ ẹranko fun u ati fun ọmọ iwò ti ndún.
entries.en: He giveth to the beast his food, and to the young ravens which cry.

entries.yo: Kò ṣe inudidùn si agbara ẹṣin: kò ṣe inudidùn si ẹsẹ ọkunrin.
entries.en: He delighteth not in the strength of the horse: he taketh not pleasure in the legs of a man.

entries.yo: Oluwa nṣe inudidùn si awọn ti o bẹ̀ru rẹ̀, si awọn ti nṣe ireti ãnu rẹ̀.
entries.en: The LORD taketh pleasure in them that fear him, in those that hope in his mercy.

entries.yo: Yìn Oluwa, iwọ Jerusalemu; yìn Ọlọrun rẹ, iwọ Sioni.
entries.en: Praise the LORD, O Jerusalem; praise thy God, O Zion.

entries.yo: Nitori ti o ti mu ọpá-idabu ẹnu-bode rẹ le; o ti busi i fun awọn ọmọ rẹ ninu rẹ.
entries.en: For he hath strengthened the bars of thy gates; he hath blessed thy children within thee.

entries.yo: O fi alafia ṣe àgbegbe rẹ, o si fi alikama didara-jù kún ọ.
entries.en: He maketh peace in thy borders, and filleth thee with the finest of the wheat.

entries.yo: O rán aṣẹ rẹ̀ jade wá si aiye; ọ̀rọ rẹ̀ sure tete.
entries.en: He sendeth forth his commandment upon earth: his word runneth very swiftly.

entries.yo: O fi òjo-didì funni bi irun-agutan, o si fún ìri-didì ká bi ẽrú.
entries.en: He giveth snow like wool: he scattereth the hoarfrost like ashes.

entries.yo: O dà omi didì rẹ̀ bi òkele; tali o le duro niwaju otutu rẹ̀.
entries.en: He casteth forth his ice like morsels: who can stand before his cold?

entries.yo: O rán ọ̀rọ rẹ̀ jade, o si mu wọn yọ́; o mu afẹfẹ rẹ̀ fẹ, omi si nṣàn.
entries.en: He sendeth out his word, and melteth them: he causeth his wind to blow, and the waters flow.

entries.yo: O fi ọ̀rọ rẹ̀ hàn fun Jakobu, aṣẹ rẹ̀ ati idajọ rẹ̀ fun Israeli.
entries.en: He sheweth his word unto Jacob, his statutes and his judgments unto Israel.

entries.yo: Kò ba orilẹ-ède kan ṣe bẹ̃ ri; bi o si ṣe ti idajọ rẹ̀ ni, nwọn kò mọ̀ wọn. Ẹ fi iyìn fun Oluwa.
entries.en: He hath not dealt so with any nation: and as for his judgments, they have not known them. Praise ye the LORD.

entries.yo: Ẹ fi iyìn fun Oluwa, Ẹ fi iyìn fun Oluwa lati ọrun wá; ẹ fi iyìn fun u ni ibi giga.
entries.en: Praise ye the LORD. Praise ye the LORD from the heavens: praise him in the heights.

entries.yo: Ẹ fi iyìn fun u, gbogbo ẹnyin angeli rẹ̀; ẹ fi iyìn fun u, gbogbo ẹnyin ọmọ-ogun rẹ̀.
entries.en: Praise ye him, all his angels: praise ye him, all his hosts.

entries.yo: Ẹ fi iyìn fun u, õrun ati oṣupa; ẹ fi iyìn fun u, gbogbo ẹnyin irawọ imọlẹ.
entries.en: Praise ye him, sun and moon: praise him, all ye stars of light.

entries.yo: Ẹ fi iyìn fun u, ẹnyin ọrun awọn ọrun, ati ẹnyin omi ti mbẹ loke ọrun.
entries.en: Praise him, ye heavens of heavens, and ye waters that be above the heavens.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki nwọn ki o ma yìn orukọ Oluwa; nitori ti on paṣẹ, a si da wọn.
entries.en: Let them praise the name of the LORD: for he commanded, and they were created.

entries.yo: O si fi idi wọn mulẹ lai ati lailai; o si ti ṣe ilana kan ti kì yio kọja.
entries.en: He hath also stablished them for ever and ever: he hath made a decree which shall not pass.

entries.yo: Ẹ yìn Oluwa lati aiye wá, ẹnyin erinmi, ati gbogbo ibu-omi;
entries.en: Praise the LORD from the earth, ye dragons, and all deeps:

entries.yo: Iná ati yinyin òjo-didì ati ikũku; ìji mu ọ̀rọ rẹ̀ ṣẹ;
entries.en: Fire, and hail; snow, and vapour; stormy wind fulfilling his word:

entries.yo: Ẹnyin òke nla, ati gbogbo òke kekere; igi eleso, ati gbogbo igi Kedari;
entries.en: Mountains, and all hills; fruitful trees, and all cedars:

entries.yo: Ẹranko, ati gbogbo ẹran-ọ̀sin; ohun ti nrakò, ati ẹiyẹ́ ti nfò;
entries.en: Beasts, and all cattle; creeping things, and flying fowl:

entries.yo: Awọn ọba aiye, ati gbogbo enia; ọmọ-alade, ati gbogbo onidajọ aiye;
entries.en: Kings of the earth, and all people; princes, and all judges of the earth:

entries.yo: Awọn ọdọmọkunrin ati awọn wundia, awọn arugbo enia ati awọn ọmọde;
entries.en: Both young men, and maidens; old men, and children:

entries.yo: Ki nwọn ki o ma yìn orukọ Oluwa; nitori orukọ rẹ̀ nikan li o li ọlá; ogo rẹ̀ bori aiye on ọrun.
entries.en: Let them praise the name of the LORD: for his name alone is excellent; his glory is above the earth and heaven.

entries.yo: O si gbé iwo kan soke fun awọn enia rẹ̀, iyìn fun gbogbo enia mimọ́ rẹ̀; ani awọn ọmọ Israeli, awọn enia ti o sunmọ ọdọ rẹ̀. Ẹ fi iyìn fun Oluwa.
entries.en: He also exalteth the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints; even of the children of Israel, a people near unto him. Praise ye the LORD.

entries.yo: Ẹ fi iyìn fun Oluwa. Ẹ kọ orin titun si Oluwa, ati iyìn rẹ̀ ninu ijọ awọn enia-mimọ́.
entries.en: Praise ye the LORD. Sing unto the LORD a new song, and his praise in the congregation of saints.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki Israeli ki o yọ̀ si ẹniti o dá a; jẹ ki awọn ọmọ Sioni ki o kún fun ayọ̀ si Ọba wọn.
entries.en: Let Israel rejoice in him that made him: let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki nwọn ki o yìn orukọ rẹ̀ ninu ijó: jẹ ki nwọn ki o fi ìlu ati dùru kọrin iyìn si i.
entries.en: Let them praise his name in the dance: let them sing praises unto him with the timbrel and harp.

entries.yo: Nitori ti Oluwa ṣe inudidùn si awọn enia rẹ̀; yio fi igbala ṣe awọn onirẹlẹ li ẹwà.
entries.en: For the LORD taketh pleasure in his people: he will beautify the meek with salvation.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki awọn enia mimọ́ ki o kún fun ayọ̀ ninu ogo; ki nwọn ki o mã kọrin kikan lori ẹni wọn.
entries.en: Let the saints be joyful in glory: let them sing aloud upon their beds.

entries.yo: Ki iyìn Ọlọrun ki o wà li ẹnu wọn, ati idà oloju meji li ọwọ wọn;
entries.en: Let the high praises of God be in their mouth, and a twoedged sword in their hand;

entries.yo: Lati san ẹsan lara awọn keferi, ati ijiya lara awọn enia.
entries.en: To execute vengeance upon the heathen, and punishments upon the people;

entries.yo: Lati fi ẹ̀wọn dè awọn ọba wọn, ati lati fi ṣẹkẹṣẹkẹ irin dè awọn ọlọ̀tọ wọn;
entries.en: To bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;

entries.yo: Lati ṣe idajọ wọn, ti a ti kọwe rẹ̀, ọlá yi ni gbogbo enia mimọ́ rẹ̀ ni. Ẹ fi iyìn fun Oluwa.
entries.en: To execute upon them the judgment written: this honour have all his saints. Praise ye the LORD.

entries.yo: Ẹ fi iyìn fun Oluwa. Ẹ fi iyìn fun Ọlọrun ninu ibi mimọ́ rẹ̀; yìn i ninu ofurufu oju-ọrun agbara rẹ̀.
entries.en: Praise ye the LORD. Praise God in his sanctuary: praise him in the firmament of his power.

entries.yo: Yìn i nitori iṣẹ agbara rẹ̀: yìn i gẹgẹ bi titobi nla rẹ̀.
entries.en: Praise him for his mighty acts: praise him according to his excellent greatness.

entries.yo: Fi ohùn ipè yìn i: fi ohun-èlo orin ati duru yìn i.
entries.en: Praise him with the sound of the trumpet: praise him with the psaltery and harp.

entries.yo: Fi ìlu ati ijó yìn i: fi ohun ọnà orin olokùn ati fère yìn i.
entries.en: Praise him with the timbrel and dance: praise him with stringed instruments and organs.

entries.yo: Ẹ yìn i lara aro olohùn òke: ẹ yìn i lara aro olohùn goro:
entries.en: Praise him upon the loud cymbals: praise him upon the high sounding cymbals.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki ohun gbogbo ti o li ẹmi ki o yìn Oluwa. Ẹ fi iyìn fun Oluwa.
entries.en: Let every thing that hath breath praise the LORD. Praise ye the LORD.

entries.yo: OWE Solomoni, ọmọ Dafidi, ọba Israeli;
entries.en: The proverbs of Solomon the son of David, king of Israel;

entries.yo: Lati mọ̀ ọgbọ́n ati ẹkọ́; lati mọ̀ ọ̀rọ oye;
entries.en: To know wisdom and instruction; to perceive the words of understanding;

entries.yo: Lati gbà ẹkọ́ ọgbọ́n, ododo, ati idajọ, ati aiṣègbe;
entries.en: To receive the instruction of wisdom, justice, and judgment, and equity;

entries.yo: Lati fi oye fun alaimọ̀kan, lati fun ọdọmọkunrin ni ìmọ ati ironu.
entries.en: To give subtilty to the simple, to the young man knowledge and discretion.

entries.yo: Ọlọgbọ́n yio gbọ́, yio si ma pọ̀ si i li ẹkọ́; ati ẹni oye yio gba igbimọ̀ ọgbọ́n:
entries.en: A wise man will hear, and will increase learning; and a man of understanding shall attain unto wise counsels:

entries.yo: Lati mọ̀ owe, ati ìtumọ; ọ̀rọ ọgbọ́n, ati ọ̀rọ ikọkọ wọn.
entries.en: To understand a proverb, and the interpretation; the words of the wise, and their dark sayings.

entries.yo: Ibẹ̀ru Oluwa ni ipilẹṣẹ ìmọ; ṣugbọn awọn aṣiwere gàn ọgbọ́n ati ẹkọ́.
entries.en: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge: but fools despise wisdom and instruction.

entries.yo: Ọmọ mi, gbọ́ ẹkọ́ baba rẹ, ki iwọ ki o má si kọ̀ ofin iya rẹ silẹ:
entries.en: My son, hear the instruction of thy father, and forsake not the law of thy mother:

entries.yo: Nitoripe awọn ni yio ṣe ade ẹwà fun ori rẹ, ati ọṣọ́ yi ọrùn rẹ ka.
entries.en: For they shall be an ornament of grace unto thy head, and chains about thy neck.

entries.yo: Ọmọ mi, bi awọn ẹlẹṣẹ̀ ba tàn ọ, iwọ má ṣe gbà.
entries.en: My son, if sinners entice thee, consent thou not.

entries.yo: Bi nwọn wipe, Wá pẹlu wa, jẹ ki a ba fun ẹ̀jẹ, jẹ ki a lugọ ni ikọkọ de alaiṣẹ̀ lainidi.
entries.en: If they say, Come with us, let us lay wait for blood, let us lurk privily for the innocent without cause:

entries.yo: Jẹ ki a gbe wọn mì lãye bi isà-okú; ati awọn ẹni-diduroṣinṣin bi awọn ti nlọ sinu iho:
entries.en: Let us swallow them up alive as the grave; and whole, as those that go down into the pit:

entries.yo: Awa o ri onirũru ọrọ̀ iyebiye, awa o fi ikogun kún ile wa:
entries.en: We shall find all precious substance, we shall fill our houses with spoil:

entries.yo: Dà ipin rẹ pọ̀ mọ arin wa; jẹ ki gbogbo wa ki a jọ ni àpo kan:
entries.en: Cast in thy lot among us; let us all have one purse:

entries.yo: Ọmọ mi, máṣe rìn li ọ̀na pẹlu wọn: fà ẹsẹ rẹ sẹhin kuro ni ipa-ọ̀na wọn.
entries.en: My son, walk not thou in the way with them; refrain thy foot from their path:

entries.yo: Nitori ti ẹsẹ wọn sure si ibi, nwọn si yara lati ta ẹ̀jẹ silẹ.
entries.en: For their feet run to evil, and make haste to shed blood.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ, lasan li a nà àwọn silẹ li oju ẹiyẹkẹiyẹ.
entries.en: Surely in vain the net is spread in the sight of any bird.

entries.yo: Awọn wọnyi si ba fun ẹ̀jẹ ara wọn; nwọn lumọ nikọkọ fun ẹmi ara wọn.
entries.en: And they lay wait for their own blood; they lurk privily for their own lives.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni ọ̀na gbogbo awọn ti nṣe ojukokoro ère; ti ngba ẹmi awọn oluwa ohun na.
entries.en: So are the ways of every one that is greedy of gain; which taketh away the life of the owners thereof.

entries.yo: Ọgbọ́n nkigbe lode; o nfọhùn rẹ̀ ni igboro:
entries.en: Wisdom crieth without; she uttereth her voice in the streets:

entries.yo: O nke ni ibi pataki apejọ, ni gbangba ẹnubode ilu, o sọ ọ̀rọ rẹ̀ wipe,
entries.en: She crieth in the chief place of concourse, in the openings of the gates: in the city she uttereth her words, saying,

entries.yo: Yio ti pẹ tó, ẹnyin alaimọ̀kan ti ẹnyin o fi ma fẹ aimọ̀kan? ati ti awọn ẹlẹgàn yio fi ma ṣe inudidùn ninu ẹ̀gan wọn, ati ti awọn aṣiwere yio fi ma korira ìmọ?
entries.en: How long, ye simple ones, will ye love simplicity? and the scorners delight in their scorning, and fools hate knowledge?

entries.yo: Ẹ yipada ni ibawi mi; kiyesi i, emi o dà ẹmi mi sinu nyin, emi o fi ọ̀rọ mi hàn fun nyin.
entries.en: Turn you at my reproof: behold, I will pour out my spirit unto you, I will make known my words unto you.

entries.yo: Nitori ti emi pè, ti ẹnyin si kọ̀; ti emi nà ọwọ mi, ti ẹnikan kò si kà a si:
entries.en: Because I have called, and ye refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no man regarded;

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹnyin ti ṣá gbogbo ìgbimọ mi tì, ẹnyin kò si fẹ ibawi mi:
entries.en: But ye have set at nought all my counsel, and would none of my reproof:

entries.yo: Emi pẹlu o rẹrin idãmu nyin; emi o ṣe ẹ̀fẹ nigbati ibẹ̀ru nyin ba de;
entries.en: I also will laugh at your calamity; I will mock when your fear cometh;

entries.yo: Nigbati ibẹ̀ru nyin ba de bi ìji, ati idãmu nyin bi afẹyika-ìji; nigbati wahala ati àrodun ba de si nyin.
entries.en: When your fear cometh as desolation, and your destruction cometh as a whirlwind; when distress and anguish cometh upon you.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ẹnyin o kepè mi, ṣugbọn emi kì yio dahùn; nwọn o ṣafẹri mi ni kùtukùtu, ṣugbọn nwọn kì yio ri mi:
entries.en: Then shall they call upon me, but I will not answer; they shall seek me early, but they shall not find me:

entries.yo: Nitori ti nwọn korira ìmọ, nwọn kò si yàn ibẹ̀ru Oluwa.
entries.en: For that they hated knowledge, and did not choose the fear of the LORD:

entries.yo: Nwọn kò fẹ ìgbimọ mi: nwọn gàn gbogbo ibawi mi.
entries.en: They would none of my counsel: they despised all my reproof.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni nwọn o ṣe ma jẹ ninu ère ìwa ara wọn, nwọn o si kún fun ìmọkimọ wọn.
entries.en: Therefore shall they eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own devices.

entries.yo: Nitoripe irọra awọn alaimọ̀kan ni yio pa wọn, ati alafia awọn aṣiwere ni yio pa wọn run.
entries.en: For the turning away of the simple shall slay them, and the prosperity of fools shall destroy them.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹnikẹni ti o ba fetisi mi yio ma gbe lailewu, yio si farabalẹ kuro ninu ibẹ̀ru ibi.
entries.en: But whoso hearkeneth unto me shall dwell safely, and shall be quiet from fear of evil.

entries.yo: ỌMỌ mi, bi iwọ ba fẹ igba ọ̀rọ mi, ki iwọ si pa ofin mi mọ́ pẹlu rẹ.
entries.en: My son, if thou wilt receive my words, and hide my commandments with thee;

entries.yo: Ti iwọ dẹti rẹ silẹ si ọgbọ́n, ti iwọ si fi ọkàn si oye;
entries.en: So that thou incline thine ear unto wisdom, and apply thine heart to understanding;

entries.yo: Ani bi iwọ ba nke tọ̀ ìmọ lẹhin, ti iwọ si gbé ohùn rẹ soke fun oye;
entries.en: Yea, if thou criest after knowledge, and liftest up thy voice for understanding;

entries.yo: Bi iwọ ba ṣafẹri rẹ̀ bi fadaka, ti iwọ si nwá a kiri bi iṣura ti a pamọ́;
entries.en: If thou seekest her as silver, and searchest for her as for hid treasures;

entries.yo: Nigbana ni iwọ o mọ̀ ibẹ̀ru Oluwa, iwọ o si ri ìmọ Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Then shalt thou understand the fear of the LORD, and find the knowledge of God.

entries.yo: Nitori Oluwa ni ifi ọgbọ́n funni: lati ẹnu rẹ̀ jade ni ìmọ ati oye ti iwá.
entries.en: For the LORD giveth wisdom: out of his mouth cometh knowledge and understanding.

entries.yo: O to igbala jọ fun awọn olododo: on li asà fun awọn ti nrìn dede.
entries.en: He layeth up sound wisdom for the righteous: he is a buckler to them that walk uprightly.

entries.yo: O pa ipa-ọ̀na idajọ mọ́, o si pa ọ̀na awọn ayanfẹ rẹ̀ mọ́.
entries.en: He keepeth the paths of judgment, and preserveth the way of his saints.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni iwọ o mọ̀ ododo, ati idajọ, ati aiṣegbe; ani, gbogbo ipa-ọ̀na rere.
entries.en: Then shalt thou understand righteousness, and judgment, and equity; yea, every good path.

entries.yo: Nigbati ọgbọ́n bá wọ̀ inu rẹ lọ, ti ìmọ si dùn mọ ọkàn rẹ;
entries.en: When wisdom entereth into thine heart, and knowledge is pleasant unto thy soul;

entries.yo: Imoye yio pa ọ mọ́, oye yio si ma ṣọ́ ọ:
entries.en: Discretion shall preserve thee, understanding shall keep thee:

entries.yo: Lati gbà ọ li ọwọ ẹni-ibi, li ọwọ ọkunrin ti nsọrọ ayidayida;
entries.en: To deliver thee from the way of the evil man, from the man that speaketh froward things;

entries.yo: Ẹniti o fi ipa-ọ̀na iduroṣinṣin silẹ, lati rìn li ọ̀na òkunkun;
entries.en: Who leave the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness;

entries.yo: Ẹniti o yọ̀ ni buburu iṣe, ti o ṣe inu-didùn si ayidàyidà awọn enia buburu;
entries.en: Who rejoice to do evil, and delight in the frowardness of the wicked;

entries.yo: Ọ̀na ẹniti o wọ́, nwọn si ṣe arekereke ni ipa-ọ̀na wọn:
entries.en: Whose ways are crooked, and they froward in their paths:

entries.yo: Lati gbà ọ li ọwọ ajeji obinrin, ani li ọwọ ajeji obinrin ti nfi ọ̀rọ ẹnu rẹ̀ pọnni;
entries.en: To deliver thee from the strange woman, even from the stranger which flattereth with her words;

entries.yo: Ẹniti o kọ̀ ọrẹ́ igbà-ewe rẹ̀ silẹ, ti o si gbagbe majẹmu Ọlọrun rẹ̀.
entries.en: Which forsaketh the guide of her youth, and forgetteth the covenant of her God.

entries.yo: Nitoripe ile rẹ̀ tẹ̀ sinu ikú, ati ipa-ọ̀na rẹ̀ sọdọ awọn okú.
entries.en: For her house inclineth unto death, and her paths unto the dead.

entries.yo: Kò si ẹniti o tọ̀ ọ lọ ti o si tun pada sẹhin, bẹ̃ni nwọn kì idé ipa-ọ̀na ìye.
entries.en: None that go unto her return again, neither take they hold of the paths of life.

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o le ma rin li ọ̀na enia rere, ki iwọ ki o si pa ọ̀na awọn olododo mọ́.
entries.en: That thou mayest walk in the way of good men, and keep the paths of the righteous.

entries.yo: Nitoripe ẹni-iduroṣinṣin ni yio joko ni ilẹ na, awọn ti o pé yio si ma wà ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: For the upright shall dwell in the land, and the perfect shall remain in it.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn enia buburu li a o ke kuro ni ilẹ aiye, ati awọn olurekọja li a o si fàtu kuro ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: But the wicked shall be cut off from the earth, and the transgressors shall be rooted out of it.

entries.yo: ỌMỌ mi, máṣe gbagbe ofin mi; si jẹ ki aiya rẹ ki o pa ofin mi mọ́.
entries.en: My son, forget not my law; but let thine heart keep my commandments:

entries.yo: Nitori ọjọ gigùn, ati ẹmi gigùn, ati alafia ni nwọn o fi kún u fun ọ.
entries.en: For length of days, and long life, and peace, shall they add to thee.

entries.yo: Máṣe jẹ ki ãnu ati otitọ ki o fi ọ silẹ: so wọn mọ ọrùn rẹ; kọ wọn si walã aiya rẹ:
entries.en: Let not mercy and truth forsake thee: bind them about thy neck; write them upon the table of thine heart:

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni iwọ o ri ojurere, ati ọ̀na rere loju Ọlọrun ati enia.
entries.en: So shalt thou find favour and good understanding in the sight of God and man.

entries.yo: Fi gbogbo aiya rẹ gbẹkẹle Oluwa; ma si ṣe tẹ̀ si ìmọ ara rẹ.
entries.en: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.

entries.yo: Mọ̀ ọ ni gbogbo ọ̀na rẹ: on o si ma tọ́ ipa-ọna rẹ.
entries.en: In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.

entries.yo: Máṣe ọlọgbọ́n li oju ara rẹ; bẹ̀ru Oluwa, ki o si kuro ninu ibi.
entries.en: Be not wise in thine own eyes: fear the LORD, and depart from evil.

entries.yo: On o ṣe ilera si idodo rẹ, ati itura si egungun rẹ.
entries.en: It shall be health to thy navel, and marrow to thy bones.

entries.yo: Fi ohun-ini rẹ bọ̀wọ fun Oluwa, ati lati inu gbogbo akọbi ibisi-oko rẹ:
entries.en: Honour the LORD with thy substance, and with the firstfruits of all thine increase:

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni aká rẹ yio kún fun ọ̀pọlọpọ, ati agbá rẹ yio si kún fun ọti-waini titun.
entries.en: So shall thy barns be filled with plenty, and thy presses shall burst out with new wine.

entries.yo: Ọmọ mi, máṣe kọ̀ ibawi Oluwa; bẹ̃ni ki agara itọ́ni rẹ̀ ki o máṣe dá ọ:
entries.en: My son, despise not the chastening of the LORD; neither be weary of his correction:

entries.yo: Nitoripe ẹniti Oluwa fẹ on ni itọ́, gẹgẹ bi baba ti itọ́ ọmọ ti inu rẹ̀ dùn si.
entries.en: For whom the LORD loveth he correcteth; even as a father the son in whom he delighteth.

entries.yo: Ibukún ni fun ọkunrin na ti o wá ọgbọ́n ri, ati ọkunrin na ti o gbà oye.
entries.en: Happy is the man that findeth wisdom, and the man that getteth understanding.

entries.yo: Nitori ti òwo rẹ̀ ju òwo fadaka lọ, ère rẹ̀ si jù ti wura daradara lọ.
entries.en: For the merchandise of it is better than the merchandise of silver, and the gain thereof than fine gold.

entries.yo: O ṣe iyebiye jù iyùn lọ: ati ohun gbogbo ti iwọ le fẹ, kò si eyi ti a le fi we e.
entries.en: She is more precious than rubies: and all the things thou canst desire are not to be compared unto her.

entries.yo: Ọjọ gigùn mbẹ li ọwọ ọtún rẹ̀; ati li ọwọ osì rẹ̀, ọrọ̀ ati ọlá.
entries.en: Length of days is in her right hand; and in her left hand riches and honour.

entries.yo: Ọ̀na rẹ̀, ọ̀na didùn ni, ati gbogbo ipa-ọ̀na rẹ̀, alafia.
entries.en: Her ways are ways of pleasantness, and all her paths are peace.

entries.yo: Igi ìye ni iṣe fun gbogbo awọn ti o dì i mu: ibukún si ni fun ẹniti o dì i mu ṣinṣin.
entries.en: The is a tree of life to them that lay hold upon her: and happy is every one that retaineth her.

entries.yo: Ọgbọ́n li Oluwa fi fi idi aiye sọlẹ, oye li o si fi pese awọn ọrun.
entries.en: The LORD by wisdom hath founded the earth; by understanding hath he established the heavens.

entries.yo: Nipa ìmọ rẹ̀ ni ibú ya soke, ti awọsanma si nsẹ̀ ìri rẹ̀ silẹ.
entries.en: By his knowledge the depths are broken up, and the clouds drop down the dew.

entries.yo: Ọmọ mi, máṣe jẹ ki nwọn ki o lọ kuro li oju rẹ: pa ọgbọ́n ti o yè, ati imoye mọ́:
entries.en: My son, let not them depart from thine eyes: keep sound wisdom and discretion:

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni nwọn o ma jẹ ìye si ọkàn rẹ, ati ore-ọfẹ si ọrùn rẹ.
entries.en: So shall they be life unto thy soul, and grace to thy neck.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni iwọ o ma rìn ọ̀na rẹ lailewu, iwọ ki yio si fi ẹsẹ̀ kọ.
entries.en: Then shalt thou walk in thy way safely, and thy foot shall not stumble.

entries.yo: Nigbati iwọ dubulẹ, iwọ kì yio bẹ̀ru: nitõtọ, iwọ o dubulẹ, orun rẹ yio si dùn.
entries.en: When thou liest down, thou shalt not be afraid: yea, thou shalt lie down, and thy sleep shall be sweet.

entries.yo: Máṣe fòya ẹ̀ru ojijì, tabi idahoro awọn enia buburu, nigbati o de.
entries.en: Be not afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it cometh.

entries.yo: Nitori Oluwa ni yio ṣe igbẹkẹle rẹ, yio si pa ẹsẹ rẹ mọ́ kuro ninu atimu.
entries.en: For the LORD shall be thy confidence, and shall keep thy foot from being taken.

entries.yo: Máṣe fawọ ire sẹhin kuro lọdọ ẹniti iṣe tirẹ̀, bi o ba wà li agbara ọwọ rẹ lati ṣe e.
entries.en: Withhold not good from them to whom it is due, when it is in the power of thine hand to do it.

entries.yo: Máṣe wi fun ẹnikeji rẹ pe, Lọ, ki o si pada wá, bi o ba si di ọla, emi o fi fun ọ; nigbati iwọ ni i li ọwọ rẹ.
entries.en: Say not unto thy neighbour, Go, and come again, and to morrow I will give; when thou hast it by thee.

entries.yo: Máṣe gbìro buburu si ọmọnikeji rẹ, bi on ti joko laibẹ̀ru lẹba ọdọ rẹ.
entries.en: Devise not evil against thy neighbour, seeing he dwelleth securely by thee.

entries.yo: Máṣe ba enia jà lainidi, bi on kò ba ṣe ọ ni ibi.
entries.en: Strive not with a man without cause, if he have done thee no harm.

entries.yo: Máṣe ilara aninilara, má si ṣe yàn ọkan ninu gbogbo ọ̀na rẹ̀.
entries.en: Envy thou not the oppressor, and choose none of his ways.

entries.yo: Nitoripe irira li ẹlẹgan loju Oluwa; ṣugbọn aṣiri rẹ̀ wà pẹlu awọn olododo.
entries.en: For the froward is abomination to the LORD: but his secret is with the righteous.

entries.yo: Egún Oluwa mbẹ ni ile awọn enia buburu: ṣugbọn o bukún ibujoko awọn olõtọ.
entries.en: The curse of the LORD is in the house of the wicked: but he blesseth the habitation of the just.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ o ṣe ẹ̀ya si awọn ẹlẹya: ṣugbọn o fi ore-ọfẹ fun awọn onirẹlẹ.
entries.en: Surely he scorneth the scorners: but he giveth grace unto the lowly.

entries.yo: Awọn ọlọgbọ́n ni yio jogun ogo: ṣugbọn awọn aṣiwere ni yio ru itiju wọn.
entries.en: The wise shall inherit glory: but shame shall be the promotion of fools.

entries.yo: ENYIN ọmọ, ẹ gbọ́ ẹkọ́ baba, ki ẹ si fiyesi ati mọ̀ oye.
entries.en: Hear, ye children, the instruction of a father, and attend to know understanding.

entries.yo: Nitori ti mo fun nyin li ẹkọ rere, ẹ máṣe kọ̀ ofin mi silẹ.
entries.en: For I give you good doctrine, forsake ye not my law.

entries.yo: Nitoripe ọmọ baba mi li emi iṣe, ẹni-ikẹ́ ati olufẹ li oju iya mi.
entries.en: For I was my father's son, tender and only beloved in the sight of my mother.

entries.yo: On si kọ́ mi pẹlu, o si wi fun mi pe, jẹ ki aiya rẹ ki o gbà ọ̀rọ mi duro: pa ofin mi mọ́ ki iwọ ki o si yè.
entries.en: He taught me also, and said unto me, Let thine heart retain my words: keep my commandments, and live.

entries.yo: Ni ọgbọ́n, ni oye: máṣe gbagbe; bẹ̃ni ki iwọ ki o máṣe fà sẹhin kuro li ọ̀rọ ẹnu mi.
entries.en: Get wisdom, get understanding: forget it not; neither decline from the words of my mouth.

entries.yo: Máṣe kọ̀ ọ silẹ, yio si mu ọ tọ́: fẹ ẹ, yio si pa ọ mọ́.
entries.en: Forsake her not, and she shall preserve thee: love her, and she shall keep thee.

entries.yo: Ipilẹṣẹ ọgbọ́n ni lati ni ọgbọ́n: ati pẹlu ini rẹ gbogbo, ni oye.
entries.en: Wisdom is the principal thing; therefore get wisdom: and with all thy getting get understanding.

entries.yo: Gbé e ga, on o si ma gbé ọ lekè: on o mu ọ wá si ọlá, nigbati iwọ ba gbá a mọra.
entries.en: Exalt her, and she shall promote thee: she shall bring thee to honour, when thou dost embrace her.

entries.yo: On o fi ohun-ọṣọ́ daradara si ọ li ori: on o fi ọjá daradara fun ori rẹ.
entries.en: She shall give to thine head an ornament of grace: a crown of glory shall she deliver to thee.

entries.yo: Gbọ́, iwọ ọmọ mi, ki o si gbà ọ̀rọ mi; ọdun ẹmi rẹ yio si di pipọ.
entries.en: Hear, O my son, and receive my sayings; and the years of thy life shall be many.

entries.yo: Emi ti kọ́ ọ li ọ̀na ọgbọ́n; emi ti mu ọ tọ̀ ipa-ọ̀na titọ.
entries.en: I have taught thee in the way of wisdom; I have led thee in right paths.

entries.yo: Nigbati iwọ nrìn, ọ̀na rẹ kì yio há fun àye; nigbati iwọ nsare, iwọ kì yio fi ẹsẹ kọ.
entries.en: When thou goest, thy steps shall not be straitened; and when thou runnest, thou shalt not stumble.

entries.yo: Di ẹkọ́ mu ṣinṣin, máṣe jẹ ki o lọ; pa a mọ́, nitori on li ẹmi rẹ.
entries.en: Take fast hold of instruction; let her not go: keep her; for she is thy life.

entries.yo: Máṣe bọ si ipa-ọ̀na enia buburu, má si ṣe rìn li ọ̀na awọn enia ibi.
entries.en: Enter not into the path of the wicked, and go not in the way of evil men.

entries.yo: Yẹ̀ ẹ silẹ, máṣe kọja ninu rẹ̀, yẹ̀ kuro nibẹ, si ma ba tirẹ lọ.
entries.en: Avoid it, pass not by it, turn from it, and pass away.

entries.yo: Nitoriti nwọn kì isùn bikoṣepe nwọn hùwa buburu; orun wọn a si dá, bikoṣepe nwọn ba mu enia ṣubu.
entries.en: For they sleep not, except they have done mischief; and their sleep is taken away, unless they cause some to fall.

entries.yo: Nitori ti nwọn njẹ onjẹ ìwa-ika, nwọn si nmu ọti-waini ìwa-agbara.
entries.en: For they eat the bread of wickedness, and drink the wine of violence.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ipa-ọ̀na awọn olõtọ dabi titàn imọlẹ, ti o ntàn siwaju ati siwaju titi di ọsangangan.
entries.en: But the path of the just is as the shining light, that shineth more and more unto the perfect day.

entries.yo: Ọna awọn enia buburu dabi òkunkun: nwọn kò mọ̀ ohun ti nwọn ndugbolu.
entries.en: The way of the wicked is as darkness: they know not at what they stumble.

entries.yo: Ọmọ mi, fetisi ọ̀rọ mi; dẹti rẹ silẹ si ọ̀rọ mi.
entries.en: My son, attend to my words; incline thine ear unto my sayings.

entries.yo: Máṣe jẹ ki nwọn ki o lọ kuro li oju rẹ; pa wọn mọ́ li ãrin aiya rẹ.
entries.en: Let them not depart from thine eyes; keep them in the midst of thine heart.

entries.yo: Nitori ìye ni nwọn iṣe fun awọn ti o wá wọn ri, ati imularada si gbogbo ẹran-ara wọn.
entries.en: For they are life unto those that find them, and health to all their flesh.

entries.yo: Jù gbogbo ohun ipamọ́, pa aiya rẹ mọ́; nitoripe lati inu rẹ̀ wá ni orisun ìye.
entries.en: Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of life.

entries.yo: Mu arekereke kuro lọdọ rẹ, ati ète ẹ̀tan jina rére kuro lọdọ rẹ.
entries.en: Put away from thee a froward mouth, and perverse lips put far from thee.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki oju rẹ ki o ma wò ọkankan gan, ki ipenpeju rẹ ki o ma wò gan niwaju rẹ.
entries.en: Let thine eyes look right on, and let thine eyelids look straight before thee.

entries.yo: Ronu ipa-ọ̀na rẹ, gbogbo ọ̀na rẹ ni yio si fi idi mulẹ.
entries.en: Ponder the path of thy feet, and let all thy ways be established.

entries.yo: Máṣe yà si apa ọtun tabi si apa òsi, ṣi ẹsẹ rẹ kuro ninu ibi.
entries.en: Turn not to the right hand nor to the left: remove thy foot from evil.

entries.yo: ỌMỌ mi, fiyesi ọgbọ́n mi, ki o si dẹti rẹ si oye mi.
entries.en: My son, attend unto my wisdom, and bow thine ear to my understanding:

entries.yo: Lati ma pa ironu mọ́, ati ki ète rẹ ki o le ma pa ìmọ mọ́.
entries.en: That thou mayest regard discretion, and that thy lips may keep knowledge.

entries.yo: Nitori ti ète awọn ajeji obinrin a ma kán bi oyin, ẹnu rẹ̀ si kunna ju ororo lọ:
entries.en: For the lips of a strange woman drop as an honeycomb, and her mouth is smoother than oil:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn igbẹhin rẹ̀ koro bi idápa, o si mú bi idà olojumeji.
entries.en: But her end is bitter as wormwood, sharp as a twoedged sword.

entries.yo: Ẹsẹ rẹ̀ nsọkalẹ lọ sinu ikú, ìrin-ẹsẹ rẹ̀ de ipo-okú.
entries.en: Her feet go down to death; her steps take hold on hell.

entries.yo: Ki iwọ má ba ja ipa-ọ̀na ìye, ipa-ọ̀na rẹ̀ a ma yi sihin yi sọhun, on kò si mọ̀.
entries.en: Lest thou shouldest ponder the path of life, her ways are moveable, that thou canst not know them.

entries.yo: Njẹ gbọ́ temi nisisiyi, ẹnyin ọmọ, ki ẹnyin ki o máṣe yà kuro li ọ̀rọ ẹnu mi.
entries.en: Hear me now therefore, O ye children, and depart not from the words of my mouth.

entries.yo: Takete kuro lọdọ rẹ̀, má si ṣe sunmọ eti ilẹkun ile rẹ̀:
entries.en: Remove thy way far from her, and come not nigh the door of her house:

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o má ba fi ọlá rẹ fun ẹlomiran, ati ọdun rẹ fun ẹni-ìka;
entries.en: Lest thou give thine honour unto others, and thy years unto the cruel:

entries.yo: Ki a má ba fi ọrọ̀ rẹ fun ajeji enia; ki ère-iṣẹ ọwọ rẹ ki o má ba wà ni ile alejo.
entries.en: Lest strangers be filled with thy wealth; and thy labours be in the house of a stranger;

entries.yo: Iwọ a si ma kãnu ni ikẹhin rẹ̀, nigbati ẹran-ara ati ara rẹ ba parun.
entries.en: And thou mourn at the last, when thy flesh and thy body are consumed,

entries.yo: Iwọ a si wipe, emi ha ti korira ẹkọ́ to, ti aiya mi si gàn ìbawi:
entries.en: And say, How have I hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof;

entries.yo: Ti emi kò gbà ohùn awọn olukọ́ mi gbọ́, tabi ki emi dẹti mi silẹ si awọn ti nkọ́ mi.
entries.en: And have not obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor inclined mine ear to them that instructed me!

entries.yo: Emi fẹrẹ wà ninu ibi patapata larin awujọ, ati ni ijọ.
entries.en: I was almost in all evil in the midst of the congregation and assembly.

entries.yo: Mu omi lati inu kudu rẹ, ati omi ti nṣàn lati inu kanga rẹ.
entries.en: Drink waters out of thine own cistern, and running waters out of thine own well.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki isun rẹ ki o ṣàn kakiri, ati awọn odò omi ni ita.
entries.en: Let thy fountains be dispersed abroad, and rivers of waters in the streets.

entries.yo: Ki nwọn ki o jẹ kiki tirẹ, ki o má ṣe ti awọn ajeji pẹlu rẹ.
entries.en: Let them be only thine own, and not strangers' with thee.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki orisun rẹ ki o ni ibukun: ki iwọ ki o si ma yọ̀ tiwọ ti aya ìgba-èwe rẹ.
entries.en: Let thy fountain be blessed: and rejoice with the wife of thy youth.

entries.yo: Bi abo agbọnrin daradara ati abo igalà, jẹ ki ọmu rẹ̀ ki o ma fi ayọ̀ kún ọ nigbagbogbo; ki o si ma yọ̀ gidigidi ninu ifẹ rẹ̀ nigbakugba.
entries.en: Let her be as the loving hind and pleasant roe; let her breasts satisfy thee at all times; and be thou ravished always with her love.

entries.yo: Ọmọ mi, ẽṣe ti iwọ o fi ma yọ̀ ninu ifẹ ajeji obinrin, ti iwọ o fi gbá aiya ajeji obinrin mọra?
entries.en: And why wilt thou, my son, be ravished with a strange woman, and embrace the bosom of a stranger?

entries.yo: Nitoripe ọ̀na enia mbẹ niwaju Oluwa, o si nṣiwọ̀n irin wọn gbogbo.
entries.en: For the ways of man are before the eyes of the LORD, and he pondereth all his goings.

entries.yo: Ẹ̀ṣẹ ẹni-buburu ni yio mu ontikararẹ̀, okùn ẹ̀ṣẹ ara rẹ̀ yio si dì i mu.
entries.en: His own iniquities shall take the wicked himself, and he shall be holden with the cords of his sins.

entries.yo: Yio kú li aigbà ẹkọ́, ati ninu ọ̀pọlọpọ were rẹ̀ yio si ma ṣina kiri.
entries.en: He shall die without instruction; and in the greatness of his folly he shall go astray.

entries.yo: ỌMỌ mi, bi iwọ ba ṣe onigbọwọ fun ọrẹ́ rẹ, bi iwọ ba jẹ́ ẹ̀jẹ́ fun ajeji enia.
entries.en: My son, if thou be surety for thy friend, if thou hast stricken thy hand with a stranger,

entries.yo: Bi a ba fi ọ̀rọ ẹnu rẹ dẹkùn fun ọ, bi a ba fi ọ̀rọ ẹnu rẹ mu ọ.
entries.en: Thou art snared with the words of thy mouth, thou art taken with the words of thy mouth.

entries.yo: Njẹ, sa ṣe eyi, ọmọ mi, ki o si gbà ara rẹ silẹ nigbati iwọ ba bọ si ọwọ ọrẹ́ rẹ; lọ, rẹ ara rẹ silẹ, ki iwọ ki o si tù ọrẹ́ rẹ.
entries.en: Do this now, my son, deliver thyself, when thou art come into the hand of thy friend; go, humble thyself, and make sure thy friend.

entries.yo: Máṣe fi orun fun oju rẹ, tabi õgbe fun ipenpeju rẹ.
entries.en: Give not sleep to thine eyes, nor slumber to thine eyelids.

entries.yo: Gbà ara rẹ bi abo agbọnrin li ọwọ ọdẹ, ati bi ẹiyẹ li ọwọ apẹiyẹ.
entries.en: Deliver thyself as a roe from the hand of the hunter, and as a bird from the hand of the fowler.

entries.yo: Tọ ẽrùn lọ, iwọ ọlẹ: kiyesi iṣe rẹ̀ ki iwọ ki o si gbọ́n:
entries.en: Go to the ant, thou sluggard; consider her ways, and be wise:

entries.yo: Ti kò ni onidajọ, alabojuto, tabi alakoso.
entries.en: Which having no guide, overseer, or ruler,

entries.yo: Ti npese onjẹ rẹ̀ ni igba-ẹ̀run, ti o si nkó onjẹ rẹ̀ jọ ni ìgba ikore.
entries.en: Provideth her meat in the summer, and gathereth her food in the harvest.

entries.yo: Ọlẹ, iwọ o ti sùn pẹ to? nigbawo ni iwọ o dide kuro ninu orun rẹ?
entries.en: How long wilt thou sleep, O sluggard? when wilt thou arise out of thy sleep?

entries.yo: Orun diẹ si i, õgbe diẹ si i, ikawọkòpọ lati sùn diẹ:
entries.en: Yet a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni òṣi rẹ yio de bi ẹniti nrìn àjo, ati aini rẹ bi ọkunrin ti o hamọra ogun.
entries.en: So shall thy poverty come as one that travelleth, and thy want as an armed man.

entries.yo: Enia-kenia, ọkunrin buburu, ti o nrìn ti on ti ẹnu arekereke.
entries.en: A naughty person, a wicked man, walketh with a froward mouth.

entries.yo: O nṣẹju rẹ̀, o nfi ẹsẹ rẹ̀ sọ̀rọ, o nfi ika rẹ̀ ṣe ajuwe;
entries.en: He winketh with his eyes, he speaketh with his feet, he teacheth with his fingers;

entries.yo: Arekereke mbẹ li aiya rẹ̀, o humọ ìwa-ika nigbagbogbo; o ndá ija silẹ.
entries.en: Frowardness is in his heart, he deviseth mischief continually; he soweth discord.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni ipọnju rẹ̀ yio de si i lojiji; ojiji ni yio ṣẹ́ laini atunṣe.
entries.en: Therefore shall his calamity come suddenly; suddenly shall he be broken without remedy.

entries.yo: Ohun mẹfa li Oluwa korira: nitõtọ, meje li o ṣe irira fun ọkàn rẹ̀:
entries.en: These six things doth the LORD hate: yea, seven are an abomination unto him:

entries.yo: Oju igberaga, ète eke, ati ọwọ ti nta ẹ̀jẹ alaiṣẹ silẹ,
entries.en: A proud look, a lying tongue, and hands that shed innocent blood,

entries.yo: Aiya ti nhumọ buburu, ẹsẹ ti o yara ni ire sisa si ìwa-ika,
entries.en: An heart that deviseth wicked imaginations, feet that be swift in running to mischief,

entries.yo: Ẹlẹri eke ti nsọ eke jade, ati ẹniti ndá ìja silẹ larin awọn arakunrin.
entries.en: A false witness that speaketh lies, and he that soweth discord among brethren.

entries.yo: Ọmọ mi, pa aṣẹ baba rẹ mọ́, ki iwọ ki o má si ṣe kọ̀ ofin iya rẹ silẹ:
entries.en: My son, keep thy father's commandment, and forsake not the law of thy mother:

entries.yo: Dì wọn mọ aiya rẹ nigbagbogbo, ki iwọ ki o si so o mọ ọrùn rẹ.
entries.en: Bind them continually upon thine heart, and tie them about thy neck.

entries.yo: Nigbati iwọ ba nrìn, yio ma ṣe amọ̀na rẹ; nigbati iwọ ba sùn, yio ma ṣọ ọ; nigbati iwọ ba si ji, yio si ma ba ọ sọ̀rọ.
entries.en: When thou goest, it shall lead thee; when thou sleepest, it shall keep thee; and when thou awakest, it shall talk with thee.

entries.yo: Nitoripe aṣẹ ni fitila; ofin si ni imọlẹ; ati ibawi ẹkọ́ li ọ̀na ìye:
entries.en: For the commandment is a lamp; and the law is light; and reproofs of instruction are the way of life:

entries.yo: Lati pa ọ mọ́ kuro lọwọ obinrin buburu nì, lọwọ ahọn ìpọnni ajeji obinrin.
entries.en: To keep thee from the evil woman, from the flattery of the tongue of a strange woman.

entries.yo: Máṣe ifẹkufẹ li aiya rẹ si ẹwà rẹ̀; bẹ̃ni ki o má si ṣe jẹ ki on ki o fi ipenpeju rẹ̀ mu ọ.
entries.en: Lust not after her beauty in thine heart; neither let her take thee with her eyelids.

entries.yo: Nitoripe nipasẹ agbere obinrin li enia fi idi oniṣù-akara kan: ṣugbọn aya enia a ma wá iye rẹ̀ daradara.
entries.en: For by means of a whorish woman a man is brought to a piece of bread: and the adulteress will hunt for the precious life.

entries.yo: Ọkunrin le gbé iná lé aiya rẹ̀ ki aṣọ rẹ̀ ki o má jona?
entries.en: Can a man take fire in his bosom, and his clothes not be burned?

entries.yo: Ẹnikan ha le gun ori ẹyin-iná gbigbona, ki ẹsẹ rẹ̀ ki o má jona?
entries.en: Can one go upon hot coals, and his feet not be burned?

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li ẹniti o wọle tọ obinrin ẹnikeji rẹ̀ lọ; ẹnikẹni ti o fi ọwọ bà a, kì yio wà li ailẹṣẹ̀.
entries.en: So he that goeth in to his neighbour's wife; whosoever toucheth her shall not be innocent.

entries.yo: Nwọn ki igàn ole, bi o ba ṣe pe, o jale lati tẹ́ ọkàn rẹ̀ lọrùn, nigbati ebi npa a;
entries.en: Men do not despise a thief, if he steal to satisfy his soul when he is hungry;

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi a ba mu u, yio san a pada niwọ̀n meje; gbogbo ini ile rẹ̀ ni yio fi san ẹsan.
entries.en: But if he be found, he shall restore sevenfold; he shall give all the substance of his house.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹni ti o ba ba obinrin ṣe panṣaga, oye kù fun u: ẹniti o ba ṣe e yio pa ẹmi ara rẹ run.
entries.en: But whoso committeth adultery with a woman lacketh understanding: he that doeth it destroyeth his own soul.

entries.yo: Ọgbẹ ati àbuku ni yio ni; ẹ̀gan rẹ̀ kì yio si parẹ́ kuro.
entries.en: A wound and dishonour shall he get; and his reproach shall not be wiped away.

entries.yo: Nitori owú ni ibinu ọkunrin: nitorina kì yio dasi li ọjọ ẹsan.
entries.en: For jealousy is the rage of a man: therefore he will not spare in the day of vengeance.

entries.yo: On kì yio nani owo idande, bẹ̃ni inu rẹ̀ kì yio yọ́, bi iwọ tilẹ sọ ẹ̀bun di pipọ.
entries.en: He will not regard any ransom; neither will he rest content, though thou givest many gifts.

entries.yo: ỌMỌ mi, pa ọ̀rọ mi mọ́, ki o si fi ofin mi ṣe ìṣura ṣura pẹlu rẹ.
entries.en: My son, keep my words, and lay up my commandments with thee.

entries.yo: Pa ofin mi mọ́, ki iwọ ki o si yè; ati aṣẹ mi bi ọmọloju rẹ.
entries.en: Keep my commandments, and live; and my law as the apple of thine eye.

entries.yo: Dì wọn mọ ika rẹ, kọ wọn si wala aiya rẹ.
entries.en: Bind them upon thy fingers, write them upon the table of thine heart.

entries.yo: Wi fun ọgbọ́n pe, Iwọ li arabinrin mi; ki o si pe oye ni ibatan rẹ obinrin:
entries.en: Say unto wisdom, Thou art my sister; and call understanding thy kinswoman:

entries.yo: Ki nwọn ki o le pa ọ mọ́ kuro lọwọ obinrin ẹlomiran, lọwọ ajeji ti nfi ọ̀rọ rẹ̀ ṣe ipọnni.
entries.en: That they may keep thee from the strange woman, from the stranger which flattereth with her words.

entries.yo: Li oju ferese ile mi li emi sa bojuwò lãrin ferese mi.
entries.en: For at the window of my house I looked through my casement,

entries.yo: Mo si ri ninu awọn òpe, mo kiyesi ninu awọn ọmọkunrin, ọmọkunrin kan ti oye kù fun,
entries.en: And beheld among the simple ones, I discerned among the youths, a young man void of understanding,

entries.yo: O nkọja lọ ni igboro li eti igun ile rẹ̀; o si lọ si ọ̀na ile rẹ̀,
entries.en: Passing through the street near her corner; and he went the way to her house,

entries.yo: Ni wiriwiri imọlẹ, li aṣãlẹ, li oru dudu ati òkunkun:
entries.en: In the twilight, in the evening, in the black and dark night:

entries.yo: Si kiyesi i, obinrin kan pade rẹ̀, o wọ aṣọ panṣaga, alarekereke aiya.
entries.en: And, behold, there met him a woman with the attire of an harlot, and subtil of heart.

entries.yo: (O jẹ alariwo ati alagidi; ẹsẹ rẹ̀ kì iduro ni ile rẹ̀.
entries.en: (She is loud and stubborn; her feet abide not in her house:

entries.yo: Nisisiyi o jade, nisisiyi o wà ni igboro, o si mba ni ibi igun ile gbogbo.)
entries.en: Now is she without, now in the streets, and lieth in wait at every corner.)

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li o dì i mu, o si fẹnu kò o li ẹnu, o si fi ọ̀yájú wi fun u pe,
entries.en: So she caught him, and kissed him, and with an impudent face said unto him,

entries.yo: Ọrẹ́, alafia mbẹ lọwọ mi, loni ni mo ti san ẹjẹ́ mi.
entries.en: I have peace offerings with me; this day have I payed my vows.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni mo ṣe jade wá pade rẹ, lati ṣe afẹri oju rẹ, emi si ri ọ.
entries.en: Therefore came I forth to meet thee, diligently to seek thy face, and I have found thee.

entries.yo: Emi ti fi aṣọ titẹ ọlọnà tẹ́ akete mi, ọlọnà finfin ati aṣọ ọ̀gbọ daradara ti Egipti.
entries.en: I have decked my bed with coverings of tapestry, with carved works, with fine linen of Egypt.

entries.yo: Emi ti fi turari olõrùn didùn ti mirra, aloe, ati kinnamoni si akete mi.
entries.en: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.

entries.yo: Wá, jẹ ki a gbà ẹkún ifẹ wa titi yio fi di owurọ, jẹ ki a fi ifẹ tù ara wa lara.
entries.en: Come, let us take our fill of love until the morning: let us solace ourselves with loves.

entries.yo: Nitoripe bãle kò si ni ile, o re àjo ọ̀na jijin:
entries.en: For the goodman is not at home, he is gone a long journey:

entries.yo: O mu àsuwọn owo kan lọwọ rẹ̀, yio si de li oṣupa arànmọju.
entries.en: He hath taken a bag of money with him, and will come home at the day appointed.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ rẹ̀ daradara li o fi mu u fẹ, ipọnni ète rẹ̀ li o fi ṣẹ́ ẹ li apa.
entries.en: With her much fair speech she caused him to yield, with the flattering of her lips she forced him.

entries.yo: On si tọ̀ ọ lọ lẹsẹkanna bi malu ti nlọ si ibupa, tabi bi aṣiwere ti nlọ si ibi ọgbọ́n ìfabà kọ́.
entries.en: He goeth after her straightway, as an ox goeth to the slaughter, or as a fool to the correction of the stocks;

entries.yo: Titi ọfà fi gún u li ẹ̀dọ̀; bi ẹiyẹ ti nyara bọ sinu okùn, ti kò si mọ̀ pe fun ẹmi on ni.
entries.en: Till a dart strike through his liver; as a bird hasteth to the snare, and knoweth not that it is for his life.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, ẹnyin ọmọ, ẹ feti si temi, ki ẹ si fiye si ọ̀rọ ẹnu mi.
entries.en: Hearken unto me now therefore, O ye children, and attend to the words of my mouth.

entries.yo: Máṣe jẹ ki aiya rẹ̀ ki o tẹ̀ si ọ̀na rẹ̀, máṣe ṣina lọ si ipa-ọ̀na rẹ̀.
entries.en: Let not thine heart decline to her ways, go not astray in her paths.

entries.yo: Nitori ọ̀pọlọpọ enia li o ṣá lulẹ; nitõtọ ọ̀pọlọpọ alagbara enia li a ti ọwọ rẹ̀ pa.
entries.en: For she hath cast down many wounded: yea, many strong men have been slain by her.

entries.yo: Ile rẹ̀ li ọ̀na ọrun-apadi, ti nsọkalẹ lọ si iyẹwu ikú.
entries.en: Her house is the way to hell, going down to the chambers of death.

entries.yo: ỌGBỌ́N kò ha nkigbe bi? Oye kò ha gbé ohùn rẹ̀ soke bi?
entries.en: Doth not wisdom cry? and understanding put forth her voice?

entries.yo: O duro li ori ibi-giga wọnni, lẹba ọ̀na, nibi ipa-ọ̀na wọnni.
entries.en: She standeth in the top of high places, by the way in the places of the paths.

entries.yo: O nke li ẹnu-ọ̀na, ati ni ibode ilu, li atiwọ̀ oju ilẹkun.
entries.en: She crieth at the gates, at the entry of the city, at the coming in at the doors.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin enia li emi npè; ohùn mi si nkọ si awọn ọmọ enia.
entries.en: Unto you, O men, I call; and my voice is to the sons of man.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin òpe, ẹ mọ̀ ọgbọ́n: ati ẹnyin aṣiwere ki ẹnyin ki o ṣe alaiya oye.
entries.en: O ye simple, understand wisdom: and, ye fools, be ye of an understanding heart.

entries.yo: Ẹ gbọ́, nitori ti emi o sọ̀rọ ohun ti o dara, ati ṣiṣi ète mi yio sọ̀rọ ohun titọ.
entries.en: Hear; for I will speak of excellent things; and the opening of my lips shall be right things.

entries.yo: Nitori ti ẹnu mi yio sọ̀rọ otitọ; ìwa-buburu si ni irira fun ète mi.
entries.en: For my mouth shall speak truth; and wickedness is an abomination to my lips.

entries.yo: Ninu ododo ni gbogbo ọ̀rọ ẹnu mi; kò si ẹ̀tan kan tabi arekereke ninu wọn.
entries.en: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness; there is nothing froward or perverse in them.

entries.yo: Gbangba ni gbogbo wọn jasi fun ẹniti o yé, o si tọ́ fun awọn ti o nwá ìmọ ri.
entries.en: They are all plain to him that understandeth, and right to them that find knowledge.

entries.yo: Gbà ẹkọ mi, kì si iṣe fadaka; si gbà ìmọ jù wura àṣayan lọ.
entries.en: Receive my instruction, and not silver; and knowledge rather than choice gold.

entries.yo: Nitori ti ìmọ jù iyùn lọ; ohun gbogbo ti a le fẹ, kò si eyi ti a le fi we e.
entries.en: For wisdom is better than rubies; and all the things that may be desired are not to be compared to it.

entries.yo: Emi ọgbọ́n li o mba imoye gbe, emi ìmọ si ri imoye ironu.
entries.en: I wisdom dwell with prudence, and find out knowledge of witty inventions.

entries.yo: Ibẹ̀ru Oluwa ni ikorira ibi: irera, ati igberaga, ati ọ̀na ibi, ati ẹnu arekereke, ni mo korira.
entries.en: The fear of the LORD is to hate evil: pride, and arrogancy, and the evil way, and the froward mouth, do I hate.

entries.yo: Temi ni ìmọ ati ọgbọ́n ti o yè: emi li oye, emi li agbara.
entries.en: Counsel is mine, and sound wisdom: I am understanding; I have strength.

entries.yo: Nipasẹ mi li ọba nṣe akoso, ti awọn olori si nlàna otitọ.
entries.en: By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.

entries.yo: Nipasẹ mi li awọn ijoye nṣolori, ati awọn ọ̀lọtọ̀, ani gbogbo awọn onidajọ aiye.
entries.en: By me princes rule, and nobles, even all the judges of the earth.

entries.yo: Mo fẹ awọn ti o fẹ mi; awọn ti o si wá mi ni kutukutu yio ri mi.
entries.en: I love them that love me; and those that seek me early shall find me.

entries.yo: Ọrọ̀ ati ọlá mbẹ lọwọ mi, ani ọrọ̀ daradara ati ododo.
entries.en: Riches and honour are with me; yea, durable riches and righteousness.

entries.yo: Ere mi ta wura yọ; nitõtọ, jù wura daradara lọ: ati ọrọ̀ mi jù fadaka àṣayan lọ.
entries.en: My fruit is better than gold, yea, than fine gold; and my revenue than choice silver.

entries.yo: Emi nrìn li ọ̀na ododo, larin ipa-ọ̀na idajọ:
entries.en: I lead in the way of righteousness, in the midst of the paths of judgment:

entries.yo: Ki emi ki o le mu awọn ti o fẹ mi jogun ohun-ini mi, emi o si fi kún iṣura wọn.
entries.en: That I may cause those that love me to inherit substance; and I will fill their treasures.

entries.yo: Oluwa pèse mi ni ipilẹṣẹ ìwa rẹ̀, ṣaju iṣẹ rẹ̀ atijọ.
entries.en: The LORD possessed me in the beginning of his way, before his works of old.

entries.yo: A ti yàn mi lati aiyeraiye, lati ipilẹṣẹ, tabi ki aiye ki o to wà.
entries.en: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, or ever the earth was.

entries.yo: Nigbati ọgbun kò si, a ti bi mi; nigbati kò si orisun ti o kún fun omi pipọ.
entries.en: When there were no depths, I was brought forth; when there were no fountains abounding with water.

entries.yo: Ki a to fi idi awọn òke-nla sọlẹ, ṣãju awọn òke li a ti bi mi:
entries.en: Before the mountains were settled, before the hills was I brought forth:

entries.yo: Nigbati kò ti ida aiye, tabi pẹ̀tẹlẹ, tabi ori erupẹ aiye.
entries.en: While as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the highest part of the dust of the world.

entries.yo: Nigbati o nṣe ipilẹ awọn ọrun, emi wà nibẹ: nigbati o fi oṣuwọn ayika le oju ọgbun.
entries.en: When he prepared the heavens, I was there: when he set a compass upon the face of the depth:

entries.yo: Nigbati o sọ awọsanma lọjọ̀ soke: nigbati o fi agbara fun orisun ibu:
entries.en: When he established the clouds above: when he strengthened the fountains of the deep:

entries.yo: Nigbati o fi aṣẹ rẹ̀ fun okun, ki omi rẹ̀ ki o máṣe kọja ẹnu rẹ̀: ati ofin rẹ̀ fun ipilẹ aiye.
entries.en: When he gave to the sea his decree, that the waters should not pass his commandment: when he appointed the foundations of the earth:

entries.yo: Nigbana, emi wà lọdọ rẹ̀, bi oniṣẹ: emi si jẹ didùn-inu rẹ̀ lojojumọ, emi nyọ̀ nigbagbogbo niwaju rẹ̀;
entries.en: Then I was by him, as one brought up with him: and I was daily his delight, rejoicing always before him;

entries.yo: Emi nyọ̀ ni ibi-itẹdo aiye rẹ̀: didùn-inu mi si wà sipa awọn ọmọ enia.
entries.en: Rejoicing in the habitable part of his earth; and my delights were with the sons of men.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, ẹ fetisi temi, ẹnyin ọmọ: nitoripe ibukún ni fun awọn ti o tẹle ọ̀na mi:
entries.en: Now therefore hearken unto me, O ye children: for blessed are they that keep my ways.

entries.yo: Gbọ́ ẹkọ́, ki ẹnyin ki o si gbọ́n, má si ṣe jẹ ki o lọ.
entries.en: Hear instruction, and be wise, and refuse it not.

entries.yo: Ibukún ni fun ẹniti o gbọ́ temi, ti o nṣọ́ ẹnu-ọ̀na mi lojojumọ, ti o si nduro ti opó ẹnu-ilẹkun mi.
entries.en: Blessed is the man that heareth me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at the posts of my doors.

entries.yo: Nitoripe ẹniti o ri mi, o ri ìye, yio si ri ojurere Oluwa.
entries.en: For whoso findeth me findeth life, and shall obtain favour of the LORD.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹniti o ṣẹ̀ mi, o ṣe ọkàn ara rẹ̀ nikà: gbogbo awọn ti o korira mi, nwọn fẹ ikú.
entries.en: But he that sinneth against me wrongeth his own soul: all they that hate me love death.

entries.yo: ỌGBỌ́N ti kọ́ ile rẹ̀, o si gbẹ́ ọwọ̀n rẹ̀ meje:
entries.en: Wisdom hath builded her house, she hath hewn out her seven pillars:

entries.yo: O ti pa ẹran rẹ̀; o ti ṣe àdalu ọti-waini rẹ̀; o si ti tẹ́ tabili rẹ̀.
entries.en: She hath killed her beasts; she hath mingled her wine; she hath also furnished her table.

entries.yo: O ti ran awọn ọmọbinrin rẹ̀ jade, o nke lori ibi giga ilu, pe,
entries.en: She hath sent forth her maidens: she crieth upon the highest places of the city,

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni ti o ṣe òpe ki o yà si ihin: fun ẹniti oye kù fun, o wipe,
entries.en: Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither: as for him that wanteth understanding, she saith to him,

entries.yo: Wá, jẹ ninu onjẹ mi, ki o si mu ninu ọti-waini mi ti mo dàlu.
entries.en: Come, eat of my bread, and drink of the wine which I have mingled.

entries.yo: Kọ̀ iwere silẹ ki o si yè; ki o si ma rìn li ọ̀na oye.
entries.en: Forsake the foolish, and live; and go in the way of understanding.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba ba ẹlẹgàn wi, yio gba itiju fun ara rẹ̀, ati ẹniti o ba ba enia buburu wi yio gbà àbuku rẹ̀.
entries.en: He that reproveth a scorner getteth to himself shame: and he that rebuketh a wicked man getteth himself a blot.

entries.yo: Máṣe ba ẹlẹgàn wi, ki o má ba korira rẹ, ba ọlọgbọ́n enia wi, yio si ma fẹ ọ.
entries.en: Reprove not a scorner, lest he hate thee: rebuke a wise man, and he will love thee.

entries.yo: Fi ẹkọ́ fun ọlọgbọ́n enia, yio si ma gbọ́n siwaju, kọ́ enia olõtọ, yio si ma fẹ ọ.
entries.en: Give instruction to a wise man, and he will be yet wiser: teach a just man, and he will increase in learning.

entries.yo: Ibẹ̀ru Oluwa ni ipilẹṣẹ ọgbọ́n: ati ìmọ Ẹni-Mimọ́ li oye.
entries.en: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom: and the knowledge of the holy is understanding.

entries.yo: Nitori nipasẹ mi li ọjọ rẹ yio ma lé si i, ati ọdun ìye rẹ yio si ma lé si i.
entries.en: For by me thy days shall be multiplied, and the years of thy life shall be increased.

entries.yo: Bi iwọ ba gbọ́n, iwọ o gbọ́n fun ara rẹ: ṣugbọn bi iwọ ba iṣe ẹlẹgàn, iwọ nikan ni yio rù u.
entries.en: If thou be wise, thou shalt be wise for thyself: but if thou scornest, thou alone shalt bear it.

entries.yo: Alaroye li aṣiwere obinrin: òpe ni kò si mọ̀ nkan.
entries.en: A foolish woman is clamourous: she is simple, and knoweth nothing.

entries.yo: O sa joko li ẹnu-ọ̀na ile rẹ̀, lori apoti, ni ibi giga ilu.
entries.en: For she sitteth at the door of her house, on a seat in the high places of the city,

entries.yo: Lati ma pè awọn ti nkọja nibẹ, ti nrìn ọ̀na ganran wọn lọ: pe,
entries.en: To call passengers who go right on their ways:

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni ti o ba ṣe òpe, ki o yà si ìhin: ẹniti oye kù fun, o wi fun u pe,
entries.en: Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither: and as for him that wanteth understanding, she saith to him,

entries.yo: Omi ole dùn, ati onjẹ ikọkọ si ṣe didùn.
entries.en: Stolen waters are sweet, and bread eaten in secret is pleasant.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn on kò mọ̀ pe awọn okú wà nibẹ: ati pe awọn alapejẹ rẹ̀ wà ni isalẹ ọrun-apadi.
entries.en: But he knoweth not that the dead are there; and that her guests are in the depths of hell.

entries.yo: OWE Solomoni ni wọnyi. Ọlọgbọ́n ọmọ ṣe inu-didùn baba rẹ̀, ṣugbọn aṣiwere ọmọ ni ibanujẹ iya rẹ̀.
entries.en: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son maketh a glad father: but a foolish son is the heaviness of his mother.

entries.yo: Iṣura ìwa-buburu kò li ère: ṣugbọn ododo ni igbani kuro lọwọ ikú.
entries.en: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing: but righteousness delivereth from death.

entries.yo: Oluwa kì yio jẹ ki ebi ki o pa ọkàn olododo; ṣugbọn o yi ifẹ awọn enia buburu danu.
entries.en: The LORD will not suffer the soul of the righteous to famish: but he casteth away the substance of the wicked.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba dẹ̀ ọwọ a di talaka; ṣugbọn ọwọ awọn alãpọn ni imu ọlà wá.
entries.en: He becometh poor that dealeth with a slack hand: but the hand of the diligent maketh rich.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba kojọ ni igba-ẹ̀run li ọlọgbọ́n ọmọ: ṣugbọn ẹniti o ba nsùn ni igba ikore li ọmọ ti idoju tì ni.
entries.en: He that gathereth in summer is a wise son: but he that sleepeth in harvest is a son that causeth shame.

entries.yo: Ibukún wà li ori olododo: ṣugbọn ìwa-agbara ni yio bo ẹnu enia buburu.
entries.en: Blessings are upon the head of the just: but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.

entries.yo: Ibukún ni iranti olõtọ: ṣugbọn orukọ enia buburu yio rà.
entries.en: The memory of the just is blessed: but the name of the wicked shall rot.

entries.yo: Ọlọgbọ́n inu ni yio gbà ofin: ṣugbọn ete werewere li a o parun.
entries.en: The wise in heart will receive commandments: but a prating fool shall fall.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o nrìn dede, o rìn dajudaju: ṣugbọn ẹniti o ba nṣe ayida ọ̀na rẹ̀, on li a o mọ̀.
entries.en: He that walketh uprightly walketh surely: but he that perverteth his ways shall be known.

entries.yo: Ẹniti nṣẹ́ oju o mu ibanujẹ wá: ṣugbọn ète werewere li a o parun.
entries.en: He that winketh with the eye causeth sorrow: but a prating fool shall fall.

entries.yo: Kanga ìye li ẹnu olododo: ṣugbọn ìwa-agbara ni yio bo ẹnu enia buburu.
entries.en: The mouth of a righteous man is a well of life: but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.

entries.yo: Irira ni irú ìja soke: ṣugbọn ifẹ bò gbogbo ẹ̀ṣẹ mọlẹ.
entries.en: Hatred stirreth up strifes: but love covereth all sins.

entries.yo: Li ète ẹniti o moye li a ri ọgbọ́n: ṣugbọn kùmọ ni fun ẹhin ẹniti oye kù fun.
entries.en: In the lips of him that hath understanding wisdom is found: but a rod is for the back of him that is void of understanding.

entries.yo: Awọn ọlọgbọ́n a ma to ìmọ jọ: ṣugbọn ẹnu awọn aṣiwere sunmọ iparun.
entries.en: Wise men lay up knowledge: but the mouth of the foolish is near destruction.

entries.yo: Ọrọ̀ ọlọlà ni agbára rẹ̀: aini awọn talaka ni iparun wọn.
entries.en: The rich man's wealth is his strong city: the destruction of the poor is their poverty.

entries.yo: Iṣẹ olododo tẹ̀ si ìye; èro awọn enia buburu si ẹ̀ṣẹ.
entries.en: The labour of the righteous tendeth to life: the fruit of the wicked to sin.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba pa ẹkọ́ mọ́, o wà ni ipa-ọ̀na ìye; ṣugbọn ẹniti o ba kọ̀ ibawi o ṣìna.
entries.en: He is in the way of life that keepeth instruction: but he that refuseth reproof erreth.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba pa ikorira mọ́ li ète eke, ati ẹniti o ba ngba ọ̀rọ-ẹ̀hin, aṣiwere ni.
entries.en: He that hideth hatred with lying lips, and he that uttereth a slander, is a fool.

entries.yo: Ninu ọ̀rọ pipọ, a kò le ifẹ ẹ̀ṣẹ kù: ṣugbọn ẹniti o fi ète mọ ète li o gbọ́n.
entries.en: In the multitude of words there wanteth not sin: but he that refraineth his lips is wise.

entries.yo: Ahọn olõtọ dabi ãyo fadaka: aiya enia buburu kò ni iye lori.
entries.en: The tongue of the just is as choice silver: the heart of the wicked is little worth.

entries.yo: Ete olododo mbọ́ ọ̀pọlọpọ enia: ṣugbọn awọn aṣiwere yio kú li ailọgbọ́n.
entries.en: The lips of the righteous feed many: but fools die for want of wisdom.

entries.yo: Ibukún Oluwa ni imu ni ilà, kì isi ifi lãla pẹlu rẹ̀.
entries.en: The blessing of the LORD, it maketh rich, and he addeth no sorrow with it.

entries.yo: Bi ẹrín ni fun aṣiwere lati hu ìwa-ika: ṣugbọn ọlọgbọ́n li ẹni oye.
entries.en: It is as sport to a fool to do mischief: but a man of understanding hath wisdom.

entries.yo: Ibẹ̀ru enia buburu mbọwá ba a: ṣugbọn ifẹ olododo li a o fi fun u.
entries.en: The fear of the wicked, it shall come upon him: but the desire of the righteous shall be granted.

entries.yo: Bi ìji ti ijà rekọja: bẹ̃li enia buburu kì yio si mọ: ṣugbọn olododo ni ipilẹ ainipẹkun.
entries.en: As the whirlwind passeth, so is the wicked no more: but the righteous is an everlasting foundation.

entries.yo: Bi ọti kikan si ehin, ati bi ẽfin si oju, bẹ̃li ọlẹ si ẹniti o rán a ni iṣẹ.
entries.en: As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, so is the sluggard to them that send him.

entries.yo: Ibẹ̀ru Oluwa mu ọjọ gùn: ṣugbọn ọdun enia buburu li a o ṣẹ́ kuru.
entries.en: The fear of the LORD prolongeth days: but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.

entries.yo: Abá olododo ayọ̀ ni yio jasi: ṣugbọn ireti enia buburu ni yio ṣegbe.
entries.en: The hope of the righteous shall be gladness: but the expectation of the wicked shall perish.

entries.yo: Ọ̀na Oluwa jẹ́ ãbò fun ẹni iduroṣinṣin, ṣugbọn egbe ni fun awọn oniṣẹ-ẹ̀ṣẹ.
entries.en: The way of the LORD is strength to the upright: but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity.

entries.yo: A kì yio ṣi olododo ni ipo lai; ṣugbọn enia buburu kì yio gbe ilẹ̀-aiye.
entries.en: The righteous shall never be removed: but the wicked shall not inhabit the earth.

entries.yo: Ẹnu olõtọ mu ọgbọ́n jade; ṣugbọn ahọn arekereke li a o ke kuro.
entries.en: The mouth of the just bringeth forth wisdom: but the froward tongue shall be cut out.

entries.yo: Ete olododo mọ̀ ohun itẹwọgba; ṣugbọn ẹnu enia buburu nsọ̀rọ arekereke.
entries.en: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable: but the mouth of the wicked speaketh frowardness.

entries.yo: OṢUWỌN eke irira ni loju Oluwa; ṣugbọn òṣuwọn otitọ ni didùn inu rẹ̀.
entries.en: A false balance is abomination to the LORD: but a just weight is his delight.

entries.yo: Bi igberaga ba de, nigbana ni itiju de, ṣugbọn ọgbọ́n wà pẹlu onirẹlẹ.
entries.en: When pride cometh, then cometh shame: but with the lowly is wisdom.

entries.yo: Otitọ aduro-ṣinṣin ni yio ma tọ́ wọn; ṣugbọn arekereke awọn olurekọja ni yio pa wọn run.
entries.en: The integrity of the upright shall guide them: but the perverseness of transgressors shall destroy them.

entries.yo: Ọrọ̀ kì ini anfani li ọjọ ibinu: ṣugbọn ododo ni igbani lọwọ ikú.
entries.en: Riches profit not in the day of wrath: but righteousness delivereth from death.

entries.yo: Ododo ẹni-pipé yio ma tọ́ ọ̀na rẹ̀: ṣugbọn enia buburu yio ṣubu ninu ìwa-buburu rẹ̀.
entries.en: The righteousness of the perfect shall direct his way: but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.

entries.yo: Ododo awọn aduro-ṣinṣin yio gbà wọn là: ṣugbọn awọn olurekọja li a o mu ninu iṣekuṣe wọn:
entries.en: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them: but transgressors shall be taken in their own naughtiness.

entries.yo: Nigbati enia buburu ba kú, ireti rẹ̀ a dasan, ireti awọn alaiṣedede enia a si dasan.
entries.en: When a wicked man dieth, his expectation shall perish: and the hope of unjust men perisheth.

entries.yo: A yọ olododo kuro ninu iyọnu, enia buburu a si bọ si ipò rẹ̀.
entries.en: The righteous is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked cometh in his stead.

entries.yo: Ẹnu li agabagebe ifi pa aladugbo rẹ̀: ṣugbọn ìmọ li a o fi gbà awọn olododo silẹ.
entries.en: An hypocrite with his mouth destroyeth his neighbour: but through knowledge shall the just be delivered.

entries.yo: Nigbati o ba nṣe rere fun olododo, ilu a yọ̀: nigbati enia buburu ba ṣegbe, igbe-ayọ̀ a ta.
entries.en: When it goeth well with the righteous, the city rejoiceth: and when the wicked perish, there is shouting.

entries.yo: Nipa ibukún aduro-ṣinṣin ilu a gbé lèke: ṣugbọn a bì i ṣubu nipa ẹnu enia buburu.
entries.en: By the blessing of the upright the city is exalted: but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.

entries.yo: Ẹniti oye kù fun gàn ọmọnikeji rẹ̀; ṣugbọn ẹni oye a pa ẹnu rẹ̀ mọ́.
entries.en: He that is void of wisdom despiseth his neighbour: but a man of understanding holdeth his peace.

entries.yo: Ẹniti nṣofofo fi ọ̀ran ipamọ́ hàn; ṣugbọn ẹniti nṣe olõtọ-ọkàn a pa ọ̀rọ na mọ́.
entries.en: A talebearer revealeth secrets: but he that is of a faithful spirit concealeth the matter.

entries.yo: Nibiti ìgbimọ kò si, awọn enia a ṣubu; ṣugbọn ninu ọ̀pọlọpọ ìgbimọ ni ailewu.
entries.en: Where no counsel is, the people fall: but in the multitude of counsellers there is safety.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba ṣe onigbọwọ fun alejo, ni yio ri iyọnu; ẹniti o ba si korira iṣegbọwọ wà lailewu.
