entries.en: He that is surety for a stranger shall smart for it: and he that hateth suretiship is sure.

entries.yo: Obinrin olore-ọfẹ gbà iyìn: bi alagbara enia ti igbà ọrọ̀.
entries.en: A gracious woman retaineth honour: and strong men retain riches.

entries.yo: Alãnu enia ṣe rere fun ara rẹ̀: ṣugbọn ìka-enia nyọ ẹran-ara rẹ̀ li ẹnu.
entries.en: The merciful man doeth good to his own soul: but he that is cruel troubleth his own flesh.

entries.yo: Enia buburu nṣiṣẹ ère-ẹ̀tan; ṣugbọn ẹniti ngbin ododo ni ère otitọ wà fun.
entries.en: The wicked worketh a deceitful work: but to him that soweth righteousness shall be a sure reward.

entries.yo: Bi ẹniti o duro ninu ododo ti ini ìye, bẹ̃ni ẹniti nlepa ibi, o nle e si ikú ara rẹ̀.
entries.en: As righteousness tendeth to life: so he that pursueth evil pursueth it to his own death.

entries.yo: Awọn ti iṣe alarekereke aiya, irira ni loju Oluwa; ṣugbọn inu rẹ̀ dùn si awọn aduroṣinṣin:
entries.en: They that are of a froward heart are abomination to the LORD: but such as are upright in their way are his delight.

entries.yo: Bi a tilẹ fi ọwọ so ọwọ, enia buburu kì yio lọ laijiya, ṣugbọn iru-ọmọ olododo li a o gbàla.
entries.en: Though hand join in hand, the wicked shall not be unpunished: but the seed of the righteous shall be delivered.

entries.yo: Bi oruka wura ni imu ẹlẹdẹ bẹ̃ni arẹwà obinrin ti kò moye.
entries.en: As a jewel of gold in a swine's snout, so is a fair woman which is without discretion.

entries.yo: Kiki rere ni ifẹ inu awọn olododo; ṣugbọn ibinu ni ireti awọn enia buburu.
entries.en: The desire of the righteous is only good: but the expectation of the wicked is wrath.

entries.yo: Ẹnikan wà ti ntuka, sibẹ o mbi si i, ẹnikan si wà ti nhawọ jù bi o ti yẹ lọ, ṣugbọn kiki si aini ni.
entries.en: There is that scattereth, and yet increaseth; and there is that withholdeth more than is meet, but it tendeth to poverty.

entries.yo: Ọkàn iṣore li a o mu sànra; ẹniti o mbomirin ni, ontikararẹ̀ li a o si bomirin pẹlu.
entries.en: The liberal soul shall be made fat: and he that watereth shall be watered also himself.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba dawọ ọkà duro, on li enia o fibu: ṣugbọn ibukún yio wà li ori ẹniti o tà a.
entries.en: He that withholdeth corn, the people shall curse him: but blessing shall be upon the head of him that selleth it.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o fi ara balẹ wá rere, a ri oju-rere: ṣugbọn ẹniti o nwá ibi kiri, o mbọ̀wá ba a.
entries.en: He that diligently seeketh good procureth favour: but he that seeketh mischief, it shall come unto him.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba gbẹkẹle ọrọ̀ rẹ̀ yio ṣubu: ṣugbọn olododo yio ma gbà bi ẹka igi.
entries.en: He that trusteth in his riches shall fall: but the righteous shall flourish as a branch.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba yọ ile ara rẹ̀ li ẹnu yio jogun ofo: aṣiwere ni yio ma ṣe iranṣẹ fun ọlọgbọ́n aiya.
entries.en: He that troubleth his own house shall inherit the wind: and the fool shall be servant to the wise of heart.

entries.yo: Eso ododo ni igi ìye; ẹniti o ba si yi ọkàn enia pada, ọlọgbọ́n ni.
entries.en: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life; and he that winneth souls is wise.

entries.yo: Kiye si i a o san a fun olododo li aiye: melomelo li enia buburu ati ẹ̀lẹṣẹ.
entries.en: Behold, the righteous shall be recompensed in the earth: much more the wicked and the sinner.

entries.yo: ẸNIKẸNI ti o fẹ ẹkọ́, o fẹ ìmọ: ṣugbọn ẹniti o korira ibawi, ẹranko ni.
entries.en: Whoso loveth instruction loveth knowledge: but he that hateth reproof is brutish.

entries.yo: Enia rere ni ojurere lọdọ Oluwa: ṣugbọn enia ete buburu ni yio dalẹbi.
entries.en: A good man obtaineth favour of the LORD: but a man of wicked devices will he condemn.

entries.yo: A kì yio fi ẹsẹ enia mulẹ nipa ìwa-buburu: ṣugbọn gbòngbo olododo kì yio fatu.
entries.en: A man shall not be established by wickedness: but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.

entries.yo: Obinrin oniwa-rere li ade ọkọ rẹ̀: ṣugbọn eyi ti ndojuti ni dabi ọyún ninu egungun rẹ̀.
entries.en: A virtuous woman is a crown to her husband: but she that maketh ashamed is as rottenness in his bones.

entries.yo: Ìro olododo tọ́: ṣugbọn ìgbimọ awọn enia buburu, ẹ̀tan ni.
entries.en: The thoughts of the righteous are right: but the counsels of the wicked are deceit.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ enia buburu ni lati luba fun ẹ̀jẹ: ṣugbọn ẹnu aduro-ṣinsin ni yio gbà wọn silẹ.
entries.en: The words of the wicked are to lie in wait for blood: but the mouth of the upright shall deliver them.

entries.yo: A bì enia buburu ṣubu, nwọn kò si si: ṣugbọn ile olododo ni yio duro.
entries.en: The wicked are overthrown, and are not: but the house of the righteous shall stand.

entries.yo: A o yìn enia gẹgẹ bi ọgbọ́n rẹ̀: ṣugbọn ẹni alayidayida aiya li a o gàn.
entries.en: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom: but he that is of a perverse heart shall be despised.

entries.yo: Ẹniti a ngàn, ti o si ni ọmọ-ọdọ, o san jù ẹ̀niti nyìn ara rẹ̀ ti kò si ni onjẹ.
entries.en: He that is despised, and hath a servant, is better than he that honoureth himself, and lacketh bread.

entries.yo: Olododo enia mọ̀ ãjo ẹmi ẹran rẹ̀: ṣugbọn iyọ́nu awọn enia buburu, ìka ni.
entries.en: A righteous man regardeth the life of his beast: but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ro ilẹ rẹ̀ li a o fi onjẹ tẹlọrun: ṣugbọn ẹniti ntọ̀ enia-lasan lẹhin ni oye kù fun.
entries.en: He that tilleth his land shall be satisfied with bread: but he that followeth vain persons is void of understanding.

entries.yo: Enia buburu fẹ ilu-odi awọn enia buburu: ṣugbọn gbòngbo olododo so eso.
entries.en: The wicked desireth the net of evil men: but the root of the righteous yieldeth fruit.

entries.yo: Irekọja ète enia buburu li a fi idẹkùn rẹ̀: ṣugbọn olododo yio yọ kuro ninu ipọnju.
entries.en: The wicked is snared by the transgression of his lips: but the just shall come out of trouble.

entries.yo: Nipa ère ẹnu enia li a o fi ohun rere tẹ ẹ lọrun: ère-iṣẹ ọwọ enia li a o si san fun u.
entries.en: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth: and the recompence of a man's hands shall be rendered unto him.

entries.yo: Ọ̀na aṣiwere tọ li oju ara rẹ̀: ṣugbọn ẹniti o fetisi ìgbimọ li ọlọgbọ́n.
entries.en: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes: but he that hearkeneth unto counsel is wise.

entries.yo: Ibinu aṣiwere kò pẹ imọ̀: ṣugbọn amoye enia bò itiju mọlẹ.
entries.en: A fool's wrath is presently known: but a prudent man covereth shame.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o sọ otitọ, o fi ododo hàn jade; ṣugbọn ẹlẹri eke, ẹ̀tan.
entries.en: He that speaketh truth sheweth forth righteousness: but a false witness deceit.

entries.yo: Awọn kan mbẹ ti nyara sọ̀rọ lasan bi igunni idà; ṣugbọn ahọn ọlọgbọ́n, ilera ni.
entries.en: There is that speaketh like the piercings of a sword: but the tongue of the wise is health.

entries.yo: Ete otitọ li a o mu duro lailai; ṣugbọn ahọn eke, ìgba diẹ ni.
entries.en: The lip of truth shall be established for ever: but a lying tongue is but for a moment.

entries.yo: Ẹtan wà li aiya awọn ti nrò ibi: ṣugbọn fun awọn ìgbimọ alafia, ayọ̀ ni.
entries.en: Deceit is in the heart of them that imagine evil: but to the counsellers of peace is joy.

entries.yo: Kò si ibi kan ti yio ba olododo; ṣugbọn awọn enia buburu ni yio kún fun ibi.
entries.en: There shall no evil happen to the just: but the wicked shall be filled with mischief.

entries.yo: Irira loju Oluwa li ahọn eke; ṣugbọn awọn ti nṣe rere ni didùn-inu rẹ̀.
entries.en: Lying lips are abomination to the LORD: but they that deal truly are his delight.

entries.yo: Ọlọgbọ́n enia pa ìmọ mọ; ṣugbọn aiya awọn aṣiwere nkede iwere.
entries.en: A prudent man concealeth knowledge: but the heart of fools proclaimeth foolishness.

entries.yo: Ọwọ alãpọn ni yio ṣe akoso; ṣugbọn ọlẹ ni yio wà labẹ irú-sisìn.
entries.en: The hand of the diligent shall bear rule: but the slothful shall be under tribute.

entries.yo: Ibinujẹ li aiya enia ni idori rẹ̀ kọ odò; ṣugbọn ọ̀rọ rere ni imu u yọ̀.
entries.en: Heaviness in the heart of man maketh it stoop: but a good word maketh it glad.

entries.yo: Olododo tọ́ aladugbo rẹ̀ si ọ̀na; ṣugbọn ọ̀na awọn enia buburu tàn wọn jẹ.
entries.en: The righteous is more excellent than his neighbour: but the way of the wicked seduceth them.

entries.yo: Ọlẹ enia kò mu ohun ọdẹ rẹ̀; ṣugbọn lati jẹ alãpọn enia, ọrọ̀ iyebiye ni.
entries.en: The slothful man roasteth not that which he took in hunting: but the substance of a diligent man is precious.

entries.yo: Li ọ̀na olododo ni ìye; ikú kò si loju ọ̀na otitọ.
entries.en: In the way of righteousness is life; and in the pathway thereof there is no death.

entries.yo: ỌLỌGBỌ́N ọmọ gbà ẹkọ́ baba rẹ̀; ṣugbọn ẹlẹgàn kò gbọ́ ibawi.
entries.en: A wise son heareth his father's instruction: but a scorner heareth not rebuke.

entries.yo: Enia yio jẹ rere nipa ère ẹnu rẹ̀; ṣugbọn ifẹ ọkàn awọn olurekọja ni ìwa-agbara.
entries.en: A man shall eat good by the fruit of his mouth: but the soul of the transgressors shall eat violence.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o pa ẹnu rẹ̀ mọ́, o pa ẹmi rẹ̀ mọ́; ṣugbọn ẹniti o ṣi ète rẹ̀ pupọ yio ni iparun.
entries.en: He that keepeth his mouth keepeth his life: but he that openeth wide his lips shall have destruction.

entries.yo: Ọkàn ọlẹ nfẹ, kò si ri nkan; ṣugbọn ọkàn awọn alãpọn li a o mu sanra.
entries.en: The soul of the sluggard desireth, and hath nothing: but the soul of the diligent shall be made fat.

entries.yo: Olododo korira ẹ̀tan; ṣugbọn enia buburu mu ni hu ìwa irira on itiju.
entries.en: A righteous man hateth lying: but a wicked man is loathsome, and cometh to shame.

entries.yo: Ododo pa aduro-ṣinṣin li ọ̀na mọ́; ṣugbọn ìwa-buburu ni imuni ṣubu sinu ẹ̀ṣẹ.
entries.en: Righteousness keepeth him that is upright in the way: but wickedness overthroweth the sinner.

entries.yo: Ẹnikan wà ti o nfi ara rẹ̀ ṣe ọlọrọ̀, ṣugbọn kò ni nkan; ẹnikan wà ti o nfi ara rẹ̀ ṣe talaka ṣugbọn o li ọrọ̀ pupọ.
entries.en: There is that maketh himself rich, yet hath nothing: there is that maketh himself poor, yet hath great riches.

entries.yo: Irapada ẹmi enia li ọrọ̀ rẹ̀; ṣugbọn olupọnju kò kiyesi ibawi.
entries.en: The ransom of a man's life are his riches: but the poor heareth not rebuke.

entries.yo: Imọlẹ olododo nfi ayọ̀ jó; ṣugbọn fitila enia buburu li a o pa.
entries.en: The light of the righteous rejoiceth: but the lamp of the wicked shall be put out.

entries.yo: Nipa kiki igberaga ni ìja ti iwá; ṣugbọn lọdọ awọn ti a fi ìmọ hàn li ọgbọ́n wà.
entries.en: Only by pride cometh contention: but with the well advised is wisdom.

entries.yo: Ọrọ̀ ti a fi ìwa-asan ni yio fàsẹhin; ṣugbọn ẹniti o fi iṣẹ-ọwọ kojọ ni yio ma pọ̀ si i.
entries.en: Wealth gotten by vanity shall be diminished: but he that gathereth by labour shall increase.

entries.yo: Ireti pipẹ mu ọkàn ṣàisan; ṣugbọn nigbati ifẹ ba de, igi ìye ni.
entries.en: Hope deferred maketh the heart sick: but when the desire cometh, it is a tree of life.

entries.yo: Ẹnikan ti o ba gàn ọ̀rọ na li a o parun: ṣugbọn ẹniti o bẹ̀ru ofin na, li a o san pada fun.
entries.en: Whoso despiseth the word shall be destroyed: but he that feareth the commandment shall be rewarded.

entries.yo: Ofin ọlọgbọ́n li orisun ìye, lati kuro ninu okùn ikú.
entries.en: The law of the wise is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.

entries.yo: Oye rere fi ojurere fun ni; ṣugbọn ọ̀na awọn olurekọja ṣoro.
entries.en: Good understanding giveth favour: but the way of transgressors is hard.

entries.yo: Gbogbo amoye enia ni nfi ìmọ ṣiṣẹ; ṣugbọn aṣiwere tan were rẹ̀ kalẹ.
entries.en: Every prudent man dealeth with knowledge: but a fool layeth open his folly.

entries.yo: Oniṣẹ buburu bọ́ sinu ipọnju; ṣugbọn olõtọ ikọ̀ mu ilera wá.
entries.en: A wicked messenger falleth into mischief: but a faithful ambassador is health.

entries.yo: Oṣi ati itiju ni fun ẹniti o kọ̀ ẹkọ́; ṣugbọn ẹniti o ba fetisi ibawi li a o bu ọlá fun.
entries.en: Poverty and shame shall be to him that refuseth instruction: but he that regardeth reproof shall be honoured.

entries.yo: Ifẹ ti a muṣẹ dùnmọ ọkàn; ṣugbọn irira ni fun aṣiwere lati kuro ninu ibi.
entries.en: The desire accomplished is sweet to the soul: but it is abomination to fools to depart from evil.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o mba ọlọgbọ́n rìn yio gbọ́n; ṣugbọn ẹgbẹ awọn aṣiwere ni yio ṣegbe.
entries.en: He that walketh with wise men shall be wise: but a companion of fools shall be destroyed.

entries.yo: Ibi nlepa awọn ẹlẹṣẹ̀; ṣugbọn fun awọn olododo, rere li a o ma fi san a.
entries.en: Evil pursueth sinners: but to the righteous good shall be repayed.

entries.yo: Enia rere fi ogún silẹ fun awọn ọmọ ọmọ rẹ̀; ṣugbọn ọrọ̀ ẹlẹṣẹ̀ li a tò jọ fun olododo,
entries.en: A good man leaveth an inheritance to his children's children: and the wealth of the sinner is laid up for the just.

entries.yo: Onjẹ pupọ li o wà ni ilẹ titun awọn talaka; ṣugbọn awọn kan wà ti a nparun nitori aini idajọ;
entries.en: Much food is in the tillage of the poor: but there is that is destroyed for want of judgment.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba fà ọwọ paṣan sẹhin, o korira ọmọ rẹ̀; ṣugbọn ẹniti o fẹ ẹ a ma tète nà a.
entries.en: He that spareth his rod hateth his son: but he that loveth him chasteneth him betimes.

entries.yo: Olododo jẹ to itẹrun ọkàn rẹ̀; ṣugbọn inu awọn enia buburu ni yio ṣe alaini.
entries.en: The righteous eateth to the satisfying of his soul: but the belly of the wicked shall want.

entries.yo: ỌLUKULUKU ọlọgbọ́n obinrin ni kọ́ ile rẹ̀: ṣugbọn aṣiwere a fi ọwọ ara rẹ̀ fà a lulẹ.
entries.en: Every wise woman buildeth her house: but the foolish plucketh it down with her hands.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o nrìn ni iduroṣiṣin rẹ̀ o bẹ̀ru Oluwa: ṣugbọn ẹniti o ṣe arekereke li ọ̀na rẹ̀, o gàn a.
entries.en: He that walketh in his uprightness feareth the LORD: but he that is perverse in his ways despiseth him.

entries.yo: Li ẹnu aṣiwere ni paṣan igberaga; ṣugbọn ète awọn ọlọgbọ́n ni yio pa wọn mọ́.
entries.en: In the mouth of the foolish is a rod of pride: but the lips of the wise shall preserve them.

entries.yo: Nibiti malu kò si, ibujẹ a di ofo: ṣugbọn ibisi pupọ mbẹ nipa agbara malu.
entries.en: Where no oxen are, the crib is clean: but much increase is by the strength of the ox.

entries.yo: Ẹlẹri olõtọ kò jẹ ṣeke: ṣugbọn ẹ̀tan li ẹlẹri eke ima sọ jade.
entries.en: A faithful witness will not lie: but a false witness will utter lies.

entries.yo: Ẹlẹgan nwá ọgbọ́n, kò si ri i: ṣugbọn ìmọ kò ṣoro fun ẹniti oye ye.
entries.en: A scorner seeketh wisdom, and findeth it not: but knowledge is easy unto him that understandeth.

entries.yo: Kuro niwaju aṣiwere, ati lọdọ ẹniti kò ni ète ìmọ.
entries.en: Go from the presence of a foolish man, when thou perceivest not in him the lips of knowledge.

entries.yo: Ọgbọ́n amoye ni ati moye ọ̀na rẹ̀: ṣugbọn iwere awọn aṣiwere li ẹ̀tan.
entries.en: The wisdom of the prudent is to understand his way: but the folly of fools is deceit.

entries.yo: Aṣiwere nfi ẹbi-ẹ̀ṣẹ ṣẹsin: ṣugbọn ojurere wà larin awọn olododo.
entries.en: Fools make a mock at sin: but among the righteous there is favour.

entries.yo: Aiya mọ̀ ikoro ara rẹ̀; alejo kò si ni iṣe pẹlu ayọ̀ rẹ̀.
entries.en: The heart knoweth his own bitterness; and a stranger doth not intermeddle with his joy.

entries.yo: Ile enia buburu li a o run: ṣugbọn agọ ẹni diduroṣinṣin ni yio ma gbilẹ.
entries.en: The house of the wicked shall be overthrown: but the tabernacle of the upright shall flourish.

entries.yo: Ọ̀na kan wà ti o dabi ẹnipe o dara li oju enia, ṣugbọn opin rẹ̀ li ọ̀na ikú.
entries.en: There is a way which seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.

entries.yo: Ninu ẹrín pẹlu, aiya a ma kãnu; ati li opin, ayọ̀ a di ibinujẹ.
entries.en: Even in laughter the heart is sorrowful; and the end of that mirth is heaviness.

entries.yo: Apadasẹhin li aiya ni itẹlọrun lati inu ọ̀na ara rẹ̀: ṣugbọn enia rere lati inu ohun ti iṣe tirẹ̀.
entries.en: The backslider in heart shall be filled with his own ways: and a good man shall be satisfied from himself.

entries.yo: Òpe enia gbà ọ̀rọ gbogbo gbọ́: ṣugbọn amoye enia wò ọ̀na ara rẹ̀ rere.
entries.en: The simple believeth every word: but the prudent man looketh well to his going.

entries.yo: Ọlọgbọ́n enia bẹ̀ru, o si kuro ninu ibi; ṣugbọn aṣiwère gberaga, o si da ara rẹ̀ loju.
entries.en: A wise man feareth, and departeth from evil: but the fool rageth, and is confident.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba tete binu, huwa wère; ẹni eletè buburu li a korira.
entries.en: He that is soon angry dealeth foolishly: and a man of wicked devices is hated.

entries.yo: Awọn òpe jogun iwère; ṣugbọn awọn amoye li a fi ìmọ de li ade.
entries.en: The simple inherit folly: but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.

entries.yo: Awọn ẹni-buburu tẹriba niwaju awọn ẹnirere; ati awọn enia buburu li ẹnu-ọ̀na awọn olododo.
entries.en: The evil bow before the good; and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.

entries.yo: A tilẹ korira talaka lati ọdọ aladugbo rẹ̀ wá: ṣugbọn ọlọrọ̀ ni ọrẹ́ pupọ.
entries.en: The poor is hated even of his own neighbour: but the rich hath many friends.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o kẹgàn ẹnikeji rẹ̀, o ṣẹ̀: ṣugbọn ẹniti o ba ṣãnu fun awọn talaka, ibukún ni fun u.
entries.en: He that despiseth his neighbour sinneth: but he that hath mercy on the poor, happy is he.

entries.yo: Awọn ti ngbìmọ buburu kò ha ṣina bi? ṣugbọn ãnu ati otitọ ni fun awọn ti ngbìmọ ire.
entries.en: Do they not err that devise evil? but mercy and truth shall be to them that devise good.

entries.yo: Ninu gbogbo lãla li ère pupọ wà: ṣugbọn ọ̀rọ-ẹnu, lasan ni.
entries.en: In all labour there is profit: but the talk of the lips tendeth only to penury.

entries.yo: Adé awọn ọlọgbọ́n li ọrọ̀ wọn: ṣugbọn iwère awọn aṣiwère ni wère.
entries.en: The crown of the wise is their riches: but the foolishness of fools is folly.

entries.yo: Olõtọ ẹlẹri gbà ọkàn silẹ: ṣugbọn ẹlẹri ẹ̀tan sọ̀rọ eke.
entries.en: A true witness delivereth souls: but a deceitful witness speaketh lies.

entries.yo: Ni ibẹ̀ru Oluwa ni igbẹkẹle ti o lagbara: yio si jẹ ibi àbo fun awọn ọmọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: In the fear of the LORD is strong confidence: and his children shall have a place of refuge.

entries.yo: Ibẹ̀ru Oluwa li orisun ìye, lati kuro ninu ikẹkùn ikú.
entries.en: The fear of the LORD is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.

entries.yo: Ninu ọ̀pọlọpọ enia li ọlá ọba: ṣugbọn ninu enia diẹ ni iparun ijoye.
entries.en: In the multitude of people is the king's honour: but in the want of people is the destruction of the prince.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba lọra ati binu, o ni ìmọ pupọ; ṣugbọn ẹniti o ba yara binu o gbe wère leke.
entries.en: He that is slow to wrath is of great understanding: but he that is hasty of spirit exalteth folly.

entries.yo: Ọkàn ti o yè kõro ni ìye ara; ṣugbọn ilara ni ibajẹ egungun.
entries.en: A sound heart is the life of the flesh: but envy the rottenness of the bones.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba nni talaka lara, o gàn Ẹlẹda rẹ̀; ṣugbọn ẹniti o ṣãnu fun talaka o bu ọlá fun u.
entries.en: He that oppresseth the poor reproacheth his Maker: but he that honoureth him hath mercy on the poor.

entries.yo: A pa enia buburu run ninu ìwa-buburu rẹ̀; ṣugbọn olododo ni ireti ninu ikú rẹ̀.
entries.en: The wicked is driven away in his wickedness: but the righteous hath hope in his death.

entries.yo: Ọgbọ́n fi idi kalẹ li aiya ẹniti o moye; ṣugbọn a fi i hàn laiya awọn aṣiwère.
entries.en: Wisdom resteth in the heart of him that hath understanding: but that which is in the midst of fools is made known.

entries.yo: Ododo ni igbé orilẹ-ède leke; ṣugbọn ẹ̀ṣẹ li ẹ̀gan orilẹ-ède.
entries.en: Righteousness exalteth a nation: but sin is a reproach to any people.

entries.yo: Ojurere ọba mbẹ li ọdọ ọlọgbọ́n iranṣẹ; ṣugbọn ibinu rẹ̀ si iranṣẹ ti nhùwa itiju.
entries.en: The king's favour is toward a wise servant: but his wrath is against him that causeth shame.

entries.yo: IDAHÙN pẹlẹ yi ibinu pada; ṣugbọn ọ̀rọ lile ni irú ibinu soke.
entries.en: A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.

entries.yo: Ahọn ọlọgbọ́n nlò ìmọ rere: ṣugbọn ẹnu aṣiwère a ma gufẹ wère.
entries.en: The tongue of the wise useth knowledge aright: but the mouth of fools poureth out foolishness.

entries.yo: Oju Oluwa mbẹ ni ibi gbogbo, o nwò awọn ẹni-buburu ati ẹni-rere.
entries.en: The eyes of the LORD are in every place, beholding the evil and the good.

entries.yo: Ahọn imularada ni igi ìye: ṣugbọn ayidayida ninu rẹ̀ ni ibajẹ ọkàn.
entries.en: A wholesome tongue is a tree of life: but perverseness therein is a breach in the spirit.

entries.yo: Aṣiwère gàn ẹkọ́ baba rẹ̀: ṣugbọn ẹniti o ba feti si ibawi li o moye.
entries.en: A fool despiseth his father's instruction: but he that regardeth reproof is prudent.

entries.yo: Ni ile olododo li ọ̀pọlọpọ iṣura: ṣugbọn ninu òwò enia buburu ni iyọnu.
entries.en: In the house of the righteous is much treasure: but in the revenues of the wicked is trouble.

entries.yo: Ete ọlọgbọ́n tan ìmọ kalẹ: ṣugbọn aiya aṣiwère kì iṣe bẹ̃.
entries.en: The lips of the wise disperse knowledge: but the heart of the foolish doeth not so.

entries.yo: Ẹbọ awọn enia buburu, irira ni loju Oluwa; ṣugbọn adura awọn aduroṣinṣin ni didùn-inu rẹ̀.
entries.en: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to the LORD: but the prayer of the upright is his delight.

entries.yo: Ọ̀na enia buburu, irira ni loju Oluwa; ṣugbọn o fẹ ẹniti ntọ̀ ododo lẹhin.
entries.en: The way of the wicked is an abomination unto the LORD: but he loveth him that followeth after righteousness.

entries.yo: Ikilọ kikan wà fun ẹniti o kọ̀ ọ̀na silẹ; ẹniti o ba si korira ibawi yio kú.
entries.en: Correction is grievous unto him that forsaketh the way: and he that hateth reproof shall die.

entries.yo: Ipo-okú ati iparun ṣi silẹ niwaju Oluwa; njẹ melomelo li aiya awọn ọmọ enia.
entries.en: Hell and destruction are before the LORD: how much more then the hearts of the children of men?

entries.yo: Ẹlẹgàn kò fẹ ẹniti mba a wi; bẹ̃ni kì yio tọ̀ awọn ọlọgbọ́n lọ.
entries.en: A scorner loveth not one that reproveth him: neither will he go unto the wise.

entries.yo: Inu-didùn a mu oju daraya; ṣugbọn nipa ibinujẹ aiya, ọkàn a rẹ̀wẹsi.
entries.en: A merry heart maketh a cheerful countenance: but by sorrow of the heart the spirit is broken.

entries.yo: Aiya ẹniti oye ye nṣe afẹri ìmọ; ṣugbọn ẹnu aṣiwère nfi wère bọ́ ara rẹ̀.
entries.en: The heart of him that hath understanding seeketh knowledge: but the mouth of fools feedeth on foolishness.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ọjọ olupọnju ni ibi; ṣugbọn oninu-didùn njẹ alafia nigbagbogbo.
entries.en: All the days of the afflicted are evil: but he that is of a merry heart hath a continual feast.

entries.yo: Diẹ pẹlu ibẹ̀ru Oluwa, o san jù iṣura pupọ ti on ti iyọnu ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: Better is little with the fear of the LORD than great treasure and trouble therewith.

entries.yo: Onjẹ ewebẹ̀ nibiti ifẹ wà, o san jù abọpa malu lọ ati irira pẹlu rẹ̀.
entries.en: Better is a dinner of herbs where love is, than a stalled ox and hatred therewith.

entries.yo: Abinu enia rú asọ̀ soke; ṣugbọn ẹniti o lọra ati binu, o tù ìja ninu.
entries.en: A wrathful man stirreth up strife: but he that is slow to anger appeaseth strife.

entries.yo: Ọna ọlẹ dabi igbo ẹgún; ṣugbọn ọ̀na olododo já gẽrege ni.
entries.en: The way of the slothful man is as an hedge of thorns: but the way of the righteous is made plain.

entries.yo: Ọlọgbọ́n ọmọ ṣe ayọ̀ baba; ṣugbọn aṣiwère enia gàn iya rẹ̀.
entries.en: A wise son maketh a glad father: but a foolish man despiseth his mother.

entries.yo: Ayọ̀ ni wère fun ẹniti oye kù fun; ṣugbọn ẹni-oye a ma rìn ni iduroṣinṣin.
entries.en: Folly is joy to him that is destitute of wisdom: but a man of understanding walketh uprightly.

entries.yo: Laisi ìgbimọ, èro a dasan; ṣugbọn li ọ̀pọlọpọ ìgbimọ, nwọn a fi idi mulẹ.
entries.en: Without counsel purposes are disappointed: but in the multitude of counsellers they are established.

entries.yo: Enia ni ayọ̀ nipa idahùn ẹnu rẹ̀; ati ọ̀rọ kan li akoko rẹ̀, o ti wọ̀ to?
entries.en: A man hath joy by the answer of his mouth: and a word spoken in due season, how good is it!

entries.yo: Ọ̀na ìye lọ soke fun ọlọgbọ́n, ki o le kuro ni ipo-okú nisalẹ.
entries.en: The way of life is above to the wise, that he may depart from hell beneath.

entries.yo: Oluwa yio run ile agberaga; ṣugbọn yio fi ìpãlà opó kalẹ.
entries.en: The LORD will destroy the house of the proud: but he will establish the border of the widow.

entries.yo: Ìro inu enia buburu, irira ni loju Oluwa; ṣugbọn mimọ́ ni ọ̀rọ didùn niwaju rẹ̀.
entries.en: The thoughts of the wicked are an abomination to the LORD: but the words of the pure are pleasant words.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o njẹ ère aiṣododo, o nyọ ile ara rẹ̀ lẹnu; ṣugbọn ẹniti o korira ẹ̀bun yio yè.
entries.en: He that is greedy of gain troubleth his own house; but he that hateth gifts shall live.

entries.yo: Aiya olododo ṣe àṣaro lati dahùn; ṣugbọn ẹnu enia buburu ngufẹ ohun ibi jade.
entries.en: The heart of the righteous studieth to answer: but the mouth of the wicked poureth out evil things.

entries.yo: Oluwa jina si awọn enia-buburu; ṣugbọn o gbọ́ adura awọn olododo.
entries.en: The LORD is far from the wicked: but he heareth the prayer of the righteous.

entries.yo: Imọlẹ oju mu inu dùn; ihin rere si mu egungun sanra.
entries.en: The light of the eyes rejoiceth the heart: and a good report maketh the bones fat.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba gbọ́ ibawi ìye, a joko lãrin awọn ọlọgbọ́n.
entries.en: The ear that heareth the reproof of life abideth among the wise.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o kọ̀ ẹkọ́, o gàn ọkàn ara rẹ̀: ṣugbọn ẹniti o ba gbọ́ ibawi, o ni imoye.
entries.en: He that refuseth instruction despiseth his own soul: but he that heareth reproof getteth understanding.

entries.yo: Ibẹ̀ru Oluwa li ẹkọ́ ọgbọ́n; ati ṣãju ọlá ni irẹlẹ.
entries.en: The fear of the LORD is the instruction of wisdom; and before honour is humility.

entries.yo: IMURA aiya, ti enia ni, ṣugbọn lati ọdọ Oluwa ni idadùn ahọn.
entries.en: The preparations of the heart in man, and the answer of the tongue, is from the LORD.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ọ̀na enia li o mọ́ li oju ara rẹ̀; ṣugbọn Oluwa li o ndiwọ̀n ọkàn.
entries.en: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes; but the LORD weigheth the spirits.

entries.yo: Kó iṣẹ rẹ le Oluwa lọwọ, a o si fi idi ìro-inu rẹ kalẹ.
entries.en: Commit thy works unto the LORD, and thy thoughts shall be established.

entries.yo: Oluwa ti ṣe ohun gbogbo fun ipinnu rẹ̀: nitõtọ, awọn enia buburu fun ọjọ ibi.
entries.en: The LORD hath made all things for himself: yea, even the wicked for the day of evil.

entries.yo: Olukulùku enia ti o gberaga li aiya, irira ni loju Oluwa: bi a tilẹ fi ọwọ so ọwọ, kì yio wà laijiya.
entries.en: Every one that is proud in heart is an abomination to the LORD: though hand join in hand, he shall not be unpunished.

entries.yo: Nipa ãnu ati otitọ a bò ẹ̀ṣẹ mọlẹ; ati nipa ibẹ̀ru Oluwa, enia a kuro ninu ibi.
entries.en: By mercy and truth iniquity is purged: and by the fear of the LORD men depart from evil.

entries.yo: Nigbati ọ̀na enia ba wù Oluwa, On a mu awọn ọtá rẹ̀ pãpa wà pẹlu rẹ̀ li alafia.
entries.en: When a man's ways please the LORD, he maketh even his enemies to be at peace with him.

entries.yo: Diẹ pẹlu ododo, o san jù ọrọ̀ nla lọ laisi ẹtọ́.
entries.en: Better is a little with righteousness than great revenues without right.

entries.yo: Aiya enia ni ngbìmọ ọ̀na rẹ̀, ṣugbọn Oluwa li o ntọ́ itẹlẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: A man's heart deviseth his way: but the LORD directeth his steps.

entries.yo: Ọrọ isọtẹlẹ mbẹ li ète ọba: ẹnu rẹ̀ kì iṣẹ̀ ni idajọ.
entries.en: A divine sentence is in the lips of the king: his mouth transgresseth not in judgment.

entries.yo: Iwọn ati òṣuwọn otitọ ni ti Oluwa: gbogbo okuta-ìwọn àpo, iṣẹ rẹ̀ ni.
entries.en: A just weight and balance are the LORD's: all the weights of the bag are his work.

entries.yo: Irira ni fun awọn ọba lati ṣe buburu: nitoripe nipa ododo li a ti fi idi itẹ́ kalẹ.
entries.en: It is an abomination to kings to commit wickedness: for the throne is established by righteousness.

entries.yo: Ete ododo ni didùn-inu awọn ọba: nwọn si fẹ ẹniti nsọ̀rọ titọ.
entries.en: Righteous lips are the delight of kings; and they love him that speaketh right.

entries.yo: Ibinu ọba dabi iranṣẹ ikú: ṣugbọn ọlọgbọ́n enia ni yio tù u.
entries.en: The wrath of a king is as messengers of death: but a wise man will pacify it.

entries.yo: Ni imọlẹ oju ọba ni ìye; ojurere rẹ̀ si dabi awọsanma òjo arọkuro.
entries.en: In the light of the king's countenance is life; and his favour is as a cloud of the latter rain.

entries.yo: Lati ni ọgbọ́n, melomelo li o san jù wura lọ; ati lati ni oye, melomelo li o dara jù fadaka lọ.
entries.en: How much better is it to get wisdom than gold! and to get understanding rather to be chosen than silver!

entries.yo: Òpopo-ọ̀na awọn aduro-ṣinṣin ni ati kuro ninu ibi: ẹniti o pa ọ̀na rẹ̀ mọ́, o pa ọkàn rẹ̀ mọ́.
entries.en: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil: he that keepeth his way preserveth his soul.

entries.yo: Igberaga ni iṣaju iparun, agidi ọkàn ni iṣaju iṣubu.
entries.en: Pride goeth before destruction, and an haughty spirit before a fall.

entries.yo: O san lati ṣe onirẹlẹ ọkàn pẹlu awọn talaka, jù ati ba awọn agberaga pin ikógun.
entries.en: Better it is to be of an humble spirit with the lowly, than to divide the spoil with the proud.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o fi oye ṣe ọ̀ran yio ri ire; ẹniti o si gbẹkẹ le Oluwa, ibukún ni fun u.
entries.en: He that handleth a matter wisely shall find good: and whoso trusteth in the LORD, happy is he.

entries.yo: Ọlọgbọ́n aiya li a o pè li amoye: didùn-ète a si ma mu ẹkọ́ pọ̀.
entries.en: The wise in heart shall be called prudent: and the sweetness of the lips increaseth learning.

entries.yo: Oye li orisun ìye fun ẹniti o ni i: ṣugbọn ẹkọ́ aṣiwère ni iwère.
entries.en: Understanding is a wellspring of life unto him that hath it: but the instruction of fools is folly.

entries.yo: Aiya ọlọgbọ́n mu ọ̀rọ ẹnu rẹ̀ gbọ́n, o si mu ẹkọ́ pọ̀ li ète rẹ̀.
entries.en: The heart of the wise teacheth his mouth, and addeth learning to his lips.

entries.yo: Ọrọ didùn dabi afara oyin, o dùn mọ ọkàn, o si ṣe ilera fun egungun.
entries.en: Pleasant words are as an honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.

entries.yo: Ọ̀na kan wà ti o dabi ẹnipe o dara fun enia, ṣugbọn opin rẹ̀ li ọ̀na ikú.
entries.en: There is a way that seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.

entries.yo: Ọkàn ti o nṣiṣẹ, o nṣiṣẹ fun ara rẹ̀; nitoripe ẹnu ara rẹ̀ li o nsún u ṣe e.
entries.en: He that laboureth laboureth for himself; for his mouth craveth it of him.

entries.yo: Enia-buburu hù ìwa-ibi jade, ati li ète rẹ̀ bi ẹnipe iná jijo li o wà nibẹ.
entries.en: An ungodly man diggeth up evil: and in his lips there is as a burning fire.

entries.yo: Alayidayida enia dá ìja silẹ: asọ̀rọkẹlẹ yà awọn ọrẹ́ ni ipa.
entries.en: A froward man soweth strife: and a whisperer separateth chief friends.

entries.yo: Ẹni ìwa-agbara tàn aladugbo rẹ̀, a si mu u lọ si ipa-ọ̀na ti kò dara.
entries.en: A violent man enticeth his neighbour, and leadeth him into the way that is not good.

entries.yo: On a di oju rẹ̀ lati gbèro ohun ayidayida: o ká ète rẹ̀ sinu, o pari ohun buburu.
entries.en: He shutteth his eyes to devise froward things: moving his lips he bringeth evil to pass.

entries.yo: Ade ogo li ori ewú, bi a ba ri i li ọ̀na ododo.
entries.en: The hoary head is a crown of glory, if it be found in the way of righteousness.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o lọra ati binu, o san jù alagbara lọ; ẹniti o si ṣe akoso ẹmi rẹ̀, o jù ẹniti o ṣẹgun ilu lọ.
entries.en: He that is slow to anger is better than the mighty; and he that ruleth his spirit than he that taketh a city.

entries.yo: A ṣẹ́ keke dà si iṣẹpo aṣọ; ṣugbọn gbogbo idajọ rẹ̀ lọwọ Oluwa ni.
entries.en: The lot is cast into the lap; but the whole disposing thereof is of the LORD.

entries.yo: OKELE gbigbẹ, ti on ti alafia, o san jù ile ti o kún fun ẹran-pipa ti on ti ìja.
entries.en: Better is a dry morsel, and quietness therewith, than an house full of sacrifices with strife.

entries.yo: Ọlọgbọ́n iranṣẹ yio ṣe olori ọmọ ti nhùwa itiju, yio si pin ogún lãrin awọn arakunrin.
entries.en: A wise servant shall have rule over a son that causeth shame, and shall have part of the inheritance among the brethren.

entries.yo: Koro ni fun fadaka, ati ileru fun wura: bẹ̃li Oluwa ndan aiya wò.
entries.en: The fining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold: but the LORD trieth the hearts.

entries.yo: Oluṣe buburu fetisi ète eke; ẹni-eké a si ma kiyesi ọ̀rọ ahọn buburu.
entries.en: A wicked doer giveth heed to false lips; and a liar giveth ear to a naughty tongue.

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni ti o ba sín olupọnju jẹ, o gàn Ẹlẹda rẹ̀: ẹniti o ba si nyọ̀ si wahala kì yio wà li aijiya.
entries.en: Whoso mocketh the poor reproacheth his Maker: and he that is glad at calamities shall not be unpunished.

entries.yo: Ọmọ ọmọ li ade arugbo: ogo awọn ọmọ si ni baba wọn.
entries.en: Children's children are the crown of old men; and the glory of children are their fathers.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ daradara kò yẹ fun aṣiwère; bẹ̃li ète eke kò yẹ fun ọmọ-alade.
entries.en: Excellent speech becometh not a fool: much less do lying lips a prince.

entries.yo: Okuta iyebiye jẹ ẹ̀bun li oju ẹniti o ni i; nibikibi ti o yi si, a ṣe rere.
entries.en: A gift is as a precious stone in the eyes of him that hath it: whithersoever it turneth, it prospereth.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o bò ẹ̀ṣẹ mọlẹ, o nwá ifẹ; ṣugbọn ẹniti o tun ọ̀ran hú silẹ, o yà ọrẹ́ nipa.
entries.en: He that covereth a transgression seeketh love; but he that repeateth a matter separateth very friends.

entries.yo: Ibawi wọ̀ inu ọlọgbọ́n jù ọgọrun paṣan lọ ninu aṣiwère.
entries.en: A reproof entereth more into a wise man than an hundred stripes into a fool.

entries.yo: Ẹni-ọ̀tẹ a ma wá kiki ibi kiri; nitorina iranṣẹ ìka li a o ran si i.
entries.en: An evil man seeketh only rebellion: therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.

entries.yo: O yá ki ẹranko beari ti a kó li ọmọ ki o pade enia, jù aṣiwère lọ ninu wère rẹ̀.
entries.en: Let a bear robbed of her whelps meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni ti o ba fi ibi san ire, ibi kì yio kuro ninu ile rẹ̀.
entries.en: Whoso rewardeth evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o daju fun omi dabi olupilẹṣẹ ìja; nitorina fi ìja silẹ ki o to di nla.
entries.en: The beginning of strife is as when one letteth out water: therefore leave off contention, before it be meddled with.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o da enia buburu lare, ati ẹniti o da olododo lẹbi, ani awọn mejeji irira ni loju Oluwa.
entries.en: He that justifieth the wicked, and he that condemneth the just, even they both are abomination to the LORD.

entries.yo: Nitori kini iye owo yio ṣe wà lọwọ aṣiwère lati rà ọgbọ́n, sa wò o, kò ni oye?
entries.en: Wherefore is there a price in the hand of a fool to get wisdom, seeing he hath no heart to it?

entries.yo: Ọrẹ́ a ma fẹni nigbagbogbo, ṣugbọn arakunrin li a bi fun ìgba ipọnju.
entries.en: A friend loveth at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.

entries.yo: Enia ti oye kù fun, a ṣe onigbọwọ, a si fi ara sọfà niwaju ọrẹ́ rẹ̀.
entries.en: A man void of understanding striketh hands, and becometh surety in the presence of his friend.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o fẹ ìja, o fẹ ẹ̀ṣẹ; ẹniti o kọ́ ẹnu-ọ̀na rẹ̀ ga, o nwá iparun.
entries.en: He loveth transgression that loveth strife: and he that exalteth his gate seeketh destruction.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ni ayidayida ọkàn kì yio ri ire: ati ẹniti o ni ahọn ọ̀rọ-meji, a bọ sinu ibi.
entries.en: He that hath a froward heart findeth no good: and he that hath a perverse tongue falleth into mischief.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o bi aṣiwère, o bi i si ibinujẹ rẹ̀; baba aṣiwère kò si li ayọ̀.
entries.en: He that begetteth a fool doeth it to his sorrow: and the father of a fool hath no joy.

entries.yo: Inu-didùn mu imularada rere wá: ṣugbọn ibinujẹ ọkàn mu egungun gbẹ.
entries.en: A merry heart doeth good like a medicine: but a broken spirit drieth the bones.

entries.yo: Enia buburu mu ẹ̀bun lati iṣẹpo-aṣọ lati yi ọ̀na idajọ pada.
entries.en: A wicked man taketh a gift out of the bosom to pervert the ways of judgment.

entries.yo: Ọgbọ́n wà niwaju ẹniti o moye; ṣugbọn oju aṣiwère mbẹ li opin ilẹ̀-aiye.
entries.en: Wisdom is before him that hath understanding; but the eyes of a fool are in the ends of the earth.

entries.yo: Aṣiwère ọmọ ni ibinujẹ baba rẹ̀, ati kikoro ọkàn fun iya ti o bi i.
entries.en: A foolish son is a grief to his father, and bitterness to her that bare him.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu kò dara ki a ṣẹ́ olotitọ ni iṣẹ́, tabi ki a lu ọmọ-alade nitori iṣedẽde.
entries.en: Also to punish the just is not good, nor to strike princes for equity.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ni ìmọ, a ṣẹ́ ọ̀rọ rẹ̀ kù: ọlọkàn tutu si li amoye enia.
entries.en: He that hath knowledge spareth his words: and a man of understanding is of an excellent spirit.

entries.yo: Lõtọ, aṣiwère, nigbati o ba pa ẹnu rẹ̀ mọ́, a kà a si ọlọgbọ́n; ẹniti o ba pa ẹnu rẹ̀ mọ́ si li amoye.
entries.en: Even a fool, when he holdeth his peace, is counted wise: and he that shutteth his lips is esteemed a man of understanding.

entries.yo: ẸNITI o yà ara rẹ̀ sọtọ̀ yio lepa ifẹ ara rẹ̀, yio si kọju ìja nla si ohunkohun ti iṣe ti oye.
entries.en: Through desire a man, having separated himself, seeketh and intermeddleth with all wisdom.

entries.yo: Aṣiwère kò ni inu-didùn si imoye, ṣugbọn ki o le fi aiya ara rẹ̀ hàn.
entries.en: A fool hath no delight in understanding, but that his heart may discover itself.

entries.yo: Nigbati enia-buburu ba de, nigbana ni ẹ̀gan de, ati pẹlu ẹ̀gan ni itiju.
entries.en: When the wicked cometh, then cometh also contempt, and with ignominy reproach.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ ẹnu enia dabi omi jijìn, orisun ọgbọ́n bi odò ṣiṣàn.
entries.en: The words of a man's mouth are as deep waters, and the wellspring of wisdom as a flowing brook.

entries.yo: Kò dara lati ṣe ojuṣãju enia-buburu, lati bì olododo ṣubu ni idajọ.
entries.en: It is not good to accept the person of the wicked, to overthrow the righteous in judgment.

entries.yo: Ete aṣiwère bọ sinu ìja, ẹnu rẹ̀ a si ma pè ìna wá.
entries.en: A fool's lips enter into contention, and his mouth calleth for strokes.

entries.yo: Ẹnu aṣiwère ni iparun rẹ̀, ète rẹ̀ si ni ikẹkùn ọkàn rẹ̀.
entries.en: A fool's mouth is his destruction, and his lips are the snare of his soul.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ olofofo dabi adidùn, nwọn a si wọ isalẹ inu lọ.
entries.en: The words of a talebearer are as wounds, and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o lọra pẹlu ni iṣẹ rẹ̀, arakunrin jẹguduragudu enia ni.
entries.en: He also that is slothful in his work is brother to him that is a great waster.

entries.yo: Orukọ Oluwa, ile-iṣọ agbara ni: Olododo sá wọ inu rẹ̀, o si là.
entries.en: The name of the LORD is a strong tower: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe.

entries.yo: Ọrọ̀ ọlọrọ̀ ni ilu-agbara rẹ̀, o si dabi odi giga li oju ara rẹ̀.
entries.en: The rich man's wealth is his strong city, and as an high wall in his own conceit.

entries.yo: Ṣaju iparun, aiya enia a ṣe agidi, ṣaju ọlá si ni irẹlẹ.
entries.en: Before destruction the heart of man is haughty, and before honour is humility.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba dahùn ọ̀rọ ki o to gbọ́, wère ati itiju ni fun u.
entries.en: He that answereth a matter before he heareth it, it is folly and shame unto him.

entries.yo: Ọkàn enia yio faiyàrán ailera rẹ̀; ṣugbọn ọkàn ti o rẹ̀wẹsi, tani yio gbà a?
entries.en: The spirit of a man will sustain his infirmity; but a wounded spirit who can bear?

entries.yo: Aiya amoye ni ìmọ; eti ọlọgbọ́n a si ma ṣe afẹri ìmọ.
entries.en: The heart of the prudent getteth knowledge; and the ear of the wise seeketh knowledge.

entries.yo: Ọrẹ enia a ma fi àye fun u, a si mu u wá siwaju awọn enia nla.
entries.en: A man's gift maketh room for him, and bringeth him before great men.

entries.yo: Ẹnikini ninu ẹjọ rẹ̀ a dabi ẹnipe o jare, ṣugbọn ẹnikeji rẹ̀ a wá, a si hudi rẹ̀ silẹ.
entries.en: He that is first in his own cause seemeth just; but his neighbour cometh and searcheth him.

entries.yo: Keké mu ìja pari, a si làja lãrin awọn alagbara.
entries.en: The lot causeth contentions to cease, and parteth between the mighty.

entries.yo: Arakunrin ti a ṣẹ̀ si, o ṣoro jù ilu olodi lọ: ìja wọn si dabi ọpá idabu ãfin.
entries.en: A brother offended is harder to be won than a strong city: and their contentions are like the bars of a castle.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ ẹnu enia ni yio mu inu rẹ̀ tutu: ibisi ẹnu rẹ̀ li a o si fi tù u ninu.
entries.en: A man's belly shall be satisfied with the fruit of his mouth; and with the increase of his lips shall he be filled.

entries.yo: Ikú ati ìye mbẹ ni ipa ahọn: awọn ẹniti o ba si nlò o yio jẹ ère rẹ̀.
entries.en: Death and life are in the power of the tongue: and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof.

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni ti o ri aya fẹ, o ri ohun rere, o si ri ojurere lọdọ Oluwa.
entries.en: Whoso findeth a wife findeth a good thing, and obtaineth favour of the LORD.

entries.yo: Talaka a ma bẹ̀ ẹ̀bẹ; ṣugbọn ọlọrọ̀ a ma fi ikanra dahùn.
entries.en: The poor useth intreaties; but the rich answereth roughly.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ni ọrẹ́ pupọ, o ṣe e si iparun ara rẹ̀; ọrẹ́ kan si mbẹ ti o fi ara mọni ju arakunrin lọ.
entries.en: A man that hath friends must shew himself friendly: and there is a friend that sticketh closer than a brother.

entries.yo: TALAKA ti nrìn ninu ìwa-titọ rẹ̀, o san jù ẹniti o nṣe arekereke li ète rẹ̀ lọ, ti o si nṣe wère.
entries.en: Better is the poor that walketh in his integrity, than he that is perverse in his lips, and is a fool.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu, ọkàn laini ìmọ, kò dara; ẹniti o ba si fi ẹsẹ rẹ̀ yara yio ṣubu.
entries.en: Also, that the soul be without knowledge, it is not good; and he that hasteth with his feet sinneth.

entries.yo: Wère enia yi ọ̀na rẹ̀ po: nigbana ni aiya rẹ̀ binu si Oluwa.
entries.en: The foolishness of man perverteth his way: and his heart fretteth against the LORD.

entries.yo: Ọrọ̀ fà ọrẹ́ pupọ; ṣugbọn talaka di yiyà kuro lọdọ aladugbo rẹ̀.
entries.en: Wealth maketh many friends; but the poor is separated from his neighbour.

entries.yo: Ẹlẹri eke kì yio lọ laijiya, ati ẹniti o si nṣeke kì yio mu u jẹ.
entries.en: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaketh lies shall not escape.

entries.yo: Ọpọlọpọ ni yio ma bẹ̀bẹ ojurere ọmọ-alade: olukuluku enia ni si iṣe ọrẹ́ ẹniti ntani li ọrẹ.
entries.en: Many will intreat the favour of the prince: and every man is a friend to him that giveth gifts.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn arakunrin talaka ni ikorira rẹ̀: melomelo ni awọn ọrẹ́ rẹ̀ yio ha jina si i? o ntẹle ọ̀rọ wọn, ṣugbọn nwọn kò si.
entries.en: All the brethren of the poor do hate him: how much more do his friends go far from him? he pursueth them with words, yet they are wanting to him.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o gbọ́n, o fẹ ọkàn ara rẹ̀: ẹniti o pa oye mọ́ yio ri rere.
entries.en: He that getteth wisdom loveth his own soul: he that keepeth understanding shall find good.

entries.yo: Ẹlẹri eke kì yio lọ laijiya, ẹniti o si nṣeke yio ṣegbe.
entries.en: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaketh lies shall perish.

entries.yo: Ohun rere kò yẹ fun aṣiwère; tabi melomelo fun iranṣẹ lati ṣe olori awọn ijoye.
entries.en: Delight is not seemly for a fool; much less for a servant to have rule over princes.

entries.yo: Imoye enia mu u lọra ati binu; ogo rẹ̀ si ni lati ré ẹ̀ṣẹ kọja.
entries.en: The discretion of a man deferreth his anger; and it is his glory to pass over a transgression.

entries.yo: Ibinu ọba dabi igbe kiniun; ṣugbọn ọjurere rẹ̀ dabi ìri lara koriko.
entries.en: The king's wrath is as the roaring of a lion; but his favour is as dew upon the grass.

entries.yo: Aṣiwère ọmọ ni ibanujẹ baba rẹ̀: ìja aya dabi ọ̀ṣọrọ òjo.
entries.en: A foolish son is the calamity of his father: and the contentions of a wife are a continual dropping.

entries.yo: Ile ati ọrọ̀ li ogún awọn baba: ṣugbọn amoye aya, lati ọdọ Oluwa wá ni.
entries.en: House and riches are the inheritance of fathers and a prudent wife is from the LORD.

entries.yo: Imẹlẹ mu ni sun orun fọnfọn; ọkàn ọlẹ li ebi yio si pa.
entries.en: Slothfulness casteth into a deep sleep; and an idle soul shall suffer hunger.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o pa ofin mọ́, o pa ọkàn ara rẹ̀ mọ́; ṣugbọn ẹniti o ba kẹgàn ọ̀na rẹ̀ yio kú.
entries.en: He that keepeth the commandment keepeth his own soul; but he that despiseth his ways shall die.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ṣãnu fun talaka Oluwa li o win; ati iṣeun rẹ̀, yio san a pada fun u.
entries.en: He that hath pity upon the poor lendeth unto the LORD; and that which he hath given will he pay him again.

entries.yo: Nà ọmọ rẹ nigbati ireti wà, má si ṣe gbe ọkàn rẹ le ati pa a.
entries.en: Chasten thy son while there is hope, and let not thy soul spare for his crying.

entries.yo: Onibinu nla ni yio jiya; nitoripe bi iwọ ba gbà a, sibẹ iwọ o tun ṣe e.
entries.en: A man of great wrath shall suffer punishment: for if thou deliver him, yet thou must do it again.

entries.yo: Fetisi ìmọ ki o si gbà ẹkọ́, ki iwọ ki o le gbọ́n ni igbẹhin rẹ.
entries.en: Hear counsel, and receive instruction, that thou mayest be wise in thy latter end.

entries.yo: Ete pupọ li o wà li aiya enia; ṣugbọn ìgbimọ Oluwa, eyini ni yio duro.
entries.en: There are many devices in a man's heart; nevertheless the counsel of the LORD, that shall stand.

entries.yo: Ẹwà enia ni iṣeun rẹ̀: talaka enia si san jù eleke lọ.
entries.en: The desire of a man is his kindness: and a poor man is better than a liar.

entries.yo: Ibẹ̀ru Oluwa tẹ̀ si ìye: ẹniti o ni i yio joko ni itẹlọrun; a kì yio fi ibi bẹ̀ ẹ wọ́.
entries.en: The fear of the LORD tendeth to life: and he that hath it shall abide satisfied; he shall not be visited with evil.

entries.yo: Imẹlẹ enia kì ọwọ rẹ̀ sinu iṣasun, kò si le yọ ọ jade pada wá si ẹnu ara rẹ̀.
entries.en: A slothful man hideth his hand in his bosom, and will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.

entries.yo: Lu ẹlẹgàn, òpe yio si kiyesi ara: si ba ẹniti o moye wi, oye ìmọ yio si ye e.
entries.en: Smite a scorner, and the simple will beware: and reprove one that hath understanding, and he will understand knowledge.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba nṣìka si baba rẹ̀, ti o si le iya rẹ̀ jade, on li ọmọ ti nṣe itiju, ti o si mu ẹ̀gan wá.
entries.en: He that wasteth his father, and chaseth away his mother, is a son that causeth shame, and bringeth reproach.

entries.yo: Ọmọ mi, dẹkun ati fetisi ẹkọ́ ti imu ni ṣìna kuro ninu ọ̀rọ ìmọ.
entries.en: Cease, my son, to hear the instruction that causeth to err from the words of knowledge.

entries.yo: Ẹlẹri buburu fi idajọ ṣẹsin: ẹnu enia buburu si gbe aiṣedẽde mì.
entries.en: An ungodly witness scorneth judgment: and the mouth of the wicked devoureth iniquity.

entries.yo: A pèse ọ̀rọ-idajọ fun awọn ẹlẹgàn, ati paṣan fun ẹ̀hin awọn aṣiwère.
entries.en: Judgments are prepared for scorners, and stripes for the back of fools.

entries.yo: ẸLẸYA li ọti-waini, alariwo li ọti lile, ẹnikẹni ti a ba fi tanjẹ kò gbọ́n.
entries.en: Wine is a mocker, strong drink is raging: and whosoever is deceived thereby is not wise.

entries.yo: Ibẹ̀ru ọba dabi igbe kiniun: ẹnikẹni ti o ba mu u binu, o ṣẹ̀ si ọkàn ara rẹ̀.
entries.en: The fear of a king is as the roaring of a lion: whoso provoketh him to anger sinneth against his own soul.

entries.yo: Ọlá ni fun enia lati ṣiwọ kuro ninu ìja: ṣugbọn olukuluku aṣiwère ni ima ja ìja nla.
entries.en: It is an honour for a man to cease from strife: but every fool will be meddling.

entries.yo: Ọlẹ kò jẹ tu ilẹ nitori otutu; nitorina ni yio fi ma ṣagbe nigba ikore, kì yio si ni nkan.
entries.en: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the cold; therefore shall he beg in harvest, and have nothing.

entries.yo: Ìmọ ninu ọkàn enia dabi omi jijin; ṣugbọn amoye enia ni ifà a jade.
entries.en: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water; but a man of understanding will draw it out.

entries.yo: Ọ̀pọlọpọ enia ni ima fọnrere, olukuluku ọrẹ ara rẹ̀: ṣugbọn olõtọ enia tani yio ri i.
entries.en: Most men will proclaim every one his own goodness: but a faithful man who can find?

entries.yo: Olõtọ enia nrìn ninu iwa-titọ rẹ̀: ibukún si ni fun awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ lẹhin rẹ̀!
entries.en: The just man walketh in his integrity: his children are blessed after him.

entries.yo: Ọba ti o joko lori itẹ́ idajọ, o fi oju rẹ̀ fọ́n ìwa-ibi gbogbo ka.
entries.en: A king that sitteth in the throne of judgment scattereth away all evil with his eyes.

entries.yo: Tali o le wipe, Mo ti mu aiya mi mọ́, emi ti mọ́ kuro ninu ẹ̀ṣẹ mi?
entries.en: Who can say, I have made my heart clean, I am pure from my sin?

entries.yo: Ìwọn miran, ati òṣuwọn miran, bakanna ni mejeji ṣe irira loju Oluwa.
entries.en: Divers weights, and divers measures, both of them are alike abomination to the LORD.

entries.yo: Iṣe ọmọde pãpa li a fi imọ̀ ọ, bi ìwa rẹ̀ ṣe rere ati titọ.
entries.en: Even a child is known by his doings, whether his work be pure, and whether it be right.

entries.yo: Eti igbọ́ ati oju irí, Oluwa li o ti dá awọn mejeji.
entries.en: The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, the LORD hath made even both of them.

entries.yo: Máṣe fẹ orun sisùn, ki iwọ ki o má ba di talaka; ṣi oju rẹ, a o si fi onjẹ tẹ ọ lọrùn.
entries.en: Love not sleep, lest thou come to poverty; open thine eyes, and thou shalt be satisfied with bread.

entries.yo: Kò ni lãri, kò ni lãri li oníbárà iwi; ṣugbọn nigbati o ba bọ si ọ̀na rẹ̀, nigbana ni iṣogo.
entries.en: It is naught, it is naught, saith the buyer: but when he is gone his way, then he boasteth.

entries.yo: Wura wà ati iyùn ọ̀pọlọpọ: ṣugbọn ète ìmọ, èlo iyebiye ni.
entries.en: There is gold, and a multitude of rubies: but the lips of knowledge are a precious jewel.

entries.yo: Gba aṣọ rẹ̀, nitori ti o ṣe onigbọwọ fun alejo, si gba ohun ẹrí lọwọ rẹ̀ fun ajeji obinrin.
entries.en: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger: and take a pledge of him for a strange woman.

entries.yo: Onjẹ ẹ̀tan dùn mọ enia; ṣugbọn nikẹhin, ẹnu rẹ̀ li a o fi tarã kún.
entries.en: Bread of deceit is sweet to a man; but afterwards his mouth shall be filled with gravel.

entries.yo: Igbimọ li a fi ifi idi ete gbogbo kalẹ: ati pẹlu èro rere ni ki o ṣigun.
entries.en: Every purpose is established by counsel: and with good advice make war.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba nkiri bi olofofo a ma fi ọ̀ran ìkọkọ hàn: má si ṣe ba ẹniti nṣi ète rẹ̀ ṣire.
entries.en: He that goeth about as a talebearer revealeth secrets: therefore meddle not with him that flattereth with his lips.

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni ti o ba bú baba rẹ̀ tabi iya rẹ̀, fitila rẹ̀ li a o pa ninu òkunkun biribiri.
entries.en: Whoso curseth his father or his mother, his lamp shall be put out in obscure darkness.

entries.yo: Ogún ti a yara jẹ latetekọṣe, li a kì yio bukún li opin rẹ̀.
entries.en: An inheritance may be gotten hastily at the beginning; but the end thereof shall not be blessed.

entries.yo: Iwọ máṣe wipe, Emi o gbẹsan ibi; ṣugbọn duro de Oluwa, on o si gbà ọ.
entries.en: Say not thou, I will recompense evil; but wait on the LORD, and he shall save thee.

entries.yo: Ìwọn miran, ati òṣuwọn miran, irira ni loju Oluwa; ìwọn irẹjẹ kò si dara.
entries.en: Divers weights are an abomination unto the LORD; and a false balance is not good.

entries.yo: Irin ti enia nrìn, lati ọdọ Oluwa ni; tani ninu awọn enia ti o le mọ̀ ọ̀na rẹ̀?
entries.en: Man's goings are of the LORD; how can a man then understand his own way?

entries.yo: Idẹkùn ni fun enia lati yara ṣe ileri mimọ́, ati lẹhin ẹjẹ́, ki o ma ronu.
entries.en: It is a snare to the man who devoureth that which is holy, and after vows to make inquiry.

entries.yo: Ọlọgbọ́n ọba a tú enia buburu ka, a si mu ayika-kẹkẹ́ rẹ̀ kọja lori wọn.
entries.en: A wise king scattereth the wicked, and bringeth the wheel over them.

entries.yo: Ẹmi enia ni fitila Oluwa, a ma ṣe awari iyara inu.
entries.en: The spirit of man is the candle of the LORD, searching all the inward parts of the belly.

entries.yo: Anu ati otitọ pa ọba mọ́: ãnu li a si fi ndi itẹ́ rẹ̀ mu.
entries.en: Mercy and truth preserve the king: and his throne is upholden by mercy.

entries.yo: Ogo awọn ọdọmọkunrin li agbara wọn: ẹwà awọn arugbo li ewú.
entries.en: The glory of young men is their strength: and the beauty of old men is the gray head.

entries.yo: Apá ọgbẹ ni iwẹ̀ ibi nù kuro: bẹ̃ si ni ìna ti o wọ̀ odò ikùn lọ.
entries.en: The blueness of a wound cleanseth away evil: so do stripes the inward parts of the belly.

entries.yo: AIYA ọba mbẹ lọwọ Oluwa bi odò omi; on a si dari rẹ̀ si ìbikibi ti o wù u.
entries.en: The king's heart is in the hand of the LORD, as the rivers of water: he turneth it whithersoever he will.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ọ̀na enia li o dara li oju ara rẹ̀: ṣugbọn Oluwa li o nṣe amọ̀na ọkàn.
entries.en: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes: but the LORD pondereth the hearts.

entries.yo: Lati ṣe ododo ati idajọ, o ṣe itẹwọgba fun Oluwa jù ẹbọ lọ.
entries.en: To do justice and judgment is more acceptable to the LORD than sacrifice.

entries.yo: Gangan oju, ati igberaga aiya, ati itulẹ̀ enia buburu, ẹ̀ṣẹ ni.
entries.en: An high look, and a proud heart, and the plowing of the wicked, is sin.

entries.yo: Ìronu alãpọn si kiki ọ̀pọ ni; ṣugbọn ti olukuluku ẹniti o yara, si kiki aini ni.
entries.en: The thoughts of the diligent tend only to plenteousness; but of every one that is hasty only to want.

entries.yo: Ini iṣura nipa ahọn eke, o jẹ ẽmi ti a ntì sihin tì sọhun lọwọ awọn ti nwá ikú kiri.
entries.en: The getting of treasures by a lying tongue is a vanity tossed to and fro of them that seek death.

entries.yo: Iwa-agbara awọn enia buburu ni yio pa wọn run: nitori ti nwọn kọ̀ lati ṣe idajọ.
entries.en: The robbery of the wicked shall destroy them; because they refuse to do judgment.

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni ti o nrìn ọ̀na ayidayida, enia buburu ni; ṣugbọn oninu funfun ni iṣẹ rẹ̀ tọ́.
entries.en: The way of man is froward and strange: but as for the pure, his work is right.

entries.yo: O san lati joko ni igun òke àja, jù pẹlu onija obinrin lọ ninu ile ajumọgbe.
entries.en: It is better to dwell in a corner of the housetop, than with a brawling woman in a wide house.

entries.yo: Ọkàn enia buburu nwá ibi kiri: aladugbo rẹ̀ kò ri ojurere li oju rẹ̀.
entries.en: The soul of the wicked desireth evil: his neighbour findeth no favour in his eyes.

entries.yo: Nigbati a ba jẹ ẹlẹgàn ni ìya, a sọ òpe di ọlọgbọ́n: nigbati a ba si nkọ́ ọlọgbọ́n, on o ma ni ìmọ.
entries.en: When the scorner is punished, the simple is made wise: and when the wise is instructed, he receiveth knowledge.

entries.yo: Olododo kiyesi ile enia buburu: pe ẹnikan wà ti yio bì enia buburu ṣubu sinu iparun.
entries.en: The righteous man wisely considereth the house of the wicked: but God overthroweth the wicked for their wickedness.

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni ti o ba di eti rẹ̀ si igbe olupọnju, ontikararẹ̀ yio ke pẹlu: ṣugbọn a kì yio gbọ́.
entries.en: Whoso stoppeth his ears at the cry of the poor, he also shall cry himself, but shall not be heard.

entries.yo: Ọrẹ ikọkọ, o tù ibinu: ati ẹ̀bun ni iṣẹpo-aṣọ, o tù ibinu lile.
entries.en: A gift in secret pacifieth anger: and a reward in the bosom strong wrath.

entries.yo: Ayọ̀ ni fun olododo lati ṣe idajọ: ṣugbọn iparun ni fun awọn oniṣẹ ẹ̀ṣẹ.
entries.en: It is joy to the just to do judgment: but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba yà kuro li ọ̀na oye, yio ma gbe inu ijọ awọn okú.
entries.en: The man that wandereth out of the way of understanding shall remain in the congregation of the dead.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba fẹ afẹ, yio di talaka: ẹniti o fẹ ọti-waini pẹlu ororo kò le lọrọ̀.
entries.en: He that loveth pleasure shall be a poor man: he that loveth wine and oil shall not be rich.

entries.yo: Enia buburu ni yio ṣe owo-irapada fun olododo, ati olurekọja ni ipò ẹni diduro-ṣinṣin.
entries.en: The wicked shall be a ransom for the righteous, and the transgressor for the upright.

entries.yo: O san lati joko li aginju jù pẹlu onija obinrin ati oṣónu lọ.
entries.en: It is better to dwell in the wilderness, than with a contentious and an angry woman.

entries.yo: Iṣura fifẹ ati ororo wà ni ibugbe ọlọgbọ́n; ṣugbọn enia aṣiwère ná a bajẹ.
entries.en: There is treasure to be desired and oil in the dwelling of the wise; but a foolish man spendeth it up.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba tẹle ododo ati ãnu, a ri ìye, ododo, ati ọlá.
entries.en: He that followeth after righteousness and mercy findeth life, righteousness, and honour.

entries.yo: Ọlọgbọ́n gùn odi ilu awọn alagbara, a si fi idi agbara igbẹkẹle rẹ̀ jalẹ̀.
entries.en: A wise man scaleth the city of the mighty, and casteth down the strength of the confidence thereof.

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni ti o ba pa ẹnu ati ahọn rẹ̀ mọ́, o pa ọkàn rẹ̀ mọ́ kuro ninu iyọnu.
entries.en: Whoso keepeth his mouth and his tongue keepeth his soul from troubles.

entries.yo: Agberaga ati agidi ẹlẹgàn li orukọ rẹ̀, ẹniti nhùwa ninu ibinu pupọpupọ.
entries.en: Proud and haughty scorner is his name, who dealeth in proud wrath.

entries.yo: Ifẹ ọlẹ pa a; nitoriti, ọwọ rẹ̀ kọ̀ iṣẹ ṣiṣe.
entries.en: The desire of the slothful killeth him; for his hands refuse to labour.

entries.yo: O nfi ilara ṣojukokoro ni gbogbo ọjọ: ṣugbọn olododo a ma fi funni kì si idawọduro.
entries.en: He coveteth greedily all the day long: but the righteous giveth and spareth not.

entries.yo: Ẹbọ enia buburu, irira ni: melomelo ni nigbati o mu u wá ti on ti ìwakiwa rẹ̀?
entries.en: The sacrifice of the wicked is abomination: how much more, when he bringeth it with a wicked mind?

entries.yo: Ẹlẹri eke yio ṣegbe: ṣugbọn ẹniti o gbọ́, yio ma sọ̀rọ li aiyannu.
entries.en: A false witness shall perish: but the man that heareth speaketh constantly.

entries.yo: Enia buburu gbè oju rẹ̀ le: ṣugbọn ẹni iduro-ṣinṣin li o nmu ọ̀na rẹ̀ tọ̀.
entries.en: A wicked man hardeneth his face: but as for the upright, he directeth his way.

entries.yo: Kò si ọgbọ́n, kò si imoye, tabi ìgbimọ si Oluwa.
entries.en: There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against the LORD.

entries.yo: A mura ẹṣin silẹ de ọjọ ogun: ṣugbọn iṣẹgun lati ọwọ Oluwa ni.
entries.en: The horse is prepared against the day of battle: but safety is of the LORD.

entries.yo: ORUKỌ rere sàn ni yiyàn jù ọrọ̀ pupọ lọ, ati ojurere ifẹ jù fadaka ati wura lọ.
entries.en: A good name is rather to be chosen than great riches, and loving favour rather than silver and gold.

entries.yo: Ọlọrọ̀ ati talaka pejọ pọ̀: Oluwa li ẹlẹda gbogbo wọn.
entries.en: The rich and poor meet together: the LORD is the maker of them all.

entries.yo: Ọlọgbọ́n enia ti ri ibi tẹlẹ, o si pa ara rẹ̀ mọ́: ṣugbọn awọn òpe a kọja, a si jẹ wọn niya.
entries.en: A prudent man foreseeth the evil, and hideth himself: but the simple pass on, and are punished.

entries.yo: Ere irẹlẹ ati ibẹ̀ru Oluwa li ọrọ̀, ọlá, ati ìye.
entries.en: By humility and the fear of the LORD are riches, and honour, and life.

entries.yo: Ẹgún ati idẹkùn mbẹ li ọ̀na alayidayida: ẹniti o ba pa ọkàn rẹ̀ mọ́ yio jina si wọn.
entries.en: Thorns and snares are in the way of the froward: he that doth keep his soul shall be far from them.

entries.yo: Tọ́ ọmọde li ọ̀na ti yio tọ̀: nigbati o si dàgba tan, kì yio kuro ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: Train up a child in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.

entries.yo: Ọlọrọ̀ ṣe olori olupọnju, ajigbese si ṣe iranṣẹ fun onigbese.
entries.en: The rich ruleth over the poor, and the borrower is servant to the lender.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba funrugbin ẹ̀ṣẹ, yio ri asan ka: ọpá ibinu rẹ̀ si ti mura tan.
entries.en: He that soweth iniquity shall reap vanity: and the rod of his anger shall fail.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o li oju ãnu li a o bukun fun; nitoriti o fi ninu onjẹ rẹ̀ fun olupọnju.
entries.en: He that hath a bountiful eye shall be blessed; for he giveth of his bread to the poor.

entries.yo: Ṣá ẹlẹgàn tì sode, ìja yio si jade; nitõtọ ìja ati ẹ̀gan yio dẹkun.
entries.en: Cast out the scorner, and contention shall go out; yea, strife and reproach shall cease.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o fẹ ìwa funfun aiya, ti o fẹ ọ̀rọ pẹlẹ, ọba yio ṣe ọrẹ́ rẹ̀.
entries.en: He that loveth pureness of heart, for the grace of his lips the king shall be his friend.

entries.yo: Oju Oluwa pa ìmọ mọ́, o si yi ọ̀rọ olurekọja po.
entries.en: The eyes of the LORD preserve knowledge, and he overthroweth the words of the transgressor.

entries.yo: Ọlẹ wipe, kiniun mbẹ lode, a o pa mi ni igboro.
entries.en: The slothful man saith, There is a lion without, I shall be slain in the streets.

entries.yo: Ẹnu awọn ajeji obinrin, iho jijin ni; ẹniti a mbinu si lati ọdọ Oluwa wá ni yio ṣubu sinu rẹ̀.
entries.en: The mouth of strange women is a deep pit: he that is abhorred of the LORD shall fall therein.

entries.yo: Li aiya ọmọde ni wère dì si; ṣugbọn paṣan itọ́ni ni yio le e jina kuro lọdọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Foolishness is bound in the heart of a child; but the rod of correction shall drive it far from him.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o nni talaka lara lati mu ọrọ̀ pọ̀, ti o si nta ọlọrọ̀ lọrẹ, yio di alaini bi o ti wu ki o ṣe.
entries.en: He that oppresseth the poor to increase his riches, and he that giveth to the rich, shall surely come to want.

entries.yo: Dẹti rẹ silẹ, ki o gbọ́ ọ̀rọ awọn ọlọgbọ́n, ki o si fi aiya rẹ si ẹkọ́ mi.
entries.en: Bow down thine ear, and hear the words of the wise, and apply thine heart unto my knowledge.

entries.yo: Nitori ohun didùn ni bi iwọ ba pa wọn mọ́ ni inu rẹ; nigbati a si pese wọn tan li ète rẹ.
entries.en: For it is a pleasant thing if thou keep them within thee; they shall withal be fitted in thy lips.

entries.yo: Ki igbẹkẹle rẹ ki o le wà niti Oluwa, emi fi hàn ọ loni, ani fun ọ.
entries.en: That thy trust may be in the LORD, I have made known to thee this day, even to thee.

entries.yo: Emi kò ti kọwe ohun daradara si ọ ni igbimọ ati li ẹkọ́,
entries.en: Have not I written to thee excellent things in counsels and knowledge,

entries.yo: Ki emi ki o le mu ọ mọ̀ idaju ọ̀rọ otitọ; ki iwọ ki o le ma fi idahùn otitọ fun awọn ti o rán ọ?
entries.en: That I might make thee know the certainty of the words of truth; that thou mightest answer the words of truth to them that send unto thee?

entries.yo: Máṣe ja talaka li ole, nitori ti iṣe talaka: bẹ̃ni ki o má si ṣe ni olupọnju lara ni ibode:
entries.en: Rob not the poor, because he is poor: neither oppress the afflicted in the gate:

entries.yo: Nitori Oluwa yio gbija wọn, yio si gbà ọkàn awọn ti ngbà lọwọ wọn.
entries.en: For the LORD will plead their cause, and spoil the soul of those that spoiled them.

entries.yo: Máṣe ba onibinu enia ṣe ọrẹ́; má si ṣe ba ọkunrin oninu-fùfu rìn.
entries.en: Make no friendship with an angry man; and with a furious man thou shalt not go:

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o má ba kọ́ ìwa rẹ̀, iwọ a si gbà ikẹkùn fun ara rẹ.
entries.en: Lest thou learn his ways, and get a snare to thy soul.

entries.yo: Máṣe wà ninu awọn ti nṣe igbọwọ, tabi ninu awọn ti o duro fun gbèse.
entries.en: Be not thou one of them that strike hands, or of them that are sureties for debts.

entries.yo: Bi iwọ kò ba ni nkan ti iwọ o fi san, nitori kini yio ṣe gbà ẹní rẹ kuro labẹ rẹ?
entries.en: If thou hast nothing to pay, why should he take away thy bed from under thee?

entries.yo: Máṣe yẹ̀ àla ilẹ igbàni, ti awọn baba rẹ ti pa.
entries.en: Remove not the ancient landmark, which thy fathers have set.

entries.yo: Iwọ ri enia ti o nfi aiṣemẹlẹ ṣe iṣẹ rẹ̀? on o duro niwaju awọn ọba; on kì yio duro niwaju awọn enia lasan.
entries.en: Seest thou a man diligent in his business? he shall stand before kings; he shall not stand before mean men.

entries.yo: NIGBATI iwọ ba joko lati ba ijoye jẹun, kiyesi ẹniti o wà niwaju rẹ gidigidi.
entries.en: When thou sittest to eat with a ruler, consider diligently what is before thee:

entries.yo: Ki o si fi ọbẹ le ara rẹ li ọfun, bi iwọ ba iṣe okundùn enia.
entries.en: And put a knife to thy throat, if thou be a man given to appetite.

entries.yo: Máṣe fẹ onjẹ-didùn rẹ̀: nitoripe onjẹ ẹ̀tan ni.
entries.en: Be not desirous of his dainties: for they are deceitful meat.

entries.yo: Máṣe lãla ati lọrọ̀: ṣiwọ kuro ninu imoye ara rẹ.
entries.en: Labour not to be rich: cease from thine own wisdom.

entries.yo: Iwọ o ha fi oju rẹ wò o? kì yio si si mọ, nitoriti ọrọ̀ hu iyẹ-apá fun ara rẹ̀ bi ìdi ti nfò li oju ọrun.
entries.en: Wilt thou set thine eyes upon that which is not? for riches certainly make themselves wings; they fly away as an eagle toward heaven.

entries.yo: Máṣe jẹ onjẹ oloju buburu, bẹ̃ni ki o má si ṣe fẹ onjẹ-didùn rẹ̀.
entries.en: Eat thou not the bread of him that hath an evil eye, neither desire thou his dainty meats:

entries.yo: Nitoripe bi o ti nṣiro li ọkàn rẹ̀, bẹ̃ li o ri: mã jẹ, ki o si ma mu li o nwi fun ọ; ṣugbọn ọkàn rẹ̀ kò pẹlu rẹ.
entries.en: For as he thinketh in his heart, so is he: Eat and drink, saith he to thee; but his heart is not with thee.

entries.yo: Okele ti iwọ jẹ ni iwọ o pọ̀ jade, iwọ a si sọ ọ̀rọ didùn rẹ nù.
entries.en: The morsel which thou hast eaten shalt thou vomit up, and lose thy sweet words.

entries.yo: Máṣe sọ̀rọ li eti aṣiwère: nitoriti yio gàn ọgbọ́n ọ̀rọ rẹ.
entries.en: Speak not in the ears of a fool: for he will despise the wisdom of thy words.

entries.yo: Máṣe ṣi àla atijọ; má si ṣe bọ sinu oko alaini-baba.
entries.en: Remove not the old landmark; and enter not into the fields of the fatherless:

entries.yo: Nitoripe Olurapada wọn lagbara; yio gbà ìja wọn ja ti awọn tirẹ.
entries.en: For their redeemer is mighty; he shall plead their cause with thee.

entries.yo: Fi aiya si ẹkọ́, ati eti rẹ si ọ̀rọ ìmọ.
entries.en: Apply thine heart unto instruction, and thine ears to the words of knowledge.

entries.yo: Máṣe fà ọwọ ibawi sẹhin kuro lara ọmọde, nitoripe bi iwọ ba fi paṣan nà a, on kì yio kú.
entries.en: Withhold not correction from the child: for if thou beatest him with the rod, he shall not die.

entries.yo: Iwọ fi paṣan nà a, iwọ o si gbà ọkàn rẹ̀ la kuro li ọrun-apadi.
entries.en: Thou shalt beat him with the rod, and shalt deliver his soul from hell.

entries.yo: Ọmọ mi, bi ọkàn rẹ ba gbọ́n ọkàn mi yio yọ̀, ani emi pẹlu.
entries.en: My son, if thine heart be wise, my heart shall rejoice, even mine.

entries.yo: Inu mi yio si dùn nigbati ètè rẹ ba nsọ̀rọ titọ.
entries.en: Yea, my reins shall rejoice, when thy lips speak right things.

entries.yo: Máṣe jẹ ki aiya rẹ ki o ṣe ilara si awọn ẹ̀lẹṣẹ, ṣugbọn ki iwọ ki o wà ni ibẹ̀ru Oluwa, li ọjọ gbogbo.
entries.en: Let not thine heart envy sinners: but be thou in the fear of the LORD all the day long.

entries.yo: Nitoripe ikẹhin mbẹ nitõtọ; ireti rẹ kì yio si ke kuro.
entries.en: For surely there is an end; and thine expectation shall not be cut off.

entries.yo: Gbọ́, iwọ ọmọ mi, ki iwọ ki o si gbọ́n, ki iwọ ki o si ma tọ́ aiya rẹ si ọ̀na titọ.
entries.en: Hear thou, my son, and be wise, and guide thine heart in the way.

entries.yo: Máṣe wà ninu awọn ọmuti; ninu awọn ti mba ẹran-ara awọn tikarawọn jẹ.
entries.en: Be not among winebibbers; among riotous eaters of flesh:

entries.yo: Nitoripe ọmuti ati ọjẹun ni yio di talaka; ọlẹ ni yio si fi akisa bò ara rẹ̀.
entries.en: For the drunkard and the glutton shall come to poverty: and drowsiness shall clothe a man with rags.

entries.yo: Fetisi ti baba rẹ ti o bi ọ, má si ṣe gàn iya rẹ, nigbati o ba gbó.
entries.en: Hearken unto thy father that begat thee, and despise not thy mother when she is old.

entries.yo: Ra otitọ, ki o má si ṣe tà a; ọgbọ́n pẹlu ati ẹkọ́, ati imoye.
entries.en: Buy the truth, and sell it not; also wisdom, and instruction, and understanding.

entries.yo: Baba olododo ni yio yọ̀ gidigidi: ẹniti o si bi ọmọ ọlọgbọ́n, yio ni ayọ̀ ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: The father of the righteous shall greatly rejoice: and he that begetteth a wise child shall have joy of him.

entries.yo: Baba rẹ ati iya rẹ yio yọ̀, inu ẹniti o bi ọ yio dùn.
entries.en: Thy father and thy mother shall be glad, and she that bare thee shall rejoice.

entries.yo: Ọmọ mi, fi aiya rẹ fun mi, ki o si jẹ ki oju rẹ ki o ni inu-didùn si ọ̀na mi.
entries.en: My son, give me thine heart, and let thine eyes observe my ways.

entries.yo: Nitoripe agbere, iho jijin ni; ati ajeji obinrin, iho hiha ni.
entries.en: For a whore is a deep ditch; and a strange woman is a narrow pit.

entries.yo: On a si ba ni ibuba bi ole, a si sọ awọn olurekọja di pupọ ninu awọn enia.
entries.en: She also lieth in wait as for a prey, and increaseth the transgressors among men.

entries.yo: Tali o ni òṣi? tali o ni ibinujẹ? tali o ni ijà? tali o ni asọ̀? tali o ni ọgbẹ lainidi, tali o ni oju pipọn.
entries.en: Who hath woe? who hath sorrow? who hath contentions? who hath babbling? who hath wounds without cause? who hath redness of eyes?

entries.yo: Awọn ti o duro pẹ nibi ọti-waini; awọn ti nlọ idan ọti-waini àdalu wò.
entries.en: They that tarry long at the wine; they that go to seek mixed wine.

entries.yo: Iwọ máṣe wò ọti-waini pe o pọn, nigbati o ba fi àwọ rẹ̀ han ninu ago, ti a ngbe e mì, ti o ndùn.
entries.en: Look not thou upon the wine when it is red, when it giveth his colour in the cup, when it moveth itself aright.

entries.yo: Nikẹhin on a buniṣán bi ejò, a si bunijẹ bi paramọlẹ.
entries.en: At the last it biteth like a serpent, and stingeth like an adder.

entries.yo: Oju rẹ yio wò awọn ajeji obinrin, aiya rẹ yio si sọ̀rọ ayidayida.
entries.en: Thine eyes shall behold strange women, and thine heart shall utter perverse things.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ, iwọ o dabi ẹniti o dubulẹ li arin okun, tabi ẹniti o dubulẹ lòke òpó-ọkọ̀.
entries.en: Yea, thou shalt be as he that lieth down in the midst of the sea, or as he that lieth upon the top of a mast.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si wipe, nwọn lù mi; kò dùn mi; nwọn lù mi, emi kò si mọ̀: nigbawo li emi o ji? emi o tun ma wá a kiri.
entries.en: They have stricken me, shalt thou say, and I was not sick; they have beaten me, and I felt it not: when shall I awake? I will seek it yet again.

entries.yo: IWỌ máṣe ilara si awọn enia buburu, bẹ̃ni ki o má si ṣe fẹ lati ba wọn gbe.
entries.en: Be not thou envious against evil men, neither desire to be with them.

entries.yo: Nitoriti aiya wọn ngbiro iparun, ète wọn si nsọ̀rọ ìwa-ika.
entries.en: For their heart studieth destruction, and their lips talk of mischief.

entries.yo: Ọgbọ́n li a fi ikọ ile; oye li a si fi ifi idi rẹ̀ kalẹ.
entries.en: Through wisdom is an house builded; and by understanding it is established:

entries.yo: Nipa ìmọ ni iyará fi ikún fun oniruru ọrọ̀ iyebiye ati didùn.
entries.en: And by knowledge shall the chambers be filled with all precious and pleasant riches.

entries.yo: Ọlọgbọ́n enia li agbara: nitõtọ enia ìmọ a sọ agbara rẹ̀ di pupọ.
entries.en: A wise man is strong; yea, a man of knowledge increaseth strength.

entries.yo: Nitori nipa ìgbimọ ọgbọ́n ni iwọ o fi ṣigun rẹ: ati ninu ọ̀pọlọpọ ìgbimọ ni iṣẹgun.
entries.en: For by wise counsel thou shalt make thy war: and in multitude of counsellers there is safety.

entries.yo: Ọgbọ́n ga jù aṣiwère lọ: on kì yio yà ẹnu rẹ̀ ni ẹnu-bode.
entries.en: Wisdom is too high for a fool: he openeth not his mouth in the gate.

entries.yo: Ẹniti nhùmọ ati ṣe ibi li a o pè li enia ìwa-ika.
entries.en: He that deviseth to do evil shall be called a mischievous person.

entries.yo: Ironu wère li ẹ̀ṣẹ; irira ninu enia si li ẹlẹgàn.
entries.en: The thought of foolishness is sin: and the scorner is an abomination to men.

entries.yo: Bi iwọ ba rẹwẹsi li ọjọ ipọnju, agbara rẹ ko to nkan.
entries.en: If thou faint in the day of adversity, thy strength is small.

entries.yo: Bi iwọ ba fà sẹhin ati gbà awọn ti a wọ́ lọ sinu ikú, ati awọn ti a yàn fun pipa.
entries.en: If thou forbear to deliver them that are drawn unto death, and those that are ready to be slain;

entries.yo: Ti iwọ si wipe, wò o, awa kò mọ̀ ọ; kò ha jẹ pe ẹniti ndiwọ̀n ọkàn nkiyesi i? ati ẹniti npa ọkàn rẹ mọ́, on li o mọ̀, yio si san a fun enia gẹgẹ bi iṣẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: If thou sayest, Behold, we knew it not; doth not he that pondereth the heart consider it? and he that keepeth thy soul, doth not he know it? and shall not he render to every man according to his works?

entries.yo: Ọmọ mi, jẹ oyin, nitoriti o dara; ati afara oyin, ti o dùn li ẹnu rẹ:
entries.en: My son, eat thou honey, because it is good; and the honeycomb, which is sweet to thy taste:

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni ìmọ ọgbọ́n yio ri si ọkàn rẹ: bi iwọ ba ri i, nigbana ni ère yio wà, a kì yio si ke ireti rẹ kuro.
entries.en: So shall the knowledge of wisdom be unto thy soul: when thou hast found it, then there shall be a reward, and thy expectation shall not be cut off.

entries.yo: Máṣe ba ni ibuba bi enia buburu, lati gba ibujoko olododo: máṣe fi ibi isimi rẹ̀ ṣe ijẹ.
entries.en: Lay not wait, O wicked man, against the dwelling of the righteous; spoil not his resting place:

entries.yo: Nitoripe olõtọ a ṣubu nigba meje, a si tun dide: ṣugbọn enia buburu yio ṣubu sinu ibi.
entries.en: For a just man falleth seven times, and riseth up again: but the wicked shall fall into mischief.

entries.yo: Máṣe yọ̀ nigbati ọta rẹ ba ṣubu, má si ṣe jẹ ki inu rẹ ki o dùn nigbati o ba kọsẹ̀:
entries.en: Rejoice not when thine enemy falleth, and let not thine heart be glad when he stumbleth:

entries.yo: Ki Oluwa ki o má ba ri i, ki o si buru li oju rẹ̀, on a si yi ibinu rẹ̀ pada kuro lori rẹ̀.
entries.en: Lest the LORD see it, and it displease him, and he turn away his wrath from him.

entries.yo: Máṣe ilara si awọn enia buburu, má si ṣe jowu enia buburu.
entries.en: Fret not thyself because of evil men, neither be thou envious at the wicked;

entries.yo: Nitoripe, ère kì yio si fun enia ibi; fitila enia buburu li a o pa.
entries.en: For there shall be no reward to the evil man; the candle of the wicked shall be put out.

entries.yo: Ọmọ mi, iwọ bẹ̀ru Oluwa ati ọba: ki iwọ ki o má si ṣe dàpọ mọ awọn ti nṣe ayidayida.
entries.en: My son, fear thou the LORD and the king: and meddle not with them that are given to change:

entries.yo: Nitoripe wàhala wọn yio dide lojiji, ati iparun awọn mejeji, tali o mọ̀ ọ!
entries.en: For their calamity shall rise suddenly; and who knoweth the ruin of them both?

entries.yo: Wọnyi pẹlu ni ọ̀rọ awọn ọlọgbọ́n. Kò dara lati ṣe ojuṣãju ni idajọ.
entries.en: These things also belong to the wise. It is not good to have respect of persons in judgment.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba wi fun enia buburu pe, olododo ni iwọ; on ni awọn enia yio bú, awọn orilẹ-ède yio si korira rẹ̀.
entries.en: He that saith unto the wicked, Thou are righteous; him shall the people curse, nations shall abhor him:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn ti o ba a wi ni yio ni inu-didùn, ibukún rere yio si bọ̀ sori wọn.
entries.en: But to them that rebuke him shall be delight, and a good blessing shall come upon them.

entries.yo: Yio dabi ẹniti o ṣe ifẹnukonu: ẹniti o ba ṣe idahùn rere.
entries.en: Every man shall kiss his lips that giveth a right answer.

entries.yo: Mura iṣẹ rẹ silẹ lode, ki o si fi itara tulẹ li oko rẹ; nikẹhin eyi, ki o si kọ́ ile rẹ.
entries.en: Prepare thy work without, and make it fit for thyself in the field; and afterwards build thine house.

entries.yo: Máṣe ẹlẹri si ẹnikeji rẹ lainidi: ki iwọ ki o má si ṣe fi ète rẹ ṣẹ̀tan.
entries.en: Be not a witness against thy neighbour without cause; and deceive not with thy lips.

entries.yo: Máṣe wipe, bẹ̃li emi o ṣe si i, gẹgẹ bi o ti ṣe si mi: emi o san a fun ọkunrin na gẹgẹ bi iṣẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Say not, I will do so to him as he hath done to me: I will render to the man according to his work.

entries.yo: Mo kọja lọ li oko ọlẹ, ati lẹba ọgbà-ajara ẹniti oye kù fun:
entries.en: I went by the field of the slothful, and by the vineyard of the man void of understanding;

entries.yo: Si kiyesi i, ẹgún kún bo gbogbo rẹ̀, igbó si bo oju rẹ̀, iganna okuta rẹ̀ si wo lulẹ.
entries.en: And, lo, it was all grown over with thorns, and nettles had covered the face thereof, and the stone wall thereof was broken down.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni mo ri, mo si fi ọkàn mi si i gidigidi: mo wò o, mo si gbà ẹkọ́.
entries.en: Then I saw, and considered it well: I looked upon it, and received instruction.

entries.yo: Orun diẹ si i, õgbe diẹ, ikawọkòpọ lati sùn diẹ.
entries.en: Yet a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li òṣi rẹ yio de bi ẹniti nrìn; ati aini rẹ bi ọkunrin ti o hamọra ogun.
entries.en: So shall thy poverty come as one that travelleth; and thy want as an armed man.

entries.yo: WỌNYI pẹlu li owe Solomoni, ti awọn ọkunrin Hesekiah, ọba Judah kọ silẹ.
entries.en: These are also proverbs of Solomon, which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied out.

entries.yo: Ogo Ọlọrun ni lati pa ọ̀ran mọ́: ṣugbọn ọlá awọn ọba ni lati wadi ọ̀ran.
entries.en: It is the glory of God to conceal a thing: but the honour of kings is to search out a matter.

entries.yo: Ọrun fun giga, ati ilẹ fun jijin bẹ̃ni a kò le iwadi aiya awọn ọba.
entries.en: The heaven for height, and the earth for depth, and the heart of kings is unsearchable.

entries.yo: Mu idarọ kuro ninu fadaka, ohun-elo yio si jade fun alagbẹdẹ fadaka.
entries.en: Take away the dross from the silver, and there shall come forth a vessel for the finer.

entries.yo: Mu enia buburu kuro niwaju ọba, a o si fi idi itẹ́ rẹ̀ kalẹ ninu ododo.
entries.en: Take away the wicked from before the king, and his throne shall be established in righteousness.

entries.yo: Máṣe ṣefefe niwaju ọba, má si ṣe duro ni ipò awọn enia nla.
entries.en: Put not forth thyself in the presence of the king, and stand not in the place of great men:

entries.yo: Nitoripe, o san ki a wi fun ọ pe, wá soke nihin, jù ki a fà ọ tì sẹhin niwaju ọmọ-alade ti oju rẹ ti ri.
entries.en: For better it is that it be said unto thee, Come up hither; than that thou shouldest be put lower in the presence of the prince whom thine eyes have seen.

entries.yo: Máṣe jade lọ kankan lati jà, ki iwọ ki o má ba ṣe alaimọ̀ eyiti iwọ o ṣe li opin rẹ̀, nigbati aladugbo rẹ yio dojutì ọ.
entries.en: Go not forth hastily to strive, lest thou know not what to do in the end thereof, when thy neighbour hath put thee to shame.

entries.yo: Ba ẹnikeji rẹ ja ìja rẹ̀; ṣugbọn aṣiri ẹlomiran ni iwọ kò gbọdọ fihàn.
entries.en: Debate thy cause with thy neighbour himself; and discover not a secret to another:

entries.yo: Ki ẹniti o ba gbọ́ ki o má ba dojuti ọ, ẹ̀gan rẹ kì yio si lọ kuro lai.
entries.en: Lest he that heareth it put thee to shame, and thine infamy turn not away.

entries.yo: Bi eso igi wura ninu agbọ̀n fadaka, bẹ̃ni ọ̀rọ ti a sọ li akoko rẹ̀.
entries.en: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in pictures of silver.

entries.yo: Bi oruka wura ati ohun ọṣọ́ wura daradara, bẹ̃li ọlọgbọ́n olubaniwi li eti igbọràn.
entries.en: As an earring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, so is a wise reprover upon an obedient ear.

entries.yo: Bi otutu òjo-didì ni ìgba ikore, bẹ̃ni olõtọ ikọ̀ si awọn ti o rán a: nitoriti o tù awọn oluwa rẹ̀ ninu.
entries.en: As the cold of snow in the time of harvest, so is a faithful messenger to them that send him: for he refresheth the soul of his masters.

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni ti o ba ṣefefe ninu ẹ̀bun ẹ̀tan, o dabi awọsanma ati afẹfẹ ti kò ni òjo.
entries.en: Whoso boasteth himself of a false gift is like clouds and wind without rain.

entries.yo: Ipamọra pipẹ li a fi iyi ọmọ-alade li ọkàn pada, ahọn ti o kunna ni ifọ egungun.
entries.en: By long forbearing is a prince persuaded, and a soft tongue breaketh the bone.

entries.yo: Bi iwọ ba ri oyin, jẹ eyi ti o to fun ọ, ki o má ba su ọ, iwọ a si bì i.
