entries.en: Hast thou found honey? eat so much as is sufficient for thee, lest thou be filled therewith, and vomit it.

entries.yo: Fà ẹṣẹ sẹhin kuro ni ile aladugbo rẹ; ki agara rẹ o má ba da a, on a si korira rẹ.
entries.en: Withdraw thy foot from thy neighbour's house; lest he be weary of thee, and so hate thee.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o jẹri eke si ẹnikeji rẹ̀, ni olugboro, ati idà, ati ọfà mimu.
entries.en: A man that beareth false witness against his neighbour is a maul, and a sword, and a sharp arrow.

entries.yo: Igbẹkẹle alaiṣõtọ enia ni ìgba ipọnju, o dabi ehin ti o ṣẹ́, ati ẹsẹ̀ ti o yẹ̀ lori ike.
entries.en: Confidence in an unfaithful man in time of trouble is like a broken tooth, and a foot out of joint.

entries.yo: Bi ẹniti o bọ aṣọ nigba otutu, ati bi ọti-kikan ninu ẽru, bẹ̃li ẹniti nkọrin fun ẹniti inu rẹ̀ bajẹ.
entries.en: As he that taketh away a garment in cold weather, and as vinegar upon nitre, so is he that singeth songs to an heavy heart.

entries.yo: Bi ebi ba npa ọta rẹ, fun u li onjẹ; bi ongbẹ ba si gbẹ ẹ, fun u li ohun mimu.
entries.en: If thine enemy be hungry, give him bread to eat; and if he be thirsty, give him water to drink:

entries.yo: Nitoriti iwọ o kó ẹyin iná jọ si ori rẹ̀, Oluwa yio san fun ọ.
entries.en: For thou shalt heap coals of fire upon his head, and the LORD shall reward thee.

entries.yo: Afẹfẹ ariwa mu òjo wá, bẹ̃li ahọn isọ̀rọ-ẹni-lẹhin imu oju kikoro wá.
entries.en: The north wind driveth away rain: so doth an angry countenance a backbiting tongue.

entries.yo: O san lati joko ni igun òke àja, jù pẹlu onija obinrin lọ ninu ile ajumọgbe.
entries.en: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop, than with a brawling woman and in a wide house.

entries.yo: Bi omi tutu si ọkàn ti ongbẹ ngbẹ, bẹ̃ni ihin-rere lati ilu okere wá.
entries.en: As cold waters to a thirsty soul, so is good news from a far country.

entries.yo: Olododo ti o ṣipo pada niwaju enia buburu, o dabi orisun ti o wú, ati isun-omi ti o bajẹ.
entries.en: A righteous man falling down before the wicked is as a troubled fountain, and a corrupt spring.

entries.yo: Kò dara lati mã jẹ oyin pupọ: bẹni kò dara lati mã wa ogo ara ẹni.
entries.en: It is not good to eat much honey: so for men to search their own glory is not glory.

entries.yo: Ẹniti kò le ṣe akoso ara rẹ̀, o dabi ilu ti a wo lulẹ, ti kò si li odi.
entries.en: He that hath no rule over his own spirit is like a city that is broken down, and without walls.

entries.yo: BI òjo-didì ni ìgba ẹrun, ati bi òjo ni ìgba ikore, bẹ̃li ọlá kò yẹ fun aṣiwère.
entries.en: As snow in summer, and as rain in harvest, so honour is not seemly for a fool.

entries.yo: Bi ẹiyẹ fun iṣikiri, ati alapandẹdẹ fun fifò, bẹ̃ni egún kì yio wá lainidi.
entries.en: As the bird by wandering, as the swallow by flying, so the curse causeless shall not come.

entries.yo: Lagbà fun ẹṣin, ijanu fun kẹtẹkẹtẹ, ati ọgọ fun ẹhin aṣiwère.
entries.en: A whip for the horse, a bridle for the ass, and a rod for the fool's back.

entries.yo: Máṣe da aṣiwère lohùn gẹgẹ bi wère rẹ̀, ki iwọ pãpa ki o má ba dabi rẹ̀.
entries.en: Answer not a fool according to his folly, lest thou also be like unto him.

entries.yo: Da aṣiwère lohùn gẹgẹ bi wère rẹ̀, ki on ki o má ba gbọ́n li oju ara rẹ̀.
entries.en: Answer a fool according to his folly, lest he be wise in his own conceit.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o rán iṣẹ nipa ọwọ aṣiwère, o ke ẹsẹ ara rẹ̀ kuro, o si jẹ ara rẹ̀ niya.
entries.en: He that sendeth a message by the hand of a fool cutteth off the feet, and drinketh damage.

entries.yo: Bi ẹsẹ mejeji ti rọ̀ silẹ lara amukun, bẹ̃li owe li ẹnu awọn aṣiwère.
entries.en: The legs of the lame are not equal: so is a parable in the mouth of fools.

entries.yo: Bi ẹniti o fi àpo okuta iyebiye sinu okiti okuta, bẹ̃li ẹniti nfi ọlá fun aṣiwère.
entries.en: As he that bindeth a stone in a sling, so is he that giveth honour to a fool.

entries.yo: Bi ẹgún ti igún ọmuti lọwọ, bẹ̃li owe li ẹnu awọn aṣiwère.
entries.en: As a thorn goeth up into the hand of a drunkard, so is a parable in the mouth of fools.

entries.yo: Bi tafatafa ti o mu gbogbo enia gbọgbẹ, bẹ̃ni ẹniti o gbà aṣiwère si iṣẹ, ti o si gba awọn olurekọja si iṣẹ-owo.
entries.en: The great God that formed all things both rewardeth the fool, and rewardeth transgressors.

entries.yo: Bi aja ti ipada sinu ẽbì rẹ̀, bẹ̃li aṣiwère itun pada sinu wère rẹ̀.
entries.en: As a dog returneth to his vomit, so a fool returneth to his folly.

entries.yo: Iwọ ri ẹnikan ti o gbọ́n li oju ara rẹ̀? ireti mbẹ fun aṣiwère jù fun u lọ.
entries.en: Seest thou a man wise in his own conceit? there is more hope of a fool than of him.

entries.yo: Ọlẹ enia wipe, Kiniun mbẹ li ọ̀na; kiniun mbẹ ni igboro.
entries.en: The slothful man saith, There is a lion in the way; a lion is in the streets.

entries.yo: Bi ilẹkun ti iyi lori ìwakun rẹ̀, bẹ̃li ọlẹ lori ẹní rẹ̀.
entries.en: As the door turneth upon his hinges, so doth the slothful upon his bed.

entries.yo: Ọlẹ pa ọwọ rẹ̀ mọ́ sinu iṣãsun; kò si le yọ ọ jade pada wá si ẹnu rẹ̀.
entries.en: The slothful hideth his hand in his bosom; it grieveth him to bring it again to his mouth.

entries.yo: Ọlẹ gbọ́n li oju ara rẹ̀ jù enia meje lọ ti nwọn le fi ọgbọ́n dahùn ọ̀ran.
entries.en: The sluggard is wiser in his own conceit than seven men that can render a reason.

entries.yo: Ẹniti nkọja lọ, ti o si dasi ìja ti kì iṣe tirẹ̀, o dabi ẹniti o mu ajá leti.
entries.en: He that passeth by, and meddleth with strife belonging not to him, is like one that taketh a dog by the ears.

entries.yo: Bi asiwin ti nsọ ọ̀kọ, ọfa ati ikú,
entries.en: As a mad man who casteth firebrands, arrows, and death,

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li ẹniti o tan ẹnikeji rẹ̀ jẹ, ti o si wipe, Iré ha kọ li emi nṣe?
entries.en: So is the man that deceiveth his neighbour, and saith, Am not I in sport?

entries.yo: Nigbati igi tan, ina a kú, bẹ̃ni nigbati olofofo kò si, ìja a da.
entries.en: Where no wood is, there the fire goeth out: so where there is no talebearer, the strife ceaseth.

entries.yo: Bi ẹyin ti ri si ẹyin-iná, ati igi si iná; bẹ̃li enia onijà lati da ìja silẹ.
entries.en: As coals are to burning coals, and wood to fire; so is a contentious man to kindle strife.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ olofofo dabi adidùn, nwọn a si wọ isalẹ inu lọ.
entries.en: The words of a talebearer are as wounds, and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly.

entries.yo: Ete jijoni, ati aiya buburu, dabi idarọ fadaka ti a fi bò ìkoko.
entries.en: Burning lips and a wicked heart are like a potsherd covered with silver dross.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba korira, ti o fi ète rẹ̀ ṣe agabagebe, yio si pa ẹ̀tan mọ́ ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: He that hateth dissembleth with his lips, and layeth up deceit within him;

entries.yo: Nigbati o ba sọ̀rọ daradara, máṣe gbà a gbọ́: nitoripe irira meje li o wà li aiya rẹ̀,
entries.en: When he speaketh fair, believe him not: for there are seven abominations in his heart.

entries.yo: Ẹniti a fi ẹ̀tan bò irira rẹ̀ mọlẹ, ìwa-buburu rẹ̀ li a o fi hàn niwaju gbogbo ijọ:
entries.en: Whose hatred is covered by deceit, his wickedness shall be shewed before the whole congregation.

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni ti o ba wà ihò yio ṣubu sinu rẹ̀: ẹniti o ba si nyi okuta, on ni yio pada tọ̀.
entries.en: Whoso diggeth a pit shall fall therein: and he that rolleth a stone, it will return upon him.

entries.yo: Ahọn eke korira awọn ti a fi njẹniya; ẹnu ipọnni a si ma ṣiṣẹ iparun.
entries.en: A lying tongue hateth those that are afflicted by it; and a flattering mouth worketh ruin.

entries.yo: MÁṢE leri ara rẹ niti ọjọ ọla, nitoriti iwọ kò mọ̀ ohun ti ọjọ kan yio hù jade.
entries.en: Boast not thyself of to morrow; for thou knowest not what a day may bring forth.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki ẹlomiran ki o yìn ọ, ki o máṣe ẹnu ara rẹ; alejo, ki o má si ṣe ète ara rẹ.
entries.en: Let another man praise thee, and not thine own mouth; a stranger, and not thine own lips.

entries.yo: Okuta wuwo, yanrin si wuwo, ṣugbọn ibinu aṣiwère, o wuwo jù mejeji lọ.
entries.en: A stone is heavy, and the sand weighty; but a fool's wrath is heavier than them both.

entries.yo: Ibinu ni ìka, irunu si ni kikún-omi; ṣugbọn tani yio duro niwaju owú.
entries.en: Wrath is cruel, and anger is outrageous; but who is able to stand before envy?

entries.yo: Ibawi nigbangba, o san jù ifẹ ti o farasin lọ.
entries.en: Open rebuke is better than secret love.

entries.yo: Otitọ li ọgbẹ ọrẹ́: ṣugbọn ifẹnukonu ọta li ẹ̀tan.
entries.en: Faithful are the wounds of a friend; but the kisses of an enemy are deceitful.

entries.yo: Ọkàn ti o yó fi ẹsẹ tẹ afara-oyin; ṣugbọn ọkàn ti ebi npa, ohun kikoro gbogbo li o dùn.
entries.en: The full soul loatheth an honeycomb; but to the hungry soul every bitter thing is sweet.

entries.yo: Bi ẹiyẹ ti ima fò kiri lati inu itẹ́ rẹ̀, bẹ̃li enia ti o nrìn kiri jina si ipò rẹ̀.
entries.en: As a bird that wandereth from her nest, so is a man that wandereth from his place.

entries.yo: Ororo ati turari mu ọkàn dùn: bẹ̃ni adùn ọrẹ ẹni nipa ìgbimọ atọkànwa.
entries.en: Ointment and perfume rejoice the heart: so doth the sweetness of a man's friend by hearty counsel.

entries.yo: Ọrẹ́ rẹ ati ọrẹ́ baba rẹ, máṣe kọ̀ silẹ, bẹ̃ni ki iwọ ki o máṣe lọ si ile arakunrin li ọjọ idãmu rẹ: nitoripe aladugbo ti o sunmọ ni, o san jù arakunrin ti o jina rere lọ.
entries.en: Thine own friend, and thy father's friend, forsake not; neither go into thy brother's house in the day of thy calamity: for better is a neighbour that is near than a brother far off.

entries.yo: Ọmọ mi, ki iwọ ki o gbọ́n, ki o si mu inu mi dùn; ki emi ki o le da ẹniti ngàn mi lohùn.
entries.en: My son, be wise, and make my heart glad, that I may answer him that reproacheth me.

entries.yo: Amoye enia ri ibi tẹlẹ, o si pa ara rẹ̀ mọ́; ṣugbọn awọn òpe kọja a si jẹ wọn niya.
entries.en: A prudent man foreseeth the evil, and hideth himself; but the simple pass on, and are punished.

entries.yo: Gbà aṣọ rẹ̀ nitoriti o ṣe onigbọwọ alejo, si gbà ohun ẹri lọwọ rẹ̀ fun ajeji obinrin.
entries.en: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger, and take a pledge of him for a strange woman.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba ndide ni kutukutu ti o nfi ohùn rara kí ọrẹ́ rẹ̀, egún li a o kà a si fun u.
entries.en: He that blesseth his friend with a loud voice, rising early in the morning, it shall be counted a curse to him.

entries.yo: Ọṣọrọ-òjo li ọjọ òjo, ati onija obinrin, bakanna ni.
entries.en: A continual dropping in a very rainy day and a contentious woman are alike.

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni ti o pa a mọ́, o pa ẹfũfu mọ́, ororo ọwọ-ọtún rẹ̀ yio si fihàn.
entries.en: Whosoever hideth her hideth the wind, and the ointment of his right hand, which bewrayeth itself.

entries.yo: Irin a ma pọn irin: bẹ̃li ọkunrin ipọn oju ọrẹ́ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Iron sharpeneth iron; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend.

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni ti o tọju igi-ọpọtọ yio jẹ eso rẹ̀; bẹ̃li ẹniti o duro tì oluwa rẹ̀ li a o buyì fun.
entries.en: Whoso keepeth the fig tree shall eat the fruit thereof: so he that waiteth on his master shall be honoured.

entries.yo: Bi oju ti ikò oju li omi, bẹ̃li aiya enia si enia.
entries.en: As in water face answereth to face, so the heart of man to man.

entries.yo: Ipò-okú ati iparun kì ikún, bẹ̃ni kì isu oju enia.
entries.en: Hell and destruction are never full; so the eyes of man are never satisfied.

entries.yo: Bi koro fun fadaka, ati ileru fun wura, bẹ̃li enia si iyìn rẹ̀.
entries.en: As the fining pot for silver, and the furnace for gold; so is a man to his praise.

entries.yo: Bi iwọ tilẹ fi ọmọri-odó gún aṣiwère ninu odo larin alikama, wère rẹ̀ kì yio fi i silẹ.
entries.en: Though thou shouldest bray a fool in a mortar among wheat with a pestle, yet will not his foolishness depart from him.

entries.yo: Iwọ ma ṣaniyan ati mọ̀ ìwa agbo-ẹran rẹ, ki iwọ ki o si bojuto awọn ọwọ-ẹran rẹ.
entries.en: Be thou diligent to know the state of thy flocks, and look well to thy herds.

entries.yo: Nitoripe ọrọ̀ ki iwà titi lai: ade a ha si ma wà de irandiran?
entries.en: For riches are not for ever: and doth the crown endure to every generation?

entries.yo: Koriko yọ, ati ọmunú koriko fi ara han, ati ewebẹ̀ awọn òke kojọ pọ̀.
entries.en: The hay appeareth, and the tender grass sheweth itself, and herbs of the mountains are gathered.

entries.yo: Awọn ọdọ-agutan ni fun aṣọ rẹ, awọn obukọ si ni iye-owo oko.
entries.en: The lambs are for thy clothing, and the goats are the price of the field.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si ni wàra ewurẹ to fun onjẹ rẹ, fun onjẹ awọn ara ile rẹ, ati fun onjẹ awọn iranṣẹ-birin rẹ.
entries.en: And thou shalt have goats' milk enough for thy food, for the food of thy household, and for the maintenance for thy maidens.

entries.yo: ENIA buburu sá nigbati ẹnikan kò le e: ṣugbọn olododo laiya bi kiniun.
entries.en: The wicked flee when no man pursueth: but the righteous are bold as a lion.

entries.yo: Nipa irekọja ilẹ li awọn ijoye idi pupọ, ṣugbọn nipa amoye ati oni ìmọ̀ enia kan, li a mu ilẹ pẹ.
entries.en: For the transgression of a land many are the princes thereof: but by a man of understanding and knowledge the state thereof shall be prolonged.

entries.yo: Olupọnju ti o nni olupọnju lara, o dabi agbalọ òjo ti kò fi onjẹ silẹ.
entries.en: A poor man that oppresseth the poor is like a sweeping rain which leaveth no food.

entries.yo: Awọn ti o kọ̀ ofin silẹ a ma yìn enia buburu: ṣugbọn awọn ti o pa ofin mọ́ a ma binu si wọn.
entries.en: They that forsake the law praise the wicked: but such as keep the law contend with them.

entries.yo: Oye idajọ kò ye enia buburu: ṣugbọn awọn ti nṣe afẹri Oluwa moye ohun gbogbo.
entries.en: Evil men understand not judgment: but they that seek the LORD understand all things.

entries.yo: Talaka ti nrin ninu iduro-ṣinṣin rẹ̀, o san jù alarekereke ìwa, bi o tilẹ ṣe ọlọrọ̀.
entries.en: Better is the poor that walketh in his uprightness, than he that is perverse in his ways, though he be rich.

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni ti o pa ofin mọ́, o ṣe ọlọgbọ́n ọmọ: ṣugbọn ẹniti o ṣe ẹlẹgbẹ jẹguduragudu, o dojuti baba rẹ̀.
entries.en: Whoso keepeth the law is a wise son: but he that is a companion of riotous men shameth his father.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o fi elé ati ère aiṣõtọ sọ ọ̀rọ̀ rẹ̀ di pupọ, o kó o jọ fun ẹniti yio ṣãnu fun awọn talaka.
entries.en: He that by usury and unjust gain increaseth his substance, he shall gather it for him that will pity the poor.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o mu eti rẹ̀ kuro lati gbọ́ ofin, ani adura rẹ̀ pãpa yio di irira.
entries.en: He that turneth away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer shall be abomination.

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni ti o mu olododo ṣìna si ọ̀na buburu, ontikararẹ̀ yio bọ si iho, ṣugbọn aduro-ṣinṣin yio jogun ohun rere.
entries.en: Whoso causeth the righteous to go astray in an evil way, he shall fall himself into his own pit: but the upright shall have good things in possession.

entries.yo: Ọlọrọ̀ gbọ́n li oju ara rẹ̀: ṣugbọn talaka ti o moye ridi rẹ̀.
entries.en: The rich man is wise in his own conceit; but the poor that hath understanding searcheth him out.

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn olododo enia ba nyọ̀, ọṣọ́ nla a wà; ṣugbọn nigbati enia buburu ba dide, enia a sá pamọ́.
entries.en: When righteous men do rejoice, there is great glory: but when the wicked rise, a man is hidden.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o bo ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ̀ mọlẹ kì yio ṣe rere: ṣugbọn ẹnikẹni ti o jẹwọ ti o si kọ̀ ọ silẹ yio ri ãnu.
entries.en: He that covereth his sins shall not prosper: but whoso confesseth and forsaketh them shall have mercy.

entries.yo: Ibukún ni fun ẹniti o bẹ̀ru nigbagbogbo: ṣugbọn ẹniti o ba sé aiya rẹ̀ le ni yio ṣubu sinu ibi.
entries.en: Happy is the man that feareth alway: but he that hardeneth his heart shall fall into mischief.

entries.yo: Bi kiniun ti nke ramùramu, ati ẹranko beari ti nfi ebi sare kiri; bẹ̃ni ẹni buburu ti o joye lori awọn talaka.
entries.en: As a roaring lion, and a ranging bear; so is a wicked ruler over the poor people.

entries.yo: Ọmọ-alade ti o ṣe alaimoye pupọ ni iṣe ìwa-ika pupọ pẹlu: ṣugbọn eyiti o korira ojukokoro yio mu ọjọ rẹ̀ pẹ.
entries.en: The prince that wanteth understanding is also a great oppressor: but he that hateth covetousness shall prolong his days.

entries.yo: Enia ti o ba hù ìwa-ika si ẹ̀jẹ ẹnikeji, yio sá lọ si ihò: ki ẹnikan ki o máṣe mu u.
entries.en: A man that doeth violence to the blood of any person shall flee to the pit; let no man stay him.

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni ti o ba nrin dẽde ni yio là: ṣugbọn ẹniti o nfi ayidayida rìn loju ọ̀na meji, yio ṣubu ninu ọkan ninu wọn.
entries.en: Whoso walketh uprightly shall be saved: but he that is perverse in his ways shall fall at once.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba ro ilẹ rẹ̀ yio li ọ̀pọ onjẹ: ṣugbọn ẹniti o ba ntọ̀ enia asan lẹhin yio ni òṣi to.
entries.en: He that tilleth his land shall have plenty of bread: but he that followeth after vain persons shall have poverty enough.

entries.yo: Olõtọ enia yio pọ̀ fun ibukún: ṣugbọn ẹniti o kanju ati là kì yio ṣe alaijiya.
entries.en: A faithful man shall abound with blessings: but he that maketh haste to be rich shall not be innocent.

entries.yo: Iṣojuṣãju enia kò dara: nitoripe fun òkele onjẹ kan, ọkunrin na yio ṣẹ̀.
entries.en: To have respect of persons is not good: for for a piece of bread that man will transgress.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o kanju ati là, o li oju ilara, kò si rò pe òṣi mbọ̀wá ta on.
entries.en: He that hasteth to be rich hath an evil eye, and considereth not that poverty shall come upon him.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba enia wi yio ri ojurere ni ikẹhin jù ẹniti nfi ahọn pọn ọ lọ.
entries.en: He that rebuketh a man afterwards shall find more favour than he that flattereth with the tongue.

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni ti o ba nja baba tabi iya rẹ̀ li ole, ti o si wipe, kì iṣe ẹ̀ṣẹ; on na li ẹgbẹ apanirun.
entries.en: Whoso robbeth his father or his mother, and saith, It is no transgression; the same is the companion of a destroyer.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ṣe agberaga li aiya, a rú ìja soke, ṣugbọn ẹniti o gbẹkẹ rẹ̀ le Oluwa li a o mu sanra.
entries.en: He that is of a proud heart stirreth up strife: but he that putteth his trust in the LORD shall be made fat.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o gbẹkẹ le aiya ara rẹ̀, aṣiwère ni; ṣugbọn ẹnikẹni ti o ba nfi ọgbọ́n rìn, on li a o gbà la.
entries.en: He that trusteth in his own heart is a fool: but whoso walketh wisely, he shall be delivered.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba nfi fun olupọnju kì yio ṣe alaini: ṣugbọn ẹniti o mu oju rẹ̀ kuro, yio gbà egún pupọ.
entries.en: He that giveth unto the poor shall not lack: but he that hideth his eyes shall have many a curse.

entries.yo: Nigbati enia buburu ba hù, awọn enia a sá Owe pamọ́: ṣugbọn nigbati nwọn ba ṣegbe, awọn olododo a ma pọ̀ si i.
entries.en: When the wicked rise, men hide themselves: but when they perish, the righteous increase.

entries.yo: ẸNITI a ba mbawi ti o wà ọrùn kì, yio parun lojiji, laisi atunṣe.
entries.en: He, that being often reproved hardeneth his neck, shall suddenly be destroyed, and that without remedy.

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn olododo wà lori oyè, awọn enia a yọ̀; ṣugbọn nigbati enia buburu ba gori oyè, awọn enia a kẹdùn.
entries.en: When the righteous are in authority, the people rejoice: but when the wicked beareth rule, the people mourn.

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni ti o fẹ ọgbọ́n, a mu baba rẹ̀ yọ̀: ṣugbọn ẹniti o mba panṣaga kẹgbẹ, a ba ọrọ̀ rẹ̀ jẹ.
entries.en: Whoso loveth wisdom rejoiceth his father: but he that keepeth company with harlots spendeth his substance.

entries.yo: Nipa idajọ li ọba imu ilẹ tòro: ṣugbọn ẹniti o ba ngbà ọrẹ a bì i ṣubu.
entries.en: The king by judgment establisheth the land: but he that receiveth gifts overthroweth it.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o npọ́n ẹnikeji rẹ̀ ta àwọn silẹ fun ẹsẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: A man that flattereth his neighbour spreadeth a net for his feet.

entries.yo: Ninu irekọja enia ibi, ikẹkùn mbẹ: ṣugbọn olododo a ma kọrin, a si ma yọ̀.
entries.en: In the transgression of an evil man there is a snare: but the righteous doth sing and rejoice.

entries.yo: Olododo a ma rò ọ̀ran talaka: ṣugbọn enia buburu kò ṣú si i lati rò o.
entries.en: The righteous considereth the cause of the poor: but the wicked regardeth not to know it.

entries.yo: Awọn ẹlẹgàn enia da irukerudo si ilu: ṣugbọn awọn ọlọgbọ́n enia ṣẹ́ri ibinu kuro.
entries.en: Scornful men bring a city into a snare: but wise men turn away wrath.

entries.yo: Ọlọgbọ́n enia ti mba aṣiwère enia ja, bi inu li o mbi, bi ẹrín li o nrín, isimi kò si.
entries.en: If a wise man contendeth with a foolish man, whether he rage or laugh, there is no rest.

entries.yo: Awọn enia-ẹ̀jẹ korira aduro-ṣinṣin: ṣugbọn awọn olododo a ma ṣe afẹri ọkàn rẹ̀.
entries.en: The bloodthirsty hate the upright: but the just seek his soul.

entries.yo: Aṣiwère a sọ gbogbo inu rẹ̀ jade: ṣugbọn ọlọgbọ́n a pa a mọ́ di ìgba ikẹhin.
entries.en: A fool uttereth all his mind: but a wise man keepeth it in till afterwards.

entries.yo: Bi ijoye ba feti si ọ̀rọ-eke, gbogbo awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀ ni yio buru.
entries.en: If a ruler hearken to lies, all his servants are wicked.

entries.yo: Talaka ati aninilara enia pejọ pọ̀: Oluwa li o ntan imọlẹ si oju awọn mejeji.
entries.en: The poor and the deceitful man meet together: the LORD lighteneth both their eyes.

entries.yo: Ọba ti o fi otitọ ṣe idajọ talaka, itẹ́ rẹ̀ yio fi idi mulẹ lailai.
entries.en: The king that faithfully judgeth the poor, his throne shall be established for ever.

entries.yo: Paṣan ati ibawi funni li ọgbọ́n: ṣugbọn ọmọ ti a ba jọwọ rẹ̀ fun ara rẹ̀, a dojuti iya rẹ̀.
entries.en: The rod and reproof give wisdom: but a child left to himself bringeth his mother to shame.

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn enia buburu ba npọ̀ si i, irekọja a pọ̀ si i: ṣugbọn awọn olododo yio ri iṣubu wọn.
entries.en: When the wicked are multiplied, transgression increaseth: but the righteous shall see their fall.

entries.yo: Tọ́ ọmọ rẹ, yio si fun ọ ni isimi; yio si fi inu-didùn si ọ li ọkàn.
entries.en: Correct thy son, and he shall give thee rest; yea, he shall give delight unto thy soul.

entries.yo: Nibiti iran-woli kò si, enia a yapa, ṣugbọn ibukún ni fun ẹniti o pa ofin mọ́.
entries.en: Where there is no vision, the people perish: but he that keepeth the law, happy is he.

entries.yo: A kì ifi ọ̀rọ kilọ fun ọmọ-ọdọ; bi o tilẹ ye e kì yio dahùn.
entries.en: A servant will not be corrected by words: for though he understand he will not answer.

entries.yo: Iwọ ri enia ti o yara li ọ̀rọ rẹ̀? ireti mbẹ fun aṣiwère jù fun u lọ.
entries.en: Seest thou a man that is hasty in his words? there is more hope of a fool than of him.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba fi ikẹ́ tọ́ ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ̀ lati igba-ewe wá, oun ni yio jogún rẹ̀.
entries.en: He that delicately bringeth up his servant from a child shall have him become his son at the length.

entries.yo: Ẹni ibinu ru ìja soke, ati ẹni ikannu pọ̀ ni irekọja.
entries.en: An angry man stirreth up strife, and a furious man aboundeth in transgression.

entries.yo: Igberaga enia ni yio rẹ̀ ẹ silẹ: ṣugbọn onirẹlẹ ọkàn ni yio gbà ọlá.
entries.en: A man's pride shall bring him low: but honour shall uphold the humble in spirit.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o kó ẹgbẹ ole korira ọkàn ara rẹ̀: o ngbọ́ ifiré, kò si fihan.
entries.en: Whoso is partner with a thief hateth his own soul: he heareth cursing, and bewrayeth it not.

entries.yo: Ibẹ̀ru enia ni imu ikẹkùn wá: ṣugbọn ẹnikẹni ti o gbẹkẹ rẹ̀ le Oluwa li a o gbe leke.
entries.en: The fear of man bringeth a snare: but whoso putteth his trust in the LORD shall be safe.

entries.yo: Ọpọlọpọ enia li o nwá ojurere ijoye: ṣugbọn idajọ enia li o nti ọdọ Oluwa wá.
entries.en: Many seek the ruler's favour; but every man's judgment cometh from the LORD.

entries.yo: Alaiṣõtọ enia, irira ni si awọn olododo: ẹniti o si ṣe aduro-ṣinṣin li ọ̀na, irira ni si enia buburu.
entries.en: An unjust man is an abomination to the just: and he that is upright in the way is abomination to the wicked.

entries.yo: Ọ̀RỌ Aguri, ọmọ Jake, ọ̀rọ ẹkọ́ ti ọkunrin na ti sọ, fun Itieli, ani fun Itieli ati Ukali.
entries.en: The words of Agur the son of Jakeh, even the prophecy: the man spake unto Ithiel, even unto Ithiel and Ucal,

entries.yo: Nitõtọ emi ṣiwère jù ẹlomiran lọ, emi kò si ni imoye enia.
entries.en: Surely I am more brutish than any man, and have not the understanding of a man.

entries.yo: Emi kò tilẹ kọ́ ọgbọ́n, emi kò tilẹ ni ìmọ ohun mimọ́.
entries.en: I neither learned wisdom, nor have the knowledge of the holy.

entries.yo: Tali o ti gòke lọ si ọrun, tabi ti o si sọkalẹ wá? tali o kó afẹfẹ jọ li ọwọ rẹ̀? tali o di omi sinu aṣọ; tali o fi gbogbo opin aiye le ilẹ? Orukọ rẹ̀ ti ijẹ, ati orukọ ọmọ rẹ̀ ti ijẹ, bi iwọ ba le mọ̀ ọ?
entries.en: Who hath ascended up into heaven, or descended? who hath gathered the wind in his fists? who hath bound the waters in a garment? who hath established all the ends of the earth? what is his name, and what is his son's name, if thou canst tell?

entries.yo: Gbogbo ọ̀rọ Oluwa jẹ́ otitọ: on li asà fun gbogbo awọn ti o gbẹkẹ wọn le e.
entries.en: Every word of God is pure: he is a shield unto them that put their trust in him.

entries.yo: Iwọ máṣe fi kún ọ̀rọ rẹ̀, ki on má ba ba ọ wi, a si mu ọ li eke.
entries.en: Add thou not unto his words, lest he reprove thee, and thou be found a liar.

entries.yo: Ohun meji ni mo tọrọ lọdọ rẹ; máṣe fi wọn dù mi ki emi to kú.
entries.en: Two things have I required of thee; deny me them not before I die:

entries.yo: Mu asan ati eke jìna si mi: máṣe fun mi li òṣi, máṣe fun mi li ọrọ̀; fi onjẹ ti o to fun mi bọ mi.
entries.en: Remove far from me vanity and lies: give me neither poverty nor riches; feed me with food convenient for me:

entries.yo: Ki emi ki o má ba yó jù, ki emi ki o má si sẹ́ ọ, pe ta li Oluwa? tabi ki emi má ba tòṣi, ki emi si jale, ki emi si ṣẹ̀ si orukọ Ọlọrun mi.
entries.en: Lest I be full, and deny thee, and say, Who is the LORD? or lest I be poor, and steal, and take the name of my God in vain.

entries.yo: Máṣe fi iranṣẹ sùn oluwa rẹ̀, ki o má ba fi ọ bu, ki iwọ má ba jẹbi.
entries.en: Accuse not a servant unto his master, lest he curse thee, and thou be found guilty.

entries.yo: Iran kan wà ti nfi baba rẹ̀ bu, ti kò si sure fun iya rẹ̀.
entries.en: There is a generation that curseth their father, and doth not bless their mother.

entries.yo: Iran kan wà, ti o mọ́ li oju ara rẹ̀, ṣugbọn a kò ti iwẹ̀ ẹ nù kuro ninu ẽri rẹ̀.
entries.en: There is a generation that are pure in their own eyes, and yet is not washed from their filthiness.

entries.yo: Iran kan wà, yẽ, oju rẹ̀ ti gbega to! ipenpeju rẹ̀ si gbé soke.
entries.en: There is a generation, O how lofty are their eyes! and their eyelids are lifted up.

entries.yo: Iran kan wà, ehin ẹniti o dabi idà, erigi rẹ̀ dabi ọbẹ, lati jẹ talaka run kuro lori ilẹ, ati awọn alaini kuro ninu awọn enia.
entries.en: There is a generation, whose teeth are as swords, and their jaw teeth as knives, to devour the poor from off the earth, and the needy from among men.

entries.yo: Eṣúṣu ni ọmọbinrin meji, ti nkigbe pe, Muwá, muwá. Ohun mẹta ni mbẹ ti a kò le tẹ lọrùn lai, ani mẹrin kì iwipe, o to.
entries.en: The horseleach hath two daughters, crying, Give, give. There are three things that are never satisfied, yea, four things say not, It is enough:

entries.yo: Isa-okú, ati inu àgan; ilẹ ti kì ikún fun omi; ati iná ti kì iwipe, o to.
entries.en: The grave; and the barren womb; the earth that is not filled with water; and the fire that saith not, It is enough.

entries.yo: Oju ti o sin baba rẹ̀ jẹ, ti o gàn ati gbọ́ ti iya rẹ̀, kanakáná ẹba odò ni yio yọ ọ jade, ọmọ idì a si mu u jẹ.
entries.en: The eye that mocketh at his father, and despiseth to obey his mother, the ravens of the valley shall pick it out, and the young eagles shall eat it.

entries.yo: Ohun mẹta ni mbẹ ti o ṣe iyanu fun mi, nitõtọ, mẹrin li emi kò mọ̀.
entries.en: There be three things which are too wonderful for me, yea, four which I know not:

entries.yo: Ipa idì loju ọrun; ipa ejò lori apata: ipa ọkọ̀ loju okun; ati ìwa ọkunrin pẹlu wundia.
entries.en: The way of an eagle in the air; the way of a serpent upon a rock; the way of a ship in the midst of the sea; and the way of a man with a maid.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni ìwa agbere obinrin: o jẹun, o si nù ẹnu rẹ̀ nù, o si wipe, emi kò ṣe buburu kan.
entries.en: Such is the way of an adulterous woman; she eateth, and wipeth her mouth, and saith, I have done no wickedness.

entries.yo: Nitori ohun mẹta, aiye a di rũru, ati labẹ mẹrin ni kò le duro.
entries.en: For three things the earth is disquieted, and for four which it cannot bear:

entries.yo: Iranṣẹ, nigbati o jọba; ati aṣiwère, nigbati o yo fun onjẹ;
entries.en: For a servant when he reigneth; and a fool when he is filled with meat;

entries.yo: Fun obinrin, ti a korira, nigbati a sọ ọ di iyale; ati fun iranṣẹbinrin, nigbati o di arole iya rẹ̀.
entries.en: For an odious woman when she is married; and an handmaid that is heir to her mistress.

entries.yo: Ohun mẹrin ni mbẹ ti o kerejù lori ilẹ, sibẹ nwọn gbọ́n, nwọn kọ́ni li ẹkọ́.
entries.en: There be four things which are little upon the earth, but they are exceeding wise:

entries.yo: Alailagbara enia li ẽra, ṣugbọn nwọn a pese onjẹ wọn silẹ ni ìgba ẹ̀run.
entries.en: The ants are a people not strong, yet they prepare their meat in the summer;

entries.yo: Alailagbara enia li ehoro, ṣugbọn nwọn a ṣe ìho wọn ni ibi palapala okuta.
entries.en: The conies are but a feeble folk, yet make they their houses in the rocks;

entries.yo: Awọn ẽṣú kò li ọba, sibẹ gbogbo wọn a jade lọ li ọwọ́-ọwọ́;
entries.en: The locusts have no king, yet go they forth all of them by bands;

entries.yo: Ọmọle fi ọwọ rẹ̀ dì mu, o si wà li ãfin awọn ọba.
entries.en: The spider taketh hold with her hands, and is in kings' palaces.

entries.yo: Ohun mẹta ni mbẹ ti nrìn rere, nitõtọ, mẹrin li o dára pupọ ni ìrin rirìn:
entries.en: There be three things which go well, yea, four are comely in going:

entries.yo: Kiniun ti o lagbara julọ ninu ẹranko, ti kò si pẹhinda fun ẹnikan;
entries.en: A lion which is strongest among beasts, and turneth not away for any;

entries.yo: Ẹṣin ti a dì lẹgbẹ; ati obukọ; ati ọba larin awọn enia rẹ̀.
entries.en: A greyhound; an he goat also; and a king, against whom there is no rising up.

entries.yo: Bi iwọ ba ti ṣiwère ni gbigbe ara rẹ soke, tabi bi iwọ ba ti ronú ibi, fi ọwọ rẹ le ẹnu rẹ.
entries.en: If thou hast done foolishly in lifting up thyself, or if thou hast thought evil, lay thine hand upon thy mouth.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ, mimì wàra ni imu orí-àmọ́ wá, ati fifun imu ni imu ẹ̀jẹ jade; bẹ̃ni riru ibinu soke ni imu ìja wá.
entries.en: Surely the churning of milk bringeth forth butter, and the wringing of the nose bringeth forth blood: so the forcing of wrath bringeth forth strife.

entries.yo: Ọ̀RỌ Lemueli, ọba, ọ̀rọ-ẹkọ́ ti ìya rẹ̀ kọ́ ọ.
entries.en: The words of king Lemuel, the prophecy that his mother taught him.

entries.yo: Kini, ọmọ mi? ki si ni, ọmọ inu mi? ati kini, ọmọ ẹ̀jẹ́ mi?
entries.en: What, my son? and what, the son of my womb? and what, the son of my vows?

entries.yo: Máṣe fi agbara rẹ fun awọn obinrin, tabi ìwa rẹ fun awọn obinrin ti mbà awọn ọba jẹ.
entries.en: Give not thy strength unto women, nor thy ways to that which destroyeth kings.

entries.yo: Kì iṣe fun awọn ọba, Lemueli, kì iṣe fun awọn ọba lati mu ọti-waini; bẹ̃ni kì iṣe fun awọn ọmọ alade lati fẹ ọti lile:
entries.en: It is not for kings, O Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine; nor for princes strong drink:

entries.yo: Ki nwọn ki o má ba mu, nwọn a si gbagbe ofin, nwọn a si yi idajọ awọn olupọnju.
entries.en: Lest they drink, and forget the law, and pervert the judgment of any of the afflicted.

entries.yo: Fi ọti lile fun ẹniti o mura tan lati ṣegbe, ati ọti-waini fun awọn oninu bibajẹ.
entries.en: Give strong drink unto him that is ready to perish, and wine unto those that be of heavy hearts.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki o mu, ki o si gbagbe aini rẹ̀, ki o má si ranti òṣi rẹ̀ mọ́.
entries.en: Let him drink, and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.

entries.yo: Yà ẹnu rẹ fun ayadi, ninu ọ̀ran gbogbo ẹniti iṣe ọmọ iparun.
entries.en: Open thy mouth for the dumb in the cause of all such as are appointed to destruction.

entries.yo: Yà ẹnu rẹ, fi ododo ṣe idajọ, ki o si gbèja talaka ati alaini.
entries.en: Open thy mouth, judge righteously, and plead the cause of the poor and needy.

entries.yo: Tani yio ri obinrin oniwà rere? nitoriti iye rẹ̀ kọja iyùn.
entries.en: Who can find a virtuous woman? for her price is far above rubies.

entries.yo: Aiya ọkọ rẹ̀ gbẹkẹle e laibẹ̀ru, bẹ̃ni on kì yio ṣe alaini ère iṣẹ.
entries.en: The heart of her husband doth safely trust in her, so that he shall have no need of spoil.

entries.yo: Rere li obinrin na yio ma ṣe fun u, kì iṣe buburu li ọjọ aiye rẹ̀ gbogbo.
entries.en: She will do him good and not evil all the days of her life.

entries.yo: Obinrin na yio ma ṣafẹri kubusu ati ọ̀gbọ, o si fi ọwọ rẹ̀ ṣiṣẹ tinutinu.
entries.en: She seeketh wool, and flax, and worketh willingly with her hands.

entries.yo: O dabi ọkọ̀ oniṣowo: o si mu onjẹ rẹ̀ lati ọ̀na jijin rére wá.
entries.en: She is like the merchants' ships; she bringeth her food from afar.

entries.yo: On a si dide nigbati ilẹ kò ti imọ́, a si fi onjẹ fun enia ile rẹ̀, ati iṣẹ õjọ fun awọn ọmọbinrin rẹ̀.
entries.en: She riseth also while it is yet night, and giveth meat to her household, and a portion to her maidens.

entries.yo: O kiyesi oko, o si mu u: ère ọwọ rẹ̀ li o fi gbin ọgbà-ajara.
entries.en: She considereth a field, and buyeth it: with the fruit of her hands she planteth a vineyard.

entries.yo: O fi agbara gbá ẹ̀gbẹ rẹ̀ li ọjá, o si mu apa rẹ̀ mejeji le.
entries.en: She girdeth her loins with strength, and strengtheneth her arms.

entries.yo: O kiyesi i pe ọjà on dara: fitila rẹ̀ kò kú li oru.
entries.en: She perceiveth that her merchandise is good: her candle goeth not out by night.

entries.yo: O fi ọwọ rẹ̀ le kẹkẹ́-owú, ọwọ rẹ̀ si di ìranwu mu.
entries.en: She layeth her hands to the spindle, and her hands hold the distaff.

entries.yo: O nà ọwọ rẹ̀ si talaka; nitõtọ, ọwọ rẹ̀ si kàn alaini.
entries.en: She stretcheth out her hand to the poor; yea, she reacheth forth her hands to the needy.

entries.yo: On kò si bẹ̀ru òjo-didì fun awọn ara ile rẹ̀; nitoripe gbogbo awọn ara ile rẹ̀ li a wọ̀ li aṣọ iṣẹpo meji.
entries.en: She is not afraid of the snow for her household: for all her household are clothed with scarlet.

entries.yo: On si wun aṣọ titẹ́ fun ara rẹ̀; ẹ̀wu daradara ati elese aluko li aṣọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: She maketh herself coverings of tapestry; her clothing is silk and purple.

entries.yo: A mọ̀ ọkọ rẹ̀ li ẹnu-bode, nigbati o ba joko pẹlu awọn àgba ilẹ na.
entries.en: Her husband is known in the gates, when he sitteth among the elders of the land.

entries.yo: O da aṣọ ọ̀gbọ daradara, o si tà a, pẹlupẹlu o fi ọjá amure fun oniṣòwo tà.
entries.en: She maketh fine linen, and selleth it; and delivereth girdles unto the merchant.

entries.yo: Agbara ati iyìn li aṣọ rẹ̀; on o si yọ̀ si ọjọ ti mbọ.
entries.en: Strength and honour are her clothing; and she shall rejoice in time to come.

entries.yo: O fi ọgbọ́n yà ẹnu rẹ̀; ati li ahọn rẹ̀ li ofin iṣeun.
entries.en: She openeth her mouth with wisdom; and in her tongue is the law of kindness.

entries.yo: O fi oju silẹ wò ìwa awọn ara ile rẹ̀, kò si jẹ onjẹ imẹlẹ.
entries.en: She looketh well to the ways of her household, and eateth not the bread of idleness.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ dide, nwọn si pè e li alabukúnfun, ati bãle rẹ̀ pẹlu, on si fi iyìn fun u.
entries.en: Her children arise up, and call her blessed; her husband also, and he praiseth her.

entries.yo: Ọpọlọpọ awọn ọmọbinrin li o hùwa rere, ṣugbọn iwọ ta gbogbo wọn yọ.
entries.en: Many daughters have done virtuously, but thou excellest them all.

entries.yo: Oju daradara li ẹ̀tan, ẹwà si jasi asan: ṣugbọn obinrin ti o bẹ̀ru Oluwa, on ni ki a fi iyìn fun.
entries.en: Favour is deceitful, and beauty is vain: but a woman that feareth the LORD, she shall be praised.

entries.yo: Fi fun u ninu eso-iṣẹ ọwọ rẹ̀; jẹ ki iṣẹ ọwọ ara rẹ̀ ki o si yìn i li ẹnu-bodè.
entries.en: Give her of the fruit of her hands; and let her own works praise her in the gates.

entries.yo: Ọ̀RỌ oniwasu, ọmọ Dafidi, ti o jọba ni Jerusalemu.
entries.en: The words of the Preacher, the son of David, king in Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Asan inu asan, oniwasu na wipe, asan inu asan; gbogbo rẹ̀ asan ni!
entries.en: Vanity of vanities, saith the Preacher, vanity of vanities; all is vanity.

entries.yo: Ere kili enia jẹ ninu gbogbo lãla rẹ̀ ti o ṣe labẹ õrùn?
entries.en: What profit hath a man of all his labour which he taketh under the sun?

entries.yo: Iran kan lọ, iran miran si bọ̀: ṣugbọn aiye duro titi lai.
entries.en: One generation passeth away, and another generation cometh: but the earth abideth for ever.

entries.yo: Õrun pẹlu là, õrun si wọ̀, o si yara lọ si ipò rẹ̀ nibiti o ti là.
entries.en: The sun also ariseth, and the sun goeth down, and hasteth to his place where he arose.

entries.yo: Afẹfẹ nfẹ lọ siha gusu, a si yipada siha ariwa; o si nlọ sihin sọhun titi, afẹfẹ si tun pada gẹgẹ nipa ayika rẹ̀.
entries.en: The wind goeth toward the south, and turneth about unto the north; it whirleth about continually, and the wind returneth again according to his circuits.

entries.yo: Odò gbogbo ni nṣan sinu okun; ṣugbọn okun kò kún, nibiti awọn odò ti nṣàn wá, nibẹ ni nwọn si tun pada lọ.
entries.en: All the rivers run into the sea; yet the sea is not full; unto the place from whence the rivers come, thither they return again.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ gbogbo kò to; enia kò le sọ ọ: iran kì isu oju, bẹ̃li eti kì ikún fun gbigbọ́.
entries.en: All things are full of labour; man cannot utter it: the eye is not satisfied with seeing, nor the ear filled with hearing.

entries.yo: Ohun ti o wà, on ni yio si wà; ati eyiti a ti ṣe li eyi ti a o ṣe; kò si ohun titun labẹ õrùn.
entries.en: The thing that hath been, it is that which shall be; and that which is done is that which shall be done: and there is no new thing under the sun.

entries.yo: Ohun kan wà nipa eyi ti a wipe, Wò o, titun li eyi! o ti wà na nigba atijọ, ti o ti wà ṣaju wa.
entries.en: Is there any thing whereof it may be said, See, this is new? it hath been already of old time, which was before us.

entries.yo: Kò si iranti ohun iṣaju; bẹ̃ni iranti kì yio si fun ohun ikẹhin ti mbọ̀, lọdọ awọn ti mbọ̀ ni igba ikẹhin.
entries.en: There is no remembrance of former things; neither shall there be any remembrance of things that are to come with those that shall come after.

entries.yo: Emi oniwasu jọba lori Israeli ni Jerusalemu.
entries.en: I the Preacher was king over Israel in Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Mo si fi aiya mi si ati ṣe afẹri on ati wadi ọgbọ́n niti ohun gbogbo ti a nṣe labẹ ọrun, lãla kikan yi li Ọlorun fi fun awọn ọmọ enia lati ṣe lãla ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And I gave my heart to seek and search out by wisdom concerning all things that are done under heaven: this sore travail hath God given to the sons of man to be exercised therewith.

entries.yo: Mo ti ri iṣẹ gbogbo ti a nṣe labẹ õrùn; si kiyesi i, asan ni gbogbo rẹ̀ ati imulẹmofo.
entries.en: I have seen all the works that are done under the sun; and, behold, all is vanity and vexation of spirit.

entries.yo: Eyi ti o wọ́, a kò le mu u tọ́: ati iye àbuku, a kò le kà a.
entries.en: That which is crooked cannot be made straight: and that which is wanting cannot be numbered.

entries.yo: Mo si ba aiya ara mi sọ̀rọ wipe, kiyesi i, mo li ọgbọ́n nla, mo si fi kún u jù gbogbo wọn lọ ti o ti ṣaju mi ni Jerusalemu; aiya mi si ri ohun pupọ nla niti ọgbọ́n ati ti ìmọ.
entries.en: I communed with mine own heart, saying, Lo, I am come to great estate, and have gotten more wisdom than all they that have been before me in Jerusalem: yea, my heart had great experience of wisdom and knowledge.

entries.yo: Nigbati mo fi aiya mi si ati mọ̀ ọgbọ́n, ati lati mọ̀ isinwin ati iwère: nigbana ni mo mọ̀ pe, eyi pẹlu jẹ imulẹmofo.
entries.en: And I gave my heart to know wisdom, and to know madness and folly: I perceived that this also is vexation of spirit.

entries.yo: Nitoripe ninu ọgbọ́n pupọ ni ibinujẹ pupọ wà, ẹniti o si nsọ ìmọ di pupọ, o nsọ ikãnu di pupọ.
entries.en: For in much wisdom is much grief: and he that increaseth knowledge increaseth sorrow.

entries.yo: EMI wi ninu mi pe, wá na! emi o fi iré-ayọ̀ dan ọ wò, nitorina mã jẹ afẹ! si kiyesi i, asan li eyi pẹlu!
entries.en: I said in mine heart, Go to now, I will prove thee with mirth, therefore enjoy pleasure: and, behold, this also is vanity.

entries.yo: Emi wi fun ẹrin pe, Iwère ni ọ: ati fun iré-ayọ̀ pe kili o nṣe?
entries.en: I said of laughter, It is mad: and of mirth, What doeth it?

entries.yo: Mo rò ninu aiya mi lati fi ọti-waini mu ara mi le, ṣugbọn emi nfi ọgbọ́n tọ́ aiya mi: on ati fi ọwọ le iwère, titi emi o fi ri ohun ti o dara fun ọmọ enia, ti nwọn iba mã ṣe labẹ ọrun ni iye ọjọ aiye wọn gbogbo.
entries.en: I sought in mine heart to give myself unto wine, yet acquainting mine heart with wisdom; and to lay hold on folly, till I might see what was that good for the sons of men, which they should do under the heaven all the days of their life.

entries.yo: Mo ṣe iṣẹ nla fun ara mi; mo kọ́ ile pupọ fun ara mi; mo gbin ọgbà-ajara fun ara mi.
entries.en: I made me great works; I builded me houses; I planted me vineyards:

entries.yo: Mo ṣe ọgbà ati agbala daradara fun ara mi, mo si gbin igi oniruru eso sinu wọn.
entries.en: I made me gardens and orchards, and I planted trees in them of all kind of fruits:

entries.yo: Mo ṣe adagun pupọ, lati ma bomi lati inu wọn si igbo ti o nmu igi jade wá:
entries.en: I made me pools of water, to water therewith the wood that bringeth forth trees:

entries.yo: Mo ni iranṣẹ-kọnrin ati iranṣẹ-birin, mo si ni ibile; mo si ni ini agbo malu ati agutan nlanla jù gbogbo awọn ti o wà ni Jerusalemu ṣaju mi.
entries.en: I got me servants and maidens, and had servants born in my house; also I had great possessions of great and small cattle above all that were in Jerusalem before me:

entries.yo: Mo si kó fadaka ati wura jọ ati iṣura ti ọba ati ti igberiko, mo ni awọn olorin ọkunrin ati olorin obinrin, ati didùn inu ọmọ enia, aya ati obinrin pupọ.
entries.en: I gathered me also silver and gold, and the peculiar treasure of kings and of the provinces: I gat me men singers and women singers, and the delights of the sons of men, as musical instruments, and that of all sorts.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni mo tobi, mo si pọ̀ si i jù gbogbo awọn ti o wà ṣaju mi ni Jerusalemu: ọgbọ́n mi si mbẹ pẹlu mi.
entries.en: So I was great, and increased more than all that were before me in Jerusalem: also my wisdom remained with me.

entries.yo: Ohunkohun ti oju mi fẹ, emi kò pa a mọ́ fun wọn; emi kò si dù aiya mi li ohun ayò kan; nitoriti aiya mi yọ̀ ninu iṣẹ mi gbogbo; eyi si ni ipin mi lati inu gbogbo lãla mi.
entries.en: And whatsoever mine eyes desired I kept not from them, I withheld not my heart from any joy; for my heart rejoiced in all my labour: and this was my portion of all my labour.

entries.yo: Nigbati mo wò gbogbo iṣẹ ti ọwọ mi ṣe, ati lãla ti mo ṣe lãla lati ṣe: si kiyesi i, asan ni gbogbo rẹ̀ ati imulẹmofo, ko si si ère kan labẹ õrùn.
entries.en: Then I looked on all the works that my hands had wrought, and on the labour that I had laboured to do: and, behold, all was vanity and vexation of spirit, and there was no profit under the sun.

entries.yo: Mo si yi ara mi pada lati wò ọgbọ́n, ati isinwin ati iwère: nitoripe kili ọkunrin na ti mbọ lẹhin ọba yio le ṣe? eyi ti a ti ṣe tan nigbani ni yio ṣe.
entries.en: And I turned myself to behold wisdom, and madness, and folly: for what can the man do that cometh after the king? even that which hath been already done.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni mo ri pe ọgbọ́n ta wère yọ, to iwọn bi imọlẹ ti ta òkunkun yọ.
entries.en: Then I saw that wisdom excelleth folly, as far as light excelleth darkness.

entries.yo: Oju ọlọgbọ́n mbẹ li ori rẹ̀; ṣugbọn aṣiwère nrìn li òkunkun: emitikalami si mọ̀ pẹlu pe, iṣe kanna li o nṣe gbogbo wọn.
entries.en: The wise man's eyes are in his head; but the fool walketh in darkness: and I myself perceived also that one event happeneth to them all.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni mo wi li aiya mi pe, Bi o ti nṣe si aṣiwère, bẹ̃li o si nṣe si emitikalami; nitori kili emi si ṣe gbọ́n jù? Nigbana ni mo wi li ọkàn mi pe, asan li eyi pẹlu.
entries.en: Then said I in my heart, As it happeneth to the fool, so it happeneth even to me; and why was I then more wise? Then I said in my heart, that this also is vanity.

entries.yo: Nitoripe iranti kò si fun ọlọgbọ́n pẹlu aṣiwère lailai; ki a wò o pe, bi akoko ti o kọja, bẹ̃li ọjọ ti mbọ, a o gbagbe gbogbo rẹ̀. Ọlọgbọ́n ha ṣe nkú bi aṣiwère?
entries.en: For there is no remembrance of the wise more than of the fool for ever; seeing that which now is in the days to come shall all be forgotten. And how dieth the wise man? as the fool.

entries.yo: Nitorina mo korira ìwa-laiye: nitoripe iṣẹ ti a ṣe labẹ õrun: ibi ni fun mi: nitoripe asan ni gbogbo rẹ̀ ati imulẹmofo.
entries.en: Therefore I hated life; because the work that is wrought under the sun is grievous unto me: for all is vanity and vexation of spirit.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ mo korira gbogbo lãla mi ti mo ṣe labẹ õrùn: nitoriti emi o fi i silẹ fun enia ti mbọ̀ lẹhin mi.
entries.en: Yea, I hated all my labour which I had taken under the sun: because I should leave it unto the man that shall be after me.

entries.yo: Tali o si mọ̀ bi ọlọgbọ́n ni yio ṣe tabi aṣiwère? sibẹ on ni yio ṣe olori iṣẹ mi gbogbo ninu eyi ti mo ṣe lãla, ati ninu eyi ti mo fi ara mi hàn li ọlọgbọ́n labẹ õrùn. Asan li eyi pẹlu.
entries.en: And who knoweth whether he shall be a wise man or a fool? yet shall he have rule over all my labour wherein I have laboured, and wherein I have shewed myself wise under the sun. This is also vanity.

entries.yo: Nitorina mo kirilọ lati mu aiya mi ṣí kuro ninu gbogbo lãla mi ti mo ṣe labẹ õrùn.
entries.en: Therefore I went about to cause my heart to despair of all the labour which I took under the sun.

entries.yo: Nitoriti enia kan mbẹ, iṣẹ ẹniti o wà li ọgbọ́n ati ni ìmọ, ati ni iṣedẽde; sibẹ ẹniti kò ṣe lãla ninu rẹ̀ ni yio fi i silẹ fun ni ipin rẹ̀. Eyi pẹlu asan ni ati ibi nlanla.
entries.en: For there is a man whose labour is in wisdom, and in knowledge, and in equity; yet to a man that hath not laboured therein shall he leave it for his portion. This also is vanity and a great evil.

entries.yo: Nitoripe kili enia ni ninu gbogbo lãla rẹ̀ ti o fi nṣe lãla labẹ õrùn?
entries.en: For what hath man of all his labour, and of the vexation of his heart, wherein he hath laboured under the sun?

entries.yo: Nitoripe ọjọ rẹ̀ gbogbo, ikãnu ni, ati iṣẹ rẹ̀, ibinujẹ, nitõtọ aiya rẹ̀ kò simi li oru. Eyi pẹlu asan ni.
entries.en: For all his days are sorrows, and his travail grief; yea, his heart taketh not rest in the night. This is also vanity.

entries.yo: Kò si ohun ti o dara fun enia jù ki o jẹ, ki o si mu ati ki o mu ọkàn rẹ̀ jadùn ohun rere ninu lãla rẹ̀. Eyi ni mo ri pẹlu pe, lati ọwọ Ọlọrun wá ni.
entries.en: There is nothing better for a man, than that he should eat and drink, and that he should make his soul enjoy good in his labour. This also I saw, that it was from the hand of God.

entries.yo: Nitoripe tali o le jẹun, tabi tani pẹlu ti o le mọ̀ adùn jù mi lọ?
entries.en: For who can eat, or who else can hasten hereunto, more than I?

entries.yo: Nitoripe Ọlọrun fun enia ti o tọ li oju rẹ̀ li ọgbọ́n, ati ìmọ ati ayọ̀: ṣugbọn ẹlẹṣẹ li o fi ìṣẹ́ fun, lati ma kó jọ ati lati ma tò jọ ki on ki o le ma fi fun ẹni rere niwaju Ọlọrun. Eyi pẹlu asan ni ati imulẹmofo.
entries.en: For God giveth to a man that is good in his sight wisdom, and knowledge, and joy: but to the sinner he giveth travail, to gather and to heap up, that he may give to him that is good before God. This also is vanity and vexation of spirit.

entries.yo: OLUKULÙKU ohun li akoko wà fun, ati ìgba fun iṣẹ gbogbo labẹ ọrun.
entries.en: To every thing there is a season, and a time to every purpose under the heaven:

entries.yo: Ìgba bibini, ati ìgba kikú, ìgba gbigbin ati ìgba kika ohun ti a gbin;
entries.en: A time to be born, and a time to die; a time to plant, and a time to pluck up that which is planted;

entries.yo: Ìgba pipa ati ìgba imularada; ìgba wiwo lulẹ ati ìgba kikọ;
entries.en: A time to kill, and a time to heal; a time to break down, and a time to build up;

entries.yo: Ìgba sisọkun ati ìgba rirẹrín; ìgba ṣiṣọ̀fọ ati igba jijo;
entries.en: A time to weep, and a time to laugh; a time to mourn, and a time to dance;

entries.yo: Ìgba kikó okuta danu, ati ìgba kiko okuta jọ; ìgba fifọwọkoni mọra, ati ìgba fifasẹhin ni fifọwọkoni mọra;
entries.en: A time to cast away stones, and a time to gather stones together; a time to embrace, and a time to refrain from embracing;

entries.yo: Ìgba wiwari, ati ìgba sísọnu: ìgba pipamọ́ ati ìgba ṣiṣa tì;
entries.en: A time to get, and a time to lose; a time to keep, and a time to cast away;

entries.yo: Ìgba fifaya, ati ìgba rirán; ìgba didakẹ, ati ìgba fifọhùn;
entries.en: A time to rend, and a time to sew; a time to keep silence, and a time to speak;

entries.yo: Ìgba fifẹ, ati ìgba kikorira; ìgba ogun, ati ìgba alafia.
entries.en: A time to love, and a time to hate; a time of war, and a time of peace.

entries.yo: Ere kili ẹniti nṣiṣẹ ni ninu eyiti o nṣe lãla?
entries.en: What profit hath he that worketh in that wherein he laboureth?

entries.yo: Mo ti ri ìṣẹ́ ti Ọlọrun fi fun awọn ọmọ enia lati ma ṣíṣẹ ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: I have seen the travail, which God hath given to the sons of men to be exercised in it.

entries.yo: O ti ṣe ohun gbogbo daradara ni ìgba tirẹ̀; pẹlupẹlu o fi aiyeraiye si wọn li aiya, bẹ̃li ẹnikan kò le ridi iṣẹ na ti Ọlọrun nṣe lati ipilẹṣẹ titi de opin.
entries.en: He hath made every thing beautiful in his time: also he hath set the world in their heart, so that no man can find out the work that God maketh from the beginning to the end.

entries.yo: Emi mọ̀ pe kò si rere ninu wọn, bikoṣe ki enia ki o ma yọ̀, ki o si ma ṣe rere li aiya rẹ̀.
entries.en: I know that there is no good in them, but for a man to rejoice, and to do good in his life.

entries.yo: Ati pẹlu ki olukulùku enia ki o ma jẹ ki o si ma mu, ki o si ma jadùn gbogbo lãla rẹ̀, ẹ̀bun Ọlọrun ni.
entries.en: And also that every man should eat and drink, and enjoy the good of all his labour, it is the gift of God.

entries.yo: Emi mọ̀ pe ohunkohun ti Ọlọrun ṣe yio wà lailai: a kò le fi ohun kan kún u, bẹ̃li a kò le mu ohun kan kuro ninu rẹ̀; Ọlọrun si ṣe eyi ki enia ki o le ma bẹ̀ru rẹ̀.
entries.en: I know that, whatsoever God doeth, it shall be for ever: nothing can be put to it, nor any thing taken from it: and God doeth it, that men should fear before him.

entries.yo: Ohun ti o ti wà ri mbẹ nisisiyi, ati eyi ti yio si wà, o ti wà na; Ọlọrun si bère eyi ti o ti kọja lọ.
entries.en: That which hath been is now; and that which is to be hath already been; and God requireth that which is past.

entries.yo: Ati pẹlupẹlu mo ri ibi idajọ labẹ õrùn pe ìwa buburu mbẹ nibẹ; ati ni ibi ododo, pe aiṣedẽde mbẹ nibẹ.
entries.en: And moreover I saw under the sun the place of judgment, that wickedness was there; and the place of righteousness, that iniquity was there.

entries.yo: Mo wi li aiya mi pe, Ọlọrun yio ṣe idajọ olododo ati enia buburu: nitoripe ìgba kan mbẹ fun ipinnu ati fun iṣẹ gbogbo.
entries.en: I said in mine heart, God shall judge the righteous and the wicked: for there is a time there for every purpose and for every work.

entries.yo: Mo wi li aiya mi niti ìwa awọn ọmọ enia; ki Ọlọrun ki o le fi wọn hàn, ati ki nwọn ki o le ri pe ẹran ni awọn tikalawọn fun ara wọn.
entries.en: I said in mine heart concerning the estate of the sons of men, that God might manifest them, and that they might see that they themselves are beasts.

entries.yo: Nitoripe ohun ti nṣe ọmọ enia nṣe ẹran; ani ohun kanna li o nṣe wọn: bi ekini ti nkú bẹ̃li ekeji nkú; nitõtọ ẹmi kanna ni gbogbo wọn ní, bẹ̃li enia kò li ọlá jù ẹran lọ: nitoripe asan ni gbogbo rẹ̀.
entries.en: For that which befalleth the sons of men befalleth beasts; even one thing befalleth them: as the one dieth, so dieth the other; yea, they have all one breath; so that a man hath no preeminence above a beast: for all is vanity.

entries.yo: Nibikanna ni gbogbo wọn nlọ; lati inu erupẹ wá ni gbogbo wọn, gbogbo wọn si tun pada di erupẹ.
entries.en: All go unto one place; all are of the dust, and all turn to dust again.

entries.yo: Tali o mọ̀ ẹmi ọmọ enia ti ngoke si apa òke, ati ẹmi ẹran ti nsọkalẹ si isalẹ ilẹ?
entries.en: Who knoweth the spirit of man that goeth upward, and the spirit of the beast that goeth downward to the earth?

entries.yo: Nitorina mo woye pe kò si ohun ti o dara jù ki enia ki o ma yọ̀ ni iṣẹ ara rẹ̀; nitori eyini ni ipin rẹ̀: nitoripe tani yio mu u wá ri ohun ti yio wà lẹhin rẹ̀.
entries.en: Wherefore I perceive that there is nothing better, than that a man should rejoice in his own works; for that is his portion: for who shall bring him to see what shall be after him?

entries.yo: BẸ̃NI mo pada, mo si rò inilara gbogbo ti a nṣe labẹ õrùn; mo si wò omije awọn ti a nnilara, nwọn kò si ni olutunu; ati lọwọ aninilara wọn ni ipá wà; ṣugbọn nwọn kò ni olutunu.
entries.en: So I returned, and considered all the oppressions that are done under the sun: and behold the tears of such as were oppressed, and they had no comforter; and on the side of their oppressors there was power; but they had no comforter.

entries.yo: Nitorina mo yìn okú ti o ti kú pẹ jù awọn alãye ti o wà lãye sibẹ.
entries.en: Wherefore I praised the dead which are already dead more than the living which are yet alive.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ, ẹniti kò ti isi san jù awọn mejeji; ẹniti kò ti iri iṣẹ buburu ti a nṣe labẹ õrùn.
entries.en: Yea, better is he than both they, which hath not yet been, who hath not seen the evil work that is done under the sun.

entries.yo: Ati pẹlu, mo rò gbogbo lãla ati ìmọ iṣẹ gbogbo, pe eyiyi ni ilara ẹnikini lati ọdọ ẹnikeji rẹ̀. Asan li eyi pẹlu ati imulẹmofo.
entries.en: Again, I considered all travail, and every right work, that for this a man is envied of his neighbour. This is also vanity and vexation of spirit.

entries.yo: Aṣiwère fọwọ rẹ̀ lọwọ, o si njẹ ẹran-ara rẹ̀.
entries.en: The fool foldeth his hands together, and eateth his own flesh.

entries.yo: Onjẹ ikunwọ kan pẹlu idakẹjẹ, o san jù ikunwọ meji lọ ti o kun fun lãla ati imulẹmofo.
entries.en: Better is an handful with quietness, than both the hands full with travail and vexation of spirit.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni mo pada, mo si ri asan labẹ õrun.
entries.en: Then I returned, and I saw vanity under the sun.

entries.yo: Ẹnikan ṣoṣo wà, kò si ni ẹnikeji; nitõtọ kò li ọmọ, bẹ̃ni kò li arakunrin: sibẹ kò si opin ninu lãla rẹ̀ gbogbo; bẹ̃li ọrọ̀ kò tẹ oju rẹ̀ lọrun: bẹ̃ni kò si wipe, Nitori tali emi nṣe lãla, ti mo si nfi ire dù ọkàn mi? Eyi pẹlu asan ni ati iṣẹ òṣi.
entries.en: There is one alone, and there is not a second; yea, he hath neither child nor brother: yet is there no end of all his labour; neither is his eye satisfied with riches; neither saith he, For whom do I labour, and bereave my soul of good? This is also vanity, yea, it is a sore travail.

entries.yo: Ẹni meji san jù ẹnikan; nitori nwọn ni ère rere fun lãla wọn.
entries.en: Two are better than one; because they have a good reward for their labour.

entries.yo: Nitoripe bi nwọn ba ṣubu, ẹnikini yio gbe ọ̀gba rẹ̀ dide: ṣugbọn egbe ni fun ẹniti o ṣe on nikan nigbati o ba ṣubu; ti kò li ẹlomiran ti yio gbé e dide.
entries.en: For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow: but woe to him that is alone when he falleth; for he hath not another to help him up.

entries.yo: Ati pẹlu, bi ẹni meji ba dubulẹ pọ̀, nigbana ni nwọn o mõru: ṣugbọn ẹnikan yio ha ti ṣe mõru?
entries.en: Again, if two lie together, then they have heat: but how can one be warm alone?

entries.yo: Bi ẹnikan ba kọlu ẹnikan, ẹni meji yio kò o loju; ati okùn onikọ mẹta kì iyá fàja.
entries.en: And if one prevail against him, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.

entries.yo: Otoṣi ipẹ̃rẹ ti o ṣe ọlọgbọ́n, o san jù arugbo ati aṣiwère ọba lọ ti kò mọ̀ bi a ti igbà ìmọran.
entries.en: Better is a poor and a wise child than an old and foolish king, who will no more be admonished.

entries.yo: Nitoripe lati inu tubu li o ti jade wá ijọba; bi a tilẹ ti bi i ni talaka ni ijọba rẹ̀.
entries.en: For out of prison he cometh to reign; whereas also he that is born in his kingdom becometh poor.

entries.yo: Mo ri gbogbo alãye ti nrìn labẹ õrun, pẹlu ipẹ̃rẹ ekeji ti yio dide duro ni ipò rẹ̀.
entries.en: I considered all the living which walk under the sun, with the second child that shall stand up in his stead.

entries.yo: Kò si opin gbogbo awọn enia na, ani fun gbogbo awọn ti on wà ṣiwaju wọn: awọn pẹlu ti mbọ̀ lẹhin kì yio yọ̀ si i. Nitõtọ asan li eyi pẹlu ati imulẹmofo.
entries.en: There is no end of all the people, even of all that have been before them: they also that come after shall not rejoice in him. Surely this also is vanity and vexation of spirit.

entries.yo: PA ẹsẹ rẹ mọ́ nigbati iwọ ba nlọ si ile Ọlọrun, ki iwọ ki o si mura ati gbọ́ jù ati ṣe irubọ aṣiwère: nitoriti nwọn kò rò pe nwọn nṣe ibi.
entries.en: Keep thy foot when thou goest to the house of God, and be more ready to hear, than to give the sacrifice of fools: for they consider not that they do evil.

entries.yo: Máṣe fi ẹnu rẹ yara, ki o má si jẹ ki aiya rẹ ki o yara sọ ọ̀rọ niwaju Ọlọrun: nitoriti Ọlọrun mbẹ li ọrun, iwọ si mbẹ li aiye: nitorina jẹ ki ọ̀rọ rẹ ki o mọ̀ ni ìwọn.
entries.en: Be not rash with thy mouth, and let not thine heart be hasty to utter any thing before God: for God is in heaven, and thou upon earth: therefore let thy words be few.

entries.yo: Nitoripe nipa ọ̀pọlọpọ iṣẹ ni alá ti iwá; bẹ̃ni nipa ọ̀pọlọpọ ọ̀rọ li ã mọ̀ ohùn aṣiwère.
entries.en: For a dream cometh through the multitude of business; and a fool's voice is known by multitude of words.

entries.yo: Nigbati iwọ ba jẹ ẹjẹ́ fun Ọlọrun, máṣe duro pẹ lati san a: nitori kò ni inu-didun si aṣiwère: san eyi ti iwọ jẹjẹ́.
entries.en: When thou vowest a vow unto God, defer not to pay it; for he hath no pleasure in fools: pay that which thou hast vowed.

entries.yo: O san ki iwọ ki o má jẹ ẹjẹ́, jù ki iwọ ki o jẹ ẹjẹ́, ki o má san a.
entries.en: Better is it that thou shouldest not vow, than that thou shouldest vow and not pay.

entries.yo: Máṣe jẹ ki ẹnu rẹ ki o mu ara rẹ ṣẹ̀: ki iwọ ki o má si ṣe wi niwaju iranṣẹ Ọlọrun pe, èṣi li o ṣe: nitori kili Ọlọrun yio ṣe binu si ohùn rẹ, a si ba iṣẹ ọwọ rẹ jẹ?
entries.en: Suffer not thy mouth to cause thy flesh to sin; neither say thou before the angel, that it was an error: wherefore should God be angry at thy voice, and destroy the work of thine hands?

entries.yo: Nitoripe bi ninu ọ̀pọlọpọ alá ni asan wà, bẹ̃ni ninu ọ̀pọlọpọ ọ̀rọ pẹlu: ṣugbọn iwọ bẹ̀ru Ọlọrun.
entries.en: For in the multitude of dreams and many words there are also divers vanities: but fear thou God.

entries.yo: Bi iwọ ba ri inilara awọn olupọnju, ati ifi agbara yi idajọ ati otitọ pada ni igberiko, máṣe jẹ ki ẹnu ki o yà ọ si ọ̀ran na: nitoripe ẹniti o ga jù nṣọ ẹniti o ga, ati ẹni-giga-julọ wà lori wọn.
entries.en: If thou seest the oppression of the poor, and violent perverting of judgment and justice in a province, marvel not at the matter: for he that is higher than the highest regardeth; and there be higher than they.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu ère ilẹ ni fun gbogbo enia: a si nsìn ọba tikalarẹ pãpa lati inu oko wa.
entries.en: Moreover the profit of the earth is for all: the king himself is served by the field.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba fẹ fadaka, fadaka kì yio tẹ́ ẹ lọrun; bẹ̃li ẹniti o fẹ ọrọ̀ kì yio tẹ́ ẹ lọrun: asan li eyi pẹlu.
entries.en: He that loveth silver shall not be satisfied with silver; nor he that loveth abundance with increase: this is also vanity.

entries.yo: Nigbati ẹrù ba npọ̀ si i, awọn ti o si njẹ ẹ a ma pọ̀ si i: ore ki tilẹ ni fun ẹniti o ni i bikoṣepe ki nwọn ki o ma fi oju wọn wò o?
entries.en: When goods increase, they are increased that eat them: and what good is there to the owners thereof, saving the beholding of them with their eyes?

entries.yo: Didùn ni orun oniṣẹ, iba jẹ onjẹ diẹ tabi pupọ: ṣugbọn itẹlọrun ọlọrọ̀ kì ijẹ, ki o sùn.
entries.en: The sleep of a labouring man is sweet, whether he eat little or much: but the abundance of the rich will not suffer him to sleep.

entries.yo: Ibi buburu kan mbẹ ti mo ri labẹ õrùn, eyini ni pe, ọrọ̀ ti a pamọ́ fun ifarapa awọn ti o ni i.
entries.en: There is a sore evil which I have seen under the sun, namely, riches kept for the owners thereof to their hurt.

entries.yo: Nitori ọrọ̀ wọnni a ṣegbe nipa iṣẹ buburu; bi o si bi ọmọkunrin kan, kò ni nkan lọwọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: But those riches perish by evil travail: and he begetteth a son, and there is nothing in his hand.

entries.yo: Bi o ti ti inu iya rẹ̀ jade wá, ihoho ni yio si tun pada lọ bi o ti wá, kì yio si mu nkan ninu lãla rẹ̀, ti iba mu lọ lọwọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: As he came forth of his mother's womb, naked shall he return to go as he came, and shall take nothing of his labour, which he may carry away in his hand.

entries.yo: Ibi buburu li eyi pẹlu, pe li ọ̀na gbogbo, bi o ti wá, bẹ̃ni yio si lọ: ère ki si ni fun ẹniti nṣe lãla fun afẹfẹ?
entries.en: And this also is a sore evil, that in all points as he came, so shall he go: and what profit hath he that hath laboured for the wind?

entries.yo: Li ọjọ rẹ̀ gbogbo pẹlu, o njẹun li òkunkun, o si ni ibinujẹ pupọ ati àrun ati irora rẹ̀.
entries.en: All his days also he eateth in darkness, and he hath much sorrow and wrath with his sickness.

entries.yo: Kiyesi eyi ti mo ri: o dara o si yẹ fun enia, ki o jẹ, ki o si mu, ki o si ma jẹ alafia ninu gbogbo lãla rẹ̀ ti o ṣe labẹ õrùn, ni iye ọjọ aiye rẹ̀ gbogbo, ti Ọlọrun fi fun u: nitori eyi ni ipin tirẹ̀.
entries.en: Behold that which I have seen: it is good and comely for one to eat and to drink, and to enjoy the good of all his labour that he taketh under the sun all the days of his life, which God giveth him: for it is his portion.

entries.yo: Bi Ọlọrun ba fi ọrọ̀ fun ẹnikẹni, ti o si fun u li agbara ati jẹ ninu rẹ̀: ati lati mu ipin rẹ̀, ati lati yọ̀ ninu lãla rẹ eyi; pẹlu ẹ̀bun Ọlọrun ni.
entries.en: Every man also to whom God hath given riches and wealth, and hath given him power to eat thereof, and to take his portion, and to rejoice in his labour; this is the gift of God.

entries.yo: Nitoriti kì yio ranti ọjọ aiye rẹ̀ pọju; nitoriti Ọlọrun da a lohùn ninu ayọ̀ ọkàn rẹ̀.
entries.en: For he shall not much remember the days of his life; because God answereth him in the joy of his heart.

entries.yo: IBI kan mbẹ ti mo ri labẹ õrùn, o si ṣọpọ lãrin awọn ọmọ enia.
entries.en: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, and it is common among men:

entries.yo: Ẹniti Ọlọrun fi ọrọ̀, ọlà ati ọlá fun, ti kò si si nkan ti o si kù fun ọkàn rẹ̀ ninu ohun gbogbo ti o fẹ, ṣugbọn ti Ọlọrun kò fun u li agbara ati jẹ ninu rẹ̀, ṣugbọn awọn ajeji enia li o njẹ ẹ: asan li eyi, àrun buburu si ni.
entries.en: A man to whom God hath given riches, wealth, and honour, so that he wanteth nothing for his soul of all that he desireth, yet God giveth him not power to eat thereof, but a stranger eateth it: this is vanity, and it is an evil disease.

entries.yo: Bi ọkunrin kan bi ọgọrun ọmọ, ti o si wà li ọdun pupọ, tobẹ̃ ti ọjọ ọdun rẹ̀ pọ̀, ti ọkàn rẹ̀ kò si kún fun ohun didara, ati pẹlu ti a kò si sinkú rẹ̀; mo ni, ọmọ iṣẹnu san jù u lọ.
entries.en: If a man beget an hundred children, and live many years, so that the days of his years be many, and his soul be not filled with good, and also that he have no burial; I say, that an untimely birth is better than he.

entries.yo: Nitoripe lasan li o wá, o si lọ li òkunkun, òkunkun li a o si fi bo orukọ rẹ̀ mọlẹ.
entries.en: For he cometh in with vanity, and departeth in darkness, and his name shall be covered with darkness.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu on kò ri õrùn kò mọ ohun kan: eyi ni isimi jù ekeji lọ.
entries.en: Moreover he hath not seen the sun, nor known any thing: this hath more rest than the other.

entries.yo: Ani bi o tilẹ wà ni ẹgbẹrun ọdun lẹrin-meji, ṣugbọn kò ri rere: ibikanna ki gbogbo wọn ha nrè?
entries.en: Yea, though he live a thousand years twice told, yet hath he seen no good: do not all go to one place?

entries.yo: Gbogbo lãla enia ni fun ẹnu rẹ̀, ṣugbọn a kò ti itẹ adùn ọkàn rẹ̀ lọrun.
entries.en: All the labour of man is for his mouth, and yet the appetite is not filled.

entries.yo: Nitoripe ère kili ọlọgbọ́n ni jù aṣiwère lọ? kini talaka ni ti o mọ̀ bi a ti rin niwaju awọn alãye?
entries.en: For what hath the wise more than the fool? what hath the poor, that knoweth to walk before the living?

entries.yo: Eyiti oju ri san jù irokakiri ifẹ lọ; asan li eyi pẹlu ati imulẹmofo.
entries.en: Better is the sight of the eyes than the wandering of the desire: this is also vanity and vexation of spirit.

entries.yo: Eyi ti o wà, a ti da orukọ rẹ̀ ri, a si ti mọ̀ ọ pe, enia ni: bẹ̃ni kò le ba ẹniti o lagbara jù u lọ jà.
entries.en: That which hath been is named already, and it is known that it is man: neither may he contend with him that is mightier than he.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i ohun pupọ li o wà ti nmu asan bi si i, ère kili enia ni?
entries.en: Seeing there be many things that increase vanity, what is man the better?

entries.yo: Nitoripe tali o mọ̀ ohun ti o dara fun enia li aiye yi, ni iye ọjọ asan rẹ̀ ti nlọ bi ojiji? nitoripe tali o le sọ fun enia li ohun ti yio wà lẹhin rẹ̀ labẹ õrùn?
entries.en: For who knoweth what is good for man in this life, all the days of his vain life which he spendeth as a shadow? for who can tell a man what shall be after him under the sun?

entries.yo: ORUKỌ rere dara jù ororo ikunra; ati ọjọ ikú jù ọjọ ibi enia lọ.
entries.en: A good name is better than precious ointment; and the day of death than the day of one's birth.

entries.yo: O dara lati lọ si ile ọ̀fọ jù ati lọ si ile àse: nitoripe eyi li opin gbogbo enia; alãye yio si pa a mọ́ li aiya rẹ̀.
entries.en: It is better to go to the house of mourning, than to go to the house of feasting: for that is the end of all men; and the living will lay it to his heart.

entries.yo: Ibinujẹ san jù ẹrín: nitoripe nipa ifaro oju a si mu aiya san.
entries.en: Sorrow is better than laughter: for by the sadness of the countenance the heart is made better.

entries.yo: Aiya ọlọgbọ́n mbẹ ni ile ọ̀fọ; ṣugbọn aiya aṣiwère ni ile iré.
entries.en: The heart of the wise is in the house of mourning; but the heart of fools is in the house of mirth.

entries.yo: O san lati gbọ́ ibawi ọlọgbọ́n jù ki enia ki o fetisi orin aṣiwère.
entries.en: It is better to hear the rebuke of the wise, than for a man to hear the song of fools.

entries.yo: Nitoripe bi itapàpa ẹgún labẹ ìkoko, bẹ̃li ẹrín aṣiwère: asan li eyi pẹlu.
entries.en: For as the crackling of thorns under a pot, so is the laughter of the fool: this also is vanity.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ inilara mu ọlọgbọ́n enia sinwin; ọrẹ a si ba aiya jẹ.
entries.en: Surely oppression maketh a wise man mad; and a gift destroyeth the heart.

entries.yo: Opin nkan san jù ipilẹṣẹ rẹ̀ lọ: ati onisuru ọkàn jù ọlọkàn igberaga.
entries.en: Better is the end of a thing than the beginning thereof: and the patient in spirit is better than the proud in spirit.

entries.yo: Máṣe yara li ọkàn rẹ lati binu, nitoripe ibinu simi li aiya aṣiwère.
entries.en: Be not hasty in thy spirit to be angry: for anger resteth in the bosom of fools.

entries.yo: Iwọ máṣe wipe, nitori kili ọjọ iṣaju ṣe san jù wọnyi lọ? nitoripe iwọ kò fi ọgbọ́n bere niti eyi.
entries.en: Say not thou, What is the cause that the former days were better than these? for thou dost not inquire wisely concerning this.

entries.yo: Ọgbọ́n dara gẹgẹ bi iní, ati nipasẹ rẹ̀ ère wà fun awọn ti nri õrùn.
entries.en: Wisdom is good with an inheritance: and by it there is profit to them that see the sun.

entries.yo: Nitoripe ãbò li ọgbọ́n, ani bi owo ti jẹ́ abò: ṣugbọn ère ìmọ ni pe, ọgbọ́n fi ìye fun awọn ti o ni i.
entries.en: For wisdom is a defence, and money is a defence: but the excellency of knowledge is, that wisdom giveth life to them that have it.

entries.yo: Wò iṣẹ Ọlọrun: nitoripe, tali o le mu eyini tọ́ ti on ṣe ni wiwọ?
entries.en: Consider the work of God: for who can make that straight, which he hath made crooked?

entries.yo: Li ọjọ alafia, mã yọ̀, ṣugbọn li ọjọ ipọnju, ronu pe, bi Ọlọrun ti da ekini bẹ̃li o da ekeji, niti idi eyi pe ki enia ki o máṣe ri nkan ti mbọ̀ lẹhin rẹ̀.
entries.en: In the day of prosperity be joyful, but in the day of adversity consider: God also hath set the one over against the other, to the end that man should find nothing after him.

entries.yo: Ohun gbogbo ni mo ri li ọjọ asan mi: olõtọ enia wà ti o ṣegbé ninu ododo rẹ̀, ati enia buburu wà ti ọjọ rẹ̀ pẹ ninu ìwa buburu rẹ̀.
entries.en: All things have I seen in the days of my vanity: there is a just man that perisheth in his righteousness, and there is a wicked man that prolongeth his life in his wickedness.

entries.yo: Iwọ máṣe ododo aṣeleke; bẹ̃ni ki iwọ ki o máṣe fi ara rẹ ṣe ọlọgbọ́n aṣeleke: nitori kini iwọ o ṣe run ara rẹ?
entries.en: Be not righteous over much; neither make thyself over wise: why shouldest thou destroy thyself?

entries.yo: Iwọ máṣe buburu aṣeleke, bẹ̃ni ki iwọ ki o má ṣiwère; nitori kini iwọ o ṣe kú ki ọjọ rẹ ki o to pe?
entries.en: Be not over much wicked, neither be thou foolish: why shouldest thou die before thy time?

entries.yo: O dara ki iwọ ki o dì eyi mu; pẹlupẹlu iwọ máṣe yọ ọwọ rẹ kuro ninu eyi: nitori ẹniti o bẹ̀ru Ọlọrun ni yio yọ kuro ninu rẹ̀ gbogbo.
entries.en: It is good that thou shouldest take hold of this; yea, also from this withdraw not thine hand: for he that feareth God shall come forth of them all.

entries.yo: Ọgbọ́n mu ọlọgbọ́n lara le jù enia alagbara mẹwa lọ ti o wà ni ilu.
entries.en: Wisdom strengtheneth the wise more than ten mighty men which are in the city.

entries.yo: Nitoriti kò si olõtọ enia lori ilẹ, ti nṣe rere ti kò si dẹṣẹ.
entries.en: For there is not a just man upon earth, that doeth good, and sinneth not.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu máṣe fiyesi gbogbo ọ̀rọ ti a nsọ; ki iwọ ki o má ba gbọ́ ki iranṣẹ rẹ ki o bu ọ.
entries.en: Also take no heed unto all words that are spoken; lest thou hear thy servant curse thee:

entries.yo: Nitoripe nigba pupọ pẹlu li aiya rẹ mọ̀ pe iwọ tikalarẹ pẹlu ti bu awọn ẹlomiran.
entries.en: For oftentimes also thine own heart knoweth that thou thyself likewise hast cursed others.

entries.yo: Idi gbogbo wọnyi ni mo fi ọgbọ́n wá; mo ni, emi o gbọ́n: ṣugbọn ọ̀na rẹ̀ jin si mi.
entries.en: All this have I proved by wisdom: I said, I will be wise; but it was far from me.

entries.yo: Eyi ti o jinna, ti o si jinlẹ gidigidi, tali o le wá a ri?
entries.en: That which is far off, and exceeding deep, who can find it out?

entries.yo: Mo fi aiya mi si i lati mọ̀, on ati wadi, on ati ṣe afẹri ọgbọ́n ati oye, on ati mọ̀ ìwa buburu wère, ani ti wère ati ti isinwin:
entries.en: I applied mine heart to know, and to search, and to seek out wisdom, and the reason of things, and to know the wickedness of folly, even of foolishness and madness:

entries.yo: Mo si ri ohun ti o korò jù ikú lọ, ani obinrin ti aiya rẹ̀ iṣe idẹkun ati àwọn, ati ọwọ rẹ̀ bi ọbára: ẹnikẹni ti inu Ọlọrun dùn si yio bọ lọwọ rẹ̀; ṣugbọn ẹlẹṣẹ li a o ti ọwọ rẹ̀ mu.
entries.en: And I find more bitter than death the woman, whose heart is snares and nets, and her hands as bands: whoso pleaseth God shall escape from her; but the sinner shall be taken by her.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, eyi ni mo ri, bẹ̃li oniwasu wi, ni wiwadi rẹ̀ li ọkọkan lati ri oye.
entries.en: Behold, this have I found, saith the preacher, counting one by one, to find out the account:

entries.yo: Ti ọkàn mi nwakiri sibẹ, ṣugbọn emi kò ri: ọkunrin kanṣoṣo ninu ẹgbẹrun ni mo ri; ṣugbọn obinrin kan ninu gbogbo awọn wọnni, emi kò ri.
entries.en: Which yet my soul seeketh, but I find not: one man among a thousand have I found; but a woman among all those have I not found.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, eyi nikanṣoṣo ni mo ri, pe, Ọlọrun ti da enia ni iduroṣinṣin; ṣugbọn nwọn ti ṣe afẹri ihumọkihumọ.
entries.en: Lo, this only have I found, that God hath made man upright; but they have sought out many inventions.

entries.yo: TALI o dabi ọlọgbọ́n enia? tali o si mọ̀ itumọ nkan? Ọgbọ́n enia mu oju rẹ̀ dán, ati igboju rẹ̀ li a o si yipada.
entries.en: Who is as the wise man? and who knoweth the interpretation of a thing? a man's wisdom maketh his face to shine, and the boldness of his face shall be changed.

entries.yo: Mo ba ọ mọ̀ ọ pe, ki iwọ ki o pa ofin ọba mọ́, eyini si ni nitori ibura Ọlọrun.
entries.en: I counsel thee to keep the king's commandment, and that in regard of the oath of God.

entries.yo: Máṣe yara ati jade kuro niwaju rẹ̀: máṣe duro ninu ohun buburu; nitori ohun ti o wù u ni iṣe.
entries.en: Be not hasty to go out of his sight: stand not in an evil thing; for he doeth whatsoever pleaseth him.

entries.yo: Nibiti ọ̀rọ ọba gbe wà, agbara mbẹ nibẹ; tali o si le wi fun u pe, kini iwọ nṣe nì?
entries.en: Where the word of a king is, there is power: and who may say unto him, What doest thou?

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni ti o pa ofin mọ́ kì yio mọ̀ ohun buburu: aiya ọlọgbọ́n enia si mọ̀ ìgba ati àṣa.
entries.en: Whoso keepeth the commandment shall feel no evil thing: and a wise man's heart discerneth both time and judgment.

entries.yo: Nitoripe ohun gbogbo ti o wuni ni ìgba ati àṣa wà fun, nitorina òṣi enia pọ̀ si ori ara rẹ̀.
entries.en: Because to every purpose there is time and judgment, therefore the misery of man is great upon him.

entries.yo: Nitoriti kò mọ̀ ohun ti mbọ̀: tali o si le wi fun u bi yio ti ri?
entries.en: For he knoweth not that which shall be: for who can tell him when it shall be?

entries.yo: Kò si enia kan ti o lagbara lori ẹmi lati da ẹmi duro; bẹ̃ni kò si lagbara li ọjọ ikú: kò si iránpada ninu ogun na; bẹ̃ni ìwa buburu kò le gbà awọn oluwa rẹ̀.
entries.en: There is no man that hath power over the spirit to retain the spirit; neither hath he power in the day of death: and there is no discharge in that war; neither shall wickedness deliver those that are given to it.

entries.yo: Gbogbo nkan wọnyi ni mo ri, mo si fiyè si iṣẹ gbogbo ti a nṣe labẹ õrùn: ìgba kan mbẹ ninu eyi ti ẹnikan nṣe olori ẹnikeji fun ifarapa rẹ̀.
entries.en: All this have I seen, and applied my heart unto every work that is done under the sun: there is a time wherein one man ruleth over another to his own hurt.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni mo si ri isinkú enia buburu, ati awọn ti o ṣe otitọ ti o wá ti o si lọ kuro ni ibi mimọ́, a si gbagbe wọn ni ilu na: asan li eyi pẹlu.
entries.en: And so I saw the wicked buried, who had come and gone from the place of the holy, and they were forgotten in the city where they had so done: this is also vanity.

entries.yo: Nitoriti a kò mu idajọ ṣẹ kánkán si iṣẹ buburu, nitorina aiya awọn ọmọ enia mura pãpa lati huwa ibi.
entries.en: Because sentence against an evil work is not executed speedily, therefore the heart of the sons of men is fully set in them to do evil.

entries.yo: Bi ẹlẹṣẹ tilẹ ṣe ibi nigba ọgọrun, ti ọjọ rẹ̀ si gùn, ṣugbọn nitõtọ, emi mọ̀ pe yio dara fun awọn ti o bẹ̀ru Ọlọrun, ti o bẹ̀ru niwaju rẹ̀:
entries.en: Though a sinner do evil an hundred times, and his days be prolonged, yet surely I know that it shall be well with them that fear God, which fear before him:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn kì yio dara fun enia buburu, bẹ̃ni kì yio fa ọjọ rẹ̀ gun ti o dabi ojiji, nitoriti kò bẹ̀ru niwaju Ọlọrun.
entries.en: But it shall not be well with the wicked, neither shall he prolong his days, which are as a shadow; because he feareth not before God.

entries.yo: Asan kan mbẹ ti a nṣe li aiye; niti pe, olõtọ enia wà, awọn ti o nri fun bi iṣẹ buburu; ati pẹlu, enia buburu wà, awọn ti o nri fun bi iṣẹ olododo: mo ni asan li eyi pẹlu.
entries.en: There is a vanity which is done upon the earth; that there be just men, unto whom it happeneth according to the work of the wicked; again, there be wicked men, to whom it happeneth according to the work of the righteous: I said that this also is vanity.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni mo yìn iré, nitori enia kò ni ohun rere labẹ õrùn jù jijẹ ati mimu, ati ṣiṣe ariya: nitori eyini ni yio ba a duro ninu lãla rẹ̀ li ọjọ aiye rẹ̀, ti Ọlọrun fi fun u labẹ õrùn.
entries.en: Then I commended mirth, because a man hath no better thing under the sun, than to eat, and to drink, and to be merry: for that shall abide with him of his labour the days of his life, which God giveth him under the sun.

entries.yo: Nigbati mo fi aiya mi si ati mọ̀ ọgbọ́n, on ati ri ohun ti a ṣe lori ilẹ: (ẹnikan sa wà pẹlu ti kò fi oju rẹ̀ ba orun li ọsan ati li oru.)
entries.en: When I applied mine heart to know wisdom, and to see the business that is done upon the earth: (for also there is that neither day nor night seeth sleep with his eyes:)

entries.yo: Nigbana ni mo wò gbogbo iṣẹ Ọlọrun, pe enia kò le ridi iṣẹ ti a nṣe labẹ õrùn: nitoripe bi enia tilẹ gbiyanju ati wadi rẹ̀, sibẹ kì yio le ri i; ati pẹlupẹlu bi ọlọgbọ́n enia rò lati wadi rẹ̀, sibẹ kì yio lè ridi rẹ̀.
entries.en: Then I beheld all the work of God, that a man cannot find out the work that is done under the sun: because though a man labour to seek it out, yet he shall not find it; yea further; though a wise man think to know it, yet shall he not be able to find it.

entries.yo: NITORI nkan yi ni mo rò li aiya mi, ani lati wadi gbogbo eyi pe, olododo, ati ọlọgbọ́n, ati iṣẹ wọn, lọwọ Ọlọrun li o wà: ifẹni ati irira, kò si ẹniti o mọ̀, gbogbo eyi wà niwaju wọn.
entries.en: For all this I considered in my heart even to declare all this, that the righteous, and the wise, and their works, are in the hand of God: no man knoweth either love or hatred by all that is before them.

entries.yo: Bakanna li ohun gbogbo ri fun gbogbo wọn: ohun kanna li o nṣe si olododo, ati si ẹni buburu; si enia rere, ati si mimọ́ ati si alaimọ́; si ẹniti nrubọ, ati si ẹniti kò rubọ: bi enia rere ti ri, bẹ̃ li ẹ̀lẹṣẹ; ati ẹniti mbura bi ẹniti o bẹ̀ru ibura.
entries.en: All things come alike to all: there is one event to the righteous, and to the wicked; to the good and to the clean, and to the unclean; to him that sacrificeth, and to him that sacrificeth not: as is the good, so is the sinner; and he that sweareth, as he that feareth an oath.

entries.yo: Eyi ni ibi ninu ohun gbogbo ti a nṣe labẹ õrùn, pe iṣẹ kanna ni si gbogbo wọn: ati pẹlu, aiya awọn ọmọ enia kún fun ibi, isinwin mbẹ ninu wọn nigbati wọn wà lãye, ati lẹhin eyini; nwọn a lọ sọdọ awọn okú.
entries.en: This is an evil among all things that are done under the sun, that there is one event unto all: yea, also the heart of the sons of men is full of evil, and madness is in their heart while they live, and after that they go to the dead.

entries.yo: Nitoripe tali ẹniti a yàn, ti ireti alãye wà fun: nitoripe ãye ajá san jù okú kiniun lọ.
entries.en: For to him that is joined to all the living there is hope: for a living dog is better than a dead lion.

entries.yo: Nitori alãye mọ̀ pe awọn o kú; ṣugbọn awọn okú kò mọ̀ ohun kan, bẹ̃ni nwọn kì ili ère mọ; nitori iranti wọn ti di igbagbe.
entries.en: For the living know that they shall die: but the dead know not any thing, neither have they any more a reward; for the memory of them is forgotten.

entries.yo: Ifẹ wọn pẹlu, ati irira wọn, ati ilara wọn, o parun nisisiyi; bẹ̃ni nwọn kò si ni ipin mọ lailai ninu ohun gbogbo ti a nṣe labẹ õrùn.
