entries.en: Also their love, and their hatred, and their envy, is now perished; neither have they any more a portion for ever in any thing that is done under the sun.

entries.yo: Ma ba tirẹ lọ, ma fi ayọ̀ jẹ onjẹ rẹ, ki o si mã fi inu-didun mu ọti-waini rẹ: nitoripe Ọlọrun tẹwọgba iṣẹ rẹ nisisiyi.
entries.en: Go thy way, eat thy bread with joy, and drink thy wine with a merry heart; for God now accepteth thy works.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki aṣọ rẹ ki o ma fún nigbagbogbo; ki o má si jẹ ki ori rẹ ki o ṣe alaini ororo ikunra,
entries.en: Let thy garments be always white; and let thy head lack no ointment.

entries.yo: Ma fi ayọ̀ ba aya rẹ gbe ti iwọ fẹ ni gbogbo ọjọ aiye asan rẹ, ti o fi fun ọ labẹ õrùn ni gbogbo ọjọ asan rẹ: nitori eyini ni ipin tirẹ li aiye yi, ati ninu lãla ti iwọ ṣe labẹ õrùn.
entries.en: Live joyfully with the wife whom thou lovest all the days of the life of thy vanity, which he hath given thee under the sun, all the days of thy vanity: for that is thy portion in this life, and in thy labour which thou takest under the sun.

entries.yo: Ohunkohun ti ọwọ rẹ ri ni ṣiṣe, fi agbara rẹ ṣe e; nitoriti kò si ete, bẹ̃ni kò si ìmọ, tabi ọgbọ́n, ni isa-okú nibiti iwọ nrè.
entries.en: Whatsoever thy hand findeth to do, do it with thy might; for there is no work, nor device, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in the grave, whither thou goest.

entries.yo: Mo pada, mo si ri labẹ õrùn, pe ire-ije kì iṣe ti ẹniti o yara, bẹ̃li ogun kì iṣe ti alagbara, bẹ̃li onjẹ kì iṣe ti ọlọgbọ́n, bẹ̃li ọrọ̀ kì iṣe ti ẹni oye, bẹ̃li ojurere kì iṣe ti ọlọgbọ́n-inu; ṣugbọn ìgba ati eṣe nṣe si gbogbo wọn.
entries.en: I returned, and saw under the sun, that the race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, neither yet bread to the wise, nor yet riches to men of understanding, nor yet favour to men of skill; but time and chance happeneth to them all.

entries.yo: Nitoripe enia pẹlu kò mọ̀ ìgba tirẹ̀; bi ẹja ti a mu ninu àwọn buburu, ati bi ẹiyẹ ti a mu ninu okùn; bẹ̃li a ndẹ awọn ọmọ enia ni ìgba buburu, nigbati o ṣubu lù wọn lojiji.
entries.en: For man also knoweth not his time: as the fishes that are taken in an evil net, and as the birds that are caught in the snare; so are the sons of men snared in an evil time, when it falleth suddenly upon them.

entries.yo: Ọgbọ́n yi ni mo ri pẹlu labẹ õrùn, o si dabi ẹnipe o tobi fun mi.
entries.en: This wisdom have I seen also under the sun, and it seemed great unto me:

entries.yo: Ilu kekere kan wà, ati enia diẹ ninu rẹ̀; ọba nla kan si ṣigun tọ̀ ọ lọ, o si dótì i, o si mọ ile-iṣọ ti o tobi tì i.
entries.en: There was a little city, and few men within it; and there came a great king against it, and besieged it, and built great bulwarks against it:

entries.yo: A si ri ọkunrin talaka ọlọgbọ́n ninu rẹ̀, on si fi ọgbọ́n rẹ̀ gbà ilu na silẹ; ṣugbọn kò si ẹnikan ti o ranti ọkunrin talaka na.
entries.en: Now there was found in it a poor wise man, and he by his wisdom delivered the city; yet no man remembered that same poor man.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni mo wipe, Ọgbọ́n san jù agbara lọ; ṣugbọn a kẹgan ọgbọ́n ọkunrin talaka na, ohùn rẹ̀ kò si to òke.
entries.en: Then said I, Wisdom is better than strength: nevertheless the poor man's wisdom is despised, and his words are not heard.

entries.yo: A ngbọ́ ọ̀rọ ọlọgbọ́n enia ni pẹlẹ jù igbe ẹniti njẹ olori ninu awọn aṣiwère.
entries.en: The words of wise men are heard in quiet more than the cry of him that ruleth among fools.

entries.yo: Ọgbọ́n san jù ohun-elo ogun: ṣugbọn ẹ̀lẹṣẹ kan o ba ohun didara pupọ jẹ.
entries.en: Wisdom is better than weapons of war: but one sinner destroyeth much good.

entries.yo: OKÚ eṣinṣin o mu ororo-ikunra alapolu bajẹ ki o ma run õrùn buburu: bẹ̃ni wère diẹ wuwo jù ọgbọ́n ati ọlá lọ.
entries.en: Dead flies cause the ointment of the apothecary to send forth a stinking savour: so doth a little folly him that is in reputation for wisdom and honour.

entries.yo: Aiya ọlọgbọ́n mbẹ li ọwọ ọtún rẹ̀; ṣugbọn aiya aṣiwère li ọwọ òsi rẹ̀.
entries.en: A wise man's heart is at his right hand; but a fool's heart at his left.

entries.yo: Ati pẹlu nigbati ẹniti o ṣiwère ba nrìn li ọ̀na, ọgbọ́n rẹ̀ a fò lọ, on a si wi fun olukuluku enia pe aṣiwère li on.
entries.en: Yea also, when he that is a fool walketh by the way, his wisdom faileth him, and he saith to every one that he is a fool.

entries.yo: Bi ọkàn ijoye ba ru si ọ, máṣe fi ipò rẹ silẹ; nitoripe itũbá ama tù ẹ̀ṣẹ nla.
entries.en: If the spirit of the ruler rise up against thee, leave not thy place; for yielding pacifieth great offences.

entries.yo: Buburu kan mbẹ ti mo ri labẹ õrùn, bi ìṣina ti o ti ọdọ awọn ijoye wá.
entries.en: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, as an error which proceedeth from the ruler:

entries.yo: A gbe aṣiwère sipò ọlá, awọn ọlọrọ̀ si joko nipò ẹhin.
entries.en: Folly is set in great dignity, and the rich sit in low place.

entries.yo: Mo ri awọn ọmọ-ọdọ lori ẹṣin, ati awọn ọmọ-alade nrìn bi ọmọ-ọdọ ni ilẹ.
entries.en: I have seen servants upon horses, and princes walking as servants upon the earth.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o wà iho ni yio bọ́ sinu rẹ̀; ati ẹniti o si njá ọgbà tútù, ejo yio si bù u ṣán.
entries.en: He that diggeth a pit shall fall into it; and whoso breaketh an hedge, a serpent shall bite him.

entries.yo: Ẹnikan ti o nyi okuta ni yio si ti ipa rẹ̀ ni ipalara; ati ẹniti o si nla igi ni yio si wu li ewu.
entries.en: Whoso removeth stones shall be hurt therewith; and he that cleaveth wood shall be endangered thereby.

entries.yo: Bi irin ba kújú, ti on kò si pọn oju rẹ̀, njẹ ki on ki o fi agbara si i; ṣugbọn ère ọgbọ́n ni lati fi ọ̀na hàn.
entries.en: If the iron be blunt, and he do not whet the edge, then must he put to more strength: but wisdom is profitable to direct.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ bi ejo ba bu ni ṣán lainitùju; njẹ ère kì yio si fun onitùju.
entries.en: Surely the serpent will bite without enchantment; and a babbler is no better.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ ẹnu ọlọgbọ̀n li ore-ọfẹ; ṣugbọn ète aṣiwère ni yio gbe ara rẹ̀ mì.
entries.en: The words of a wise man's mouth are gracious; but the lips of a fool will swallow up himself.

entries.yo: Ipilẹṣẹ ọ̀rọ ẹnu rẹ̀ ni wère: ati opin ọ̀rọ ẹnu rẹ̀ ni isinwin iparun.
entries.en: The beginning of the words of his mouth is foolishness: and the end of his talk is mischievous madness.

entries.yo: Aṣiwère pẹlu kún fun ọ̀rọ pupọ: enia kò le sọ ohun ti yio ṣẹ; ati ohun ti yio wà lẹhin rẹ̀, tali o le wi fun u?
entries.en: A fool also is full of words: a man cannot tell what shall be; and what shall be after him, who can tell him?

entries.yo: Lãla aṣiwère da olukuluku wọn li agara, nitoriti kò mọ̀ bi a ti lọ si ilu.
entries.en: The labour of the foolish wearieth every one of them, because he knoweth not how to go to the city.

entries.yo: Egbé ni fun ọ, iwọ ilẹ, nigbati ọba rẹ ba ṣe ọmọde, ti awọn ọmọ-alade rẹ njẹun ni kutukutu.
entries.en: Woe to thee, O land, when thy king is a child, and thy princes eat in the morning!

entries.yo: Ibukún ni fun ọ, iwọ ilẹ, nigbati ọba rẹ ba jẹ ọmọ ọlọlá, ti awọn ọmọ-alade rẹ njẹun li akoko ti o yẹ, fun ilera ti kì si iṣe fun ọti amupara!
entries.en: Blessed art thou, O land, when thy king is the son of nobles, and thy princes eat in due season, for strength, and not for drunkenness!

entries.yo: Nipa ilọra pupọ igi ile a hù; ati nipa ọlẹ ọwọ, ile a si ma jò.
entries.en: By much slothfulness the building decayeth; and through idleness of the hands the house droppeth through.

entries.yo: Ẹrín li a nsàse fun, ati ọti-waini ni imu inu alãye dùn: owo si ni idahùn ohun gbogbo.
entries.en: A feast is made for laughter, and wine maketh merry: but money answereth all things.

entries.yo: Máṣe bu ọba, ki o má ṣe ninu èro rẹ; máṣe bu ọlọrọ̀ ni iyẹwu rẹ; nitoripe ẹiyẹ oju-ọrun yio gbe ohùn na lọ, ohun ti o ni iyẹ-apá yio si sọ ọ̀ran na.
entries.en: Curse not the king, no not in thy thought; and curse not the rich in thy bedchamber: for a bird of the air shall carry the voice, and that which hath wings shall tell the matter.

entries.yo: FUN onjẹ rẹ si oju omi; nitoriti iwọ o ri i lẹhin ọjọ pupọ.
entries.en: Cast thy bread upon the waters: for thou shalt find it after many days.

entries.yo: Fi ipin fun meje ati fun mẹjọ pẹlu, nitoriti iwọ kò mọ̀ ibi ti yio wà laiye.
entries.en: Give a portion to seven, and also to eight; for thou knowest not what evil shall be upon the earth.

entries.yo: Bi awọsanma ba kún fun òjo, nwọn a si tu dà si aiye: bi igi ba si wó sìha gusu tabi siha ariwa, nibiti igi na gbe ṣubu si, nibẹ ni yio si ma gbe.
entries.en: If the clouds be full of rain, they empty themselves upon the earth: and if the tree fall toward the south, or toward the north, in the place where the tree falleth, there it shall be.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o nkiyesi afẹfẹ kì yio funrugbin; ati ẹniti o si nwòju awọsanma kì yio ṣe ikore.
entries.en: He that observeth the wind shall not sow; and he that regardeth the clouds shall not reap.

entries.yo: Bi iwọ kò ti mọ ipa-ọ̀na afẹfẹ, tabi bi egungun ti idàgba ninu aboyun: ani bẹ̃ni iwọ kò le mọ̀ iṣẹ Ọlọrun ti nṣe ohun gbogbo.
entries.en: As thou knowest not what is the way of the spirit, nor how the bones do grow in the womb of her that is with child: even so thou knowest not the works of God who maketh all.

entries.yo: Ni kutukutu fún irugbin rẹ, ati li aṣãlẹ máṣe da ọwọ rẹ duro: nitori ti iwọ kò mọ̀ eyi ti yio ṣe rere, yala eyi tabi eyini, tabi bi awọn mejeji yio dara bakanna.
entries.en: In the morning sow thy seed, and in the evening withhold not thine hand: for thou knowest not whether shall prosper, either this or that, or whether they both shall be alike good.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ imọlẹ dùn ati ohun didara ni fun oju lati wò õrùn.
entries.en: Truly the light is sweet, and a pleasant thing it is for the eyes to behold the sun:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi enia wà li ọ̀pọlọpọ ọdun, ti o si nyọ̀ ninu gbogbo wọn, sibẹ, jẹ ki o ranti ọjọ òkunkun pe nwọn o pọ̀. Ohun gbogbo ti mbọ̀, asan ni.
entries.en: But if a man live many years, and rejoice in them all; yet let him remember the days of darkness; for they shall be many. All that cometh is vanity.

entries.yo: Mã yọ̀, iwọ ọdọmọde ninu ewe rẹ; ki o si jẹ ki ọkàn rẹ ki o mu ọ laraya li ọjọ ewe rẹ, ki o si ma rìn nipa ọ̀na ọkàn rẹ ati nipa irí oju rẹ; ṣugbọn iwọ mọ̀ eyi pe, nitori nkan wọnyi Ọlọrun yio mu ọ wá si idajọ.
entries.en: Rejoice, O young man, in thy youth; and let thy heart cheer thee in the days of thy youth, and walk in the ways of thine heart, and in the sight of thine eyes: but know thou, that for all these things God will bring thee into judgment.

entries.yo: Nitorina ṣi ibinujẹ kuro li aiya rẹ, ki o si mu ibi kuro li ara rẹ: nitoripe asan ni igba-ewe ati ọmọde.
entries.en: Therefore remove sorrow from thy heart, and put away evil from thy flesh: for childhood and youth are vanity.

entries.yo: RANTI ẹlẹda rẹ nisisiyi li ọjọ ewe rẹ, nigbati ọjọ ibi kò ti ide, ati ti ọdun kò ti isunmọ etile, nigbati iwọ o wipe, emi kò ni inudidùn ninu wọn;
entries.en: Remember now thy Creator in the days of thy youth, while the evil days come not, nor the years draw nigh, when thou shalt say, I have no pleasure in them;

entries.yo: Nigbati õrùn, tabi imọlẹ, tabi oṣupa tabi awọn irawọ kò ti iṣu òkunkun, ati ti awọsanma kò ti itun pada lẹhin òjo:
entries.en: While the sun, or the light, or the moon, or the stars, be not darkened, nor the clouds return after the rain:

entries.yo: Li ọjọ ti awọn oluṣọ ile yio warìri, ati ti awọn ọkunrin alagbara yio tẹri wọn ba, awọn õlọ̀ yio si dakẹ nitoriti nwọn kò to nkan, ati awọn ti nwode loju ferese yio ṣu òkunkun,
entries.en: In the day when the keepers of the house shall tremble, and the strong men shall bow themselves, and the grinders cease because they are few, and those that look out of the windows be darkened,

entries.yo: Ti ilẹkun yio si se ni igboro, nigbati iró ọlọ yio rẹlẹ, ti yio si dide li ohùn kike ẹiyẹ, ati ti gbogbo awọn ọmọbinrin orin yio rẹ̀ silẹ;
entries.en: And the doors shall be shut in the streets, when the sound of the grinding is low, and he shall rise up at the voice of the bird, and all the daughters of musick shall be brought low;

entries.yo: Ati pẹlu ti nwọn o bẹ̀ru ibi ti o ga, ti iwariri yio si wà li ọ̀na, ati ti igi almondi yio tanna, ti ẹlẹnga yio di ẹrù, ti ifẹ yio si ṣá: nitoriti ọkunrin nlọ si ile rẹ̀ pipẹ, awọn aṣọ̀fọ yio si ma yide kakiri.
entries.en: Also when they shall be afraid of that which is high, and fears shall be in the way, and the almond tree shall flourish, and the grasshopper shall be a burden, and desire shall fail: because man goeth to his long home, and the mourners go about the streets:

entries.yo: Tabi ki okùn fadaka ki o to tu, tabi ki ọpọn wura ki o to fọ, tabi ki ìṣa ki o to fọ nibi isun, tabi ki ayika-kẹkẹ ki o to kán nibi kanga.
entries.en: Or ever the silver cord be loosed, or the golden bowl be broken, or the pitcher be broken at the fountain, or the wheel broken at the cistern.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni erupẹ yio pada si ilẹ bi o ti wà ri, ẹmi yio si pada tọ̀ Ọlọrun ti o fi i funni.
entries.en: Then shall the dust return to the earth as it was: and the spirit shall return unto God who gave it.

entries.yo: Asan ninu asan, oniwasu wipe, gbogbo rẹ̀ asan ni.
entries.en: Vanity of vanities, saith the preacher; all is vanity.

entries.yo: Ati pẹlu, nitori Oniwasu na gbọ́n, o si nkọ́ awọn enia ni ìmọ pẹlu; nitõtọ o ṣe akiyesi daradara, o si wadi, o si fi owe pupọ lelẹ li ẹsẹsẹ.
entries.en: And moreover, because the preacher was wise, he still taught the people knowledge; yea, he gave good heed, and sought out, and set in order many proverbs.

entries.yo: Oniwasu wadi ati ri ọ̀rọ didùn eyiti a si kọ, ohun iduro-ṣinṣin ni, ani ọ̀rọ otitọ.
entries.en: The preacher sought to find out acceptable words: and that which was written was upright, even words of truth.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ ọlọgbọ́n dabi ẹgún, ati awọn olori akojọ-ọ̀rọ bi iṣó ti a kàn, ti a nfi fun ni lati ọwọ oluṣọ-agutan kan wá.
entries.en: The words of the wise are as goads, and as nails fastened by the masters of assemblies, which are given from one shepherd.

entries.yo: Ati siwaju, lati inu eyi, ọmọ mi, ki o gbà ìmọran: ninu kikọ iwe pupọ, opin kò si: ati iwe kikà pupọ li ãrẹ̀ ara.
entries.en: And further, by these, my son, be admonished: of making many books there is no end; and much study is a weariness of the flesh.

entries.yo: Opin gbogbo ọ̀rọ na ti a gbọ́ ni pe: Bẹ̀ru Ọlọrun ki o si pa ofin rẹ̀ mọ́: nitori eyi ni fun gbogbo enia.
entries.en: Let us hear the conclusion of the whole matter: Fear God, and keep his commandments: for this is the whole duty of man.

entries.yo: Nitoripe Ọlọrun yio mu olukuluku iṣẹ wa sinu idajọ, ati olukuluku ohun ìkọkọ, ibã ṣe rere, ibã ṣe buburu.
entries.en: For God shall bring every work into judgment, with every secret thing, whether it be good, or whether it be evil.

entries.yo: ORIN awọn orin ti iṣe ti Solomoni.
entries.en: The song of songs, which is Solomon's.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki o fi ifẹnukonu ẹnu rẹ̀ kò mi li ẹnu nitori ifẹ rẹ sàn jù ọti-waini lọ.
entries.en: Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth: for thy love is better than wine.

entries.yo: Nitoriti õrun ikunra rere rẹ, orukọ rẹ dabi ikunra ti a tú jade, nitorina ni awọn wundia ṣe fẹ ọ.
entries.en: Because of the savour of thy good ointments thy name is as ointment poured forth, therefore do the virgins love thee.

entries.yo: Fà mi, awa o sare tọ̀ ọ: ọba ti mu mi wá sinu iyẹwù rẹ̀: awa o yọ̀, inu wa o si dùn si ọ, awa o ranti ifẹ rẹ jù ọti-waini lọ: nwọn fẹ ọ nitõtọ.
entries.en: Draw me, we will run after thee: the king hath brought me into his chambers: we will be glad and rejoice in thee, we will remember thy love more than wine: the upright love thee.

entries.yo: Emi dú, ṣugbọn mo li ẹwà, Ẹnyin ọmọbinrin Jerusalemu, bi awọn agọ Kedari, bi awọn aṣọ-tita Solomoni.
entries.en: I am black, but comely, O ye daughters of Jerusalem, as the tents of Kedar, as the curtains of Solomon.

entries.yo: Máṣe wò mi, nitori pe mo dú, nitori pe õrùn ti bojuwò mi: awọn ọmọ iyá mi binu si mi; nwọn fi mi ṣe oluṣọ ọgba-ajara; ṣugbọn ọgba-ajara temi li emi kò tọju.
entries.en: Look not upon me, because I am black, because the sun hath looked upon me: my mother's children were angry with me; they made me the keeper of the vineyards; but mine own vineyard have I not kept.

entries.yo: Wi fun mi, Iwọ ẹniti ọkàn mi fẹ, nibiti iwọ nṣọ agutan; nibiti iwọ nmu agbo-ẹran rẹ simi li ọsan; ki emi ki o má ba dabi alãrẹ̀ ti o ṣina kiri pẹlu agbo-ẹran awọn ẹgbẹ́ rẹ.
entries.en: Tell me, O thou whom my soul loveth, where thou feedest, where thou makest thy flock to rest at noon: for why should I be as one that turneth aside by the flocks of thy companions?

entries.yo: Bi iwọ kò ba mọ̀, Iwọ arẹwà julọ ninu awọn obinrin, jade lọ ni ipasẹ agbo-ẹran, ki iwọ ki o si bọ́ awọn ọmọ ewurẹ rẹ lẹba agọ awọn aluṣọ-agutan.
entries.en: If thou know not, O thou fairest among women, go thy way forth by the footsteps of the flock, and feed thy kids beside the shepherds' tents.

entries.yo: Olufẹ mi, mo ti fi ọ we ẹṣin mi ninu kẹkẹ́ Farao.
entries.en: I have compared thee, O my love, to a company of horses in Pharaoh's chariots.

entries.yo: Ẹrẹkẹ́ rẹ li ẹwà ninu ọwọ́ ohun ọṣọ́, ọrùn rẹ ninu ilẹkẹ.
entries.en: Thy cheeks are comely with rows of jewels, thy neck with chains of gold.

entries.yo: Awa o ṣe ọwọ́ ohun ọṣọ́ wura fun ọ, pẹlu ami fadaka.
entries.en: We will make thee borders of gold with studs of silver.

entries.yo: Nigbati ọba wà ni ibujoko ijẹun rẹ̀, ororo mi rán õrun rẹ̀ jade.
entries.en: While the king sitteth at his table, my spikenard sendeth forth the smell thereof.

entries.yo: Idi ojia ni olufẹ ọ̀wọ́n mi si mi; on o ma gbe ãrin ọmu mi.
entries.en: A bundle of myrrh is my wellbeloved unto me; he shall lie all night betwixt my breasts.

entries.yo: Olufẹ mi ri si mi bi ìdi ìtànná igi kipressi ni ọgba-ajara Engedi.
entries.en: My beloved is unto me as a cluster of camphire in the vineyards of En-gedi.

entries.yo: Wò o, iwọ li ẹwà, olufẹ mi; wò o, iwọ li ẹwà: iwọ li oju àdaba.
entries.en: Behold, thou art fair, my love; behold, thou art fair; thou hast doves' eyes.

entries.yo: Wò o, iwọ li ẹwà, olufẹ mi, nitõtọ, o wuni: ibusun wa pẹlu ni itura.
entries.en: Behold, thou art fair, my beloved, yea, pleasant: also our bed is green.

entries.yo: Igi kedari ni iti-igi ile wa, igi firi si ni ẹkẹ́ wa.
entries.en: The beams of our house are cedar, and our rafters of fir.

entries.yo: EMI ni itanná eweko Ṣaroni, ati itanná lili awọn afonifoji.
entries.en: I am the rose of Sharon, and the lily of the valleys.

entries.yo: Bi itanná lili lãrin ẹgún, bẹ̃li olufẹ mi ri lãrin awọn ọmọbinrin.
entries.en: As the lily among thorns, so is my love among the daughters.

entries.yo: Bi igi eleso lãrin awọn igi igbẹ, bẹ̃li olufẹ mi ri lãrin awọn ọmọkunrin. Emi fi ayọ̀ nla joko labẹ ojiji rẹ̀, eso rẹ̀ si dùn mọ mi li ẹnu.
entries.en: As the apple tree among the trees of the wood, so is my beloved among the sons. I sat down under his shadow with great delight, and his fruit was sweet to my taste.

entries.yo: O mu mi wá si ile ọti-waini, Ifẹ si ni ọpagun rẹ̀ lori mi.
entries.en: He brought me to the banqueting house, and his banner over me was love.

entries.yo: Fi akara didùn da mi duro, fi eso igi tù mi ni inu: nitori aisàn ifẹ nṣe mi.
entries.en: Stay me with flagons, comfort me with apples: for I am sick of love.

entries.yo: Ọwọ osì rẹ̀ mbẹ labẹ ori mi, ọwọ ọtún rẹ̀ si gbá mi mọra.
entries.en: His left hand is under my head, and his right hand doth embrace me.

entries.yo: Mo fi awọn abo egbin, ati awọn abo agbọnrin igbẹ fi nyin bú, ẹnyin ọmọbinrin Jerusalemu, ki ẹ máṣe rú olufẹ mi soke, ki ẹ má si ṣe ji i, titi yio fi wù u.
entries.en: I charge you, O ye daughters of Jerusalem, by the roes, and by the hinds of the field, that ye stir not up, nor awake my love, till he please.

entries.yo: Ohùn olufẹ mi! sa wò o, o mbọ̀, o nfò lori awọn òke, o mbẹ lori awọn òke kékeké.
entries.en: The voice of my beloved! behold, he cometh leaping upon the mountains, skipping upon the hills.

entries.yo: Olufẹ mi dabi abo egbin, tabi ọmọ agbọnrin: sa wò o, o duro lẹhin ogiri wa, o yọju loju ferese, o nfi ara rẹ̀ hàn loju ferese ọlọnà.
entries.en: My beloved is like a roe or a young hart: behold, he standeth behind our wall, he looketh forth at the windows, shewing himself through the lattice.

entries.yo: Olufẹ mi sọ̀rọ, o si wi fun mi pe, Dide, olufẹ mi, arẹwà mi kanna, ki o si jade kalọ.
entries.en: My beloved spake, and said unto me, Rise up, my love, my fair one, and come away.

entries.yo: Sa wò o, ìgba otutu ti kọja, òjo ti da, o si ti lọ.
entries.en: For, lo, the winter is past, the rain is over and gone;

entries.yo: Awọn itanna eweko farahàn lori ilẹ; akoko ikọrin awọn ẹiyẹ de, a si gbọ ohùn àdaba ni ilẹ wa.
entries.en: The flowers appear on the earth; the time of the singing of birds is come, and the voice of the turtle is heard in our land;

entries.yo: Igi ọ̀pọtọ so eso titun, awọn àjara funni ni õrun daradara nipa itanná wọn. Dide, olufẹ mi, arẹwà mi kanna, ki o si jade kalọ.
entries.en: The fig tree putteth forth her green figs, and the vines with the tender grape give a good smell. Arise, my love, my fair one, and come away.

entries.yo: Adaba mi, ti o wà ninu pàlapala okuta, ni ibi ìkọkọ okuta, jẹ ki emi ri oju rẹ, jẹ ki emi gbọ́ ohùn rẹ; nitori didùn ni ohùn rẹ, oju rẹ si li ẹwà.
entries.en: O my dove, that art in the clefts of the rock, in the secret places of the stairs, let me see thy countenance, let me hear thy voice; for sweet is thy voice, and thy countenance is comely.

entries.yo: Mu awọn kọ̀lọkọlọ fun wa, awọn kọ̀lọkọlọ kékeké ti mba àjara jẹ: nitori àjara wa ni itanná.
entries.en: Take us the foxes, the little foxes, that spoil the vines: for our vines have tender grapes.

entries.yo: Olufẹ mi ni temi, emi si ni tirẹ̀: o njẹ lãrin awọn lili.
entries.en: My beloved is mine, and I am his: he feedeth among the lilies.

entries.yo: Titi ìgba itura ọjọ, titi ojiji yio fi salọ, yipada, olufẹ mi, ki iwọ ki o si dabi abo egbin, tabi ọmọ agbọnrin lori awọn oke Beteri.
entries.en: Until the day break, and the shadows flee away, turn, my beloved, and be thou like a roe or a young hart upon the mountains of Bether.

entries.yo: LI oru lori akete mi, mo wá ẹniti ọkàn mi fẹ: emi wá a, ṣugbọn emi kò ri i.
entries.en: By night on my bed I sought him whom my soul loveth: I sought him, but I found him not.

entries.yo: Emi o dide nisisiyi, emi o si rìn lọ ni ilu, ni igboro, ati li ọ̀na gbòro ni emi o wá ẹniti ọkàn mi fẹ: emi wá a, ṣugbọn emi kò ri i.
entries.en: I will rise now, and go about the city in the streets, and in the broad ways I will seek him whom my soul loveth: I sought him, but I found him not.

entries.yo: Awọn oluṣọ ti nrìn ilu yika ri mi: mo bère pe, Ẹ ha ri ẹniti ọkàn mi fẹ bi?
entries.en: The watchmen that go about the city found me: to whom I said, Saw ye him whom my soul loveth?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi mo ti fi wọn silẹ gẹrẹ ni mo ri ẹniti ọkàn mi fẹ: mo dì i mu, emi kò si jọ̃rẹ̀ lọwọ, titi mo fi mu u wá sinu ile iya mi, ati sinu iyẹwu ẹniti o loyun mi.
entries.en: It was but a little that I passed from them, but I found him whom my soul loveth: I held him, and would not let him go, until I had brought him into my mother's house, and into the chamber of her that conceived me.

entries.yo: Mo fi awọn abo egbin ati awọn abo agbọnrin igbẹ fi nyin bú, ẹnyin ọmọbinrin Jerusalemu, ki ẹ máṣe rú olufẹ mi soke, ki ẹ má si ji i, titi yio fi wù u.
entries.en: I charge you, O ye daughters of Jerusalem, by the roes, and by the hinds of the field, that ye stir not up, nor awake my love, till he please.

entries.yo: Tani eyi ti nti ijù jade wá bi ọwọ̀n ẽfin, ti a ti fi ojia ati turari kùn lara, pẹlu gbogbo ipara olõrun oniṣowo?
entries.en: Who is this that cometh out of the wilderness like pillars of smoke, perfumed with myrrh and frankincense, with all powders of the merchant?

entries.yo: Wo akete rẹ̀, ti iṣe ti Solomoni; ọgọta akọni enia li o yi i ka ninu awọn akọni Israeli.
entries.en: Behold his bed, which is Solomon's; threescore valiant men are about it, of the valiant of Israel.

entries.yo: Gbogbo wọn li o di idà mu, nwọn gbọ́n ọgbọ́n ogun: olukulùku kọ́ idà rẹ̀ nitori ẹ̀ru li oru.
entries.en: They all hold swords, being expert in war: every man hath his sword upon his thigh because of fear in the night.

entries.yo: Solomoni, ọba, ṣe akete nla fun ara rẹ̀ lati inu igi Lebanoni.
entries.en: King Solomon made himself a chariot of the wood of Lebanon.

entries.yo: O fi fadaka ṣe ọwọ̀n rẹ̀, o fi wura ṣe ibi ẹhin rẹ̀, o fi elese aluko ṣe ibujoko rẹ̀, inu rẹ̀ li o fi ifẹ tẹ́ nitori awọn ọmọbinrin Jerusalemu.
entries.en: He made the pillars thereof of silver, the bottom thereof of gold, the covering of it of purple, the midst thereof being paved with love, for the daughters of Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Ẹ jade lọ, Ẹnyin ọmọbinrin Sioni, ki ẹ si wò Solomoni, ọba, ti on ti ade ti iya rẹ̀ fi de e li ọjọ igbeyawo rẹ̀, ati li ọjọ ayọ̀ ọkàn rẹ̀.
entries.en: Go forth, O ye daughters of Zion, and behold king Solomon with the crown wherewith his mother crowned him in the day of his espousals, and in the day of the gladness of his heart.

entries.yo: WÒ o, iwọ li ẹwà, olufẹ mi: wò o, iwọ li ẹwà; iwọ li oju àdaba labẹ iboju rẹ: irun rẹ dabi ọwọ́ ewurẹ, ti o dubulẹ lori òke Gileadi.
entries.en: Behold, thou art fair, my love; behold, thou art fair; thou hast doves' eyes within thy locks: thy hair is as a flock of goats, that appear from mount Gilead.

entries.yo: Ehin rẹ dabi ọwọ́ ewurẹ ti a rẹ́ ni irun, ti o gòke lati ibi iwẹ̀ wá, olukulùku wọn bi èjirẹ, kò si si ọkan ti o yàgan ninu wọn.
entries.en: Thy teeth are like a flock of sheep that are even shorn, which came up from the washing; whereof every one bear twins, and none is barren among them.

entries.yo: Ete rẹ dabi owu òdodo, ohùn rẹ si dùn: ẹ̀rẹkẹ rẹ si dabi ẹlà pomegranate kan labẹ iboju rẹ.
entries.en: Thy lips are like a thread of scarlet, and thy speech is comely: thy temples are like a piece of a pomegranate within thy locks.

entries.yo: Ọrùn rẹ dabi ile-iṣọ Dafidi ti a kọ́ fun ihamọra, lori eyi ti a fi ẹgbẹrun apata kọ́, gbogbo wọn jẹ asà awọn alagbara.
entries.en: Thy neck is like the tower of David builded for an armoury, whereon there hang a thousand bucklers, all shields of mighty men.

entries.yo: Ọmu rẹ mejeji dabi abo egbin kekere meji ti iṣe èjirẹ, ti njẹ lãrin itanna lili.
entries.en: Thy two breasts are like two young roes that are twins, which feed among the lilies.

entries.yo: Titi ọjọ yio fi rọ̀, ti ojiji yio si fi fò lọ, emi o lọ si òke nla ojia, ati si òke kékeké turari.
entries.en: Until the day break, and the shadows flee away, I will get me to the mountain of myrrh, and to the hill of frankincense.

entries.yo: Iwọ li ẹwà gbogbo, olufẹ mi; kò si abawọ́n lara rẹ!
entries.en: Thou art all fair, my love; there is no spot in thee.

entries.yo: Ki a lọ kuro ni Lebanoni, iyawo mi, ki a lọ kuro ni Lebanoni: wò lati ori òke Amana, lati ori òke Ṣeniri ati Hermoni, lati ibi ihò kiniun, lati òke awọn ẹkùn.
entries.en: Come with me from Lebanon, my spouse, with me from Lebanon: look from the top of Amana, from the top of Shenir and Hermon, from the lions' dens, from the mountains of the leopards.

entries.yo: Iwọ ti gbà mi li ọkàn, arabinrin mi, iyawo! iwọ ti fi ọkan ninu ìwo oju rẹ, ati ọkan ninu ẹwọ̀n ọrùn rẹ gbà mi li ọkàn.
entries.en: Thou hast ravished my heart, my sister, my spouse; thou hast ravished my heart with one of thine eyes, with one chain of thy neck.

entries.yo: Ifẹ rẹ ti dara to, arabinrin mi, iyawo! ifẹ rẹ ti sàn jù ọti-waini to! õrùn ikunra rẹ si jù turari gbogbo lọ.
entries.en: How fair is thy love, my sister, my spouse! how much better is thy love than wine! and the smell of thine ointments than all spices!

entries.yo: Iyawo! ète rẹ nkán bi afara-oyin: oyin ati wàra mbẹ labẹ ahọn rẹ; õrun aṣọ rẹ si dabi õrun Lebanoni.
entries.en: Thy lips, O my spouse, drop as the honeycomb: honey and milk are under thy tongue; and the smell of thy garments is like the smell of Lebanon.

entries.yo: Ọgbà ti a sọ ni arabinrin mi, iyawo! isun ti a sé, orisun ti a fi edidi dí.
entries.en: A garden inclosed is my sister, my spouse; a spring shut up, a fountain sealed.

entries.yo: Ohun gbigbìn rẹ agbala pomegranate ni, ti on ti eso ti o wunni; kipressi ati nardi.
entries.en: Thy plants are an orchard of pomegranates, with pleasant fruits; camphire, with spikenard,

entries.yo: Nardi ati saffroni; kalamusi, kinnamoni, pẹlu gbogbo igi turari; ojia ati aloe, pẹlu gbogbo awọn olori olõrun didùn.
entries.en: Spikenard and saffron; calamus and cinnamon, with all trees of frankincense; myrrh and aloes, with all the chief spices:

entries.yo: Orisun ninu ọgba kanga omi iyè, ti nṣan lati Lebanoni wá.
entries.en: A fountain of gardens, a well of living waters, and streams from Lebanon.

entries.yo: Ji afẹfẹ ariwa; si wá, iwọ ti gusu; fẹ́ sori ọgbà mi, ki õrun inu rẹ̀ le fẹ́ jade. Jẹ ki olufẹ mi wá sinu ọgbà rẹ̀, ki o si jẹ eso didara rẹ̀.
entries.en: Awake, O north wind; and come, thou south; blow upon my garden, that the spices thereof may flow out. Let my beloved come into his garden, and eat his pleasant fruits.

entries.yo: MO de inu ọgbà mi, arabinrin mi, iyawo! mo ti kó ojia mi pẹlu õrùn didùn mi jọ; mo ti jẹ afara mi pẹlu oyin mi; mo ti mu ọti-waini mi pẹlu wàra mi: Ẹ jẹun, ẹnyin ọrẹ́; mu, ani mu amuyo, ẹnyin olufẹ.
entries.en: I am come into my garden, my sister, my spouse: I have gathered my myrrh with my spice; I have eaten my honeycomb with my honey; I have drunk my wine with my milk: eat, O friends; drink, yea, drink abundantly, O beloved.

entries.yo: Emi sùn, ṣugbọn ọkàn mi ji, ohùn olufẹ mi ni nkànkun, wipe: Ṣilẹkun fun mi, arabinrin mi, olufẹ mi, adaba mi, alailabawọn mi: nitori ori mi kún fun ìri, ati ìdi irun mi fun kikán oru.
entries.en: I sleep, but my heart waketh: it is the voice of my beloved that knocketh, saying, Open to me, my sister, my love, my dove, my undefiled: for my head is filled with dew, and my locks with the drops of the night.

entries.yo: Mo ti bọ́ awọtẹlẹ mi; emi o ti ṣe gbe e wọ̀? mo ti wẹ̀ ẹsẹ̀ mi; emi o ti ṣe sọ wọn di aimọ́?
entries.en: I have put off my coat; how shall I put it on? I have washed my feet; how shall I defile them?

entries.yo: Olufẹ mi nawọ rẹ̀ lati inu ihò ilẹkùn, inu mi sì yọ si i.
entries.en: My beloved put in his hand by the hole of the door, and my bowels were moved for him.

entries.yo: Emi dide lati ṣilẹkun fun olufẹ mi, ojia si nkán lọwọ mi, ati ojia olõrùn didùn ni ika mi sori idimu iṣikà.
entries.en: I rose up to open to my beloved; and my hands dropped with myrrh, and my fingers with sweet smelling myrrh, upon the handles of the lock.

entries.yo: Mo ṣilẹkun fun olufẹ mi; ṣugbọn olufẹ mi ti fà sẹhin, o si ti lọ: aiya pá mi nigbati o sọ̀rọ, mo wá a, ṣugbọn emi kò ri i, mo pè e, ṣugbọn on kò da mi lohùn.
entries.en: I opened to my beloved; but my beloved had withdrawn himself, and was gone: my soul failed when he spake: I sought him, but I could not find him; I called him, but he gave me no answer.

entries.yo: Awọn oluṣọ ti nrìn ilu kiri ri mi, nwọn lù mi, nwọn sì ṣa mi lọgbẹ, awọn oluṣọ gbà iborùn mi lọwọ mi.
entries.en: The watchmen that went about the city found me, they smote me, they wounded me; the keepers of the walls took away my veil from me.

entries.yo: Mo fi nyin bu, ẹnyin ọmọbinrin Jerusalemu, bi ẹnyin ba ri olufẹ mi, ki ẹ wi fun u pe, aisan ifẹ nṣe mi.
entries.en: I charge you, O daughters of Jerusalem, if ye find my beloved, that ye tell him, that I am sick of love.

entries.yo: Kini olufẹ rẹ jù olufẹ miran lọ, iwọ arẹwà julọ ninu awọn obinrin? kini olufẹ rẹ jù olufẹ miran ti iwọ fi nfi wa bú bẹ̃?
entries.en: What is thy beloved more than another beloved, O thou fairest among women? what is thy beloved more than another beloved, that thou dost so charge us?

entries.yo: Olufẹ mi funfun, o si pọn, on ni ọlá jù ọ̀pọlọpọ lọ.
entries.en: My beloved is white and ruddy, the chiefest among ten thousand.

entries.yo: Ori rẹ̀ dabi wura ti o dara julọ, ìdi irun rẹ̀ dabi imọ̀ ọpẹ, o si du bi ẹiyẹ iwò.
entries.en: His head is as the most fine gold, his locks are bushy, and black as a raven.

entries.yo: Oju rẹ̀ dabi àdaba li ẹba odò, ti a fi wàra wẹ̀, ti o si ngbe inu alafia.
entries.en: His eyes are as the eyes of doves by the rivers of waters, washed with milk, and fitly set.

entries.yo: Ẹrẹ̀kẹ rẹ̀ dabi ebè turari, bi olõrùn didùn, ète rẹ̀ bi itanna lili, o nkán ojia olõrùn didùn.
entries.en: His cheeks are as a bed of spices, as sweet flowers: his lips like lilies, dropping sweet smelling myrrh.

entries.yo: Ọwọ rẹ̀ dabi oruka wura ti o tò ni berili yika, ara rẹ̀ bi ehin-erin didán ti a fi saffire bò.
entries.en: His hands are as gold rings set with the beryl: his belly is as bright ivory overlaid with sapphires.

entries.yo: Itan rẹ̀ bi ọwọ̀n marbili, ti a gbe ka ihò ìtẹbọ wura daradara; ìwo rẹ̀ dabi Lebanoni, titayọ rẹ̀ bi igi kedari.
entries.en: His legs are as pillars of marble, set upon sockets of fine gold: his countenance is as Lebanon, excellent as the cedars.

entries.yo: Ẹnu rẹ̀ dùn rekọja: ani o wunni patapata. Eyi li olufẹ mi, eyi si li ọrẹ mi, ẹnyin ọmọbinrin Jerusalemu.
entries.en: His mouth is most sweet: yea, he is altogether lovely. This is my beloved, and this is my friend, O daughters of Jerusalem.

entries.yo: NIBO ni olufẹ rẹ lọ, iwọ arẹwà julọ ninu awọn obinrin? nibo li olufẹ rẹ yà si? ki a le ba ọ wá a.
entries.en: Whither is thy beloved gone, O thou fairest among women? whither is thy beloved turned aside? that we may seek him with thee.

entries.yo: Olufẹ mi sọkalẹ lọ sinu ọgba rẹ̀, si ebè turari, lati ma jẹ̀ ninu ọgbà, ati lati ká itanna lili.
entries.en: My beloved is gone down into his garden, to the beds of spices, to feed in the gardens, and to gather lilies.

entries.yo: Emi ni ti olufẹ mi, olufẹ mi si ni ti emi: o njẹ̀ lãrin itanna lili.
entries.en: I am my beloved's, and my beloved is mine: he feedeth among the lilies.

entries.yo: Iwọ yanju, olufẹ mi, bi Tirsa, o li ẹwà bi Jerusalemu, ṣugbọn o li ẹ̀ru bi ogun pẹlu ọpagun.
entries.en: Thou art beautiful, O my love, as Tirzah, comely as Jerusalem, terrible as an army with banners.

entries.yo: Mu oju rẹ kuro lara mi nitori nwọn bori mi: irun rẹ si dabi ọwọ́ ewurẹ ti o dubulẹ ni Gileadi.
entries.en: Turn away thine eyes from me, for they have overcome me: thy hair is as a flock of goats that appear from Gilead.

entries.yo: Ehin rẹ dabi ọwọ́ agutan ti ngòke lati ibi iwẹ̀ wá, ti olukuluku wọn bi ìbejì, kò si si ọkan ti o yàgan ninu wọn.
entries.en: Thy teeth are as a flock of sheep which go up from the washing, whereof every one beareth twins, and there is not one barren among them.

entries.yo: Bi ẹ̀la eso-pomegranate kan ni ẹrẹkẹ rẹ ri lãrin iboju rẹ.
entries.en: As a piece of a pomegranate are thy temples within thy locks.

entries.yo: Ọgọta ayaba ni mbẹ, ati ọgọrin àle, ati awọn wundia lainiye.
entries.en: There are threescore queens, and fourscore concubines, and virgins without number.

entries.yo: Ọkan ni adaba mi, alailabawọn mi; on nikanṣoṣo ni ti iya rẹ̀, on ni ãyo ẹniti o bi i. Awọn ọmọbinrin ri i, nwọn si sure fun u; ani awọn ayaba ati awọn àle, nwọn si yìn i.
entries.en: My dove, my undefiled is but one; she is the only one of her mother, she is the choice one of her that bare her. The daughters saw her, and blessed her; yea, the queens and the concubines, and they praised her.

entries.yo: Tali ẹniti ntàn jàde bi owurọ, ti o li ẹwà bi oṣupa, ti o mọ́ bi õrun, ti o si li ẹ̀ru bi ogun pẹlu ọpagun?
entries.en: Who is she that looketh forth as the morning, fair as the moon, clear as the sun, and terrible as an army with banners?

entries.yo: Emi sọkalẹ lọ sinu ọgba eso igi, lati ri awọn ẹka igi tutu afonifoji, ati lati ri bi ajara ba ruwe, ati bi igi-granate ba rudi.
entries.en: I went down into the garden of nuts to see the fruits of the valley, and to see whether the vine flourished, and the pomegranates budded.

entries.yo: Ki emi to mọ̀, ọkàn mi gbe mi ka ori kẹkẹ́ Amminadibu.
entries.en: Or ever I was aware, my soul made me like the chariots of Amminadib.

entries.yo: Pada, pada, Ṣulamite; pada, pada, ki awa ki o le wò ọ. Ẽṣe ti ẹnyin fẹ wò Ṣulamite bi ẹnipe orin ijó Mahanaimu.
entries.en: Return, return, O Shulamite; return, return, that we may look upon thee. What will ye see in the Shulamite? As it were the company of two armies.

entries.yo: Ẹsẹ rẹ ti li ẹwà to ninu bata, iwọ ọmọ-alade! orike itan rẹ dabi ohun ọṣọ́, iṣẹ ọwọ ọlọgbọ́n oniṣọna.
entries.en: How beautiful are thy feet with shoes, O prince's daughter! the joints of thy thighs are like jewels, the work of the hands of a cunning workman.

entries.yo: Iwọ́ rẹ dabi ago ti kò ṣe alaini ọti, ara rẹ dabi okiti alikama ti a fi lili yika.
entries.en: Thy navel is like a round goblet, which wanteth not liquor: thy belly is like an heap of wheat set about with lilies.

entries.yo: Ọmú rẹ mejeji dabi abo ọmọ agbọnrin meji ti iṣe ìbejì.
entries.en: Thy two breasts are like two young roes that are twins.

entries.yo: Ọrùn rẹ dabi ile iṣọ ehin-erin; oju rẹ dabi adagun ni Heṣboni, lẹba ẹnu-bode Batrabbimu: imú rẹ dabi ile-iṣọ Lebanoni ti o kọju si ihà Damasku.
entries.en: Thy neck is as a tower of ivory; thine eyes like the fishpools in Heshbon, by the gate of Bath-rabbim: thy nose is as the tower of Lebanon which looketh toward Damascus.

entries.yo: Ori rẹ dabi Karmeli lara rẹ, ati irun ori rẹ bi purpili; a fi aidì irun rẹ di ọba mu.
entries.en: Thine head upon thee is like Carmel, and the hair of thine head like purple; the king is held in the galleries.

entries.yo: O ti li ẹwà to, o si ti dara to, iwọ olufẹ mi ninu adùn ifẹ!
entries.en: How fair and how pleasant art thou, O love, for delights!

entries.yo: Iduro rẹ yi dabi igi ọ̀pẹ ati ọmú rẹ bi ṣiri eso àjara.
entries.en: This thy stature is like to a palm tree, and thy breasts to clusters of grapes.

entries.yo: Mo ni, emi o gùn ọ̀pẹ lọ, emi o di ẹka rẹ̀ mu: pẹlupẹlu nisisiyi ọmú rẹ pẹlu yio dabi ṣiri àjara, ati õrùn imú rẹ bi eso appili;
entries.en: I said, I will go up to the palm tree, I will take hold of the boughs thereof: now also thy breasts shall be as clusters of the vine, and the smell of thy nose like apples;

entries.yo: Ati ẹnu rẹ bi ọti-waini ti o dara jù, ti o sọkalẹ kẹlẹkẹlẹ fun olufẹ mi, ti o nmu ki etè awọn ti o sùn ki o sọ̀rọ.
entries.en: And the roof of thy mouth like the best wine for my beloved, that goeth down sweetly, causing the lips of those that are asleep to speak.

entries.yo: Ti olufẹ mi li emi iṣe, ifẹ rẹ̀ si mbẹ si mi.
entries.en: I am my beloved's, and his desire is toward me.

entries.yo: Wá, olufẹ mi, jẹ ki a lọ si pápa; jẹ ki a wọ̀ si iletò wọnni.
entries.en: Come, my beloved, let us go forth into the field; let us lodge in the villages.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki a dide lọ sinu ọgba-àjara ni kutukutu; jẹ ki a wò bi àjara ruwe, bi itanná àjara ba là, ati bi igi granate ba rudi: nibẹ li emi o fi ifẹ mi fun ọ.
entries.en: Let us get up early to the vineyards; let us see if the vine flourish, whether the tender grape appear, and the pomegranates bud forth: there will I give thee my loves.

entries.yo: Awọn eso mandraki fun ni li õrùn, li ẹnu-ọ̀na wa ni onirũru eso ti o wunni, ọtun ati ogbologbo, ti mo ti fi pamọ́ fun ọ, iwọ olufẹ mi.
entries.en: The mandrakes give a smell, and at our gates are all manner of pleasant fruits, new and old, which I have laid up for thee, O my beloved.

entries.yo: IWỌ iba jẹ dabi arakunrin fun mi, ti o mu ọmú iya mi! emi iba ri ọ lode emi iba fi ẹnu kò ọ lẹnu; lõtọ, nwọn kì ba fi mi ṣe ẹlẹya.
entries.en: O that thou wert as my brother, that sucked the breasts of my mother! when I should find thee without, I would kiss thee; yea, I should not be despised.

entries.yo: Emi iba fọnahàn ọ, emi iba mu ọ wá sinu ile iya mi, iwọ iba kọ́ mi: emi iba mu ọ mu ọti-waini õrùn didùn, ati oje eso granate mi.
entries.en: I would lead thee, and bring thee into my mother's house, who would instruct me: I would cause thee to drink of spiced wine of the juice of my pomegranate.

entries.yo: Ọwọ osì rẹ̀ iba wà labẹ ori mi, ọwọ ọtún rẹ̀ iba si gbá mi mọra.
entries.en: His left hand should be under my head, and his right hand should embrace me.

entries.yo: Mo fi nyin bu, ẹnyin ọmọbinrin Jerusalemu, ki ẹ máṣe rú olufẹ mi soke, ki ẹ má si ṣe ji i, titi yio fi wù u.
entries.en: I charge you, O daughters of Jerusalem, that ye stir not up, nor awake my love, until he please.

entries.yo: Tani eyi ti ngòke lati aginju wá, ti o fi ara tì olufẹ rẹ̀? mo ji ọ dide labẹ igi eleso: nibẹ ni iya rẹ gbe bi ọ si, nibẹ li ẹniti o bi ọ gbe bi ọ si.
entries.en: Who is this that cometh up from the wilderness, leaning upon her beloved? I raised thee up under the apple tree: there thy mother brought thee forth: there she brought thee forth that bare thee.

entries.yo: Gbe mi ka aiya rẹ bi edidi, bi edidi le apá rẹ: nitori ifẹ lagbara bi ikú; ijowu si le bi isa-okú; jijo rẹ̀ dabi jijo iná, ani ọwọ iná Oluwa.
entries.en: Set me as a seal upon thine heart, as a seal upon thine arm: for love is strong as death; jealousy is cruel as the grave: the coals thereof are coals of fire, which hath a most vehement flame.

entries.yo: Omi pupọ kò le paná ifẹ, bẹ̃ni kikún omi kò le gbá a lọ, bi enia fẹ fi gbogbo ọrọ̀ rẹ̀ fun ifẹ, a o kẹgàn rẹ̀ patapata.
entries.en: Many waters cannot quench love, neither can the floods drown it: if a man would give all the substance of his house for love, it would utterly be contemned.

entries.yo: Awa ni arabinrin kekere kan, on kò si ni ọmú: kili awa o ṣe fun arabinrin wa li ọjọ ti a o ba fẹ ẹ?
entries.en: We have a little sister, and she hath no breasts: what shall we do for our sister in the day when she shall be spoken for?

entries.yo: Bi on ba ṣe ogiri, awa o kọ́ ile-odi fadaka le e lori: bi on ba si ṣe ẹnu-ọ̀na, awa o fi apako kedari dí i.
entries.en: If she be a wall, we will build upon her a palace of silver: and if she be a door, we will inclose her with boards of cedar.

entries.yo: Ogiri ni mi, ọmú mi sì dabi ile-iṣọ: nigbana loju rẹ̀ mo dabi ẹniti o ri alafia.
entries.en: I am a wall, and my breasts like towers: then was I in his eyes as one that found favour.

entries.yo: Solomoni ni ọgba-àjara kan ni Baalhamoni; o fi ọgba-àjara na ṣe ọ̀ya fun awọn oluṣọ; olukuluku ni imu ẹgbẹrun fadaka wá nipò eso rẹ̀.
entries.en: Solomon had a vineyard at Baal-hamon; he let out the vineyard unto keepers; every one for the fruit thereof was to bring a thousand pieces of silver.

entries.yo: Ọgba-àjara mi, ti iṣe temi, o wà niwaju mi: iwọ Solomoni yio ni ẹgbẹrun fadaka, ati awọn ti nṣọ eso na yio ni igba.
entries.en: My vineyard, which is mine, is before me: thou, O Solomon, must have a thousand, and those that keep the fruit thereof two hundred.

entries.yo: Iwọ ti ngbe inu ọgbà, awọn ẹgbẹ rẹ fetisi ohùn rẹ: mu mi gbọ́ ọ pẹlu.
entries.en: Thou that dwellest in the gardens, the companions hearken to thy voice: cause me to hear it.

entries.yo: Yara, olufẹ mi, ki iwọ ki o si dabi abo egbin tabi ọmọ agbọnrin lori òke õrùn didùn.
entries.en: Make haste, my beloved, and be thou like to a roe or to a young hart upon the mountains of spices.

entries.yo: IRAN Isaiah ọmọ Amosi, ti o rí nipa Juda ati Jerusalemu li ọjọ Ussiah, Jotamu, Ahasi, ati Hesekiah, awọn ọba Juda.
entries.en: The vision of Isaiah the son of Amoz, which he saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.

entries.yo: Gbọ́, ẹnyin ọrun, si fi eti silẹ, iwọ aiye: nitori Oluwa ti sọ̀rọ, emi ti bọ́, emi si ti tọ́ awọn ọmọ, nwọn si ti ṣọ̀tẹ si mi.
entries.en: Hear, O heavens, and give ear, O earth: for the LORD hath spoken, I have nourished and brought up children, and they have rebelled against me.

entries.yo: Malũ mọ̀ oluwa rẹ̀, kẹtẹ́kẹtẹ si mọ̀ ibujẹ oluwa rẹ̀: ṣugbọn Israeli kò mọ̀, awọn enia mi kò ronu.
entries.en: The ox knoweth his owner, and the ass his master's crib: but Israel doth not know, my people doth not consider.

entries.yo: A! orilẹ-ède ti o kún fun ẹ̀ṣẹ, enia ti ẹrù ẹ̀ṣẹ npa, irú awọn oluṣe buburu, awọn ọmọ ti iṣe olubajẹ: nwọn ti kọ̀ Oluwa silẹ, nwọn ti mu Ẹni-Mimọ́ Israeli binu, nwọn si ti yipada sẹhìn.
entries.en: Ah sinful nation, a people laden with iniquity, a seed of evildoers, children that are corrupters: they have forsaken the LORD, they have provoked the Holy One of Israel unto anger, they are gone away backward.

entries.yo: Ẽṣe ti a o fi lù nyin si i mọ? ẹnyin o ma ṣọ̀tẹ siwaju ati siwaju: gbogbo ori li o ṣaisàn, gbogbo ọkàn li o si dakú.
entries.en: Why should ye be stricken any more? ye will revolt more and more: the whole head is sick, and the whole heart faint.

entries.yo: Lati atẹlẹ̀sẹ titi fi de ori kò si ilera ninu rẹ̀; bikòṣe ọgbẹ́, ipalara, ati õju ti nrà: nwọn kò iti pajumọ, bẹ̃ni a kò iti dì wọn, bẹ̃ni a kò si ti ifi ororo kùn wọn.
entries.en: From the sole of the foot even unto the head there is no soundness in it; but wounds, and bruises, and putrifying sores: they have not been closed, neither bound up, neither mollified with ointment.

entries.yo: Ilẹ nyin di ahoro, a fi iná kun ilu nyin: ilẹ nyin, alejo jẹ ẹ run li oju nyin, o si di ahoro, bi eyiti awọn alejo wó palẹ.
entries.en: Your country is desolate, your cities are burned with fire: your land, strangers devour it in your presence, and it is desolate, as overthrown by strangers.

entries.yo: Ọmọbinrin Sioni li a si fi silẹ bi agọ ninu ọgbà àjara, bi abule ninu ọgbà ẹ̀gúsí, bi ilu ti a dóti.
entries.en: And the daughter of Zion is left as a cottage in a vineyard, as a lodge in a garden of cucumbers, as a besieged city.

entries.yo: Bikòṣe bi Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun ti fi iyokù diẹ kiun silẹ fun wa, awa iba ti dabi Sodomu, awa iba si ti dabi Gomorra.
entries.en: Except the LORD of hosts had left unto us a very small remnant, we should have been as Sodom, and we should have been like unto Gomorrah.

entries.yo: Gbọ́ ọ̀rọ Oluwa, ẹnyin olori Sodomu; fi eti si ofin Ọlọrun wa, ẹnyin enia Gomorra.
entries.en: Hear the word of the LORD, ye rulers of Sodom; give ear unto the law of our God, ye people of Gomorrah.

entries.yo: Oluwa ni, kini ọ̀pọlọpọ ẹbọ nyin jasi fun mi? emi kún fun ọrẹ sisun agbò, ati fun ọrá ẹran abọ́pa; bẹ̃ni emi kò si ni inu didùn si ẹjẹ akọ malũ, tabi si ti ọdọ-agutan, tabi si ti obúkọ.
entries.en: To what purpose is the multitude of your sacrifices unto me? saith the LORD: I am full of the burnt offerings of rams, and the fat of fed beasts; and I delight not in the blood of bullocks, or of lambs, or of he goats.

entries.yo: Nigbati ẹnyin wá lati fi ara hàn niwaju mi, tali o bere eyi lọwọ nyin, lati tẹ̀ agbalá mi?
entries.en: When ye come to appear before me, who hath required this at your hand, to tread my courts?

entries.yo: Ẹ má mu ọrẹ asan wá mọ́: turari jasi ohun irira fun mi; oṣù titun ati ọjọ isimi, ìpe ajọ, emi kò le rọju gbà; ẹ̀ṣẹ ni, ani apèjọ ọ̀wọ nì.
entries.en: Bring no more vain oblations; incense is an abomination unto me; the new moons and sabbaths, the calling of assemblies, I cannot away with; it is iniquity, even the solemn meeting.

entries.yo: Oṣù titun nyin ati ajọ ìdasilẹ nyin, ọkàn mi korira; nwọn jasi iyọlẹnu fun mi; o sú mi lati gbà wọn.
entries.en: Your new moons and your appointed feasts my soul hateth: they are a trouble unto me; I am weary to bear them.

entries.yo: Nigbati ẹnyin si nà ọwọ́ nyin jade, emi o pa oju mi mọ fun nyin: nitõtọ, nigbati ẹnyin ba gbà adura pupọ, emi kì yio gbọ́: ọwọ́ nyin kún fun ẹ̀jẹ.
entries.en: And when ye spread forth your hands, I will hide mine eyes from you: yea, when ye make many prayers, I will not hear: your hands are full of blood.

entries.yo: Ẹ wẹ̀, ki ẹ mọ́; mu buburu iṣe nyin kuro niwaju oju mi: dawọ duro lati ṣe buburu;
entries.en: Wash you, make you clean; put away the evil of your doings from before mine eyes; cease to do evil;

entries.yo: Kọ́ lati ṣe rere; wá idajọ, ràn awọn ẹniti a nilara lọwọ, ṣe idajọ alainibaba, gbà ẹjọ opó rò.
entries.en: Learn to do well; seek judgment, relieve the oppressed, judge the fatherless, plead for the widow.

entries.yo: Oluwa wipe, wá nisisiyi, ki ẹ si jẹ ki a sọ asọyé pọ̀: bi ẹ̀ṣẹ nyin ba ri bi òdodó, nwọn o si fun bi òjo-didì; bi nwọn pọ́n bi àlãri, nwọn o dabi irun-agutan.
entries.en: Come now, and let us reason together, saith the LORD: though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they be red like crimson, they shall be as wool.

entries.yo: Bi ẹnyin ba fẹ́ ti ẹ si gbọran, ẹnyin o jẹ ire ilẹ na:
entries.en: If ye be willing and obedient, ye shall eat the good of the land:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi ẹnyin ba kọ̀, ti ẹ si ṣọ̀tẹ, a o fi idà run nyin: nitori ẹnu Oluwa li o ti wi i.
entries.en: But if ye refuse and rebel, ye shall be devoured with the sword: for the mouth of the LORD hath spoken it.

entries.yo: Ilu otitọ ha ti ṣe di àgbere! o ti kún fun idajọ ri; ododo ti gbe inu rẹ̀ ri; ṣugbọn nisisiyi, awọn apania.
entries.en: How is the faithful city become an harlot! it was full of judgment; righteousness lodged in it; but now murderers.

entries.yo: Fadaka rẹ ti di ìdarọ́, ọti-waini rẹ ti dà lu omi:
entries.en: Thy silver is become dross, thy wine mixed with water:

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ-alade rẹ di ọlọ̀tẹ, ati ẹgbẹ olè: olukuluku nfẹ́ ọrẹ, o si ntọ̀ erè lẹhin: nwọn kò ṣe idajọ alainibaba, bẹ̃ni ọ̀ran opó kò wá sọdọ wọn.
entries.en: Thy princes are rebellious, and companions of thieves: every one loveth gifts, and followeth after rewards: they judge not the fatherless, neither doth the cause of the widow come unto them.

entries.yo: Nitorina Oluwa, Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun, Ẹni alagbara Israeli, wipe, A, emi o fi aiya balẹ niti awọn ọtá mi, emi o si gbẹ̀san lara awọn ọtá mi.
entries.en: Therefore saith the Lord, the LORD of hosts, the mighty One of Israel, Ah, I will ease me of mine adversaries, and avenge me of mine enemies:

entries.yo: Emi o yi ọwọ́ mi si ara rẹ, emi o si yọ́ ìdarọ́ rẹ kuro patapata, emi o si mu gbogbo tanganran rẹ kuro:
entries.en: And I will turn my hand upon thee, and purely purge away thy dross, and take away all thy tin:

entries.yo: Emi o si mu awọn onidajọ rẹ pada bi igbà iṣãju, ati awọn igbìmọ rẹ bi igbà akọbẹ̀rẹ: lẹhin na, a o pè ọ ni, Ilu ododo, ilu otitọ.
entries.en: And I will restore thy judges as at the first, and thy counsellers as at the beginning: afterward thou shalt be called, The city of righteousness, the faithful city.

entries.yo: Idajọ li a o fi rà Sioni pada, ati awọn ti o pada bọ̀ nipa ododo.
entries.en: Zion shall be redeemed with judgment, and her converts with righteousness.

entries.yo: Iparun awọn alarekọja pẹlu awọn ẹlẹṣẹ yio wà pọ̀, ati awọn ti o kọ̀ Oluwa silẹ li a o parun.
entries.en: And the destruction of the transgressors and of the sinners shall be together, and they that forsake the LORD shall be consumed.

entries.yo: Nitoriti oju yio tì wọn niti igi-nla ti ẹnyin ti fẹ, a o si dãmu nyin niti ọgbà ti ẹnyin ti yàn.
entries.en: For they shall be ashamed of the oaks which ye have desired, and ye shall be confounded for the gardens that ye have chosen.

entries.yo: Nitori ẹnyin o dabi igi-nla ti ewe rẹ̀ rọ, ati bi ọgbà ti kò ni omi.
entries.en: For ye shall be as an oak whose leaf fadeth, and as a garden that hath no water.

entries.yo: Alagbara yio si dabi ògùṣọ̀, iṣẹ rẹ̀ yio si dabi ẹta-iná, ati awọn mejeji yio jọ jona pọ̀, ẹnikẹni kì yio si pa wọn.
entries.en: And the strong shall be as tow, and the maker of it as a spark, and they shall both burn together, and none shall quench them.

entries.yo: Ọ̀RỌ ti Isaiah ọmọ Amosi ri nipa Juda ati Jerusalemu.
entries.en: the word that Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe ni ọjọ ikẹhìn, a o fi òke ile Oluwa kalẹ lori awọn òke nla, a o si gbe e ga ju awọn òke kékèké lọ; gbogbo orilẹ-ède ni yio si wọ́ si inu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass in the last days, that the mountain of the LORD's house shall be established in the top of the mountains, and shall be exalted above the hills; and all nations shall flow unto it.

entries.yo: Ọ̀pọlọpọ enia ni yio si lọ, nwọn o si wipe, Ẹ wá, ẹ jẹ ki a lọ si òke Oluwa, si ile Ọlọrun Jakobu; On o si kọ́ wa li ọ̀na rẹ̀, awa o si ma rìn ni ipa rẹ̀; nitori lati Sioni ni ofin yio ti jade lọ, ati ọ̀rọ Oluwa lati Jerusalemu.
entries.en: And many people shall go and say, Come ye, and let us go up to the mountain of the LORD, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for out of Zion shall go forth the law, and the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.

entries.yo: On o si dajọ lãrin awọn orilẹ-ède, yio si ba ọ̀pọlọpọ enia wi: nwọn o fi idà wọn rọ ọbẹ-plau, nwọn o si fi ọ̀kọ wọn rọ dojé; orilẹ-ède kì yio gbe idà soke si orilẹ-ède; bẹ̃ni nwọn kì yio kọ́ ogun jijà mọ.
entries.en: And he shall judge among the nations, and shall rebuke many people: and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruninghooks: nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.

entries.yo: Ara ile Jakobu, ẹ wá, ẹ jẹ́ ka rìn ninu imọlẹ Ọluwa.
entries.en: O house of Jacob, come ye, and let us walk in the light of the LORD.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni iwọ ṣe kọ̀ awọn enia rẹ, ile Jakobu silẹ̀; nitoriti nwọn kún lati ìla ọ̀run wá, nwọn jẹ alafọ̀ṣẹ bi awọn ara Filistia, nwọn si nṣe inu didùn ninu awọn ọmọ alejò.
entries.en: Therefore thou hast forsaken thy people the house of Jacob, because they be replenished from the east, and are soothsayers like the Philistines, and they please themselves in the children of strangers.

entries.yo: Ilẹ wọn pẹlu kún fun fadakà ati wurà; bẹ̃ni kò si opin fun iṣura wọn; ilẹ wọn si kun fun ẹṣin, bẹ̃ni kò si opin fun kẹkẹ́ ogun wọn.
entries.en: Their land also is full of silver and gold, neither is there any end of their treasures; their land is also full of horses, neither is there any end of their chariots:

entries.yo: Ilẹ wọn kún fun oriṣa pẹlu; nwọn mbọ iṣẹ ọwọ́ ara wọn, eyiti ika awọn tikalawọn ti ṣe.
entries.en: Their land also is full of idols; they worship the work of their own hands, that which their own fingers have made:

entries.yo: Enia lasan si foribalẹ, ẹni-nla si rẹ̀ ara rẹ̀ silẹ; nitorina má ṣe darijì wọn.
entries.en: And the mean man boweth down, and the great man humbleth himself: therefore forgive them not.

entries.yo: Wọ̀ inu apata lọ, ki o si fi ara rẹ pamọ ninu ekuru, nitori ibẹru Oluwa, ati nitori ogo ọlanla rẹ̀.
entries.en: Enter into the rock, and hide thee in the dust, for fear of the LORD, and for the glory of his majesty.

entries.yo: A o rẹ̀ ìwo giga enia silẹ, a o si tẹ̀ ori igberaga enia ba, Oluwa nikanṣoṣo li a o gbe ga li ọjọ na.
entries.en: The lofty looks of man shall be humbled, and the haughtiness of men shall be bowed down, and the LORD alone shall be exalted in that day.

entries.yo: Nitori ọjọ Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun yio wà lori olukuluku ẹniti o rera, ti o si gberaga, ati lori olukuluku ẹniti a gbe soke, on li a o si rẹ̀ silẹ.
entries.en: For the day of the LORD of hosts shall be upon every one that is proud and lofty, and upon every one that is lifted up; and he shall be brought low:

entries.yo: Lori gbogbo igi kedari Lebanoni, ti o ga, ti a sì gbe soke, ati lori gbogbo igi-nla Baṣani.
entries.en: And upon all the cedars of Lebanon, that are high and lifted up, and upon all the oaks of Bashan,

entries.yo: Ati lori gbogbo òke giga, ati lori gbogbo òke kékèké ti a gbe soke.
entries.en: And upon all the high mountains, and upon all the hills that are lifted up,

entries.yo: Ati lori gbogbo ile-iṣọ giga ati lori gbogbo odi,
entries.en: And upon every high tower, and upon every fenced wall,

entries.yo: Ati lori gbogbo ọkọ̀ Tarṣiṣi, ati lori gbogbo awòran ti o wuni,
entries.en: And upon all the ships of Tarshish, and upon all pleasant pictures.

entries.yo: A o si tẹ̀ ori igberaga enia balẹ, irera awọn enia li a o si rẹ̀ silẹ; Oluwa nikanṣoṣo li a o gbega li ọjọ na.
entries.en: And the loftiness of man shall be bowed down, and the haughtiness of men shall be made low: and the LORD alone shall be exalted in that day.

entries.yo: Awọn òriṣa ni yio si parun patapata.
entries.en: And the idols he shall utterly abolish.

entries.yo: Nwọn o si wọ̀ inu ihò apata lọ, ati inu ihò ilẹ, nitori ìbẹru Oluwa, ati nitori ogo ọlanla rẹ̀, nigbati o ba dide lati mì ilẹ aiye kijikiji.
entries.en: And they shall go into the holes of the rocks, and into the caves of the earth, for fear of the LORD, and for the glory of his majesty, when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ na, enia yio jù òriṣa fadakà rẹ̀, ati òriṣa wurà rẹ̀, ti nwọn ṣe olukuluku wọn lati ma bọ, si ekute ati si àdan,
entries.en: In that day a man shall cast his idols of silver, and his idols of gold, which they made each one for himself to worship, to the moles and to the bats;

entries.yo: Lati lọ sinu pàlapala apata, ati soke apata sisán, nitori ibẹru Oluwa, ati nitori ogo ọlanla rẹ̀; nigbati o ba dide lati mì ilẹ aiye kijikiji.
entries.en: To go into the clefts of the rocks, and into the tops of the ragged rocks, for fear of the LORD, and for the glory of his majesty, when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth.

entries.yo: Ẹ simi lẹhìn enia, ẹmi ẹniti o wà ni ihò imu rẹ̀; nitori ninu kini a le kà a si?
entries.en: Cease ye from man, whose breath is in his nostrils: for wherein is he to be accounted of?

entries.yo: KIYESI i, Oluwa, Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun, mu idaduro ati ọpá kuro ninu Jerusalemu ati Juda, gbogbo idaduro onjẹ, ati gbogbo idaduro omi.
entries.en: For, behold, the Lord, the LORD of hosts, doth take away from Jerusalem and from Judah the stay and the staff, the whole stay of bread, and the whole stay of water,

entries.yo: Alagbara ọkunrin, ati jagunjagun, onidajọ, ati wolĩ, ati amoye, ati agbà.
entries.en: The mighty man, and the man of war, the judge, and the prophet, and the prudent, and the ancient,

entries.yo: Balogun ãdọta, ati ọkunrin ọlọla, ati igbìmọ, ati oniṣọ̀na, ati alasọdùn.
entries.en: The captain of fifty, and the honourable man, and the counseller, and the cunning artificer, and the eloquent orator.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọde li emi o fi ṣe ọmọ-alade wọn, awọn ọmọ-ọwọ ni yio si ma ṣe akoso wọn.
entries.en: And I will give children to be their princes, and babes shall rule over them.

entries.yo: A o si ni awọn enia lara, olukuluku lọwọ ẹnikeji, ati olukuluku lọwọ aladugbo rẹ̀; ọmọde yio huwà igberaga si àgba, ati alailọla si ọlọla.
entries.en: And the people shall be oppressed, every one by another, and every one by his neighbour: the child shall behave himself proudly against the ancient, and the base against the honourable.

entries.yo: Nigbati enia kan yio di arakunrin rẹ̀ ti ile baba rẹ̀ mu, wipe, Iwọ ni aṣọ, mã ṣe alakoso wa, ki o si jẹ ki iparun yi wà labẹ ọwọ́ rẹ.
entries.en: When a man shall take hold of his brother of the house of his father, saying, Thou hast clothing, be thou our ruler, and let this ruin be under thy hand:

entries.yo: Lọjọ na ni yio bura, wipe, Emi kì yio ṣe alatunṣe; nitori ni ile mi kò si onjẹ tabi aṣọ: máṣe fi emi ṣe alakoso awọn enia.
entries.en: In that day shall he swear, saying, I will not be an healer; for in my house is neither bread nor clothing: make me not a ruler of the people.

entries.yo: Nitori Jerusalemu di iparun, Juda si ṣubu: nitori ahọn wọn ati iṣe wọn lòdi si Oluwa, lati mu oju ogo rẹ̀ binu.
entries.en: For Jerusalem is ruined, and Judah is fallen: because their tongue and their doings are against the LORD, to provoke the eyes of his glory.

entries.yo: Iwò oju wọn njẹri si wọn; nwọn si nfi ẹ̀ṣẹ wọn hàn bi Sodomu, nwọn kò pa a mọ. Egbe ni fun ọkàn wọn! nitori nwọn ti fi ibi san a fun ara wọn.
entries.en: The shew of their countenance doth witness against them; and they declare their sin as Sodom, they hide it not. Woe unto their soul! for they have rewarded evil unto themselves.

entries.yo: Ẹ sọ fun olododo pe, yio dara fun u: nitori nwọn o jẹ eso iṣe wọn.
entries.en: Say ye to the righteous, that it shall be well with him: for they shall eat the fruit of their doings.

entries.yo: Egbe ni fun enia buburu! yio buru fun u: nitori ere ọwọ́ rẹ̀ li a o fi fun u.
entries.en: Woe unto the wicked! it shall be ill with him: for the reward of his hands shall be given him.

entries.yo: Niti awọn enia mi awọn ọmọde ni aninilara wọn, awọn obinrin si njọba wọn. A! enia mi, awọn ti nyẹ ọ si mu ọ ṣìna, nwọn si npa ipa-ọ̀na rẹ run.
entries.en: As for my people, children are their oppressors, and women rule over them. O my people, they which lead thee cause thee to err, and destroy the way of thy paths.

entries.yo: Oluwa dide duro lati wijọ, o si dide lati da awọn enia li ẹjọ.
entries.en: The LORD standeth up to plead, and standeth to judge the people.

entries.yo: Oluwa yio ba awọn agbà enia rẹ̀ lọ sinu idajọ, ati awọn ọmọ-alade inu wọn: nitori ẹnyin ti jẹ ọ̀gba àjara nì run: ẹrù awọn talakà mbẹ ninu ile nyin.
entries.en: The LORD will enter into judgment with the ancients of his people, and the princes thereof: for ye have eaten up the vineyard; the spoil of the poor is in your houses.

entries.yo: Oluwa, Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wipe, Kili ẹnyin rò ti ẹ fi fọ́ awọn enia mi tutu, ti ẹ si fi oju awọn talakà rinlẹ?
entries.en: What mean ye that ye beat my people to pieces, and grind the faces of the poor? saith the LORD GOD of hosts.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu Oluwa wipe, Nitori awọn ọmọbinrin Sioni gberaga, ti nwọn si nrìn pẹlu ọrùn giga ati oju ifẹkufẹ, ti nwọn nrìn ti nwọn si nyan bi nwọn ti nlọ, ti nwọn si njẹ ki ẹsẹ wọn ró woro:
entries.en: Moreover the LORD saith, Because the daughters of Zion are haughty, and walk with stretched forth necks and wanton eyes, walking and mincing as they go, and making a tinkling with their feet:

entries.yo: Nitorina Oluwa yio fi ẽpá lu atàri awọn ọmọbinrin Sioni, Oluwa yio si fi ihoho wọn hàn.
entries.en: Therefore the LORD will smite with a scab the crown of the head of the daughters of Zion, and the LORD will discover their secret parts.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ na Oluwa yio mu ogo ṣaworo wọn kuro, ati awọn ọṣọ́ wọn, ati iweri wọn bi oṣupa.
entries.en: In that day the Lord will take away the bravery of their tinkling ornaments about their feet, and their cauls, and their round tires like the moon,

entries.yo: Ati ẹ̀wọn, ati jufù, ati ìboju,
entries.en: The chains, and the bracelets, and the mufflers,

entries.yo: Ati akẹtẹ̀, ati ohun ọṣọ́-ẹsẹ, ati ọjá-ori, ati ago olõrùn didùn, ati oruka eti,
entries.en: The bonnets, and the ornaments of the legs, and the headbands, and the tablets, and the earrings,

entries.yo: Oruka, ati ọṣọ́-imu,
entries.en: The rings, and nose jewels,

entries.yo: Ipãrọ̀ aṣọ wiwọ, ati aṣọ ilekè, ati ibọ̀run, ati àpo,
entries.en: The changeable suits of apparel, and the mantles, and the wimples, and the crisping pins,

entries.yo: Awòjiji, ati aṣọ ọ̀gbọ daradara, ati ibòri ati ibòju,
entries.en: The glasses, and the fine linen, and the hoods, and the vails.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe pe, õrun buburu yio wà dipò õrun didùn; akisà ni yio si dipò amùre; ori pipá ni yio si dipò irun didì daradara; sisan aṣọ ọ̀fọ dipò igbaiya, ijoná yio si dipò ẹwà.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass, that instead of sweet smell there shall be stink; and instead of a girdle a rent; and instead of well set hair baldness; and instead of a stomacher a girding of sackcloth; and burning instead of beauty.

entries.yo: Awọn ọkunrin rẹ yio ti ipa idà ṣubu, ati awọn alagbara rẹ loju ogun.
entries.en: Thy men shall fall by the sword, and thy mighty in the war.

entries.yo: Awọn bodè rẹ̀ yio pohùnrere ẹkun, nwọn o si ṣọ̀fọ; ati on, nitori o di ahoro, yio joko ni ilẹ.
entries.en: And her gates shall lament and mourn; and she being desolate shall sit upon the ground.

entries.yo: ATI li ọjọ na obinrin meje yio dimọ́ ọkunrin kan, wipe, Awa o jẹ onjẹ ara wa, awa o si wọ̀ aṣọ ara wa: kìkì pe, jẹ ki a fi orukọ rẹ pè wa, lati mu ẹgàn wa kuro.
entries.en: And in that day seven women shall take hold of one man, saying, We will eat our own bread, and wear our own apparel: only let us be called by thy name, to take away our reproach.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ na ni ẹka Oluwa yio ni ẹwà on ogo, eso ilẹ yio si ni ọla, yio si dara fun awọn ti o sálà ni Israeli.
entries.en: In that day shall the branch of the LORD be beautiful and glorious, and the fruit of the earth shall be excellent and comely for them that are escaped of Israel.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, pe, ẹniti a fi silẹ ni Sioni, ati ẹniti o kù ni Jerusalemu, li a o pè ni mimọ́, ani orukọ olukuluku ẹniti a kọ pẹlu awọn alãye ni Jerusalemu.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass, that he that is left in Zion, and he that remaineth in Jerusalem, shall be called holy, even every one that is written among the living in Jerusalem:

entries.yo: Nigbati Oluwa ba ti wẹ̀ ẹgbin awọn ọmọbinrin Sioni nù, ti o si ti fọ ẹ̀jẹ Jerusalemu kuro li ãrin rẹ̀ nipa ẹmi idajọ, ati nipa ẹmi ijoná.
entries.en: When the Lord shall have washed away the filth of the daughters of Zion, and shall have purged the blood of Jerusalem from the midst thereof by the spirit of judgment, and by the spirit of burning.

entries.yo: Lori olukuluku ibùgbe oke Sioni, ati lori awọn apejọ rẹ̀, li Oluwa yio si da awọsanma, ati ẹ̃fin li ọsan, ati didan ọwọ́ iná li oru: nitori àbò yio wá lori gbogbo ogo.
entries.en: And the LORD will create upon every dwelling place of mount Zion, and upon her assemblies, a cloud and smoke by day, and the shining of a flaming fire by night: for upon all the glory shall be a defence.

entries.yo: Agọ kan yio si wà fun ojiji li ọsan kuro ninu oru, ati fun ibi isasi, ati fun ãbo kuro ninu ijì, ati kuro ninu ojò.
entries.en: And there shall be a tabernacle for a shadow in the daytime from the heat, and for a place of refuge, and for a covert from storm and from rain.

entries.yo: NISISIYI, emi o kọ orin si olufẹ ọwọ́n mi, orin olùfẹ mi ọwọ́n niti ọ̀gba àjara rẹ̀. Olufẹ ọwọ́n mi ni ọ̀gba àjara lori okè ẹlẹtù loju:
entries.en: Now will I sing to my wellbeloved a song of my beloved touching his vineyard. My wellbeloved hath a vineyard in a very fruitful hill:

entries.yo: O si sọ ọ̀gba yi i ka, o si ṣà okuta kuro ninu rẹ̀, o si gbìn ayànfẹ àjara si inu rẹ̀, o si kọ ile iṣọ sãrin rẹ̀, o si ṣe ifunti sinu rẹ̀ pẹlu: o si wò pe ki o so eso, ṣugbọn eso kikan li o so.
entries.en: And he fenced it, and gathered out the stones thereof, and planted it with the choicest vine, and built a tower in the midst of it, and also made a winepress therein: and he looked that it should bring forth grapes, and it brought forth wild grapes.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, ẹnyin ara Jerusalemu ati ẹnyin ọkunrin Juda, emi bẹ̀ nyin, ṣe idajọ lãrin mi, ati lãrin ọ̀gba àjara mi.
entries.en: And now, O inhabitants of Jerusalem, and men of Judah, judge, I pray you, betwixt me and my vineyard.

entries.yo: Kini a ba ṣe si ọ̀gba àjara mi ti emi kò ti ṣe ninu rẹ̀, nigbati mo wò pe iba so eso, ẽṣe ti o fi so eso kikan?
entries.en: What could have been done more to my vineyard, that I have not done in it? wherefore, when I looked that it should bring forth grapes, brought it forth wild grapes?

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, ẹ wá na, emi o sọ ohun ti emi o ṣe si ọ̀gba àjara mi fun nyin: emi o mu ọ̀gba rẹ̀ kuro, a o si jẹ ẹ run, emi o wo ogiri rẹ̀ lu ilẹ, a o si tẹ̀ ẹ mọlẹ.
entries.en: And now go to; I will tell you what I will do to my vineyard: I will take away the hedge thereof, and it shall be eaten up; and break down the wall thereof, and it shall be trodden down:

entries.yo: Emi o si sọ ọ di ahoro, a kì yio tọ́ ẹka rẹ̀, bẹ̃ni a kì yio wà a, ṣugbọn ẹ̀wọn ati ẹ̀gún ni yio ma hù nibẹ, emi o si paṣẹ fun awọsanma ki o má rọjò sori rẹ̀.
entries.en: And I will lay it waste: it shall not be pruned, nor digged; but there shall come up briers and thorns: I will also command the clouds that they rain no rain upon it.

entries.yo: Nitori ọ̀gba àjara Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun ni ile Israeli, ati awọn ọkunrin Juda ni igi-gbìgbin ti o wù u, o reti idajọ, ṣugbọn kiyesi i, inilara; o si reti ododo; ṣugbọn kiyesi i, igbe.
entries.en: For the vineyard of the LORD of hosts is the house of Israel, and the men of Judah his pleasant plant: and he looked for judgment, but behold oppression; for righteousness, but behold a cry.

entries.yo: Egbe ni fun awọn ti o ni ile kún ile, ti nfi oko kún oko, titi ãyè kò fi si mọ, ki nwọn bà le nikan wà li ãrin ilẹ aiye!
entries.en: Woe unto them that join house to house, that lay field to field, till there be no place, that they may be placed alone in the midst of the earth!

entries.yo: Li eti mi ni Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun sọ pe, Nitõtọ ọ̀pọ ile ni yio di ahoro, ile nla ati daradara laisi olugbe.
entries.en: In mine ears said the LORD of hosts, Of a truth many houses shall be desolate, even great and fair, without inhabitant.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ ìwọn akeri mẹwa ọ̀gba àjara yio mu òṣuwọn bati kan wá, ati òṣuwọn irugbìn homeri kan yio mu òṣuwọn efa kan wá.
entries.en: Yea, ten acres of vineyard shall yield one bath, and the seed of an homer shall yield an ephah.

entries.yo: Egbe ni fun awọn ti ima dide ni kùtukutu, ki nwọn le ma lepa ọti lile; ti nwọn wà ninu rẹ̀ titi di alẹ, titi ọti-waini mu ara wọn gbona!
entries.en: Woe unto them that rise up early in the morning, that they may follow strong drink; that continue until night, till wine inflame them!

entries.yo: Ati durù, ati fioli, tabreti, ferè, ati ọti-waini wà ninu àse wọn: ṣugbọn nwọn kò kà iṣẹ Oluwa si, bẹ̃ni nwọn kò rò iṣẹ ọwọ́ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the harp, and the viol, the tabret, and pipe, and wine, are in their feasts: but they regard not the work of the LORD, neither consider the operation of his hands.

entries.yo: Nitorina awọn enia mi lọ si oko-ẹrú, nitoriti oye kò si, awọn ọlọla wọn di rirù, ati ọ̀pọlọpọ wọn gbẹ fun orùngbẹ.
entries.en: Therefore my people are gone into captivity, because they have no knowledge: and their honourable men are famished, and their multitude dried up with thirst.

entries.yo: Nitorina ipò-òkú ti fun ara rẹ̀ li àye, o si là ẹnu rẹ̀ li aini ìwọn: ati ogo wọn, ati ọ̀pọlọpọ wọn, ati ọṣọ́ wọn, ati awọn ẹniti nyọ̀, yio sọkalẹ sinu rẹ̀.
entries.en: Therefore hell hath enlarged herself, and opened her mouth without measure: and their glory, and their multitude, and their pomp, and he that rejoiceth, shall descend into it.

entries.yo: Enia lasan li a o rẹ̀ silẹ, ati ẹni-alagbara li a o rẹ̀ silẹ, oju agberaga li a o si rẹ̀ silẹ.
entries.en: And the mean man shall be brought down, and the mighty man shall be humbled, and the eyes of the lofty shall be humbled:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun li a o gbe ga ni idajọ, ati Ọlọrun Ẹni-Mimọ́ yio jẹ mimọ́ ninu ododo.
entries.en: But the LORD of hosts shall be exalted in judgment, and God that is holy shall be sanctified in righteousness.

entries.yo: Nigbana li awọn ọdọ-agutan yio ma jẹ̀ gẹgẹ bi iṣe wọn, ati ibi ahoro awọn ti o sanra li awọn alejò yio ma jẹ.
entries.en: Then shall the lambs feed after their manner, and the waste places of the fat ones shall strangers eat.

entries.yo: Egbe ni fun awọn ti nfi ohun asan fà ìwa buburu, ati awọn ti o dabi ẹnipe nfi okùn kẹkẹ́ fà ẹ̀ṣẹ.
entries.en: Woe unto them that draw iniquity with cords of vanity, and sin as it were with a cart rope:

entries.yo: Awọn ti o wipe, Jẹ ki o yara, ki o si mu iṣẹ rẹ̀ yara, ki awa ki o le ri i: ati jẹ ki ìmọ Ẹni-Mimọ́ Israeli sunmọ ihin, ki o si wá, ki awa ki o le mọ̀ ọ.
entries.en: That say, Let him make speed, and hasten his work, that we may see it: and let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel draw nigh and come, that we may know it!

entries.yo: Egbe ni fun awọn ti npè ibi ni rere, ati rere ni ibi, ti nfi okùnkun ṣe imọlẹ, ati imọlẹ ṣe okùnkun: ti nfi ikorò pe adùn, ati adùn pe ikorò!
entries.en: Woe unto them that call evil good, and good evil; that put darkness for light, and light for darkness; that put bitter for sweet, and sweet for bitter!

entries.yo: Egbe ni fun awọn ti nwọn gbọ́n li oju ara wọn, ti nwọn si mọ̀ oye li oju ara wọn!
entries.en: Woe unto them that are wise in their own eyes, and prudent in their own sight!

entries.yo: Egbe ni fun awọn ti o ni ipá lati mu ọti-waini, ati awọn ọkunrin alagbara lati ṣe adàlu ọti lile:
entries.en: Woe unto them that are mighty to drink wine, and men of strength to mingle strong drink:

entries.yo: Awọn ẹniti o da are fun ẹni-buburu nitori ère, ti nwọn si mu ododo olododo kuro li ọwọ́ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Which justify the wicked for reward, and take away the righteousness of the righteous from him!

entries.yo: Nitorina bi iná ti ijo akekù koriko run, ti ọwọ́ iná si ijo iyàngbo; bẹ̃ni egbò wọn yio da bi rirà; itanna wọn yio si gòke bi ekuru; nitori nwọn ti ṣá ofin Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun tì, nwọn si ti gàn ọ̀rọ Ẹni-Mimọ Israeli.
entries.en: Therefore as the fire devoureth the stubble, and the flame consumeth the chaff, so their root shall be as rottenness, and their blossom shall go up as dust: because they have cast away the law of the LORD of hosts, and despised the word of the Holy One of Israel.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni ibinu Oluwa fi ràn si enia rẹ̀, o si ti na ọwọ́ rẹ̀ si wọn, o si ti lù wọn: awọn òke si warìri, okú wọn si wà bi igbẹ li ãrin igboro. Ni gbogbo eyi ibinu rẹ̀ kò yi kuro, ṣugbọn ọwọ́ rẹ̀ nà jade sibẹ.
entries.en: Therefore is the anger of the LORD kindled against his people, and he hath stretched forth his hand against them, and hath smitten them: and the hills did tremble, and their carcases were torn in the midst of the streets. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

entries.yo: Yio si gbe ọpágun soke si awọn orilẹ-ède ti o jìna, yio si kọ si wọn lati opin ilẹ wá, si kiyesi i, nwọn o yara wá kánkán.
entries.en: And he will lift up an ensign to the nations from far, and will hiss unto them from the end of the earth: and, behold, they shall come with speed swiftly:

entries.yo: Kò si ẹniti yio rẹ̀, tabi ti yio kọsẹ ninu wọn, kò si ẹniti yio tõgbe tabi ti yio sùn: bẹ̃ni amùre ẹgbẹ wọn kì yio tu, bẹ̃ni okùn bàta wọn kì yio ja.
entries.en: None shall be weary nor stumble among them; none shall slumber nor sleep; neither shall the girdle of their loins be loosed, nor the latchet of their shoes be broken:

entries.yo: Awọn ẹniti ọfà wọn mu, ti gbogbo ọrun wọn si kàn, a o ka patakò ẹsẹ ẹṣin wọn si okuta akọ, ati kẹkẹ́ wọn bi ãja.
entries.en: Whose arrows are sharp, and all their bows bent, their horses' hoofs shall be counted like flint, and their wheels like a whirlwind:

entries.yo: Kike wọn yio dabi ti kiniun, nwọn o ma ke bi awọn ọmọ kiniun, nitõtọ nwọn o ma ke, nwọn o si di ohun ọdẹ na mu, nwọn a si gbe e lọ li ailewu, kò si ẹnikan ti yio gbà a.
entries.en: Their roaring shall be like a lion, they shall roar like young lions: yea, they shall roar, and lay hold of the prey, and shall carry it away safe, and none shall deliver it.

entries.yo: Ati li ọjọ na nwọn o ho si wọn, bi hiho okun: bi ẹnikan ba si wo ilẹ na, kiyesi i, okùnkun ati ipọnju, imọlẹ si di okùnkun ninu awọsanma dudu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And in that day they shall roar against them like the roaring of the sea: and if one look unto the land, behold darkness and sorrow, and the light is darkened in the heavens thereof.

entries.yo: LI ọdun ti Ussiah ọba kú, emi ri Oluwa joko lori itẹ ti o ga, ti o si gbe ara soke, iṣẹti aṣọ igunwà rẹ̀ kun tempili.
entries.en: In the year that king Uzziah died I saw also the Lord sitting upon a throne, high and lifted up, and his train filled the temple.

entries.yo: Awọn serafu duro loke rẹ̀: ọkọ̃kan wọn ni iyẹ mẹfa, o fi meji bò oju rẹ̀, o si fi meji bò ẹsẹ rẹ̀, o si fi meji fò.
entries.en: Above it stood the seraphims: each one had six wings; with twain he covered his face, and with twain he covered his feet, and with twain he did fly.

entries.yo: Ikini si ke si ekeji pe, Mimọ́, mimọ́, mimọ́, li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun, gbogbo aiye kún fun ogo rẹ̀.
entries.en: And one cried unto another, and said, Holy, holy, holy, is the LORD of hosts: the whole earth is full of his glory.

entries.yo: Awọn òpo ilẹ̀kun si mì nipa ohùn ẹniti o ke, ile na si kún fun ẹ̃fin.
entries.en: And the posts of the door moved at the voice of him that cried, and the house was filled with smoke.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni mo wipe, Egbe ni fun mi, nitori mo gbé, nitoriti mo jẹ́ ẹni alaimọ́ etè, mo si wà lãrin awọn enia alaimọ́ etè, nitoriti oju mi ti ri Ọba, Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun.
entries.en: Then said I, Woe is me! for I am undone; because I am a man of unclean lips, and I dwell in the midst of a people of unclean lips: for mine eyes have seen the King, the LORD of hosts.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ọkan ninu awọn serafu fò wá sọdọ mi, o ni ẹṣẹ́-iná li ọwọ́ rẹ̀, ti o ti fi ẹmú mu lati ori pẹpẹ wá.
entries.en: Then flew one of the seraphims unto me, having a live coal in his hand, which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar:

entries.yo: O si fi kàn mi li ẹnu, o si wipe, Kiyesi i, eyi ti kàn etè rẹ, a mu aiṣedede rẹ kuro, a si fọ ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ nù.
entries.en: And he laid it upon my mouth, and said, Lo, this hath touched thy lips; and thine iniquity is taken away, and thy sin purged.

entries.yo: Emi si gbọ́ ohùn Oluwa pẹlu wipe, Tali emi o rán, ati tani yio si lọ fun wa? Nigbana li emi wipe, Emi nĩ; rán mi.
entries.en: Also I heard the voice of the Lord, saying, Whom shall I send, and who will go for us? Then said I, Here am I; send me.

entries.yo: On si wipe, Lọ, ki o si wi fun awọn enia yi, Ni gbigbọ́, ẹ gbọ́, ṣugbọn oye ki yio ye nyin; ni riri, ẹ ri, ṣugbọn ẹnyin ki yio si mọ̀ oye.
entries.en: And he said, Go, and tell this people, Hear ye indeed, but understand not; and see ye indeed, but perceive not.

entries.yo: Mu ki aiya awọn enia yi ki o sebọ́, mú ki eti wọn ki o wuwo, ki o si di wọn li oju, ki nwọn ki o má ba fi eti wọn gbọ́, ki nwọn ki o má ba fi ọkàn wọn mọ̀, ki nwọn ki o má ba yipada, ki a má ba mu wọn li ara dá.
entries.en: Make the heart of this people fat, and make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes; lest they see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and understand with their heart, and convert, and be healed.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni emi wipe, Oluwa, yio ti pẹ to? O si dahùn pe, Titi awọn ilu-nla yio fi di ahoro, li aisi olugbe, ati awọn ile li aisi enia, ati ilẹ yio di ahoro patapata.
entries.en: Then said I, Lord, how long? And he answered, Until the cities be wasted without inhabitant, and the houses without man, and the land be utterly desolate,

entries.yo: Titi Oluwa yio fi ṣi awọn enia na kuro lọ rére, ti ikọ̀silẹ nla yio si wà ni inu ilẹ na.
entries.en: And the LORD have removed men far away, and there be a great forsaking in the midst of the land.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn sibẹ, idamẹwa yio wà ninu rẹ̀, yio si padà, yio si di rirun, bi igi teili, ati bi igi oakù eyiti ọpá wà ninu wọn, nigbati ewe wọn ba rẹ̀: bẹ̃ni iru mimọ́ na yio jẹ ọpá ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: But yet in it shall be a tenth, and it shall return, and shall be eaten: as a teil tree, and as an oak, whose substance is in them, when they cast their leaves: so the holy seed shall be the substance thereof.

entries.yo: O si ṣe li ọjọ Ahasi ọmọ Jotamu ọmọ Ussiah, ọba Juda, ti Resini, ọba Siria, ati Peka ọmọ Remaliah, ọba Israeli, gokè lọ si Jerusalemu lati jà a li ogun, ṣugbọn nwọn kò le bori rẹ̀.
entries.en: And it came to pass in the days of Ahaz the son of Jotham, the son of Uzziah, king of Judah, that Rezin the king of Syria, and Pekah the son of Remaliah, king of Israel, went up toward Jerusalem to war against it, but could not prevail against it.

entries.yo: A si sọ fun ile Dafidi pe, Siria ba Efraimu dìmọlú. Ọkàn rẹ̀ si mì, ati ọkàn awọn enia rẹ̀ bi igi igbo ti imì nipa ẹfũfu.
entries.en: And it was told the house of David, saying, Syria is confederate with Ephraim. And his heart was moved, and the heart of his people, as the trees of the wood are moved with the wind.
