entries.yo: Oluwa si sọ fun Isaiah pe, Jade nisisiyi, lọ ipade Ahasi, iwọ, ati Ṣeaja-ṣubu ọmọ rẹ, ni ipẹkun oju iṣàn ikũdu ti apa oke, li opopo pápa afọṣọ;
entries.en: Then said the LORD unto Isaiah, Go forth now to meet Ahaz, thou, and Shear-jashub thy son, at the end of the conduit of the upper pool in the highway of the fuller's field;

entries.yo: Si sọ fun u pe, Kiyesara, ki o si gbe jẹ, má bẹ̀ru, bẹ̃ni ki o máṣe jaiya nitori ìru meji igi iná ti nrú ẹ̃fin wọnyi nitori ibinu mimuna Resini pẹlu Siria, ati ti ọmọ Remaliah.
entries.en: And say unto him, Take heed, and be quiet; fear not, neither be fainthearted for the two tails of these smoking firebrands, for the fierce anger of Rezin with Syria, and of the son of Remaliah.

entries.yo: Nitori Siria, Efraimu, ati ọmọ Remaliah ti gbìmọ ibi si ọ wipe.
entries.en: Because Syria, Ephraim, and the son of Remaliah, have taken evil counsel against thee, saying,

entries.yo: Ẹ jẹ ki a gòke lọ si Juda, ki a si bà a ninu jẹ, ẹ si jẹ ki a ṣe ihò ninu rẹ̀ fun ara wa, ki a si gbe ọba kan kalẹ lãrin rẹ̀, ani ọmọ Tabeali:
entries.en: Let us go up against Judah, and vex it, and let us make a breach therein for us, and set a king in the midst of it, even the son of Tabeal:

entries.yo: Bayi ni Oluwa Jehofah wi, Ìmọ na kì yio duro, bẹ̃ni ki yio ṣẹ.
entries.en: Thus saith the Lord GOD, It shall not stand, neither shall it come to pass.

entries.yo: Nitori ori Siria ni Damasku, ori Damasku si ni Resini; ninu ọdun marunlelọgọta li a o fọ Efraimu ti ki yio si jẹ́ enia mọ.
entries.en: For the head of Syria is Damascus, and the head of Damascus is Rezin; and within threescore and five years shall Ephraim be broken, that it be not a people.

entries.yo: Ori Efraimu si ni Samaria, ori Samaria si ni ọmọ Remaliah. Bi ẹnyin ki yio ba gbagbọ́, lotitọ, a ki yio fi idi nyin mulẹ.
entries.en: And the head of Ephraim is Samaria, and the head of Samaria is Remaliah's son. If ye will not believe, surely ye shall not be established.

entries.yo: Oluwa si tun sọ fun Ahasi pe,
entries.en: Moreover the LORD spake again unto Ahaz, saying,

entries.yo: Bere àmi kan lọwọ Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ; bere rẹ̀, ibã jẹ ni ọgbun tabi li okè.
entries.en: Ask thee a sign of the LORD thy God; ask it either in the depth, or in the height above.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Ahasi wipe, Emi ki yio bere, bẹ̃ni emi ki yio dán Oluwa wò.
entries.en: But Ahaz said, I will not ask, neither will I tempt the LORD.

entries.yo: On si wipe, Ẹ gbọ́ nisisiyi ẹnyin ara ile Dafidi, iṣe ohun kekere fun nyin lati dá enia lagara, ṣugbọn ẹnyin o ha si dá Ọlọrun mi lagara pẹlu bi?
entries.en: And he said, Hear ye now, O house of David; Is it a small thing for you to weary men, but will ye weary my God also?

entries.yo: Nitorina, Oluwa tikalarẹ̀ yio fun nyin li àmi kan, kiyesi i, Wundia kan yio loyun, yio si bi ọmọkunrin kan, yio si pe orukọ rẹ̀ ni Immanueli.
entries.en: Therefore the Lord himself shall give you a sign; Behold, a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.

entries.yo: Ori-amọ ati oyin ni yio ma jẹ, ki o le ba mọ̀ bi ati kọ̀ ibi, ati bi ati yàn ire.
entries.en: Butter and honey shall he eat, that he may know to refuse the evil, and choose the good.

entries.yo: Nitoripe, ki ọmọ na ki o to mọ̀ bi ati kọ̀ ibi, ati bi ati yàn ire, ilẹ ti iwọ korira yio di ikọ̀silẹ lọdọ ọba rẹ̀ mejeji.
entries.en: For before the child shall know to refuse the evil, and choose the good, the land that thou abhorrest shall be forsaken of both her kings.

entries.yo: Oluwa yio si mu ọjọ ti kò si bẹ̃ ri wá sori rẹ ati sori awọn enia rẹ, ati sori ile baba rẹ, lati ọjọ ti Efraimu ti lọ kuro lọdọ Juda, ani ọba Assiria.
entries.en: The LORD shall bring upon thee, and upon thy people, and upon thy father's house, days that have not come, from the day that Ephraim departed from Judah; even the king of Assyria.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe li ọjọ na, Oluwa yio kọ si eṣinṣin ti o wà li apa ipẹkun odo ṣiṣàn nlanla Egipti, ati si oyin ti o wà ni ilẹ Assiria.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the LORD shall hiss for the fly that is in the uttermost part of the rivers of Egypt, and for the bee that is in the land of Assyria.

entries.yo: Nwọn o si wá, gbogbo wọn o si bà sinu afonifojì ijù, ati sinu pàlapala okuta, ati lori gbogbo ẹgun, ati lori eweko gbogbo.
entries.en: And they shall come, and shall rest all of them in the desolate valleys, and in the holes of the rocks, and upon all thorns, and upon all bushes.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ kanna ni Oluwa yio fi abẹ ti a yá, eyini ni, awọn ti ihà keji odo nì, ọba Assiria, fá ori ati irun ẹsẹ, yio si run irungbọn pẹlu.
entries.en: In the same day shall the Lord shave with a rasor that is hired, namely, by them beyond the river, by the king of Assyria, the head, and the hair of the feet: and it shall also consume the beard.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe li ọjọ na, enia kan yio si tọ́ ọmọ malu kan ati agutan meji;
entries.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that a man shall nourish a young cow, and two sheep;

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, nitori ọ̀pọlọpọ wàra ti nwọn o mu wá, yio ma jẹ ori-amọ; nitori ori-amọ ati oyin ni olukulùku ti o ba kù ni ãrin ilẹ na yio ma jẹ.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass, for the abundance of milk that they shall give he shall eat butter: for butter and honey shall every one eat that is left in the land.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe li ọjọ na, ibi gbogbo yio ri bayi pe, ibi ti ẹgbẹrun àjara ti wà fun ẹgbẹrun owo fadakà yio di ti ẹwọn ati ẹgun.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that every place shall be, where there were a thousand vines at a thousand silverlings, it shall even be for briers and thorns.

entries.yo: Pẹlu ọfà ati ọrun ni enia yio wá ibẹ, nitoripe gbogbo ilẹ na yio di ẹwọn ati ẹgun.
entries.en: With arrows and with bows shall men come thither; because all the land shall become briers and thorns.

entries.yo: Ati lori gbogbo okè kékèké ti a o fi ọkọ́ tu, ẹ̀ru ẹ̀wọn ati ẹ̀gun ki yio de ibẹ̀: ṣugbọn yio jẹ ilu ti a ndà malũ lọ, ati ibi itẹ̀mọlẹ fun awọn ẹran kékèké.
entries.en: And on all hills that shall be digged with the mattock, there shall not come thither the fear of briers and thorns: but it shall be for the sending forth of oxen, and for the treading of lesser cattle.

entries.yo: PẸLUPẸLU Oluwa wi fun mi pe, Iwọ mu iwe nla kan, ki o si fi kalamu enia kọwe si inu rẹ̀ niti Maher-ṣalal-haṣ-basi.
entries.en: Moreover the LORD said unto me, Take thee a great roll, and write in it with a man's pen concerning Maher-shalal-hash-baz.

entries.yo: Emi si mu awọn ẹlẹri otitọ sọdọ mi lati ṣe ẹlẹri. Uriah alufa, ati Sekariah ọmọ Jeberekiah.
entries.en: And I took unto me faithful witnesses to record, Uriah the priest, and Zechariah the son of Jeberechiah.

entries.yo: Mo si wọle tọ wolĩ obinrin ni lọ; o si loyun o si bi ọmọkunrin kan. Nigbana ni Oluwa wi fun mi pe, sọ orukọ rẹ̀ ni Maher-ṣalal-haṣ-basi.
entries.en: And I went unto the prophetess; and she conceived, and bare a son. Then said the LORD to me, Call his name Maher-shalal-hash-baz.

entries.yo: Nitoripe ki ọmọ na to ni oye ati ke pe, Baba mi, ati iya mi, ọrọ̀ Damasku ati ikogun Samaria ni a o mu kuro niwaju ọba Assiria.
entries.en: For before the child shall have knowledge to cry, My father, and my mother, the riches of Damascus and the spoil of Samaria shall be taken away before the king of Assyria.

entries.yo: Oluwa si tun wi fun mi pe,
entries.en: The LORD spake also unto me again, saying,

entries.yo: Niwọn bi enia yi ti kọ̀ omi Ṣiloa ti nṣàn jẹjẹ silẹ, ti nwọn si nyọ̀ ninu Resini ati ọmọ Remaliah.
entries.en: Forasmuch as this people refuseth the waters of Shiloah that go softly, and rejoice in Rezin and Remaliah's son;

entries.yo: Njẹ nitorina kiyesi i, Oluwa nfà omi odò ti o le, ti o si pọ̀, wá sori wọn, ani ọba Assiria ati gbogbo ogo rẹ̀; yio si wá sori gbogbo ọ̀na odò rẹ̀, yio si gun ori gbogbo bèbe rẹ̀.
entries.en: Now therefore, behold, the Lord bringeth up upon them the waters of the river, strong and many, even the king of Assyria, and all his glory: and he shall come up over all his channels, and go over all his banks:

entries.yo: Yio si kọja li arin Juda; yio si ṣàn bò o mọlẹ yio si mù u de ọrùn, ninà iyẹ rẹ̀ yio si kún ibú ilẹ rẹ, iwọ Immanueli.
entries.en: And he shall pass through Judah; he shall overflow and go over, he shall reach even to the neck; and the stretching out of his wings shall fill the breadth of thy land, O Immanuel.

entries.yo: Ẹ ko ara nyin jọ, ẹnyin enia, a o si fọ nyin tũtu: ẹ si fi eti silẹ, gbogbo ẹnyin ará ilẹ jijìna: ẹ di ara nyin li àmure, a o si fọ nyin tũtu; ẹ di ara nyin li àmure, a o si fọ nyin tũtu.
entries.en: Associate yourselves, O ye people, and ye shall be broken in pieces; and give ear, all ye of far countries: gird yourselves, and ye shall be broken in pieces; gird yourselves, and ye shall be broken in pieces.

entries.yo: Ẹ gbìmọ pọ̀ yio si di asan; ẹ sọ̀rọ na, ki yio si duro: nitoripe Ọlọrun wà pẹlu wa.
entries.en: Take counsel together, and it shall come to nought; speak the word, and it shall not stand: for God is with us.

entries.yo: Nitoriti Oluwa wi bayi fun mi, nipa ọwọ agbara, o si kọ mi ki nmá ba rìn ni ọ̀na enia yi, pe,
entries.en: For the LORD spake thus to me with a strong hand, and instructed me that I should not walk in the way of this people, saying,

entries.yo: Ẹ máṣe pè gbogbo eyi ni imulẹ ti awọn enia yi pè ni imulẹ: bẹ̃ni ẹ máṣe bẹ̀ru ibẹ̀ru wọn, ẹ má si ṣe foya.
entries.en: Say ye not, A confederacy, to all them to whom this people shall say, A confederacy; neither fear ye their fear, nor be afraid.

entries.yo: Yà Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun tikalarẹ̀ si mimọ́; si jẹ ki o ṣe ẹ̀ru nyin, si jẹ ki o ṣe ifòya nyin.
entries.en: Sanctify the LORD of hosts himself; and let him be your fear, and let him be your dread.

entries.yo: On o si wà fun ibi mimọ́, ṣugbọn fun okuta idùgbolu, ati fun apata ẹ̀ṣẹ, si ile Israeli mejeji, fun ẹgẹ, ati fun okùn didẹ si awọn ara Jerusalemu.
entries.en: And he shall be for a sanctuary; but for a stone of stumbling and for a rock of offence to both the houses of Israel, for a gin and for a snare to the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Ọ̀pọlọpọ ninu wọn yio si kọsẹ, nwọn o si ṣubu, a o si fọ wọn, a o si mu wọn.
entries.en: And many among them shall stumble, and fall, and be broken, and be snared, and be taken.

entries.yo: Di ẹri na, fi edídi di ofin na lãrin awọn ọmọ-ẹhin mi.
entries.en: Bind up the testimony, seal the law among my disciples.

entries.yo: Emi o si duro de Oluwa, ti o pa oju rẹ̀ mọ kuro lara ile Jakobu, emi o si ma wo ọ̀na rẹ̀.
entries.en: And I will wait upon the LORD, that hideth his face from the house of Jacob, and I will look for him.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, emi ati awọn ọmọ ti Oluwa ti fi fun mi wà fun àmi ati fun iyanu ni Israeli, lati ọdọ Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wá, ti ngbe òke Sioni.
entries.en: Behold, I and the children whom the LORD hath given me are for signs and for wonders in Israel from the LORD of hosts, which dwelleth in mount Zion.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn ba si wi fun nyin pe, Ẹ wá awọn ti mba okú lò, ati awọn oṣó ti nke, ti nsi nkùn, kò ha yẹ ki orilẹ-ède ki o wá Ọlọrun wọn jù ki awọn alãye ma wá awọn okú?
entries.en: And when they shall say unto you, Seek unto them that have familiar spirits, and unto wizards that peep, and that mutter: should not a people seek unto their God? for the living to the dead?

entries.yo: Si ofin ati si ẹri: bi nwọn kò ba sọ gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ yi, nitoriti kò si imọlẹ ninu wọn ni.
entries.en: To the law and to the testimony: if they speak not according to this word, it is because there is no light in them.

entries.yo: Nwọn o si kọja lọ lãrin rẹ̀, ninu inilara ati ebi: yio si ṣe pe nigbati ebi yio pa wọn, nwọn o ma kanra, nwọn o si fi ọba ati Ọlọrun wọn re, nwọn o si ma wò òke.
entries.en: And they shall pass through it, hardly bestead and hungry: and it shall come to pass, that when they shall be hungry, they shall fret themselves, and curse their king and their God, and look upward.

entries.yo: Nwọn o si wò ilẹ, si kiyesi i, iyọnu ati okùnkun, iṣuju irora: a o si le wọn lọ sinu okùnkun.
entries.en: And they shall look unto the earth; and behold trouble and darkness, dimness of anguish; and they shall be driven to darkness.

entries.yo: ṢUGBỌN iṣuju na kì yio wà nibiti wahalà mbẹ nisisiyi, gẹgẹ bi ìgba iṣãju ti mu itìju wá si ilẹ Sebuloni ati ilẹ Naftali, bẹ̃ni ìgba ikẹhin yio mu ọla wá si ọ̀na okun, niha ẹkùn Jordani, Galili awọn orilẹ-ède.
entries.en: Nevertheless the dimness shall not be such as was in her vexation, when at the first he lightly afflicted the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, and afterward did more grievously afflict her by the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, in Galilee of the nations.

entries.yo: Awọn enia ti nrin li okùnkun ri imọlẹ nla: awọn ti ngbe ilẹ ojiji ikú, lara wọn ni imọlẹ mọ́ si.
entries.en: The people that walked in darkness have seen a great light: they that dwell in the land of the shadow of death, upon them hath the light shined.

entries.yo: Iwọ ti mu orilẹ-ède nì bi si i pupọ̀pupọ̀, iwọ si sọ ayọ̀ di pupọ̀ fun u: nwọn nyọ̀ niwaju rẹ gẹgẹ bi ayọ̀ ikore, ati gẹgẹ bi enia iti yọ̀ nigbati nwọn npin ikogun.
entries.en: Thou hast multiplied the nation, and not increased the joy: they joy before thee according to the joy in harvest, and as men rejoice when they divide the spoil.

entries.yo: Nitori iwọ ṣẹ́ ajàga-irú rẹ̀, ati ọpá ejika rẹ̀, ọgọ aninilara rẹ̀, gẹgẹ bi li ọjọ Midiani.
entries.en: For thou hast broken the yoke of his burden, and the staff of his shoulder, the rod of his oppressor, as in the day of Midian.

entries.yo: Nitori gbogbo ihamọra awọn ologun ninu irọkẹ̀kẹ, ati aṣọ ti a yi ninu ẹ̀jẹ, yio jẹ fun ijoná ati igi iná.
entries.en: For every battle of the warrior is with confused noise, and garments rolled in blood; but this shall be with burning and fuel of fire.

entries.yo: Nitori a bi ọmọ kan fun wa, a fi ọmọkunrin kan fun wa: ijọba yio si wà li ejika rẹ̀: a o si ma pe orukọ rẹ̀ ni Iyanu, Oludamọ̀ran, Ọlọrun Alagbara, Baba Aiyeraiye, Ọmọ-Alade Alafia.
entries.en: For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counseller, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.

entries.yo: Ijọba yio bi si i, alafia ki yio ni ipẹkun: lori itẹ Dafidi, ati lori ijọba rẹ̀, lati ma tọ́ ọ, ati lati fi idi rẹ̀ mulẹ, nipa idajọ, ati ododo lati isisiyi lọ, ani titi lai. Itara Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun yio ṣe eyi.
entries.en: Of the increase of his government and peace there shall be no end, upon the throne of David, and upon his kingdom, to order it, and to establish it with judgment and with justice from henceforth even for ever. The zeal of the LORD of hosts will perform this.

entries.yo: Oluwa rán ọ̀rọ si Jakobu, o si ti bà lé Israeli.
entries.en: The Lord sent a word into Jacob, and it hath lighted upon Israel.

entries.yo: Gbogbo enia yio si mọ̀ ọ, Efraimu ati awọn ti ngbe Samaria, ti nwi ninu igberaga, ati lile aiya pe,
entries.en: And all the people shall know, even Ephraim and the inhabitant of Samaria, that say in the pride and stoutness of heart,

entries.yo: Briki wọnni ṣubu lu ilẹ, ṣugbọn awa o fi okuta gbigbẹ́ mọ ọ: a ke igi sikamore lu ilẹ, ṣugbọn a o fi igi kedari pãrọ wọn.
entries.en: The bricks are fallen down, but we will build with hewn stones: the sycomores are cut down, but we will change them into cedars.

entries.yo: Nitorina li Oluwa yio gbe awọn aninilara Resini dide si i, yio si dá awọn ọtá rẹ̀ pọ̀.
entries.en: Therefore the LORD shall set up the adversaries of Rezin against him, and join his enemies together;

entries.yo: Awọn ara Siria niwaju, ati awọn Filistini lẹhin: nwọn o si fi gbogbo ẹnu jẹ Israeli run. Ni gbogbo eyi ibinu rẹ̀ kò yi kuro, ṣugbọn ọwọ́ rẹ̀ nà jade sibẹ.
entries.en: The Syrians before, and the Philistines behind; and they shall devour Israel with open mouth. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

entries.yo: Awọn enia na kọ yipada si ẹniti o lù wọn, bẹ̃ni nwọn kò wá Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun.
entries.en: For the people turneth not unto him that smiteth them, neither do they seek the LORD of hosts.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni Oluwa yio ke ori ati irù, imọ̀-ọpẹ ati koriko-odo kuro ni Israeli, li ọjọ kan.
entries.en: Therefore the LORD will cut off from Israel head and tail, branch and rush, in one day.

entries.yo: Agbà ati ọlọla, on li ori, ati wolĩ ti nkọni li eké, on ni irù.
entries.en: The ancient and honourable, he is the head; and the prophet that teacheth lies, he is the tail.

entries.yo: Nitori awọn olori enia yi mu wọn ṣìna: awọn ti a si tọ́ li ọ̀na ninu wọn li a parun.
entries.en: For the leaders of this people cause them to err; and they that are led of them are destroyed.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni Oluwa kì yio ṣe ni ayọ̀ ninu ọdọ-ọmọkunrin wọn, bẹ̃ni ki yio ṣãnu fun awọn alainibaba ati opo wọn: nitori olukuluku wọn jẹ agabagebe ati oluṣe-buburu, olukuluku ẹnu nsọ wère. Ni gbogbo eyi ibinu rẹ̀ kò yi kuro, ṣugbọn ọwọ́ rẹ̀ nà jade sibẹ.
entries.en: Therefore the Lord shall have no joy in their young men, neither shall have mercy on their fatherless and widows: for every one is an hypocrite and an evildoer, and every mouth speaketh folly. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

entries.yo: Nitori ìwa-buburu njo bi iná: yio jo ẹwọn ati ẹgún run, yio si ràn ninu pàntiri igbó, nwọn o si goke lọ bi ẹ̃fin iti goke.
entries.en: For wickedness burneth as the fire: it shall devour the briers and thorns, and shall kindle in the thickets of the forest, and they shall mount up like the lifting up of smoke.

entries.yo: Nipa ibinu Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun ni ilẹ fi ṣõkùn, awọn enia yio dabi igi iná, ẹnikan kì yio dá arakunrin rẹ̀ si.
entries.en: Through the wrath of the LORD of hosts is the land darkened, and the people shall be as the fuel of the fire: no man shall spare his brother.

entries.yo: On o si jajẹ li ọwọ́ ọ̀tun, ebi o si pa a; on o si jẹ li ọwọ́ osì; nwọn kì yio si yo: olukuluku enia yio si jẹ ẹran-ara apa rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he shall snatch on the right hand, and be hungry; and he shall eat on the left hand, and they shall not be satisfied: they shall eat every man the flesh of his own arm:

entries.yo: Manasse o jẹ Efraimu; Efraimu o si jẹ Manasse: awọn mejeji o dojukọ Juda. Ni gbogbo eyi, ibinu rẹ̀ kò yi kuro, ṣugbọn ọwọ́ rẹ̀ nà jade sibẹ.
entries.en: Manasseh, Ephraim; and Ephraim, Manasseh: and they together shall be against Judah. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

entries.yo: EGBE ni fun awọn ti npaṣẹ aiṣododo, ati fun awọn akọwe ti nkọ iwe ìka;
entries.en: Woe unto them that decree unrighteous decrees, and that write grievousness which they have prescribed;

entries.yo: Lati yi alaini kuro ni idajọ, ati lati mu ohun ẹtọ kuro lọwọ talakà enia mi, ki awọn opo ba le di ijẹ wọn, ati ki wọn ba le jà alainibaba li ole!
entries.en: To turn aside the needy from judgment, and to take away the right from the poor of my people, that widows may be their prey, and that they may rob the fatherless!

entries.yo: Kili ẹnyin o ṣe lọjọ ibẹ̀wo, ati ni idahoro ti yio ti okere wá? tali ẹnyin o sá tọ̀ fun irànlọwọ? nibo li ẹnyin o si fi ogo nyin si?
entries.en: And what will ye do in the day of visitation, and in the desolation which shall come from far? to whom will ye flee for help? and where will ye leave your glory?

entries.yo: Laisi emi nwọn o tẹ̀ ba labẹ awọn ara-tubu, nwọn o si ṣubu labẹ awọn ti a pa. Ni gbogbo eyi ibinu rẹ̀ kò yi kuro, ṣugbọn ọwọ́ rẹ̀ nà jade sibẹ.
entries.en: Without me they shall bow down under the prisoners, and they shall fall under the slain. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

entries.yo: Egbe ni fun Assuri, ọgọ ibinu mi, ati ọ̀pa ọwọ́ wọn ni irúnu mi.
entries.en: O Assyrian, the rod of mine anger, and the staff in their hand is mine indignation.

entries.yo: Emi o ran a si orilẹ-ède agabàgebe, ati fun awọn enia ibinu mi li emi o paṣẹ kan, lati ko ikogun, ati lati mu ohun ọdẹ, ati lati tẹ̀ wọn mọlẹ bi ẹrẹ̀ ni igboro.
entries.en: I will send him against an hypocritical nation, and against the people of my wrath will I give him a charge, to take the spoil, and to take the prey, and to tread them down like the mire of the streets.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn on kò rò bẹ̃, bẹ̃ni ọkàn rẹ̀ kò rò bẹ̃; ṣugbọn o wà li ọkàn rẹ̀ lati parun ati lati ke orilẹ-ède kuro, ki iṣe diẹ.
entries.en: Howbeit he meaneth not so, neither doth his heart think so; but it is in his heart to destroy and cut off nations not a few.

entries.yo: Nitori o wipe, Ọba kọ awọn ọmọ-alade mi ha jẹ patapata?
entries.en: For he saith, Are not my princes altogether kings?

entries.yo: Kalno kò ha dabi Karkemiṣi? Hamati kò ha dabi Arpadi? Samaria kò ha dabi Damasku?
entries.en: Is not Calno as Carchemish? is not Hamath as Arpad? is not Samaria as Damascus?

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi ọwọ́ mi ti nà de ijọba ere ri, ere eyi ti o jù ti Jerusalemu ati ti Samaria lọ.
entries.en: As my hand hath found the kingdoms of the idols, and whose graven images did excel them of Jerusalem and of Samaria;

entries.yo: Bi emi ti ṣe si Samaria ati ere rẹ̀, emi kì yio ha ṣe bẹ̃ si Jerusalemu ati ere rẹ̀ bi?
entries.en: Shall I not, as I have done unto Samaria and her idols, so do to Jerusalem and her idols?

entries.yo: Nitorina yio si ṣe, nigbati Oluwa ti ṣe gbogbo iṣẹ rẹ̀ lori òke Sioni ati Jerusalemu, emi o ba eso aiya lile ọba Assiria wi, ati ogo ìwo giga rẹ̀.
entries.en: Wherefore it shall come to pass, that when the Lord hath performed his whole work upon mount Zion and on Jerusalem, I will punish the fruit of the stout heart of the king of Assyria, and the glory of his high looks.

entries.yo: Nitori o wipe, nipa agbara ọwọ́ mi ni emi ti ṣe e, ati nipa ọgbọ́n mi; nitori emi moye, emi si ti mu àla awọn enia kuro, emi si ti ji iṣura wọn, emi si ti sọ awọn ará ilu na kalẹ bi alagbara ọkunrin.
entries.en: For he saith, By the strength of my hand I have done it, and by my wisdom; for I am prudent: and I have removed the bounds of the people, and have robbed their treasures, and I have put down the inhabitants like a valiant man:

entries.yo: Ọwọ́ mi si ti wá ọrọ̀ awọn enia ri bi itẹ ẹiyẹ: ati gẹgẹ bi ẹnipe ẹnikan nko ẹyin ti o kù, li emi ti kó gbogbo aiye jọ; kò si ẹniti o gbọ̀n iyẹ, tabi ti o ya ẹnu, tabi ti o dún.
entries.en: And my hand hath found as a nest the riches of the people: and as one gathereth eggs that are left, have I gathered all the earth; and there was none that moved the wing, or opened the mouth, or peeped.

entries.yo: Ãke ha le fọnnu si ẹniti nfi i la igi? tabi ayùn ha le gbe ara rẹ̀ ga si ẹniti nmì i? bi ẹnipe ọgọ le mì ara rẹ̀ si awọn ti o gbe e soke, tabi bi ẹnipe ọpa le gbe ara rẹ̀ soke, bi ẹnipe ki iṣe igi.
entries.en: Shall the axe boast itself against him that heweth therewith? or shall the saw magnify itself against him that shaketh it? as if the rod should shake itself against them that lift it up, or as if the staff should lift up itself, as if it were no wood.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni Oluwa, Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun yio mu awọn tirẹ̀ ti o sanra di rirù: ati labẹ ogo rẹ̀ yio da jijo kan bi jijo iná.
entries.en: Therefore shall the Lord, the Lord of hosts, send among his fat ones leanness; and under his glory he shall kindle a burning like the burning of a fire.

entries.yo: Imọlẹ Israeli yio si jẹ iná, ati Ẹni-Mimọ́ rẹ̀ yio jẹ ọwọ́-iná: yio si jo ẹgún ati ẹwọn rẹ̀ run, li ọjọ kan;
entries.en: And the light of Israel shall be for a fire, and his Holy One for a flame: and it shall burn and devour his thorns and his briers in one day;

entries.yo: Yio si jo ogo igbó rẹ̀ run, ati oko rẹ̀ ẹlẹtù loju, ati ọkàn ati ara: nwọn o si dabi igbati ọlọpagun ndakú.
entries.en: And shall consume the glory of his forest, and of his fruitful field, both soul and body: and they shall be as when a standardbearer fainteth.

entries.yo: Iyokù igi igbó rẹ̀ yio si jẹ diẹ, ti ọmọde yio le kọwe wọn.
entries.en: And the rest of the trees of his forest shall be few, that a child may write them.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe li ọjọ na, iyokù Israeli, ati iru awọn ti o salà ni ile Jakobu, ki yio tun duro tì ẹniti o lù wọn mọ; ṣugbọn nwọn o duro tì Oluwa, Ẹni-Mimọ Israeli, li otitọ.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the remnant of Israel, and such as are escaped of the house of Jacob, shall no more again stay upon him that smote them; but shall stay upon the LORD, the Holy One of Israel, in truth.

entries.yo: Awọn iyokù yio pada, awọn iyokù ti Jakobu, si Ọlọrun alagbara.
entries.en: The remnant shall return, even the remnant of Jacob, unto the mighty God.

entries.yo: Bi Israeli enia rẹ ba dàbi iyanrìn okun, sibẹ iyokù ninu wọn o pada: aṣẹ iparun na yio kun àkúnwọ́sílẹ̀ ninu ododo.
entries.en: For though thy people Israel be as the sand of the sea, yet a remnant of them shall return: the consumption decreed shall overflow with righteousness.

entries.yo: Nitori Oluwa, Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun yio ṣe iparun, ani ipinnu, li ãrin ilẹ gbogbo.
entries.en: For the Lord GOD of hosts shall make a consumption, even determined, in the midst of all the land.

entries.yo: Nitorina bayi li Oluwa, Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi, Ẹnyin enia mi ti ngbe Sioni, ẹ má bẹ̀ru awọn ara Assiria: on o fi ọgọ lù ọ, yio si gbe ọpa rẹ̀ soke si ọ, gẹgẹ bi iru ti Egipti.
entries.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD of hosts, O my people that dwellest in Zion, be not afraid of the Assyrian: he shall smite thee with a rod, and shall lift up his staff against thee, after the manner of Egypt.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn niwọn igba diẹ kiun, irunú yio si tan, ati ibinu mi ninu iparun wọn.
entries.en: For yet a very little while, and the indignation shall cease, and mine anger in their destruction.

entries.yo: Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun yio gbe paṣan kan soke fun u, gẹgẹ bi ipakupa ti Midiani ni apata Orebu: ati gẹgẹ bi ọgọ rẹ̀ soju okun, bẹ̃ni yio gbe e soke gẹgẹ bi iru ti Egipti.
entries.en: And the LORD of hosts shall stir up a scourge for him according to the slaughter of Midian at the rock of Oreb: and as his rod was upon the sea, so shall he lift it up after the manner of Egypt.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe li ọjọ na, ni a o gbe ẹrù rẹ̀ kuro li ejika rẹ, ati àjaga rẹ̀ kuro li ọrùn rẹ, a o si ba àjaga na jẹ ní ọrùn rẹ.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that his burden shall be taken away from off thy shoulder, and his yoke from off thy neck, and the yoke shall be destroyed because of the anointing.

entries.yo: On de si Aiati, on ti kọja si Migroni; ni Mikmaṣi li on ko ẹrù-ogun rẹ̀ jọ si:
entries.en: He is come to Aiath, he is passed to Migron; at Michmash he hath laid up his carriages:

entries.yo: Nwọn ti rekọja ọ̀na na: nwọn ti wọ̀ ni Geba; Rama bẹ̀ru; Gibea ti Saulu sá.
entries.en: They are gone over the passage: they have taken up their lodging at Geba; Ramah is afraid; Gibeah of Saul is fled.

entries.yo: Gbe ohùn rẹ soke, ọmọbinrin Gallimu: mu ki a gbọ́ ọ de Laiṣi, otòṣi Anatoti.
entries.en: Lift up thy voice, O daughter of Gallim: cause it to be heard unto Laish, O poor Anathoth.

entries.yo: A ṣi Madmena nipo dà; awọn ara Gebimu ko ara wọn jọ lati sa.
entries.en: Madmenah is removed; the inhabitants of Gebim gather themselves to flee.

entries.yo: Yio duro sibẹ ni Nobu li ọjọ na: on o si mì ọwọ́ rẹ̀ si oke giga ọmọbinrin Sioni, oke kekere Jerusalemu.
entries.en: As yet shall he remain at Nob that day: he shall shake his hand against the mount of the daughter of Zion, the hill of Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, Oluwa, Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun yio fi ẹ̀ru wọ́n ẹka: ati awọn ti o ga ni inà li a o ke kuro, ati awọn agberaga li a o rẹ̀ silẹ.
entries.en: Behold, the Lord, the LORD of hosts, shall lop the bough with terror: and the high ones of stature shall be hewn down, and the haughty shall be humbled.

entries.yo: On o si fi irin ke pantiri igbó lu ilẹ, Lebanoni yio si ṣubu nipa alagbara kan.
entries.en: And he shall cut down the thickets of the forest with iron, and Lebanon shall fall by a mighty one.

entries.yo: ẼKÀN kan yio si jade lati inu kùkute Jesse wá, ẹka kan yio si hù jade lati inu gbòngbo rẹ̀:
entries.en: And there shall come forth a rod out of the stem of Jesse, and a Branch shall grow out of his roots:

entries.yo: Ẹmi Oluwa yio si bà le e, ẹmi ọgbọ́n ati oye, ẹmi igbimọ̀ ati agbara, ẹmi imọ̀ran ati ibẹ̀ru Oluwa.
entries.en: And the spirit of the LORD shall rest upon him, the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of the LORD;

entries.yo: Õrùn-didùn rẹ̀ si wà ni ibẹ̀ru Oluwa, on ki yio si dajọ nipa ìri oju rẹ̀, bẹ̃ni ki yio dajọ nipa gbigbọ́ eti rẹ̀;
entries.en: And shall make him of quick understanding in the fear of the LORD: and he shall not judge after the sight of his eyes, neither reprove after the hearing of his ears:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn yio fi ododo ṣe idajọ talakà, yio si fi otitọ ṣe idajọ fun awọn ọlọkàn tutù aiye; on o si fi ọgọ ẹnu rẹ̀ lu aiye, on o si fi ẽmi ète rẹ̀ lu awọn enia buburu pa.
entries.en: But with righteousness shall he judge the poor, and reprove with equity for the meek of the earth: and he shall smite the earth with the rod of his mouth, and with the breath of his lips shall he slay the wicked.

entries.yo: Ododo yio si jẹ amure ẹgbẹ́ rẹ̀, ati iṣotitọ amure inu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And righteousness shall be the girdle of his loins, and faithfulness the girdle of his reins.

entries.yo: Ikõkò pẹlu yio ma ba ọdọ-agutan gbe pọ̀, kiniun yio si dubulẹ pẹlu ọmọ ewurẹ; ati ọmọ malũ ati ọmọ kiniun ati ẹgbọ̀rọ ẹran abọpa yio ma gbe pọ̀; ọmọ kekere yio si ma dà wọn.
entries.en: The wolf also shall dwell with the lamb, and the leopard shall lie down with the kid; and the calf and the young lion and the fatling together; and a little child shall lead them.

entries.yo: Malũ ati beari yio si ma jẹ pọ̀; ọmọ wọn yio dubulẹ pọ̀; kiniun yio si jẹ koriko bi malũ.
entries.en: And the cow and the bear shall feed; their young ones shall lie down together: and the lion shall eat straw like the ox.

entries.yo: Ọmọ ẹnu-ọmu yio si ṣire ni ihò pãmọlẹ, ati ọmọ ti a já lẹnu-ọmu yio si fi ọwọ́ rẹ̀ si ihò ejò.
entries.en: And the sucking child shall play on the hole of the asp, and the weaned child shall put his hand on the cockatrice' den.

entries.yo: Nwọn ki yio panilara, bẹ̃ni nwọn ki yio panirun ni gbogbo oke mimọ́ mi: nitori aiye yio kún fun ìmọ Oluwa gẹgẹ bi omi ti bò okun.
entries.en: They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain: for the earth shall be full of the knowledge of the LORD, as the waters cover the sea.

entries.yo: Ati li ọjọ na kùkute Jesse kan yio wà, ti yio duro fun ọpágun awọn enia; on li awọn keferi yio wá ri: isimi rẹ̀ yio si li ogo.
entries.en: And in that day there shall be a root of Jesse, which shall stand for an ensign of the people; to it shall the Gentiles seek: and his rest shall be glorious.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe li ọjọ na, ni Oluwa yio tun nawọ rẹ̀ lati gbà awọn enia rẹ̀ iyokù padà, ti yio kù, lati Assiria, ati lati Egipti, ati lati Patrosi, ati lati Kuṣi, ati lati Elamu, ati Ṣinari, ati lati Hamati, ati lati awọn erekùṣu okun wá.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the Lord shall set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria, and from Egypt, and from Pathros, and from Cush, and from Elam, and from Shinar, and from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.

entries.yo: On o si gbe ọpagun kan duro fun awọn orilẹ-ède, yio si gbá awọn aṣati Israeli jọ, yio si kó awọn ti a tuka ni Juda jọ lati igun mẹrin aiye wá.
entries.en: And he shall set up an ensign for the nations, and shall assemble the outcasts of Israel, and gather together the dispersed of Judah from the four corners of the earth.

entries.yo: Ilara Efraimu yio si tan kuro; Efraimu ki yio ṣe ilara Juda, Juda ki yio si bà Efraimu ninu jẹ.
entries.en: The envy also of Ephraim shall depart, and the adversaries of Judah shall be cut off: Ephraim shall not envy Judah, and Judah shall not vex Ephraim.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nwọn o si fò mọ ejika awọn Filistini siha iwọ̀-õrun; nwọn o jùmọ bà awọn ti ilà-õrun jẹ: nwọn o si gbe ọwọ́ le Edomu ati Moabu; awọn ọmọ Ammoni yio si gbà wọn gbọ́.
entries.en: But they shall fly upon the shoulders of the Philistines toward the west; they shall spoil them of the east together: they shall lay their hand upon Edom and Moab; and the children of Ammon shall obey them.

entries.yo: Oluwa yio si pa ahọn okun Egipti run tũtũ; ẹfũfu lile rẹ̀ ni yio si mì ọwọ́ rẹ̀ lori odo na, yio si lù u ni iṣàn meje, yio si jẹ ki enia rekọja ni batà gbigbẹ.
entries.en: And the LORD shall utterly destroy the tongue of the Egyptian sea; and with his mighty wind shall he shake his hand over the river, and shall smite it in the seven streams, and make men go over dryshod.

entries.yo: Ọna opopo kan yio si wà fun iyokù awọn enia rẹ̀, ti yio kù, lati Assiria; gẹgẹ bi o ti ri fun Israeli li ọjọ ti o goke jade kuro ni ilẹ Egipti.
entries.en: And there shall be an highway for the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria; like as it was to Israel in the day that he came up out of the land of Egypt.

entries.yo: ATI li ọjọ na iwọ o si wipe, Oluwa, emi o yìn ọ: bi o tilẹ ti binu si mi, ibinu rẹ ti yi kuro, iwọ si tù mi ninu.
entries.en: And in that day thou shalt say, O LORD, I will praise thee: though thou wast angry with me, thine anger is turned away, and thou comfortedst me.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, Ọlọrun ni igbala mi; emi o gbẹkẹle, emi ki yio si bẹ̀ru: nitori Oluwa Jehofah li agbara mi ati orin mi; on pẹlu si di igbala mi.
entries.en: Behold, God is my salvation; I will trust, and not be afraid: for the LORD JEHOVAH is my strength and my song; he also is become my salvation.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin o si fi ayọ̀ fà omi jade lati inu kanga igbala wá.
entries.en: Therefore with joy shall ye draw water out of the wells of salvation.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ na li ẹnyin o si wipe, Yìn Oluwa, kepe orukọ rẹ̀, sọ iṣẹ́ rẹ̀ lãrin awọn enia, mu u wá si iranti pe, orukọ rẹ̀ li a gbe leke.
entries.en: And in that day shall ye say, Praise the LORD, call upon his name, declare his doings among the people, make mention that his name is exalted.

entries.yo: Kọrin si Oluwa: nitori o ti ṣe ohun didara: eyi di mimọ̀ ni gbogbo aiye.
entries.en: Sing unto the LORD; for he hath done excellent things: this is known in all the earth.

entries.yo: Kigbe, si hó, iwọ olugbe Sioni: nitori ẹni titobi ni Ẹni-Mimọ́ Israeli li ãrin rẹ.
entries.en: Cry out and shout, thou inhabitant of Zion: for great is the Holy One of Israel in the midst of thee.

entries.yo: Ọ̀RỌ-ìmọ niti Babiloni ti Isaiah ọmọ Amosi ri.
entries.en: The burden of Babylon, which Isaiah the son of Amoz did see.

entries.yo: Ẹ gbe ọpágun soke lori oke giga, ẹ kọ si wọn, ẹ juwọ, ki nwọn ba le lọ sinu ẹnu-odi awọn ọlọla.
entries.en: Lift ye up a banner upon the high mountain, exalt the voice unto them, shake the hand, that they may go into the gates of the nobles.

entries.yo: Emi ti paṣẹ fun awọn temi ti a yà si mimọ́, emi ti pe awọn alagbara mi pẹlu fun ibinu mi, ani awọn ti nwọn yọ̀ ninu ọlanla mi.
entries.en: I have commanded my sanctified ones, I have also called my mighty ones for mine anger, even them that rejoice in my highness.

entries.yo: Ariwo ọ̀pọlọpọ lori oke, gẹgẹ bi ti enia pupọ̀: ariwo rudurudu ti ijọba awọn orilẹ-ède, ti a kojọ pọ̀: Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun gbá ogun awọn ọmọ-ogun jọ.
entries.en: The noise of a multitude in the mountains, like as of a great people; a tumultuous noise of the kingdoms of nations gathered together: the LORD of hosts mustereth the host of the battle.

entries.yo: Nwọn ti ilẹ okerè wá, lati ipẹkun ọrun, ani, Oluwa, ati ohun-elò ibinu rẹ̀, lati pa gbogbo ilẹ run.
entries.en: They come from a far country, from the end of heaven, even the LORD, and the weapons of his indignation, to destroy the whole land.

entries.yo: Ẹ hu; nitori ọjọ Oluwa kù si dẹdẹ; yio de bi iparun lati ọdọ Olodumare wá.
entries.en: Howl ye; for the day of the LORD is at hand; it shall come as a destruction from the Almighty.

entries.yo: Nitorina gbogbo ọwọ́ yio rọ, ọkàn olukuluku enia yio si di yiyọ́.
entries.en: Therefore shall all hands be faint, and every man's heart shall melt:

entries.yo: Nwọn o si bẹ̀ru: irora ati ikãnu yio dì wọn mu; nwọn o wà ni irora bi obinrin ti nrọbi: ẹnu yio yà ẹnikan si ẹnikeji rẹ̀; oju wọn yio dabi ọwọ́-iná.
entries.en: And they shall be afraid: pangs and sorrows shall take hold of them; they shall be in pain as a woman that travaileth: they shall be amazed one at another; their faces shall be as flames.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, ọjọ Oluwa mbọ̀ wá, o ni ibi ti on ti ikannú ati ibinu gbigboná, lati sọ ilẹ na di ahoro: yio si pa awọn ẹlẹṣẹ run kuro ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: Behold, the day of the LORD cometh, cruel both with wrath and fierce anger, to lay the land desolate: and he shall destroy the sinners thereof out of it.

entries.yo: Nitori awọn iràwọ ọrun, ati iṣùpọ iràwọ inu rẹ̀ kì yio tàn imọlẹ wọn: õrun yio ṣu okùnkun ni ijadelọ rẹ̀, oṣùpa kì yio si mu ki imọlẹ rẹ̀ tàn.
entries.en: For the stars of heaven and the constellations thereof shall not give their light: the sun shall be darkened in his going forth, and the moon shall not cause her light to shine.

entries.yo: Emi o si bẹ̀ ibi wò lara aiye, ati aiṣedẽde lara awọn enia buburu; emi o si mu ki igberaga awọn agberaga ki o mọ, emi o si mu igberaga awọn alagbara rẹ̀ silẹ.
entries.en: And I will punish the world for their evil, and the wicked for their iniquity; and I will cause the arrogancy of the proud to cease, and will lay low the haughtiness of the terrible.

entries.yo: Emi o mu ki ọkunrin kan ṣọwọ́n ju wura lọ; ani enia kan ju wura Ofiri daradara.
entries.en: I will make a man more precious than fine gold; even a man than the golden wedge of Ophir.

entries.yo: Nitorina emi o mu ọrun mì titi, ilẹ aiye yio si ṣipò rẹ̀ pada, ninu ibinu Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun, ati li ọjọ ibinu gbigbona rẹ̀.
entries.en: Therefore I will shake the heavens, and the earth shall remove out of her place, in the wrath of the LORD of hosts, and in the day of his fierce anger.

entries.yo: Yio si dabi abo agbọ̀nrin ti a nlepa, ati bi agutan ti ẹnikan kò gbajọ: olukuluku wọn o yipada si enia rẹ̀, olukuluku yio si sa si ilẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And it shall be as the chased roe, and as a sheep that no man taketh up: they shall every man turn to his own people, and flee every one into his own land.

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni ti a ri li a o gun li agunyọ; ẹnikẹni ti o si dà ara rẹ̀ pọ̀ mọ́ wọn yio ti ipa idà ṣubu.
entries.en: Every one that is found shall be thrust through; and every one that is joined unto them shall fall by the sword.

entries.yo: Ọmọ wọn pẹlu li a o fọ́ tũtu loju ara wọn; a o si kó wọn ni ile, a o si fi agbara bà obinrin wọn jẹ́;
entries.en: Their children also shall be dashed to pieces before their eyes; their houses shall be spoiled, and their wives ravished.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, emi o gbe awọn ara Media dide si wọn, ti ki yio ka fadakà si; bi o si ṣe ti wura, nwọn ki yio ni inu didùn si i.
entries.en: Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them, which shall not regard silver; and as for gold, they shall not delight in it.

entries.yo: Ọrun wọn pẹlu yio fọ́ awọn ọdọmọkunrin tũtũ; nwọn ki yio ṣãnu fun ọmọ-inu: oju wọn kì yio dá ọmọde si.
entries.en: Their bows also shall dash the young men to pieces; and they shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb; their eye shall not spare children.

entries.yo: Ati Babiloni, ogo ijọba gbogbo, ẹwà ogo Kaldea, yio dabi igbati Ọlọrun bi Sodomu on Gomorra ṣubu.
entries.en: And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beauty of the Chaldees' excellency, shall be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.

entries.yo: A kì yio tẹ̀ ẹ dó mọ, bẹ̃ni a kì yio si gbe ibẹ̀ mọ lati irandiran: bẹ̃ni awọn ara Arabia kì yio pagọ nibẹ mọ; bẹ̃ni awọn oluṣọ-agutan kì yio kọ́ agbo wọn nibẹ mọ.
entries.en: It shall never be inhabited, neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation: neither shall the Arabian pitch tent there; neither shall the shepherds make their fold there.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹranko igbẹ yio dubulẹ nibẹ; ile wọn yio si kun fun òwiwí, abo ogòngo yio ma gbe ibẹ, ọ̀rọ̀ yio si ma jo nibẹ.
entries.en: But wild beasts of the desert shall lie there; and their houses shall be full of doleful creatures; and owls shall dwell there, and satyrs shall dance there.

entries.yo: Awọn ọ̀wawa yio si ma ke ninu ãfin wọn, ati dragoni ninu gbọ̀ngàn wọn daradara: ìgba rẹ̀ si sunmọ etile, a kì yio si fa ọjọ rẹ̀ gùn.
entries.en: And the wild beasts of the islands shall cry in their desolate houses, and dragons in their pleasant palaces: and her time is near to come, and her days shall not be prolonged.

entries.yo: NITORI Oluwa yio ṣãnu fun Jakobu, yio si tun yan Israeli, yio si mu wọn gbe ilẹ wọn; alejò yio si dapọ̀ mọ wọn, nwọn o si faramọ ile Jakobu.
entries.en: For the LORD will have mercy on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel, and set them in their own land: and the strangers shall be joined with them, and they shall cleave to the house of Jacob.

entries.yo: Awọn enia yio si mu wọn, nwọn o si mu wọn wá si ipò wọn: ile Israeli yio si ni wọn ni ilẹ Oluwa, fun iranṣẹkunrin ati iranṣẹbinrin: awọn ti o ti kó wọn ni igbekun ni nwọn o kó ni igbekun; nwọn o si ṣe akoso aninilara wọn.
entries.en: And the people shall take them, and bring them to their place: and the house of Israel shall possess them in the land of the LORD for servants and handmaids: and they shall take them captives, whose captives they were; and they shall rule over their oppressors.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe li ọjọ ti Oluwa yio fun ọ ni isimi kuro ninu ibanujẹ rẹ, ati kuro ninu ijaiya rẹ, ati kuro ninu oko-ẹru lile nibiti a ti mu ọ sìn,
entries.en: And it shall come to pass in the day that the LORD shall give thee rest from thy sorrow, and from thy fear, and from the hard bondage wherein thou wast made to serve,

entries.yo: Ni iwọ o si fi ọba Babiloni ṣẹ̀fẹ yi, ti iwọ o si wipe, Aninilara nì ha ti ṣe dakẹ! alọnilọwọgbà wura dakẹ!
entries.en: That thou shalt take up this proverb against the king of Babylon, and say, How hath the oppressor ceased! the golden city ceased!

entries.yo: Oluwa ti ṣẹ ọpá oluṣe-buburu, ati ọpá-alade awọn alakoso.
entries.en: The LORD hath broken the staff of the wicked, and the sceptre of the rulers.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o fi ibinu lù awọn enia lai dawọ duro, ẹniti o fi ibinu ṣe akoso awọn orilẹ-ède, li a nṣe inunibini si, lai dẹkun.
entries.en: He who smote the people in wrath with a continual stroke, he that ruled the nations in anger, is persecuted, and none hindereth.

entries.yo: Gbogbo aiye simi, nwọn si gbe jẹ: nwọn bú jade ninu orin kikọ.
entries.en: The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet: they break forth into singing.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ, igi firi nyọ̀ ọ, ati igi kedari ti Lebanoni, wipe, Lati ìgba ti iwọ ti dubulẹ, kò si akegi ti o tọ̀ wa wá.
entries.en: Yea, the fir trees rejoice at thee, and the cedars of Lebanon, saying, Since thou art laid down, no feller is come up against us.

entries.yo: Ipò-okú lati isalẹ wá mì fun ọ lati pade rẹ li àbọ rẹ: o rú awọn okú dide fun ọ, ani gbogbo awọn alakoso aiye; o ti gbe gbogbo ọba awọn orilẹ-ède dide kuro lori itẹ wọn.
entries.en: Hell from beneath is moved for thee to meet thee at thy coming: it stirreth up the dead for thee, even all the chief ones of the earth; it hath raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations.

entries.yo: Gbogbo wọn o dahùn, nwọn o si wi fun ọ pe, Iwọ pẹlu ti di ailera gẹgẹ bi awa? iwọ ha dabi awa?
entries.en: All they shall speak and say unto thee, Art thou also become weak as we? art thou become like unto us?

entries.yo: Ogo rẹ li ati sọ̀kalẹ si ipò-okú, ati ariwo durù rẹ: ekòlo ti tàn sabẹ rẹ, idin si bò ọ mọ ilẹ.
entries.en: Thy pomp is brought down to the grave, and the noise of thy viols: the worm is spread under thee, and the worms cover thee.

entries.yo: Bawo ni iwọ ti ṣe ṣubu lati ọrun wá, Iwọ Lusiferi, iràwọ owurọ! bawo li a ti ṣe ke ọ lu ilẹ, iwọ ti o ti ṣẹ́ awọn orilẹ-ède li apa!
entries.en: How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning! how art thou cut down to the ground, which didst weaken the nations!

entries.yo: Nitori iwọ ti wi li ọkàn rẹ pe, Emi o goke lọ si ọrun, emi o gbe itẹ mi ga kọja iràwọ Ọlọrun: emi o si joko lori oke ijọ enia ni iha ariwa:
entries.en: For thou hast said in thine heart, I will ascend into heaven, I will exalt my throne above the stars of God: I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation, in the sides of the north:

entries.yo: Emi o goke kọja giga awọsanma: emi o dabi ọga-ogo jùlọ.
entries.en: I will ascend above the heights of the clouds; I will be like the most High.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn a o mu ọ sọkalẹ si ipò okú, si iha ihò.
entries.en: Yet thou shalt be brought down to hell, to the sides of the pit.

entries.yo: Awọn ti o ri ọ yio tẹjumọ ọ, nwọn o si ronu rẹ pe, Eyi li ọkunrin na ti o mu aiye wárìrì, ti o mu ilẹ ọba mìtiti;
entries.en: They that see thee shall narrowly look upon thee, and consider thee, saying, Is this the man that made the earth to tremble, that did shake kingdoms;

entries.yo: Ti o sọ aiye dàbi agìnju, ti o si pa ilu rẹ̀ run; ti kò dá awọn ondè rẹ̀ silẹ lati lọ ile?
entries.en: That made the world as a wilderness, and destroyed the cities thereof; that opened not the house of his prisoners?

entries.yo: Gbogbo ọba awọn orilẹ-ède, ani gbogbo wọn, dubulẹ ninu ogo, olukuluku ninu ile rẹ̀.
entries.en: All the kings of the nations, even all of them, lie in glory, every one in his own house.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn iwọ li a gbe sọnù kuro nibi iboji rẹ bi ẹka irira, bi aṣọ awọn ti a pa, awọn ti a fi idà gun li agunyọ, ti nsọkalẹ lọ si ihò okuta; bi okú ti a tẹ̀ mọlẹ.
entries.en: But thou art cast out of thy grave like an abominable branch, and as the raiment of those that are slain, thrust through with a sword, that go down to the stones of the pit; as a carcase trodden under feet.

entries.yo: A kì o sin ọ pọ̀ pẹlu wọn, nitoriti iwọ ti pa ilẹ rẹ run, o si ti pa awọn enia rẹ: iru awọn oluṣe buburu li a kì o darukọ lailai.
entries.en: Thou shalt not be joined with them in burial, because thou hast destroyed thy land, and slain thy people: the seed of evildoers shall never be renowned.

entries.yo: Mura ibi pipa fun awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, nitori aiṣedẽde awọn baba wọn; ki nwọn ki o má ba dide, ki nwọn ni ilẹ na, ki nwọn má si fi ilu-nla kun oju aiye.
entries.en: Prepare slaughter for his children for the iniquity of their fathers; that they do not rise, nor possess the land, nor fill the face of the world with cities.

entries.yo: Nitori emi o dide si wọn, li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi; emi o si ke orukọ ati iyokù kuro ni Babiloni, ati ọmọ, ati ọmọ de ọmọ, ni Oluwa wi.
entries.en: For I will rise up against them, saith the LORD of hosts, and cut off from Babylon the name, and remnant, and son, and nephew, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Emi o si ṣe e ni ilẹ-ini fun õrẹ̀, ati àbata omi; emi o si fi ọwọ̀ iparun gbá a, li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi.
entries.en: I will also make it a possession for the bittern, and pools of water: and I will sweep it with the besom of destruction, saith the LORD of hosts.

entries.yo: Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun ti bura, wipe, Lõtọ gẹgẹ bi mo ti gberò, bẹ̃ni yio ri, ati gẹgẹ bi mo ti pinnu, bẹ̃ni yio si duro:
entries.en: The LORD of hosts hath sworn, saying, Surely as I have thought, so shall it come to pass; and as I have purposed, so shall it stand:

entries.yo: Pe, emi o fọ́ awọn ara Assiria ni ilẹ mi, ati lori oke mi li emi o tẹ̀ ẹ mọlẹ labẹ ẹsẹ: nigbana li ajàga rẹ̀ yio kuro lara wọn, ati ẹrù rẹ̀ kuro li ejiká wọn.
entries.en: That I will break the Assyrian in my land, and upon my mountains tread him under foot: then shall his yoke depart from off them, and his burden depart from off their shoulders.

entries.yo: Eyi ni ipinnu ti a pinnu lori gbogbo aiye: eyi si ni ọwọ́ ti a nà jade lori gbogbo orilẹ-ède.
entries.en: This is the purpose that is purposed upon the whole earth: and this is the hand that is stretched out upon all the nations.

entries.yo: Nitori Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun ti pinnu, tani yio si sọ ọ di asan? ọwọ́ rẹ̀ si nà jade, tani yio si dá a padà?
entries.en: For the LORD of hosts hath purposed, and who shall disannul it? and his hand is stretched out, and who shall turn it back?

entries.yo: Li ọdun ti Ahasi ọba kú, li ọ̀rọ-imọ yi wà.
entries.en: In the year that king Ahaz died was this burden.

entries.yo: Iwọ máṣe yọ̀, gbogbo Filistia, nitori paṣan ẹniti o nà ọ ṣẹ́; nitori lati inu gbòngbo ejo ni pãmọlẹ kan yio jade wá, irú rẹ̀ yio si jẹ́ ejò iná ti nfò.
entries.en: Rejoice not thou, whole Palestina, because the rod of him that smote thee is broken: for out of the serpent's root shall come forth a cockatrice, and his fruit shall be a fiery flying serpent.

entries.yo: Akọbi awọn otòṣi yio si jẹ, awọn alaini yio si dubulẹ lailewu; emi o si fi iyàn pa gbòngbo rẹ, on o si pa iyokù rẹ.
entries.en: And the firstborn of the poor shall feed, and the needy shall lie down in safety: and I will kill thy root with famine, and he shall slay thy remnant.

entries.yo: Hu, iwọ ẹnu-odi; kigbe, iwọ ilu; gbogbo Palestina, iwọ ti di yiyọ́: nitori ẹ̃fin yio ti ariwa jade wá, ẹnikan kì yio si yà ara rẹ̀ kuro lọdọ ẹgbẹ́ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Howl, O gate; cry, O city; thou, whole Palestina, art dissolved: for there shall come from the north a smoke, and none shall be alone in his appointed times.

entries.yo: Èsi wo li a o fi fun awọn ikọ̀ orilẹ-ède? Pe, Oluwa ti tẹ̀ Sioni dó, talaka ninu awọn enia rẹ̀ yio si sá wọ̀ inu rẹ̀.
entries.en: What shall one then answer the messengers of the nation? That the LORD hath founded Zion, and the poor of his people shall trust in it.

entries.yo: ỌRỌ-imọ̀ niti Moabu. Nitori li oru li a sọ Ari ti Moabu di ahoro, a si mu u dakẹ; nitori li oru li a sọ Kiri ti Moabu di ahoro, a si mu u dakẹ;
entries.en: The burden of Moab. Because in the night Ar of Moab is laid waste, and brought to silence; because in the night Kir of Moab is laid waste, and brought to silence;

entries.yo: On ti goke lọ si Bajiti, ati si Diboni, ibi giga wọnni, lati sọkun: Moabu yio hu lori Nebo, ati lori Medeba: gbogbo ori wọn ni yio pá, irungbọ̀n olukulùku li a o fá.
entries.en: He is gone up to Bajith, and to Dibon, the high places, to weep: Moab shall howl over Nebo, and over Medeba: on all their heads shall be baldness, and every beard cut off.

entries.yo: Ni igboro ni wọn o da aṣọ-ọ̀fọ bò ara wọn: lori okè ilé wọn, ati ni igboro wọn, olukuluku yio hu, yio si ma sọkun pẹ̀rẹpẹ̀rẹ.
entries.en: In their streets they shall gird themselves with sackcloth: on the tops of their houses, and in their streets, every one shall howl, weeping abundantly.

entries.yo: Heṣboni yio si kigbe, ati Eleale: a o si gbọ́ ohùn wọn titi dé Jahasi: nitorina ni awọn ọmọ-ogun Moabu ti o hamọra yio kigbe soke; ọkàn rẹ̀ yio bajẹ fun ara rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Heshbon shall cry, and Elealeh: their voice shall be heard even unto Jahaz: therefore the armed soldiers of Moab shall cry out; his life shall be grievous unto him.

entries.yo: Ọkàn mi kigbe soke fun Moabu; awọn ìsánsá rẹ̀ sá de Soari, abo-malũ ọlọdun mẹta: ni gigun oke Luhiti tẹkúntẹkún ni nwọn o ma fi gùn u lọ; niti ọ̀na Horonaimu nwọn o gbe ohùn iparun soke.
entries.en: My heart shall cry out for Moab; his fugitives shall flee unto Zoar, an heifer of three years old: for by the mounting up of Luhith with weeping shall they go it up; for in the way of Horonaim they shall raise up a cry of destruction.

entries.yo: Nitori awọn omi Nimrimu yio di ahoro: nitori koriko nrọgbẹ, eweko nkú lọ, ohun tutù kan kò si.
entries.en: For the waters of Nimrim shall be desolate: for the hay is withered away, the grass faileth, there is no green thing.

entries.yo: Nitorina ọ̀pọ eyi ti nwọn ti ni, ati eyi ti nwọn ti kojọ, ni nwọn o gbe kọja odò willo.
entries.en: Therefore the abundance they have gotten, and that which they have laid up, shall they carry away to the brook of the willows.

entries.yo: Nitori igbe na ti yi agbegbè Moabu ka; igbe na si de Eglaimu, ati igbe na de Beerelimu.
entries.en: For the cry is gone round about the borders of Moab; the howling thereof unto Eglaim, and the howling thereof unto Beer-elim.

entries.yo: Nitori odò Dimoni yio kún fun ẹ̀jẹ: nitori emi o fi ibi miran sori Dimoni, emi o mu kiniun wá sori ẹniti ó sálà kuro ni Moabu, ati lori awọn ti o kù ni ilẹ na.
entries.en: For the waters of Dimon shall be full of blood: for I will bring more upon Dimon, lions upon him that escapeth of Moab, and upon the remnant of the land.

entries.yo: Ẹ rán ọdọ-agutan si alakoso ilẹ lati Sela wá si aginju, si oke ọmọbinrin Sioni.
entries.en: Send ye the lamb to the ruler of the land from Sela to the wilderness, unto the mount of the daughter of Zion.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, bi alarinkiri ẹiyẹ ti a le jade kuro ninu itẹ́-ẹiyẹ, bẹ̃ni ọmọbinrin Moabu yio ri ni iwọdò Arnoni.
entries.en: For it shall be, that, as a wandering bird cast out of the nest, so the daughters of Moab shall be at the fords of Arnon.

entries.yo: Ẹ gbìmọ, ẹ mu idajọ ṣẹ; ṣe ojiji rẹ bi oru li ãrin ọsángangan; pa awọn ti a le jade mọ́; máṣe fi isánsa hàn.
entries.en: Take counsel, execute judgment; make thy shadow as the night in the midst of the noonday; hide the outcasts; bewray not him that wandereth.

entries.yo: Moabu, jẹ ki awọn isánsa mi ba ọ gbe, iwọ ma jẹ ãbo fun wọn li oju akoni: nitori alọnilọwọgbà de opin, akoni dasẹ̀, a pa awọn aninilara run kuro lori ilẹ.
entries.en: Let mine outcasts dwell with thee, Moab; be thou a covert to them from the face of the spoiler: for the extortioner is at an end, the spoiler ceaseth, the oppressors are consumed out of the land.

entries.yo: Ninu ãnu li a o si fi idi ilẹ mulẹ: yio si joko lori rẹ̀ li otitọ ninu agọ Dafidi, yio ma ṣe idajọ, yio si ma wá idajọ, yio si ma mu ododo yara kánkán.
entries.en: And in mercy shall the throne be established: and he shall sit upon it in truth in the tabernacle of David, judging, and seeking judgment, and hasting righteousness.

entries.yo: Awa ti gbọ́ ti igberaga Moabu; o gberaga pọju: ani ti irera rẹ̀, ati igberaga rẹ̀, ati ibinu rẹ̀; ihalẹ rẹ̀ asan ni.
entries.en: We have heard of the pride of Moab; he is very proud: even of his haughtiness, and his pride, and his wrath: but his lies shall not be so.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni Moabu yio hu fun Moabu, gbogbo wọn o hu: nitori ipilẹ Kir-haresi li ẹnyin o gbàwẹ; nitõtọ a lù wọn.
entries.en: Therefore shall Moab howl for Moab, every one shall howl: for the foundations of Kir-hareseth shall ye mourn; surely they are stricken.

entries.yo: Nitori igbẹ́ Heṣboni rọ, ati àjara Sibma: awọn oluwa awọn keferi ti ke pataki ọ̀gbin rẹ̀ lu ilẹ, nwọn tàn de Jaseri, nwọn nrìn kakiri aginjù: ẹka rẹ̀ nà jade, nwọn kọja okun.
entries.en: For the fields of Heshbon languish, and the vine of Sibmah: the lords of the heathen have broken down the principal plants thereof, they are come even unto Jazer, they wandered through the wilderness: her branches are stretched out, they are gone over the sea.

entries.yo: Nitorina emi o pohùnrére ẹkun, bi ẹkun Jaseri, àjara Sibma: emi o fi omije mi rin ọ, iwọ Heṣboni, ati Eleale: nitori ariwo nla ta lori èso-igi ẹ̃rùn rẹ, ati lori ikore rẹ.
entries.en: Therefore I will bewail with the weeping of Jazer the vine of Sibmah: I will water thee with my tears, O Heshbon, and Elealeh: for the shouting for thy summer fruits and for thy harvest is fallen.

entries.yo: A si mu inu-didun kuro, ati ayọ̀ kuro ninu oko ti nso eso ọ̀pọlọpọ; orin kì yio si si mọ ninu ọgbà-àjara, bẹ̃ni kì yio si ihó-ayọ̀ mọ: afọnti kì yio fọn ọti-waini mọ ninu ifọnti wọn, emi ti mu ariwo dá.
entries.en: And gladness is taken away, and joy out of the plentiful field; and in the vineyards there shall be no singing, neither shall there be shouting: the treaders shall tread out no wine in their presses; I have made their vintage shouting to cease.

entries.yo: Nitorina inu mi yio dún bi harpu fun Moabu, ati ọkàn mi fun Kir-haresi.
entries.en: Wherefore my bowels shall sound like an harp for Moab, and mine inward parts for Kir-haresh.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, nigbati a ba ri pe ãrẹ̀ mú Moabu ni ibi giga, ni yio wá si ibi-mimọ́ rẹ̀ lati gbadura; ṣugbọn kì yio bori.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass, when it is seen that Moab is weary on the high place, that he shall come to his sanctuary to pray; but he shall not prevail.

entries.yo: Eyi li ọ̀rọ ti Oluwa ti sọ niti Moabu lati igbà na wá.
entries.en: This is the word that the LORD hath spoken concerning Moab since that time.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nisisiyi Oluwa ti sọ̀rọ, wipe, Niwọn ọdun mẹta, gẹgẹ bi ọdun alagbaṣe, a o si kẹgàn ogo Moabu, pẹlu gbogbo ọ̀pọlọpọ nì: awọn iyokù yio kere, kì yio si li agbara.
entries.en: But now the LORD hath spoken, saying, Within three years, as the years of an hireling, and the glory of Moab shall be contemned, with all that great multitude; and the remnant shall be very small and feeble.

entries.yo: Ọ̀RỌ-ìmọ niti Damasku. Kiye si i, a mu Damasku kuro lati ma jẹ ilu, yi o si di òkiti àlapa.
entries.en: The burden of Damascus. Behold, Damascus is taken away from being a city, and it shall be a ruinous heap.

entries.yo: A kọ̀ gbogbo ilu Aroeri silẹ: nwọn o jẹ ti ọ̀wọ-ẹran, ti yio dubulẹ, ẹnikẹni kì yio dẹrubà wọn.
entries.en: The cities of Aroer are forsaken: they shall be for flocks, which shall lie down, and none shall make them afraid.

entries.yo: Odi kì yio si si mọ ni Efraimu, ati ijọba ni Damasku, ati iyokù ti Siria: nwọn o dabi ogo awọn ọmọ Israeli, li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi.
entries.en: The fortress also shall cease from Ephraim, and the kingdom from Damascus, and the remnant of Syria: they shall be as the glory of the children of Israel, saith the LORD of hosts.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ na yio si ṣe, a o mu ogo Jakobu dinkù, ati sisanra ara rẹ̀ li a o sọ di rirù.
entries.en: And in that day it shall come to pass, that the glory of Jacob shall be made thin, and the fatness of his flesh shall wax lean.

entries.yo: Yio si dabi igbati olukorè nkó agbado jọ, ti o si nfi apá rẹ̀ rẹ́ ipẹ́-ọkà yio si dabi ẹniti nkó ipẹ́-ọkà jọ ni afonifoji Refaimu.
entries.en: And it shall be as when the harvestman gathereth the corn, and reapeth the ears with his arm; and it shall be as he that gathereth ears in the valley of Rephaim.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẽṣẹ́ eso-àjara yio hù ninu rẹ̀, gẹgẹ bi mimì igi olifi, eso kekere meji bi mẹta ni ṣonṣo oke ẹka mẹrin bi marun ni ẹka ode ti o ni eso pupọ, li Oluwa Ọlọrun Israeli wi.
entries.en: Yet gleaning grapes shall be left in it, as the shaking of an olive tree, two or three berries in the top of the uppermost bough, four or five in the outmost fruitful branches thereof, saith the LORD God of Israel.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ na li ẹnikan yio wò Ẹlẹda rẹ̀, ati oju rẹ̀ yio si bọ̀wọ fun Ẹni-Mimọ Israeli.
entries.en: At that day shall a man look to his Maker, and his eyes shall have respect to the Holy One of Israel.

entries.yo: On kì yio si wò pẹpẹ, iṣẹ ọwọ́ rẹ̀, bẹ̃ni kì yio si bọ̀wọ fun eyi ti ika rẹ̀ ti ṣe, yala igbo-òriṣa tabi ere-õrun.
entries.en: And he shall not look to the altars, the work of his hands, neither shall respect that which his fingers have made, either the groves, or the images.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ na ni ilu alagbara rẹ̀ yio dabi ẹka ìkọsilẹ, ati ẹka tente oke ti nwọn fi silẹ nitori awọn ọmọ Israeli: iparun yio si wà.
entries.en: In that day shall his strong cities be as a forsaken bough, and an uppermost branch, which they left because of the children of Israel: and there shall be desolation.

entries.yo: Nitori iwọ ti gbagbe Ọlọrun igbala rẹ, ti iwọ kò si nani apata agbára rẹ, nitorina ni iwọ ti gbìn ọ̀gbin daradara, iwọ si tọ́ àjeji ẹka sinu rẹ̀.
entries.en: Because thou hast forgotten the God of thy salvation, and hast not been mindful of the rock of thy strength, therefore shalt thou plant pleasant plants, and shalt set it with strange slips:

entries.yo: Li ọjọ na ni iwọ o mu ki ọ̀gbin rẹ dàgba, ati li owurọ ni iwọ o mu ki irugbin rẹ rú: ṣugbọn a o mu ikorè lọ li ọjọ ini, ikãnu kikoro yio si wà.
entries.en: In the day shalt thou make thy plant to grow, and in the morning shalt thou make thy seed to flourish: but the harvest shall be a heap in the day of grief and of desperate sorrow.

entries.yo: Egbé ni fun ariwo ọ̀pọ enia, ti o pa ariwo bi ariwo okun; ati fun irọ́ awọn orilẹ-ède, ti nwọn rọ bi rirọ́ omi pupọ̀!
entries.en: Woe to the multitude of many people, which make a noise like the noise of the seas; and to the rushing of nations, that make a rushing like the rushing of mighty waters!

entries.yo: Awọn orilẹ-ède yio rọ́ bi rirọ́ omi pupọ: ṣugbọn Ọlọrun yio bá wọn wi, nwọn si sa jina rere, a o si lepa wọn gẹgẹ bi ìyangbo oke-nla niwaju ẹfũfu, ati gẹgẹ bi ohun yiyi niwaju ãjà.
entries.en: The nations shall rush like the rushing of many waters: but God shall rebuke them, and they shall flee far off, and shall be chased as the chaff of the mountains before the wind, and like a rolling thing before the whirlwind.

entries.yo: Si kiye si i, li aṣalẹ, iyọnu; ki ilẹ to mọ́ on kò si. Eyi ni ipín awọn ti o kó wa, ati ipín awọn ti o jà wa li olè.
entries.en: And behold at eveningtide trouble; and before the morning he is not. This is the portion of them that spoil us, and the lot of them that rob us.

entries.yo: EGBE ni fun ilẹ ti o ni ojiji apá meji, ti o wà ni ikọja odò Etiopia:
entries.en: Woe to the land shadowing with wings, which is beyond the rivers of Ethiopia:

entries.yo: Ti o rán awọn ikọ̀ li ọ̀na okun, ani ninu ọkọ̀ koriko odò, li oju odò, wipe, Lọ, ẹnyin onṣẹ ti o yara kánkan, si orilẹ-ède ti a nà ká ti a si tẹju, si enia ti o ni ibẹ̀ru lati igbayi ati titi lọ; orilẹ-ède ti o ni ipá, ti o si tẹ̀ ni mọlẹ, ilẹ ẹniti odò pupọ̀ pinyà!
entries.en: That sendeth ambassadors by the sea, even in vessels of bulrushes upon the waters, saying, Go, ye swift messengers, to a nation scattered and peeled, to a people terrible from their beginning hitherto; a nation meted out and trodden down, whose land the rivers have spoiled!

entries.yo: Gbogbo ẹnyin ti ngbe aiye, ati olugbé aiye, ẹ wò, nigbati on gbe ọpagun sori awọn oke giga; ati nigbati on fọn ipè, ẹ gbọ́.
entries.en: All ye inhabitants of the world, and dwellers on the earth, see ye, when he lifteth up an ensign on the mountains; and when he bloweth a trumpet, hear ye.

entries.yo: Nitori bẹ̃li Oluwa sọ fun mi, emi o simi, emi o si gbèro ninu ibugbé mi, bi oru ọsángangan, ati bi awọsanma ìri, ninu oru ikorè.
entries.en: For so the LORD said unto me, I will take my rest, and I will consider in my dwelling place like a clear heat upon herbs, and like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest.

entries.yo: Nitori ṣaju ikorè, nigbati ìrudi ba kún, ti itanná ba di eso-àjara pipọn on o fi dojé rẹ́ ẹka-titun, yio si mu kuro, yio si ke ẹka lu ilẹ.
entries.en: For afore the harvest, when the bud is perfect, and the sour grape is ripening in the flower, he shall both cut off the sprigs with pruning hooks, and take away and cut down the branches.

entries.yo: A o si fi wọn silẹ fun awọn ẹiyẹ oke-nla, ati fun awọn ẹranko aiye: awọn ẹiyẹ yio yá õrùn lori wọn, gbogbo awọn ẹranko aiye yio si potutù lori wọn.
entries.en: They shall be left together unto the fowls of the mountains, and to the beasts of the earth: and the fowls shall summer upon them, and all the beasts of the earth shall winter upon them.

entries.yo: Li akoko na ni a o mu ọrẹ wá fun Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun lati ọdọ awọn enia ti a nà ka, ti a si tẹju, ati enia ti o ni ibẹ̀ru lati igbayi ati titi lọ; orilẹ-ède ti o ni ipá ti o tẹ̀ ni mọlẹ, ilẹ ẹniti odò pupọ̀ pinyà, si ibi orukọ Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun, oke giga Sioni.
entries.en: In that time shall the present be brought unto the LORD of hosts of a people scattered and peeled, and from a people terrible from their beginning hitherto; a nation meted out and trodden under foot, whose land the rivers have spoiled, to the place of the name of the LORD of hosts, the mount Zion.

entries.yo: Ọ̀RỌ-ìmọ niti Egipti. Kiyesi i, Oluwa ngùn awọsanma ti o yara, yio si wá si Egipti: a o si ṣi ipò awọn òriṣa Egipti pàda niwaju rẹ̀, aiya Egipti yio yọ́ li ãrin rẹ̀.
entries.en: The burden of Egypt. Behold, the LORD rideth upon a swift cloud, and shall come into Egypt: and the idols of Egypt shall be moved at his presence, and the heart of Egypt shall melt in the midst of it.

entries.yo: Emi o si gbe Egipti dide si Egipti: olukuluku yio si ba arakunrin rẹ̀ jà, ati olukuluku aladugbò rẹ̀; ilu yio dojukọ ilu, ati ijọba yio dojukọ ijọba.
entries.en: And I will set the Egyptians against the Egyptians: and they shall fight every one against his brother, and every one against his neighbour; city against city, and kingdom against kingdom.

entries.yo: Ẹmi Egipti yio si rẹ̀wẹsi lãrin inu rẹ̀; emi o si pa ìmọ inu rẹ̀ run: nwọn o si wá a tọ̀ òriṣa lọ, ati sọdọ awọn atuju, ati sọdọ awọn ajẹ́, ati sọdọ awọn oṣó;
entries.en: And the spirit of Egypt shall fail in the midst thereof; and I will destroy the counsel thereof: and they shall seek to the idols, and to the charmers, and to them that have familiar spirits, and to the wizards.

entries.yo: Oluwa, Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wipe, Awọn ara Egipti li emi o fi le oluwa onrorò li ọwọ́; ọba ti o muna yio ṣe akoso wọn.
entries.en: And the Egyptians will I give over into the hand of a cruel lord; and a fierce king shall rule over them, saith the Lord, the LORD of hosts.

entries.yo: Omi yio si buṣe li okun, a o si fi odò ṣofo, yio si gbẹ.
entries.en: And the waters shall fail from the sea, and the river shall be wasted and dried up.

entries.yo: Odò yio si di rirùn; odò ãbo li a o sọ di ofo, ti a o si gbọ́n gbẹ; oko-odò ati iyè yio rọ.
entries.en: And they shall turn the rivers far away; and the brooks of defence shall be emptied and dried up: the reeds and flags shall wither.

entries.yo: Oko-tutù ni ipadò, li ẹnu odò, ati ohun gbogbo ti a gbìn sipadò, ni yio rọ, yio funka, kì yio si si mọ.
entries.en: The paper reeds by the brooks, by the mouth of the brooks, and every thing sown by the brooks, shall wither, be driven away, and be no more.

entries.yo: Awọn apẹja yio gbàwẹ pẹlu, ati gbogbo awọn ti nfì ìwọ li odò yio pohùnrére-ẹkun; ati awọn ti nda àwọn li odò yio sorikọ́.
entries.en: The fishers also shall mourn, and all they that cast angle into the brooks shall lament, and they that spread nets upon the waters shall languish.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu awọn ti nṣiṣẹ ọ̀gbọ daradara, ati awọn ti nwun asọ-àla yio dãmu.
entries.en: Moreover they that work in fine flax, and they that weave networks, shall be confounded.

entries.yo: A o si fọ́ wọn ni ipilẹ rẹ̀, gbogbo awọn alagbàṣe li a o bà ni inu jẹ.
entries.en: And they shall be broken in the purposes thereof, all that make sluices and ponds for fish.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ òpe ni awọn ọmọ-alade Soani, ìmọ awọn ìgbimọ ọlọgbọn Farao di wère: ẹ ha ti ṣe sọ fun Farao, pe, Emi li ọmọ ọlọgbọn, ọmọ awọn ọba igbãni?
entries.en: Surely the princes of Zoan are fools, the counsel of the wise counsellers of Pharaoh is become brutish: how say ye unto Pharaoh, I am the son of the wise, the son of ancient kings?

entries.yo: Awọn dà? awọn ọlọgbọn rẹ dà? si jẹ ki wọn sọ fun ọ nisisiyi, si jẹ ki wọn mọ̀ ete ti Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun ti pa le Egipti.
entries.en: Where are they? where are thy wise men? and let them tell thee now, and let them know what the LORD of hosts hath purposed upon Egypt.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ-alade Soani di aṣiwère, a tàn awọn ọmọ-alade Nofi jẹ; ani awọn ti iṣe pataki ẹyà rẹ̀.
entries.en: The princes of Zoan are become fools, the princes of Noph are deceived; they have also seduced Egypt, even they that are the stay of the tribes thereof.

entries.yo: Oluwa ti mí ẽmi iyapa si inu rẹ̀ na: nwọn si ti mu Egipti ṣina ninu gbogbo iṣẹ inu rẹ̀, gẹgẹ bi ọ̀muti enia ti nta gbọngbọ́n ninu ẽbi rẹ̀.
entries.en: The LORD hath mingled a perverse spirit in the midst thereof: and they have caused Egypt to err in every work thereof, as a drunken man staggereth in his vomit.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni kì yio si iṣẹkiṣẹ́ fun Egipti, ti ori tabi ìru, ẹka tabi oko-odò, le ṣe.
entries.en: Neither shall there be any work for Egypt, which the head or tail, branch or rush, may do.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ na ni Egipti yio dabi obinrin; yio si warìri, ẹ̀ru yio si bà a nitori mimì ọwọ́ Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun ti o mì le e lori.
entries.en: In that day shall Egypt be like unto women: and it shall be afraid and fear because of the shaking of the hand of the LORD of hosts, which he shaketh over it.

entries.yo: Ilẹ Juda yio si di ẹ̀ru fun Egipti, olukuluku ẹniti o dá a sọ ninu rẹ̀ yio tikararẹ̀ bẹ̀ru, nitori ìmọ Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun, ti o ti gbà si i.
entries.en: And the land of Judah shall be a terror unto Egypt, every one that maketh mention thereof shall be afraid in himself, because of the counsel of the LORD of hosts, which he hath determined against it.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ na ni ilu marun ni ilẹ Egipti yio fọ̀ ède Kenaani, ti nwọn o sì bura si Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun; a o ma pè ọkan ni Ilu ìparun.
entries.en: In that day shall five cities in the land of Egypt speak the language of Canaan, and swear to the LORD of hosts; one shall be called, The city of destruction.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ na ni pẹpẹ kan yio wà fun Oluwa li ãrin ilẹ Egipti, ati ọwọ̀n ni àgbegbe inu rẹ̀ fun Oluwa.
entries.en: In that day shall there be an altar to the LORD in the midst of the land of Egypt, and a pillar at the border thereof to the LORD.

entries.yo: Yio si jẹ fun ami, ati fun ẹ̀ri si Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun ni ilẹ Egipti: nitori nwọn o kigbe pè Oluwa nitori awọn aninilara, yio si rán olugbala kan si i, ati ẹni-nla, on o si gbà wọn.
entries.en: And it shall be for a sign and for a witness unto the LORD of hosts in the land of Egypt: for they shall cry unto the LORD because of the oppressors, and he shall send them a saviour, and a great one, and he shall deliver them.

entries.yo: Oluwa yio si di mimọ̀ fun Egipti, awọn ara Egipti yio so mọ́ Oluwa li ọjọ na, nwọn o si rú ẹbọ, nwọn o si ta ọrẹ; nitõtọ nwọn o jẹ'jẹ fun Oluwa, nwọn o si mu u ṣẹ.
entries.en: And the LORD shall be known to Egypt, and the Egyptians shall know the LORD in that day, and shall do sacrifice and oblation; yea, they shall vow a vow unto the LORD, and perform it.

entries.yo: Oluwa o si lù Egipti bolẹ, yio si mu u li ara da: nwọn o si yipada si Oluwa, on o si gbọ́ ẹ̀bẹ wọn, yio si mu wọn li ara da.
entries.en: And the LORD shall smite Egypt: he shall smite and heal it: and they shall return even to the LORD, and he shall be intreated of them, and shall heal them.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ na ni opopo kan yio wà lati Egipti de Assiria, awọn ara Assiria yio si wá si Egipti, awọn ara Egipti si Assiria, awọn ara Egipti yio si sìn pẹlu awọn ara Assiria.
entries.en: In that day shall there be a highway out of Egypt to Assyria, and the Assyrian shall come into Egypt, and the Egyptian into Assyria, and the Egyptians shall serve with the Assyrians.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ na ni Israeli yio jẹ ẹkẹta pẹlu Egipti ati pẹlu Assiria, ani ibukún li ãrin ilẹ na:
entries.en: In that day shall Israel be the third with Egypt and with Assyria, even a blessing in the midst of the land:

entries.yo: Ti Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun yio bukún fun, wipe, Ibukun ni fun Egipti enia mi, ati fun Assiria iṣẹ ọwọ́ mi, ati fun Israeli ini mi.
entries.en: Whom the LORD of hosts shall bless, saying, Blessed be Egypt my people, and Assyria the work of my hands, and Israel mine inheritance.

entries.yo: LI ọdun ti Tartani wá si Aṣdodi, (nigbati Sargoni ọba Assiria rán a,) ti o si ba Aṣdodi jà, ti o si kó o;
entries.en: In the year that Tartan came unto Ashdod, (when Sargon the king of Assyria sent him,) and fought against Ashdod, and took it;

entries.yo: Li akoko na li Oluwa wi nipa Isaiah ọmọ Amosi, pe, Lọ, bọ aṣọ-ọ̀fọ kuro li ẹgbẹ́ rẹ, si bọ́ bàta rẹ kuro li ẹsẹ rẹ. O si ṣe bẹ̃, o nrin nihòho ati laibọ̀ bàta.
entries.en: At the same time spake the LORD by Isaiah the son of Amoz, saying, Go and loose the sackcloth from off thy loins, and put off thy shoe from thy foot. And he did so, walking naked and barefoot.

entries.yo: Oluwa si wipe, Gẹgẹ bi Isaiah iranṣẹ mi ti rìn nihòho ati laibọ̀ bàta li ọdun mẹta fun ami ati iyanu lori Egipti ati lori Etiopia;
entries.en: And the LORD said, Like as my servant Isaiah hath walked naked and barefoot three years for a sign and wonder upon Egypt and upon Ethiopia;

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li ọba Assiria yio kó awọn ara Egipti ni igbèkun ati awọn ara Etiopia ni igbèkun, ọmọde ati arugbo, nihòho ati laibọ̀ bàta, ani ti awọn ti idí wọn nihòho, si itiju Egipti.
entries.en: So shall the king of Assyria lead away the Egyptians prisoners, and the Ethiopians captives, young and old, naked and barefoot, even with their buttocks uncovered, to the shame of Egypt.

entries.yo: Ẹ̀ru yio si bà wọn, oju o si tì wọn fun Etiopia ireti wọn, ati fun Egipti ogo wọn.
entries.en: And they shall be afraid and ashamed of Ethiopia their expectation, and of Egypt their glory.

entries.yo: Awọn olugbé àgbegbe okun yio si wi li ọjọ na pe, Kiyesi i, iru eyi ni ireti wa, nibiti awa salọ fun iranlọwọ ki a ba le gbani là kuro li ọwọ́ ọba Assiria: ati bawo li a o si ṣe salà?
entries.en: And the inhabitant of this isle shall say in that day, Behold, such is our expectation, whither we flee for help to be delivered from the king of Assyria: and how shall we escape?

entries.yo: Ọ̀RỌ-ìmọ niti ijù okun. Gẹgẹ bi ãja gusù ti ikọja lọ; bẹ̃ni o ti ijù wá, lati ilẹ ti o li ẹ̀ru.
entries.en: The burden of the desert of the sea. As whirlwinds in the south pass through; so it cometh from the desert, from a terrible land.

entries.yo: Iran lile li a fi hàn mi; ọ̀dalẹ dalẹ, akoni si nkoni. Goke lọ, iwọ Elamu: dotì, iwọ Media; gbogbo ìmí-ẹ̀dùn inu rẹ̀ li emi ti mu da.
entries.en: A grievous vision is declared unto me; the treacherous dealer dealeth treacherously, and the spoiler spoileth. Go up, O Elam: besiege, O Media; all the sighing thereof have I made to cease.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni ẹgbẹ́ mi ṣe kun fun irora: irora si ti dì mi mu, gẹgẹ bi irora obinrin ti nrọbi: emi tẹ̀ ba nigbati emi gbọ́ ọ: emi dãmu nigbati emi ri i.
entries.en: Therefore are my loins filled with pain: pangs have taken hold upon me, as the pangs of a woman that travaileth: I was bowed down at the hearing of it; I was dismayed at the seeing of it.

entries.yo: Ọkàn mi nrò, ẹ̀ru dẹrùba mi: oru ayọ̀ mi li o ti sọ di ìbẹru fun mi.
entries.en: My heart panted, fearfulness affrighted me: the night of my pleasure hath he turned into fear unto me.

entries.yo: Pèse tabili silẹ, yàn alore, jẹ, mu: dide, ẹnyin ọmọ-alade, ẹ kùn asà nyin.
entries.en: Prepare the table, watch in the watchtower, eat, drink: arise, ye princes, and anoint the shield.

entries.yo: Nitori bayi li Oluwa ti sọ fun mi, Lọ, fi ẹnikan ṣọ ọ̀na, jẹ ki o sọ ohun ti o ri.
entries.en: For thus hath the Lord said unto me, Go, set a watchman, let him declare what he seeth.

entries.yo: O si ri kẹkẹ́ pẹlu ẹlẹṣin meji-meji, kẹkẹ́ kẹtẹkẹtẹ, kẹkẹ́ ibakasiẹ; o si farabalẹ̀ tẹtilelẹ gidigidi:
entries.en: And he saw a chariot with a couple of horsemen, a chariot of asses, and a chariot of camels; and he hearkened diligently with much heed:

entries.yo: On si kigbe pe, kiniun kan: Oluwa mi, nigbagbogbo li emi nduro lori ile-iṣọ li ọsan, a si fi mi si iṣọ mi ni gbogbo oru:
entries.en: And he cried, A lion: My lord, I stand continually upon the watchtower in the daytime, and I am set in my ward whole nights:

entries.yo: Si kiyesi i, kẹkẹ́ enia kan ni mbọ̀ wá yi, pẹlu ẹlẹṣin meji-meji. On si dahun, o si wipe, Babiloni ṣubu, o ṣubu; ati gbogbo ere fifin òriṣa rẹ̀ li o wó mọlẹ.
entries.en: And, behold, here cometh a chariot of men, with a couple of horsemen. And he answered and said, Babylon is fallen, is fallen; and all the graven images of her gods he hath broken unto the ground.

entries.yo: Iwọ ìpaka mi, ati ọkà ilẹ ìpaka mi: eyi ti emi ti gbọ́ lọdọ Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ọgun, Ọlọrun Israeli li emi ti sọ fun ọ.
entries.en: O my threshing, and the corn of my floor: that which I have heard of the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, have I declared unto you.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ-ìmọ niti Duma. O ké si mi lati Seiri wá, Oluṣọ́, oru ti ri? Oluṣọ́ oru ti ri?
entries.en: The burden of Dumah. He calleth to me out of Seir, Watchman, what of the night? Watchman, what of the night?

entries.yo: Oluṣọ́ wipe, ilẹ nmọ́ bọ̀, alẹ si nlẹ pẹlu: bi ẹnyin o ba bere, ẹ bere: ẹ pada, ẹ wá.
entries.en: The watchman said, The morning cometh, and also the night: if ye will inquire, inquire ye: return, come.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ-ìmọ niti Arabia. Ninu igbó Arabia li ẹnyin o wọ̀, ẹnyin ẹgbẹ́-erò Dedanimu.
entries.en: The burden upon Arabia. In the forest in Arabia shall ye lodge, O ye travelling companies of Dedanim.

entries.yo: Awọn olugbé ilẹ Tema bù omi wá fun ẹniti ongbẹ ngbẹ, onjẹ wọn ni nwọn fi ṣaju ẹniti nsalọ.
entries.en: The inhabitants of the land of Tema brought water to him that was thirsty, they prevented with their bread him that fled.

entries.yo: Nitori nwọn nsá fun idà, fun idà fifayọ, ati fun ọrun kikàn, ati fun ibinujẹ ogun.
entries.en: For they fled from the swords, from the drawn sword, and from the bent bow, and from the grievousness of war.

entries.yo: Nitori bayi li Oluwa ti sọ fun mi, ki ọdun kan to pe, gẹgẹ bi ọdun alagbaṣe, gbogbo ogo Kedari yio wọ̀.
entries.en: For thus hath the Lord said unto me, Within a year, according to the years of an hireling, and all the glory of Kedar shall fail:

entries.yo: Iyokù ninu iye awọn tafàtafà, awọn alagbara ninu awọn ọmọ Kedari yio dinkù: nitori Oluwa Ọlọrun Israeli ti wi i.
entries.en: And the residue of the number of archers, the mighty men of the children of Kedar, shall be diminished: for the LORD God of Israel hath spoken it.

entries.yo: Ọ̀RỌ-ìmọ niti afonifoji ojuran. Kili o ṣe ọ nisisiyi, ti iwọ fi gùn ori ile lọ patapata?
entries.en: The burden of the valley of vision. What aileth thee now, that thou art wholly gone up to the housetops?

entries.yo: Iwọ ti o kún fun ìrukerudo, ilu aitòro, ilu ayọ̀: a kò fi idà pa awọn okú rẹ, bẹ̃ni nwọn kò kú li ogun.
entries.en: Thou that art full of stirs, a tumultuous city, a joyous city: thy slain men are not slain with the sword, nor dead in battle.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn alakoso rẹ ti jumọ sa lọ, awọn tafàtafà ti dì wọn ni igbekun: gbogbo awọn ti a ri ninu rẹ li a dì jọ, ti o ti sa lati okere wá.
entries.en: All thy rulers are fled together, they are bound by the archers: all that are found in thee are bound together, which have fled from far.

entries.yo: Nitorina li emi ṣe wipe, Mu oju kuro lara mi; emi o sọkun kikoro, má ṣe ãpọn lati tù mi ni inu, nitori iparun ti o ba ọmọbinrin enia mi.
entries.en: Therefore said I, Look away from me; I will weep bitterly, labour not to comfort me, because of the spoiling of the daughter of my people.

entries.yo: Nitori ọjọ wahála ni, ati itẹmọlẹ, ati idãmu, nipa Oluwa, Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun ni afonifoji ojuran, o nwó odi palẹ, o si nkigbe si oke-nla.
entries.en: For it is a day of trouble, and of treading down, and of perplexity by the Lord GOD of hosts in the valley of vision, breaking down the walls, and of crying to the mountains.

entries.yo: Elamu ru apó pẹlu kẹkẹ́ enia ati ẹlẹṣin, Kiri si na asà silẹ.
entries.en: And Elam bare the quiver with chariots of men and horsemen, and Kir uncovered the shield.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, afonifoji àṣayan rẹ yio kún fun kẹkẹ́, awọn ẹlẹṣin yio si tẹ́ ogun niha ẹnu odi.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass, that thy choicest valleys shall be full of chariots, and the horsemen shall set themselves in array at the gate.

entries.yo: On si ri iboju Juda, iwọ si wò li ọjọ na ihamọra ile igbó.
entries.en: And he discovered the covering of Judah, and thou didst look in that day to the armour of the house of the forest.
