entries.yo: Ẹnyin ti ri oju-iho ilu Dafidi pẹlu, pe, nwọn pọ̀: ẹnyin si gbá omi ikudu isalẹ jọ.
entries.en: Ye have seen also the breaches of the city of David, that they are many: and ye gathered together the waters of the lower pool.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin ti kà iye ile Jerusalemu, awọn ile na li ẹnyin biwó lati mu odi le.
entries.en: And ye have numbered the houses of Jerusalem, and the houses have ye broken down to fortify the wall.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin pẹlu ti wà yàra lãrin odi meji fun omi ikudu atijọ: ṣugbọn ẹnyin kò wò ẹniti o ṣe e, bẹ̃ni ẹ kò si buyìn fun ẹniti o ṣe e nigbãni,
entries.en: Ye made also a ditch between the two walls for the water of the old pool: but ye have not looked unto the maker thereof, neither had respect unto him that fashioned it long ago.

entries.yo: Ati li ọjọ na ni Oluwa, Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun yio pè lati sọkun, ati lati ṣọ̀fọ, ati lati fá ori, ati lati sán aṣọ ọ̀fọ.
entries.en: And in that day did the Lord GOD of hosts call to weeping, and to mourning, and to baldness, and to girding with sackcloth:

entries.yo: Si kiyesi i, ayọ̀ ati inu-didùn, pipa malũ, ati pipa agutan, jijẹ ẹran, ati mimu ọti-waini: ẹ jẹ ki a ma jẹ, ki a si ma mu; nitori ọla li awa o kú.
entries.en: And behold joy and gladness, slaying oxen, and killing sheep, eating flesh, and drinking wine: let us eat and drink; for to morrow we shall die.

entries.yo: Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun sọ li eti mi, pe, Nitõtọ, a kì yio fọ̀ aiṣedede yi kuro lara nyin titi ẹnyin o fi kú, li Oluwa, Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi.
entries.en: And it was revealed in mine ears by the LORD of hosts, Surely this iniquity shall not be purged from you till ye die, saith the Lord GOD of hosts.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa, Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi, pe, Lọ, tọ olutọju yi lọ, ani tọ Ṣebna lọ, ti iṣe olori ile,
entries.en: Thus saith the Lord GOD of hosts, Go, get thee unto this treasurer, even unto Shebna, which is over the house, and say,

entries.yo: Si wipe, Kili o ni nihin? ati tali o ni nihin, ti iwọ fi wà ibojì nihin bi ẹniti o wà ibojì fun ara rẹ̀ nibi giga, ti o si gbẹ́ ibugbé fun ara rẹ̀ ninu apáta?
entries.en: What hast thou here? and whom hast thou here, that thou hast hewed thee out a sepulchre here, as he that heweth him out a sepulchre on high, and that graveth an habitation for himself in a rock?

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, Oluwa yio fi sisọ agbara sọ ọ nù, yio si bò ọ mọlẹ.
entries.en: Behold, the LORD will carry thee away with a mighty captivity, and will surely cover thee.

entries.yo: Yio wé ọ li ewé bi ẹni wé lawàni bi ohun ṣiṣù ti a o fi sọ òko si ilẹ titobi: nibẹ ni iwọ o kú, ati nibẹ ni kẹkẹ́ ogo rẹ yio jẹ ìtiju ile oluwa rẹ.
entries.en: He will surely violently turn and toss thee like a ball into a large country: there shalt thou die, and there the chariots of thy glory shall be the shame of thy lord's house.

entries.yo: Emi o si le ọ jade kuro ni ibujoko rẹ, yio tilẹ wọ́ ọ kuro ni ipò rẹ.
entries.en: And I will drive thee from thy station, and from thy state shall he pull thee down.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe li ọjọ na, ni emi o pè Eliakimu iranṣẹ mi ọmọ Hilkiah.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will call my servant Eliakim the son of Hilkiah:

entries.yo: Emi o si fi aṣọ-igunwà rẹ wọ̀ ọ, emi o si fi àmure rẹ dì i, emi o si fi ijọba rẹ le e li ọwọ́: on o si jẹ baba fun awọn olugbé Jerusalemu, ati fun ile Juda.
entries.en: And I will clothe him with thy robe, and strengthen him with thy girdle, and I will commit thy government into his hand: and he shall be a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to the house of Judah.

entries.yo: Iṣikà ile Dafidi li emi o fi le èjiká rẹ̀: yio si ṣí, kò si ẹniti yio tì; on o si tì, kò si si ẹniti yio ṣí.
entries.en: And the key of the house of David will I lay upon his shoulder; so he shall open, and none shall shut; and he shall shut, and none shall open.

entries.yo: Emi o si kàn a bi iṣó ni ibi ti o le, on o jẹ fun itẹ ogo fun ile baba rẹ̀.
entries.en: And I will fasten him as a nail in a sure place; and he shall be for a glorious throne to his father's house.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ogo ile baba rẹ̀ ni nwọn o si fi kọ́ ọ li ọrùn, ati ọmọ ati eso, gbogbo ohun-elò ife titi de ago ọti.
entries.en: And they shall hang upon him all the glory of his father's house, the offspring and the issue, all vessels of small quantity, from the vessels of cups, even to all the vessels of flagons.

entries.yo: Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wipe, Li ọjọ na, ni a o ṣi iṣó ti a kàn mọ ibi ti o le ni ipò, a o si ke e lu ilẹ, yio si ṣubu; ẹrù ara rẹ̀ li a o ké kuro: nitori Oluwa ti sọ ọ.
entries.en: In that day, saith the LORD of hosts, shall the nail that is fastened in the sure place be removed, and be cut down, and fall; and the burden that was upon it shall be cut off: for the LORD hath spoken it.

entries.yo: Ọ̀RỌ-ìmọ niti Tire. Hu, ẹnyin ọkọ̀ Tarṣiṣi; nitoriti a o sọ ọ di ahoro, tobẹ̃ ti kò si ile, kò si ibi wiwọ̀: a fi hàn fun wọn lati ilẹ Kittimu.
entries.en: The burden of Tyre. Howl, ye ships of Tarshish; for it is laid waste, so that there is no house, no entering in: from the land of Chittim it is revealed to them.

entries.yo: Ẹ duro jẹ, ẹnyin olugbé erekùṣu; iwọ ẹniti awọn oniṣowo Sidoni, ti nre okun kọja ti kún.
entries.en: Be still, ye inhabitants of the isle; thou whom the merchants of Zidon, that pass over the sea, have replenished.

entries.yo: Ati nipa omi nla iru Sihori, ikorè odò, ni owo ọdun rẹ̀; on ni ọjà awọn orilẹ-ède.
entries.en: And by great waters the seed of Sihor, the harvest of the river, is her revenue; and she is a mart of nations.

entries.yo: Ki oju ki o tì ọ, Iwọ Sidoni: nitori okun ti sọ̀rọ, ani agbara okun, wipe, Emi kò rọbi, bẹ̃ni emi kò bi ọmọ, bẹ̃li emi kò tọ́ ọdọmọkunrin dàgba, bẹ̃ni emi kò tọ́ wundia dàgba.
entries.en: Be thou ashamed, O Zidon: for the sea hath spoken, even the strength of the sea, saying, I travail not, nor bring forth children, neither do I nourish up young men, nor bring up virgins.

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi ihìn niti Egipti, bẹ̃ni ara yio ro wọn goro ni ihìn Tire.
entries.en: As at the report concerning Egypt, so shall they be sorely pained at the report of Tyre.

entries.yo: Ẹ kọja si Tarṣiṣi; hu, ẹnyin olugbé erekùṣu.
entries.en: Pass ye over to Tarshish; howl, ye inhabitants of the isle.

entries.yo: Eyi ha ni ilu ayọ̀ fun nyin, ti o ti wà lati ọjọ jọjọ? ẹsẹ on tikara rẹ̀ yio rù u lọ si ọna jijìn rére lati ṣe atipó.
entries.en: Is this your joyous city, whose antiquity is of ancient days? her own feet shall carry her afar off to sojourn.

entries.yo: Tali o ti gbìmọ yi si Tire, ilu ade, awọn oniṣòwo ẹniti o jẹ ọmọ-alade, awọn alajapá ẹniti o jẹ ọlọla aiye?
entries.en: Who hath taken this counsel against Tyre, the crowning city, whose merchants are princes, whose traffickers are the honourable of the earth?

entries.yo: Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun ti pete rẹ̀, lati sọ irera gbogbo ogo di aimọ́, lati sọ gbogbo awọn ọlọla aiye di ẹ̀gan.
entries.en: The LORD of hosts hath purposed it, to stain the pride of all glory, and to bring into contempt all the honourable of the earth.

entries.yo: La ilẹ rẹ ja bi odò, iwọ ọmọbinrin Tarṣiṣi: àmure kò si mọ́.
entries.en: Pass through thy land as a river, O daughter of Tarshish: there is no more strength.

entries.yo: O nà ọwọ́ rẹ̀ jade si oju okun, o mì awọn ijọba: Oluwa ti pa aṣẹ niti Kenaani, lati run agbàra inu rẹ̀.
entries.en: He stretched out his hand over the sea, he shook the kingdoms: the LORD hath given a commandment against the merchant city, to destroy the strong holds thereof.

entries.yo: On si wipe, Iwọ kò gbọdọ yọ̀ mọ, iwọ wundia ti a ni lara, ọmọbinrin Sidoni; dide rekọja lọ si Kittimu, nibẹ pẹlu iwọ kì yio ri isimi.
entries.en: And he said, Thou shalt no more rejoice, O thou oppressed virgin, daughter of Zidon: arise, pass over to Chittim; there also shalt thou have no rest.

entries.yo: Wò ilẹ awọn ara Kaldea; awọn enia yi kò ti si ri, titi awọn ara Assiria tẹ̀ ẹ dó fun awọn ti ngbe aginju: nwọn kọ́ ile-iṣọ́ inu rẹ̀, nwọn si kọ́ ãfin inu rẹ̀; on si pa a run.
entries.en: Behold the land of the Chaldeans; this people was not, till the Assyrian founded it for them that dwell in the wilderness: they set up the towers thereof, they raised up the palaces thereof; and he brought it to ruin.

entries.yo: Hu, ẹnyin ọkọ̀ Tarṣiṣi: nitori a sọ agbara nyin di ahoro.
entries.en: Howl, ye ships of Tarshish: for your strength is laid waste.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe li ọjọ na, ni a o gbagbe Tire li ãdọrin ọdun, gẹgẹ bi ọjọ ọba kan: lẹhin ãdọrin ọdun ni Tire yio kọrin bi panṣaga obinrin.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Tyre shall be forgotten seventy years, according to the days of one king: after the end of seventy years shall Tyre sing as an harlot.

entries.yo: Mu harpu kan, kiri ilu lọ, iwọ panṣaga obinrin ti a ti gbagbe; dá orin didùn: kọ orin pupọ̀ ki a le ranti rẹ.
entries.en: Take an harp, go about the city, thou harlot that hast been forgotten; make sweet melody, sing many songs, that thou mayest be remembered.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe li ẹhìn ãdọrin ọdun, ni Oluwa yio bẹ̀ Tire wò, yio si yipadà si ọ̀ya rẹ̀, yio si ba gbogbo ijọba aiye yi ti o wà lori ilẹ ṣe àgbere.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass after the end of seventy years, that the LORD will visit Tyre, and she shall turn to her hire, and shall commit fornication with all the kingdoms of the world upon the face of the earth.

entries.yo: Ọjà rẹ̀ ati ọ̀ya rẹ̀ yio jẹ mimọ́ si Oluwa: a kì yio fi ṣura, bẹ̃li a ki yio tò o jọ; nitori ọjà rẹ̀ yio jẹ ti awọn ti ngbe iwaju Oluwa, lati jẹ ajẹtẹrùn, ati fun aṣọ daradara.
entries.en: And her merchandise and her hire shall be holiness to the LORD: it shall not be treasured nor laid up; for her merchandise shall be for them that dwell before the LORD, to eat sufficiently, and for durable clothing.

entries.yo: KIYESI i, Oluwa sọ aiye di ofo, o si sọ ọ di ahoro, o si yi i po, o si tú awọn olugbé inu rẹ̀ ka.
entries.en: Behold, the LORD maketh the earth empty, and maketh it waste, and turneth it upside down, and scattereth abroad the inhabitants thereof.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, bi o ti ri fun awọn enia, bẹ̃li o ri fun alufa; bi o ti ri fun iranṣẹ-kunrin, bẹ̃ni fun oluwa rẹ̀; bi o ti ri fun iranṣẹbinrin, bẹ̃ni fun oluwa rẹ̀; bi o ti ri fun olùra, bẹ̃ni fun olùta; bi o ti ri fun awinni, bẹ̃ni fun atọrọ; bi o ti ri fun agbà elé, bẹ̃ni fun ẹniti o san ele fun u.
entries.en: And it shall be, as with the people, so with the priest; as with the servant, so with his master; as with the maid, so with her mistress; as with the buyer, so with the seller; as with the lender, so with the borrower; as with the taker of usury, so with the giver of usury to him.

entries.yo: Ilẹ yio di ofo patapata, yio si bajẹ patapata: nitori Oluwa ti sọ ọ̀rọ yi.
entries.en: The land shall be utterly emptied, and utterly spoiled: for the LORD hath spoken this word.

entries.yo: Ilẹ̀ nṣọ̀fọ o si nṣá, aiye nrù o si nṣá, awọn ẹni giga ilẹ njoro.
entries.en: The earth mourneth and fadeth away, the world languisheth and fadeth away, the haughty people of the earth do languish.

entries.yo: Ilẹ pẹlu si di aimọ́ li abẹ awọn ti ngbe inu rẹ̀; nitori nwọn ti rú ofin, nwọn pa ilàna dà, nwọn dà majẹmu aiyeraiye.
entries.en: The earth also is defiled under the inhabitants thereof; because they have transgressed the laws, changed the ordinance, broken the everlasting covenant.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni egún ṣe jẹ ilẹ run, awọn ti ngbe inu rẹ̀ di ahoro: nitorina ni awọn ti ngbe ilẹ jona, enia diẹ li o si kù.
entries.en: Therefore hath the curse devoured the earth, and they that dwell therein are desolate: therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned, and few men left.

entries.yo: Ọti-waini titun nṣọ̀fọ, àjara njoro, gbogbo awọn ti nṣe aríya nkẹdùn.
entries.en: The new wine mourneth, the vine languisheth, all the merryhearted do sigh.

entries.yo: Ayọ̀ tabreti dá, ariwo awọn ti nyọ̀ pin, ayọ̀ harpu dá.
entries.en: The mirth of tabrets ceaseth, the noise of them that rejoice endeth, the joy of the harp ceaseth.

entries.yo: Nwọn kì yio fi orin mu ọti-waini mọ́; ọti-lile yio koro fun awọn ti nmu u.
entries.en: They shall not drink wine with a song; strong drink shall be bitter to them that drink it.

entries.yo: A wó ilu rúdurudu palẹ: olukuluku ile li a se, ki ẹnikan má bà wọle.
entries.en: The city of confusion is broken down: every house is shut up, that no man may come in.

entries.yo: Igbe fun ọti-waini mbẹ ni igboro; gbogbo ayọ̀ ṣú òkunkun, aríya ilẹ na lọ.
entries.en: There is a crying for wine in the streets; all joy is darkened, the mirth of the land is gone.

entries.yo: Idahoro li o kù ni ilu, a si fi iparun lù ẹnu-ibode.
entries.en: In the city is left desolation, and the gate is smitten with destruction.

entries.yo: Nigbati yio ri bayi li ãrin ilẹ lãrin enia na, bi mimì igi olifi, ati bi pipẽṣẹ eso-àjara nigbati ikorè àjara tán.
entries.en: When thus it shall be in the midst of the land among the people, there shall be as the shaking of an olive tree, and as the gleaning grapes when the vintage is done.

entries.yo: Nwọn o gbe ohùn wọn soke, nwọn o kọrin nitori ọla-nla Oluwa, nwọn o kigbe kikan lati okun wá.
entries.en: They shall lift up their voice, they shall sing for the majesty of the LORD, they shall cry aloud from the sea.

entries.yo: Nitorina yìn Oluwa li ogo ni ilẹ imọlẹ, ani orukọ Oluwa Ọlọrun Israeli li erekùṣu okun.
entries.en: Wherefore glorify ye the LORD in the fires, even the name of the LORD God of Israel in the isles of the sea.

entries.yo: Lati opin ilẹ li awa ti gbọ́ orin, ani ogo fun olododo. Ṣugbọn emi wipe, Iparun mi, iparun mi, egbé ni fun mi! awọn ọ̀dalẹ ti dalẹ: nitõtọ, awọn ọ̀dalẹ dalẹ rekọja.
entries.en: From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs, even glory to the righteous. But I said, My leanness, my leanness, woe unto me! the treacherous dealers have dealt treacherously; yea, the treacherous dealers have dealt very treacherously.

entries.yo: Ibẹ̀ru, ati ọ̀fin, ati ẹgẹ́, wà lori rẹ, iwọ ti ngbe ilẹ-aiye.
entries.en: Fear, and the pit, and the snare, are upon thee, O inhabitant of the earth.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, ẹniti o sá kuro fun ariwo ìbẹru yio jin sinu ọ̀fin; ati ẹniti o jade lati inu ọ̀fin wá li a o fi ẹgẹ́ mu: nitori awọn ferese lati oke wá ṣi silẹ, ipilẹ ilẹ si mì.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass, that he who fleeth from the noise of the fear shall fall into the pit; and he that cometh up out of the midst of the pit shall be taken in the snare: for the windows from on high are open, and the foundations of the earth do shake.

entries.yo: Ilẹ di fifọ́ patapata, ilẹ di yíyọ patapata, ilẹ mì tìtì.
entries.en: The earth is utterly broken down, the earth is clean dissolved, the earth is moved exceedingly.

entries.yo: Ilẹ yio ta gbọ̀ngbọn sihin sọhun bi ọ̀mutí, a o si ṣi i ni idí bi agọ́; irekọja inu rẹ̀ yio wọ̀ ọ li ọrùn; yio si ṣubu, kì yio si dide mọ́.
entries.en: The earth shall reel to and fro like a drunkard, and shall be removed like a cottage; and the transgression thereof shall be heavy upon it; and it shall fall, and not rise again.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe li ọjọ na, Oluwa yio bẹ̀ ogun awọn ẹni-giga ni ibi-giga wò, ati awọn ọba aiye li aiye.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the LORD shall punish the host of the high ones that are on high, and the kings of the earth upon the earth.

entries.yo: A o si ko wọn jọ pọ̀, bi a iti kó ara tubu jọ sinu ihò, a o tì wọn sinu tubu, lẹhin ọjọ pupọ̀ li a o si bẹ̀ wọn wò.
entries.en: And they shall be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and shall be shut up in the prison, and after many days shall they be visited.

entries.yo: Nigbana li a o dãmu oṣupa, oju yio si tì õrun, nigbati Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun yio jọba li oke Sioni, ati ni Jerusalemu, ogo yio si wà niwaju awọn alàgba rẹ̀.
entries.en: Then the moon shall be confounded, and the sun ashamed, when the LORD of hosts shall reign in mount Zion, and in Jerusalem, and before his ancients gloriously.

entries.yo: OLUWA, iwọ li Ọlọrun mi; emi o gbe ọ ga, emi o yìn orukọ rẹ; nitori iwọ ti ṣe ohun iyanu; ìmọ igbani, ododo ati otitọ ni.
entries.en: O LORD, thou art my God; I will exalt thee, I will praise thy name; for thou hast done wonderful things; thy counsels of old are faithfulness and truth.

entries.yo: Nitori iwọ ti sọ ilu kan di okiti; iwọ ti sọ ilu olodi di iparun: ãfin awọn alejo, kò jẹ ilu mọ́; a kì yio kọ́ ọ mọ.
entries.en: For thou hast made of a city an heap; of a defenced city a ruin: a palace of strangers to be no city; it shall never be built.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni awọn alagbara enia yio yìn ọ li ogo, ilu orilẹ-ède ti o ni ibẹ̀ru yio bẹ̀ru rẹ.
entries.en: Therefore shall the strong people glorify thee, the city of the terrible nations shall fear thee.

entries.yo: Nitori iwọ ti jẹ agbara fun talaka, agbara fun alaini ninu iṣẹ́ rẹ̀, ãbo kuro ninu ìji, ojiji kuro ninu oru, nigbati ẹfũfu lile awọn ti o ni ibẹ̀ru dabi ìji lara ogiri.
entries.en: For thou hast been a strength to the poor, a strength to the needy in his distress, a refuge from the storm, a shadow from the heat, when the blast of the terrible ones is as a storm against the wall.

entries.yo: Iwọ o mu ariwo awọn alejo rọlẹ, gẹgẹ bi oru nibi gbigbẹ; ani oru pẹlu ojiji awọsanma: a o si rẹ̀ orin-ayọ̀ awọn ti o ni ibẹ̀ru silẹ.
entries.en: Thou shalt bring down the noise of strangers, as the heat in a dry place; even the heat with the shadow of a cloud: the branch of the terrible ones shall be brought low.

entries.yo: Ati ni oke-nla yi li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun yio sè asè ohun abọ́pa fun gbogbo orilẹ-ède, asè ọti-waini lori gẹ̀dẹ̀gẹ́dẹ, ti ohun abọpa ti o kún fun ọra, ti ọti-waini ti o tòro lori gẹ̀dẹ̀gẹ́dẹ.
entries.en: And in this mountain shall the LORD of hosts make unto all people a feast of fat things, a feast of wines on the lees, of fat things full of marrow, of wines on the lees well refined.

entries.yo: Li oke-nla yi on o si pa iboju ti o bò gbogbo enia loju run, ati iboju ti a nà bò gbogbo orilẹ-ède.
entries.en: And he will destroy in this mountain the face of the covering cast over all people, and the vail that is spread over all nations.

entries.yo: On o gbe iku mì lailai; Oluwa Jehofah yio nù omije nù kuro li oju gbogbo enia; yio si mu ẹ̀gan enia rẹ̀ kuro ni gbogbo aiye: nitori Oluwa ti wi i.
entries.en: He will swallow up death in victory; and the Lord GOD will wipe away tears from off all faces; and the rebuke of his people shall he take away from off all the earth: for the LORD hath spoken it.

entries.yo: A o si sọ li ọjọ na pe, Wò o, Ọlọrun wa li eyi; awa ti duro de e, on o si gbà wa là: Oluwa li eyi: awa ti duro de e, awa o ma yọ̀, inu wa o si ma dùn ninu igbala rẹ̀.
entries.en: And it shall be said in that day, Lo, this is our God; we have waited for him, and he will save us: this is the LORD; we have waited for him, we will be glad and rejoice in his salvation.

entries.yo: Nitori li oke-nla yi ni ọwọ́ Oluwa yio simi, yio si tẹ Moabu labẹ rẹ̀, ani gẹgẹ bi ãti tẹ̀ koriko mọlẹ fun ãtan.
entries.en: For in this mountain shall the hand of the LORD rest, and Moab shall be trodden down under him, even as straw is trodden down for the dunghill.

entries.yo: Yio si nà ọwọ́ rẹ̀ jade li ãrin wọn, gẹgẹ bi òmùwẹ̀ iti nà ọwọ́ rẹ̀ jade lati wẹ̀: on o si rẹ̀ igberaga wọn silẹ pọ̀ pẹlu ikogun ọwọ́ wọn.
entries.en: And he shall spread forth his hands in the midst of them, as he that swimmeth spreadeth forth his hands to swim: and he shall bring down their pride together with the spoils of their hands.

entries.yo: Odi alagbara, odi giga, odi rẹ li on o wó lulẹ, yio rẹ̀ ẹ silẹ, yio mu u wá ilẹ, ani sinu ekuru.
entries.en: And the fortress of the high fort of thy walls shall he bring down, lay low, and bring to the ground, even to the dust.

entries.yo: LI ọjọ na li a o kọ orin yi ni ilẹ Juda; Awa ní ilu agbara; igbala li Ọlọrun yio yàn fun odi ati ãbo.
entries.en: In that day shall this song be sung in the land of Judah; We have a strong city; salvation will God appoint for walls and bulwarks.

entries.yo: Ẹ ṣi ilẹkun bodè silẹ, ki orilẹ-ède ododo ti nṣọ́ otitọ ba le wọ̀ ile.
entries.en: Open ye the gates, that the righteous nation which keepeth the truth may enter in.

entries.yo: Iwọ o pa a mọ li alafia pipé, ọkàn ẹniti o simi le ọ: nitoriti o gbẹkẹle ọ.
entries.en: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.

entries.yo: Ẹ gbẹkẹle Oluwa titi lai: nitori Oluwa Jehofa li apata aiyeraiye:
entries.en: Trust ye in the LORD for ever: for in the LORD JEHOVAH is everlasting strength:

entries.yo: Nitori o rẹ̀ awọn ti ngbe oke giga silẹ; ilu giga, o mu u wálẹ; o mu u wálẹ; ani si ilẹ; o mu u de inu ekuru.
entries.en: For he bringeth down them that dwell on high; the lofty city, he layeth it low; he layeth it low, even to the ground; he bringeth it even to the dust.

entries.yo: Ẹsẹ yio tẹ̀ ẹ mọlẹ, ani ẹsẹ awọn talaka, ati ìṣísẹ̀ awọn alaini.
entries.en: The foot shall tread it down, even the feet of the poor, and the steps of the needy.

entries.yo: Ọ̀na awọn olõtọ ododo ni: iwọ, olõtọ-julọ, ti wọ̀n ipa-ọ̀na awọn olõtọ.
entries.en: The way of the just is uprightness: thou, most upright, dost weigh the path of the just.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ, Oluwa, li ọ̀na idajọ rẹ, li awa duro de ọ: ifẹ́ ọkàn wa ni si orukọ rẹ, ati si iranti rẹ.
entries.en: Yea, in the way of thy judgments, O LORD, have we waited for thee; the desire of our soul is to thy name, and to the remembrance of thee.

entries.yo: Ọkàn mi li emi fi ṣe afẹ̃ri rẹ li oru; nitõtọ, pẹlu ẹmi mi ninu mi li emi o wá ọ ni kutùkutù; nitori nigbati idajọ rẹ mbẹ ni ilẹ, awọn ti mbẹ li aiye yio kọ́ ododo.
entries.en: With my soul have I desired thee in the night; yea, with my spirit within me will I seek thee early: for when thy judgments are in the earth, the inhabitants of the world will learn righteousness.

entries.yo: Bi a ba fi ojurere hàn enia buburu, kì yio kọ́ ododo: ni ilẹ iduroṣinṣin li on o hùwa aiṣõtọ, kì yio si ri ọlanla Oluwa.
entries.en: Let favour be shewed to the wicked, yet will he not learn righteousness: in the land of uprightness will he deal unjustly, and will not behold the majesty of the LORD.

entries.yo: Oluwa, ọwọ́ rẹ gbe soke, nwọn kì yio ri, ṣugbọn nwọn o ri, oju o si tì wọn nitori ilara wọn si awọn enia; nitõtọ, iná awọn ọta rẹ yio jẹ wọn run.
entries.en: LORD, when thy hand is lifted up, they will not see: but they shall see, and be ashamed for their envy at the people; yea, the fire of thine enemies shall devour them.

entries.yo: Oluwa, iwọ o fi idi alafia mulẹ fun wa: pẹlupẹlu nitori iwọ li o ti ṣe gbogbo iṣẹ wa fun wa.
entries.en: LORD, thou wilt ordain peace for us: for thou also hast wrought all our works in us.

entries.yo: Oluwa Ọlọrun wa, awọn oluwa miran lẹhin rẹ ti jọba lori wa: ṣugbọn nipa rẹ nikan li awa o da orukọ rẹ sọ.
entries.en: O LORD our God, other lords beside thee have had dominion over us: but by thee only will we make mention of thy name.

entries.yo: Awọn okú, nwọn kì yio yè; awọn ti ngbe isà-okú, nwọn kì yio dide; nitorina ni iwọ ṣe bẹ̀ wọn wò ti o si pa wọn run, ti o si mu ki gbogbo iranti wọn parun.
entries.en: They are dead, they shall not live; they are deceased, they shall not rise: therefore hast thou visited and destroyed them, and made all their memory to perish.

entries.yo: Iwọ ti mu orilẹ-ède bi si i, Oluwa, iwọ ti mu orilẹ-ède bi si i; iwọ ti di ẹni-ãyin li ogo: iwọ ti sún gbogbo ãlà siwaju.
entries.en: Thou hast increased the nation, O LORD, thou hast increased the nation: thou art glorified: thou hadst removed it far unto all the ends of the earth.

entries.yo: Oluwa, ninu wahala ni nwọn wá ọ, nwọn gbadura wúyẹ́wúyẹ́ nigbati ibawi rẹ wà lara wọn.
entries.en: LORD, in trouble have they visited thee, they poured out a prayer when thy chastening was upon them.

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi aboyun, ti o sunmọ akoko ibi rẹ̀, ti wà ni irora, ti o si kigbe ninu irora rẹ̀; bẹ̃li awa ti wà li oju rẹ, Oluwa.
entries.en: Like as a woman with child, that draweth near the time of her delivery, is in pain, and crieth out in her pangs; so have we been in thy sight, O LORD.

entries.yo: Awa ti loyun, awa ti wà ni irora, o si dabi ẹnipe awa ti bi ẹfũfu; awa kò ṣiṣẹ igbala kan lori ilẹ, bẹ̃ni awọn ti ngbe aiye kò ṣubu.
entries.en: We have been with child, we have been in pain, we have as it were brought forth wind; we have not wrought any deliverance in the earth; neither have the inhabitants of the world fallen.

entries.yo: Awọn okú rẹ yio yè, okú mi, nwọn o dide. Ẹ ji, ẹ si kọrin, ẹnyin ti ngbe inu ekuru: nitori ìri rẹ ìri ewebẹ̀ ni, ilẹ yio si sọ awọn okú jade.
entries.en: Thy dead men shall live, together with my dead body shall they arise. Awake and sing, ye that dwell in dust: for thy dew is as the dew of herbs, and the earth shall cast out the dead.

entries.yo: Wá, enia mi, wọ̀ inu iyẹ̀wu rẹ lọ, si se ilẹkun rẹ mọ ara rẹ: fi ara rẹ pamọ bi ẹnipe ni iṣẹ́ju kan, titi ibinu na fi rekọja.
entries.en: Come, my people, enter thou into thy chambers, and shut thy doors about thee: hide thyself as it were for a little moment, until the indignation be overpast.

entries.yo: Nitorina, kiye si i, Oluwa ti ipò rẹ̀ jade lati bẹ̀ aiṣedede ẹniti ngbe ori ilẹ wo lori ilẹ; ilẹ pẹlu yio fi ẹ̀jẹ rẹ̀ hàn, kì yio si bo okú rẹ̀ mọ.
entries.en: For, behold, the LORD cometh out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity: the earth also shall disclose her blood, and shall no more cover her slain.

entries.yo: LI ọjọ na li Oluwa yio fi idà rẹ̀ mimú ti o tobi, ti o si wuwo bá lefiatani ejò ti nfò wi, ati lefiatani ejò wiwọ́ nì; on o si pa dragoni ti mbẹ li okun.
entries.en: In that day the LORD with his sore and great and strong sword shall punish leviathan the piercing serpent, even leviathan that crooked serpent; and he shall slay the dragon that is in the sea.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ na ẹ kọrin si i, Ajàra ọti-waini pipọ́n.
entries.en: In that day sing ye unto her, A vineyard of red wine.

entries.yo: Emi Oluwa li o ṣọ ọ: emi o bù omi wọ́n ọ nigbakugba: ki ẹnikẹni má ba bà a jẹ, emi o ṣọ ọ ti oru ti ọsan.
entries.en: I the LORD do keep it; I will water it every moment: lest any hurt it, I will keep it night and day.

entries.yo: Irunú kò si ninu mi: tani le doju pantiri ẹlẹgun ati ẹgun kọ mi li ogun jijà? emi iba là wọn kọja, emi iba fi wọn jona pọ̀ ṣọ̀kan.
entries.en: Fury is not in me: who would set the briers and thorns against me in battle? I would go through them, I would burn them together.

entries.yo: Tabi jẹ ki o di agbara mi mu, ki o ba le ba mi lajà; yio si ba mi lajà.
entries.en: Or let him take hold of my strength, that he may make peace with me; and he shall make peace with me.

entries.yo: Yio mu ki awọn ti o ti Jakobu wá ta gbòngbo: Israeli yio tanna yio si rudi, yio si fi eso kún oju gbogbo aiye.
entries.en: He shall cause them that come of Jacob to take root: Israel shall blossom and bud, and fill the face of the world with fruit.

entries.yo: On ha lù u bi o ti nlu awọn ti o lù u? a ha pa a gẹgẹ bi pipa awọn ti on pa?
entries.en: Hath he smitten him, as he smote those that smote him? or is he slain according to the slaughter of them that are slain by him?

entries.yo: Niwọ̀n-niwọ̀n, nigba itìjade rẹ̀, iwọ o ba a wi: on ṣi ẹfũfu-ile rẹ̀ ni ipò li ọjọ ẹfũfu ilà-õrun.
entries.en: In measure, when it shooteth forth, thou wilt debate with it: he stayeth his rough wind in the day of the east wind.

entries.yo: Nitorina nipa eyi li a o bò ẹ̀ṣẹ Jakobu mọlẹ: eyi si ni gbogbo eso lati mu ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ̀ kuro; nigbati on gbe okuta pẹpẹ kalẹ bi okuta ẹfun ti a lù wẹwẹ, igbó ati ere-õrun kì yio dide duro.
entries.en: By this therefore shall the iniquity of Jacob be purged; and this is all the fruit to take away his sin; when he maketh all the stones of the altar as chalkstones that are beaten in sunder, the groves and images shall not stand up.

entries.yo: Nitori ilu-olodi yio di ahoro, a o si kọ̀ ibugbé silẹ, a o si fi i silẹ bi aginju: nibẹ ni ọmọ-malu yio ma jẹ̀, nibẹ ni yio si dubulẹ, yio si jẹ ẹka rẹ̀ run.
entries.en: Yet the defenced city shall be desolate, and the habitation forsaken, and left like a wilderness: there shall the calf feed, and there shall he lie down, and consume the branches thereof.

entries.yo: Nigbati ẹka inu rẹ̀ ba rọ, a o ya wọn kuro: awọn obinrin de, nwọn si tẹ̀ iná bọ̀ wọn: nitori alaini oye enia ni nwọn: nitorina ẹniti o dá wọn kì yio ṣãnu fun wọn, ẹniti o si mọ wọn kì yio fi ojurere hàn wọn.
entries.en: When the boughs thereof are withered, they shall be broken off: the women come, and set them on fire: for it is a people of no understanding: therefore he that made them will not have mercy on them, and he that formed them will shew them no favour.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe li ọjọ na, Oluwa yio ja eso kuro ni ibu odò si iṣàn Egipti, a o si ṣà nyin jọ li ọkọkan, ẹnyin ọmọ Israeli.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the LORD shall beat off from the channel of the river unto the stream of Egypt, and ye shall be gathered one by one, O ye children of Israel.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe li ọjọ na, a o fun ipè nla, awọn ti o mura lati ṣegbe ni ilẹ Assiria yio si wá, ati awọn aṣátì ilẹ Egipti, nwọn o si sìn Oluwa ni oke mimọ́ ni Jerusalemu.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the great trumpet shall be blown, and they shall come which were ready to perish in the land of Assyria, and the outcasts in the land of Egypt, and shall worship the LORD in the holy mount at Jerusalem.

entries.yo: EGBE ni fun ade igberaga, fun awọn ọmuti Efraimu, ati fun itàna rirọ ti ogo ẹwà rẹ , ti o wà lori afonifoji ọlọra ti awọn ti ọti-waini pa.
entries.en: Woe to the crown of pride, to the drunkards of Ephraim, whose glorious beauty is a fading flower, which are on the head of the fat valleys of them that are overcome with wine!

entries.yo: Kiye si i, Oluwa ni ẹnikan alagbara ati onipá, bi ẹfũfu lile, yiyin, ati ìji iparun, bi iṣàn-omi nla àkúnya, yio fi ọwọ́ bì ṣubu sori ilẹ.
entries.en: Behold, the Lord hath a mighty and strong one, which as a tempest of hail and a destroying storm, as a flood of mighty waters overflowing, shall cast down to the earth with the hand.

entries.yo: Ade igberaga, awọn ọmuti Efraimu, li a o fi ẹsẹ tẹ  mọlẹ:
entries.en: The crown of pride, the drunkards of Ephraim, shall be trodden under feet:

entries.yo: Ati ogo ẹwà, ti o wà lori afonifoji ọlọra, yio jẹ itanna rirọ, gẹgẹ bi eso ti o yara ṣaju igba ìkore; eyiti nigbati ẹniti o ba nwò o ba ri, nigbati o wà li ọwọ́ rẹ  sibẹ, o gbe e mì.
entries.en: And the glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fat valley, shall be a fading flower, and as the hasty fruit before the summer; which when he that looketh upon it seeth, while it is yet in his hand he eateth it up.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ na li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun yio jẹ ade ogo, ati ade ẹwà fun iyokù awọn enia rẹ ,
entries.en: In that day shall the LORD of hosts be for a crown of glory, and for a diadem of beauty, unto the residue of his people,

entries.yo: Ati ẹmi idajọ fun awọn ẹniti o joko ni idajọ, ati agbara fun awọn ti o le ogun padà si ibode.
entries.en: And for a spirit of judgment to him that sitteth in judgment, and for strength to them that turn the battle to the gate.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn pẹlu ti ti ipa ọti-waini ṣìna, ati nipa ọti-lile nwọn ti ṣako; alufa ati wolĩ ti ṣìna nipa ọti-lile, ọti-waini mu wọn daradara, nwọn di aṣako nipa ọti-lile, nwọn ṣìna ninu iran, nwọn kọsẹ ni idajọ.
entries.en: But they also have erred through wine, and through strong drink are out of the way; the priest and the prophet have erred through strong drink, they are swallowed up of wine, they are out of the way through strong drink; they err in vision, they stumble in judgment.

entries.yo: Nitori gbogbo tabili li o kún fun ẽbi ati ẹgbin, kò si ibi ti o mọ́.
entries.en: For all tables are full of vomit and filthiness, so that there is no place clean.

entries.yo: Tani on o kọ́ ni ìmọ? ati tani on o fi oye ẹkọ́ yé? awọn ẹniti a wọ́n li ẹnu-ọmú, ti a si já li ẹnu ọyàn.
entries.en: Whom shall he teach knowledge? and whom shall he make to understand doctrine? them that are weaned from the milk, and drawn from the breasts.

entries.yo: Nitori aṣẹ le aṣẹ, aṣẹ le aṣẹ; ẹsẹ le ẹsẹ, ẹsẹ le ẹsẹ; diẹ nihin, diẹ lọhun:
entries.en: For precept must be upon precept, precept upon precept; line upon line, line upon line; here a little, and there a little:

entries.yo: Nitori nipa ète ẹlẹyà ati ni ède miran li on o fi bá enia wọnyi sọ rọ.
entries.en: For with stammering lips and another tongue will he speak to this people.

entries.yo: Si ẹniti on wipe, Eyi ni isimi, ẹnyin ìba mu awọn alãrẹ  simi; eyi si ni itura: sibẹ nwọn kì yio gbọ́.
entries.en: To whom he said, This is the rest wherewith ye may cause the weary to rest; and this is the refreshing: yet they would not hear.

entries.yo: Nitorina ọ rọ Oluwa jẹ aṣẹ le aṣẹ, aṣẹ le aṣẹ fun wọn: ẹsẹ le ẹsẹ, ẹsẹ le ẹsẹ; diẹ nihin, diẹ lọhun: ki nwọn ba le lọ, ki nwọn si ṣubu sẹhin, ki nwọn si ṣẹ́, ki a si dẹ wọn, ki a si mu wọn.
entries.en: But the word of the LORD was unto them precept upon precept, precept upon precept; line upon line, line upon line; here a little, and there a little; that they might go, and fall backward, and be broken, and snared, and taken.

entries.yo: Nitorina ẹ gbọ́ ọ rọ Oluwa, ẹnyin ẹlẹgàn, ti nṣe akoso awọn enia yi ti mbẹ ni Jerusalemu.
entries.en: Wherefore hear the word of the LORD, ye scornful men, that rule this people which is in Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Nitori ẹnyin ti wipe, Awa ti ba ikú dá majẹmu, a si ti ba ipò-okú mulẹ: nigbati pàṣan gigun yio là a já, kì yio de ọdọ wa: nitori awa ti fi eké ṣe ãbo wa, ati labẹ irọ́ li awa ti fi ara wa pamọ:
entries.en: Because ye have said, We have made a covenant with death, and with hell are we at agreement; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through, it shall not come unto us: for we have made lies our refuge, and under falsehood have we hid ourselves:

entries.yo: Nitorina bayi li Oluwa Jehofah wi, pe, Kiyesi i, emi gbe okuta kan kalẹ ni Sioni fun ipilẹ, okuta ti a dán wò, okuta igun-ile iyebiye, ipilẹ ti o daju: ẹniti o gbagbọ kì yio sá.
entries.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD, Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious corner stone, a sure foundation: he that believeth shall not make haste.

entries.yo: Idajọ li emi o fi le ẹsẹ pẹlu, ati ododo li emi o fi lé òṣuwọn: yinyín yio gbá ãbo eke lọ, omi o si kún bò ibi isasi mọlẹ.
entries.en: Judgment also will I lay to the line, and righteousness to the plummet: and the hail shall sweep away the refuge of lies, and the waters shall overflow the hiding place.

entries.yo: Majẹmu nyin ti ẹ ba ikú dá li a o sọ di asan, imulẹ nyin pẹlu ipò-okú kì yio duro; nigbati paṣán gigun yio rekọja; nigbana ni on o tẹ  nyin mọlẹ.
entries.en: And your covenant with death shall be disannulled, and your agreement with hell shall not stand; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through, then ye shall be trodden down by it.

entries.yo: Niwọn igbati o ba jade lọ ni yio mu nyin: nitori ni gbogbo owurọ ni yio rekọja, li ọsan ati li oru: kiki igburo rẹ  yio si di ijaiyà.
entries.en: From the time that it goeth forth it shall take you: for morning by morning shall it pass over, by day and by night: and it shall be a vexation only to understand the report.

entries.yo: Nitori akete kuru jù eyiti enia le nà ara rẹ  si, ati ìbora kò ni ibò to eyi ti on le fi bò ara rẹ .
entries.en: For the bed is shorter than that a man can stretch himself on it: and the covering narrower than that he can wrap himself in it.

entries.yo: Nitori Oluwa yio dide bi ti oke Perasimu, yio si binu gẹgẹ bi ti afonifoji Gibeoni, ki o ba le ṣe iṣẹ rẹ , iṣẹ àrà rẹ ; yio si mu iṣe rẹ  ṣẹ, ajeji iṣe rẹ .
entries.en: For the LORD shall rise up as in mount Perazim, he shall be wroth as in the valley of Gibeon, that he may do his work, his strange work; and bring to pass his act, his strange act.

entries.yo: Njẹ nitorina, ẹ máṣe jẹ ẹlẹgàn, ki a má ba sọ ìde nyin di lile; nitori emi ti gbọ́ iparun lati ọdọ Oluwa, Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wá, ti o ti pinnu lori gbogbo ilẹ.
entries.en: Now therefore be ye not mockers, lest your bands be made strong: for I have heard from the Lord GOD of hosts a consumption, even determined upon the whole earth.

entries.yo: Ẹ fetisilẹ, ẹ si gbọ́ ohùn mi: ẹ tẹtilelẹ, ẹ si gbọ́ ọ rọ mi.
entries.en: Give ye ear, and hear my voice; hearken, and hear my speech.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ọjọ ni agbẹ  ha nroko lati gbìn? on o ha ma tú, a si ma fọ́ ilẹ rẹ  bi?
entries.en: Doth the plowman plow all day to sow? doth he open and break the clods of his ground?

entries.yo: Nigbati on ti tẹ́ ojú rẹ  tan, on kò ha nfunrugbìn dili, ki o si fọn irugbìn kummini ka, ki o si gbìn alikama lẹsẹ-ẹsẹ, ati barle ti a yàn, ati spelti nipò rẹ ?
entries.en: When he hath made plain the face thereof, doth he not cast abroad the fitches, and scatter the cummin, and cast in the principal wheat and the appointed barley and rie in their place?

entries.yo: Nitori Ọlọrun rẹ  kọ́ ọ lati ni oye, o tilẹ kọ́ ọ.
entries.en: For his God doth instruct him to discretion, and doth teach him.

entries.yo: Nitori a kò fi ohun-elò pakà dili, bẹ̃ni a kì iyí kẹkẹ́ kiri lori kummini; ṣugbọn ọpá li a ifi pa dili jade, ọgọ li a si fi lù kummini.
entries.en: For the fitches are not threshed with a threshing instrument, neither is a cart wheel turned about upon the cummin; but the fitches are beaten out with a staff, and the cummin with a rod.

entries.yo: Akara agbado li a lọ ; on kò le ma pa a titi, bẹ̃ni kò fi kẹkẹ́-ẹrù fọ́ ọ, bẹ̃ni kì ifi awọn ẹlẹṣin rẹ  tẹ  ẹ.
entries.en: Bread corn is bruised; because he will not ever be threshing it, nor break it with the wheel of his cart, nor bruise it with his horsemen.

entries.yo: Eyi pẹlu ti ọdọ Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wá, ẹniti o kún fun iyanu ni ìmọ, ti o tayọ ni iṣe.
entries.en: This also cometh forth from the LORD of hosts, which is wonderful in counsel, and excellent in working.

entries.yo: EGBE ni fun Arieli, fun Arieli, ilu ti Dafidi ti ngbe! ẹ fi ọdun kún ọdun; jẹ ki wọn pa ẹran rubọ.
entries.en: Woe to Ariel, to Ariel, the city where David dwelt! add ye year to year; let them kill sacrifices.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi o pọ́n Arieli loju, àwẹ on ibanujẹ yio si wà; yio si dabi Arieli si mi.
entries.en: Yet I will distress Ariel, and there shall be heaviness and sorrow: and it shall be unto me as Ariel.

entries.yo: Emi o si dótì ọ yika, emi o si wà odi tì ọ, emi o si mọ odi giga tì ọ.
entries.en: And I will camp against thee round about, and will lay siege against thee with a mount, and I will raise forts against thee.

entries.yo: A o si rẹ̀ ọ silẹ, iwọ o sọ̀rọ lati ilẹ jade, ọ̀rọ rẹ yio rẹ̀lẹ lati inu ekuru wá, ohùn rẹ yio si dabi ti ẹnikan ti o li ẹmi àfọṣẹ lati ilẹ jade, ọ̀rọ rẹ yio si dún lati inu erupẹ ilẹ wá.
entries.en: And thou shalt be brought down, and shalt speak out of the ground, and thy speech shall be low out of the dust, and thy voice shall be, as of one that hath a familiar spirit, out of the ground, and thy speech shall whisper out of the dust.

entries.yo: Ọpọlọpọ awọn ọtá rẹ yio dabi ekuru lẹ́bulẹ́bu, ọpọlọpọ aninilara rẹ yio dabi ìyangbo ti o kọja lọ: lõtọ, yio ri bẹ̃ nisisiyi lojiji.
entries.en: Moreover the multitude of thy strangers shall be like small dust, and the multitude of the terrible ones shall be as chaff that passeth away: yea, it shall be at an instant suddenly.

entries.yo: Ãrá, ìṣẹlẹ, ati iró nla, pẹlu ìji on ẹfúfu, ati ọwọ́ ajonirun iná ni a o fi bẹ̀ ọ wò lati ọdọ Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wá.
entries.en: Thou shalt be visited of the LORD of hosts with thunder, and with earthquake, and great noise, with storm and tempest, and the flame of devouring fire.

entries.yo: Bi alá iran oru li ọ̀pọlọpọ awọn orilẹ-ède ti mba Arieli jà yio ri; gbogbo ẹniti o bá ati on, ati odi agbara rẹ̀ jà, ti nwọn si pọ́n ọ loju.
entries.en: And the multitude of all the nations that fight against Ariel, even all that fight against her and her munition, and that distress her, shall be as a dream of a night vision.

entries.yo: Yio si dabi igbati ẹni ebi npa nla alá; si wo o, o njẹun; ṣugbọn o ji, ọkàn rẹ̀ si ṣofo: tabi bi igbati ẹniti ongbẹ ngbẹ nla alá, si wo o, o nmu omi, ṣugbọn o ji, si wo o, o dáku, ongbẹ si ngbẹ ọkàn rẹ̀; gẹgẹ bẹ̃ ni gbogbo ọ̀pọlọpọ orilẹ-ède yio ri, ti mba oke Sioni jà.
entries.en: It shall even be as when an hungry man dreameth, and, behold, he eateth; but he awaketh, and his soul is empty: or as when a thirsty man dreameth, and, behold, he drinketh; but he awaketh, and, behold, he is faint, and his soul hath appetite: so shall the multitude of all the nations be, that fight against mount Zion.

entries.yo: Mu ara duro jẹ, ki ẹnu ki o yà nyin; ẹ fọ́ ara nyin loju, ẹ si fọju: nwọn mu amupara; ṣugbọn kì iṣe fun ọti-waini, nwọn nta gbọngbọ́n ṣugbọn kì iṣe fun ohun mimu lile.
entries.en: Stay yourselves, and wonder; cry ye out, and cry: they are drunken, but not with wine; they stagger, but not with strong drink.

entries.yo: Nitori Oluwa dà ẹmi õrun ijìka lù nyin, o si se nyin li oju: awọn wolĩ ati awọn olori awọn ariran nyin li o bò li oju.
entries.en: For the LORD hath poured out upon you the spirit of deep sleep, and hath closed your eyes: the prophets and your rulers, the seers hath he covered.

entries.yo: Iran gbogbo si dabi ọ̀rọ iwe kan fun nyin ti a dí, ti a fi fun ẹnikan ti o mọ̀ ọ kà, wipe, Emi bẹ̀ ọ, kà eyi, ti o si wipe, emi kò le ṣe e; nitori a ti dí i.
entries.en: And the vision of all is become unto you as the words of a book that is sealed, which men deliver to one that is learned, saying, Read this, I pray thee: and he saith, I cannot; for it is sealed:

entries.yo: A si fi iwe na fun ẹniti kò mọ̀ iwe, wipe, Emi bẹ̀ ọ, kà eyi, on si wipe, emi kò mọ̀ iwe.
entries.en: And the book is delivered to him that is not learned, saying, Read this, I pray thee: and he saith, I am not learned.

entries.yo: Nitorina Oluwa wipe, Niwọ̀n bi awọn enia yi ti nfi ẹnu wọn fà mọ mi, ti nwọn si nfi etè wọn yìn mi, ṣugbọn ti ọkàn wọn jìna si mi, ti nwọn si bẹru mi nipa ilana enia ti a kọ́ wọn.
entries.en: Wherefore the Lord said, Forasmuch as this people draw near me with their mouth, and with their lips do honour me, but have removed their heart far from me, and their fear toward me is taught by the precept of men:

entries.yo: Nitorina, Kiye si i, emi o ma ṣe iṣẹ́ iyanu lọ lãrin awọn enia yi, ani iṣẹ iyanu ati ajeji: ọgbọ́n awọn ọlọgbọ́n wọn yio si ṣegbe, oye awọn amoye wọn yio si põra.
entries.en: Therefore, behold, I will proceed to do a marvellous work among this people, even a marvellous work and a wonder: for the wisdom of their wise men shall perish, and the understanding of their prudent men shall be hid.

entries.yo: Egbe ni fun awọn ti nwá ọ̀na lati fi ipinnu buruburu wọn pamọ́ kuro loju Oluwa, ti iṣẹ wọn si wà li okunkun, ti nwọn si wipe, Tali o ri wa? tali o mọ̀ wa?
entries.en: Woe unto them that seek deep to hide their counsel from the LORD, and their works are in the dark, and they say, Who seeth us? and who knoweth us?

entries.yo: A, iyipo nyin! a ha le kà amọ̀koko si bi amọ̀: ohun ti a mọ ti ṣe lè wi fun ẹniti o ṣe e pe, On kò ṣe mi? ìkoko ti a mọ le wi fun ẹniti o mọ ọ pe, On kò moye?
entries.en: Surely your turning of things upside down shall be esteemed as the potter's clay: for shall the work say of him that made it, He made me not? or shall the thing framed say of him that framed it, He had no understanding?

entries.yo: Kò ha ṣe pe ìgba diẹ kiun si i, a o sọ Lebanoni di ọgbà eleso, ati ọgbà eleso li a o kà si bi igbo?
entries.en: Is it not yet a very little while, and Lebanon shall be turned into a fruitful field, and the fruitful field shall be esteemed as a forest?

entries.yo: Ati li ọjọ na awọn aditi yio si gbọ́ ọ̀rọ iwe nì, awọn afọju yio si riran lati inu owúsuwusù, ati lati inu okunkun.
entries.en: And in that day shall the deaf hear the words of the book, and the eyes of the blind shall see out of obscurity, and out of darkness.

entries.yo: Ayọ̀ awọn onirẹlẹ yio bí si i ninu Oluwa, ati inu awọn talaka ninu awọn enia yio si dùn ninu Ẹni-Mimọ Israeli.
entries.en: The meek also shall increase their joy in the LORD, and the poor among men shall rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.

entries.yo: Nitori a sọ aninilara na di asan, a si pa ẹlẹgàn run, a si ké gbogbo awọn ti nṣọ́ aiṣedede kuro.
entries.en: For the terrible one is brought to nought, and the scorner is consumed, and all that watch for iniquity are cut off:

entries.yo: Ẹniti o dá enia li ẹbi nitori ọ̀rọ kan, ti nwọn dẹkùn silẹ fun ẹniti o baniwi ni ẹnubodè, ti nwọn si tì olododo si apakan, si ibi ofo.
entries.en: That make a man an offender for a word, and lay a snare for him that reproveth in the gate, and turn aside the just for a thing of nought.

entries.yo: Nitorina bayi li Oluwa, ẹniti o rà Abrahamu padà wi, pe, niti ile Jakobu, oju kì yio tì Jakobu mọ bẹ̃ni oju rẹ̀ kì yio yipada mọ.
entries.en: Therefore thus saith the LORD, who redeemed Abraham, concerning the house of Jacob, Jacob shall not now be ashamed, neither shall his face now wax pale.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati on nri awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, iṣẹ́ ọwọ́ mi, li ãrin rẹ̀, nwọn o yà orukọ mi si mimọ́, nwọn o si yà Ẹni-Mimọ Jakobu nì si mimọ́, nwọn o si bẹ̀ru Ọlọrun Israeli.
entries.en: But when he seeth his children, the work of mine hands, in the midst of him, they shall sanctify my name, and sanctify the Holy One of Jacob, and shall fear the God of Israel.

entries.yo: Awọn pẹlu ti o ṣinà nipa ẹmi, oye yio wá yé wọn, ati awọn ti nsọ bótibòti yio kọ́ ẹkọ́.
entries.en: They also that erred in spirit shall come to understanding, and they that murmured shall learn doctrine.

entries.yo: OLUWA wipe, egbé ni fun awọn ọlọ̀tẹ ọmọ, ti nwọn gbà ìmọ, ṣugbọn kì iṣe ati ọdọ mi; ti nwọn si mulẹ, ṣugbọn kì iṣe nipa ẹmi mi, ki nwọn ba le fi ẹ̀ṣẹ kún ẹ̀ṣẹ:
entries.en: Woe to the rebellious children, saith the LORD, that take counsel, but not of me; and that cover with a covering, but not of my spirit, that they may add sin to sin:

entries.yo: Ti nwọn nrìn lọ si Egipti, ṣugbọn ti nwọn kò bere li ẹnu mi; lati mu ara wọn le nipa agbara Farao, ati lati gbẹkẹle ojiji Egipti!
entries.en: That walk to go down into Egypt, and have not asked at my mouth; to strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh, and to trust in the shadow of Egypt!

entries.yo: Nitorina ni agbara Farao yio ṣe jẹ itiju nyin, ati igbẹkẹle ojiji Egipti yio jẹ idãmu nyin.
entries.en: Therefore shall the strength of Pharaoh be your shame, and the trust in the shadow of Egypt your confusion.

entries.yo: Nitori awọn olori rẹ̀ wá ni Soani, awọn ikọ̀ rẹ̀ de Hanesi.
entries.en: For his princes were at Zoan, and his ambassadors came to Hanes.

entries.yo: Oju awọn enia kan ti kò li ère fun wọn tilẹ tì wọn, ti kò le ṣe iranwọ, tabi anfani, bikoṣe itiju ati ẹ̀gan pẹlu.
entries.en: They were all ashamed of a people that could not profit them, nor be an help nor profit, but a shame, and also a reproach.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ-ìmọ niti awọn ẹranko gusu: sinu ilẹ wahala on àrodun, nibiti akọ ati abo kiniun ti wá, pamọlẹ ati ejò-ina ti nfò, nwọn o rù ọrọ̀ wọn li ejika awọn ọmọ kẹtẹkẹtẹ, ati iṣura wọn lori iké awọn ràkumi, sọdọ awọn enia kan ti kò li ère.
entries.en: The burden of the beasts of the south: into the land of trouble and anguish, from whence come the young and old lion, the viper and fiery flying serpent, they will carry their riches upon the shoulders of young asses, and their treasures upon the bunches of camels, to a people that shall not profit them.

entries.yo: Egipti yio ṣe iranwọ lasan, kò si ni lari: nitorina ni mo ṣe kigbe pè e ni, Rahabu ti o joko jẹ.
entries.en: For the Egyptians shall help in vain, and to no purpose: therefore have I cried concerning this, Their strength is to sit still.

entries.yo: Nisisiyi lọ, kọ ọ niwaju wọn si walã kan, si kọ ọ sinu iwe kan, ki o le jẹ fun igbà ti mbọ lai ati lailai:
entries.en: Now go, write it before them in a table, and note it in a book, that it may be for the time to come for ever and ever:

entries.yo: Pe, ọlọ̀tẹ enia ni awọn wọnyi, awọn ọmọ eké, awọn ọmọ ti kò fẹ igbọ́ ofin Oluwa:
entries.en: That this is a rebellious people, lying children, children that will not hear the law of the LORD:

entries.yo: Ti nwọn wi fun awọn ariran pe, Máṣe riran; ati fun awọn wolĩ pe, Má sọtẹlẹ ohun ti o tọ́ fun wa, sọ nkan didùn fun wa, sọ asọtẹlẹ̀ itanjẹ.
entries.en: Which say to the seers, See not; and to the prophets, Prophesy not unto us right things, speak unto us smooth things, prophesy deceits:

entries.yo: Kuro li ọna na, yẹ̀ kuro ni ipa na, mu ki Ẹni-Mimọ Israeli ki o dẹkun kuro niwaju wa.
entries.en: Get you out of the way, turn aside out of the path, cause the Holy One of Israel to cease from before us.

entries.yo: Nitorina bayi li Ẹni-Mimọ Israeli wi, Nitoriti ẹnyin gàn ọ̀rọ yi, ti ẹnyin si gbẹkẹle ininilara on ìyapa, ti ẹnyin si gbe ara nyin lé e;
entries.en: Wherefore thus saith the Holy One of Israel, Because ye despise this word, and trust in oppression and perverseness, and stay thereon:

entries.yo: Nitorina ni aiṣedede yi yio ri si nyin bi odi yiya ti o mura ati ṣubu, ti o tiri sode lara ogiri giga, eyiti wiwó rẹ̀ de lojijì, lojukanna.
entries.en: Therefore this iniquity shall be to you as a breach ready to fall, swelling out in a high wall, whose breaking cometh suddenly at an instant.

entries.yo: Yio si fọ́ ọ bi fifọ́ ohun-èlo amọ̀ ti a fọ́ tútu; ti a kò dasi: tobẹ̃ ti a kì yio ri apãdi kan ninu ẹfọ́ rẹ̀ lati fi fọ̀n iná li oju ãro, tabi lati fi bù omi ninu ikũdu.
entries.en: And he shall break it as the breaking of the potters' vessel that is broken in pieces; he shall not spare: so that there shall not be found in the bursting of it a sherd to take fire from the hearth, or to take water withal out of the pit.

entries.yo: Nitori bayi ni Oluwa Jehofah, Ẹni-Mimọ Israeli wi; Ninu pipada on sisimi li a o fi gbà nyin là; ninu didakẹjẹ ati gbigbẹkẹle li agbara nyin wà; ṣugbọn ẹnyin kò fẹ.
entries.en: For thus saith the Lord GOD, the Holy One of Israel; In returning and rest shall ye be saved; in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength: and ye would not.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹnyin wipe, Bẹ̃kọ; nitori ẹṣin li a o fi sá; nitorina li ẹnyin o ṣe sá: ati pe, Awa o gùn eyi ti o lè sare; nitorina awọn ti yio lepa nyin yio lè sare.
entries.en: But ye said, No; for we will flee upon horses; therefore shall ye flee: and, We will ride upon the swift; therefore shall they that pursue you be swift.

entries.yo: Ẹgbẹrun yio sá ni ibawi ẹnikan; ni ibawi ẹni marun li ẹnyin o sá: titi ẹnyin o fi kù bi àmi lori oke-nla, ati bi asia lori oke.
entries.en: One thousand shall flee at the rebuke of one; at the rebuke of five shall ye flee: till ye be left as a beacon upon the top of a mountain, and as an ensign on an hill.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni Oluwa yio duro, ki o le ṣe ore fun nyin, ati nitori eyi li o ṣe ga, ki o le ṣe iyọ́nu si nyin: nitori Oluwa li Ọlọrun idajọ: ibukun ni fun gbogbo awọn ti o duro dè e.
entries.en: And therefore will the LORD wait, that he may be gracious unto you, and therefore will he be exalted, that he may have mercy upon you: for the LORD is a God of judgment: blessed are all they that wait for him.

entries.yo: Nitori awọn enia Sioni yio gbe Jerusalemu, iwọ kì yio sọkun mọ: yio ṣanu fun ọ gidigidi nigbati iwọ ba nkigbe; nigbati on ba gbọ́ ọ, yio dá ọ lohùn.
entries.en: For the people shall dwell in Zion at Jerusalem: thou shalt weep no more: he will be very gracious unto thee at the voice of thy cry; when he shall hear it, he will answer thee.

entries.yo: Oluwa yio si fi onjẹ ipọnju, ati omi inira fun nyin, awọn olukọ́ni rẹ kì yio sápamọ́ mọ, ṣugbọn oju rẹ yio ri olukọ́ni rẹ̀:
entries.en: And though the Lord give you the bread of adversity, and the water of affliction, yet shall not thy teachers be removed into a corner any more, but thine eyes shall see thy teachers:

entries.yo: Eti rẹ o si gbọ́ ọ̀rọ kan lẹhin rẹ, wipe, Eyiyi li ọ̀na, ẹ ma rin ninu rẹ̀, nigbati ẹnyin bá yi si apa ọtún, tabi nigbati ẹnyin bá yi si apa òsi.
entries.en: And thine ears shall hear a word behind thee, saying, This is the way, walk ye in it, when ye turn to the right hand, and when ye turn to the left.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin o si sọ ibora ere fadaka nyin wọnni di aimọ́, ati ọṣọ́ ere wura didà nyin wọnni: iwọ o sọ wọn nù bi ohun-aimọ́, iwọ o si wi fun u pe, Kuro nihinyi.
entries.en: Ye shall defile also the covering of thy graven images of silver, and the ornament of thy molten images of gold: thou shalt cast them away as a menstruous cloth; thou shalt say unto it, Get thee hence.

entries.yo: On o si rọ̀ òjo si irugbin rẹ ti iwọ ti fọ́n si ilẹ: ati onjẹ ibísi ilẹ, yio li ọrá yio si pọ̀: li ọjọ na ni awọn ẹran rẹ yio ma jẹ̀ ni pápa oko nla.
entries.en: Then shall he give the rain of thy seed, that thou shalt sow the ground withal; and bread of the increase of the earth, and it shall be fat and plenteous: in that day shall thy cattle feed in large pastures.

entries.yo: Awọn akọ-malu pẹlu, ati awọn ọmọ kẹtẹkẹtẹ ti ntulẹ yio jẹ oko didùn, ti a ti fi kọ̀nkọsọ ati atẹ fẹ.
entries.en: The oxen likewise and the young asses that ear the ground shall eat clean provender, which hath been winnowed with the shovel and with the fan.

entries.yo: Ati lori gbogbo oke-nla giga, ati lori gbogbo oke kékèké ti o ga, ni odò ati ipa-omi yio wà li ọjọ pipa nla, nigbati ile-iṣọ́ wọnni bá wó.
entries.en: And there shall be upon every high mountain, and upon every high hill, rivers and streams of waters in the day of the great slaughter, when the towers fall.

entries.yo: Imọ́lẹ oṣupa yio si dabi imọ́lẹ õrun, imọ́lẹ õrun yio si ràn ni iwọ̀n igbà meje, bi imọ́lẹ ọjọ meje, li ọjọ ti Oluwa dí yiya awọn enia rẹ̀, ti o si ṣe àwotán ọgbẹ ti a ṣá wọn.
entries.en: Moreover the light of the moon shall be as the light of the sun, and the light of the sun shall be sevenfold, as the light of seven days, in the day that the LORD bindeth up the breach of his people, and healeth the stroke of their wound.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, orukọ Ọluwa mbọ̀ lati ọ̀na jijin wá, ibinu rẹ̀ si njo, ẹrù rẹ̀ si wuwo: ète rẹ̀ si kún fun ikannu, ati ahọn rẹ̀ bi ajonirun iná:
entries.en: Behold, the name of the LORD cometh from far, burning with his anger, and the burden thereof is heavy: his lips are full of indignation, and his tongue as a devouring fire:

entries.yo: Ẽmi rẹ̀ bi kikun omi, yio si de ãrin-meji ọrùn, lati fi kọ̀nkọsọ kù awọn orilẹ-ède: ijanu yio si wà li ẹ̀rẹkẹ́ awọn enia, lati mu wọn ṣina.
entries.en: And his breath, as an overflowing stream, shall reach to the midst of the neck, to sift the nations with the sieve of vanity: and there shall be a bridle in the jaws of the people, causing them to err.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin o li orin kan, gẹgẹ bi igbati a nṣe ajọ li oru; ati didùn inu, bi igbati ẹnikan fun fère lọ, lati wá si òke-nla Oluwa, sọdọ Apata Israeli.
entries.en: Ye shall have a song, as in the night when a holy solemnity is kept; and gladness of heart, as when one goeth with a pipe to come into the mountain of the LORD, to the mighty One of Israel.

entries.yo: Oluwa yio si mu ki a gbọ́ ohùn ogo rẹ̀, yio si fi isọkalẹ apá rẹ̀ hàn pẹlu ikannu ibinu rẹ̀, ati pẹlu ọwọ́ ajonirun iná, pẹlu ifúnka, ati ijì, ati yinyín.
entries.en: And the LORD shall cause his glorious voice to be heard, and shall shew the lighting down of his arm, with the indignation of his anger, and with the flame of a devouring fire, with scattering, and tempest, and hailstones.

entries.yo: Nitori nipa ohùn Oluwa li a o fi lù awọn ara Assiria bo ilẹ, ti o fi kùmọ lù.
entries.en: For through the voice of the LORD shall the Assyrian be beaten down, which smote with a rod.

entries.yo: Ati nibi gbogbo ti paṣán ti a yàn ba kọja si, ti Oluwa yio fi lé e, yio ṣe pẹlu tabreti ati dùru: yio si fi irọ́kẹ̀kẹ ogun bá a jà.
entries.en: And in every place where the grounded staff shall pass, which the LORD shall lay upon him, it shall be with tabrets and harps: and in battles of shaking will he fight with it.

entries.yo: Nitori a ti yàn Tofeti lati igbà atijọ; nitõtọ, ọba li a ti pèse rẹ̀ fun; o ti ṣe e ki o jìn, ki o si gbòro: okiti rẹ̀ ni iná ati igi pupọ; emi Oluwa, bi iṣàn imí-ọjọ́ ntàn iná ràn a.
entries.en: For Tophet is ordained of old; yea, for the king it is prepared; he hath made it deep and large: the pile thereof is fire and much wood; the breath of the LORD, like a stream of brimstone, doth kindle it.

entries.yo: EGBE ni fun awọn ti o sọkalẹ lọ si Egipti fun iranlọwọ; ti nwọn gbẹkẹlẹ ẹṣin, ti nwọn gbiyèle kẹkẹ́, nitoriti nwọn pọ̀: nwọn si gbẹkẹle ẹlẹṣin nitoriti nwọn li agbara jọjọ; ṣugbọn ti nwọn kò wò Ẹni-Mimọ Israeli, nwọn kò si wá Oluwa!
entries.en: Woe to them that go down to Egypt for help; and stay on horses, and trust in chariots, because they are many; and in horsemen, because they are very strong; but they look not unto the Holy One of Israel, neither seek the LORD!

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn on gbọ́n pẹlu, o si mu ibi wá, kì yio si dá ọ̀rọ rẹ̀ padà: on si dide si ile awọn oluṣe buburu, ati si oluranlọwọ awọn ti nṣiṣẹ aiṣedede.
entries.en: Yet he also is wise, and will bring evil, and will not call back his words: but will arise against the house of the evildoers, and against the help of them that work iniquity.

entries.yo: Nitori enia li awọn ara Egipti, nwọn kì iṣe Ọlọrun; ẹran li awọn ẹṣin wọn, nwọn kì si iṣe ẹmi. Oluwa yio si nà ọwọ́ rẹ̀, ki ẹniti nràn ni lọwọ ba le ṣubu, ati ki ẹniti a nràn lọwọ ba lè ṣubu, gbogbo wọn o jùmọ ṣegbe.
entries.en: Now the Egyptians are men, and not God; and their horses flesh, and not spirit. When the LORD shall stretch out his hand, both he that helpeth shall fall, and he that is holpen shall fall down, and they all shall fail together.

entries.yo: Nitori bayi li Oluwa ti wi fun mi pe, Gẹgẹ bi kiniun ati ẹgbọ̀rọ kiniun ti nkùn si ohun-ọdẹ rẹ̀, nigbati a npè ọpọlọpọ oluṣọ́-agutan jade wá si i, ti on kò bẹ̀ru ohùn wọn, ti kò si rẹ̀ ara rẹ̀ silẹ fun ariwo wọn: bẹ̃li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun yio sọkalẹ wá lati jà lori okè-nla Sioni, ati lori oke kékèké rẹ̀.
entries.en: For thus hath the LORD spoken unto me, Like as the lion and the young lion roaring on his prey, when a multitude of shepherds is called forth against him, he will not be afraid of their voice, nor abase himself for the noise of them: so shall the LORD of hosts come down to fight for mount Zion, and for the hill thereof.

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi ẹiyẹ iti fi iyẹ́ apa ṣe, bẹ̃ni Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun yio dabòbo Jerusalemu; ni didãbòbo o pẹlu yio si gbà o silẹ; ni rirekọja on o si dá a si.
entries.en: As birds flying, so will the LORD of hosts defend Jerusalem; defending also he will deliver it; and passing over he will preserve it.

entries.yo: Ẹ yipadà si ẹniti ẹ ti nṣọ̀tẹ si gidigidi, ẹnyin ọmọ Israeli.
entries.en: Turn ye unto him from whom the children of Israel have deeply revolted.

entries.yo: Nitori li ọjọ na ni olukuluku enia yio jù ere fadaka rẹ̀, ati ere wura rẹ̀ nù, ti ọwọ́ ẹnyin tikara nyin ti ṣe fun ẹ̀ṣẹ fun nyin.
entries.en: For in that day every man shall cast away his idols of silver, and his idols of gold, which your own hands have made unto you for a sin.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ara Assiria na yio ṣubú nipa idà, ti kì iṣe nipa idà ọkunrin, ati idà, ti ki iṣe ti enia yio jẹ ẹ: ṣugbọn on o sá kuro niwaju idà, awọn ọdọmọkunrin rẹ̀ yio ma sìnrú.
entries.en: Then shall the Assyrian fall with the sword, not of a mighty man; and the sword, not of a mean man, shall devour him: but he shall flee from the sword, and his young men shall be discomfited.

entries.yo: Apata rẹ̀ yio kọja lọ fun ẹ̀ru, awọn olori rẹ̀ yiọ bẹ̀ru asia na, ni Oluwa wi, ẹniti iná rẹ̀ wà ni Sioni, ati ileru rẹ̀ ni Jerusalemu.
entries.en: And he shall pass over to his strong hold for fear, and his princes shall be afraid of the ensign, saith the LORD, whose fire is in Zion, and his furnace in Jerusalem.

entries.yo: KIYESI i, ọba kan yio jẹ li ododo, awọn olori yio fi idajọ ṣe akoso.
entries.en: Behold, a king shall reign in righteousness, and princes shall rule in judgment.

entries.yo: Ẹnikan yio si jẹ bi ibi isápamọ́ kuro loju ẹfũfu, ati ãbo kuro lọwọ ijì; bi odo-omi ni ibi gbigbẹ, bi ojiji apata nla ni ilẹ gbigbẹ.
entries.en: And a man shall be as an hiding place from the wind, and a covert from the tempest; as rivers of water in a dry place, as the shadow of a great rock in a weary land.

entries.yo: Oju awọn ẹniti o riran kì yio ṣe baibai, ati eti awọn ti o ngbọ́ yio tẹ́ silẹ.
entries.en: And the eyes of them that see shall not be dim, and the ears of them that hear shall hearken.

entries.yo: Ọkàn awọn oniwàduwàdu yio mọ̀ oye, ahọn awọn akolòlo yio sọ̀rọ kedere.
entries.en: The heart also of the rash shall understand knowledge, and the tongue of the stammerers shall be ready to speak plainly.

entries.yo: A kì yio tun pè alaigbọ́n ni ẹni-ọlá mọ, bẹ̃ni a kì yio pe ọ̀bàlújẹ́ ni ẹni pataki mọ.
entries.en: The vile person shall be no more called liberal, nor the churl said to be bountiful.

entries.yo: Nitori eniakenia yio ma sọ isọkusọ, ọkàn rẹ̀ yio si ma ṣiṣẹ aiṣedede, lati ṣe agabàgebe, ati lati ṣì ọ̀rọ sọ si Oluwa, lati sọ ọkàn ẹniti ebi npa di ofo, ati lati mu ki ohun-mimu awọn ti ongbẹ ngbẹ ki o dá.
entries.en: For the vile person will speak villany, and his heart will work iniquity, to practise hypocrisy, and to utter error against the LORD, to make empty the soul of the hungry, and he will cause the drink of the thirsty to fail.

entries.yo: Ibi ni gbogbo ohun-elò enia-kenia jẹ pẹlu: on gbà èro buburu, lati fi ọ̀rọ eke pa talaka run, bi alaini tilẹ nsọ õtọ ọ̀rọ.
entries.en: The instruments also of the churl are evil: he deviseth wicked devices to destroy the poor with lying words, even when the needy speaketh right.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹni-rere a ma gbèro ohun rere; nipa ohun-rere ni yio ṣe duro.
entries.en: But the liberal deviseth liberal things; and by liberal things shall he stand.

entries.yo: Dide, ẹnyin obinrin ti o wà ni irọra; gbọ́ ohùn mi, ẹnyin alafara obinrin; fetisi ọ̀rọ mi.
entries.en: Rise up, ye women that are at ease; hear my voice, ye careless daughters; give ear unto my speech.

entries.yo: Ọpọlọpọ ọjọ, on ọdún, li a o fi ma wahala nyin, ẹnyin alafara obinrin: nitori ikore kì yio si, kikojọ rẹ̀ kì yio de.
entries.en: Many days and years shall ye be troubled, ye careless women: for the vintage shall fail, the gathering shall not come.

entries.yo: Warìri, ẹnyin obinrin ti o wà ni irọra; ki wahala ba nyin ẹnyin alafara: ẹ tú aṣọ, ki ẹ si wà ni ihòho, ki ẹ si dì àmure ẹgbẹ́ nyin.
entries.en: Tremble, ye women that are at ease; be troubled, ye careless ones: strip you, and make you bare, and gird sackcloth upon your loins.

entries.yo: Nwọn o pohùnrere fun ọmú, fun pápa daradara, ati fun àjara eleso.
entries.en: They shall lament for the teats, for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vine.

entries.yo: Ẹgún ọ̀gan on òṣuṣu yio wá sori ilẹ awọn enia mi; nitõtọ, si gbogbo ile ayọ̀ ni ilu alayọ̀.
entries.en: Upon the land of my people shall come up thorns and briers; yea, upon all the houses of joy in the joyous city:

entries.yo: Nitoripe a o kọ̀ ãfin wọnni silẹ; a o fi ilu ariwo na silẹ; odi ati ile-iṣọ́ ni yio di ihò titi lai, ayọ̀ fun kẹtẹkẹ́tẹ-igbẹ, pápa-oko fun ọwọ́-ẹran;
entries.en: Because the palaces shall be forsaken; the multitude of the city shall be left; the forts and towers shall be for dens for ever, a joy of wild asses, a pasture of flocks;

entries.yo: Titi a o fi tú Ẹmi jade si wa lara lati oke wá, ati ti aginju yio fi di ilẹ eléso, ti a o si kà ilẹ eleso si bi igbo.
entries.en: Until the spirit be poured upon us from on high, and the wilderness be a fruitful field, and the fruitful field be counted for a forest.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni idajọ yio ma gbe aginju; ati ododo ninu ilẹ eleso.
entries.en: Then judgment shall dwell in the wilderness, and righteousness remain in the fruitful field.

entries.yo: Iṣẹ ododo yio si jẹ alafia, ati eso ododo yio jẹ idakẹjẹ on ãbo titi lai.
entries.en: And the work of righteousness shall be peace; and the effect of righteousness quietness and assurance for ever.

entries.yo: Awọn enia mi yio si ma gbe ibugbe alafia, ati ni ibugbe idaniloju, ati ni ibi isimi iparọrọ;
entries.en: And my people shall dwell in a peaceable habitation, and in sure dwellings, and in quiet resting places;

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn yio rọ̀ yìnyín, nigbati igbó nṣubu lulẹ; ati ni irẹlẹ a o rẹ̀ ilu na silẹ.
entries.en: When it shall hail, coming down on the forest; and the city shall be low in a low place.

entries.yo: Alabukun fun ni ẹnyin ti nfọ̀nrugbìn niha omi gbogbo, ti nrán ẹṣẹ malu ati ti kẹtẹkẹtẹ jade sibẹ.
entries.en: Blessed are ye that sow beside all waters, that send forth thither the feet of the ox and the ass.

entries.yo: EGBÉ ni fun iwọ abanijẹ, ti a kò si bà ọ jẹ: ti o nhùwa arekereke, ti a kò si hùwa arekereke si ọ! nigbati iwọ o dẹkun ati banijẹ, a o bà ọ jẹ; ati nigbati iwọ bá fi opin si ihùwa arekereke, nwọn o hùwa arekereke si ọ.
entries.en: Woe to thee that spoilest, and thou wast not spoiled; and dealest treacherously, and they dealt not treacherously with thee! when thou shalt cease to spoil, thou shalt be spoiled; and when thou shalt make an end to deal treacherously, they shall deal treacherously with thee.

entries.yo: Oluwa, ṣãnu fun wa; awa ti duro dè ọ: iwọ mã ṣe apá wọn li òròwúrọ̀ ani igbala wa nigba ipọnju.
entries.en: O LORD, be gracious unto us; we have waited for thee: be thou their arm every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.

entries.yo: Li ariwo irọ́kẹ̀kẹ li awọn enia sá, ni gbigbe ara rẹ soke li a fọ́n awọn orilẹ-ède ká.
entries.en: At the noise of the tumult the people fled; at the lifting up of thyself the nations were scattered.

entries.yo: A o si ṣà ikogun nyin jọ bi ikojọ awọn ẹlẹngà: bi isure siwa, isure sẹhìn awọn eṣú, li on o sure si wọn.
entries.en: And your spoil shall be gathered like the gathering of the caterpiller: as the running to and fro of locusts shall he run upon them.

entries.yo: Gbigbega li Oluwa; nitori on ngbe ibi giga: on ti fi idajọ ati ododo kún Sioni.
entries.en: The LORD is exalted; for he dwelleth on high: he hath filled Zion with judgment and righteousness.

entries.yo: On o si jẹ iduroṣinṣin akoko rẹ̀, iṣura igbala, ọgbọ́n ati ìmọ; ìbẹru Oluwa ni yio jẹ iṣura rẹ̀.
entries.en: And wisdom and knowledge shall be the stability of thy times, and strength of salvation: the fear of the LORD is his treasure.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, awọn akọni kigbe lode, awọn ikọ̀ alafia sọkún kikorò.
entries.en: Behold, their valiant ones shall cry without: the ambassadors of peace shall weep bitterly.

entries.yo: Ọ̀na opopo nla wọnni ṣófo, èro dá, on ti bà majẹmu jẹ, o ti kẹgàn ilu wọnni, kò kà ẹnikan si.
entries.en: The highways lie waste, the wayfaring man ceaseth: he hath broken the covenant, he hath despised the cities, he regardeth no man.

entries.yo: Ilẹ ngbawẹ̀ o si njoro, oju ntì Lebanoni o si rọ: Ṣaroni dabi aginju; ati Baṣani ati Karmeli gbọ̀n eso wọn danù.
entries.en: The earth mourneth and languisheth: Lebanon is ashamed and hewn down: Sharon is like a wilderness; and Bashan and Carmel shake off their fruits.

entries.yo: Oluwa wipe, nisisiyi li emi o dide, nisisiyi li emi o gbe ara mi soke.
entries.en: Now will I rise, saith the LORD; now will I be exalted; now will I lift up myself.

entries.yo: Ẹ o loyun iyangbò, ẹ o si bi pòropóro; ẽmi nyin, bi iná, yio jẹ nyin run.
entries.en: Ye shall conceive chaff, ye shall bring forth stubble: your breath, as fire, shall devour you.

entries.yo: Awọn enia yio si dabi sisun ẽru, bi ẹgún ti a ké ni nwọn o jo ninu iná.
entries.en: And the people shall be as the burnings of lime: as thorns cut up shall they be burned in the fire.

entries.yo: Ẹ gbọ́, ẹnyin ti o jìna rére, eyi ti mo ti ṣe; ati ẹnyin ti o sunmọ tosí, ẹ jẹwọ agbara mi.
entries.en: Hear, ye that are far off, what I have done; and, ye that are near, acknowledge my might.

entries.yo: Ẹ̀ru bà awọn ẹlẹṣẹ̀ ni Sioni; ibẹru-bojo ti mu awọn agabàgebè. Tani ninu wa ti o le gbe inu ajonirun iná? tani ninu wa ti yio le gbe inu iná ainipẹkun?
entries.en: The sinners in Zion are afraid; fearfulness hath surprised the hypocrites. Who among us shall dwell with the devouring fire? who among us shall dwell with everlasting burnings?

entries.yo: Ẹniti nrìn li ododo, ti o si nsọ̀rọ titọ́; ẹniti o gàn ère ininilara, ti o gbọ̀n ọwọ́ rẹ̀ kuro ni gbigbà abẹtẹlẹ, ti o di eti rẹ ni gbigbọ́ ti ẹ̀jẹ, ti o si di oju rẹ̀ ni riri ibi.
entries.en: He that walketh righteously, and speaketh uprightly; he that despiseth the gain of oppressions, that shaketh his hands from holding of bribes, that stoppeth his ears from hearing of blood, and shutteth his eyes from seeing evil;

entries.yo: On na yio gbe ibi giga: ile apáta yio ṣe ibi ãbo rẹ̀: a o fi onjẹ fun u; omi rẹ̀ yio si daju.
entries.en: He shall dwell on high: his place of defence shall be the munitions of rocks: bread shall be given him; his waters shall be sure.

entries.yo: Oju rẹ̀ yio ri ọba ninu ẹwà rẹ̀: nwọn o ma wò ilẹ ti o jina réré.
entries.en: Thine eyes shall see the king in his beauty: they shall behold the land that is very far off.

entries.yo: Aiyà rẹ yio ṣe aṣaro ẹ̀ru nla. Nibo ni akọwe wà? nibo ni ẹniti nwọ̀n nkan gbe wà? nibo ni ẹniti o nkà ile-ẹ̀ṣọ wọnni gbe wà?
entries.en: Thine heart shall meditate terror. Where is the scribe? where is the receiver? where is he that counted the towers?

entries.yo: Iwọ kì yio ri awọn enia ti o muná; awọn enia ti ọ̀rọ wọn jinlẹ jù eyiti iwọ le gbọ́, ti ahọn wọn ṣe ololò, ti kò le ye ọ.
entries.en: Thou shalt not see a fierce people, a people of a deeper speech than thou canst perceive; of a stammering tongue, that thou canst not understand.

entries.yo: Wo Sioni, ilu ajọ afiyesi wa: oju rẹ yio ri Jerusalemu ibugbe idakẹjẹ, agọ́ ti a kì yio tú palẹ mọ; kò si ọkan ninu ẽkàn rẹ ti a o ṣí ni ipò lai, bẹ̃ni kì yio si ọkan ninu okùn rẹ̀ ti yio já.
entries.en: Look upon Zion, the city of our solemnities: thine eyes shall see Jerusalem a quiet habitation, a tabernacle that shall not be taken down; not one of the stakes thereof shall ever be removed, neither shall any of the cords thereof be broken.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nibẹ ni Oluwa ogo yio ri fun wa, bi ibi odò gbigbòro on odò ṣiṣàn; nibiti ọkọ̀ alajẹ̀ kì yio kọja, bẹ̃ni ọkọ̀ nlanla ki yio là a ja.
entries.en: But there the glorious LORD will be unto us a place of broad rivers and streams; wherein shall go no galley with oars, neither shall gallant ship pass thereby.

entries.yo: Nitori Oluwa ni onidajọ wa, Oluwa li olofin wa, Oluwa li ọba wa; on o gbà wa là.
entries.en: For the LORD is our judge, the LORD is our lawgiver, the LORD is our king; he will save us.

entries.yo: Okùn opó-ọkọ̀ rẹ tú; nwọn kò le dì opó-ọkọ̀ mu le danin-danin, nwọn kò le ta igbokun: nigbana li a pin ikogun nla; amúkun ko ikogun.
entries.en: Thy tacklings are loosed; they could not well strengthen their mast, they could not spread the sail: then is the prey of a great spoil divided; the lame take the prey.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ará ibẹ̀ ki yio wipe, Ara mi kò yá: a o dari aiṣedede awọn enia ti ngbe ibẹ jì wọn.
entries.en: And the inhabitant shall not say, I am sick: the people that dwell therein shall be forgiven their iniquity.

entries.yo: SUNMỌ tosí, ẹnyin orilẹ-ède lati gbọ́, tẹtisilẹ ẹnyin enia, jẹ ki aiye gbọ́, ati ẹ̀kun rẹ̀; aiye ati ohun gbogbo ti o ti inu rẹ̀ jade.
entries.en: Come near, ye nations, to hear; and hearken, ye people: let the earth hear, and all that is therein; the world, and all things that come forth of it.

entries.yo: Nitori ibinu Oluwa mbẹ lara gbogbo orilẹ-ède, ati irúnu rẹ̀ lori gbogbo ogun wọn: o ti pa wọn run patapata, o ti fi wọn fun pipa.
entries.en: For the indignation of the LORD is upon all nations, and his fury upon all their armies: he hath utterly destroyed them, he hath delivered them to the slaughter.

entries.yo: Awọn ti a pa ninu wọn li a o si jù sode, õrùn wọn yio ti inu okú wọn jade, awọn oke-nla yio si yọ́ nipa ẹ̀jẹ wọn.
entries.en: Their slain also shall be cast out, and their stink shall come up out of their carcases, and the mountains shall be melted with their blood.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn ogun ọrun ni yio di yiyọ́, a o si ká awọn ọrun jọ bi takàda, gbogbo ogun wọn yio si ṣubu lulẹ, bi ewe ti ibọ́ kuro lara àjara, ati bi bibọ́ eso lara igi ọ̀pọtọ́.
entries.en: And all the host of heaven shall be dissolved, and the heavens shall be rolled together as a scroll: and all their host shall fall down, as the leaf falleth off from the vine, and as a falling fig from the fig tree.

entries.yo: Nitori ti a rẹ́ idà mi li ọrun, kiyesi i, yio sọkalẹ wá sori Idumea, ati sori awọn enia egún mi, fun idajọ.
entries.en: For my sword shall be bathed in heaven: behold, it shall come down upon Idumea, and upon the people of my curse, to judgment.

entries.yo: Idà Oluwa kun fun ẹ̀jẹ, a mu u sanra fun ọ̀ra, ati fun ẹ̀jẹ ọdọ-agutan ati ewurẹ, fun ọrá erẽ àgbo: nitoriti Oluwa ni irubọ kan ni Bosra, ati ipakupa nla kan ni ilẹ Idumea.
entries.en: The sword of the LORD is filled with blood, it is made fat with fatness, and with the blood of lambs and goats, with the fat of the kidneys of rams: for the LORD hath a sacrifice in Bozrah, and a great slaughter in the land of Idumea.

entries.yo: Ati awọn agbanrere yio bá wọn sọkalẹ wá, ati awọn ẹgbọ̀rọ malu pẹlu awọn akọ malu; ilẹ wọn li a o fi ẹ̀jẹ rin, a o si fi ọ̀rá sọ ekuru wọn di ọlọ́ra.
entries.en: And the unicorns shall come down with them, and the bullocks with the bulls; and their land shall be soaked with blood, and their dust made fat with fatness.

entries.yo: Nitori ọjọ ẹsan Oluwa ni, ati ọdun isanpadà, nitori ọ̀ran Sioni.
entries.en: For it is the day of the LORD's vengeance, and the year of recompences for the controversy of Zion.

entries.yo: Odò rẹ̀ li a o si sọ di ọ̀dà, ati ekuru rẹ̀ di imi-õrun, ilẹ rẹ̀ yio si di ọ̀dà ti njona.
entries.en: And the streams thereof shall be turned into pitch, and the dust thereof into brimstone, and the land thereof shall become burning pitch.

entries.yo: A kì o pa a li oru tabi li ọsan; ẹ̃fin rẹ̀ yio goke lailai: yio dahoro lati iran de iran; kò si ẹnikan ti yio là a kọja lai ati lailai.
entries.en: It shall not be quenched night nor day; the smoke thereof shall go up for ever: from generation to generation it shall lie waste; none shall pass through it for ever and ever.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹiyẹ ofú ati àkala ni yio ni i; ati owiwi ati iwò ni yio ma gbe inu rẹ̀: on o si nà okùn iparun sori rẹ̀, ati okuta ofo.
entries.en: But the cormorant and the bittern shall possess it; the owl also and the raven shall dwell in it: and he shall stretch out upon it the line of confusion, and the stones of emptiness.

entries.yo: Niti awọn ijoye rẹ̀ ẹnikan kì yio si nibẹ ti nwọn o pè wá si ijọba, gbogbo awọn olori rẹ̀ yio si di asan.
entries.en: They shall call the nobles thereof to the kingdom, but none shall be there, and all her princes shall be nothing.

entries.yo: Ẹgún yio si hù jade ninu ãfin rẹ̀ wọnni, ẹgún ọ̀gan ninu ilú olodi rẹ̀: yio jẹ ibugbé awọn dragoni, ati agbalá fun awọn owiwi.
entries.en: And thorns shall come up in her palaces, nettles and brambles in the fortresses thereof: and it shall be an habitation of dragons, and a court for owls.

entries.yo: Awọn ẹran ijù ati awọn ọ̀wawa ni yio pade, ati satire kan yio ma kọ si ekeji rẹ̀; iwin yio ma gbe ibẹ̀ pẹlu, yio si ri ibí isimi fun ara rẹ̀.
entries.en: The wild beasts of the desert shall also meet with the wild beasts of the island, and the satyr shall cry to his fellow; the screech owl also shall rest there, and find for herself a place of rest.

entries.yo: Owiwi yio tẹ́ itẹ́ rẹ̀ sibẹ̀, yio yé, yio si pa, yio si kojọ labẹ ojiji rẹ̀: awọn gúnugú yio pejọ sibẹ pẹlu, olukuluku pẹlu ẹnikeji rẹ̀.
entries.en: There shall the great owl make her nest, and lay, and hatch, and gather under her shadow: there shall the vultures also be gathered, every one with her mate.

entries.yo: Ẹ wá a ninu iwe Oluwa, ẹ si kà a: ọkan ninu wọnyi kì yio yẹ̀, kò si ọkan ti yio fẹ́ ekeji rẹ̀ kù: nitori ẹnu mi on li o ti paṣẹ, ẹmi rẹ̀ li o ti ko wọn jọ.
entries.en: Seek ye out of the book of the LORD, and read: no one of these shall fail, none shall want her mate: for my mouth it hath commanded, and his spirit it hath gathered them.

entries.yo: On ti dì ìbo fun wọn, ọwọ́ rẹ̀ si fi tita okùn pin i fun wọn: nwọn o jogun rẹ̀ lailai, lati iran de iran ni nwọn o ma gbe inu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he hath cast the lot for them, and his hand hath divided it unto them by line: they shall possess it for ever, from generation to generation shall they dwell therein.

entries.yo: AGINJU ati ilẹ gbigbẹ yio yọ̀ fun wọn; ijù yio yọ̀, yio si tanna bi lili.
entries.en: The wilderness and the solitary place shall be glad for them; and the desert shall rejoice, and blossom as the rose.

entries.yo: Ni titanna yio tanna; yio si yọ̀ ani pẹlu ayọ̀ ati orin: ogo Lebanoni li a o fi fun u, ẹwà Karmeli on Ṣaroni; nwọn o ri ogo Oluwa, ati ẹwà Ọlọrun wa.
entries.en: It shall blossom abundantly, and rejoice even with joy and singing: the glory of Lebanon shall be given unto it, the excellency of Carmel and Sharon, they shall see the glory of the LORD, and the excellency of our God.

entries.yo: Ẹ mu ọwọ́ ailera le, ẹ si mu ẽkun ailera lokun.
entries.en: Strengthen ye the weak hands, and confirm the feeble knees.

entries.yo: Ẹ sọ fun awọn alailaiyà pe, ẹ tujuka, ẹ má bẹ̀ru: wò o, Ọlọrun nyin o wá ti on ti ẹsan, Ọlọrun ti on ti igbẹsan; on o wá, yio si gbà nyin.
entries.en: Say to them that are of a fearful heart, Be strong, fear not: behold, your God will come with vengeance, even God with a recompence; he will come and save you.

entries.yo: Nigbana li oju awọn afọju yio là, eti awọn aditi yio si ṣi.
entries.en: Then the eyes of the blind shall be opened, and the ears of the deaf shall be unstopped.

entries.yo: Nigbana li awọn arọ yio fò bi agbọ̀nrin, ati ahọ́n odi yio kọrin: nitori omi yio tú jade li aginju, ati iṣàn omi ni ijù.
entries.en: Then shall the lame man leap as an hart, and the tongue of the dumb sing: for in the wilderness shall waters break out, and streams in the desert.

entries.yo: Ilẹ yíyan yio si di àbata, ati ilẹ ongbẹ yio di isun omi; ni ibugbé awọn dragoni, nibiti olukuluku dubulẹ, ni o jẹ ọgbà fun ẽsú on iyè.
entries.en: And the parched ground shall become a pool, and the thirsty land springs of water: in the habitation of dragons, where each lay, shall be grass with reeds and rushes.

entries.yo: Opopo kan yio si wà nibẹ, ati ọ̀na kan, a o si ma pè e ni, Ọ̀na iwà-mimọ́; alaimọ́ kì yio kọja nibẹ; nitori on o wà pẹlu wọn: awọn èro ọ̀na na, bi nwọn tilẹ jẹ òpe, nwọn kì yio ṣì i.
entries.en: And an highway shall be there, and a way, and it shall be called The way of holiness; the unclean shall not pass over it; but it shall be for those: the wayfaring men, though fools, shall not err therein.

entries.yo: Kiniun kì yio si nibẹ, bẹ̃ni ẹranko buburu kì yio gùn u, a kì yio ri i nibẹ; ṣugbọn awọn ti a ràpada ni yio ma rìn nibẹ:
entries.en: No lion shall be there, nor any ravenous beast shall go up thereon, it shall not be found there; but the redeemed shall walk there:

entries.yo: Awọn ẹni-iràpada Oluwa yio padà, nwọn o wá si Sioni ti awọn ti orin, ayọ̀ ainipẹkun yio si wà li ori wọn: nwọn o ri ayọ̀ ati inu didùn gbà, ikãnu on imí-ẹ̀dùn yio si fò lọ.
entries.en: And the ransomed of the LORD shall return, and come to Zion with songs and everlasting joy upon their heads: they shall obtain joy and gladness, and sorrow and sighing shall flee away.

entries.yo: O si di igbati o ṣe li ọdun ikẹrinla Hesekiah ọba, Sennakeribu ọba Assiria wá dótì gbogbo ilu olodi Juda, o si kó wọn.
entries.en: Now it came to pass in the fourteenth year of king Hezekiah, that Sennacherib king of Assyria came up against all the defenced cities of Judah, and took them.
