entries.yo: Ọba Assiria si rán Rabṣake lati Lakiṣi lọ si Jerusalemu, ti on ti ogun nla, sọdọ Hesekiah ọba. O si duro lẹba idari omi abàta oke, li opopo pápa afọṣọ.
entries.en: And the king of Assyria sent Rabshakeh from Lachish to Jerusalem unto king Hezekiah with a great army. And he stood by the conduit of the upper pool in the highway of the fuller's field.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Eliakimu ọmọ Hilkia, olùtọ́ju ile, jade tọ̀ ọ wá, pẹlu Ṣebna akọwe, ati Joa ọmọ Asafu, akọwe iranti.
entries.en: Then came forth unto him Eliakim, Hilkiah's son, which was over the house, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, Asaph's son, the recorder.

entries.yo: Rabṣake si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ wi fun Hesekiah nisisiyi, pe, Bayi li ọba nla, ọba Assiria wi, pe, Igbẹkẹle wo ni eyi ti iwọ gbe ara le yi?
entries.en: And Rabshakeh said unto them, Say ye now to Hezekiah, Thus saith the great king, the king of Assyria, What confidence is this wherein thou trustest?

entries.yo: Iwọ wi pe, Mo ni, (ṣugbọn ọ̀rọ ète lasan ni nwọn) emi ni ìmọ ati agbara fun ogun jija: njẹ tani iwọ tilẹ gbẹkẹle ti iwọ fi nṣọ̀tẹ si mi?
entries.en: I say, sayest thou, (but they are but vain words) I have counsel and strength for war: now on whom dost thou trust, that thou rebellest against me?

entries.yo: Wò o, iwọ gbẹkẹle ọpá iyè fifọ́ yi, le Egipti; eyiti bi ẹnikẹni ba fi ara tì, yio wọnu ọwọ́ rẹ̀, yio si gún u: bẹ̃ni Farao ọba Egipti ri si gbogbo awọn ti o gbẹkẹle e.
entries.en: Lo, thou trustest in the staff of this broken reed, on Egypt; whereon if a man lean, it will go into his hand, and pierce it: so is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all that trust in him.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi iwọ ba wi fun mi pe, Awa gbẹkẹle Oluwa Ọlọrun wa: on kọ́ ẹniti Hesekiah ti mu ibi giga rẹ̀ wọnni, ati pẹpẹ rẹ̀, wọnni kuro, ti o si wi fun Juda ati Jerusalemu pe, ẹnyin o ma sìn niwaju pẹpẹ yi?
entries.en: But if thou say to me, We trust in the LORD our God: is it not he, whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah hath taken away, and said to Judah and to Jerusalem, Ye shall worship before this altar?

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, emi bẹ̀ ọ, mu ohun-iyàn wá fun oluwa mi ọba Assiria, emi o si fun ọ li ẹgbã ẹṣin, bi iwọ nipa tirẹ ba le ni enia to lati gùn wọn.
entries.en: Now therefore give pledges, I pray thee, to my master the king of Assyria, and I will give thee two thousand horses, if thou be able on thy part to set riders upon them.

entries.yo: Njẹ iwọ o ti ṣe le yi oju balogun kan pada ninu awọn ti o rẹhin jù ninu awọn iranṣẹ oluwa mi, ti iwọ si ngbẹkẹ rẹ le Egipti fun kẹkẹ́, ati fun ẹlẹṣin?
entries.en: How then wilt thou turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master's servants, and put thy trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?

entries.yo: Emi ha dá goke wá nisisiyi lẹhin Oluwa si ilẹ yi lati pa a run bi? Oluwa wi fun mi pe, Goke lọ si ilẹ yi, ki o si pa a run.
entries.en: And am I now come up without the LORD against this land to destroy it? the LORD said unto me, Go up against this land, and destroy it.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Eliakimu ati Ṣebna ati Joa wi fun Rabṣake pe, Mo bẹ̀ ọ, ba awọn ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ sọ̀rọ li ède Siria, nitori awa gbọ́: má si ṣe ba wa sọ̀rọ li ède Ju, li eti awọn enia ti o wà lori odi.
entries.en: Then said Eliakim and Shebna and Joah unto Rabshakeh, Speak, I pray thee, unto thy servants in the Syrian language; for we understand it: and speak not to us in the Jews' language, in the ears of the people that are on the wall.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Rabṣake wipe, Oluwa mi ha rán mi si oluwa rẹ lati sọ ọ̀rọ wọnyi? kò ha ran mi sọdọ awọn ọkunrin ti o joko lori odi, ki nwọn ki o le ma jẹ igbẹ́ ara wọn, ki nwọn si ma mu ìtọ ara wọn pẹlu nyin?
entries.en: But Rabshakeh said, Hath my master sent me to thy master and to thee to speak these words? hath he not sent me to the men that sit upon the wall, that they may eat their own dung, and drink their own piss with you?

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Rabṣake duro, o si fi ohùn rara kigbe li ède awọn Ju, o si wipe, Ẹ gbọ́ ọ̀rọ ọba nla, ọba Assiria.
entries.en: Then Rabshakeh stood, and cried with a loud voice in the Jews' language, and said, Hear ye the words of the great king, the king of Assyria.

entries.yo: Bayi ni ọba na wi, pe, Ẹ máṣe jẹ ki Hesekiah tàn nyin jẹ: nitori on kì o lè gbà nyin.
entries.en: Thus saith the king, Let not Hezekiah deceive you: for he shall not be able to deliver you.

entries.yo: Ẹ máṣe jẹ ki Hesekiah ki o mu nyin gbẹkẹle Oluwa, wipe, Ni gbigbà Oluwa yio gbà wa, a ki o fi ilu yi le ọba Assiria lọwọ.
entries.en: Neither let Hezekiah make you trust in the LORD, saying, The LORD will surely deliver us: this city shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.

entries.yo: Ẹ máṣe fetisi ti Hesekiah: nitori bayi li ọba Assiria wi pe, Ẹ fi ẹ̀bun bá mi rẹ́, ki ẹ si jade tọ̀ mi wá: ki olukuluku nyin ma jẹ ninu àjara rẹ̀, ati olukuluku nyin ninu igi ọ̀pọtọ́ rẹ̀, ki olukuluku nyin si ma mu omi ninu àmu on tikalarẹ̀;
entries.en: Hearken not to Hezekiah: for thus saith the king of Assyria, Make an agreement with me by a present, and come out to me: and eat ye every one of his vine, and every one of his fig tree, and drink ye every one the waters of his own cistern;

entries.yo: Titi emi o fi wá lati mu nyin lọ si ilẹ kan bi ilẹ ẹnyin tikala nyin, ilẹ ọkà ati ọti-waini, ilẹ onjẹ ati ọ̀gba àjara.
entries.en: Until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of corn and wine, a land of bread and vineyards.

entries.yo: Ẹ ṣọra ki Hesekiah ki o má pa nyin niyè dà wipe, Oluwa yio gbà wa, ọkan ninu òriṣa awọn orilẹ-ède ha gba ilẹ rẹ̀ lọwọ ọba Assiria ri bi?
entries.en: Beware lest Hezekiah persuade you, saying, The LORD will deliver us. Hath any of the gods of the nations delivered his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria?

entries.yo: Nibo li awọn òriṣa Hamati on Arfardi gbe wà? Nibo li awọn òriṣa Sefarfaimu wà? nwọn ha si ti gbà Samaria li ọwọ́ mi bi?
entries.en: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arphad? where are the gods of Sepharvaim? and have they delivered Samaria out of my hand?

entries.yo: Tani ninu gbogbo oriṣa ilẹ wọnyi, ti o ti gbà ilẹ wọn kuro li ọwọ́ mi, ti Oluwa yio fi gbà Jerusalemu kuro li ọwọ́ mi?
entries.en: Who are they among all the gods of these lands, that have delivered their land out of my hand, that the LORD should deliver Jerusalem out of my hand?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nwọn dakẹ, nwọn kò si da a lohùn ọ̀rọ kan: nitoriti aṣẹ ọba ni, pe, Ẹ máṣe da a lohùn.
entries.en: But they held their peace, and answered him not a word: for the king's commandment was, saying, Answer him not.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Eliakimu, ọmọ Hilkia, ti iṣe olutọju ile, ati Ṣebna akọwe, ati Joa, ọmọ Asafu akọwe iranti, wá sọdọ Hesekiah ti awọn ti aṣọ wọn ni fifàya, nwọn si sọ ọ̀rọ Rabṣake fun u.
entries.en: Then came Eliakim, the son of Hilkiah, that was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, the son of Asaph, the recorder, to Hezekiah with their clothes rent, and told him the words of Rabshakeh.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati Hesekiah ọba gbọ́, o fà aṣọ rẹ̀ ya, o si fi aṣọ ọ̀fọ bora, o si lọ sinu ile Oluwa.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when king Hezekiah heard it, that he rent his clothes, and covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the house of the LORD.

entries.yo: O si ran Eliakimu, ti o ṣe olutọju ile, ati Ṣebna akọwe, ati awọn agba alufa ti nwọn fi aṣọ ọ̀fọ bora, sọdọ Isaiah woli, ọmọ Amosi.
entries.en: And he sent Eliakim, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests covered with sackcloth, unto Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz.

entries.yo: Nwọn si wi fun u pe, Bayi ni Hesekiah wi, Oni jẹ ọjọ wahalà, ati ibawi, ati ẹgàn: nitori awọn ọmọ de igbà ibí, agbara kò si si lati bí wọn.
entries.en: And they said unto him, Thus saith Hezekiah, This day is a day of trouble, and of rebuke, and of blasphemy: for the children are come to the birth, and there is not strength to bring forth.

entries.yo: Bọya Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ yio gbọ́ ọ̀rọ Rabṣake, ẹniti oluwa rẹ̀ ọba Assiria ti rán lati gàn Ọlọrun alãyè, yio si ba ọ̀rọ ti Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ ti gbọ́ wi: nitorina gbe adura rẹ soke fun awọn iyokù ti o kù.
entries.en: It may be the LORD thy God will hear the words of Rabshakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master hath sent to reproach the living God, and will reprove the words which the LORD thy God hath heard: wherefore lift up thy prayer for the remnant that is left.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni awọn iranṣẹ Hesekiah ọba wá sọdọ Isaiah.
entries.en: So the servants of king Hezekiah came to Isaiah.

entries.yo: Isaiah si wi fun wọn pe, Bayi ni ki ẹ wi fun oluwa nyin, pe, Bayi ni Oluwa wi, Máṣe bẹ̀ru ọ̀rọ ti iwọ ti gbọ́, nipa eyiti awọn iranṣẹ ọba Assiria ti fi sọ̀rọ buburu si mi.
entries.en: And Isaiah said unto them, Thus shall ye say unto your master, Thus saith the LORD, Be not afraid of the words that thou hast heard, wherewith the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.

entries.yo: Wò o, emi o fi ẽmi kan sinu rẹ̀, on o si gbọ́ iró kan, yio si pada si ilu on tikalarẹ̀; emi o si mu ki o ti ipa idà ṣubu ni ilẹ on tikalarẹ̀.
entries.en: Behold, I will send a blast upon him, and he shall hear a rumour, and return to his own land; and I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Rabṣake padà, o si ba ọba Assiria mba Libna jagun: nitori ti o ti gbọ́ pe o ti kuro ni Lakiṣi.
entries.en: So Rabshakeh returned, and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah: for he had heard that he was departed from Lachish.

entries.yo: O si gbọ́ a nwi niti Tirhaka ọba Etiopia, pe, O mbọ̀ wá ba iwọ jagun. Nigbati o si gbọ́, o rán awọn ikọ̀ lọ sọdọ Hesekiah, wipe,
entries.en: And he heard say concerning Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, He is come forth to make war with thee. And when he heard it, he sent messengers to Hezekiah, saying,

entries.yo: Bayi ni ki ẹ wi fun Hesekiah ọba Juda, pe, Má jẹ ki Ọlọrun rẹ, ẹniti iwọ gbẹkẹle, ki o tàn ọ jẹ, wipe, A kì yio fi Jerusalemu le ọba Assiria lọwọ.
entries.en: Thus shall ye speak to Hezekiah king of Judah, saying, Let not thy God, in whom thou trustest, deceive thee, saying, Jerusalem shall not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, iwọ ti gbọ́ ohun ti awọn ọba Assiria ti ṣe si ilẹ gbogbo bi nwọn ti pa wọn run patapata: a o si gbà iwọ bi?
entries.en: Behold, thou hast heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands by destroying them utterly; and shalt thou be delivered?

entries.yo: Oriṣa awọn orilẹ-ède ha gbà awọn ti awọn baba mi ti parun bi? bi Gosani, ati Harani ati Resefu, ati awọn ọmọ Edeni ti nwọn ti wà ni Telassari?
entries.en: Have the gods of the nations delivered them which my fathers have destroyed, as Gozan, and Haran, and Rezeph, and the children of Eden which were in Telassar?

entries.yo: Nibo ni ọba Hamati wà, ati ọba Arfadi, ati ọba ilu Sefarfaimu, Hena, ati Ifa?
entries.en: Where is the king of Hamath, and the king of Arphad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivah?

entries.yo: Hesekiah si gbà iwe na lọwọ awọn ikọ̀, o si kà a: Hesekiah si gòke lọ si ile Oluwa, o si tẹ́ ẹ siwaju Oluwa.
entries.en: And Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers, and read it: and Hezekiah went up unto the house of the LORD, and spread it before the LORD.

entries.yo: Hesekiah si gbadura si Oluwa, wipe,
entries.en: And Hezekiah prayed unto the LORD, saying,

entries.yo: Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun, Ọlọrun Israeli, ti ngbe ãrin awọn kerubu, iwọ li Ọlọrun, ani iwọ nikan, ninu gbogbo ijọba aiye: iwọ li o dá ọrun on aiye.
entries.en: O LORD of hosts, God of Israel, that dwellest between the cherubims, thou art the God, even thou alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth: thou hast made heaven and earth.

entries.yo: Dẹti rẹ silẹ, Oluwa, ki o si gbọ́; ṣi oju rẹ, Oluwa, ki o si wò: si gbọ́ gbogbo ọ̀rọ Senakeribu, ti o ranṣẹ lati kẹgàn Ọlọrun alãyè.
entries.en: Incline thine ear, O LORD, and hear; open thine eyes, O LORD, and see: and hear all the words of Sennacherib, which hath sent to reproach the living God.

entries.yo: Lõtọ ni, Oluwa, awọn ọba Assiria ti sọ gbogbo orilẹ-ède di ahoro, ati ilẹ wọn,
entries.en: Of a truth, LORD, the kings of Assyria have laid waste all the nations, and their countries,

entries.yo: Nwọn si ti sọ awọn òriṣa wọn sinu iná: nitori ọlọrun ki nwọn iṣe, ṣugbọn iṣẹ ọwọ́ enia ni, igi ati òkuta: nitorina ni nwọn ṣe pa wọn run.
entries.en: And have cast their gods into the fire: for they were no gods, but the work of men's hands, wood and stone: therefore they have destroyed them.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, Oluwa Ọlọrun wa, gbà wa lọwọ rẹ̀, ki gbogbo ijọba aiye le mọ̀ pe iwọ ni Oluwa, ani iwọ nikanṣoṣo.
entries.en: Now therefore, O LORD our God, save us from his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that thou art the LORD, even thou only.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Isaiah ọmọ Amosi ranṣẹ si Hesekiah, wipe, Bayi ni Oluwa Ọlọrun Israeli wi, niwọ̀n bi iwọ ti gbadura si mi niti Sennakeribu ọba Assiria:
entries.en: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent unto Hezekiah, saying, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Whereas thou hast prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria:

entries.yo: Eyi ni ọ̀rọ ti Oluwa ti sọ niti rẹ̀: Wundia, ọmọbinrin Sioni, ti kẹ́gàn rẹ, o si ti fi ọ rẹrin ẹlẹyà; ọmọbinrin Jerusalemu ti mì ori rẹ̀ si ọ.
entries.en: This is the word which the LORD hath spoken concerning him; The virgin, the daughter of Zion, hath despised thee, and laughed thee to scorn; the daughter of Jerusalem hath shaken her head at thee.

entries.yo: Tani iwọ kẹgàn ti o si sọ̀rọ buburu si? tani iwọ si gbe oju rẹ ga si, ti o si gbe oju rẹ soke gangan? si Ẹni-Mimọ́ Israeli ni.
entries.en: Whom hast thou reproached and blasphemed? and against whom hast thou exalted thy voice, and lifted up thine eyes on high? even against the Holy One of Israel.

entries.yo: Nipasẹ awọn iranṣẹ rẹ li o ti kẹgàn Oluwa, ti o si ti wipe, Ni ọ̀pọlọpọ kẹkẹ́ mi, emi ti goke wá si oke awọn oke giga, si ẹba Lebanoni; emi o si ke igi kedari rẹ̀ giga lulẹ, ati ãyò igi firi rẹ̀, emi o si wá si ẹnu agbègbe rẹ̀, ati si igbó Karmeli rẹ̀.
entries.en: By thy servants hast thou reproached the Lord, and hast said, By the multitude of my chariots am I come up to the height of the mountains, to the sides of Lebanon; and I will cut down the tall cedars thereof, and the choice fir trees thereof: and I will enter into the height of his border, and the forest of his Carmel.

entries.yo: Emi ti wà kanga, mo si ti mu omi; atẹlẹsẹ mi ni mo si ti fi mu gbogbo odò ibi ihamọ gbẹ.
entries.en: I have digged, and drunk water; and with the sole of my feet have I dried up all the rivers of the besieged places.

entries.yo: Iwọ kò ti gbọ́ ri pe, lai emi li o ti ṣe e, ati pe emi li o ti dá a nigba atijọ? nisisiyi mo mu u ṣẹ, ki iwọ ki o sọ ilu-nla olodi dahoro, di okiti iparun.
entries.en: Hast thou not heard long ago, how I have done it; and of ancient times, that I have formed it? now have I brought it to pass, that thou shouldest be to lay waste defenced cities into ruinous heaps.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni awọn olugbé wọn fi ṣe alainipa, aiya fò wọn, nwọn si dãmu: nwọn dabi koriko igbẹ, ati bi ewebẹ̀ tutù, bi koriko lori okè ilé, ati bi ọkà ti igbẹ ki o to dàgba soke.
entries.en: Therefore their inhabitants were of small power, they were dismayed and confounded: they were as the grass of the field, and as the green herb, as the grass on the housetops, and as corn blasted before it be grown up.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn mo mọ̀ ibugbe rẹ, ijadelọ rẹ, ati iwọle rẹ, ati irúnu rẹ si mi.
entries.en: But I know thy abode, and thy going out, and thy coming in, and thy rage against me.

entries.yo: Nitori irúnu rẹ si mi, ati igberaga rẹ, ti goke wá si eti mi, nitorina ni emi o ṣe fi ìwọ mi kọ́ ọ ni imú, ati ijanu mi si ète rẹ, emi o si mu ọ pada li ọ̀na ti o ba wá.
entries.en: Because thy rage against me, and thy tumult, is come up into mine ears, therefore will I put my hook in thy nose, and my bridle in thy lips, and I will turn thee back by the way by which thou camest.

entries.yo: Eyi ni o si jẹ àmi fun ọ, Ẹ jẹ ilalẹ̀hu li ọdun yi; ati li ọdun keji eyiti o sọ jade ninu ọkanna: ati li ọdun kẹta ẹ fọnrugbìn, ki ẹ si kore, ki ẹ si gbìn ọgba àjara, ki ẹ si jẹ eso wọn.
entries.en: And this shall be a sign unto thee, Ye shall eat this year such as groweth of itself; and the second year that which springeth of the same: and in the third year sow ye, and reap, and plant vineyards, and eat the fruit thereof.

entries.yo: Ati iyokù ti o sala ninu ile Juda yio tun fi gbòngbo mulẹ nisalẹ, yio si so eso loke:
entries.en: And the remnant that is escaped of the house of Judah shall again take root downward, and bear fruit upward:

entries.yo: Nitori lati Jerusalemu ni iyokù yio jade lọ, ati awọn ti o sala lati oke Sioni wá: itara Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun yio ṣe eyi.
entries.en: For out of Jerusalem shall go forth a remnant, and they that escape out of mount Zion: the zeal of the LORD of hosts shall do this.

entries.yo: Nitorina bayi ni Oluwa wi niti ọba Assiria, on kì yio wá si ilu yi, bẹ̃ni kì yio ta ọfà kan sibẹ, kì yio si mu asà wá siwaju rẹ̀, bẹ̃ni kì yio wà odi tì i.
entries.en: Therefore thus saith the LORD concerning the king of Assyria, He shall not come into this city, nor shoot an arrow there nor come before it with shields, nor cast a bank against it.

entries.yo: Li ọ̀na ti o ba wá, li ọkanna ni yio bá padà, kò si ni wá si ilu yi, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: By the way that he came, by the same shall he return, and shall not come into this city, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Nitori emi o dãbo bò ilu yi lati gbà a nitoriti emi tikala mi, ati nitoriti Dafidi iranṣẹ mi.
entries.en: For I will defend this city to save it for mine own sake, and for my servant David's sake.

entries.yo: Angeli Oluwa si jade lọ, o si pa ọkẹ́ mẹsan o le ẹgbẹ̃dọgbọn ni budo awọn ara Assiria; nigbati nwọn si dide lowurọ kùtukutu, kiyesi i, gbogbo wọn jẹ okú.
entries.en: Then the angel of the LORD went forth, and smote in the camp of the Assyrians a hundred and fourscore and five thousand: and when they arose early in the morning, behold, they were all dead corpses.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Sennakeribu ọba Assiria mu ọ̀na rẹ̀ pọ̀n, o si lọ, o si padà, o si ngbe Ninefe.
entries.en: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, and went and returned, and dwelt at Nineveh.

entries.yo: O si di igbati o ṣe, bi o ti ntẹriba ni ile Nisroki oriṣa rẹ̀, ni Adrammeleki ati Ṣaresari awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ fi idà pa a; nwọn si salà si ilẹ Armenia: Esarhaddoni ọmọ rẹ̀ si jọba ni ipò rẹ̀.
entries.en: And it came to pass, as he was worshipping in the house of Nisroch his god, that Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons smote him with the sword; and they escaped into the land of Armenia: and Esar-haddon his son reigned in his stead.

entries.yo: LI ọjọ wọnni Hesekiah ṣaisàn de oju ikú. Woli Isaiah ọmọ Amosi si wá sọdọ rẹ̀, o si wi fun u pe, Bayi ni Oluwa wi, Palẹ ile rẹ mọ́: nitori iwọ o kú, o ki yio si yè.
entries.en: In those days was Hezekiah sick unto death. And Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz came unto him, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Set thine house in order: for thou shalt die, and not live.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Hesekiah yi oju rẹ̀ si ogiri, o si gbadura si Oluwa.
entries.en: Then Hezekiah turned his face toward the wall, and prayed unto the LORD,

entries.yo: O si wipe, Nisisiyi, Oluwa, mo bẹ̀ ọ, ranti bi mo ti rìn niwaju rẹ li otitọ ati pẹlu aiya pipé, ati bi mo si ti ṣe eyiti o dara li oju rẹ. Hesekiah si sọkún pẹrẹ̀pẹrẹ̀.
entries.en: And said, Remember now, O LORD, I beseech thee, how I have walked before thee in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done that which is good in thy sight. And Hezekiah wept sore.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ Oluwa si tọ̀ Isaiah wá, wipe,
entries.en: Then came the word of the LORD to Isaiah, saying,

entries.yo: Lọ, si wi fun Hesekiah pe, Bayi ni Oluwa, Ọlọrun Dafidi baba rẹ wi, mo ti gbọ́ adura rẹ, mo ti ri omije rẹ: kiyesi i emi o fi ọdun mẹ̃dogun kún ọjọ rẹ.
entries.en: Go, and say to Hezekiah, Thus saith the LORD, the God of David thy father, I have heard thy prayer, I have seen thy tears: behold, I will add unto thy days fifteen years.

entries.yo: Emi o si gbà ọ ati ilu yi lọwọ ọba Assiria: emi o si dãbò bò ilu yi.
entries.en: And I will deliver thee and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria: and I will defend this city.

entries.yo: Eyi yio sì jẹ àmi fun ọ lati ọdọ Oluwa wá, pe, Oluwa yio ṣe nkan yi ti o ti sọ;
entries.en: And this shall be a sign unto thee from the LORD, that the LORD will do this thing that he hath spoken;

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, emi o tún mu ìwọn òjiji ti o ti sọkalẹ lara agogo-õrùn Ahasi pada ni ìwọn mẹwa. Bẹ̃ni õrun pada ni ìwọn mẹwa ninu ìwọn ti o ti sọkalẹ.
entries.en: Behold, I will bring again the shadow of the degrees, which is gone down in the sun dial of Ahaz, ten degrees backward. So the sun returned ten degrees, by which degrees it was gone down.

entries.yo: Iwe Hesekiah ọba Juda, nigbati o fi ṣaisàn, ti o si sàn ninu aisàn rẹ̀:
entries.en: The writing of Hezekiah king of Judah, when he had been sick, and was recovered of his sickness:

entries.yo: Mo ni, ni ìke-kuro ọjọ mi, emi o lọ si ẹnu-ọnà isà-okú; a dù mi ni iyokù ọdun mi.
entries.en: I said in the cutting off of my days, I shall go to the gates of the grave: I am deprived of the residue of my years.

entries.yo: Mo ni, emi kì yio ri Oluwa, ani Oluwa, ni ilẹ alãyè: emi kì yio ri enia mọ lãrin awọn ti ngbé ibi idakẹ.
entries.en: I said, I shall not see the LORD, even the LORD, in the land of the living: I shall behold man no more with the inhabitants of the world.

entries.yo: Ọjọ ori mi lọ, a si ṣi i kuro lọdọ mi bi àgọ olùṣọ agutan: mo ti ké ẹmi mi kuro bi ahunṣọ: yio ké mi kuro bi fọ́nran-òwu tinrin: lati ọ̀san de oru ni iwọ o mu mi de òpin mi.
entries.en: Mine age is departed, and is removed from me as a shepherd's tent: I have cut off like a weaver my life: he will cut me off with pining sickness: from day even to night wilt thou make an end of me.

entries.yo: Mo ṣirò titi di òwurọ, pe, bi kiniun, bẹ̃ni yio fọ́ gbogbo egungun mi; lati ọ̀san de oru ni iwọ o mu mi de òpin mi.
entries.en: I reckoned till morning, that, as a lion, so will he break all my bones: from day even to night wilt thou make an end of me.

entries.yo: Bi akọ̀ tabi alapandẹ̀dẹ, bẹ̃ni mo dún; mo kãnu bi oriri: ãrẹ̀ mu oju mi fun iwòke: Oluwa, ara nni mi: ṣe onigbọwọ mi.
entries.en: Like a crane or a swallow, so did I chatter: I did mourn as a dove: mine eyes fail with looking upward: O LORD, I am oppressed; undertake for me.

entries.yo: Kili emi o wi? o ti sọ fun mi, on tikalarẹ̀ si ti ṣe e: emi o ma lọ jẹjẹ fun gbogbo ọdun mi ni kikorò ọkàn mi.
entries.en: What shall I say? he hath both spoken unto me, and himself hath done it: I shall go softly all my years in the bitterness of my soul.

entries.yo: Oluwa, nipa nkan wọnyi li enia ima wà, ati ni gbogbo nkan wọnyi ni iye ẹmi mi: bẹ̃ni iwọ o mu mi lara dá, iwọ o si mu mi yè.
entries.en: O Lord, by these things men live, and in all these things is the life of my spirit: so wilt thou recover me, and make me to live.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, mo ti ni ikorò nla nipò alafia: ṣugbọn iwọ ti fẹ́ ọkàn mi lati ihò idibàjẹ wá: nitori iwọ ti gbe gbogbo ẹ̀ṣẹ mi si ẹ̀hin rẹ.
entries.en: Behold, for peace I had great bitterness: but thou hast in love to my soul delivered it from the pit of corruption: for thou hast cast all my sins behind thy back.

entries.yo: Nitori ibojì kò le yìn ọ, ikú kò le fiyìn fun ọ: awọn ti o sọkalẹ lọ sinu ihò kò le ni irèti otitọ rẹ.
entries.en: For the grave cannot praise thee, death can not celebrate thee: they that go down into the pit cannot hope for thy truth.

entries.yo: Alãyè, alãyè, on ni yio yìn ọ, bi mo ti nṣe loni yi: baba yio fi otitọ rẹ hàn fun awọn ọmọ.
entries.en: The living, the living, he shall praise thee, as I do this day: the father to the children shall make known thy truth.

entries.yo: Oluwa mura tan lati gbà mi: nitorina a o kọ orin mi lara dùrù olokùn, ni gbogbo ọjọ aiye wa ni ile Oluwa.
entries.en: The LORD was ready to save me: therefore we will sing my songs to the stringed instruments all the days of our life in the house of the LORD.

entries.yo: Nitori Isaiah ti wipe, Ki nwọn mu ìṣu ọ̀pọtọ́, ki a si fi ṣán õwo na, yio si sàn.
entries.en: For Isaiah had said, Let them take a lump of figs, and lay it for a plaister upon the boil, and he shall recover.

entries.yo: Hesekiah pẹlu ti wipe, Kili àmi na pe emi o goke lọ si ile Oluwa?
entries.en: Hezekiah also had said, What is the sign that I shall go up to the house of the LORD?

entries.yo: LI akoko na ni Merodaki-baladani, ọmọ Baladani, ọba Babiloni, rán iwe ati ọrẹ si Hesekiah: nitori o ti gbọ́ pe o ti ṣaisàn, o si ti sàn.
entries.en: At that time Merodach-baladan, the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present to Hezekiah: for he had heard that he had been sick, and was recovered.

entries.yo: Inu Hesekiah si dùn si wọn, o si fi ile iṣura hàn wọn, fadaka, ati wura, ati nkan olõrun didùn, ati ikunra iyebiye, ati ile gbogbo ìhamọra rẹ̀, ati ohun gbogbo ti a ri ninu iṣura rẹ̀: kò si si nkankan ti Hesekiah kò fi hàn wọn ninu ile rẹ̀, tabi ni ijọba rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Hezekiah was glad of them, and shewed them the house of his precious things, the silver, and the gold, and the spices, and the precious ointment, and all the house of his armour, and all that was found in his treasures: there was nothing in his house, nor in all his dominion, that Hezekiah shewed them not.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni wolĩ Isaiah wá sọdọ Hesekiah ọba, o si wi fun u pe, Kini awọn ọkunrin wọnyi wi? ati lati ibo ni nwọn ti wá sọdọ rẹ? Hesekiah si wi pe, Lati ilẹ jijin ni nwọn ti wá sọdọ mi, ani lati Babiloni.
entries.en: Then came Isaiah the prophet unto king Hezekiah, and said unto him, What said these men? and from whence came they unto thee? And Hezekiah said, They are come from a far country unto me, even from Babylon.

entries.yo: O si wipe, Kini nwọn ri ni ile rẹ? Hesekiah si dahùn pe, Ohun gbogbo ti o wà ni ile mi ni nwọn ti ri: kò si nkankan ti emi kò fi hàn wọn ninu iṣura mi.
entries.en: Then said he, What have they seen in thine house? And Hezekiah answered, All that is in mine house have they seen: there is nothing among my treasures that I have not shewed them.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Isaiah wi fun Hesekiah pe, Gbọ́ ọ̀rọ Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun:
entries.en: Then said Isaiah to Hezekiah, Hear the word of the LORD of hosts:

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, ọjọ na dé, ti a o kó ohun gbogbo ti o wà ni ile rẹ, ati ohun ti awọn baba rẹ ti kojọ titi di oni, lọ si Babiloni: kò si nkankan ti yio kù, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: Behold, the days come, that all that is in thine house, and that which thy fathers have laid up in store until this day, shall be carried to Babylon: nothing shall be left, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Ati ninu awọn ọmọ rẹ ọkunrin ti yio ti inu rẹ jade, ti iwọ o bi, ni nwọn o kó lọ: nwọn o si jẹ́ iwẹ̀fa ni ãfin ọba Babiloni.
entries.en: And of thy sons that shall issue from thee, which thou shalt beget, shall they take away; and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Hesekiah wi fun Isaiah pe, Rere ni ọ̀rọ Oluwa ti iwọ ti sọ. O si wi pẹlu pe, Alafia ati otitọ́ yio sa wà li ọjọ mi.
entries.en: Then said Hezekiah to Isaiah, Good is the word of the LORD which thou hast spoken. He said moreover, For there shall be peace and truth in my days.

entries.yo: Ẹ tù enia mi ninu, ẹ tù wọn ninu, ni Ọlọrun nyin wi.
entries.en: Comfort ye, comfort ye my people, saith your God.

entries.yo: Ẹ sọ ọ̀rọ ìtunu fun Jerusalemu, ki ẹ si ké si i pe, ogun jijà rẹ tán, pe, a dari aiṣedẽde rẹ jì: nitoripe o ti gbà nigba meji lati ọwọ́ Oluwa wá fun ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ̀ gbogbo.
entries.en: Speak ye comfortably to Jerusalem, and cry unto her, that her warfare is accomplished, that her iniquity is pardoned: for she hath received of the LORD's hand double for all her sins.

entries.yo: Ohùn ẹniti nkigbe ni ijù, ẹ tún ọ̀na Oluwa ṣe, ṣe opópo titọ́ ni aginjù fun Ọlọrun wa.
entries.en: The voice of him that crieth in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the LORD, make straight in the desert a highway for our God.

entries.yo: Gbogbo afonifoji ni a o gbe soke, gbogbo òke-nla ati òke kékèké ni a o si rẹ̀ silẹ: wiwọ́ ni a o si ṣe ni titọ́, ati ọ̀na pàlapala ni a o sọ di titẹ́ju:
entries.en: Every valley shall be exalted, and every mountain and hill shall be made low: and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough places plain:

entries.yo: A o si fi ogo Oluwa hàn, gbogbo ẹran-ara ni yio jùmọ ri i: nitori ẹnu Oluwa li o sọ ọ.
entries.en: And the glory of the LORD shall be revealed, and all flesh shall see it together: for the mouth of the LORD hath spoken it.

entries.yo: Ohùn na wipe, Kigbe. On si wipe, Igbe kini emi o ke? Gbogbo ẹran-ara ni koriko, gbogbo ogo rẹ̀ si dabi ìtànná igbẹ́:
entries.en: The voice said, Cry. And he said, What shall I cry? All flesh is grass, and all the goodliness thereof is as the flower of the field:

entries.yo: Koriko nrọ, ìtànná eweko nrẹ̀: nitoripe ẹmi Oluwa ti fẹ́ lù u: dajudaju koriko ni enia.
entries.en: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: because the spirit of the LORD bloweth upon it: surely the people is grass.

entries.yo: Koriko nrọ, ìtànná nrẹ̀: ṣugbọn ọ̀rọ Ọlọrun wa yio duro lailai.
entries.en: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: but the word of our God shall stand for ever.

entries.yo: Iwọ onihinrere Sioni, gùn òke giga lọ: Iwọ onihin-rere Jerusalemu, gbé ohùn rẹ soke pẹlu agbara; gbé e soke, má bẹ̀ru; wi fun awọn ilu Juda pe, Ẹ wò Ọlọrun nyin!
entries.en: O Zion, that bringest good tidings, get thee up into the high mountain; O Jerusalem, that bringest good tidings, lift up thy voice with strength; lift it up, be not afraid; say unto the cities of Judah, Behold your God!

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, Oluwa Jehofah yio wá ninu agbara, apá rẹ̀ yio ṣe akoso fun u: kiyesi i, ère rẹ̀ wà pẹlu rẹ̀, ẹ̀san rẹ̀ si mbẹ niwaju rẹ̀.
entries.en: Behold, the Lord GOD will come with strong hand, and his arm shall rule for him: behold, his reward is with him, and his work before him.

entries.yo: On o bọ́ ọwọ-ẹran rẹ̀ bi oluṣọ-agùtan: yio si fi apá rẹ̀ ko awọn ọdọ-agùtan, yio si kó wọn si aiya rẹ̀, yio si rọra dà awọn ti o loyun.
entries.en: He shall feed his flock like a shepherd: he shall gather the lambs with his arm, and carry them in his bosom, and shall gently lead those that are with young.

entries.yo: Tali o ti wọ̀n omi ni kòto-ọwọ́ rẹ̀, ti o si ti fi ika wọ̀n ọrun, ti o si ti kó erùpẹ aiye jọ sinu òṣuwọn, ti o si fi ìwọn wọ̀n awọn oke-nla, ati awọn oke kékèké ninu òṣuwọn?
entries.en: Who hath measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, and meted out heaven with the span, and comprehended the dust of the earth in a measure, and weighed the mountains in scales, and the hills in a balance?

entries.yo: Tali o ti tọ́ Ẹmi Oluwa, tabi ti iṣe igbimọ̀ rẹ̀ ti o kọ́ ọ?
entries.en: Who hath directed the Spirit of the LORD, or being his counseller hath taught him?

entries.yo: Tali o mba a gbìmọ, tali o si kọ́ ọ lẹkọ́, ti o si kọ́ ọ ni ọ̀na idajọ, ti o si kọ́ ọ ni ìmọ, ti o si fi ọ̀na oye hàn a?
entries.en: With whom took he counsel, and who instructed him, and taught him in the path of judgment, and taught him knowledge, and shewed to him the way of understanding?

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, awọn orilẹ-ède dabi iró kan ninu omi ladugbo, a si kà wọn bi ekúru kiun ninu ìwọn: kiyesi i, o nmu awọn erekùṣu bi ohun diẹ kiun.
entries.en: Behold, the nations are as a drop of a bucket, and are counted as the small dust of the balance: behold, he taketh up the isles as a very little thing.

entries.yo: Lebanoni kò si tó fi joná, bẹ̃ni awọn ẹranko ibẹ kò to lati fi rubọ sisun.
entries.en: And Lebanon is not sufficient to burn, nor the beasts thereof sufficient for a burnt offering.

entries.yo: Gbogbo orilẹ-ède li o dabi ofo niwaju rẹ̀; a si kà wọn si fun u bi ohun ti o rẹ̀hin jù ofo ati asan lọ.
entries.en: All nations before him are as nothing; and they are counted to him less than nothing, and vanity.

entries.yo: Tali ẹnyin o ha fi Ọlọrun we? tabi awòran kini ẹnyin o fi ṣe akàwe rẹ̀?
entries.en: To whom then will ye liken God? or what likeness will ye compare unto him?

entries.yo: Oniṣọ̀na ngbẹ́ ère, alagbẹdẹ wura si nfi wura bò o, o si ndà ẹ̀wọn fadakà.
entries.en: The workman melteth a graven image, and the goldsmith spreadeth it over with gold, and casteth silver chains.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o talakà tobẹ̃ ti kò fi ni ohun ọrẹ, yàn igi ti kì yio rà; o nwá ọlọgbọn oniṣọ̀na fun ara rẹ̀ lati gbẹ́ ère gbigbẹ́ ti a ki yio ṣi nipò.
entries.en: He that is so impoverished that he hath no oblation chooseth a tree that will not rot; he seeketh unto him a cunning workman to prepare a graven image, that shall not be moved.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin kò ti mọ̀? ẹnyin kò ti gbọ́? a kò ti sọ fun nyin li atètekọṣe? kò iti yé nyin lati ipilẹṣẹ aiye wá?
entries.en: Have ye not known? have ye not heard? hath it not been told you from the beginning? have ye not understood from the foundations of the earth?

entries.yo: On ni ẹniti o joko lori òbíri aiye, gbogbo awọn ti ngbe ibẹ si dabi ẹlẹngà; ẹniti o ta ọrun bi ohun tita, ti o si nà wọn bi àgọ lati gbe.
entries.en: It is he that sitteth upon the circle of the earth, and the inhabitants thereof are as grasshoppers; that stretcheth out the heavens as a curtain, and spreadeth them out as a tent to dwell in:

entries.yo: Ẹniti o nsọ awọn ọmọ-alade di ofo; o ṣe awọn onidajọ aiye bi asan.
entries.en: That bringeth the princes to nothing; he maketh the judges of the earth as vanity.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ, a kì yio gbìn wọn; nitõtọ, a kì yio sú wọn: nitõtọ igi wọn kì yio fi gbòngbo mulẹ: on o si fẹ́ lù wọn pẹlu, nwọn o si rọ, ãja yio si mu wọn lọ bi akekù koriko.
entries.en: Yea, they shall not be planted; yea, they shall not be sown: yea, their stock shall not take root in the earth: and he shall also blow upon them, and they shall wither, and the whirlwind shall take them away as stubble.

entries.yo: Njẹ tani ẹnyin o ha fi mi we, tabi tali emi o ba dọgbà? ni Ẹni-Mimọ wi.
entries.en: To whom then will ye liken me, or shall I be equal? saith the Holy One.

entries.yo: Gbe oju nyin soke sibi giga, ki ẹ si wò, tali o dá nkan wọnyi, ti nmu ogun wọn jade wá ni iye: o npè gbogbo wọn li orukọ nipa titobi ipá rẹ̀, nitoripe on le ni ipá; kò si ọkan ti o kù.
entries.en: Lift up your eyes on high, and behold who hath created these things, that bringeth out their host by number: he calleth them all by names by the greatness of his might, for that he is strong in power; not one faileth.

entries.yo: Ẽṣe ti iwọ fi nwi, Iwọ Jakobu, ti iwọ si nsọ, Iwọ Israeli pe, Ọ̀na mi pamọ kuro lọdọ Oluwa, idajọ mi si rekọja kuro lọdọ Ọlọrun mi?
entries.en: Why sayest thou, O Jacob, and speakest, O Israel, My way is hid from the LORD, and my judgment is passed over from my God?

entries.yo: Iwọ kò ti imọ? iwọ kò ti igbọ́ pe, Ọlọrun aiyeraiye, Oluwa, Ẹlẹda gbogbo ipẹkun aiye, kì iṣãrẹ̀, bẹ̃ni ãrẹ̀ kì imu u? kò si awari oye rẹ̀.
entries.en: Hast thou not known? hast thou not heard, that the everlasting God, the LORD, the Creator of the ends of the earth, fainteth not, neither is weary? there is no searching of his understanding.

entries.yo: O nfi agbara fun alãrẹ̀; o si fi agbara kún awọn ti kò ni ipá.
entries.en: He giveth power to the faint; and to them that have no might he increaseth strength.

entries.yo: Ani ãrẹ̀ yio mu awọn ọdọmọde, yio si rẹ̀ wọn, ati awọn ọdọmọkunrin yio tilẹ ṣubu patapata:
entries.en: Even the youths shall faint and be weary, and the young men shall utterly fall:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn ti o ba duro de Oluwa yio tun agbara wọn ṣe; nwọn o fi iyẹ́ gùn oke bi idì; nwọn o sare, kì yio si rẹ̀ wọn; nwọn o rìn, ãrẹ̀ kì yio si mu wọn.
entries.en: But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.

entries.yo: DAKẸ niwaju mi, Ẹnyin erekùṣu; si jẹ ki awọn enia tún agbara wọn ṣe: jẹ ki wọn sunmọ tosí; nigbana ni ki wọn sọ̀rọ: jẹ ki a jumọ sunmọ tosí fun idajọ.
entries.en: Keep silence before me, O islands; and let the people renew their strength: let them come near; then let them speak: let us come near together to judgment.

entries.yo: Tali o gbe olododo dide lati ìla-õrun wa, ti o pè e si ẹsẹ rẹ̀, ti o fi awọn orilẹ-ède fun u niwaju rẹ̀, ti o si fi ṣe akoso awọn ọba? o fi wọn fun idà rẹ̀ bi ekuru, ati bi akekù iyàngbo fun ọrun rẹ̀.
entries.en: Who raised up the righteous man from the east, called him to his foot, gave the nations before him, and made him rule over kings? he gave them as the dust to his sword, and as driven stubble to his bow.

entries.yo: O lepa wọn, o si kọja li alafia; nipa ọ̀na ti kò ti fi ẹsẹ rẹ̀ tẹ̀ ri.
entries.en: He pursued them, and passed safely; even by the way that he had not gone with his feet.

entries.yo: Tali o ti dá a ti o si ti ṣe e, ti o npè awọn iran lati ipilẹṣẹ̀ wá? Emi Oluwa ni; ẹni-ikini, ati pẹlu ẹni-ikẹhìn; Emi na ni.
entries.en: Who hath wrought and done it, calling the generations from the beginning? I the LORD, the first, and with the last; I am he.

entries.yo: Awọn erekùṣu ri i, nwọn si bẹ̀ru; aiya nfò awọn opin aiye; nwọn sunmọ tosí, nwọn si wá.
entries.en: The isles saw it, and feared; the ends of the earth were afraid, drew near, and came.

entries.yo: Olukulùku ràn aladugbo rẹ̀ lọwọ; o si wi fun arakunrin rẹ̀ pe, Ẹ mu ara le.
entries.en: They helped every one his neighbour; and every one said to his brother, Be of good courage.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni gbẹnàgbẹnà ngbà alagbẹdẹ wura niyànju, ati ẹniti nfi ọmọ-owú dán a, ngbà ẹniti nlù ògún niyànju; wipe, o ṣetan fun mimọlù: o si fi iṣo kàn a mọra ki o má le ṣi.
entries.en: So the carpenter encouraged the goldsmith, and he that smootheth with the hammer him that smote the anvil, saying, It is ready for the sodering: and he fastened it with nails, that it should not be moved.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn iwọ, Israeli, ni iranṣẹ mi, Jakobu ẹniti mo ti yàn, iru-ọmọ Abrahamu ọrẹ mi.
entries.en: But thou, Israel, art my servant, Jacob whom I have chosen, the seed of Abraham my friend.

entries.yo: Ẹniti mo ti mu lati opin aiye wá, ti mo ti pè ọ lati ọdọ awọn olori enia ibẹ, ti mo si wi fun ọ pe, Iwọ ni iranṣẹ mi; mo ti yàn ọ, emi kò si ni ta ọ nù,
entries.en: Thou whom I have taken from the ends of the earth, and called thee from the chief men thereof, and said unto thee, Thou art my servant; I have chosen thee, and not cast thee away.

entries.yo: Iwọ má bẹ̀ru; nitori mo wà pẹlu rẹ; má foyà; nitori emi ni Ọlọrun rẹ: emi o fun ọ ni okun; nitõtọ, emi o ràn ọ lọwọ; nitõtọ, emi o fi ọwọ́ ọ̀tun ododo mi gbe ọ sokè.
entries.en: Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, gbogbo awọn ti o binu si ọ ni oju o tì, nwọn o si dãmu: nwọn o dabi asan; awọn ti o si mba ọ jà yio ṣegbe.
entries.en: Behold, all they that were incensed against thee shall be ashamed and confounded: they shall be as nothing; and they that strive with thee shall perish.

entries.yo: Iwọ o wá wọn, iwọ kì yio si rí wọn, ani awọn ti o ba ọ jà: awọn ti o mba ọ jagun yio dabi asan, ati bi ohun ti kò si.
entries.en: Thou shalt seek them, and shalt not find them, even them that contended with thee: they that war against thee shall be as nothing, and as a thing of nought.

entries.yo: Nitori emi Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ yio di ọwọ́ ọ̀tun rẹ mu, emi o wi fun ọ pe, Má bẹ̀ru; emi o ràn ọ lọwọ.
entries.en: For I the LORD thy God will hold thy right hand, saying unto thee, Fear not; I will help thee.

entries.yo: Má bẹ̀ru, iwọ Jakobu kòkoro, ati ẹnyin ọkunrin Israeli; emi o ràn ọ lọwọ, bẹ̃ni Oluwa ati Oluràpada rẹ wi, Ẹni-mimọ́ Israeli.
entries.en: Fear not, thou worm Jacob, and ye men of Israel; I will help thee, saith the LORD, and thy redeemer, the Holy One of Israel.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, emi ti ṣe ọ bi ohun-èlo ipakà mimú titun ti o ni ehín; iwọ o tẹ̀ awọn òke-nla, iwọ o si gún wọn kunná, iwọ o si sọ awọn oke kékèké di iyàngbo.
entries.en: Behold, I will make thee a new sharp threshing instrument having teeth: thou shalt thresh the mountains, and beat them small, and shalt make the hills as chaff.

entries.yo: Iwọ o fẹ́ wọn, ẹfũfu yio si fẹ́ wọn lọ, ãjà yio si tú wọn ká: iwọ o si yọ̀ ninu Oluwa, iwọ o si ṣogo ninu Ẹni-Mimọ Israeli.
entries.en: Thou shalt fan them, and the wind shall carry them away, and the whirlwind shall scatter them: and thou shalt rejoice in the LORD, and shalt glory in the Holy One of Israel.

entries.yo: Nigbati talakà ati alaini nwá omi, ti kò si si, ti ahọn wọn si gbẹ fun ongbẹ, emi Oluwa yio gbọ́ ti wọn, emi Ọlọrun Israeli ki yio kọ̀ wọn silẹ.
entries.en: When the poor and needy seek water, and there is none, and their tongue faileth for thirst, I the LORD will hear them, I the God of Israel will not forsake them.

entries.yo: Emi o ṣi odò nibi giga, ati orisún lãrin afonifoji: emi o sọ aginjù di abàta omi, ati ilẹ gbigbẹ di orisun omi.
entries.en: I will open rivers in high places, and fountains in the midst of the valleys: I will make the wilderness a pool of water, and the dry land springs of water.

entries.yo: Emi o fi igi kedari si aginjù, ati igi ṣita, ati mirtili, ati igi oróro; emi o gbìn igi firi ati igi pine ati igi boksi pọ̀ ni aginjù.
entries.en: I will plant in the wilderness the cedar, the shittah tree, and the myrtle, and the oil tree; I will set in the desert the fir tree, and the pine, and the box tree together:

entries.yo: Ki nwọn ki o le ri, ki nwọn ki o si mọ̀, ki nwọn si gbèro, ki o si le yé won pọ̀, pe, ọwọ́ Oluwa li o ti ṣe eyi, ati pe Ẹni-Mimọ Israeli ni o ti dá a.
entries.en: That they may see, and know, and consider, and understand together, that the hand of the LORD hath done this, and the Holy One of Israel hath created it.

entries.yo: Mú ẹjọ nyin wá, ni Oluwa wi; mú ọràn dajudaju nyin jade wá, ni ọba Jakobu wi.
entries.en: Produce your cause, saith the LORD; bring forth your strong reasons, saith the King of Jacob.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki wọn mú wọn jade wá, ki wọn si fi ohun ti yio ṣe hàn ni: jẹ ki wọn fi ohun iṣãju hàn, bi nwọn ti jẹ, ki awa ki o lè rò wọn, ki a si mọ̀ igbẹ̀hin wọn; tabi ki nwọn sọ ohun wọnni ti mbọ̀ fun wa.
entries.en: Let them bring them forth, and shew us what shall happen: let them shew the former things, what they be, that we may consider them, and know the latter end of them; or declare us things for to come.

entries.yo: Fi ohun ti mbọ̀ lẹhìn eyi hàn, ki awa ki o le mọ̀ pe ọlọrun ni nyin: nitõtọ, ẹ ṣe rere, tabi ẹ ṣe buburu, ki ẹ̀ru le bà wa, ki a le jumọ ri i.
entries.en: Shew the things that are to come hereafter, that we may know that ye are gods: yea, do good, or do evil, that we may be dismayed, and behold it together.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, lati nkan asan ni nyin, iṣẹ nyin si jẹ asan: irira ni ẹniti o yàn nyin.
entries.en: Behold, ye are of nothing, and your work of nought: an abomination is he that chooseth you.

entries.yo: Emi ti gbé ẹnikan dide lati ariwa, on o si wá: lati ilà-õrun ni yio ti ké pe orukọ mi: yio si wá sori awọn ọmọ-alade bi sori àmọ, ati bi alamọ̀ ti itẹ̀ erupẹ.
entries.en: I have raised up one from the north, and he shall come: from the rising of the sun shall he call upon my name: and he shall come upon princes as upon morter, and as the potter treadeth clay.

entries.yo: Tani o ti fi hàn lati ipilẹ̀ṣẹ, ki awa ki o le mọ̀? ati nigba iṣãju, ki a le wi pe, Olododo ni on? nitõtọ, kò si ẹnikan ti o fi hàn, nitõtọ, kò si ẹnikan ti o sọ ọ, nitõtọ, kò si ẹnikan ti o gbọ́ ọ̀rọ nyin.
entries.en: Who hath declared from the beginning, that we may know? and beforetime, that we may say, He is righteous? yea, there is none that sheweth, yea, there is none that declareth, yea, there is none that heareth your words.

entries.yo: Ẹni-ikini o wi fun Sioni pe, Wò o, on na nĩ: emi o fi ẹnikan ti o mú ihinrere wá fun Jerusalemu.
entries.en: The first shall say to Zion, Behold, behold them: and I will give to Jerusalem one that bringeth good tidings.

entries.yo: Nitori mo wò, kò si si ẹnikan; ani ninu wọn, kò si si olugbimọ̀ kan, nigbati mo bere lọwọ wọn, kò si ẹniti o le dahùn ọ̀rọ kan.
entries.en: For I beheld, and there was no man; even among them, and there was no counseller, that, when I asked of them, could answer a word.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, asan ni gbogbo wọn; asan ni iṣẹ wọn; ẹfũfu ati rudurudu ni ere didà wọn.
entries.en: Behold, they are all vanity; their works are nothing: their molten images are wind and confusion.

entries.yo: WÒ iranṣẹ mi, ẹniti mo gbéro: ayànfẹ mi, ẹniti inu mi dùn si; mo ti fi ẹmi mi fun u: on o mu idajọ wá fun awọn keferi.
entries.en: Behold my servant, whom I uphold; mine elect, in whom my soul delighteth; I have put my spirit upon him: he shall bring forth judgment to the Gentiles.

entries.yo: On kì yio kigbé, bẹ̃ni kì yio gbé ohùn soke, bẹ̃ni kì yio jẹ ki a gbọ́ ohùn rẹ̀ ni igboro.
entries.en: He shall not cry, nor lift up, nor cause his voice to be heard in the street.

entries.yo: Iyè fifọ́ ni on ki yio ṣẹ, owú ti nrú ẹ̃fin ni on kì yio pa: yio mu idajọ wá si otitọ.
entries.en: A bruised reed shall he not break, and the smoking flax shall he not quench: he shall bring forth judgment unto truth.

entries.yo: Ãrẹ̀ kì yio mú u, a kì yio si daiyà fò o, titi yio fi gbé idajọ kalẹ li aiye, awọn erekùṣu yio duro de ofin rẹ̀.
entries.en: He shall not fail nor be discouraged, till he have set judgment in the earth: and the isles shall wait for his law.

entries.yo: Bayi ni Ọlọrun Oluwa wi, ẹniti o dá ọrun, ti o si nà wọn jade; ẹniti o tẹ̀ aiye, ati ohun ti o ti inu rẹ̀ wá; ẹniti o fi ẽmi fun awọn enia lori rẹ̀, ati ẹmi fun awọn ti o nrin ninu rẹ̀:
entries.en: Thus saith God the LORD, he that created the heavens, and stretched them out; he that spread forth the earth, and that which cometh out of it; he that giveth breath unto the people upon it, and spirit to them that walk therein:

entries.yo: Emi Oluwa li o ti pè ọ ninu ododo, emi o si di ọwọ́ rẹ mu, emi o si pa ọ mọ, emi o si fi ọ ṣe majẹmu awọn enia, imọlẹ awọn keferi.
entries.en: I the LORD have called thee in righteousness, and will hold thine hand, and will keep thee, and give thee for a covenant of the people, for a light of the Gentiles;

entries.yo: Lati là oju awọn afọju, lati mu awọn ondè kuro ninu tubu, ati awọn ti o joko li okùnkun kuro ni ile tubu.
entries.en: To open the blind eyes, to bring out the prisoners from the prison, and them that sit in darkness out of the prison house.

entries.yo: Emi li Oluwa: eyi ni orukọ mi: ogo mi li emi kì yio fi fun ẹlòmiran, bẹ̃ni emi kì yio fi iyìn mi fun ere gbigbẹ́.
entries.en: I am the LORD: that is my name: and my glory will I not give to another, neither my praise to graven images.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, nkan iṣãju ṣẹ, nkan titun ni emi si nsọ: ki nwọn to hù, mo mu nyin gbọ́ wọn.
entries.en: Behold, the former things are come to pass, and new things do I declare: before they spring forth I tell you of them.

entries.yo: Ẹ kọ orin titun si Oluwa, iyìn rẹ̀ lati opin aiye, ẹnyin ti nsọkalẹ lọ si okun, ati ohun gbogbo ti mbẹ ninu rẹ̀: erekùṣu, ati awọn ti ngbé inu wọn.
entries.en: Sing unto the LORD a new song, and his praise from the end of the earth, ye that go down to the sea, and all that is therein; the isles, and the inhabitants thereof.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki aginjù ati ilu-nla ibẹ gbé ohùn wọn soke, iletò wọnni ti Kedari ngbé: jẹ ki awọn ti ngbé apáta kọrin, jẹ ki wọn hó lati ori oke-nla wá.
entries.en: Let the wilderness and the cities thereof lift up their voice, the villages that Kedar doth inhabit: let the inhabitants of the rock sing, let them shout from the top of the mountains.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki wọn fi ogo fun Oluwa, ki wọn si wi iyìn rẹ̀ ninu erekùṣu.
entries.en: Let them give glory unto the LORD, and declare his praise in the islands.

entries.yo: Oluwa yio jade bi ọkunrin alagbara, yio rú owú soke bi ologun: yio kigbé, nitõtọ, yio ké ramuramu; yio bori awọn ọta rẹ̀.
entries.en: The LORD shall go forth as a mighty man, he shall stir up jealousy like a man of war: he shall cry, yea, roar; he shall prevail against his enemies.

entries.yo: Lailai ni mo ti dakẹ́: mo ti gbe jẹ, mo ti pa ara mi mọra; nisisiyi emi o ké bi obinrin ti nrọbi; emi o parun, emi o si gbé mì lẹ̃kanna.
entries.en: I have long time holden my peace; I have been still, and refrained myself: now will I cry like a travailing woman; I will destroy and devour at once.

entries.yo: Emi o sọ oke-nla ati òke-kékèké di ofo, emi o si mú gbogbo ewebẹ̀ wọn gbẹ: emi o sọ odò ṣiṣàn di iyangbẹ́ ilẹ, emi o si mú abàta gbẹ.
entries.en: I will make waste mountains and hills, and dry up all their herbs; and I will make the rivers islands, and I will dry up the pools.

entries.yo: Emi o si mu awọn afọju bá ọ̀na ti nwọn kò mọ̀ wá; emi o tọ́ wọn ninu ipa ti wọn kò ti mọ̀; emi o sọ okùnkun di imọlẹ niwaju wọn, ati ohun wiwọ́ di titọ. Nkan wọnyi li emi o ṣe fun wọn, emi kì yio si kọ̀ wọn silẹ.
entries.en: And I will bring the blind by a way that they knew not; I will lead them in paths that they have not known: I will make darkness light before them, and crooked things straight. These things will I do unto them, and not forsake them.

entries.yo: A o dá awọn ti o gbẹkẹle ere gbigbẹ́ padà, a o doju tì wọn gidigidi, awọn ti nwi fun ere didà pe, Ẹnyin ni ọlọrun wa.
entries.en: They shall be turned back, they shall be greatly ashamed, that trust in graven images, that say to the molten images, Ye are our gods.

entries.yo: Gbọ́, ẹnyin aditi; ki ẹ si wò, ẹnyin afọju ki ẹnyin ki o le ri i.
entries.en: Hear, ye deaf; and look, ye blind, that ye may see.

entries.yo: Tani afọju, bikoṣe iranṣẹ mi? tabi aditi, bi ikọ̀ mi ti mo rán? tani afọju bi ẹni pipé? ti o si fọju bi iranṣẹ Oluwa?
entries.en: Who is blind, but my servant? or deaf, as my messenger that I sent? who is blind as he that is perfect, and blind as the LORD's servant?

entries.yo: Ni riri nkan pupọ, ṣugbọn iwọ kò kiyesi i; ni ṣiṣi eti, ṣugbọn on ko gbọ́.
entries.en: Seeing many things, but thou observest not; opening the ears, but he heareth not.

entries.yo: Inu Oluwa dùn gidigidi nitori ododo rẹ̀; yio gbe ofin ga, yio si sọ ọ di ọlọlá.
entries.en: The LORD is well pleased for his righteousness' sake; he will magnify the law, and make it honourable.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn enia ti a jà lole ti a si ko li ẹrù ni eyi: gbogbo wọn li a dẹkùn mu ninu ihò, a fi wọn pamọ ninu tubu: a fi wọn fun ikogun, ẹnikan ko si gbà wọn; a fi wọn fun ikogun, ẹnikan ko si wipe, Mu u pada.
entries.en: But this is a people robbed and spoiled; they are all of them snared in holes, and they are hid in prison houses: they are for a prey, and none delivereth; for a spoil, and none saith, Restore.

entries.yo: Tani ninu nyin ti o fi eti si eyi? ti o dẹti silẹ, ti yio si gbọ́ eyi ti mbọ̀ lẹhin?
entries.en: Who among you will give ear to this? who will hearken and hear for the time to come?

entries.yo: Tani fi Jakobu fun ikogun, ti o si fi Israeli fun ole? Oluwa ha kọ́ ẹniti a ti dẹṣẹ si? nitori nwọn kò fẹ rìn li ọ̀na rẹ̀, bẹ̃ni nwọn ko gbọ́ ti ofin rẹ̀.
entries.en: Who gave Jacob for a spoil, and Israel to the robbers? did not the LORD, he against whom we have sinned? for they would not walk in his ways, neither were they obedient unto his law.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni o ṣe dà irúnu ibinu rẹ̀ si i lori, ati agbara ogun: o si ti tẹ̀ iná bọ̀ ọ yika, ṣugbọn on kò mọ̀; o si jo o, ṣugbọn on kò kà a si.
entries.en: Therefore he hath poured upon him the fury of his anger, and the strength of battle: and it hath set him on fire round about, yet he knew not; and it burned him, yet he laid it not to heart.

entries.yo: ṢUGBỌN nisisiyi bayi ni Oluwa wi, ẹniti o dá ọ, Jakobu, ati ẹniti o mọ ọ, Israeli, Má bẹru: nitori mo ti rà ọ pada, mo ti pè ọ li orukọ rẹ, ti emi ni iwọ.
entries.en: But now thus saith the LORD that created thee, O Jacob, and he that formed thee, O Israel, Fear not: for I have redeemed thee, I have called thee by thy name; thou art mine.

entries.yo: Nigbati iwọ ba nlà omi kọja, emi o pẹlu rẹ; ati lãrin odò, nwọn ki yio bò ọ mọlẹ: nigbati iwọ ba nrìn ninu iná, ki yio jo ọ, bẹ̃ni ọwọ́-iná ki yio ràn ọ.
entries.en: When thou passest through the waters, I will be with thee; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow thee: when thou walkest through the fire, thou shalt not be burned; neither shall the flame kindle upon thee.

entries.yo: Nitori emi li Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ, Ẹni-Mimọ Israeli, Olugbala rẹ: mo fi Egipti ṣe irapada rẹ, mo si fi Etiopia ati Seba fun ọ.
entries.en: For I am the LORD thy God, the Holy One of Israel, thy Saviour: I gave Egypt for thy ransom, Ethiopia and Seba for thee.

entries.yo: Niwọn bi iwọ ti ṣe iyebiye to loju mi, ti iwọ ṣe ọlọla, emi si ti fẹ ọ: nitorina emi o fi enia rọpò rẹ, ati enia dipo ẹmi rẹ.
entries.en: Since thou wast precious in my sight, thou hast been honourable, and I have loved thee: therefore will I give men for thee, and people for thy life.

entries.yo: Má bẹ̀ru: nitori emi wà pẹlu rẹ; emi o mu iru-ọmọ rẹ lati ìla-õrun wá, emi o si ṣà ọ jọ lati ìwọ-õrun wá.
entries.en: Fear not: for I am with thee: I will bring thy seed from the east, and gather thee from the west;

entries.yo: Emi o wi fun ariwa pe, Da silẹ; ati fun gusu pe, Máṣe da duro; mu awọn ọmọ mi ọkunrin lati okere wá, ati awọn ọmọ mi obinrin lati opin ilẹ wá.
entries.en: I will say to the north, Give up; and to the south, Keep not back: bring my sons from far, and my daughters from the ends of the earth;

entries.yo: Olukuluku ẹniti a npè li orukọ mi: nitori mo ti dá a fun ogo mi, mo ti mọ ọ, ani, mo ti ṣe e pé.
entries.en: Even every one that is called by my name: for I have created him for my glory, I have formed him; yea, I have made him.

entries.yo: Mu awọn afọju enia ti o li oju jade wá, ati awọn aditi ti o li eti.
entries.en: Bring forth the blind people that have eyes, and the deaf that have ears.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki gbogbo awọn orilẹ-ède ṣa ara wọn jọ pọ̀, ki awọn enia pejọ; tani ninu wọn ti o le sọ eyi, ti o si le fi ohun atijọ han ni? jẹ ki wọn mu awọn ẹlẹri wọn jade, ki a le dá wọn lare; nwọn o si gbọ́, nwọn o si wipe, Õtọ ni.
entries.en: Let all the nations be gathered together, and let the people be assembled: who among them can declare this, and shew us former things? let them bring forth their witnesses, that they may be justified: or let them hear, and say, It is truth.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin li ẹlẹri mi, ni Oluwa wi, ati iranṣẹ mi ti mo ti yàn: ki ẹnyin ki o le mọ̀, ki ẹ si gbà mi gbọ́ ki o si ye nyin pe, Emi ni; a kò mọ̀ Ọlọrun kan ṣãju mi, bẹ̃ni ọkan kì yio si hù lẹhin mi.
entries.en: Ye are my witnesses, saith the LORD, and my servant whom I have chosen: that ye may know and believe me, and understand that I am he: before me there was no God formed, neither shall there be after me.

entries.yo: Emi, ani emi ni Oluwa; ati lẹhin mi, kò si olugbala kan.
entries.en: I, even I, am the LORD; and beside me there is no saviour.

entries.yo: Emi ti sọ, mo ti gbalà, mo si ti fi hàn, nigbati ko si ajeji ọlọrun kan lãrin nyin: ẹnyin ni iṣe ẹlẹri mi, li Oluwa wi, pe, Emi li Ọlọrun.
entries.en: I have declared, and have saved, and I have shewed, when there was no strange god among you: therefore ye are my witnesses, saith the LORD, that I am God.

entries.yo: Lõtọ, ki ọjọ ki o to wà, Emi na ni, ko si si ẹniti o le gbani kuro li ọwọ́ mi: emi o ṣiṣẹ, tani o le yi i pada?
entries.en: Yea, before the day was I am he; and there is none that can deliver out of my hand: I will work, and who shall let it?

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa, olurapada nyin, Ẹni-Mimọ Israeli wi; Nitori nyin ni mo ṣe ranṣẹ si Babiloni, ti mo si jù gbogbo wọn bi isansa, ati awọn ara Kaldea, sisalẹ si awọn ọkọ̀ igbe-ayọ̀ wọn.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD, your redeemer, the Holy One of Israel; For your sake I have sent to Babylon, and have brought down all their nobles, and the Chaldeans, whose cry is in the ships.

entries.yo: Emi ni Oluwa, Ẹni-Mimọ́ nyin, ẹlẹda Israeli Ọba nyin.
entries.en: I am the LORD, your Holy One, the creator of Israel, your King.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa wi, ẹniti o la ọ̀na ninu okun, ati ipa-ọ̀na ninu alagbara omi;
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD, which maketh a way in the sea, and a path in the mighty waters;

entries.yo: Ẹniti o mu kẹkẹ ati ẹṣin jade, ogun ati agbara; nwọn o jumọ dubulẹ, nwọn kì yio dide: nwọn run, a pa wọn bi owú fitila.
entries.en: Which bringeth forth the chariot and horse, the army and the power; they shall lie down together, they shall not rise: they are extinct, they are quenched as tow.

entries.yo: Ẹ máṣe ranti nkan ti iṣaju mọ, ati nkan ti atijọ, ẹ máṣe rò wọn.
entries.en: Remember ye not the former things, neither consider the things of old.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, emi o ṣe ohun titun kan; nisisiyi ni yio hù jade; ẹnyin ki yio mọ̀ ọ bi? lõtọ, emi o là ọ̀na kan ninu aginju, ati odò li aṣalẹ̀.
entries.en: Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.

entries.yo: Awọn ẹran igbẹ yio yìn mi logo, awọn dragoni ati awọn owiwi; nitori emi o funni li omi li aginjù, ati odo ni aṣalẹ̀, lati fi ohun mimu fun awọn enia mi, ayanfẹ mi;
entries.en: The beast of the field shall honour me, the dragons and the owls: because I give waters in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert, to give drink to my people, my chosen.

entries.yo: Awọn enia yi ni mo ti mọ fun ara mi; nwọn o fi iyìn mi hàn.
entries.en: This people have I formed for myself; they shall shew forth my praise.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn iwọ kò ké pe mi, Jakobu; ṣugbọn ãrẹ̀ mu ọ nitori mi, iwọ Israeli.
entries.en: But thou hast not called upon me, O Jacob; but thou hast been weary of me, O Israel.

entries.yo: Iwọ ko mu ọmọ-ẹran ẹbọ sisun rẹ fun mi wá; bẹ̃ni iwọ ko fi ẹbọ rẹ bu ọlá fun mi. Emi ko fi ọrẹ mu ọ sìn, emi ko si fi turari da ọ li agara.
entries.en: Thou hast not brought me the small cattle of thy burnt offerings; neither hast thou honoured me with thy sacrifices. I have not caused thee to serve with an offering, nor wearied thee with incense.

entries.yo: Iwọ ko fi owo rà kalamu olõrun didun fun mi, bẹ̃ni iwọ ko fi ọra ẹbọ rẹ yó mi; ṣugbọn iwọ fi ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ mu mi ṣe lãla, iwọ si fi aiṣedẽde rẹ da mi li agara.
entries.en: Thou hast bought me no sweet cane with money, neither hast thou filled me with the fat of thy sacrifices: but thou hast made me to serve with thy sins, thou hast wearied me with thine iniquities.

entries.yo: Emi, ani emi li ẹniti o pa irekọja rẹ rẹ́ nitori ti emi tikalami, emi ki yio si ranti ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ.
entries.en: I, even I, am he that blotteth out thy transgressions for mine own sake, and will not remember thy sins.

entries.yo: Rán mi leti: ki a jumọ sọ ọ; iwọ rò, ki a le da ọ lare.
entries.en: Put me in remembrance: let us plead together: declare thou, that thou mayest be justified.

entries.yo: Baba rẹ iṣãju ti ṣẹ̀, awọn olukọni rẹ ti yapa kuro lọdọ mi.
entries.en: Thy first father hath sinned, and thy teachers have transgressed against me.

entries.yo: Nitorina mo ti sọ awọn olori ibi mimọ́ na di aimọ́, mo si ti fi Jakobu fun egún, ati Israeli fun ẹ̀gan.
entries.en: Therefore I have profaned the princes of the sanctuary, and have given Jacob to the curse, and Israel to reproaches.

entries.yo: ṢUGBỌN nisisiyi, gbọ́, iwọ Jakobu iranṣẹ mi, ati Israeli ẹniti mo ti yàn:
entries.en: Yet now hear, O Jacob my servant; and Israel, whom I have chosen:

entries.yo: Bayi ni Oluwa wi, ẹniti o dá ọ, ti o mọ ọ lati inu wá, ti yio si ràn ọ lọwọ; Má bẹ̀ru, iwọ Jakobu, iranṣẹ mi; ati iwọ Jeṣuruni ti mo ti yàn.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD that made thee, and formed thee from the womb, which will help thee; Fear not, O Jacob, my servant; and thou, Jesurun, whom I have chosen.

entries.yo: Nitori emi o dà omi lu ẹniti ongbẹ ngbẹ, ati iṣàn-omi si ilẹ gbigbẹ: emi o dà ẹmi mi si iru rẹ, ati ibukun mi si iru-ọmọ rẹ.
entries.en: For I will pour water upon him that is thirsty, and floods upon the dry ground: I will pour my spirit upon thy seed, and my blessing upon thine offspring:

entries.yo: Nwọn o si hù soke lãrin koriko, bi igi willo leti ipadò.
entries.en: And they shall spring up as among the grass, as willows by the water courses.

entries.yo: Ọkan yio wipe, ti Oluwa li emi, omiran yio si pe ara rẹ̀ nipa orukọ Jakobu; omiran yio si fi ọwọ́ rẹ̀ kọ pe, on ni ti Oluwa, yio si pe apele rẹ̀ nipa orukọ Israeli.
entries.en: One shall say, I am the LORD's; and another shall call himself by the name of Jacob; and another shall subscribe with his hand unto the LORD, and surname himself by the name of Israel.

entries.yo: Bayi ni Oluwa wi, Ọba Israeli, ati Olurapada rẹ, Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun; Emi ni ẹni-ikini, ati ẹni-ikẹhin; ati lẹhin mi ko si Ọlọrun kan.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD the King of Israel, and his redeemer the LORD of hosts; I am the first, and I am the last; and beside me there is no God.

entries.yo: Tani yio si pè bi emi, ti yio si sọ ọ ti yio si tò o lẹsẹ-ẹsẹ fun mi, lati igbati mo ti yàn awọn enia igbani? ati nkan wọnni ti mbọ̀, ti yio si ṣẹ, ki nwọn fi hàn fun wọn.
entries.en: And who, as I, shall call, and shall declare it, and set it in order for me, since I appointed the ancient people? and the things that are coming, and shall come, let them shew unto them.

entries.yo: Ẹ má bẹ̀ru, ẹ má si foyà; emi ko ha ti mu nyin gbọ́ lati igba na wá, nkò ha si ti sọ ọ? ẹnyin na ni ẹlẹri mi. Ọlọrun kan mbẹ lẹhin mi bi? kò si Apata kan, emi ko mọ̀ ọkan.
entries.en: Fear ye not, neither be afraid: have not I told thee from that time, and have declared it? ye are even my witnesses. Is there a God beside me? yea, there is no God; I know not any.

entries.yo: Asan ni gbogbo awọn ti ngbẹ ere; nkan iyebiye wọn ki yio si lerè; awọn tikala wọn li ẹlẹri ara wọn: nwọn kò riran, bẹ̃ni nwọn kò mọ̀; ki oju ba le tì wọn.
entries.en: They that make a graven image are all of them vanity; and their delectable things shall not profit; and they are their own witnesses; they see not, nor know; that they may be ashamed.

entries.yo: Tani yio gbẹ́ oriṣa, tabi ti yio dà ere ti kò ni ère kan?
entries.en: Who hath formed a god, or molten a graven image that is profitable for nothing?

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, oju o tì gbogbo awọn ẹgbẹ́ rẹ̀; awọn oniṣọna, enia ni nwọn: jẹ ki gbogbo wọn kò ara wọn jọ, ki nwọn dide duro; nwọn o bẹ̀ru, oju o si jumọ tì wọn.
entries.en: Behold, all his fellows shall be ashamed: and the workmen, they are of men: let them all be gathered together, let them stand up; yet they shall fear, and they shall be ashamed together.

entries.yo: Alagbẹdẹ rọ ãke kan, o ṣiṣẹ ninu ẹyín, o fi ọmọ-owú rọ ọ, o si fi agbara apá rẹ̀ ṣe e: ebi npa a pẹlu, agbara rẹ̀ si tan; ko mu omi, o si rẹ̀ ẹ.
entries.en: The smith with the tongs both worketh in the coals, and fashioneth it with hammers, and worketh it with the strength of his arms: yea, he is hungry, and his strength faileth: he drinketh no water, and is faint.

entries.yo: Gbẹnàgbẹnà ta okùn rẹ̀, o si fi nkan pupa sàmi rẹ̀, o fi ìfá fá a, o si fi kọmpassi là a birikiti: o sì yá a li aworán ọkunrin, gẹgẹ bi ẹwà enia, ki o le ma gbe inu ile.
entries.en: The carpenter stretcheth out his rule; he marketh it out with a line; he fitteth it with planes, and he marketh it out with the compass, and maketh it after the figure of a man, according to the beauty of a man; that it may remain in the house.

entries.yo: O bẹ́ igi kedari lu ilẹ fun ra rẹ̀, o si mu igi kipressi ati oaku, o si mu u le fun ra rẹ̀ ninu awọn igi igbó: o gbìn igi aṣi, ojò si mu u dagba.
entries.en: He heweth him down cedars, and taketh the cypress and the oak, which he strengtheneth for himself among the trees of the forest: he planteth an ash, and the rain doth nourish it.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni yio jẹ ohun idana fun enia: nitori yio mu ninu wọn, yio si fi yá iná; lõtọ, o dá iná, o si din akara, lõtọ, o ṣe ọlọrun fun ra rẹ̀, o si nsìn i; o gbẹ ẹ li ere, o si nforibalẹ fun u.
entries.en: Then shall it be for a man to burn: for he will take thereof, and warm himself; yea, he kindleth it, and baketh bread; yea, he maketh a god, and worshippeth it; he maketh it a graven image, and falleth down thereto.

entries.yo: Apakan ninu rẹ̀ li o fi dá iná, apakan ninu rẹ̀ li o fi jẹ ẹran: o sun sisun, o si yo, o yá iná pẹlu, o si wipe, Ahã, ara mi gbona, mo ti ri iná.
entries.en: He burneth part thereof in the fire; with part thereof he eateth flesh; he roasteth roast, and is satisfied: yea, he warmeth himself, and saith, Aha, I am warm, I have seen the fire:

entries.yo: Iyokù rẹ̀ li o si fi ṣe ọlọrun, ani ere gbigbẹ́ rẹ̀, o foribalẹ fun u, o sìn i, o gbadura si i, o si wipe, Gbà mi; nitori iwọ li ọlọrun mi.
entries.en: And the residue thereof he maketh a god, even his graven image: he falleth down unto it, and worshippeth it, and prayeth unto it, and saith, Deliver me; for thou art my god.

entries.yo: Nwọn kò mọ̀, oye ko si ye wọn: nitori o dí wọn li oju, ki nwọn ki o má le ri; ati aiya wọn, ki oye ki o má le ye wọn.
entries.en: They have not known nor understood: for he hath shut their eyes, that they cannot see; and their hearts, that they cannot understand.

entries.yo: Kò si ẹniti o rò li ọkàn rẹ̀, bẹ̃ni ko si imọ̀ tabi oye lati wipe, Mo ti fi apakan rẹ̀ da iná; mo si din akara pẹlu lori ẹyin iná rẹ̀: mo ti sun ẹran, mo si jẹ ẹ: emi o ha fi iyokù rẹ̀ ṣe irira? emi o ha foribalẹ fun ìti igi?
entries.en: And none considereth in his heart, neither is there knowledge nor understanding to say, I have burned part of it in the fire; yea, also I have baked bread upon the coals thereof; I have roasted flesh, and eaten it: and shall I make the residue thereof an abomination? shall I fall down to the stock of a tree?

entries.yo: O fi ẽru bọ́ ara rẹ̀: aiya ẹtàn ti dari rẹ̀ si apakan, ti kò le gbà ọkàn rẹ̀ là, bẹ̃ni kò le wipe, Eke ko ha wà li ọwọ́ ọtun mi?
entries.en: He feedeth on ashes: a deceived heart hath turned him aside, that he cannot deliver his soul, nor say, Is there not a lie in my right hand?

entries.yo: Ranti wọnyi, Jakobu ati Israeli; nitori iwọ ni iranṣẹ mi: Emi ti mọ ọ; iranṣẹ mi ni iwọ, Israeli; iwọ ki yio di ẹni-igbagbe lọdọ mi.
entries.en: Remember these, O Jacob and Israel; for thou art my servant: I have formed thee; thou art my servant: O Israel, thou shalt not be forgotten of me.

entries.yo: Mo ti pa irekọja rẹ rẹ́, bi awọsanma ṣiṣú dùdu, ati ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ, bi kũku: yipada sọdọ mi; nitori mo ti rà ọ pada.
entries.en: I have blotted out, as a thick cloud, thy transgressions, and, as a cloud, thy sins: return unto me; for I have redeemed thee.

entries.yo: Kọrin, ẹnyin ọrun; nitori Oluwa ti ṣe e: kigbe, ẹnyin isalẹ aiye; bú si orin, ẹnyin oke-nla, igbó, ati gbogbo igi inu rẹ̀; nitori Oluwa ti rà Jakobu pada, o si ṣe ara rẹ̀ logo ni Israeli.
entries.en: Sing, O ye heavens; for the LORD hath done it: shout, ye lower parts of the earth: break forth into singing, ye mountains, O forest, and every tree therein: for the LORD hath redeemed Jacob, and glorified himself in Israel.

entries.yo: Bayi ni Oluwa, Olurapada rẹ wi, ati ẹniti o mọ ọ lati inu wá: emi li Oluwa ti o ṣe ohun gbogbo; ti o nikan nà awọn ọrun; ti mo si tikara mi tẹ́ aiye.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD, thy redeemer, and he that formed thee from the womb, I am the LORD that maketh all things; that stretcheth forth the heavens alone; that spreadeth abroad the earth by myself;

entries.yo: Ẹniti o sọ àmi awọn eke di asan, ti o si bà awọn alafọṣẹ li ori jẹ, ti o dá awọn ọlọgbọn pada, ti o si sọ imọ̀ wọn di wère.
entries.en: That frustrateth the tokens of the liars, and maketh diviners mad; that turneth wise men backward, and maketh their knowledge foolish;

entries.yo: Ti o fi ìdi ọ̀rọ iranṣẹ rẹ̀ mulẹ, ti o si mu ìmọ awọn ikọ̀ rẹ̀ ṣẹ; ti o wi fun Jerusalemu pe, A o tẹ̀ ọ dó; ati fun gbogbo ilu Juda pe, A o kọ́ nyin, emi o si gbe gbogbo ahoro rẹ̀ dide:
entries.en: That confirmeth the word of his servant, and performeth the counsel of his messengers; that saith to Jerusalem, Thou shalt be inhabited; and to the cities of Judah, Ye shall be built, and I will raise up the decayed places thereof:

entries.yo: Ti o wi fun ibú pe, Gbẹ, emi o si mu gbogbo odò rẹ gbẹ.
entries.en: That saith to the deep, Be dry, and I will dry up thy rivers:

entries.yo: Ti o wi niti Kirusi pe, Oluṣọ-agutan mi ni, yío si mu gbogbo ifẹ mi ṣẹ: ti o wi niti Jerusalemu pe, A o kọ́ ọ: ati niti tempili pe, A o fi ipilẹ rẹ̀ sọlẹ.
entries.en: That saith of Cyrus, He is my shepherd, and shall perform all my pleasure: even saying to Jerusalem, Thou shalt be built; and to the temple, Thy foundation shall be laid.

entries.yo: BAYI ni Oluwa wi fun ẹni-ororo rẹ̀, fun Kirusi, ẹniti mo di ọwọ́ ọtún rẹ̀ mu, lati ṣẹ́gun awọn orilẹ-ède niwaju rẹ̀; emi o si tú amure ẹgbẹ awọn ọba, lati ṣi ilẹkùn mejeji niwaju rẹ̀, a ki yio si tì ẹnu-bode na;
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have holden, to subdue nations before him; and I will loose the loins of kings, to open before him the two leaved gates; and the gates shall not be shut;

entries.yo: Emi o lọ siwaju rẹ, emi o si sọ ibi wiwọ́ wọnni di titọ́: emi o fọ ilẹkùn idẹ wọnni tũtũ, emi o si ke ọjá-irin si meji.
entries.en: I will go before thee, and make the crooked places straight: I will break in pieces the gates of brass, and cut in sunder the bars of iron:

entries.yo: Emi o si fi iṣura okùnkun fun ọ, ati ọrọ̀ ti a pamọ nibi ikọkọ, ki iwọ le mọ̀ pe, emi Oluwa, ti o pè ọ li orukọ rẹ, li Ọlọrun Israeli.
entries.en: And I will give thee the treasures of darkness, and hidden riches of secret places, that thou mayest know that I, the LORD, which call thee by thy name, am the God of Israel.

entries.yo: Nitori Jakobu iranṣẹ mi, ati Israeli ayanfẹ mi, emi ti pè ọ li orukọ rẹ: mo ti fi apele kan fun ọ, bi iwọ ko tilẹ ti mọ̀ mi.
entries.en: For Jacob my servant's sake, and Israel mine elect, I have even called thee by thy name: I have surnamed thee, though thou hast not known me.

entries.yo: Emi li Oluwa, ko si ẹlomiran, kò si Ọlọrun kan lẹhin mi: mo dì ọ li àmure, bi iwọ kò tilẹ ti mọ̀ mi.
entries.en: I am the LORD, and there is none else, there is no God beside me: I girded thee, though thou hast not known me:

entries.yo: Ki nwọn le mọ̀ lati ila-õrun, ati lati iwọ-õrun wá pe, ko si ẹnikan lẹhin mi; Emi ni Oluwa, ko si ẹlomiran.
entries.en: That they may know from the rising of the sun, and from the west, that there is none beside me. I am the LORD, and there is none else.

entries.yo: Mo dá imọlẹ, mo si dá okunkun: mo ṣe alafia, mo si dá ibi: Emi Oluwa li o ṣe gbogbo wọnyi.
entries.en: I form the light, and create darkness: I make peace, and create evil: I the LORD do all these things.

entries.yo: Kán silẹ, ẹnyin ọrun, lati oke wá, ki ẹ si jẹ ki ofurufu rọ̀ ododo silẹ; jẹ ki ilẹ ki o là, ki o si mu igbala jade; si jẹ ki ododo ki o hù soke pẹlu rẹ̀; Emi Oluwa li o dá a.
entries.en: Drop down, ye heavens, from above, and let the skies pour down righteousness: let the earth open, and let them bring forth salvation, and let righteousness spring up together; I the LORD have created it.

entries.yo: Egbe ni fun ẹniti o mbá Elẹda rẹ̀ jà, apãdi ninu awọn apãdi ilẹ! Amọ̀ yio ha wi fun ẹniti o mọ ọ pe, Kini iwọ nṣe? tabi iṣẹ rẹ pe, On kò li ọwọ́?
entries.en: Woe unto him that striveth with his Maker! Let the potsherd strive with the potsherds of the earth. Shall the clay say to him that fashioneth it, What makest thou? or thy work, He hath no hands?

entries.yo: Egbe ni fun ẹniti o wi fun baba rẹ̀ pe, Kini iwọ bi? tabi fun obinrin nì pe, Kini iwọ bi?
entries.en: Woe unto him that saith unto his father, What begettest thou? or to the woman, What hast thou brought forth?

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa wi, Ẹni-Mimọ Israeli, ati Ẹlẹda rẹ̀, Bere nkan ti mbọ̀ lọwọ mi, niti awọn ọmọ mi ọkunrin, ati niti iṣẹ ọwọ mi, ẹ paṣẹ fun mi.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD, the Holy One of Israel, and his Maker, Ask me of things to come concerning my sons, and concerning the work of my hands command ye me.

entries.yo: Mo ti dá aiye, mo si ti da enia sori rẹ̀; Emi, ani ọwọ́ mi, li o ti nà awọn ọrun, gbogbo awọn ogun wọn ni mo si ti paṣẹ fun.
entries.en: I have made the earth, and created man upon it: I, even my hands, have stretched out the heavens, and all their host have I commanded.

entries.yo: Mo ti gbe e dide ninu ododo, emi o si mu gbogbo ọ̀na rẹ̀ tọ́; on o kọ́ ilu mi, yio si dá awọn ondè mi silẹ: ki iṣe fun iye owo tabi ère, li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi.
entries.en: I have raised him up in righteousness, and I will direct all his ways: he shall build my city, and he shall let go my captives, not for price nor reward, saith the LORD of hosts.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa wi, pe, Ere iṣẹ Egipti, ati ọjà Etiopia ati ti awọn ara Sabea, awọn enia ti o ṣigbọnlẹ yio kọja wá sọdọ rẹ, nwọn o si jẹ tirẹ: nwọn o tẹle ọ; ninu ẹwọ̀n ni nwọn o kọja wá, nwọn o foribalẹ fun ọ, nwọn o si bẹ̀ ọ, wipe, Nitotọ Ọlọrun wà ninu rẹ; kò si si ẹlomiran, kò si Ọlọrun miran.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD, The labour of Egypt, and merchandise of Ethiopia and of the Sabeans, men of stature, shall come over unto thee, and they shall be thine: they shall come after thee; in chains they shall come over, and they shall fall down unto thee, they shall make supplication unto thee, saying, Surely God is in thee; and there is none else, there is no God.

entries.yo: Lõtọ iwọ li Ọlọrun ti o fi ara rẹ pamọ, Ọlọrun Israeli, Olugbala.
entries.en: Verily thou art a God that hidest thyself, O God of Israel, the Saviour.

entries.yo: Oju yio tì wọn, gbogbo wọn o si dãmu pọ̀; gbogbo awọn ti nṣe ere yio si jumọ lọ si idãmu.
entries.en: They shall be ashamed, and also confounded, all of them: they shall go to confusion together that are makers of idols.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn a o fi igbala ainipẹkun gba Israeli là ninu Oluwa: oju ki yio tì nyin, bẹ̃ni ẹ ki yio dãmu titi aiye ainipẹkun.
entries.en: But Israel shall be saved in the LORD with an everlasting salvation: ye shall not be ashamed nor confounded world without end.

entries.yo: Nitori bayi li Oluwa wi, ẹniti o dá awọn ọrun; Ọlọrun tikararẹ̀ ti o mọ aiye, ti o si ṣe e; o ti fi idi rẹ̀ mulẹ, kò da a lasan, o mọ ọ ki a le gbe inu rẹ̀: Emi ni Oluwa; ko si ẹlomiran.
entries.en: For thus saith the LORD that created the heavens; God himself that formed the earth and made it; he hath established it, he created it not in vain, he formed it to be inhabited: I am the LORD; and there is none else.

entries.yo: Emi kò sọrọ ni ikọkọ ni ibi okùnkun aiye: Emi kò wi fun iru-ọmọ Jakobu pe, Ẹ wá mi lasan: emi Oluwa li o nsọ ododo, mo fi nkan wọnni ti o tọ́ hàn.
entries.en: I have not spoken in secret, in a dark place of the earth: I said not unto the seed of Jacob, Seek ye me in vain: I the LORD speak righteousness, I declare things that are right.

entries.yo: Ko ara nyin jọ ki ẹ si wá; ẹ jọ sunmọ tosi, ẹnyin ti o salà ninu awọn orilẹ-ède: awọn ti o gbé igi ere gbigbẹ́ wọn kò ni ìmọ, nwọn si gbadura si ọlọrun ti ko le gba ni.
entries.en: Assemble yourselves and come; draw near together, ye that are escaped of the nations: they have no knowledge that set up the wood of their graven image, and pray unto a god that cannot save.

entries.yo: Ẹ sọ ọ, ki ẹ si mu wá, lõtọ, ki nwọn ki o jọ gbimọ̀ pọ̀: tali o mu ni gbọ́ eyi lati igbãni wa? tali o ti sọ ọ lati igba na wá? emi Oluwa kọ? ko si Ọlọrun miran pẹlu mi; Ọlọrun ododo ati Olugbala; ko si ẹlomiran lẹhin mi.
entries.en: Tell ye, and bring them near; yea, let them take counsel together: who hath declared this from ancient time? who hath told it from that time? have not I the LORD? and there is no God else beside me; a just God and a Saviour; there is none beside me.

entries.yo: Kọju si mi, ki a si gba nyin là, gbogbo opin aiye: nitori emi li Ọlọrun, ko si ẹlomiran.
entries.en: Look unto me, and be ye saved, all the ends of the earth: for I am God, and there is none else.

entries.yo: Mo ti fi ara mi bura, ọ̀rọ na ti ti ẹnu ododo mi jade, ki yio si pada, pe, Gbogbo ẽkún yio kunlẹ fun mi, gbogbọ ahọn yio bura.
entries.en: I have sworn by myself, the word is gone out of my mouth in righteousness, and shall not return, That unto me every knee shall bow, every tongue shall swear.

entries.yo: Lõtọ, a o wipe, ninu Oluwa li emi ni ododo ati agbara: sọdọ rẹ̀ ni gbogbo enia yio wá; oju o si tì gbogbo awọn ti o binu si i.
entries.en: Surely, shall one say, in the LORD have I righteousness and strength: even to him shall men come; and all that are incensed against him shall be ashamed.

entries.yo: Ninu Oluwa li a o dá gbogbo iru-ọmọ Israeli lare, nwọn o si ṣogo.
entries.en: In the LORD shall all the seed of Israel be justified, and shall glory.

entries.yo: SỌKALẸ, si joko ninu ekuru, iwọ wundia ọmọbinrin Babiloni, joko ni ilẹ: itẹ́ kò si, iwọ ọmọbinrin ara Kaldea: nitori a kì o pè ọ ni ẹlẹ́gẹ on aláfẹ mọ.
entries.en: Come down, and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon, sit on the ground: there is no throne, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for thou shalt no more be called tender and delicate.

entries.yo: Gbe ọlọ, si lọ̀ iyẹfun, ṣi iboju rẹ, ká aṣọ ẹsẹ, ká aṣọ itan, là odo wọnni kọja.
entries.en: Take the millstones, and grind meal: uncover thy locks, make bare the leg, uncover the thigh, pass over the rivers.

entries.yo: A o ṣi ihoho rẹ, a o si ri itiju rẹ pẹlu; emi o gbẹsan, enia kì yio sí lati da mi duro.
entries.en: Thy nakedness shall be uncovered, yea, thy shame shall be seen: I will take vengeance, and I will not meet thee as a man.

entries.yo: Olurapada wa, Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun li orukọ rẹ̀, Ẹni-Mimọ Israeli.
entries.en: As for our redeemer, the LORD of hosts is his name, the Holy One of Israel.

entries.yo: Joko, dakẹ jẹ, lọ sinu okùnkun, iwọ ọmọbinrin ara Kaldea, nitori a ki yio pe ọ ni Iyálode awọn ijọba mọ.
entries.en: Sit thou silent, and get thee into darkness, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for thou shalt no more be called, The lady of kingdoms.

entries.yo: Emi ti binu si enia mi, emi ti sọ ilẹ ini mi di aimọ́, mo si ti fi wọn le ọ lọwọ: iwọ kò kãnu wọn, iwọ fi ajàga wuwo le awọn alagba lori.
entries.en: I was wroth with my people, I have polluted mine inheritance, and given them into thine hand: thou didst shew them no mercy; upon the ancient hast thou very heavily laid thy yoke.

entries.yo: Iwọ si wipe, Emi o ma jẹ Iyalode titi lai: bẹ̃ni iwọ kò fi nkan wọnyi si aiya rẹ, bẹ̃ni iwọ kò ranti igbẹhin rẹ.
entries.en: And thou saidst, I shall be a lady for ever: so that thou didst not lay these things to thy heart, neither didst remember the latter end of it.

entries.yo: Nitorina gbọ́ eyi, iwọ alafẹ́, ti o joko li ainani, ti o wi li ọkàn rẹ pe, Emi ni, kò si si ẹlomiran lẹhin mi: emi ki yio joko bi opo, bẹ̃ni emi ki yio mọ̀ òfo ọmọ.
entries.en: Therefore hear now this, thou that art given to pleasures, that dwellest carelessly, that sayest in thine heart, I am, and none else beside me; I shall not sit as a widow, neither shall I know the loss of children:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nkan meji wọnyi ni yio deba ọ li ojiji, li ọjọ kan, òfo ọmọ ati opo: nwọn o ba ọ perepere, nitori ọpọlọpọ iṣẹ́ ajẹ́ rẹ, ati nitori ọpọlọpọ iṣẹ́ afọṣẹ rẹ.
entries.en: But these two things shall come to thee in a moment in one day, the loss of children, and widowhood: they shall come upon thee in their perfection for the multitude of thy sorceries, and for the great abundance of thine enchantments.

entries.yo: Nitori ti iwọ ti gbẹkẹle ìwa buburu rẹ: iwọ ti wipe, Kò si ẹnikan ti o ri mi. Ọgbọ́n rẹ ati ìmọ rẹ, o ti mu ọ ṣinà; iwọ si ti wi li ọkàn rẹ pe, Emi ni, ko si ẹlomiran lẹhin mi.
entries.en: For thou hast trusted in thy wickedness: thou hast said, None seeth me. Thy wisdom and thy knowledge, it hath perverted thee; and thou hast said in thine heart, I am, and none else beside me.
