entries.yo: Nitorina ni ibi yio ṣe ba ọ; iwọ ki yio mọ̀ ibẹrẹ rẹ̀: ibi yio si ṣubu lù ọ; ti iwọ kì yio le mu kuro: idahoro yio deba ọ lojiji, iwọ kì yio si mọ̀.
entries.en: Therefore shall evil come upon thee; thou shalt not know from whence it riseth: and mischief shall fall upon thee; thou shalt not be able to put it off: and desolation shall come upon thee suddenly, which thou shalt not know.

entries.yo: Duro nisisiyi, ti iwọ ti iṣẹ afọṣẹ rẹ, ati ọpọlọpọ iṣẹ ajẹ́ rẹ, eyi ti o ti fi nṣe iṣẹ iṣe lati igba ewe rẹ wá; bi o ba ṣepe o lè jẹ erè fun ọ, bi o ba ṣe pe iwọ lè bori.
entries.en: Stand now with thine enchantments, and with the multitude of thy sorceries, wherein thou hast laboured from thy youth; if so be thou shalt be able to profit, if so be thou mayest prevail.

entries.yo: Arẹ̀ mu ọ nipa ọpọlọpọ ìgbimọ rẹ. Jẹ ki awọn awoye-ọrun, awọn awoye-irawọ, awọn afi-oṣupasọ-asọtẹlẹ, dide duro nisisiyi, ki nwọn si gbà ọ lọwọ nkan wọnyi ti yio ba ọ.
entries.en: Thou art wearied in the multitude of thy counsels. Let now the astrologers, the stargazers, the monthly prognosticators, stand up, and save thee from these things that shall come upon thee.

entries.yo: Kiye si i, nwọn o dabi akekù koriko: iná yio jo wọn: nwọn ki yio gba ara wọn lọwọ agbara ọwọ́ iná; ẹyin iná kan ki yio si lati yá, tabi iná lati joko niwaju rẹ̀.
entries.en: Behold, they shall be as stubble; the fire shall burn them; they shall not deliver themselves from the power of the flame: there shall not be a coal to warm at, nor fire to sit before it.

entries.yo: Bayi ni awọn ti iwọ ti ba ṣiṣẹ yio jẹ fun ọ, awọn oniṣowo rẹ, lati ewe rẹ wá; nwọn o kiri lọ, olukuluku si ẹkùn rẹ̀; ko si ẹnikan ti yio gbà ọ.
entries.en: Thus shall they be unto thee with whom thou hast laboured, even thy merchants, from thy youth: they shall wander every one to his quarter; none shall save thee.

entries.yo: GBỌ́ eyi, ẹnyin ile Jakobu, ti a nfi orukọ Israeli pè, ti o si ti inu omi Juda wọnni jade wá, ti o nfi orukọ Oluwa bura, ti o si ndarukọ Ọlọrun Israeli, ṣugbọn ki iṣe li otitọ, tabi li ododo.
entries.en: Hear ye this, O house of Jacob, which are called by the name of Israel, and are come forth out of the waters of Judah, which swear by the name of the LORD, and make mention of the God of Israel, but not in truth, nor in righteousness.

entries.yo: Nitori nwọn npè ara wọn ni ti ilu mimọ́ nì, nwọn si gbé ara wọn le Ọlọrun Israeli: Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun li orukọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: For they call themselves of the holy city, and stay themselves upon the God of Israel; The LORD of hosts is his name.

entries.yo: Emi ti sọ nkan ti iṣãju wọnni lati ipilẹṣẹ; nwọn si ti jade lati ẹnu mi lọ, emi si fi wọn hàn; emi ṣe wọn lojijì, nwọn si ti ṣẹ.
entries.en: I have declared the former things from the beginning; and they went forth out of my mouth, and I shewed them; I did them suddenly, and they came to pass.

entries.yo: Nitori emi mọ̀ pe olori-lile ni iwọ, ọrùn rẹ jẹ iṣan irin, iwaju rẹ si jẹ idẹ.
entries.en: Because I knew that thou art obstinate, and thy neck is an iron sinew, and thy brow brass;

entries.yo: Li atetekọṣe ni mo tilẹ ti sọ fun ọ; ki o to de ni emi ti fihàn ọ: ki iwọ má ba wipe, Oriṣa mi li o ṣe wọn, ati ere mi gbigbẹ́, ati ere mi didà li o ti pa wọn li aṣẹ.
entries.en: I have even from the beginning declared it to thee; before it came to pass I shewed it thee: lest thou shouldest say, Mine idol hath done them, and my graven image, and my molten image, hath commanded them.

entries.yo: Iwọ ti gbọ́, wò gbogbo eyi; ẹnyin kì yio ha sọ ọ? Emi ti fi ohun titun hàn ọ lati igba yi lọ, ani nkan ti o pamọ́, iwọ kò si mọ̀ wọn.
entries.en: Thou hast heard, see all this; and will not ye declare it? I have shewed thee new things from this time, even hidden things, and thou didst not know them.

entries.yo: Nisisiyi li a dá wọn, ki isi ṣe li atetekọṣe; ani ṣaju ọjọ na ti iwọ kò gbọ́ wọn; ki iwọ má ba wipe, Kiyesi i, emi mọ̀ wọn.
entries.en: They are created now, and not from the beginning; even before the day when thou heardest them not; lest thou shouldest say, Behold, I knew them.

entries.yo: Lõtọ, iwọ kò gbọ́; lõtọ, iwọ kò mọ̀; lõtọ lati igba na eti rẹ̀ kò ṣi: nitori ti emi mọ̀ pe, iwọ o hùwa arekerekè, gidigidi li a si pè ọ li olurekọja lati inu wá.
entries.en: Yea, thou heardest not; yea, thou knewest not; yea, from that time that thine ear was not opened: for I knew that thou wouldest deal very treacherously, and wast called a transgressor from the womb.

entries.yo: Nitori orukọ mi emi o mu ibinu mi pẹ, ati nitori iyìn mi, emi o fàsẹhin nitori rẹ, ki emi má ba ké ọ kuro.
entries.en: For my name's sake will I defer mine anger, and for my praise will I refrain for thee, that I cut thee not off.

entries.yo: Wò o, emi ti dà ọ, ṣugbọn ki iṣe bi fadaka; emi ti yan ọ ninu iná ileru wahala.
entries.en: Behold, I have refined thee, but not with silver; I have chosen thee in the furnace of affliction.

entries.yo: Nitori emi tikalami, ani nitori ti emi tikala mi, li emi o ṣe e, nitori a o ha ṣe bà orukọ mi jẹ? emi kì yio si fi ogo mi fun ẹlomiran.
entries.en: For mine own sake, even for mine own sake, will I do it: for how should my name be polluted? and I will not give my glory unto another.

entries.yo: Gbọ́ ti emi, iwọ Jakobu, ati Israeli, ẹni-ipè mi; Emi na ni; emi li ẹni-ikini, ati ẹni-ikẹhin.
entries.en: Hearken unto me, O Jacob and Israel, my called; I am he; I am the first, I also am the last.

entries.yo: Ọwọ́ mi pẹlu li o si ti fi ipilẹ aiye sọlẹ, atẹlẹwọ ọ̀tun mi li o si na awọn ọrun: nigbati mo pè wọn, nwọn jumọ dide duro.
entries.en: Mine hand also hath laid the foundation of the earth, and my right hand hath spanned the heavens: when I call unto them, they stand up together.

entries.yo: Gbogbo nyin, ẹ pejọ, ẹ si gbọ́; tani ninu wọn ti o ti sọ nkan wọnyi? Oluwa ti fẹ́ ẹ: yio si ṣe ifẹ rẹ̀ ni Babiloni, apá rẹ̀ yio si wà lara awọn ara Kaldea.
entries.en: All ye, assemble yourselves, and hear; which among them hath declared these things? The LORD hath loved him: he will do his pleasure on Babylon, and his arm shall be on the Chaldeans.

entries.yo: Emi, ani emi ti sọ ọ; lõtọ emi ti pè e: emi ti mu u wá, on o si mu ọ̀na rẹ̀ ṣe dẽde.
entries.en: I, even I, have spoken; yea, I have called him: I have brought him, and he shall make his way prosperous.

entries.yo: Ẹ sunmọ ọdọ mi, ẹ gbọ́ eyi; lati ipilẹ̀ṣẹ emi kò sọ̀rọ ni ikọ̀kọ; lati igbati o ti wà, nibẹ ni mo wà; ati nisisiyi Oluwa Jehofa, on Ẹmi rẹ̀, li o ti rán mi.
entries.en: Come ye near unto me, hear ye this; I have not spoken in secret from the beginning; from the time that it was, there am I: and now the Lord GOD, and his Spirit, hath sent me.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa wi, Olurapada rẹ, Ẹni-Mimọ Israeli: Emi li Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ, ti o kọ́ ọ fun èrè, ẹniti o tọ́ ọ li ọ̀na ti iwọ iba ma lọ.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD, thy Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel; I am the LORD thy God which teacheth thee to profit, which leadeth thee by the way that thou shouldest go.

entries.yo: Ibaṣepe iwọ fi eti si ofin mi! nigbana ni alafia rẹ iba dabi odo, ati ododo rẹ bi ìgbi-omi okun.
entries.en: O that thou hadst hearkened to my commandments! then had thy peace been as a river, and thy righteousness as the waves of the sea:

entries.yo: Iru-ọmọ rẹ pẹlu iba dabi iyanrìn, ati ọmọ-bibi inu rẹ bi tãra rẹ̀; a ki ba ti ke orukọ rẹ̀ kuro, bẹ̃ni a kì ba pa a run kuro niwaju mi.
entries.en: Thy seed also had been as the sand, and the offspring of thy bowels like the gravel thereof; his name should not have been cut off nor destroyed from before me.

entries.yo: Ẹ jade kuro ni Babiloni, ẹ sá kuro lọdọ awọn ara Kaldea, ẹ fi ohùn orin sọ ọ, wi eyi, sọ ọ jade titi de opin aiye; ẹ wipe, Oluwa ti rà Jakobu iranṣẹ rẹ̀ pada.
entries.en: Go ye forth of Babylon, flee ye from the Chaldeans, with a voice of singing declare ye, tell this, utter it even to the end of the earth; say ye, The LORD hath redeemed his servant Jacob.

entries.yo: Ongbẹ kò si gbẹ wọn, nigbati o mu wọn là aginjù wọnni ja; o mu omi ṣàn jade lati inu apata fun wọn, o sán apáta pẹlu, omi si tú jade.
entries.en: And they thirsted not when he led them through the deserts: he caused the waters to flow out of the rock for them: he clave the rock also, and the waters gushed out.

entries.yo: Alafia kò si fun awọn enia buburu, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: There is no peace, saith the LORD, unto the wicked.

entries.yo: Ẹ gbọ ti emi, ẹnyin erekùṣu; ki ẹ si fi etí silẹ, ẹnyin enia lati ọ̀na jijìn wá; Oluwa ti pè mi lati inu wá; lati inu iya mi li o ti dá orukọ mi.
entries.en: Listen, O isles, unto me; and hearken, ye people, from far; The LORD hath called me from the womb; from the bowels of my mother hath he made mention of my name.

entries.yo: O si ti ṣe ẹnu mi bi idà mimú; ninu ojìji ọwọ́ rẹ̀ li o ti pa mi mọ, o si sọ mi di ọfà didán; ninu apó rẹ̀ li o ti pa mi mọ́;
entries.en: And he hath made my mouth like a sharp sword; in the shadow of his hand hath he hid me, and made me a polished shaft; in his quiver hath he hid me;

entries.yo: O si wi fun mi pe, Iwọ ni iranṣẹ mi, Israeli, ninu ẹniti a o yìn mi logo.
entries.en: And said unto me, Thou art my servant, O Israel, in whom I will be glorified.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni mo wi pe, Emi ti ṣiṣẹ́ lasan, emi ti lò agbara mi lofo, ati lasan: nitõtọ idajọ mi mbẹ lọdọ Oluwa, ati iṣẹ mi lọdọ Ọlọrun mi.
entries.en: Then I said, I have laboured in vain, I have spent my strength for nought, and in vain: yet surely my judgment is with the LORD, and my work with my God.

entries.yo: Ati nisisiyi, li Oluwa wi, ẹni ti o mọ mi lati inu wá lati ṣe iranṣẹ rẹ̀, lati mu Jakobu pada wá sọdọ rẹ̀, lati ṣà Israeli jọ, ki emi le ni ogo loju Oluwa, Ọlọrun mi yio si jẹ́ agbara mi.
entries.en: And now, saith the LORD that formed me from the womb to be his servant, to bring Jacob again to him, Though Israel be not gathered, yet shall I be glorious in the eyes of the LORD, and my God shall be my strength.

entries.yo: O si wipe, O ṣe ohun kekere ki iwọ ṣe iranṣẹ mi, lati gbe awọn ẹyà Jakobu dide, ati lati mu awọn ipamọ Israeli pada: emi o si fi ọ ṣe imọlẹ awọn Keferi, ki iwọ ki o le ṣe igbala mi titi de opin aiye.
entries.en: And he said, It is a light thing that thou shouldest be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to restore the preserved of Israel: I will also give thee for a light to the Gentiles, that thou mayest be my salvation unto the end of the earth.

entries.yo: Bayi ni Oluwa, Olurapada Israeli, ati Ẹni-Mimọ rẹ wi, fun ẹniti enia ngàn, fun ẹniti orilẹ-ède korira, fun iranṣẹ awọn olori, pe, Awọn ọba yio ri, nwọn o si dide, awọn ọmọ-alade pẹlu yio wolẹ sìn, nitori Oluwa ti iṣe olõtọ, Ẹni-Mimọ Israeli, on li o yàn ọ.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD, the Redeemer of Israel, and his Holy One, to him whom man despiseth, to him whom the nation abhorreth, to a servant of rulers, Kings shall see and arise, princes also shall worship, because of the LORD that is faithful, and the Holy One of Israel, and he shall choose thee.

entries.yo: Bayi ni Oluwa wi, Li akoko itẹwọgba emi ti gbọ́ tirẹ, ati li ọjọ igbala, mo si ti ràn ọ lọwọ: emi o si pa ọ mọ, emi o si fi ọ ṣe majẹmu awọn enia, lati fi idi aiye mulẹ, lati mu ni jogun ahoro ilẹ nini wọnni.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD, In an acceptable time have I heard thee, and in a day of salvation have I helped thee: and I will preserve thee, and give thee for a covenant of the people, to establish the earth, to cause to inherit the desolate heritages;

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o le wi fun awọn igbekùn pe, Ẹ jade lọ; fun awọn ti o wà ni okùnkun pe, Ẹ fi ara nyin hàn. Nwọn o jẹ̀ li ọ̀na wọnni, pápa ijẹ wọn o si wà ni gbogbo ibi giga.
entries.en: That thou mayest say to the prisoners, Go forth; to them that are in darkness, Shew yourselves. They shall feed in the ways, and their pastures shall be in all high places.

entries.yo: Ebi kì yio pa wọn, bẹ̃ni ongbẹ kì yio si gbẹ wọn; õru kì yio mu wọn, bẹ̃ni õrùn kì yio si pa wọn: nitori ẹniti o ti ṣãnu fun wọn yio tọ́ wọn, ani nihà isun omi ni yio dà wọn.
entries.en: They shall not hunger nor thirst; neither shall the heat nor sun smite them: for he that hath mercy on them shall lead them, even by the springs of water shall he guide them.

entries.yo: Emi o si sọ gbogbo awọn òke-nla mi wọnni di ọ̀na, a o si gbe ọ̀na opopo mi wọnni ga.
entries.en: And I will make all my mountains a way, and my highways shall be exalted.

entries.yo: Kiye si i, awọn wọnyi yio wá lati ọ̀na jijìn: si wò o, awọn wọnyi lati ariwa wá; ati lati iwọ-õrun wá, ati awọn wọnyi lati ilẹ Sinimu wá.
entries.en: Behold, these shall come from far: and, lo, these from the north and from the west; and these from the land of Sinim.

entries.yo: Kọrin, ẹnyin ọrun; ki o si yọ̀, iwọ aiye; bú jade ninu orin, ẹnyin oke-nla: nitori Oluwa ti tù awọn enia rẹ̀ ninu, yio si ṣãnu fun awọn olupọnju rẹ̀.
entries.en: Sing, O heavens; and be joyful, O earth; and break forth into singing, O mountains: for the LORD hath comforted his people, and will have mercy upon his afflicted.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Sioni wipe, Oluwa ti kọ̀ mi silẹ; Oluwa mi si ti gbagbe mi.
entries.en: But Zion said, The LORD hath forsaken me, and my Lord hath forgotten me.

entries.yo: Obinrin ha lè gbagbe ọmọ ọmú rẹ̀ bi, ti kì yio fi ṣe iyọ́nu si ọmọ inu rẹ̀? lõtọ, nwọn le gbagbe, ṣugbọn emi kì yio gbagbe rẹ.
entries.en: Can a woman forget her sucking child, that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? yea, they may forget, yet will I not forget thee.

entries.yo: Kiye si i, emi ti kọ ọ si atẹlẹwọ mi: awọn odi rẹ mbẹ niwaju mi nigbagbogbo.
entries.en: Behold, I have graven thee upon the palms of my hands; thy walls are continually before me.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ rẹ yára; awọn oluparun rẹ ati awọn ti o fi ọ ṣofò yio ti ọdọ rẹ jade.
entries.en: Thy children shall make haste; thy destroyers and they that made thee waste shall go forth of thee.

entries.yo: Gbe oju rẹ soke yika kiri, si kiyesi i: gbogbo awọn wọnyi ṣà ara wọn jọ, nwọn si wá sọdọ rẹ. Oluwa wipe, Bi mo ti wà, iwọ o fi gbogbo wọn bò ara rẹ, bi ohun ọṣọ́, nitõtọ, iwọ o si há wọn mọ ara, bi iyawo.
entries.en: Lift up thine eyes round about, and behold: all these gather themselves together, and come to thee. As I live, saith the LORD, thou shalt surely clothe thee with them all, as with an ornament, and bind them on thee, as a bride doeth.

entries.yo: Nitori ibi ofò rẹ, ati ibi ahoro rẹ wọnni, ati ilẹ iparun rẹ, yio tilẹ há jù nisisiyi, nitori awọn ti ngbe inu wọn, awọn ti o gbe ọ mì yio si jinà rére.
entries.en: For thy waste and thy desolate places, and the land of thy destruction, shall even now be too narrow by reason of the inhabitants, and they that swallowed thee up shall be far away.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ-ọmọ rẹ ti o ti nù yio tun wi li eti rẹ pe, Ayè kò gbà mi, fi ayè fun mi lati ma gbé.
entries.en: The children which thou shalt have, after thou hast lost the other, shall say again in thine ears, The place is too strait for me: give place to me that I may dwell.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni iwọ o wi li ọkàn rẹ pe, Tali o bi awọn wọnyi fun mi, mo sa ti wà li ailọmọ ati li àgan, igbèkun ati ẹni-iṣikiri? tani o si ti tọ́ awọn wọnyi dagba? Kiyesi i, a fi emi nikan silẹ, awọn wọnyi, nibo ni nwọn gbe ti wà.
entries.en: Then shalt thou say in thine heart, Who hath begotten me these, seeing I have lost my children, and am desolate, a captive, and removing to and fro? and who hath brought up these? Behold, I was left alone; these, where had they been?

entries.yo: Bayi ni Oluwa Jehofa wi, Kiyesi i, emi o gbe ọwọ́ mi soke si awọn Keferi, emi o si gbe ọpágun mi soke si awọn enia, nwọn o si gbe awọn ọmọkunrin rẹ wá li apa wọn, a o si gbe awọn ọmọbinrin rẹ li ejìka wọn.
entries.en: Thus saith the Lord GOD, Behold, I will lift up mine hand to the Gentiles, and set up my standard to the people: and they shall bring thy sons in their arms, and thy daughters shall be carried upon their shoulders.

entries.yo: Awọn ọba yio jẹ baba olutọju rẹ, awọn ayaba wọn yio si jẹ iya olutọju rẹ; ni idojubolẹ ni nwọn o ma tẹriba fun ọ, nwọn o si lá ekuru ẹsẹ rẹ; iwọ o si mọ̀ pe emi li Oluwa; nitori oju kì yio tì awọn ti o ba duro dè mi.
entries.en: And kings shall be thy nursing fathers, and their queens thy nursing mothers: they shall bow down to thee with their face toward the earth, and lick up the dust of thy feet; and thou shalt know that I am the LORD: for they shall not be ashamed that wait for me.

entries.yo: A ha le gba ikogun lọwọ alagbara bi? tabi a le gbà awọn ondè lọwọ awọn ẹniti nwọn tọ́ fun?
entries.en: Shall the prey be taken from the mighty, or the lawful captive delivered?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bayi ni Oluwa wi, a o tilẹ̀ gbà awọn ondè kuro lọwọ awọn alagbara, a o si gbà ikogun lọwọ awọn ẹni-ẹ̀ru; nitori ẹniti o mba ọ jà li emi o ba jà, emi o si gbà awọn ọmọ rẹ là.
entries.en: But thus saith the LORD, Even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away, and the prey of the terrible shall be delivered: for I will contend with him that contendeth with thee, and I will save thy children.

entries.yo: Awọn ti o ni ọ lara li emi o fi ẹran ara wọn bọ́, nwọn o mu ẹjẹ ara wọn li amuyo bi ọti-waini didùn: gbogbo ẹran-ara yio si mọ̀ pe, Emi Oluwa ni Olugbala ati Olurapada rẹ, Ẹni-alagbara ti Jakobu.
entries.en: And I will feed them that oppress thee with their own flesh; and they shall be drunken with their own blood, as with sweet wine: and all flesh shall know that I the LORD am thy Saviour and thy Redeemer, the mighty One of Jacob.

entries.yo: BAYI ni Oluwa wi, Nibo ni iwe ikọsilẹ iyá nyin gbe wà, ẹniti mo ti kọ̀ silẹ? tabi tani ninu awọn onigbese mi ti mo ti tà nyin fun? Kiyesi i, nitori aiṣedẽde nyin li ẹnyin ti tà ara nyin, ati nitori irekọja nyin li a ṣe kọ̀ iyá nyin silẹ.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD, Where is the bill of your mother's divorcement, whom I have put away? or which of my creditors is it to whom I have sold you? Behold, for your iniquities have ye sold yourselves, and for your transgressions is your mother put away.

entries.yo: Nitori nigbati mo de, kò si ẹnikan? nigbati mo pè, kò si ẹnikan lati dahùn? Ọwọ́ mi ha kuru tobẹ̃ ti kò fi le rapada? tabi emi kò ha li agbara lati gbani? Kiyesi i, ni ibawi mi mo gbẹ okun, mo sọ odò nla di aginjù, ẹja wọn nrùn nitori ti omi kò si, nwọn si kú fun ongbẹ.
entries.en: Wherfore, when I came, was there no man? when I called, was there none to answer? Is my hand shortened at all, that it cannot redeem? or have I no power to deliver? behold, at my rebuke I dry up the sea, I make the rivers a wilderness: their fish stinketh, because there is no water, and dieth for thirst.

entries.yo: Mo fi ohun dúdu wọ̀ awọn ọrun, mo si fi aṣọ ọfọ̀ ṣe ibora wọn.
entries.en: I clothe the heavens with blackness, and I make sackcloth their covering.

entries.yo: Oluwa Jehofa ti fi ahọn akẹ́kọ fun mi, ki emi ki o le mọ̀ bi a iti sọ̀rọ li akokò fun alãrẹ, o nji li oròwurọ̀, o ṣi mi li eti lati gbọ́ bi akẹkọ.
entries.en: The Lord GOD hath given me the tongue of the learned, that I should know how to speak a word in season to him that is weary: he wakeneth morning by morning, he wakeneth mine ear to hear as the learned.

entries.yo: Oluwa Jehofa ti ṣí mi li eti, emi kò si ṣe aigbọràn, bẹ̃ni emi kò yipada.
entries.en: The Lord GOD hath opened mine ear, and I was not rebellious, neither turned away back.

entries.yo: Mo fi ẹ̀hìn mi fun awọn aluni, ati ẹ̀rẹkẹ mi fun awọn ti ntú irun: emi kò pa oju mi mọ́ kuro ninu itìju ati itutọ́ si.
entries.en: I gave my back to the smiters, and my cheeks to them that plucked off the hair: I hid not my face from shame and spitting.

entries.yo: Nitori Oluwa Jehofa yio ràn mi lọwọ: nitorina emi kì yio dãmu; nitorina ni mo ṣe gbe oju mi ró bi okuta lile, emi si mọ̀ pe oju kì yio tì mi.
entries.en: For the Lord GOD will help me; therefore shall I not be confounded: therefore have I set my face like a flint, and I know that I shall not be ashamed.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o dá mi lare wà ni tosí, tani o ba mi jà? jẹ ki a duro pọ̀: tani iṣe ẹlẹ́jọ mi? jẹ ki o sunmọ mi.
entries.en: He is near that justifieth me; who will contend with me? let us stand together: who is mine adversary? let him come near to me.

entries.yo: Kiye si i, Oluwa Jehofa yio ràn mi lọwọ, tani o dá mi li ẹbi? wò o, gbogbo wọn o di ogbó bi ẹwù; kokòro yio jẹ wọn run.
entries.en: Behold, the Lord GOD will help me; who is he that shall condemn me? lo, they all shall wax old as a garment; the moth shall eat them up.

entries.yo: Tani ninu nyin ti o bẹ̀ru Oluwa, ti o gba ohùn iranṣẹ rẹ̀ gbọ́, ti nrìn ninu okùnkun, ti kò si ni imọlẹ? jẹ ki on gbẹkẹ̀le orukọ Oluwa, ki o si fi ẹ̀hìn tì Ọlọrun rẹ̀.
entries.en: Who is among you that feareth the LORD, that obeyeth the voice of his servant, that walketh in darkness, and hath no light? let him trust in the name of the LORD, and stay upon his God.

entries.yo: Kiye si i, gbogbo ẹnyin ti o dá iná, ti ẹ fi ẹta iná yi ara nyin ká: ẹ mã rìn ninu imọlẹ iná nyin, ati ninu ẹta iná ti ẹ ti dá. Eyi ni yio jẹ ti nyin lati ọwọ́ mi wá; ẹnyin o dubulẹ ninu irora.
entries.en: Behold, all ye that kindle a fire, that compass yourselves about with sparks: walk in the light of your fire, and in the sparks that ye have kindled. This shall ye have of mine hand; ye shall lie down in sorrow.

entries.yo: GBỌ ti emi, ẹnyin ti ntẹle ododo, ẹnyin ti nwá Oluwa; wò apáta nì ninu eyiti a ti gbẹ́ nyin, ati ihò kòto nì nibiti a gbe ti wà nyin.
entries.en: Hearken to me, ye that follow after righteousness, ye that seek the LORD: look unto the rock whence ye are hewn, and to the hole of the pit whence ye are digged.

entries.yo: Ẹ wò Abrahamu baba nyin, ati Sara ti o bi nyin; nitori on nikan ni mo pè, mo si sure fun u, mo si mu u pọ̀ si i.
entries.en: Look unto Abraham your father, and unto Sarah that bare you: for I called him alone, and blessed him, and increased him.

entries.yo: Nitori Oluwa yio tù Sioni ninu; yio tú gbogbo ibi ofo rẹ̀ ninu; yio si ṣe aginju rẹ̀ bi Edeni, ati aṣálẹ rẹ̀ bi ọgbà Oluwa, ayọ̀ ati inudidùn li a o ri ninu rẹ̀, idupẹ, ati ohùn orin.
entries.en: For the LORD shall comfort Zion: he will comfort all her waste places; and he will make her wilderness like Eden, and her desert like the garden of the LORD; joy and gladness shall be found therein, thanksgiving, and the voice of melody.

entries.yo: Tẹtilelẹ si mi, ẹnyin enia mi; si fi eti si mi, iwọ orilẹ-ède mi: nitori ofin kan yio ti ọdọ mi jade lọ, emi o si gbe idajọ mi kalẹ fun imọlẹ awọn enia.
entries.en: Hearken unto me, my people; and give ear unto me, O my nation: for a law shall proceed from me, and I will make my judgment to rest for a light of the people.

entries.yo: Ododo mi wà nitosí; igbala mi ti jade lọ, apá mi yio si ṣe idajọ awọn enia; awọn erekùṣu yio duro dè mi, apá mi ni nwọn o si gbẹkẹle.
entries.en: My righteousness is near; my salvation is gone forth, and mine arms shall judge the people; the isles shall wait upon me, and on mine arm shall they trust.

entries.yo: Ẹ gbé ojú nyin soke si awọn ọrun, ki ẹ si wò aiye nisalẹ: nitori awọn ọrun yio fẹ́ lọ bi ẹ̃fin, aiye o si di ogbó bi ẹwù, awọn ti ngbe inu rẹ̀ yio si kú bakanna: ṣugbọn igbala mi o wà titi lai, ododo mi kì yio si parẹ́.
entries.en: Lift up your eyes to the heavens, and look upon the earth beneath: for the heavens shall vanish away like smoke, and the earth shall wax old like a garment, and they that dwell therein shall die in like manner: but my salvation shall be for ever, and my righteousness shall not be abolished.

entries.yo: Gbọ́ ti emi, ẹnyin ti o mọ̀ ododo, enia ninu aiya ẹniti ofin mi mbẹ; ẹ máṣe bẹ̀ru ẹgàn awọn enia, ẹ má si ṣe foyà ẹsín wọn.
entries.en: Hearken unto me, ye that know righteousness, the people in whose heart is my law; fear ye not the reproach of men, neither be ye afraid of their revilings.

entries.yo: Nitori kòkoro yio jẹ wọn bi ẹ̀wu, idin yio si jẹ wọn bi irun agutan: ṣugbọn ododo mi yio wà titi lai, ati igbala mi lati iran de iran.
entries.en: For the moth shall eat them up like a garment, and the worm shall eat them like wool: but my righteousness shall be for ever, and my salvation from generation to generation.

entries.yo: Ji, ji, gbe agbara wọ̀, Iwọ apa Oluwa; ji, bi li ọjọ igbãni, ni iran atijọ. Iwọ kọ́ ha ke Rahabu, ti o si ṣá Dragoni li ọgbẹ́?
entries.en: Awake, awake, put on strength, O arm of the LORD; awake, as in the ancient days, in the generations of old. Art thou not it that hath cut Rahab, and wounded the dragon?

entries.yo: Iwọ kọ́ ha gbẹ okun, omi ibu nla wọnni? ti o ti sọ ibú okun di ọ̀na fun awọn ẹni ìrapada lati gbà kọja?
entries.en: Art thou not it which hath dried the sea, the waters of the great deep; that hath made the depths of the sea a way for the ransomed to pass over?

entries.yo: Nitorina awọn ẹni-ìrapada Oluwa yio pada, nwọn o si wá si Sioni ti awọn ti orin; ayọ̀ ainipẹkun yio si wà li ori wọn: nwọn o ri inudidùn ati ayọ̀ gbà; ikãnu ati ọ̀fọ yio fò lọ.
entries.en: Therefore the redeemed of the LORD shall return, and come with singing unto Zion; and everlasting joy shall be upon their head: they shall obtain gladness and joy; and sorrow and mourning shall flee away.

entries.yo: Emi, ani emi ni ẹniti ntù nyin ninu: tani iwọ, ti iwọ o fi bẹ̀ru enia ti yio kú, ati ọmọ enia ti a ṣe bi koriko.
entries.en: I, even I, am he that comforteth you: who art thou, that thou shouldest be afraid of a man that shall die, and of the son of man which shall be made as grass;

entries.yo: Ti iwọ si gbagbe Oluwa Elẹda rẹ ti o ti nà awọn ọrun, ti o si ti fi ipilẹ aiye sọlẹ; ti iwọ si ti mbẹ̀ru nigbagbogbo lojojumọ nitori irúnu aninilara nì, bi ẹnipe o ti mura lati panirun? nibo ni irúnu aninilara na ha gbe wà?
entries.en: And forgettest the LORD thy maker, that hath stretched forth the heavens, and laid the foundations of the earth; and hast feared continually every day because of the fury of the oppressor, as if he were ready to destroy? and where is the fury of the oppressor?

entries.yo: Ondè ti a ti ṣí nipo yara ki a ba le tú u silẹ, ati ki o má ba kú sinu ihò, tabi ki onjẹ rẹ̀ má ba tán.
entries.en: The captive exile hasteneth that he may be loosed, and that he should not die in the pit, nor that his bread should fail.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ ti o pin okun ni iyà, eyi ti ìgbi rẹ̀ nhó; Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun ni orukọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: But I am the LORD thy God, that divided the sea, whose waves roared: The LORD of hosts is his name.

entries.yo: Emi si ti fi ọ̀rọ mi si ẹnu rẹ, mo si ti bò ọ mọlẹ ni ojiji ọwọ́ mi, ki emi ki o le gbìn awọn ọrun, ki emi si le fi ipilẹ aiye sọlẹ, ati ki emi le wi fun Sioni pe, Iwọ ni enia mi.
entries.en: And I have put my words in thy mouth, and I have covered thee in the shadow of mine hand, that I may plant the heavens, and lay the foundations of the earth, and say unto Zion, Thou art my people.

entries.yo: Ji, ji, dide duro, iwọ Jerusalemu, ti o ti mu li ọwọ́ Oluwa ago irúnu rẹ̀; iwọ ti mu gẹ̀dẹgẹ́dẹ̀ ago ìwarìri, iwọ si fọ́n wọn jade.
entries.en: Awake, awake, stand up, O Jerusalem, which hast drunk at the hand of the LORD the cup of his fury; thou hast drunken the dregs of the cup of trembling, and wrung them out.

entries.yo: Kò si ẹnikan ninu gbogbo awọn ọmọ ọkunrin ti o bí lati tọ́ ọ; bẹ̃ni kò si ẹniti o fà a lọwọ, ninu gbogbo awọn ọmọ ọkunrin ti on tọ́ dàgba.
entries.en: There is none to guide her among all the sons whom she hath brought forth; neither is there any that taketh her by the hand of all the sons that she hath brought up.

entries.yo: Ohun meji wọnyi li o débá ọ: tani o kãnu fun ọ? idahoro, on iparun, ati ìyan, on idà: nipa tani emi o tù ọ ninu?
entries.en: These two things are come unto thee; who shall be sorry for thee? desolation, and destruction, and the famine, and the sword: by whom shall I comfort thee?

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ rẹ ọkunrin ti dáku, nwọn dubulẹ ni gbogbo ikorita, bi ẹfọ̀n ninu àwọn: nwọn kún fun ìrúnu Oluwa, ibawi Ọlọrun rẹ.
entries.en: Thy sons have fainted, they lie at the head of all the streets, as a wild bull in a net: they are full of the fury of the LORD, the rebuke of thy God.

entries.yo: Nitorina gbọ́ eyi na, iwọ ẹniti a pọ́n loju, ti o si mu amuyo, ṣugbọn kì iṣe nipa ọti-waini:
entries.en: Therefore hear now this, thou afflicted, and drunken, but not with wine:

entries.yo: Bayi ni Oluwa rẹ Jehofa wi, ati Ọlọrun rẹ ti ngbèja enia rẹ̀, Kiyesi i, emi ti gbà ago ìwárìri kuro lọwọ rẹ, gẹ̀dẹgẹ́dẹ̀ ago irúnu mi; iwọ kì yio si mu u mọ.
entries.en: Thus saith thy Lord the LORD, and thy God that pleadeth the cause of his people, Behold, I have taken out of thine hand the cup of trembling, even the dregs of the cup of my fury; thou shalt no more drink it again:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi o fi i si ọwọ́ awọn ti o pọ́n ọ loju; ti nwọn ti wi fun ọkàn rẹ pe, Wólẹ, ki a ba le rekọja: iwọ si ti tẹ́ ara rẹ silẹ bi ilẹ, ati bi ita, fun awọn ti o rekọja.
entries.en: But I will put it into the hand of them that afflict thee; which have said to thy soul, Bow down, that we may go over: and thou hast laid thy body as the ground, and as the street, to them that went over.

entries.yo: TALI o ti gbà ihìn wa gbọ́? tali a si ti fi apá Oluwa hàn fun?
entries.en: Who hath believed our report? and to whom is the arm of the LORD revealed?

entries.yo: Nitori yio dàgba niwaju rẹ̀ bi ọ̀jẹlẹ ohun ọ̀gbin, ati bi gbòngbo lati inu ilẹ gbigbẹ: irísi rẹ̀ kò dara, bẹ̃ni kò li ẹwà, nigbati a ba si ri i, kò li ẹwà ti a ba fi fẹ ẹ.
entries.en: For he shall grow up before him as a tender plant, and as a root out of a dry ground: he hath no form nor comeliness; and when we shall see him, there is no beauty that we should desire him.

entries.yo: A kẹgan rẹ̀ a si kọ̀ ọ lọdọ awọn enia, ẹni-ikãnu, ti o si mọ̀ ibanujẹ: o si dabi ẹnipe o mu ki a pa oju wa mọ kuro lara rẹ̀; a kẹgàn rẹ̀, awa kò si kà a si.
entries.en: He is despised and rejected of men; a man of sorrows, and acquainted with grief: and we hid as it were our faces from him; he was despised, and we esteemed him not.

entries.yo: Lõtọ o ti ru ibinujẹ wa, o si gbe ikãnu wa lọ; ṣugbọn awa kà a si bi ẹniti a nà, ti a lù lati ọdọ Ọlọrun, ti a si pọ́n loju.
entries.en: Surely he hath borne our griefs, and carried our sorrows: yet we did esteem him stricken, smitten of God, and afflicted.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn a ṣá a li ọgbẹ nitori irekọja wa, a pa a li ara nitori aiṣedede wa; ìna alafia wa wà lara rẹ̀, ati nipa ìna rẹ̀ li a fi mu wa lara da.
entries.en: But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities: the chastisement of our peace was upon him; and with his stripes we are healed.

entries.yo: Gbogbo wa ti ṣina kirikiri bi agutan, olukuluku wa tẹ̀le ọ̀na ara rẹ̀; Oluwa si ti mu aiṣedede wa gbogbo pade lara rẹ̀.
entries.en: All we like sheep have gone astray; we have turned every one to his own way; and the LORD hath laid on him the iniquity of us all.

entries.yo: A jẹ ẹ ni iyà, a si pọ́n ọ loju, ṣugbọn on kò yà ẹnu rẹ̀: a mu u wá bi ọdọ-agutan fun pipa, ati bi agutan ti o yadi niwaju olurẹ́run rẹ̀, bẹ̃ni kò yà ẹnu rẹ̀.
entries.en: He was oppressed, and he was afflicted, yet he opened not his mouth: he is brought as a lamb to the slaughter, and as a sheep before her shearers is dumb, so he openeth not his mouth.

entries.yo: A mu u jade lati ibi ihamọ on idajọ: tani o si sọ iran rẹ̀? nitori a ti ke e kuro ni ilẹ alãye: nitori irekọja awọn enia mi li a ṣe lù u.
entries.en: He was taken from prison and from judgment: and who shall declare his generation? for he was cut off out of the land of the living: for the transgression of my people was he stricken.

entries.yo: O si ṣe ibojì rẹ̀ pẹlu awọn enia buburu, ati pẹlu ọlọrọ̀ ni ikú rẹ̀; nitori kò hù iwà-ipa, bẹ̃ni kò si arekereke li ẹnu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he made his grave with the wicked, and with the rich in his death; because he had done no violence, neither was any deceit in his mouth.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn o wu Oluwa lati pa a lara; o ti fi i sinu ibanujẹ; nigbati iwọ o fi ẹmi rẹ̀ ṣẹbọ fun ẹ̀ṣẹ: yio ri iru-ọmọ rẹ̀, yio mu ọjọ rẹ̀ gùn, ifẹ Oluwa yio ṣẹ li ọwọ́ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Yet it pleased the LORD to bruise him; he hath put him to grief: when thou shalt make his soul an offering for sin, he shall see his seed, he shall prolong his days, and the pleasure of the LORD shall prosper in his hand.

entries.yo: Yio ri ninu eso lãlã ọkàn rẹ̀, yio si tẹ́ ẹ li ọrùn: nipa imọ̀ rẹ̀ ni iranṣẹ mi olododo yio da ọ̀pọlọpọ lare; nitori yio rù aiṣedede wọn wọnni.
entries.en: He shall see of the travail of his soul, and shall be satisfied: by his knowledge shall my righteous servant justify many; for he shall bear their iniquities.

entries.yo: Nitorina emi o fun u ni ipín pẹlu awọn ẹni-nla, yio si ba awọn alagbara pín ikogun, nitori o ti tú ẹmi rẹ̀ jade si ikú: a si kà a mọ awọn alarekọja, o si rù ẹ̀ṣẹ ọ̀pọlọpọ; o si nṣipẹ̀ fun awọn alarekọja.
entries.en: Therefore will I divide him a portion with the great, and he shall divide the spoil with the strong; because he hath poured out his soul unto death: and he was numbered with the transgressors; and he bare the sin of many, and made intercession for the transgressors.

entries.yo: KỌRIN, iwọ àgan, ti kò bi ri; bú si orin, si ké rara, iwọ ti kò rọbi ri; nitori awọn ọmọ ẹni-alahoro pọ̀ ju awọn ọmọ ẹniti a gbe ni iyawo: li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: Sing, O barren, thou that didst not bear; break forth into singing, and cry aloud, thou that didst not travail with child: for more are the children of the desolate than the children of the married wife, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Sọ ibi agọ rẹ di gbigbõro, si jẹ ki wọn nà aṣọ tita ibugbe rẹ̀ jade: máṣe dási, sọ okùn rẹ di gigùn, ki o si mu ẽkàn rẹ le.
entries.en: Enlarge the place of thy tent, and let them stretch forth the curtains of thine habitations: spare not, lengthen thy cords, and strengthen thy stakes;

entries.yo: Nitori iwọ o ya si apa ọtún ati si apa osì, iru-ọmọ rẹ yio si jogun awọn keferi: nwọn o si mu ki awọn ilu ahoro wọnni di ibi gbigbe.
entries.en: For thou shalt break forth on the right hand and on the left; and thy seed shall inherit the Gentiles, and make the desolate cities to be inhabited.

entries.yo: Má bẹ̀ru, nitori oju kì yio tì ọ: bẹ̃ni ki o máṣe dãmu; nitori a ki yio doju tì ọ; nitori iwọ o gbagbe itìju igbà ewe rẹ, iwọ kì yio sì ranti ẹ̀gan iwà-opo rẹ mọ.
entries.en: Fear not; for thou shalt not be ashamed: neither be thou confounded; for thou shalt not be put to shame: for thou shalt forget the shame of thy youth, and shalt not remember the reproach of thy widowhood any more.

entries.yo: Nitori Ẹlẹda rẹ li ọkọ rẹ; Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun li orukọ rẹ̀; ati Olurapada rẹ Ẹni-Mimọ Israeli; Ọlọrun agbaiye li a o ma pè e.
entries.en: For thy Maker is thine husband; the LORD of hosts is his name; and thy Redeemer the Holy One of Israel; The God of the whole earth shall he be called.

entries.yo: Nitori Oluwa ti pè ọ bi obinrin ti a kọ̀ silẹ, ti a si bà ni inu jẹ, ati bi aya igba ewe nigbati a ti kọ̀ ọ, li Ọlọrun rẹ wi.
entries.en: For the LORD hath called thee as a woman forsaken and grieved in spirit, and a wife of youth, when thou wast refused, saith thy God.

entries.yo: Ni iṣẹju diẹ ni mo ti kọ̀ ọ silẹ, ṣugbọn li ãnu nla li emi o kó ọ jọ:
entries.en: For a small moment have I forsaken thee; but with great mercies will I gather thee.

entries.yo: Ni ṣiṣàn ibinu li emi pa oju mi mọ kuro lara rẹ ni iṣẹju kan! ṣugbọn õre ainipẹkun li emi o fi ṣãnu fun ọ; li Oluwa Olurapada rẹ wí.
entries.en: In a little wrath I hid my face from thee for a moment; but with everlasting kindness will I have mercy on thee, saith the LORD thy Redeemer.

entries.yo: Nitori bi awọn omi Noa li eyi ri si mi, nitori gẹgẹ bi mo ti bura pe omi Noa kì yio bò aiye mọ, bẹ̃ni mo si ti bura pe emi kì yio binu si ọ, bẹ̃ni emi kì yio ba ọ wi.
entries.en: For this is as the waters of Noah unto me: for as I have sworn that the waters of Noah should no more go over the earth; so have I sworn that I would not be wroth with thee, nor rebuke thee.

entries.yo: Nitori awọn oke-nla yio ṣi lọ, a o si ṣi awọn oke kékèké ni idi, ṣugbọn ore mi kì yio fi ọ silẹ, bẹ̃ni emi kì yio ṣi majẹmu alafia mi ni ipò: li Oluwa wi, ti o ṣãnu fun ọ.
entries.en: For the mountains shall depart, and the hills be removed; but my kindness shall not depart from thee, neither shall the covenant of my peace be removed, saith the LORD that hath mercy on thee.

entries.yo: Iwọ ẹniti a npọ́n loju, ti a si nfi ijì gbákiri, ti a kò si tù ninu, wò o, emi o fi tìrõ tẹ́ okuta rẹ, emi o si fi safire fi ipilẹ rẹ le ilẹ.
entries.en: O thou afflicted, tossed with tempest, and not comforted, behold, I will lay thy stones with fair colours, and lay thy foundations with sapphires.

entries.yo: Emi o fi rubi ṣe ṣonṣo-ile rẹ, emi o si fi okuta didán ṣe àsẹ rẹ; emi o si fi awọn okuta àṣayan ṣe agbègbe rẹ.
entries.en: And I will make thy windows of agates, and thy gates of carbuncles, and all thy borders of pleasant stones.

entries.yo: A o si kọ́ gbogbo awọn ọmọ rẹ lati ọdọ Oluwa wá; alafia awọn ọmọ rẹ yio si pọ̀.
entries.en: And all thy children shall be taught of the LORD; and great shall be the peace of thy children.

entries.yo: Ninu ododo li a o fi idi rẹ mulẹ: iwọ o jina si inira; nitori iwọ kì yio bẹ̀ru: ati si ifoiya, nitori kì yio sunmọ ọ.
entries.en: In righteousness shalt thou be established: thou shalt be far from oppression; for thou shalt not fear: and from terror; for it shall not come near thee.

entries.yo: Kiye si i, ni kikojọ nwọn o kó ara wọn jọ, ṣugbọn ki iṣe nipasẹ mi; ẹnikẹni ti o ba ditẹ si ọ yio ṣubu nitori rẹ.
entries.en: Behold, they shall surely gather together, but not by me: whosoever shall gather together against thee shall fall for thy sake.

entries.yo: Kiye si i, emi li ẹniti o ti dá alagbẹ̀dẹ ti nfẹ́ iná ẹyín, ti o si mu ohun-elò jade fun iṣẹ rẹ̀; emi li o si ti dá apanirun lati panirun.
entries.en: Behold, I have created the smith that bloweth the coals in the fire, and that bringeth forth an instrument for his work; and I have created the waster to destroy.

entries.yo: Kò si ohun-ijà ti a ṣe si ọ ti yio lè ṣe nkan; ati gbogbo ahọn ti o dide si ọ ni idajọ ni iwọ o da li ẹbi. Eyi ni ogún awọn iranṣẹ Oluwa, lati ọdọ mi ni ododo wọn ti wá, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper; and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment thou shalt condemn. This is the heritage of the servants of the LORD, and their righteousness is of me, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: NJẸ gbogbo ẹniti ongbẹ ngbẹ, ẹ wá sibi omi, ati ẹniti kò li owo; ẹ wá, ẹ rà, ki ẹ si jẹ; lõtọ, ẹ wá, ẹ rà ọti-waini ati wàra, laini owo ati laidiyele.
entries.en: Ho, every one that thirsteth, come ye to the waters, and he that hath no money; come ye, buy, and eat; yea, come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.

entries.yo: Nitori kini ẹ ṣe nná owo fun eyiti kì iṣe onjẹ? ati lãla nyin fun eyi ti kì itẹnilọrun? ni gbigbọ́, ẹ gbọ́ t'emi, ki ẹ si jẹ eyi ti o dara, si jẹ ki inu nyin dùn ninu ọra.
entries.en: Wherefore do ye spend money for that which is not bread? and your labour for that which satisfieth not? hearken diligently unto me, and eat ye that which is good, and let your soul delight itself in fatness.

entries.yo: Ẹ tẹtilelẹ, ki ẹ si wá sọdọ mi: ẹ gbọ́, ọkàn nyin yio si yè: emi o si ba nyin dá majẹmu ainipẹkun, ãnu Dafidi ti o daju.
entries.en: Incline your ear, and come unto me: hear, and your soul shall live; and I will make an everlasting covenant with you, even the sure mercies of David.

entries.yo: Kiye si i, emi ti fi on fun awọn enia fun ẹlẹri, olori ati alaṣẹ fun awọn enia.
entries.en: Behold, I have given him for a witness to the people, a leader and commander to the people.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, iwọ o pe orilẹ-ède ti iwọ kò mọ̀, ati orilẹ-ède ti kò mọ̀ ọ yio sare wá sọdọ rẹ, nitori Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ, ati nitori Ẹni-Mimọ Israeli; nitori on ti ṣe ọ li ogo.
entries.en: Behold, thou shalt call a nation that thou knowest not, and nations that knew not thee shall run unto thee because of the LORD thy God, and for the Holy One of Israel; for he hath glorified thee.

entries.yo: Ẹ wá Oluwa nigbati ẹ le ri i, ẹ pè e nigbati o wà nitosí.
entries.en: Seek ye the LORD while he may be found, call ye upon him while he is near:

entries.yo: Jẹ ki enia buburu kọ̀ ọ̀na rẹ̀ silẹ, ki ẹ̀lẹṣẹ si kọ̀ ironu rẹ̀ silẹ: si jẹ ki o yipada si Oluwa, on o si ṣãnu fun u, ati si Ọlọrun wa, yio si fi jì li ọpọlọpọ.
entries.en: Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts: and let him return unto the LORD, and he will have mercy upon him; and to our God, for he will abundantly pardon.

entries.yo: Nitori èro mi kì iṣe èro nyin, bẹ̃ni ọ̀na nyin kì iṣe ọ̀na mi, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: For my thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Nitori bi ọrun ti ga ju aiye lọ, bẹ̃ni ọ̀na mi ga ju ọ̀na nyin lọ, ati èro mi ju èro nyin lọ.
entries.en: For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.

entries.yo: Nitori gẹgẹ bi òjo ati ojo-didì ti iti ọrun wá ilẹ, ti kì isi tun pada sọhun, ṣugbọn ti o nrin ilẹ, ti o si nmu nkan hù jade ki o si rudi, ki o le fi irú fun awọn afúnrúgbìn, ati onjẹ fun ọjẹun:
entries.en: For as the rain cometh down, and the snow from heaven, and returneth not thither, but watereth the earth, and maketh it bring forth and bud, that it may give seed to the sower, and bread to the eater:

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni ọ̀rọ mi ti o ti ẹnu mi jade yio ri: kì yio pada sọdọ mi lofo, ṣugbọn yio ṣe eyiti o wù mi, yio si ma ṣe rere ninu ohun ti mo rán a.
entries.en: So shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth: it shall not return unto me void, but it shall accomplish that which I please, and it shall prosper in the thing whereto I sent it.

entries.yo: Nitori ayọ̀ li ẹ o fi jade, alafia li a o fi tọ́ nyin: awọn oke-nla ati awọn oke kékèké yio bú si orin niwaju nyin, gbogbo igi igbẹ́ yio si ṣapẹ́.
entries.en: For ye shall go out with joy, and be led forth with peace: the mountains and the hills shall break forth before you into singing, and all the trees of the field shall clap their hands.

entries.yo: Igi firi yio hù jade dipò ẹgún, igi mirtili yio hù jade dipò oṣuṣu: yio si jẹ orukọ fun Oluwa, fun àmi aiyeraiye, ti a kì yio ke kuro.
entries.en: Instead of the thorn shall come up the fir tree, and instead of the brier shall come up the myrtle tree: and it shall be to the LORD for a name, for an everlasting sign that shall not be cut off.

entries.yo: BAYI li Oluwa wi, Ẹ pa idajọ mọ, ẹ si ṣe ododo: nitori igbala mi fẹrẹ idé, ati ododo mi lati fi hàn.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD, Keep ye judgment, and do justice: for my salvation is near to come, and my righteousness to be revealed.

entries.yo: Alabukun ni fun ọkunrin na ti o ṣe eyi, ati fun ọmọ enia ti o dì i mu: ti o pa ọjọ isimi mọ laisọ ọ di aimọ́; ti o si pa ọwọ́ rẹ̀ mọ kuro ni ṣiṣe ibi.
entries.en: Blessed is the man that doeth this, and the son of man that layeth hold on it; that keepeth the sabbath from polluting it, and keepeth his hand from doing any evil.

entries.yo: Ti kò si jẹ ki ọmọ alejò ti o ti dà ara rẹ̀ pọ̀ mọ́ Oluwa sọ, wipe; Oluwa ti yà mi kuro ninu awọn enia rẹ̀ patapata: bẹ̃ni kò jẹ ki ìwẹ̀fà wipe, Wò o, igi gbigbẹ ni mi.
entries.en: Neither let the son of the stranger, that hath joined himself to the LORD, speak, saying, The LORD hath utterly separated me from his people: neither let the eunuch say, Behold, I am a dry tree.

entries.yo: Nitori bayi li Oluwa wi fun awọn ìwẹfa ti nwọn pa ọjọ isimi mi mọ, ti nwọn si yàn eyi ti o wù mi, ti nwọn si di majẹmu mi mu;
entries.en: For thus saith the LORD unto the eunuchs that keep my sabbaths, and choose the things that please me, and take hold of my covenant;

entries.yo: Pe, emi o fi ipò kan fun wọn ni ile mi, ati ninu odi mi, ati orukọ ti o dara jù ti awọn ọmọkunrin ati ọmọ-obinrin lọ: emi o fi orukọ ainipẹkun fun wọn, ti a kì yio ke kuro.
entries.en: Even unto them will I give in mine house and within my walls a place and a name better than of sons and of daughters: I will give them an everlasting name, that shall not be cut off.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ alejò ti nwọn dà ara pọ̀ mọ Oluwa, lati sìn i, ati lati fẹ orukọ Oluwa, lati jẹ iranṣẹ rẹ̀, olukuluku ẹniti o pa ọjọ isimi mọ laisọ ọ di aimọ́, ti o si di majẹmu mi mu;
entries.en: Also the sons of the stranger, that join themselves to the LORD, to serve him, and to love the name of the LORD, to be his servants, every one that keepeth the sabbath from polluting it, and taketh hold of my covenant;

entries.yo: Awọn li emi o si mu wá si oke-nla mimọ́ mi, emi o si mu inu wọn dùn, ninu ile adua mi: ẹbọ sisun wọn, ati irubọ wọn, yio jẹ itẹwọgba lori pẹpẹ mi; nitori ile adua li a o ma pe ile mi fun gbogbo enia.
entries.en: Even them will I bring to my holy mountain, and make them joyful in my house of prayer: their burnt offerings and their sacrifices shall be accepted upon mine altar; for mine house shall be called an house of prayer for all people.

entries.yo: Oluwa Jehofah, ẹniti o ṣà àtanu Israeli jọ wipe, Emi o ṣà awọn ẹlomiran jọ sọdọ rẹ̀, pẹlu awọn ti a ti ṣà jọ sọdọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: The Lord GOD which gathereth the outcasts of Israel saith, Yet will I gather others to him, beside those that are gathered unto him.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ẹnyin ẹranko igbẹ, ẹ wá lati pajẹ ani gbogbo ẹranko igbẹ.
entries.en: All ye beasts of the field, come to devour, yea, all ye beasts in the forest.

entries.yo: Afọju li awọn alore rẹ̀: òpe ni gbogbo wọn, odi ajá ni nwọn, nwọn kò le igbó, nwọn a ma sùn, nwọn ndubulẹ, nwọn fẹ ma tõgbé.
entries.en: His watchmen are blind: they are all ignorant, they are all dumb dogs, they cannot bark; sleeping, lying down, loving to slumber.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ ọjẹun aja ni nwọn ti kì iyó, ati oluṣọ́ agutan ti kò moye ni nwọn: olukuluku wọn nwò ọ̀na ara wọn, olukuluku ntọju ere rẹ̀ lati ẹ̀kun rẹ̀ wá.
entries.en: Yea, they are greedy dogs which can never have enough, and they are shepherds that cannot understand: they all look to their own way, every one for his gain, from his quarter.

entries.yo: Ẹ wá, ni nwọn wi, emi o mu ọti-waini wá, a o si mu ọti-lile li amuyo; ọla yio si dabi ọjọ oni, yio si pọ̀ lọpọlọpọ.
entries.en: Come ye, say they, I will fetch wine, and we will fill ourselves with strong drink; and to morrow shall be as this day, and much more abundant.

entries.yo: OLODODO ṣegbe, kò si ẹniti o kà a si: a mu awọn alãnu kuro, kò si ẹniti nrò pe a mu olododo kuro ṣaju ibi.
entries.en: The righteous perisheth, and no man layeth it to heart: and merciful men are taken away, none considering that the righteous is taken away from the evil to come.

entries.yo: On wọ̀ inu alafia: nwọn simi lori akete wọn, olukuluku ẹniti nrin ninu iduroṣinṣin rẹ̀.
entries.en: He shall enter into peace: they shall rest in their beds, each one walking in his uprightness.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹ sunmọ ihin, ẹnyin ọmọ oṣo, iru-ọmọ panṣaga on àgbere.
entries.en: But draw near hither, ye sons of the sorceress, the seed of the adulterer and the whore.

entries.yo: Tani ẹnyin fi nṣe ẹsín? tani ẹnyin nyanu gborò si, ti ẹnyin yọ ahọn jade si? ọmọ alarekọja ki ẹnyin, iru-ọmọ eke,
entries.en: Against whom do ye sport yourselves? against whom make ye a wide mouth, and draw out the tongue? are ye not children of transgression, a seed of falsehood,

entries.yo: Ti òriṣa ngùn labẹ gbogbo igi tutù, ti ẹ npa awọn ọmọ wẹrẹ ninu afonifoji wọnni, labẹ apáta ti o yanu?
entries.en: Enflaming yourselves with idols under every green tree, slaying the children in the valleys under the clifts of the rocks?

entries.yo: Lãrin okuta ọ̀bọrọ́ odo ni ipín rẹ, awọn, awọn ni ipín rẹ: ani awọn ni iwọ dà ẹbọ ọrẹ mimu si: ti iwọ si rú ẹbọ ọrẹ jijẹ. Emi ha le gbà itunu ninu wọnyi?
entries.en: Among the smooth stones of the stream is thy portion; they, they are thy lot: even to them hast thou poured a drink offering, thou hast offered a meat offering. Should I receive comfort in these?

entries.yo: Lori oke giga giga ni iwọ fi akete rẹ si, ani nibẹ ni iwọ ti lọ lati rú ẹbọ.
entries.en: Upon a lofty and high mountain hast thou set thy bed: even thither wentest thou up to offer sacrifice.

entries.yo: Lẹhin ilẹkùn ati opó ilẹkun ni iwọ si ti gbe iranti rẹ soke: nitori iwọ ti fi ara rẹ hàn fun ẹlomiran dipò mi, iwọ si ti goke: iwọ ti sọ akete rẹ di nla, iwọ si ba wọn dá majẹmu; iwọ ti fẹ akete wọn nibiti iwọ ri i.
entries.en: Behind the doors also and the posts hast thou set up thy remembrance: for thou hast discovered thyself to another than me, and art gone up; thou hast enlarged thy bed, and made thee a covenant with them; thou lovedst their bed where thou sawest it.

entries.yo: Iwọ si ti lọ tiwọ ti ikunra sọdọ ọba, iwọ si ti sọ õrùn didùn rẹ di pupọ, iwọ si ti rán awọn ikọ̀ rẹ lọ jina réré, iwọ si ti rẹ̀ ara rẹ silẹ, ani si ipò okú.
entries.en: And thou wentest to the king with ointment, and didst increase thy perfumes, and didst send thy messengers far off, and didst debase thyself even unto hell.

entries.yo: Ãrẹ̀ mu ọ ninu jijìn ọ̀na rẹ: iwọ kò wipe, Ireti kò si: ìye ọwọ́ rẹ ni iwọ ti ri; nitorina ni inu rẹ kò ṣe bajẹ.
entries.en: Thou art wearied in the greatness of thy way; yet saidst thou not, There is no hope: thou hast found the life of thine hand; therefore thou wast not grieved.

entries.yo: Ẹ̀ru tani mbà ọ ti o si nfòya, ti o nṣeke, ti iwọ kò si ranti mi tabi ki o kà a si? emi kò ha ti dakẹ ani lati igbãni wá, iwọ kò si bẹ̀ru mi?
entries.en: And of whom hast thou been afraid or feared, that thou hast lied, and hast not remembered me, nor laid it to thy heart? have not I held my peace even of old, and thou fearest me not?

entries.yo: Emi o fi ododo rẹ, ati iṣẹ rẹ hàn; nwọn kì o si gbè ọ.
entries.en: I will declare thy righteousness, and thy works; for they shall not profit thee.

entries.yo: Nigbati iwọ ba kigbe, jẹ ki awọn ẹgbẹ rẹ ki o gbà ọ; ṣugbọn ẹfũfu ni yio gbá gbogbo wọn lọ; emi yio mu wọn kuro: ṣugbọn ẹniti o ba gbẹkẹ rẹ̀ le mi yio ni ilẹ na, yio si jogun oke mimọ́ mi.
entries.en: When thou criest, let thy companies deliver thee; but the wind shall carry them all away; vanity shall take them: but he that putteth his trust in me shall possess the land, and shall inherit my holy mountain;

entries.yo: On o si wipe, Ẹ kọ bèbe, ẹ kọ bèbe, ẹ tun ọ̀na ṣe; ẹ mu ìdugbolu kuro li ọ̀na awọn enia mi.
entries.en: And shall say, Cast ye up, cast ye up, prepare the way, take up the stumblingblock out of the way of my people.

entries.yo: Nitori bayi li Ẹni-giga, ati ẹniti a gbéga soke sọ, ti ngbe aiyeraiye, orukọ ẹniti ijẹ Mimọ́, emi ngbe ibi giga ati mimọ́, ati inu ẹniti o li ẹmi irobinujẹ on irẹlẹ pẹlu, lati mu ẹmi awọn onirẹlẹ sọji, ati lati mu ọkàn awọn oniròbinujẹ sọji.
entries.en: For thus saith the high and lofty One that inhabiteth eternity, whose name is Holy; I dwell in the high and holy place, with him also that is of a contrite and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble, and to revive the heart of the contrite ones.

entries.yo: Nitori emi kì yio jà titi lai, bẹ̃ni emi kì yio binu nigbagbogbo: nitori ẹmi iba daku niwaju mi, ati ẽmi ti emi ti dá.
entries.en: For I will not contend for ever, neither will I be always wroth: for the spirit should fail before me, and the souls which I have made.

entries.yo: Mo ti binu nitori aiṣedede ojukokoro rẹ̀, mo si lù u: mo fi oju pamọ́, mo si binu, on si nlọ ni iṣìna li ọ̀na ọkàn rẹ̀.
entries.en: For the iniquity of his covetousness was I wroth, and smote him: I hid me, and was wroth, and he went on frowardly in the way of his heart.

entries.yo: Mo ti ri ọ̀na rẹ̀, emi o si mu u li ara da: emi o si tọ́ ọ pẹlu, emi o si mu itunu pada fun u wá, ati fun awọn aṣọ̀fọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: I have seen his ways, and will heal him: I will lead him also, and restore comforts unto him and to his mourners.

entries.yo: Emi li o da eso ète; Alafia, alafia fun ẹniti o jina rére, ati fun ẹniti o wà nitosí, ni Oluwa wi; emi o si mu u li ara da.
entries.en: I create the fruit of the lips; Peace, peace to him that is far off, and to him that is near, saith the LORD; and I will heal him.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn enia buburu dabi okun ríru, nigbati kò le simi, eyiti omi rẹ̀ nsọ ẹrẹ ati ẽri soke.
entries.en: But the wicked are like the troubled sea, when it cannot rest, whose waters cast up mire and dirt.

entries.yo: Alafia kò si fun awọn enia buburu, ni Ọlọrun mi wi.
entries.en: There is no peace, saith my God, to the wicked.

entries.yo: KE rara, máṣe dasi, gbe ohùn rẹ soke bi ipè, ki o si fi irekọja awọn enia mi hàn wọn, ati ile Jakobu, ẹ̀ṣẹ wọn.
entries.en: Cry aloud, spare not, lift up thy voice like a trumpet, and shew my people their transgression, and the house of Jacob their sins.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nwọn nwá mi lojojumọ, nwọn si ni inu didun lati mọ̀ ọ̀na mi, bi orilẹ-ède ti nṣe ododo, ti kò si fi ilàna Ọlọrun wọn silẹ: nwọn mbere ilàna ododo wọnnì lọwọ mi; nwọn a ma ṣe inu didun ati sunmọ Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Yet they seek me daily, and delight to know my ways, as a nation that did righteousness, and forsook not the ordinance of their God: they ask of me the ordinances of justice; they take delight in approaching to God.

entries.yo: Nitori kini awa ṣe ngbãwẹ̀, ti iwọ kò si ri i? nitori kini awa jẹ ọkàn wa ni ìya, ti iwọ kò si mọ̀? Kiyesi i, li ọjọ ãwẹ̀ nyin ẹnyin nṣe afẹ́, ẹ si nfi agbara mu ni ṣe gbogbo iṣẹ nyin.
entries.en: Wherefore have we fasted, say they, and thou seest not? wherefore have we afflicted our soul, and thou takest no knowledge? Behold, in the day of your fast ye find pleasure, and exact all your labours.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, ẹnyin ngbãwẹ̀ fun ìja ati ãwọ̀, ati lilù, nipa ikũku ìwa-buburu: ẹ máṣe gbãwẹ bi ti ọjọ yi, ki a le gbọ́ ohùn nyin li oke.
entries.en: Behold, ye fast for strife and debate, and to smite with the fist of wickedness: ye shall not fast as ye do this day, to make your voice to be heard on high.

entries.yo: Ãwẹ̀ iru eyi ni mo yàn bi? ọjọ ti enia njẹ ọkàn rẹ̀ ni ìya? lati tẹ ori rẹ̀ ba bi koriko odo? ati lati tẹ́ aṣọ ọ̀fọ ati ẽru labẹ rẹ̀? iwọ o ha pe eyi ni ãwẹ̀, ati ọjọ itẹwọgba fun Oluwa?
entries.en: Is it such a fast that I have chosen? a day for a man to afflict his soul? is it to bow down his head as a bulrush, and to spread sackcloth and ashes under him? wilt thou call this a fast, and an acceptable day to the LORD?

entries.yo: Awẹ ti mo ti yàn kọ́ eyi? lati tú ọjá aiṣododo, lati tú ẹrù wiwo, ati lati jẹ ki anilara lọ lọfẹ, ati lati já gbogbo ajàga.
entries.en: Is not this the fast that I have chosen? to loose the bands of wickedness, to undo the heavy burdens, and to let the oppressed go free, and that ye break every yoke?

entries.yo: Kì ha ṣe lati fi onjẹ rẹ fun awọn ti ebi npa, ati ki iwọ ki o mu awọn otòṣi ti a tì sode wá si ile rẹ? nigbati iwọ ba ri arinhòho, ki iwọ ki o bò o, ki iwọ, ki o má si fi ara rẹ pamọ kuro lọdọ ẹran-ara tirẹ.
entries.en: Is it not to deal thy bread to the hungry, and that thou bring the poor that are cast out to thy house? when thou seest the naked, that thou cover him; and that thou hide not thyself from thine own flesh?

entries.yo: Nigbana ni imọlẹ rẹ yio bẹ́ jade bi owurọ, ilera rẹ yio sọ jade kánkán: ododo rẹ yio si lọ ṣaju rẹ; ogo Oluwa yio kó ọ jọ.
entries.en: Then shall thy light break forth as the morning, and thine health shall spring forth speedily: and thy righteousness shall go before thee; the glory of the LORD shall be thy rereward.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni iwọ o pè, Oluwa yio si dahun; iwọ o kigbe, on o si wipe, Emi nĩ. Bi iwọ ba mu àjaga, ninà ika, ati sisọ asan, kuro lãrin rẹ.
entries.en: Then shalt thou call, and the LORD shall answer; thou shalt cry, and he shall say, Here I am. If thou take away from the midst of thee the yoke, the putting forth of the finger, and speaking vanity;

entries.yo: Bi iwọ ba fà ọkàn rẹ jade fun ẹniti ebi npa, ti o si tẹ́ ọkàn ti a npọ́n loju lọrùn, nigbana ni imọlẹ rẹ yio si là ninu okùnkun, ati okùnkun rẹ bi ọ̀san gangan.
entries.en: And if thou draw out thy soul to the hungry, and satisfy the afflicted soul; then shall thy light rise in obscurity, and thy darkness be as the noonday:

entries.yo: Oluwa yio ma tọ́ ọ nigbagbogbo, yio si tẹ́ ọkàn rẹ lọrun ni ibi gbigbẹ, yio si mu egungun rẹ sanra; iwọ o si dabi ọgbà ti a bomirin, ati bi isun omi ti omi rẹ̀ ki itán.
entries.en: And the LORD shall guide thee continually, and satisfy thy soul in drought, and make fat thy bones: and thou shalt be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water, whose waters fail not.

entries.yo: Ati awọn tirẹ yio mọ ibi ahoro atijọ wọnni: iwọ o gbé ipilẹ iran ọ̀pọlọpọ ró, a o si ma pe ọ ni, Alatunṣe ẹyà nì, Olumupada ọ̀na wọnni lati gbe inu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And they that shall be of thee shall build the old waste places: thou shalt raise up the foundations of many generations; and thou shalt be called, The repairer of the breach, The restorer of paths to dwell in.

entries.yo: Bi iwọ ba yí ẹsẹ rẹ kuro li ọjọ isimi, lati má ṣe afẹ́ rẹ li ọjọ isimi mi; ti iwọ si pè ọjọ isimi ni adùn, ọjọ mimọ́ Oluwa, ọlọ́wọ̀; ti iwọ si bọ̀wọ fun u, ti iwọ kò hù ìwa rẹ, tabi tẹle afẹ rẹ, tabi sọ ọ̀rọ ara rẹ.
entries.en: If thou turn away thy foot from the sabbath, from doing thy pleasure on my holy day; and call the sabbath a delight, the holy of the LORD, honourable; and shalt honour him, not doing thine own ways, nor finding thine own pleasure, nor speaking thine own words:

entries.yo: Nigbana ni inu rẹ yio dùn si Oluwa, emi o si mu ọ gùn ibi giga aiye, emi o si fi ilẹ níni Jakobu baba rẹ bọ́ ọ: nitori ẹnu Oluwa li o ti sọ ọ.
entries.en: Then shalt thou delight thyself in the LORD; and I will cause thee to ride upon the high places of the earth, and feed thee with the heritage of Jacob thy father: for the mouth of the LORD hath spoken it.

entries.yo: KIYESI i, ọwọ́ Oluwa kò kuru lati gbàni, bẹ̃ni eti rẹ̀ kò wuwo ti kì yio fi gbọ́.
entries.en: Behold, the LORD's hand is not shortened, that it cannot save; neither his ear heavy, that it cannot hear:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn aiṣedede nyin li o yà nyin kuro lọdọ Ọlọrun nyin, ati ẹ̀ṣẹ nyin li o pa oju rẹ̀ mọ kuro lọdọ nyin, ti on kì yio fi gbọ́.
entries.en: But your iniquities have separated between you and your God, and your sins have hid his face from you, that he will not hear.

entries.yo: Nitori ọwọ́ nyin di alaimọ́ fun ẹ̀jẹ, ati ika nyin fun aiṣedede, ète nyin nsọ eke, ahọn nyin nsọ ibi jade.
entries.en: For your hands are defiled with blood, and your fingers with iniquity; your lips have spoken lies, your tongue hath muttered perverseness.

entries.yo: Kò si ẹniti nwá ẹtọ́, bẹ̃ni kò si ẹniti ndajọ ni otitọ: nwọn gbẹkẹle ohun asan, nwọn nsọ eke; nwọn loyun ikà, nwọn mbí iparun.
entries.en: None calleth for justice, nor any pleadeth for truth: they trust in vanity, and speak lies; they conceive mischief, and bring forth iniquity.

entries.yo: Nwọn npa ẹyin pamọlẹ, nwọn nhun okùn alantakùn: ẹniti o jẹ ninu ẹyin wọn yio kú, ati eyi ti a tẹ̀ bẹ́ ọká jade.
entries.en: They hatch cockatrice' eggs, and weave the spider's web: he that eateth of their eggs dieth, and that which is crushed breaketh out into a viper.

entries.yo: Okùn wọn kì yio di ẹwù, bẹ̃ni nwọn kì yio fi iṣẹ wọn bò ara wọn: iṣẹ wọn ni iṣẹ ikà, iṣe ipá si mbẹ li ọwọ́ wọn.
entries.en: Their webs shall not become garments, neither shall they cover themselves with their works: their works are works of iniquity, and the act of violence is in their hands.

entries.yo: Ẹsẹ wọn sare si ibi, nwọn si yara lati tajẹ̀ alaiṣẹ̀ silẹ: èro wọn èro ibi ni; ibajẹ ati iparun mbẹ ni ipa wọn.
entries.en: Their feet run to evil, and they make hast to shed innocent blood: their thoughts are thoughts of iniquity; wasting and destruction are in their paths.

entries.yo: Ọ̀na alafia ni nwọn kò mọ̀; kò si idajọ kan ninu ìrin wọn: nwọn ṣe ipa-ọ̀na wiwọ́ fun ara wọn: ẹnikẹni ti o ba tọ̀ ọ kì yio mọ̀ alafia.
entries.en: The way of peace they know not; and there is no judgment in their goings: they have made them crooked paths: whosoever goeth therein shall not know peace.

entries.yo: Nitori na ni idajọ jìna si wa, bẹ̃ni ododo kì yio le wa bá, awa duro dè imọlẹ, ṣugbọn kiyesi i, okunkun, a duro de imọlẹ, ṣugbọn a nrin ninu okunkun.
entries.en: Therefore is judgment far from us, neither doth justice overtake us: we wait for light, but behold obscurity; for brightness, but we walk in darkness.

entries.yo: A nwá ogiri kiri bi afọju, awa si nwá ọ̀na bi ẹniti kò li oju: awa nkọsẹ lọsangangan bi ẹnipe loru, ni ibi ahoro, bi okú.
entries.en: We grope for the wall like the blind, and we grope as if we had no eyes: we stumble at noonday as in the night; we are in desolate places as dead men.

entries.yo: Gbogbo wa mbu bi beari, awa si npohunrere bi oriri: awa wò ọ̀na fun idajọ, ṣugbọn kò si, fun igbala, ṣugbọn o jìna si wa.
entries.en: We roar all like bears, and mourn sore like doves: we look for judgment, but there is none; for salvation, but it is far off from us.

entries.yo: Nitori irekọja wa npọ̀ si i niwaju rẹ, ẹ̀ṣẹ wa njẹri gbè wa, nitori irekọja wa mbẹ lọdọ wa, niti aiṣedede wa, awa mọ̀ wọn.
entries.en: For our transgressions are multiplied before thee, and our sins testify against us: for our transgressions are with us; and as for our iniquities, we know them;

entries.yo: Ni rirekọja ati ṣiṣeke si Oluwa, ifaṣẹhin kuro lọdọ Ọlọrun wa, isọrọ inilara ati ìṣọtẹ, liloyun ati sisọrọ eke lati inu jade wá.
entries.en: In transgressing and lying against the LORD, and departing away from our God, speaking oppression and revolt, conceiving and uttering from the heart words of falsehood.

entries.yo: A dá idajọ pada, ẹtọ́ si duro lokerè rére: otitọ ṣubu ni igboro, aiṣègbe kò le wọ ile.
entries.en: And judgment is turned away backward, and justice standeth afar off: for truth is fallen in the street, and equity cannot enter.

entries.yo: Otitọ kò si, ẹniti o si kuro ninu ibi o sọ ara rẹ̀ di ijẹ: Oluwa si ri i, o si buru loju rẹ̀, ti idajọ kò si.
entries.en: Yea, truth faileth; and he that departeth from evil maketh himself a prey: and the LORD saw it, and it displeased him that there was no judgment.

entries.yo: O si ri pe kò si ẹnikan, ẹnu si yà a pe onipẹ̀ kò si, nitorina apá rẹ̀ mu igbala fun u wá; ati ododo rẹ̀, on li o gbé e ró.
entries.en: And he saw that there was no man, and wondered that there was no intercessor: therefore his arm brought salvation unto him; and his righteousness, it sustained him.

entries.yo: O si gbe ododo wọ̀ bi awo-aiya, o si fi aṣibori irin igbala dé ara rẹ̀ lori: o wọ̀ ẹwù igbẹsan li aṣọ, a si fi itara wọ̀ ọ bi agbada.
entries.en: For he put on righteousness as a breastplate, and an helmet of salvation upon his head; and he put on the garments of vengeance for clothing, and was clad with zeal as a cloke.

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi ere iṣe wọn, bẹ̃ gẹgẹ ni yio san a fun wọn, irunú fun awọn ọta rẹ̀, igbẹsan fun awọn ọta rẹ̀; fun awọn erekuṣu yio san ẹsan.
entries.en: According to their deeds, accordingly he will repay, fury to his adversaries, recompence to his enemies; to the islands he will repay recompence.

entries.yo: Nwọn o si bẹ̀ru orukọ Oluwa lati ìwọ-õrùn wá, ati ogo rẹ̀ lati ilà-õrun wá. Nigbati ọta yio de bi kikún omi, Ẹmi Oluwa yio gbe ọpágun soke si i.
entries.en: So shall they fear the name of the LORD from the west, and his glory from the rising of the sun. When the enemy shall come in like a flood, the Spirit of the LORD shall lift up a standard against him.

entries.yo: Olurapada yio si wá si Sioni, ati sọdọ awọn ti o yipada kuro ninu irekọja ni Jakobu, ni Oluwa wi.
entries.en: And the Redeemer shall come to Zion, and unto them that turn from transgression in Jacob, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Niti emi, eyi ni majẹmu mi pẹlu wọn, ni Oluwa wi; Ẹmi mi ti o wà lara rẹ̀, ati ọ̀rọ mi ti mo fi si ẹnu rẹ, kì yio kuro li ẹnu rẹ, tabi kuro lẹnu iru-ọmọ rẹ, tabi kuro lẹnu iru-ọmọ ọmọ rẹ, ni Oluwa wi, lati isisiyi lọ ati lailai.
entries.en: As for me, this is my covenant with them, saith the LORD; My spirit that is upon thee, and my words which I have put in thy mouth, shall not depart out of thy mouth, nor out of the mouth of thy seed, nor out of the mouth of thy seed's seed, saith the LORD, from henceforth and for ever.

entries.yo: DIDE, tàn imọlẹ: nitori imọlẹ rẹ dé, ogo Oluwa si yọ lara rẹ.
entries.en: Arise, shine; for thy light is come, and the glory of the LORD is risen upon thee.

entries.yo: Nitori kiyesi i, okùnkun bò aiye mọlẹ, ati okùnkun biribiri bò awọn enia: ṣugbọn Oluwa yio yọ lara rẹ, a o si ri ogo rẹ̀ lara rẹ.
entries.en: For, behold, the darkness shall cover the earth, and gross darkness the people: but the LORD shall arise upon thee, and his glory shall be seen upon thee.

entries.yo: Awọn keferi yio wá si imọlẹ rẹ, ati awọn ọba si titàn yiyọ rẹ.
entries.en: And the Gentiles shall come to thy light, and kings to the brightness of thy rising.

entries.yo: Gbe oju rẹ soke yika, ki o si wò; gbogbo wọn ṣa ara wọn jọ pọ̀, nwọn wá sọdọ rẹ: awọn ọmọ rẹ ọkunrin yio ti ọ̀na jíjin wá, a o si tọju awọn ọmọ rẹ obinrin li ẹgbẹ rẹ.
entries.en: Lift up thine eyes round about, and see: all they gather themselves together, they come to thee: thy sons shall come from far, and thy daughters shall be nursed at thy side.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni iwọ o ri, oju rẹ o si mọlẹ, ọkàn rẹ yio si yipada, yio si di nla: nitori a o yi ọrọ̀ okun pada si ọ, ipá awọn Keferi yio wá sọdọ rẹ.
entries.en: Then thou shalt see, and flow together, and thine heart shall fear, and be enlarged; because the abundance of the sea shall be converted unto thee, the forces of the Gentiles shall come unto thee.

entries.yo: Ọ̀pọlọpọ rakunmi yio bò ọ mọlẹ, awọn ọmọ rakunmi Midiani on Ẹfa; gbogbo wọn o wá lati Ṣeba: nwọn o mu wura ati turari wá; nwọn o fi iyìn Oluwa hàn sode.
entries.en: The multitude of camels shall cover thee, the dromedaries of Midian and Ephah; all they from Sheba shall come: they shall bring gold and incense; and they shall shew forth the praises of the LORD.

entries.yo: A o ṣà gbogbo ọwọ́-ẹran Kedari jọ sọdọ rẹ, awọn àgbo Nebaioti yio ṣe iranṣẹ fun ọ; nwọn o goke wá si pẹpẹ mi pẹlu itẹwọgba, emi o si ṣe ile ogo mi li ogo.
entries.en: All the flocks of Kedar shall be gathered together unto thee, the rams of Nebaioth shall minister unto thee: they shall come up with acceptance on mine altar, and I will glorify the house of my glory.

entries.yo: Tani wọnyi ti nfò bi awọsanma, ati bi awọn ẹiyẹle si ojule wọn?
entries.en: Who are these that fly as a cloud, and as the doves to their windows?

entries.yo: Nitõtọ erekuṣu wọnni yio duro dè mi, ọkọ Tarṣiṣi wọnni li ekini, lati mu awọn ọmọ rẹ ọkunrin ti ọ̀na jìjin wá, fadaka wọn, ati wura wọn pẹlu wọn, fun orukọ Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ, ati fun Ẹni-Mimọ́ Israeli, nitoriti on ti ṣe ọ logo.
entries.en: Surely the isles shall wait for me, and the ships of Tarshish first, to bring thy sons from far, their silver and their gold with them, unto the name of the LORD thy God, and to the Holy One of Israel, because he hath glorified thee.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ alejo yio si mọ odi rẹ: awọn ọba wọn yio ṣe iranṣẹ fun ọ: nitori ni ìkannu mi ni mo lù ọ, ṣugbọn ni inu rere mi ni mo si ṣãnu fun ọ.
entries.en: And the sons of strangers shall build up thy walls, and their kings shall minister unto thee: for in my wrath I smote thee, but in my favour have I had mercy on thee.

entries.yo: Nitori na awọn ẹnu-bodè rẹ yio ṣi silẹ nigbagbogbo; a kì yio se wọn lọsan tabi loru, ki a le mu ọla awọn Keferi wá sọdọ rẹ, ki a ba si mu awọn ọba wọn wá.
entries.en: Therefore thy gates shall be open continually; they shall not be shut day nor night; that men may bring unto thee the forces of the Gentiles, and that their kings may be brought.

entries.yo: Nitori orilẹ-ède, tabi ilẹ ọba ti kì yio sin ọ, yio ṣegbe; orilẹ-ède wọnni li a o sọ dahoro raurau.
entries.en: For the nation and kingdom that will not serve thee shall perish; yea, those nations shall be utterly wasted.

entries.yo: Ogo Lebanoni yio wá sọdọ rẹ, igi firi, igi pine, pẹlu igi boksi, lati ṣe ibi mimọ́ mi li ọṣọ; emi o ṣe ibi ẹsẹ mi logo.
entries.en: The glory of Lebanon shall come unto thee, the fir tree, the pine tree, and the box together, to beautify the place of my sanctuary; and I will make the place of my feet glorious.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọkunrin awọn aninilara rẹ pẹlu yio wá ni itẹriba sọdọ rẹ; gbogbo awọn ti o ti ngàn ọ, nwọn o tẹ̀ ara wọn ba silẹ li atẹlẹsẹ rẹ; nwọn o si pe ọ ni Ilu Oluwa, Sioni ti Ẹni-Mimọ́ Israeli.
entries.en: The sons also of them that afflicted thee shall come bending unto thee; and all they that despised thee shall bow themselves down at the soles of thy feet; and they shall call thee, The city of the LORD, The Zion of the Holy One of Israel.

entries.yo: Ni bi a ti kọ̀ ọ silẹ, ti a si ti korira rẹ, tobẹ̃ ti ẹnikan kò kọja lãrin rẹ, emi o sọ ọ di ogo aiyeraiye, ayọ̀ iran-de-iran ọ̀pọlọpọ.
entries.en: Whereas thou hast been forsaken and hated, so that no man went through thee, I will make thee an eternal excellency, a joy of many generations.

entries.yo: Iwọ o mu wàra awọn Keferi, iwọ o si mu ọmu awọn ọba; iwọ o si mọ̀ pe, emi Oluwa ni Olugbala rẹ, ati Olurapada rẹ, Ẹni-alagbara Jakobu.
entries.en: Thou shalt also suck the milk of the Gentiles, and shalt suck the breast of kings: and thou shalt know that I the LORD am thy Saviour and thy Redeemer, the mighty One of Jacob.

entries.yo: Nipo idẹ emi o mu wura wá, nipo irin emi o mu fadaka wá, ati nipo igi, idẹ, ati nipo okuta, irin: emi o ṣe awọn ijoye rẹ ni alafia, ati awọn akoniṣiṣẹ́ rẹ ni ododo.
entries.en: For brass I will bring gold, and for iron I will bring silver, and for wood brass, and for stones iron: I will also make thy officers peace, and thine exactors righteousness.

entries.yo: A kì yio gbọ́ ìwa-ipá mọ ni ilẹ rẹ, idahoro tabi iparun li agbègbe rẹ; ṣugbọn iwọ o pe odi rẹ ni Igbala, ati ẹnu-bodè rẹ ni Iyin.
entries.en: Violence shall no more be heard in thy land, wasting nor destruction within thy borders; but thou shalt call thy walls Salvation, and thy gates Praise.

entries.yo: Õrùn kì yio jẹ imọlẹ rẹ mọ li ọsan, bẹ̃ni oṣupa kì yio fi imọlẹ rẹ̀ ràn fun ọ; ṣugbọn Oluwa yio ṣe imọlẹ ainipẹkun rẹ, ati Ọlọrun rẹ ogo rẹ.
entries.en: The sun shall be no more thy light by day; neither for brightness shall the moon give light unto thee: but the LORD shall be unto thee an everlasting light, and thy God thy glory.

entries.yo: Õrùn rẹ ki yio wọ̀ mọ; bẹ̃ni oṣupa rẹ kì yio wọ̃kùn: nitori Oluwa yio jẹ imọlẹ ainipẹkun fun ọ, ọjọ ãwẹ̀ rẹ wọnni yio si de opin.
entries.en: Thy sun shall no more go down; neither shall thy moon withdraw itself: for the LORD shall be thine everlasting light, and the days of thy mourning shall be ended.

entries.yo: Ati awọn enia rẹ, gbogbo wọn o jẹ olododo: nwọn o jogun ilẹ na titi lailai, ẹka gbigbin mi, iṣẹ ọwọ́ mi, ki a ba le yìn mi logo.
entries.en: Thy people also shall be all righteous: they shall inherit the land for ever, the branch of my planting, the work of my hands, that I may be glorified.

entries.yo: Ẹni-kekere kan ni yio di ẹgbẹrun, ati kekere kan yio di alagbara orilẹ-ède: emi Oluwa yio ṣe e kankan li akokò rẹ̀.
entries.en: A little one shall become a thousand, and a small one a strong nation: I the LORD will hasten it in his time.

entries.yo: ẸMI Oluwa Jehofah mbẹ lara mi: nitori o ti fi ami ororo yàn mi lati wãsu ihin-rere fun awọn òtoṣi; o ti rán mi lati ṣe awotán awọn onirobinujẹ ọkàn, lati kede idasilẹ fun awọn igbekùn, ati iṣisilẹ tubu fun awọn ondè.
entries.en: The Spirit of the Lord GOD is upon me; because the LORD hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek; he hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to them that are bound;

entries.yo: Lati kede ọdun itẹwọgba Oluwa, ati ọjọ ẹsan Ọlọrun wa; lati tù gbogbo awọn ti ngbãwẹ̀ ninu.
entries.en: To proclaim the acceptable year of the LORD, and the day of vengeance of our God; to comfort all that mourn;

entries.yo: Lati yàn fun awọn ti nṣọ̀fọ fun Sioni, lati fi ọṣọ́ fun wọn nipo ẽrú, ororo ayọ̀ nipo ọ̀fọ, aṣọ iyìn nipo ẹmi ibanujẹ, ki a le pè wọn ni igi ododo, ọgbìn Oluwa, ki a le yìn i logo.
entries.en: To appoint unto them that mourn in Zion, to give unto them beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness; that they might be called trees of righteousness, the planting of the LORD, that he might be glorified.

entries.yo: Nwọn o si mọ ibi ahoro atijọ wọnni, nwọn o gbe ahoro atijọ wọnni ro, nwọn o si tun ilu wọnni ti o ṣofo ṣe, ahoro iran ọ̀pọlọpọ.
entries.en: And they shall build the old wastes, they shall raise up the former desolations, and they shall repair the waste cities, the desolations of many generations.

entries.yo: Awọn alejò yio si duro, nwọn o si bọ́ ọwọ́ ẹran nyin, awọn ọmọ alejò yio si ṣe atulẹ nyin, ati olurẹ́ ọwọ́ àjara nyin.
entries.en: And strangers shall stand and feed your flocks, and the sons of the alien shall be your plowmen and your vinedressers.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn a o ma pè nyin ni Alufa Oluwa: nwọn o ma pè nyin ni Iranṣẹ Ọlọrun wa: ẹ o jẹ ọrọ̀ wọn Keferi, ati ninu ogo awọn li ẹ o mã ṣogo.
entries.en: But ye shall be named the Priests of the LORD: men shall call you the Ministers of our God: ye shall eat the riches of the Gentiles, and in their glory shall ye boast yourselves.

entries.yo: Nipo itijú nyin ẹ o ni iṣẹpo-meji; ati nipo idãmu, nwọn o yọ̀ ninu ipin wọn: nitorina nwọn o ni iṣẹpo-meji ni ilẹ wọn: ayọ̀ ainipẹkun yio jẹ ti wọn.
entries.en: For your shame ye shall have double; and for confusion they shall rejoice in their portion: therefore in their land they shall possess the double: everlasting joy shall be unto them.

entries.yo: Nitori emi Oluwa fẹ idajọ, mo korira ijale ninu aiṣododo; emi o si fi iṣẹ wọn fun wọn ni otitọ, emi o si ba wọn da majẹmu aiyeraiye.
entries.en: For I the LORD love judgment, I hate robbery for burnt offering; and I will direct their work in truth, and I will make an everlasting covenant with them.

entries.yo: A o si mọ̀ iru wọn ninu awọn Keferi, ati iru-ọmọ wọn lãrin awọn enia, gbogbo ẹniti o ri wọn yio mọ̀ wọn, pé, iru-ọmọ ti Oluwa busi ni nwọn.
entries.en: And their seed shall be known among the Gentiles, and their offspring among the people: all that see them shall acknowledge them, that they are the seed which the LORD hath blessed.

entries.yo: Emi o yọ̀ gidigidi ninu Oluwa, ọkàn mi yio yọ̀ ninu Ọlọrun mi; nitori o ti fi agbáda wọ̀ mi, o ti fi aṣọ ododo bò mi, gẹgẹ bi ọkọ iyawó ti iṣe ara rẹ̀ lọṣọ́, ati bi iyawó ti ifi ohun ọṣọ́ ṣe ara rẹ̀ lọṣọ́.
entries.en: I will greatly rejoice in the LORD, my soul shall be joyful in my God; for he hath clothed me with the garments of salvation, he hath covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decketh himself with ornaments, and as a bride adorneth herself with her jewels.

entries.yo: Nitori gẹgẹ bi ilẹ ti imu ẽhù rẹ̀ jade, ati bi ọgbà ti imu ohun ti a gbìn sinu rẹ̀ hù soke; bẹ̃ni Oluwa Jehofah yio mu ododo ati iyìn hù soke niwaju gbogbo orilẹ-ède.
entries.en: For as the earth bringeth forth her bud, and as the garden causeth the things that are sown in it to spring forth; so the Lord GOD will cause righteousness and praise to spring forth before all the nations.

entries.yo: NITORI ti Sioni emi kì yio dakẹ, ati nitori ti Jerusalemu emi kì yio simi, titi ododo rẹ̀ yio fi jade bi titan imọlẹ, ati igbala rẹ̀ bi fitila ti njó.
entries.en: For Zion's sake will I not hold my peace, and for Jerusalem's sake I will not rest, until the righteousness thereof go forth as brightness, and the salvation thereof as a lamp that burneth.

entries.yo: Ati awọn Keferi yio ri ododo rẹ, ati gbogbo ọba yio ri ogo rẹ: a o si fi orukọ titun pè ọ, eyiti ẹnu Oluwa yio darukọ.
entries.en: And the Gentiles shall see thy righteousness, and all kings thy glory: and thou shalt be called by a new name, which the mouth of the LORD shall name.

entries.yo: Iwọ o jẹ ade ogo pẹlu li ọwọ́ Oluwa, ati adé oyè ọba li ọwọ́ Ọlọrun rẹ.
entries.en: Thou shalt also be a crown of glory in the hand of the LORD, and a royal diadem in the hand of thy God.

entries.yo: A ki yio pè ọ ni Ikọ̀silẹ mọ́, bẹ̃ni a ki yio pè ilẹ rẹ ni Ahoro mọ: ṣugbọn a o pè ọ ni Hefsiba: ati ilẹ rẹ ni Beula: nitori inu Oluwa dùn si ọ, a o si gbe ilẹ rẹ ni iyawo.
entries.en: Thou shalt no more be termed Forsaken; neither shall thy land any more be termed Desolate: but thou shalt be called Hephzi-bah, and thy land Beulah: for the LORD delighteth in thee, and thy land shall be married.

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi ọdọmọkunrin ti igbé wundia ni iyawo, bẹ̃ni awọn ọmọ rẹ ọkunrin yio gbe ọ ni iyawo: ati bi ọkọ iyawo ti iyọ̀ si iyawo, bẹ̃ni Ọlọrun rẹ yio yọ̀ si ọ.
entries.en: For as a young man marrieth a virgin, so shall thy sons marry thee: and as the bridegroom rejoiceth over the bride, so shall thy God rejoice over thee.

entries.yo: Emi ti fi awọn alore sori odi rẹ, iwọ Jerusalemu, ti kì yio pa ẹnu wọn mọ lọsan ati loru titilai: ẹnyin ti nṣe iranti Oluwa, ẹ máṣe dakẹ.
entries.en: I have set watchmen upon thy walls, O Jerusalem, which shall never hold their peace day nor night: ye that make mention of the LORD, keep not silence,

entries.yo: Ẹ máṣe fun u ni isimi, titi yio fi fi idi Jerusalemu mulẹ, ti yio ṣe e ni iyìn li aiye.
entries.en: And give him no rest, till he establish, and till he make Jerusalem a praise in the earth.

entries.yo: Oluwa ti fi apá ọtun rẹ̀, ati apá agbara rẹ̀ bura, Lõtọ emi kì yio fi ọkà rẹ ṣe onjẹ fun awọn ọta rẹ mọ, bẹ̃ni awọn ọmọ ajeji kì yio mu ọti-waini rẹ, eyi ti iwọ ti ṣíṣẹ fun.
entries.en: The LORD hath sworn by his right hand, and by the arm of his strength, Surely I will no more give thy corn to be meat for thine enemies; and the sons of the stranger shall not drink thy wine, for the which thou hast laboured:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn ti o ṣà a jọ yio jẹ ẹ, nwọn o si yìn Oluwa; ati awọn ti nkó o jọ yio mu u, ninu ãfin mimọ́ mi.
entries.en: But they that have gathered it shall eat it, and praise the LORD; and they that have brought it together shall drink it in the courts of my holiness.

entries.yo: Ẹ kọja lọ, ẹ kọja li ẹnu bode; tun ọ̀na awọn enia ṣe; kọ bèbe, kọ bèbe opopo; ṣà okuta wọnni kuro, gbe ọpagun ró fun awọn enia.
entries.en: Go through, go through the gates; prepare ye the way of the people; cast up, cast up the highway; gather out the stones; lift up a standard for the people.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, Oluwa ti kede titi de opin aiye: Ẹ wi fun ọmọbinrin Sioni pe, Wo o, igbala rẹ de; wo o, ère rẹ̀ wà pẹlu rẹ̀, ati ẹsan rẹ̀ niwaju rẹ̀.
entries.en: Behold, the LORD hath proclaimed unto the end of the world, Say ye to the daughter of Zion, Behold, thy salvation cometh; behold, his reward is with him, and his work before him.

entries.yo: A o si ma pè wọn ni, Enia mimọ́, Ẹni-irapada Oluwa: a o si ma pè ọ ni, Iwári, Ilu aikọ̀silẹ.
entries.en: And they shall call them, The holy people, The redeemed of the LORD: and thou shalt be called, Sought out, A city not forsaken.

entries.yo: TANI eleyi ti o ti Edomu wá, ti on ti aṣọ arẹpọ́n lati Bosra wá? eyi ti o li ogo ninu aṣọ rẹ̀, ti o nyan ninu titobi agbara rẹ̀? Emi ni ẹniti nsọ̀rọ li ododo, ti o ni ipá lati gbala.
entries.en: Who is this that cometh from Edom, with dyed garments from Bozrah? this that is glorious in his apparel, travelling in the greatness of his strength? I that speak in righteousness, mighty to save.

entries.yo: Nitori kini aṣọ rẹ fi pọ́n, ti aṣọ rẹ wọnni fi dabi ẹniti ntẹ̀ ohun-èlo ifunti waini?
entries.en: Wherefore art thou red in thine apparel, and thy garments like him that treadeth in the winefat?

entries.yo: Emi nikan ti tẹ̀ ohun-elò ifunti waini; ati ninu awọn enia, ẹnikan kò pẹlu mi: nitori emi tẹ̀ wọn ninu ibinu mi, mo si tẹ̀ wọn mọlẹ ninu irunú mi; ẹ̀jẹ wọn si ta si aṣọ mi, mo si ṣe gbogbo ẹ̀wu mi ni abawọ́n.
