entries.en: I have trodden the winepress alone; and of the people there was none with me: for I will tread them in mine anger, and trample them in my fury; and their blood shall be sprinkled upon my garments, and I will stain all my raiment.

entries.yo: Nitori ọjọ ẹsan mbẹ li aiya mi, ọdun awọn ẹni-irapada mi ti de.
entries.en: For the day of vengeance is in mine heart, and the year of my redeemed is come.

entries.yo: Mo si wò, kò si si oluranlọwọ; ẹnu si yà mi pe kò si olugbéro; nitorina apa ti emi tikalami mu igbala wá sọdọ mi; ati irunú mi, on li o gbe mi ro.
entries.en: And I looked, and there was none to help; and I wondered that there was none to uphold: therefore mine own arm brought salvation unto me; and my fury, it upheld me.

entries.yo: Emi si tẹ̀ awọn enia mọlẹ ninu ibinu mi, mo si mu wọn mu yó ninu irunú mi, mo si mu ipa wọn sọkalẹ si ilẹ.
entries.en: And I will tread down the people in mine anger, and make them drunk in my fury, and I will bring down their strength to the earth.

entries.yo: Emi o sọ ti iṣeun ifẹ Oluwa, iyìn Oluwa gẹgẹ bi gbogbo eyiti Oluwa ti fi fun wa, ati ti ore nla si ile Israeli, ti o ti fi fun wọn gẹgẹ bi ãnu rẹ̀, ati gẹgẹ bi ọ̀pọlọpọ iṣeun ifẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: I will mention the lovingkindnesses of the LORD, and the praises of the LORD, according to all that the LORD hath bestowed on us, and the great goodness toward the house of Israel, which he hath bestowed on them according to his mercies, and according to the multitude of his lovingkindnesses.

entries.yo: On si wipe, Lõtọ enia mi ni nwọn, awọn ọmọ ti kì iṣeke: on si di Olugbala wọn.
entries.en: For he said, Surely they are my people, children that will not lie: so he was their Saviour.

entries.yo: Ninu gbogbo ipọnju wọn, oju a pọn ọ, angeli iwaju rẹ̀ si gbà wọn: ninu ifẹ rẹ̀ ati suru rẹ̀ li o rà wọn pada; o si gbe wọn, o si rù wọn ni gbogbo ọjọ igbani.
entries.en: In all their affliction he was afflicted, and the angel of his presence saved them: in his love and in his pity he redeemed them; and he bare them, and carried them all the days of old.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nwọn ṣọ̀tẹ, nwọn si bi Ẹmi mimọ́ rẹ̀ ninu; nitorina li o ṣe pada di ọta wọn, on tikalarẹ̀ si ba wọn ja.
entries.en: But they rebelled, and vexed his holy Spirit: therefore he was turned to be their enemy, and he fought against them.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni o ranti ọjọ atijọ, Mose, awọn enia rẹ̀, wipe, Nibo li ẹniti o mu wọn ti inu okun jade gbe wà, ti on ti olùṣọ agutan ọwọ́-ẹran rẹ̀? nibo li ẹniti o fi Ẹmi mimọ́ rẹ̀ sinu rẹ̀ gbe wà?
entries.en: Then he remembered the days of old, Moses, and his people, saying, Where is he that brought them up out of the sea with the shepherd of his flock? where is he that put his holy Spirit within him?

entries.yo: Ti o fi ọwọ́ ọtun Mose dà wọn, pẹlu apá rẹ̀ ti o logo, ti o npin omi meji niwaju wọn, lati ṣe orukọ aiyeraiye fun ara rẹ̀?
entries.en: That led them by the right hand of Moses with his glorious arm, dividing the water before them, to make himself an everlasting name?

entries.yo: Ti o mu wọn là ibú ja, bi ẹṣin li aginjù, ki nwọn ki o má ba kọsẹ?
entries.en: That led them through the deep, as an horse in the wilderness, that they should not stumble?

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi ẹran ti isọ̀kalẹ lọ si afonifoji, bẹ̃ni Ẹmi Oluwa mu u simi: bẹ̃ni iwọ tọ́ awọn enia rẹ, lati ṣe orukọ ti o li ogo fun ara rẹ.
entries.en: As a beast goeth down into the valley, the Spirit of the LORD caused him to rest: so didst thou lead thy people, to make thyself a glorious name.

entries.yo: Wò ilẹ lati ọrun wá, ki o si kiyesi lati ibugbe ìwa mimọ́ rẹ ati ogo rẹ wá: nibo ni itara rẹ ati agbara rẹ, ọ̀pọlọpọ iyanu rẹ, ati ãnu rẹ sọdọ mi gbe wà? a ha da wọn duro bi?
entries.en: Look down from heaven, and behold from the habitation of thy holiness and of thy glory: where is thy zeal and thy strength, the sounding of thy bowels and of thy mercies toward me? are they restrained?

entries.yo: Laiṣiyemeji iwọ ni baba wa, bi Abrahamu tilẹ ṣe alaimọ̀ wa, ti Israeli kò si jẹwọ wa: iwọ Oluwa, ni baba wa, Olurapada wa; lati aiyeraiye ni orukọ rẹ.
entries.en: Doubtless thou art our father, though Abraham be ignorant of us, and Israel acknowledge us not: thou, O LORD, art our father, our redeemer; thy name is from everlasting.

entries.yo: Oluwa, nitori kili o ṣe mu wa ṣina kuro li ọ̀na rẹ, ti o si sọ ọkàn wa di lile kuro ninu ẹ̀ru rẹ? Yipada nitori awọn iranṣẹ rẹ, awọn ẹya ilẹ ini rẹ.
entries.en: O LORD, why hast thou made us to err from thy ways, and hardened our heart from thy fear? Return for thy servants' sake, the tribes of thine inheritance.

entries.yo: Awọn enia mimọ́ rẹ ti ni i, ni igba diẹ: awọn ọta wa ti tẹ̀ ibi mimọ́ rẹ mọlẹ.
entries.en: The people of thy holiness have possessed it but a little while: our adversaries have trodden down thy sanctuary.

entries.yo: Tirẹ li awa: lati lailai iwọ kò jọba lori wọn, a kò pè orukọ rẹ mọ wọn.
entries.en: We are thine: thou never barest rule over them; they were not called by thy name.

entries.yo: IWỌ iba jẹ fà awọn ọrun ya, ki iwọ si sọkalẹ, ki awọn oke-nla ki o le yọ́ niwaju rẹ.
entries.en: Oh that thou wouldest rend the heavens, that thou wouldest come down, that the mountains might flow down at thy presence,

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi igbati iná ileru ti njo, bi iná ti imu omi hó, lati sọ orukọ rẹ di mimọ̀ fun awọn ọta rẹ, ki awọn orilẹ-ède ki o le warìri niwaju rẹ!
entries.en: As when the melting fire burneth, the fire causeth the waters to boil, to make thy name known to thine adversaries, that the nations may tremble at thy presence!

entries.yo: Nigbati iwọ ṣe nkan wọnni ti o lẹ̀ru ti awa kò fi oju sọna fun, iwọ sọkalẹ wá, awọn oke-nla yọ́ niwaju rẹ.
entries.en: When thou didst terrible things which we looked not for, thou camest down, the mountains flowed down at thy presence.

entries.yo: Nitori lati ipilẹṣẹ aiye wá, a kò ti igbọ́, bẹ̃ni eti kò ti gbọ́ ọ, bẹ̃ni oju kò ti iri Ọlọrun kan lẹhin rẹ, ti o ti pèse fun ẹniti o duro dè e.
entries.en: For since the beginning of the world men have not heard, nor perceived by the ear, neither hath the eye seen, O God, beside thee, what he hath prepared for him that waiteth for him.

entries.yo: Iwọ pade ẹniti nyọ̀ ti o nṣiṣẹ ododo, ti o ranti rẹ li ọ̀na rẹ: kiyesi i, iwọ binu; nitori awa ti dẹṣẹ̀; a si pẹ ninu wọn, a o ha si là?
entries.en: Thou meetest him that rejoiceth and worketh righteousness, those that remember thee in thy ways: behold, thou art wroth; for we have sinned: in those is continuance, and we shall be saved.

entries.yo: Gbogbo wa si dabi ohun aimọ́, gbogbo ododo wa si dabi akisa ẹlẹgbin; gbogbo wa si rẹ̀ bi ewe; aiṣedede wa si mu wa kuro bi afẹfẹ.
entries.en: But we are all as an unclean thing, and all our righteousnesses are as filthy rags; and we all do fade as a leaf; and our iniquities, like the wind, have taken us away.

entries.yo: Kò si ẹniti npè orukọ rẹ, ti o si rú ara rẹ̀ soke lati di ọ mu: nitori iwọ ti pa oju rẹ mọ kuro lara wa, iwọ si ti run wa, nitori aiṣedede wa.
entries.en: And there is none that calleth upon thy name, that stirreth up himself to take hold of thee: for thou hast hid thy face from us, and hast consumed us, because of our iniquities.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nisisiyi, Oluwa, iwọ ni baba wa; awa ni amọ̀, iwọ si ni ọ̀mọ; gbogbo wa si ni iṣẹ ọwọ́ rẹ.
entries.en: But now, O LORD, thou art our father; we are the clay, and thou our potter; and we all are the work of thy hand.

entries.yo: Máṣe binu kọja àla, Oluwa, ki o má si ranti aiṣedede wa titilai: kiyesi i, wò, awa bẹ̀ ọ, enia rẹ ni gbogbo wa iṣe.
entries.en: Be not wroth very sore, O LORD, neither remember iniquity for ever: behold, see, we beseech thee, we are all thy people.

entries.yo: Awọn ilu mimọ́ rẹ di aginju, Sioni dí aginju, Jerusalemu di ahoro.
entries.en: Thy holy cities are a wilderness, Zion is a wilderness, Jerusalem a desolation.

entries.yo: Ile wa mimọ́ ati ologo, nibiti awọn baba wa ti nyìn ọ, li a fi iná kun: gbogbo ohun ãyo wa si ti run.
entries.en: Our holy and our beautiful house, where our fathers praised thee, is burned up with fire: and all our pleasant things are laid waste.

entries.yo: Iwọ o ha da ara rẹ duro nitori nkan wọnyi, Oluwa? iwọ o ha dakẹ, ki o si pọn wa loju kọja àla?
entries.en: Wilt thou refrain thyself for these things, O LORD? wilt thou hold thy peace, and afflict us very sore?

entries.yo: A wá mi lọdọ awọn ti kò bere mi; a ri mi lọdọ awọn ti kò wá mi: mo wi fun orilẹ-ède ti a kò pe li orukọ mi pe, Wò mi, wò mi.
entries.en: I am sought of them that asked not for me; I am found of them that sought me not: I said, Behold me, behold me, unto a nation that was not called by my name.

entries.yo: Ni gbogbo ọjọ ni mo ti na ọwọ́ mi si awọn ọlọtẹ̀ enia, ti nrìn li ọ̀na ti kò dara, nipa ìro ara wọn;
entries.en: I have spread out my hands all the day unto a rebellious people, which walketh in a way that was not good, after their own thoughts;

entries.yo: Awọn enia ti o nṣọ́ mi ni inu nigbagbogbo kàn mi loju; ti nrubọ ninu agbàla, ti nwọn si nfi turari jona lori pẹpẹ briki.
entries.en: A people that provoketh me to anger continually to my face; that sacrificeth in gardens, and burneth incense upon altars of brick;

entries.yo: Awọn ti ngbe inu ibojì, ti nwọn si nwọ̀ ni ile awọn oriṣa, ti njẹ ẹran ẹlẹdẹ, omi-ẹran nkan irira si mbẹ ninu ohun-elò wọn;
entries.en: Which remain among the graves, and lodge in the monuments, which eat swine's flesh, and broth of abominable things is in their vessels;

entries.yo: Ẹniti o wipe, Duro fun ara rẹ, máṣe sunmọ mi; nitori ti mo ṣe mimọ́ jù ọ lọ. Wọnyi li ẹ̃fin ni imu mi, iná ti njo ni gbogbo ọjọ ni.
entries.en: Which say, Stand by thyself, come not near to me; for I am holier than thou. These are a smoke in my nose, a fire that burneth all the day.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, a ti kọwe rẹ̀ niwaju mi: emi kì o dakẹ, ṣugbọn emi o gbẹ̀san, ani ẹ̀san si aiya wọn,
entries.en: Behold, it is written before me: I will not keep silence, but will recompense, even recompense into their bosom,

entries.yo: Aiṣedede nyin, ati aiṣedede awọn baba nyin ṣọkan pọ̀, li Oluwa wi, awọn ẹniti o fi turari jona lori oke-nla, ti nwọn mbu ọla mi kù lori awọn oke kékèké: nitori na li emi o wọ̀n iṣẹ wọn iṣaju, sinu aiya wọn.
entries.en: Your iniquities, and the iniquities of your fathers together, saith the LORD, which have burned incense upon the mountains, and blasphemed me upon the hills: therefore will I measure their former work into their bosom.

entries.yo: Bayi ni Oluwa wi, gẹgẹ bi a ti iri ọti-waini titun ninu ìdi eso àjara, ti a si nwipe, Máṣe bà a jẹ nitori ibukun mbẹ ninu rẹ̀: bẹ̃li emi o ṣe nitori awọn iranṣẹ mi, ki emi ki o má ba pa gbogbo wọn run.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD, As the new wine is found in the cluster, and one saith, Destroy it not; for a blessing is in it: so will I do for my servants' sakes, that I may not destroy them all.

entries.yo: Emi o si mu iru kan jade ni Jakobu, ati ajogun oke-nla mi lati inu Juda: ayanfẹ mi yio si jogun rẹ̀, awọn iranṣẹ mi yio si gbe ibẹ.
entries.en: And I will bring forth a seed out of Jacob, and out of Judah an inheritor of my mountains: and mine elect shall inherit it, and my servants shall dwell there.

entries.yo: Ṣaroni yio di agbo-ẹran, ati afonifoji Akori ibikan fun awọn ọwọ́ ẹran lati dubulẹ ninu rẹ̀, nitori awọn enia mi ti o ti wá mi kiri.
entries.en: And Sharon shall be a fold of flocks, and the valley of Achor a place for the herds to lie down in, for my people that have sought me.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹnyin ti o kọ̀ Oluwa silẹ, ti o gbàgbe oke-nla mimọ́ mi, ti o pèse tabili fun Gadi, ti o si fi ọrẹ mimu kun Meni.
entries.en: But ye are they that forsake the LORD, that forget my holy mountain, that prepare a table for that troop, and that furnish the drink offering unto that number.

entries.yo: Nitorina li emi o ṣe kà nyin fun idà, gbogbo nyin yio wolẹ fun pipa: nitori nigbati mo pè, ẹnyin kò dahùn; nigbati mo sọ̀rọ, ẹnyin kò gbọ́; ṣugbọn ẹnyin ṣe ibi loju mi, ẹnyin si yàn eyiti inu mi kò dùn si.
entries.en: Therefore will I number you to the sword, and ye shall all bow down to the slaughter: because when I called, ye did not answer; when I spake, ye did not hear; but did evil before mine eyes, and did choose that wherein I delighted not.

entries.yo: Nitorina bayi ni Oluwa Jehofah wi, Kiyesi i awọn iranṣẹ mi o jẹun, ṣugbọn ebi yio pa ẹnyin: kiyesi i, awọn iranṣẹ mi o mu, ṣugbọn ongbẹ o gbẹ ẹnyin: kiyesi i, awọn iranṣẹ mi o yọ̀, ṣugbọn oju o tì ẹnyin:
entries.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD, Behold, my servants shall eat, but ye shall be hungry: behold, my servants shall drink, but ye shall be thirsty: behold, my servants shall rejoice, but ye shall be ashamed:

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, awọn iranṣẹ mi yio kọrin fun inudidun, ṣugbọn ẹnyin o ke fun ibanujẹ ọkàn, ẹnyin o si hu fun irobinujẹ ọkàn.
entries.en: Behold, my servants shall sing for joy of heart, but ye shall cry for sorrow of heart, and shall howl for vexation of spirit.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin o si fi orukọ nyin silẹ fun egún fun awọn ayanfẹ mi: nitori Oluwa Jehofah yio pa ọ, yio si pè awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀ li orukọ miran:
entries.en: And ye shall leave your name for a curse unto my chosen: for the Lord GOD shall slay thee, and call his servants by another name:

entries.yo: Ki ẹniti o fi ibukun fun ara rẹ̀ li aiye, ki o fi ibukun fun ara rẹ̀ ninu Ọlọrun otitọ; ẹniti o si mbura li aiye ki o fi Ọlọrun otitọ bura; nitori ti a gbagbe wahala iṣaju, ati nitoriti a fi wọn pamọ kuro loju mi.
entries.en: That he who blesseth himself in the earth shall bless himself in the God of truth; and he that sweareth in the earth shall swear by the God of truth; because the former troubles are forgotten, and because they are hid from mine eyes.

entries.yo: Sa wò o, emi o da ọrun titun ati aiye titun: a kì yio si ranti awọn ti iṣaju, bẹ̃ni nwọn kì yio wá si aiya.
entries.en: For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth: and the former shall not be remembered, nor come into mind.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ki ẹnyin ki o yọ̀, ki inu nyin ki o si dùn titi lai ninu eyi ti emi o da: nitori kiyesi i, emi o da Jerusalemu ni inudidùn, ati awọn enia rẹ̀ ni ayọ̀.
entries.en: But be ye glad and rejoice for ever in that which I create: for, behold, I create Jerusalem a rejoicing, and her people a joy.

entries.yo: Emi o si ṣe ariya ni Jerusalemu, emi o si yọ̀ ninu awọn enia mi: a kì yio si tun gbọ́ ohùn ẹkún mọ ninu rẹ̀, tabi ohùn igbe.
entries.en: And I will rejoice in Jerusalem, and joy in my people: and the voice of weeping shall be no more heard in her, nor the voice of crying.

entries.yo: Ki yio si ọmọ-ọwọ nibẹ ti ọjọ rẹ̀ kì yio pẹ́, tabi àgba kan ti ọjọ rẹ̀ kò kún: nitori ọmọde yio kú li ọgọrun ọdun; ṣugbọn ẹlẹṣẹ ọlọgọrun ọdun yio di ẹni-ifibu.
entries.en: There shall be no more thence an infant of days, nor an old man that hath not filled his days: for the child shall die an hundred years old; but the sinner being an hundred years old shall be accursed.

entries.yo: Nwọn o si kọ ile, nwọn o si gbe inu wọn; nwọn o si gbìn ọgba àjara, nwọn o si jẹ eso wọn.
entries.en: And they shall build houses, and inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, and eat the fruit of them.

entries.yo: Nwọn kì yio kọ ile fun ẹlomiran lati gbé, nwọn kì yio gbìn fun ẹlomiran lati jẹ: nitori gẹgẹ bi ọjọ igi li ọjọ awọn enia mi ri, awọn ayanfẹ mi yio si jìfà iṣẹ ọwọ́ wọn.
entries.en: They shall not build, and another inhabit; they shall not plant, and another eat: for as the days of a tree are the days of my people, and mine elect shall long enjoy the work of their hands.

entries.yo: Nwọn kì yio ṣiṣẹ lasan, nwọn kì yio bimọ fun wahala: nitori awọn ni iru alabukun Oluwa ati iru-ọmọ wọn pẹlu wọn.
entries.en: They shall not labour in vain, nor bring forth for trouble; for they are the seed of the blessed of the LORD, and their offspring with them.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, pe, ki nwọn ki o to pè, emi o dahùn; ati bi nwọn ba ti nsọ̀rọ lọwọ, emi o gbọ́.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass, that before they call, I will answer; and while they are yet speaking, I will hear.

entries.yo: Ikõko ati ọdọ-agutan yio jumọ jẹ pọ̀, kiniun yio si jẹ koriko bi akọ-mãlu: erupẹ ni yio jẹ onjẹ ejò. Nwọn kì yio panilara, tabi ki nwọn panirun ni gbogbo oke mimọ́ mi, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: The wolf and the lamb shall feed together, and the lion shall eat straw like the bullock: and dust shall be the serpent's meat. They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: BAYI ni Oluwa wi, pe, Ọrun ni itẹ́ mi, aiye si ni apoti itisẹ̀ mi: nibo ni ile ti ẹ kọ́ fun mi gbé wà? ati nibo ni isimi mi gbe wà?
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD, The heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool: where is the house that ye build unto me? and where is the place of my rest?

entries.yo: Nitori gbogbo nkan wọnni li ọwọ́ mi sa ti ṣe, gbogbo nkan wọnni si ti wà, li Oluwa wi: ṣugbọn eleyi li emi o wò, ani òtoṣi ati oniròbinujẹ ọkàn, ti o si nwarìri si ọ̀rọ mi.
entries.en: For all those things hath mine hand made, and those things have been, saith the LORD: but to this man will I look, even to him that is poor and of a contrite spirit, and trembleth at my word.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o pa akọ-malu, o dabi ẹnipe o pa enia; ẹniti o fi ọdọ-agutan rubọ, a dabi ẹnipe o bẹ́ ajá lọrùn; ẹniti o rubọ ọrẹ, bi ẹnipe o fi ẹ̀jẹ ẹlẹdẹ̀ rubọ; ẹniti o fi turari jona, bi ẹniti o sure fun òriṣa. Nitotọ, nwọn ti yàn ọ̀na ara wọn, inu wọn si dùn si ohun iríra wọn.
entries.en: He that killeth an ox is as if he slew a man; he that sacrificeth a lamb, as if he cut off a dog's neck; he that offereth an oblation, as if he offered swine's blood; he that burneth incense, as if he blessed an idol. Yea, they have chosen their own ways, and their soul delighteth in their abominations.

entries.yo: Emi pẹlu yio yàn itanjẹ wọn, emi o si mu eyi ti nwọn bẹ̀ru wá sara wọn, nitori nigbati mo pè, kò si ẹnikan ti o dahùn; nigbati mo sọ̀rọ, nwọn kò gbọ́: ṣugbọn nwọn ṣe buburu niwaju mi, nwọn si yàn eyiti inu mi kò dùn si.
entries.en: I also will choose their delusions, and will bring their fears upon them; because when I called, none did answer; when I spake, they did not hear: but they did evil before mine eyes, and chose that in which I delighted not.

entries.yo: Ẹ gbọ́ ọ̀rọ Oluwa, ẹnyin ti o nwarìri si ọ̀rọ rẹ̀; Awọn arakunrin nyin ti nwọn korira nyin, ti nwọn ta nyin nù nitori orukọ mi, wipe, Jẹ ki a fi ogo fun Oluwa: ṣugbọn on o fi ara hàn fun ayọ̀ nyin, oju yio si tì awọn na.
entries.en: Hear the word of the LORD, ye that tremble at his word; your brethren that hated you, that cast you out for my name's sake, said, Let the LORD be glorified: but he shall appear to your joy, and they shall be ashamed.

entries.yo: Ohùn ariwo lati inu ilu wá, ohùn lati inu tempili wá, ohùn Oluwa ti nsan ẹ̀san fun awọn ọta rẹ̀.
entries.en: A voice of noise from the city, a voice from the temple, a voice of the LORD that rendereth recompence to his enemies.

entries.yo: Ki o to rọbi, o bimọ; ki irora rẹ̀ ki o to de, o bi ọmọkunrin kan.
entries.en: Before she travailed, she brought forth; before her pain came, she was delivered of a man child.

entries.yo: Tali o ti igbọ́ iru eyi ri? tali o ti iri irú eyi ri? Ilẹ le hù nkan jade li ọjọ kan bi? tabi a ha le bi orilẹ-ède ni ọjọ́ kan nã? nitori bi Sioni ti nrọbi gẹ, bẹ̃li o bi awọn ọmọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Who hath heard such a thing? who hath seen such things? Shall the earth be made to bring forth in one day? or shall a nation be born at once? for as soon as Zion travailed, she brought forth her children.

entries.yo: Emi o ha mu wá si irọbi, ki nmá si mu ki o bi? li Oluwa wi: emi o ha mu ni bi, ki nsi sé inu? li Ọlọrun rẹ wi.
entries.en: Shall I bring to the birth, and not cause to bring forth? saith the LORD: shall I cause to bring forth, and shut the womb? saith thy God.

entries.yo: Ẹ ba Jerusalemu yọ̀, ki inu nyin si dùn pẹlu rẹ̀, gbogbo ẹnyin ti o fẹ ẹ; ẹ ba a yọ̀ fun ayọ̀, gbogbo ẹnyin ti ngbãwẹ̀ fun u.
entries.en: Rejoice ye with Jerusalem, and be glad with her, all ye that love her: rejoice for joy with her, all ye that mourn for her:

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o le mu ọmú, ki a si fi ọmú itunu rẹ̀ tẹ́ nyin lọrùn; ki ẹnyin ki o ba le fun wàra, ki inu nyin ba sì le dùn si ọ̀pọlọpọ ogo rẹ̀.
entries.en: That ye may suck, and be satisfied with the breasts of her consolations; that ye may milk out, and be delighted with the abundance of her glory.

entries.yo: Nitori bayi li Oluwa wi, Kiyesi i, emi o nà alafia si i bi odò, ati ogo awọn Keferi bi odò ṣiṣàn: nigbana li ẹnyin o mu ọmú, a o dà nyin si ẹgbẹ́ rẹ̀, a o si ma gbe nyin jo lori ẽkún rẹ̀.
entries.en: For thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will extend peace to her like a river, and the glory of the Gentiles like a flowing stream: then shall ye suck, ye shall be borne upon her sides, and be dandled upon her knees.

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi ẹniti iya rẹ̀ ntù ninu, bẹ̃ni emi o tù nyin ninu; a o si tù nyin ninu ni Jerusalemu.
entries.en: As one whom his mother comforteth, so will I comfort you; and ye shall be comforted in Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Nigbati ẹnyin ba ri eyi, ọkàn nyin yio yọ̀, egungun nyin yio si tutu yọ̀yọ bi ewebẹ̀; a o si mọ̀ ọwọ́ Oluwa lara awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀, ati ibinu rẹ̀ si awọn ọta rẹ̀.
entries.en: And when ye see this, your heart shall rejoice, and your bones shall flourish like an herb: and the hand of the LORD shall be known toward his servants, and his indignation toward his enemies.

entries.yo: Nitori kiyesi i, Oluwa mbọ wá ti on ti iná, ati awọn kẹkẹ́ rẹ̀ bi ãjà, lati fi irunu sẹsan ibinu rẹ̀, ati ibawi rẹ̀ nipa ọwọ́ iná.
entries.en: For, behold, the LORD will come with fire, and with his chariots like a whirlwind, to render his anger with fury, and his rebuke with flames of fire.

entries.yo: Nitori Oluwa yio fi iná ati idà rẹ̀ ṣe idajọ gbogbo ẹran-ara; awọn okú Oluwa yio si pọ̀.
entries.en: For by fire and by his sword will the LORD plead with all flesh: and the slain of the LORD shall be many.

entries.yo: Awọn ti o yà ara wọn si mimọ́, ti nwọn si sọ ara wọn di mimọ́ ninu agbala wọnni, ti ọkan tẹle ekeji li ãrin, nwọn njẹ ẹran ẹlẹdẹ, ati ohun irira, ati eku, awọn li a o parun pọ̀; li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: They that sanctify themselves, and purify themselves in the gardens behind one tree in the midst, eating swine's flesh, and the abomination, and the mouse, shall be consumed together, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Nitori emi mọ̀ iṣẹ ati ìro wọn: igba na yio dé lati ṣà gbogbo awọn orilẹ-ède ati ahọn jọ, nwọn o si wá, nwọn o si ri ogo mi.
entries.en: For I know their works and their thoughts: it shall come, that I will gather all nations and tongues; and they shall come, and see my glory.

entries.yo: Emi o si fi àmi kan si ãrin wọn, emi o si rán awọn ti o salà ninu wọn si awọn orilẹ-ède, si Tarṣiṣi, Puli, ati Ludi, awọn ti nfà ọrun, si Tubali, on Jafani, si awọn erekuṣu ti o jina rére, ti nwọn kò ti igbọ́ okiki mi, ti nwọn kò si ti iri ogo mi; nwọn o si rohin ogo mi lãrin awọn Keferi.
entries.en: And I will set a sign among them, and I will send those that escape of them unto the nations, to Tarshish, Pul, and Lud, that draw the bow, to Tubal, and Javan, to the isles afar off, that have not heard my fame, neither have seen my glory; and they shall declare my glory among the Gentiles.

entries.yo: Nwọn o si mu gbogbo awọn arakunrin nyin lati orilẹ-ède gbogbo wá, ẹbọ kan si Oluwa lori ẹṣin, ati ninu kẹkẹ́, ati ninu páfa, ati lori ibaka, ati lori rakunmi, si Jerusalemu oke-nla mimọ́ mi; li Oluwa wi, gẹgẹ bi awọn ọmọ Israeli ti imu ọrẹ wá ninu ohun-elò mimọ́ sinu ile Oluwa.
entries.en: And they shall bring all your brethren for an offering unto the LORD out of all nations upon horses, and in chariots, and in litters, and upon mules, and upon swift beasts, to my holy mountain Jerusalem, saith the LORD, as the children of Israel bring an offering in a clean vessel into the house of the LORD.

entries.yo: Ninu wọn pẹlu li emi o si mu ṣe alufa ati Lefi; li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: And I will also take of them for priests and for Levites, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Nitori gẹgẹ bi awọn ọrun titun, ati aiye titun, ti emi o ṣe, yio ma duro niwaju mi, bẹ̃ni iru-ọmọ rẹ ati orukọ rẹ yio duro, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: For as the new heavens and the new earth, which I will make, shall remain before me, saith the LORD, so shall your seed and your name remain.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, gbogbo ẹran-ara yio si wá tẹriba niwaju mi, lati oṣù titun de oṣù titun, ati lati ọjọ isimi de ọjọ isimi, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass, that from one new moon to another, and from one sabbath to another, shall all flesh come to worship before me, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Nwọn o si jade lọ, nwọn o si wò okú awọn ti o ti ṣọtẹ si mi: nitori kokoro wọn kì yio kú, bẹ̃ni iná wọn kì yio si kú; nwọn o si jẹ ohun irira si gbogbo ẹran-ara.
entries.en: And they shall go forth, and look upon the carcases of the men that have transgressed against me: for their worm shall not die, neither shall their fire be quenched; and they shall be an abhorring unto all flesh.

entries.yo: Ọ̀RỌ Jeremiah, ọmọ Hilkiah, ọkan ninu awọn alufa ti o wà ni Anatoti, ni ilẹ Benjamini.
entries.en: The words of Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah, of the priests that were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin:

entries.yo: Ẹniti ọ̀rọ Oluwa tọ̀ wá ni igba ọjọ Josiah, ọmọ Amoni, ọba Juda, li ọdun kẹtala ijọba rẹ̀.
entries.en: To whom the word of the LORD came in the days of Josiah the son of Amon king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.

entries.yo: O si tọ̀ ọ wá pẹlu ni igba ọjọ Jehoiakimu, ọmọ Josiah, ọba Juda, titi de opin ọdun kọkanla Sedekiah, ọmọ Josiah, ọba Juda, ani de igba ti a kó Jerusalemu lọ ni igbekun li oṣu karun.
entries.en: It came also in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, unto the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah the son of Josiah king of Judah, unto the carrying away of Jerusalem captive in the fifth month.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ọ̀rọ Oluwa tọ̀ mi wá wipe:
entries.en: Then the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

entries.yo: Ki emi ki o to dá ọ ni inu, emi ti mọ̀ ọ, ki iwọ ki o si to ti inu jade wá li emi ti sọ ọ di mimọ́, emi si yà ọ sọtọ lati jẹ́ woli fun awọn orilẹ-ède.
entries.en: Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee; and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee, and I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations.

entries.yo: Emi si wipe, Oluwa Ọlọrun! sa wò o, emi kò mọ̀ ọ̀rọ isọ nitori ọmọde li emi.
entries.en: Then said I, Ah, Lord GOD! behold, I cannot speak: for I am a child.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Oluwa wi fun mi pe, má wipe, ọmọde li emi: ṣugbọn iwọ o lọ sọdọ ẹnikẹni ti emi o ran ọ si, ati ohunkohun ti emi o paṣẹ fun ọ ni iwọ o sọ.
entries.en: But the LORD said unto me, Say not, I am a child: for thou shalt go to all that I shall send thee, and whatsoever I command thee thou shalt speak.

entries.yo: Má bẹ̀ru niwaju wọn nitori emi wà pẹlu rẹ lati gbà ọ: li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: Be not afraid of their faces: for I am with thee to deliver thee, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Oluwa si nà ọwọ rẹ̀, o fi bà ẹnu mi; Oluwa si wi fun mi pe, sa wò o, emi fi ọ̀rọ mi si ọ li ẹnu.
entries.en: Then the LORD put forth his hand, and touched my mouth. And the LORD said unto me, Behold, I have put my words in thy mouth.

entries.yo: Wò o, li oni yi ni mo fi ọ ṣe olori awọn orilẹ-ède, ati olori ijọba wọnni, lati fàtu, ati lati fà lulẹ; lati parun, ati lati wó lulẹ; lati kọ́, ati lati gbìn.
entries.en: See, I have this day set thee over the nations and over the kingdoms, to root out, and to pull down, and to destroy, and to throw down, to build, and to plant.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ Oluwa si tọ̀ mi wá wipe, Jeremiah, kini iwọ ri? emi si wipe, mo ri ọpa igi almondi.
entries.en: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying, Jeremiah, what seest thou? And I said, I see a rod of an almond tree.

entries.yo: Oluwa si wi fun mi pe, iwọ riran rere, nitori ti emi o kiye si ọ̀rọ mi lati mu u ṣẹ.
entries.en: Then said the LORD unto me, Thou hast well seen: for I will hasten my word to perform it.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ Oluwa si tọ̀ mi wá lẹ̃keji pe, kini iwọ ri? emi si wipe, mo ri ìkoko ori iná, oju rẹ̀ si ni lati iha ariwa wá.
entries.en: And the word of the LORD came unto me the second time, saying, What seest thou? And I said, I see a seething pot; and the face thereof is toward the north.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Oluwa sọ fun mi pe, ibi yio tú jade lati ariwa wá, sori gbogbo awọn ti ngbe inu ilẹ.
entries.en: Then the LORD said unto me, Out of the north an evil shall break forth upon all the inhabitants of the land.

entries.yo: Sa wò o, Emi o pè gbogbo idile awọn ijọba ariwa, li Oluwa wi, nwọn o si wá: olukuluku wọn o si tẹ́ itẹ rẹ̀ li ẹnu-bode Jerusalemu, ati lori gbogbo odi rẹ̀ yikakiri, ati lori gbogbo ilu Juda.
entries.en: For, lo, I will call all the families of the kingdoms of the north, saith the LORD; and they shall come, and they shall set every one his throne at the entering of the gates of Jerusalem, and against all the walls thereof round about, and against all the cities of Judah.

entries.yo: Emi o si sọ̀rọ idajọ mi si wọn nitori gbogbo buburu wọn; ti nwọn ti kọ̀ mi silẹ, ti nwọn ti sun turari fun ọlọrun miran, ti nwọn si tẹriba fun iṣẹ ọwọ wọn.
entries.en: And I will utter my judgments against them touching all their wickedness, who have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other gods, and worshipped the works of their own hands.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn iwọ di ẹ̀gbẹ́ rẹ li amure, ki o si dide, ki o si wi fun wọn gbogbo ohun ti emi o pa laṣẹ fun ọ, má fòya niwaju wọn, ki emi ki o má ba mu ọ dãmu niwaju wọn.
entries.en: Thou therefore gird up thy loins, and arise, and speak unto them all that I command thee: be not dismayed at their faces, lest I confound thee before them.

entries.yo: Sa wò o, loni ni mo fi ọ ṣe ilu-odi, ati ọwọ̀n irin, ati odi idẹ fun gbogbo ilẹ; fun awọn ọba Juda, awọn ijoye rẹ̀, awọn alufa, ati enia ilẹ na.
entries.en: For, behold, I have made thee this day a defenced city, and an iron pillar, and brasen walls against the whole land, against the kings of Judah, against the princes thereof, against the priests thereof, and against the people of the land.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nwọn o ba ọ jà, nwọn kì o si le bori rẹ; nitori emi wà pẹlu rẹ, li Oluwa wi, lati gbà ọ.
entries.en: And they shall fight against thee; but they shall not prevail against thee; for I am with thee, saith the LORD, to deliver thee.

entries.yo: Ọ̀RỌ Oluwa si tọ̀ mi wá wipe,
entries.en: Moreover the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

entries.yo: Lọ, ki o si ke li eti Jerusalemu wipe, Bayi li Oluwa wi, Emi ranti rẹ, iṣeun igbà ọmọde rẹ, ifẹ igbeyawo rẹ, nigbati iwọ tẹle mi ni iju, ni ilẹ ti a kì igbin si.
entries.en: Go and cry in the ears of Jerusalem, saying, Thus saith the LORD; I remember thee, the kindness of thy youth, the love of thine espousals, when thou wentest after me in the wilderness, in a land that was not sown.

entries.yo: Mimọ́ ni Israeli fun Oluwa, akọso eso oko rẹ̀, ẹnikẹni ti o fi jẹ yio jẹbi; ibi yio si wá si ori wọn, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: Israel was holiness unto the LORD, and the firstfruits of his increase: all that devour him shall offend; evil shall come upon them, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Ẹ gbọ́ ọ̀rọ Oluwa, ẹnyin ara-ile Jakobu, ati gbogbo iran ile Israeli:
entries.en: Hear ye the word of the LORD, O house of Jacob, and all the families of the house of Israel:

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa wi: Aiṣedede wo li awọn baba nyin ri lọwọ mi ti nwọn lọ jina kuro lọdọ mi, ti nwọn si tẹle asan, ti nwọn si di enia asan?
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD, What iniquity have your fathers found in me, that they are gone far from me, and have walked after vanity, and are become vain?

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni nwọn kò si wipe, nibo li Oluwa wà? ti o mu wa goke lati ilẹ Egipti wá, ti o mu wa rìn ninu iju, ninu ilẹ pẹtẹlẹ ati ihò, ninu ilẹ gbigbẹ ati ojiji ikú, ninu ilẹ ti enia kò là kọja, ati nibiti enia kò tẹdo si.
entries.en: Neither said they, Where is the LORD that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, that led us through the wilderness, through a land of deserts and of pits, through a land of drought, and of the shadow of death, through a land that no man passed through, and where no man dwelt?

entries.yo: Emi si mu nyin wá si ilẹ ọgba-eso, lati jẹ eso rẹ̀ ati ire rẹ̀; ṣugbọn ẹnyin wọ inu rẹ̀, ẹ si ba ilẹ mi jẹ, ẹ si sọ ogún mi di ohun irira:
entries.en: And I brought you into a plentiful country, to eat the fruit thereof and the goodness thereof; but when ye entered, ye defiled my land, and made mine heritage an abomination.

entries.yo: Awọn alufa kò wipe, Nibo li Oluwa wà? ati awọn ti o mu ofin lọwọ kò mọ̀ mi: awọn oluṣọ si ṣẹ̀ si mi, ati awọn woli sọ asọtẹlẹ nipa Baali, nwọn si tẹle ohun ti kò lerè.
entries.en: The priests said not, Where is the LORD? and they that handle the law knew me not: the pastors also transgressed against me, and the prophets prophesied by Baal, and walked after things that do not profit.

entries.yo: Nitorina, Emi o ba nyin jà, li Oluwa wi, Emi o si ba atọmọde-ọmọ nyin jà.
entries.en: Wherefore I will yet plead with you, saith the LORD, and with your children's children will I plead.

entries.yo: Njẹ, ẹ kọja lọ si erekuṣu awọn ara Kittimu, ki ẹ si wò, si ranṣẹ lọ si Kedari, ki ẹ si ṣe akiyesi gidigidi, ki ẹ wò bi iru nkan yi ba mbẹ nibẹ?
entries.en: For pass over the isles of Chittim, and see; and send unto Kedar, and consider diligently, and see if there be such a thing.

entries.yo: Orilẹ-ède kan ha pa ọlọrun rẹ̀ dà? sibẹ awọn wọnyi kì iṣe ọlọrun! ṣugbọn enia mi ti yi ogo wọn pada fun eyiti kò lerè.
entries.en: Hath a nation changed their gods, which are yet no gods? but my people have changed their glory for that which doth not profit.

entries.yo: Ki ẹnu ki o ya ọrun nitori eyi, ki o si dãmu, ki o si di gbigbẹ, li Oluwa wi!
entries.en: Be astonished, O ye heavens, at this, and be horribly afraid, be ye very desolate, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Nitori awọn enia mi ṣe ibi meji: nwọn fi Emi, isun omi-ìye silẹ, nwọn si wà kanga omi fun ara wọn, kanga fifọ́ ti kò le da omi duro.
entries.en: For my people have committed two evils; they have forsaken me the fountain of living waters, and hewed them out cisterns, broken cisterns, that can hold no water.

entries.yo: Ẹrú ni Israeli iṣe bi? tabi ẹru ibile? ẽṣe ti o fi di ijẹ.
entries.en: Is Israel a servant? is he a homeborn slave? why is he spoiled?

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ kiniun ke ramuramu lori rẹ̀, nwọn si bú, nwọn si sọ ilẹ rẹ̀ di ahoro, ilu rẹ̀ li a fi jona li aini olugbe.
entries.en: The young lions roared upon him, and yelled, and they made his land waste: his cities are burned without inhabitant.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ Nofi ati ti Tafanesi pẹlu ti jẹ agbari rẹ;
entries.en: Also the children of Noph and Tahapanes have broken the crown of thy head.

entries.yo: Fifi Oluwa ọlọrun rẹ silẹ kọ́ ha mu eyi ba ọ, nigbati o tọ́ ọ loju ọ̀na?
entries.en: Hast thou not procured this unto thyself, in that thou hast forsaken the LORD thy God, when he led thee by the way?

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi kíni iwọ ni iṣe ni ipa-ọ̀na Egipti, lati mu omi Sihori? tabi kini iwọ ni iṣe ni ipa-ọ̀na Assiria lati mu omi odò rẹ̀.
entries.en: And now what hast thou to do in the way of Egypt, to drink the waters of Sihor? or what hast thou to do in the way of Assyria, to drink the waters of the river?

entries.yo: Ìwa-buburu rẹ ni yio kọ́ ọ, ipadasẹhin rẹ ni yio si ba ọ wi: mọ̀, ki iwọ si ri i pe, ohun buburu ati kikoro ni, pe, iwọ ti kò Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ, ati pe ìbẹru mi kò si si niwaju rẹ; li Oluwa Ọlọrun awọn ọmọ-ogun wi.
entries.en: Thine own wickedness shall correct thee, and thy backslidings shall reprove thee: know therefore and see that it is an evil thing and bitter, that thou hast forsaken the LORD thy God, and that my fear is not in thee, saith the Lord GOD of hosts.

entries.yo: Nitori ni igba atijọ iwọ ti ṣẹ́ ajaga ọrun rẹ, iwọ si já idè rẹ; iwọ si wipe, Emi kì o sìn, nitori lori oke giga gbogbo, ati labẹ igi tutu gbogbo ni iwọ nṣe panṣaga.
entries.en: For of old time I have broken thy yoke, and burst thy bands; and thou saidst, I will not transgress; when upon every high hill and under every green tree thou wanderest, playing the harlot.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi ti gbin ọ ni ajara ọlọla, irugbin rere patapata: ẽṣe ti iwọ fi yipada di ẹka ajara ajeji si mi?
entries.en: Yet I had planted thee a noble vine, wholly a right seed: how then art thou turned into the degenerate plant of a strange vine unto me?

entries.yo: Nitori iwọ iba wẹ ara rẹ ni ẽru, ki o si mu ọṣẹ pupọ, ẽri ni ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ niwaju mi sibẹsibẹ, li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi.
entries.en: For though thou wash thee with nitre, and take thee much soap, yet thine iniquity is marked before me, saith the Lord GOD.

entries.yo: Bawo li o ṣe wipe, emi kò ṣe alaimọ́, emi kò tọpa Baalimu? wò ọ̀na rẹ li afonifoji, mọ̀ ohun ti iwọ ti ṣe, iwọ dabi abo ibakasiẹ ayasẹ̀ ti nrin ọ̀na rẹ̀ ka.
entries.en: How canst thou say, I am not polluted, I have not gone after Baalim? see thy way in the valley, know what thou hast done: thou art a swift dromedary traversing her ways;

entries.yo: Kẹtẹkẹtẹ igbẹ ti ima gbe aginju, ninu ifẹ ọkàn rẹ̀ ti nfa ẹfufu, li akoko rẹ̀, tani le yi i pada? gbogbo awọn ti nwá a kiri kì yio da ara wọn li agara, nwọn o ri i li oṣu rẹ̀.
entries.en: A wild ass used to the wilderness, that snuffeth up the wind at her pleasure; in her occasion who can turn her away? all they that seek her will not weary themselves; in her month they shall find her.

entries.yo: Da ẹsẹ̀ rẹ duro ni aiwọ bàta, ati ọfun rẹ ninu ongbẹ: ṣugbọn iwọ wipe, lasan ni! bẹ̃kọ, nitoriti emi ti fẹ awọn alejo, awọn li emi o tọ̀ lẹhin.
entries.en: Withhold thy foot from being unshod, and thy throat from thirst: but thou saidst, There is no hope: no; for I have loved strangers, and after them will I go.

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi oju ti itì ole nigbati a ba mu u, bẹ̃li oju tì ile Israeli; awọn ọba wọn, ijoye wọn, alufa wọn, ati woli wọn pẹlu.
entries.en: As the thief is ashamed when he is found, so is the house of Israel ashamed; they, their kings, their princes, and their priests, and their prophets,

entries.yo: Ti nwọn wi fun igi pe, Iwọ ni baba mi; ati fun okuta pe, iwọ li o bi mi. Nitori nwọn ti yi ẹ̀hìn wọn pada si mi kì iṣe iwaju wọn: ṣugbọn ni igba ipọnju wọn, nwọn o wipe, Dide, ki o gbani.
entries.en: Saying to a stock, Thou art my father; and to a stone, Thou hast brought me forth: for they have turned their back unto me, and not their face: but in the time of their trouble they will say, Arise, and save us.

entries.yo: Njẹ nibo li awọn ọlọrun rẹ wà, ti iwọ ti da fun ara rẹ? jẹ ki nwọn ki o dide, bi nwọn ba le gba ọ nigba ipọnju rẹ, nitori bi iye ilu rẹ, bẹ̃li ọlọrun rẹ, iwọ Juda.
entries.en: But where are thy gods that thou hast made thee? let them arise, if they can save thee in the time of thy trouble: for according to the number of thy cities are thy gods, O Judah.

entries.yo: Ẽṣe ti ẹnyin o ba mi jà? gbogbo nyin li o ti rufin mi, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: Wherefore will ye plead with me? ye all have transgressed against me, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Lasan ni mo lù ọmọ nyin, nwọn kò gbà ibawi, idà ẹnyin tikara nyin li o pa awọn woli bi kiniun apanirun.
entries.en: In vain have I smitten your children; they received no correction: your own sword hath devoured your prophets, like a destroying lion.

entries.yo: Iran enia yi, ẹ kiyesi ọ̀rọ Oluwa. Emi ha ti di aginju si Israeli bi? tabi ilẹ okunkun biribiri, ẽṣe ti enia mi wipe, awa nrin kakiri, awa kì yio tọ̀ ọ wá mọ.
entries.en: O generation, see ye the word of the LORD. Have I been a wilderness unto Israel? a land of darkness? wherefore say my people, We are lords; we will come no more unto thee?

entries.yo: Wundia le gbagbe ohun ọṣọ rẹ̀, tabi iyawo ọjá-ọṣọ rẹ̀? ṣugbọn enia mi ti gbagbe mi li ọjọ ti kò ni iye.
entries.en: Can a maid forget her ornaments, or a bride her attire? yet my people have forgotten me days without number.

entries.yo: Ẽṣe ti iwọ tun ọ̀na rẹ ṣe lati wá ifẹ rẹ? nitorina iwọ ṣe kọ́ awọn obinrin buburu li ọ̀na rẹ.
entries.en: Why trimmest thou thy way to seek love? therefore hast thou also taught the wicked ones thy ways.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu ẹjẹ ẹmi awọn talaka ati alaiṣẹ mbẹ lara aṣọ rẹ, iwọ kò ri wọn nibi irunlẹ wọle, ṣugbọn lara gbogbo wọnyi.
entries.en: Also in thy skirts is found the blood of the souls of the poor innocents: I have not found it by secret search, but upon all these.

entries.yo: Sibẹ iwọ wipe, alaiṣẹ̀ li emi, ibinu rẹ̀ yio sa yipada lọdọ mi. Sa wò o, emi o ba ọ jà, nitori iwọ wipe, emi kò ṣẹ̀.
entries.en: Yet thou sayest, Because I am innocent, surely his anger shall turn from me. Behold, I will plead with thee, because thou sayest, I have not sinned.

entries.yo: Ẽṣe ti iwọ ṣe ati yi ọ̀na rẹ pada bẹ̃, oju yio tì ọ pẹlu fun Egipti, gẹgẹ bi oju ti tì ọ fun Assiria.
entries.en: Why gaddest thou about so much to change thy way? thou also shalt be ashamed of Egypt, as thou wast ashamed of Assyria.

entries.yo: Lõtọ iwọ o kuro lọdọ rẹ̀, iwọ o si ka ọwọ le ori, nitori Oluwa ti kọ̀ awọn onigbẹkẹle rẹ, iwọ kì yio si ṣe rere ninu wọn.
entries.en: Yea, thou shalt go forth from him, and thine hands upon thine head: for the LORD hath rejected thy confidences, and thou shalt not prosper in them.

entries.yo: SA wò o, bi a wipe ọkunrin kan kọ̀ aya rẹ̀ silẹ, ti aya na si kuro lọdọ rẹ̀, ti o si di aya ẹlomiran, ọkunrin na le tun tọ̀ ọ wá? ilẹ na kì yio di ibajẹ gidigidi? ṣugbọn iwọ ti ba ayanfẹ pupọ ṣe panṣaga, iwọ o tun tọ̀ mi wá! li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: They say, If a man put away his wife, and she go from him, and become another man's, shall he return unto her again? shall not that land be greatly polluted? but thou hast played the harlot with many lovers; yet return again to me, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Gbe oju rẹ soke si ibi giga wọnnì, ki o si wò, nibo ni a kò ti bà ọ jẹ? Iwọ joko de wọn li oju ọ̀na, bi ara Arabia kan ni iju, iwọ si ti fi agbere ati ìwa buburu rẹ bà ilẹ na jẹ.
entries.en: Lift up thine eyes unto the high places, and see where thou hast not been lien with. In the ways hast thou sat for them, as the Arabian in the wilderness; and thou hast polluted the land with thy whoredoms and with thy wickedness.

entries.yo: Nitorina emi fa ọ̀wara òjo sẹhin, kò si òjo arọkuro, sibẹ iwọ ni iwaju agbere, iwọ kọ̀ lati tiju.
entries.en: Therefore the showers have been withholden, and there hath been no latter rain; and thou hadst a whore's forehead, thou refusedst to be ashamed.

entries.yo: Lõtọ lati isisiyi, iwọ kì yio ha pè mi pe, Baba mi! iwọ li ayanfẹ ìgba-ewe mi?
entries.en: Wilt thou not from this time cry unto me, My father, thou art the guide of my youth?

entries.yo: On o ha pa ibinu rẹ̀ mọ lailai? yio pa a mọ de opin? sa wò o, bayi ni iwọ ti wi, ṣugbọn iwọ ṣe ohun buburu li aidẹkun.
entries.en: Will he reserve his anger for ever? will he keep it to the end? Behold, thou hast spoken and done evil things as thou couldest.

entries.yo: Oluwa si wi fun mi ni igba Josiah ọba, pe, Iwọ ri ohun ti Israeli apẹhinda ti ṣe? o ti gun ori oke giga gbogbo, ati labẹ gbogbo igi tutu, nibẹ li o ti ṣe panṣaga.
entries.en: The LORD said also unto me in the days of Josiah the king, Hast thou seen that which backsliding Israel hath done? she is gone up upon every high mountain and under every green tree, and there hath played the harlot.

entries.yo: Emi si wipe, lẹhin ti o ti ṣe gbogbo ohun wọnyi tan, yio yipada si mi, ṣugbọn kò yipada, Juda alarekereke arabinrin rẹ̀ si ri i.
entries.en: And I said after she had done all these things, Turn thou unto me. But she returned not. And her treacherous sister Judah saw it.

entries.yo: Emi si wò pe, nitori gbogbo wọnyi ti Israeli apẹhinda ti ṣe agbere, ti mo kọ̀ ọ silẹ ti emi si fun u ni iwe-ikọsilẹ, sibẹ Juda, alarekereke arabinrin rẹ̀, kò bẹ̀ru, o si nṣe agbere lọ pẹlu.
entries.en: And I saw, when for all the causes whereby backsliding Israel committed adultery I had put her away, and given her a bill of divorce; yet her treacherous sister Judah feared not, but went and played the harlot also.

entries.yo: O si ṣe nitori okìki àgbere rẹ̀ li o fi bà ilẹ jẹ, ti o si ṣe àgbere tọ̀ okuta ati igi lọ.
entries.en: And it came to pass through the lightness of her whoredom, that she defiled the land, and committed adultery with stones and with stocks.

entries.yo: Lẹhin gbogbo wọnyi, sibẹ Juda, alarekereke arabinrin rẹ̀, kò yipada si mi tọkàntọkàn ṣugbọn li agabagebe; li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: And yet for all this her treacherous sister Judah hath not turned unto me with her whole heart, but feignedly, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Oluwa si wi fun mi pe, Israeli apẹhinda, ti dá ara rẹ̀ li are ju Juda alarekereke lọ.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto me, The backsliding Israel hath justified herself more than treacherous Judah.

entries.yo: Lọ ki o si kede ọ̀rọ wọnyi ni iha ariwa, ki o si wipe, Yipada iwọ Israeli, apẹhinda, li Oluwa wi, emi kì yio jẹ ki oju mi ki o korò si ọ; nitori emi ni ãnu, li Oluwa wi, emi kì o si pa ibinu mi mọ titi lai.
entries.en: Go and proclaim these words toward the north, and say, Return, thou backsliding Israel, saith the LORD; and I will not cause mine anger to fall upon you: for I am merciful, saith the LORD, and I will not keep anger for ever.

entries.yo: Sa jẹwọ ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ pe, iwọ ti ṣẹ̀ si Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ, ati pe, o si tú ọ̀na rẹ ka fun awọn alejo labẹ igi tutu gbogbo, ṣugbọn ẹnyin kò gba ohùn mi gbọ́, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: Only acknowledge thine iniquity, that thou hast transgressed against the LORD thy God, and hast scattered thy ways to the strangers under every green tree, and ye have not obeyed my voice, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Pada, ẹnyin apẹhinda ọmọ, li Oluwa wi, nitori emi gbe nyin ni iyawo; emi o si mu nyin, ọkan ninu ilu kan, ati meji ninu idile kan; emi o si mu nyin wá si Sioni.
entries.en: Turn, O backsliding children, saith the LORD; for I am married unto you: and I will take you one of a city, and two of a family, and I will bring you to Zion:

entries.yo: Emi o si fun nyin li oluṣọ-agutan gẹgẹ bi ti inu mi, ti yio fi ìmọ ati oye bọ́ nyin.
entries.en: And I will give you pastors according to mine heart, which shall feed you with knowledge and understanding.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe nigbati ẹnyin ba pọ̀ si i, ti ẹ si dàgba ni ilẹ na, li ọjọ wọnnì, li Oluwa wi; nwọn kì yio si tun le wipe, Apoti-ẹri majẹmu Oluwa; bẹ̃ni kì yio wọ inu wọn, nwọn kì yio si ranti rẹ̀, nwọn kì yio tọ̀ ọ wá pẹlu, bẹ̃ni a kì yio si tun ṣe e mọ.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass, when ye be multiplied and increased in the land, in those days, saith the LORD, they shall say no more, The ark of the covenant of the LORD: neither shall it come to mind: neither shall they remember it; neither shall they visit it; neither shall that be done any more.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni nwọn o pè Jerusalemu ni itẹ Oluwa; gbogbo orilẹ-ède yio kọja tọ̀ ọ wá si orukọ Oluwa, si Jerusalemu, bẹ̃ni nwọn kì yio rìn mọ nipa agidi ọkàn buburu wọn,
entries.en: At that time they shall call Jerusalem the throne of the LORD; and all the nations shall be gathered unto it, to the name of the LORD, to Jerusalem: neither shall they walk any more after the imagination of their evil heart.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ wọnnì, ile Juda yio rin pẹlu ile Israeli, nwọn o jumọ wá lati ilẹ ariwa, si ilẹ ti emi ti fi fun awọn baba nyin li ogún.
entries.en: In those days the house of Judah shall walk with the house of Israel, and they shall come together out of the land of the north to the land that I have given for an inheritance unto your fathers.

entries.yo: Emi si wipe, Bawo li emi o ṣe gbe ọ kalẹ pẹlu awọn ọmọ, ati lati fun ọ ni ilẹ ayanfẹ, ogún daradara, ani ogún awọn orilẹ-ède? Emi si wipe, Iwọ o pè mi ni, Baba mi! iwọ kì o si pada kuro lọdọ mi.
entries.en: But I said, How shall I put thee among the children, and give thee a pleasant land, a goodly heritage of the hosts of nations? and I said, Thou shalt call me, My father; and shalt not turn away from me.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ gẹgẹ bi aya ti ifi arekereke lọ kuro lọdọ ọkọ rẹ̀, bẹ̃ni ẹnyin ti hùwa arekereke si mi, iwọ ile Israeli: li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: Surely as a wife treacherously departeth from her husband, so have ye dealt treacherously with me, O house of Israel, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: A gbọ́ ohùn kan lori ibi giga, ẹkun, ani ẹ̀bẹ awọn ọmọ Israeli pe: nwọn ti bà ọ̀na wọn jẹ, nwọn si ti gbagbe Oluwa, Ọlọrun wọn.
entries.en: A voice was heard upon the high places, weeping and supplications of the children of Israel: for they have perverted their way, and they have forgotten the LORD their God.

entries.yo: Yipada, ẹnyin ọmọ apẹhinda, emi o si wò ipẹhinda nyin sàn; Sa wò o, awa tọ̀ ọ wá, nitori iwọ li Oluwa Ọlọrun wa!
entries.en: Return, ye backsliding children, and I will heal your backslidings. Behold, we come unto thee; for thou art the LORD our God.

entries.yo: Lotitọ asan ni eyi ti o ti oke wá, ani ọ̀pọlọpọ oke giga, lõtọ ninu Oluwa Ọlọrun wa ni igbala Israeli wà.
entries.en: Truly in vain is salvation hoped for from the hills, and from the multitude of mountains: truly in the LORD our God is the salvation of Israel.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ohun itiju oriṣa ti jẹ ère iṣẹ awọn baba wa lati igba ewe wa wá, ọwọ́-ẹran wọn ati agbo-ẹran wọn, pẹlu ọmọkunrin ati ọmọbinrin wọn.
entries.en: For shame hath devoured the labour of our fathers from our youth; their flocks and their herds, their sons and their daughters.

entries.yo: Awa dubulẹ ninu itiju wa, rudurudu wa bò wa mọlẹ, nitoriti awa ti ṣẹ̀ si Oluwa Ọlọrun wa, awa pẹlu awọn baba wa, lati igba ewe wa wá, titi di oni yi, awa kò gba ohùn Oluwa Ọlọrun wa gbọ́.
entries.en: We lie down in our shame, and our confusion covereth us: for we have sinned against the LORD our God, we and our fathers, from our youth even unto this day, and have not obeyed the voice of the LORD our God.

entries.yo: Israeli bi iwọ o ba yipada, li Oluwa wi, yipada sọdọ mi; ati bi iwọ o ba mu irira rẹ kuro niwaju mi, iwọ kì o si rìn kiri:
entries.en: If thou wilt return, O Israel, saith the LORD, return unto me: and if thou wilt put away thine abominations out of my sight, then shalt thou not remove.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si bura pe, Oluwa mbẹ ni otitọ, ni idajọ, ati ni ododo; ati nipasẹ rẹ̀ ni gbogbo orilẹ-ède yio fi ibukun fun ara wọn, nwọn o si ṣe ogo ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And thou shalt swear, The LORD liveth, in truth, in judgment, and in righteousness; and the nations shall bless themselves in him, and in him shall they glory.

entries.yo: Nitori bayi li Oluwa wi fun awọn ọkunrin Juda, ati Jerusalemu pe, tú ilẹ titun fun ara nyin, ki ẹ má si gbìn lãrin ẹ̀gun.
entries.en: For thus saith the LORD to the men of Judah and Jerusalem, Break up your fallow ground, and sow not among thorns.

entries.yo: Ẹ kọ ara nyin ni ilà fun Oluwa, ki ẹ si mu awọ ikọla ọkàn nyin kuro, ẹnyin enia Juda ati olugbe Jerusalemu, ki ikannu mi ki o má ba jade bi iná, ki o si jo tobẹ̃ ti kò si ẹniti o le pa a, nitori buburu iṣe nyin.
entries.en: Circumcise yourselves to the LORD, and take away the foreskins of your heart, ye men of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem: lest my fury come forth like fire, and burn that none can quench it, because of the evil of your doings.

entries.yo: Ẹ kede ni Juda, ki ẹ si pokikí ni Jerusalemu; ki ẹ si wipe, ẹ fun fère ni ilẹ na, ẹ ké, ẹ kojọ pọ̀, ki ẹ si wipe; Pè apejọ ara nyin, ki ẹ si lọ si ilu olodi wọnnì.
entries.en: Declare ye in Judah, and publish in Jerusalem; and say, Blow ye the trumpet in the land: cry, gather together, and say, Assemble yourselves, and let us go into the defenced cities.

entries.yo: Ẹ gbé ọpagun soke siha Sioni; ẹ kuro, ẹ má duro: nitori emi o mu buburu lati ariwa wá pẹlu ibajẹ nlanla.
entries.en: Set up the standard toward Zion: retire, stay not: for I will bring evil from the north, and a great destruction.

entries.yo: Kiniun jade wá lati inu pantiri rẹ̀, ati olubajẹ awọn orilẹ-ède dide: o jade kuro ninu ipo rẹ̀ lati sọ ilẹ rẹ di ahoro; ati ilu rẹ di ofo, laini olugbe.
entries.en: The lion is come up from his thicket, and the destroyer of the Gentiles is on his way; he is gone forth from his place to make thy land desolate; and thy cities shall be laid waste, without an inhabitant.

entries.yo: Nitori eyi, di amure aṣọ ọ̀fọ, pohùnrere ki o si sọkun: nitori ibinu gbigbona Oluwa kò lọ kuro lọdọ wa.
entries.en: For this gird you with sackcloth, lament and howl: for the fierce anger of the LORD is not turned back from us.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe li ọjọ na, li Oluwa wi, ọkàn ọba yio nù, ati ọkàn awọn ijoye: awọn alufa yio si dãmu, hà yio si ṣe awọn woli.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass at that day, saith the LORD, that the heart of the king shall perish, and the heart of the princes; and the priests shall be astonished, and the prophets shall wonder.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni mo wipe, Ye! Oluwa Ọlọrun! nitõtọ iwọ ti tan awọn enia yi ati Jerusalemu jẹ gidigidi, wipe, Ẹnyin o ni alafia; nigbati idà wọ inu ọkàn lọ.
entries.en: Then said I, Ah, Lord GOD! surely thou hast greatly deceived this people and Jerusalem, saying, Ye shall have peace; whereas the sword reacheth unto the soul.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni a o wi fun awọn enia yi ati fun Jerusalemu pe, Ẹfũfu gbigbona lati ibi giga ni iju niha ọmọbinrin enia mi, kì iṣe lati fẹ, tabi lati fẹnù.
entries.en: At that time shall it be said to this people and to Jerusalem, A dry wind of the high places in the wilderness toward the daughter of my people, not to fan, nor to cleanse,

entries.yo: Ẹfũfu ti o lagbara jù wọnyi lọ yio fẹ fun mi: nisisiyi emi pẹlu yio sọ̀rọ idajọ si wọn.
entries.en: Even a full wind from those places shall come unto me: now also will I give sentence against them.

entries.yo: Sa wò o, on o dide bi awọsanma, kẹ̀kẹ rẹ̀ yio dabi ìji: ẹṣin rẹ̀ yara jù idì lọ. Egbe ni fun wa! nitori awa di ijẹ.
entries.en: Behold, he shall come up as clouds, and his chariots shall be as a whirlwind: his horses are swifter than eagles. Woe unto us! for we are spoiled.

entries.yo: Jerusalemu! wẹ ọkàn rẹ kuro ninu buburu, ki a ba le gba ọ là. Yio ti pẹ to ti iro asan yio wọ̀ si inu rẹ.
entries.en: O Jerusalem, wash thine heart from wickedness, that thou mayest be saved. How long shall thy vain thoughts lodge within thee?

entries.yo: Nitori ohùn kan kede lati Dani wá, o si pokiki ipọnju lati oke Efraimu.
entries.en: For a voice declareth from Dan, and publisheth affliction from mount Ephraim.

entries.yo: Ẹ wi fun awọn orilẹ-ède; sa wò o, kede si Jerusalemu, pe, awọn ọluṣọ-ogun ti ilẹ jijin wá, nwọn si sọ ohùn wọn jade si ilu Juda.
entries.en: Make ye mention to the nations; behold, publish against Jerusalem, that watchers come from a far country, and give out their voice against the cities of Judah.

entries.yo: Bi awọn ti nṣọ oko, bẹ̃ni nwọn wà yi i kakiri: nitori o ti ṣọtẹ̀ si mi, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: As keepers of a field, are they against her round about; because she hath been rebellious against me, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Ìwa rẹ ati iṣe rẹ li o ti mu gbogbo ohun wọnyi bá ọ; eyi ni buburu rẹ, nitoriti o korò, nitoriti o de ọkàn rẹ.
entries.en: Thy way and thy doings have procured these things unto thee; this is thy wickedness, because it is bitter, because it reacheth unto thine heart.

entries.yo: Inu mi, inu mi! ẹ̀dun dùn mi jalẹ de ọkàn mi; ọkàn mi npariwo ninu mi; emi kò le dakẹ, Nitoriti iwọ, ọkàn mi, ngbọ́ iro fère, ati idagiri ogun.
entries.en: My bowels, my bowels! I am pained at my very heart; my heart maketh a noise in me; I cannot hold my peace, because thou hast heard, O my soul, the sound of the trumpet, the alarm of war.

entries.yo: Iparun lori iparun ni a nke; nitori gbogbo ilẹ li o ti parun, lojiji ni agọ mi di ijẹ, pẹlu aṣọ ikele mi ni iṣẹju kan.
entries.en: Destruction upon destruction is cried; for the whole land is spoiled: suddenly are my tents spoiled, and my curtains in a moment.

entries.yo: Yio ti pẹ to ti emi o ri ọpagun, ti emi o si gbọ́ iro fère?
entries.en: How long shall I see the standard, and hear the sound of the trumpet?

entries.yo: Nitori òpe li enia mi, nwọn kò mọ̀ mi; alaimoye ọmọ ni nwọn iṣe, nwọn kò si ni ìmọ: nwọn ni ọgbọ́n lati ṣe ibi, ṣugbọn oye ati ṣe rere ni nwọn kò ni.
entries.en: For my people is foolish, they have not known me; they are sottish children, and they have none understanding: they are wise to do evil, but to do good they have no knowledge.

entries.yo: Mo bojuwo aiye, sa wò o, o wà ni jũju, o si ṣofo; ati ọrun, imọlẹ kò si lara rẹ̀.
entries.en: I beheld the earth, and, lo, it was without form, and void; and the heavens, and they had no light.

entries.yo: Mo bojuwo gbogbo oke nla, sa wò o, o warìri ati gbogbo oke kekere mì jẹjẹ.
entries.en: I beheld the mountains, and, lo, they trembled, and all the hills moved lightly.

entries.yo: Mo bojuwo, sa wò o, kò si enia kan, pẹlupẹlu gbogbo ẹiyẹ oju-ọrun sa lọ.
entries.en: I beheld, and, lo, there was no man, and all the birds of the heavens were fled.

entries.yo: Mo bojuwo, sa wò o, Karmeli di aginju, ati gbogbo ilu rẹ̀ li o wó lulẹ, niwaju Oluwa ati niwaju ibinu rẹ̀ gbigbona.
entries.en: I beheld, and, lo, the fruitful place was a wilderness, and all the cities thereof were broken down at the presence of the LORD, and by his fierce anger.

entries.yo: Nitori bayi li Oluwa wi pe: Gbogbo ilẹ ni yio di ahoro; ṣugbọn emi kì yio ṣe ipari tan.
entries.en: For thus hath the LORD said, The whole land shall be desolate; yet will I not make a full end.

entries.yo: Nitori eyi ni ilẹ yio ṣe kãnu, ati ọrun loke yio di dudu: nitori emi ti wi i, mo ti pete rẹ̀, emi kì o yi ọkàn da, bẹ̃ni kì o yipada kuro ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: For this shall the earth mourn, and the heavens above be black: because I have spoken it, I have purposed it, and will not repent, neither will I turn back from it.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ilu ni yio sá nitori ariwo awọn ẹlẹṣin ati awọn tafatafa; nwọn o sa lọ sinu igbo; nwọn o si gun ori oke okuta lọ, gbogbo ilu ni a o kọ̀ silẹ, ẹnikan kì yio gbe inu wọn.
entries.en: The whole city shall flee for the noise of the horsemen and bowmen; they shall go into thickets, and climb up upon the rocks: every city shall be forsaken, and not a man dwell therein.

entries.yo: Ati iwọ, ẹniti o di ijẹ tan, kini iwọ o ṣe? Iwọ iba wọ ara rẹ ni aṣọ òdodó, iwọ iba fi wura ṣe ara rẹ lọṣọ, iwọ iba fi tirõ kun oju rẹ: lasan ni iwọ o ṣe ara rẹ daradara, awọn ayanfẹ rẹ yio kọ̀ ọ silẹ, nwọn o wá ẹmi rẹ.
entries.en: And when thou art spoiled, what wilt thou do? Though thou clothest thyself with crimson, though thou deckest thee with ornaments of gold, though thou rentest thy face with painting, in vain shalt thou make thyself fair; thy lovers will despise thee, they will seek thy life.

entries.yo: Nitori mo ti gbọ́ ohùn kan bi ti obinrin ti nrọbi, irora bi obinrin ti nbi akọbi ọmọ rẹ̀, ohùn ọmọbinrin Sioni ti npohùnrere ẹkun ara rẹ̀, ti o nnà ọwọ rẹ̀ wipe: Egbé ni fun mi nisisiyi nitori ãrẹ mu mi li ọkàn, nitori awọn apania.
entries.en: For I have heard a voice as of a woman in travail, and the anguish as of her that bringeth forth her first child, the voice of the daughter of Zion, that bewaileth herself, that spreadeth her hands, saying, Woe is me now! for my soul is wearied because of murderers.

entries.yo: Ẹrìn kiri la ita Jerusalemu ja, ki ẹ si wò nisisiyi, ki ẹ si mọ̀, ki ẹ si wakiri nibi gbigbòro rẹ̀, bi ẹ ba lè ri ẹnikan, bi ẹnikan wà ti nṣe idajọ, ti o nwá otitọ; emi o si dari ji i.
entries.en: Run ye to and fro through the streets of Jerusalem, and see now, and know, and seek in the broad places thereof, if ye can find a man, if there be any that executeth judgment, that seeketh the truth; and I will pardon it.

entries.yo: Bi nwọn ba si wipe, Oluwa mbẹ; sibẹ nwọn bura eke.
entries.en: And though they say, The LORD liveth; surely they swear falsely.

entries.yo: Oluwa, oju rẹ kò ha wà lara otitọ? iwọ ti lù wọn, ṣugbọn kò dùn wọn; iwọ ti run wọn, ṣugbọn nwọn kọ̀ lati gba ẹkọ: nwọn ti mu oju wọn le jù apata lọ; nwọn kọ̀ lati yipada.
entries.en: O LORD, are not thine eyes upon the truth? thou hast stricken them, but they have not grieved; thou hast consumed them, but they have refused to receive correction: they have made their faces harder than a rock; they have refused to return.

entries.yo: Emi si wipe, Lõtọ talaka enia ni awọn wọnyi, nwọn kò ni oye, nitori nwọn kò mọ̀ ọ̀na Oluwa, tabi idajọ Ọlọrun wọn.
entries.en: Therefore I said, Surely these are poor; they are foolish: for they know not the way of the LORD, nor the judgment of their God.

entries.yo: Emi o tọ̀ awọn ẹni-nla lọ, emi o si ba wọn sọrọ; nitori nwọn ti mọ̀ ọ̀na Oluwa, idajọ Ọlọrun wọn. Ṣugbọn awọn wọnyi ti jumọ ṣẹ́ àjaga, nwọn si ti ja ìde.
entries.en: I will get me unto the great men, and will speak unto them; for they have known the way of the LORD, and the judgment of their God: but these have altogether broken the yoke, and burst the bonds.

entries.yo: Nitorina kiniun lati inu igbo wa yio pa wọn, ikõko aṣálẹ̀ yio pa wọn run, ẹkùn yio mã ṣọ ilu wọn: ẹnikẹni ti o ba ti ibẹ jade li a o ya pẹrẹpẹrẹ: nitori ẹ̀ṣẹ wọn pọ̀, ati ipẹhinda wọn le.
entries.en: Wherefore a lion out of the forest shall slay them, and a wolf of the evenings shall spoil them, a leopard shall watch over their cities: every one that goeth out thence shall be torn in pieces: because their transgressions are many, and their backslidings are increased.

entries.yo: Emi o ha ṣe dari eyi ji ọ? awọn ọmọ rẹ ti kọ̀ mi silẹ, nwọn si fi eyi ti kì iṣe ọlọrun bura: emi ti mu wọn bura, ṣugbọn nwọn ṣe panṣaga, nwọn si kó ara wọn jọ si ile àgbere.
entries.en: How shall I pardon thee for this? thy children have forsaken me, and sworn by them that are no gods: when I had fed them to the full, they then committed adultery, and assembled themselves by troops in the harlots' houses.

entries.yo: Nwọn jẹ akọ ẹṣin ti a bọ́ rere ti nrin kiri, olukuluku nwọn nyán si aya aladugbo rẹ̀.
entries.en: They were as fed horses in the morning: every one neighed after his neighbour's wife.

entries.yo: Emi kì yio ha ṣe ibẹwo nitori nkan wọnyi? li Oluwa wi, ẹmi mi kì yio ha gbẹsan lara iru orilẹ-ède bi eyi?
entries.en: Shall I not visit for these things? saith the LORD: and shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?

entries.yo: Ẹ goke lọ si ori odi rẹ̀, ki ẹ si parun; ṣugbọn ẹ máṣe pa a run tan: ẹ wó kùrùkúrù rẹ̀ kuro nitori nwọn kì iṣe ti Oluwa.
entries.en: Go ye up upon her walls, and destroy; but make not a full end: take away her battlements; for they are not the LORD's.

entries.yo: Nitori ile Israeli ati ile Juda ti huwa arekereke gidigidi si mi, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: For the house of Israel and the house of Judah have dealt very treacherously against me, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Nwọn sẹ Oluwa, wipe, Kì iṣe on, ibi kò ni wá si ori wa, awa kì yio si ri idà tabi ìyan:
entries.en: They have belied the LORD, and said, It is not he; neither shall evil come upon us; neither shall we see sword nor famine:

entries.yo: Awọn woli yio di ẹfufu, ọ̀rọ kò sì si ninu wọn: bayi li a o ṣe si wọn.
entries.en: And the prophets shall become wind, and the word is not in them: thus shall it be done unto them.

entries.yo: Nitorina bayi li Oluwa, Ọlọrun awọn ọmọ-ogun wi, nitori ẹnyin sọ ọ̀rọ yi, sa wò o, emi o sọ ọ̀rọ mi li ẹnu rẹ di iná, ati awọn enia yi di igi, yio si jo wọn run.
entries.en: Wherefore thus saith the LORD God of hosts, Because ye speak this word, behold, I will make my words in thy mouth fire, and this people wood, and it shall devour them.

entries.yo: Wò o emi o mu orilẹ-ède kan wá sori nyin lati ọ̀na jijin, ẹnyin ile Israeli, li Oluwa wi, orilẹ-ède alagbara ni, orilẹ-ède lati igbãni wá ni, orilẹ-ède ti iwọ kò mọ̀ ede rẹ̀, bẹ̃ni iwọ kò gbọ́ eyiti o nwi.
entries.en: Lo, I will bring a nation upon you from far, O house of Israel, saith the LORD: it is a mighty nation, it is an ancient nation, a nation whose language thou knowest not, neither understandest what they say.

entries.yo: Apó ọfa rẹ̀ dabi isa-okú ti a ṣi, akọni enia ni gbogbo wọn.
entries.en: Their quiver is as an open sepulchre, they are all mighty men.

entries.yo: On o si jẹ ikore rẹ ati onjẹ rẹ, nwọn o jẹ awọn ọmọkunrin ati awọn ọmọbinrin rẹ, nwọn o si jẹ agbo rẹ ati ọwọ́-ẹran rẹ, nwọn o jẹ àjara rẹ ati igi ọ̀pọtọ rẹ, nwọn o fi idà sọ ilu olodi rẹ ti iwọ gbẹkẹle di ahoro.
entries.en: And they shall eat up thine harvest, and thy bread, which thy sons and thy daughters should eat: they shall eat up thy flocks and thine herds: they shall eat up thy vines and thy fig trees: they shall impoverish thy fenced cities, wherein thou trustedst, with the sword.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn li ọjọ wọnnì, li Oluwa wi, emi kì yio ṣe iparun nyin patapata.
entries.en: Nevertheless in those days, saith the LORD, I will not make a full end with you.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, nigbati ẹnyin o wipe: Ẽṣe ti Oluwa Ọlọrun wa fi ṣe gbogbo ohun wọnyi si wa? nigbana ni iwọ o da wọn lohùn: Gẹgẹ bi ẹnyin ti kọ̀ mi, ti ẹnyin si nsìn ọlọrun ajeji ni ilẹ nyin, bẹ̃ni ẹnyin o sin alejo ni ilẹ ti kì iṣe ti nyin.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass, when ye shall say, Wherefore doeth the LORD our God all these things unto us? then shalt thou answer them, Like as ye have forsaken me, and served strange gods in your land, so shall ye serve strangers in a land that is not yours.

entries.yo: Kede eyi ni ile Jakobu, pokiki rẹ̀ ni Juda wipe,
entries.en: Declare this in the house of Jacob, and publish it in Judah, saying,

entries.yo: Ẹ gbọ́ eyi nisisiyi, ẹnyin aṣiwere enia ati alailọgbọ́n; ti o ni oju, ti kò si riran, ti o ni eti ti kò si gbọ́.
entries.en: Hear now this, O foolish people, and without understanding; which have eyes, and see not; which have ears, and hear not:

entries.yo: Ẹ kò ha bẹ̀ru mi; li Oluwa wi, ẹ kì yio warìri niwaju mi, ẹniti o fi yanrin ṣe ipãla okun, opin lailai ti kò le rekọja: ìgbì rẹ̀ kọlu u, kò si le bori rẹ̀, o pariwo, ṣugbọn kò lè re e kọja?
entries.en: Fear ye not me? saith the LORD: will ye not tremble at my presence, which have placed the sand for the bound of the sea by a perpetual decree, that it cannot pass it: and though the waves thereof toss themselves, yet can they not prevail; though they roar, yet can they not pass over it?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn enia yi ni aiya isàgun ati iṣọtẹ si, nwọn sọ̀tẹ, nwọn si lọ.
entries.en: But this people hath a revolting and a rebellious heart; they are revolted and gone.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni nwọn kò wi li ọkàn wọn pe, Ẹ jẹ ki a bẹ̀ru Oluwa Ọlọrun wa wayi, ẹniti o fun wa ni òjo akọrọ ati arọkuro ni igba rẹ̀: ti o fi ọ̀sẹ ikore ti a pinnu pamọ fun wa.
entries.en: Neither say they in their heart, Let us now fear the LORD our God, that giveth rain, both the former and the latter, in his season: he reserveth unto us the appointed weeks of the harvest.

entries.yo: Aiṣedede nyin ti yi gbogbo ohun wọnyi pada, ati ẹ̀ṣẹ nyin ti fà ohun rere sẹhin kuro lọdọ nyin.
entries.en: Your iniquities have turned away these things, and your sins have withholden good things from you.

entries.yo: Nitori lãrin enia mi ni a ri enia ìka, nwọn wò kakiri, bi biba ẹniti ndẹ ẹiyẹ, nwọn dẹ okùn nwọn mu enia.
entries.en: For among my people are found wicked men: they lay wait, as he that setteth snares; they set a trap, they catch men.

entries.yo: Bi àgo ti o kún fun ẹiyẹ, bẹ̃ni ile wọn kún fun ẹ̀tan, nitorina ni nwọn ṣe di nla, nwọn si di ọlọrọ̀.
entries.en: As a cage is full of birds, so are their houses full of deceit: therefore they are become great, and waxen rich.

entries.yo: Nwọn sanra, nwọn ndán, pẹlupẹlu nwọn rekọja ni ìwa-buburu, nwọn kò ṣe idajọ, nwọn kò dajọ ọ̀ran alainibaba, ki nwọn le ri rere; nwọn kò si dajọ are awọn talaka.
entries.en: They are waxen fat, they shine: yea, they overpass the deeds of the wicked: they judge not the cause, the cause of the fatherless, yet they prosper; and the right of the needy do they not judge.

entries.yo: Emi kì yio ha ṣe ibẹwò nitori nkan wọnyi, li Oluwa wi, ẹmi mi kì yio ha gbẹsan lori orilẹ-ède bi eyi?
entries.en: Shall I not visit for these things? saith the LORD: shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?

entries.yo: Ohun iyanu ati irira li a ṣe ni ilẹ na.
entries.en: A wonderful and horrible thing is committed in the land;

entries.yo: Awọn woli sọ asọtẹlẹ eke, ati awọn alufa ṣe akoso labẹ ọwọ wọn, awọn enia mi si fẹ ki o ri bẹ̃; kini ẹnyin o si ṣe ni igbẹhin rẹ̀?
entries.en: The prophets prophesy falsely, and the priests bear rule by their means; and my people love to have it so: and what will ye do in the end thereof?

entries.yo: ẸNYIN ọmọ Benjamini, ẹ ko ẹrù nyin salọ kuro li arin Jerusalemu, ẹ si fun fère ni Tekoa, ki ẹ si gbe àmi soke ni Bet-hakeremu, nitori ibi farahàn lati ariwa wá; ani iparun nlanla.
entries.en: O ye children of Benjamin, gather yourselves to flee out of the midst of Jerusalem, and blow the trumpet in Tekoa, and set up a sign of fire in Beth-haccerem: for evil appeareth out of the north, and great destruction.

entries.yo: Emi ti pa ọmọbinrin Sioni run, ti o ṣe ẹlẹgẹ ati ẹlẹwà.
entries.en: I have likened the daughter of Zion to a comely and delicate woman.

entries.yo: Awọn oluṣọ-agutan pẹlu agbo wọn yio tọ̀ ọ wá, nwọn o pa agọ wọn yi i ka olukuluku yio ma jẹ ni àgbegbe rẹ̀.
entries.en: The shepherds with their flocks shall come unto her; they shall pitch their tents against her round about; they shall feed every one in his place.

entries.yo: Ẹ ya ara nyin si mimọ́ lati ba a jagun; dide, ki ẹ si jẹ ki a goke li ọsan. Egbe ni fun wa! nitori ọjọ nlọ, nitori ojiji ọjọ alẹ nà jade.
entries.en: Prepare ye war against her; arise, and let us go up at noon. Woe unto us! for the day goeth away, for the shadows of the evening are stretched out.

entries.yo: Dide, ẹ jẹ ki a goke lọ li oru, ki a si pa ãfin rẹ̀ run.
entries.en: Arise, and let us go by night, and let us destroy her palaces.

entries.yo: Nitori bayi li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi, ke igi lulẹ, ki ẹ si wà yàra ka Jerusalemu; eyi ni ilu nla ti a o bẹ̀wo; kìki ininilara li o wà lãrin rẹ̀.
entries.en: For thus hath the LORD of hosts said, Hew ye down trees, and cast a mount against Jerusalem: this is the city to be visited; she is wholly oppression in the midst of her.

entries.yo: Bi isun ti itú omi rẹ̀ jade, bẹ̃ni o ntú ìwa-buburu rẹ̀ jade: ìwa-ipa ati ìka li a gbọ́ niwaju mi nigbagbogbo ninu rẹ̀, ani aisan ati ọgbẹ́.
entries.en: As a fountain casteth out her waters, so she casteth out her wickedness: violence and spoil is heard in her; before me continually is grief and wounds.

entries.yo: Gbọ́ ẹkọ́, Jerusalemu, ki ẹmi mi ki o má ba lọ kuro lọdọ rẹ; ki emi má ba sọ ọ di ahoro, ilẹ ti a kò gbe inu rẹ̀.
entries.en: Be thou instructed, O Jerusalem, lest my soul depart from thee; lest I make thee desolate, a land not inhabited.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi, jẹ ki nwọn ki o pẽṣẹ iyokù Israeli bi àjara: yi ọwọ rẹ pada bi aká-eso-ajara sinu agbọ̀n.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, They shall throughly glean the remnant of Israel as a vine: turn back thine hand as a grapegatherer into the baskets.

entries.yo: Tani emi o sọ fun, ti emi o kilọ fun ti nwọn o si gbọ́? sa wò o, eti wọn jẹ alaikọla, nwọn kò si le fi iye si i: sa wò o, ọ̀rọ Oluwa di ẹ̀gan si wọn, nwọn kò ni inu didùn ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: To whom shall I speak, and give warning, that they may hear? behold, their ear is uncircumcised, and they cannot hearken: behold, the word of the LORD is unto them a reproach; they have no delight in it.

entries.yo: Nitorina emi kún fun ikannu Oluwa, ãrẹ̀ mu mi lati pa a mọra: tu u jade sori ọmọde ni ita, ati sori ajọ awọn ọmọkunrin pẹlu: nitori a o mu bãle pẹlu aya rẹ̀ ni igbekun, arugbo pẹlu ẹniti o ni ọjọ kikún lori.
entries.en: Therefore I am full of the fury of the LORD; I am weary with holding in: I will pour it out upon the children abroad, and upon the assembly of young men together: for even the husband with the wife shall be taken, the aged with him that is full of days.

entries.yo: Ile wọn o di ti ẹlomiran, oko wọn ati aya wọn lakopọ̀: nitori emi o nà ọwọ mi si ori awọn olugbe ilẹ na, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: And their houses shall be turned unto others, with their fields and wives together: for I will stretch out my hand upon the inhabitants of the land, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Lati kekere wọn titi de nla wọn, gbogbo wọn li o fi ara wọn fun ojukokoro, ati lati woli titi de alufa, gbogbo wọn ni nṣe eke.
entries.en: For from the least of them even unto the greatest of them every one is given to covetousness; and from the prophet even unto the priest every one dealeth falsely.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ti wo ọgbẹ ọmọbinrin enia mi fẹrẹ̀; nwọn wipe, Alafia! Alafia! nigbati kò si alafia.
entries.en: They have healed also the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly, saying, Peace, peace; when there is no peace.

entries.yo: A mu itiju ba wọn, nitoriti nwọn ṣe ohun irira: sibẹ nwọn kò tiju kan pẹlu, pẹlupẹlu õru itiju kò mu wọn: nitorina nwọn o ṣubu lãrin awọn ti o ṣubu: nigbati emi ba bẹ̀ wọn wo, a o wó wọn lulẹ, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? nay, they were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush: therefore they shall fall among them that fall: at the time that I visit them they shall be cast down, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa wi, ẹ duro li oju ọ̀na, ki ẹ si wò, ki ẹ si bere oju-ọ̀na igbàni, ewo li ọ̀na didara, ki ẹ si rin nibẹ, ẹnyin o si ri isimi fun ọkàn nyin. Ṣugbọn nwọn wipe, Awa kì yio rin.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD, Stand ye in the ways, and see, and ask for the old paths, where is the good way, and walk therein, and ye shall find rest for your souls. But they said, We will not walk therein.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu mo fi oluṣọ sọdọ nyin, ti o wipe, Ẹ fi eti si iro fère. Ṣugbọn nwọn wipe, awa kì yio feti si i.
entries.en: Also I set watchmen over you, saying, Hearken to the sound of the trumpet. But they said, We will not hearken.

entries.yo: Nitorina, gbọ́, ẹnyin orilẹ-ède, ki ẹ si mọ̀, ẹnyin ijọ enia, ohun ti o wà ninu wọn!
entries.en: Therefore hear, ye nations, and know, O congregation, what is among them.

entries.yo: Gbọ́, iwọ ilẹ! wò o, emi o mu ibi wá si ori enia yi, ani eso iro inu wọn, nitori nwọn kò fi eti si ọ̀rọ mi, ati ofin mi ni nwọn kọ̀ silẹ.
entries.en: Hear, O earth: behold, I will bring evil upon this people, even the fruit of their thoughts, because they have not hearkened unto my words, nor to my law, but rejected it.

entries.yo: Ère wo li o wà fun mi ninu turari lati Ṣeba wá, ati ẽsu daradara lati ilẹ ti o jina wá? ọrẹ sisun nyin kò ṣe inu-didun mi, ẹbọ jijẹ nyin kò wù mi.
entries.en: To what purpose cometh there to me incense from Sheba, and the sweet cane from a far country? your burnt offerings are not acceptable, nor your sacrifices sweet unto me.

entries.yo: Nitorina, bayi li Oluwa wi, sa wò o, emi o fi ohun idugbolu siwaju awọn enia yi, ti baba ati awọn ọmọ yio jumọ ṣubu lù wọn, aladugbo ati ọrẹ rẹ̀ yio ṣegbe.
entries.en: Therefore thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will lay stumblingblocks before this people, and the fathers and the sons together shall fall upon them; the neighbour and his friend shall perish.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa wi, sa wò o, enia kan ti ilu ariwa wá, ati orilẹ-ède nla kan yio ti opin ilẹ aiye dide wá.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD, Behold, a people cometh from the north country, and a great nation shall be raised from the sides of the earth.

entries.yo: Nwọn di ọrun ati ọ̀kọ mu; onroro ni nwọn, nwọn kò ni ãnu; ohùn wọn yio hó bi okun; nwọn gun ẹṣin; nwọn si mura bi ọkunrin ti yio ja ọ logun, iwọ ọmọbinrin Sioni.
entries.en: They shall lay hold on bow and spear; they are cruel, and have no mercy; their voice roareth like the sea; and they ride upon horses, set in array as men for war against thee, O daughter of Zion.

entries.yo: Awa ti gbọ́ òkiki eyi na: ọwọ wa di rirọ, ẹ̀dun ti di wa mu, ati irora bi obinrin ti nrọbi.
entries.en: We have heard the fame thereof: our hands wax feeble: anguish hath taken hold of us, and pain, as of a woman in travail.

entries.yo: Máṣe lọ si inu oko, bẹ̃ni ki o má si rin oju ọ̀na na, nitori idà ọ̀ta, idagiri wà yikakiri.
entries.en: Go not forth into the field, nor walk by the way; for the sword of the enemy and fear is on every side.

entries.yo: Iwọ, ọmọbinrin enia mi, di ara rẹ ni amure aṣọ-ọ̀fọ ki o si ku ẽru sara, ṣe ọ̀fọ bi ẹniti nṣọ̀fọ fun ọmọ rẹ̀ nikanṣoṣo, pohùnrere kikoro: nitori afiniṣe-ijẹ yio ṣubu lù wa lojiji.
entries.en: O daughter of my people, gird thee with sackcloth, and wallow thyself in ashes: make thee mourning, as for an only son, most bitter lamentation: for the spoiler shall suddenly come upon us.

entries.yo: Emi ti fi ọ ṣe ẹniti o ma dán ni wò, odi alagbara lãrin enia mi, ki iwọ ki o le mọ̀ ki o si le dan ọ̀na wọn wò.
entries.en: I have set thee for a tower and a fortress among my people, that thou mayest know and try their way.

entries.yo: Gbogbo nwọn ni alagidi ọlọtẹ̀, ti nrin kiri sọ̀rọ̀ ẹni lẹhin, idẹ ati irin ni nwọn; abanijẹ ni gbogbo nwọn iṣe.
entries.en: They are all grievous revolters, walking with slanders: they are brass and iron; they are all corrupters.

entries.yo: Ẹwìri joná, iná ti jẹ ojé, ẹniti nyọ ọ, nyọ ọ lasan, a kò si ya enia buburu kuro.
entries.en: The bellows are burned, the lead is consumed of the fire; the founder melteth in vain: for the wicked are not plucked away.

entries.yo: Fàdaka bibajẹ ni enia yio ma pè wọn, nitori Oluwa ti kọ̀ wọn silẹ.
entries.en: Reprobate silver shall men call them, because the LORD hath rejected them.

entries.yo: Ọ̀RỌ ti o tọ̀ Jeremiah wá lati ọdọ Oluwa wá wipe:
entries.en: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,

entries.yo: Duro ni ẹnu ilẹkun ile Oluwa, ki o si kede ọ̀rọ yi wipe, Gbọ́ ọ̀rọ Oluwa, gbogbo ẹnyin ti Juda ti ẹ wọ̀ ẹnu ilẹkun wọnyi lati sin Oluwa.
entries.en: Stand in the gate of the LORD's house, and proclaim there this word, and say, Hear the word of the LORD, all ye of Judah, that enter in at these gates to worship the LORD.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun, Ọlọrun Israeli wi, tun ọ̀na ati ìwa nyin ṣe, emi o si jẹ ki ẹnyin ma gbe ibi yi.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, Amend your ways and your doings, and I will cause you to dwell in this place.

entries.yo: Ẹ máṣe gbẹkẹle ọ̀rọ eke, wipe: Tempili Oluwa, Tempili Oluwa, Tempili Oluwa ni eyi!
entries.en: Trust ye not in lying words, saying, The temple of the LORD, The temple of the LORD, The temple of the LORD, are these.

entries.yo: Nitori bi ẹnyin ba tun ọ̀na ati ìwa nyin ṣe nitõtọ; ti ẹnyin ba ṣe idajọ otitọ jalẹ, ẹnikini si ẹnikeji rẹ̀.
entries.en: For if ye throughly amend your ways and your doings; if ye throughly execute judgment between a man and his neighbour;

entries.yo: Ti ẹnyin kò ba si ṣẹ́ alejo ni iṣẹ́, alainibaba ati opó, ti ẹnyin kò si ta ẹ̀jẹ alaiṣẹ̀ silẹ ni ibi yi, ti ẹnyin kò si rìn tọ ọlọrun miran si ipalara nyin.
entries.en: If ye oppress not the stranger, the fatherless, and the widow, and shed not innocent blood in this place, neither walk after other gods to your hurt:

entries.yo: Nigbana ni emi o mu nyin gbe ibi yi, ni ilẹ ti emi fi fun awọn baba nyin lai ati lailai.
entries.en: Then will I cause you to dwell in this place, in the land that I gave to your fathers, for ever and ever.

entries.yo: Sa wò o, ẹnyin gbẹkẹle ọ̀rọ eke, ti kò ni ère.
entries.en: Behold, ye trust in lying words, that cannot profit.

entries.yo: Kohaṣepe, ẹnyin njale, ẹ npania, ẹ nṣe panṣaga, ẹ nbura eke, ẹ nsun turari fun Baali, ẹ si nrin tọ ọlọrun miran ti ẹnyin kò mọ̀?
entries.en: Will ye steal, murder, and commit adultery, and swear falsely, and burn incense unto Baal, and walk after other gods whom ye know not;

entries.yo: Ẹnyin si wá, ẹ si duro niwaju mi ni ile yi, ti a fi orukọ mi pè! ẹnyin si wipe: Gbà wa, lati ṣe gbogbo irira wọnyi?
entries.en: And come and stand before me in this house, which is called by my name, and say, We are delivered to do all these abominations?
