entries.yo: Ile yi, ti ẹ fi orukọ mi pè, o ha di iho olè li oju nyin? sa wò o, emi tikarami ti ri i, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: Is this house, which is called by my name, become a den of robbers in your eyes? Behold, even I have seen it, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Ẹ si lọ nisisiyi, si ibujoko mi, ti o wà ni Ṣilo, ni ibi ti emi fi orukọ mi si li àtetekọṣe, ki ẹ si ri ohun ti emi ṣe si i nitori ìwa-buburu enia mi, Israeli.
entries.en: But go ye now unto my place which was in Shiloh, where I set my name at the first, and see what I did to it for the wickedness of my people Israel.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, nitori ẹnyin ti ṣe gbogbo iṣẹ wọnyi, li Oluwa wi, ti emi si ba nyin sọ̀rọ, ti emi ndide ni kutukutu ti mo si nsọ, ṣugbọn ẹnyin kò gbọ́; ti emi si npè nyin, ṣugbọn ẹnyin kò dahùn.
entries.en: And now, because ye have done all these works, saith the LORD, and I spake unto you, rising up early and speaking, but ye heard not; and I called you, but ye answered not;

entries.yo: Nitorina li emi o ṣe si ile yi, ti a pè ni orukọ mi, ti ẹ gbẹkẹle, ati si ibi ti emi fi fun nyin, ati fun awọn baba nyin, gẹgẹ bi emi ti ṣe si Ṣilo.
entries.en: Therefore will I do unto this house, which is called by my name, wherein ye trust, and unto the place which I gave to you and to your fathers, as I have done to Shiloh.

entries.yo: Emi o si ṣá nyin tì kuro niwaju mi, gẹgẹ bi mo ti ṣá awọn arakunrin nyin tì, ani gbogbo iru-ọmọ Efraimu.
entries.en: And I will cast you out of my sight, as I have cast out all your brethren, even the whole seed of Ephraim.

entries.yo: Nitorina máṣe gbadura fun enia yi, bẹ̃ni ki o má si gbe igbe rẹ soke ati adura fun wọn, bẹ̃ni ki o má ṣe rọ̀ mi: nitori emi kì yio gbọ́ tirẹ.
entries.en: Therefore pray not thou for this people, neither lift up cry nor prayer for them, neither make intercession to me: for I will not hear thee.

entries.yo: Iwọ kò ha ri ohun ti nwọn nṣe ni ilu Juda ati ni ita Jerusalemu?
entries.en: Seest thou not what they do in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ ko igi jọ, awọn baba nda iná, awọn obinrin npò akara lati ṣe akara didùn fun ayaba-ọrun ati lati tú ẹbọ-ọrẹ mimu jade fun ọlọrun miran, ki nwọn ki o le rú ibinu mi soke.
entries.en: The children gather wood, and the fathers kindle the fire, and the women knead their dough, to make cakes to the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto other gods, that they may provoke me to anger.

entries.yo: Ibinu mi ni nwọn ha ru soke bi? li Oluwa wi, kì ha ṣe si ara wọn fun rudurudu oju wọn?
entries.en: Do they provoke me to anger? saith the LORD: do they not provoke themselves to the confusion of their own faces?

entries.yo: Nitorina bayi li Ọlọrun Oluwa wi, sa wò o, a o dà ibinu ati irunu mi si ibi yi, sori enia ati sori ẹranko, ati sori igi igbo, ati sori eso ilẹ, yio si jo, a kì o le pa iná rẹ̀.
entries.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, mine anger and my fury shall be poured out upon this place, upon man, and upon beast, and upon the trees of the field, and upon the fruit of the ground; and it shall burn, and shall not be quenched.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun, Ọlọrun Israeli wi, kó ẹbọ sisun nyin pẹlu ẹbọ jijẹ nyin, ki ẹ si jẹ ẹran.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Put your burnt offerings unto your sacrifices, and eat flesh.

entries.yo: Nitori emi kò wi fun awọn baba nyin, bẹ̃ni emi kò paṣẹ fun wọn ni ọjọ ti mo mu wọn jade kuro ni ilẹ Egipti niti ẹbọ sisun tabi ẹbọ jijẹ:
entries.en: For I spake not unto your fathers, nor commanded them in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt, concerning burnt offerings or sacrifices:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn eyi ni mo paṣẹ fun wọn wipe, Gba ohùn mi gbọ́, emi o si jẹ Ọlọrun nyin, ẹnyin o si jẹ enia mi: ki ẹ si rin ni gbogbo ọ̀na ti mo ti paṣẹ fun nyin, ki o le dara fun nyin.
entries.en: But this thing commanded I them, saying, Obey my voice, and I will be your God, and ye shall be my people: and walk ye in all the ways that I have commanded you, that it may be well unto you.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nwọn kò gbọ́, bẹ̃ni nwọn kò tẹ eti silẹ, nwọn si rin ni ìmọ ati agidi ọkàn buburu wọn, nwọn si kọ̀ ẹ̀hin wọn kì iṣe oju wọn si mi.
entries.en: But they hearkened not, nor inclined their ear, but walked in the counsels and in the imagination of their evil heart, and went backward, and not forward.

entries.yo: Lati ọjọ ti baba nyin ti ilẹ Egipti jade wá titi di oni, emi ti rán gbogbo iranṣẹ mi, awọn woli si nyin, lojojumọ emi dide ni kutukutu, emi si rán wọn.
entries.en: Since the day that your fathers came forth out of the land of Egypt unto this day I have even sent unto you all my servants the prophets, daily rising up early and sending them:

entries.yo: Sibẹ nwọn kò gbọ́ temi, bẹ̃ni nwọn kò tẹti wọn silẹ, sugbọn nwọn mu ọrun le, nwọn ṣe buburu jù awọn baba wọn lọ.
entries.en: Yet they hearkened not unto me, nor inclined their ear, but hardened their neck: they did worse than their fathers.

entries.yo: Bi iwọ ba si wi gbogbo ọ̀rọ wọnyi fun wọn, nwọn kì yio gbọ́ tirẹ: iwọ o si pè wọn, ṣugbọn nwọn kì o da ọ lohùn.
entries.en: Therefore thou shalt speak all these words unto them; but they will not hearken to thee: thou shalt also call unto them; but they will not answer thee.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si wi fun wọn pe: Eyi ni enia na ti kò gba ohùn Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ̀ gbọ́, bẹ̃ni nwọn kò gba ẹkọ́: otitọ ṣègbe, a si ke e kuro li ẹnu wọn.
entries.en: But thou shalt say unto them, This is a nation that obeyeth not the voice of the LORD their God, nor receiveth correction: truth is perished, and is cut off from their mouth.

entries.yo: Fá irun ori rẹ, ki o si sọ ọ nù, ki o si sọkun lori oke: nitori Oluwa ti kọ̀ iran ibinu rẹ̀ silẹ, o si ṣa wọn tì.
entries.en: Cut off thine hair, O Jerusalem, and cast it away, and take up a lamentation on high places; for the LORD hath rejected and forsaken the generation of his wrath.

entries.yo: Nitori awọn ọmọ Juda ti ṣe buburu niwaju mi, li Oluwa wi; nwọn ti gbe ohun irira wọn kalẹ sinu ile ti a pe li orukọ mi, lati ba a jẹ.
entries.en: For the children of Judah have done evil in my sight, saith the LORD: they have set their abominations in the house which is called by my name, to pollute it.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ti kọ́ ibi giga Tofeti, ti o wà ni afonifoji ọmọ Hinnomu, lati sun awọn ọmọkunrin ati awọn ọmọbinrin wọn ninu iná; aṣẹ eyiti emi kò pa fun wọn, bẹ̃ni kò si wá si inu mi.
entries.en: And they have built the high places of Tophet, which is in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to burn their sons and their daughters in the fire; which I commanded them not, neither came it into my heart.

entries.yo: Nitorina sa wò o, ọjọ mbọ̀, li Oluwa wi, ti a kì o pe e ni Tofeti mọ, tabi afonifoji ọmọ Hinnomu, ṣugbọn a o pe e ni afonifoji ipakupa: nitori nwọn o sin oku ni Tofeti, titi àye kì yio si mọ.
entries.en: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that it shall no more be called Tophet, nor the valley of the son of Hinnom, but the valley of slaughter: for they shall bury in Tophet, till there be no place.

entries.yo: Okú awọn enia yi yio di onjẹ fun ẹiyẹ oju-ọrun, ati fun ẹranko ilẹ: ẹnikan kì yio lé wọn kuro.
entries.en: And the carcases of this people shall be meat for the fowls of the heaven, and for the beasts of the earth; and none shall fray them away.

entries.yo: Emi o si mu ki ohùn inu-didun ki o da kuro ni ilu Juda ati kuro ni ita Jerusalemu, ohùn ayọ̀, ohùn ọkọ iyawo, ati ti iyawo; nitori ilẹ na yio di ahoro.
entries.en: Then will I cause to cease from the cities of Judah, and from the streets of Jerusalem, the voice of mirth, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride: for the land shall be desolate.

entries.yo: LI akoko na, li Oluwa wi, ni nwọn o hú egungun awọn ọba Juda ati egungun awọn ijoye, egungun awọn alufa ati egungun awọn woli, ati egungun awọn olugbe Jerusalemu kuro ninu isà wọn:
entries.en: At that time, saith the LORD, they shall bring out the bones of the kings of Judah, and the bones of his princes, and the bones of the priests, and the bones of the prophets, and the bones of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, out of their graves:

entries.yo: Nwọn o si tẹ́ wọn siwaju õrùn ati òṣupa ati gbogbo ogun ọrun, ti nwọn ti fẹ, ti nwọn si ti sìn, awọn ti nwọn si rìn tọ̀ lẹhin, ti nwọn si wá, ti nwọn si foribalẹ fun: a kì yio kó wọn jọ, bẹ̃li a kì yio sin wọn, nwọn o di àtan li oju ilẹ-aiye.
entries.en: And they shall spread them before the sun, and the moon, and all the host of heaven, whom they have loved, and whom they have served, and after whom they have walked, and whom they have sought, and whom they have worshipped: they shall not be gathered, nor be buried; they shall be for dung upon the face of the earth.

entries.yo: Awon iyokù ti o kù ninu idile buburu yi yio yan kikú jù yiyè lọ: ni ibi gbogbo ti nwọn kù si, ti emi ti tì wọn jade si, li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi.
entries.en: And death shall be chosen rather than life by all the residue of them that remain of this evil family, which remain in all the places whither I have driven them, saith the LORD of hosts.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si wi fun wọn pe, Bayi li Oluwa wi; enia le ṣubu li aidide mọ? tabi enia le pada, ki o má tun yipada mọ?
entries.en: Moreover thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the LORD; Shall they fall, and not arise? shall he turn away, and not return?

entries.yo: Ẽṣe ti awọn enia Jerusalemu yi sọ ipadasẹhin di ipẹhinda lailai? nwọn di ẹ̀tan mu ṣinṣin, nwọn kọ̀ lati pada.
entries.en: Why then is this people of Jerusalem slidden back by a perpetual backsliding? they hold fast deceit, they refuse to return.

entries.yo: Mo tẹti lélẹ, mo si gbọ́, ṣugbọn nwọn kò sọ̀rọ titọ: kò si ẹnikan ti o ronupiwada buburu rẹ̀ wipe, kili emi ṣe? gbogbo nwọn yipo li ọ̀na wọn, bi akọ-ẹṣin ti nsare gburu sinu ogun.
entries.en: I hearkened and heard, but they spake not aright: no man repented him of his wickedness, saying, What have I done? every one turned to his course, as the horse rusheth into the battle.

entries.yo: Lõtọ ẹiyẹ àkọ li oju-ọrun mọ̀ akoko rẹ̀, àdaba ati ẹiyẹ lekeleke pẹlu alapandẹ̀dẹ sọ́ igba wiwá wọn; ṣugbọn enia mi kò mọ̀ idajọ Oluwa.
entries.en: Yea, the stork in the heaven knoweth her appointed times; and the turtle and the crane and the swallow observe the time of their coming; but my people know not the judgment of the LORD.

entries.yo: Bawo li ẹnyin ṣe wipe, Ọlọgbọ́n ni wa, ati ofin Oluwa mbẹ lọdọ wa? sa wò o nitõtọ! kalamu eke awọn akọwe ti sọ ofin di eke.
entries.en: How do ye say, We are wise, and the law of the LORD is with us? Lo, certainly in vain made he it; the pen of the scribes is in vain.

entries.yo: Oju tì awọn ọlọgbọ́n, idamu ba wọn a si mu wọn: sa wò o, nwọn ti kọ̀ ọ̀rọ Oluwa! ọgbọ́n wo li o wà ninu wọn?
entries.en: The wise men are ashamed, they are dismayed and taken: lo, they have rejected the word of the LORD; and what wisdom is in them?

entries.yo: Nitorina ni emi o fi aya wọn fun ẹlomiran, ati oko wọn fun awọn ti yio gbà wọn: nitori gbogbo wọn, lati ẹni kekere titi o fi de enia-nla, fi ara wọn fun ojukokoro, lati woli titi de alufa, gbogbo wọn nṣe ẹ̀tan.
entries.en: Therefore will I give their wives unto others, and their fields to them that shall inherit them: for every one from the least even unto the greatest is given to covetousness, from the prophet even unto the priest every one dealeth falsely.

entries.yo: Nitoripe nwọn ti wo ipalara ọmọbinrin enia mi fẹrẹ̀ wipe, Alafia! Alafia! nigbati alafia kò si.
entries.en: For they have healed the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly, saying, Peace, peace; when there is no peace.

entries.yo: Itiju yio ba wọn nitori nwọn ti ṣe ohun irira, sibẹ nwọn kò tiju, bẹ̃ni õru itiju kò mu wọn, nitorina ni nwọn o ṣe ṣubu lãrin awọn ti o ṣubu; ni igba ibẹ̀wo wọn, a o si wó wọn lulẹ, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? nay, they were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush: therefore shall they fall among them that fall: in the time of their visitation they shall be cast down, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Ni kiká emi o ká wọn jọ, li Oluwa wi, eso-àjara kì yio si mọ lori ajara, tabi eso-ọ̀pọtọ lori igi ọ̀pọtọ, ewe rẹ̀ yio si rẹ̀; nitorina ni emi o yàn awọn ti yio kọja lọ lori rẹ̀.
entries.en: I will surely consume them, saith the LORD: there shall be no grapes on the vine, nor figs on the fig tree, and the leaf shall fade; and the things that I have given them shall pass away from them.

entries.yo: Ẽṣe ti awa joko jẹ? ẹ ko ara nyin jọ, ki ẹ si jẹ ki a wọ̀ inu ilu olodi, ki a si dakẹ sibẹ: nitori Oluwa Ọlọrun wa, ti mu wa dakẹ, o si fun wa ni omi orõro lati mu, nitori ti awa ṣẹ̀ si Oluwa.
entries.en: Why do we sit still? assemble yourselves, and let us enter into the defenced cities, and let us be silent there: for the LORD our God hath put us to silence, and given us water of gall to drink, because we have sinned against the LORD.

entries.yo: Awa reti alafia, ṣugbọn kò si ireti kan, ati ìgba didá ara, si kiye si i, idamu!
entries.en: We looked for peace, but no good came; and for a time of health, and behold trouble!

entries.yo: Lati Dani ni a gbọ́ fifọn imu ẹṣin rẹ̀; gbogbo ilẹ warìri fun iro yiyan akọ-ẹṣin rẹ̀; nwọn si de, nwọn si jẹ ile run, ati eyi ti mbẹ ninu rẹ̀: ilu ati awọn ti ngbe inu rẹ̀,
entries.en: The snorting of his horses was heard from Dan: the whole land trembled at the sound of the neighing of his strong ones; for they are come, and have devoured the land, and all that is in it; the city, and those that dwell therein.

entries.yo: Sa wò o, emi o ran ejo, ejo gunte si ãrin nyin, ti kì yio gbọ́ ituju, nwọn o si bu nyin jẹ, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: For, behold, I will send serpents, cockatrices, among you, which will not be charmed, and they shall bite you, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Emi iba le tù ara mi ninu, ninu ikãnu mi? ọkàn mi daku ninu mi!
entries.en: When I would comfort myself against sorrow, my heart is faint in me.

entries.yo: Sa wò o, ohùn ẹkún ọmọbinrin enia mi, lati ilẹ jijina wá, Kò ha si Oluwa ni Sioni bi? ọba rẹ̀ kò ha si ninu rẹ̀? ẽṣe ti nwọn fi ere gbigbẹ ati ohun asan àjeji mu mi binu?
entries.en: Behold the voice of the cry of the daughter of my people because of them that dwell in a far country: Is not the LORD in Zion? is not her king in her? Why have they provoked me to anger with their graven images, and with strange vanities?

entries.yo: Ikore ti kọja, ẹ̀run ti pari, a kò si gba wa la!
entries.en: The harvest is past, the summer is ended, and we are not saved.

entries.yo: Nitori ipalara ọmọbinrin enia mi li a ṣe pa mi lara; emi ṣọ̀fọ, iyanu si di mi mu.
entries.en: For the hurt of the daughter of my people am I hurt; I am black; astonishment hath taken hold on me.

entries.yo: Kò ha si ojiya ikunra ni Gileadi, oniṣegun kò ha si nibẹ? ẽṣe ti a kò fi ọ̀ja dì ọgbẹ́ ọmọbinrin enia mi.
entries.en: Is there no balm in Gilead; is there no physician there? why then is not the health of the daughter of my people recovered?

entries.yo: ORI mi iba jẹ omi, ati oju mi iba jẹ orisun omije, ki emi le sọkun lọsan ati loru fun awọn ti a pa ninu ọmọbinrin enia mi!
entries.en: Oh that my head were waters, and mine eyes a fountain of tears, that I might weep day and night for the slain of the daughter of my people!

entries.yo: A! emi iba ni buka ero ni iju, ki emi ki o le fi enia mi silẹ, ki nlọ kuro lọdọ wọn! nitori gbogbo nwọn ni panṣaga, ajọ alarekereke enia ni nwọn.
entries.en: Oh that I had in the wilderness a lodging place of wayfaring men; that I might leave my people, and go from them! for they be all adulterers, an assembly of treacherous men.

entries.yo: Nwọn si fà ahọn wọn bi ọrun fun eke; ṣugbọn nwọn kò ṣe akoso fun otitọ lori ilẹ, nitoripe nwọn ti inu buburu lọ si buburu nwọn kò si mọ̀ mi, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: And they bend their tongues like their bow for lies: but they are not valiant for the truth upon the earth; for they proceed from evil to evil, and they know not me, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Ẹ mã ṣọra, olukuluku nyin lọdọ aladugbo rẹ̀, ki ẹ má si gbẹkẹle arakunrin karakunrin: nitoripe olukuluku arakunrin fi arekereke ṣẹtan patapata, ati olukuluku aladugbo nsọ̀rọ ẹnilẹhin.
entries.en: Take ye heed every one of his neighbour, and trust ye not in any brother: for every brother will utterly supplant, and every neighbour will walk with slanders.

entries.yo: Ẹnikini ntàn ẹnikeji rẹ̀ jẹ, nwọn kò si sọ otitọ: nwọn ti kọ́ ahọn wọn lati ṣeke, nwọn si ti ṣe ara wọn lãrẹ lati ṣe aiṣedede.
entries.en: And they will deceive every one his neighbour, and will not speak the truth: they have taught their tongue to speak lies, and weary themselves to commit iniquity.

entries.yo: Ibugbe rẹ mbẹ lãrin ẹ̀tan; nipa ẹ̀tan nwọn kọ̀ lati mọ̀ mi, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: Thine habitation is in the midst of deceit; through deceit they refuse to know me, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Nitorina bayi li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi, sa wò o, emi o yọ́ wọn, emi o si dán wọn wò, nitori kili emi o ṣe fun ọmọbinrin enia mi.
entries.en: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, Behold, I will melt them, and try them; for how shall I do for the daughter of my people?

entries.yo: Ahọn wọn dabi ọfa ti a ta, o nsọ ẹ̀tan, ẹnikini nfi ẹnu rẹ̀ sọ alafia fun ẹnikeji rẹ̀, ṣugbọn li ọkàn rẹ̀ o ba dè e.
entries.en: Their tongue is as an arrow shot out; it speaketh deceit: one speaketh peaceably to his neighbour with his mouth, but in heart he layeth his wait.

entries.yo: Emi kì yio ha bẹ̀ wọn wò nitori nkan wọnyi? li Oluwa wi, ọkàn mi kì yio ha gbẹsan lara orilẹ-ède bi iru eyi?
entries.en: Shall I not visit them for these things? saith the LORD: shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?

entries.yo: Fun awọn oke-nla ni emi o gbe ẹkún ati ohùnrere soke, ati ẹkún irora lori papa oko aginju wọnnì, nitoriti nwọn jona, ẹnikan kò le kọja nibẹ, bẹ̃ni a kò gbọ́ ohùn ẹran-ọsin, lati ẹiyẹ oju-ọrun titi de ẹranko ti sa kuro, nwọn ti lọ.
entries.en: For the mountains will I take up a weeping and wailing, and for the habitations of the wilderness a lamentation, because they are burned up, so that none can pass through them; neither can men hear the voice of the cattle; both the fowl of the heavens and the beast are fled; they are gone.

entries.yo: Emi o sọ Jerusalemu di okiti àlapa, ati iho awọn ikõko, emi o si sọ ilu Juda di ahoro, laini olugbe.
entries.en: And I will make Jerusalem heaps, and a den of dragons; and I will make the cities of Judah desolate, without an inhabitant.

entries.yo: Tani enia na ti o gbọ́n, ti o moye yi? ati tani ẹniti ẹnu Oluwa ti sọ fun, ki o ba le kede rẹ̀, pe: kili o ṣe ti ilẹ fi ṣegbe, ti o si sun jona bi aginju, ti ẹnikan kò kọja nibẹ?
entries.en: Who is the wise man, that may understand this? and who is he to whom the mouth of the LORD hath spoken, that he may declare it, for what the land perisheth and is burned up like a wilderness, that none passeth through?

entries.yo: Oluwa si wipe, nitoriti nwọn ti kọ̀ ofin mi silẹ ti mo ti gbe kalẹ niwaju wọn, ti nwọn kò si gbà ohùn mi gbọ́, bẹ̃ni nwọn kò si rin ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the LORD saith, Because they have forsaken my law which I set before them, and have not obeyed my voice, neither walked therein;

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nwọn ti rin nipa agidi ọkàn wọn ati nipasẹ Baalimu, ti awọn baba wọn kọ́ wọn:
entries.en: But have walked after the imagination of their own heart, and after Baalim, which their fathers taught them:

entries.yo: Nitorina bayi li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun, Ọlọrun Israeli wi; sa wò o, awọn enia yi pãpa ni emi o fi wahala bọ́, emi o si mu wọn mu omi orõro.
entries.en: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will feed them, even this people, with wormwood, and give them water of gall to drink.

entries.yo: Emi o si tú wọn ka ninu awọn keferi, ti awọn tikarawọn ati baba wọn kò mọ ri, emi o si rán idà si wọn titi emi o fi run wọn.
entries.en: I will scatter them also among the heathen, whom neither they nor their fathers have known: and I will send a sword after them, till I have consumed them.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi, Ẹ kiye si i, ki ẹ si pe awọn obinrin ti nṣọfọ, ki nwọn wá; ẹ si ranṣẹ pè awọn obinrin ti o moye, ki nwọn wá.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, Consider ye, and call for the mourning women, that they may come; and send for cunning women, that they may come:

entries.yo: Ki nwọn ki o si yara, ki nwọn pohùnrere ẹkun fun wa, ki oju wa ki o le sun omije ẹkun, ati ki ipenpeju wa le tu omi jade.
entries.en: And let them make haste, and take up a wailing for us, that our eyes may run down with tears, and our eyelids gush out with waters.

entries.yo: Nitori a gbọ́ ohùn ẹkun lati Sioni, pe, A ti pa wa run to! awa dãmu jọjọ, nitoriti a kọ̀ ilẹ yi silẹ, nitoriti ibugbe wa tì wa jade.
entries.en: For a voice of wailing is heard out of Zion, How are we spoiled! we are greatly confounded, because we have forsaken the land, because our dwellings have cast us out.

entries.yo: Njẹ ẹnyin obinrin, ẹ gbọ́ ọ̀rọ Oluwa, ẹ jẹ ki eti nyin gbọ́ ọ̀rọ ẹnu rẹ̀, ki ẹ si kọ́ ọmọbinrin nyin ni ẹkun, ati ki olukuluku obinrin ki o kọ́ aladugbo rẹ̀ ni arò.
entries.en: Yet hear the word of the LORD, O ye women, and let your ear receive the word of his mouth, and teach your daughters wailing, and every one her neighbour lamentation.

entries.yo: Nitori iku ti de oju ferese wa, o ti wọ̀ inu ãfin wa, lati ke awọn ọmọ-ọmu kuro ni ita, ati awọn ọmọdekunrin kuro ni igboro.
entries.en: For death is come up into our windows, and is entered into our palaces, to cut off the children from without, and the young men from the streets.

entries.yo: Sọ pe, Bayi li Oluwa wi, Okú enia yio ṣubu bi àtan li oko, ati bi ibukunwọ lẹhin olukore, ti ẹnikan ko kojọ.
entries.en: Speak, Thus saith the LORD, Even the carcases of men shall fall as dung upon the open field, and as the handful after the harvestman, and none shall gather them.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa wi, ki ọlọgbọ́n ki o má ṣogo nitori ọgbọ́n rẹ̀, bẹ̃ni ki alagbara ki o má ṣogo nitori agbara rẹ̀, ki ọlọrọ̀ ki o má ṣogo nitori ọrọ̀ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD, Let not the wise man glory in his wisdom, neither let the mighty man glory in his might, let not the rich man glory in his riches:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ki ẹnikẹni ti yio ba ma ṣogo, ki o ṣe e ninu eyi pe: on ni oye, on si mọ̀ mi; pe, Emi li Oluwa ti nṣe ãnu ati idajọ ati ododo li aiye: nitori inu mi dùn ninu ohun wọnyi, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: But let him that glorieth glory in this, that he understandeth and knoweth me, that I am the LORD which exercise lovingkindness, judgment, and righteousness, in the earth: for in these things I delight, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Sa wò o, ọjọ mbọ̀ li Oluwa wi, ti emi o jẹ gbogbo awọn ti a kọ ni ilà pẹlu awọn alaikọla ni ìya;
entries.en: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will punish all them which are circumcised with the uncircumcised;

entries.yo: Egipti ati Juda ati Edomu, ati awọn ọmọ Ammoni ati Moabu, pẹlu gbogbo awọn ti ndá òṣu, ti ngbe aginju: nitori alaikọla ni gbogbo orilẹ-ède yi, ṣugbọn gbogbo ile Israeli jẹ alaikọla ọkàn.
entries.en: Egypt, and Judah, and Edom, and the children of Ammon, and Moab, and all that are in the utmost corners, that dwell in the wilderness: for all these nations are uncircumcised, and all the house of Israel are uncircumcised in the heart.

entries.yo: Ẹ gbọ́ ọ̀rọ ti Oluwa sọ fun nyin, ẹnyin ile Israeli:
entries.en: Hear ye the word which the LORD speaketh unto you, O house of Israel:

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa wi, Ẹ máṣe kọ́ ìwa awọn keferi, ki àmi ọrun ki o má si dãmu nyin, nitoripe, nwọn ndamu awọn orilẹ-ède.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD, Learn not the way of the heathen, and be not dismayed at the signs of heaven; for the heathen are dismayed at them.

entries.yo: Nitori asan ni ilana awọn orilẹ-ède; nitori igi ti a ke lati igbo ni iṣẹ ọwọ oniṣọna ati ti ãke.
entries.en: For the customs of the people are vain: for one cutteth a tree out of the forest, the work of the hands of the workman, with the axe.

entries.yo: Nwọn fi fádaka ati wura ṣe e lọṣọ, nwọn fi iṣo ati olù dì i mu, ki o má le mì.
entries.en: They deck it with silver and with gold; they fasten it with nails and with hammers, that it move not.

entries.yo: Nwọn nàro bi igi ọpẹ, ṣugbọn nwọn kò fọhùn: gbigbe li a ngbe wọn, nitori nwọn kò le rin. Má bẹ̀ru wọn; nitori nwọn kò le ṣe buburu, bẹ̃li ati ṣe rere, kò si ninu wọn.
entries.en: They are upright as the palm tree, but speak not: they must needs be borne, because they cannot go. Be not afraid of them; for they cannot do evil, neither also is it in them to do good.

entries.yo: Kò si ẹnikan ti o dabi Iwọ Oluwa! iwọ tobi, orukọ rẹ si tobi ni agbara!
entries.en: Forasmuch as there is none like unto thee, O LORD; thou art great, and thy name is great in might.

entries.yo: Tani kì ba bẹ̀ru rẹ, Iwọ Ọba orilẹ-ède? nitori tirẹ ni o jasi; kò si ninu awọn ọlọgbọ́n orilẹ-ède, ati gbogbo ijọba wọn, kò si ẹniti o dabi Iwọ!
entries.en: Who would not fear thee, O King of nations? for to thee doth it appertain: forasmuch as among all the wise men of the nations, and in all their kingdoms, there is none like unto thee.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nwọn jumọ ṣe ope ati aṣiwere; ìti igi ni ẹkọ́ ohun asan.
entries.en: But they are altogether brutish and foolish: the stock is a doctrine of vanities.

entries.yo: Fadaka ti a fi ṣe awo ni a mu lati Tarṣiṣi wá, ati wura lati Upasi wá, iṣẹ oniṣọna, ati lọwọ alagbẹdẹ: alaro ati elese aluko ni aṣọ wọn: iṣẹ ọlọgbọ́n ni gbogbo wọn.
entries.en: Silver spread into plates is brought from Tarshish, and gold from Uphaz, the work of the workman, and of the hands of the founder: blue and purple is their clothing: they are all the work of cunning men.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Oluwa, Ọlọrun otitọ ni, on ni Ọlọrun alãye, ati Ọba aiyeraiye! aiye yio warìri nigbati o ba binu, orilẹ-ède kì yio le duro ni ibinu rẹ̀.
entries.en: But the LORD is the true God, he is the living God, and an everlasting king: at his wrath the earth shall tremble, and the nations shall not be able to abide his indignation.

entries.yo: Bayi li ẹnyin o wi fun wọn pe: Awọn ọlọrun ti kò da ọrun on aiye, awọn na ni yio ṣegbe loju aiye, ati labẹ ọrun wọnyi.
entries.en: Thus shall ye say unto them, The gods that have not made the heavens and the earth, even they shall perish from the earth, and from under these heavens.

entries.yo: On ti da aiye nipa agbara rẹ̀, on ti pinnu araiye nipa ọgbọ́n rẹ̀, o si nà awọn ọrun nipa oye rẹ̀.
entries.en: He hath made the earth by his power, he hath established the world by his wisdom, and hath stretched out the heavens by his discretion.

entries.yo: Nigbati o ba sán ãrá, ọ̀pọlọpọ omi ni mbẹ loju-ọrun, o si jẹ ki kũku rú soke lati opin aiye; o da mànamana fun òjo, o si mu ẹfũfu jade lati inu iṣura rẹ̀ wá.
entries.en: When he uttereth his voice, there is a multitude of waters in the heavens, and he causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings with rain, and bringeth forth the wind out of his treasures.

entries.yo: Aṣiwere ni gbogbo enia nitori oye kò si: oju tì olukuluku alagbẹdẹ niwaju ere rẹ̀, nitori ère didà rẹ̀ eke ni, kò si sí ẹmi ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: Every man is brutish in his knowledge: every founder is confounded by the graven image: for his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.

entries.yo: Asan ni nwọn, ati iṣẹ iṣina: nigba ibẹwo wọn nwọn o ṣègbe.
entries.en: They are vanity, and the work of errors: in the time of their visitation they shall perish.

entries.yo: Ipin Jakobu kò si dabi wọn nitori on ni iṣe Ẹlẹda ohun gbogbo; Israeli si ni ẹya ijogun rẹ̀: Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun li orukọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: The portion of Jacob is not like them: for he is the former of all things; and Israel is the rod of his inheritance: The LORD of hosts is his name.

entries.yo: Ko ẹrù rẹ kuro ni ilẹ na, Iwọ olugbe ilu ti a dotì.
entries.en: Gather up thy wares out of the land, O inhabitant of the fortress.

entries.yo: Nitori bayi li Oluwa wi, sa wò o, emi o gbọ̀n awọn olugbe ilẹ na nù lẹ̃kan yi, emi o si pọ́n wọn loju, ki nwọn ki o le ri i.
entries.en: For thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will sling out the inhabitants of the land at this once, and will distress them, that they may find it so.

entries.yo: Egbe ni fun mi nitori ipalara mi! ọgbẹ mi pọ̀: ṣugbọn mo wipe, nitõtọ ìya mi ni eyi, emi o si rù u.
entries.en: Woe is me for my hurt! my wound is grievous: but I said, Truly this is a grief, and I must bear it.

entries.yo: Agọ mi bajẹ, gbogbo okùn mi si ja: awọn ọmọ mi ti fi mi silẹ lọ, nwọn kò sí mọ́, kò si ẹnikan ti yio nà agọ mi mọ, ti yio si ta aṣọ ikele mi.
entries.en: My tabernacle is spoiled, and all my cords are broken: my children are gone forth of me, and they are not: there is none to stretch forth my tent any more, and to set up my curtains.

entries.yo: Nitori awọn oluṣọ agutan ti di ope, nwọn kò si wá Oluwa: nitorina nwọn kì yio ri rere, gbogbo agbo wọn yio si tuka.
entries.en: For the pastors are become brutish, and have not sought the LORD: therefore they shall not prosper, and all their flocks shall be scattered.

entries.yo: Sa wò o, ariwo igbe ti de, ati irukerudo nla lati ilẹ ariwa wá, lati sọ ilu Judah di ahoro, ati iho ọwawa.
entries.en: Behold, the noise of the bruit is come, and a great commotion out of the north country, to make the cities of Judah desolate, and a den of dragons.

entries.yo: Oluwa! emi mọ̀ pe, ọ̀na enia kò si ni ipa ara rẹ̀: kò si ni ipá enia ti nrin, lati tọ́ iṣisẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: O LORD, I know that the way of man is not in himself: it is not in man that walketh to direct his steps.

entries.yo: Oluwa kilọ fun mi, ṣugbon ni idajọ ni, ki o máṣe ni ibinu rẹ, ki iwọ ki o má sọ mi di asan.
entries.en: O LORD, correct me, but with judgment; not in thine anger, lest thou bring me to nothing.

entries.yo: Tu ibinu rẹ si ori awọn orilẹ-ède, ti kò mọ̀ ọ, ati sori awọn idile ti kò ke pè orukọ rẹ, nitoriti nwọn ti jẹ Jakobu run, nwọn si gbe e mì, nwọn si pa a run tan, nwọn si sọ ibugbe rẹ̀ di ahoro.
entries.en: Pour out thy fury upon the heathen that know thee not, and upon the families that call not on thy name: for they have eaten up Jacob, and devoured him, and consumed him, and have made his habitation desolate.

entries.yo: Ọ̀RỌ ti o ti ọdọ Oluwa wá sọdọ Jeremiah wipe:
entries.en: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,

entries.yo: Ẹ gbọ́ ọ̀rọ majẹmu yi, ki ẹ si sọ fun awọn enia Juda ati awọn olugbe Jerusalemu,
entries.en: Hear ye the words of this covenant, and speak unto the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem;

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o si wi fun wọn pe, Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun Israeli wi; Ifibu ni oluwarẹ̀ ti kò ba gbà ọ̀rọ majẹmu yi gbọ́,
entries.en: And say thou unto them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel; Cursed be the man that obeyeth not the words of this covenant,

entries.yo: Ti mo pa li aṣẹ fun awọn baba nyin, li ọjọ ti mo mu wọn ti ilẹ Egipti jade, lati inu ileru irin wipe, Gbà ohùn mi gbọ́, ki ẹ si ṣe gẹgẹ bi emi ti paṣẹ fun nyin: bẹ̃ni ẹnyin o jẹ enia mi, emi o si jẹ Ọlọrun nyin:
entries.en: Which I commanded your fathers in the day that I brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, from the iron furnace, saying, Obey my voice, and do them, according to all which I command you: so shall ye be my people, and I will be your God:

entries.yo: Ki emi ki o le mu ileri mi ṣẹ, ti mo ti bura fun awọn baba nyin, lati fun wọn ni ilẹ ti nṣàn fun wara ati fun oyin, gẹgẹ bi o ti ri li oni: mo si dahùn mo si wipe, Amin, Oluwa!
entries.en: That I may perform the oath which I have sworn unto your fathers, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey, as it is this day. Then answered I, and said, So be it, O LORD.

entries.yo: Oluwa si wi fun mi pe, Kede gbogbo ọ̀rọ wọnyi ni ilu Juda ati ni ita Jerusalemu wipe, Ẹ gbọ́ ọ̀rọ majẹmu yi ki ẹ si ṣe wọn.
entries.en: Then the LORD said unto me, Proclaim all these words in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, saying, Hear ye the words of this covenant, and do them.

entries.yo: Nitori ni kikilọ mo kilọ fun awọn baba nyin lati ọjọ ti mo ti mu wọn wá lati ilẹ Egipti, titi di oni, emi si nyara kilọ fun wọn, mo si nsọ wipe, Ẹ gbà ohùn mi gbọ́.
entries.en: For I earnestly protested unto your fathers in the day that I brought them up out of the land of Egypt, even unto this day, rising early and protesting, saying, Obey my voice.

entries.yo: Sibẹsibẹ nwọn kò gbọ́, nwọn kò tẹti silẹ, nwọn si rìn, olukuluku wọn ni agidi ọkàn buburu wọn: nitorina emi o mu gbogbo ọ̀rọ majẹmu yi wá sori wọn, ti mo paṣẹ fun wọn lati ṣe; nwọn kò si ṣe e.
entries.en: Yet they obeyed not, nor inclined their ear, but walked every one in the imagination of their evil heart: therefore I will bring upon them all the words of this covenant, which I commanded them to do; but they did them not.

entries.yo: Oluwa si wi fun mi pe, A ri ìditẹ lãrin awọn ọkunrin Juda ati lãrin awọn olugbe Jerusalemu.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto me, A conspiracy is found among the men of Judah, and among the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Nwọn yipada si ẹ̀ṣẹ iṣaju awọn baba wọn ti o kọ̀ lati gbọ́ ọ̀rọ mi; awọn wọnyi si tọ̀ ọlọrun miran lẹhin lati sìn wọn: ile Israeli ati ile Juda ti dà majẹmu mi ti mo ba awọn baba wọn dá.
entries.en: They are turned back to the iniquities of their forefathers, which refused to hear my words; and they went after other gods to serve them: the house of Israel and the house of Judah have broken my covenant which I made with their fathers.

entries.yo: Nitorina, bayi li Oluwa wi, sa wò o, Emi o mu ibi wá sori wọn, ti nwọn kì yio le yẹba fun: bi nwọn tilẹ ke pè mi, emi kì yio fetisi igbe wọn.
entries.en: Therefore thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will bring evil upon them, which they shall not be able to escape; and though they shall cry unto me, I will not hearken unto them.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki ilu Juda ati awọn olugbe Jerusalemu ki o lọ, ki nwọn ki o si ke pe awọn ọlọrun ti nwọn ńsun turari fun, ṣugbọn lõtọ nwọn kì yio le gba wọn ni igba ipọnju wọn.
entries.en: Then shall the cities of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem go, and cry unto the gods unto whom they offer incense: but they shall not save them at all in the time of their trouble.

entries.yo: Nitori bi iye ilu rẹ, bẹ̃ni iye ọlọrun rẹ, iwọ Juda, ati bi iye ita Jerusalemu, bẹ̃ni iye pẹpẹ ti ẹnyin ti tẹ́ fun ohun itìju nì, pẹpẹ lati sun turari fun Baali.
entries.en: For according to the number of thy cities were thy gods, O Judah; and according to the number of the streets of Jerusalem have ye set up altars to that shameful thing, even altars to burn incense unto Baal.

entries.yo: Nitorina máṣe gbadura fun awọn enia yi, bẹ̃ni ki o má si ṣe gbe ohùn ẹkun tabi ti adura soke fun wọn, nitori emi kì yio gbọ́ ni igba ti nwọn ba kigbe pè mi, ni wakati wahala wọn.
entries.en: Therefore pray not thou for this people, neither lift up a cry or prayer for them: for I will not hear them in the time that they cry unto me for their trouble.

entries.yo: Kini olufẹ mi ni iṣe ni ile mi? nigbati nwọn nṣe buburu pupọ bayi? adura on ẹran mimọ́ ha le mu ibi kọja kuro lọdọ rẹ? bi o ba ri bayi? nigbana jẹ ki inu rẹ ki o dùn.
entries.en: What hath my beloved to do in mine house, seeing she hath wrought lewdness with many, and the holy flesh is passed from thee? when thou doest evil, then thou rejoicest.

entries.yo: Oluwa pè orukọ rẹ ni igi Olifi tutu, didara, eleso rere: ṣugbọn nisisiyi o fi ariwo irọkẹkẹ nla dá iná lara rẹ̀, ẹka rẹ̀ li o si faya.
entries.en: The LORD called thy name, A green olive tree, fair, and of goodly fruit: with the noise of a great tumult he hath kindled fire upon it, and the branches of it are broken.

entries.yo: Nitori Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun, ti o gbìn ọ, ti sọ̀rọ ibi si ọ, nitori buburu ile Israeli, ati ile Juda, ti nwọn ti ṣe si ara wọn lati ru ibinu mi soke ni sisun turari fun Baali.
entries.en: For the LORD of hosts, that planted thee, hath pronounced evil against thee, for the evil of the house of Israel and of the house of Judah, which they have done against themselves to provoke me to anger in offering incense unto Baal.

entries.yo: Oluwa si ti mu mi mọ̀, emi si mọ̀: nigbana ni iwọ fi iṣe wọn hàn mi.
entries.en: And the LORD hath given me knowledge of it, and I know it: then thou shewedst me their doings.

entries.yo: Ani mo dabi ọdọ-agutan ti o mọ̀ oju ile, ti a mu wá fun pipa: emi kò si mọ̀ pe, nwọn ti pinnu buburu si mi wipe: Jẹ ki a ke igi na pẹlu eso rẹ̀ ki a si ke e kuro ni ilẹ alãye, ki a máṣe ranti orukọ rẹ̀ mọ.
entries.en: But I was like a lamb or an ox that is brought to the slaughter; and I knew not that they had devised devices against me, saying, Let us destroy the tree with the fruit thereof, and let us cut him off from the land of the living, that his name may be no more remembered.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun, onidajọ otitọ ti ndan aiya ati inu wò, emi o ri igbẹsan rẹ lori wọn: nitori iwọ ni mo fi ọ̀ran mi le lọwọ.
entries.en: But, O LORD of hosts, that judgest righteously, that triest the reins and the heart, let me see thy vengeance on them: for unto thee have I revealed my cause.

entries.yo: Nitorina bayi li Oluwa wi, niti enia Anatoti ti o nwá ẹmi rẹ, ti nwipe, Máṣe sọ asọtẹlẹ li orukọ Oluwa, ki iwọ ki o má ba kú nipa, ọwọ wa.
entries.en: Therefore thus saith the LORD of the men of Anathoth, that seek thy life, saying, Prophesy not in the name of the LORD, that thou die not by our hand:

entries.yo: Nitorina bayi li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi, wò o, emi o bẹ̀ wọn wo, awọn ọdọmọkunrin o ti ọwọ idà kú, ọmọ wọn ọkunrin ati ọmọ wọn obinrin yio kú nipa iyàn:
entries.en: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, Behold, I will punish them: the young men shall die by the sword; their sons and their daughters shall die by famine:

entries.yo: Ẹnikan kì yio kù ninu wọn: nitori emi o mu ibi wá sori awọn enia Anatoti, ani ọdun ìbẹwo wọn.
entries.en: And there shall be no remnant of them: for I will bring evil upon the men of Anathoth, even the year of their visitation.

entries.yo: ALARE ni iwọ, Oluwa, nigbati mo mba ọ wijọ: sibẹ, jẹ ki emi ba ọ sọ ti ọ̀ran idajọ: ẽtiṣe ti ãsiki mbẹ ni ọ̀na enia buburu, ti gbogbo awọn ti nṣe ẹ̀tan jẹ alailewu.
entries.en: Righteous art thou, O LORD, when I plead with thee: yet let me talk with thee of thy judgments: Wherefore doth the way of the wicked prosper? wherefore are all they happy that deal very treacherously?

entries.yo: Iwọ ti gbìn wọn, nwọn si ti ta gbòngbo: nwọn dagba, nwọn si nso eso: iwọ sunmọ ẹnu wọn, o si jìna si ọkàn wọn.
entries.en: Thou hast planted them, yea, they have taken root: they grow, yea, they bring forth fruit: thou art near in their mouth, and far from their reins.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn iwọ, Oluwa, mọ̀ mi: iwọ ri mi, o si dan ọkàn mi wò bi o ti ri si ọ: pa wọn mọ bi agutan fun pipa, ki o si yà wọn sọtọ fun ọjọ pipa.
entries.en: But thou, O LORD, knowest me: thou hast seen me, and tried mine heart toward thee: pull them out like sheep for the slaughter, and prepare them for the day of slaughter.

entries.yo: Yio ti pẹ to ti ilẹ yio fi ma ṣọ̀fọ, ati ti ewe igbẹ gbogbo yio rẹ̀ nitori ìwa-buburu awọn ti mbẹ ninu rẹ̀? ẹranko ati ẹiyẹ nṣòfò nitori ti nwọn wipe, on kì o ri ẹ̀hin wa.
entries.en: How long shall the land mourn, and the herbs of every field wither, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein? the beasts are consumed, and the birds; because they said, He shall not see our last end.

entries.yo: Bi iwọ ba ba ẹlẹsẹ rìn, ti ãrẹ si mu ọ, iwọ o ha ti ṣe ba ẹlẹṣin dije? ati pẹlu ni ilẹ alafia, bi iwọ ba ni igbẹkẹle, kini iwọ o ṣe ninu ẹkún odò Jordani?
entries.en: If thou hast run with the footmen, and they have wearied thee, then how canst thou contend with horses? and if in the land of peace, wherein thou trustedst, they wearied thee, then how wilt thou do in the swelling of Jordan?

entries.yo: Nitori pẹlupẹlu, awọn arakunrin rẹ, ati ile baba rẹ, awọn na ti hùwa ẹ̀tan si ọ, lõtọ, awọn na ti ho le ọ: Má gbẹkẹle wọn, bi nwọn tilẹ ba ọ sọ̀rọ daradara.
entries.en: For even thy brethren, and the house of thy father, even they have dealt treacherously with thee; yea, they have called a multitude after thee: believe them not, though they speak fair words unto thee.

entries.yo: Emi ti kọ̀ ile mi silẹ, mo ti fi ogún mi silẹ; mo ti fi olufẹ ọ̀wọn ọkàn mi le ọta rẹ̀ lọwọ.
entries.en: I have forsaken mine house, I have left mine heritage; I have given the dearly beloved of my soul into the hand of her enemies.

entries.yo: Ogún mi di kiniun ninu igbo fun mi; on kigbe soke si mi; nitorina ni mo ṣe korira rẹ̀.
entries.en: Mine heritage is unto me as a lion in the forest; it crieth out against me: therefore have I hated it.

entries.yo: Ogún mi di ẹranko ọ̀wawa fun mi, ẹranko yi i kakiri, ẹ lọ, ẹ ko gbogbo ẹran igbẹ jọ pọ̀, ẹ mu wọn wá jẹ.
entries.en: Mine heritage is unto me as a speckled bird, the birds round about are against her; come ye, assemble all the beasts of the field, come to devour.

entries.yo: Ọ̀pọlọpọ oluṣọ-agutan ba ọgba ajara mi jẹ, nwọn tẹ ipin oko mi mọlẹ labẹ ẹsẹ wọn, nwọn ti sọ ipin oko mi ti mo fẹ di aginju ahoro.
entries.en: Many pastors have destroyed my vineyard, they have trodden my portion under foot, they have made my pleasant portion a desolate wilderness.

entries.yo: Nwọn ti sọ ọ di ahoro, o ṣọ̀fọ fun mi bi ahoro: gbogbo ilẹ ti di ahoro, nitori ti kò si ẹnikan ti o rò li ọkàn rẹ̀.
entries.en: They have made it desolate, and being desolate it mourneth unto me; the whole land is made desolate, because no man layeth it to heart.

entries.yo: Awọn abanijẹ ti gori gbogbo ibi giga wọnni ni ọ̀dan, nitori idà Oluwa yio pa lati ikangun de ikangun ekeji ilẹ na, alafia kò si fun gbogbo alãye.
entries.en: The spoilers are come upon all high places through the wilderness: for the sword of the LORD shall devour from the one end of the land even to the other end of the land: no flesh shall have peace.

entries.yo: Nwọn ti gbin alikama, ṣugbọn nwọn o ka ẹ́gun, nwọn ti fi irora ẹ̀dun mu ara wọn, ṣugbọn nwọn kì yio ri anfani: ki oju ki o tì nyin nitori ère nyin, nitori ibinu gbigbona Oluwa.
entries.en: They have sown wheat, but shall reap thorns: they have put themselves to pain, but shall not profit: and they shall be ashamed of your revenues because of the fierce anger of the LORD.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa wi si gbogbo awọn aladugbo buburu mi ti nwọn fi ọwọ kan ogún mi ti mo ti mu enia mi, Israeli, jogun. Sa wò o, emi o fa wọn tu kuro ni ilẹ wọn, emi o si fà ile Juda tu kuro larin wọn.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD against all mine evil neighbours, that touch the inheritance which I have caused my people Israel to inherit; Behold, I will pluck them out of their land, and pluck out the house of Judah from among them.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, nigba ti emi o ti fà wọn tu kuro tan, emi o pada, emi o si ni iyọ́nu si wọn, emi o si tun mu wọn wá, olukuluku wọn, si ogún rẹ̀, ati olukuluku si ilẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass, after that I have plucked them out I will return, and have compassion on them, and will bring them again, every man to his heritage, and every man to his land.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, bi nwọn ba ṣe ãpọn lati kọ́ ìwa enia mi, lati fi orukọ mi bura pe, Oluwa mbẹ: gẹgẹ bi nwọn ti kọ́ enia mi lati fi Baali bura; nigbana ni a o gbe wọn ró lãrin enia mi.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass, if they will diligently learn the ways of my people, to swear by my name, The LORD liveth; as they taught my people to swear by Baal; then shall they be built in the midst of my people.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi nwọn kì o gbọ́, emi o fà orilẹ-ède na tu patapata; emi o si pa wọn run, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: But if they will not obey, I will utterly pluck up and destroy that nation, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: BAYI li Oluwa wi fun mi pe: Lọ, ki o si rà àmure aṣọ ọgbọ̀, ki o si dì i mọ ẹgbẹ rẹ, ki o má si fi i sinu omi.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD unto me, Go and get thee a linen girdle, and put it upon thy loins, and put it not in water.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ li emi si rà àmure na, gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ Oluwa, emi si dì i mọ ẹgbẹ mi.
entries.en: So I got a girdle according to the word of the LORD, and put it on my loins.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ Oluwa si tọ̀ mi wa lẹ̃keji wipe:
entries.en: And the word of the LORD came unto me the second time, saying,

entries.yo: Mu amure ti iwọ ti rà, ti o wà li ẹgbẹ rẹ, ki o si dide, lọ si odò Ferate, ki o si fi i pamọ nibẹ, ninu pàlapála okuta.
entries.en: Take the girdle that thou hast got, which is upon thy loins, and arise, go to Euphrates, and hide it there in a hole of the rock.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni mo lọ, emi si fi i pamọ leti odò Ferate, gẹgẹ bi Oluwa ti paṣẹ fun mi.
entries.en: So I went, and hid it by Euphrates, as the LORD commanded me.

entries.yo: O si ṣe lẹhin ọjọ pupọ, Oluwa wi fun mi pe, Dide, lọ si odò Ferate, ki o si mu amure nì jade, ti mo paṣẹ fun ọ lati fi pamọ nibẹ.
entries.en: And it came to pass after many days, that the LORD said unto me, Arise, go to Euphrates, and take the girdle from thence, which I commanded thee to hide there.

entries.yo: Mo si lọ si odò Ferate, mo si walẹ̀, mo si mu àmure na jade kuro ni ibi ti emi ti fi i pamọ si, sa wò o, àmure na di hihù, kò si yẹ fun ohunkohun.
entries.en: Then I went to Euphrates, and digged, and took the girdle from the place where I had hid it: and, behold, the girdle was marred, it was profitable for nothing.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ọ̀rọ Oluwa tọ̀ mi wá wipe,
entries.en: Then the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa wi, Gẹgẹ bi eyi na ni emi o bà igberaga Juda jẹ, ati igberaga nla Jerusalemu.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD, After this manner will I mar the pride of Judah, and the great pride of Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Awọn enia buburu yi, ti o kọ̀ lati gbọ́ ọ̀rọ mi, ti nrin ni agidi ọkàn wọn, ti o si nrin tọ̀ awọn ọlọrun miran, lati sìn wọn ati lati foribalẹ fun wọn, yio si dabi àmure yi, ti kò yẹ fun ohunkohun.
entries.en: This evil people, which refuse to hear my words, which walk in the imagination of their heart, and walk after other gods, to serve them, and to worship them, shall even be as this girdle, which is good for nothing.

entries.yo: Nitori bi amure iti lẹ̀ mọ ẹgbẹ enia, bẹ̃ni mo ṣe ki gbogbo ile Israeli ati gbogbo ile Juda ki o lẹ̀ mọ mi lara, li Oluwa wi, ki nwọn ki o le jẹ enia mi, ati orukọ ati ogo, ati iyìn, ṣugbọn nwọn kò fẹ igbọ́.
entries.en: For as the girdle cleaveth to the loins of a man, so have I caused to cleave unto me the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah, saith the LORD; that they might be unto me for a people, and for a name, and for a praise, and for a glory: but they would not hear.

entries.yo: Nitorina ki iwọ ki o sọ ọ̀rọ yi fun wọn pe; Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun Israeli wi, Gbogbo igo ni a o fi ọti-waini kún: nwọn o si wi fun ọ pe, A kò ha mọ̀ nitõtọ pe, gbogbo igo ni a o fi ọti-waini kún?
entries.en: Therefore thou shalt speak unto them this word; Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Every bottle shall be filled with wine: and they shall say unto thee, Do we not certainly know that every bottle shall be filled with wine?

entries.yo: Nigbana ni iwọ o sọ fun wọn pe, Bayi li Oluwa wi, sa wò o, emi o fi imutipara kún gbogbo olugbe ilẹ yi, ani awọn ọba ti o joko lori itẹ Dafidi, awọn alufa ati awọn woli, pẹlu gbogbo awọn olugbe Jerusalemu.
entries.en: Then shalt thou say unto them, Thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will fill all the inhabitants of this land, even the kings that sit upon David's throne, and the priests, and the prophets, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, with drunkenness.

entries.yo: Emi o tì ekini lu ekeji, ani awọn baba ati awọn ọmọkunrin pọ̀, li Oluwa wi: emi kì yio dariji, bẹ̃ni emi kì o ṣãnu, emi kì yio ṣe iyọ́nu, lati má pa wọn run.
entries.en: And I will dash them one against another, even the fathers and the sons together, saith the LORD: I will not pity, nor spare, nor have mercy, but destroy them.

entries.yo: Ẹ gbọ́, ki ẹ si fi eti silẹ; ẹ má ṣe gberaga: nitori ti Oluwa ti sọ̀rọ.
entries.en: Hear ye, and give ear; be not proud: for the LORD hath spoken.

entries.yo: Ẹ fi ogo fun Oluwa Ọlọrun nyin, ki o to mu òkunkun wá, ati ki o to mu ẹsẹ nyin tase lori oke ṣiṣu wọnni, ati nigbati ẹnyin si nreti imọlẹ, on o sọ ọ di ojiji ikú, o si ṣe e bi òkunkun biribiri.
entries.en: Give glory to the LORD your God, before he cause darkness, and before your feet stumble upon the dark mountains, and, while ye look for light, he turn it into the shadow of death, and make it gross darkness.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi ẹnyin kì o gbọ́, ọkàn mi yio sọkun ni ibi ikọkọ, nitori igberaga na, oju mi yio sọkun kikan, yio sun omije pẹ̀rẹpẹ̀rẹ, nitori ti a kó agbo Oluwa lọ ni igbekun.
entries.en: But if ye will not hear it, my soul shall weep in secret places for your pride; and mine eye shall weep sore, and run down with tears, because the LORD's flock is carried away captive.

entries.yo: Sọ fun ọba ati fun ayaba pe, Ẹ rẹ̀ ara nyin silẹ, ẹ joko silẹ, nitori ade ogo nyin bọ́ si ilẹ lati ori nyin.
entries.en: Say unto the king and to the queen, Humble yourselves, sit down: for your principalities shall come down, even the crown of your glory.

entries.yo: Ilu gusu wọnni ni a o si mọ, kò si ẹnikan ti yio ṣe wọn: a o kó Judah lọ ni igbekun gbogbo rẹ̀, a o kó wọn lọ patapata ni igbekun.
entries.en: The cities of the south shall be shut up, and none shall open them: Judah shall be carried away captive all of it, it shall be wholly carried away captive.

entries.yo: Gbe oju nyin soke, ki ẹ si wo awọn ti mbọ̀ lati ariwa! nibo ni agbo-ẹran nì wà, ti a ti fi fun ọ, agbo-ẹran rẹ daradara?
entries.en: Lift up your eyes, and behold them that come from the north: where is the flock that was given thee, thy beautiful flock?

entries.yo: Kini iwọ o wi, nigbati on o fi awọn ti iwọ ti kọ́ lati ṣe korikosun rẹ jẹ olori lori rẹ, irora kì yio ha mu ọ bi obinrin ti nrọbi?
entries.en: What wilt thou say when he shall punish thee? for thou hast taught them to be captains, and as chief over thee: shall not sorrows take thee, as a woman in travail?

entries.yo: Bi iwọ ba si wi ninu ọkàn rẹ pe, Ẽṣe ti nkan wọnyi ṣe wá sori mi? Nitori ti ọ̀pọlọpọ ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ ni a ṣe ká aṣọ rẹ soke, ti a si fi agbara fi gigisẹ rẹ hàn ni ihoho.
entries.en: And if thou say in thine heart, Wherefore come these things upon me? For the greatness of thine iniquity are thy skirts discovered, and thy heels made bare.

entries.yo: Ara Etiopia le yi àwọ rẹ̀ pada, tabi ẹkùn le yi ilà ara rẹ̀ pada? bẹ̃ni ẹnyin pẹlu iba le ṣe rere, ẹnyin ti a kọ́ ni ìwa buburu?
entries.en: Can the Ethiopian change his skin, or the leopard his spots? then may ye also do good, that are accustomed to do evil.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni emi o tú wọn ka bi iyangbo ti nkọja lọ niwaju afẹfẹ aginju.
entries.en: Therefore will I scatter them as the stubble that passeth away by the wind of the wilderness.

entries.yo: Eyi ni ipin rẹ, apakan òṣuwọn rẹ lọwọ mi, li Oluwa wi: nitori iwọ ti gbàgbe mi, ti o si gbẹkẹle eke.
entries.en: This is thy lot, the portion of thy measures from me, saith the LORD; because thou hast forgotten me, and trusted in falsehood.

entries.yo: Nitorina emi o ka aṣọ iṣẹti rẹ loju rẹ, ki itiju rẹ ki o le hàn sode.
entries.en: Therefore will I discover thy skirts upon thy face, that thy shame may appear.

entries.yo: Emi ti ri panṣaga rẹ, ati yiyan rẹ bi ẹṣin, buburu ìwa-agbere rẹ, ati ìwa irira rẹ lori oke ati ninu oko. Egbe ni fun ọ, iwọ Jerusalemu! iwọ kò le di mimọ́, yio ha ti pẹ to!
entries.en: I have seen thine adulteries, and thy neighings, the lewdness of thy whoredom, and thine abominations on the hills in the fields. Woe unto thee, O Jerusalem! wilt thou not be made clean? when shall it once be?

entries.yo: EYI li ọ̀rọ Oluwa ti o tọ̀ Jeremiah wá nipa ti ọdá.
entries.en: The word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah concerning the dearth.

entries.yo: Juda kãnu ati ẹnu-bode rẹ̀ wọnnì si jõro, nwọn dudu de ilẹ; igbe Jerusalemu si ti goke.
entries.en: Judah mourneth, and the gates thereof languish; they are black unto the ground; and the cry of Jerusalem is gone up.

entries.yo: Awọn ọlọla wọn si ti rán awọn ọmọ wẹrẹ lọ si odò: nwọn wá si kanga, nwọn kò ri omi; nwọn pada pẹlu agbè wọn lofo, oju tì wọn, idãmu mu wọn, nwọn si bo ori wọn.
entries.en: And their nobles have sent their little ones to the waters: they came to the pits, and found no water; they returned with their vessels empty; they were ashamed and confounded, and covered their heads.

entries.yo: Nitori ilẹ, ti ndãmu gidigidi, nitoriti òjo kò si ni ilẹ, oju tì awọn àgbẹ, nwọn bo ori wọn.
entries.en: Because the ground is chapt, for there was no rain in the earth, the plowmen were ashamed, they covered their heads.

entries.yo: Lõtọ abo-àgbọnrin pẹlu ni papa bimọ, o fi i silẹ nitori ti kò si koriko.
entries.en: Yea, the hind also calved in the field, and forsook it, because there was no grass.

entries.yo: Ati awọn kẹtẹkẹtẹ-igbẹ duro lori oke wọnni, nwọn fọn imu si ẹfũfu bi ikõko, oju wọn rẹ̀ nitoriti kò si koriko.
entries.en: And the wild asses did stand in the high places, they snuffed up the wind like dragons; their eyes did fail, because there was no grass.

entries.yo: Oluwa, bi ẹ̀ṣẹ wa ti jẹri si wa to nì, ṣe atunṣe nitori orukọ rẹ: nitoriti ipẹhinda wa pọ̀; si ọ li awa ti ṣẹ̀.
entries.en: O LORD, though our iniquities testify against us, do thou it for thy name's sake: for our backslidings are many; we have sinned against thee.

entries.yo: Iwọ, ireti Israeli, olugbala rẹ̀ ni wakati ipọnju! ẽṣe ti iwọ o dabi alejo ni ilẹ, ati bi èro ti o pa agọ lati sùn?
entries.en: O the hope of Israel, the saviour thereof in time of trouble, why shouldest thou be as a stranger in the land, and as a wayfaring man that turneth aside to tarry for a night?

entries.yo: Ẽṣe ti iwọ o dabi ẹniti o dãmu, bi ọkunrin akọni ti kò le ràn ni lọwọ? sibẹ iwọ, Oluwa, mbẹ li ãrin wa, a si npè orukọ rẹ mọ wa, má fi wa silẹ.
entries.en: Why shouldest thou be as a man astonied, as a mighty man that cannot save? yet thou, O LORD, art in the midst of us, and we are called by thy name; leave us not.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa wi fun awọn enia yi, bayi ni nwọn ti fẹ lati rò kiri, nwọn kò dá ẹsẹ wọn duro; Oluwa kò si ni inu-didun ninu wọn: yio ranti aiṣedẽde wọn nisisiyi, yio si bẹ ẹ̀ṣẹ wọn wò.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD unto this people, Thus have they loved to wander, they have not refrained their feet, therefore the LORD doth not accept them; he will now remember their iniquity, and visit their sins.

entries.yo: Nigbana li Oluwa wi fun mi pe, Máṣe gbadura fun awọn enia yi fun rere.
entries.en: Then said the LORD unto me, Pray not for this people for their good.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn ba gbãwẹ, emi kì yio gbọ́ ẹ̀bẹ wọn; nigbati nwọn ba ru ẹbọ-ọrẹ sisun ati ẹbọ-ọrẹ, inu mi kì o dùn si wọn: ṣugbọn emi o fi idà, ati ìyan, ati ajakalẹ-àrun pa wọn run.
entries.en: When they fast, I will not hear their cry; and when they offer burnt offering and an oblation, I will not accept them: but I will consume them by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence.

entries.yo: Emi si wipe, Oluwa Ọlọrun, sa wò o, awọn woli wi fun wọn pe; Ẹnyin kì yio ri idà, bẹ̃li ìyan kì yio de si nyin; ṣugbọn emi o fun nyin ni alafia otitọ ni ibi yi.
entries.en: Then said I, Ah, Lord GOD! behold, the prophets say unto them, Ye shall not see the sword, neither shall ye have famine; but I will give you assured peace in this place.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Oluwa wi fun mi pe, awọn woli nsọ asọtẹlẹ eke li orukọ mi; emi kò rán wọn, bẹ̃ni emi kò paṣẹ fun wọn, emi kò si sọ̀rọ kan fun wọn, iran eke, afọṣẹ, ati ohun asan, ati ẹ̀tan inu wọn, ni awọn wọnyi sọtẹlẹ fun nyin.
entries.en: Then the LORD said unto me, The prophets prophesy lies in my name: I sent them not, neither have I commanded them, neither spake unto them: they prophesy unto you a false vision and divination, and a thing of nought, and the deceit of their heart.

entries.yo: Nitorina bayi li Oluwa wi niti awọn woli ti nsọ asọtẹlẹ li orukọ mi, ti emi kò rán; sibẹ nwọn wipe, Idà ati ìyan kì yio wá sori ilẹ yi; nipa idà, pẹlu ìyan, ni awọn woli wọnyi yio ṣegbe.
entries.en: Therefore thus saith the LORD concerning the prophets that prophesy in my name, and I sent them not, yet they say, Sword and famine shall not be in this land; By sword and famine shall those prophets be consumed.

entries.yo: Ati awọn enia ti nwọn nsọ asọtẹlẹ fun ni a o lù bolẹ ni ita Jerusalemu, nitori ìyan ati idà, nwọn kì yio ri ẹniti o sin wọn, awọn aya wọn, ati ọmọkunrin wọn, ati ọmọbinrin wọn: nitoriti emi o tu ìwa-buburu wọn jade sori wọn.
entries.en: And the people to whom they prophesy shall be cast out in the streets of Jerusalem because of the famine and the sword; and they shall have none to bury them, them, their wives, nor their sons, nor their daughters: for I will pour their wickedness upon them.

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o si sọ ọ̀rọ yi fun wọn pe: oju mi sun omije li oru ati li ọsan, kì yio si dá, nitoriti a ti ṣa wundia ọmọbinrin enia mi li ọgbẹ nla kikoro gidigidi ni lilù na.
entries.en: Therefore thou shalt say this word unto them; Let mine eyes run down with tears night and day, and let them not cease: for the virgin daughter of my people is broken with a great breach, with a very grievous blow.

entries.yo: Bi emi ba jade lọ si papa, sa wò o, a ri awọn ti a fi idà pa! bi emi ba si wọ inu ilu lọ, sa wò o, awọn ti npa ọ̀kakà ikú nitori iyan! nitori awọn, ati awọn woli, ati awọn alufa nwọ́ lọ si ilẹ ti nwọn kò mọ̀.
entries.en: If I go forth into the field, then behold the slain with the sword! and if I enter into the city, then behold them that are sick with famine! yea, both the prophet and the priest go about into a land that they know not.

entries.yo: Iwọ ha ti kọ̀ Juda silẹ patapata? ọkàn rẹ ti korira Sioni? ẽṣe ti iwọ ti lù wa, ti imularada kò si fun wa? awa nreti alafia, kò si si rere, ati fun igba imularada, ṣugbọn wò o, idãmu!
entries.en: Hast thou utterly rejected Judah? hath thy soul lothed Zion? why hast thou smitten us, and there is no healing for us? we looked for peace, and there is no good; and for the time of healing, and behold trouble!

entries.yo: Awa jẹwọ iwa buburu wa, Oluwa, ati aiṣedede awọn baba wa: nitori awa ti ṣẹ̀ si ọ.
entries.en: We acknowledge, O LORD, our wickedness, and the iniquity of our fathers: for we have sinned against thee.

entries.yo: Máṣe korira wa, nitori orukọ rẹ, máṣe gan itẹ́ ogo rẹ, ranti, ki o máṣe dà majẹmu ti o ba wa dá.
entries.en: Do not abhor us, for thy name's sake, do not disgrace the throne of thy glory: remember, break not thy covenant with us.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o le mu ojo rọ̀ ha wà lọdọ awọn oriṣa awọn keferi? tabi ọrun le rọ̀ òjo? iwọ ha kọ́, Oluwa Ọlọrun wa? awa si nreti rẹ: nitori iwọ li o da gbogbo nkan wọnyi.
entries.en: Are there any among the vanities of the Gentiles that can cause rain? or can the heavens give showers? art not thou he, O LORD our God? therefore we will wait upon thee: for thou hast made all these things.

entries.yo: OLUWA si wi fun mi pe, Bi Mose ati Samueli duro niwaju mi, sibẹ inu mi kì yio si yipada si awọn enia yi: ṣá wọn tì kuro niwaju mi, ki nwọn o si jade lọ.
entries.en: Then said the LORD unto me, Though Moses and Samuel stood before me, yet my mind could not be toward this people: cast them out of my sight, and let them go forth.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, nigbati nwọn ba wi fun ọ pe, nibo ni awa o jade lọ? ki iwọ ki o sọ fun wọn pe, Bayi li Oluwa wi; awọn ti ikú, si ikú, awọn ti idà, si idà; ati awọn ti ìyan, si ìyan, ati awọn ti igbèkun si igbèkun.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass, if they say unto thee, Whither shall we go forth? then thou shalt tell them, Thus saith the LORD; Such as are for death, to death; and such as are for the sword, to the sword; and such as are for the famine, to the famine; and such as are for the captivity, to the captivity.

entries.yo: Emi si fi iru ijiya mẹrin sori wọn, li Oluwa wi, idà lati pa, ajá lati wọ́ kiri, ẹiyẹ oju-ọrun ati ẹranko ilẹ, lati jẹ, ati lati parun.
entries.en: And I will appoint over them four kinds, saith the LORD: the sword to slay, and the dogs to tear, and the fowls of the heaven, and the beasts of the earth, to devour and destroy.

entries.yo: Emi o si fi wọn fun iwọsi ni gbogbo ijọba aiye, nitori Manasse, ọmọ Hesekiah, ọba Juda, nitori eyiti o ti ṣe ni Jerusalemu.
entries.en: And I will cause them to be removed into all kingdoms of the earth, because of Manasseh the son of Hezekiah king of Judah, for that which he did in Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Nitori tani yio ṣãnu fun ọ, iwọ Jerusalemu? tabi ti yio sọkun rẹ? tabi tani yio wá lati bere alafia rẹ.
entries.en: For who shall have pity upon thee, O Jerusalem? or who shall bemoan thee? or who shall go aside to ask how thou doest?

entries.yo: Iwọ ti kọ̀ mi silẹ, li Oluwa wi, iwọ ti pada sẹhin; nitorina emi o ná ọwọ mi si ọ, emi o si pa ọ run; ãrẹ̀ mu mi lati ṣe iyọnu.
entries.en: Thou hast forsaken me, saith the LORD, thou art gone backward: therefore will I stretch out my hand against thee, and destroy thee; I am weary with repenting.

entries.yo: Emi o fi atẹ fẹ́ wọn si ẹnu-ọ̀na ilẹ na; emi o pa awọn ọmọ wọn, emi o si pa enia mi run, ẹniti kò yipada kuro ninu ọ̀na rẹ̀.
entries.en: And I will fan them with a fan in the gates of the land; I will bereave them of children, I will destroy my people, since they return not from their ways.

entries.yo: Awọn opo rẹ̀ o di pipọ ju iyanrin eti okun: emi o mu arunni wa sori wọn, sori iyá ati ọdọmọkunrin li ọjọkanri; emi o mu ifoya ati ìbẹru nla ṣubu lu wọn li ojiji.
entries.en: Their widows are increased to me above the sand of the seas: I have brought upon them against the mother of the young men a spoiler at noonday: I have caused him to fall upon it suddenly, and terrors upon the city.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o bi meje nṣọ̀fọ o si jọwọ ẹmi rẹ̀ lọwọ; õrùn rẹ̀ wọ̀ l'ọsan, oju ntì i, o si ndamu: iyoku ninu wọn l'emi o si fifun idà niwaju awọn ọta wọn, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: She that hath borne seven languisheth: she hath given up the ghost; her sun is gone down while it was yet day: she hath been ashamed and confounded: and the residue of them will I deliver to the sword before their enemies, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Egbe ni fun mi, iyá mi, ti o bi mi ni ọkunrin ija ati ijiyan gbogbo aiye! emi kò win li elé, bẹ̃ni enia kò win mi li elé; sibẹ gbogbo wọn nfi mi ré.
entries.en: Woe is me, my mother, that thou hast borne me a man of strife and a man of contention to the whole earth! I have neither lent on usury, nor men have lent to me on usury; yet every one of them doth curse me.

entries.yo: Oluwa ni, Emi kì o tú ọ silẹ fun rere! emi o mu ki ọta ki o bẹ̀ ọ ni ìgba ibi ati ni ìgba ipọnju!
entries.en: The LORD said, Verily it shall be well with thy remnant; verily I will cause the enemy to entreat thee well in the time of evil and in the time of affliction.

entries.yo: A ha le ṣẹ irin, irin ariwa, ati idẹ bi?
entries.en: Shall iron break the northern iron and the steel?

entries.yo: Ohun-ini ati iṣura rẹ li emi o fi fun ijẹ, li aigbowo, nitori gbogbo ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ ni àgbegbe rẹ.
entries.en: Thy substance and thy treasures will I give to the spoil without price, and that for all thy sins, even in all thy borders.

entries.yo: Emi o si mu ki awọn ọta rẹ kó wọn lọ si ilẹ ti iwọ kò mọ̀: nitoriti iná njo ni ibinu mi, ti yio jo lori rẹ.
entries.en: And I will make thee to pass with thine enemies into a land which thou knowest not: for a fire is kindled in mine anger, which shall burn upon you.

entries.yo: Oluwa, iwọ mọ̀, ranti mi, bẹ̀ mi wò, ki o si gbẹsan mi lara awọn oninunibini mi! máṣe mu mi kuro nitori ipamọra rẹ: mọ̀ pe, mo ti jiya itiju nitori rẹ!
entries.en: O LORD, thou knowest: remember me, and visit me, and revenge me of my persecutors; take me not away in thy longsuffering: know that for thy sake I have suffered rebuke.

entries.yo: Nigbati a ri ọ̀rọ rẹ, emi si jẹ wọn, ọ̀rọ rẹ si jẹ inu didùn mi, nitori orukọ rẹ li a fi npè mi, iwọ Oluwa, Ọlọrun awọn ọmọ-ogun!
entries.en: Thy words were found, and I did eat them; and thy word was unto me the joy and rejoicing of mine heart: for I am called by thy name, O LORD God of hosts.

entries.yo: Emi kò joko ni ajọ awọn ẹlẹgan! ki emi si ni ayọ̀; mo joko emi nikan, nitori ọwọ rẹ: nitori iwọ ti fi ibanujẹ kún mi.
entries.en: I sat not in the assembly of the mockers, nor rejoiced; I sat alone because of thy hand: for thou hast filled me with indignation.

entries.yo: Ẽṣe ti irora mi pẹ́ titi, ati ọgbẹ mi jẹ alaiwotan, ti o kọ̀ lati jina? lõtọ iwọ si dabi kanga ẹ̀tan fun mi, bi omi ti kò duro?
entries.en: Why is my pain perpetual, and my wound incurable, which refuseth to be healed? wilt thou be altogether unto me as a liar, and as waters that fail?

entries.yo: Nitorina, bayi li Oluwa wi, Bi iwọ ba yipada, nigbana li emi o si tun mu ọ pada wá, iwọ o si duro niwaju mi: bi iwọ ba si yà eyi ti iṣe iyebiye kuro ninu buburu, iwọ o dabi ẹnu mi: nwọn o si yipada si ọ; ṣugbọn iwọ máṣe yipada si wọn.
entries.en: Therefore thus saith the LORD, If thou return, then will I bring thee again, and thou shalt stand before me: and if thou take forth the precious from the vile, thou shalt be as my mouth: let them return unto thee; but return not thou unto them.

entries.yo: Emi o si ṣe ọ fun awọn enia yi bi odi idẹ ati alagbara: nwọn o si ba ọ jà, ṣugbọn nwọn kì yio le bori rẹ, nitori emi wà pẹlu rẹ, lati gbà ọ là ati lati gbà ọ silẹ, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: And I will make thee unto this people a fenced brasen wall: and they shall fight against thee, but they shall not prevail against thee: for I am with thee to save thee and to deliver thee, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Emi o si gba ọ silẹ kuro lọwọ awọn enia buburu, emi o si rà ọ pada kuro lọwọ awọn ìka.
entries.en: And I will deliver thee out of the hand of the wicked, and I will redeem thee out of the hand of the terrible.

entries.yo: Ọ̀RỌ Oluwa tọ̀ mi wá wipe:
entries.en: The word of the LORD came also unto me, saying,

entries.yo: Iwọ kò gbọdọ ni aya, bẹ̃ni iwọ kò gbọdọ ni ọmọkunrin tabi ọmọbinrin ni ihinyi.
entries.en: Thou shalt not take thee a wife, neither shalt thou have sons or daughters in this place.

entries.yo: Nitori bayi li Oluwa wi niti ọmọkunrin ati ọmọbinrin ti a bi ni ihinyi, ati niti awọn iya wọn ti o bi wọn, ati niti awọn baba wọn ti o bi wọn ni ilẹ yi.
entries.en: For thus saith the LORD concerning the sons and concerning the daughters that are born in this place, and concerning their mothers that bare them, and concerning their fathers that begat them in this land;

entries.yo: Nwọn o kú ikú àrun; a kì yio ṣọ̀fọ wọn; bẹ̃ni a kì yio si sin wọn; nwọn o si di àtan lori ilẹ: a o fi idà ati ìyan run wọn, ati okú wọn yio di onjẹ fun ẹiyẹ oju-ọrun, ati fun ẹranko ilẹ.
entries.en: They shall die of grievous deaths; they shall not be lamented; neither shall they be buried; but they shall be as dung upon the face of the earth: and they shall be consumed by the sword, and by famine; and their carcases shall be meat for the fowls of heaven, and for the beasts of the earth.

entries.yo: Nitori bayi li Oluwa wi, máṣe wọ inu ile ãwẹ̀, bẹ̃ni ki iwọ máṣe lọ sọ̀fọ, tabi lọ pohùnrere ẹkun wọn; nitori emi ti mu alafia mi kuro lọdọ enia yi, li Oluwa wi, ani ãnu ati iyọ́nu.
entries.en: For thus saith the LORD, Enter not into the house of mourning, neither go to lament nor bemoan them: for I have taken away my peace from this people, saith the LORD, even lovingkindness and mercies.

entries.yo: Ati ẹni-nla ati ẹni-kekere yio kú ni ilẹ yi, a kì yio sin wọn, bẹ̃ni nwọn kì yio fá ori wọn nitori wọn.
entries.en: Both the great and the small shall die in this land: they shall not be buried, neither shall men lament for them, nor cut themselves, nor make themselves bald for them:

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni ẹnikan kì yio bu àkara lati ṣọ̀fọ fun wọn, lati tù wọn ninu nitori okú; bẹ̃ni ẹnikan kì yio fun wọn ni ago itunu mu nitori baba wọn, tabi nitori iya wọn.
entries.en: Neither shall men tear themselves for them in mourning, to comfort them for the dead; neither shall men give them the cup of consolation to drink for their father or for their mother.

entries.yo: Iwọ kò gbọdọ lọ sinu ile àse, lati joko pẹlu wọn lati jẹ ati lati mu.
entries.en: Thou shalt not also go into the house of feasting, to sit with them to eat and to drink.

entries.yo: Nitori bayi li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun, Ọlọrun Israeli, wi; Sa wò o, emi o mu ohùn inudidùn, ati ohùn ayọ̀, ohùn ọkọ-iyawo, ati ohùn iyawo dakẹ ni ihinyi loju nyin ati li ọjọ nyin.
entries.en: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will cause to cease out of this place in your eyes, and in your days, the voice of mirth, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, nigbati iwọ o ba fi gbogbo ọ̀rọ wọnyi han enia yi, nwọn o wi fun ọ pe, Ẽṣe ti Oluwa fi sọ̀rọ gbogbo ohun buburu nla yi si wa, tabi kini aiṣedede wa? tabi ẹ̀ṣẹ kini awa da si Oluwa Ọlọrun wa?
entries.en: And it shall come to pass, when thou shalt shew this people all these words, and they shall say unto thee, Wherefore hath the LORD pronounced all this great evil against us? or what is our iniquity? or what is our sin that we have committed against the LORD our God?

entries.yo: Nigbana ni iwọ o wi fun wọn pe, Nitoripe awọn baba nyin ti kọ̀ mi silẹ, li Oluwa wi, ti nwọn si rìn tọ̀ ọlọrun miran lọ, ti nwọn si sìn wọn, ti nwọn si foribalẹ fun wọn, ti nwọn kọ̀ mi silẹ, ti nwọn kò pa ofin mi mọ;
entries.en: Then shalt thou say unto them, Because your fathers have forsaken me, saith the LORD, and have walked after other gods, and have served them, and have worshipped them, and have forsaken me, and have not kept my law;

entries.yo: Ati pẹlu pe, ẹnyin ti ṣe buburu jù awọn baba nyin lọ: nitorina sa wò o, ẹnyin rìn olukuluku nyin, ni agidi ọkàn buburu rẹ̀, ki ẹnyin ki o má ba gbọ́ temi:
entries.en: And ye have done worse than your fathers; for, behold, ye walk every one after the imagination of his evil heart, that they may not hearken unto me:

entries.yo: Emi o si ta nyin nu kuro ni ilẹ yi, sinu ilẹ ti ẹnyin kò mọ̀, ẹnyin tabi awọn baba nyin, nibẹ li ẹnyin o sin ọlọrun miran, lọsan ati loru nibiti emi kì yio ṣe oju-rere fun nyin.
entries.en: Therefore will I cast you out of this land into a land that ye know not, neither ye nor your fathers; and there shall ye serve other gods day and night; where I will not shew you favour.

entries.yo: Nitorina, sa wò o, Bayi li Oluwa wi, ọjọ mbọ̀, ti a kì o wi mọ́ pe, Oluwa mbẹ ti o mu awọn ọmọ Israeli jade kuro ni ilẹ Egipti;
entries.en: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that it shall no more be said, The LORD liveth, that brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn, Oluwa mbẹ ti o mu awọn ọmọ Israeli jade wá kuro ni ilẹ ariwa, ati kuro ni ilẹ nibiti o ti lé wọn si: emi o si tun mu wọn wá si ilẹ wọn, eyiti mo fi fun awọn baba wọn.
entries.en: But, The LORD liveth, that brought up the children of Israel from the land of the north, and from all the lands whither he had driven them: and I will bring them again into their land that I gave unto their fathers.

entries.yo: Sa wò o, emi o ran apẹja pupọ, li Oluwa wi, nwọn o si dẹ wọn: lẹhin eyini, emi o rán ọdẹ pupọ, nwọn o si dẹ wọn lati ori oke-nla gbogbo, ati ori oke kekere gbogbo, ati lati inu palapala okuta jade.
entries.en: Behold, I will send for many fishers, saith the LORD, and they shall fish them; and after will I send for many hunters, and they shall hunt them from every mountain, and from every hill, and out of the holes of the rocks.

entries.yo: Nitoriti oju mi mbẹ lara ọ̀na wọn gbogbo: nwọn kò pamọ kuro niwaju mi, bẹ̃ni ẹ̀ṣẹ wọn kò farasin kuro li oju mi.
entries.en: For mine eyes are upon all their ways: they are not hid from my face, neither is their iniquity hid from mine eyes.

entries.yo: Li atetekọṣe, emi o san ẹsan ìwa buburu mejeji wọn, ani, ẹ̀ṣẹ wọn nitoriti nwọn ti bà ilẹ mi jẹ, nwọn ti fi okú ati ohun ẹgbin ati irira wọn kún ilẹ ini mi.
entries.en: And first I will recompense their iniquity and their sin double; because they have defiled my land, they have filled mine inheritance with the carcases of their detestable and abominable things.

entries.yo: Oluwa, agbara mi ati ilu-odi mi! àbo mi li ọjọ ipọnju! awọn orilẹ-ède yio tọ̀ ọ wá, lati ipẹkun aiye, nwọn o si wipe, Lõtọ, awọn baba wa ti jogun eke, ohun asan, iranlọwọ kò si si ninu wọn!
entries.en: O LORD, my strength, and my fortress, and my refuge in the day of affliction, the Gentiles shall come unto thee from the ends of the earth, and shall say, Surely our fathers have inherited lies, vanity, and things wherein there is no profit.

entries.yo: Enia lè ma dá ọlọrun fun ara rẹ̀: nitori awọn wọnyi kì iṣe ọlọrun?
entries.en: Shall a man make gods unto himself, and they are no gods?

entries.yo: Nitorina, sa wò o, emi o mu ki nwọn ki o mọ̀, lẹ̃kan yi, emi o si mu ki nwọn ki o mọ̀ ọwọ mi ati ipa mi; nwọn o si mọ̀ pe, orukọ mi ni JEHOFA.
entries.en: Therefore, behold, I will this once cause them to know, I will cause them to know mine hand and my might; and they shall know that my name is The LORD.

entries.yo: Ẹ̀ṢẸ Juda ni a fi kalamu irin kọ, a fi ṣonṣo okuta adamante gbẹ ẹ sori walã aiya wọn, ati sori iwo pẹpẹ nyin.
entries.en: The sin of Judah is written with a pen of iron, and with the point of a diamond: it is graven upon the table of their heart, and upon the horns of your altars;

entries.yo: Bi awọn ọmọ wọn ba ranti pẹpẹ wọn, ati ere òriṣa wọn, lẹba igi tutu, ati ibi giga wọnni.
entries.en: Whilst their children remember their altars and their groves by the green trees upon the high hills.

entries.yo: Oke mi ti o wà ni papa! emi o fi ohun-ini rẹ pẹlu ọrọ̀ rẹ gbogbo fun ijẹ, ati ibi giga rẹ, nitori ẹ̀ṣẹ yi gbogbo àgbegbe rẹ ka.
entries.en: O my mountain in the field, I will give thy substance and all thy treasures to the spoil, and thy high places for sin, throughout all thy borders.

entries.yo: Iwọ fun ara rẹ ni yio jọ̃ ogún rẹ lọwọ, ti mo ti fi fun ọ, emi o mu ọ sìn awọn ọta rẹ ni ilẹ ti iwọ kò mọ̀ ri: nitoriti ẹnyin ti tinabọ ibinu mi, ti yio jo lailai.
entries.en: And thou, even thyself, shalt discontinue from thine heritage that I gave thee; and I will cause thee to serve thine enemies in the land which thou knowest not: for ye have kindled a fire in mine anger, which shall burn for ever.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa wi: Egbe ni fun ẹniti o gbẹkẹle enia, ti o fi ẹlẹran ara ṣe apá rẹ̀, ẹniti ọkàn rẹ̀ si ṣi kuro lọdọ Oluwa!
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD; Cursed be the man that trusteth in man, and maketh flesh his arm, and whose heart departeth from the LORD.

entries.yo: Nitoripe yio dabi alaini ni aginju, ti kò si ri pe rere mbọ̀: ṣugbọn yio gbe ibi iyangbẹ ilẹ wọnni ni aginju, ilẹ iyọ̀ ti a kì igbe inu rẹ̀.
entries.en: For he shall be like the heath in the desert, and shall not see when good cometh; but shall inhabit the parched places in the wilderness, in a salt land and not inhabited.

entries.yo: Ibukun ni fun ẹniti o gbẹkẹle Oluwa, ti o si fi Oluwa ṣe igbẹkẹle rẹ̀!
entries.en: Blessed is the man that trusteth in the LORD, and whose hope the LORD is.

entries.yo: Yio si dabi igi ti a gbìn lẹba omi, ti o nà gbòngbo rẹ̀ lẹba odò, ti kì yio bẹ̀ru bi õru ba de, ṣugbọn ewe rẹ̀ yio tutu, kì yio si ni ijaya ni ọdun ọ̀dá, bẹ̃ni kì yio dẹkun lati ma so eso.
entries.en: For he shall be as a tree planted by the waters, and that spreadeth out her roots by the river, and shall not see when heat cometh, but her leaf shall be green; and shall not be careful in the year of drought, neither shall cease from yielding fruit.

entries.yo: Ọkàn enia kún fun ẹ̀tan jù ohun gbogbo lọ, o si buru jayi! tani o le mọ̀ ọ?
entries.en: The heart is deceitful above all things, and desperately wicked: who can know it?

entries.yo: Emi, Oluwa, ni iwá awari ọkàn enia, emi ni ndan inu wò, ani lati fi fun olukuluku gẹgẹ bi ọ̀na rẹ̀, ati gẹgẹ bi eso iṣe rẹ̀.
entries.en: I the LORD search the heart, I try the reins, even to give every man according to his ways, and according to the fruit of his doings.

entries.yo: Bi aparo ti isaba lori ẹyin ti kò yin, bẹ̃ gẹgẹ ni ẹniti o kó ọrọ̀ jọ, ṣugbọn kì iṣe ni ododo; yio fi i silẹ lagbedemeji ọjọ rẹ̀, ati ni opin rẹ̀ yio jẹ aṣiwere.
entries.en: As the partridge sitteth on eggs, and hatcheth them not; so he that getteth riches, and not by right, shall leave them in the midst of his days, and at his end shall be a fool.

entries.yo: Itẹ́ ogo! ibi giga lati ipilẹsẹ ni ibi ile mimọ́ wa!
entries.en: A glorious high throne from the beginning is the place of our sanctuary.

entries.yo: Oluwa ni ireti Israeli! gbogbo awọn ti o kọ̀ ọ silẹ yio dãmu, awọn ti o yẹ̀ kuro lọdọ mi, ni a o kọ orukọ wọn sinu ẽkuru, si ori ilẹ, nitori nwọn ti kọ̀ Oluwa silẹ, orisun omi ìye.
entries.en: O LORD, the hope of Israel, all that forsake thee shall be ashamed, and they that depart from me shall be written in the earth, because they have forsaken the LORD, the fountain of living waters.

entries.yo: Wò mi sàn, Oluwa, emi o si sàn! gbà mi là, emi o si là, nitori iwọ ni iyìn mi!
entries.en: Heal me, O LORD, and I shall be healed; save me, and I shall be saved: for thou art my praise.

entries.yo: Sa wò o, nwọn wi fun mi pe, Nibo ni ọ̀rọ Oluwa wà? jẹ ki o wá wayi.
entries.en: Behold, they say unto me, Where is the word of the LORD? let it come now.

entries.yo: Bi o ṣe ti emi ni, emi kò yara kuro ki emi má ṣe oluṣọ-agutan, lẹhin rẹ, bẹ̃ni emi kò bere ọjọ ipọnju, iwọ mọ̀: eyiti o jade li ète mi, o ti hàn niwaju rẹ.
entries.en: As for me, I have not hastened from being a pastor to follow thee: neither have I desired the woeful day; thou knowest: that which came out of my lips was right before thee.

entries.yo: Máṣe di ibẹ̀ru fun mi! iwọ ni ireti mi li ọjọ ibi!
entries.en: Be not a terror unto me: thou art my hope in the day of evil.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki oju ki o tì awọn ti o nṣe inunibini si mi, ṣugbọn má jẹ ki oju ki o tì mi: jẹ ki nwọn ki o dãmu, ṣugbọn máṣe jẹ ki emi ki o dãmu: mu ọjọ ibi wá sori wọn, ki o si fi iparun iṣẹpo meji pa wọn run.
entries.en: Let them be confounded that persecute me, but let not me be confounded: let them be dismayed, but let not me be dismayed: bring upon them the day of evil, and destroy them with double destruction.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa wi fun mi; Lọ, ki o si duro ni ẹnu-ọ̀na awọn enia nibi ti awọn ọba Juda nwọle, ti nwọn si njade, ati ni gbogbo ẹnu-bode Jerusalemu.
entries.en: Thus said the LORD unto me; Go and stand in the gate of the children of the people, whereby the kings of Judah come in, and by the which they go out, and in all the gates of Jerusalem;

entries.yo: Ki o si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ gbọ́ ọ̀rọ Oluwa, ẹnyin ọba Juda ati gbogbo Juda, ati gbogbo ẹnyin olugbe Jerusalemu, ti o nkọja ninu ẹnu-bode wọnyi.
entries.en: And say unto them, Hear ye the word of the LORD, ye kings of Judah, and all Judah, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, that enter in by these gates:

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa wi, Ẹ kiyesi li ọkàn nyin, ki ẹ máṣe ru ẹrù li ọjọ isimi, bẹ̃ni ki ẹ má si ṣe mu u wá ninu ẹnu-bode Jerusalemu:
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD; Take heed to yourselves, and bear no burden on the sabbath day, nor bring it in by the gates of Jerusalem;

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni ki ẹ má si ṣe gbe ẹrù jade kuro ninu ile nyin li ọjọ isimi, bẹ̃ni ki ẹ má ṣe iṣẹkiṣẹ, ṣugbọn ki ẹ yà ọjọ isimi si mimọ́, gẹgẹ bi mo ti paṣẹ fun awọn baba nyin.
entries.en: Neither carry forth a burden out of your houses on the sabbath day, neither do ye any work, but hallow ye the sabbath day, as I commanded your fathers.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nwọn kò gbọ́, nwọn kò si tẹti silẹ, nwọn mu ọrun wọn le, ki nwọn ki o má ba gbọ́, ati ki nwọn o má bà gba ẹ̀kọ́.
entries.en: But they obeyed not, neither inclined their ear, but made their neck stiff, that they might not hear, nor receive instruction.
