entries.yo: Yio si ṣe bi ẹnyin ba tẹtisilẹ gidigidi si mi, li Oluwa wi, ti ẹ kò ba ru ẹrù kọja ni ẹnu-bode ilu yi li ọjọ isimi, ti ẹ ba si yà ọjọ isimi si mimọ, ti ẹ kò si ṣe iṣẹkiṣẹ ninu rẹ̀,
entries.en: And it shall come to pass, if ye diligently hearken unto me, saith the LORD, to bring in no burden through the gates of this city on the sabbath day, but hallow the sabbath day, to do no work therein;

entries.yo: Nigbana ni nwọn o wọ ẹnu-bode ilu yi, ani ọba, ati ijoye ti o joko lori itẹ Dafidi, awọn ti ngun kẹ̀kẹ ati ẹṣin, awọn wọnyi pẹlu ijoye wọn, awọn ọkunrin Juda, ati olugbe Jerusalemu: nwọn o si ma gbe ilu yi lailai.
entries.en: Then shall there enter into the gates of this city kings and princes sitting upon the throne of David, riding in chariots and on horses, they, and their princes, the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem: and this city shall remain for ever.

entries.yo: Nwọn o si wá lati ilu Juda wọnni, ati lati àgbegbe Jerusalemu yikakiri, ati lati ilẹ Benjamini, lati pẹtẹlẹ, ati lati oke, ati lati gusu wá, nwọn o si mu ọrẹ-ẹbọ sisun, ati ọrẹ ẹran ati turari, ati awọn wọnyi ti o mu iyìn wá si ile Oluwa.
entries.en: And they shall come from the cities of Judah, and from the places about Jerusalem, and from the land of Benjamin, and from the plain, and from the mountains, and from the south, bringing burnt offerings, and sacrifices, and meat offerings, and incense, and bringing sacrifices of praise, unto the house of the LORD.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi ẹnyin kò ba gbọ́ ti emi, lati ya ọjọ isimi si mimọ́, ti ẹ kò si ru ẹrù, ti ẹ kò tilẹ wọ ẹnu-bode Jerusalemu li ọjọ isimi; nigbana ni emi o da iná ni ẹnu-bode wọnni, yio si jo ãfin Jerusalemu run, a kì o si pa a.
entries.en: But if ye will not hearken unto me to hallow the sabbath day, and not to bear a burden, even entering in at the gates of Jerusalem on the sabbath day; then will I kindle a fire in the gates thereof, and it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem, and it shall not be quenched.

entries.yo: Ọ̀RỌ ti o tọ̀ Jeremiah wá lati ọdọ̀ Oluwa wipe,
entries.en: The word which came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,

entries.yo: Dide, sọkalẹ lọ si ile amọkoko, nibẹ li emi o mu ọ gbọ́ ọ̀rọ mi.
entries.en: Arise, and go down to the potter's house, and there I will cause thee to hear my words.

entries.yo: Mo si sọkalẹ lọ si ile amọkoko, sa wò o, o mọ iṣẹ kan lori kẹ̀kẹ.
entries.en: Then I went down to the potter's house, and, behold, he wrought a work on the wheels.

entries.yo: Ati ohun-èlo, ti o fi amọ mọ, si bajẹ lọwọ amọkoko na: nigbana ni o si mọ ohun-elo miran, bi o ti ri li oju amọkoko lati mọ ọ.
entries.en: And the vessel that he made of clay was marred in the hand of the potter: so he made it again another vessel, as seemed good to the potter to make it.

entries.yo: Ọrọ Oluwa si tọ̀ mi wá wipe,
entries.en: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

entries.yo: Ẹnyin ile Israeli, emi kò ha le fi nyin ṣe gẹgẹ bi amọkoko yi ti ṣe, li Oluwa wi: sa wò o, gẹgẹ bi amọ̀ li ọwọ amọkoko, bẹ̃ni ẹnyin wà li ọwọ mi, ile Israeli.
entries.en: O house of Israel, cannot I do with you as this potter? saith the LORD. Behold, as the clay is in the potter's hand, so are ye in mine hand, O house of Israel.

entries.yo: Lojukanna ti emi sọ̀rọ si orilẹ-ède kan ati si ijọba kan lati fà a tu, ati lati fà a lulẹ, ati lati pa a run.
entries.en: At what instant I shall speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to pluck up, and to pull down, and to destroy it;

entries.yo: Bi orilẹ-ède na ti mo ti sọ ọ̀rọ si ba yipada kuro ninu ìwa-buburu rẹ̀, emi o yi ọkàn mi pada niti ibi ti emi ti rò lati ṣe si wọn.
entries.en: If that nation, against whom I have pronounced, turn from their evil, I will repent of the evil that I thought to do unto them.

entries.yo: Ati lojukanna ti emi sọ ọ̀rọ si orilẹ-ède kan ati si ijọba kan, lati tẹ̀ ẹ do ati lati gbìn i.
entries.en: And at what instant I shall speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to build and to plant it;

entries.yo: Bi o ba ṣe ibi niwaju mi, ti kò si gbà ohùn mi gbọ́: nigbana ni emi o yi ọkàn mi pada niti rere, eyiti mo wi pe, emi o ṣe fun wọn.
entries.en: If it do evil in my sight, that it obey not my voice, then I will repent of the good, wherewith I said I would benefit them.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, sa sọ fun awọn enia Juda, ati fun awọn olugbe Jerusalemu wipe, Bayi li Oluwa wi, sa wò o, emi npete ibi si nyin, emi si nṣe ipinnu kan si nyin, si yipada, olukuluku kuro ninu ọ̀na buburu rẹ̀, ki ẹ si tun ọ̀na ati iṣe nyin ṣe rere.
entries.en: Now therefore go to, speak to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying, Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I frame evil against you, and devise a device against you: return ye now every one from his evil way, and make your ways and your doings good.

entries.yo: Nwọn si wipe: Lasan ni: nitori awa o rìn nipa ipinnu wa, olukuluku yio si huwa agidi ọkàn buburu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And they said, There is no hope: but we will walk after our own devices, and we will every one do the imagination of his evil heart.

entries.yo: Nitorina bayi li Oluwa wí, Ẹ sa bère ninu awọn orilẹ-ède, tani gbọ́ iru ohun wọnni: wundia Israeli ti ṣe ohun kan ti o buru jayi.
entries.en: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Ask ye now among the heathen, who hath heard such things: the virgin of Israel hath done a very horrible thing.

entries.yo: Omi ojo-didì Lebanoni yio ha dá lati ma ṣàn lati apata oko? tabi odò ti o jina, ti o tutu, ti o nṣan, yio ha gbẹ bi?
entries.en: Will a man leave the snow of Lebanon which cometh from the rock of the field? or shall the cold flowing waters that come from another place be forsaken?

entries.yo: Nitoripe awọn enia mi gbàgbe mi, nwọn ti sun turari fun ohun asan, nwọn si ti mu ki nwọn ki o ṣubu loju ọ̀na wọn, ni ipa igbãni; lati rìn ni ipa ti a kò tẹ́.
entries.en: Because my people hath forgotten me, they have burned incense to vanity, and they have caused them to stumble in their ways from the ancient paths, to walk in paths, in a way not cast up;

entries.yo: Lati sọ ilẹ wọn di ahoro, ati ẹ̀gan lailai; olukuluku ẹniti o ba kọja nibẹ, yio dãmu yio mì ori rẹ̀ si i.
entries.en: To make their land desolate, and a perpetual hissing; every one that passeth thereby shall be astonished, and wag his head.

entries.yo: Emi o tú wọn ka gẹgẹ bi ẹ̀fufu ila-õrùn niwaju ọta wọn; emi o kọ ẹ̀hin mi si wọn, kì yio ṣe oju mi, ni ọjọ iparun wọn.
entries.en: I will scatter them as with an east wind before the enemy; I will shew them the back, and not the face, in the day of their calamity.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni nwọn wipe, Wá, ẹ jẹ ki a pinnu ìwa ibi si Jeremiah, nitori ofin kì yio ṣegbe lọwọ alufa, tabi igbimọ lọwọ ọlọgbọ́n, tabi ọ̀rọ lọwọ woli: ẹ wá, ẹ jẹ ki a fi ahọn wa lù u, ki a má si kiyesi ohun kan ninu ọ̀rọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Then said they, Come, and let us devise devices against Jeremiah; for the law shall not perish from the priest, nor counsel from the wise, nor the word from the prophet. Come, and let us smite him with the tongue, and let us not give heed to any of his words.

entries.yo: Kiyesi mi, Oluwa, ki o si gbọ́ ohùn awọn ti nni mi lara.
entries.en: Give heed to me, O LORD, and hearken to the voice of them that contend with me.

entries.yo: A ha le fi ibi san rere? nitori nwọn ti wà iho fun ẹmi mi. Ranti pe emi ti duro niwaju rẹ lati sọ ohun rere nipa ti wọn, ati lati yi ibinu rẹ kuro lọdọ wọn.
entries.en: Shall evil be recompensed for good? for they have digged a pit for my soul. Remember that I stood before thee to speak good for them, and to turn away thy wrath from them.

entries.yo: Nitorina, fi awọn ọmọ wọn fun ìyan, ki o si fi idà pa wọn, jẹ ki aya wọn ki o di alailọmọ ati opó: ki a si fi ìka pa awọn ọkunrin wọn, jẹ ki a fi idà pa awọn ọdọmọde wọn li ogun.
entries.en: Therefore deliver up their children to the famine, and pour out their blood by the force of the sword; and let their wives be bereaved of their children, and be widows; and let their men be put to death; let their young men be slain by the sword in battle.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki a gbọ́ igbe lati ilẹ wọn, nigbati iwọ o mu ẹgbẹ kan wá lojiji sori wọn: nitori nwọn ti wà ihò lati mu mi, nwọn si dẹ okùn fun ẹsẹ mi.
entries.en: Let a cry be heard from their houses, when thou shalt bring a troop suddenly upon them: for they have digged a pit to take me, and hid snares for my feet.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nisisiyi, Oluwa, iwọ mọ̀ gbogbo igbimọ wọn si mi lati pa mi, máṣe bò ẹbi wọn mọlẹ, bẹ̃ni ki iwọ máṣe pa ẹṣẹ wọn rẹ́ kuro niwaju rẹ, jẹ ki nwọn ki o ṣubu niwaju rẹ, bẹ̃ni ki iwọ ki o ṣe si wọn ni ọjọ ibinu rẹ.
entries.en: Yet, LORD, thou knowest all their counsel against me to slay me: forgive not their iniquity, neither blot out their sin from thy sight, but let them be overthrown before thee; deal thus with them in the time of thine anger.

entries.yo: BAYI li Oluwa wi, Lọ, rà igo amọ ti amọkoko, si mu ninu awọn àgba enia, ati awọn àgba alufa;
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD, Go and get a potter's earthen bottle, and take of the ancients of the people, and of the ancients of the priests;

entries.yo: Ki o si lọ si afonifoji ọmọ Hinnomu ti o wà niwaju ẹnu-bode Harsiti, nibẹ ni ki o si kede gbogbo ọ̀rọ ti emi o sọ fun ọ.
entries.en: And go forth unto the valley of the son of Hinnom, which is by the entry of the east gate, and proclaim there the words that I shall tell thee,

entries.yo: Ki o si wipe, Ẹ gbọ́ ọ̀rọ Oluwa, ẹnyin ọba Juda, ati olugbe Jerusalemu; Bayi li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun, Ọlọrun Israeli, wi: sa wò o, emi o mu ibi wá sihin yi, eyiti eti gbogbo awọn ti o ba gbọ́ ọ, yio ho.
entries.en: And say, Hear ye the word of the LORD, O kings of Judah, and inhabitants of Jerusalem; Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, the which whosoever heareth, his ears shall tingle.

entries.yo: Nitori nwọn ti kọ̀ mi silẹ, nwọn ti sọ ihín yi di iyapa, nwọn si ti sun turari ninu rẹ̀ fun awọn ọlọrun miran, eyiti awọn, tabi awọn baba wọn kò mọ̀ ri, tabi awọn ọba Juda, nwọn si ti fi ẹ̀jẹ alaiṣẹ kún ibi yi;
entries.en: Because they have forsaken me, and have estranged this place, and have burned incense in it unto other gods, whom neither they nor their fathers have known, nor the kings of Judah, and have filled this place with the blood of innocents;

entries.yo: Nwọn ti kọ́ ibi giga fun Baali pẹlu, lati fi iná sun ọmọkunrin wọn, bi ẹbọ-ọrẹ sisun fun Baali, eyiti emi kò pa laṣẹ lati ṣe, ti emi kò si sọ, tabi ti kò si ru soke ninu mi:
entries.en: They have built also the high places of Baal, to burn their sons with fire for burnt offerings unto Baal, which I commanded not, nor spake it, neither came it into my mind:

entries.yo: Nitorina, sa wò o, ọjọ mbọ̀, li Oluwa wi, a kì yio pe orukọ ibi yi ni Tofeti mọ, tabi afonifoji ọmọ Hinnomu, ṣugbọn Afonifoji ipakupa.
entries.en: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that this place shall no more be called Tophet, nor The valley of the son of Hinnom, but The valley of slaughter.

entries.yo: Emi o sọ igbimọ Juda ati Jerusalemu di asan ni ibi yi; emi o mu ki nwọn ki o ṣubu niwaju ọta wọn, ati lọwọ awọn ti o nwá ẹmi wọn, okú wọn ni a o fi fun ẹiyẹ oju-ọrun, ati ẹranko ilẹ fun onjẹ.
entries.en: And I will make void the counsel of Judah and Jerusalem in this place; and I will cause them to fall by the sword before their enemies, and by the hands of them that seek their lives: and their carcases will I give to be meat for the fowls of the heaven, and for the beasts of the earth.

entries.yo: Emi o si sọ ilu yi di ahoro, ati ẹ̀gan, ẹnikẹni ti o ba nkọja lọ nibẹ yio dãmu, yio si poṣe nitori gbogbo ìna rẹ̀.
entries.en: And I will make this city desolate, and an hissing; every one that passeth thereby shall be astonished and hiss because of all the plagues thereof.

entries.yo: Emi o si mu ki nwọn ki o jẹ ẹran-ara awọn ọmọkunrin wọn, ati ẹran-ara awọn ọmọbinrin wọn, ati ẹnikini wọn yio jẹ ẹran-ara ẹnikẹji ni igba idoti ati ihamọ, ti awọn ọta wọn, ati awọn ti o nwá ẹmi wọn yio ha wọn mọ.
entries.en: And I will cause them to eat the flesh of their sons and the flesh of their daughters, and they shall eat every one the flesh of his friend in the siege and straitness, wherewith their enemies, and they that seek their lives, shall straiten them.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni iwọ o fọ igo na li oju awọn ti o ba ọ lọ.
entries.en: Then shalt thou break the bottle in the sight of the men that go with thee,

entries.yo: Ki o si wi fun wọn pe, Bayi li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi: Bẹ̃ gẹgẹ li emi o fọ enia yi ati ilu yi, bi a ti ifọ ohun-èlo amọkoko, ti ẹnikan kò le tun ṣe mọ, nwọn o si sin wọn ni Tofeti, nitoriti aye kò si lati sinkú.
entries.en: And shalt say unto them, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Even so will I break this people and this city, as one breaketh a potter's vessel, that cannot be made whole again: and they shall bury them in Tophet, till there be no place to bury.

entries.yo: Bayi li emi o ṣe si ibi yi, li Oluwa wi, ati si olugbe inu rẹ̀, emi o tilẹ ṣe ilu yi bi Tofeti:
entries.en: Thus will I do unto this place, saith the LORD, and to the inhabitants thereof, and even make this city as Tophet:

entries.yo: Gbogbo ile Jerusalemu ati ile awọn ọba Juda ni a o sọ di alaimọ́ bi Tofeti, gbogbo ile wọnni, lori orule eyiti a ti sun turari fun ogun ọrun, ti a si ru ẹbọ mimu fun ọlọrun miran.
entries.en: And the houses of Jerusalem, and the houses of the kings of Judah, shall be defiled as the place of Tophet, because of all the houses upon whose roofs they have burned incense unto all the host of heaven, and have poured out drink offerings unto other gods.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Jeremiah wá si Tofeti, nibiti Oluwa ti rán a lati sọ asọtẹlẹ; o si duro ni àgbala ile Oluwa; o si wi fun gbogbo awọn enia pe,
entries.en: Then came Jeremiah from Tophet, whither the LORD had sent him to prophesy; and he stood in the court of the LORD's house; and said to all the people,

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun, Ọlọrun Israeli, wi; Sa wò o, emi o mu wá sori ilu yi, ati sori ileto rẹ̀ gbogbo ibi ti mo ti sọ si i, nitori ti nwọn ti wà ọrun kì, ki nwọn ki o má bà gbọ́ ọ̀rọ mi.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will bring upon this city and upon all her towns all the evil that I have pronounced against it, because they have hardened their necks, that they might not hear my words.

entries.yo: NJẸ Paṣuri, ọmọ Immeri, alufa, ti iṣe olori olutọju ni ile Oluwa, gbọ́ pe, Jeremiah sọ asọtẹlẹ ohun wọnyi.
entries.en: Now Pashur the son of Immer the priest, who was also chief governor in the house of the LORD, heard that Jeremiah prophesied these things.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Paṣuri lù Jeremiah, woli, o si kàn a li àba ti o wà ni ẹnu-ọ̀na Benjamini, ti o wà li òke ti o wà lẹba ile Oluwa.
entries.en: Then Pashur smote Jeremiah the prophet, and put him in the stocks that were in the high gate of Benjamin, which was by the house of the LORD.

entries.yo: O si ṣe ni ọjọ keji, Paṣuri mu Jeremiah kuro ninu àba. Nigbana ni Jeremiah wi fun u pe, Oluwa kò pe orukọ rẹ ni Paṣuri (ire-yika-kiri), bikoṣe Magori-missa-bibu (idãmu-yika-kiri.)
entries.en: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Pashur brought forth Jeremiah out of the stocks. Then said Jeremiah unto him, The LORD hath not called thy name Pashur, but Magor-missabib.

entries.yo: Nitori bayi li Oluwa wi, sa wò o, emi o fi ọ le idãmu lọwọ, pẹlu gbogbo awọn ọrẹ rẹ, nwọn o ṣubu nipa idà awọn ọta wọn, oju rẹ yio si ri i, emi o si fi gbogbo Juda le ọwọ ọba Babeli, on o si mu wọn lọ ni igbèkun si Babeli, yio si fi idà pa wọn.
entries.en: For thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will make thee a terror to thyself, and to all thy friends: and they shall fall by the sword of their enemies, and thine eyes shall behold it: and I will give all Judah into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall carry them captive into Babylon, and shall slay them with the sword.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu emi o fi ọrọ̀ ilu yi, pẹlu ẽre rẹ̀ ati ohun iyebiye rẹ̀, ati gbogbo iṣura awọn ọba Juda li emi o fi le ọwọ awọn ọta wọn, ti yio jẹ wọn ti yio si mu wọn lọ si Babeli.
entries.en: Moreover I will deliver all the strength of this city, and all the labours thereof, and all the precious things thereof, and all the treasures of the kings of Judah will I give into the hand of their enemies, which shall spoil them, and take them, and carry them to Babylon.

entries.yo: Ati iwọ, Paṣuri, ati gbogbo awọn ti o ngbe inu ile rẹ ni yio lọ si igbekun, iwọ o wá si Babeli, ati nibẹ ni iwọ o kú si, a o si sin ọ sibẹ, iwọ ati gbogbo ọrẹ rẹ ti iwọ ti sọ asọtẹlẹ eke fun.
entries.en: And thou, Pashur, and all that dwell in thine house shall go into captivity: and thou shalt come to Babylon, and there thou shalt die, and shalt be buried there, thou, and all thy friends, to whom thou hast prophesied lies.

entries.yo: Oluwa, iwọ ti fi ọ̀rọ rọ̀ mi, emi si gba rirọ̀! iwọ li agbara jù mi lọ, o si bori mi; emi di ẹni iyọ-ṣuti-si lojojumọ, gbogbo wọn ni ngàn mi!
entries.en: O LORD, thou hast deceived me, and I was deceived: thou art stronger than I, and hast prevailed: I am in derision daily, every one mocketh me.

entries.yo: Nitori lati igba ti mo ti sọ̀rọ, emi kigbe, mo ke, Iwa-agbara, ati iparun, nitori a sọ ọ̀rọ Oluwa di ohun ẹ̀gan ati itiju fun mi lojojumọ.
entries.en: For since I spake, I cried out, I cried violence and spoil; because the word of the LORD was made a reproach unto me, and a derision, daily.

entries.yo: Nitorina mo si wipe, emi kì yio mu ni ranti rẹ̀, emi kì yio si sọ ọ̀rọ li orukọ rẹ̀ mọ́. Ṣugbọn ọ̀rọ rẹ̀ mbẹ bi iná ti njó ninu mi ti a se mọ inu egungun mi, o si rẹ̀ mi lati pa a mọra, emi kò le ṣe e.
entries.en: Then I said, I will not make mention of him, nor speak any more in his name. But his word was in mine heart as a burning fire shut up in my bones, and I was weary with forbearing, and I could not stay.

entries.yo: Nitoriti mo gbọ́ ẹgan ọ̀pọlọpọ, idãmu niha gbogbo, nwọn wipe: fi sùn, awa o si fi sùn. Gbogbo awọn ọrẹ mi, ati gbogbo awọn ẹgbẹ mi wipe: bọya a o tãn jẹ, awa o si ṣẹgun rẹ̀, a o si gbẹsan wa lara rẹ̀.
entries.en: For I heard the defaming of many, fear on every side. Report, say they, and we will report it. All my familiars watched for my halting, saying, Peradventure he will be enticed, and we shall prevail against him, and we shall take our revenge on him.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Oluwa mbẹ lọdọ mi bi akọni ẹlẹrù, nitorina awọn ti nṣe inunibini si mi yio ṣubu, nwọn kì yio le bori: oju yio tì wọn gidigidi, nitoripe nwọn kì o ṣe rere: a ki yio gbagbe itiju wọn lailai!
entries.en: But the LORD is with me as a mighty terrible one: therefore my persecutors shall stumble, and they shall not prevail: they shall be greatly ashamed; for they shall not prosper: their everlasting confusion shall never be forgotten.

entries.yo: Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun, iwọ ti ndán olododo wò, iwọ si ri inu ati ọkàn, emi o ri ẹsan rẹ lara wọn: nitoriti mo ti fi ọ̀ran mi le ọ lọwọ!
entries.en: But, O LORD of hosts, that triest the righteous, and seest the reins and the heart, let me see thy vengeance on them: for unto thee have I opened my cause.

entries.yo: Ẹ kọrin si Oluwa, ẹ yìn Oluwa, nitoriti o ti gbà ọkàn talaka kuro lọwọ awọn oluṣe buburu.
entries.en: Sing unto the LORD, praise ye the LORD: for he hath delivered the soul of the poor from the hand of evildoers.

entries.yo: Egbe ni fun ọjọ na ti a bi mi! ọjọ na ti iya mi bi mi, ki o má ri ibukun!
entries.en: Cursed be the day wherein I was born: let not the day wherein my mother bare me be blessed.

entries.yo: Egbe ni fun ọkunrin na ti o mu ihìn tọ̀ baba mi wá, wipe, Ọmọkunrin li a bi fun ọ; o mu u yọ̀.
entries.en: Cursed be the man who brought tidings to my father, saying, A man child is born unto thee; making him very glad.

entries.yo: Ki ọkunrin na ki o si dabi ilu wọnni ti Oluwa ti bì ṣubu, li aiyi ọkàn pada, ki o si gbọ́ ẹkun li owurọ, ati ọ̀fọ li ọsangangan.
entries.en: And let that man be as the cities which the LORD overthrew, and repented not: and let him hear the cry in the morning, and the shouting at noontide;

entries.yo: Nitoriti kò pa mi ni inu iya mi, tobẹ̃ ki iya mi di isà mi, ki o loyun mi lailai.
entries.en: Because he slew me not from the womb; or that my mother might have been my grave, and her womb to be always great with me.

entries.yo: Ẽṣe ti emi fi jade kuro ninu iya mi, lati ri irora ati oṣi, ati lati pari ọjọ mi ni itiju?
entries.en: Wherefore came I forth out of the womb to see labour and sorrow, that my days should be consumed with shame?

entries.yo: Ọ̀RỌ ti o tọ̀ Jeremiah wá lati ọdọ Oluwa nigbati Sedekiah, ọba, ran Paṣuru, ọmọ Melkiah, ati Sefaniah, ọmọ Maaseah, alufa, wipe,
entries.en: The word which came unto Jeremiah from the LORD, when king Zedekiah sent unto him Pashur the son of Melchiah, and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest, saying,

entries.yo: Bère, emi bẹ ọ, lọdọ Oluwa fun wa; nitori Nebukadnessari, ọba Babeli, ṣi ogun tì wa; bọya bi Oluwa yio ba wa lò gẹgẹ bi gbogbo iṣẹ iyanu rẹ̀, ki on ki o le lọ kuro lọdọ wa.
entries.en: Inquire, I pray thee, of the LORD for us; for Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon maketh war against us; if so be that the LORD will deal with us according to all his wondrous works, that he may go up from us.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Jeremiah wi fun wọn pe, Bayi li ẹnyin o wi fun Sedekiah.
entries.en: Then said Jeremiah unto them, Thus shall ye say to Zedekiah:

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun Israeli wi: wõ, emi o yi ihamọra ogun ti o wà ni ọwọ nyin pada, eyiti ẹnyin nfi ba ọba Babeli, ati awọn ara Kaldea jà, ti o dotì nyin lẹhin odi, emi o kó wọn jọ si ãrin ilu yi.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD God of Israel; Behold, I will turn back the weapons of war that are in your hands, wherewith ye fight against the king of Babylon, and against the Chaldeans, which besiege you without the walls, and I will assemble them into the midst of this city.

entries.yo: Emi tikarami yio fi ọwọ ninà ati apa lile ba nyin jà, pẹlupẹlu ni ibinu, ati ni ikannu pẹlu ibinu nla.
entries.en: And I myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and with a strong arm, even in anger, and in fury, and in great wrath.

entries.yo: Emi o si pa awọn olugbe ilu yi, enia pẹlu ẹranko, nwọn o ti ipa àjakalẹ-arun nlanla kú.
entries.en: And I will smite the inhabitants of this city, both man and beast: they shall die of a great pestilence.

entries.yo: Lẹhin eyi, li Oluwa wi, emi o fi Sedekiah, ọba Juda, ati awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀, ati awọn enia, ati awọn ti o kù ni ilu yi lọwọ ajakalẹ-àrun ati lọwọ idà, ati lọwọ ìyan; emi o fi wọn le Nebukadnessari, ọba Babeli lọwọ, ati le ọwọ awọn ọta wọn, ati le ọwọ awọn ti nwá ẹmi wọn: yio si fi oju idà pa wọn; kì yio da wọn si, bẹ̃ni kì yio ni iyọ́nu tabi ãnu.
entries.en: And afterward, saith the LORD, I will deliver Zedekiah king of Judah, and his servants, and the people, and such as are left in this city from the pestilence, from the sword, and from the famine, into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of those that seek their life: and he shall smite them with the edge of the sword; he shall not spare them, neither have pity, nor have mercy.

entries.yo: Ati fun enia yi ni ki iwọ ki o wipe, Bayi li Oluwa wi; Sa wò o, emi fi ọ̀na ìye ati ọ̀na ikú lelẹ niwaju nyin.
entries.en: And unto this people thou shalt say, Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I set before you the way of life, and the way of death.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba joko ninu ilu yi, yio ti ipa idà kú, ati nipa ìyan ati nipa àjakalẹ-àrun: ṣugbọn ẹniti o ba jade ti o si ṣubu si ọwọ awọn ara Kaldea ti o dó tì nyin, yio yè, ẹmi rẹ̀ yio si dabi ijẹ fun u.
entries.en: He that abideth in this city shall die by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence: but he that goeth out, and falleth to the Chaldeans that besiege you, he shall live, and his life shall be unto him for a prey.

entries.yo: Nitori emi ti yi oju mi si ilu yi fun ibi, kì isi iṣe fun rere, li Oluwa wi: a o fi i le ọba Babeli lọwọ, yio fi iná kun u.
entries.en: For I have set my face against this city for evil, and not for good, saith the LORD: it shall be given into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall burn it with fire.

entries.yo: Ati fun ile ọba Juda; Ẹ gbọ́ ọ̀rọ Oluwa:
entries.en: And touching the house of the king of Judah, say, Hear ye the word of the LORD;

entries.yo: Ile Dafidi, Bayi li Oluwa wi, Mu idajọ ṣẹ li owurọ, ki o si gba ẹniti a lọ lọwọ gba kuro li ọwọ aninilara, ki ibinu mi ki o má ba jade bi iná, ki o má si jo ti kì o si ẹniti yio pa a, nitori buburu iṣe nyin.
entries.en: O house of David, thus saith the LORD; Execute judgment in the morning, and deliver him that is spoiled out of the hand of the oppressor, lest my fury go out like fire, and burn that none can quench it, because of the evil of your doings.

entries.yo: Wò o, Emi doju kọ nyin, olugbe afonifoji, ati ti okuta pẹtẹlẹ, li Oluwa wi, ẹnyin ti o wipe, Tani yio kọlu wa? ati tani yio wọ̀ inu ibugbe wa?
entries.en: Behold, I am against thee, O inhabitant of the valley, and rock of the plain, saith the LORD; which say, Who shall come down against us? or who shall enter into our habitations?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi o jẹ nyin niya gẹgẹ bi eso iṣe nyin, li Oluwa wi; emi o si da iná ninu igbo rẹ ki o le jo gbogbo agbegbe rẹ.
entries.en: But I will punish you according to the fruit of your doings, saith the LORD: and I will kindle a fire in the forest thereof, and it shall devour all things round about it.

entries.yo: BAYI li Oluwa wi, Sọkalẹ lọ si ile ọba Juda, ki o si sọ ọ̀rọ yi nibẹ.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD; Go down to the house of the king of Judah, and speak there this word,

entries.yo: Si wipe, Gbọ́ ọ̀rọ Oluwa, ọba Juda, ti o joko ni itẹ Dafidi, iwọ, ati awọn iranṣẹ rẹ, ati awọn enia rẹ ti o wọle ẹnu-bode wọnyi.
entries.en: And say, Hear the word of the LORD, O king of Judah, that sittest upon the throne of David, thou, and thy servants, and thy people that enter in by these gates:

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa wi; Mu idajọ ati ododo ṣẹ, ki o si gbà ẹniti a lọ lọwọ gbà kuro lọwọ aninilara, ki o máṣe fi agbara ati ìka lò alejo, alainibaba ati opó, bẹ̃ni ki o máṣe ta ẹ̀jẹ alaiṣẹ silẹ nihinyi.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD; Execute ye judgment and righteousness, and deliver the spoiled out of the hand of the oppressor: and do no wrong, do no violence to the stranger, the fatherless, nor the widow, neither shed innocent blood in this place.

entries.yo: Nitori bi ẹnyin ba ṣe nkan yi nitõtọ, nigbana ni awọn ọba yio wọle ẹnu-bode ilu yi, ti nwọn o joko lori itẹ Dafidi, ti yio gun kẹ̀kẹ ati ẹṣin, on, ati awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀, ati enia rẹ̀.
entries.en: For if ye do this thing indeed, then shall there enter in by the gates of this house kings sitting upon the throne of David, riding in chariots and on horses, he, and his servants, and his people.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi ẹnyin kì yio ba gbọ́ ọ̀rọ wọnyi, Emi fi emitikarami bura, li Oluwa wi, pe, ile yi yio di ahoro.
entries.en: But if ye will not hear these words, I swear by myself, saith the LORD, that this house shall become a desolation.

entries.yo: Nitori bayi li Oluwa wi fun ile ọba Juda; Gileadi ni iwọ si mi, ori Lebanoni: sibẹ, lõtọ emi o sọ ọ di aginju, ati ilu ti a kò gbe inu wọn.
entries.en: For thus saith the LORD unto the king's house of Judah; Thou art Gilead unto me, and the head of Lebanon: yet surely I will make thee a wilderness, and cities which are not inhabited.

entries.yo: Emi o ya awọn apanirun sọtọ fun ọ, olukuluku pẹlu ihamọra rẹ̀: nwọn o si ke aṣayan igi kedari rẹ lulẹ, nwọn o si sọ wọn sinu iná.
entries.en: And I will prepare destroyers against thee, every one with his weapons: and they shall cut down thy choice cedars, and cast them into the fire.

entries.yo: Ọ̀pọlọpọ orilẹ-ède yio rekọja lẹba ilu yi, nwọn o wi, ẹnikan fun ẹnikeji rẹ̀ pe, Ẽṣe ti Oluwa ṣe bayi si ilu nla yi?
entries.en: And many nations shall pass by this city, and they shall say every man to his neighbour, Wherefore hath the LORD done thus unto this great city?

entries.yo: Nigbana ni nwọn o dahùn pe, nitoriti nwọn ti kọ̀ majẹmu Oluwa Ọlọrun wọn silẹ; ti nwọn fi ori balẹ fun ọlọrun miran, nwọn si sìn wọn.
entries.en: Then they shall answer, Because they have forsaken the covenant of the LORD their God, and worshipped other gods, and served them.

entries.yo: Ẹ máṣe sọkun fun okú, bẹ̃ni ki ẹ máṣe pohùnrere rẹ̀, ṣugbọn ẹ sọkun ẹ̀dun fun ẹniti o nlọ, nitori kì yio pada wá mọ, kì yio si ri ilẹ rẹ̀ mọ.
entries.en: Weep ye not for the dead, neither bemoan him: but weep sore for him that goeth away: for he shall return no more, nor see his native country.

entries.yo: Nitori bayi li Oluwa wi fun Ṣallumu, ọmọ Josiah, ọba Juda, ti o jọba ni ipo Josiah, baba rẹ̀, ti o jade kuro nihin pe, On kì yio pada wá mọ.
entries.en: For thus saith the LORD touching Shallum the son of Josiah king of Judah, which reigned instead of Josiah his father, which went forth out of this place; He shall not return thither any more:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn yio kú ni ibi ti a mu u ni igbèkun lọ, kì yio si ri ilẹ yi mọ.
entries.en: But he shall die in the place whither they have led him captive, and shall see this land no more.

entries.yo: Egbe ni fun ẹniti o kọ́ ilẹ rẹ̀, ti kì iṣe nipa ododo, ati iyẹwu rẹ̀, ti kì iṣe nipa ẹ̀tọ́: ti o lò iṣẹ ọwọ aladugbo rẹ̀ lọfẹ, ti kò fi ere iṣẹ rẹ̀ fun u.
entries.en: Woe unto him that buildeth his house by unrighteousness, and his chambers by wrong; that useth his neighbour's service without wages, and giveth him not for his work;

entries.yo: Ti o wipe, emi o kọ ile ti o ni ibò fun ara mi, ati iyẹwu nla, ti o ke oju ferese fun ara rẹ̀, ti o fi igi kedari bò o, ti o si fi ajẹ̀ kùn u.
entries.en: That saith, I will build me a wide house and large chambers, and cutteth him out windows; and it is cieled with cedar, and painted with vermilion.

entries.yo: Iwọ o ha jọba, nitori iwọ fi igi kedari dije? baba rẹ kò ha jẹ, kò ha mu? o si ṣe idajọ ati ododo, nitorina o dara fun u.
entries.en: Shalt thou reign, because thou closest thyself in cedar? did not thy father eat and drink, and do judgment and justice, and then it was well with him?

entries.yo: O dajọ ọ̀ran talaka ati alaini; o dara fun u: bi ãti mọ̀ mi kọ́ eyi? li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: He judged the cause of the poor and needy; then it was well with him: was not this to know me? saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn oju rẹ̀ ati ọkàn rẹ kì iṣe fun ohunkohun bikoṣe ojukokoro rẹ, ati lati ta ẹ̀jẹ alaiṣẹ silẹ, ati lati ṣe ininilara ati agbara.
entries.en: But thine eyes and thine heart are not but for thy covetousness, and for to shed innocent blood, and for oppression, and for violence, to do it.

entries.yo: Nitorina bayi li Oluwa wi nitori Jehoiakimu ọmọ Josiah, ọba Juda, nwọn kì yio ṣọ̀fọ fun u, wipe, Oṣe! arakunrin mi! tabi Oṣe! arabinrin mi! nwọn kì o ṣọ̀fọ fun u pe, Oṣe, oluwa! tabi Oṣe, ọlọla!
entries.en: Therefore thus saith the LORD concerning Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah; They shall not lament for him, saying, Ah my brother! or, Ah sister! they shall not lament for him, saying, Ah lord! or, Ah his glory!

entries.yo: A o sin i ni isinkú kẹtẹkẹtẹ, ti a wọ́ ti a si sọ junù kuro ni ẹnu-bode Jerusalemu.
entries.en: He shall be buried with the burial of an ass, drawn and cast forth beyond the gates of Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Goke lọ si Lebanoni, ki o si ke, ki o si gbe ohùn rẹ soke ni Baṣani, ki o kigbe lati Abarimu, nitori a ti ṣẹ́ gbogbo olufẹ rẹ tutu,
entries.en: Go up to Lebanon, and cry; and lift up thy voice in Bashan, and cry from the passages: for all thy lovers are destroyed.

entries.yo: Emi ti ba ọ sọ̀rọ ni ìgba ire rẹ; iwọ wipe, emi kì yio gbọ́. Eyi ni ìwa rẹ lati igba ewe rẹ wá, ti iwọ kò si gba ohùn mi gbọ.
entries.en: I spake unto thee in thy prosperity; but thou saidst, I will not hear. This hath been thy manner from thy youth, that thou obeyedst not my voice.

entries.yo: Ẹfũfu yio fẹ gbogbo oluṣọ-agutan rẹ lọ, ati awọn olufẹ rẹ yio lọ si ìgbekun: nitõtọ, ni wakati na ni oju yio tì ọ, iwọ o si dãmu nitori gbogbo buburu rẹ.
entries.en: The wind shall eat up all thy pastors, and thy lovers shall go into captivity: surely then shalt thou be ashamed and confounded for all thy wickedness.

entries.yo: Iwọ, olugbe Lebanoni, ti o tẹ́ itẹ si ori igi kedari, iwọ o ti jẹ otoṣi to, nigbati irora ba deba ọ, irora bi obinrin ti nrọbi!
entries.en: O inhabitant of Lebanon, that makest thy nest in the cedars, how gracious shalt thou be when pangs come upon thee, the pain as of a woman in travail!

entries.yo: Bi emi ti wà, li Oluwa wi, bi Koniah, ọmọ Jehoiakimu, ọba Juda, tilẹ jẹ oruka-èdidi lọwọ ọtun mi, sibẹ̀ emi o fà ọ tu kuro nibẹ.
entries.en: As I live, saith the LORD, though Coniah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah were the signet upon my right hand, yet would I pluck thee thence;

entries.yo: Emi o si fi ọ le ọwọ awọn ti o nwá ẹmi rẹ, ati le ọwọ ẹniti iwọ bẹ̀ru rẹ̀, ani le ọwọ Nebukadnessari, ọba Babeli, ati ọwọ awọn ara Kaldea.
entries.en: And I will give thee into the hand of them that seek thy life, and into the hand of them whose face thou fearest, even into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of the Chaldeans.

entries.yo: Emi o tì ọ sode, ati iya rẹ ti o bi ọ si ilẹ miran, nibiti a kò bi nyin si; nibẹ li ẹnyin o si kú.
entries.en: And I will cast thee out, and thy mother that bare thee, into another country, where ye were not born; and there shall ye die.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ilẹ na ti ẹnyin fẹ li ọkàn nyin lati pada si, nibẹ ni ẹnyin kì o pada si mọ.
entries.en: But to the land whereunto they desire to return, thither shall they not return.

entries.yo: Ọkunrin yi, Koniah, ohun-èlo ẹlẹgan, fifọ ha ni bi? o ha dabi ohun-èlo ti kò ni ẹwà lara? ẽṣe ti a tì wọn jade, on, ati iru-ọmọ rẹ̀, ti a si le wọn jade si ilẹ ti nwọn kò mọ̀?
entries.en: Is this man Coniah a despised broken idol? is he a vessel wherein is no pleasure? wherefore are they cast out, he and his seed, and are cast into a land which they know not?

entries.yo: Ilẹ! ilẹ! ilẹ! gbọ́ ọ̀rọ Oluwa!
entries.en: O earth, earth, earth, hear the word of the LORD.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa wi, Ẹ kọwe pe, ọkunrin yi alailọmọ ni, ẹniti kì yio ri rere li ọjọ aiye rẹ̀: nitori ọkan ninu iru-ọmọ rẹ̀ kì yio ri rere, ti yio fi joko lori itẹ Dafidi, ti yio si fi tun jọba lori Juda.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD, Write ye this man childless, a man that shall not prosper in his days: for no man of his seed shall prosper, sitting upon the throne of David, and ruling any more in Judah.

entries.yo: EGBE ni fun awọn oluṣọ-agutan, ti nmu agbo-ẹran mi ṣìna, ti o si ntú wọn ka, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: Woe be unto the pastors that destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture! saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Nitorina bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun Israeli, wi si oluṣọ-agutan wọnni, ti nṣọ enia mi; Ẹnyin tú agbo-ẹran mi ká, ẹ le wọn junù, ẹnyin kò si bẹ̀ wọn wò, sa wò o, emi o bẹ̀ nyin wò nitori buburu iṣe nyin, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: Therefore thus saith the LORD God of Israel against the pastors that feed my people; Ye have scattered my flock, and driven them away, and have not visited them: behold, I will visit upon you the evil of your doings, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Emi o si kó iyokù agbo-ẹran mi jọ lati inu gbogbo ilẹ, ti mo ti le wọn si, emi o si mu wọn pada wá sinu pápá oko wọn, nwọn o bi si i, nwọn o si rẹ̀ si i.
entries.en: And I will gather the remnant of my flock out of all countries whither I have driven them, and will bring them again to their folds; and they shall be fruitful and increase.

entries.yo: Emi o gbe oluṣọ-agutan dide fun wọn, ti yio bọ́ wọn: nwọn kì yio bẹ̀ru mọ́, tabi nwọn kì yio si dãmu, bẹ̃li ọkan ninu wọn kì yio si sọnu, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: And I will set up shepherds over them which shall feed them: and they shall fear no more, nor be dismayed, neither shall they be lacking, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Sa wò o, ọjọ mbọ, li Oluwa wi, ti emi o gbe Ẹka ododo soke fun Dafidi, yio si jẹ Ọba, yio si ṣe rere, yio si ṣe idajọ ati ododo ni ilẹ na.
entries.en: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will raise unto David a righteous Branch, and a King shall reign and prosper, and shall execute judgment and justice in the earth.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ rẹ̀ ni a o gba Juda là, Israeli yio si ma gbe li ailewu, ati eyi li orukọ ti a o ma pè e: OLUWA ODODO WA.
entries.en: In his days Judah shall be saved, and Israel shall dwell safely: and this is his name whereby he shall be called, THE LORD OUR RIGHTEOUSNESS.

entries.yo: Nitorina, sa wò o, ọjọ mbọ̀, li Oluwa wi, ti nwọn kì yio tun wipe, Oluwa mbẹ, ti o mu awọn ọmọ Israeli jade kuro ni ilẹ Egipti:
entries.en: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that they shall no more say, The LORD liveth, which brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn pe, Oluwa mbẹ, ti o mu iru-ọmọ ile Israeli wá, ti o si tọ́ wọn lati ilu ariwa wá, ati lati ilu wọnni nibi ti mo ti lé wọn si, nwọn o si gbe inu ilẹ wọn.
entries.en: But, The LORD liveth, which brought up and which led the seed of the house of Israel out of the north country, and from all countries whither I had driven them; and they shall dwell in their own land.

entries.yo: Si awọn woli. Ọkàn mi ti bajẹ ninu mi, gbogbo egungun mi mì; emi dabi ọmuti, ati ọkunrin ti ọti-waini ti bori rẹ̀ niwaju Oluwa, ati niwaju ọ̀rọ ìwa-mimọ́ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Mine heart within me is broken because of the prophets; all my bones shake; I am like a drunken man, and like a man whom wine hath overcome, because of the LORD, and because of the words of his holiness.

entries.yo: Nitori ilẹ na kún fun awọn panṣaga; ilẹ na nṣọ̀fọ, nitori egún, pápá oko aginju gbẹ: irìn wọn di buburu, agbara wọn kò si to.
entries.en: For the land is full of adulterers; for because of swearing the land mourneth; the pleasant places of the wilderness are dried up, and their course is evil, and their force is not right.

entries.yo: Nitori, ati woli ati alufa, nwọn bajẹ; pẹlupẹlu ninu ile mi ni mo ri ìwa-buburu wọn, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: For both prophet and priest are profane; yea, in my house have I found their wickedness, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Nitorina ipa-ọ̀na wọn yio jẹ fun wọn bi ibi yiyọ́ li okunkun: a o tì wọn, nwọn o si ṣubu ninu rẹ̀, nitori emi o mu ibi wá sori wọn, ani ọdun ibẹ̀wo wọn, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: Wherefore their way shall be unto them as slippery ways in the darkness: they shall be driven on, and fall therein: for I will bring evil upon them, even the year of their visitation, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Emi si ti ri were ninu awọn woli Samaria, nwọn sọ asọtẹlẹ li orukọ Baali, nwọn si mu Israeli enia mi ṣina.
entries.en: And I have seen folly in the prophets of Samaria; they prophesied in Baal, and caused my people Israel to err.

entries.yo: Emi ti ri irira lara awọn woli Jerusalemu, nwọn ṣe panṣaga, nwọn si rìn ninu eke, nwọn mu ọwọ oluṣe-buburu le tobẹ̃, ti kò si ẹnikan ti o yipada kuro ninu ìwa-buburu rẹ̀; gbogbo wọn dabi Sodomu niwaju mi, ati awọn olugbe rẹ̀ bi Gomorra.
entries.en: I have seen also in the prophets of Jerusalem an horrible thing: they commit adultery, and walk in lies: they strengthen also the hands of evildoers, that none doth return from his wickedness: they are all of them unto me as Sodom, and the inhabitants thereof as Gomorrah.

entries.yo: Nitorina bayi li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi niti awọn woli; Sa wò o, emi o fi wahala bọ́ wọn, emi o si jẹ ki nwọn ki o mu omi orõro: nitori lati ọdọ awọn woli Jerusalemu ni ibajẹ ti jade lọ si gbogbo ilẹ na.
entries.en: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts concerning the prophets; Behold, I will feed them with wormwood, and make them drink the water of gall: for from the prophets of Jerusalem is profaneness gone forth into all the land.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi: Ẹ máṣe feti si ọ̀rọ awọn woli ti nsọ asọtẹlẹ fun nyin: nwọn sọ nyin di asan, nwọn sọ̀rọ iran inu ara wọn, kì iṣe lati ẹnu Oluwa.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, Hearken not unto the words of the prophets that prophesy unto you: they make you vain: they speak a vision of their own heart, and not out of the mouth of the LORD.

entries.yo: Nwọn wi sibẹ fun awọn ti o ngàn mi pe, Oluwa ti wi pe, Alafia yio wà fun nyin; nwọn si wi fun olukuluku ti o nrìn nipa agidi ọkàn rẹ̀, pe, kò si ibi kan ti yio wá sori nyin.
entries.en: They say still unto them that despise me, The LORD hath said, Ye shall have peace; and they say unto every one that walketh after the imagination of his own heart, No evil shall come upon you.

entries.yo: Nitori tali o duro ninu igbimọ Oluwa, ti o woye, ti o si gbọ́ ọ̀rọ rẹ̀? tali o kíyesi ọ̀rọ rẹ̀, ti o si gbà a gbọ́?
entries.en: For who hath stood in the counsel of the LORD, and hath perceived and heard his word? who hath marked his word, and heard it?

entries.yo: Sa wò o, afẹfẹ-ìji Oluwa! ibinu ti jade! afẹyika ìji yio ṣubu ni ikanra si ori awọn oluṣe buburu:
entries.en: Behold, a whirlwind of the LORD is gone forth in fury, even a grievous whirlwind: it shall fall grievously upon the head of the wicked.

entries.yo: Ibinu Oluwa kì yio pada, titi yio fi ṣe e, titi yio si fi mu iro inu rẹ̀ ṣẹ, li ọjọ ikẹhin ẹnyin o mọ̀ ọ daju.
entries.en: The anger of the LORD shall not return, until he have executed, and till he have performed the thoughts of his heart: in the latter days ye shall consider it perfectly.

entries.yo: Emi kò ran awọn woli wọnyi, ṣugbọn nwọn sare: emi kò ba wọn sọ̀rọ, ṣugbọn nwọn sọ asọtẹlẹ.
entries.en: I have not sent these prophets, yet they ran: I have not spoken to them, yet they prophesied.

entries.yo: Ibaṣepe nwọn duro ni imọran mi, nwọn iba jẹ ki enia mi ki o gbọ́ ọ̀rọ mi, nigbana ni nwọn iba yipada kuro ni ọ̀na buburu wọn, ati kuro ninu buburu iṣe wọn.
entries.en: But if they had stood in my counsel, and had caused my people to hear my words, then they should have turned them from their evil way, and from the evil of their doings.

entries.yo: Emi ha iṣe Ọlọrun itosi? li Oluwa wi, kì iṣe Ọlọrun lati okere pẹlu?
entries.en: Am I a God at hand, saith the LORD, and not a God afar off?

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni le fi ara rẹ̀ pamọ ni ibi ìkọkọ, ti emi kì yio ri i, li Oluwa wi. Emi kò ha kún ọrun on aiye, li Oluwa wi?
entries.en: Can any hide himself in secret places that I shall not see him? saith the LORD. Do not I fill heaven and earth? saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Emi ti gbọ́ eyiti awọn woli sọ, ti nwọn sọ asọtẹlẹ li orukọ mi wi pe, Mo lá alá! mo lá alá!
entries.en: I have heard what the prophets said, that prophesy lies in my name, saying, I have dreamed, I have dreamed.

entries.yo: Yio ti pẹ to, ti eyi yio wà li ọkàn awọn woli ti nsọ asọtẹlẹ eke? ani, awọn alasọtẹlẹ ẹ̀tan ọkàn wọn.
entries.en: How long shall this be in the heart of the prophets that prophesy lies? yea, they are prophets of the deceit of their own heart;

entries.yo: Ti nwọn rò lati mu ki enia mi ki o gbàgbe orukọ mi nipa alá wọn ti nwọn nrọ́, ẹnikini fun ẹnikeji rẹ̀, gẹgẹ bi awọn baba wọn ti gbagbe orukọ mi nitori Baali.
entries.en: Which think to cause my people to forget my name by their dreams which they tell every man to his neighbour, as their fathers have forgotten my name for Baal.

entries.yo: Woli na ti o lála, jẹ ki o rọ́ ọ; ati ẹniti o ni ọ̀rọ mi, jẹ ki o fi ododo sọ ọ̀rọ mi. Kini iyangbo ni iṣe ninu ọkà, li Oluwa wi?
entries.en: The prophet that hath a dream, let him tell a dream; and he that hath my word, let him speak my word faithfully. What is the chaff to the wheat? saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ mi kò ha dabi iná? li Oluwa wi; ati bi òlu irin ti nfọ́ apata tútu?
entries.en: Is not my word like as a fire? saith the LORD; and like a hammer that breaketh the rock in pieces?

entries.yo: Nitorina sa wò o, emi dojukọ awọn woli, li Oluwa wi, ti o nji ọ̀rọ mi, ẹnikini lati ọwọ ẹnikeji rẹ̀.
entries.en: Therefore, behold, I am against the prophets, saith the LORD, that steal my words every one from his neighbour.

entries.yo: Sa wò o, emi o dojukọ awọn woli, li Oluwa wi, ti nwọn lò ahọn wọn, ti nwọn nsọ jade pe: O wi.
entries.en: Behold, I am against the prophets, saith the LORD, that use their tongues, and say, He saith.

entries.yo: Sa wò o, emi dojukọ awọn ti o nsọ asọtẹlẹ alá èke, li Oluwa wi, ti nwọn si nrọ́ wọn, ti nwọn si mu enia mi ṣìna nipa eke wọn, ati nipa iran wọn: ṣugbọn emi kò rán wọn, emi kò si paṣẹ fun wọn: nitorina, nwọn kì yio ràn awọn enia yi lọwọ rara, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: Behold, I am against them that prophesy false dreams, saith the LORD, and do tell them, and cause my people to err by their lies, and by their lightness; yet I sent them not, nor commanded them: therefore they shall not profit this people at all, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Ati nigbati awọn enia yi, tabi woli, tabi alufa, yio bi ọ lere wipe, kini Ọ̀rọ-wuwo Oluwa? nigbana ni iwọ o wi fun wọn Ọ̀rọ-wuwo ni eyi pé: Emi o tì nyin jade, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: And when this people, or the prophet, or a priest, shall ask thee, saying, What is the burden of the LORD? thou shalt then say unto them, What burden? I will even forsake you, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Ati woli, ati alufa, ati awọn enia, ti yio wipe, Ọ̀rọ-wuwo Oluwa, emi o jẹ oluwa rẹ̀ ati ile rẹ̀ ni ìya.
entries.en: And as for the prophet, and the priest, and the people, that shall say, The burden of the LORD, I will even punish that man and his house.

entries.yo: Bayi li ẹnyin o wi, ẹnikini fun ẹnikeji, ati ẹnikan fun arakunrin rẹ̀, pe Kini idahùn Oluwa? ati kini ọ̀rọ Oluwa?
entries.en: Thus shall ye say every one to his neighbour, and every one to his brother, What hath the LORD answered? and, What hath the LORD spoken?

entries.yo: Ẹ kì o si ranti ọ̀rọ-wuwo Oluwa mọ́, nitori ọ̀rọ olukuluku yio di ẹrù-wuwo fun ontikararẹ̀; nitori ti ẹnyin ti yi ọ̀rọ Ọlọrun alãye dà, Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun, Ọlọrun wa.
entries.en: And the burden of the LORD shall ye mention no more: for every man's word shall be his burden; for ye have perverted the words of the living God, of the LORD of hosts our God.

entries.yo: Bayi ni iwọ o wi fun woli nì pe: Idahùn wo li Oluwa fi fun ọ? ati pẹlu; Kini Oluwa wi?
entries.en: Thus shalt thou say to the prophet, What hath the LORD answered thee? and, What hath the LORD spoken?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi ẹnyin ba wipe, ọ̀rọ-wuwo Oluwa, nitorina, bayi li Oluwa wi, nitori ẹnyin nsọ ọ̀rọ yi pe, ọ̀rọ-wuwo Oluwa ti emi si ranṣẹ si nyin pe ki ẹ máṣe wipe: ọ̀rọ-wuwọ Oluwa;
entries.en: But since ye say, The burden of the LORD; therefore thus saith the LORD; Because ye say this word, The burden of the LORD, and I have sent unto you, saying, Ye shall not say, The burden of the LORD;

entries.yo: Nitorina, sa wò o, Emi o gbagbe nyin patapata, emi o si kọ̀ nyin silẹ, emi o si tì nyin jade, ati ilu ti mo fi fun nyin ati fun awọn baba nyin, kuro niwaju mi.
entries.en: Therefore, behold, I, even I, will utterly forget you, and I will forsake you, and the city that I gave you and your fathers, and cast you out of my presence:

entries.yo: Emi o si mu ẹ̀gan ainipẹkun wá sori nyin, ati itiju lailai, ti a kì yio gbagbe.
entries.en: And I will bring an everlasting reproach upon you, and a perpetual shame, which shall not be forgotten.

entries.yo: SI wò o, Oluwa fi agbọn eso-ọ̀pọtọ meji hàn mi, ti a gbe kalẹ niwaju ile Oluwa, lẹhin igbati Nebukadnessari, ọba Babeli, ti mu Jekoniah, ọmọ Jehoiakimu, ọba Juda, ni ìgbekun pẹlu awọn olori Juda, pẹlu awọn gbẹna-gbẹna, ati awọn alagbẹdẹ, lati Jerusalemu, ti o si mu wọn wá si Babeli.
entries.en: The LORD shewed me, and, behold, two baskets of figs were set before the temple of the LORD, after that Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon had carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah, and the princes of Judah, with the carpenters and smiths, from Jerusalem, and had brought them to Babylon.

entries.yo: Agbọn ikini ni eso-ọ̀pọtọ daradara jù, gẹgẹ bi eso ọ̀pọtọ ti o tetekọ pọ́n: agbọn ekeji ni eso-ọ̀pọtọ ti o buruju, ti a kò le jẹ, bi nwọn ti buru tó.
entries.en: One basket had very good figs, even like the figs that are first ripe: and the other basket had very naughty figs, which could not be eaten, they were so bad.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Oluwa wi fun mi pe, Kini iwọ ri, Jeremiah? Emi wipe, Eso-ọ̀pọtọ, eyi ti o dara, dara jù, ati eyi ti o buru, buru jù, tobẹ̃ ti a kò le jẹ ẹ, nitori nwọn buru jù.
entries.en: Then said the LORD unto me, What seest thou, Jeremiah? And I said, Figs; the good figs, very good; and the evil, very evil, that cannot be eaten, they are so evil.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ Oluwa si tọ̀ mi wá wipe,
entries.en: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun Israeli wi; Gẹgẹ bi eso-ọ̀pọtọ daradara wọnyi, bẹ̃li emi o fi oju rere wò awọn ìgbekun Juda, ti emi ran jade kuro ni ibi yi lọ si ilẹ awọn ara Kaldea.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel; Like these good figs, so will I acknowledge them that are carried away captive of Judah, whom I have sent out of this place into the land of the Chaldeans for their good.

entries.yo: Emi o si kọju mi si wọn fun rere, emi o si mu wọn pada wá si ilẹ yi, emi o gbe wọn ró li aitun wó wọn lulẹ, emi o gbìn wọn, li aitun fà wọn tu.
entries.en: For I will set mine eyes upon them for good, and I will bring them again to this land: and I will build them, and not pull them down; and I will plant them, and not pluck them up.

entries.yo: Emi o si fun wọn li ọkàn lati mọ̀ mi, pe, Emi li Oluwa, nwọn o si jẹ enia mi, emi o si jẹ Ọlọrun wọn, nitoripe nwọn o fi gbogbo ọkàn wọn yipada si mi.
entries.en: And I will give them an heart to know me, that I am the LORD: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God: for they shall return unto me with their whole heart.

entries.yo: Ati gẹgẹ bi eso-ọ̀pọtọ biburujù ti a kò le jẹ, nitoriti nwọn burujù, bayi li Oluwa wi, Bẹ̃ gẹgẹ ni emi o ṣe Sedekiah, ọba Juda, ati awọn ijoye rẹ̀, ati awọn ti o kù ni Jerusalemu, ati awọn iyokù ni ilẹ yi ati awọn ti ngbe ilẹ Egipti.
entries.en: And as the evil figs, which cannot be eaten, they are so evil; surely thus saith the LORD, So will I give Zedekiah the king of Judah, and his princes, and the residue of Jerusalem, that remain in this land, and them that dwell in the land of Egypt:

entries.yo: Emi o fi wọn fun iwọsi ati fun ibi ninu gbogbo ijọba aiye, lati di ìtiju, owe, ẹsin, ati ẹ̀gan ni ibi gbogbo, ti emi o le wọn si.
entries.en: And I will deliver them to be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth for their hurt, to be a reproach and a proverb, a taunt and a curse, in all places whither I shall drive them.

entries.yo: Emi o si rán idà, ìyan, ati ajakalẹ-arun, si ãrin wọn, titi nwọn o fi parun kuro ni ilẹ eyi ti emi fi fun wọn ati fun awọn baba wọn.
entries.en: And I will send the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, among them, till they be consumed from off the land that I gave unto them and to their fathers.

entries.yo: Ọ̀RỌ ti o tọ̀ Jeremiah wá nitori gbogbo enia Juda, li ọdun kẹrin Jehoiakimu, ọmọ Josiah, ọbà Juda, ti iṣe ọdun ikini Nebukadnessari, ọba Babeli.
entries.en: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the people of Judah in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, that was the first year of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon;

entries.yo: Eyi ti Jeremiah, woli, sọ fun gbogbo enia Juda, ati fun awọn olugbe Jerusalemu wipe:
entries.en: The which Jeremiah the prophet spake unto all the people of Judah, and to all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying,

entries.yo: Lati ọdun kẹtala Josiah, ọmọ Amoni, ọba Juda, titi di oni-oloni, eyini ni, ọdun kẹtalelogun, ọ̀rọ Oluwa ti tọ mi wá, emi si ti sọ fun nyin, emi ndide ni kutukutu, emi nsọ, ṣugbọn ẹnyin kò feti si i.
entries.en: From the thirteenth year of Josiah the son of Amon king of Judah, even unto this day, that is the three and twentieth year, the word of the LORD hath come unto me, and I have spoken unto you, rising early and speaking; but ye have not hearkened.

entries.yo: Oluwa si ti rán gbogbo awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀, awọn woli si nyin, o ndide ni kutukutu lati rán wọn, ṣugbọn ẹnyin kò feti si i, bẹ̃ni ẹnyin kò tẹ eti nyin silẹ lati gbọ́.
entries.en: And the LORD hath sent unto you all his servants the prophets, rising early and sending them; but ye have not hearkened, nor inclined your ear to hear.

entries.yo: Wipe, ẹ sa yipada, olukuluku kuro ni ọ̀na buburu rẹ̀, ati kuro ni buburu iṣe nyin, ẹnyin o si gbe ilẹ ti Oluwa ti fi fun nyin, ati fun awọn baba nyin lai ati lailai.
entries.en: They said, Turn ye again now every one from his evil way, and from the evil of your doings, and dwell in the land that the LORD hath given unto you and to your fathers for ever and ever:

entries.yo: Ki ẹ má si tọ̀ ọlọrun miran lẹhin lati ma sìn wọn, ati lati ma foribalẹ fun wọn, ki ẹ má si ṣe fi iṣẹ ọwọ nyin mu mi binu, emi kì yio si ṣe nyin ni ibi.
entries.en: And go not after other gods to serve them, and to worship them, and provoke me not to anger with the works of your hands; and I will do you no hurt.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹnyin kò gbọ́ temi, li Oluwa wi, ki ẹnyin le fi iṣẹ ọwọ nyin mu mi binu si ibi ara nyin.
entries.en: Yet ye have not hearkened unto me, saith the LORD; that ye might provoke me to anger with the works of your hands to your own hurt.

entries.yo: Nitorina, bayi li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi: nitori ti ẹnyin kò gbọ́ ọ̀rọ mi.
entries.en: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts; Because ye have not heard my words,

entries.yo: Sa wò o, emi o ranṣẹ, emi o si mu gbogbo idile orilẹ-ède ariwa wá, li Oluwa wi, emi o si ranṣẹ si Nebukadnessari, ọba Babeli, ọmọ-ọdọ mi, emi o si mu wọn wá si ilẹ yi, ati olugbe rẹ̀, ati si gbogbo awọn orilẹ-ède yikakiri, emi o si pa wọn patapata, emi o si sọ wọn di iyanu ati iyọṣuti si, ati ahoro ainipẹkun.
entries.en: Behold, I will send and take all the families of the north, saith the LORD, and Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon, my servant, and will bring them against this land, and against the inhabitants thereof, and against all these nations round about, and will utterly destroy them, and make them an astonishment, and an hissing, and perpetual desolations.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu emi o mu ohùn inudidùn, ati ohùn ayọ, ohùn ọkọ-iyawo, ati ohùn iyawo, iro okuta ọlọ, ati imọlẹ fitila kuro lọdọ wọn.
entries.en: Moreover I will take from them the voice of mirth, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride, the sound of the millstones, and the light of the candle.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ilẹ yi yio si di iparun ati ahoro: orilẹ-ède wọnyi yio si sìn ọba Babeli li ãdọrin ọdun.
entries.en: And this whole land shall be a desolation, and an astonishment; and these nations shall serve the king of Babylon seventy years.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, nigbati ãdọrin ọdun ba pari tan, li emi o bẹ̀ ọba Babeli, ati orilẹ-ède na, ati ilẹ awọn ara Kaldea wò, nitori ẹ̀ṣẹ wọn; li Oluwa wi, emi o si sọ ọ di ahoro titi lai.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass, when seventy years are accomplished, that I will punish the king of Babylon, and that nation, saith the LORD, for their iniquity, and the land of the Chaldeans, and will make it perpetual desolations.

entries.yo: Emi o si mu gbogbo ọ̀rọ mi wá sori ilẹ na, ti mo ti sọ si i: ani gbogbo eyiti a ti kọ sinu iwe yi, eyiti Jeremiah ti sọtẹlẹ si gbogbo orilẹ-ède.
entries.en: And I will bring upon that land all my words which I have pronounced against it, even all that is written in this book, which Jeremiah hath prophesied against all the nations.

entries.yo: Nitoriti awọn wọnyi pẹlu yio mu ki orilẹ-ède pupọ, ati awọn ọba nla sìn wọn: emi o san a fun wọn gẹgẹ bi iṣe wọn ati pẹlu gẹgẹ bi iṣẹ ọwọ wọn.
entries.en: For many nations and great kings shall serve themselves of them also: and I will recompense them according to their deeds, and according to the works of their own hands.

entries.yo: Nitori bayi ni Oluwa Ọlọrun Israeli wi fun mi: Gba ago ọti-waini ibinu mi yi kuro lọwọ mi, ki o si jẹ ki gbogbo orilẹ-ède ti emi o rán ọ si, mu u.
entries.en: For thus saith the LORD God of Israel unto me; Take the wine cup of this fury at my hand, and cause all the nations, to whom I send thee, to drink it.

entries.yo: Ki nwọn mu, ki nwọn si ma ta gbọ̀ngbọn, ki nwọn si di aṣiwere, nitori idà ti emi o rán si ãrin wọn.
entries.en: And they shall drink, and be moved, and be mad, because of the sword that I will send among them.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni mo gba ago na li ọwọ Oluwa, emi si jẹ ki gbogbo orilẹ-ède, ti Oluwa rán mi si, mu u.
entries.en: Then took I the cup at the LORD's hand, and made all the nations to drink, unto whom the LORD had sent me:

entries.yo: Ani Jerusalemu ati ilu Juda wọnni, ati awọn ọba wọn pẹlu awọn ijoye, lati sọ wọn di ahoro, idãmu, ẹsin, ati egún, gẹgẹ bi o ti ri loni.
entries.en: To wit, Jerusalem, and the cities of Judah, and the kings thereof, and the princes thereof, to make them a desolation, an astonishment, an hissing, and a curse; as it is this day;

entries.yo: Farao, ọba Egipti, ati awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀, ati awọn ijoye rẹ̀, ati gbogbo enia rẹ̀.
entries.en: Pharaoh king of Egypt, and his servants, and his princes, and all his people;

entries.yo: Ati gbogbo awọn enia ajeji, ati gbogbo ọba ilẹ Usi, gbogbo ọba ilẹ Filistia, ati Aṣkeloni, ati Gasa, ati Ekroni, ati awọn iyokù Aṣdodi,
entries.en: And all the mingled people, and all the kings of the land of Uz, and all the kings of the land of the Philistines, and Ashkelon, and Azzah, and Ekron, and the remnant of Ashdod,

entries.yo: Edomu, ati Moabu, ati awọn ọmọ Ammoni,
entries.en: Edom, and Moab, and the children of Ammon,

entries.yo: Ati gbogbo awọn ọba Tire, ati gbogbo awọn ọba Sidoni, ati awọn ọba erekuṣu wọnni ti mbẹ ni ikọja okun,
entries.en: And all the kings of Tyrus, and all the kings of Zidon, and the kings of the isles which are beyond the sea,

entries.yo: Dedani, ati Tema, ati Busi, ati gbogbo awọn ti nda òṣu.
entries.en: Dedan, and Tema, and Buz, and all that are in the utmost corners,

entries.yo: Ati gbogbo awọn ọba Arabia, pẹlu awọn ọba awọn enia ajeji ti ngbe inu aginju.
entries.en: And all the kings of Arabia, and all the kings of the mingled people that dwell in the desert,

entries.yo: Ati gbogbo awọn ọba Simri, ati gbogbo awọn ọba Elamu, ati gbogbo awọn ọba Medea.
entries.en: And all the kings of Zimri, and all the kings of Elam, and all the kings of the Medes,

entries.yo: Ati gbogbo awọn ọba ariwa, ti itosi ati ti ọ̀na jijin, ẹnikini pẹlu ẹnikeji rẹ̀, ati gbogbo ijọba aiye, ti mbẹ li oju aiye, ọba Ṣeṣaki yio si mu lẹhin wọn.
entries.en: And all the kings of the north, far and near, one with another, and all the kingdoms of the world, which are upon the face of the earth: and the king of Sheshach shall drink after them.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si wi fun wọn pe: Bayi li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun, Ọlọrun Israeli wi, Ẹ mu, ki ẹ si mu amuyo, ki ẹ bì, ki ẹ si ṣubu, ki ẹ má si le dide mọ́, nitori idà ti emi o rán sãrin nyin.
entries.en: Therefore thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Drink ye, and be drunken, and spue, and fall, and rise no more, because of the sword which I will send among you.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, bi nwọn ba kọ̀ lati gba ago lọwọ rẹ lati mu, ni iwọ o si wi fun wọn pe: Bayi li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi, ni mimu ẹnyin o mu!
entries.en: And it shall be, if they refuse to take the cup at thine hand to drink, then shalt thou say unto them, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Ye shall certainly drink.

entries.yo: Sa wò o, nitori ti emi bẹrẹ si imu ibi wá sori ilu na ti a pè li orukọ mi, ẹnyin fẹ ijẹ alaijiya? ẹnyin kì yio ṣe alaijiya: nitori emi o pè fun idà sori gbogbo olugbe aiye, li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi.
entries.en: For, lo, I begin to bring evil on the city which is called by my name, and should ye be utterly unpunished? Ye shall not be unpunished: for I will call for a sword upon all the inhabitants of the earth, saith the LORD of hosts.

entries.yo: Njẹ iwọ sọ asọtẹlẹ gbogbo ọ̀rọ wọnyi fun wọn, ki o si wi fun wọn pe, Oluwa yio kọ lati oke wá, yio si fọ ohùn rẹ̀ lati ibugbe rẹ̀ mimọ́, ni kikọ, yio kọ sori ibugbe rẹ̀, yio pariwo sori gbogbo olugbe aiye, bi awọn ti ntẹ ifunti.
entries.en: Therefore prophesy thou against them all these words, and say unto them, The LORD shall roar from on high, and utter his voice from his holy habitation; he shall mightily roar upon his habitation; he shall give a shout, as they that tread the grapes, against all the inhabitants of the earth.

entries.yo: Igbe kan yio wá titi de opin ilẹ aiye; nitori Oluwa ni ijà ti yio ba awọn orilẹ-ède ja, yio ba gbogbo ẹran-ara wijọ, yio fi awọn oluṣe-buburu fun idà, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: A noise shall come even to the ends of the earth; for the LORD hath a controversy with the nations, he will plead with all flesh; he will give them that are wicked to the sword, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi, sa wò o, ibi yio jade lati orilẹ-ède de orilẹ-ède, ìji nlanla yio ru soke lati agbegbe aiye.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, Behold, evil shall go forth from nation to nation, and a great whirlwind shall be raised up from the coasts of the earth.

entries.yo: Awọn ti Oluwa pa yio wà li ọjọ na lati ipẹkun kini aiye titi de ipẹkun keji aiye, a kì yio ṣọ̀fọ wọn, a kì yio ko wọn jọpọ, bẹ̃ni a kì yio sin wọn, nwọn o di àtan lori ilẹ.
entries.en: And the slain of the LORD shall be at that day from one end of the earth even unto the other end of the earth: they shall not be lamented, neither gathered, nor buried; they shall be dung upon the ground.

entries.yo: Ke! ẹnyin oluṣọ-agutan! ki ẹ si sọkun! ẹ fi ara nyin yilẹ ninu ẽru, ẹnyin ọlọla agbo-ẹran! nitori ọjọ a ti pa nyin ati lati tú nyin ka pe, ẹnyin o si ṣubu bi ohun-elo iyebiye.
entries.en: Howl, ye shepherds, and cry; and wallow yourselves in the ashes, ye principal of the flock: for the days of your slaughter and of your dispersions are accomplished; and ye shall fall like a pleasant vessel.

entries.yo: Sisa kì yio si fun awọn oluṣọ-agutan, bẹ̃ni asalà kì yio si fun awọn ọlọla agbo-ẹran.
entries.en: And the shepherds shall have no way to flee, nor the principal of the flock to escape.

entries.yo: Ohùn ẹkun awọn oluṣọ-agutan, ati igbe awọn ọlọla agbo-ẹran li a o gbọ́: nitori Oluwa bà papa-oko tutu wọn jẹ.
entries.en: A voice of the cry of the shepherds, and an howling of the principal of the flock, shall be heard: for the LORD hath spoiled their pasture.

entries.yo: Ibùgbe alafia li o di ahoro, niwaju ibinu kikan Oluwa.
entries.en: And the peaceable habitations are cut down because of the fierce anger of the LORD.

entries.yo: O ti fi pantiri rẹ̀ silẹ bi kiniun nitori ti ilẹ wọn di ahoro, niwaju ibinu idà aninilara, ati niwaju ibinu kikan rẹ̀.
entries.en: He hath forsaken his covert, as the lion: for their land is desolate because of the fierceness of the oppressor, and because of his fierce anger.

entries.yo: NI ibẹrẹ ijọba Jehoiakimu, ọmọ Josiah, ọba Juda, ni ọ̀rọ yi ti ọdọ Oluwa wá wipe;
entries.en: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah came this word from the LORD, saying,

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa wi, Duro ni àgbala ile Oluwa, ki o si sọ fun gbogbo ilu Juda ti o wá lati sìn ni ile Oluwa gbogbo ọ̀rọ ti mo pa laṣẹ fun ọ lati sọ fun wọn: máṣe ke ọ̀rọ kanṣoṣo kù:
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD; Stand in the court of the LORD's house, and speak unto all the cities of Judah, which come to worship in the LORD's house, all the words that I command thee to speak unto them; diminish not a word:

entries.yo: Bi o ba jẹ pe nwọn o gbọ́, ti olukuluku yio yipada kuro li ọ̀na buburu rẹ̀, ki emi ki o le yi ọkàn pada niti ibi ti emi rò lati ṣe si wọn, nitori iṣe buburu wọn.
entries.en: If so be they will hearken, and turn every man from his evil way, that I may repent me of the evil, which I purpose to do unto them because of the evil of their doings.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si wi fun wọn pe, Bayi li Oluwa wi: bi ẹnyin kì yio feti si mi lati rin ninu ofin mi, ti emi ti gbe kalẹ niwaju nyin.
entries.en: And thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the LORD; If ye will not hearken to me, to walk in my law, which I have set before you,

entries.yo: Lati gbọ́ ọ̀rọ awọn ọmọ-ọdọ mi, awọn woli, ti emi rán si nyin, ti mo ndide ni kutukutu, ti mo rán wọn; ṣugbọn ẹnyin kò gbọ́.
entries.en: To hearken to the words of my servants the prophets, whom I sent unto you, both rising up early, and sending them, but ye have not hearkened;

entries.yo: Emi o si ṣe ile yi bi Ṣilo, emi o si ṣe ilu yi ni ifibu si gbogbo orilẹ-ède aiye.
entries.en: Then will I make this house like Shiloh, and will make this city a curse to all the nations of the earth.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni awọn alufa, ati awọn woli, ati gbogbo enia gbọ́, bi Jeremiah ti nsọ ọ̀rọ wọnyi ni ile Oluwa.
entries.en: So the priests and the prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in the house of the LORD.

entries.yo: O si ṣe nigbati Jeremiah pari gbogbo ọ̀rọ ti Oluwa paṣẹ fun u lati sọ fun gbogbo enia, nigbana ni awọn alufa, ati awọn woli, ati gbogbo enia di i mu wipe, kikú ni iwọ o kú!
entries.en: Now it came to pass, when Jeremiah had made an end of speaking all that the LORD had commanded him to speak unto all the people, that the priests and the prophets and all the people took him, saying, Thou shalt surely die.

entries.yo: Ẽṣe ti iwọ sọ asọtẹlẹ li orukọ Oluwa wipe, Ile yi yio dabi Ṣilo, ati ilu yi yio di ahoro laini olugbe? Gbogbo enia kojọ pọ̀ tì Jeremiah ni ile Oluwa.
entries.en: Why hast thou prophesied in the name of the LORD, saying, This house shall be like Shiloh, and this city shall be desolate without an inhabitant? And all the people were gathered against Jeremiah in the house of the LORD.

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn ijoye Juda gbọ́ nkan wọnyi, nwọn jade lati ile ọba wá si ile Oluwa, nwọn si joko li ẹnu-ọ̀na titun ile Oluwa.
entries.en: When the princes of Judah heard these things, then they came up from the king's house unto the house of the LORD, and sat down in the entry of the new gate of the LORD's house.

entries.yo: Awọn alufa ati awọn woli wi fun awọn ijoye, ati gbogbo enia pe, ọkunrin yi jẹbi ikú nitoriti o sọ asọtẹlẹ si ilu yi, bi ẹnyin ti fi eti nyin gbọ́.
entries.en: Then spake the priests and the prophets unto the princes and to all the people, saying, This man is worthy to die; for he hath prophesied against this city, as ye have heard with your ears.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Jeremiah wi fun awọn ijoye ati gbogbo enia pe, Oluwa rán mi lati sọ asọtẹlẹ gbogbo ọ̀rọ ti ẹnyin gbọ́, si ile yi ati si ilu yi.
entries.en: Then spake Jeremiah unto all the princes and to all the people, saying, The LORD sent me to prophesy against this house and against this city all the words that ye have heard.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, ẹ tun ọ̀na nyin ati iṣe nyin ṣe, ki ẹ si gbọ́ ohùn Oluwa Ọlọrun nyin; Oluwa yio si yi ọkàn rẹ̀ pada niti ibi ti o sọ si nyin.
entries.en: Therefore now amend your ways and your doings, and obey the voice of the LORD your God; and the LORD will repent him of the evil that he hath pronounced against you.

entries.yo: Bi o ṣe ti emi, sa wò o, emi mbẹ li ọwọ nyin: ẹ ṣe si mi, gẹgẹ bi o ti dara ti o si yẹ loju nyin.
entries.en: As for me, behold, I am in your hand: do with me as seemeth good and meet unto you.

entries.yo: Sibẹ, ẹ mọ̀ eyi daju pe, bi ẹ ba pa mi, mimu ni ẹnyin o mu ẹ̀jẹ alaiṣẹ wá sori nyin ati sori ilu yi, ati sori awọn olugbe rẹ̀: nitori li otitọ Oluwa li o rán mi si nyin lati sọ gbogbo ọ̀rọ wọnyi li eti nyin.
entries.en: But know ye for certain, that if ye put me to death, ye shall surely bring innocent blood upon yourselves, and upon this city, and upon the inhabitants thereof: for of a truth the LORD hath sent me unto you to speak all these words in your ears.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni awọn ijoye ati gbogbo enia sọ fun awọn alufa ati awọn woli pe, ọkunrin yi kò yẹ lati kú; nitoriti o sọ̀rọ fun wa li orukọ Oluwa, Ọlọrun wa.
entries.en: Then said the princes and all the people unto the priests and to the prophets; This man is not worthy to die: for he hath spoken to us in the name of the LORD our God.

entries.yo: Awọn ọkunrin kan ninu awọn àgba na si dide, nwọn si sọ fun gbogbo ijọ enia wipe:
entries.en: Then rose up certain of the elders of the land, and spake to all the assembly of the people, saying,

entries.yo: Mikah, ara Moraṣi, ṣe woli li ọjọ Hesekiah, ọba Juda, o si wi fun gbogbo enia Juda pe: Bayi li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi: a o tulẹ Sioni fun oko, Jerusalemu yio di òkiti alapa, ati oke ile yi gẹgẹ bi ibi giga igbo.
entries.en: Micah the Morasthite prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and spake to all the people of Judah, saying, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Zion shall be plowed like a field, and Jerusalem shall become heaps, and the mountains of the house as the high places of a forest.

entries.yo: Njẹ, Hesekiah, ọba Juda, ati gbogbo Juda ha pa a bi? Ẹ̀ru Oluwa kò ha bà a, kò ha bẹ Oluwa bi? Oluwa si yi ọkàn pada niti ibi ti o ti sọ si wọn; Bayi li awa iba ṣe mu ibi nla wá sori ẹmi wa?
entries.en: Did Hezekiah king of Judah and all Judah put him at all to death? did he not fear the LORD, and besought the LORD, and the LORD repented him of the evil which he had pronounced against them? Thus might we procure great evil against our souls.

entries.yo: Ọkunrin kan si wà ẹ̀wẹ, ti o sọ asọtẹlẹ ni orukọ Oluwa, ani Urijah, ọmọ Ṣemaiah, ara Kirjatjearimu, ti o sọ asọtẹlẹ si ilu yi, ati si ilẹ yi, gẹgẹ bi gbogbo ọ̀rọ Jeremiah.
entries.en: And there was also a man that prophesied in the name of the LORD, Urijah the son of Shemaiah of Kirjath-jearim, who prophesied against this city and against this land according to all the words of Jeremiah:

entries.yo: Ati nigbati Jehoiakimu, ọba, pẹlu gbogbo ọkunrin alagbara rẹ̀, ati awọn ijoye gbọ́ ọ̀rọ rẹ̀, ọba nwá a lati pa; ṣugbọn nigbati Urijah gbọ́, o bẹ̀ru, o salọ o si wá si Egipti.
entries.en: And when Jehoiakim the king, with all his mighty men, and all the princes, heard his words, the king sought to put him to death: but when Urijah heard it, he was afraid, and fled, and went into Egypt;

entries.yo: Jehoiakimu, ọba, si rán enia lọ si Egipti, ani Elnatani, ọmọ Akbori ati enia miran pẹlu rẹ̀ lọ si Egipti.
entries.en: And Jehoiakim the king sent men into Egypt, namely, Elnathan the son of Achbor, and certain men with him into Egypt.

entries.yo: Nwọn si mu Urijah lati Egipti tọ Jehoiakimu ọba wá; ẹni ti o fi idà pa a, o si sọ okú rẹ̀ sinu isa-okú awọn enia lasan.
entries.en: And they fetched forth Urijah out of Egypt, and brought him unto Jehoiakim the king; who slew him with the sword, and cast his dead body into the graves of the common people.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni ọwọ Ahikamu, ọmọ Safani mbẹ pẹlu Jeremiah, ki nwọn ki o má ba fi i le awọn enia lọwọ lati pa.
entries.en: Nevertheless the hand of Ahikam the son of Shaphan was with Jeremiah, that they should not give him into the hand of the people to put him to death.

entries.yo: LI atetekọbẹrẹ ijọba Sedekiah, ọmọ Josiah, ọba Juda, li ọ̀rọ yi tọ̀ Jeremiah wá lati ọ̀dọ Oluwa wipe,
entries.en: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah came this word unto Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa wi fun mi; Ṣe ijara ati àjaga-ọrùn fun ara rẹ, ki o si fi wọ ọrùn rẹ.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD to me; Make thee bonds and yokes, and put them upon thy neck,

entries.yo: Ki o rán wọn lọ si ọdọ ọba Edomu, ati si ọba Moabu, ati si ọba awọn ọmọ Ammoni, ati si ọba Tire, ati si ọba Sidoni, lọwọ awọn ikọ̀ ti o wá si Jerusalemu sọdọ Sedekiah, ọba Juda.
entries.en: And send them to the king of Edom, and to the king of Moab, and to the king of the Ammonites, and to the king of Tyrus, and to the king of Zidon, by the hand of the messengers which come to Jerusalem unto Zedekiah king of Judah;

entries.yo: Ki o si paṣẹ fun wọn lati wi fun awọn oluwa wọn pe, Bayi li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun, Ọlọrun Israeli wi, Bayi li ẹnyin o wi fun awọn oluwa nyin pe;
entries.en: And command them to say unto their masters, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Thus shall ye say unto your masters;

entries.yo: Emi ti dá aiye, enia ati ẹranko ti o wà lori ilẹ aiye, nipa agbara nla mi, ati nipa ọwọ ninà mi, emi si fi i fun ẹnikẹni ti o wù mi.
entries.en: I have made the earth, the man and the beast that are upon the ground, by my great power and by my outstretched arm, and have given it unto whom it seemed meet unto me.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, emi fi gbogbo ilẹ yi le ọwọ Nebukadnessari, ọba Babeli, ọmọ-ọdọ mi: ati ẹranko igbẹ ni mo fi fun u pẹlu lati sin i.
entries.en: And now have I given all these lands unto the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, my servant; and the beasts of the field have I given him also to serve him.

entries.yo: Ati orilẹ-ède gbogbo ni yio sin on, ati ọmọ rẹ̀ ati ọmọ-ọmọ rẹ̀, titi di ìgba ti akoko ilẹ tirẹ̀ yio de; lara rẹ̀ ni orilẹ-ède pupọ ati awọn ọba nla yio jẹ.
entries.en: And all nations shall serve him, and his son, and his son's son, until the very time of his land come: and then many nations and great kings shall serve themselves of him.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, orilẹ-ède ati ijọba ti kì yio sin Nebukadnessari ọba Babeli, ti kì yio fi ọrùn wọn si abẹ àjaga ọba Babeli, orilẹ-ède na li emi o fi idà, ati ìyan, ati ajakalẹ-arun, jẹ niya, li Oluwa wi, titi emi o fi run wọn nipa ọwọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass, that the nation and kingdom which will not serve the same Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, and that will not put their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, that nation will I punish, saith the LORD, with the sword, and with the famine, and with the pestilence, until I have consumed them by his hand.

entries.yo: Nitorina ẹ máṣe fi eti si awọn woli nyin, tabi si awọn alafọṣẹ nyin, tabi si awọn alála, tabi si awọn oṣo nyin, tabi awọn ajẹ nyin ti nsọ fun nyin pe, Ẹnyin kì o sin ọba Babeli:
entries.en: Therefore hearken not ye to your prophets, nor to your diviners, nor to your dreamers, nor to your enchanters, nor to your sorcerers, which speak unto you, saying, Ye shall not serve the king of Babylon:

entries.yo: Nitori nwọn sọ-asọtẹlẹ eke fun nyin, lati mu nyin jina réré kuro ni ilẹ nyin, ki emi ki o lè lé nyin jade, ti ẹnyin o si ṣegbe.
entries.en: For they prophesy a lie unto you, to remove you far from your land; and that I should drive you out, and ye should perish.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn orilẹ-ède na ti o mu ọrùn rẹ̀ wá si abẹ àjaga ọba Babeli, ti o si sìn i, on li emi o jẹ ki o joko ni ilẹ wọn, li Oluwa wi, yio si ro o, yio si gbe ibẹ.
entries.en: But the nations that bring their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him, those will I let remain still in their own land, saith the LORD; and they shall till it, and dwell therein.

entries.yo: Emi si wi fun Sedekiah, ọba Juda, gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ wọnyi, pe, Ẹ mu ọrùn nyin si abẹ àjaga ọba Babeli, ki ẹ sin i, pẹlu awọn enia rẹ̀, bẹ̃li ẹnyin o yè.
entries.en: I spake also to Zedekiah king of Judah according to all these words, saying, Bring your necks under the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him and his people, and live.

entries.yo: Ẽṣe ti ẹnyin o kú, iwọ, ati enia rẹ, nipa idà, ati ìyan, ati ajakalẹ-arun, bi Oluwa ti sọ si orilẹ-ède ti kì yio sin ọba Babeli.
entries.en: Why will ye die, thou and thy people, by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, as the LORD hath spoken against the nation that will not serve the king of Babylon?

entries.yo: Ẹ máṣe gbọ́ ọ̀rọ awọn woli ti nwọn nsọ fun nyin wipe, Ẹnyin kì yio sin ọba Babeli, nitori nwọn sọ asọtẹlẹ eke fun nyin.
entries.en: Therefore hearken not unto the words of the prophets that speak unto you, saying, Ye shall not serve the king of Babylon: for they prophesy a lie unto you.

entries.yo: Nitori emi kò rán wọn, li Oluwa wi, ṣugbọn nwọn nsọ asọtẹlẹ eke li orukọ mi: ki emi ki o lè lé nyin jade, ki ẹ ṣegbe, ẹnyin, pẹlu awọn woli ti o sọ asọtẹlẹ fun nyin.
entries.en: For I have not sent them, saith the LORD, yet they prophesy a lie in my name; that I might drive you out, and that ye might perish, ye, and the prophets that prophesy unto you.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu emi sọ fun awọn alufa ati fun gbogbo enia yi wipe, Bayi li Oluwa wi, Ẹ má gbọ́ ọ̀rọ awọn woli ti nsọ asọtẹlẹ fun nyin wipe, Sa wò o, ohun-èlo ile Oluwa li a o mu pada li aipẹ nisisiyi lati Babeli wá: nitori nwọn sọ asọtẹlẹ eke fun nyin.
entries.en: Also I spake to the priests and to all this people, saying, Thus saith the LORD; Hearken not to the words of your prophets that prophesy unto you, saying, Behold, the vessels of the LORD's house shall now shortly be brought again from Babylon: for they prophesy a lie unto you.

entries.yo: Ẹ máṣe gbọ́ ti wọn; ẹ sin ọba Babeli, ẹ si yè: ẽṣe ti ilu yi yio fi di ahoro?
entries.en: Hearken not unto them; serve the king of Babylon, and live: wherefore should this city be laid waste?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi nwọn ba ṣe woli, ati bi ọ̀rọ Oluwa ba wà pẹlu wọn, jẹ ki nwọn ki o bẹbẹ lọdọ Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun, ki ohun-èlo iyokù ni ile Oluwa ati ni ile ọba Judah, ati ni Jerusalemu, ki nwọn ki o máṣe lọ si Babeli.
entries.en: But if they be prophets, and if the word of the LORD be with them, let them now make intercession to the LORD of hosts, that the vessels which are left in the house of the LORD, and in the house of the king of Judah, and at Jerusalem, go not to Babylon.

entries.yo: Nitori bayi li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi niti opó mejeji, ati niti agbada nla, ati niti ipilẹṣẹ, ati niti ohun-èlo iyokù ti o kù ni ilu yi.
entries.en: For thus saith the LORD of hosts concerning the pillars, and concerning the sea, and concerning the bases, and concerning the residue of the vessels that remain in this city,

entries.yo: Eyi ti Nebukadnessari, ọba Babeli, kò mu lọ nigbati o mu Jekoniah, ọmọ Jehoiakimu, ọba Juda, ni igbèkun lati Jerusalemu lọ si Babeli, pẹlu gbogbo awọn ọlọla Juda ati Jerusalemu;
entries.en: Which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took not, when he carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah from Jerusalem to Babylon, and all the nobles of Judah and Jerusalem;

entries.yo: Nitori bayi li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun, Ọlọrun Israeli wi, niti ohun-èlo ti o kù ni ile Oluwa, ati ni ile ọba Juda ati Jerusalemu.
entries.en: Yea, thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, concerning the vessels that remain in the house of the LORD, and in the house of the king of Judah and of Jerusalem;

entries.yo: A o kó wọn lọ si Babeli, nibẹ ni nwọn o wà titi di ọjọ na ti emi o bẹ̀ wọn wò, li Oluwa wi, emi o si mu wọn goke wá, emi o si mu wọn pada wá si ibi yi.
entries.en: They shall be carried to Babylon, and there shall they be until the day that I visit them, saith the LORD; then will I bring them up, and restore them to this place.

entries.yo: O si ṣe li ọdun kanna li atetekọbẹrẹ ijọba Sedekiah, ọba Juda, li ọdun kẹrin ati oṣù karun, ti Hananiah, ọmọ Asuri woli, ti iṣe ti Gibeoni, wi fun mi ni ile Oluwa, niwaju awọn alufa ati gbogbo enia pe,
entries.en: And it came to pass the same year, in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the fourth year, and in the fifth month, that Hananiah the son of Azur the prophet, which was of Gibeon, spake unto me in the house of the LORD, in the presence of the priests and of all the people, saying,

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun, Ọlọrun Israeli wi, pe, Emi ti ṣẹ àjaga ọba Babeli.
entries.en: Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, saying, I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon.

entries.yo: Ninu akoko ọdun meji li emi o tun mu gbogbo ohun-èlo ile Oluwa pada wá si ibi yi, ti Nebukadnessari, ọba Babeli, kó kuro ni ibi yi, ti o si mu wọn lọ si Babeli.
entries.en: Within two full years will I bring again into this place all the vessels of the LORD's house, that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took away from this place, and carried them to Babylon:
