entries.yo: Emi o si tun mu Jekoniah, ọmọ Jehoiakimu, ọba Juda, pẹlu awọn igbekun Juda, ti o ti lọ si Babeli pada wá si ibi yi, li Oluwa wi, nitori emi o si ṣẹ àjaga ọba Babeli.
entries.en: And I will bring again to this place Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah, with all the captives of Judah, that went into Babylon, saith the LORD: for I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon.

entries.yo: Jeremiah woli si wi fun Hananiah woli niwaju awọn alufa ati niwaju gbogbo enia, ti o duro ni ile Oluwa pe:
entries.en: Then the prophet Jeremiah said unto the prophet Hananiah in the presence of the priests, and in the presence of all the people that stood in the house of the LORD,

entries.yo: Jeremiah woli si wipe, Amin: ki Oluwa ki o ṣe bẹ̃: ki Oluwa ki o mu ọ̀rọ rẹ ti iwọ sọ asọtẹlẹ ṣẹ, lati mu ohun-elo ile Oluwa ati gbogbo igbekun pada, lati Babeli wá si ibi yi.
entries.en: Even the prophet Jeremiah said, Amen: the LORD do so: the LORD perform thy words which thou hast prophesied, to bring again the vessels of the LORD's house, and all that is carried away captive, from Babylon into this place.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nisisiyi, iwọ gbọ́ ọ̀rọ yi ti mo sọ si eti rẹ ati si eti enia gbogbo.
entries.en: Nevertheless hear thou now this word that I speak in thine ears, and in the ears of all the people;

entries.yo: Awọn woli ti o ti ṣaju mi, ati ṣaju rẹ ni igbãni sọ asọtẹlẹ pupọ, ati si ijọba nla niti ogun, ati ibi, ati ajakalẹ-arun.
entries.en: The prophets that have been before me and before thee of old prophesied both against many countries, and against great kingdoms, of war, and of evil, and of pestilence.

entries.yo: Woli nì ti o sọ asọtẹlẹ alafia, bi ọ̀rọ woli na ba ṣẹ, nigbana ni a o mọ̀ woli na pe, Oluwa rán a nitõtọ.
entries.en: The prophet which prophesieth of peace, when the word of the prophet shall come to pass, then shall the prophet be known, that the LORD hath truly sent him.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Hananiah woli mu àjaga kuro li ọrùn Jeremiah woli o si ṣẹ́ ẹ.
entries.en: Then Hananiah the prophet took the yoke from off the prophet Jeremiah's neck, and brake it.

entries.yo: Hananiah si wi niwaju gbogbo enia pe, Bayi li Oluwa wi; Bẹ̃ gẹgẹ li emi o ṣẹ́ ajaga Nebukadnessari, ọba Babeli, kuro li ọrùn orilẹ-ède gbogbo ni igba ọdun meji. Jeremiah woli si ba ọ̀na tirẹ̀ lọ.
entries.en: And Hananiah spake in the presence of all the people, saying, Thus saith the LORD; Even so will I break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon from the neck of all nations within the space of two full years. And the prophet Jeremiah went his way.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ọ̀rọ Oluwa tọ̀ Jeremiah woli wá lẹhin igbati Hananiah woli ti ṣẹ́ ajaga kuro li ọrùn Jeremiah woli, wipe,
entries.en: Then the word of the LORD came unto Jeremiah the prophet, after that Hananiah the prophet had broken the yoke from off the neck of the prophet Jeremiah, saying,

entries.yo: Lọ isọ fun Hananiah wipe, Bayi li Oluwa wi; Iwọ ti ṣẹ́ àjaga igi; ṣugbọn iwọ o si ṣe àjaga irin ni ipo wọn.
entries.en: Go and tell Hananiah, saying, Thus saith the LORD; Thou hast broken the yokes of wood; but thou shalt make for them yokes of iron.

entries.yo: Nitori bayi li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun, Ọlọrun Israeli wi: emi ti fi ajaga irin si ọrùn gbogbo orilẹ-ède wọnyi, ki nwọn ki o sin Nebukadnessari, ọba Babeli, nwọn o si sin i, emi si fi ẹranko igbẹ fun u pẹlu.
entries.en: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; I have put a yoke of iron upon the neck of all these nations, that they may serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; and they shall serve him: and I have given him the beasts of the field also.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Jeremiah, woli, wi fun Hananiah, woli, pe, Gbọ́ nisisiyi, Hananiah; Oluwa kò rán ọ; ṣugbọn iwọ jẹ ki enia yi ki o gbẹkẹle eke.
entries.en: Then said the prophet Jeremiah unto Hananiah the prophet, Hear now, Hananiah; The LORD hath not sent thee; but thou makest this people to trust in a lie.

entries.yo: Nitorina bayi li Oluwa wi; Sa wo o, emi o ta ọ nù kuro loju aiye: li ọdun yi ni iwọ o kú, nitori iwọ ti sọ̀rọ iṣọtẹ si Oluwa.
entries.en: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will cast thee from off the face of the earth: this year thou shalt die, because thou hast taught rebellion against the LORD.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Hananiah woli si kú li ọdun na li oṣu keje.
entries.en: So Hananiah the prophet died the same year in the seventh month.

entries.yo: WỌNYI si li ọ̀rọ iwe ti Jeremiah woli rán lati Jerusalemu si iyokù ninu awọn àgba ti o wà ni igbèkun, ati si awọn alufa, ati awọn woli, ati si gbogbo enia ti Nebukadnessari kó ni igbekun lọ lati Jerusalemu si Babeli.
entries.en: Now these are the words of the letter that Jeremiah the prophet sent from Jerusalem unto the residue of the elders which were carried away captives, and to the priests, and to the prophets, and to all the people whom Nebuchadnezzar had carried away captive from Jerusalem to Babylon;

entries.yo: Lẹhin igbati Jekoniah, ọba, ati ayaba, ati awọn iwẹfa, ati awọn ijoye Juda ati Jerusalemu, ati awọn gbẹna-gbẹna pẹlu awọn alagbẹdẹ ti fi Jerusalemu silẹ lọ.
entries.en: (After that Jeconiah the king, and the queen, and the eunuchs, the princes of Judah and Jerusalem, and the carpenters, and the smiths, were departed from Jerusalem;)

entries.yo: Nipa ọwọ Elasa, ọmọ Ṣafani, ati Gemariah, ọmọ Hilkiah, (ẹniti Sedekiah, ọba Juda, rán si Babeli tọ Nebukadnessari, ọba Babeli) wipe,
entries.en: By the hand of Elasah the son of Shaphan, and Gemariah the son of Hilkiah, (whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent unto Babylon to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon) saying,

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun, Ọlọrun Israeli, wi fun gbogbo awọn ti a kó ni igbekun lọ, ti emi mu ki a kó lọ lati Jerusalemu si Babeli;
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, unto all that are carried away captives, whom I have caused to be carried away from Jerusalem unto Babylon;

entries.yo: Ẹ kọ́ ile ki ẹ si ma gbe inu wọn; ẹ gbìn ọgba, ki ẹ si mã jẹ eso wọn;
entries.en: Build ye houses, and dwell in them; and plant gardens, and eat the fruit of them;

entries.yo: Ẹ fẹ́ aya, ki ẹ si bi ọmọkunrin ati ọmọbinrin; ki ẹ si fẹ́ aya fun awọn ọmọ nyin, ẹ si fi awọn ọmọbinrin nyin fun ọkọ, ki nwọn ki o le mã bi ọmọkunrin ati ọmọbinrin; ki ẹ le mã pọ si i nibẹ, ki ẹ má si dínkù.
entries.en: Take ye wives, and beget sons and daughters; and take wives for your sons, and give your daughters to husbands, that they may bear sons and daughters; that ye may be increased there, and not diminished.

entries.yo: Ki ẹ si mã wá alafia ilu na, nibiti emi ti mu ki a kó nyin lọ ni igbekun, ẹ si mã gbadura si Oluwa fun u: nitori ninu alafia rẹ̀ li ẹnyin o ni alafia.
entries.en: And seek the peace of the city whither I have caused you to be carried away captives, and pray unto the LORD for it: for in the peace thereof shall ye have peace.

entries.yo: Nitori bayi li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun, Ọlọrun Israeli, wi pe, Ẹ máṣe jẹ ki awọn woli nyin ti o wà lãrin nyin ati awọn alafọṣẹ nyin tàn nyin jẹ, ki ẹ má si feti si alá nyin ti ẹnyin lá.
entries.en: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Let not your prophets and your diviners, that be in the midst of you, deceive you, neither hearken to your dreams which ye cause to be dreamed.

entries.yo: Nitori nwọn sọ asọtẹlẹ eke fun nyin li orukọ mi: emi kò rán wọn, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: For they prophesy falsely unto you in my name: I have not sent them, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Nitori bayi li Oluwa wi pe, Lẹhin ti ãdọrin ọdun ba pari ni Babeli, li emi o bẹ̀ nyin wò, emi o si mu ọ̀rọ rere mi ṣẹ si nyin, ni mimu nyin pada si ibi yi.
entries.en: For thus saith the LORD, That after seventy years be accomplished at Babylon I will visit you, and perform my good word toward you, in causing you to return to this place.

entries.yo: Nitori emi mọ̀ ìro ti mo rò si nyin, li Oluwa wi, ani ìro alafia, kì si iṣe fun ibi, lati fun nyin ni ìgba ikẹhin ati ireti.
entries.en: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the LORD, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin o si kepe mi, ẹ o si lọ, ẹ o si gbadura si mi, emi o si tẹti si nyin.
entries.en: Then shall ye call upon me, and ye shall go and pray unto me, and I will hearken unto you.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin o si ṣafẹri mi, ẹ o si ri mi, nitori ẹ o fi gbogbo ọkàn nyin wá mi.
entries.en: And ye shall seek me, and find me, when ye shall search for me with all your heart.

entries.yo: Emi o di ríri fun nyin, li Oluwa wi: emi o si yi igbekun nyin pada kuro, emi o si kó nyin jọ lati gbogbo orilẹ-ède ati lati ibi gbogbo wá, nibiti emi ti lé nyin lọ, li Oluwa wi; emi o si tun mu nyin wá si ibi ti mo ti mu ki a kó nyin ni igbekun lọ.
entries.en: And I will be found of you, saith the LORD: and I will turn away your captivity, and I will gather you from all the nations, and from all the places whither I have driven you, saith the LORD; and I will bring you again into the place whence I caused you to be carried away captive.

entries.yo: Nitoriti ẹnyin ti wipe, Oluwa ti gbe awọn woli kalẹ fun wa ni Babeli:
entries.en: Because ye have said, The LORD hath raised us up prophets in Babylon;

entries.yo: Pe, Bayi li Oluwa wi niti ọba ti o joko lori itẹ́ Dafidi, ati niti gbogbo enia, ti ngbe ilu yi, ani niti awọn arakunrin nyin ti kò jade lọ pẹlu nyin sinu igbekun.
entries.en: Know that thus saith the LORD of the king that sitteth upon the throne of David, and of all the people that dwelleth in this city, and of your brethren that are not gone forth with you into captivity;

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi; Wò o, emi o rán idà sarin wọn, ìyan, ati àjakalẹ-àrun, emi o ṣe wọn bi eso-ọ̀pọtọ buburu, ti a kò le jẹ, nitori nwọn buru.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Behold, I will send upon them the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, and will make them like vile figs, that cannot be eaten, they are so evil.

entries.yo: Emi o si fi idà, ìyan, ati àjakalẹ-arun lepa wọn; emi o si fi wọn fun iwọsi ni gbogbo ijọba aiye, fun egún, ati iyanu, ati ẹsin, ati ẹ̀gan, lãrin gbogbo orilẹ-ède, nibiti emi o le wọn si.
entries.en: And I will persecute them with the sword, with the famine, and with the pestilence, and will deliver them to be removed to all the kingdoms of the earth, to be a curse, and an astonishment, and an hissing, and a reproach, among all the nations whither I have driven them:

entries.yo: Nitoriti nwọn kò gbọ́ ọ̀rọ mi, li Oluwa wi, ti emi rán si wọn nipa awọn ọmọ-ọdọ mi, awọn woli, emi dide ni kutukutu mo si rán wọn; ṣugbọn ẹnyin kò fẹ igbọ́, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: Because they have not hearkened to my words, saith the LORD, which I sent unto them by my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them; but ye would not hear, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Njẹ ẹ gbọ́ ọ̀rọ Oluwa, gbogbo ẹnyin igbekun ti emi ti ran jade lati Jerusalemu si Babeli.
entries.en: Hear ye therefore the word of the LORD, all ye of the captivity, whom I have sent from Jerusalem to Babylon:

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun, Ọlọrun Israeli, wi, niti Ahabu ọmọ Kolaiah, ati niti Sedekiah ọmọ Maaseiah, ti nsọtẹlẹ eke fun nyin li orukọ mi; wò o, emi fi wọn le ọwọ Nebukadnessari, ọba Babeli; on o si pa wọn li oju nyin;
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, of Ahab the son of Kolaiah, and of Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah, which prophesy a lie unto you in my name; Behold, I will deliver them into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon; and he shall slay them before your eyes;

entries.yo: Ati lati ọdọ wọn li a o da ọ̀rọ-egún kan silẹ li ẹnu gbogbo igbekun Juda ti o wà ni Babeli, wipe; Ki Oluwa ki o ṣe ọ bi Sedekiah, ati bi Ahabu, awọn ẹniti ọba Babeli sun ninu iná.
entries.en: And of them shall be taken up a curse by all the captivity of Judah which are in Babylon, saying, The LORD make thee like Zedekiah and like Ahab, whom the king of Babylon roasted in the fire;

entries.yo: Nitori nwọn ti hùwa wère ni Israeli, nwọn si ba aya aladugbo wọn ṣe panṣaga, nwọn si ti sọ̀rọ eke li orukọ mi, ti emi kò ti pa li aṣẹ fun wọn: emi tilẹ mọ̀, emi si li ẹlẹri, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: Because they have committed villany in Israel, and have committed adultery with their neighbours' wives, and have spoken lying words in my name, which I have not commanded them; even I know, and am a witness, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Ati fun Ṣemaiah ara Nehalami, ni iwọ o sọ wipe.
entries.en: Thus shalt thou also speak to Shemaiah the Nehelamite, saying,

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun, Ọlọrun Israeli wi pe, Nitoripe iwọ ti rán iwe li orukọ rẹ si gbogbo enia ti o wà ni Jerusalemu ati si Sefaniah, ọmọ Maaseiah, alufa, ati si gbogbo awọn alufa, wipe,
entries.en: Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, saying, Because thou hast sent letters in thy name unto all the people that are at Jerusalem, and to Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest, and to all the priests, saying,

entries.yo: Oluwa ti fi ọ jẹ oyè alufa ni ipo Jehoiada, alufa, ki ẹnyin ki o lè jẹ olutọju ni ile Oluwa, nitori olukuluku aṣiwere enia, ati ẹnikẹni ti o sọ asọtẹlẹ ki iwọ ki o le fi wọn sinu tubu ati sinu àba.
entries.en: The LORD hath made thee priest in the stead of Jehoiada the priest, that ye should be officers in the house of the LORD, for every man that is mad, and maketh himself a prophet, that thou shouldest put him in prison, and in the stocks.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, ẽṣe ti iwọ kò ba Jeremiah ti Anatoti wi, ẹniti o nsọ asọtẹlẹ fun nyin!
entries.en: Now therefore why hast thou not reproved Jeremiah of Anathoth, which maketh himself a prophet to you?

entries.yo: Nitorina li o ṣe ranṣẹ si wa ni Babeli, wipe, Akoko yio pẹ: ẹ kọ́ ile, ki ẹ si ma gbe inu wọn, ẹ si gbìn ọgbà, ki ẹ ma jẹ eso wọn.
entries.en: For therefore he sent unto us in Babylon, saying, This captivity is long: build ye houses, and dwell in them; and plant gardens, and eat the fruit of them.

entries.yo: Sefaniah, alufa, si ka iwe yi li eti Jeremiah woli.
entries.en: And Zephaniah the priest read this letter in the ears of Jeremiah the prophet.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ Oluwa si tọ̀ Jeremiah wá wipe,
entries.en: Then came the word of the LORD unto Jeremiah, saying,

entries.yo: Ranṣẹ si gbogbo awọn igbekun, wipe, Bayi li Oluwa wi niti Ṣemaiah, ara Nehalami, nitoripe Ṣemaiah ti sọtẹlẹ fun nyin, ṣugbọn emi kò ran a, ti on si mu nyin gbẹkẹle eke:
entries.en: Send to all them of the captivity, saying, Thus saith the LORD concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite; Because that Shemaiah hath prophesied unto you, and I sent him not, and he caused you to trust in a lie:

entries.yo: Nitorina, bayi li Oluwa wi: Wò o, emi o bẹ Ṣemaiah, ara Nehalami, wò, ati iru-ọmọ rẹ̀; on kì yio ni ọkunrin kan lati ma gbe ãrin enia yi; bẹ̃ni kì yio ri rere na ti emi o ṣe fun awọn enia mi, li Oluwa wi; nitoripe o ti ṣọ̀tẹ si Oluwa.
entries.en: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will punish Shemaiah the Nehelamite, and his seed: he shall not have a man to dwell among this people; neither shall he behold the good that I will do for my people, saith the LORD; because he hath taught rebellion against the LORD.

entries.yo: Ọ̀RỌ ti o tọ̀ Jeremiah wá lati ọdọ Oluwa wá, wipe.
entries.en: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa, Ọlọrun Israeli wi, pe, Iwọ kọ gbogbo ọ̀rọ ti mo ti ba ọ sọ sinu iwe kan.
entries.en: Thus speaketh the LORD God of Israel, saying, Write thee all the words that I have spoken unto thee in a book.

entries.yo: Nitori kiyesi i, ọjọ mbọ, li Oluwa wi, ti emi o mu igbekun awọn enia mi, Israeli ati Juda, pada, li Oluwa wi: emi o si mu ki nwọn pada bọ̀ si ilẹ ti emi fi fun awọn baba wọn, nwọn o si ni i.
entries.en: For, lo, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will bring again the captivity of my people Israel and Judah, saith the LORD: and I will cause them to return to the land that I gave to their fathers, and they shall possess it.

entries.yo: Wọnyi si li ọ̀rọ ti Oluwa sọ niti Israeli ati niti Juda.
entries.en: And these are the words that the LORD spake concerning Israel and concerning Judah.

entries.yo: Nitori bayi li Oluwa wi; Awa ti gbọ́ ohùn ìwa-riri, ẹ̀ru, kì si iṣe ti alafia.
entries.en: For thus saith the LORD; We have heard a voice of trembling, of fear, and not of peace.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin sa bere, ki ẹ si ri bi ọkunrin a mã rọbi ọmọ: Ẽṣe ti emi fi ri gbogbo awọn ọkunrin pẹlu ọwọ wọn li ẹgbẹ wọn, bi obinrin ti nrọbi, ti a si sọ gbogbo oju di jijoro?
entries.en: Ask ye now, and see whether a man doth travail with child? wherefore do I see every man with his hands on his loins, as a woman in travail, and all faces are turned into paleness?

entries.yo: Oṣe! nitori ọjọ na tobi, tobẹ̃ ti kò si ọkan bi iru rẹ̀: o jẹ àkoko wahala fun Jakobu; sibẹ a o gbà a kuro ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: Alas! for that day is great, so that none is like it: it is even the time of Jacob's trouble; but he shall be saved out of it.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe li ọjọ na, li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi, ti emi o si ṣẹ àjaga kuro li ọrùn rẹ, emi o si ja ìde rẹ, awọn alejo kì yio si mu ọ sìn wọn mọ:
entries.en: For it shall come to pass in that day, saith the LORD of hosts, that I will break his yoke from off thy neck, and will burst thy bonds, and strangers shall no more serve themselves of him:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nwọn o ma sin Oluwa Ọlọrun wọn, ati Dafidi ọba wọn, ẹniti emi o gbe kalẹ fun wọn.
entries.en: But they shall serve the LORD their God, and David their king, whom I will raise up unto them.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, má bẹ̀ru, iwọ Jakobu, ọmọ-ọdọ mi, li Oluwa wi; ki o má si fòya, iwọ Israeli: nitorina sa wò o, emi o gbà ọ lati okere wá, ati iru-ọmọ rẹ lati igbekun wọn; Jakobu yio si pada, yio si wà ni isimi, yio si gbe jẹ, ẹnikan kì yio si dẹruba a.
entries.en: Therefore fear thou not, O my servant Jacob, saith the LORD; neither be dismayed, O Israel: for, lo, I will save thee from afar, and thy seed from the land of their captivity; and Jacob shall return, and shall be in rest, and be quiet, and none shall make him afraid.

entries.yo: Nitori emi wà pẹlu rẹ, li Oluwa wi, lati gbà ọ: bi emi tilẹ ṣe ipari patapata ni gbogbo orilẹ-ède, nibiti emi ti tu ọ ka si, sibẹ emi kì yio ṣe ọ pari patapata: ṣugbọn emi o ba ọ wi ni ìwọn, emi kì o jọ̃ rẹ lọwọ li alaijiya.
entries.en: For I am with thee, saith the LORD, to save thee: though I make a full end of all nations whither I have scattered thee, yet will I not make a full end of thee: but I will correct thee in measure, and will not leave thee altogether unpunished.

entries.yo: Nitori bayi li Oluwa wi, Ifarapa rẹ jẹ aiwotan, ọgbẹ rẹ si jẹ aijina.
entries.en: For thus saith the LORD, Thy bruise is incurable, and thy wound is grievous.

entries.yo: Kò si ẹniti o gba ọ̀ran rẹ rò, lati dì i, ọja imularada kò si.
entries.en: There is none to plead thy cause, that thou mayest be bound up: thou hast no healing medicines.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn olufẹ rẹ ti gbagbe rẹ; nwọn kò tẹle ọ; nitori ìlù ọta li emi o lù ọ, ni inà alaini ãnu, nitori ọ̀pọlọpọ aiṣedede rẹ, nitori ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ pọ si i,
entries.en: All thy lovers have forgotten thee; they seek thee not; for I have wounded thee with the wound of an enemy, with the chastisement of a cruel one, for the multitude of thine iniquity; because thy sins were increased.

entries.yo: Ẽṣe ti iwọ nkigbe nitori ifarapa rẹ? ikãnu rẹ jẹ aiwotan, nitori ọ̀pọlọpọ aiṣedede rẹ; ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ si pọ̀ si i, nitorina ni emi ti ṣe ohun wọnyi si ọ.
entries.en: Why criest thou for thine affliction? thy sorrow is incurable for the multitude of thine iniquity: because thy sins were increased, I have done these things unto thee.

entries.yo: Nitorina gbogbo awọn ti o jẹ ọ, li a o jẹ; ati gbogbo awọn ọta rẹ, olukuluku wọn, ni yio lọ si igbekun: ati awọn ti o kó ọ yio di kikó, ati gbogbo awọn ti o fi ọ ṣe ijẹ li emi o fi fun ijẹ.
entries.en: Therefore all they that devour thee shall be devoured; and all thine adversaries, every one of them, shall go into captivity; and they that spoil thee shall be a spoil, and all that prey upon thee will I give for a prey.

entries.yo: Nitori emi o fi ọja imularada lè ọ, emi o si wò ọgbẹ rẹ san, li Oluwa wi; nitori nwọn pè ọ li ẹniti a le jade; Sioni, ti ẹnikan kò ṣafẹri rẹ̀!
entries.en: For I will restore health unto thee, and I will heal thee of thy wounds, saith the LORD; because they called thee an Outcast, saying, This is Zion, whom no man seeketh after.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa wi; Wò o, emi o tun mu igbekun agọ Jakobu pada bọ̀; emi o si ṣãnu fun ibugbe rẹ̀; a o si kọ́ ilu na sori okiti rẹ̀, a o si ma gbe ãfin gẹgẹ bi ilana rẹ̀.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will bring again the captivity of Jacob's tents, and have mercy on his dwellingplaces; and the city shall be builded upon her own heap, and the palace shall remain after the manner thereof.

entries.yo: Ati lati inu wọn ni ọpẹ́ ati ohùn awọn ti nyọ̀ yio ti jade: emi o si mu wọn bi si i, nwọn kì o si jẹ diẹ; emi o ṣe wọn li ogo pẹlu, nwọn kì o si kere.
entries.en: And out of them shall proceed thanksgiving and the voice of them that make merry: and I will multiply them, and they shall not be few; I will also glorify them, and they shall not be small.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ wọn pẹlu yio ri bi ti iṣaju, ijọ wọn li a o fi idi rẹ̀ mulẹ niwaju mi, emi o si jẹ gbogbo awọn ti o ni wọn lara niya.
entries.en: Their children also shall be as aforetime, and their congregation shall be established before me, and I will punish all that oppress them.

entries.yo: Ọlọla rẹ̀ yio si jẹ lati inu ara wọn wá, alakoso rẹ̀ lati ãrin rẹ̀; emi o si mu u sunmọ tosi, on o si sunmọ ọdọ mi: nitori tani ẹniti o mura ọkàn rẹ̀ lati sunmọ ọdọ mi? li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: And their nobles shall be of themselves, and their governor shall proceed from the midst of them; and I will cause him to draw near, and he shall approach unto me: for who is this that engaged his heart to approach unto me? saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin o si jẹ enia mi, emi o si jẹ Ọlọrun nyin.
entries.en: And ye shall be my people, and I will be your God.

entries.yo: Wò o, afẹfẹ iji Oluwa! ibinu ti jade! afẹyika ìji yio ṣubu ni ikanra si ori oluṣe-buburu.
entries.en: Behold, the whirlwind of the LORD goeth forth with fury, a continuing whirlwind: it shall fall with pain upon the head of the wicked.

entries.yo: Ibinu kikan Oluwa kì o pada, titi on o fi ṣe e, ati titi on o fi mu èro ọkàn rẹ̀ ṣẹ: li ọjọ ikẹhin ẹnyin o mọ̀ ọ daju.
entries.en: The fierce anger of the LORD shall not return, until he have done it, and until he have performed the intents of his heart: in the latter days ye shall consider it.

entries.yo: LI àkoko na, li Oluwa wi, li emi o jẹ Ọlọrun gbogbo idile Israeli, nwọn o si jẹ enia mi.
entries.en: At the same time, saith the LORD, will I be the God of all the families of Israel, and they shall be my people.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa wi, Enia ti o sala lọwọ idà ri ore-ọfẹ li aginju, ani Israeli nigbati emi lọ lati mu u lọ si isimi rẹ̀.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD, The people which were left of the sword found grace in the wilderness; even Israel, when I went to cause him to rest.

entries.yo: Oluwa ti fi ara hàn fun mi lati okere pe, Nitõtọ emi fi ifẹni aiyeraiye fẹ ọ, nitorina ni emi ti ṣe pa ore-ọfẹ mọ fun ọ.
entries.en: The LORD hath appeared of old unto me, saying, Yea, I have loved thee with an everlasting love: therefore with lovingkindness have I drawn thee.

entries.yo: Emi o tun ọ kọ́, iwọ o si di kikọ, iwọ wundia Israeli! iwọ o si fi timbreli rẹ ṣe ara rẹ lọṣọ, iwọ o si jade lọ ni ọwọ́-ijo ti awọn ti nyọ̀.
entries.en: Again I will build thee, and thou shalt be built, O virgin of Israel: thou shalt again be adorned with thy tabrets, and shalt go forth in the dances of them that make merry.

entries.yo: Iwọ o gbìn ọgba-ajara sori oke Samaria: awọn àgbẹ yio gbìn i, nwọn o si jẹ ẹ.
entries.en: Thou shalt yet plant vines upon the mountains of Samaria: the planters shall plant, and shall eat them as common things.

entries.yo: Nitori ọjọ na ni eyi, ti awọn oluṣọ lori oke Efraimu yio kigbe pe, Ẹ dide, ẹ si jẹ ki a goke lọ si Sioni sọdọ Oluwa, Ọlọrun wa.
entries.en: For there shall be a day, that the watchmen upon the mount Ephraim shall cry, Arise ye, and let us go up to Zion unto the LORD our God.

entries.yo: Nitori bayi li Oluwa wi; ẹ fi ayọ̀ kọrin didùn fun Jakobu, ẹ si ho niti olori awọn orilẹ-ède: ẹ kede! ẹ yìn, ki ẹ si wipe: Oluwa, gbà awọn enia rẹ la, iyokù Israeli!
entries.en: For thus saith the LORD; Sing with gladness for Jacob, and shout among the chief of the nations: publish ye, praise ye, and say, O LORD, save thy people, the remnant of Israel.

entries.yo: Wò o, emi o mu wọn lati ilẹ ariwa wá, emi o si kó wọn jọ lati àgbegbe ilẹ aiye, afọju ati ayarọ pẹlu wọn, aboyun ati ẹniti nrọbi ṣọkan pọ̀: li ẹgbẹ nlanla ni nwọn o pada sibẹ.
entries.en: Behold, I will bring them from the north country, and gather them from the coasts of the earth, and with them the blind and the lame, the woman with child and her that travaileth with child together: a great company shall return thither.

entries.yo: Nwọn o wá pẹlu ẹkun, pẹlu adura li emi o si ṣe amọ̀na wọn: emi o mu wọn rìn lẹba odò omi li ọ̀na ganran, nwọn kì yio kọsẹ ninu rẹ̀: nitori emi jẹ baba fun Israeli, Efraimu si li akọbi mi.
entries.en: They shall come with weeping, and with supplications will I lead them: I will cause them to walk by the rivers of waters in a straight way, wherein they shall not stumble: for I am a father to Israel, and Ephraim is my firstborn.

entries.yo: Ẹ gbọ́ ọ̀rọ Oluwa, ẹnyin orilẹ-ède, ẹ sọ ọ ninu erekuṣu òkere, ki ẹ si wipe, Ẹniti o tú Israeli ka yio kó o jọ, yio si pa a mọ, gẹgẹ bi oluṣọ-agutan agbo-ẹran rẹ̀.
entries.en: Hear the word of the LORD, O ye nations, and declare it in the isles afar off, and say, He that scattered Israel will gather him, and keep him, as a shepherd doth his flock.

entries.yo: Nitori Oluwa ti tú Jakobu silẹ, o si rà a pada li ọwọ awọn ti o li agbara jù u lọ.
entries.en: For the LORD hath redeemed Jacob, and ransomed him from the hand of him that was stronger than he.

entries.yo: Njẹ, nwọn o wá, nwọn o si kọrin ni ibi giga Sioni, nwọn o si jumọ lọ sibi ore Oluwa, ani fun alikama, ati fun ọti-waini, ati fun ororo, ati fun ẹgbọrọ agbo-ẹran, ati ọwọ́-ẹran: ọkàn wọn yio si dabi ọgbà ti a bomi rin; nwọn kì yio si kãnu mọ rara.
entries.en: Therefore they shall come and sing in the height of Zion, and shall flow together to the goodness of the LORD, for wheat, and for wine, and for oil, and for the young of the flock and of the herd: and their soul shall be as a watered garden; and they shall not sorrow any more at all.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni wundia yio yọ̀ ninu ijó, pẹlu ọdọmọkunrin ati arugbo ṣọkan pọ̀: nitori emi o sọ ọ̀fọ wọn di ayọ̀, emi o si tù wọn ninu, emi o si mu wọn yọ̀ lẹhin ikãnu wọn.
entries.en: Then shall the virgin rejoice in the dance, both young men and old together: for I will turn their mourning into joy, and will comfort them, and make them rejoice from their sorrow.

entries.yo: Emi o si fi sisanra tẹ ọkàn awọn alufa lọrun, ore mi yio si tẹ awọn enia mi lọrun, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: And I will satiate the soul of the priests with fatness, and my people shall be satisfied with my goodness, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa wi, Ni Rama li a gbọ́ ohùnrere, ẹkún kikoro; Rakeli nsọkun fun awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, kò gbipẹ nitori awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, nitoripe nwọn kò si.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD; A voice was heard in Ramah, lamentation, and bitter weeping; Rahel weeping for her children refused to be comforted for her children, because they were not.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa wi; Dá ohùn rẹ duro ninu ẹkun, ati oju rẹ ninu omije: nitori iṣẹ rẹ ni ère, li Oluwa wi, nwọn o si pada wá lati ilẹ ọta.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD; Refrain thy voice from weeping, and thine eyes from tears: for thy work shall be rewarded, saith the LORD; and they shall come again from the land of the enemy.

entries.yo: Ireti si wà ni igbẹhin rẹ, li Oluwa wi, pe awọn ọmọ rẹ yio pada si agbegbe wọn.
entries.en: And there is hope in thine end, saith the LORD, that thy children shall come again to their own border.

entries.yo: Lõtọ emi ti gbọ́ Efraimu npohùnrere ara rẹ̀ bayi pe; Iwọ ti nà mi, emi si di ninà, bi ọmọ-malu ti a kò kọ́; yi mi pada, emi o si yipada; nitori iwọ li Oluwa Ọlọrun mi.
entries.en: I have surely heard Ephraim bemoaning himself thus; Thou hast chastised me, and I was chastised, as a bullock unaccustomed to the yoke: turn thou me, and I shall be turned; for thou art the LORD my God.

entries.yo: Lõtọ lẹhin ti emi yipada, mo ronupiwada; ati lẹhin ti a kọ́ mi, mo lu ẹ̀gbẹ mi: oju tì mi, lõtọ, ani mo dãmu, nitoripe emi ru ẹ̀gan igba ewe mi.
entries.en: Surely after that I was turned, I repented; and after that I was instructed, I smote upon my thigh: I was ashamed, yea, even confounded, because I did bear the reproach of my youth.

entries.yo: Ọmọ ọ̀wọn ha ni Efraimu fun mi bi? ọmọ inu-didùn ha ni? nitori bi emi ti sọ̀rọ si i to, sibẹ emi ranti rẹ̀, nitorina ni ọkàn mi ṣe lù fun u; emi o ṣe iyọ́nu fun u nitõtọ, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: Is Ephraim my dear son? is he a pleasant child? for since I spake against him, I do earnestly remember him still: therefore my bowels are troubled for him; I will surely have mercy upon him, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Gbe àmi-ọ̀na soke, ṣe ọwọ̀n àmi: gbe ọkàn rẹ si opopo ọ̀na, ani ọ̀na ti iwọ ti lọ: tun yipada, iwọ wundia Israeli, tun yipada si ilu rẹ wọnyi.
entries.en: Set thee up waymarks, make thee high heaps: set thine heart toward the highway, even the way which thou wentest: turn again, O virgin of Israel, turn again to these thy cities.

entries.yo: Iwọ o ti ṣina kiri pẹ to, iwọ apẹhinda ọmọbinrin? nitori Oluwa dá ohun titun ni ilẹ na pe, Obinrin kan yio yi ọkunrin kan ka.
entries.en: How long wilt thou go about, O thou backsliding daughter? for the LORD hath created a new thing in the earth, A woman shall compass a man.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun, Ọlọrun Israeli wi, pe, Nwọn o si tun lò ède yi ni ilẹ Juda ati ni ilu rẹ̀ wọnni, nigbati emi o mu igbekun wọn pada, pe, Ki Oluwa ki o bukun ọ, Ibugbe ododo, Oke ìwa-mimọ́!
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; As yet they shall use this speech in the land of Judah and in the cities thereof, when I shall bring again their captivity; The LORD bless thee, O habitation of justice, and mountain of holiness.

entries.yo: Juda ati gbogbo ilu rẹ̀ yio ma jumọ gbe inu rẹ̀, agbẹ, ati awọn ti mba agbo-ẹran lọ kakiri,
entries.en: And there shall dwell in Judah itself, and in all the cities thereof together, husbandmen, and they that go forth with flocks.

entries.yo: Nitori emi tù ọkàn alãrẹ ninu, emi si ti tẹ gbogbo ọkàn ikãnu lọrun.
entries.en: For I have satiated the weary soul, and I have replenished every sorrowful soul.

entries.yo: Lori eyi ni mo ji, mo si wò; õrun mi si dùn mọ mi.
entries.en: Upon this I awaked, and beheld; and my sleep was sweet unto me.

entries.yo: Wò o, ọjọ mbọ, li Oluwa wi, ti emi o gbin ile Israeli ati Judah ni irugbin enia, ati irugbin ẹran.
entries.en: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will sow the house of Israel and the house of Judah with the seed of man, and with the seed of beast.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, pe gẹgẹ bi emi ti ṣọ́ wọn, lati fà tu, ati lati fa lulẹ, ati lati wo lulẹ, ati lati parun, ati lati pọnloju, bẹ̃ni emi o ṣọ́ wọn, lati kọ́, ati lati gbìn, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass, that like as I have watched over them, to pluck up, and to break down, and to throw down, and to destroy, and to afflict; so will I watch over them, to build, and to plant, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ wọnni, nwọn kì yio wi mọ pe, Awọn baba ti jẹ eso ajara aipọn, ehín si ti kan awọn ọmọ.
entries.en: In those days they shall say no more, The fathers have eaten a sour grape, and the children's teeth are set on edge.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn olukuluku ni yio kú nitori aiṣedede rẹ̀, olukuluku ti o jẹ eso ajara-aipọn ni ehín yio kan.
entries.en: But every one shall die for his own iniquity: every man that eateth the sour grape, his teeth shall be set on edge.

entries.yo: Wò o, ọjọ mbọ, li Oluwa wi, ti emi o ba ile Israeli ati ile Juda dá majẹmu titun.
entries.en: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel, and with the house of Judah:

entries.yo: Kì iṣe bi majẹmu na ti emi ba baba wọn dá li ọjọ na ti emi fà wọn lọwọ lati mu wọn jade lati ilẹ Egipti: awọn ti nwọn dà majẹmu mi, bi emi tilẹ jẹ alakoso wọn sibẹ, li Oluwa wi;
entries.en: Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day that I took them by the hand to bring them out of the land of Egypt; which my covenant they brake, although I was an husband unto them, saith the LORD:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn eyi ni majẹmu ti emi o ba ile Israeli da; Lẹhin ọjọ wọnni, li Oluwa wi, emi o fi ofin mi si inu wọn, emi o si kọ ọ si aiya wọn; emi o si jẹ Ọlọrun wọn, awọn o si jẹ enia mi.
entries.en: But this shall be the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel; After those days, saith the LORD, I will put my law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts; and will be their God, and they shall be my people.

entries.yo: Nwọn kì yio si kọni mọ ẹnikini ẹnikeji rẹ̀, ati ẹ̀gbọn, aburo rẹ̀ wipe, Mọ̀ Oluwa: nitoripe gbogbo nwọn ni yio mọ̀ mi, lati ẹni-kekere wọn de ẹni-nla wọn, li Oluwa wi; nitori emi o dari aiṣedede wọn ji, emi kì o si ranti ẹ̀ṣẹ wọn mọ.
entries.en: And they shall teach no more every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying, Know the LORD: for they shall all know me, from the least of them unto the greatest of them, saith the LORD; for I will forgive their iniquity, and I will remember their sin no more.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa wi ti o fi õrùn fun imọlẹ li ọsan, ilana oṣupa ati irawọ fun imọlẹ li oru, ti o rú okun soke tobẹ̃, ti riru omi rẹ̀ nho; Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun li orukọ rẹ̀:
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD, which giveth the sun for a light by day, and the ordinances of the moon and of the stars for a light by night, which divideth the sea when the waves thereof roar; The LORD of hosts is his name:

entries.yo: Bi ilana wọnyi ba yẹ̀ kuro niwaju mi, li Oluwa wi, njẹ iru-ọmọ Israeli pẹlu yio dẹkun lati ma jẹ orilẹ-ède niwaju mi lailai.
entries.en: If those ordinances depart from before me, saith the LORD, then the seed of Israel also shall cease from being a nation before me for ever.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa wi, Bi a ba le wọ̀n ọrun loke, ti a si le wá ipilẹ aiye ri nisalẹ, emi pẹlu yio ta iru-ọmọ Israeli nù nitori gbogbo eyiti nwọn ti ṣe, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD; If heaven above can be measured, and the foundations of the earth searched out beneath, I will also cast off all the seed of Israel for all that they have done, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Wò o, ọjọ mbọ, li Oluwa wi, ti a o kọ́ ilu na fun Oluwa lati ile-iṣọ Hananeeli de ẹnu-bode igun odi.
entries.en: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that the city shall be built to the LORD from the tower of Hananeel unto the gate of the corner.

entries.yo: Okùn ìwọn yio si nà jade siwaju lẹba rẹ̀ lori oke Garebi, yio si lọ yi Goati ka.
entries.en: And the measuring line shall yet go forth over against it upon the hill Gareb, and shall compass about to Goath.

entries.yo: Ati gbogbo afonifoji okú, ati ti ẽru, ati gbogbo oko titi de odò Kidroni, titi de igun ẹnubode-ẹṣin niha ilà-õrun, ni yio jẹ mimọ́ fun Oluwa; a kì yio fà a tu, bẹ̃ni a kì yio si wó o lulẹ mọ lailai.
entries.en: And the whole valley of the dead bodies, and of the ashes, and all the fields unto the brook of Kidron, unto the corner of the horse gate toward the east, shall be holy unto the LORD; it shall not be plucked up, nor thrown down any more for ever.

entries.yo: Ọ̀RỌ ti o tọ̀ Jeremiah wá lati ọdọ Oluwa li ọdun kẹwa Sedekiah, ọba Juda, eyiti o jẹ ọdun kejidilogun ti Nebukadnessari.
entries.en: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD in the tenth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, which was the eighteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ogun ọba Babeli ha Jerusalemu mọ: a si se Jeremiah woli mọ agbala ile túbu, ti o wà ni ile ọba Juda.
entries.en: For then the king of Babylon's army besieged Jerusalem: and Jeremiah the prophet was shut up in the court of the prison, which was in the king of Judah's house.

entries.yo: Nitori Sedekiah, ọba Judah, ti se e mọ, wipe, Ẽṣe ti iwọ sọtẹlẹ, ti o si wipe, Bayi li Oluwa wi, wò o, emi o fi ilu yi le ọwọ ọba Babeli, on o si ko o;
entries.en: For Zedekiah king of Judah had shut him up, saying, Wherefore dost thou prophesy, and say, Thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall take it;

entries.yo: Ati Sedekiah, ọba Juda, kì yio bọ́ li ọwọ awọn ara Kaldea, ṣugbọn a o fi i le ọwọ ọba Babeli, Lõtọ, yio si ba a sọ̀rọ li ojukoju, oju rẹ̀ yio si ri oju rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Zedekiah king of Judah shall not escape out of the hand of the Chaldeans, but shall surely be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon, and shall speak with him mouth to mouth, and his eyes shall behold his eyes;

entries.yo: On o si mu Sedekiah lọ si Babeli, nibẹ ni yio si wà titi emi o fi bẹ̀ ẹ wò, li Oluwa wi; bi ẹnyin tilẹ ba awọn ará Kaldea jà, ẹnyin kì yio ṣe rere.
entries.en: And he shall lead Zedekiah to Babylon, and there shall he be until I visit him, saith the LORD: though ye fight with the Chaldeans, ye shall not prosper?

entries.yo: Jeremiah si wipe, ọ̀rọ Oluwa tọ̀ mi wá wipe,
entries.en: And Jeremiah said, The word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

entries.yo: Wò o, Hanameeli, ọmọ Ṣallumu, ẹ̀gbọn rẹ, yio tọ̀ ọ wá, wipe, Iwọ rà oko mi ti o wà ni Anatoti: nitori titọ́ irasilẹ jẹ tirẹ lati rà a.
entries.en: Behold, Hanameel the son of Shallum thine uncle shall come unto thee, saying, Buy thee my field that is in Anathoth: for the right of redemption is thine to buy it.

entries.yo: Hanameeli, ọmọ ẹ̀gbọn mi, si tọ̀ mi wá li agbala ile túbu gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ Oluwa, o si wi fun mi pe, Jọ̃, ra oko mi, ti o wà ni Anatoti, ti o wà ni ilẹ Benjamini: nitori titọ́ ogun rẹ̀ jẹ tirẹ, ati irasilẹ jẹ tirẹ; rà a fun ara rẹ. Nigbana ni mo mọ̀ pe, eyi li ọ̀rọ Oluwa.
entries.en: So Hanameel mine uncle's son came to me in the court of the prison according to the word of the LORD, and said unto me, Buy my field, I pray thee, that is in Anathoth, which is in the country of Benjamin: for the right of inheritance is thine, and the redemption is thine; buy it for thyself. Then I knew that this was the word of the LORD.

entries.yo: Emi si rà oko na lọwọ Hanameeli, ọmọ ẹ̀gbọn mi, ti o wà ni Anatoti, mo si wọ̀n owo fun u, ṣekeli meje ati ìwọn fadaka mẹwa.
entries.en: And I bought the field of Hanameel my uncle's son, that was in Anathoth, and weighed him the money, even seventeen shekels of silver.

entries.yo: Mo si kọ ọ sinu iwe, mo si di i, mo si pè awọn ẹlẹri si i, mo si wọ̀n owo na ninu òṣuwọn.
entries.en: And I subscribed the evidence, and sealed it, and took witnesses, and weighed him the money in the balances.

entries.yo: Mo si mu iwe rirà na eyiti a dí nipa aṣẹ ati ilana, ati eyiti a ṣi silẹ.
entries.en: So I took the evidence of the purchase, both that which was sealed according to the law and custom, and that which was open:

entries.yo: Mo si fi iwe rirà na fun Baruki, ọmọ Neriah, ọmọ Masseiah, li oju Hanameeli, ọmọ ẹ̀gbọn mi, ati niwaju awọn ẹlẹri ti o kọ orukọ wọn si iwe rirà na, niwaju gbogbo ọkunrin Juda ti o joko ni àgbala ile túbu.
entries.en: And I gave the evidence of the purchase unto Baruch the son of Neriah, the son of Maaseiah, in the sight of Hanameel mine uncle's son, and in the presence of the witnesses that subscribed the book of the purchase, before all the Jews that sat in the court of the prison.

entries.yo: Mo si paṣẹ fun Baruki li oju wọn wipe,
entries.en: And I charged Baruch before them, saying,

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun, Ọlọrun Israeli wipe, Mu iwe wọnyi, iwe rirà yi, ti a dí, ati iwe yi ti a ṣi silẹ; ki o si fi wọn sinu ikoko, ki nwọn ki o le wà li ọjọ pupọ.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Take these evidences, this evidence of the purchase, both which is sealed, and this evidence which is open; and put them in an earthen vessel, that they may continue many days.

entries.yo: Nitori bayi li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun, Ọlọrun Israeli, wipe, A o tun rà ile ati oko ati ọgba-ajara ni ilẹ yi.
entries.en: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Houses and fields and vineyards shall be possessed again in this land.

entries.yo: Mo si gbadura si Oluwa lẹhin igbati mo ti fi iwe rirà na fun Baruki, ọmọ Neriah, wipe,
entries.en: Now when I had delivered the evidence of the purchase unto Baruch the son of Neriah, I prayed unto the LORD, saying,

entries.yo: A! Oluwa Ọlọrun! wò o, iwọ ti o da ọrun on aiye nipa agbara nla rẹ ati ninà apa rẹ: kò si ohun-kohun ti o ṣoro fun ọ.
entries.en: Ah Lord GOD! behold, thou hast made the heaven and the earth by thy great power and stretched out arm, and there is nothing too hard for thee:

entries.yo: Iwọ ṣe ãnu fun ẹgbẹgbẹrun, o si san aiṣedede awọn baba si aiya awọn ọmọ lẹhin wọn: Ọlọrun titobi, Alagbara! Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun li orukọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Thou shewest lovingkindness unto thousands, and recompensest the iniquity of the fathers into the bosom of their children after them: the Great, the Mighty God, the LORD of hosts, is his name,

entries.yo: Titobi ni igbimọ, ati alagbara ni iṣe; oju rẹ ṣí si gbogbo ọ̀na awọn ọmọ enia: lati fi fun olukuluku gẹgẹ bi ọ̀na rẹ̀ ati gẹgẹ bi eso iṣe rẹ̀:
entries.en: Great in counsel, and mighty in work: for thine eyes are open upon all the ways of the sons of men: to give every one according to his ways, and according to the fruit of his doings:

entries.yo: Ẹniti o gbe àmi ati iṣẹ-iyanu kalẹ ni Egipti, titi di oni yi, ati lara Israeli, ati lara enia miran: ti iwọ si ti ṣe orukọ fun ara rẹ, gẹgẹ bi o ti ri li oni yi.
entries.en: Which hast set signs and wonders in the land of Egypt, even unto this day, and in Israel, and among other men; and hast made thee a name, as at this day;

entries.yo: Ti o si fi àmi ati iṣẹ-iyanu, ati ọwọ agbara, ati ninà apa ati ẹ̀ru nla mu Israeli enia rẹ jade ni ilẹ Egipti.
entries.en: And hast brought forth thy people Israel out of the land of Egypt with signs, and with wonders, and with a strong hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with great terror;

entries.yo: Ti iwọ si ti fun wọn ni ilẹ yi, eyiti iwọ bura fun awọn baba wọn lati fi fun wọn, ilẹ ti nṣàn fun wara ati oyin;
entries.en: And hast given them this land, which thou didst swear to their fathers to give them, a land flowing with milk and honey;

entries.yo: Nwọn si wá, nwọn si ni i; ṣugbọn nwọn kò gbà ohùn rẹ gbọ́, bẹ̃ni nwọn kò rìn ninu ofin rẹ, nwọn kò ṣe gbogbo eyiti iwọ paṣẹ fun wọn lati ṣe: iwọ si pè gbogbo ibi yi wá sori wọn:
entries.en: And they came in, and possessed it; but they obeyed not thy voice, neither walked in thy law; they have done nothing of all that thou commandedst them to do: therefore thou hast caused all this evil to come upon them:

entries.yo: Wo o! odi ọta! nwọn sunmọ ilu lati kó o; a si fi ilu le ọwọ awọn ara Kaldea, ti mba a jà, niwaju idà, ati ìyan, àjakalẹ-àrun: ati ohun ti iwọ ti sọ, ṣẹ; si wò o, iwọ ri i.
entries.en: Behold the mounts, they are come unto the city to take it; and the city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans, that fight against it, because of the sword, and of the famine, and of the pestilence: and what thou hast spoken is come to pass; and, behold, thou seest it.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn iwọ ti sọ fun mi, Oluwa Ọlọrun! pe, Iwọ fi owo rà oko na fun ara rẹ, ki o si pe awọn ẹlẹri; sibẹ, a o fi ilu le ọwọ awọn ara Kaldea.
entries.en: And thou hast said unto me, O Lord GOD, Buy thee the field for money, and take witnesses; for the city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ọ̀rọ Oluwa tọ Jeremiah wá, wipe,
entries.en: Then came the word of the LORD unto Jeremiah, saying,

entries.yo: Wò o, emi li Oluwa, Ọlọrun gbogbo ẹran-ara: ohun kan ha wà ti o ṣòro fun mi bi?
entries.en: Behold, I am the LORD, the God of all flesh: is there any thing too hard for me?

entries.yo: Nitorina, bayi li Oluwa wi, Wò o, emi o fi ilu yi le ọwọ awọn ara Kaldea, ani le ọwọ Nebukadnessari, ọba Babeli, on o si kó o:
entries.en: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the Chaldeans, and into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and he shall take it:

entries.yo: Ati awọn ara Kaldea, ti mba ilu yi jà, nwọn o wá, nwọn o si tẹ iná bọ̀ ilu yi, nwọn o si kun u, ati ile, lori orule eyiti nwọn ti nrubọ turari si Baali, ti nwọn si ti ndà ẹbọ ohun mimu fun ọlọrun miran, lati mu mi binu.
entries.en: And the Chaldeans, that fight against this city, shall come and set fire on this city, and burn it with the houses, upon whose roofs they have offered incense unto Baal, and poured out drink offerings unto other gods, to provoke me to anger.

entries.yo: Nitori awọn ọmọ Israeli ati awọn ọmọ Juda ti ṣe kiki ibi niwaju mi lati igba èwe wọn wá: nitori awọn ọmọ Israeli ti fi kiki iṣẹ ọwọ wọn mu mi binu, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: For the children of Israel and the children of Judah have only done evil before me from their youth: for the children of Israel have only provoked me to anger with the work of their hands, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Nitori ilu yi ti jẹ ohun ibinu ati irunu fun mi lati ọjọ ti nwọn ti kọ ọ wá titi di oni yi; tobẹ̃ ti emi o mu u kuro niwaju mi.
entries.en: For this city hath been to me as a provocation of mine anger and of my fury from the day that they built it even unto this day; that I should remove it from before my face,

entries.yo: Nitori gbogbo ibi awọn ọmọ Israeli, ati awọn ọmọ Juda, ti nwọn ti ṣe lati mu mi binu, awọn, awọn ọba wọn, ijoye wọn, alufa wọn, ati woli wọn, ati awọn ọkunrin Juda, ati awọn olugbe Jerusalemu.
entries.en: Because of all the evil of the children of Israel and of the children of Judah, which they have done to provoke me to anger, they, their kings, their princes, their priests, and their prophets, and the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ti yi ẹhin wọn pada si mi, kì isi ṣe oju: emi kọ́ wọn, mo ndide ni kutukutu lati kọ́ wọn, sibẹ nwọn kò fetisilẹ lati gbà ẹkọ.
entries.en: And they have turned unto me the back, and not the face: though I taught them, rising up early and teaching them, yet they have not hearkened to receive instruction.

entries.yo: Nwọn si gbe ohun irira wọn ka inu ile na, ti a fi orukọ mi pè, lati sọ ọ di aimọ́.
entries.en: But they set their abominations in the house, which is called by my name, to defile it.

entries.yo: Nwọn si kọ́ ibi giga Baali, ti o wà ni afonifoji ọmọ Hinnomu, lati fi awọn ọmọkunrin wọn ati awọn ọmọbinrin wọn fun Moleki; ti emi kò paṣẹ fun wọn, bẹ̃ni kò wá si ọkàn mi, pe ki nwọn ki o mã ṣe ohun irira yi, lati mu Juda ṣẹ̀.
entries.en: And they built the high places of Baal, which are in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to cause their sons and their daughters to pass through the fire unto Molech; which I commanded them not, neither came it into my mind, that they should do this abomination, to cause Judah to sin.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun Israeli wi, niti ilu yi, sipa eyiti ẹnyin wipe, A o fi le ọwọ ọba Babeli, nipa idà, ati nipa ìyan, ati nipa ajakalẹ-arun.
entries.en: And now therefore thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel, concerning this city, whereof ye say, It shall be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence;

entries.yo: Wò o, emi o kó wọn jọ lati gbogbo ilẹ jade, nibiti emi ti le wọn si ninu ibinu mi, ati ninu irunu mi, ati ninu ikannu nla; emi o si jẹ ki nwọn ki o mã gbe lailewu:
entries.en: Behold, I will gather them out of all countries, whither I have driven them in mine anger, and in my fury, and in great wrath; and I will bring them again unto this place, and I will cause them to dwell safely:

entries.yo: Nwọn o si jẹ enia mi, emi o si jẹ Ọlọrun wọn.
entries.en: And they shall be my people, and I will be their God:

entries.yo: Emi o si fun wọn li ọkàn kan, ati ọ̀na kan, ki nwọn ki o le bẹ̀ru mi li ọjọ gbogbo, fun rere wọn, ati ti awọn ọmọ wọn lẹhin wọn:
entries.en: And I will give them one heart, and one way, that they may fear me for ever, for the good of them, and of their children after them:

entries.yo: Emi o si ba wọn dá majẹmu aiyeraiye, pe emi kì o yipada lẹhin wọn lati ṣe wọn ni rere, emi o fi ibẹ̀ru mi si ọkàn wọn, ti nwọn kì o lọ kuro lọdọ mi.
entries.en: And I will make an everlasting covenant with them, that I will not turn away from them, to do them good; but I will put my fear in their hearts, that they shall not depart from me.

entries.yo: Lõtọ, emi o yọ̀ lori wọn lati ṣe wọn ni rere, emi o si gbìn wọn si ilẹ yi li otitọ tinutinu mi ati tọkàntọkàn mi.
entries.en: Yea, I will rejoice over them to do them good, and I will plant them in this land assuredly with my whole heart and with my whole soul.

entries.yo: Nitori bayi li Oluwa wi; Gẹgẹ bi emi ti mu gbogbo ibi nla yi wá sori awọn enia yi, bẹ̃ni emi o mu gbogbo rere ti emi ti sọ nipa ti wọn wá sori wọn.
entries.en: For thus saith the LORD; Like as I have brought all this great evil upon this people, so will I bring upon them all the good that I have promised them.

entries.yo: Enia o si rà oko ni ilẹ yi, nipa eyi ti ẹnyin wipe, Ahoro ni laisi enia, laisi ẹran, a fi le ọwọ awọn ara Kaldea.
entries.en: And fields shall be bought in this land, whereof ye say, It is desolate without man or beast; it is given into the hand of the Chaldeans.

entries.yo: Enia yio fi owo rà oko, nwọn o kọ ọ sinu iwe, nwọn o si dí i, nwọn o si pe awọn ẹlẹri ni ilẹ Benjamini, ati ni ibi wọnni yi Jerusalemu ka, ati ni ilu Juda, ati ni ilu ọwọ́-oke na, ati ni ilu afonifoji, ati ni ilu iha gusu; nitori emi o mu igbekun wọn pada wá, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: Men shall buy fields for money, and subscribe evidences, and seal them, and take witnesses in the land of Benjamin, and in the places about Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, and in the cities of the mountains, and in the cities of the valley, and in the cities of the south: for I will cause their captivity to return, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Ọ̀RỌ Oluwa si tọ̀ Jeremiah wá lẹ̃keji, nigbati a si se e mọ ninu agbala ile túbu, wipe,
entries.en: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto Jeremiah the second time, while he was yet shut up in the court of the prison, saying,

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa wi, ẹniti o ṣe e, Oluwa, ti o pinnu rẹ̀, lati fi idi rẹ̀ mulẹ; Oluwa li orukọ rẹ̀;
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD the maker thereof, the LORD that formed it, to establish it; the LORD is his name;

entries.yo: Képe mi, emi o si da ọ lohùn, emi o si fi ohun nla ati alagbara han ọ ti iwọ kò mọ̀.
entries.en: Call unto me, and I will answer thee, and shew thee great and mighty things, which thou knowest not.

entries.yo: Nitori bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun Israeli wi, niti ile ilu yi, ati niti ile awọn ọba Juda ti a wó lulẹ ati nitori odi ati nitori idà;
entries.en: For thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel, concerning the houses of this city, and concerning the houses of the kings of Judah, which are thrown down by the mounts, and by the sword;

entries.yo: Nwọn wá lati ba awọn ara Kaldea jà, ṣugbọn lati fi okú enia kún wọn, awọn ẹniti Emi pa ninu ibinu mi ati ninu irunu mi, ati nitori gbogbo buburu wọnni, nitori eyiti emi ti pa oju mi mọ fun ilu yi.
entries.en: They come to fight with the Chaldeans, but it is fill them with the dead bodies of men, whom I have slain in mine anger and in my fury, and for all whose wickedness I have hid my face from this city.

entries.yo: Wò o, emi o fi ọjá ati õgùn imularada dì i, emi o si wò wọn san, emi o si fi ọ̀pọlọpọ alafia ati otitọ hàn fun wọn.
entries.en: Behold, I will bring it health and cure, and I will cure them, and will reveal unto them the abundance of peace and truth.

entries.yo: Emi o si mu igbèkun Juda ati igbèkun Israeli pada wá, emi o si gbe wọn ró gẹgẹ bi ti iṣaju.
entries.en: And I will cause the captivity of Judah and the captivity of Israel to return, and will build them, as at the first.

entries.yo: Emi o si wẹ̀ wọn nù kuro ninu gbogbo aiṣedede wọn, nipa eyiti nwọn ti ṣẹ̀ si mi; emi o si dari gbogbo aiṣedede wọn jì nipa eyiti nwọn ti sẹ̀, ati nipa eyi ti nwọn ti ṣe irekọja si mi.
entries.en: And I will cleanse them from all their iniquity, whereby they have sinned against me; and I will pardon all their iniquities, whereby they have sinned, and whereby they have transgressed against me.

entries.yo: Ilu na yio si jẹ orukọ ayọ̀ fun mi, iyìn ati ọlá niwaju gbogbo orilẹ-ède ilẹ aiye, ti nwọn gbọ́ gbogbo rere ti emi ṣe fun wọn: nwọn o si bẹ̀ru, nwọn o si warìri, nitori gbogbo ore ati nitori gbogbo alafia ti emi ṣe fun u.
entries.en: And it shall be to me a name of joy, a praise and an honour before all the nations of the earth, which shall hear all the good that I do unto them: and they shall fear and tremble for all the goodness and for all the prosperity that I procure unto it.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa wi; A o si tun gbọ́ ni ibi yi ti ẹnyin wipe, O dahoro, laini enia ati laini ẹran, ani ni ilu Juda, ati ni ilu Jerusalemu, ti o dahoro, laini enia, ati laini olugbe, ati laini ẹran.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD; Again there shall be heard in this place, which ye say shall be desolate without man and without beast, even in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, that are desolate, without man, and without inhabitant, and without beast,

entries.yo: Ohùn ayọ̀, ati ohùn inu-didùn, ohùn ọkọ-iyawo, ati ohùn iyawo, ohùn awọn ti o wipe, Ẹ fi ọpẹ fun Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun: nitori ti o ṣeun, nitoriti ãnu rẹ̀ duro lailai: ati ti awọn ti o mu ẹbọ-ọpẹ́ wá si ile Oluwa. Nitoriti emi o mu igbèkun ilẹ na pada wá gẹgẹ bi atetekọṣe, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: The voice of joy, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride, the voice of them that shall say, Praise the LORD of hosts: for the LORD is good; for his mercy endureth for ever: and of them that shall bring the sacrifice of praise into the house of the LORD. For I will cause to return the captivity of the land, as at the first, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi pe; Papa-oko awọn oluṣọ-agutan yio tun wà, ti nwọn mu ẹran-ọsin dubulẹ ni ibi yi, ti o dahoro, laini enia ati laini ẹran, ati ni gbogbo ilu rẹ̀!
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Again in this place, which is desolate without man and without beast, and in all the cities thereof, shall be an habitation of shepherds causing their flocks to lie down.

entries.yo: Ninu ilu oke wọnni, ninu ilu afonifoji, ati ninu ilu iha gusu, ati ni ilẹ Benjamini, ati ni ibi wọnni yi Jerusalemu ka, ati ni ilu Juda ni agbo agutan yio ma kọja labẹ ọwọ ẹniti nkà wọn, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: In the cities of the mountains, in the cities of the vale, and in the cities of the south, and in the land of Benjamin, and in the places about Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, shall the flocks pass again under the hands of him that telleth them, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Wò o, ọjọ mbọ, li Oluwa wi, ti emi o mu ohun rere na, ti emi ti leri fun ilẹ Israeli ati fun ile Juda, ṣẹ.
entries.en: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will perform that good thing which I have promised unto the house of Israel and to the house of Judah.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ wọnni, ati li akoko na, emi o jẹ ki Ẹka ododo ki o hu soke fun Dafidi; ẹniti yio si ṣe idajọ ati ododo ni ilẹ na.
entries.en: In those days, and at that time, will I cause the Branch of righteousness to grow up unto David; and he shall execute judgment and righteousness in the land.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ wọnni li a o gbà Juda la, Jerusalemu yio si ma gbe li ailewu: orukọ yi li a o ma pè e: OLUWA ODODO WA.
entries.en: In those days shall Judah be saved, and Jerusalem shall dwell safely: and this is the name wherewith she shall be called, The LORD our righteousness.

entries.yo: Nitori bayi li Oluwa wi; A kì o fẹ ọkunrin kan kù lọdọ Dafidi lati joko lori itẹ́ ile Israeli lailai.
entries.en: For thus saith the LORD; David shall never want a man to sit upon the throne of the house of Israel;

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni awọn alufa, awọn ọmọ Lefi, kì yio fẹ ọkunrin kan kù niwaju mi lati ru ẹbọ sisun, ati lati dana ọrẹ ohun jijẹ, ati lati ṣe irubọ lojojumọ.
entries.en: Neither shall the priests the Levites want a man before me to offer burnt offerings, and to kindle meat offerings, and to do sacrifice continually.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ Oluwa si tọ̀ Jeremiah wá, wipe,
entries.en: And the word of the LORD came unto Jeremiah, saying,

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa wi; Bi ẹnyin ba le bà majẹmu mi ti ọsan jẹ, ati majẹmu mi ti oru, tí ọsan ati oru kò le si li akoko wọn;
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD; If ye can break my covenant of the day, and my covenant of the night, and that there should not be day and night in their season;

entries.yo: Nigbana ni majẹmu mi pẹlu Dafidi, iranṣẹ mi le bajẹ, pe ki on ki o má le ni ọmọ lati joko lori itẹ rẹ̀; ati pẹlu awọn ọmọ Lefi, awọn alufa, awọn iranṣẹ mi.
entries.en: Then may also my covenant be broken with David my servant, that he should not have a son to reign upon his throne; and with the Levites the priests, my ministers.

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi a kò ti le ka iye ogun-ọrun, tabi ki a le wọ̀n iyanrin eti okun: bẹ̃ni emi o sọ iru-ọmọ Dafidi iranṣẹ mi di pupọ, ati awọn ọmọ Lefi, ti nṣe iranṣẹ fun mi.
entries.en: As the host of heaven cannot be numbered, neither the sand of the sea measured: so will I multiply the seed of David my servant, and the Levites that minister unto me.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ Oluwa si tọ Jeremiah wá, wipe,
entries.en: Moreover the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah, saying,

entries.yo: Iwọ kò ha ro eyi ti awọn enia yi ti sọ wipe, Idile meji ti Oluwa ti yàn, o ti kọ̀ wọn silẹ̀? nitorina ni nwọn ti ṣe kẹgan awọn enia mi, pe nwọn kì o le jẹ orilẹ-ède kan mọ li oju wọn.
entries.en: Considerest thou not what this people have spoken, saying, The two families which the LORD hath chosen, he hath even cast them off? thus they have despised my people, that they should be no more a nation before them.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa wi, Bi emi kò ba paṣẹ majẹmu mi ti ọsan ati ti oru, pẹlu ilana ọrun ati aiye,
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD; If my covenant be not with day and night, and if I have not appointed the ordinances of heaven and earth;

entries.yo: Nigbana ni emi iba ta iru-ọmọ Jakobu nù, ati Dafidi, iranṣẹ mi, ti emi kì o fi mu ninu iru-ọmọ rẹ̀ lati ṣe alakoso lori iru-ọmọ Abrahamu, Isaaki, ati Jakobu: nitori emi o mu ki igbekun wọn ki o pada bọ̀, emi o si ṣãnu fun wọn.
entries.en: Then will I cast away the seed of Jacob, and David my servant, so that I will not take any of his seed to be rulers over the seed of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob: for I will cause their captivity to return, and have mercy on them.

entries.yo: Ọ̀RỌ ti o tọ̀ Jeremiah wá lati ọdọ Oluwa, ni wakati ti Nebukadnessari, ọba Babeli, ati gbogbo ogun rẹ̀, ati gbogbo ijọba ilẹ-ijọba ọwọ rẹ̀, ati gbogbo awọn orilẹ-ède, mba Jerusalemu ati gbogbo ilu rẹ̀ ja, wipe:
entries.en: The word which came unto Jeremiah from the LORD, when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and all his army, and all the kingdoms of the earth of his dominion, and all the people, fought against Jerusalem, and against all the cities thereof, saying,

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa, Ọlọrun Israeli, wi: Lọ, ki o si sọ fun Sedekiah, ọba Juda, ki o si wi fun u pe, Bayi li Oluwa wi; Wò o, emi o fi ilu yi le ọwọ ọba Babeli, on o si fi iná kun u:
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel; Go and speak to Zedekiah king of Judah, and tell him, Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall burn it with fire:

entries.yo: Iwọ kì o si le sala kuro lọwọ rẹ̀, ṣugbọn ni mimú a o mu ọ, a o si fi ọ le e lọwọ; oju rẹ yio si ri oju ọba Babeli, on o si ba ọ sọ̀rọ lojukoju, iwọ o si lọ si Babeli.
entries.en: And thou shalt not escape out of his hand, but shalt surely be taken, and delivered into his hand; and thine eyes shall behold the eyes of the king of Babylon, and he shall speak with thee mouth to mouth, and thou shalt go to Babylon.

entries.yo: Sibẹ, gbọ́ ọ̀rọ Oluwa, iwọ Sedekiah, ọba Juda: Bayi li Oluwa wi niti rẹ, Iwọ kì yio ti ipa idà kú.
entries.en: Yet hear the word of the LORD, O Zedekiah king of Judah; Thus saith the LORD of thee, Thou shalt not die by the sword:

entries.yo: Iwọ o kú li alafia: ati bi ijona-isinkú awọn baba rẹ, awọn ọba igbãni ti o wà ṣaju rẹ, bẹ̃ni nwọn o si ṣe ijona-isinkú fun ọ, nwọn o si pohunrere rẹ, pe, Yẽ oluwa! nitori eyi li ọ̀rọ ti emi ti sọ, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: But thou shalt die in peace: and with the burnings of thy fathers, the former kings which were before thee, so shall they burn odours for thee; and they will lament thee, saying, Ah lord! for I have pronounced the word, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Jeremiah woli, si sọ gbogbo ọ̀rọ wọnyi fun Sedekiah, ọba Juda ni Jerusalemu.
entries.en: Then Jeremiah the prophet spake all these words unto Zedekiah king of Judah in Jerusalem,

entries.yo: Ni wakati na ogun ọba Babeli mba Jerusalemu jà, ati gbogbo ilu Juda ti o kù, Lakiṣi, ati Aseka: wọnyi li o kù ninu ilu Juda, nitori nwọn jẹ ilu olodi.
entries.en: When the king of Babylon's army fought against Jerusalem, and against all the cities of Judah that were left, against Lachish, and against Azekah: for these defenced cities remained of the cities of Judah.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ ti o tọ Jeremiah wá lati ọdọ Oluwa lẹhin ti Sedekiah, ọba, ti ba gbogbo enia ti o wà ni Jerusalemu dá majẹmu, lati kede omnira fun wọn.
entries.en: This is the word that came unto Jeremiah from the LORD, after that the king Zedekiah had made a covenant with all the people which were at Jerusalem, to proclaim liberty unto them;

entries.yo: Pe, ki olukuluku enia le jẹ ki iranṣẹkunrin rẹ̀, ati olukuluku enia, iranṣẹbinrin rẹ̀, ti iṣe ọkunrin Heberu tabi obinrin Heberu, lọ lọfẹ; ki ẹnikẹni ki o má mu ara Juda, arakunrin rẹ̀, sìn.
entries.en: That every man should let his manservant, and every man his maidservant, being an Hebrew or an Hebrewess, go free; that none should serve himself of them, to wit, of a Jew his brother.

entries.yo: Njẹ nigbati gbogbo awọn ijoye, ati gbogbo enia, ti nwọn dá majẹmu yi, gbọ́ pe ki olukuluku ki o jẹ ki iranṣẹkunrin rẹ̀, ati olukuluku, iranṣẹbinrin rẹ̀, lọ lọfẹ, ki ẹnikan má mu wọn sin wọn mọ, nwọn gbọ́, nwọn si jọ̃ wọn lọwọ.
entries.en: Now when all the princes, and all the people, which had entered into the covenant, heard that every one should let his manservant, and every one his maidservant, go free, that none should serve themselves of them any more, then they obeyed, and let them go.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn lẹhin na nwọn yi ọkàn pada, nwọn si mu ki awọn iranṣẹkunrin ati awọn iranṣẹbinrin, awọn ẹniti nwọn ti jẹ ki o lọ lọfẹ, ki o pada, nwọn si mu wọn sin bi iranṣẹkunrin ati bi iranṣẹbinrin.
entries.en: But afterward they turned, and caused the servants and the handmaids, whom they had let go free, to return, and brought them into subjection for servants and for handmaids.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ọ̀rọ Oluwa tọ Jeremiah wá lati ọdọ Oluwa, wipe,
entries.en: Therefore the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun Israeli, wi, pe; Emi ba awọn baba nyin dá majẹmu li ọjọ ti emi mu wọn jade lati ilẹ Egipti, kuro ninu oko-ẹrú, wipe,
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel; I made a covenant with your fathers in the day that I brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondmen, saying,

entries.yo: Li opin ọdọdun meje ki olukuluku enia jẹ ki arakunrin rẹ̀ ki o lọ, ani ara Heberu ti o ta ara rẹ̀ fun ọ; yio si sìn ọ li ọdun mẹfa, nigbana ni iwọ o jẹ ki o lọ lọfẹ lọdọ rẹ: ṣugbọn awọn baba nyin kò gbọ́ temi, bẹ̃ni wọn ko tẹti wọn silẹ.
entries.en: At the end of seven years let ye go every man his brother an Hebrew, which hath been sold unto thee; and when he hath served thee six years, thou shalt let him go free from thee: but your fathers hearkened not unto me, neither inclined their ear.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin si yi ọkàn pada loni, ẹ si ti ṣe eyi ti o tọ li oju mi, ni kikede omnira, ẹnikini fun ẹnikeji rẹ̀; ẹnyin si ti dá majẹmu niwaju mi ni ile ti a fi orukọ mi pè:
entries.en: And ye were now turned, and had done right in my sight, in proclaiming liberty every man to his neighbour; and ye had made a covenant before me in the house which is called by my name:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹnyin yipada, ẹ si sọ orukọ mi di ẽri, olukuluku enia si mu ki iranṣẹkunrin rẹ̀, ati olukuluku enia iranṣẹbinrin rẹ̀, ti on ti sọ di omnira ni ifẹ wọn, ki o pada, ẹnyin si mu wọn sìn lati jẹ iranṣẹkunrin ati iranṣẹbinrin, fun nyin.
entries.en: But ye turned and polluted my name, and caused every man his servant, and every man his handmaid, whom ye had set at liberty at their pleasure, to return, and brought them into subjection, to be unto you for servants and for handmaids.

entries.yo: Nitorina bayi li Oluwa wi, Ẹnyin kò feti si mi, ni kikede omnira, ẹgbọ́n fun aburo rẹ̀, ati ẹnikini fun ẹnikeji rẹ̀: wò o, emi o kede omnira fun nyin, li Oluwa wi, si idà, si ajakalẹ-àrun, ati si ìyan, emi o si fi nyin fun iwọsi ni gbogbo ijọba ilẹ aiye.
entries.en: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Ye have not hearkened unto me, in proclaiming liberty, every one to his brother, and every man to his neighbour: behold, I proclaim a liberty for you, saith the LORD, to the sword, to the pestilence, and to the famine; and I will make you to be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth.

entries.yo: Emi o si ṣe awọn ọkunrin na, ti o ti ré majẹmu mi kọja, ti kò ṣe ọ̀rọ majẹmu ti nwọn ti dá niwaju mi, bi ẹgbọrọ malu ti nwọn ti ke meji, ti nwọn si kọja lãrin ipin mejeji rẹ̀,
entries.en: And I will give the men that have transgressed my covenant, which have not performed the words of the covenant which they had made before me, when they cut the calf in twain, and passed between the parts thereof,

entries.yo: Awọn ijoye Juda, ati awọn ijoye Jerusalemu, awọn ìwẹfa, ati awọn alufa, ati gbogbo enia ilẹ na, ti o kọja lãrin ipin mejeji ẹgbọrọ malu na;
entries.en: The princes of Judah, and the princes of Jerusalem, the eunuchs, and the priests, and all the people of the land, which passed between the parts of the calf;

entries.yo: Emi o fi wọn le ọwọ awọn ọta wọn, ati le ọwọ awọn ti nwá ẹmi wọn: okú wọn yio si jẹ onjẹ fun awọn ẹiyẹ oju-ọrun, ati fun awọn ẹranko igbẹ.
entries.en: I will even give them into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of them that seek their life: and their dead bodies shall be for meat unto the fowls of the heaven, and to the beasts of the earth.

entries.yo: Ati Sedekiah, ọba Juda, ati awọn ijoye rẹ̀ li emi o fi le ọwọ awọn ọta wọn, ati le ọwọ awọn ti nwá ẹmi wọn, ati le ọwọ ogun ọba Babeli, ti o ṣi lọ kuro lọdọ nyin.
entries.en: And Zedekiah king of Judah and his princes will I give into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of them that seek their life, and into the hand of the king of Babylon's army, which are gone up from you.

entries.yo: Wò o, emi o paṣẹ, li Oluwa wi: emi o si mu wọn pada si ilu yi; nwọn o si ba a jà, nwọn o si kó o, nwọn o si fi iná kún u: emi o si ṣe ilu Juda li ahoro laini olugbe.
entries.en: Behold, I will command, saith the LORD, and cause them to return to this city; and they shall fight against it, and take it, and burn it with fire: and I will make the cities of Judah a desolation without an inhabitant.

entries.yo: Ọ̀RỌ ti o tọ̀ Jeremiah wá lati ọdọ Oluwa li ọjọ Jehoiakimu, ọmọ Josiah, ọba Juda, wipe:
entries.en: The word which came unto Jeremiah from the LORD in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, saying,

entries.yo: Lọ si ile awọn ọmọ Rekabu, ki o si ba wọn sọ̀rọ, ki o si mu wọn wá si ile Oluwa, si ọkan ninu iyara wọnni, ki o si fun wọn li ọti-waini mu.
entries.en: Go unto the house of the Rechabites, and speak unto them, and bring them into the house of the LORD, into one of the chambers, and give them wine to drink.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni mo mu Jaasaniah, ọmọ Jeremiah, ọmọ Habasiniah, ati awọn arakunrin rẹ̀, ati gbogbo awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, ati gbogbo ile awọn ọmọ Rekabu;
entries.en: Then I took Jaazaniah the son of Jeremiah, the son of Habaziniah, and his brethren, and all his sons, and the whole house of the Rechabites;

entries.yo: Mo si mu wọn wá si ile Oluwa, sinu iyara awọn ọmọ Hanani, ọmọ Igdaliah, enia Ọlọrun, ti o wà lẹba iyara awọn ijoye, ti o wà li oke iyara Maaseiah, ọmọ Ṣallumu, olutọju ẹnu-ọ̀na,
entries.en: And I brought them into the house of the LORD, into the chamber of the sons of Hanan, the son of Igdaliah, a man of God, which was by the chamber of the princes, which was above the chamber of Maaseiah the son of Shallum, the keeper of the door:

entries.yo: Mo si gbe ìkoko ti o kún fun ọti-waini pẹlu ago, ka iwaju awọn ọmọ ile Rekabu, mo si wi fun wọn pe: Ẹ mu ọti-waini.
entries.en: And I set before the sons of the house of the Rechabites pots full of wine, and cups, and I said unto them, Drink ye wine.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nwọn wipe, Awa kì yio mu ọti-waini, nitori Jonadabu, ọmọ Rekabu, baba wa, paṣẹ fun wa pe: Ẹnyin kò gbọdọ mu ọti-waini, ẹnyin ati awọn ọmọ nyin lailai.
entries.en: But they said, We will drink no wine: for Jonadab the son of Rechab our father commanded us, saying, Ye shall drink no wine, neither ye, nor your sons for ever:

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni ẹnyin kò gbọdọ kọ́ ile, tabi ki ẹ fun irugbin, tabi ki ẹ gbin ọgba-àjara, bẹ̃ni ẹnyin kò gbọdọ ni; ṣugbọn ni gbogbo ọjọ nyin li ẹnyin o ma gbe inu agọ; ki ẹnyin ki o le wà li ọjọ pupọ ni ilẹ na nibiti ẹnyin nṣe atipo.
entries.en: Neither shall ye build house, nor sow seed, nor plant vineyard, nor have any: but all your days ye shall dwell in tents; that ye may live many days in the land where ye be strangers.

entries.yo: Bayi li awa gbà ohùn Jonadabu, ọmọ Rekabu, baba wa gbọ́ ninu gbogbo eyiti o palaṣẹ fun wa, ki a má mu ọti-waini ni gbogbo ọjọ wa, awa, awọn aya wa, awọn ọmọkunrin wa, ati awọn ọmọbinrin wa;
entries.en: Thus have we obeyed the voice of Jonadab the son of Rechab our father in all that he hath charged us, to drink no wine all our days, we, our wives, our sons, nor our daughters;

entries.yo: Ati ki a má kọ ile lati gbe; bẹ̃ni awa kò ni ọgba-ajara, tabi oko, tabi ohùn ọgbin.
entries.en: Nor to build houses for us to dwell in: neither have we vineyard, nor field, nor seed:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awa ngbe inu agọ, a si gbọran, a si ṣe gẹgẹ bi gbogbo eyiti Jonadabu, baba wa, palaṣẹ fun wa.
entries.en: But we have dwelt in tents, and have obeyed, and done according to all that Jonadab our father commanded us.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati Nebukadnessari, ọba Babeli, goke wá si ilẹ na, ni awa wipe, Ẹ wá, ẹ jẹ ki a lọ si Jerusalemu, nitori ibẹ̀ru ogun awọn ara Kaldea, ati nitori ibẹ̀ru ogun awọn ara Siria: bẹ̃ni awa ngbe Jerusalemu.
entries.en: But it came to pass, when Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon came up into the land, that we said, Come, and let us go to Jerusalem for fear of the army of the Chaldeans, and for fear of the army of the Syrians: so we dwell at Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ọ̀rọ Oluwa tọ̀ Jeremiah wá wipe:
entries.en: Then came the word of the LORD unto Jeremiah, saying,

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun, Ọlọrun Israeli wi pe, Lọ, ki o si sọ fun awọn ọkunrin Juda, ati awọn olugbe Jerusalemu pe, Ẹnyin kì yio ha gbà ẹkọ lati feti si ọ̀rọ mi? li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Go and tell the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, Will ye not receive instruction to hearken to my words? saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ Jonadabu, ọmọ Rekabu, ti o pa laṣẹ fun awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, pe, ki nwọn ki o má mu ọti-waini, ni a mu ṣẹ; nwọn kò si mu ọti-waini titi di oni yi. Nitoriti nwọn gbọ́ ofin baba wọn, emi si ti nsọ̀rọ fun nyin, emi dide ni kutukutu, emi nsọ: ṣugbọn ẹnyin kò fetisi ti emi.
entries.en: The words of Jonadab the son of Rechab, that he commanded his sons not to drink wine, are performed; for unto this day they drink none, but obey their father's commandment: notwithstanding I have spoken unto you, rising early and speaking; but ye hearkened not unto me.

entries.yo: Emi si ti rán gbogbo awọn iranṣẹ mi, awọn woli, si nyin pẹlu, emi dide ni kutukutu, mo ran wọn wipe, Ẹ yipada nisisiyi, olukuluku kuro ni ọ̀na buburu rẹ̀, ki ẹ si tun iṣe nyin ṣe rere, ki ẹ máṣe tọ̀ awọn ọlọrun miran lẹhin lati sin wọn, ẹnyin o si ma gbe ilẹ na ti mo ti fi fun nyin, ati fun awọn baba nyin; ṣugbọn ẹnyin kò tẹ eti nyin, bẹ̃ni ẹnyin kò si gbọ́ temi.
entries.en: I have sent also unto you all my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them, saying, Return ye now every man from his evil way, and amend your doings, and go not after other gods to serve them, and ye shall dwell in the land which I have given to you and to your fathers: but ye have not inclined your ear, nor hearkened unto me.

entries.yo: Lõtọ awọn ọmọ Jonadabu, ọmọ Rekabu, pa ofin baba wọn mọ, ti o pa laṣẹ fun wọn; ṣugbọn awọn enia yi kò gbọ́ ti emi:
entries.en: Because the sons of Jonadab the son of Rechab have performed the commandment of their father, which he commanded them; but this people hath not hearkened unto me:

entries.yo: Nitorina bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun Israeli wi pe, Wò o, emi o mu wá sori Juda, ati sori gbogbo olugbe Jerusalemu, gbogbo ibi ti emi ti sọ si wọn; nitori ti emi ti ba wọn sọ̀rọ, nwọn kò si gbọ́; mo si ti pè wọn, nwọn kò si dahùn.
entries.en: Therefore thus saith the LORD God of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will bring upon Judah and upon all the inhabitants of Jerusalem all the evil that I have pronounced against them: because I have spoken unto them, but they have not heard; and I have called unto them, but they have not answered.

entries.yo: Jeremiah si wi fun ile awọn ọmọ Rekabu pe, Bayi li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun, Ọlọrun Israeli wi pe, Nitori ti ẹnyin gbà ofin Jonadabu, baba nyin gbọ́, ti ẹnyin si pa gbogbo ilana rẹ̀ mọ, ti ẹ si ṣe gẹgẹ bi eyi ti o ti palaṣẹ fun nyin:
entries.en: And Jeremiah said unto the house of the Rechabites, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Because ye have obeyed the commandment of Jonadab your father, and kept all his precepts, and done according unto all that he hath commanded you:

entries.yo: Nitorina bayi li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun, Ọlọrun Israeli wi pe, Jonadabu, ọmọ Rekabu kì yio fẹ ọkunrin kan kù lati duro niwaju mi lailai.
entries.en: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Jonadab the son of Rechab shall not want a man to stand before me for ever.

entries.yo: O si ṣe li ọdun kẹrin Jehoiakimu, ọmọ Josiah ọba Juda, li ọ̀rọ yi tọ̀ Jeremiah wá lati ọdọ Oluwa wá, wipe,
entries.en: And it came to pass in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, that this word came unto Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,

entries.yo: Mu iwe-kiká fun ara rẹ̀, ki o si kọ sinu rẹ̀, gbogbo ọ̀rọ ti emi ti sọ si Israeli, ati si Juda, ati si gbogbo orilẹ-ède, lati ọjọ ti mo ti sọ fun ọ, lati ọjọ Josiah titi di oni yi.
entries.en: Take thee a roll of a book, and write therein all the words that I have spoken unto thee against Israel, and against Judah, and against all the nations, from the day I spake unto thee, from the days of Josiah, even unto this day.

entries.yo: O le jẹ pe ile Juda yio gbọ́ gbogbo ibi ti mo pinnu lati ṣe si wọn; ki nwọn ki o le yipada, olukuluku kuro li ọ̀na buburu rẹ̀; ki emi ki o dari aiṣedede wọn ati ẹ̀ṣẹ wọn ji wọn.
entries.en: It may be that the house of Judah will hear all the evil which I purpose to do unto them; that they may return every man from his evil way; that I may forgive their iniquity and their sin.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Jeremiah pè Baruku, ọmọ Neriah; Baruku si kọ lati ẹnu Jeremiah gbogbo ọ̀rọ Oluwa ti o ti sọ fun u, sori iwe-kiká na.
entries.en: Then Jeremiah called Baruch the son of Neriah: and Baruch wrote from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the LORD, which he had spoken unto him, upon a roll of a book.

entries.yo: Jeremiah si paṣẹ fun Baruku pe, a se mi mọ: emi kò le lọ si ile Oluwa:
entries.en: And Jeremiah commanded Baruch, saying, I am shut up; I cannot go into the house of the LORD:

entries.yo: Nitorina iwọ lọ, ki o si kà ninu iwe-kika na, ti iwọ kọ lati ẹnu mi wá, ọ̀rọ Oluwa li eti awọn enia ni ile Oluwa li ọjọ ãwẹ: ati pẹlu, iwọ o si kà a li eti gbogbo Juda, ti nwọn jade wá lati ilu wọn.
entries.en: Therefore go thou, and read in the roll, which thou hast written from my mouth, the words of the LORD in the ears of the people in the LORD's house upon the fasting day: and also thou shalt read them in the ears of all Judah that come out of their cities.

entries.yo: O le jẹ pe, ẹ̀bẹ wọn yio wá siwaju Oluwa, nwọn o si yipada, olukuluku kuro li ọ̀na buburu rẹ̀: nitoripe nla ni ibinu ati irunu ti Oluwa ti sọ si awọn enia yi.
entries.en: It may be they will present their supplication before the LORD, and will return every one from his evil way: for great is the anger and the fury that the LORD hath pronounced against this people.

entries.yo: Baruku, ọmọ Neriah, si ṣe gẹgẹ bi gbogbo eyiti Jeremiah, woli, ti palaṣẹ fun u, lati ka ọ̀rọ Oluwa lati inu iwe ni ile Oluwa.
entries.en: And Baruch the son of Neriah did according to all that Jeremiah the prophet commanded him, reading in the book the words of the LORD in the LORD's house.

entries.yo: O si ṣe li ọdun karun Jehoiakimu, ọmọ Josiah, ọba Juda, li oṣu kẹsan ni nwọn kede ãwẹ niwaju Oluwa, fun gbogbo enia ni Jerusalemu: ati fun gbogbo awọn enia ti o wá lati ilu Juda, si Jerusalemu.
entries.en: And it came to pass in the fifth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, in the ninth month, that they proclaimed a fast before the LORD to all the people in Jerusalem, and to all the people that came from the cities of Judah unto Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Baruku si ka ọ̀rọ Jeremiah lati inu iwe ni ile Oluwa, ni iyara Gemariah, ọmọ Ṣafani, akọwe, ni àgbala oke, nibi ilẹkun ẹnu-ọ̀na titun ile Oluwa li eti gbogbo enia.
entries.en: Then read Baruch in the book the words of Jeremiah in the house of the LORD, in the chamber of Gemariah the son of Shaphan the scribe, in the higher court, at the entry of the new gate of the LORD's house, in the ears of all the people.

entries.yo: Nigbati Mikaiah, ọmọ Gemariah, ọmọ Ṣafani, gbọ́ gbogbo ọ̀rọ Oluwa lati inu iwe na wá,
entries.en: When Michaiah the son of Gemariah, the son of Shaphan, had heard out of the book all the words of the LORD,

entries.yo: O si sọkalẹ lọ si ile ọba, sinu iyara akọwe, si wò o, gbogbo awọn ijoye joko nibẹ, Eliṣama, akọwe, ati Delaiah, ọmọ Semaiah, ati Elnatani, ọmọ Akbori, ati Gemariah, ọmọ Safani, ati Sedekiah, ọmọ Hananiah, ati gbogbo awọn ijoye.
entries.en: Then he went down into the king's house, into the scribe's chamber: and, lo, all the princes sat there, even Elishama the scribe, and Delaiah the son of Shemaiah, and Elnathan the son of Achbor, and Gemariah the son of Shaphan, and Zedekiah the son of Hananiah, and all the princes.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Mikaiah sọ gbogbo ọ̀rọ wọnni ti o ti gbọ́, fun wọn, nigbati Baruku kà lati inu iwe na li eti awọn enia.
entries.en: Then Michaiah declared unto them all the words that he had heard, when Baruch read the book in the ears of the people.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni gbogbo awọn ìjoye rán Jehudu, ọmọ Netaniah, ọmọ Ṣelemiah, ọmọ Kuṣi, si Baruku wipe, Mu iwe-kiká na li ọwọ rẹ, lati inu eyiti iwọ kà li eti awọn enia, ki o si wá. Nigbana ni Baruku, ọmọ Neriah, mu iwe-kiká na li ọwọ rẹ̀, o si wá si ọdọ wọn.
