entries.yo: Oluwa ti ṣe eyi ti o ti rò; o ti mu ọrọ rẹ̀ ṣẹ ti o ti paṣẹ li ọjọ igbãni: o ti bì ṣubu, kò si dasi: o si ti mu ọta yọ̀ lori rẹ, o ti gbe iwo awọn aninilara rẹ soke.
entries.en: The LORD hath done that which he had devised; he hath fulfilled his word that he had commanded in the days of old: he hath thrown down, and hath not pitied: and he hath caused thine enemy to rejoice over thee, he hath set up the horn of thine adversaries.

entries.yo: Ọkàn wọn kigbe si Oluwa, iwọ odi ọmọbinrin Sioni, jẹ ki omije ṣan silẹ gẹgẹ bi odò lọsan ati loru; má fun ara rẹ ni isimi; máṣe jẹ ki ẹyin oju rẹ gbe jẹ.
entries.en: Their heart cried unto the Lord, O wall of the daughter of Zion, let tears run down like a river day and night: give thyself no rest; let not the apple of thine eye cease.

entries.yo: Dide, kigbe soke li oru ni ibẹrẹ akoko iṣọ: tú ọkàn rẹ jade gẹgẹ bi omi niwaju Oluwa: gbe ọwọ rẹ soke si i fun ẹmi awọn ọmọ wẹwẹ rẹ, ti nkulọ fun ebi ni gbogbo ori-ita.
entries.en: Arise, cry out in the night: in the beginning of the watches pour out thine heart like water before the face of the Lord: lift up thy hands toward him for the life of thy young children, that faint for hunger in the top of every street.

entries.yo: Wò o, Oluwa, ki o rò, fun tani iwọ ti ṣe eyi? Awọn obinrin ha le ma jẹ eso-inu wọn, awọn ọmọ-ọwọ ti nwọn npọ̀n? a ha le ma pa alufa ati woli ni ibi mimọ́ Oluwa?
entries.en: Behold, O LORD, and consider to whom thou hast done this. Shall the women eat their fruit, and children of a span long? shall the priest and the prophet be slain in the sanctuary of the Lord?

entries.yo: Ewe ati arugbo dubulẹ ni ita wọnni: awọn wundia mi ati awọn ọdọmọkunrin mi ṣubu nipa idà: iwọ ti pa li ọjọ ibinu rẹ; iwọ ti pa, iwọ kò si dasi.
entries.en: The young and the old lie on the ground in the streets: my virgins and my young men are fallen by the sword; thou hast slain them in the day of thine anger; thou hast killed, and not pitied.

entries.yo: Iwọ ti kepe ẹ̀ru mi yikakiri gẹgẹ bi li ọjọ mimọ́, tobẹ̃ ti ẹnikan kò sala tabi kì o kù li ọjọ ibinu Oluwa: awọn ti mo ti pọ̀n ti mo si tọ́, ni ọta mi ti run.
entries.en: Thou hast called as in a solemn day my terrors round about, so that in the day of the LORD's anger none escaped nor remained: those that I have swaddled and brought up hath mine enemy consumed.

entries.yo: EMI ni ọkunrin na ti o ti ri wàhala nipa ọpa ibinu rẹ̀.
entries.en: I am the man that hath seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.

entries.yo: O ti fà mi, o si mu mi wá sinu òkunkun, kì si iṣe sinu imọlẹ.
entries.en: He hath led me, and brought me into darkness, but not into light.

entries.yo: Lõtọ, o yi ọwọ rẹ̀ pada si mi siwaju ati siwaju li ọjọ gbogbo.
entries.en: Surely against me is he turned; he turneth his hand against me all the day.

entries.yo: O ti sọ ẹran-ara mi ati àwọ mi di ogbó, o ti fọ́ egungun mi.
entries.en: My flesh and my skin hath he made old; he hath broken my bones.

entries.yo: O ti mọdi tì mi, o fi orõrò ati ãrẹ̀ yi mi ka.
entries.en: He hath builded against me, and compassed me with gall and travail.

entries.yo: O ti fi mi si ibi òkunkun, bi awọn ti o ti kú pẹ.
entries.en: He hath set me in dark places, as they that be dead of old.

entries.yo: O ti sọgba yi mi ka, ti emi kò le jade; o ti ṣe ẹ̀wọn mi wuwo
entries.en: He hath hedged me about, that I cannot get out: he hath made my chain heavy.

entries.yo: Bi emi ti kigbe pẹlu, ti emi si npariwo, o sé adura mi mọ.
entries.en: Also when I cry and shout, he shutteth out my prayer.

entries.yo: O ti fi okuta gbigbẹ sọgba yi ọ̀na mi ka, o ti yi ipa ọ̀na mi po.
entries.en: He hath inclosed my ways with hewn stone, he hath made my paths crooked.

entries.yo: On jẹ bi ẹranko beari ti o ba dè mi, bi kiniun ni ibi ìkọkọ.
entries.en: He was unto me as a bear lying in wait, and as a lion in secret places.

entries.yo: O ti mu mi ṣina li ọ̀na mi, o si fà mi ya pẹrẹpẹrẹ: o ti sọ mi di ahoro.
entries.en: He hath turned aside my ways, and pulled me in pieces: he hath made me desolate.

entries.yo: O ti fà ọrun rẹ̀, o si fi mi ṣe itasi fun ọfa rẹ̀.
entries.en: He hath bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.

entries.yo: O ti mu ki ọfà apó rẹ̀ wọ inu-ẹdọ mi lọ.
entries.en: He hath caused the arrows of his quiver to enter into my reins.

entries.yo: Emi jẹ ẹni ẹsin fun gbogbo enia mi; orin wọn ni gbogbo ọjọ.
entries.en: I was a derision to all my people; and their song all the day.

entries.yo: O ti fi ìkoro mu mi yo, o ti mu mi mu omi wahala.
entries.en: He hath filled me with bitterness, he hath made me drunken with wormwood.

entries.yo: O ti fi ọta ṣẹ́ ehín mi, o tẹ̀ mi mọlẹ ninu ẽru.
entries.en: He hath also broken my teeth with gravel stones, he hath covered me with ashes.

entries.yo: Iwọ si ti mu ọkàn mi jina réré si alafia; emi gbagbe rere.
entries.en: And thou hast removed my soul far off from peace: I forgat prosperity.

entries.yo: Emi si wipe, Agbara mi ati ireti mi ṣègbe kuro lọdọ Oluwa.
entries.en: And I said, My strength and my hope is perished from the LORD:

entries.yo: Ranti wahala mi ati inilara mi, ani ìkoro ati orõro.
entries.en: Remembering mine affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the gall.

entries.yo: Lõtọ, nigbati ọkàn mi nṣe iranti wọn, o si tẹriba ninu mi.
entries.en: My soul hath them still in remembrance, and is humbled in me.

entries.yo: Eyi ni emi o rò li ọkàn mi, nitorina emi o ma reti.
entries.en: This I recall to my mind, therefore have I hope.

entries.yo: Ãnu Oluwa ni, ti awa kò parun tan, nitori irọnu-ãnu rẹ kò li opin.
entries.en: It is of the LORD's mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.

entries.yo: Ọtun ni li orowurọ; titobi ni otitọ rẹ.
entries.en: They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.

entries.yo: Oluwa ni ipin mi, bẹ̃li ọkàn mi wi; nitorina ni emi ṣe reti ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: The LORD is my portion, saith my soul; therefore will I hope in him.

entries.yo: Oluwa ṣe rere fun gbogbo ẹniti o duro dè e, fun ọkàn ti o ṣafẹri rẹ̀.
entries.en: The LORD is good unto them that wait for him, to the soul that seeketh him.

entries.yo: O dara ti a ba mã reti ni idakẹjẹ fun igbala Oluwa.
entries.en: It is good that a man should both hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the LORD.

entries.yo: O dara fun ọkunrin, ki o gbe àjaga ni igba-ewe rẹ̀.
entries.en: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.

entries.yo: Ki o joko on nikan, ki o si dakẹ, nitori Ọlọrun ti gbe e le ori rẹ̀.
entries.en: He sitteth alone and keepeth silence, because he hath borne it upon him.

entries.yo: Ki o fi ẹnu rẹ̀ sinu ẽkuru; pe bọya ireti le wà:
entries.en: He putteth his mouth in the dust; if so be there may be hope.

entries.yo: Ki o fi ẹ̀rẹkẹ fun ẹniti o lù u; ki o kún fun ẹ̀gan patapata.
entries.en: He giveth his cheek to him that smiteth him: he is filled full with reproach.

entries.yo: Nitoriti Oluwa kì yio ṣá ni tì lailai:
entries.en: For the Lord will not cast off for ever:

entries.yo: Bi o tilẹ mu ibanujẹ wá, sibẹ on o ni irọnu gẹgẹ bi ọ̀pọlọpọ ãnu rẹ̀.
entries.en: But though he cause grief, yet will he have compassion according to the multitude of his mercies.

entries.yo: Nitori on kì ifẹ ipọn-ni-loju lati ọkàn rẹ̀ wá, bẹ̃ni kì ibà ọmọ enia ninu jẹ.
entries.en: For he doth not afflict willingly nor grieve the children of men.

entries.yo: Lati tẹ̀ gbogbo ara-tubu ilẹ-aiye mọlẹ li abẹ ẹsẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: To crush under his feet all the prisoners of the earth,

entries.yo: Lati yi ẹ̀tọ enia sapakan niwaju Ọga-ogo julọ.
entries.en: To turn aside the right of a man before the face of the most High,

entries.yo: Lati yi ọ̀ran idajọ enia pada, Oluwa kò fẹ ri i?
entries.en: To subvert a man in his cause, the Lord approveth not.

entries.yo: Tali ẹniti iwi, ti isi iṣẹ, nigbati Oluwa kò paṣẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Who is he that saith, and it cometh to pass, when the Lord commandeth it not?

entries.yo: Ibi ati rere kò ha njade lati ẹnu Ọga-ogo-julọ wá?
entries.en: Out of the mouth of the most High proceedeth not evil and good?

entries.yo: Ẽṣe ti enia alãye nkùn? ti o wà lãye, ki olukuluku ki o kùn nitori ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ̀!
entries.en: Wherefore doth a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?

entries.yo: Jẹ ki a wádi, ki a si dán ọ̀na wa wò, ki a si tun yipada si Oluwa.
entries.en: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to the LORD.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki a gbe ọkàn ati ọwọ wa soke si Ọlọrun li ọrun.
entries.en: Let us lift up our heart with our hands unto God in the heavens.

entries.yo: Awa ti dẹṣẹ, a si ti ṣọtẹ: iwọ kò ti dariji.
entries.en: We have transgressed and have rebelled: thou hast not pardoned.

entries.yo: Iwọ ti fi ibinu bora, o si ṣe inunibini si wa: iwọ ti pa, o kò si ti dasi.
entries.en: Thou hast covered with anger, and persecuted us: thou hast slain, thou hast not pitied.

entries.yo: Iwọ ti fi awọsanma bo ara rẹ, ki adura má le là kọja.
entries.en: Thou hast covered thyself with a cloud, that our prayer should not pass through.

entries.yo: Iwọ ti ṣe wa bi idarọ ati ohun alainilãri li ãrin awọn orilẹ-ède.
entries.en: Thou hast made us as the offscouring and refuse in the midst of the people.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn ọta wa ti ya ẹnu wọn si wa.
entries.en: All our enemies have opened their mouths against us.

entries.yo: Ẹ̀ru ati ọ̀fin wá sori wa, idahoro ati iparun.
entries.en: Fear and a snare is come upon us, desolation and destruction.

entries.yo: Oju mi fi odò omi ṣan silẹ, nitori iparun ọmọbinrin awọn enia mi.
entries.en: Mine eye runneth down with rivers of water for the destruction of the daughter of my people.

entries.yo: Oju mi dà silẹ ni omije, kò si dá, laiṣe isimi.
entries.en: Mine eye trickleth down, and ceaseth not, without any intermission,

entries.yo: Titi Oluwa fi wò ilẹ, ti o wò lati ọrun wá,
entries.en: Till the LORD look down, and behold from heaven.

entries.yo: Oju mi npọn ọkàn mi loju, nitori gbogbo awọn ọmọbinrin ilu mi.
entries.en: Mine eye affecteth mine heart because of all the daughters of my city.

entries.yo: Awọn ọta mi dẹkùn fun mi gidigidi, gẹgẹ bi fun ẹiyẹ laini idi.
entries.en: Mine enemies chased me sore, like a bird, without cause.

entries.yo: Nwọn ti ke ẹmi mi kuro ninu iho, nwọn si yi okuta sori mi.
entries.en: They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and cast a stone upon me.

entries.yo: Nwọn mu omi ṣan lori mi; emi wipe, Mo gbe!
entries.en: Waters flowed over mine head; then I said, I am cut off.

entries.yo: Emi kepe orukọ rẹ, Oluwa, lati iho jijin wá.
entries.en: I called upon thy name, O LORD, out of the low dungeon.

entries.yo: Iwọ ti gbọ́ ohùn mi: máṣe se eti rẹ mọ si imikanlẹ mi, si igbe mi.
entries.en: Thou hast heard my voice: hide not thine ear at my breathing, at my cry.

entries.yo: Iwọ sunmọ itosi li ọjọ ti emi kigbe pè ọ: iwọ wipe: Má bẹ̀ru!
entries.en: Thou drewest near in the day that I called upon thee: thou saidst, Fear not.

entries.yo: Oluwa, iwọ ti gba ijà mi jà; iwọ ti rà ẹmi mi pada.
entries.en: O Lord, thou hast pleaded the causes of my soul; thou hast redeemed my life.

entries.yo: Oluwa, iwọ ti ri inilara mi, ṣe idajọ ọran mi!
entries.en: O LORD, thou hast seen my wrong: judge thou my cause.

entries.yo: Iwọ ti ri gbogbo igbẹsan wọn, gbogbo èro buburu wọn si mi.
entries.en: Thou hast seen all their vengeance and all their imaginations against me.

entries.yo: Iwọ ti gbọ́ ẹ̀gan wọn, Oluwa, gbogbo èro buburu wọn si mi.
entries.en: Thou hast heard their reproach, O LORD, and all their imaginations against me;

entries.yo: Ète awọn wọnni ti o dide si mi, ati ipinnu wọn si mi ni gbogbo ọjọ.
entries.en: The lips of those that rose up against me, and their device against me all the day.

entries.yo: Kiyesi ijoko wọn ati idide wọn! emi ni orin-ẹsin wọn.
entries.en: Behold their sitting down, and their rising up; I am their musick.

entries.yo: San ẹsan fun wọn, Oluwa, gẹgẹ bi iṣẹ ọwọ wọn!
entries.en: Render unto them a recompence, O LORD, according to the work of their hands.

entries.yo: Fun wọn ni ifọju ọkàn, ègun rẹ lori wọn!
entries.en: Give them sorrow of heart, thy curse unto them.

entries.yo: Fi ibinu lepa wọn, ki o si pa wọn run kuro labẹ ọrun Oluwa!
entries.en: Persecute and destroy them in anger from under the heavens of the LORD.

entries.yo: BAWO ni wura ṣe di baibai! bawo ni wura didara julọ ṣe pada! okuta ibi-mimọ́ li a tuka ni gbogbo ori ita.
entries.en: How is the gold become dim! how is the most fine gold changed! the stones of the sanctuary are poured out in the top of every street.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ iyebiye Sioni, ti o niye lori bi wura didara, bawo li a ṣe kà wọn si bi ikoko amọ̀, iṣẹ ọwọ alamọ̀!
entries.en: The precious sons of Zion, comparable to fine gold, how are they esteemed as earthen pitchers, the work of the hands of the potter!

entries.yo: Ani ọ̀wawa nfà ọmu jade, nwọn nfi ọmu fun awọn ọmọ wọn: ṣugbọn ọmọbinrin awọn enia mi ti di ìka, gẹgẹ bi abo ògongo li aginju.
entries.en: Even the sea monsters draw out the breast, they give suck to their young ones: the daughter of my people is become cruel, like the ostriches in the wilderness.

entries.yo: Ahọn ọmọ-ọmu lẹ̀ mọ oke ẹnu rẹ̀ nitori ongbẹ: awọn ọmọ kekere mbere onjẹ, ẹnikan kò si bu u fun wọn.
entries.en: The tongue of the sucking child cleaveth to the roof of his mouth for thirst: the young children ask bread, and no man breaketh it unto them.

entries.yo: Awọn ti o ti njẹ ohun didùndidùn nkú lọ ni ita: awọn ti a ti tọ́ ninu aṣọ-òdodó, gbá ãtàn mọra.
entries.en: They that did feed delicately are desolate in the streets: they that were brought up in scarlet embrace dunghills.

entries.yo: Nitori aiṣedede ọmọbinrin awọn enia mi tobi jù ẹ̀ṣẹ Sodomu lọ, ti a bì ṣubu ni iṣẹju, laisi iṣiṣẹ ọwọ ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: For the punishment of the iniquity of the daughter of my people is greater than the punishment of the sin of Sodom, that was overthrown as in a moment, and no hands stayed on her.

entries.yo: Awọn Nasire rẹ̀ mọ́ jù ẹ̀gbọn-owu, nwọn funfun jù wàra; irisi wọn pọn jù iyùn, apẹrẹ wọn dabi okuta Safire:
entries.en: Her Nazarites were purer than snow, they were whiter than milk, they were more ruddy in body than rubies, their polishing was of sapphire:

entries.yo: Oju wọn dudu jù ẽdu nisisiyi; a kò mọ̀ wọn ni ita: àwọ wọn lẹ mọ egungun wọn; o di gbigbẹ gẹgẹ bi igi.
entries.en: Their visage is blacker than a coal; they are not known in the streets: their skin cleaveth to their bones; it is withered, it is become like a stick.

entries.yo: Awọn ti a fi idà pa san jù awọn ti a fi ebi pa, ti ndaku, ti a gún wọn lara nitori aisi eso-oko.
entries.en: They that be slain with the sword are better than they that be slain with hunger: for these pine away, stricken through for want of the fruits of the field.

entries.yo: Ọwọ awọn obinrin alãnu ti sè awọn ọmọ awọn tikarawọn: awọn wọnyi li ohun jijẹ fun wọn ni igba wahala ọmọbinrin awọn enia mi.
entries.en: The hands of the pitiful women have sodden their own children: they were their meat in the destruction of the daughter of my people.

entries.yo: Oluwa ti ṣe aṣepe irunu rẹ̀; o ti dà ibinu gbigbona rẹ̀ jade, o ti dá iná ni Sioni, ti o si ti jo ipilẹ rẹ̀ run.
entries.en: The LORD hath accomplished his fury; he hath poured out his fierce anger, and hath kindled a fire in Zion, and it hath devoured the foundations thereof.

entries.yo: Awọn ọba aiye, ati gbogbo olugbe ilẹ-aiye, kò gbagbọ pe aninilara ati ọta iba ti wọ inu ẹnu-bode Jerusalemu.
entries.en: The kings of the earth, and all the inhabitants of the world, would not have believed that the adversary and the enemy should have entered into the gates of Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Nitori ẹ̀ṣẹ awọn woli rẹ̀, ati aiṣedede awọn alufa rẹ̀, ti nwọn ti ta ẹ̀jẹ awọn olododo silẹ li ãrin rẹ̀.
entries.en: For the sins of her prophets, and the iniquities of her priests, that have shed the blood of the just in the midst of her,

entries.yo: Nwọn ti rin kiri bi afọju ni ita, nwọn di alaimọ́ fun ẹ̀jẹ tobẹ̃ ti enia kò le fi ọwọ kan aṣọ wọn.
entries.en: They have wandered as blind men in the streets, they have polluted themselves with blood, so that men could not touch their garments.

entries.yo: Nwọn nkigbe si wọn pe, ẹ lọ! alaimọ́ ni! ẹ lọ! ẹ lọ! ẹ máṣe fi ọwọ kan a! nigbati nwọn salọ, nwọn si rìn kiri pẹlu: nwọn nwi lãrin awọn orilẹ-ède pe, awọn kì o ṣatipo nibẹ mọ.
entries.en: They cried unto them, Depart ye; it is unclean; depart, depart, touch not: when they fled away and wandered, they said among the heathen, They shall no more sojourn there.

entries.yo: Oju Oluwa ti tú wọn ka: on kì o fiyesi wọn mọ: nwọn kò buyin fun awọn alufa, nwọn kò ṣãnu fun awọn àgbagba.
entries.en: The anger of the LORD hath divided them; he will no more regard them: they respected not the persons of the priests, they favoured not the elders.

entries.yo: Bi o ṣe ti wa ni, oju wa nwọ̀na siwaju ati siwaju, fun iranlọwọ wa ti o jẹ asan: lori ile-iṣọ wa, awa nwọ̀na fun orilẹ-ède, ti kò le ràn ni lọwọ.
entries.en: As for us, our eyes as yet failed for our vain help: in our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save us.

entries.yo: Nwọn dẹkun si ipa ọ̀na wa, ti awa kò le rìn ita wa: opin wa sunmọ tosi, ọjọ wa pé; nitori opin wa de.
entries.en: They hunt our steps, that we cannot go in our streets: our end is near, our days are fulfilled; for our end is come.

entries.yo: Awọn ti nlepa wa yara jù idì ọrun lọ: nwọn nlepa wa lori oke wọnni, nwọn bà dè wa li aginju.
entries.en: Our persecutors are swifter than the eagles of the heaven: they pursued us upon the mountains, they laid wait for us in the wilderness.

entries.yo: Ẽmi iho imu wa, ani ẹni-ororo Oluwa, ni a mu ninu ọ̀fin wọn, niti ẹniti awa wipe, labẹ ojiji rẹ̀ li awa o ma gbé lãrin awọn orilẹ-ède.
entries.en: The breath of our nostrils, the anointed of the LORD, was taken in their pits, of whom we said, Under his shadow we shall live among the heathen.

entries.yo: Yọ̀, ki inu rẹ si dùn, iwọ ọmọbinrin Edomu, ti ngbe inu ilẹ Usi; sibẹ ago na yio kọja sọdọ rẹ pẹlu: iwọ o si yo bi ọ̀muti, a o si tu ọ ni ihoho.
entries.en: Rejoice and be glad, O daughter of Edom, that dwellest in the land of Uz; the cup also shall pass through unto thee: thou shalt be drunken, and shalt make thyself naked.

entries.yo: A mu aiṣedede rẹ kuro, iwọ ọmọbinrin Sioni: on kì o si tun mu ọ lọ si igbekun mọ: On o bẹ̀ aiṣedede rẹ wò, iwọ ọmọbinrin Edomu; yio si fi ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ hàn.
entries.en: The punishment of thine iniquity is accomplished, O daughter of Zion; he will no more carry thee away into captivity: he will visit thine iniquity, O daughter of Edom; he will discover thy sins.

entries.yo: RANTI, Oluwa, ohun ti o de sori wa; rò ki o si wò ẹ̀gan wa!
entries.en: Remember, O LORD, what is come upon us: consider, and behold our reproach.

entries.yo: A fi ogún wa le awọn alejo lọwọ, ile wa fun awọn ajeji.
entries.en: Our inheritance is turned to strangers, our houses to aliens.

entries.yo: Awa jẹ alaini obi, baba kò si, awọn iyá wa dabi opó.
entries.en: We are orphans and fatherless, our mothers are as widows.

entries.yo: Awa ti fi owo mu omi wa; a nta igi wa fun wa.
entries.en: We have drunken our water for money; our wood is sold unto us.

entries.yo: Awọn ti nlepa wa sunmọ ọrùn wa: ãrẹ̀ mu wa, awa kò si ni isimi.
entries.en: Our necks are under persecution: we labour, and have no rest.

entries.yo: Awa ti fi ọwọ wa fun awọn ara Egipti, ati fun ara Assiria, lati fi onjẹ tẹ́ wa lọrùn.
entries.en: We have given the hand to the Egyptians, and to the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.

entries.yo: Awọn baba wa ti ṣẹ̀, nwọn kò si sí; awa si nrù aiṣedede wọn.
entries.en: Our fathers have sinned, and are not; and we have borne their iniquities.

entries.yo: Awọn ẹrú ti jọba lori wa: ẹnikan kò si gbà wa kuro li ọwọ wọn.
entries.en: Servants have ruled over us: there is none that doth deliver us out of their hand.

entries.yo: Ninu ewu ẹmi wa li awa nlọ mu onjẹ wa, nitori idà ti aginju.
entries.en: We gat our bread with the peril of our lives because of the sword of the wilderness.

entries.yo: Àwọ wa pọ́n gẹgẹ bi àro nitori gbigbona ìyan na.
entries.en: Our skin was black like an oven because of the terrible famine.

entries.yo: Nwọn tẹ́ awọn obinrin li ogo ni Sioni, awọn wundia ni ilu Juda.
entries.en: They ravished the women in Zion, and the maids in the cities of Judah.

entries.yo: A so awọn ijoye rọ̀ nipa ọwọ wọn: a kò buyin fun oju awọn àgbagba.
entries.en: Princes are hanged up by their hand: the faces of elders were not honoured.

entries.yo: Awọn ọdọmọkunrin ru ọlọ, ãrẹ̀ mu awọn ọmọde labẹ ẹrù-igi.
entries.en: They took the young men to grind, and the children fell under the wood.

entries.yo: Awọn àgbagba dasẹ kuro li ẹnu-bode, awọn ọdọmọkunrin kuro ninu orin wọn.
entries.en: The elders have ceased from the gate, the young men from their musick.

entries.yo: Ayọ̀ ọkàn wa ti dá; a yi ijo wa pada si ọ̀fọ.
entries.en: The joy of our heart is ceased; our dance is turned into mourning.

entries.yo: Ade ṣubu kuro li ori wa: ègbe ni fun wa, nitori awa ti ṣẹ̀.
entries.en: The crown is fallen from our head: woe unto us, that we have sinned!

entries.yo: Nitori eyi li ọkàn wa rẹ̀wẹsi; nitori nkan wọnyi oju wa di baibai.
entries.en: For this our heart is faint; for these things our eyes are dim.

entries.yo: Nitori oke Sioni, ti dahoro, awọn kọ̀lọkọlọ nrin lori rẹ̀.
entries.en: Because of the mountain of Zion, which is desolate, the foxes walk upon it.

entries.yo: Iwọ, Oluwa, li o wà lailai; itẹ́ rẹ lati iran de iran!
entries.en: Thou, O LORD, remainest for ever; thy throne from generation to generation.

entries.yo: Ẽṣe ti iwọ fi gbagbe wa lailai, ti o si kọ̀ wa silẹ li ọjọ pipẹ?
entries.en: Wherefore dost thou forget us for ever, and forsake us so long time?

entries.yo: Oluwa, yi wa pada sọdọ rẹ, awa o si yipada; sọ ọjọ wa di ọtun gẹgẹ bi ti igbãni.
entries.en: Turn thou us unto thee, O LORD, and we shall be turned; renew our days as of old.

entries.yo: Tabi iwọ ha ti kọ̀ wa silẹ patapata, tobẹ̃ ti iwọ si binu si wa gidigidi?
entries.en: But thou hast utterly rejected us; thou art very wroth against us.

entries.yo: O si ṣe ọgbọ̀n ọdun, ni oṣu ẹkẹrin, li ọjọ ẹkarun oṣu, bi mo ti wà lãrin awọn igbekùn leti odo Kebari, ọrun ṣi, mo si ri iran Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Now it came to pass in the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I was among the captives by the river of Chebar, that the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ karun oṣu, ti iṣe ọdun karun igbekùn Jehoiakini ọba,
entries.en: In the fifth day of the month, which was the fifth year of king Jehoiachin's captivity,

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ Oluwa tọ̀ Esekieli alufa, ọmọ Busi wá papã, ni ilẹ awọn ara Kaldea leti odò Kebari, ọwọ́ Oluwa si wà li ara rẹ̀ nibẹ.
entries.en: The word of the LORD came expressly unto Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and the hand of the LORD was there upon him.

entries.yo: Mo si wò, si kiye si i, ãja jade wá lati ariwa, awọsanma nla, ati iná ti o yi ara rẹ̀ ka, didán si wà yika, ani lati ãrin rẹ̀ wá, bi àwọ amberi, lati ãrin iná na wá.
entries.en: And I looked, and, behold, a whirlwind came out of the north, a great cloud, and a fire infolding itself, and a brightness was about it, and out of the midst thereof as the colour of amber, out of the midst of the fire.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu lati ãrin rẹ̀ wá, aworan ẹda alãye mẹrin, eyi si ni irí wọn, nwọn ni aworan enia.
entries.en: Also out of the midst thereof came the likeness of four living creatures. And this was their appearance; they had the likeness of a man.

entries.yo: Olukuluku si ni oju mẹrin, olukuluku si ni iyẹ mẹrin.
entries.en: And every one had four faces, and every one had four wings.

entries.yo: Ẹsẹ wọn si tọ́, atẹlẹsẹ wọn si dabi atẹlẹsẹ ọmọ malũ: nwọn si tàn bi awọ̀ idẹ didan.
entries.en: And their feet were straight feet; and the sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf's foot: and they sparkled like the colour of burnished brass.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ni ọwọ́ enia labẹ iyẹ́ wọn, li ẹgbẹ wọn mẹrẹrin, awọn mẹrẹrin si ni oju wọn ati iyẹ́ wọn.
entries.en: And they had the hands of a man under their wings on their four sides; and they four had their faces and their wings.

entries.yo: Iyẹ́ wọn si kàn ara wọn; nwọn kò yipada nigbati nwọn lọ, olukuluku wọn lọ li ọkankan ganran.
entries.en: Their wings were joined one to another; they turned not when they went; they went every one straight forward.

entries.yo: Niti aworan oju wọn, awọn mẹrẹrin ni oju enia, ati oju kiniun, niha ọtun: awọn mẹrẹrin si ni oju malu niha osì; awọn mẹrẹrin si ni oju idì.
entries.en: As for the likeness of their faces, they four had the face of a man, and the face of a lion, on the right side: and they four had the face of an ox on the left side; they four also had the face of an eagle.

entries.yo: Bayi li oju wọn ri: iyẹ́ wọn si nà soke, iyẹ́ meji olukuluku wọn kàn ara wọn, meji si bo ara wọn.
entries.en: Thus were their faces: and their wings were stretched upward; two wings of every one were joined one to another, and two covered their bodies.

entries.yo: Olukuluku wọn si lọ li ọkankan ganran: nibiti ẹmi ibá lọ, nwọn lọ; nwọn kò si yipada nigbati nwọn lọ.
entries.en: And they went every one straight forward: whither the spirit was to go, they went; and they turned not when they went.

entries.yo: Niti aworan awọn ẹda alãye na, irí wọn dabi ẹṣẹ́ iná, ati bi irí inà fitila: o lọ soke ati sodo, lãrin awọn ẹda alãye na, iná na si mọlẹ, manamana si jade lati inu iná na wá.
entries.en: As for the likeness of the living creatures, their appearance was like burning coals of fire, and like the appearance of lamps: it went up and down among the living creatures; and the fire was bright, and out of the fire went forth lightning.

entries.yo: Awọn ẹda alãye na si sure, awọn si pada bi kíkọ manamana.
entries.en: And the living creatures ran and returned as the appearance of a flash of lightning.

entries.yo: Bi mo si ti wo awọn ẹda alãye na, kiyesi i, kẹkẹ́ kan wà lori ilẹ aiye lẹba awọn ẹda alãye na, pẹlu oju rẹ̀ mẹrin.
entries.en: Now as I beheld the living creatures, behold one wheel upon the earth by the living creatures, with his four faces.

entries.yo: Irí awọn kẹkẹ́ na ati iṣẹ wọn dabi awọ̀ berili: awọn mẹrẹrin ni aworan kanna; irí wọn ati iṣẹ wọn dabi ẹnipe kẹkẹ́ li ãrin kẹkẹ́.
entries.en: The appearance of the wheels and their work was like unto the colour of a beryl: and they four had one likeness: and their appearance and their work was as it were a wheel in the middle of a wheel.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn lọ, nwọn fi iha wọn mẹrẹrin lọ, nwọn kò si yipada nigbati nwọn lọ.
entries.en: When they went, they went upon their four sides: and they turned not when they went.

entries.yo: Niti oruka wọn, nwọn ga tobẹ̃ ti nwọn fi ba ni li ẹ̀ru; oruka wọn si kún fun oju yi awọn mẹrẹrin ka.
entries.en: As for their rings, they were so high that they were dreadful; and their rings were full of eyes round about them four.

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn ẹda alãye na lọ, awọn kẹkẹ́ lọ li ẹgbẹ́ wọn: nigbati a si gbe awọn ẹda alãye na soke, kuro lori ilẹ, a gbe awọn kẹkẹ́ na soke pẹlu.
entries.en: And when the living creatures went, the wheels went by them: and when the living creatures were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up.

entries.yo: Nibikibi ti ẹmi ni iba lọ, nwọn lọ; nibẹ li ẹmi fẹ ilọ: a si gbe awọn kẹkẹ́ na soke pẹlu wọn; nitori ẹmi ìye wà ninu awọn kẹkẹ́ na.
entries.en: Whithersoever the spirit was to go, they went, thither was their spirit to go; and the wheels were lifted up over against them: for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.

entries.yo: Nigbati wọnni lọ, wọnyi lọ; nigbati a gbe wọnni duro, wọnyi duro; ati nigbati a gbe wọnni soke kuro lori ilẹ a gbe kẹkẹ́ soke pẹlu wọn: nitori ẹmi ìye wà ninu awọn kẹkẹ́ na.
entries.en: When those went, these went; and when those stood, these stood; and when those were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up over against them: for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.

entries.yo: Aworan ofurufu li ori ẹda alãye na dabi àwọ kristali ti o ba ni li ẹ̀ru, ti o nà sori wọn loke.
entries.en: And the likeness of the firmament upon the heads of the living creature was as the colour of the terrible crystal, stretched forth over their heads above.

entries.yo: Iyẹ́ wọn si tọ́ labẹ ofurufu, ekini si ekeji: olukuluku ni meji, ti o bo ihà ihín, olukuluku si ni meji ti o bo iha ọhún ara wọn.
entries.en: And under the firmament were their wings straight, the one toward the other: every one had two, which covered on this side, and every one had two, which covered on that side, their bodies.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si lọ, mo gbọ́ ariwo iyẹ́ wọn, bi ariwo omi pupọ, bi ohùn Olodumare, ohùn ọ̀rọ bi ariwo ogun: nigbati nwọn duro, nwọn rẹ̀ iyẹ́ wọn silẹ.
entries.en: And when they went, I heard the noise of their wings, like the noise of great waters, as the voice of the Almighty, the voice of speech, as the noise of an host: when they stood, they let down their wings.

entries.yo: Ohùn kan ti inu ofurufu ti o wà lori wọn wá, nigbati nwọn duro, ti nwọn si ti rẹ̀ iyẹ́ wọn silẹ.
entries.en: And there was a voice from the firmament that was over their heads, when they stood, and had let down their wings.

entries.yo: Ati lori ofurufu ti o wà lori wọn, aworan itẹ kan wà, bi irí okuta safire: ati loke aworan itẹ na li aworan kan bi ori enia wà.
entries.en: And above the firmament that was over their heads was the likeness of a throne, as the appearance of a sapphire stone: and upon the likeness of the throne was the likeness as the appearance of a man above upon it.

entries.yo: Mo si ri bi awọ amberi, bi irí iná yika ninu rẹ̀, lati irí ẹgbẹ́ rẹ̀ de oke, ati lati irí ẹgbẹ́ rẹ̀ de isalẹ, mo ri bi ẹnipe irí iná, o si ni didan yika.
entries.en: And I saw as the colour of amber, as the appearance of fire round about within it, from the appearance of his loins even upward, and from the appearance of his loins even downward, I saw as it were the appearance of fire, and it had brightness round about.

entries.yo: Bi irí oṣumare ti o wà ninu awọsanma ni ọjọ ojo, bẹ̃ni irí didan na yika. Eyi ni aworan ogo Oluwa. Nigbati mo si ri, mo dojubolẹ, mo si gbọ́ ohùn ẹnikan ti nsọ̀rọ.
entries.en: As the appearance of the bow that is in the cloud in the day of rain, so was the appearance of the brightness round about. This was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of the LORD. And when I saw it, I fell upon my face, and I heard a voice of one that spake.

entries.yo: O si wi fun mi pe, Ọmọ enia, duro li ẹsẹ rẹ, emi o si ba ọ sọ̀rọ.
entries.en: And he said unto me, Son of man, stand upon thy feet, and I will speak unto thee.

entries.yo: Ẹmi si wọ inu mi, nigbati o ba mi sọ̀rọ o si gbe mi duro li ẹsẹ mi, mo si gbọ́ ẹniti o ba mi sọrọ.
entries.en: And the spirit entered into me when he spake unto me, and set me upon my feet, that I heard him that spake unto me.

entries.yo: O si wi fun mi pe, Ọmọ enia, emi ran ọ si awọn ọmọ Israeli, si ọlọtẹ̀ orilẹ-ède, ti o ti ṣọtẹ si mi: awọn ati baba wọn ti ṣẹ̀ si mi titi di oni oloni.
entries.en: And he said unto me, Son of man, I send thee to the children of Israel, to a rebellious nation that hath rebelled against me: they and their fathers have transgressed against me, even unto this very day.

entries.yo: Nitori ọmọ alafojudi ati ọlọkàn lile ni nwọn, Emi rán ọ si wọn; iwọ o si wi fun wọn pe, Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi.
entries.en: For they are impudent children and stiffhearted. I do send thee unto them; and thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD.

entries.yo: Ati awọn, bi nwọn o gbọ́, tabi bi nwọn o kọ̀, (nitori ọlọtẹ̀ ile ni nwọn) sibẹ nwọn o mọ̀ pe woli kan ti wà larin wọn.
entries.en: And they, whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear, (for they are a rebellious house,) yet shall know that there hath been a prophet among them.

entries.yo: Ati iwọ, ọmọ enia, máṣe bẹ̀ru wọn, bẹ̃ni ki o máṣe bẹ̀ru ọ̀rọ wọn, bi ẹgun ọgàn ati oṣuṣu tilẹ pẹlu rẹ, ti iwọ si gbe ãrin akẽkẽ: máṣe bẹ̀ru ọ̀rọ wọn, bẹ̃ni ki o máṣe foya wiwò wọn, bi nwọn tilẹ jẹ ọlọtẹ̀ ile.
entries.en: And thou, son of man, be not afraid of them, neither be afraid of their words, though briers and thorns be with thee, and thou dost dwell among scorpions: be not afraid of their words, nor be dismayed at their looks, though they be a rebellious house.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si sọ ọ̀rọ mi fun wọn, bi nwọn o gbọ́, tabi bi wọn o kọ̀: nitoriti nwọn jẹ ọlọtẹ̀.
entries.en: And thou shalt speak my words unto them, whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear: for they are most rebellious.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn iwọ, ọmọ enia, gbọ́ ohun ti mo sọ fun ọ; Iwọ máṣe jẹ ọlọtẹ̀ bi ọlọtẹ̀ ile nì: ya ẹ̀nu rẹ, ki o si jẹ ohun ti mo fi fun ọ.
entries.en: But thou, son of man, hear what I say unto thee; Be not thou rebellious like that rebellious house: open thy mouth, and eat that I give thee.

entries.yo: Nigbati mo wò, si kiye si i, a ran ọwọ́ kan si mi; si kiye si i, iká-iwé kan wà ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And when I looked, behold, an hand was sent unto me; and, lo, a roll of a book was therein;

entries.yo: O si tẹ́ ẹ siwaju mi, a si kọ ọ ninu ati lode: a si kọ ohùn-reré-ẹkun, ati ọ̀fọ, ati egbé.
entries.en: And he spread it before me; and it was written within and without: and there was written therein lamentations, and mourning, and woe.

entries.yo: PẸLUPẸLU o wi fun mi pe, Ọmọ enia, jẹ ohun ti iwọ ri, jẹ iká-iwé yi, si lọ ba ile Israeli sọrọ.
entries.en: Moreover he said unto me, Son of man, eat that thou findest; eat this roll, and go speak unto the house of Israel.

entries.yo: Mo si ya ẹnu mi, o si mu mi jẹ iká-iwé na.
entries.en: So I opened my mouth, and he caused me to eat that roll.

entries.yo: O si wi fun mi pe, Ọmọ enia, mu ki ikùn rẹ jẹ, ki o si fi iká-iwé yi ti emi fi fun ọ kún inu rẹ. Nigbana ni mo jẹ ẹ, o si dabi oyin li ẹnu ni didùn.
entries.en: And he said unto me, Son of man, cause thy belly to eat, and fill thy bowels with this roll that I give thee. Then did I eat it; and it was in my mouth as honey for sweetness.

entries.yo: O si wi fun mi pe, Ọmọ enia, Lọ, tọ̀ ile Israeli lọ ki o si fi ọ̀rọ mi ba wọn sọrọ.
entries.en: And he said unto me, Son of man, go, get thee unto the house of Israel, and speak with my words unto them.

entries.yo: Nitori a kò ran ọ si enia ède ajeji ati sisọrọ, ṣugbọn si ile Israeli.
entries.en: For thou art not sent to a people of a strange speech and of an hard language, but to the house of Israel;

entries.yo: Ki iṣe si ọ̀pọlọpọ enia ède ajeji, ati ède sisọrọ, ọ̀rọ ẹniti iwọ kò le gbọ́. Nitotọ emi iba rán ọ si wọn, nwọn iba gbọ́ tirẹ.
entries.en: Not to many people of a strange speech and of an hard language, whose words thou canst not understand. Surely, had I sent thee to them, they would have hearkened unto thee.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ile Israeli kò ni gbọ́ tirẹ; nitori ti nwọn kò fẹ gbọ́ ti emi: nitori alafojudi ati ọlọkàn lile ni gbogbo ile Israeli.
entries.en: But the house of Israel will not hearken unto thee; for they will not hearken unto me: for all the house of Israel are impudent and hardhearted.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, mo ti sọ oju rẹ di lile si oju wọn, ati iwaju rẹ di lile si iwaju wọn.
entries.en: Behold, I have made thy face strong against their faces, and thy forehead strong against their foreheads.

entries.yo: Bi okuta diamondi ti o le ju okuta ibọn ni mo ṣe iwaju rẹ: máṣe bẹ̀ru wọn, bẹ̃ni ki o máṣe fòya oju wọn, bi nwọn tilẹ jẹ ọlọ̀tẹ ile.
entries.en: As an adamant harder than flint have I made thy forehead: fear them not, neither be dismayed at their looks, though they be a rebellious house.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu o wi fun mi pe, Ọmọ enia, gba gbogbo ọ̀rọ ti emi o sọ fun ọ si ọkàn rẹ, si fi eti rẹ gbọ́ wọn.
entries.en: Moreover he said unto me, Son of man, all my words that I shall speak unto thee receive in thine heart, and hear with thine ears.

entries.yo: Si lọ, tọ̀ awọn ti igbekùn lọ, awọn ọmọ enia rẹ, si ba wọn sọ̀rọ, ki o si wi fun wọn pe, Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; bi nwọn o gbọ́, tabi bi nwọn o kọ̀.
entries.en: And go, get thee to them of the captivity, unto the children of thy people, and speak unto them, and tell them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear.

entries.yo: Ẹmi si gbe mi soke, mo si gbọ́ ohùn iró nla lẹhin mi, nwipe, Ibukun ni fun ogo Oluwa lati ipò rẹ̀ wá.
entries.en: Then the spirit took me up, and I heard behind me a voice of a great rushing, saying, Blessed be the glory of the LORD from his place.

entries.yo: Mo si gbọ́ ariwo iyẹ́ awọn ẹ̀da alãye, ti o kàn ara wọn, ati ariwo awọn kẹkẹ́ ti o wà pẹlu wọn, ati ariwo iró nla.
entries.en: I heard also the noise of the wings of the living creatures that touched one another, and the noise of the wheels over against them, and a noise of a great rushing.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni ẹmi na gbe mi soke, o si mu mi kuro, mo si lọ ni ibinujẹ, ati ninu gbigbona ọkàn mi; ṣugbọn ọwọ́ Oluwa le lara mi.
entries.en: So the spirit lifted me up, and took me away, and I went in bitterness, in the heat of my spirit; but the hand of the LORD was strong upon me.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni mo tọ̀ awọn ti igbekùn ti Telabibi lọ, ti nwọn ngbe ẹba odò Kebari, mo si joko nibiti nwọn joko, ẹnu si yà mi bi mo ti wà lãrin wọn ni ijọ meje.
entries.en: Then I came to them of the captivity at Tel-abib, that dwelt by the river of Chebar, and I sat where they sat, and remained there astonished among them seven days.

entries.yo: O si di igbati o ṣe li opin ijọ meje, ọ̀rọ Oluwa wá sọdọ mi, wipe:
entries.en: And it came to pass at the end of seven days, that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

entries.yo: Ọmọ enia, mo ti fi iwọ ṣe oluṣọ́ fun ile Israeli, nitorina gbọ́ ọ̀rọ li ẹnu mi, si kilọ fun wọn lati ọdọ mi wá.
entries.en: Son of man, I have made thee a watchman unto the house of Israel: therefore hear the word at my mouth, and give them warning from me.

entries.yo: Nigbati emi wi fun enia buburu pe, Iwọ o kú nitõtọ; ti iwọ kò si kilọ̀ fun u, ti iwọ kò sọ̀rọ lati kilọ fun enia buburu, lati kuro li ọ̀na buburu rẹ̀, lati gba ẹmi rẹ̀ là; enia buburu na yio kú ninu ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ̀; ṣugbọn ẹjẹ rẹ̀ li emi o bere li ọwọ́ rẹ.
entries.en: When I say unto the wicked, Thou shalt surely die; and thou givest him not warning, nor speakest to warn the wicked from his wicked way, to save his life; the same wicked man shall die in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at thine hand.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi iwọ ba kilọ̀ fun enia buburu, ti kò si kuro ninu buburu rẹ̀, ti ko yipada kuro li ọ̀na buburu rẹ̀, yio kú ninu ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ̀, ṣugbọn ọrun rẹ mọ́.
entries.en: Yet if thou warn the wicked, and he turn not from his wickedness, nor from his wicked way, he shall die in his iniquity; but thou hast delivered thy soul.

entries.yo: Ẹ̀wẹ, nigbati olododo ba yipada kuro ninu ododo rẹ̀, ti o si da ẹ̀ṣẹ, ti mo si fi ohun idigbolu siwaju rẹ, yio kú; nitoriti iwọ kò kilọ fun u, yio kú ninu ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ̀, a ki yio ranti ododo rẹ̀ ti o ti ṣe; ṣugbọn ẹjẹ rẹ̀ li emi o bere li ọwọ́ rẹ.
entries.en: Again, When a righteous man doth turn from his righteousness, and commit iniquity, and I lay a stumblingblock before him, he shall die: because thou hast not given him warning, he shall die in his sin, and his righteousness which he hath done shall not be remembered; but his blood will I require at thine hand.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi iwọ ba kilọ fun olododo, ki olododo ki o má dẹ̀ṣẹ, ti on kò si ṣẹ̀, yio yè nitotọ, nitori ti a kilọ fun u, ọrùn rẹ si mọ́.
entries.en: Nevertheless if thou warn the righteous man, that the righteous sin not, and he doth not sin, he shall surely live, because he is warned; also thou hast delivered thy soul.

entries.yo: Ọwọ́ Oluwa si wà lara mi nibẹ; o si wi fun mi pe, Dide, lọ si pẹtẹlẹ, emi o si ba ọ sọ̀rọ nibẹ.
entries.en: And the hand of the LORD was there upon me; and he said unto me, Arise, go forth into the plain, and I will there talk with thee.

entries.yo: Mo si dide, mo si lọ si pẹtẹlẹ, si kiyesi i ogo Oluwa duro nibẹ, bi ogo ti mo ri lẹba odò Kebari: mo si doju mi bolẹ.
entries.en: Then I arose, and went forth into the plain: and, behold, the glory of the LORD stood there, as the glory which I saw by the river of Chebar: and I fell on my face.

entries.yo: Ẹmi si wọ̀ inu mi lọ, o si gbe mi duro li ẹsẹ mi, o si ba mi sọ̀rọ, o si sọ fun mi pe, Lọ, há ara rẹ mọ ile rẹ.
entries.en: Then the spirit entered into me, and set me upon my feet, and spake with me, and said unto me, Go, shut thyself within thine house.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn iwọ, ọmọ enia, kiyesi i, nwọn o si fi idè le ọ, nwọn o si fi dè ọ, iwọ ki yio si jade larin wọn.
entries.en: But thou, O son of man, behold, they shall put bands upon thee, and shall bind thee with them, and thou shalt not go out among them:

entries.yo: Emi o si mu ahọn rẹ lẹ mọ oke ẹnu rẹ, iwọ o si yadi, iwọ ki yio jẹ abaniwi si wọn; nitori ọlọ̀tẹ ile ni nwọn.
entries.en: And I will make thy tongue cleave to the roof of thy mouth, that thou shalt be dumb, and shalt not be to them a reprover: for they are a rebellious house.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati mo ba bá ọ sọ̀rọ, emi o ya ẹnu rẹ, iwọ o si wi fun wọn pe, Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Ẹniti o gbọ́, jẹ ki o gbọ́; ẹniti o kọ̀, jẹ ki o kọ̀ nitori ọlọ̀tẹ ile ni nwọn.
entries.en: But when I speak with thee, I will open thy mouth, and thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; He that heareth, let him hear; and he that forbeareth, let him forbear: for they are a rebellious house.

entries.yo: IWỌ, ọmọ enia, mu awo kan, ki o si fi si iwaju rẹ, ki o si ṣe aworan ilu Jerusalemu sinu rẹ̀.
entries.en: Thou also, son of man, take thee a tile, and lay it before thee, and pourtray upon it the city, even Jerusalem:

entries.yo: Ki o si dótì i, ki o si mọ ile iṣọ tì i, ki o si mọ odi tì i, ki o si gbe ogun si i, ki o si to õlù yi i ka.
entries.en: And lay siege against it, and build a fort against it, and cast a mount against it; set the camp also against it, and set battering rams against it round about.

entries.yo: Mu awo irin kan, ki o si gbe e duro bi odi irin lãrin rẹ ati ilu na: ki o si kọju si i, a o si dótì i, iwọ o si dótì i. Eyi o jẹ àmi si ile Israeli.
entries.en: Moreover take thou unto thee an iron pan, and set it for a wall of iron between thee and the city: and set thy face against it, and it shall be besieged, and thou shalt lay siege against it. This shall be a sign to the house of Israel.

entries.yo: Fi iha osì rẹ dubulẹ, ki o si fi ẹ̀ṣẹ ile Israeli sori rẹ̀: gẹgẹ bi iye ọjọ ti iwọ o dubulẹ sori rẹ̀ ni iwọ o ru ẹ̀ṣẹ wọn.
entries.en: Lie thou also upon thy left side, and lay the iniquity of the house of Israel upon it: according to the number of the days that thou shalt lie upon it thou shalt bear their iniquity.

entries.yo: Nitori mo ti fi ọdun ẹ̀ṣẹ wọn le ọ lori, gẹgẹ bi iye ọjọ na, ẹwa-di-ni-irinwo ọjọ: bẹ̃ni iwọ o ru ẹ̀ṣẹ ile Israeli.
entries.en: For I have laid upon thee the years of their iniquity, according to the number of the days, three hundred and ninety days: so shalt thou bear the iniquity of the house of Israel.

entries.yo: Nigbati iwọ ba si pari wọn, tun fi ẹgbẹ́ rẹ ọtún dubulẹ, iwọ o si ru ẹ̀ṣẹ ile Juda li ogoji ọjọ: mo ti yàn ọjọ kan fun ọdun kan fun ọ.
entries.en: And when thou hast accomplished them, lie again on thy right side, and thou shalt bear the iniquity of the house of Judah forty days: I have appointed thee each day for a year.

entries.yo: Nitorina iwọ o kọju si didótì Jerusalemu, iwọ ki yio si bo apá rẹ, iwọ o si sọ asọtẹlẹ si i.
entries.en: Therefore thou shalt set thy face toward the siege of Jerusalem, and thine arm shall be uncovered, and thou shalt prophesy against it.

entries.yo: Si kiyesi i, emi o fi idè le ara rẹ, iwọ ki yio si yipada lati ihà kan de ekeji, titi iwọ o fi pari gbogbo ọjọ didotì rẹ.
entries.en: And, behold, I will lay bands upon thee, and thou shalt not turn thee from one side to another, till thou hast ended the days of thy siege.

entries.yo: Si mu alikama, ati ọka bàba, erẽ ati lentile ati milleti, ati ẹwẹ, fi wọn sinu ikoko kan, ki o si fi wọn ṣe akara, gẹgẹ bi iye ọjọ ti iwọ o dubulẹ li ẹgbẹ́ rẹ, ẹwa-di-ni-irinwo ọjọ ni iwọ o jẹ ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: Take thou also unto thee wheat, and barley, and beans, and lentiles, and millet, and fitches, and put them in one vessel, and make thee bread thereof, according to the number of the days that thou shalt lie upon thy side, three hundred and ninety days shalt thou eat thereof.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si jẹ onjẹ rẹ nipa ìwọn, ogún ìwọn ṣekeli li ọjọ kan, lati akoko de akoko ni iwọ o jẹ ẹ.
entries.en: And thy meat which thou shalt eat shall be by weight, twenty shekels a day: from time to time shalt thou eat it.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si mu omi nipa ìwọn, idamẹfa oṣuwọ̀n hini kan: lati akoko de akoko ni iwọ o mu u.
entries.en: Thou shalt drink also water by measure, the sixth part of an hin: from time to time shalt thou drink.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si jẹ ẹ bi akara ọka bàba, iwọ o si fi igbẹ́ enia din i, li oju wọn.
entries.en: And thou shalt eat it as barley cakes, and thou shalt bake it with dung that cometh out of man, in their sight.

entries.yo: Oluwa si wipe, Bayi li awọn ọmọ Israeli yio jẹ akara aimọ́ wọn larin awọn keferi, nibiti emi o le wọn lọ.
entries.en: And the LORD said, Even thus shall the children of Israel eat their defiled bread among the Gentiles, whither I will drive them.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni mo wipe, A, Oluwa Ọlọrun! kiye si i, a kò ti sọ ọkàn mi di aimọ́: nitori lati igba ewe mi wá titi di isisiyi, emi kò ti ijẹ ninu ohun ti o kú fun ara rẹ̀, tabi ti a faya pẹrẹpẹrẹ, bẹ̃ni ẹran ẽwọ̀ kò iti iwọ̀ mi li ẹnu ri.
entries.en: Then said I, Ah Lord GOD! behold, my soul hath not been polluted: for from my youth up even till now have I not eaten of that which dieth of itself, or is torn in pieces; neither came there abominable flesh into my mouth.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni o wi fun mi pe, Wõ, mo ti fi ẹlẹbọtọ fun ọ dipò igbẹ́ enia, iwọ o si fi ṣe akara rẹ.
entries.en: Then he said unto me, Lo, I have given thee cow's dung for man's dung, and thou shalt prepare thy bread therewith.

entries.yo: O si wi fun mi pe, Ọmọ enia, kiye si i, emi o ṣẹ ọpá onjẹ ni Jerusalemu: nwọn o si jẹ akara nipa ìwọn, ati pẹlu itọju; nwọn o si mu omi nipa ìwọn ati pẹlu iyanu.
entries.en: Moreover he said unto me, Son of man, behold, I will break the staff of bread in Jerusalem: and they shall eat bread by weight, and with care; and they shall drink water by measure, and with astonishment:

entries.yo: Ki nwọn ki o le ṣe alaini akara ati omi, ki olukuluku wọn ki o le yanu si ọmọ-nikeji rẹ̀, ki nwọn si run nitori ẹ̀ṣẹ wọn.
entries.en: That they may want bread and water, and be astonied one with another, and consume away for their iniquity.

entries.yo: IWỌ, ọmọ enia, mu ọbẹ mimú, mu abẹ onigbajamọ̀, ki o si mu u kọja li ori rẹ, ati ni irùngbọn rẹ: si mu oṣuwọ̀n lati wọ̀n, ki o si pin irun na.
entries.en: And thou, son of man, take thee a sharp knife, take thee a barber's rasor, and cause it to pass upon thine head and upon thy beard: then take thee balances to weight, and divide the hair.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si fi iná sun idamẹta li ãrin ilu, nigbati ọjọ didotì ba pé: iwọ o si mu idamẹta, ki o si fi ọbẹ bù u kakiri: idamẹta ni iwọ o si tuka sinu ẹfũfù, emi o si yọ idà tẹle wọn.
entries.en: Thou shalt burn with fire a third part in the midst of the city, when the days of the siege are fulfilled: and thou shalt take a third part, and smite about it with a knife: and a third part thou shalt scatter in the wind; and I will draw out a sword after them.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si mu iye diẹ nibẹ, iwọ o si dì wọn si eti aṣọ rẹ.
entries.en: Thou shalt also take thereof a few in number, and bind them in thy skirts.

entries.yo: Si tun mu ninu wọn, ki o si sọ wọn si ãrin iná, ki o si sun wọn ninu iná; lati inu rẹ̀ wá ni iná o ti jade wá si gbogbo ile Israeli.
entries.en: Then take of them again, and cast them into the midst of the fire, and burn them in the fire; for thereof shall a fire come forth into all the house of Israel.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Eyi ni Jerusalemu: Emi ti gbe e kalẹ li ãrin awọn orilẹ-ède, ati awọn ilẹ ti o wà yi i ka kiri.
entries.en: Thus saith the Lord GOD; This is Jerusalem: I have set it in the midst of the nations and countries that are round about her.

entries.yo: O si ti pa idajọ mi dà si buburu ju awọn orilẹ-ède lọ, ati ilana mi ju ilẹ ti o yi i kakiri: nitori nwọn ti kọ̀ idajọ ati ilana mi, nwọn kò rìn ninu wọn.
entries.en: And she hath changed my judgments into wickedness more than the nations, and my statutes more than the countries that are round about her: for they have refused my judgments and my statutes, they have not walked in them.

entries.yo: Nitorina bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi: Nitori ti ẹnyin ṣe ju awọn orilẹ-ède ti o yi nyin ka kiri lọ, ti ẹnyin kò rìn ninu ilana mi, ti ẹ kò pa idajọ mi mọ, ti ẹ kò si ṣe gẹgẹ bi idajọ awọn orilẹ-ède ti o yi nyin ka kiri.
entries.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because ye multiplied more than the nations that are round about you, and have not walked in my statutes, neither have kept my judgments, neither have done according to the judgments of the nations that are round about you;

entries.yo: Nitorina bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi: kiye si i, Emi, ani Emi, doju kọ ọ, emi o si ṣe idajọ li ãrin rẹ li oju awọn orilẹ-ède.
entries.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I, even I, am against thee, and will execute judgments in the midst of thee in the sight of the nations.

entries.yo: Emi o si ṣe ninu rẹ ohun ti emi kò ṣe ri, iru eyi ti emi kì yio si ṣe mọ, nitori gbogbo ohun irira rẹ.
entries.en: And I will do in thee that which I have not done, and whereunto I will not do any more the like, because of all thine abominations.

entries.yo: Nitorina awọn baba yio jẹ awọn ọmọ li ãrin rẹ, ati awọn ọmọ yio si jẹ awọn baba wọn; emi o si ṣe idajọ ninu rẹ, ati gbogbo iyokù rẹ li emi o tuka si gbogbo ẹfũfù.
entries.en: Therefore the fathers shall eat the sons in the midst of thee, and the sons shall eat their fathers; and I will execute judgments in thee, and the whole remnant of thee will I scatter into all the winds.

entries.yo: Nitorina Oluwa Ọlọrun wipe, Bi mo ti wà; Nitõtọ, nitori ti iwọ ti sọ ibi mimọ́ mi di aimọ́ nipa ohun ẹgbin rẹ, ati pẹlu gbogbo ohun irira rẹ, nitori na li emi o ṣe dín ọ kù, oju mi kì yio dasi, bẹ̃ni emi kì yio ṣãnu fun ọ.
entries.en: Wherefore, as I live, saith the Lord GOD; Surely, because thou hast defiled my sanctuary with all thy detestable things, and with all thine abominations, therefore will I also diminish thee; neither shall mine eye spare, neither will I have any pity.

entries.yo: Idámẹta rẹ yio kú nipa ajakalẹ arùn, nwọn o si run li ãrin rẹ nipa iyàn, idámẹta yio si ṣubu nipa idà yi ọ ka kiri, emi o si tú idamẹta ká si gbogbo ẹfũfù, emi o si yọ idà tẹle wọn.
entries.en: A third part of thee shall die with the pestilence, and with famine shall they be consumed in the midst of thee: and a third part shall fall by the sword round about thee and I will scatter a third part into all the winds, and I will draw out a sword after them.

entries.yo: Bayi ni ibinu mi o ṣẹ, emi o si mu ibinu mi duro lori wọn, inu mi yio si tutù: nwọn o si mọ̀ pe emi Oluwa ti sọ ọ ninu itara mi, nigbati mo ba pari ibinu mi ninu wọn.
entries.en: Thus shall mine anger be accomplished, and I will cause my fury to rest upon them, and I will be comforted: and they shall know that I the LORD have spoken it in my zeal, when I have accomplished my fury in them.

entries.yo: Emi o si fi ọ ṣòfo, emi o si sọ ọ di ẹ̀gan lãrin awọn orilẹ-ède ti o yi ọ ka kiri, li oju gbogbo awọn ti nkọja.
entries.en: Moreover I will make thee waste, and a reproach among the nations that are round about thee, in the sight of all that pass by.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni yio si di ẹ̀gan ati ẹsín, ẹkọ́ ati iyanu si awọn orilẹ-ède ti o wà yi ọ ka kiri; nigbati emi o ṣe idajọ ninu rẹ ninu ibinu, ati ninu irunu on ibawi irunu. Emi Oluwa li o sọ ọ.
entries.en: So it shall be a reproach and a taunt, an instruction and an astonishment unto the nations that are round about thee, when I shall execute judgments in thee in anger and in fury and in furious rebukes. I the LORD have spoken it.

entries.yo: Nigbati emi o rán ọfà buburu iyàn si wọn, eyi ti yio jẹ fun iparun wọn, eyi ti emi o rán lati run nyin: emi o si sọ iyàn di pupọ̀ fun nyin, emi o si ṣẹ́ ọpá onjẹ nyin.
entries.en: When I shall send upon them the evil arrows of famine, which shall be for their destruction, and which I will send to destroy you: and I will increase the famine upon you, and will break your staff of bread:

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni emi o rán iyàn ati ẹranko buburu si nyin, nwọn o si gbà ọ li ọmọ, ajàkalẹ arùn ati ẹjẹ̀ yio si kọja lãrin rẹ, emi o si mu idà wá sori rẹ. Emi Oluwa li o ti sọ ọ.
entries.en: So will I send upon you famine and evil beasts, and they shall bereave thee; and pestilence and blood shall pass through thee; and I will bring the sword upon thee. I the LORD have spoken it.

entries.yo: Ọ̀RỌ Oluwa si tọ̀ mi wá, wipe,
entries.en: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

entries.yo: Ọmọ enia, kọju rẹ si awọn oke-nla Israeli, si sọtẹlẹ si wọn.
entries.en: Son of man, set thy face toward the mountains of Israel, and prophesy against them,

entries.yo: Si wipe, Ẹnyin oke-nla Israeli, ẹ gbọ́ ọ̀rọ Oluwa Ọlọrun; bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi si awọn oke-nla, si awọn oke kekeke, si awọn odò siṣàn, ati si awọn afonifoji; kiyesi i, Emi, ani Emi, o mu idà wá sori nyin, emi o si pa ibi giga nyin run.
entries.en: And say, Ye mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord GOD; Thus saith the Lord GOD to the mountains, and to the hills, to the rivers, and to the valleys; Behold, I, even I, will bring a sword upon you, and I will destroy your high places.

entries.yo: Pẹpẹ nyin yio si di ahoro, ere nyin yio si fọ; okú nyin li emi o si gbe jù siwaju oriṣa nyin.
entries.en: And your altars shall be desolate, and your images shall be broken: and I will cast down your slain men before your idols.

entries.yo: Emi o si tẹ́ okú awọn ọmọ Israeli siwaju oriṣa wọn; emi o si tú egungun nyin ka yi pẹpẹ nyin ka.
entries.en: And I will lay the dead carcases of the children of Israel before their idols; and I will scatter your bones round about your altars.

entries.yo: Ilu-nla li a o parun ninu gbogbo ibugbe nyin, ibi giga yio si di ahoro: ki a le run pẹpẹ nyin, ki a si sọ ọ di ahoro, ki a si le fọ́ oriṣa nyin, ki o si tan, ki a si le ké ere nyin lu ilẹ, ki iṣẹ́ nyin si le parẹ.
entries.en: In all your dwellingplaces the cities shall be laid waste, and the high places shall be desolate; that your altars may be laid waste and made desolate, and your idols may be broken and cease, and your images may be cut down, and your works may be abolished.

entries.yo: Okú yio si ṣubu li ãrin nyin, ẹnyin o si mọ̀ pe, Emi li Oluwa.
entries.en: And the slain shall fall in the midst of you, and ye shall know that I am the LORD.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi o fi iyokú silẹ, ki ẹnyin le ni diẹ ti yio bọ́ lọwọ idà lãrin awọn orilẹ-ède, nigbati a o tú nyin ka gbogbo ilẹ.
entries.en: Yet will I leave a remnant, that ye may have some that shall escape the sword among the nations, when ye shall be scattered through the countries.

entries.yo: Awọn ti o bọ́ ninu nyin yio si ranti mi, lãrin awọn orilẹ-ède nibiti nwọn o gbe dì wọn ni igbekun lọ, nitoriti mo ti fọ́ ọkàn agbere wọn ti o ti lọ kuro lọdọ mi, ati pẹlu oju wọn, ti nṣagbere lọ sọdọ oriṣa wọn: nwọn o si sú ara wọn nitori ìwa ibi ti nwọn ti hù ninu gbogbo irira wọn.
entries.en: And they that escape of you shall remember me among the nations whither they shall be carried captives, because I am broken with their whorish heart, which hath departed from me, and with their eyes, which go a whoring after their idols: and they shall lothe themselves for the evils which they have committed in all their abominations.

entries.yo: Nwọn o si mọ̀ pe emi li Oluwa, emi kò wi lasan pe, emi o ṣe ibi yi si wọn.
entries.en: And they shall know that I am the LORD, and that I have not said in vain that I would do this evil unto them.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; pàtẹwọ rẹ, si fi ẹsẹ rẹ kì ilẹ; si wipe, o ṣe! fun gbogbo irira buburu ilẹ Israeli, nitori nwọn o ṣubu nipa idà, nipa ìyan, ati nipa ajakalẹ àrun.
entries.en: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Smite with thine hand, and stamp with thy foot, and say, Alas for all the evil abominations of the house of Israel! for they shall fall by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o jina rere yio kú nipa ajakalẹ àrun; ati ẹniti o sunmọ tosí yio ṣubu nipa idà; ati ẹniti o kù ti a si do tì yio kú nipa iyàn: bayi li emi o mu irunu mi ṣẹ lori wọn.
entries.en: He that is far off shall die of the pestilence; and he that is near shall fall by the sword; and he that remaineth and is besieged shall die by the famine: thus will I accomplish my fury upon them.

entries.yo: Nigbana li ẹnyin o mọ̀ pe emi li Oluwa, nigbati okú wọn yio wà larin ere wọn yi pẹpẹ wọn ka, lori oke kekeke gbogbo, lori ṣonṣo ori oke giga gbogbo, ati labẹ igi tutu gbogbo, ati labẹ gbogbo igi oaku bibò, ibiti nwọn ti rubọ õrùn didùn si gbogbo ere wọn.
entries.en: Then shall ye know that I am the LORD, when their slain men shall be among their idols round about their altars, upon every high hill, in all the tops of the mountains, and under every green tree, and under every thick oak, the place where they did offer sweet savour to all their idols.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ li emi o nà ọwọ́ mi jade sori wọn, emi o si sọ ilẹ na di ahoro, nitotọ, yio di ahoro jù aginju iha Diblati lọ, ninu gbogbo ibugbe wọn: nwọn o si mọ̀ pe emi li Oluwa.
entries.en: So will I stretch out my hand upon them, and make the land desolate, yea, more desolate than the wilderness toward Diblath, in all their habitations: and they shall know that I am the LORD.

entries.yo: Ọ̀RỌ Oluwa si tọ̀ mi wá, wipe,
entries.en: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

entries.yo: Iwọ ọmọ enia, bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi pẹlu si ile Israeli; Opin, opin de sori igun mẹrẹrin ilẹ.
entries.en: Also, thou son of man, thus saith the Lord GOD unto the land of Israel; An end, the end is come upon the four corners of the land.

entries.yo: Opin de si ọ wayi, emi o si rán ibinu mi sori rẹ, emi o si da ọ lẹjọ gẹgẹ bi ọ̀na rẹ; emi o si san gbogbo irira rẹ pada si ọ lori.
entries.en: Now is the end come upon thee, and I will send mine anger upon thee, and will judge thee according to thy ways, and will recompense upon thee all thine abominations.

entries.yo: Oju mi kì yio si dasi, bẹ̃li emi kì yio ṣãnu: ṣugbọn emi o san ọ̀na rẹ pada si ọ lori, ati irira rẹ yio wà li ãrin rẹ: ẹnyin o si mọ̀ pe, emi li Oluwa.
entries.en: And mine eye shall not spare thee, neither will I have pity: but I will recompense thy ways upon thee, and thine abominations shall be in the midst of thee: and ye shall know that I am the LORD.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; ibi kan, ibi kanṣoṣo, kiye si i, o de.
entries.en: Thus saith the Lord GOD; An evil, an only evil, behold, is come.

entries.yo: Opin de, opin de: o jí si ọ; kiye si i, o de.
entries.en: An end is come, the end is come: it watcheth for thee; behold, it is come.

entries.yo: Ilẹ mọ́ ọ, iwọ ẹniti ngbe ilẹ na: akokò na de, ọjọ wahala sunmọ tosí; kì isi ṣe ariwo awọn oke-nla.
entries.en: The morning is come unto thee, O thou that dwellest in the land: the time is come, the day of trouble is near, and not the sounding again of the mountains.

entries.yo: Nisisiyi li emi o dà ikannu mi si ọ lori, emi o si mu ibinu mi ṣẹ si ọ lori: emi o si dá ọ lẹjọ gẹgẹ bi ọ̀na rẹ, emi o si san fun ọ nitori gbogbo irira rẹ.
entries.en: Now will I shortly pour out my fury upon thee, and accomplish mine anger upon thee: and I will judge thee according to thy ways, and will recompense thee for all thine abominations.

entries.yo: Oju mi kì yio si dasi, bẹ̃li emi kì yio ṣãnu: emi o si san fun ọ gẹgẹ bi ọ̀na rẹ, ati irira rẹ ti mbẹ lãrin rẹ; ẹnyin o si mọ̀ pe emi li Oluwa ti nkọlu.
entries.en: And mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity: I will recompense thee according to thy ways and thine abominations that are in the midst of thee; and ye shall know that I am the LORD that smiteth.

entries.yo: Kiye si i ọjọ na, kiyesi i, o de: ilẹ ti mọ́; ọpá ti tanná, irera ti rudi.
entries.en: Behold the day, behold, it is come: the morning is gone forth; the rod hath blossomed, pride hath budded.

entries.yo: Iwa-ipa ti dide di ọpa ìwa buburu: ọkan ninu wọn kì yio kù, tabi ninu ọ̀pọlọpọ wọn, tabi ninu ohun kan wọn, bẹ̃ni kì yio si ipohùnreré ẹkun fun wọn.
entries.en: Violence is risen up into a rod of wickedness: none of them shall remain, nor of their multitude, nor of any of theirs: neither shall there be wailing for them.

entries.yo: Akoko na de, ọjọ na sunmọ itosi: ki olùra máṣe yọ̀, bẹ̃ni ki olùta máṣe gbãwẹ: nitori ibinu de ba gbogbo wọn.
entries.en: The time is come, the day draweth near: let not the buyer rejoice, nor the seller mourn: for wrath is upon all the multitude thereof.

entries.yo: Nitori olùta kì yio pada si eyi ti a tà, bi wọn tilẹ wà lãye: nitori iran na kàn gbogbo enia ibẹ̀, ti kì yio pada; bẹ̃ni kò si ẹniti yio mu ara rẹ̀ le ninu ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: For the seller shall not return to that which is sold, although they were yet alive: for the vision is touching the whole multitude thereof, which shall not return; neither shall any strengthen himself in the iniquity of his life.

entries.yo: Nwọn ti fọn ipè, lati jẹ ki gbogbo wọn mura; ṣugbọn kò si ẹnikan ti o lọ si ogun: nitori ibinu mi wà lori gbogbo wọn.
entries.en: They have blown the trumpet, even to make all ready; but none goeth to the battle: for my wrath is upon all the multitude thereof.

entries.yo: Idà mbẹ lode, ajakálẹ àrun ati iyàn si mbẹ ninu: ẹniti o wà li oko yio kú nipa idà; ẹniti o wà ninu ilu, iyàn ati ajakálẹ àrun ni yio si jẹ ẹ run.
entries.en: The sword is without, and the pestilence and the famine within: he that is in the field shall die with the sword; and he that is in the city, famine and pestilence shall devour him.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn ti o bọ́ ninu wọn yio salà, nwọn o si wà lori oke bi adabà afonifoji, gbogbo nwọn o ma gbãwẹ, olukuluku nitori aiṣedede rẹ̀.
entries.en: But they that escape of them shall escape, and shall be on the mountains like doves of the valleys, all of them mourning, every one for his iniquity.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ọwọ́ ni yio rọ, gbogbo ẽkun ni yio si di ailera bi omi.
entries.en: All hands shall be feeble, and all knees shall be weak as water.

entries.yo: Aṣọ ọ̀fọ ni nwọn o fi gbajá pẹlu; ìbẹru ikú yio si bò wọn mọlẹ; itiju yio si wà loju gbogbo wọn, ẽpá yio si wà li ori gbogbo wọn.
entries.en: They shall also gird themselves with sackcloth, and horror shall cover them; and shame shall be upon all faces, and baldness upon all their heads.

entries.yo: Nwọn o sọ fadaka wọn si igboro, wura wọn li a o si mu kuro; fadaka wọn ati wura wọn kì yio si le gbà wọn là li ọjọ ibinu Oluwa: nwọn kì yio tẹ́ ọkàn wọn lọrùn, bẹ̃ni nwọn kì yio kún inu wọn; nitori on ni idùgbolu aiṣedede wọn.
entries.en: They shall cast their silver in the streets, and their gold shall be removed: their silver and their gold shall not be able to deliver them in the day of the wrath of the LORD: they shall not satisfy their souls, neither fill their bowels: because it is the stumblingblock of their iniquity.

entries.yo: Bi o ṣe ti ẹwà ohun ọṣọ́ rẹ̀ ni, o gbe e ka ibi ọlanla: ṣugbọn nwọn yá ere irira wọn ati ohun ikorira wọn ninu rẹ̀: nitorina li emi ṣe mu u jina si wọn.
entries.en: As for the beauty of his ornament, he set it in majesty: but they made the images of their abominations and of their detestable things therein: therefore have I set it far from them.

entries.yo: Emi o si fi i si ọwọ́ awọn alejo fun ijẹ, ati fun enia buburu aiye fun ikogun: nwọn o si bà a jẹ.
entries.en: And I will give it into the hands of the strangers for a prey, and to the wicked of the earth for a spoil; and they shall pollute it.

entries.yo: Oju mi pẹlu li emi o yipada kuro lọdọ wọn, nwọn o si ba ibi ikọkọ mi jẹ; nitori awọn ọlọṣà yio wọ inu rẹ̀, nwọn o si bà a jẹ.
entries.en: My face will I turn also from them, and they shall pollute my secret place: for the robbers shall enter into it, and defile it.

entries.yo: Rọ ẹ̀wọn kan; nitori ilẹ na kún fun ẹ̀ṣẹ ẹjẹ, ilu-nla na si kún fun iwa ipa.
entries.en: Make a chain: for the land is full of bloody crimes, and the city is full of violence.

entries.yo: Nitorina li emi o mu awọn keferi ti o burujulọ, nwọn o si jogun ile wọn: emi o si mu ọṣọ-nla awọn alagbara tán pẹlu, ibi mimọ́ wọn li a o si bajẹ.
entries.en: Wherefore I will bring the worst of the heathen, and they shall possess their houses: I will also make the pomp of the strong to cease; and their holy places shall be defiled.

entries.yo: Iparun mbọ̀ wá, nwọn o si wá alafia, kì yio si si.
entries.en: Destruction cometh; and they shall seek peace, and there shall be none.

entries.yo: Tulasì yio gori tulasi, irọkẹ̀kẹ yio si gori irọkẹ̀kẹ; nigbana ni nwọn o bere lọdọ woli; ṣugbọn ofin yio ṣegbé kuro lọdọ alufa, ati imọ̀ kuro lọdọ awọn agbà.
entries.en: Mischief shall come upon mischief, and rumour shall be upon rumour; then shall they seek a vision of the prophet; but the law shall perish from the priest, and counsel from the ancients.

entries.yo: Ọba yio ṣọ̀fọ, a o si fi idahoro wọ̀ ọmọ-alade, ọwọ́ awọn enia ilẹ na li a o wahala, emi o ṣe si wọn gẹgẹ bi ọ̀na wọn, ati gẹgẹ bi ẹjọ wọn ti ri li emi o dá a fun wọn: nwọn o si mọ̀ pe emi li Oluwa.
entries.en: The king shall mourn, and the prince shall be clothed with desolation, and the hands of the people of the land shall be troubled: I will do unto them after their way, and according to their deserts will I judge them; and they shall know that I am the LORD.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, li ọdun ẹkẹfa, li oṣù ẹkẹfa, li ọjọ karun oṣù, bi mo ti joko ni ile mi, ti awọn àgbagba Juda si joko niwaju mi, ni ọwọ́ Oluwa Ọlọrun bà le mi nibẹ.
entries.en: And it came to pass in the sixth year, in the sixth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I sat in mine house, and the elders of Judah sat before me, that the hand of the Lord GOD fell there upon me.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni mo wò, si kiye si i, aworán bi irí iná: lati irí ẹgbẹ rẹ̀ ani de isalẹ, iná; ati lati ẹgbẹ́ rẹ de oke, bi irí didan bi àwọ amberi.
entries.en: Then I beheld, and lo a likeness as the appearance of fire: from the appearance of his loins even downward, fire; and from his loins even upward, as the appearance of brightness, as the colour of amber.

entries.yo: O si nà àworan ọwọ́ jade, o si mu mi ni ìdi-irun ori mi; ẹmi si gbe mi soke lagbedemeji aiye on ọrun, o si mu mi wá ni iran Ọlọrun si Jerusalemu, si ilẹkun ẹnu-ọ̀na ti inu to kọju si ariwa; nibiti ijoko ere owu wà ti nmu ni jowu.
entries.en: And he put forth the form of an hand, and took me by a lock of mine head; and the spirit lifted me up between the earth and the heaven, and brought me in the visions of God to Jerusalem, to the door of the inner gate that looketh toward the north; where was the seat of the image of jealousy, which provoketh to jealousy.

entries.yo: Si kiyesi i, ogo Ọlọrun Israeli wà nibẹ, gẹgẹ bi iran ti mo ri ni pẹtẹlẹ.
entries.en: And, behold, the glory of the God of Israel was there, according to the vision that I saw in the plain.

entries.yo: Nigbana li o wi fun mi pe, Ọmọ enia, gbe oju rẹ soke nisisiyi si ọ̀na ihà ariwa. Bẹ̃ni mo gbe oju mi soke si ọ̀na ihà ariwa, si kiye si i, ere owu yi niha ariwa li ati-wọle ọ̀na pẹpẹ.
entries.en: Then said he unto me, Son of man, lift up thine eyes now the way toward the north. So I lifted up mine eyes the way toward the north, and behold northward at the gate of the altar this image of jealousy in the entry.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu o wi fun mi pe, Ọmọ enia, iwọ ri ohun ti nwọn nṣe? ani irira nla ti ile Israeli nṣe nihinyi, ki emi ba le lọ jina kuro ni ibi mimọ́ mi? ṣugbọn si tun yipada, iwọ o si ri ohun irira ti o jù wọnyi lọ.
entries.en: He said furthermore unto me, Son of man, seest thou what they do? even the great abominations that the house of Israel committeth here, that I should go far off from my sanctuary? but turn thee yet again, and thou shalt see greater abominations.

entries.yo: O si mu mi wá si ẹnu-ọ̀na agbala; nigbati mo si wò, kiye si i iho lara ogiri.
entries.en: And he brought me to the door of the court; and when I looked, behold a hole in the wall.

entries.yo: Nigbana li o wi fun mi pe, Ọmọ enia, dá ogirí na lu nisisiyi: nigbati mo si ti dá ogiri na lu tan, kiye si i, ilẹkun.
entries.en: Then said he unto me, Son of man, dig now in the wall: and when I had digged in the wall, behold a door.

entries.yo: O si wi fun mi pe, Wọ ile, ki o si wo ohun irira buburu ti nwọn nṣe nihin.
entries.en: And he said unto me, Go in, and behold the wicked abominations that they do here.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni mo wọle, mo si ri; si kiye si i, gbogbo aworan ohun ti nrakò, ati ẹranko irira, ati gbogbo oriṣa ile Israeli li a yá li aworan lara ogiri yika kiri.
entries.en: So I went in and saw; and behold every form of creeping things, and abominable beasts, and all the idols of the house of Israel, pourtrayed upon the wall round about.

entries.yo: Adọrin ọkunrin ninu awọn agbà ile Israeli si duro niwaju wọn, Jaasania ọmọ Ṣafani si duro lãrin wọn, olukuluku pẹlu awo turari lọwọ rẹ̀; ẹ̃fin ṣiṣu dùdu ti turari si goke lọ.
entries.en: And there stood before them seventy men of the ancients of the house of Israel, and in the midst of them stood Jaazaniah the son of Shaphan, with every man his censer in his hand; and a thick cloud of incense went up.

entries.yo: Nigbana li o si wi fun mi pe, Ọmọ enia iwọ ri ohun ti awọn agbà ile Israeli nṣe li okunkùn, olukuluku ninu iyará oriṣa tirẹ̀? nitori nwọn wipe, Oluwa kò ri wa; Oluwa ti kọ̀ aiye silẹ.
entries.en: Then said he unto me, Son of man, hast thou seen what the ancients of the house of Israel do in the dark, every man in the chambers of his imagery? for they say, The LORD seeth us not; the LORD hath forsaken the earth.

entries.yo: O si wi fun mi pe, Tun yipada, iwọ o si ri ohun irira ti o tobi jù yi ti nwọn nṣe.
entries.en: He said also unto me, Turn thee yet again, and thou shalt see greater abominations that they do.

entries.yo: Nigbana li o mu mi wá si ilẹkun ẹnu-ọ̀na ile Oluwa, ti o wà nihà ariwa; si kiye si i, awọn obinrin joko nwọn nsọkun fun Tammusi.
entries.en: Then he brought me to the door of the gate of the LORD's house which was toward the north; and, behold, there sat women weeping for Tammuz.

entries.yo: Nigbana li o sọ fun mi pe, Iwọ ri eyi, Iwọ ọmọ enia? tun yipada, iwọ o si ri ohun irira ti o tobi ju wọnyi lọ.
entries.en: Then said he unto me, Hast thou seen this, O son of man? turn thee yet again, and thou shalt see greater abominations than these.

entries.yo: O si mu mi wá si inu agbala ile Oluwa, si kiye si i, li ẹnu-ọ̀na tempili Oluwa, lãrin iloro ati pẹpẹ, ni iwọ̀n ọkunrin mẹ̃dọgbọ̀n wà, ti nwọn kẹ̀hin si tẹmpili Oluwa, ti nwọn si kọju si ila-õrùn; nwọn si foribalẹ fun õrun si ila-õrun.
entries.en: And he brought me into the inner court of the LORD's house, and, behold, at the door of the temple of the LORD, between the porch and the altar, were about five and twenty men, with their backs toward the temple of the LORD, and their faces toward the east; and they worshipped the sun toward the east.

entries.yo: Nigbana li o wi fun mi pe, Iwọ ri eyi, ọmọ enia? ohun kekere ni fun ile Juda lati ṣe ohun irira ti nwọn nṣe nihin? nitori nwọn fi ìwa-ipa kún ilẹ na, nwọn si ti pada lati mu mi binu, si kiye si i, nwọn tẹ̀ ẹka-igi bọ imú wọn.
entries.en: Then he said unto me, Hast thou seen this, O son of man? Is it a light thing to the house of Judah that they commit the abominations which they commit here? for they have filled the land with violence, and have returned to provoke me to anger: and, lo, they put the branch to their nose.

entries.yo: Emi pẹlu yio si fi irúnu ba wọn lò: oju mi kì yio dasi, bẹ̃li emi kì yio ṣãnu: ati bi o tilẹ ṣepe nwọn fi ohùn rara kigbe li eti mi, sibẹ emi kì yio gbọ́ ti wọn.
entries.en: Therefore will I also deal in fury: mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity: and though they cry in mine ears with a loud voice, yet will I not hear them.

entries.yo: O si fi ohùn rara kigbe li eti mi wipe, Mu gbogbo awọn alaṣẹ ilu sunmọ itosi, olukuluku ton ti ohun ija iparun li ọwọ́ rẹ̀.
entries.en: He cried also in mine ears with a loud voice, saying, Cause them that have charge over the city to draw near, even every man with his destroying weapon in his hand.

entries.yo: Si kiyesi i, ọkunrin mẹfa jade lati ẹnu ilẹkun oke wá, ti o wà niha ariwa, olukuluku ton ti ohun-ijà ipani li ọwọ́ rẹ̀: ọkunrin kan ninu wọn si wọ aṣọ ọgbọ̀, pẹlu ìwo-tàdawa akọwe li ẹgbẹ́ rẹ̀: nwọn si wọ inu ile, nwọn si duro lẹba pẹpẹ idẹ.
entries.en: And, behold, six men came from the way of the higher gate, which lieth toward the north, and every man a slaughter weapon in his hand; and one man among them was clothed with linen, with a writer's inkhorn by his side: and they went in, and stood beside the brasen altar.

entries.yo: Ogo Ọlọrun Israeli si ti goke kuro lori kerubu, eyi ti o ti wà, si iloro ile. O si pe ọkunrin na ti o wọ aṣọ ọgbọ̀, ti o ni ìwo-tàdawa akọwe li ẹgbẹ́ rẹ̀:
entries.en: And the glory of the God of Israel was gone up from the cherub, whereupon he was, to the threshold of the house. And he called to the man clothed with linen, which had the writer's inkhorn by his side;

entries.yo: Oluwa si wi fun u pe, La ãrin ilu já, li ãrin Jerusalemu, ki o si sami si iwaju awọn ọkunrin ti nkẹdùn, ti nwọn si nkigbe nitori ohun irira ti nwọn nṣe lãrin rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto him, Go through the midst of the city, through the midst of Jerusalem, and set a mark upon the foreheads of the men that sigh and that cry for all the abominations that be done in the midst thereof.

entries.yo: O si sọ fun awọn iyokù li eti mi, pe, Ẹ tẹ̀ le e la ilu lọ, ẹ si ma kọlù: ẹ má jẹ ki oju nyin dasi, bẹ̃ni ẹ máṣe ṣãnu.
entries.en: And to the others he said in mine hearing, Go ye after him through the city, and smite: let not your eye spare, neither have ye pity:

entries.yo: Ẹ pa arugbo ati ọmọde patapata, awọn wundia ati ọmọ kekeke ati obinrin; ṣugbọn ẹ máṣe sunmọ ẹnikan lara ẹniti àmi na wà; ẹ si bẹrẹ lati ibi mimọ́ mi. Bẹ̃ni nwọn bẹrẹ lati ọdọ awọn agbà ti o wà niwaju ile.
entries.en: Slay utterly old and young, both maids, and little children, and women: but come not near any man upon whom is the mark; and begin at my sanctuary. Then they began at the ancient men which were before the house.

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, ẹ sọ ile na di aimọ́, ẹ si fi okú kún agbala na: ẹ jade lọ. Nwọn si jade lọ, nwọn si pa enia ni ilu.
entries.en: And he said unto them, Defile the house, and fill the courts with the slain: go ye forth. And they went forth, and slew in the city.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati nwọn npa wọn, ti a si fi emi silẹ, mo da oju mi bo ilẹ, mo si kigbe, mo si wipe, Oluwa Ọlọrun, iwọ o ha pa gbogbo awọn iyokù Israeli run, nipa dida irúnu rẹ jade sori Jerusalemu?
entries.en: And it came to pass, while they were slaying them, and I was left, that I fell upon my face, and cried, and said, Ah Lord GOD! wilt thou destroy all the residue of Israel in thy pouring out of thy fury upon Jerusalem?

entries.yo: O si wi fun mi pe, Aiṣedede ile Israeli ati ti Juda pọ̀ gidigidi, ilẹ na si kún fun ẹjẹ, ilu si kún fun iyi-ẹjọ-po, nitori nwọn wipe, Oluwa ti kọ aiye silẹ, Oluwa kò riran.
entries.en: Then said he unto me, The iniquity of the house of Israel and Judah is exceeding great, and the land is full of blood, and the city full of perverseness: for they say, The LORD hath forsaken the earth, and the LORD seeth not.

entries.yo: Bi o si ṣe ti emi ni, oju mi kì o dasi, bẹ̃li emi kì o ṣanu, ṣugbọn emi o sán ọ̀na wọn pada si ori wọn.
entries.en: And as for me also, mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity, but I will recompense their way upon their head.

entries.yo: Si kiye si i, ọkunrin ti o wọ aṣọ ọ̀gbọ, ti o ni ìwo-tadawa li ẹgbẹ́ rẹ̀ rohìn, wipe, mo ti ṣe gẹgẹ bi o ti paṣẹ fun mi.
entries.en: And, behold, the man clothed with linen, which had the inkhorn by his side, reported the matter, saying, I have done as thou hast commanded me.

entries.yo: MO si wò, si kiye si i, ninu ofurufu ti o wà loke lori awọn kerubu, ohun kan hàn li ori wọn bi okuta safire bi irí aworan itẹ́.
entries.en: Then I looked, and, behold, in the firmament that was above the head of the cherubims there appeared over them as it were a sapphire stone, as the appearance of the likeness of a throne.

entries.yo: O si sọ fun ọkunrin ti o wọ aṣọ ọ̀gbọ, o si wipe, Bọ sarin kẹkẹ, labẹ kerubu; si bu ikúnwọ ẹyin iná lati agbedemeji awọn kerubu; si fọ́n wọn ka sori ilu na. O si wọ inu ile li oju mi.
entries.en: And he spake unto the man clothed with linen, and said, Go in between the wheels, even under the cherub, and fill thine hand with coals of fire from between the cherubims, and scatter them over the city. And he went in in my sight.

entries.yo: Awọn kerubu si duro li apá ọtun ile na, nigbati ọkunrin na wọ ile; awọ sanma si kún agbala ti inu.
entries.en: Now the cherubims stood on the right side of the house, when the man went in; and the cloud filled the inner court.

entries.yo: Ogo Oluwa si goke lọ kuro lori kerubu o si duro loke iloro ile na; ile na si kún fun awọsanma, agbala na si kùn fun didán ogo Oluwa.
entries.en: Then the glory of the LORD went up from the cherub, and stood over the threshold of the house; and the house was filled with the cloud, and the court was full of the brightness of the LORD's glory.

entries.yo: A si gbọ́ iró iyẹ awọn kerubu titi de agbala ode, bi ohùn Ọlọrun Oludumare nigbati o nsọ̀rọ.
entries.en: And the sound of the cherubims' wings was heard even to the outer court, as the voice of the Almighty God when he speaketh.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati o ti paṣẹ fun ọkunrin ti o wọ aṣọ ọgbọ, wipe, Fọn iná lati ãrin awọn kẹkẹ, lati ãrin awọn kerubu, o si wọ inu ile, o si duro lẹba awọn kẹkẹ.
entries.en: And it came to pass, that when he had commanded the man clothed with linen, saying, Take fire from between the wheels, from between the cherubims; then he went in, and stood beside the wheels.

entries.yo: Kerubu kan si nà ọwọ́ rẹ̀ jade lati ãrin awọn kerubu si iná ti o wà li ãrin awọn kerubu, o si mu ninu rẹ̀, o si fi si ọwọ́ ẹniti o wọ aṣọ ọgbọ̀: ẹniti o gbà a; ti o si jade lọ.
entries.en: And one cherub stretched forth his hand from between the cherubims unto the fire that was between the cherubims, and took thereof, and put it into the hands of him that was clothed with linen: who took it, and went out.

entries.yo: Aworan ọwọ́ enia si hàn ninu awọn kerubu labẹ iyẹ́ wọn.
entries.en: And there appeared in the cherubims the form of a man's hand under their wings.

entries.yo: Nigbati mo si wò, kiye si i, awọn kẹkẹ mẹrin na niha awọn kerubu, kẹkẹ kan niha kerubu kan, ati kẹkẹ miran niha kerubu miran; irí awọn kẹkẹ na si dabi awọ̀ okuta berili.
entries.en: And when I looked, behold the four wheels by the cherubims, one wheel by one cherub, and another wheel by another cherub: and the appearance of the wheels was as the colour of a beryl stone.

entries.yo: Bi o si ṣe ti irí wọn, awọn mẹrẹrin ni aworan kanna, bi ẹnipe kẹkẹ́ kan ti wà li ãrin kẹkẹ́ kan.
entries.en: And as for their appearances, they four had one likeness, as if a wheel had been in the midst of a wheel.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn lọ, nwọn fi ihà wọn mẹrẹrin lọ, nwọn kò yipada bi nwọn ti nlọ, ṣugbọn ibi ti ori ba kọju si, nwọn a tẹle e; nwọn kò yipada bi nwọn ti nlọ.
entries.en: When they went, they went upon their four sides; they turned not as they went, but to the place whither the head looked they followed it; they turned not as they went.
