entries.yo: Ati gbogbo ara wọn, ati ẹhìn wọn, ati ọwọ́ wọn ati iyẹ́ wọn, ati awọn kẹkẹ́, kún fun oju yika kiri kẹkẹ́, ti awọn mẹrẹrin ni.
entries.en: And their whole body, and their backs, and their hands, and their wings, and the wheels, were full of eyes round about, even the wheels that they four had.

entries.yo: Niti awọn kẹkẹ́, a ke si wọn li etí mi wipe, Kẹkẹ́!
entries.en: As for the wheels, it was cried unto them in my hearing, O wheel.

entries.yo: Olukuluku wọn si ni oju mẹrin, oju ekini oju kerubu, oju keji, oju enia, ati ẹkẹta oju kiniun, ati ẹkẹrin oju idi.
entries.en: And every one had four faces: the first face was the face of a cherub, and the second face was the face of a man, and the third the face of a lion, and the fourth the face of an eagle.

entries.yo: A si gbe awọn kerubu soke, eyi ni ẹda alãye ti mo ri lẹba odò Kebari.
entries.en: And the cherubims were lifted up. This is the living creature that I saw by the river of Chebar.

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn kerubu si lọ, awọn kẹkẹ lọ li ẹgbẹ́ wọn: nigbati awọn kerubu si gbe iyẹ́ wọn soke lati fò soke kuro lori ilẹ, kẹkẹ́ kanna kò yipada kuro li ẹgbẹ́ wọn.
entries.en: And when the cherubims went, the wheels went by them: and when the cherubims lifted up their wings to mount up from the earth, the same wheels also turned not from beside them.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn duro, wọnyi duro; nigbati a si gbe wọn soke, wọnyi gbe ara wọn soke pẹlu; nitori ẹmi ẹda alãye na mbẹ ninu wọn.
entries.en: When they stood, these stood; and when they were lifted up, these lifted up themselves also: for the spirit of the living creature was in them.

entries.yo: Ogo Oluwa si lọ kuro ni iloro ile na, o si duro lori awọn kerubu.
entries.en: Then the glory of the LORD departed from off the threshold of the house, and stood over the cherubims.

entries.yo: Awọn kerubu si gbe iyẹ́ wọn soke, nwọn si fò kuro lori ilẹ li oju mi: nigbati nwọn jade lọ, awọn kẹkẹ wà li ẹgbẹ̀ wọn pẹlu, olukuluku si duro nibi ilẹkun ẹnu-ọ̀na ilà-õrun ile Oluwa: ogo Ọlọrun Israeli si wà lori wọn loke.
entries.en: And the cherubims lifted up their wings, and mounted up from the earth in my sight: when they went out, the wheels also were beside them, and every one stood at the door of the east gate of the LORD's house; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above.

entries.yo: Eyi ni ẹda alãye ti mo ri labẹ Ọlọrun Israeli li ẹba odò Kebari, mo si mọ̀ pe kerubu ni nwọn.
entries.en: This is the living creature that I saw under the God of Israel by the river of Chebar; and I knew that they were the cherubims.

entries.yo: Olukuluku wọn ni oju mẹrin li ọkankan, olukuluku wọn si ni iyẹ́ mẹrin; ati aworan ọwọ́ enia wà li abẹ iyẹ́ wọn.
entries.en: Every one had four faces apiece, and every one four wings; and the likeness of the hands of a man was under their wings.

entries.yo: Aworan oju wọn si jẹ oju kanna ti mo ri lẹba odò Kebari, iri wọn ati awọn tikara wọn: olukuluku wọn lọ li ọkankan ganran.
entries.en: And the likeness of their faces was the same faces which I saw by the river of Chebar, their appearances and themselves: they went every one straight forward.

entries.yo: ẸMI si gbe mi soke, o si mu mi wá si ẹnu-ọ̀na ile Oluwa ti ilà õrun ti o kọju siha ilà-õrùn, si kiyesi i, ọkunrin mẹdọgbọn wà nibi ilẹkun ẹnu-ọ̀na; ninu awọn ẹniti mo ri Jaasania ọmọ Assuri, ati Pelatia ọmọ Benaia, awọn ijoyè awọn enia.
entries.en: Moreover the spirit lifted me up, and brought me unto the east gate of the LORD's house, which looketh eastward: and behold at the door of the gate five and twenty men; among whom I saw Jaazaniah the son of Azur, and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah, the princes of the people.

entries.yo: O si wi fun mi pe, Ọmọ enia, awọn ọkunrin ti npete ikà ni wọnyi, ti nsi gbimọ̀ buburu ni ilu yi:
entries.en: Then said he unto me, Son of man, these are the men that devise mischief, and give wicked counsel in this city:

entries.yo: Awọn ti o wipe, Kò sunmọ tosi; ẹ jẹ ki a kọ ile: ilu yi ni ìgba, awa si ni ẹran.
entries.en: Which say, It is not near; let us build houses: this city is the caldron, and we be the flesh.

entries.yo: Nitorina sọtẹlẹ si wọn, Ọmọ enia, sọtẹlẹ.
entries.en: Therefore prophesy against them, prophesy, O son of man.

entries.yo: Ẹmi Oluwa si bà le mi, o si wi fun mi pe, Sọ̀rọ; Bayi li Oluwa wi; Bayi li ẹnyin ti wi, Ile Israeli, nitoriti mo mọ̀ olukuluku ohun ti o wá si inu nyin.
entries.en: And the Spirit of the LORD fell upon me, and said unto me, Speak; Thus saith the LORD; Thus have ye said, O house of Israel: for I know the things that come into your mind, every one of them.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin ti sọ okú nyin di pupọ̀ ni ilu yi, ẹnyin si ti fi okú kún igboro rẹ̀,
entries.en: Ye have multiplied your slain in this city, and ye have filled the streets thereof with the slain.

entries.yo: Nitorina bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi, Awọn okú nyin ti ẹnyin ti tẹ́ si ãrin rẹ̀, awọn ni ẹran, ilu yi si ni ìgba; ṣugbọn emi o mu nyin jade kuro lãrin rẹ̀.
entries.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Your slain whom ye have laid in the midst of it, they are the flesh, and this city is the caldron: but I will bring you forth out of the midst of it.

entries.yo: Oluwa Ọlọrun wipe, Ẹnyin ti bẹ̀ru idà, emi o si mu idà wa sori nyin.
entries.en: Ye have feared the sword; and I will bring a sword upon you, saith the Lord GOD.

entries.yo: Emi o si mu nyin kuro lãrin rẹ̀, emi o si fi nyin le awọn alejo lọwọ, emi o si mu idajọ ṣẹ si nyin lara.
entries.en: And I will bring you out of the midst thereof, and deliver you into the hands of strangers, and will execute judgments among you.

entries.yo: Nipa idà li ẹnyin o ṣubu; emi o ṣe idajọ nyin li agbegbe Israeli; ẹnyin o si mọ̀ pe emi li Oluwa.
entries.en: Ye shall fall by the sword; I will judge you in the border of Israel; and ye shall know that I am the LORD.

entries.yo: Ilu yi ki yio ṣe ìgba fun nyin, bẹ̃ni ẹnyin kì yio jẹ ẹran lãrin rẹ̀; ṣugbọn emi o ṣe idajọ nyin li agbegbe Israeli.
entries.en: This city shall not be your caldron, neither shall ye be the flesh in the midst thereof; but I will judge you in the border of Israel:

entries.yo: Ẹnyin o si mọ̀ pe emi li Oluwa: nitoriti ẹnyin kò rìn ninu aṣẹ mi, bẹ̃ni ẹnyin kò mu idajọ mi ṣẹ, ṣugbọn ẹnyin ti hu ìwa awọn keferi ti o wà yi nyin ka.
entries.en: And ye shall know that I am the LORD: for ye have not walked in my statutes, neither executed my judgments, but have done after the manners of the heathen that are round about you.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati mo sọtẹlẹ, Pelatia ọmọ Benaiah kú. Mo si dojubolẹ, mo si fi ohùn rara kigbe, mo si wipe, A! Oluwa Ọlọrun, iwọ o ha ṣe aṣetan iyokù Israeli bi?
entries.en: And it came to pass, when I prophesied, that Pelatiah the son of Benaiah died. Then fell I down upon my face, and cried with a loud voice, and said, Ah Lord GOD! wilt thou make a full end of the remnant of Israel?

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ Oluwa tun tọ̀ mi wá, wipe,
entries.en: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

entries.yo: Ọmọ enia, awọn ará rẹ, ani awọn ará rẹ, awọn ọkunrin ninu ibatan rẹ, ati gbogbo ile Israeli patapata, ni awọn ti awọn ara Jerusalemu ti wi fun pe, Ẹ jina si Oluwa; awa ni a fi ilẹ yi fun ni ini.
entries.en: Son of man, thy brethren, even thy brethren, the men of thy kindred, and all the house of Israel wholly, are they unto whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem have said, Get you far from the LORD: unto us is this land given in possession.

entries.yo: Nitorina wipe, Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi, Bi mo tilẹ ti tá wọn nù réré lãrin awọn keferi; bi mo si ti tú wọn ka lãrin ilẹ pupọ, sibẹ emi o jẹ ibi mimọ́ kekere fun wọn ni ilẹ ti wọn o de.
entries.en: Therefore say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Although I have cast them far off among the heathen, and although I have scattered them among the countries, yet will I be to them as a little sanctuary in the countries where they shall come.

entries.yo: Nitorina wipe, Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi, pe, Emi tilẹ kó nyin kuro lọdọ awọn orilẹ-ède; emi o si kó nyin jọ lati ilẹ ti a ti tú nyin ká si, emi o si fun nyin ni ilẹ Israeli.
entries.en: Therefore say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will even gather you from the people, and assemble you out of the countries where ye have been scattered, and I will give you the land of Israel.

entries.yo: Nwọn o si wá sibẹ, nwọn o si mu gbogbo ohun irira rẹ̀ ati gbogbo ohun ẽri rẹ̀ kuro nibẹ.
entries.en: And they shall come thither, and they shall take away all the detestable things thereof and all the abominations thereof from thence.

entries.yo: Emi o si fun wọn li ọkàn kan, emi o si fi ẹmi titun sinu nyin; emi o si mu ọkàn okuta kuro lara wọn, emi o si fun wọn li ọkàn ẹran:
entries.en: And I will give them one heart, and I will put a new spirit within you; and I will take the stony heart out of their flesh, and will give them an heart of flesh:

entries.yo: Ki wọn le rìn ninu aṣẹ mi, ki wọn si le pa ilana mi mọ, ki nwọn si ṣe wọn: nwọn o si jẹ enia mi, emi o si jẹ Ọlọrun wọn.
entries.en: That they may walk in my statutes, and keep mine ordinances, and do them: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi o ṣe ti awọn ti ọkàn wọn nrìn nipa ọkàn ohun irira ati ohun ẽri wọn, Emi o sẹsan ọ̀na wọn sori ara wọn, li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi.
entries.en: But as for them whose heart walketh after the heart of their detestable things and their abominations, I will recompense their way upon their own heads, saith the Lord GOD.

entries.yo: Awọn kerubu si gbe iyẹ́ wọn soke, pelu awọn kẹkẹ́ lẹgbẹ wọn, ogo Ọlọrun Israeli si wà lori wọn loke.
entries.en: Then did the cherubims lift up their wings, and the wheels beside them; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above.

entries.yo: Ogo Oluwa si goke lọ kuro lãrin ilu na; o si duro lori oke-nla, ti o wà nihà ila-õrùn ilu na.
entries.en: And the glory of the LORD went up from the midst of the city, and stood upon the mountain which is on the east side of the city.

entries.yo: Lẹhin na ẹmi gbe mi soke, o si mu mi wá si Kaldea li ojuran, nipa Ẹmi Ọlọrun sọdọ awọn ti igbekun. Bẹ̃ni iran ti mo ti ri lọ kuro lọdọ mi.
entries.en: Afterwards the spirit took me up, and brought me in a vision by the Spirit of God into Chaldea, to them of the captivity. So the vision that I had seen went up from me.

entries.yo: Mo si sọ gbogbo ohun ti Oluwa ti fi hàn mi fun awọn ti igbekùn.
entries.en: Then I spake unto them of the captivity all the things that the LORD had shewed me.

entries.yo: Ọ̀RỌ Oluwa si tọ̀ mi wá, wipe,
entries.en: The word of the LORD also came unto me, saying,

entries.yo: Ọmọ enia, iwọ ngbe ãrin ọlọ̀tẹ ile, ti nwọn ni oju lati ri, ti kò si ri; nwọn ni eti lati gbọ́, nwọn kò si gbọ́: nitori ọlọ̀tẹ ile ni nwọn.
entries.en: Son of man, thou dwellest in the midst of a rebellious house, which have eyes to see, and see not; they have ears to hear, and hear not: for they are a rebellious house.

entries.yo: Nitorina, iwọ ọmọ enia, mura nkan kikolọ, ki o si kó lọ li oju wọn li ọsan; ki o si kó lati ipò rẹ lọ si ibomiran li oju wọn; o le ṣe pe nwọn o ronu, bi nwọn tilẹ jẹ ọlọ̀tẹ ile.
entries.en: Therefore, thou son of man, prepare thee stuff for removing, and remove by day in their sight; and thou shalt remove from thy place to another place in their sight: it may be they will consider, though they be a rebellious house.

entries.yo: Ki o si mu nkan rẹ jade li ọsan li oju wọn, bi nkan kikolọ; ki o si jade lọ li aṣalẹ li oju wọn, bi awọn ti nlọ si igbekùn.
entries.en: Then shalt thou bring forth thy stuff by day in their sight, as stuff for removing: and thou shalt go forth at even in their sight, as they that go forth into captivity.

entries.yo: Da ogiri lu loju wọn, ki o si kó jade nibẹ.
entries.en: Dig thou through the wall in their sight, and carry out thereby.

entries.yo: Li oju wọn ni ki o rù u le ejika rẹ, ki o si rù u lọ ni wiriwiri alẹ, ki o si bo oju rẹ, ki o má ba ri ilẹ; nitori mo ti gbe ọ kalẹ fun àmi si ile Israeli.
entries.en: In their sight shalt thou bear it upon thy shoulders, and carry it forth in the twilight: thou shalt cover thy face, that thou see not the ground: for I have set thee for a sign unto the house of Israel.

entries.yo: Mo si ṣe bi a ti paṣẹ fun mi: mo mu nkan mi jade li ọsan, bi nkan fun igbekùn, mo si fi ọwọ́ mi dá ogiri lu li aṣalẹ; mo gbe e jade ni wiriwiri alẹ, mo si rù u le ejika mi loju wọn.
entries.en: And I did so as I was commanded: I brought forth my stuff by day, as stuff for captivity, and in the even I digged through the wall with mine hand; I brought it forth in the twilight, and I bare it upon my shoulder in their sight.

entries.yo: Li owurọ ọ̀rọ Oluwa si ti tọ̀ mi wá, wipe,
entries.en: And in the morning came the word of the LORD unto me, saying,

entries.yo: Ọmọ enia, ile Israeli, ọlọ̀tẹ ile nì kò ti wi fun ọ pe, kini iwọ nṣe?
entries.en: Son of man, hath not the house of Israel, the rebellious house, said unto thee, What doest thou?

entries.yo: Wi fun wọn pe, Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Ẹrù yi hàn fun awọn ọmọ-alade ni Jerusalemu, ati gbogbo ile Israeli ti o wà lãrin wọn.
entries.en: Say thou unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; This burden concerneth the prince in Jerusalem, and all the house of Israel that are among them.

entries.yo: Wipe, emi ni àmi nyin, gẹgẹ bi mo ti ṣe, bẹ̃ni a o si ṣe si wọn: nwọn o ko kuro, nwọn o si lọ si igbekùn.
entries.en: Say, I am your sign: like as I have done, so shall it be done unto them: they shall remove and go into captivity.

entries.yo: Ọmọ-alade ti o wà larin wọn yio si rẹrù lori ejika rẹ̀ ni wiriwiri alẹ, yio si jade lọ; nwọn o si dá ogiri lu lati kó jade nibẹ; yio si bo oju rẹ̀, ki o má ba fi oju rẹ̀ ri ilẹ.
entries.en: And the prince that is among them shall bear upon his shoulder in the twilight, and shall go forth: they shall dig through the wall to carry out thereby: he shall cover his face, that he see not the ground with his eyes.

entries.yo: Awọ̀n mi ni emi o si tẹ́ le e lori, a o si mu u ninu ẹgẹ́ mi: emi o si mu u wá si Babiloni, si ilẹ awọn ara Kaldea; kì yio si ri i, bẹ̃ni yio kú nibẹ.
entries.en: My net also will I spread upon him, and he shall be taken in my snare: and I will bring him to Babylon to the land of the Chaldeans; yet shall he not see it, though he shall die there.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn ti o yi i ka lati ràn a lọwọ, ati gbogbo ọwọ-ogun rẹ̀, ni emi o tuká si gbogbo afẹ̃fẹ, emi o si yọ idà le wọn.
entries.en: And I will scatter toward every wind all that are about him to help him, and all his bands; and I will draw out the sword after them.

entries.yo: Nwọn o si mọ̀ pe, Emi li Oluwa, nigbati mo ba tú wọn ka lãrin awọn orilẹ-ède; ti mo ba si fọ́n wọn ká ilẹ pupọ.
entries.en: And they shall know that I am the LORD, when I shall scatter them among the nations, and disperse them in the countries.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi o kù diẹ ninu wọn silẹ lọwọ idà, lọwọ iyàn, ati lọwọ ajakálẹ arùn; ki nwọn le sọ gbogbo ohun ẽri wọn lãrin awọn keferi, nibiti nwọn ba de; nwọn o si mọ̀ pe emi li Oluwa.
entries.en: But I will leave a few men of them from the sword, from the famine, and from the pestilence; that they may declare all their abominations among the heathen whither they come; and they shall know that I am the LORD.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ Oluwa si tọ̀ mi wá, wipe,
entries.en: Moreover the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

entries.yo: Ọmọ enia, fi ìgbọnriri jẹ onjẹ rẹ, si fi ìwariri ati ikiyesara mu omi rẹ;
entries.en: Son of man, eat thy bread with quaking, and drink thy water with trembling and with carefulness;

entries.yo: Ki o si sọ fun awọn enia ilẹ na pe, Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi fun awọn ara Jerusalemu, niti ilẹ Israeli; nwọn o fi ikiyesara jẹ onjẹ wọn, nwọn o si fi iyanu mu omi wọn, ki ilẹ rẹ̀ ki o le di ahoro kuro ninu gbogbo ohun ti o wà ninu rẹ̀, nitori ìwa-ipá gbogbo awọn ti ngbe ibẹ̀.
entries.en: And say unto the people of the land, Thus saith the Lord GOD of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and of the land of Israel; They shall eat their bread with carefulness, and drink their water with astonishment, that her land may be desolate from all that is therein, because of the violence of all them that dwell therein.

entries.yo: Awọn ilu ti a ngbe yio di ofo, ilẹ na yio si di ahoro; ẹnyin o si mọ̀ pe emi li Oluwa.
entries.en: And the cities that are inhabited shall be laid waste, and the land shall be desolate; and ye shall know that I am the LORD.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ Oluwa si tọ̀ mi wá, wipe,
entries.en: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

entries.yo: Ọmọ enia, owe wo li ẹnyin ni, ni ilẹ Israeli pe, A fà ọjọ gùn, gbogbo iran di asan?
entries.en: Son of man, what is that proverb that ye have in the land of Israel, saying, The days are prolonged, and every vision faileth?

entries.yo: Nitorina wi fun wọn pe, Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; emi o jẹ ki owe yi dẹkun, nwọn kì yio si pa a li owe ni Israeli mọ; ṣugbọn wi fun wọn pe, Ọjọ kù si dẹ̀dẹ; ati imuṣẹ gbogbo iran.
entries.en: Tell them therefore, Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will make this proverb to cease, and they shall no more use it as a proverb in Israel; but say unto them, The days are at hand, and the effect of every vision.

entries.yo: Nitori kì yio si iran asan mọ, kì yio si si afọṣẹ ti npọnni ninu ile Israeli.
entries.en: For there shall be no more any vain vision nor flattering divination within the house of Israel.

entries.yo: Nitori emi li Oluwa: emi o sọ̀rọ, ọ̀rọ ti emi o sọ yio si ṣẹ, a kì yio fà a gùn mọ; nitori li ọjọ nyin, Ọlọtẹ ile, li emi o sọ ọ̀rọ na, emi o si ṣe e, ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi.
entries.en: For I am the LORD: I will speak, and the word that I shall speak shall come to pass; it shall be no more prolonged: for in your days, O rebellious house, will I say the word, and will perform it, saith the Lord GOD.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ Oluwa si tun tọ̀ mi wá, wipe,
entries.en: Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

entries.yo: Ọmọ enia, kiyesi i, awọn ara ile Israeli wipe, Iran ti o ri, fun ọjọ pupọ ti mbọ̀ ni, o si sọ asọtẹlẹ akoko ti o jina rere.
entries.en: Son of man, behold, they of the house of Israel say, The vision that he seeth is for many days to come, and he prophesieth of the times that are far off.

entries.yo: Nitorina wi fun wọn pe, Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi: Kò si ọkan ninu ọ̀rọ mi ti a o fà gùn mọ, ṣugbọn ọ̀rọ ti mo ti sọ yio ṣẹ, ni Oluwa wi.
entries.en: Therefore say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; There shall none of my words be prolonged any more, but the word which I have spoken shall be done, saith the Lord GOD.

entries.yo: Ọ̀RỌ Oluwa si tọ̀ mi wá, wipe:
entries.en: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

entries.yo: Ọmọ enia, sọtẹlẹ si awọn woli Israeli ti nsọtẹlẹ, ki o si wi fun awọn ti nti ọkàn ara wọn sọtẹlẹ pe, Ẹ gbọ́ ọ̀rọ Oluwa;
entries.en: Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel that prophesy, and say thou unto them that prophesy out of their own hearts, Hear ye the word of the LORD;

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi, egbé ni fun awọn aṣiwere woli, ti nwọn ntẹ̀le ẹmi ara wọn, ti wọn kò si ri nkan!
entries.en: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Woe unto the foolish prophets, that follow their own spirit, and have seen nothing!

entries.yo: Israeli, awọn woli rẹ dabi kọ̀lọkọ̀lọ ni ijù,
entries.en: O Israel, thy prophets are like the foxes in the deserts.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin kò ti goke lọ si ibi ti o ya, bẹ̃ni ẹ kò si tun odi mọ fun ile Israeli lati duro li oju ogun li ọjọ Oluwa.
entries.en: Ye have not gone up into the gaps, neither made up the hedge for the house of Israel to stand in the battle in the day of the LORD.

entries.yo: Nwọn ti ri asan ati àfọṣẹ eke, pe, Oluwa wi: bẹ̃ni Oluwa kò rán wọn, nwọn si ti jẹ ki awọn ẹlomiran ni ireti pe, nwọn o fi idí ọ̀rọ wọn mulẹ.
entries.en: They have seen vanity and lying divination, saying, The LORD saith: and the LORD hath not sent them: and they have made others to hope that they would confirm the word.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin kò ti ri iran asan, ẹ kò si ti fọ àfọṣẹ eke, ti ẹnyin wipe, Oluwa wi bẹ̃? bẹ̃ni emi kò sọrọ.
entries.en: Have ye not seen a vain vision, and have ye not spoken a lying divination, whereas ye say, The LORD saith it; albeit I have not spoken?

entries.yo: Nitorina bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Nitori ẹnyin ti sọ̀rọ asan, ẹnyin si ti ri eke, nitorina, kiyesi i, mo dojukọ nyin, ni Oluwa wi.
entries.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because ye have spoken vanity, and seen lies, therefore, behold, I am against you, saith the Lord GOD.

entries.yo: Ọwọ́ mi yio si wà lori awọn woli, ti nwọn ri asan, ti nwọn si nfọ àfọṣẹ eke; nwọn kì yio si ninu ijọ awọn enia mi, bẹ̃ni a kì yio kọwe wọn sinu iwe ile Israeli; bẹ̃ni nwọn kì yio wọ̀ ilẹ Israeli, ẹnyin o si mọ̀ pe emi li Oluwa.
entries.en: And mine hand shall be upon the prophets that see vanity, and that divine lies: they shall not be in the assembly of my people, neither shall they be written in the writing of the house of Israel, neither shall they enter into the land of Israel; and ye shall know that I am the Lord GOD.

entries.yo: Nitori, ani nitori ti nwọn ti tàn awọn enia mi wipe, Alafia; bẹ̃ni kò si alafia, ọkan si mọ ogiri, si kiyesi, awọn miran si nfi amọ̀ ti a kò pò rẹ́ ẹ.
entries.en: Because, even because they have seduced my people, saying, Peace; and there was no peace; and one built up a wall, and, lo, others daubed it with untempered morter:

entries.yo: Wi fun awọn ti nfi amọ̀ aipò rẹ́ ẹ, pe, yio ṣubu; òjo yio rọ̀ pupọ; ati Ẹnyin, yinyín nla, o si bọ́; ẹfũfu lile yio si ya a.
entries.en: Say unto them which daub it with untempered morter, that it shall fall: there shall be an overflowing shower; and ye, O great hailstones, shall fall; and a stormy wind shall rend it.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, nigbati ogiri na ba wo, a kì yio ha wi fun nyin pe, Rirẹ́ ti ẹnyin rẹ́ ẹ ha dà?
entries.en: Lo, when the wall is fallen, shall it not be said unto you, Where is the daubing wherewith ye have daubed it?

entries.yo: Nitorina bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; emi o tilẹ fi ẹfũfu lile ya a ni irúnu mi; òjo yio si rọ̀ pupọ ni ibinu mi, ati yinyin nla ni irúnu mi lati run u.
entries.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; I will even rend it with a stormy wind in my fury; and there shall be an overflowing shower in mine anger, and great hailstones in my fury to consume it.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni emi o wo ogiri ti ẹnyin fi amọ̀ aipò rẹ́ lulẹ, emi o si mu u wá ilẹ, tobẹ̃ ti ipilẹ rẹ̀ yio hàn, yio si ṣubu, a o si run nyin li ãrin rẹ̀: ẹnyin o si mọ̀ pe, emi li Oluwa.
entries.en: So will I break down the wall that ye have daubed with untempered morter, and bring it down to the ground, so that the foundation thereof shall be discovered, and it shall fall, and ye shall be consumed in the midst thereof: and ye shall know that I am the LORD.

entries.yo: Bayi li emi o mu ibinu mi ṣẹ lori ogiri na, ati lori awọn ti o fi amọ̀ aipò rẹ ẹ, emi o si wi fun nyin pe, Ogiri na kò si mọ ati awọn ti o ti rẹ́ ẹ;
entries.en: Thus will I accomplish my wrath upon the wall, and upon them that have daubed it with untempered morter, and will say unto you, The wall is no more, neither they that daubed it;

entries.yo: Eyini ni, awọn woli Israeli, ti nwọn sọtẹlẹ niti Jerusalemu, ti nwọn si ri iran alafia fun u, bẹ̃ni alafia kò si, ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi.
entries.en: To wit, the prophets of Israel which prophesy concerning Jerusalem, and which see visions of peace for her, and there is no peace, saith the Lord GOD.

entries.yo: Iwọ ọmọ enia, dojukọ awọn ọmọbinrin awọn enia rẹ bẹ̃ gẹgẹ, ti nwọn nsọtẹlẹ lati ọkàn ara wọn wá; ki o si sọtẹlẹ si wọn.
entries.en: Likewise, thou son of man, set thy face against the daughters of thy people, which prophesy out of their own heart; and prophesy thou against them,

entries.yo: Si wipe, Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi: Egbé ni fun awọn obinrin ti nrán tìmtim si gbogbo ìgbọnwọ, ti nwọn sì ndá gèle si ori olukuluku enia lati ṣọdẹ ọkàn! Ẹnyin o ṣọdẹ ọkàn awọn enia mi bi, ẹnyin o si gbà ọkàn ti o tọ̀ nyin wá là bi?
entries.en: And say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Woe to the women that sew pillows to all armholes, and make kerchiefs upon the head of every stature to hunt souls! Will ye hunt the souls of my people, and will ye save the souls alive that come unto you?

entries.yo: Ẹnyin o ha si bà mi jẹ lãrin awọn enia mi nitori ikunwọ ọkà bàba, ati nitori òkele onjẹ, lati pa ọkàn ti kì ba kú, ati lati gba awọn ọkàn ti kì ba wà lãye là, nipa ṣiṣeke fun awọn enia mi ti ngbọ́ eke nyin?
entries.en: And will ye pollute me among my people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread, to slay the souls that should not die, and to save the souls alive that should not live, by your lying to my people that hear your lies?

entries.yo: Nitorina bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Kiyesi i, mo dojukọ awọn tìmtim nyin, ti ẹnyin fi nṣọdẹ ọkàn nibẹ lati mu wọn fò, emi o si yà wọn kuro li apá nyin, emi o si jẹ ki awọn ọkàn na lọ, ani awọn ọkàn ti ẹnyin ndọdẹ lati mu fò.
entries.en: Wherefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I am against your pillows, wherewith ye there hunt the souls to make them fly, and I will tear them from your arms, and will let the souls go, even the souls that ye hunt to make them fly.

entries.yo: Gèle nyin pẹlu li emi o ya, emi o si gba awọn enia mi lọwọ nyin, nwọn kì yio si si lọwọ nyin mọ lati ma dọdẹ wọn; ẹnyin o si mọ̀ pe emi li Oluwa.
entries.en: Your kerchiefs also will I tear, and deliver my people out of your hand, and they shall be no more in your hand to be hunted; and ye shall know that I am the LORD.

entries.yo: Nitoripe eke li ẹnyin fi mu ọkàn awọn olododo kãnu, awọn ẹniti emi kò mu kãnu, ẹnyin si mu ọwọ́ enia buburu le, ki o má ba pada kuro li ọ̀na buburu rẹ̀ nipa ṣiṣe ileri ìye fun u:
entries.en: Because with lies ye have made the heart of the righteous sad, whom I have not made sad; and strengthened the hands of the wicked, that he should not return from his wicked way, by promising him life:

entries.yo: Nitorina ẹnyin kì yio ri asan mọ, ẹ kì yio si ma fọ àfọṣẹ, nitoriti emi o gba awọn enia mi kuro li ọwọ́ nyin, ẹnyin o si mọ̀ pe emi li Oluwa.
entries.en: Therefore ye shall see no more vanity, nor divine divinations: for I will deliver my people out of your hand: and ye shall know that I am the LORD.

entries.yo: AWỌN kan ninu awọn àgba Israeli si wá sọdọ mi, nwọn si joko niwaju mi.
entries.en: Then came certain of the elders of Israel unto me, and sat before me.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ Oluwa si tọ̀ mi wá, wipe,
entries.en: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

entries.yo: Ọmọ enia, awọn ọkunrin wọnyi ti gbe oriṣa wọn si ọkàn wọn, nwọn si fi ohun ìdigbolu aiṣedede wọn siwaju wọn: emi o ha jẹ ki nwọn bere lọwọ mi rara bi?
entries.en: Son of man, these men have set up their idols in their heart, and put the stumblingblock of their iniquity before their face: should I be inquired of at all by them?

entries.yo: Nitorina sọ fun wọn, ki o si wi fun wọn pe, Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; olukuluku ọkunrin ile Israeli ti o gbe oriṣa rẹ̀ si ọkàn rẹ̀, ti o si fi ohun ìdugbolu aiṣedẽde rẹ̀ siwaju rẹ̀, ti o si wá sọdọ woli; emi Oluwa yio dá ẹniti o wá lohùn gẹgẹ bi ọpọlọpọ oriṣa rẹ̀.
entries.en: Therefore speak unto them, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Every man of the house of Israel that setteth up his idols in his heart, and putteth the stumblingblock of his iniquity before his face, and cometh to the prophet; I the LORD will answer him that cometh according to the multitude of his idols;

entries.yo: Ki emi ba le mu ile Israeli li ọkàn ara wọn, nitori gbogbo wọn di ajeji si mi nipasẹ oriṣa wọn.
entries.en: That I may take the house of Israel in their own heart, because they are all estranged from me through their idols.

entries.yo: Nitorina wi fun ile Israeli pe, Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Ẹ ronupiwada, ki ẹ si yipada kuro lọdọ oriṣa nyin, ki ẹ si yi oju nyin kuro ninu ohun ẽri nyin.
entries.en: Therefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Repent, and turn yourselves from your idols; and turn away your faces from all your abominations.

entries.yo: Nitori olukuluku ninu ile Israeli, tabi ninu alejo ti o ṣe atipo ni Israeli, ti o yà ara rẹ̀ kuro lọdọ mi, ti o si gbe oriṣa rẹ̀ si ọkàn rẹ̀, ti o si fi ohun ìdugbolu aiṣedẽde rẹ̀ siwaju rẹ̀, ti o si tọ̀ wolĩ kan wá lati bere lọwọ rẹ̀ niti emi: Emi Oluwa yio da a lohùn tikalami:
entries.en: For every one of the house of Israel, or of the stranger that sojourneth in Israel, which separateth himself from me, and setteth up his idols in his heart, and putteth the stumblingblock of his iniquity before his face, and cometh to a prophet to inquire of him concerning me; I the LORD will answer him by myself:

entries.yo: Emi o si dojukọ ọkunrin na, emi o si fi i ṣe àmi ati owe, emi o si ké e kuro lãrin awọn enia mi; ẹnyin o si mọ̀ pe, emi li Oluwa.
entries.en: And I will set my face against that man, and will make him a sign and a proverb, and I will cut him off from the midst of my people; and ye shall know that I am the LORD.

entries.yo: Bi a ba si tan wolĩ na jẹ nigbati o sọ ohun kan, Emi Oluwa ni mo ti tan wolĩ na jẹ, emi o si nawọ mi le e, emi o si run u kuro lãrin Israeli enia mi.
entries.en: And if the prophet be deceived when he hath spoken a thing, I the LORD have deceived that prophet, and I will stretch out my hand upon him, and will destroy him from the midst of my people Israel.

entries.yo: Awọn ni yio si rù ìya aiṣedẽde wọn; ìya wolĩ na yio ri gẹgẹ bi ìya ẹniti o bẽre lọdọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And they shall bear the punishment of their iniquity: the punishment of the prophet shall be even as the punishment of him that seeketh unto him;

entries.yo: Ki ile Israeli má ba ṣako lọ kuro lọdọ mi mọ, ki nwọn má ba fi gbogbo irekọja wọn bà ara wọn jẹ mọ, ṣugbọn ki nwọn ki o le jẹ enia mi, ki emi si le jẹ Ọlọrun wọn, ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi.
entries.en: That the house of Israel may go no more astray from me, neither be polluted any more with all their transgressions; but that they may be my people, and I may be their God, saith the Lord GOD.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ Oluwa si tun tọ̀ mi wá, wipe,
entries.en: The word of the LORD came again to me, saying,

entries.yo: Ọmọ enia, nigbati ilẹ na ba ṣẹ̀ si mi nipa irekọja buburu, nigbana ni emi o nawọ mi le e, emi o si ṣẹ́ ọpa onjẹ inu rẹ̀, emi o si rán ìyan si i, emi o si ke enia ati ẹranko kuro ninu rẹ̀:
entries.en: Son of man, when the land sinneth against me by trespassing grievously, then will I stretch out mine hand upon it, and will break the staff of the bread thereof, and will send famine upon it, and will cut off man and beast from it:

entries.yo: Bi awọn ọkunrin mẹta wọnyi, Noa, Danieli, ati Jobu tilẹ wà ninu rẹ̀, kiki ẹmi ara wọn ni nwọn o fi ododo wọn gbàla, li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi.
entries.en: Though these three men, Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, they should deliver but their own souls by their righteousness, saith the Lord GOD.

entries.yo: Bi mo ba jẹ ki ẹranko buburu kọja lãrin ilẹ na, ti nwọn si bà a jẹ, tobẹ̃ ti o di ahoro, ti ẹnikan kò le là a ja nitori awọn ẹranko na.
entries.en: If I cause noisome beasts to pass through the land, and they spoil it, so that it be desolate, that no man may pass through because of the beasts:

entries.yo: Bi awọn ọkunrin mẹta wọnyi tilẹ wà ninu rẹ̀, Oluwa Ọlọrun wipe, Bi mo ti wà, nwọn kì yio gbà ọmọkunrin tabi ọmọbinrin là; awọn nikan li a o gbàla, ṣugbọn ilẹ na yio di ahoro.
entries.en: Though these three men were in it, as I live, saith the Lord GOD, they shall deliver neither sons nor daughters; they only shall be delivered, but the land shall be desolate.

entries.yo: Tabi bi mo mu idà wá sori ilẹ na, ti mo si wipe, Idà, la ilẹ na ja; tobẹ̃ ti mo ke enia ati ẹranko kuro ninu rẹ̀:
entries.en: Or if I bring a sword upon that land, and say, Sword, go through the land; so that I cut off man and beast from it:

entries.yo: Bi awọn ọkunrin mẹta yi tilẹ wà ninu rẹ̀, Oluwa Ọlọrun wipe, Bi mo ti wà, nwọn kì yio gba ọmọkunrin tabi ọmọbinrin là, ṣugbọn awọn tikara wọn nikan li a o gbàla.
entries.en: Though these three men were in it, as I live, saith the Lord GOD, they shall deliver neither sons nor daughters, but they only shall be delivered themselves.

entries.yo: Tabi bi mo rán ajàkalẹ arùn si ilẹ na, ti mo si da irúnu mi le e ni ẹjẹ, lati ke enia ati ẹranko kuro ninu rẹ̀:
entries.en: Or if I send a pestilence into that land, and pour out my fury upon it in blood, to cut off from it man and beast:

entries.yo: Bi Noa, Danieli, ati Jobu tilẹ wà ninu rẹ̀, Oluwa Ọlọrun wipe, Bi mo ti wà, nwọn kì yio gba ọmọkunrin tabi ọmọbinrin là; kìki ọkàn ara wọn ni awọn o fi ododo wọn gbàla.
entries.en: Though Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, as I live, saith the Lord GOD, they shall deliver neither son nor daughter; they shall but deliver their own souls by their righteousness.

entries.yo: Nitori bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Melomelo ni nigbati mo ba rán awọn idajọ kikan mi mẹrẹrin sori Jerusalemu, idà, ati iyàn, ati ẹranko buburu, ati ajakalẹ àrun, lati ké enia ati ẹranko kuro ninu rẹ̀?
entries.en: For thus saith the Lord GOD; How much more when I send my four sore judgments upon Jerusalem, the sword, and the famine, and the noisome beast, and the pestilence, to cut off from it man and beast?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn kiye si i, ninu rẹ̀ li a o kù awọn ti a o yọ silẹ, ti a o mu jade wá, ati ọmọkunrin, ati ọmọbinrin, kiye si i, nwọn o jade tọ̀ nyin wá, ẹnyin o si ri ọ̀na wọn ati iṣe wọn, a o si tù nyin ninu niti ibi ti emi ti mu wá sori Jerusalemu, ani niti gbogbo ohun ti mo ti mu wá sori rẹ̀.
entries.en: Yet, behold, therein shall be left a remnant that shall be brought forth, both sons and daughters: behold, they shall come forth unto you, and ye shall see their way and their doings: and ye shall be comforted concerning the evil that I have brought upon Jerusalem, even concerning all that I have brought upon it.

entries.yo: Nwọn o si tù nyin ninu, nigbati ẹnyin ba ri ọ̀na wọn ati iṣe wọn: ẹnyin o si mọ̀ pe emi kò ṣe gbogbo ohun ti mo ti ṣe ninu rẹ̀ li ainidi, ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi.
entries.en: And they shall comfort you, when ye see their ways and their doings: and ye shall know that I have not done without cause all that I have done in it, saith the Lord GOD.

entries.yo: Ọ̀RỌ Oluwa si tọ̀ mi wá, wipe,
entries.en: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

entries.yo: Ọmọ enia, kini igi ajara fi ju igikigi lọ, tabi ju ẹka ti o wà lãrin igi igbo?
entries.en: Son of man, What is the vine tree more than any tree, or than a branch which is among the trees of the forest?

entries.yo: A ha le mu igi lara rẹ̀ ṣe iṣẹkiṣẹ? tabi enia le mu ẽkàn lara rẹ̀ lati fi ohunkohun kọ́ sori rẹ̀.
entries.en: Shall wood be taken thereof to do any work? or will men take a pin of it to hang any vessel thereon?

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, a jù u sinu iná bi igi, iná si jo ipẹkun rẹ̀ mejeji, ãrin rẹ̀ si jona. O ha yẹ fun iṣẹkiṣẹ bi?
entries.en: Behold, it is cast into the fire for fuel; the fire devoureth both the ends of it, and the midst of it is burned. Is it meet for any work?

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, nigbati o wà li odidi, kò yẹ fun iṣẹ kan: melomelo ni kì yio si yẹ fun iṣẹkiṣẹ, nigbati iná ba ti jo o, ti o si jona?
entries.en: Behold, when it was whole, it was meet for no work: how much less shall it be meet yet for any work, when the fire hath devoured it, and it is burned?

entries.yo: Nitorina bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Bi igi ajara lãrin igi igbó, ti mo ti fi fun iná bi igi, bẹ̃ni emi o fi ara Jerusalemu ṣe.
entries.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; As the vine tree among the trees of the forest, which I have given to the fire for fuel, so will I give the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Emi o si doju mi kọ wọn, nwọn o jade kuro ninu iná kan, iná miran yio si jo wọn, ẹnyin o si mọ̀ pe emi li Oluwa, nigbati mo ba dojukọ wọn.
entries.en: And I will set my face against them; they shall go out from one fire, and another fire shall devour them; and ye shall know that I am the LORD, when I set my face against them.

entries.yo: Emi o si sọ ilẹ na di ahoro, nitori ti nwọn ti dẹṣẹ, ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi.
entries.en: And I will make the land desolate, because they have committed a trespass, saith the Lord GOD.

entries.yo: Ọ̀RỌ Oluwa tún tọ̀ mi wá, wipe,
entries.en: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

entries.yo: Ọmọ enia, jẹ ki Jerusalemu mọ̀ ohun irira rẹ̀.
entries.en: Son of man, cause Jerusalem to know her abominations,

entries.yo: Si wipe, Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi si Jerusalemu; Ibi rẹ ati ilẹ ibi rẹ ni ati ilẹ Kenaani wá; ará Amori ni baba rẹ, ará Hiti si ni iyá rẹ.
entries.en: And say, Thus saith the Lord GOD unto Jerusalem; Thy birth and thy nativity is of the land of Canaan; thy father was an Amorite, and thy mother an Hittite.

entries.yo: Ati niti ìbi rẹ, a kò da ọ ni iwọ́ ni ijọ ti a bi ọ, bẹ̃ni a kò wẹ̀ ọ ninu omi lati mu ọ mọ́, a kò fi iyọ̀ pa ọ lara rara, bẹ̃ni a kò fi ọja wé ọ rara.
entries.en: And as for thy nativity, in the day thou wast born thy navel was not cut, neither wast thou washed in water to supple thee; thou wast not salted at all, nor swaddled at all.

entries.yo: Kò si oju ti o kãnu fun ọ, lati ṣe ọkan ninu nkan wọnyi fun ọ, lati ṣe iyọnu si ọ; ṣugbọn ninu igbẹ li a gbe ọ sọ si, fun ikorira ara rẹ, ni ijọ ti a bi ọ.
entries.en: None eye pitied thee, to do any of these unto thee, to have compassion upon thee; but thou wast cast out in the open field, to the lothing of thy person, in the day that thou wast born.

entries.yo: Nigbati mo si kọja lọdọ rẹ, ti mo si ri ọ, ti a tẹ̀ ọ mọlẹ ninu ẹjẹ ara rẹ, mo wi fun ọ nigbati iwọ wà ninu ẹjẹ rẹ pe, Yè: nitõtọ, mo wi fun ọ nigbati iwọ wà ninu ẹjẹ rẹ pe, Yè.
entries.en: And when I passed by thee, and saw thee polluted in thine own blood, I said unto thee when thou wast in thy blood, Live; yea, I said unto thee when thou wast in thy blood, Live.

entries.yo: Emi ti mu ọ bi si i bi irudi itàna ìgbẹ; iwọ si ti pọ̀ si i, o si ti di nla, iwọ si gbà ohun ọṣọ́ ti o ti inu ọṣọ́ wá: a ṣe ọmú rẹ yọ, irun rẹ si dagba, nigbati o jẹ pe iwọ ti wà nihoho ti o si wà goloto.
entries.en: I have caused thee to multiply as the bud of the field, and thou hast increased and waxen great, and thou art come to excellent ornaments: thy breasts are fashioned, and thine hair is grown, whereas thou wast naked and bare.

entries.yo: Nigbati mo si kọja lọdọ rẹ, ti mo si wò ọ; kiye si i, ìgba rẹ jẹ ìgba ifẹ; mo si nà aṣọ mi bò ọ, mo si bo ihoho rẹ: nitõtọ, mo bura fun ọ, mo si ba ọ da majẹmu, ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi, iwọ si di temi.
entries.en: Now when I passed by thee, and looked upon thee, behold, thy time was the time of love; and I spread my skirt over thee, and covered thy nakedness: yea, I sware unto thee, and entered into a covenant with thee, saith the Lord GOD, and thou becamest mine.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni mo fi omi wẹ̀ ọ; nitõtọ, mo wẹ ẹjẹ rẹ kuro lara rẹ patapata, mo si fi ororo kùn ọ lara.
entries.en: Then washed I thee with water; yea, I throughly washed away thy blood from thee, and I anointed thee with oil.

entries.yo: Mo wọ̀ ọ laṣọ oniṣẹ-ọnà pẹlu, mo si fi awọ̀ badgeri wọ̀ ọ ni bàta, mo si fi aṣọ ọ̀gbọ daradara di ọ ni amure yika, mo si fi aṣọ ṣẹ́dà bò ọ.
entries.en: I clothed thee also with broidered work, and shod thee with badgers' skin, and I girded thee about with fine linen, and I covered thee with silk.

entries.yo: Mo fi ohun-ọṣọ ṣe ọ lọṣọ pẹlu, mo si fi júfu bọ̀ ọ lọwọ, mo si fi ẹ̀wọn kọ́ ọ li ọrùn.
entries.en: I decked thee also with ornaments, and I put bracelets upon thy hands, and a chain on thy neck.

entries.yo: Mo si fi oruka si ọ ni imú, mo si fi oruka bọ̀ ọ leti, mo si fi ade daradara de ọ lori.
entries.en: And I put a jewel on thy forehead, and earrings in thine ears, and a beautiful crown upon thine head.

entries.yo: Bayi ni a fi wura ati fadaka ṣe ọ lọṣọ; aṣọ rẹ si jẹ ọgbọ̀ daradara, ati ṣẹ́dà, ati aṣọ oniṣẹ-ọnà; iwọ jẹ iyẹfun daradara ati oyin, ati ororo: iwọ si ni ẹwà gidigidi, iwọ si gbilẹ di ijọba kan.
entries.en: Thus wast thou decked with gold and silver; and thy raiment was of fine linen, and silk, and broidered work; thou didst eat fine flour, and honey, and oil: and thou wast exceeding beautiful, and thou didst prosper into a kingdom.

entries.yo: Okiki rẹ si kan lãrin awọn keferi nitori ẹwà rẹ: nitori iwọ pé nipa ẹwà mi, ti mo fi si ọ lara, ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi.
entries.en: And thy renown went forth among the heathen for thy beauty: for it was perfect through my comeliness, which I had put upon thee, saith the Lord GOD.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn iwọ gbẹkẹle ẹwà ara rẹ, o si huwa panṣaga nitori okìki rẹ, o si dà gbogbo agbere rẹ sori olukuluku ẹniti nkọja: tirẹ̀ ni.
entries.en: But thou didst trust in thine own beauty, and playedst the harlot because of thy renown, and pouredst out thy fornications on every one that passed by; his it was.

entries.yo: Iwọ si mu ninu ẹwù rẹ, iwọ si fi aṣọ alaràbarà ṣe ibi giga rẹ lọṣọ, o si hùwa panṣaga nibẹ: iru nkan bẹ̃ kì yio de, bẹ̃ni kì yio ri bẹ̃.
entries.en: And of thy garments thou didst take, and deckedst thy high places with divers colours, and playedst the harlot thereupon: the like things shall not come, neither shall it be so.

entries.yo: Iwọ si mu ohun ọṣọ́ ẹlẹwà rẹ ninu wura mi, ati ninu fadaka mi, ti mo ti fun ọ, iwọ si ṣe àworán ọkunrin fun ara rẹ, o si fi wọn ṣe panṣaga,
entries.en: Thou hast also taken thy fair jewels of my gold and of my silver, which I had given thee, and madest to thyself images of men, and didst commit whoredom with them,

entries.yo: Iwọ si mu ẹwù oniṣẹ-ọnà rẹ, o si fi bò wọn: iwọ si gbe ororo mi ati turari mi kalẹ niwaju wọn.
entries.en: And tookest thy broidered garments, and coveredst them: and thou hast set mine oil and mine incense before them.

entries.yo: Onjẹ mi pẹlu ti mo ti fun ọ, iyẹfun daradara, ati ororo, ati oyin, ti mo fi bọ́ ọ, iwọ tilẹ gbe e kalẹ niwaju wọn fun õrùn didùn: bayi li o si ri, ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi.
entries.en: My meat also which I gave thee, fine flour, and oil, and honey, wherewith I fed thee, thou hast even set it before them for a sweet savour: and thus it was, saith the Lord GOD.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu iwọ ti mu awọn ọmọ rẹ ọkunrin ati awọn ọmọ rẹ obinrin, ti iwọ ti bi fun mi, awọn wọnyi ni iwọ si ti fi rubọ si wọn lati jẹ. Ohun kekere ha ni eyi ninu ìwa panṣaga rẹ,
entries.en: Moreover thou hast taken thy sons and thy daughters, whom thou hast borne unto me, and these hast thou sacrificed unto them to be devoured. Is this of thy whoredoms a small matter,

entries.yo: Ti iwọ ti pa awọn ọmọ mi, ti o si fi wọn fun ni lati mu wọn kọja lãrin iná fun wọn?
entries.en: That thou hast slain my children, and delivered them to cause them to pass through the fire for them?

entries.yo: Ati ni gbogbo ohun irira rẹ, ati panṣaga rẹ, iwọ kò ranti ọjọ ewe rẹ, nigbati iwọ wà nihoho ti o si wà goloto, ti a si bà ọ jẹ ninu ẹjẹ rẹ.
entries.en: And in all thine abominations and thy whoredoms thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth, when thou wast naked and bare, and wast polluted in thy blood.

entries.yo: O si ṣe lẹhin gbogbo ìwa buburu rẹ, (Egbe, egbe ni fun ọ! ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi;)
entries.en: And it came to pass after all thy wickedness, (woe, woe unto thee! saith the Lord GOD;)

entries.yo: Ti iwọ si kọ́ ile giga fun ara rẹ, ti iwọ si ṣe ibi giga ni gbogbo ita fun ara rẹ.
entries.en: That thou hast also built unto thee an eminent place, and hast made thee an high place in every street.

entries.yo: Iwọ ti kọ́ ibi giga rẹ ni gbogbo ikórita, o si ti sọ ẹwà rẹ di ikorira, o si ti ya ẹsẹ rẹ si gbogbo awọn ti nkọja, o si sọ panṣaga rẹ di pupọ.
entries.en: Thou hast built thy high place at every head of the way, and hast made thy beauty to be abhorred, and hast opened thy feet to every one that passed by, and multiplied thy whoredoms.

entries.yo: Iwọ ti ba awọn ara Egipti aladugbo rẹ, ti o sanra ṣe agbere, o si ti sọ panṣaga rẹ di pupọ, lati mu mi binu.
entries.en: Thou hast also committed fornication with the Egyptians thy neighbours, great of flesh; and hast increased thy whoredoms, to provoke me to anger.

entries.yo: Kiye si i, emi si ti nawọ mi le ọ lori, mo si ti bu onjẹ rẹ kù, mo si fi ọ fun ifẹ awọn ti o korira rẹ, awọn ọmọbinrin Filistia, ti ìwa ifẹkufẹ rẹ tì loju.
entries.en: Behold, therefore I have stretched out my hand over thee, and have diminished thine ordinary food, and delivered thee unto the will of them that hate thee, the daughters of the Philistines, which are ashamed of thy lewd way.

entries.yo: Iwọ ti ba awọn ara Assiria ṣe panṣaga pẹlu, nitori iwọ kò ni itẹlọrun; nitotọ, iwọ ti ba wọn ṣe panṣaga, sibẹsibẹ kò si le tẹ́ ọ lọrùn,
entries.en: Thou hast played the whore also with the Assyrians, because thou wast unsatiable; yea, thou hast played the harlot with them, and yet couldest not be satisfied.

entries.yo: Iwọ si ti sọ agbere rẹ di pupọ lati ilẹ Kenaani de Kaldea; sibẹsibẹ eyi kò si tẹ́ ọ lọrun nihinyi.
entries.en: Thou hast moreover multiplied thy fornication in the land of Canaan unto Chaldea; and yet thou wast not satisfied herewith.

entries.yo: Oluwa Ọlọrun wipe, aiyà rẹ ti ṣe alailera to, ti iwọ nṣe nkan wọnyi, iṣe agídi panṣaga obinrin;
entries.en: How weak is thine heart, saith the Lord GOD, seeing thou doest all these things, the work of an imperious whorish woman;

entries.yo: Nitipe iwọ kọ́ ile giga rẹ ni gbogbo ikoríta, ti o si ṣe ibi giga rẹ ni gbogbo ita; iwọ kò si wa dabi panṣaga obinrin, nitipe iwọ gan ọ̀ya.
entries.en: In that thou buildest thine eminent place in the head of every way, and makest thine high place in every street; and hast not been as an harlot, in that thou scornest hire;

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn gẹgẹ bi aya ti o ṣe panṣaga, ti o gbà alejo dipo ọkọ rẹ̀!
entries.en: But as a wife that committeth adultery, which taketh strangers instead of her husband!

entries.yo: Nwọn nfi ẹbùn fun gbogbo awọn panṣaga, ṣugbọn iwọ fi ẹbùn rẹ fun gbogbo awọn olufẹ rẹ, iwọ si ta wọn lọrẹ, ki nwọn le tọ̀ ọ wá ni ihà gbogbo fun panṣaga rẹ.
entries.en: They give gifts to all whores: but thou givest thy gifts to all thy lovers, and hirest them, that they may come unto thee on every side for thy whoredom.

entries.yo: Eyiti o yatọ si ti awọn obinrin miran si mbẹ ninu rẹ, ninu panṣaga rẹ, ti ẹnikan kò tẹ̀le ọ lati ṣe panṣaga: ati nitipe iwọ ntọrẹ, ti a kò si tọrẹ fun ọ nitorina iwọ yatọ.
entries.en: And the contrary is in thee from other women in thy whoredoms, whereas none followeth thee to commit whoredoms: and in that thou givest a reward, and no reward is given unto thee, therefore thou art contrary.

entries.yo: Nitorina, iwọ panṣaga, gbọ́ ọ̀rọ Oluwa:
entries.en: Wherefore, O harlot, hear the word of the LORD:

entries.yo: Bayi ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Nitoriti a dà ẹgbin rẹ jade, ti a si ri ihoho rẹ nipa panṣaga rẹ pẹlu awọn olufẹ rẹ, ati pẹlu gbogbo oriṣa irira rẹ, ati nipa ẹjẹ awọn ọmọ rẹ, ti iwọ fi fun wọn:
entries.en: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thy filthiness was poured out, and thy nakedness discovered through thy whoredoms with thy lovers, and with all the idols of thy abominations, and by the blood of thy children, which thou didst give unto them;

entries.yo: Si kiye si i, Emi o kó gbogbo awọn olufẹ rẹ jọ, awọn ẹniti iwọ ti ba jaiye, ati gbogbo awọn ti iwọ ti fẹ, pẹlu gbogbo awọn ti iwọ ti korira; ani emi o gbá wọn jọ kakiri si ọ, emi o si fi ihoho rẹ hàn wọn, ki nwọn ki o le ri gbogbo ihoho rẹ.
entries.en: Behold, therefore I will gather all thy lovers, with whom thou hast taken pleasure, and all them that thou hast loved, with all them that thou hast hated; I will even gather them round about against thee, and will discover thy nakedness unto them, that they may see all thy nakedness.

entries.yo: Emi o si dá ọ lẹjọ, gẹgẹ bi a ti da awọn obinrin lẹjọ ti o ba igbeyawo jẹ ti nwọn si ta ẹjẹ silẹ; emi o si fi ẹjẹ fun ọ, ni irúnu ati ni ijowu.
entries.en: And I will judge thee, as women that break wedlock and shed blood are judged; and I will give thee blood in fury and jealousy.

entries.yo: Emi o si fi ọ le wọn lọwọ pẹlu, nwọn o si wo ibi giga rẹ, nwọn o si wo ibi giga rẹ palẹ: nwọn o si bọ aṣọ rẹ pẹlu, nwọn o si gbà ohun ọṣọ rẹ didara, nwọn o si fi ọ silẹ ni ihoho, ati ni goloto.
entries.en: And I will also give thee into their hand, and they shall throw down thine eminent place, and shall break down thy high places: they shall strip thee also of thy clothes, and shall take thy fair jewels, and leave thee naked and bare.

entries.yo: Nwọn o mu ẹgbẹ́ kan wá si ọ pẹlu, nwọn o si sọ ọ li okuta, nwọn o si fi idà wọn gún ọ yọ.
entries.en: They shall also bring up a company against thee, and they shall stone thee with stones, and thrust thee through with their swords.

entries.yo: Nwọn o si fi iná kun gbogbo ile rẹ; nwọn o si mu idajọ ṣẹ si ọ lara niwaju obinrin pupọ; emi o si jẹ ki o fi panṣaga rẹ mọ, iwọ pẹlu kì yio si funni ni ọ̀ya mọ.
entries.en: And they shall burn thine houses with fire, and execute judgments upon thee in the sight of many women: and I will cause thee to cease from playing the harlot, and thou also shalt give no hire any more.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni emi o jẹ ki irúnu mi si ọ ki o dá, owú mi yio si kuro lọdọ rẹ, emi o si dakẹjẹ, emi kì yio binu mọ.
entries.en: So will I make my fury toward thee to rest, and my jealousy shall depart from thee, and I will be quiet, and will be no more angry.

entries.yo: Nitoripe iwọ kò ranti ọjọ ewe rẹ, ṣugbọn o si mu mi kanra ninu gbogbo nkan wọnyi; si kiye si i, nitorina emi pẹlu o san ẹsan ọ̀na rẹ si ọ lori, ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi: iwọ kì yio si ṣe ifẹkufẹ yi lori gbogbo ohun irira rẹ mọ.
entries.en: Because thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth, but hast fretted me in all these things; behold, therefore I also will recompense thy way upon thine head, saith the Lord GOD: and thou shalt not commit this lewdness above all thine abominations.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, olukuluku ẹniti npowe ni yio powe yi si ọ, wipe, Bi iyá ti ri, bẹ̃ni ọmọ rẹ̀ obinrin.
entries.en: Behold, every one that useth proverbs shall use this proverb against thee, saying, As is the mother, so is her daughter.

entries.yo: Iwọ ni ọmọ iyá rẹ ti o kọ̀ ọkọ rẹ̀, ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀; iwọ ni arabinrin awọn arabinrin rẹ, ti o kọ̀ awọn ọkọ wọn ati awọn ọmọ wọn: ará Hiti ni iyá rẹ, ará Amori si ni baba rẹ.
entries.en: Thou art thy mother's daughter, that lotheth her husband and her children; and thou art the sister of thy sisters, which lothed their husbands and their children: your mother was an Hittite, and your father an Amorite.

entries.yo: Ẹgbọn rẹ obinrin si ni Samaria, on ati awọn ọmọbinrin rẹ ti ngbe ọwọ́ osì rẹ: ati aburo rẹ obinrin ti ngbe ọwọ́ ọ̀tun rẹ ni Sodomu ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ obinrin.
entries.en: And thine elder sister is Samaria, she and her daughters that dwell at thy left hand: and thy younger sister, that dwelleth at thy right hand, is Sodom and her daughters.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn iwọ kò rin ni ọ̀na wọn, iwọ kò si ṣe gẹgẹ bi irira wọn: ṣugbọn, bi ẹnipe ohun kekere ni eyini, iwọ bajẹ jù wọn lọ ni gbogbo ọ̀na rẹ.
entries.en: Yet hast thou not walked after their ways, nor done after their abominations: but, as if that were a very little thing, thou wast corrupted more than they in all thy ways.

entries.yo: Oluwa Ọlọrun wipe, Bi mo ti wà, Sodomu arabinrin rẹ, on, tabi awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ obinrin kò ṣe gẹgẹ bi iwọ ti ṣe, iwọ ati awọn ọmọ rẹ obinrin.
entries.en: As I live, saith the Lord GOD, Sodom thy sister hath not done, she nor her daughters, as thou hast done, thou and thy daughters.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, ẹ̀ṣẹ Sodomu arabinrin rẹ niyi, irera, onjẹ ajẹyo, ati ọ̀pọlọpọ orayè wà ninu rẹ̀, ati ninu awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ obinrin; bẹ̃ni on kò mu ọwọ́ talaka ati alaini lokun.
entries.en: Behold, this was the iniquity of thy sister Sodom, pride, fulness of bread, and abundance of idleness was in her and in her daughters, neither did she strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.

entries.yo: Nwọn si gberaga, nwọn si ṣe ohun irira niwaju mi: nitorina ni mo mu wọn kuro gẹgẹ bi mo ti ri pe o dara.
entries.en: And they were haughty, and committed abomination before me: therefore I took them away as I saw good.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Samaria kò dá abọ̀ ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ: ṣugbọn iwọ sọ ohun irira rẹ di pupọ jù wọn lọ, o si ti da awọn arabinrin rẹ lare ninu gbogbo ohun irira rẹ ti iwọ ti ṣe.
entries.en: Neither hath Samaria committed half of thy sins; but thou hast multiplied thine abominations more than they, and hast justified thy sisters in all thine abominations which thou hast done.

entries.yo: Iwọ pẹlu, ti o ti da awọn arabinrin rẹ lẹbi, ru itiju ara rẹ, nitori ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ ti iwọ ti ṣe ni iṣe irira jù wọn lọ: awọn ṣe olododo jù iwọ lọ; nitotọ, ki iwọ ki o dãmu pẹlu, si ru itiju rẹ, nitipe iwọ dá awọn arabinrin rẹ lare.
entries.en: Thou also, which hast judged thy sisters, bear thine own shame for thy sins that thou hast committed more abominable than they: they are more righteous than thou: yea, be thou confounded also, and bear thy shame, in that thou hast justified thy sisters.

entries.yo: Nigbati mo ba tun mu igbèkun wọn wá, igbèkun Sodomu ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ obinrin, pẹlu igbèkun Samaria ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ obinrin, nigbana li emi o tun mu igbèkun awọn onde rẹ wá lãrin wọn:
entries.en: When I shall bring again their captivity, the captivity of Sodom and her daughters, and the captivity of Samaria and her daughters, then will I bring again the captivity of thy captives in the midst of them:

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o le ru itiju ara rẹ, ki o si le dãmu ni gbogbo eyi ti o ti ṣe, nitipe iwọ jẹ itunu fun wọn.
entries.en: That thou mayest bear thine own shame, and mayest be confounded in all that thou hast done, in that thou art a comfort unto them.

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn arabinrin rẹ Sodomu, ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ obinrin, ba pada si ipò wọn iṣaju, ti Samaria ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ obinrin ba pada si ipò wọn iṣaju, nigbana ni iwọ ati awọn ọmọ rẹ obinrin yio pada si ipò nyin iṣaju.
entries.en: When thy sisters, Sodom and her daughters, shall return to their former estate, and Samaria and her daughters shall return to their former estate, then thou and thy daughters shall return to your former estate.

entries.yo: Nitori ẹnu rẹ kò da orukọ Sodomu arabinrin rẹ li ọjọ irera rẹ,
entries.en: For thy sister Sodom was not mentioned by thy mouth in the day of thy pride,

entries.yo: Ki a to ri ìwa buburu rẹ, bi akoko ti awọn ọmọbinrin Siria gàn ọ, ati gbogbo awọn ti o wà yi i ka, awọn ọmọbinrin Filistia ti o gàn ọ ka kiri.
entries.en: Before thy wickedness was discovered, as at the time of thy reproach of the daughters of Syria, and all that are round about her, the daughters of the Philistines, which despise thee round about.

entries.yo: Iwọ ti ru ifẹkufẹ rẹ ati ohun irira rẹ, ni Oluwa wi.
entries.en: Thou hast borne thy lewdness and thine abominations, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Nitori bayi ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Emi o tilẹ ba ọ lò gẹgẹ bi iwọ ti ṣe, ti iwọ ti gàn ibura nipa biba majẹmu jẹ.
entries.en: For thus saith the Lord GOD; I will even deal with thee as thou hast done, which hast despised the oath in breaking the covenant.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi o ranti majẹmu mi pẹlu rẹ, ni ọjọ ewe rẹ, emi o si gbe majẹmu aiyeraiye kalẹ fun ọ.
entries.en: Nevertheless I will remember my covenant with thee in the days of thy youth, and I will establish unto thee an everlasting covenant.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si ranti ọ̀na rẹ, oju o si tì ọ, nigbati iwọ ba gba awọn arabinrin rẹ, ẹgbọ́n rẹ ati aburò rẹ: emi o si fi wọn fun ọ bi ọmọbinrin, ṣugbọn ki iṣe nipa majẹmu rẹ.
entries.en: Then thou shalt remember thy ways, and be ashamed, when thou shalt receive thy sisters, thine elder and thy younger: and I will give them unto thee for daughters, but not by thy covenant.

entries.yo: Emi o si gbe majẹmu mi kalẹ pẹlu rẹ; iwọ o si mọ̀ pe emi li Oluwa.
entries.en: And I will establish my covenant with thee; and thou shalt know that I am the LORD:

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o le ranti, ki o si le dãmu, ki iwọ ki o má si le yà ẹnu rẹ mọ nitori itiju rẹ, nigbati inu mi ba tutù si ọ, nitori ohun ti iwọ ti ṣe, ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi.
entries.en: That thou mayest remember, and be confounded, and never open thy mouth any more because of thy shame, when I am pacified toward thee for all that thou hast done, saith the Lord GOD.

entries.yo: Ọ̀RỌ Oluwa si tọ̀ mi wá, wipe,
entries.en: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

entries.yo: Ọmọ enia, pa alọ́ kan, si pa owe kan fun ile Israeli;
entries.en: Son of man, put forth a riddle, and speak a parable unto the house of Israel;

entries.yo: Si wipe, Bayi ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Idì nla kan, pẹlu apá nla, alapá gigùn, o kún fun iyẹ́; ti o ni àwọ alaràbarà wá si Lebanoni, o si mu ẹka igi Kedari ti o ga julọ.
entries.en: And say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; A great eagle with great wings, longwinged, full of feathers, which had divers colours, came unto Lebanon, and took the highest branch of the cedar:

entries.yo: O ke ori ọ̀munú ẹka rẹ̀ kuro, o si mu u lọ si ilẹ òwo kan; o gbe e kalẹ ni ilu awọn oniṣòwo.
entries.en: He cropped off the top of his young twigs, and carried it into a land of traffick; he set it in a city of merchants.

entries.yo: O mu ninu irugbìn ilẹ na pẹlu, o si gbìn i sinu oko daradara kan; o fi si ibi omi nla, o si gbe e kalẹ bi igi willo.
entries.en: He took also of the seed of the land, and planted it in a fruitful field; he placed it by great waters, and set it as a willow tree.

entries.yo: O si dagba, o si di igi àjara ti o bò ti o kuru, ẹka ẹniti o tẹ̀ sọdọ rẹ̀, gbòngbo rẹ̀ si wà labẹ rẹ̀; bẹ̃ni o di ajara, o si pa ẹka, o si yọ ọ̀munú jade.
entries.en: And it grew, and became a spreading vine of low stature, whose branches turned toward him, and the roots thereof were under him: so it became a vine, and brought forth branches, and shot forth sprigs.

entries.yo: Idì nla miran si wà pẹlu apá nla ati iyẹ́ pupọ: si kiye si i, àjara yi tẹ̀ gbòngbo rẹ̀ sọdọ rẹ̀, o si yọ ẹka rẹ̀ sọdọ rẹ̀, ki o le ma b'omi si i ninu aporo ọgbà rẹ̀.
entries.en: There was also another great eagle with great wings and many feathers: and, behold, this vine did bend her roots toward him, and shot forth her branches toward him, that he might water it by the furrows of her plantation.

entries.yo: Ilẹ rere lẹba omi nla ni a gbìn i si, ki o le bà yọ ẹka jade, ki o si le so eso, ki o le jẹ́ àjara rere.
entries.en: It was planted in a good soil by great waters, that it might bring forth branches, and that it might bear fruit, that it might be a goodly vine.

entries.yo: Wipe, Bayi ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; yio ha gbà? on kì yio hú gbòngbo rẹ̀, kì yio si ka eso rẹ̀ kuro, ki o le rọ? yio rọ ninu gbogbo ewe rirú rẹ̀, ani laisi agbara nla tabi enia pupọ̀ lati fà a tu pẹlu gbòngbo rẹ̀.
entries.en: Say thou, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Shall it prosper? shall he not pull up the roots thereof, and cut off the fruit thereof, that it wither? it shall wither in all the leaves of her spring, even without great power or many people to pluck it up by the roots thereof.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ, kiye si i, bi a ti gbìn i yi, yio ha gbà? kì yio ha rẹ̀ patapata? nigbati afẹfẹ ilà-õrun ba kàn a? yio rẹ̀ ninu aporo ti o ti hù.
entries.en: Yea, behold, being planted, shall it prosper? shall it not utterly wither, when the east wind toucheth it? it shall wither in the furrows where it grew.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ Oluwa si tọ̀ mi wá, wipe,
entries.en: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

entries.yo: Sọ nisisiyi fun ọlọ̀tẹ ile na pe, Ẹnyin kò mọ̀ ohun ti nkan wọnyi jasi? Sọ fun wọn, kiyesi i, ọba Babiloni de Jerusalemu, o si ti mu ọba ibẹ ati awọn ọmọ-alade ibẹ, o si mu wọn pẹlu rẹ̀ lọ si Babiloni:
entries.en: Say now to the rebellious house, Know ye not what these things mean? tell them, Behold, the king of Babylon is come to Jerusalem, and hath taken the king thereof, and the princes thereof, and led them with him to Babylon;

entries.yo: O si ti mu ninu iru-ọmọ ọba, o si bá a dá majẹmu, o si ti mu u bura: o si mu awọn alagbara ilẹ na pẹlu:
entries.en: And hath taken of the king's seed, and made a covenant with him, and hath taken an oath of him: he hath also taken the mighty of the land:

entries.yo: Ki ijọba na le jẹ alailọla, ki o má le gbe ara rẹ̀ soke, ki o le duro nipa pipa majẹmu rẹ̀ mọ.
entries.en: That the kingdom might be base, that it might not lift itself up, but that by keeping of his covenant it might stand.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn on ṣọ̀tẹ si i ni rirán awọn ikọ̀ rẹ̀ lọ si Egipti, ki nwọn ki o le fi ẹṣin fun u ati enia pupọ. Yio ha sàn a? ẹniti nṣe iru nkan wọnyi yio ha bọ́? tabi yio dalẹ tan ki o si bọ́?
entries.en: But he rebelled against him in sending his ambassadors into Egypt, that they might give him horses and much people. Shall he prosper? shall he escape that doeth such things? or shall he break the covenant, and be delivered?

entries.yo: Oluwa Ọlọrun wipe, Bi mo ti wà, nitotọ ibi ti ọba ngbe ti o fi i jọba, ibura ẹniti o gàn, majẹmu ẹniti o si bajẹ, ani lọdọ rẹ̀ lãrin Babiloni ni yio kú.
entries.en: As I live, saith the Lord GOD, surely in the place where the king dwelleth that made him king, whose oath he despised, and whose covenant he brake, even with him in the midst of Babylon he shall die.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Farao ti on ti ogun rẹ̀ ti o li agbara ati ẹgbẹ́ nla kì yio ṣe fun u ninu ogun, nipa mimọ odi, ati kikọle iṣọ́ ti o li agbara, lati ke enia pupọ̀ kuro:
entries.en: Neither shall Pharaoh with his mighty army and great company make for him in the war, by casting up mounts, and building forts, to cut off many persons:

entries.yo: Nitoriti o gàn ibura nipa didalẹ, kiye si i, o ti fi ọwọ́ rẹ̀ fun ni, o si ti ṣe gbogbo nkan wọnyi, kì yio bọ́.
entries.en: Seeing he despised the oath by breaking the covenant, when, lo, he had given his hand, and hath done all these things, he shall not escape.

entries.yo: Nitorina bayi ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Bi mo ti wà, dajudaju ibura mi ti o ti gàn, ati majẹmu mi ti o ti dà, ani on li emi o san si ori on tikalarẹ̀.
entries.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; As I live, surely mine oath that he hath despised, and my covenant that he hath broken, even it will I recompense upon his own head.

entries.yo: Emi o si nà àwọn mi si i lori, a o si mu u ninu ẹgẹ́ mi; emi o si mu u de Babiloni, emi o si ba a rojọ nibẹ, nitori ẹ̀ṣẹ ti o ti da si mi.
entries.en: And I will spread my net upon him, and he shall be taken in my snare, and I will bring him to Babylon, and will plead with him there for his trespass that he hath trespassed against me.

entries.yo: Ati gbogbo awọn isánsa rẹ̀ pẹlu gbogbo awọn ẹgbẹ́-ogun rẹ̀, ni yio ti oju idà ṣubu; awọn ti o si kù ni a o tuka si gbogbo ẹfũfu: ẹnyin o si mọ̀ pe emi Oluwa li o ti sọ ọ.
entries.en: And all his fugitives with all his bands shall fall by the sword, and they that remain shall be scattered toward all winds: and ye shall know that I the LORD have spoken it.

entries.yo: Bayi ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; emi o mu ninu ẹka ti o ga jùlọ, ninu igi Kedari giga; emi o si lọ́ ọ, emi o ke ọ̀munú ẹka kan kuro ninu ọ̀munú ẹka rẹ̀; emi o si gbìn i sori oke giga kan ti o si hàn:
entries.en: Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will also take of the highest branch of the high cedar, and will set it; I will crop off from the top of his young twigs a tender one, and will plant it upon an high mountain and eminent:

entries.yo: Lori oke giga ti Israeli ni emi o gbìn i si, yio si yọ ẹka; yio si so eso, yio si jẹ igi Kedari daradara; labẹ rẹ̀ ni gbogbo ẹiyẹ oniruru iyẹ́ o si gbe; ninu ojiji ẹka rẹ̀ ni nwọn o gbe.
entries.en: In the mountain of the height of Israel will I plant it: and it shall bring forth boughs, and bear fruit, and be a goodly cedar: and under it shall dwell all fowl of every wing; in the shadow of the branches thereof shall they dwell.

entries.yo: Gbogbo igi inu igbẹ ni yio si mọ̀ pe, emi Oluwa li o ti mu igi giga walẹ, ti mo ti gbe igi rirẹlẹ soke, ti mo ti mu igi tutù gbẹ, ti mo si ti mu igi gbigbẹ ruwé: emi Oluwa li o ti sọ ti mo si ti ṣe e.
entries.en: And all the trees of the field shall know that I the LORD have brought down the high tree, have exalted the low tree, have dried up the green tree, and have made the dry tree to flourish: I the LORD have brought down the high tree, have exalted the low tree, have dried up the green tree, and have made the dry tree to flourish: I the LORD have spoken and have done it.

entries.yo: Ọ̀RỌ Oluwa tun tọ̀ mi wá, wipe,
entries.en: The word of the LORD came unto me again, saying,

entries.yo: Kini ẹnyin rò ti ẹnyin fi npowe yi niti ilẹ Israeli, pe, Awọn baba ti jẹ eso àjara kíkan, ehin awọn ọmọ si kan.
entries.en: What mean ye, that ye use this proverb concerning the land of Israel, saying, The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children's teeth are set on edge?

entries.yo: Oluwa Ọlọrun wipe, bi mo ti wà, ẹnyin kì yio ri àye lati powe yi mọ ni ilẹ Israeli.
entries.en: As I live, saith the Lord GOD, ye shall not have occasion any more to use this proverb in Israel.

entries.yo: Kiye si i, gbogbo ọkàn ni t'emi; gẹgẹ bi ọkàn baba ti jẹ t'emi, bẹ̃ni t'emi ni ọkàn ọmọ pẹlu; ọkàn ti o bá ṣẹ̀, on o kú.
entries.en: Behold, all souls are mine; as the soul of the father, so also the soul of the son is mine: the soul that sinneth, it shall die.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi enia kan ba ṣe olõtọ, ti o si ṣe eyiti o tọ ati eyiti o yẹ,
entries.en: But if a man be just, and do that which is lawful and right,

entries.yo: Ti kò si jẹun lori oke, ti kò si gbe oju rẹ̀ soke si awọn oriṣa ile Israeli, ti kò si bà obinrin aladugbo rẹ̀ jẹ, ti kò sì sunmọ obinrin ti o wà ninu aimọ́ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And hath not eaten upon the mountains, neither hath lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, neither hath defiled his neighbour's wife, neither hath come near to a menstruous woman,

entries.yo: Ti kò si ni ẹnikan lara, ṣugbọn ti o ti fi ohun ògo onigbèse fun u, ti kò fi agbara kó ẹnikẹni, ti o ti fi onjẹ rẹ̀ fun ẹniti ebi npa, ti o si ti fi ẹwu bo ẹni-ihoho.
entries.en: And hath not oppressed any, but hath restored to the debtor his pledge, hath spoiled none by violence, hath given his bread to the hungry, and hath covered the naked with a garment;

entries.yo: Ẹniti kò fi fun ni lati gba ẹdá, bẹ̃ni kò gba elékele, ti o ti fa ọwọ́ rẹ̀ kuro ninu aiṣedẽde, ti o ti mu idajọ otitọ ṣẹ lãrin ọkunrin ati ọkunrin,
entries.en: He that hath not given forth upon usury, neither hath taken any increase, that hath withdrawn his hand from iniquity, hath executed true judgment between man and man,

entries.yo: Ti o ti rìn ninu aṣẹ mi, ti o si ti pa idajọ mi mọ, lati hùwa titọ́; on ṣe olõtọ, yiyè ni yio yè, ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi.
entries.en: Hath walked in my statutes, and hath kept my judgments, to deal truly; he is just, he shall surely live, saith the Lord GOD.

entries.yo: Bi o ba bi ọmọkunrin kan ti iṣe ọlọṣà, oluta ẹ̀jẹ silẹ, ti o si nṣe ohun ti o jọ ọkan ninu nkan wọnyi si arakunrin rẹ̀.
entries.en: If he beget a son that is a robber, a shedder of blood, and that doeth the like to any one of these things,

entries.yo: Ti kò si ṣe ọkan ninu gbogbo iṣẹ wọnni, ṣugbọn ti o tilẹ ti jẹun lori oke, ti o si ba obinrin aladugbo rẹ̀ jẹ,
entries.en: And that doeth not any of those duties, but even hath eaten upon the mountains, and defiled his neighbour's wife,

entries.yo: Ti o ti ni talaka ati alaini lara; ti o ti fi agbara koni, ti kò mu ohun ògo pada, ti o ti gbe oju rẹ̀ soke si oriṣa, ti o ti ṣe ohun irira,
entries.en: Hath oppressed the poor and needy, hath spoiled by violence, hath not restored the pledge, and hath lifted up his eyes to the idols, hath committed abomination,

entries.yo: Ti o ti fi fun ni lati gba ẹdá, ti o si ti gba èle: on o ha yè bẹ̃? on ki yio yè: on ti ṣe gbogbo ohun irira wọnyi; kikú ni yio kú: ẹjẹ rẹ̀ yio wà lori rẹ̀.
entries.en: Hath given forth upon usury, and hath taken increase: shall he then live? he shall not live: he hath done all these abominations; he shall surely die; his blood shall be upon him.

entries.yo: Si kiye si i, bi o ba bi ọmọkunrin ti o ri gbogbo ẹ̀ṣẹ baba rẹ̀ ti o ti ṣe, ti o si bẹ̀ru, ti kò si ṣe iru rẹ̀,
entries.en: Now, lo, if he beget a son, that seeth all his father's sins which he hath done, and considereth, and doeth not such like,

entries.yo: Ti kò si jẹun lori oke, ti kò gbe oju rẹ̀ soke si oriṣa ile Israeli, ti kò ba obinrin aladugbo rẹ̀ jẹ,
entries.en: That hath not eaten upon the mountains, neither hath lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, hath not defiled his neighbour's wife,

entries.yo: Ti kò ni ẹnikan lara, ti kò dá ohun ògo duro, ti kò fi agbara koni, ṣugbọn ti o ti fi onjẹ rẹ̀ fun ẹniti ebi npa, ti o si ti fi ẹ̀wu bo ẹni-ihoho,
entries.en: Neither hath oppressed any, hath not withholden the pledge, neither hath spoiled by violence, but hath given his bread to the hungry, and hath covered the naked with a garment,

entries.yo: Ti o ti mu ọwọ́ rẹ̀ kuro lara ẹni-inilara, ti kò ti gba ẹdá tabi elé ti o ti mu idajọ mi ṣẹ, ti o ti rìn ninu aṣẹ mi; on kì yio kú nitori aiṣedẽde baba rẹ̀, yiyè ni yio yè.
entries.en: That hath taken off his hand from the poor, that hath not received usury nor increase, hath executed my judgments, hath walked in my statutes; he shall not die for the iniquity of his father, he shall surely live.

entries.yo: Bi o ṣe ti baba rẹ̀, nitoripe o fi ikà ninilara, ti o fi agbara ko arakunrin rẹ̀; ti o ṣe eyiti kò dara lãrin enia rẹ̀, kiye si i, on o tilẹ kú ninu aiṣedẽde rẹ̀.
entries.en: As for his father, because he cruelly oppressed, spoiled his brother by violence, and did that which is not good among his people, lo, even he shall die in his iniquity.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹnyin wipe, Ẽṣe? ọmọ kò ha ru aiṣedẽde baba? Nigbati ọmọ ti ṣe eyiti o tọ́ ati eyiti o yẹ, ti o si ti pa gbogbo aṣẹ mi mọ, ti o si ti ṣe wọn, yiyè ni yio yè.
entries.en: Yet say ye, Why? doth not the son bear the iniquity of the father? When the son hath done that which is lawful and right, and hath kept all my statutes, and hath done them, he shall surely live.

entries.yo: Ọkàn ti o ba ṣẹ̀, on o kú. Ọmọ kì yio rù aiṣedẽde baba, bẹ̃ni baba kì yio rù aiṣedẽde ọmọ: ododo olododo yio wà lori rẹ̀, ìwa buburu enia buburu yio si wà lori rẹ̀.
entries.en: The soul that sinneth, it shall die. The son shall not bear the iniquity of the father, neither shall the father bear the iniquity of the son: the righteousness of the righteous shall be upon him, and the wickedness of the wicked shall be upon him.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi enia buburu yio ba yipada kuro ninu gbogbo ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ̀ ti o ti da, ti o si pa gbogbo aṣẹ mi mọ, ti o si ṣe eyi ti o tọ́, ati eyiti o yẹ, yiyè ni yio yè, on kì yio kú.
entries.en: But if the wicked will turn from all his sins that he hath committed, and keep all my statutes, and do that which is lawful and right, he shall surely live, he shall not die.

entries.yo: Gbogbo irekọja rẹ̀ ti o ti ṣe, a kì yio ranti wọn si i: ninu ododo rẹ̀ ti o ti ṣe ni on o yè.
entries.en: All his transgressions that he hath committed, they shall not be mentioned unto him: in his righteousness that he hath done he shall live.

entries.yo: Emi ha ni inu-didùn rara pe ki enia buburu ki o kú? ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi: kò ṣepe ki o yipada kuro ninu ọ̀na rẹ̀, ki o si yè?
entries.en: Have I any pleasure at all that the wicked should die? saith the Lord GOD: and not that he should return from his ways, and live?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati olododo ba yipada kuro ninu ododo rẹ̀, ti o si huwà aiṣedede, ti o si ṣe gẹgẹ bi gbogbo irira ti enia buburu nṣe, on o ha yè? gbogbo ododo rẹ̀ ti o ti ṣe ni a kì yio ranti: ninu irekọja rẹ̀ ti o ti ṣe, ati ninu ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ̀ ti o ti da, ninu wọn ni yio kú.
entries.en: But when the righteous turneth away from his righteousness, and committeth iniquity, and doeth according to all the abominations that the wicked man doeth, shall he live? All his righteousness that he hath done shall not be mentioned: in his trespass that he hath trespassed, and in his sin that he hath sinned, in them shall he die.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹnyin wipe, ọ̀na Oluwa kò gún. Gbọ́ nisisiyi, iwọ ile Israeli; ọ̀na mi kò ha gún? ọ̀na ti nyin kọ́ kò gún?
entries.en: Yet ye say, The way of the Lord is not equal. Hear now, O house of Israel; Is not my way equal? are not your ways unequal?

entries.yo: Nigbati olododo kan ba yipada kuro ninu ododo rẹ̀, ti o si huwà aiṣedẽde, ti o si kú ninu wọn; nitori aiṣedẽde rẹ̀ ti o ti ṣe ni yio kú.
entries.en: When a righteous man turneth away from his righteousness, and committeth iniquity, and dieth in them; for his iniquity that he hath done shall he die.

entries.yo: Ẹwẹ, nigbati enia buburu ba yipada kuro ninu ìwa buburu rẹ̀ ti o ti ṣe, ti o si ṣe eyiti o tọ́, ati eyiti o yẹ, on o gba ọkàn rẹ̀ là lãye.
entries.en: Again, when the wicked man turneth away from his wickedness that he hath committed, and doeth that which is lawful and right, he shall save his soul alive.

entries.yo: Nitoripe o bẹ̀ru o si yipada kuro ninu gbogbo irekọja rẹ̀ ti o ti ṣe, yiyè ni yio yè, on kì yio kú.
entries.en: Because he considereth, and turneth away from all his transgressions that he hath committed, he shall surely live, he shall not die.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ile Israeli wipe, Ọ̀na Oluwa kò gún. Ile Israeli, ọ̀na mi kò ha gún? ọ̀na ti nyin kọ́ kò gún?
entries.en: Yet saith the house of Israel, The way of the Lord is not equal. O house of Israel, are not my ways equal? are not your ways unequal?

entries.yo: Nitorina emi o dá nyin lẹjọ, ile Israeli, olukuluku gẹgẹ bi ọ̀na rẹ̀, ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi. Ẹ yipada, ki ẹ si yi kuro ninu gbogbo irekọja nyin; bẹ̃ni aiṣedẽde kì yio jẹ iparun nyin.
entries.en: Therefore I will judge you, O house of Israel, every one according to his ways, saith the Lord GOD. Repent, and turn yourselves from all your transgressions; so iniquity shall not be your ruin.

entries.yo: Ẹ ta gbogbo irekọja nyin nù kuro lọdọ nyin, nipa eyiti ẹnyin fi rekọja; ẹ si dá ọkàn titun ati ẹmi titun fun ara nyin: nitori kini ẹnyin o ṣe kú, ile Israeli?
entries.en: Cast away from you all your transgressions, whereby ye have transgressed; and make you a new heart and a new spirit: for why will ye die, O house of Israel?

entries.yo: Nitoripe emi kò ni inu didùn si ikú ẹniti o kú, ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi: nitorina ẹ yi ara nyin pada, ki ẹ si yè.
entries.en: For I have no pleasure in the death of him that dieth, saith the Lord GOD: wherefore turn yourselves, and live ye.

entries.yo: PẸLUPẸLU iwọ pohùn-rére ẹkun fun awọn ọmọ-alade Israeli,
entries.en: Moreover take thou up a lamentation for the princes of Israel,

entries.yo: Si wipe, Kini iyá rẹ? Abo kiniun: o dubulẹ lãrin kiniun, o bọ́ awọn ọmọ rẹ lãrin ọmọ kiniun.
entries.en: And say, What is thy mother? A lioness: she lay down among lions, she nourished her whelps among young lions.

entries.yo: O si tọ́ ọkan ninu ọmọ rẹ̀ dàgba: o di ọmọ kiniun, o si kọ́ ati ṣọdẹ; o pa enia jẹ.
entries.en: And she brought up one of her whelps: it became a young lion, and it learned to catch the prey; it devoured men.

entries.yo: Awọn orilẹ-ède pẹlu gburo rẹ̀: a mu u ninu iho wọn, nwọn si fi ẹ̀wọn mu u lọ si ilẹ Egipti.
entries.en: The nations also heard of him; he was taken in their pit, and they brought him with chains unto the land of Egypt.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si ri pe on si duro, ti ireti rẹ̀ si sọnu, nigbana ni o mu omiran ninu ọmọ rẹ̀, o si sọ ọ di ọmọ kiniun.
entries.en: Now when she saw that she had waited, and her hope was lost, then she took another of her whelps, and made him a young lion.

entries.yo: On si lọ soke lọ sodo lãrin awọn kiniun, o di ọmọ kiniun, o si kọ́ lati ṣọdẹ, o si pa enia jẹ.
entries.en: And he went up and down among the lions, he became a young lion, and learned to catch the prey, and devoured men.

entries.yo: On si mọ̀ awọn opo wọn, o si sọ ilu-nla wọn di ahoro; ilẹ na di ahoro, ati ẹkún rẹ̀, pẹlu nipa ariwo kike ramuramu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he knew their desolate palaces, and he laid waste their cities; and the land was desolate, and the fulness thereof, by the noise of his roaring.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni awọn orilẹ-ède kó tì i nihà gbogbo lati ìgberiko wá, nwọn si na awọ̀n wọn le e lori: a mu u ninu iho wọn.
entries.en: Then the nations set against him on every side from the provinces, and spread their net over him: he was taken in their pit.

entries.yo: Nwọn si fi i sinu ẹṣọ́ ninu ẹ̀wọn, nwọn si mu u wá sọdọ ọba Babiloni: nwọn mu u lọ sinu ilu olodi, ki a má ba gbọ́ ohùn rẹ̀ mọ lori oke Israeli.
entries.en: And they put him in ward in chains, and brought him to the king of Babylon: they brought him into holds, that his voice should no more be heard upon the mountains of Israel.

entries.yo: Iyá rẹ dabi àjara kan ninu ẹjẹ rẹ, ti a gbìn si eti odò, on kún fun eso, o si kún fun ẹka nitori ọ̀pọlọpọ odò.
entries.en: Thy mother is like a vine in thy blood, planted by the waters: she was fruitful and full of branches by reason of many waters.

entries.yo: O si ni ọpá ti o le fun ọpá-ade awọn ti o jẹ oye; giga rẹ̀ li a gbega lãrin ẹka gigun, o si farahàn ninu giga rẹ̀ pẹlu ọ̀pọlọpọ ẹka rẹ̀.
entries.en: And she had strong rods for the sceptres of them that bare rule, and her stature was exalted among the thick branches, and she appeared in her height with the multitude of her branches.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn a fã a tu ni irúnu, a wọ ọ lulẹ, ẹfũfu ila-õrun si gbe eso rẹ̀, ọpá lile rẹ̀ ti ṣẹ, o si rọ; iná jo o run.
entries.en: But she was plucked up in fury, she was cast down to the ground, and the east wind dried up her fruit: her strong rods were broken and withered; the fire consumed them.

entries.yo: Nisisiyi a si gbìn i si aginju, ni ilẹ gbigbẹ ati ilẹ ongbẹ.
entries.en: And now she is planted in the wilderness, in a dry and thirsty ground.

entries.yo: Iná si jade lati inu ọpá kan ninu ẹka rẹ̀, ti o ti jo eso rẹ̀ run, tobẹ̃ ti kò fi ni ẹka ti o le lati ṣe ọpa lati joye. Eyi ni ohùnrére ẹkun, yio si jẹ ohùn-rére ẹkun.
entries.en: And fire is gone out of a rod of her branches, which hath devoured her fruit, so that she hath no strong rod to be a sceptre to rule. This is a lamentation, and shall be for a lamentation.

entries.yo: O si ṣe ni ọdun keje ni oṣu karun, ni ọjọ kẹwa oṣu, ti awọn kan ninu awọn àgba Israeli wá ibere lọwọ Oluwa, nwọn si joko niwaju mi.
entries.en: And it came to pass in the seventh year, in the fifth month, the tenth day of the month, that certain of the elders of Israel came to inquire of the LORD, and sat before me.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ọ̀rọ Oluwa tọ̀ mi wá, wipe,
entries.en: Then came the word of the LORD unto me, saying,

entries.yo: Ọmọ enia, sọ fun awọn àgba Israeli, si wi fun wọn pe, Bayi ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi: Lati bere lọwọ mi ni ẹ ṣe wá? Oluwa Ọlọrun wipe, Bi mo ti wà, lọwọ mi kọ́ ẹnyin o bere.
entries.en: Son of man, speak unto the elders of Israel, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Are ye come to inquire of me? As I live, saith the Lord GOD, I will not be inquired of by you.

entries.yo: Iwọ o ha dá wọn lẹjọ bi, ọmọ enia, iwọ o ha da wọn lẹjọ? jẹ ki wọn mọ̀ ohun-irira baba wọn.
entries.en: Wilt thou judge them, son of man, wilt thou judge them? cause them to know the abominations of their fathers:

entries.yo: Si wi fun wọn pe, Bayi ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Ni ọjọ na nigbati mo yàn Israeli, ti mo si gbe ọwọ́ mi soke si iru-ọmọ ile Jakobu, ti mo si sọ ara mi di mimọ̀ fun wọn ni ilẹ Egipti, nigbati mo gbe ọwọ́ mi soke si wọn, wipe, Emi ni Oluwa Ọlọrun nyin:
entries.en: And say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; In the day when I chose Israel, and lifted up mine hand unto the seed of the house of Jacob, and made myself known unto them in the land of Egypt, when I lifted up mine hand unto them, saying, I am the LORD your God;

entries.yo: Ni ọjọ ti mo gbe ọwọ́ mi soke si wọn, lati mu wọn jade lati ilẹ Egipti si ilẹ ti mo ti wò silẹ fun wọn, ti nṣàn fun wàra ati fun oyin, ti iṣe ogo gbogbo ilẹ.
entries.en: In the day that I lifted up mine hand unto them, to bring them forth of the land of Egypt into a land that I had espied for them, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all lands:

entries.yo: Mo si wi fun wọn pe, Ki olukuluku ninu nyin gbe irira oju rẹ̀ junù, ẹ má si ṣe fi oriṣa Egipti sọ ara nyin di aimọ́: emi ni Oluwa Ọlọrun nyin.
entries.en: Then said I unto them, Cast ye away every man the abominations of his eyes, and defile not yourselves with the idols of Egypt: I am the LORD your God.
