entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nwọn ṣọ̀tẹ si mi, nwọn kò si fẹ fi eti si mi: olukuluku wọn kò gbe ohun-irira oju wọn junù, bẹ̃ni nwọn kò kọ oriṣa Egipti silẹ: nigbana ni mo wipe, emi o da irúnu mi si wọn lori, lati pari ibinu mi si wọn lãrin ilẹ Egipti.
entries.en: But they rebelled against me, and would not hearken unto me: they did not every man cast away the abominations of their eyes, neither did they forsake the idols of Egypt: then I said, I will pour out my fury upon them to accomplish my anger against them in the midst of the land of Egypt.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn mo ṣiṣẹ nitori orukọ mi; ki o má bà bajẹ niwaju awọn keferi, lãrin ẹniti nwọn wà, loju ẹniti mo sọ ara mi di mimọ̀ fun wọn, ni mimu wọn jade kuro ni ilẹ Egipti.
entries.en: But I wrought for my name's sake, that it should not be polluted before the heathen, among whom they were, in whose sight I made myself known unto them, in bringing them forth out of the land of Egypt.

entries.yo: Mo si jẹ ki wọn lọ kuro ni ilẹ Egipti, mo si mu wọn wá si aginju.
entries.en: Wherefore I caused them to go forth out of the land of Egypt, and brought them into the wilderness.

entries.yo: Mo si fi aṣẹ mi fun wọn, mo si fi idajọ mi hàn wọn, eyiti bi enia kan ba ṣe, yio tilẹ yè ninu wọn.
entries.en: And I gave them my statutes, and shewed them my judgments, which if a man do, he shall even live in them.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu mo si fun wọn ni ọjọ isimi mi, lati ṣe àmi lãrin t'emi ti wọn, ki nwọn ki o le mọ̀ pe emi ni Oluwa ti o yà wọn si mimọ́.
entries.en: Moreover also I gave them my sabbaths, to be a sign between me and them, that they might know that I am the LORD that sanctify them.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ile Israeli ṣọ̀tẹ si mi ni aginjù: nwọn kò rìn ni aṣẹ mi, nwọn si gàn idajọ mi, eyiti bi enia kan ba ṣe, on o tilẹ yè ninu wọn; ati ọjọ isimi mi ni wọn tilẹ bajẹ gidigidi: nigbana ni mo wipe, emi o dà irúnu mi si wọn lori li aginju, lati pa wọn run.
entries.en: But the house of Israel rebelled against me in the wilderness: they walked not in my statutes, and they despised my judgments, which if a man do, he shall even live in them; and my sabbaths they greatly polluted: then I said, I would pour out my fury upon them in the wilderness, to consume them.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn mo ṣiṣẹ nitori orukọ mi, ki o má ba di ibajẹ niwaju awọn keferi, loju ẹniti mo mu wọn jade.
entries.en: But I wrought for my name's sake, that it should not be polluted before the heathen, in whose sight I brought them out.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu mo gbe ọwọ́ mi soke si wọn ni aginju pe emi kò ni mu wọn de ilẹ ti mo ti fi fun wọn, ti nṣàn fun wàra ati fun oyin, ti iṣe ogo gbogbo ilẹ;
entries.en: Yet also I lifted up my hand unto them in the wilderness, that I would not bring them into the land which I had given them, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all lands;

entries.yo: Nitoriti nwọn gàn idajọ mi, nwọn kò si rìn ninu aṣẹ mi, ṣugbọn nwọn bà ọjọ isimi mi jẹ: nitoripe ọkàn wọn tẹ̀le oriṣa wọn.
entries.en: Because they despised my judgments, and walked not in my statutes, but polluted my sabbaths: for their heart went after their idols.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn oju mi dá wọn si ki emi má ba pa wọn, bẹ̃ni emi kò ṣe wọn li aṣetan ni aginju.
entries.en: Nevertheless mine eye spared them from destroying them, neither did I make an end of them in the wilderness.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn mo sọ fun awọn ọmọ wọn li aginju pe, Ẹ máṣe rìn ninu aṣẹ baba nyin, ẹ má si ṣe kiyesi idajọ wọn, ẹ má si fi oriṣa wọn sọ ara nyin di aimọ́:
entries.en: But I said unto their children in the wilderness, Walk ye not in the statutes of your fathers, neither observe their judgments, nor defile yourselves with their idols:

entries.yo: Emi ni Oluwa Ọlọrun nyin: ẹ rìn ninu aṣẹ mi, ẹ si pa idajọ mi mọ, ẹ si ṣe wọn;
entries.en: I am the LORD your God; walk in my statutes, and keep my judgments, and do them;

entries.yo: Ẹ si bọ̀wọ fun ọjọ isimi mi; nwọn o si jẹ àmi lãrin t'emi ti nyin, ki ẹnyin ki o le mọ̀ pe emi ni Oluwa Ọlọrun nyin.
entries.en: And hallow my sabbaths; and they shall be a sign between me and you, that ye may know that I am the LORD your God.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn ọmọ na ṣọ̀tẹ si mi: nwọn kò rìn ninu aṣẹ mi, bẹ̃ni nwọn kò pa idajọ mi mọ lati ṣe wọn, eyiti bi enia kan ba ṣe, yio tilẹ yè ninu wọn; nwọn bà ọjọ isimi mi jẹ: mo si wipe, Emi o da irúnu mi sori wọn, lati pari ibinu mi sori wọn li aginju.
entries.en: Notwithstanding the children rebelled against me: they walked not in my statutes, neither kept my judgments to do them, which if a man do, he shall even live in them; they polluted my sabbaths: then I said, I would pour out my fury upon them, to accomplish my anger against them in the wilderness.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn mo fà ọwọ́ mi sẹhìn, mo si ṣiṣẹ nitori orukọ mi, ki o má bà di ibajẹ li oju awọn keferi, loju ẹniti mo mu wọn jade.
entries.en: Nevertheless I withdrew mine hand, and wrought for my name's sake, that it should not be polluted in the sight of the heathen, in whose sight I brought them forth.

entries.yo: Mo gbe ọwọ́ mi soke si wọn pẹlu li aginju, lati tú wọn ka lãrin awọn keferi, ati lati fọ́n wọn ká ilẹ gbogbo;
entries.en: I lifted up mine hand unto them also in the wilderness, that I would scatter them among the heathen, and disperse them through the countries;

entries.yo: Nitoripe nwọn kò mu idajọ mi ṣẹ, ṣugbọn nwọn kẹgàn aṣẹ mi, nwọn si ti bà ọjọ isimi mi jẹ, oju wọn si wà lara oriṣa baba wọn.
entries.en: Because they had not executed my judgments, but had despised my statutes, and had polluted my sabbaths, and their eyes were after their fathers' idols.

entries.yo: Nitorina mo fun wọn ni aṣẹ pẹlu ti kò dara, ati idajọ nipa eyiti wọn kì yio fi le yè;
entries.en: Wherefore I gave them also statutes that were not good, and judgments whereby they should not live;

entries.yo: Emi si bà wọn jẹ́ ninu ẹ̀bun ara wọn, nitipe nwọn mu gbogbo awọn akọbi kọja lãrin iná, ki emi ba le sọ wọn di ahoro, ki nwọn le bà mọ̀ pe emi ni Oluwa.
entries.en: And I polluted them in their own gifts, in that they caused to pass through the fire all that openeth the womb, that I might make them desolate, to the end that they might know that I am the LORD.

entries.yo: Nitorina, ọmọ enia, sọ fun ile Israeli, si wi fun wọn pe, Bayi ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Ninu eyi pẹlu baba nyin ti sọ̀rọ odi si mi, nitipe nwọn ti dẹṣẹ si mi.
entries.en: Therefore, son of man, speak unto the house of Israel, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Yet in this your fathers have blasphemed me, in that they have committed a trespass against me.

entries.yo: Nitori nigbati mo ti mu wọn de ilẹ, niti eyiti mo gbé ọwọ́ mi soke lati fi i fun wọn, nigbana ni nwọn ri olukuluku oke giga, ati gbogbo igi bibò, nwọn si ru ẹbọ wọn nibẹ, nwọn si gbe imunibinu ọrẹ wọn kalẹ nibẹ: nibẹ pẹlu ni nwọn ṣe õrun didùn wọn, nwọn si ta ohun-ọrẹ mimu silẹ nibẹ.
entries.en: For when I had brought them into the land, for the which I lifted up mine hand to give it to them, then they saw every high hill, and all the thick trees, and they offered there their sacrifices, and there they presented the provocation of their offering: there also they made their sweet savour, and poured out there their drink offerings.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni mo wi fun wọn pe, Kini ibi giga ti ẹnyin nlọ na? Orukọ rẹ̀ ni a si npe ni Bama titi o fi di oni oloni.
entries.en: Then I said unto them, What is the high place whereunto ye go? And the name thereof is called Bamah unto this day.

entries.yo: Si wi fun ile Israeli pe, Bayi ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; A bà nyin jẹ́ gẹgẹ bi baba nyin? ẹnyin si ṣe agbère gẹgẹ bi ohun-irira wọn?
entries.en: Wherefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Are ye polluted after the manner of your fathers? and commit ye whoredom after their abominations?

entries.yo: Nitori nigbati ẹnyin nta ọrẹ nyin, nigbati ẹnyin mu ọmọ nyin kọja lãrin iná, ẹnyin fi oriṣa nyin bà ara nyin jẹ́, ani titi o fi di oni oloni: ẹnyin o ha si bere lọwọ mi, Iwọ ile Israeli? Bi mo ti wà, ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi, lọwọ mi kọ́ ẹnyin o bere.
entries.en: For when ye offer your gifts, when ye make your sons to pass through the fire, ye pollute yourselves with all your idols, even unto this day: and shall I be inquired of by you, O house of Israel? As I live, saith the Lord GOD, I will not be inquired of by you.

entries.yo: Eyiti o si wá si iye nyin kì yio wà rara; ti ẹnyin wipe, Awa o wà bi awọn keferi, gẹgẹ bi idile awọn orilẹ-ède lati bọ igi ati okuta.
entries.en: And that which cometh into your mind shall not be at all, that ye say, We will be as the heathen, as the families of the countries, to serve wood and stone.

entries.yo: Bi mo ti wà, ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi, nitõtọ nipa agbara ọwọ́, ati ninà apa, pẹlu irúnu ti a dà jade li emi o fi jọba lori nyin:
entries.en: As I live, saith the Lord GOD, surely with a mighty hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with fury poured out, will I rule over you:

entries.yo: Emi o si mu nyin jade kuro lãrin awọn enia, emi o si ṣà nyin jọ lati ilẹ ti a ti tú nyin ka si, pẹlu ọwọ́ agbara, ati ninà apa, ati pẹlu irúnu ti a dà jade.
entries.en: And I will bring you out from the people, and will gather you out of the countries wherein ye are scattered, with a mighty hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with fury poured out.

entries.yo: Emi o si mu nyin wá si aginju awọn enia, nibẹ ni emi o si bá nyin rojọ lojukoju.
entries.en: And I will bring you into the wilderness of the people, and there will I plead with you face to face.

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi mo ti dá awọn baba nyin lẹjọ li aginju ilẹ Egipti, bẹ̃ni emi o bá nyin rojọ, ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi.
entries.en: Like as I pleaded with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so will I plead with you, saith the Lord GOD.

entries.yo: Emi o si mu nyin kọja labẹ ọpá, emi o si mu nyin wá si ìde majẹmu:
entries.en: And I will cause you to pass under the rod, and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant:

entries.yo: Emi o si ṣà awọn ọlọ̀tẹ kuro lãrin nyin, ati awọn olurekọja, emi o mu wọn jade kuro ni ilẹ ti wọn gbe ṣe atipo, nwọn kì yio si wọ ilẹ Israeli: ẹnyin o si mọ̀ pe emi ni Oluwa.
entries.en: And I will purge out from among you the rebels, and them that transgress against me: I will bring them forth out of the country where they sojourn, and they shall not enter into the land of Israel: and ye shall know that I am the LORD.

entries.yo: Bi o ṣe ti nyin, ile Israeli, Bayi ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi, Ẹ lọ, olukuluku sìn oriṣa rẹ̀, ati lẹhin eyi pẹlu, bi ẹnyin kì yio ba fi eti si mi: ṣugbọn ẹ máṣe fi ẹ̀bun nyin ati oriṣa nyin bà orukọ mimọ́ mi jẹ́ mọ.
entries.en: As for you, O house of Israel, thus saith the Lord GOD; Go ye, serve ye every one his idols, and hereafter also, if ye will not hearken unto me: but pollute ye my holy name no more with your gifts, and with your idols.

entries.yo: Nitori lori oke mimọ́ mi, lori oke giga Israeli, ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi, nibẹ ni gbogbo ile Israeli, gbogbo wọn ni ilẹ na, yio sìn mi: nibẹ ni emi o gbà wọn, nibẹ ni emi o si bere ẹbọ nyin, ati ọrẹ akọso nyin, pẹlu ohun mimọ́ nyin.
entries.en: For in mine holy mountain, in the mountain of the height of Israel, saith the Lord GOD, there shall all the house of Israel, all of them in the land, serve me: there will I accept them, and there will I require your offerings, and the firstfruits of your oblations, with all your holy things.

entries.yo: Emi o gbà nyin pẹlu õrùn didùn nyin, nigbati mo mu nyin jade kuro lãrin awọn enia, ti mo si ko nyin jọ lati ilẹ gbogbo nibiti a gbe ti tú nyin ká si; a o si yà mi si mimọ́ ninu nyin niwaju awọn keferi.
entries.en: I will accept you with your sweet savour, when I bring you out from the people, and gather you out of the countries wherein ye have been scattered; and I will be sanctified in you before the heathen.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin o si mọ̀ pe emi ni Oluwa, nigbati emi o mu nyin de ilẹ Israeli, si ilẹ niti eyiti o gbe ọwọ́ mi soke lati fi fun awọn baba nyin.
entries.en: And ye shall know that I am the LORD, when I shall bring you into the land of Israel, into the country for the which I lifted up mine hand to give it to your fathers.

entries.yo: Nibẹ li ẹnyin o ranti ọ̀na nyin, ati gbogbo iṣe nyin, ninu eyiti a ti bà nyin jẹ; ẹ o si sú ara nyin loju ara nyin nitori gbogbo buburu ti ẹnyin ti ṣe.
entries.en: And there shall ye remember your ways, and all your doings, wherein ye have been defiled; and ye shall lothe yourselves in your own sight for all your evils that ye have committed.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin o si mọ̀ pe emi ni Oluwa, nigbati emi ti ṣiṣẹ pẹlu nyin nitori orukọ mi, ki iṣe gẹgẹ bi ọ̀na buburu nyin, tabi gẹgẹ bi iṣe bibajẹ nyin, ẹnyin ile Israeli, ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi.
entries.en: And ye shall know that I am the LORD, when I have wrought with you for my name's sake, not according to your wicked ways, nor according to your corrupt doings, O ye house of Israel, saith the Lord GOD.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ Oluwa si tọ̀ mi wá, wipe,
entries.en: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

entries.yo: Ọmọ enia, kọju rẹ siha gusù, si sọ ọ̀rọ rẹ siha gusù, si sọtẹlẹ si igbó oko gusù;
entries.en: Son of man, set thy face toward the south, and drop thy word toward the south, and prophesy against the forest of the south field;

entries.yo: Si wi fun igbó gusù pe, Gbọ́ ọ̀rọ Oluwa; bayi ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Kiyesi i, emi o da iná kan ninu rẹ, yio si jo olukuluku igi tutù ninu rẹ, ati olukuluku igi gbigbẹ: jijo ọwọ́ iná na ni a kì yio pa, ati gbogbo oju lati gusu de ariwa ni a o sun ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And say to the forest of the south, Hear the word of the LORD; Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will kindle a fire in thee, and it shall devour every green tree in thee, and every dry tree: the flaming flame shall not be quenched, and all faces from the south to the north shall be burned therein.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ẹran-ara ni yio si ri i pe emi Oluwa li o ti da a, a kì yio pa a.
entries.en: And all flesh shall see that I the LORD have kindled it: it shall not be quenched.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni mo wipe, A! Oluwa Ọlọrun, nwọn wi niti emi pe, Owe ki o npa yi?
entries.en: Then said I, Ah Lord GOD! they say of me, Doth he not speak parables?

entries.yo: Ọ̀RỌ Oluwa si tọ̀ mi wá, wipe.
entries.en: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

entries.yo: Ọmọ enia, kọju rẹ sihà Jerusalemu, si sọ ọ̀rọ si ibi mimọ́ wọnni, si sọtẹlẹ si ilẹ Israeli.
entries.en: Son of man, set thy face toward Jerusalem, and drop thy word toward the holy places, and prophesy against the land of Israel,

entries.yo: Si wi fun ilẹ Israeli pe, Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Kiyesi i, mo dojukọ ọ, emi o si fa idà mi yọ kuro li akọ̀ rẹ̀, emi o si ke olododo ati enia buburu kuro lãrin rẹ.
entries.en: And say to the land of Israel, Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I am against thee, and will draw forth my sword out of his sheath, and will cut off from thee the righteous and the wicked.

entries.yo: Njẹ bi o ti ṣe pe emi o ke olododo ati enia buburu kuro lãrin rẹ, nitorina ni idà mi o ṣe jade lọ lati inu àkọ rẹ̀, si gbogbo ẹran-ara, lati gusù de ariwa:
entries.en: Seeing then that I will cut off from thee the righteous and the wicked, therefore shall my sword go forth out of his sheath against all flesh from the south to the north:

entries.yo: Ki gbogbo ẹran-ara le mọ̀ pe emi Oluwa ti fà idà mi yọ kuro li àkọ rẹ̀: kì yio pada mọ lai.
entries.en: That all flesh may know that I the LORD have drawn forth my sword out of his sheath: it shall not return any more.

entries.yo: Nitorina kerora, iwọ ọmọ enia, pẹlu ṣiṣẹ́ ẹgbẹ́ rẹ, ati pẹlu ikerora kikoro niwaju wọn.
entries.en: Sigh therefore, thou son of man, with the breaking of thy loins; and with bitterness sigh before their eyes.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, nigbati nwọn ba wi fun ọ pe, Ẽṣe ti iwọ fi nkerora? iwọ o dahùn wipe, Nitori ihìn na; nitoripe o de: olukuluku ọkàn ni yio yọ́, gbogbo ọwọ́ ni yio si ṣe ailokun, olukuluku ẹmi yio si dakú, gbogbo ẽkún ni yio ṣe ailagbara bi omi: kiyesi i, o de, a o si mu u ṣẹ, ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi.
entries.en: And it shall be, when they say unto thee, Wherefore sighest thou? that thou shalt answer, For the tidings; because it cometh: and every heart shall melt, and all hands shall be feeble, and every spirit shall faint, and all knees shall be weak as water: behold, it cometh, and shall be brought to pass, saith the Lord GOD.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ Oluwa si tun tọ̀ mi wá, wipe,
entries.en: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

entries.yo: Ọmọ enia, sọtẹlẹ, si wipe, Bayi li Oluwa wi; Wipe, Idà, idà ti a pọ́n, ti a si dán pẹlu:
entries.en: Son of man, prophesy, and say, Thus saith the LORD; Say, A sword, a sword is sharpened, and also furbished:

entries.yo: A pọ́n ọ lati pa enia pupọ; a dán a lati ma kọ màna: awa o ha ma ṣe ariyá? ọgọ ọmọ mi, o gàn gbogbo igi.
entries.en: It is sharpened to make a sore slaughter; it is furbished that it may glitter: should we then make mirth? it contemneth the rod of my son, as every tree.

entries.yo: On si ti fi i le ni lọwọ lati dán, ki a ba le lò o; idà yi li a pọ́n, ti a si dán, lati fi i le ọwọ́ apani.
entries.en: And he hath give it to be furbished, that it may be handled: this sword is sharpened, and it is furbished, to give it into the hand of the slayer.

entries.yo: Kigbe, ki o si wu, ọmọ enia: nitori yio wá sori awọn enia mi, yio wá sori gbogbo ọmọ-alade Israeli: ìbẹru nla yio wá sori awọn enia mi nitori idà na: nitorina lu itan rẹ.
entries.en: Cry and howl, son of man: for it shall be upon my people, it shall be upon all the princes of Israel: terrors by reason of the sword shall be upon my people: smite therefore upon thy thigh.

entries.yo: Nitoripe idanwo ni, ki si ni bi idà na gàn ọgọ na? kì yio si mọ́, ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi.
entries.en: Because it is a trial, and what if the sword contemn even the rod? it shall be no more, saith the Lord GOD.

entries.yo: Nitorina, iwọ ọmọ enia, sọtẹlẹ, si fi ọwọ́ lu ọwọ́ pọ̀, si jẹ ki idà ki o ṣẹ́po nigba kẹta, idà awọn ti a pa: idà awọn enia nla ti a pa ni, ti o wọ inu yara ikọ̀kọ wọn lọ.
entries.en: Thou therefore, son of man, prophesy, and smite thine hands together, and let the sword be doubled the third time, the sword of the slain: it is the sword of the great men that are slain, which entereth into their privy chambers.

entries.yo: Mo ti nà ṣonṣo idà si gbogbo bode wọn: ki aiya wọn le dakú, ati ki ahoro wọn le di pupọ: ã! a ti ṣe e dán, a ti pọ́n ọ mú silẹ fun pipa.
entries.en: I have set the point of the sword against all their gates, that their heart may faint, and their ruins be multiplied: ah! it is made bright, it is wrapped up for the slaughter.

entries.yo: Iwọ gba ọ̀na kan tabi ọ̀na keji lọ, si apa ọtún tabi si òsi, nibikibi ti iwọ dojukọ.
entries.en: Go thee one way or other, either on the right hand, or on the left, whithersoever thy face is set.

entries.yo: Emi o si fi ọwọ́ lu ọwọ́ pọ̀, emi o si jẹ ki irúnu mi ki o simi: emi Oluwa li o ti wi bẹ̃.
entries.en: I will also smite mine hands together, and I will cause my fury to rest: I the LORD have said it.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ Oluwa tun tọ̀ mi wá, wipe,
entries.en: The word of the LORD came unto me again, saying,

entries.yo: Iwọ pẹlu, ọmọ enia, yan ọ̀na meji fun ara rẹ, ki idà ọba Babiloni ki o le wá: awọn mejeji yio jade lati ilẹ kanna wá: si yan ibi kan, yàn a ni ikorita ti o lọ si ilu-nla.
entries.en: Also, thou son of man, appoint thee two ways, that the sword of the king of Babylon may come: both twain shall come forth out of one land: and choose thou a place, choose it at the head of the way to the city.

entries.yo: Yàn ọ̀na kan, ki idà na le wá si Rabba ti awọn ara Ammoni, ati si Juda ni Jerusalemu ti o li odi.
entries.en: Appoint a way, that the sword may come to Rabbath of the Ammonites, and to Judah in Jerusalem the defenced.

entries.yo: Nitori ọba Babiloni duro ni iyàna, lori ọ̀na meji, lati ma lo afọṣẹ: o mì ọfà rẹ̀, o da òriṣa, o wo ẹ̀dọ.
entries.en: For the king of Babylon stood at the parting of the way, at the head of the two ways, to use divination: he made his arrows bright, he consulted with images, he looked in the liver.

entries.yo: Li ọwọ́ ọtún rẹ̀ ni afọṣẹ Jerusalemu wà, lati yan õlù, lati ya ẹnu rẹ̀ ni pipa, lati gbohùn soke pẹlu ariwo, lati yan õlù si bode, lati mọ odi, ati lati kọ ile iṣọ́.
entries.en: At his right hand was the divination for Jerusalem, to appoint captains, to open the mouth in the slaughter, to lift up the voice with shouting, to appoint battering rams against the gates, to cast a mount, and to build a fort.

entries.yo: Afọ̀ṣẹ na yio si dabi eké fun wọn, loju awọn ti o ti bura fun wọn: ṣugbọn on o mu aiṣedẽde wá si iranti, ki a ba le mu wọn.
entries.en: And it shall be unto them as a false divination in their sight, to them that have sworn oaths: but he will call to remembrance the iniquity, that they may be taken.

entries.yo: Nitorina bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Nitoripe ẹnyin jẹ ki a ranti aiṣedẽde nyin, niti pe a ri irekọja nyin, tobẹ̃ ti ẹ̀ṣẹ nyin hàn, ni gbogbo iṣe nyin: nitoripe ẹnyin wá si iranti, ọwọ́ li a o fi mu nyin.
entries.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because ye have made your iniquity to be remembered, in that your transgressions are discovered, so that in all your doings your sins do appear; because, I say, that ye are come to remembrance, ye shall be taken with the hand.

entries.yo: Ati iwọ, alailọ̀wọ ẹni-buburu ọmọ-alade Israeli, ẹniti ọjọ rẹ̀ de, nigba aiṣedẽde ikẹhìn.
entries.en: And thou, profane wicked prince of Israel, whose day is come, when iniquity shall have an end,

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Mu fila ọba kuro, si ṣi ade kuro; eyi kò ni jẹ ọkanna: gbe ẹniti o rẹlẹ ga, si rẹ̀ ẹniti o ga silẹ.
entries.en: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Remove the diadem, and take off the crown: this shall not be the same: exalt him that is low, and abase him that is high.

entries.yo: Emi o bì ṣubu, emi o bì ṣubu, emi o bì i subu, kì yio si si mọ, titi igbati ẹniti o ni i ba de; emi o si fi fun u.
entries.en: I will overturn, overturn, overturn, it: and it shall be no more, until he come whose right it is; and I will give it him.

entries.yo: Ati iwọ, ọmọ enia, sọtẹlẹ, si wipe, Bayi ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi niti awọn ara Ammoni, ati niti ẹgàn wọn; ani ki iwọ wipe, Idà na, idà na ti a fà yọ, a ti dán a fun pipa, lati parun lati kọ màna.
entries.en: And thou, son of man, prophesy and say, Thus saith the Lord GOD concerning the Ammonites, and concerning their reproach; even say thou, The sword, the sword is drawn: for the slaughter it is furbished, to consume because of the glittering:

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn ri ohun asan si ọ, nigbati nwọn fọ̀ àfọṣẹ eke si ọ, lati mu ọ wá si ọrùn awọn ti a pa, ti ẹni-buburu, ẹniti ọjọ rẹ̀ de, nigbati aiṣedẽde pin.
entries.en: Whiles they see vanity unto thee, whiles they divine a lie unto thee, to bring thee upon the necks of them that are slain, of the wicked, whose day is come, when their iniquity shall have an end.

entries.yo: Tun mu ki o pada sinu àkọ rẹ̀! Emi o ṣe idajọ rẹ nibi ti a gbe ṣe ẹdá rẹ, ni ilẹ ibi rẹ.
entries.en: Shall I cause it to return into his sheath? I will judge thee in the place where thou wast created, in the land of thy nativity.

entries.yo: Emi o dà ibinujẹ mi le ọ lori, ninu iná irúnu mi li emi o fẹ si ọ, emi o si fi ọ le awọn eniakenia lọwọ, ti nwọn ni ọgbọn lati parun.
entries.en: And I will pour out mine indignation upon thee, I will blow against thee in the fire of my wrath, and deliver thee into the hand of brutish men, and skilful to destroy.

entries.yo: Iwọ o jẹ́ igi fun iná; ẹjẹ rẹ yio wà lãrin ilẹ na; a kì yio ranti rẹ mọ: nitori emi Oluwa li o ti wi i.
entries.en: Thou shalt be for fuel to the fire; thy blood shall be in the midst of the land; thou shalt be no more remembered: for I the LORD have spoken it.

entries.yo: Ọ̀RỌ Oluwa si tọ̀ mi wá, wipe,
entries.en: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

entries.yo: Njẹ, iwọ ọmọ enia, iwọ o ha ṣe idajọ, iwọ o ha ṣe idajọ ilu ẹlẹjẹ na? nitõtọ, iwọ o jẹ ki o mọ̀ ohun irira rẹ̀ gbogbo.
entries.en: Now, thou son of man, wilt thou judge, wilt thou judge the bloody city? yea, thou shalt shew her all her abominations.

entries.yo: Nitorina, iwọ wipe, Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi, Ilu ti o ta ẹjẹ silẹ lãrin rẹ̀, ki akoko rẹ̀ ki o le de, o si ṣe oriṣa si ara rẹ̀ lati sọ ara rẹ̀ di aimọ́.
entries.en: Then say thou, Thus saith the Lord GOD, The city sheddeth blood in the midst of it, that her time may come, and maketh idols against herself to defile herself.

entries.yo: Iwọ ti di ẹlẹbi niti ẹjẹ rẹ ti iwọ ti ta silẹ; iwọ si ti sọ ara rẹ di aimọ́ niti òriṣa rẹ ti iwọ ti ṣe, iwọ si ti mu ọjọ rẹ summọ tosí, iwọ si ti dé ọdun rẹ: nitorina ni mo ṣe sọ ọ di ẹgàn si awọn keferi, ati ẹsín si gbogbo ilẹ.
entries.en: Thou art become guilty in thy blood that thou hast shed; and hast defiled thyself in thine idols which thou hast made; and thou hast caused thy days to draw near, and art come even unto thy years: therefore have I made thee a reproach unto the heathen, and a mocking to all countries.

entries.yo: Awọn ti o sunmọ tosí, ati awọn ti o jìna si ọ, yio fi ọ ṣẹ̀sin, iwọ ti a bà orukọ rẹ̀ jẹ, ti a si bà ninu jẹ pupọ.
entries.en: Those that be near, and those that be far from thee, shall mock thee, which art infamous and much vexed.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, awọn ọmọ-alade Israeli, olukuluku ninu agbara rẹ̀ wà ninu rẹ lati ta ẹjẹ silẹ.
entries.en: Behold, the princes of Israel, every one were in thee to their power to shed blood.

entries.yo: Ninu rẹ ni nwọn kò ka baba ati iyá si: lãrin rẹ ni nwọn ti ni awọn alejo lara: ninu rẹ ni nwọn ti bà alaini-baba ati opo ninu jẹ.
entries.en: In thee have they set light by father and mother: in the midst of thee have they dealt by oppression with the stranger: in thee have they vexed the fatherless and the widow.

entries.yo: Iwọ ti gan awọn ohun mimọ́ mi, o si ti sọ ọjọ isimi mi di ailọ̀wọ.
entries.en: Thou hast despised mine holy things, and hast profaned my sabbaths.

entries.yo: Ninu rẹ ni awọn ọkunrin ti o nṣe ofófo lati ta ẹjẹ silẹ wà: ninu rẹ ni nwọn si jẹun lori awọn oke: lãrin rẹ ni nwọn huwà ifẹkufẹ.
entries.en: In thee are men that carry tales to shed blood: and in thee they eat upon the mountains: in the midst of thee they commit lewdness.

entries.yo: Ninu rẹ ni nwọn ti tu ihòho baba wọn: ninu rẹ ni nwọn ti tẹ́ obinrin ti a yà sapakan nitori aimọ́ rẹ̀ logo.
entries.en: In thee have they discovered their fathers' nakedness: in thee have they humbled her that was set apart for pollution.

entries.yo: Ẹnikan si ti ṣe ohun irira pẹlu aya aladugbo rẹ̀: ẹlomiran si ti fi ifẹkufẹ bà aya-ọmọ rẹ̀ jẹ́; ẹlomiran ninu rẹ si ti tẹ́ arabinrin rẹ̀ logo, ọmọ baba rẹ̀.
entries.en: And one hath committed abomination with his neighbour's wife; and another hath lewdly defiled his daughter in law; and another in thee hath humbled his sister, his father's daughter.

entries.yo: Ninu rẹ ni nwọn ti gba ẹbùn lati ta ẹjẹ silẹ: iwọ ti gba ẹdá ati elé, o si ti fi iwọra jère lara awọn aladugbo rẹ, nipa ilọni lọwọ-gbà; o si ti gbagbe mi, ni Oluwa, Ọlọrun wi.
entries.en: In thee have they taken gifts to shed blood; thou hast taken usury and increase, and thou hast greedily gained of thy neighbours by extortion, and hast forgotten me, saith the Lord GOD.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, nitorina, mo ti fi ọwọ́ lu ọwọ̀ pọ̀ si ère aiṣõtọ rẹ ti o ti jẹ, ati si ẹjẹ rẹ ti o ti wà lãrin rẹ.
entries.en: Behold, therefore I have smitten mine hand at thy dishonest gain which thou hast made, and at thy blood which hath been in the midst of thee.

entries.yo: Ọkàn rẹ le gbà a, tabi ọwọ́ rẹ lè le, li ọjọ ti emi o ba ọ ṣe? emi Oluwa li o ti sọ ọ, emi o sì ṣe e.
entries.en: Can thine heart endure, or can thine hands be strong, in the days that I shall deal with thee? I the LORD have spoken it, and will do it.

entries.yo: Emi o fọ́n ọ ká sãrin awọn keferi, emi o si tú ọ ká si orilẹ-ède gbogbo, emi o si run ẽri rẹ kuro lara rẹ.
entries.en: And I will scatter thee among the heathen, and disperse thee in the countries, and will consume thy filthiness out of thee.

entries.yo: A o si sọ ọ di aìlọwọ ninu ara rẹ loju awọn keferi, iwọ o si mọ̀ pe emi li Oluwa.
entries.en: And thou shalt take thine inheritance in thyself in the sight of the heathen, and thou shalt know that I am the LORD.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ Oluwa si tọ̀ mi wá, wipe,
entries.en: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

entries.yo: Ọmọ enia, ile Israeli di idarọ si mi: gbogbo wọn jẹ idẹ, ati tánganran, ati irin, ati ojé, lãrin ileru; ani nwọn jẹ idarọ fadaka.
entries.en: Son of man, the house of Israel is to me become dross: all they are brass, and tin, and iron, and lead, in the midst of the furnace; they are even the dross of silver.

entries.yo: Nitorina bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Nitori ti gbogbo nyin di idarọ, kiyesi i, nitorina emi o ko nyin jọ si ãrin Jerusalemu.
entries.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because ye are all become dross, behold, therefore I will gather you into the midst of Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi nwọn ti ima ko fadaka, ati idẹ, ati irin, ati ojé, ati tánganran jọ si ãrin ileru, lati fin iná si i, ki a lè yọ́ ọ, bẹ̃ni emi o kó nyin ni ibinu mi, ati irúnu mi, emi o si fi nyin sibẹ emi o yọ́ nyin.
entries.en: As they gather silver, and brass, and iron, and lead, and tin, into the midst of the furnace, to blow the fire upon it, to melt it; so will I gather you in mine anger and in my fury, and I will leave you there, and melt you.

entries.yo: Nitotọ, emi o ko nyin jọ, emi o si fin iná ibinu mi si nyin lara, ẹ o si di yiyọ́ lãrin rẹ̀.
entries.en: Yea, I will gather you, and blow upon you in the fire of my wrath, and ye shall be melted in the midst thereof.

entries.yo: Bi a ti iyọ́ fadaka lãrin ileru, bẹ̃li a o yọ́ nyin lãrin rẹ̀; ẹnyin o si mọ̀ pe emi Oluwa li o ti dà irúnu mi si nyin lori.
entries.en: As silver is melted in the midst of the furnace, so shall ye be melted in the midst thereof; and ye shall know that I the LORD have poured out my fury upon you.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ Oluwa si tọ̀ mi wá, wipe,
entries.en: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

entries.yo: Ọmọ enia, sọ fun u, Iwọ ni ilẹ ti a kò gbá mọ́, ti a kò si rọ̀jo si i lori lọjọ ibinu.
entries.en: Son of man, say unto her, Thou art the land that is not cleansed, nor rained upon in the day of indignation.

entries.yo: Ìditẹ awọn wolĩ rẹ̀ wà lãrin rẹ̀, bi kiniun ti nke ramuramu ti nṣọdẹ; nwọn ti jẹ ọkàn run, nwọn ti kó ohun iṣura ati ohun iyebiye; nwọn ti sọ ọ̀pọlọpọ di opó fun u lãrin rẹ̀.
entries.en: There is a conspiracy of her prophets in the midst thereof, like a roaring lion ravening the prey; they have devoured souls; they have taken the treasure and precious things; they have made her many widows in the midst thereof.

entries.yo: Awọn alufa rẹ̀ ti rú ofin mi, nwọn si fi sọ ohun mimọ́ mi di àilọwọ: nwọn kò fi ìyatọ sãrin ohun mimọ́ ati àilọwọ, bẹ̃ni nwọn kò fi ìyatọ hàn lãrin ohun aimọ́, ati mimọ́, nwọn si ti fi oju wọn pamọ kuro li ọjọ isimi mi, mo si di ẹmi àilọwọ lãrin wọn.
entries.en: Her priests have violated my law, and have profaned mine holy things: they have put no difference between the holy and profane, neither have they shewed difference between the unclean and the clean, and have hid their eyes from my sabbaths, and I am profaned among them.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ-alade ãrin rẹ̀ dabi kõkò ti nṣọdẹ, lati tàjẹ silẹ, lati pa ọkàn run, lati jère aiṣõtọ.
entries.en: Her princes in the midst thereof are like wolves ravening the prey, to shed blood, and to destroy souls, to get dishonest gain.

entries.yo: Ati awọn wolĩ rẹ̀ ti fi ẹfun kùn wọn, nwọn nri asan, nwọn si nfọ afọ̀ṣẹ eke si wọn, wipe, Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi, nigbati o ṣepe Oluwa kò sọ̀rọ.
entries.en: And her prophets have daubed them with untempered morter, seeing vanity, and divining lies unto them, saying, Thus saith the Lord GOD, when the LORD hath not spoken.

entries.yo: Awọn enia ilẹ na, ti lo ìwa-ininilara, nwọn si ja olè, nwọn si ti bi awọn talaka ati alaini ninu: nitõtọ, nwọn ti ni alejò lara lainidi.
entries.en: The people of the land have used oppression, and exercised robbery, and have vexed the poor and needy: yea, they have oppressed the stranger wrongfully.

entries.yo: Emi si wá ẹnikan lãrin wọn, ti ibá tun odi na mọ, ti ibá duro ni ibiti o ya na niwaju mi fun ilẹ na, ki emi má bà parun: ṣugbọn emi kò ri ẹnikan.
entries.en: And I sought for a man among them, that should make up the hedge, and stand in the gap before me for the land, that I should not destroy it: but I found none.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni mo ṣe dà ibinu mi si wọn lori; mo ti fi iná ibinu mi run wọn: mo si ti fi ọ̀na wọn gbẹsan lori ara wọn, li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi.
entries.en: Therefore have I poured out mine indignation upon them; I have consumed them with the fire of my wrath: their own way have I recompensed upon their heads, saith the Lord GOD.

entries.yo: Ọ̀RỌ Oluwa tun tọ̀ mi wá, wipe,
entries.en: The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,

entries.yo: Ọmọ enia, obinrin meji wà, ọmọbinrin iyá kanna:
entries.en: Son of man, there were two women, the daughters of one mother:

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣe panṣaga ni Egipti; nwọn ṣe panṣaga nigba ewe wọn: nibẹ ni a tẹ̀ ọmú wọn, nibẹ ni wọn si rin ọmú igbà wundia wọn.
entries.en: And they committed whoredoms in Egypt; they committed whoredoms in their youth: there were their breasts pressed, and there they bruised the teats of their virginity.

entries.yo: Orukọ wọn si ni Ahola, ti iṣe ẹ̀gbọn, ati Aholiba aburo rẹ̀: ti emi si ni nwọn, nwọn si bi ọmọkunrin ati ọmọbinrin. Orukọ wọn ni eyi; Samaria ni Ahola, Jerusalemu si li Aholiba.
entries.en: And the names of them were Aholah the elder, and Aholibah her sister: and they were mine, and they bare sons and daughters. Thus were their names; Samaria is Aholah, and Jerusalem Aholibah.

entries.yo: Ahola si ṣe panṣaga, nigbati o jẹ ti emi; o si fẹ awọn olufẹ rẹ̀ li afẹju, awọn ara Assiria aladugbo rẹ̀,
entries.en: And Aholah played the harlot when she was mine; and she doted on her lovers, on the Assyrians her neighbours,

entries.yo: Ti a fi aṣọ alaro bò lara, awọn balogun ati awọn olori, gbogbo nwọn jẹ ọmọkunrin ti o wun ni, awọn ẹlẹṣin ti o ngùn ẹṣin.
entries.en: Which were clothed with blue, captains and rulers, all of them desirable young men, horsemen riding upon horses.

entries.yo: Bayi li o ṣe panṣaga rẹ̀ pẹlu wọn, pẹlu gbogbo awọn aṣàyan ọkunrin Assiria, ati pẹlu gbogbo awọn ti o fẹ li afẹjù: o fi gbogbo oriṣa wọn ba ara rẹ̀ jẹ.
entries.en: Thus she committed her whoredoms with them, with all them that were the chosen men of Assyria, and with all on whom she doted: with all their idols she defiled herself.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni kò fi panṣaga rẹ̀ ti o mu ti Egipti wá silẹ: nitori nigba ewe rẹ̀ ni nwọn ba a sùn, nwọn si rin ọmú ìgba wundia rẹ̀, nwọn si dà panṣaga wọn si i lara.
entries.en: Neither left she her whoredoms brought from Egypt: for in her youth they lay with her, and they bruised the breasts of her virginity, and poured their whoredom upon her.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni mo ti fi le ọwọ́ awọn olufẹ rẹ̀, le ọwọ́ awọn ara Assiria, awọn ti o fẹ li afẹju.
entries.en: Wherefore I have delivered her into the hand of her lovers, into the hand of the Assyrians, upon whom she doted.

entries.yo: Awọn wọnyi tu ìhoho rẹ̀ silẹ: nwọn mu awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ ọkunrin ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ obinrin, nwọn si fi idà pa a: o si di ẹni-olokiki lãrin awọn obinrin; nitori pe nwọn ti mu idajọ ṣẹ si i lara.
entries.en: These discovered her nakedness: they took her sons and her daughters, and slew her with the sword: and she became famous among women; for they had executed judgment upon her.

entries.yo: Nigbati Aholiba aburo ri eyi, o wà bàjẹ ju on lọ ni ìwa ifẹkufẹ rẹ̀, ati ni panṣaga rẹ̀ ju ẹ̀gbọn rẹ̀ lọ ni panṣaga rẹ̀.
entries.en: And when her sister Aholibah saw this, she was more corrupt in her inordinate love than she, and in her whoredoms more than her sister in her whoredoms.

entries.yo: O fẹ awọn ara Asiria aludugbo rẹ̀ li afẹju, awọn balogun ati awọn olori, ti a wọ̀ li aṣọ daradara, awọn ẹlẹṣin ti o ngùn ẹṣin, gbogbo wọn jẹ ọmọkunrin ti o wuni.
entries.en: She doted upon the Assyrians her neighbours, captains and rulers clothed most gorgeously, horsemen riding upon horses, all of them desirable young men.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni mo ri pe a bà a jẹ, awọn mejeji gba ọ̀na kan.
entries.en: Then I saw that she was defiled, that they took both one way,

entries.yo: Ati pe o mu ki panṣaga rẹ̀ bi si i: nitori igbati o ri awọn ọkunrin ti a ṣe li àworan sara ogiri, ere awọn ara Kaldea ti a fi ododó ṣe li àworan,
entries.en: And that she increased her whoredoms: for when she saw men pourtrayed upon the wall, the images of the Chaldeans pourtrayed with vermilion,

entries.yo: Ti a dì li àmure li ẹ̀gbẹ, ti nwọn ṣe aṣejù ni rirẹ lawani ori wọn, gbogbo wọn jẹ ajagun-kẹkẹ́ ti a ba ma wò, gẹgẹ bi iṣe awọn ara Babiloni ti Kaldea, ilẹ ibi wọn:
entries.en: Girded with girdles upon their loins, exceeding in dyed attire upon their heads, all of them princes to look to, after the manner of the Babylonians of Chaldea, the land of their nativity:

entries.yo: Bi o si ti fi oju rẹ̀ ri wọn, o fẹ wọn li afẹjù, o si ran onṣẹ si wọn si Kaldea.
entries.en: And as soon as she saw them with her eyes, she doted upon them, and sent messengers unto them into Chaldea.

entries.yo: Awọn ara Babiloni si tọ̀ ọ wá lori akete ifẹ, nwọn si fi panṣaga wọn bà a jẹ, a si bà a jẹ pẹlu wọn, ọkàn rẹ̀ si ṣi kuro lọdọ wọn.
entries.en: And the Babylonians came to her into the bed of love, and they defiled her with their whoredom, and she was polluted with them, and her mind was alienated from them.

entries.yo: Bayi li o tú idi panṣaga rẹ̀ silẹ, o si tú ihòho rẹ̀ silẹ: nigbana li ọkàn mi ṣi kuro lọdọ rẹ̀, gẹgẹ bi ọkàn mi ti ṣi kuro lọdọ ẹ̀gbọn rẹ̀.
entries.en: So she discovered her whoredoms, and discovered her nakedness: then my mind was alienated from her, like as my mind was alienated from her sister.

entries.yo: Sibẹsibẹ o mu panṣaga rẹ̀ bi si i ni pipè ọjọ ewe rẹ̀ si iranti, ninu eyi ti o ti ṣe panṣaga ni ilẹ Egipti.
entries.en: Yet she multiplied her whoredoms, in calling to remembrance the days of her youth, wherein she had played the harlot in the land of Egypt.

entries.yo: Nitoripe o fẹ awọn olufẹ wọn li afẹju, ẹran-ara awọn ti o dabi ẹran-ara kẹtẹkẹtẹ, ati irú awọn ẹni ti o dabi irú ẹṣin.
entries.en: For she doted upon their paramours, whose flesh is as the flesh of asses, and whose issue is like the issue of horses.

entries.yo: Bayi ni iwọ pe ìwa ifẹkufẹ ìgba ewe rẹ wá si iranti, niti ririn ori ọmú rẹ lati ọwọ́ awọn ara Egipti, fun ọmú ìgba ewe rẹ.
entries.en: Thus thou calledst to remembrance the lewdness of thy youth, in bruising thy teats by the Egyptians for the paps of thy youth.

entries.yo: Nitorina, iwọ Aholiba, bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Kiye si i, emi o gbe awọn olufẹ rẹ dide si ọ, lọdọ awọn ti ọkàn rẹ ti ṣi, emi o si mu wọn doju kọ ọ niha gbogbo.
entries.en: There, O Aholibah, thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will raise up thy lovers against thee, from whom thy mind is alienated, and I will bring them against thee on every side;

entries.yo: Awọn ara Babiloni, ati gbogbo awọn ara Kaldea, Pekodu, ati Ṣoa, ati Koa, ati gbogbo awọn ara Assiria pẹlu wọn: gbogbo wọn jẹ ọmọkunrin ti o wunni, balogun ati awọn olori, awọn ọkunrin ti o li okiki, gbogbo wọn li o ngun ẹṣin.
entries.en: The Babylonians, and all the Chaldeans, Pekod, and Shoa, and Koa, and all the Assyrians with them: all of them desirable young men, captains and rulers, great lords and renowned, all of them riding upon horses.

entries.yo: Nwọn o si wá fi kẹkẹ́ ogun, kẹkẹ́ ẹrù, ati kekẹ́ kekeke doju kọ ọ, ati pẹlu ìgbajọ ọ̀pọ enia, awọn ti yio doju asà, ati apata, ati akoro kọ ọ niha gbogbo: emi o si gbe idajọ kalẹ niwaju wọn, nwọn o si da ọ lẹjọ gẹgẹ bi idajọ wọn.
entries.en: And they shall come against thee with chariots, wagons, and wheels, and with an assembly of people, which shall set against thee buckler and shield and helmet round about: and I will set judgment before them, and they shall judge thee according to their judgments.

entries.yo: Emi o si doju owu mi kọ ọ, nwọn o si fi irúnu ba ọ lò: nwọn o fá imu rẹ ati eti rẹ; ati awọn ti o kù ninu rẹ yio ti ọwọ́ idà ṣubu: nwọn o mu awọn ọmọ rẹ ọkunrin, ati awọn ọmọ rẹ obinrin lọ, ati awọn ti o kù ninu rẹ, li a o fi iná run.
entries.en: And I will set my jealousy against thee, and they shall deal furiously with thee: they shall take away thy nose and thine ears; and thy remnant shall fall by the sword: they shall take thy sons and thy daughters; and thy residue shall be devoured by the fire.

entries.yo: Nwọn o si bọ aṣọ rẹ, nwọn o si mu ohun ọṣọ daradara rẹ lọ.
entries.en: They shall also strip thee out of thy clothes, and take away thy fair jewels.

entries.yo: Bayi li emi o jẹ ki ifẹkufẹ rẹ mọ kuro lọdọ rẹ, ati panṣaga rẹ ti o mu ti ilẹ Egipti wá; tobẹ̃, ti iwọ kì yio gboju rẹ soke si wọn, bẹ̃ni iwọ kì yio si ranti Egipti mọ.
entries.en: Thus will I make thy lewdness to cease from thee, and thy whoredom brought from the land of Egypt: so that thou shalt not lift up thine eyes unto them, nor remember Egypt any more.

entries.yo: Nitori bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Kiyesi i, emi o fi ọ le awọn ti iwọ korira lọwọ, li ọwọ́ awọn ẹniti ọkàn rẹ ṣi:
entries.en: For thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will deliver thee into the hand of them whom thou hatest, into the hand of them from whom thy mind is alienated:

entries.yo: Nwọn o si ba ọ lo ilo irira, nwọn o si ko gbogbo iṣẹ rẹ lọ, nwọn o si fi ọ silẹ ni ihoho ati ni goloto: ati ihoho panṣaga rẹ li a o tu silẹ, ti ifẹkufẹ rẹ, ati panṣaga rẹ.
entries.en: And they shall deal with thee hatefully, and shall take away all thy labour, and shall leave thee naked and bare: and the nakedness of thy whoredoms shall be discovered, both thy lewdness and thy whoredoms.

entries.yo: Emi o ṣe gbogbo nkan wọnyi si ọ, nitori pe iwọ ti bá awọn keferi ṣe agbere lọ, ati pe iwọ ti fi oriṣa wọn bà ara rẹ jẹ́.
entries.en: I will do these things unto thee, because thou hast gone a whoring after the heathen, and because thou art polluted with their idols.

entries.yo: Iwọ ti rìn li ọ̀na ẹ̀gbọn rẹ, nitorina li emi o fi ago rẹ̀ le ọ lọwọ.
entries.en: Thou hast walked in the way of thy sister; therefore will I give her cup into thine hand.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Iwọ o mu ninu ago ẹ̀gbọn rẹ ti o jin, ti o si tobi: a o fi ọ rẹrin ẹlẹya, a o yọ ṣuti si ọ; o gbà pupọ.
entries.en: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Thou shalt drink of thy sister's cup deep and large: thou shalt be laughed to scorn and had in derision; it containeth much.

entries.yo: A o fi ọti pa ọ, a o si fi ikãnu kún ọ, pẹlu ago iyanu ati idahoro, pẹlu ago Samaria ẹ̀gbọn rẹ.
entries.en: Thou shalt be filled with drunkenness and sorrow, with the cup of astonishment and desolation, with the cup of thy sister Samaria.

entries.yo: Iwọ o tilẹ mu u, iwọ o si fi ẹnu fa ọti jade, iwọ o si fọ apãdi na, iwọ o si fà ọmú ara rẹ tu, nitori mo ti sọ ọ, li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi.
entries.en: Thou shalt even drink it and suck it out, and thou shalt break the sherds thereof, and pluck off thine own breasts: for I have spoken it, saith the Lord GOD.

entries.yo: Nitorina bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Nitoripe iwọ ti gbagbe mi ti o si ti sọ mi si ẹhìn rẹ, nitorina iwọ rù ifẹkufẹ rẹ pẹlu ati panṣaga rẹ,
entries.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thou hast forgotten me, and cast me behind thy back, therefore bear thou also thy lewdness and thy whoredoms.

entries.yo: Oluwa tun sọ fun mi pe; Ọmọ enia, iwọ o ha dá Ahola ati Aholiba lẹ́jọ? nitõtọ sọ irira wọn fun wọn;
entries.en: The LORD said moreover unto me; Son of man, wilt thou judge Aholah and Aholibah? yea, declare unto them their abominations;

entries.yo: Pe, nwọn ti ṣe panṣaga ẹ̀jẹ si mbẹ lọwọ wọn, ati nipasẹ oriṣa wọn ni nwọn ti ṣe panṣaga, nwọn si ti jẹ ki awọn ọmọ wọn, ti nwọn bi fun mi, kọja lãrin iná fun wọn, lati run wọn.
entries.en: That they have committed adultery, and blood is in their hands, and with their idols have they committed adultery, and have also caused their sons, whom they bare unto me, to pass for them through the fire, to devour them.

entries.yo: Eyi ni nwọn si ṣe si mi; nwọn ti bà ibi mimọ́ mi jẹ li ọjọ kanna, nwọn sọ ọjọ isimi mi di aìlọwọ.
entries.en: Moreover this they have done unto me: they have defiled my sanctuary in the same day, and have profaned my sabbaths.

entries.yo: Nitoripe igbati nwọn pa awọn ọmọ wọn fun oriṣa wọn, nigbana ni nwọn wá ni ijọ kanna si ibi mimọ́ mi, lati sọ ọ di àilọwọ; si kiye si i, bayi ni nwọn ṣe lãrin ile mi.
entries.en: For when they had slain their children to their idols, then they came the same day into my sanctuary to profane it; and, lo, thus have they done in the midst of mine house.

entries.yo: Ati pẹlupẹlu, ti pe ẹnyin ranṣẹ pè awọn ọkunrin lati okẽre wá, sọdọ awọn ti a ranṣẹ pè; si kiyesi i, nwọn de: fun ẹniti iwọ wẹ̀ ara rẹ, ti o si le tirõ, ti o si fi ohun ọṣọ́ ṣe ara rẹ li ọṣọ́.
entries.en: And furthermore, that ye have sent for men to come from far, unto whom a messenger was sent; and, lo, they came: for whom thou didst wash thyself, paintedst thy eyes, and deckedst thyself with ornaments,

entries.yo: Ti o si joko lori àkete daradara, a si tẹ́ tabili siwaju rẹ̀, lori eyi ti iwọ gbe turari mi ati ororó mi lé.
entries.en: And satest upon a stately bed, and a table prepared before it, whereupon thou hast set mine incense and mine oil.

entries.yo: Ati ohùn ọ̀pọlọpọ enia, ti nwọn pa rọ́rọ wà lọdọ rẹ̀: ati pẹlu enia lasan li a mu awọn Sabeani lati aginjù wá, ti nwọn fi jufù si apá wọn, ati ade daradara si ori wọn.
entries.en: And a voice of a multitude being at ease was with her: and with the men of the common sort were brought Sabeans from the wilderness, which put bracelets upon their hands, and beautiful crowns upon their heads.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni mo wi fun on ti o gbó ni panṣaga, Nwọn o ha bá a ṣe panṣaga nisisiyi, ati on pẹlu wọn?
entries.en: Then said I unto her that was old in adulteries, Will they now commit whoredoms with her, and she with them?

entries.yo: Sibẹsibẹ wọn wọle tọ̀ ọ, bi nwọn ti iwọle tọ̀ obinrin ti nṣe panṣaga: bẹ̃ni nwọn wọle tọ̀ Ahola ati Aholiba, awọn onifẹkufẹ obinrin.
entries.en: Yet they went in unto her, as they go in unto a woman that playeth the harlot: so went they in unto Aholah and unto Aholibah, the lewd women.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọkunrin olododo, nwọn o ṣe idajọ wọn, bi a ti iṣe idajọ awọn àgbere obinrin, ati bi a ti iṣe idajọ awọn obinrin ti o ta ẹjẹ silẹ; nitoripe àgbere ni nwọn, ẹjẹ si wà lọwọ wọn.
entries.en: And the righteous men, they shall judge them after the manner of adulteresses, and after the manner of women that shed blood; because they are adulteresses, and blood is in their hands.

entries.yo: Nitori bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; emi o mu ẹgbẹ kan tọ̀ wọn wá, emi o si fi wọn fun wọn lati kó wọn lọ, ati lati bà wọn jẹ.
entries.en: For thus saith the Lord GOD; I will bring up a company upon them, and will give them to be removed and spoiled.

entries.yo: Ẹgbẹ na yio si sọ wọn li okuta, nwọn o si fi idà pa wọn; nwọn o pa awọn ọmọ wọn ọkunrin, ati awọn ọmọ wọn obinrin, nwọn o si fi iná kun ile wọn.
entries.en: And the company shall stone them with stones, and dispatch them with their swords; they shall slay their sons and their daughters, and burn up their houses with fire.

entries.yo: Bayi li emi o jẹ ki ìwa ifẹkufẹ mọ lãrin ilẹ na, ki a ba le kọ́ gbogbo obinrin, ki nwọn má bà ṣe bi ifẹkufẹ nyin.
entries.en: Thus will I cause lewdness to cease out of the land, that all women may be taught not to do after your lewdness.

entries.yo: Nwọn o si san ẹ̀san ìwa ifẹkufẹ nyin si ori nyin, ẹnyin o si rù ẹ̀ṣẹ oriṣa nyin; ẹnyin o si mọ̀ pe emi li Oluwa Ọlọrun.
entries.en: And they shall recompense your lewdness upon you, and ye shall bear the sins of your idols: and ye shall know that I am the Lord GOD.

entries.yo: Ọ̀RỌ Oluwa tun tọ̀ mi wá, li ọdun kẹsan, li oṣu kẹwa, li ọjọ kẹwa oṣu, wipe,
entries.en: Again in the ninth year, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

entries.yo: Ọmọ enia, iwọ kọ orukọ ọjọ na, ani ọjọ kanna yi: ọba Babiloni doju kọ Jerusalemu li ọjọ kanna yi:
entries.en: Son of man, write thee the name of the day, even of this same day: the king of Babylon set himself against Jerusalem this same day.

entries.yo: Si pa owe si ọlọtẹ ilẹ na, si wi fun wọn pe, Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi: Gbe ìkoko ka iná, gbe e kà a, si dà omi sinu rẹ̀ pẹlu:
entries.en: And utter a parable unto the rebellious house, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Set on a pot, set it on, and also pour water into it:

entries.yo: Kó aján na jọ sinu rẹ̀, olukuluku aján ti o tobi, itan, ati apá, fi egungun ti o jọju kún inu rẹ̀.
entries.en: Gather the pieces thereof into it, even every good piece, the thigh, and the shoulder; fill it with the choice bones.

entries.yo: Mu ninu agbo-ẹran ti o jọju, ko awọn egungun sabẹ rẹ̀, si jẹ ki o hó dãdã, si jẹ ki nwọn bọ̀ egungun rẹ̀ ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: Take the choice of the flock, and burn also the bones under it, and make it boil well, and let them seethe the bones of it therein.

entries.yo: Nitorina bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Egbé ni fun ilu ẹlẹjẹ na, fun ìkoko ti ifõfo rẹ̀ wà ninu rẹ̀, ti ifõfo rẹ̀ kò dá loju rẹ̀: mu u jade li aján li aján; máṣe dìbo nitori rẹ̀.
entries.en: Wherefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Woe to the bloody city, to the pot whose scum is therein, and whose scum is not gone out of it! bring it out piece by piece; let no lot fall up on it.

entries.yo: Nitori ẹjẹ rẹ̀ wà lãrin rẹ̀, o gbé e kà ori apata kan, kò tú u dà sori ilẹ, lati fi erupẹ bò o.
entries.en: For her blood is in the midst of her; she set it upon the top of a rock; she poured it not upon the ground, to cover it with dust;

entries.yo: Ki o ba lè jẹ ki irúnu ki o de, lati gbẹsan; mo ti gbe ẹjẹ rẹ̀ kà ori apata kan, ki a má ba le bò o.
entries.en: That it might cause fury to come up to take vengeance; I have set her blood upon the top of a rock, that it should not be covered.

entries.yo: Nitorina, bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Egbe ni fun ilu ẹlẹjẹ na! Emi o tilẹ jẹ ki òkiti iná na tobi.
entries.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Woe to the bloody city! I will even make the pile for fire great.

entries.yo: Ko igi jọ si i, ko iná jọ, jo ẹran na, fi turari dùn u; si jẹ ki egungun na jona.
entries.en: Heap on wood, kindle the fire, consume the flesh, and spice it well, and let the bones be burned.

entries.yo: Si gbe e kà ori ẹyín iná na lasan, ki idẹ rẹ̀ le gbona, ki o le pọ́n, ati ki ẽri rẹ̀ le di yiyọ́ ninu rẹ̀, ki ifõfo rẹ̀ le run.
entries.en: Then set it empty upon the coals thereof, that the brass of it may be hot, and may burn, and that the filthiness of it may be molten in it, that the scum of it may be consumed.

entries.yo: On ti fi eke dá ara rẹ̀ lagara, ifõfo nla rẹ̀ kò si jade kuro lara rẹ̀ ifõfo rẹ̀ yio wà ninu iná.
entries.en: She hath wearied herself with lies, and her great scum went not forth out of her: her scum shall be in the fire.

entries.yo: Ninu ẽri rẹ̀ ni iwà ifẹkufẹ wà: nitori mo ti wẹ̀ ọ, iwọ kò si mọ́, a kì yio si tun wẹ̀ ọ kuro ninu ẽri rẹ mọ, titi emi o fi jẹ ki irúnu mi ba le ọ lori.
entries.en: In thy filthiness is lewdness: because I have purged thee, and thou wast not purged, thou shalt not be purged from thy filthiness any more, till I have caused my fury to rest upon thee.

entries.yo: Emi Oluwa li o ti sọ ọ, yio si ṣẹ, emi o si ṣe e: emi kì yio pada sẹhìn, bẹ̃ni emi kì yio dasi, bẹ̃ni emi kì yio ronupiwada; gẹgẹ bi ọ̀na rẹ, ati gẹgẹ bi iṣe rẹ ni nwọn o da ọ lẹjọ, li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi.
entries.en: I the LORD have spoken it: it shall come to pass, and I will do it; I will not go back, neither will I spare, neither will I repent; according to thy ways, and according to thy doings, shall they judge thee, saith the Lord GOD.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ Oluwa si tọ̀ mi wá, wipe,
entries.en: Also the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

entries.yo: Ọmọ enia, kiye si i, mo mu ifẹ oju rẹ kuro lọdọ rẹ, nipa lilù kan: ṣugbọn iwọ kò gbọdọ gbãwẹ, bẹ̃ni iwọ kò gbọdọ sọkun, bẹ̃ni omije rẹ kò gbọdọ ṣan silẹ.
entries.en: Son of man, behold, I take away from thee the desire of thine eyes with a stroke: yet neither shalt thou mourn nor weep, neither shall thy tears run down.

entries.yo: Máṣe sọkun, máṣe gbãwẹ fun okú, wé lawàni sori rẹ, si bọ̀ bata rẹ si ẹsẹ rẹ, máṣe bò ète rẹ, máṣe jẹ onjẹ enia.
entries.en: Forbear to cry, make no mourning for the dead, bind the tire of thine head upon thee, and put on thy shoes upon thy feet, and cover not thy lips, and eat not the bread of men.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni mo sọ fun awọn enia li owurọ: li aṣálẹ obinrin mi si kú, mo si ṣe li owurọ bi a ti pá a li aṣẹ fun mi.
entries.en: So I spake unto the people in the morning: and at even my wife died; and I did in the morning as I was commanded.

entries.yo: Awọn enia si sọ fun mi wipe, Iwọ kì yio ha sọ fun wa ohun ti nkan wọnyi jasi fun wa, ti iwọ ṣe bayi?
entries.en: And the people said unto me, Wilt thou not tell us what these things are to us, that thou doest so?

entries.yo: Mo si da wọn lohùn pe, Ọ̀rọ Oluwa tọ̀ mi wá wipe,
entries.en: Then I answered them, The word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

entries.yo: Sọ fun ile Israeli pe, Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi, kiyesi i emi o sọ ibi mimọ́ mi di aimọ́, titayọ agbara nyin, ifẹ oju nyin, ikãnu ọkàn nyin, ati ọmọ nyin ọkunrin ati ọmọ nyin obinrin, ti ẹnyin ti fi silẹ, yio ti ipa idà ṣubu.
entries.en: Speak unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will profane my sanctuary, the excellency of your strength, the desire of your eyes, and that which your soul pitieth; and your sons and your daughters whom ye have left shall fall by the sword.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin o si ṣe bi emi ti ṣe: ẹnyin kò ni bò ète nyin, bẹ̃ni ẹ kò ni jẹ onjẹ enia.
entries.en: And ye shall do as I have done: ye shall not cover your lips, nor eat the bread of men.

entries.yo: Lawani nyin yio si wà li ori nyin, ati bàta nyin li ẹsẹ nyin: ẹnyin kò ni gbãwẹ, bẹ̃ni ẹ kò ni sọkun: ṣugbọn ẹnyin o ma joro nitori aiṣedẽde nyin, ẹ o si ma ṣọ̀fọ ẹnikan si ẹnikeji.
entries.en: And your tires shall be upon your heads, and your shoes upon your feet: ye shall not mourn nor weep; but ye shall pine away for your iniquities, and mourn one toward another.

entries.yo: Bayi ni Esekieli jẹ àmi fun nyin: gẹgẹ bi gbogbo ohun ti o ṣe, li ẹ o si ṣe nigbati eyi bá si de, ẹnyin o si mọ̀ pe emi li Oluwa Ọlọrun:
entries.en: Thus Ezekiel is unto you a sign: according to all that he hath done shall ye do: and when this cometh, ye shall know that I am the Lord GOD.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu, iwọ ọmọ enia, kì yio ha ṣe pe, ni ijọ na nigbati mo ba gbà agbara wọn, ayọ̀ ogo wọn, ifẹ oju wọn, ati eyiti nwọn gbe ọkàn wọn le, ọmọ wọn ọkunrin, ati ọmọ wọn obinrin, kuro lọdọ wọn,
entries.en: Also, thou son of man, shall it not be in the day when I take from them their strength, the joy of their glory, the desire of their eyes, and that whereupon they set their minds, their sons and their daughters,

entries.yo: Ti ẹniti ti o ba sálà nijọ na, yio tọ̀ ọ wá, lati jẹ ki iwọ ki o fi eti ara rẹ gbọ́?
entries.en: That he that escapeth in that day shall come unto thee, to cause thee to hear it with thine ears?

entries.yo: Li ọjọ na li ẹnu rẹ yio ṣi si ẹni ti o sala, iwọ o si sọ̀rọ, iwọ kì yio si yadi mọ: iwọ o si jẹ àmi fun wọn; nwọn o si mọ̀ pe emi li Oluwa.
entries.en: In that day shall thy mouth be opened to him which is escaped, and thou shalt speak, and be no more dumb: and thou shalt be a sign unto them; and they shall know that I am the LORD.

entries.yo: Ọ̀RỌ Oluwa tún tọ̀ mi wá, wipe,
entries.en: The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,

entries.yo: Ọmọ enia, doju kọ awọn ara Ammoni, si sọtẹlẹ si wọn;
entries.en: Son of man, set thy face against the Ammonites, and prophesy against them;

entries.yo: Si wi fun awọn ara Ammoni pe, Ẹ gbọ́ ọ̀rọ Oluwa Ọlọrun: Bayi ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Nitori ti iwọ wipe, Aha, si ibi mimọ́ mi, nigbati o di àilọwọ, ati si ilẹ Israeli, nigbati o di ahoro; ati si ilẹ Juda, nigbati nwọn lọ ni ìgbekun;
entries.en: And say unto the Ammonites, Hear the word of the Lord GOD; Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thou saidst, Aha, against my sanctuary, when it was profaned; and against the land of Israel, when it was desolate; and against the house of Judah, when they went into captivity;

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, nitorina emi o fi ọ le awọn enia ilà-õrùn lọwọ fun ini, nwọn o si gbe ãfin wọn kalẹ ninu rẹ, nwọn o si ṣe ibugbe wọn ninu rẹ: nwọn o jẹ eso rẹ, nwọn o si mu wàra rẹ.
entries.en: Behold, therefore I will deliver thee to the men of the east for a possession, and they shall set their palaces in thee, and make their dwellings in thee: they shall eat thy fruit, and they shall drink thy milk.

entries.yo: Emi o si sọ Rabba di ibujẹ fun ibakasiẹ, ati awọn ọmọ Ammoni di ibùsun fun agbo-ẹran: ẹnyin o si mọ̀ pe emi li Oluwa.
entries.en: And I will make Rabbah a stable for camels, and the Ammonites a couchingplace for flocks: and ye shall know that I am the LORD.

entries.yo: Nitori bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Nitoriti iwọ ti pa atẹ́wọ, ti o si ti fi ẹsẹ kì ilẹ, ti o si yọ̀ li ọkàn pẹlu gbogbo aránkan rẹ si ilẹ Israeli:
entries.en: For thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thou hast clapped thine hands, and stamped with the feet, and rejoiced in heart with all thy despite against the land of Israel;

entries.yo: Kiye si i, nitorina, emi o nà ọwọ́ mi le ọ, emi o si fi ọ fun awọn keferi fun ikogun; emi o si ke ọ kuro lãrin awọn enia, emi o si jẹ ki o ṣegbé kuro ninu ilẹ gbogbo: emi o pa ọ run; iwọ o si mọ̀ pe emi li Oluwa.
entries.en: Behold, therefore I will stretch out mine hand upon thee, and will deliver thee for a spoil to the heathen; and I will cut thee off from the people, and I will cause thee to perish out of the countries: I will destroy thee; and thou shalt know that I am the LORD.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Nitoripe Moabu ati Seiri wipe, Kiye si i, ile Juda dabi gbogbo awọn keferi;
entries.en: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because that Moab and Seir do say, Behold, the house of Judah is like unto all the heathen;

entries.yo: Nitorina, kiye si i, emi o ṣi ìha Moabu kuro lati awọn ilu gbogbo, kuro ninu awọn ilu rẹ̀ ti o wà li àgbegbe rẹ̀, ogo ilẹ na, Bet-jeṣimoti, Baalimeoni, ati Kiri-ataimu,
entries.en: Therefore, behold, I will open the side of Moab from the cities, from his cities which are on his frontiers, the glory of the country, Beth-jeshimoth, Baal-meon, and Kiriathaim,

entries.yo: Fun awọn ọmọ ìla-orun, pẹlu awọn ara Ammoni, emi o si fi wọn fun ni ni iní; ki a má ba ranti awọn ara Ammoni lãrin orilẹ-ède mọ.
entries.en: Unto the men of the east with the Ammonites, and will give them in possession, that the Ammonites may not be remembered among the nations.

entries.yo: Emi o si mu idajọ ṣẹ si Moabu lara, nwọn o si mọ̀ pe emi li Oluwa.
entries.en: And I will execute judgments upon Moab; and they shall know that I am the LORD.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Nitoripe Edomu ti huwà si ile Juda nipa gbigba ẹsan, o si ti ṣẹ̀ gidigidi, o si gbẹ̀san ara rẹ̀ lara wọn.
entries.en: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because that Edom hath dealt against the house of Judah by taking vengeance, and hath greatly offended, and revenged himself upon them;

entries.yo: Nitorina, bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; emi pẹlu yio nawọ mi si Edomu, emi o si ke enia ati ẹranko kuro ninu rẹ̀; emi o si sọ ọ di ahoro lati Temani; ati awọn ti Dedani, yio ti ipa idà ṣubu.
entries.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; I will also stretch out mine hand upon Edom, and will cut off man and beast from it; and I will make it desolate from Teman; and they of Dedan shall fall by the sword.

entries.yo: Emi o si gbe ẹ̀san mi le ori Edomu lati ọwọ́ Israeli enia mi: nwọn o si ṣe ni Edomu gẹgẹ bi ibinu mi, ati gẹgẹ bi irúnu mi; nwọn o si mọ̀ ẹ̀san mi, li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi.
entries.en: And I will lay my vengeance upon Edom by the hand of my people Israel: and they shall do in Edom according to mine anger and according to my fury; and they shall know my vengeance, saith the Lord GOD.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Nitori ti awọn ara Filistia ti lò ilo ẹsan, ti nwọn si ti fi ọkàn ti o kún fun arankàn gbẹsan, lati pa a run, nitori irira atijọ.
entries.en: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because the Philistines have dealt by revenge, and have taken vengeance with a despiteful heart, to destroy it for the old hatred;

entries.yo: Nitorina, bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Kiyesi i, emi o nà ọwọ́ mi le awọn ara Filistia, emi o si ke awọn ara Keriti kuro, emi o si run awọn iyokù ti eti okun.
entries.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will stretch out mine hand upon the Philistines, and I will cut off the Cherethims, and destroy the remnant of the sea coast.

entries.yo: Emi o si san ẹsan nla lara wọn nipa ibáwi gbigbona; nwọn o si mọ̀ pe, emi li Oluwa, nigbati emi o gbe ẹsan mi le wọn.
entries.en: And I will execute great vengeance upon them with furious rebukes; and they shall know that I am the LORD, when I shall lay my vengeance upon them.

entries.yo: O si ṣe li ọdun kọkanla, li oṣu ikini, ọ̀rọ Oluwa tọ̀ mi wá, wipe,
entries.en: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the first day of the month, that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

entries.yo: Ọmọ enia, nitoriti Tire ti sọ̀rọ si Jerusalemu, pe, Aha, a fọ́ eyiti iṣe bode awọn orilẹ-ède: a yi i pada si mi, emi o di kikún, on di ahoro:
entries.en: Son of man, because that Tyrus hath said against Jerusalem, Aha, she is broken that was the gates of the people: she is turned unto me: I shall be replenished, now she is laid waste:

entries.yo: Nitorina bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; kiyesi i, mo doju kọ ọ, iwọ Tire, emi o si jẹ ki orilẹ-ède pupọ dide si ọ, gẹgẹ bi okun ti igbé ríru rẹ̀ soke.
entries.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I am against thee, O Tyrus, and will cause many nations to come up against thee, as the sea causeth his waves to come up.

entries.yo: Nwọn o si wó odi Tire lulẹ, nwọn o si wó ile iṣọ́ rẹ̀ lulẹ; emi o si há erùpẹ rẹ̀ kuro lara rẹ̀, emi o si ṣe e bi ori apata.
entries.en: And they shall destroy the walls of Tyrus, and break down her towers: I will also scrape her dust from her, and make her like the top of a rock.

entries.yo: Yio jẹ ibi ninà awọ̀n si lãrin okun: nitori mo ti sọ ọ, li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi: yio si di ikogun fun awọn orilẹ-ède.
entries.en: It shall be a place for the spreading of nets in the midst of the sea: for I have spoken it, saith the Lord GOD: and it shall become a spoil to the nations.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọbinrin rẹ̀ ti o wà li oko, li a o fi idà pa; nwọn o si mọ̀ pe emi li Oluwa.
entries.en: And her daughters which are in the field shall be slain by the sword; and they shall know that I am the LORD.

entries.yo: Nitori bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Kiyesi i, emi o mu Nebukadnessari ọba Babiloni, ọba awọn ọba, wá si Tire, lati ariwa, pẹlu ẹṣin, ati kẹkẹ́ ogun, ati ẹlẹṣin, ati ẹgbẹ́, ati enia pupọ.
entries.en: For thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will bring upon Tyrus Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, a king of kings, from the north, with horses, and with chariots, and with horsemen, and companies, and much people.

entries.yo: Yio fi idà pa awọn ọmọbinrin rẹ li oko: yio si kọ kũkũ tì ọ, yio si mọ odi tì ọ, yio si gbe apata soke si ọ.
entries.en: He shall slay with the sword thy daughters in the field: and he shall make a fort against thee, and cast a mount against thee, and lift up the buckler against thee.

entries.yo: Yio si gbe ohun-ẹrọ ogun tì odi rẹ, yio si fi ãke rẹ̀ wó ile-iṣọ́ rẹ lulẹ.
entries.en: And he shall set engines of war against thy walls, and with his axes he shall break down thy towers.

entries.yo: Nitori ọ̀pọ awọn ẹṣin rẹ̀ ẽkuru wọn yio bò ọ: odi rẹ yio mì nipa ariwo awọn ẹlẹṣin, ati kẹkẹ́, ati kẹkẹ́ ogun, nigbati yio wọ̀ inu odi rẹ lọ, gẹgẹ bi enia ti wọ̀ inu ilu ti a fọ́.
entries.en: By reason of the abundance of his horses their dust shall cover thee: thy walls shall shake at the noise of the horsemen, and of the wheels, and of the chariots, when he shall enter into thy gates, as men enter into a city wherein is made a breach.

entries.yo: Pátakò ẹṣin rẹ̀ ni yio fi tẹ̀ gbogbo ìta rẹ mọlẹ: on o fi idà pa awọn enia rẹ, ati ọwọ̀n lile rẹ yio wó lulẹ.
entries.en: With the hoofs of his horses shall he tread down all thy streets: he shall slay thy people by the sword, and thy strong garrisons shall go down to the ground.

entries.yo: Nwọn o si fi ọrọ̀ rẹ ṣe ikogun, ati òwo rẹ ṣe ijẹ ogun; nwọn o si wo odi rẹ lulẹ, nwọn o si bà ile rẹ daradara jẹ: nwọn o si ko okuta rẹ, ati ìti igi-ìkọle rẹ, ati erùpẹ rẹ, dà si ãrin omi.
entries.en: And they shall make a spoil of thy riches, and make a prey of thy merchandise: and they shall break down thy walls, and destroy thy pleasant houses: and they shall lay thy stones and thy timber and thy dust in the midst of the water.

entries.yo: Emi o si mu ariwo orin rẹ dakẹ; ati iró dùru rẹ li a kì yio gbọ́ mọ.
entries.en: And I will cause the noise of thy songs to cease; and the sound of thy harps shall be no more heard.

entries.yo: Emi o si ṣe ọ bi ori apáta; iwọ o si jẹ ibi lati nà awọ̀n le lori; a kì yio kọ́ ọ mọ: nitori emi Oluwa li o ti sọ ọ, li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi.
entries.en: And I will make thee like the top of a rock: thou shalt be a place to spread nets upon; thou shalt be built no more: for I the LORD have spoken it, saith the Lord GOD.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi si Tire; awọn erekùṣu kì yio ha mì-titi nipa iró iṣubu rẹ, nigbati awọn ti o gbọgbẹ́ kigbe, nigbati a ṣe ipani li ãrin rẹ?
entries.en: Thus saith the Lord GOD to Tyrus; Shall not the isles shake at the sound of thy fall, when the wounded cry, when the slaughter is made in the midst of thee?

entries.yo: Nigbana li awọn ọmọ-alade okun yio sọ̀kalẹ kuro lori itẹ́ wọn, nwọn o si pa aṣọ igunwà wọn tì, nwọn o si bọ́ ẹ̀wu oniṣẹ-ọnà wọn: nwọn o fi ìwariri bò ara wọn; nwọn o joko lori ilẹ, nwọn o si warìri nigba-gbogbo, ẹnu o si yà wọn si ọ.
entries.en: Then all the princes of the sea shall come down from their thrones, and lay away their robes, and put off their broidered garments: they shall clothe themselves with trembling; they shall sit upon the ground, and shall tremble at every moment, and be astonished at thee.

entries.yo: Nwọn o si pohunrere-ẹkun fun ọ, nwọn o si wi fun ọ pe, Bawo li ati pa ọ run, iwọ ti awọn èro okun ti ngbe inu rẹ̀, ilu olokikí, ti o lagbara li okun, on ati awọn ti o gbe inu rẹ̀, ẹniti o mu ẹ̀ru wọn wá sara gbogbo awọn ti o pàra ninu rẹ!
entries.en: And they shall take up a lamentation for thee, and say to thee, How art thou destroyed, that wast inhabited of seafaring men, the renowned city, which wast strong in the sea, she and her inhabitants, which cause their terror to be on all that haunt it!

entries.yo: Nisisiyi ni awọn erekùṣu yio warìri li ọjọ iṣubu rẹ; nitõtọ, awọn erekùṣu ti o wà ninu okun li a o yọ lẹnu nigba atilọ rẹ.
entries.en: Now shall the isles tremble in the day of thy fall; yea, the isles that are in the sea shall be troubled at thy departure.

entries.yo: Nitori bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Nigbati emi o sọ ọ di ahoro ilu, gẹgẹ bi ilu wọnni ti a kò gbe inu wọn; nigbati emi o si mu ibú wá sori rẹ, ati omi nla yio si bò ọ.
entries.en: For thus saith the Lord GOD; When I shall make thee a desolate city, like the cities that are not inhabited; when I shall bring up the deep upon thee, and great waters shall cover thee;

entries.yo: Nigbati emi o bá mu ọ walẹ pẹlu awọn ti o sọkalẹ sinu ihò, pẹlu awọn enia igbãni, ti emi o si gbe ọ kà ibi isalẹ ilẹ aiye, ni ibi ahoro igbãni, pẹlu awọn ti o sọkalẹ lọ si ihò, ki a máṣe gbe inu rẹ mọ́: emi o si gbe ogo kalẹ ni ilẹ awọn alãye;
entries.en: When I shall bring thee down with them that descend into the pit, with the people of old time, and shall set thee in the low parts of the earth, in places desolate of old, with them that go down to the pit, that thou be not inhabited; and I shall set glory in the land of the living;

entries.yo: Emi o si ṣe ọ ni ẹ̀ru, iwọ kì yio si si mọ́: bi a tilẹ wá ọ, sibẹ a kì yio tun ri ọ mọ́, li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi.
entries.en: I will make thee a terror, and thou shalt be no more: though thou be sought for, yet shalt thou never be found again, saith the Lord GOD.

entries.yo: Ọ̀RỌ Oluwa tun tọ̀ mi wá, wipe,
entries.en: The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,

entries.yo: Nisisiyi, iwọ ọmọ enia, pohunrere ẹkun fun Tire;
entries.en: Now, thou son of man, take up a lamentation for Tyrus;

entries.yo: Ki o si wi fun Tire pe, Iwọ ti a tẹ̀do si ẹnu-ọ̀na okun, oniṣòwo awọn orilẹ-ède fun ọ̀pọlọpọ erekùṣu, Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Iwọ Tire, iwọ ti wipe, emi pé li ẹwà.
entries.en: And say unto Tyrus, O thou that art situate at the entry of the sea, which art a merchant of the people for many isles, Thus saith the Lord GOD; O Tyrus, thou hast said, I am of perfect beauty.

entries.yo: Àlà rẹ wà li ãrin okun, awọn ọ̀mọle rẹ ti mu ẹwà rẹ pé.
entries.en: Thy borders are in the midst of the seas, thy builders have perfected thy beauty.

entries.yo: Nwọn ti fi apako firi ti Seniri kàn gbogbo ọkọ̀ rẹ, nwọn ti mu kedari ti Lebanoni wá lati fi ṣe opó ọkọ̀ fun ọ.
entries.en: They have made all thy ship boards of fir trees of Senir: they have taken cedars from Lebanon to make masts for thee.

entries.yo: Ninu igi oaku ti Baṣani ni nwọn ti fi gbẹ́ àjẹ rẹ; ijoko rẹ ni nwọn fi ehin-erin ṣe pelu igi boksi lati erekuṣu Kittimu wá.
entries.en: Of the oaks of Bashan have they made thine oars; the company of the Ashurites have made thy benches of ivory, brought out of the isles of Chittim.

entries.yo: Ọ̀gbọ daradara iṣẹ-ọnà lati Egipti wá li eyiti iwọ ta fi ṣe igbokun rẹ; aṣọ aláro ati purpili lati erekusu Eliṣa wá li eyiti a fi bò ọ.
entries.en: Fine linen with broidered work from Egypt was that which thou spreadest forth to be thy sail; blue and purple from the isles of Elishah was that which covered thee.

entries.yo: Awọn ara ilu Sidoni ati Arfadi ni awọn ara ọkọ̀ rẹ̀: awọn ọlọgbọn rẹ, Iwọ Tire, ti o wà ninu rẹ, li awọn atọkọ̀ rẹ.
entries.en: The inhabitants of Zidon and Arvad were thy mariners: thy wise men, O Tyrus, that were in thee, were thy pilots.

entries.yo: Awọn àgba Gebali, ati awọn ọlọgbọn ibẹ̀, wà ninu rẹ bi adikọ̀ rẹ: gbogbo ọkọ̀ òkun pẹlu awọn ara ọkọ̀ wọn wà ninu rẹ lati ma ṣòwo rẹ.
entries.en: The ancients of Gebal and the wise men thereof were in thee thy calkers: all the ships of the sea with their mariners were in thee to occupy thy merchandise.

entries.yo: Awọn ti Persia, ati ti Ludi, ati ti Futi, wà ninu ogun rẹ, awọn ologun rẹ: nwọn fi apata ati ìbori-ogun kọ́ ninu rẹ; nwọn fi ẹwà rẹ hàn.
entries.en: They of Persia and of Lud and of Phut were in thine army, thy men of war: they hanged the shield and helmet in thee; they set forth thy comeliness.

entries.yo: Awọn enia Arfadi, pẹlu awọn ogun rẹ, wà lori odi rẹ yika, ati awọn akọ-jamã wà ni ile-iṣọ rẹ: nwọn fi apata kọ́ sara odi rẹ yika; nwọn ti ṣe ẹwà rẹ pé.
entries.en: The men of Arvad with thine army were upon thy walls round about, and the Gammadims were in thy towers: they hanged their shields upon thy walls round about; they have made thy beauty perfect.

entries.yo: Tarṣiṣi ni oniṣòwo rẹ nitori ọ̀pọlọpọ̀ ọ̀rọ̀ rẹ; pẹlu fadakà, irin, tánganran, ati ojé, nwọn ti ṣòwo li ọja rẹ.
entries.en: Tarshish was thy merchant by reason of the multitude of all kind of riches; with silver, iron, tin, and lead, they traded in thy fairs.

entries.yo: Jafani, Tubali, ati Meṣeki, awọn li awọn oniṣòwo rẹ: nwọn ti fi ẹrú ati ohun-elò idẹ ṣòwo li ọjà rẹ.
entries.en: Javan, Tubal, and Meshech, they were thy merchants: they traded the persons of men and vessels of brass in thy market.

entries.yo: Awọn ti ile Togarma fi ẹṣin, ati ẹlẹṣin ati ibaka ṣòwo li ọjà rẹ.
entries.en: They of the house of Togarmah traded in thy fairs with horses and horsemen and mules.

entries.yo: Awọn enia Dedani li awọn oniṣòwo rẹ; ọ̀pọlọpọ erekuṣu ni mba ọ ṣòwo, nwọn mu ehin-erin ati igi eboni wá fun ọ lati rà.
entries.en: The men of Dedan were thy merchants; many isles were the merchandise of thine hand: they brought thee for a present horns of ivory and ebony.

entries.yo: Siria li oniṣòwo rẹ nitori ọ̀pọlọpọ iṣẹ ọwọ́ rẹ: nwọn ntà emeraldi li ọjà rẹ, pẹlu purpili, ati iṣẹ oniṣẹ-ọnà, ati ọ̀gbọ daradara, ati iyùn, ati agate.
entries.en: Syria was thy merchant by reason of the multitude of the wares of thy making: they occupied in thy fairs with emeralds, purple, and broidered work, and fine linen, and coral, and agate.

entries.yo: Juda, ati ilẹ Israeli, awọn li awọn oniṣòwo rẹ, alikama ti Minniti, ati Pannagi, ati oyin, ati ororo, ati balmu, ni nwọn fi ná ọjà rẹ.
entries.en: Judah, and the land of Israel, they were thy merchants: they traded in thy market wheat of Minnith, and Pannag, and honey, and oil, and balm.

entries.yo: Damasku li oniṣòwo rẹ nitori ọ̀pọlọpọ ohun ọjà ti o ṣe, nitori ọ̀pọlọpọ ọrọ̀; ni ọti-waini ti Helboni, ati irun agutan funfun.
entries.en: Damascus was thy merchant in the multitude of the wares of thy making, for the multitude of all riches; in the wine of Helbon, and white wool.

entries.yo: Dani pẹlu ati Jafani lati Usali ngbé ọjà rẹ: irin didán, kassia, ati kalamu wà li ọjà rẹ.
entries.en: Dan also and Javan going to and fro occupied in thy fairs: bright iron, cassia, and calamus, were in thy market.

entries.yo: Dedani ni oniṣòwo rẹ ni aṣọ ibori fun kẹkẹ́.
entries.en: Dedan was thy merchant in precious clothes for chariots.

entries.yo: Arabia, ati gbogbo awọn ọmọ-alade Kedari, awọn ni awọn oniṣòwo rẹ, ni ọdọ-agutan, ati agbò, ati ewurẹ; ninu wọnyi ni nwọn ṣe oniṣòwo rẹ.
entries.en: Arabia, and all the princes of Kedar, they occupied with thee in lambs, and rams, and goats: in these were they thy merchants.

entries.yo: Awọn oniṣòwo Ṣeba ati Rama, awọn li awọn oniṣòwo rẹ: nwọn tà onirũru turari daradara li ọjà rẹ, ati pẹlu onirũru okuta oniyebiye, ati wura.
entries.en: The merchants of Sheba and Raamah, they were thy merchants: they occupied in thy fairs with chief of all spices, and with all precious stones, and gold.

entries.yo: Harani, ati Kanneh, ati Edeni, awọn oniṣòwo Ṣeba, Assuru, ati Kilmadi, ni awọn oniṣòwo rẹ.
entries.en: Haran, and Canneh, and Eden, the merchants of Sheba, Assur, and Chilmad, were thy merchants.

entries.yo: Wọnyi li awọn oniṣòwo rẹ li onirũru nkan, ni aṣọ alaro, ati oniṣẹ-ọnà, ati apoti aṣọ oniyebiye, ti a fi okùn dì, ti a si fi igi kedari ṣe, ninu awọn oniṣòwo rẹ.
entries.en: These were thy merchants in all sorts of things, in blue clothes, and broidered work, and in chests of rich apparel, bound with cords, and made of cedar, among thy merchandise.

entries.yo: Awọn ọkọ Tarṣiṣi ni èro li ọjà rẹ: a ti mu ọ rẹ̀ si i, a si ti ṣe ọ logo li ãrin okun.
entries.en: The ships of Tarshish did sing of thee in thy market: and thou wast replenished, and made very glorious in the midst of the seas.

entries.yo: Awọn atukọ̀ rẹ ti mu ọ wá sinu omi nla: ẹfũfu ilà-õrun ti fọ́ ọ li ãrin okun.
entries.en: Thy rowers have brought thee into great waters: the east wind hath broken thee in the midst of the seas.

entries.yo: Ọrọ̀ rẹ ati ọjà rẹ, ọjà tità rẹ, awọn atukọ̀ rẹ, ati atọ́kọ̀ rẹ, adikọ̀ rẹ, ati awọn alábarà rẹ, ati gbogbo awọn ologun rẹ, ti o wà ninu rẹ, ati ninu gbogbo ẹgbẹ́ rẹ, ti o wà li ãrin rẹ, yio ṣubu li ãrin okun li ọjọ iparun rẹ.
entries.en: Thy riches, and thy fairs, thy merchandise, thy mariners, and thy pilots, thy calkers, and the occupiers of thy merchandise, and all thy men of war, that are in thee, and in all thy company which is in the midst of thee, shall fall into the midst of the seas in the day of thy ruin.

entries.yo: Awọn ilẹ àgbègbe yio mì nitori iró igbe awọn atọkọ̀ rẹ.
entries.en: The suburbs shall shake at the sound of the cry of thy pilots.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn alajẹ̀, awọn atukọ̀, ati awọn atọ́kọ̀ okun yio sọkalẹ kuro ninu ọkọ̀ wọn, nwọn o duro lori ilẹ.
entries.en: And all that handle the oar, the mariners, and all the pilots of the sea, shall come down from their ships, they shall stand upon the land;

entries.yo: Nwọn o si jẹ ki a gbọ́ ohùn wọn si ọ, nwọn o si kigbe kikoro, nwọn o si kù ekuru sori ara wọn, nwọn o si yi ara wọn ninu ẽru:
entries.en: And shall cause their voice to be heard against thee, and shall cry bitterly, and shall cast up dust upon their heads, they shall wallow themselves in the ashes:

entries.yo: Nwọn o si fari wọn patapata fun ọ, nwọn o si fi aṣọ-àpo di ara wọn, nwọn o si sọkun fun ọ ni ikorò aiya, pẹlu ohùnrére ẹkun kikorò.
entries.en: And they shall make themselves utterly bald for thee, and gird them with sackcloth, and they shall weep for thee with bitterness of heart and bitter wailing.

entries.yo: Ati ninu arò wọn ni nwọn o si pohùnrére ẹkún fun ọ, nwọn o si pohùnrére ẹkún sori rẹ, wipe, Ta li o dabi Tire, eyiti a parun li ãrin okun?
entries.en: And in their wailing they shall take up a lamentation for thee, and lament over thee, saying, What city is like Tyrus, like the destroyed in the midst of the sea?

entries.yo: Nigbati ọjà-tità rẹ ti okun jade wá, iwọ tẹ́ orilẹ-ède pupọ lọrun; iwọ fi ọ̀pọlọpọ ọrọ̀ rẹ, ati ọjà rẹ, sọ awọn ọba aiye di ọlọrọ̀.
entries.en: When thy wares went forth out of the seas, thou filledst many people; thou didst enrich the kings of the earth with the multitude of thy riches and of thy merchandise.

entries.yo: Nisisiyi ti okun fọ́ ọ bajẹ̀ ninu ibú omi, nitorina òwo rẹ, ati gbogbo ẹgbẹ́ rẹ li ãrin rẹ, li o ṣubu.
entries.en: In the time when thou shalt be broken by the seas in the depths of the waters thy merchandise and all thy company in the midst of thee shall fall.

entries.yo: Ẹnu yio yà gbogbo awọn olugbe erekuṣu wọnni si ọ, awọn ọba wọn yio si dijì, iyọnu yio yọ li oju wọn.
entries.en: All the inhabitants of the isles shall be astonished at thee, and their kings shall be sore afraid, they shall be troubled in their countenance.

entries.yo: Awọn oniṣòwo lãrin awọn orilẹ-ède yio dún bi ejò si ọ; iwọ o si jẹ ẹ̀ru, iwọ kì yio si si mọ́ lailai.
entries.en: The merchants among the people shall hiss at thee; thou shalt be a terror, and never shalt be any more.

entries.yo: Ọ̀RỌ Oluwa tun tọ̀ mi wá, wipe,
entries.en: The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,

entries.yo: Ọmọ enia, sọ fun ọmọ-alade Tire pe, Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Nitori ti ọkàn rẹ gbe soke, ati ti iwọ si wipe, Ọlọrun li emi, emi joko ni ibujoko Ọlọrun, larin okun; ṣugbọn enia ni iwọ, iwọ kì isi ṣe Ọlọrun, bi o tilẹ gbe ọkàn rẹ soke bi ọkàn Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Son of man, say unto the prince of Tyrus, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thine heart is lifted up, and thou hast said, I am a God, I sit in the seat of God, in the midst of the seas; yet thou art a man, and not God, though thou set thine heart as the heart of God:

entries.yo: Wo o, iwọ sa gbọn ju Danieli lọ; kò si si ohun ikọ̀kọ ti o le fi ara sin fun ọ.
entries.en: Behold, thou art wiser than Daniel; there is no secret that they can hide from thee:

entries.yo: Ọgbọ́n rẹ ati oye rẹ li o fi ni ọrọ̀, o si ti ni wura ati fadáka sinu iṣura rẹ:
entries.en: With thy wisdom and with thine understanding thou hast gotten thee riches, and hast gotten gold and silver into thy treasures:

entries.yo: Nipa ọgbọ́n rẹ nla ati nipa òwo rẹ li o ti fi sọ ọrọ̀ rẹ di púpọ, ọkàn rẹ si gbe soke nitori ọrọ̀ rẹ.
entries.en: By thy great wisdom and by thy traffick hast thou increased thy riches, and thine heart is lifted up because of thy riches:

entries.yo: Nitorina bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Nitoriti o ti ṣe ọkàn rẹ bi ọkàn Ọlọrun;
entries.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thou hast set thine heart as the heart of God;

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, nitorina emi o mu alejo wá ba ọ, ẹlẹ̀ru ninu awọn orilẹ-ède: nwọn o si fà idà wọn yọ si ẹwà ọgbọ́n rẹ, nwọn o si bà didán rẹ jẹ.
entries.en: Behold, therefore I will bring strangers upon thee, the terrible of the nations: and they shall draw their swords against the beauty of thy wisdom, and they shall defile thy brightness.
