entries.yo: Nwọn o mu ọ sọkalẹ wá sinu ihò, iwọ o si kú ikú awọn ti a pa li ãrin okun.
entries.en: They shall bring thee down to the pit, and thou shalt die the deaths of them that are slain in the midst of the seas.

entries.yo: Iwọ ha le sọ sibẹ niwaju ẹni ti npa ọ, pe, Emi li Ọlọrun? ṣugbọn enia ni iwọ, o kì yio si jẹ Ọlọrun, lọwọ ẹniti npa ọ.
entries.en: Wilt thou yet say before him that slayeth thee, I am God? but thou shalt be a man, and no God, in the hand of him that slayeth thee.

entries.yo: Iwọ o kú ikú awọn alaikọlà lọwọ awọn alejo: nitori emi li o ti sọ ọ, li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi.
entries.en: Thou shalt die the deaths of the uncircumcised by the hand of strangers: for I have spoken it, saith the Lord GOD.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ Oluwa si tun tọ̀ mi wá, wipe,
entries.en: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

entries.yo: Ọmọ enia, pohùnréré sori ọba Tire, ki o si wi fun u pe, Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Iwọ fi edidi dí iye na, o kún fun ọgbọ́n, o si pé li ẹwà.
entries.en: Son of man, take up a lamentation upon the king of Tyrus, and say unto him, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Thou sealest up the sum, full of wisdom, and perfect in beauty.

entries.yo: Iwọ ti wà ni Edeni ọgbà Ọlọrun; oniruru okuta iyebiye ni ibora rẹ, sardiu, topasi, ati diamondi, berili, oniki, ati jasperi, safire, emeraldi, ati karbunkili, ati wura: iṣẹ ìlu rẹ ati ti fère rẹ li a pèse ninu rẹ li ọjọ ti a dá ọ.
entries.en: Thou hast been in Eden the garden of God; every precious stone was thy covering, the sardius, topaz, and the diamond, the beryl, the onyx, and the jasper, the sapphire, the emerald, and the carbuncle, and gold: the workmanship of thy tabrets and of thy pipes was prepared in thee in the day that thou wast created.

entries.yo: Iwọ ni kerubu ti a nà ti o si bò; emi si ti gbe ọ kalẹ: iwọ wà lori oke mimọ́ Ọlọrun; iwọ ti rìn soke rìn sodò lãrin okuta iná.
entries.en: Thou art the anointed cherub that covereth; and I have set thee so: thou wast upon the holy mountain of God; thou hast walked up and down in the midst of the stones of fire.

entries.yo: Iwọ pé li ọnà rẹ lati ọjọ ti a ti dá ọ, titi a fi ri aiṣedẽde ninu rẹ.
entries.en: Thou wast perfect in thy ways from the day that thou wast created, till iniquity was found in thee.

entries.yo: Nitori ọ̀pọlọpọ òwo rẹ, nwọn ti fi iwà-ipa kún ãrin rẹ, iwọ si ti ṣẹ̀: nitorina li emi o ṣe sọ ọ nù bi ohun ailọ̀wọ kuro li oke Ọlọrun: emi o si pa ọ run, iwọ kerubu ti o bò, kuro lãrin okuta iná.
entries.en: By the multitude of thy merchandise they have filled the midst of thee with violence, and thou hast sinned: therefore I will cast thee as profane out of the mountain of God: and I will destroy thee, O covering cherub, from the midst of the stones of fire.

entries.yo: Ọkàn rẹ gbe soke nitori ẹwà rẹ, o ti bà ọgbọ́n rẹ jẹ nitori dídan rẹ; emi o bì ọ lulẹ, emi o gbe ọ kalẹ niwaju awọn ọba, ki nwọn ba le wò ọ.
entries.en: Thine heart was lifted up because of thy beauty, thou hast corrupted thy wisdom by reason of thy brightness: I will cast thee to the ground, I will lay thee before kings, that they may behold thee.

entries.yo: Iwọ ti bà ibi mimọ́ rẹ jẹ nipa ọ̀pọlọpọ aiṣedẽde rẹ, nipa aiṣedẽde òwo rẹ; nitorina emi o mu iná jade lati ãrin rẹ wá, yio jó ọ run, emi o si sọ ọ di ẽru lori ilẹ loju gbogbo awọn ti o wò ọ:
entries.en: Thou hast defiled thy sanctuaries by the multitude of thine iniquities, by the iniquity of thy traffick; therefore will I bring forth a fire from the midst of thee, it shall devour thee, and I will bring thee to ashes upon the earth in the sight of all them that behold thee.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn ti o mọ̀ ọ lãrin awọn orilẹ-ède li ẹnu o yà si ọ: iwọ o jẹ ẹ̀ru, iwọ kì yio si si mọ́ lailai.
entries.en: All they that know thee among the people shall be astonished at thee: thou shalt be a terror, and never shalt thou be any more.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ Oluwa tun tọ̀ mi wá, wipe,
entries.en: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

entries.yo: Ọmọ enia, gbé oju rẹ si Sidoni, ki o si sọtẹlẹ si i,
entries.en: Son of man, set thy face against Zidon, and prophesy against it,

entries.yo: Si wipe, Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Sa wò o, Emi doju kọ ọ, iwọ Sidoni; a o si ṣe mi logo li ãrin rẹ, nwọn o si mọ̀ pe emi li Oluwa, nigbati emi o bá ti mu idajọ mi ṣẹ ninu rẹ̀, ti a o si yà mi si mimọ́ ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I am against thee, O Zidon; and I will be glorified in the midst of thee: and they shall know that I am the LORD, when I shall have executed judgments in her, and shall be sanctified in her.

entries.yo: Emi o si rán àjakálẹ àrun sinu rẹ̀, ati ẹjẹ ni igboro rẹ̀; a o si fi idà pa awọn si a ṣá li ọgbẹ li ãrin rẹ̀ lori rẹ̀ nihà gbogbo; nwọn o si mọ̀ pe emi li Oluwa.
entries.en: For I will send into her pestilence, and blood into her streets; and the wounded shall be judged in the midst of her by the sword upon her on every side; and they shall know that I am the LORD.

entries.yo: Kì yio si si ẹgún ti ngún ni fun ile Israeli mọ́, tabi ẹgún bibani ninu jẹ́ ti gbogbo awọn ti o yi wọn ká, ti o si ṣãtá wọn; nwọn o si mọ̀ pe emi li Oluwa Ọlọrun.
entries.en: And there shall be no more a pricking brier unto the house of Israel, nor any grieving thorn of all that are round about them, that despised them; and they shall know that I am the Lord GOD.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi, Nigbati emi o bá ti kó ile Israeli jọ kuro lãrin awọn orilẹ-ède ti a tú wọn ká si, ti a o si yà mi si mimọ́ ninu wọn loju awọn keferi, nigbana ni nwọn o gbé ilẹ wọn ti mo ti fi fun Jakobu iranṣẹ mi.
entries.en: Thus saith the Lord GOD; When I shall have gathered the house of Israel from the people among whom they are scattered, and shall be sanctified in them in the sight of the heathen, then shall they dwell in their land that I have given to my servant Jacob.

entries.yo: Nwọn o si ma gbé inu rẹ̀ ni ibalẹ-aiya, nwọn o si kọ́ ile, nwọn o si gbìn ọgbà àjara; nitõtọ, nwọn o wà ni ibalẹ-aiya, nigbati emi bá ti mu idajọ mi ṣẹ si ara awọn ti ngàn wọn yi wọn kakiri, nwọn o si mọ̀ pe emi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wọn.
entries.en: And they shall dwell safely therein, and shall build houses, and plant vineyards; yea, they shall dwell with confidence, when I have executed judgments upon all those that despise them round about them; and they shall know that I am the LORD their God.

entries.yo: LI ọdun kẹwa, li oṣù kẹwa, li ọjọ kejila oṣù, ọ̀rọ Oluwa tọ̀ mi wá, wipe,
entries.en: In the tenth year, in the tenth month, in the twelfth day of the month, the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

entries.yo: Ọmọ enia, kọ oju rẹ si Farao ọba Egipti, si sọtẹlẹ si i, ati si gbogbo Egipti:
entries.en: Son of man, set thy face against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and prophesy against him, and against all Egypt:

entries.yo: Sọ̀rọ, ki o si wipe, Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Kiyesi i, emi doju kọ ọ; Farao ọba Egipti, dragoni nla ti o dubulẹ li ãrin awọn odò rẹ̀, eyiti o ti wipe, Ti emi li odò mi, emi li o si ti wà a fun ara mi.
entries.en: Speak, and say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I am against thee, Pharaoh king of Egypt, the great dragon that lieth in the midst of his rivers, which hath said, My river is mine own, and I have made it for myself.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi o fi ìwọ kọ́ ọ li ẹ̀rẹkẹ́, emi o si jẹ ki ẹja odò rẹ ki o lẹ mọ́ ipẹ́ rẹ, emi o si mu ọ kuro li ãrin odò rẹ, ati gbogbo ẹja odò rẹ yio lẹ mọ́ ipẹ́ rẹ.
entries.en: But I will put hooks in thy jaws, and I will cause the fish of thy rivers to stick unto thy scales, and I will bring thee up out of the midst of thy rivers, and all the fish of thy rivers shall stick unto thy scales.

entries.yo: Emi o si sọ ọ nù si aginjù, iwọ ati gbogbo ẹja odò rẹ: iwọ o ṣubu ni gbangba oko: a kì yio si kó ọ jọ, bẹ̃li a kì yio si ṣà ọ jọ: emi ti fi ọ ṣe onjẹ fun awọn ẹranko igbẹ́, ati fun awọn ẹiyẹ oju ọrun.
entries.en: And I will leave thee thrown into the wilderness, thee and all the fish of thy rivers: thou shalt fall upon the open fields; thou shalt not be brought together, nor gathered: I have given thee for meat to the beasts of the field and to the fowls of the heaven.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn olugbé Egipti yio mọ̀ pe emi li Oluwa, nitori nwọn ti jẹ́ ọpá ìye fun ile Israeli.
entries.en: And all the inhabitants of Egypt shall know that I am the LORD, because they have been a staff of reed to the house of Israel.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn di ọ lọwọ mu, iwọ fọ́, o si ya gbogbo èjiká wọn: nigbati nwọn si fi ara tì ọ, iwọ ṣẹ́, o si mu gbogbo ẹgbẹ́ wọn gbọ̀n.
entries.en: When they took hold of thee by thy hand, thou didst break, and rend all their shoulder: and when they leaned upon thee, thou brakest, and madest all their loins to be at a stand.

entries.yo: Nitorina bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi, Kiyesi i, emi o mu idà kan wá sori rẹ, ti yio ké enia ati ẹranko kuro ninu rẹ.
entries.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will bring a sword upon thee, and cut off man and beast out of thee.

entries.yo: Ilẹ Egipti yio si di aginjù yio si di ahoro; nwọn o si mọ̀ pe emi li Oluwa: nitori ti o ti wipe, Odò na temi ni, emi li o si ti wà a.
entries.en: And the land of Egypt shall be desolate and waste; and they shall know that I am the LORD: because he hath said, The river is mine, and I have made it.

entries.yo: Nitorina, kiyesi i, emi dojukọ ọ, mo si dojukọ odò rẹ, emi o si sọ ilẹ Egipti di ahoro patapata, lati Migdoli lọ de Siene ati titi de ẹkùn Etiopia.
entries.en: Behold, therefore I am against thee, and against thy rivers, and I will make the land of Egypt utterly waste and desolate, from the tower of Syene even unto the border of Ethiopia.

entries.yo: Ẹsẹ enia kì yio kọja li ãrin rẹ̀, bẹ̃ni ẹsẹ ẹrankẹran kì yio kọja li ãrin rẹ̀, bẹ̃ni a kì yio tẹ̀ ẹ dó li ogoji ọdun.
entries.en: No foot of man shall pass through it, nor foot of beast shall pass through it, neither shall it be inhabited forty years.

entries.yo: Emi o si sọ ilẹ Egipti di ahoro li ãrin awọn ilẹ ti o di ahoro, ati ilu rẹ̀ yio si di ahoro li ãrin awọn ilu ti o di ahoro li ogoji ọdun: emi o si tú awọn ara Egipti ká sãrin gbogbo orilẹ-ède, emi o si tú wọn ká sãrin gbogbo ilẹ.
entries.en: And I will make the land of Egypt desolate in the midst of the countries that are desolate, and her cities among the cities that are laid waste shall be desolate forty years: and I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Lẹhin ogoji ọdun li emi o ko awọn ara Egipti jọ lati ọdọ awọn enia nibiti a ti tú wọn ká si:
entries.en: Yet thus saith the Lord GOD; At the end of forty years will I gather the Egyptians from the people whither they were scattered:

entries.yo: Emi o si tun mu igbèkun Egipti pada bọ̀, emi o si mu wọn pada si ilẹ Patrosi, si ilẹ ibí wọn, nwọn o si wà nibẹ bi ijọba ti a rẹ̀ silẹ.
entries.en: And I will bring again the captivity of Egypt, and will cause them to return into the land of Pathros, into the land of their habitation; and they shall be there a base kingdom.

entries.yo: Yio si jẹ ijọba ti o rẹ̀lẹ jù ninu awọn ijọba; bẹ̃ni kì yio si gbe ara rẹ̀ ga mọ́ sori awọn orilẹ-ède: nitori emi o dín wọn kù, ti nwọn kì yio fi ṣe olori awọn orilẹ-ède mọ́.
entries.en: It shall be the basest of the kingdoms; neither shall it exalt itself any more above the nations: for I will diminish them, that they shall no more rule over the nations.

entries.yo: Kì yio si jẹ igbẹkẹle fun ile Israeli mọ́, ti o mu aiṣedẽde wọn wá si iranti, nigbati nwọn o ba wò wọn: ṣugbọn nwọn o mọ̀ pe emi li Oluwa Ọlọrun.
entries.en: And it shall be no more the confidence of the house of Israel, which bringeth their iniquity to remembrance, when they shall look after them: but they shall know that I am the Lord GOD.

entries.yo: O si ṣe li ọdun kẹtadilọgbọ̀n, li oṣù ikini, li ọjọ ikini oṣù, ọ̀rọ Oluwa tọ̀ mi wá, wipe,
entries.en: And it came to pass in the seven and twentieth year, in the first month, in the first day of the month, the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

entries.yo: Ọmọ enia, Nebukadresari ọba Babiloni mu ki ogun rẹ̀ sìn irú nla si Tire: gbogbo ori pá, ati gbogbo èjiká bó: sibẹsibẹ on, ati awọn ogun rẹ̀, kò ri owo ọ̀ya gbà, lati Tire fun irú ti o ti sìn si i:
entries.en: Son of man, Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon caused his army to serve a great service against Tyrus: every head was made bald, and every shoulder was peeled: yet had he no wages, nor his army, for Tyrus, for the service that he had served against it:

entries.yo: Nitorina bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Kiyesi i, emi o fi ilẹ Egipti fun Nebukadresari ọba Babiloni; yio si kó awọn ọ̀pọlọpọ enia rẹ̀, ati ikógun rẹ̀, ati ijẹ rẹ̀; yio si jẹ owo ọ̀ya fun awọn ogun rẹ̀.
entries.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will give the land of Egypt unto Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon; and he shall take her multitude, and take her spoil, and take her prey; and it shall be the wages for his army.

entries.yo: Mo ti fi ilẹ Egipti fun u, fun irú ti o sìn si i, nitoriti nwọn ṣiṣẹ́ fun mi, li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi.
entries.en: I have given him the land of Egypt for his labour wherewith he served against it, because they wrought for me, saith the Lord GOD.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ na li emi o mu ki iwọ Israeli rú jade, emi o si fun ọ ni iṣínu li ãrin wọn; nwọn o si mọ̀ pe emi li Oluwa.
entries.en: In that day will I cause the horn of the house of Israel to bud forth, and I will give thee the opening of the mouth in the midst of them; and they shall know that I am the LORD.

entries.yo: Ọ̀RỌ Oluwa tun tọ̀ mi wá, wipe,
entries.en: The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,

entries.yo: Ọmọ enia, sọtẹlẹ ki o si wipe, Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Ẹ wu, Egbé fun ọjọ na!
entries.en: Son of man, prophesy and say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Howl ye, Woe worth the day

entries.yo: Nitori ọjọ na sunmọ tosí, ani ọjọ Oluwa sunmọ tosi, ọjọ ikũkũ ni; yio jẹ akoko ti awọn keferi.
entries.en: For the day is near, even the day of the LORD is near, a cloudy day; it shall be the time of the heathen.

entries.yo: Idà yio si wá sori Egipti, irora nla yio wà ni Etiopia, nigbati awọn ti a pa yio ṣubu ni Egipti, nwọn o si mu ọ̀pọlọpọ enia rẹ̀ lọ kuro, ipilẹ rẹ̀ yio si wó lulẹ.
entries.en: And the sword shall come upon Egypt, and great pain shall be in Ethiopia, when the slain shall fall in Egypt, and they shall take away her multitude, and her foundations shall be broken down.

entries.yo: Etiopia, ati Libia, ati Lidia, ati gbogbo awọn olùranlọ́wọ, ati Kubu, ati awọn enia ilẹ na ti o mulẹ yio ti ipa idà ṣubu pẹlu wọn.
entries.en: Ethiopia, and Libya, and Lydia, and all the mingled people, and Chub, and the men of the land that is in league, shall fall with them by the sword.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa wi; Awọn pẹlu ti nwọn gbe Egipti ró yio ṣubu; ati igberaga agbara rẹ̀ yio sọkalẹ: lati Migdoli lọ de Siene ni nwọn o ti ipà idà ṣubu ninu rẹ̀, li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD; They also that uphold Egypt shall fall; and the pride of her power shall come down: from the tower of Syene shall they fall in it by the sword, saith the Lord GOD.

entries.yo: Nwọn o si di ahoro li ãrin awọn ilẹ ti o di ahoro, ilu rẹ̀ yio si wà li àrin awọn ilu ti o di ahoro.
entries.en: And they shall be desolate in the midst of the countries that are desolate, and her cities shall be in the midst of the cities that are wasted.

entries.yo: Nwọn o si mọ̀ pe emi li Oluwa, nigbati mo bá gbe iná kalẹ ni Egipti, ti gbogbo awọn olùranlọ́wọ rẹ̀ bá parun.
entries.en: And they shall know that I am the LORD, when I have set a fire in Egypt, and when all her helpers shall be destroyed.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ na ni onṣẹ yio lọ lati ọdọ mi ninu ọkọ̀, lati dẹ̀ruba Etiopia ti o wà li alafia, irora yio wá sori wọn gẹgẹ bi li ọjọ Egipti: kiyesi i, o de.
entries.en: In that day shall messengers go forth from me in ships to make the careless Ethiopians afraid, and great pain shall come upon them, as in the day of Egypt: for, lo, it cometh.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; emi o si ṣe ki ọ̀pọlọpọ enia Egipti ki o ti ipa ọwọ́ Nebukaddressari ọba Babiloni dínkù.
entries.en: Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will also make the multitude of Egypt to cease by the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon.

entries.yo: On ati enia rẹ̀ pẹlu rẹ̀, ẹ̀ru awọn orilẹ-ède, li a o mu wá pa ilẹ na run: nwọn o si fà idà wọn yọ si Egipti, nwọn o si fi awọn ti a pa kún ilẹ na.
entries.en: He and his people with him, the terrible of the nations, shall be brought to destroy the land: and they shall draw their swords against Egypt, and fill the land with the slain.

entries.yo: Emi o mu gbogbo odò wọn gbẹ, emi o si tà ilẹ na si ọwọ́ awọn enia buburu; emi o si ti ipa ọwọ́ awọn alejo sọ ilẹ wọn di ahoro, ati ẹkún rẹ̀: Emi Oluwa li o ti sọ ọ.
entries.en: And I will make the rivers dry, and sell the land into the hand of the wicked: and I will make the land waste, and all that is therein, by the hand of strangers: I the LORD have spoken it.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; emi o pa awọn oriṣa run pẹlu, emi o si jẹ ki ere wọn tán ni Nofi; kì yio si si ọmọ alade kan ni ilẹ Egipti mọ́: emi o si fi ẹ̀ru si ilẹ Egipti.
entries.en: Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will also destroy the idols, and I will cause their images to cease out of Noph; and there shall be no more a prince of the land of Egypt: and I will put a fear in the land of Egypt.

entries.yo: Emi o si sọ Patrosi di ahoro, emi o si gbe iná kalẹ ni Soani, emi o si mu idajọ ṣẹ ni No.
entries.en: And I will make Pathros desolate, and will set fire in Zoan, and will execute judgments in No.

entries.yo: Emi o si dà irúnu mi si ori Sini, agbara Egipti; emi o si ké ọ̀pọlọpọ enia No kuro.
entries.en: And I will pour my fury upon Sin, the strength of Egypt; and I will cut off the multitude of No.

entries.yo: Emi o si gbe iná kalẹ ni Egipti, Sini yio ni irora nla, a o si fà No ya pẹ́rẹpẹ̀rẹ, Nofi yio si ni ipọnju lojojumọ.
entries.en: And I will set fire in Egypt: Sin shall have great pain, and No shall be rent asunder, and Noph shall have distresses daily.

entries.yo: Awọn ọdọmọkunrin Afeni ati Pibeseti yio ti ipa idà ṣubu: ati awọn wọnyi yio lọ si igbèkun.
entries.en: The young men of Aven and of Pi-beseth shall fall by the sword: and these cities shall go into captivity.

entries.yo: Ọjọ yio si ṣõkun ni Tehafnehesi, nigbati emi bá dá àjaga ọrùn Egipti nibẹ: ọṣọ́ agbara rẹ̀ yio tán ninu rẹ̀: bi o ṣe tirẹ̀ ni, ikũkũ yio bò on, ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ obinrin yio lọ si igbèkun.
entries.en: At Tehaphnehes also the day shall be darkened, when I shall break there the yokes of Egypt: and the pomp of her strength shall cease in her: as for her, a cloud shall cover her, and her daughters shall go into captivity.

entries.yo: Bayi li emi o mu idajọ ṣẹ ni Egipti: nwọn o si mọ̀ pe emi li Oluwa.
entries.en: Thus will I execute judgments in Egypt: and they shall know that I am the LORD.

entries.yo: O si ṣe li ọdun kọkanla, li oṣù kini, li ọjọ keje oṣù, ọ̀rọ Oluwa tọ̀ mi wá, wipe,
entries.en: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the first month, in the seventh day of the month, that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

entries.yo: Ọmọ enia, emi ti ṣẹ apá Farao ọba Egipti; si kiyesi i, a kì yio dì i ki o ba le san, bẹ̃ni a kì yio fi igi si i lati dì i ki o ba lagbara lati di idà mu.
entries.en: Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and, lo, it shall not be bound up to be healed, to put a roller to bind it, to make it strong to hold the sword.

entries.yo: Nitorina bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; kiyesi i, emi dojukọ Farao ọba Egipti, emi o si ṣẹ́ apá rẹ̀, eyi ti o le, ati eyiti o ṣẹ́; emi o si jẹ ki idà bọ́ kuro li ọwọ́ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and will break his arms, the strong, and that which was broken; and I will cause the sword to fall out of his hand.

entries.yo: Emi o si tú awọn ara Egipti ká sãrin awọn orilẹ-ède, emi o si tú wọn ká sãrin ilẹ.
entries.en: And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.

entries.yo: Emi o si mu apá ọba Babiloni le, emi o si fi idà mi si ọwọ́ rẹ̀: ṣugbọn emi o ṣẹ́ apá Farao, yio si ma kerora niwaju rẹ bi ikérora ọkunrin ti a ṣá li aṣápa.
entries.en: And I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and put my sword in his hand: but I will break Pharaoh's arms, and he shall groan before him with the groanings of a deadly wounded man.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi o mu apá ọba Babiloni le, apá Farao yio si rọ; nwọn o si mọ̀ pe emi li Oluwa, nigbati emi o ba fi idà mi si ọwọ́ ọba Babiloni, ki o le ba nà a sori ilẹ Egipti.
entries.en: But I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and the arms of Pharaoh shall fall down; and they shall know that I am the LORD, when I shall put my sword into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall stretch it out upon the land of Egypt.

entries.yo: Emi o si tú awọn ara Egipti ká sãrin awọn orilẹ-ède, emi o si tú wọn ká sãrin awọn ilẹ; nwọn o si mọ̀ pe emi li Oluwa.
entries.en: And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and disperse them among the countries; and they shall know that I am the LORD.

entries.yo: O si ṣe li ọdun kọkanla, li oṣù kẹta, li ọjọ ekini oṣù, ọ̀rọ Oluwa tọ̀ mi wá, wipe,
entries.en: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the third month, in the first day of the month, that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

entries.yo: Ọmọ enia, sọ fun Farao ọba Egipti, ati fun ọ̀pọlọpọ enia rẹ̀ pe, Tani iwọ jọ ni titobi rẹ?
entries.en: Son of man, speak unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, and to his multitude; Whom art thou like in thy greatness?

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, awọn ara Assiria ni igi kedari ni Lebanoni ti o li ẹ̀ka daradara, ti o si ṣiji boni, ti o si ga, ṣonṣo ori rẹ̀ si wà lãrin awọn ẹ̀ka bibò.
entries.en: Behold, the Assyrian was a cedar in Lebanon with fair branches, and with a shadowing shroud, and of an high stature; and his top was among the thick boughs.

entries.yo: Omi sọ ọ di nla, ibú gbé e ga soke, o fi awọn odò nla rẹ̀ yi oko rẹ̀ ka, o si rán awọn odo kékèké rẹ̀ si gbogbo igbẹ́.
entries.en: The waters made him great, the deep set him up on high with her rivers running round about his plants, and sent out her little rivers unto all the trees of the field.

entries.yo: Nitorina a gbe giga rẹ̀ soke jù gbogbo igi igbẹ́ lọ, ẹ̀ka rẹ̀ si di pupọ̀, awọn ẹ̀ka rẹ̀ si di gigùn nitori ọ̀pọlọpọ omi, nigbati o yọ wọn jade.
entries.en: Therefore his height was exalted above all the trees of the field, and his boughs were multiplied, and his branches became long because of the multitude of waters, when he shot forth.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ẹiyẹ oju ọrun kọ́ itẹ́ wọn ninu ẹ̀ka rẹ̀, ati labẹ ẹ̀ka rẹ̀ ni gbogbo ẹranko igbẹ́ bi ọmọ wọn si, ati labẹ ojiji rẹ̀ ni gbogbo awọn orilẹ-ède nla ngbe.
entries.en: All the fowls of heaven made their nests in his boughs, and under his branches did all the beasts of the field bring forth their young, and under his shadow dwelt all great nations.

entries.yo: Bayi li o ni ẹwà ninu titobi rẹ̀, ninu gigùn ẹ̀ka rẹ̀: nitori ti egbò rẹ̀ wà li ẹbá omi nla.
entries.en: Thus was he fair in his greatness, in the length of his branches: for his root was by great waters.

entries.yo: Awọn igi kedari inu ọgbà Ọlọrun kò le bò o mọlẹ: awọn igi firi kò dabi ẹ̀ka rẹ̀, awọn igi kẹsnuti kò si dabi ẹ̀ka rẹ̀; bẹ̃ni kò si igikigi ninu ọgbà Ọlọrun ti o dabi rẹ̀ li ẹwà rẹ̀.
entries.en: The cedars in the garden of God could not hide him: the fir trees were not like his boughs, and the chestnut trees were not like his branches; nor any tree in the garden of God was like unto him in his beauty.

entries.yo: Emi ti ṣe e ni ẹwà nipa ọ̀pọlọpọ ẹ̀ka rẹ̀: tobẹ̃ ti gbogbo igi Edeni, ti o wà ninu ọgbà Ọlọrun, ṣe ilara rẹ̀.
entries.en: I have made him fair by the multitude of his branches: so that all the trees of Eden, that were in the garden of God, envied him.

entries.yo: Nitorina bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Nitori ti on gbe ara rẹ̀ soke ni giga, o si ti yọ ṣonṣo rẹ̀ soke lãrin awọn ẹ̀ka didí, ọkàn rẹ̀ si gbe soke nitori giga rẹ̀;
entries.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thou hast lifted up thyself in height, and he hath shot up his top among the thick boughs, and his heart is lifted up in his height;

entries.yo: Nitorina li emi ti ṣe fi i le alagbara awọn keferi lọwọ; on o bá a ṣe dajudaju: Emi ti lé e jade nitori buburu rẹ̀.
entries.en: I have therefore delivered him into the hand of the mighty one of the heathen; he shall surely deal with him: I have driven him out for his wickedness.

entries.yo: Ati awọn alejo, ẹlérù awọn orilẹ-ède, ti ké e kuro, nwọn si ti tú u ká; ẹka rẹ̀ ṣubu sori awọn oke, ati ninu gbogbo afonifoji, ẹka rẹ̀ si ṣẹ́ lẹba gbogbo odò ilẹ na; gbogbo awọn orilẹ-ède aiye si jade lọ kuro labẹ òjiji rẹ̀, nwọn si fi i silẹ.
entries.en: And strangers, the terrible of the nations, have cut him off, and have left him: upon the mountains and in all the valleys his branches are fallen, and his boughs are broken by all the rivers of the land; and all the people of the earth are gone down from his shadow, and have left him.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn ẹiyẹ oju ọrun yio ma gbe ori ahoro rẹ̀, ati lori ẹ̀ka rẹ̀ ni gbogbo ẹranko igbẹ́ yio wà.
entries.en: Upon his ruin shall all the fowls of the heaven remain, and all the beasts of the field shall be upon his branches:

entries.yo: Nitori ki igikigi ti o wà lẹba omi ki o má ba gbe ara wọn ga nitori giga wọn, tabi ki nwọn yọ ṣonṣo wọn lãrin ẹ̀ka dídi; tabi ki igi wọn duro ni giga wọn, gbogbo awọn ti o mu omi: nitori ti a fi gbogbo wọn le ikú lọwọ, si isalẹ aiye, li ãrin awọn ọmọ enia, pẹlu awọn ti o sọkalẹ lọ si ihò.
entries.en: To the end that none of all the trees by the waters exalt themselves for their height, neither shoot up their top among the thick boughs, neither their trees stand up in their height, all that drink water: for they are all delivered unto death, to the nether parts of the earth, in the midst of the children of men, with them that go down to the pit.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; pe, Li ọjọ ti o sọkalẹ lọ si ibojì mo jẹ ki ọ̀fọ ki o wà, mo fi ibú bò o mọlẹ, mo si se awọn iṣàn omi, awọn omi nla ni mo si dá duro: emi si jẹ ki Lebanoni ki o ṣọ̀fọ fun u, gbogbo igi igbẹ́ si dakú nitori rẹ̀.
entries.en: Thus saith the Lord GOD; In the day when he went down to the grave I caused a mourning: I covered the deep for him, and I restrained the floods thereof, and the great waters were stayed: and I caused Lebanon to mourn for him, and all the trees of the field fainted for him.

entries.yo: Emi mu awọn orilẹ̀-èdè mì nipa iró iṣubu rẹ̀, nigbati mo sọ ọ sinu ipòokú, pẹlu awọn ti o sọkalẹ sinu ihò, ati gbogbo igi Edeni, awọn àṣayan ati awọn ti o dara jù ti Lebanoni, gbogbo awọn ti o mu omi, li a o tù ninu ni ìsalẹ aiye.
entries.en: I made the nations to shake at the sound of his fall, when I cast him down to hell with them that descend into the pit: and all the trees of Eden, the choice and best of Lebanon, all that drink water, shall be comforted in the nether parts of the earth.

entries.yo: Awọn pẹlu sọkalẹ lọ sinu ipò-okú pẹlu rẹ̀ sọdọ awọn ti a fi idà pa; awọn ti o si jẹ apá rẹ̀, ti ngbe abẹ òjiji rẹ̀ li ãrin awọn keferi.
entries.en: They also went down into hell with him unto them that be slain with the sword; and they that were his arm, that dwelt under his shadow in the midst of the heathen.

entries.yo: Tani iwọ jọ li ogo ati ni titobi lãrin awọn igi Edeni? sibẹ a o mu ọ wá ilẹ pẹlu awọn igi Edeni si ìsalẹ aiye, iwọ o dubulẹ li ãrin awọn alaikọlà, pẹlu awọn ti a fi idà pa. Eyi ni Farao Esekieli ati gbogbo ọ̀pọlọpọ enia rẹ̀, li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi.
entries.en: To whom art thou thus like in glory and in greatness among the trees of Eden? yet shalt thou be brought down with the trees of Eden unto the nether parts of the earth: thou shalt lie in the midst of the uncircumcised with them that be slain by the sword. This is Pharaoh and all his multitude, saith the Lord GOD.

entries.yo: O si ṣe li ọdun kejila, li oṣù kejila, li ọjọ ikini oṣù, ọ̀rọ Oluwa tọ̀ mi wá, wipe,
entries.en: And it came to pass in the twelfth year, in the twelfth month, in the first day of the month, that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

entries.yo: Ọmọ enia, pohunrére fun Farao ọba Egipti, si wi fun u pe, Iwọ dabi ẹgbọ̀rọ kiniun awọn orilẹ-ède, iwọ si dabi dragoni ninu okun, iwọ si jade wá pẹlu awọn odò rẹ, iwọ ti fi ẹsẹ rẹ rú omi, o si ti bà awọn odò wọn jẹ́.
entries.en: Son of man, take up a lamentation for Pharaoh king of Egypt, and say unto him, Thou art like a young lion of the nations, and thou art as a whale in the seas: and thou camest forth with thy rivers, and troubledst the waters with thy feet, and fouledst their rivers.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Nitorina emi o nà àwọn mi sori rẹ pẹlu ẹgbẹ́ enia pupọ̀; nwọn o si fà ọ goke ninu àwọn mi.
entries.en: Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will therefore spread out my net over thee with a company of many people; and they shall bring thee up in my net.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni emi o fi ọ silẹ lori ilẹ, emi o gbe ọ sọ sinu igbẹ́, emi o mu ki gbogbo awọn ẹiyẹ oju ọrun ba le ọ lori, emi o si fi ọ bọ́ gbogbo awọn ẹranko aiye.
entries.en: Then will I leave thee upon the land, I will cast thee forth upon the open field, and will cause all the fowls of the heaven to remain upon thee, and I will fill the beasts of the whole earth with thee.

entries.yo: Emi o gbe ẹran ara rẹ kà awọn ori oke, gbogbo afonifoji li emi o fi giga rẹ kún.
entries.en: And I will lay thy flesh upon the mountains, and fill the valleys with thy height.

entries.yo: Emi o si fi ẹ̀jẹ rẹ rin ilẹ nibiti iwọ nluwẹ́, ani si awọn oke; awọn odò yio si kún fun ọ.
entries.en: I will also water with thy blood the land wherein thou swimmest, even to the mountains; and the rivers shall be full of thee.

entries.yo: Nigbati emi o ba mú ọ kuro, emi o bò ọrun, emi o si mu ki awọn ìrawọ inu rẹ̀ ṣokùnkun, emi o fi kũkũ bò õrùn, òṣupa kì yio si fi imọlẹ rẹ̀ hàn.
entries.en: And when I shall put thee out, I will cover the heaven, and make the stars thereof dark; I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon shall not give her light.

entries.yo: Gbogbo imọlẹ oju ọrun li emi o mu ṣokùnkun lori rẹ, emi o gbe okùnkun kà ilẹ rẹ, li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi.
entries.en: All the bright lights of heaven will I make dark over thee, and set darkness upon thy land, saith the Lord GOD.

entries.yo: Emi o si bí ọ̀pọlọpọ enia ninu, nigbati emi o ba mu iparun rẹ wá sãrin awọn orilẹ-ède, si ilẹ ti iwọ kò ti mọ̀ ri.
entries.en: I will also vex the hearts of many people, when I shall bring thy destruction among the nations, into the countries which thou hast not known.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ, emi o mu ki ẹnu yà ọ̀pọlọpọ orilẹ-ède si ọ, awọn ọba wọn yio si bẹ̀ru gidigidi nitori rẹ, nigbati emi o ba mì idà mi niwaju wọn; nwọn o si warìri nigbagbogbo, olukuluku enia fun ẹmi ara rẹ̀, li ọjọ iṣubu rẹ.
entries.en: Yea, I will make many people amazed at thee, and their kings shall be horribly afraid for thee, when I shall brandish my sword before them; and they shall tremble at every moment, every man for his own life, in the day of thy fall.

entries.yo: Nitorina bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Idà ọba Babiloni yio wá sori rẹ.
entries.en: For thus saith the Lord GOD; The sword of the king of Babylon shall come upon thee.

entries.yo: Emi o mu ki ọ̀pọlọpọ enia rẹ ṣubu nipa idà awọn alagbara, ẹlẹ́rù awọn orilẹ-ẹ̀de ni gbogbo wọn; nwọn o si bà afẹ́ Egipti jẹ́, ati gbogbo ọ̀pọlọpọ enia rẹ̀ ni nwọn o parun.
entries.en: By the swords of the mighty will I cause thy multitude to fall, the terrible of the nations, all of them: and they shall spoil the pomp of Egypt, and all the multitude thereof shall be destroyed.

entries.yo: Emi o si pa gbogbo awọn ẹranko inu rẹ̀ run kuro lẹba awọn omi nla, bẹ̃ni ẹsẹ enia kì yio rú wọn mọ́ lailai, tabi pátakò awọn ẹranko kì yio rú wọn.
entries.en: I will destroy also all the beasts thereof from beside the great waters; neither shall the foot of man trouble them any more, nor the hoofs of beasts trouble them.

entries.yo: Nigbana li emi o mu ki omi wọn ki o rẹlẹ, emi o si mu ki odò wọn ki o ṣàn bi oróro, li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi.
entries.en: Then will I make their waters deep, and cause their rivers to run like oil, saith the Lord GOD.

entries.yo: Nigbati emi o mu ki ilẹ Egipti di ahoro ti ilẹ na yio si di alaini ohun ti o kún inu rẹ̀ ri, nigbati emi o kọlù gbogbo awọn ti ngbe inu rẹ̀, nigbana ni nwọn o mọ̀ pe emi li Oluwa.
entries.en: When I shall make the land of Egypt desolate, and the country shall be destitute of that whereof it was full, when I shall smite all them that dwell therein, then shall they know that I am the LORD.

entries.yo: Eyi ni ohùn-rére, nwọn o si pohùnrére rẹ̀: awọn ọmọbinrin awọn orilẹ-ède yio pohùnrére rẹ̀: nwọn o pohùnrére nitori rẹ̀, ani fun Egipti, ati gbogbo ọ̀pọlọpọ enia rẹ̀, li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi.
entries.en: This is the lamentation wherewith they shall lament her: the daughters of the nations shall lament her: they shall lament for her, even for Egypt, and for all her multitude, saith the Lord GOD.

entries.yo: O si tun ṣe li ọdun kejila, li ọjọ kẹ̃dogun oṣù, ọ̀rọ Oluwa tọ̀ mi wá, wipe.
entries.en: It came to pass also in the twelfth year, in the fifteenth day of the month, that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

entries.yo: Ọmọ enia, pohùnrére fun ọ̀pọlọpọ enia Egipti, ki o si sọ̀ wọn kalẹ, on, ati awọn ọmọbinrin orilẹ-ède olokiki, si ìsalẹ aiye, pẹlu awọn ti o sọkalẹ lọ sinu ihò.
entries.en: Son of man, wail for the multitude of Egypt, and cast them down, even her, and the daughters of the famous nations, unto the nether parts of the earth, with them that go down into the pit.

entries.yo: Tani iwọ julọ li ẹwà? sọkalẹ, ki a si tẹ́ ọ tì awọn alaikọla.
entries.en: Whom dost thou pass in beauty? go down, and be thou laid with the uncircumcised.

entries.yo: Nwọn o ṣubu li ãrin awọn ti a fi idà pa: a fi on le idà lọwọ: fà a, ati awọn ọ̀pọlọpọ enia rẹ̀.
entries.en: They shall fall in the midst of them that are slain by the sword: she is delivered to the sword: draw her and all her multitudes.

entries.yo: Awọn alagbara lãrin awọn alagbara yio sọ̀rọ si i lati ãrin ipò-okú wá, pẹlu awọn ti o ràn a lọwọ: nwọn sọkalẹ lọ, nwọn dubulẹ, awọn alaikọla ti a fi idà pa.
entries.en: The strong among the mighty shall speak to him out of the midst of hell with them that help him: they are gone down, they lie uncircumcised, slain by the sword.

entries.yo: Assuru wà nibẹ̀ ati gbogbo ẹgbẹ́ rẹ̀: awọn ibojì rẹ̀ wà lọdọ rẹ̀: gbogbo wọn li a pa, ti o ti ipa idà ṣubu:
entries.en: Asshur is there and all her company: his graves are about him: all of them slain, fallen by the sword:

entries.yo: Ibojì awọn ẹniti a gbe kà ẹgbẹ́ ihò, awọn ẹgbẹ́ rẹ̀ si yi ibojì rẹ̀ ka, gbogbo wọn li a pa, nwọn ti ipa idà ṣubu, ti o da ẹ̀ru silẹ ni ilẹ alãye.
entries.en: Whose graves are set in the sides of the pit, and her company is round about her grave: all of them slain, fallen by the sword, which caused terror in the land of the living.

entries.yo: Elamu wà nibẹ, ati gbogbo ọ̀pọlọpọ enia rẹ̀ yi ibojì rẹ̀ ka, gbogbo wọn li a pa, nwọn ti ipa idà ṣubu, ti nwọn sọkalẹ li alaikọla si ìsalẹ aiye, ti o da ẹ̀ru wọn silẹ ni ilẹ alãye; sibẹ nwọn ti rù itiju wọn pẹlu awọn ti o sọkalẹ lọ si ihò.
entries.en: There is Elam and all her multitude round about her grave, all of them slain, fallen by the sword, which are gone down uncircumcised into the nether parts of the earth, which caused their terror in the land of the living; yet have they borne their shame with them that go down to the pit.

entries.yo: Nwọn ti gbe akete kan kalẹ fun u li ãrin awọn ti a pa pẹlu gbogbo ọ̀pọlọpọ enia rẹ̀: awọn ibojì rẹ̀ yi i ka, gbogbo wọn alaikọla ti a fi idà pa: bi a tilẹ dá ẹ̀ru wọn silẹ ni ilẹ alãye, sibẹ nwọn ti rù itiju wọn pẹlu awọn ti o sọkalẹ lọ si ihò: a fi i si ãrin awọn ti a pa.
entries.en: They have set her a bed in the midst of the slain with all her multitude: her graves are round about him: all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword: though their terror was caused in the land of the living, yet have they borne their shame with them that go down to the pit: he is put in the midst of them that be slain.

entries.yo: Meṣeki ati Tubali wà nibẹ, ati gbogbo ọ̀pọlọpọ enia rẹ̀: awọn ibojì rẹ̀ yi i ka: gbogbo wọn alaikọlà ti a fi idà pa, bi nwọn tilẹ dá ẹ̀ru wọn silẹ ni ilẹ alãye.
entries.en: There is Meshech, Tubal, and all her multitude: her graves are round about him: all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword, though they caused their terror in the land of the living.

entries.yo: Nwọn kì yio si dubulẹ tì awọn alagbara ti o ṣubu ninu awọn alaikọlà, ti nwọn sọkalẹ lọ si ipò-okú pẹlu ihámọra ogun wọn: nwọn ti fi idà wọn rọ ori wọn, ṣugbọn aiṣedẽde wọn yio wà lori egungun wọn, bi nwọn tilẹ jẹ ẹ̀ru awọn alagbara ni ilẹ alãye.
entries.en: And they shall not lie with the mighty that are fallen of the uncircumcised, which are gone down to hell with their weapons of war: and they have laid their swords under their heads, but their iniquities shall be upon their bones, though they were the terror of the mighty in the land of the living.

entries.yo: Lõtọ, a o fọ́ ọ lãrin awọn alaikọlà, iwọ o si dubulẹ tì awọn ti a fi idà pa.
entries.en: Yea, thou shalt be broken in the midst of the uncircumcised, and shalt lie with them that are slain with the sword.

entries.yo: Edomu wà nibẹ, awọn ọba rẹ̀, ati awọn ọmọ-alade rẹ̀, ti a tẹ́ pẹlu agbara wọn tì awọn ti a fi idà pa, nwọn o dubulẹ tì awọn alaikọlà, ati pẹlu awọn ti o sọkalẹ lọ si ihò.
entries.en: There is Edom, her kings, and all her princes, which with their might are laid by them that were slain by the sword: they shall lie with the uncircumcised, and with them that go down to the pit.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ-alade ariwa wà nibẹ, gbogbo wọn, ati awọn ara Sidoni, ti nwọn sọkalẹ lọ pẹlu awọn ti a pa; pẹlu ẹ̀ru wọn, oju agbara wọn tì wọn; nwọn si dubulẹ li alaikọlà pẹlu awọn ti a fi idà pa, nwọn si rù itiju wọn pẹlu awọn ti o sọkalẹ lọ si ihò.
entries.en: There be the princes of the north, all of them, and all the Zidonians, which are gone down with the slain; with their terror they are ashamed of their might; and they lie uncircumcised with them that be slain by the sword, and bear their shame with them that go down to the pit.

entries.yo: Farao yio ri wọn, a o si tù u ninu lori gbogbo ọ̀pọlọpọ enia rẹ̀, ani Farao ati gbogbo ogun rẹ̀ ti a fi idà pa, li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi.
entries.en: Pharaoh shall see them, and shall be comforted over all his multitude, even Pharaoh and all his army slain by the sword, saith the Lord GOD.

entries.yo: Nitoriti emi ti dá ẹ̀ru mi silẹ ni ilẹ alãye: a o si tẹ́ ẹ si ãrin awọn alaikọlà, pẹlu awọn ti a fi idà pa ani Farao ati gbogbo ọ̀pọlọpọ enia rẹ̀, li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi.
entries.en: For I have caused my terror in the land of the living: and he shall be laid in the midst of the uncircumcised with them that are slain with the sword, even Pharaoh and all his multitude, saith the Lord GOD.

entries.yo: Ọ̀RỌ Oluwa tun tọ̀ mi wá, wipe,
entries.en: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

entries.yo: Ọmọ enia, sọ fun awọn ọmọ enia rẹ, si wi fun wọn pe, Bi emi bá mu idà wá sori ilẹ kan, bi awọn enia ilẹ na bá mu ọkunrin kan ninu ara wọn, ti nwọn si fi ṣe oluṣọ́ wọn:
entries.en: Son of man, speak to the children of thy people, and say unto them, When I bring the sword upon a land, if the people of the land take a man of their coasts, and set him for their watchman:

entries.yo: Bi on bá ri ti idà mbọ̀ wá sori ilẹ na ti o bá fun ipè, ti o si kìlọ fun awọn enia na:
entries.en: If when he seeth the sword come upon the land, he blow the trumpet, and warn the people;

entries.yo: Nigbana ẹnikẹni ti o bá gbọ́ iró ipè, ti kò si gbà ìkilọ; bi idà ba de, ti o si mu on kuro, ẹjẹ rẹ̀ yio wà lori on tikalarẹ̀.
entries.en: Then whosoever heareth the sound of the trumpet, and taketh not warning; if the sword come, and take him away, his blood shall be upon his own head.

entries.yo: O gbọ́ iró ipè, kò si gbà ìkilọ: ẹ̀jẹ rẹ̀ yio wà lori rẹ̀. Ṣugbọn ẹniti o gbọ́ ìkilọ yio gbà ọkàn ara rẹ̀ là.
entries.en: He heard the sound of the trumpet, and took not warning; his blood shall be upon him. But he that taketh warning shall deliver his soul.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi oluṣọ́ na bá ri ti idà mbọ̀, ti kò si fun ipè, ti a kò si kìlọ fun awọn enia; bi idà ba de, ti o ba si mu ẹnikẹni lãrin wọn, a mu u kuro nitori aiṣedẽde rẹ̀, ṣugbọn ẹjẹ rẹ̀ li emi o bere lọwọ oluṣọ́ na.
entries.en: But if the watchman see the sword come, and blow not the trumpet, and the people be not warned; if the sword come, and take any person from among them, he is taken away in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at the watchman's hand.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni, iwọ ọmọ enia, emi ti fi ọ ṣe oluṣọ́ fun ile Israeli; nitorina iwọ o gbọ́ ọ̀rọ li ẹnu mi, iwọ o si kìlọ fun wọn lati ọdọ mi.
entries.en: So thou, O son of man, I have set thee a watchman unto the house of Israel; therefore thou shalt hear the word at my mouth, and warn them from me.

entries.yo: Nigbati emi ba wi fun enia buburu pe, Iwọ enia buburu, kikú ni iwọ o kú, bi iwọ kò bá sọ̀rọ lati kìlọ fun enia buburu na ki o kuro li ọ̀na rẹ̀, enia buburu na yio kú nitori aiṣedẽde rẹ̀, ṣugbọn ẹjẹ rẹ̀ li emi o bere li ọwọ́ rẹ.
entries.en: When I say unto the wicked, O wicked man, thou shalt surely die; if thou dost not speak to warn the wicked from his way, that wicked man shall die in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at thine hand.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn, bi iwọ ba kìlọ fun enia buburu na niti ọ̀na rẹ̀ lati pada kuro ninu rẹ̀, bi on kò ba yipada kuro ninu ọ̀na rẹ̀, on o kù nitori aiṣedẽde rẹ̀, ṣugbọn iwọ ti gbà ọkàn rẹ là.
entries.en: Nevertheless, if thou warn the wicked of his way to turn from it; if he do not turn from his way, he shall die in his iniquity; but thou hast delivered thy soul.

entries.yo: Nitorina, iwọ ọmọ enia, sọ fun ile Israeli; pe, Bayi li ẹnyin nwi, pe, Bi irekọja ati ẹ̀ṣẹ wa ba wà lori wa, ti awa si njoró ninu wọn, bawo li a o ti ṣe le wà lãye.
entries.en: Therefore, O thou son of man, speak unto the house of Israel; Thus ye speak, saying, If our transgressions and our sins be upon us, and we pine away in them, how should we then live?

entries.yo: Sọ fun wọn pe, Bi emi ti wà, ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi, emi kò ni inu-didun ni ikú enia buburu, ṣugbọn ki enia buburu yipada kuro ninu ọ̀na rẹ̀ ki o si yè: ẹ yipada, ẹ yipada kuro ninu ọ̀na buburu nyin; nitori kini ẹnyin o ṣe kú, Ile Israeli?
entries.en: Say unto them, As I live, saith the Lord GOD, I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked; but that the wicked turn from his way and live: turn ye, turn ye from your evil ways; for why will ye die, O house of Israel?

entries.yo: Nitorina, iwọ ọmọ enia, sọ fun awọn ọmọ enia rẹ, ododo olododo kì yio gbà a là li ọjọ irekọja rẹ̀: bi o ṣe ti ìwa buburu enia buburu, on kì yio ti ipa rẹ̀ ṣubu li ọjọ ti o yipada kuro ninu ìwa buburu rẹ̀: bẹ̃ni olododo kì yio là nipa ododo rẹ̀ li ọjọ ti o dẹṣẹ.
entries.en: Therefore, thou son of man, say unto the children of thy people, The righteousness of the righteous shall not deliver him in the day of his transgression: as for the wickedness of the wicked, he shall not fall thereby in the day that he turneth from his wickedness; neither shall the righteous be able to live for his righteousness in the day that he sinneth.

entries.yo: Nigbati emi o wi fun olododo pe, yiyè ni yio yè, bi o ba gbẹkẹle ododo ara rẹ̀, ti o si ṣe aiṣedẽde, gbogbo ododo rẹ̀ li a kì yio ranti mọ, ṣugbọn nitori aiṣedẽde ti o ti ṣe, on o ti itori rẹ̀ kú.
entries.en: When I shall say to the righteous, that he shall surely live; if he trust to his own righteousness, and commit iniquity, all his righteousnesses shall not be remembered; but for his iniquity that he hath committed, he shall die for it.

entries.yo: Ẹ̀wẹ, nigbati emi wi fun enia buburu pe, Kikú ni iwọ o kú; bi on ba yipada kuro ninu ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ̀, ti o si ṣe eyi ti o tọ ti o si yẹ;
entries.en: Again, when I say unto the wicked, Thou shalt surely die; if he turn from his sin, and do that which is lawful and right;

entries.yo: Bi enia buburu ba mu ògo padà, ti o si san ohun ti o ti jí padà, ti o si nrin ni ilana ìye, li aiṣe aiṣedẽde; yiyè ni yio yè, on kì o kú.
entries.en: If the wicked restore the pledge, give again that he had robbed, walk in the statutes of life, without committing iniquity; he shall surely live, he shall not die.

entries.yo: A kì yio ṣe iranti gbogbo ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ̀ ti o ti ndá fun u: on ti ṣe eyi ti o tọ ti o si yẹ; on o yè nitõtọ.
entries.en: None of his sins that he hath committed shall be mentioned unto him: he hath done that which is lawful and right; he shall surely live.

entries.yo: Sibẹ awọn ọmọ enia rẹ wipe, Ọ̀na Oluwa kò dọgba: ṣugbọn bi o ṣe ti wọn ni, ọ̀na wọn kò dọgba.
entries.en: Yet the children of thy people say, The way of the Lord is not equal: but as for them, their way is not equal.

entries.yo: Nigbati olododo ba yipada kuro ninu ododo rẹ̀ ti o si ṣe aiṣedẽde, on o ti ipa rẹ̀ kú.
entries.en: When the righteous turneth from his righteousness, and committeth iniquity, he shall even die thereby.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi enia buburu bá yipada kuro ninu buburu rẹ̀, ti o si ṣe eyiti o tọ ti o si yẹ̀, on o ti ipa rẹ̀ wà lãye.
entries.en: But if the wicked turn from his wickedness, and do that which is lawful and right, he shall live thereby.

entries.yo: Sibẹ ẹnyin wi pe, Ọ̀na Oluwa kò dọgba, Ẹnyin ile Israeli, emi o dá olukuluku nyin li ẹjọ gẹgẹ bi ọ̀na rẹ̀.
entries.en: Yet ye say, The way of the Lord is not equal. O ye house of Israel, I will judge you every one after his ways.

entries.yo: O si ṣe li ọdun ikejila ikolọ wa, li oṣu kẹwa, li ọjọ karun oṣu, ẹnikan ti o ti salà jade ni Jerusalemu tọ̀ mi wá, o wipe, A kọlù ilu na.
entries.en: And it came to pass in the twelfth year of our captivity, in the tenth month, in the fifth day of the month, that one that had escaped out of Jerusalem came unto me, saying, The city is smitten.

entries.yo: Ọwọ́ Oluwa si wà lara mi li àṣalẹ, ki ẹniti o salà na to de; o si ti ṣi ẹnu mi, titi on fi wá sọdọ mi li owurọ; ẹnu mi si ṣi, emi kò si yadi mọ.
entries.en: Now the hand of the LORD was upon me in the evening, afore he that was escaped came; and had opened my mouth, until he came to me in the morning; and my mouth was opened, and I was no more dumb.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ọ̀rọ Oluwa tọ̀ mi wá, wipe,
entries.en: Then the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

entries.yo: Ọmọ enia, awọn ti ngbe ahoro ile Israeli wọnni sọ, wipe, Abrahamu jẹ ẹnikan, on si jogun ilẹ na: ṣugbọn awa pọ̀, a fi ilẹ na fun wa ni ini.
entries.en: Son of man, they that inhabit those wastes of the land of Israel speak, saying, Abraham was one, and he inherited the land: but we are many; the land is given us for inheritance.

entries.yo: Nitorina wi fun wọn pe, Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi, pe, ẹnyin njẹ ẹ̀jẹ mọ ẹran, ẹ si gbe oju nyin soke si awọn oriṣa nyin, ẹ si ta ẹjẹ silẹ, ẹnyin o ha ni ilẹ na?
entries.en: Wherefore say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Ye eat with the blood, and lift up your eyes toward your idols, and shed blood: and shall ye possess the land?

entries.yo: Ẹnyin gbẹkẹle idà nyin, ẹ ṣe irira, olukuluku nyin bà obinrin aladugbò rẹ̀ jẹ́: ẹnyin o ha ni ilẹ na?
entries.en: Ye stand upon your sword, ye work abomination, and ye defile every one his neighbour's wife: and shall ye possess the land?

entries.yo: Iwọ wi bayi fun wọn pe, Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Bi emi ti wà, nitõtọ, awọn ti o wà ninu ahoro na yio ti ipa idà ṣubu, ẹniti o si wà ni gbangba oko li emi o si fi fun ẹranko lati pajẹ, awọn ti o si wà ninu odi ati ninu ihò okuta yio ti ipa ajakalẹ-àrun kú.
entries.en: Say thou thus unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; As I live, surely they that are in the wastes shall fall by the sword, and him that is in the open field will I give to the beasts to be devoured, and they that be in the forts and in the caves shall die of the pestilence.

entries.yo: Nitoriti emi o sọ ilẹ na di ahoro patapata, ọ̀ṣọ nla agbara rẹ̀ kì yio si mọ, awọn oke Israeli yio si di ahoro, ti ẹnikan kì yio le là a kọja.
entries.en: For I will lay the land most desolate, and the pomp of her strength shall cease; and the mountains of Israel shall be desolate, that none shall pass through.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni nwọn o mọ̀ pe emi li Oluwa, nigbati mo ba ti sọ ilẹ na di ahoro patapata, nitori gbogbo irira ti nwọn ti ṣe.
entries.en: Then shall they know that I am the LORD, when I have laid the land most desolate because of all their abominations which they have committed.

entries.yo: Iwọ ọmọ enia, sibẹ awọn ọmọ enia rẹ nsọ̀rọ si ọ lẹba ogiri ati lẹba ilẹkun ile, ẹnikini si sọ fun ẹnikeji, olukuluku fun arakunrin rẹ̀ wipe, Wá, emi bẹ̀ ọ si gbọ́ ọ̀rọ ti o ti ọdọ Oluwa jade wá.
entries.en: Also, thou son of man, the children of thy people still are talking against thee by the walls and in the doors of the houses, and speak one to another, every one to his brother, saying, Come, I pray you, and hear what is the word that cometh forth from the LORD.

entries.yo: Nwọn si tọ̀ ọ wá, bi enia ti iwá, nwọn si joko niwaju rẹ bi enia mi, nwọn si gbọ́ ọ̀rọ rẹ, ṣugbọn nwọn kì yio ṣe wọn: nitori ẹnu wọn ni nwọn fi nfi ifẹ pupọ hàn, ṣugbọn ọkàn wọn tẹ̀le ojukokoro wọn.
entries.en: And they come unto thee as the people cometh, and they sit before thee as my people, and they hear thy words, but they will not do them: for with their mouth they shew much love, but their heart goeth after their covetousness.

entries.yo: Si kiyesi i, iwọ jẹ orin ti o dùn pupọ fun wọn, ti ẹnikan ti o ni ohùn daradara, ti o si le fún ohun-elò orin daradara: nitori nwọn gbọ́ ọ̀rọ rẹ, ṣugbọn nwọn kò ṣe wọn.
entries.en: And, lo, thou art unto them as a very lovely song of one that hath a pleasant voice, and can play well on an instrument: for they hear thy words, but they do them not.

entries.yo: Ati nigbati eyi bá ṣẹ, (kiyesi i, yio de,) nigbana ni nwọn o mọ̀ pe wolĩ kan ti wà lãrin wọn.
entries.en: And when this cometh to pass, (lo, it will come,) then shall they know that a prophet hath been among them.

entries.yo: Ọ̀RỌ Oluwa si tọ̀ mi wá, wipe,
entries.en: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

entries.yo: Ọmọ enia, sọtẹlẹ si awọn oluṣọ́ agutan Israeli, sọtẹlẹ, ki o si wi fun wọn pe, Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi fun awọn oluṣọ́ agutan; pe, Egbé ni fun awọn oluṣọ́ agutan Israeli, ti mbọ́ ara wọn, awọn oluṣọ́ agutan kì ba bọ́ ọwọ́-ẹran?
entries.en: Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel, prophesy, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD unto the shepherds; Woe be to the shepherds of Israel that do feed themselves! should not the shepherds feed the flocks?

entries.yo: Ẹnyin jẹ ọrá, ẹ si fi irun agutan bora, ẹ pa awọn ti o sanra: ẹ kò bọ́ agbo-ẹran.
entries.en: Ye eat the fat, and ye clothe you with the wool, ye kill them that are fed: but ye feed not the flock.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin kò mu alailera lara le, bẹ̃ni ẹ kò mu eyiti kò sàn li ara da, bẹ̃ni ẹ kò dì eyiti a ṣá lọ́gbẹ, bẹ̃ni ẹ kò tun mu eyi ti a ti lé lọ padà bọ̀, bẹ̃ni ẹ kò wá eyiti o sọnu, ṣugbọn ipá ati ìka li ẹ ti fi nṣe akoso wọn.
entries.en: The diseased have ye not strengthened, neither have ye healed that which was sick, neither have ye bound up that which was broken, neither have ye brought again that which was driven away, neither have ye sought that which was lost; but with force and with cruelty have ye ruled them.

entries.yo: A si tú wọn ka, nitori ti oluṣọ́ agutan kò si: nwọn si di onjẹ fun gbogbo ẹranko igbẹ́, nigbati a tú wọn ka.
entries.en: And they were scattered, because there is no shepherd: and they became meat to all the beasts of the field, when they were scattered.

entries.yo: Awọn agutàn mi ṣako ni gbogbo òke, ati lori gbogbo òke kékèké, nitõtọ, a tú ọwọ́-ẹran mi ká ilẹ gbogbo, ẹnikẹni kò bere wọn ki o si wá wọn lọ.
entries.en: My sheep wandered through all the mountains, and upon every high hill: yea, my flock was scattered upon all the face of the earth, and none did search or seek after them.

entries.yo: Nitorina ẹnyin oluṣọ́ agutan, ẹ gbọ́ ọ̀rọ Oluwa.
entries.en: Therefore, ye shepherds, hear the word of the LORD;

entries.yo: Bi mo ti wà, ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi, nitõtọ, nitori ti ọwọ́-ẹran mi di ijẹ, ti ọwọ́-ẹran mi di onjẹ fun olukuluku ẹranko igbẹ́, nitoriti kò si oluṣọ́ agutan, bẹ̃ni awọn oluṣọ́ agutan kò wá ọwọ́-ẹran mi ri, ṣugbọn awọn oluṣọ́ agutan bọ́ ara wọn, nwọn kò si bọ́ ọwọ́-ẹran mi.
entries.en: As I live, saith the Lord GOD, surely because my flock became a prey, and my flock became meat to every beast of the field, because there was no shepherd, neither did my shepherds search for my flock, but the shepherds fed themselves, and fed not my flock;

entries.yo: Nitorina, ẹnyin oluṣọ́ agutan, ẹ gbọ́ ọ̀rọ Oluwa;
entries.en: Therefore, O ye shepherds, hear the word of the LORD;

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Kiyesi i, emi dojukọ awọn oluṣọ́ agutan; emi o si bere ọwọ́-ẹ̀ran mi lọwọ wọn, emi o si mu wọn dẹ́kun ati ma bọ́ awọn ọwọ́-ẹran: bẹ̃ni awọn ọluṣọ́ agutan kì yio bọ́ ara wọn mọ, nitori ti emi o gbà ọwọ́-ẹran mi kuro li ẹnu wọn ki nwọn ki o má ba jẹ onjẹ fun wọn.
entries.en: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I am against the shepherds; and I will require my flock at their hand, and cause them to cease from feeding the flock; neither shall the shepherds feed themselves any more; for I will deliver my flock from their mouth, that they may not be meat for them.

entries.yo: Nitori bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Kiyesi i, emi, ani emi, o bere awọn agutan mi, emi o si wá wọn ri.
entries.en: For thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I, even I, will both search my sheep, and seek them out.

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi oluṣọ́ agutan iti iwá ọwọ́-ẹran rẹ̀ ri, li ọjọ ti o wà lãrin awọn agutan rẹ̀ ti o fọnka, bẹ̃li emi o wá agutan mi ri, emi o si gbà wọn nibi gbogbo ti wọn ti fọnka si, li ọjọ kũkũ ati okùnkun biribiri.
entries.en: As a shepherd seeketh out his flock in the day that he is among his sheep that are scattered; so will I seek out my sheep, and will deliver them out of all places where they have been scattered in the cloudy and dark day.

entries.yo: Emi o si mu wọn jade kuro ninu awọn orilẹ-ède, emi o si kó wọn jọ lati ilẹ gbogbo, emi o si mu wọn wá si ilẹ ara wọn, emi o si bọ́ wọn lori oke Israeli, lẹba odò, ati ni ibi gbigbé ni ilẹ na.
entries.en: And I will bring them out from the people, and gather them from the countries, and will bring them to their own land, and feed them upon the mountains of Israel by the rivers, and in all the inhabited places of the country.

entries.yo: Emi o bọ́ wọn ni pápa oko daradara ati lori okè giga Israeli ni agbo wọn o wà: nibẹ ni nwọn o dubulẹ ni agbo daradara, pápa oko ọlọ́ra ni nwọn o si ma jẹ lori oke Israeli.
entries.en: I will feed them in a good pasture, and upon the high mountains of Israel shall their fold be: there shall they lie in a good fold, and in a fat pasture shall they feed upon the mountains of Israel.

entries.yo: Emi o bọ́ ọwọ́-ẹran mi, emi o si mu ki nwọn dubulẹ, li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi.
entries.en: I will feed my flock, and I will cause them to lie down, saith the Lord GOD.

entries.yo: Emi o wá eyiti o sọnu lọ, emi o si mu eyiti a lé lọ pada bọ̀, emi o si dì eyiti a ṣá lọ́gbẹ, emi o mu eyiti o ṣaisan li ara le; ṣugbọn emi o run eyiti o sanra ati eyiti o lagbara; emi o fi idajọ bọ́ wọn.
entries.en: I will seek that which was lost, and bring again that which was driven away, and will bind up that which was broken, and will strengthen that which was sick: but I will destroy the fat and the strong; I will feed them with judgment.

entries.yo: Bi o ṣe ti nyin, Ẹnyin ọwọ́-ẹran mi, bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Kiyesi i emi o ṣe idajọ lãrin ẹran ati ẹran, lãrin àgbo ati obukọ.
entries.en: And as for you, O my flock, thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I judge between cattle and cattle, between the rams and the he goats.

entries.yo: Ohun kekere ni li oju nyin ti ẹ ti jẹ oko daradara, ṣugbọn ẹnyin si fi ẹsẹ tẹ̀ oko iyokù mọlẹ, ati ti ẹ ti mu ninu omi jijìn, ṣugbọn ẹ si fi ẹsẹ ba eyi ti o kù jẹ?
entries.en: Seemeth it a small thing unto you to have eaten up the good pasture, but ye must tread down with your feet the residue of your pastures? and to have drunk of the deep waters, but ye must foul the residue with your feet?

entries.yo: Bi o ṣe ti ọwọ́-ẹran mi ni, nwọn jẹ eyiti ẹ ti fi ẹsẹ nyin tẹ̀ mọlẹ; nwọn si mu eyiti ẹ ti fi ẹsẹ nyin bajẹ.
entries.en: And as for my flock, they eat that which ye have trodden with your feet; and they drink that which ye have fouled with your feet.

entries.yo: Nitorina, bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi fun wọn, Kiyesi, emi, ani emi, o ṣe idajọ lãrin ọwọ́-ẹran ti o sanra, ati eyiti o rù.
entries.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD unto them; Behold, I, even I, will judge between the fat cattle and between the lean cattle.

entries.yo: Nitoriti ẹnyin ti fi ẹgbẹ́ ati ejiká gbún, ti ẹ si ti fi iwo nyin kàn gbogbo awọn ti o li àrun titi ẹ fi tú wọn kakiri.
entries.en: Because ye have thrust with side and with shoulder, and pushed all the diseased with your horns, till ye have scattered them abroad;

entries.yo: Nitorina ni emi o ṣe gbà ọwọ́-ẹran mi là, nwọn kì yio si jẹ ijẹ́ mọ, emi o si ṣe idajọ lãrin ẹran ati ẹran.
entries.en: Therefore will I save my flock, and they shall no more be a prey; and I will judge between cattle and cattle.

entries.yo: Emi o si gbe oluṣọ́ agutan kan soke lori wọn, on o si bọ́ wọn, ani Dafidi iranṣẹ mi; on o bọ́ wọn, on o si jẹ oluṣọ́ agutan wọn.
entries.en: And I will set up one shepherd over them, and he shall feed them, even my servant David; he shall feed them, and he shall be their shepherd.

entries.yo: Emi Oluwa yio si jẹ Ọlọrun wọn, ati Dafidi iranṣẹ mi o jẹ ọmọ-alade li ãrin wọn, emi Oluwa li o ti sọ ọ.
entries.en: And I the LORD will be their God, and my servant David a prince among them; I the LORD have spoken it.

entries.yo: Emi o si ba wọn da majẹmu alafia, emi o si jẹ ki awọn ẹranko buburu dasẹ ni ilẹ na: nwọn o si ma gbe aginju li ailewu, nwọn o si sùn ninu igbó.
entries.en: And I will make with them a covenant of peace, and will cause the evil beasts to cease out of the land: and they shall dwell safely in the wilderness, and sleep in the woods.

entries.yo: Emi o si ṣe awọn ati ibi ti o yi oke mi ká ni ibukún; emi o si jẹ ki ojò ki o rọ̀ li akoko rẹ̀, òjo ibukún yio wà.
entries.en: And I will make them and the places round about my hill a blessing; and I will cause the shower to come down in his season; there shall be showers of blessing.

entries.yo: Igi igbẹ́ yio si so eso rẹ̀, ilẹ yio si ma mu asunkun rẹ̀ wá, nwọn o si wà li alafia ni ilẹ wọn, nwọn o si mọ̀ pe emi li Oluwa, nigbati emi o ti ṣẹ́ èdídi àjaga wọn, ti emi o si ti gbà wọn lọwọ awọn ti nwọn nsìn bi ẹrú.
entries.en: And the tree of the field shall yield her fruit, and the earth shall yield her increase, and they shall be safe in their land, and shall know that I am the LORD, when I have broken the bands of their yoke, and delivered them out of the hand of those that served themselves of them.

entries.yo: Nwọn kì yio si ṣe ijẹ fun awọn keferi mọ, bẹ̃ni ẹranko ilẹ na kì yio pa wọn jẹ, ṣugbọn nwọn o wà li alafia ẹnikẹni kì yio si dẹrùba wọn,
entries.en: And they shall no more be a prey to the heathen, neither shall the beast of the land devour them; but they shall dwell safely, and none shall make them afraid.

entries.yo: Emi o si gbe igi okiki kan soke fun wọn, ebi kì yio si run wọn ni ilẹ na mọ, bẹ̃ni nwọn kì yio rù itiju awọn keferi mọ.
entries.en: And I will raise up for them a plant of renown, and they shall be no more consumed with hunger in the land, neither bear the shame of the heathen any more.

entries.yo: Bayi ni nwọn o mọ̀ pe emi Oluwa Ọlọrun wọn wà pẹlu wọn, ati awọn, ile Israeli, jẹ enia mi, li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi.
entries.en: Thus shall they know that I the LORD their God am with them, and that they, even the house of Israel, are my people, saith the Lord GOD.

entries.yo: Ati ẹnyin ọwọ́-ẹran mi, ọwọ́-ẹran pápa oko mi ni enia, emi si li Ọlọrun nyin, li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi.
entries.en: And ye my flock, the flock of my pasture, are men, and I am your God, saith the Lord GOD.

entries.yo: Ọ̀RỌ Oluwa si tọ̀ mi wá, wipe,
entries.en: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

entries.yo: Ọmọ enia, kọ oju rẹ si oke Seiri, ki o si sọtẹlẹ si i.
entries.en: Son of man, set thy face against mount Seir, and prophesy against it,

entries.yo: Ki o si wi fun u pe, Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi, Kiyesi i, iwọ oke Seiri, emi dojukọ ọ, emi o nà ọwọ́ mi si ọ, emi o si sọ ọ di ahoro patapata.
entries.en: And say unto it, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, O mount Seir, I am against thee, and I will stretch out mine hand against thee, and I will make thee most desolate.

entries.yo: Emi o sọ awọn ilu rẹ di ahoro, iwọ o si di ahoro, iwọ o si mọ̀ pe, emi li Oluwa.
entries.en: I will lay thy cities waste, and thou shalt be desolate, and thou shalt know that I am the LORD.

entries.yo: Nitori ti iwọ ti ni irira lailai, iwọ si ti fi awọn ọmọ Israeli le idà lọwọ́, li akoko idãmu wọn, li akoko ti aiṣedẽde wọn de opin.
entries.en: Because thou hast had a perpetual hatred, and hast shed the blood of the children of Israel by the force of the sword in the time of their calamity, in the time that their iniquity had an end:

entries.yo: Nitorina, bi emi ti wà, ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi, emi o pèse rẹ silẹ fun ẹ̀jẹ, ẹ̀jẹ yio si lepa rẹ: bi iwọ kò ti korira ẹ̀jẹ nì, ẹ̀jẹ yio lepa rẹ.
entries.en: Therefore, as I live, saith the Lord GOD, I will prepare thee unto blood, and blood shall pursue thee: sith thou hast not hated blood, even blood shall pursue thee.

entries.yo: Bayi li emi o sọ oke Seiri di ahoro patapata, emi o si ké ẹniti nkọja lọ ati ẹniti npadà bọ̀ kuro ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: Thus will I make mount Seir most desolate, and cut off from it him that passeth out and him that returneth.

entries.yo: Emi o si fi awọn okú rẹ̀ kún awọn oke rẹ̀; ni oke kékèké rẹ, ati ni afonifoji rẹ, ati ni gbogbo odò rẹ li awọn ti a fi idà pa yio ṣubu si.
entries.en: And I will fill his mountains with his slain men: in thy hills, and in thy valleys, and in all thy rivers, shall they fall that are slain with the sword.

entries.yo: Emi o sọ ọ di ahoro lailai, awọn ilu rẹ kì yio si padà bọ̀: ẹnyin o si mọ̀ pe, emi li Oluwa.
entries.en: I will make thee perpetual desolations, and thy cities shall not return: and ye shall know that I am the LORD.

entries.yo: Nitoriti iwọ ti wipe, Awọn orilẹ-ède mejeji yi, ati awọn ilẹ mejeji yi yio jẹ́ ti emi, awa o si ni i; nigbati o ṣepe Oluwa wà nibẹ:
entries.en: Because thou hast said, These two nations and these two countries shall be mine, and we will possess it; whereas the LORD was there:

entries.yo: Nitorina, bi emi ti wà, ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi emi o tilẹ ṣe gẹgẹ bi ibinu rẹ, ati gẹgẹ bi ilara rẹ ti iwọ ti lò lati inu irira rẹ si wọn; emi o si sọ ara mi di mimọ̀ lãrin wọn, nigbati emi ba ti da ọ li ẹjọ.
entries.en: Therefore, as I live, saith the Lord GOD, I will even do according to thine anger, and according to thine envy which thou hast used out of thy hatred against them; and I will make myself known among them, when I have judged thee.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si mọ̀ pe emi li Oluwa, ati pe emi ti gbọ́ ọ̀rọ buburu rẹ, ti iwọ ti sọ si oke Israeli, wipe, A sọ wọn di ahoro, a fi wọn fun wa lati run.
entries.en: And thou shalt know that I am the LORD, and that I have heard all thy blasphemies which thou hast spoken against the mountains of Israel, saying, They are laid desolate, they are given us to consume.

entries.yo: Bayi li ẹnyin ti fi ẹnu nyin buná si mi, ẹ si ti sọ ọ̀rọ nyin di pupọ si mi: emi ti gbọ́.
entries.en: Thus with your mouth ye have boasted against me, and have multiplied your words against me: I have heard them.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi pe, Nigbati gbogbo aiye nyọ̀, emi o sọ ọ di ahoro.
entries.en: Thus saith the Lord GOD; When the whole earth rejoiceth, I will make thee desolate.

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi iwọ ti yọ̀ si ini ile Israeli, nitori ti o di ahoro, bẹ̃li emi o ṣe si ọ; iwọ o di ahoro, iwọ oke Seiri ati gbogbo Idumea, ani gbogbo rẹ̀: nwọn o si mọ̀ pe emi li Oluwa.
entries.en: As thou didst rejoice at the inheritance of the house of Israel, because it was desolate, so will I do unto thee: thou shalt be desolate, O mount Seir, and all Idumea, even all of it: and they shall know that I am the LORD.

entries.yo: ATI iwọ, ọmọ enia, sọtẹlẹ si awọn oke Israeli, si wipe, Ẹnyin oke Israeli, ẹ gbọ́ ọ̀rọ Oluwa:
entries.en: Also, thou son of man, prophesy unto the mountains of Israel, and say, Ye mountains of Israel, hear the word of the LORD:

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi, Nitori ti ọta ti wi si nyin pe, Aha, ani ibi giga igbãni jẹ tiwa ni ini:
entries.en: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because the enemy hath said against you, Aha, even the ancient high places are ours in possession:

entries.yo: Nitorina sọtẹlẹ, ki o si wipe, Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi, pe, Nitõtọ nitori nwọn ti sọ ọ di ahoro, ti nwọn si gbe ọ mì niha gbogbo, ki ẹnyin ba le jẹ ini fun awọn keferi iyokù, ti a mu nyin si ẹnu, ti ẹnyin si jasi ẹ̀gan awọn enia:
entries.en: Therefore prophesy and say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because they have made you desolate, and swallowed you up on every side, that ye might be a possession unto the residue of the heathen, and ye are taken up in the lips of talkers, and are an infamy of the people:

entries.yo: Nitorina, ẹnyin oke Israeli, ẹ gbọ́ ọ̀rọ Oluwa Ọlọrun; Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi fun awọn oke-nla, ati fun awọn oke kékèké, fun awọn odò, ati fun awọn afonifoji, fun ibi idahoro, ati fun awọn ilu ti a kọ̀ silẹ, ti o di ijẹ ati iyọsùtisi fun awọn keferi iyokù ti o yika kiri;
entries.en: Therefore, ye mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord GOD; Thus saith the Lord GOD to the mountains, and to the hills, to the rivers, and to the valleys, to the desolate wastes, and to the cities that are forsaken, which became a prey and derision to the residue of the heathen that are round about;

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Nitõtọ ninu iná owu mi li emi ti sọ̀rọ si awọn keferi iyokù, ati si gbogbo Idumea, ti o ti fi ayọ̀ inu wọn gbogbo yàn ilẹ mi ni iní wọn, pẹlu àrankan inu, lati ta a nù fun ijẹ.
entries.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Surely in the fire of my jealousy have I spoken against the residue of the heathen, and against all Idumea, which have appointed my land into their possession with the joy of all their heart, with despiteful minds, to cast it out for a prey.

entries.yo: Nitorina sọtẹlẹ niti ilẹ Israeli, ki o si wi fun awọn oke nla, ati fun awọn oke kékèké, fun awọn odò, ati fun awọn afonifoji, pe, Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi, Wò o, emi ti sọ̀rọ ninu owu mi, ati ninu irúnu mi, nitori ti ẹnyin ti rù itiju awọn keferi.
entries.en: Prophesy therefore concerning the land of Israel, and say unto the mountains, and to the hills, to the rivers, and to the valleys, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I have spoken in my jealousy and in my fury, because ye have borne the shame of the heathen:

entries.yo: Nitorina bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; emi ti gbe ọwọ́ mi soke, Nitõtọ awọn keferi ti o yi nyin ka, awọn ni yio rù itiju wọn.
entries.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; I have lifted up mine hand, Surely the heathen that are about you, they shall bear their shame.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹnyin, oke Israeli, ẹnyin o yọ ẹka jade, ẹ o si so eso nyin fun Israeli enia mi; nitori nwọn fẹrẹ̀ de.
entries.en: But ye, O mountains of Israel, ye shall shoot forth your branches, and yield your fruit to my people of Israel; for they are at hand to come.

entries.yo: Si kiyesi i, emi wà fun nyin, emi o si yipadà si nyin, a o si ro nyin, a o si gbìn nyin:
entries.en: For, behold, I am for you, and I will turn unto you, and ye shall be tilled and sown:

entries.yo: Emi o si mu enia bi si i lori nyin, gbogbo ile Israeli, ani gbogbo rẹ̀: awọn ilu yio si ni olugbe, a o si kọ́ ibi ti o di ahoro:
entries.en: And I will multiply men upon you, all the house of Israel, even all of it: and the cities shall be inhabited, and the wastes shall be builded:

entries.yo: Emi o si mu enia ati ẹranko bi si i lori nyin; nwọn o si pọ̀ si i, nwọn o si rẹ̀: emi o si mu nyin joko ni ibugbe nyin, bi ti atijọ, emi o si ṣe si nyin jù igbà ibẹ̀rẹ nyin lọ: ẹnyin o si mọ̀ pe, emi li Oluwa.
entries.en: And I will multiply upon you man and beast; and they shall increase and bring fruit: and I will settle you after your old estates, and will do better unto you than at your beginnings: and ye shall know that I am the LORD.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ, emi o mu ki enia rìn lori nyin, ani Israeli enia mi; nwọn o si ni ọ, iwọ o si jẹ iní wọn, iwọ kì yio si gbà wọn li ọmọ mọ lati isisiyi lọ.
entries.en: Yea, I will cause men to walk upon you, even my people Israel; and they shall possess thee, and thou shalt be their inheritance, and thou shalt no more henceforth bereave them of men.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Nitori nwọn wi fun nyin, pe, Iwọ jẹ enia run, o si ti gbà awọn orilẹ-ède li ọmọ;
entries.en: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because they say unto you, Thou land devourest up men, and hast bereaved thy nations;

entries.yo: Nitorina iwọ kì yio jẹ enia run mọ, bẹ̃ni iwọ kì yio gbà awọn orilẹ rẹ li ọmọ mọ, li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi.
entries.en: Therefore thou shalt devour men no more, neither bereave thy nations any more, saith the Lord GOD.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni emi kì yio mu ki enia gbọ́ ìtiju awọn keferi ninu rẹ mọ, bẹ̃ni iwọ kì yio rù ẹ̀gan awọn orilẹ-ède mọ, bẹ̃ni iwọ kì yio mu ki orilẹ-ẹ̀de rẹ ṣubu mọ, li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi.
entries.en: Neither will I cause men to hear in thee the shame of the heathen any more, neither shalt thou bear the reproach of the people any more, neither shalt thou cause thy nations to fall any more, saith the Lord GOD.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ Oluwa si tọ̀ mi wá, wipe,
entries.en: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

entries.yo: Ọmọ enia, nigbati ile Israeli ngbe ilẹ ti wọn; nwọn bà a jẹ nipa ọ̀na wọn, ati nipa iṣe wọn: ọ̀na wọn loju mi dabi aimọ́ obinrin ti a mu kuro.
entries.en: Son of man, when the house of Israel dwelt in their own land, they defiled it by their own way and by their doings: their way was before me as the uncleanness of a removed woman.

entries.yo: Nitorina emi fi irúnu mi si ori wọn, nitori ẹ̀jẹ ti wọn ti ta sori ilẹ na, ati nitori ere wọn ti wọn ti fi bà a jẹ.
entries.en: Wherefore I poured my fury upon them for the blood that they had shed upon the land, and for their idols wherewith they had polluted it:

entries.yo: Emi si ti tú wọn ká sãrin awọn keferi, a si fọn wọn ká si gbogbo ilẹ: emi dá wọn lẹjọ, gẹgẹ bi ọ̀na wọn, ati gẹgẹ bi iṣe wọn.
entries.en: And I scattered them among the heathen, and they were dispersed through the countries: according to their way and according to their doings I judged them.

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn si wọ̀ inu awọn keferi, nibiti nwọn lọ, nwọn bà orukọ mimọ́ mi jẹ, nigbati nwọn wi fun wọn pe, Awọn wọnyi li enia Oluwa, nwọn si ti jade kuro ni ilẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And when they entered unto the heathen, whither they went, they profaned my holy name, when they said to them, These are the people of the LORD, and are gone forth out of his land.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ãnu orukọ mimọ́ mi ṣe mi, ti ile Israeli ti bajẹ lãrin awọn keferi, nibiti nwọn lọ.
entries.en: But I had pity for mine holy name, which the house of Israel had profaned among the heathen, whither they went.

entries.yo: Nitorina sọ fun ile Israeli, pe, Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Ile Israeli, emi kò ṣe eyi nitori ti nyin, ṣugbọn fun orukọ mimọ́ mi, ti ẹnyin ti bajẹ lãrin awọn keferi, nibiti ẹnyin lọ.
entries.en: Therefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord GOD; I do not this for your sakes, O house of Israel, but for mine holy name's sake, which ye have profaned among the heathen, whither ye went.

entries.yo: Emi o si sọ orukọ nla mi di mimọ́, ti a bajẹ lãrin awọn keferi, ti ẹnyin ti bajẹ lãrin wọn; awọn keferi yio si mọ̀ pe emi li Oluwa, nigbati a o sọ mi di mimọ́ ninu nyin niwaju wọn, li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi.
entries.en: And I will sanctify my great name, which was profaned among the heathen, which ye have profaned in the midst of them; and the heathen shall know that I am the LORD, saith the Lord GOD, when I shall be sanctified in you before their eyes.

entries.yo: Nitori emi o mu nyin kuro lãrin awọn keferi, emi o si ṣà nyin jọ kuro ni gbogbo ilẹ, emi o si mu nyin padà si ilẹ ti nyin.
entries.en: For I will take you from among the heathen, and gather you out of all countries, and will bring you into your own land.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni emi o fi omi mimọ́ wọ́n nyin, ẹnyin o si mọ́: emi o si wẹ̀ nyin mọ́ kuro ninu gbogbo ẹgbin nyin ati kuro ninu gbogbo oriṣa nyin.
entries.en: Then will I sprinkle clean water upon you, and ye shall be clean: from all your filthiness, and from all your idols, will I cleanse you.

entries.yo: Emi o fi ọkàn titun fun nyin pẹlu, ẹmi titun li emi o fi sinu nyin, emi o si mu ọkàn okuta kuro lara nyin, emi o si fi ọkàn ẹran fun nyin.
entries.en: A new heart also will I give you, and a new spirit will I put within you: and I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you an heart of flesh.

entries.yo: Emi o si fi ẹmi mi sinu nyin, emi o si mu ki ẹ ma rìn ninu aṣẹ mi, ẹnyin o pa idajọ mi mọ, ẹ o si ma ṣe wọn.
entries.en: And I will put my spirit within you, and cause you to walk in my statutes, and ye shall keep my judgments, and do them.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin o si ma gbe ilẹ ti emi fi fun awọn baba nyin; ẹnyin o si ma jẹ enia mi, emi o si ma jẹ Ọlọrun nyin.
entries.en: And ye shall dwell in the land that I gave to your fathers; and ye shall be my people, and I will be your God.

entries.yo: Emi o si gbà nyin là kuro ninu aimọ́ nyin gbogbo: emi o si pè ọkà wá, emi o si mu u pọ̀ si i, emi kì yio si mu ìyan wá ba nyin.
entries.en: I will also save you from all your uncleannesses: and I will call for the corn, and will increase it, and lay no famine upon you.

entries.yo: Emi o si sọ eso-igi di pupọ̀, ati ibísi oko, ki ẹ má bà gbà ẹ̀gan ìyan mọ lãrin awọn keferi.
entries.en: And I will multiply the fruit of the tree, and the increase of the field, that ye shall receive no more reproach of famine among the heathen.

entries.yo: Nigbana li ẹnyin o ranti ọ̀na buburu nyin, ati iṣe nyin ti kò dara, ẹ o si sú ara nyin li oju ara nyin fun aiṣedẽde nyin, ati fun irira nyin.
entries.en: Then shall ye remember your own evil ways, and your doings that were not good, and shall lothe yourselves in your own sight for your iniquities and for your abominations.

entries.yo: Kì iṣe nitori ti nyin li emi ṣe eyi, ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi, ẹ mọ̀ eyi: ki oju ki o tì nyin, ki ẹ si dãmú nitori ọ̀na ara nyin, ile Israeli.
entries.en: Not for your sakes do I this, saith the Lord GOD, be it known unto you: be ashamed and confounded for your own ways, O house of Israel.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Li ọjọ ti emi o ti wẹ̀ nyin mọ́ kuro ninu aiṣedẽde nyin gbogbo, emi o mu ki a tun gbe ilu, a o si kọ́ ibi ahoro wọnni.
entries.en: Thus saith the Lord GOD; In the day that I shall have cleansed you from all your iniquities I will also cause you to dwell in the cities, and the wastes shall be builded.

entries.yo: Ilẹ ahoro li a o si ro, ti o ti di ahoro li oju gbogbo awọn ti o ti kọja.
entries.en: And the desolate land shall be tilled, whereas it lay desolate in the sight of all that passed by.

entries.yo: Nwọn o si wipe, Ilẹ yi ti o ti di ahoro ti dabi ọgbà Edeni; ati ilu ti o tú, ti o di ahoro, ti o si parun, di ilu olodi, o si ni olugbe.
entries.en: And they shall say, This land that was desolate is become like the garden of Eden; and the waste and desolate and ruined cities are become fenced, and are inhabited.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni awọn keferi iyokù yika nyin yio mọ̀ pe emi Oluwa ti kọ́ ilu ti o parun, emi si ti gbìn eyiti o ti di ahoro: emi Oluwa ti sọ ọ, emi o si ṣe e.
entries.en: Then the heathen that are left round about you shall know that I the LORD build the ruined places, and plant that that was desolate: I the LORD have spoken it, and I will do it.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Ile Israeli yio bere eyi lọwọ mi, lati ṣe e fun wọn, emi o mu enia bi si i fun wọn bi ọwọ́-ẹran.
entries.en: Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will yet for this be inquired of by the house of Israel, to do it for them; I will increase them with men like a flock.

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi ọwọ́-ẹran mimọ́, bi ọwọ́-ẹran Jerusalemu ni àse wọn ti o ni ironu, bẹ̃ni ilu ti o di ahoro yio kún fun enia: nwọn o si mọ̀ pe, emi li Oluwa.
entries.en: As the holy flock, as the flock of Jerusalem in her solemn feasts; so shall the waste cities be filled with flocks of men: and they shall know that I am the LORD.

entries.yo: ỌWỌ́ Oluwa wà li ara mi, o si mu mi jade ninu ẹmi Oluwa, o si gbe mi kalẹ li ãrin afonifojì ti o kún fun egungun,
entries.en: The hand of the LORD was upon me, and carried me out in the spirit of the LORD, and set me down in the midst of the valley which was full of bones,

entries.yo: O si mu mi rìn yi wọn ka: si wò o, ọ̀pọlọpọ ni mbẹ ni gbangba afonifojì; si kiyesi i, nwọn gbẹ pupọpupọ.
entries.en: And caused me to pass by them round about: and, behold, there were very many in the open valley; and, lo, they were very dry.

entries.yo: O si wi fun mi pe, Ọmọ enia, egungun wọnyi le yè? Emi si wipe, Oluwa Ọlọrun, iwọ li o le mọ̀.
entries.en: And he said unto me, Son of man, can these bones live? And I answered, O Lord GOD, thou knowest.

entries.yo: O tun wi fun mi pe, Sọtẹlẹ sori egungun wọnyi, si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹnyin egungun gbigbẹ, ẹ gbọ́ ọ̀rọ Oluwa.
entries.en: Again he said unto me, Prophesy upon these bones, and say unto them, O ye dry bones, hear the word of the LORD.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi fun egungun wọnyi; Kiyesi i, emi o mu ki ẽmi wọ̀ inu nyin, ẹnyin o si yè:
entries.en: Thus saith the Lord GOD unto these bones; Behold, I will cause breath to enter into you, and ye shall live:

entries.yo: Emi o si fi iṣan sara nyin, emi o si mu ẹran wá sara nyin, emi o si fi àwọ bò nyin, emi o si fi ẽmi sinu nyin, ẹnyin o si yè; ẹnyin o si mọ̀ pe emi li Oluwa.
entries.en: And I will lay sinews upon you, and will bring up flesh upon you, and cover you with skin, and put breath in you, and ye shall live; and ye shall know that I am the LORD.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni mo ṣotẹlẹ gẹgẹ bi a ti paṣẹ fun mi: bi mo si ti sọtẹlẹ, ariwo ta, si wò o, mimì kan wà, awọn egungun na si wá ọdọ ara wọn, egungun si egungun rẹ̀.
entries.en: So I prophesied as I was commanded: and as I prophesied, there was a noise, and behold a shaking, and the bones came together, bone to his bone.

entries.yo: Nigbati mo si wò, kiyesi i, iṣan ati ẹran-ara wá si wọn, àwọ si bò wọn loke: ṣugbọn ẽmi kò si ninu wọn.
entries.en: And when I beheld, lo, the sinews and the flesh came up upon them, and the skin covered them above: but there was no breath in them.

entries.yo: Nigbana li o sọ fun mi, pe, ọmọ enia, Sọtẹlẹ si ẽmi, sọtẹlẹ, si wi fun ẽmi pe, Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Iwọ ẽmi, wá lati igun mẹrẹrin, si mí si okú wọnyi, ki nwọn ba le yè.
entries.en: Then said he unto me, Prophesy unto the wind, prophesy, son of man, and say to the wind, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Come from the four winds, O breath, and breathe upon these slain, that they may live.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni mo sọtẹlẹ gẹgẹ bi a ti paṣẹ fun mi, ẽmi na si wá sinu wọn, nwọn si yè, nwọn si dide duro li ẹsẹ wọn ogun nlanla.
entries.en: So I prophesied as he commanded me, and the breath came into them, and they lived, and stood up upon their feet, an exceeding great army.

entries.yo: Nigbana li o sọ fun mi pe, Ọmọ enia, egungun wọnyi ni gbogbo ile Israeli: wò o, nwọn wipe, Egungun wa gbẹ, ireti wa si pin: ni ti awa, a ti ke wa kuro.
entries.en: Then he said unto me, Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel: behold, they say, Our bones are dried, and our hope is lost: we are cut off for our parts.
