entries.yo: Nitorina sọtẹlẹ ki o si wi fun wọn pe, Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Kiyesi i, ẹnyin enia mi, emi o ṣi ibojì nyin, emi o si mu ki ẹ dide kuro ninu ibojì nyin, emi o si mu nyin wá si ilẹ Israeli.
entries.en: Therefore prophesy and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, O my people, I will open your graves, and cause you to come up out of your graves, and bring you into the land of Israel.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin o si mọ̀ pe emi li Oluwa, nigbati emi bá ti ṣí ibojì nyin, ẹnyin enia mi, ti emi bá si mu nyin dide kuro ninu ibojì nyin.
entries.en: And ye shall know that I am the LORD, when I have opened your graves, O my people, and brought you up out of your graves,

entries.yo: Emi o si fi ẹmi mi sinu nyin, ẹnyin o si yè, emi o si mu nyin joko ni ilẹ ti nyin: nigbana li ẹnyin o mọ̀ pe, emi Oluwa li o ti sọ ọ, ti o si ti ṣe e, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: And shall put my spirit in you, and ye shall live, and I shall place you in your own land: then shall ye know that I the LORD have spoken it, and performed it, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Ọrọ Oluwa tun tọ̀ mi wá, wipe,
entries.en: The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,

entries.yo: Ati iwọ, ọmọ enia, mu igi kan, si kọwe si i lara, Fun Juda, ati fun awọn ọmọ Israeli ẹgbẹ́ rẹ̀: si mu igi miran, si kọwe si i lara, Fun Josefu, igi Efraimu, ati fun gbogbo ile Israeli ẹgbẹ́ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Moreover, thou son of man, take thee one stick, and write upon it, For Judah, and for the children of Israel his companions: then take another stick, and write upon it, For Joseph, the stick of Ephraim, and for all the house of Israel his companions:

entries.yo: Si dà wọn pọ̀ ṣọkan si igi kan; nwọn o si di ọkan li ọwọ́ rẹ.
entries.en: And join them one to another into one stick; and they shall become one in thine hand.

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn enia rẹ ba ba ọ sọ̀rọ, wipe, Iwọ kì yio fi idi nkan wọnyi hàn wa?
entries.en: And when the children of thy people shall speak unto thee, saying, Wilt thou not shew us what thou meanest by these?

entries.yo: Wi fun wọn pe, Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Kiyesi i, emi o mu igi Josefu, ti o wà li ọwọ́ Efraimu, ati awọn ẹya Israeli ẹgbẹ́ rẹ̀, emi o si mu wọn pẹlu rẹ̀, pẹlu igi Juda, emi o si sọ wọn di igi kan, nwọn o si di ọkan li ọwọ́ mi.
entries.en: Say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will take the stick of Joseph, which is in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Israel his fellows, and will put them with him, even with the stick of Judah, and make them one stick, and they shall be one in mine hand.

entries.yo: Igi ti iwọ kọwe si lara yio wà li ọwọ́ rẹ, niwaju wọn.
entries.en: And the sticks whereon thou writest shall be in thine hand before their eyes.

entries.yo: Si wi fun wọn pe, Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Kiyesi i, emi o mu awọn ọmọ Israeli kuro lãrin awọn keferi, nibiti nwọn lọ, emi o si ṣà wọn jọ niha gbogbo, emi o si mu wọn wá si ilẹ ti wọn.
entries.en: And say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will take the children of Israel from among the heathen, whither they be gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land:

entries.yo: Emi o si sọ wọn di orilẹ-ède kan ni ilẹ lori oke-nla Israeli; ọba kan ni yio si jẹ lori gbogbo wọn: nwọn kì yio si jẹ orilẹ-ède meji mọ, bẹ̃ni a kì yio sọ wọn di ijọba meji mọ rara.
entries.en: And I will make them one nation in the land upon the mountains of Israel; and one king shall be king to them all: and they shall be no more two nations, neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all:

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni nwọn kì yio fi oriṣa wọn bà ara wọn jẹ mọ, tabi ohun-irira wọn, tabi ohun irekọja wọn: ṣugbọn emi o gbà wọn là kuro ninu gbogbo ibugbe wọn, nibiti nwọn ti dẹṣẹ, emi o si wẹ̀ wọn mọ́: bẹ̃ni nwọn o jẹ enia mi, emi o si jẹ Ọlọrun wọn.
entries.en: Neither shall they defile themselves any more with their idols, nor with their detestable things, nor with any of their transgressions: but I will save them out of all their dwellingplaces, wherein they have sinned, and will cleanse them: so shall they be my people, and I will be their God.

entries.yo: Dafidi iranṣẹ mi yio si jẹ ọba lori wọn; gbogbo wọn ni yio si ni oluṣọ-agutan kan: nwọn o rìn ninu idajọ mi pẹlu, nwọn o si kiyesi aṣẹ mi, nwọn o si ṣe wọn.
entries.en: And David my servant shall be king over them; and they all shall have one shepherd: they shall also walk in my judgments, and observe my statutes, and do them.

entries.yo: Nwọn o si ma gbe ilẹ ti emi ti fi fun Jakobu iranṣẹ mi, nibiti awọn baba nyin ti gbe; nwọn o si ma gbe inu rẹ̀, awọn, ati awọn ọmọ wọn, ati awọn ọmọ ọmọ wọn lailai: Dafidi iranṣẹ mi yio si ma jẹ ọmọ-alade wọn lailai.
entries.en: And they shall dwell in the land that I have given unto Jacob my servant, wherein your fathers have dwelt; and they shall dwell therein, even they, and their children, and their children's children for ever: and my servant David shall be their prince for ever.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu emi o ba wọn dá majẹmu alafia; yio si jẹ majẹmu aiyeraiye pẹlu wọn: emi o si gbe wọn kalẹ, emi o si mu wọn rẹ̀, emi o si gbe ibi mimọ́ mi si ãrin wọn titi aiye.
entries.en: Moreover I will make a covenant of peace with them; it shall be an everlasting covenant with them: and I will place them, and multiply them, and will set my sanctuary in the midst of them for evermore.

entries.yo: Agọ mi yio wà pẹlu wọn: nitõtọ, emi o si jẹ Ọlọrun wọn, nwọn o si jẹ enia mi.
entries.en: My tabernacle also shall be with them: yea, I will be their God, and they shall be my people.

entries.yo: Awọn keferi yio si mọ̀ pe, emi Oluwa li o ti sọ Israeli di mimọ́, nigbati ibi mimọ́ mi yio wà li ãrin wọn titi aiye.
entries.en: And the heathen shall know that I the LORD do sanctify Israel, when my sanctuary shall be in the midst of them for evermore.

entries.yo: Ọ̀RỌ Oluwa si tọ̀ mi wá wipe,
entries.en: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

entries.yo: Ọmọ enia, kọ oju rẹ si Gogu, ilẹ Magogu, olori Roṣi, Meṣeki, ati Tubali, si sọtẹlẹ si i,
entries.en: Son of man, set thy face against Gog, the land of Magog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal, and prophesy against him,

entries.yo: Si wipe, Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Kiyesi i, emi dojukọ ọ, iwọ Gogu, olori Roṣi, Meṣeki, ati Tubali:
entries.en: And say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold I am against thee, O Gog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal:

entries.yo: Emi o si dá ọ padà, emi o si fi ìwọ kọ́ ọ li ẹ̀rẹkẹ́, emi o si mu ọ jade wá, ati gbogbo ogun rẹ, ẹṣin ati ẹlẹṣin, gbogbo wọn li a wọ̀ laṣọ daradara, ani ẹgbẹ́ nla pẹlu apata on asà, gbogbo wọn dì idà mu:
entries.en: And I will turn thee back, and put hooks into thy jaws, and I will bring thee forth, and all thine army, horses and horsemen, all of them clothed with all sorts of armour, even a great company with bucklers and shields, all of them handling swords:

entries.yo: Persia, Etiopia, ati Libia pẹlu wọn; gbogbo wọn pẹlu asà on akoro:
entries.en: Persia, Ethiopia, and Libya with them; all of them with shield and helmet:

entries.yo: Gomeri, ati gbogbo ogun rẹ̀; ile Togarma ti ihà ariwa, ati gbogbo ogun rẹ̀: enia pupọ̀ pẹlu rẹ̀.
entries.en: Gomer, and all his bands; the house of Togarmah of the north quarters, and all his bands: and many people with thee.

entries.yo: Iwọ mura silẹ, si mura fun ara rẹ, iwọ, ati gbogbo ẹgbẹ́ rẹ ti a gbajọ fun ọ, ki iwọ jẹ alãbo fun wọn.
entries.en: Be thou prepared, and prepare for thyself, thou, and all thy company that are assembled unto thee, and be thou a guard unto them.

entries.yo: Lẹhìn ọjọ pupọ̀ li a o bẹ̀ ọ wò: li ọdun ikẹhìn, iwọ o wá si ilẹ ti a gbà padà lọwọ idà, ti a si kojọ pọ̀ kuro lọdọ enia pupọ̀, lori oke-nla Israeli, ti iti ma di ahoro: ṣugbọn a mu u jade kuro ninu awọn orilẹ-ède, nwọn o si ma gbe li ailewu, gbogbo wọn.
entries.en: After many days thou shalt be visited: in the latter years thou shalt come into the land that is brought back from the sword, and is gathered out of many people, against the mountains of Israel, which have been always waste: but it is brought forth out of the nations, and they shall dwell safely all of them.

entries.yo: Iwọ o goke wá, iwọ o si de bi ijì, iwọ o dabi awọsanma lati bò ilẹ, iwọ, ati gbogbo awọn ogun rẹ, ati ọ̀pọlọpọ enia pẹlu rẹ.
entries.en: Thou shalt ascend and come like a storm, thou shalt be like a cloud to cover the land, thou, and all thy bands, and many people with thee.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; yio si ṣe pe nigbakanna ni nkan yio sọ si ọ̀kàn rẹ, iwọ o si rò èro ibi kan.
entries.en: Thus saith the Lord GOD; It shall also come to pass, that at the same time shall things come into thy mind, and thou shalt think an evil thought:

entries.yo: Iwọ o si wipe, emi o goke lọ si ilẹ ileto ti kò ni odi: emi o tọ̀ awọn ti o wà ni isimi lọ, ti nwọn ngbe laibẹ̀ru, ti gbogbo wọn ngbe laisi odi, ti nwọn kò si ni agbarà-irin tabi ẹnu-odi,
entries.en: And thou shalt say, I will go up to the land of unwalled villages; I will go to them that are at rest, that dwell safely, all of them dwelling without walls, and having neither bars nor gates,

entries.yo: Lati lọ kó ikogun, ati lati lọ mu ohun ọdẹ; lati yi ọwọ́ rẹ si ibi ahoro wọnni ti a tẹ̀do nisisiyi, ati si enia ti a kojọ lati inu awọn orilẹ-ède wá, awọn ti o ti ni ohun-ọ̀sin ati ẹrù, ti ngbe oke ilẹ na.
entries.en: To take a spoil, and to take a prey; to turn thine hand upon the desolate places that are now inhabited, and upon the people that are gathered out of the nations, which have gotten cattle and goods, that dwell in the midst of the land.

entries.yo: Ṣeba, ati Dedani, ati awọn oniṣòwo Tarṣiṣi, pẹlu gbogbo awọn ọmọ kiniun wọn, yio si wi fun ọ pe, Ikogun ni iwọ wá kó? lati wá mu ohun ọdẹ li o ṣe gbá awọn ẹgbẹ́ rẹ jọ? lati wá rù fadaka ati wura lọ, lati wá rù ohun-ọsìn ati ẹrù, lati wá kó ikogun nla?
entries.en: Sheba, and Dedan, and the merchants of Tarshish, with all the young lions thereof, shall say unto thee, Art thou come to take a spoil? hast thou gathered thy company to take a prey? to carry away silver and gold, to take away cattle and goods, to take a great spoil?

entries.yo: Nitorina, sọtẹlẹ, ọmọ enia, si wi fun Gogu pe, Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Ni ijọ na nigbati awọn enia mi Israeli ba ngbe laibẹ̀ru, iwọ kì yio mọ̀?
entries.en: Therefore, son of man, prophesy and say unto Gog, Thus saith the Lord GOD; In that day when my people of Israel dwelleth safely, shalt thou not know it?

entries.yo: Iwọ o si ti ipò rẹ wá lati iha ariwa, iwọ, ati ọ̀pọ enia pẹlu rẹ, gbogbo wọn li o ngùn ẹṣin, ẹgbẹ nla, ati ọ̀pọlọpọ ogun alagbara:
entries.en: And thou shalt come from thy place out of the north parts, thou, and many people with thee, all of them riding upon horses, a great company, and a mighty army:

entries.yo: Iwọ o si goke wá si awọn enia mi Israeli, bi awọsanma lati bò ilẹ; yio si ṣe nikẹhin ọjọ, emi o si mu ọ dojukọ ilẹ mi, ki awọn orilẹ-ède ki o le mọ̀ mi, nigbati a o yà mi si mimọ́ ninu rẹ, niwaju wọn, iwọ Gogu.
entries.en: And thou shalt come up against my people of Israel, as a cloud to cover the land; it shall be in the latter days, and I will bring thee against my land, that the heathen may know me, when I shall be sanctified in thee, O Gog, before their eyes.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Iwọ li ẹniti mo ti sọ̀rọ rẹ̀ nigba atijọ lati ọwọ́ awọn iranṣẹ mi awọn woli Israeli, ti nwọn sọtẹlẹ li ọjọ wọnni li ọdun pupọ pe, emi o mu ọ wá dojukọ wọn?
entries.en: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Art thou he of whom I have spoken in old time by my servants the prophets of Israel, which prophesied in those days many years that I would bring thee against them?

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe nigbakanna li ákoko ti Gogu yio wá dojukọ ilẹ Israeli, ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi, ti irúnu mi yio yọ li oju mi.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass at the same time when Gog shall come against the land of Israel, saith the Lord GOD, that my fury shall come up in my face.

entries.yo: Nitori ni ijowu mi ati ni iná ibinu mi ni mo ti sọ̀rọ, Nitõtọ li ọjọ na mimì nla kan yio wà ni ilẹ Israeli;
entries.en: For in my jealousy and in the fire of my wrath have I spoken, Surely in that day there shall be a great shaking in the land of Israel;

entries.yo: Awọn ẹja inu okun, ati awọn ẹiyẹ oju ọrun, ati awọn ẹranko inu igbó, ati ohun gbogbo ti nrakò lori ilẹ, ati gbogbo enia ti mbẹ loju ilẹ, yio si mì niwaju mi, a o si bì òke-nla ṣubu, ati gbogbo ibi giga yio ṣubu, olukuluku ogiri yio ṣubu lulẹ.
entries.en: So that the fishes of the sea, and the fowls of the heaven, and the beasts of the field, and all creeping things that creep upon the earth, and all the men that are upon the face of the earth, shall shake at my presence, and the mountains shall be thrown down, and the steep places shall fall, and every wall shall fall to the ground.

entries.yo: Emi o si pè idà si i lori gbogbo oke mi, ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi: idà olukuluku yio si dojukọ arakunrin rẹ̀.
entries.en: And I will call for a sword against him throughout all my mountains, saith the Lord GOD: every man's sword shall be against his brother.

entries.yo: Emi o si fi ajàkalẹ arùn ati ẹjẹ ba a wijọ; emi o si rọ̀ ojò pupọ̀, ati yìnyin nla, iná ati imi-ọjọ, si i lori, ati sori áwọn ẹgbẹ rẹ̀, ati sori ọ̀pọlọpọ enia ti o wà pẹlu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And I will plead against him with pestilence and with blood; and I will rain upon him, and upon his bands, and upon the many people that are with him, an overflowing rain, and great hailstones, fire, and brimstone.

entries.yo: Emi o si gbe ara mi lèke, emi o si ya ara mi si mimọ́; emi o si di mimọ̀ loju ọ̀pọlọpọ orilẹ-ède, nwọn o si mọ̀ pe emi li Oluwa.
entries.en: Thus will I magnify myself, and sanctify myself; and I will be known in the eyes of many nations, and they shall know that I am the LORD.

entries.yo: NITORINA, iwọ ọmọ enia, sọtẹlẹ si Gogu, si wipe, Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Kiye si i, emi dojukọ́ ọ, iwọ Gogu, olori ọmọ-alade Meṣeki ati Tubali:
entries.en: Therefore, thou son of man, prophesy against Gog, and say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I am against thee, O Gog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal:

entries.yo: Emi o si dá ọ padà, emi o si dári rẹ, emi o si mu ọ goke wá lati ihà ariwa, emi o si mu ọ wá sori oke giga Israeli:
entries.en: And I will turn thee back, and leave but the sixth part of thee, and will cause thee to come up from the north parts, and will bring thee upon the mountains of Israel:

entries.yo: Emi o si lù ọrun rẹ kurò li ọwọ́ osì rẹ, emi o si mu ọfà rẹ bọ kuro lọwọ ọtun rẹ.
entries.en: And I will smite thy bow out of thy left hand, and will cause thine arrows to fall out of thy right hand.

entries.yo: Iwọ o ṣubu lori òke giga Israeli, iwọ, ati gbogbo awọn ogun rẹ, ati awọn enia ti o wà pẹlu rẹ: emi o fi ọ fun ẹiyẹ ọdẹ onirũru iyẹ, ati ẹranko igbẹ lati pa jẹ.
entries.en: Thou shalt fall upon the mountains of Israel, thou, and all thy bands, and the people that is with thee: I will give thee unto the ravenous birds of every sort, and to the beasts of the field to be devoured.

entries.yo: Iwọ o ṣubu ni gbangba oko: nitori emi li o sọ ọ, ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi.
entries.en: Thou shalt fall upon the open field: for I have spoken it, saith the Lord GOD.

entries.yo: Emi o si rán iná si Magogu, ati sãrin awọn ti ngbe erekuṣu laibẹ̀ru; nwọn o si mọ̀ pe emi li Oluwa.
entries.en: And I will send a fire on Magog, and among them that dwell carelessly in the isles: and they shall know that I am the LORD.

entries.yo: Emi o si sọ orukọ mimọ́ mi di mimọ̀ lãrin enia mi Israeli; emi kì yio si jẹ ki nwọn bà orukọ mimọ́ mi jẹ mọ: awọn orilẹ-ède yio si mọ̀ pe emi li Oluwa, Ẹni-Mimọ́ ni Israeli.
entries.en: So will I make my holy name known in the midst of my people Israel; and I will not let them pollute my holy name any more: and the heathen shall know that I am the LORD, the Holy One in Israel.

entries.yo: Kiye si i, o ti de, a si ti ṣe e; ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi, eyi ni ọjọ ti emi ti sọ.
entries.en: Behold, it is come, and it is done, saith the Lord GOD; this is the day whereof I have spoken.

entries.yo: Awọn ti o si ngbe ilu Israeli yio jade lọ, nwọn o si fi ohun ihamọra wọnni jona ati asa ati apata, ọrun ati ọfà, kùmọ ati ọ̀kọ; nwọn o si fi iná sun wọn li ọdun meje:
entries.en: And they that dwell in the cities of Israel shall go forth, and shall set on fire and burn the weapons, both the shields and the bucklers, the bows and the arrows, and the handstaves, and the spears, and they shall burn them with fire seven years:

entries.yo: Nwọn kì yio lọ rù igi lati inu oko wá, bẹ̃ni nwọn kì yio ke igi lulẹ lati inu igbẹ́ wá; nitori ohun ihamọra ni nwọn ti fi daná; nwọn o si ko awọn ti o ko wọn, nwọn o si dọdẹ awọn ti o dọdẹ wọn, ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi.
entries.en: So that they shall take no wood out of the field, neither cut down any out of the forests; for they shall burn the weapons with fire: and they shall spoil those that spoiled them, and rob those that robbed them, saith the Lord GOD.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe li ọjọ na, emi o fi ibikan fun Gogu nibẹ fun iboji ni Israeli, afonifoji awọn èro ni gabasi okun; on si pa awọn èro ni ẹnu mọ: nibẹ ni nwọn o gbe sin Gogu ati gbogbo ọ̀pọlọpọ enia rẹ̀ si: nwọn o si pè e ni, Afonifoji Hamon-gogu.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will give unto Gog a place there of graves in Israel, the valley of the passengers on the east of the sea: and it shall stop the noses of the passengers: and there shall they bury Gog and all his multitude: and they shall call it The valley of Hamon-gog.

entries.yo: Oṣù meje ni ile Israeli yio si ma fi sin okú wọn, ki nwọn ba le sọ ilẹ na di mimọ́.
entries.en: And seven months shall the house of Israel be burying of them, that they may cleanse the land.

entries.yo: Gbogbo enia ilẹ na ni yio si sin wọn: yio si jẹ okiki fun wọn li ọjọ ti a o yìn mi logo, ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi.
entries.en: Yea, all the people of the land shall bury them; and it shall be to them a renown the day that I shall be glorified, saith the Lord GOD.

entries.yo: Nwọn o si yà awọn ọkunrin sọtọ ti yio ma fi ṣe iṣẹ iṣe, lati ma rìn ilẹ na ja lati lọ isin awọn erò ti o kù lori ilẹ, lati sọ ọ di mimọ́: lẹhin oṣù meje nwọn o ma wá kiri.
entries.en: And they shall sever out men of continual employment, passing through the land to bury with the passengers those that remain upon the face of the earth, to cleanse it: after the end of seven months shall they search.

entries.yo: Awọn èro ti nlà ilẹ na kọja, nigbati ẹnikan ba ri egungun enia kan, yio sàmi kan si ẹba rẹ̀, titi awọn asinku yio fi sin i si afonifoji Hamon-gogu.
entries.en: And the passengers that pass through the land, when any seeth a man's bone, then shall he set up a sign by it, till the buriers have buried it in the valley of Hamon-gog.

entries.yo: Orukọ ilu na pẹlu yio si jẹ Hamona. Bayi ni nwọn o si sọ ilẹ na di mimọ́.
entries.en: And also the name of the city shall be Hamonah. Thus shall they cleanse the land.

entries.yo: Ati iwọ, ọmọ enia, bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi: Sọ fun olukuluku ẹiyẹ abiyẹ́, ati fun olukuluku ẹranko igbẹ, pe, Ẹ ko ara nyin jọ, ki ẹ si wá: ẹ gbá ara nyin jọ ni ihà gbogbo si ẹbọ mi ti emi rú fun nyin, ani irubọ nla lori oke giga Israeli, ki ẹnyin ba le jẹ ẹran, ki ẹ si mu ẹjẹ.
entries.en: And, thou son of man, thus saith the Lord GOD; Speak unto every feathered fowl, and to every beast of the field, Assemble yourselves, and come; gather yourselves on every side to my sacrifice that I do sacrifice for you, even a great sacrifice upon the mountains of Israel, that ye may eat flesh, and drink blood.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin o jẹ ẹran-ara awọn alagbara, ẹnyin o si mu ẹjẹ awọn ọmọ-alade aiye, ti agbò, ti ọdọ agutan, ati ti obukọ, ti akọ malũ, gbogbo wọn abọpa Baṣani.
entries.en: Ye shall eat the flesh of the mighty, and drink the blood of the princes of the earth, of rams, of lambs, and of goats, of bullocks, all of them fatlings of Bashan.

entries.yo: Ẹ o si jẹ ọra li ajẹyo, ẹ o si mu ẹjẹ li amupara, lati inu ẹbọ mi ti mo ti rú fun nyin.
entries.en: And ye shall eat fat till ye be full, and drink blood till ye be drunken, of my sacrifice which I have sacrificed for you.

entries.yo: Bayi li a o fi ẹṣin ati ẹlẹṣin bọ́ nyin yo lori tabili mi, pẹlu awọn alagbara, ati gbogbo awọn ologun, ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi.
entries.en: Thus ye shall be filled at my table with horses and chariots, with mighty men, and with all men of war, saith the Lord GOD.

entries.yo: Emi o si gbe ogo mi kalẹ lãrin awọn keferi, gbogbo awọn keferi yio si ri idajọ mi ti mo ti ṣe, ati ọwọ́ mi ti mo ti fi le wọn.
entries.en: And I will set my glory among the heathen, and all the heathen shall see my judgment that I have executed, and my hand that I have laid upon them.

entries.yo: Ile Israeli yio si mọ̀ pe, Emi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wọn lati ọjọ na lọ titi.
entries.en: So the house of Israel shall know that I am the LORD their God from that day and forward.

entries.yo: Awọn keferi yio si mọ̀ pe Israeli lọ si igbekùn nitori aiṣedẽde wọn: nitoriti nwọn ti ṣọ̀tẹ si mi, nitorina ni mo ṣe fi oju mi pamọ kuro lọdọ wọn, ti mo si fi wọn le awọn ọta wọn lọwọ: gbogbo wọn si ti ipa idà ṣubu.
entries.en: And the heathen shall know that the house of Israel went into captivity for their iniquity: because they trespassed against me, therefore hid I my face from them, and gave them into the hand of their enemies: so fell they all by the sword.

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi aimọ́ wọn, ati gẹgẹ bi irekọja wọn ni mo ṣe si wọn, mo si fi oju mi pamọ́ kuro lọdọ wọn.
entries.en: According to their uncleanness and according to their transgressions have I done unto them, and hid my face from them.

entries.yo: Nitorina bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Nisisiyi li emi o mu igbèkun Jakobu padà bọ̀, emi o si ṣãnu fun gbogbo ile Israeli, emi o si jowu nitori orukọ mi mimọ́:
entries.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Now will I bring again the captivity of Jacob, and have mercy upon the whole house of Israel, and will be jealous for my holy name;

entries.yo: Nwọn o si rù itiju wọn, ati gbogbo ọ̀tẹ wọn ti nwọn ti ṣe si mi, nigbati nwọn ngbe laibẹ̀ru ni ilẹ wọn, ti ẹnikẹni kò si dẹ̀ruba wọn.
entries.en: After that they have borne their shame, and all their trespasses whereby they have trespassed against me, when they dwelt safely in their land, and none made them afraid.

entries.yo: Nigbati emi ti mu wọn bọ̀ lati ọdọ orilẹ-ède, ti mo si ko wọn jọ lati ilẹ awọn ọta wọn wá, ti a si yà mi si mimọ́ ninu wọn niwaju orilẹ-ède pupọ.
entries.en: When I have brought them again from the people, and gathered them out of their enemies' lands, and am sanctified in them in the sight of many nations;

entries.yo: Nigbana ni nwọn o mọ̀ pe emi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wọn, nipa kikó ti mo mu ki a kó wọn lọ si igbekun lãrin awọn keferi: ṣugbọn mo ti ṣà wọn jọ si ilẹ wọn, emi kò si fi ẹnikẹni wọn silẹ nibẹ mọ.
entries.en: Then shall they know that I am the LORD their God, which cause them to be led into captivity among the heathen: but I have gathered them unto their own land, and have left none of them any more there.

entries.yo: Emi kì yio si fi oju mi pamọ kuro lọdọ wọn mọ: nitori emi ti tú ẹmi mi sori ile Israeli, ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi.
entries.en: Neither will I hide my face any more from them: for I have poured out my spirit upon the house of Israel, saith the Lord GOD.

entries.yo: LI ọdun kẹ̃dọgbọn oko-ẹrú wa, ni ibẹ̀rẹ ọdun na, li ọjọ ikẹwa oṣù, li ọdun ikẹrinla lẹhin igbati ilu fọ́, li ọjọ na gan, ọwọ́ Oluwa wà lara mi, o si mu mi wá sibẹ na.
entries.en: In the five and twentieth year of our captivity, in the beginning of the year, in the tenth day of the month, in the fourteenth year after that the city was smitten, in the selfsame day the hand of the LORD was upon me, and brought me thither.

entries.yo: Ninu iran Ọlọrun li o mu mi wá si ilẹ Israeli, o si gbe mi ka oke giga kan, lori eyiti kikọ ilu wà ni iha gusu.
entries.en: In the visions of God brought he me into the land of Israel, and set me upon a very high mountain, by which was as the frame of a city on the south.

entries.yo: O si mu mi wá sibẹ, si kiyesi i, ọkunrin kan mbẹ, ẹniti irí rẹ̀ dabi irí bàba, pẹlu okùn ọ̀gbọ li ọwọ́ rẹ̀, ati ije iwọ̀nlẹ; on si duro ni ẹnu-ọ̀na.
entries.en: And he brought me thither, and, behold, there was a man, whose appearance was like the appearance of brass, with a line of flax in his hand, and a measuring reed; and he stood in the gate.

entries.yo: Ọkunrin na si wi fun mi pe, Ọmọ enia, fi oju rẹ wò, ki o si fi eti rẹ gbọ́, ki o si gbe ọkàn rẹ le ohun gbogbo ti emi o fi han ọ; nitori ka ba le fi wọn han ọ li a ṣe mu ọ wá ihinyi: sọ ohun gbogbo ti o ri fun ile Israeli.
entries.en: And the man said unto me, Son of man, behold with thine eyes, and hear with thine ears, and set thine heart upon all that I shall shew thee; for to the intent that I might shew them unto thee art thou brought hither: declare all that thou seest to the house of Israel.

entries.yo: Si kiye si i, ogiri kan mbẹ lode ile na yika, ije iwọ̀nlẹ kan si mbẹ lọwọ ọkunrin na, igbọnwọ mẹfa, nipa igbọnwọ ati ibú atẹlẹwọ kan: o si wọ̀n ibú ile na, ije kan; ati giga rẹ̀, ije kan.
entries.en: And behold a wall on the outside of the house round about, and in the man's hand a measuring reed of six cubits long by the cubit and an hand breadth: so he measured the breadth of the building, one reed; and the height, one reed.

entries.yo: Nigbana li o wá si ẹnu-ọ̀na ti o kọju si ọ̀na ila-õrun, o si gùn oke atẹ̀gun na lọ, o si wọ̀n iloro ẹnu ọ̀na, ti o jẹ ije kan ni ibú; ati iloro miran ti ẹnu-ọ̀na na, ti o jẹ ije kan ni ibú.
entries.en: Then came he unto the gate which looketh toward the east, and went up the stairs thereof, and measured the threshold of the gate, which was one reed broad; and the other threshold of the gate, which was one reed broad.

entries.yo: Yará kékèké si jẹ ije kan ni gigùn, ati ije kan ni ibú; ati lãrin yará kékèké igbọnwọ marun; àtẹwọ ẹnu-ọ̀na lẹba iloro ẹnu-ọ̀na ti inu si jẹ ije kan.
entries.en: And every little chamber was one reed long, and one reed broad; and between the little chambers were five cubits; and the threshold of the gate by the porch of the gate within was one reed.

entries.yo: O si wọ̀n iloro ẹnu-ọ̀na ti inu, ije kan.
entries.en: He measured also the porch of the gate within, one reed.

entries.yo: O si wọ̀n iloro ẹnu-ọ̀na, igbọnwọ mẹjọ; ati atẹrigba rẹ̀, igbọnwọ meji-meji; iloro ti ẹnu-ọ̀na na si mbẹ ninu.
entries.en: Then measured he the porch of the gate, eight cubits; and the posts thereof, two cubits; and the porch of the gate was inward.

entries.yo: Ati yará kékèké ẹnu-ọ̀na ti ọ̀na ila-õrun jẹ mẹta nihà ìhin, ati mẹta nihà ọhún; awọn mẹtẹta jẹ ìwọn kanna: awọn atẹrigba na jẹ ìwọn kanna niha ìhin ati niha ọhún.
entries.en: And the little chambers of the gate eastward were three on this side, and three on that side; they three were of one measure: and the posts had one measure on this side and on that side.

entries.yo: O si wọ̀n ibu abawọle ẹnu-ọ̀na na, igbọnwọ mẹwa; ati gigùn ẹnu-ọ̀na na, igbọnwọ mẹtala.
entries.en: And he measured the breadth of the entry of the gate, ten cubits; and the length of the gate, thirteen cubits.

entries.yo: Àye ti si mbẹ niwaju awọn yará kékèké na jẹ igbọnwọ kan nihà ìhin, àye na si jẹ igbọnwọ kan nihá ọhún; awọn yará kékèké na si jẹ igbọnwọ mẹfa nihà ìhin, ati igbọnwọ mẹfa niha ọhún.
entries.en: The space also before the little chambers was one cubit on this side, and the space was one cubit on that side: and the little chambers were six cubits on this side, and six cubits on that side.

entries.yo: O si wọ̀n ẹnu-ọ̀na na lati orule yará kékèké kan lọ de orule miran: ibú rẹ jẹ igbọnwọ mẹ̃dọgbọn, ilẹkùn dojukọ ilẹkùn.
entries.en: He measured then the gate from the roof of one little chamber to the roof of another: the breadth was five and twenty cubits, door against door.

entries.yo: O si ṣe atẹrigba ọlọgọta igbọnwọ, ani titi de atẹrigba àgbalá yi ẹnu-ọ̀na na ka.
entries.en: He made also posts of threescore cubits, even unto the post of the court round about the gate.

entries.yo: Lati iwaju ẹnu-ọ̀na àtẹwọ titi fi de iwaju iloro ẹnu-ọ̀na ti inu, adọta igbọnwọ.
entries.en: And from the face of the gate of the entrance unto the face of the porch of the inner gate were fifty cubits.

entries.yo: Awọn ferese tõro si mbẹ lara yará kékèké na, ati lara atẹrigba wọn ninu ẹnu-ọ̀na niha gbogbo ati pẹlu yará iloro: ferese pupọ si mbẹ niha inu gbogbo: igi ọpẹ si mbẹ lara olukuluku atẹrigbà.
entries.en: And there were narrow windows to the little chambers, and to their posts within the gate round about, and likewise to the arches: and windows were round about inward: and upon each post were palm trees.

entries.yo: O si mu mi wá si agbala ode, si kiyesi i, ọ̀pọlọpọ yará mbẹ nibẹ, a si fi okuta tẹ́ agbala na niha gbogbo: ọgbọ̀n yará ni mbẹ lori okuta itẹlẹ na.
entries.en: Then brought he me into the outward court, and, lo, there were chambers, and a pavement made for the court round about: thirty chambers were upon the pavement.

entries.yo: Ati okuta itẹlẹ ti iha ẹnu-ọ̀na na ti o kọju si gigun ẹnu-ọ̀na, ani okuta itẹlẹ isalẹ.
entries.en: And the pavement by the side of the gates over against the length of the gates was the lower pavement.

entries.yo: O si wọ̀n ibú rẹ̀ lati iwaju ẹnu-ọ̀na isalẹ titi fi de iwaju àgbala inu ti ode, ọgọrun igbọnwọ niha ila-õrun ati niha ariwa.
entries.en: Then he measured the breadth from the forefront of the lower gate unto the forefront of the inner court without, an hundred cubits eastward and northward.

entries.yo: Ẹnu-ọ̀na àgbala ode ti o kọju si ariwa, o wọ̀n gigun rẹ̀, ati ibu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the gate of the outward court that looked toward the north, he measured the length thereof, and the breadth thereof.

entries.yo: Awọn yará kékèké ibẹ̀ jẹ mẹta niha ìhin, mẹta nihà ọhun; awọn atẹrigba ibẹ ati iloro ibẹ jẹ gẹgẹ bi ìwọn ẹnu-ọ̀na ekini: gigùn rẹ̀ jẹ ãdọta igbọnwọ, ibú rẹ̀ si jẹ igbọnwọ mẹ̃dọgbọ̀n.
entries.en: And the little chambers thereof were three on this side and three on that side; and the posts thereof and the arches thereof were after the measure of the first gate: the length thereof was fifty cubits, and the breadth five and twenty cubits.

entries.yo: Ati fèrese wọn, ati iloro wọn, ati igi ọpẹ wọn jẹ gẹgẹ bi ìwọn ti ẹnu-ọ̀na ti o kọju si ọ̀na ila-õrun; nwọn si ba atẹgun meje gùn oke rẹ̀ lọ; awọn iloro na si mbẹ niwaju wọn.
entries.en: And their windows, and their arches, and their palm trees, were after the measure of the gate that looketh toward the east; and they went up unto it by seven steps; and the arches thereof were before them.

entries.yo: Ati ẹnu-ọ̀na agbala inu ti o kọju si ẹnu-ọ̀na ti ariwa, ati ti ila-õrun; o si wọ̀n lati ẹnu-ọ̀na de ẹnu-ọ̀na, ọgọrun igbọnwọ.
entries.en: And the gate of the inner court was over against the gate toward the north, and toward the east; and he measured from gate to gate an hundred cubits.

entries.yo: O si mu mi lọ si ọ̀na gusù, si kiye si i, ẹnu-ọ̀na kan mbẹ li ọ̀na gusù: o si wọ̀n awọn atẹrigba wọn, ati ìloro wọn gẹgẹ bi ìwọn wọnyi.
entries.en: After that he brought me toward the south, and behold a gate toward the south: and he measured the posts thereof and the arches thereof according to these measures.

entries.yo: Fèrese pupọ si mbẹ ninu rẹ̀ ati ninu iloro wọn yika, bi ferese wọnni: gigùn rẹ̀ jẹ ãdọta igbọnwọ, ibú rẹ̀ jẹ igbọnwọ mẹ̃dọgbọn.
entries.en: And there were windows in it and in the arches thereof round about, like those windows: the length was fifty cubits, and the breadth five and twenty cubits.

entries.yo: Atẹ̀gun meje ni mbẹ lati bá gùn oke rẹ̀, ati awọn iloro rẹ̀ si mbẹ niwaju wọn: o si ni igi ọpẹ, ọkan nihà ìhin, ati ọkan nihà ọhún, lara awọn atẹrigbà rẹ̀.
entries.en: And there were seven steps to go up to it, and the arches thereof were before them: and it had palm trees, one on this side, and another on that side, upon the posts thereof.

entries.yo: Ati ẹnu-ọ̀na agbalá ti inu mbẹ li ọ̀na gusu; o si wọ̀n lati ẹnu-ọ̀na de ẹnu-ọ̀na li ọ̀na gusu, ọgọrun igbọnwọ.
entries.en: And there was a gate in the inner court toward the south: and he measured from gate to gate toward the south an hundred cubits.

entries.yo: O si mu mi wá si agbalá ti inu nipa ẹnu-ọ̀na gusu: o si wọ̀n ẹnu-ọ̀na gusu na gẹgẹ bi ìwọn wọnyi;
entries.en: And he brought me to the inner court by the south gate: and he measured the south gate according to these measures;

entries.yo: Ati awọn yará kékèké rẹ̀, ati atẹrigbà rẹ̀, ati iloro rẹ̀, gẹgẹ bi ìwọn wọnyi: ferese pupọ̀ si mbẹ nibẹ ati ni iloro rẹ̀ yika: o jẹ ãdọta igbọnwọ ni gigùn, igbọnwọ mẹ̃dọgbọn ni ibú.
entries.en: And the little chambers thereof, and the posts thereof, and the arches thereof, according to these measures: and there were windows in it and in the arches thereof round about: it was fifty cubits long, and five and twenty cubits broad.

entries.yo: Awọn iloro ti mbẹ yika jẹ igbọnwọ mẹ̃dọgbọ̀n ni gigùn, ati igbọnwọ marun ni ibú.
entries.en: And the arches round about were five and twenty cubits long, and five cubits broad.

entries.yo: Awọn iloro rẹ̀ mbẹ nihà agbalá ode; igi ọpẹ si mbẹ lara atẹrigbà rẹ̀: abágòke rẹ̀ si ní atẹ̀gun mẹjọ.
entries.en: And the arches thereof were toward the utter court; and palm trees were upon the posts thereof: and the going up to it had eight steps.

entries.yo: O si mu mi wá si agbalá ti inu nihà ọ̀na ila-õrun: o si wọ̀n ẹnu-ọ̀na na, gẹgẹ bi iwọn wọnyi.
entries.en: And he brought me into the inner court toward the east: and he measured the gate according to these measures.

entries.yo: Ati yara kékèké rẹ̀, ati atẹrigbà rẹ̀, ati iloro rẹ̀, jẹ gẹgẹ bi ìwọn wọnyi: ferese si mbẹ ninu rẹ̀ ati ninu awọn iloro rẹ̀ yika: o jẹ ãdọta igbọnwọ ni gigùn, ati igbọnwọ mẹ̃dọgbọn ni ibú.
entries.en: And the little chambers thereof, and the posts thereof, and the arches thereof, were according to these measures: and there were windows therein and in the arches thereof round about: it was fifty cubits long, and five and twenty cubits broad.

entries.yo: Awọn iloro rẹ̀ mbẹ nihà agbalá ode; igi ọpẹ si mbẹ lara atẹrigbà rẹ̀, nihà ìhin, ati nihà ọ̀hun: abagòke rẹ̀ si ní atẹ̀gun mẹjọ.
entries.en: And the arches thereof were toward the outward court; and palm trees were upon the posts thereof, on this side, and on that side: and the going up to it had eight steps.

entries.yo: O si mu mi wá si ẹnu-ọ̀na ariwa, o si wọ̀n ọ gẹgẹ bi ìwọn wọnyi;
entries.en: And he brought me to the north gate, and measured it according to these measures;

entries.yo: Awọn yará kékèké rẹ̀, atẹrigbà rẹ̀, ati iloro rẹ̀, ati ferese rẹ̀ yika: gigùn rẹ̀ jẹ ãdọta igbọnwọ, ati ibu rẹ̀ igbọnwọ mẹ̃dọgbọ̀n.
entries.en: The little chambers thereof, the posts thereof, and the arches thereof, and the windows to it round about: the length was fifty cubits, and the breadth five and twenty cubits.

entries.yo: Ati atẹrigba rẹ̀ mbẹ niha agbalá ode; igi ọpẹ si mbẹ lara atẹrigba rẹ̀, niha ìhin, ati niha ọ̀hun: abagòke rẹ̀ si ní atẹ̀gun mẹjọ.
entries.en: And the posts thereof were toward the utter court; and palm trees were upon the posts thereof, on this side, and on that side: and the going up to it had eight steps.

entries.yo: Ati yàra ati abáwọle rẹ̀ wà nihà atẹrigbà ẹnu-ọ̀na na, nibiti nwọn ima wẹ̀ ọrẹ ẹbọ sisun.
entries.en: And the chambers and the entries thereof were by the posts of the gates, where they washed the burnt offering.

entries.yo: Ati ni iloro ẹnu-ọ̀na na tabili meji mbẹ nihà ìhin, ati tabili meji nihà ọ̀hun, lati ma pa ẹran ẹbọ sisun, ati ọrẹ ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ, ati ọrẹ ẹbọ irekọja lori wọn.
entries.en: And in the porch of the gate were two tables on this side, and two tables on that side, to slay thereon the burnt offering and the sin offering and the trespass offering.

entries.yo: Ati ni ihà ode, bi a ba nlọ si àbáwọle ẹnu-ọ̀na ariwa, ni tabili meji mbẹ; ati nihà miran, ti iṣe iloro ẹnu-ọ̀na, ni tabili meji mbẹ.
entries.en: And at the side without, as one goeth up to the entry of the north gate, were two tables; and on the other side, which was at the porch of the gate, were two tables.

entries.yo: Tabili mẹrin mbẹ nihà ìhin, tabili mẹrin si mbẹ nihà ọ̀hun, nihà ẹnu-ọ̀na; tabili mẹjọ, lori eyiti nwọn a ma pa ẹran ẹbọ wọn.
entries.en: Four tables were on this side, and four tables on that side, by the side of the gate; eight tables, whereupon they slew their sacrifices.

entries.yo: Tabili mẹrin na si jẹ ti okuta gbigbẹ́ fun ọrẹ ẹbọ sisun, igbọnwọ kan on ãbọ ni gigùn, ati igbọnwọ kan on ãbọ ni ibú, ati igbọnwọ kan ni giga: lori eyiti nwọn a si ma kó ohun-elò wọn le, ti nwọn ifi pa ọrẹ ẹbọ sisun ati ẹran ẹbọ.
entries.en: And the four tables were of hewn stone for the burnt offering, of a cubit and an half long, and a cubit and an half broad, and one cubit high: whereupon also they laid the instruments wherewith they slew the burnt offering and the sacrifice.

entries.yo: Ati ninu ni ìwọ ẹlẹnu meji, oníbu atẹlẹwọ kan, ti a kàn mọ ọ yika: ati lori awọn tabili na ni ẹran ọrẹ gbe wà.
entries.en: And within were hooks, an hand broad, fastened round about: and upon the tables was the flesh of the offering.

entries.yo: Ati lode ẹnu-ọ̀na ti inu ni yará awọn akọrin gbe wà, ninu agbala ti inu, ti mbẹ ni ihà ẹnu-ọ̀na ariwa; oju wọn si wà li ọ̀na gusu: ọkan ni iha ẹnu-ọ̀na ila-õrun, oju eyiti mbẹ li ọ̀na ariwa.
entries.en: And without the inner gate were the chambers of the singers in the inner court, which was at the side of the north gate; and their prospect was toward the south: one at the side of the east gate having the prospect toward the north.

entries.yo: O si wi fun mi pe, Yàrá yi, ti oju rẹ̀ mbẹ li ọ̀na gusu, ni fun awọn alufa, awọn olutọjú iṣọ ile na.
entries.en: And he said unto me, This chamber, whose prospect is toward the south, is for the priests, the keepers of the charge of the house.

entries.yo: Yará ti oju rẹ̀ mbẹ li ọ̀na ariwa, ni fun awọn alufa, awọn olutọjú iṣọ pẹpẹ na; awọn wọnyi li awọn ọmọ Sadoku ninu awọn ọmọ Lefi, ti nwọn ima sunmọ Oluwa lati ṣe iranṣẹ fun u.
entries.en: And the chamber whose prospect is toward the north is for the priests, the keepers of the charge of the altar: these are the sons of Zadok among the sons of Levi, which come near to the LORD to minister unto him.

entries.yo: O si wọ̀n agbalá na, ọgọrun igbọnwọ ni gigùn, ọgọrun igbọnwọ ni ibú, igun mẹrin lọgbọgba; ati pẹpẹ ti mbẹ niwaju ile na.
entries.en: So he measured the court, an hundred cubits long, and an hundred cubits broad, foursquare; and the altar that was before the house.

entries.yo: O si mu mi wá si iloro ile na, o si wọ̀n opo iloro na, igbọnwọ marun nihà ìhin, ati igbọnwọ marun nihà ọ̀hun: ibu ẹnu-ọ̀na na si jẹ igbọnwọ mẹta nihà ìhin, ati igbọnwọ mẹta nihà ọ̀hun.
entries.en: And he brought me to the porch of the house, and measured each post of the porch, five cubits on this side, and five cubits on that side: and the breadth of the gate was three cubits on this side, and three cubits on that side.

entries.yo: Gigùn iloro na jẹ ogún igbọnwọ, ibú rẹ̀ igbọnwọ mọkànla; o si mu mi wá si atẹ̀gun ti nwọn ifi ba gokè rẹ̀: ọwọ̀n pupọ̀ si mbẹ nihà ibi atẹrigbà, ọkan nihin, ati ọkan lọhun.
entries.en: The length of the porch was twenty cubits, and the breadth eleven cubits; and he brought me by the steps whereby they went up to it: and there were pillars by the posts, one on this side, and another on that side.

entries.yo: O si mu mi wá si tempili, o si wọ̀n awọn atẹrigbà, igbọnwọ mẹfa ni gbigborò li apakan, igbọnwọ mẹfa ni gbigborò li apakeji, ibú agọ na.
entries.en: Afterward he brought me to the temple, and measured the posts, six cubits broad on the one side, and six cubits broad on the other side, which was the breadth of the tabernacle.

entries.yo: Ati ibú ilẹkùn na jẹ igbọnwọ mẹwa; ihà ilẹkùn na si jẹ igbọnwọ marun li apakan, ati igbọnwọ marun li apakeji; o si wọ̀n gigùn rẹ̀, ogoji igbọnwọ; ati ibú rẹ̀, ogún igbọnwọ.
entries.en: And the breadth of the door was ten cubits; and the sides of the door were five cubits on the one side, and five cubits on the other side: and he measured the length thereof, forty cubits: and the breadth, twenty cubits.

entries.yo: O si wá si inu rẹ̀, o si wọ̀n atẹrigbà ilẹkùn na, igbọnwọ meji; ati ilẹkùn na, igbọnwọ mẹfa; ibú ilẹkùn na si jẹ igbọnwọ meje.
entries.en: Then went he inward, and measured the post of the door, two cubits; and the door, six cubits; and the breadth of the door, seven cubits.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ li o si wọ̀n gigùn rẹ̀, ogún igbọnwọ; ati ibú rẹ̀, ogún igbọnwọ, niwaju tempili: o si wi fun mi pe, Eyi ni ibi mimọ́ julọ.
entries.en: So he measured the length thereof, twenty cubits; and the breadth, twenty cubits, before the temple: and he said unto me, This is the most holy place.

entries.yo: O si wọ̀n ogiri ile na, igbọnwọ mẹfa; ati ibú yàrá-ihà gbogbo igbọnwọ mẹrin, yi ile na ka nihà gbogbo.
entries.en: After he measured the wall of the house, six cubits; and the breadth of every side chamber, four cubits, round about the house on every side.

entries.yo: Ati awọn yará-ihà, ọkan lori ekeji jẹ mẹta, nigba ọgbọ̀n: nwọn si wọ̀ inu ogiri ti ile awọn yará-ihà na yika, ki nwọn ba le di ara wọn mu, nitori kò si idimú ninu ogiri ile na.
entries.en: And the side chambers were three, one over another, and thirty in order; and they entered into the wall which was of the house for the side chambers round about, that they might have hold, but they had not hold in the wall of the house.

entries.yo: A si ṣe e gborò, o si lọ yika loke awọn yará ihà: nitori ogiri ile na lọ loke-loke yi ile na ka: nitorina ibú ile na wà loke, bẹ̃ni iyará isalẹ yọ si toke lãrin.
entries.en: And there was an enlarging, and a winding about still upward to the side chambers: for the winding about of the house went still upward round about the house: therefore the breadth of the house was still upward, and so increased from the lowest chamber to the highest by the midst.

entries.yo: Emi si ri giga ile na yika: ipilẹ awọn yará-ẹ̀gbẹ́ na si jẹ ije kikun kan ti igbọnwọ mẹfa ni gigun.
entries.en: I saw also the height of the house round about: the foundations of the side chambers were a full reed of six great cubits.

entries.yo: Ibú ogiri na, ti yará-ẹ̀gbẹ́ lode, jẹ igbọnwọ marun: ati eyi ti o kù ni ibi yará-ẹ̀gbẹ́ ti mbẹ ninu.
entries.en: The thickness of the wall, which was for the side chamber without, was five cubits: and that which was left was the place of the side chambers that were within.

entries.yo: Ati lãrin yará na, ogún igbọnwọ ni gbigborò, yi ile na ka ni ihà gbogbo.
entries.en: And between the chambers was the wideness of twenty cubits round about the house on every side.

entries.yo: Ati ilẹkùn awọn yará-ẹ̀gbẹ́ na mbẹ li ọ̀na ibi ti o kù, ilẹkùn kan li ọ̀na ariwa, ati ilẹkùn kan ni gusu: ati ibú ibẹ̀ na ti o kù, jẹ igbọnwọ marun yika.
entries.en: And the doors of the side chambers were toward the place that was left, one door toward the north, and another door toward the south: and the breadth of the place that was left was five cubits round about.

entries.yo: Ati ile ti o wà niwaju eyiti a yà sọtọ̀ ni igun ọ̀na iwọ-õrun, jẹ ãdọrin igbọnwọ ni gbigborò; ogiri ile na si jẹ igbọnwọ marun ni ibú yika, ati gigùn rẹ̀, ãdọrun igbọnwọ.
entries.en: Now the building that was before the separate place at the end toward the west was seventy cubits broad; and the wall of the building was five cubits thick round about, and the length thereof ninety cubits.

entries.yo: O si wọ̀n ile na, ọgọrun igbọnwọ ni gigùn; ati ibi ti a yà sọtọ̀, ati ile na, pẹlu ogiri wọn, ọgọrun igbọnwọ ni gigùn.
entries.en: So he measured the house, an hundred cubits long; and the separate place, and the building, with the walls thereof, an hundred cubits long;

entries.yo: Ati ibú oju ile na, ati ti ibi ti a yà sọtọ̀ nihà ila-õrun ọgọrun igbọnwọ.
entries.en: Also the breadth of the face of the house, and of the separate place toward the east, an hundred cubits.

entries.yo: O si wọ̀n gigun ile na ti o kọju si ibiti a yà sọtọ̀ ti mbẹ lẹhin rẹ̀, ati ibujoko-oke ni ihà kan ati nihà miran, ọgọrún igbọnwọ, pẹlu tempeli inu, ati iloro agbalá na;
entries.en: And he measured the length of the building over against the separate place which was behind it, and the galleries thereof on the one side and on the other side, an hundred cubits, with the inner temple, and the porches of the court;

entries.yo: Awọn iloro, ati ferese toro, ati ibujoko oke yika lori ile olorule mẹta wọn, ti o wà niwaju iloro na, li a fi igi tẹ́ yika, ati lati ilẹ de oke ferese, a si bò awọn ferese na;
entries.en: The door posts, and the narrow windows, and the galleries round about on their three stories, over against the door, cieled with wood round about, and from the ground up to the windows, and the windows were covered;

entries.yo: Si ti oke ilẹkun ani titi de ile ti inu, ati ti ode, ati lara ogiri niha gbogbo tinu tode ni wiwọ̀n.
entries.en: To that above the door, even unto the inner house, and without, and by all the wall round about within and without, by measure.

entries.yo: Kerubu ati igi ọpẹ li a si fi ṣe e, igi ọpẹ kan si mbẹ lãrin kerubu ati kerubu: kerubu kọkan si ni oju meji;
entries.en: And it was made with cherubims and palm trees, so that a palm tree was between a cherub and a cherub; and every cherub had two faces;

entries.yo: Oju enia kan si wà nihà ibi igi ọpe li apa kan, ati oju ẹgbọ̀rọ kiniun kan si wà nihà ibi igi ọpẹ li apa keji: a ṣe e yi ile na ka niha gbogbo.
entries.en: So that the face of a man was toward the palm tree on the one side, and the face of a young lion toward the palm tree on the other side: it was made through all the house round about.

entries.yo: Lati ilẹ titi fi de okè ilẹkùn, ni a ṣe kerubu ati igi ọpẹ si, ati lara ogiri tempili na.
entries.en: From the ground unto above the door were cherubims and palm trees made, and on the wall of the temple.

entries.yo: Awọn opó ilẹkùn tempili na jẹ igun mẹrin lọgbọgba: ati iwaju ibi mimọ́ irí ọkan bi irí ekeji.
entries.en: The posts of the temple were squared, and the face of the sanctuary; the appearance of the one as the appearance of the other.

entries.yo: Pẹpẹ igi na jẹ igbọnwọ mẹta ni giga, gigùn rẹ̀ igbọnwọ meji; ati igun rẹ̀, ati gigùn rẹ̀, ati awọn ogiri rẹ̀ jẹ ti igi: o si wi fun mi pe, Eyi ni tabili ti mbẹ niwaju Oluwa.
entries.en: The altar of wood was three cubits high, and the length thereof two cubits; and the corners thereof, and the length thereof, and the walls thereof, were of wood: and he said unto me, This is the table that is before the LORD.

entries.yo: Ati tempili na, ati ibi mimọ́ na, ni ilẹkùn meji.
entries.en: And the temple and the sanctuary had two doors.

entries.yo: Awọn ilẹkùn mejeji na ni awẹ, awẹ meji ti nyi; awẹ meji fun ilẹkùn kan, ati awẹ meji fun ilẹkùn keji.
entries.en: And the doors had two leaves apiece, two turning leaves; two leaves for the one door, and two leaves for the other door.

entries.yo: Kerubu, ati igi ọpẹ li a ṣe si ara wọn, sara ilẹkùn tempili, gẹgẹ bi eyiti a ṣe sara ogiri; igi ibori wà loju iloro lode.
entries.en: And there were made on them, on the doors of the temple, cherubims and palm trees, like as were made upon the walls; and there were thick planks upon the face of the porch without.

entries.yo: Ferese toro ati igi ọpẹ mbẹ nihà ihin ati nihà ọhun nihà iloro, ati ni yará-iha ile na, ati ni igi ibori.
entries.en: And there were narrow windows and palm trees on the one side and on the other side, on the sides of the porch, and upon the side chambers of the house, and thick planks.

entries.yo: O si mu mi wá si agbala ode, li ọ̀na apa ariwa: o si mu mi wá si yará ti o kọju si ibi ti a yà sọtọ̀, ti o si kọju si ile lọna ariwa.
entries.en: Then he brought me forth into the utter court, the way toward the north: and he brought me into the chamber that was over against the separate place, and which was before the building toward the north.

entries.yo: Niwaju, ọgọrun igbọnwọ ni gigùn ni ilẹkun ariwa, ati ibú rẹ̀ ãdọta igbọnwọ.
entries.en: Before the length of an hundred cubits was the north door, and the breadth was fifty cubits.

entries.yo: Niwaju, ogún igbọnwọ ti o wà fun agbalá ti inu, ati niwaju itẹle ti o wà fun agbalá ti ode; ibujoko oke ti o kọju si ibujoko-oke wà ni orule mẹta.
entries.en: Over against the twenty cubits which were for the inner court, and over against the pavement which was for the utter court, was gallery against gallery in three stories.

entries.yo: Ati niwaju awọn yará ni irìn igbọnwọ mẹwa ni ibú ninu, ọ̀na igbọnwọ kan; ilẹkùn wọn si wà nihà ariwa.
entries.en: And before the chambers was a walk of ten cubits breadth inward, a way of one cubit; and their doors toward the north.

entries.yo: Ati awọn yará oke kuru jù; nitori ibujoko ti awọn yará isalẹ ati yará ãrin yọ siwaju wọnyi ti ile.
entries.en: Now the upper chambers were shorter: for the galleries were higher than these, than the lower, and than the middlemost of the building.

entries.yo: Nitori nwọn jẹ olorule mẹta, ṣugbọn nwọn kò ni ọwọ̀n bi ọwọ̀n agbalá: nitorina a fasẹhin kuro ninu yará isalẹ ati kuro ninu yará ãrin lati ilẹ wá.
entries.en: For they were in three stories, but had not pillars as the pillars of the courts: therefore the building was straitened more than the lowest and the middlemost from the ground.

entries.yo: Ati ogiri ti o wà lode ti o kọju si yará, li apa agbala ode niwaju yará, gigùn rẹ̀ jẹ ãdọta igbọnwọ.
entries.en: And the wall that was without over against the chambers, toward the utter court on the forepart of the chambers, the length thereof was fifty cubits.

entries.yo: Nitori gigùn awọn yará ti o wà lode jẹ ãdọta igbọnwọ: si wò o, niwaju tempili o jẹ ọgọrun igbọnwọ.
entries.en: For the length of the chambers that were in the utter court was fifty cubits: and, lo, before the temple were an hundred cubits.

entries.yo: Ati lati isalẹ yará wọnyi ni iwọle li ọ̀na ila-õrun wà, bi a ti nlọ sinu wọn lati agbala ode wá.
entries.en: And from under these chambers was the entry on the east side, as one goeth into them from the utter court.

entries.yo: Ni ibú ogiri agbala, li ọ̀na ila-õrun niwaju ibiti a yà sọtọ̀, ati niwaju ile na, ni awọn yará na wà.
entries.en: The chambers were in the thickness of the wall of the court toward the east, over against the separate place, and over against the building.

entries.yo: Ati ọ̀na iwaju wọn ti gẹgẹ bi iri awọn yará ti o wà li ọ̀na ariwa, bi nwọn ti gùn mọ, bẹ̃ ni nwọn gbòro mọ: ati gbogbo ijade wọn si dabi iṣe wọn, ati bi ilẹkùn wọn.
entries.en: And the way before them was like the appearance of the chambers which were toward the north, as long as they, and as broad as they: and all their goings out were both according to their fashions, and according to their doors.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ gẹgẹ ni yará ti on ti ilẹkùn wọn li ọ̀na gusu, ilẹkùn kan wà lori ọ̀na, li ọ̀na gbọran niwaju ogiri li ọ̀na ila-õrun bi a ti nwọ̀ inu wọn.
entries.en: And according to the doors of the chambers that were toward the south was a door in the head of the way, even the way directly before the wall toward the east, as one entereth into them.

entries.yo: O si wi fun mi pe, Awọn yará ariwa ati awọn yará gusu, ti o wà niwaju ibiti a yà sọtọ̀, awọn ni yará mimọ́, nibiti awọn alufa ti nsunmọ Oluwa yio ma jẹ ohun mimọ́ julọ: nibẹ̀ ni nwọn o ma gbe ohun mimọ́ julọ kà, ati ọrẹ ẹbọ jijẹ, ati ọrẹ ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ, ati ọrẹ ẹbọ irekọja; nitori ibẹ̀ jẹ mimọ́.
entries.en: Then said he unto me, The north chambers and the south chambers, which are before the separate place, they be holy chambers, where the priests that approach unto the LORD shall eat the most holy things: there shall they lay the most holy things, and the meat offering, and the sin offering, and the trespass offering; for the place is holy.

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn alufa ba wọ̀ ibẹ̀, nwọn kì yio si kuro ni ibi mimọ́ si agbala ode, ṣugbọn nibẹ nibiti nwọn gbe nṣiṣẹ ni nwọn o fi ẹwù wọn si; nitori nwọn jẹ mimọ́; nwọn o si wọ̀ ẹwù miran, nwọn o si sunmọ nkan wọnni ti o jẹ́ ti enia.
entries.en: When the priests enter therein, then shall they not go out of the holy place into the utter court, but there they shall lay their garments wherein they minister; for they are holy; and shall put on other garments, and shall approach to those things which are for the people.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si ti wọ̀n ile ti inu tan, o mu mi wá sihà ilẹkùn ti o kọju si ọ̀na ila-õrun, o si wọ̀n yika.
entries.en: Now when he had made an end of measuring the inner house, he brought me forth toward the gate whose prospect is toward the east, and measured it round about.

entries.yo: O fi ije iwọ̀nlẹ wọ̀n ti apa ila-õrun, ẹ̃dẹgbẹta ije, nipa ije iwọ̀nlẹ yika.
entries.en: He measured the east side with the measuring reed, five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed round about.

entries.yo: O si fi ije iwọ̀nlẹ wọ̀n ti apa ariwa, ẹ̃dẹgbẹta ije yika.
entries.en: He measured the north side, five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed round about.

entries.yo: O si fi ije iwọ̀nlẹ wọ̀n ti apa gusu, ẹ̃dẹgbẹta ije.
entries.en: He measured the south side, five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed.

entries.yo: O yipadà si ọ̀na iwọ-õrun, o si fi ije iwọ̀nlẹ wọ̀n ọ, ẹ̃dẹgbẹta ije.
entries.en: He turned about to the west side, and measured five hundred reeds with the measuring reed.

entries.yo: O wọ̀n ọ nihà mẹrẹrin: o ni ogiri kan yi i ka, ẹ̃dẹgbẹta ije ni gigùn, ati ẹ̃dẹgbẹta ni ibú, lati pàla lãrin ibi mimọ́ ati ibi aimọ́.
entries.en: He measured it by the four sides: it had a wall round about, five hundred reeds long, and five hundred broad, to make a separation between the sanctuary and the profane place.

entries.yo: O si mu mi wá si ẹnu-ọ̀na, ẹnu-ọ̀na ti o kọjusi ọ̀na ila-õrun:
entries.en: Afterward he brought me to the gate, even the gate that looketh toward the east:

entries.yo: Si kiyesi i, ogo Ọlọrun Israeli wá lati ọ̀na ila-õrun: ati ohùn rẹ̀ ri bi ariwo omi pupọ̀: aiye si ràn fun ogo rẹ̀.
entries.en: And, behold, the glory of the God of Israel came from the way of the east: and his voice was like a noise of many waters: and the earth shined with his glory.

entries.yo: O si dabi irí iran ti mo ri, gẹgẹ bi iran ti mo ri nigbati mo wá lati pa ilu na run: iran na si dabi iran ti mo ri lẹba odò Kebari, mo si doju mi bolẹ.
entries.en: And it was according to the appearance of the vision which I saw, even according to the vision that I saw when I came to destroy the city: and the visions were like the vision that I saw by the river Chebar; and I fell upon my face.

entries.yo: Ogo Oluwa si wá si ile na lati ọ̀na ilẹkùn ti o kọjusi ọ̀na ila-õrun.
entries.en: And the glory of the LORD came into the house by the way of the gate whose prospect is toward the east.

entries.yo: Ẹmi si gbe mi soke, o si mu mi wá si àgbala tinu: si kiye si i, ogo Oluwa kún ile na.
entries.en: So the spirit took me up, and brought me into the inner court; and, behold, the glory of the LORD filled the house.

entries.yo: Mo si gbọ́ o mba mi sọ̀rọ lati inu ile wá; ọkunrin na si duro tì mi.
entries.en: And I heard him speaking unto me out of the house; and the man stood by me.

entries.yo: O si wi fun mi pe, Ọmọ enia, ibi itẹ mi, ati ibi atẹlẹṣẹ mi, nibiti emi o gbe lãrin awọn ọmọ Israeli lailai, ati orukọ mimọ́ mi, ni ki ile Israeli má bajẹ mọ, awọn, tabi ọba wọn, nipa panṣaga wọn, tabi nipa okú ọba wọn ni ibi giga wọn.
entries.en: And he said unto me, Son of man, the place of my throne, and the place of the soles of my feet, where I will dwell in the midst of the children of Israel for ever, and my holy name, shall the house of Israel no more defile, neither they, nor their kings, by their whoredom, nor by the carcases of their kings in their high places.

entries.yo: Ni titẹ́ iloro wọn nibi iloro mi, ati opó wọn nibi opó mi, ogiri si wà lãrin emi ati awọn, nwọn si ti ba orukọ mimọ́ mi jẹ nipa ohun irira wọn ti nwọn ti ṣe: mo si run wọn ni ibinu mi.
entries.en: In their setting of their threshold by my thresholds, and their post by my posts, and the wall between me and them, they have even defiled my holy name by their abominations that they have committed: wherefore I have consumed them in mine anger.

entries.yo: Njẹ ki nwọn mu panṣaga wọn, ati okú awọn ọba wọn jina kuro lọdọ mi, emi o si ma gbe ãrin wọn lailai.
entries.en: Now let them put away their whoredom, and the carcases of their kings, far from me, and I will dwell in the midst of them for ever.

entries.yo: Iwọ ọmọ enia, fi ile na hàn ile Israeli, ki oju aiṣedede wọn ba le tì wọn: si jẹ ki nwọn wọ̀n apẹrẹ na.
entries.en: Thou son of man, shew the house to the house of Israel, that they may be ashamed of their iniquities: and let them measure the pattern.

entries.yo: Bi oju gbogbo ohun ti nwọn ba ṣe ba si tì wọn, fi irí ile na hàn wọn, ati kikọ́ rẹ̀, ati ijade rẹ̀, ati iwọle rẹ̀, ati gbogbo irí rẹ̀, ati gbogbo aṣẹ rẹ̀, ati gbogbo irí rẹ̀, ati gbogbo ofin rẹ̀; ki o si kọ ọ loju wọn, ki nwọn ki o lè pa gbogbo irí rẹ̀ mọ, ati gbogbo aṣẹ rẹ̀, ki nwọn si ṣe wọn.
entries.en: And if they be ashamed of all that they have done, shew them the form of the house, and the fashion thereof, and the goings out thereof, and the comings in thereof, and all the forms thereof, and all the ordinances thereof, and all the forms thereof, and all the laws thereof: and write it in their sight, that they may keep the whole form thereof, and all the ordinances thereof, and do them.

entries.yo: Eyi ni ofin ile na; Lori oke giga, gbogbo ipinnu rẹ̀ yika ni mimọ́ julọ. Kiyesi i, eyi ni ofin ile na.
entries.en: This is the law of the house; Upon the top of the mountain the whole limit thereof round about shall be most holy. Behold, this is the law of the house.

entries.yo: Wọnyi si ni iwọ̀n pẹpẹ nipa igbọnwọ; Igbọnwọ jẹ igbọnwọ kan ati ibú atẹlẹwọ kan; isalẹ rẹ̀ yio jẹ igbọnwọ kan, ati ibu rẹ̀ igbọnwọ kan, ati igbati rẹ̀ ni eti rẹ̀ yika yio jẹ ika kan: eyi ni yio si jẹ ibi giga pẹpẹ na.
entries.en: And these are the measures of the altar after the cubits: The cubit is a cubit and an hand breadth; even the bottom shall be a cubit, and the breadth a cubit, and the border thereof by the edge thereof round about shall be a span: and this shall be the higher place of the altar.

entries.yo: Lati isalẹ ilẹ titi de ijoko isalẹ yio jẹ igbọnwọ meji, ati ibú rẹ̀ igbọnwọ́ kan; ati lati ijoko kekere titi de ijoko nla yio jẹ igbọnwọ mẹrin, ati ibú rẹ̀ igbọnwọ kan.
entries.en: And from the bottom upon the ground even to the lower settle shall be two cubits, and the breadth one cubit; and from the lesser settle even to the greater settle shall be four cubits, and the breadth one cubit.

entries.yo: Pẹpẹ na si jẹ igbọnwọ mẹrin: ati lati pẹpẹ titi de oke jẹ iwo mẹrin.
entries.en: So the altar shall be four cubits; and from the altar and upward shall be four horns.

entries.yo: Pẹpẹ na yio si jẹ igbọnwọ mejila ni gigùn, ati mejila ni ibú onigun mẹrin ni igun mẹrẹrin rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the altar shall be twelve cubits long, twelve broad, square in the four squares thereof.

entries.yo: Ati ijoko ni yio jẹ igbọ̀nwọ mẹrinla ni gigun ati mẹrinla ni ibú ninu igun mẹrẹrin rẹ̀; ati eti rẹ̀ yika yio jẹ́ abọ̀ igbọnwọ; ati isalẹ rẹ̀ yio jẹ igbọnwọ kan yika; atẹgùn rẹ̀ yio si kọjusi iha ila-õrun.
entries.en: And the settle shall be fourteen cubits long and fourteen broad in the four squares thereof; and the border about it shall be half a cubit; and the bottom thereof shall be a cubit about; and his stairs shall look toward the east.

entries.yo: O si wi fun mi pe, Ọmọ enia, bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Eyi ni aṣẹ pẹpẹ na li ọjọ ti nwọn o ṣe e, lati rú ọrẹ ẹbọ sisun lori rẹ̀, ati lati wọ́n ẹ̀jẹ sori rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he said unto me, Son of man, thus saith the Lord GOD; These are the ordinances of the altar in the day when they shall make it, to offer burnt offerings thereon, and to sprinkle blood thereon.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si fi ẹgbọrọ malu, fun ọrẹ ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ, fun awọn alufa, awọn Lefi, ti iṣe iru-ọmọ Sadoku, ti nsunmọ mi, lati ṣe iranṣẹ fun mi, ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi.
entries.en: And thou shalt give to the priests the Levites that be of the seed of Zadok, which approach unto me, to minister unto me, saith the Lord GOD, a young bullock for a sin offering.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si mu ninu ẹjẹ rẹ̀, iwọ o si fi si iwo mẹrẹrin rẹ̀, ati si igun mẹrẹrin ijoko na, ati si eti rẹ̀ yika: iwọ o si wẹ̀ ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ̀ mọ́, iwọ o si ṣe etùtu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And thou shalt take of the blood thereof, and put it on the four horns of it, and on the four corners of the settle, and upon the border round about: thus shalt thou cleanse and purge it.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si mu ẹgbọrọ malu ti ọrẹ ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ, on o si sun u ni ibiti a yàn ni ile na lode ibi-mimọ́.
entries.en: Thou shalt take the bullock also of the sin offering, and he shall burn it in the appointed place of the house, without the sanctuary.

entries.yo: Ati ni ọjọ keji iwọ o fi ọmọ ewurẹ alailabawọn rubọ ọrẹ ẹ̀ṣẹ; nwọn o si sọ pẹpẹ na di mimọ́, bi nwọn iti ifi ẹgbọrọ malu sọ ọ di mimọ́.
entries.en: And on the second day thou shalt offer a kid of the goats without blemish for a sin offering; and they shall cleanse the altar, as they did cleanse it with the bullock.

entries.yo: Nigbati iwọ ba ti sọ ọ di mimọ tan, iwọ o fi ẹgbọrọ malu alailabawọn rubọ, ati àgbo alailabawọn lati inu agbo wá.
entries.en: When thou hast made an end of cleansing it, thou shalt offer a young bullock without blemish, and a ram out of the flock without blemish.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si fi wọn rubọ niwaju Oluwa, awọn alufa yio si dà iyọ̀ si wọn, nwọn o si fi wọn rú ọrẹ ẹbọ sisun si Oluwa.
entries.en: And thou shalt offer them before the LORD, and the priests shall cast salt upon them, and they shall offer them up for a burnt offering unto the LORD.

entries.yo: Ọjọ meje ni iwọ o fi pèse obukọ fun ọrẹ ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ lojojumọ: nwọn o si pèse ẹgbọrọ malu pẹlu ati àgbo lati inu agbo wá, ti nwọn ṣe ailabawọn.
entries.en: Seven days shalt thou prepare every day a goat for a sin offering: they shall also prepare a young bullock, and a ram out of the flock, without blemish.

entries.yo: Ọjọ meje ni nwọn o fi wẹ̀ pẹpẹ, nwọn o si sọ ọ di mimọ́: nwọn o si yà ara wọn sọtọ̀.
entries.en: Seven days shall they purge the altar and purify it; and they shall consecrate themselves.

entries.yo: Nigbati ọjọ wọnyi ba pe, yio si ṣe, ni ọjọ kẹjọ, ati siwaju, awọn alufa yio ṣe ọrẹ ẹbọ sisun nyin lori pẹpẹ, ati ọrẹ ẹbọ idupẹ: emi o si gbà nyin, ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi.
entries.en: And when these days are expired, it shall be, that upon the eighth day, and so forward, the priests shall make your burnt offerings upon the altar, and your peace offerings; and I will accept you, saith the Lord GOD.

entries.yo: O si mu mi pada lọna ẹnu-ọ̀na ibi mimọ́ ti ode ti o kọju si ila-õrun; o si tì.
entries.en: Then he brought me back the way of the gate of the outward sanctuary which looketh toward the east; and it was shut.

entries.yo: Oluwa si wi fun mi pe; Ẹnu-ọ̀na yi yio wà ni titì, a kì yio ṣi i, ẹnikan kì yio si gbà a wọ inu rẹ̀; nitori Oluwa, Ọlọrun Israeli, ti gbà a wọ inu rẹ̀, yio si wà ni titì.
entries.en: Then said the LORD unto me; This gate shall be shut, it shall not be opened, and no man shall enter in by it; because the LORD, the God of Israel, hath entered in by it, therefore it shall be shut.

entries.yo: Fun ọmọ-alade ni; ọmọ-alade, on ni yio joko ninu rẹ̀ lati jẹ akara niwaju Oluwa; yio wọ̀ ọ lati ọ̀na iloro ẹnu-ọ̀na na, yio si jade lati ọ̀na rẹ̀ na lọ.
entries.en: It is for the prince; the prince, he shall sit in it to eat bread before the LORD; he shall enter by the way of the porch of that gate, and shall go out by the way of the same.

entries.yo: O si mu mi wá ọ̀na ẹnu-ọ̀na ariwa siwaju ile na; mo si wò, si kiyesi i, ogo Oluwa kun ile Oluwa: mo si doju mi bolẹ.
entries.en: Then brought he me the way of the north gate before the house: and I looked, and, behold, the glory of the LORD filled the house of the LORD: and I fell upon my face.

entries.yo: Oluwa si wi fun mi pe, Ọmọ enia, fi iyè rẹ si i, si fi oju rẹ wò, si fi eti rẹ gbọ́ ohun gbogbo ti emi ti sọ fun ọ niti gbogbo aṣẹ ile Oluwa, ati ti gbogbo ofin rẹ̀; si fi iyè rẹ si iwọ̀nu ile nì, pẹlu gbogbo ijadelọ ibi-mimọ́ na.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto me, Son of man, mark well, and behold with thine eyes, and hear with thine ears all that I say unto thee concerning all the ordinances of the house of the LORD, and all the laws thereof; and mark well the entering in of the house, with every going forth of the sanctuary.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si wi fun awọn ọlọ̀tẹ, ani fun ile Israeli, pe, Bayi ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; ki gbogbo ohun-irira nyin to fun nyin, ile Israeli,
entries.en: And thou shalt say to the rebellious, even to the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord GOD; O ye house of Israel, let it suffice you of all your abominations,

entries.yo: Niti pe ẹ mu ọmọ-ajèji, alaikọla aiya, ati alaikọla ara wa, lati wà ni ibi-mimọ́ mi, lati sọ ọ di alailọ̀wọ, ani ile mi, nigbati ẹ rú akara mi, ọ̀ra ati ẹjẹ, nwọn si bà majẹmu mi jẹ nipa gbogbo ohun-irira nyin.
entries.en: In that ye have brought into my sanctuary strangers, uncircumcised in heart, and uncircumcised in flesh, to be in my sanctuary, to pollute it, even my house, when ye offer my bread, the fat and the blood, and they have broken my covenant because of all your abominations.

entries.yo: Ẹ kò si pa ibi-iṣọ́ ohun-mimọ́ mi mọ́: ṣugbọn ẹ ti yàn oluṣọ́ ibi-iṣọ́ inu ibi-mimọ́ mi fun ara nyin.
entries.en: And ye have not kept the charge of mine holy things: but ye have set keepers of my charge in my sanctuary for yourselves.

entries.yo: Bayi ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi: Gbogbo ọmọ àjeji, alaikọla aiya, tabi alaikọla ara kì yio wọ̀ inu ibi mimọ́ mi, ninu gbogbo ọmọ àjeji ti o wà lãrin awọn ọmọ Israeli.
entries.en: Thus saith the Lord GOD; No stranger, uncircumcised in heart, nor uncircumcised in flesh, shall enter into my sanctuary, of any stranger that is among the children of Israel.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn Lefi ti o ti lọ jina kuro lọdọ mi, ni ìṣina Israeli, ti nwọn ṣìna kuro lọdọ mi lẹhin oriṣa wọn: yio si rù aiṣedede wọn.
entries.en: And the Levites that are gone away far from me, when Israel went astray, which went astray away from me after their idols; they shall even bear their iniquity.

entries.yo: Nwọn o si jẹ iranṣẹ ni ibi mimọ́ mi, oluṣọ́ ẹnu-ọ̀na ile, nwọn o si ma ṣe iranṣẹ ni ile: awọn ni yio pa ọrẹ-ẹbọ sisun ati ẹbọ fun awọn enia, nwọn o si duro niwaju wọn lati ṣe iranṣẹ fun wọn.
entries.en: Yet they shall be ministers in my sanctuary, having charge at the gates of the house, and ministering to the house: they shall slay the burnt offering and the sacrifice for the people, and they shall stand before them to minister unto them.

entries.yo: Nitori ti nwọn ṣe iranṣẹ fun wọn niwaju òriṣa wọn, nwọn si jẹ ohun ìdugbolu aiṣedede fun ile Israeli: nitorina ni mo gbe ọwọ́ mi soke si wọn, ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi, nwọn o si rù aiṣedede wọn.
entries.en: Because they ministered unto them before their idols, and caused the house of Israel to fall into iniquity; therefore have I lifted up mine hand against them, saith the Lord GOD, and they shall bear their iniquity.

entries.yo: Nwọn kì yio si sunmọ ọdọ mi, lati ṣiṣẹ alufa fun mi, tabi lati sunmọ gbogbo ohun-mimọ́ mi, ni ibi mimọ́ julọ: nwọn o si rù itijú wọn, ati ohun-irira wọn ti nwọn ti ṣe.
entries.en: And they shall not come near unto me, to do the office of a priest unto me, nor to come near to any of my holy things, in the most holy place: but they shall bear their shame, and their abominations which they have committed.

entries.yo: Emi o si ṣe wọn ni oluṣọ́ ibi-iṣọ́ ile, fun gbogbo iṣẹ rẹ̀, ati fun ohun gbogbo ti a o ṣe ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: But I will make them keepers of the charge of the house, for all the service thereof, and for all that shall be done therein.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn alufa awọn Lefi, awọn ọmọ Sadoku, ti o pa ibi-iṣọ ibi mimọ́ mi mọ, nigbati awọn ọmọ Israeli ṣìna kuro lọdọ mi, awọn ni yio sunmọ ọdọ mi lati ṣe iranṣẹ fun mi, nwọn o si duro niwaju mi lati rú ọrá ati ẹjẹ si mi, ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi:
entries.en: But the priests the Levites, the sons of Zadok, that kept the charge of my sanctuary when the children of Israel went astray from me, they shall come near to me to minister unto me, and they shall stand before me to offer unto me the fat and the blood, saith the Lord GOD:

entries.yo: Awọn ni yio wá si ibi-mimọ́ mi, awọn ni o si sunmọ tabili mi, lati ṣe iranṣẹ fun mi, nwọn o si pa ibi-iṣọ́ mi mọ́.
entries.en: They shall enter into my sanctuary, and they shall come near to my table, to minister unto me, and they shall keep my charge.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe pe, nigbati nwọn ba wá si ẹnu-ọ̀na agbalá ti inu, nwọn o wọ̀ ẹ̀wu ọ̀gbọ; irun agutan kì yio bọ́ si ara wọn, nigbati nwọn ba nṣe iranṣẹ ni ẹnu-ọ̀na agbalá ti inu, ati ninu ile.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass, that when they enter in at the gates of the inner court, they shall be clothed with linen garments; and no wool shall come upon them, whiles they minister in the gates of the inner court, and within.

entries.yo: Nwọn o si ni filà ọ̀gbọ li ori wọn, ṣòkoto ọ̀gbọ ni nwọn o si wọ̀ ni idí wọn; nwọn kì o si fi ohun ti imuni lãgùn dì amurè.
entries.en: They shall have linen bonnets upon their heads, and shall have linen breeches upon their loins; they shall not gird themselves with any thing that causeth sweat.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn ba si lọ si agbalá ode, ani si agbalá ode sọdọ awọn enia, nwọn o bọ́ ẹ̀wu wọn ti wọn ifi ṣe iranṣẹ, nwọn o si fi wọn si awọn yará mimọ́, nwọn o si wọ̀ ẹ̀wu miran; nwọn kì yio si fi ẹ̀wu wọn sọ awọn enia di mimọ́.
entries.en: And when they go forth into the utter court, even into the utter court to the people, they shall put off their garments wherein they ministered, and lay them in the holy chambers, and they shall put on other garments; and they shall not sanctify the people with their garments.

entries.yo: Nwọn kì o si fá ori wọn, bẹ̃ni nwọn kì yio jẹ ki irun wọn gbọ̀; ni rirẹ nwọn o rẹ irun ori wọn.
entries.en: Neither shall they shave their heads, nor suffer their locks to grow long; they shall only poll their heads.

entries.yo: Alufa gbogbo kì yio mu ọti-waini, nigbati nwọn ba wá si agbalá ti inu.
entries.en: Neither shall any priest drink wine, when they enter into the inner court.

entries.yo: Nwọn kì yio si fẹ́ opo, tabi ẹniti a tì jade fun aya wọn: ṣugbọn nwọn o fẹ́ wundia lati iru-ọmọ ile Israeli, tabi opo ti o ti ni alufa ri.
entries.en: Neither shall they take for their wives a widow, nor her that is put away: but they shall take maidens of the seed of the house of Israel, or a widow that had a priest before.

entries.yo: Nwọn o si kọ́ awọn enia mi ni iyàtọ ti o wà lãrin mimọ́ ati ailọ̀wọ, nwọn o si mu wọn mọ̀ eyiti o wà lãrin aimọ́ ati mimọ́.
entries.en: And they shall teach my people the difference between the holy and profane, and cause them to discern between the unclean and the clean.

entries.yo: Ati ni ija, awọn ni yio duro lati ṣe idajọ; nwọn o si dá a ni idajọ mi: nwọn o si pa ofin mi ati aṣẹ mi mọ́ ni gbogbo apejọ mi; nwọn o si yà awọn ọjọ isimi mi si mimọ́.
entries.en: And in controversy they shall stand in judgment; and they shall judge it according to my judgments: and they shall keep my laws and my statutes in all mine assemblies; and they shall hallow my sabbaths.

entries.yo: Nwọn kì yio si wá sọdọ okú enia lati sọ ara wọn di aimọ́, ṣugbọn fun baba, tabi fun iya, tabi fun ọmọkunrin, tabi fun ọmọbinrin, fun arakunrin, tabi fun arabinrin ti kò ti ni ọkọ, nwọn le sọ ara wọn di aimọ́.
entries.en: And they shall come at no dead person to defile themselves: but for father, or for mother, or for son, or for daughter, for brother, or for sister that hath had no husband, they may defile themselves.

entries.yo: Ati lẹhin iwẹnumọ́ rẹ̀, nwọn o si ká ọjọ meje fun u.
entries.en: And after he is cleansed, they shall reckon unto him seven days.

entries.yo: Ati li ọjọ ti yio lọ si ibi-mimọ́, si agbalá ti inu, lati ṣe iranṣẹ ni ibi-mimọ́, on o rú ọrẹ ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ̀, ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi.
entries.en: And in the day that he goeth into the sanctuary, unto the inner court, to minister in the sanctuary, he shall offer his sin offering, saith the Lord GOD.

entries.yo: Ati ogún ni yio jẹ fun wọn: emi ni ogún wọn: ẹ kì yio si fun wọn ni ini ni Israeli: emi ni ini wọn.
entries.en: And it shall be unto them for an inheritance: I am their inheritance: and ye shall give them no possession in Israel: I am their possession.

entries.yo: Awọn ni yio jẹ ọrẹ ẹbọ jijẹ, ati ọrẹ ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ, ati ọrẹ ẹbọ irekọja; ati gbogbo ohun-egún ni Israeli, yio jẹ́ ti wọn.
entries.en: They shall eat the meat offering, and the sin offering, and the trespass offering; and every dedicated thing in Israel shall be theirs.

entries.yo: Ati ikini ninu gbogbo akọ́so nkan gbogbo, olukuluku ọrẹ gbogbo, ninu gbogbo ọrẹ nyin, yio jẹ ti awọn alufa: ẹ o si fi akọ́po iyẹfun nyin fun alufa, ki ibukun le bà le ile rẹ.
entries.en: And the first of all the firstfruits of all things, and every oblation of all, of every sort of your oblations, shall be the priest's: ye shall also give unto the priest the first of your dough, that he may cause the blessing to rest in thine house.

entries.yo: Gbogbo okú nkan, ati ohun ti a fà ya ninu ẹiyẹ tabi ninu ẹranko, ni awọn alufa kì yio jẹ.
entries.en: The priests shall not eat of any thing that is dead of itself, or torn, whether it be fowl or beast.

entries.yo: PẸLUPẸLU nigbati ẹnyin ba fi ibo pín ilẹ li ogún, ẹ o gbé ọrẹ wá fun Oluwa, eyiti o mọ́ lati ilẹ na wá: gigùn na yio jẹ ẹgbã le ẹgbẹrun ije ni gigùn, ati ẹgbãrun ni ibú. Eyi yio jẹ́ mimọ́ ni gbogbo àgbegbe rẹ̀ yika.
entries.en: Moreover, when ye shall divide by lot the land for inheritance, ye shall offer an oblation unto the LORD, an holy portion of the land: the length shall be the length of five and twenty thousand reeds, and the breadth shall be ten thousand. This shall be holy in all the borders thereof round about.

entries.yo: Lati inu eyi, ẹ̃dẹgbẹta yio jẹ ti ibi-mimọ́ ni gigùn, pẹlu ẹ̃dẹgbẹta ni ibú, ni igun mẹrẹrin yika; ati adọta igbọnwọ fun igbangba rẹ̀ yika.
entries.en: Of this there shall be for the sanctuary five hundred in length, with five hundred in breadth, square round about; and fifty cubits round about for the suburbs thereof.

entries.yo: Ati ninu ìwọn yi ni iwọ o wọ̀n ẹgbã mejila le ẹgbẹrun ni gigùn, ati ẹgbarun ni ibú; ati ninu rẹ̀ ni ibi-mimọ́ yio wà, ibi-mimọ́ julọ.
entries.en: And of this measure shalt thou measure the length of five and twenty thousand, and the breadth of ten thousand: and in it shall be the sanctuary and the most holy place.

entries.yo: Eyi ti o mọ́ ninu ilẹ na yio jẹ ti awọn alufa, awọn iranṣẹ ibi-mimọ́, ti yio sunmọ lati ṣe iránṣẹ fun Oluwa: yio si jẹ àye fun ile wọn, ati ibi-mimọ́ fun ibi-mimọ́.
entries.en: The holy portion of the land shall be for the priests the ministers of the sanctuary, which shall come near to minister unto the LORD: and it shall be a place for their houses, and an holy place for the sanctuary.

entries.yo: Ati ẹgbã mejila le ẹgbẹrun ni gigun, ati ti ẹgbãrun ni ibú, ni awọn Lefi, pẹlu awọn iranṣẹ ile na, ni ogún yará, fun ara wọn, ni ini.
entries.en: And the five and twenty thousand of length, and the ten thousand of breadth, shall also the Levites, the ministers of the house, have for themselves, for a possession for twenty chambers.

entries.yo: Ati ini ilu na li ẹnyin o yàn ẹgbarun ni ibú, ati ẹgba mejila le ẹgbẹrun ni gigùn, lẹba ọrẹ ipín mimọ́ na: yio jẹ ti gbogbo ile Israeli.
entries.en: And ye shall appoint the possession of the city five thousand broad, and five and twenty thousand long, over against the oblation of the holy portion: it shall be for the whole house of Israel.

entries.yo: Ati ipín kan yio jẹ ti olori nihà kan ati niha keji ọrẹ ipin mimọ́, ati ti ini ilu, ti o kọju si ọrẹ ipín mimọ́, ti o si kọju si iní ti ilu, lati iha iwọ-õrun si iwọ-õrun, ati lati ihà ila-õrun si ila-õrun: gigùn rẹ̀ yio gbe ọkan ninu awọn ipín, lati eti iwọ-õrun de eti ila-õrun.
entries.en: And a portion shall be for the prince on the one side and on the other side of the oblation of the holy portion, and of the possession of the city, before the oblation of the holy portion, and before the possession of the city, from the west side westward, and from the east side eastward: and the length shall be over against one of the portions, from the west border unto the east border.

entries.yo: Ni ilẹ na ni iní rẹ̀ yio wà ni Israeli: awọn olori mi kì yio si ni awọn enia mi lara mọ́; ati ilẹ iyokù ni nwọn o fi fun ile Israeli gẹgẹ bi ẹyà wọn.
entries.en: In the land shall be his possession in Israel: and my princes shall no more oppress my people; and the rest of the land shall they give to the house of Israel according to their tribes.

entries.yo: Bayi ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Ki o to fun nyin, ẹnyin olori Israeli: ẹ mu ìwa ipa irẹ́jẹ kuro, ki ẹ si mu idajọ ati ododo ṣẹ, mu ilọ́nilọwọgbà nyin kuro lọdọ awọn enia mi, ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi.
entries.en: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Let it suffice you, O princes of Israel: remove violence and spoil, and execute judgment and justice, take away your exactions from my people, saith the Lord GOD.

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o ni ìwọn títọ, ati efà títọ, ati bati títọ.
entries.en: Ye shall have just balances, and a just ephah, and a just bath. I

entries.yo: Efa ati bati yio jẹ ìwọn kanna, ki bati ba le gbà ìdamẹwa homeri, ati efa idamẹwa homeri: iwọ̀n rẹ̀ yio jẹ gẹgẹ bi ti homeri.
entries.en: The ephah and the bath shall be of one measure, that the bath may contain the tenth part of an homer, and the ephah the tenth part of an homer: the measure thereof shall be after the homer.

entries.yo: Ṣekeli yio si jẹ́ ogún gera: ogún ṣekeli, ṣekeli mẹdọgbọ̀n, ṣekeli mẹdogun, ni manẹ nyin yio jẹ.
entries.en: And the shekel shall be twenty gerahs: twenty shekels, five and twenty shekels, fifteen shekels, shall be your manneh.

entries.yo: Eyi ni ọrẹ ti ẹ o rú; idamẹfa efa homeri alikama kan, ẹ o si mu idamẹfa efa homeri barle kan wá.
entries.en: This is the oblation that ye shall offer; the sixth part of an ephah of an homer of wheat, and ye shall give the sixth part of an ephah of an homer of barley:

entries.yo: Niti aṣẹ oróro, bati oróro, idamẹwa bati kan, lati inu kori wá, ti o jẹ homeri onibati mẹwa; nitori bati mẹwa ni homeri kan:
entries.en: Concerning the ordinance of oil, the bath of oil, ye shall offer the tenth part of a bath out of the cor, which is an homer of ten baths; for ten baths are an homer:

entries.yo: Ati ọdọ-agutan kan lati inu agbo, lati inu igba, lati inu pápa tutù Israeli; fun ọrẹ ẹbọ jijẹ, ati fun ọrẹ ẹbọ sisun, fun ọrẹ ẹbọ idupẹ, lati fi ṣe ètutu fun wọn, ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi.
entries.en: And one lamb out of the flock, out of two hundred, out of the fat pastures of Israel; for a meat offering, and for a burnt offering, and for peace offerings, to make reconciliation for them, saith the Lord GOD.

entries.yo: Gbogbo enia ilẹ na ni yio mu ẹbọ yi wá fun olori ni Israeli.
entries.en: All the people of the land shall give this oblation for the prince in Israel.

entries.yo: Ti ọmọ-alade yio jẹ́ ọrẹ ẹbọ sisun, ati ọrẹ ẹbọ jijẹ, ati ọrẹ ẹbọ mimu, ninu asè gbogbo, ati ni oṣù titun, ati ni awọn ọjọ isimi, ni gbogbo ajọ ile Israeli: on o pèse ọrẹ ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ, ati ọrẹ ẹbọ jijẹ, ati ọrẹ ẹbọ sisun, ati ọrẹ ẹbọ idupẹ, lati ṣe etùtu fun ile Israeli.
entries.en: And it shall be the prince's part to give burnt offerings, and meat offerings, and drink offerings, in the feasts, and in the new moons, and in the sabbaths, in all solemnities of the house of Israel: he shall prepare the sin offering, and the meat offering, and the burnt offering, and the peace offerings, to make reconciliation for the house of Israel.

entries.yo: Bayi ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; li oṣù ekini, li ọjọ ekini oṣù, iwọ o mu ẹgbọ̀rọ akọ malu alailabawọn, iwọ o si fi sọ ibi mimọ́ di mimọ́:
entries.en: Thus saith the Lord GOD; In the first month, in the first day of the month, thou shalt take a young bullock without blemish, and cleanse the sanctuary:

entries.yo: Alufa yio si mu ninu ẹjẹ ọrẹ ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ, yio si fi si opó ile, ati si igun mẹrẹrin ijoko pẹpẹ, ati si opó ẹnu-ọ̀na agbalá ti inu ile.
