entries.en: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering, and put it upon the posts of the house, and upon the four corners of the settle of the altar, and upon the posts of the gate of the inner court.

entries.yo: Bayi ni iwọ o si ṣe li ọjọ keje oṣù fun olukuluku ẹniti o ṣina, ati fun òpe: ẹ o si ṣe etùtu ilẹ na.
entries.en: And so thou shalt do the seventh day of the month for every one that erreth, and for him that is simple: so shall ye reconcile the house.

entries.yo: Li oṣù ekini, li ọjọ ẹkẹrinla oṣù, ẹnyin o ni irekọja, asè ọjọ meje: akara aiwú ni jijẹ.
entries.en: In the first month, in the fourteenth day of the month, ye shall have the passover, a feast of seven days; unleavened bread shall be eaten.

entries.yo: Ati li ọjọ na ni ọmọ-alade yio pèse ẹgbọ̀rọ akọ malu fun ọrẹ ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ fun ara rẹ̀ ati fun gbogbo enia ilẹ na.
entries.en: And upon that day shall the prince prepare for himself and for all the people of the land a bullock for a sin offering.

entries.yo: Ati ọjọ meje àse na ni yio pèse ọrẹ ẹbọ sisun fun Oluwa, ẹgbọ̀rọ akọ malu meje ati àgbo meje alailabawọ́n lojojumọ fun ọjọ meje na; ati ọmọ ewurẹ kan lojojumọ fun ọrẹ ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ.
entries.en: And seven days of the feast he shall prepare a burnt offering to the LORD, seven bullocks and seven rams without blemish daily the seven days; and a kid of the goats daily for a sin offering.

entries.yo: Yio si pèse ọrẹ ẹbọ jijẹ ti efa kan fun ẹgbọ̀rọ akọ malu kan, ati efa kan fun àgbo kan, ati hini ororo kan fun efa kan.
entries.en: And he shall prepare a meat offering of an ephah for a bullock, and an ephah for a ram, and an hin of oil for an ephah.

entries.yo: Li oṣù keje, li ọjọ kẹ̃dogun oṣù, ni yio ṣe gẹgẹ bi wọnyi ni àse ọjọ meje, gẹgẹ bi ọrẹ ẹbọ ẹ̀ṣẹ, gẹgẹ bi ọrẹ ẹbọ sisun, ati gẹgẹ bi ọrẹ ẹbọ jijẹ, ati gẹgẹ bi oróro.
entries.en: In the seventh month, in the fifteenth day of the month, shall he do the like in the feast of the seven days, according to the sin offering, according to the burnt offering, and according to the meat offering, and according to the oil.

entries.yo: BAYI li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Ẹnu-ọ̀na agbala ti inu ti o kọju si ila-õrun yio wà ni titì ni ọjọ mẹfa ti a fi iṣiṣẹ; ṣugbọn ni ọjọ isimi li a o ṣi i silẹ, ati li ọjọ oṣù titun li a o si ṣi i silẹ.
entries.en: Thus saith the Lord GOD; The gate of the inner court that looketh toward the east shall be shut the six working days; but on the sabbath it shall be opened, and in the day of the new moon it shall be opened.

entries.yo: Olori na yio si ba ẹnu-ọ̀na iloro ti ẹnu-ọ̀na ode wọle, yio si duro nibi opó ẹnu-ọ̀na, awọn alufa yio si pèse ọrẹ ẹbọ sisun rẹ̀ ati ọrẹ ẹbọ idupẹ rẹ̀, on o si ma sìn ni iloro ẹnu-ọ̀na: yio si jade wá; a kì yio si tì ẹnu-ọ̀na titi di aṣalẹ.
entries.en: And the prince shall enter by the way of the porch of that gate without, and shall stand by the post of the gate, and the priests shall prepare his burnt offering and his peace offerings, and he shall worship at the threshold of the gate: then he shall go forth; but the gate shall not be shut until the evening.

entries.yo: Enia ilẹ na yio si ma sìn ni ilẹkùn ẹnu-ọ̀na yi niwaju Oluwa ni ọjọ isimi, ati ni oṣù titun.
entries.en: Likewise the people of the land shall worship at the door of this gate before the LORD in the sabbaths and in the new moons.

entries.yo: Ọrẹ-ẹbọ sisun ti olori na yio rú si Oluwa ni ọjọ isimi, yio jẹ ọdọ-agutan mẹfa alailabawọn, ati agbò kan alailabàwọn.
entries.en: And the burnt offering that the prince shall offer unto the LORD in the sabbath day shall be six lambs without blemish, and a ram without blemish.

entries.yo: Ati ọrẹ ẹbọ jijẹ yio jẹ efà kan fun agbò kan, ati ọrẹ-ẹbọ jijẹ fun ọdọ-agutan ẹbùn ọwọ́ rẹ̀, ati hini ororo kan fun efa kan.
entries.en: And the meat offering shall be an ephah for a ram, and the meat offering for the lambs as he shall be able to give, and an hin of oil to an ephah.

entries.yo: Ati li ọjọ oṣù titun, ẹgbọ̀rọ malũ kan ailabawọn, ati ọdọ-agutan mẹfa, ati agbò kan: nwọn o wà lailabàwọn.
entries.en: And in the day of the new moon it shall be a young bullock without blemish, and six lambs, and a ram: they shall be without blemish.

entries.yo: Yio si pèse ọrẹ-ẹbọ jijẹ, efa fun ẹgbọ̀rọ akọ malu kan, ati efa kan fun agbò kan, ati fun awọn ọdọ-agutan gẹgẹ bi ọwọ́ rẹ̀ ba ti to, ati hini ororo kan fun efa kan.
entries.en: And he shall prepare a meat offering, an ephah for a bullock, and an ephah for a ram, and for the lambs according as his hand shall attain unto, and an hin of oil to an ephah.

entries.yo: Nigbati olori na yio ba si wọle, ọ̀na iloro ẹnu-ọ̀na ni yio ba wọle, yio si ba ọ̀na rẹ̀ jade.
entries.en: And when the prince shall enter, he shall go in by the way of the porch of that gate, and he shall go forth by the way thereof.

entries.yo: Nigbati enia ilẹ na yio ba si wá siwaju Oluwa ni awọn apejọ ọ̀wọ, ẹniti o ba ba ọ̀na ẹnu-ọ̀na ariwa wọle lati sìn, yio ba ọ̀na ẹnu-ọ̀na gusu jade; ẹniti o ba si ba ọ̀na ẹnu-ọ̀na gusu wọle yio si ba ọ̀na ẹnu-ọ̀na ariwa jade; kì yio ba ọ̀na ẹnu-ọ̀na ti o ba wọle jade, ṣugbọn yio jade lodi keji.
entries.en: But when the people of the land shall come before the LORD in the solemn feasts, he that entereth in by the way of the north gate to worship shall go out by the way of the south gate; and he that entereth by the way of the south gate shall go forth by the way of the north gate: he shall not return by the way of the gate whereby he came in, but shall go forth over against it.

entries.yo: Ati olori ti o wà lãrin wọn, nigbati nwọn ba wọle, yio wọle; nigbati nwọn ba si jade, yio jade.
entries.en: And the prince in the midst of them, when they go in, shall go in; and when they go forth, shall go forth.

entries.yo: Ati ninu awọn asè ati ninu awọn ajọ, ọrẹ-ẹbọ jijẹ yio jẹ efa kan fun ẹgbọ̀rọ akọ-malu kan, ati efa kan fun agbò kan, ati fun awọn ọdọ-agutan ẹbùn ọwọ́ rẹ̀, ati hini ororo kan fun efa kan.
entries.en: And in the feast and in the solemnities the meat offering shall be an ephah to a bullock, and ephah to a ram, and to the lambs as he is able to give, and an hin of oil to an ephah.

entries.yo: Nigbati olori na yio ba si pèse ọrẹ-ẹbọ sisun atinuwá, tabi ọrẹ-ẹbọ idupẹ atinuwá fun Oluwa, ẹnikan yio si ṣi ilẹkun ti o kọjusi ila-õrun fun u, yio si pèse ọrẹ-ẹbọ sisun rẹ̀, ati ẹbọ idupẹ rẹ̀, bi o ti ṣe li ọjọ-isimi: yio si jade; ati lẹhin ijadelọ rẹ̀ ẹnikan yio tì ilẹkun.
entries.en: Now when the prince shall prepare a voluntary burnt offering or peace offerings voluntarily unto the LORD, one shall then open him the gate that looketh toward the east, and he shall prepare his burnt offering and his peace offerings, as he did on the sabbath day: then he shall go forth; and after his going forth one shall shut the gate.

entries.yo: Li ojojumọ ni iwọ o pèse ọdọ agutan kan alailabawọn ọlọdun kan fun ọrẹ-ẹbọ sisun fun Oluwa: iwọ o ma pèse rẹ̀ lorowurọ̀.
entries.en: Thou shalt daily prepare a burnt offering unto the LORD of a lamb of the first year without blemish: thou shalt prepare it every morning.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si pèse ọrẹ-ẹbọ jijẹ fun u lorowurọ̀, idamẹfa efa, ati idamẹfa hini ororo kan, lati fi pò iyẹfun daradara na; ọrẹ-ẹbọ jijẹ nigbagbogbo nipa aṣẹ lailai fun Oluwa.
entries.en: And thou shalt prepare a meat offering for it every morning, the sixth part of an ephah, and the third part of an hin of oil, to temper with the fine flour; a meat offering continually by a perpetual ordinance unto the LORD.

entries.yo: Bayi ni nwọn o pèse ọdọ-agutan na, ati ọrẹ-ẹbọ jijẹ na, ati ororo na, lojojumọ fun ọrẹ-ẹbọ sisun nigbagbogbo.
entries.en: Thus shall they prepare the lamb, and the meat offering, and the oil, every morning for a continual burnt offering.

entries.yo: Bayi ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Bi olori na ba fi ẹbùn fun ẹnikẹni ninu awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, ogún rẹ̀ yio jẹ ti awọn ọmọ rẹ̀; yio jẹ ini wọn nipa ijogun.
entries.en: Thus saith the Lord GOD; If the prince give a gift unto any of his sons, the inheritance thereof shall be his sons'; it shall be their possession by inheritance.

entries.yo: Bi o ba si fi ẹbùn ninu ini rẹ̀ fun ọkan ninu awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀, nigbana yio jẹ tirẹ̀ titi di ọdun omnira; yio si tun pada di ti olori na: ṣugbọn ogún rẹ̀ yio jẹ ti awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ fun wọn.
entries.en: But if he give a gift of his inheritance to one of his servants, then it shall be his to the year of liberty; after it shall return to the prince: but his inheritance shall be his sons' for them.

entries.yo: Olori na kì yio si fi ipá mu ninu ogún awọn enia lati le wọn jade kuro ninu ini wọn, yio fi ogún fun awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ lara ini ti ontikalarẹ̀: ki awọn enia mi ki o má ba tuká, olukuluku kuro ni ini rẹ̀.
entries.en: Moreover the prince shall not take of the people's inheritance by oppression, to thrust them out of their possession; but he shall give his sons inheritance out of his own possession: that my people be not scattered every man from his possession.

entries.yo: O si mu mi kọja li abawọ̀, ti o wà lẹba ẹnu-ọ̀na, si awọn yará mimọ́ ti awọn alufa, ti o kọjusi ariwa: si kiyesi i, ibi kan wà nibẹ̀ ni ihà mejeji iwọ-õrun.
entries.en: After he brought me through the entry, which was at the side of the gate, into the holy chambers of the priests, which looked toward the north: and, behold, there was a place on the two sides westward.

entries.yo: O si wi fun mi pe, Eyi ni ibiti awọn alufa yio ma sè ọrẹ irekọja ati ọrẹ ẹ̀ṣẹ, nibiti nwọn o ma yan ọrẹ jijẹ; ki nwọn má ba gbe wọn jade si agbalá ode, lati sọ awọn enia di mimọ́.
entries.en: Then said he unto me, This is the place where the priests shall boil the trespass offering and the sin offering, where they shall bake the meat offering; that they bear them not out into the utter court, to sanctify the people.

entries.yo: O si mu mi jade wá si agbalá ode, o si mu mi kọja ni igun mẹrẹrin agbalá na; si kiyesi i, ni olukuluku igun agbalá na ni agbala kan gbe wà.
entries.en: Then he brought me forth into the utter court, and caused me to pass by the four corners of the court; and, behold, in every corner of the court there was a court.

entries.yo: Ni igun mẹrẹrin agbalá na, ni agbalá ti a kànpọ ologoji igbọnwọ ni gigùn, ati ọgbọ̀n ni ibú: awọn igun mẹrẹrin wọnyi jẹ iwọ̀n kanna.
entries.en: In the four corners of the court there were courts joined of forty cubits long and thirty broad: these four corners were of one measure.

entries.yo: Ọwọ́ ile kan si wà yika ninu wọn, yika awọn mẹrẹrin, a si ṣe ibudaná si abẹ ọwọ́ na yika.
entries.en: And there was a row of building round about in them, round about them four, and it was made with boiling places under the rows round about.

entries.yo: O si wi fun mi pe, Wọnyi ni ibi awọn ti nsè, nibiti awọn iranṣẹ ile na yio ma se ẹbọ awọn enia.
entries.en: Then said he unto me, These are the places of them that boil, where the ministers of the house shall boil the sacrifice of the people.

entries.yo: O si mu mi padà wá si ibi ilẹkùn ile na; si kiyesi i, omi ntù jade lati abẹ iloro ile na nihà ila-õrun: nitori iwaju ile na wà ni ila-õrun, omi si nwalẹ lati abẹ apa ọtun ile na, ni gusu pẹpẹ.
entries.en: Afterward he brought me again unto the door of the house; and, behold, waters issued out from under the threshold of the house eastward: for the forefront of the house stood toward the east, and the waters came down from under from the right side of the house, at the south side of the altar.

entries.yo: O si mu mi jade ni ọ̀na ẹnu-ọ̀na ihà ariwa, o si mu mi yi wá ọ̀na ode si ẹnu-ọ̀na ode ni ọ̀na ti o kọjusi ila-õrun; si kiyesi i, omi ṣàn jade lati ihà ọtun.
entries.en: Then brought he me out of the way of the gate northward, and led me about the way without unto the utter gate by the way that looketh eastward; and, behold, there ran out waters on the right side.

entries.yo: Nigbati ọkunrin na jade sihà ila-õrun, pẹlu okùn kan lọwọ rẹ̀, o si wọ̀n ẹgbẹrun igbọnwọ, o si mu mi là omi na ja; omi na si de kókosẹ̀.
entries.en: And when the man that had the line in his hand went forth eastward, he measured a thousand cubits, and he brought me through the waters; the waters were to the ancles.

entries.yo: O tun wọ̀n ẹgbẹrun, o si mu mi là omi na ja; omi na si de ẽkun. O si wọ̀n ẹgbẹrun, o si mu mi là a ja; omi si de ẹgbẹ́.
entries.en: Again he measured a thousand, and brought me through the waters; the waters were to the knees. Again he measured a thousand, and brought me through; the waters were to the loins.

entries.yo: O si wọ̀n ẹgbẹrun; odò ti nkò le wọ́: nitori omi ti kún, omi ilúwẹ, odò ti kò ṣe rekọja.
entries.en: Afterward he measured a thousand; and it was a river that I could not pass over: for the waters were risen, waters to swim in, a river that could not be passed over.

entries.yo: O si wi fun mi pe, Ọmọ enia, Iwọ ri yi? O si mu mi wá, o si mu mi pada wá si bèbe odò na.
entries.en: And he said unto me, Son of man, hast thou seen this? Then he brought me, and caused me to return to the brink of the river.

entries.yo: Nigbati mo pada, si kiyesi i, igi pupọ̀pupọ̀ wà ni ihà ihin ati ni ihà ọhun li eti odò na.
entries.en: Now when I had returned, behold, at the bank of the river were very many trees on the one side and on the other.

entries.yo: O si wi fun mi pe, Omi wọnyi ntú jade sihà ilẹ ila-õrun, nwọn si nsọkalẹ lọ si pẹ̀tẹlẹ, nwọn si wọ̀ okun lọ: nigbati a si mu wọn wọ̀ inu okun, a si mu omi wọn lara dá.
entries.en: Then said he unto me, These waters issue out toward the east country, and go down into the desert, and go into the sea: which being brought forth into the sea, the waters shall be healed.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe pe, ohunkohun ti o ba wà lãye ti nrakò, nibikibi ti odò mejeji ba de, yio wà lãye: ọ̀pọlọpọ ẹja yio si de, nitori omi wọnyi yio de ibẹ̀: a o si mu wọn lara dá; ohun gbogbo yio si yè nibikibi ti odò na ba de.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass, that every thing that liveth, which moveth, whithersoever the rivers shall come, shall live: and there shall be a very great multitude of fish, because these waters shall come thither: for they shall be healed; and every thing shall live whither the river cometh.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe pe, Awọn apẹja yio duro lori rẹ̀ lati Engedi titi de Eneglaimu; nwọn o jẹ ibi lati nà àwọn si; ẹja wọn o dabi iru wọn, bi ẹja okun-nla, lọpọlọpọ.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass, that the fishers shall stand upon it from En-gedi even unto En-eglaim; they shall be a place to spread forth nets; their fish shall be according to their kinds, as the fish of the great sea, exceeding many.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ibi ẹrẹ̀ rẹ̀ ati ibi irà rẹ̀ li a kì o mu laradá; a o fi nwọn fun iyọ̀.
entries.en: But the miry places thereof and the marishes thereof shall not be healed; they shall be given to salt.

entries.yo: Ati lẹba odò ni eti rẹ̀, ni ihà ihin ati ni ihà ọhun, ni gbogbo igi jijẹ yio hù, ti ewe rẹ̀ kì yio rọ, ti eso rẹ̀ kì yio si run: yio ma so eso titun rẹ̀ li oṣù rẹ̀, nitori omi wọn lati ibi mimọ́ ni nwọn ti ntú jade: eso rẹ̀ yio si jẹ fun jijẹ, ati ewe rẹ̀ fun imunilaradá.
entries.en: And by the river upon the bank thereof, on this side and on that side, shall grow all trees for meat, whose leaf shall not fade, neither shall the fruit thereof be consumed: it shall bring forth new fruit according to his months, because their waters they issued out of the sanctuary: and the fruit thereof shall be for meat, and the leaf thereof for medicine.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; eyi ni yio jẹ ãlà, ti ẹnyin o fi jogún ilẹ na fun ara nyin fun ẹ̀ya mejila Israeli: Josefu yio ni ipin meji.
entries.en: Thus saith the Lord GOD; This shall be the border, whereby ye shall inherit the land according to the twelve tribes of Israel: Joseph shall have two portions.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin o si jogún rẹ̀, olukuluku bi ti ekeji rẹ̀: eyiti mo ti gbe ọwọ́ mi sokè lati fi i fun awọn baba nyin: ilẹ yi yio si bọ sọdọ nyin fun ogún.
entries.en: And ye shall inherit it, one as well as another: concerning the which I lifted up mine hand to give it unto your fathers: and this land shall fall unto you for inheritance.

entries.yo: Eyi ni yio si jẹ ãlà ilẹ na nihà ariwa, lati okun nla, ni ọ̀na Hetloni, bi a ti nlọ si Sedadi;
entries.en: And this shall be the border of the land toward the north side, from the great sea, the way of Hethlon, as men go to Zedad;

entries.yo: Hamati, Berota, Sibraimu, ti o wà lãrin ãlà Damasku, ati ãlà Hamati; Hasar-hatikonu, ti o wà ni agbègbe Haurani.
entries.en: Hamath, Berothah, Sibraim, which is between the border of Damascus and the border of Hamath; Hazar-hatticon, which is by the coast of Hauran.

entries.yo: Alà lati okun yio si jẹ Hasarenani, ãlà Damasku, ati ariwa nihà ariwa, ati ãlà Hamati. Eyi si ni ihà ariwa.
entries.en: And the border from the sea shall be Hazar-enan, the border of Damascus, and the north northward, and the border of Hamath. And this is the north side.

entries.yo: Ati ni ihà ila-õrun ẹ o wọ̀n lati ãrin Haurani, ati lati ãrin Damasku, ati lati ãrin Gileadi, ati lati ãrin ilẹ Israeli lẹba Jordani, lati ãlà titi de okun ila-õrun. Eyi ni ihà ila-õrun.
entries.en: And the east side ye shall measure from Hauran, and from Damascus, and from Gilead, and from the land of Israel by Jordan, from the border unto the east sea. And this is the east side.

entries.yo: Ati ihà gusu si gusu, lati Tamari titi de omi ijà ni Kadeṣi, pẹ̀tẹlẹ si okun nla. Eyi ni ihà gusu.
entries.en: And the south side southward, from Tamar even to the waters of strife in Kadesh, the river to the great sea. And this is the south side southward.

entries.yo: Ihà iwọ-õrun pẹlu yio jẹ okun nla lati ãlà bi a ti nlọ si Hamati. Eyi ni ihà iwọ-õrun.
entries.en: The west side also shall be the great sea from the border, till a man come over against Hamath. This is the west side.

entries.yo: Bayi li ẹ o pin ilẹ yi fun ara nyin gẹgẹ bi awọn ẹ̀ya Israeli.
entries.en: So shall ye divide this land unto you according to the tribes of Israel.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe pe, ìbo ni ẹ o fi pin i ni ogún fun ara nyin, ati fun awọn alejo ti o ṣe atipo lãrin nyin, ti nwọn bi ọmọ lãrin nyin: nwọn o si ri si nyin bi ibilẹ ninu awọn ọmọ Israeli; nwọn o ba nyin pin i li ogún lãrin awọn ẹ̀ya Israeli.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass, that ye shall divide it by lot for an inheritance unto you, and to the strangers that sojourn among you, which shall beget children among you: and they shall be unto you as born in the country among the children of Israel; they shall have inheritance with you among the tribes of Israel.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe pe, ni ẹ̀ya ti alejò ba ṣe atipo, nibẹ̀ li ẹ o fun u ni ogún, ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass, that in what tribe the stranger sojourneth, there shall ye give him his inheritance, saith the Lord GOD.

entries.yo: WỌNYI si ni orukọ awọn ẹ̀ya na. Lati opin ariwa titi de ọwọ́ ọ̀na Hetlonu, bi a ba nlọ si Hamati, Hasaenani, leti Damasku niha ariwa, de ọwọ́ Hamati; wọnyi sa ni ihà rẹ̀ ni ila-õrun ati iwọ-õrun; ipin kan fun Dani.
entries.en: Now these are the names of the tribes. From the north end to the coast of the way of Hethlon, as one goeth to Hamath, Hazar-enan, the border of Damascus northward, to the coast of Hamath; for these are his sides east and west; a portion for Dan.

entries.yo: Ati ni àgbegbe Dani, lati ihà ila-õrun, de ihà iwọ-õrun, ipin kan, fun Aṣeri.
entries.en: And by the border of Dan, from the east side unto the west side, a portion for Asher.

entries.yo: Ati ni àgbegbe Aṣeri, lati ihà ila-õrun, ani titi de ihà iwọ-õrun, ipin kan, fun Naftali.
entries.en: And by the border of Asher, from the east side even unto the west side, a portion for Naphtali.

entries.yo: Ati ni àgbegbe Naftali, lati ihà ila-õrun, de ihà iwọ-õrun, ipin kan, fun Manasse.
entries.en: And by the border of Naphtali, from the east side unto the west side, a portion for Manasseh.

entries.yo: Ati ni àgbegbe Manasse, lati ihà ila-õrun, de ihà iwọ-õrun, ipin kan, fun Efraimu.
entries.en: And by the border of Manasseh, from the east side unto the west side, a portion for Ephraim.

entries.yo: Ati ni àgbegbe Efraimu, lati ihà ila-õrun, ani titi de ihà iwọ-õrun, ipin kan, fun Reubeni.
entries.en: And by the border of Ephraim, from the east side even unto the west side, a portion for Reuben.

entries.yo: Ati ni àgbegbe Reubeni, lati ihà ila-õrun, ani titi de ihà iwọ-õrun, ipin kan, fun Juda.
entries.en: And by the border of Reuben, from the east side unto the west side, a portion for Judah.

entries.yo: Ati ni àgbegbe Juda, lati ihà ila-õrun, de ihà iwọ-õrun ni yio jẹ ọrẹ ti ẹnyin o ta, ẹgbã-mejila, o le ẹgbẹrun ije ni ibú, ati ni gigùn, bi ọkan ninu awọn ipin iyokù, lati ihà ila-õrun, de ihà iwọ-õrun: ibi mimọ́ yio si wà lãrin rẹ̀.
entries.en: And by the border of Judah, from the east side unto the west side, shall be the offering which ye shall offer of five and twenty thousand reeds in breadth, and in length as one of the other parts, from the east side unto the west side: and the sanctuary shall be in the midst of it.

entries.yo: Ọrẹ ti ẹnyin o si ta fun Oluwa yio jẹ ẹgbã-mejila, o le ẹgbẹrun ni gigùn, ati ẹgbã-marun ni ibú.
entries.en: The oblation that ye shall offer unto the LORD shall be of five and twenty thousand in length, and of ten thousand in breadth.

entries.yo: Ati fun wọn, ani fun awọn alufa, ni ọrẹ mimọ́ yi yio jẹ; ni ihà ariwa, ẹgbã-mejila, o le ẹgbẹrun ni gigùn, ati ni ihà iwọ-õrun, ẹgbã-marun ni ibú, ati ni ihà ila-õrun, ẹgbã-marun ni ibú, ati ni ihà gusu, ẹgbã-mejila, o le ẹgbẹrun ni gigùn: ibi mimọ́ yio si wà lãrin rẹ̀.
entries.en: And for them, even for the priests, shall be this holy oblation; toward the north five and twenty thousand in length, and toward the west ten thousand in breadth, and toward the east ten thousand in breadth, and toward the south five and twenty thousand in length: and the sanctuary of the LORD shall be in the midst thereof.

entries.yo: Yio jẹ ti awọn alufa ti a yà si mimọ́, ninu awọn ọmọ Sadoku; ti nwọn ti pa ilàna mi mọ, ti nwọn kò si ṣìna ni iṣìna awọn ọmọ Israeli, bi awọn Lefi ti ṣìna.
entries.en: It shall be for the priests that are sanctified of the sons of Zadok; which have kept my charge, which went not astray when the children of Israel went astray, as the Levites went astray.

entries.yo: Ọrẹ ilẹ ti a si ta yi, yio jẹ ohun mimọ́ julọ fun wọn li àgbegbe awọn Lefi.
entries.en: And this oblation of the land that is offered shall be unto them a thing most holy by the border of the Levites.

entries.yo: Ati ni ikọjusi àgbegbe awọn alufa, ni awọn Lefi yio ni ẹgbã-mejila, o le ẹgbẹrun ni gigùn, ati ẹgbã-marun ni ibú: gigùn gbogbo rẹ̀ yio jẹ ẹgbã-mejila o le ẹgbẹrun, ati ibú rẹ̀, ẹgbã-marun.
entries.en: And over against the border of the priests the Levites shall have five and twenty thousand in length, and ten thousand in breadth: all the length shall be five and twenty thousand, and the breadth ten thousand.

entries.yo: Nwọn kì yio si tà ninu rẹ̀, nwọn kì yio si fi ṣe paṣiparọ, bẹ̃ni nwọn kì yio si fi akọ́so ilẹ na si ọwọ́ ẹlomiran, nitoripe o jẹ mimọ́ fun Oluwa.
entries.en: And they shall not sell of it, neither exchange, nor alienate the firstfruits of the land: for it is holy unto the LORD.

entries.yo: Ati ẹgbẹ̃dọgbọn ti o kù ni ibú, ni ikọjusi ẹgbã-mejila o le ẹgbẹrun na, yio jẹ ibi aimọ́ fun ilu-nla na, fun ibugbe, ati fun àgbegbe: ilu-nla na yio si wà lãrin rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the five thousand, that are left in the breadth over against the five and twenty thousand, shall be a profane place for the city, for dwelling, and for suburbs: and the city shall be in the midst thereof.

entries.yo: Wọnyi ni yio si jẹ iwọ̀n rẹ̀; ni ihà ariwa, ẹgbã-meji o le ẹ̃dẹgbẹta, ati ni ihà gusu, ẹgbã-meji o le ẹ̃dẹgbẹta, ati ni ihà ila-õrun, ẹgbã-meji o le ẹ̃dẹgbẹta, ati ni ihà iwọ-õrun, ẹgbã-meji o le ẹ̃dẹgbẹta.
entries.en: And these shall be the measures thereof; the north side four thousand and five hundred, and the south side four thousand and five hundred, and on the east side four thousand and five hundred, and the west side four thousand and five hundred.

entries.yo: Awọn àgbegbe ilu-nla na yio jẹ niha ariwa, ãdọtalerugba, ati nihà gusu, ãdọtalerugba ati nihà ila-õrun, ãdọtalerugba, ati nihà iwọ-õrun, ãdọtalerugba.
entries.en: And the suburbs of the city shall be toward the north two hundred and fifty, and toward the south two hundred and fifty, and toward the east two hundred and fifty, and toward the west two hundred and fifty.

entries.yo: Ati iyokù ni gigùn, ni ikọjusi ọrẹ ti ipin mimọ́ na, yio si jẹ ẹgbã-marun nihà ila-õrun, ati ẹgbã-marun nihà iwọ-õrun: yio si wà ni ikọjusi ọrẹ ipin mimọ́ na, ati ibisi rẹ̀ yio jẹ fun onjẹ fun awọn ti nsìn ni ilu-nla na.
entries.en: And the residue in length over against the oblation of the holy portion shall be ten thousand eastward, and ten thousand westward: and it shall be over against the oblation of the holy portion; and the increase thereof shall be for food unto them that serve the city.

entries.yo: Awọn ti mba nsìn ilu-nla na yio si ma sìn i, lati inu gbogbo ẹ̀ya Israeli.
entries.en: And they that serve the city shall serve it out of all the tribes of Israel.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ọrẹ na yio jẹ ẹgbã-mejila o le ẹgbẹrun, nipa ẹgbã-mejila o le ẹgbẹrun: ẹ o si ta ọrẹ mimọ́ na, igun mẹrẹrin lọgbọ̃gba pẹlu ini ilu-nla na.
entries.en: All the oblation shall be five and twenty thousand by five and twenty thousand: ye shall offer the holy oblation foursquare, with the possession of the city.

entries.yo: Ati iyokù yio jẹ ti olori, ni ihà kan, ati nihà keji ti ọrẹ mimọ́ na, ati ti ini ibi nla na, ni ikọjusi ẹgbã-mejila o le ẹgbẹrun, ọrẹ ti àgbegbe ila-õrun, ati nihà iwọ-õrun ni ikọjusi ẹgbã-mejila, o le ẹgbẹrun, nihà àgbegbe iwọ-õrun, ni ikọjusi awọn ipin ti olori: yio si jẹ ọrẹ mimọ́ na; ibi mimọ́ ile na, yio si wà lãrin rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the residue shall be for the prince, on the one side and on the other of the holy oblation, and of the possession of the city, over against the five and twenty thousand of the oblation toward the east border, and westward over against the five and twenty thousand toward the west border, over against the portions for the prince: and it shall be the holy oblation; and the sanctuary of the house shall be in the midst thereof.

entries.yo: Ati lati ini awọn Lefi, ati lati ini ti ilu-nla na, lãrin eyiti iṣe ti olori, lãrin àgbegbe Juda, ati lãrin àgbegbe Benjamini, yio jẹ ti olori.
entries.en: Moreover from the possession of the Levites, and from the possession of the city, being in the midst of that which is the prince's, between the border of Judah and the border of Benjamin, shall be for the prince.

entries.yo: Ati fun awọn ẹ̀ya iyokù, lati ihà ila-õrun de ihà iwọ-õrun, Benjamini ipin kan.
entries.en: As for the rest of the tribes, from the east side unto the west side, Benjamin shall have a portion.

entries.yo: Ati ni àgbegbe Benjamini, lati ihà ila-õrun de ihà iwọ-õrun, Simeoni ipin kan.
entries.en: And by the border of Benjamin, from the east side unto the west side, Simeon shall have a portion.

entries.yo: Ati ni àgbegbe Simeoni, lati ihà ila-õrun de ihà iwọ-õrun, Issakari ipin kan.
entries.en: And by the border of Simeon, from the east side unto the west side, Issachar a portion.

entries.yo: Ati ni àgbegbe Issakari, lati ihà ila-õrun de ihà iwọ-õrun, Sebuloni ipin kan.
entries.en: And by the border of Issachar, from the east side unto the west side, Zebulun a portion.

entries.yo: Ati ni àgbegbe Sebuloni, lati ihà ila-õrun de ihà iwọ-õrun, Gadi ipin kan.
entries.en: And by the border of Zebulun, from the east side unto the west side, Gad a portion.

entries.yo: Ati ni àgbegbe Gadi, ni ihà gusu si gusu, àgbegbe na yio jẹ lati Tamari de omi ijà ni Kadeṣi, ati si odò, titi de okun nla.
entries.en: And by the border of Gad, at the south side southward, the border shall be even from Tamar unto the waters of strife in Kadesh, and to the river toward the great sea.

entries.yo: Eyi ni ilẹ ti ẹnyin o fi ìbo pin ni ogún fun awọn ẹ̀ya Israeli, wọnyi si ni ipin wọn, ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi.
entries.en: This is the land which ye shall divide by lot unto the tribes of Israel for inheritance, and these are their portions, saith the Lord GOD.

entries.yo: Wọnyi si ni ibajade ti ilu-nla na lati ìha ariwa, ẹgbã-meji, o le ẹ̃dẹgbẹta oṣùwọn.
entries.en: And these are the goings out of the city on the north side, four thousand and five hundred measures.

entries.yo: Awọn bode ilu-nla na yio jẹ gẹgẹ bi orukọ awọn ẹ̀ya Israeli: bodè mẹta nihà ariwa, bodè Reubeni ọkan, bodè Juda ọkan, bodè Lefi ọkan.
entries.en: And the gates of the city shall be after the names of the tribes of Israel: three gates northward; one gate of Reuben, one gate of Judah, one gate of Levi.

entries.yo: Ati ni ihà ila-õrun, ẹgbã-meji o le ẹ̃dẹgbẹta: ati bodè mẹta; ati bode Josefu ọkan, bode Benjamini ọkan, bodè Dani ọkan.
entries.en: And at the east side four thousand and five hundred: and three gates; and one gate of Joseph, one gate of Benjamin, one gate of Dan.

entries.yo: Ati ni ihà gusu, ẹgbã-meji, o le ẹ̃dẹgbẹta ìwọn: ati bodè mẹta; bodè Simeoni ọkan, bodè Issakari ọkan, bodè Sebuloni ọkan.
entries.en: And at the south side four thousand and five hundred measures: and three gates; one gate of Simeon, one gate of Issachar, one gate of Zebulun.

entries.yo: Ni ihà iwọ-õrun, ẹgbã-meji o le ẹ̃dẹgbẹta, pẹlu bodè mẹta wọn; bodè Gadi ọkan, bodè Aṣeri ọkan, bodè Naftali ọkan.
entries.en: At the west side four thousand and five hundred, with their three gates; one gate of Gad, one gate of Asher, one gate of Naphtali.

entries.yo: O jẹ ẹgbã-mẹsan ìwọn yika: orukọ ilu-nla na lati ijọ na lọ yio ma jẹ, Oluwa mbẹ nibẹ̀.
entries.en: It was round about eighteen thousand measures: and the name of the city from that day shall be, The LORD is there.

entries.yo: LI ọdun kẹta ijọba Jehoiakimu, ọba Juda ni Nebukadnessari, ọba Babeli, wá si Jerusalemu, o si do tì i.
entries.en: In the third year of the reign of Jehoiakim king of Judah came Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon unto Jerusalem, and besieged it.

entries.yo: Oluwa si fi Jehoiakimu, ọba Juda le e lọwọ, pẹlu apakan ohun-elo ile Ọlọrun, ti o kó lọ si ilẹ Ṣinari, si ile oriṣa rẹ̀: o si kó ohun-elo na wá sinu ile-iṣura oriṣa rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the Lord gave Jehoiakim king of Judah into his hand, with part of the vessels of the house of God: which he carried into the land of Shinar to the house of his god; and he brought the vessels into the treasure house of his god.

entries.yo: Ọba si wi fun Aṣpenasi, olori awọn iwẹfa rẹ̀, pe, ki o mu awọn kan wá ninu awọn ọmọ Israeli, ninu iru-ọmọ ọba, ati ti awọn ijoye;
entries.en: And the king spake unto Ashpenaz the master of his eunuchs, that he should bring certain of the children of Israel, and of the king's seed, and of the princes;

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ ti kò lẹgan lara, ṣugbọn awọn ti o ṣe arẹwa, ti o si ni ìmọ ninu ọgbọ́n gbogbo, ti o mọ̀ oye, ti o si ni iyè ninu, ati iru awọn ti o yẹ lati duro li ãfin ọba ati awọn ti a ba ma kọ́ ni iwe ati ede awọn ara Kaldea.
entries.en: Children in whom was no blemish, but well favoured, and skilful in all wisdom, and cunning in knowledge, and understanding science, and such as had ability in them to stand in the king's palace, and whom they might teach the learning and the tongue of the Chaldeans.

entries.yo: Ọba si pese onjẹ wọn ojojumọ ninu adidùn ọba ati ninu ọti-waini ti o nmu: ki a bọ wọn bẹ̃ li ọdun mẹta, pe, li opin rẹ̀, ki nwọn ki o le duro niwaju ọba.
entries.en: And the king appointed them a daily provision of the king's meat, and of the wine which he drank: so nourishing them three years, that at the end thereof they might stand before the king.

entries.yo: Njẹ ninu awọn wọnyi ni Danieli, Hananiah, Miṣaeli, ati Asariah, lati inu awọn ọmọ Juda:
entries.en: Now among these were of the children of Judah, Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah:

entries.yo: Awọn ẹniti olori awọn iwẹfa si fi orukọ fun: bẹ̃li o pè Danieli ni Belteṣassari, ati Hananiah ni Ṣadraki; ati Miṣaeli ni Méṣaki; ati Asariah ni Abednego.
entries.en: Unto whom the prince of the eunuchs gave names: for he gave unto Daniel the name of Belteshazzar; and to Hananiah, of Shadrach; and to Mishael, of Meshach; and to Azariah, of Abed-nego.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Danieli pinnu rẹ̀ li ọkàn rẹ̀ pe, on kì yio fi onjẹ adidùn ọba, ati ọti-waini ti o nmu ba ara on jẹ: nitorina o bẹ̀ olori awọn iwẹfa pe, ki on má ba ba ara on jẹ.
entries.en: But Daniel purposed in his heart that he would not defile himself with the portion of the king's meat, nor with the wine which he drank: therefore he requested of the prince of the eunuchs that he might not defile himself.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun sa ti mu Danieli ba ojurere ati iyọ́nu pade lọdọ olori awọn iwẹfa.
entries.en: Now God had brought Daniel into favour and tender love with the prince of the eunuchs.

entries.yo: Olori awọn iwẹfa si wi fun Danieli pe, Mo bẹ̀ru ọba, oluwa mi, ẹniti o yàn onjẹ nyin ati ohun mimu nyin: nitori bawo li on o ṣe ri oju nyin ki o faro jù ti awọn ọmọkunrin ẹgbẹ nyin kanna lọ? nigbana li ẹnyin o ṣe ki emi ki o fi ori mi wewu lọdọ ọba.
entries.en: And the prince of the eunuchs said unto Daniel, I fear my lord the king, who hath appointed your meat and your drink: for why should he see your faces worse liking than the children which are of your sort? then shall ye make me endanger my head to the king.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Danieli wi fun olutọju ti olori awọn iwẹfa fi ṣe oluṣọ Danieli, Hananiah, Miṣaeli, ati Asariah pe,
entries.en: Then said Daniel to Melzar, whom the prince of the eunuchs had set over Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah,

entries.yo: Dán awọn ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ wò, emi bẹ̀ ọ, ni ijọ mẹwa; ki o si jẹ ki nwọn ki o ma fi ẹ̀wa fun wa lati jẹ, ati omi lati mu.
entries.en: Prove thy servants, I beseech thee, ten days; and let them give us pulse to eat, and water to drink.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ki a wò oju wa niwaju rẹ, ati oju awọn ọmọ ti njẹ onjẹ adidùn ọba: bi iwọ ba si ti ri i si, bẹ̃ni ki o ṣe si awọn ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ.
entries.en: Then let our countenances be looked upon before thee, and the countenance of the children that eat of the portion of the king's meat: and as thou seest, deal with thy servants.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li o gbà fun wọn li ọ̀ran yi, o si dan wọn wò ni ijọ mẹwa.
entries.en: So he consented to them in this matter, and proved them ten days.

entries.yo: Li opin ọjọ mẹwa, a ri oju wọn lẹwa, nwọn si sanra jù gbogbo awọn ti njẹ onjẹ adidùn ọba lọ.
entries.en: And at the end of ten days their countenances appeared fairer and fatter in flesh than all the children which did eat the portion of the king's meat.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni olutọju mu onjẹ adidùn wọn kuro, ati ọti-waini ti nwọn iba mu, o si fun wọn li ẹ̀wa.
entries.en: Thus Melzar took away the portion of their meat, and the wine that they should drink; and gave them pulse.

entries.yo: Bi o ṣe ti awọn ọmọ mẹrẹrin wọnyi ni, Ọlọrun fun wọn ni ìmọ ati oye ni gbogbo iwe ati ọgbọ́n: Danieli si li oye ni gbogbo iran ati alá.
entries.en: As for these four children, God gave them knowledge and skill in all learning and wisdom: and Daniel had understanding in all visions and dreams.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si di opin ọjọ ti ọba ti da pe ki a mu wọn wá, nigbana ni olori awọn iwẹfa mu wọn wá siwaju Nebukadnessari.
entries.en: Now at the end of the days that the king had said he should bring them in, then the prince of the eunuchs brought them in before Nebuchadnezzar.

entries.yo: Ọba si ba wọn sọ̀rọ: ninu gbogbo wọn, kò si si ẹniti o dabi Danieli, Hananiah, Miṣaeli ati Asariah: nitorina ni nwọn fi nduro niwaju ọba.
entries.en: And the king communed with them; and among them all was found none like Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah: therefore stood they before the king.

entries.yo: Ati ninu gbogbo ọ̀ran ọgbọ́n ati oye, ti ọba mbère lọwọ wọn, o ri pe ni iwọn igba mẹwa, nwọn sàn jù gbogbo awọn amoye ati ọlọgbọ́n ti o wà ni gbogbo ilẹ ijọba rẹ̀ lọ.
entries.en: And in all matters of wisdom and understanding, that the king inquired of them, he found them ten times better than all the magicians and astrologers that were in all his realm.

entries.yo: Danieli si wà sibẹ titi di ọdun ikini ti Kirusi, ọba.
entries.en: And Daniel continued even unto the first year of king Cyrus.

entries.yo: ATI li ọdun keji ijọba Nebukadnessari, Nebukadnessari lá alá nipa eyi ti ọkàn rẹ̀ kò fi le ilẹ ninu rẹ̀, ti orun si dá loju rẹ̀.
entries.en: And in the second year of the reign of Nebuchadnezzar Nebuchadnezzar dreamed dreams, wherewith his spirit was troubled, and his sleep brake from him.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ọba paṣẹ pe, ki a pè awọn amoye ati ọlọgbọ́n, ati awọn oṣó, ati awọn Kaldea wá, lati fi alá ọba na hàn fun u. Bẹ̃ni nwọn si duro niwaju ọba.
entries.en: Then the king commanded to call the magicians, and the astrologers, and the sorcerers, and the Chaldeans, for to shew the king his dreams. So they came and stood before the king.

entries.yo: Ọba si wi fun wọn pe, mo lá alá kan, ọkàn mi kò si le ilẹ lati mọ̀ alá na.
entries.en: And the king said unto them, I have dreamed a dream, and my spirit was troubled to know the dream.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni awọn Kaldea wi fun ọba li ede awọn ara Siria pe, Ki ọba ki o pẹ́: rọ́ alá na fun awọn ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ, awa o si fi itumọ̀ na hàn.
entries.en: Then spake the Chaldeans to the king in Syriack, O king, live for ever: tell thy servants the dream, and we will shew the interpretation.

entries.yo: Ọba dahùn o si wi fun awọn Kaldea pe, ohun na ti kuro li ori mi: bi ẹnyin kò ba fi alá na hàn fun mi ati itumọ̀ rẹ̀ pẹlu, a o ké nyin wẹwẹ, a o si sọ ile nyin di ãtàn.
entries.en: The king answered and said to the Chaldeans, The thing is gone from me: if ye will not make known unto me the dream, with the interpretation thereof, ye shall be cut in pieces, and your houses shall be made a dunghill.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi ẹnyin ba fi alá na hàn, ati itumọ̀ rẹ̀ pẹlu, ẹnyin o gba ẹ̀bun ati ọrẹ ati ọlá nla li ọwọ mi: nitorina, ẹ fi alá na hàn fun mi, ati itumọ̀ rẹ̀ pẹlu.
entries.en: But if ye shew the dream, and the interpretation thereof, ye shall receive of me gifts and rewards and great honour: therefore shew me the dream, and the interpretation thereof.

entries.yo: Nwọn tun dahùn nwọn si wipe, Ki ọba ki o rọ alá na fun awọn ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ̀, awa o si fi itumọ̀ rẹ̀ hàn.
entries.en: They answered again and said, Let the king tell his servants the dream, and we will shew the interpretation of it.

entries.yo: Ọba si dahùn o wi pe, emi mọ̀ dajudaju pe, ẹnyin fẹ mu akoko pẹ, nitoriti ẹnyin ri pe nkan na lọ li ori mi.
entries.en: The king answered and said, I know of certainty that ye would gain the time, because ye see the thing is gone from me.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi ẹnyin kò ba fi alá na hàn fun mi, njẹ ipinnu kan li ẹnyin ti ṣe: nitoriti ẹnyin mura lati ma sọ̀rọ eke ati idibajẹ niwaju mi, titi akoko yio fi kọja: nitorina ẹ rọ́ alá na fun mi emi o si mọ̀ pe ẹnyin o le fi itumọ̀ rẹ̀ hàn fun mi pẹlu.
entries.en: But if ye will not make known unto me the dream, there is but one decree for you: for ye have prepared lying and corrupt words to speak before me, till the time be changed: therefore tell me the dream, and I shall know that ye can shew me the interpretation thereof.

entries.yo: Awọn Kaldea si dahùn niwaju ọba, nwọn si wipe, kò si ẹnikan ti o wà li aiye ti o le fi ọ̀ran ọba hàn: kò si si ọba, oluwa, tabi ijoye kan ti o bère iru nkan bẹ̃ lọwọ amoye, tabi ọlọgbọ́n, tabi Kaldea kan ri.
entries.en: The Chaldeans answered before the king, and said, There is not a man upon the earth that can shew the king's matter: therefore there is no king, lord, nor ruler, that asked such things at any magician, or astrologer, or Chaldean.

entries.yo: Ohun ti o tilẹ ṣọwọ́n ni ọba bère, kò si si ẹlomiran ti o le fi i hàn niwaju ọba bikoṣe awọn oriṣa, ibugbe ẹniti kì iṣe ninu ẹran-ara.
entries.en: And it is a rare thing that the king requireth, and there is none other that can shew it before the king, except the gods, whose dwelling is not with flesh.

entries.yo: Nitori ọ̀ran yi ni inu ọba fi bajẹ, o si binu gidigidi, o si paṣẹ pe ki nwọn ki o pa gbogbo awọn amoye Babeli run.
entries.en: For this cause the king was angry and very furious, and commanded to destroy all the wise men of Babylon.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni aṣẹ jade lọ pe, ki nwọn ki o pa awọn amoye; nwọn si nwá Danieli pẹlu awọn ẹgbẹ́ rẹ̀ lati pa wọn.
entries.en: And the decree went forth that the wise men should be slain; and they sought Daniel and his fellows to be slain.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Danieli fi ìmọ ati ọgbọ́n dahùn wi fun Arioku, ti iṣe balogun ẹṣọ ọba, ẹniti nlọ pa awọn amoye Babeli.
entries.en: Then Daniel answered with counsel and wisdom to Arioch the captain of the king's guard, which was gone forth to slay the wise men of Babylon:

entries.yo: O dahùn o si wi fun Arioku, balogun ọba pe, Ẽṣe ti aṣẹ fi yá kánkán lati ọdọ ọba wá bẹ̃? Nigbana ni Arioku fi nkan na hàn fun Danieli.
entries.en: He answered and said to Arioch the king's captain, Why is the decree so hasty from the king? Then Arioch made the thing known to Daniel.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Danieli wọle lọ, o si bère lọwọ ọba pe, ki o fi akokò fun on, o si wipe, on o fi itumọ rẹ̀ hàn fun ọba.
entries.en: Then Daniel went in, and desired of the king that he would give him time, and that he would shew the king the interpretation.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Danieli lọ si ile rẹ̀, o si fi nkan na hàn fun Hananiah, Miṣaeli, ati Asariah, awọn ẹgbẹ́ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Then Daniel went to his house, and made the thing known to Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah, his companions:

entries.yo: Pe, ki nwọn ki o bère ãnu lọwọ Ọlọrun, Oluwa ọrun, nitori aṣiri yi: ki Danieli ati awọn ẹgbẹ rẹ̀ má ba ṣegbe pẹlu awọn ọlọgbọ́n Babeli iyokù, ti o wà ni Babeli.
entries.en: That they would desire mercies of the God of heaven concerning this secret; that Daniel and his fellows should not perish with the rest of the wise men of Babylon.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni a fi aṣiri na hàn fun Danieli ni iran li oru, Danieli si fi ibukún fun Ọlọrun, Oluwa ọrun.
entries.en: Then was the secret revealed unto Daniel in a night vision. Then Daniel blessed the God of heaven.

entries.yo: Danieli dahùn o si wipe, Olubukún ni orukọ Ọlọrun titi lai; nitori tirẹ̀ li ọgbọ́n ati agbara.
entries.en: Daniel answered and said, Blessed be the name of God for ever and ever: for wisdom and might are his:

entries.yo: O si nyi ìgba ati akokò pada: o nmu ọba kuro, o si ngbe ọba leke: o si nfi ọgbọ́n fun awọn ọlọgbọ́n, ati ìmọ fun awọn ti o mọ̀ oye:
entries.en: And he changeth the times and the seasons: he removeth kings, and setteth up kings: he giveth wisdom unto the wise, and knowledge to them that know understanding:

entries.yo: O fi ohun ijinlẹ ati aṣiri hàn: o mọ̀ ohun ti o wà li òkunkun, lọdọ rẹ̀ ni imọlẹ si wà.
entries.en: He revealeth the deep and secret things: he knoweth what is in the darkness, and the light dwelleth with him.

entries.yo: Mo dupẹ lọwọ rẹ, mo si fi iyìn fun ọ, iwọ Ọlọrun awọn baba mi, ẹniti o fi ọgbọ́n ati agbara fun mi, ti o si fi ohun ti awa bère lọwọ rẹ hàn fun mi nisisiyi: nitoriti iwọ fi ọ̀ran ọba hàn fun wa nisisiyi.
entries.en: I thank thee, and praise thee, O thou God of my fathers, who hast given me wisdom and might, and hast made known unto me now what we desired of thee: for thou hast now made known unto us the king's matter.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Danieli wọle tọ Arioku lọ, ẹniti ọba yàn lati pa awọn ọlọgbọ́n Babeli run, o si lọ, o si wi fun u bayi pe; Máṣe pa awọn ọlọgbọ́n Babeli run: mu mi lọ siwaju ọba, emi o si fi itumọ na hàn fun ọba.
entries.en: Therefore Daniel went in unto Arioch, whom the king had ordained to destroy the wise men of Babylon: he went and said thus unto him; Destroy not the wise men of Babylon: bring me in before the king, and I will shew unto the king the interpretation.

entries.yo: Nigbana li Arioku yara mu Danieli lọ siwaju ọba, o si wi bayi fun u pe, Mo ri ọkunrin kan ninu awọn ọmọ igbekun Juda, ẹniti yio fi itumọ na hàn fun ọba.
entries.en: Then Arioch brought in Daniel before the king in haste and said thus unto him, I have found a man of the captives of Judah, that will make known unto the king the interpretation.

entries.yo: Ọba dahùn o si wi fun Danieli, orukọ ẹniti ijẹ Belteṣassari pe, Iwọ le fi alá ti mo la hàn fun mi, ati itumọ rẹ̀ pẹlu?
entries.en: The king answered and said to Daniel, whose name was Belteshazzar, Art thou able to make known unto me the dream which I have seen, and the interpretation thereof?

entries.yo: Danieli si dahùn niwaju ọba, o si wipe, Aṣiri ti ọba mbère, awọn ọlọgbọ́n, awọn oṣó, awọn amoye, ati awọn alafọṣẹ, kò le fi hàn fun ọba.
entries.en: Daniel answered in the presence of the king, and said, The secret which the king hath demanded cannot the wise men, the astrologers, the magicians, the soothsayers, shew unto the king;

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Ọlọrun kan mbẹ li ọrun ti o nfi aṣiri hàn, ẹniti o si fi hàn fun Nebukadnessari ohun ti mbọ wá ṣe ni ikẹhin ọjọ. Alá rẹ, ati iran ori rẹ lori akete rẹ, ni wọnyi;
entries.en: But there is a God in heaven that revealeth secrets, and maketh known to the king Nebuchadnezzar what shall be in the latter days. Thy dream, and the visions of thy head upon thy bed, are these;

entries.yo: Ọba, iwọ nronu lori akete rẹ, ohun ti yio ṣe lẹhin ọla, ati ẹniti o nfi aṣiri hàn funni mu ọ mọ̀ ohun ti mbọ wá ṣe.
entries.en: As for thee, O king, thy thoughts came into thy mind upon thy bed, what should come to pass hereafter: and he that revealeth secrets maketh known to thee what shall come to pass.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi o ṣe temi ni, a kò fi aṣiri yi hàn fun mi nitori ọgbọ́n ti emi ni jù ẹni alãye kan lọ, ṣugbọn nitori ki a le fi itumọ na hàn fun ọba, ati ki iwọ ki o le mọ̀ èro ọkàn rẹ.
entries.en: But as for me, this secret is not revealed to me for any wisdom that I have more than any living, but for their sakes that shall make known the interpretation to the king, and that thou mightest know the thoughts of thy heart.

entries.yo: Iwọ ọba nwò, si kiyesi, ere nla kan. Ere giga yi, ti didan rẹ̀ pọ̀ gidigidi, o duro niwaju rẹ, ìrí rẹ̀ si ba ni lẹ̀ru gidigidi.
entries.en: Thou, O king, sawest, and behold a great image. This great image, whose brightness was excellent, stood before thee; and the form thereof was terrible.

entries.yo: Eyi ni ere na; ori rẹ̀ jẹ wura daradara, aiya ati apa rẹ̀ jẹ fadaka, inu ati ẹ̀gbẹ rẹ̀ jẹ idẹ,
entries.en: This image's head was of fine gold, his breast and his arms of silver, his belly and his thighs of brass,

entries.yo: Itan rẹ̀ jẹ irin, ẹsẹ rẹ̀ si jẹ apakan irin, apakan amọ̀.
entries.en: His legs of iron, his feet part of iron and part of clay.

entries.yo: Iwọ ri titi okuta kan fi wá laisi ọwọ, o si kọlu ere na lẹsẹ rẹ̀, ti iṣe ti irin ati amọ̀, o si fọ́ wọn tũtu.
entries.en: Thou sawest till that a stone was cut out without hands, which smote the image upon his feet that were of iron and clay, and brake them to pieces.

entries.yo: Nigbana li a si fọ irin, amọ̀, idẹ, fadaka ati wura pọ̀ tũtu, o si dabi iyangbo ipaka nigba ẹ̀run; afẹfẹ si gbá wọn lọ, ti a kò si ri ibi kan fun wọn mọ́: okuta ti o si fọ ere na si di òke nla, o si kún gbogbo aiye.
entries.en: Then was the iron, the clay, the brass, the silver, and the gold, broken to pieces together, and became like the chaff of the summer threshingfloors; and the wind carried them away, that no place was found for them: and the stone that smote the image became a great mountain, and filled the whole earth.

entries.yo: Eyiyi li alá na; awa o si sọ itumọ rẹ̀ pẹlu niwaju ọba.
entries.en: This is the dream; and we will tell the interpretation thereof before the king.

entries.yo: Iwọ ọba, li ọba awọn ọba: nitori Ọlọrun ọrun ti fi ijọba, agbara, ati ipá, ati ogo fun ọ.
entries.en: Thou, O king, art a king of kings: for the God of heaven hath given thee a kingdom, power, and strength, and glory.

entries.yo: Ati nibikibi ti ọmọ enia wà, ẹranko igbẹ ati ẹiyẹ oju-ọrun li o si fi le ọ lọwọ, o si ti fi ọ ṣe alakoso lori gbogbo wọn. Iwọ li ori wura yi.
entries.en: And wheresoever the children of men dwell, the beasts of the field and the fowls of the heaven hath he given into thine hand, and hath made thee ruler over them all. Thou art this head of gold.

entries.yo: Lẹhin rẹ ni ijọba miran yio si dide ti yio rẹ̀hin jù ọ, ati ijọba kẹta miran ti iṣe ti idẹ, ti yio si ṣe alakoso lori gbogbo aiye.
entries.en: And after thee shall arise another kingdom inferior to thee, and another third kingdom of brass, which shall bear rule over all the earth.

entries.yo: Ijọba kẹrin yio si le bi irin; gẹgẹ bi irin ti ifọ tũtu, ti si iṣẹgun ohun gbogbo: ati gẹgẹ bi irin na ti o fọ gbogbo wọnyi, bẹ̃ni yio si fọ tũtu ti yio si lọ̀ wọn kunna.
entries.en: And the fourth kingdom shall be strong as iron: forasmuch as iron breaketh in pieces and subdueth all things: and as iron that breaketh all these, shall it break in pieces and bruise.

entries.yo: Ati gẹgẹ bi iwọ ti ri ẹsẹ ati ọmọkasẹ ti o jẹ apakan amọ̀ amọkoko, ati apakan irin, ni ijọba na yio yà si ara rẹ̀; ṣugbọn ipá ti irin yio wà ninu rẹ̀, niwọn bi iwọ ti ri irin ti o dapọ mọ amọ̀.
entries.en: And whereas thou sawest the feet and toes, part of potters' clay, and part of iron, the kingdom shall be divided; but there shall be in it of the strength of the iron, forasmuch as thou sawest the iron mixed with miry clay.

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi ọmọkasẹ na ti jẹ apakan irin ati apakan amọ̀, bẹ̃li apakan ijọba na yio lagbara, apakan yio si jẹ ohun fifọ.
entries.en: And as the toes of the feet were part of iron, and part of clay, so the kingdom shall be partly strong, and partly broken.

entries.yo: Ati gẹgẹ bi iwọ si ti ri irin ti o dapọ mọ amọ̀, nwọn o da ara wọn pọ mọ iru-ọmọ enia, ṣugbọn nwọn kì yio fi ara wọn mọ ara wọn, gẹgẹ bi irin kì ti idapọ mọ amọ̀.
entries.en: And whereas thou sawest iron mixed with miry clay, they shall mingle themselves with the seed of men: but they shall not cleave one to another, even as iron is not mixed with clay.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ awọn ọba wọnyi li Ọlọrun ọrun yio gbe ijọba kan kalẹ, eyi ti a kì yio le parun titi lai: a kì yio si fi ijọba na le orilẹ-ède miran lọwọ, yio si fọ tutu, yio si pa gbogbo ijọba wọnyi run, ṣugbọn on o duro titi lailai.
entries.en: And in the days of these kings shall the God of heaven set up a kingdom, which shall never be destroyed: and the kingdom shall not be left to other people, but it shall break in pieces and consume all these kingdoms, and it shall stand for ever.

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi iwọ si ti ri ti okuta na wá laisi ọwọ lati òke wá, ti o si fọ irin, idẹ, amọ̀, fadaka ati wura wọnni tutu; Ọlọrun titobi ti fi hàn fun ọba, ohun ti mbọ wá ṣe lẹhin ọla: otitọ si li alá na, itumọ rẹ̀ si daju.
entries.en: Forasmuch as thou sawest that the stone was cut out of the mountain without hands, and that it brake in pieces the iron, the brass, the clay, the silver, and the gold; the great God hath made known to the king what shall come to pass hereafter: and the dream is certain, and the interpretation thereof sure.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Nebukadnessari, ọba, wolẹ o si doju rẹ̀ bolẹ, o si fi ori balẹ fun Danieli, o si paṣẹ pe ki nwọn ki o ṣe ẹbọ-ọrẹ ati õrùn didùn fun u.
entries.en: Then the king Nebuchadnezzar fell upon his face, and worshipped Daniel, and commanded that they should offer an oblation and sweet odours unto him.

entries.yo: Ọba da Danieli lohùn, o si wipe, Lõtọ ni, pe Ọlọrun nyin li Ọlọrun awọn ọlọrun ati Oluwa awọn ọba, ati olufihàn gbogbo aṣiri, nitori ti iwọ le fi aṣiri yi hàn.
entries.en: The king answered unto Daniel, and said, Of a truth it is, that your God is a God of gods, and a Lord of kings, and a revealer of secrets, seeing thou couldest reveal this secret.

entries.yo: Nigbana li ọba sọ Danieli di ẹni-nla, o si fun u li ẹ̀bun nla pupọ, o si fi i jẹ olori gbogbo igberiko Babeli, ati olori onitọju gbogbo awọn ọlọgbọ́n Babeli.
entries.en: Then the king made Daniel a great man, and gave him many great gifts, and made him ruler over the whole province of Babylon, and chief of the governors over all the wise men of Babylon.

entries.yo: Danieli si bère lọwọ ọba, o si fi Ṣadraki, Meṣaki, ati Abednego jẹ olori ọ̀ran igberiko Babeli; ṣugbọn Danieli joko li ẹnu-ọ̀na ãfin ọba.
entries.en: Then Daniel requested of the king, and he set Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, over the affairs of the province of Babylon: but Daniel sat in the gate of the king.

entries.yo: NEBUKADNESSARI ọba, si yá ere wura kan, eyi ti giga rẹ̀ jẹ ọgọta igbọnwọ, ati ibú rẹ̀ jẹ igbọnwọ mẹfa: o si gbé e kalẹ ni pẹtẹlẹ Dura, ni igberiko Babeli.
entries.en: Nebuchadnezzar the king made an image of gold, whose height was threescore cubits, and the breadth thereof six cubits: he set it up in the plain of Dura, in the province of Babylon.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Nebukadnessari ọba, ranṣẹ lọ ipè awọn ọmọ-alade, awọn bãlẹ, ati awọn balogun, awọn onidajọ, awọn oluṣọ iṣura, awọn ìgbimọ, ati awọn ijoye, ati gbogbo awọn olori igberiko, lati wá si iyasi-mimọ́ ere ti Nebukadnessari ọba, gbé kalẹ.
entries.en: Then Nebuchadnezzar the king sent to gather together the princes, the governors, and the captains, the judges, the treasurers, the counsellers, the sheriffs, and all the rulers of the provinces, to come to the dedication of the image which Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up.

entries.yo: Nigbana li awọn ọmọ-alade, awọn bãlẹ, ati awọn balogun, awọn onidajọ, awọn oluṣọ iṣura, awọn ìgbimọ, awọn ijoye, ati gbogbo awọn olori igberiko pejọ si iyasi-mimọ́ ere ti Nebukadnessari gbe kalẹ, nwọn si duro niwaju ere ti Nebukadnessari gbé kalẹ.
entries.en: Then the princes, the governors, and captains, the judges, the treasurers, the counsellers, the sheriffs, and all the rulers of the provinces, were gathered together unto the dedication of the image that Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up; and they stood before the image that Nebuchadnezzar had set up.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni akede kigbe soke pe, A pa a laṣẹ fun nyin, ẹnyin enia, orilẹ, ati ède gbogbo,
entries.en: Then an herald cried aloud, To you it is commanded, O people, nations, and languages,

entries.yo: Pe, akokò ki akokò ti ẹnyin ba gbọ́ ohùn ipè, fère, duru, ìlu, orin, katè, ati oniruru orin, ki ẹnyin wolẹ, ki ẹ si tẹriba fun ere wura ti Nebukadnessari ọba gbé kalẹ.
entries.en: That at what time ye hear the sound of the cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, dulcimer, and all kinds of musick, ye fall down and worship the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar the king hath set up:

entries.yo: Ẹniti kò ba si wolẹ̀, ki o si tẹriba, lojukanna li a o gbé e sọ si ãrin iná ileru ti njo.
entries.en: And whoso falleth not down and worshippeth shall the same hour be cast into the midst of a burning fiery furnace.

entries.yo: Nitorina, lakokò na nigbati gbogbo enia gbọ́ ohùn ipè, fère, duru, ìlu, orin, ati oniruru orin gbogbo, gbogbo enia, orilẹ, ati ède wolẹ, nwọn si tẹriba fun ere wura na ti Nebukadnessari ọba gbé kalẹ.
entries.en: Therefore at that time, when all the people heard the sound of the cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, and all kinds of musick, all the people, the nations, and the languages, fell down and worshipped the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up.

entries.yo: Lakokò na ni awọn ọkunrin ara Kaldea kan wá, nwọn si fi awọn ara Juda sùn.
entries.en: Wherefore at that time certain Chaldeans came near, and accused the Jews.

entries.yo: Nwọn dahùn, nwọn si wi fun Nebukadnessari ọba, pe, Ki ọba ki o pẹ́.
entries.en: They spake and said to the king Nebuchadnezzar, O king, live for ever.

entries.yo: Iwọ ọba ti paṣẹ pe, bi ẹnikẹni ba ti gbọ́ ohùn ipè, fère, duru, ìlu, orin, katè, ati oniruru orin, ki o wolẹ ki o si tẹriba fun ere wura na.
entries.en: Thou, O king, hast made a decree, that every man that shall hear the sound of the cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, and dulcimer, and all kinds of musick, shall fall down and worship the golden image:

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni ti kò ba si wolẹ ki o tẹriba, ki a gbé e sọ si ãrin iná ileru ti njo.
entries.en: And whoso falleth not down and worshippeth, that he should be cast into the midst of a burning fiery furnace.

entries.yo: Awọn ara Juda kan wà, Ṣadraki, Meṣaki, ati Abednego ti iwọ fi ṣe olori ọ̀ran igberiko Babeli: Ọba, awọn ọkunrin wọnyi kò kà ọ si, nwọn kò sìn oriṣa rẹ, nwọn kò si tẹriba fun ere wura ti iwọ gbé kalẹ.
entries.en: There are certain Jews whom thou hast set over the affairs of the province of Babylon, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego; these men, O king, have not regarded thee: they serve not thy gods, nor worship the golden image which thou hast set up.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Nebukadnessari ọba paṣẹ ni ibinu ati irunu rẹ̀, pe, ki nwọn ki o mu Ṣadraki, Meṣaki, ati Abednego wá. Nigbana ni a si mu awọn ọkunrin wọnyi wá siwaju ọba.
entries.en: Then Nebuchadnezzar in his rage and fury commanded to bring Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego. Then they brought these men before the king.

entries.yo: Nebukadnessari dahùn, o si wi fun wọn pe, otitọ ha ni, Ṣadraki, Meṣaki, ati Abednego, pe, ẹnyin kò sìn oriṣa mi, ẹ kò si tẹriba fun ere wura na ti mo gbé kalẹ?
entries.en: Nebuchadnezzar spake and said unto them, Is it true, O Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, do not ye serve my gods, nor worship the golden image which I have set up?

entries.yo: Njẹ bi ẹnyin ba mura pe, li akokò ti o wù ki o ṣe ti ẹnyin ba gbọ́ ohùn ipè, fère, duru, ìlu, orin, katè, ati oniruru orin, ti ẹ ba wolẹ ti ẹ ba si tẹriba fun ere wura ti mo yá, yio ṣe gẹgẹ; ṣugbọn bi ẹnyin kò ba tẹriba, a o gbé nyin ni wakati kanna sọ si ãrin iná ileru ti njo; ta li Ọlọrun na ti yio si gbà nyin kuro li ọwọ mi.
entries.en: Now if ye be ready that at what time ye hear the sound of the cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, and dulcimer, and all kinds of musick, ye fall down and worship the image which I have made; well: but if ye worship not, ye shall be cast the same hour into the midst of a burning fiery furnace; and who is that God that shall deliver you out of my hands?

entries.yo: Ṣadraki, Meṣaki, ati Abednego dahùn, nwọn si wi fun ọba pe, Nebukadnessari, kò tọ si wa lati fi èsi kan fun ọ nitori ọ̀ran yi.
entries.en: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, answered and said to the king, O Nebuchadnezzar, we are not careful to answer thee in this matter.

entries.yo: Bi o ba ri bẹ̃, Ọlọrun wa ti awa nsìn, le gbà wa lọwọ iná ileru na ti njo, on o si gbà wa lọwọ rẹ, ọba.
entries.en: If it be so, our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace, and he will deliver us out of thine hand, O king.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi bẹ̃kọ, ki o ye ọ, ọba pe, awa kì yio sìn oriṣa rẹ, bẹ̃li awa kì yio si tẹriba fun ere wura ti iwọ gbé kalẹ.
entries.en: But if not, be it known unto thee, O king, that we will not serve thy gods, nor worship the golden image which thou hast set up.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Nebukadnessari kún fun ibinu, àwọ oju rẹ̀ si yipada si Ṣadraki, Meṣaki, ati Abednego: o dahùn, o si paṣẹ pe, ki nwọn ki o da iná ileru na ki õru rẹ̀ gboná niwọn igba meje jù bi a ti imu u gboná ri lọ.
entries.en: Then was Nebuchadnezzar full of fury, and the form of his visage was changed against Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego: therefore he spake, and commanded that they should heat the furnace one seven times more than it was wont to be heated.

entries.yo: O si paṣẹ fun awọn ọkunrin ani awọn alagbara julọ ninu ogun rẹ̀ pe ki nwọn ki o di Ṣadraki, Meṣaki, ati Abednego, ki nwọn ki o si sọ wọn sinu iná ileru na ti njo.
entries.en: And he commanded the most mighty men that were in his army to bind Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, and to cast them into the burning fiery furnace.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni a dè awọn ọkunrin wọnyi ti awọn ti agbáda, ṣokoto, ati ibori wọn, ati ẹwu wọn miran, a si gbé wọn sọ si ãrin iná ileru ti njo.
entries.en: Then these men were bound in their coats, their hosen, and their hats, and their other garments, and were cast into the midst of the burning fiery furnace.

entries.yo: Nitorina bi aṣẹ ọba ti le to, ati bi ileru na si ti gboná gidigidi to, ọwọ iná na si pa awọn ọkunrin ti o gbé Ṣadraki, Meṣaki, ati Abednego, lọ.
entries.en: Therefore because the king's commandment was urgent, and the furnace exceeding hot, the flame of the fire slew those men that took up Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn ọkunrin mẹtẹta wọnyi, Ṣadraki, Meṣaki, ati Abednego, ṣubu lulẹ ni didè si ãrin iná ileru ti njo.
entries.en: And these three men, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, fell down bound into the midst of the burning fiery furnace.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Nebukadnessari ọba warìri o si dide duro lọgan, o dahùn, o si wi fun awọn ìgbimọ rẹ̀ pe, awọn ọkunrin mẹta kọ a gbé sọ si ãrin iná ni didè? Nwọn si dahùn wi fun ọba pe, Lõtọ ni ọba.
entries.en: Then Nebuchadnezzar the king was astonied, and rose up in haste, and spake, and said unto his counsellers, Did not we cast three men bound into the midst of the fire? They answered and said unto the king, True, O king.

entries.yo: O si dahùn wipe, Wò o, mo ri ọkunrin mẹrin ni titu, nwọn sì nrin lãrin iná, nwọn kò si farapa, ìrisi ẹnikẹrin si dabi ti Ọmọ Ọlọrun.
entries.en: He answered and said, Lo, I see four men loose, walking in the midst of the fire, and they have no hurt; and the form of the fourth is like the Son of God.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Nebukadnessari sunmọ ẹnu-ọ̀na ileru na o dahùn o si wipe, Ṣadraki, Meṣaki, ati Abednego, ẹnyin iranṣẹ Ọlọrun Ọga-ogo, ẹ jade ki ẹ si wá. Nigbana ni Ṣadraki, Meṣaki, ati Abednego, jade lati ãrin iná na wá.
entries.en: Then Nebuchadnezzar came near to the mouth of the burning fiery furnace, and spake, and said, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, ye servants of the most high God, come forth, and come hither. Then Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, came forth of the midst of the fire.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni awọn ọmọ-alade, bãlẹ, balogun, ati awọn ìgbimọ ọba ti o pejọ ri pe iná kò lagbara lara awọn ọkunrin wọnyi, bẹ̃ni irun ori wọn kan kò jona, bẹ̃li aṣọ wọn kò si pada, õrùn iná kò tilẹ kọja lara wọn.
entries.en: And the princes, governors, and captains, and the king's counsellers, being gathered together, saw these men, upon whose bodies the fire had no power, nor was an hair of their head singed, neither were their coats changed, nor the smell of fire had passed on them.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Nebukadnessari dahùn o si wipe, Olubukún li Ọlọrun Ṣadraki, Meṣaki, ati Abednego, ẹniti o rán angeli rẹ̀ ti o si gbà awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀ la, ti o gbẹkẹ le e, nwọn si pa ọ̀rọ ọba da, nwọn si fi ara wọn jìn, ki nwọn ki o má ṣe sìn, tabi ki nwọn ki o tẹriba fun oriṣakoriṣa bikoṣe Ọlọrun ti awọn tikarawọn.
entries.en: Then Nebuchadnezzar spake, and said, Blessed be the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, who hath sent his angel, and delivered his servants that trusted in him, and have changed the king's word, and yielded their bodies, that they might not serve nor worship any god, except their own God.

entries.yo: Nitorina, emi paṣẹ pe, olukulùku enia, orilẹ, ati ède, ti o ba sọ ọ̀rọ odi si Ọlọrun Ṣadraki, Meṣaki, ati Abednego, a o ke e wẹwẹ, a o si sọ ile rẹ̀ di àtan: nitori kò si Ọlọrun miran ti o le gbà ni là bi iru eyi.
entries.en: Therefore I make a decree, That every people, nation, and language, which speak any thing amiss against the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, shall be cut in pieces, and their houses shall be made a dunghill: because there is no other God that can deliver after this sort.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ọba gbé Ṣadraki, Meṣaki, ati Abednego leke ni igberiko Babeli.
entries.en: Then the king promoted Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, in the province of Babylon.

entries.yo: NEBUKADNESSARI ọba, si gbogbo enia, orilẹ, ati ède, ti o ngbe gbogbo agbaiye; ki alafia ki o ma pọ̀ si i fun nyin.
entries.en: Nebuchadnezzar the king, unto all people, nations, and languages, that dwell in all the earth; Peace be multiplied unto you.

entries.yo: O tọ loju mi lati fi àmi ati iṣẹ iyanu ti Ọlọrun, Ọga-ogo, ti ṣe si mi hàn.
entries.en: I thought it good to shew the signs and wonders that the high God hath wrought toward me.

entries.yo: Ami rẹ̀ ti tobi to! agbara iṣẹ iyanu rẹ̀ ti pọ̀ to! ijọba ainipẹkun ni ijọba rẹ̀, ati agbara ijọba rẹ̀ ati irandiran ni.
entries.en: How great are his signs! and how mighty are his wonders! his kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and his dominion is from generation to generation.

entries.yo: Emi Nebukadnessari wà li alafia ni ile mi, mo si ngbilẹ li ãfin mi:
entries.en: I Nebuchadnezzar was at rest in mine house, and flourishing in my palace:

entries.yo: Mo si lá alá kan ti o dẹ̀ruba mi, ati ìro ọkàn mi lori akete mi, ati iran ori mi dãmu mi.
entries.en: I saw a dream which made me afraid, and the thoughts upon my bed and the visions of my head troubled me.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni mo ṣe paṣẹ lati mu gbogbo awọn ọlọgbọ́n Babeli wá niwaju mi, ki nwọn ki o le fi itumọ alá na hàn fun mi.
entries.en: Therefore made I a decree to bring in all the wise men of Babylon before me, that they might make known unto me the interpretation of the dream.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni awọn amoye, ọlọgbọ́n, awọn Kaldea, ati awọn alafọṣẹ wá siwaju mi: emi si rọ́ alá na fun wọn, ṣugbọn nwọn kò le fi ìtumọ rẹ̀ hàn fun mi.
entries.en: Then came in the magicians, the astrologers, the Chaldeans, and the soothsayers: and I told the dream before them; but they did not make known unto me the interpretation thereof.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nikẹhin ni Danieli wá siwaju mi, orukọ ẹniti ijẹ Belteṣassari, gẹgẹ bi orukọ oriṣa mi, ati ninu ẹniti ẹmi Ọlọrun mimọ́ wà: mo si rọ́ alá na fun u pe,
entries.en: But at the last Daniel came in before me, whose name was Belteshazzar, according to the name of my god, and in whom is the spirit of the holy gods: and before him I told the dream, saying,

entries.yo: Belteṣassari, olori awọn amoye, nitoriti mo mọ̀ pe ẹmi Ọlọrun mimọ mbẹ ninu rẹ, kò si si aṣiri kan ti o ṣoro fun ọ, sọ iran alá ti mo lá fun mi, ati itumọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: O Belteshazzar, master of the magicians, because I know that the spirit of the holy gods is in thee, and no secret troubleth thee, tell me the visions of my dream that I have seen, and the interpretation thereof.

entries.yo: Bayi ni iran ori mi lori akete mi; mo ri, si kiyesi i, igi kan duro li arin aiye, giga rẹ̀ si pọ̀ gidigidi.
entries.en: Thus were the visions of mine head in my bed; I saw, and behold a tree in the midst of the earth, and the height thereof was great.

entries.yo: Igi na si dagba, o si lagbara, giga rẹ̀ si kan ọrun, a si ri i titi de gbogbo opin aiye.
entries.en: The tree grew, and was strong, and the height thereof reached unto heaven, and the sight thereof to the end of all the earth:

entries.yo: Ewe rẹ̀ lẹwa, eso rẹ̀ si pọ̀, lara rẹ̀ li onjẹ wà fun gbogbo aiye: abẹ rẹ̀ jẹ iboji fun awọn ẹranko igbẹ, ati lori ẹka rẹ̀ li awọn ẹiyẹ oju-ọrun ngbe, ati lati ọdọ rẹ̀ li a si ti mbọ gbogbo ẹran-ara.
entries.en: The leaves thereof were fair, and the fruit thereof much, and in it was meat for all: the beasts of the field had shadow under it, and the fowls of the heaven dwelt in the boughs thereof, and all flesh was fed of it.

entries.yo: Mo ri ninu iran ori mi lori akete mi, si kiye si i, oluṣọ, ani ẹni mimọ́ kan sọkalẹ lati ọrun wá;
entries.en: I saw in the visions of my head upon my bed, and, behold, a watcher and an holy one came down from heaven;

entries.yo: O kigbe li ohùn rara, o si wi bayi pe, Ke igi na lulẹ, ki o si ke awọn ẹka rẹ̀ kuro, gbọ̀n ewe rẹ̀ danu; ki o si fọn eso rẹ̀ ka, jẹ ki awọn ẹranko igbẹ kuro labẹ rẹ̀, ki awọn ẹiyẹ si kuro lori ẹka rẹ̀:
entries.en: He cried aloud, and said thus, Hew down the tree, and cut off his branches, shake off his leaves, and scatter his fruit: let the beasts get away from under it, and the fowls from his branches:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn, fi kukute gbòngbo rẹ̀ silẹ ninu ilẹ, ani pẹlu ide ninu irin ati idẹ ninu koriko tutu igbẹ; si jẹ ki ìri ọrun sẹ̀ si i lara, ki o si ni ipin rẹ̀ ninu koriko ilẹ aiye pẹlu awọn ẹranko:
entries.en: Nevertheless leave the stump of his roots in the earth, even with a band of iron and brass, in the tender grass of the field; and let it be wet with the dew of heaven, and let his portion be with the beasts in the grass of the earth:

entries.yo: Ki a si pa aiya rẹ̀ da kuro ni ti enia, ki a si fi aiya ẹranko fun u, ki igba meje ki o si kọja lori rẹ̀.
entries.en: Let his heart be changed from man's, and let a beast's heart be given unto him; and let seven times pass over him.

entries.yo: Nipa ọ̀rọ lati ọdọ awọn oluṣọ li ọ̀ran yi, ati aṣẹ nipa ọ̀rọ awọn ẹni mimọ́ nì; nitori ki awọn alàye ki o le mọ̀ pe Ọga-ogo li o nṣe olori ni ijọba enia, on a si fi fun ẹnikẹni ti o wù u, on a si gbé onirẹlẹ julọ leke lori rẹ̀.
entries.en: This matter is by the decree of the watchers, and the demand by the word of the holy ones: to the intent that the living may know that the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men, and giveth it to whomsoever he will, and setteth up over it the basest of men.

entries.yo: Alá yi li emi Nebukadnessari lá, njẹ nisisiyi, iwọ Belteṣassari, sọ itumọ rẹ̀ fun mi, bi gbogbo awọn ọlọgbọ́n ijọba mi kò ti le fi itumọ rẹ̀ hàn fun mi: ṣugbọn iwọ le ṣe e; nitori ẹmi Ọlọrun mimọ́ mbẹ lara rẹ.
entries.en: This dream I king Nebuchadnezzar have seen. Now thou, O Belteshazzar, declare the interpretation thereof, forasmuch as all the wise men of my kingdom are not able to make known unto me the interpretation: but thou art able; for the spirit of the holy gods is in thee.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Danieli, ẹniti a npè ni Belteṣassari wà ni ìwariri niwọn wakati kan, ìro-inu rẹ̀ si dãmu rẹ̀. Ọba si dahùn wipe, Belteṣassari, máṣe jẹ ki alá na, tabi itumọ rẹ̀ ki o dãmu rẹ̀. Belteṣassari si dahùn wipe, oluwa mi! ti awọn ẹniti o korira rẹ li alá yi, ki itumọ rẹ̀ ki o si jẹ ti awọn ọta rẹ.
entries.en: Then Daniel, whose name was Belteshazzar, was astonied for one hour, and his thoughts troubled him. The king spake, and said, Belteshazzar, let not the dream, or the interpretation thereof, trouble thee. Belteshazzar answered and said, My lord, the dream be to them that hate thee, and the interpretation thereof to thine enemies.

entries.yo: Igi ti iwọ ri ti o si dagba, ti o si lagbara, eyi ti giga rẹ̀ kan ọrun, ti a si ri i de gbogbo aiye;
entries.en: The tree that thou sawest, which grew, and was strong, whose height reached unto the heaven, and the sight thereof to all the earth;

entries.yo: Eyi ti ewe rẹ̀ lẹwà, ti eso rẹ̀ si pọ̀, ninu eyi ti onjẹ si wà fun gbogbo ẹda, labẹ eyi ti awọn ẹranko igbẹ ngbe, lori ẹka eyi ti awọn ẹiyẹ oju-ọrun ni ibugbe wọn.
entries.en: Whose leaves were fair, and the fruit thereof much, and in it was meat for all; under which the beasts of the field dwelt, and upon whose branches the fowls of the heaven had their habitation:

entries.yo: Ọba, iwọ ni ẹniti o dagba, ti o si di alagbara: nitori titobi rẹ ga o si kan ọrun, agbara ijọba rẹ si de opin aiye.
entries.en: It is thou, O king, that art grown and become strong: for thy greatness is grown, and reacheth unto heaven, and thy dominion to the end of the earth.

entries.yo: Ati gẹgẹ bi ọba si ti ri oluṣọ́ kan ani ẹni mimọ́ ti o sọkalẹ lati ọrun wá, ti o si wipe, Ke igi na lulẹ, ki o si pa a run: ṣugbọn fi kukute gbòngbo rẹ̀ silẹ lãye, ani ti on ti ìde irin ati ti idẹ, ninu koriko tutu igbẹ; ki a si jẹ ki ìri ọrun sẹ̀ si i lara, ki ipin rẹ̀ si wà pẹlu awọn ẹranko igbẹ, titi ìgba meje yio fi kọja lori rẹ̀,
entries.en: And whereas the king saw a watcher and an holy one coming down from heaven, and saying, Hew the tree down, and destroy it; yet leave the stump of the roots thereof in the earth, even with a band of iron and brass, in the tender grass of the field; and let it be wet with the dew of heaven, and let his portion be with the beasts of the field, till seven times pass over him;

entries.yo: Ọba, itumọ rẹ̀ li eyi, ati eyiyi li aṣẹ Ọga-ogo, ti o wá sori ọba, oluwa mi:
entries.en: This is the interpretation, O king, and this is the decree of the most High, which is come upon my lord the king:

entries.yo: Nwọn o le ọ kuro larin enia, ibugbe rẹ yio si wà pẹlu awọn ẹranko igbẹ nwọn o si mu ki iwọ ki o jẹ koriko bi malu, nwọn o si mu ki iri ọrun sẹ̀ si ọ lara, igba meje yio si kọja lori rẹ, titi iwọ o fi mọ̀ pe Ọga-ogo ni iṣe olori ni ijọba enia, on a si fi i fun ẹnikẹni ti o wù u.
entries.en: That they shall drive thee from men, and thy dwelling shall be with the beasts of the field, and they shall make thee to eat grass as oxen, and they shall wet thee with the dew of heaven, and seven times shall pass over thee, till thou know that the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men, and giveth it to whomsoever he will.

entries.yo: Ati gẹgẹ bi nwọn si ti paṣẹ pe ki nwọn ki o fi kukute gbòngbo igi na silẹ, ijọba rẹ yio jẹ tirẹ, lẹhin igbati o ba ti mọ̀ pe, ọrun ni iṣe olori.
entries.en: And whereas they commanded to leave the stump of the tree roots; thy kingdom shall be sure unto thee, after that thou shalt have known that the heavens do rule.

entries.yo: Nitorina ọba, jẹ ki ìmọran mi ki o jẹ itẹwọgba lọdọ rẹ, ki o si fi ododo ja ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ kuro, ati aiṣedẽde rẹ nipa fifi ãnu hàn fun awọn talaka; bi yio le mu alafia rẹ pẹ.
entries.en: Wherefore, O king, let my counsel be acceptable unto thee, and break off thy sins by righteousness, and thine iniquities by shewing mercy to the poor; if it may be a lengthening of thy tranquillity.

entries.yo: Gbogbo eyi de ba Nebukadnessari, ọba.
entries.en: All this came upon the king Nebuchadnezzar.

entries.yo: Lẹhin oṣu mejila, o nrin kiri lori ãfin ijọba Babeli.
entries.en: At the end of twelve months he walked in the palace of the kingdom of Babylon.

entries.yo: Ọba si dahùn, o wipe, Ko ṣepe eyi ni Babeli nla, ti emi ti fi lile agbara mi kọ́ ni ile ijọba, ati fun ogo ọlanla mi?
entries.en: The king spake, and said, Is not this great Babylon, that I have built for the house of the kingdom by the might of my power, and for the honour of my majesty?

entries.yo: Bi ọ̀rọ na si ti wà lẹnu ọba, ohùn kan fọ̀ lati ọrun wá, pe, Nebukadnessari, ọba, iwọ li a sọ fun; pe, a gba ijọba kuro lọwọ rẹ.
entries.en: While the word was in the king's mouth, there fell a voice from heaven, saying, O king Nebuchadnezzar, to thee it is spoken; The kingdom is departed from thee.

entries.yo: A o si le ọ kuro larin enia, ibugbe rẹ yio si wà pẹlu awọn ẹranko igbẹ: nwọn o si mu ọ jẹ koriko bi malu, igba meje yio si kọja lori rẹ, titi iwọ o fi mọ̀ pe, Ọga-ogo ni iṣe olori ninu ijọba enia, on a si fi i fun ẹnikẹni ti o wù u.
entries.en: And they shall drive thee from men, and thy dwelling shall be with the beasts of the field: they shall make thee to eat grass as oxen, and seven times shall pass over thee, until thou know that the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men, and giveth it to whomsoever he will.

entries.yo: Ni wakati kanna ni nkan na si ṣẹ si Nebukadnessari, a si le e kuro larin enia, o si jẹ koriko bi malu, a si mu ki ìri ọrun sẹ̀ si i lara, titi irun ori rẹ̀ fi kún gẹgẹ bi iyẹ idì, ẽkana rẹ̀ si dabi ti ẹiyẹ.
entries.en: The same hour was the thing fulfilled upon Nebuchadnezzar: and he was driven from men, and did eat grass as oxen, and his body was wet with the dew of heaven, till his hairs were grown like eagles' feathers, and his nails like birds' claws.

entries.yo: Li opin igba na, Emi Nebukadnessari si gbé oju mi soke si ọrun, oye mi si pada tọ̀ mi wá, emi si fi ibukún fun Ọga-ogo, mo yìn, mo si fi ọla fun ẹniti o wà titi lailai, ẹniti agbara ijọba rẹ̀ jẹ ijọba ainipẹkun, agbara ati ijọba rẹ̀ lati irandiran.
entries.en: And at the end of the days I Nebuchadnezzar lifted up mine eyes unto heaven, and mine understanding returned unto me, and I blessed the most High, and I praised and honoured him that liveth for ever, whose dominion is an everlasting dominion, and his kingdom is from generation to generation:

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn araiye li a si kà si bi ohun asan, on a si ma ṣe gẹgẹ bi o ti wù u ninu ogun ọrun, ati larin awọn araiye: kò si si ẹniti idá ọwọ rẹ̀ duro, tabi ẹniti iwi fun u pe, Kini iwọ nṣe nì?
entries.en: And all the inhabitants of the earth are reputed as nothing: and he doeth according to his will in the army of heaven, and among the inhabitants of the earth: and none can stay his hand, or say unto him, What doest thou?

entries.yo: Lakoko kanna oye mi pada tọ̀ mi wá; ati niti ogo ijọba mi, ọlá ati ogo didan mi si pada wá sọdọ mi: awọn ìgbimọ ati awọn ijoye mi si ṣafẹri mi; a si fi ẹsẹ mi mulẹ ninu ijọba mi, emi si ni ọlanla agbara jù ti iṣaju lọ.
entries.en: At the same time my reason returned unto me; and for the glory of my kingdom, mine honour and brightness returned unto me; and my counsellers and my lords sought unto me; and I was established in my kingdom, and excellent majesty was added unto me.

entries.yo: Nisisiyi, emi Nebukadnessari yìn, mo si gbé Ọba ọrun ga, mo si fi ọlá fun u, ẹniti gbogbo iṣẹ rẹ̀ iṣe otitọ, ati gbogbo ọ̀na rẹ̀ iṣe idajọ: ati awọn ti nrìn ninu igberaga, on le rẹ̀ wọn silẹ.
entries.en: Now I Nebuchadnezzar praise and extol and honour the King of heaven, all whose works are truth, and his ways judgment: and those that walk in pride he is able to abase.

entries.yo: BELṢASSARI, ọba se àse nla fun ẹgbẹrun awọn ijoye rẹ̀, o si nmu ọti-waini niwaju awọn ẹgbẹrun na.
entries.en: Belshazzar the king made a great feast to a thousand of his lords, and drank wine before the thousand.

entries.yo: Bi Belṣassari ti tọ́ ọti-waini na wò, o paṣẹ pe ki nwọn ki o mu ohun-elo wura, ati ti fadaka wá, eyiti Nebukadnessari baba rẹ̀, kó jade lati inu tempili ti o wà ni Jerusalemu wá, ki ọba, ati awọn ijoye rẹ̀, awọn aya rẹ̀, ati awọn àle rẹ̀, ki o le ma muti ninu wọn.
entries.en: Belshazzar, whiles he tasted the wine, commanded to bring the golden and silver vessels which his father Nebuchadnezzar had taken out of the temple which was in Jerusalem; that the king, and his princes, his wives, and his concubines, might drink therein.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni nwọn mu ohun-elo wura ti a ti kó jade lati inu tempili ile Ọlọrun ti o wà ni Jerusalemu wá; ọba, ati awọn ijoye rẹ̀, awọn aya rẹ̀, ati awọn àle rẹ̀, si nmuti ninu wọn.
entries.en: Then they brought the golden vessels that were taken out of the temple of the house of God which was at Jerusalem; and the king, and his princes, his wives, and his concubines, drank in them.

entries.yo: Nwọn nmu ọti-waini, nwọn si nkọrin ìyin si awọn oriṣa wura, ati ti fadaka, ti idẹ, ti irin, ti igi, ati ti okuta.
entries.en: They drank wine, and praised the gods of gold, and of silver, of brass, of iron, of wood, and of stone.

entries.yo: Ni wakati kanna ni awọn ika ọwọ enia kan jade wá, a si kọwe sara ẹfun ogiri niwaju ọpa-fitila li ãfin ọba: ọba si ri ọwọ ti o kọwe na.
entries.en: In the same hour came forth fingers of a man's hand, and wrote over against the candlestick upon the plaister of the wall of the king's palace: and the king saw the part of the hand that wrote.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni oju ọba yipada, ìro-inu rẹ̀ si dãmu rẹ̀, tobẹ̃ ti amure ẹ̀gbẹ rẹ̀ tu, ẽkunsẹ̀ rẹ̀ mejeji si nlù ara wọn.
entries.en: Then the king's countenance was changed, and his thoughts troubled him, so that the joints of his loins were loosed, and his knees smote one against another.

entries.yo: Ọba si kigbe kikan pe, ki a mu awọn amoye, awọn Kaldea, ati awọn alafọṣẹ wá. Ọba dahùn o si wi fun awọn ọlọgbọ́n Babeli, pe, Ẹnikan ti o ba kà iwe yi, ti o ba si fi itumọ rẹ̀ hàn fun mi, on li a o fi aṣọ ododó wọ̀, a o si fi ẹ̀wọn wura kọ̀ ọ li ọrùn, on o si jẹ ẹkẹta olori ni ijọba.
entries.en: The king cried aloud to bring in the astrologers, the Chaldeans, and the soothsayers. And the king spake, and said to the wise men of Babylon, Whosoever shall read this writing, and shew me the interpretation thereof, shall be clothed with scarlet, and have a chain of gold about his neck, and shall be the third ruler in the kingdom.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni gbogbo awọn amoye ọba wọle; ṣugbọn nwọn kò le kà iwe na, nwọn kò si le fi itumọ rẹ̀ hàn fun ọba.
