entries.en: Then came in all the king's wise men: but they could not read the writing, nor make known to the king the interpretation thereof.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ẹ̀ru nla ba Belṣassari ọba gidigidi, oju rẹ̀ si yipada lori rẹ̀, ẹ̀ru si ba awọn ijoye rẹ̀.
entries.en: Then was king Belshazzar greatly troubled, and his countenance was changed in him, and his lords were astonied.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni ayaba ṣe wọ ile-àse wá, nitori ọ̀ran ọba, ati ti awọn ijoye rẹ̀; ayaba dahùn o si wipe, Ki ọba ki o pẹ́: má ṣe jẹ ki ìro-inu rẹ ki o dãmu rẹ, má si jẹ ki oju rẹ ki o yipada.
entries.en: Now the queen, by reason of the words of the king and his lords, came into the banquet house: and the queen spake and said, O king, live for ever: let not thy thoughts trouble thee, nor let thy countenance be changed:

entries.yo: Ọkunrin kan mbẹ ni ijọba rẹ, lara ẹniti ẹmi Ọlọrun mimọ́ wà; ati li ọjọ baba rẹ, a ri imọlẹ, ati oye, ati ọgbọ́n gẹgẹ bi ọgbọ́n Ọlọrun lara rẹ̀: ẹniti Nebukadnessari ọba, baba rẹ, ani ọba, baba rẹ fi ṣe olori awọn amoye, ọlọgbọ́n, awọn Kaldea, ti awọn alafọṣẹ:
entries.en: There is a man in thy kingdom, in whom is the spirit of the holy gods; and in the days of thy father light and understanding and wisdom, like the wisdom of the gods, was found in him; whom the king Nebuchadnezzar thy father, the king, I say, thy father, made master of the magicians, astrologers, Chaldeans, and soothsayers;

entries.yo: Niwọnbi ẹmi titayọ ati ìmọ, ati oye itumọ alá, oye ati já alọ́, ati lati ma ṣe itumọ ọ̀rọ ti o diju, gbogbo wọnyi li a ri lara Danieli na, ẹniti ọba fi orukọ Belteṣassari fun, njẹ nisisiyi jẹ ki a pè Danieli wá, on o si fi itumọ rẹ̀ hàn.
entries.en: Forasmuch as an excellent spirit, and knowledge, and understanding, interpreting of dreams, and shewing of hard sentences, and dissolving of doubts, were found in the same Daniel, whom the king named Belteshazzar: now let Daniel be called, and he will shew the interpretation.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni a mu Danieli wá siwaju ọba. Ọba si dahùn o wi fun Danieli pe, Iwọ ni Danieli nì, ti iṣe ti inu awọn ọmọ igbekun Juda! awọn ẹniti ọba, baba mi kó lati ilẹ Juda wá?
entries.en: Then was Daniel brought in before the king. And the king spake and said unto Daniel, Art thou that Daniel, which art of the children of the captivity of Judah, whom the king my father brought out of Jewry?

entries.yo: Emi ti gburo rẹ pe ẹmi Ọlọrun mbẹ lara rẹ, ati pe, a ri imọlẹ, ati oye, ati ọgbọ́n titayọ lara rẹ,
entries.en: I have even heard of thee, that the spirit of the gods is in thee, and that light and understanding and excellent wisdom is found in thee.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, a ti mu awọn amoye, ati awọn ọlọgbọ́n wá siwaju mi, ki nwọn ki o le ka iwe yi, ati lati fi itumọ rẹ̀ hàn fun mi: ṣugbọn nwọn kò le fi itumọ ọ̀ran na hàn:
entries.en: And now the wise men, the astrologers, have been brought in before me, that they should read this writing, and make known unto me the interpretation thereof: but they could not shew the interpretation of the thing:

entries.yo: Emi si gburo rẹ pe, iwọ le ṣe itumọ, iwọ si le tu ọ̀rọ ti o diju: njẹ nisisiyi, bi iwọ ba le ka iwe na, ti iwọ ba si le fi itumọ rẹ̀ hàn fun mi, a o wọ̀ ọ li aṣọ ododó, a o si fi ẹ̀wọn wura kọ́ ọ lọrun, a o si fi ọ jẹ olori ẹkẹta ni ijọba.
entries.en: And I have heard of thee, that thou canst make interpretations, and dissolve doubts: now if thou canst read the writing, and make known to me the interpretation thereof, thou shalt be clothed with scarlet, and have a chain of gold about thy neck, and shalt be the third ruler in the kingdom.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Danieli dahùn, o si wi niwaju ọba pe, Jẹ ki ẹ̀bun rẹ gbe ọwọ rẹ, ki o si fi ẹsan rẹ fun ẹlomiran; ṣugbọn emi o ka iwe na fun ọba, emi o si fi itumọ rẹ̀ hàn fun u.
entries.en: Then Daniel answered and said before the king, Let thy gifts be to thyself, and give thy rewards to another; yet I will read the writing unto the king, and make known to him the interpretation.

entries.yo: Iwọ ọba! Ọlọrun Ọga-ogo fi ijọba, ati ọlanla, ati ogo, ati ọlá fun Nebukadnessari, baba rẹ:
entries.en: O thou king, the most high God gave Nebuchadnezzar thy father a kingdom, and majesty, and glory, and honour:

entries.yo: Ati nitori ọlanla ti o fi fun u, gbogbo enia, orilẹ, ati ède gbogbo nwariri, nwọn si mbẹ̀ru niwaju rẹ̀: ẹniti o wù u, a pa, ẹniti o si wù u, a da si lãye; ẹniti o wù u, a gbé ga; ẹniti o si wú u, a rẹ̀ silẹ.
entries.en: And for the majesty that he gave him, all people, nations, and languages, trembled and feared before him: whom he would he slew; and whom he would he kept alive; and whom he would he set up; and whom he would he put down.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati ọkàn rẹ̀ gbega, ti inu rẹ̀ si le nipa igberaga, a mu u kuro lori itẹ rẹ̀, nwọn si gba ogo rẹ̀ lọwọ rẹ̀:
entries.en: But when his heart was lifted up, and his mind hardened in pride, he was deposed from his kingly throne, and they took his glory from him:

entries.yo: A si le e kuro lãrin awọn ọmọ enia; a si ṣe aiya rẹ̀ dabi ti ẹranko, ibugbe rẹ̀ si wà lọdọ awọn kẹtẹkẹtẹ igbẹ; nwọn si fi koriko bọ́ ọ gẹgẹ bi malu, a si mu ki ìri ọrun sẹ̀ si i lara; titi on fi mọ̀ pe Ọlọrun Ọga-ogo ni iṣe alakoso ninu ijọba enia, on a si yàn ẹnikẹni ti o wù u ṣe olori rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he was driven from the sons of men; and his heart was made like the beasts, and his dwelling was with the wild asses: they fed him with grass like oxen, and his body was wet with the dew of heaven; till he knew that the most high God ruled in the kingdom of men, and that he appointeth over it whomsoever he will.

entries.yo: Ati iwọ Belṣassari, ọmọ rẹ̀, iwọ kò rẹ̀ ọkàn rẹ silẹ, bi iwọ si tilẹ ti mọ̀ gbogbo nkan wọnyi;
entries.en: And thou his son, O Belshazzar, hast not humbled thine heart, though thou knewest all this;

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn iwọ gbé ara rẹ ga si Oluwa ọrun, nwọn si ti mu ohun-elo ile rẹ̀ wá siwaju rẹ, iwọ ati awọn ijoye rẹ, ati awọn aya rẹ, ati awọn àle rẹ si ti nmu ọti-waini ninu wọn; iwọ si ti nkọrin iyìn si oriṣa fadaka, ati ti wura, ti idẹ, ti irin, ti igi, ati ti okuta, awọn ti kò riran, ti kò gbọran, bẹ̃ni nwọn kò si mọ̀: ṣugbọn Ọlọrun na, lọwọ ẹniti ẹmi rẹ wà, ati ti ẹniti gbogbo ọ̀na rẹ iṣe on ni iwọ kò bu ọlá fun.
entries.en: But hast lifted up thyself against the LORD of heaven; and they have brought the vessels of his house before thee, and thou, and thy lords, thy wives, and thy concubines, have drunk wine in them; and thou hast praised the gods of silver, and gold, of brass, iron, wood, and stone, which see not, nor hear, nor know: and the God in whose hand thy breath is, and whose are all thy ways, hast thou not glorified:

entries.yo: Nitorina ni a ṣe rán ọwọ na lati ọdọ rẹ̀ wá; ti a si fi kọ iwe yi.
entries.en: Then was the part of the hand sent from him; and this writing was written.

entries.yo: Eyiyi si ni iwe na ti a kọ, MENE, MENE, TEKELI, PERESINI.
entries.en: And this is the writing that was written, MENE, MENE, TEKEL, UPHARSIN.

entries.yo: Eyi ni itumọ ohun na: MENE, Ọlọrun ti ṣirò ijọba rẹ, o si pari rẹ̀.
entries.en: This is the interpretation of the thing: MENE; God hath numbered thy kingdom, and finished it.

entries.yo: TEKELI; A ti wọ̀n ọ wò ninu ọ̀ṣuwọn, iwọ kò si to.
entries.en: TEKEL; Thou art weighed in the balances, and art found wanting.

entries.yo: PERESINI; A pin ijọba rẹ, a si fi fun awọn ara Media, ati awọn ara Persia.
entries.en: PERES; Thy kingdom is divided, and given to the Medes and Persians.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Belṣassari paṣẹ, nwọn si wọ̀ Danieli li aṣọ ododó, a si fi ẹ̀wọn wura kọ́ ọ lọrun, a si ṣe ikede niwaju rẹ̀ pe, ki a fi i ṣe olori ẹkẹta ni ijọba.
entries.en: Then commanded Belshazzar, and they clothed Daniel with scarlet, and put a chain of gold about his neck, and made a proclamation concerning him, that he should be the third ruler in the kingdom.

entries.yo: Loru ijọ kanna li a pa Belṣassari, ọba awọn ara Kaldea.
entries.en: In that night was Belshazzar the king of the Chaldeans slain.

entries.yo: Dariusi, ara Media si gba ijọba na, o si jẹ bi ẹni iwọn ọdun mejilelọgọta.
entries.en: And Darius the Median took the kingdom, being about threescore and two years old.

entries.yo: O ṣe didùn inu Dariusi lati fi ọgọfa arẹ bãlẹ sori ijọba na, ti yio wà lori gbogbo ijọba;
entries.en: It pleased Darius to set over the kingdom an hundred and twenty princes, which should be over the whole kingdom;

entries.yo: Ati lori awọn wọnyi ni alakoso mẹta: Danieli si jẹ ọkan ninu wọn: ki awọn arẹ bãlẹ ki o le ma jiyin fun wọn, ki ọba ki o má ṣe ni ipalara.
entries.en: And over these three presidents; of whom Daniel was first: that the princes might give accounts unto them, and the king should have no damage.

entries.yo: Danieli yi si bori gbogbo awọn alakoso ati arẹ bãlẹ wọnyi, nitoripe ẹmi titayọ wà lara rẹ̀: ọba si ngbiro lati fi i ṣe olori gbogbo ijọba.
entries.en: Then this Daniel was preferred above the presidents and princes, because an excellent spirit was in him; and the king thought to set him over the whole realm.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni awọn alakoso, ati awọn arẹ bãlẹ nwá ẹ̀sùn si Danieli lẹsẹ̀ nipa ọ̀rọ ijọba, ṣugbọn nwọn kò le ri ẹ̀sùn tabi ẹ̀ṣẹkẹṣẹ lọwọ rẹ̀; niwọn bi on ti jẹ olododo enia tobẹ̃ ti a kò si ri iṣina tabi ẹ̀ṣẹ kan lọwọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Then the presidents and princes sought to find occasion against Daniel concerning the kingdom; but they could find none occasion nor fault; forasmuch as he was faithful, neither was there any error or fault found in him.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni awọn ọkunrin wọnyi wipe, Awa kì yio le ri ẹ̀sùn kan si Danieli bikoṣepe a ba ri i si i nipasẹ ofin Ọlọrun rẹ̀.
entries.en: Then said these men, We shall not find any occasion against this Daniel, except we find it against him concerning the law of his God.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni awọn alakoso ati awọn arẹ bãlẹ wọnyi pejọ pọ̀ lẹsẹkanna lọdọ ọba, nwọn si wi bayi pe ki Dariusi ọba, ki o pẹ́.
entries.en: Then these presidents and princes assembled together to the king, and said thus unto him, King Darius, live for ever.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn olori alakoso ijọba, awọn bãlẹ ati awọn arẹ bãlẹ, awọn ìgbimọ, ati olori ogun jọ gbìmọ pọ̀ lati fi ofin ọba kan lelẹ, ati lati paṣẹ lile kan, pe ẹnikẹni ti o ba bère nkan lọwọ Ọlọrun tabi eniakenia niwọn ọgbọ̀n ọjọ bikoṣepe lọwọ rẹ, ọba, a o gbé e sọ sinu ihò kiniun.
entries.en: All the presidents of the kingdom, the governors, and the princes, the counsellers, and the captains, have consulted together to establish a royal statute, and to make a firm decree, that whosoever shall ask a petition of any God or man for thirty days, save of thee, O king, he shall be cast into the den of lions.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, ọba, fi aṣẹ na lelẹ, ki o si fi ọwọ rẹ sinu iwe ki o máṣe yipada, gẹgẹ bi ofin awọn ara Media ati Persia, eyi ti a kò gbọdọ pada.
entries.en: Now, O king, establish the decree, and sign the writing, that it be not changed, according to the law of the Medes and Persians, which altereth not.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Dariusi fi ọwọ sinu iwe ati aṣẹ na.
entries.en: Wherefore king Darius signed the writing and the decree.

entries.yo: Nigbati Danieli si ti mọ̀ pe a kọ iwe na tan, o wọ ile rẹ̀ lọ; (a si ṣi oju ferese yara rẹ̀ silẹ siha Jerusalemu) o kunlẹ li ẽkun rẹ̀ nigba mẹta lõjọ, o gbadura, o si dupẹ niwaju Ọlọrun rẹ̀, gẹgẹ bi on ti iṣe nigba atijọ ri.
entries.en: Now when Daniel knew that the writing was signed, he went into his house; and his windows being open in his chamber toward Jerusalem, he kneeled upon his knees three times a day, and prayed, and gave thanks before his God, as he did aforetime.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni awọn ọkunrin wọnyi rìn wọle, nwọn si ri Danieli ngbadura, o si mbẹbẹ niwaju Ọlọrun rẹ̀.
entries.en: Then these men assembled, and found Daniel praying and making supplication before his God.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni nwọn wá, nwọn si wi niwaju ọba niti aṣẹ ọba pe, Kò ṣepe iwọ fi ọwọ sinu iwe pe, ẹnikan ti o ba bère ohunkohun lọwọ Ọlọrun tabi lọwọ enia kan niwọn ọgbọ̀n ọjọ, bikoṣe lọwọ rẹ, ọba, pe a o gbé e sọ sinu iho kiniun? Ọba si dahùn o wipe, Otitọ li ọ̀ran na, gẹgẹ bi ofin awọn ara Media ati Persia, ti a kò gbọdọ pada.
entries.en: Then they came near, and spake before the king concerning the king's decree; Hast thou not signed a decree, that every man that shall ask a petition of any God or man within thirty days, save of thee, O king, shall be cast into the den of lions? The king answered and said, The thing is true, according to the law of the Medes and Persians, which altereth not.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni nwọn dahùn nwọn si wi niwaju ọba pe, Danieli ọkan ninu awọn ọmọ igbekun Juda kò kà ọ si, ọba, ati aṣẹ, nitori eyi ti iwọ fi ọwọ rẹ sinu iwe, ṣugbọn o ngbadura rẹ̀ nigba mẹta lõjọ.
entries.en: Then answered they and said before the king, That Daniel, which is of the children of the captivity of Judah, regardeth not thee, O king, nor the decree that thou hast signed, but maketh his petition three times a day.

entries.yo: Nigbati ọba gbọ́ ọ̀rọ wọnyi, inu rẹ̀ bajẹ gidigidi o si fi ọkàn rẹ̀ si Danieli lati gbà a silẹ: o si ṣe lãlã ati gbà a silẹ titi fi di igbati õrun wọ̀.
entries.en: Then the king, when he heard these words, was sore displeased with himself, and set his heart on Daniel to deliver him: and he laboured till the going down of the sun to deliver him.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni awọn ọkunrin wọnyi pejọ lẹsẹkanna lọdọ ọba, nwọn si wi fun ọba pe, Iwọ mọ̀, ọba, pe ofin awọn ara Media ati Persia ni pe: kò si aṣẹ tabi ofin ti ọba fi lelẹ ti a gbọdọ yipada.
entries.en: Then these men assembled unto the king, and said unto the king, Know, O king, that the law of the Medes and Persians is, That no decree nor statute which the king establisheth may be changed.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ọba paṣẹ, nwọn si mu Danieli wá, nwọn si gbé e sọ sinu iho kiniun. Ọba si dahùn o wi fun Danieli pe, Ọlọrun rẹ, ẹniti iwọ nsìn laisimi, on o gbà ọ la.
entries.en: Then the king commanded, and they brought Daniel, and cast him into the den of lions. Now the king spake and said unto Daniel, Thy God whom thou servest continually, he will deliver thee.

entries.yo: A si yi okuta kan wá, nwọn si gbé e ka oju iho na; ọba si fi oruka edidi rẹ̀ sami si i, ati oruka edidi awọn ijoye rẹ̀, ki ohunkohun máṣe yipada nitori Danieli.
entries.en: And a stone was brought and laid upon the mouth of the den; and the king sealed it with his own signet, and with the signet of his lords; that the purpose might not be changed concerning Daniel.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Ọba wọ̀ ãfin rẹ̀ lọ, o si fi oru na gbàwẹ: bẹ̃li a kò si gbé ohun-elo orin kan wá siwaju rẹ̀: orun kò si wá si oju rẹ̀.
entries.en: Then the king went to his palace, and passed the night fasting: neither were instruments of musick brought before him: and his sleep went from him.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Ọba dide li afẹmọjumọ, o si yara kánkan lọ si ibi iho kiniun na.
entries.en: Then the king arose very early in the morning, and went in haste unto the den of lions.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si sunmọ iho na o fi ohùnrére ẹkun kigbe si Danieli: ọba dahùn o si wi fun Danieli pe, Danieli! iranṣẹ Ọlọrun alãye! Ọlọrun rẹ, ẹniti iwọ nsìn laisimi, ha le gbà ọ lọwọ awọn kiniun bi?
entries.en: And when he came to the den, he cried with a lamentable voice unto Daniel: and the king spake and said to Daniel, O Daniel, servant of the living God, is thy God, whom thou servest continually, able to deliver thee from the lions?

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Danieli wi fun ọba pe, ki ọba ki o pẹ.
entries.en: Then said Daniel unto the king, O king, live for ever.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun mi ti ran angeli rẹ̀, o si dì awọn kiniun na lẹnu, ti nwọn kò fi le pa mi lara: gẹgẹ bi a ti ri mi lailẹṣẹ niwaju rẹ̀; ati niwaju rẹ pẹlu, ọba, emi kò si ṣe ohun buburu kan.
entries.en: My God hath sent his angel, and hath shut the lions' mouths, that they have not hurt me: forasmuch as before him innocency was found in me; and also before thee, O king, have I done no hurt.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ọba yọ̀ gidigidi, o si paṣẹ pe, ki nwọn ki o fà Danieli jade kuro ninu iho. Bẹ̃li a si fa Danieli jade kuro ninu iho, a kò si ri ipalara lara rẹ̀, nitoriti o gbà Ọlọrun rẹ̀ gbọ́.
entries.en: Then was the king exceeding glad for him, and commanded that they should take Daniel up out of the den. So Daniel was taken up out of the den, and no manner of hurt was found upon him, because he believed in his God.

entries.yo: Ọba si paṣẹ, pe ki a mu awọn ọkunrin wọnni wá, ti o fi Danieli sùn, nwọn si gbé wọn sọ sinu iho kiniun, awọn, ati awọn ọmọ wọn, ati awọn aya wọn. Ki nwọn ki o to de isalẹ iho, awọn kiniun bori wọn, nwọn si fọ egungun wọn tũtu.
entries.en: And the king commanded, and they brought those men which had accused Daniel, and they cast them into the den of lions, them, their children, and their wives; and the lions had the mastery of them, and brake all their bones in pieces or ever they came at the bottom of the den.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Dariusi, ọba kọwe si gbogbo enia, orilẹ, ati ède ti o wà ni gbogbo aiye pe, Ki alafia ki o ma bi si i fun nyin.
entries.en: Then king Darius wrote unto all people, nations, and languages, that dwell in all the earth; Peace be multiplied unto you.

entries.yo: Mo paṣẹ pe, Ni gbogbo igberiko ijọba mi, ki awọn enia ki o ma warìri, ki nwọn si ma bẹ̀ru niwaju Ọlọrun Danieli, nitoripe on li Ọlọrun alãye, on si duro lailai, ati ijọba rẹ̀, eyi ti a kì yio le parun ni, ati agbara ijọba rẹ̀ yio si wà titi de opin.
entries.en: I make a decree, That in every dominion of my kingdom men tremble and fear before the God of Daniel: for he is the living God, and stedfast for ever, and his kingdom that which shall not be destroyed, and his dominion shall be even unto the end.

entries.yo: O ngbà ni, o si nyọ ni, o si nṣe iṣẹ-ami ati iṣẹ-iyanu li ọrun ati li aiye, ẹniti o gbà Danieli là lọwọ awọn kiniun.
entries.en: He delivereth and rescueth, and he worketh signs and wonders in heaven and in earth, who hath delivered Daniel from the power of the lions.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Danieli yi si nṣe rere ni igba ijọba Dariusi, ati ni igba ijọba Kirusi, ara Persia.
entries.en: So this Daniel prospered in the reign of Darius, and in the reign of Cyrus the Persian.

entries.yo: LI ọdun kini Belṣassari, ọba Babeli, ni Danieli lá alá, ati iran ori rẹ̀ lori akete rẹ̀: nigbana ni o kọwe alá na, o si sọ gbogbo ọ̀rọ na.
entries.en: In the first year of Belshazzar king of Babylon Daniel had a dream and visions of his head upon his bed: then he wrote the dream, and told the sum of the matters.

entries.yo: Danieli dahùn, o si wipe, Mo ri ni iran mi li oru, si kiyesi i, afẹfẹ mẹrẹrin ọrun njà loju okun nla.
entries.en: Daniel spake and said, I saw in my vision by night, and, behold, the four winds of the heaven strove upon the great sea.

entries.yo: Ẹranko mẹrin nla si ti inu okun jade soke, nwọn si yatọ si ara wọn.
entries.en: And four great beasts came up from the sea, diverse one from another.

entries.yo: Ẹranko kini dabi kiniun, o si ni iyẹ-apa idì: mo si wò titi a fi fà iyẹ-apa rẹ̀ wọnni tu, a si gbé e soke kuro ni ilẹ, a mu ki o fi ẹsẹ duro bi enia, a si fi aiya enia fun u.
entries.en: The first was like a lion, and had eagle's wings: I beheld till the wings thereof were plucked, and it was lifted up from the earth, and made stand upon the feet as a man, and a man's heart was given to it.

entries.yo: Sa si kiyesi, ẹranko miran, ekeji, ti o dabi ẹranko beari, o si gbé ara rẹ̀ soke li apakan, o si ni egungun-ìha mẹta lẹnu rẹ̀ larin ehin rẹ̀: nwọn si wi fun u bayi pe, Dide ki o si jẹ ẹran pipọ.
entries.en: And behold another beast, a second, like to a bear, and it raised up itself on one side, and it had three ribs in the mouth of it between the teeth of it: and they said thus unto it, Arise, devour much flesh.

entries.yo: Lẹhin eyi, mo ri, si kiyesi i, ẹranko miran, gẹgẹ bi ẹkùn, ti o ni iyẹ-apa ẹiyẹ mẹrin li ẹhin rẹ̀; ẹranko na ni ori mẹrin pẹlu; a si fi agbara ijọba fun u.
entries.en: After this I beheld, and lo another, like a leopard, which had upon the back of it four wings of a fowl; the beast had also four heads; and dominion was given to it.

entries.yo: Lẹhin eyi, mo ri ni iran oru, si kiyesi i, ẹranko kẹrin ti o burujù, ti o si lẹrù, ti o si lagbara gidigidi; o si ni ehin irin nla: o njẹ o si nfọ tũtu, o si fi ẹsẹ rẹ̀ tẹ̀ iyokù mọlẹ: o si yatọ si gbogbo awọn ẹranko ti o ṣiwaju rẹ̀; o si ni iwo mẹwa.
entries.en: After this I saw in the night visions, and behold a fourth beast, dreadful and terrible, and strong exceedingly; and it had great iron teeth: it devoured and brake in pieces, and stamped the residue with the feet of it: and it was diverse from all the beasts that were before it; and it had ten horns.

entries.yo: Mo si kiyesi awọn iwo na, si wò o, iwo kekere miran kan si jade larin wọn, niwaju eyiti a fa mẹta tu ninu awọn iwo iṣaju: si kiyesi i, oju gẹgẹ bi oju enia wà lara iwo yi, ati ẹnu ti nsọ ohun nlanlà.
entries.en: I considered the horns, and, behold, there came up among them another little horn, before whom there were three of the first horns plucked up by the roots: and, behold, in this horn were eyes like the eyes of man, and a mouth speaking great things.

entries.yo: Mo si wò titi a fi sọ̀ itẹ́ wọnni kalẹ titi Ẹni-àgba ọjọ na fi joko, aṣọ ẹniti o fún gẹgẹ bi ẹ̀gbọn owu, irun ori rẹ̀ si dabi irun agutan ti o mọ́: itẹ rẹ̀ jẹ ọwọ iná, ayika-kẹkẹ rẹ̀ si jẹ jijo iná.
entries.en: I beheld till the thrones were cast down, and the Ancient of days did sit, whose garment was white as snow, and the hair of his head like the pure wool: his throne was like the fiery flame, and his wheels as burning fire.

entries.yo: Iṣàn iná nṣẹyọ, o si ntu jade lati iwaju rẹ̀ wá; awọn ẹgbẹ̃gbẹrun nṣe iranṣẹ fun u, ati awọn ẹgbẹgbarun nigba ẹgbarun duro niwaju rẹ̀: awọn onidajọ joko, a si ṣi iwe wọnni silẹ.
entries.en: A fiery stream issued and came forth from before him: thousand thousands ministered unto him, and ten thousand times ten thousand stood before him: the judgment was set, and the books were opened.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni mo wò nitori ohùn ọ̀rọ nla ti iwo na nsọ: mo si wò titi a fi pa ẹranko na, a si pa ara rẹ̀ run, a si sọ ọ sinu ọwọ iná ti njo.
entries.en: I beheld then because of the voice of the great words which the horn spake: I beheld even till the beast was slain, and his body destroyed, and given to the burning flame.

entries.yo: Bi o ṣe ti awọn ẹranko iyokù ni, a ti gba agbara wọn kuro: nitori a ti yàn akokò ati ìgba fun wọn bi olukulùku yio ti pẹ tó.
entries.en: As concerning the rest of the beasts, they had their dominion taken away: yet their lives were prolonged for a season and time.

entries.yo: Mo ri ni iran oru, si kiyesi i, ẹnikan bi Ọmọ enia wá pẹlu awọsanma ọrun, o si wá sọdọ Ẹni-Àgba ọjọ na, nwọn si mu u sunmọ iwaju rẹ̀.
entries.en: I saw in the night visions, and, behold, one like the Son of man came with the clouds of heaven, and came to the Ancient of days, and they brought him near before him.

entries.yo: A si fi agbara ijọba fun u, ati ogo, ati ijọba, ki gbogbo enia, ati orilẹ, ati ède, ki o le ma sìn i; agbara ijọba rẹ̀ si jẹ agbara ijọba ainipẹkun, eyiti a kì yio rekọja, ati ijọba rẹ̀, eyiti a kì yio le parun.
entries.en: And there was given him dominion, and glory, and a kingdom, that all people, nations, and languages, should serve him: his dominion is an everlasting dominion, which shall not pass away, and his kingdom that which shall not be destroyed.

entries.yo: Ẹmi emi Danieli si rẹwẹsi ninu ara mi, iran ori mi si mu mi dãmu.
entries.en: I Daniel was grieved in my spirit in the midst of my body, and the visions of my head troubled me.

entries.yo: Mo sunmọ ọkan ninu awọn ti o duro lapakan, mo si bi i lere otitọ gbogbo nkan wọnyi. Bẹ̃li o sọ fun mi, o si fi itumọ nkan wọnyi hàn fun mi.
entries.en: I came near unto one of them that stood by, and asked him the truth of all this. So he told me, and made me know the interpretation of the things.

entries.yo: Awọn ẹranko nla wọnyi, ti o jẹ mẹrin, li awọn ọba mẹrin ti yio dide li aiye.
entries.en: These great beasts, which are four, are four kings, which shall arise out of the earth.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn enia-mimọ́ ti Ọga-ogo julọ yio gbà ijọba, nwọn o si jogun ijọba na lai, ani titi lailai.
entries.en: But the saints of the most High shall take the kingdom, and possess the kingdom for ever, even for ever and ever.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni mo si nfẹ imọ̀ otitọ ti ẹranko kẹrin, eyiti o yatọ si gbogbo awọn iyokù, ti o lẹrù gidigidi, eyi ti ehin rẹ̀ jẹ irin, ti ẽkanna rẹ̀ jẹ idẹ, ti njẹ, ti nfọ tũtu, ti o si nfi ẹsẹ rẹ̀ tẹ̀ iyokù mọlẹ.
entries.en: Then I would know the truth of the fourth beast, which was diverse from all the others, exceeding dreadful, whose teeth were of iron, and his nails of brass; which devoured, brake in pieces, and stamped the residue with his feet;

entries.yo: Ati niti iwo mẹwa ti o wà li ori rẹ̀, ati omiran na ti o yọ soke, niwaju eyiti mẹta si ṣubu; ani iwo na ti o ni oju, ati ẹnu ti nsọ̀rọ ohun nlanla, eyi ti oju rẹ̀ si koro jù ti awọn ẹgbẹ rẹ̀ lọ.
entries.en: And of the ten horns that were in his head, and of the other which came up, and before whom three fell; even of that horn that had eyes, and a mouth that spake very great things, whose look was more stout than his fellows.

entries.yo: Mo ri iwo kanna si mba awọn enia-mimọ́ jagun, o si bori wọn.
entries.en: I beheld, and the same horn made war with the saints, and prevailed against them;

entries.yo: Titi Ẹni-àgba ọjọ nì fi de, ti a si fi idalare fun awọn enia-mimọ ti Ọga-ogo; titi akokò si fi de ti awọn enia-mimọ́ jogun ijọba na.
entries.en: Until the Ancient of days came, and judgment was given to the saints of the most High; and the time came that the saints possessed the kingdom.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li o wipe, Ẹranko kẹrin nì yio ṣe ijọba kẹrin li aiye, eyiti yio yàtọ si gbogbo ijọba miran, yio pa gbogbo aiye rẹ́, yio si tẹ̀ ẹ molẹ, yio si fọ ọ tũtu.
entries.en: Thus he said, The fourth beast shall be the fourth kingdom upon earth, which shall be diverse from all kingdoms, and shall devour the whole earth, and shall tread it down, and break it in pieces.

entries.yo: Ati iwo mẹwa, lati inu ijọba na wá ni ọba mẹwa yio dide: omiran kan yio si dide lẹhin wọn, on o si yàtọ si gbogbo awọn ti iṣaju, on o si bori ọba mẹta.
entries.en: And the ten horns out of this kingdom are ten kings that shall arise: and another shall rise after them; and he shall be diverse from the first, and he shall subdue three kings.

entries.yo: On o si ma sọ̀rọ nla si Ọga-ogo, yio si da awọn enia-mimọ́ ti Ọga-ogo lagara, yio si rò lati yi akokò ati ofin pada; a o si fi wọn le e lọwọ titi fi di igba akokò kan, ati awọn akokò, ati idaji akokò.
entries.en: And he shall speak great words against the most High, and shall wear out the saints of the most High, and think to change times and laws: and they shall be given into his hand until a time and times and the dividing of time.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn onidajọ yio joko, nwọn o si gbà agbara ijọba rẹ̀ lọwọ rẹ̀ lati fi ṣòfo, ati lati pa a run de opin.
entries.en: But the judgment shall sit, and they shall take away his dominion, to consume and to destroy it unto the end.

entries.yo: Ati ijọba, ati agbara ijọba ati ipa gbogbo ijọba ni gbogbo abẹ-ọrun, li a o si fi fun enia awọn enia-mimọ ti Ọga-ogo, ijọba ẹniti iṣe ijọba ainipẹkun, ati gbogbo awọn alakoso ni yio ma sìn, ti nwọn o si ma tẹriba fun u.
entries.en: And the kingdom and dominion, and the greatness of the kingdom under the whole heaven, shall be given to the people of the saints of the most High, whose kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and all dominions shall serve and obey him.

entries.yo: Titi de ihinyi li opin ọ̀ran na. Bi o ṣe ti emi Danieli ni, igbero inu mi dãmu mi gidigidi, oju mi si yipada lori mi: ṣugbọn mo pa ọran na mọ́ li ọkàn mi.
entries.en: Hitherto is the end of the matter. As for me Daniel, my cogitations much troubled me, and my countenance changed in me: but I kept the matter in my heart.

entries.yo: LI ọdun kẹta ijọba Belṣassari ọba, iran kan fi ara hàn fun mi, ani emi Danieli, lẹhin iran ti emi ri ni iṣaju.
entries.en: In the third year of the reign of king Belshazzar a vision appeared unto me, even unto me Daniel, after that which appeared unto me at the first.

entries.yo: Emi si ri loju iran, o si ṣe nigbati mo ri, ti mo si wà ni Ṣuṣani, li ãfin, ti o wà ni igberiko Elamu, mo si ri loju iran, mo si wà leti odò Ulai.
entries.en: And I saw in a vision; and it came to pass, when I saw, that I was at Shushan in the palace, which is in the province of Elam; and I saw in a vision, and I was by the river of Ulai.

entries.yo: Mo si gbé oju mi soke, mo si ri, si kiye si i, àgbo kan ti o ni iwo meji duro lẹba odò na: iwo mejeji na si ga, ṣugbọn ekini ga jù ekeji lọ, eyiti o ga jù li o jade kẹhin.
entries.en: Then I lifted up mine eyes, and saw, and, behold, there stood before the river a ram which had two horns: and the two horns were high; but one was higher than the other, and the higher came up last.

entries.yo: Mo si ri àgbo na o nkàn siha iwọ-õrùn, ati si ariwa, ati si gusu; tobẹ ti gbogbo ẹranko kò fi le duro niwaju rẹ̀, bẹ̃ni kò si ẹniti o le gbani lọwọ rẹ̀: ṣugbọn o nṣe gẹgẹ bi ifẹ inu rẹ̀, o si nṣe ohun nlanla.
entries.en: I saw the ram pushing westward, and northward, and southward; so that no beasts might stand before him, neither was there any that could deliver out of his hand; but he did according to his will, and became great.

entries.yo: Bi mo si ti nwoye, kiyesi i, obukọ kan ti iha iwọ-õrùn jade wá sori gbogbo aiye, kò si fi ẹsẹ kan ilẹ: obukọ na si ni iwo nla kan lãrin oju rẹ̀.
entries.en: And as I was considering, behold, an he goat came from the west on the face of the whole earth, and touched not the ground: and the goat had a notable horn between his eyes.

entries.yo: O si tọ̀ àgbo ti o ni iwo meji na wá, eyi ti mo ti ri ti o duro lẹba odò na, o si fi irunu agbara sare si i.
entries.en: And he came to the ram that had two horns, which I had there seen standing before the river, and ran unto him in the fury of his power.

entries.yo: Mo si ri i, o sunmọ ọdọ́-àgbo na, o si fi ikoro ibinu sare si i, o lu àgbo na bolẹ, o si ṣẹ́ iwo rẹ̀ mejeji: kò si si agbara ninu àgbo na, lati duro niwaju rẹ̀, ṣugbọn o lù u bolẹ o si tẹ̀ ẹ mọlẹ: kò si si ẹniti o le gbà àgbo na lọwọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And I saw him come close unto the ram, and he was moved with choler against him, and smote the ram, and brake his two horns: and there was no power in the ram to stand before him, but he cast him down to the ground, and stamped upon him: and there was none that could deliver the ram out of his hand.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni obukọ na nṣe ohun nla pupọpupọ, nigbati o si di alagbara tan, iwo nla na ṣẹ́; ati nipò rẹ̀ iwo mẹrin miran ti iṣe afiyesi si yọ jade si ọ̀na afẹfẹ mẹrẹrin ọrun.
entries.en: Therefore the he goat waxed very great: and when he was strong, the great horn was broken; and for it came up four notable ones toward the four winds of heaven.

entries.yo: Ati lati inu ọkan ninu wọn ni iwo kekere kan ti jade, ti o si di alagbara gidigidi, si iha gusu, ati si iha ila-õrùn, ati si iha ilẹ ogo.
entries.en: And out of one of them came forth a little horn, which waxed exceeding great, toward the south, and toward the east, and toward the pleasant land.

entries.yo: O si di alagbara, titi de ogun ọrun, o si bì ṣubu ninu awọn ogun ọrun, ati ninu awọn irawọ si ilẹ, o si tẹ̀ wọn mọlẹ.
entries.en: And it waxed great, even to the host of heaven; and it cast down some of the host and of the stars to the ground, and stamped upon them.

entries.yo: Ani o gbé ara rẹ̀ ga titi de ọdọ olori awọn ogun na pãpa, a si ti mu ẹbọ ojojumọ kuro lọdọ rẹ̀, a si wó ibujoko ìwa-mimọ́ rẹ̀ lulẹ.
entries.en: Yea, he magnified himself even to the prince of the host, and by him the daily sacrifice was taken away, and the place of his sanctuary was cast down.

entries.yo: A si fi ogun le e lọwọ pẹlu ẹbọ ojojumọ nitori irekọja, o si ja otitọ lulẹ, o si nṣe eyi, o si nri rere.
entries.en: And an host was given him against the daily sacrifice by reason of transgression, and it cast down the truth to the ground; and it practised, and prospered.

entries.yo: Mo si gbọ́ ẹni-mimọ́ ti nsọ̀rọ; ẹni-mimọ́ kan si wi fun ẹnikan ti nsọ̀rọ pe, Iran na niti ẹbọ ojojumọ, ati ti irekọja isọdahoro, ani lati fi ibi-mimọ́ ati ogun fun ni ni itẹmọlẹ yio ti pẹ to?
entries.en: Then I heard one saint speaking, and another saint said unto that certain saint which spake, How long shall be the vision concerning the daily sacrifice, and the transgression of desolation, to give both the sanctuary and the host to be trodden under foot?

entries.yo: O si wi fun mi pe, titi fi di ọgbọnkanla le ọgọrun ti alẹ ti owurọ: nigbana ni a o si yà ibi-mimọ́ si mimọ́.
entries.en: And he said unto me, Unto two thousand and three hundred days; then shall the sanctuary be cleansed.

entries.yo: O si ṣe ti emi, ani emi Danieli si ti ri iran na, ti mo si nfẹ imọ̀ idi rẹ̀, si kiyesi i, ẹnikan duro niwaju mi, gẹgẹ bi aworan ọkunrin.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when I, even I Daniel, had seen the vision, and sought for the meaning, then, behold, there stood before me as the appearance of a man.

entries.yo: Emi si gbọ́ ohùn enia kan lãrin odò Ulai, ti o pè, ti o si wi pe, Gabrieli, mu ki eleyi moye iran na.
entries.en: And I heard a man's voice between the banks of Ulai, which called, and said, Gabriel, make this man to understand the vision.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li o si wá sibi ti mo duro: nigbati o si de, ẹ̀ru bà mi, mo si da oju mi bolẹ: ṣugbọn o wi fun mi pe, Kiyesi i, ọmọ enia: nitoripe ti akokò igba ikẹhin ni iran na iṣe.
entries.en: So he came near where I stood: and when he came, I was afraid, and fell upon my face: but he said unto me, Understand, O son of man: for at the time of the end shall be the vision.

entries.yo: Njẹ bi o ti mba mi sọ̀rọ, mo dãmu, mo si doju bolẹ: ṣugbọn o fi ọwọ kàn mi, o si gbé mi dide duro si ipò mi.
entries.en: Now as he was speaking with me, I was in a deep sleep on my face toward the ground: but he touched me, and set me upright.

entries.yo: O si wipe, kiyesi i, emi o mu ọ mọ̀ ohun ti yio ṣe ni igba ikẹhin ibinu na: nitoripe, akokò igba ikẹhin ni eyi iṣe.
entries.en: And he said, Behold, I will make thee know what shall be in the last end of the indignation: for at the time appointed the end shall be.

entries.yo: Agbò na ti iwọ ri ti o ni iwo meji nì, awọn ọba Media ati Persia ni nwọn.
entries.en: The ram which thou sawest having two horns are the kings of Media and Persia.

entries.yo: Obukọ onirun nì li ọba Hellene: iwo nla ti o wà lãrin oju rẹ̀ mejeji li ọba ekini.
entries.en: And the rough goat is the king of Grecia: and the great horn that is between his eyes is the first king.

entries.yo: Njẹ bi eyini si ti ṣẹ́, ti iwo mẹrin miran si dide duro nipò rẹ̀, ijọba mẹrin ni yio dide ninu orilẹ-ède na, ṣugbọn kì yio ṣe ninu agbara rẹ̀.
entries.en: Now that being broken, whereas four stood up for it, four kingdoms shall stand up out of the nation, but not in his power.

entries.yo: Li akokò ikẹhin ijọba wọn, nigbati awọn oluṣe irekọja ba de ni kíkun, li ọba kan yio dide, ti oju rẹ̀ buru, ti o si moye ọ̀rọ arekereke.
entries.en: And in the latter time of their kingdom, when the transgressors are come to the full, a king of fierce countenance, and understanding dark sentences, shall stand up.

entries.yo: Agbara rẹ̀ yio si le gidigidi, ṣugbọn kì iṣe agbara ti on tikararẹ̀: on o si ma ṣe iparun ti o yani lẹnu, yio si ma ri rere ninu iṣẹ, yio si pa awọn alagbara ati awọn enia ẹni-mimọ́ run.
entries.en: And his power shall be mighty, but not by his own power: and he shall destroy wonderfully, and shall prosper, and practise, and shall destroy the mighty and the holy people.

entries.yo: Ati nipa arekereke rẹ̀ yio si mu ki iṣẹ ẹ̀tan ṣe dẽde lọwọ rẹ̀; on o si gbé ara rẹ̀ ga li ọkàn rẹ̀, lojiji ni yio si pa ọ̀pọlọpọ run, yio dide si olori awọn ọmọ-alade nì; ṣugbọn on o ṣẹ́ laisi ọwọ.
entries.en: And through his policy also he shall cause craft to prosper in his hand; and he shall magnify himself in his heart, and by peace shall destroy many: he shall also stand up against the Prince of princes; but he shall be broken without hand.

entries.yo: Ati iran ti alẹ ati ti owurọ ti a ti sọ, otitọ ni; sibẹ, iwọ sé iran na mọ, nitoripe fun ọjọ pipọ ni.
entries.en: And the vision of the evening and the morning which was told is true: wherefore shut thou up the vision; for it shall be for many days.

entries.yo: Arẹ̀ si mu emi Danieli, ara mi si ṣe alaida niwọn ọjọ melokan; lẹhin na, mo dide, mo si nṣe iṣẹ ọba; ẹ̀ru si bà mi, nitori iran na, ṣugbọn kò si ẹni ti o fi ye mi.
entries.en: And I Daniel fainted, and was sick certain days; afterward I rose up, and did the king's business; and I was astonished at the vision, but none understood it.

entries.yo: LI ọdun kini Dariusi, ọmọ Ahasuerusi, lati iru-ọmọ awọn ara Media wá, ti a fi jọba lori ilẹ-ọba awọn ara Kaldea;
entries.en: In the first year of Darius the son of Ahasuerus, of the seed of the Medes, which was made king over the realm of the Chaldeans;

entries.yo: Li ọdun kini ijọba rẹ̀ li emi Danieli fiyesi lati inu iwe, iye ọdun, nipa eyi ti ọ̀rọ Oluwa tọ Jeremiah, woli wá, pe adọrin ọdun li on o mu pé lori idahoro Jerusalemu.
entries.en: In the first year of his reign I Daniel understood by books the number of the years, whereof the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah the prophet, that he would accomplish seventy years in the desolations of Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Emi si kọju mi si Oluwa Ọlọrun, lati ma ṣafẹri nipa adura ati ẹ̀bẹ, pẹlu àwẹ, ninu aṣọ-ọ̀fọ, ati ẽru.
entries.en: And I set my face unto the Lord God, to seek by prayer and supplication, with fasting, and sackcloth, and ashes:

entries.yo: Emi si gbadura si Oluwa Ọlọrun mi, mo si ṣe ijẹwọ mi, mo si wipe, Oluwa, iwọ Ọlọrun ti o tobi, ti o si li ẹ̀ru, ti npa majẹmu ati ãnu mọ́ fun awọn ti o fẹ ẹ, ati fun awọn ti o pa ofin rẹ̀ mọ́;
entries.en: And I prayed unto the LORD my God, and made my confession, and said, O Lord, the great and dreadful God, keeping the covenant and mercy to them that love him, and to them that keep his commandments;

entries.yo: Awa ti ṣẹ̀, awa si ti nda ẹ̀ṣẹ, awa si ti ṣe buburu gidigidi, awa si ti ṣọ̀tẹ, ani nipa kikuro ninu ẹkọ́ rẹ, ati idajọ rẹ:
entries.en: We have sinned, and have committed iniquity, and have done wickedly, and have rebelled, even by departing from thy precepts and from thy judgments:

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li awa kò si fi eti si awọn iranṣẹ rẹ, awọn woli, ti o sọ̀rọ li orukọ rẹ fun awọn ọba wa, awọn ọmọ-alade wa, ati awọn baba wa, ati fun gbogbo awọn enia ilẹ wa.
entries.en: Neither have we hearkened unto thy servants the prophets, which spake in thy name to our kings, our princes, and our fathers, and to all the people of the land.

entries.yo: Oluwa tirẹ li ododo, ṣugbọn tiwa ni itiju, gẹgẹ bi o ti ri loni; fun awọn enia Juda, ati fun awọn olugbe Jerusalemu, ati fun gbogbo Israeli, ti o sunmọ tosi, ati awọn ti o jina rére; ni gbogbo ilẹkilẹ, nibiti o gbe ti le wọn rè, nitori ẹ̀ṣẹ wọn ti nwọn ti ṣẹ̀ si ọ.
entries.en: O Lord, righteousness belongeth unto thee, but unto us confusion of faces, as at this day; to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and unto all Israel, that are near, and that are far off, through all the countries whither thou hast driven them, because of their trespass that they have trespassed against thee.

entries.yo: Oluwa, tiwa ni itiju, ti awọn ọba wa, ati awọn olori wa, ati ti awọn baba wa, nitori ti awa ti ṣọ̀tẹ si ọ.
entries.en: O Lord, to us belongeth confusion of face, to our kings, to our princes, and to our fathers, because we have sinned against thee.

entries.yo: Sibẹ ti Oluwa Ọlọrun wa li ãnu ati idariji bi awa tilẹ ṣọ̀tẹ si i;
entries.en: To the Lord our God belong mercies and forgivenesses, though we have rebelled against him;

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li awa kò si gbà ohùn Oluwa Ọlọrun wa gbọ́, lati ma rìn nipa ofin ti o gbé kalẹ niwaju wa lati ọwọ awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀, awọn woli wá.
entries.en: Neither have we obeyed the voice of the LORD our God, to walk in his laws, which he set before us by his servants the prophets.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni gbogbo Israeli ti ṣẹ̀ si ofin rẹ, ani nipa kikuro, ki nwọn ki o máṣe gbà ohùn rẹ gbọ́; nitorina li a ṣe yi egún dà si ori wa, ati ibura na ti a kọ sinu ofin Mose, iranṣẹ Ọlọrun, nitori ti awa ti ṣẹ̀ si i.
entries.en: Yea, all Israel have transgressed thy law, even by departing, that they might not obey thy voice; therefore the curse is poured upon us, and the oath that is written in the law of Moses the servant of God, because we have sinned against him.

entries.yo: On si mu ọ̀rọ rẹ̀ ṣẹ, eyi ti o sọ si wa, ati si awọn onidajọ wa ti o nṣe idajọ fun wa, nipa eyi ti o fi mu ibi nla bá wa: iru eyi ti a kò ti iṣe si gbogbo abẹ ọrun, gẹgẹ bi a ti ṣe sori Jerusalemu.
entries.en: And he hath confirmed his words, which he spake against us, and against our judges that judged us, by bringing upon us a great evil: for under the whole heaven hath not been done as hath been done upon Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi a ti kọ ọ ninu ofin Mose, gbogbo ibi wọnyi wá sori wa: bẹ̃li awa kò si wá ojurere niwaju Oluwa, Ọlọrun wa, ki awa ki o le yipada kuro ninu ẹ̀ṣẹ wa, ki a si moye otitọ rẹ.
entries.en: As it is written in the law of Moses, all this evil is come upon us: yet made we not our prayer before the LORD our God, that we might turn from our iniquities, and understand thy truth.

entries.yo: Nitorina li Oluwa ṣe fiyesi ibi na, ti o si mu u wá sori wa; nitoripe olododo li Oluwa Ọlọrun wa ni gbogbo iṣẹ rẹ̀ ti o nṣe: ṣugbọn awa kò gbà ohùn rẹ̀ gbọ́.
entries.en: Therefore hath the LORD watched upon the evil, and brought it upon us: for the LORD our God is righteous in all his works which he doeth: for we obeyed not his voice.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, Oluwa Ọlọrun wa, iwọ ti o ti fi ọwọ agbara mu awọn enia rẹ jade lati Egipti wá, ti iwọ si ti gba orukọ fun ara rẹ gẹgẹ bi o ti wà loni: awa ti ṣẹ̀, awa si ti ṣe buburu gidigidi.
entries.en: And now, O Lord our God, that hast brought thy people forth out of the land of Egypt with a mighty hand, and hast gotten thee renown, as at this day; we have sinned, we have done wickedly.

entries.yo: Oluwa, gẹgẹ bi gbogbo ododo rẹ, lõtọ, jẹ ki ibinu ati irunu rẹ yi kuro lori Jerusalemu, ilu rẹ, òke mimọ́ rẹ: nitori ẹ̀ṣẹ wa, ati ẹ̀ṣẹ awọn baba wa ni Jerusalemu, ati awọn enia rẹ fi di ẹ̀gan si gbogbo awọn ti o yi wa ka.
entries.en: O Lord, according to all thy righteousness, I beseech thee, let thine anger and thy fury be turned away from thy city Jerusalem, thy holy mountain: because for our sins, and for the iniquities of our fathers, Jerusalem and thy people are become a reproach to all that are about us.

entries.yo: Njẹ nitorina, Ọlọrun wa, gbọ́ adura ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ, ati ẹ̀bẹ rẹ̀, ki o si mu ki oju rẹ ki o mọlẹ si ibi-mimọ́ rẹ ti o dahoro, nitori ti Oluwa.
entries.en: Now therefore, O our God, hear the prayer of thy servant, and his supplications, and cause thy face to shine upon thy sanctuary that is desolate, for the Lord's sake.

entries.yo: Tẹ eti rẹ silẹ, Ọlọrun mi, ki o si gbọ́: ṣi oju rẹ, ki o si wò idahoro wa, ati ilu ti a nfi orukọ rẹ pè: nitoriti awa kò gbé ẹ̀bẹ wa kalẹ niwaju rẹ nitori ododo wa, ṣugbọn nitori ọ̀pọlọpọ ãnu rẹ nla.
entries.en: O my God, incline thine ear, and hear; open thine eyes, and behold our desolations, and the city which is called by thy name: for we do not present our supplications before thee for our righteousnesses, but for thy great mercies.

entries.yo: Oluwa, gbọ́, Oluwa, dariji: Oluwa, tẹ eti rẹ silẹ ki o si ṣe; máṣe jafara, nitori ti iwọ tikararẹ, Ọlọrun mi: nitori orukọ rẹ li a fi npè ilu rẹ, ati awọn enia rẹ.
entries.en: O Lord, hear; O Lord, forgive; O Lord, hearken and do; defer not, for thine own sake, O my God: for thy city and thy people are called by thy name.

entries.yo: Bi emi si ti nwi, ti emi ngbadura, ati bi emi si ti njẹwọ ẹṣẹ mi, ati ẹ̀ṣẹ Israeli awọn enia mi, ti emi si ngbé ẹbẹ mi kalẹ niwaju Oluwa, Ọlọrun mi, nitori òke mimọ́ Ọlọrun mi.
entries.en: And whiles I was speaking, and praying, and confessing my sin and the sin of my people Israel, and presenting my supplication before the LORD my God for the holy mountain of my God;

entries.yo: Bẹni, bi mo ti nwi lọwọ ninu adura mi, ọkunrin na, Gabrieli ti mo ti ri ni iran mi li atetekọṣe, li a mu lati fò wá kankan, o de ọdọ mi niwọn akokò ẹbọ aṣãlẹ.
entries.en: Yea, whiles I was speaking in prayer, even the man Gabriel, whom I had seen in the vision at the beginning, being caused to fly swiftly, touched me about the time of the evening oblation.

entries.yo: O mu mi mọ̀, o si mba mi sọ̀rọ wipe, Danieli, mo jade wá nisisiyi lati fi oye fun ọ.
entries.en: And he informed me, and talked with me, and said, O Daniel, I am now come forth to give thee skill and understanding.

entries.yo: Ni ipilẹṣẹ ẹ̀bẹ rẹ li ọ̀rọ ti jade wá, emi si wá lati fi hàn fun ọ, nitoriti iwọ iṣe ayanfẹ gidigidi: nitorina, moye ọ̀ran na, ki o si kiyesi iran na.
entries.en: At the beginning of thy supplications the commandment came forth, and I am come to shew thee; for thou art greatly beloved: therefore understand the matter, and consider the vision.

entries.yo: Adọrin ọ̀sẹ li a pinnu sori awọn enia rẹ, ati sori ilu mimọ́ rẹ, lati ṣe ipari irekọja, ati lati fi edidi di ẹ̀ṣẹ, ati lati ṣe ilaja fun aiṣedẽde ati lati mu ododo ainipẹkun wá ati lati ṣe edidi iran ati woli, ati lati fi ororo yàn Ẹni-mimọ́ julọ nì.
entries.en: Seventy weeks are determined upon thy people and upon thy holy city, to finish the transgression, and to make an end of sins, and to make reconciliation for iniquity, and to bring in everlasting righteousness, and to seal up the vision and prophecy, and to anoint the most Holy.

entries.yo: Nitorina ki iwọ ki o mọ̀, ki o si ye ọ, pe lati ijade lọ ọ̀rọ na lati tun Jerusalemu ṣe, ati lati tun u kọ́, titi de igba ọmọ-alade Ẹni-ororo na, yio jẹ ọ̀sẹ meje, ati ọ̀sẹ mejilelọgọta: a o si tun igboro rẹ̀ ṣe, a o mọdi rẹ̀, ṣugbọn ni igba wahala.
entries.en: Know therefore and understand, that from the going forth of the commandment to restore and to build Jerusalem unto the Messiah the Prince shall be seven weeks, and threescore and two weeks: the street shall be built again, and the wall, even in troublous times.

entries.yo: Lẹhin ọ̀sẹ mejilelọgọta na li a o ke Ẹni-ororo na kuro, kì yio si si ẹnikan fun u, ati awọn enia ọmọ-alade kan ti yio wá ni yio pa ilu na ati ibi-mimọ́ run; opin ẹniti mbọ yio dabi ikún omi, ati ogun titi de opin, eyi ni ipari idahoro.
entries.en: And after threescore and two weeks shall Messiah be cut off, but not for himself: and the people of the prince that shall come shall destroy the city and the sanctuary; and the end thereof shall be with a flood, and unto the end of the war desolations are determined.

entries.yo: On o si fi idi majẹmu kan mulẹ fun ọ̀pọlọpọ niwọn ọ̀sẹ kan: ati lãrin ọ̀sẹ na ni yio mu ki a dẹkun ẹbọ, ati ọrẹ-ẹbọ, irira isọdahoro yio si duro lori ibi-mimọ́ titi idajọ ti a pinnu yio túdà sori asọnidahoro.
entries.en: And he shall confirm the covenant with many for one week: and in the midst of the week he shall cause the sacrifice and the oblation to cease, and for the overspreading of abominations he shall make it desolate, even until the consummation, and that determined shall be poured upon the desolate.

entries.yo: LI ọdun kẹta Kirusi, ọba Persia, li a fi ọ̀rọ kan hàn fun Danieli, orukọ ẹniti ijẹ Belteṣassari; otitọ li ọ̀rọ na, ati lãla na tobi, o si mọ̀ ọ̀rọ na, o si moye iran na.
entries.en: In the third year of Cyrus king of Persia a thing was revealed unto Daniel, whose name was called Belteshazzar; and the thing was true, but the time appointed was long: and he understood the thing, and had understanding of the vision.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ wọnni li emi Danieli fi ikãnu ṣọ̀fọ li ọ̀sẹ mẹta gbako.
entries.en: In those days I Daniel was mourning three full weeks.

entries.yo: Emi kò jẹ onjẹ ti o dara, bẹ̃ni kò si si ẹran tabi ọti-waini ti o wá si ẹnu mi, bẹ̃li emi kò fi ororo kùn ara mi rara, titi ọ̀sẹ mẹta na fi pe.
entries.en: I ate no pleasant bread, neither came flesh nor wine in my mouth, neither did I anoint myself at all, till three whole weeks were fulfilled.

entries.yo: Nigbati o di ọjọ kẹrinlelogun oṣu kini, bi mo ti wà li eti odò nla, ti ijẹ Hiddekeli;
entries.en: And in the four and twentieth day of the first month, as I was by the side of the great river, which is Hiddekel;

entries.yo: Nigbana ni mo gbé oju mi soke, mo wò, si kiyesi i, ọkunrin kan ti o wọ̀ aṣọ àla, ẹ̀gbẹ ẹniti a fi wura Ufasi daradara dì li àmure:
entries.en: Then I lifted up mine eyes, and looked, and behold a certain man clothed in linen, whose loins were girded with fine gold of Uphaz:

entries.yo: Ara rẹ̀ pẹlu dabi okuta berili, oju rẹ̀ si dabi manamána, ẹyinju rẹ̀ dabi iná fitila, apa ati ẹsẹ rẹ̀ li awọ̀ ti o dabi idẹ ti a wẹ̀ dan, ohùn ọ̀rọ ẹnu rẹ̀ si dabi ohùn ijọ enia pupọ.
entries.en: His body also was like the beryl, and his face as the appearance of lightning, and his eyes as lamps of fire, and his arms and his feet like in colour to polished brass, and the voice of his words like the voice of a multitude.

entries.yo: Emi Danieli nikanṣoṣo li o si ri iran na, awọn ọkunrin ti o si wà pẹlu mi kò ri iran na; ṣugbọn ìwariri nlanla dà bò wọn, tobẹ̃ ti nwọn fi sá lọ lati fi ara wọn pamọ́.
entries.en: And I Daniel alone saw the vision: for the men that were with me saw not the vision; but a great quaking fell upon them, so that they fled to hide themselves.

entries.yo: Nitorina emi nikan li o kù, ti mo si ri iran nla yi, kò si kù agbara ninu mi: ẹwà mi si yipada lara mi di ibajẹ, emi kò si lagbara mọ.
entries.en: Therefore I was left alone, and saw this great vision, and there remained no strength in me: for my comeliness was turned in me into corruption, and I retained no strength.

entries.yo: Sibẹ mo gbọ́ ohùn ọ̀rọ rẹ̀: nigbati mo si gbọ́ ohùn ọ̀rọ rẹ̀, nigbana ni mo dãmu, mo si wà ni idojubolẹ̀.
entries.en: Yet heard I the voice of his words: and when I heard the voice of his words, then was I in a deep sleep on my face, and my face toward the ground.

entries.yo: Sa si kiyesi i, ọwọ kan kàn mi, ti o gbé mi dide lori ẽkun mi, ati lori atẹlẹwọ mi.
entries.en: And, behold, an hand touched me, which set me upon my knees and upon the palms of my hands.

entries.yo: O si wi fun mi pe, Danieli, iwọ ọkunrin olufẹ gidigidi, ki oye ọ̀rọ ti mo nsọ fun ọ ki o ye ọ, ki o si duro ni ipò rẹ: nitoripe iwọ li a rán mi si nisisiyi. Nigbati on ti sọ̀rọ bayi fun mi, mo dide duro ni ìwariri.
entries.en: And he said unto me, O Daniel, a man greatly beloved, understand the words that I speak unto thee, and stand upright: for unto thee am I now sent. And when he had spoken this word unto me, I stood trembling.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni o wi fun mi pe, má bẹ̀ru, Danieli: lati ọjọ kini ti iwọ ti fi aiya rẹ si lati moye, ti iwọ si npọ́n ara rẹ loju niwaju Ọlọrun rẹ, a gbọ́ ọ̀rọ rẹ, emi si wá nitori ọ̀rọ rẹ.
entries.en: Then said he unto me, Fear not, Daniel: for from the first day that thou didst set thine heart to understand, and to chasten thyself before thy God, thy words were heard, and I am come for thy words.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn balogun ijọba Persia nì dè mi li ọ̀na li ọjọ mọkanlelogun: ṣugbọn, wò o, Mikaeli, ọkan ninu awọn olori balogun wá lati ràn mi lọwọ: emi si di ipò mi mu lọdọ awọn ọba Persia.
entries.en: But the prince of the kingdom of Persia withstood me one and twenty days: but, lo, Michael, one of the chief princes, came to help me; and I remained there with the kings of Persia.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, mo de lati mu ọ moye ohun ti yio ba awọn enia rẹ ni ikẹhin ọjọ: nitori ti ọjọ pipọ ni iran na iṣe.
entries.en: Now I am come to make thee understand what shall befall thy people in the latter days: for yet the vision is for many days.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si ti sọ iru ọ̀rọ bayi fun mi tan, mo dojukọ ilẹ mo si yadi.
entries.en: And when he had spoken such words unto me, I set my face toward the ground, and I became dumb.

entries.yo: Si wò o, ẹnikan ti jijọ rẹ̀ dabi ti awọn ọmọ enia fi ọwọ kan ète mi: nigbana ni mo ya ẹnu mi, mo si fọhùn, mo si wi fun ẹniti o duro tì mi pe, oluwa mi, niti iran na, irora mi pada sinu mi, emi kò si lagbara mọ.
entries.en: And, behold, one like the similitude of the sons of men touched my lips: then I opened my mouth, and spake, and said unto him that stood before me, O my lord, by the vision my sorrows are turned upon me, and I have retained no strength.

entries.yo: Nitoripé bawo ni ọmọ-ọdọ oluwa mi yi yio ti ṣe le ba oluwa mi yi sọ̀rọ? ṣugbọn bi o ṣe temi ni, lojukanna, agbara kò kù ninu mi, bẹ̃ni kò si kù ẽmi ninu mi.
entries.en: For how can the servant of this my lord talk with this my lord? for as for me, straightway there remained no strength in me, neither is there breath left in me.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ẹnikan ti o ni aworan enia wá o si tun fi ọwọ tọ́ mi, o si mu mi lara le,
entries.en: Then there came again and touched me one like the appearance of a man, and he strengthened me,

entries.yo: O si wipe, iwọ ọkunrin olufẹ gidigidi, má bẹ̀ru: alafia ni fun ọ, mu ara le. Ani mu ara le, Nigbati on ba mi sọ̀rọ, a si mu mi lara le, mo si wipe, Ki oluwa mi ki o ma sọ̀rọ, nitoriti iwọ ti mu mi lara le.
entries.en: And said, O man greatly beloved, fear not: peace be unto thee, be strong, yea, be strong. And when he had spoken unto me, I was strengthened, and said, Let my lord speak; for thou hast strengthened me.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni o wipe, Iwọ, ha mọ̀ idi ohun ti mo tọ̀ ọ wá si? nisisiyi li emi o si yipada lọ iba balogun Persia jà: nigbati emi ba si jade lọ, kiyesi i, balogun Hellene yio wá.
entries.en: Then said he, Knowest thou wherefore I come unto thee? and now will I return to fight with the prince of Persia: and when I am gone forth, lo, the prince of Grecia shall come.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi o fi eyi ti a kọ sinu iwe otitọ hàn ọ: kò si si ẹniti o ràn mi lọwọ si awọn wọnyi, bikoṣe Mikaeli balogun nyin.
entries.en: But I will shew thee that which is noted in the scripture of truth: and there is none that holdeth with me in these things, but Michael your prince.

entries.yo: PẸLUPẸLU li ọdun kini Dariusi ara Media, emi pãpa duro lati mu u lọkàn le, ati lati fi idi rẹ̀ kalẹ.
entries.en: Also I in the first year of Darius the Mede, even I, stood to confirm and to strengthen him.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi li emi o fi otitọ hàn ọ, Kiyesi i, ọba mẹta pẹlu ni yio dide ni Persia; ẹkẹrin yio si ṣe ọlọrọ̀ jù gbogbo wọn lọ: ati nipa agbara rẹ̀ ni yio fi fi ọrọ̀ rú gbogbo wọn soke si ijọba Hellene.
entries.en: And now will I shew thee the truth. Behold, there shall stand up yet three kings in Persia; and the fourth shall be far richer than they all: and by his strength through his riches he shall stir up all against the realm of Grecia.

entries.yo: Ọba alagbara kan yio si dide, yio si fi agbara nla ṣe akoso, yio si ma ṣe gẹgẹ bi ifẹ inu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And a mighty king shall stand up, that shall rule with great dominion, and do according to his will.

entries.yo: Nigbati on ba dide tan, ijọba rẹ̀ yio fọ́, a o si pin i si orígun mẹrẹrin ọrun; kì si iṣe fun ọmọ rẹ̀, pẹlupẹlu kì si iṣe ninu agbara rẹ̀ ti on fi jọba, nitoriti a o fa ijọba rẹ̀ tu, ani fun ẹlomiran lẹhin awọn wọnyi.
entries.en: And when he shall stand up, his kingdom shall be broken, and shall be divided toward the four winds of heaven; and not to his posterity, nor according to his dominion which he ruled: for his kingdom shall be plucked up, even for others beside those.

entries.yo: Ọba iha gusu yio si lagbara; ṣugbọn ọkan ninu awọn balogun rẹ̀, on o si lagbara jù u lọ, yio si jọba, ijọba rẹ̀ yio jẹ ijọba nla.
entries.en: And the king of the south shall be strong, and one of his princes; and he shall be strong above him, and have dominion; his dominion shall be a great dominion.

entries.yo: Lẹhin ọdun pipọ nwọn o si kó ara wọn jọ pọ̀; ọmọbinrin ọba gusu yio wá sọdọ ọba ariwa, lati ba a dá majẹmu: ṣugbọn on kì yio le di agbara apá na mu; bẹ̃ni on kì yio le duro, tabi apá rẹ̀: ṣugbọn a o fi on silẹ, ati awọn ti o mu u wá, ati ẹni ti o bi i, ati ẹniti nmu u lọkàn le li akokò ti o kọja.
entries.en: And in the end of years they shall join themselves together; for the king's daughter of the south shall come to the king of the north to make an agreement: but she shall not retain the power of the arm; neither shall he stand, nor his arm: but she shall be given up, and they that brought her, and he that begat her, and he that strengthened her in these times.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ninu ẹka gbòngbo rẹ̀ li ẹnikan yio dide ni ipò rẹ̀, ẹniti yio wá pẹlu ogun, yio si wọ̀ ilu-olodi ọba ariwa, yio si ba wọn ṣe, yio si bori.
entries.en: But out of a branch of her roots shall one stand up in his estate, which shall come with an army, and shall enter into the fortress of the king of the north, and shall deal against them, and shall prevail:

entries.yo: On o si kó oriṣa wọn pẹlu ere didà wọn, ati ohunelo wọn daradara, ti fadaka, ati ti wura ni igbekun lọ si Egipti; on o si duro li ọdun melokan kuro lọdọ ọba ariwa.
entries.en: And shall also carry captives into Egypt their gods, with their princes, and with their precious vessels of silver and of gold; and he shall continue more years than the king of the north.

entries.yo: On o si lọ si ijọba ọba gusu, ṣugbọn yio yipada si ilẹ ontikararẹ̀.
entries.en: So the king of the south shall come into his kingdom, and shall return into his own land.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ yio ru soke, nwọn o si gbá ogun nla ọ̀pọlọpọ enia jọ; ẹnikan yio wọle wá, yio si bolẹ̀, yio si kọja lọ. Nigbana ni yio pada yio si gbé ogun lọ si ilu olodi rẹ̀.
entries.en: But his sons shall be stirred up, and shall assemble a multitude of great forces: and one shall certainly come, and overflow, and pass through: then shall he return, and be stirred up, even to his fortress.

entries.yo: Ọba gusu yio si fi ibinu ru soke, yio si jade wá ba a jà, ani, ọba ariwa na: on o si kó enia pipọ jọ; ṣugbọn a o fi ọ̀pọlọpọ na le e lọwọ.
entries.en: And the king of the south shall be moved with choler, and shall come forth and fight with him, even with the king of the north: and he shall set forth a great multitude; but the multitude shall be given into his hand.

entries.yo: Yio si kó ọ̀pọlọpọ na lọ, ọkàn rẹ̀ yio si gbé soke; on o si bì ọ̀pọlọpọ ẹgbãrun enia ṣubu; ṣugbọn a kì yio fi ẹsẹ rẹ̀ mulẹ nipa eyi.
entries.en: And when he hath taken away the multitude, his heart shall be lifted up; and he shall cast down many ten thousands: but he shall not be strengthened by it.

entries.yo: Nitoripe ọba ariwa yio si yipada, yio si kó ọ̀pọlọpọ enia jọ ti yio pọ̀ jù ti iṣaju lọ, yio si wá lẹhin ọdun melokan pẹlu ogun nla, ati ọ̀pọlọpọ ọrọ̀.
entries.en: For the king of the north shall return, and shall set forth a multitude greater than the former, and shall certainly come after certain years with a great army and with much riches.

entries.yo: Li akoko wọnni li ọ̀pọlọpọ yio si dide si ọba gusu; awọn ọlọ̀tẹ ninu awọn enia rẹ̀ yio si gbé ara wọn ga lati fi ẹsẹ iran na mulẹ pẹlu: ṣugbọn nwọn o ṣubu.
entries.en: And in those times there shall many stand up against the king of the south: also the robbers of thy people shall exalt themselves to establish the vision; but they shall fall.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li ọba ariwa yio si wá, yio si mọdi, yio si gbà ilu olodi; apá ogun ọba gusu kì yio le duro, ati awọn ayanfẹ enia rẹ̀, bẹ̃ni kì yio si agbara lati da a duro.
entries.en: So the king of the north shall come, and cast up a mount, and take the most fenced cities: and the arms of the south shall not withstand, neither his chosen people, neither shall there be any strength to withstand.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹniti o tọ̀ ọ wá yio mã ṣe gẹgẹ bi ifẹ inu ara rẹ̀, kì yio si si ẹniti yio duro niwaju rẹ̀; on o si duro ni ilẹ daradara nì, ti yio si fi ọwọ rẹ̀ parun.
entries.en: But he that cometh against him shall do according to his own will, and none shall stand before him: and he shall stand in the glorious land, which by his hand shall be consumed.

entries.yo: On o si gbé oju rẹ̀ soke lati wọ̀ ọ nipa agbara gbogbo ijọba rẹ̀, yio si ba a dá majẹmu, bẹ̃ni yio ṣe; on o si fi ọmọbinrin awọn obinrin fun u, lati bà a jẹ: ṣugbọn on kì yio duro, bẹ̃ni kì yio si ṣe tirẹ̀.
entries.en: He shall also set his face to enter with the strength of his whole kingdom, and upright ones with him; thus shall he do: and he shall give him the daughter of women, corrupting her: but she shall not stand on his side, neither be for him.

entries.yo: Lẹhin eyi, yio kọ oju rẹ̀ si erekuṣu wọnni, yio si gbà ọ̀pọlọpọ: ṣugbọn balogun kan fun ara rẹ̀, yio fi opin si ẹ̀gan rẹ̀: ati nipò eyi, yio mu ẹ̀gan rẹ̀ pada wá sori ara rẹ̀.
entries.en: After this shall he turn his face unto the isles, and shall take many: but a prince for his own behalf shall cause the reproach offered by him to cease; without his own reproach he shall cause it to turn upon him.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni yio si yi oju rẹ̀ pada si ilu olodi ontikararẹ̀: ṣugbọn yio kọsẹ, yio si ṣubu, a kì yio si ri i mọ.
entries.en: Then he shall turn his face toward the fort of his own land: but he shall stumble and fall, and not be found.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ẹnikan yio dide ni ipò rẹ̀ ti yio mu agbowode kan rekọja ninu ogo ijọba (ilẹ Juda): ṣugbọn niwọn ijọ melokan li a o si pa a run, kì yio ṣe nipa ibinu tabi loju ogun.
entries.en: Then shall stand up in his estate a raiser of taxes in the glory of the kingdom: but within few days he shall be destroyed, neither in anger, nor in battle.

entries.yo: Ni ipò rẹ̀ li enia lasan kan yio dide, ẹniti nwọn kì yio fi ọlá ọba fun: ṣugbọn yio wá lojiji, yio si fi arekereke gbà ijọba.
entries.en: And in his estate shall stand up a vile person, to whom they shall not give the honour of the kingdom: but he shall come in peaceably, and obtain the kingdom by flatteries.

entries.yo: Ogun ti mbò ni mọlẹ li a o fi bò wọn mọlẹ niwaju rẹ̀, a o si fọ ọ tũtu, ati pẹlu ọmọ-alade majẹmu kan.
entries.en: And with the arms of a flood shall they be overflown from before him, and shall be broken; yea, also the prince of the covenant.

entries.yo: Ati lẹhin igbati a ba ti ba a ṣe ipinnu tan, yio fi ẹ̀tan ṣiṣẹ: yio si gòke lọ, yio si fi enia diẹ bori.
entries.en: And after the league made with him he shall work deceitfully: for he shall come up, and shall become strong with a small people.

entries.yo: Yio si wọ̀ gbogbo ibi igberiko ọlọra; yio si ṣe ohun ti awọn baba rẹ̀ kò ṣe ri, tabi awọn baba nla rẹ̀; yio si fọn ikogun, ìfa, ati ọ̀pọlọpọ ọrọ̀ ká si ãrin wọn: yio si gbèro tẹlẹ si ilu olodi, ani titi akokò kan.
entries.en: He shall enter peaceably even upon the fattest places of the province; and he shall do that which his fathers have not done, nor his fathers' fathers; he shall scatter among them the prey, and spoil, and riches: yea, and he shall forecast his devices against the strong holds, even for a time.

entries.yo: Yio si rú agbara ati igboya rẹ̀ soke si ọba gusu ti on ti ogun nla; a o si rú ọba gusu soke si ija pẹlu ogun nlanla ati alagbara pupọ; ṣugbọn on kì yio le duro: nitori nwọn o gba èro tẹlẹ si i.
entries.en: And he shall stir up his power and his courage against the king of the south with a great army; and the king of the south shall be stirred up to battle with a very great and mighty army; but he shall not stand: for they shall forecast devices against him.

entries.yo: Awọn ẹniti o jẹ ninu adidùn rẹ̀ ni yio si pa a run, ogun rẹ̀ yio si tàn kalẹ; ọ̀pọlọpọ ni yio si ṣubu ni pipa.
entries.en: Yea, they that feed of the portion of his meat shall destroy him, and his army shall overflow: and many shall fall down slain.

entries.yo: Ọkàn awọn ọba mejeji wọnyi ni yio wà lati ṣe buburu, nwọn o si mã sọ̀rọ eké lori tabili kan, ṣugbọn kì yio jẹ rere; nitoripe opin yio wà li akokò ti a pinnu.
entries.en: And both these kings' hearts shall be to do mischief, and they shall speak lies at one table; but it shall not prosper: for yet the end shall be at the time appointed.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni yio pada lọ si ilẹ ontikararẹ̀ ti on ti ọrọ̀ pupọ: ọkàn rẹ̀ yio si lodi si majẹmu mimọ́ nì, yio ṣe e, yio si pada lọ si ilẹ ontikararẹ̀.
entries.en: Then shall he return into his land with great riches; and his heart shall be against the holy covenant; and he shall do exploits, and return to his own land.

entries.yo: Yio si pada wá li akokò ti a pinnu, yio si wá si iha gusu; ṣugbọn kì yio ri bi ti iṣaju, ni ikẹhin.
entries.en: At the time appointed he shall return, and come toward the south; but it shall not be as the former, or as the latter.

entries.yo: Nitoripe ọkọ̀ awọn ara Kittimu yio tọ̀ ọ wá, nitorina ni yio ṣe dãmu, yio si yipada, yio si ni ibinu si majẹmu mimọ́ nì; bẹ̃ni yio ṣe; ani on o yipada, yio si tun ni idapọ pẹlu awọn ti o kọ̀ majẹmu mimọ́ na silẹ.
entries.en: For the ships of Chittim shall come against him: therefore he shall be grieved, and return, and have indignation against the holy covenant: so shall he do; he shall even return, and have intelligence with them that forsake the holy covenant.

entries.yo: Agbara ogun yio si duro li apa tirẹ̀, nwọn o si sọ ibi mimọ́, ani ilu olodi na di aimọ́, nwọn o si mu ẹbọ ojojumọ kuro, nwọn o si gbé irira isọdahoro nì kalẹ.
entries.en: And arms shall stand on his part, and they shall pollute the sanctuary of strength, and shall take away the daily sacrifice, and they shall place the abomination that maketh desolate.

entries.yo: Ati iru awọn ti nṣe buburu si majẹmu nì ni yio fi ọ̀rọ ipọnni mu ṣọ̀tẹ: ṣugbọn awọn enia ti o mọ̀ Ọlọrun yio mu ọkàn le, nwọn o si ma ṣe iṣẹ agbara.
entries.en: And such as do wickedly against the covenant shall he corrupt by flatteries: but the people that do know their God shall be strong, and do exploits.

entries.yo: Awọn ti o moye ninu awọn enia yio ma kọ́ ọ̀pọlọpọ: ṣugbọn nwọn o ma ti ipa oju idà ṣubu, ati nipa iná, ati nipa igbekun, ati nipa ikogun nijọmelo kan.
entries.en: And they that understand among the people shall instruct many: yet they shall fall by the sword, and by flame, by captivity, and by spoil, many days.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, nigbati nwọn o ṣubu, a o fi iranlọwọ diẹ ràn wọn lọwọ: ṣugbọn ọ̀pọlọpọ ni yio fi ẹ̀tan fi ara mọ́ wọn.
entries.en: Now when they shall fall, they shall be holpen with a little help: but many shall cleave to them with flatteries.

entries.yo: Awọn ẹlomiran ninu awọn ti o moye yio si ṣubu, lati dan wọn wò, ati lati wẹ̀ wọn mọ́, ati lati sọ wọn di funfun, ani titi fi di akokò opin: nitoripe yio wà li akokò ti a pinnu.
entries.en: And some of them of understanding shall fall, to try them, and to purge, and to make them white, even to the time of the end: because it is yet for a time appointed.

entries.yo: Ọba na yio si ma ṣe gẹgẹ bi ifẹ inu rẹ̀; on o si gbé ara rẹ̀ ga, yio si gbéra rẹ̀ ga jù gbogbo ọlọrun lọ, yio si ma sọ̀rọ ohun iyanu si Ọlọrun awọn ọlọrun, yio si ma ṣe rere titi a o fi pari ibinu: nitori a o mu eyi ti a ti pinnu rẹ̀ ṣẹ.
entries.en: And the king shall do according to his will; and he shall exalt himself, and magnify himself above every god, and shall speak marvellous things against the God of gods, and shall prosper till the indignation be accomplished: for that that is determined shall be done.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li on kì yio si kà Ọlọrun awọn baba rẹ̀ si, tabi ifẹ awọn obinrin, on kì yio si kà ọlọrun kan si: nitoriti yio gbé ara rẹ̀ ga jù ẹni gbogbo lọ.
entries.en: Neither shall he regard the God of his fathers, nor the desire of women, nor regard any god: for he shall magnify himself above all.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ni ipò rẹ̀, yio ma bu ọlá fun ọlọrun awọn ilu olodi, ani ọlọrun kan ti awọn baba rẹ̀ kò mọ̀ ri ni yio ma fi wura, ati fadaka, ati okuta iyebiye, ati ohun daradara bu ọlá fun.
entries.en: But in his estate shall he honour the God of forces: and a god whom his fathers knew not shall he honour with gold, and silver, and with precious stones, and pleasant things.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ gẹgẹ ni yio ṣe ninu ilu olodi wọnni ti o lagbara julọ nipa iranlọwọ ọlọrun ajeji, ẹniti o jẹ́wọ rẹ̀ ni yio fi ogo fun, ti yio si mu ṣe alakoso ọ̀pọlọpọ, yio si pín ilẹ fun li ère.
entries.en: Thus shall he do in the most strong holds with a strange god, whom he shall acknowledge and increase with glory: and he shall cause them to rule over many, and shall divide the land for gain.

entries.yo: Li akokò opin, ọba gusu yio kàn a, ọba ariwa yio si fi kẹkẹ́, ati ẹlẹṣin, ati ọ̀pọlọpọ ọkọ̀, kọ lu u bi afẹyika-ìji: on o si wọ̀ ilẹ wọnni yio si bò wọn mọlẹ, yio si rekọja.
entries.en: And at the time of the end shall the king of the south push at him: and the king of the north shall come against him like a whirlwind, with chariots, and with horsemen, and with many ships; and he shall enter into the countries, and shall overflow and pass over.

entries.yo: Yio si wọ̀ ilẹ ologo nì pẹlu, ọ̀pọlọpọ li a o si bì ṣubu: ṣugbọn awọn wọnyi ni yio si bọ lọwọ rẹ̀, ani Edomu, ati Moabu, ati olori awọn ọmọ Ammoni.
entries.en: He shall enter also into the glorious land, and many countries shall be overthrown: but these shall escape out of his hand, even Edom, and Moab, and the chief of the children of Ammon.

entries.yo: On o si nà ọwọ rẹ̀ jade si ilẹ wọnni pẹlu, ilẹ Egipti kì yio si là a.
entries.en: He shall stretch forth his hand also upon the countries: and the land of Egypt shall not escape.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn on o lagbara lori iṣura wura, ati ti fadaka, ati lori gbogbo ohun daradara ni ilẹ Egipti: ati awọn ara Libia, awọn ara Etiopia yio si wà lẹhin rẹ̀.
entries.en: But he shall have power over the treasures of gold and of silver, and over all the precious things of Egypt: and the Libyans and the Ethiopians shall be at his steps.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ìhin lati ila-õrùn, ati lati iwọ-õrùn wá yio dãmu rẹ̀: nitorina ni yio ṣe fi ìbinu nla jade lọ lati ma parun, ati lati mu ọ̀pọlọpọ kuro patapata.
entries.en: But tidings out of the east and out of the north shall trouble him: therefore he shall go forth with great fury to destroy, and utterly to make away many.

entries.yo: On o si pagọ ãfin rẹ̀ lãrin omi kọju si òke mimọ́ ologo nì; ṣugbọn on o si de opin rẹ̀, kì yio si si ẹniti yio ràn a lọwọ.
entries.en: And he shall plant the tabernacles of his palace between the seas in the glorious holy mountain; yet he shall come to his end, and none shall help him.

entries.yo: LI akoko na ni Mikaeli, balogun nla nì, ti yio gbeja awọn ọmọ awọn enia rẹ yio dide, akokò wahala yio si wà, iru eyi ti kò ti isi ri, lati igba ti orilẹ-ède ti wà titi fi di igba akokò yi, ati ni igba akokò na li a o gbà awọn enia rẹ la, ani gbogbo awọn ti a ti kọ orukọ wọn sinu iwe.
entries.en: And at that time shall Michael stand up, the great prince which standeth for the children of thy people: and there shall be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time: and at that time thy people shall be delivered, every one that shall be found written in the book.

entries.yo: Ati ọ̀pọlọpọ ninu awọn ti o sùn ninu erupẹ ilẹ ni yio ji, awọn miran si ìye ainipẹkun, ati awọn miran si itiju ati ẹ̀gan ainipẹkun.
entries.en: And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.

entries.yo: Awọn ọlọgbọ́n yio si ma tàn bi imọlẹ ofurufu: awọn ti o si nyi ọ̀pọlọpọ pada si ododo yio si ma tàn bi irawọ̀ lai ati lailai.
entries.en: And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn iwọ, Danieli sé ọ̀rọ na mọhun, ki o si fi edidi di iwe na, titi fi di igba ikẹhin: ọ̀pọlọpọ ni yio ma wadi rẹ̀, ìmọ yio si di pupọ.
entries.en: But thou, O Daniel, shut up the words, and seal the book, even to the time of the end: many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall be increased.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni emi Danieli wò, si kiyesi i, awọn meji miran si duro: ọ̀kan lapa ihín eti odò, ati ekeji lapa ọhún eti odò.
entries.en: Then I Daniel looked, and, behold, there stood other two, the one on this side of the bank of the river, and the other on that side of the bank of the river.

entries.yo: Ẹnikan si wi fun ọkunrin na ti o wọ̀ aṣọ àla ti o duro lori omi odò pe, opin ohun iyanu wọnyi yio ti pẹ to?
entries.en: And one said to the man clothed in linen, which was upon the waters of the river, How long shall it be to the end of these wonders?

entries.yo: Emi si gbọ́, ọkunrin na ti o wọ̀ aṣọ àla, ti o duro loju omi odò na, o gbé ọwọ ọtún ati ọwọ òsi rẹ̀ si ọrun, o si fi Ẹniti o wà titi lai nì bura pe, yio jẹ akokò kan, awọn akokò, ati ãbọ akokò; nigbati yio si ti ṣe aṣepe ifunka awọn enia mimọ́, gbogbo nkan wọnyi li a o si pari.
entries.en: And I heard the man clothed in linen, which was upon the waters of the river, when he held up his right hand and his left hand unto heaven, and sware by him that liveth for ever that it shall be for a time, times, and an half; and when he shall have accomplished to scatter the power of the holy people, all these things shall be finished.

entries.yo: Emi si gbọ́, ṣugbọn kò ye mi: nigbana ni mo wipe, Oluwa mi, kini yio ṣe ikẹhin wọnyi?
entries.en: And I heard, but I understood not: then said I, O my Lord, what shall be the end of these things?

entries.yo: O si wipe, Ma ba ọ̀na rẹ lọ, Danieli, nitoriti a ti se ọ̀rọ na mọ sọhún, a si fi edidi di i titi fi di igba ikẹhin.
entries.en: And he said, Go thy way, Daniel: for the words are closed up and sealed till the time of the end.

entries.yo: Ọ̀pọlọpọ li a o wẹ̀ mọ́, nwọn o si di funfun, a o si dan wọn wò: ṣugbọn awọn ẹni-buburu yio ma ṣe buburu: gbogbo awọn enia buburu kì yio kiyesi i; ṣugbọn awọn ọlọgbọ́n ni yio kiyesi i.
entries.en: Many shall be purified, and made white, and tried; but the wicked shall do wickedly: and none of the wicked shall understand; but the wise shall understand.

entries.yo: Ati lati igba akokò ti a o mu ẹbọ ojojumọ kuro, ati lati gbé irira isọdahoro kalẹ, yio jẹ ẹgbẹrun ati igba le ãdọrun ọjọ.
entries.en: And from the time that the daily sacrifice shall be taken away, and the abomination that maketh desolate set up, there shall be a thousand two hundred and ninety days.

entries.yo: Ibukún ni fun ẹniti o duro dè, ti o si de ẹgbẹrun, ati ọdurun le marundilogoji ọjọ nì.
entries.en: Blessed is he that waiteth, and cometh to the thousand three hundred and five and thirty days.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn iwọ ma ba ọ̀na rẹ lọ, titi opin yio fi de, iwọ o si simi, iwọ o si dide duro ni ipo rẹ ni ikẹhin ọjọ.
entries.en: But go thou thy way till the end be: for thou shalt rest, and stand in thy lot at the end of the days.

entries.yo: Ọ̀RỌ Oluwa ti o tọ̀ Hosea, ọmọ Beeri wá, li ọjọ Ussiah, Jotamu, Ahasi, ati Hesekiah, awọn ọba Juda, ati li ọjọ Jeroboamu ọmọ Joaṣi, ọba Israeli.
entries.en: The word of the LORD that came unto Hosea, the son of Beeri, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel.

entries.yo: Ibẹ̀rẹ ọ̀rọ Oluwa si Hosea. Oluwa si wi fun Hosea, pe, Lọ, fẹ́ agbère obinrin kan fun ara rẹ, ati awọn ọmọ agbère; nitori ilẹ yi ti ṣe agbère gidigidi, kuro lẹhin Oluwa.
entries.en: The beginning of the word of the LORD by Hosea. And the LORD said to Hosea, Go, take unto thee a wife of whoredoms and children of whoredoms: for the land hath committed great whoredom, departing from the LORD.

entries.yo: O si lọ o si fẹ́ Gomeri ọmọbinrin Diblaimu; ẹniti o loyún, ti o si bi ọmọkunrin kan fun u.
entries.en: So he went and took Gomer the daughter of Diblaim; which conceived, and bare him a son.

entries.yo: Oluwa si wi fun u pe, Pè orukọ rẹ̀ ni Jesreeli; nitori niwọ̀n igbà diẹ, emi o bẹ̀ ẹ̀jẹ Jesreeli wò li ara ile Jehu, emi o si mu ki ijọba ile Israeli kasẹ̀.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto him, Call his name Jezreel; for yet a little while, and I will avenge the blood of Jezreel upon the house of Jehu, and will cause to cease the kingdom of the house of Israel.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe li ọjọ na, li emi o ṣẹ́ ọrun Israeli ni afonifojì Jesreeli.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass at that day, that I will break the bow of Israel in the valley of Jezreel.

entries.yo: O si tún loyún, o si bi ọmọbinrin kan. Ọlọrun si wi fun u pe, Pè orukọ rẹ̀ li Loruhama: nitori emi kì yio tún ma ṣãnu fun ile Israeli mọ, nitoriti emi o mu wọn kuro.
entries.en: And she conceived again, and bare a daughter. And God said unto him, Call her name Lo-ruhamah: for I will no more have mercy upon the house of Israel; but I will utterly take them away.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi o ṣãnu fun ile Juda, emi o si fi Oluwa Ọlọrun wọn gbà wọn là, emi kì yio si fi ọrun, tabi idà, tabi ogun, ẹṣin, tabi ẹlẹṣin gbà wọn là.
entries.en: But I will have mercy upon the house of Judah, and will save them by the LORD their God, and will not save them by bow, nor by sword, nor by battle, by horses, nor by horsemen.

entries.yo: Nigbati o gbà ọmu li ẹnu Loruhama, o si loyún o si bi ọmọkunrin kan.
entries.en: Now when she had weaned Lo-ruhamah, she conceived, and bare a son.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Ọlọrun wipe, Pè orukọ rẹ̀ ni Loammi; nitori ẹnyin kì iṣe enia mi, emi kì yio si ṣe Ọlọrun nyin.
entries.en: Then said God, Call his name Lo-ammi: for ye are not my people, and I will not be your God.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn iye awọn ọmọ Israeli yio ri bi iyanrìn okun, ti a kò le wọ̀n ti a kò si lè ikà; yio si ṣe, ni ibi ti a gbe ti wi fun wọn pe, Ẹnyin kì iṣe enia mi, ibẹ̀ li a o gbe wi fun wọn pe, Ẹnyin li ọmọ Ọlọrun alãyè.
entries.en: Yet the number of the children of Israel shall be as the sand of the sea, which cannot be measured nor numbered; and it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people, there it shall be said unto them, Ye are the sons of the living God.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni a o kó awọn ọmọ Juda ati awọn ọmọ Israeli jọ̀ pọ̀, nwọn o si yàn olori kan fun ara wọn, nwọn o si jade kuro ni ilẹ na: nitori nla ni ọjọ Jesreeli yio jẹ.
entries.en: Then shall the children of Judah and the children of Israel be gathered together, and appoint themselves one head, and they shall come up out of the land: for great shall be the day of Jezreel.

entries.yo: Ẹ wi fun awọn arakunrin nyin, Ammi; ati fun awọn arabinrin nyin, Ruhama.
entries.en: Say ye unto your brethren, Ammi; and to your sisters, Ru-hamah.

entries.yo: Ẹ ba iya nyin wijọ, ẹ wijọ; nitori on kì iṣe aya mi, bẹ̃ni emi kì iṣe ọkọ rẹ̀: nitori na jẹ ki on ki o mu gbogbo agberè rẹ̀ kuro ni iwaju rẹ̀, ati gbogbo panṣaga rẹ̀ kuro larin ọyàn rẹ̀.
entries.en: Plead with your mother, plead: for she is not my wife, neither am I her husband: let her therefore put away her whoredoms out of her sight, and her adulteries from between her breasts;

entries.yo: Ki emi má ba tú u si ihòho, emi o si gbe e kalẹ bi ọjọ ti a bi i, emi o si ṣe e bi ijù, emi o si gbe e kalẹ bi ilẹ gbigbẹ, emi o si fi ongbẹ pa a kú.
entries.en: Lest I strip her naked, and set her as in the day that she was born, and make her as a wilderness, and set her like a dry land, and slay her with thirst.

entries.yo: Emi kì yio si ṣãnu fun awọn ọmọ rẹ̀; nitoriti nwọn jẹ́ ọmọ agbère.
entries.en: And I will not have mercy upon her children; for they be the children of whoredoms.

entries.yo: Nitoriti iya wọn ti hùwa agbère: ẹniti o loyun wọn ti ṣe ohun itiju: nitori ti o wipe, Emi o tun tọ̀ awọn ayànfẹ́ mi lẹhìn, ti nfun mi ni onjẹ mi ati omi mi, irun agùtan mi ati ọgbọ̀ mi, ororo mi, ati ohun mimu mi.
entries.en: For their mother hath played the harlot: she that conceived them hath done shamefully: for she said, I will go after my lovers, that give me my bread and my water, my wool and my flax, mine oil and my drink.

entries.yo: Nitorina kiyesi i, emi o fi ẹgún sagbàra yi ọ̀na rẹ̀ ka, emi o si mọ odi, ti on kì yio fi ri ọ̀na rẹ̀ mọ.
entries.en: Therefore, behold, I will hedge up thy way with thorns, and make a wall, that she shall not find her paths.
