entries.yo: On o si lepa awọn ayànfẹ́ rẹ̀, ṣugbọn kì yio le ba wọn; on o si wá wọn, ṣugbọn kì yio ri wọn: nigbana ni yio wipe, Emi o padà tọ̀ ọkọ mi iṣãju lọ; nitoriti o sàn fun mi nigbana jù ti isisiyi lọ.
entries.en: And she shall follow after her lovers, but she shall not overtake them; and she shall seek them, but shall not find them: then shall she say, I will go and return to my first husband; for then was it better with me than now.

entries.yo: Nitori on kò ti mọ̀ pe emi li ẹniti o fun u li ọkà, ati ọti-waini titun, ati ororo; ti mo si mu fàdakà ati wurà rẹ̀ pọ̀ si i, ti nwọn fi ṣe Baali.
entries.en: For she did not know that I gave her corn, and wine, and oil, and multiplied her silver and gold, which they prepared for Baal.

entries.yo: Nitorina li emi o ṣe padà, emi o si mu ọkà mi kuro li akokò rẹ̀, ati ọti-waini mi ni igbà rẹ̀, emi o si gbà irun agùtan ati ọgbọ̀ mi padà, ti mo ti fi fun u lati bò ihòho rẹ̀.
entries.en: Therefore will I return, and take away my corn in the time thereof, and my wine in the season thereof, and will recover my wool and my flax given to cover her nakedness.

entries.yo: Nisisiyi li emi o ṣi itiju rẹ̀ silẹ li oju awọn ayànfẹ́ rẹ̀, ẹnikẹni kì yio si gbà a lọwọ mi.
entries.en: And now will I discover her lewdness in the sight of her lovers, and none shall deliver her out of mine hand.

entries.yo: Emi o si mu ki gbogbo ayọ̀ rẹ̀ de opin, ọjọ asè rẹ̀, oṣù titun rẹ̀, ati ọjọ isimi rẹ̀, gbogbo ọjọ ọ̀wọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: I will also cause all her mirth to cease, her feast days, her new moons, and her sabbaths, and all her solemn feasts.

entries.yo: Emi o si pa ajàra rẹ̀ ati igi ọpọ̀tọ rẹ̀ run, niti awọn ti o ti wipe, Awọn wọnyi li èrè mi ti awọn ayànfẹ́ mi ti fi fun mi; emi o si sọ wọn di igbo, awọn ẹranko igbẹ yio si jẹ wọn.
entries.en: And I will destroy her vines and her fig trees, whereof she hath said, These are my rewards that my lovers have given me: and I will make them a forest, and the beasts of the field shall eat them.

entries.yo: Emi o si bẹ̀ ọjọ Baalimu wò li ara rẹ̀, ninu eyiti on fi turari joná fun wọn, ti on si fi oruka eti, ati ohun ọ̀ṣọ rẹ̀, ṣe ara rẹ̀ lọṣọ, ti on si tọ̀ awọn ayànfẹ́ lẹhìn lọ, ti on si gbagbe mi, ni Oluwa wi.
entries.en: And I will visit upon her the days of Baalim, wherein she burned incense to them, and she decked herself with her earrings and her jewels, and she went after her lovers, and forgat me, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Nitorina, kiyesi i, emi o tàn a, emi o si mu u wá si aginjù, emi o si sọ̀rọ itùnu fun u.
entries.en: Therefore, behold, I will allure her, and bring her into the wilderness, and speak comfortably unto her.

entries.yo: Emi o si fun u ni ọgbà àjara rẹ̀ lati ibẹ̀ wá, ati afonifojì Akori fun ilẹ̀kun ireti: on o si kọrin nibẹ̀, bi li ọjọ ewe rẹ̀, ati bi li ọjọ ti o jade lati ilẹ Egipti wá.
entries.en: And I will give her her vineyards from thence, and the valley of Achor for a door of hope: and she shall sing there, as in the days of her youth, and as in the day when she came up out of the land of Egypt.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe li ọjọ na, iwọ o pè mi ni Iṣi; iwọ kì yio si pè mi ni Baali mọ, ni Oluwa wi,
entries.en: And it shall be at that day, saith the LORD, that thou shalt call me Ishi; and shalt call me no more Baali.

entries.yo: Nitori emi o mu orukọ awọn Baali kuro li ẹnu rẹ̀, a kì yio si fi orukọ wọn ranti wọn mọ́.
entries.en: For I will take away the names of Baalim out of her mouth, and they shall no more be remembered by their name.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ na li emi o si fi awọn ẹranko igbẹ, ati ẹiyẹ oju ọrun, ati ohun ti nrakò lori ilẹ da majẹmu fun wọn, emi o si ṣẹ́ ọrun ati idà ati ogun kuro ninu aiye, emi o si mu wọn dubulẹ li ailewu.
entries.en: And in that day will I make a covenant for them with the beasts of the field, and with the fowls of heaven, and with the creeping things of the ground: and I will break the bow and the sword and the battle out of the earth, and will make them to lie down safely.

entries.yo: Emi o si fẹ́ ọ fun ara mi titi lai; nitõtọ, emi o si fẹ́ ọ fun ara mi ni ododo, ni idajọ, ati ni iyọ́nu, ati ni ãnu.
entries.en: And I will betroth thee unto me for ever; yea, I will betroth thee unto me in righteousness, and in judgment, and in lovingkindness, and in mercies.

entries.yo: Emi o tilẹ fẹ́ ọ fun ara mi ni otitọ, iwọ o si mọ̀ Oluwa.
entries.en: I will even betroth thee unto me in faithfulness: and thou shalt know the LORD.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe li ọjọ na, emi o dahùn, emi o dá awọn ọrun li ohùn, nwọn o si da aiye lohùn; li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, I will hear, saith the LORD, I will hear the heavens, and they shall hear the earth;

entries.yo: Ilẹ yio si dá ọkà, ati ọti-waini, ati ororo, li ohùn; nwọn o si dá Jesreeli li ohùn.
entries.en: And the earth shall hear the corn, and the wine, and the oil; and they shall hear Jezreel.

entries.yo: Emi o si gbìn i fun ara mi lori ilẹ, emi o si ṣãnu fun ẹniti kò ti ri ãnu gbà; emi o si wi fun awọn ti kì iṣe enia mi pe, Iwọ li enia mi; on o si wipe, Iwọ li Ọlọrun mi.
entries.en: And I will sow her unto me in the earth; and I will have mercy upon her that had not obtained mercy; and I will say to them which were not my people, Thou art my people; and they shall say, Thou art my God.

entries.yo: OLUWA sí wi fun mi pe, Tun lọ, fẹ́ obinrin kan ti iṣe olùfẹ́ ọrẹ rẹ̀, ati panṣagà, gẹgẹ bi ifẹ Oluwa si awọn ọmọ Israeli, ti nwò awọn ọlọrun miràn, ti nwọn si nfẹ́ akàra eso àjara.
entries.en: Then said the LORD unto me, Go yet, love a woman beloved of her friend, yet an adulteress, according to the love of the LORD toward the children of Israel, who look to other gods, and love flagons of wine.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni mo rà a fun ara mi ni fadakà mẹ̃dogun, ati homeri barli kan pẹlu ãbọ̀:
entries.en: So I bought her to me for fifteen pieces of silver, and for an homer of barley, and an half homer of barley:

entries.yo: Mo si wi fun u pe, Iwọ o ba mi gbe li ọjọ pupọ̀; iwọ kì yio si hùwa agbère, iwọ kì yio si jẹ ti ọkunrin miràn: bẹ̃li emi o jẹ tirẹ pẹlu.
entries.en: And I said unto her, Thou shalt abide for me many days; thou shalt not play the harlot, and thou shalt not be for another man: so will I also be for thee.

entries.yo: Nitori ọjọ pupọ̀ li awọn ọmọ Israeli yio gbe li aini ọba, ati li aini olori, ati li aini ẹbọ, li aini ere, ati li aini awòaiyà, ati li aini tẹrafimu.
entries.en: For the children of Israel shall abide many days without a king, and without a prince, and without a sacrifice, and without an image, and without an ephod, and without teraphim:

entries.yo: Lẹhìn na awọn ọmọ Israeli yio padà, nwọn o si wá Oluwa Ọlọrun wọn, ati Dafidi ọba wọn; nwọn o si bẹ̀ru Oluwa, ati ore rẹ̀ li ọjọ ikẹhìn.
entries.en: Afterward shall the children of Israel return, and seek the LORD their God, and David their king; and shall fear the LORD and his goodness in the latter days.

entries.yo: Ẹ gbọ́ ọ̀rọ Oluwa, ẹnyin ọmọ Israeli; nitori Oluwa ni ẹjọ kan ba awọn ara ilẹ na wi, nitoriti kò si otitọ, tabi ãnu, tabi ìmọ Ọlọrun ni ilẹ na.
entries.en: Hear the word of the LORD, ye children of Israel: for the LORD hath a controversy with the inhabitants of the land, because there is no truth, nor mercy, nor knowledge of God in the land.

entries.yo: Nipa ibura, ati eke, ati ipani, ati olè, ati iṣe panṣaga, nwọn gbìjà, ẹ̀jẹ si nkàn ẹ̀jẹ.
entries.en: By swearing, and lying, and killing, and stealing, and committing adultery, they break out, and blood toucheth blood.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni ilẹ na yio ṣe ṣọ̀fọ, ati olukuluku ẹniti ngbé inu rẹ̀ yio rọ, pẹlu awọn ẹranko igbẹ, ati pẹlu awọn ẹiyẹ oju ọrun; a o si mu awọn ẹja inu okun kuro pẹlu.
entries.en: Therefore shall the land mourn, and every one that dwelleth therein shall languish, with the beasts of the field, and with the fowls of heaven; yea, the fishes of the sea also shall be taken away.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn má jẹ ki ẹnikẹni ki o jà, tabi ki o ba ẹnikeji rẹ̀ wi: nitori awọn enia rẹ dabi awọn ti mba alufa jà.
entries.en: Yet let no man strive, nor reprove another: for thy people are as they that strive with the priest.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si ṣubu li ọ̀san, woli yio si ṣubu pẹlu rẹ li alẹ, emi o si ké iya rẹ kuro.
entries.en: Therefore shalt thou fall in the day, and the prophet also shall fall with thee in the night, and I will destroy thy mother.

entries.yo: A ké awọn enia mi kuro nitori aini ìmọ: nitori iwọ ti kọ̀ ìmọ silẹ, emi o si kọ̀ ọ, ti iwọ kì yio ṣe alufa mi mọ: niwọ̀n bi iwọ ti gbagbe ofin Ọlọrun rẹ, emi pẹlu o gbagbe awọn ọmọ rẹ.
entries.en: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge: because thou hast rejected knowledge, I will also reject thee, that thou shalt be no priest to me: seeing thou hast forgotten the law of thy God, I will also forget thy children.

entries.yo: Bi a ti mu wọn pọ̀ si i to, bẹ̃ na ni nwọn si dẹ̀ṣẹ si mi to: nitorina emi o yi ogo wọn padà si itìju.
entries.en: As they were increased, so they sinned against me: therefore will I change their glory into shame.

entries.yo: Nwọn jẹ ẹ̀ṣẹ awọn enia mi, nwọn si gbe ọkàn wọn si aiṣedẽde wọn.
entries.en: They eat up the sin of my people, and they set their heart on their iniquity.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, gẹgẹ bi enia, bẹ̃li alufa: emi o si bẹ̀ wọn wò nitori ọ̀na wọn, emi o si san èrè iṣẹ wọn padà fun wọn.
entries.en: And there shall be, like people, like priest: and I will punish them for their ways, and reward them their doings.

entries.yo: Nwọn o si jẹ, nwọn kì o si yó: nwọn o ṣe agbère, nwọn kì o si rẹ̀: nitori nwọn ti fi ati-kiyesi Oluwa silẹ.
entries.en: For they shall eat, and not have enough: they shall commit whoredom, and shall not increase: because they have left off to take heed to the LORD.

entries.yo: Agbère ati ọti-waini, ati ọti-waini titun a ma gbà enia li ọkàn.
entries.en: Whoredom and wine and new wine take away the heart.

entries.yo: Awọn enia mi mbère ìmọ lọwọ igi wọn, ọpá wọn si nfi hàn fun wọn: nitori ẹmi agbère ti mu wọn ṣìna, nwọn si ti ṣe agbère lọ kuro labẹ Ọlọrun wọn.
entries.en: My people ask counsel at their stocks, and their staff declareth unto them: for the spirit of whoredoms hath caused them to err, and they have gone a whoring from under their God.

entries.yo: Nwọn rubọ lori awọn oke-nla, nwọn si sun turari lori awọn oke kékèké, labẹ igi oaku ati igi poplari ati igi ẹlmu, nitoriti ojìji wọn dara: nitorina awọn ọmọbinrin nyin yio ṣe agbère, ati awọn afẹ́sọnà nyin yio ṣe panṣagà.
entries.en: They sacrifice upon the tops of the mountains, and burn incense upon the hills, under oaks and poplars and elms, because the shadow thereof is good: therefore your daughters shall commit whoredom, and your spouses shall commit adultery.

entries.yo: Emi kì yio ba awọn ọmọbinrin nyin wi nigbati nwọn ba ṣe agbère, tabi awọn afẹ́sọnà nyin nigbati nwọn ba ṣe panṣagà: nitori nwọn yà si apakan pẹlu awọn agbère, nwọn si mba awọn panṣagà rubọ̀: nitorina awọn enia ti kò ba moye yio ṣubu.
entries.en: I will not punish your daughters when they commit whoredom, nor your spouses when they commit adultery: for themselves are separated with whores, and they sacrifice with harlots: therefore the people that doth not understand shall fall.

entries.yo: Bi iwọ, Israeli, ba ṣe agbère, máṣe jẹ ki Juda ṣẹ̀; ẹ má si wá si Gilgali, bẹ̃ni ki ẹ má si goke lọ si Bet-afeni, bẹ̃ni ki ẹ má si bura pe, Oluwa mbẹ.
entries.en: Though thou, Israel, play the harlot, yet let not Judah offend; and come not ye unto Gilgal, neither go ye up to Beth-aven, nor swear, The LORD liveth.

entries.yo: Nitori Israeli ṣe agidi bi ọmọ malu alagidi; nisisiyi Oluwa yio bọ́ wọn bi ọdọ-agùtan ni ibi ayè nla.
entries.en: For Israel slideth back as a backsliding heifer: now the LORD will feed them as a lamb in a large place.

entries.yo: Efraimu dapọ̀ mọ òriṣa: jọwọ rẹ̀ si.
entries.en: Ephraim is joined to idols: let him alone.

entries.yo: Ohun mimu wọn di kikan: nwọn ṣe agbère gidigidi; awọn olori rẹ̀ fẹ itìju, ẹ bun u li ayè.
entries.en: Their drink is sour: they have committed whoredom continually: her rulers with shame do love, Give ye.

entries.yo: Afẹfẹ ti dè e pẹlu mọ iyẹ́ apa rẹ̀, nwọn o si tíju nitori ẹbọ wọn.
entries.en: The wind hath bound her up in her wings, and they shall be ashamed because of their sacrifices.

entries.yo: Ẹ gbọ́ eyi, ẹnyin alufa: si tẹtilelẹ ẹnyin ile Israeli; ki ẹ si gbọ́, ile ọba na; nitori idajọ kàn nyin, nitoriti ẹnyin ti jẹ ẹgẹ́ si Mispa, àwọn ti a nà silẹ lori Tabori.
entries.en: Hear ye this, O priests; and hearken, ye house of Israel; and give ye ear, O house of the king; for judgment is toward you, because ye have been a snare on Mizpah, and a net spread upon Tabor.

entries.yo: Awọn ọlọ̀tẹ si jinlẹ ni pipanirun, emi o jẹ olùbawi gbogbo wọn.
entries.en: And the revolters are profound to make slaughter, though I have been a rebuker of them all.

entries.yo: Emi mọ̀ Efraimu, Israeli kò si pamọ́ fun mi: nitori nisisiyi, Efraimu, iwọ ṣe agbère, Israeli si dibajẹ.
entries.en: I know Ephraim, and Israel is not hid from me: for now, O Ephraim, thou committest whoredom, and Israel is defiled.

entries.yo: Iṣe wọn kì o jọ̀wọ wọn lati yipadà si Ọlọrun wọn: nitori ẹmi agbère wà lãrin wọn, nwọn kò si mọ̀ Oluwa.
entries.en: They will not frame their doings to turn unto their God: for the spirit of whoredoms is in the midst of them, and they have not known the LORD.

entries.yo: A si rẹ̀ ogo Israeli silẹ loju ara rẹ̀; nitorina ni Israeli ati Efraimu yio ṣubu ninu aiṣedẽde wọn, Juda yio si ṣubu pẹlu wọn.
entries.en: And the pride of Israel doth testify to his face: therefore shall Israel and Ephraim fall in their iniquity; Judah also shall fall with them.

entries.yo: Nwọn o lọ ti awọn ti agbo-ẹran wọn ati ọ̀wọ ẹran wọn lati wá Oluwa: ṣugbọn nwọn kì o ri i, on ti fà ara rẹ̀ sẹhìn kuro lọdọ wọn.
entries.en: They shall go with their flocks and with their herds to seek the LORD; but they shall not find him; he hath withdrawn himself from them.

entries.yo: Nwọn ti hùwa arekerekè si Oluwa: nitori nwọn ti bi ajèji ọmọ: nisisiyi li oṣù titun yio jẹ wọn run, pẹlu ipin wọn.
entries.en: They have dealt treacherously against the LORD: for they have begotten strange children: now shall a month devour them with their portions.

entries.yo: Ẹ fun korneti ni Gibea, ati ipè ni Rama; kigbe kikan ni Bet-afeni, lẹhìn rẹ, iwọ Benjamini.
entries.en: Blow ye the cornet in Gibeah, and the trumpet in Ramah: cry aloud at Beth-aven, after thee, O Benjamin.

entries.yo: Efraimu yio di ahoro li ọjọ ibawi: ninu awọn ẹyà Israeli li emi ti fi ohun ti o wà nitõtọ hàn.
entries.en: Ephraim shall be desolate in the day of rebuke: among the tribes of Israel have I made known that which shall surely be.

entries.yo: Awọn olori Juda dàbi awọn ti o yẹ̀ oju àla: lara wọn li emi o tú ibinu mi si bi omi.
entries.en: The princes of Judah were like them that remove the bound: therefore I will pour out my wrath upon them like water.

entries.yo: A tẹ̀ ori Efraimu ba, a si ṣẹgun rẹ̀ ninu idajọ, nitoriti on mọ̃mọ̀ tẹ̀le ofin na.
entries.en: Ephraim is oppressed and broken in judgment, because he willingly walked after the commandment.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni emi o ṣe dabi kòkoro aṣọ si Efraimu, ati si ile Juda bi idin.
entries.en: Therefore will I be unto Ephraim as a moth, and to the house of Judah as rottenness.

entries.yo: Nigbati Efraimu ri arùn rẹ̀, ti Juda si ri ọgbẹ́ rẹ̀, nigbana ni Efraimu tọ̀ ara Assiria lọ, o si ranṣẹ si ọba Jarebu; ṣugbọn on kò le mu ọ lara da, bẹ̃ni kò le wò ọgbẹ́ rẹ jiná.
entries.en: When Ephraim saw his sickness, and Judah saw his wound, then went Ephraim to the Assyrian, and sent to king Jareb: yet could he not heal you, nor cure you of your wound.

entries.yo: Nitori emi o dàbi kiniun si Efraimu, ati bi ọmọ kiniun si ile Juda, emi, ani emi o fàya, emi o si lọ, emi o mu lọ, ẹnikẹni kì yio si gbà a silẹ.
entries.en: For I will be unto Ephraim as a lion, and as a young lion to the house of Judah: I, even I, will tear and go away; I will take away, and none shall rescue him.

entries.yo: Emi o padà lọ si ipò mi, titi nwọn o fi jẹwọ ẹ̀ṣẹ wọn, ti nwọn o si wá oju mi: ninu ipọnju wọn, nwọn o wá mi ni kùtukùtu.
entries.en: I will go and return to my place, till they acknowledge their offence, and seek my face: in their affliction they will seek me early.

entries.yo: Ẹ wá, ẹ jẹ ki a yipadà si Oluwa: nitori o ti fà wa ya, on o si mu wa lara da; o ti lù wa, yio si tun wa dì.
entries.en: Come, and let us return unto the LORD: for he hath torn, and he will heal us; he hath smitten, and he will bind us up.

entries.yo: Lẹhìn ijọ meji, yio tún wa jí: ni ijọ kẹta yio ji wa dide, awa o si wà lãyè niwaju rẹ̀.
entries.en: After two days will he revive us: in the third day he will raise us up, and we shall live in his sight.

entries.yo: Nigbana li awa o mọ̀, bi a ba tẹramọ́ ati mọ̀ Oluwa: ati pèse ijadelọ rẹ̀ bi owùrọ: on o si tọ̀ wa wá bi ojò: bi arọ̀kuro ati akọrọ̀ òjo si ilẹ.
entries.en: Then shall we know, if we follow on to know the LORD: his going forth is prepared as the morning; and he shall come unto us as the rain, as the latter and former rain unto the earth.

entries.yo: Efraimu, kili emi o ṣe si ọ? Juda, kili emi o ṣe si ọ? nitori ore nyin dàbi ikuku owurọ̀, ati bi ìri kùtukùtu ti o kọja lọ.
entries.en: O Ephraim, what shall I do unto thee? O Judah, what shall I do unto thee? for your goodness is as a morning cloud, and as the early dew it goeth away.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni mo ṣe fi ãké ké wọn lati ọwọ awọn woli; mo ti fi ọ̀rọ ẹnu mi pa wọn: ki idajọ rẹ le ri bi imọlẹ ti o jade lọ.
entries.en: Therefore have I hewed them by the prophets; I have slain them by the words of my mouth: and thy judgments are as the light that goeth forth.

entries.yo: Nitori ãnu ni mo fẹ́, ki iṣe ẹbọ; ati ìmọ Ọlọrun jù ọrẹ-ẹbọ sisun lọ.
entries.en: For I desired mercy, and not sacrifice; and the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi Adamu nwọn ti dá majẹmu kọja: nibẹ̀ ni nwọn ti ṣẹ̀tan si mi.
entries.en: But they like men have transgressed the covenant: there have they dealt treacherously against me.

entries.yo: Gileadi ni ilu awọn ti nṣiṣẹ ẹ̀ṣẹ, a si ti fi ẹ̀jẹ bà a jẹ.
entries.en: Gilead is a city of them that work iniquity, and is polluted with blood.

entries.yo: Ati gẹgẹ bi ọwọ́ olè iti lùmọ dè enia, bẹ̃ni ẹgbẹ́ awọn alufa fohùnṣọ̀kan lati pania li ọ̀na: nitori nwọn dá ẹ̀ṣẹ nla.
entries.en: And as troops of robbers wait for a man, so the company of priests murder in the way by consent: for they commit lewdness.

entries.yo: Mo ti ri ohun buburu kan ni ile Israeli: agbère Efraimu wà nibẹ̀, Israeli ti bajẹ.
entries.en: I have seen an horrible thing in the house of Israel: there is the whoredom of Ephraim, Israel is defiled.

entries.yo: Iwọ Juda pẹlu, on ti gbe ikorè kalẹ fun ọ, nigbati mo ba yi igbekun awọn enia mi padà.
entries.en: Also, O Judah, he hath set an harvest for thee, when I returned the captivity of my people.

entries.yo: NIGBATI emi iba mu Israeli li ara dá, nigbana ni ẹ̀ṣẹ Efraimu fi ara hàn, ati ìwa-buburu Samaria; nitori nwọn ṣeké; olè si wọle, ọwọ́ olè si nkoni lode.
entries.en: When I would have healed Israel, then the iniquity of Ephraim was discovered, and the wickedness of Samaria: for they commit falsehood; and the thief cometh in, and the troop of robbers spoileth without.

entries.yo: Nwọn kò si rò li ọkàn wọn pe, emi ranti gbogbo ìwa-buburu wọn: nisisiyi iṣẹ ara wọn duro yi wọn ka; nwọn wà niwaju mi.
entries.en: And they consider not in their hearts that I remember all their wickedness: now their own doings have beset them about; they are before my face.

entries.yo: Nwọn fi ìwa-buburu wọn mu ki ọba yọ̀; nwọn si fi eké wọn mu awọn ọmọ-alade yọ̀.
entries.en: They make the king glad with their wickedness, and the princes with their lies.

entries.yo: Gbogbo nwọn ni panṣagà, bi ãrò ti alakàra mu gboná, ti o dawọ́ kikoná duro, lẹhìn igbati o ti pò iyẹ̀fun tan, titi yio fi wú.
entries.en: They are all adulterers, as an oven heated by the baker, who ceaseth from raising after he hath kneeded the dough, until it be leavened.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ ọba wa, awọn ọmọ-alade ti fi oru ọti-waini mu u ṣaisàn; o nà ọwọ́ rẹ̀ jade pẹlu awọn ẹlẹgàn.
entries.en: In the day of our king the princes have made him sick with bottles of wine; he stretched out his hand with scorners.

entries.yo: Nitori nwọn ti mura ọkàn wọn silẹ bi ãrò, nigbati nwọn ba ni buba: alakàra wọn sùn ni gbogbo oru; li owurọ̀ o jo bi ọwọ́-iná.
entries.en: For they have made ready their heart like an oven, whiles they lie in wait: their baker sleepeth all the night; in the morning it burneth as a flaming fire.

entries.yo: Gbogbo wọn gboná bi ãrò, nwọn ti jẹ awọn onidajọ wọn run; gbogbo ọba wọn ṣubu: kò si ẹnikan ninu wọn ti o ke pè mi.
entries.en: They are all hot as an oven, and have devoured their judges; all their kings are fallen: there is none among them that calleth unto me.

entries.yo: Efraimu, on ti dà ara rẹ̀ pọ̀ mọ awọn enia na; Efraimu ni akàra ti a kò yipadà.
entries.en: Ephraim, he hath mixed himself among the people; Ephraim is a cake not turned.

entries.yo: Awọn alejò ti jẹ agbara rẹ̀ run, on kò si mọ̀: nitõtọ, ewú wà kakiri li ara rẹ̀, sibẹ̀ on kò mọ̀.
entries.en: Strangers have devoured his strength, and he knoweth it not: yea, gray hairs are here and there upon him, yet he knoweth not.

entries.yo: Igberaga Israeli si njẹri si i li oju rẹ̀; nwọn kò si yipadà si Oluwa Ọlọrun wọn, bẹ̃ni fun gbogbo eyi nwọn kò si wá a.
entries.en: And the pride of Israel testifieth to his face: and they do not return to the LORD their God, nor seek him for all this.

entries.yo: Efraimu pẹlu dabi òpe adàba ti kò li ọkàn; nwọn kọ si Egipti, nwọn lọ si Assiria.
entries.en: Ephraim also is like a silly dove without heart: they call to Egypt, they go to Assyria.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn o lọ, emi o nà àwọn mi le wọn; emi o mu wọn wá ilẹ bi ẹiyẹ oju-ọrun; emi o nà wọn, bi ijọ-enia wọn ti gbọ́.
entries.en: When they shall go, I will spread my net upon them; I will bring them down as the fowls of the heaven; I will chastise them, as their congregation hath heard.

entries.yo: Egbe ni fun wọn! nitori nwọn ti sá kuro lọdọ mi: iparun ni fun wọn! nitori nwọn ti ṣẹ̀ si mi: bi o tilẹ ṣepe mo ti rà wọn padà, ṣugbọn nwọn ti ṣe eké si mi.
entries.en: Woe unto them! for they have fled from me: destruction unto them! because they have transgressed against me: though I have redeemed them, yet they have spoken lies against me.

entries.yo: Nwọn kò si ti fi tọkàntọkàn ké pè mi, nigbati nwọn hu lori akete wọn: nwọn kó ara wọn jọ fun ọkà ati ọti-waini, nwọn si ṣọ̀tẹ si mi.
entries.en: And they have not cried unto me with their heart, when they howled upon their beds: they assemble themselves for corn and wine, and they rebel against me.

entries.yo: Bi mo ti dì, ti mo si fun apa wọn li okun, sibẹ̀ nwọn nrò ibi si mi.
entries.en: Though I have bound and strengthened their arms, yet do they imagine mischief against me.

entries.yo: Nwọn yipadà, ṣugbọn kì iṣe si Ọga-ogo: nwọn dàbi ọrun ẹtàn; awọn ọmọ-alade wọn yio tipa idà ṣubu, nitori irúnu ahọn wọn: eyi ni yio ṣe ẹsín wọn ni ilẹ Egipti.
entries.en: They return, but not to the most High: they are like a deceitful bow: their princes shall fall by the sword for the rage of their tongue: this shall be their derision in the land of Egypt.

entries.yo: FI ipè si ẹnu rẹ. Yio wá bi idì si ile Oluwa, nitori nwọn ti re majẹmu mi kọja, nwọn si ti rú ofin mi.
entries.en: Set the trumpet to thy mouth. He shall come as an eagle against the house of the LORD, because they have transgressed my covenant, and trespassed against my law.

entries.yo: Nwọn o kigbe si mi pe, Ọlọrun mi, awa Israeli mọ̀ ọ.
entries.en: Israel shall cry unto me, My God, we know thee.

entries.yo: Israeli ti gbe ohunrere sọnù; ọta yio lepa rẹ̀.
entries.en: Israel hath cast off the thing that is good: the enemy shall pursue him.

entries.yo: Nwọn ti fi ọba jẹ, ṣugbọn kì iṣe nipasẹ̀ mi: nwọn ti jẹ olori, ṣugbọn emi kò si mọ̀: fàdakà wọn ati wurà wọn ni nwọn fi ṣe òriṣa fun ara wọn, ki a ba le ké wọn kuro.
entries.en: They have set up kings, but not by me: they have made princes, and I knew it not: of their silver and their gold have they made them idols, that they may be cut off.

entries.yo: Ọmọ-malu rẹ ti ta ọ nù, Samaria; ibinu mi rú si wọn: yio ti pẹ to ki nwọn to de ipò ailẹ̀ṣẹ?
entries.en: Thy calf, O Samaria, hath cast thee off; mine anger is kindled against them: how long will it be ere they attain to innocency?

entries.yo: Nitori lati ọdọ Israeli wá li o ti ri bẹ̃ pẹlu; oniṣọ̀na li o ṣe e; nitorina on kì iṣe Ọlọrun: ṣugbọn ọmọ malu Samaria yio fọ tũtũ.
entries.en: For from Israel was it also: the workman made it; therefore it is not God: but the calf of Samaria shall be broken in pieces.

entries.yo: Nitori nwọn ti gbìn ẹfũfũ, nwọn o si ka ãjà: kò ni igi ọka: irúdi kì yio si mu onjẹ wá: bi o ba ṣepe o mu wá, alejò yio gbe e mì.
entries.en: For they have sown the wind, and they shall reap the whirlwind: it hath no stalk: the bud shall yield no meal: if so be it yield, the strangers shall swallow it up.

entries.yo: A gbe Israeli mì: nisisiyi ni nwọn o wà lãrin awọn Keferi bi ohun-elò ninu eyiti inu-didùn kò si.
entries.en: Israel is swallowed up: now shall they be among the Gentiles as a vessel wherein is no pleasure.

entries.yo: Nitori nwọn goke lọ si Assiria, kẹtẹ́kẹtẹ́ igbẹ́ nikan fun ara rẹ̀: Efraimu ti bẹ̀ awọn ọrẹ li ọ̀wẹ.
entries.en: For they are gone up to Assyria, a wild ass alone by himself: Ephraim hath hired lovers.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ, bi nwọn tilẹ ti bẹ̀ ọ̀wẹ lãrin awọn orilẹ-ède, nisisiyi li emi o ko wọn jọ, nwọn o si kãnu diẹ fun ẹrù ọba awọn ọmọ-alade.
entries.en: Yea, though they have hired among the nations, now will I gather them, and they shall sorrow a little for the burden of the king of princes.

entries.yo: Nitori Efraimu ti tẹ́ pẹpẹ pupọ̀ lati dẹ̀ṣẹ, pẹpẹ yio jẹ ohun atidẹ̀ṣẹ fun u.
entries.en: Because Ephraim hath made many altars to sin, altars shall be unto him to sin.

entries.yo: Mo ti kọwe ohun pupọ̀ ti ofin mi si i, ṣugbọn a kà wọn si bi ohun ajèji.
entries.en: I have written to him the great things of my law, but they were counted as a strange thing.

entries.yo: Nwọn rubọ ẹran ninu ẹbọ ẹran mi, nwọn si jẹ ẹ; Oluwa kò tẹwọgbà wọn; nisisiyi ni yio ránti ìwa-buburu wọn, yio si bẹ̀ ẹ̀ṣẹ wọn wò: nwọn o padà lọ si Egipti.
entries.en: They sacrifice flesh for the sacrifices of mine offerings, and eat it; but the LORD accepteth them not; now will he remember their iniquity, and visit their sins: they shall return to Egypt.

entries.yo: Nitori Israeli ti gbagbe Ẹlẹda rẹ̀, o si kọ́ tempili pupọ; Juda si ti sọ ilu olodi di pupọ̀: ṣugbọn emi o rán iná kan si ori awọn ilu rẹ̀, yio si jẹ awọn ãfin rẹ̀ wọnni run.
entries.en: For Israel hath forgotten his Maker, and buildeth temples; and Judah hath multiplied fenced cities: but I will send a fire upon his cities, and it shall devour the palaces thereof.

entries.yo: MÁṢE yọ̀, Israeli, fun ayọ̀, bi awọn enia miràn: nitori iwọ ti ṣe agbère lọ kuro lọdọ Ọlọrun rẹ, iwọ ti fẹ́ èrè lori ilẹ ipakà gbogbo.
entries.en: Rejoice not, O Israel, for joy, as other people: for thou hast gone a whoring from thy God, thou hast loved a reward upon every cornfloor.

entries.yo: Ilẹ ipakà ati ohun ifunti kì yio bọ́ wọn, ọti-waini titun yio si tan ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: The floor and the winepress shall not feed them, and the new wine shall fail in her.

entries.yo: Nwọn kì yio gbe inu ilẹ Oluwa; ṣugbọn Efraimu yio padà si Egipti, nwọn o si jẹ ohun aimọ́ ni Assiria.
entries.en: They shall not dwell in the LORD's land; but Ephraim shall return to Egypt, and they shall eat unclean things in Assyria.

entries.yo: Nwọn kì yio ta Oluwa li ọrẹ ọti-waini, bẹ̃ni nwọn kì yio mu u ni inu dùn: ẹbọ wọn yio ri fun wọn bi onjẹ awọn ti nṣọ̀fọ; gbogbo awọn ti o jẹ ninu rẹ̀ ni yio di alaimọ́: nitori onjẹ wọn kì yio wá si ile Oluwa fun ọkàn wọn.
entries.en: They shall not offer wine offerings to the LORD, neither shall they be pleasing unto him: their sacrifices shall be unto them as the bread of mourners; all that eat thereof shall be polluted: for their bread for their soul shall not come into the house of the LORD.

entries.yo: Kili ẹnyin o ṣe li ọjọ ti o ni irònu, ati li ọjọ àse Oluwa?
entries.en: What will ye do in the solemn day, and in the day of the feast of the LORD?

entries.yo: Nitori, sa wò o, nwọn ti lọ nitori ikogun: Egipti yio kó wọn jọ, Memfisi yio sin wọn: ibi didara fun fadakà wọn li ẹgún-ọ̀gan yio jogun wọn: ẹgún yio wà ninu agọ wọn.
entries.en: For, lo, they are gone because of destruction: Egypt shall gather them up, Memphis shall bury them: the pleasant places for their silver, nettles shall possess them: thorns shall be in their tabernacles.

entries.yo: Ọjọ ibẹ̀wo de, ọjọ ẹsan de; Israeli yio mọ̀: aṣiwère ni woli na, ẹni ẹmi na nsinwin; nitori ọ̀pọlọpọ ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ, ati irira nla na.
entries.en: The days of visitation are come, the days of recompence are come; Israel shall know it: the prophet is a fool, the spiritual man is mad, for the multitude of thine iniquity, and the great hatred.

entries.yo: Olùṣọ Efraimu wà pẹlu Ọlọrun mi: ṣugbọn okùn pẹyẹpẹyẹ ni woli na li ọ̀na rẹ̀ gbogbo, ati irira si ile Ọlọrun rẹ̀.
entries.en: The watchman of Ephraim was with my God: but the prophet is a snare of a fowler in all his ways, and hatred in the house of his God.

entries.yo: Nwọn ti ba ara wọn jẹ pupọ̀pupọ̀, bi li ọjọ Gibea: nitorina, on o ranti aiṣedẽde wọn, yio bẹ̀ ẹ̀ṣẹ wọn wò.
entries.en: They have deeply corrupted themselves, as in the days of Gibeah: therefore he will remember their iniquity, he will visit their sins.

entries.yo: Mo ri Israeli bi eso ajara li aginjù; mo ri awọn baba nyin bi akọpọ́n ninu igi ọpọ̀tọ li akọso rẹ̀: ṣugbọn nwọn tọ̀ Baal-peori lọ, nwọn si yà ara wọn si itiju nì; ohun irira wọn si ri gẹgẹ bi nwọn ti fẹ.
entries.en: I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness; I saw your fathers as the firstripe in the fig tree at her first time: but they went to Baal-peor, and separated themselves unto that shame; and their abominations were according as they loved.

entries.yo: Bi o ṣe ti Efraimu, ogo wọn yio fò lọ bi ẹiyẹ, lati ibí, ati lati inu, ati lati iloyun.
entries.en: As for Ephraim, their glory shall fly away like a bird, from the birth, and from the womb, and from the conception.

entries.yo: Bi nwọn tilẹ tọ́ ọmọ wọn dàgba, ṣugbọn emi o gbà wọn li ọwọ wọn, ti kì yio fi kù enia kan; lõtọ, egbe ni fun wọn pẹlu nigbati mo ba kuro lọdọ wọn!
entries.en: Though they bring up their children, yet will I bereave them, that there shall not be a man left: yea, woe also to them when I depart from them!

entries.yo: Efraimu, bi mo ti ri Tirusi, li a gbìn si ibi daradara: ṣugbọn Efraimu yio bi ọmọ rẹ̀ fun apania.
entries.en: Ephraim, as I saw Tyrus, is planted in a pleasant place: but Ephraim shall bring forth his children to the murderer.

entries.yo: Fun wọn, Oluwa, li ohun ti iwọ o fun wọn. Fun wọn ni iṣẹnu ati ọmú gbigbẹ́.
entries.en: Give them, O LORD: what wilt thou give? give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ìwa-buburu wọn mbẹ ni Gilgali; nitori nibẹ̀ ni mo korira wọn; nitori ìwa-buburu iṣe wọn, emi o le wọn kuro ni ile mi, emi kì yio fẹràn wọn mọ́; gbogbo ọmọ-alade wọn ni ọlọ̀tẹ.
entries.en: All their wickedness is in Gilgal: for there I hated them: for the wickedness of their doings I will drive them out of mine house, I will love them no more: all their princes are revolters.

entries.yo: A lù Efraimu, gbòngbo wọn gbẹ, nwọn kì yio so eso, bi nwọn tilẹ bi ọmọ, ṣugbọn emi o pa ãyò eso inu wọn.
entries.en: Ephraim is smitten, their root is dried up, they shall bear no fruit: yea, though they bring forth, yet will I slay even the beloved fruit of their womb.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun mi yio sọ wọn nù, nitoriti nwọn kò fetisi tirẹ̀; nwọn o si di alarinkiri lãrin awọn keferi.
entries.en: My God will cast them away, because they did not hearken unto him: and they shall be wanderers among the nations.

entries.yo: ÁJARA ofo ni Israeli, o nso eso fun ara rẹ̀; gẹgẹ bi ọ̀pọ eso rẹ̀ li o mu pẹpẹ pọ̀ si i; gẹgẹ bi didara ilẹ rẹ̀ ni nwọn yá ere daradara.
entries.en: Israel is an empty vine, he bringeth forth fruit unto himself: according to the multitude of his fruit he hath increased the altars; according to the goodness of his land they have made goodly images.

entries.yo: Ọkàn wọn dá meji; nisisiyi ni nwọn o jẹbi; on o wó pẹpẹ wọn lulẹ, on o si ba ere wọn jẹ.
entries.en: Their heart is divided; now shall they be found faulty: he shall break down their altars, he shall spoil their images.

entries.yo: Nitori nisisiyi ni nwọn o wipe, Awa kò li ọba, nitoriti awa kò bẹ̀ru Oluwa; njẹ kili ọba o ṣe fun wa?
entries.en: For now they shall say, We have no king, because we feared not the LORD; what then should a king do to us?

entries.yo: Nwọn ti sọ ọ̀rọ, nwọn mbura eke ni didà majẹmu: bayi ni idajọ hù soke bi igi iwọ, ni aporo oko.
entries.en: They have spoken words, swearing falsely in making a covenant: thus judgment springeth up as hemlock in the furrows of the field.

entries.yo: Nitori awọn ọmọ-malu Bet-afeni, awọn ti ngbe Samaria yio bẹ̀ru: nitori awọn enia ibẹ̀ yio ṣọ̀fọ lori rẹ̀, ati awọn baba-oloriṣà ibẹ̀ ti o yọ̀ lori rẹ̀, nitori ogo rẹ̀, nitori o ti lọ kuro lọdọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: The inhabitants of Samaria shall fear because of the calves of Beth-aven: for the people thereof shall mourn over it, and the priests thereof that rejoiced on it, for the glory thereof, because it is departed from it.

entries.yo: A o si mu u lọ si Assiria pẹlu ẹbùn fun Jarebu ọba: Efraimu yio gbà itiju, oju yio si tì Israeli nitori igbìmọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: It shall be also carried unto Assyria for a present to king Jareb: Ephraim shall receive shame, and Israel shall be ashamed of his own counsel.

entries.yo: Bi o ṣe ti Samaria, a ké ọba rẹ̀ kuro bi ifõfõ loju omi.
entries.en: As for Samaria, her king is cut off as the foam upon the water.

entries.yo: Ibi giga Afeni pẹlu, ẹ̀ṣẹ Israeli, li a o parun; ẹgún ọ̀gan on oṣuṣu yio hù jade lori pẹpẹ wọn; nwọn o si wi fun awọn oke-nla pe, Bò wa mọlẹ; ati fun awọn oke kékèké pe, Wó lù wa.
entries.en: The high places also of Aven, the sin of Israel, shall be destroyed: the thorn and the thistle shall come up on their altars; and they shall say to the mountains, Cover us; and to the hills, Fall on us.

entries.yo: Lati ọjọ Gibea ni iwọ ti ṣẹ̀, Israeli: nibẹ̀ ni nwọn duro: ogun Gibea si awọn ọmọ ẹ̀ṣẹ kò ha le wọn ba?
entries.en: O Israel, thou hast sinned from the days of Gibeah: there they stood: the battle in Gibeah against the children of iniquity did not overtake them.

entries.yo: Ifẹ inu mi ni ki nle nà wọn; a o si gbá awọn enia jọ si wọn, lati di ara wọn si ẹ̀ṣẹ wọn mejeji.
entries.en: It is in my desire that I should chastise them; and the people shall be gathered against them, when they shall bind themselves in their two furrows.

entries.yo: Efraimu si dabi ọmọ-malu ti a kọ́, ti o si fẹ́ lati ma tẹ ọkà; ṣugbọn emi rekọja li ori ọrùn rẹ̀ ti o ni ẹwà: emi o mu ki Efraimu gùn ẹṣin; Juda yio tú ilẹ, Jakobu yio si fọ́ ogulùtu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Ephraim is as an heifer that is taught, and loveth to tread out the corn; but I passed over upon her fair neck: I will make Ephraim to ride; Judah shall plow, and Jacob shall break his clods.

entries.yo: Ẹ furùngbin fun ara nyin li ododo, ẹ ká li ãnu: ẹ tú ilẹ nyin ti a kò ro: nitori o to akokò lati wá Oluwa, titi yio fi de, ti yio si fi rọ̀jo ododo si nyin.
entries.en: Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap in mercy; break up your fallow ground: for it is time to seek the LORD, till he come and rain righteousness upon you.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin ti tulẹ ìwa-buburu, ẹnyin ti ká aiṣedẽde; ẹnyin ti jẹ eso eke: nitori iwọ gbẹkẹ̀le ọ̀na rẹ, ninu ọ̀pọlọpọ awọn alagbara rẹ.
entries.en: Ye have plowed wickedness, ye have reaped iniquity; ye have eaten the fruit of lies: because thou didst trust in thy way, in the multitude of thy mighty men.

entries.yo: Nitorina li ariwo yio dide ninu awọn enia rẹ, gbogbo awọn odi agbara rẹ li a o si bajẹ, bi Ṣalmani ti ba Bet-abeli jẹ li ọjọ ogun: a fọ́ iya tũtũ lori awọn ọmọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Therefore shall a tumult arise among thy people, and all thy fortresses shall be spoiled, as Shalman spoiled Beth-arbel in the day of battle: the mother was dashed in pieces upon her children.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Beteli yio ṣe si nyin, nitori ìwa-buburu nla nyin; ni kùtukùtu li a o ke ọba Israeli kuro patapata.
entries.en: So shall Bethel do unto you because of your great wickedness: in a morning shall the king of Israel utterly be cut off.

entries.yo: NIGBATI Israeli wà li ọmọde, nigbana ni mo fẹ́ ẹ, mo si pè ọmọ mi lati Egipti jade wá.
entries.en: When Israel was a child, then I loved him, and called my son out of Egypt.

entries.yo: Bi nwọn ti pè wọn, bẹ̃ni nwọn lọ kuro lọdọ wọn: nwọn rubọ si Baalimu, nwọn si fi turari joná si ere fifin.
entries.en: As they called them, so they went from them: they sacrificed unto Baalim, and burned incense to graven images.

entries.yo: Mo kọ́ Efraimu pẹlu lati rìn, mo dì wọn mu li apa, ṣugbọn nwọn kò mọ̀ pe mo ti mu wọn lara dá.
entries.en: I taught Ephraim also to go, taking them by their arms; but they knew not that I healed them.

entries.yo: Mo fi okùn enia fà wọn, ati idè ifẹ: mo si ri si wọn bi awọn ti o mu ajàga kuro li ẹrẹkẹ wọn, mo si gbe onjẹ kalẹ niwaju wọn.
entries.en: I drew them with cords of a man, with bands of love: and I was to them as they that take off the yoke on their jaws, and I laid meat unto them.

entries.yo: On kì yio yipadà si ilẹ Egipti, ṣugbọn ara Assiria ni yio jẹ ọba rẹ̀, nitori nwọn kọ̀ lati yipadà.
entries.en: He shall not return into the land of Egypt, but the Assyrian shall be his king, because they refused to return.

entries.yo: Idà yio si ma gbe inu ilu rẹ̀, yio si run ìtikun rẹ̀, yio si jẹ wọn run, nitori ìmọran ara wọn.
entries.en: And the sword shall abide on his cities, and shall consume his branches, and devour them, because of their own counsels.

entries.yo: Awọn enia mi si tẹ̀ si ifàsẹhin kuro lọdọ mi: bi o tilẹ̀ ṣepe nwọn pè wọn si Ọga-ogo jùlọ, nwọn kò jùmọ gbe e ga.
entries.en: And my people are bent to backsliding from me: though they called them to the most High, none at all would exalt him.

entries.yo: Emi o ha ṣe jọwọ rẹ lọwọ, Efraimu? emi o ha ṣe gbà ọ silẹ, Israeli? emi o ha ti ṣe ṣe ọ bi Adma? emi o ha ti ṣe gbe ọ kalẹ bi Seboimu, ọkàn mi yi ninu mi, iyọnu mi gbiná pọ̀.
entries.en: How shall I give thee up, Ephraim? how shall I deliver thee, Israel? how shall I make thee as Admah? how shall I set thee as Zeboim? mine heart is turned within me, my repentings are kindled together.

entries.yo: Emi kì yio mu gbigboná ibinu mi ṣẹ, emi kì yio yipadà lati run Efraimu: nitori Ọlọrun li emi, kì iṣe enia; Ẹni-Mimọ lãrin rẹ: emi kì yio si wá ninu ibinu.
entries.en: I will not execute the fierceness of mine anger, I will not return to destroy Ephraim: for I am God, and not man; the Holy One in the midst of thee: and I will not enter into the city.

entries.yo: Nwọn o ma tẹ̀le Oluwa: on o ke ramùramù bi kiniun: nigbati on o ke, nigbana li awọn ọmọ yio wariri lati iwọ-õrun wá.
entries.en: They shall walk after the LORD: he shall roar like a lion: when he shall roar, then the children shall tremble from the west.

entries.yo: Nwọn o warìri bi ẹiyẹ lati Egipti wá, ati bi adàba lati ilẹ Assiria wá: emi o si fi wọn si ile wọn, li Oluwa wi
entries.en: They shall tremble as a bird out of Egypt, and as a dove out of the land of Assyria: and I will place them in their houses, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Efraimu fi eke sagbàra yi mi ka, ile Israeli si fi ẹtàn sagbàra yi mi ka: ṣugbọn Juda njọba sibẹ̀ pẹlu Ọlọrun, o si ṣe olõtọ pẹlu Ẹni-mimọ́.
entries.en: Ephraim compasseth me about with lies, and the house of Israel with deceit: but Judah yet ruleth with God, and is faithful with the saints.

entries.yo: EFRAIMU njẹ afẹfẹ́, o si ntọ̀ afẹfẹ́ ila-õrun lẹhìn: o nmu eke ati iparun pọ̀ si i lojojumọ; nwọn si ba awọn ara Assiria da majẹmu, nwọn si nrù ororo lọ si Egipti.
entries.en: Ephraim feedeth on wind, and followeth after the east wind: he daily increaseth lies and desolation; and they do make a covenant with the Assyrians, and oil is carried into Egypt.

entries.yo: Oluwa ni ẹjọ kan ba Juda rò pẹlu, yio si jẹ Jakobu ni iyà gẹgẹ bi ọ̀na rẹ̀; gẹgẹ bi iṣe rẹ̀ ni yio san padà fun u.
entries.en: The LORD hath also a controversy with Judah, and will punish Jacob according to his ways; according to his doings will he recompense him.

entries.yo: O di arakunrin rẹ̀ mu ni gigisẹ̀ ni inu, ati nipa ipá rẹ̀ o ni agbara pẹlu Ọlọrun.
entries.en: He took his brother by the heel in the womb, and by his strength he had power with God:

entries.yo: Nitõtọ, o ni agbara lori angeli, o si bori: o sọkun, o si bẹ̀bẹ lọdọ rẹ̀: o ri i ni Beteli, nibẹ̀ li o gbe ba wa sọ̀rọ;
entries.en: Yea, he had power over the angel, and prevailed: he wept, and made supplication unto him: he found him in Bethel, and there he spake with us;

entries.yo: Ani Oluwa Ọlọrun awọn ọmọ-ogun; Oluwa ni iranti rẹ̀.
entries.en: Even the LORD God of hosts; the LORD is his memorial.

entries.yo: Nitorina, iwọ yipadà si Ọlọrun rẹ: pa ãnu ati idajọ mọ, ki o si ma duro de Ọlọrun rẹ nigbagbogbo.
entries.en: Therefore turn thou to thy God: keep mercy and judgment, and wait on thy God continually.

entries.yo: Kenaani ni, iwọ̀n ẹtàn mbẹ li ọwọ́ rẹ̀: o fẹ lati ninilara.
entries.en: He is a merchant, the balances of deceit are in his hand: he loveth to oppress.

entries.yo: Efraimu si wipe, Ṣugbọn emi di ọlọrọ̀, mo ti ri ini fun ara mi: ninu gbogbo lãlã mi nwọn kì yio ri aiṣedẽde kan ti iṣe ẹ̀ṣẹ lara mi.
entries.en: And Ephraim said, Yet I am become rich, I have found me out substance: in all my labours they shall find none iniquity in me that were sin.

entries.yo: Ati emi, Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ lati ilẹ̀ Egipti wá, yio si tún mu ọ gbe inu agọ, bi ọjọ ajọ-ọ̀wọ wọnni.
entries.en: And I that am the LORD thy God from the land of Egypt will yet make thee to dwell in tabernacles, as in the days of the solemn feast.

entries.yo: Emi ti sọ̀rọ nipa awọn woli pẹlu, mo si ti mu iran di pupọ̀, mo ti ṣe ọ̀pọlọpọ akàwe, nipa ọwọ́ awọn woli.
entries.en: I have also spoken by the prophets, and I have multiplied visions, and used similitudes, by the ministry of the prophets.

entries.yo: Aiṣedẽde mbẹ ni Gileadi bi? nitõtọ asan ni nwọn: nwọn rubọ akọ malu ni Gilgali; nitõtọ, pẹpẹ wọn dabi ebè ni aporo oko.
entries.en: Is there iniquity in Gilead? surely they are vanity: they sacrifice bullocks in Gilgal; yea, their altars are as heaps in the furrows of the fields.

entries.yo: Jakobu si salọ si ilẹ Siria: Israeli si sìn nitori aya kan; ati nitori aya kan li o ṣọ agùtan.
entries.en: And Jacob fled into the country of Syria, and Israel served for a wife, and for a wife he kept sheep.

entries.yo: Ati nipa woli kan ni Oluwa mu Israeli jade ni Egipti: nipa woli kan li a si pa on mọ.
entries.en: And by a prophet the LORD brought Israel out of Egypt, and by a prophet was he preserved.

entries.yo: Efraimu mu u binu kikorò: nitorina ni yio fi ẹjẹ̀ rẹ̀ si ori rẹ̀, ẹgàn rẹ̀ li Oluwa rẹ̀ yio si san padà fun u.
entries.en: Ephraim provoked him to anger most bitterly: therefore shall he leave his blood upon him, and his reproach shall his Lord return unto him.

entries.yo: NIGBATI Efraimu sọ̀rọ, ìwarìri ni; o gbe ara rẹ̀ ga ni Israeli; ṣugbọn nigbati o ṣẹ̀ ninu Baali, o kú.
entries.en: When Ephraim spake trembling, he exalted himself in Israel; but when he offended in Baal, he died.

entries.yo: Nisisiyi, nwọn si dá ẹ̀ṣẹ kún ẹ̀ṣẹ, nwọn si ti fi fàdakà wọn ṣe ere didà fun ara wọn, ati òriṣa ìmọ wọn: iṣẹ oniṣọnà ni gbogbo rẹ̀; nwọn wi niti wọn pe, Jẹ ki awọn enia ti nrubọ fi ẹnu kò awọn ọmọ malu li ẹnu.
entries.en: And now they sin more and more, and have made them molten images of their silver, and idols according to their own understanding, all of it the work of the craftsmen: they say of them, Let the men that sacrifice kiss the calves.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni nwọn o ṣe dabi kũkũ owurọ̀, ati bi irì owurọ̀ ti nkọja lọ, bi iyangbò ti a ti ọwọ́ ijì gbá kuro ninu ilẹ ipakà, ati bi ẹ̃fin ti ijade kuro ninu ile ẹ̃fin.
entries.en: Therefore they shall be as the morning cloud, and as the early dew that passeth away, as the chaff that is driven with the whirlwind out of the floor, and as the smoke out of the chimney.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi li Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ lati ilẹ Egipti wá, iwọ kì yio si mọ̀ ọlọrun kan bikòṣe emi: nitori kò si olugbàla kan lẹhìn mi.
entries.en: Yet I am the LORD thy God from the land of Egypt, and thou shalt know no god but me: for there is no saviour beside me.

entries.yo: Emi ti mọ̀ ọ li aginjù, ni ilẹ ti o pongbẹ.
entries.en: I did know thee in the wilderness, in the land of great drought.

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi a ti bọ́ wọn, bẹ̃ni nwọn yó; nwọn yó, nwọn si gbe ọkàn wọn ga; nitorina ni nwọn ṣe gbagbe mi.
entries.en: According to their pasture, so were they filled; they were filled, and their heart was exalted; therefore have they forgotten me.

entries.yo: Nitorina li emi o ṣe dabi kiniun si wọn; emi o si ma ṣọ wọn bi ẹkùn li ẹ̀ba ọ̀na.
entries.en: Therefore I will be unto them as a lion: as a leopard by the way will I observe them:

entries.yo: Emi o pade wọn bi beari ti a gbà li ọ̀mọ, emi o si fà àwọn ọkàn wọn ya, nibẹ̀ ni emi o si jẹ wọn run bi kiniun, ẹranko igbẹ ni yio fà wọn ya.
entries.en: I will meet them as a bear that is bereaved of her whelps, and will rend the caul of their heart, and there will I devour them like a lion: the wild beast shall tear them.

entries.yo: Israeli, iwọ ti pa ara rẹ run, niti pe iwọ wà lodi si emi, irànlọwọ rẹ.
entries.en: O Israel, thou hast destroyed thyself; but in me is thine help.

entries.yo: Nibo li ọba rẹ gbe wà nisisiyi ninu gbogbo ilu rẹ, ti o le gbà ọ? ati awọn onidajọ rẹ, niti awọn ti iwọ wipe; Fun mi li ọba ati awọn ọmọ-alade.
entries.en: I will be thy king: where is any other that may save thee in all thy cities? and thy judges of whom thou saidst, Give me a king and princes?

entries.yo: Emi fun ọ li ọba ni ibinu mi, mo si mu u kuro ni irúnu mi.
entries.en: I gave thee a king in mine anger, and took him away in my wrath.

entries.yo: A dì aiṣedẽde Efraimu; ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ̀ pamọ.
entries.en: The iniquity of Ephraim is bound up; his sin is hid.

entries.yo: Irora obinrin ti nrọbi yio de si i: alaigbọn ọmọ li on; nitori on kò duro li akokò si ibi ijade ọmọ.
entries.en: The sorrows of a travailing woman shall come upon him: he is an unwise son; for he should not stay long in the place of the breaking forth of children.

entries.yo: Emi o rà wọn padà lọwọ agbara isà-okú; Emi o rà wọn padà lọwọ ikú; Ikú, ajàkalẹ arùn rẹ dà? Isà-okú, iparun rẹ dà? ironupiwàda yio pamọ kuro loju mi.
entries.en: I will ransom them from the power of the grave; I will redeem them from death: O death, I will be thy plagues; O grave, I will be thy destruction: repentance shall be hid from mine eyes.

entries.yo: Bi on tilẹ ṣe eleso ninu awọn arakunrin rẹ̀, afẹfẹ́ ilà-õrùn kan yio de, afẹ̃fẹ́ Oluwa yio ti aginjù wá, orisun rẹ̀ yio si gbẹ, ati oju isun rẹ̀ li a o mu gbẹ: on o bà ohun elò daradara gbogbo jẹ.
entries.en: Though he be fruitful among his brethren, an east wind shall come, the wind of the LORD shall come up from the wilderness, and his spring shall become dry, and his fountain shall be dried up: he shall spoil the treasure of all pleasant vessels.

entries.yo: Samaria yio di ahoro: nitoriti on ti ṣọ̀tẹ si Ọlọrun rẹ̀: nwọn o ti ipa idà ṣubu: a o fọ́ ọmọ wọn tũtũ, ati aboyún wọn li a o là ni inu.
entries.en: Samaria shall become desolate; for she hath rebelled against her God: they shall fall by the sword: their infants shall be dashed in pieces, and their women with child shall be ripped up.

entries.yo: ISRAELI, yipadà si Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ, nitori iwọ ti ṣubu ninu aiṣedẽde rẹ.
entries.en: O Israel, return unto the LORD thy God; for thou hast fallen by thine iniquity.

entries.yo: Mu ọ̀rọ pẹlu nyin, ẹ si yipadà si Oluwa: ẹ wi fun u pe, Mu aiṣedẽde gbogbo kuro, si fi ore-ọfẹ gbà wa: bẹ̃ni awa o fi ọmọ malu ète wa san a fun ọ.
entries.en: Take with you words, and turn to the LORD: say unto him, Take away all iniquity, and receive us graciously: so will we render the calves of our lips.

entries.yo: Assuru kì yio gbà wa; awa kì yio gùn ẹṣin: bẹ̃ni awa kì yio tun wi mọ fun iṣẹ ọwọ́ wa pe, Ẹnyin li ọlọrun wa: nitori lọdọ rẹ ni alainibaba gbe ri ãnu.
entries.en: Asshur shall not save us; we will not ride upon horses: neither will we say any more to the work of our hands, Ye are our gods: for in thee the fatherless findeth mercy.

entries.yo: Emi o wo ifàsẹhìn wọn sàn, emi o fẹ wọn lọfẹ: nitori ibinu mi yí kuro lọdọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: I will heal their backsliding, I will love them freely: for mine anger is turned away from him.

entries.yo: Emi o dabi ìri si Israeli: on o tanná bi eweko lili; yio si ta gbòngbo rẹ̀ bi Lebanoni.
entries.en: I will be as the dew unto Israel: he shall grow as the lily, and cast forth his roots as Lebanon.

entries.yo: Ẹka rẹ̀ yio tàn, ẹwà rẹ̀ yio si dabi igi olifi, ati õrùn rẹ̀ bi Lebanoni.
entries.en: His branches shall spread, and his beauty shall be as the olive tree, and his smell as Lebanon.

entries.yo: Awọn ti o ngbe abẹ ojiji rẹ̀ yio padà wá; nwọn o sọji bi ọkà: nwọn o si tanná bi àjara: õrun rẹ̀ yio dabi ọti-waini ti Lebanoni.
entries.en: They that dwell under his shadow shall return; they shall revive as the corn, and grow as the vine: the scent thereof shall be as the wine of Lebanon.

entries.yo: Efraimu yio wipe, Kili emi ni fi òriṣa ṣe mọ? Emi ti gbọ́, mo si ti kiyesi i: emi dabi igi firi tutù. Lati ọdọ mi li a ti ri èso rẹ.
entries.en: Ephraim shall say, What have I to do any more with idols? I have heard him, and observed him: I am like a green fir tree. From me is thy fruit found.

entries.yo: Tali o gbọ́n, ti o lè moye nkan wọnyi? tali o li oye, ti o le mọ̀ wọn? nitori ọ̀na Oluwa tọ́, awọn olododo yio si ma rìn ninu wọn: ṣugbọn awọn alarekọja ni yio ṣubu sinu wọn.
entries.en: Who is wise, and he shall understand these things? prudent, and he shall know them? for the ways of the LORD are right, and the just shall walk in them: but the transgressors shall fall therein.

entries.yo: Ọ̀RỌ Oluwa ti o tọ̀ Joeli ọmọ Petueli wá.
entries.en: The word of the LORD that came to Joel the son of Pethuel.

entries.yo: Gbọ́ eyi, ẹnyin arugbo, si fi eti silẹ, gbogbo ẹnyin ará ilẹ na. Eyi ha wà li ọjọ nyin, tabi li ọjọ awọn baba nyin?
entries.en: Hear this, ye old men, and give ear, all ye inhabitants of the land. Hath this been in your days, or even in the days of your fathers?

entries.yo: Ẹ sọ ọ fun awọn ọmọ nyin, ati awọn ọmọ nyin fun awọn ọmọ wọn, ati awọn ọmọ wọn fun iran miràn.
entries.en: Tell ye your children of it, and let your children tell their children, and their children another generation.

entries.yo: Eyi ti iru kòkoro kan jẹ kù ni ẽṣú jẹ; ati eyi ti ẽṣú jẹ kù ni kòkoro miràn jẹ; eyiti kòkoro na si jẹ kù ni kòkoro miràn jẹ.
entries.en: That which the palmerworm hath left hath the locust eaten; and that which the locust hath left hath the cankerworm eaten; and that which the cankerworm hath left hath the caterpiller eaten.

entries.yo: Ji, ẹnyin ọmùti, ẹ si sọkun; si hu, gbogbo ẹnyin ọmùti waini, nitori ọti-waini titun; nitoriti a ké e kuro li ẹnu nyin.
entries.en: Awake, ye drunkards, and weep; and howl, all ye drinkers of wine, because of the new wine; for it is cut off from your mouth.

entries.yo: Nitori orilẹ-ède kan goke wá si ilẹ mi, o li agbara, kò si ni iye, ehin ẹniti iṣe ehin kiniun, o si ni erìgi abo kiniun.
entries.en: For a nation is come up upon my land, strong, and without number, whose teeth are the teeth of a lion, and he hath the cheek teeth of a great lion.

entries.yo: O ti pa àjara mi run, o si ti ya ẹ̀ka igi ọ̀pọtọ́ mi kuro, o ti bó o jalẹ, o si sọ ọ nù; awọn ẹ̀ka rẹ̀ li a si sọ di funfun.
entries.en: He hath laid my vine waste, and barked my fig tree: he hath made it clean bare, and cast it away; the branches thereof are made white.

entries.yo: Ẹ pohùnrére-ẹkun bi wundia ti a fi aṣọ ọ̀fọ dì li àmure, nitori ọkọ igbà ewe rẹ̀.
entries.en: Lament like a virgin girded with sackcloth for the husband of her youth.

entries.yo: A ké ọrẹ-jijẹ ati ọrẹ-mimu kuro ni ile Oluwa; awọn alufa, awọn iranṣẹ Oluwa, ṣọ̀fọ.
entries.en: The meat offering and the drink offering is cut off from the house of the LORD; the priests, the LORD's ministers, mourn.

entries.yo: Oko di ìgboro, ilẹ nṣọ̀fọ, nitori a fi ọkà ṣòfo: ọti-waini titun gbẹ, ororo mbuṣe.
entries.en: The field is wasted, the land mourneth; for the corn is wasted: the new wine is dried up, the oil languisheth.

entries.yo: Ki oju ki o tì nyin, ẹnyin agbẹ̀; ẹ hu, ẹnyin olùtọju àjara, nitori alikamà ati nitori ọkà barli; nitori ikorè oko ṣègbe.
entries.en: Be ye ashamed, O ye husbandmen; howl, O ye vinedressers, for the wheat and for the barley; because the harvest of the field is perished.

entries.yo: Ajara gbẹ, igi ọ̀pọtọ́ si rọgbẹ; igi pomegranate, igi ọ̀pẹ pẹlu, ati igi appili, gbogbo igi igbo li o rọ: nitoriti ayọ̀ rọgbẹ kuro lọdọ awọn ọmọ enia.
entries.en: The vine is dried up, and the fig tree languisheth; the pomegranate tree, the palm tree also, and the apple tree, even all the trees of the field, are withered: because joy is withered away from the sons of men.

entries.yo: Ẹ dì ara nyin li amùre, si pohùnrére ẹkún ẹnyin alufa: ẹ hu, ẹnyin iranṣẹ pẹpẹ: ẹ wá, fi gbogbo oru dùbulẹ ninu aṣọ-ọ̀fọ, ẹnyin iranṣẹ Ọlọrun mi: nitori ti a dá ọrẹ-jijẹ, ati ọrẹ-mimu duro ni ile Ọlọrun nyin.
entries.en: Gird yourselves, and lament, ye priests: howl, ye ministers of the altar: come, lie all night in sackcloth, ye ministers of my God: for the meat offering and the drink offering is withholden from the house of your God.

entries.yo: Ẹ yà àwẹ kan si mimọ́, ẹ pè ajọ kan ti o ni irònu, ẹ pè awọn agbà, ati gbogbo awọn ará ilẹ na jọ si ile Oluwa Ọlọrun nyin, ki ẹ si kepe Oluwa,
entries.en: Sanctify ye a fast, call a solemn assembly, gather the elders and all the inhabitants of the land into the house of the LORD your God, and cry unto the LORD,

entries.yo: A! fun ọjọ na, nitori ọjọ Oluwa kù si dẹ̀dẹ, ati bi iparun lati ọwọ́ Olodumare ni yio de.
entries.en: Alas for the day! for the day of the LORD is at hand, and as a destruction from the Almighty shall it come.

entries.yo: A kò ha ké onjẹ kuro niwaju oju wa, ayọ̀ ati inu didùn kuro ninu ile Ọlọrun wa?
entries.en: Is not the meat cut off before our eyes, yea, joy and gladness from the house of our God?

entries.yo: Irugbìn bajẹ ninu ebè wọn, a sọ aká di ahoro, a wó abà palẹ; nitoriti a mu ọ̀ka rọ.
entries.en: The seed is rotten under their clods, the garners are laid desolate, the barns are broken down; for the corn is withered.

entries.yo: Awọn ẹranko ti nkerora to! awọn agbo-ẹran dãmu, nitoriti nwọn kò ni papa oko; nitõtọ, a sọ awọn agbo agùtan di ahoro.
entries.en: How do the beasts groan! the herds of cattle are perplexed, because they have no pasture; yea, the flocks of sheep are made desolate.

entries.yo: Oluwa, si ọ li emi o ké, nitori iná ti run pápa oko tutú aginju, ọwọ́ iná si ti jo gbogbo igi igbẹ.
entries.en: O LORD, to thee will I cry: for the fire hath devoured the pastures of the wilderness, and the flame hath burned all the trees of the field.

entries.yo: Awọn ẹranko igbẹ gbé oju soke si ọ pẹlu: nitoriti awọn iṣàn omi gbẹ, iná si ti jó awọn pápa oko aginju run.
entries.en: The beasts of the field cry also unto thee: for the rivers of waters are dried up, and the fire hath devoured the pastures of the wilderness.

entries.yo: Ẹ fun ipè ni Sioni, ẹ si dá idagìri ni oke mimọ́ mi; jẹ ki awọn ará ilẹ na warìri: nitoriti ọjọ Oluwa mbọ̀ wá, nitori o kù si dẹ̀dẹ;
entries.en: Blow ye the trumpet in Zion, and sound an alarm in my holy mountain: let all the inhabitants of the land tremble: for the day of the LORD cometh, for it is nigh at hand;

entries.yo: Ọjọ òkunkun ati òkudu, ọjọ ikũku ati òkunkun biribiri, bi ọyẹ̀ owurọ̀ ti ilà bò ori awọn oke-nla: enia nla ati alagbara; kò ti isi iru rẹ̀ ri, bẹ̃ni iru rẹ̀ kì yio si mọ lẹhin rẹ̀, titi de ọdun iran de iran.
entries.en: A day of darkness and of gloominess, a day of clouds and of thick darkness, as the morning spread upon the mountains: a great people and a strong; there hath not been ever the like, neither shall be any more after it, even to the years of many generations.

entries.yo: Iná njó niwaju wọn; ọwọ́-iná si njó lẹhin wọn: ilẹ na dàbi ọgbà Edeni niwaju wọn, ati lẹhin wọn bi ahoro ijù; nitõtọ, kò si si ohun ti yio bọ́ lọwọ wọn.
entries.en: A fire devoureth before them; and behind them a flame burneth: the land is as the garden of Eden before them, and behind them a desolate wilderness; yea, and nothing shall escape them.

entries.yo: Irí wọn dàbi irí awọn ẹṣin; ati bi awọn ẹlẹṣin, bẹ̃ni nwọn o sure.
entries.en: The appearance of them is as the appearance of horses; and as horsemen, so shall they run.

entries.yo: Bi ariwo kẹkẹ́ lori oke ni nwọn o fò, bi ariwo ọwọ́-iná ti o jó koriko gbigbẹ, bi alagbara enia ti a tẹ́ ni itẹ́gun.
entries.en: Like the noise of chariots on the tops of mountains shall they leap, like the noise of a flame of fire that devoureth the stubble, as a strong people set in battle array.

entries.yo: Li oju wọn, awọn enia yio jẹ irora pupọ̀: gbogbo oju ni yio ṣú dùdu.
entries.en: Before their face the people shall be much pained: all faces shall gather blackness.

entries.yo: Nwọn o sare bi awọn alagbara; nwọn o gùn odi bi ọkunrin ologun; olukuluku wọn o si rìn lọ li ọ̀na rẹ̀, nwọn kì yio si bà ọ̀wọ́ wọn jẹ.
entries.en: They shall run like mighty men; they shall climb the wall like men of war; and they shall march every one on his ways, and they shall not break their ranks:

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni ẹnikan kì yio tì ẹnikeji rẹ̀; olukuluku wọn o rìn li ọ̀na rẹ̀: nigbati nwọn ba si ṣubu lù idà, nwọn kì o gbọgbẹ́.
entries.en: Neither shall one thrust another; they shall walk every one in his path: and when they fall upon the sword, they shall not be wounded.

entries.yo: Nwọn o sure siwa sẹhin ni ilu: nwọn o sure lori odi, nwọn o gùn ori ile; nwọn o gbà oju fèrese wọ̀ inu ile bi olè.
entries.en: They shall run to and fro in the city; they shall run upon the wall, they shall climb up upon the houses; they shall enter in at the windows like a thief.

entries.yo: Aiye yio mì niwaju wọn; awọn ọrun yio warìri: õrùn ati oṣupa yio ṣu òkunkun, awọn iràwọ yio si fà imọlẹ wọn sẹhìn.
entries.en: The earth shall quake before them; the heavens shall tremble: the sun and the moon shall be dark, and the stars shall withdraw their shining:

entries.yo: Oluwa yio si fọ̀ ohùn rẹ̀ jade niwaju ogun rẹ̀: nitori ibùdo rẹ̀ tobi gidigidi: nitori alagbara li on ti nmu ọ̀rọ rẹ̀ ṣẹ; nitori ọjọ Oluwa tobi o si li ẹ̀ru gidigidi; ara tali o le gbà a?
entries.en: And the LORD shall utter his voice before his army: for his camp is very great: for he is strong that executeth his word: for the day of the LORD is great and very terrible; and who can abide it?

entries.yo: Njẹ nitorina nisisiyi, ni Oluwa wi, Ẹ fi gbogbo ọkàn nyin yipada si mi, ati pẹlu ãwẹ̀, ati pẹlu ẹkún, ati pẹlu ọ̀fọ.
entries.en: Therefore also now, saith the LORD, turn ye even to me with all your heart, and with fasting, and with weeping, and with mourning:

entries.yo: Ẹ si fà aiyà nyin ya, kì isi ṣe aṣọ nyin, ẹ si yipadà si Oluwa Ọlọrun nyin, nitoriti o pọ̀ li ore-ọfẹ, o si kún fun ãnu, o lọra lati binu, o si ṣeun pupọ̀, o si ronupiwada ati ṣe buburu.
entries.en: And rend your heart, and not your garments, and turn unto the LORD your God: for he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and repenteth him of the evil.

entries.yo: Tali o mọ̀ bi on o yipadà, ki o si ronupiwàda, ki o si fi ibukún silẹ̀ lẹhin rẹ̀; ani ọrẹ-jijẹ ati ọrẹ-mimu fun Oluwa Ọlọrun nyin?
entries.en: Who knoweth if he will return and repent, and leave a blessing behind him; even a meat offering and a drink offering unto the LORD your God?

entries.yo: Ẹ fun ipè ni Sioni, ẹ yà ãwẹ̀ kan si mimọ́, ẹ pè ajọ ti o ni irònu.
entries.en: Blow the trumpet in Zion, sanctify a fast, call a solemn assembly:

entries.yo: Ẹ kó awọn enia jọ, ẹ yà ijọ si mimọ́, ẹ pè awọn àgba jọ, ẹ kó awọn ọmọde jọ, ati awọn ti nmu ọmú: jẹ ki ọkọ iyàwo jade kuro ni iyẹ̀wu rẹ̀, ati iyàwo kuro ninu iyẹ̀wu rẹ̀.
entries.en: Gather the people, sanctify the congregation, assemble the elders, gather the children, and those that suck the breasts: let the bridegroom go forth of his chamber, and the bride out of her closet.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki awọn alufa, awọn iranṣẹ Oluwa, sọkun lãrin iloro ati pẹpẹ, si jẹ ki wọn wi pe, Dá awọn enia rẹ si, Oluwa, má si ṣe fi iní rẹ fun ẹ̀gan, ti awọn keferi yio fi ma jọba lori wọn: ẽṣe ti nwọn o fi wi ninu awọn enia pe, Ọlọrun wọn há da?
entries.en: Let the priests, the ministers of the LORD, weep between the porch and the altar, and let them say, Spare thy people, O LORD, and give not thine heritage to reproach, that the heathen should rule over them: wherefore should they say among the people, Where is their God?

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Oluwa yio jowú fun ilẹ rẹ̀, yio si kãnu fun enia rẹ̀.
entries.en: Then will the LORD be jealous for his land, and pity his people.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ, Oluwa yio dahùn, yio si wi fun awọn enia rẹ̀ pe, Wò o emi o rán ọkà, ati ọti-waini, ati ororo si nyin, a o si fi wọn tẹ́ nyin lọrùn: emi kì yio si fi nyin ṣe ẹ̀gan mọ lãrin awọn keferi.
entries.en: Yea, the LORD will answer and say unto his people, Behold, I will send you corn, and wine, and oil, and ye shall be satisfied therewith: and I will no more make you a reproach among the heathen:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi o ṣi ogun ariwa nì jinà rére kuro lọdọ nyin, emi o si le e lọ si ilẹ ti o ṣá, ti o si di ahoro, pẹlu oju rẹ̀ si okun ila-õrun, ati ẹhìn rẹ̀ si ipẹkùn okun, õrùn rẹ̀ yio si goke, õrùn buburu rẹ̀ yio si goke, nitoriti o ti ṣe ohun nla.
entries.en: But I will remove far off from you the northern army, and will drive him into a land barren and desolate, with his face toward the east sea, and his hinder part toward the utmost sea, and his stink shall come up, and his ill savour shall come up, because he hath done great things.

entries.yo: Má bẹ̀ru, iwọ ilẹ; jẹ ki inu rẹ dùn, ki o si yọ̀: nitori Oluwa yio ṣe ohun nla.
entries.en: Fear not, O land; be glad and rejoice: for the LORD will do great things.

entries.yo: Ẹ má bẹ̀ru, ẹranko igbẹ: nitori pápa-oko aginju nrú, nitori igi nso eso rẹ̀, igi ọ̀pọtọ ati àjara nso eso ipá wọn.
entries.en: Be not afraid, ye beasts of the field: for the pastures of the wilderness do spring, for the tree beareth her fruit, the fig tree and the vine do yield their strength.

entries.yo: Njẹ jẹ ki inu nyin dùn, ẹnyin ọmọ Sioni, ẹ si yọ̀ ninu Oluwa Ọlọrun nyin; nitoriti o ti fi akọrọ̀ ojò fun nyin bi o ti tọ́, on o si mu ki ojò rọ̀ silẹ fun nyin, akọrọ̀ ati arọ̀kuro ojò ni oṣù ikini.
entries.en: Be glad then, ye children of Zion, and rejoice in the LORD your God: for he hath given you the former rain moderately, and he will cause to come down for you the rain, the former rain, and the latter rain in the first month.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ilẹ ipakà yio kún fun ọkà, ati ọpọ́n wọnni yio ṣàn jade pẹlu ọti-waini ati ororo.
entries.en: And the floors shall be full of wheat, and the fats shall overflow with wine and oil.

entries.yo: Emi o si mu ọdun wọnni padà fun nyin wá, eyi ti ẽṣú on iru kòkoro jewejewe, ati iru kòkoro keji, ati iru kòkoro jewejewe miràn ti fi jẹ, awọn ogun nla mi ti mo rán sãrin nyin.
entries.en: And I will restore to you the years that the locust hath eaten, the cankerworm, and the caterpiller, and the palmerworm, my great army which I sent among you.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin o si jẹun li ọ̀pọlọpọ, ẹ o si yó, ẹ o si yìn orukọ Oluwa Ọlọrun nyin, ẹniti o fi iyanu ba nyin lò; oju kì o si tì awọn enia mi lai.
entries.en: And ye shall eat in plenty, and be satisfied, and praise the name of the LORD your God, that hath dealt wondrously with you: and my people shall never be ashamed.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin o si mọ̀ pe, emi wà lãrin Israeli, ati pe: Emi li Oluwa Ọlọrun nyin, kì iṣe ẹlomiràn: oju kì yio si tì awọn enia mi lai.
entries.en: And ye shall know that I am in the midst of Israel, and that I am the LORD your God, and none else: and my people shall never be ashamed.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, nikẹhìn emi o tú ẹmi mi jade si ara enia gbogbo; ati awọn ọmọ nyin ọkunrin, ati awọn ọmọ nyin obinrin yio ma ṣotẹlẹ, awọn arugbo nyin yio ma lá alá, awọn ọdọmọkunrin nyin yio ma riran:
entries.en: And it shall come to pass afterward, that I will pour out my spirit upon all flesh; and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, your old men shall dream dreams, your young men shall see visions:

entries.yo: Ati pẹlu si ara awọn ọmọ-ọdọ ọkunrin, ati si ara awọn ọmọ-ọdọ obinrin, li emi o tú ẹmi mi jade li ọjọ wọnni.
entries.en: And also upon the servants and upon the handmaids in those days will I pour out my spirit.

entries.yo: Emi o si fi iṣẹ iyanu hàn li ọrun ati li aiye, ẹjẹ̀ ati iná, ati ọwọ̀n ẹ̃fin.
entries.en: And I will shew wonders in the heavens and in the earth, blood, and fire, and pillars of smoke.

entries.yo: A ó sọ õrùn di òkunkun, ati oṣùpá di ẹjẹ̀, ki ọjọ nla ati ẹ̀ru Oluwa to de.
entries.en: The sun shall be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and the terrible day of the LORD come.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe ẹnikẹni ti o ba ke pè orukọ Oluwa li a o gbàla: nitori li oke Sioni ati ni Jerusalemu ni igbàla yio gbe wà, bi Oluwa ti wi, ati ninu awọn iyokù ti Oluwa yio pè.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass, that whosoever shall call on the name of the LORD shall be delivered: for in mount Zion and in Jerusalem shall be deliverance, as the LORD hath said, and in the remnant whom the LORD shall call.

entries.yo: NITORINA kiyesi i, li ọjọ wọnni, ati li akokò na, nigbati emi o tun mu igbèkun Juda ati Jerusalemu padà bọ̀.
entries.en: For, behold, in those days, and in that time, when I shall bring again the captivity of Judah and Jerusalem,

entries.yo: Emi o kó gbogbo orilẹ-ède jọ pẹlu, emi o si mu wọn wá si afonifojì Jehoṣafati, emi o si ba wọn wijọ nibẹ̀ nitori awọn enia mi, ati nitori Israeli iní mi, ti nwọn ti fọ́n ka sãrin awọn orilẹ̀-ede, nwọn si ti pín ilẹ mi.
entries.en: I will also gather all nations, and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat, and will plead with them there for my people and for my heritage Israel, whom they have scattered among the nations, and parted my land.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ti di ibò fun awọn enia mi; nwọn si ti fi ọmọdekunrin kan fun panṣagà obinrin kan, nwọn si ti tà ọmọdebinrin kan fun ọti-waini, ki nwọn ki o le mu.
entries.en: And they have cast lots for my people; and have given a boy for an harlot, and sold a girl for wine, that they might drink.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ, ati ki li ẹnyin ni ifi mi ṣe, ẹnyin Tire ati Sidoni, ati gbogbo ẹkùn Palestina? ẹnyin o ha san ẹsan fun mi? bi ẹnyin ba si san ẹsan fun mi, ni kánkan ati ni koyákoyá li emi o san ẹsan nyin padà sori ara nyin.
entries.en: Yea, and what have ye to do with me, O Tyre, and Zidon, and all the coasts of Palestine? will ye render me a recompence? and if ye recompence me, swiftly and speedily will I return your recompence upon your own head;

entries.yo: Nitoriti ẹnyin ti mu fàdakà mi ati wurà mi, ẹnyin si ti mu ohun rere daradara mi lọ sinu tempili nyin:
entries.en: Because ye have taken my silver and my gold, and have carried into your temples my goodly pleasant things:

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ Juda, ati awọn ọmọ Jerusalemu li ẹnyin ti tà fun awọn ara Griki, ki ẹnyin ba le sìn wọn jina kuro li agbègbe wọn.
entries.en: The children also of Judah and the children of Jerusalem have ye sold unto the Grecians, that ye might remove them far from their border.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, emi o gbe wọn dide kuro nibiti ẹnyin ti tà wọn si, emi o si san ẹsan nyin padà sori ara nyin.
entries.en: Behold, I will raise them out of the place whither ye have sold them, and will return your recompence upon your own head:

entries.yo: Emi o si tà awọn ọmọkunrin nyin ati awọn ọmọbinrin nyin si ọwọ́ awọn ọmọ Juda, nwọn o si tà wọn fun awọn ara Sabia, fun orilẹ-ède kan ti o jinà rére, nitori Oluwa li o ti sọ ọ.
entries.en: And I will sell your sons and your daughters into the hand of the children of Judah, and they shall sell them to the Sabeans, to a people far off: for the LORD hath spoken it.

entries.yo: Ẹ kede eyi li ãrin awọn keferi; ẹ yà ogun si mimọ́, ẹ ji awọn alagbara, ẹ sunmọ tòsi, ẹ goke wá gbogbo ẹnyin ọkunrin ologun.
entries.en: Proclaim ye this among the Gentiles; Prepare war, wake up the mighty men, let all the men of war draw near; let them come up:

entries.yo: Ẹ fi irin ọkọ́ itulẹ̀ nyin rọ idà, ati dojé nyin rọ ọkọ̀: jẹ ki alailera wi pe, Ara mi le koko.
entries.en: Beat your plowshares into swords, and your pruninghooks into spears: let the weak say, I am strong.

entries.yo: Ẹ kó ara nyin jọ, si wá, gbogbo ẹnyin keferi, ẹ si gbá ara nyin jọ yikakiri: nibẹ̀ ni ki o mu awọn alagbara rẹ sọkalẹ, Oluwa.
entries.en: Assemble yourselves, and come, all ye heathen, and gather yourselves together round about: thither cause thy mighty ones to come down, O LORD.

entries.yo: Ẹ ji, ẹ si goke wá si afonifojì Jehoṣafati ẹnyin keferi: nitori nibẹ̀ li emi o joko lati ṣe idajọ awọn keferi yikakiri.
entries.en: Let the heathen be wakened, and come up to the valley of Jehoshaphat: for there will I sit to judge all the heathen round about.

entries.yo: Ẹ tẹ̀ doje bọ̀ ọ, nitori ikore pọ́n: ẹ wá, ẹ sọkalẹ; nitori ifunti kún, nitori awọn ọpọ́n kún rekọja, nitori ìwa-buburu wọn pọ̀.
entries.en: Put ye in the sickle, for the harvest is ripe: come, get you down; for the press is full, the fats overflow; for their wickedness is great.

entries.yo: Ọ̀pọlọpọ, ọ̀pọlọpọ li afonifojì idajọ, nitori ọjọ Oluwa kù si dẹ̀dẹ ni afonifojì idajọ.
entries.en: Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision: for the day of the LORD is near in the valley of decision.

entries.yo: Õrùn ati oṣupa yio ṣu òkunkun, ati awọn irawọ̀ yio fà titàn wọn sẹhin.
entries.en: The sun and the moon shall be darkened, and the stars shall withdraw their shining.

entries.yo: Oluwa yio si ké ramùramù lati Sioni wá, yio si fọ ohùn rẹ̀ jade lati Jerusalemu wá; awọn ọrun ati aiye yio si mì: ṣugbọn Oluwa yio ṣe ãbò awọn enia rẹ̀, ati agbara awọn ọmọ Israeli.
entries.en: The LORD also shall roar out of Zion, and utter his voice from Jerusalem; and the heavens and the earth shall shake: but the LORD will be the hope of his people, and the strength of the children of Israel.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li ẹnyin o mọ̀ pe, Emi li Oluwa Ọlọrun nyin, ti ngbe Sioni oke mimọ́ mi: nigbana ni Jerusalemu yio jẹ mimọ́, awọn alejo kì yio si là a kọja mọ.
entries.en: So shall ye know that I am the LORD your God dwelling in Zion, my holy mountain: then shall Jerusalem be holy, and there shall no strangers pass through her any more.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe li ọjọ na, awọn oke-nla yio ma kán ọti-waini titún silẹ, awọn oke kékèké yio ma ṣàn fun warà, ati gbogbo odò Juda yio ma ṣan fun omi, orisun kan yio si jade lati inu ile Oluwa wá, yio si rin afonifojì Ṣittimu.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the mountains shall drop down new wine, and the hills shall flow with milk, and all the rivers of Judah shall flow with waters, and a fountain shall come forth of the house of the LORD, and shall water the valley of Shittim.

entries.yo: Egipti yio di ahoro, Edomu yio si di aginju ahoro, nitori ìwa ipá si awọn ọmọ Juda, nitoriti nwọn ti ta ẹjẹ̀ alaiṣẹ̀ silẹ ni ilẹ wọn.
entries.en: Egypt shall be a desolation, and Edom shall be a desolate wilderness, for the violence against the children of Judah, because they have shed innocent blood in their land.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Juda yio joko titi lai, ati Jerusalemu lati iran de iran.
entries.en: But Judah shall dwell for ever, and Jerusalem from generation to generation.

entries.yo: Nitori emi o wẹ̀ ẹjẹ̀ wọn nù, ti emi kò ti wẹ̀nu: nitori Oluwa ngbe Sioni.
entries.en: For I will cleanse their blood that I have not cleansed: for the LORD dwelleth in Zion.

entries.yo: Ọ̀RỌ Amosi, ẹniti o wà ninu awọn darandaran Tekoa, ti o ri niti Israeli li ọjọ ọba Ussiah ọba Juda, ati li ọjọ Jeroboamu ọmọ Joaṣi ọba Israeli, ọdun meji ṣãju isẹ̀lẹ nì.
entries.en: The words of Amos, who was among the herdman of Tekoa, which he saw concerning Israel in the days of Uzziah king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Israel, two years before the earthquake.

entries.yo: O si wipe, Oluwa yio bu jade lati Sioni wá, yio si fọ̀ ohùn rẹ̀ lati Jerusalemu wá; ibùgbe awọn olùṣọ-agùtan yio si ṣọ̀fọ, oke Karmeli yio si rọ.
entries.en: And he said, The LORD will roar from Zion, and utter his voice from Jerusalem; and the habitations of the shepherds shall mourn, and the top of Carmel shall wither.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa wi; nitori irekọja mẹta ti Damasku, ati nitori mẹrin, emi kì o yi iyà rẹ̀ kuro; nitori nwọn ti fi ohunèlo irin ipakà pa Gileadi:
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Damascus, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they have threshed Gilead with threshing instruments of iron:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi o rán iná kan si ile Hasaeli, ti yio jo ãfin Benhadadi wọnni run.
entries.en: But I will send a fire into the house of Hazael, which shall devour the palaces of Ben-hadad.

entries.yo: Emi o ṣẹ ọpá idabu Damasku pẹlu, emi o si ke ará pẹ̀tẹlẹ Afeni kuro, ati ẹniti o dì ọpá alade nì mu kuro ni ile Edeni: awọn enia Siria yio si lọ si igbèkun si Kiri, ni Oluwa wi.
entries.en: I will break also the bar of Damascus, and cut off the inhabitant from the plain of Aven, and him that holdeth the sceptre from the house of Eden: and the people of Syria shall go into captivity unto Kir, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa wi; nitori irekọja mẹta ti Gasa, ati nitori mẹrin, emi kì o yi iyà rẹ̀ kuro; nitori nwọn ti kó gbogbo igbèkun ni igbèkun lọ, lati fi wọn le Edomu lọwọ.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Gaza, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they carried away captive the whole captivity, to deliver them up to Edom:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi o rán iná kan sara odi Gasa, ti yio jo ãfin rẹ̀ wọnni run:
entries.en: But I will send a fire on the wall of Gaza, which shall devour the palaces thereof:

entries.yo: Emi o si ke ara Aṣdodi kuro, ati ẹniti o di ọpá alade mu kuro ni Aṣkeloni, emi o si yi ọwọ́ mi si Ekroni; iyokù ninu awọn ara Filistia yio ṣegbe, li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi.
entries.en: And I will cut off the inhabitant from Ashdod, and him that holdeth the sceptre from Ashkelon, and I will turn mine hand against Ekron: and the remnant of the Philistines shall perish, saith the Lord GOD.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa wi; nitori irekọja mẹta ti Tire, ati nitori mẹrin: emi kì o yi iyà rẹ̀ kuro; nitori nwọn fi gbogbo igbèkun le Edomu lọwọ, nwọn kò si ranti majẹmu arakunrin.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Tyrus, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they delivered up the whole captivity to Edom, and remembered not the brotherly covenant:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi o rán iná kan sara odi Tire, ti yio jo ãfin rẹ̀ wọnni run.
entries.en: But I will send a fire on the wall of Tyrus, which shall devour the palaces thereof.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa wi; nitori irekọja mẹta ti Edomu, ati nitori mẹrin, emi kì o yi iyà rẹ̀ kuro; nitori o fi idà lepa arakunrin rẹ̀, o si gbe gbogbo ãnu sọnù; ibinu rẹ̀ si nfaniya titi, o si pa ibinu rẹ̀ mọ titi lai.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Edom, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because he did pursue his brother with the sword, and did cast off all pity, and his anger did tear perpetually, and he kept his wrath for ever:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi o rán iná kan si Temani, ti yio jó afin Bosra wọnni run.
entries.en: But I will send a fire upon Teman, which shall devour the palaces of Bozrah.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa wi; nitori irekọja mẹta ti awọn ọmọ Ammoni, ati nitori mẹrin, emi kì o yi iyà rẹ̀ kuro; nitori nwọn ti là inu awọn aboyun Gileadi, ki nwọn le ba mu agbègbe wọn tobi:
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of the children of Ammon, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they have ripped up the women with child of Gilead, that they might enlarge their border:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi o da iná kan ninu odi Rabba, yio si jó ãfin rẹ̀ wọnni run, pẹlu iho ayọ̀ li ọjọ ogun, pẹlu ijì li ọjọ ãjà:
entries.en: But I will kindle a fire in the wall of Rabbah, and it shall devour the palaces thereof, with shouting in the day of battle, with a tempest in the day of the whirlwind:

entries.yo: Ọba wọn o si lọ si igbèkun, on ati awọn ọmọ-alade rẹ̀ pọ̀, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: And their king shall go into captivity, he and his princes together, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: BAYI li Oluwa wi; nitori irekọja mẹta ti Moabu, ati nitori mẹrin, emi kì o yi iyà rẹ̀ kuro; nitori o ti sun egungun ọba Edomu di ẽrú.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Moab, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because he burned the bones of the king of Edom into lime:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi o rán iná kan sara Moabu, yio si jó ãfin Kirioti wọnni run: Moabu yio si kú pẹlu ariwo, pẹlu iho ayọ̀, ati pẹlu iro ipè:
entries.en: But I will send a fire upon Moab, and it shall devour the palaces of Kerioth: and Moab shall die with tumult, with shouting, and with the sound of the trumpet:

entries.yo: Emi o si ké onidajọ kurò lãrin rẹ̀, emi o si pa gbogbo ọmọ-alade inu rẹ̀ pẹlu rẹ̀; li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: And I will cut off the judge from the midst thereof, and will slay all the princes thereof with him, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa wi; nitori irekọja mẹta ti Juda, ati nitori mẹrin, emi kì o yi iyà rẹ̀ kuro; nitori nwọn ti gàn ofin Oluwa, nwọn kò si pa aṣẹ rẹ̀ mọ, eke wọn si ti mu wọn ṣina, eyiti awọn baba wọn ti tẹ̀le.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Judah, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they have despised the law of the LORD, and have not kept his commandments, and their lies caused them to err, after the which their fathers have walked:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi o rán iná kan sara Juda, yio si jó ãfin Jerusalemu wọnni run.
entries.en: But I will send a fire upon Judah, and it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa wi; nitori irekọja mẹta ti Israeli, ati nitori mẹrin, emi kì o yi iyà rẹ̀ kuro; nitori nwọn tà olododo fun fàdakà, ati talakà fun bàta ẹsẹ̀ mejeji;
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Israel, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they sold the righteous for silver, and the poor for a pair of shoes;

entries.yo: Nwọn tẹ ori talaka sinu eruku ilẹ, nwọn si yi ọ̀na ọlọkàn tutù po: ati ọmọ ati baba rẹ̀ nwọle tọ̀ wundia kan, lati bà orukọ mimọ́ mi jẹ.
entries.en: That pant after the dust of the earth on the head of the poor, and turn aside the way of the meek: and a man and his father will go in unto the same maid, to profane my holy name:

entries.yo: Nwọn si dùbulẹ le aṣọ ti a fi lelẹ fun ògo lẹba olukuluku pẹpẹ, nwọn si mu ọti-waini awọn ti a yá, ni ile ọlọrun wọn.
entries.en: And they lay themselves down upon clothes laid to pledge by every altar, and they drink the wine of the condemned in the house of their god.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn mo pa ará Amori run niwaju wọn, giga ẹniti o dàbi giga igi-kedari, on si le bi igi-oaku; ṣugbọn mo pa eso rẹ̀ run lati oke wá, ati egbò rẹ̀ lati isalẹ wá.
entries.en: Yet destroyed I the Amorite before them, whose height was like the height of the cedars, and he was strong as the oaks; yet I destroyed his fruit from above, and his roots from beneath.
