entries.yo: Emi mu nyin goke pẹlu lati ilẹ Egipti wá, mo si sìn nyin li ogoji ọdun là aginjù ja, lati ni ilẹ awọn Amori.
entries.en: Also I brought you up from the land of Egypt, and led you forty years through the wilderness, to possess the land of the Amorite.

entries.yo: Mo si gbe ninu ọmọkunrin nyin dide lati jẹ woli, ati ninu awọn ọdọmọkunrin nyin lati jẹ Nasarite. Bẹ̃ ki o ri, ẹnyin ọmọ Israeli? li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: And I raised up of your sons for prophets, and of your young men for Nazarites. Is it not even thus, O ye children of Israel? saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹnyin fun awọn Nasarite ni ọti-waini mu, ẹ si paṣẹ fun awọn woli pe, Ẹ máṣe sọtẹlẹ.
entries.en: But ye gave the Nazarites wine to drink; and commanded the prophets, saying, Prophesy not.

entries.yo: Wò o, emi o tẹ̀ nyin mọlẹ, bi kẹkẹ́ ti o kún fun ití ti itẹ̀.
entries.en: Behold, I am pressed under you, as a cart is pressed that is full of sheaves.

entries.yo: Nitorina sisá yio dẹti fun ẹni yiyara, onipá kì yio si mu ipa rẹ̀ le, bẹ̃ni alagbara kì yio le gba ara rẹ̀ là.
entries.en: Therefore the flight shall perish from the swift, and the strong shall not strengthen his force, neither shall the mighty deliver himself:

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni tafàtafà kì yio duro; ati ẹniti o yasẹ̀ kì yio le gbà ara rẹ̀ là: bẹ̃ni ẹniti ngùn ẹṣin kì yio gbà ara rẹ̀ là:
entries.en: Neither shall he stand that handleth the bow; and he that is swift of foot shall not deliver himself: neither shall he that rideth the horse deliver himself.

entries.yo: Ati ẹniti o gboiyà ninu awọn alagbara yio salọ ni ihòho li ọjọ na, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: And he that is courageous among the mighty shall flee away naked in that day, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Ẹ gbọ̀ ọ̀rọ yi ti Oluwa ti sọ si nyin, ẹnyin ọmọ Israeli, si gbogbo idile ti mo mú goke lati ilẹ Egipti wá, wipe,
entries.en: Hear this word that the LORD hath spoken against you, O children of Israel, against the whole family which I brought up from the land of Egypt, saying,

entries.yo: Ẹnyin nikan ni mo mọ̀ ninu gbogbo idile aiye: nitorina emi o bẹ̀ nyin wò nitori gbogbo ẹ̀ṣẹ nyin.
entries.en: You only have I known of all the families of the earth: therefore I will punish you for all your iniquities.

entries.yo: Ẹni meji lè rìn pọ̀, bikòṣepe nwọn rẹ́?
entries.en: Can two walk together, except they be agreed?

entries.yo: Kiniun yio ké ramùramù ninu igbo, bi kò ni ohun ọdẹ? ọmọ kiniun yio ha ké jade ninu ihò rẹ̀, bi kò ri nkan mu?
entries.en: Will a lion roar in the forest, when he hath no prey? will a young lion cry out of his den, if he have taken nothing?

entries.yo: Ẹiyẹ le lu okùn ni ilẹ, nibiti okùn didẹ kò gbe si fun u? okùn ha le ré kuro lori ilẹ, laijẹ pe o mu nkan rara?
entries.en: Can a bird fall in a snare upon the earth, where no gin is for him? shall one take up a snare from the earth, and have taken nothing at all?

entries.yo: A le fun ipè ni ilu, ki awọn enia má bẹ̀ru? tulasi ha le wà ni ilu, ki o má ṣepe Oluwa li o ṣe e?
entries.en: Shall a trumpet be blown in the city, and the people not be afraid? shall there be evil in a city, and the LORD hath not done it?

entries.yo: Nitori Oluwa Ọlọrun kì o ṣe nkan kan, ṣugbọn o fi ohun ikọ̀kọ rẹ̀ hàn awọn woli iranṣẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Surely the Lord GOD will do nothing, but he revealeth his secret unto his servants the prophets.

entries.yo: Kiniun ti ké ramùramù, tani kì yio bẹ̀ru? Oluwa Ọlọrun ti sọ̀rọ, tani lè ṣe aisọtẹlẹ?
entries.en: The lion hath roared, who will not fear? the Lord GOD hath spoken, who can but prophesy?

entries.yo: Ẹ kede li ãfin Aṣdodu, ati li ãfin ni ilẹ Egipti, ki ẹ si wipe, Pè ara nyin jọ lori awọn oke nla Samaria, ki ẹ si wò irọkẹ̀kẹ nla lãrin rẹ̀, ati inilara lãrin rẹ̀.
entries.en: Publish in the palaces at Ashdod, and in the palaces in the land of Egypt, and say, Assemble yourselves upon the mountains of Samaria, and behold the great tumults in the midst thereof, and the oppressed in the midst thereof.

entries.yo: Nitori nwọn kò mọ̀ bi ati ṣe otitọ, li Oluwa wi, nwọn ti kó ìwa-ipá ati ìwa-olè jọ li ãfin wọn.
entries.en: For they know not to do right, saith the LORD, who store up violence and robbery in their palaces.

entries.yo: Nitorina, bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Ọta kan yio si wà yi ilẹ na ka; on o si sọ agbara rẹ kalẹ kuro lara rẹ, a o si kó ãfin rẹ wọnni.
entries.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; An adversary there shall be even round about the land; and he shall bring down thy strength from thee, and thy palaces shall be spoiled.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa wi; gẹgẹ bi oluṣọ-agùtan iti gbà itan meji kuro li ẹnu kiniun, tabi ẹlà eti kan; bẹ̃li a o mu awọn ọmọ Israeli ti ngbe Samaria kuro ni igun akete, ati ni aṣọ Damasku irọ̀gbọku.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD; As the shepherd taketh out of the mouth of the lion two legs, or a piece of an ear; so shall the children of Israel be taken out that dwell in Samaria in the corner of a bed, and in Damascus in a couch.

entries.yo: Ẹ gbọ́, ẹ si jẹri si ile Jakobu, li Oluwa Ọlọrun, Ọlọrun awọn ọmọ-ogun wi,
entries.en: Hear ye, and testify in the house of Jacob, saith the Lord GOD, the God of hosts,

entries.yo: Pe, li ọjọ ti emi o bẹ̀ irekọja Israeli wò lara rẹ̀, emi o bẹ̀ awọn pẹpẹ Beteli wò pẹlu: a o si ké iwo pẹpẹ kuro, nwọn o si wó lulẹ.
entries.en: That in the day that I shall visit the transgressions of Israel upon him I will also visit the altars of Bethel: and the horns of the altar shall be cut off, and fall to the ground.

entries.yo: Emi o si lù ile otutù pẹlu ile ẹ̃rùn; ile ehín erin yio si ṣègbe, ile nla wọnni yio si li opin, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: And I will smite the winter house with the summer house; and the houses of ivory shall perish, and the great houses shall have an end, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Ẹ gbọ́ ọ̀rọ yi, ẹnyin ọmọ malu Baṣan, ti o wà li oke nla Samaria, ti o nni talakà lara, ti o ntẹ̀ alaini rẹ́, ti o nwi fun oluwa wọn pe, Gbe wá, ki a si mu.
entries.en: Hear this word, ye kine of Bashan, that are in the mountain of Samaria, which oppress the poor, which crush the needy, which say to their masters, Bring, and let us drink.

entries.yo: Oluwa Ọlọrun ti bura ninu iwà-mimọ́ rẹ̀, pe, Sa wò o, ọjọ wọnni yio de ba nyin, ti on o fi ìwọ gbe nyin kuro, yio si fi ìwọ-ẹja gbe iran nyin.
entries.en: The Lord GOD hath sworn by his holiness, that, lo, the days shall come upon you, that he will take you away with hooks, and your posterity with fishhooks.

entries.yo: Ati ni ibi yiya odi wọnni li ẹnyin o ba jade lọ, olukuluku niwaju rẹ̀ gan; ẹnyin o si gbe ara nyin sọ si Harmona, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: And ye shall go out at the breaches, every cow at that which is before her; and ye shall cast them into the palace, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Ẹ wá si Beteli, ki ẹ si dẹṣẹ: ẹ mu irekọja nyin pọ̀ si i ni Gilgali; ẹ si mu ẹbọ nyin wá li orowurọ̀, ati idamẹwa nyin lẹhìn ọdun mẹta.
entries.en: Come to Bethel, and transgress; at Gilgal multiply transgression; and bring your sacrifices every morning, and your tithes after three years:

entries.yo: Ki ẹ si ru ẹbọ ọpẹ́ pẹlu iwukara, ẹ kede, ki ẹ si fi ọrẹ atinuwa lọ̀: nitori bẹ̃li ẹnyin fẹ́, ẹnyin ọmọ Israeli, li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi.
entries.en: And offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving with leaven, and proclaim and publish the free offerings: for this liketh you, O ye children of Israel, saith the Lord GOD.

entries.yo: Emi pẹlu si ti fun nyin ni mimọ́ ehín ni gbogbo ilu nyin, ati aini onjẹ, ni ibùgbe nyin gbogbo: sibẹ̀ ẹnyin kò yipadà sọdọ mi, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: And I also have given you cleanness of teeth in all your cities, and want of bread in all your places: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Ati pẹlu, emi ti fà ọwọ́ òjo sẹhìn kuro lọdọ nyin, nigbati o kù oṣù mẹta si i fun ikorè; emi si ti mu òjo rọ̀ si ilu kan, emi kò si jẹ ki o rọ̀ si ilu miràn: o rọ̀ si apakan, ibiti kò gbe rọ̀ si si rọ.
entries.en: And also I have withholden the rain from you, when there were yet three months to the harvest: and I caused it to rain upon one city, and caused it not to rain upon another city: one piece was rained upon, and the piece whereupon it rained not withered.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni ilu meji tabi mẹta nrìn lọ si ilu kan, lati mu omi: ṣugbọn kò tẹ́ wọn lọrùn: sibẹ̀ ẹnyin kò ti ipadà sọdọ mi, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: So two or three cities wandered unto one city, to drink water; but they were not satisfied: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Mo ti fi irẹ̀danù ati imúwòdú lù nyin: nigbati ọgbà nyin ati ọgbà-àjara nyin, ati igi ọ̀pọtọ́ nyin, ati igi olifi nyin npọ̀ si i, kòkoro jẹ wọn run; sibẹ̀ ẹnyin kò ti ipadà sọdọ mi, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: I have smitten you with blasting and mildew: when your gardens and your vineyards and your fig trees and your olive trees increased, the palmerworm devoured them: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Mo ti rán ajàkalẹ-arùn si ãrin nyin, gẹgẹ bi ti Egipti: awọn ọdọmọkunrin nyin li emi si ti fi idà pa, nwọn si ti kó ẹṣin nyin ni igbèkun pẹlu; mo si ti jẹ ki õrùn ibùdo nyin bù soke wá si imú nyin: sibẹ̀ ẹnyin kò ti ipadà sọdọ mi, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: I have sent among you the pestilence after the manner of Egypt: your young men have I slain with the sword, and have taken away your horses; and I have made the stink of your camps to come up unto your nostrils: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Mo ti bì ṣubu ninu nyin, bi Ọlọrun ti bì Sodomu on Gomorra ṣubu, ẹnyin si dàbi oguná ti a fà yọ kuro ninu ijoná: sibẹ̀ ẹnyin kò ti ipadà sọdọ mi, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: I have overthrown some of you, as God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah, and ye were as a firebrand plucked out of the burning: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Nitorina, bayi li emi o ṣe si ọ, iwọ Israeli: ati nitoriti emi o ṣe eyi si ọ, mura lati pade Ọlọrun rẹ, iwọ Israeli.
entries.en: Therefore thus will I do unto thee, O Israel: and because I will do this unto thee, prepare to meet thy God, O Israel.

entries.yo: Nitori sa wò o, ẹniti o dá awọn oke nla, ti o si dá afẹ̃fẹ, ti o si sọ fun enia ohun ti erò inu rẹ̀ jasi, ti o sọ owurọ̀ di òkunkun, ti o si tẹ̀ ibi giga aiye mọlẹ, Oluwa, Ọlọrun awọn ọmọ-ogun li orukọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: For, lo, he that formeth the mountains, and createth the wind, and declareth unto man what is his thought, that maketh the morning darkness, and treadeth upon the high places of the earth, The LORD, The God of hosts, is his name.

entries.yo: Ẹ gbọ́ ọ̀rọ yi ti emi gbe soke si nyin, ani ohùnrére ẹkun, ẹnyin ile Israeli.
entries.en: Hear ye this word which I take up against you, even a lamentation, O house of Israel.

entries.yo: Wundia Israeli ti ṣubu; kì yio dide mọ: a kọ̀ ọ silẹ lori ilẹ rẹ̀; kò si ẹniti yio gbe e dide.
entries.en: The virgin of Israel is fallen; she shall no more rise: she is forsaken upon her land; there is none to raise her up.

entries.yo: Nitori bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; Ilu ti o jade lọ li ẹgbẹrun yio ṣikù ọgọrun; eyiti o si jade lọ li ọgọrun yio ṣikù mẹwa, fun ile Israeli.
entries.en: For thus saith the Lord GOD; The city that went out by a thousand shall leave an hundred, and that which went forth by an hundred shall leave ten, to the house of Israel.

entries.yo: Nitori bayi li Oluwa wi fun ile Israeli, ẹ wá mi, ẹnyin o si yè:
entries.en: For thus saith the LORD unto the house of Israel, Seek ye me, and ye shall live:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹ máṣe wá Beteli, bẹ̃ni ki ẹ má wọ̀ inu Gilgali lọ, ẹ má si rekọja lọ si Beerṣeba: nitori lõtọ Gilgali yio lọ si igbèkun, Beteli yio si di asan.
entries.en: But seek not Bethel, nor enter into Gilgal, and pass not to Beer-sheba: for Gilgal shall surely go into captivity, and Bethel shall come to nought.

entries.yo: Ẹ wá Oluwa, ẹnyin o si yè; ki o má ba gbilẹ bi iná ni ile Josefu, a si jó o run, ti kì o fi si ẹnikan lati pá a ni Beteli.
entries.en: Seek the LORD, and ye shall live; lest he break out like fire in the house of Joseph, and devour it, and there be none to quench it in Bethel.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin ti ẹ sọ idajọ di iwọ, ti ẹ si kọ̀ ododo silẹ li aiye.
entries.en: Ye who turn judgment to wormwood, and leave off righteousness in the earth,

entries.yo: Ẹ wá ẹniti o dá irawọ̀ meje nì ati Orioni, ti o si sọ ojiji ikú di owurọ̀, ti o si fi oru mu ọjọ ṣokùnkun: ti o pè awọn omi okun, ti o si tú wọn jade soju aiye: Oluwa li orukọ rẹ̀:
entries.en: Seek him that maketh the seven stars and Orion, and turneth the shadow of death into the morning, and maketh the day dark with night: that calleth for the waters of the sea, and poureth them out upon the face of the earth: The LORD is his name:

entries.yo: Ti o mu iparun kọ manà sori alagbara, tobẹ̃ ti iparun yio wá si odi agbara.
entries.en: That strengtheneth the spoiled against the strong, so that the spoiled shall come against the fortress.

entries.yo: Nwọn korira ẹniti nbaniwi li ẹnu bodè, nwọn si korira ẹniti nsọ otitọ.
entries.en: They hate him that rebuketh in the gate, and they abhor him that speaketh uprightly.

entries.yo: Nitorina niwọ̀n bi itẹ̀mọlẹ nyin ti wà lori talakà, ti ẹnyin si gba ẹrù alikama lọwọ rẹ̀: ẹnyin ti fi okuta ti a gbẹ́ kọ́ ile, ṣugbọn ẹ kì o gbe inu wọn; ẹnyin ti gbìn ọgbà àjara daradara, ṣugbọn ẹ kì o mu ọti-waini wọn.
entries.en: Forasmuch therefore as your treading is upon the poor, and ye take from him burdens of wheat: ye have built houses of hewn stone, but ye shall not dwell in them; ye have planted pleasant vineyards, but ye shall not drink wine of them.

entries.yo: Nitori mo mọ̀ onirũru irekọja nyin, ati ẹ̀ṣẹ nla nyin: nwọn npọ́n olododo loju, nwọn ngbà owo abẹ̀tẹlẹ, nwọn si nyi awọn talakà si apakan ni bodè, kuro ninu are wọn.
entries.en: For I know your manifold transgressions and your mighty sins: they afflict the just, they take a bribe, and they turn aside the poor in the gate from their right.

entries.yo: Nitorina ẹni-oye yio dakẹ nigbana; nitori akòko ibi ni.
entries.en: Therefore the prudent shall keep silence in that time; for it is an evil time.

entries.yo: Ẹ ma wá ire, kì isi iṣe ibi, ki ẹ ba le yè; bẹ̃ni Oluwa, Ọlọrun awọn ọmọ-ogun, yio si pẹlu nyin, bi ẹnyin ti wi.
entries.en: Seek good, and not evil, that ye may live: and so the LORD, the God of hosts, shall be with you, as ye have spoken.

entries.yo: Ẹ korira ibi, ẹ si fẹ́ ire, ki ẹ si fi idajọ gunlẹ ni bodè; boya Oluwa Ọlọrun awọn ọmọ-ogun yio ṣe ojurere si iyokù Josefu.
entries.en: Hate the evil, and love the good, and establish judgment in the gate: it may be that the LORD God of hosts will be gracious unto the remnant of Joseph.

entries.yo: Nitorina Oluwa Ọlọrun awọn ọmọ-ogun, ani Oluwa wi bayi pe, Ẹkun yio wà ni gbogbo ita; nwọn o si ma wi ni gbogbo òpopó ọ̀na pe, Ã! ã! nwọn o si pè agbẹ̀ si iṣọ̀fọ, ati iru awọn ti o gbọ́n lati pohùnrére si isọkún.
entries.en: Therefore the LORD, the God of hosts, the Lord, saith thus; Wailing shall be in all streets; and they shall say in all the highways, Alas! alas! and they shall call the husbandman to mourning, and such as are skilful of lamentation to wailing.

entries.yo: Ati ni gbogbo ọ̀gba àjara ni isọkún yio gbe wà: nitori emi o kọja lãrin rẹ, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: And in all vineyards shall be wailing: for I will pass through thee, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Egbe ni fun ẹnyin ti ẹ nfẹ́ ọjọ Oluwa! kili eyi o jasi fun nyin? ọjọ Oluwa òkunkun ni, kì isi iṣe imọlẹ.
entries.en: Woe unto you that desire the day of the LORD! to what end is it for you? the day of the LORD is darkness, and not light.

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi enia ti o sa fun kiniun, ti beari si pade rẹ̀; tabi ti o wọ̀ inu ile, ti o si fi ọwọ́ rẹ̀ tì lara ogiri, ti ejò si bù u jẹ.
entries.en: As if a man did flee from a lion, and a bear met him; or went into the house, and leaned his hand on the wall, and a serpent bit him.

entries.yo: Ọjọ Oluwa kì o ha ṣe òkunkun laiṣe imọlẹ? ani òkunkun biribiri, laisi imọlẹ ninu rẹ̀?
entries.en: Shall not the day of the LORD be darkness, and not light? even very dark, and no brightness in it?

entries.yo: Mo korira, mo si kẹgàn ọjọ asè nyin, emi kì o si gbõrùn ọjọ ajọ ọ̀wọ nyin.
entries.en: I hate, I despise your feast days, and I will not smell in your solemn assemblies.

entries.yo: Bi ẹnyin tilẹ rú ẹbọ sisun ati ẹbọ jijẹ nyin si mi, emi kì o si gbà wọn: bẹ̃ni emi ki yio nani ẹbọ ọpẹ́ ẹran abọ́pa nyin.
entries.en: Though ye offer me burnt offerings and your meat offerings, I will not accept them: neither will I regard the peace offerings of your fat beasts.

entries.yo: Mu ariwo orin rẹ kuro lọdọ mi; nitori emi kì o gbọ́ iró adùn fioli rẹ.
entries.en: Take thou away from me the noise of thy songs; for I will not hear the melody of thy viols.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn jẹ ki idajọ ki o ṣàn silẹ bi omi, ati ododo bi iṣàn omi nla.
entries.en: But let judgment run down as waters, and righteousness as a mighty stream.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin ha ti rubọ si mi, ẹ ha ti ta mi lọrẹ li aginjù li ogoji ọdun, ẹnyin ile Israeli.
entries.en: Have ye offered unto me sacrifices and offerings in the wilderness forty years, O house of Israel?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹnyin ti rù agọ Moloku ati Kiuni nyin, awọn ere nyin, irawọ̀ òriṣa nyin, ti ẹ ṣe fun ara nyin.
entries.en: But ye have borne the tabernacle of your Moloch and Chiun your images, the star of your god, which ye made to yourselves.

entries.yo: Nitorina, emi o mu ki ẹ lọ si igbèkun rekọja Damasku, li Oluwa wi, Ọlọrun awọn ọmọ-ogun li orukọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Therefore will I cause you to go into captivity beyond Damascus, saith the LORD, whose name is The God of hosts.

entries.yo: EGBE ni fun ẹniti ara rọ̀ ni Sioni, ati awọn ti o gbẹkẹ̀le oke nla Samaria, awọn ti a pè ni ikini ninu awọn orilẹ-ède, awọn ti ile Israeli tọ̀ wá!
entries.en: Woe to them that are at ease in Zion, and trust in the mountain of Samaria, which are named chief of the nations, to whom the house of Israel came!

entries.yo: Ẹ kọja si Kalne, si wò; ẹ si ti ibẹ̀ lọ si Hamati nla: lẹhìn na ẹ sọ̀kalẹ lọ si Gati ti awọn Filistini: nwọn ha san jù ilẹ ọba wọnyi lọ? tabi agbègbe wọn ha tobi jù agbègbe nyin lọ?
entries.en: Pass ye unto Calneh, and see; and from thence go ye to Hamath the great: then go down to Gath of the Philistines: be they better than these kingdoms? or their border greater than your border?

entries.yo: Ẹnyin ti o sún ọjọ ibi siwaju, ti ẹ si mu ibùgbe ìwa-ipá sunmọ tòsi;
entries.en: Ye that put far away the evil day, and cause the seat of violence to come near;

entries.yo: Awọn ti o ndùbulẹ lori akete ehin-erin, ti nwọn si nnà ara wọn lori irọ̀gbọku wọn, ti nwọn njẹ ọdọ-agùtan inu agbo, ati ẹgbọ̀rọ malu inu agbo;
entries.en: That lie upon beds of ivory, and stretch themselves upon their couches, and eat the lambs out of the flock, and the calves out of the midst of the stall;

entries.yo: Ti nwáhùn si iró orin fioli, ti nwọn si nṣe ohun-ikọrin fun ara wọn, bi Dafidi;
entries.en: That chant to the sound of the viol, and invent to themselves instruments of musick, like David;

entries.yo: Awọn ti nmuti ninu ọpọ́n waini, ti nwọn si nfi olori ororo kun ara wọn; ṣugbọn nwọn kò banujẹ nitori ipọnju Josefu.
entries.en: That drink wine in bowls, and anoint themselves with the chief ointments: but they are not grieved for the affliction of Joseph.

entries.yo: Nitorina awọn ni o lọ si igbèkun pẹlu awọn ti o ti kọ́ lọ si igbèkun; àse awọn ti nṣe aṣeleke li a o mu kuro.
entries.en: Therefore now shall they go captive with the first that go captive, and the banquet of them that stretched themselves shall be removed.

entries.yo: Oluwa Ọlọrun ti fi ara rẹ̀ bura, li Oluwa Ọlọrun awọn ọmọ ogun wi, Emi korira ọlanla Jakobu, mo si korira ãfin rẹ̀: nitorina li emi o ṣe fi ilu na, ati ohun gbogbo ti o wà ninu rẹ̀ tọrẹ.
entries.en: The Lord GOD hath sworn by himself, saith the LORD the God of hosts, I abhor the excellency of Jacob, and hate his palaces: therefore will I deliver up the city with all that is therein.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, bi enia mẹwa li o ba kù ninu ile kan, nwọn o si kú.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass, if there remain ten men in one house, that they shall die.

entries.yo: Ati arakunrin rẹ̀, ati ẹniti o nfi i joná, lati kó egungun wọnni jade kuro ninu ile, yio gbe e, yio si bi ẹniti o wà li ẹba ile lere pe, O ha tun kù ẹnikan pẹlu rẹ? On o si wipe, Bẹ̃kọ̀. Nigbana li on o wipe, Pa ẹnu rẹ mọ: nitoripe awa kò gbọdọ da orukọ Oluwa.
entries.en: And a man's uncle shall take him up, and he that burneth him, to bring out the bones out of the house, and shall say unto him that is by the sides of the house, Is there yet any with thee? and he shall say, No. Then shall he say, Hold thy tongue: for we may not make mention of the name of the LORD.

entries.yo: Nitori kiyesi i, Oluwa paṣẹ, yio si fi iparun kọlù ile nla na, ati aisàn kọlù ile kékèké.
entries.en: For, behold, the LORD commandeth, and he will smite the great house with breaches, and the little house with clefts.

entries.yo: Ẹṣin ha le ma sure lori apata? ẹnikan ha le fi akọ malu ṣiṣẹ ìtulẹ̀ nibẹ̀? nitoriti ẹnyin ti yi idajọ dà si oró, ati eso ododo dà si iwọ:
entries.en: Shall horses run upon the rock? will one plow there with oxen? for ye have turned judgment into gall, and the fruit of righteousness into hemlock:

entries.yo: Ẹnyin ti nyọ̀ si ohun asan, ti nwipe, Nipa agbara ara wa kọ́ li awa fi gbà iwo fun ara wa?
entries.en: Ye which rejoice in a thing of nought, which say, Have we not taken to us horns by our own strength?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn kiyesi i, emi o gbe orilẹ-ède kan dide si nyin, ẹnyin ile Israeli, li Oluwa Ọlọrun awọn ọmọ-ogun wi; nwọn o si pọ́n nyin loju lati iwọle Hamati, titi de odò pẹ̀tẹlẹ.
entries.en: But, behold, I will raise up against you a nation, O house of Israel, saith the LORD the God of hosts; and they shall afflict you from the entering in of Hamath unto the river of the wilderness.

entries.yo: BAYI li Oluwa Ọlọrun ti fi hàn mi; si wò o, o dá ẽṣú ni ibẹ̀rẹ irú-soke idàgba ikẹhin, si wò o, idàgba ikẹhìn lẹhìn ike-kuro ti ọba nì.
entries.en: Thus hath the Lord GOD shewed unto me; and, behold, he formed grasshoppers in the beginning of the shooting up of the latter growth; and, lo, it was the latter growth after the king's mowings.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, ti nwọn jẹ koriko ilẹ na tan, nigbana ni mo wipe, Oluwa Ọlọrun, darijì, emi bẹ̀ ọ: Jakobu yio ha ṣe le dide? nitori ẹnikekere li on.
entries.en: And it came to pass, that when they had made an end of eating the grass of the land, then I said, O Lord GOD, forgive, I beseech thee: by whom shall Jacob arise? for he is small.

entries.yo: Oluwa ronupiwàda nitori eyi: Kì yio ṣe, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: The LORD repented for this: It shall not be, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun ti fi hàn mi: si wò o, Oluwa Ọlọrun pè lati fi iná jà, o si jó ibú nla nì run, o si jẹ apakan run.
entries.en: Thus hath the Lord GOD shewed unto me: and, behold, the Lord GOD called to contend by fire, and it devoured the great deep, and did eat up a part.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni mo wipe, Oluwa Ọlọrun, dawọ duro, emi bẹ̀ ọ: Jakobu yio ha ṣe le dide? nitori ẹnikekere li on.
entries.en: Then said I, O Lord GOD, cease, I beseech thee: by whom shall Jacob arise? for he is small.

entries.yo: Oluwa ronupiwàda nitori eyi: Eyi pẹlu kì yio ṣe, li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi.
entries.en: The LORD repented for this: This also shall not be, saith the Lord GOD.

entries.yo: Bayi li on fi hàn mi: si wò o, Oluwa duro lori odi kan, ti a fi okùn-ìwọn ti o run mọ, ti on ti okùn-ìwọn ti o run li ọwọ́ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Thus he shewed me: and, behold, the Lord stood upon a wall made by a plumbline, with a plumbline in his hand.

entries.yo: Oluwa si wi fun mi pe, Amosi, kini iwọ ri? Emi si wipe, Okùn-ìwọn kan ti o run ni. Nigbana ni Oluwa wipe, Wò o, emi o fi okùn-ìwọn rirun kan le ilẹ lãrin Israeli enia mi: emi kì yio si tun kọja lọdọ wọn mọ:
entries.en: And the LORD said unto me, Amos, what seest thou? And I said, A plumbline. Then said the Lord, Behold, I will set a plumbline in the midst of my people Israel: I will not again pass by them any more:

entries.yo: Ibi giga Israeli wọnni yio si di ahoro: ati ibi mimọ́ Israeli wọnni yio di ahoro; emi o si fi idà dide si ile Jeroboamu.
entries.en: And the high places of Isaac shall be desolate, and the sanctuaries of Israel shall be laid waste; and I will rise against the house of Jeroboam with the sword.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Amasiah, alufa Beteli ranṣẹ si Jeroboamu ọba Israeli, wipe, Amosi ti ditẹ̀ si ọ lãrin ile Israeli: ilẹ kò si le gba gbogbo ọ̀rọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Then Amaziah the priest of Bethel sent to Jeroboam king of Israel, saying, Amos hath conspired against thee in the midst of the house of Israel: the land is not able to bear all his words.

entries.yo: Nitori bayi li Amosi wi, Jeroboamu yio ti ipa idà kú, nitõtọ Israeli li a o si fà lọ si igbèkun kuro ni ilẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: For thus Amos saith, Jeroboam shall die by the sword, and Israel shall surely be led away captive out of their own land.

entries.yo: Amasiah sọ fun Amosi pẹlu pe, Iwọ ariran, lọ, salọ si ilẹ Juda, si ma jẹun nibẹ̀, si ma sọtẹlẹ nibẹ̀:
entries.en: Also Amaziah said unto Amos, O thou seer, go, flee thee away into the land of Judah, and there eat bread, and prophesy there:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn máṣe sọtẹlẹ̀ mọ ni Beteli: nitori ibi mimọ́ ọba ni, ãfin ọba si ni.
entries.en: But prophesy not again any more at Bethel: for it is the king's chapel, and it is the king's court.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Amosi dahùn, o si wi fun Amasiah pe, Emi ki iṣe woli ri, bẹ̃ni emi kì iṣe ọmọ woli, ṣugbọn olùṣọ-agùtan li emi ti iṣe ri, ati ẹniti iti ma ká eso ọpọ̀tọ:
entries.en: Then answered Amos, and said to Amaziah, I was no prophet, neither was I a prophet's son; but I was an herdman, and a gatherer of sycomore fruit:

entries.yo: Oluwa si mu mi, bi mo ti ntọ̀ agbo-ẹran lẹhìn, Oluwa si wi fun mi pe, Lọ, sọtẹlẹ̀ fun Israeli enia mi.
entries.en: And the LORD took me as I followed the flock, and the LORD said unto me, Go, prophesy unto my people Israel.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, iwọ gbọ́ ọ̀rọ Oluwa: Iwọ wipe, Máṣe sọtẹlẹ̀ si Israeli, má si jẹ ki ọ̀rọ rẹ kán silẹ si ile Isaaki.
entries.en: Now therefore hear thou the word of the LORD: Thou sayest, Prophesy not against Israel, and drop not thy word against the house of Isaac.

entries.yo: Nitorina bayi li Oluwa wi; Obinrin rẹ yio di panṣagà ni ilu, ati awọn ọmọ rẹ ọkunrin ati awọn ọmọ rẹ obinrin, yio ti ipa idà ṣubu; ilẹ rẹ li a o si fi okùn pin; iwọ o si kú ni ilẹ aimọ́: nitõtọ, a o si kó Israeli lọ ni igbèkun kuro ni ilẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Thy wife shall be an harlot in the city, and thy sons and thy daughters shall fall by the sword, and thy land shall be divided by line; and thou shalt die in a polluted land: and Israel shall surely go into captivity forth of his land.

entries.yo: BAYI li Oluwa Ọlọrun ti fi hàn mi: si kiyesi i, agbọ̀n eso ẹrùn kan.
entries.en: Thus hath the Lord GOD shewed unto me: and behold a basket of summer fruit.

entries.yo: On si wipe, Amosi, kili ohun ti iwọ ri? Emi si wipe, Agbọ̀n eso ẹrùn ni. Nigbana li Oluwa wi fun mi pe, Opin de si Israeli enia mi; emi kì yio tún kọja lọdọ wọn mọ.
entries.en: And he said, Amos, what seest thou? And I said, A basket of summer fruit. Then said the LORD unto me, The end is come upon my people of Israel; I will not again pass by them any more.

entries.yo: Orin inu tempeli yio si jẹ hihu li ọjọ na, li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi: okú pupọ̀ ni yio wà ni ibi gbogbo; nwọn o ma fi idakẹ jù wọn sode.
entries.en: And the songs of the temple shall be howlings in that day, saith the Lord GOD: there shall be many dead bodies in every place; they shall cast them forth with silence.

entries.yo: Ẹ gbọ́ eyi, ẹnyin ti ngbe awọn alaini mì, lati sọ awọn talakà ilẹ na di alaini,
entries.en: Hear this, O ye that swallow up the needy, even to make the poor of the land to fail,

entries.yo: Ti nwipe, Nigbawo ni oṣù titún yio pari, ki awa ba le ta ọkà? ati ọjọ isimi, ki awa ba le ṣi alikama silẹ, ki a si ṣe ìwọn efà kere, ati ìwọn ṣekeli tobi, ki a si ma fi ẹ̀tan yi ìwọn padà?
entries.en: Saying, When will the new moon be gone, that we may sell corn? and the sabbath, that we may set forth wheat, making the ephah small, and the shekel great, and falsifying the balances by deceit?

entries.yo: Ki awa le fi fàdakà rà talakà, ati bàta ẹsẹ̀ mejeji rà alaini, ki a si tà eyiti o dànu ninu alikama?
entries.en: That we may buy the poor for silver, and the needy for a pair of shoes; yea, and sell the refuse of the wheat?

entries.yo: Oluwa ti bura nipa ọlanla Jakobu pe, Nitõtọ emi kì yio gbàgbe ọkan ninu iṣẹ wọn.
entries.en: The LORD hath sworn by the excellency of Jacob, Surely I will never forget any of their works.

entries.yo: Ilẹ na kì yio ha warìri nitori eyi, ati olukuluku ẹniti o ngbe inu rẹ̀ kì yio ha ṣọ̀fọ? yio si rú soke patapata bi kikún omi; a o si tì i jade, a o si tẹ̀ ẹ rì, gẹgẹ bi odò Egipti.
entries.en: Shall not the land tremble for this, and every one mourn that dwelleth therein? and it shall rise up wholly as a flood; and it shall be cast out and drowned, as by the flood of Egypt.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe li ọjọ na, li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi; emi o si mu ki õrùn ki o wọ̀ lọsan, emi o si mu aiye ṣu òkunkun li ọ̀san gangan:
entries.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the Lord GOD, that I will cause the sun to go down at noon, and I will darken the earth in the clear day:

entries.yo: Emi o si yi àse nyin padà si ọ̀fọ, ati orin nyin gbogbo si ohùn-rére ẹkún: emi o si mu aṣọ ọ̀fọ wá si ẹgbẹ̀ gbogbo, ati pipá ori, si gbogbo ori; emi o si ṣe e ki o dàbi iṣọ̀fọ fun ọmọ kanṣoṣo ti a bi; ati opin rẹ̀ bi ọjọ kikorò.
entries.en: And I will turn your feasts into mourning, and all your songs into lamentation; and I will bring up sackcloth upon all loins, and baldness upon every head; and I will make it as the mourning of an only son, and the end thereof as a bitter day.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, ọjọ na de, li Oluwa Ọlọrun wi, emi o rán iyàn wá si ilẹ na, kì iṣe iyàn onjẹ, tabi ongbẹ fun omi, ṣugbọn iyàn gbigbọ́ ọ̀rọ Oluwa:
entries.en: Behold, the days come, saith the Lord GOD, that I will send a famine in the land, not a famine of bread, nor a thirst for water, but of hearing the words of the LORD:

entries.yo: Nwọn o si ma rìn kiri lati okun de okun, ati lati ariwa ani titi de ila-õrun, nwọn o sare siwá sẹhìn lati wá ọ̀rọ Oluwa, nwọn kì yio si ri i.
entries.en: And they shall wander from sea to sea, and from the north even to the east, they shall run to and fro to seek the word of the LORD, and shall not find it.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ na li awọn arẹwà wundia, ati awọn ọdọmọkunrin yio daku fun ongbẹ.
entries.en: In that day shall the fair virgins and young men faint for thirst.

entries.yo: Awọn ti o fi ẹ̀ṣẹ Samaria bura, ti nwọn si wipe, Iwọ Dani, ọlọrun rẹ mbẹ lãyè! ati ọ̀na Beerṣeba mbẹ lãyè! ani nwọn o ṣubu, nwọn kì yio si tún dide mọ.
entries.en: They that swear by the sin of Samaria, and say, Thy god, O Dan, liveth; and, The manner of Beer-sheba liveth; even they shall fall, and never rise up again.

entries.yo: MO ri Oluwa o duro lori pẹpẹ: o si wipe, Lù itẹrigbà ilẹ̀kun, ki awọn òpo ki o le mì: si ṣá wọn li ori, gbogbo wọn; emi o si fi idà pa ẹni ikẹhìn wọn: ẹniti o sá ninu wọn, kì yio salọ gbe; ati ẹniti o sa asalà ninu wọn li a kì yio gbàla.
entries.en: I saw the LORD standing upon the altar: and he said, Smite the lintel of the door, that the posts may shake: and cut them in the head, all of them; and I will slay the last of them with the sword: he that fleeth of them shall not flee away, and he that escapeth of them shall not be delivered.

entries.yo: Bi nwọn tilẹ wà ilẹ lọ si ọrun-apadi, lati ibẹ̀ li ọwọ́ mi yio ti tẹ̀ wọn; bi nwọn tilẹ gùn okè ọrun lọ; lati ibẹ̀ li emi o ti mu wọn sọ̀kalẹ:
entries.en: Though they dig into hell, thence shall mine hand take them; though they climb up to heaven, thence will I bring them down:

entries.yo: Ati bi nwọn tilẹ fi ara wọn pamọ li ori oke Karmeli; emi o wá wọn ri, emi o si mu wọn kuro nibẹ̀; ati bi a tilẹ fi wọn pamọ kuro niwaju mi ni isàlẹ okun; lati ibẹ̀ na li emi o ti paṣẹ fun ejò nì, on o si bù wọn jẹ:
entries.en: And though they hide themselves in the top of Carmel, I will search and take them out thence; and though they be hid from my sight in the bottom of the sea, thence will I command the serpent, and he shall bite them:

entries.yo: Ati bi nwọn tilẹ lọ si igbèkun niwaju awọn ọta wọn, lati ibẹ̀ wá li emi o ti paṣẹ fun idà, on o si pa wọn: emi a si tẹ̀ oju mi mọ wọn lara fun ibi, kì isi ṣe fun ire.
entries.en: And though they go into captivity before their enemies, thence will I command the sword, and it shall slay them: and I will set mine eyes upon them for evil, and not for good.

entries.yo: Oluwa Ọlọrun awọn ọmọ-ogun li ẹniti o si fi ọwọ́ kan ilẹ na, yio si di yiyọ́, gbogbo awọn ti o ngbe inu rẹ̀ yio si ṣọ̀fọ: yio si rú soke patapata bi kikun omi: a o si tẹ̀ ẹ ri, bi odò Egipti.
entries.en: And the Lord GOD of hosts is he that toucheth the land, and it shall melt, and all that dwell therein shall mourn: and it shall rise up wholly like a flood; and shall be drowned, as by the flood of Egypt.

entries.yo: On li ẹniti o kọ́ itẹ́ rẹ̀ ninu awọn ọrun, ti o si fi ipilẹ rẹ̀ sọlẹ ni ilẹ aiye: ẹniti o pè awọn omi okun, ti o si tú wọn jade si ori ilẹ aiye: Oluwa li orukọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: It is he that buildeth his stories in the heaven, and hath founded his troop in the earth; he that calleth for the waters of the sea, and poureth them out upon the face of the earth: The LORD is his name.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin kò ha dàbi awọn ọmọ Etiopia si mi, Ẹnyin ọmọ Israeli? li Oluwa wi. Emi kò ha ti mu Israeli goke ti ilẹ Egipti jade wá? ati awọn Filistini lati ilẹ Kaftori, ati awọn ara Siria lati Kiri.
entries.en: Are ye not as children of the Ethiopians unto me, O children of Israel? saith the LORD. Have not I brought up Israel out of the land of Egypt? and the Philistines from Caphtor, and the Syrians from Kir?

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, Oluwa Ọlọrun mbẹ lara ilẹ ọba ti o kún fun ẹ̀ṣẹ, emi o si pa a run kuro lori ilẹ; ṣugbọn emi kì yio pa ile Jakobu run tan patapata, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: Behold, the eyes of the Lord GOD are upon the sinful kingdom, and I will destroy it from off the face of the earth; saving that I will not utterly destroy the house of Jacob, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Wò o, nitori emi o paṣẹ, emi o si kù ile Israeli ninu awọn orilẹ-ède, bi ã ti kù ọkà ninu kọ̀nkọsọ, ṣugbọn woro kikini kì yio bọ́ sori ilẹ.
entries.en: For, lo, I will command, and I will sift the house of Israel among all nations, like as corn is sifted in a sieve, yet shall not the least grain fall upon the earth.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn ẹlẹṣẹ ninu enia mi yio ti ipa idà kú, ti nwipe, Ibi na kì yio le wa ba, bẹ̃ni kì yio ba wa lojijì.
entries.en: All the sinners of my people shall die by the sword, which say, The evil shall not overtake nor prevent us.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ na li emi o gbe agọ Dafidi ti o ṣubu ró, emi o si dí ẹya rẹ̀; emi o si gbe ahoro rẹ̀ soke, emi o si kọ́ ọ bi ti ọjọ igbani:
entries.en: In that day will I raise up the tabernacle of David that is fallen, and close up the breaches thereof; and I will raise up his ruins, and I will build it as in the days of old:

entries.yo: Ki nwọn le ni iyokù Edomu ni iní, ati ti gbogbo awọn keferi, ti a pè nipa orukọ mi, li Oluwa ti o nṣe eyi wi.
entries.en: That they may possess the remnant of Edom, and of all the heathen, which are called by my name, saith the LORD that doeth this.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, ọjọ na de, li Oluwa wi, ti ẹniti ntulẹ yio le ẹniti nkorè bá, ati ẹniti o ntẹ̀ eso àjara yio le ẹniti o nfunrùgbin bá; awọn oke-nla yio si kán ọti-waini didùn silẹ, gbogbo oke kékèké yio si di yiyọ́.
entries.en: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that the plowman shall overtake the reaper, and the treader of grapes him that soweth seed; and the mountains shall drop sweet wine, and all the hills shall melt.

entries.yo: Emi o si tun mu igbèkun Israeli enia mi padà bọ̀, nwọn o si kọ́ ahoro ilu wọnni, nwọn o si ma gbe inu wọn; nwọn o si gbin ọgbà-àjara, nwọn o si mu ọti-waini wọn; nwọn o ṣe ọgbà pẹlu, nwọn o si jẹ eso inu wọn.
entries.en: And I will bring again the captivity of my people of Israel, and they shall build the waste cities, and inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, and drink the wine thereof; they shall also make gardens, and eat the fruit of them.

entries.yo: Emi o si gbìn wọn si ori ilẹ wọn, a kì yio si fà wọn tu mọ kuro ninu ilẹ wọn, ti mo ti fi fun wọn, li Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ wi.
entries.en: And I will plant them upon their land, and they shall no more be pulled up out of their land which I have given them, saith the LORD thy God.

entries.yo: IRAN ti Obadiah. Bayi ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wi niti Edomu; Awa ti gbọ́ ihìn kan lati ọdọ Oluwa wá, a si ti rán ikọ̀ kan si ãrin awọn keferi, Ẹ dide, ẹ si jẹ ki a dide ogun si i.
entries.en: The vision of Obadiah. Thus saith the Lord GOD concerning Edom; We have heard a rumour from the LORD, and an ambassador is sent among the heathen, Arise ye, and let us rise up against her in battle.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, mo ti sọ iwọ di kekere larin awọn keferi: iwọ di gigàn lọpọlọpọ.
entries.en: Behold, I have made thee small among the heathen: thou art greatly despised.

entries.yo: Irera aiya rẹ ti tàn ọ jẹ, iwọ ti ngbe inu pàlapála apáta, ibugbe ẹniti o ga: ti o nwi li ọkàn rẹ̀ pe, Tani yio mu mi sọkalẹ?
entries.en: The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee, thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high; that saith in his heart, Who shall bring me down to the ground?

entries.yo: Bi iwọ tilẹ gbe ara rẹ ga bi idì, ati bi iwọ tilẹ tẹ́ itẹ rẹ sãrin awọn irawọ, lati ibẹ li emi o ti sọ̀ ọ kalẹ, ni Oluwa wi.
entries.en: Though thou exalt thyself as the eagle, and though thou set thy nest among the stars, thence will I bring thee down, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Bi awọn olè tọ̀ ọ wá, bi awọn ọlọṣà li oru, (bawo li a ti ke ọ kuro!) nwọn kì yio ha jale titi nwọn fi ni to? bi awọn aka-eso-ajara wá sọdọ rẹ, nwọn kì yio ha fi ẽṣẹ́ diẹ silẹ?
entries.en: If thieves came to thee, if robbers by night, (how art thou cut off!) would they not have stolen till they had enough? if the grapegatherers came to thee, would they not leave some grapes?

entries.yo: Bawo li a ti ṣawari awọn nkan Esau! bawo li a ti wá awọn ohun ikọkọ rẹ̀ jade!
entries.en: How are the things of Esau searched out! how are his hidden things sought up!

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn ẹni imulẹ rẹ ti mu ọ de opin ilẹ rẹ: awọn ti nwọn ti wà li alafia pẹlu rẹ ti tàn ọ jẹ, nwọn si bori rẹ; awọn ti o jẹ onjẹ rẹ ti fi ọgbẹ́ si abẹ rẹ: oye kò si ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: All the men of thy confederacy have brought thee even to the border: the men that were at peace with thee have deceived thee, and prevailed against thee; they that eat thy bread have laid a wound under thee: there is none understanding in him.

entries.yo: Oluwa wipe, li ọjọ na ki emi o run awọn ọlọgbọn kuro ni Edomu, ati imoye kuro li oke Esau?
entries.en: Shall I not in that day, saith the LORD, even destroy the wise men out of Edom, and understanding out of the mount of Esau?

entries.yo: Awọn alagbara rẹ yio si bẹ̀ru, iwọ Temani, nitori ki a le ke olukuluku ti ori oke Esau kuro nitori ipania.
entries.en: And thy mighty men, O Teman, shall be dismayed, to the end that every one of the mount of Esau may be cut off by slaughter.

entries.yo: Nitori ìwa-ipa si Jakobu arakunrin rẹ itiju yio bò ọ, a o si ke ọ kuro titi lai.
entries.en: For thy violence against thy brother Jacob shame shall cover thee, and thou shalt be cut off for ever.

entries.yo: Ni ọjọ ti iwọ duro li apa keji, ni ọjọ ti awọn alejo kó awọn ogun rẹ̀ ni igbèkun lọ, ti awọn ajeji si wọ inu ibode rẹ̀, ti nwọn si ṣẹ keké lori Jerusalemu, ani iwọ wà bi ọkan ninu wọn.
entries.en: In the day that thou stoodest on the other side, in the day that the strangers carried away captive his forces, and foreigners entered into his gates, and cast lots upon Jerusalem, even thou wast as one of them.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn iwọ kì ba ti ṣiju wo ọjọ arakunrin rẹ ni ọjọ ti on di ajeji; bẹ̃ni iwọ kì ba ti yọ̀ lori awọn ọmọ Juda ni ọjọ iparun wọn; bẹ̃ni iwọ kì ba ti sọ̀rọ irera ni ọjọ wahala.
entries.en: But thou shouldest not have looked on the day of thy brother in the day that he became a stranger; neither shouldest thou have rejoiced over the children of Judah in the day of their destruction; neither shouldest thou have spoken proudly in the day of distress.

entries.yo: Iwọ kì ba ti wọ inu ibode awọn enia mi lọ li ọjọ idãmú wọn; nitotọ, iwọ kì ba ti ṣiju wo ipọnju wọn li ọjọ idãmú wọn, bẹ̃ni iwọ kì ba ti gbe ọwọ́ le ohun ini wọn li ọ̀jọ idãmú wọn.
entries.en: Thou shouldest not have entered into the gate of my people in the day of their calamity; yea, thou shouldest not have looked on their affliction in the day of their calamity, nor have laid hands on their substance in the day of their calamity;

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni iwọ kì ba ti duro ni ikorita lati ké awọn tirẹ̀ ti o ti salà kuro; bẹ̃ni iwọ kì ba ti sé awọn tirẹ̀ ti o kù li ọjọ wahala mọ.
entries.en: Neither shouldest thou have stood in the crossway, to cut off those of his that did escape; neither shouldest thou have delivered up those of his that did remain in the day of distress.

entries.yo: Nitori ọjọ Oluwa kù si dẹdẹ sori gbogbo awọn keferi: bi iwọ ti ṣe, bẹ̃li a o si ṣe si ọ: ẹsan rẹ yio si yipada sori ara rẹ.
entries.en: For the day of the LORD is near upon all the heathen: as thou hast done, it shall be done unto thee: thy reward shall return upon thine own head.

entries.yo: Nitori bi ẹnyin ti mu lori oke mimọ́ mi, bẹ̃ni gbogbo awọn keferi yio ma mu titi, nitõtọ, nwọn o mu, nwọn o si gbemì, nwọn o si wà bi ẹnipe nwọn kò ti si.
entries.en: For as ye have drunk upon my holy mountain, so shall all the heathen drink continually, yea, they shall drink, and they shall swallow down, and they shall be as though they had not been.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn igbala yio wà lori oke Sioni, yio si jẹ mimọ́, awọn ara ile Jakobu yio si ni ini wọn.
entries.en: But upon mount Zion shall be deliverance, and there shall be holiness; and the house of Jacob shall possess their possessions.

entries.yo: Ile Jakobu yio si jẹ iná, ati ile Josefu ọwọ́-iná, ati ile Esau fun akeku-koriko, nwọn o si ràn ninu wọn, nwọn o si run wọn; kì yio si sí ẹniti yio kù ni ile Esau: nitori Oluwa ti wi i.
entries.en: And the house of Jacob shall be a fire, and the house of Joseph a flame, and the house of Esau for stubble, and they shall kindle in them, and devour them; and there shall not be any remaining of the house of Esau; for the LORD hath spoken it.

entries.yo: Awọn ara gusu yio ni oke Esau; awọn ti pẹ̀tẹlẹ yio si ni awọn ara Filistia: nwọn o si ni oko Efraimu, ati oko Samaria: Benjamini yio si ni Gileadi.
entries.en: And they of the south shall possess the mount of Esau; and they of the plain the Philistines: and they shall possess the fields of Ephraim, and the fields of Samaria: and Benjamin shall possess Gilead.

entries.yo: Ati igbèkun ogun yi, ti awọn ọmọ Israeli ti o wà larin awọn ara Kenaani, titi de Sarefati; ati igbèkun Jerusalemu ti o wà ni Sefaradi, yio ni awọn ilu nla gusu.
entries.en: And the captivity of this host of the children of Israel shall possess that of the Canaanites, even unto Zarephath; and the captivity of Jerusalem, which is in Sepharad, shall possess the cities of the south.

entries.yo: Awọn olugbala yio si goke Sioni wá lati ṣe idajọ oke Esau; ijọba na yio si jẹ ti Oluwa.
entries.en: And saviours shall come up on mount Zion to judge the mount of Esau; and the kingdom shall be the LORD's.

entries.yo: NJẸ ọ̀rọ Oluwa tọ̀ Jona ọmọ Amittai wá, wipe,
entries.en: Now the word of the LORD came unto Jonah the son of Amittai, saying,

entries.yo: Dide, lọ si Ninefe, ilu nla nì, ki o si kigbe si i; nitori ìwa buburu wọn goke wá iwaju mi.
entries.en: Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and cry against it; for their wickedness is come up before me.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Jona dide lati sá lọ si Tarṣiṣi kuro niwaju Oluwa, o si sọkalẹ lọ si Joppa; o si ri ọkọ̀ kan ti nlọ si Tarṣiṣi: bẹ̃li o sanwo ọkọ, o si sọkalẹ sinu rẹ̀, lati ba wọn lọ si Tarṣiṣi lati sá kuro niwaju Oluwa.
entries.en: But Jonah rose up to flee unto Tarshish from the presence of the LORD, and went down to Joppa; and he found a ship going to Tarshish: so he paid the fare thereof, and went down into it, to go with them unto Tarshish from the presence of the LORD.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Oluwa rán ẹfufu nla jade si oju okun, ijì lile si wà ninu okun, tobẹ̃ ti ọkọ̀ na dabi ẹnipe yio fọ.
entries.en: But the LORD sent out a great wind into the sea, and there was a mighty tempest in the sea, so that the ship was like to be broken.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni awọn atukọ̀ bẹ̀ru, olukuluku si kigbe si ọlọrun rẹ̀, nwọn ko ẹrù ti o wà ninu ọkọ dà sinu okun, lati mu u fẹrẹ. Ṣugbọn Jona sọkalẹ lọ si ẹ̀gbẹ́ ọkọ̀; o si dubulẹ sùn wọra.
entries.en: Then the mariners were afraid, and cried every man unto his god, and cast forth the wares that were in the ship into the sea, to lighten it of them. But Jonah was gone down into the sides of the ship; and he lay, and was fast asleep.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li olori-ọkọ̀ tọ̀ ọ wá, o si wi fun u pe, Kini iwọ rò, iwọ olõrun? dide, kepe Ọlọrun rẹ, boya Ọlọrun yio ro tiwa, ki awa ki o má bà ṣegbé.
entries.en: So the shipmaster came to him, and said unto him, What meanest thou, O sleeper? arise, call upon thy God, if so be that God will think upon us, that we perish not.

entries.yo: Olukuluku wọn si wi fun ẹgbẹ rẹ̀ pe, Wá, ẹ si jẹ ka ṣẹ keké, ki awa ki o le mọ̀ itori tani buburu yi ṣe wá sori wa. Bẹ̃ni nwọn ṣẹ keké, keké si mu Jona.
entries.en: And they said every one to his fellow, Come, and let us cast lots, that we may know for whose cause this evil is upon us. So they cast lots, and the lot fell upon Jonah.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni nwọn wi fun u pe, Sọ fun wa, awa bẹ̀ ọ, nitori ti tani buburu yi ṣe wá sori wa? kini iṣẹ rẹ? nibo ni iwọ si ti wá? orukọ ilu rẹ? orilẹ-ède wo ni iwọ si iṣe?
entries.en: Then said they unto him, Tell us, we pray thee, for whose cause this evil is upon us; What is thine occupation? and whence comest thou? what is thy country? and of what people art thou?

entries.yo: On si wi fun wọn pe, Heberu li emi; mo si bẹ̀ru Oluwa, Ọlọrun ọrun, ti o dá okun ati iyangbẹ ilẹ.
entries.en: And he said unto them, I am an Hebrew; and I fear the LORD, the God of heaven, which hath made the sea and the dry land.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni awọn ọkunrin na bẹ̀ru gidigidi, nwọn si wi fun u pe, Ẽṣe ti iwọ fi ṣe eyi? nitori awọn ọkunrin na mọ̀ pe o sá kuro niwaju Oluwa, nitori on ti sọ fun wọn.
entries.en: Then were the men exceedingly afraid, and said unto him, Why hast thou done this? For the men knew that he fled from the presence of the LORD, because he had told them.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni nwọn wi fun u pe, Kini ki a ṣe si ọ, ki okun le dakẹ fun wa? nitori okun ru, o si jà ẹfufu lile.
entries.en: Then said they unto him, What shall we do unto thee, that the sea may be calm unto us? for the sea wrought, and was tempestuous.

entries.yo: On si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ gbe mi, ki ẹ si sọ mi sinu okun; bẹ̃li okun yio si dakẹ fun nyin: nitori emi mọ̀ pe nitori mi ni ẹfufu lile yi ṣe de bá nyin.
entries.en: And he said unto them, Take me up, and cast me forth into the sea; so shall the sea be calm unto you: for I know that for my sake this great tempest is upon you.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn ọkunrin na wà kikan lati mu ọkọ̀ wá si ilẹ; ṣugbọn nwọn kò le ṣe e: nitori ti okun ru, o si jà ẹfufu lile si wọn.
entries.en: Nevertheless the men rowed hard to bring it to the land; but they could not: for the sea wrought, and was tempestuous against them.

entries.yo: Nitorina nwọn kigbe si Oluwa nwọn si wi pe, Awa bẹ̀ ọ, Oluwa awa bẹ̀ ọ, máṣe jẹ ki awa ṣegbe nitori ẹmi ọkunrin yi, má si ka ẹjẹ alaiṣẹ si wa li ọrùn: nitori iwọ, Oluwa, ti ṣe bi o ti wù ọ.
entries.en: Wherefore they cried unto the LORD, and said, We beseech thee, O LORD, we beseech thee, let us not perish for this man's life, and lay not upon us innocent blood: for thou, O LORD, hast done as it pleased thee.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni nwọn gbe Jona, ti nwọn si sọ ọ sinu okun: okun si dẹkun riru rẹ̀.
entries.en: So they took up Jonah, and cast him forth into the sea: and the sea ceased from her raging.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni awọn ọkunrin na bẹ̀ru Oluwa gidigidi, nwọn si rubọ si Oluwa, nwọn si jẹ́ ẹ̀jẹ́.
entries.en: Then the men feared the LORD exceedingly, and offered a sacrifice unto the LORD, and made vows.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Oluwa ti pese ẹja nla kan lati gbe Jona mì. Jona si wà ninu ẹja na li ọsan mẹta ati oru mẹta.
entries.en: Now the LORD had prepared a great fish to swallow up Jonah. And Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.

entries.yo: NIGBANA ni Jona gbadura si Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ̀ lati inu ẹja na wá,
entries.en: Then Jonah prayed unto the LORD his God out of the fish's belly,

entries.yo: O si wipe, Emi kigbe nitori ipọnju mi si Oluwa, on si gbohùn mi; mo kigbe lati inu ipo-okú, iwọ si ti gbohùn mi.
entries.en: And said, I cried by reason of mine affliction unto the LORD, and he heard me; out of the belly of hell cried I, and thou heardest my voice.

entries.yo: Nitoriti iwọ ti sọ mi sinu ibu, larin okun; iṣàn omi si yi mi kakiri; gbogbo bibì omi ati riru omi rẹ kọja lori mi.
entries.en: For thou hadst cast me into the deep, in the midst of the seas; and the floods compassed me about: all thy billows and thy waves passed over me.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni mo wipe, A ta mi nù kuro niwaju rẹ; ṣugbọn sibẹ emi o tun ma wo iha tempili mimọ́ rẹ.
entries.en: Then I said, I am cast out of thy sight; yet I will look again toward thy holy temple.

entries.yo: Omi yi mi kakiri, ani titi de ọkàn; ibu yi mi kakiri, a fi koriko-odò wé mi lori.
entries.en: The waters compassed me about, even to the soul: the depth closed me round about, the weeds were wrapped about my head.

entries.yo: Emi sọkalẹ lọ si isalẹ awọn oke nla; ilẹ aiye pẹlu idenà rẹ̀ wà yi mi ka titi: ṣugbọn iwọ ti mu ẹmi mi wá soke lati inu ibú wá, Oluwa Ọlọrun mi.
entries.en: I went down to the bottoms of the mountains; the earth with her bars was about me for ever: yet hast thou brought up my life from corruption, O LORD my God.

entries.yo: Nigbati o rẹ ọkàn mi ninu mi, emi ranti Oluwa: adura mi si wá sọdọ rẹ sinu tempili mimọ́ rẹ.
entries.en: When my soul fainted within me I remembered the LORD: and my prayer came in unto thee, into thine holy temple.

entries.yo: Awọn ti nkiyesi eke asan kọ̀ ãnu ara wọn silẹ.
entries.en: They that observe lying vanities forsake their own mercy.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi o fi ohùn idupẹ rubọ si ọ; emi o san ẹjẹ́ ti mo ti jẹ. Ti Oluwa ni igbala.
entries.en: But I will sacrifice unto thee with the voice of thanksgiving; I will pay that that I have vowed. Salvation is of the LORD.

entries.yo: Oluwa si sọ fun ẹja na, o si pọ̀ Jona sori ilẹ gbigbẹ.
entries.en: And the LORD spake unto the fish, and it vomited out Jonah upon the dry land.

entries.yo: Ọ̀RỌ Oluwa si tọ̀ Jona wá lẹ̃keji, wipe,
entries.en: And the word of the LORD came unto Jonah the second time, saying,

entries.yo: Dide, lọ si Ninefe, ilu nla nì, ki o si kede si i, ikede ti mo sọ fun ọ.
entries.en: Arise, go unto Nineveh, that great city, and preach unto it the preaching that I bid thee.

entries.yo: Jona si dide, o si lọ si Ninefe, gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ Oluwa. Ninefe si jẹ ilu nla gidigidi tó irin ijọ mẹta.
entries.en: So Jonah arose, and went unto Nineveh, according to the word of the LORD. Now Nineveh was an exceeding great city of three days' journey.

entries.yo: Jona si bẹrẹsi wọ inu ilu na lọ ni irin ijọ kan, o si kede, o si wipe, Niwọn ogoji ọjọ si i, a o bì Ninefe wo.
entries.en: And Jonah began to enter into the city a day's journey, and he cried, and said, Yet forty days, and Nineveh shall be overthrown.

entries.yo: Awọn enia Ninefe si gba Ọlọrun gbọ́, nwọn si kede awẹ̀, nwọn si wọ aṣọ ọ̀fọ, lati agbà wọn titi de kekere wọn.
entries.en: So the people of Nineveh believed God, and proclaimed a fast, and put on sackcloth, from the greatest of them even to the least of them.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ na si de ọdọ ọba Ninefe, o si dide kuro lori itẹ rẹ̀, o si bọ aṣọ igunwa rẹ̀ kuro lara rẹ̀, o si daṣọ ọ̀fọ bora, o si joko ninu ẽru.
entries.en: For word came unto the king of Nineveh, and he arose from his throne, and he laid his robe from him, and covered him with sackcloth, and sat in ashes.

entries.yo: O si kede rẹ̀, o si wi pe ki a là Ninefe ja nipa aṣẹ ọba, ati awọn agbagbà rẹ̀ pe, Máṣe jẹ ki enia, tabi ẹranko, ọwọ-ẹran tabi agbo-ẹran, tọ́ ohunkohun wò: má jẹ ki wọn jẹun, má jẹ ki wọn mu omi.
entries.en: And he caused it to be proclaimed and published through Nineveh by the decree of the king and his nobles, saying, Let neither man nor beast, herd nor flock, taste any thing: let them not feed, nor drink water:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn jẹ ki enia ati ẹranko fi aṣọ ọ̀fọ bora, ki nwọn si kigbe kikan si Ọlọrun: si jẹ ki nwọn yipada, olukuluku kuro li ọ̀na ibi rẹ̀, ati kuro ni ìwa agbara ti o wà lọwọ wọn.
entries.en: But let man and beast be covered with sackcloth, and cry mightily unto God: yea, let them turn every one from his evil way, and from the violence that is in their hands.

entries.yo: Tani le mọ̀ bi Ọlọrun yio yipada ki o si ronupiwada, ki o si yipada kuro ni ibinu gbigbona rẹ̀, ki awa má ṣegbe?
entries.en: Who can tell if God will turn and repent, and turn away from his fierce anger, that we perish not?

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si ri iṣe wọn pe nwọn yipada kuro li ọ̀na ibi wọn: Ọlọrun si ronupiwada ibi ti on ti wi pe on o ṣe si wọn; on kò si ṣe e mọ.
entries.en: And God saw their works, that they turned from their evil way; and God repented of the evil, that he had said that he would do unto them; and he did it not.

entries.yo: ṢUGBỌN o bà Jona ninu jẹ́ gidigidi, o si binu pupọ̀.
entries.en: But it displeased Jonah exceedingly, and he was very angry.

entries.yo: O si gbadura si Oluwa, o si wipe, Emi bẹ ọ, Oluwa, ọ̀rọ mi kọ yi nigbati mo wà ni ilẹ mi? nitorina ni mo ṣe salọ si Tarṣiṣi ni iṣaju: nitori emi mọ̀ pe, Ọlọrun olore-ọfẹ ni iwọ, ati alãnu, o lọra lati binu, o si ṣeun pupọ, o si ronupiwada ibi na.
entries.en: And he prayed unto the LORD, and said, I pray thee, O LORD, was not this my saying, when I was yet in my country? Therefore I fled before unto Tarshish: for I knew that thou art a gracious God, and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and repentest thee of the evil.

entries.yo: Njẹ nitorina, Oluwa, emi bẹ ọ, gbà ẹmi mi kuro lọwọ mi nitori o sàn fun mi lati kú jù ati wà lãyè.
entries.en: Therefore now, O LORD, take, I beseech thee, my life from me; for it is better for me to die than to live.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Oluwa wipe, Iwọ ha ṣe rere lati binu?
entries.en: Then said the LORD, Doest thou well to be angry?

entries.yo: Jona si jade kuro ni ilu na, o si joko niha ila-õrun ilu na, o si pa agọ kan nibẹ fun ara rẹ̀, o si joko ni iboji labẹ rẹ̀, titi yio fi ri ohun ti yio ṣe ilu na.
entries.en: So Jonah went out of the city, and sat on the east side of the city, and there made him a booth, and sat under it in the shadow, till he might see what would become of the city.

entries.yo: Oluwa Ọlọrun si pese itakùn kan, o si ṣe e ki o goke wá sori Jona; ki o le ṣiji bò o lori; lati gbà a kuro ninu ibinujẹ rẹ̀. Jona si yọ ayọ̀ nla nitori itakùn na.
entries.en: And the LORD God prepared a gourd, and made it to come up over Jonah, that it might be a shadow over his head, to deliver him from his grief. So Jonah was exceeding glad of the gourd.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Ọlọrun pese kokorò kan nigbati ilẹ mọ́ ni ijọ keji, o si jẹ itakùn na, o si rọ.
entries.en: But God prepared a worm when the morning rose the next day, and it smote the gourd that it withered.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati õrun là, Ọlọrun si pese ẹfufu gbigbona ti ila-õrùn; õrùn si pa Jona lori, tobẹ̃ ti o rẹ̀ ẹ, o si fẹ́ ninu ara rẹ̀ lati kú, o si wipe, O sàn fun mi lati kú jù ati wà lãyè lọ.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when the sun did arise, that God prepared a vehement east wind; and the sun beat upon the head of Jonah, that he fainted, and wished in himself to die, and said, It is better for me to die than to live.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si wi fun Jona pe, O ha tọ́ fun ọ lati binu nitori itakùn na? on si wipe, O tọ́ fun mi lati binu titi de ikú.
entries.en: And God said to Jonah, Doest thou well to be angry for the gourd? And he said, I do well to be angry, even unto death.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Oluwa wipe, Iwọ kẹdùn itakùn na nitori eyiti iwọ kò ṣiṣẹ, bẹ̃li iwọ kò mu u dagbà; ti o hù jade li oru kan ti o si kú li oru kan.
entries.en: Then said the LORD, Thou hast had pity on the gourd, for the which thou hast not laboured, neither madest it grow; which came up in a night, and perished in a night:

entries.yo: Ki emi ki o má si da Ninefe si, ilu nla nì, ninu eyiti jù ọ̀kẹ-mẹfa enia wà ti kò le mọ̀ ọtun mọ̀ osì ninu ọwọ́ wọn, ati ọ̀pọlọpọ ohun-ọsìn?
entries.en: And should not I spare Nineveh, that great city, wherein are more than sixscore thousand persons that cannot discern between their right hand and their left hand; and also much cattle?

entries.yo: Ọ̀RỌ Oluwa ti o tọ̀ Mika ara Moraṣti wá li ọjọ Jotamu, Ahasi, ati Hesekiah, awọn ọba Juda, ti o ri niti Samaria ati Jerusalemu.
entries.en: The word of the LORD that came to Micah the Morasthite in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Ẹ gbọ́, gbogbo ẹnyin enia; fetisilẹ, Iwọ ilẹ aiye, ati ẹkún rẹ̀: si jẹ ki Oluwa Ọlọrun ṣe ẹlẹri si nyin, Oluwa lati inu tempili mimọ́ rẹ̀ wá.
entries.en: Hear, all ye people; hearken, O earth, and all that therein is: and let the Lord GOD be witness against you, the Lord from his holy temple.

entries.yo: Nitori, wo o, Oluwa jade lati ipò rẹ̀ wá, yio si sọ̀kalẹ, yio si tẹ̀ awọn ibi giga aiye mọlẹ.
entries.en: For, behold, the LORD cometh forth out of his place, and will come down, and tread upon the high places of the earth.

entries.yo: Awọn oke nla yio si yọ́ labẹ rẹ̀, awọn afonifojì yio si pinyà, bi ida niwaju iná, bi omi ti igbálọ ni ibi gẹ̀rẹgẹ̀rẹ.
entries.en: And the mountains shall be molten under him, and the valleys shall be cleft, as wax before the fire, and as the waters that are poured down a steep place.

entries.yo: Nitori irekọja Jakobu ni gbogbo eyi, ati nitori ẹ̀ṣẹ ile Israeli. Kini irekọja Jakobu? Samaria ha kọ? ki si ni awọn ibi giga Juda? Jerusalemu ha kọ?
entries.en: For the transgression of Jacob is all this, and for the sins of the house of Israel. What is the transgression of Jacob? is it not Samaria? and what are the high places of Judah? are they not Jerusalem?

entries.yo: Nitorina li emi o ṣe Samaria bi òkiti pápa, ati bi gbigbin àjara: emi o si gbá awọn okuta rẹ̀ danù sinu afonifojì, emi o si ṣi awọn ipalẹ rẹ̀ silẹ.
entries.en: Therefore I will make Samaria as an heap of the field, and as plantings of a vineyard: and I will pour down the stones thereof into the valley, and I will discover the foundations thereof.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn ere fifin rẹ̀ ni a o run womu-womu, gbogbo awọn ẹbùn rẹ̀ li a o fi iná sun, gbogbo awọn oriṣà rẹ̀ li emi o sọ di ahoro: nitoriti o ko o jọ lati inu ẹbùn panṣaga wá, nwọn o si pada si ẹbùn panṣaga.
entries.en: And all the graven images thereof shall be beaten to pieces, and all the hires thereof shall be burned with the fire, and all the idols thereof will I lay desolate: for she gathered it of the hire of an harlot, and they shall return to the hire of an harlot.

entries.yo: Nitori eyi li emi o ṣe pohunrere, ti emi o si ma hu, emi o ma lọ ni ẹsẹ lasan, ati ni ihòho: emi o pohunrere bi dragoni, emi o si ma kedaro bi awọn ọmọ ògongo.
entries.en: Therefore I will wail and howl, I will go stripped and naked: I will make a wailing like the dragons, and mourning as the owls.

entries.yo: Nitori ti ọgbẹ́ rẹ̀ jẹ alailewòtan; nitoriti o wá si Juda; on de ẹnu-bode awọn enia mi, ani si Jerusalemu.
entries.en: For her wound is incurable; for it is come unto Judah; he is come unto the gate of my people, even to Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Ẹ máṣe sọ ni Gati, ẹ máṣe sọkun rara: ni ile Afra mo yi ara mi ninu ekuru.
entries.en: Declare ye it not at Gath, weep ye not at all: in the house of Aphrah roll thyself in the dust.

entries.yo: Ẹ kọja lọ, iwọ ará Safiri, pẹlu itiju rẹ ni ihòhò: ara Saanani kò jade wá; ọ̀fọ̀ Beteseli yio gba iduro rẹ̀ lọwọ nyin.
entries.en: Pass ye away, thou inhabitant of Saphir, having thy shame naked: the inhabitant of Zaanan came not forth in the mourning of Beth-ezel; he shall receive of you his standing.

entries.yo: Nitori ara Maroti nreti ire, ṣugbọn ibi sọkalẹ ti ọdọ Oluwa wá si ẹnu bode Jerusalemu.
entries.en: For the inhabitant of Maroth waited carefully for good: but evil came down from the LORD unto the gate of Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Iwọ ara Lakiṣi, di kẹkẹ mọ ẹranko ti o yara: on ni ibẹrẹ ẹ̀ṣẹ si ọmọbinrin Sioni: nitori a ri irekọja Israeli ninu rẹ.
entries.en: O thou inhabitant of Lachish, bind the chariot to the swift beast: she is the beginning of the sin to the daughter of Zion: for the transgressions of Israel were found in thee.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni iwọ o ṣe fi iwe ikọ̀silẹ fun Moreṣetigati: awọn ile Aksibi yio jẹ eke si awọn ọba Israeli.
entries.en: Therefore shalt thou give presents to Moresheth-gath: the houses of Achzib shall be a lie to the kings of Israel.

entries.yo: Sibẹ̀ emi o mu arole kan fun ọ wá, Iwọ ara Mareṣa: ogo Israeli yio wá si Adullamu.
entries.en: Yet will I bring an heir unto thee, O inhabitant of Mareshah: he shall come unto Adullam the glory of Israel.

entries.yo: Sọ ara rẹ di apari, si rẹ́ irun rẹ nitori awọn ọmọ rẹ ẹlẹgẹ́; sọ apári rẹ di gbòro bi idì; nitori a dì wọn ni igbèkun lọ kuro lọdọ rẹ.
entries.en: Make thee bald, and poll thee for thy delicate children; enlarge thy baldness as the eagle; for they are gone into captivity from thee.

entries.yo: EGBE ni fun awọn ti ngbìmọ aiṣedede, ti nṣiṣẹ ibi lori akete wọn! nigbati ojumọ́ mọ́ nwọn nṣe e, nitoripe o wà ni agbara ọwọ́ wọn.
entries.en: Woe to them that devise iniquity, and work evil upon their beds! when the morning is light, they practise it, because it is in the power of their hand.

entries.yo: Nwọn si nṣe ojukòkoro oko, nwọn si nfi ipá gbà a: ati ile, nwọn a si mu wọn lọ: nwọn si ni enia lara ati ile rẹ̀, ani enia ati ini rẹ̀.
entries.en: And they covet fields, and take them by violence; and houses, and take them away: so they oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.

entries.yo: Nitorina bayi ni Oluwa wi; Kiyesi i, emi ngbimọ̀ ibi si idile yi, ninu eyiti ọrùn nyin kì yio le yọ; bẹni ẹnyin kì yio fi igberaga lọ: nitori akokò ibi ni yi.
entries.en: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Behold, against this family do I devise an evil, from which ye shall not remove your necks; neither shall ye go haughtily: for this time is evil.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ na ni ẹnikan yio pa owe kan si nyin, yio si pohunrere-ẹkun kikorò pe, Ni kikó a kó wa tan? on ti pin iní enia mi: bawo ni o ti ṣe mu u kuro lọdọ mi! o ti pin oko wa fun awọn ti o yapa.
entries.en: In that day shall one take up a parable against you, and lament with a doleful lamentation, and say, We be utterly spoiled: he hath changed the portion of my people: how hath he removed it from me! turning away he hath divided our fields.

entries.yo: Nitorina iwọ kì yio ni ẹnikan ti yio ta okùn nipa ìbo ninu ijọ enia Oluwa.
entries.en: Therefore thou shalt have none that shall cast a cord by lot in the congregation of the LORD.

entries.yo: Nwọn ni, ẹ máṣe sọtẹlẹ, nwọn o sọtẹlẹ, bi nwọn kò ba sọtẹlẹ bayi, itiju kì yio kuro.
entries.en: Prophesy ye not, say they to them that prophesy: they shall not prophesy to them, that they shall not take shame.

entries.yo: Iwọ ẹniti anpe ni ile Jakobu, Ẹmi Oluwa ha bùkù bi? iṣe rẹ̀ ha ni wọnyi? ọ̀rọ mi kò ha nṣe rere fun ẹni ti nrin dẽde bi?
entries.en: O thou that art named the house of Jacob, is the spirit of the LORD straitened? are these his doings? do not my words do good to him that walketh uprightly?

entries.yo: Ati nijelo awọn enia mi dide bi ọta si mi: ẹnyin ti bọ́ ẹ̀wu ati aṣọ ibora kuro lọdọ awọn ti nkọja li ailewu, bi awọn ẹniti o kọ̀ ogun silẹ.
entries.en: Even of late my people is risen up as an enemy: ye pull off the robe with the garment from them that pass by securely as men averse from war.

entries.yo: Obinrin awọn enia mi li ẹnyin ti le jade kuro ninu ile wọn daradara; ẹnyin ti gbà ogo mi kuro lọwọ awọn ọmọ wọn lailai.
entries.en: The women of my people have ye cast out from their pleasant houses; from their children have ye taken away my glory for ever.

entries.yo: Ẹ dide, ki ẹ si ma lọ; nitoripe eyi kì iṣe ibi isimi: nitoriti o jẹ alaimọ́, yio pa nyin run, ani iparun kikorò?
entries.en: Arise ye, and depart; for this is not your rest: because it is polluted, it shall destroy you, even with a sore destruction.

entries.yo: Bi enia kan ti nrin ninu ẹmi ati itanjẹ ba ṣeke, wipe, emi o sọ asọtẹlẹ̀ ti ọti-waini ati ọti-lile fun ọ; on ni o tilẹ ṣe woli awọn enia yi.
entries.en: If a man walking in the spirit and falsehood do lie, saying, I will prophesy unto thee of wine and of strong drink; he shall even be the prophet of this people.

entries.yo: Ni kikó emi o kó nyin jọ, iwọ Jakobu, gbogbo nyin; ni gbigbá emi o gbá iyokù Israeli jọ; emi o si tò wọn jọ pọ̀ gẹgẹ bi agutan Bosra, gẹgẹ bi ọwọ́ ẹran ninu agbo wọn: nwọn o si pariwo nla nitori ọ̀pọlọpọ enia.
entries.en: I will surely assemble, O Jacob, all of thee; I will surely gather the remnant of Israel; I will put them together as the sheep of Bozrah, as the flock in the midst of their fold: they shall make great noise by reason of the multitude of men.

entries.yo: Ẹniti nfọ́ni ti dide niwaju wọn: nwọn ti fọ́, nwọn kọja lãrin bode, nwọn si ti jade lọ nipa rẹ̀: ọba wọn o si kọja lọ niwaju wọn, Oluwa ni yio si ṣe olori wọn.
entries.en: The breaker is come up before them: they have broken up, and have passed through the gate, and are gone out by it: and their king shall pass before them, and the LORD on the head of them.

entries.yo: EMI si wipe, Gbọ́, emi bẹ̀ nyin, ẹnyin olori ni Jakobu, ati ẹnyin alakoso ile Israeli; ti nyin kì iṣe lati mọ̀ idajọ bi?
entries.en: And I said, Hear, I pray you, O heads of Jacob, and ye princes of the house of Israel; Is it not for you to know judgment?

entries.yo: Ẹnyin ti o korira ire, ti ẹ si fẹ ibi; ti ẹ já awọ-ara wọn kuro lara wọn, ati ẹran-ara wọn kuro li egungun wọn;
entries.en: Who hate the good, and love the evil; who pluck off their skin from off them, and their flesh from off their bones;

entries.yo: Awọn ẹniti o si jẹ ẹran-ara awọn enia mi pẹlu, ti nwọn si họ́ awọ-ara wọn kuro lara wọn, nwọn si fọ́ egungun wọn, nwọn si ke wọn wẹwẹ, bi ti ikòko, ati gẹgẹ bi ẹran ninu òdu.
entries.en: Who also eat the flesh of my people, and flay their skin from off them; and they break their bones, and chop them in pieces, as for the pot, and as flesh within the caldron.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni nwọn o kigbe pe Oluwa, ṣugbọn on kì yio gbọ́ ti wọn: on o tilẹ pa oju rẹ̀ mọ kuro lọdọ wọn li akoko na, gẹgẹ bi nwọn ti huwà alaifi ri ninu gbogbo iṣe wọn.
entries.en: Then shall they cry unto the LORD, but he will not hear them: he will even hide his face from them at that time, as they have behaved themselves ill in their doings.

entries.yo: Bayi ni Oluwa wi niti awọn woli ti nṣì awọn enia mi li ọ̀na, ti nfi ehín wọn bù ni ṣán, ti o si nkigbe wipe, Alafia; on ẹniti kò fi nkan si wọn li ẹnu, awọn na si mura ogun si i.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD concerning the prophets that make my people err, that bite with their teeth, and cry, Peace; and he that putteth not into their mouths, they even prepare war against him.

entries.yo: Nitorina oru yio ru nyin, ti ẹnyin kì yio fi ri iran; òkunkun yio si kùn fun nyin, ti ẹnyin kì o fi le sọtẹlẹ; õrùn yio si wọ̀ lori awọn woli, ọjọ yio si ṣokùnkun lori wọn.
entries.en: Therefore night shall be unto you, that ye shall not have a vision; and it shall be dark unto you, that ye shall not divine; and the sun shall go down over the prophets, and the day shall be dark over them.

entries.yo: Oju yio si tì awọn ariran, awọn alasọtẹlẹ̀ na yio si dãmu: nitõtọ, gbogbo wọn o bò ete wọn: nitori idahùn kò si lati ọdọ Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Then shall the seers be ashamed, and the diviners confounded: yea, they shall all cover their lips; for there is no answer of God.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nitõtọ emi kún fun agbara nipa ẹmi Oluwa, ati fun idajọ, ati fun ipá, lati sọ irekọja Jakobu fun u, ati lati sọ ẹ̀ṣẹ Israeli fun u.
entries.en: But truly I am full of power by the spirit of the LORD, and of judgment, and of might, to declare unto Jacob his transgression, and to Israel his sin.

entries.yo: Gbọ́ eyi, emi bẹ̀ nyin, ẹnyin olori ile Jakobu; ati awọn alakoso ile Israeli, ti o korira idajọ, ti o si yi otitọ pada.
entries.en: Hear this, I pray you, ye heads of the house of Jacob, and princes of the house of Israel, that abhor judgment, and pervert all equity.

entries.yo: Ti o fi ẹjẹ kọ́ Sioni, ati Jerusalemu pẹlu iwà ẹ̀ṣẹ.
entries.en: They build up Zion with blood, and Jerusalem with iniquity.

entries.yo: Awọn olori rẹ̀ nṣe idajọ nitori ère, awọn alufa rẹ̀ nkọ́ni fun ọyà, awọn woli rẹ̀ si nsọtẹlẹ fun owo: sibẹ ni nwọn o gbẹkẹle Oluwa, wipe, Oluwa kò ha wà lãrin wa? ibi kan kì yio ba wa.
entries.en: The heads thereof judge for reward, and the priests thereof teach for hire, and the prophets thereof divine for money: yet will they lean upon the LORD, and say, Is not the LORD among us? none evil can come upon us.

entries.yo: Nitorina nitori nyin ni a o ṣe ro Sioni bi oko, Jerusalemu yio si di okìti, ati oke-nla ile bi ibi giga igbo.
entries.en: Therefore shall Zion for your sake be plowed as a field, and Jerusalem shall become heaps, and the mountain of the house as the high places of the forest.

entries.yo: YIO si ṣe li ọjọ ikẹhìn, a o fi oke ile Oluwa kalẹ lori awọn oke-nla, a o si gbe e ga jù awọn oke kekeke lọ; awọn enia yio si mã wọ́ sinu rẹ̀.
entries.en: But in the last days it shall come to pass, that the mountain of the house of the LORD shall be established in the top of the mountains, and it shall be exalted above the hills; and people shall flow unto it.

entries.yo: Ọ̀pọlọpọ orilẹ-ède yio si wá, nwọn o si wipe, Ẹ wá, ẹ jẹ ki a goke lọ si oke-nla Oluwa, ati si ile Ọlọrun Jakobu; on o si kọ́ wa li ọ̀na rẹ̀, awa o si ma rìn ni ipa-ọ̀na rẹ̀: nitori lati Sioni ni ofin yio ti jade lọ, ati ọ̀rọ Oluwa lati Jerusalemu.
entries.en: And many nations shall come, and say, Come, and let us go up to the mountain of the LORD, and to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for the law shall go forth of Zion, and the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.

entries.yo: On o si ṣe idajọ lãrin ọ̀pọlọpọ enia, yio si bá alagbara orilẹ-ède rére wi; nwọn o si fi idà wọn rọ ọbẹ irin-itulẹ̀, ati ọ̀kọ wọn rọ dojé: orilẹ-ède kì yio gbe idà soke si orilẹ-ède, bẹ̃ni nwọn kì yio kọ́ ogun jijà mọ.
entries.en: And he shall judge among many people, and rebuke strong nations afar off; and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruninghooks: nation shall not lift up a sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nwọn o joko olukuluku labẹ ajara rẹ̀ ati labẹ igi ọpọtọ rẹ̀; ẹnikan kì yio si daiyà fò wọn: nitori ẹnu Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun li o ti sọ ọ.
entries.en: But they shall sit every man under his vine and under his fig tree; and none shall make them afraid: for the mouth of the LORD of hosts hath spoken it.

entries.yo: Nitori gbogbo awọn enia ni yio ma rìn, olukuluku li orukọ ọlọrun tirẹ̀, awa o si ma rìn li orukọ Oluwa Ọlọrun wa lai ati lailai.
entries.en: For all people will walk every one in the name of his god, and we will walk in the name of the LORD our God for ever and ever.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ na, ni Oluwa wi, li emi o kó amukun, emi o si ṣà ẹniti a le jade, ati ẹniti emi ti pọn loju jọ;
entries.en: In that day, saith the LORD, will I assemble her that halteth, and I will gather her that is driven out, and her that I have afflicted;

entries.yo: Emi o si dá awọn amukun si fun iyokù, emi o si sọ ẹniti a ta nù rére di orilẹ-ède alagbara: Oluwa yio si jọba lori wọn li oke-nla Sioni lati isisiyi lọ, ati si i lailai.
entries.en: And I will make her that halted a remnant, and her that was cast far off a strong nation: and the LORD shall reign over them in mount Zion from henceforth, even for ever.

entries.yo: Ati iwọ, Ile iṣọ agbo agùtan, odi ọmọbinrin Sioni, si ọdọ rẹ ni yio wá, ani ijọba iṣãju; ijọba yio si wá si ọdọ ọmọbinrin Jerusalemu.
entries.en: And thou, O tower of the flock, the strong hold of the daughter of Zion, unto thee shall it come, even the first dominion; the kingdom shall come to the daughter of Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Njẹ kini iwọ ha nkigbe soke si? ọba kò ha si ninu rẹ? awọn ìgbimọ rẹ ṣegbé bi? nitori irora ti dì ọ mu bi obinrin ti nrọbi.
entries.en: Now why dost thou cry out aloud? is there no king in thee? is thy counseller perished? for pangs have taken thee as a woman in travail.

entries.yo: Ma rọbi, si bi, ọmọbinrin Sioni, bi ẹniti nrọbi: nitori nisisiyi ni iwọ o jade lọ kuro ninu ilu, iwọ o si ma gbe inu igbẹ́, iwọ o si lọ si Babiloni; nibẹ̀ ni a o gbà ọ; nibẹ̀ ni Oluwa yio rà ọ padà kuro lọwọ awọn ọta rẹ.
entries.en: Be in pain, and labour to bring forth, O daughter of Zion, like a woman in travail: for now shalt thou go forth out of the city, and thou shalt dwell in the field, and thou shalt go even to Babylon; there shalt thou be delivered; there the LORD shall redeem thee from the hand of thine enemies.

entries.yo: Ati nisisiyi ọ̀pọlọpọ orile-ède gbá jọ si ọ, ti nwi pe, jẹ ki a sọ ọ di aimọ́, si jẹ ki oju wa ki o wo Sioni.
entries.en: Now also many nations are gathered against thee, that say, Let her be defiled, and let our eye look upon Zion.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nwọn kò mọ̀ erò Oluwa, bẹ̃ni oye ìmọ rẹ̀ kò ye wọn: nitori on o kó wọn jọ bi ití sinu ipaka.
entries.en: But they know not the thoughts of the LORD, neither understand they his counsel: for he shall gather them as the sheaves into the floor.

entries.yo: Dide, si ma pakà, Iwọ ọmọbinrin Sioni: nitori emi o sọ iwo rẹ di irin, emi o si sọ patakò rẹ di idẹ, iwọ o si run ọ̀pọlọpọ enia womu-womu: emi o si yá ère wọn sọtọ̀ fun Oluwa, ati iní wọn si Oluwa gbogbo aiye.
entries.en: Arise and thresh, O daughter of Zion: for I will make thine horn iron, and I will make thy hoofs brass: and thou shalt beat in pieces many people: and I will consecrate their gain unto the LORD, and their substance unto the Lord of the whole earth.

entries.yo: NISISIYI gbá ara rẹ jọ li ọwọ́, Iwọ ọmọbinrin ọwọ́: o ti dó tì wa; nwọn o fi ọ̀pa lu onidajọ Israeli li ẹ̀rẹkẹ.
entries.en: Now gather thyself in troops, O daughter of troops: he hath laid siege against us: they shall smite the judge of Israel with a rod upon the cheek.

entries.yo: Ati iwọ Betlehemu Efrata; bi iwọ ti jẹ kekere lãrin awọn ẹgbẹgbẹ̀run Juda, ninu rẹ ni ẹniti yio jẹ olori ni Israeli yio ti jade tọ̀ mi wá; ijade lọ rẹ̀ si jẹ lati igbãni, lati aiyeraiye.
entries.en: But thou, Bethlehem Ephratah, though thou be little among the thousands of Judah, yet out of thee shall he come forth unto me that is to be ruler in Israel; whose goings forth have been from of old, from everlasting.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni yio ṣe jọwọ wọn lọwọ, titi di akokò ti ẹniti nrọbi yio fi bi: iyokù awọn arakunrin rẹ̀ yio si pada wá sọdọ awọn ọmọ Israeli.
entries.en: Therefore will he give them up, until the time that she which travaileth hath brought forth: then the remnant of his brethren shall return unto the children of Israel.

entries.yo: On o si duro yio si ma jẹ̀ li agbara Oluwa, ni ọlanla orukọ Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ̀; nwọn o si wà, nitori nisisiyi ni on o tobi titi de opin aiye.
entries.en: And he shall stand and feed in the strength of the LORD, in the majesty of the name of the LORD his God; and they shall abide: for now shall he be great unto the ends of the earth.

entries.yo: Eleyi ni yio jẹ alafia, nigbati ara Assiria yio wá si ilẹ wa; nigbati yio si tẹ̀ awọn ãfin wa mọlẹ, nigba nã li awa o gbe oluṣọ agutan meje dide si i, ati olori enia mẹjọ.
entries.en: And this man shall be the peace, when the Assyrian shall come into our land: and when he shall tread in our palaces, then shall we raise against him seven shepherds, and eight principal men.

entries.yo: Nwọn o si fi idà pa ilẹ Assiria run, ati ilẹ Nimrodu ni àbawọ̀ inu rẹ̀: yio si gbà wa lọwọ ara Assiria nigbati o ba wá ilẹ wa, ati nigbati o ba si ntẹ̀ àgbegbe wa mọlẹ.
entries.en: And they shall waste the land of Assyria with the sword, and the land of Nimrod in the entrances thereof: thus shall he deliver us from the Assyrian, when he cometh into our land, and when he treadeth within our borders.

entries.yo: Iyokù Jakobu yio si wà lãrin ọ̀pọ enia bi irì lati ọdọ Oluwa wá, bi ọwarà òjo lori koriko, ti kì idara duro de enia, ti kì isi duro de awọn ọmọ enia.
entries.en: And the remnant of Jacob shall be in the midst of many people as a dew from the LORD, as the showers upon the grass, that tarrieth not for man, nor waiteth for the sons of men.

entries.yo: Iyokù Jakobu yio si wà lãrin awọn Keferi, lãrin ọ̀pọ enia bi kiniun, lãrin awọn ẹranko igbo, bi ọmọkiniun lãrin agbo agutan; eyiti, bi o ba là a ja, ti itẹ̀ mọlẹ, ti isi ifa ya pẹrẹpẹrẹ, kò si ẹniti yio gbalà.
entries.en: And the remnant of Jacob shall be among the Gentiles in the midst of many people as a lion among the beasts of the forest, as a young lion among the flocks of sheep: who, if he go through, both treadeth down, and teareth in pieces, and none can deliver.

entries.yo: A o gbe ọwọ́ rẹ soke sori awọn ọ̀ta rẹ, gbogbo awọn ọ̀ta rẹ, li a o si ke kuro.
entries.en: Thine hand shall be lifted up upon thine adversaries, and all thine enemies shall be cut off.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe li ọjọ na, ni Oluwa wi, ti emi o ke awọn ẹṣin rẹ kuro lãrin rẹ, emi o si pa awọn kẹkẹ́ ogun rẹ run.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the LORD, that I will cut off thy horses out of the midst of thee, and I will destroy thy chariots:

entries.yo: Emi o si ke ilu-nla ilẹ rẹ kuro, emi o si tì gbogbo odi rẹ ṣubu:
entries.en: And I will cut off the cities of thy land, and throw down all thy strong holds:

entries.yo: Emi o si ke iwà-ajẹ kuro lọwọ rẹ: iwọ kì yio si ni alafọ̀ṣẹ mọ:
entries.en: And I will cut off witchcrafts out of thine hand; and thou shalt have no more soothsayers:

entries.yo: Ere fifin rẹ pẹlu li emi o ke kuro, awọn ere rẹ kuro lãrin rẹ; iwọ kì o si ma sin iṣẹ ọwọ́ rẹ mọ.
entries.en: Thy graven images also will I cut off, and thy standing images out of the midst of thee; and thou shalt no more worship the work of thine hands.

entries.yo: Emi o si tú igbo òriṣa rẹ kuro lãrin rẹ: emi o si pa awọn ilu rẹ run.
entries.en: And I will pluck up thy groves out of the midst of thee: so will I destroy thy cities.

entries.yo: Emi o si gbẹsan ni ibinu ati irunu lara awọn keferi, ti nwọn kò ti igbọ́ ri.
entries.en: And I will execute vengeance in anger and fury upon the heathen, such as they have not heard.

entries.yo: Ẹ gbọ́ nisisiyi ohun ti Oluwa wi; Dide, ba oke nla wijọ, si jẹ ki oke kékèké gbohùn rẹ.
entries.en: Hear ye now what the LORD saith; Arise, contend thou before the mountains, and let the hills hear thy voice.

entries.yo: Ẹ gbọ́ ẹjọ Oluwa, ẹnyin oke-nla, ati ẹnyin ipilẹ ilẹ̀ aiye: nitori Oluwa mba awọn enia rẹ̀ wijọ, yio si ba Israeli rojọ.
entries.en: Hear ye, O mountains, the LORD's controversy, and ye strong foundations of the earth: for the LORD hath a controversy with his people, and he will plead with Israel.

entries.yo: Enia mi, kini mo fi ṣe ọ? ati ninu kini mo fi da ọ li agara? dahùn si i.
entries.en: O my people, what have I done unto thee? and wherein have I wearied thee? testify against me.
