entries.yo: Nitori mo ti mu ọ goke lati ilẹ Egipti wá, mo si rà ọ padà lati ile ẹrú wá; mo si rán Mose, Aaroni, ati Miriamu siwaju rẹ.
entries.en: For I brought thee up out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed thee out of the house of servants; and I sent before thee Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.

entries.yo: Enia mi, ranti nisisiyi ohun ti Balaki ọba Moabu gbèro, ati ohun ti Balaamu ọmọ Beori dá a lohùn lati Ṣittimu titi de Gilgali; ki ẹ ba le mọ̀ ododo Oluwa.
entries.en: O my people, remember now what Balak king of Moab consulted, and what Balaam the son of Beor answered him from Shittim unto Gilgal; that ye may know the righteousness of the LORD.

entries.yo: Kini emi o ha mu wá siwaju Oluwa, ti emi o fi tẹ̀ ara mi ba niwaju Ọlọrun giga? ki emi ha wá siwaju rẹ̀ pẹlu ọrẹ-ẹbọ sisun, pẹlu ọmọ malu ọlọdún kan?
entries.en: Wherewith shall I come before the LORD, and bow myself before the high God? shall I come before him with burnt offerings, with calves of a year old?

entries.yo: Inu Oluwa yio ha dùn si ẹgbẹgbẹ̀run àgbo, tabi si ẹgbẹgbãrun iṣàn òroro? emi o ha fi àkọbi mi fun irekọja mi, iru-ọmọ inu mi fun ẹ̀ṣẹ ọkàn mi?
entries.en: Will the LORD be pleased with thousands of rams, or with ten thousands of rivers of oil? shall I give my firstborn for my transgression, the fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?

entries.yo: A ti fi hàn ọ, Iwọ enia, ohun ti o dara; ati ohun ti Oluwa bère lọwọ rẹ, bikoṣe ki o ṣe otitọ, ki o si fẹ ãnu, ati ki o rìn ni irẹ̀lẹ pẹlu Ọlọrun rẹ?
entries.en: He hath shewed thee, O man, what is good; and what doth the LORD require of thee, but to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God?

entries.yo: Ohùn Oluwa kigbe si ilu na, ọlọgbọ́n yio si ri orukọ rẹ; ẹ gbọ́ ọ̀pa na, ati ẹniti o yàn a?
entries.en: The LORD's voice crieth unto the city, and the man of wisdom shall see thy name: hear ye the rod, and who hath appointed it.

entries.yo: Iṣura ìwa buburu ha wà ni ile enia buburu sibẹ̀, ati òṣuwọ̀n aikún ti o jẹ ohun ibinú?
entries.en: Are there yet the treasures of wickedness in the house of the wicked, and the scant measure that is abominable?

entries.yo: Ki emi ha kà wọn si mimọ́ pẹlu òṣuwọ̀n buburu, ati pẹlu àpo òṣuwọ̀n ẹ̀tan?
entries.en: Shall I count them pure with the wicked balances, and with the bag of deceitful weights?

entries.yo: Ti awọn ọlọrọ̀ rẹ̀ kún fun ìwa-ipá, ati awọn ti ngbe inu rẹ̀ ti sọ̀rọ eké, ahọn wọn si kún fun ẹ̀tan li ẹnu wọn.
entries.en: For the rich men thereof are full of violence, and the inhabitants thereof have spoken lies, and their tongue is deceitful in their mouth.

entries.yo: Nitorina pẹlu li emi o ṣe mu ọ ṣàisan ni lilù ọ, ni sisọ ọ dahoro nitori ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ.
entries.en: Therefore also will I make thee sick in smiting thee, in making thee desolate because of thy sins.

entries.yo: Iwọ o jẹun, ṣugbọn iwọ kì yio yo; idábẹ yio wà lãrin rẹ; iwọ o kó kuro, ṣugbọn iwọ kì o lọ lailewu; ati eyi ti o kó lọ li emi o fi fun idà.
entries.en: Thou shalt eat, but not be satisfied; and thy casting down shall be in the midst of thee; and thou shalt take hold, but shalt not deliver; and that which thou deliverest will I give up to the sword.

entries.yo: Iwọ o gbìn, ṣugbọn iwọ kì yio ká; iwọ o tẹ̀ igi olifi, ṣugbọn iwọ kì o fi ororo kunra; ati eso àjara, sugbọn iwọ kì o mu ọti-waini.
entries.en: Thou shalt sow, but thou shalt not reap; thou shalt tread the olives, but thou shalt not anoint thee with oil; and sweet wine, but shalt not drink wine.

entries.yo: Nitori ti a pa aṣẹ Omri mọ́, ati gbogbo iṣẹ ile Ahabu, ẹ si rìn ni ìmọ wọn; ki emi ba le sọ ọ di ahoro, ati awọn ti ngbe inu rẹ di ẹ̀gan: ẹnyin o si rù ẹgan enia mi.
entries.en: For the statutes of Omri are kept, and all the works of the house of Ahab, and ye walk in their counsels; that I should make thee a desolation, and the inhabitants thereof an hissing: therefore ye shall bear the reproach of my people.

entries.yo: EGBE ni fun mi! nitori emi dàbi ikojọpọ̀ eso ẹ̃rùn, bi ẽṣẹ́ ikorè eso àjara: kò si ití kan lati jẹ: akọso ti ọkàn mi fẹ.
entries.en: Woe is me! for I am as when they have gathered the summer fruits, as the grapegleanings of the vintage: there is no cluster to eat: my soul desired the firstripe fruit.

entries.yo: Oninurere ti run kuro li aiye: kò si si olotitọ kan ninu enia: gbogbo wọn ba fun ẹ̀jẹ, olukuluku wọn nfi àwọn dẹ arakunrin rẹ̀.
entries.en: The good man is perished out of the earth: and there is none upright among men: they all lie in wait for blood; they hunt every man his brother with a net.

entries.yo: Ọwọ́ wọn ti mura tan lati ṣe buburu, olori mbère, onidajọ si mbère fun ẹsan; ẹni-nla nsọ ìro ika rẹ̀, nwọn si nyi i po.
entries.en: That they may do evil with both hands earnestly, the prince asketh, and the judge asketh for a reward; and the great man, he uttereth his mischievous desire: so they wrap it up.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o sànjulọ ninu wọn dàbi ẹ̀gun: ìduroṣiṣin julọ mú jù ẹgún ọgbà lọ: ọjọ awọn olùṣọ rẹ ati ti ìbẹwo rẹ de; nisisiyi ni idãmu wọn o de.
entries.en: The best of them is as a brier: the most upright is sharper than a thorn hedge: the day of thy watchmen and thy visitation cometh; now shall be their perplexity.

entries.yo: Ẹ má gba ọrẹ́ kan gbọ́, ẹ má si gbẹkẹ̀le amọ̀na kan: pa ilẹkùn ẹnu rẹ mọ fun ẹniti o sùn ni õkan-àiya rẹ.
entries.en: Trust ye not in a friend, put ye not confidence in a guide: keep the doors of thy mouth from her that lieth in thy bosom.

entries.yo: Nitori ọmọkunrin nṣàibọ̀wọ fun baba, ọmọbinrin dide si ìya rẹ̀, aya-ọmọ si iyakọ rẹ̀; ọta olukuluku ni awọn ara ile rẹ̀.
entries.en: For the son dishonoureth the father, the daughter riseth up against her mother, the daughter in law against her mother in law; a man's enemies are the men of his own house.

entries.yo: Nitorina emi o ni ireti si Oluwa: emi o duro de Ọlọrun igbala mi: Ọlọrun mi yio gbọ́ temi.
entries.en: Therefore I will look unto the LORD; I will wait for the God of my salvation: my God will hear me.

entries.yo: Má yọ̀ mi, Iwọ ọta mi: nigbati mo ba ṣubu, emi o dide; nigbati mo ba joko li okùnkun, Oluwa yio jẹ imọlẹ fun mi.
entries.en: Rejoice not against me, O mine enemy: when I fall, I shall arise; when I sit in darkness, the LORD shall be a light unto me.

entries.yo: Emi o rù ibinu Oluwa, nitori emi ti dẹṣẹ si i, titi yio fi gbà ẹjọ mi rò, ti yio si ṣe idajọ mi; yio mu mi wá si imọlẹ, emi o si ri ododo rẹ̀.
entries.en: I will bear the indignation of the LORD, because I have sinned against him, until he plead my cause, and execute judgment for me: he will bring me forth to the light, and I shall behold his righteousness.

entries.yo: Nitori ọta mi yio ri i, itiju yio si bò ẹniti o wipe, Nibo ni Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ wà? oju mi yio ri i, nisisiyi ni yio di itẹ̀mọlẹ bi ẹrẹ̀ ita.
entries.en: Then she that is mine enemy shall see it, and shame shall cover her which said unto me, Where is the LORD thy God? mine eyes shall behold her: now shall she be trodden down as the mire of the streets.

entries.yo: Ọjọ ti a o mọ odi rẹ, ọjọ na ni aṣẹ yio jinà rére.
entries.en: In the day that thy walls are to be built, in that day shall the decree be far removed.

entries.yo: Ọjọ na ni nwọn o si ti Assiria wá sọdọ rẹ, ati lati ilu olodi, ati lati ile iṣọ́ alagbara titi de odò, ati lati okun de okun, ati oke-nla de oke-nla.
entries.en: In that day also he shall come even to thee from Assyria, and from the fortified cities, and from the fortress even to the river, and from sea to sea, and from mountain to mountain.

entries.yo: Ilẹ na yio si di ahoro fun awọn ti ngbe inu rẹ̀, nitori eso ìwa wọn.
entries.en: Notwithstanding the land shall be desolate because of them that dwell therein, for the fruit of their doings.

entries.yo: Fi ọpa rẹ bọ́ enia agbo ini rẹ, ti ndágbe inu igbó lãrin Karmeli: jẹ ki wọn jẹ̀ ni Baṣani ati Gileadi, bi ọjọ igbãni.
entries.en: Feed thy people with thy rod, the flock of thine heritage, which dwell solitarily in the wood, in the midst of Carmel: let them feed in Bashan and Gilead, as in the days of old.

entries.yo: Bi ọjọ ti o jade kuro ni ilẹ Egipti li emi o fi ohun iyanu han a.
entries.en: According to the days of thy coming out of the land of Egypt will I shew unto him marvellous things.

entries.yo: Awọn orilẹ-ède yio ri, oju o si tì wọn ninu gbogbo agbara wọn: nwọn o fi ọwọ́ le ẹnu, eti wọn o si di.
entries.en: The nations shall see and be confounded at all their might: they shall lay their hand upon their mouth, their ears shall be deaf.

entries.yo: Nwọn o lá erùpẹ bi ejò, nwọn o si jade kuro ninu ihò wọn bi ekòlo ilẹ: nwọn o bẹ̀ru Oluwa Ọlọrun wa, nwọn o si bẹ̀ru nitori rẹ.
entries.en: They shall lick the dust like a serpent, they shall move out of their holes like worms of the earth: they shall be afraid of the LORD our God, and shall fear because of thee.

entries.yo: Tani Ọlọrun bi iwọ, ti o ndari aiṣedede jì, ti o nre iyokù ini rẹ̀ kọja? kò dá ibinu rẹ̀ duro titi lai, nitori on ni inudidun si ãnu.
entries.en: Who is a God like unto thee, that pardoneth iniquity, and passeth by the transgression of the remnant of his heritage? he retaineth not his anger for ever, because he delighteth in mercy.

entries.yo: Yio yipadà, yio ni iyọnú si wa; yio si tẹ̀ aiṣedede wa ba; iwọ o si sọ gbogbo ẹ̀ṣẹ wọn sinu ọgbun okun.
entries.en: He will turn again, he will have compassion upon us; he will subdue our iniquities; and thou wilt cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.

entries.yo: Iwọ o fi otitọ fun Jakobu, ãnu fun Abrahamu, ti iwọ ti bura fun awọn baba wa, lati ọjọ igbani.
entries.en: Thou wilt perform the truth to Jacob, and the mercy to Abraham, which thou hast sworn unto our fathers from the days of old.

entries.yo: Ọ̀RỌ-ÌMỌ̀ niti Ninefe. Iwe iran Nahumu ara Elkoṣi.
entries.en: The burden of Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun njowu, Oluwa si ngbẹsan; Oluwa ngbẹsan, o si kún fun ibinu; Oluwa ngbẹsan li ara awọn ọta rẹ̀, o si fi ibinu de awọn ọta rẹ̀.
entries.en: God is jealous, and the LORD revengeth; the LORD revengeth, and is furious; the LORD will take vengeance on his adversaries, and he reserveth wrath for his enemies.

entries.yo: Oluwa lọra lati binu, o si tobi li agbara, ni didasilẹ̀ kì yio da enia buburu silẹ: Oluwa ni ọ̀na rẹ̀ ninu ãjà ati ninu ìji, awọsanma si ni ekuru ẹsẹ̀ rẹ̀.
entries.en: The LORD is slow to anger, and great in power, and will not at all acquit the wicked: the LORD hath his way in the whirlwind and in the storm, and the clouds are the dust of his feet.

entries.yo: O ba okun wi, o si mu ki o gbẹ, o si sọ gbogbo odò di gbigbẹ: Baṣani di alailera, ati Karmeli, itànna Lebanoni si rọ.
entries.en: He rebuketh the sea, and maketh it dry, and drieth up all the rivers: Bashan languisheth, and Carmel, and the flower of Lebanon languisheth.

entries.yo: Awọn oke-nla mì nitori rẹ̀, ati awọn oke kékèké di yiyọ́, ilẹ aiye si joná niwaju rẹ̀, ani aiye ati gbogbo awọn ti ngbe inu rẹ̀.
entries.en: The mountains quake at him, and the hills melt, and the earth is burned at his presence, yea, the world, and all that dwell therein.

entries.yo: Tani o le duro niwaju ibinu rẹ̀? tani o si le duro gba gbigboná ibinu rẹ̀? a dà ibinu rẹ̀ jade bi iná, on li o si fọ́ awọn apata.
entries.en: Who can stand before his indignation? and who can abide in the fierceness of his anger? his fury is poured out like fire, and the rocks are thrown down by him.

entries.yo: Rere li Oluwa, ãbo li ọjọ ipọnju; on si mọ̀ awọn ti o gbẹkẹ̀le e.
entries.en: The LORD is good, a strong hold in the day of trouble; and he knoweth them that trust in him.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ikún omi akunrekọja li on fi ṣe iparun ibẹ̀ na de opin, okùnkun yio si ma lepa awọn ọta rẹ̀.
entries.en: But with an overrunning flood he will make an utter end of the place thereof, and darkness shall pursue his enemies.

entries.yo: Kili ẹnyin ngbirò si Oluwa? on o ṣe iparun de opin, ipọnju kì yio dide lẹrinkeji.
entries.en: What do ye imagine against the LORD? he will make an utter end: affliction shall not rise up the second time.

entries.yo: Nitori sã ti a ba ká wọn jọ bi ẹ̀gun, ati sã ti wọn iba mu amupara bi ọmùti, a o run wọn gẹgẹ bi koriko ti o ti gbẹ de opin.
entries.en: For while they be folden together as thorns, and while they are drunken as drunkards, they shall be devoured as stubble fully dry.

entries.yo: Ẹnikan ti ọdọ rẹ jade wá, ti o ngbirò ibi si Oluwa, olugbìmọ buburu.
entries.en: There is one come out of thee, that imagineth evil against the LORD, a wicked counseller.

entries.yo: Bayi ni Oluwa wi; bi nwọn tilẹ pé, ti nwọn si pọ̀ niye, ṣugbọn bayi ni a o ke nwọn lulẹ, nigbati on o ba kọja. Bi mo tilẹ ti pọn ọ loju, emi kì yio pọn ọ loju mọ.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD: Though they be quiet, and likewise many, yet thus shall they be cut down, when he shall pass through. Though I have afflicted thee, I will afflict thee no more.

entries.yo: Nitori nisisiyi li emi o fà ajàga rẹ̀ kuro li ọrun rẹ, emi o si dá idè rẹ wọnni li agbede-meji.
entries.en: For now will I break his yoke from off thee, and will burst thy bonds in sunder.

entries.yo: Oluwa si ti fi aṣẹ kan lelẹ nitori rẹ pe, ki a má ṣe gbìn ninu orukọ rẹ mọ: lati inu ile ọlọrun rẹ wá li emi o ke ere fifin ati ere didà kuro: emi o wà ibojì rẹ; nitori ẹgbin ni iwọ.
entries.en: And the LORD hath given a commandment concerning thee, that no more of thy name be sown: out of the house of thy gods will I cut off the graven image and the molten image: I will make thy grave; for thou art vile.

entries.yo: Wò o lori oke nla ẹsẹ̀ ẹniti o mu ihìn rere wá, ẹniti o nkede alafia! Iwọ Juda, pa aṣẹ rẹ ti o ni irònu mọ, san ẹ̀jẹ́ rẹ: nitori enia buburu kì yio kọja lãrin rẹ mọ; a ti ké e kuro patapata.
entries.en: Behold upon the mountains the feet of him that bringeth good tidings, that publisheth peace! O Judah, keep thy solemn feasts, perform thy vows: for the wicked shall no more pass through thee; he is utterly cut off.

entries.yo: ATUNIKA de iwaju rẹ (Ninefe): pa ile-iṣọ mọ, ṣọ ọ̀na na, di àmurè ẹ̀gbẹ rẹ ko le, mura girigiri.
entries.en: He that dasheth in pieces is come up before thy face: keep the munition, watch the way, make thy loins strong, fortify thy power mightily.

entries.yo: Nitori Oluwa tun pada si ọlanla Jakobu, gẹgẹ bi ọlanla Israeli: atunidanù ti tú wọn danù, nwọn si ba ẹka àjara wọn jẹ.
entries.en: For the LORD hath turned away the excellency of Jacob, as the excellency of Israel: for the emptiers have emptied them out, and marred their vine branches.

entries.yo: A sọ asà awọn ọkunrin alagbara rẹ̀ di pupa, awọn akin wọn wọ̀ odòdó: kẹkẹ́ ogun yio ma kọ bi iná li ọjọ ipèse rẹ̀, igi firi li a o si mì tìti.
entries.en: The shield of his mighty men is made red, the valiant men are in scarlet: the chariots shall be with flaming torches in the day of his preparation, and the fir trees shall be terribly shaken.

entries.yo: Ariwo kẹkẹ́ ni igboro, nwọn o si ma gbún ara wọn ni ọ̀na gbigbòro, nwọn o dabi etùfu, nwọn o kọ́ bi mànamána.
entries.en: The chariots shall rage in the streets, they shall justle one against another in the broad ways: they shall seem like torches, they shall run like the lightnings.

entries.yo: On o ṣe aṣàro awọn ọlọla rẹ̀: nwọn o kọsẹ̀ ni irìn wọn; nwọn o yara si ibi odi rẹ̀, a o si pèse ãbo rẹ̀.
entries.en: He shall recount his worthies: they shall stumble in their walk; they shall make hast to the wall thereof, and the defence shall be prepared.

entries.yo: A o ṣi ilẹ̀kun odò wọnni silẹ, a o si sọ ãfin na di yiyọ́.
entries.en: The gates of the rivers shall be opened, and the palace shall be dissolved.

entries.yo: Eyi ti a ti fi idi rẹ̀ mulẹ li a o si dì ni igbèkun lọ, a o si mu u goke wá, ati awọn iranṣẹbinrin rẹ̀ yio fi ohùn bi ti oriri ṣe amọ̀na rẹ̀, nwọn a ma lù aiya wọn.
entries.en: And Huzzab shall be led away captive, she shall be brought up, and her maids shall lead her as with the voice of doves, tabering upon their breasts.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Ninefe li ọjọ ti o ti wà bi adagun omi: sibẹ̀ nwọn o salọ kuro. Duro, duro! ni nwọn o ma ke; ṣugbọn ẹnikan kì yio wò ẹhìn.
entries.en: But Nineveh is of old like a pool of water: yet they shall flee away. Stand, stand, shall they cry; but none shall look back.

entries.yo: Ẹ ko ikogun fàdakà, ẹ ko ikogun wurà! ati iṣura wọn ailopin na, ati ogo kuro ninu gbogbo ohunelò ti a fẹ́.
entries.en: Take ye the spoil of silver, take the spoil of gold: for there is none end of the store and glory out of all the pleasant furniture.

entries.yo: On ti sòfo, o ti di asan, o si di ahoro: aiyà si yọ́, ẽkún nlù ara wọn, irora pupọ̀ si wà ninu gbogbo ẹgbẹ́, ati oju gbogbo wọn si kó dudu jọ.
entries.en: She is empty, and void, and waste: and the heart melteth, and the knees smite together, and much pain is in all loins, and the faces of them all gather blackness.

entries.yo: Nibo ni ibugbé awọn kiniun wà, ati ibujẹ awọn ọmọ kiniun, nibiti kiniun, ani agbà kiniun, ti nrìn, ati ọmọ kiniun, kò si si ẹniti o dẹruba wọn?
entries.en: Where is the dwelling of the lions, and the feedingplace of the young lions, where the lion, even the old lion, walked, and the lion's whelp, and none made them afraid?

entries.yo: Kiniun ti fàya pẹrẹpẹrẹ tẹrùn fun awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, o si fun li ọrun pa fun awọn abo kiniun rẹ̀, o si fi ohun ọdẹ kún isà rẹ̀, ati ihò rẹ̀ fun onjẹ agbara.
entries.en: The lion did tear in pieces enough for his whelps, and strangled for his lionesses, and filled his holes with prey, and his dens with ravin.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, emi dojukọ ọ, ni Oluwa awọn ọmọ ogun wi, emi o si fi kẹkẹ́ rẹ̀ wọnni joná ninu ẹ̃fin, idà yio si jẹ ọmọ kiniun rẹ wọnni run: emi o si ke ohun ọdẹ rẹ kuro lori ilẹ aiye, ohùn awọn ojiṣẹ rẹ li a kì yio si tún gbọ́ mọ.
entries.en: Behold, I am against thee, saith the LORD of hosts, and I will burn her chariots in the smoke, and the sword shall devour thy young lions: and I will cut off thy prey from the earth, and the voice of thy messengers shall no more be heard.

entries.yo: EGBE ni fun ilu ẹjẹ̀ nì! gbogbo rẹ̀ kun fun eké, ati olè, ijẹ kò kuro;
entries.en: Woe to the bloody city! it is all full of lies and robbery; the prey departeth not;

entries.yo: Ariwo pàṣan, ati ariwo kikùn kẹkẹ́, ati ti ijọ awọn ẹṣin, ati ti fifò kẹkẹ́.
entries.en: The noise of a whip, and the noise of the rattling of the wheels, and of the pransing horses, and of the jumping chariots.

entries.yo: Ẹlẹṣin ti gbe idà rẹ̀ ti nkọ màna, ati ọkọ̀ rẹ̀ ti ndán yànran si oke: ọ̀pọlọpọ si li awọn ẹniti a pa, ati ọ̀pọlọpọ okú; okú kò si ni opin; nwọn nkọsẹ̀ li ara okú wọn wọnni:
entries.en: The horseman lifteth up both the bright sword and the glittering spear: and there is a multitude of slain, and a great number of carcases; and there is none end of their corpses; they stumble upon their corpses:

entries.yo: Nitori ọ̀pọlọpọ awọn panṣagà àgbere ti o roju rere gbà, iya ajẹ ti o ntà awọn orilẹ-ède nipasẹ̀ panṣaga rẹ̀, ati idile nipasẹ̀ ajẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Because of the multitude of the whoredoms of the wellfavoured harlot, the mistress of witchcrafts, that selleth nations through her whoredoms, and families through her witchcrafts.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, emi dojukọ́ ọ, ni Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi; emi o si ká aṣọ itẹlẹ̀di rẹ li oju rẹ, emi o si fi ihòho rẹ hàn awọn orilẹ-ède, ati itiju rẹ hàn awọn ilẹ̀ ọba.
entries.en: Behold, I am against thee, saith the LORD of hosts; and I will discover thy skirts upon thy face, and I will shew the nations thy nakedness, and the kingdoms thy shame.

entries.yo: Emi o da ẹgbin ti o ni irira si ọ lara, emi o si sọ ọ di alaimọ́, emi o si gbe ọ kalẹ bi ẹni ifiṣẹlẹyà.
entries.en: And I will cast abominable filth upon thee, and make thee vile, and will set thee as a gazingstock.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe pe, gbogbo awọn ti o wò ọ yio sa fun ọ, nwọn o si wipe, A ti fi Ninefe ṣòfo: tani yio kẹdùn rẹ̀? nibo ni emi o ti wá olutùnu fun ọ?
entries.en: And it shall come to pass, that all they that look upon thee shall flee from thee, and say, Nineveh is laid waste: who will bemoan her? whence shall I seek comforters for thee?

entries.yo: Iwọ ha sàn jù No-ammoni, eyiti o wà lãrin odò ti omi yika kiri, ti agbara rẹ̀ jẹ okun, ti odi rẹ̀ si ti inu okun jade wá?
entries.en: Art thou better than populous No, that was situate among the rivers, that had the waters round about it, whose rampart was the sea, and her wall was from the sea?

entries.yo: Etiopia ati Egipti li agbara rẹ̀, kò si li opin; Puti ati Lubimu li awọn olùranlọwọ rẹ.
entries.en: Ethiopia and Egypt were her strength, and it was infinite; Put and Lubim were thy helpers.

entries.yo: Sibẹ̀sibẹ̀ a kó o lọ, o lọ si oko-ẹrú: awọn ọmọ wẹ́wẹ rẹ̀ li a fi ṣánlẹ̀ pẹlu li ori ita gbogbo; nwọn si di ibò nitori awọn ọlọla rẹ̀ ọkunrin, gbogbo awọn ọlọla rẹ̀ li a si fi ẹwọ̀n dì.
entries.en: Yet was she carried away, she went into captivity: her young children also were dashed in pieces at the top of all the streets: and they cast lots for her honourable men, and all her great men were bound in chains.

entries.yo: Iwọ pẹlu o si yó ọti; a o si fi ọ pamọ, iwọ pẹlu o si ma ṣe afẹri ãbò nitori ti ọta na.
entries.en: Thou also shalt be drunken: thou shalt be hid, thou also shalt seek strength because of the enemy.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ile-iṣọ agbara rẹ yio dabi igi ọpọ̀tọ pẹlu akọpọn ọpọ̀tọ: bi a ba gbọ̀n wọn, nwọn o si bọ si ẹnu ọjẹun.
entries.en: All thy strong holds shall be like fig trees with the firstripe figs: if they be shaken, they shall even fall into the mouth of the eater.

entries.yo: Kiye si i, obinrin li awọn enia rẹ lãrin rẹ: oju ibodè ilẹ rẹ li a o ṣi silẹ gbaguda fun awọn ọta rẹ: iná yio jo ikere rẹ.
entries.en: Behold, thy people in the midst of thee are women: the gates of thy land shall be set wide open unto thine enemies: the fire shall devour thy bars.

entries.yo: Iwọ pọn omi de ihamọ, mu ile iṣọ rẹ le: wọ̀ inu amọ̀, ki o si tẹ̀ erupẹ̀, ki o si ṣe ibiti a nsun okuta-amọ̀ ki o le.
entries.en: Draw thee waters for the siege, fortify thy strong holds: go into clay, and tread the morter, make strong the brickkiln.

entries.yo: Nibẹ̀ ni iná yio jo ọ run; idà yio ké ọ kuro, yio si jẹ ọ bi kòkoro: sọ ara rẹ di pupọ̀ bi kòkoro, si sọ ara rẹ di pupọ̀ bi ẽṣu.
entries.en: There shall the fire devour thee; the sword shall cut thee off, it shall eat thee up like the cankerworm: make thyself many as the cankerworm, make thyself many as the locusts.

entries.yo: Iwọ ti sọ awọn oniṣòwo rẹ di pupọ̀ jù iràwọ oju ọrun lọ: kokòro nà ara rẹ̀, o si fò lọ.
entries.en: Thou hast multiplied thy merchants above the stars of heaven: the cankerworm spoileth, and flieth away.

entries.yo: Awọn alade rẹ dabi eṣú, awọn ọgagun rẹ si dabi ẹlẹngà nla, eyiti ndó sinu ọgbà la ọjọ otutù, ṣugbọn nigbati õrùn là, nwọn sa lọ, a kò si mọ̀ ibiti wọn gbe wà.
entries.en: Thy crowned are as the locusts, and thy captains as the great grasshoppers, which camp in the hedges in the cold day, but when the sun ariseth they flee away, and their place is not known where they are.

entries.yo: Awọn olùṣọ agùtan rẹ ntõgbe, Iwọ ọba Assiria: awọn ọlọla rẹ yio ma gbe inu ekuru: awọn enia rẹ si tuka lori oke-nla, ẹnikan kò si kó wọn jọ.
entries.en: Thy shepherds slumber, O king of Assyria: thy nobles shall dwell in the dust: thy people is scattered upon the mountains, and no man gathereth them.

entries.yo: Kò si ipajumọ fun ifarapa rẹ; ọgbẹ rẹ kún fun irora, gbogbo ẹniti o gbọ́ ihin rẹ yio pàtẹwọ le ọ lori, nitori li ori tani ìwa-buburu rẹ kò ti kọja nigbagbogbo?
entries.en: There is no healing of thy bruise; thy wound is grievous: all that hear the bruit of thee shall clap the hands over thee: for upon whom hath not thy wickedness passed continually?

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ-ìmọ ti Habakuku wolii rí.
entries.en: The burden which Habakkuk the prophet did see.

entries.yo: Oluwa, emi o ti ke pẹ to, ti iwọ kì yio fi gbọ́! ti emi o kigbe si ọ, niti ìwa-ipa, ti iwọ kì yio si gbalà!
entries.en: O LORD, how long shall I cry, and thou wilt not hear! even cry out unto thee of violence, and thou wilt not save!

entries.yo: Ẽṣe ti o mu mi ri aiṣedede, ti o si jẹ ki nma wò ìwa-ìka? nitori ikógun ati ìwa-ipá wà niwaju mi: awọn ti si nrú ijà ati ãwọ̀ soke mbẹ.
entries.en: Why dost thou shew me iniquity, and cause me to behold grievance? for spoiling and violence are before me: and there are that raise up strife and contention.

entries.yo: Nitorina li ofin ṣe di ẹ̀rọ, ti idajọ kò si jade lọ li ẹtọ́; nitoriti ẹni buburu yí olododo ka; nitorina ni idajọ ẹbi ṣe njade.
entries.en: Therefore the law is slacked, and judgment doth never go forth: for the wicked doth compass about the righteous; therefore wrong judgment proceedeth.

entries.yo: Ẹ wò inu awọn keferi, ki ẹ si wò o, ki hà ki o si ṣe nyin gidigidi: nitoriti emi o ṣe iṣẹ kan li ọjọ nyin, ti ẹ kì yio si gbagbọ́, bi a tilẹ sọ fun nyin.
entries.en: Behold ye among the heathen, and regard, and wonder marvellously: for I will work a work in your days, which ye will not believe, though it be told you.

entries.yo: Nitoripe, wò o, emi gbe awọn ara Kaldea dide, orilẹ-ède ti o korò, ti o si yára, ti yio rìn ibú ilẹ na ja, lati ni ibùgbe wọnni, ti kì iṣe ti wọn.
entries.en: For, lo, I raise up the Chaldeans, that bitter and hasty nation, which shall march through the breadth of the land, to possess the dwellingplaces that are not theirs.

entries.yo: Nwọn ni ẹ̀ru, nwọn si fò ni laiyà: idajọ wọn, ati ọlanla wọn, yio ma ti inu wọn jade.
entries.en: They are terrible and dreadful: their judgment and their dignity shall proceed of themselves.

entries.yo: Ẹṣin wọn pẹlu yara jù ẹkùn lọ, nwọn si muná jù ikõkò aṣãlẹ lọ: ẹlẹṣin wọn yio si tàn ara wọn ka, ẹlẹṣin wọn yio si ti ọ̀na jijìn rére wá; nwọn o si fò bi idì ti nyára lati jẹun.
entries.en: Their horses also are swifter than the leopards, and are more fierce than the evening wolves: and their horsemen shall spread themselves, and their horsemen shall come from far; they shall fly as the eagle that hasteth to eat.

entries.yo: Gbogbo wọn o si wá fun ìwa-ipá; iwò oju wọn o si wà siwaju, nwọn o si kó igbèkun jọ bi yanrìn.
entries.en: They shall come all for violence: their faces shall sup up as the east wind, and they shall gather the captivity as the sand.

entries.yo: Nwọn o si ma fi awọn ọba ṣẹsín, awọn ọmọ alade yio si di ẹni-ẹ̀gan fun wọn: gbogbo ibi agbara ni nwọn o si fi rẹrin; nitoripe nwọn o ko erupẹ̀ jọ, nwọn o si gbà a.
entries.en: And they shall scoff at the kings, and the princes shall be a scorn unto them: they shall deride every strong hold; for they shall heap dust, and take it.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni inu rẹ̀ yio yipadà, yio si rekọja, yio si ṣẹ̀, ni kikà agbara rẹ̀ yi si iṣẹ òriṣa rẹ̀.
entries.en: Then shall his mind change, and he shall pass over, and offend, imputing this his power unto his god.

entries.yo: Lati aiyeraiye ki iwọ ti wà? Oluwa Ọlọrun mi, Ẹni Mimọ́ mi? awa kì yio kú. Oluwa, iwọ ti yàn wọn fun idajọ; Ọlọrun alagbara, iwọ ti fi ẹsẹ̀ wọn mulẹ fun ibawi.
entries.en: Art thou not from everlasting, O LORD my God, mine Holy One? we shall not die. O LORD, thou hast ordained them for judgment; and, O mighty God, thou hast established them for correction.

entries.yo: Oju rẹ mọ́ jù ẹniti iwò ibi lọ, iwọ kò si lè wò ìwa-ìka: nitori kini iwọ ha ṣe nwò awọn ti nhùwa arekerekè, ti o si pa ẹnu rẹ mọ, nigbati ẹni-buburu jẹ ẹniti iṣe olododo jù u run?
entries.en: Thou art of purer eyes than to behold evil, and canst not look on iniquity: wherefore lookest thou upon them that deal treacherously, and holdest thy tongue when the wicked devoureth the man that is more righteous than he?

entries.yo: Ti iwọ si nṣe enia bi ẹja okun, bi ohun ti nrakò, ti kò ni alakoso lori wọn?
entries.en: And makest men as the fishes of the sea, as the creeping things, that have no ruler over them?

entries.yo: Iwọ ni àwọn lati fi gbé gbogbo wọn, nwọn nfi àwọn mu wọn, nwọn si nfi awò wọn kó wọn: nitorina ni nwọn ṣe nyọ̀, ti inu wọn si ndùn.
entries.en: They take up all of them with the angle, they catch them in their net, and gather them in their drag: therefore they rejoice and are glad.

entries.yo: Nitorina, nwọn nrubọ si àwọn wọn, nwọn si nsùn turari fun awò wọn; nitori nipa wọn ni ipin wọn ṣe li ọrá, ti onjẹ wọn si fi di pupọ̀.
entries.en: Therefore they sacrifice unto their net, and burn incense unto their drag; because by them their portion is fat, and their meat plenteous.

entries.yo: Nitorina, nwọn o ha ma dà àwọn wọn, nwọn kì yio ha dẹkun lati ma fọ́ orilẹ-ède gbogbo?
entries.en: Shall they therefore empty their net, and not spare continually to slay the nations?

entries.yo: LORI ibuṣọ́ mi li emi o duro, emi o si gbe ara mi kà ori alore, emi o si ṣọ lati ri ohun ti yio sọ fun mi, ati èsi ti emi o fọ́, nigbati a ba mba mi wi.
entries.en: I will stand upon my watch, and set me upon the tower, and will watch to see what he will say unto me, and what I shall answer when I am reproved.

entries.yo: Oluwa si da mi lohùn, o si wipe, Kọ iran na, ki o si hàn a lara wàlã, ki ẹniti nkà a, le ma sare.
entries.en: And the LORD answered me, and said, Write the vision, and make it plain upon tables, that he may run that readeth it.

entries.yo: Nitori iran na jẹ ti igbà kan ti a yàn, yio ma yára si igbẹhìn, kì yio si ṣeke, bi o tilẹ̀ pẹ, duro dè e, nitori ni dide, yio de, kì yio pẹ.
entries.en: For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak, and not lie: though it tarry, wait for it; because it will surely come, it will not tarry.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, ọkàn rẹ̀ ti o gbega, kò duro ṣinṣin ninu rẹ̀: ṣugbọn olododo yio wà nipa ìgbagbọ́ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Behold, his soul which is lifted up is not upright in him: but the just shall live by his faith.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni pẹlu, nitoriti ọti-waini li ẹtàn, agberaga enia li on, kì isi simi, ẹniti o sọ ifẹ rẹ̀ di gbigbõrò bi ipò-okú, o si dabi ikú, a kò si lè tẹ́ ẹ lọrun, ṣugbọn o kó gbogbo orilẹ-ède jọ si ọdọ, o si gbá gbogbo enia jọ si ọdọ rẹ̀:
entries.en: Yea also, because he transgresseth by wine, he is a proud man, neither keepeth at home, who enlargeth his desire as hell, and is as death, and cannot be satisfied, but gathereth unto him all nations, and heapeth unto him all people:

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn wọnyi kì yio ma pa owe si i, ti nwọn o si ma kọ orin owe si i, wipe, Egbe ni fun ẹniti nmu ohun ti kì iṣe tirẹ̀ pọ̀ si i! yio ti pẹ to? ati fun ẹniti ndi ẹrẹ̀ ilọnilọwọgbà ru ara rẹ̀.
entries.en: Shall not all these take up a parable against him, and a taunting proverb against him, and say, Woe to him that increaseth that which is not his! how long? and to him that ladeth himself with thick clay!

entries.yo: Awọn ti o yọ ọ lẹnu, kì yio ha dide lojiji? awọn ti o wahalà rẹ kì yio ha ji? iwọ kì yio ha si di ikogun fun wọn?
entries.en: Shall they not rise up suddenly that shall bite thee, and awake that shall vex thee, and thou shalt be for booties unto them?

entries.yo: Nitori iwọ ti kó orilẹ-ède pupọ̀, gbogbo iyokù awọn enia na ni yio kó ọ; nitori ẹjẹ̀ enia, ati ìwa-ipá ilẹ na, ti ilu na, ati ti gbogbo awọn ti ngbe inu rẹ̀.
entries.en: Because thou hast spoiled many nations, all the remnant of the people shall spoil thee; because of men's blood, and for the violence of the land, of the city, and of all that dwell therein.

entries.yo: Egbe ni fun ẹniti njẹ erè ijẹkujẹ si ile rẹ̀, ki o lè ba gbe itẹ́ rẹ̀ ka ibi giga, ki a lè ba gbà a silẹ kuro lọwọ ibi!
entries.en: Woe to him that coveteth an evil covetousness to his house, that he may set his nest on high, that he may be delivered from the power of evil!

entries.yo: Iwọ ti gbìmọ itìju si ile rẹ, nipa kike enia pupọ̀ kuro, o si ti ṣẹ̀ si ọkàn rẹ.
entries.en: Thou hast consulted shame to thy house by cutting off many people, and hast sinned against thy soul.

entries.yo: Nitoriti okuta yio kigbe lati inu ogiri wá, ati igi-idábu lati inu òpo wá yio si da a lohùn.
entries.en: For the stone shall cry out of the wall, and the beam out of the timber shall answer it.

entries.yo: Egbe ni fun ẹniti o fi ẹjẹ̀ kọ ilu, ti o si fi aiṣedede tẹ̀ ilu nla do.
entries.en: Woe to him that buildeth a town with blood, and stablisheth a city by iniquity!

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, ti Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun kọ́ pe, ki awọn enia na ma ṣe lãla fun iná, ati ki awọn enia na si ma ṣe ara wọn li ãrẹ̀ fun asan?
entries.en: Behold, is it not of the LORD of hosts that the people shall labour in the very fire, and the people shall weary themselves for very vanity?

entries.yo: Nitoriti aiye yio kún fun ìmọ ogo Oluwa, bi omi ti bò okun.
entries.en: For the earth shall be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the LORD, as the waters cover the sea.

entries.yo: Egbe ni fun ẹniti o fi ohun mimu fun aladugbo rẹ̀, ti o si fi ọti-lile rẹ fun u, ti o si jẹ ki o mu amupara pẹlu, ki iwọ ba le wò ihòho wọn!
entries.en: Woe unto him that giveth his neighbour drink, that puttest thy bottle to him, and makest him drunken also, that thou mayest look on their nakedness!

entries.yo: Itìju bò ọ nipò ogo, iwọ mu pẹlu, ki abẹ́ rẹ le hàn, ago ọwọ́ ọtun Oluwa ni a o yipadà si ọ, ati itọ́ itìju sára ogo rẹ.
entries.en: Thou art filled with shame for glory: drink thou also, and let thy foreskin be uncovered: the cup of the LORD's right hand shall be turned unto thee, and shameful spewing shall be on thy glory.

entries.yo: Nitori ti ìwa-ipá ti Lebanoni yio bò ọ, ati ikogun awọn ẹranko, ti o bà wọn li ẹ̀ru, nitori ẹjẹ̀ enia, ati ìwa ipá ilẹ na, ti ilu na, ati ti gbogbo awọn ti ngbe inu rẹ̀.
entries.en: For the violence of Lebanon shall cover thee, and the spoil of beasts, which made them afraid, because of men's blood, and for the violence of the land, of the city, and of all that dwell therein.

entries.yo: Erè kini ere fínfin nì, ti oniṣọna rẹ̀ fi gbẹ́ ẹ; ere didà, ati olùkọ eké, ti ẹniti nṣe iṣẹ rẹ̀ fi gbẹkẹ̀le e, lati ma ṣe ere ti o yadi?
entries.en: What profiteth the graven image that the maker thereof hath graven it; the molten image, and a teacher of lies, that the maker of his work trusteth therein, to make dumb idols?

entries.yo: Egbe ni fun ẹniti o wi fun igi pe, Ji; fun okuta ti o yadi pe, Dide, on o kọ́ ni! Kiyesi i, wurà ati fàdakà li a fi bò o yika, kò si si ẽmi kan ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: Woe unto him that saith to the wood, Awake; to the dumb stone, Arise, it shall teach! Behold, it is laid over with gold and silver, and there is no breath at all in the midst of it.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Oluwa mbẹ ninu tempili rẹ̀ mimọ́; jẹ ki gbogbo aiye pa rọ́rọ niwaju rẹ̀.
entries.en: But the LORD is in his holy temple: let all the earth keep silence before him.

entries.yo: ADURA Habakuku woli lara Sigionoti.
entries.en: A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet upon Shigionoth.

entries.yo: Oluwa, mo ti gbọ́ ohùn rẹ, ẹ̀ru si bà mi: Oluwa, mu iṣẹ rẹ sọji lãrin ọdun, lãrin ọdun sọ wọn di mimọ̀; ni ibinu ranti ãnu.
entries.en: O LORD, I have heard thy speech, and was afraid: O LORD, revive thy work in the midst of the years, in the midst of the years make known; in wrath remember mercy.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun yio ti Temani wá, ati Ẹni Mimọ́ lati oke Parani. Ogo rẹ̀ bò awọn ọrun, ilẹ aiye si kun fun iyìn rẹ̀.
entries.en: God came from Teman, and the Holy One from mount Paran. Selah. His glory covered the heavens, and the earth was full of his praise.

entries.yo: Didán rẹ̀ si dabi imọlẹ; itanṣan nti iha rẹ̀ wá: nibẹ̀ si ni ipamọ agbara rẹ̀ wà.
entries.en: And his brightness was as the light; he had horns coming out of his hand: and there was the hiding of his power.

entries.yo: Ajàkalẹ arùn nlọ niwaju rẹ̀, ati okunrun njade lati ẹsẹ̀ rẹ̀ lọ.
entries.en: Before him went the pestilence, and burning coals went forth at his feet.

entries.yo: O duro, o si wọ̀n ilẹ aiye: o wò, o si mu awọn orilẹ-ède warìri; a si tú awọn oke-nla aiyeraiye ká, awọn òkèkékèké aiyeraiye si tẹba: ọ̀na rẹ̀ aiyeraiye ni.
entries.en: He stood, and measured the earth: he beheld, and drove asunder the nations; and the everlasting mountains were scattered, the perpetual hills did bow: his ways are everlasting.

entries.yo: Mo ri agọ Kuṣani labẹ ipọnju: awọn aṣọ-ikele ilẹ̀ Midiani si warìri.
entries.en: I saw the tents of Cushan in affliction: and the curtains of the land of Midian did tremble.

entries.yo: Oluwa ha binu si awọn odò? ibinu rẹ̀ ha wà si awọn odò? ibinu rẹ̀ ha wà si okun, ti iwọ fi ngùn ẹṣin rẹ ati kẹkẹ́ igbàla rẹ?
entries.en: Was the LORD displeased against the rivers? was thine anger against the rivers? was thy wrath against the sea, that thou didst ride upon thine horses and thy chariots of salvation?

entries.yo: A ṣi ọrun rẹ̀ silẹ patapata, gẹgẹ bi ibura awọn ẹ̀ya, ani ọ̀rọ rẹ. Iwọ ti fi odò là ilẹ aiye.
entries.en: Thy bow was made quite naked, according to the oaths of the tribes, even thy word. Selah. Thou didst cleave the earth with rivers.

entries.yo: Awọn oke-nla ri ọ, nwọn si warìri: akúnya omi kọja lọ: ibú fọ̀ ohùn rẹ̀, o si gbe ọwọ́ rẹ̀ si oke.
entries.en: The mountains saw thee, and they trembled: the overflowing of the water passed by: the deep uttered his voice, and lifted up his hands on high.

entries.yo: Õrùn ati oṣupa duro jẹ ni ibùgbe wọn: ni imọlẹ ọfà rẹ ni nwọn lọ, ati ni didán ọ̀kọ rẹ ti nkọ màna.
entries.en: The sun and moon stood still in their habitation: at the light of thine arrows they went, and at the shining of thy glittering spear.

entries.yo: Ni irúnu ni iwọ rìn ilẹ na ja, ni ibinu ni iwọ ti tẹ̀ awọn orilẹ-ede rẹ́.
entries.en: Thou didst march through the land in indignation, thou didst thresh the heathen in anger.

entries.yo: Iwọ jade lọ fun igbàla awọn enia rẹ, fun igbàla ẹni atororosi rẹ; iwọ ti ṣá awọn olori kuro ninu ile awọn enia buburu, ni fifi ipinlẹ hàn titi de ọrùn.
entries.en: Thou wentest forth for the salvation of thy people, even for salvation with thine anointed; thou woundedst the head out of the house of the wicked, by discovering the foundation unto the neck. Selah.

entries.yo: Iwọ ti fi ọ̀pa rẹ̀ lu awọn olori iletò rẹ̀ já: nwọn rọ́ jade bi ãjà lati tu mi ka: ayọ̀ wọn ni bi ati jẹ talakà run nikọ̀kọ.
entries.en: Thou didst strike through with his staves the head of his villages: they came out as a whirlwind to scatter me: their rejoicing was as to devour the poor secretly.

entries.yo: Iwọ fi awọn ẹṣin rẹ rìn okun ja, okìti omi nla.
entries.en: Thou didst walk through the sea with thine horses, through the heap of great waters.

entries.yo: Nigbati mo gbọ́, ikùn mi warìri; etè mi gbọ̀n li ohùn na; ibàjẹ wọ̀ inu egungun mi lọ, mo si warìri ni inu mi, ki emi ba le simi li ọjọ ipọnju: nigbati o ba goke tọ̀ awọn enia lọ, yio ke wọn kuro.
entries.en: When I heard, my belly trembled; my lips quivered at the voice: rottenness entered into my bones, and I trembled in myself, that I might rest in the day of trouble: when he cometh up unto the people, he will invade them with his troops.

entries.yo: Bi igi ọpọ̀tọ kì yio tilẹ tanná, ti eso kò si ninu àjara; iṣẹ igi-olifi yio jẹ aṣedanù, awọn oko kì yio si mu onje wá; a o ke agbo-ẹran kuro ninu agbo, ọwọ́ ẹran kì yio si si ni ibùso mọ:
entries.en: Although the fig tree shall not blossom, neither shall fruit be in the vines; the labour of the olive shall fail, and the fields shall yield no meat; the flock shall be cut off from the fold, and there shall be no herd in the stalls:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi o ma yọ̀ ninu Oluwa, emi o ma yọ̀ ninu Ọlọrun igbàla mi.
entries.en: Yet I will rejoice in the LORD, I will joy in the God of my salvation.

entries.yo: Oluwa Ọlọrun ni agbara mi, on o si ṣe ẹsẹ̀ mi bi ẹsẹ̀ agbọ̀nrin, lori ibi giga mi ni yio si mu mi rìn. Si olori akọrin lara ohun-ọnà orin olokùn mi.
entries.en: The LORD God is my strength, and he will make my feet like hinds' feet, and he will make me to walk upon mine high places. To the chief singer on my stringed instruments.

entries.yo: Ọ̀RỌ Oluwa ti o tọ̀ Sefaniah wá ọmọ Kuṣi, ọmọ Gedaliah, ọmọ Amariah, ọmọ Hisikiah, li ọjọ Josiah, ọmọ Amoni ọba Juda.
entries.en: The word of the LORD which came unto Zephaniah the son of Cushi, the son of Gedaliah, the son of Amariah, the son of Hizkiah, in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah.

entries.yo: Oluwa wipe, emi o mu gbogbo nkan kuro lori ilẹ na patapata.
entries.en: I will utterly consume all things from off the land, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Emi o mu enia ati ẹranko kuro; emi o mu ẹiyẹ oju ọrun kuro, ati ẹja inu okun, ati ohun idigbòlu pẹlu awọn enia buburu; emi o si ké enia kuro lori ilẹ, ni Oluwa wi.
entries.en: I will consume man and beast; I will consume the fowls of the heaven, and the fishes of the sea, and the stumblingblocks with the wicked; and I will cut off man from off the land, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Emi o nà ọwọ́ mi pẹlu sori Juda, ati sori gbogbo ara Jerusalemu; emi o si ké iyokù Baali kuro nihinyi, ati orukọ Kemarimu pẹlu awọn alufa;
entries.en: I will also stretch out mine hand upon Judah, and upon all the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and I will cut off the remnant of Baal from this place, and the name of the Chemarims with the priests;

entries.yo: Ati awọn ti nsìn ogun ọrun lori orule: awọn ti nsìn, ti nfi Oluwa bura, ti si nfi Malkomu bura;
entries.en: And them that worship the host of heaven upon the housetops; and them that worship and that swear by the LORD, and that swear by Malcham;

entries.yo: Ati awọn ẹniti o yipadà kuro lọdọ Oluwa; ati awọn ẹniti kò ti wá Oluwa, bẹ̃ni nwọn kò si bère rẹ̀.
entries.en: And them that are turned back from the LORD; and those that have not sought the LORD, nor inquired for him.

entries.yo: Pa ẹnu rẹ mọ niwaju Oluwa Ọlọrun: nitoriti ọjọ Oluwa kù si dẹ̀dẹ: nitori Oluwa ti pesè ẹbọ kan silẹ̀, o si ti yà awọn alapèjẹ rẹ̀ si mimọ́.
entries.en: Hold thy peace at the presence of the Lord GOD: for the day of the LORD is at hand: for the LORD hath prepared a sacrifice, he hath bid his guests.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe li ọjọ ẹbọ Oluwa, ti emi o bẹ̀ awọn olori wò, ati awọn ọmọ ọba, ati gbogbo iru awọn ti o wọ̀ ajèji aṣọ.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass in the day of the LORD's sacrifice, that I will punish the princes, and the king's children, and all such as are clothed with strange apparel.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ na gan li emi o bẹ̀ gbogbo awọn ti nfò le iloro wò pẹlu, ti nfi ìwà-ipá on ẹ̀tan kún ile oluwa wọn.
entries.en: In the same day also will I punish all those that leap on the threshold, which fill their masters' houses with violence and deceit.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe li ọjọ na, li Oluwa wi, ohùn ẹkún yio ti ihà bodè-ẹja wá, ati hihu lati ihà keji wá, ati iro nla lati oke-kékèké wọnni wá.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the LORD, that there shall be the noise of a cry from the fish gate, and an howling from the second, and a great crashing from the hills.

entries.yo: Hu, ẹnyin ara Maktẹsi, nitoripe gbogbo enia oniṣòwo li a ti ke lu ilẹ; gbogbo awọn ẹniti o nrù fàdakà li a ke kuro.
entries.en: Howl, ye inhabitants of Maktesh, for all the merchant people are cut down; all they that bear silver are cut off.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe li akokò na, li emi o fi fitilà wá Jerusalemu kiri, emi o si bẹ̀ awọn enia ti o silẹ sinu gẹ̀dẹgẹdẹ̀ wọn wò: awọn ti nwi li ọkàn wọn pe, Oluwa kì yio ṣe rere, bẹ̃ni kì yio ṣe buburu.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass at that time, that I will search Jerusalem with candles, and punish the men that are settled on their lees: that say in their heart, The LORD will not do good, neither will he do evil.

entries.yo: Nitorina ogun wọn o di ikógun, ati ilẹ wọn yio di ahoro: nwọn o kọ́ ile pẹlu, ṣugbọn nwọn kì yio gbe inu wọn, nwọn o si gbìn ọgbà àjara, ṣugbọn nwọn kì yio mu ọti-waini inu rẹ̀.
entries.en: Therefore their goods shall become a booty, and their houses a desolation: they shall also build houses, but not inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, but not drink the wine thereof.

entries.yo: Ọjọ nla Oluwa kù si dẹ̀dẹ, o kù si dẹ̀dẹ̀, o si nyara kánkan, ani ohùn ọjọ Oluwa: alagbara ọkunrin yio sọkun kikorò nibẹ̀.
entries.en: The great day of the LORD is near, it is near, and hasteth greatly, even the voice of the day of the LORD: the mighty man shall cry there bitterly.

entries.yo: Ọjọ na ọjọ ibinu ni, ọjọ iyọnu, ati ipọnju, ọjọ ofò ati idahoro, ọjọ okùnkun ọti okùdu, ọjọ kũku ati okunkun biribiri,
entries.en: That day is a day of wrath, a day of trouble and distress, a day of wasteness and desolation, a day of darkness and gloominess, a day of clouds and thick darkness,

entries.yo: Ọjọ ipè ati idagirì si ilu olodi wọnni ati si iṣọ giga wọnni.
entries.en: A day of the trumpet and alarm against the fenced cities, and against the high towers.

entries.yo: Emi o si mu ipọnju wá bá enia, ti nwọn o ma rìn bi afọju, nitori nwọn ti dẹṣẹ si Oluwa: ẹjẹ̀ wọn li a o si tú jade bi ekuru, ati ẹran-ara wọn bi igbẹ.
entries.en: And I will bring distress upon men, that they shall walk like blind men, because they have sinned against the LORD: and their blood shall be poured out as dust, and their flesh as the dung.

entries.yo: Fàdakà wọn tabi wurà wọn kì yio lè gbà wọn li ọjọ ìbinu Oluwa: ṣugbọn gbogbo ilẹ̀ na li a o fi iná ijowu rẹ̀ parun: nitori on o fi iyara mu gbogbo awọn ti ngbe ilẹ na kuro.
entries.en: Neither their silver nor their gold shall be able to deliver them in the day of the LORD's wrath; but the whole land shall be devoured by the fire of his jealousy: for he shall make even a speedy riddance of all them that dwell in the land.

entries.yo: Ẹ kó ara nyin jọ pọ̀, ani, ẹ kójọ pọ̀ orilẹ-ède ti kò nani;
entries.en: Gather yourselves together, yea, gather together, O nation not desired;

entries.yo: Ki a to pa aṣẹ na, ki ọjọ na to kọja bi iyàngbò, ki gbigboná ibinu Oluwa to de ba nyin, ki ọjọ ibinu Oluwa ki o to de ba nyin.
entries.en: Before the decree bring forth, before the day pass as the chaff, before the fierce anger of the LORD come upon you, before the day of the LORD's anger come upon you.

entries.yo: Ẹ wá Oluwa, gbogbo ẹnyin ọlọkàn tutù aiye, ti nṣe idajọ rẹ̀; ẹ wá ododo, ẹ wá ìwa-pẹ̀lẹ: boya a o pa nyin mọ li ọjọ ibinu Oluwa.
entries.en: Seek ye the LORD, all ye meek of the earth, which have wrought his judgment; seek righteousness, seek meekness: it may be ye shall be hid in the day of the LORD's anger.

entries.yo: Nitoripe a o kọ̀ Gasa silẹ, Aṣkeloni yio si dahoro: nwọn o le Aṣdodu jade li ọsangangan, a o si fà Ekronu tu kuro.
entries.en: For Gaza shall be forsaken, and Ashkelon a desolation: they shall drive out Ashdod at the noon day, and Ekron shall be rooted up.

entries.yo: Egbe ni fun awọn ẹniti ngbe agbègbe okun, orilẹ-ède awọn ara Kereti! ọ̀rọ Oluwa dojukọ nyin; iwọ Kenaani, ilẹ awọn ara Filistia, emi o tilẹ pa ọ run, ti ẹnikan kì yio gbe ibẹ̀ mọ.
entries.en: Woe unto the inhabitants of the sea coast, the nation of the Cherethites! the word of the LORD is against you; O Canaan, the land of the Philistines, I will even destroy thee, that there shall be no inhabitant.

entries.yo: Agbègbe okun yio si jẹ ibujoko ati agọ fun awọn olùṣọ agùtan, ati agbo fun agbo-ẹran.
entries.en: And the sea coast shall be dwellings and cottages for shepherds, and folds for flocks.

entries.yo: Agbègbe na yio si wà fun iyokù ile Juda; nwọn o jẹ̀ li ori wọn: ni ile Aṣkeloni wọnni ni nwọn o dùbulẹ li aṣãlẹ: nitori Oluwa Ọlọrun wọn yio bẹ̀ wọn wò, yio si yi igbèkun wọn padà kuro.
entries.en: And the coast shall be for the remnant of the house of Judah; they shall feed thereupon: in the houses of Ashkelon shall they lie down in the evening: for the LORD their God shall visit them, and turn away their captivity.

entries.yo: Emi ti gbọ́ ẹgàn Moabu, ati ẹlẹyà awọn ọmọ Ammoni, nipa eyiti nwọn ti kẹgàn awọn enia mi, ti nwọn si ti gbe ara wọn ga si agbègbe wọn.
entries.en: I have heard the reproach of Moab, and the revilings of the children of Ammon, whereby they have reproached my people, and magnified themselves against their border.

entries.yo: Nitorina bi emi ti wà, li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi, Ọlọrun Israeli, Dajudaju Moabu yio dabi Sodomu, ati awọn ọmọ Ammoni bi Gomorra, bi titàn wèrepe, ati bi ihò iyọ, ati ìdahoro titi lai, iyokù awọn enia mi o kó wọn, iyokù awọn orilẹ-ède mi yio si jogun wọn.
entries.en: Therefore as I live, saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, Surely Moab shall be as Sodom, and the children of Ammon as Gomorrah, even the breeding of nettles, and saltpits, and a perpetual desolation: the residue of my people shall spoil them, and the remnant of my people shall possess them.

entries.yo: Eyi ni nwọn o ni nitori igberaga wọn, nitoripe nwọn ti kẹgàn, nwọn si ti gbe ara wọn ga si enia Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun.
entries.en: This shall they have for their pride, because they have reproached and magnified themselves against the people of the LORD of hosts.

entries.yo: Oluwa yio jẹ ibẹ̀ru fun wọn: nitori on o mu ki gbogbo òriṣa ilẹ aiye ki o rù; enia yio si ma sìn i, olukuluku lati ipò rẹ̀ wá, ani gbogbo erekùṣu awọn keferi.
entries.en: The LORD will be terrible unto them: for he will famish all the gods of the earth; and men shall worship him, every one from his place, even all the isles of the heathen.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin ara Etiopia pẹlu, a o fi idà mi pa nyin.
entries.en: Ye Ethiopians also, ye shall be slain by my sword.

entries.yo: On o si nà ọwọ́ rẹ̀ si ihà ariwa, yio si pa Assiria run; yio si sọ Ninefe di ahoro, ati di gbigbẹ bi aginjù.
entries.en: And he will stretch out his hand against the north, and destroy Assyria; and will make Nineveh a desolation, and dry like a wilderness.

entries.yo: Agbo-ẹran yio si dùbulẹ li ãrin rẹ̀, gbogbo ẹranko awọn orilẹ-ède: ati ẹiyẹ òfu ati õrẹ̀ yio ma gbe atẹrigbà rẹ̀, ohùn wọn yio kọrin li oju fèrese; idahoro yio wà ninu iloro: nitoriti on o ṣi iṣẹ kedari silẹ.
entries.en: And flocks shall lie down in the midst of her, all the beasts of the nations: both the cormorant and the bittern shall lodge in the upper lintels of it; their voice shall sing in the windows; desolation shall be in the thresholds: for he shall uncover the cedar work.

entries.yo: Eyi ni ilu alayọ̀ na ti o ti joko lainani ti o wi li ọkàn rẹ̀ pe, Emi ni, kò si si ẹnikan ti mbẹ lẹhìn mi: on ha ti ṣe di ahoro bayi, ibùgbe fun ẹranko lati dubulẹ si! olukuluku ẹniti o ba kọja lọdọ rẹ̀ yio pòṣe yio si mì ọwọ́ rẹ̀.
entries.en: This is the rejoicing city that dwelt carelessly, that said in her heart, I am, and there is none beside me: how is she become a desolation, a place for beasts to lie down in! every one that passeth by her shall hiss, and wag his hand.

entries.yo: EGBE ni fun ọlọ̀tẹ ati alaimọ́, fun ilu aninilara nì.
entries.en: Woe to her that is filthy and polluted, to the oppressing city!

entries.yo: On kò fetisi ohùn na; on kò gba ẹkọ́; on kò gbẹkẹ̀le Oluwa; on kò sunmọ ọdọ Ọlọrun rẹ̀.
entries.en: She obeyed not the voice; she received not correction; she trusted not in the LORD; she drew not near to her God.

entries.yo: Awọn olori rẹ̀ ti o wà lãrin rẹ̀ kiniun ti nke ramùramù ni nwọn; awọn onidajọ rẹ̀ ikõkò aṣãlẹ ni nwọn; nwọn kò sán egungun titi di owurọ̀.
entries.en: Her princes within her are roaring lions; her judges are evening wolves; they gnaw not the bones till the morrow.

entries.yo: Awọn woli rẹ̀ gberaga, nwọn si jẹ ẹlẹtàn enia: awọn alufa rẹ̀ ti ba ibi mimọ́ jẹ: nwọn ti rú ofin.
entries.en: Her prophets are light and treacherous persons: her priests have polluted the sanctuary, they have done violence to the law.

entries.yo: Oluwa li olõtọ lãrin rẹ̀, kì yio ṣe buburu: li orowurọ̀ li o nmu idajọ rẹ̀ wá si imọlẹ, kì itase; ṣugbọn awọn alaiṣõtọ kò mọ itìju.
entries.en: The just LORD is in the midst thereof; he will not do iniquity: every morning doth he bring his judgment to light, he faileth not; but the unjust knoweth no shame.

entries.yo: Mo ti ke awọn orilẹ-ède kuro; ile giga wọn dahoro; mo sọ ita wọnni di ofo, tobẹ̃ ti ẹnikan kò kọja ihà ibẹ̀: a pa ilu wọnni run, tobẹ̃ ti kò si enia kan, ti kò si ẹniti ngbe ibẹ̀.
entries.en: I have cut off the nations: their towers are desolate; I made their streets waste, that none passeth by: their cities are destroyed, so that there is no man, that there is none inhabitant.

entries.yo: Emi wipe, Lõtọ iwọ o bẹ̀ru mi, iwọ o gba ẹkọ́; bẹ̃ni a kì ba ti ke ibujoko wọn kuro, bi o ti wù ki mo jẹ wọn ni iyà to: ṣugbọn nwọn dide ni kùtukùtu, nwọn ba gbogbo iṣẹ wọn jẹ.
entries.en: I said, Surely thou wilt fear me, thou wilt receive instruction; so their dwelling should not be cut off, howsoever I punished them: but they rose early, and corrupted all their doings.

entries.yo: Nitorina ẹ duro dè mi, ni Oluwa wi, titi di ọjọ na ti emi o dide si ohun-ọdẹ: nitori ipinnu mi ni lati kó awọn orilẹ-ède jọ, ki emi ki o le kó awọn ilẹ ọba jọ, lati dà irúnu mi si ori wọn, ani gbogbo ibinu mi gbigbona: nitori a o fi iná owu mi jẹ gbogbo aiye run.
entries.en: Therefore wait ye upon me, saith the LORD, until the day that I rise up to the prey: for my determination is to gather the nations, that I may assemble the kingdoms, to pour upon them mine indignation, even all my fierce anger: for all the earth shall be devoured with the fire of my jealousy.

entries.yo: Nitori nigbana li emi o yi ède mimọ́ si awọn enia, ki gbogbo wọn ki o le ma pè orukọ Oluwa, lati fi ọkàn kan sìn i.
entries.en: For then will I turn to the people a pure language, that they may all call upon the name of the LORD, to serve him with one consent.

entries.yo: Lati oke odò Etiopia awọn ẹlẹbẹ̀ mi, ani ọmọbinrin afunká mi, yio mu ọrẹ mi wá.
entries.en: From beyond the rivers of Ethiopia my suppliants, even the daughter of my dispersed, shall bring mine offering.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ na ni iwọ kì yio tijú, nitori gbogbo iṣe rẹ, ninu eyiti iwọ ti dẹṣẹ si mi: nitori nigbana li emi o mu awọn ti nyọ̀ ninu igberaga rẹ kuro lãrin rẹ, iwọ kì yio si gberaga mọ li oke mimọ́ mi.
entries.en: In that day shalt thou not be ashamed for all thy doings, wherein thou hast transgressed against me: for then I will take away out of the midst of thee them that rejoice in thy pride, and thou shalt no more be haughty because of my holy mountain.

entries.yo: Emi o fi awọn otòṣi ati talakà enia silẹ pẹlu lãrin rẹ, nwọn o si gbẹkẹ̀le orukọ Oluwa.
entries.en: I will also leave in the midst of thee an afflicted and poor people, and they shall trust in the name of the LORD.

entries.yo: Awọn iyokù Israeli kì yio hùwa ibi, bẹ̃ni nwọn kì yio sọ̀rọ eke, bẹ̃ni a kì yio ri ahọn arekerekè li ẹnu wọn: ṣugbọn nwọn o jẹun nwọn o si dubulẹ, ẹnikan kì yio si dẹ̀ruba wọn.
entries.en: The remnant of Israel shall not do iniquity, nor speak lies; neither shall a deceitful tongue be found in their mouth: for they shall feed and lie down, and none shall make them afraid.

entries.yo: Kọrin, iwọ ọmọbinrin Sioni; kigbe, iwọ Israeli; fi gbogbo ọkàn yọ̀, ki inu rẹ ki o si dùn, iwọ ọmọbinrin Jerusalemu.
entries.en: Sing, O daughter of Zion; shout, O Israel; be glad and rejoice with all the heart, O daughter of Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Oluwa ti mu idajọ rẹ wọnni kuro, o ti tì ọta rẹ jade: ọba Israeli, ani Oluwa, mbẹ lãrin rẹ: iwọ kì yio si ri ibi mọ.
entries.en: The LORD hath taken away thy judgments, he hath cast out thine enemy: the king of Israel, even the LORD, is in the midst of thee: thou shalt not see evil any more.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ na a o wi fun Jerusalemu pe, Iwọ má bẹ̀ru: ati fun Sioni pe, Má jẹ ki ọwọ́ rẹ ki o dẹ̀.
entries.en: In that day it shall be said to Jerusalem, Fear thou not: and to Zion, Let not thine hands be slack.

entries.yo: Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ li agbara li ãrin rẹ; yio gbà ni là, yio yọ̀ li ori rẹ fun ayọ̀; yio simi ninu ifẹ rẹ̀, yio fi orin yọ̀ li ori rẹ.
entries.en: The LORD thy God in the midst of thee is mighty; he will save, he will rejoice over thee with joy; he will rest in his love, he will joy over thee with singing.

entries.yo: Emi o kó awọn ti o banujẹ fun ajọ mimọ́ jọ awọn ti o jẹ tirẹ, fun awọn ti ẹgàn rẹ̀ jasi ẹrù.
entries.en: I will gather them that are sorrowful for the solemn assembly, who are of thee, to whom the reproach of it was a burden.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, nigbana li emi o ṣe awọn ti npọn ọ li oju: emi a gbà atiro là, emi o si ṣà ẹniti a le jade jọ; emi o si sọ wọn di ẹni iyìn ati olokìki ni gbogbo ilẹ ti a ti gàn wọn.
entries.en: Behold, at that time I will undo all that afflict thee: and I will save her that halteth, and gather her that was driven out; and I will get them praise and fame in every land where they have been put to shame.

entries.yo: Nigbana li emi o mu nyin padà wá, ani li akokò na li emi o ṣà nyin jọ: nitori emi o fi orukọ ati iyìn fun nyin lãrin gbogbo enia agbaiye, nigbati emi o yi igbèkun nyin padà li oju nyin, ni Oluwa wi.
entries.en: At that time will I bring you again, even in the time that I gather you: for I will make you a name and a praise among all people of the earth, when I turn back your captivity before your eyes, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: LI ọdun keji Dariusi ọba, li oṣù kẹfa, li ọjọ ekini oṣù na, ọ̀rọ Oluwa wá, nipa ọwọ Hagai woli, sọdọ Serubbabeli ọmọ Ṣealtieli, bãlẹ Juda, ati sọdọ Joṣua ọmọ Josedeki, olori alufa, wipe,
entries.en: In the second year of Darius the king, in the sixth month, in the first day of the month, came the word of the LORD by Haggai the prophet unto Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest, saying,

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi, Awọn enia wọnyi nsọ pe, Akokò kò ti ide, akokò ti a ba fi kọ́ ile Oluwa.
entries.en: Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts, saying, This people say, The time is not come, the time that the LORD's house should be built.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ọ̀rọ Oluwa wá nipa Hagai woli, wipe,
entries.en: Then came the word of the LORD by Haggai the prophet, saying,

entries.yo: Akokò ha ni fun nyin, ẹnyin, lati ma gbe ile ọṣọ nyin, ṣugbọn ile yi wà li ahoro?
entries.en: Is it time for you, O ye, to dwell in your cieled houses, and this house lie waste?

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi bayi li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wipe, Ẹ kiyesi ọ̀na nyin.
entries.en: Now therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts; Consider your ways.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin ti fọ́n irugbin pupọ̀, ẹ si mu diẹ wá ile; ẹnyin njẹ, ṣugbọn ẹnyin kò yo: ẹnyin nmu, ṣugbọn kò tẹ nyin lọrun; ẹnyin mbora, ṣugbọn kò si ẹniti o gboná; ẹniti o si ngbowo ọ̀ya ńgbà a sinu ajadi àpo.
entries.en: Ye have sown much, and bring in little; ye eat, but ye have not enough; ye drink, but ye are not filled with drink; ye clothe you, but there is none warm; and he that earneth wages earneth wages to put it into a bag with holes.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi: Ẹ kiyesi ọ̀na nyin.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Consider your ways.

entries.yo: Ẹ gùn ori oke-nla lọ, ẹ si mu igi wá, ki ẹ si kọ́ ile na; inu mi yio si dùn si i, a o si yìn mi logo, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: Go up to the mountain, and bring wood, and build the house; and I will take pleasure in it, and I will be glorified, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin tí nreti ọ̀pọ, ṣugbọn kiyesi i, diẹ ni; nigbati ẹnyin si mu u wá ile, mo si fẹ ẹ danù. Nitori kini? li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi. Nitori ti ile mi ti o dahoro; ti olukuluku nyin si nsare fun ile ara rẹ̀.
entries.en: Ye looked for much, and, lo, it came to little; and when ye brought it home, I did blow upon it. Why? saith the LORD of hosts. Because of mine house that is waste, and ye run every man unto his own house.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni a ṣe dá ìri ọrun duro lori nyin, a si da eso ilẹ duro.
entries.en: Therefore the heaven over you is stayed from dew, and the earth is stayed from her fruit.

entries.yo: Mo si ti pè ọdá sori ilẹ, ati sori oke-nla, ati sori ọkà ati sori ọti-waini titún, ati sori ororo, ati sori ohun ti ilẹ mu jade, ati sori enia, ati sori ẹran, ati sori gbogbo iṣẹ ọwọ ẹni.
entries.en: And I called for a drought upon the land, and upon the mountains, and upon the corn, and upon the new wine, and upon the oil, and upon that which the ground bringeth forth, and upon men, and upon cattle, and upon all the labour of the hands.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Serubbabeli ọmọ Ṣealtieli, ati Joṣua ọmọ Josedeki, olori alufa, pẹlu gbogbo enia iyokù, gba ohùn Oluwa Ọlọrun wọn gbọ́, ati ọ̀rọ Hagai woli, gẹgẹ bi Oluwa Ọlọrun wọn ti rán a, awọn enia si bẹ̀ru niwaju Oluwa.
entries.en: Then Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest, with all the remnant of the people, obeyed the voice of the LORD their God, and the words of Haggai the prophet, as the LORD their God had sent him, and the people did fear before the LORD.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Hagai iranṣẹ Oluwa jiṣẹ Oluwa fun awọn enia pe, Emi wà pẹlu nyin, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: Then spake Haggai the LORD's messenger in the LORD's message unto the people, saying, I am with you, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Oluwa si rú ẹ̀mi Serubbabeli ọmọ Ṣealtieli, bãlẹ Juda soke, ati ẹmi Joṣua ọmọ Josedeki, olori alufa, ati ẹmi gbogbo awọn enia iyokù; nwọn si wá nwọn si ṣiṣẹ ni ile Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun Ọlọrun wọn.
entries.en: And the LORD stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and the spirit of Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest, and the spirit of all the remnant of the people; and they came and did work in the house of the LORD of hosts, their God,

entries.yo: Li ọjọ kẹrinlelogun oṣù kẹfà, li ọdun keji Dariusi ọba.
entries.en: In the four and twentieth day of the sixth month, in the second year of Darius the king.

entries.yo: LI oṣù keje, li ọjọ kọkanlelogun oṣù na, ni ọ̀rọ Oluwa wá nipa ọwọ́ Hagai woli, wipe,
entries.en: In the seventh month, in the one and twentieth day of the month, came the word of the LORD by the prophet Haggai, saying,

entries.yo: Sọ nisisiyi fun Serubbabeli ọmọ Ṣealtieli, bãlẹ Juda, ati fun Joṣua, ọmọ Josedeki, olori alufa, ati fun awọn enia iyokù pe,
entries.en: Speak now to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest, and to the residue of the people, saying,

entries.yo: Tali o kù ninu nyin ti o ti ri ile yi li ogo rẹ̀ akọṣe? bawo li ẹnyin si ti ri i si nisisiyi? kò ha dàbi asan loju nyin bi a fi ṣe akawe rẹ̀?
entries.en: Who is left among you that saw this house in her first glory? and how do ye see it now? is it not in your eyes in comparison of it as nothing?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nisisiyi mura giri, Iwọ Serubbabeli, li Oluwa wi, ki o si mura giri, Iwọ Joṣua, ọmọ Josedeki, olori alufa; ẹ si mura giri gbogbo ẹnyin enia ilẹ na, li Oluwa wi, ki ẹ si ṣiṣẹ: nitori emi wà pẹlu nyin, li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi.
entries.en: Yet now be strong, O Zerubbabel, saith the LORD; and be strong, O Joshua, son of Josedech, the high priest; and be strong, all ye people of the land, saith the LORD, and work: for I am with you, saith the LORD of hosts:

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ ti mo ba nyin dá majẹmu nigbati ẹnyin ti Egipti jade wá, bẹ̃ni ẹmi mi wà lãrin nyin: ẹ máṣe bẹ̀ru.
entries.en: According to the word that I covenanted with you when ye came out of Egypt, so my spirit remaineth among you: fear ye not.

entries.yo: Nitori bayi ni Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi, pe, Ẹ̃kan ṣa, nigbà diẹ si i, li emi o mì awọn ọrun, ati aiye, ati okun, ati iyàngbẹ ilẹ.
entries.en: For thus saith the LORD of hosts; Yet once, it is a little while, and I will shake the heavens, and the earth, and the sea, and the dry land;

entries.yo: Emi o si mì gbogbo orilẹ-ède, ifẹ gbogbo orilẹ-ède yio si de: emi o si fi ogo kún ile yi, li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi.
entries.en: And I will shake all nations, and the desire of all nations shall come: and I will fill this house with glory, saith the LORD of hosts.

entries.yo: Temi ni fàdakà, temi si ni wurà, li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi.
entries.en: The silver is mine, and the gold is mine, saith the LORD of hosts.

entries.yo: Ogo ile ikẹhìn yi yio pọ̀ jù ti iṣãju lọ, li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi: nihinyi li emi o si fi alafia fun ni, li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi.
entries.en: The glory of this latter house shall be greater than of the former, saith the LORD of hosts: and in this place will I give peace, saith the LORD of hosts.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ ikẹrinlelogun oṣù kẹsan, li ọdun keji Dariusi, li ọ̀rọ Oluwa wá nipa Hagai woli, pe,
entries.en: In the four and twentieth day of the ninth month, in the second year of Darius, came the word of the LORD by Haggai the prophet, saying,

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi; bère ofin lọwọ awọn alufa nisisiyi, pe,
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Ask now the priests concerning the law, saying,

entries.yo: Bi ẹnikan ba rù ẹran mimọ́ ni iṣẹti aṣọ rẹ̀, ti o si fi iṣẹti aṣọ rẹ̀ kan àkara, tabi àṣaró, tabi ọti-waini, tabi ororo, tabi ẹrankẹran, yio ha jẹ mimọ́? Awọn alufa si dahùn wipe, Bẹ̃kọ.
entries.en: If one bear holy flesh in the skirt of his garment, and with his skirt do touch bread, or pottage, or wine, or oil, or any meat, shall it be holy? And the priests answered and said, No.

entries.yo: Hagai si wipe, Bi ẹnikan ti o ba jẹ alaimọ́ nipa okú ba fi ara kan ọkan ninu wọnyi, yio ha jẹ alaimọ́? Awọn alufa si dahùn wipe, Yio jẹ alaimọ́.
entries.en: Then said Haggai, If one that is unclean by a dead body touch any of these, shall it be unclean? And the priests answered and said, It shall be unclean.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Hagai dahùn o si wipe, Bẹ̃ni enia wọnyi ri, bẹ̃ si ni orilẹ-ède yi ri niwaju mi, li Oluwa wi; bẹ̃ si li olukuluku iṣẹ ọwọ wọn; eyiti nwọn si fi rubọ nibẹ̀ jẹ alaimọ́.
entries.en: Then answered Haggai, and said, So is this people, and so is this nation before me, saith the LORD; and so is every work of their hands; and that which they offer there is unclean.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, mo bẹ̀ nyin, ẹ rò lati oni yi de atẹhìnwa, ki a to fi okuta kan le ori ekeji ninu tempili Oluwa;
entries.en: And now, I pray you, consider from this day and upward, from before a stone was laid upon a stone in the temple of the LORD:

entries.yo: Lati ọjọ wọnni wá, nigbati ẹnikan bã de ibi ile ogun, mẹwa pere ni: nigbati ẹnikan ba de ibi ifunti lati bã gbọ́n ãdọta akoto ninu ifunti na, ogún pere ni.
entries.en: Since those days were, when one came to an heap of twenty measures, there were but ten: when one came to the pressfat for to draw out fifty vessels out of the press, there were but twenty.

entries.yo: Mo fi ìrẹdanù ati imúwòdu ati yìnyin lù nyin ninu gbogbo iṣẹ ọwọ nyin: ṣugbọn ẹnyin kò yipadà sọdọ mi, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: I smote you with blasting and with mildew and with hail in all the labours of your hands; yet ye turned not to me, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Nisisiyi ẹ rò lati oni lọ de atẹhìnwa, lati ọjọ ikẹrinlelogun oṣù kẹsan, ani lati ọjọ ti a ti fi ipilẹ tempili Oluwa sọlẹ, ro o.
entries.en: Consider now from this day and upward, from the four and twentieth day of the ninth month, even from the day that the foundation of the LORD's temple was laid, consider it.

entries.yo: Eso ha wà ninu abà bi? lõtọ, àjara, ati igi òpọtọ, ati pomegranate, ati igi olifi, kò iti so sibẹ̀sibẹ̀: lati oni lọ li emi o bukún fun nyin.
entries.en: Is the seed yet in the barn? yea, as yet the vine, and the fig tree, and the pomegranate, and the olive tree, hath not brought forth: from this day will I bless you.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ Oluwa si tún tọ̀ Hagai wá li ọjọ kẹrinlelogun oṣù na pe,
entries.en: And again the word of the LORD came unto Haggai in the four and twentieth day of the month, saying,

entries.yo: Sọ fun Serubbabeli, bãlẹ Juda, pe, emi o mì awọn ọrun ati aiye;
entries.en: Speak to Zerubbabel, governor of Judah, saying, I will shake the heavens and the earth;

entries.yo: Emi o si bì itẹ awọn ijọba ṣubu, emi o si pa agbara ijọba keferi run; emi o si doju awọn kẹkẹ́ de, ati awọn ti o gùn wọn; ati ẹṣin ati awọn ẹlẹṣin yio wá ilẹ; olukuluku nipa idà arakunrin rẹ̀.
entries.en: And I will overthrow the throne of kingdoms, and I will destroy the strength of the kingdoms of the heathen; and I will overthrow the chariots, and those that ride in them; and the horses and their riders shall come down, every one by the sword of his brother.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ na, li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi, li emi o mu ọ, Iwọ Serubbabeli, iranṣẹ mi, ọmọ Ṣealtieli, li Oluwa wi, emi o si sọ ọ di oruka edídi kan: nitoriti mo ti yàn ọ, li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi.
entries.en: In that day, saith the LORD of hosts, will I take thee, O Zerubbabel, my servant, the son of Shealtiel, saith the LORD, and will make thee as a signet: for I have chosen thee, saith the LORD of hosts.

entries.yo: LI oṣù kẹjọ, li ọdun keji Dariusi, li ọ̀rọ Oluwa tọ̀ Sekariah wá, ọmọ Berekiah ọmọ Iddo woli, pe,
entries.en: In the eighth month, in the second year of Darius, came the word of the LORD unto Zechariah, the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo the prophet, saying,

entries.yo: Oluwa ti binu pupọ̀ si awọn baba nyin.
entries.en: The LORD hath been sore displeased with your fathers.

entries.yo: Nitorina iwọ wi fun wọn pe, Bayi li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi; Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wipe, Ẹ yipadà si mi, emi o si yipadà si nyin, ni Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi.
entries.en: Therefore say thou unto them, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Turn ye unto me, saith the LORD of hosts, and I will turn unto you, saith the LORD of hosts.

entries.yo: Ẹ má dàbi awọn baba nyin, awọn ti awọn woli iṣãju ti ké si wipe, Bayi li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi; Ẹ yipadà nisisiyi kuro li ọ̀na buburu nyin, ati kuro ninu ìwa-buburu nyin: ṣugbọn nwọn kò gbọ́, bẹ̃ni nwọn kò fetisi ti emi, ni Oluwa wi.
entries.en: Be ye not as your fathers, unto whom the former prophets have cried, saying, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Turn ye now from your evil ways, and from your evil doings: but they did not hear, nor hearken unto me, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Awọn baba nyin, nibo ni nwọn wà? ati awọn woli, nwọn ha wà titi aiye?
entries.en: Your fathers, where are they? and the prophets, do they live for ever?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ọ̀rọ mi ati ilàna mi, ti mo pa li aṣẹ fun awọn iranṣẹ mi woli, nwọn kò ha fi mu awọn baba nyin? nwọn si padà nwọn wipe, Gẹgẹ bi Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun ti rò lati ṣe si wa, gẹgẹ bi ọ̀na wa, ati gẹgẹ bi iṣe wa, bẹ̃ni o ti ṣe si wa.
entries.en: But my words and my statutes, which I commanded my servants the prophets, did they not take hold of your fathers? and they returned and said, Like as the LORD of hosts thought to do unto us, according to our ways, and according to our doings, so hath he dealt with us.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ kẹrinlelogun oṣù kọkanla, ti iṣe oṣù Sebati, li ọdun keji Dariusi, li ọ̀rọ Oluwa tọ̀ Sekariah, ọmọ Berekiah ọmọ Iddo woli wá, pe,
entries.en: Upon the four and twentieth day of the eleventh month, which is the month Sebat, in the second year of Darius, came the word of the LORD unto Zechariah, the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo the prophet, saying,

entries.yo: Mo ri li oru, si wò o, ọkunrin kan ngun ẹṣin pupa kan, on si duro lãrin awọn igi mirtili ti o wà ni ibi õji; lẹhìn rẹ̀ si li ẹṣin pupa, adíkalà, ati funfun gbe wà.
entries.en: I saw by night, and behold a man riding upon a red horse, and he stood among the myrtle trees that were in the bottom; and behind him were there red horses, speckled, and white.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni mo wipe, Kini wọnyi oluwa mi? Angeli ti mba mi sọ̀rọ si wi fun mi pe, emi o fi ohun ti wọnyi jẹ hàn ọ.
entries.en: Then said I, O my lord, what are these? And the angel that talked with me said unto me, I will shew thee what these be.

entries.yo: Ọkunrin ti o duro lãrin awọn igi mirtili si dahùn o si wipe, Wọnyi li awọn ti Oluwa ti rán lati ma rìn sokè sodò li aiye.
entries.en: And the man that stood among the myrtle trees answered and said, These are they whom the LORD hath sent to walk to and fro through the earth.

entries.yo: Nwọn si da angeli Oluwa ti o duro lãrin awọn igi mirtili na lohùn pe, Awa ti rìn sokè sodò já aiye, si kiyesi i, gbogbo aiye wà ni isimi, o si duro jẹ.
entries.en: And they answered the angel of the LORD that stood among the myrtle trees, and said, We have walked to and fro through the earth, and, behold, all the earth sitteth still, and is at rest.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni angeli Oluwa na dahùn o si wipe, Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun, yio ti pẹ to ti iwọ kì yio fi ṣãnu fun Jerusalemu, ati fun awọn ilu-nla Juda, ti iwọ ti binu si li ãdọrin ọdun wọnyi?
entries.en: Then the angel of the LORD answered and said, O LORD of hosts, how long wilt thou not have mercy on Jerusalem and on the cities of Judah, against which thou hast had indignation these threescore and ten years?

entries.yo: Oluwa si fi ọ̀rọ rere ati ọ̀rọ itùnu da angeli ti mba mi sọ̀rọ lohùn.
entries.en: And the LORD answered the angel that talked with me with good words and comfortable words.

entries.yo: Angeli ti mba mi sọ̀rọ si wi fun mi pe, Iwọ kigbe wipe, Bayi li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi; emi nfi ijowu nla jowu fun Jerusalemu ati fun Sioni.
entries.en: So the angel that communed with me said unto me, Cry thou, saying, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; I am jealous for Jerusalem and for Zion with a great jealousy.

entries.yo: Emi si binu pupọ̀pupọ̀ si awọn orilẹ-ède ti o gbe jẹ: nitoripe emi ti binu diẹ, nwọn si ti kún buburu na lọwọ.
entries.en: And I am very sore displeased with the heathen that are at ease: for I was but a little displeased, and they helped forward the affliction.

entries.yo: Nitorina bayi li Oluwa wi; mo padà tọ̀ Jerusalemu wá pẹlu ãnu; Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wipe, a o kọ ile mi sinu rẹ̀, a o si ta okùn kan jade sori Jerusalemu.
entries.en: Therefore thus saith the LORD; I am returned to Jerusalem with mercies: my house shall be built in it, saith the LORD of hosts, and a line shall be stretched forth upon Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Ma ke sibẹ̀ pe, Bayi li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi; A o ma fi ire kún ilu-nla mi sibẹ̀; Oluwa yio si ma tù Sioni ninu sibẹ̀, yio si yàn Jerusalemu sibẹ̀.
entries.en: Cry yet, saying, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; My cities through prosperity shall yet be spread abroad; and the LORD shall yet comfort Zion, and shall yet choose Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Mo si gbe oju mi soke, mo si ri, si kiyesi i, iwo mẹrin.
entries.en: Then lifted I up mine eyes, and saw, and behold four horns.

entries.yo: Mo si sọ fun angeli ti o ba mi sọ̀rọ pe, Kini wọnyi? O si da mi lohùn pe, Awọn wọnyi ni iwo ti o ti tú Juda, Israeli, ati Jerusalemu ka.
entries.en: And I said unto the angel that talked with me, What be these? And he answered me, These are the horns which have scattered Judah, Israel, and Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Oluwa si fi gbẹnàgbẹnà mẹrin kan hàn mi.
entries.en: And the LORD shewed me four carpenters.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni mo wipe, kini awọn wọnyi wá ṣe? O si sọ wipe, Awọn wọnyi ni iwo ti o ti tú Juda ka, tobẹ̃ ti ẹnikẹni kò fi gbe ori rẹ̀ soke? ṣugbọn awọn wọnyi wá lati dẹruba wọn, lati le iwo awọn orilẹ-ède jade, ti nwọn gbe iwo wọn sori ilẹ Juda lati tu u ka.
entries.en: Then said I, What come these to do? And he spake, saying, These are the horns which have scattered Judah, so that no man did lift up his head: but these are come to fray them, to cast out the horns of the Gentiles, which lifted up their horn over the land of Judah to scatter it.

entries.yo: MO si tun gbe oju mi soke, mo si wò, si kiyesi i, ọkunrin kan ti on ti okùn-iwọ̀n lọwọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: I lifted up mine eyes again, and looked, and behold a man with a measuring line in his hand.

entries.yo: Mo si wipe, Nibo ni iwọ nlọ? o si wi fun mi pe, Lati wọ̀n Jerusalemu, lati ri iye ibú rẹ̀, ati iye gigùn rẹ̀.
entries.en: Then said I, Whither goest thou? And he said unto me, To measure Jerusalem, to see what is the breadth thereof, and what is the length thereof.

entries.yo: Si kiyesi i, angeli ti o mba mi sọ̀rọ jade lọ, angeli miran si jade lọ ipade rẹ̀.
entries.en: And, behold, the angel that talked with me went forth, and another angel went out to meet him,

entries.yo: O si wi fun u pe, Sare, sọ fun ọdọmọkunrin yi wipe, a o gbe inu Jerusalemu bi ilu ti kò ni odi nitori ọ̀pọ enia ati ohun-ọsìn inu rẹ̀:
entries.en: And said unto him, Run, speak to this young man, saying, Jerusalem shall be inhabited as towns without walls for the multitude of men and cattle therein:

entries.yo: Oluwa wipe, Emi o si jẹ odi iná fun u yika, emi o si jẹ ogo lãrin rẹ̀.
entries.en: For I, saith the LORD, will be unto her a wall of fire round about, and will be the glory in the midst of her.

entries.yo: Ã! ã! sá kuro ni ilẹ ariwa, ni Oluwa wi; nitoripe bi afẹfẹ mẹrin ọrun ni mo tu nyin kakiri, ni Oluwa wi.
entries.en: Ho, ho, come forth, and flee from the land of the north, saith the LORD: for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the heaven, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Sioni, gba ara rẹ là, iwọ ti o mba ọmọbinrin Babiloni gbe.
entries.en: Deliver thyself, O Zion, that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon.

entries.yo: Nitori bayi ni Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi; lẹhìn ogo li o ti rán mi si awọn orilẹ-ède ti nkó nyin: nitori ẹniti o tọ́ nyin, o tọ́ ọmọ oju rẹ̀.
entries.en: For thus saith the LORD of hosts; After the glory hath he sent me unto the nations which spoiled you: for he that toucheth you toucheth the apple of his eye.

entries.yo: Nitori kiyesi i, emi o gbọ̀n ọwọ mi si ori wọn, nwọn o si jẹ ikogun fun iranṣẹ wọn: ẹnyin o si mọ̀ pe, Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun li o rán mi.
entries.en: For, behold, I will shake mine hand upon them, and they shall be a spoil to their servants: and ye shall know that the LORD of hosts hath sent me.

entries.yo: Kọrin ki o si yọ̀, iwọ ọmọbinrin Sioni: sa wò o, mo de, emi o si gbe ãrin rẹ, ni Oluwa wi.
entries.en: Sing and rejoice, O daughter of Zion: for, lo, I come, and I will dwell in the midst of thee, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Ọ̀pọlọpọ orilẹ-ède ni yio dapọ̀ mọ Oluwa li ọjọ na, nwọn o si di enia mi; emi o si gbe ãrin rẹ, iwọ o si mọ̀ pe, Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun li o rán mi si ọ.
entries.en: And many nations shall be joined to the LORD in that day, and shall be my people: and I will dwell in the midst of thee, and thou shalt know that the LORD of hosts hath sent me unto thee.

entries.yo: Oluwa o si jogún Juda iní rẹ̀, nilẹ̀ mimọ́, yio si tun yàn Jerusalemu.
entries.en: And the LORD shall inherit Judah his portion in the holy land, and shall choose Jerusalem again.

entries.yo: Ẹ dakẹ, gbogbo ẹran-ara niwaju Oluwa: nitori a ji i lati ibùgbe mimọ́ rẹ̀ wá.
entries.en: Be silent, O all flesh, before the LORD: for he is raised up out of his holy habitation.

entries.yo: O sì fi Joṣua olori alufa hàn mi, o duro niwaju angeli Oluwa, Satani si duro lọwọ ọtun rẹ̀ lati kọju ijà si i.
entries.en: And he shewed me Joshua the high priest standing before the angel of the LORD, and Satan standing at his right hand to resist him.

entries.yo: Oluwa si wi fun Satani pe, Oluwa ba ọ wi, iwọ Satani; ani Oluwa ti o ti yàn Jerusalemu, o ba ọ wi: igi iná kọ eyi ti a mu kuro ninu iná?
entries.en: And the LORD said unto Satan, The LORD rebuke thee, O Satan; even the LORD that hath chosen Jerusalem rebuke thee: is not this a brand plucked out of the fire?

entries.yo: A si wọ̀ Joṣua li aṣọ ẽri, o si duro niwaju angeli na.
entries.en: Now Joshua was clothed with filthy garments, and stood before the angel.

entries.yo: O si dahùn o wi fun awọn ti o duro niwaju rẹ̀ pe, Bọ aṣọ ẽri nì kuro li ara rẹ̀. O si wi fun u pe, Wò o, mo mu ki aiṣedẽde rẹ kuro lọdọ rẹ, emi o si wọ̀ ọ li aṣọ ẹyẹ.
entries.en: And he answered and spake unto those that stood before him, saying, Take away the filthy garments from him. And unto him he said, Behold, I have caused thine iniquity to pass from thee, and I will clothe thee with change of raiment.

entries.yo: Mo si wipe, Jẹ ki wọn fi lawàni mimọ́ wé e li ori. Nwọn si fi lawàni mimọ́ wé e lori, nwọn si fi aṣọ wọ̀ ọ. Angeli Oluwa si duro tì i.
entries.en: And I said, Let them set a fair mitre upon his head. So they set a fair mitre upon his head, and clothed him with garments. And the angel of the LORD stood by.

entries.yo: Angeli Oluwa si tẹnu mọ fun Joṣua pe,
entries.en: And the angel of the LORD protested unto Joshua, saying,

entries.yo: Bayi ni Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi; bi iwọ o ba rìn li ọ̀na mi, bi iwọ o ba si pa aṣẹ mi mọ, iwọ o si ṣe idajọ ile mi pẹlu, iwọ o si pa ãfin mi mọ pẹlu, emi o si fun ọ li àye ati rìn lãrin awọn ti o duro yi.
