entries.en: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; If thou wilt walk in my ways, and if thou wilt keep my charge, then thou shalt also judge my house, and shalt also keep my courts, and I will give thee places to walk among these that stand by.

entries.yo: Gbọ́ na, iwọ Joṣua olori alufa, iwọ, ati awọn ẹgbẹ́ rẹ ti o joko niwaju rẹ: nitori ẹni iyanu ni nwọn: nitori kiyesi i, emi o mu iranṣẹ mi, ẸKA, wá.
entries.en: Hear now, O Joshua the high priest, thou, and thy fellows that sit before thee: for they are men wondered at: for, behold, I will bring forth my servant the BRANCH.

entries.yo: Nitori kiyesi i, okuta ti mo ti gbe kalẹ niwaju Joṣua; lori okuta kan ni oju meje o wà: kiyesi i, emi o fin finfin rẹ̀, ni Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi, emi o si mu aiṣedẽde ilẹ na kuro ni ijọ kan.
entries.en: For behold the stone that I have laid before Joshua; upon one stone shall be seven eyes: behold, I will engrave the graving thereof, saith the LORD of hosts, and I will remove the iniquity of that land in one day.

entries.yo: Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wipe, ni ọjọ na ni olukuluku yio pe ẹnikeji rẹ̀ sabẹ igi àjara ati sabẹ igi ọpọ̀tọ.
entries.en: In that day, saith the LORD of hosts, shall ye call every man his neighbour under the vine and under the fig tree.

entries.yo: ANGELI ti o mba mi sọ̀rọ si tún de, o si ji mi, bi ọkunrin ti a ji lati oju orun rẹ̀,
entries.en: And the angel that talked with me came again, and waked me, as a man that is wakened out of his sleep,

entries.yo: O si wi fun mi pe, Kini iwọ ri? Mo si wipe, mo wò, si kiyesi i, ọ̀pa fitilà ti gbogbo rẹ̀ jẹ wurà, pẹlu kòjo rẹ̀ lori rẹ̀, pẹlu fitilà meje rẹ̀ lori rẹ̀, ati àrọ meje fun fitilà mejeje, ti o wà lori rẹ̀:
entries.en: And said unto me, What seest thou? And I said, I have looked, and behold a candlestick all of gold, with a bowl upon the top of it, and his seven lamps thereon, and seven pipes to the seven lamps, which are upon the top thereof:

entries.yo: Igi olifi meji si wà leti rẹ̀, ọkan li apa ọtun kòjo na, ati ekeji li apa osì rẹ̀.
entries.en: And two olive trees by it, one upon the right side of the bowl, and the other upon the left side thereof.

entries.yo: Mo si dahùn mo si wi fun angeli ti o mba mi sọ̀rọ, pe, Kini wọnyi, Oluwa mi?
entries.en: So I answered and spake to the angel that talked with me, saying, What are these, my lord?

entries.yo: Angeli ti o mba mi sọ̀rọ dahùn o si wi fun mi pe, Iwọ kò mọ̀ ohun ti awọn wọnyi jasi? Mo si wipe, Nkò mọ̀, oluwa mi.
entries.en: Then the angel that talked with me answered and said unto me, Knowest thou not what these be? And I said, No, my lord.

entries.yo: O si dahùn o si wi fun mi pe, Eyi ni ọ̀rọ Oluwa si Serubbabeli wipe, Kì iṣe nipa ipá, kì iṣe nipa agbara, bikoṣe nipa Ẹmi mi, ni Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi.
entries.en: Then he answered and spake unto me, saying, This is the word of the LORD unto Zerubbabel, saying, Not by might, nor by power, but by my spirit, saith the LORD of hosts.

entries.yo: Tani iwọ, Iwọ oke nla? iwọ o di pẹ̀tẹlẹ niwaju Serubbabeli: on o si fi ariwo mu okuta tenté ori rẹ̀ wá, yio ma kigbe wipe, Ore-ọfẹ, ore-ọfẹ si i.
entries.en: Who art thou, O great mountain? before Zerubbabel thou shalt become a plain: and he shall bring forth the headstone thereof with shoutings, crying, Grace, grace unto it.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ Oluwa si tọ̀ mi wá, wipe,
entries.en: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

entries.yo: Ọwọ Serubbabeli li o pilẹ ile yi; ọwọ rẹ̀ ni yio si pari rẹ̀; iwọ o si mọ̀ pe, Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun li o rán mi si nyin.
entries.en: The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this house; his hands shall also finish it; and thou shalt know that the LORD of hosts hath sent me unto you.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn tani ha kẹgàn ọjọ ohun kekere? nitori nwọn o yọ̀, nwọn o si ri iwọ̀n lọwọ Serubbabeli pẹlu meje wọnni; awọn ni oju Oluwa, ti o nsare sihin sọhun ni gbogbo aiye.
entries.en: For who hath despised the day of small things? for they shall rejoice, and shall see the plummet in the hand of Zerubbabel with those seven; they are the eyes of the LORD, which run to and fro through the whole earth.

entries.yo: Mo si dahun, mo si sọ fun u pe, Kini awọn igi olifi meji wọnyi jasi, ti o wà li apá ọtun fitilà ati li apá osì rẹ̀?
entries.en: Then answered I, and said unto him, What are these two olive trees upon the right side of the candlestick and upon the left side thereof?

entries.yo: Mo si tún dahùn, mo si sọ fun u pe, Kini awọn ẹka meji igi olifi wọnyi jasi, ti ntú ororo wurà jade lori wọn lati inu ikòko wurà.
entries.en: And I answered again, and said unto him, What be these two olive branches which through the two golden pipes empty the golden oil out of themselves?

entries.yo: O si dahùn, o wi fun mi pe, Iwọ kò mọ̀ ohun ti awọn wọnyi jasi? Mo si wipe, N kò mọ̀, oluwa mi.
entries.en: And he answered me and said, Knowest thou not what these be? And I said, No, my lord.

entries.yo: O si wipe, Awọn meji wọnyi ni awọn ti a fi ororo yàn, ti o duro tì Oluwa gbogbo aiye.
entries.en: Then said he, These are the two anointed ones, that stand by the LORD of the whole earth.

entries.yo: NIGBANA ni mo yipadà, mo si gbe oju mi soke, mo si wò, si kiyesi i, iwe-kiká ti nfò.
entries.en: Then I turned, and lifted up mine eyes, and looked, and behold a flying roll.

entries.yo: O si wi fun mi pe, Kini iwọ ri? Emi si dahùn pe, mo ri iwe-kiká ti nfò; gigùn rẹ̀ jẹ ogún igbọnwọ, ibú rẹ̀ si jẹ igbọnwọ mẹwa.
entries.en: And he said unto me, What seest thou? And I answered, I see a flying roll; the length thereof is twenty cubits, and the breadth thereof ten cubits.

entries.yo: O si wi fun mi pe, Eyi ni ègun ti o jade lọ si gbogbo ilẹ aiye: nitori gbogbo awọn ti o ba jale ni a o ke kuro lati ihin lọ nipa rẹ̀; gbogbo awọn ti o ba si bura ni a o ke kuro lati ihin lọ nipa rẹ̀.
entries.en: Then said he unto me, This is the curse that goeth forth over the face of the whole earth: for every one that stealeth shall be cut off as on this side according to it; and every one that sweareth shall be cut off as on that side according to it.

entries.yo: Emi o mu u jade, ni Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi, yio si wọ̀ inu ile olè lọ, ati inu ile ẹniti o ba fi orukọ mi bura eke: yio si wà li ãrin ile rẹ̀, yio si run u pẹlu igi ati okuta inu rẹ̀.
entries.en: I will bring it forth, saith the LORD of hosts, and it shall enter into the house of the thief, and into the house of him that sweareth falsely by my name: and it shall remain in the midst of his house, and shall consume it with the timber thereof and the stones thereof.

entries.yo: Angeli ti mba mi sọ̀rọ si jade lọ, o si wi fun mi pe, Gbe oju rẹ si oke nisisiyi, ki o si wò nkan yi ti o jade lọ.
entries.en: Then the angel that talked with me went forth, and said unto me, Lift up now thine eyes, and see what is this that goeth forth.

entries.yo: Mo si wipe, Kini nì? O si wipe, Eyi ni òṣuwọn efà ti o jade lọ. O si wipe, Eyi ni àworan ni gbogbo ilẹ aiye.
entries.en: And I said, What is it? And he said, This is an ephah that goeth forth. He said moreover, This is their resemblance through all the earth.

entries.yo: Si kiyesi i, a gbe talenti ojé soke: obinrin kan si niyi ti o joko si ãrin òṣuwọn efa.
entries.en: And, behold, there was lifted up a talent of lead: and this is a woman that sitteth in the midst of the ephah.

entries.yo: O si wipe, Eyi ni ìwa-buburu. O si jù u si ãrin òṣuwọn efa: o si jù òṣuwọn ojé si ẹnu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he said, This is wickedness. And he cast it into the midst of the ephah; and he cast the weight of lead upon the mouth thereof.

entries.yo: Mo si gbe oju mi soke, mo si wò, si kiyesi i, obinrin meji jade wá, ẹfũfu si wà ninu iyẹ wọn; nitori nwọn ni iyẹ bi iyẹ àkọ: nwọn si gbe òṣuwọn efa na de agbedemeji aiye on ọrun.
entries.en: Then lifted I up mine eyes, and looked, and, behold, there came out two women, and the wind was in their wings; for they had wings like the wings of a stork: and they lifted up the ephah between the earth and the heaven.

entries.yo: Mo si sọ fun angeli ti o mba mi sọ̀rọ pe, Nibo ni awọn wọnyi ngbe òṣuwọn efa na lọ?
entries.en: Then said I to the angel that talked with me, Whither do these bear the ephah?

entries.yo: O si wi fun mi pe, Lati kọ́ ọ ni ile ni ilẹ Ṣinari: a o si fi idi rẹ̀ mulẹ, a o si fi ka ori ipilẹ rẹ̀ nibẹ̀.
entries.en: And he said unto me, To build it an house in the land of Shinar: and it shall be established, and set there upon her own base.

entries.yo: MO si yipadà, mo si gbe oju mi soke, mo si wò, si kiyesi i, kẹkẹ́ mẹrin jade wá lati ãrin oke-nla meji; awọn oke-nla na si jẹ oke-nla idẹ.
entries.en: And I turned, and lifted up mine eyes, and looked, and, behold, there came four chariots out from between two mountains; and the mountains were mountains of brass.

entries.yo: Awọn ẹṣin pupa wà ni kẹkẹ́ ekini; ati awọn ẹṣin dudu ni kẹkẹ́ keji;
entries.en: In the first chariot were red horses; and in the second chariot black horses;

entries.yo: Ati awọn ẹṣin funfun ni kẹkẹ́ kẹta; ati awọn adikalà ati alagbara ẹṣin ni kẹkẹ́ kẹrin.
entries.en: And in the third chariot white horses; and in the fourth chariot grisled and bay horses.

entries.yo: Mo si dahùn mo si wi fun angeli ti mba mi sọ̀rọ pe, Kini wọnyi, oluwa mi?
entries.en: Then I answered and said unto the angel that talked with me, What are these, my lord?

entries.yo: Angeli na si dahùn o si wi fun mi pe, Wọnyi ni awọn ẹmi mẹrin ti ọrun, ti njade lọ kuro ni iduro niwaju Oluwa gbogbo aiye.
entries.en: And the angel answered and said unto me, These are the four spirits of the heavens, which go forth from standing before the Lord of all the earth.

entries.yo: Awọn ẹṣin dudu ti o wà ninu rẹ̀ jade lọ si ilẹ ariwa; awọn funfun si jade tẹ̀le wọn; awọn adíkalà si jade lọ si ihà ilẹ gusù.
entries.en: The black horses which are therein go forth into the north country; and the white go forth after them; and the grisled go forth toward the south country.

entries.yo: Awọn alagbara ẹṣin si jade lọ, nwọn si nwá ọ̀na ati lọ ki nwọn ba le rìn sihin sọhun li aiye; o si wipe, Ẹ lọ, ẹ lọ irìn sihin sọhun li aiye. Nwọn si rìn sihin sọhun li aiye.
entries.en: And the bay went forth, and sought to go that they might walk to and fro through the earth: and he said, Get you hence, walk to and fro through the earth. So they walked to and fro through the earth.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni on si kọ́ si mi, o si ba mi sọ̀rọ, wipe, Wò o, awọn wọnyi ti o lọ sihà ilẹ ariwa ti mu ẹmi mi parọrọ ni ilẹ ariwa.
entries.en: Then cried he upon me, and spake unto me, saying, Behold, these that go toward the north country have quieted my spirit in the north country.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ Oluwa si tọ̀ mi wá, wipe,
entries.en: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

entries.yo: Mu ninu igbèkun, ninu awọn ti Heldai, ti Tobijah, ati ti Jedaiah, ti o ti Babiloni de, ki iwọ si wá li ọjọ kanna, ki o si wọ ile Josiah ọmọ Sefaniah lọ;
entries.en: Take of them of the captivity, even of Heldai, of Tobijah, and of Jedaiah, which are come from Babylon, and come thou the same day, and go into the house of Josiah the son of Zephaniah;

entries.yo: Ki o si mu fàdakà ati wurà, ki o si fi ṣe ade pupọ̀, ki o si gbe wọn kà ori Joṣua ọmọ Josedeki, olori alufa:
entries.en: Then take silver and gold, and make crowns, and set them upon the head of Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest;

entries.yo: Si sọ fun u pe, Bayi ni Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun sọ wipe, Wò ọkunrin na ti orukọ rẹ̀ njẹ ẸKA; yio si yọ ẹka lati abẹ rẹ̀ wá, yio si kọ́ tempili Oluwa;
entries.en: And speak unto him, saying, Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts, saying, Behold the man whose name is The BRANCH; and he shall grow up out of his place, and he shall build the temple of the LORD:

entries.yo: On ni yio si kọ́ tempili Oluwa; on ni yio si rù ogo, yio si joko yio si jọba lori itẹ rẹ̀; on o si jẹ alufa lori itẹ̀ rẹ̀; ìmọ alafia yio si wà lãrin awọn mejeji.
entries.en: Even he shall build the temple of the LORD; and he shall bear the glory, and shall sit and rule upon his throne; and he shall be a priest upon his throne: and the counsel of peace shall be between them both.

entries.yo: Ade wọnni yio si wà fun Helemu, ati fun Tobijah, ati fun Jedaiah, ati fun Heni, ọmọ Sefaniah, fun iranti ni tempili Oluwa.
entries.en: And the crowns shall be to Helem, and to Tobijah, and to Jedaiah, and to Hen the son of Zephaniah, for a memorial in the temple of the LORD.

entries.yo: Awọn ti o jìna rére yio wá ikọle ni tempili Oluwa, ẹnyin o si mọ̀ pe, Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun ti rán mi si nyin. Yio si ri bẹ, bi ẹnyin o ba gbà ohùn Oluwa Ọlọrun nyin gbọ́ nitõtọ.
entries.en: And they that are far off shall come and build in the temple of the LORD, and ye shall know that the LORD of hosts hath sent me unto you. And this shall come to pass, if ye will diligently obey the voice of the LORD your God.

entries.yo: O si ṣe li ọdun kẹrin Dariusi ọba, ọ̀rọ Oluwa tọ̀ Sekariah wá ni ijọ kẹrin oṣù kẹsan, Kislefi;
entries.en: And it came to pass in the fourth year of king Darius, that the word of the LORD came unto Zechariah in the fourth day of the ninth month, even in Chisleu;

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn rán Ṣereṣeri ati Regemmeleki, ati awọn enia wọn si ile Ọlọrun lati wá oju rere Oluwa.
entries.en: When they had sent unto the house of God Sherezer and Regem-melech, and their men, to pray before the LORD,

entries.yo: Ati lati bá awọn alufa ti o wà ni ile Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun, ati awọn woli sọ̀rọ, wipe, Ki emi ha sọkun li oṣù karun, ki emi ya ara mi sọtọ, bi mo ti nṣe lati ọdun melo wonyi wá?
entries.en: And to speak unto the priests which were in the house of the LORD of hosts, and to the prophets, saying, Should I weep in the fifth month, separating myself, as I have done these so many years?

entries.yo: Nigbana li ọ̀rọ Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun tọ̀ mi wá wipe,
entries.en: Then came the word of the LORD of hosts unto me, saying,

entries.yo: Sọ fun gbogbo awọn enia ilẹ na, ati fun awọn alufa, wipe, Nigbati ẹnyin gbawẹ̀ ti ẹ si ṣọ̀fọ li oṣù karun ati keje, ani fun ãdọrin ọdun wọnni, ẹnyin ha gbawẹ̀ si mi rara, ani si emi?
entries.en: Speak unto all the people of the land, and to the priests, saying, When ye fasted and mourned in the fifth and seventh month, even those seventy years, did ye at all fast unto me, even to me?

entries.yo: Nigbati ẹ si jẹ, ati nigbati ẹ mu, fun ara nyin ki ẹnyin ha jẹ, ati fun ara nyin ki ẹnyin ha mu?
entries.en: And when ye did eat, and when ye did drink, did not ye eat for yourselves, and drink for yourselves?

entries.yo: Wọnyi kì ọ̀rọ ti Oluwa ti kigbe lati ọdọ awọn woli iṣãju wá, nigbati a ngbe Jerusalemu, ti o si wà li alafia, pẹlu awọn ilu rẹ̀ ti o yi i ka kiri, nigbati a ngbe gusù ati pẹtẹlẹ?
entries.en: Should ye not hear the words which the LORD hath cried by the former prophets, when Jerusalem was inhabited and in prosperity, and the cities thereof round about her, when men inhabited the south and the plain?

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ Oluwa si tọ̀ Sekariah wá, wipe,
entries.en: And the word of the LORD came unto Zechariah, saying,

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun sọ wipe, Dá idajọ otitọ, ki ẹ si ṣe ãnu ati iyọ́nu olukuluku si arakunrin rẹ̀.
entries.en: Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts, saying, Execute true judgment, and shew mercy and compassions every man to his brother:

entries.yo: Má si ṣe ni opó lara, tabi alainibaba, alejo, tabi talakà; ki ẹnikẹni ninu nyin ki o máṣe gbèro ibi li ọkàn si arakunrin rẹ̀.
entries.en: And oppress not the widow, nor the fatherless, the stranger, nor the poor; and let none of you imagine evil against his brother in your heart.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nwọn kọ̀ lati gbọ́, nwọn si gùn ejika, nwọn si di eti wọn, ki nwọn ki o má bà gbọ́.
entries.en: But they refused to hearken, and pulled away the shoulder, and stopped their ears, that they should not hear.

entries.yo: Ani nwọn ṣe aiya wọn bi okuta adamanti, ki nwọn ki o má ba gbọ́ ofin, ati ọ̀rọ ti Ọluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun ti fi ẹmi rẹ̀ rán nipa ọwọ awọn woli iṣãju wá: ibinu nla si de lati ọdọ Ọluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wá.
entries.en: Yea, they made their hearts as an adamant stone, lest they should hear the law, and the words which the LORD of hosts hath sent in his spirit by the former prophets: therefore came a great wrath from the LORD of hosts.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, gẹgẹ bi o ti kigbe, ti nwọn kò si fẹ igbọ́, bẹ̃ni nwọn kigbe, ti emi kò si fẹ igbọ́, li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi.
entries.en: Therefore it is come to pass, that as he cried, and they would not hear; so they cried, and I would not hear, saith the LORD of hosts:

entries.yo: Mo si fi ãja tú wọn ka si gbogbo orilẹ-ède ti nwọn kò mọ̀. Ilẹ na si dahoro lẹhin wọn, ti ẹnikẹni kò là a kọja tabi ki o pada bọ̀: nwọn si sọ ilẹ ãyò na dahoro.
entries.en: But I scattered them with a whirlwind among all the nations whom they knew not. Thus the land was desolate after them, that no man passed through nor returned: for they laid the pleasant land desolate.

entries.yo: Ọ̀RỌ Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun si tun tọ̀ mi wá, wipe,
entries.en: Again the word of the LORD of hosts came to me, saying,

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi; owu nlanla ni mo jẹ fun Sioni, ikannu nlanla ni mo fi jowu fun u.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; I was jealous for Zion with great jealousy, and I was jealous for her with great fury.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa wi; Mo ti yipada si Sioni emi o si gbe ãrin Jerusalemu: a o si pè Jerusalemu ni ilu nla otitọ; ati oke nla Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun, okenla mimọ́ nì.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD; I am returned unto Zion, and will dwell in the midst of Jerusalem: and Jerusalem shall be called a city of truth; and the mountain of the LORD of hosts the holy mountain.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi, arugbo ọkunrin ati arugbo obinrin, yio sa gbe igboro Jerusalemu, ati olukuluku ti on ti ọ̀pa li ọwọ rẹ̀ fun ogbó.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; There shall yet old men and old women dwell in the streets of Jerusalem, and every man with his staff in his hand for very age.

entries.yo: Igboro ilu yio si kún fun ọmọdekunrin, ati ọmọdebinrin, ti nṣire ni ita wọn.
entries.en: And the streets of the city shall be full of boys and girls playing in the streets thereof.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi pe, bi o ba ṣe iyanu li oju iyokù awọn enia yi li ọjọ wọnyi, iba jẹ iyanu li oju mi pẹlu bi? li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; If it be marvellous in the eyes of the remnant of this people in these days, should it also be marvellous in mine eyes? saith the LORD of hosts.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi pe, Kiye si i, emi o gbà awọn enia mi kuro ni ilẹ ila-õrun, ati kuro ni ilẹ yama;
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Behold, I will save my people from the east country, and from the west country;

entries.yo: Emi o si mu wọn wá, nwọn o si ma gbe ãrin Jerusalemu: nwọn o si jẹ enia mi, emi o si jẹ Ọlọrun wọn, li otitọ, ati li ododo.
entries.en: And I will bring them, and they shall dwell in the midst of Jerusalem: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God, in truth and in righteousness.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi pe, Jẹ ki ọwọ nyin ki o le, ẹnyin ti ngbọ́ ọ̀rọ wọnyi li ọjọ wọnyi li ẹnu awọn woli ti o wà li ọjọ ti a fi ipilẹ ile Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun lelẹ, ki a ba le kọ́ tempili.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Let your hands be strong, ye that hear in these days these words by the mouth of the prophets, which were in the day that the foundation of the house of the LORD of hosts was laid, that the temple might be built.

entries.yo: Nitori pe ṣãju ọjọ wọnni ọya enia kò to nkan, bẹni ọ̀ya ẹran pẹlu; bẹ̃ni kò si alafia fun ẹniti njade lọ, tabi ẹniti nwọle bọ̀, nitori ipọnju na: nitori mo doju gbogbo enia olukuluku kọ aladugbo rẹ̀.
entries.en: For before these days there was no hire for man, nor any hire for beast; neither was there any peace to him that went out or came in because of the affliction: for I set all men every one against his neighbour.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nisisiyi emi kì yio ṣe si iyokù awọn enia yi gẹgẹ bi ti ìgba atijọ wọnni, li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi.
entries.en: But now I will not be unto the residue of this people as in the former days, saith the LORD of hosts.

entries.yo: Nitori irugbin yio gbilẹ: àjara yio so eso rẹ̀, ilẹ yio si hù ọ̀pọlọpọ nkan rẹ̀ jade, awọn ọrun yio si mu irì wọn wá: emi o si mu ki awọn iyokù enia yi ni gbogbo nkan wọnyi.
entries.en: For the seed shall be prosperous; the vine shall give her fruit, and the ground shall give her increase, and the heavens shall give their dew; and I will cause the remnant of this people to possess all these things.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, gẹgẹ bi ẹnyin ti jẹ egún lãrin awọn keferi, ẹnyin ile Juda, ati ile Israeli, bẹ̃li emi o gbà nyin silẹ; ẹnyin o si jẹ ibukún: ẹ má bẹ̀ru, ṣugbọn jẹ ki ọwọ nyin ki o le.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass, that as ye were a curse among the heathen, O house of Judah, and house of Israel; so will I save you, and ye shall be a blessing: fear not, but let your hands be strong.

entries.yo: Nitori bayi li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi; gẹgẹ bi mo ti rò lati ṣẹ́ nyin niṣẹ, nigbati awọn baba nyin mu mi binu, li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi, ti emi kò si ronupiwadà.
entries.en: For thus saith the LORD of hosts; As I thought to punish you, when your fathers provoked me to wrath, saith the LORD of hosts, and I repented not:

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li emi si ti rò ọjọ wọnyi lati ṣe rere fun Jerusalemu, ati fun ile Juda: ẹ má bẹ̀ru.
entries.en: So again have I thought in these days to do well unto Jerusalem and to the house of Judah: fear ye not.

entries.yo: Wọnyi ni nkan ti ẹnyin o ṣe: Ẹ sọ̀rọ otitọ, olukuluku si ẹnikeji rẹ̀; ṣe idajọ tõtọ ati alafia ni bodè nyin wọnni.
entries.en: These are the things that ye shall do; Speak ye every man the truth to his neighbour; execute the judgment of truth and peace in your gates:

entries.yo: Ẹ máṣe jẹ ki ẹnikan ki o rò ibi li ọkàn rẹ̀ si ẹnikeji rẹ̀; ẹ má fẹ ibura eke: nitori gbogbo wọnyi ni mo korira, li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: And let none of you imagine evil in your hearts against his neighbour; and love no false oath: for all these are things that I hate, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun si tọ̀ mi wá wipe,
entries.en: And the word of the LORD of hosts came unto me, saying,

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi pe; Ãwẹ̀ oṣù kẹrin, ati ti oṣù karun, ati ãwẹ̀ oṣù keje, ati ti ẹkẹwa, yio jẹ ayọ̀, ati didùn inu, ati apejọ ariya fun ile Juda; nitorina ẹ fẹ́ otitọ ati alafia.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; The fast of the fourth month, and the fast of the fifth, and the fast of the seventh, and the fast of the tenth, shall be to the house of Judah joy and gladness, and cheerful feasts; therefore love the truth and peace.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi pe; Awọn enia yio sa tún wá, ati ẹniti yio gbe ilu-nla pupọ.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; It shall yet come to pass, that there shall come people, and the inhabitants of many cities:

entries.yo: Awọn ẹniti ngbe ilu-nla kan yio lọ si omiran, wipe, Ẹ jẹ ki a yára lọ igbadura niwaju Oluwa, ati lati wá Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun: emi pẹlu o si lọ.
entries.en: And the inhabitants of one city shall go to another, saying, Let us go speedily to pray before the LORD, and to seek the LORD of hosts: I will go also.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ ọ̀pọlọpọ enia, ati awọn alagbara orilẹ-ède yio wá lati wá Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun ni Jerusalemu; ati lati gbadura niwaju Oluwa.
entries.en: Yea, many people and strong nations shall come to seek the LORD of hosts in Jerusalem, and to pray before the LORD.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi pe, li ọjọ wọnni yio ṣẹ, ni ọkunrin mẹwa lati inu gbogbo ède ati orilẹ-ède yio dì i mú, ani yio dì eti aṣọ ẹniti iṣe Ju mu, wipe, A o ba ọ lọ, nitori awa ti gbọ́ pe, Ọlọrun wà pẹlu rẹ.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; In those days it shall come to pass, that ten men shall take hold out of all languages of the nations, even shall take hold of the skirt of him that is a Jew, saying, We will go with you: for we have heard that God is with you.

entries.yo: Ọ̀RỌ-ÌMỌ ọ̀rọ Oluwa ni ilẹ Hadraki, Damasku ni yio si jẹ ibi isimi rẹ̀: nitori oju Oluwa mbẹ lara enia, ati lara gbogbo ẹ̀ya Israeli.
entries.en: The burden of the word of the LORD in the land of Hadrach, and Damascus shall be the rest thereof: when the eyes of man, as of all the tribes of Israel, shall be toward the LORD.

entries.yo: Ati Hamati pẹlu yio ṣe ãla rẹ̀: Tire ati Sidoni bi o tilẹ ṣe ọlọgbọ́n gidigidi.
entries.en: And Hamath also shall border thereby; Tyrus, and Zidon, though it be very wise.

entries.yo: Tire si mọ odi lile fun ara rẹ̀, o si ko fàdakà jọ bi ekuru, ati wurà daradara bi ẹrẹ̀ ita.
entries.en: And Tyrus did build herself a strong hold, and heaped up silver as the dust, and fine gold as the mire of the streets.

entries.yo: Kiye si i, Oluwa yio tá a nù, yio si kọlu ipá rẹ̀ ninu okun; a o si fi iná jẹ ẹ run.
entries.en: Behold, the Lord will cast her out, and he will smite her power in the sea; and she shall be devoured with fire.

entries.yo: Aṣkeloni yio ri i, yio si bẹ̀ru; Gasa pẹlu yio ri i, yio si kãnu gidigidi, ati Ekroni: nitori oju o tì ireti rẹ̀: ọba yio si ṣegbe kuro ni Gasa, a kì o si gbe Aṣkeloni.
entries.en: Ashkelon shall see it, and fear; Gaza also shall see it, and be very sorrowful, and Ekron; for her expectation shall be ashamed; and the king shall perish from Gaza, and Ashkelon shall not be inhabited.

entries.yo: Ọmọ alè yio si gbe inu Aṣdodi, emi o si ke irira awọn Filistini kuro.
entries.en: And a bastard shall dwell in Ashdod, and I will cut off the pride of the Philistines.

entries.yo: Emi o si mu ẹ̀jẹ rẹ̀ kuro li ẹnu rẹ̀, ati ohun irira rẹ̀ wọnni kuro lãrin ehín rẹ̀: ṣugbọn ẹniti o kù, ani on na yio jẹ ti Ọlọrun wa, yio si jẹ bi bãlẹ kan ni Juda, ati Ekroni bi Jebusi.
entries.en: And I will take away his blood out of his mouth, and his abominations from between his teeth: but he that remaineth, even he, shall be for our God, and he shall be as a governor in Judah, and Ekron as a Jebusite.

entries.yo: Emi o si dó yi ilẹ mi ka nitori ogun, nitori ẹniti nkọja lọ, ati nitori ẹniti npada bọ̀: kò si aninilara ti yio là wọn já mọ: nitori nisisiyi ni mo fi oju mi ri.
entries.en: And I will encamp about mine house because of the army, because of him that passeth by, and because of him that returneth: and no oppressor shall pass through them any more: for now have I seen with mine eyes.

entries.yo: Yọ̀ gidigidi, iwọ ọmọbinrin Sioni; ho, Iwọ ọmọbinrin Jerusalemu: kiye si i, Ọba rẹ mbọ̀wá sọdọ rẹ: ododo li on, o si ni igbalà; o ni irẹ̀lẹ, o si ngùn kẹtẹkẹtẹ, ani ọmọ kẹtẹkẹtẹ.
entries.en: Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Zion; shout, O daughter of Jerusalem: behold, thy King cometh unto thee: he is just, and having salvation; lowly, and riding upon an ass, and upon a colt the foal of an ass.

entries.yo: Emi o si ke kẹkẹ́ kuro ni Efraimu, ati ẹṣin kuro ni Jerusalemu, a o si ké ọrun ogun kuro: yio si sọ̀rọ alafia si awọn keferi: ijọba rẹ̀ yio si jẹ lati okun de okun, ati lati odo titi de opin aiye.
entries.en: And I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim, and the horse from Jerusalem, and the battle bow shall be cut off: and he shall speak peace unto the heathen: and his dominion shall be from sea even to sea, and from river even to the ends of the earth.

entries.yo: Ni tirẹ pẹlu, emi o fi ẹjẹ majẹmu rẹ rán awọn igbèkun rẹ jade kuro ninu ihò ti kò li omi.
entries.en: As for thee also, by the blood of thy covenant I have sent forth thy prisoners out of the pit wherein is no water.

entries.yo: Ẹ pada si odi agbara, ẹnyin onde ireti: ani loni yi emi sọ pe, emi o san a fun ọ ni igbàmejì.
entries.en: Turn you to the strong hold, ye prisoners of hope: even to day do I declare that I will render double unto thee;

entries.yo: Nitori mo fa Juda le bi ọrun mi, mo si fi Efraimu kún u, mo si gbe awọn ọmọ rẹ ọkunrin dide, iwọ Sioni, si awọn ọmọ rẹ ọkunrin, iwọ ilẹ Griki, mo ṣe ọ bi idà alagbara.
entries.en: When I have bent Judah for me, filled the bow with Ephraim, and raised up thy sons, O Zion, against thy sons, O Greece, and made thee as the sword of a mighty man.

entries.yo: Oluwa yio si fi ara rẹ̀ hàn lori wọn, ọfà rẹ̀ yio si jade lọ bi mànamána: Oluwa Ọlọrun yio si fun ipè, yio si lọ ti on ti ãjà gusù.
entries.en: And the LORD shall be seen over them, and his arrow shall go forth as the lightning: and the LORD GOD shall blow the trumpet, and shall go with whirlwinds of the south.

entries.yo: Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun yio dãbo bò wọn; nwọn o si jẹ ni run, nwọn o si tẹ̀ okuta kànna-kànna mọlẹ; nwọn o si mu, nwọn o si pariwo bi nipa ọti-waini; nwọn o si kún bi ọpọ́n, ati bi awọn igun pẹpẹ.
entries.en: The LORD of hosts shall defend them; and they shall devour, and subdue with sling stones; and they shall drink, and make a noise as through wine; and they shall be filled like bowls, and as the corners of the altar.

entries.yo: Oluwa Ọlọrun wọn yio si gbà wọn là li ọjọ na bi agbo enia rẹ̀: nitori nwọn o dabi awọn okuta ade, ti a gbe soke bi àmi lori ilẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the LORD their God shall save them in that day as the flock of his people: for they shall be as the stones of a crown, lifted up as an ensign upon his land.

entries.yo: Nitori ore rẹ̀ ti tobi to, ẹwà rẹ̀ si ti pọ̀ to! ọkà yio mu ọdọmọkunrin darayá, ati ọti-waini titún yio mu awọn ọdọmọbinrin ṣe bẹ̃ pẹlu.
entries.en: For how great is his goodness, and how great is his beauty! corn shall make the young men cheerful, and new wine the maids.

entries.yo: Ẹ bère òjo nigba arọ̀kuro li ọwọ Oluwa; Oluwa yio kọ mànamána, yio si fi ọ̀pọ òjò fun wọn, fun olukulukù koriko ni pápa.
entries.en: Ask ye of the LORD rain in the time of the latter rain; so the LORD shall make bright clouds, and give them showers of rain, to every one grass in the field.

entries.yo: Nitori awọn oriṣa ti nsọ̀rọ asan, awọn alafọṣẹ si ti ri eké, nwọn si ti rọ́ alá eké; nwọn ntù ni ni inu lasan, nitorina nwọn ba ti wọn lọ bi ọwọ́ ẹran, a ṣẹ wọn niṣẹ, nitori darandaran kò si.
entries.en: For the idols have spoken vanity, and the diviners have seen a lie, and have told false dreams; they comfort in vain: therefore they went their way as a flock, they were troubled, because there was no shepherd.

entries.yo: Ibinu mi ru si awọn darandaran, mo si jẹ awọn ewurẹ ni iyà; nitori Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun ti bẹ̀ agbo rẹ̀ ile Juda wò, o si fi wọn ṣe bi ẹṣin rẹ̀ daradara li ogun.
entries.en: Mine anger was kindled against the shepherds, and I punished the goats: for the LORD of hosts hath visited his flock the house of Judah, and hath made them as his goodly horse in the battle.

entries.yo: Lati ọdọ rẹ̀ ni igun ti jade wá, lati ọdọ rẹ̀ ni iṣo ti wá, lati ọdọ rẹ̀ ni ọrun ogun ti wá, lati ọdọ rẹ̀ ni awọn akoniṣiṣẹ gbogbo ti wá.
entries.en: Out of him came forth the corner, out of him the nail, out of him the battle bow, out of him every oppressor together.

entries.yo: Nwọn o si dabi awọn alagbara, ti ntẹ́ ẹrẹ̀ ita ni mọlẹ li ogun: nwọn o si jagun, nitori Oluwa wà pẹlu wọn nwọn o si doju tì awọn ti ngùn ẹṣin.
entries.en: And they shall be as mighty men, which tread down their enemies in the mire of the streets in the battle: and they shall fight, because the LORD is with them, and the riders on horses shall be confounded.

entries.yo: Emi o si mu ile Juda le, emi o si gbà ile Josefu là, emi o si tún mu wọn joko; nitori mo ti ṣãnu fun wọn, nwọn o si dabi ẹnipe emi kò ti ta wọn nù: nitori emi ni Oluwa Ọlọrun wọn, emi o si gbọ́ ti wọn.
entries.en: And I will strengthen the house of Judah, and I will save the house of Joseph, and I will bring them again to place them; for I have mercy upon them: and they shall be as though I had not cast them off: for I am the LORD their God, and will hear them.

entries.yo: Efraimu yio si ṣe bi alagbara, ọkàn wọn yio si yọ̀ bi ẹnipe nipa ọti-waini: ani awọn ọmọ wọn yio ri i, nwọn o si yọ̀, inu wọn o si dùn si Oluwa.
entries.en: And they of Ephraim shall be like a mighty man, and their heart shall rejoice as through wine: yea, their children shall see it, and be glad; their heart shall rejoice in the LORD.

entries.yo: Emi o kọ si wọn, emi o si ṣà wọn jọ; nitori emi ti rà wọn pada: nwọn o si rẹ̀ si i gẹgẹ bi wọn ti nrẹ̀ si i ri.
entries.en: I will hiss for them, and gather them; for I have redeemed them: and they shall increase as they have increased.

entries.yo: Emi o si gbìn wọn lãrin awọn enia: nwọn o si ranti mi ni ilẹ jijin; nwọn o si wà pẹlu awọn ọmọ wọn, nwọn o si tún pada.
entries.en: And I will sow them among the people: and they shall remember me in far countries; and they shall live with their children, and turn again.

entries.yo: Emi o si tún mu wọn pada kuro ni ilẹ Egipti pẹlu, emi o si ṣà wọn jọ kuro ni ilẹ Assiria: emi o si mu wọn wá si ilẹ Gileadi ati Lebanoni; a kì yio si ri àye fun wọn.
entries.en: I will bring them again also out of the land of Egypt, and gather them out of Assyria; and I will bring them into the land of Gilead and Labanon; and place shall not be found for them.

entries.yo: Yio si là okun wahala ja, yio si lù riru omi ninu okun, gbogbo ibu odò ni yio si gbẹ, a o si rẹ̀ igberaga Assiria silẹ, ọpa alade Egipti yio si lọ kuro.
entries.en: And he shall pass through the sea with affliction, and shall smite the waves in the sea, and all the deeps of the river shall dry up: and the pride of Assyria shall be brought down, and the sceptre of Egypt shall depart away.

entries.yo: Emi o si mu wọn le ninu Oluwa; nwọn o si rìn soke rìn sodò li orukọ rẹ̀, ni Oluwa wi.
entries.en: And I will strengthen them in the LORD; and they shall walk up and down in his name, saith the LORD.

entries.yo: ṢI ilẹkun rẹ wọnni silẹ, Iwọ Lebanoni, ki iná ba le jẹ igi kedari rẹ run.
entries.en: Open thy doors, O Lebanon, that the fire may devour thy cedars.

entries.yo: Hu, igi firi; nitori igi kedari ṣubu; nitori ti a ba awọn alagbara jẹ: hu, ẹnyin igi oaku ti Baṣani, nitori a ke igbo ajara lulẹ.
entries.en: Howl, fir tree; for the cedar is fallen; because the mighty are spoiled: howl, O ye oaks of Bashan; for the forest of the vintage is come down.

entries.yo: Ohùn igbe awọn oluṣọ agutan; nitori ogo wọn bajẹ: ohùn bibu awọn ọmọ kiniun; nitori ogo Jordani bajẹ.
entries.en: There is a voice of the howling of the shepherds; for their glory is spoiled: a voice of the roaring of young lions; for the pride of Jordan is spoiled.

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa Ọlọrun mi wi; Bọ́ ọwọ́-ẹran abọ́pa.
entries.en: Thus saith the LORD my God; Feed the flock of the slaughter;

entries.yo: Ti awọn oluwa wọn npa wọn, ti nwọn kò si kà ara wọn si pe nwọn jẹbi: ati awọn ti ntà wọn wipe, Ibukún ni fun Oluwa, nitoriti mo di ọlọrọ̀: awọn oluṣọ agutan wọn kò si ṣãnu wọn.
entries.en: Whose possessors slay them, and hold themselves not guilty: and they that sell them say, Blessed be the LORD; for I am rich: and their own shepherds pity them not.

entries.yo: Nitori emi kì yio ṣãnu fun awọn ara ilẹ na mọ, li Oluwa wi; si kiye si i, emi o fi olukuluku enia le aladugbo rẹ̀ lọwọ, ati le ọwọ ọba rẹ̀: nwọn o si fọ́ ilẹ na, emi kì yio si gbà wọn lọwọ wọn.
entries.en: For I will no more pity the inhabitants of the land, saith the LORD: but, lo, I will deliver the men every one into his neighbour's hand, and into the hand of his king: and they shall smite the land, and out of their hand I will not deliver them.

entries.yo: Emi o si bọ́ ẹran abọ́pa, ani ẹnyin otoṣi ninu ọwọ́ ẹran. Mo si mu ọpa meji sọdọ; mo pe ọkan ni Ẹwà, mo si pe ekeji ni Amure; mo si bọ́ ọwọ́-ẹran na.
entries.en: And I will feed the flock of slaughter, even you, O poor of the flock. And I took unto me two staves; the one I called Beauty, and the other I called Bands; and I fed the flock.

entries.yo: Oluṣọ agutan mẹta ni mo si ke kuro li oṣu kan; ọkàn mi si korira wọn, ọkàn wọn pẹlu si korira mi.
entries.en: Three shepherds also I cut off in one month; and my soul lothed them, and their soul also abhorred me.

entries.yo: Mo si wipe, emi kì yio bọ nyin: eyi ti nkú lọ, jẹ ki o kú; eyi ti a o ba si ke kuro, jẹ ki a ke e kuro; ki olukuluku ninu awọn iyokù jẹ ẹran-ara ẹnikeji rẹ̀.
entries.en: Then said I, I will not feed you: that that dieth, let it die; and that that is to be cut off, let it be cut off; and let the rest eat every one the flesh of another.

entries.yo: Mo si mu ọpa mi, ani Ẹwà, mo si ṣẹ ẹ si meji, ki emi ba le dà majẹmu mi ti mo ti ba gbogbo awọn enia ni da.
entries.en: And I took my staff, even Beauty, and cut it assunder, that I might break my covenant which I had made with all the people.

entries.yo: O si dá li ọjọ na; bẹ̃ni awọn otoṣi ninu ọwọ́-ẹran nì ti o duro tì mi mọ̀ pe, ọ̀rọ Oluwa ni.
entries.en: And it was broken in that day: and so the poor of the flock that waited upon me knew that it was the word of the LORD.

entries.yo: Mo si wi fun wọn pe, Bi o ba dara li oju nyin, ẹ fun mi ni owo-ọ̀ya mi: bi bẹ̃kọ, ẹ jọwọ rẹ̀. Bẹ̃ni nwọn wọ̀n ọgbọ̀n owo fadakà fun iye mi.
entries.en: And I said unto them, If ye think good, give me my price; and if not, forbear. So they weighed for my price thirty pieces of silver.

entries.yo: Oluwa si wi fun mi pe, Sọ ọ si amọkòko: iye daradara na ti nwọn yọwó mi si. Mo si mu ọgbọ̀n owo fadakà na, mo si sọ wọn si amọkòko ni ile Oluwa.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto me, Cast it unto the potter: a goodly price that I was prised at of them. And I took the thirty pieces of silver, and cast them to the potter in the house of the LORD.

entries.yo: Mo si ṣẹ ọpa mi keji, ani Amure, si meji, ki emi ki o le yà ibatan ti o wà lãrin Juda ati lãrin Israeli.
entries.en: Then I cut asunder mine other staff, even Bands, that I might break the brotherhood between Judah and Israel.

entries.yo: Oluwa si wi fun mi pe, Tún mu ohun-elò oluṣọ agutan aṣiwere kan sọdọ rẹ.
entries.en: And the LORD said unto me, Take unto thee yet the instruments of a foolish shepherd.

entries.yo: Nitori kiye si i, Emi o gbe oluṣọ-agutan kan dide ni ilẹ na, ti kì yio bẹ̀ awọn ti o ṣegbé wò, ti kì yio si wá eyi ti o yapa: ti kì yio ṣe awotan eyi ti o ṣẹ́, tabi kì o bọ́ awọn ti o duro jẹ: ṣugbọn on o jẹ ẹran eyi ti o li ọ̀ra, yio si fà ẽkanna wọn ya pẹrẹpẹ̀rẹ.
entries.en: For, lo, I will raise up a shepherd in the land, which shall not visit those that be cut off, neither shall seek the young one, nor heal that that is broken, nor feed that that standeth still: but he shall eat the flesh of the fat, and tear their claws in pieces.

entries.yo: Egbe ni fun oluṣọ agutan asan na ti o fi ọwọ́-ẹran silẹ! idà yio wà li apá rẹ̀, ati li oju ọ̀tun rẹ̀: apá rẹ̀ yio gbẹ patapata, oju ọ̀tun rẹ̀ yio si ṣõkùnkun biribiri.
entries.en: Woe to the idol shepherd that leaveth the flock! the sword shall be upon his arm, and upon his right eye: his arm shall be clean dried up, and his right eye shall be utterly darkened.

entries.yo: Ọ̀RỌ-ÌMỌ ọ̀rọ Oluwa fun Israeli, li Oluwa wi, ẹni ti o nnà awọn ọrun, ti o si fi ipilẹ aiye sọlẹ, ti o si mọ ẹmi enia ti mbẹ ni inu rẹ̀.
entries.en: The burden of the word of the LORD for Israel, saith the LORD, which stretcheth forth the heavens, and layeth the foundation of the earth, and formeth the spirit of man within him.

entries.yo: Kiye si i, emi o sọ Jerusalemu di ago iwarìri si gbogbo enia yika, nigbati nwọn o do tì Juda ati Jerusalemu.
entries.en: Behold, I will make Jerusalem a cup of trembling unto all the people round about, when they shall be in the siege both against Judah and against Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ na li emi o sọ Jerusalemu di ẹrù okuta fun gbogbo enia: gbogbo awọn ti o ba si fi dẹrù pa ara wọn li a o ke si wẹwẹ, bi gbogbo awọn orilẹ-ède aiye tilẹ ko ara wọn jọ si i.
entries.en: And in that day will I make Jerusalem a burdensome stone for all people: all that burden themselves with it shall be cut in pieces, though all the people of the earth be gathered together against it.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ na, ni Oluwa wi, li emi o fi itagìri lù gbogbo ẹṣin, ati fi wère lu ẹniti ngùn u; emi o si ṣi oju mi si ile Juda, emi o si bu ifọju lù gbogbo ẹṣin ti enia na.
entries.en: In that day, saith the LORD, I will smite every horse with astonishment, and his rider with madness: and I will open mine eyes upon the house of Judah, and will smite every horse of the people with blindness.

entries.yo: Ati awọn bãlẹ Juda yio si wi li ọkàn wọn pe, Awọn ara Jerusalemu li agbara mi nipa Oluwa Ọlọrun wọn.
entries.en: And the governors of Judah shall say in their heart, The inhabitants of Jerusalem shall be my strength in the LORD of hosts their God.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ na li emi o ṣe awọn bãlẹ Juda bi ãrò iná kan lãrin igi, ati bi ètùfù iná lãrin ití; nwọn o si jẹ gbogbo awọn enia run yika lapa ọ̀tun ati lapa osi: a o si tun ma gbe Jerusalemu ni ipo rẹ̀, ani Jerusalemu.
entries.en: In that day will I make the governors of Judah like an hearth of fire among the wood, and like a torch of fire in a sheaf; and they shall devour all the people round about, on the right hand and on the left: and Jerusalem shall be inhabited again in her own place, even in Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Oluwa pẹlu yio kọ́ tète gba agọ Juda là na, ki ogo ile Dafidi ati ogo awọn ara Jerusalemu ma bà gbe ara wọn ga si Juda.
entries.en: The LORD also shall save the tents of Judah first, that the glory of the house of David and the glory of the inhabitants of Jerusalem do not magnify themselves against Judah.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ na li Oluwa yio dãbò bò awọn ti ngbe Jerusalemu; ẹniti o ba si ṣe ailera ninu wọn li ọjọ na yio dabi Dafidi; ile Dafidi yio si dabi Ọlọrun, bi angeli Oluwa niwaju wọn.
entries.en: In that day shall the LORD defend the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and he that is feeble among them at that day shall be as David; and the house of David shall be as God, as the angel of the LORD before them.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe li ọjọ na, emi o wá lati pa gbogbo awọn orilẹ-ède run ti o wá kọjuja si Jerusalemu.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will seek to destroy all the nations that come against Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Emi o si tú ẹmi ore-ọfẹ ati ẹbẹ sori ile Dafidi ati sori Jerusalemu: nwọn o si ma wò mi ẹniti nwọn ti gún li ọ̀kọ, nwọn o si ma ṣọ̀fọ rẹ̀, gẹgẹ bi enia ti nṣọ̀fọ fun ọmọ ọkunrin rẹ̀ kanṣoṣo, nwọn o si wà ni ibanujẹ, bi ẹniti mbanujẹ fun akọbi rẹ̀.
entries.en: And I will pour upon the house of David, and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the spirit of grace and of supplications: and they shall look upon me whom they have pierced, and they shall mourn for him, as one mourneth for his only son, and shall be in bitterness for him, as one that is in bitterness for his firstborn.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ na li ọ̀fọ nlanlà yio wà ni Jerusalemu, gẹgẹ bi ọ̀fọ Hadadrimmoni li afonifoji Megiddoni.
entries.en: In that day shall there be a great mourning in Jerusalem, as the mourning of Hadadrimmon in the valley of Megiddon.

entries.yo: Ilẹ na yio ṣọ̀fọ, idile idile lọtọ̀tọ; idile Dafidi lọ́tọ̀; ati awọn aya wọn lọ́tọ̀; idile Natani lọ́tọ̀, ati awọn aya wọn lọtọ̀.
entries.en: And the land shall mourn, every family apart; the family of the house of David apart, and their wives apart; the family of the house of Nathan apart, and their wives apart;

entries.yo: Idile Lefi lọ́tọ̀, ati awọn aya wọn lọ́tọ̀; idile Ṣimei lọ́tọ̀, ati awọn aya wọn lọ́tọ̀.
entries.en: The family of the house of Levi apart, and their wives apart; the family of Shimei apart, and their wives apart;

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn idile ti o kù, idile idile lọtọ̀tọ, ati awọn aya wọn lọ́tọ̀.
entries.en: All the families that remain, every family apart, and their wives apart.

entries.yo: LI ọjọ na isun kan yio ṣi silẹ fun ile Dafidi ati fun awọn ara Jerusalemu, fun ẹ̀ṣẹ ati fun ìwa aimọ́.
entries.en: In that day there shall be a fountain opened to the house of David and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem for sin and for uncleanness.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe li ọjọ na, li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi, li emi o ke orukọ awọn òriṣa kuro ni ilẹ na, a kì yio si ranti wọn mọ: ati pẹlu emi o mu awọn woli ati awọn ẹmi aimọ́ kọja kuro ni ilẹ na.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the LORD of hosts, that I will cut off the names of the idols out of the land, and they shall no more be remembered: and also I will cause the prophets and the unclean spirit to pass out of the land.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, nigbati ẹnikan yio sọtẹlẹ sibẹ̀, ni baba rẹ̀ ati iya rẹ̀ ti o bi i yio wi fun u pe, Iwọ kì yio yè: nitori iwọ nsọ̀rọ eké li orukọ Oluwa: ati baba rẹ̀ ati iya rẹ̀ ti o bi i yio gún u li agúnyọ nigbati o ba sọ̀tẹlẹ.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass, that when any shall yet prophesy, then his father and his mother that begat him shall say unto him, Thou shalt not live; for thou speakest lies in the name of the LORD: and his father and his mother that begat him shall thrust him through when he prophesieth.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe li ọjọ na, oju yio tì awọn woli olukulukù nitori iran rẹ̀, nigbati on ba ti sọtẹlẹ; bẹ̃ni nwọn kì yio si wọ̀ aṣọ onirun lati tan ni jẹ:
entries.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the prophets shall be ashamed every one of his vision, when he hath prophesied; neither shall they wear a rough garment to deceive:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn on o wipe, Emi kì iṣe woli, agbẹ̀ li emi; nitori enia li o ni mi bi iranṣẹ lati igbà ewe mi wá.
entries.en: But he shall say, I am no prophet, I am an husbandman; for man taught me to keep cattle from my youth.

entries.yo: Ẹnikan o si wi fun u pe, Ọgbẹ́ kini wọnyi li ọwọ rẹ? On o si dahùn pe, Wọnyi ni a ti ṣá mi ni ile awọn ọrẹ́ mi.
entries.en: And one shall say unto him, What are these wounds in thine hands? Then he shall answer, Those with which I was wounded in the house of my friends.

entries.yo: Dide, iwọ idà, si olùṣọ-agùtan mi, ati si ẹniti iṣe ẹnikeji mi, li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi; kọlù olùṣọ-agùtan, awọn àgutan a si tuká: emi o si yi ọwọ mi si awọn kékèké.
entries.en: Awake, O sword, against my shepherd, and against the man that is my fellow, saith the LORD of hosts: smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered: and I will turn mine hand upon the little ones.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, ni gbogbo ilẹ, li Oluwa wi, a o ké apá meji ninu rẹ̀ kuro yio si kú; ṣugbọn apá kẹta yio kù ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass, that in all the land, saith the LORD, two parts therein shall be cut off and die; but the third shall be left therein.

entries.yo: Emi o si mu apá kẹta na là ãrin iná, emi o si yọ́ wọn bi a ti yọ́ fàdakà, emi o si dán wọn wò, bi a ti idán wura wò: nwọn o si pè orukọ mi, emi o si gbọ́ wọn: emi o wipe, Awọn enia mi ni: awọn o si wipe, Oluwa li Ọlọrun mi.
entries.en: And I will bring the third part through the fire, and will refine them as silver is refined, and will try them as gold is tried: they shall call on my name, and I will hear them: I will say, It is my people: and they shall say, The LORD is my God.

entries.yo: KIYESI i, ọjọ Oluwa mbọ̀, a o si pin ikogun rẹ lãrin rẹ.
entries.en: Behold, the day of the LORD cometh, and thy spoil shall be divided in the midst of thee.

entries.yo: Nitori emi o kó gbogbo orilẹ-ède jọ si Jerusalemu fun ogun; a o si kó ilu na, a o si kó awọn ile, a o si bà awọn obinrin jẹ, abọ̀ ilu na yio lọ si igbèkun, a kì yio si ké iyokù awọn enia na kuro ni ilu na.
entries.en: For I will gather all nations against Jerusalem to battle; and the city shall be taken, and the houses rifled, and the women ravished; and half of the city shall go forth into captivity, and the residue of the people shall not be cut off from the city.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Oluwa yio jade lọ, yio si ba awọn orilẹ-ède wọnni jà, gẹgẹ bi iti ijà li ọjọ ogun.
entries.en: Then shall the LORD go forth, and fight against those nations, as when he fought in the day of battle.

entries.yo: Ẹsẹ̀ rẹ̀ yio si duro li ọjọ na lori oke Olifi, ti o wà niwaju Jerusalemu ni ila-õrun, oke Olifi yio si là meji si ihà ila-õrun ati si ihà iwọ̀-õrun, afonifojì nlanla yio wà: idajì oke na yio si ṣi sihà ariwa, ati idajì rẹ̀ siha gusu.
entries.en: And his feet shall stand in that day upon the mount of Olives, which is before Jerusalem on the east, and the mount of Olives shall cleave in the midst thereof toward the east and toward the west, and there shall be a very great valley; and half of the mountain shall remove toward the north, and half of it toward the south.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin o si sá si afonifojì oke mi wọnni: nitoripe afonifoji oke na yio de Asali: nitõtọ, ẹnyin o sa bi ẹ ti sa fun ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ nì li ọjọ Ussiah ọba Juda: Oluwa Ọlọrun mi yio si wá, ati gbogbo awọn Ẹni-mimọ́ pẹlu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And ye shall flee to the valley of the mountains; for the valley of the mountains shall reach unto Azal: yea, ye shall flee, like as ye fled from before the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Judah: and the LORD my God shall come, and all the saints with thee.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe li ọjọ na, imọlẹ kì yio mọ́, bẹ̃ni kì yio ṣõkùnkun.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the light shall not be clear, nor dark:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn yio jẹ ọjọ kan mimọ̀ fun Oluwa, kì iṣe ọsan, kì iṣe oru; ṣugbọn yio ṣe pe, li aṣãlẹ imọlẹ yio wà.
entries.en: But it shall be one day which shall be known to the LORD, not day, nor night: but it shall come to pass, that at evening time it shall be light.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe li ọjọ na, omi iyè yio ti Jerusalemu ṣàn lọ; idajì wọn sihà kun ilà-õrun, ati idajì wọn sihà okun ẹhìn: nigbà ẹ̀run ati nigbà otutù ni yio ri bẹ̃.
entries.en: And it shall be in that day, that living waters shall go out from Jerusalem; half of them toward the former sea, and half of them toward the hinder sea: in summer and in winter shall it be.

entries.yo: Oluwa yio si jọba lori gbogbo aiye: li ọjọ na ni Oluwa kan yio wà, orukọ rẹ̀ yio si jẹ ọkan.
entries.en: And the LORD shall be king over all the earth: in that day shall there be one LORD, and his name one.

entries.yo: A o yi gbogbo ilẹ padà bi pẹtẹlẹ kan lati Geba de Rimmoni lapa gusu Jerusalemu: a o si gbe e soke, yio si gbe ipò rẹ̀, lati ibode Benjamini titi de ibi ibode ekini, de ibode igun nì, ati lati ile iṣọ Hananeeli de ibi ifunti waini ọba.
entries.en: All the land shall be turned as a plain from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem: and it shall be lifted up, and inhabited in her place, from Benjamin's gate unto the place of the first gate, unto the corner gate, and from the tower of Hananeel unto the king's winepresses.

entries.yo: Enia yio si ma gbe ibẹ̀, kì yio si si iparun yanyan mọ; Ṣugbọn a o ma gbe Jerusalemu lailewu.
entries.en: And men shall dwell in it, and there shall be no more utter destruction; but Jerusalem shall be safely inhabited.

entries.yo: Eyi ni yio si jẹ àrun ti Oluwa yio fi kọlu gbogbo awọn enia ti o ti ba Jerusalemu ja; ẹran-ara wọn yio rù nigbati wọn duro li ẹsẹ̀ wọn, oju wọn yio si rà ni ihò wọn, ahọn wọn yio si jẹrà li ẹnu wọn.
entries.en: And this shall be the plague wherewith the LORD will smite all the people that have fought against Jerusalem; Their flesh shall consume away while they stand upon their feet, and their eyes shall consume away in their holes, and their tongue shall consume away in their mouth.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe li ọjọ na, irọkẹ̀kẹ nla lati ọdọ Oluwa wá yio wà lãrin wọn; nwọn o si dì ọwọ ara wọn mu, ọwọ rẹ̀ yio si dide si ọwọ ẹnikeji rẹ̀.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that a great tumult from the LORD shall be among them; and they shall lay hold every one on the hand of his neighbour, and his hand shall rise up against the hand of his neighbour.

entries.yo: Juda pẹlu yio si jà ni Jerusalemu; ọrọ̀ gbogbo awọn keferi ti o wà kakiri li a o si kojọ, wurà, ati fàdakà, ati aṣọ, li ọpọlọpọ.
entries.en: And Judah also shall fight at Jerusalem; and the wealth of all the heathen round about shall be gathered together, gold, and silver, and apparel, in great abundance.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni àrun ẹṣin, ibãka, ràkumi, ati ti kẹtẹkẹtẹ, yio si wà, ati gbogbo ẹranko ti mbẹ ninu agọ wọnyi gẹgẹ bi àrun yi.
entries.en: And so shall be the plague of the horse, of the mule, of the camel, and of the ass, and of all the beasts that shall be in these tents, as this plague.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, olukuluku ẹniti o kù ninu gbogbo awọn orilẹ-ède ti o dide si Jerusalemu yio ma goke lọ lọdọdun lati sìn Ọba, Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun, ati lati pa àse agọ wọnni mọ.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass, that every one that is left of all the nations which came against Jerusalem shall even go up from year to year to worship the King, the LORD of hosts, and to keep the feast of tabernacles.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, ẹnikẹni ti kì yio goke wá ninu gbogbo idile aiye si Jerusalemu lati sìn Ọba, Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun, fun wọn ni òjo kì yio rọ̀.
entries.en: And it shall be, that whoso will not come up of all the families of the earth unto Jerusalem to worship the King, the LORD of hosts, even upon them shall be no rain.

entries.yo: Bi idile Egipti kò ba si goke lọ, ti nwọn kò si wá, ti kò ni òjo; àrun na yio wà, ti Oluwa yio fi kọlù awọn keferi ti kò goke wá lati pa àse agọ na mọ.
entries.en: And if the family of Egypt go not up, and come not, that have no rain; there shall be the plague, wherewith the LORD will smite the heathen that come not up to keep the feast of tabernacles.

entries.yo: Eyi ni yio si jẹ iyà Egipti, ati iyà gbogbo orilẹ-ède ti kò goke wá lati pa àse agọ mọ.
entries.en: This shall be the punishment of Egypt, and the punishment of all nations that come not up to keep the feast of tabernacles.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ na ni MIMỌ SI OLUWA yio wà lara ṣaworo ẹṣin; ati awọn ikòko ni ile Oluwa yio si dàbi awọn ọpọ́n wọnni niwaju pẹpẹ.
entries.en: In that day shall there be upon the bells of the horses, HOLINESS UNTO THE LORD; and the pots in the LORD's house shall be like the bowl's before the altar.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ, gbogbo ikòko ni Jerusalemu ati ni Juda yio jẹ mimọ́ si Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun: ati gbogbo awọn ti nrubọ yio wá, nwọn o si gbà ninu wọn, nwọn o si bọ̀ ninu rẹ̀: li ọjọ na ni ara Kenaani kì yio si si mọ ni ile Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun.
entries.en: Yea, every pot in Jerusalem and in Judah shall be holiness unto the LORD of hosts: and all they that sacrifice shall come and take of them, and seethe therein: and in that day there shall be no more the Canaanite in the house of the LORD of hosts.

entries.yo: Ọ̀RỌ-ÌMỌ ọ̀rọ Oluwa si Israeli nipa ọwọ Malaki.
entries.en: The burden of the word of the LORD to Israel by Malachi.

entries.yo: Emi ti fẹ nyin, li Oluwa wi. Ṣugbọn ẹnyin wipe, Ninu kili o fẹ wa? Arakunrin Jakobu ki Esau iṣe? li Oluwa wi: bẹli emi sa fẹ Jakobu,
entries.en: I have loved you, saith the LORD. Yet ye say, Wherein hast thou loved us? Was not Esau Jacob's brother? saith the LORD: yet I loved Jacob,

entries.yo: Mo si korira Esau, mo si sọ awọn oke-nla rẹ̀ ati ilẹ nini rẹ̀ di ahoro fun awọn dragoni aginjù.
entries.en: And I hated Esau, and laid his mountains and his heritage waste for the dragons of the wilderness.

entries.yo: Nitori Edomu wipe, A run wa tan, ṣugbọn awa o padà, a si kọ ibùgbe ahoro wọnni; bayi li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi; Nwọn o kọ, ṣugbọn emi o wo lulẹ; Nwọn o si pe wọn ni, Agbègbe ìwa buburu, ati awọn enia ti Oluwa ni ikọnnu si titi lai.
entries.en: Whereas Edom saith, We are impoverished, but we will return and build the desolate places; thus saith the LORD of hosts, They shall build, but I will throw down; and they shall call them, The border of wickedness, and, The people against whom the LORD hath indignation for ever.

entries.yo: Oju nyin o si ri, ẹnyin o si wipe, A o gbe Oluwa ga lati oke agbègbe Israeli wá.
entries.en: And your eyes shall see, and ye shall say, The LORD will be magnified from the border of Israel.

entries.yo: Ọmọ a ma bọla fun baba, ati ọmọ-ọdọ fun oluwa rẹ̀: njẹ bi emi ba ṣe baba, ọla mi ha da? bi emi ba si ṣe oluwa, ẹ̀ru mi ha da? li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi fun nyin: Ẹnyin alufa, ti ngàn orukọ mi. Ẹnyin si wipe, Ninu kini awa fi kẹ́gàn orukọ rẹ?
entries.en: A son honoureth his father, and a servant his master: if then I be a father, where is mine honour? and if I be a master, where is my fear? saith the LORD of hosts unto you, O priests, that despise my name. And ye say, Wherein have we despised thy name?

entries.yo: Ẹnyin fi akarà aimọ́ rubọ lori pẹpẹ mi; ẹnyin si wipe, Ninu kini awa ti sọ ọ di aimọ́? Ninu eyi ti ẹnyin wipe, Tabili Oluwa di ohun ẹgàn.
entries.en: Ye offer polluted bread upon mine altar; and ye say, Wherein have we polluted thee? In that ye say, The table of the LORD is contemptible.

entries.yo: Bi ẹnyin ba si fi eyi ti oju rẹ̀ fọ́ rubọ, ibi kọ́ eyini? bi ẹnyin ba si fi amúkun ati olokunrùn rubọ, ibi kọ́ eyini? mu u tọ bãlẹ rẹ lọ nisisiyi; inu rẹ̀ yio ha dùn si ọ, tabi yio ha kà ọ si? li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi.
entries.en: And if ye offer the blind for sacrifice, is it not evil? and if ye offer the lame and sick, is it not evil? offer it now unto thy governor; will he be pleased with thee, or accept thy person? saith the LORD of hosts.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, mo bẹ̀ nyin, ẹ bẹ̀ Ọlọrun ki o ba le ṣe ojurere si wa: lati ọwọ nyin li eyi ti wá: on o ha kà nyin si? li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi.
entries.en: And now, I pray you, beseech God that he will be gracious unto us: this hath been by your means: will he regard your persons? saith the LORD of hosts.

entries.yo: Ta si ni ninu nyin ti yio se ilẹkun? bẹ̃li ẹnyin kò da iná asan lori pẹpẹ mi mọ. Emi kò ni inu-didùn si nyin, li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi, bẹ̃li emi kì yio gba ọrẹ kan lọwọ nyin.
entries.en: Who is there even among you that would shut the doors for nought? neither do ye kindle fire on mine altar for nought. I have no pleasure in you, saith the LORD of hosts, neither will I accept an offering at your hand.

entries.yo: Nitori lati ilã-õrùn titi o si fi de iwọ̀ rẹ̀, orukọ mi yio tobi lãrin awọn keferi; nibi gbogbo li a o si fi turàri jona si orukọ mi, pẹlu ọrẹ mimọ́: nitori orukọ mi o tobi lãrin awọn keferi, li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi.
entries.en: For from the rising of the sun even unto the going down of the same my name shall be great among the Gentiles; and in every place incense shall be offered unto my name, and a pure offering: for my name shall be great among the heathen, saith the LORD of hosts.

entries.yo: Nitori ẹnyin ti sọ ọ di aimọ́, ninu eyi ti ẹ wipe, Tabili Oluwa di aimọ́; ati eso rẹ̀, ani onjẹ rẹ̀ ni ohun ẹ̀gan.
entries.en: But ye have profaned it, in that ye say, The table of the LORD is polluted; and the fruit thereof, even his meat, is contemptible.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin wi pẹlu pe, Wo o agara kili eyi! ẹnyin ṣitìmú si i, li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi; ẹnyin si mu eyi ti o ya, ati arọ, ati olokunrùn wá; bayi li ẹnyin mu ọrẹ wá: emi o ha gbà eyi lọwọ nyin? li Oluwa wi.
entries.en: Ye said also, Behold, what a weariness is it! and ye have snuffed at it, saith the LORD of hosts; and ye brought that which was torn, and the lame, and the sick; thus ye brought an offering: should I accept this of your hand? saith the LORD.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ifibu ni fun ẹlẹtàn na, ti o ni akọ ninu ọwọ́-ẹran rẹ̀, ti o si ṣe ileri ti o si fi ohun abùku rubọ si Oluwa; nitori Ọba nla li emi, li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi, ẹ̀ru si li orukọ mi lãrin awọn keferi.
entries.en: But cursed be the deceiver, which hath in his flock a male, and voweth, and sacrificeth unto the LORD a corrupt thing: for I am a great King, saith the LORD of hosts, and my name is dreadful among the heathen.

entries.yo: NJẸ nisisiyi, ẹnyin alufa, ofin yi ni fun nyin.
entries.en: And now, O ye priests, this commandment is for you.

entries.yo: Bi ẹnyin kì o ba gbọ́, ti ẹnyin kì o ba fi si aiya, lati fi ogo fun orukọ mi, li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi; emi o si rán egún si ori nyin, emi o si fi ibukun nyin ré, lõtọ mo ti fi ré na, nitori pe, ẹnyin kò fi i si ọkàn.
entries.en: If ye will not hear, and if ye will not lay it to heart, to give glory unto my name, saith the LORD of hosts, I will even send a curse upon you, and I will curse your blessings: yea, I have cursed them already, because ye do not lay it to heart.

entries.yo: Wò o, emi o ba irugbìn nyin jẹ, emi o si fi igbẹ́ rẹ́ nyin loju, ani igbẹ́ asè ọ̀wọ nyin wọnni; a o si kó nyin lọ pẹlu rẹ̀.
entries.en: Behold, I will corrupt your seed, and spread dung upon your faces, even the dung of your solemn feasts; and one shall take you away with it.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin o si mọ̀ pe, emi li o ti rán ofin yi si nyin, ki majẹ̀mu mi le wà pẹlu Lefi, li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi.
entries.en: And ye shall know that I have sent this commandment unto you, that my covenant might be with Levi, saith the LORD of hosts.

entries.yo: Majẹmu mi ti iyè on alafia wà pẹlu rẹ̀; mo si fi wọn fun u, nitori bibẹ̀ru ti o bẹ̀ru mi, ti ẹ̀ru orukọ mi si bà a.
entries.en: My covenant was with him of life and peace; and I gave them to him for the fear wherewith he feared me, and was afraid before my name.

entries.yo: Ofin otitọ wà li ẹnu rẹ̀, a kò si ri ìwa-buburu li etè rẹ̀: o ba mi rìn li alafia ati ni ododo, o si yi ọ̀pọlọpọ kuro ninu ìwa-buburu.
entries.en: The law of truth was in his mouth, and iniquity was not found in his lips: he walked with me in peace and equity, and did turn many away from iniquity.

entries.yo: Nitori ète alufa iba ma pa ìmọ mọ, ki nwọn ki o si ma wá ofin li ẹnu rẹ̀: nitori onṣẹ Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun li on iṣe.
entries.en: For the priest's lips should keep knowledge, and they should seek the law at his mouth: for he is the messenger of the LORD of hosts.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹnyin ti yapa kuro li ọ̀na na: ẹnyin ti mu ọ̀pọlọpọ kọsẹ ninu ofin; ẹnyin ti ba majẹmu Lefi jẹ, li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi.
entries.en: But ye are departed out of the way; ye have caused many to stumble at the law; ye have corrupted the covenant of Levi, saith the LORD of hosts.

entries.yo: Nitorina li emi pẹlu ṣe sọ nyin di ẹ̀gan, ati ẹni aikàsi niwaju gbogbo enia, niwọ̀n bi ẹnyin kò ti pa ọ̀na mi mọ, ti ẹnyin si ti nṣe ojusaju ninu ofin.
entries.en: Therefore have I also made you contemptible and base before all the people, according as ye have not kept my ways, but have been partial in the law.

entries.yo: Baba kanna ki gbogbo wa ha ni? Ọlọrun kanna kó ha da wa bi? nitori kili awa ha ṣe nhùwa arekerekè olukuluku si arakunrin rẹ̀, nipa sisọ majẹmu awọn baba wa di alaimọ́.
entries.en: Have we not all one father? hath not one God created us? why do we deal treacherously every man against his brother, by profaning the covenant of our fathers?

entries.yo: Juda ti nhùwa arekerekè, a si ti nhùwa irira ni Israeli ati ni Jerusalemu: nitori Juda ti sọ ìwa mimọ́ Oluwa di alaimọ́, eyi ti o fẹ, o si ti gbe ọmọbinrin ọlọrun ajeji ni iyàwo.
entries.en: Judah hath dealt treacherously, and an abomination is committed in Israel and in Jerusalem; for Judah hath profaned the holiness of the LORD which he loved, and hath married the daughter of a strange god.

entries.yo: Oluwa yio ke ọkunrin na ti o ṣe eyi kuro, olukọ ati ẹniti a nkọ, kuro ninu agọ Jakobu wọnni, ati ẹniti nrubọ ọrẹ si Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun.
entries.en: The LORD will cut off the man that doeth this, the master and the scholar, out of the tabernacles of Jacob, and him that offereth an offering unto the LORD of hosts.

entries.yo: Eyi li ẹnyin si tún ṣe, ẹnyin fi omije, ati ẹkún, ati igbe, bò pẹpẹ Oluwa mọlẹ, tobẹ̃ ti on kò fi kà ọrẹ nyin si mọ, tabi ki o fi inu-didùn gbà nkan lọwọ nyin.
entries.en: And this have ye done again, covering the altar of the LORD with tears, with weeping, and with crying out, insomuch that he regardeth not the offering any more, or receiveth it with good will at your hand.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹnyin wipe, Nitori kini? Nitori Oluwa ti ṣe ẹlẹri lãrin iwọ ati lãrin aya ewe rẹ, ẹniti iwọ ti nhùwa ẹ̀tan si: bẹ̃li ẹgbẹ́ rẹ li on sa iṣe, ati aya majẹmu rẹ.
entries.en: Yet ye say, Wherefore? Because the LORD hath been witness between thee and the wife of thy youth, against whom thou hast dealt treacherously: yet is she thy companion, and the wife of thy covenant.

entries.yo: On kò ha ti ṣe ọkan? bẹ̃li on ni iyokù ẹmi. Ẽ si ti ṣe jẹ ọkan? ki on ba le wá iru-ọmọ bi ti Ọlọrun. Nitorina ẹ tọju ẹmi nyin, ẹ má si jẹ ki ẹnikẹni hùwa ẹ̀tan si aya ewe rẹ̀.
entries.en: And did not he make one? Yet had he the residue of the spirit. And wherefore one? That he might seek a godly seed. Therefore take heed to your spirit, and let none deal treacherously against the wife of his youth.

entries.yo: Nitori Oluwa, Ọlọrun Israeli wipe, on korira ikọ̀silẹ: ẹnikan fi ìwa-ipá bò aṣọ rẹ̀ mọlẹ, li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi: nitorina ẹ ṣọ ẹmi nyin, ki ẹ má ṣe hùwa ẹ̀tan.
entries.en: For the LORD, the God of Israel, saith that he hateth putting away: for one covereth violence with his garment, saith the LORD of hosts: therefore take heed to your spirit, that ye deal not treacherously.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin ti fi ọ̀rọ nyin dá Oluwa li agara. Ṣugbọn ẹnyin wipe, Ninu kini awa fi da a lagara? Nigbati ẹnyin wipe, Olukulùku ẹniti o ṣe ibi, rere ni niwaju Oluwa, inu rẹ̀ si dùn si wọn; tabi, nibo ni Ọlọrun idajọ gbe wà?
entries.en: Ye have wearied the LORD with your words. Yet ye say, Wherein have we wearied him? When ye say, Every one that doeth evil is good in the sight of the LORD, and he delighteth in them; or, Where is the God of judgment?

entries.yo: KIYESI i, Emi o rán onṣẹ mi, yio si tún ọ̀na ṣe niwaju mi: ati Oluwa, ti ẹnyin nwá, yio de li ojijì si tempili rẹ̀, ani onṣẹ majẹmu na, ti inu nyin dùn si; kiye si i, o mbọ̀ wá, li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi.
entries.en: Behold, I will send my messenger, and he shall prepare the way before me: and the Lord, whom ye seek, shall suddenly come to this temple, even the messenger of the covenant, whom ye delight in: behold, he shall come, saith the LORD of hosts.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn tali o le gbà ọjọ wíwa rẹ̀? tani yio si duro nigbati o ba fi ara hàn? nitori on dabi iná ẹniti ndà fadakà, ati bi ọṣẹ afọṣọ:
entries.en: But who may abide the day of his coming? and who shall stand when he appeareth? for he is like a refiner's fire, and like fullers' soap:

entries.yo: On o si joko bi ẹniti nyọ́, ti o si ndà fadakà: yio si ṣe awọn ọmọ Lefi mọ́, yio si yọ́ wọn bi wurà on fadakà, ki nwọn ki o le mu ọrẹ ododo wá fun Oluwa.
entries.en: And he shall sit as a refiner and purifer of silver: and he shall purify the sons of Levi, and purge them as gold and silver, that they may offer unto the LORD an offering in righteousness.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ọrẹ Juda ati ti Jerusalemu yio wù Oluwa, gẹgẹ bi ti ọjọ igbãni, ati gẹgẹ bi ọdun atijọ.
entries.en: Then shall the offering of Judah and Jerusalem be pleasant unto the LORD, as in the days of old, and as in former years.

entries.yo: Emi o si sunmọ nyin fun idajọ, emi o si ṣe ẹlẹri yiyara si awọn oṣó, ati si awọn panṣaga, ati si awọn abura eké, ati awọn ti o ni alagbaṣe lara ninu ọyà rẹ̀, ati opo, ati alainibaba, ati si ẹniti o nrẹ́ alejo jẹ, ti nwọn kò si bẹ̀ru mi, li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi.
entries.en: And I will come near to you to judgment; and I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers, and against the adulterers, and against false swearers, and against those that oppress the hireling in his wages, the widow, and the fatherless, and that turn aside the stranger from his right, and fear not me, saith the LORD of hosts.

entries.yo: Nitori Emi li Oluwa, Emi kò yipada; nitorina li a kò ṣe run ẹnyin ọmọ Jakobu.
entries.en: For I am the LORD, I change not; therefore ye sons of Jacob are not consumed.

entries.yo: Lati ọjọ awọn baba nyin wá li ẹnyin tilẹ ti yapa kuro ni ilàna mi, ti ẹ kò si pa wọn mọ. Ẹ yipada si ọdọ mi, Emi o si yipada si ọdọ nyin, li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi. Ṣugbọn ẹnyin wipe, nipa bawo li awa o yipada?
entries.en: Even from the days of your fathers ye are gone away from mine ordinances, and have not kept them. Return unto me, and I will return unto you, saith the LORD of hosts. But ye said, Wherein shall we return?

entries.yo: Enia yio ha jà Ọlọrun li olè? ṣugbọn ẹnyin sa ti jà mi li olè. Ṣugbọn ẹnyin wipe, nipa bawo li awa fi jà ọ li olè? Nipa idamẹwa ati ọrẹ.
entries.en: Will a man rob God? Yet ye have robbed me. But ye say, Wherein have we robbed thee? In tithes and offerings.

entries.yo: Riré li a o fi nyin ré: nitori ẹnyin ti jà mi li olè, ani gbogbo orilẹ-ède yi.
entries.en: Ye are cursed with a curse: for ye have robbed me, even this whole nation.

entries.yo: Ẹ mu gbogbo idamẹwa wá si ile iṣura, ki onjẹ ba le wà ni ile mi, ẹ si fi eyi dán mi wò nisisiyi, bi emi ki yio ba ṣi awọn ferese ọrun fun nyin, ki nsi tú ibukún jade fun nyin, tobẹ̃ ti ki yio si aye to lati gbà a.
entries.en: Bring ye all the tithes into the storehouse, that there may be meat in mine house, and prove me now herewith, saith the LORD of hosts, if I will not open you the windows of heaven, and pour you out a blessing, that there shall not be room enough to receive it.

entries.yo: Emi o si ba ajẹnirun wi nitori nyin, on kì o si run eso ilẹ nyin, bẹ̃ni àjara nyin kì o rẹ̀ dànu, li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi.
entries.en: And I will rebuke the devourer for your sakes, and he shall not destroy the fruits of your ground; neither shall your vine cast her fruit before the time in the field, saith the LORD of hosts.

entries.yo: Gbogbo orilẹ-ède ni yio si pè nyin li alabukún fun: nitori ẹnyin o jẹ ilẹ ti o wuni, li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi.
entries.en: And all nations shall call you blessed: for ye shall be a delightsome land, saith the LORD of hosts.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ nyin ti jẹ lile si mi, li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi. Ṣugbọn ẹnyin wipe, Ọ̀rọ kili awa sọ si ọ?
entries.en: Your words have been stout against me, saith the LORD. Yet ye say, What have we spoken so much against thee?

entries.yo: Ẹnyin ti wipe, Asan ni lati sìn Ọlọrun: anfani kili o si wà, ti awa ti pa ilàna rẹ̀ mọ, ti awa si ti rìn ni igbãwẹ̀ niwaju Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun?
entries.en: Ye have said, It is vain to serve God: and what profit is it that we have kept his ordinance, and that we have walked mournfully before the LORD of hosts?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nisisiyi awa pè agberaga li alabùkunfun; lõtọ awọn ti o nhùwa buburu npọ si i; lõtọ, awọn ti o dán Oluwa wò li a dá si.
entries.en: And now we call the proud happy; yea, they that work wickedness are set up; yea, they that tempt God are even delivered.

entries.yo: Nigbana li awọn ti o bẹ̀ru Oluwa mba ara wọn sọ̀rọ nigbakugba; Oluwa si tẹti si i, o si gbọ́, a si kọ iwe-iranti kan niwaju rẹ̀, fun awọn ti o bẹ̀ru Oluwa, ti nwọn si nṣe aṣaro orukọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Then they that feared the LORD spake often one to another: and the LORD hearkened, and heard it, and a book of remembrance was written before him for them that feared the LORD, and that thought upon his name.

entries.yo: Nwọn o si jẹ temi ni ini kan, li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi, li ọjọ na ti emi o dá; emi o si dá wọn si gẹgẹ bi enia iti ma dá ọmọ rẹ̀ si ti o nsìn i.
entries.en: And they shall be mine, saith the LORD of hosts, in that day when I make up my jewels; and I will spare them, as a man spareth his own son that serveth him.

entries.yo: Nigbana li ẹnyin o yipada, ẹ o si mọ̀ iyatọ̀ lãrin olododo ati ẹni-buburu, lãrin ẹniti nsìn Ọlọrun, ati ẹniti kò sìn i.
entries.en: Then shall ye return, and discern between the righteous and the wicked, between him that serveth God and him that serveth him not.

entries.yo: SA kiye si i, ọjọ na mbọ̀, ti yio ma jó bi iná ileru; ati gbogbo awọn agberaga, ati gbogbo awọn oluṣe buburu yio dabi akékù koriko: ọjọ na ti mbọ̀ yio si jo wọn run, li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi, ti kì yio fi kù gbòngbo tabi ẹka fun wọn.
entries.en: For, behold, the day cometh, that shall burn as an oven; and all the proud, yea, and all that do wickedly, shall be stubble: and the day that cometh shall burn them up, saith the LORD of hosts, that it shall leave them neither root nor branch.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Õrùn ododo yio là, ti on ti imularada ni iyẹ́-apá rẹ̀, fun ẹnyin ti o bẹ̀ru orukọ mi; ẹnyin o si jade lọ, ẹnyin o si ma dagba bi awọn ẹgbọrọ malu inu agbo.
entries.en: But unto you that fear my name shall the Sun of righteousness arise with healing in his wings; and ye shall go forth, and grow up as calves of the stall.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin o si tẹ̀ awọn enia buburu mọlẹ: nitori nwọn o jasi ẽrú labẹ atẹlẹsẹ̀ nyin, li ọjọ na ti emi o dá, li Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun wi.
entries.en: And ye shall tread down the wicked; for they shall be ashes under the soles of your feet in the day that I shall do this, saith the LORD of hosts.

entries.yo: Ẹ ranti ofin Mose iranṣẹ mi, eyi ti mo pa li aṣẹ fun u ni Horebu fun gbogbo Israeli, pẹlu aṣẹ ati idajọ wọnni.
entries.en: Remember ye the law of Moses my servant, which I commanded unto him in Horeb for all Israel, with the statutes and judgments.

entries.yo: Wò o, emi o rán woli Elijah si nyin, ki ọjọ nla-nlà Oluwa, ati ọjọ ti o li ẹ̀ru to de:
entries.en: Behold, I will send you Elijah the prophet before the coming of the great and dreadful day of the LORD:

entries.yo: Yio si pa ọkàn awọn baba dà si ti awọn ọmọ, ati ọkàn awọn ọmọ si ti awọn baba wọn, ki emi ki o má ba wá fi aiye gégun.
entries.en: And he shall turn the heart of the fathers to the children, and the heart of the children to their fathers, lest I come and smite the earth with a curse.

entries.yo: IBẸRẸ ihinrere Jesu Kristi, Ọmọ Ọlọrun.
entries.en: The beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God;

entries.yo: Bi a ti kọ ọ ninu iwe woli Isaiah: Kiyesi i, mo rán onṣẹ mi ṣiwaju rẹ, ẹniti yio tún ọ̀na rẹ ṣe niwaju rẹ.
entries.en: As it is written in the prophets, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.

entries.yo: Ohùn ẹnikan ti nkigbe ni ijù, Ẹ tún ọ̀na Oluwa ṣe, ẹ ṣe oju ọ̀na rẹ̀ tọ́.
entries.en: The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.

entries.yo: Johanu de, ẹniti o mbaptisi ni iju, ti o si nwasu baptismu ironupiwada fun idariji ẹ̀ṣẹ.
entries.en: John did baptize in the wilderness, and preach the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ilẹ Judea, ati gbogbo awọn ará Jerusalemu jade tọ̀ ọ lọ, a si ti ọwọ́ rẹ̀ baptisi gbogbo wọn li odò Jordani, nwọn njẹwọ ẹ̀ṣẹ wọn.
entries.en: And there went out unto him all the land of Judaea, and they of Jerusalem, and were all baptized of him in the river of Jordan, confessing their sins.

entries.yo: Johanu si wọ̀ aṣọ irun ibakasiẹ, o si dì amure awọ mọ ẹgbẹ rẹ̀; o si njẹ ẽṣú ati oyin ìgan.
entries.en: And John was clothed with camel's hair, and with a girdle of a skin about his loins; and he did eat locusts and wild honey;

entries.yo: O si nwasu, wipe, Ẹnikan ti o pọ̀ju mi lọ mbọ̀ lẹhin mi, okùn bata ẹsẹ ẹniti emi ko to bẹ̀rẹ tú:
entries.en: And preached, saying, There cometh one mightier than I after me, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to stoop down and unloose.

entries.yo: Emi fi omi baptisi nyin; ṣugbọn on yio fi Ẹmí Mimọ́ baptisi nyin.
entries.en: I indeed have baptized you with water: but he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost.

entries.yo: O si ṣe li ọjọ wọnni, Jesu jade wá lati Nasareti ti Galili, a si ti ọwọ́ Johanu baptisi rẹ̀ li odò Jordani.
entries.en: And it came to pass in those days, that Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized of John in Jordan.

entries.yo: Lojukanna bi o si ti goke lati inu omi wá, o ri ọrun pinya, Ẹmi nsọkalẹ bi àdaba le e lori:
entries.en: And straightway coming up out of the water, he saw the heavens opened, and the Spirit like a dove descending upon him:

entries.yo: Ohùn kan si ti ọrun wá, wipe, Iwọ ni ayanfẹ Ọmọ mi, ẹniti inu mi dùn si gidigidi.
entries.en: And there came a voice from heaven, saying, Thou art my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.

entries.yo: Loju kan náà Ẹmí si dari rẹ̀ si ijù.
entries.en: And immediately the Spirit driveth him into the wilderness.

entries.yo: O si wà ni ogoji ọjọ ni ijù, a ti ọwọ́ Satani dán an wò, o si wà pẹlu awọn ẹranko igbẹ́; awọn angẹli si nṣe iranṣẹ fun u.
entries.en: And he was there in the wilderness forty days, tempted of Satan; and was with the wild beasts; and the angels ministered unto him.

entries.yo: Lẹhin igbati a fi Johanu sinu tubu tan, Jesu lọ si Galili, o nwasu ihinrere ijọba Ọlọrun,
entries.en: Now after that John was put in prison, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the gospel of the kingdom of God,

entries.yo: O si nwipe, Akokò na de, ijọba Ọlọrun si kù si dẹ̀dẹ: ẹ ronupiwada, ki ẹ si gbà ihinrere gbọ́.
entries.en: And saying, The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God is at hand: repent ye, and believe the gospel.

entries.yo: Bi o si ti nrìn leti okun Galili, o ri Simoni ati Anderu arakunrin rẹ̀, nwọn nsọ àwọn sinu okun: nitoriti nwọn ṣe apẹja.
entries.en: Now as he walked by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew his brother casting a net into the sea: for they were fishers.

entries.yo: Jesu si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ mã tọ̀ mi lẹhin, emi o si sọ nyin di apẹja enia.
entries.en: And Jesus said unto them, Come ye after me, and I will make you to become fishers of men.

entries.yo: Lojukanna nwọn si fi àwọn wọn silẹ, nwọn si tọ̀ ọ lẹhin.
entries.en: And straightway they forsook their nets, and followed him.

entries.yo: Bi o si ti lọ siwaju diẹ, o ri Jakọbu ọmọ Sebede, ati Johanu arakunrin rẹ̀, nwọn wà ninu ọkọ̀, nwọn ndí àwọn wọn.
entries.en: And when he had gone a little further thence, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who also were in the ship mending their nets.

entries.yo: Lojukanna o si pè wọn: nwọn si fi Sebede baba wọn silẹ ninu ọkọ̀ pẹlu awọn alagbaṣe, nwọn si tọ̀ ọ lẹhin.
entries.en: And straightway he called them: and they left their father Zebedee in the ship with the hired servants, and went after him.

entries.yo: Nwọn si lọ si Kapernaumu; lojukanna o si wọ̀ inu sinagogu li ọjọ, isimi, o si nkọ́ni.
entries.en: And they went into Capernaum; and straightway on the sabbath day he entered into the synagogue, and taught.

entries.yo: Ẹnu si yà wọn si ẹkọ́ rẹ̀: nitoriti o nkọ́ wọn bi ẹniti o li aṣẹ, kì isi ṣe bí awọn akọwe.
entries.en: And they were astonished at his doctrine: for he taught them as one that had authority, and not as the scribes.

entries.yo: Ọkunrin kan si wà ninu sinagogu wọn, ti o li ẹmi aimọ́; o si kigbe soke.
entries.en: And there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit; and he cried out,

entries.yo: O wipe, Jọwọ wa jẹ; kini ṣe tawa tirẹ, Jesu ara Nasareti? iwọ wá lati pa wa run? emi mọ̀ ẹniti iwọ ṣe, Ẹni-Mimọ́ Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Saying, Let us alone; what have we to do with thee, thou Jesus of Nazareth? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art, the Holy One of God.

entries.yo: Jesu si ba a wi, o wipe, Pa ẹnu rẹ mọ́, ki o si jade kuro lara rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Hold thy peace, and come out of him.

entries.yo: Nigbati ẹmi aimọ́ na si gbé e ṣanlẹ, o ke li ohùn rara, o si jade kuro lara rẹ̀.
entries.en: And when the unclean spirit had torn him, and cried with a loud voice, he came out of him.

entries.yo: Hà si ṣe gbogbo wọn, tobẹ̃ ti nwọn fi mbi ara wọn lẽre, wipe, Kili eyi? ẹkọ́ titun li eyi? nitoriti o fi agbara paṣẹ fun awọn ẹmi aimọ́, nwọn si gbọ́ tirẹ̀.
entries.en: And they were all amazed, insomuch that they questioned among themselves, saying, What thing is this? what new doctrine is this? for with authority commandeth he even the unclean spirits, and they do obey him.

entries.yo: Lojukanna okikí rẹ̀ si kàn yi gbogbo ẹkùn Galili ká.
entries.en: And immediately his fame spread abroad throughout all the region round about Galilee.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si jade kuro ninu sinagogu, lojukanna nwọn wọ̀ ile Simoni ati Anderu, pẹlu Jakọbu ati Johanu.
entries.en: And forthwith, when they were come out of the synagogue, they entered into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.

entries.yo: Iya aya Simoni si dubulẹ aìsan ibà, nwọn si sọ ọ̀ran rẹ̀ fun u.
entries.en: But Simon's wife's mother lay sick of a fever, and anon they tell him of her.

entries.yo: O si wá, o fà a lọwọ, o si gbé e dide; lojukanna ibà na si fi i silẹ, o si nṣe iranṣẹ fun wọn.
