entries.en: And he came and took her by the hand, and lifted her up; and immediately the fever left her, and she ministered unto them.

entries.yo: Nigbati o di aṣalẹ, ti õrun wọ̀, nwọn gbe gbogbo awọn alaìsan, ati awọn ti o li ẹmi i èṣu tọ̀ ọ wá.
entries.en: And at even, when the sun did set, they brought unto him all that were diseased, and them that were possessed with devils.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ilu si pejọ li ẹnu-ọ̀na.
entries.en: And all the city was gathered together at the door.

entries.yo: O si wò ọ̀pọ awọn ti o ni onirũru àrun sàn, o si lé ọ̀pọ ẹmi èṣu jade; ko si jẹ ki awọn ẹmi èṣu na ki o fọhun, nitoriti nwọn mọ̀ ọ.
entries.en: And he healed many that were sick of divers diseases, and cast out many devils; and suffered not the devils to speak, because they knew him.

entries.yo: O si dide li owurọ̀ ki ilẹ to mọ́, o si jade lọ si ibi iju kan, nibẹ li o si ngbadura.
entries.en: And in the morning, rising up a great while before day, he went out, and departed into a solitary place, and there prayed.

entries.yo: Simoni ati awọn ti o wà pẹlu rẹ̀ si nwá a.
entries.en: And Simon and they that were with him followed after him.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si ri i, nwọn wi fun u pe, Gbogbo enia nwá ọ.
entries.en: And when they had found him, they said unto him, All men seek for thee.

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ jẹ ki a lọ si ilu miran, ki emi ki o le wasu nibẹ̀ pẹlu: nitori eyi li emi sá ṣe wá.
entries.en: And he said unto them, Let us go into the next towns, that I may preach there also: for therefore came I forth.

entries.yo: O si nwãsu ninu sinagogu wọn lọ ni gbogbo Galili, o si nlé awọn ẹmi èṣu jade.
entries.en: And he preached in their synagogues throughout all Galilee, and cast out devils.

entries.yo: Ọkunrin kan ti o dẹtẹ si tọ̀ ọ wá, o si kunlẹ niwaju rẹ̀, o si mbẹ̀ ẹ, o si wi fun u pe, Bi iwọ ba fẹ, iwọ le sọ mi di mimọ́.
entries.en: And there came a leper to him, beseeching him, and kneeling down to him, and saying unto him, If thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.

entries.yo: Jesu ṣãnu rẹ̀, o nà ọwọ́ rẹ̀, o fi bà a, o si wi fun u pe, Mo fẹ, iwọ di mimọ́.
entries.en: And Jesus, moved with compassion, put forth his hand, and touched him, and saith unto him, I will; be thou clean.

entries.yo: Bi o si ti sọ̀rọ, lojukanna ẹ̀tẹ na fi i silẹ; o si di mimọ́.
entries.en: And as soon as he had spoken, immediately the leprosy departed from him, and he was cleansed.

entries.yo: O si kìlọ fun u gidigidi, lojukanna o si rán a lọ;
entries.en: And he straitly charged him, and forthwith sent him away;

entries.yo: O si wi fun u pe, Wo o, máṣe sọ ohunkohun fun ẹnikẹni: ṣugbọn lọ, fi ara rẹ hàn fun alufa, ki o si fi ẹ̀bun iwẹnumọ́ rẹ ti Mose ti palaṣẹ, ni ẹrí fun wọn.
entries.en: And saith unto him, See thou say nothing to any man: but go thy way, shew thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing those things which Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn o jade, o si bẹrẹ si ikokiki, ati si itàn ọ̀ran na kalẹ, tobẹ̃ ti Jesu kò si le wọ̀ ilu ni gbangba mọ́, ṣugbọn o wà lẹhin odi nibi iju: nwọn si tọ̀ ọ wá lati ìha gbogbo wá.
entries.en: But he went out, and began to publish it much, and to blaze abroad the matter, insomuch that Jesus could no more openly enter into the city, but was without in desert places: and they came to him from every quarter.

entries.yo: NIGBATI o si tún wọ̀ Kapernaumu lọ lẹhin ijọ melokan; okikí kàn yiká pe, o wà ninu ile.
entries.en: And again he entered into Capernaum, after some days; and it was noised that he was in the house.

entries.yo: Lojukanna ọ̀pọ enia si pejọ tobẹ̃ ti aye kò si fun wọn mọ, kò si, titi de ẹnu-ọ̀na: o si wasu ọ̀rọ na fun wọn.
entries.en: And straightway many were gathered together, insomuch that there was no room to receive them, no, not so much as about the door: and he preached the word unto them.

entries.yo: Nwọn si wá sọdọ rẹ̀, nwọn gbé ẹnikan ti o li ẹ̀gba tọ̀ ọ wá, ẹniti mẹrin gbé.
entries.en: And they come unto him, bringing one sick of the palsy, which was borne of four.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn kò si le sunmọ ọ nitori ọ̀pọ enia, nwọn si ṣí orule ile nibiti o gbé wà: nigbati nwọn si da a lu tan, nwọn sọ akete na kalẹ lori eyiti ẹlẹgba na dubulẹ.
entries.en: And when they could not come nigh unto him for the press, they uncovered the roof where he was: and when they had broken it up, they let down the bed wherein the sick of the palsy lay.

entries.yo: Nigbati Jesu ri igbagbọ́ wọn, o wi fun ẹlẹgba na pe, Ọmọ, a dari ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ jì ọ.
entries.en: When Jesus saw their faith, he said unto the sick of the palsy, Son, thy sins be forgiven thee.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn kan ninu awọn akọwe wà ti nwọn joko nibẹ̀, nwọn si ngbèro li ọkàn wọn, wipe,
entries.en: But there were certain of the scribes sitting there, and reasoning in their hearts,

entries.yo: Ẽṣe ti ọkunrin yi fi sọrọ bayi? o nsọ ọrọ-odi; tali o le dari eṣẹ jìni bikoṣe ẹnikan, aní Ọlọrun?
entries.en: Why doth this man thus speak blasphemies? who can forgive sins but God only?

entries.yo: Lojukanna bi Jesu ti woye li ọkàn rẹ̀ pe, nwọn ngbèro bẹ̃ ninu ara wọn, o wi fun wọn pe, Ẽṣe ti ẹnyin fi nrò nkan wọnyi ninu ọkàn nyin?
entries.en: And immediately when Jesus perceived in his spirit that they so reasoned within themselves, he said unto them, Why reason ye these things in your hearts?

entries.yo: Ewo li o ya jù lati wi fun ẹlẹgba na pe, A dari ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ jì ọ; tabi lati wipe, Dide, si gbé akete rẹ, ki o si ma rìn?
entries.en: Whether is it easier to say to the sick of the palsy, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Arise, and take up thy bed, and walk?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ki ẹ le mọ̀ pe, Ọmọ-enia li agbara li aiye lati dari ẹ̀ṣẹ jìni, (o wi fun ẹlẹgba na pe,)
entries.en: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins, (he saith to the sick of the palsy,)

entries.yo: Mo wi fun ọ, Dide, gbé akete rẹ, ki o si mã lọ ile rẹ.
entries.en: I say unto thee, Arise, and take up thy bed, and go thy way into thine house.

entries.yo: O si dide lojukanna, o si gbé akete na, o si jade lọ li oju gbogbo wọn; tobẹ̃ ti ẹnu fi yà gbogbo wọn, nwọn si yìn Ọlọrun logo, wipe, Awa ko ri irú eyi rí.
entries.en: And immediately he arose, took up the bed, and went forth before them all; insomuch that they were all amazed, and glorified God, saying, We never saw it on this fashion.

entries.yo: O si tún jade lọ si eti okun; gbogbo ijọ enia si wá sọdọ rẹ̀, o si kọ́ wọn.
entries.en: And he went forth again by the sea side; and all the multitude resorted unto him, and he taught them.

entries.yo: Bi o si ti nkọja lọ, o ri Lefi ọmọ Alfeu, o joko ni bode, o si wi fun u pe, Mã tọ̀ mi lẹhin. O si dide, o tọ̀ ọ lẹhin.
entries.en: And as he passed by, he saw Levi the son of Alphaeus sitting at the receipt of custom, and said unto him, Follow me. And he arose and followed him.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, bi o si ti joko tì onjẹ ni ile rẹ̀, ọ̀pọ awọn agbowode ati ẹlẹṣẹ wá bá Jesu joko pẹlu awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀: nitoriti nwọn pọ̀ nwọn si tọ̀ ọ lẹhin.
entries.en: And it came to pass, that, as Jesus sat at meat in his house, many publicans and sinners sat also together with Jesus and his disciples: for there were many, and they followed him.

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn akọwe ati awọn Farisi si ri i ti o mbá awọn agbowode ati awọn ẹlẹṣẹ jẹun, nwọn wi fun awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ pe, Ẽtiri ti o fi mba awọn agbowode ati awọn ẹlẹṣẹ jẹ, ti o si mba wọn mu?
entries.en: And when the scribes and Pharisees saw him eat with publicans and sinners, they said unto his disciples, How is it that he eateth and drinketh with publicans and sinners?

entries.yo: Nigbati Jesu gbọ́, o wi fun wọn pe, Awọn ti ara wọn le kì iwá oniṣegun, bikoṣe awọn ti ara wọn ko da: Emi ko wá lati pè awọn olododo, bikoṣe awọn ẹlẹṣẹ si ironupiwada.
entries.en: When Jesus heard it, he saith unto them, They that are whole have no need of the physician, but they that are sick: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ-ẹhin Johanu, ati awọn ọmọ-ẹhin awọn Farisi a ma gbàwẹ: nwọn si wá, nwọn si bi i pe, Ẽṣe ti awọn ọmọ-ẹhin Johanu, ati awọn ọmọ-ẹhin awọn Farisi fi ngbàwẹ, ṣugbọn awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ ko gbàwẹ?
entries.en: And the disciples of John and of the Pharisees used to fast: and they come and say unto him, Why do the disciples of John and of the Pharisees fast, but thy disciples fast not?

entries.yo: Jesu si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹnyin le mu ki awọn ọmọ ile iyawo gbàwe, nigbati ọkọ iyawo mbẹ lọdọ wọn? niwọn igbati nwọn ni ọkọ iyawo lọdọ wọn, nwọn kò le gbàwẹ.
entries.en: And Jesus said unto them, Can the children of the bridechamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them? as long as they have the bridegroom with them, they cannot fast.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ọjọ mbọ̀ nigbati a o gbà ọkọ iyawo lọwọ wọn, nigbana ni nwọn o gbàwẹ ni ijọ wọnni.
entries.en: But the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then shall they fast in those days.

entries.yo: Ko si ẹniti ifi idãsa aṣọ titun mọ ogbologbo ẹ̀wu; bi bẹ̃ko eyi titun ti a fi lẹ ẹ a fà ogbologbo ya, aṣọ a si ma ya siwaju.
entries.en: No man also seweth a piece of new cloth on an old garment: else the new piece that filled it up taketh away from the old, and the rent is made worse.

entries.yo: Ko si ẹniti ifi ọti-waini titun sinu ogbologbo ìgo; bi bẹ̃kọ ọti-waini titun a bẹ́ ìgo na, ọti-waini a si danu, ìgo na a si fàya; ṣugbọn ọti-waini titun ni ã fi sinu ìgo titun.
entries.en: And no man putteth new wine into old bottles: else the new wine doth burst the bottles, and the wine is spilled, and the bottles will be marred: but new wine must be put into new bottles.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, bi Jesu ti nkọja lọ lãrin oko ọkà li ọjọ isimi; awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ bẹ̀rẹ si ima ya ipẹ́ ọkà bi nwọn ti nlọ.
entries.en: And it came to pass, that he went through the corn fields on the sabbath day; and his disciples began, as they went, to pluck the ears of corn.

entries.yo: Awọn Farisi si wi fun u pe, Wo o, ẽṣe ti nwọn fi nṣe eyi ti kò yẹ li ọjọ isimi?
entries.en: And the Pharisees said unto him, Behold, why do they on the sabbath day that which is not lawful?

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹnyin kò ti kà ohun ti Dafidi ṣe, nigbati o ṣe alaini, ti ebi si npa a, on, ati awọn ti o wà lọdọ rẹ̀?
entries.en: And he said unto them, Have ye never read what David did, when he had need, and was an hungred, he, and they that were with him?

entries.yo: Bi o ti wọ̀ inu ile Ọlọrun lọ li ọjọ Abiatari olori alufa, ti o si jẹ akara ifihàn, ti ko tọ́ fun u lati jẹ bikoṣe fun awọn alufa, o si fifun awọn ti mbẹ lọdọ rẹ̀ pẹlu?
entries.en: How he went into the house of God in the days of Abiathar the high priest, and did eat the shewbread, which is not lawful to eat but for the priests, and gave also to them which were with him?

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, A dá ọjọ isimi nitori enia, a kò dá enia nitori ọjọ isimi:
entries.en: And he said unto them, The sabbath was made for man, and not man for the sabbath:

entries.yo: Nitorina Ọmọ-enia li oluwa ọjọ isimi pẹlu.
entries.en: Therefore the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath.

entries.yo: O si tún wọ̀ inu sinagogu lọ; ọkunrin kan si mbẹ nibẹ̀ ti ọwọ́ rẹ̀ kan rọ.
entries.en: And he entered again into the synagogue; and there was a man there which had a withered hand.

entries.yo: Nwọn si nṣọ ọ, bi yio mu u larada li ọjọ isimi; ki nwọn ki o le fi i sùn.
entries.en: And they watched him, whether he would heal him on the sabbath day; that they might accuse him.

entries.yo: O si wi fun ọkunrin na ti ọwọ́ rẹ̀ rọ pe, Dide, duro larin.
entries.en: And he saith unto the man which had the withered hand, Stand forth.

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, O tọ́ lati mã ṣe rere li ọjọ isimi, tabi lati mã ṣe buburu? lati gbà ẹmí là, tabi lati pa a run? nwọn si dakẹ.
entries.en: And he saith unto them, Is it lawful to do good on the sabbath days, or to do evil? to save life, or to kill? But they held their peace.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si fi ibinu wò gbogbo wọn yiká, ti inu rẹ̀ bajẹ nitori lile àiya wọn, o wi fun ọkunrin na pe, Nà ọwọ́ rẹ. O si nà a: ọwọ́ rẹ̀ si pada bọ̀ sipò gẹgẹ bi ekeji.
entries.en: And when he had looked round about on them with anger, being grieved for the hardness of their hearts, he saith unto the man, Stretch forth thine hand. And he stretched it out: and his hand was restored whole as the other.

entries.yo: Awọn Farisi jade lọ lojukanna lati ba awọn ọmọ-ẹhin Herodu gbìmọ pọ̀ si i, bi awọn iba ti ṣe pa a.
entries.en: And the Pharisees went forth, and straightway took counsel with the Herodians against him, how they might destroy him.

entries.yo: Jesu pẹlu awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ si kuro nibẹ̀ lọ si eti okun: ijọ enia pipọ lati Galili ati Judea wá si tọ̀ ọ lẹhin,
entries.en: But Jesus withdrew himself with his disciples to the sea: and a great multitude from Galilee followed him, and from Judaea,

entries.yo: Ati lati Jerusalemu, ati lati Idumea, ati lati oke odò Jordani, ati awọn ti o wà niha Tire on Sidoni, ijọ enia pipọ; nigbati nwọn gbọ́ ohun nla ti o ṣe, nwọn tọ̀ ọ wá.
entries.en: And from Jerusalem, and from Idumaea, and from beyond Jordan; and they about Tyre and Sidon, a great multitude, when they had heard what great things he did, came unto him.

entries.yo: O si wi fun awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ pe, ki nwọn mu ọkọ̀ kekere kan sunmọ on, nitori ijọ enia, ki nwọn ki o má bà bilù u.
entries.en: And he spake to his disciples, that a small ship should wait on him because of the multitude, lest they should throng him.

entries.yo: Nitoriti o mu ọ̀pọ enia larada; tobẹ̃ ti nwọn mbì ara wọn lù u lati fi ọwọ́ kàn a, iye awọn ti o li arùn.
entries.en: For he had healed many; insomuch that they pressed upon him for to touch him, as many as had plagues.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ẹmi aimọ́, nigbàkugba ti nwọn ba ri i, nwọn a wolẹ niwaju rẹ̀, nwọn a kigbe soke, wipe, Iwọ li Ọmọ Ọlọrun.
entries.en: And unclean spirits, when they saw him, fell down before him, and cried, saying, Thou art the Son of God.

entries.yo: O si kìlọ fun wọn gidigidi pe, ki nwọn ki o máṣe fi on hàn.
entries.en: And he straitly charged them that they should not make him known.

entries.yo: O si gùn ori òke lọ, o si npè ẹnikẹni ti o fẹ sọdọ rẹ̀: nwọn si tọ̀ ọ wá.
entries.en: And he goeth up into a mountain, and calleth unto him whom he would: and they came unto him.

entries.yo: O si yàn awọn mejila, ki nwọn ki o le mã gbé ọdọ rẹ̀, ati ki o le ma rán wọn lọ lati wasu,
entries.en: And he ordained twelve, that they should be with him, and that he might send them forth to preach,

entries.yo: Ati lati li agbara lati wò arunkarun san, ati lati lé awọn ẹmi èṣu jade:
entries.en: And to have power to heal sicknesses, and to cast out devils:

entries.yo: Simoni ẹniti o si sọ apele rẹ̀ ni Peteru;
entries.en: And Simon he surnamed Peter;

entries.yo: Ati Jakọbu ọmọ Sebede, ati Johanu arakunrin Jakọbu; o si sọ apele wọn ni Boanerge, eyi ti ijẹ Awọn ọmọ ãrá:
entries.en: And James the son of Zebedee, and John the brother of James; and he surnamed them Boanerges, which is, The sons of thunder:

entries.yo: Ati Anderu, ati Filippi, ati Bartolomeu, ati Matiu, ati Tomasi, ati Jakọbu ọmọ Alfeu, ati Taddeu, ati Simoni ti a npè ni Selote,
entries.en: And Andrew, and Philip, and Bartholomew, and Matthew, and Thomas, and James the son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus, and Simon the Canaanite,

entries.yo: Ati Judasi Iskariotu, ẹniti o si fi i hàn pẹlu: nwọn si wọ̀ ile kan lọ.
entries.en: And Judas Iscariot, which also betrayed him: and they went into an house.

entries.yo: Ijọ enia si tún wọjọ pọ̀, ani tobẹ̃ ti nwọn ko tilẹ le jẹ onjẹ.
entries.en: And the multitude cometh together again, so that they could not so much as eat bread.

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn ibatan rẹ̀ si gbọ́ eyini, nwọn jade lọ lati mu u: nitoriti nwọn wipe, Ori rẹ̀ bajẹ.
entries.en: And when his friends heard of it, they went out to lay hold on him: for they said, He is beside himself.

entries.yo: Awọn akọwe ti o ti Jerusalemu sọkalẹ wá, wipe, O ni Beelsebubu, olori awọn ẹmi èṣu li o si fi nlé awọn ẹmi èṣu jade.
entries.en: And the scribes which came down from Jerusalem said, He hath Beelzebub, and by the prince of the devils casteth he out devils.

entries.yo: O si pè wọn sọdọ rẹ̀, o si fi owe ba wọn sọrọ pe, Satani yio ti ṣe le lé Satani jade?
entries.en: And he called them unto him, and said unto them in parables, How can Satan cast out Satan?

entries.yo: Bi ijọba kan ba si yàpa si ara rẹ̀, ijọba na kì yio le duro.
entries.en: And if a kingdom be divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.

entries.yo: Bi ile kan ba si yàpa si ara rẹ̀, ile na kì yio le duro.
entries.en: And if a house be divided against itself, that house cannot stand.

entries.yo: Bi Satani ba si dide si ara rẹ̀, ti o si yàpa, on kì yio le duro, ṣugbọn yio ni opin.
entries.en: And if Satan rise up against himself, and be divided, he cannot stand, but hath an end.

entries.yo: Kò si ẹniti o le wọ̀ ile ọkunrin alagbara kan lọ, ki o si kó o li ẹrù lọ, bikoṣepe o tètekọ dè ọkunrin alagbara na li okùn; nigbana ni yio le kó o li ẹrù ni ile.
entries.en: No man can enter into a strong man's house, and spoil his goods, except he will first bind the strong man; and then he will spoil his house.

entries.yo: Lõtọ ni mo wi fun nyin, Gbogbo ẹ̀ṣẹ li a o dari wọn jì awọn ọmọ enia, ati gbogbo ọrọ-odi nipa eyiti nwọn o ma fi sọrọ-odi:
entries.en: Verily I say unto you, All sins shall be forgiven unto the sons of men, and blasphemies wherewith soever they shall blaspheme:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹniti o ba sọrọ-odi si Ẹmi Mimọ́ kì yio ni idariji titi lai, ṣugbọn o wà ninu ewu ẹbi ainipẹkun:
entries.en: But he that shall blaspheme against the Holy Ghost hath never forgiveness, but is in danger of eternal damnation:

entries.yo: Nitoriti nwọn wipe, O li ẹmi aimọ́.
entries.en: Because they said, He hath an unclean spirit.

entries.yo: Nigbana li awọn arakunrin rẹ̀ ati iya rẹ̀ wá, nwọn duro lode, nwọn si ranṣẹ si i, nwọn npè e.
entries.en: There came then his brethren and his mother, and, standing without, sent unto him, calling him.

entries.yo: Awọn ọ̀pọ enia si joko lọdọ rẹ̀, nwọn si wi fun u pe, Wò o, iya rẹ ati awọn arakunrin rẹ nwá ọ lode.
entries.en: And the multitude sat about him, and they said unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren without seek for thee.

entries.yo: O si da wọn lohùn, wipe, Tani iṣe iya mi, tabi awọn arakunrin mi?
entries.en: And he answered them, saying, Who is my mother, or my brethren?

entries.yo: O si wò gbogbo awọn ti o joko lọdọ rẹ̀ yiká, o si wipe, Wò iya mi ati awọn arakunrin mi:
entries.en: And he looked round about on them which sat about him, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren!

entries.yo: Nitori ẹnikẹni ti o ba ṣe ifẹ Ọlọrun, on na li arakunrin mi, ati arabinrin mi, ati iya mi.
entries.en: For whosoever shall do the will of God, the same is my brother, and my sister, and mother.

entries.yo: O si tún bẹ̀rẹ si ikọni leti okun: ọ̀pọ ijọ enia si pejọ sọdọ rẹ̀, tobẹ̃ ti o bọ́ sinu ọkọ̀ kan, o si joko ninu okun; gbogbo awọn enia si wà ni ilẹ leti okun.
entries.en: And he began again to teach by the sea side: and there was gathered unto him a great multitude, so that he entered into a ship, and sat in the sea; and the whole multitude was by the sea on the land.

entries.yo: O si fi owe kọ́ wọn li ohun pipọ, o si wi fun wọn ninu ẹkọ́ rẹ̀ pe,
entries.en: And he taught them many things by parables, and said unto them in his doctrine,

entries.yo: Ẹ fi eti silẹ; Wo o, afunrugbin kan jade lọ ifunrugbin;
entries.en: Hearken; Behold, there went out a sower to sow:

entries.yo: O si ṣe, bi o ti nfunrugbin, diẹ bọ́ si ẹba ọ̀na, awọn ẹiyẹ si wá, nwọn si ṣà a jẹ.
entries.en: And it came to pass, as he sowed, some fell by the way side, and the fowls of the air came and devoured it up.

entries.yo: Diẹ si bọ́ sori ilẹ apata, nibiti kò li erupẹ̀ pipọ; lojukanna o si ti hù jade, nitoriti kò ni ijinlẹ:
entries.en: And some fell on stony ground, where it had not much earth; and immediately it sprang up, because it had no depth of earth:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati õrùn goke, o jóna; nitoriti kò ni gbongbo, o gbẹ.
entries.en: But when the sun was up, it was scorched; and because it had no root, it withered away.

entries.yo: Diẹ si bọ́ sarin ẹgún, nigbati ẹgún si dàgba soke, o fun u pa, kò si so eso.
entries.en: And some fell among thorns, and the thorns grew up, and choked it, and it yielded no fruit.

entries.yo: Omiran si bọ́ si ilẹ rere, o si so eso, ti o ndagba ti o si npọ̀; o si mu eso jade wá, omiran ọgbọgbọn, omiran ọgọtọta, omiran ọgọrọ̀run.
entries.en: And other fell on good ground, and did yield fruit that sprang up and increased; and brought forth, some thirty, and some sixty, and some an hundred.

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹniti o ba li etí lati fi gbọ, ki o gbọ́.
entries.en: And he said unto them, He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.

entries.yo: Nigbati o kù on nikan, awọn ti o wà lọdọ rẹ̀ pẹlu awọn mejila bi i lẽre idi owe na.
entries.en: And when he was alone, they that were about him with the twelve asked of him the parable.

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹnyin li a fifun lati mọ̀ ohun ijinlẹ ijọba Ọlọrun: ṣugbọn fun awọn ti o wà lode, gbogbo ohun wọnyi li a nfi owe sọ fun wọn:
entries.en: And he said unto them, Unto you it is given to know the mystery of the kingdom of God: but unto them that are without, all these things are done in parables:

entries.yo: Nitori ni ríri ki nwọn ki o le ri, ki nwọn má si kiyesi; ati ni gbigbọ́ ki nwọn ki o le gbọ́, ki o má si yé wọn; ki nwọn ki o má ba yipada, ki a má ba dari jì wọn.
entries.en: That seeing they may see, and not perceive; and hearing they may hear, and not understand; lest at any time they should be converted, and their sins should be forgiven them.

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹnyin kò mọ̀ owe yi? ẹnyin o ha ti ṣe le mọ̀ owe gbogbo?
entries.en: And he said unto them, Know ye not this parable? and how then will ye know all parables?

entries.yo: Afunrugbin funrugbin ọ̀rọ na.
entries.en: The sower soweth the word.

entries.yo: Awọn wọnyi si ni ti ẹba ọ̀na, nibiti a funrugbin ọ̀rọ na; nigbati nwọn si ti gbọ́, lojukanna Satani wá, o si mu ọ̀rọ na ti a fọn si àiya wọn kuro.
entries.en: And these are they by the way side, where the word is sown; but when they have heard, Satan cometh immediately, and taketh away the word that was sown in their hearts.

entries.yo: Awọn wọnyi pẹlu si li awọn ti a fun sori ilẹ apata; awọn ẹniti nigbati nwọn ba gbọ́ ọ̀rọ na, lojukanna nwọn a fi ayọ̀ gbà a;
entries.en: And these are they likewise which are sown on stony ground; who, when they have heard the word, immediately receive it with gladness;

entries.yo: Nwọn kò si ni gbongbo ninu ara wọn, ṣugbọn nwọn a wà fun ìgba diẹ: lẹhinna nigbati wahalà tabi inunibini ba dide nitori ọ̀rọ na, lojukanna nwọn a kọsẹ̀.
entries.en: And have no root in themselves, and so endure but for a time: afterward, when affliction or persecution ariseth for the word's sake, immediately they are offended.

entries.yo: Awọn wọnyi li awọn ti a fun sarin ẹgún; awọn ti o gbọ́ ọ̀rọ na,
entries.en: And these are they which are sown among thorns; such as hear the word,

entries.yo: Aniyan aiye, ati itanjẹ ọrọ̀, ati ifẹkufẹ ohun miran si bọ sinu wọn, nwọn fún ọ̀rọ na pa, bẹ̃li o si jẹ alaileso.
entries.en: And the cares of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the lusts of other things entering in, choke the word, and it becometh unfruitful.

entries.yo: Awọn wọnyi si li eyi ti a fún si ilẹ rere; irú awọn ti o gbọ́ ọ̀rọ na, ti wọn si gbà a, ti wọn si so eso, omiran ọgbọgbọ̀n, omiran ọgọtọta, omiran ọgọrọrun.
entries.en: And these are they which are sown on good ground; such as hear the word, and receive it, and bring forth fruit, some thirtyfold, some sixty, and some an hundred.

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, A ha gbé fitilà wá lati fi sabẹ òṣuwọn, tabi sabẹ akete, ki a ma si ṣe gbé e kà ori ọpá fitilà?
entries.en: And he said unto them, Is a candle brought to be put under a bushel, or under a bed? and not to be set on a candlestick?

entries.yo: Nitori kò si ohun ti o pamọ́ bikoṣe ki a le fi i hàn; bẹ̃ni kò si ohun ti o wà ni ikọkọ, bikoṣepe ki o le yọ si gbangba.
entries.en: For there is nothing hid, which shall not be manifested; neither was any thing kept secret, but that it should come abroad.

entries.yo: Bi ẹnikẹni ba li etí lati fi gbọ́, ki o gbọ́.
entries.en: If any man have ears to hear, let him hear.

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ mã kiyesi ohun ti ẹnyin ngbọ́: òṣuwọn ti ẹnyin ba fi wọ̀n, on li a o fi wọ̀n fun nyin: a o si fi kún u fun nyin.
entries.en: And he said unto them, Take heed what ye hear: with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured to you: and unto you that hear shall more be given.

entries.yo: Nitori ẹniti o ba ni, on li a o fifun: ati ẹniti kò ba si ni, lọwọ rẹ̀ li a o si gbà eyi na ti o ni.
entries.en: For he that hath, to him shall be given: and he that hath not, from him shall be taken even that which he hath.

entries.yo: O si wipe, Bẹ̃ sá ni ijọba Ọlọrun, o dabi ẹnipe ki ọkunrin kan funrugbin sori ilẹ;
entries.en: And he said, So is the kingdom of God, as if a man should cast seed into the ground;

entries.yo: Ki o si sùn, ki o si dide li oru ati li ọsán, ki irugbin na ki o si sọ jade ki o si dàgba, on kò si mọ̀ bi o ti ri.
entries.en: And should sleep, and rise night and day, and the seed should spring and grow up, he knoweth not how.

entries.yo: Nitori ilẹ a ma so eso jade fun ara rẹ̀; ekini ẽhù, lẹhinna ipẹ́, lẹhinna ikunmọ ọkà ninu ipẹ́.
entries.en: For the earth bringeth forth fruit of herself; first the blade, then the ear, after that the full corn in the ear.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati eso ba pọ́n tan, lojukanna on a tẹ̀ doje bọ inu rẹ̀ nitori igba ikorè de.
entries.en: But when the fruit is brought forth, immediately he putteth in the sickle, because the harvest is come.

entries.yo: O si wipe, Kili a o fi ijọba Ọlọrun we? tabi kili a ba fi ṣe akawe rẹ̀?
entries.en: And he said, Whereunto shall we liken the kingdom of God? or with what comparison shall we compare it?

entries.yo: O dabi wóro irugbin mustardi, eyiti, nigbati a gbin i si ilẹ, bi o tilẹ ṣe pe o kére jù gbogbo irugbin ti o wa ni ilẹ lọ,
entries.en: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, is less than all the seeds that be in the earth:

entries.yo: Sibẹ nigbati a gbin i o dàgba soke, o si di titobi jù gbogbo ewebẹ lọ, o si pa ẹká nla; tobẹ ti awọn ẹiyẹ oju ọrun le ma gbe abẹ ojiji rẹ̀.
entries.en: But when it is sown, it groweth up, and becometh greater than all herbs, and shooteth out great branches; so that the fowls of the air may lodge under the shadow of it.

entries.yo: Irù ọ̀pọ owe bẹ̃ li o fi mba wọn nsọ̀rọ, niwọn bi nwọn ti le gbà a si.
entries.en: And with many such parables spake he the word unto them, as they were able to hear it.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn on kì iba wọn sọrọ laìsi owe: nigbati o ba si kù awọn nikan, on a si sọ idi ohun gbogbo fun awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀.
entries.en: But without a parable spake he not unto them: and when they were alone, he expounded all things to his disciples.

entries.yo: Ni ijọ kanna, nigbati alẹ lẹ tan, o wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ jẹ ki a rekọja lọ si apá keji.
entries.en: And the same day, when the even was come, he saith unto them, Let us pass over unto the other side.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si ti tu ijọ ká, nwọn si gbà a gẹgẹ bi o ti wà sinu ọkọ̀. Awọn ọkọ̀ kekere miran pẹlu si wà lọdọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And when they had sent away the multitude, they took him even as he was in the ship. And there were also with him other little ships.

entries.yo: Ìji nla si dide, ìgbi si mbù sinu ọkọ̀, tobẹ̃ ti ọkọ̀ fi bẹ̀rẹ si ikún.
entries.en: And there arose a great storm of wind, and the waves beat into the ship, so that it was now full.

entries.yo: On pãpã si wà ni idi ọkọ̀, o nsùn lori irọri: nwọn si jí i, nwọn si wi fun u pe, Olukọni, iwọ ko bikita bi awa ṣegbé?
entries.en: And he was in the hinder part of the ship, asleep on a pillow: and they awake him, and say unto him, Master, carest thou not that we perish?

entries.yo: O si ji, o ba afẹfẹ na wi, o si wi fun okun pe, Dakẹ jẹ. Afẹfẹ si da, iparọrọ nla si de.
entries.en: And he arose, and rebuked the wind, and said unto the sea, Peace, be still. And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm.

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Ẽṣe ti ẹnyin fi nṣe ojo bẹ̃? ẹ kò ti iní igbagbọ sibẹ?
entries.en: And he said unto them, Why are ye so fearful? how is it that ye have no faith?

entries.yo: Ẹru si ba wọn gidigidi, nwọn si nwi fun ara wọn pe, Irú enia kili eyi, ti ati afẹfẹ ati okun gbọ́ tirẹ̀?
entries.en: And they feared exceedingly, and said one to another, What manner of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?

entries.yo: NWỌN si wá si apa keji okun ni ilẹ awọn ara Gadara.
entries.en: And they came over unto the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gadarenes.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si ti inu ọkọ̀ jade, lojukanna ọkunrin kan ti o li ẹmi aimọ pade rẹ̀, o nti ibi ibojì jade wá,
entries.en: And when he was come out of the ship, immediately there met him out of the tombs a man with an unclean spirit,

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ni ibugbe rẹ̀ ninu ibojì; kò si si ẹniti o le dè e, kò si, kì iṣe ẹ̀wọn:
entries.en: Who had his dwelling among the tombs; and no man could bind him, no, not with chains:

entries.yo: Nitoripe nigbapupọ li a ti nfi ṣẹkẹṣẹkẹ ati ẹ̀wọn de e, on a si dá ẹ̀wọn na meji, a si dá ṣẹkẹṣẹkẹ wẹ́wẹ: bẹ̃ni kò si ẹnikan ti o li agbara lati se e rọ̀.
entries.en: Because that he had been often bound with fetters and chains, and the chains had been plucked asunder by him, and the fetters broken in pieces: neither could any man tame him.

entries.yo: Ati nigbagbogbo, li ọsán ati li oru, o wà lori òke, ati ninu ibojì, a ma kigbe, a si ma fi okuta pa ara rẹ̀ lara.
entries.en: And always, night and day, he was in the mountains, and in the tombs, crying, and cutting himself with stones.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati o ri Jesu li òkere, o sare wá, o si foribalẹ fun u,
entries.en: But when he saw Jesus afar off, he ran and worshipped him,

entries.yo: O si nkigbe li ohùn rara, wipe, Kini ṣe temi tirẹ, Jesu, iwọ Ọmọ Ọlọrun Ọgá-ogo? mo fi Ọlọrun bẹ̀ ọ, ki iwọ ki o máṣe da mi loró.
entries.en: And cried with a loud voice, and said, What have I to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of the most high God? I adjure thee by God, that thou torment me not.

entries.yo: Nitoriti o wi fun u pe, Jade kuro lara ọkunrin na, iwọ ẹmi aimọ́.
entries.en: For he said unto him, Come out of the man, thou unclean spirit.

entries.yo: O si bi i lẽre pe, Orukọ rẹ? O si dahùn, wipe, Legioni li orukọ mi: nitori awa pọ̀.
entries.en: And he asked him, What is thy name? And he answered, saying, My name is Legion: for we are many.

entries.yo: O si bẹ̀ ẹ gidigidi pe, ki o máṣe rán wọn jade kuro ni ilẹ na.
entries.en: And he besought him much that he would not send them away out of the country.

entries.yo: Agbo ọ̀pọ ẹlẹdẹ kan si wà nibẹ ti njẹ lẹba oke.
entries.en: Now there was there nigh unto the mountains a great herd of swine feeding.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn ẹmi èṣu bẹ̀ ẹ wipe, Rán wa lọ sinu awọn ẹlẹdẹ, ki awa ki o le wọ̀ inu wọn lọ.
entries.en: And all the devils besought him, saying, Send us into the swine, that we may enter into them.

entries.yo: Lọgan Jesu si jọwọ wọn. Awọn ẹmi aimọ́ si jade, nwọn si wọ̀ inu awọn ẹlẹdẹ lọ: agbo ẹlẹdẹ si tupũ nwọn si sure ni gẹrẹgẹrẹ lọ sinu okun (nwọn si to ìwọn ẹgbã;) nwọn si kú sinu okun.
entries.en: And forthwith Jesus gave them leave. And the unclean spirits went out, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the sea, (they were about two thousand;) and were choked in the sea.

entries.yo: Awọn ti mbọ́ wọn si sá, nwọn si lọ ròhin ni ilu nla, atì ni ilẹ na. Nwọn si jade lọ lati wò ohun na ti o ṣe.
entries.en: And they that fed the swine fled, and told it in the city, and in the country. And they went out to see what it was that was done.

entries.yo: Nwọn si wá sọdọ Jesu, nwọn si ri ẹniti o ti ni ẹmi èṣu, ti o si ni Legioni na, o joko, o si wọṣọ, iyè rẹ̀ si bọ si ipò: ẹ̀ru si ba wọn.
entries.en: And they come to Jesus, and see him that was possessed with the devil, and had the legion, sitting, and clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.

entries.yo: Awọn ti o ri i si ròhin fun wọn bi o ti ri fun ẹniti o li ẹmi èṣu, ati ti awọn ẹlẹdẹ pẹlu.
entries.en: And they that saw it told them how it befell to him that was possessed with the devil, and also concerning the swine.

entries.yo: Nwọn si bẹ̀rẹ si ibẹ̀ ẹ, wipe, ki o lọ kuro li àgbegbe wọn.
entries.en: And they began to pray him to depart out of their coasts.

entries.yo: Bi o si ti nwọ̀ inu ọkọ̀, ẹniti o ti li ẹmi èṣu na o mbẹ ẹ, ki on ki o le mã bá a gbé.
entries.en: And when he was come into the ship, he that had been possessed with the devil prayed him that he might be with him.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Jesu kò gbà fun u, ṣugbọn o wi fun u pe, Lọ si ile rẹ ki o si sọ fun awọn ará ile rẹ, bi Oluwa ti ṣe ohun nla fun ọ, ati bi o si ti ṣanu fun ọ.
entries.en: Howbeit Jesus suffered him not, but saith unto him, Go home to thy friends, and tell them how great things the Lord hath done for thee, and hath had compassion on thee.

entries.yo: O si pada lọ, o bẹ̀rẹ si ima ròhin ni Dekapoli, ohun nla ti Jesu ṣe fun u: ẹnu si yà gbogbo enia.
entries.en: And he departed, and began to publish in Decapolis how great things Jesus had done for him: and all men did marvel.

entries.yo: Nigbati Jesu si tun ti inu ọkọ̀ kọja si apa keji, ọ̀pọ enia pejọ tì i: o si wà leti okun.
entries.en: And when Jesus was passed over again by ship unto the other side, much people gathered unto him: and he was nigh unto the sea.

entries.yo: Si wo o, ọkan ninu awọn olori sinagogu, ti a npè ni Jairu, wa sọdọ rẹ̀; nigbati o si ri i, o wolẹ lẹba ẹsẹ rẹ̀,
entries.en: And, behold, there cometh one of the rulers of the synagogue, Jairus by name; and when he saw him, he fell at his feet,

entries.yo: O si bẹ̀ ẹ gidigidi, wipe, Ọmọbinrin mi kekere wà loju ikú: mo bẹ̀ ọ ki o wá fi ọwọ́ rẹ le e, ki a le mu u larada: on o si yè.
entries.en: And besought him greatly, saying, My little daughter lieth at the point of death: I pray thee, come and lay thy hands on her, that she may be healed; and she shall live.

entries.yo: O si ba a lọ; ọ̀pọ enia si ntọ̀ ọ lẹhin, nwọn si nhá a li àye.
entries.en: And Jesus went with him; and much people followed him, and thronged him.

entries.yo: Obinrin kan ti o ti ni isun ẹ̀jẹ li ọdún mejila,
entries.en: And a certain woman, which had an issue of blood twelve years,

entries.yo: Ẹniti oju rẹ̀ si ri ohun pipọ lọdọ ọ̀pọ awọn oniṣegun, ti o si ti ná ohun gbogbo ti o ni tan, ti kò si sàn rara, ṣugbọn kàka bẹ̃ o npọ̀ siwaju.
entries.en: And had suffered many things of many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was nothing bettered, but rather grew worse,

entries.yo: Nigbati o gburo Jesu, o wá sẹhin rẹ̀ larin ọ̀pọ enia, o fọwọ́kàn aṣọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: When she had heard of Jesus, came in the press behind, and touched his garment.

entries.yo: Nitori o wipe, Bi mo ba sá le fi ọwọ́ mi kàn aṣọ rẹ̀, ara mi yio da.
entries.en: For she said, If I may touch but his clothes, I shall be whole.

entries.yo: Lọgan ni isun ẹ̀jẹ rẹ̀ si ti gbẹ; on si mọ̀ lara rẹ̀ pe, a mu on larada ninu arun na.
entries.en: And straightway the fountain of her blood was dried up; and she felt in her body that she was healed of that plague.

entries.yo: Lọgan Jesu si ti mọ̀ ninu ara rẹ̀ pe, aṣẹ ti ara on jade, o yipada larin ọpọ enia, o si wipe, Tali o fi ọwọ́ kàn mi li aṣọ?
entries.en: And Jesus, immediately knowing in himself that virtue had gone out of him, turned him about in the press, and said, Who touched my clothes?

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ wi fun u pe, Iwọ ri bi ijọ enia ti nhá ọ li àye, iwọ si nwipe, Tali o fi ọwọ́ tọ́ mi?
entries.en: And his disciples said unto him, Thou seest the multitude thronging thee, and sayest thou, Who touched me?

entries.yo: O si wò yiká lati ri ẹniti o ṣe nkan yi.
entries.en: And he looked round about to see her that had done this thing.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn obinrin na ni ibẹ̀ru ati iwarìri, bi o ti mọ̀ ohun ti a ṣe lara on, o wá, o si wolẹ niwaju rẹ̀, o si sọ gbogbo otitọ fun u.
entries.en: But the woman fearing and trembling, knowing what was done in her, came and fell down before him, and told him all the truth.

entries.yo: O si wi fun u pe, Ọmọbinrin, igbagbọ́ rẹ mu ọ larada; mã lọ li alafia, ki iwọ ki o si sàn ninu arun rẹ.
entries.en: And he said unto her, Daughter, thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace, and be whole of thy plague.

entries.yo: Bi o si ti nsọ̀rọ li ẹnu, awọn kan ti ile olori sinagogu wá ti o wipe, Ọmọbinrin rẹ kú: ẽṣe ti iwọ si fi nyọ olukọni lẹnu?
entries.en: While he yet spake, there came from the ruler of the synagogue's house certain which said, Thy daughter is dead: why troublest thou the Master any further?

entries.yo: Lojukanna bi Jesu ti gbọ́ ọ̀rọ na ti a sọ, o si wi fun olori sinagogu na pe, Má bẹ̀ru, sá gbagbọ́ nikan.
entries.en: As soon as Jesus heard the word that was spoken, he saith unto the ruler of the synagogue, Be not afraid, only believe.

entries.yo: Kò si jẹ ki ẹnikẹni tọ̀ on lẹhin, bikoṣe Peteru, ati Jakọbu, ati Johanu arakunrin Jakọbu.
entries.en: And he suffered no man to follow him, save Peter, and James, and John the brother of James.

entries.yo: O si wá si ile olori sinagogu, o si ri ariwo, ati awọn ti nsọkun ti nwọn si npohunrere ẹkún gidigidi.
entries.en: And he cometh to the house of the ruler of the synagogue, and seeth the tumult, and them that wept and wailed greatly.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si wọle, o wi fun wọn pe, Ẽṣe ti ẹnyin fi npariwo, ti ẹ si nsọkun? ọmọ na ko kú, ṣugbọn sisùn li o sùn.
entries.en: And when he was come in, he saith unto them, Why make ye this ado, and weep? the damsel is not dead, but sleepeth.

entries.yo: Nwọn si fi rẹrin ẹlẹya. Ṣugbọn nigbati o si tì gbogbo wọn jade, o mu baba ati iya ọmọ na, ati awọn ti o wà pẹlu rẹ̀, o si wọ̀ ibiti ọmọ na gbé dubulẹ si.
entries.en: And they laughed him to scorn. But when he had put them all out, he taketh the father and the mother of the damsel, and them that were with him, and entereth in where the damsel was lying.

entries.yo: O si mu ọmọ na li ọwọ́, o wi fun u pe, Talita kumi; itumọ eyi ti ijẹ Ọmọbinrin, mo wi fun ọ, Dide.
entries.en: And he took the damsel by the hand, and said unto her, Talitha cumi; which is, being interpreted, Damsel, I say unto thee, arise.

entries.yo: Lọgan ọmọbinrin na si dide, o si nrìn; nitori ọmọ ọdún mejila ni. Ẹ̀ru si ba wọn, ẹnu si yà wọn gidigidi.
entries.en: And straightway the damsel arose, and walked; for she was of the age of twelve years. And they were astonished with a great astonishment.

entries.yo: O si paṣe fun wọn gidigidi pe, ki ẹnikẹni ki o máṣe mọ̀ eyi; o si wipe, ki nwọn ki o fun u li onjẹ.
entries.en: And he charged them straitly that no man should know it; and commanded that something should be given her to eat.

entries.yo: O SI jade nibẹ̀, o wá si ilu on tikararẹ̀; awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ si tọ̀ ọ lẹhin.
entries.en: And he went out from thence, and came into his own country; and his disciples follow him.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si di ọjọ isimi, o bẹ̀rẹ si ikọni ninu sinagogu; ẹnu si yà awọn enia pipọ ti o gbọ́, nwọn wipe, Nibo li ọkunrin yi gbé ti ri nkan wọnyi? irú ọgbọ́n kili eyi ti a fifun u, ti irú iṣẹ agbara bayi nti ọwọ́ rẹ̀ ṣe?
entries.en: And when the sabbath day was come, he began to teach in the synagogue: and many hearing him were astonished, saying, From whence hath this man these things? and what wisdom is this which is given unto him, that even such mighty works are wrought by his hands?

entries.yo: Gbẹnagbẹna na kọ yi, ọmọ Maria, arakunrin Jakọbu, ati Jose, ati ti Juda, ati Simoni? awọn arabinrin rẹ̀ kò ha si wà nihinyi lọdọ wa? Nwọn si kọsẹ̀ lara rẹ̀.
entries.en: Is not this the carpenter, the son of Mary, the brother of James, and Joses, and of Juda, and Simon? and are not his sisters here with us? And they were offended at him.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Jesu wi fun wọn pe, Ko si woli ti o wà laili ọlá, bikoṣe ni ilu on tikararẹ̀, ati larin awọn ibatan rẹ̀, ati ninu ile rẹ̀.
entries.en: But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, but in his own country, and among his own kin, and in his own house.

entries.yo: On ko si le ṣe iṣẹ agbara kan nibẹ̀, jù pe o gbé ọwọ́ rẹ̀ le awọn alaisan diẹ, o si mu wọn larada.
entries.en: And he could there do no mighty work, save that he laid his hands upon a few sick folk, and healed them.

entries.yo: Ẹnu si yà a nitori aigbagbọ́ wọn. O si lọ si gbogbo iletò yiká, o nkọni.
entries.en: And he marvelled because of their unbelief. And he went round about the villages, teaching.

entries.yo: O si pè awọn mejila na sọdọ rẹ̀, o bẹ̀rẹ si irán wọn lọ ni meji-meji; o si fi aṣẹ fun wọn lori awọn ẹmi aimọ́;
entries.en: And he called unto him the twelve, and began to send them forth by two and two; and gave them power over unclean spirits;

entries.yo: O si paṣẹ fun wọn pe, ki nwọn ki o máṣe mu ohunkohun, lọ si àjo wọn, bikoṣe ọpá nikan; ki nwọn ki o máṣe mu àpo, tabi akara, tabi owo ninu asuwọn wọn:
entries.en: And commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, save a staff only; no scrip, no bread, no money in their purse:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ki nwọn ki o wọ̀ salubàta: ki nwọn máṣe wọ̀ ẹ̀wu meji.
entries.en: But be shod with sandals; and not put on two coats.

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Nibikibi ti ẹnyin ba wọ̀ ile kan, nibẹ̀ ni ki ẹ mã gbé titi ẹnyin o fi jade kuro nibẹ̀ na.
entries.en: And he said unto them, In what place soever ye enter into an house, there abide till ye depart from that place.

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni ti kò ba si gbà nyin, ti kò si gbọrọ̀ nyin, nigbati ẹnyin ba jade kuro nibẹ̀, ẹ gbọ̀n eruku ẹsẹ nyin fun ẹrí si wọn. Lõtọ ni mo wi fun nyin, yio san fun Sodomu ati Gomorra li ọjọ idajọ jù fun ilu nla na lọ.
entries.en: And whosoever shall not receive you, nor hear you, when ye depart thence, shake off the dust under your feet for a testimony against them. Verily I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment, than for that city.

entries.yo: Nwọn si jade lọ, nwọn si wasu ki awọn enia ki o le ronupiwada.
entries.en: And they went out, and preached that men should repent.

entries.yo: Nwọn si lé ọ̀pọ awọn ẹmi èṣu jade, nwọn si fi oróro kùn ọ̀pọ awọn ti ara wọn ṣe alaida, nwọn si mu wọn larada.
entries.en: And they cast out many devils, and anointed with oil many that were sick, and healed them.

entries.yo: Herodu ọba si gburo rẹ̀; (nitoriti okikí orukọ rẹ̀ kàn yiká:) o si wipe, Johanu Baptisti jinde kuro ninu oku, nitorina ni iṣẹ agbara ṣe nṣe lati ọwọ rẹ̀ wá.
entries.en: And king Herod heard of him; (for his name was spread abroad:) and he said, That John the Baptist was risen from the dead, and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him.

entries.yo: Awọn ẹlomiran wipe, Elijah ni. Ṣugbọn awọn miran wipe, Woli kan ni, tabi bi ọkan ninu awọn woli.
entries.en: Others said, That it is Elias. And others said, That it is a prophet, or as one of the prophets.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati Herodu gbọ́, o wipe, Johanu ni, ẹniti mo ti bẹ́ lori: on li o jinde kuro ninu okú.
entries.en: But when Herod heard thereof, he said, It is John, whom I beheaded: he is risen from the dead.

entries.yo: Herodu tikararẹ̀ sá ti ranṣẹ mu Johanu, o si dè e sinu tubu nitori Herodia, aya Filippi arakunrin rẹ̀: on sá ti fi i ṣe aya.
entries.en: For Herod himself had sent forth and laid hold upon John, and bound him in prison for Herodias' sake, his brother Philip's wife: for he had married her.

entries.yo: Johanu sá ti wi fun Herodu pe, kò tọ́ fun iwọ lati ni aya arakunrin rẹ.
entries.en: For John had said unto Herod, It is not lawful for thee to have thy brother's wife.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni Herodia ṣe ni i sinu, on si nfẹ ipa a; ṣugbọn kò le ṣe e:
entries.en: Therefore Herodias had a quarrel against him, and would have killed him; but she could not:

entries.yo: Nitori Herodu bẹ̀ru Johanu, o si mọ̀ ọ li olõtọ enia ati ẹni mimọ́, o si ntọju rẹ̀; nigbati o gbọrọ rẹ̀, o ṣe ohun pipọ, o si fi ayọ̀ gbọrọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: For Herod feared John, knowing that he was a just man and an holy, and observed him; and when he heard him, he did many things, and heard him gladly.

entries.yo: Nigbati ọjọ ti o wọ̀ si de, ti Herodu sàse ọjọ ibí rẹ̀ fun awọn ijoye rẹ̀, awọn balogun, ati awọn olori ni Galili;
entries.en: And when a convenient day was come, that Herod on his birthday made a supper to his lords, high captains, and chief estates of Galilee;

entries.yo: Nigbati ọmọbinrin Herodia si wọle, ti o si njó, o mu inu Herodu dùn ati awọn ti o ba a joko, ọba si wi fun ọmọbinrin na pe, Bère ohunkohun ti iwọ fẹ lọwọ mi, emi o si fifun ọ.
entries.en: And when the daughter of the said Herodias came in, and danced, and pleased Herod and them that sat with him, the king said unto the damsel, Ask of me whatsoever thou wilt, and I will give it thee.

entries.yo: O si bura fun u, wipe, Ohunkohun ti iwọ ba bere lọwọ mi, emi o si fifun ọ, titi fi de idameji ijọba mi.
entries.en: And he sware unto her, Whatsoever thou shalt ask of me, I will give it thee, unto the half of my kingdom.

entries.yo: O si jade lọ, o wi fun iya rẹ̀ pe, Kini ki emi ki o bère? On si wipe, Ori Johanu Baptisti.
entries.en: And she went forth, and said unto her mother, What shall I ask? And she said, The head of John the Baptist.

entries.yo: Lojukanna, o si wọle tọ̀ ọba wá kánkan, o bère, wipe, emi nfẹ ki iwọ ki o fi ori Johanu Baptisti fun mi ninu awopọkọ nisisiyi.
entries.en: And she came in straightway with haste unto the king, and asked, saying, I will that thou give me by and by in a charger the head of John the Baptist.

entries.yo: Inu ọba si bajẹ gidigidi; ṣugbọn nitori ibura rẹ̀, ati nitori awọn ti o bá a joko pọ̀, kò si fẹ ikọ̀ fun u.
entries.en: And the king was exceeding sorry; yet for his oath's sake, and for their sakes which sat with him, he would not reject her.

entries.yo: Lọgan ọba si rán ẹṣọ́ kan, o fi aṣẹ fun u pe, ki o gbé ori rẹ̀ wá: o si lọ, o bẹ́ Johanu lori ninu tubu.
entries.en: And immediately the king sent an executioner, and commanded his head to be brought: and he went and beheaded him in the prison,

entries.yo: O si gbé ori rẹ̀ wá ninu awopọkọ, o si fi fun ọmọbinrin na: ọmọbinrin na si fi fun iya rẹ̀.
entries.en: And brought his head in a charger, and gave it to the damsel: and the damsel gave it to her mother.

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ si gbọ́, nwọn wá, nwọn gbé okú rẹ̀, nwọn si lọ tẹ́ ẹ sinu ibojì.
entries.en: And when his disciples heard of it, they came and took up his corpse, and laid it in a tomb.

entries.yo: Awọn aposteli si kó ara wọn jọ sọdọ Jesu, nwọn si ròhin ohungbogbo ti nwọn ti ṣe fun u, ati ohungbogbo ti nwọn ti kọni.
entries.en: And the apostles gathered themselves together unto Jesus, and told him all things, both what they had done, and what they had taught.

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ wá ẹnyin tikaranyin si ibi ijù li apakan, ki ẹ si simi diẹ: nitori ọ̀pọlọpọ li awọn ti nwá ti nwọn si nlọ, nwọn kò tilẹ ri ãye tobẹ̃ ti nwọn iba fi jẹun.
entries.en: And he said unto them, Come ye yourselves apart into a desert place, and rest a while: for there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ba ti ọkọ̀ lọ si ibi ijù awọn nikan.
entries.en: And they departed into a desert place by ship privately.

entries.yo: Awọn enia si ri wọn nigbati nwọn nlọ, ọ̀pọlọpọ si mọ̀ ọ, nwọn si sare ba ti ẹsẹ lọ sibẹ̀ lati ilu nla gbogbo wá, nwọn si ṣiwaju wọn, nwọn si jùmọ wá sọdọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the people saw them departing, and many knew him, and ran afoot thither out of all cities, and outwent them, and came together unto him.

entries.yo: Nigbati Jesu jade, o ri ọ̀pọ enia, ãnu wọn ṣe e, nitoriti nwọn dabi awọn agutan ti kò li oluṣọ: o si bẹ̀rẹ si ima kọ́ wọn li ohun pipọ.
entries.en: And Jesus, when he came out, saw much people, and was moved with compassion toward them, because they were as sheep not having a shepherd: and he began to teach them many things.

entries.yo: Nigbati ọjọ si bù lọ tan, awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ tọ̀ ọ wá, wipe, Ibi ijù li eyi, ọjọ si bù lọ tan:
entries.en: And when the day was now far spent, his disciples came unto him, and said, This is a desert place, and now the time is far passed:

entries.yo: Rán wọn lọ, ki nwọn ki o le lọ si àgbegbe ilu, ati si iletò ti o yiká, ki nwọn ki o le rà onjẹ fun ara wọn: nitoriti nwọn kò li ohun ti nwọn o jẹ.
entries.en: Send them away, that they may go into the country round about, and into the villages, and buy themselves bread: for they have nothing to eat.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn o dahùn o si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ fun wọn li onjẹ. Nwọn si wi fun u pe, Awa o ha lọ irà akara igba owo idẹ ki a si fifun wọn jẹ?
entries.en: He answered and said unto them, Give ye them to eat. And they say unto him, Shall we go and buy two hundred pennyworth of bread, and give them to eat?

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Iṣu akara melo li ẹnyin ni? ẹ lọ wò o. Nigbati nwọn si mọ̀, nwọn wipe, Marun, pẹlu ẹja meji.
entries.en: He saith unto them, How many loaves have ye? go and see. And when they knew, they say, Five, and two fishes.

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, ki nwọn ki o mu gbogbo wọn joko li ẹgbẹgbẹ lori koriko.
entries.en: And he commanded them to make all sit down by companies upon the green grass.

entries.yo: Nwọn si joko li ẹgbẹgbẹ li ọrọrun ati li aradọta.
entries.en: And they sat down in ranks, by hundreds, and by fifties.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si mu iṣu akara marun ati ẹja meji na, o gbé oju soke, o si sure, o si bù iṣu akara na, o si fifun awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀, ki nwọn ki o gbé e kalẹ niwaju wọn; ati awọn ẹja meji na li o si pín fun gbogbo wọn.
entries.en: And when he had taken the five loaves and the two fishes, he looked up to heaven, and blessed, and brake the loaves, and gave them to his disciples to set before them; and the two fishes divided he among them all.

entries.yo: Gbogbo wọn si jẹ, nwọn si yó.
entries.en: And they did all eat, and were filled.

entries.yo: Nwọn si kó agbọ̀n mejila kún fun ajẹkù, ati ti ẹja pẹlu.
entries.en: And they took up twelve baskets full of the fragments, and of the fishes.

entries.yo: Awọn ti o si jẹ ìṣu akara na to iwọn ẹgbẹdọgbọn ọkunrin.
entries.en: And they that did eat of the loaves were about five thousand men.

entries.yo: Lojukanna li o si rọ̀ awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ lati bọ sinu ọkọ̀, ki nwọn ki o si ṣiwaju lọ si apa keji si Betsaida, nigbati on tikararẹ̀ tú awọn enia ká.
entries.en: And straightway he constrained his disciples to get into the ship, and to go to the other side before unto Bethsaida, while he sent away the people.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si rán wọn lọ tan, o gùn ori òke lọ igbadura.
entries.en: And when he had sent them away, he departed into a mountain to pray.

entries.yo: Nigbati alẹ si lẹ, ọkọ̀ si wà larin okun, on nikan si wà ni ilẹ.
entries.en: And when even was come, the ship was in the midst of the sea, and he alone on the land.

entries.yo: O si ri nwọn nṣiṣẹ ni wiwà ọkọ̀; nitoriti afẹfẹ ṣe ọwọ òdi si wọn: nigbati o si di ìwọn iṣọ kẹrin oru, o tọ̀ wọn wá, o nrìn lori okun, on si nfẹ ré wọn kọja.
entries.en: And he saw them toiling in rowing; for the wind was contrary unto them: and about the fourth watch of the night he cometh unto them, walking upon the sea, and would have passed by them.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati nwọn ri ti o nrìn loju omi, nwọn ṣebi iwin ni, nwọn si kigbe soke:
entries.en: But when they saw him walking upon the sea, they supposed it had been a spirit, and cried out:

entries.yo: Nitori gbogbo wọn li o ri i, ti ẹ̀ru si ba wọn. Ṣugbọn lojukanna o si ba wọn sọ̀rọ, o si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ tújuka: Emi ni; ẹ má bẹ̀ru.
entries.en: For they all saw him, and were troubled. And immediately he talked with them, and saith unto them, Be of good cheer: it is I; be not afraid.

entries.yo: O si wọ̀ inu ọkọ̀ tọ̀ wọn lọ; afẹfẹ si da: ẹ̀ru si ba wọn rekọja gidigidi ninu ara wọn, ẹnu si yà wọn.
entries.en: And he went up unto them into the ship; and the wind ceased: and they were sore amazed in themselves beyond measure, and wondered.

entries.yo: Nwọn kò sá ronu iṣẹ iyanu ti iṣu akara: nitoriti ọkàn wọn le.
entries.en: For they considered not the miracle of the loaves: for their heart was hardened.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si rekọja tan, nwọn de ilẹ awọn ara Genesareti, nwọn si sunmọ eti ilẹ.
entries.en: And when they had passed over, they came into the land of Gennesaret, and drew to the shore.

entries.yo: Bi nwọn si ti njade lati inu ọkọ̀ wá, lojukanna nwọn si mọ̀ ọ,
entries.en: And when they were come out of the ship, straightway they knew him,

entries.yo: Nwọn si sare lọ si gbogbo igberiko yiká, nwọn bẹ̀rẹ si ima gbé awọn ti ara wọn ṣe alaida wá lori akete, si ibiti nwọn gbọ́ pe o wà.
entries.en: And ran through that whole region round about, and began to carry about in beds those that were sick, where they heard he was.

entries.yo: Nibikibi ti o ba si gbé wọ̀, ni iletò gbogbo, tabi ilu nla, tabi arọko, nwọn ngbé olokunrun kalẹ ni igboro, nwọn si bẹ̀ ẹ pe, ki nwọn ki o sá le fi ọwọ́ kàn iṣẹti aṣọ rẹ̀: ìwọn awọn ti o si fi ọwọ́ kàn a, a mu wọn larada.
entries.en: And whithersoever he entered, into villages, or cities, or country, they laid the sick in the streets, and besought him that they might touch if it were but the border of his garment: and as many as touched him were made whole.

entries.yo: AWỌN Farisi si pejọ sọdọ rẹ̀, ati awọn kan ninu awọn akọwe ti nwọn ti Jerusalemu wá.
entries.en: Then came together unto him the Pharisees, and certain of the scribes, which came from Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn ri omiran ninu awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ nfi ọwọ aimọ́ jẹun, eyini ni li aiwẹ̀ ọwọ́, nwọn mba wọn wijọ.
entries.en: And when they saw some of his disciples eat bread with defiled, that is to say, with unwashen, hands, they found fault.

entries.yo: Nitori awọn Farisi, ati gbogbo awọn Ju, bi nwọn ko ba wẹ̀ ọwọ́ wọn gidigidi, nwọn ki ijẹun, nitoriti nwọn npa ofin atọwọdọwọ awọn àgba mọ́.
entries.en: For the Pharisees, and all the Jews, except they wash their hands oft, eat not, holding the tradition of the elders.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn ba si ti ọjà bọ̀, bi nwọn ko ba wẹ̀, nwọn ki ijẹun, ọ̀pọlọpọ ohun miran li o si wà, ti nwọn ti gbà lati mã fiyesi, bi fifọ ago, ati ikòko, ati ohunèlo idẹ, ati akete.
entries.en: And when they come from the market, except they wash, they eat not. And many other things there be, which they have received to hold, as the washing of cups, and pots, brasen vessels, and of tables.

entries.yo: Nigbana li awọn Farisi ati awọn akọwe bi i lẽre, wipe, Ẽṣe ti awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ ko rìn gẹgẹ bi ofin atọwọdọwọ awọn àgba, ṣugbọn nwọn nfi ọwọ aimọ́ jẹun?
entries.en: Then the Pharisees and scribes asked him, Why walk not thy disciples according to the tradition of the elders, but eat bread with unwashen hands?

entries.yo: O dahùn o si wi fun wọn pe, Otitọ ni Isaiah sọtẹlẹ nipa ti ẹnyin agabagebe, bi a ti kọ ọ pe, Awọn enia yi nfi ète wọn bọla fun mi, ṣugbọn ọkàn wọn jìna si mi.
entries.en: He answered and said unto them, Well hath Esaias prophesied of you hypocrites, as it is written, This people honoureth me with their lips, but their heart is far from me.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn lasan ni nwọn ntẹriba fun mi, ti nwọn nfi ofin enia kọ́ni fun ẹkọ́.
entries.en: Howbeit in vain do they worship me, teaching for doctines the commandments of men.

entries.yo: Nitoriti ẹnyin fi ofin Ọlọrun si apakan, ẹnyin nfiyesi ofin atọwọdọwọ ti enia, bi irú wiwẹ̀ ohun-èlo ati ago: ati irú ohun miran pipọ bẹ̃ li ẹnyin nṣe.
entries.en: For laying aside the commandment of God, ye hold the tradition of men, as the washing of pots and cups: and many other such like things ye do.

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Lõtọ li ẹnyin kọ̀ ofin Ọlọrun silẹ, ki ẹnyin ki o le pa ofin atọwọdọwọ ti nyin mọ́.
entries.en: And he said unto them, Full well ye reject the commandment of God, that ye may keep your own tradition.

entries.yo: Mose sá wipe, Bọ̀wọ fun baba on iya rẹ; ati Ẹnikẹni ti o ba sọrọ baba tabi iya rẹ̀ ni buburu, ẹ jẹ ki o kú ikú rẹ̀ na:
entries.en: For Moses said, Honour thy father and thy mother; and, Whoso curseth father or mother, let him die the death:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹnyin wipe, Bi enia ba wi fun baba tabi iya rẹ̀ pe, ohunkohun ti iwọ iba fi jère lara mi, Korbani ni, eyini ni Ẹbùn, o bọ́.
entries.en: But ye say, If a man shall say to his father or mother, It is Corban, that is to say, a gift, by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me; he shall be free.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li ẹnyin ko si jẹ ki o ṣe ohunkohun fun baba tabi iya rẹ̀ mọ́;
entries.en: And ye suffer him no more to do ought for his father or his mother;

entries.yo: Ẹnyin nfi ofin atọwọdọwọ ti nyin, ti ẹ fi le ilẹ, sọ ọ̀rọ Ọlọrun di asan; ati ọpọ iru nkan bẹ̃ li ẹnyin nṣe.
entries.en: Making the word of God of none effect through your tradition, which ye have delivered: and many such like things do ye.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si pè gbogbo awọn enia sọdọ rẹ̀, o wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ fi etí si mi olukuluku nyin, ẹ si kiyesi i:
entries.en: And when he had called all the people unto him, he said unto them, Hearken unto me every one of you, and understand:

entries.yo: Kò si ohunkokun lati ode enia, ti o wọ̀ inu rẹ̀ lọ, ti o le sọ ọ di alaimọ́: ṣugbọn nkan wọnni ti o ti inu rẹ̀ jade, awọn wọnni ni isọ enia di alaimọ́.
entries.en: There is nothing from without a man, that entering into him can defile him: but the things which come out of him, those are they that defile the man.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba li etí lati fi gbọ́, ki o gbọ́.
entries.en: If any man have ears to hear, let him hear.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si ti ọdọ awọn enia kuro wọ̀ inu ile, awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ si bi i lẽre niti owe na.
entries.en: And when he was entered into the house from the people, his disciples asked him concerning the parable.

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹnyin pẹlu wà li aimoye tobẹ̃? ẹnyin ko kuku kiyesi pe, ohunkohun ti o wọ̀ inu enia lati ode lọ, ko le sọni di alaimọ́;
entries.en: And he saith unto them, Are ye so without understanding also? Do ye not perceive, that whatsoever thing from without entereth into the man, it cannot defile him;

entries.yo: Nitoriti ko lọ sinu ọkàn rẹ̀, ṣugbọn sinu ara, a si yà a jade, a si gbá gbogbo onjẹ danù?
entries.en: Because it entereth not into his heart, but into the belly, and goeth out into the draught, purging all meats?

entries.yo: O si wipe, Eyi ti o ti inu enia jade, eyini ni isọ enia di alaimọ́.
entries.en: And he said, That which cometh out of the man, that defileth the man.

entries.yo: Nitori lati inu, lati inu ọkàn enia ni iro buburu ti ijade wá, panṣaga, àgbere, ipania,
entries.en: For from within, out of the heart of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, fornications, murders,

entries.yo: Olè, ojukòkoro, iwa buburu, itanjẹ, wọ̀bia, oju buburu, isọrọ-odi, igberaga, iwère:
entries.en: Thefts, covetousness, wickedness, deceit, lasciviousness, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, foolishness:

entries.yo: Lati inu wá ni gbogbo nkan buburu wọnyi ti ijade, nwọn a si sọ enia di alaimọ́.
entries.en: All these evil things come from within, and defile the man.

entries.yo: O si dide ti ibẹ̀ kuro, o si lọ si àgbegbe Tire on Sidoni, o si wọ̀ inu ile kan, ko si fẹ ki ẹnikẹni ki o mọ̀: ṣugbọn on kò le fi ara pamọ́.
entries.en: And from thence he arose, and went into the borders of Tyre and Sidon, and entered into an house, and would have no man know it: but he could not be hid.

entries.yo: Nitori obinrin kan, ẹniti ọmọbinrin rẹ̀ kekere li ẹmi aimọ́ gburo rẹ̀, o wá, o si wolẹ lẹba ẹsẹ rẹ̀:
entries.en: For a certain woman, whose young daughter had an unclean spirit, heard of him, and came and fell at his feet:

entries.yo: Hellene si li obinrin na, Sirofenikia ni orilẹ-ède rẹ̀; o si bẹ̀ ẹ ki on iba lé ẹmi èṣu na jade lara ọmọbinrin rẹ̀.
entries.en: The woman was a Greek, a Syrophenician by nation; and she besought him that he would cast forth the devil out of her daughter.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Jesu wi fun u pe, Jẹ ki a kọ́ fi onjẹ tẹ awọn ọmọ lọrun na: nitoriti ko tọ́ lati mu onjẹ awọn ọmọ, ki a si fi i fun ajá.
entries.en: But Jesus said unto her, Let the children first be filled: for it is not meet to take the children's bread, and to cast it unto the dogs.

entries.yo: O si dahùn o si wi fun u pe, Bẹni Oluwa: ṣugbọn awọn ajá pãpã a ma jẹ ẹrún awọn ọmọ labẹ tabili.
entries.en: And she answered and said unto him, Yes, Lord: yet the dogs under the table eat of the children's crumbs.

entries.yo: O si wi fun u pe, Nitori ọ̀rọ yi, mã lọ; ẹmi ẹ̀ṣu na ti jade kuro lara ọmọbinrin rẹ.
entries.en: And he said unto her, For this saying go thy way; the devil is gone out of thy daughter.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si pada wá si ile rẹ̀, o ri pe ẹmi èṣu na ti jade, ọmọbinrin rẹ̀ si sùn lori akete.
entries.en: And when she was come to her house, she found the devil gone out, and her daughter laid upon the bed.

entries.yo: O si tun lọ kuro li àgbegbe Tire on Sidoni, o wá si okun Galili larin àgbegbe Dekapoli.
entries.en: And again, departing from the coasts of Tyre and Sidon, he came unto the sea of Galilee, through the midst of the coasts of Decapolis.

entries.yo: Nwọn si mu enia kan wá sọdọ rẹ̀ ti etí rẹ̀ di, ti o si nkólolo; nwọn si bẹ̀ ẹ pe, ki o gbé ọwọ́ rẹ̀ le e.
entries.en: And they bring unto him one that was deaf, and had an impediment in his speech; and they beseech him to put his hand upon him.

entries.yo: O si mu u kuro larin ijọ enia lọ si apakan, o si tẹ ika rẹ̀ bọ̀ ọ li etí, nigbati o tutọ́, o si fi ọwọ́ tọ́ ọ li ahọn;
entries.en: And he took him aside from the multitude, and put his fingers into his ears, and he spit, and touched his tongue;

entries.yo: O si gbé oju soke wo ọrun, o kẹdùn, o si wi fun u pe, Efata, eyini ni, Iwọ ṣí.
entries.en: And looking up to heaven, he sighed, and saith unto him, Ephphatha, that is, Be opened.

entries.yo: Lojukanna, etì rẹ̀ si ṣí, okùn ahọn rẹ̀ si tú, o si nsọrọ ketekete.
entries.en: And straightway his ears were opened, and the string of his tongue was loosed, and he spake plain.

entries.yo: O si paṣẹ fun wọn pe, ki nwọn ki o máṣe sọ fun ẹnikẹni: ṣugbọn bi o ti npaṣẹ fun wọn to, bẹ̃ ni nwọn si nkokikí rẹ̀ to;
entries.en: And he charged them that they should tell no man: but the more he charged them, so much the more a great deal they published it;

entries.yo: Ẹnu si yà wọn gidigidi rekọja, nwọn wipe, O ṣe ohun gbogbo daradara: o mu aditi gbọran, o si mu ki odi fọhun.
entries.en: And were beyond measure astonished, saying, He hath done all things well: he maketh both the deaf to hear, and the dumb to speak.

entries.yo: LI ọjọ wọnni nigbati ijọ enia pọ̀ gidigidi, ti nwọn ko si li onjẹ, Jesu pè awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ sọdọ rẹ̀, o si wi fun wọn pe,
entries.en: In those days the multitude being very great, and having nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples unto him, and saith unto them,

entries.yo: Ãnu ijọ enia nṣe mi, nitoriti o di ijọ mẹta nisisiyi ti nwọn ti wà lọdọ mi, nwọn kò si li ohun ti nwọn o jẹ:
entries.en: I have compassion on the multitude, because they have now been with me three days, and have nothing to eat:

entries.yo: Bi emi ba si rán wọn lọ si ile wọn li ebi, ãrẹ̀ yio mu wọn li ọ̀na: nitori ninu wọn ti ọ̀na jijìn wá.
entries.en: And if I send them away fasting to their own houses, they will faint by the way: for divers of them came from far.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ si da a lohùn wipe, Nibo li a ó gbé ti le fi akara tẹ́ awọn enia wọnyi lọrùn li aginjù yi?
entries.en: And his disciples answered him, From whence can a man satisfy these men with bread here in the wilderness?

entries.yo: O si bi wọn lẽre, wipe, Iṣu akara melo li ẹnyin ni? Nwọn si wipe, Meje.
entries.en: And he asked them, How many loaves have ye? And they said, Seven.

entries.yo: O si paṣẹ ki awọn enia joko ni ilẹ: o si mu iṣu akara meje na, o dupẹ, o bu u, o si fifun awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀, ki nwọn ki o gbé e kalẹ niwaju wọn; nwọn si gbé e kalẹ niwaju awọn enia.
entries.en: And he commanded the people to sit down on the ground: and he took the seven loaves, and gave thanks, and brake, and gave to his disciples to set before them; and they did set them before the people.

entries.yo: Nwọn si li ẹja kekeke diẹ: o si sure, o si ni ki a fi wọn siwaju wọn pẹlu.
entries.en: And they had a few small fishes: and he blessed, and commanded to set them also before them.

entries.yo: Nwọn si jẹ, nwọn si yó: nwọn si kó ajẹkù ti o kù jọ agbọ̀n meje.
entries.en: So they did eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets.

entries.yo: Awọn ti o jẹ ẹ to ìwọn ẹgbãji enia: o si rán wọn lọ.
entries.en: And they that had eaten were about four thousand: and he sent them away.

entries.yo: Lojukanna, o si wọ̀ ọkọ̀ pẹlu awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀, o si wá si apa ìha Dalmanuta.
entries.en: And straightway he entered into a ship with his disciples, and came into the parts of Dalmanutha.

entries.yo: Awọn Farisi si jade wá, nwọn bẹrẹ si bi i lẽre, nwọn nfẹ àmi lati ọrun wá lọwọ rẹ̀, nwọn ndán a wò.
entries.en: And the Pharisees came forth, and began to question with him, seeking of him a sign from heaven, tempting him.

entries.yo: O si kẹdùn gidigidi ninu ọkàn rẹ̀, o si wipe, Ẽṣe ti iran yi fi nwá àmi? lõtọ ni mo wi fun nyin, Ko si àmi ti a o fifun iran yi.
entries.en: And he sighed deeply in his spirit, and saith, Why doth this generation seek after a sign? verily I say unto you, There shall no sign be given unto this generation.

entries.yo: O si fi wọn silẹ o si tún bọ sinu ọkọ̀ rekọja lọ si apa ekeji.
entries.en: And he left them, and entering into the ship again departed to the other side.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ si gbagbé lati mu akara lọwọ, nwọn kò si ni jù iṣu akara kan ninu ọkọ̀ pẹlu wọn.
entries.en: Now the disciples had forgotten to take bread, neither had they in the ship with them more than one loaf.

entries.yo: O si kìlọ fun wọn, wipe, Ẹ kiyesara, ki ẹ ma ṣọra nitori iwukara awọn Farisi ati iwukara Herodu.
entries.en: And he charged them, saying, Take heed, beware of the leaven of the Pharisees, and of the leaven of Herod.

entries.yo: Nwọn si mba ara wọn ṣe aroye, wipe, Nitoriti awa kò mu akara lọwọ ni.
entries.en: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, It is because we have no bread.

entries.yo: Nigbati Jesu si mọ̀, o wi fun wọn pe, Ẽṣe ti ẹnyin fi nṣàroye pe ẹnyin ko ni akara lọwọ? ẹnyin ko ti ikiyesi titi di isisiyi, ẹ ko si ti iwoye, ẹnyin si li ọkàn lile titi di isisiyi?
entries.en: And when Jesus knew it, he saith unto them, Why reason ye, because ye have no bread? perceive ye not yet, neither understand? have ye your heart yet hardened?

entries.yo: Ẹnyin li oju ẹnyin kò si riran? ẹnyin li etí, ẹnyin kò si gbọran? ẹnyin kò si ranti?
entries.en: Having eyes, see ye not? and having ears, hear ye not? and do ye not remember?

entries.yo: Nigbati mo bu iṣu akara marun larin ẹgbẹdọgbọn enia, agbọ̀n melo li o kún fun ajẹkù ti ẹnyin kójọ? Nwọn si wi fun u pe, Mejila.
entries.en: When I brake the five loaves among five thousand, how many baskets full of fragments took ye up? They say unto him, Twelve.

entries.yo: Ati nigba iṣu akara meje larin ẹgbaji enia, agbọ̀n melo li o kún fun ajẹkù ti ẹnyin kójọ? Nwọn si wipe, Meje.
entries.en: And when the seven among four thousand, how many baskets full of fragments took ye up? And they said, Seven.

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Ẽha ti ṣe ti kò fi yé nyin?
entries.en: And he said unto them, How is it that ye do not understand?

entries.yo: O si wá si Betsaida; nwọn si mu afọju kan wá sọdọ rẹ̀, nwọn si bẹ̀ ẹ pe, ki o fi ọwọ́ kàn a.
entries.en: And he cometh to Bethsaida; and they bring a blind man unto him, and besought him to touch him.

entries.yo: O si mu afọju na li ọwọ́, o si fà a jade lọ sẹhin ilu; nigbati o si tutọ́ si i loju, ti o si gbé ọwọ́ rẹ̀ le e, o bi i lẽre bi o ri ohunkohun.
entries.en: And he took the blind man by the hand, and led him out of the town; and when he had spit on his eyes, and put his hands upon him, he asked him if he saw ought.

entries.yo: O si wòke, o si wipe, Mo ri awọn enia dabi igi, nwọn nrìn.
entries.en: And he looked up, and said, I see men as trees, walking.

entries.yo: Lẹhin eyini o si tún fi ọwọ́ kàn a loju, o si mu ki o wòke: o si sàn, o si ri gbogbo enia gbangba.
entries.en: After that he put his hands again upon his eyes, and made him look up: and he was restored, and saw every man clearly.

entries.yo: O si rán a pada lọ si ile rẹ̀, wipe, Máṣe lọ si ilu, ki o má si sọ ọ fun ẹnikẹni ni ilu.
entries.en: And he sent him away to his house, saying, Neither go into the town, nor tell it to any in the town.

entries.yo: Jesu si jade, ati awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ lọ si awọn ileto Kesarea Filippi: o si bi awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ lẽre li ọna nwi fun wọn pe, Tali awọn enia nfi mi pè?
entries.en: And Jesus went out, and his disciples, into the towns of Caesarea Philippi: and by the way he asked his disciples, saying unto them, Whom do men say that I am?

entries.yo: Nwọn si dahùn wipe, Johanu Baptisti: ẹlomiran si wipe Elijah; ṣugbọn awọn ẹlomiran wipe, Ọkan ninu awọn woli.
entries.en: And they answered, John the Baptist: but some say, Elias; and others, One of the prophets.

entries.yo: O si bi wọn pe, Ṣugbọn tali ẹnyin nfi mi pè? Peteru si dahùn o si wi fun u pe, Iwọ ni Kristi na.
entries.en: And he saith unto them, But whom say ye that I am? And Peter answereth and saith unto him, Thou art the Christ.

entries.yo: O si kìlọ fun wọn pe, ki nwọn ki o máṣe sọ̀rọ on fun ẹnikan.
entries.en: And he charged them that they should tell no man of him.

entries.yo: O si bẹ̀rẹ si ikọ́ wọn, pe, Ọmọ-enia ko le ṣaima jìya ohun pipọ, a o si kọ̀ ọ lati ọdọ awọn àgbagba ati awọn olori alufa, ati awọn akọwe, a o si pa a, lẹhin ijọ mẹta yio si jinde.
entries.en: And he began to teach them, that the Son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected of the elders, and of the chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.

entries.yo: O si sọ ọ̀rọ na ni gbangba. Peteru si mu u, o bẹ̀rẹ si iba a wi.
entries.en: And he spake that saying openly. And Peter took him, and began to rebuke him.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn o yipada o si wò awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀, o si ba Peteru wi, o ni, Kuro lẹhin mi, Satani: nitori iwọ ko ro ohun ti Ọlọrun bikoṣe ohun ti enia.
entries.en: But when he had turned about and looked on his disciples, he rebuked Peter, saying, Get thee behind me, Satan: for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but the things that be of men.

entries.yo: O si pè ijọ enia sọdọ rẹ̀, pẹlu awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀, o wi fun wọn pe Bi ẹnikẹni ba fẹ tọ̀ mi lẹhin, ki o sẹ ara rẹ̀, ki o si gbé agbelebu rẹ̀, ki o si mã tọ̀ mi lẹhin.
entries.en: And when he had called the people unto him with his disciples also, he said unto them, Whosoever will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

entries.yo: Nitori ẹnikẹni ti o ba fẹ gbà ẹmí rẹ̀ là, yio sọ ọ nù: ṣugbọn ẹnikẹni ti o ba sọ ẹmí rẹ̀ nù nitori mi ati nitori ihinrere, on na ni yio gbà a là.
entries.en: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it; but whosoever shall lose his life for my sake and the gospel's, the same shall save it.

entries.yo: Nitoripe ère kini fun enia, bi o jère gbogbo aiye, ti o si sọ ẹmi rẹ̀ nù?
entries.en: For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul?

entries.yo: Tabi kili enia iba fi ṣe paṣiparọ ẹmi rẹ̀?
entries.en: Or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?

entries.yo: Nitori ẹnikẹni ti o ba tiju mi, ati ọ̀rọ mi, ni iran panṣaga ati ẹlẹsẹ yi, on na pẹlu li Ọmọ-enia yio tiju rẹ̀, nigbati o ba de ninu ogo Baba rẹ̀ pẹlu awọn angẹli mimọ́.
entries.en: Whosoever therefore shall be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation; of him also shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he cometh in the glory of his Father with the holy angels.

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Lõtọ ni mo wi fun nyin, Ẹlomiran wà ninu awọn ti o duro nihinyi, ti kì yio tọ́ iku wò, titi nwọn o fi ri ti ijọba Ọlọrun yio fi de pẹlu agbara.
entries.en: And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That there be some of them that stand here, which shall not taste of death, till they have seen the kingdom of God come with power.

entries.yo: Lẹhin ijọ mẹfa Jesu si mu Peteru, ati Jakọbu, ati Johanu, o si mu wọn lọ sori òke giga li apakan awọn nikan: ara rẹ̀ si yipada niwaju wọn.
entries.en: And after six days Jesus taketh with him Peter, and James, and John, and leadeth them up into an high mountain apart by themselves: and he was transfigured before them.

entries.yo: Aṣọ rẹ̀ si di didán, o si funfun gidigidi; afọṣọ kan li aiye kò le fọ̀ aṣọ fún bi iru rẹ̀.
entries.en: And his raiment became shining, exceeding white as snow; so as no fuller on earth can white them.

entries.yo: Elijah pẹlu Mose si farahàn fun wọn: nwọn si mba Jesu sọ̀rọ.
entries.en: And there appeared unto them Elias with Moses: and they were talking with Jesus.

entries.yo: Peteru si dahùn o si wi fun Jesu pe, Olukọni, o dara fun wa lati ma gbé ihinyi: si jẹ ki a pa agọ́ mẹta, ọkan fun ọ, ati ọkan fun Mose, ati ọkan fun Elijah.
entries.en: And Peter answered and said to Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.

entries.yo: On kò sá mọ̀ eyi ti iba wi; nitori ẹ̀ru bà wọn gidigidi.
entries.en: For he wist not what to say; for they were sore afraid.

entries.yo: Ikuku kan si wá, o ṣiji bò wọn; ohùn kan si ti inu ikuku na wá, o ni, Eyiyi li ayanfẹ Ọmọ mi: ẹ mã gbọ́ tirẹ̀.
entries.en: And there was a cloud that overshadowed them: and a voice came out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son: hear him.

entries.yo: Lojiji, nigbati nwọn si wò yika, nwọn ko si ri ẹnikan mọ́, bikoṣe Jesu nikan pẹlu ara wọn.
entries.en: And suddenly, when they had looked round about, they saw no man any more, save Jesus only with themselves.

entries.yo: Bi nwọn si ti nti ori òke sọkalẹ, o paṣẹ fun wọn pe, ki nwọn ki o máṣe sọ ohun ti nwọn ri fun ẹnikan, bikoṣe igbati Ọmọ-enia ba ti jinde kuro ninu okú.
entries.en: And as they came down from the mountain, he charged them that they should tell no man what things they had seen, till the Son of man were risen from the dead.

entries.yo: Nwọn si fi ọ̀rọ na pamọ́ sinu ara wọn, nwọn si mbi ara wọn lẽre, kili ajinde kuro ninu okú iba jẹ.
entries.en: And they kept that saying with themselves, questioning one with another what the rising from the dead should mean.

entries.yo: Nwọn si bi i lẽre, wipe, Ẽṣe ti awọn akọwe fi nwipe, Elijah ni yio tètekọ de?
entries.en: And they asked him, saying, Why say the scribes that Elias must first come?

entries.yo: O si dahùn o si wi fun wọn pe, Lõtọ, ni Elijah yio tètekọ, de, yio si mu nkan gbogbo pada si ipò; ati gẹgẹ bi a ti kọwe rẹ̀ nipa ti Ọmọ-enia pe, ko le ṣaima jìya ohun pipọ, ati pe a o si kọ̀ ọ silẹ.
entries.en: And he answered and told them, Elias verily cometh first, and restoreth all things; and how it is written of the Son of man, that he must suffer many things, and be set at nought.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn mo wi fun nyin pe, Elijah ti de na, nwọn si ti ṣe ohunkohun ti o wù wọn si i, gẹgẹ bi a ti kọwe nipa rẹ̀.
entries.en: But I say unto you, That Elias is indeed come, and they have done unto him whatsoever they listed, as it is written of him.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si de ọdọ awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀, nwọn ri ijọ enia pipọ lọdọ wọn, awọn akọwe si mbi wọn lẽre ọ̀ran.
entries.en: And when he came to his disciples, he saw a great multitude about them, and the scribes questioning with them.

entries.yo: Lọgan nigbati gbogbo enia si ri i, ẹnu si yà wọn gidigidi, nwọn si sare tọ ọ nwọn nki i.
entries.en: And straightway all the people, when they beheld him, were greatly amazed, and running to him saluted him.

entries.yo: O si bi awọn akọwe, wipe, Kili ẹnyin mbère lọwọ wọn?
entries.en: And he asked the scribes, What question ye with them?

entries.yo: Ọkan ninu ijọ enia na si dahùn, wipe, Olukọni, mo mu ọmọ mi ti o ni odi, ẹmi tọ̀ ọ wá;
entries.en: And one of the multitude answered and said, Master, I have brought unto thee my son, which hath a dumb spirit;

entries.yo: Nibikibi ti o ba gbé si mu u, a si ma nà a tantan: on a si ma yọ ifofó li ẹnu, a si ma pahin keke, a si ma daku; mo si sọ fun awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ, ki nwọn lé e jade; nwọn ko si le ṣe e.
entries.en: And wheresoever he taketh him, he teareth him: and he foameth, and gnasheth with his teeth, and pineth away: and I spake to thy disciples that they should cast him out; and they could not.

entries.yo: O si da wọn lohùn, o si wipe, Iran alaigbagbọ́ yi, emi o ti ba nyin gbé pẹ to? emi o si ti mu sũru fun nyin pẹ to? ẹ mu u wá sọdọ mi.
entries.en: He answereth him, and saith, O faithless generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him unto me.

entries.yo: Nwọn si mu u wá sọdọ rẹ̀: nigbati o si ri i, lojukanna ẹmi nã nà a tantan; o si ṣubu lulẹ o si nfi ara yilẹ o si nyọ ifofó li ẹnu.
entries.en: And they brought him unto him: and when he saw him, straightway the spirit tare him; and he fell on the ground, and wallowed foaming.

entries.yo: O si bi baba rẹ̀ lẽre, wipe, O ti pẹ to ti eyi ti de si i? o si wipe, Lati kekere ni.
entries.en: And he asked his father, How long is it ago since this came unto him? And he said, Of a child.

entries.yo: Nigbakugba ni si ima gbé e sọ sinu iná, ati sinu omi, lati pa a run: ṣugbọn bi iwọ ba le ṣe ohunkohun, ṣãnu fun wa, ki o si ràn wa lọwọ.
entries.en: And ofttimes it hath cast him into the fire, and into the waters, to destroy him: but if thou canst do any thing, have compassion on us, and help us.

entries.yo: Jesu si wi fun u pe, Bi iwọ ba le gbagbọ́, ohun gbogbo ni ṣiṣe fun ẹniti o ba gbagbọ́.
entries.en: Jesus said unto him, If thou canst believe, all things are possible to him that believeth.

entries.yo: Lojukanna baba ọmọ na kigbe li ohùn rara, o si fi omije wipe, Oluwa, mo gbagbọ́; ràn aigbagbọ́ mi lọwọ.
entries.en: And straightway the father of the child cried out, and said with tears, Lord, I believe; help thou mine unbelief.

entries.yo: Nigbati Jesu si ri pe ijọ enia nsare wọjọ pọ̀, o ba ẹmi aimọ́ na wi, o wi fun u pe, Iwọ odi ati aditi ẹmi, mo paṣẹ fun ọ, jade lara rẹ̀, ki iwọ má ṣe wọ̀ inu rẹ̀ mọ́.
entries.en: When Jesus saw that the people came running together, he rebuked the foul spirit, saying unto him, Thou dumb and deaf spirit, I charge thee, come out of him, and enter no more into him.

entries.yo: On si kigbe soke, o si nà a tàntàn, o si jade lara rẹ̀: ọmọ na si dabi ẹniti o kú; tobẹ ti ọpọlọpọ fi wipe, O kú.
entries.en: And the spirit cried, and rent him sore, and came out of him: and he was as one dead; insomuch that many said, He is dead.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Jesu mu u li ọwọ́, o si fà a soke; on si dide.
entries.en: But Jesus took him by the hand, and lifted him up; and he arose.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si wọ̀ ile, awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ bi i lẽre nikọ̀kọ wipe, Ẽṣe ti awa ko fi le lé e jade?
entries.en: And when he was come into the house, his disciples asked him privately, Why could not we cast him out?

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Irú yi kò le ti ipa ohun kan jade, bikoṣe nipa adura ati àwẹ.
entries.en: And he said unto them, This kind can come forth by nothing, but by prayer and fasting.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ti ibẹ̀ kuro, nwọn si kọja larin Galili; on kò si fẹ ki ẹnikẹni mọ̀.
entries.en: And they departed thence, and passed through Galilee; and he would not that any man should know it.

entries.yo: Nitori o kọ́ awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀, o si wi fun wọn pe, A o fi Ọmọ-enia le awọn enia lọwọ nwọn o si pa a; lẹhin igbati a ba si pa a tan, yio jinde ni ijọ kẹta.
entries.en: For he taught his disciples, and said unto them, The Son of man is delivered into the hands of men, and they shall kill him; and after that he is killed, he shall rise the third day.
