entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ọ̀rọ na kò yé wọn, ẹ̀ru si ba wọn lati bi i lẽre.
entries.en: But they understood not that saying, and were afraid to ask him.

entries.yo: O si wá si Kapernaumu: nigbati o si wà ninu ile o bi wọn lẽre, wipe, Kili ohun ti ẹnyin mba ara nyin jiyan si li ọ̀na?
entries.en: And he came to Capernaum: and being in the house he asked them, What was it that ye disputed among yourselves by the way?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nwọn dakẹ: nitori nwọn ti mba ara wọn jiyan pe, tali ẹniti o pọ̀ju.
entries.en: But they held their peace: for by the way they had disputed among themselves, who should be the greatest.

entries.yo: O si joko, o si pè awọn mejila na, o si wi fun wọn pe, Bi ẹnikẹni ba nfẹ ṣe ẹni iwaju, on na ni yio ṣe ẹni ikẹhin gbogbo wọn, ati iranṣẹ gbogbo wọn.
entries.en: And he sat down, and called the twelve, and saith unto them, If any man desire to be first, the same shall be last of all, and servant of all.

entries.yo: O si mu ọmọ kekere kan, o fi i sarin wọn; nigbati o si gbé e si apa rẹ̀, o wi fun wọn pe,
entries.en: And he took a child, and set him in the midst of them: and when he had taken him in his arms, he said unto them,

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni ti o ba gbà ọkan ninu iru awọn ọmọ kekere wọnyi li orukọ mi, o gbà mi: ẹnikẹni ti o ba si gbà mi, ki iṣe emi li o gbà, ṣugbọn o gbà ẹniti o rán mi.
entries.en: Whosoever shall receive one of such children in my name, receiveth me: and whosoever shall receive me, receiveth not me, but him that sent me.

entries.yo: Johanu si da a lohùn, o wipe, Olukọni, awa ri ẹnikan nfi orukọ rẹ lé awọn ẹmi èṣu jade, on kò si tọ̀ wa lẹhin: awa si da a lẹkun, nitoriti ko tọ̀ wa lẹhin:
entries.en: And John answered him, saying, Master, we saw one casting out devils in thy name, and he followeth not us: and we forbad him, because he followeth not us.

entries.yo: Jesu si wipe, Ẹ máṣe da a lẹkun mọ́: nitori kò si ẹnikan ti yio ṣe iṣẹ agbara li orukọ mi, ti o si le yara sọ ibi si mi.
entries.en: But Jesus said, Forbid him not: for there is no man which shall do a miracle in my name, that can lightly speak evil of me.

entries.yo: Nitori ẹniti ko ba kọ oju ija si wa, o wà ni iha tiwa.
entries.en: For he that is not against us is on our part.

entries.yo: Nitori ẹnikẹni ti o ba fi ago omi fun nyin mu li orukọ mi, nitoriti ẹnyin jẹ ti Kristi, lõtọ ni mo wi fun nyin, on kì yio padanù ère rẹ̀ bi o ti wù ki o ri.
entries.en: For whosoever shall give you a cup of water to drink in my name, because ye belong to Christ, verily I say unto you, he shall not lose his reward.

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni ti o ba si mu ki ọkan ninu awọn kekeke wọnyi ti o gbà mi gbọ́ kọsẹ̀, o sàn fun u ki a so ọlọ nla mọ́ ọ li ọrùn, ki a si sọ ọ sinu omi okun.
entries.en: And whosoever shall offend one of these little ones that believe in me, it is better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and he were cast into the sea.

entries.yo: Bi ọwọ́ rẹ, ba si mu ọ kọsẹ̀, ke e kuro: o sàn fun ọ ki o ṣe akewọ lọ si ibi iye, jù ki o li ọwọ mejeji ki o lọ si ọrun apadi, sinu iná ajõku,
entries.en: And if thy hand offend thee, cut it off: it is better for thee to enter into life maimed, than having two hands to go into hell, into the fire that never shall be quenched:

entries.yo: Nibiti kòkoro wọn ki ikú, ti iná na kì si ikú.
entries.en: Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.

entries.yo: Bi ẹsẹ rẹ ba si mu ọ kọsè, ke e kuro: o sàn fun ọ ki o ṣe akesẹ lọ si ibi ìye, jù ki o li ẹsẹ mejeji ki a gbé ọ sọ si ọrun apadi, sinu iná ajõku,
entries.en: And if thy foot offend thee, cut it off: it is better for thee to enter halt into life, than having two feet to be cast into hell, into the fire that never shall be quenched:

entries.yo: Nibiti kòkoro wọn ki ikú, ti iná na ki si ikú.
entries.en: Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.

entries.yo: Bi oju rẹ ba si mu ọ kọsẹ̀, yọ ọ jade: o sàn fun ọ ki o lọ si ijọba Ọlọrun li olojukan, jù ki o li oju mejeji, ki a gbé ọ sọ sinu iná ọrun apadi,
entries.en: And if thine eye offend thee, pluck it out: it is better for thee to enter into the kingdom of God with one eye, than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire:

entries.yo: Nibiti kòkoro wọn ki ikú, ti iná na ki si ikú.
entries.en: Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.

entries.yo: Nitoripe olukukuku li a o fi iná dùn, ati gbogbo ẹbọ li a o si fi iyọ̀ dùn.
entries.en: For every one shall be salted with fire, and every sacrifice shall be salted with salt.

entries.yo: Iyọ̀ dara: ṣugbọn bi iyọ̀ ba sọ agbara rẹ̀ nù, kili ẹ o fi mu u dùn? Ẹ ni iyọ̀ ninu ara nyin, ki ẹ si ma wà li alafia lãrin ara nyin.
entries.en: Salt is good: but if the salt have lost his saltness, wherewith will ye season it? Have salt in yourselves, and have peace one with another.

entries.yo: O si dide kuro nibẹ̀, o si wá si ẹkùn Judea niha oke odò Jordani: awọn enia si tún tọ̀ ọ wá; bi iṣe rẹ̀ ti ri, o si tún nkọ́ wọn.
entries.en: And he arose from thence, and cometh into the coasts of Judaea by the farther side of Jordan: and the people resort unto him again; and, as he was wont, he taught them again.

entries.yo: Awọn Farisi si tọ̀ ọ wá, nwọn ndán a wò, nwọn si bi i lẽre, wipe, O tọ́ fun ọkunrin ki o fi aya rẹ̀ silẹ?
entries.en: And the Pharisees came to him, and asked him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife? tempting him.

entries.yo: O si dahùn o si wi fun wọn pe, Aṣẹ kini Mose pa fun nyin?
entries.en: And he answered and said unto them, What did Moses command you?

entries.yo: Nwọn si wipe, Mose yọda fun wa lati kọ iwe ikọsilẹ fun u, ki a si fi i silẹ.
entries.en: And they said, Moses suffered to write a bill of divorcement, and to put her away.

entries.yo: Jesu si da wọn lohùn, o si wi fun wọn pe, Nitori lile àiya nyin li o ṣe kọ irú ofin yi fun nyin.
entries.en: And Jesus answered and said unto them, For the hardness of your heart he wrote you this precept.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn lati igba ti aiye ti ṣẹ, Ọlọrun da wọn ti akọ ti abo.
entries.en: But from the beginning of the creation God made them male and female.

entries.yo: Nitori eyi li ọkunrin yio ṣe fi baba ati iya rẹ̀ silẹ ti yio si faramọ aya rẹ̀;
entries.en: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and cleave to his wife;

entries.yo: Awọn mejeji a si di ara kan: nitorina nwọn kì iṣe meji mọ́, bikoṣe ara kan.
entries.en: And they twain shall be one flesh: so then they are no more twain, but one flesh.

entries.yo: Nitorina ohun ti Ọlọrun ba so ṣọkan, ki enia ki o máṣe yà wọn.
entries.en: What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ si tun bi i lẽre ọ̀ran kanna ninu ile.
entries.en: And in the house his disciples asked him again of the same matter.

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹnikẹni ti o ba fi aya rẹ̀ silẹ, ti o ba si gbé omiran ni iyawo, o ṣe panṣaga si i.
entries.en: And he saith unto them, Whosoever shall put away his wife, and marry another, committeth adultery against her.

entries.yo: Bi obinrin kan ba si fi ọkọ rẹ̀ silẹ, ti a ba si gbé e ni iyawo fun ẹlomiran, o ṣe panṣaga.
entries.en: And if a woman shall put away her husband, and be married to another, she committeth adultery.

entries.yo: Nwọn si gbé awọn ọmọ-ọwọ tọ̀ ọ wá, ki o le fi ọwọ́ tọ́ wọn: awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ si ba awọn ti o gbé wọn wá wi.
entries.en: And they brought young children to him, that he should touch them: and his disciples rebuked those that brought them.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati Jesu ri i, inu bi i, o si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ jẹ ki awọn ọmọ kekere ki o wá sọdọ mi, ẹ má si ṣe da wọn lẹkun: nitoriti irú wọn ni ijọba Ọlọrun.
entries.en: But when Jesus saw it, he was much displeased, and said unto them, Suffer the little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.

entries.yo: Lõtọ ni mo wi fun nyin, Ẹnikẹni ti kò ba gbà ijọba Ọlọrun bi ọmọ kekere, kì yio le wọ̀ inu rẹ̀ bi o ti wù o ri.
entries.en: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child, he shall not enter therein.

entries.yo: O si gbé wọn si apa rẹ̀, o gbé ọwọ́ rẹ̀ le wọn, o si sure fun wọn.
entries.en: And he took them up in his arms, put his hands upon them, and blessed them.

entries.yo: Bi o si ti njade bọ̀ si ọ̀na, ẹnikan nsare tọ̀ ọ wá, o si kunlẹ fun u, o bi i lẽre, wipe, Olukọni rere, kili emi o ṣe ti emi o fi le jogún ìye ainipẹkun?
entries.en: And when he was gone forth into the way, there came one running, and kneeled to him, and asked him, Good Master, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?

entries.yo: Jesu si wi fun u pe, Ẽṣe ti iwọ fi npè mi li ẹni rere? ẹni rere kan ko si bikoṣe ẹnikan, eyini li Ọlọrun.
entries.en: And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? there is none good but one, that is, God.

entries.yo: Iwọ sá mọ̀ ofin: Máṣe panṣaga, Máṣe pania, Máṣe jale, Máṣe jẹri eke, Máṣe rẹ-ni-jẹ, Bọwọ fun baba on iya rẹ.
entries.en: Thou knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Defraud not, Honour thy father and mother.

entries.yo: O si dahùn o si wi fun u pe, Olukọni, gbogbo nkan wọnyi li emi ti nkiyesi lati igba ewe mi wá.
entries.en: And he answered and said unto him, Master, all these have I observed from my youth.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Jesu sì wò o, o fẹràn rẹ̀, o si wi fun u pe, Ohun kan li o kù ọ kù: lọ tà ohunkohun ti o ni ki o si fifun awọn talakà, iwọ ó si ni iṣura li ọrun: si wá, gbé agbelebu, ki o si mã tọ̀ mi lẹhin.
entries.en: Then Jesus beholding him loved him, and said unto him, One thing thou lackest: go thy way, sell whatsoever thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, take up the cross, and follow me.

entries.yo: Inu rẹ̀ si bajẹ si ọ̀rọ̀ na, o si jade lọ ni ibinujẹ: nitoriti o li ọrọ̀ pipọ.
entries.en: And he was sad at that saying, and went away grieved: for he had great possessions.

entries.yo: Jesu si wò yiká, o si wi fun awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ pe, Yio ti ṣoro to fun awọn ti o li ọrọ̀ lati wọ̀ ijọba Ọlọrun!
entries.en: And Jesus looked round about, and saith unto his disciples, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!

entries.yo: Ẹnu si yà awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ si ọ̀rọ rẹ̀. Ṣugbọn Jesu si tun dahùn wi fun wọn pe, Ẹnyin ọmọ, yio ti ṣoro to fun awọn ti o gbẹkẹle ọrọ̀ lati wọ̀ ijọba Ọlọrun!
entries.en: And the disciples were astonished at his words. But Jesus answereth again, and saith unto them, Children, how hard is it for them that trust in riches to enter into the kingdom of God!

entries.yo: O rọrun fun ibakasiẹ lati wọ̀ oju abẹrẹ jù fun ọlọrọ̀ lati wọ̀ ijọba Ọlọrun lọ.
entries.en: It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.

entries.yo: Ẹnu si yà wọn rekọja, nwọn si mba ara wọn sọ wipe, Njẹ tali o ha le là?
entries.en: And they were astonished out of measure, saying among themselves, Who then can be saved?

entries.yo: Jesu si wò wọn o wipe, Enia li eyi ko le ṣe iṣe fun, ṣugbọn ki iṣe fun Ọlọrun: nitori ohun gbogbo ni ṣiṣe fun Ọlọrun.
entries.en: And Jesus looking upon them saith, With men it is impossible, but not with God: for with God all things are possible.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Peteru bẹ̀rẹ si iwi fun u pe, Wo o, awa ti fi gbogbo nkan silẹ awa si ti tọ̀ ọ lẹhin.
entries.en: Then Peter began to say unto him, Lo, we have left all, and have followed thee.

entries.yo: Jesu si dahùn, o wipe, Lõtọ ni mo wi fun nyin, Kò si ẹniti o fi ile silẹ, tabi arakunrin, tabi arabinrin, tabi baba, tabi iya, tabi aya, tabi ọmọ, tabi ilẹ, nitori mi, ati nitori ihinrere,
entries.en: And Jesus answered and said, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my sake, and the gospel's,

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nisisiyi li aiye yi on o si gbà ọgọrọrun, ile, ati arakunrin, ati arabinrin, ati iya, ati ọmọ, ati ilẹ, pẹlu inunibini, ati li aiye ti mbọ̀ ìye ainipẹkun;
entries.en: But he shall receive an hundredfold now in this time, houses, and brethren, and sisters, and mothers, and children, and lands, with persecutions; and in the world to come eternal life.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ọ̀pọ awọn ti o ṣiwaju ni yio kẹhin; awọn ti o kẹhin ni yio si ṣiwaju.
entries.en: But many that are first shall be last; and the last first.

entries.yo: Nwọn si wà li ọ̀na nwọn ngoke lọ si Jerusalemu; Jesu si nlọ niwaju wọn: ẹnu si yà wọn; bi nwọn si ti ntọ̀ ọ lẹhin, ẹ̀ru ba wọn. O si tun mu awọn mejila, o bẹ̀rẹ si isọ gbogbo ohun ti a o ṣe si i fun wọn,
entries.en: And they were in the way going up to Jerusalem; and Jesus went before them: and they were amazed; and as they followed, they were afraid. And he took again the twelve, and began to tell them what things should happen unto him,

entries.yo: Wipe, Sá wo o, awa ngoke lọ si Jerusalemu, a o si fi Ọmọ-enia le awọn olori alufa, ati awọn akọwe lọwọ; nwọn o si da a lẹbi ikú, nwọn o si fi i le awọn Keferi lọwọ:
entries.en: Saying, Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man shall be delivered unto the chief priests, and unto the scribes; and they shall condemn him to death, and shall deliver him to the Gentiles:

entries.yo: Nwọn o si fi i ṣe ẹlẹyà, nwọn o si nà a, nwọn o si tutọ́ si i lara, nwọn o si pa a: ni ijọ kẹta yio si jinde.
entries.en: And they shall mock him, and shall scourge him, and shall spit upon him, and shall kill him: and the third day he shall rise again.

entries.yo: Jakọbu ati Johanu awọn ọmọ Sebede si wá sọdọ rẹ̀, wipe, Olukọni, awa nfẹ ki iwọ ki o ṣe ohunkohun ti awa ba bere lọwọ rẹ fun wa.
entries.en: And James and John, the sons of Zebedee, come unto him, saying, Master, we would that thou shouldest do for us whatsoever we shall desire.

entries.yo: O si bi wọn lẽre pe, Kili ẹnyin nfẹ ki emi ki o ṣe fun nyin?
entries.en: And he said unto them, What would ye that I should do for you?

entries.yo: Nwọn si wi fun u pe, Fifun wa ki awa ki o le joko, ọkan li ọwọ́ ọtun rẹ, ati ọkan li ọwọ́ òsi rẹ, ninu ogo rẹ.
entries.en: They said unto him, Grant unto us that we may sit, one on thy right hand, and the other on thy left hand, in thy glory.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Jesu wi fun wọn pe, Ẹnyin ko mọ̀ ohun ti ẹnyin mbère: ẹnyin le mu ago ti emi mu? tabi ki a fi baptismu ti a fi baptisi mi baptisi nyin?
entries.en: But Jesus said unto them, Ye know not what ye ask: can ye drink of the cup that I drink of? and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?

entries.yo: Nwọn si wi fun u pe, Awa le ṣe e. Jesu si wi fun wọn pe, Lõtọ li ẹnyin ó mu ago ti emi mu; ati baptismu ti a o fi baptisi mi li a o fi baptisi nyin:
entries.en: And they said unto him, We can. And Jesus said unto them, Ye shall indeed drink of the cup that I drink of; and with the baptism that I am baptized withal shall ye be baptized:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn lati joko li ọwọ́ ọtún mi ati li ọwọ́ òsi mi ki iṣe ti emi lati fi funni: bikoṣe fun awọn ẹniti a ti pèse rẹ̀ silẹ.
entries.en: But to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not mine to give; but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared.

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn mẹwa iyokù gbọ́, nwọn bẹ̀re si ibinu si Jakọbu ati Johanu.
entries.en: And when the ten heard it, they began to be much displeased with James and John.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Jesu pè wọn sọdọ rẹ̀, o si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹnyin mọ̀ pe, awọn ti a nkà si olori awọn Keferi, a ma lò ipá lori wọn: ati awọn ẹni-nla wọn a ma fi ọlá tẹri wọn ba.
entries.en: But Jesus called them to him, and saith unto them, Ye know that they which are accounted to rule over the Gentiles exercise lordship over them; and their great ones exercise authority upon them.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn kì yio ri bẹ̃ lãrin nyin: ṣugbọn ẹnikẹni ti o ba fẹ tobi lãrin nyin, on ni yio ṣe iranṣẹ nyin:
entries.en: But so shall it not be among you: but whosoever will be great among you, shall be your minister:

entries.yo: Ati ẹnikẹni ninu nyin ti o ba fẹ ṣe olori, on ni yio ṣe ọmọ-ọdọ gbogbo nyin.
entries.en: And whosoever of you will be the chiefest, shall be servant of all.

entries.yo: Nitori Ọmọ-enia tikalarẹ̀ kò ti wá ki a ba mã ṣe iranṣẹ fun, bikoṣe lati mã ṣe iranṣẹ funni, ati lati fi ẹmi rẹ̀ ṣe irapada fun ọ̀pọlọpọ enia.
entries.en: For even the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.

entries.yo: Nwọn si wá si Jeriko: bi o si ti njade kuro ni Jeriko pẹlu awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀, ati ọ̀pọ awọn enia, Bartimeu afọju, ọmọ Timeu, joko lẹba ọ̀na, o nṣagbe.
entries.en: And they came to Jericho: and as he went out of Jericho with his disciples and a great number of people, blind Bartimaeus, the son of Timaeus, sat by the highway side begging.

entries.yo: Nigbati o gbọ́ pe, Jesu ti Nasareti ni, o bẹ̀rẹ si ikigbe lohùn rara, wipe, Jesu, iwọ Ọmọ Dafidi, ṣãnu fun mi.
entries.en: And when he heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth, he began to cry out, and say, Jesus, thou Son of David, have mercy on me.

entries.yo: Ọpọlọpọ si ba a wipe, ki o pa ẹnu rẹ̀ mọ́: ṣugbọn on si kigbe si i jù bẹ̃ lọ pe, Iwọ Ọmọ Dafidi, ṣãnu fun mi.
entries.en: And many charged him that he should hold his peace: but he cried the more a great deal, Thou Son of David, have mercy on me.

entries.yo: Jesu si dẹsẹ duro, o si paṣẹ pe ki a pè e wá. Nwọn si pè afọju na, nwọn wi fun u pe, Tùjuka, dide; o npè ọ.
entries.en: And Jesus stood still, and commanded him to be called. And they call the blind man, saying unto him, Be of good comfort, rise; he calleth thee.

entries.yo: O si bọ ẹ̀wu rẹ́ sọnù, o dide, o si tọ̀ Jesu wá.
entries.en: And he, casting away his garment, rose, and came to Jesus.

entries.yo: Jesu si dahùn o si wi fun u pe, Kini iwọ nfẹ ki emi ki o ṣe fun ọ? Afọju na si wi fun u pe, Rabboni, ki emi ki o le riran.
entries.en: And Jesus answered and said unto him, What wilt thou that I should do unto thee? The blind man said unto him, Lord, that I might receive my sight.

entries.yo: Jesu si wi fun u pe, Mã lọ; igbagbọ́ rẹ mu ọ larada. Lojukanna, o si riran, o si tọ̀ Jesu lẹhin li ọ̀na.
entries.en: And Jesus said unto him, Go thy way; thy faith hath made thee whole. And immediately he received his sight, and followed Jesus in the way.

entries.yo: NIGBATI nwọn si sunmọ eti Jerusalemu, leti Betfage ati Betani, li òke Olifi, o rán meji ninu awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀,
entries.en: And when they came nigh to Jerusalem, unto Bethphage and Bethany, at the mount of Olives, he sendeth forth two of his disciples,

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ lọ si iletò ti o kọju si nyin: lojukanna bi ẹnyin ti nwọ̀ inu rẹ̀ lọ, ẹnyin ó si ri ọmọ kẹtẹkẹtẹ kan ti a so, ti ẹnikẹni ko gùn rì; ẹ tú u, ki é si fà a wá.
entries.en: And saith unto them, Go your way into the village over against you: and as soon as ye be entered into it, ye shall find a colt tied, whereon never man sat; loose him, and bring him.

entries.yo: Bi ẹnikẹni ba si wi fun nyin pe, Ẽṣe ti ẹnyin fi nṣe eyi? ẹ wipe, Oluwa ni fi ṣe; lojukanna yio si rán a wá sihinyi.
entries.en: And if any man say unto you, Why do ye this? say ye that the Lord hath need of him; and straightway he will send him hither.

entries.yo: Nwọn si mu ọ̀na wọn pọ̀n, nwọn ri ọmọ kẹtẹkẹtẹ na ti a so li ẹnu-ọ̀na lode ni ita gbangba; nwọn si tú u.
entries.en: And they went their way, and found the colt tied by the door without in a place where two ways met; and they loose him.

entries.yo: Awọn kan ninu awọn ti o duro nibẹ̀ wi fun wọn pe, Kili ẹnyin nṣe, ti ẹnyin fi ntú ọmọ kẹtẹkẹtẹ nì?
entries.en: And certain of them that stood there said unto them, What do ye, loosing the colt?

entries.yo: Nwọn si wi fun wọn gẹgẹ bi Jesu ti wi fun wọn: nwọn si jọwọ wọn lọwọ lọ.
entries.en: And they said unto them even as Jesus had commanded: and they let them go.

entries.yo: Nwọn si fà ọmọ kẹtẹkẹtẹ na tọ̀ Jesu wá, nwọn si tẹ́ aṣọ wọn si ẹ̀hin rẹ̀; on si joko lori rẹ̀.
entries.en: And they brought the colt to Jesus, and cast their garments on him; and he sat upon him.

entries.yo: Awọn pipọ si tẹ́ aṣọ wọn si ọ̀na: ati awọn miran ṣẹ́ ẹ̀ka igi, nwọn si fún wọn si ọ̀na.
entries.en: And many spread their garments in the way: and others cut down branches off the trees, and strawed them in the way.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ti nlọ niwaju, ati awọn ti mbọ̀ lẹhin, nkigbe wipe, Hosanna; Olubukun li ẹniti o mbọ̀wá li orukọ Oluwa:
entries.en: And they that went before, and they that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna; Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord:

entries.yo: Olubukun ni ijọba ti mbọ̀wá, ijọba Dafidi, baba wa: Hosanna loke ọrun.
entries.en: Blessed be the kingdom of our father David, that cometh in the name of the Lord: Hosanna in the highest.

entries.yo: Jesu si wọ̀ Jerusalemu, ati tẹmpili. Nigbati o si wò ohun gbogbo yiká, alẹ sa ti lẹ tan, o si jade lọ si Betani pẹlu awọn mejila.
entries.en: And Jesus entered into Jerusalem, and into the temple: and when he had looked round about upon all things, and now the eventide was come, he went out unto Bethany with the twelve.

entries.yo: Ni ijọ keji, nigbati nwọn ti Betani jade, ebi si npa a:
entries.en: And on the morrow, when they were come from Bethany, he was hungry:

entries.yo: O si ri igi ọpọtọ kan li òkere ti o li ewé, o wá, bi bọya on le ri ohun kan lori rẹ̀: nigbati o si wá si idi rẹ̀, ko ri ohun kan, bikoṣe ewé; nitori akokò eso ọpọtọ kò ti ito.
entries.en: And seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came, if haply he might find any thing thereon: and when he came to it, he found nothing but leaves; for the time of figs was not yet.

entries.yo: Jesu si dahùn o si wi fun u pe, Ki ẹnikẹni má jẹ eso lori rẹ mọ́ titi lai. Awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ si gbọ́ ọ.
entries.en: And Jesus answered and said unto it, No man eat fruit of thee hereafter for ever. And his disciples heard it.

entries.yo: Nwọn si wá si Jerusalemu: Jesu si wọ̀ inu tẹmpili lọ, o bẹ̀rẹ si ilé awọn ti ntà ati awọn ti nrà ni tẹmpili jade, o si tari tabili awọn onipaṣiparọ owo danù, ati ijoko awọn ti ntà ẹiyẹle.
entries.en: And they come to Jerusalem: and Jesus went into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves;

entries.yo: Kò si jẹ ki ẹnikẹni ki o gbe ohun èlo kọja larin tẹmpili.
entries.en: And would not suffer that any man should carry any vessel through the temple.

entries.yo: O si nkọ́ni, o nwi fun wọn pe, A ko ti kọwe rẹ̀ pe, Ile adura fun gbogbo orilẹ-ède li a o ma pè ile mi? ṣugbọn ẹnyin ti ṣọ di ihò awọn ọlọsà.
entries.en: And he taught, saying unto them, Is it not written, My house shall be called of all nations the house of prayer? but ye have made it a den of thieves.

entries.yo: Awọn akọwe ati awọn olori alufa si gbọ́, nwọn si nwá ọ̀na bi nwọn o ti ṣe pa a run: nitori nwọn bẹ̀ru rẹ̀, nitori ẹnu yà gbogbo ijọ enia si ẹkọ́ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the scribes and chief priests heard it, and sought how they might destroy him: for they feared him, because all the people was astonished at his doctrine.

entries.yo: Nigbati alẹ ba si lẹ, a jade kuro ni ilu.
entries.en: And when even was come, he went out of the city.

entries.yo: Bi nwọn si ti nkọja lọ li owurọ, nwọn ri igi ọpọtọ na gbẹ ti gbongbo ti gbongbo.
entries.en: And in the morning, as they passed by, they saw the fig tree dried up from the roots.

entries.yo: Peteru si wa iranti o wi fun u pe, Rabbi, wò bi igi ọpọtọ ti iwọ fi bú ti gbẹ.
entries.en: And Peter calling to remembrance saith unto him, Master, behold, the fig tree which thou cursedst is withered away.

entries.yo: Jesu si dahùn o si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ ni igbagbọ́ si Ọlọrun.
entries.en: And Jesus answering saith unto them, Have faith in God.

entries.yo: Lõtọ ni mo wi fun nyin, Ẹnikẹni ti o ba wi fun òke yi pe, Ṣidi, ki o si bọ sinu okun; ti kò ba si ṣiyemeji li ọkàn rẹ̀, ṣugbọn ti o ba gbagbọ́ pe ohun ti on wi yio ṣẹ, yio ri bẹ̃ fun u.
entries.en: For verily I say unto you, That whosoever shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; and shall not doubt in his heart, but shall believe that those things which he saith shall come to pass; he shall have whatsoever he saith.

entries.yo: Nitorina mo wi fun nyin, Ohunkohun ti ẹnyin ba tọrọ nigbati ẹ ba ngbadura, ẹ gbagbọ́ pe ẹ ti ri wọn gbà na, yio si ri bẹ̃ fun nyin.
entries.en: Therefore I say unto you, What things soever ye desire, when ye pray, believe that ye receive them, and ye shall have them.

entries.yo: Nigbati ẹnyin ba si duro ngbadura, ẹ darijì, bi ẹnyin ba ni ohunkohun si ẹnikẹni: ki Baba nyin ti mbẹ li ọrun ba le dari ẹṣẹ nyin jì nyin pẹlu.
entries.en: And when ye stand praying, forgive, if ye have ought against any: that your Father also which is in heaven may forgive you your trespasses.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi ẹnyin ko ba dariji, Baba nyin ti mbẹ li ọrun kì yio si dari ẹ̀ṣẹ nyin jì nyin.
entries.en: But if ye do not forgive, neither will your Father which is in heaven forgive your trespasses.

entries.yo: Nwọn si tún wá si Jerusalemu: bi o si ti nrìn kiri ni tẹmpili, awọn olori alufa, ati awọn akọwe, ati awọn agbàgba, tọ̀ ọ wá,
entries.en: And they come again to Jerusalem: and as he was walking in the temple, there come to him the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders,

entries.yo: Nwọn si wi fun u pe, Aṣẹ wo li o fi nṣe nkan wọnyi? tali o si fun ọ li aṣẹ yi lati mã ṣe nkan wọnyi?
entries.en: And say unto him, By what authority doest thou these things? and who gave thee this authority to do these things?

entries.yo: Jesu si dahùn o si wi fun wọn pe, Emi ó bi nyin lẽre ọ̀rọ kan, ki ẹ si da mi lohùn, emi o si sọ fun nyin aṣẹ ti emi fi nṣe nkan wọnyi.
entries.en: And Jesus answered and said unto them, I will also ask of you one question, and answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.

entries.yo: Baptismu Johanu lati ọrun wá ni, tabi lati ọdọ enia? ẹ da mi lohùn.
entries.en: The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or of men? answer me.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ba ara wọn gbèro, wipe, Bi awa ba wipe, Lati ọrun wá ni: on o wipe, Ẽha ti ṣe ti ẹnyin ko fi gbà a gbọ́?
entries.en: And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then did ye not believe him?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi awa ba wipe, Lati ọdọ enia; nwọn bẹ̀ru awọn enia: nitori gbogbo enia kà Johanu si woli nitõtọ.
entries.en: But if we shall say, Of men; they feared the people: for all men counted John, that he was a prophet indeed.

entries.yo: Nwọn si dahùn wi fun Jesu pe, Awa kó mọ̀. Jesu si dahùn wi fun wọn pe, Emi kì yio si wi fun nyin aṣẹ ti emi fi nṣe nkan wọnyi.
entries.en: And they answered and said unto Jesus, We cannot tell. And Jesus answering saith unto them, Neither do I tell you by what authority I do these things.

entries.yo: O si bẹ̀rẹ si ifi owe ba wọn sọ̀rọ pe, ọkunrin kan gbìn ọgba ajara kan, o si ṣọgba yi i ká, o si wà ibi ifunti waini, o si kọ́ ile-isọ si i, o si fi ṣe agbatọju fun awọn oluṣọgba, o si lọ si àjo.
entries.en: And he began to speak unto them by parables. A certain man planted a vineyard, and set an hedge about it, and digged a place for the winefat, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si di akokò, o rán ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ̀ kan si awọn oluṣọgba na, ki o le gbà ninu eso ọgba ajara na lọwọ awọn oluṣọgba.
entries.en: And at the season he sent to the husbandmen a servant, that he might receive from the husbandmen of the fruit of the vineyard.

entries.yo: Nwọn si mu u, nwọn lù u, nwọn si rán a pada lọwọ̀ ofo.
entries.en: And they caught him, and beat him, and sent him away empty.

entries.yo: O si tún rán ọmọ-ọdọ miran si wọn, on ni nwọn si sọ okuta lù, nwọn sá a logbẹ́ li ori, nwọn si ran a lọ ni itiju.
entries.en: And again he sent unto them another servant; and at him they cast stones, and wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully handled.

entries.yo: O si tún rán omiran; eyini ni nwọn si pa: ati ọ̀pọ miran, nwọn lù miran, nwọn si pa miran.
entries.en: And again he sent another; and him they killed, and many others; beating some, and killing some.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn o kù ọmọ rẹ̀ kan ti o ni, ti iṣe ayanfẹ rẹ̀, o si rán a si wọn pẹlu nikẹhin, o wipe, Nwọn ó ṣe ojuṣãju fun ọmọ mi.
entries.en: Having yet therefore one son, his wellbeloved, he sent him also last unto them, saying, They will reverence my son.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn oluṣọgba wọnni wi fun ara wọn pe, Eyiyi li arole; ẹ wá, ẹ jẹ ki a pa a, ogún rẹ̀ yio si jẹ tiwa.
entries.en: But those husbandmen said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and the inheritance shall be ours.

entries.yo: Nwọn si mu u, nwọn pa a, nwọn si wọ́ ọ jade kuro ninu ọgba ajara na.
entries.en: And they took him, and killed him, and cast him out of the vineyard.

entries.yo: Njẹ kili oluwa ọgba ajara na yio ṣe? On o wá, yio si pa awọn oluṣọgba wọnni run, yio si fi ọgba ajara rẹ̀ ṣe agbatọju fun awọn ẹlomiran.
entries.en: What shall therefore the lord of the vineyard do? he will come and destroy the husbandmen, and will give the vineyard unto others.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin kò ha ti kà iwe-mimọ yi; Okuta ti awọn ọmọle kọ̀ silẹ on na li o di pàtaki igun ile:
entries.en: And have ye not read this scripture; The stone which the builders rejected is become the head of the corner:

entries.yo: Eyi ni ìṣe Oluwa, o si jẹ iyanu li oju wa?
entries.en: This was the Lord's doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?

entries.yo: Nwọn si nwá ọ̀na ati mu u, sugbọn nwọn si bẹ̀ru ijọ enia: nitori nwọn mọ̀ pe, awọn li o powe na mọ: nwọn si fi i silẹ, nwọn lọ.
entries.en: And they sought to lay hold on him, but feared the people: for they knew that he had spoken the parable against them: and they left him, and went their way.

entries.yo: Nwọn si rán awọn kan si i ninu awọn Farisi, ati ninu awọn ọmọ-ẹhin Herodu, lati fi ọ̀rọ rẹ̀ mu u.
entries.en: And they send unto him certain of the Pharisees and of the Herodians, to catch him in his words.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si de, nwọn wi fun u pe, Olukọni, awa mọ̀ pe olotitọ ni iwọ bẹ̃ni iwọ kì iwoju ẹnikẹni: nitori iwọ kì iṣe ojuṣãju enia, ṣugbọn iwọ nkọ́ni li ọ̀na Ọlọrun li otitọ: O tọ́ lati mã san owode fun Kesari, tabi kò tọ́?
entries.en: And when they were come, they say unto him, Master, we know that thou art true, and carest for no man: for thou regardest not the person of men, but teachest the way of God in truth: Is it lawful to give tribute to Caesar, or not?

entries.yo: Ki awa ki o fifun u, tabi ki a má fifun u? Ṣugbọn Jesu mọ̀ agabagebe wọn, o wi fun wọn pe, Ẽṣe ti ẹnyin fi ndán mi wò? ẹ mu owo-idẹ kan fun mi wá ki emi ki o wò o.
entries.en: Shall we give, or shall we not give? But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said unto them, Why tempt ye me? bring me a penny, that I may see it.

entries.yo: Nwọn si mu u wá. O si bi wọn pe, Aworan ati akọle tali eyi? Nwọn si wi fun u pe, Ti Kesari ni.
entries.en: And they brought it. And he saith unto them, Whose is this image and superscription? And they said unto him, Caesar's.

entries.yo: Jesu si dahùn o si wi fun wọn pe, Njẹ ẹ fi ohun ti Kesari fun Kesari, ati ohun ti Ọlọrun fun Ọlọrun. Ẹnu si yà wọn si i gidigidi.
entries.en: And Jesus answering said unto them, Render to Caesar the things that are Caesar's, and to God the things that are God's. And they marvelled at him.

entries.yo: Awọn Sadusi si tọ̀ ọ wá, awọn ti o wipe ajinde okú kò si; nwọn si bi i lẽre, wipe,
entries.en: Then come unto him the Sadducees, which say there is no resurrection; and they asked him, saying,

entries.yo: Olukọni, Mose kọwe fun wa pe, Bi arakunrin ẹnikan ba kú, ti o ba si fi aya silẹ, ti kò si fi ọmọ silẹ, ki arakunrin rẹ̀ ki o ṣu aya rẹ̀ lopó, ki o si gbe iru-ọmọ dide fun arakunrin rẹ̀.
entries.en: Master, Moses wrote unto us, If a man's brother die, and leave his wife behind him, and leave no children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.

entries.yo: Njẹ awọn arakunrin meje kan ti wà: eyi ekini si gbé iyawo, o si kú lai fi ọmọ silẹ.
entries.en: Now there were seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and dying left no seed.

entries.yo: Eyi ekeji si ṣu u lopó, on si kú, bẹ̃li on kò si fi ọmọ silẹ: gẹgẹ bẹ̃ si li ẹkẹta.
entries.en: And the second took her, and died, neither left he any seed: and the third likewise.

entries.yo: Awọn mejeje si ṣu u lopó, nwọn kò si fi ọmọ silẹ: nikẹhin gbogbo wọn obinrin na kú pẹlu.
entries.en: And the seven had her, and left no seed: last of all the woman died also.

entries.yo: Njẹ li ajinde, nigbati nwọn ba jinde, aya tani yio ha ṣe ninu wọn? awọn mejeje li o sá ni i li aya?
entries.en: In the resurrection therefore, when they shall rise, whose wife shall she be of them? for the seven had her to wife.

entries.yo: Jesu si dahùn o wi fun wọn pe, Ki ha ṣe nitori eyi li ẹ ṣe ṣina, pe ẹnyin kò mọ̀ iwe-mimọ, tabi agbara Ọlọrun?
entries.en: And Jesus answering said unto them, Do ye not therefore err, because ye know not the scriptures, neither the power of God?

entries.yo: Nitori nigbati nwọn o jinde kuro ninu okú, nwọn kò ni gbeyawo, bẹ̃ni nwọn kì yio sinni ni iyawo; ṣugbọn nwọn ó dabi awọn angẹli ti mbẹ li ọrun.
entries.en: For when they shall rise from the dead, they neither marry, nor are given in marriage; but are as the angels which are in heaven.

entries.yo: Ati niti awọn okú pe a o ji wọn dide: ẹnyin ko ti kà a ninu iwe Mose, bi Ọlọrun ti sọ fun u ninu igbẹ́, wipe, Emi li Ọlọrun Abrahamu, ati Ọlọrun Isaaki, ati Ọlọrun Jakọbu?
entries.en: And as touching the dead, that they rise: have ye not read in the book of Moses, how in the bush God spake unto him, saying, I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob?

entries.yo: On kì iṣe Ọlọrun awọn okú, bikọse Ọlọrun awọn alãye: nitorina ẹnyin ṣìna gidigidi.
entries.en: He is not the God of the dead, but the God of the living: ye therefore do greatly err.

entries.yo: Ọkan ninu awọn akọwe tọ̀ ọ wá, nigbati o si gbọ́ bi nwọn ti mbi ara wọn li ere ọ̀rọ, ti o si woye pe, o da wọn lohùn rere, o bi i pe, Ewo li ekini ninu gbogbo ofin?
entries.en: And one of the scribes came, and having heard them reasoning together, and perceiving that he had answered them well, asked him, Which is the first commandment of all?

entries.yo: Jesu si da a lohùn, wipe, Ekini ninu gbogbo ofin ni, Gbọ́, Israeli; Oluwa Ọlọrun wa Oluwa kan ni.
entries.en: And Jesus answered him, The first of all the commandments is, Hear, O Israel; The Lord our God is one Lord:

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o si fi gbogbo àiya rẹ, ati gbogbo ọkàn rẹ, ati gbogbo iye rẹ, ati gbogbo agbara rẹ, fẹ Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ: eyi li ofin ekini.
entries.en: And thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind, and with all thy strength: this is the first commandment.

entries.yo: Ekeji si dabi rẹ̀, Fẹ ọmọnikeji rẹ bi ara rẹ. Ko si si ofin miran, ti o tobi jù wọnyi lọ.
entries.en: And the second is like, namely this, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself. There is none other commandment greater than these.

entries.yo: Akọwe na si wi fun u pe, Olukọni, o dara, otitọ li o sọ pe Ọlọrun kan ni mbẹ; ko si si omiran bikoṣe on:
entries.en: And the scribe said unto him, Well, Master, thou hast said the truth: for there is one God; and there is none other but he:

entries.yo: Ati ki a fi gbogbo àiya, ati gbogbo òye, ati gbogbo ọkàn, ati gbogbo agbara fẹ ẹ, ati ki a fẹ ọmọnikeji ẹni bi ara-ẹni, o jù gbogbo ẹbọ-sisun ati ẹbọ lọ.
entries.en: And to love him with all the heart, and with all the understanding, and with all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbour as himself, is more than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.

entries.yo: Nigbati Jesu ri i pe o fi òye dahùn, o wi fun u pe, Iwọ kò jìna si ijọba Ọlọrun. Lẹhin eyini, kò si ẹnikan ti o jẹ bi i lẽre ohunkan mọ́.
entries.en: And when Jesus saw that he answered discreetly, he said unto him, Thou art not far from the kingdom of God. And no man after that durst ask him any question.

entries.yo: Bi Jesu si ti nkọ́ni ni tẹmpili, o dahùn wipe, Ẽṣe ti awọn akọwe fi nwipe, Ọmọ Dafidi ni Kristi iṣe?
entries.en: And Jesus answered and said, while he taught in the temple, How say the scribes that Christ is the Son of David?

entries.yo: Nitori Dafidi tikararẹ̀ wi nipa Ẹmi Mimọ́ pe, OLUWA wi fun Oluwa mi pe, Iwọ joko li ọwọ́ ọtún mi, titi emi o fi sọ awọn ọtá rẹ di apoti itisẹ rẹ.
entries.en: For David himself said by the Holy Ghost, The Lord said to my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, till I make thine enemies thy footstool.

entries.yo: Njẹ bi Dafidi tikararẹ̀ ba pè e li Oluwa; nibo li o si ti wa ijẹ ọmọ rẹ̀? Ọpọ ijọ enia si fi ayọ̀ gbọ́ ọ̀rọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: David therefore himself calleth him Lord; and whence is he then his son? And the common people heard him gladly.

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn ninu ẹkọ́ rẹ̀ pe, Ẹ mã kiyesara lọdọ awọn akọwe, ti nwọn fẹ lati mã rìn li aṣọ gigùn, ti nwọn si fẹ ikíni li ọjà,
entries.en: And he said unto them in his doctrine, Beware of the scribes, which love to go in long clothing, and love salutations in the marketplaces,

entries.yo: Ati ibujoko ọlá ninu sinagogu, ati ipò ọla ni ibi ase;
entries.en: And the chief seats in the synagogues, and the uppermost rooms at feasts:

entries.yo: Awọn ti o jẹ ile awọn opó run, ti nwọn si ngbadura gigun fun aṣehàn: awọn wọnyi ni yio jẹbi pọ̀ju.
entries.en: Which devour widows' houses, and for a pretence make long prayers: these shall receive greater damnation.

entries.yo: Jesu si joko kọjusi apoti iṣura, o si nwò bi ijọ enia ti nsọ owo sinu apoti iṣura: ọ̀pọ awọn ọlọrọ̀ si sọ pipọ si i.
entries.en: And Jesus sat over against the treasury, and beheld how the people cast money into the treasury: and many that were rich cast in much.

entries.yo: Talakà opó kan si wá, o sọ owo idẹ wẹ́wẹ meji ti iṣe idameji owo-bàba kan sinu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And there came a certain poor widow, and she threw in two mites, which make a farthing.

entries.yo: O si pè awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ sọdọ rẹ̀, o si wi fun wọn pe, Lõtọ ni mo wi fun nyin pe, Talakà opó yi sọ sinu apoti iṣura jù gbogbo awọn ti o sọ sinu rẹ̀ lọ.
entries.en: And he called unto him his disciples, and saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That this poor widow hath cast more in, than all they which have cast into the treasury:

entries.yo: Nitori gbogbo nwọn sọ sinu rẹ̀ ninu ọ̀pọlọpọ ini wọn; ṣugbọn on ninu aini rẹ̀ o sọ ohun gbogbo ti o ni si i, ani gbogbo ini rẹ̀.
entries.en: For all they did cast in of their abundance; but she of her want did cast in all that she had, even all her living.

entries.yo: BI o si ti nti tẹmpili jade, ọkan ninu awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ wipe, Olukọni, wò irú okuta ati irú ile ti o wà nihinyi!
entries.en: And as he went out of the temple, one of his disciples saith unto him, Master, see what manner of stones and what buildings are here!

entries.yo: Jesu si dahùn wi fun u pe, Iwọ ri ile nla wọnyi? kì yio si okuta kan ti a o fi silẹ lori ekeji, ti a kì yio wó lulẹ.
entries.en: And Jesus answering said unto him, Seest thou these great buildings? there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.

entries.yo: Bi o si ti joko lori òke Olifi ti o kọju si tẹmpili, Peteru ati Jakọbu, ati Johanu ati Anderu, bi i lẽre nikọ̀kọ wipe,
entries.en: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives over against the temple, Peter and James and John and Andrew asked him privately,

entries.yo: Sọ fun wa, nigbawo ni nkan wọnyi yio ṣẹ? kini yio si ṣe àmi nigbati gbogbo nkan wọnyi yio ṣẹ?
entries.en: Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign when all these things shall be fulfilled?

entries.yo: Jesu si da wọn lohùn, o bẹ̀rẹ si isọ fun wọn pẹ, Ẹ mã kiyesara, ki ẹnikẹni ki o máṣe tàn nyin jẹ:
entries.en: And Jesus answering them began to say, Take heed lest any man deceive you:

entries.yo: Nitori awọn enia pipọ yio wá li orukọ mi, wipe, Emi ni Kristi; nwọn o si tàn ọ̀pọlọpọ jẹ.
entries.en: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.

entries.yo: Nigbati ẹnyin ba si ngburó ogun ati idagìri ogun; ki ẹnyin ki o máṣe jaiya: nitori irú nkan wọnyi kò le ṣe ki o ma ṣẹ; ṣugbọn opin na kì iṣe isisiyi.
entries.en: And when ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars, be ye not troubled: for such things must needs be; but the end shall not be yet.

entries.yo: Nitoripe orilẹ-ède yio dide si orilẹ-ede, ati ilẹ-ọba si ilẹ-ọba: isẹlẹ yio si wà ni ibi pupọ, ìyan yio si wà ati wahalà: nkan wọnyi ni ipilẹṣẹ ipọnju.
entries.en: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be earthquakes in divers places, and there shall be famines and troubles: these are the beginnings of sorrows.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹ mã kiyesara nyin: nitori nwọn ó si fi nyin le awọn igbimọ lọwọ; a o si lù nyin ninu sinagogu: a o si mu nyin duro niwaju awọn balẹ ati awọn ọba nitori orukọ mi, fun ẹrí si wọn.
entries.en: But take heed to yourselves: for they shall deliver you up to councils; and in the synagogues ye shall be beaten: and ye shall be brought before rulers and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them.

entries.yo: A kò le ṣaima kọ́ wasu ihinrere ni gbogbo orilẹ-ède.
entries.en: And the gospel must first be published among all nations.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati nwọn ba nfà nyin, lọ, ti nwọn ba si nfi nyin le wọn lọwọ, ẹ maṣe ṣaniyan ṣaju ohun ti ẹ o sọ; ṣugbọn ohun ti a ba fifun nyin ni wakati na, on ni ki ẹnyin ki o wi: nitori kì iṣe ẹnyin ni nwi, bikoṣe Ẹmí Mimọ́.
entries.en: But when they shall lead you, and deliver you up, take no thought beforehand what ye shall speak, neither do ye premeditate: but whatsoever shall be given you in that hour, that speak ye: for it is not ye that speak, but the Holy Ghost.

entries.yo: Arakunrin yio si fi arakunrin fun pipa, ati baba yio fi ọmọ rẹ̀ hàn; awọn ọmọ yio si dide si obi wọn, nwọn o si mu ki a pa wọn.
entries.en: Now the brother shall betray the brother to death, and the father the son; and children shall rise up against their parents, and shall cause them to be put to death.

entries.yo: Gbogbo enia ni yio si korira nyin nitori orukọ mi: ṣugbọn ẹniti o ba foritì i titi fi de opin, on na li a o gbalà.
entries.en: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name's sake: but he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati ẹnyin ba ri irira isọdahoro nì, ti o duro nibiti ko tọ́, ti a ti ẹnu woli Danieli ṣọ, (ẹnikẹni ti o ba kà a, ki o yé e,) nigbana ni ki awọn ti mbẹ ni Judea sálọ si ori òke:
entries.en: But when ye shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not, (let him that readeth understand,) then let them that be in Judaea flee to the mountains:

entries.yo: Ki ẹniti mbẹ lori ile ki o máṣe sọkalẹ lọ sinu ile, bẹ̃ni ki o má si ṣe wọ̀ inu rẹ̀, lati mu ohunkohun jade ninu ile rẹ̀:
entries.en: And let him that is on the housetop not go down into the house, neither enter therein, to take any thing out of his house:

entries.yo: Ati ki ẹniti mbẹ li oko ki o maṣe pada sẹhin wá lati mu aṣọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And let him that is in the field not turn back again for to take up his garment.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn egbé ni fun awọn ti o lóyun, ati fun awọn ti o nfi ọmu fun ọmọ mu li ọjọ wọnni!
entries.en: But woe to them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!

entries.yo: Ki ẹ si ma gbadura, ki sisá nyin ki o máṣe bọ́ si igba otutù.
entries.en: And pray ye that your flight be not in the winter.

entries.yo: Nitori ọjọ wọnni, yio jẹ ọjọ ipọnju irú eyi ti kò si lati igba ọjọ ìwa ti Ọlọrun da, titi fi di akokò yi, irú rẹ̀ ki yio si si.
entries.en: For in those days shall be affliction, such as was not from the beginning of the creation which God created unto this time, neither shall be.

entries.yo: Bi ko si ṣe bi Oluwa ti ke ọjọ wọnni kuru, kò si ẹda ti iba le là: ṣugbọn nitoriti awọn ayanfẹ ti o ti yàn, o ti ke ọjọ wọnni kuru.
entries.en: And except that the Lord had shortened those days, no flesh should be saved: but for the elect's sake, whom he hath chosen, he hath shortened the days.

entries.yo: Nitorina bi ẹnikan ba wi fun nyin pe, wo o, Kristi mbẹ nihinyi; tabi, wo o, o mbẹ lọ́hun; ẹ máṣe gbà a gbọ́:
entries.en: And then if any man shall say to you, Lo, here is Christ; or, lo, he is there; believe him not:

entries.yo: Nitori awọn eke Kristi, ati awọn eke woli yio dide, nwọn o si fi àmi ati ohun iyanu hàn, tobẹ̃ bi o ṣe iṣe, nwọn iba tàn awọn ayanfẹ pãpã.
entries.en: For false Christs and false prophets shall rise, and shall shew signs and wonders, to seduce, if it were possible, even the elect.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹ kiyesara: wo o, mo sọ ohun gbogbo fun nyin tẹlẹ.
entries.en: But take ye heed: behold, I have foretold you all things.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn li ọjọ wọnni, lẹhin ipọnju na, õrùn yio ṣõkun, oṣupá kì yio si fi imọle rẹ̀ hàn;
entries.en: But in those days, after that tribulation, the sun shall be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light,

entries.yo: Awọn irawọ oju ọrun yio já silẹ̀, ati agbara ti mbẹ li ọrun li a o si mì titi.
entries.en: And the stars of heaven shall fall, and the powers that are in heaven shall be shaken.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni nwọn o si ri Ọmọ-enia ti yio ma ti oju ọrun bọ̀ ti on ti agbara nla ati ogo.
entries.en: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in the clouds with great power and glory.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni yio si rán awọn angẹli rẹ̀, yio si kó gbogbo awọn ayanfẹ rẹ̀ lati ori igun mẹrẹrin aiye jọ, lati ikangun aiye titi de ikangun ọrun.
entries.en: And then shall he send his angels, and shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from the uttermost part of the earth to the uttermost part of heaven.

entries.yo: Nisisiyi ẹ kọ́ owe lara igi ọpọtọ; Nigbati ẹ̀ka rẹ̀ ba yọ titun, ti o ba si ru ewé, ẹnyin mọ̀ pe igba ẹ̃rùn sunmọ etile:
entries.en: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When her branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer is near:

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bẹ̃ na li ẹnyin, nigbati ẹnyin ba ri nkan wọnyi ti nṣẹ, ki ẹ mọ̀ pe o sunmọ etile tan lẹhin ilẹkun.
entries.en: So ye in like manner, when ye shall see these things come to pass, know that it is nigh, even at the doors.

entries.yo: Lõtọ ni mo wi fun nyin, Iran yi kì yio rekọja, titi a o fi mu gbogbo nkan wọnyi ṣẹ.
entries.en: Verily I say unto you, that this generation shall not pass, till all these things be done.

entries.yo: Ọrun on aiye yio rekọja: ṣugbọn ọ̀rọ mi kì yio rekọja.
entries.en: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn niti ọjọ ati wakati na, kò si ẹnikan ti o mọ̀ ọ, kò si, ki tilẹ iṣe awọn angẹli ọrun, tabi Ọmọ, bikoṣe Baba mi nikanṣoṣo.
entries.en: But of that day and that hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels which are in heaven, neither the Son, but the Father.

entries.yo: Ẹ mã ṣọra, ki ẹ si mã gbadura: nitori ẹnyin ko mọ̀ igbati akokò na yio de.
entries.en: Take ye heed, watch and pray: for ye know not when the time is.

entries.yo: Nitori Ọmọ-enia dabi ọkunrin kan ti o lọ si àjo ti o jìna rére, ẹniti o fi ile rẹ̀ silẹ, ti o si fi aṣẹ fun awọn ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ̀, ati iṣẹ olukuluku fun u, ti o si fi aṣẹ fun oluṣọna ki o mã ṣọna.
entries.en: For the Son of man is as a man taking a far journey, who left his house, and gave authority to his servants, and to every man his work, and commanded the porter to watch.

entries.yo: Nitorina ẹ mã ṣọna: nitori ẹnyin ko mọ̀ igba ti bãle ile mbọ̀wá, bi li alẹ ni, tabi larin ọganjọ, tabi li akukọ, tabi li owurọ̀:
entries.en: Watch ye therefore: for ye know not when the master of the house cometh, at even, or at midnight, or at the cockcrowing, or in the morning:

entries.yo: Pe, nigbati o ba de li ojijì, ki o máṣe ba nyin li oju orun.
entries.en: Lest coming suddenly he find you sleeping.

entries.yo: Ohun ti mo wi fun nyin, mo wi fun gbogbo enia, Ẹ mã ṣọna.
entries.en: And what I say unto you I say unto all, Watch.

entries.yo: LẸHIN ọjọ meji ni ajọ irekọja, ati ti aiwukara: ati awọn olori alufa ati awọn akọwe nwá ọ̀na bi nwọn iba ti fi ẹ̀tan mu u, ki nwọn ki o pa a.
entries.en: After two days was the feast of the passover, and of unleavened bread: and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might take him by craft, and put him to death.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nwọn wipe, Ki iṣe li ọjọ ajọ, ki ariwo ki o má ba wà ninu awọn enia.
entries.en: But they said, Not on the feast day, lest there be an uproar of the people.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si wà ni Betani ni ile Simoni adẹtẹ̀, bi o ti joko tì onjẹ, obinrin kan ti o ni oruba alabasta ororo ikunra nardi iyebiye, o wá, o si fọ́ orúba na, o si ndà a si i lori.
entries.en: And being in Bethany in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at meat, there came a woman having an alabaster box of ointment of spikenard very precious; and she brake the box, and poured it on his head.

entries.yo: Awọn kan si wà ti inu wọn ru ninu ara wọn, nwọn si wipe, Nitori kili a ṣe nfi ororo ikunra yi ṣòfo?
entries.en: And there were some that had indignation within themselves, and said, Why was this waste of the ointment made?

entries.yo: A ba sá tà ororo ikunra yi jù ìwọn ọ̃dunrun owo idẹ lọ a ba si fifun awọn talakà. Nwọn si nkùn si i.
entries.en: For it might have been sold for more than three hundred pence, and have been given to the poor. And they murmured against her.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Jesu wipe, Ẹ jọwọ rẹ̀ si; ẽṣe ti ẹnyin fi mba a wi? iṣẹ rere li o ṣe si mì lara.
entries.en: And Jesus said, Let her alone; why trouble ye her? she hath wrought a good work on me.

entries.yo: Nigbagbogbo li ẹnyin sá ni talakà pẹlu nyin, ẹnyin le ma ṣore fun wọn nigbakugba ti ẹnyin fẹ; ṣugbọn emi li ẹnyin kó ni nigbagbogbo.
entries.en: For ye have the poor with you always, and whensoever ye will ye may do them good: but me ye have not always.

entries.yo: O ṣe eyi ti o le ṣe: o wá ṣiwaju lati fi oróro kùn ara mi fun sisinku mi.
entries.en: She hath done what she could: she is come aforehand to anoint my body to the burying.

entries.yo: Lõtọ ni mo wi fun nyin, Nibikibi ti a o gbé wasu ihinrere yi ni gbogbo aiye, nibẹ̀ pẹlu li a o si rò ihin eyi ti obinrin yi ṣe lati fi ṣe iranti rẹ̀.
entries.en: Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached throughout the whole world, this also that she hath done shall be spoken of for a memorial of her.

entries.yo: Judasi Iskariotu, ọkan ninu awọn mejila, si tọ̀ awọn olori alufa lọ, lati fi i le wọn lọwọ.
entries.en: And Judas Iscariot, one of the twelve, went unto the chief priests, to betray him unto them.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si gbọ́, nwọn yọ̀, nwọn si ṣe ileri lati fun u li owo. O si nwá ọ̀na bi yio ti ṣe fi i le wọn lọwọ.
entries.en: And when they heard it, they were glad, and promised to give him money. And he sought how he might conveniently betray him.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ kini ajọ aiwukara, nigbati nwọn npa ẹran irekọja, awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ si wi fun u pe, Nibo ni iwọ nfẹ ki a lọ ipèse silẹ, ki iwọ́ ki o le jẹ irekọja.
entries.en: And the first day of unleavened bread, when they killed the passover, his disciples said unto him, Where wilt thou that we go and prepare that thou mayest eat the passover?

entries.yo: O si rán awọn meji ninu awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀, o si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ lọ si ilu, ọkunrin kan ti nrù ìṣa omi yio pade nyin: ẹ mã tọ̀ ọ lẹhin.
entries.en: And he sendeth forth two of his disciples, and saith unto them, Go ye into the city, and there shall meet you a man bearing a pitcher of water: follow him.

entries.yo: Ati ibikibi ti o ba gbé wọ̀, ki ẹnyin ki o wi fun bãle na pe, Olukọni wipe, Nibo ni gbọ̀ngan apejẹ na gbé wà, nibiti emi o gbé jẹ irekọja pẹlu awọn ọmọ-ẹhin mi?
entries.en: And wheresoever he shall go in, say ye to the goodman of the house, The Master saith, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?

entries.yo: On o si fi gbọ̀ngan nla kan loke hàn nyin, ti a ṣe lọṣọ, ti a si pèse tẹlẹ; nibẹ̀ ni ki ẹnyin ki o pèse silẹ dè wa.
entries.en: And he will shew you a large upper room furnished and prepared: there make ready for us.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ si jade lọ, nwọn wá si ilu, nwọn si ri i gẹgẹ bi o ti sọ fun wọn: nwọn si pèse irekọja silẹ.
entries.en: And his disciples went forth, and came into the city, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.

entries.yo: Nigbati alẹ lẹ, o wá pẹlu awọn mejila.
entries.en: And in the evening he cometh with the twelve.

entries.yo: Bi nwọn si ti joko ti nwọn njẹun, Jesu wipe, Lõtọ ni mo wi fun nyin, Ọkan ninu nyin yio fi mi hàn, ani on na ti mba mi jẹun.
entries.en: And as they sat and did eat, Jesus said, Verily I say unto you, One of you which eateth with me shall betray me.

entries.yo: Nwọn si bẹ̀rẹ si ikãnu gidigidi, ati si ibi i lẽre lọkọ̃kan wipe, Emi ni bi? ekeji si wipe, Emi ni bi?
entries.en: And they began to be sorrowful, and to say unto him one by one, Is it I? and another said, Is it I?

entries.yo: O si dahùn o si wi fun wọn pe, Ọkan ninu awọn mejila ni, ti o ntọwọ bọ̀ inu awo pẹlu mi.
entries.en: And he answered and said unto them, It is one of the twelve, that dippeth with me in the dish.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ Ọmọ-enia nlọ bi a ti kọwe nipa tirẹ̀: ṣugbọn egbé ni fun ọkunrin na, lọdọ ẹniti a gbé ti fi Ọmọ-enia hàn! iba san fun ọkunrin na, bi o ṣepe a kò bí i.
entries.en: The Son of man indeed goeth, as it is written of him: but woe to that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! good were it for that man if he had never been born.

entries.yo: Bi nwọn si ti njẹun, Jesu mu akara, o si sure, o si bu u, o si fifun wọn, o wipe, Gbà, jẹ: eyiyi li ara mi.
entries.en: And as they did eat, Jesus took bread, and blessed, and brake it, and gave to them, and said, Take, eat: this is my body.

entries.yo: O si gbe ago, nigbati o si sure tan, o fifun wọn: gbogbo nwọn si mu ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he took the cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave it to them: and they all drank of it.

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Eyi li ẹ̀jẹ mi ti majẹmu titun, ti a ta silẹ fun ọ̀pọ enia.
entries.en: And he said unto them, This is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many.

entries.yo: Lõtọ ni mo wi fun nyin, emi kì yio mu ninu eso ajara mọ́, titi yio fi di ọjọ na, nigbati emi o mu u ni titun ni ijọba Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Verily I say unto you, I will drink no more of the fruit of the vine, until that day that I drink it new in the kingdom of God.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si kọ orin kan tan, nwọn jade lọ sori òke Olifi.
entries.en: And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives.

entries.yo: Jesu si wi fun wọn pe, Gbogbo nyin ni yio kọsẹ̀ lara mi li oru oni: nitoriti a ti kọwe rẹ̀ pe, Emi o lù oluṣọ agutan, a o si tú agbo agutan ká kiri.
entries.en: And Jesus saith unto them, All ye shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn lẹhin igba ti mo ba jinde, emi o ṣaju nyin lọ si Galili.
entries.en: But after that I am risen, I will go before you into Galilee.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Peteru wi fun u pe, Bi gbogbo enia tilẹ kọsẹ̀, ṣugbọn emi kọ́.
entries.en: But Peter said unto him, Although all shall be offended, yet will not I.

entries.yo: Jesu si wi fun u pe, Lõtọ ni mo wi fun ọ pe, loni yi, ani li alẹ yi, ki akukọ ki o to kọ nigba meji, iwọ o sẹ́ mi nigba mẹta.
entries.en: And Jesus saith unto him, Verily I say unto thee, That this day, even in this night, before the cock crow twice, thou shalt deny me thrice.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn o tẹnumọ ọ gidigidi wipe, Bi o tilẹ di ati ba ọ kú, emi ko jẹ sẹ́ ọ bi o ti wù ki o ri. Gẹgẹ bẹ̃ni gbogbo wọn wi pẹlu.
entries.en: But he spake the more vehemently, If I should die with thee, I will not deny thee in any wise. Likewise also said they all.

entries.yo: Nwọn si wá si ibi kan ti a npè ni Getsemane: o si wi fun awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ pe, Ẹ joko nihinyi, nigbati mo ba lọ igbadura.
entries.en: And they came to a place which was named Gethsemane: and he saith to his disciples, Sit ye here, while I shall pray.

entries.yo: O si mu Peteru ati Jakọbu ati Johanu pẹlu rẹ̀, ẹnu si bẹrẹ si yà a gidigidi, o si bẹré si rẹ̀wẹsi.
entries.en: And he taketh with him Peter and James and John, and began to be sore amazed, and to be very heavy;

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pẹ, Ọkàn mi nkãnu gidigidi titi de ikú: ẹ duro nihin, ki ẹ si mã ṣọna.
entries.en: And saith unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful unto death: tarry ye here, and watch.

entries.yo: O si lọ siwaju diẹ, o si dojubolẹ, o si gbadura pe, bi o ba le ṣe, ki wakati na le kọja kuro lori rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that, if it were possible, the hour might pass from him.

entries.yo: O si wipe, Abba, Baba, ṣiṣe li ohun gbogbo fun ọ; mú ago yi kuro lori mi: ṣugbọn kì iṣe eyiti emi fẹ, bikoṣe eyiti iwọ fẹ,
entries.en: And he said, Abba, Father, all things are possible unto thee; take away this cup from me: nevertheless not what I will, but what thou wilt.

entries.yo: O si wá, o ba wọn, nwọn nsùn, o si wi fun Peteru pe, Simoni, iwọ nsùn? iwọ kò le ṣọna ni wakati kan?
entries.en: And he cometh, and findeth them sleeping, and saith unto Peter, Simon, sleepest thou? couldest not thou watch one hour?

entries.yo: Ẹ mã ṣọna, kì ẹ si mã gbadura, ki ẹ má ba bọ́ sinu idẹwò. Lõtọ li ẹmí nfẹ, ṣugbọn o ṣe ailera fun ara.
entries.en: Watch ye and pray, lest ye enter into temptation. The spirit truly is ready, but the flesh is weak.

entries.yo: O si tún pada lọ, o si gbadura, o nsọ ọ̀rọ kanna.
entries.en: And again he went away, and prayed, and spake the same words.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si pada wá, o tún bá wọn, nwọn nsùn, nitoriti oju wọn kún fun orun, bẹ̃ni nwọn kò si mọ̀ èsi ti nwọn iba fifun u.
entries.en: And when he returned, he found them asleep again, (for their eyes were heavy,) neither wist they what to answer him.

entries.yo: O si wá li ẹrinkẹta, o si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ mã sùn wayi, ki ẹ si mã simi: o to bẹ̃, wakati na de; wo o, a fi Ọmọ-enia le awọn ẹlẹṣẹ lọwọ.
entries.en: And he cometh the third time, and saith unto them, Sleep on now, and take your rest: it is enough, the hour is come; behold, the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

entries.yo: Ẹ dide, ki a ma lọ; wo o, ẹniti o fi mi hàn sunmọ tosi.
entries.en: Rise up, let us go; lo, he that betrayeth me is at hand.

entries.yo: Lojukanna, bi o si ti nsọ lọwọ, Judasi de, ọkan ninu awọn mejila, ati ọ̀pọ enia pẹlu rẹ̀ ti awọn ti idà, pẹlu ọgọ, lati ọdọ olori alufa, ati awọn akọwe, ati awọn agbagba wá.
entries.en: And immediately, while he yet spake, cometh Judas, one of the twelve, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and the scribes and the elders.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o si fi i hàn ti fi àmi fun wọn, wipe, Ẹnikẹni ti mo ba fi ẹnu kò li ẹnu, on na ni; ẹ mu u, ki ẹ si ma fà a lọ li alafia.
entries.en: And he that betrayed him had given them a token, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is he; take him, and lead him away safely.

entries.yo: Nigbati o de, o tọ̀ ọ lọ gan, o wipe, Olukọni, olukọni! o si fi ẹnu kò o li ẹnu.
entries.en: And as soon as he was come, he goeth straightway to him, and saith, Master, master; and kissed him.

entries.yo: Nwọn si gbé ọwọ́ wọn le e, nwọn si mu u.
entries.en: And they laid their hands on him, and took him.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ọkan ninu awọn ti o duro nibẹ̀ fà idà yọ, o si sá ọmọ-ọdọ olori alufa, o si ke etí rẹ̀ kuro.
entries.en: And one of them that stood by drew a sword, and smote a servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.

entries.yo: Jesu si dahùn o si wi fun wọn pe, Emi li ẹnyin jade tọ̀ wá bi olè, ti ẹnyin ti idà ati ọgọ lati mu?
entries.en: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Are ye come out, as against a thief, with swords and with staves to take me?

entries.yo: Li ojojumọ li emi wà pẹlu nyin ni tẹmpili, ti emi nkọ́ nyin, ẹnyin kò si mu mi: ṣugbọn iwe-mimọ kò le ṣe alaiṣẹ.
entries.en: I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and ye took me not: but the scriptures must be fulfilled.

entries.yo: Gbogbo wọn si fi i silẹ, nwọn si sá lọ.
entries.en: And they all forsook him, and fled.

entries.yo: Ọmọkunrin kan si ntọ̀ ọ lẹhin, ti o fi aṣọ ọgbọ bò ìhoho rẹ̀; awọn ọmọ-ogun si gbá a mu:
entries.en: And there followed him a certain young man, having a linen cloth cast about his naked body; and the young men laid hold on him:

entries.yo: O si jọwọ aṣọ ọgbọ na lọwọ, o si sá kuro lọdọ wọn nihoho.
entries.en: And he left the linen cloth, and fled from them naked.

entries.yo: Nwọn si mu Jesu lọ ṣọdọ olori alufa: gbogbo awọn olori alufa, ati awọn agbagba, ati awọn akọwe si pejọ pẹlu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And they led Jesus away to the high priest: and with him were assembled all the chief priests and the elders and the scribes.

entries.yo: Peteru si tọ̀ ọ lẹhin li òkere wọ̀ inu ile, titi fi de agbala olori alufa; o si bá awọn ọmọ-ọdọ joko, o si nyána.
entries.en: And Peter followed him afar off, even into the palace of the high priest: and he sat with the servants, and warmed himself at the fire.

entries.yo: Awọn olori alufa ati gbogbo ajọ ìgbimọ nwá ẹlẹri si Jesu lati pa a; nwọn kò si ri ohun kan.
entries.en: And the chief priests and all the council sought for witness against Jesus to put him to death; and found none.

entries.yo: Nitoripe ọ̀pọlọpọ li o jẹri eke si i, ṣugbọn ohùn awọn ẹlẹri na kò ṣọkan.
entries.en: For many bare false witness against him, but their witness agreed not together.

entries.yo: Awọn kan si dide, nwọn njẹri eke si i, wipe,
entries.en: And there arose certain, and bare false witness against him, saying,

entries.yo: Awa gbọ́ o wipe, Emi ó wó tẹmpili yi ti a fi ọwọ́ ṣe, niwọn ijọ́ mẹta emi o si kọ́ omiran ti a kò fi ọwọ́ ṣe.
entries.en: We heard him say, I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and within three days I will build another made without hands.

entries.yo: Ati ninu eyi na pẹlu, ohùn wọn kò ṣọkan.
entries.en: But neither so did their witness agree together.

entries.yo: Olori alufa si dide duro larin, o si bi Jesu lẽre, wipe, Iwọ kò dahùn kan? kili eyi ti awọn wọnyi njẹri si ọ?
entries.en: And the high priest stood up in the midst, and asked Jesus, saying, Answerest thou nothing? what is it which these witness against thee?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Jesu dakẹ, ko si dahùn ohun kan. Olori alufa si tun bi i lẽre, o wi fun u pe, Iwọ ni Kristi na, Ọmọ Olubukun nì?
entries.en: But he held his peace, and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked him, and said unto him, Art thou the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?

entries.yo: Jesu si wipe, Emi ni: ẹnyin o si ri Ọmọ-enia joko li ọwọ́ ọtún agbara, yio si ma ti inu awọsanma ọrun wá.
entries.en: And Jesus said, I am: and ye shall see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.

entries.yo: Nigbana li olori alufa fà aṣọ rẹ̀ ya, o wipe, Ẹlẹri kili a si nwá?
entries.en: Then the high priest rent his clothes, and saith, What need we any further witnesses?

entries.yo: Ẹnyin gbọ́ ọrọ-odi na: ẹnyin ti rò o si? Gbogbo wọn si da a lẹbi pe, o jẹbi ikú.
entries.en: Ye have heard the blasphemy: what think ye? And they all condemned him to be guilty of death.

entries.yo: Awon miran si bẹ̀rẹ si itutọ́ si i lara, ati si ibò o loju, ati si ikàn a lẹṣẹ́, nwọn si wi fun u pe, Sọtẹlẹ: awọn onṣẹ si nfi atẹlẹ ọwọ́ wọn gbá a loju.
entries.en: And some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to buffet him, and to say unto him, Prophesy: and the servants did strike him with the palms of their hands.

entries.yo: Bi Peteru si ti wà ni isalẹ li ãfin, ọkan ninu awọn ọmọbinrin olori alufa wá:
entries.en: And as Peter was beneath in the palace, there cometh one of the maids of the high priest:

entries.yo: Nigbati o si ri ti Peteru nyána, o wò o, o si wipe, Iwọ pẹlu ti wà pẹlu Jesu ti Nasareti.
entries.en: And when she saw Peter warming himself, she looked upon him, and said, And thou also wast with Jesus of Nazareth.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn o sẹ́, wipe, Emi ko mọ̀, oyé ohun ti iwọ nwi kò tilẹ yé mi. O si jade lọ si iloro; akukọ si kọ.
entries.en: But he denied, saying, I know not, neither understand I what thou sayest. And he went out into the porch; and the cock crew.

entries.yo: Ọmọbinrin na si tún ri i, o si bẹ̀rẹ si iwi fun awọn ti o duro nibẹ̀ pe, Ọkan ninu wọn ni eyi.
entries.en: And a maid saw him again, and began to say to them that stood by, This is one of them.

entries.yo: O si tún sẹ́. O si pẹ diẹ, awọn ti o duro nibẹ̀ tún wi fun Peteru pe, Lõtọ ni, ọkan ninu wọn ni iwọ iṣe: nitoripe ara Galili ni iwọ, ède rẹ si jọ bẹ̃.
entries.en: And he denied it again. And a little after, they that stood by said again to Peter, Surely thou art one of them: for thou art a Galilaean, and thy speech agreeth thereto.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn o bẹ̀rẹ si iré ati si ibura, wipe, Emi ko mọ̀ ọkunrin yi ẹniti ẹnyin nwi.
entries.en: But he began to curse and to swear, saying, I know not this man of whom ye speak.

entries.yo: Lojukanna akukọ si kọ lẹrinkeji. Peteru si ranti ọrọ ti Jesu wi fun u pe, Ki akukọ ki o to kọ lẹrinmeji, iwo o sẹ́ mi lẹrinmẹta. Nigbati o si rò o, o sọkun.
entries.en: And the second time the cock crew. And Peter called to mind the word that Jesus said unto him, Before the cock crow twice, thou shalt deny me thrice. And when he thought thereon, he wept.

entries.yo: ATI lojukanna li owurọ, awọn olori alufa jọ gbìmọ pẹlu awọn alàgba, ati awọn akọwe, ati gbogbo ajọ ìgbimọ, nwọn si dè Jesu, nwọn si mu u lọ, nwọn si fi i le Pilatu lọwọ.
entries.en: And straightway in the morning the chief priests held a consultation with the elders and scribes and the whole council, and bound Jesus, and carried him away, and delivered him to Pilate.

entries.yo: Pilatu si bi i lẽre, wipe Iwọ ha li Ọba awọn Ju? O si dahùn wi fun u pe, Iwọ wi i.
entries.en: And Pilate asked him, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answering said unto him, Thou sayest it.

entries.yo: Awọn olori alufa si fi i sùn li ohun pipọ: ṣugbọn on ko dahùn kan.
entries.en: And the chief priests accused him of many things: but he answered nothing.

entries.yo: Pilatu si tún bi i lẽre, wipe, Iwọ ko dahùn ohun kan? wò ọ̀pọ ohun ti nwọn njẹri si ọ.
entries.en: And Pilate asked him again, saying, Answerest thou nothing? behold how many things they witness against thee.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Jesu ko da a ni gbolohùn kan: tobẹ̃ ti ẹnu fi yà Pilatu.
entries.en: But Jesus yet answered nothing; so that Pilate marvelled.

entries.yo: Njẹ nigba ajọ na, on a ma dá ondè kan silẹ fun wọn, ẹnikẹni ti nwọn ba bere.
entries.en: Now at that feast he released unto them one prisoner, whomsoever they desired.

entries.yo: Ẹnikan si wà ti a npè ni Barabba, ẹniti a sọ sinu tubu pẹlu awọn ti o ṣọ̀tẹ pẹlu rẹ̀, awọn ẹniti o si pania pẹlu ninu ìṣọtẹ na.
entries.en: And there was one named Barabbas, which lay bound with them that had made insurrection with him, who had committed murder in the insurrection.

entries.yo: Ijọ enia si bẹ̀rẹ si ikigbe soke li ohùn rara, nwọn nfẹ ki o ṣe bi on ti ima ṣe fun wọn ri.
entries.en: And the multitude crying aloud began to desire him to do as he had ever done unto them.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Pilatu da wọn lohùn, wipe, Ẹnyin nfẹ ki emi ki o da Ọba awọn Ju silẹ fun nyin?
entries.en: But Pilate answered them, saying, Will ye that I release unto you the King of the Jews?

entries.yo: On sá ti mọ̀ pe nitori ilara ni awọn olori alufa ṣe fi i le on lọwọ.
entries.en: For he knew that the chief priests had delivered him for envy.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn olori alufa rú awọn enia soke pe, ki o kuku dá Barabba silẹ fun wọn.
entries.en: But the chief priests moved the people, that he should rather release Barabbas unto them.

entries.yo: Pilatu si dahùn o tún wi fun wọn pe, Kili ẹnyin ha nfẹ ki emi ki o ṣe si ẹniti ẹnyin npè li Ọba awọn Ju?
entries.en: And Pilate answered and said again unto them, What will ye then that I shall do unto him whom ye call the King of the Jews?

entries.yo: Nwọn si tún kigbe soke, wipe, Kàn a mọ agbelebu.
entries.en: And they cried out again, Crucify him.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Pilatu si bi wọn lẽre, wipe, Eṣe? buburu kili o ṣe? Nwọn si kigbe soke gidigidi, wipe, Kàn a mọ agbelebu.
entries.en: Then Pilate said unto them, Why, what evil hath he done? And they cried out the more exceedingly, Crucify him.

entries.yo: Pilatu si nfẹ se eyi ti o wù awọn enia, o da Barabba silẹ fun wọn. Nigbati o si nà Jesu tan, o fà a le wọn lọwọ lati kàn a mọ agbelebu.
entries.en: And so Pilate, willing to content the people, released Barabbas unto them, and delivered Jesus, when he had scourged him, to be crucified.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ-ogun si fà a jade lọ sinu gbọ̀ngan, ti a npè ni Pretorioni; nwọn si pè gbogbo ẹgbẹ awọn ọmọ-ogun jọ.
entries.en: And the soldiers led him away into the hall, called Praetorium; and they call together the whole band.

entries.yo: Nwọn si fi aṣọ elesè àluko wọ̀ ọ, nwọn hun ade ẹgún, nwọn si fi dé e li ori;
entries.en: And they clothed him with purple, and platted a crown of thorns, and put it about his head,

entries.yo: Nwọn si bẹ̀rẹ si ikí i, wipe, Kabiyesi, Ọba awọn Ju!
entries.en: And began to salute him, Hail, King of the Jews!

entries.yo: Nwọn si fi ọpá iye lù u lori, nwọn si tutọ́ si i lara, nwọn si kunlẹ niwaju rẹ̀, nwọn si foribalẹ fun u.
entries.en: And they smote him on the head with a reed, and did spit upon him, and bowing their knees worshipped him.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si fi i ṣẹ̀sin tan, nwọn si bọ́ aṣọ elesè àluko na kuro lara rẹ̀, nwọn si fi aṣọ rẹ̀ wọ̀ ọ, nwọn si mu u jade lọ lati kàn a mọ agbelebu.
entries.en: And when they had mocked him, they took off the purple from him, and put his own clothes on him, and led him out to crucify him.

entries.yo: Nwọn si fi agbara mu ọkunrin kan, lati rù agbelebu rẹ̀, Simoni ara Kirene, ẹniti nkọja lọ, ti nti igberiko bọ̀, baba Aleksanderu ati Rufu.
entries.en: And they compel one Simon a Cyrenian, who passed by, coming out of the country, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to bear his cross.

entries.yo: Nwọn si mu u wá si ibi ti a npè ni Golgota, itumọ eyi ti ijẹ́, Ibi agbari.
entries.en: And they bring him unto the place Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, The place of a skull.

entries.yo: Nwọn si fi ọti-waini ti a dàpọ mọ ojia fun u lati mu: ṣugbọn on kò gbà a.
entries.en: And they gave him to drink wine mingled with myrrh: but he received it not.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si kàn a mọ agbelebu tan, nwọn si pín aṣọ rẹ̀, nwọn si ṣẹ gège lori wọn, eyi ti olukuluku iba mú.
entries.en: And when they had crucified him, they parted his garments, casting lots upon them, what every man should take.

entries.yo: Ni wakati kẹta ọjọ, on ni nwọn kàn a mọ agbelebu.
entries.en: And it was the third hour, and they crucified him.

entries.yo: A si kọwe akọle ọ̀ran ifisùn rẹ̀ si igberi rẹ̀ ỌBA AWỌN JU.
entries.en: And the superscription of his accusation was written over, THE KING OF THE JEWS.

entries.yo: Nwọn si kàn awọn olè meji mọ agbelebu pẹlu rẹ̀; ọkan li ọwọ́ ọtún, ati ekeji li ọwọ́ òsi rẹ̀.
entries.en: And with him they crucify two thieves; the one on his right hand, and the other on his left.

entries.yo: Iwe-mimọ si ṣẹ, ti o wipe, A si kà a mọ awọn arufin.
entries.en: And the scripture was fulfilled, which saith, And he was numbered with the transgressors.

entries.yo: Awọn ti nrekọja lọ si nfi i ṣe ẹlẹyà, nwọn si nmì ori wọn, wipe, A, Iwọ ti o wó tẹmpili, ti o si kọ́ ọ ni ijọ mẹta,
entries.en: And they that passed by railed on him, wagging their heads, and saying, Ah, thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest it in three days,

entries.yo: Gbà ara rẹ, ki o si sọkalẹ lati ori agbelebu wá.
entries.en: Save thyself, and come down from the cross.

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bẹ̃li awọn olori alufa pẹlu, nwọn nsin i jẹ ninu ara wọn pẹlu awọn akọwe, wipe, O gbà awọn ẹlomiran là; kò le gbà ara rẹ̀.
entries.en: Likewise also the chief priests mocking said among themselves with the scribes, He saved others; himself he cannot save.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki Kristi, Ọba Israeli, sọkalẹ lati ori agbelebu wá nisisiyi, ki awa ki o le ri i, ki a si le gbagbọ́. Awọn ti a kàn mọ agbelebu pẹlu rẹ̀ si nkẹgan rẹ̀.
entries.en: Let Christ the King of Israel descend now from the cross, that we may see and believe. And they that were crucified with him reviled him.

entries.yo: Nigbati o di wakati kẹfa, òkunkun si ṣú bò gbogbo ilẹ titi o fi di wakati kẹsan.
entries.en: And when the sixth hour was come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.

entries.yo: Ni wakati kẹsan ni Jesu si kigbe soke li ohùn rara, wipe, Eloi, Eloi, lama sabaktani? itumọ eyi ti ijẹ, Ọlọrun mi, Ọlọrun mi, ẽṣe ti iwọ fi kọ̀ mi silẹ?
entries.en: And at the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani? which is, being interpreted, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn kan ninu awọn ti o duro nibẹ̀ gbọ́ eyi, nwọn wipe, Wò o, o npè Elijah.
entries.en: And some of them that stood by, when they heard it, said, Behold, he calleth Elias.

entries.yo: Ẹnikan si sare, o fi sponge bọ ọti kikan, o fi le ori ọpá iyè, o fifun u mu, wipe, Ẹ jọwọ rẹ̀ si; ẹ jẹ ki a ma wò bi Elijah yio wá gbé e sọkalẹ.
entries.en: And one ran and filled a spunge full of vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him to drink, saying, Let alone; let us see whether Elias will come to take him down.

entries.yo: Jesu si kigbe soke li ohùn rara, o jọwọ ẹmi rẹ̀ lọwọ.
entries.en: And Jesus cried with a loud voice, and gave up the ghost.

entries.yo: Aṣọ ikele tẹmpili si ya si meji lati oke de isalẹ.
entries.en: And the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom.

entries.yo: Nigbati balogun ọrún, ti o duro niha ọdọ rẹ̀ ri ti o kigbe soke bayi, ti o si jọwọ ẹmi rẹ̀ lọwọ, o wipe, Lõtọ Ọmọ Ọlọrun li ọkunrin yi iṣe.
entries.en: And when the centurion, which stood over against him, saw that he so cried out, and gave up the ghost, he said, Truly this man was the Son of God.

entries.yo: Awọn obinrin pẹlu si wà li òkere nwọn nwò: ninu awọn ẹniti Maria Magdalene wà, ati Maria iya Jakọbu kekere, ati ti Jose ati Salome;
entries.en: There were also women looking on afar off: among whom was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses, and Salome;

entries.yo: (Awọn ẹniti, nigbati o wà ni Galili, ti nwọn ntọ̀ ọ lẹhin, ti nwọn si nṣe iranṣẹ fun u;) ati ọ̀pọ obinrin miran pẹlu, ti o ba a goke wá si Jerusalemu.
entries.en: (Who also, when he was in Galilee, followed him, and ministered unto him;) and many other women which came up with him unto Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Nigbati alẹ si lẹ, nitoriti iṣe ọjọ ipalẹmọ, eyini ni, ọjọ ti o ṣiwaju ọjọ isimi,
entries.en: And now when the even was come, because it was the preparation, that is, the day before the sabbath,

entries.yo: Josefu ara Arimatea, ọlọlá ìgbimọ, ẹniti on tikalarẹ̀ pẹlu nreti ijọba Ọlọrun, o wá, o si wọle tọ̀ Pilatu lọ laifòya, o si tọrọ okú Jesu.
entries.en: Joseph of Arimathaea, and honourable counseller, which also waited for the kingdom of God, came, and went in boldly unto Pilate, and craved the body of Jesus.

entries.yo: Ẹnu si yà Pilatu gidigidi, bi o ti kú na: o si pè balogun ọrún, o bi i lẽre bi igba ti o ti kú ti pẹ diẹ.
entries.en: And Pilate marvelled if he were already dead: and calling unto him the centurion, he asked him whether he had been any while dead.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si mọ̀ lati ọdọ balọgun ọrún na, o si fi okú na fun Josefu.
entries.en: And when he knew it of the centurion, he gave the body to Joseph.

entries.yo: O si rà aṣọ ọgbọ wá, o si sọ̀ ọ kalẹ, o si fi aṣọ ọgbọ na dì i, o si tẹ́ ẹ sinu ibojì ti a gbẹ́ ninu apata, o si yi okuta kan di ẹnu-ọ̀na ibojì na.
entries.en: And he bought fine linen, and took him down, and wrapped him in the linen, and laid him in a sepulchre which was hewn out of a rock, and rolled a stone unto the door of the sepulchre.

entries.yo: Ati Maria Magdalene, ati Maria iya Jose, ri ibi ti a gbé tẹ́ ẹ si.
entries.en: And Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses beheld where he was laid.

entries.yo: NIGBATI ọjọ isimi si kọja, Maria Magdalene, ati Maria iya Jakọbu, ati Salome rà turari ki nwọn ba wá lati fi kùn u.
entries.en: And when the sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome, had bought sweet spices, that they might come and anoint him.

entries.yo: Ni kutukutu owurọ̀ ọjọ kini ọ̀sẹ, nwọn wá si ibi iboji nigbati õrùn bẹ̀rẹ si ilà.
entries.en: And very early in the morning the first day of the week, they came unto the sepulchre at the rising of the sun.

entries.yo: Nwọn si mba ara wọn ṣe aroye, wipe, Tani yio yi okuta kuro li ẹnu ibojì na fun wa?
entries.en: And they said among themselves, Who shall roll us away the stone from the door of the sepulchre?

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si wò o, nwọn ri pe a ti yi okuta na kuro: nitoripe o tobi gidigidi.
entries.en: And when they looked, they saw that the stone was rolled away: for it was very great.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si wọ̀ inu ibojì na, nwọn ri ọmọkunrin kan joko li apa ọtún, ti o wọ̀ agbada funfun; ẹ̀ru si ba wọn.
entries.en: And entering into the sepulchre, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, clothed in a long white garment; and they were affrighted.

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ má bẹ̀ru: ẹnyin nwá Jesu ti Nasareti, ti a kàn mọ agbelebu: o jinde; kò si nihinyi: ẹ wò ibi ti nwọn gbé tẹ́ ẹ si.
entries.en: And he saith unto them, Be not affrighted: Ye seek Jesus of Nazareth, which was crucified: he is risen; he is not here: behold the place where they laid him.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹ lọ, ki ẹ si wi fun awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ ati Peteru pe, o ṣaju nyin lọ si Galili: nibẹ̀ li ẹnyin ó gbe ri i, bi o ti wi fun nyin.
entries.en: But go your way, tell his disciples and Peter that he goeth before you into Galilee: there shall ye see him, as he said unto you.

entries.yo: Nwọn si jade lọ kánkan, nwọn si sá kuro ni ibojì; nitoriti nwọn nwarìri, ẹ̀ru si ba wọn gidigidi: bẹ̃ni nwọn ko wi ohunkohun fun ẹnikan; nitoripe ẹ̀ru ba wọn.
entries.en: And they went out quickly, and fled from the sepulchre; for they trembled and were amazed: neither said they any thing to any man; for they were afraid.

entries.yo: Nigbati Jesu jinde li owurọ̀ kutukutu ni ijọ kini ọ̀sẹ, o kọ́ fi ara hàn fun Maria Magdalene, lara ẹniti o ti lé ẹmi èṣu meje jade.
entries.en: Now when Jesus was risen early the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, out of whom he had cast seven devils.

entries.yo: On si lọ sọ fun awọn ti o ti mba a gbé, bi nwọn ti ngbàwẹ, ti nwọn si nsọkun.
entries.en: And she went and told them that had been with him, as they mourned and wept.

entries.yo: Ati awọn, nigbati nwọn si gbọ́ pe o ti di alãye, ati pe, on si ti ri i, nwọn kò gbagbọ.
entries.en: And they, when they had heard that he was alive, and had been seen of her, believed not.

entries.yo: Lẹhin eyini, o si fi ara hàn fun awọn meji ninu wọn li ọna miran, bi nwọn ti nrìn li ọ̀na, ti nwọn si nlọ si igberiko.
entries.en: After that he appeared in another form unto two of them, as they walked, and went into the country.

entries.yo: Nwọn si lọ isọ fun awọn iyokù: nwọn kò si gbà wọn gbọ́ pelu.
entries.en: And they went and told it unto the residue: neither believed they them.

entries.yo: Lẹhinna o si fi ara hàn fun awọn mọkanla bi nwọn ti joko tì onje, o si ba aigbagbọ́ ati lile àiya wọn wi, nitoriti nwọn ko gbà awọn ti o ti ri i gbọ́ lẹhin igbati o jinde.
entries.en: Afterward he appeared unto the eleven as they sat at meat, and upbraided them with their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they believed not them which had seen him after he was risen.

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ lọ si gbogbo aiye, ki ẹ si ma wasu ihinrere fun gbogbo ẹda.
entries.en: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba gbagbọ́, ti a ba si baptisi rẹ̀ yio là; ṣugbọn ẹniti kò ba gbagbọ́ yio jẹbi.
