entries.en: He that believeth and is baptized shall be saved; but he that believeth not shall be damned.

entries.yo: Àmi wọnyi ni yio si ma ba awọn ti o gbagbọ́ lọ; Li orukọ mi ni nwọn o ma lé awọn ẹmi èṣu jade; nwọn o si ma fi ède titun sọ̀rọ;
entries.en: And these signs shall follow them that believe; In my name shall they cast out devils; they shall speak with new tongues;

entries.yo: Nwọn o si ma gbé ejò lọwọ; bi nwọn ba si mu ohunkohun ti o li oró, kì yio pa wọn lara rara: nwọn o gbé ọwọ́ le awọn ọlọkunrun, ara wọn ó da.
entries.en: They shall take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it shall not hurt them; they shall lay hands on the sick, and they shall recover.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni nigbati Oluwa si ti ba wọn sọ̀rọ tan, a si gbà a lọ soke ọrun, o si joko li ọwọ́ ọtún Ọlọrun.
entries.en: So then after the Lord had spoken unto them, he was received up into heaven, and sat on the right hand of God.

entries.yo: Nwọn si jade lọ, nwọn si nwasu nibigbogbo, Oluwa si mba wọn ṣiṣẹ, o si nfi idi ọ̀rọ na kalẹ, nipa àmi ti ntẹ̀le e. Amin.
entries.en: And they went forth, and preached everywhere, the Lord working with them, and confirming the word with signs following. Amen.

entries.yo: NIWỌNBI ọ̀pọ enia ti dawọle e lati tò ìhin wọnni jọ lẹsẹsẹ, eyiti o ti gbilẹ ṣinṣin lãrin wa,
entries.en: Forasmuch as many have taken in hand to set forth in order a declaration of those things which are most surely believed among us,

entries.yo: Ani gẹgẹ bi awọn ti o ṣe oju wọn lati ibẹrẹ, ti nwọn si jasi iranṣẹ ọrọ na, ti fi le wa lọwọ;
entries.en: Even as they delivered them unto us, which from the beginning were eyewitnesses, and ministers of the word;

entries.yo: O si yẹ fun mi pẹlu, lati kọwe si ọ lẹsẹsẹ bi mo ti wadi ohun gbogbo kinikini si lati ipilẹsẹ, Teofilu ọlọla jùlọ,
entries.en: It seemed good to me also, having had perfect understanding of all things from the very first, to write unto thee in order, most excellent Theophilus,

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o le mọ̀ ọtitọ ohun wọnni, ti a ti kọ́ ọ.
entries.en: That thou mightest know the certainty of those things, wherein thou hast been instructed.

entries.yo: Nigba ọjọ Herodu ọba Judea, alufa kan wà, ni ipa ti Abia, orukọ rẹ̀ a ma jẹ Sakariah: aya rẹ̀ si ṣe ọkan ninu awọn ọmọbinrin Aaroni, orukọ rẹ̀ a si ma jẹ Elisabeti.
entries.en: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judaea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the course of Abia: and his wife was of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elisabeth.

entries.yo: Awọn mejeji si ṣe olododo niwaju Ọlọrun, nwọn nrìn ni gbogbo ofin on ìlana Oluwa li ailẹgan.
entries.en: And they were both righteous before God, walking in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord blameless.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nwọn kò li ọmọ, nitoriti Elisabeti yàgan, awọn mejeji si di arugbo.
entries.en: And they had no child, because that Elisabeth was barren, and they both were now well stricken in years.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati o nṣe iṣẹ alufa niwaju Ọlọrun ni ipa iṣẹ́ tirẹ̀,
entries.en: And it came to pass, that while he executed the priest's office before God in the order of his course,

entries.yo: Bi iṣe awọn alufa, ipa tirẹ̀ ni ati ma fi turari jóna, nigbati o ba wọ̀ inu tẹmpili Oluwa lọ.
entries.en: According to the custom of the priest's office, his lot was to burn incense when he went into the temple of the Lord.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ijọ awọn enia si ngbadura lode li akokò sisun turari.
entries.en: And the whole multitude of the people were praying without at the time of incense.

entries.yo: Angẹli Oluwa kan si fi ara hàn a, o duro li apa ọtún pẹpẹ turari.
entries.en: And there appeared unto him an angel of the Lord standing on the right side of the altar of incense.

entries.yo: Nigbati Sakariah si ri i, ori rẹ̀ wúle, ẹ̀ru si ba a.
entries.en: And when Zacharias saw him, he was troubled, and fear fell upon him.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn angẹli na wi fun u pe, Má bẹ̀ru, Sakariah: nitoriti adura rẹ gbà; Elisabeti aya rẹ yio si bí ọmọkunrin kan fun ọ, iwọ o si sọ orukọ rẹ̀ ni Johanu.
entries.en: But the angel said unto him, Fear not, Zacharias: for thy prayer is heard; and thy wife Elisabeth shall bear thee a son, and thou shalt call his name John.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si li ayọ̀ ati inu didùn: enia pipọ yio si yọ̀ si ibí rẹ̀.
entries.en: And thou shalt have joy and gladness; and many shall rejoice at his birth.

entries.yo: Nitori on o pọ̀ niwaju Oluwa, kì yio si mu ọti-waini, bẹ̃ni kì yio si mu ọti-lile; yio si kún fun Ẹmi Mimọ́ ani lati inu iya rẹ̀ wá.
entries.en: For he shall be great in the sight of the Lord, and shall drink neither wine nor strong drink; and he shall be filled with the Holy Ghost, even from his mother's womb.

entries.yo: On o si pa pipọ da ninu awọn ọmọ Israeli si Oluwa Ọlọrun wọn.
entries.en: And many of the children of Israel shall he turn to the Lord their God.

entries.yo: Ẹmí ati agbara Elijah ni on o si fi ṣaju rẹ̀ lọ, lati pa ọkàn awọn baba dà si ti awọn ọmọ, ati ti awọn alaigbọran si ọgbọ́n awọn olõtọ; ki o le pèse enia ti a mura silẹ dè Oluwa.
entries.en: And he shall go before him in the spirit and power of Elias, to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children, and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just; to make ready a people prepared for the Lord.

entries.yo: Sakariah si wi fun angẹli na pe, Àmi wo li emi o fi mọ̀ eyi? Emi sá di àgba, ati Elisabeti aya mi si di arugbo.
entries.en: And Zacharias said unto the angel, Whereby shall I know this? for I am an old man, and my wife well stricken in years.

entries.yo: Angẹli na si dahùn o wi fun u pe, Emi ni Gabrieli, ti ima duro niwaju Ọlọrun; emi li a rán wá lati sọ fun ọ, ati lati mu ìhin ayọ̀ wọnyi fun ọ wá.
entries.en: And the angel answering said unto him, I am Gabriel, that stand in the presence of God; and am sent to speak unto thee, and to shew thee these glad tidings.

entries.yo: Si kiyesi i, iwọ o yadi, iwọ kì yio si le fọhun, titi ọjọ na ti nkan wọnyi yio fi ṣẹ, nitori iwọ ko gbà ọ̀rọ mi gbọ́ ti yio ṣẹ li akokò wọn.
entries.en: And, behold, thou shalt be dumb, and not able to speak, until the day that these things shall be performed, because thou believest not my words, which shall be fulfilled in their season.

entries.yo: Awọn enia si duro dè Sakariah, ẹnu si yà wọn nitoriti o pẹ ninu tẹmpili.
entries.en: And the people waited for Zacharias, and marvelled that he tarried so long in the temple.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si jade, kò le fọhun si wọn: nwọn si woye pe o ri iran ninu tẹmpili: nitoriti o nṣe apẹrẹ si wọn, o si yà odi.
entries.en: And when he came out, he could not speak unto them: and they perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple: for he beckoned unto them, and remained speechless.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati ọjọ iṣẹ isin rẹ̀ pe, o lọ si ile rẹ̀.
entries.en: And it came to pass, that, as soon as the days of his ministration were accomplished, he departed to his own house.

entries.yo: Lẹhin ọjọ wọnyi ni Elisabeti aya rẹ̀ lóyun, o si fi ara rẹ̀ pamọ́ li oṣù marun, o ni,
entries.en: And after those days his wife Elisabeth conceived, and hid herself five months, saying,

entries.yo: Bayi li Oluwa ṣe fun mi li ọjọ ti o ṣijuwò mi, lati mu ẹ̀gan mi kuro lọdọ araiye.
entries.en: Thus hath the Lord dealt with me in the days wherein he looked on me, to take away my reproach among men.

entries.yo: Li oṣù kẹfa a si rán angẹli Gabrieli lati ọdọ Ọlọrun lọ si ilu kan ni Galili, ti a npè ni Nasareti,
entries.en: And in the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent from God unto a city of Galilee, named Nazareth,

entries.yo: Si wundia kan ti a fẹ fun ọkunrin kan, ti a npè ni Josefu, ti idile Dafidi; orukọ wundia na a si ma jẹ Maria.
entries.en: To a virgin espoused to a man whose name was Joseph, of the house of David; and the virgin's name was Mary.

entries.yo: Angẹli na si tọ̀ ọ wá, o ni, Alãfia iwọ ẹniti a kọjusi ṣe li ore, Oluwa pẹlu rẹ: alabukun-fun ni iwọ ninu awọn obinrin.
entries.en: And the angel came in unto her, and said, Hail, thou that art highly favoured, the Lord is with thee: blessed art thou among women.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ọkàn rẹ̀ kò lelẹ nitori ọ̀rọ na, o si rò ninu ara rẹ̀ pe, irú kíki kili eyi.
entries.en: And when she saw him, she was troubled at his saying, and cast in her mind what manner of salutation this should be.

entries.yo: Angẹli na si wi fun u pe, Má bẹ̀ru, Maria: nitori iwọ ti ri ojurere lọdọ Ọlọrun.
entries.en: And the angel said unto her, Fear not, Mary: for thou hast found favour with God.

entries.yo: Sá si kiyesi i, iwọ o lóyun ninu rẹ, iwọ o si bí ọmọkunrin kan, iwọ o si pè orukọ rẹ̀ ni JESU.
entries.en: And, behold, thou shalt conceive in thy womb, and bring forth a son, and shalt call his name JESUS.

entries.yo: On o pọ̀, Ọmọ Ọgá-ogo julọ li a o si ma pè e: Oluwa Ọlọrun yio si fi itẹ́ Dafidi baba rẹ̀ fun u:
entries.en: He shall be great, and shall be called the Son of the Highest: and the Lord God shall give unto him the throne of his father David:

entries.yo: Yio si jọba ni ile Jakọbu titi aiye; ijọba rẹ̀ ki yio si ni ipẹkun.
entries.en: And he shall reign over the house of Jacob for ever; and of his kingdom there shall be no end.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Maria wi fun angẹli na pe, Eyi yio ha ti ṣe ri bẹ̃, nigbati emi kò ti mọ̀ ọkunrin?
entries.en: Then said Mary unto the angel, How shall this be, seeing I know not a man?

entries.yo: Angẹli na si dahùn o si wi fun u pe, Ẹmí Mimọ́ yio tọ̀ ọ wá, ati agbara Ọgá-ogo yio ṣiji bò ọ: nitorina ohun mimọ́ ti a o ti inu rẹ bi, Ọmọ Ọlọrun li a o ma pè e.
entries.en: And the angel answered and said unto her, The Holy Ghost shall come upon thee, and the power of the Highest shall overshadow thee: therefore also that holy thing which shall be born of thee shall be called the Son of God.

entries.yo: Si kiyesi i, Elisabeti ibatan rẹ, on pẹlu si lóyun ọmọkunrin kan li ogbologbo rẹ̀: eyi si li oṣu kẹfa fun ẹniti a npè li agàn.
entries.en: And, behold, thy cousin Elisabeth, she hath also conceived a son in her old age: and this is the sixth month with her, who was called barren.

entries.yo: Nitori kò si ohun ti Ọlọrun ko le ṣe.
entries.en: For with God nothing shall be impossible.

entries.yo: Maria si wipe, Wò ọmọ-ọdọ Oluwa; ki o ri fun mi gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ rẹ. Angẹli na si fi i silẹ lọ.
entries.en: And Mary said, Behold the handmaid of the Lord; be it unto me according to thy word. And the angel departed from her.

entries.yo: Ni ijọ wọnyi ni Maria si dide, o lọ kánkan si ilẹ-òke, si ilu kan ni Juda;
entries.en: And Mary arose in those days, and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Juda;

entries.yo: O si wọ̀ ile Sakariah lọ o si ki Elisabeti.
entries.en: And entered into the house of Zacharias, and saluted Elisabeth.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati Elisabeti gbọ́ kikí Maria, ọlẹ̀ sọ ninu rẹ̀; Elisabeti si kún fun Ẹmí Mimọ́:
entries.en: And it came to pass, that, when Elisabeth heard the salutation of Mary, the babe leaped in her womb; and Elisabeth was filled with the Holy Ghost:

entries.yo: O si ke li ohùn rara, o si wipe, Alabukun-fun ni iwọ ninu awọn obinrin, alabukun-fun si ni fun ọmọ inu rẹ.
entries.en: And she spake out with a loud voice, and said, Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb.

entries.yo: Nibo si li eyi ti wá ba mi, ti iya Oluwa mi iba fi tọ̀ mi wá?
entries.en: And whence is this to me, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?

entries.yo: Sawò o, bi ohùn kikí rẹ ti bọ́ si mi li etí, ọlẹ̀ sọ ninu mi fun ayọ̀.
entries.en: For, lo, as soon as the voice of thy salutation sounded in mine ears, the babe leaped in my womb for joy.

entries.yo: Alabukun-fun si li ẹniti o gbagbọ́: nitori nkan wọnyi ti a ti sọ fun u lati ọdọ Oluwa wá yio ṣẹ.
entries.en: And blessed is she that believed: for there shall be a performance of those things which were told her from the Lord.

entries.yo: Maria si dahùn, o ni, Ọkàn mi yìn Oluwa logo,
entries.en: And Mary said, My soul doth magnify the Lord,

entries.yo: Ẹmí mi si yọ̀ si Ọlọrun Olugbala mi.
entries.en: And my spirit hath rejoiced in God my Saviour.

entries.yo: Nitoriti o ṣijuwò ìwa irẹlẹ ọmọbinrin ọdọ rẹ̀: sá wò o, lati isisiyi lọ gbogbo iran enia ni yio ma pè mi li alabukunfun.
entries.en: For he hath regarded the low estate of his handmaiden: for, behold, from henceforth all generations shall call me blessed.

entries.yo: Nitori ẹniti o li agbara ti ṣe ohun ti o tobi fun mi; mimọ́ si li orukọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: For he that is mighty hath done to me great things; and holy is his name.

entries.yo: Anu rẹ̀ si mbẹ fun awọn ti o bẹ̀ru rẹ̀ lati irandiran.
entries.en: And his mercy is on them that fear him from generation to generation.

entries.yo: O ti fi agbara hàn li apa rẹ̀; o ti tú awọn onirera ká ni ironu ọkàn wọn.
entries.en: He hath shewed strength with his arm; he hath scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.

entries.yo: O ti mu awọn alagbara kuro lori itẹ́ wọn, o si gbé awọn talakà leke.
entries.en: He hath put down the mighty from their seats, and exalted them of low degree.

entries.yo: O ti fi ohun ti o dara kún awọn ti ebi npa; o si rán awọn ọlọrọ̀ pada lọwọ ofo.
entries.en: He hath filled the hungry with good things; and the rich he hath sent empty away.

entries.yo: O ti ràn Israeli ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ̀ lọwọ, ni iranti ãnu rẹ̀;
entries.en: He hath holpen his servant Israel, in remembrance of his mercy;

entries.yo: Bi o ti sọ fun awọn baba wa, fun Abrahamu, ati fun irú-ọmọ rẹ̀ lailai.
entries.en: As he spake to our fathers, to Abraham, and to his seed for ever.

entries.yo: Maria si ba a joko niwọn oṣù mẹta, o si pada lọ si ile rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Mary abode with her about three months, and returned to her own house.

entries.yo: Ọjọ Elisabeti pe wayi ti yio bí; o si bí ọmọkunrin kan.
entries.en: Now Elisabeth's full time came that she should be delivered; and she brought forth a son.

entries.yo: Ati awọn aladugbo, ati awọn ibatan rẹ̀ gbọ́ bi Oluwa ti ṣe ãnu nla fun u; nwọn si ba a yọ̀.
entries.en: And her neighbours and her cousins heard how the Lord had shewed great mercy upon her; and they rejoiced with her.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, ni ijọ kẹjọ nwọn wá lati kọ ọmọ na nila; nwọn si sọ orukọ rẹ̀ ni Sakariah, gẹgẹ bi orukọ baba rẹ̀.
entries.en: And it came to pass, that on the eighth day they came to circumcise the child; and they called him Zacharias, after the name of his father.

entries.yo: Iya rẹ̀ si dahùn, o ni Bẹ̃kọ; bikoṣe Johanu li a o pè e.
entries.en: And his mother answered and said, Not so; but he shall be called John.

entries.yo: Nwọn si wi fun u pe, Kò si ọkan ninu awọn ará rẹ ti a npè li orukọ yi.
entries.en: And they said unto her, There is none of thy kindred that is called by this name.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣe apẹrẹ si baba rẹ̀, bi o ti nfẹ ki a pè e.
entries.en: And they made signs to his father, how he would have him called.

entries.yo: O si bère walã, o kọ, wipe, Johanu li orukọ rẹ̀. Ẹnu si yà gbogbo wọn.
entries.en: And he asked for a writing table, and wrote, saying, His name is John. And they marvelled all.

entries.yo: Ẹnu rẹ̀ si ṣí lọgan, okùn ahọn rẹ̀ si tú, o si sọ̀rọ, o si nyìn Ọlọrun.
entries.en: And his mouth was opened immediately, and his tongue loosed, and he spake, and praised God.

entries.yo: Ẹ̀ru si ba gbogbo awọn ti mbẹ li àgbegbe wọn: a si rohin gbogbo nkan wọnyi ká gbogbo ilẹ òke Judea.
entries.en: And fear came on all that dwelt round about them: and all these sayings were noised abroad throughout all the hill country of Judaea.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn ti o gbọ́ si tò o sinu ọkàn wọn, nwọn nwipe, Irú ọmọ kili eyi yio jẹ! Ọwọ́ Oluwa si wà pẹlu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And all they that heard them laid them up in their hearts, saying, What manner of child shall this be! And the hand of the Lord was with him.

entries.yo: Sakariah baba rẹ̀ si kún fun Ẹmí Mimọ́, o si sọtẹlẹ, o ni,
entries.en: And his father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Ghost, and prophesied, saying,

entries.yo: Olubukun li Oluwa Ọlọrun Israeli; nitoriti o ti bojuwò, ti o si ti dá awọn enia rẹ̀ nide,
entries.en: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel; for he hath visited and redeemed his people,

entries.yo: O si ti gbé iwo igbala soke fun wa ni ile Dafidi ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ̀;
entries.en: And hath raised up an horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David;

entries.yo: Bi o ti wi li ẹnu awọn woli rẹ̀ mimọ́, ti nwọn ti mbẹ nigbati aiye ti ṣẹ̀:
entries.en: As he spake by the mouth of his holy prophets, which have been since the world began:

entries.yo: Pe, a o gbà wa là lọwọ awọn ọtá wa, ati lọwọ gbogbo awọn ti o korira wa;
entries.en: That we should be saved from our enemies, and from the hand of all that hate us;

entries.yo: Lati ṣe ãnu ti o ti leri fun awọn baba wa, ati lati ranti majẹmu rẹ̀ mimọ́,
entries.en: To perform the mercy promised to our fathers, and to remember his holy covenant;

entries.yo: Ara ti o ti bú fun Abrahamu baba wa,
entries.en: The oath which he sware to our father Abraham,

entries.yo: Pe on o fifun wa, lati gbà wa lọwọ awọn ọtá wa, ki awa ki o le ma sìn i laifòya,
entries.en: That he would grant unto us, that we being delivered out of the hand of our enemies might serve him without fear,

entries.yo: Ni mimọ́ ìwa ati li ododo niwaju rẹ̀, li ọjọ aiye wa gbogbo.
entries.en: In holiness and righteousness before him, all the days of our life.

entries.yo: Ati iwọ, ọmọ, woli Ọgá-ogo li a o ma pè ọ: nitori iwọ ni yio ṣaju Oluwa lati tún ọ̀na rẹ̀ ṣe;
entries.en: And thou, child, shalt be called the prophet of the Highest: for thou shalt go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways;

entries.yo: Lati fi ìmọ igbala fun awọn enia rẹ̀ fun imukuro ẹ̀ṣẹ wọn,
entries.en: To give knowledge of salvation unto his people by the remission of their sins,

entries.yo: Nitori iyọ́nu Ọlọrun wa; nipa eyiti ìla-õrùn lati oke wá bojuwò wa,
entries.en: Through the tender mercy of our God; whereby the dayspring from on high hath visited us,

entries.yo: Lati fi imọlẹ fun awọn ti o joko li òkunkun ati li ojiji ikú, ati lati fi ẹsẹ wa le ọ̀na alafia.
entries.en: To give light to them that sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, to guide our feet into the way of peace.

entries.yo: Ọmọ na si dàgba, o si le li ọkàn, o si wà ni ijù titi o fi di ọjọ ifihàn rẹ̀ fun Israeli.
entries.en: And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, and was in the deserts till the day of his shewing unto Israel.

entries.yo: O SI ṣe li ọjọ wọnni, aṣẹ ti ọdọ Kesari Augustu jade wá pe, ki a kọ orukọ gbogbo aiye sinu iwe.
entries.en: And it came to pass in those days, that there went out a decree from Caesar Augustus, that all the world should be taxed.

entries.yo: (Eyi ni ikọsinu-iwe ikini ti a ṣe nigbati Kireniu fi jẹ Bãlẹ Siria.)
entries.en: (And this taxing was first made when Cyrenius was governor of Syria.)

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn enia si lọ lati kọ orukọ rẹ̀ sinu iwe, olukuluku si ilu ara rẹ̀.
entries.en: And all went to be taxed, every one into his own city.

entries.yo: Josefu pẹlu si goke lati Nasareti ilu Galili lọ, si ilu Dafidi ni Judea, ti a npè ni Betlehemu; nitoriti iran ati idile Dafidi ni iṣe,
entries.en: And Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judaea, unto the city of David, which is called Bethlehem; (because he was of the house and lineage of David:)

entries.yo: Lati kọ orukọ rẹ̀, pẹlu Maria aya rẹ̀ afẹsọna, ti o tobi fun oyún.
entries.en: To be taxed with Mary his espoused wife, being great with child.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati nwọn wà nibẹ̀, ọjọ rẹ̀ pé ti on o bí.
entries.en: And so it was, that, while they were there, the days were accomplished that she should be delivered.

entries.yo: O si bí akọbi rẹ̀ ọmọkunrin, o si fi ọja wé e, o si tẹ́ ẹ sinu ibujẹ ẹran; nitoriti àye kò si fun wọn ninu ile èro.
entries.en: And she brought forth her firstborn son, and wrapped him in swaddling clothes, and laid him in a manger; because there was no room for them in the inn.

entries.yo: Awọn oluṣọ-agutan mbẹ ni ilu na, nwọn nṣọ agbo agutan wọn li oru ni pápá ti nwọn ngbé.
entries.en: And there were in the same country shepherds abiding in the field, keeping watch over their flock by night.

entries.yo: Sá si kiyesi i, angẹli Oluwa na yọ si wọn, ogo Oluwa si ràn yi wọn ká: ẹ̀ru si ba wọn gidigidi.
entries.en: And, lo, the angel of the Lord came upon them, and the glory of the Lord shone round about them: and they were sore afraid.

entries.yo: Angẹli na si wi fun wọn pe, Má bẹ̀ru: sawò o, mo mu ihinrere ayọ̀ nla fun nyin wá, ti yio ṣe ti enia gbogbo.
entries.en: And the angel said unto them, Fear not: for, behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy, which shall be to all people.

entries.yo: Nitori a bí Olugbala fun nyin loni ni ilu Dafidi, ti iṣe Kristi Oluwa.
entries.en: For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.

entries.yo: Eyi ni yio si ṣe àmi fun nyin; ẹnyin ó ri ọmọ-ọwọ ti a fi ọja wé, o dubulẹ ni ibujẹ ẹran.
entries.en: And this shall be a sign unto you; Ye shall find the babe wrapped in swaddling clothes, lying in a manger.

entries.yo: Ọpọlọpọ ogun ọrun si yọ si angẹli na li ojijì, nwọn nyìn Ọlọrun, wipe,
entries.en: And suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly host praising God, and saying,

entries.yo: Ogo ni fun Ọlọrun loke ọrun, ati li aiye alafia, ifẹ inu rere si enia.
entries.en: Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati awọn angẹli na pada kuro lọdọ wọn lọ si ọrun, awọn ọkunrin oluṣọ-agutan na ba ara wọn sọ pe, Ẹ jẹ ki a lọ tàra si Betlehemu, ki a le ri ohun ti o ṣẹ, ti Oluwa fihàn fun wa.
entries.en: And it came to pass, as the angels were gone away from them into heaven, the shepherds said one to another, Let us now go even unto Bethlehem, and see this thing which is come to pass, which the Lord hath made known unto us.

entries.yo: Nwọn si wá lọgan, nwọn si ri Maria, ati Josefu, ati ọmọ-ọwọ na, o dubulẹ ninu ibujẹ ẹran.
entries.en: And they came with haste, and found Mary, and Joseph, and the babe lying in a manger.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si ti ri i, nwọn sọ ohun ti a ti wi fun wọn nipa ti ọmọ yi.
entries.en: And when they had seen it, they made known abroad the saying which was told them concerning this child.

entries.yo: Ẹnu si yà gbogbo awọn ti o gbọ́ si nkan wọnyi, ti a ti wi fun wọn lati ọdọ awọn oluṣọ-agutan wá.
entries.en: And all they that heard it wondered at those things which were told them by the shepherds.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Maria pa gbogbo nkan wọnyi mọ́, o nrò wọn ninu ọkàn rẹ̀.
entries.en: But Mary kept all these things, and pondered them in her heart.

entries.yo: Awọn oluṣọ-agutan si pada lọ, nwọn nfi ogo fun Ọlọrun, nwọn si nyìn i, nitori ohun gbogbo ti nwọn ti gbọ́ ati ti nwọn ti ri, bi a ti wi i fun wọn.
entries.en: And the shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, as it was told unto them.

entries.yo: Nigbati ijọ mẹjọ si pé lati kọ ọmọ na nila, nwọn pè orukọ rẹ̀ ni JESU, bi a ti sọ ọ tẹlẹ lati ọdọ angẹli na wá ki a to lóyun rẹ̀ ninu.
entries.en: And when eight days were accomplished for the circumcising of the child, his name was called JESUS, which was so named of the angel before he was conceived in the womb.

entries.yo: Nigbati ọjọ iwẹnu Maria si pé gẹgẹ bi ofin Mose, nwọn gbé Jesu wá si Jerusalemu lati fi i fun Oluwa;
entries.en: And when the days of her purification according to the law of Moses were accomplished, they brought him to Jerusalem, to present him to the Lord;

entries.yo: (Bi a ti kọ ọ sinu ofin Oluwa pe, Gbogbo ọmọ ọkunrin ti o ṣe akọbi, on li a o pè ni mimọ́ fun Oluwa;)
entries.en: (As it is written in the law of the Lord, Every male that openeth the womb shall be called holy to the Lord;)

entries.yo: Ati lati rubọ gẹgẹ bi eyi ti a wi ninu ofin Oluwa, Àdaba meji, tabi ọmọ ẹiyẹle meji.
entries.en: And to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.

entries.yo: Si kiyesi i, ọkunrin kan wà ni Jerusalemu, orukọ rẹ̀ a ma jẹ Simeoni; ọkunrin na si ṣe olõtọ ati olufọkànsin, o nreti itunu Israeli: Ẹmí Mimọ́ si bà le e.
entries.en: And, behold, there was a man in Jerusalem, whose name was Simeon; and the same man was just and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel: and the Holy Ghost was upon him.

entries.yo: A si ti fihàn a lati ọdọ Ẹmí Mimọ́ na wá pe, on kì yio ri ikú, ki o to ri Kristi Oluwa.
entries.en: And it was revealed unto him by the Holy Ghost, that he should not see death, before he had seen the Lord's Christ.

entries.yo: O si ti ipa Ẹmí wá sinu tẹmpili: nigbati awọn obi rẹ̀ si gbé ọmọ na Jesu wá, lati ṣe fun u bi iṣe ofin.
entries.en: And he came by the Spirit into the temple: and when the parents brought in the child Jesus, to do for him after the custom of the law,

entries.yo: Nigbana li o gbé e li apa rẹ̀, o fi ibukun fun Ọlọrun, o ni,
entries.en: Then took he him up in his arms, and blessed God, and said,

entries.yo: Oluwa, nigbayi li o to jọwọ ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ lọwọ lọ li alafia, gẹgẹ bi ọ̀rọ rẹ:
entries.en: Lord, now lettest thou thy servant depart in peace, according to thy word:

entries.yo: Nitoriti oju mi ti ri igbala rẹ na,
entries.en: For mine eyes have seen thy salvation,

entries.yo: Ti iwọ ti pèse silẹ niwaju enia gbogbo;
entries.en: Which thou hast prepared before the face of all people;

entries.yo: Imọlẹ lati mọ́ si awọn Keferi, ati ogo Israeli enia rẹ.
entries.en: A light to lighten the Gentiles, and the glory of thy people Israel.

entries.yo: Ẹnu si yà Josefu ati iya rẹ̀ si nkan ti a nsọ si i wọnyi.
entries.en: And Joseph and his mother marvelled at those things which were spoken of him.

entries.yo: Simeoni si sure fun wọn, o si wi fun Maria iya rẹ̀ pe, Kiyesi i, a gbé ọmọ yi kalẹ fun iṣubu ati idide ọ̀pọ enia ni Israeli; ati fun àmi ti a nsọ̀rọ òdi si;
entries.en: And Simeon blessed them, and said unto Mary his mother, Behold, this child is set for the fall and rising again of many in Israel; and for a sign which shall be spoken against;

entries.yo: (Idà yio si gún iwọ na li ọkàn pẹlu,) ki a le fi ironu ọ̀pọ ọkàn hàn.
entries.en: (Yea, a sword shall pierce through thy own soul also,) that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.

entries.yo: Ẹnikan si mbẹ, Anna woli, ọmọbinrin Fanueli, li ẹ̀ya Aseri: ọjọ ogbó rẹ̀ pọ̀, o ti ba ọkọ gbé li ọdún meje lati igba wundia rẹ̀ wá;
entries.en: And there was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Aser: she was of a great age, and had lived with an husband seven years from her virginity;

entries.yo: O si ṣe opó ìwọn ọdún mẹrinlelọgọrin, ẹniti kò kuro ni tẹmpili, o si nfi àwẹ ati adura sìn Ọlọrun lọsán ati loru.
entries.en: And she was a widow of about fourscore and four years, which departed not from the temple, but served God with fastings and prayers night and day.

entries.yo: O si wọle li akokò na, o si dupẹ fun Oluwa pẹlu, o si sọ̀rọ rẹ̀ fun gbogbo awọn ti o nreti idande Jerusalemu.
entries.en: And she coming in that instant gave thanks likewise unto the Lord, and spake of him to all them that looked for redemption in Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si ti ṣe nkan gbogbo tan gẹgẹ bi ofin Oluwa, nwọn pada lọ si Galili, si Nasareti ilu wọn.
entries.en: And when they had performed all things according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city Nazareth.

entries.yo: Ọmọ na si ndàgba, o si nlagbara, o si kún fun ọgbọn: ore-ọfẹ Ọlọrun si mbẹ lara rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, filled with wisdom: and the grace of God was upon him.

entries.yo: Awọn õbi rẹ̀ a si mã lọ si Jerusalemu li ọdọdún si ajọ irekọja.
entries.en: Now his parents went to Jerusalem every year at the feast of the passover.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si di ọmọ ọdún mejila, nwọn goke lọ si Jerusalemu gẹgẹ bi iṣe ajọ na.
entries.en: And when he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem after the custom of the feast.

entries.yo: Nigbati ọjọ wọn si pé bi nwọn ti npada bọ̀, ọmọ na Jesu duro lẹhin ni Jerusalemu; Josefu ati iya rẹ̀ kò mọ̀.
entries.en: And when they had fulfilled the days, as they returned, the child Jesus tarried behind in Jerusalem; and Joseph and his mother knew not of it.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nwọn ṣebi o wà li ẹgbẹ èro, nwọn rìn ìrin ọjọ kan; nwọn wá a kiri ninu awọn ará ati awọn ojulumọ̀ wọn.
entries.en: But they, supposing him to have been in the company, went a day's journey; and they sought him among their kinsfolk and acquaintance.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn kò si ri i, nwọn pada si Jerusalemu, nwọn nwá a kiri.
entries.en: And when they found him not, they turned back again to Jerusalem, seeking him.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, lẹhin ijọ mẹta nwọn ri i ninu tẹmpili o joko li arin awọn olukọni, o ngbọ́ ti wọn, o si mbi wọn lẽre.
entries.en: And it came to pass, that after three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the doctors, both hearing them, and asking them questions.

entries.yo: Ẹnu si yà gbogbo awọn ti o gbọ́ ọ̀rọ rẹ̀ fun oyé ati idahùn rẹ̀.
entries.en: And all that heard him were astonished at his understanding and answers.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si ri i, hà ṣe wọn: iya rẹ̀ si bi i pe, Ọmọ, ẽṣe ti iwọ fi ṣe wa bẹ̃? sawò o, baba rẹ ati emi ti nfi ibinujẹ wá ọ kiri.
entries.en: And when they saw him, they were amazed: and his mother said unto him, Son, why hast thou thus dealt with us? behold, thy father and I have sought thee sorrowing.

entries.yo: O si dahùn wi fun wọn pe, Ẽṣe ti ẹnyin fi nwá mi kiri? ẹnyin kò mọ pe, emi kò le ṣàima wà nibi iṣẹ Baba mi?
entries.en: And he said unto them, How is it that ye sought me? wist ye not that I must be about my Father's business?

entries.yo: Ọrọ ti o sọ kò si yé wọn.
entries.en: And they understood not the saying which he spake unto them.

entries.yo: O si ba wọn sọkalẹ lọ si Nasareti, o si fi ara balẹ fun wọn: ṣugbọn iya rẹ̀ pa gbogbo nkan wọnyi mọ́ ninu ọkàn rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he went down with them, and came to Nazareth, and was subject unto them: but his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.

entries.yo: Jesu si npọ̀ li ọgbọ́n, o si ndàgba, o si wà li ojurere li ọdọ Ọlọrun ati enia.
entries.en: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favour with God and man.

entries.yo: LI ọdún kẹdogun ijọba Tiberiu Kesari, nigbati Pontiu Pilatu jẹ Bãlẹ, Judea, ti Herodu si jẹ tetrarki Galili, Filippi arakunrin rẹ̀ si jẹ tetrarki Iturea ati ti Trakoniti, Lisania si jẹ tetrarki Abilene,
entries.en: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judaea, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of Ituraea and of the region of Trachonitis, and Lysanias the tetrarch of Abilene,

entries.yo: Ti Anna on Kaiafa nṣe olori awọn alufa, nigbana li ọ̀rọ Ọlọrun tọ̀ Johanu ọmọ Sakariah wá ni ijù.
entries.en: Annas and Caiaphas being the high priests, the word of God came unto John the son of Zacharias in the wilderness.

entries.yo: O si wá si gbogbo ilẹ ìha Jordani, o nwasu baptismu ironupiwada fun imukuro ẹ̀ṣẹ;
entries.en: And he came into all the country about Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins;

entries.yo: Bi a ti kọ ọ ninu iwe ọ̀rọ woli Isaiah pe, Ohùn ẹni ti nkigbe ni ijù, Ẹ tún ọ̀na Oluwa ṣe, ẹ mu ipa-ọna rẹ̀ tọ́.
entries.en: As it is written in the book of the words of Esaias the prophet, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ọgbún li a o kún, gbogbo òke nla ati òke kekere li a o tẹ-bẹrẹ; wíwọ li a o ṣe ni títọ, ati ọ̀na palapala li a o sọ di kikuna;
entries.en: Every valley shall be filled, and every mountain and hill shall be brought low; and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough ways shall be made smooth;

entries.yo: Gbogbo enia ni yio si ri igbala Ọlọrun.
entries.en: And all flesh shall see the salvation of God.

entries.yo: Nigbana li o wi fun ọ̀pọ awọn enia ti o wá lati baptisi lọdọ rẹ̀ pe, Ẹnyin iran paramọlẹ, tali o kìlọ fun nyin lati sá kuro ninu ibinu ti mbọ̀?
entries.en: Then said he to the multitude that came forth to be baptized of him, O generation of vipers, who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come?

entries.yo: Nitorina ki ẹnyin ki o so eso ti o yẹ fun ironupiwada, ki ẹ má si ṣe bẹ̀rẹ si iwi ninu ara nyin pe, awa ni Abrahamu ni baba: ki emi ki o wi fun nyin, Ọlọrun le gbe ọmọ dide fun Abrahamu ninu okuta wọnyi.
entries.en: Bring forth therefore fruits worthy of repentance, and begin not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto you, That God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.

entries.yo: Ati nisisiyi pẹlu, a fi ãke le gbòngbo igi na: gbogbo igi ti kò ba so eso rere, a ke e lulẹ, a si wọ́ ọ jù sinu iná.
entries.en: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees: every tree therefore which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.

entries.yo: Awọn enia si mbi i pe, Kini ki awa ki o ha ṣe?
entries.en: And the people asked him, saying, What shall we do then?

entries.yo: O dahùn o si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹniti o ba li ẹ̀wu meji, ki o fi ọkan fun ẹniti kò ni; ẹniti o ba si li onjẹ, ki o ṣe bẹ̃ pẹlu.
entries.en: He answereth and saith unto them, He that hath two coats, let him impart to him that hath none; and he that hath meat, let him do likewise.

entries.yo: Awọn agbowode si tọ̀ ọ wá lati baptisi lọdọ rẹ̀, nwọn si bi i pe, Olukọni, kili awa o ha ṣe?
entries.en: Then came also publicans to be baptized, and said unto him, Master, what shall we do?

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ máṣe fi agbara gbà jù bi a ti rán nyin lọ mọ́.
entries.en: And he said unto them, Exact no more than that which is appointed you.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ-ogun si bère lọdọ rẹ̀, pe, Ati awa, kili awa o ṣe? O si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ máṣe huwa ipá si ẹnikẹni, ki ẹ má si ṣe rẹ ẹnikẹni jẹ; ki owo onjẹ nyin to nyin.
entries.en: And the soldiers likewise demanded of him, saying, And what shall we do? And he said unto them, Do violence to no man, neither accuse any falsely; and be content with your wages.

entries.yo: Bi awọn enia si ti nreti, ti gbogbo wọn si nrò ninu ara wọn nitori Johanu, bi on ni Kristi bi on kọ́;
entries.en: And as the people were in expectation, and all men mused in their hearts of John, whether he were the Christ, or not;

entries.yo: Johanu dahùn o si wi fun gbogbo wọn pe, Lõtọ li emi nfi omi baptisi nyin; ṣugbọn ẹniti o lagbarà ju mi lọ mbọ̀, okùn bàta ẹsẹ ẹniti emi ko to itú: on ni yio fi Ẹmí Mimọ́ ati iná baptisi nyin:
entries.en: John answered, saying unto them all, I indeed baptize you with water; but one mightier than I cometh, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to unloose: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost and with fire:

entries.yo: Ẹniti atẹ rẹ̀ mbẹ li ọwọ́ rẹ̀, lati gbá ilẹ ipaka rẹ̀ mọ́ toto, ki o si kó alikama rẹ̀ sinu aká; ṣugbọn ìyangbo ni yio fi iná ajõku sun.
entries.en: Whose fan is in his hand, and he will throughly purge his floor, and will gather the wheat into his garner; but the chaff he will burn with fire unquenchable.

entries.yo: Ohun pipọ pẹlu li o si wasu fun awọn enia ni ọrọ iyanju rẹ̀.
entries.en: And many other things in his exhortation preached he unto the people.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Herodu tetrarki, ti o bawi nitori Herodia aya Filippi arakunrin rẹ̀, ati nitori ohun buburu gbogbo ti Herodu ti ṣe,
entries.en: But Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him for Herodias his brother Philip's wife, and for all the evils which Herod had done,

entries.yo: O fi eyi pari gbogbo rẹ̀ niti o fi Johanu sinu tubu.
entries.en: Added yet this above all, that he shut up John in prison.

entries.yo: Nigbati a si baptisi awọn enia gbogbo tan, o si ṣe, a baptisi Jesu pẹlu, bi o ti ngbadura, ọrun ṣí silẹ̀,
entries.en: Now when all the people were baptized, it came to pass, that Jesus also being baptized, and praying, the heaven was opened,

entries.yo: Ẹmí Mimọ́ si sọkalẹ si ori rẹ̀ li àwọ àdaba, ohùn kan si ti ọrun wá, ti o wipe, Iwọ ni ayanfẹ ọmọ mi; ẹniti inu mi dùn si gidigidi.
entries.en: And the Holy Ghost descended in a bodily shape like a dove upon him, and a voice came from heaven, which said, Thou art my beloved Son; in thee I am well pleased.

entries.yo: Jesu tikararẹ̀ nto bi ẹni ìwọn ọgbọ̀n ọdún, o jẹ (bi a ti fi pè) ọmọ Josefu, ti iṣe ọmọ Eli,
entries.en: And Jesus himself began to be about thirty years of age, being (as was supposed) the son of Joseph, which was the son of Heli,

entries.yo: Ti iṣe ọmọ Mattati, ti iṣe ọmọ Lefi, ti iṣe ọmọ Melki, ti iṣe ọmọ Janna, ti iṣe ọmọ Josefu,
entries.en: Which was the son of Matthat, which was the son of Levi, which was the son of Melchi, which was the son of Janna, which was the son of Joseph,

entries.yo: Ti iṣe ọmọ Mattatai, ti iṣe ọmọ Amosi, ti iṣe ọmọ Naumu, ti iṣe ọmọ Esli, ti iṣe ọmọ Naggai,
entries.en: Which was the son of Mattathias, which was the son of Amos, which was the son of Naum, which was the son of Esli, which was the son of Nagge,

entries.yo: Ti iṣe ọmọ Maati, ti iṣe ọmọ Mattatia, ti iṣe ọmọ Simei, ti iṣe ọmọ Josefu, ti iṣe ọmọ Juda,
entries.en: Which was the son of Maath, which was the son of Mattathias, which was the son of Semei, which was the son of Joseph, which was the son of Juda,

entries.yo: Ti iṣe ọmọ Joanna, ti iṣe ọmọ Resa, ti iṣe ọmọ Sorobabeli, ti iṣe ọmọ Salatieli, ti iṣe ọmọ Neri,
entries.en: Which was the son of Joanna, which was the son of Rhesa, which was the son of Zorobabel, which was the son of Salathiel, which was the son of Neri,

entries.yo: Ti iṣe ọmọ Melki, ti iṣe ọmọ Addi, ti iṣe ọmọ Kosamu, ti iṣe ọmọ Elmodamu, ti iṣe ọmọ Eri,
entries.en: Which was the son of Melchi, which was the son of Addi, which was the son of Cosam, which was the son of Elmodam, which was the son of Er,

entries.yo: Ti iṣe ọmọ Jose, ti iṣe ọmọ Elieseri, ti iṣe ọmọ Jorimu, ti iṣe ọmọ Mattati, ti iṣe ọmọ Lefi,
entries.en: Which was the son of Jose, which was the son of Eliezer, which was the son of Jorim, which was the son of Matthat, which was the son of Levi,

entries.yo: Ti iṣe ọmọ Simeoni, ti iṣe ọmọ Juda, ti iṣe ọmọ Josefu, ti iṣe ọmọ Jonani, ti iṣe ọmọ Eliakimu,
entries.en: Which was the son of Simeon, which was the son of Juda, which was the son of Joseph, which was the son of Jonan, which was the son of Eliakim,

entries.yo: Ti iṣe ọmọ Melea, ti iṣe ọmọ Menani, ti iṣe ọmọ Mattata, ti iṣe ọmọ Natani, ti iṣe ọmọ Dafidi,
entries.en: Which was the son of Melea, which was the son of Menan, which was the son of Mattatha, which was the son of Nathan, which was the son of David,

entries.yo: Ti iṣe ọmọ Jesse, ti iṣe ọmọ Obedi, ti iṣe ọmọ Boasi, ti iṣe ọmọ Salmoni, ti iṣe ọmọ Naassoni,
entries.en: Which was the son of Jesse, which was the son of Obed, which was the son of Booz, which was the son of Salmon, which was the son of Naasson,

entries.yo: Ti iṣe ọmọ Aminadabu, ti iṣe ọmọ Aramu, ti iṣe ọmọ Esromu, ti iṣe ọmọ Faresi, ti iṣe ọmọ Juda,
entries.en: Which was the son of Aminadab, which was the son of Aram, which was the son of Esrom, which was the son of Phares, which was the son of Juda,

entries.yo: Ti iṣe ọmọ Jakọbu, ti iṣe ọmọ Isaaki, ti iṣe ọmọ Abrahamu, ti iṣe ọmọ Tera, ti iṣe ọmọ Nakoru,
entries.en: Which was the son of Jacob, which was the son of Isaac, which was the son of Abraham, which was the son of Thara, which was the son of Nachor,

entries.yo: Ti iṣe ọmọ Saruku, ti iṣe ọmọ Ragau, ti iṣe ọmọ Faleki, ti iṣe ọmọ Eberi, ti iṣe ọmọ Sala,
entries.en: Which was the son of Saruch, which was the son of Ragau, which was the son of Phalec, which was the son of Heber, which was the son of Sala,

entries.yo: Ti iṣe ọmọ Kainani, ti iṣe ọmọ Arfaksadi, ti iṣe ọmọ Semu, ti iṣe ọmọ Noa, ti iṣe ọmọ Lameki,
entries.en: Which was the son of Cainan, which was the son of Arphaxad, which was the son of Sem, which was the son of Noe, which was the son of Lamech,

entries.yo: Ti iṣe ọmọ Metusala, ti iṣe ọmọ Enoku, ti iṣe ọmọ Jaredi, ti iṣe ọmọ Maleleeli, ti iṣe ọmọ Kainani,
entries.en: Which was the son of Mathusala, which was the son of Enoch, which was the son of Jared, which was the son of Maleleel, which was the son of Cainan,

entries.yo: Ti iṣe ọmọ Enosi, ti iṣe ọmọ Seti, ti iṣe ọmọ Adamu, ti iṣe ọmọ Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Which was the son of Enos, which was the son of Seth, which was the son of Adam, which was the son of God.

entries.yo: JESU si kún fun Ẹmí Mimọ́, o pada ti Jordani wá, a si ti ọwọ́ Ẹmí dari rẹ̀ si ijù;
entries.en: And Jesus being full of the Holy Ghost returned from Jordan, and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness,

entries.yo: Ogoji ọjọ li a fi dán a wò lọwọ Èṣu. Kò si jẹ ohunkohun li ọjọ wọnni: nigbati nwọn si pari, lẹhinna li ebi wá npa a.
entries.en: Being forty days tempted of the devil. And in those days he did eat nothing: and when they were ended, he afterward hungered.

entries.yo: Eṣu si wi fun u pe, Bi iwọ ba ṣe Ọmọ Ọlọrun, paṣẹ fun okuta yi ki o di akara.
entries.en: And the devil said unto him, If thou be the Son of God, command this stone that it be made bread.

entries.yo: Jesu si dahùn wi fun u pe, A ti kọwe rẹ pe, Enia kì yio wà lãye nipa akara nikan, bikoṣe nipa gbogbo ọ̀rọ Ọlọrun.
entries.en: And Jesus answered him, saying, It is written, That man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of God.

entries.yo: Èṣu si mu u re ori òke giga, o si fi gbogbo ilẹ-ọba aiye hàn a ni iṣẹju kan.
entries.en: And the devil, taking him up into an high mountain, shewed unto him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.

entries.yo: Èṣu si wi fun u pe, Iwọ li emi o fi gbogbo agbara yi ati ogo wọn fun: gbogbo rẹ̀ li a sá ti fifun mi; ẹnikẹni ti o ba si wù mi, emi a fi i fun.
entries.en: And the devil said unto him, All this power will I give thee, and the glory of them: for that is delivered unto me; and to whomsoever I will I give it.

entries.yo: Njẹ bi iwọ ba foribalẹ fun mi, gbogbo rẹ̀ ni yio jẹ tirẹ.
entries.en: If thou therefore wilt worship me, all shall be thine.

entries.yo: Jesu si dahùn o si wi fun u pe, Kuro lẹhin mi, Satani, nitoriti a kọwe rẹ̀ pe, Iwọ foribalẹ fun Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ, on nikanṣoṣo ni ki iwọ ki o si ma sìn.
entries.en: And Jesus answered and said unto him, Get thee behind me, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.

entries.yo: O si mu u lọ si Jerusalemu, o si gbé e le ṣonṣo tẹmpili, o si wi fun u pe, Bi iwọ ba ṣe Ọmọ Ọlọrun, bẹ́ silẹ fun ara rẹ lati ihinyi lọ:
entries.en: And he brought him to Jerusalem, and set him on a pinnacle of the temple, and said unto him, If thou be the Son of God, cast thyself down from hence:

entries.yo: A sá ti kọwe rẹ̀ pe, Yio paṣẹ fun awọn angẹli rẹ̀ nitori rẹ, lati ma ṣe itọju rẹ:
entries.en: For it is written, He shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee:

entries.yo: Ati pe li ọwọ́ wọn ni nwọn o gbé ọ soke, ki iwọ ki o má ba fi ẹsẹ rẹ gbún okuta.
entries.en: And in their hands they shall bear thee up, lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone.

entries.yo: Jesu si dahùn o wi fun u pe, A ti sọ pe, Iwọ kò gbọdọ dán Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ wò.
entries.en: And Jesus answering said unto him, It is said, Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.

entries.yo: Nigbati Èṣu si pari idanwò na gbogbo, o fi i silẹ lọ di sã kan.
entries.en: And when the devil had ended all the temptation, he departed from him for a season.

entries.yo: Jesu si fi agbara Ẹmí pada wá si Galili: okikí rẹ̀ si kàn kalẹ ni gbogbo àgbegbe ti o yiká.
entries.en: And Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee: and there went out a fame of him through all the region round about.

entries.yo: O si nkọni ninu sinagogu wọn; a nyìn i logo lati ọdọ gbogbo awọn enia wá.
entries.en: And he taught in their synagogues, being glorified of all.

entries.yo: O si wá si Nasareti, nibiti a gbé ti tọ́ ọ dàgba: bi iṣe rẹ̀ ti ri, o si wọ̀ inu sinagogu lọ li ọjọ isimi, o si dide lati kàwe.
entries.en: And he came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up: and, as his custom was, he went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and stood up for to read.

entries.yo: A si fi iwe woli Isaiah fun u. Nigbati o si ṣí iwe na, o ri ibiti a gbé kọ ọ pe,
entries.en: And there was delivered unto him the book of the prophet Esaias. And when he had opened the book, he found the place where it was written,

entries.yo: Ẹmi Oluwa mbẹ lara mi, nitoriti o fi àmi oróro yàn mi lati wasu ihinrere fun awọn òtoṣi; o ti rán mi wá lati ṣe iwosan awọn ọkàn onirobinujẹ, lati wasu idasilẹ fun awọn igbekun, itunriran fun awọn afọju, ati lati jọwọ awọn ti a pa lara lọwọ.
entries.en: The Spirit of the Lord is upon me, because he hath anointed me to preach the gospel to the poor; he hath sent me to heal the brokenhearted, to preach deliverance to the captives, and recovering of sight to the blind, to set at liberty them that are bruised,

entries.yo: Lati kede ọdún itẹwọgba Oluwa.
entries.en: To preach the acceptable year of the Lord.

entries.yo: O si pa iwe na de, o tun fi i fun iranṣẹ, o si joko. Gbogbo awọn ti o mbẹ ninu sinagogu si tẹjumọ ọ.
entries.en: And he closed the book, and he gave it again to the minister, and sat down. And the eyes of all them that were in the synagogue were fastened on him.

entries.yo: O si bẹ̀rẹ si iwi fun wọn pe, Loni ni Iwe-mimọ yi ṣẹ li etí nyin.
entries.en: And he began to say unto them, This day is this scripture fulfilled in your ears.

entries.yo: Gbogbo wọn si jẹri rẹ̀, ha si ṣe wọn si ọ̀rọ ore-ọfẹ ti njade li ẹnu rẹ̀. Nwọn si wipe, Ọmọ Josefu kọ́ yi?
entries.en: And all bare him witness, and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth. And they said, Is not this Joseph's son?

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Lõtọ li ẹnyin o pa owe yi si mi pe, Oniṣegun, wò ara rẹ sàn: ohunkohun ti awa gbọ́ pe o ti ọwọ́ rẹ ṣe ni Kapernaumu, ṣe e nihinyi pẹlu ni ilẹ ara rẹ.
entries.en: And he said unto them, Ye will surely say unto me this proverb, Physician, heal thyself: whatsoever we have heard done in Capernaum, do also here in thy country.

entries.yo: O si wipe, Lõtọ ni mo wi fun nyin, Kò si woli ti a tẹwọgbà ni ilẹ baba rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he said, Verily I say unto you, No prophet is accepted in his own country.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn mo wi fun nyin nitõtọ, opó pipọ li o wà ni Israeli nigba ọjọ woli Elijah, nigbati ọrun fi sé li ọdún mẹta on oṣù mẹfa, nigbati ìyan nla fi mu ká ilẹ gbogbo;
entries.en: But I tell you of a truth, many widows were in Israel in the days of Elias, when the heaven was shut up three years and six months, when great famine was throughout all the land;

entries.yo: Kò si si ẹnikan ninu wọn ti a rán Elijah si, bikoṣe si obinrin opó kan ni Sarefati, ilu kan ni Sidoni.
entries.en: But unto none of them was Elias sent, save unto Sarepta, a city of Sidon, unto a woman that was a widow.

entries.yo: Ati adẹtẹ̀ pipọ ni mbẹ ni Israeli nigba woli Eliṣa; kò si si ọkan ninu wọn ti a wẹnumọ́, bikoṣe Naamani ara Siria.
entries.en: And many lepers were in Israel in the time of Eliseus the prophet; and none of them was cleansed, saving Naaman the Syrian.

entries.yo: Nigbati gbogbo awọn ti o wà ninu sinagogu gbọ́ nkan wọnyi, inu ru wọn ṣùṣù,
entries.en: And all they in the synagogue, when they heard these things, were filled with wrath,

entries.yo: Nwọn si dide, nwọn tì i sode si ẹhin ilu, nwọn si fà a lọ si bèbe òke nibiti nwọn gbé tẹ̀ ilu wọn do, ki nwọn ba le tari rẹ̀ li ogedengbe.
entries.en: And rose up, and thrust him out of the city, and led him unto the brow of the hill whereon their city was built, that they might cast him down headlong.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn o kọja larin wọn, o ba tirẹ̀ lọ.
entries.en: But he passing through the midst of them went his way,

entries.yo: O si sọkalẹ wá si Kapernaumu, ilu kan ni Galili, o si nkọ́ wọn li ọjọ isimi.
entries.en: And came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee, and taught them on the sabbath days.

entries.yo: Ẹnu si yà wọn si ẹkọ́ rẹ̀: nitori taṣẹ-taṣẹ li ọ̀rọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And they were astonished at his doctrine: for his word was with power.

entries.yo: Ọkunrin kan si wà ninu sinagogu, ẹniti o li ẹmi aimọ́, o kigbe li ohùn rara,
entries.en: And in the synagogue there was a man, which had a spirit of an unclean devil, and cried out with a loud voice,

entries.yo: O ni, Jọwọ wa jẹ; kini ṣe tawa tirẹ, Jesu ara Nasareti? iwọ wá lati pa wa run? emi mọ̀ ẹniti iwọ iṣe; Ẹni Mimọ́ Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Saying, Let us alone; what have we to do with thee, thou Jesus of Nazareth? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art; the Holy One of God.

entries.yo: Jesu si ba a wi, o ni, Pa ẹnu rẹ mọ́, ki o si jade lara rẹ̀. Nigbati ẹmí eṣu na si gbé e ṣanlẹ li awujọ, o jade kuro lara rẹ̀, kò si pa a lara.
entries.en: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Hold thy peace, and come out of him. And when the devil had thrown him in the midst, he came out of him, and hurt him not.

entries.yo: Hà si ṣe gbogbo wọn nwọn si mba ara wọn sọ, wipe, Ọ̀rọ kili eyi! nitori pẹlu aṣẹ ati agbara li o fi ba awọn ẹmi aimọ́ wi, nwọn si jade kuro.
entries.en: And they were all amazed, and spake among themselves, saying, What a word is this! for with authority and power he commandeth the unclean spirits, and they come out.

entries.yo: Okikí rẹ̀ si kàn nibi gbogbo li àgbegbe ilẹ na yiká.
entries.en: And the fame of him went out into every place of the country round about.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si dide kuro ninu sinagogu, o si wọ̀ ile Simoni lọ; ibà si ti dá iya aya Simoni bulẹ; nwọn si bẹ̀ ẹ nitori rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he arose out of the synagogue, and entered into Simon's house. And Simon's wife's mother was taken with a great fever; and they besought him for her.

entries.yo: O si duro tirisi i, o ba ibà na wi; ibà si jọwọ rẹ̀ lọwọ: o si dide lọgan, o nṣe iranṣẹ fun wọn.
entries.en: And he stood over her, and rebuked the fever; and it left her: and immediately she arose and ministered unto them.

entries.yo: Nigbati õrùn si nwọ̀, gbogbo awọn ẹniti o ni olokunrun ti o li arunkarun, nwọn mu wọn tọ̀ ọ wá; o si fi ọwọ́ le olukuluku wọn, o si mu wọn larada.
entries.en: Now when the sun was setting, all they that had any sick with divers diseases brought them unto him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.

entries.yo: Awọn ẹmi eṣu si jade lara ẹni pipọ pẹlu, nwọn nkigbe, nwọn si nwipe, Iwọ ni Kristi Ọmọ Ọlọrun. O si mba wọn wi, kò si jẹ ki nwọn ki o fọhun: nitoriti nwọn mọ̀ pe Kristi ni iṣe.
entries.en: And devils also came out of many, crying out, and saying, Thou art Christ the Son of God. And he rebuking them suffered them not to speak: for they knew that he was Christ.

entries.yo: Nigbati ilẹ si mọ́, o dide lọ si ibi ijù: ijọ enia si nwá a kiri, nwọn si tọ̀ ọ wá, nwọn si da a duro, nitori ki o má ba lọ kuro lọdọ wọn.
entries.en: And when it was day, he departed and went into a desert place: and the people sought him, and came unto him, and stayed him, that he should not depart from them.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn o si wi fun wọn pe, Emi kò le ṣaima wasu ijọba Ọlọrun fun ilu miran pẹlu: nitorina li a sá ṣe rán mi.
entries.en: And he said unto them, I must preach the kingdom of God to other cities also: for therefore am I sent.

entries.yo: O si nwasu ninu sinagogu ti Galili.
entries.en: And he preached in the synagogues of Galilee.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati ijọ enia ṣù mọ́ ọ lati gbọ́ ọ̀rọ Ọlọrun, ti o si duro leti adagun Genesareti,
entries.en: And it came to pass, that, as the people pressed upon him to hear the word of God, he stood by the lake of Gennesaret,

entries.yo: O ri ọkọ̀ meji ti nwọn gún leti adagun: ṣugbọn awọn apẹja sọkalẹ kuro ninu wọn, nwọn nfọ̀ àwọn wọn.
entries.en: And saw two ships standing by the lake: but the fishermen were gone out of them, and were washing their nets.

entries.yo: O si wọ̀ ọkan ninu awọn ọkọ̀ na, ti iṣe ti Simoni, o si bẹ̀ ẹ ki o tẹ̀ si ẹhin diẹ kuro ni ilẹ. O si joko, o si nkọ́ ijọ enia lati inu ọkọ̀ na.
entries.en: And he entered into one of the ships, which was Simon's, and prayed him that he would thrust out a little from the land. And he sat down, and taught the people out of the ship.

entries.yo: Bi o si ti dakẹ ọ̀rọ isọ, o wi fun Simoni pe, Tì si ibu, ki o si jù àwọn nyin si isalẹ fun akopọ̀.
entries.en: Now when he had left speaking, he said unto Simon, Launch out into the deep, and let down your nets for a draught.

entries.yo: Simoni si dahùn o si wi fun u pe, Olukọni, gbogbo oru aná li awa fi ṣìṣẹ, awa kò si mú nkan: ṣugbọn nitori ọrọ rẹ emi ó jù àwọn na si isalẹ.
entries.en: And Simon answering said unto him, Master, we have toiled all the night, and have taken nothing: nevertheless at thy word I will let down the net.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si ti ṣe eyi, nwọn kó ọpọlọpọ ẹja: àwọn wọn si ya.
entries.en: And when they had this done, they inclosed a great multitude of fishes: and their net brake.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣapẹrẹ si ẹgbẹ wọn, ti o wà li ọkọ̀ keji, ki nwọn ki o wá ràn wọn lọwọ. Nwọn si wá, nwọn si kún ọkọ̀ mejeji, bẹ̃ni nwọn bẹ̀rẹ si irì.
entries.en: And they beckoned unto their partners, which were in the other ship, that they should come and help them. And they came, and filled both the ships, so that they began to sink.

entries.yo: Nigbati Simoni Peteru si ri i, o wolẹ lẹba ẽkun Jesu, o wipe, Lọ kuro lọdọ mi; nitori ẹlẹṣẹ ni mi, Oluwa.
entries.en: When Simon Peter saw it, he fell down at Jesus' knees, saying, Depart from me; for I am a sinful man, O Lord.

entries.yo: Hà si ṣe e, ati gbogbo awọn ti mbẹ pẹlu rẹ̀, fun akopọ̀ ẹja ti nwọn kó:
entries.en: For he was astonished, and all that were with him, at the draught of the fishes which they had taken:

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ ni Jakọbu ati Johanu awọn ọmọ Sebede, ti nṣe olupẹja pọ pẹlu Simoni. Jesu si wi fun Simoni pe, Má bẹ̀ru; lati isisiyi lọ iwọ o ma mú enia.
entries.en: And so was also James, and John, the sons of Zebedee, which were partners with Simon. And Jesus said unto Simon, Fear not; from henceforth thou shalt catch men.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si ti mu ọkọ̀ wọn de ilẹ, nwọn fi gbogbo rẹ̀ silẹ, nwọn si tọ̀ ọ lẹhin lọ.
entries.en: And when they had brought their ships to land, they forsook all, and followed him.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati o wọ̀ ilu kan, kiyesi i, ọkunrin kan ti ẹ̀tẹ bò: nigbati o ri Jesu, o wolẹ, o si mbẹ̀ ẹ, wipe, Oluwa, bi iwọ ba fẹ, iwọ le sọ mi di mimọ́.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when he was in a certain city, behold a man full of leprosy: who seeing Jesus fell on his face, and besought him, saying, Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.

entries.yo: O si nà ọwọ́ rẹ̀, o fi kàn a, o ni, Mo fẹ: iwọ di mimọ́. Lọgan ẹ̀tẹ si fi i silẹ lọ.
entries.en: And he put forth his hand, and touched him, saying, I will: be thou clean. And immediately the leprosy departed from him.

entries.yo: O si kílọ fun u pe, ki o máṣe sọ fun ẹnikan: ṣugbọn ki o lọ, ki o si fi ara rẹ hàn fun alufa, ki o si ta ọrẹ fun iwẹnumọ́ rẹ, gẹgẹ bi Mose ti paṣẹ fun ẹrí si wọn.
entries.en: And he charged him to tell no man: but go, and shew thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing, according as Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn si iwaju li okikí rẹ̀ nkàn kalẹ: ọ̀pọ ijọ enia si jumọ pade lati gbọ́ ọ̀rọ rẹ̀, ati lati gbà dida ara lọdọ rẹ̀ kuro lọwọ ailera wọn.
entries.en: But so much the more went there a fame abroad of him: and great multitudes came together to hear, and to be healed by him of their infirmities.

entries.yo: O si yẹra si ijù, o si gbadura.
entries.en: And he withdrew himself into the wilderness, and prayed.

entries.yo: O si ṣe ni ijọ kan, bi o si ti nkọ́ni, awọn Farisi ati awọn amofin joko ni ìha ibẹ̀, awọn ti o ti ilu Galili gbogbo, ati Judea, ati Jerusalemu wá: agbara Oluwa si mbẹ lati mu wọn larada.
entries.en: And it came to pass on a certain day, as he was teaching, that there were Pharisees and doctors of the law sitting by, which were come out of every town of Galilee, and Judaea, and Jerusalem: and the power of the Lord was present to heal them.

entries.yo: Sá si kiyesi i, awọn ọkunrin gbé ọkunrin kan ti o lẹ̀gba wá lori akete: nwọn nwá ọ̀na ati gbé e wọle, ati lati tẹ́ ẹ siwaju rẹ̀.
entries.en: And, behold, men brought in a bed a man which was taken with a palsy: and they sought means to bring him in, and to lay him before him.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn kò si ri ọ̀na ti nwọn iba fi gbé e wọle nitori ijọ enia, nwọn gùn oke àja ile lọ, nwọn sọ̀ ọ kalẹ li alafo àja ti on ti akete rẹ̀ larin niwaju Jesu.
entries.en: And when they could not find by what way they might bring him in because of the multitude, they went upon the housetop, and let him down through the tiling with his couch into the midst before Jesus.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si ri igbagbọ́ wọn, o wi fun u pe, Ọkunrin yi, a dari ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ jì ọ.
entries.en: And when he saw their faith, he said unto him, Man, thy sins are forgiven thee.

entries.yo: Awọn akọwe ati awọn Farisi bẹ̀rẹ si igberò, wipe, Tali eleyi ti nsọ ọrọ-odi? Tali o le dari ẹ̀ṣẹ jìni bikoṣe Ọlọrun nikanṣoṣo?
entries.en: And the scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, Who is this which speaketh blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, but God alone?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati Jesu mọ̀ ìro inu wọn, o dahùn o si wi fun wọn pe, Kili ẹnyin nrò ninu ọkàn nyin?
entries.en: But when Jesus perceived their thoughts, he answering said unto them, What reason ye in your hearts?

entries.yo: Ewo li o ya jù, lati wipe, A dari ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ jì ọ; tabi lati wipe, Dide ki iwọ ki o si mã rìn?
entries.en: Whether is easier, to say, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Rise up and walk?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ki ẹnyin ki o le mọ̀ pe, Ọmọ-enia li agbara li aiye lati dari ẹ̀ṣẹ jìni, (o wi fun ẹlẹgba na pe,) Mo wi fun ọ, Dide, si gbé akete rẹ, ki o si lọ si ile rẹ.
entries.en: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power upon earth to forgive sins, (he said unto the sick of the palsy,) I say unto thee, Arise, and take up thy couch, and go into thine house.

entries.yo: O si dide lọgan niwaju wọn, o gbé ohun ti o dubulẹ le, o si lọ si ile rẹ̀, o nyìn Ọlọrun logo.
entries.en: And immediately he rose up before them, and took up that whereon he lay, and departed to his own house, glorifying God.

entries.yo: Ẹnu si yà gbogbo wọn, nwọn si nyìn Ọlọrun logo, ẹ̀ru si bà wọn, nwọn nwipe, Awa ri ohun abàmi loni.
entries.en: And they were all amazed, and they glorified God, and were filled with fear, saying, We have seen strange things to day.

entries.yo: Lẹhin nkan wọnyi o jade lọ, o si ri agbowode kan ti a npè ni Lefi, o joko ni bode: o si wi fun u pe, Mã tọ̀ mi lẹhin.
entries.en: And after these things he went forth, and saw a publican, named Levi, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he said unto him, Follow me.

entries.yo: O si fi gbogbo nkan silẹ, o dide, o si ntọ̀ ọ lẹhin.
entries.en: And he left all, rose up, and followed him.

entries.yo: Lefi si se àse nla fun u ni ile rẹ̀: ọ̀pọ ijọ awọn agbowode, ati awọn ẹlomiran mbẹ nibẹ̀ ti nwọn ba wọn joko.
entries.en: And Levi made him a great feast in his own house: and there was a great company of publicans and of others that sat down with them.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn akọwe, ati awọn Farisi nkùn si awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀, wipe, Ẽṣe ti ẹnyin fi mbá awọn agbowode ati awọn ẹlẹṣẹ jẹ, ti ẹ mba wọn mu.
entries.en: But their scribes and Pharisees murmured against his disciples, saying, Why do ye eat and drink with publicans and sinners?

entries.yo: Jesu dahùn o si wi fun wọn pe, Awọn ti ara wọn dá kò wá oniṣegun, bikoṣe awọn ti ara wọn kò da.
entries.en: And Jesus answering said unto them, They that are whole need not a physician; but they that are sick.

entries.yo: Emi kò wá ipè awọn olododo, bikoṣe awọn ẹlẹṣẹ si ironupiwada.
entries.en: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.

entries.yo: Nwọn si bi i pe, Ẽṣe ti awọn ọmọ-ẹhin Johanu fi ngbàwẹ nigbakugba, ti nwọn a si ma gbadura, gẹgẹ bẹ̃ si ni awọn ọmọ-ẹhin awọn Farisi; ṣugbọn awọn tirẹ njẹ, nwọn nmu?
entries.en: And they said unto him, Why do the disciples of John fast often, and make prayers, and likewise the disciples of the Pharisees; but thine eat and drink?

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹnyin le mu ki awọn ọmọ ile iyawo gbàwẹ, nigbati ọkọ iyawo mbẹ lọdọ wọn?
entries.en: And he said unto them, Can ye make the children of the bridechamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ọjọ mbọ̀ nigbati a o gbà ọkọ iyawo lọwọ wọn, nigbana ni nwọn o si gbàwẹ ni ijọ wọnni.
entries.en: But the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then shall they fast in those days.

entries.yo: O si pa owe kan fun wọn pẹlu pe, Kò si ẹniti ifi idãsa aṣọ titun lẹ ogbologbo ẹ̀wu; bikoṣepe titun fà a ya, ati pẹlu idãsà titun kò si ba ogbologbo aṣọ rẹ.
entries.en: And he spake also a parable unto them; No man putteth a piece of a new garment upon an old; if otherwise, then both the new maketh a rent, and the piece that was taken out of the new agreeth not with the old.

entries.yo: Kò si si ẹniti ifi ọti-waini titun sinu ogbologbo ìgo; bikoṣepe ọti-waini titun bẹ́ ìgo na, a si danù, ìgo a si bajẹ.
entries.en: And no man putteth new wine into old bottles; else the new wine will burst the bottles, and be spilled, and the bottles shall perish.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ọti-waini titun li a ifi sinu igo titun; awọn mejeji a si ṣe dede.
entries.en: But new wine must be put into new bottles; and both are preserved.

entries.yo: Kò si si ẹniti imu ìsà ọti-waini tan, ti o si fẹ titun lojukanna: nitoriti o ni, ìsà san jù.
entries.en: No man also having drunk old wine straightway desireth new: for he saith, The old is better.

entries.yo: O si ṣe li ọjọ isimi keji lẹhin ekini, Jesu kọja larin oko ọkà; awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ si nya ipẹ́ ọkà, nwọn nfi ọwọ́ ra a jẹ.
entries.en: And it came to pass on the second sabbath after the first, that he went through the corn fields; and his disciples plucked the ears of corn, and did eat, rubbing them in their hands.

entries.yo: Awọn kan ninu awọn Farisi si wi fun wọn pe, Ẽṣe ti ẹnyin fi nṣe eyi ti kò yẹ lati ṣe li ọjọ isimi?
entries.en: And certain of the Pharisees said unto them, Why do ye that which is not lawful to do on the sabbath days?

entries.yo: Jesu si da wọn li ohùn, wipe, Ẹnyin kò kawe to bi eyi, bi Dafidi ti ṣe, nigbati ebi npa on tikararẹ̀ ati awọn ti o wà lọdọ rẹ̀;
entries.en: And Jesus answering them said, Have ye not read so much as this, what David did, when himself was an hungred, and they which were with him;

entries.yo: Bi o ti wọ̀ ile Ọlọrun lọ, ti o si mu akara ifihàn ti o jẹ, ti o si fifun awọn ti mbẹ lọdọ rẹ̀ pẹlu; ti kò yẹ fun u lati jẹ, bikoṣe fun awọn alufa nikanṣoṣo?
entries.en: How he went into the house of God, and did take and eat the shewbread, and gave also to them that were with him; which it is not lawful to eat but for the priests alone?

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Ọmọ-enia li oluwa ọjọ isimi.
entries.en: And he said unto them, That the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath.

entries.yo: O si ṣe li ọjọ isimi miran, ti o wọ̀ inu sinagogu lọ, o si nkọ́ni: ọkunrin kan si mbẹ nibẹ̀ ti ọwọ́ rẹ̀ ọtún rọ.
entries.en: And it came to pass also on another sabbath, that he entered into the synagogue and taught: and there was a man whose right hand was withered.

entries.yo: Ati awọn akọwe ati awọn Farisi nṣọ ọ, bi yio mu u larada li ọjọ isimi; ki nwọn ki o le ri ọna ati fi i sùn.
entries.en: And the scribes and Pharisees watched him, whether he would heal on the sabbath day; that they might find an accusation against him.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn o mọ̀ ìro inu wọn, o si wi fun ọkunrin na ti ọwọ́ rẹ̀ rọ pe, Dide, ki o si duro lãrin. O si dide duro.
entries.en: But he knew their thoughts, and said to the man which had the withered hand, Rise up, and stand forth in the midst. And he arose and stood forth.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Jesu wi fun wọn pe, Emi o bi nyin lẽre ohunkan; O tọ́ lati mã ṣe ore li ọjọ isimi, tabi lati mã ṣe buburu? lati gbà ẹmí là, tabi lati pa a run?
entries.en: Then said Jesus unto them, I will ask you one thing; Is it lawful on the sabbath days to do good, or to do evil? to save life, or to destroy it?

entries.yo: Nigbati o si wò gbogbo wọn yiká, o wi fun ọkunrin na pe, Nà ọwọ́ rẹ. O si ṣe bẹ̃: ọwọ́ rẹ̀ si pada bọ̀ sipò gẹgẹ bi ekeji.
entries.en: And looking round about upon them all, he said unto the man, Stretch forth thy hand. And he did so: and his hand was restored whole as the other.

entries.yo: Nwọn si kún fun ibinu gbigbona; nwọn si ba ara wọn rò ohun ti awọn iba ṣe si Jesu.
entries.en: And they were filled with madness; and communed one with another what they might do to Jesus.

entries.yo: O si ṣe ni ijọ wọnni, o lọ si ori òke lọ igbadura, o si fi gbogbo oru na gbadura si Ọlọrun.
entries.en: And it came to pass in those days, that he went out into a mountain to pray, and continued all night in prayer to God.

entries.yo: Nigbati ilẹ si mọ́, o pè awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀: ninu wọn li o si yàn mejila, ti o si sọ ni Aposteli;
entries.en: And when it was day, he called unto him his disciples: and of them he chose twelve, whom also he named apostles;

entries.yo: Simoni, (ẹniti o si sọ ni Peteru,) ati Anderu arakunrin rẹ̀, Jakọbu ati Johanu, Filippi ati Bartolomeu,
entries.en: Simon, (whom he also named Peter,) and Andrew his brother, James and John, Philip and Bartholomew,

entries.yo: Matiu ati Tomasi, Jakọbu ọmọ Alfeu, ati Simoni ti a npè ni Selote,
entries.en: Matthew and Thomas, James the son of Alphaeus, and Simon called Zelotes,

entries.yo: Ati Juda arakunrin Jakọbu, ati Judasi Iskariotu ti iṣe onikupani.
entries.en: And Judas the brother of James, and Judas Iscariot, which also was the traitor.

entries.yo: O si ba wọn sọkalẹ, o si duro ni pẹ̀tẹlẹ, pẹlu ọ̀pọ awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀, ati ọ̀pọ ijọ enia, lati gbogbo Judea, ati Jerusalemu, ati àgbegbe Tire on Sidoni, ti nwọn wá lati gbọ́ ọ̀rọ rẹ̀, ati lati gbà dida ara kuro ninu arùn wọn;
entries.en: And he came down with them, and stood in the plain, and the company of his disciples, and a great multitude of people out of all Judaea and Jerusalem, and from the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, which came to hear him, and to be healed of their diseases;

entries.yo: Ati awọn ti ara kan fun ẹmi aimọ́: a si mu wọn larada.
entries.en: And they that were vexed with unclean spirits: and they were healed.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ijọ enia si nfẹ fi ọwọ́ kàn a; nitoriti aṣẹ njade lara rẹ̀, o si mu gbogbo wọn larada.
entries.en: And the whole multitude sought to touch him: for there went virtue out of him, and healed them all.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si gbé oju rẹ̀ soke si awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀, o ni, Alabukun-fun li ẹnyin òtoṣi: nitori ti nyin ni ijọba Ọlọrun.
entries.en: And he lifted up his eyes on his disciples, and said, Blessed be ye poor: for yours is the kingdom of God.

entries.yo: Alabukun-fun li ẹnyin ti ebi npa nisisiyi: nitoriti ẹ ó yo. Alabukun-fun li ẹnyin ti nsọkun nisisiyi: nitoriti ẹnyin ó rẹrin.
entries.en: Blessed are ye that hunger now: for ye shall be filled. Blessed are ye that weep now: for ye shall laugh.

entries.yo: Alabukun-fun li ẹnyin, nigbati awọn enia ba korira nyin, ti nwọn ba yà nyin kuro ninu ẹgbẹ wọn, ti nwọn ba gàn nyin, ti nwọn ba ta orukọ nyin nù bi ohun buburu, nitori Ọmọ-enia.
entries.en: Blessed are ye, when men shall hate you, and when they shall separate you from their company, and shall reproach you, and cast out your name as evil, for the Son of man's sake.

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o yọ̀ ni ijọ na, ki ẹnyin ki o si fò soke fun ayọ̀: sá wò o, ère nyin pọ̀ li ọrun: nitori bẹ̃ gẹgẹ li awọn baba wọn ṣe si awọn woli.
entries.en: Rejoice ye in that day, and leap for joy: for, behold, your reward is great in heaven: for in the like manner did their fathers unto the prophets.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn egbé ni fun ẹnyin ọlọrọ̀! nitoriti ẹnyin ti ri irọra nyin na.
entries.en: But woe unto you that are rich! for ye have received your consolation.

entries.yo: Egbé ni fun ẹnyin ti o yó! nitoriti ebi yio pa nyin. Egbé ni fun ẹnyin ti nrẹrin nisisiyi! nitoriti ẹnyin o gbàwẹ, ẹnyin o si sọkun.
entries.en: Woe unto you that are full! for ye shall hunger. Woe unto you that laugh now! for ye shall mourn and weep.

entries.yo: Egbé ni fun nyin, nigbati gbogbo enia ba nsọrọ nyin ni rere! nitori bẹ̃ gẹgẹ li awọn baba wọn ṣe si awọn eke woli.
entries.en: Woe unto you, when all men shall speak well of you! for so did their fathers to the false prophets.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn mo wi fun ẹnyin ti ngbọ́, Ẹ fẹ awọn ọtá nyin, ṣore fun awọn ti o korira nyin.
entries.en: But I say unto you which hear, Love your enemies, do good to them which hate you,

entries.yo: Sure fun awọn ti nfi nyin ré, si gbadura fun awọn ti nkẹgan nyin.
entries.en: Bless them that curse you, and pray for them which despitefully use you.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba si lù ọ ni ẹrẹkẹ kan, pa ekeji dà si i pẹlu; ati ẹniti o gbà agbada rẹ, máṣe da a duro lati gbà àwọtẹlẹ rẹ pẹlu.
entries.en: And unto him that smiteth thee on the one cheek offer also the other; and him that taketh away thy cloke forbid not to take thy coat also.

entries.yo: Si fifun gbogbo ẹniti o tọrọ lọdọ rẹ; lọdọ ẹniti o si kó ọ li ẹrù, má si ṣe pada bère.
entries.en: Give to every man that asketh of thee; and of him that taketh away thy goods ask them not again.

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi ẹnyin si ti fẹ ki enia ki o ṣe si nyin, ki ẹnyin ki o si ṣe bẹ̃ si wọn pẹlu.
entries.en: And as ye would that men should do to you, do ye also to them likewise.

entries.yo: Njẹ bi ẹnyin ba fẹ awọn ti o fẹ nyin, ọpẹ́ kili ẹnyin ni? awọn ẹlẹṣẹ pẹlu nfẹ́ awọn ti o fẹ wọn.
entries.en: For if ye love them which love you, what thank have ye? for sinners also love those that love them.

entries.yo: Bi ẹnyin si ṣore fun awọn ti o ṣore fun nyin, ọpẹ́ kili ẹnyin ni? awọn ẹlẹṣẹ pẹlu nṣe bẹ̃ gẹgẹ.
entries.en: And if ye do good to them which do good to you, what thank have ye? for sinners also do even the same.

entries.yo: Bi ẹnyin si win wọn ni nkan lọwọ ẹniti ẹnyin ó reti ati ri gbà pada, ọpẹ́ kili ẹnyin ni? awọn ẹlẹṣẹ pẹlu nwin ẹlẹṣẹ, ki nwọn ki o le gbà iwọn bẹ̃ pada.
entries.en: And if ye lend to them of whom ye hope to receive, what thank have ye? for sinners also lend to sinners, to receive as much again.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ki ẹnyin ki o fẹ awọn ọtá nyin, ki ẹnyin ki o si ṣore, ki ẹnyin ki o si winni, ki ẹnyin ki o máṣe reti ati ri nkan gbà pada; ère nyin yio si pọ̀, awọn ọmọ Ọgá-ogo li a o si ma pè nyin: nitoriti o ṣeun fun alaimore ati fun ẹni-buburu.
entries.en: But love ye your enemies, and do good, and lend, hoping for nothing again; and your reward shall be great, and ye shall be the children of the Highest: for he is kind unto the unthankful and to the evil.

entries.yo: Njẹ ki ẹnyin ki o li ãnu, gẹgẹ bi Baba nyin si ti li ãnu.
entries.en: Be ye therefore merciful, as your Father also is merciful.

entries.yo: Ẹ máṣe dani li ẹjọ, a kì yio si da nyin li ẹjọ: ẹ máṣe dani li ẹbi, a kì yio si da nyin li ẹbi: ẹ darijì, a o si darijì nyin:
entries.en: Judge not, and ye shall not be judged: condemn not, and ye shall not be condemned: forgive, and ye shall be forgiven:

entries.yo: Ẹ fifun ni, a o si fifun nyin; oṣuwọn daradara, akìmọlẹ, ati amipọ, akún-wọsilẹ, li a o wọ̀n si àiya nyin; nitori oṣuwọn na ti ẹnyin fi wọ̀n, on li a o pada fi wọ̀n fun nyin.
entries.en: Give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over, shall men give into your bosom. For with the same measure that ye mete withal it shall be measured to you again.

entries.yo: O si pa owe kan fun wọn, Afọju le ṣe amọ̀na afọju? awọn mejeji kì yio ṣubu sinu ihò?
entries.en: And he spake a parable unto them, Can the blind lead the blind? shall they not both fall into the ditch?

entries.yo: Ẹniti a nkọ́ ki ijù olukọ́ rẹ̀ lọ: ṣugbọn olukuluku ẹniti o ba pé, yio dabi olukọ́ rẹ̀.
entries.en: The disciple is not above his master: but every one that is perfect shall be as his master.

entries.yo: Ẽṣe ti iwọ si nwò ẹrún igi ti mbẹ li oju arakunrin rẹ, ṣugbọn iwọ kò kiyesi ìti igi ti mbẹ li oju ara rẹ?
entries.en: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother's eye, but perceivest not the beam that is in thine own eye?

entries.yo: Tabi iwọ o ti ṣe le wi fun arakunrin rẹ pe, Arakunrin, jẹ ki emi ki o yọ ẹrún igi ti mbẹ li oju rẹ, nigbati iwọ tikararẹ kò kiyesi ìti igi ti mbẹ li oju ara rẹ? iwọ agabagebe, tètekọ yọ ìti igi jade kuro li oju ara rẹ na, nigbana ni iwọ o si to riran gbangba lati yọ ẹrún igi kuro ti mbẹ li oju arakunrin rẹ.
entries.en: Either how canst thou say to thy brother, Brother, let me pull out the mote that is in thine eye, when thou thyself beholdest not the beam that is in thine own eye? Thou hypocrite, cast out first the beam out of thine own eye, and then shalt thou see clearly to pull out the mote that is in thy brother's eye.

entries.yo: Nitori igi rere kì iso eso buburu; bẹ̃ni igi buburu kì iso eso rere.
entries.en: For a good tree bringeth not forth corrupt fruit; neither doth a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.

entries.yo: Olukuluku igi li a ifi eso rẹ̀ mọ̀; nitori lori ẹgún oṣuṣu, enia kì iká eso ọpọtọ bẹ̃ni lori ẹgún ọgàn a kì iká eso ajara.
entries.en: For every tree is known by his own fruit. For of thorns men do not gather figs, nor of a bramble bush gather they grapes.

entries.yo: Enia rere lati inu iṣura rere ọkàn rẹ̀ ni imu ohun rere jade wá; ati enia buburu lati inu iṣura buburu ọkàn rẹ̀ ni imu ohun buburu jade wá: nitori lati ọ̀pọlọpọ ohun ọkàn li ẹnu rẹ̀ isọ.
entries.en: A good man out of the good treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is good; and an evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is evil: for of the abundance of the heart his mouth speaketh.

entries.yo: Ẽsitiṣe ti ẹnyin npè mi li Oluwa, Oluwa, ti ẹnyin kò si ṣe ohun ti mo wi?
entries.en: And why call ye me, Lord, Lord, and do not the things which I say?

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni ti o tọ̀ mi wá, ti o si ngbọ́ ọ̀rọ mi, ti o si nṣe e, emi o fi ẹniti o jọ hàn nyin:
entries.en: Whosoever cometh to me, and heareth my sayings, and doeth them, I will shew you to whom he is like:

entries.yo: O jọ ọkunrin kan ti o kọ́ ile, ti o si walẹ jìn, ti o si fi ipilẹ sọlẹ lori apata: nigbati kíkun omi de, igbi-omi bilù ile na, kò si le mì i: nitoriti a fi ipilẹ rẹ̀ sọlẹ lori apata.
entries.en: He is like a man which built an house, and digged deep, and laid the foundation on a rock: and when the flood arose, the stream beat vehemently upon that house, and could not shake it: for it was founded upon a rock.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹniti o gbọ́, ti kò si ṣe, o dabi ọkunrin ti o kọ́ ile si ori ilẹ laini ipilẹ; nigbati igbi-omi bilù u, lọgan o si wó; iwó ile na si pọ̀.
entries.en: But he that heareth, and doeth not, is like a man that without a foundation built an house upon the earth; against which the stream did beat vehemently, and immediately it fell; and the ruin of that house was great.

entries.yo: NIGBATI o si pari gbogbo ọ̀rọ rẹ̀ li eti awọn enia, o wọ̀ Kapernaumu lọ.
entries.en: Now when he had ended all his sayings in the audience of the people, he entered into Capernaum.

entries.yo: Ọmọ-ọdọ balogun ọrún kan, ti o ṣọwọn fun u, o ṣaisàn, o nkú lọ.
entries.en: And a certain centurion's servant, who was dear unto him, was sick, and ready to die.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si gburó Jesu, o rán awọn agbagba Ju si i, o mbẹ̀ ẹ pe, ki o máṣai wá mu ọmọ-ọdọ on larada.
entries.en: And when he heard of Jesus, he sent unto him the elders of the Jews, beseeching him that he would come and heal his servant.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si de ọdọ Jesu, nwọn fi itara bẹ̀ ẹ, wipe, O yẹ li ẹniti on iba ṣe eyi fun:
entries.en: And when they came to Jesus, they besought him instantly, saying, That he was worthy for whom he should do this:

entries.yo: Nitoriti o fẹran orilẹ-ede wa, o si ti kọ́ sinagogu kan fun wa.
entries.en: For he loveth our nation, and he hath built us a synagogue.

entries.yo: Jesu si mba wọn lọ. Nigbati kò si jìn si eti ile mọ́, balogun ọrún na rán awọn ọrẹ́ si i, wipe, Oluwa, má yọ ara rẹ lẹnu: nitoriti emi kò to ti iwọ iba fi wọ̀ abẹ orule mi:
entries.en: Then Jesus went with them. And when he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying unto him, Lord, trouble not thyself: for I am not worthy that thou shouldest enter under my roof:

entries.yo: Nitorina emi kò si rò pe emi na yẹ lati tọ̀ ọ wá: ṣugbọn sọ ni gbolohùn kan, a o si mu ọmọ-ọdọ mi larada.
entries.en: Wherefore neither thought I myself worthy to come unto thee: but say in a word, and my servant shall be healed.

entries.yo: Nitori emi na pẹlu jẹ ẹniti a fi si abẹ aṣẹ, ti o li ọmọ-ogun li ẹhin mi, mo wi fun ọkan pe, Lọ, a si lọ; ati fun omiran pe, Wá, a si wá; ati fun ọmọ-ọdọ mi pe, Ṣe eyi, a si ṣe e.
entries.en: For I also am a man set under authority, having under me soldiers, and I say unto one, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth it.

entries.yo: Nigbati Jesu gbọ́ nkan wọnni, ẹnu yà a si i, o si yipada si ijọ enia ti ntọ̀ ọ lẹhin, o wipe, Mo wi fun nyin, emi kò ri irú igbagbọ́ nla bi eyi ninu awọn enia Israeli.
entries.en: When Jesus heard these things, he marvelled at him, and turned him about, and said unto the people that followed him, I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn onṣẹ si pada rè ile, nwọn ba ọmọ-ọdọ na ti nṣaisàn, ara rẹ̀ ti da.
entries.en: And they that were sent, returning to the house, found the servant whole that had been sick.

entries.yo: O si ṣe ni ijọ keji, o lọ sí ilu kan ti a npè ni Naini; awọn pipọ ninu awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ si mba a lọ ati ọ̀pọ ijọ enia.
entries.en: And it came to pass the day after, that he went into a city called Nain; and many of his disciples went with him, and much people.

entries.yo: Bi o si ti sunmọ ẹnu bode ilu na, si kiyesi i, nwọn ngbé okú kan jade, ọmọ kanṣoṣo na ti iya rẹ̀, o si jẹ opó: ọ̀pọ ijọ enia ilu na si wà pẹlu rẹ̀.
entries.en: Now when he came nigh to the gate of the city, behold, there was a dead man carried out, the only son of his mother, and she was a widow: and much people of the city was with her.

entries.yo: Nigbati Oluwa si ri i, ãnu rẹ̀ ṣe e, o si wi fun u pe, Má sọkun mọ́.
entries.en: And when the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her, and said unto her, Weep not.

entries.yo: O si wá, o si fi ọwọ́ tọ́ aga posi na: awọn ti si nrù u duro jẹ. O si wipe, Ọdọmọkunrin, mo wi fun ọ, Dide.
entries.en: And he came and touched the bier: and they that bare him stood still. And he said, Young man, I say unto thee, Arise.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o kú na si dide joko, o bẹ̀rẹ si ohùn ifọ̀. O si fà a le iya rẹ̀ lọwọ.
entries.en: And he that was dead sat up, and began to speak. And he delivered him to his mother.

entries.yo: Ẹ̀rù si ba gbogbo wọn: nwọn si nyìn Ọlọrun logo, wipe, Woli nla dide ninu wa; ati pe, Ọlọrun si wa ibẹ̀ awọn enia rẹ̀ wò.
entries.en: And there came a fear on all: and they glorified God, saying, That a great prophet is risen up among us; and, That God hath visited his people.

entries.yo: Okikí rẹ̀ si kàn ni gbogbo Judea, ati gbogbo àgbegbe ti o yiká.
entries.en: And this rumour of him went forth throughout all Judaea, and throughout all the region round about.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ-ẹhin Johanu si fi ninu gbogbo nkan wọnyi hàn fun u.
entries.en: And the disciples of John shewed him of all these things.

entries.yo: Nigbati Johanu si pè awọn meji ninu awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀, o rán wọn sọdọ Jesu, wipe, Iwọ li ẹniti mbọ̀, tabi ki a ma reti ẹlomiran?
entries.en: And John calling unto him two of his disciples sent them to Jesus, saying, Art thou he that should come? or look we for another?

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn ọkunrin na si de ọdọ rẹ̀, nwọn ni, Johanu Baptisti rán wa sọdọ rẹ, wipe, Iwọ li ẹniti mbọ̀, tabi ki a ma reti ẹlomiran?
entries.en: When the men were come unto him, they said, John Baptist hath sent us unto thee, saying, Art thou he that should come? or look we for another?
