entries.yo: Ni wakati na, o si ṣe dida ara ọpọlọpọ enia ninu aisan, ati arun, ati ẹmi buburu; o si fi iriran fun ọpọlọpọ awọn afọju.
entries.en: And in that same hour he cured many of their infirmities and plagues, and of evil spirits; and unto many that were blind he gave sight.

entries.yo: Jesu si dahùn o wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ pada lọ, ẹ ròhin nkan ti ẹnyin ri, ti ẹnyin si gbọ́ fun Johanu: awọn afọju nriran, awọn amukun nrìn ṣaṣa, a sọ awọn adẹtẹ̀ di mimọ́, awọn aditi ngbọran, a njí awọn okú dide, ati fun awọn òtoṣi li a nwasu ihinrere.
entries.en: Then Jesus answering said unto them, Go your way, and tell John what things ye have seen and heard; how that the blind see, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, to the poor the gospel is preached.

entries.yo: Alabukun-fun si li ẹnikẹni ti ki yio kọsẹ̀ lara mi.
entries.en: And blessed is he, whosoever shall not be offended in me.

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn onṣẹ Johanu pada lọ, o bẹ̀rẹ si isọ fun ijọ enia niti Johanu pe, Kili ẹnyin jade rè ijù lọ iwò? ifefe ti afẹfẹ nmì?
entries.en: And when the messengers of John were departed, he began to speak unto the people concerning John, What went ye out into the wilderness for to see? A reed shaken with the wind?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn kili ẹnyin jade lọ iwò? ọkunrin ti a wọ̀ li aṣọ fẹlẹfẹlẹ? wò o, awọn ti a wọ̀ li aṣọ ogo, ti nwọn si njaiye, mbẹ li afin ọba.
entries.en: But what went ye out for to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? Behold, they which are gorgeously apparelled, and live delicately, are in kings' courts.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn kili ẹnyin jade lọ iwò? woli? lõtọ ni mo wi fun nyin, o si jù woli lọ.
entries.en: But what went ye out for to see? A prophet? Yea, I say unto you, and much more than a prophet.

entries.yo: Eyiyi li ẹniti a ti kọwe nitori rẹ̀ pe, Wò o, mo rán onṣẹ mi siwaju rẹ, ẹniti yio tún ọ̀na rẹ ṣe niwaju rẹ.
entries.en: This is he, of whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.

entries.yo: Mo wi fun nyin, ninu awọn ti a bí ninu obinrin, kò si woli ti o pọ̀ju Johanu Baptisti lọ: ṣugbọn ẹniti o kerejulọ ni ijọba Ọlọrun, o pọ̀ju u lọ.
entries.en: For I say unto you, Among those that are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptist: but he that is least in the kingdom of God is greater than he.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn enia ti o gbọ́ ati awọn agbowode, nwọn da Ọlọrun lare, nitori a ti fi baptismu Johanu baptisi wọn.
entries.en: And all the people that heard him, and the publicans, justified God, being baptized with the baptism of John.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn Farisi ati awọn amofin kọ ìmọ Ọlọrun fun ara wọn, a kò baptisi wọn lọdọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: But the Pharisees and lawyers rejected the counsel of God against themselves, being not baptized of him.

entries.yo: Oluwa si wipe, Kili emi iba fi awọn enia iran yi wé? kini nwọn si jọ?
entries.en: And the Lord said, Whereunto then shall I liken the men of this generation? and to what are they like?

entries.yo: Nwọn dabi awọn ọmọ kekere ti o joko ni ibi ọjà, ti nwọn si nkọ si ara wọn, ti nwọn si nwipe, Awa fùn fère fun nyin, ẹnyin kò jó; awa si ṣọ̀fọ fun nyin, ẹnyin kò sọkun.
entries.en: They are like unto children sitting in the marketplace, and calling one to another, and saying, We have piped unto you, and ye have not danced; we have mourned to you, and ye have not wept.

entries.yo: Nitori Johanu Baptisti wá, kò jẹ akara, bẹ̃ni kò si mu ọti-waini; ẹnyin si wipe, O li ẹmi èṣu.
entries.en: For John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine; and ye say, He hath a devil.

entries.yo: Ọmọ-enia de, o njẹ, o si nmu; ẹnyin si wipe, Wò o, ọjẹun, ati ọmuti, ọrẹ́ awọn agbowode ati awọn ẹlẹṣẹ!
entries.en: The Son of man is come eating and drinking; and ye say, Behold a gluttonous man, and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners!

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn a da ọgbọ́n lare lati ọdọ awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ gbogbo wá.
entries.en: But wisdom is justified of all her children.

entries.yo: Farisi kan si rọ̀ ọ ki o wá ba on jẹun. O si wọ̀ ile Farisi na lọ o si joko lati jẹun.
entries.en: And one of the Pharisees desired him that he would eat with him. And he went into the Pharisee's house, and sat down to meat.

entries.yo: Si kiyesi i, obinrin kan wà ni ilu na, ẹniti iṣe ẹlẹṣẹ, nigbati o mọ̀ pe Jesu joko njẹun ni ile Farisi, o mu oruba alabastar ororo ikunra wá,
entries.en: And, behold, a woman in the city, which was a sinner, when she knew that Jesus sat at meat in the Pharisee's house, brought an alabaster box of ointment,

entries.yo: O si duro tì i lẹba ẹsẹ rẹ̀ lẹhin, o nsọkun, o si bẹ̀rẹ si ifi omije wẹ̀ ẹ li ẹsẹ, o si nfi irun ori rẹ̀ nù u nù, o si nfi ẹnu kò o li ẹsẹ, o si nfi ororo kùn wọn.
entries.en: And stood at his feet behind him weeping, and began to wash his feet with tears, and did wipe them with the hairs of her head, and kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.

entries.yo: Nigbati Farisi ti o pè e si ri i, o wi ninu ara rẹ̀ pe, ọkunrin yi iba ṣe woli, iba mọ̀ ẹni ati irú ẹniti obinrin yi iṣe ti nfi ọwọ́ kan a: nitori ẹlẹṣẹ ni.
entries.en: Now when the Pharisee which had bidden him saw it, he spake within himself, saying, This man, if he were a prophet, would have known who and what manner of woman this is that toucheth him: for she is a sinner.

entries.yo: Jesu si dahùn wi fun u pe, Simoni, Mo ni ohun kan isọ fun ọ. O si dahùn wipe, Olukọni, mã wi.
entries.en: And Jesus answering said unto him, Simon, I have somewhat to say unto thee. And he saith, Master, say on.

entries.yo: Onigbese kan wà ti o ni ajigbese meji: ọkan jẹ ẹ ni ẹdẹgbẹta owo idẹ, ekeji si jẹ ẹ ni adọta.
entries.en: There was a certain creditor which had two debtors: the one owed five hundred pence, and the other fifty.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn kò si ni ti nwọn o san, o darijì awọn mejeji. Wi, ninu awọn mejeji tani yio fẹ ẹ jù?
entries.en: And when they had nothing to pay, he frankly forgave them both. Tell me therefore, which of them will love him most?

entries.yo: Simoni dahùn o si wipe, mo ṣebi ẹniti o darijì jù ni. O si wi fun u pe, O wi i 're.
entries.en: Simon answered and said, I suppose that he, to whom he forgave most. And he said unto him, Thou hast rightly judged.

entries.yo: O si yipada si obinrin na, o wi fun Simoni pe, Iwọ ri obinrin yi? Emi wọ̀ ile rẹ, omi wiwẹ̀ ẹsẹ iwọ kò fifun mi: ṣugbọn on, omije li o fi nrọjo si mi li ẹsẹ, irun ori rẹ̀ li o fi nnù wọn nù.
entries.en: And he turned to the woman, and said unto Simon, Seest thou this woman? I entered into thine house, thou gavest me no water for my feet: but she hath washed my feet with tears, and wiped them with the hairs of her head.

entries.yo: Ifẹnukonu iwọ kò fi fun mi: ṣugbọn on, nigbati mo ti wọ̀ ile, ko dabọ̀ ẹnu ifi kò mi li ẹsẹ.
entries.en: Thou gavest me no kiss: but this woman since the time I came in hath not ceased to kiss my feet.

entries.yo: Iwọ kò fi oróro pa mi li ori: ṣugbọn on ti fi ororo pa mi li ẹsẹ.
entries.en: My head with oil thou didst not anoint: but this woman hath anointed my feet with ointment.

entries.yo: Njẹ mo wi fun ọ, A dari ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ̀ ti o pọ̀ jì i; nitoriti o ni ifẹ pipọ: ẹniti a si dari diẹ jì, on na li o ni ifẹ diẹ.
entries.en: Wherefore I say unto thee, Her sins, which are many, are forgiven; for she loved much: but to whom little is forgiven, the same loveth little.

entries.yo: O si wi fun u pe, A dari ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ jì ọ.
entries.en: And he said unto her, Thy sins are forgiven.

entries.yo: Awọn ti o bá a joko njẹun si bẹ̀rẹ si irò ninu ara wọn pe, Tali eyi ti ndari ẹ̀ṣẹ jì-ni pẹlu?
entries.en: And they that sat at meat with him began to say within themselves, Who is this that forgiveth sins also?

entries.yo: O si dahùn wi fun obinrin na pe, Igbagbọ́ rẹ gbà ọ là; mã lọ li alafia.
entries.en: And he said to the woman, Thy faith hath saved thee; go in peace.

entries.yo: O si ṣe lẹhinna, ti o nlà gbogbo ilu ati iletò lọ, o nwasu, o nrò ìhin ayọ̀ ijọba Ọlọrun: awọn mejila si mbẹ lọdọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And it came to pass afterward, that he went throughout every city and village, preaching and shewing the glad tidings of the kingdom of God: and the twelve were with him,

entries.yo: Ati awọn obinrin kan, ti a ti mu larada kuro lọwọ awọn ẹmi buburu, ati ninu ailera wọn, Maria ti a npè ni Magdalene, lara ẹniti ẹmi èṣu meje ti jade kuro,
entries.en: And certain women, which had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities, Mary called Magdalene, out of whom went seven devils,

entries.yo: Ati Joanna aya Kusa ti iṣe iriju Herodu, ati Susanna, ati awọn pipọ miran, ti nwọn nṣe iranṣẹ fun u ninu ohun ini wọn.
entries.en: And Joanna the wife of Chuza Herod's steward, and Susanna, and many others, which ministered unto him of their substance.

entries.yo: Nigbati ọ̀pọ ijọ enia pejọ pọ̀, lati ilu gbogbo si tọ̀ ọ wá, o fi owe ba wọn sọ̀rọ pe:
entries.en: And when much people were gathered together, and were come to him out of every city, he spake by a parable:

entries.yo: Afunrugbin kan jade lọ lati fun irugbin rẹ̀: bi o si ti nfunrugbin, diẹ bọ́ si ẹba ọ̀na; a si tẹ̀ ẹ mọlẹ, awọn ẹiyẹ oju ọrun si ṣà a jẹ.
entries.en: A sower went out to sow his seed: and as he sowed, some fell by the way side; and it was trodden down, and the fowls of the air devoured it.

entries.yo: Omiran si bọ́ sori apata; bi o si ti hù jade, o gbẹ nitoriti kò ni irinlẹ omi.
entries.en: And some fell upon a rock; and as soon as it was sprung up, it withered away, because it lacked moisture.

entries.yo: Omiran si bọ́ sinu ẹgún; ẹgún si ba a rú soke, o si fun u pa.
entries.en: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprang up with it, and choked it.

entries.yo: Omiran si bọ́ si ilẹ rere, o si rú soke, o si so eso ọrọrun. Nigbati o si wi nkan wọnyi tan, o nahùn wipe, Ẹniti o ba li etí lati fi gbọ́, ki o gbọ́.
entries.en: And other fell on good ground, and sprang up, and bare fruit an hundredfold. And when he had said these things, he cried, He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ si bi i lẽre, wipe, Kili a le mọ̀ owe yi si?
entries.en: And his disciples asked him, saying, What might this parable be?

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹnyin li a fifun lati mọ̀ ọ̀rọ ijinlẹ ijọba Ọlọrun: ṣugbọn fun awọn miran li owe; pe ni riri, ki nwọn ki o má le ri, ati ni gbigbọ ki o má le yé wọn.
entries.en: And he said, Unto you it is given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of God: but to others in parables; that seeing they might not see, and hearing they might not understand.

entries.yo: Njẹ owe na li eyi: Irugbin li ọ̀rọ Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God.

entries.yo: Awọn ti ẹba ọ̀na li awọn ti o gbọ́; nigbana li Èṣu wá o si mu ọ̀rọ na kuro li ọkàn wọn, ki nwọn ki o má ba gbagbọ́, ki a ma ṣe gbà wọn là.
entries.en: Those by the way side are they that hear; then cometh the devil, and taketh away the word out of their hearts, lest they should believe and be saved.

entries.yo: Awọn ti ori apata li awọn, nigbati nwọn gbọ́, nwọn fi ayọ̀ gbà ọ̀rọ na; awọn wọnyi kò si ni gbòngbo, nwọn a gbagbọ fun sã diẹ; nigba idanwò, nwọn a pada sẹhin.
entries.en: They on the rock are they, which, when they hear, receive the word with joy; and these have no root, which for a while believe, and in time of temptation fall away.

entries.yo: Awọn ti o bọ sinu ẹgún li awọn, nigbati nwọn gbọ́ tan, nwọn lọ, nwọn a si fi itọju ati ọrọ̀ ati irọra aiye fun u pa, nwọn kò si le so eso asogbo.
entries.en: And that which fell among thorns are they, which, when they have heard, go forth, and are choked with cares and riches and pleasures of this life, and bring no fruit to perfection.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ti ilẹ rere li awọn, ti nwọn fi ọkàn otitọ ati rere gbọ ọrọ na, nwọn di i mu ṣinṣin, nwọn si fi sũru so eso.
entries.en: But that on the good ground are they, which in an honest and good heart, having heard the word, keep it, and bring forth fruit with patience.

entries.yo: Kò si ẹnikẹni, nigbati o ba tàn fitilà tan, ti yio fi ohun elò bò o mọlẹ, tabi ti yio gbé e kà abẹ akete; bikoṣe ki o gbé e kà ori ọpá fitilà, ki awọn ti nwọ̀ ile ki o le ri imọlẹ.
entries.en: No man, when he hath lighted a candle, covereth it with a vessel, or putteth it under a bed; but setteth it on a candlestick, that they which enter in may see the light.

entries.yo: Nitori kò si ohun ti o lumọ́, ti a ki yio fi hàn, bẹ̃ni kò si ohun ti o pamọ́, ti a kì yio mọ̀, ti ki yio si yọ si gbangba.
entries.en: For nothing is secret, that shall not be made manifest; neither any thing hid, that shall not be known and come abroad.

entries.yo: Njẹ ki ẹnyin ki o mã kiyesara bi ẹnyin ti ngbọ́: nitori ẹnikẹni ti o ba ni, on li a o fifun; ati ẹnikẹni ti kò ba si ni, lọwọ rẹ̀ li a o si gbà eyi ti o ṣebi on ni.
entries.en: Take heed therefore how ye hear: for whosoever hath, to him shall be given; and whosoever hath not, from him shall be taken even that which he seemeth to have.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni iya rẹ̀, ati awọn arakunrin rẹ̀ tọ̀ ọ wá, nwọn kò si le sunmọ ọ nitori ọ̀pọ enia.
entries.en: Then came to him his mother and his brethren, and could not come at him for the press.

entries.yo: Nwọn si wi fun u pe, Iya rẹ ati awọn arakunrin rẹ duro lode, nwọn nfẹ ri ọ.
entries.en: And it was told him by certain which said, Thy mother and thy brethren stand without, desiring to see thee.

entries.yo: O si dahùn o si wi fun wọn pe, Iya mi ati awọn arakunrin mi li awọn wọnyi ti nwọn ngbọ́ ọ̀rọ Ọlọrun, ti nwọn si nṣe e.
entries.en: And he answered and said unto them, My mother and my brethren are these which hear the word of God, and do it.

entries.yo: O si ṣe ni ijọ kan, o si wọ̀ ọkọ̀ kan lọ ti on ti awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀: o si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ jẹ ki awa ki o rekọja lọ si ìha keji adagun. Nwọn si ṣikọ̀ lọ.
entries.en: Now it came to pass on a certain day, that he went into a ship with his disciples: and he said unto them, Let us go over unto the other side of the lake. And they launched forth.

entries.yo: Bi nwọn si ti nlọ, o sùn; iji nla si de, o nfẹ li oju adagun; nwọn si kún fun omi, nwọn si wà ninu ewu.
entries.en: But as they sailed he fell asleep: and there came down a storm of wind on the lake; and they were filled with water, and were in jeopardy.

entries.yo: Nwọn si tọ̀ ọ wá, nwọn si jí i, wipe, Olukọni, Olukọni, awa gbé. Nigbana li o dide, o si ba ẹfufu on riru omi wi: nwọn si da, idakẹ-rọrọ si de.
entries.en: And they came to him, and awoke him, saying, Master, master, we perish. Then he arose, and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water: and they ceased, and there was a calm.

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Igbagbọ́ nyin dà? Bi ẹ̀ru ti mba gbogbo wọn, ti hà si nṣe wọn, nwọn mbi ara wọn pe, irú ọkunrin kili eyi! nitori o ba ẹfufu on riru omi wi, nwọn si gbọ́ tirẹ̀.
entries.en: And he said unto them, Where is your faith? And they being afraid wondered, saying one to another, What manner of man is this! for he commandeth even the winds and water, and they obey him.

entries.yo: Nwọn si gúnlẹ ni ilẹ awọn ara Gadara, ti o kọju si Galili.
entries.en: And they arrived at the country of the Gadarenes, which is over against Galilee.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si sọkalẹ, ọkunrin kan pade rẹ̀ li ẹhin ilu na, ti o ti ni awọn ẹmi èṣu fun igba pipẹ, ti kì iwọ̀ aṣọ, bẹ̃ni kì ijoko ni ile kan, bikoṣe ni ìboji.
entries.en: And when he went forth to land, there met him out of the city a certain man, which had devils long time, and ware no clothes, neither abode in any house, but in the tombs.

entries.yo: Nigbati o ri Jesu, o ke, o wolẹ niwaju rẹ̀, o wi li ohùn rara, pe, Kini ṣe temi tirẹ Jesu, iwọ Ọmọ Ọlọrun Ọgá-ogo? emi bẹ̀ ọ máṣe da mi loró.
entries.en: When he saw Jesus, he cried out, and fell down before him, and with a loud voice said, What have I to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of God most high? I beseech thee, torment me not.

entries.yo: (Nitoriti o ti wi fun ẹmi aimọ́ na pe, ki o jade kuro lara ọkunrin na. Nigbakugba ni isá ma mu u: a si fi ẹ̀wọn ati ṣẹkẹṣẹkẹ dè e; o si da gbogbo ìde na, ẹmi èṣu na si dari rẹ̀ si ijù.)
entries.en: (For he had commanded the unclean spirit to come out of the man. For oftentimes it had caught him: and he was kept bound with chains and in fetters; and he brake the bands, and was driven of the devil into the wilderness.)

entries.yo: Jesu si bi i pe, Orukọ rẹ? o si dahùn pe, Legioni: nitoriti ẹmi eṣu pipọ wọ̀ ọ lara lọ.
entries.en: And Jesus asked him, saying, What is thy name? And he said, Legion: because many devils were entered into him.

entries.yo: Nwọn si bẹ̀ ẹ pe, ki o máṣe rán wọn lọ sinu ibu.
entries.en: And they besought him that he would not command them to go out into the deep.

entries.yo: Agbo ẹlẹdẹ pipọ si mbẹ nibẹ̀ ti njẹ li ori òke: nwọn si bẹ̀ ẹ ki o jẹ ki awọn wọ̀ inu wọn lọ. O si jọwọ wọn.
entries.en: And there was there an herd of many swine feeding on the mountain: and they besought him that he would suffer them to enter into them. And he suffered them.

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn ẹmi èṣu si jade kuro lara ọkunrin na, nwọn si wọ̀ inu awọn ẹlẹdẹ lọ: agbo ẹlẹdẹ si tu pũ nwọn si sure lọ si ibi bèbe sinu adagun, nwọn si rì sinu omi.
entries.en: Then went the devils out of the man, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the lake, and were choked.

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn ti mbọ́ wọn ri ohun ti o ṣe, nwọn sá, nwọn si lọ, nwọn si ròhin ni ilu ati ni ilẹ na.
entries.en: When they that fed them saw what was done, they fled, and went and told it in the city and in the country.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni nwọn jade lọ iwò ohun na ti o ṣe; nwọn si tọ̀ Jesu wá, nwọn si ri ọkunrin na, lara ẹniti awọn ẹmi èṣu ti jade lọ, o joko lẹba ẹsẹ Jesu, o wọṣọ, iyè rẹ̀ si bọ̀ si ipò: ẹ̀ru si ba wọn.
entries.en: Then they went out to see what was done; and came to Jesus, and found the man, out of whom the devils were departed, sitting at the feet of Jesus, clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.

entries.yo: Awọn ti o ri i si ròhin fun wọn bi o ti ṣe ti a fi mu ẹniti o li ẹmi èṣu larada.
entries.en: They also which saw it told them by what means he that was possessed of the devils was healed.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni gbogbo enia lati ilẹ Gadara yiká bẹ̀ ẹ pe, ki o lọ kuro lọdọ wọn; ẹ̀ru sá ba wọn gidigidi: o si bọ sinu ọkọ̀, o pada sẹhin.
entries.en: Then the whole multitude of the country of the Gadarenes round about besought him to depart from them; for they were taken with great fear: and he went up into the ship, and returned back again.

entries.yo: Njẹ ọkunrin na ti ẹmi èṣu jade kuro lara rẹ̀, o bẹ̀ ẹ ki on ki o le ma bá a gbé: ṣugbọn Jesu rán a lọ, wipe,
entries.en: Now the man out of whom the devils were departed besought him that he might be with him: but Jesus sent him away, saying,

entries.yo: Pada lọ ile rẹ, ki o si sọ ohun ti Ọlọrun ṣe fun ọ bi o ti pọ̀ to. O si lọ, o si nròhin já gbogbo ilu na bi Jesu ti ṣe ohun nla fun on to.
entries.en: Return to thine own house, and shew how great things God hath done unto thee. And he went his way, and published throughout the whole city how great things Jesus had done unto him.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati Jesu pada lọ, awọn enia tẹwọgbà a: nitoriti gbogbo nwọn ti nreti rẹ̀.
entries.en: And it came to pass, that, when Jesus was returned, the people gladly received him: for they were all waiting for him.

entries.yo: Si kiyesi i, ọkunrin kan ti a npè ni Jairu, ọkan ninu awọn olori sinagogu, o wá: o si wolẹ lẹba ẹsẹ Jesu, o bẹ̀ ẹ pe, ki o máṣai wá si ile on:
entries.en: And, behold, there came a man named Jairus, and he was a ruler of the synagogue: and he fell down at Jesus' feet, and besought him that he would come into his house:

entries.yo: Nitori o ni ọmọbinrin kanṣoṣo, ọmọ ìwọn ọdún mejila, o nkú lọ. Bi o si ti nlọ awọn enia nhá a li àye.
entries.en: For he had one only daughter, about twelve years of age, and she lay a dying. But as he went the people thronged him.

entries.yo: Obinrin kan ti o si ni isun ẹ̀jẹ lati igba ọdún mejila, ti o ná ohun gbogbo ti o ni fun awọn oniṣegun, bẹ̃ni a ko le mu u larada lati ọwọ́ ẹnikan wá,
entries.en: And a woman having an issue of blood twelve years, which had spent all her living upon physicians, neither could be healed of any,

entries.yo: O wá lẹhin rẹ̀, o fi ọwọ́ tọ́ iṣẹti aṣọ rẹ̀: lọgan ni isun ẹ̀jẹ rẹ̀ si ti gbẹ.
entries.en: Came behind him, and touched the border of his garment: and immediately her issue of blood stanched.

entries.yo: Jesu si wipe, Tali o fi ọwọ́ tọ́ mi? Nigbati gbogbo wọn sẹ́, Peteru ati awọn ti mbẹ lọdọ rẹ̀ wipe, Olukọni, awọn enia nhá ọ li àye, nwọn si mbilù ọ, iwọ si wipe, Tali o fi ọwọ́ kàn mi?
entries.en: And Jesus said, Who touched me? When all denied, Peter and they that were with him said, Master, the multitude throng thee and press thee, and sayest thou, Who touched me?

entries.yo: Jesu si wipe, Ẹnikan fi ọwọ́ kàn mi: nitoriti emi mọ̀ pe aṣẹ jade lara mi.
entries.en: And Jesus said, Somebody hath touched me: for I perceive that virtue is gone out of me.

entries.yo: Nigbati obinrin na si mọ̀ pe on ko farasin, o warìri, o wá, o si wolẹ niwaju rẹ̀, o si sọ fun u li oju awọn enia gbogbo nitori ohun ti o ṣe, ti on fi fi ọwọ́ tọ́ ọ, ati bi a ti mu on larada lojukanna.
entries.en: And when the woman saw that she was not hid, she came trembling, and falling down before him, she declared unto him before all the people for what cause she had touched him and how she was healed immediately.

entries.yo: O si wi fun u pe, Ọmọbinrin, tújuka: igbagbọ́ rẹ mu ọ larada; mã lọ li alafia.
entries.en: And he said unto her, Daughter, be of good comfort: thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace.

entries.yo: Bi o si ti nsọ̀rọ li ẹnu, ẹnikan ti ile olori sinagogu wá, o wi fun u pe, Ọmọbinrin rẹ kú; má yọ olukọni lẹnu mọ.
entries.en: While he yet spake, there cometh one from the ruler of the synagogue's house, saying to him, Thy daughter is dead; trouble not the Master.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati Jesu gbọ́, o da a li ohùn, wipe, Má bẹ̀ru: gbagbọ́ nikan ṣa, a o si mu u larada.
entries.en: But when Jesus heard it, he answered him, saying, Fear not: believe only, and she shall be made whole.

entries.yo: Nigbati Jesu si wọ̀ ile, kò jẹ ki ẹnikẹni wọle, bikoṣe Peteru, ati Jakọbu, ati Johanu, ati baba on iya ọmọbinrin na.
entries.en: And when he came into the house, he suffered no man to go in, save Peter, and James, and John, and the father and the mother of the maiden.

entries.yo: Gbogbo nwọn si sọkun, nwọn pohùnrere ẹkún rẹ̀: o si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ má sọkun mọ́; kò kú, sisùn li o sùn.
entries.en: And all wept, and bewailed her: but he said, Weep not; she is not dead, but sleepeth.

entries.yo: Nwọn si fi i ṣẹ̀fẹ, nwọn sa mọ̀ pe o kú.
entries.en: And they laughed him to scorn, knowing that she was dead.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si sé gbogbo wọn mọ́ ode, o mu u li ọwọ́, o si wipe, Ọmọbinrin, dide.
entries.en: And he put them all out, and took her by the hand, and called, saying, Maid, arise.

entries.yo: Ẹmí rẹ̀ si pada bọ̀, o si dide lọgan: o ni ki nwọn ki o fun u li onjẹ.
entries.en: And her spirit came again, and she arose straightway: and he commanded to give her meat.

entries.yo: Ẹnu si yà awọn õbi rẹ̀: ṣugbọn o kilọ fun wọn pe, ki nwọn ki o máṣe wi fun ẹnikan li ohun ti a ṣe.
entries.en: And her parents were astonished: but he charged them that they should tell no man what was done.

entries.yo: O si pè awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ mejila jọ, o si fun wọn li agbara on aṣẹ lori awọn ẹmi èṣu gbogbo, ati lati wò arùn sàn.
entries.en: Then he called his twelve disciples together, and gave them power and authority over all devils, and to cure diseases.

entries.yo: O si rán wọn lọ iwasu ijọba Ọlọrun, ati lati mu awọn olokunrun larada.
entries.en: And he sent them to preach the kingdom of God, and to heal the sick.

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ máṣe mu nkan lọ fun àjo nyin, ọpá, tabi àpo tabi akara, tabi owo; bẹ̃ni ki ẹnyin ki o má si ṣe ni àwọtẹlẹ meji.
entries.en: And he said unto them, Take nothing for your journey, neither staves, nor scrip, neither bread, neither money; neither have two coats apiece.

entries.yo: Ni ilekile ti ẹnyin ba si wọ̀, nibẹ̀ ni ki ẹnyin ki o gbé, lati ibẹ̀ ni ki ẹnyin ki o si ti jade.
entries.en: And whatsoever house ye enter into, there abide, and thence depart.

entries.yo: Iye awọn ti kò ba si gbà nyin, nigbati ẹnyin ba jade kuro ni ilu na, ẹ gbọ̀n ekuru ẹsẹ nyin fun ẹrí si wọn.
entries.en: And whosoever will not receive you, when ye go out of that city, shake off the very dust from your feet for a testimony against them.

entries.yo: Nwọn si jade, nwọn nlà iletò lọ, nwọn si nwasu ihinrere, nwọn si nmu enia larada nibi gbogbo.
entries.en: And they departed, and went through the towns, preaching the gospel, and healing every where.

entries.yo: Herodu tetrarki si gbọ́ nkan gbogbo ti nṣe lati ọdọ rẹ̀ wá: o si damu, nitoriti awọn ẹlomiran nwipe, Johanu li o jinde kuro ninu okú;
entries.en: Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him: and he was perplexed, because that it was said of some, that John was risen from the dead;

entries.yo: Awọn ẹlomiran si wipe Elijah li o farahàn; ati awọn ẹlomiran pe, ọkan ninu awọn woli atijọ li o jinde.
entries.en: And of some, that Elias had appeared; and of others, that one of the old prophets was risen again.

entries.yo: Herodu si wipe, Johanu ni mo ti bẹ́ lori: ṣugbọn tali eyi, ti emi ngbọ́ irú nkan wọnyi si? O si nfẹ lati ri i.
entries.en: And Herod said, John have I beheaded: but who is this, of whom I hear such things? And he desired to see him.

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn aposteli si pada de, nwọn ròhin ohun gbogbo fun u ti nwọn ti ṣe. O si mu wọn, o si lọ si apakan nibi ijù si ilu ti a npè ni Betsaida.
entries.en: And the apostles, when they were returned, told him all that they had done. And he took them, and went aside privately into a desert place belonging to the city called Bethsaida.

entries.yo: Nigbati ọpọ enia si mọ̀, nwọn tẹle e: o si gbà wọn, o si sọ̀rọ ijọba Ọlọrun fun wọn; awọn ti o fẹ imularada, li o si mu larada.
entries.en: And the people, when they knew it, followed him: and he received them, and spake unto them of the kingdom of God, and healed them that had need of healing.

entries.yo: Nigbati ọjọ bẹ̀rẹ si irẹlẹ, awọn mejila wá, nwọn si wi fun u pe, Tú ijọ enia ká, ki nwọn ki o le lọ si iletò ati si ilu yiká, ki nwọn ki o le wọ̀, ati ki nwọn ki o le wá onjẹ: nibi ijù li awa sá gbé wà nihinyi.
entries.en: And when the day began to wear away, then came the twelve, and said unto him, Send the multitude away, that they may go into the towns and country round about, and lodge, and get victuals: for we are here in a desert place.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn o wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ fi onjẹ fun wọn jẹ. Nwọn si wi fun u pe, Awa kò ni jù iṣu akara marun lọ, pẹlu ẹja meji; bikoṣepe awa lọ irà onjẹ fun gbogbo awọn enia wọnyi.
entries.en: But he said unto them, Give ye them to eat. And they said, We have no more but five loaves and two fishes; except we should go and buy meat for all this people.

entries.yo: Nitori awọn ọkunrin to ìwọn ẹgbẹdọgbọn enia. O si wi fun awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ pe, ki nwọn ki o mu wọn joko li ẹgbẹ-ẹgbẹ, li aradọta.
entries.en: For they were about five thousand men. And he said to his disciples, Make them sit down by fifties in a company.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ṣe bẹ̃, nwọn si mu gbogbo wọn joko.
entries.en: And they did so, and made them all sit down.

entries.yo: Nigbana li o mu iṣu akara marun, ati ẹja meji na, nigbati o gbé oju soke, o sure si i, o si bù u, o si fifun awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀, ki nwọn ki o gbé e kalẹ niwaju awọn enia.
entries.en: Then he took the five loaves and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed them, and brake, and gave to the disciples to set before the multitude.

entries.yo: Nwọn si jẹ, gbogbo wọn si yó: nwọn ṣà agbọ̀n mejila jọ ninu ajẹkù ti o kù fun wọn.
entries.en: And they did eat, and were all filled: and there was taken up of fragments that remained to them twelve baskets.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati o kù on nikan, o ngbadura, awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ si wà lọdọ rẹ̀: o si bi wọn pe, Tali awọn enia nfi emi pè?
entries.en: And it came to pass, as he was alone praying, his disciples were with him: and he asked them, saying, Whom say the people that I am?

entries.yo: Nwọn si dahùn wipe, Johanu Baptisti; ṣugbọn ẹlomiran ni, Elijah ni; ati awọn ẹlomiran wipe, ọkan ninu awọn woli atijọ li o jinde.
entries.en: They answering said, John the Baptist; but some say, Elias; and others say, that one of the old prophets is risen again.

entries.yo: O si bi wọn pe, Ṣugbọn tali ẹnyin nfi emi ipè? Peteru si dahùn, wipe, Kristi ti Ọlọrun.
entries.en: He said unto them, But whom say ye that I am? Peter answering said, The Christ of God.

entries.yo: O si kìlọ fun wọn, o si paṣẹ fun wọn, pe, ki nwọn ki o máṣe sọ ohun na fun ẹnikan.
entries.en: And he straitly charged them, and commanded them to tell no man that thing;

entries.yo: O si wipe, Ọmọ-enia ko le ṣaima jìya ohun pipọ, a o si kọ̀ ọ lati ọdọ awọn àgbagba ati lati ọdọ awọn olori alufa, ati lati ọdọ awọn akọwe wá, a o si pa a, ni ijọ kẹta a o si ji i dide.
entries.en: Saying, The Son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be slain, and be raised the third day.

entries.yo: O si wi fun gbogbo wọn pe, Bi ẹnikan ba nfẹ lati mã tọ̀ mi lẹhin, ki o sẹ́ ara rẹ̀, ki o si gbé agbelebu rẹ̀ ni ijọ gbogbo, ki o si mã tọ̀ mi lẹhin.
entries.en: And he said to them all, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me.

entries.yo: Nitori ẹnikẹni ti o ba fẹ gbà ẹmí rẹ̀ là, yio sọ ọ nù: ṣugbọn ẹnikẹni ti o ba sọ ẹmí rẹ̀ nù nitori mi, on na ni yio si gbà a là.
entries.en: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: but whosoever will lose his life for my sake, the same shall save it.

entries.yo: Nitoripe ère kini fun enia, bi o jère gbogbo aiye, ti o si sọ ara rẹ̀ nù, tabi ki o fi ara rẹ̀ ṣòfò.
entries.en: For what is a man advantaged, if he gain the whole world, and lose himself, or be cast away?

entries.yo: Nitori ẹnikẹni ti o ba tiju mi, ati ọ̀rọ mi, oju rẹ̀ li Ọmọ-enia yio si tì, nigbati o ba de inu ogo tirẹ̀, ati ti baba rẹ̀, ati ti awọn angẹli mimọ́.
entries.en: For whosoever shall be ashamed of me and of my words, of him shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he shall come in his own glory, and in his Father's, and of the holy angels.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi wi fun nyin nitõtọ, ẹlomiran duro nihinyi, ti kì yio ri ikú, titi nwọn o fi ri ijọba Ọlọrun.
entries.en: But I tell you of a truth, there be some standing here, which shall not taste of death, till they see the kingdom of God.

entries.yo: O si ṣe bi iwọn ijọ kẹjọ lẹhin ọ̀rọ wọnyi, o mu Peteru, ati Johanu, ati Jakọbu, o gùn ori òke lọ lati gbadura.
entries.en: And it came to pass about an eight days after these sayings, he took Peter and John and James, and went up into a mountain to pray.

entries.yo: Bi o si ti ngbadura, àwọ oju rẹ̀ yipada, aṣọ rẹ̀ si fun lawu, o njo fòfo.
entries.en: And as he prayed, the fashion of his countenance was altered, and his raiment was white and glistering.

entries.yo: Si kiyesi i, awọn ọkunrin meji, ti iṣe Mose on Elijah, nwọn mba a sọ̀rọ:
entries.en: And, behold, there talked with him two men, which were Moses and Elias:

entries.yo: Ti nwọn fi ara hàn ninu ogo, nwọn si nsọ̀rọ ikú rẹ̀, ti on ó ṣe pari ni Jerusalemu.
entries.en: Who appeared in glory, and spake of his decease which he should accomplish at Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn oju Peteru ati ti awọn ti mbẹ lọdọ rẹ̀ wuwo fun õrun. Nigbati nwọn si tají, nwọn ri ogo rẹ̀, ati ti awọn ọkunrin mejeji ti o ba a duro.
entries.en: But Peter and they that were with him were heavy with sleep: and when they were awake, they saw his glory, and the two men that stood with him.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati nwọn lọ kuro lọdọ rẹ̀, Peteru wi fun Jesu pe, Olukọni, o dara fun wa ki a mã gbé ihinyi: jẹ ki awa ki o pa agọ́ mẹta; ọkan fun iwọ, ati ọkan fun Mose, ati ọkan fun Elijah: kò mọ̀ eyi ti o nwi.
entries.en: And it came to pass, as they departed from him, Peter said unto Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias: not knowing what he said.

entries.yo: Bi o ti nsọ bayi, ikũkũ kan wá, o ṣiji bò wọn: ẹ̀ru si ba wọn nigbati nwọn nwọ̀ inu ikuku lọ.
entries.en: While he thus spake, there came a cloud, and overshadowed them: and they feared as they entered into the cloud.

entries.yo: Ohùn kan si ti inu ikũkũ wá, o ni, Eyiyi li ayanfẹ Ọmọ mi: ẹ mã gbọ́ tirẹ̀.
entries.en: And there came a voice out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son: hear him.

entries.yo: Nigbati ohùn na si dakẹ, Jesu nikanṣoṣo li a ri. Nwọn si pa a mọ́, nwọn kò si sọ ohunkohun ti nwọn ri fun ẹnikẹni ni ijọ wọnni.
entries.en: And when the voice was past, Jesus was found alone. And they kept it close, and told no man in those days any of those things which they had seen.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, ni ijọ keji, nigbati nwọn sọkalẹ lati ori òke wá, ọ̀pọ awọn enia wá ipade rẹ̀.
entries.en: And it came to pass, that on the next day, when they were come down from the hill, much people met him.

entries.yo: Si kiyesi i, ọkunrin kan ninu ijọ kigbe soke, wipe, Olukọni, mo bẹ̀ ọ, wò ọmọ mi; nitori ọmọ mi kanṣoṣo na ni.
entries.en: And, behold, a man of the company cried out, saying, Master, I beseech thee, look upon my son: for he is mine only child.

entries.yo: Si kiyesi i, ẹmi èṣu a ma mu u, a si ma kigbe lojijì; a si ma nà a tàntàn titi yio fi yọ ifofó li ẹnu, a ma pa a lara, a tilẹ fẹrẹ má fi i silẹ lọ.
entries.en: And, lo, a spirit taketh him, and he suddenly crieth out; and it teareth him that he foameth again, and bruising him hardly departeth from him.

entries.yo: Mo si bẹ̀ awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ lati lé e jade; nwọn kò si le ṣe e.
entries.en: And I besought thy disciples to cast him out; and they could not.

entries.yo: Jesu si dahùn, wipe, Iran alaigbagbọ́ ati arekereke, emi o ti ba nyin gbé pẹ to? emi o si ti ṣe sũru fun nyin pẹ to? Fà ọmọ rẹ wá nihinyi.
entries.en: And Jesus answering said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you, and suffer you? Bring thy son hither.

entries.yo: Bi o si ti mbọ̀, ẹmi èṣu na gbé e ṣanlẹ, o si nà a tantan. Jesu si ba ẹmi aimọ́ na wi, o si mu ọmọ na larada, o si fà a le baba rẹ̀ lọwọ.
entries.en: And as he was yet a coming, the devil threw him down, and tare him. And Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, and healed the child, and delivered him again to his father.

entries.yo: Ẹnu si yà gbogbo wọn si iṣẹ ọlánla Ọlọrun. Ṣugbọn nigbati hà si nṣe gbogbo wọn si ohun gbogbo ti Jesu ṣe, o wi fun awon ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ pe,
entries.en: And they were all amazed at the mighty power of God. But while they wondered every one at all things which Jesus did, he said unto his disciples,

entries.yo: Ẹ jẹ ki ọrọ wọnyi ki o rì si nyin li etí: nitori a o fi Ọmọ-enia le awọn enia lọwọ.
entries.en: Let these sayings sink down into your ears: for the Son of man shall be delivered into the hands of men.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ọ̀rọ na ko yé wọn, o si ṣú wọn li oju, bẹ̃ni nwọn kò si mọ̀ ọ: ẹ̀ru si mba wọn lati bère idi ọ̀rọ na.
entries.en: But they understood not this saying, and it was hid from them, that they perceived it not: and they feared to ask him of that saying.

entries.yo: Iyan kan si dide lãrin wọn, niti ẹniti yio ṣe olori ninu wọn.
entries.en: Then there arose a reasoning among them, which of them should be greatest.

entries.yo: Nigbati Jesu si mọ̀ ìro ọkàn wọn, o mu ọmọde kan, o gbé e joko lọdọ rẹ̀,
entries.en: And Jesus, perceiving the thought of their heart, took a child, and set him by him,

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹnikẹni ti o ba gbà ọmọde yi nitori orukọ mi, o gbà mi: ati ẹnikẹni ti o ba gbà mi, o gbà ẹniti o rán mi: nitori ẹniti o ba kere ju ninu gbogbo nyin, on na ni yio pọ̀.
entries.en: And said unto them, Whosoever shall receive this child in my name receiveth me: and whosoever shall receive me receiveth him that sent me: for he that is least among you all, the same shall be great.

entries.yo: Johanu si dahùn o si wi fun u pe, Olukọni, awa ri ẹnikan o nfi orukọ rẹ lé awọn ẹmi èṣu jade; awa si da a lẹkun, nitoriti kò ba wa tọ̀ ọ lẹhin.
entries.en: And John answered and said, Master, we saw one casting out devils in thy name; and we forbad him, because he followeth not with us.

entries.yo: Jesu si wi fun u pe, Máṣe da a lẹkun mọ́: nitori ẹniti kò ba lodi si wa, o wà fun wa.
entries.en: And Jesus said unto him, Forbid him not: for he that is not against us is for us.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati ọjọ atigbà soke rẹ̀ pé, o gbé oju le gangan lati lọ si Jerusalemu.
entries.en: And it came to pass, when the time was come that he should be received up, he stedfastly set his face to go to Jerusalem,

entries.yo: O si rán awọn onṣẹ lọ si iwaju rẹ̀: nigbati nwọn si lọ nwọn wọ̀ iletò kan ti iṣe ti ara Samaria lọ ipèse silẹ dè e.
entries.en: And sent messengers before his face: and they went, and entered into a village of the Samaritans, to make ready for him.

entries.yo: Nwọn kò si gbà a, nitoriti oju rẹ̀ dabi ẹnipe o nlọ si Jerusalemu.
entries.en: And they did not receive him, because his face was as though he would go to Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ Jakọbu on Johanu si ri i, nwọn ni, Oluwa, iwọ ko jẹ ki awa ki o pè iná lati ọrun wá, ki a sun wọn lúlu, bi Elijah ti ṣe?
entries.en: And when his disciples James and John saw this, they said, Lord, wilt thou that we command fire to come down from heaven, and consume them, even as Elias did?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Jesu yipada, o si ba wọn wi, o ni, Ẹnyin kò mọ̀ irú ẹmí ti mbẹ ninu nyin.
entries.en: But he turned, and rebuked them, and said, Ye know not what manner of spirit ye are of.

entries.yo: Nitori Ọmọ-enia ko wá lati pa ẹmi enia run, bikoṣe lati gbà a là. Nwọn si lọ si iletò miran.
entries.en: For the Son of man is not come to destroy men's lives, but to save them. And they went to another village.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, bi nwọn ti nlọ li ọ̀na, ọkunrin kan wi fun u pe, Oluwa, Emi nfẹ lati ma tọ̀ ọ lẹhin nibikibi ti iwọ ba nlọ.
entries.en: And it came to pass, that, as they went in the way, a certain man said unto him, Lord, I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.

entries.yo: Jesu si wi fun u pe, Awọn kọ̀lọkọlọ ni ihò, awọn ẹiyẹ oju ọrun si ni itẹ́; ṣugbọn Ọmọ-enia kò ni ibi ti yio fi ori rẹ̀ le.
entries.en: And Jesus said unto him, Foxes have holes, and birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.

entries.yo: O si wi fun ẹlomiran pe, Mã tọ̀ mi lẹhin. Ṣugbọn o wi fun u pe, Oluwa, jẹ ki emi ki o kọ́ lọ isinku baba mi na.
entries.en: And he said unto another, Follow me. But he said, Lord, suffer me first to go and bury my father.

entries.yo: Jesu si wi fun u pe, Je ki awọn okú ki o mã sinkú ara wọn: ṣugbọn iwọ lọ ki o si mã wãsu ijọba Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Jesus said unto him, Let the dead bury their dead: but go thou and preach the kingdom of God.

entries.yo: Ẹlomiran si wi fun u pe, Oluwa, emi nfẹ lati mã tọ̀ ọ lẹhin; ṣugbọn jẹ ki emi ki o pada lọ idagbere fun awọn ara ile mi.
entries.en: And another also said, Lord, I will follow thee; but let me first go bid them farewell, which are at home at my house.

entries.yo: Jesu si wi fun u pe, Kò si ẹni, ti o fi ọwọ́ rẹ̀ le ohun-elo itulẹ, ti o si wò ẹhin, ti o yẹ fun ijọba Ọlọrun.
entries.en: And Jesus said unto him, No man, having put his hand to the plough, and looking back, is fit for the kingdom of God.

entries.yo: LẸHIN nkan wọnyi, Oluwa si yàn adọrin ọmọ-ẹhin miran pẹlu, o si rán wọn ni mejimeji lọ ṣaju rẹ̀, si gbogbo ilu ati ibi ti on tikararẹ̀ yio gbé de.
entries.en: After these things the Lord appointed other seventy also, and sent them two and two before his face into every city and place, whither he himself would come.

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Ikore pọ̀, ṣugbọn awọn alagbaṣe ko to nkan: nitorina ẹ bẹ̀ Oluwa ikore, ki o le rán awọn alagbaṣe sinu ikore rẹ̀.
entries.en: Therefore said he unto them, The harvest truly is great, but the labourers are few: pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he would send forth labourers into his harvest.

entries.yo: Ẹ mu ọ̀na nyin pọ̀n: sa wò o, emi rán nyin lọ bi ọdọ-agutan sãrin ikõkò. 4. Ẹ máṣe mu asuwọn, ẹ máṣe mu apò, tabi bàta: ẹ má si ṣe kí ẹnikẹni li ọ̀na.
entries.en: Go your ways: behold, I send you forth as lambs among wolves.

entries.yo: Ni ilekile ti ẹnyin ba wọ̀, ki ẹ kọ́ wipe, Alafia fun ile yi.
entries.en: And into whatsoever house ye enter, first say, Peace be to this house.

entries.yo: Bi ọmọ alafia ba si mbẹ nibẹ̀, alafia nyin yio bà le e: ṣugbọn bi kò ba si, yio tún pada sọdọ nyin.
entries.en: And if the son of peace be there, your peace shall rest upon it: if not, it shall turn to you again.

entries.yo: Ni ile kanna ni ki ẹnyin ki o si gbé, ki ẹ mã jẹ, ki ẹ si mã mu ohunkohun ti nwọn ba fifun nyin; nitori ọ̀ya alagbaṣe tọ́ si i. Ẹ maṣe ṣi lati ile de ile.
entries.en: And in the same house remain, eating and drinking such things as they give: for the labourer is worthy of his hire. Go not from house to house.

entries.yo: Ati ni ilukilu ti ẹnyin ba wọ̀, ti nwọn ba si gbà nyin, ẹ jẹ ohunkohun ti a ba gbé kà iwaju nyin:
entries.en: And into whatsoever city ye enter, and they receive you, eat such things as are set before you:

entries.yo: Ẹ si mu awọn alaisan ti mbẹ ninu rẹ̀ larada, ki ẹ si wi fun wọn pe, Ijọba Ọlọrun kù dẹ̀dẹ si nyin.
entries.en: And heal the sick that are therein, and say unto them, The kingdom of God is come nigh unto you.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ni ilukilu ti ẹnyin ba si wọ̀, ti nwọn kò ba si gbà nyin, nigbati ẹnyin ba si jade si igboro ilu na, ki ẹnyin ki o si wipe,
entries.en: But into whatsoever city ye enter, and they receive you not, go your ways out into the streets of the same, and say,

entries.yo: Ekuru iyekuru ilu nyin ti o kù si wa lara, a gbọn ọ silẹ fun nyin: ṣugbọn ẹ mọ̀ eyi pe, ijọba Ọlọrun kù dẹ̀dẹ si nyin.
entries.en: Even the very dust of your city, which cleaveth on us, we do wipe off against you: notwithstanding be ye sure of this, that the kingdom of God is come nigh unto you.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn mo wi fun nyin, yio san fun Sodomu ni ijọ na, jù fun ilu na lọ.
entries.en: But I say unto you, that it shall be more tolerable in that day for Sodom, than for that city.

entries.yo: Egbé ni fun iwọ, Korasini! Egbé ni fun iwọ, Betsaida! nitori ibaṣepe a ti ṣe iṣẹ agbara ti a ṣe ninu nyin, ni Tire on Sidoni, nwọn iba ti ronupiwada lailai, nwọn iba si joko ninu aṣọ ọ̀fọ ati ninu ẽru.
entries.en: Woe unto thee, Chorazin! woe unto thee, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon, which have been done in you, they had a great while ago repented, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn yio san fun Tire on Sidoni nigba idajọ jù fun ẹnyin lọ.
entries.en: But it shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the judgment, than for you.

entries.yo: Ati iwọ, Kapernaumu, a o ha gbe ọ ga de oke ọrun? a o rẹ̀ ọ silẹ de ipo-oku.
entries.en: And thou, Capernaum, which art exalted to heaven, shalt be thrust down to hell.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba gbọ́ ti nyin, o gbọ́ ti emi: ẹniti o ba si kọ̀ nyin, o kọ̀ mi; ẹniti o ba si kọ̀ mi, o kọ̀ ẹniti o rán mi.
entries.en: He that heareth you heareth me; and he that despiseth you despiseth me; and he that despiseth me despiseth him that sent me.

entries.yo: Awọn adọrin na si fi ayọ̀ pada, wipe, Oluwa, awọn ẹmi èṣu tilẹ foribalẹ fun wa li orukọ rẹ.
entries.en: And the seventy returned again with joy, saying, Lord, even the devils are subject unto us through thy name.

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Emi ri Satani ṣubu bi manamana lati ọrun wá.
entries.en: And he said unto them, I beheld Satan as lightning fall from heaven.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, emi fun nyin li aṣẹ lati tẹ̀ ejò ati akẽkẽ mọlẹ, ati lori gbogbo agbara ọtá: kò si si ohunkan bi o ti wù ki o ṣe, ti yio pa-nyin-lara.
entries.en: Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy: and nothing shall by any means hurt you.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ki ẹ máṣe yọ̀ si eyi, pe, awọn ẹmi nforibalẹ fun nyin; ṣugbọn ẹ kuku yọ̀, pe, a kọwe orukọ nyin li ọrun.
entries.en: Notwithstanding in this rejoice not, that the spirits are subject unto you; but rather rejoice, because your names are written in heaven.

entries.yo: Ni wakati kanna Jesu yọ̀ ninu Ẹmi Mimọ́ o si wipe, Mo dupẹ lọwọ rẹ, Baba, Oluwa ọrun on aiye, pe, iwọ pa nkan wọnyi mọ́ kuro lọdọ awọn ọlọ́gbọn ati amoye, iwọ si fi wọn hàn fun awọn ọmọ-ọwọ: bẹ̃ni, Baba, bẹ̃li o sá yẹ li oju rẹ.
entries.en: In that hour Jesus rejoiced in spirit, and said, I thank thee, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them unto babes: even so, Father; for so it seemed good in thy sight.

entries.yo: Ohun gbogbo li a fifun mi lati ọdọ Baba mi wá: kò si si ẹniti o mọ̀ ẹniti Ọmọ iṣe, bikoṣe Baba; ati ẹniti Baba iṣe, bikoṣe Ọmọ, ati ẹnikẹni ti o ba si wù Ọmọ lati fi i hàn fun.
entries.en: All things are delivered to me of my Father: and no man knoweth who the Son is, but the Father; and who the Father is, but the Son, and he to whom the Son will reveal him.

entries.yo: O si yipada si awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ li apakan, o ni, Ibukún ni fun ojú ti nri ohun ti ẹnyin nri:
entries.en: And he turned him unto his disciples, and said privately, Blessed are the eyes which see the things that ye see:

entries.yo: Nitori mo wi fun nyin, Woli ati ọba pipọ li o nfẹ lati ri ohun ti ẹnyin nri, nwọn kò si ri wọn, ati lati gbọ ohun ti ẹnyin ngbọ́, nwọn ko si gbọ́ wọn,
entries.en: For I tell you, that many prophets and kings have desired to see those things which ye see, and have not seen them; and to hear those things which ye hear, and have not heard them.

entries.yo: Si kiyesi i, amofin kan dide, o ndán a wò, o ni, Olukọni, kili emi o ṣe ki emi ki o le jogún iyè ainipẹkun?
entries.en: And, behold, a certain lawyer stood up, and tempted him, saying, Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?

entries.yo: O si bi i pe, Kili a kọ sinu iwe ofin? bi iwọ ti kà a?
entries.en: He said unto him, What is written in the law? how readest thou?

entries.yo: O si dahùn wipe, Ki iwọ ki o fi gbogbo àiya rẹ, ati gbogbo ọkàn rẹ, ati gbogbo agbara rẹ, ati gbogbo inu rẹ fẹ Oluwa Ọlọrun rẹ; ati ẹnikeji rẹ bi ara rẹ.
entries.en: And he answering said, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy strength, and with all thy mind; and thy neighbour as thyself.

entries.yo: O si wi fun u pe, Iwọ dahùn rere: ṣe eyi, iwọ o si yè.
entries.en: And he said unto him, Thou hast answered right: this do, and thou shalt live.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn o nfẹ lati dá ara rẹ̀ lare, o wi fun Jesu pe, Tani ha si li ẹnikeji mi?
entries.en: But he, willing to justify himself, said unto Jesus, And who is my neighbour?

entries.yo: Jesu si dahùn o wipe, ọkunrin kan nti Jerusalemu sọkalẹ lọ si Jeriko, o si bọ si ọwọ́ awọn ọlọṣà, ti nwọn gbà a li aṣọ, nwọn ṣá a lọgbẹ, nwọn si fi i silẹ lọ li aipa li apatan.
entries.en: And Jesus answering said, A certain man went down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and fell among thieves, which stripped him of his raiment, and wounded him, and departed, leaving him half dead.

entries.yo: Ni alabapade, alufa kan si nsọkalẹ lọ lọna na: nigbati o si ri i, o kọja lọ niha keji.
entries.en: And by chance there came down a certain priest that way: and when he saw him, he passed by on the other side.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃na si ni ọmọ Lefi kan pẹlu, nigbati o de ibẹ̀, ti o si ri i, o kọja lọ niha keji.
entries.en: And likewise a Levite, when he was at the place, came and looked on him, and passed by on the other side.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ara Samaria kan, bi o ti nrè àjo, o de ibi ti o gbé wà: nigbati o si ri i, ãnu ṣe e,
entries.en: But a certain Samaritan, as he journeyed, came where he was: and when he saw him, he had compassion on him,

entries.yo: O si tọ̀ ọ lọ, o si dì i lọgbẹ, o da oróro on ọti-waini si i, o si gbé e le ori ẹranko ti on tikalarẹ̀, o si mu u wá si ile-èro, o si nṣe itọju rẹ̀.
entries.en: And went to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring in oil and wine, and set him on his own beast, and brought him to an inn, and took care of him.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si lọ ni ijọ keji, o fi owo idẹ meji fun olori ile-ero, o si wi fun u pe, Mã tọju rẹ̀; ohunkohun ti iwọ ba si ná kun u, nigbati mo ba pada de, emi ó san a fun ọ.
entries.en: And on the morrow when he departed, he took out two pence, and gave them to the host, and said unto him, Take care of him; and whatsoever thou spendest more, when I come again, I will repay thee.

entries.yo: Ninu awọn mẹtẹta wọnyi, tani iwọ rò pe iṣe ẹnikeji ẹniti o bọ si ọwọ́ awọn ọlọṣà?
entries.en: Which now of these three, thinkest thou, was neighbour unto him that fell among the thieves?

entries.yo: O si dahùn wipe, Ẹniti o ṣãnu fun u ni. Jesu si wi fun u pe, Lọ, ki iwọ ki o si ṣe bẹ̃ gẹgẹ.
entries.en: And he said, He that shewed mercy on him. Then said Jesus unto him, Go, and do thou likewise.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, bi nwọn ti nlọ, o wọ̀ iletò kan: obinrin kan ti a npè ni Marta si gbà a si ile rẹ̀.
entries.en: Now it came to pass, as they went, that he entered into a certain village: and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.

entries.yo: O si ni arabinrin kan ti a npè ni Maria, ti o si joko lẹba ẹsẹ Jesu, ti o ngbọ́ ọ̀rọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And she had a sister called Mary, which also sat at Jesus' feet, and heard his word.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Marta nṣe iyọnu ohun pupọ, o si tọ̀ ọ wá, o ni, Oluwa, iwọ kò kuku ṣu si i ti arabinrin mi fi mi silẹ lati mã nikan ṣe aisimi? Wi fun u ki o ràn mi lọwọ.
entries.en: But Martha was cumbered about much serving, and came to him, and said, Lord, dost thou not care that my sister hath left me to serve alone? bid her therefore that she help me.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Jesu si dahùn, o si wi fun u pe, Marta, Marta, iwọ nṣe aniyan ati lãlã nitori ohun pipọ:
entries.en: And Jesus answered and said unto her, Martha, Martha, thou art careful and troubled about many things:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ohun kan li a kò le ṣe alaini. Maria si ti yàn ipa rere na, ti a kò le gbà lọwọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: But one thing is needful: and Mary hath chosen that good part, which shall not be taken away from her.
Carry neither purse, nor scrip, nor shoes: and salute no man by the way.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, bi o ti ngbadura ni ibi kan, bi o ti dakẹ, ọkan ninu awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ wi fun u pe, Oluwa, kọ́ wa bi ãti igbadura, bi Johanu si ti kọ́ awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀.
entries.en: And it came to pass, that, as he was praying in a certain place, when he ceased, one of his disciples said unto him, Lord, teach us to pray, as John also taught his disciples.

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Nigbati ẹnyin ba ngbadura, ẹ mã wipe, Baba wa ti mbẹ li ọrun, Ki a bọ̀wọ̀ fun orukọ rẹ. Ki ijọba rẹ de. Ifẹ tirẹ ni ki a ṣe, bi ti ọrun, bẹni li aiye.
entries.en: And he said unto them, When ye pray, say, Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done, as in heaven, so in earth.

entries.yo: Fun wa li onjẹ ojọ wa li ojojumọ́.
entries.en: Give us day by day our daily bread.

entries.yo: Ki o si dari ẹ̀ṣẹ wa jì wa; nitori awa tikarawa pẹlu a ma darijì olukuluku ẹniti o jẹ wa ni gbese. Má si fà wa sinu idẹwò; ṣugbọn gbà wa lọwọ bilisi.
entries.en: And forgive us our sins; for we also forgive every one that is indebted to us. And lead us not into temptation; but deliver us from evil.

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Tani ninu nyin ti yio ni ọrẹ́ kan, ti yio si tọ̀ ọ lọ larin ọganjọ, ti yio si wi fun u pe, Ọrẹ́, win mi ni ìṣu akara mẹta:
entries.en: And he said unto them, Which of you shall have a friend, and shall go unto him at midnight, and say unto him, Friend, lend me three loaves;

entries.yo: Nitori ọrẹ́ mi kan ti àjo bọ sọdọ mi, emi kò si ni nkan ti emi o gbé kalẹ niwaju rẹ̀;
entries.en: For a friend of mine in his journey is come to me, and I have nothing to set before him?

entries.yo: Ti on o si gbé inu ile dahùn wi fun u pe, Má yọ mi lẹnu: a ti sé ilẹkun na, awọn ọmọ mi si mbẹ lori ẹní pẹlu mi; emi ko le dide fifun ọ?
entries.en: And he from within shall answer and say, Trouble me not: the door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed; I cannot rise and give thee.

entries.yo: Mo wi fun nyin, bi on kò tilẹ fẹ dide ki o fifun u, nitoriti iṣe ọrẹ́ rẹ̀, ṣugbọn nitori awiyannu rẹ̀ yio dide, yio si fun u pọ̀ to bi o ti nfẹ.
entries.en: I say unto you, Though he will not rise and give him, because he is his friend, yet because of his importunity he will rise and give him as many as he needeth.

entries.yo: Emi si wi fun nyin, Ẹ bère, a o si fifun nyin; ẹ wá kiri, ẹnyin o si ri; ẹ kànkun, a o si ṣi i silẹ fun nyin.
entries.en: And I say unto you, Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.

entries.yo: Nitori ẹnikẹni ti o ba bère, o ri gbà; ẹniti o si nwá kiri o ri; ati ẹniti o kànkun li a o ṣí i silẹ fun.
entries.en: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.

entries.yo: Tani iṣe baba ninu nyin ti ọmọ rẹ̀ yio bère akara lọdọ rẹ̀, ti o jẹ fun u li okuta? tabi bi o bère ẹja, ti o jẹ fun u li ejò dipo ẹja?
entries.en: If a son shall ask bread of any of you that is a father, will he give him a stone? or if he ask a fish, will he for a fish give him a serpent?

entries.yo: Tabi bi o si bère ẹyin, ti o jẹ fun u li akẽkẽ?
entries.en: Or if he shall ask an egg, will he offer him a scorpion?

entries.yo: Njẹ bi ẹnyin ti iṣe enia buburu ba mọ̀ bi ãti ifi ẹ̀bun didara fun awọn ọmọ nyin: melomelo ni Baba nyin ti mbẹ li ọrun yio fi Ẹmí Mimọ́ rẹ̀ fun awọn ti o mbère lọdọ rẹ̀?
entries.en: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children: how much more shall your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to them that ask him?

entries.yo: O si nlé ẹmi èṣu kan jade, ti o si yadi. O si ṣe, nigbati ẹmi èṣu na jade, odi sọrọ; ẹnu si yà ijọ enia.
entries.en: And he was casting out a devil, and it was dumb. And it came to pass, when the devil was gone out, the dumb spake; and the people wondered.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn ẹlomiran ninu wọn wipe, Nipa Beelsebubu olori awọn ẹmi èṣu li o fi nlé awọn ẹmi èṣu jade.
entries.en: But some of them said, He casteth out devils through Beelzebub the chief of the devils.

entries.yo: Awọn ẹlomiran si ndan a wò, nwọn fẹ àmi lọdọ rẹ̀ lati ọrun wá.
entries.en: And others, tempting him, sought of him a sign from heaven.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn on mọ̀ ìro inu wọn, o wi fun wọn pe, Gbogbo ijọba ti o yà ara rẹ̀ ni ipa, a sọ ọ di ahoro; ile ti o si yà ara rẹ̀ ni ipa, a wó.
entries.en: But he, knowing their thoughts, said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and a house divided against a house falleth.

entries.yo: Bi Satani si yàpa si ara rẹ̀, ijọba rẹ̀ yio ha ṣe duro? nitori ẹnyin wipe, Nipa Beelsebubu li emi fi nle awọn ẹmi èṣu jade.
entries.en: If Satan also be divided against himself, how shall his kingdom stand? because ye say that I cast out devils through Beelzebub.

entries.yo: Bi o ba si ṣepe nipa Beelsebubu li emi fi nlé awọn ẹmi èṣu jade, nipa tali awọn ọmọ nyin fi nlé wọn jade? nitorina awọn ni yio ṣe onidajọ nyin.
entries.en: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your sons cast them out? therefore shall they be your judges.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi o ba ṣepe ika Ọlọrun li emi fi nlé awọn ẹmi èṣu jade, kò si aniani, ijọba Ọlọrun de ba nyin.
entries.en: But if I with the finger of God cast out devils, no doubt the kingdom of God is come upon you.

entries.yo: Nigbati ọkunrin alagbara ti o hamọra ba nṣọ afin rẹ̀, ẹrù rẹ̀ a wà li alãfia:
entries.en: When a strong man armed keepeth his palace, his goods are in peace:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati ẹniti o li agbara jù u ba kọlù u, ti o si ṣẹgun rẹ̀, a gbà gbogbo ihamọra rẹ̀ ti o gbẹkẹle lọwọ rẹ̀, a si pín ikogun rẹ̀.
entries.en: But when a stronger than he shall come upon him, and overcome him, he taketh from him all his armour wherein he trusted, and divideth his spoils.

entries.yo: Ẹniti kò ba wà pẹlu mi, o lodi si mi: ẹniti kò ba si bá mi kopọ̀, o nfunká.
entries.en: He that is not with me is against me: and he that gathereth not with me scattereth.

entries.yo: Nigbati ẹmi aimọ́ ba jade kuro lara enia, ama rìn kiri ni ibi gbigbẹ, ama wá ibi isimi; nigbati ko ba si ri, a wipe, Emi o pada lọ si ile mi nibiti mo gbé ti jade wá.
entries.en: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walketh through dry places, seeking rest; and finding none, he saith, I will return unto my house whence I came out.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si de, o bá a, a gbá a, a si ṣe e li ọṣọ́.
entries.en: And when he cometh, he findeth it swept and garnished.

entries.yo: Nigbana li o lọ, o si mu ẹmi meje miran ti o buru jù on tikararẹ̀ lọ; nwọn wọle, nwọn si joko nibẹ̀: igbẹhin ọkunrin na si buru jù iṣaju rẹ̀ lọ.
entries.en: Then goeth he, and taketh to him seven other spirits more wicked than himself; and they enter in, and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, bi o ti nsọ nkan wọnyi, obinrin kan nahùn ninu ijọ, o si wi fun u pe, Ibukun ni fun inu ti o bí ọ, ati ọmú ti iwọ mu.
entries.en: And it came to pass, as he spake these things, a certain woman of the company lifted up her voice, and said unto him, Blessed is the womb that bare thee, and the paps which thou hast sucked.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn on wipe, Nitõtọ, ki a kuku wipe, Ibukun ni fun awọn ti ngbọ́ ọ̀rọ Ọlọrun, ti nwọn si pa a mọ́.
entries.en: But he said, Yea rather, blessed are they that hear the word of God, and keep it.

entries.yo: Nigbati ijọ enia si ṣùjọ si ọdọ rẹ̀ o bẹ̀rẹ si iwipe, Iran buburu li eyi: nwọn nwá àmi; a kì yio si fi àmi kan fun u, bikoṣe àmi Jona woli.
entries.en: And when the people were gathered thick together, he began to say, This is an evil generation: they seek a sign; and there shall no sign be given it, but the sign of Jonas the prophet.

entries.yo: Nitori bi Jona ti jẹ àmi fun awọn ara Ninefe, gẹgẹ bẹ̃ li Ọmọ-enia yio ṣe àmi fun iran yi.
entries.en: For as Jonas was a sign unto the Ninevites, so shall also the Son of man be to this generation.

entries.yo: Ọbabirin gusù yio dide li ọjọ idajọ pẹlu awọn enia iran yi, yio si da wọn lẹbi: nitoriti o ti iha ipẹkun aiye wá lati gbọ́ ọgbọ́n Solomoni: si kiyesi i, ẹniti o pọ̀ju Solomoni lọ mbẹ nihinyi.
entries.en: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation, and condemn them: for she came from the utmost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than Solomon is here.

entries.yo: Awọn ara Ninefe yio dide li ọjọ idajọ pẹlu iran yi, nwọn o si da a lẹbi: nitoriti nwọn ronupiwada nipa iwasu Jona; si kiyesi i, ẹniti o pọ̀ju Jona lọ mbẹ nihinyi.
entries.en: The men of Nineve shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas is here.

entries.yo: Kò si ẹnikan, nigbati o ba tan fitila tán, ti igbé e si ìkọkọ, tabi sabẹ oṣuwọn, bikoṣe sori ọpá fitilà, ki awọn ti nwọle ba le mã ri imọlẹ.
entries.en: No man, when he hath lighted a candle, putteth it in a secret place, neither under a bushel, but on a candlestick, that they which come in may see the light.

entries.yo: Oju ni imọlẹ ara: bi oju rẹ ba mọ́, gbogbo ara rẹ a mọlẹ; ṣugbọn bi oju rẹ ba buru, ara rẹ pẹlu a kun fun òkunkun.
entries.en: The light of the body is the eye: therefore when thine eye is single, thy whole body also is full of light; but when thine eye is evil, thy body also is full of darkness.

entries.yo: Nitorina kiyesi i, ki imọlẹ ti mbẹ ninu rẹ ki o máṣe di òkunkun.
entries.en: Take heed therefore that the light which is in thee be not darkness.

entries.yo: Njẹ bi gbogbo ara rẹ ba kun fun imọlẹ, ti ko li apakan ti o ṣokunkun, ara rẹ, gbogbo ni yio kun fun imọlẹ, bi igbati fitila ba fi itanṣan rẹ̀ fun ọ ni imọlẹ.
entries.en: If thy whole body therefore be full of light, having no part dark, the whole shall be full of light, as when the bright shining of a candle doth give thee light.

entries.yo: Bi o si ti nwi, Farisi kan bẹ̀ ẹ ki o ba on jẹun: o si wọle, o joko lati jẹun.
entries.en: And as he spake, a certain Pharisee besought him to dine with him: and he went in, and sat down to meat.

entries.yo: Nigbati Farisi na si ri i, ẹnu yà a nitoriti kò kọ́ wẹ̀ ki o to jẹun.
entries.en: And when the Pharisee saw it, he marvelled that he had not first washed before dinner.

entries.yo: Oluwa si wi fun u pe, Ẹnyin Farisi a ma fọ̀ ode ago ati awopọkọ́; ṣugbọn inu nyin kún fun irẹjẹ iwa-buburu.
entries.en: And the Lord said unto him, Now do ye Pharisees make clean the outside of the cup and the platter; but your inward part is full of ravening and wickedness.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin alaimoye, ẹniti o ṣe eyi ti mbẹ lode, on kọ́ ha ṣe eyi ti mbẹ ninu pẹlu?
entries.en: Ye fools, did not he that made that which is without make that which is within also?

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o kuku mã ṣe itọrẹ ãnu ninu ohun ti ẹnyin ni; si kiyesi i, ohun gbogbo li o di mimọ́ fun nyin.
entries.en: But rather give alms of such things as ye have; and, behold, all things are clean unto you.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn egbé ni fun nyin, ẹnyin Farisi! nitoriti ẹnyin a ma san idamẹwa minti, ati rue, ati gbogbo ewebẹ̀, ṣugbọn ẹnyin gbojufò idajọ ati ifẹ Ọlọrun: wọnyi li ẹnyin iba ṣe, ẹ kì ba si ti fi ekeji silẹ laiṣe.
entries.en: But woe unto you, Pharisees! for ye tithe mint and rue and all manner of herbs, and pass over judgment and the love of God: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.

entries.yo: Egbé ni fun nyin, ẹnyin Farisi! nitoriti ẹnyin fẹ ipò-ọlá ninu sinagogu, ati ikí-ni li ọjà.
entries.en: Woe unto you, Pharisees! for ye love the uppermost seats in the synagogues, and greetings in the markets.

entries.yo: Egbé ni fun nyin, ẹnyin akọwe, ati ẹnyin Farisi, agabagebe! nitoriti ẹnyin dabi isa okú ti kò hàn, awọn enia ti o si nrìn lori wọn kò mọ̀.
entries.en: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are as graves which appear not, and the men that walk over them are not aware of them.

entries.yo: Nigbana li ọkan ninu awọn amofin dahùn, o si wi fun u pe, Olukọni, li eyi ti iwọ nwi nì iwọ ngàn awa pẹlu.
entries.en: Then answered one of the lawyers, and said unto him, Master, thus saying thou reproachest us also.

entries.yo: O si wipe, Egbé ni fun ẹnyin amofin pẹlu! nitoriti ẹnyin di ẹrù ti o wuwo lati rù le enia lori, bẹ̃ni ẹnyin tikara nyin kò jẹ fi ika nyin kan kàn ẹrù na.
entries.en: And he said, Woe unto you also, ye lawyers! for ye lade men with burdens grievous to be borne, and ye yourselves touch not the burdens with one of your fingers.

entries.yo: Egbé ni fun nyin! nitoriti ẹnyin kọ́le oju-õrì awọn woli, awọn baba nyin li o si ti pa wọn.
entries.en: Woe unto you! for ye build the sepulchres of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.

entries.yo: Njẹ ẹnyin njẹ ẹlẹri, ẹ si ni inudidun si iṣe awọn baba nyin: nitori nwọn pa wọn, ẹnyin si kọ́le oju-õrì wọn.
entries.en: Truly ye bear witness that ye allow the deeds of your fathers: for they indeed killed them, and ye build their sepulchres.

entries.yo: Nitori eyi li ọgbọ́n Ọlọrun si ṣe wipe, emi ó rán awọn woli ati awọn aposteli si wọn, ninu wọn ni nwọn o si pa, ti nwọn o si ṣe inunibini si:
entries.en: Therefore also said the wisdom of God, I will send them prophets and apostles, and some of them they shall slay and persecute:

entries.yo: Ki a le bère ẹ̀jẹ awọn woli gbogbo, ti a ti ta silẹ lati igba ipilẹṣẹ aiye wá, lọdọ iran yi;
entries.en: That the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation;

entries.yo: Lati ẹ̀jẹ Abeli wá, titi o si fi de ẹ̀jẹ Sakariah, ti o ṣegbé lãrin pẹpẹ on tẹmpili: lõtọ ni mo wi fun nyin, A o bère rẹ̀ lọdọ iran yi.
entries.en: From the blood of Abel unto the blood of Zacharias, which perished between the altar and the temple: verily I say unto you, It shall be required of this generation.

entries.yo: Egbé ni fun nyin, ẹnyin amofin! nitoriti ẹnyin gbà ọmọ-ṣika ìmọ: ẹnyin tikaranyin kò wọle, awọn ti si nwọle, li ẹnyin kọ̀ fun.
entries.en: Woe unto you, lawyers! for ye have taken away the key of knowledge: ye entered not in yourselves, and them that were entering in ye hindered.

entries.yo: Bi o ti nwi nkan wọnyi fun wọn, awọn akọwe ati awọn Farisi bẹ̀rẹ si ibinu si i gidigidi, nwọn si nyọ ọ lẹnu lati wi nkan pipọ:
entries.en: And as he said these things unto them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to urge him vehemently, and to provoke him to speak of many things:

entries.yo: Nwọn nṣọ ọ, nwọn nwá ọ̀na ati ri nkan gbámu li ẹnu rẹ̀, ki nwọn ki o le fi i sùn.
entries.en: Laying wait for him, and seeking to catch something out of his mouth, that they might accuse him.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati ainiye ijọ enia pejọ pọ̀, tobẹ̃ ti nwọn ntẹ̀ ara wọn mọlẹ, o tètekọ́ wi fun awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ pe, Ẹ mã ṣọra nyin nitori iwukara awọn Farisi, ti iṣe agabagebe.
entries.en: In the mean time, when there were gathered together an innumerable multitude of people, insomuch that they trode one upon another, he began to say unto his disciples first of all, Beware ye of the leaven of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.

entries.yo: Kò si ohun ti a bò, ti a kì yio si fihàn; tabi ti o pamọ, ti a ki yio mọ̀.
entries.en: For there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; neither hid, that shall not be known.

entries.yo: Nitorina ohunkohun ti ẹnyin sọ li òkunkun, ni gbangba li a o gbé gbọ́; ati ohun ti ẹnyin ba sọ si etí ni ìkọkọ, lori orule li a o gbé kede rẹ̀.
entries.en: Therefore whatsoever ye have spoken in darkness shall be heard in the light; and that which ye have spoken in the ear in closets shall be proclaimed upon the housetops.

entries.yo: Emi si wi fun nyin ẹnyin ọrẹ́ mi, Ẹ máṣe bẹ̀ru awọn ti ipa ara enia kú, lẹhin eyini ti nwọn kò si li eyiti nwọn le ṣe mọ́.
entries.en: And I say unto you my friends, Be not afraid of them that kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi o si sọ ẹniti ẹnyin o bẹ̀ru fun nyin: Ẹ bẹru ẹniti o lagbara lẹhin ti o ba pani tan, lati wọ́ni lọ si ọrun apadi; lõtọ ni mo wi fun nyin, On ni ki ẹ bẹru.
entries.en: But I will forewarn you whom ye shall fear: Fear him, which after he hath killed hath power to cast into hell; yea, I say unto you, Fear him.

entries.yo: Ologoṣẹ marun ki a ntà li owo idẹ wẹ́wẹ meji? a kò si gbagbé ọkan ninu wọn niwaju Ọlọrun?
entries.en: Are not five sparrows sold for two farthings, and not one of them is forgotten before God?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn gbogbo irun ori nyin li a kà pé ṣanṣan. Nitorina ki ẹ máṣe bẹ̀ru: ẹnyin ni iye lori jù ologoṣẹ pipọ lọ.
entries.en: But even the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Fear not therefore: ye are of more value than many sparrows.

entries.yo: Mo si wi fun nyin pẹlu, Ẹnikẹni ti o ba jẹwọ mi niwaju enia, Ọmọ-ẹnia yio si jẹwọ rẹ̀ niwaju awọn angẹli Ọlọrun:
entries.en: Also I say unto you, Whosoever shall confess me before men, him shall the Son of man also confess before the angels of God:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹniti o ba sẹ́ mi niwaju enia, a o sẹ́ ẹ niwaju awọn angẹli Ọlọrun.
entries.en: But he that denieth me before men shall be denied before the angels of God.

entries.yo: Ati ẹnikẹni ti o ba sọ̀rọ-òdi si Ọmọ-enia, a o dari rẹ̀ jì i: ṣugbọn ẹnikẹni ti o ba sọrọ-odi si Ẹmí Mimọ́, a kì yio dari rẹ̀ jì i.
entries.en: And whosoever shall speak a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but unto him that blasphemeth against the Holy Ghost it shall not be forgiven.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn ba si mu nyin wá si sinagogu, ati siwaju awọn olori, ati awọn alaṣẹ, ẹ máṣe ṣàniyàn pe, bawo tabi ohùn kili ẹnyin ó da, tabi kili ẹnyin o wi:
entries.en: And when they bring you unto the synagogues, and unto magistrates, and powers, take ye no thought how or what thing ye shall answer, or what ye shall say:

entries.yo: Nitori Ẹmí Mimọ́ yio kọ́ nyin ni wakati kanna li ohun ti o yẹ ki ẹ wi.
entries.en: For the Holy Ghost shall teach you in the same hour what ye ought to say.

entries.yo: Ọkan ninu awujọ si wi fun u pe, Olukọni, sọ fun arakunrin mi ki o pín mi li ogún.
entries.en: And one of the company said unto him, Master, speak to my brother, that he divide the inheritance with me.

entries.yo: O si wi fun u pe, ọkunrin yi, tali o fi mi jẹ onidajọ tabi olùpín-ogún wá fun nyin?
entries.en: And he said unto him, Man, who made me a judge or a divider over you?

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Kiyesara ki ẹ si mã ṣọra nitori ojukòkoro: nitori igbesi aiye enia ki iduro nipa ọ̀pọ ohun ti o ni.
entries.en: And he said unto them, Take heed, and beware of covetousness: for a man's life consisteth not in the abundance of the things which he possesseth.

entries.yo: O si pa owe kan fun wọn, wipe, Ilẹ ọkunrin kan ọlọrọ̀ so eso ọ̀pọlọpọ:
entries.en: And he spake a parable unto them, saying, The ground of a certain rich man brought forth plentifully:

entries.yo: O si rò ninu ara rẹ̀, wipe, Emi o ti ṣe, nitoriti emi kò ni ibiti emi o gbé kó eso mi jọ si?
entries.en: And he thought within himself, saying, What shall I do, because I have no room where to bestow my fruits?

entries.yo: O si wipe, Eyi li emi o ṣe: emi o wó aká mi palẹ, emi o si kọ́ eyi ti o tobi; nibẹ̀ li emi o gbé tò gbogbo eso ati ọrọ̀ mi jọ si.
entries.en: And he said, This will I do: I will pull down my barns, and build greater; and there will I bestow all my fruits and my goods.

entries.yo: Emi o si wi fun ọkàn mi pe, Ọkàn, iwọ li ọrọ̀ pipọ ti a tò jọ fun ọ̀pọ ọdún; simi mã jẹ, mã mu, mã yọ̀.
entries.en: And I will say to my soul, Soul, thou hast much goods laid up for many years; take thine ease, eat, drink, and be merry.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Ọlọrun wi fun u pe, Iwọ aṣiwere, li oru yi li a o bère ẹmi rẹ lọwọ rẹ: njẹ titani nkan wọnni yio ha ṣe, ti iwọ ti pèse silẹ?
entries.en: But God said unto him, Thou fool, this night thy soul shall be required of thee: then whose shall those things be, which thou hast provided?

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ li ẹniti o tò iṣura jọ fun ara rẹ̀, ti ko si li ọrọ̀ lọdọ Ọlọrun.
entries.en: So is he that layeth up treasure for himself, and is not rich toward God.

entries.yo: O si wi fun awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ pe, Nitorina mo wi fun nyin pe, ẹ máṣe ṣaniyàn nitori ẹmí nyin pe, kili ẹnyin ó jẹ; tabi nitori ara nyin pe, kili ẹnyin ó fi bora.
entries.en: And he said unto his disciples, Therefore I say unto you, Take no thought for your life, what ye shall eat; neither for the body, what ye shall put on.

entries.yo: Ẹmí sa jù onjẹ lọ, ara si jù aṣọ lọ.
entries.en: The life is more than meat, and the body is more than raiment.

entries.yo: Ẹ kiyesi awọn ìwo: nwọn kì ifọnrugbin, bẹ̃ni nwọn ki kore; nwọn kò li aká, bẹ̃ni nwọn kò li abà; Ọlọrun sá mbọ́ wọn: melomelo li ẹnyin sàn jù ẹiyẹ lọ?
entries.en: Consider the ravens: for they neither sow nor reap; which neither have storehouse nor barn; and God feedeth them: how much more are ye better than the fowls?

entries.yo: Tani ninu nyin nipa aniyan ṣiṣe ti o le fi igbọnwọ kan kún ọjọ aiyé rẹ̀?
entries.en: And which of you with taking thought can add to his stature one cubit?

entries.yo: Njẹ bi ẹnyin kò le ṣe eyi ti o kere julọ, ẽṣe ti ẹnyin fi nṣaniyan nitori iyokù?
entries.en: If ye then be not able to do that thing which is least, why take ye thought for the rest?

entries.yo: Ẹ kiyesi awọn lili bi nwọn ti ndàgba: nwọn ki iṣiṣẹ nwọn ki iranwu; ṣugbọn ki emi wi fun nyin, a kò ṣe Solomoni pãpã li ọṣọ́ ni gbogbo ogo rẹ̀ to ọkan ninu wọnyi.
entries.en: Consider the lilies how they grow: they toil not, they spin not; and yet I say unto you, that Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.

entries.yo: Njẹ bi Ọlọrun ba wọ̀ koriko igbẹ́ li aṣọ tobẹ̃ eyiti o wà loni, ti a si gbá a sinu ina lọla; melomelo ni yio wọ̀ nyin li aṣọ, ẹnyin onigbagbọ́ kekere?
entries.en: If then God so clothe the grass, which is to day in the field, and to morrow is cast into the oven; how much more will he clothe you, O ye of little faith?

entries.yo: Ẹ má si ṣe bere ohun ti ẹnyin ó jẹ, tabi ohun ti ẹnyin o mu, ki ẹnyin ki o má si ṣiyemeji.
entries.en: And seek not ye what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink, neither be ye of doubtful mind.

entries.yo: Nitori gbogbo nkan wọnyi ni awọn orilẹ-ède aiye nwá kiri: Baba nyin si mọ̀ pe, ẹnyin nfẹ nkan wọnyi.
entries.en: For all these things do the nations of the world seek after: and your Father knoweth that ye have need of these things.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹ mã wá ijọba Ọlọrun; gbogbo nkan wọnyi li a o si fi kún nyin.
entries.en: But rather seek ye the kingdom of God; and all these things shall be added unto you.

entries.yo: Má bẹ̀ru, agbo kekere; nitori didùn inu Baba nyin ni lati fi ijọba fun nyin.
entries.en: Fear not, little flock; for it is your Father's good pleasure to give you the kingdom.

entries.yo: Ẹ tà ohun ti ẹnyin ni, ki ẹnyin ki o si tọrẹ ãnu; ki ẹnyin ki o si pèse àpo fun ara nyin, ti kì igbó, iṣura li ọrun ti kì itán, nibiti olè kò le sunmọ, ati ibiti kòkoro kì iba a jẹ.
entries.en: Sell that ye have, and give alms; provide yourselves bags which wax not old, a treasure in the heavens that faileth not, where no thief approacheth, neither moth corrupteth.

entries.yo: Nitori nibiti iṣura nyin gbé wà, nibẹ̀ li ọkàn nyin yio gbé wà pẹlu.
entries.en: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.

entries.yo: Ẹ di amure nyin, ki fitila nyin ki o si mã jo:
entries.en: Let your loins be girded about, and your lights burning;

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin tikara nyin ki o dabi ẹniti nreti oluwa wọn, nigbati on o pada ti ibi iyawo de; pe, nigbati o ba de, ti o si kànkun, ki nwọn ki o le ṣí i silẹ fun u lọgan.
entries.en: And ye yourselves like unto men that wait for their lord, when he will return from the wedding; that when he cometh and knocketh, they may open unto him immediately.

entries.yo: Ibukun ni fun awọn ọmọ-ọdọ wọnni nigbati oluwa na ba de ti yio ba ki nwọn ki o ma ṣọna: lõtọ ni mo wi fun nyin, yio di ara rẹ̀ li amure, yio si mu wọn joko lati jẹun, yio si jade wá lati ṣe iranṣẹ fun wọn.
entries.en: Blessed are those servants, whom the lord when he cometh shall find watching: verily I say unto you, that he shall gird himself, and make them to sit down to meat, and will come forth and serve them.

entries.yo: Bi o ba si de nigba iṣọ keji, tabi ti o si de nigba iṣọ kẹta, ti o si ba wọn bẹ̃, ibukun ni fun awọn ọmọ-ọdọ wọnni.
entries.en: And if he shall come in the second watch, or come in the third watch, and find them so, blessed are those servants.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹ mọ̀ eyi pe, bãle ile iba mọ̀ wakati ti olè yio wá, on iba ma ṣọna, kì ba ti jẹ ki a lu ile on já.
entries.en: And this know, that if the goodman of the house had known what hour the thief would come, he would have watched, and not have suffered his house to be broken through.

entries.yo: Nitorina ki ẹnyin ki o mura pẹlu: Nitori Ọmọ-enia mbọ̀ ni wakati ti ẹnyin kò daba.
entries.en: Be ye therefore ready also: for the Son of man cometh at an hour when ye think not.

entries.yo: Peteru si wipe, Oluwa, iwọ pa owe yi fun wa, tabi fun gbogbo enia?
entries.en: Then Peter said unto him, Lord, speakest thou this parable unto us, or even to all?

entries.yo: Oluwa si dahùn wipe, Tani olõtọ ati ọlọ́gbọn iriju na, ti oluwa rẹ̀ fi jẹ olori agbo ile rẹ̀, lati ma fi ìwọn onjẹ wọn fun wọn li akokò?
entries.en: And the Lord said, Who then is that faithful and wise steward, whom his lord shall make ruler over his household, to give them their portion of meat in due season?

entries.yo: Ibukun ni fun ọmọ-ọdọ na, nigbati oluwa rẹ̀ ba de, ti yio ba a ki o ma ṣe bẹ̃.
entries.en: Blessed is that servant, whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing.

entries.yo: Lõtọ ni mo wi fun nyin, yio si fi i jẹ olori ohun gbogbo ti o ni.
entries.en: Of a truth I say unto you, that he will make him ruler over all that he hath.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi ọmọ-ọdọ na ba wi li ọkàn rẹ̀ pe, Oluwa mi yẹ̀ igba atibọ̀ rẹ̀; ti o si bẹ̀rẹ si ilù awọn iranṣẹkunrin ati iranṣẹbinrin, ti o si bẹ̀rẹ si ijẹ ati si imu amupara;
entries.en: But and if that servant say in his heart, My lord delayeth his coming; and shall begin to beat the menservants and maidens, and to eat and drink, and to be drunken;

entries.yo: Oluwa ọmọ-ọdọ na yio de li ọjọ ti kò reti rẹ̀, ati ni wakati ti kò daba, yio si jẹ ẹ niya gidigidi, yio si yàn ipò rẹ̀ pẹlu awọn alaigbagbọ́.
entries.en: The lord of that servant will come in a day when he looketh not for him, and at an hour when he is not aware, and will cut him in sunder, and will appoint him his portion with the unbelievers.

entries.yo: Ati ọmọ-ọdọ na, ti o mọ̀ ifẹ oluwa rẹ̀, ti kò si mura silẹ ti kò si ṣe gẹgẹ bi ifẹ rẹ̀, on li a o nà pipọ.
entries.en: And that servant, which knew his lord's will, and prepared not himself, neither did according to his will, shall be beaten with many stripes.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn eyi ti kò mọ̀, ti o ṣe ohun ti o yẹ si lilu, on li a o lù niwọn. Nitori ẹnikẹni ti a fun ni pipọ, lọdọ rẹ̀ li a o gbé bère pipọ: lọdọ ẹniti a ba gbé fi pipọ si, lọdọ rẹ̀ li a o gbé bère si i.
entries.en: But he that knew not, and did commit things worthy of stripes, shall be beaten with few stripes. For unto whomsoever much is given, of him shall be much required: and to whom men have committed much, of him they will ask the more.

entries.yo: Iná li emi wá lati fọ̀n si aiye; kili emi si nfẹ bi a ba ti da a ná?
entries.en: I am come to send fire on the earth; and what will I if it be already kindled?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi ni baptismu kan ti a o fi baptisi mi; ara ti nni mi to titi yio fi pari!
entries.en: But I have a baptism to be baptized with; and how am I straitened till it be accomplished!

entries.yo: Ẹnyin ṣebi alafia li emi wá fi si aiye? mo wi fun nyin, Bẹ̃kọ; ki a sá kuku pe iyapa:
entries.en: Suppose ye that I am come to give peace on earth? I tell you, Nay; but rather division:

entries.yo: Nitori lati isisiyi lọ, enia marun yio wà ni ile kanna ti a o yà ni ipa, mẹta si meji, ati meji si mẹta.
entries.en: For from henceforth there shall be five in one house divided, three against two, and two against three.

entries.yo: A o yà baba ni ipa si ọmọ rẹ̀ ọkunrin, ati ọmọkunrin si baba; iya si ọmọbinrin rẹ̀, ati ọmọbinrin si iya rẹ̀; iyakọ si iyawo rẹ̀, ati iyawo si iyako rẹ̀.
entries.en: The father shall be divided against the son, and the son against the father; the mother against the daughter, and the daughter against the mother; the mother in law against her daughter in law, and the daughter in law against her mother in law.

entries.yo: O si wi fun ijọ enia pẹlu pe, Nigbati ẹnyin ba ri awọsanma ti o ṣú ni ìha ìwọ-õrùn, ọgan ẹnyin a ni, Ọwara òjo mbọ̀; a si ri bẹ̃.
entries.en: And he said also to the people, When ye see a cloud rise out of the west, straightway ye say, There cometh a shower; and so it is.

entries.yo: Nigbati afẹfẹ gusù ba nfẹ, ẹnyin a ni, Õru yio mu; a si ṣẹ.
entries.en: And when ye see the south wind blow, ye say, There will be heat; and it cometh to pass.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin agabagebe, ẹnyin le moye oju ọrun ati ti aiye; ẽhatiṣe ti ẹnyin kò le mọ̀ akokò yi?
entries.en: Ye hypocrites, ye can discern the face of the sky and of the earth; but how is it that ye do not discern this time?

entries.yo: Ẽha si ti ṣe ti ẹnyin tikara nyin ko fi rò ohun ti o tọ́?
entries.en: Yea, and why even of yourselves judge ye not what is right?

entries.yo: Nigbati iwọ ba mbá ọtá rẹ lọ sọdọ olóri, mura li ọ̀na ki a le gbà ọ lọwọ rẹ̀; ki o máṣe fi ọ le onidajọ lọwọ, ki onidajọ máṣe fi ọ le ẹṣọ lọwọ, on a si tì ọ sinu tubu.
