entries.en: When thou goest with thine adversary to the magistrate, as thou art in the way, give diligence that thou mayest be delivered from him; lest he hale thee to the judge, and the judge deliver thee to the officer, and the officer cast thee into prison.

entries.yo: Ki emi ki o wi fun ọ, iwọ ki yio jade kuro nibẹ̀, titi iwọ o fi san õkan ti o ba kù.
entries.en: I tell thee, thou shalt not depart thence, till thou hast paid the very last mite.

entries.yo: AWỌN kan si wà li akokò na ti o sọ ti awọn ara Galili fun u, ẹ̀jẹ ẹniti Pilatu dàpọ mọ ẹbọ wọn.
entries.en: There were present at that season some that told him of the Galilaeans, whose blood Pilate had mingled with their sacrifices.

entries.yo: Jesu si dahùn o wi fun wọn pe, Ẹnyin ṣebi awọn ara Galili wọnyi ṣe ẹlẹṣẹ jù gbogbo awọn ara Galili lọ, nitoriti nwọn jẹ irú ìya bawọnni?
entries.en: And Jesus answering said unto them, Suppose ye that these Galilaeans were sinners above all the Galilaeans, because they suffered such things?

entries.yo: Mo wi fun nyin, Bẹ̃kọ: bikoṣepe ẹnyin ronupiwada, gbogbo nyin ni yio ṣegbé bẹ̃ gẹgẹ.
entries.en: I tell you, Nay: but, except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish.

entries.yo: Tabi awọn mejidilogun, ti ile-iṣọ ni Siloamu wólu, ti o si pa wọn, ẹnyin ṣebi nwọn ṣe ẹlẹṣẹ jù gbogbo awọn enia ti mbẹ̀ ni Jerusalemu lọ?
entries.en: Or those eighteen, upon whom the tower in Siloam fell, and slew them, think ye that they were sinners above all men that dwelt in Jerusalem?

entries.yo: Mo wi fun nyin, Bẹ̃kọ: bikoṣepe ẹnyin ronupiwada, gbogbo nyin ni yio ṣegbé bẹ̃ gẹgẹ.
entries.en: I tell you, Nay: but, except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish.

entries.yo: O si pa owe yi fun wọn pe; ọkunrin kan ni igi ọpọtọ kan ti a gbìn si ọgbà ajara rẹ̀; o si de, o nwá eso lori rẹ̀, kò si ri nkan.
entries.en: He spake also this parable; A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard; and he came and sought fruit thereon, and found none.

entries.yo: O si wi fun oluṣọgba rẹ̀ pe, Sawõ, lati ọdún mẹta li emi ti nwá iwò eso lori igi ọpọtọ yi, emi ko si ri nkan: ké e lulẹ; ẽṣe ti o fi ngbilẹ lasan pẹlu?
entries.en: Then said he unto the dresser of his vineyard, Behold, these three years I come seeking fruit on this fig tree, and find none: cut it down; why cumbereth it the ground?

entries.yo: O si dahùn o wi fun u pe, Oluwa, jọwọ rẹ̀ li ọdún yi pẹlu, titi emi o fi tú ilẹ idi rẹ̀ yiká, titi emi o si fi bu ilẹdu si i:
entries.en: And he answering said unto him, Lord, let it alone this year also, till I shall dig about it, and dung it:

entries.yo: Bi o ba si so eso, gẹgẹ: bi kò ba si so, njẹ lẹhin eyini ki iwọ ki o ke e lulẹ̀.
entries.en: And if it bear fruit, well: and if not, then after that thou shalt cut it down.

entries.yo: O si nkọ́ni ninu sinagogu kan li ọjọ isimi.
entries.en: And he was teaching in one of the synagogues on the sabbath.

entries.yo: Si kiyesi i, obinrin kan wà nibẹ̀ ti o ni ẹmí ailera, lati ọdún mejidilogun wá, ẹniti o tẹ̀ tan, ti ko le gbé ara rẹ̀ soke bi o ti wù ki o ṣe.
entries.en: And, behold, there was a woman which had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years, and was bowed together, and could in no wise lift up herself.

entries.yo: Nigbati Jesu ri i, o pè e si ọdọ, o si wi fun u pe, Obinrin yi, a tú ọ silẹ lọwọ ailera rẹ.
entries.en: And when Jesus saw her, he called her to him, and said unto her, Woman, thou art loosed from thine infirmity.

entries.yo: O si fi ọwọ́ rẹ̀ le e: lojukanna a si ti sọ ọ di titọ, o si nyìn Ọlọrun logo.
entries.en: And he laid his hands on her: and immediately she was made straight, and glorified God.

entries.yo: Olori sinagogu si kun fun irunu, nitoriti Jesu muni larada li ọjọ isimi, o si wi fun ijọ enia pe, Ijọ mẹfa ni mbẹ ti a fi iṣiṣẹ: ninu wọn ni ki ẹnyin ki o wá ki a ṣe dida ara nyin, ki o máṣẹ li ọjọ isimi.
entries.en: And the ruler of the synagogue answered with indignation, because that Jesus had healed on the sabbath day, and said unto the people, There are six days in which men ought to work: in them therefore come and be healed, and not on the sabbath day.

entries.yo: Nigbana li Oluwa dahùn, o si wi fun u pe, Ẹnyin agabagebe, olukuluku nyin ki itú malu tabi kẹtẹkẹtẹ rẹ̀ kuro nibuso, ki si ifà a lọ imu omi li ọjọ isimi?
entries.en: The Lord then answered him, and said, Thou hypocrite, doth not each one of you on the sabbath loose his ox or his ass from the stall, and lead him away to watering?

entries.yo: Kò si yẹ ki a tú obinrin yi ti iṣe ọmọbinrin Abrahamu silẹ ni ìde yi li ọjọ isimi, ẹniti Satani ti dè, sawõ lati ọdún mejidilogun yi wá?
entries.en: And ought not this woman, being a daughter of Abraham, whom Satan hath bound, lo, these eighteen years, be loosed from this bond on the sabbath day?

entries.yo: Nigbati o si wi nkan wọnyi, oju tì gbogbo awọn ọtá rẹ̀: gbogbo ijọ enia si yọ̀ fun ohun ogo gbogbo ti o ṣe lati ọwọ́ rẹ̀ wá.
entries.en: And when he had said these things, all his adversaries were ashamed: and all the people rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him.

entries.yo: O si wipe, Kini ijọba Ọlọrun jọ? kili emi o si fi wé?
entries.en: Then said he, Unto what is the kingdom of God like? and whereunto shall I resemble it?

entries.yo: O dabi wóro irugbin mustardi, ti ọkunrin kan mú, ti o si sọ sinu ọgbà rẹ̀; ti o si hù, o si di igi nla; awọn ẹiyẹ oju ọrun si ngbé ori ẹká rẹ̀.
entries.en: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and cast into his garden; and it grew, and waxed a great tree; and the fowls of the air lodged in the branches of it.

entries.yo: O si tún wipe, Kili emi iba fi ijọba Ọlọrun wé?
entries.en: And again he said, Whereunto shall I liken the kingdom of God?

entries.yo: O dabi iwukara, ti obinrin kan mu, ti o fi sinu oṣuwọn iyẹfun mẹta, titi gbogbo rẹ̀ o fi di wiwu.
entries.en: It is like leaven, which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.

entries.yo: O si nlà arin ilu ati iletò lọ, o nkọ́ni, o si nrìn lọ si iha Jerusalemu.
entries.en: And he went through the cities and villages, teaching, and journeying toward Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Ẹnikan si bi i pe, Oluwa, diẹ ha li awọn ti a o gbalà? O si wi fun wọn pe,
entries.en: Then said one unto him, Lord, are there few that be saved? And he said unto them,

entries.yo: Ẹ làkaka lati wọ̀ oju-ọ̀na tõro: nitori mo wi fun nyin, enia pipọ ni yio wá ọ̀na ati wọ̀ ọ, nwọn kì yio si le wọle.
entries.en: Strive to enter in at the strait gate: for many, I say unto you, will seek to enter in, and shall not be able.

entries.yo: Nigbati bãle ile ba dide lẹkan fũ, ti o ba si ti sé ilẹkun, ẹnyin o si bẹ̀rẹ si iduro lode, ti ẹ o ma kànkun, wipe, Oluwa, Oluwa, ṣí i fun wa; on o si dahùn wi fun nyin pe, Emi kò mọ̀ nyin nibiti ẹnyin gbé ti wá:
entries.en: When once the master of the house is risen up, and hath shut to the door, and ye begin to stand without, and to knock at the door, saying, Lord, Lord, open unto us; and he shall answer and say unto you, I know you not whence ye are:

entries.yo: Nigbana li ẹnyin o bẹ̀rẹ si iwipe, Awa ti jẹ, awa si ti mu niwaju rẹ, iwọ si kọ́ni ni igboro ilu wa.
entries.en: Then shall ye begin to say, We have eaten and drunk in thy presence, and thou hast taught in our streets.

entries.yo: On o si wipe, Emi wi fun nyin, emi kò mọ̀ nyin nibiti ẹnyin gbé ti wá; ẹ lọ kuro lọdọ mi gbogbo ẹnyin ti nṣiṣẹ ẹ̀ṣẹ.
entries.en: But he shall say, I tell you, I know you not whence ye are; depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity.

entries.yo: Ẹkún ati ipahinkeke yio wà nibẹ̀, nigbati ẹnyin o ri Abrahamu, ati Isaaki, ati Jakọbu, ati gbogbo awọn woli, ni ijọba Ọlọrun, ti a o si tì ẹnyin sode.
entries.en: There shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth, when ye shall see Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, and all the prophets, in the kingdom of God, and you yourselves thrust out.

entries.yo: Nwọn o si ti ìla-õrùn, ati ìwọ-õrùn wá, ati lati ariwa, ati gusù wá, nwọn o si joko ni ijọba Ọlọrun.
entries.en: And they shall come from the east, and from the west, and from the north, and from the south, and shall sit down in the kingdom of God.

entries.yo: Si wo o, awọn ẹni-ẹ̀hin mbẹ ti yio di ẹni-iwaju, awọn ẹni-iwaju mbẹ, ti yio di ẹni-ẹ̀hin.
entries.en: And, behold, there are last which shall be first, and there are first which shall be last.

entries.yo: Ni wakati kanna diẹ ninu awọn Farisi tọ̀ ọ wá, nwọn si wi fun u pe, Jade, ki iwọ ki o si lọ kuro nihinyi: nitori Herodu nfẹ pa ọ.
entries.en: The same day there came certain of the Pharisees, saying unto him, Get thee out, and depart hence: for Herod will kill thee.

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ lọ, ki ẹnyin si sọ fun kọ̀lọkọlọ nì pe, Kiyesi i, emi nlé awọn ẹmi èṣu jade, emi nṣe dida ara loni ati lọla, ati ni ijọ kẹta emi o ṣe aṣepe.
entries.en: And he said unto them, Go ye, and tell that fox, Behold, I cast out devils, and I do cures to day and to morrow, and the third day I shall be perfected.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi kò jẹ má rìn loni, ati lọla, ati li ọtunla: kò le jẹ bẹ̃ pe woli ṣegbé lẹhin odi Jerusalemu.
entries.en: Nevertheless I must walk to day, and to morrow, and the day following: for it cannot be that a prophet perish out of Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Jerusalemu, Jerusalemu, iwọ ti o pa awọn woli, ti o si sọ okuta lù awọn ti a rán si ọ pa; nigba melo li emi nfẹ iradọ bò awọn ọmọ rẹ, bi agbebọ̀ ti iradọ bò awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ labẹ́ apá rẹ̀, ṣugbọn ẹnyin kò fẹ!
entries.en: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, which killest the prophets, and stonest them that are sent unto thee; how often would I have gathered thy children together, as a hen doth gather her brood under her wings, and ye would not!

entries.yo: Sawõ, a fi ile nyin silẹ fun nyin li ahoro: lõtọ ni mo si wi fun nyin, Ẹnyin ki yio ri mi, titi yio fi di akoko ti ẹnyin o wipe, Olubukun li ẹniti o mbọ̀ wá li orukọ Oluwa.
entries.en: Behold, your house is left unto you desolate: and verily I say unto you, Ye shall not see me, until the time come when ye shall say, Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati o wọ̀ ile ọkan ninu awọn olori Farisi lọ li ọjọ isimi lati jẹun, nwọn si nṣọ ọ.
entries.en: And it came to pass, as he went into the house of one of the chief Pharisees to eat bread on the sabbath day, that they watched him.

entries.yo: Si kiyesi i, ọkunrin kan ti o li asunkun mbẹ niwaju rẹ̀.
entries.en: And, behold, there was a certain man before him which had the dropsy.

entries.yo: Jesu si dahùn o wi fun awọn amofin ati awọn Farisi pe, O ha tọ́ lati mu-ni larada li ọjọ isimi, tabi kò tọ?
entries.en: And Jesus answering spake unto the lawyers and Pharisees, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath day?

entries.yo: Nwọn si dakẹ. O si mu u, o mu u larada, o si jọwọ rẹ̀ lọwọ lọ;
entries.en: And they held their peace. And he took him, and healed him, and let him go;

entries.yo: O si dahùn o wi fun wọn pe, Tani ninu nyin ti kẹtẹkẹtẹ tabi malu rẹ̀ yio bọ sinu ihò, ti kì yio si fà a soke lojukanna li ọjọ isimi?
entries.en: And answered them, saying, Which of you shall have an ass or an ox fallen into a pit, and will not straightway pull him out on the sabbath day?

entries.yo: Nwọn kò si le da a li ohùn mọ́ si nkan wọnyi.
entries.en: And they could not answer him again to these things.

entries.yo: O si pa owe kan fun awọn ti a pè wá jẹun, nigbati o wò bi nwọn ti nyàn ipò ọlá; o si wi fun wọn pe,
entries.en: And he put forth a parable to those which were bidden, when he marked how they chose out the chief rooms; saying unto them,

entries.yo: Nigbati ẹnikan ba pè ọ wá si ibi iyawo, máṣe joko ni ipò ọlá; ki o ma ba jẹ pe, a pè ẹniti o li ọlá jù ọ lọ.
entries.en: When thou art bidden of any man to a wedding, sit not down in the highest room; lest a more honourable man than thou be bidden of him;

entries.yo: Nigbati ẹniti o pè ọ ati on ba de, a si wi fun ọ pe, Fun ọkunrin yi li àye; iwọ a si wa fi itiju mu ipò ẹhin.
entries.en: And he that bade thee and him come and say to thee, Give this man place; and thou begin with shame to take the lowest room.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati a ba pè ọ, lọ ki o si joko ni ipò ẹhin; nigbati ẹniti o pè ọ ba de, ki o le wi fun ọ pe, Ọrẹ́, bọ́ soke: nigbana ni iwọ o ni iyin li oju awọn ti o ba ọ joko ti onjẹ.
entries.en: But when thou art bidden, go and sit down in the lowest room; that when he that bade thee cometh, he may say unto thee, Friend, go up higher: then shalt thou have worship in the presence of them that sit at meat with thee.

entries.yo: Nitori ẹnikẹni ti o ba gbé ara rẹ̀ ga, li a o rẹ̀ silẹ; ẹnikẹni ti o ba si rẹ̀ ara rẹ̀ silẹ, li a o si gbéga.
entries.en: For whosoever exalteth himself shall be abased; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.

entries.yo: Nigbana li o si wi fun alase ti o pè e pe, Nigbati iwọ ba se àse ọsán, tabi àse alẹ, má pè awọn ọrẹ́ rẹ, tabi awọn arakunrin rẹ, tabi awọn ibatan rẹ, tabi awọn aladugbo rẹ ọlọrọ̀; nitori ki nwọn ki o má ṣe pè ọ ẹ̀wẹ lati san ẹsan fun ọ.
entries.en: Then said he also to him that bade him, When thou makest a dinner or a supper, call not thy friends, nor thy brethren, neither thy kinsmen, nor thy rich neighbours; lest they also bid thee again, and a recompence be made thee.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati iwọ ba se àse, pè awọn talakà, awọn alabùkù arùn, awọn amukun, ati awọn afọju:
entries.en: But when thou makest a feast, call the poor, the maimed, the lame, the blind:

entries.yo: Iwọ o si jẹ alabukun fun; nitori nwọn kò ni ohun ti nwọn o fi san a fun ọ: ṣugbọn a o san a fun ọ li ajinde awọn olõtọ.
entries.en: And thou shalt be blessed; for they cannot recompense thee: for thou shalt be recompensed at the resurrection of the just.

entries.yo: Nigbati ọkan ninu awọn ti o ba a joko tì onjẹ gbọ́ nkan wọnyi, o wi fun u pe, Ibukun ni fun ẹniti yio jẹun ni ijọba Ọlọrun.
entries.en: And when one of them that sat at meat with him heard these things, he said unto him, Blessed is he that shall eat bread in the kingdom of God.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn o wi fun u pe, ọkunrin kan se àse-alẹ nla, o si pè enia pipọ:
entries.en: Then said he unto him, A certain man made a great supper, and bade many:

entries.yo: O si rán ọmọ-odọ rẹ̀ ni wakati àse-alẹ lati sọ fun awọn ti a ti pè wipe, Ẹ wá; nitori ohun gbogbo ṣe tan.
entries.en: And sent his servant at supper time to say to them that were bidden, Come; for all things are now ready.

entries.yo: Gbogbo wọn so bẹ̀rẹ, li ohùn kan lati ṣe awawi. Ekini wi fun u pe, Mo rà ilẹ kan, emi kò si le ṣe ki ng má lọ iwò o: mo bẹ̀ ọ ṣe gafara fun mi.
entries.en: And they all with one consent began to make excuse. The first said unto him, I have bought a piece of ground, and I must needs go and see it: I pray thee have me excused.

entries.yo: Ekeji si wipe, Mo rà ajaga malu marun, mo si nlọ idán wọn wò: mo bẹ̀ ọ ṣe gafara fun mi.
entries.en: And another said, I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I go to prove them: I pray thee have me excused.

entries.yo: Ẹkẹta si wipe, Mo gbeyawo, nitorina li emi kò fi le wá.
entries.en: And another said, I have married a wife, and therefore I cannot come.

entries.yo: Ọmọ-ọdọ na si pada de, o sọ nkan wọnyi fun oluwa rẹ̀. Nigbana ni bãle ile binu, o wi fun ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ̀ pe, Jade lọ si igboro, ati si abuja ọ̀na, ki o si mu awọn talakà, ati awọn alabùkù arùn, ati awọn amukun, ati awọn afọju wá si ihinyi.
entries.en: So that servant came, and shewed his lord these things. Then the master of the house being angry said to his servant, Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in hither the poor, and the maimed, and the halt, and the blind.

entries.yo: Ọmọ-ọdọ na si wipe, Oluwa, a ti ṣe bi o ti paṣẹ, àye si mbẹ sibẹ.
entries.en: And the servant said, Lord, it is done as thou hast commanded, and yet there is room.

entries.yo: Oluwa na si wi fun ọmọ-ọdọ na pe, Jade lọ si opópo, ati si ọ̀na ọgbà, ki o si rọ̀ wọn lati wọle wá, ki ile mi le kún.
entries.en: And the lord said unto the servant, Go out into the highways and hedges, and compel them to come in, that my house may be filled.

entries.yo: Nitori mo wi fun nyin, Ẹnikẹni ninu awọn enia wọnyi ti a ti pè, ki yio tọwò ninu àse-alẹ mi.
entries.en: For I say unto you, That none of those men which were bidden shall taste of my supper.

entries.yo: Awọn ọpọ ijọ enia mba a lọ: o si yipada, o si wi fun wọn pe,
entries.en: And there went great multitudes with him: and he turned, and said unto them,

entries.yo: Bi ẹnikan ba tọ̀ mi wá, ti ko si korira baba rẹ̀, ati iya, ati aya, ati ọmọ, ati arakunrin, ati arabinrin, ani ati ẹmí ara rẹ̀ pẹlu, kò le ṣe ọmọ-ẹhin mi.
entries.en: If any man come to me, and hate not his father, and mother, and wife, and children, and brethren, and sisters, yea, and his own life also, he cannot be my disciple.

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni ti kò ba rù agbelebu rẹ̀, ki o si ma tọ̀ mi lẹhin, kò le ṣe ọmọ-ẹhin mi.
entries.en: And whosoever doth not bear his cross, and come after me, cannot be my disciple.

entries.yo: Nitori tani ninu nyin ti npete ati kọ́ ile-iṣọ, ti kì yio kọ́ joko ki o ṣiro iye owo rẹ̀, bi on ni to ti yio fi pari rẹ̀.
entries.en: For which of you, intending to build a tower, sitteth not down first, and counteth the cost, whether he have sufficient to finish it?

entries.yo: Ki o ma ba jẹ pe nigbati o ba fi ipilẹ ile sọlẹ tan, ti kò le pari rẹ̀ mọ́, gbogbo awọn ti o ri i a bẹ̀rẹ si ifi i ṣe ẹlẹyà,
entries.en: Lest haply, after he hath laid the foundation, and is not able to finish it, all that behold it begin to mock him,

entries.yo: Wipe, ọkunrin yi bẹ̀rẹ si ile ikọ́, kò si le pari rẹ̀.
entries.en: Saying, This man began to build, and was not able to finish.

entries.yo: Tabi ọba wo ni nlọ ibá ọba miran jà, ti kì yio kọ́ joko, ki o si gbèro bi yio le fi ẹgbarun padegun ẹniti nmu ẹgbawa bọ̀ wá kò on loju?
entries.en: Or what king, going to make war against another king, sitteth not down first, and consulteth whether he be able with ten thousand to meet him that cometh against him with twenty thousand?

entries.yo: Bi bẹ̃kọ nigbati onitọhun si wà li òkere, on a ran ikọ si i, a si bere ipinhùn alafia.
entries.en: Or else, while the other is yet a great way off, he sendeth an ambassage, and desireth conditions of peace.

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bẹ̃ni, ẹnikẹni ti o wù ki o ṣe ninu nyin, ti kò ba kò ohun gbogbo ti o ni silẹ, kọ̀ le ṣe ọmọ-ẹhin mi.
entries.en: So likewise, whosoever he be of you that forsaketh not all that he hath, he cannot be my disciple.

entries.yo: Iyọ̀ dara: ṣugbọn bi iyọ̀ ba di obu, kili a o fi mu u dùn?
entries.en: Salt is good: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be seasoned?

entries.yo: Kò yẹ fun ilẹ, bẽni kò yẹ fun àtan; bikoṣepe ki a kó o danù. Ẹniti o ba li etí lati fi gbọ́ ki o gbọ́.
entries.en: It is neither fit for the land, nor yet for the dunghill; but men cast it out. He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.

entries.yo: GBOGBO awọn agbowode ati awọn ẹlẹṣẹ si sunmọ ọ lati gbọ́ ọ̀rọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Then drew near unto him all the publicans and sinners for to hear him.

entries.yo: Ati awọn Farisi ati awọn akọwe nkùn, wipe, ọkunrin yi ngbà ẹlẹṣẹ, o si mba wọn jẹun.
entries.en: And the Pharisees and scribes murmured, saying, This man receiveth sinners, and eateth with them.

entries.yo: O si pa owe yi fun wọn, wipe.
entries.en: And he spake this parable unto them, saying,

entries.yo: Ọkunrin wo ni ninu nyin, ti o ni ọgọrun agutan, bi o ba sọ ọ̀kan nù ninu wọn, ti kì yio fi mọkandilọgọrun iyokù silẹ ni iju, ti kì yio si tọsẹ eyi ti o nù lọ, titi yio fi ri i?
entries.en: What man of you, having an hundred sheep, if he lose one of them, doth not leave the ninety and nine in the wilderness, and go after that which is lost, until he find it?

entries.yo: Nigbati o si ri i tan, o gbé e le ejika rẹ̀, o nyọ.
entries.en: And when he hath found it, he layeth it on his shoulders, rejoicing.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si de ile, o pè awọn ọrẹ́ ati aladugbo rẹ̀ jọ, o nwi fun wọn pe, Ẹ ba mi yọ̀; nitoriti mo ri agutan mi ti o ti nù.
entries.en: And when he cometh home, he calleth together his friends and neighbours, saying unto them, Rejoice with me; for I have found my sheep which was lost.

entries.yo: Mo wi fun nyin, gẹgẹ bẹ̃li ayọ̀ yio wà li ọrun lori ẹlẹṣẹ kan ti o ronupiwada, jù lori olõtọ mọkandilọgọrun lọ, ti kò ṣe aini ironupiwada.
entries.en: I say unto you, that likewise joy shall be in heaven over one sinner that repenteth, more than over ninety and nine just persons, which need no repentance.

entries.yo: Tabi obinrin wo li o ni fadaka mẹwa bi o ba sọ ọkan nù, ti kì yio tàn fitilà, ki o si gbá ile, ki o si wá a gidigidi titi yio fi ri i?
entries.en: Either what woman having ten pieces of silver, if she lose one piece, doth not light a candle, and sweep the house, and seek diligently till she find it?

entries.yo: Nigbati o si ri i, o pè awọn ọrẹ́ ati awọn aladugbo rẹ̀ jọ, o wipe, Ẹ ba mi yọ̀; nitori mo ri fadakà ti mo ti sọnù.
entries.en: And when she hath found it, she calleth her friends and her neighbours together, saying, Rejoice with me; for I have found the piece which I had lost.

entries.yo: Mo wi fun nyin, gẹgẹ bẹ̃li ayọ̀ mbẹ niwaju awọn angẹli Ọlọrun lori ẹlẹṣẹ kan ti o ronupiwada.
entries.en: Likewise, I say unto you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner that repenteth.

entries.yo: O si wipe, ọkunrin kan li ọmọkunrin meji:
entries.en: And he said, A certain man had two sons:

entries.yo: Eyi aburo ninu wọn wi fun baba rẹ̀ pe, Baba, fun mi ni ini rẹ ti o kàn mi. O si pín ohun ìni rẹ̀ fun wọn.
entries.en: And the younger of them said to his father, Father, give me the portion of goods that falleth to me. And he divided unto them his living.

entries.yo: Kò si to ijọ melokan lẹhinna, eyi aburo kó ohun gbogbo ti o ni jọ, o si mu ọ̀na àjo rẹ̀ pọ̀n lọ si ilẹ òkere, nibẹ̀ li o si gbé fi ìwa wọ̀bia na ohun ini rẹ̀ ni inákuna.
entries.en: And not many days after the younger son gathered all together, and took his journey into a far country, and there wasted his substance with riotous living.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si bà gbogbo rẹ̀ jẹ tan, ìyan nla wá imu ni ilẹ na; o si bẹ̀rẹ si idi alaini.
entries.en: And when he had spent all, there arose a mighty famine in that land; and he began to be in want.

entries.yo: O si lọ, o da ara rẹ̀ pọ̀ mọ́ ọlọ̀tọ kan ni ilẹ na; on si rán a lọ si oko rẹ̀ lati tọju ẹlẹdẹ.
entries.en: And he went and joined himself to a citizen of that country; and he sent him into his fields to feed swine.

entries.yo: Ayọ̀ ni iba fi jẹ onjẹ ti awọn ẹlẹdẹ njẹ li ajẹyó: ẹnikẹni kò si fifun u.
entries.en: And he would fain have filled his belly with the husks that the swine did eat: and no man gave unto him.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati oju rẹ̀ walẹ, o ni, Awọn alagbaṣe baba mi melomelo li o ni onjẹ ajẹyó, ati ajẹtì, emi si nkú fun ebi nihin.
entries.en: And when he came to himself, he said, How many hired servants of my father's have bread enough and to spare, and I perish with hunger!

entries.yo: Emi o dide, emi o si tọ̀ baba mi lọ, emi o si wi fun u pe, Baba, emi ti dẹṣẹ si ọrun, ati niwaju rẹ;
entries.en: I will arise and go to my father, and will say unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and before thee,

entries.yo: Emi kò si yẹ, li ẹniti a ba ma pè li ọmọ rẹ mọ́; fi mi ṣe bi ọkan ninu awọn alagbaṣe rẹ.
entries.en: And am no more worthy to be called thy son: make me as one of thy hired servants.

entries.yo: O si dide, o si tọ̀ baba rẹ̀ lọ. Ṣugbọn nigbati o si wà li òkere, baba rẹ̀ ri i, ãnu ṣe e, o si sure, o rọ̀mọ́ ọ li ọrùn, o si fi ẹnu kò o li ẹnu.
entries.en: And he arose, and came to his father. But when he was yet a great way off, his father saw him, and had compassion, and ran, and fell on his neck, and kissed him.

entries.yo: Ọmọ na si wi fun u pe, Baba, emi ti dẹṣẹ si ọrun, ati niwaju rẹ, emi kò yẹ li ẹniti a ba ma pè li ọmọ rẹ mọ́.
entries.en: And the son said unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and in thy sight, and am no more worthy to be called thy son.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn baba na wi fun awọn ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ̀ pe, Ẹ mu ãyo aṣọ wá kánkán, ki ẹ si fi wọ̀ ọ; ẹ si fi oruka bọ̀ ọ lọwọ, ati bàta si ẹsẹ rẹ̀:
entries.en: But the father said to his servants, Bring forth the best robe, and put it on him; and put a ring on his hand, and shoes on his feet:

entries.yo: Ẹ si mu ẹgbọ̀rọ malu abọpa wá, ki ẹ si pa a; ki a mã jẹ, ki a si mã ṣe ariya:
entries.en: And bring hither the fatted calf, and kill it; and let us eat, and be merry:

entries.yo: Nitori ọmọ mi yi ti kú, o si tún yè; o ti nù, a si ri i. Nwọn si bẹ̀re si iṣe ariya.
entries.en: For this my son was dead, and is alive again; he was lost, and is found. And they began to be merry.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ọmọ rẹ̀ eyi ẹgbọn ti wà li oko: bi o si ti mbọ̀, ti o sunmọ eti ile, o gbọ́ orin on ijó.
entries.en: Now his elder son was in the field: and as he came and drew nigh to the house, he heard musick and dancing.

entries.yo: O si pè ọkan ninu awọn ọmọ-ọdọ wọn, o bère, kili ã mọ̀ nkan wọnyi si?
entries.en: And he called one of the servants, and asked what these things meant.

entries.yo: O si wi fun u pe, Aburo rẹ de; baba rẹ si pa ẹgbọ̀rọ malu abọpa, nitoriti o ri i pada li alafia ati ni ilera.
entries.en: And he said unto him, Thy brother is come; and thy father hath killed the fatted calf, because he hath received him safe and sound.

entries.yo: O si binu, o si kọ̀ lati wọle; baba rẹ̀ si jade, o si wá iṣipẹ fun u.
entries.en: And he was angry, and would not go in: therefore came his father out, and intreated him.

entries.yo: O si dahùn o wi fun baba rẹ̀ pe, Wo o, lati ọdún melo wọnyi li emi ti nsin ọ, emi kò si ru ofin rẹ ri: iwọ kò si ti ifi ọmọ ewurẹ kan fun mi, lati fi ba awọn ọrẹ́ mi ṣe ariya:
entries.en: And he answering said to his father, Lo, these many years do I serve thee, neither transgressed I at any time thy commandment: and yet thou never gavest me a kid, that I might make merry with my friends:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati ọmọ rẹ yi de, ẹniti o fi panṣaga run ọrọ̀ rẹ, iwọ si ti pa ẹgbọ̀rọ malu abọpa fun u.
entries.en: But as soon as this thy son was come, which hath devoured thy living with harlots, thou hast killed for him the fatted calf.

entries.yo: O si wi fun u pe, Ọmọ, nigbagbogbo ni iwọ mbẹ lọdọ mi, ohun gbogbo ti mo si ni, tìrẹ ni.
entries.en: And he said unto him, Son, thou art ever with me, and all that I have is thine.

entries.yo: O yẹ ki a ṣe ariya ki a si yọ̀: nitori aburo rẹ yi ti kú, o si tún yè; o ti nù, a si ri i.
entries.en: It was meet that we should make merry, and be glad: for this thy brother was dead, and is alive again; and was lost, and is found.

entries.yo: O si wi fun awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ pẹlu pe, ọkunrin ọlọrọ̀ kan wà, ti o ni iriju kan; on na ni nwọn fi sùn u pe, o ti nfi ohun-ini rẹ̀ ṣòfo.
entries.en: And he said also unto his disciples, There was a certain rich man, which had a steward; and the same was accused unto him that he had wasted his goods.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si pè e, o wi fun u pe, Ẽṣe ti emi fi ngbọ́ eyi si ọ? siro iṣẹ iriju rẹ; nitori iwọ ko le ṣe iriju mọ́.
entries.en: And he called him, and said unto him, How is it that I hear this of thee? give an account of thy stewardship; for thou mayest be no longer steward.

entries.yo: Iriju na si wi ninu ara rẹ̀ pe, Ewo li emi o ṣe? nitoriti Oluwa mi gbà iṣẹ iriju lọwọ mi: emi kò le wàlẹ; lati ṣagbe oju ntì mi.
entries.en: Then the steward said within himself, What shall I do? for my lord taketh away from me the stewardship: I cannot dig; to beg I am ashamed.

entries.yo: Mo mọ̀ eyiti emi o ṣe, nigbati a ba mu mi kuro nibi iṣẹ iriju, ki nwọn ki o le gbà mi sinu ile wọn.
entries.en: I am resolved what to do, that, when I am put out of the stewardship, they may receive me into their houses.

entries.yo: O si pè awọn ajigbese oluwa rẹ̀ sọdọ rẹ̀, o si wi fun ekini pe, Elo ni iwọ jẹ oluwa mi?
entries.en: So he called every one of his lord's debtors unto him, and said unto the first, How much owest thou unto my lord?

entries.yo: O si wipe, Ọgọrun oṣuwọn oróro. O si wi fun u pe, Mu iwe rẹ, si joko nisisiyi, ki o si kọ adọta.
entries.en: And he said, An hundred measures of oil. And he said unto him, Take thy bill, and sit down quickly, and write fifty.

entries.yo: Nigbana li o si bi ẹnikeji pe, Elo ni iwọ jẹ? On si wipe, Ọgọrun oṣuwọn alikama. O si wi fun u pe, Mu iwe rẹ, ki o si kọ ọgọrin.
entries.en: Then said he to another, And how much owest thou? And he said, An hundred measures of wheat. And he said unto him, Take thy bill, and write fourscore.

entries.yo: Oluwa rẹ̀ si yìn alaiṣõtọ iriju na, nitoriti o fi ọgbọ́n ṣe e: awọn ọmọ aiye yi sá gbọ́n ni iran wọn jù awọn ọmọ imọlẹ lọ.
entries.en: And the lord commended the unjust steward, because he had done wisely: for the children of this world are in their generation wiser than the children of light.

entries.yo: Emi si wi fun nyin, ẹ fi mammoni aiṣõtọ yàn ọrẹ́ fun ara nyin pe, nigbati yio ba yẹ̀, ki nwọn ki o le gbà nyin si ibujoko wọn titi aiye.
entries.en: And I say unto you, Make to yourselves friends of the mammon of unrighteousness; that, when ye fail, they may receive you into everlasting habitations.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba ṣe olõtọ li ohun kikini, o ṣe olõtọ ni pipọ pẹlu: ẹniti o ba si ṣe alaiṣõtọ li ohun kikini, o ṣe alaiṣõtọ li ohun pipo pẹlu.
entries.en: He that is faithful in that which is least is faithful also in much: and he that is unjust in the least is unjust also in much.

entries.yo: Njẹ bi ẹnyin kò ba ti jẹ olõtọ ni mammoni aiṣõtọ, tani yio fi ọrọ̀ tõtọ ṣú nyin?
entries.en: If therefore ye have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will commit to your trust the true riches?

entries.yo: Bi ẹnyin ko ba si ti jẹ olõtọ li ohun ti iṣe ti ẹlomiran, tani yio fun nyin li ohun ti iṣe ti ẹnyin tikara nyin?
entries.en: And if ye have not been faithful in that which is another man's, who shall give you that which is your own?

entries.yo: Kò si iranṣẹ kan ti o le sin oluwa meji: ayaṣebi yio korira ọkan, yio si fẹ ekeji; tabi yio fi ara mọ́ ọkan, yio si yàn ekeji ni ipọsi. Ẹnyin kò le sin Ọlọrun pẹlu mammoni.
entries.en: No servant can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and mammon.

entries.yo: Awọn Farisi, ti nwọn ni ojukokoro si gbọ́ gbogbo nkan wọnyi, nwọn si yọ-ṣùti si i.
entries.en: And the Pharisees also, who were covetous, heard all these things: and they derided him.

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹnyin li awọn ti ndare fun ara nyin niwaju enia; ṣugbọn Ọlọrun mọ̀ ọkàn nyin: nitori eyi ti a gbé niyin lọdọ enia, irira ni niwaju Ọlọrun.
entries.en: And he said unto them, Ye are they which justify yourselves before men; but God knoweth your hearts: for that which is highly esteemed among men is abomination in the sight of God.

entries.yo: Ofin ati awọn woli mbẹ titi di igba Johanu: lati igbana wá li a ti nwasu ijọba Ọlọrun, olukuluku si nfi ipá wọ̀ inu rẹ̀.
entries.en: The law and the prophets were until John: since that time the kingdom of God is preached, and every man presseth into it.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn o rọrun fun ọrun on aiye lati kọja lọ, jù ki ṣonṣo kan ti ofin ki o yẹ̀.
entries.en: And it is easier for heaven and earth to pass, than one tittle of the law to fail.

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni ti o ba kọ̀ aya rẹ̀ silẹ, ti o si gbé omiran ni iyawo, o ṣe panṣaga: ẹnikẹni ti o ba si gbé, ẹniti ọkọ rẹ̀ kọ̀ silẹ ni iyawo, o ṣe panṣaga.
entries.en: Whosoever putteth away his wife, and marrieth another, committeth adultery: and whosoever marrieth her that is put away from her husband committeth adultery.

entries.yo: Njẹ ọkunrin ọlọrọ̀ kan wà, ti o nwọ̀ aṣọ elesè àluko ati aṣọ àla daradara, a si ma jẹ didùndidun lojojumọ́:
entries.en: There was a certain rich man, which was clothed in purple and fine linen, and fared sumptuously every day:

entries.yo: Alagbe kan si wà ti a npè ni Lasaru, ti nwọn ima gbé wá kalẹ lẹba ọ̀na ile rẹ̀, o kún fun õju,
entries.en: And there was a certain beggar named Lazarus, which was laid at his gate, full of sores,

entries.yo: On a si ma fẹ ki a fi ẹrún ti o ti ori tabili ọlọrọ̀ bọ silẹ bọ́ on: awọn ajá si wá, nwọn si fá a li õju lá.
entries.en: And desiring to be fed with the crumbs which fell from the rich man's table: moreover the dogs came and licked his sores.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, alagbe kú, a si ti ọwọ́ awọn angẹli gbé e lọ si õkan-àiya Abrahamu: ọlọrọ̀ na si kú pẹlu, a si sin i;
entries.en: And it came to pass, that the beggar died, and was carried by the angels into Abraham's bosom: the rich man also died, and was buried;

entries.yo: Ni ipo-oku li o gbé oju rẹ̀ soke, o mbẹ ninu iṣẹ oró, o si ri Abrahamu li òkere, ati Lasaru li õkan-àiya rẹ̀.
entries.en: And in hell he lift up his eyes, being in torments, and seeth Abraham afar off, and Lazarus in his bosom.

entries.yo: O si ke, o wipe, Baba Abrahamu, ṣãnu fun mi, ki o si rán Lasaru, ki o tẹ̀ orika rẹ̀ bọmi, ki o si fi tù mi li ahọn; nitori emi njoró ninu ọwọ́ iná yi.
entries.en: And he cried and said, Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus, that he may dip the tip of his finger in water, and cool my tongue; for I am tormented in this flame.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Abrahamu wipe, Ọmọ, ranti pe, nigba aiye rẹ, iwọ ti gbà ohun rere tirẹ, ati Lasaru ohun buburu: ṣugbọn nisisiyi ara rọ̀ ọ, iwọ si njoro.
entries.en: But Abraham said, Son, remember that thou in thy lifetime receivedst thy good things, and likewise Lazarus evil things: but now he is comforted, and thou art tormented.

entries.yo: Ati pẹlu gbogbo eyi, a gbe ọgbun nla kan si agbedemeji awa ati ẹnyin, ki awọn ti nfẹ má ba le rekọja lati ìhin lọ sọdọ nyin, ki ẹnikẹni má si le ti ọ̀hun rekọja tọ̀ wa wá.
entries.en: And beside all this, between us and you there is a great gulf fixed: so that they which would pass from hence to you cannot; neither can they pass to us, that would come from thence.

entries.yo: O si wipe, Njẹ mo bẹ̀ ọ, baba, ki iwọ ki o rán a lọ si ile baba mi:
entries.en: Then he said, I pray thee therefore, father, that thou wouldest send him to my father's house:

entries.yo: Nitori mo ni arakunrin marun; ki o le rò fun wọn ki awọn ki o má ba wá si ibi oró yi pẹlu.
entries.en: For I have five brethren; that he may testify unto them, lest they also come into this place of torment.

entries.yo: Abrahamu si wi fun u pe, Nwọn ni Mose ati awọn woli; ki nwọn ki o gbọ́ ti wọn.
entries.en: Abraham saith unto him, They have Moses and the prophets; let them hear them.

entries.yo: O si wipe, Bẹ̃kọ, Abrahamu baba; ṣugbọn bi ẹnikan ba ti inu okú tọ̀ wọn lọ, nwọn ó ronupiwada.
entries.en: And he said, Nay, father Abraham: but if one went unto them from the dead, they will repent.

entries.yo: O si wi fun u pe, Bi nwọn kò ba gbọ́ ti Mose ati ti awọn woli, a kì yio yi wọn li ọkan pada bi ẹnikan tilẹ ti inu okú dide.
entries.en: And he said unto him, If they hear not Moses and the prophets, neither will they be persuaded, though one rose from the dead.

entries.yo: O SI wi fun awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ pe, Ko le ṣe ki ohun ikọsẹ̀ má de: ṣugbọn egbé ni fun ẹniti o ti ipasẹ rẹ̀ de.
entries.en: Then said he unto the disciples, It is impossible but that offences will come: but woe unto him, through whom they come!

entries.yo: Iba san fun u ki a so ọlọ nla mọ́ ọ li ọrùn, ki a si gbé e jù sinu okun, ju ki o mu ọkan ninu awọn kekere wọnyi kọsẹ̀.
entries.en: It were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and he cast into the sea, than that he should offend one of these little ones.

entries.yo: Ẹ mã kiyesara nyin: bi arakunrin rẹ ba ṣẹ̀, ba a wi; bi o ba si ronupiwada, dari jì i.
entries.en: Take heed to yourselves: If thy brother trespass against thee, rebuke him; and if he repent, forgive him.

entries.yo: Bi o ba si ṣẹ̀ ọ li ẹrinmeje li õjọ, ti o si pada tọ̀ ọ wá li ẹrinmeje li õjọ pe, Mo ronupiwada; dari jì i.
entries.en: And if he trespass against thee seven times in a day, and seven times in a day turn again to thee, saying, I repent; thou shalt forgive him.

entries.yo: Awọn aposteli si wi fun Oluwa pe, Busi igbagbọ́ wa.
entries.en: And the apostles said unto the Lord, Increase our faith.

entries.yo: Oluwa si wipe, Bi ẹnyin ba ni igbagbọ́ bi wóro irugbin mustardi, ẹnyin o le wi fun igi sikamine yi pe, Ki a fà ọ tú, ki a si gbìn ọ sinu okun; yio si gbọ́ ti nyin.
entries.en: And the Lord said, If ye had faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye might say unto this sycamine tree, Be thou plucked up by the root, and be thou planted in the sea; and it should obey you.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn tani ninu nyin, ti o li ọmọ-ọdọ, ti o ntulẹ, tabi ti o mbọ́ ẹran, ti yio wi fun u lojukanna ti o ba ti oko de pe, Lọ ijoko lati jẹun?
entries.en: But which of you, having a servant plowing or feeding cattle, will say unto him by and by, when he is come from the field, Go and sit down to meat?

entries.yo: Ti kì yio kuku wi fun u pe, Pèse ohun ti emi o jẹ, si di amure, ki iwọ ki o mã ṣe iranṣẹ fun mi, titi emi o fi jẹ ti emi o si mu tan; lẹhinna ni iwọ o si jẹ, ti iwọ o si mu?
entries.en: And will not rather say unto him, Make ready wherewith I may sup, and gird thyself, and serve me, till I have eaten and drunken; and afterward thou shalt eat and drink?

entries.yo: On o ha ma dupẹ lọwọ ọmọ-ọdọ na, nitoriti o ṣe ohun ti a palaṣẹ fun u bi? emi kò rò bẹ̃.
entries.en: Doth he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded him? I trow not.

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bẹ̃li ẹnyin pẹlu, nigbati ẹ ba ti ṣe ohun gbogbo ti a palaṣẹ fun nyin tan, ẹ wipe, Alailere ọmọ-ọdọ ni wa: eyi ti iṣe iṣẹ wa lati ṣe, li awa ti ṣe.
entries.en: So likewise ye, when ye shall have done all those things which are commanded you, say, We are unprofitable servants: we have done that which was our duty to do.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, bi o ti nlọ si Jerusalemu, o kọja larin Samaria on Galili.
entries.en: And it came to pass, as he went to Jerusalem, that he passed through the midst of Samaria and Galilee.

entries.yo: Bi o si ti nwọ̀ inu iletò kan lọ, awọn ọkunrin adẹtẹ̀ mẹwa pade rẹ̀, nwọn duro li òkere:
entries.en: And as he entered into a certain village, there met him ten men that were lepers, which stood afar off:

entries.yo: Nwọn si nahùn soke, wipe, Jesu, Olukọni ṣãnu fun wa.
entries.en: And they lifted up their voices, and said, Jesus, Master, have mercy on us.

entries.yo: Nigbati o ri wọn, o wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ lọ ifi ara nyin hàn fun awọn alufa. O si ṣe, bi nwọn ti nlọ, nwọn si di mimọ́.
entries.en: And when he saw them, he said unto them, Go shew yourselves unto the priests. And it came to pass, that, as they went, they were cleansed.

entries.yo: Nigbati ọkan ninu wọn ri pe a mu on larada o pada, o si fi ohùn rara yin Ọlọrun logo.
entries.en: And one of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, and with a loud voice glorified God,

entries.yo: O si wolẹ lẹba ẹsẹ rẹ̀, o ndupẹ li ọwọ rẹ̀: ara Samaria ni on si iṣe.
entries.en: And fell down on his face at his feet, giving him thanks: and he was a Samaritan.

entries.yo: Jesu si dahùn wipe, Awọn mẹwa ki a ṣo di mimọ́? Awọn mẹsan iyokù ha dà?
entries.en: And Jesus answering said, Were there not ten cleansed? but where are the nine?

entries.yo: A ko ri ẹnikan ti o pada wá fi ogo fun Ọlọrun, bikọse alejò yi?
entries.en: There are not found that returned to give glory to God, save this stranger.

entries.yo: O si wi fun u pe, Dide, ki o si mã lọ: igbagbọ́ rẹ mu ọ larada.
entries.en: And he said unto him, Arise, go thy way: thy faith hath made thee whole.

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn Farisi bi i pe, nigbawo ni ijọba Ọlọrun yio de, o da wọn li ohùn pe, Ijọba Ọlọrun ki iwá pẹlu àmi:
entries.en: And when he was demanded of the Pharisees, when the kingdom of God should come, he answered them and said, The kingdom of God cometh not with observation:

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni nwọn kì yio wipe, Kiyesi i nihin! tabi kiyesi i lọhun! sawõ, ijọba Ọlọrun mbẹ ninu nyin.
entries.en: Neither shall they say, Lo here! or, lo there! for, behold, the kingdom of God is within you.

entries.yo: O si wi fun awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ pe, Ọjọ mbọ̀, nigbati ẹnyin o fẹ lati ri ọkan ninu ọjọ Ọmọ-enia, ẹnyin kì yio si ri i.
entries.en: And he said unto the disciples, The days will come, when ye shall desire to see one of the days of the Son of man, and ye shall not see it.

entries.yo: Nwọn o si wi fun nyin pe, Wo o nihin; tabi wo o lọhun: ẹ má lọ, ẹ máṣe tẹle wọn.
entries.en: And they shall say to you, See here; or, see there: go not after them, nor follow them.

entries.yo: Nitori gẹgẹ bi manamana ti ikọ li apakan labẹ ọrun, ti isi mọlẹ li apa keji labẹ ọrun: bẹ̃li Ọmọ-enia yio si ri li ọjọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: For as the lightning, that lighteneth out of the one part under heaven, shineth unto the other part under heaven; so shall also the Son of man be in his day.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn kò le ṣaima kọ́ jìya ohun pipo, ki a si kọ̀ ọ lọdọ iran yi.
entries.en: But first must he suffer many things, and be rejected of this generation.

entries.yo: Bi o si ti ri li ọjọ Noa, bẹ̃ni yio ri li ọjọ Ọmọ-enia.
entries.en: And as it was in the days of Noe, so shall it be also in the days of the Son of man.

entries.yo: Nwọn njẹ, nwọn nmu, nwọn ngbeyawo, nwọn si nfà iyawo fun ni, titi o fi di ọjọ ti Noa wọ̀ inu ọkọ̀ lọ, kíkun omi si de, o si run gbogbo wọn.
entries.en: They did eat, they drank, they married wives, they were given in marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark, and the flood came, and destroyed them all.

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi o si ti ri li ọjọ Loti; nwọn njẹ, nwọn nmu, nwọn nrà, nwọn ntà, nwọn ngbìn, nwọn nkọle;
entries.en: Likewise also as it was in the days of Lot; they did eat, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they builded;

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn li ọjọ na ti Loti jade kuro ni Sodomu, ojo ina ati sulfuru rọ̀ lati ọrun wá, o si run gbogbo wọn.
entries.en: But the same day that Lot went out of Sodom it rained fire and brimstone from heaven, and destroyed them all.

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bẹ̃ni yio ri li ọjọ na ti Ọmọ-enia yio farahàn.
entries.en: Even thus shall it be in the day when the Son of man is revealed.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ na, eniti o ba wà lori ile, ti ẹrù rẹ̀ si mbẹ ni ile, ki o máṣe sọkalẹ lati wá kó o; ẹniti o ba si wà li oko, ki o máṣe pada sẹhin.
entries.en: In that day, he which shall be upon the housetop, and his stuff in the house, let him not come down to take it away: and he that is in the field, let him likewise not return back.

entries.yo: Ẹ ranti aya Loti.
entries.en: Remember Lot's wife.

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni ti o ba nwá ati gbà ẹmi rẹ̀ là yio sọ ọ nù; ẹnikẹni ti o ba si sọ ọ nù yio gbà a là.
entries.en: Whosoever shall seek to save his life shall lose it; and whosoever shall lose his life shall preserve it.

entries.yo: Mo wi fun nyin, li oru ọjọ na, enia meji yio wà lori akete kan; a o mu ọkan, a o si fi ekeji silẹ.
entries.en: I tell you, in that night there shall be two men in one bed; the one shall be taken, and the other shall be left.

entries.yo: Enia meji yio si ma lọ̀ ọlọ pọ̀; a o mu ọkan, a o si fi ekeji silẹ.
entries.en: Two women shall be grinding together; the one shall be taken, and the other left.

entries.yo: Enia meji yio wà li oko; a o mu ọkan, a o si fi ekeji silẹ.
entries.en: Two men shall be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left.

entries.yo: Nwọn si da a lohùn, nwọn bi i pe, Nibo, Oluwa? O si wi fun wọn pe, Nibiti okú ba gbé wà, nibẹ̀ pẹlu ni idì ikojọ pọ̀ si.
entries.en: And they answered and said unto him, Where, Lord? And he said unto them, Wheresoever the body is, thither will the eagles be gathered together.

entries.yo: O si pa owe kan fun wọn nitori eyiyi pe, o yẹ ki a mã gbadura nigbagbogbo, ki a má si ṣãrẹ̀;
entries.en: And he spake a parable unto them to this end, that men ought always to pray, and not to faint;

entries.yo: Wipe, Onidajọ́ kan wà ni ilu kan, ti kò bẹ̀ru Ọlọrun, ti kò si ṣe ojusaju enia:
entries.en: Saying, There was in a city a judge, which feared not God, neither regarded man:

entries.yo: Opó kan si wà ni ilu na; o si ntọ̀ ọ wá, wipe, Gbẹsan mi lara ọtá mi.
entries.en: And there was a widow in that city; and she came unto him, saying, Avenge me of mine adversary.

entries.yo: Kò si ṣu si i nigba sã kan: ṣugbọn nikẹhin o wi ninu ara rẹ̀ pe, Bi emi kò tilẹ bẹ̀ru Ọlọrun, ti emi ko si ṣe ojuṣãju enia;
entries.en: And he would not for a while: but afterward he said within himself, Though I fear not God, nor regard man;

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nitoriti opó yi nyọ mi lẹnu, emi o gbẹsan rẹ̀, ki o má ba fi wíwa rẹ̀ nigbakugba da mi lagãra.
entries.en: Yet because this widow troubleth me, I will avenge her, lest by her continual coming she weary me.

entries.yo: Oluwa si wipe, Ẹ gbọ́ bi alaiṣõtọ onidajọ ti wi.
entries.en: And the Lord said, Hear what the unjust judge saith.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun kì yio ha si gbẹsan awọn ayanfẹ rẹ̀, ti nfi ọsán ati oru kigbe pè e, ti o si mu suru fun wọn?
entries.en: And shall not God avenge his own elect, which cry day and night unto him, though he bear long with them?

entries.yo: Mo wi fun nyin, yio gbẹsan wọn kánkán. Ṣugbọn nigbati Ọmọ-enia ba de yio ha ri igbagbọ́ li aiye?
entries.en: I tell you that he will avenge them speedily. Nevertheless when the Son of man cometh, shall he find faith on the earth?

entries.yo: O si pa owe yi fun awọn kan ti nwọn gbẹkẹle ara wọn pe, awọn li olododo, ti nwọn si ngàn awọn ẹlomiran:
entries.en: And he spake this parable unto certain which trusted in themselves that they were righteous, and despised others:

entries.yo: Pe, Awọn ọkunrin meji goke lọ si tẹmpili lati gbadura; ọkan jẹ Farisi, ekeji si jẹ agbowode.
entries.en: Two men went up into the temple to pray; the one a Pharisee, and the other a publican.

entries.yo: Eyi Farisi dide, o si ngbadura ninu ara rẹ̀ bayi pe, Ọlọrun, mo dupẹ lọwọ rẹ, nitoriti emi kò ri bi awọn ara iyokù, awọn alọnilọwọgba, alaiṣõtọ, panṣaga, tabi emi kò tilẹ ri bi agbowode yi.
entries.en: The Pharisee stood and prayed thus with himself, God, I thank thee, that I am not as other men are, extortioners, unjust, adulterers, or even as this publican.

entries.yo: Emi ngbàwẹ li ẹrinmeji li ọ̀sẹ, mo nsan idamẹwa ohun gbogbo ti mo ni.
entries.en: I fast twice in the week, I give tithes of all that I possess.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn agbowode duro li òkere, kò tilẹ jẹ gbé oju rẹ̀ soke ọrun, ṣugbọn o lù ara rẹ̀ li õkan-àiya, o wipe, Ọlọrun ṣãnu fun mi, emi ẹlẹṣẹ.
entries.en: And the publican, standing afar off, would not lift up so much as his eyes unto heaven, but smote upon his breast, saying, God be merciful to me a sinner.

entries.yo: Mo wi fun nyin, ọkunrin yi sọkalẹ lọ si ile rẹ̀ ni idalare jù ekeji lọ: nitori ẹnikẹni ti o ba gbé ara rẹ̀ ga, on li a o rẹ̀ silẹ; ẹniti o ba si rẹ̀ ara rẹ̀ silẹ on li a o gbéga.
entries.en: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other: for every one that exalteth himself shall be abased; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.

entries.yo: Nwọn si gbé awọn ọmọ-ọwọ tọ̀ ọ wá pẹlu, ki o le fi ọwọ́ le wọn; ṣugbọn nigbati awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ ri i, nwọn mba wọn wi.
entries.en: And they brought unto him also infants, that he would touch them: but when his disciples saw it, they rebuked them.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Jesu pè wọn sọdọ rẹ̀, o si wipe, Ẹ jẹ ki awọn ọmọ kekere wá sọdọ mi, ẹ má si ṣe da wọn lẹkun: nitoriti irú wọn ni ijọba Ọlọrun.
entries.en: But Jesus called them unto him, and said, Suffer little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.

entries.yo: Lõtọ ni mo wi fun nyin, Ẹnikẹni ti kò ba gbà ijọba Ọlọrun bi ọmọ kekere, kì yio wọ̀ inu rẹ̀ bi o ti wù ki o ri.
entries.en: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child shall in no wise enter therein.

entries.yo: Ijoye kan si bère lọwọ rẹ̀, wipe, Olukọni rere, kili emi o ṣe ti emi o fi jogún iye ainipẹkun?
entries.en: And a certain ruler asked him, saying, Good Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?

entries.yo: Jesu si wi fun u pe, Ẽṣe ti iwọ fi npè mi li ẹni rere? ẹni rere kan kò si, bikoṣe ẹnikan, eyini li Ọlọrun.
entries.en: And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? none is good, save one, that is, God.

entries.yo: Iwọ mọ̀ ofin wọnni, Máṣe ṣe panṣaga, máṣe pania, máṣe jale, máṣe jẹri eke, bọ̀wọ fun baba on iya rẹ.
entries.en: Thou knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Honour thy father and thy mother.

entries.yo: O si wipe, Gbogbo nkan wọnyi li emi ti pamọ lati igba ewe mi wá.
entries.en: And he said, All these have I kept from my youth up.

entries.yo: Nigbati Jesu si gbọ́ eyi, o wi fun u pe, Ohun kan li o kù fun ọ sibẹ: lọ ità ohun gbogbo ti o ni, ki o si pín i fun awọn talakà, iwọ o si ni iṣura li ọrun: si wá, ki o mã tọ̀ mi lẹhin.
entries.en: Now when Jesus heard these things, he said unto him, Yet lackest thou one thing: sell all that thou hast, and distribute unto the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, follow me.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si gbọ́ eyi, inu rẹ̀ bajẹ gidigidi: nitoriti o li ọrọ̀ pipo.
entries.en: And when he heard this, he was very sorrowful: for he was very rich.

entries.yo: Nigbati Jesu ri i pe, inu rẹ̀ bajẹ gidigidi, o ni, Yio ti ṣoro to fun awọn ti o li ọrọ̀ lati wọ̀ ijọba Ọlọrun!
entries.en: And when Jesus saw that he was very sorrowful, he said, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!

entries.yo: Nitori o rọrun fun ibakasiẹ lati gbà oju abẹrẹ wọle, jù fun ọlọrọ̀ lati wọ̀ ijọba Ọlọrun lọ.
entries.en: For it is easier for a camel to go through a needle's eye, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.

entries.yo: Awọn ti o si gbọ́ wipe, Njẹ tali o ha le là?
entries.en: And they that heard it said, Who then can be saved?

entries.yo: O si wipe, Ohun ti o ṣoro lọdọ enia, kò ṣoro lọdọ Ọlọrun.
entries.en: And he said, The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.

entries.yo: Peteru si wipe, Sawõ, awa ti fi tiwa silẹ, a si tọ̀ ọ lẹhin.
entries.en: Then Peter said, Lo, we have left all, and followed thee.

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Lõtọ ni mo wi fun nyin, Kò si ẹniti o fi ile, tabi aya, tabi ará, tabi õbi, tabi ọmọ silẹ, nitori ijọba Ọlọrun,
entries.en: And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or parents, or brethren, or wife, or children, for the kingdom of God's sake,

entries.yo: Ti kì yio gba ilọpo pipọ si i li aiye yi, ati li aiye ti mbọ̀ ìye ainipẹkun.
entries.en: Who shall not receive manifold more in this present time, and in the world to come life everlasting.

entries.yo: Nigbana li o pè awọn mejila sọdọ rẹ̀, o si wi fun wọn pe, Sawõ, awa ngòke lọ si Jerusalemu, a o si mu ohun gbogbo ṣẹ, ti a ti kọ lati ọwọ́ awọn woli wá, nitori Ọmọ-enia.
entries.en: Then he took unto him the twelve, and said unto them, Behold, we go up to Jerusalem, and all things that are written by the prophets concerning the Son of man shall be accomplished.

entries.yo: Nitori a o fi i le awọn Keferi lọwọ, a o fi i ṣe ẹlẹyà, a o si fi i ṣe ẹsin, a o si tutọ́ si i lara:
entries.en: For he shall be delivered unto the Gentiles, and shall be mocked, and spitefully entreated, and spitted on:

entries.yo: Nwọn o si nà a, nwọn o si pa a: ni ijọ kẹta yio si jinde.
entries.en: And they shall scourge him, and put him to death: and the third day he shall rise again.

entries.yo: Ọkan ninu nkan wọnyi kò si yé wọn: ọ̀rọ yi si pamọ́ fun wọn, bẹ̃ni nwọn ko si mọ̀ ohun ti a wi.
entries.en: And they understood none of these things: and this saying was hid from them, neither knew they the things which were spoken.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, bi on ti sunmọ Jeriko, afọju kan joko lẹba ọ̀na o nṣagbe:
entries.en: And it came to pass, that as he was come nigh unto Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the way side begging:

entries.yo: Nigbati o gbọ́ ti ọpọ́ enia nkọja lọ, o bère pe, kili ã le mọ̀ eyi si.
entries.en: And hearing the multitude pass by, he asked what it meant.

entries.yo: Nwọn si wi fun u pe, Jesu ti Nasareti li o nkọja lọ.
entries.en: And they told him, that Jesus of Nazareth passeth by.

entries.yo: O si kigbe pe, Jesu, iwọ Ọmọ Dafidi, ṣãnu fun mi.
entries.en: And he cried, saying, Jesus, thou Son of David, have mercy on me.

entries.yo: Awọn ti nlọ niwaju ba a wi pe, ki o pa ẹnu rẹ̀ mọ́: ṣugbọn on si kigbe si i kunkun pe, Iwọ Ọmọ Dafidi, ṣãnu fun mi.
entries.en: And they which went before rebuked him, that he should hold his peace: but he cried so much the more, Thou Son of David, have mercy on me.

entries.yo: Jesu si dẹṣẹ duro, o ni, ki a mu u tọ̀ on wá: nigbati o si sunmọ ọ, o bi i,
entries.en: And Jesus stood, and commanded him to be brought unto him: and when he was come near, he asked him,

entries.yo: Wipe, Kini iwọ nfẹ ti emi iba ṣe fun o? O si wipe, Oluwa, ki emi ki o le riran.
entries.en: Saying, What wilt thou that I shall do unto thee? And he said, Lord, that I may receive my sight.

entries.yo: Jesu si wi fun u pe, Riran: igbagbọ́ rẹ gbà ọ là.
entries.en: And Jesus said unto him, Receive thy sight: thy faith hath saved thee.

entries.yo: Lojukanna o si riran, o si ntọ̀ ọ lẹhin, o nyìn Ọlọrun logo: ati gbogbo enia nigbati nwọn ri i, nwọn fi iyìn fun Ọlọrun.
entries.en: And immediately he received his sight, and followed him, glorifying God: and all the people, when they saw it, gave praise unto God.

entries.yo: JESU si wọ̀ Jeriko lọ, o si nkọja lãrin rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Jesus entered and passed through Jericho.

entries.yo: Si kiyesi i, ọkunrin kan wà ti a npè ni Sakeu, o si jẹ olori agbowode kan, o si jẹ ọlọrọ̀.
entries.en: And, behold, there was a man named Zacchaeus, which was the chief among the publicans, and he was rich.

entries.yo: O si nfẹ lati ri ẹniti Jesu iṣe; kò si le ri i, nitori ọ̀pọ enia, ati nitoriti on ṣe enia kukuru.
entries.en: And he sought to see Jesus who he was; and could not for the press, because he was little of stature.

entries.yo: O si sure siwaju, o gùn ori igi sikamore kan, ki o ba le ri i: nitoriti yio kọja lọ niha ibẹ̀.
entries.en: And he ran before, and climbed up into a sycomore tree to see him: for he was to pass that way.

entries.yo: Nigbati Jesu si de ibẹ̀, o gbé oju soke, o si ri i, o si wi fun u pe, Sakeu, yara, ki o si sọkalẹ; nitori emi kò le ṣaiwọ ni ile rẹ loni.
entries.en: And when Jesus came to the place, he looked up, and saw him, and said unto him, Zacchaeus, make haste, and come down; for to day I must abide at thy house.

entries.yo: O si yara, o sọkalẹ, o si fi ayọ̀ gbà a.
entries.en: And he made haste, and came down, and received him joyfully.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si ri i, gbogbo wọn nkùn, wipe, O lọ iwọ̀ lọdọ ọkunrin ti iṣe ẹlẹṣẹ.
entries.en: And when they saw it, they all murmured, saying, That he was gone to be guest with a man that is a sinner.

entries.yo: Sakeu si dide, o si wi fun Oluwa pe, Wo o, Oluwa, àbọ ohun ini mi ni mo fifun talakà; bi mo ba si fi ẹ̀sun eke gbà ohun kan lọwọ ẹnikẹni, mo san a pada ni ilọpo mẹrin.
entries.en: And Zacchaeus stood, and said unto the Lord; Behold, Lord, the half of my goods I give to the poor; and if I have taken any thing from any man by false accusation, I restore him fourfold.

entries.yo: Jesu si wi fun u pe, Loni ni igbala wọ̀ ile yi, niwọnbi on pẹlu ti jẹ ọmọ Abrahamu.
entries.en: And Jesus said unto him, This day is salvation come to this house, forsomuch as he also is a son of Abraham.

entries.yo: Nitori Ọmọ-enia de lati wá awọn ti o nù kiri, ati lati gbà wọn là.
entries.en: For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si ngbọ́ nkan wọnyi, o fi ọ̀rọ kún u, o si pa owe kan, nitoriti o sunmọ Jerusalemu, ati nitoriti nwọn nrò pe, ijọba Ọlọrun yio farahàn nisisiyi.
entries.en: And as they heard these things, he added and spake a parable, because he was nigh to Jerusalem, and because they thought that the kingdom of God should immediately appear.

entries.yo: O si wipe, ọkunrin ọlọlá kan rè ilu òkere lọ igbà ijọba fun ara rẹ̀, ki o si pada.
entries.en: He said therefore, A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom, and to return.

entries.yo: O si pè awọn ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ̀ mẹwa, o fi mina mẹwa fun wọn, o si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ mã ṣowo titi emi o fi de.
entries.en: And he called his ten servants, and delivered them ten pounds, and said unto them, Occupy till I come.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn ọlọ̀tọ ilu rẹ̀ korira rẹ̀, nwọn si rán ikọ̀ tẹ̀le e, wipe, Awa kò fẹ ki ọkunrin yi jọba lori wa.
entries.en: But his citizens hated him, and sent a message after him, saying, We will not have this man to reign over us.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati o gbà ijọba tan, ti o pada de, o paṣẹ pe, ki a pè awọn ọmọ-ọdọ wọnni wá sọdọ rẹ̀, ti on ti fi owo fun nitori ki o le mọ̀ iye ere ti olukuluku fi iṣowo jẹ.
entries.en: And it came to pass, that when he was returned, having received the kingdom, then he commanded these servants to be called unto him, to whom he had given the money, that he might know how much every man had gained by trading.

entries.yo: Eyi ekini si wá, o wipe, Oluwa, mina rẹ jère mina mẹwa si i.
entries.en: Then came the first, saying, Lord, thy pound hath gained ten pounds.

entries.yo: O si wi fun u pe, O ṣeun, iwọ ọmọ-ọdọ rere: nitoriti iwọ ṣe olõtọ li ohun kikini, gbà aṣẹ lori ilu mẹwa.
entries.en: And he said unto him, Well, thou good servant: because thou hast been faithful in a very little, have thou authority over ten cities.

entries.yo: Eyi ekeji si wá, o wipe, Oluwa, mina rẹ jère mina marun.
entries.en: And the second came, saying, Lord, thy pound hath gained five pounds.

entries.yo: O si wi fun u pẹlu pe, Iwọ joye ilu marun.
entries.en: And he said likewise to him, Be thou also over five cities.

entries.yo: Omiran si wá, o wipe, Oluwa, wò mina rẹ ti mbẹ li ọwọ́ mi ti mo dì sinu gèle:
entries.en: And another came, saying, Lord, behold, here is thy pound, which I have kept laid up in a napkin:

entries.yo: Nitori mo bẹ̀ru rẹ, ati nitoriti iwọ ṣe onrorò enia: iwọ a ma mu eyi ti iwọ ko fi lelẹ, iwọ a si ma ká eyi ti iwọ kò gbìn.
entries.en: For I feared thee, because thou art an austere man: thou takest up that thou layedst not down, and reapest that thou didst not sow.

entries.yo: O si wi fun u pe, Li ẹnu ara rẹ na li emi o ṣe idajọ rẹ, iwọ ọmọ-ọdọ buburu. Iwọ mọ̀ pe onrorò enia ni mi, pe, emi a ma mu eyi ti emi ko fi lelẹ emi a si ma ká eyi ti emi ko gbìn;
entries.en: And he saith unto him, Out of thine own mouth will I judge thee, thou wicked servant. Thou knewest that I was an austere man, taking up that I laid not down, and reaping that I did not sow:

entries.yo: Ẽha si ti ṣe ti iwọ ko fi owo mi si ile elé, nigbati mo ba de, emi iba si bère rẹ̀ ti on ti elé?
entries.en: Wherefore then gavest not thou my money into the bank, that at my coming I might have required mine own with usury?

entries.yo: O si wi fun awọn ti o duro leti ibẹ̀ pe, Ẹ gbà mina na lọwọ rẹ̀, ki ẹ si fi i fun ẹniti o ni mina mẹwa.
entries.en: And he said unto them that stood by, Take from him the pound, and give it to him that hath ten pounds.

entries.yo: Nwọn si wi fun u pe, Oluwa, o ni mina mẹwa.
entries.en: (And they said unto him, Lord, he hath ten pounds.)

entries.yo: Mo wi fun nyin pe, Ẹnikẹni ti o ni, li a o fifun; ati lọdọ ẹniti kò ni, eyi na ti o ni li a o gbà lọwọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: For I say unto you, That unto every one which hath shall be given; and from him that hath not, even that he hath shall be taken away from him.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn ọtá mi wọnni, ti kò fẹ ki emi ki o jọba lori wọn, ẹ mu wọn wá ihinyi, ki ẹ si pa wọn niwaju mi.
entries.en: But those mine enemies, which would not that I should reign over them, bring hither, and slay them before me.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si wi nkan wọnyi tan, o lọ ṣaju, o ngòke lọ si Jerusalemu.
entries.en: And when he had thus spoken, he went before, ascending up to Jerusalem.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati o sunmọ Betfage on Betaní li òke ti a npè ni Olifi, o rán awọn meji ninu awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀,
entries.en: And it came to pass, when he was come nigh to Bethphage and Bethany, at the mount called the mount of Olives, he sent two of his disciples,

entries.yo: Wipe, Ẹ lọ iletò ti o kọju si nyin; nigbati ẹnyin ba nwọ̀ ọ lọ, ẹnyin o ri ọmọ kẹtẹkẹtẹ kan ti a so, ti ẹnikẹni ko gùn ri: ẹ tú u, ki ẹ si fà a wá.
entries.en: Saying, Go ye into the village over against you; in the which at your entering ye shall find a colt tied, whereon yet never man sat: loose him, and bring him hither.

entries.yo: Bi ẹnikẹni ba si bi nyin pe, Ẽṣe ti ẹnyin fi ntú u? ki ẹnyin ki o wi bayi pe, Oluwa ni ifi i ṣe.
entries.en: And if any man ask you, Why do ye loose him? thus shall ye say unto him, Because the Lord hath need of him.

entries.yo: Awọn ti a rán si mu ọ̀na wọn pọ̀n, nwọn si bá a gẹgẹ bi o ti wi fun wọn.
entries.en: And they that were sent went their way, and found even as he had said unto them.

entries.yo: Bi nwọn si ti ntú ọmọ kẹtẹkẹtẹ na, awọn oluwa rẹ̀ bi wọn pe, Ẽṣe ti ẹnyin fi ntú kẹtẹkẹtẹ nì?
entries.en: And as they were loosing the colt, the owners thereof said unto them, Why loose ye the colt?

entries.yo: Nwọn si wipe, Oluwa ni ifi i ṣe.
entries.en: And they said, The Lord hath need of him.

entries.yo: Nwọn si fà a tọ̀ Jesu wá: nwọn si tẹ́ aṣọ wọn si ẹ̀hin ọmọ kẹtẹkẹtẹ na, nwọn si gbé Jesu kà a.
entries.en: And they brought him to Jesus: and they cast their garments upon the colt, and they set Jesus thereon.

entries.yo: Bi o si ti nlọ nwọn tẹ́ aṣọ wọn si ọ̀na.
entries.en: And as he went, they spread their clothes in the way.

entries.yo: Bi o si ti sunmọ eti ibẹ̀ ni gẹrẹgẹrẹ òke Olifi, gbogbo ijọ awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ bẹ̀rẹ si iyọ̀, ati si ifi ohùn rara yìn Ọlọrun, nitori iṣẹ nla gbogbo ti nwọn ti ri;
entries.en: And when he was come nigh, even now at the descent of the mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works that they had seen;

entries.yo: Wipe, Olubukun li Ọba ti o mbọ̀ wá li orukọ Oluwa: alafia li ọrun, ati ogo loke ọrun.
entries.en: Saying, Blessed be the King that cometh in the name of the Lord: peace in heaven, and glory in the highest.

entries.yo: Awọn kan ninu awọn Farisi li awujọ si wi fun u pe, Olukọni ba awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ wi.
entries.en: And some of the Pharisees from among the multitude said unto him, Master, rebuke thy disciples.

entries.yo: O si da wọn lohùn, o wi fun wọn pe, Mo wi fun nyin, Bi awọn wọnyi ba pa ẹnu wọn mọ́, awọn okuta yio kigbe soke.
entries.en: And he answered and said unto them, I tell you that, if these should hold their peace, the stones would immediately cry out.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si sunmọ etile, o ṣijuwò ilu na, o sọkun si i lori,
entries.en: And when he was come near, he beheld the city, and wept over it,

entries.yo: O nwipe, Ibaṣepe iwọ mọ̀, loni yi, ani iwọ, ohun ti iṣe ti alafia rẹ! ṣugbọn nisisiyi nwọn pamọ́ kuro li oju rẹ.
entries.en: Saying, If thou hadst known, even thou, at least in this thy day, the things which belong unto thy peace! but now they are hid from thine eyes.

entries.yo: Nitori ọjọ mbọ̀ fun ọ, ti awọn ọtá rẹ yio wà yàra ká ọ, nwọn o si yi ọ ká, nwọn o si ká ọ mọ́ niha gbogbo.
entries.en: For the days shall come upon thee, that thine enemies shall cast a trench about thee, and compass thee round, and keep thee in on every side,

entries.yo: Nwọn o si wó ọ palẹ bẹrẹ, ati awọn ọmọ rẹ ninu rẹ; nwọn kì yio si fi okuta kan silẹ lori ara wọn; nitoriti iwọ ko mọ̀ ọjọ ìbẹwo rẹ.
entries.en: And shall lay thee even with the ground, and thy children within thee; and they shall not leave in thee one stone upon another; because thou knewest not the time of thy visitation.

entries.yo: O si wọ̀ inu tẹmpili lọ, o si bẹ̀rẹ si ilé awọn ti ntà ninu rẹ̀ sode;
entries.en: And he went into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold therein, and them that bought;

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, A ti kọwe rẹ̀ pe, Ile mi yio jẹ ile adura; ṣugbọn ẹnyin ti sọ ọ di ihò olè.
entries.en: Saying unto them, It is written, My house is the house of prayer: but ye have made it a den of thieves.

entries.yo: O si nkọ́ni lojojumọ ni tẹmpili. Ṣugbọn awọn olori alufa, ati awọn akọwe, ati awọn olori awọn enia nwá ọ̀na ati pa a run,
entries.en: And he taught daily in the temple. But the chief priests and the scribes and the chief of the people sought to destroy him,

entries.yo: Nwọn kò si ri bi nwọn iba ti ṣe: nitori gbogbo enia ṣù mọ́ ọ lati gbọ̀rọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And could not find what they might do: for all the people were very attentive to hear him.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, ni ijọ kan li ọjọ wọnni, bi o ti nkọ́ awọn enia ni tẹmpili ti o si nwasu ihinrere, awọn olori alufa, ati awọn pẹlu awọn agbagbà dide sí i,
entries.en: And it came to pass, that on one of those days, as he taught the people in the temple, and preached the gospel, the chief priests and the scribes came upon him with the elders,

entries.yo: Nwọn si wi fun u pe, Sọ fun wa, aṣẹ wo ni iwọ fi nṣe nkan wọnyi? tabi tali o fun ọ li aṣẹ yi?
entries.en: And spake unto him, saying, Tell us, by what authority doest thou these things? or who is he that gave thee this authority?

entries.yo: O si dahùn o si wi fun wọn pe, Emi pẹlu yio si bi nyin lẽre ọ̀rọ kan; ẹ sọ fun mi.
entries.en: And he answered and said unto them, I will also ask you one thing; and answer me:

entries.yo: Baptismu ti Johanu, lati ọrun wá ni tabi lọdọ enia?
entries.en: The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or of men?

entries.yo: Nwọn si ba ara wọn gbèro wipe, Bi awa ba wipe, Lati ọrun wá ni; on o wipe, Ẽṣe ti ẹnyin kò fi gbà a gbọ́?
entries.en: And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then believed ye him not?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi awa ba si wipe, Lati ọdọ enia; gbogbo enia ni yio sọ wa li okuta; nitori nwọn gbagbọ pe, woli ni Johanu.
entries.en: But and if we say, Of men; all the people will stone us: for they be persuaded that John was a prophet.

entries.yo: Nwọn si dahùn wipe, nwọn kò mọ̀ ibiti o ti wá.
entries.en: And they answered, that they could not tell whence it was.

entries.yo: Jesu si wi fun wọn pe, Njẹ emi ki yio wi fun nyin aṣẹ ti emi fi nṣe nkan wọnyi.
entries.en: And Jesus said unto them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things.

entries.yo: Nigbana li o bẹ̀rẹ si ipa owe yi fun awọn enia pe; ọkunrin kan gbìn ọgba ajara kan, o si fi ṣe agbatọju fun awọn àgbẹ, o si lọ si àjo fun igba pipẹ.
entries.en: Then began he to speak to the people this parable; A certain man planted a vineyard, and let it forth to husbandmen, and went into a far country for a long time.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si di akokò, o rán ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ̀ kan si awọn àgbẹ na, ki nwọn ki o le fun u ninu eso ọgba ajara na: ṣugbọn awọn àgbẹ lù u, nwọn si rán a pada lọwọ ofo.
entries.en: And at the season he sent a servant to the husbandmen, that they should give him of the fruit of the vineyard: but the husbandmen beat him, and sent him away empty.

entries.yo: O si tún rán ọmọ-ọdọ miran: nwọn si lù u pẹlu, nwọn si jẹ ẹ nìya, nwọn si rán a pada lọwọ ofo.
entries.en: And again he sent another servant: and they beat him also, and entreated him shamefully, and sent him away empty.

entries.yo: O si tún rán ẹkẹta: nwọn si ṣá a lọgbẹ pẹlu, nwọn si tì i jade.
entries.en: And again he sent a third: and they wounded him also, and cast him out.

entries.yo: Nigbana li oluwa ọgba ajara wipe, Ewo li emi o ṣe? emi o rán ọmọ mi ayanfẹ lọ: bọya nigbati nwọn ba ri i, nwọn o ṣojuṣaju fun u.
entries.en: Then said the lord of the vineyard, What shall I do? I will send my beloved son: it may be they will reverence him when they see him.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati awọn àgbẹ na ri i, nwọn ba ara wọn gbèro pe, Eyi li arole: ẹ wá, ẹ jẹ ki a pa a, ki ogún rẹ̀ ki o le jẹ ti wa.
entries.en: But when the husbandmen saw him, they reasoned among themselves, saying, This is the heir: come, let us kill him, that the inheritance may be ours.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni nwọn si ti i jade sẹhin ọgba ajara, nwọn si pa a. Njẹ kili oluwa ọgba ajara na yio ṣe si wọn?
entries.en: So they cast him out of the vineyard, and killed him. What therefore shall the lord of the vineyard do unto them?

entries.yo: Yio wá, yio si pa awọn àgbẹ wọnni run, yio si fi ọgba ajara na fun awọn ẹlomiran. Nigbati nwọn si gbọ́, nwọn ni, Ki a má ri i.
entries.en: He shall come and destroy these husbandmen, and shall give the vineyard to others. And when they heard it, they said, God forbid.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si wò wọn, o ni, Ewo ha li eyi ti a ti kọwe pe, Okuta ti awọn ọmọle kọ̀ silẹ, on na li a sọ di pàtaki igun ile?
entries.en: And he beheld them, and said, What is this then that is written, The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner?

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni ti o ba ṣubu lù okuta na yio fọ́; ṣugbọn ẹnikẹni ti o ba ṣubu lù, yio lọ̀ ọ lulú.
entries.en: Whosoever shall fall upon that stone shall be broken; but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder.

entries.yo: Awọn olori alufa ati awọn akọwe nwá ọna ati mu u ni wakati na; ṣugbọn nwọn bẹ̀ru awọn enia: nitoriti nwọn mọ̀ pe, o pa owe yi mọ wọn.
entries.en: And the chief priests and the scribes the same hour sought to lay hands on him; and they feared the people: for they perceived that he had spoken this parable against them.

entries.yo: Nwọn si nṣọ ọ, nwọn si rán awọn amí ti nwọn jẹ ẹlẹtan fi ara wọn pe olõtọ enia, ki nwọn ki o le gbá ọ̀rọ rẹ̀ mu, ki nwọn ki o le fi i le agbara ati aṣẹ Bãlẹ.
entries.en: And they watched him, and sent forth spies, which should feign themselves just men, that they might take hold of his words, that so they might deliver him unto the power and authority of the governor.

entries.yo: Nwọn si bi i, wipe, Olukọni, awa mọ̀ pe, iwọ a ma sọrọ fun ni, iwọ a si ma kọ́-ni bi o ti tọ, bẹ̃ni iwọ kì iṣojuṣaju ẹnikan ṣugbọn iwọ nkọ́-ni li ọ̀na Ọlọrun li otitọ.
entries.en: And they asked him, saying, Master, we know that thou sayest and teachest rightly, neither acceptest thou the person of any, but teachest the way of God truly:

entries.yo: O tọ́ fun wa lati mã san owode fun Kesari, tabi kò tọ́?
entries.en: Is it lawful for us to give tribute unto Caesar, or no?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn o kiyesi arekereke wọn, o si wi fun wọn pe Ẽṣe ti ẹnyin fi ndán mi wò?
entries.en: But he perceived their craftiness, and said unto them, Why tempt ye me?

entries.yo: Ẹ fi owo-idẹ kan hàn mi. Aworan ati akọle ti tani wà nibẹ? Nwọn si da a lohùn pe, Ti Kesari ni.
entries.en: Shew me a penny. Whose image and superscription hath it? They answered and said, Caesar's.

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Njẹ ẹ fi ohun ti iṣe ti Kesari fun Kesari, ati ohun ti iṣe ti Ọlọrun fun Ọlọrun.
entries.en: And he said unto them, Render therefore unto Caesar the things which be Caesar's, and unto God the things which be God's.

entries.yo: Nwọn kò si le gbá ọ̀rọ rẹ̀ mu niwaju awọn enia: ẹnu si yà wọn si idahùn rẹ̀, nwọn si pa ẹnu wọn mọ́.
entries.en: And they could not take hold of his words before the people: and they marvelled at his answer, and held their peace.

entries.yo: Awọn Sadusi kan si tọ̀ ọ wá, awọn ti nwọn nwipe ajinde okú kò si: nwọn si bi i,
entries.en: Then came to him certain of the Sadducees, which deny that there is any resurrection; and they asked him,

entries.yo: Wipe, Olukọni, Mose kọwe fun wa pe, Bi arakunrin ẹnikan ba kú, li ailọmọ, ti o li aya, ki arakunrin rẹ̀ ki o ṣu aya rẹ̀ lopó, ki o le gbe iru dide fun arakunrin rẹ̀.
entries.en: Saying, Master, Moses wrote unto us, If any man's brother die, having a wife, and he die without children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.

entries.yo: Njẹ awọn arakunrin meje kan ti wà: ekini gbé iyawo, o si kú li ailọmọ.
entries.en: There were therefore seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and died without children.

entries.yo: Ekeji si ṣu u lopó, on si kú li ailọmọ.
entries.en: And the second took her to wife, and he died childless.

entries.yo: Ẹkẹta si ṣu u lopó; gẹgẹ bẹ̃ si li awọn mejeje pẹlu: nwọn kò si fi ọmọ silẹ, nwọn si kú.
entries.en: And the third took her; and in like manner the seven also: and they left no children, and died.

entries.yo: Nikẹhin gbogbo wọn, obinrin na kú pẹlu.
entries.en: Last of all the woman died also.

entries.yo: Njẹ li ajinde okú, aya titani yio ha ṣe ninu wọn? nitori awọn mejeje li o sá ni i li aya.
entries.en: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them is she? for seven had her to wife.

entries.yo: Jesu si dahùn o wi fun wọn pe, Awọn ọmọ aiye yi a ma gbeyawo, nwọn a si ma fà iyawo fun-ni.
entries.en: And Jesus answering said unto them, The children of this world marry, and are given in marriage:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn ti a kà yẹ lati jogún aiye na, ati ajinde kuro ninu okú, nwọn kì igbeyawo, nwọn kì si ifà iyawo fun-ni:
entries.en: But they which shall be accounted worthy to obtain that world, and the resurrection from the dead, neither marry, nor are given in marriage:

entries.yo: Nitori nwọn kò le kú mọ́; nitoriti nwọn ba awọn angẹli dọgba; awọn ọmọ Ọlọrun si ni nwọn, nitori nwọn di awọn ọmọ ajinde.
entries.en: Neither can they die any more: for they are equal unto the angels; and are the children of God, being the children of the resurrection.

entries.yo: Niti pe a njí awọn okú dide, Mose tikararẹ̀ si ti fihàn ni igbẹ́, nigbati o pè Oluwa ni Ọlọrun Abrahamu, ati Ọlọrun Isaaki, ati Ọlọrun Jakọbu.
entries.en: Now that the dead are raised, even Moses shewed at the bush, when he calleth the Lord the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.

entries.yo: Bẹni on kì iṣe Ọlọrun awọn okú, bikoṣe ti awọn alãye: nitori gbogbo wọn wà lãye fun u.
entries.en: For he is not a God of the dead, but of the living: for all live unto him.

entries.yo: Nigbana li awọn kan ninu awọn akọwe da a lohùn, wipe, Olukọni iwọ wi rere.
entries.en: Then certain of the scribes answering said, Master, thou hast well said.

entries.yo: Nwọn kò si jẹ bi i lẽre òrọ kan mọ́.
entries.en: And after that they durst not ask him any question at all.

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Ẽṣe ti nwọn fi nwipe, Ọmọ Dafidi ni Kristi?
entries.en: And he said unto them, How say they that Christ is David's son?

entries.yo: Dafidi tikararẹ̀ si wi ninu iwe Psalmu pe, OLUWA wi fun Oluwa mi pe, Iwọ joko li ọwọ́ ọtún mi,
entries.en: And David himself saith in the book of Psalms, The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand,

entries.yo: Titi emi o fi sọ awọn ọtá rẹ di apoti itisẹ rẹ.
entries.en: Till I make thine enemies thy footstool.

entries.yo: Njẹ bi Dafidi ba pè e li Oluwa; on ha si ti ṣe jẹ ọmọ rẹ̀?
entries.en: David therefore calleth him Lord, how is he then his son?

entries.yo: O si wi fun awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ li etí gbogbo enia pe,
entries.en: Then in the audience of all the people he said unto his disciples,

entries.yo: Ẹ mã kiyesara lọdọ awọn akọwe, ti nwọn fẹ lati mã rìn li aṣọ gigùn, ti nwọn si fẹ ikí-ni li ọjà, ati ibujoko ọlá ninu sinagogu, ati ipò ọla ni ibi àse;
entries.en: Beware of the scribes, which desire to walk in long robes, and love greetings in the markets, and the highest seats in the synagogues, and the chief rooms at feasts;

entries.yo: Awọn ti o jẹ ile awọn opó run, ti nwọn si ngbadura gìgun fun aṣehàn: awọn wọnyi na ni yio jẹbi pọ̀ju.
entries.en: Which devour widows' houses, and for a shew make long prayers: the same shall receive greater damnation.

entries.yo: NIGBATI o si gbé oju soke, o ri awọn ọlọrọ̀ nfi ẹ̀bun wọn sinu apoti iṣura.
entries.en: And he looked up, and saw the rich men casting their gifts into the treasury.

entries.yo: O si ri talakà opó kan pẹlu, o nsọ owo-idẹ wẹ́wẹ meji sibẹ.
entries.en: And he saw also a certain poor widow casting in thither two mites.

entries.yo: O si wipe, Lõtọ ni mo wi fun nyin, talakà opó yi fi si i jù gbogbo wọn lọ:
entries.en: And he said, Of a truth I say unto you, that this poor widow hath cast in more than they all:

entries.yo: Nitori gbogbo awọn wọnyi fi sinu ẹ̀bun Ọlọrun lati ọ̀pọlọpọ ini wọn; ṣugbọn on ninu aìni rẹ̀ o sọ gbogbo ohun ini rẹ̀ ti o ni sinu rẹ̀.
entries.en: For all these have of their abundance cast in unto the offerings of God: but she of her penury hath cast in all the living that she had.

entries.yo: Bi awọn kan si ti nsọ̀rọ ti tẹmpili, bi a ti fi okuta daradara ati ẹ̀bun ṣe e li ọṣọ, o ní,
entries.en: And as some spake of the temple, how it was adorned with goodly stones and gifts, he said,

entries.yo: Ohun ti ẹnyin nwò wọnyi, ọjọ mbọ̀ li eyi ti a kì yio fi okuta kan silẹ lori ekeji ti a kì yio wó lulẹ.
entries.en: As for these things which ye behold, the days will come, in the which there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.

entries.yo: Nwọn si bère lọwọ rẹ̀, wipe, Olukọni, nigbawo ni nkan wọnyi yio ṣẹ? ati àmi kini yio wà, nigbati nkan wọnyi yio fi ṣẹ?
entries.en: And they asked him, saying, Master, but when shall these things be? and what sign will there be when these things shall come to pass?

entries.yo: O si wipe, Ẹ mã kiyesara, ki a má bà mu nyin ṣina: nitori ọpọlọpọ yio wá li orukọ mi, ti yio mã wipe, Emi ni Kristi; akokò igbana si kù si dẹ̀dẹ: ẹ máṣe tọ̀ wọn lẹhin.
entries.en: And he said, Take heed that ye be not deceived: for many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and the time draweth near: go ye not therefore after them.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati ẹnyin ba gburó ogun ati idagìri, ẹ máṣe foiya: nitori nkan wọnyi ko le ṣe áìkọ́ṣẹ: ṣugbọn opin na kì iṣe lojukanna.
entries.en: But when ye shall hear of wars and commotions, be not terrified: for these things must first come to pass; but the end is not by and by.

entries.yo: Nigbana li o wi fun wọn pe, Orilẹ-ède yio dide si orilẹ-ède, ati ilẹ-ọba si ilẹ-ọba:
entries.en: Then said he unto them, Nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom:

entries.yo: Isẹlẹ nla yio si wà kakiri, ati ìyan ati ajakalẹ arùn; ohun ẹ̀ru, ati àmi nla yio si ti ọrun wá.
entries.en: And great earthquakes shall be in divers places, and famines, and pestilences; and fearful sights and great signs shall there be from heaven.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ṣaju gbogbo nkan wọnyi, nwọn o nawọ́ mu nyin, nwọn o si ṣe inunibini si nyin, nwọn o fi nyin le awọn oni-sinagogu lọwọ, ati sinu tubu, nwọn o mu nyin lọ sọdọ awọn ọba ati awọn ijoye nitori orukọ mi.
entries.en: But before all these, they shall lay their hands on you, and persecute you, delivering you up to the synagogues, and into prisons, being brought before kings and rulers for my name's sake.

entries.yo: Yio si pada di ẹrí fun nyin.
entries.en: And it shall turn to you for a testimony.

entries.yo: Nitorina ẹ pinnu rẹ̀ li ọkàn nyin pe ẹ kì yio ronu ṣaju, bi ẹ o ti dahun.
entries.en: Settle it therefore in your hearts, not to meditate before what ye shall answer:

entries.yo: Nitoriti emi ó fun nyin li ẹnu ati ọgbọ́n, ti gbogbo awọn ọtá nyin kì yio le sọrọ-òdi si, ti nwọn kì yio si le kò loju.
entries.en: For I will give you a mouth and wisdom, which all your adversaries shall not be able to gainsay nor resist.

entries.yo: A o si fi nyin hàn lati ọdọ awọn õbi nyin wá, ati awọn arakunrin, ati awọn ibatan, ati awọn ọrẹ́ wá; nwọn o si mu ki a pa ninu nyin.
entries.en: And ye shall be betrayed both by parents, and brethren, and kinsfolks, and friends; and some of you shall they cause to be put to death.

entries.yo: A o si korira nyin lọdọ gbogbo enia nitori orukọ mi.
entries.en: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name's sake.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn irun ori nyin kan kì o ṣegbé.
entries.en: But there shall not an hair of your head perish.

entries.yo: Ninu sũru nyin li ẹnyin o jère ọkàn nyin.
entries.en: In your patience possess ye your souls.

entries.yo: Nigbati ẹnyin ba si ri ti a fi ogun yi Jerusalemu ká, ẹ mọ̀ nigbana pe, isọdahoro rẹ̀ kù si dẹ̀dẹ.
entries.en: And when ye shall see Jerusalem compassed with armies, then know that the desolation thereof is nigh.
