entries.yo: Nigbana ni ki awọn ti mbẹ ni Judea ki o sá lọ sori òke; ati awọn ti mbẹ larin rẹ̀ ki nwọn jade kuro; ki awọn ti o si mbẹ ni igberiko ki o máṣe wọ̀ inu rẹ̀ lọ.
entries.en: Then let them which are in Judaea flee to the mountains; and let them which are in the midst of it depart out; and let not them that are in the countries enter thereinto.

entries.yo: Nitori ọjọ ẹsan li ọjọ wọnni, ki a le mu ohun gbogbo ti a ti kọwe rẹ̀ ṣẹ.
entries.en: For these be the days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn egbé ni fun awọn ti o lóyun, ati awọn ti o nfi ọmú fun ọmọ mu ni ijọ wọnni! nitoriti ipọnju pipọ yio wà lori ati ibinu si awọn enia wọnyi.
entries.en: But woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck, in those days! for there shall be great distress in the land, and wrath upon this people.

entries.yo: Nwọn o si ti oju idà ṣubu, a o si dì wọn ni igbekun lọ si orilẹ-ède gbogbo: Jerusalemu yio si di itẹmọlẹ li ẹsẹ awọn Keferi, titi akoko awọn Keferi yio fi kún.
entries.en: And they shall fall by the edge of the sword, and shall be led away captive into all nations: and Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled.

entries.yo: Àmi yio si wà li õrùn, ati li oṣupa, ati ni irawọ; ati lori ilẹ aiye idamu fun awọn orilẹ-ede nitori ipaiya ti ariwo;
entries.en: And there shall be signs in the sun, and in the moon, and in the stars; and upon the earth distress of nations, with perplexity; the sea and the waves roaring;

entries.yo: Aiya awọn enia yio ma já fun ibẹru, ati fun ireti nkan wọnni ti mbọ̀ sori aiye: nitori awọn agbara ọrun li a o mì titi.
entries.en: Men's hearts failing them for fear, and for looking after those things which are coming on the earth: for the powers of heaven shall be shaken.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni nwọn o si ri Ọmọ-enia ti yio ma ti oju ọrun bọ̀ ti on ti agbara ati ogo nla.
entries.en: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati nkan wọnyi ba bẹ̀rẹ si iṣẹ, njẹ ki ẹ wò òke, ki ẹ si gbé ori nyin soke; nitori idande nyin kù si dẹ̀dẹ.
entries.en: And when these things begin to come to pass, then look up, and lift up your heads; for your redemption draweth nigh.

entries.yo: O si pa owe kan fun wọn pe; Ẹ kiyesi igi ọpọtọ, ati si gbogbo igi;
entries.en: And he spake to them a parable; Behold the fig tree, and all the trees;

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn ba rúwe, ẹnyin ri i, ẹ si mọ̀ fun ara nyin pe, igba ẹ̀run kù fẹfẹ.
entries.en: When they now shoot forth, ye see and know of your own selves that summer is now nigh at hand.

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bẹ̃ na li ẹnyin, nigbati ẹnyin ba ri nkan wọnyi ti nṣẹ, ki ẹnyin ki o mọ̀ pe, ijọba Ọlọrun kù si dẹ̀dẹ.
entries.en: So likewise ye, when ye see these things come to pass, know ye that the kingdom of God is nigh at hand.

entries.yo: Lõtọ ni mo wi fun nyin, Iran yi ki yio rekọja, titi gbogbo nkan wọnyi yio fi ṣẹ.
entries.en: Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass away, till all be fulfilled.

entries.yo: Ọrun on aiye yio rekọja: ṣugbọn ọ̀rọ mi kì yio rekọja.
entries.en: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹ mã kiyesara nyin, ki ọkàn nyin ki o máṣe kún fun wọ̀bia, ati fun ọti amupara, ati fun aniyan aiye yi, ti ọjọ na yio si fi de ba nyin lojijì bi ikẹkun.
entries.en: And take heed to yourselves, lest at any time your hearts be overcharged with surfeiting, and drunkenness, and cares of this life, and so that day come upon you unawares.

entries.yo: Nitori bẹni yio de ba gbogbo awọn ti ngbe ori gbogbo ilẹ aiye.
entries.en: For as a snare shall it come on all them that dwell on the face of the whole earth.

entries.yo: Njẹ ki ẹ mã ṣọna, ki ẹ si mã gbadura nigbagbogbo, ki ẹ ba le là gbogbo nkan wọnyi ti mbọ̀ wá iṣẹ, ki ẹ si le duro niwaju Ọmọ-enia.
entries.en: Watch ye therefore, and pray always, that ye may be accounted worthy to escape all these things that shall come to pass, and to stand before the Son of man.

entries.yo: Lọsán, a si ma kọ́ni ni tẹmpili; loru, a si ma jade lọ iwọ̀ lori òke ti a npè ni oke Olifi.
entries.en: And in the day time he was teaching in the temple; and at night he went out, and abode in the mount that is called the mount of Olives.

entries.yo: Gbogbo enia si ntọ̀ ọ wá ni tẹmpili ni kutukutu owurọ̀, lati gbọ́rọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And all the people came early in the morning to him in the temple, for to hear him.

entries.yo: AJỌ ọdun aiwukara ti a npè ni Irekọja si kù fẹfẹ.
entries.en: Now the feast of unleavened bread drew nigh, which is called the Passover.

entries.yo: Ati awọn olori alufa, ati awọn akọwe nwá ọ̀na bi nwọn iba ti ṣe pa a; nitoriti nwọn mbẹ̀ru awọn enia.
entries.en: And the chief priests and scribes sought how they might kill him; for they feared the people.

entries.yo: Satani si wọ̀ inu Judasi, ti a npè ni Iskariotu, ọkan ninu awọn mejila.
entries.en: Then entered Satan into Judas surnamed Iscariot, being of the number of the twelve.

entries.yo: O si mu ọ̀na rẹ̀ pọ̀n, o lọ lati ba awọn olori alufa ati awọn olori ẹṣọ́ mọ̀ ọ pọ̀, bi on iba ti fi i le wọn lọwọ.
entries.en: And he went his way, and communed with the chief priests and captains, how he might betray him unto them.

entries.yo: Nwọn si yọ̀, nwọn si ba a da majẹmu ati fun u li owo.
entries.en: And they were glad, and covenanted to give him money.

entries.yo: O si gbà: o si nwá akoko ti o wọ̀, lati fi i le wọn lọwọ laìsi ariwo.
entries.en: And he promised, and sought opportunity to betray him unto them in the absence of the multitude.

entries.yo: Ọjọ aiwukara pé, nigbati nwọn kò le ṣe aiṣẹbọ irekọja.
entries.en: Then came the day of unleavened bread, when the passover must be killed.

entries.yo: O si rán Peteru on Johanu, wipe, Ẹ lọ ipèse irekọja fun wa, ki awa ki o jẹ.
entries.en: And he sent Peter and John, saying, Go and prepare us the passover, that we may eat.

entries.yo: Nwọn si wi fun u pe, Nibo ni iwọ nfẹ ki a pèse sile?
entries.en: And they said unto him, Where wilt thou that we prepare?

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Kiyesi i, nigbati ẹnyin ba nwọ̀ ilu lọ, ọkunrin kan ti o rù iṣa omi yio pade nyin; ẹ ba a lọ si ile ti o ba wọ̀.
entries.en: And he said unto them, Behold, when ye are entered into the city, there shall a man meet you, bearing a pitcher of water; follow him into the house where he entereth in.

entries.yo: Ki ẹ si wi fun bãle ile na pe, Olukọni wi fun ọ pe, Nibo ni gbọ̀ngan apejẹ na gbé wà, nibiti emi o gbé jẹ irekọja pẹlu awọn ọmọ-ẹhin mi?
entries.en: And ye shall say unto the goodman of the house, The Master saith unto thee, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?

entries.yo: On o si fi gbọ̀ngan nla kan loke hàn nyin, ti a ṣe lọṣọ: nibẹ̀ ni ki ẹnyin ki o pèse silẹ.
entries.en: And he shall shew you a large upper room furnished: there make ready.

entries.yo: Nwọn si lọ nwọn si bá a gẹgẹ bi o ti sọ fun wọn: nwọn si pèse irekọja silẹ.
entries.en: And they went, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.

entries.yo: Nigbati akokò si to, o joko ati awọn aposteli pẹlu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And when the hour was come, he sat down, and the twelve apostles with him.

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Tinu-tinu li emi fẹ fi ba nyin jẹ irekọja yi, ki emi ki o to jìya:
entries.en: And he said unto them, With desire I have desired to eat this passover with you before I suffer:

entries.yo: Nitori mo wi fun nyin, Emi kì yio jẹ ninu rẹ̀ mọ́, titi a o fi mú u ṣẹ ni ijọba Ọlọrun.
entries.en: For I say unto you, I will not any more eat thereof, until it be fulfilled in the kingdom of God.

entries.yo: O si gbà ago, nigbati o si ti dupẹ, o wipe, Gbà eyi, ki ẹ si pín i larin ara nyin.
entries.en: And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and said, Take this, and divide it among yourselves:

entries.yo: Nitori mo wi fun nyin, Emi kì yio mu ninu eso ajara mọ́, titi ijọba Ọlọrun yio fi de.
entries.en: For I say unto you, I will not drink of the fruit of the vine, until the kingdom of God shall come.

entries.yo: O si mú akara, nigbati o si ti dupẹ o bu u, o si fifun wọn, o wipe, Eyi li ara mi ti a fifun nyin: ẹ mã ṣe eyi ni iranti mi.
entries.en: And he took bread, and gave thanks, and brake it, and gave unto them, saying, This is my body which is given for you: this do in remembrance of me.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ gẹgẹ lẹhin onjẹ alẹ, o si mu ago, o wipe, Ago yi ni majẹmu titun li ẹ̀jẹ mi, ti a ta silẹ fun nyin.
entries.en: Likewise also the cup after supper, saying, This cup is the new testament in my blood, which is shed for you.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹ kiyesi i, ọwọ́ ẹniti o fi mi hàn wà pẹlu mi lori tabili.
entries.en: But, behold, the hand of him that betrayeth me is with me on the table.

entries.yo: Ọmọ-enia nlọ nitõtọ bi a ti pinnu rẹ̀: ṣugbọn egbé ni fun ọkunrin na nipasẹ ẹniti a gbé ti fi i hàn!
entries.en: And truly the Son of man goeth, as it was determined: but woe unto that man by whom he is betrayed!

entries.yo: Nwọn si bẹ̀rẹ si ibère larin ara wọn, tani ninu wọn ti yio ṣe nkan yi.
entries.en: And they began to inquire among themselves, which of them it was that should do this thing.

entries.yo: Ijà kan si mbẹ larin wọn, niti ẹniti a kà si olori ninu wọn.
entries.en: And there was also a strife among them, which of them should be accounted the greatest.

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Awọn ọba Keferi a ma fẹla lori wọn: a si ma pè awọn alaṣẹ wọn ni olõre.
entries.en: And he said unto them, The kings of the Gentiles exercise lordship over them; and they that exercise authority upon them are called benefactors.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹnyin kì yio ri bẹ̃: ṣugbọn ẹniti o ba pọ̀ju ninu nyin ki o jẹ bi aburo; ẹniti o si ṣe olori, bi ẹniti nṣe iranṣẹ.
entries.en: But ye shall not be so: but he that is greatest among you, let him be as the younger; and he that is chief, as he that doth serve.

entries.yo: Nitori tali o pọ̀ju, ẹniti o joko tì onjẹ, tabi ẹniti o nṣe iranṣẹ? ẹniti o joko tì onjẹ ha kọ́? ṣugbọn emi mbẹ larin nyin bi ẹniti nṣe iranṣẹ.
entries.en: For whether is greater, he that sitteth at meat, or he that serveth? is not he that sitteth at meat? but I am among you as he that serveth.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin li awọn ti o ti duro tì mi ninu idanwo mi.
entries.en: Ye are they which have continued with me in my temptations.

entries.yo: Mo si yàn ijọba fun nyin, gẹgẹ bi Baba mi ti yàn fun mi;
entries.en: And I appoint unto you a kingdom, as my Father hath appointed unto me;

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o le mã jẹ, ki ẹnyin ki o si le mã mu lori tabili mi ni ijọba mi, ki ẹnyin ki o le joko lori itẹ́, ati ki ẹnyin ki o le mã ṣe idajọ fun awọn ẹ̀ya Israeli mejila.
entries.en: That ye may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom, and sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

entries.yo: Oluwa si wipe, Simoni, Simoni, sawõ, Satani fẹ lati ni ọ, ki o le kù ọ bi alikama:
entries.en: And the Lord said, Simon, Simon, behold, Satan hath desired to have you, that he may sift you as wheat:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn mo ti gbadura fun ọ, ki igbagbọ́ rẹ ki o má yẹ̀; ati iwọ nigbati iwọ ba si yipada, mu awọn arakunrin rẹ li ọkàn le.
entries.en: But I have prayed for thee, that thy faith fail not: and when thou art converted, strengthen thy brethren.

entries.yo: O si wi fun u pe, Oluwa, mo mura tan lati bá ọ lọ sinu tubu, ati si ikú.
entries.en: And he said unto him, Lord, I am ready to go with thee, both into prison, and to death.

entries.yo: O si wipe, Mo wi fun ọ, Peteru, akukọ ki yio kọ loni ti iwọ o fi sẹ́ mi li ẹrinmẹta pe, iwọ kò mọ̀ mi.
entries.en: And he said, I tell thee, Peter, the cock shall not crow this day, before that thou shalt thrice deny that thou knowest me.

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Nigbati mo rán nyin lọ laini asuwọn, ati àpo, ati bàta, ọdá ohun kan da nyin bi? Nwọn si wipe, Rara o.
entries.en: And he said unto them, When I sent you without purse, and scrip, and shoes, lacked ye any thing? And they said, Nothing.

entries.yo: Nigbana li o wi fun wọn pe, Ṣugbọn nisisiyi, ẹniti o ba li asuwọn, ki o mu u, ati àpo pẹlu: ẹniti kò ba si ni idà, ki o tà aṣọ rẹ̀, ki o si fi rà kan.
entries.en: Then said he unto them, But now, he that hath a purse, let him take it, and likewise his scrip: and he that hath no sword, let him sell his garment, and buy one.

entries.yo: Nitori mo wi fun nyin pe, Eyi ti a ti kọwe rẹ̀ kò le ṣe ki o má ṣẹ lara mi, A si kà a mọ awọn arufin. Nitori ohun wọnni nipa ti emi o li opin.
entries.en: For I say unto you, that this that is written must yet be accomplished in me, And he was reckoned among the transgressors: for the things concerning me have an end.

entries.yo: Nwọn si wipe, Oluwa, sawõ, idà meji mbẹ nihinyi. O si wi fun wọn pe, O to.
entries.en: And they said, Lord, behold, here are two swords. And he said unto them, It is enough.

entries.yo: O si jade, o si lọ bi iṣe rẹ̀ si òke Olifi; awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ si tọ̀ ọ lẹhin.
entries.en: And he came out, and went, as he was wont, to the mount of Olives; and his disciples also followed him.

entries.yo: Nigbati o wà nibẹ̀, o wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ mã gbadura, ki ẹnyin ki o máṣe bọ sinu idẹwò.
entries.en: And when he was at the place, he said unto them, Pray that ye enter not into temptation.

entries.yo: O si fi wọn silẹ niwọn isọko kan, o si kunlẹ o si ngbadura,
entries.en: And he was withdrawn from them about a stone's cast, and kneeled down, and prayed,

entries.yo: Wipe, Baba, bi iwọ ba fẹ, gbà ago yi lọwọ mi: ṣugbọn ifẹ ti emi kọ́, bikoṣe tirẹ ni ki a ṣe.
entries.en: Saying, Father, if thou be willing, remove this cup from me: nevertheless not my will, but thine, be done.

entries.yo: Angẹli kan si yọ si i lati ọrun wá, o ngbà a ni iyanju.
entries.en: And there appeared an angel unto him from heaven, strengthening him.

entries.yo: Bi o si ti wà ni iwaya-ija o ngbadura si i kikankikan: õgùn rẹ̀ si dabi iro ẹ̀jẹ nla, o nkán silẹ.
entries.en: And being in an agony he prayed more earnestly: and his sweat was as it were great drops of blood falling down to the ground.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si dide kuro ni ibi adura, ti o si tọ̀ awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ wá, o ba wọn, nwọn nsùn fun ibanujẹ,
entries.en: And when he rose up from prayer, and was come to his disciples, he found them sleeping for sorrow,

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Kili ẹnyin nsùn si? ẹ dide, ẹ mã gbadura, ki ẹnyin ki o máṣe bọ́ sinu idẹwò.
entries.en: And said unto them, Why sleep ye? rise and pray, lest ye enter into temptation.

entries.yo: Bi o si ti nsọ lọwọ, kiyesi i, ọ̀pọ enia, ati ẹniti a npè ni Judasi, ọkan ninu awọn mejila, o ṣaju wọn o sunmọ Jesu lati fi ẹnu kò o li ẹnu.
entries.en: And while he yet spake, behold a multitude, and he that was called Judas, one of the twelve, went before them, and drew near unto Jesus to kiss him.

entries.yo: Jesu si wi fun u pe, Judasi, iwọ fi ifẹnukonu fi Ọmọ-enia hàn?
entries.en: But Jesus said unto him, Judas, betrayest thou the Son of man with a kiss?

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn ti o wà lọdọ rẹ̀ ri bi yio ti jasi, nwọn bi i pe, Oluwa, ki awa ki o fi idà ṣá wọn?
entries.en: When they which were about him saw what would follow, they said unto him, Lord, shall we smite with the sword?

entries.yo: Ọkan ninu wọn si fi idà ṣá ọmọ-ọdọ olori alufa, o si ke etí ọtún rẹ̀ sọnù.
entries.en: And one of them smote the servant of the high priest, and cut off his right ear.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Jesu dahùn o wipe, Ẹ jọwọ rẹ̀ bayi na. O si fi ọwọ́ tọ́ ọ li etí, o si wò o sàn.
entries.en: And Jesus answered and said, Suffer ye thus far. And he touched his ear, and healed him.

entries.yo: Jesu si wi fun awọn olori alufa, ati awọn olori ẹṣọ́ tẹmpili, ati awọn agbagba, ti nwọn jade tọ̀ ọ wá, pe, Ẹnyin ha jade wá ti ẹnyin ti idà ati ọgọ bi ẹni tọ ọlọṣa wá?
entries.en: Then Jesus said unto the chief priests, and captains of the temple, and the elders, which were come to him, Be ye come out, as against a thief, with swords and staves?

entries.yo: Nigbati emi wà pẹlu nyin lojojumọ ni tẹmpili, ẹnyin ko nà ọwọ́ mu mi: ṣugbọn akokò ti nyin li eyi, ati agbara òkunkun.
entries.en: When I was daily with you in the temple, ye stretched forth no hands against me: but this is your hour, and the power of darkness.

entries.yo: Nwọn si gbá a mu, nwọn si fà a lọ, nwọn si mu u wá si ile olori alufa. Ṣugbọn Peteru tọ̀ ọ lẹhin li òkere.
entries.en: Then took they him, and led him, and brought him into the high priest's house. And Peter followed afar off.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si ti dana larin gbọ̀ngan, ti nwọn si joko pọ̀, Peteru joko larin wọn.
entries.en: And when they had kindled a fire in the midst of the hall, and were set down together, Peter sat down among them.

entries.yo: Ọmọbinrin kan si ri i bi o ti joko nibi imọlẹ iná na, o si tẹjumọ́ ọ, o ni, Eleyi na wà pẹlu rẹ̀.
entries.en: But a certain maid beheld him as he sat by the fire, and earnestly looked upon him, and said, This man was also with him.

entries.yo: O si sẹ́, o wipe, Obinrin yi, emi ko mọ̀ ọ.
entries.en: And he denied him, saying, Woman, I know him not.

entries.yo: Kò pẹ lẹhin na ẹlomiran si ri i, o ni, Iwọ pẹlu wà ninu wọn. Ṣugbọn Peteru wipe, ọkunrin yi, Emi kọ.
entries.en: And after a little while another saw him, and said, Thou art also of them. And Peter said, Man, I am not.

entries.yo: O si to iwọn wakati kan ẹlomiran gidigidi tẹnumọ́ ọ, nwipe, Nitõtọ eleyi na wà pẹlu rẹ̀: nitori ara Galili ni iṣe.
entries.en: And about the space of one hour after another confidently affirmed, saying, Of a truth this fellow also was with him: for he is a Galilaean.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Peteru wipe, ọkunrin yi, emi kò mọ̀ ohun ti iwọ nwi. Lojukanna, bi o ti nwi li ẹnu, akukọ kọ.
entries.en: And Peter said, Man, I know not what thou sayest. And immediately, while he yet spake, the cock crew.

entries.yo: Oluwa si yipada, o wò Peteru. Peteru si ranti ọ̀rọ Oluwa, bi o ti wi fun u pe, Ki akukọ ki o to kọ, iwọ o sẹ́ mi li ẹrinmẹta.
entries.en: And the Lord turned, and looked upon Peter. And Peter remembered the word of the Lord, how he had said unto him, Before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice.

entries.yo: Peteru si bọ si ode, o sọkun kikorò.
entries.en: And Peter went out, and wept bitterly.

entries.yo: Awọn ọkunrin ti nwọn mu Jesu, si fi i ṣe ẹlẹyà, nwọn lù u.
entries.en: And the men that held Jesus mocked him, and smote him.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si dì i loju, nwọn lù u niwaju, nwọn mbi i pe, Sọtẹlẹ, tani lù ọ nì?
entries.en: And when they had blindfolded him, they struck him on the face, and asked him, saying, Prophesy, who is it that smote thee?

entries.yo: Ati nkan pipọ miran ni nwọn nfi ọ̀rọ-òdi sọ si i.
entries.en: And many other things blasphemously spake they against him.

entries.yo: Nigbati ilẹ si mọ́, awọn àgba awọn enia, ati awọn olori alufa, ati awọn akọwe pejọ, nwọn si fà a wá si ajọ wọn, nwọn nwipe,
entries.en: And as soon as it was day, the elders of the people and the chief priests and the scribes came together, and led him into their council, saying,

entries.yo: Bi iwọ ba iṣe Kristi na? sọ fun wa. O si wi fun wọn pe, Bi mo ba wi fun nyin, ẹnyin ki yio gbagbọ́:
entries.en: Art thou the Christ? tell us. And he said unto them, If I tell you, ye will not believe:

entries.yo: Bi mo ba si bi nyin lẽre pẹlu, ẹnyin kì yio da mi lohùn, bẹ̃li ẹnyin kì yio jọwọ mi lọwọ lọ.
entries.en: And if I also ask you, ye will not answer me, nor let me go.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn lati isisiyi lọ li Ọmọ-enia yio joko li ọwọ́ ọtún agbara Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Hereafter shall the Son of man sit on the right hand of the power of God.

entries.yo: Gbogbo wọn si wipe, Iwọ ha ṣe Ọmọ Ọlọrun bi? O si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹnyin wipe, emi ni.
entries.en: Then said they all, Art thou then the Son of God? And he said unto them, Ye say that I am.

entries.yo: Nwọn si wipe, Kili awa nfẹ ẹlẹri mọ́ si? Awa tikarawa sá ti gbọ́ li ẹnu ara rẹ̀.
entries.en: And they said, What need we any further witness? for we ourselves have heard of his own mouth.

entries.yo: GBOGBO ijọ enia si dide, nwọn si fà a lọ si ọdọ Pilatu.
entries.en: And the whole multitude of them arose, and led him unto Pilate.

entries.yo: Nwọn si bẹ̀rẹ si ifi i sùn, wipe, Awa ri ọkunrin yi o nyi orilẹ-ede wa li ọkàn pada, o si nda wọn lẹkun lati san owode fun Kesari, o nwipe on tikara-on ni Kristi ọba.
entries.en: And they began to accuse him, saying, We found this fellow perverting the nation, and forbidding to give tribute to Caesar, saying that he himself is Christ a King.

entries.yo: Pilatu si bi i lẽre, wipe, Iwọ ha li ọba awọn Ju? O si da a lohùn wipe, Iwọ wi i.
entries.en: And Pilate asked him, saying, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answered him and said, Thou sayest it.

entries.yo: Pilatu si wi fun awọn olori alufa ati fun ijọ enia pe, Emi kò ri ẹ̀ṣẹ lọwọ ọkunrin yi.
entries.en: Then said Pilate to the chief priests and to the people, I find no fault in this man.

entries.yo: Nwọn si tubọ tẹnumọ ọ pe, O nrú awọn enia soke, o nkọ́ni ká gbogbo Judea, o bẹ̀rẹ lati Galili wá titi o fi de ihinyi.
entries.en: And they were the more fierce, saying, He stirreth up the people, teaching throughout all Jewry, beginning from Galilee to this place.

entries.yo: Nigbati Pilatu gbọ́ orukọ Galili, o bère bi ọkunrin na iṣe ara Galili.
entries.en: When Pilate heard of Galilee, he asked whether the man were a Galilaean.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si mọ̀ pe ara ilẹ Herodu ni, o rán a si Herodu, ẹniti on tikararẹ̀ wà ni Jerusalemu li akokò na.
entries.en: And as soon as he knew that he belonged unto Herod's jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who himself also was at Jerusalem at that time.

entries.yo: Nigbati Herodu si ri Jesu, o yọ̀ gidigidi: nitoriti o ti nfẹ ẹ ri pẹ́, o sa ti ngbọ́ ìhin pipọ nitori rẹ̀; o si tanmọ̃ ati ri ki iṣẹ iyanu diẹ ki o ti ọwọ́ rẹ̀ ṣe.
entries.en: And when Herod saw Jesus, he was exceeding glad: for he was desirous to see him of a long season, because he had heard many things of him; and he hoped to have seen some miracle done by him.

entries.yo: O si bère ọ̀rọ pipọ lọwọ rẹ̀; ṣugbọn kò da a lohùn kanṣoṣo.
entries.en: Then he questioned with him in many words; but he answered him nothing.

entries.yo: Ati awọn olori alufa ati awọn akọwe duro, nwọn si nfi i sùn gidigidi.
entries.en: And the chief priests and scribes stood and vehemently accused him.

entries.yo: Ati Herodu ti on ti awọn ọmọ-ogun rẹ̀, nwọn kẹgan rẹ̀, nwọn si nfi i ṣẹsin, nwọn wọ̀ ọ li aṣọ daradara, o si rán a pada tọ̀ Pilatu lọ.
entries.en: And Herod with his men of war set him at nought, and mocked him, and arrayed him in a gorgeous robe, and sent him again to Pilate.

entries.yo: Pilatu on Herodu di ọrẹ́ ara wọn ni ijọ na: nitori latijọ ọtá ara wọn ni nwọn ti nṣe ri.
entries.en: And the same day Pilate and Herod were made friends together: for before they were at enmity between themselves.

entries.yo: Nigbati Pilatu si ti pè awọn olori alufa ati awọn olori ati awọn enia jọ,
entries.en: And Pilate, when he had called together the chief priests and the rulers and the people,

entries.yo: O sọ fun wọn pe, Ẹnyin mu ọkunrin yi tọ̀ mi wá, bi ẹni ti o npa awọn enia li ọkàn dà: si kiyesi i, emi wadi ẹjọ rẹ̀ niwaju nyin, emi kò si ri ẹ̀ṣẹ lọwọ ọkunrin yi, ni gbogbo nkan wọnyi ti ẹnyin fi i sùn si:
entries.en: Said unto them, Ye have brought this man unto me, as one that perverteth the people: and, behold, I, having examined him before you, have found no fault in this man touching those things whereof ye accuse him:

entries.yo: Ati Herodu pẹlu: o sá rán a pada tọ̀ wa wá; si kiyesi i, ohun kan ti o yẹ si ikú a ko ṣe si i ti ọwọ́ rẹ̀ wá.
entries.en: No, nor yet Herod: for I sent you to him; and, lo, nothing worthy of death is done unto him.

entries.yo: Njẹ emi ó nà a, emi ó si jọwọ rẹ̀ lọwọ lọ.
entries.en: I will therefore chastise him, and release him.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn kò le ṣe aidá ọkan silẹ fun wọn nigba ajọ irekọja.
entries.en: (For of necessity he must release one unto them at the feast.)

entries.yo: Nwọn si kigbe soke lọwọ kanna, wipe, Mu ọkunrin yi kuro, ki o si dá Barabba silẹ fun wa:
entries.en: And they cried out all at once, saying, Away with this man, and release unto us Barabbas:

entries.yo: Ẹniti a sọ sinu tubu nitori ọ̀tẹ kan ti a ṣe ni ilu, ati nitori ipania.
entries.en: (Who for a certain sedition made in the city, and for murder, was cast into prison.)

entries.yo: Pilatu si tun ba wọn sọrọ, nitori o fẹ da Jesu silẹ.
entries.en: Pilate therefore, willing to release Jesus, spake again to them.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nwọn kigbe, wipe, Kàn a mọ agbelebu, kàn a mọ agbelebu.
entries.en: But they cried, saying, Crucify him, crucify him.

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn li ẹrinkẹta pe, Ẽṣe, buburu kili ọkunrin yi ṣe? emi ko ri ọ̀ran ikú lara rẹ̀: nitorina emi o nà a, emi a si jọwọ rẹ̀ lọwọ lọ.
entries.en: And he said unto them the third time, Why, what evil hath he done? I have found no cause of death in him: I will therefore chastise him, and let him go.

entries.yo: Nwọn tilẹ̀ kirimọ́ igbe nla, nwọn nfẹ ki a kàn a mọ agbelebu. Ohùn ti wọn ati ti awọn olori alufa bori tirẹ̀.
entries.en: And they were instant with loud voices, requiring that he might be crucified. And the voices of them and of the chief priests prevailed.

entries.yo: Pilatu si fi aṣẹ si i pe, ki o ri bi nwọn ti nfẹ.
entries.en: And Pilate gave sentence that it should be as they required.

entries.yo: O si dá ẹniti nwọn fẹ silẹ fun wọn, ẹniti a titori ọ̀tẹ ati ipania sọ sinu tubu; ṣugbọn o fi Jesu le wọn lọwọ.
entries.en: And he released unto them him that for sedition and murder was cast into prison, whom they had desired; but he delivered Jesus to their will.

entries.yo: Bi nwọn si ti nfà a lọ, nwọn mu ọkunrin kan, Simoni ara Kirene, ti o nti igberiko bọ̀, on ni nwọn si gbé agbelebu na le, ki o mã rù u bọ̀ tẹle Jesu.
entries.en: And as they led him away, they laid hold upon one Simon, a Cyrenian, coming out of the country, and on him they laid the cross, that he might bear it after Jesus.

entries.yo: Ijọ enia pipọ li o ntọ̀ ọ lẹhin, ati awọn obinrin, ti npohùnrere ẹkún, ti nwọn si nṣe idarò rẹ̀.
entries.en: And there followed him a great company of people, and of women, which also bewailed and lamented him.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Jesu yiju pada si wọn, o si wipe, Ẹnyin ọmọbinrin Jerusalemu, ẹ má sọkun fun mi, ṣugbọn ẹ sọkun fun ara nyin, ati fun awọn ọmọ nyin.
entries.en: But Jesus turning unto them said, Daughters of Jerusalem, weep not for me, but weep for yourselves, and for your children.

entries.yo: Nitori kiyesi i, ọjọ mbọ̀ li eyiti ẹnyin o wipe, Ibukun ni fun àgan, ati fun inu ti kò bímọ ri, ati fun ọmú ti kò funni mu ri.
entries.en: For, behold, the days are coming, in the which they shall say, Blessed are the barren, and the wombs that never bare, and the paps which never gave suck.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni nwọn o bẹ̀rẹ si iwi fun awọn òke nla pe, Wó lù wa; ati fun awọn òke kekeke pe, Bò wa mọlẹ.
entries.en: Then shall they begin to say to the mountains, Fall on us; and to the hills, Cover us.

entries.yo: Nitori bi nwọn ba nṣe nkan wọnyi sara igi tutù, kili a o ṣe sara gbigbẹ?
entries.en: For if they do these things in a green tree, what shall be done in the dry?

entries.yo: Nwọn si fà awọn meji lọ pẹlu, awọn arufin, lati pa pẹlu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And there were also two other, malefactors, led with him to be put to death.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si de ibi ti a npè ni Agbari, nibẹ̀ ni nwọn gbé kàn a mọ agbelebu, ati awọn arufin na, ọkan li ọwọ́ ọtún, ati ọkan li ọwọ́ òsi.
entries.en: And when they were come to the place, which is called Calvary, there they crucified him, and the malefactors, one on the right hand, and the other on the left.

entries.yo: Jesu si wipe, Baba, darijì wọn; nitoriti nwọn kò mọ̀ ohun ti nwọn nṣe. Nwọn si pín aṣọ rẹ̀ lãrin ara wọn, nwọn di ìbo rẹ̀.
entries.en: Then said Jesus, Father, forgive them; for they know not what they do. And they parted his raiment, and cast lots.

entries.yo: Awọn enia si duro nworan. Ati awọn ijoye pẹlu wọn, nwọn nyọ-ṣùti si i, wipe, O gbà awọn ẹlomiran là; ki o gbà ara rẹ̀ là, bi iba ṣe Kristi, ayanfẹ Ọlọrun.
entries.en: And the people stood beholding. And the rulers also with them derided him, saying, He saved others; let him save himself, if he be Christ, the chosen of God.

entries.yo: Ati awọn ọmọ-ogun pẹlu nfi i ṣe ẹlẹyà, nwọn tọ̀ ọ wá, nwọn nfi ọti kikan fun u,
entries.en: And the soldiers also mocked him, coming to him, and offering him vinegar,

entries.yo: Nwọn si nwipe, Bi iwọ ba ṣe Ọba awọn Ju, gbà ara rẹ là.
entries.en: And saying, If thou be the king of the Jews, save thyself.

entries.yo: Nwọn si kọwe akọlé si ìgbèri rẹ̀ ni ède Hellene, ati ti Latini, ati ti Heberu, EYI LI ỌBA AWỌN JU.
entries.en: And a superscription also was written over him in letters of Greek, and Latin, and Hebrew, THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.

entries.yo: Ati ọkan ninu awọn arufin ti a gbe kọ́ nfi ṣe ẹlẹyà wipe, Bi iwọ ba ṣe Kristi, gbà ara rẹ ati awa là.
entries.en: And one of the malefactors which were hanged railed on him, saying, If thou be Christ, save thyself and us.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn eyi ekeji dahùn, o mba a wipe, Iwọ kò bẹ̀ru Ọlọrun, ti iwọ wà ninu ẹbi kanna?
entries.en: But the other answering rebuked him, saying, Dost not thou fear God, seeing thou art in the same condemnation?

entries.yo: Niti wa, nwọn jare nitori ère ohun ti a ṣe li awa njẹ: ṣugbọn ọkunrin yi kò ṣe ohun buburu kan.
entries.en: And we indeed justly; for we receive the due reward of our deeds: but this man hath done nothing amiss.

entries.yo: O si wipe, Jesu, ranti mi nigbati iwọ ba de ijọba rẹ.
entries.en: And he said unto Jesus, Lord, remember me when thou comest into thy kingdom.

entries.yo: Jesu si wi fun u pe, Lõtọ ni mo wi fun ọ, Loni ni iwọ o wà pẹlu mi ni Paradise.
entries.en: And Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, To day shalt thou be with me in paradise.

entries.yo: O si to ìwọn wakati kẹfa ọjọ, òkunkun si ṣú bò gbogbo ilẹ titi o fi di wakati kẹsan ọjọ.
entries.en: And it was about the sixth hour, and there was a darkness over all the earth until the ninth hour.

entries.yo: Õrùn si ṣú õkun, aṣọ ikele ti tẹmpili si ya li agbedemeji.
entries.en: And the sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was rent in the midst.

entries.yo: Nigbati Jesu si kigbe li ohùn rara, o ni, Baba, li ọwọ́ rẹ ni mo fi ẹmí mi le: nigbati o si wi eyi tan, o jọwọ ẹmí rẹ̀ lọwọ.
entries.en: And when Jesus had cried with a loud voice, he said, Father, into thy hands I commend my spirit: and having said thus, he gave up the ghost.

entries.yo: Nigbati balogun ọrún ri ohun ti o ṣe, o yìn Ọlọrun logo, wipe, Dajudaju olododo li ọkunrin yi.
entries.en: Now when the centurion saw what was done, he glorified God, saying, Certainly this was a righteous man.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ijọ enia ti o pejọ si iran yi, nigbati nwọn nwò ohun ti nṣe, nwọn a lù ara wọn li õkan àiya, nwọn a si pada.
entries.en: And all the people that came together to that sight, beholding the things which were done, smote their breasts, and returned.

entries.yo: Ati gbogbo awọn ojulumọ̀ rẹ̀, ati awọn obinrin ti ntọ̀ ọ lẹhin lati Galili wá, nwọn duro li òkere, nwọn nwò nkan wọnyi.
entries.en: And all his acquaintance, and the women that followed him from Galilee, stood afar off, beholding these things.

entries.yo: Si kiyesi i, ọkunrin kan ti a npè ni Josefu, ìgbimọ, enia rere, ati olõtọ,
entries.en: And, behold, there was a man named Joseph, a counseller; and he was a good man, and a just:

entries.yo: (On kò ba wọn li ohùn ni ìmọ ati iṣe wọn), ara Arimatea, ilu awọn Ju kan, ẹniti on pẹlu nreti ijọba Ọlọrun;
entries.en: (The same had not consented to the counsel and deed of them;) he was of Arimathaea, a city of the Jews: who also himself waited for the kingdom of God.

entries.yo: Ọkunrin yi tọ̀ Pilatu lọ, o si tọrọ okú Jesu.
entries.en: This man went unto Pilate, and begged the body of Jesus.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si sọ̀ ọ kalẹ, o si fi aṣọ àla dì i, o si tẹ́ ẹ sinu ibojì ti a gbẹ́ ninu okuta, nibiti a kò ti itẹ́ ẹnikẹni si ri.
entries.en: And he took it down, and wrapped it in linen, and laid it in a sepulchre that was hewn in stone, wherein never man before was laid.

entries.yo: O si ṣe ọjọ Ipalẹmọ: ọjọ isimi si kù si dẹ̀dẹ.
entries.en: And that day was the preparation, and the sabbath drew on.

entries.yo: Ati awọn obinrin, ti nwọn bá a ti Galili wá, ti nwọn si tẹle, nwọn kiyesi ibojì na, ati bi a ti tẹ́ okú rẹ̀ si.
entries.en: And the women also, which came with him from Galilee, followed after, and beheld the sepulchre, and how his body was laid.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si pada, nwọn pèse ohun olõrun didùn ororo ikunra ati turari tutù; nwọn si simi li ọjọ isimi gẹgẹ bi ofin.
entries.en: And they returned, and prepared spices and ointments; and rested the sabbath day according to the commandment.

entries.yo: Ni ijọ kini ọ̀sẹ, ni kutukutu owurọ̀, nwọn wá si ibojì, nwọn nmu turari wá ti nwọn ti pèse silẹ, ati awọn miran kan pẹlu wọn.
entries.en: Now upon the first day of the week, very early in the morning, they came unto the sepulchre, bringing the spices which they had prepared, and certain others with them.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ba a, a ti yi okuta kuro li ẹnu ibojì.
entries.en: And they found the stone rolled away from the sepulchre.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn wọ̀ inu rẹ̀, nwọn kò si ri okú Jesu Oluwa.
entries.en: And they entered in, and found not the body of the Lord Jesus.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, bi nwọn ti nṣe rọunrọ̀un kiri niha ibẹ̀, kiyesi i, awọn ọkunrin meji alaṣọ didan duro tì wọn:
entries.en: And it came to pass, as they were much perplexed thereabout, behold, two men stood by them in shining garments:

entries.yo: Nigbati ẹ̀ru mbà wọn, ti nwọn si dojubolẹ, awọn angẹli na bi wọn pe, Ẽṣe ti ẹnyin fi nwá alãye lãrin awọn okú?
entries.en: And as they were afraid, and bowed down their faces to the earth, they said unto them, Why seek ye the living among the dead?

entries.yo: Ko si nihinyi, ṣugbọn o jinde: ẹ ranti bi o ti wi fun nyin nigbati o wà ni Galili,
entries.en: He is not here, but is risen: remember how he spake unto you when he was yet in Galilee,

entries.yo: Pe, A ko le ṣaima fi Ọmọ-enia le awọn enia ẹlẹsẹ lọwọ, a o si kàn a mọ agbelebu, ni ijọ kẹta yio si jinde.
entries.en: Saying, The Son of man must be delivered into the hands of sinful men, and be crucified, and the third day rise again.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ranti ọ̀rọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And they remembered his words,

entries.yo: Nwọn si pada ti ibojì wá, nwọn si ròhin gbogbo nkan wọnyi fun awọn mọkanla, ati fun gbogbo awọn iyokù.
entries.en: And returned from the sepulchre, and told all these things unto the eleven, and to all the rest.

entries.yo: Maria Magdalene, ati Joanna, ati Maria, iya Jakọbu, ati awọn omiran pẹlu wọn si ni, ti nwọn ròhin nkan wọnyi fun awọn aposteli.
entries.en: It was Mary Magdalene, and Joanna, and Mary the mother of James, and other women that were with them, which told these things unto the apostles.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ wọnyi si dabi isọkusọ loju wọn, nwọn kò si gbà wọn gbọ́.
entries.en: And their words seemed to them as idle tales, and they believed them not.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Peteru dide, o sure lọ si ibojì; nigbati o si bẹ̀rẹ, o ri aṣọ àla li ọ̀tọ fun ara wọn, o si pada lọ ile rẹ̀, ẹnu yà a si ohun ti o ṣe.
entries.en: Then arose Peter, and ran unto the sepulchre; and stooping down, he beheld the linen clothes laid by themselves, and departed, wondering in himself at that which was come to pass.

entries.yo: Si kiyesi i, awọn meji ninu wọn nlọ ni ijọ na si iletò kan ti a npè ni Emmausi, ti o jina si Jerusalemu niwọn ọgọta furlongi.
entries.en: And, behold, two of them went that same day to a village called Emmaus, which was from Jerusalem about threescore furlongs.

entries.yo: Nwọn mba ara wọn sọ̀rọ gbogbo nkan wọnyi ti o ṣẹlẹ̀.
entries.en: And they talked together of all these things which had happened.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati nwọn mba ara wọn sọ, ti nwọn si mba ara wọn jirorò, Jesu tikararẹ̀ sunmọ wọn, o si mba wọn rìn lọ.
entries.en: And it came to pass, that, while they communed together and reasoned, Jesus himself drew near, and went with them.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn a rú wọn li oju ki nwọn ki o máṣe le mọ̀ ọ.
entries.en: But their eyes were holden that they should not know him.

entries.yo: O si bi wọn pe, Ọ̀rọ kili ẹnyin mba ara nyin sọ, bi ẹnyin ti nrìn? Nwọn si duro jẹ, nwọn fajuro.
entries.en: And he said unto them, What manner of communications are these that ye have one to another, as ye walk, and are sad?

entries.yo: Ọkan ninu wọn, ti a npè ni Kleopa, si dahùn wi fun u pe, Alejò ṣá ni iwọ ni Jerusalemu, ti iwọ kò si mọ̀ ohun ti o ṣe nibẹ̀ li ọjọ wọnyi?
entries.en: And the one of them, whose name was Cleopas, answering said unto him, Art thou only a stranger in Jerusalem, and hast not known the things which are come to pass therein these days?

entries.yo: O si bi wọn pe, Kini? Nwọn si wi fun u pe, Niti Jesu ti Nasareti, ẹniti iṣe woli, ti o pọ̀ ni iṣẹ ati li ọ̀rọ niwaju Ọlọrun ati gbogbo enia:
entries.en: And he said unto them, What things? And they said unto him, Concerning Jesus of Nazareth, which was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people:

entries.yo: Ati bi awọn olori alufa ati awọn alàgba wa ti fi i le wọn lọwọ lati da a lẹbi iku, ati bi nwọn ti kàn a mọ agbelebu.
entries.en: And how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him to be condemned to death, and have crucified him.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni on li awa ti ni ireti pe, on ni iba da Israeli ni ìde. Ati pẹlu gbogbo nkan wọnyi, oni li o di ijọ kẹta ti nkan wọnyi ti ṣẹ.
entries.en: But we trusted that it had been he which should have redeemed Israel: and beside all this, to day is the third day since these things were done.

entries.yo: Awọn obinrin kan pẹlu li ẹgbẹ wa, ti nwọn lọ si ibojì ni kutukutu, si wá idá wa nijì;
entries.en: Yea, and certain women also of our company made us astonished, which were early at the sepulchre;

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn kò si ri okú rẹ̀, nwọn wá wipe, awọn ri iran awọn angẹli ti nwọn wipe, o wà lãye.
entries.en: And when they found not his body, they came, saying, that they had also seen a vision of angels, which said that he was alive.

entries.yo: Ati awọn kan ti nwọn wà pẹlu wa lọ si ibojì, nwọn si ri i gẹgẹ bi awọn obinrin ti wi: ṣugbọn on tikararẹ̀ ni nwọn kò ri.
entries.en: And certain of them which were with us went to the sepulchre, and found it even so as the women had said: but him they saw not.

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹnyin ti oyé ko yé, ti o si yigbì li àiya lati gbà gbogbo eyi ti awọn woli ti wi gbọ́:
entries.en: Then he said unto them, O fools, and slow of heart to believe all that the prophets have spoken:

entries.yo: Ko ha yẹ ki Kristi ki o jìya nkan wọnyi ki o si wọ̀ inu ogo rẹ̀ lọ?
entries.en: Ought not Christ to have suffered these things, and to enter into his glory?

entries.yo: O si bẹ̀rẹ lati Mose ati gbogbo awọn woli wá, o si tumọ̀ nkan fun wọn ninu iwe-mimọ gbogbo nipa ti ara rẹ̀.
entries.en: And beginning at Moses and all the prophets, he expounded unto them in all the scriptures the things concerning himself.

entries.yo: Nwọn si sunmọ iletò ti nwọn nlọ: o si ṣe bi ẹnipe yio lọ si iwaju.
entries.en: And they drew nigh unto the village, whither they went: and he made as though he would have gone further.

entries.yo: Nwọn si rọ̀ ọ, wipe, Ba wa duro: nitori o di ọjọ alẹ, ọjọ si kọja tan. O si wọle lọ, o ba wọn duro.
entries.en: But they constrained him, saying, Abide with us: for it is toward evening, and the day is far spent. And he went in to tarry with them.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, bi o ti ba wọn joko tì onjẹ, o mu àkara, o sure si i, o si bù u, o si fifun wọn.
entries.en: And it came to pass, as he sat at meat with them, he took bread, and blessed it, and brake, and gave to them.

entries.yo: Oju wọn si là, nwọn si mọ̀ ọ; o si nù mọ wọn li oju.
entries.en: And their eyes were opened, and they knew him; and he vanished out of their sight.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ba ara wọn sọ pe, Ọkàn wa kò ha gbiná ninu wa, nigbati o mba wa sọ̀rọ li ọna, ati nigbati o ntumọ̀ iwe-mimọ́ fun wa?
entries.en: And they said one to another, Did not our heart burn within us, while he talked with us by the way, and while he opened to us the scriptures?

entries.yo: Nwọn si dide ni wakati kanna, nwọn pada lọ si Jerusalemu, nwọn si ba awọn mọkanla pejọ, ati awọn ti mbẹ lọdọ wọn,
entries.en: And they rose up the same hour, and returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven gathered together, and them that were with them,

entries.yo: Nwipe, Oluwa jinde nitõtọ, o si ti fi ara hàn fun Simoni.
entries.en: Saying, The Lord is risen indeed, and hath appeared to Simon.

entries.yo: Nwọn si ròhin nkan ti o ṣe li ọ̀na, ati bi o ti di mimọ̀ fun wọn ni bibu àkara.
entries.en: And they told what things were done in the way, and how he was known of them in breaking of bread.

entries.yo: Bi nwọn si ti nsọ nkan wọnyi, Jesu tikararẹ̀ duro li arin wọn, o si wi fun wọn pe, Alafia fun nyin.
entries.en: And as they thus spake, Jesus himself stood in the midst of them, and saith unto them, Peace be unto you.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn àiya fò wọn, nwọn si dijì, nwọn ṣebi awọn rí iwin.
entries.en: But they were terrified and affrighted, and supposed that they had seen a spirit.

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Ẽṣe ti ara nyin kò lelẹ̀? ẽsitiṣe ti ìrokuro fi nsọ ninu ọkàn nyin?
entries.en: And he said unto them, Why are ye troubled? and why do thoughts arise in your hearts?

entries.yo: Ẹ wò ọwọ́ mi ati ẹsẹ mi, pe emi tikarami ni: ẹ dì mi mu ki ẹ wò o; nitoriti iwin kò li ẹran on egungun lara, bi ẹnyin ti ri ti mo ni.
entries.en: Behold my hands and my feet, that it is I myself: handle me, and see; for a spirit hath not flesh and bones, as ye see me have.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si wi bẹ̃ tán, o fi ọwọ́ on ẹsẹ rẹ̀ hàn wọn.
entries.en: And when he had thus spoken, he shewed them his hands and his feet.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn kò si tí igbagbọ́ fun ayọ̀, ati fun iyanu, o wi fun wọn pe, Ẹnyin ni ohunkohun jijẹ nihinyi?
entries.en: And while they yet believed not for joy, and wondered, he said unto them, Have ye here any meat?

entries.yo: Nwọn si fun u li ẹja bibu, ati afára oyin diẹ.
entries.en: And they gave him a piece of a broiled fish, and of an honeycomb.

entries.yo: O si gba a, o jẹ ẹ loju wọn.
entries.en: And he took it, and did eat before them.

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Nwọnyi li ọrọ ti mo sọ fun nyin, nigbati emi ti wà pẹlu nyin pe, A kò le ṣe alaimu ohun gbogbo ṣẹ, ti a ti kọ ninu ofin Mose, ati ninu iwe awọn woli, ati ninu Psalmu, nipasẹ̀ mi.
entries.en: And he said unto them, These are the words which I spake unto you, while I was yet with you, that all things must be fulfilled, which were written in the law of Moses, and in the prophets, and in the psalms, concerning me.

entries.yo: Nigbana li o ṣí wọn ni iyè, ki iwe-mimọ́ ki o le yé wọn,
entries.en: Then opened he their understanding, that they might understand the scriptures,

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Bẹ̃li a ti kọwe rẹ̀, pe, ki Kristi ki o jìya, ati ki o si jinde ni ijọ kẹta kuro ninu okú:
entries.en: And said unto them, Thus it is written, and thus it behoved Christ to suffer, and to rise from the dead the third day:

entries.yo: Ati ki a wasu ironupiwada ati idariji ẹ̀ṣẹ li orukọ rẹ̀, li orilẹ-ède gbogbo, bẹ̀rẹ lati Jerusalemu lọ.
entries.en: And that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name among all nations, beginning at Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin si ni ẹlẹri nkan wọnyi.
entries.en: And ye are witnesses of these things.

entries.yo: Si kiyesi i, Mo rán ileri Baba mi si nyin: ṣugbọn ẹ joko ni ilu Jerusalemu, titi a o fi fi agbara wọ̀ nyin, lati oke ọrun wá.
entries.en: And, behold, I send the promise of my Father upon you: but tarry ye in the city of Jerusalem, until ye be endued with power from on high.

entries.yo: O si mu wọn jade lọ titi nwọn fẹrẹ̀ de Betani, nigbati o si gbé ọwọ́ rẹ̀ soke, o sure fun wọn.
entries.en: And he led them out as far as to Bethany, and he lifted up his hands, and blessed them.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, bi o ti nsure fun wọn, a yà a kuro lọdọ wọn, a si gbé e lọ si ọrun.
entries.en: And it came to pass, while he blessed them, he was parted from them, and carried up into heaven.

entries.yo: Nwọn si foribalẹ̀ fun u, nwọn si pada lọ si Jerusalemu pẹlu ayọ̀ pipọ:
entries.en: And they worshipped him, and returned to Jerusalem with great joy:

entries.yo: Nwọn si wà ni tẹmpili nigbagbogbo, nwọn mbu iyin, nwọn si nfi ibukun fun Ọlọrun. Amin.
entries.en: And were continually in the temple, praising and blessing God. Amen.

entries.yo: LI àtetekọṣe li Ọ̀rọ wà, Ọ̀rọ si wà pẹlu Ọlọrun, Ọlọrun si li Ọ̀rọ na.
entries.en: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

entries.yo: On na li o wà li àtetekọṣe pẹlu Ọlọrun.
entries.en: The same was in the beginning with God.

entries.yo: Nipasẹ̀ rẹ̀ li a ti da ohun gbogbo; lẹhin rẹ̀ a ko si da ohun kan ninu ohun ti a da.
entries.en: All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.

entries.yo: Ninu rẹ̀ ni ìye wà; ìye na si ni imọlẹ̀ araiye.
entries.en: In him was life; and the life was the light of men.

entries.yo: Imọlẹ na si nmọlẹ ninu òkunkun; òkunkun na kò si bori rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not.

entries.yo: Ọkunrin kan wà ti a rán lati ọdọ Ọlọrun wá, orukọ ẹniti njẹ Johanu.
entries.en: There was a man sent from God, whose name was John.

entries.yo: On na li a si rán fun ẹri, ki o le ṣe ẹlẹri fun imọlẹ na, ki gbogbo enia ki o le gbagbọ́ nipasẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: The same came for a witness, to bear witness of the Light, that all men through him might believe.

entries.yo: On kì iṣe imọlẹ̀ na, ṣugbọn a rán a wá lati ṣe ẹlẹri fun Imọlẹ na.
entries.en: He was not that Light, but was sent to bear witness of that Light.

entries.yo: Imọlẹ otitọ mbẹ ti ntàn mọlẹ fun olúkulùku enia ti o wá si aiye.
entries.en: That was the true Light, which lighteth every man that cometh into the world.

entries.yo: On si wà li aiye, nipasẹ rẹ̀ li a si ti da aiye, aiye kò si mọ̀ ọ.
entries.en: He was in the world, and the world was made by him, and the world knew him not.

entries.yo: O tọ̀ awọn tirẹ̀ wá, awọn ará tirẹ̀ kò si gbà a.
entries.en: He came unto his own, and his own received him not.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn iye awọn ti o gbà a, awọn li o fi agbara fun lati di ọmọ Ọlọrun, ani awọn na ti o gbà orukọ rẹ̀ gbọ́:
entries.en: But as many as received him, to them gave he power to become the sons of God, even to them that believe on his name:

entries.yo: Awọn ẹniti a bí, kì iṣe nipa ti ẹ̀jẹ, tabi nipa ti ifẹ ara, bẹ̃ni kì iṣe nipa ifẹ ti enia, bikoṣe nipa ifẹ ti Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Which were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ na si di ara, on si mba wa gbé, (awa si nwò ogo rẹ̀, ogo bi ti ọmọ bíbi kanṣoṣo lati ọdọ Baba wá,) o kún fun ore-ọfẹ ati otitọ.
entries.en: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.

entries.yo: Johanu si jẹri rẹ̀ o si kigbe, wipe, Eyi ni ẹniti mo sọrọ rẹ̀ pe, Ẹniti mbọ̀ lẹhin mi, o pọ̀ju mi lọ: nitori o wà ṣiwaju mi.
entries.en: John bare witness of him, and cried, saying, This was he of whom I spake, He that cometh after me is preferred before me: for he was before me.

entries.yo: Nitori ninu ẹkún rẹ̀ ni gbogbo wa si ti gbà, ati ore-ọfẹ kún ore-ọfẹ.
entries.en: And of his fulness have all we received, and grace for grace.

entries.yo: Nitoripe nipasẹ Mose li a ti fi ofin funni, ṣugbọn ore-ọfẹ ati otitọ tipasẹ Jesu Kristi wá.
entries.en: For the law was given by Moses, but grace and truth came by Jesus Christ.

entries.yo: Ko si ẹniti o ri Ọlọrun rí; Ọmọ bíbi kanṣoṣo, ti mbẹ li õkan àiya Baba, on na li o fi i hàn.
entries.en: No man hath seen God at any time; the only begotten Son, which is in the bosom of the Father, he hath declared him.

entries.yo: Eyi si li ẹrí Johanu, nigbati awọn Ju rán awọn alufã ati awọn ọmọ Lefi lati Jerusalemu wá lati bi i lẽre pe, Tani iwọ ṣe?
entries.en: And this is the record of John, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, Who art thou?

entries.yo: O si jẹwọ, kò si sẹ́; o si jẹwọ pe, Emi kì iṣe Kristi na.
entries.en: And he confessed, and denied not; but confessed, I am not the Christ.

entries.yo: Nwọn si bi i pe, Tani iwọ ha iṣe? Elijah ni ọ bi? O si wipe Bẹ̃kọ. Iwọ ni woli na bi? O si dahùn wipe, Bẹ̃kọ.
entries.en: And they asked him, What then? Art thou Elias? And he saith, I am not. Art thou that prophet? And he answered, No.

entries.yo: Nitorina nwọn wi fun u pe, Tani iwọ iṣe? ki awa ki o le fi èsi fun awọn ti o rán wa. Kili o wi ni ti ara rẹ?
entries.en: Then said they unto him, Who art thou? that we may give an answer to them that sent us. What sayest thou of thyself?

entries.yo: O wipe, Emi li ohùn ẹni ti nkigbe ni ijù, Ẹ ṣe ki ọ̀na Oluwa tọ́, gẹgẹ bi woli Isaiah ti wi.
entries.en: He said, I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, Make straight the way of the Lord, as said the prophet Esaias.

entries.yo: Awọn ti a rán si jẹ ninu awọn Farisi.
entries.en: And they which were sent were of the Pharisees.

entries.yo: Nwọn si bi i lẽre, nwọn si wi fun u pe, Njẹ ẽṣe ti iwọ fi mbaptisi, bi iwọ kì ibá ṣe Kristi na, tabi Elijah, tabi woli na?
entries.en: And they asked him, and said unto him, Why baptizest thou then, if thou be not that Christ, nor Elias, neither that prophet?

entries.yo: Johanu da wọn lohùn, wipe, Emi nfi omi baptisi: ẹnikan duro larin nyin, ẹniti ẹnyin kò mọ̀;
entries.en: John answered them, saying, I baptize with water: but there standeth one among you, whom ye know not;

entries.yo: On na li ẹniti mbọ̀ lẹhin mi, ti o pọju mi lọ, ẹniti emi kò yẹ lati tú okùn bàta rẹ̀.
entries.en: He it is, who coming after me is preferred before me, whose shoe's latchet I am not worthy to unloose.

entries.yo: Nkan wọnyi li a ṣe ni Betani loke odò Jordani, nibiti Johanu gbé mbaptisi.
entries.en: These things were done in Bethabara beyond Jordan, where John was baptizing.

entries.yo: Ni ijọ keji Johanu ri Jesu mbọ̀ wá sọdọ rẹ̀; o wipe, Wò o, Ọdọ-agutan Ọlọrun, ẹniti o kó ẹ̀ṣẹ aiye lọ!
entries.en: The next day John seeth Jesus coming unto him, and saith, Behold the Lamb of God, which taketh away the sin of the world.

entries.yo: Eyi li ẹniti mo ti wipe, ọkunrin kan mbọ̀ wá lẹhin mi, ẹniti o pọ̀ju mi lọ: nitoriti o ti wà ṣiwaju mi.
entries.en: This is he of whom I said, After me cometh a man which is preferred before me: for he was before me.

entries.yo: Emi kò si mọ̀ ọ: ṣugbọn ki a le fi i hàn fun Israeli, nitorina li emi ṣe wá ti mo nfi omi baptisi.
entries.en: And I knew him not: but that he should be made manifest to Israel, therefore am I come baptizing with water.

entries.yo: Johanu si jẹri, o wipe, mo ri Ẹmi sọkalẹ lati ọrun wá bi àdaba, o si bà le e.
entries.en: And John bare record, saying, I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove, and it abode upon him.

entries.yo: Emi kò si mọ̀ ọ: ṣugbọn ẹniti o rán mi wá, lati fi omi baptisi, on na li o wi fun mi pe, Lori ẹniti iwọ ba ri, ti Ẹmí sọkalẹ si, ti o si bà le e, on na li ẹniti nfi Ẹmí Mimọ́ baptisi.
entries.en: And I knew him not: but he that sent me to baptize with water, the same said unto me, Upon whom thou shalt see the Spirit descending, and remaining on him, the same is he which baptizeth with the Holy Ghost.

entries.yo: Emi si ti ri, emi si ti njẹri pe, Eyi li Ọmọ Ọlọrun.
entries.en: And I saw, and bare record that this is the Son of God.

entries.yo: Ni ijọ keji ẹwẹ Johanu duro, ati meji ninu awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀:
entries.en: Again the next day after John stood, and two of his disciples;

entries.yo: O si wò Jesu bi o ti nrìn, o si wipe, Wò Ọdọ-agutan Ọlọrun!
entries.en: And looking upon Jesus as he walked, he saith, Behold the Lamb of God!

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ-ẹhin meji na si gbọ́ nigbati o wi, nwọn si tọ̀ Jesu lẹhin.
entries.en: And the two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Jesu yipada, o ri nwọn ntọ̀ on lẹhin, o si wi fun wọn pe, Kili ẹnyin nwá? Nwọn wi fun u pe, Rabbi, (itumọ̀ eyi ti ijẹ Olukọni,) nibo ni iwọ ngbé?
entries.en: Then Jesus turned, and saw them following, and saith unto them, What seek ye? They said unto him, Rabbi, (which is to say, being interpreted, Master,) where dwellest thou?

entries.yo: O wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ wá wò o. Nwọn si wá, nwọn si ri ibi ti o ngbé, nwọn si ba a joko ni ijọ na: nitoriti o jẹ ìwọn wakati kẹwa ọjọ.
entries.en: He saith unto them, Come and see. They came and saw where he dwelt, and abode with him that day: for it was about the tenth hour.

entries.yo: Ọkan ninu awọn meji ti o gbọ́ ọ̀rọ Johanu, ti o si tọ̀ Jesu lẹhin, ni Anderu, arakunrin Simoni Peteru.
entries.en: One of the two which heard John speak, and followed him, was Andrew, Simon Peter's brother.

entries.yo: On tètekọ ri Simoni arakunrin on tikararẹ̀, o si wi fun u pe, Awa ti ri Messia, itumọ̀ eyi ti ijẹ Kristi.
entries.en: He first findeth his own brother Simon, and saith unto him, We have found the Messias, which is, being interpreted, the Christ.

entries.yo: O si mu u wá sọdọ Jesu. Jesu si wò o, o wipe, Iwọ ni Simoni ọmọ Jona: Kefa li a o si ma pè ọ, itumọ̀ eyi ti ijẹ Peteru.
entries.en: And he brought him to Jesus. And when Jesus beheld him, he said, Thou art Simon the son of Jona: thou shalt be called Cephas, which is by interpretation, A stone.

entries.yo: Ni ọjọ keji Jesu nfẹ jade lọ si Galili, o si ri Filippi, o si wi fun u pe, Mã tọ̀ mi lẹhin.
entries.en: The day following Jesus would go forth into Galilee, and findeth Philip, and saith unto him, Follow me.

entries.yo: Ara Betsaida ni Filippi iṣe, ilu Anderu ati Peteru.
entries.en: Now Philip was of Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.

entries.yo: Filippi ri Natanaeli, o si wi fun u pe, Awa ti ri ẹniti Mose ninu ofin ati awọn woli ti kọwe rẹ̀, Jesu ti Nasareti, ọmọ Josefu.
entries.en: Philip findeth Nathanael, and saith unto him, We have found him, of whom Moses in the law, and the prophets, did write, Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.

entries.yo: Natanaeli si wi fun u pe, Ohun rere kan ha le ti Nasareti jade? Filippi wi fun u pe, Wá wò o.
entries.en: And Nathanael said unto him, Can there any good thing come out of Nazareth? Philip saith unto him, Come and see.

entries.yo: Jesu ri Natanaeli mbọ̀ wá sọdọ rẹ̀, o si wi nipa rẹ̀ pe, Wo o, ọmọ Israelì nitõtọ, ninu ẹniti ẹ̀tan kò si!
entries.en: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and saith of him, Behold an Israelite indeed, in whom is no guile!

entries.yo: Natanaeli wi fun u pe, Nibo ni iwọ ti mọ̀ mi? Jesu dahùn, o si wi fun u pe, Ki Filippi to pè ọ, nigbati iwọ wà labẹ igi ọ̀pọ́tọ, mo ti ri ọ.
entries.en: Nathanael saith unto him, Whence knowest thou me? Jesus answered and said unto him, Before that Philip called thee, when thou wast under the fig tree, I saw thee.

entries.yo: Natanaeli dahùn, o si wi fun u pe, Rabbi, iwọ li Ọmọ Ọlọrun; iwọ li Ọba Israeli.
entries.en: Nathanael answered and saith unto him, Rabbi, thou art the Son of God; thou art the King of Israel.

entries.yo: Jesu dahùn, o si wi fun u pe, Nitori mo wi fun ọ pe, mo ri ọ labẹ igi ọpọtọ ni iwọ ṣe gbagbọ? iwọ ó ri ohun ti o pọ̀ju wọnyi lọ.
entries.en: Jesus answered and said unto him, Because I said unto thee, I saw thee under the fig tree, believest thou? thou shalt see greater things than these.

entries.yo: O si wi fun u pe, Lõtọ, lõtọ ni mo wi fun nyin, Ẹnyin o ri ọrun ṣí silẹ, awọn angẹli Ọlọrun yio si ma gòke, nwọn o si ma sọkalẹ sori Ọmọ-enia.
entries.en: And he saith unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Hereafter ye shall see heaven open, and the angels of God ascending and descending upon the Son of man.

entries.yo: NI ijọ kẹta a si nṣe igbeyawo kan ni Kana ti Galili; iya Jesu si mbẹ nibẹ̀:
entries.en: And the third day there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee; and the mother of Jesus was there:

entries.yo: A si pè Jesu ati awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ pẹlu, si ibi igbeyawo.
entries.en: And both Jesus was called, and his disciples, to the marriage.

entries.yo: Nigbati waini si tan, iya Jesu wi fun u pe, Nwọn kò ni waini.
entries.en: And when they wanted wine, the mother of Jesus saith unto him, They have no wine.

entries.yo: Jesu wi fun u pe, Kini ṣe temi tirẹ, obinrin yi? wakati mi kò iti de.
entries.en: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, what have I to do with thee? mine hour is not yet come.

entries.yo: Iya rẹ̀ wi fun awọn iranṣẹ pe, Ohunkohun ti o ba wi fun nyin, ẹ ṣe e.
entries.en: His mother saith unto the servants, Whatsoever he saith unto you, do it.

entries.yo: Ikoko okuta omi mẹfa li a si gbé kalẹ nibẹ̀, gẹgẹ bi iṣe ìwẹnu awọn Ju, ọkọkan nwọn gbà to ìwọn ládugbó meji tabi mẹta.
entries.en: And there were set there six waterpots of stone, after the manner of the purifying of the Jews, containing two or three firkins apiece.

entries.yo: Jesu wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ pọn omi kun ikoko wọnni. Nwọn si kún wọn titi de eti.
entries.en: Jesus saith unto them, Fill the waterpots with water. And they filled them up to the brim.

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ bù u jade nisisiyi, ki ẹ si gbé e tọ̀ olori àse lọ. Nwọn si gbé e lọ.
entries.en: And he saith unto them, Draw out now, and bear unto the governor of the feast. And they bare it.

entries.yo: Bi olori àse si ti tọ́ omi ti a sọ di waini wò, ti ko si mọ̀ ibi ti o ti wá (ṣugbọn awọn iranṣẹ ti o bù omi na wá mọ̀), olori àse pè ọkọ iyawo,
entries.en: When the ruler of the feast had tasted the water that was made wine, and knew not whence it was: (but the servants which drew the water knew;) the governor of the feast called the bridegroom,

entries.yo: O si wi fun u pe, Olukuluku enia a mã kọ́ gbé waini rere kalẹ; nigbati awọn enia ba si mu yó tan, nigbana ni imu eyi ti kò dara tobẹ̃ wá: ṣugbọn iwọ ti pa waini daradara yi mọ́ titi o fi di isisiyi.
entries.en: And saith unto him, Every man at the beginning doth set forth good wine; and when men have well drunk, then that which is worse: but thou hast kept the good wine until now.

entries.yo: Akọṣe iṣẹ àmi yi ni Jesu ṣe ni Kana ti Galili, o si fi ogo rẹ̀ hàn; awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ si gbà a gbọ́.
entries.en: This beginning of miracles did Jesus in Cana of Galilee, and manifested forth his glory; and his disciples believed on him.

entries.yo: Lẹhin eyi, o sọkalẹ lọ si Kapernamu, on ati iya rẹ̀ ati awọn arakunrin rẹ̀, ati awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀: nwọn kò si gbé ibẹ̀ li ọjọ pupọ.
entries.en: After this he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, and his brethren, and his disciples: and they continued there not many days.

entries.yo: Ajọ irekọja awọn Ju si sunmọ etile, Jesu si goke lọ si Jerusalemu,
entries.en: And the Jews' passover was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem,

entries.yo: O si ri awọn ti ntà malu, ati agutan, ati àdaba ni tẹmpili, ati awọn onipaṣipàrọ owo joko:
entries.en: And found in the temple those that sold oxen and sheep and doves, and the changers of money sitting:

entries.yo: O si fi okùn tẹrẹ ṣe paṣan, o si lé gbogbo wọn jade kuro ninu tẹmpili, ati agutan ati malu; o si dà owo awọn onipaṣipàrọ owo nù, o si bì tabili wọn ṣubu.
entries.en: And when he had made a scourge of small cords, he drove them all out of the temple, and the sheep, and the oxen; and poured out the changers' money, and overthrew the tables;

entries.yo: O si wi fun awọn ti ntà àdaba pe, Ẹ gbe nkan wọnyi kuro nihin; ẹ máṣe sọ ile Baba mi di ile ọjà tità.
entries.en: And said unto them that sold doves, Take these things hence; make not my Father's house an house of merchandise.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ si ranti pe, a ti kọ ọ pe, Itara ile rẹ jẹ mi run.
entries.en: And his disciples remembered that it was written, The zeal of thine house hath eaten me up.

entries.yo: Nigbana li awọn Ju dahùn, nwọn si wi fun u pe Àmi wo ni iwọ fi hàn wa, ti iwọ fi nṣe nkan wọnyi?
entries.en: Then answered the Jews and said unto him, What sign shewest thou unto us, seeing that thou doest these things?

entries.yo: Jesu dahùn o si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ wó tẹmpili yi palẹ̀, ni ijọ mẹta Emi o si gbé e ró.
entries.en: Jesus answered and said unto them, Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.

entries.yo: Nigbana li awọn Ju wipe, Ọdún mẹrindiladọta li a fi kọ́ tẹmpili yi, iwọ o ha si gbé e ró ni ijọ mẹta?
entries.en: Then said the Jews, Forty and six years was this temple in building, and wilt thou rear it up in three days?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn on nsọ ti tẹmpili ara rẹ̀.
entries.en: But he spake of the temple of his body.

entries.yo: Nitorina nigbati o jinde kuro ninu okú, awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ ranti pe, o ti sọ eyi fun wọn; nwọn si gbà iwe-mimọ́ gbọ́, ati ọ̀rọ ti Jesu ti sọ.
entries.en: When therefore he was risen from the dead, his disciples remembered that he had said this unto them; and they believed the scripture, and the word which Jesus had said.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si wà ni Jerusalemu, ni ajọ irekọja, lakoko ajọ na, ọ̀pọ enia gbà orukọ rẹ̀ gbọ nigbati nwọn ri iṣẹ àmi rẹ̀ ti o ṣe.
entries.en: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the passover, in the feast day, many believed in his name, when they saw the miracles which he did.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Jesu kò gbé ara le wọn, nitoriti o mọ̀ gbogbo enia.
entries.en: But Jesus did not commit himself unto them, because he knew all men,

entries.yo: On ko si wa ki ẹnikẹni ki o jẹri enia fun on: nitoriti on mọ̀ ohun ti mbẹ ninu enia.
entries.en: And needed not that any should testify of man: for he knew what was in man.

entries.yo: ỌKUNRIN kan si wà ninu awọn Farisi, ti a npè ni Nikodemu, ijoye kan ninu awọn Ju:
entries.en: There was a man of the Pharisees, named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews:

entries.yo: On na li o tọ̀ Jesu wá li oru, o si wi fun u pe, Rabbi, awa mọ̀ pe olukọni lati ọdọ Ọlọrun wá ni iwọ iṣe: nitoripe kò si ẹniti o le ṣe iṣẹ àmi wọnyi ti iwọ nṣe, bikoṣepe Ọlọrun wà pẹlu rẹ̀.
entries.en: The same came to Jesus by night, and said unto him, Rabbi, we know that thou art a teacher come from God: for no man can do these miracles that thou doest, except God be with him.

entries.yo: Jesu dahùn o si wi fun u pe, Lõtọ, lõtọ ni mo wi fun ọ, Bikoṣepe a tún enia bí, on kò le ri ijọba Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Jesus answered and said unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.

entries.yo: Nikodemu wi fun u pe, A o ti ṣe le tún enia bí, nigbati o di agbalagba tan? o ha le wọ̀ inu iya rẹ̀ lọ nigba keji, ki a si bí i?
entries.en: Nicodemus saith unto him, How can a man be born when he is old? can he enter the second time into his mother's womb, and be born?

entries.yo: Jesu dahùn wipe, Lõtọ, lõtọ ni mo wi fun ọ, Bikoṣepe a fi omi ati Ẹmi bi enia, on kò le wọ̀ ijọba Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Jesus answered, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born of water and of the Spirit, he cannot enter into the kingdom of God.

entries.yo: Eyiti a bí nipa ti ara, ara ni; eyiti a si bí nipa ti Ẹmí, ẹmí ni.
entries.en: That which is born of the flesh is flesh; and that which is born of the Spirit is spirit.

entries.yo: Ki ẹnu ki o máṣe yà ọ, nitori mo wi fun ọ pe, A kò le ṣe alaitún nyin bí.
entries.en: Marvel not that I said unto thee, Ye must be born again.

entries.yo: Afẹfẹ nfẹ si ibi ti o gbé wù u, iwọ si ngbọ́ iró rẹ̀, ṣugbọn iwọ kò mọ̀ ibi ti o ti wá, ati ibi ti o gbé nlọ: gẹgẹ bẹ̃ni olukuluku ẹniti a bí nipa ti Ẹmí.
entries.en: The wind bloweth where it listeth, and thou hearest the sound thereof, but canst not tell whence it cometh, and whither it goeth: so is every one that is born of the Spirit.

entries.yo: Nikodemu dahùn, o si wi fun u pe, Nkan wọnyi yio ti ṣe le ri bẹ̃?
entries.en: Nicodemus answered and said unto him, How can these things be?

entries.yo: Jesu dahùn, o si wi fun u pe, Ṣe olukọni ni Israeli ni iwọ iṣe, o kò si mọ̀ nkan wọnyi?
entries.en: Jesus answered and said unto him, Art thou a master of Israel, and knowest not these things?

entries.yo: Lõtọ, lõtọ ni mo wi fun ọ, Awa nsọ eyiti awa mọ̀, a si njẹri eyiti awa ti ri; ẹnyin kò si gbà ẹri wa.
entries.en: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, We speak that we do know, and testify that we have seen; and ye receive not our witness.

entries.yo: Bi mo ba sọ̀ ohun ti aiye yi fun nyin, ti ẹnyin kò si gbagbọ́, ẹnyin o ti ṣe gbagbọ́ bi mo ba sọ ohun ti ọrun fun nyin?
entries.en: If I have told you earthly things, and ye believe not, how shall ye believe, if I tell you of heavenly things?

entries.yo: Ko si si ẹniti o gòke re ọrun, bikoṣe ẹniti o ti ọrun sọkalẹ wá, ani Ọmọ-enia ti mbẹ li ọrun.
entries.en: And no man hath ascended up to heaven, but he that came down from heaven, even the Son of man which is in heaven.

entries.yo: Bi Mose si ti gbé ejò soke li aginjù, gẹgẹ bẹ̃li a kò le ṣe alaigbé Ọmọ-enia soke pẹlu:
entries.en: And as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of man be lifted up:

entries.yo: Ki ẹnikẹni ti o ba gba a gbọ, ki o má ba ṣegbé, ṣugbọn ki o le ni ìye ainipẹkun.
entries.en: That whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

entries.yo: Nitori Ọlọrun fẹ araiye tobẹ̃ gẹ, ti o fi Ọmọ bíbi rẹ̀ kanṣoṣo funni, ki ẹnikẹni ti o ba gbà a gbọ́ má bà ṣegbé, ṣugbọn ki o le ni ìye ainipẹkun.
entries.en: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.

entries.yo: Nitori Ọlọrun kò rán Ọmọ rẹ̀ si aiye lati da araiye lẹjọ; ṣugbọn ki a le ti ipasẹ rẹ̀ gbà araiye là.
entries.en: For God sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world; but that the world through him might be saved.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba gbà a gbọ́, a ko ni da a lẹjọ; ṣugbọn a ti da ẹniti kò gbà a gbọ́ lẹjọ na, nitoriti kò gbà orukọ Ọmọ bíbi kanṣoṣo ti Ọlọrun gbọ́.
entries.en: He that believeth on him is not condemned: but he that believeth not is condemned already, because he hath not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of God.

entries.yo: Eyi ni idajọ na pe, imọlẹ wá si aiye, awọn enia si fẹ òkunkun jù imọlẹ lọ, nitoriti iṣẹ wọn buru.
entries.en: And this is the condemnation, that light is come into the world, and men loved darkness rather than light, because their deeds were evil.

entries.yo: Nitori olukuluku ẹniti o ba hùwa buburu ni ikorira imọlẹ, ki isi wá si imọlẹ, ki a máṣe ba iṣẹ rẹ̀ wí.
entries.en: For every one that doeth evil hateth the light, neither cometh to the light, lest his deeds should be reproved.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹniti o ba nṣe otitọ ni iwá si imọlẹ, ki iṣẹ rẹ̀ ki o le fi ara hàn pe, a ṣe wọn nipa ti Ọlọrun.
entries.en: But he that doeth truth cometh to the light, that his deeds may be made manifest, that they are wrought in God.

entries.yo: Lẹhin nkan wọnyi Jesu pẹlu awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ wá si ilẹ Judea; o si duro pẹlu wọn nibẹ o si baptisi.
entries.en: After these things came Jesus and his disciples into the land of Judaea; and there he tarried with them, and baptized.

entries.yo: Johanu pẹlu si mbaptisi ni Ainoni, li àgbegbe Salimu, nitoriti omi pipọ wà nibẹ̀: nwọn si nwá, a si baptisi wọn.
entries.en: And John also was baptizing in Aenon near to Salim, because there was much water there: and they came, and were baptized.

entries.yo: Nitoriti a kò ti isọ Johanu sinu tubu.
entries.en: For John was not yet cast into prison.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni iyàn kan wà larin awọn ọmọ-ẹhin Johanu, pẹlu Ju kan niti ìwẹnu.
entries.en: Then there arose a question between some of John's disciples and the Jews about purifying.

entries.yo: Nwọn si tọ̀ Johanu wá, nwọn si wi fun u pe, Rabbi, ẹniti o ti wà pẹlu rẹ loke odò Jordani, ti iwọ ti jẹrí rẹ̀, wo o, on mbaptisi, gbogbo enia si ntọ̀ ọ̀ wá.
entries.en: And they came unto John, and said unto him, Rabbi, he that was with thee beyond Jordan, to whom thou barest witness, behold, the same baptizeth, and all men come to him.

entries.yo: Johanu dahùn o si wipe, Enia ko le ri nkankan gbà, bikoṣepe a ba ti fifun u lati ọrun wá.
entries.en: John answered and said, A man can receive nothing, except it be given him from heaven.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin tikaranyin jẹri mi, pe mo wipe, Emi kì iṣe Kristi na, ṣugbọn pe a rán mi ṣiwaju rẹ̀.
entries.en: Ye yourselves bear me witness, that I said, I am not the Christ, but that I am sent before him.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba ni iyawo ni ọkọ iyawo; ṣugbọn ọrẹ́ ọkọ iyawo ti o duro ti o si ngbohùn rẹ̀, o nyọ̀ gidigidi nitori ohùn ọkọ iyawo; nitorina ayọ̀ mi yi di kíkun.
entries.en: He that hath the bride is the bridegroom: but the friend of the bridegroom, which standeth and heareth him, rejoiceth greatly because of the bridegroom's voice: this my joy therefore is fulfilled.

entries.yo: On kò le ṣaima pọsi i, ṣugbọn emi kò le ṣaima rẹ̀hin.
entries.en: He must increase, but I must decrease.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ti oke wá ju gbogbo enia lọ: ẹniti o ti aiye wá ti aiye ni, a si ma sọ̀ ohun ti aiye: ẹniti o ti ọrun wá ju gbogbo enia lọ.
entries.en: He that cometh from above is above all: he that is of the earth is earthly, and speaketh of the earth: he that cometh from heaven is above all.

entries.yo: Ohun ti o ti ri ti o si ti gbọ́ eyina si li on njẹri rẹ̀; ko si si ẹniti o gbà ẹrí rẹ̀.
entries.en: And what he hath seen and heard, that he testifieth; and no man receiveth his testimony.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o gbà ẹrí rẹ̀ fi edidi di i pe, otitọ li Ọlọrun.
entries.en: He that hath received his testimony hath set to his seal that God is true.

entries.yo: Nitori ẹniti Ọlọrun ti rán nsọ ọ̀rọ Ọlọrun: nitoriti Ọlọrun kò fi Ẹmí fun u nipa oṣuwọn.
entries.en: For he whom God hath sent speaketh the words of God: for God giveth not the Spirit by measure unto him.

entries.yo: Baba fẹ Ọmọ, o si ti fi ohun gbogbo le e lọwọ.
entries.en: The Father loveth the Son, and hath given all things into his hand.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba gbà Ọmọ gbọ́, o ni iye ainipẹkun: ẹniti kò ba si gbà Ọmọ gbọ, kì yio ri ìye; ṣugbọn ibinu Ọlọrun mbẹ lori rẹ̀.
entries.en: He that believeth on the Son hath everlasting life: and he that believeth not the Son shall not see life; but the wrath of God abideth on him.

entries.yo: NITORINA nigbati Oluwa ti mọ̀ bi awọn Farisi ti gbọ́ pe, Jesu nṣe o si mbaptisi awọn ọmọ-ẹhin pupọ jù Johanu lọ,
entries.en: When therefore the Lord knew how the Pharisees had heard that Jesus made and baptized more disciples than John,

entries.yo: (Ṣugbọn Jesu tikararẹ̀ kò baptisi bikoṣe awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀,)
entries.en: (Though Jesus himself baptized not, but his disciples,)

entries.yo: O fi Judea silẹ, o si tún lọ si Galili.
entries.en: He left Judaea, and departed again into Galilee.

entries.yo: On kò si le ṣaima kọja lãrin Samaria.
entries.en: And he must needs go through Samaria.

entries.yo: Nigbana li o de ilu Samaria kan, ti a npè ni Sikari, ti o sunmọ eti ilẹ biri nì, ti Jakọbu ti fifun Josefu, ọmọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Then cometh he to a city of Samaria, which is called Sychar, near to the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.

entries.yo: Kanga Jakọbu si wà nibẹ̀. Nitorina bi o ti rẹ̀ Jesu tan nitori ìrin rẹ̀, bẹ̀li o joko leti kanga: o si jẹ ìwọn wakati kẹfa ọjọ.
entries.en: Now Jacob's well was there. Jesus therefore, being wearied with his journey, sat thus on the well: and it was about the sixth hour.

entries.yo: Obinrin kan, ara Samaria, si wá lati pọn omi: Jesu wi fun u pe, Fun mi mu.
entries.en: There cometh a woman of Samaria to draw water: Jesus saith unto her, Give me to drink.

entries.yo: (Nitori awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ ti lọ si ilu lọ irà onjẹ.)
entries.en: (For his disciples were gone away unto the city to buy meat.)

entries.yo: Nigbana li obinrin ara Samaria na wi fun u pe, Ẽti ri ti iwọ ti iṣe Ju, fi mbère ohun mimu lọwọ mi, emi ẹniti iṣe obinrin ara Samaria? nitoriti awọn Ju ki iba awọn ara Samaria da nkan pọ̀.
entries.en: Then saith the woman of Samaria unto him, How is it that thou, being a Jew, askest drink of me, which am a woman of Samaria? for the Jews have no dealings with the Samaritans.

entries.yo: Jesu dahùn, o si wi fun u pe, Ibaṣepe iwọ mọ̀ ẹ̀bun Ọlọrun, ati ẹniti o wi fun ọ pe, Fun mi mu, iwọ iba si ti bère lọwọ rẹ̀, on iba ti fi omi ìye fun ọ.
entries.en: Jesus answered and said unto her, If thou knewest the gift of God, and who it is that saith to thee, Give me to drink; thou wouldest have asked of him, and he would have given thee living water.

entries.yo: Obinrin na wi fun u pe, Ọgbẹni, iwọ kò ni nkan ti iwọ o fi fà omi, bẹ̃ni kanga na jìn: nibo ni iwọ gbé ti ri omi ìye na?
entries.en: The woman saith unto him, Sir, thou hast nothing to draw with, and the well is deep: from whence then hast thou that living water?

entries.yo: Iwọ pọ̀ju Jakọbu baba wa lọ bí, ẹniti o fun wa ni kanga na, ti on tikararẹ̀ mu ninu rẹ̀, ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, ati awọn ẹran rẹ̀?
entries.en: Art thou greater than our father Jacob, which gave us the well, and drank thereof himself, and his children, and his cattle?

entries.yo: Jesu dahùn, o si wi fun u pe, Ẹnikẹni ti o ba mu ninu omi yi, orùngbẹ yio si tún gbẹ ẹ:
entries.en: Jesus answered and said unto her, Whosoever drinketh of this water shall thirst again:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹnikẹni ti o ba mu ninu omi ti emi o fifun u, orùngbẹ kì yio gbẹ ẹ mọ́ lai; ṣugbọn omi ti emi o fifun u yio di kanga omi ninu rẹ̀, ti yio ma sun si ìye ainipẹkun.
entries.en: But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.

entries.yo: Obinrin na si wi fun u pe, Ọgbẹni, fun mi li omi yi, ki orùngbẹ ki o màṣe gbẹ mi, ki emi ki o má si wá fà omi nihin.
entries.en: The woman saith unto him, Sir, give me this water, that I thirst not, neither come hither to draw.

entries.yo: Jesu wi fun u pe, Lọ ipè ọkọ rẹ, ki o si wá si ihinyi.
entries.en: Jesus saith unto her, Go, call thy husband, and come hither.

entries.yo: Obinrin na dahùn, o si wi fun u pe, Emi kò li ọkọ. Jesu wi fun u pe, Iwọ wi rere pe, emi kò li ọkọ:
entries.en: The woman answered and said, I have no husband. Jesus said unto her, Thou hast well said, I have no husband:

entries.yo: Nitoriti iwọ ti li ọkọ marun ri; ẹniti iwọ si ni nisisiyi kì iṣe ọkọ rẹ; iwọ sọ otitọ li eyini.
entries.en: For thou hast had five husbands; and he whom thou now hast is not thy husband: in that saidst thou truly.

entries.yo: Obinrin na wi fun u pe, Ọgbẹni, mo woye pe, woli ni iwọ iṣe.
entries.en: The woman saith unto him, Sir, I perceive that thou art a prophet.

entries.yo: Awọn baba wa sìn lori òke yi; ẹnyin si wipe, Jerusalemu ni ibi ti o yẹ ti a ba ma sìn.
entries.en: Our fathers worshipped in this mountain; and ye say, that in Jerusalem is the place where men ought to worship.

entries.yo: Jesu wi fun u pe, Gbà mi gbọ́, obinrin yi, wakati na mbọ̀, nigbati kì yio ṣe lori òke yi, tabi Jerusalemu, li ẹnyin o ma sìn Baba.
entries.en: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, believe me, the hour cometh, when ye shall neither in this mountain, nor yet at Jerusalem, worship the Father.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin nsìn ohun ti ẹnyin kò mọ̀: awa nsìn ohun ti awa mọ̀: nitori igbala ti ọdọ awọn Ju wá.
entries.en: Ye worship ye know not what: we know what we worship: for salvation is of the Jews.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn wakati mbọ̀, o si de tan nisisiyi, nigbati awọn olusin tõtọ yio ma sìn Baba li ẹmí ati li otitọ: nitori irú wọn ni Baba nwá ki o ma sìn on.
entries.en: But the hour cometh, and now is, when the true worshippers shall worship the Father in spirit and in truth: for the Father seeketh such to worship him.

entries.yo: Ẹmí li Ọlọrun: awọn ẹniti nsìn i ko le ṣe alaisìn i li ẹmí ati li otitọ.
entries.en: God is a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship him in spirit and in truth.

entries.yo: Obinrin na wi fun u pe, mo mọ̀ pe Messia mbọ̀ wá, ti a npè ni Kristi: nigbati on ba de, yio sọ ohun gbogbo fun wa.
entries.en: The woman saith unto him, I know that Messias cometh, which is called Christ: when he is come, he will tell us all things.

entries.yo: Jesu wi fun u pe, Emi ẹniti mba ọ sọ̀rọ yi li on.
entries.en: Jesus saith unto her, I that speak unto thee am he.

entries.yo: Lori eyi li awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ de, ẹnu si yà wọn, pe o mba obinrin sọ̀rọ: ṣugbọn kò si ẹnikan ti o wipe, Kini iwọ nwá? tabi, Ẽṣe ti iwọ fi mba a sọ̀rọ?
entries.en: And upon this came his disciples, and marvelled that he talked with the woman: yet no man said, What seekest thou? or, Why talkest thou with her?

entries.yo: Nigbana li obinrin na fi ladugbo rẹ̀ silẹ, o si mu ọ̀na rẹ̀ pọ̀n lọ si ilu, o si wi fun awọn enia pe,
entries.en: The woman then left her waterpot, and went her way into the city, and saith to the men,

entries.yo: Ẹ wá wò ọkunrin kan, ẹniti o sọ ohun gbogbo ti mo ti ṣe ri fun mi: eyi ha le jẹ Kristi na?
entries.en: Come, see a man, which told me all things that ever I did: is not this the Christ?

entries.yo: Nigbana ni nwọn ti ilu jade, nwọn si tọ̀ ọ wá.
entries.en: Then they went out of the city, and came unto him.

entries.yo: Lãrin eyi awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ nrọ̀ ọ, wipe, Rabbi, jẹun.
entries.en: In the mean while his disciples prayed him, saying, Master, eat.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn o wi fun wọn pe, emi li onjẹ lati jẹ, ti ẹnyin kò mọ̀.
entries.en: But he said unto them, I have meat to eat that ye know not of.

entries.yo: Nitorina li awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ mbi ara wọn lère wipe, Ẹnikan mú onjẹ fun u wá lati jẹ bi?
entries.en: Therefore said the disciples one to another, Hath any man brought him ought to eat?

entries.yo: Jesu wi fun wọn pe, Onjẹ mi ni lati ṣe ifẹ ẹniti o rán mi, ati lati pari iṣẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Jesus saith unto them, My meat is to do the will of him that sent me, and to finish his work.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin kò ha nwipe, O kù oṣù mẹrin, ikorè yio si de? wo o, mo wi fun nyin, Ẹ gbé oju nyin soke, ki ẹ si wó oko; nitoriti nwọn ti funfun fun ikore na.
entries.en: Say not ye, There are yet four months, and then cometh harvest? behold, I say unto you, Lift up your eyes, and look on the fields; for they are white already to harvest.

entries.yo: Ẹniti nkorè ngba owo ọ̀ya, o si nkó eso jọ si ìye ainipẹkun: ki ẹniti o nfunrugbin ati ẹniti nkore le jọ mã yọ̀ pọ̀.
entries.en: And he that reapeth receiveth wages, and gathereth fruit unto life eternal: that both he that soweth and he that reapeth may rejoice together.

entries.yo: Nitori ninu eyi ni ọ̀rọ na fi jẹ otitọ: Ẹnikan li o fọnrugbin, ẹlomiran li o si nkòre jọ.
entries.en: And herein is that saying true, One soweth, and another reapeth.

entries.yo: Mo rán nyin lọ ikore ohun ti ẹ kò ṣiṣẹ le lori: awọn ẹlomiran ti ṣiṣẹ, ẹnyin si wọ̀ inu iṣẹ wọn lọ.
entries.en: I sent you to reap that whereon ye bestowed no labour: other men laboured, and ye are entered into their labours.

entries.yo: Ọpọ awọn ara Samaria lati ilu na wá si gbà a gbọ́, nitori ọ̀rọ obinrin na, o jẹri pe, O sọ gbogbo ohun ti mo ti ṣe fun mi.
entries.en: And many of the Samaritans of that city believed on him for the saying of the woman, which testified, He told me all that ever I did.

entries.yo: Nitorina, nigbati awọn ara Samaria wá sọdọ rẹ̀, nwọn bẹ̀ ẹ pe, ki o ba wọn joko: o si gbé ibẹ̀ ni ijọ meji.
entries.en: So when the Samaritans were come unto him, they besought him that he would tarry with them: and he abode there two days.

entries.yo: Awọn ọ̀pọlọpọ si i si gbagbọ́ nitori ọ̀rọ rẹ̀;
entries.en: And many more believed because of his own word;

entries.yo: Nwọn si wi fun obinrin na pe, Ki iṣe nitori ọrọ rẹ mọ li awa ṣe gbagbọ: nitoriti awa tikarawa ti gbọ́ ọ̀rọ rẹ̀, awa si mọ̀ pe, nitõtọ eyi ni Kristi na, Olugbala araiye.
entries.en: And said unto the woman, Now we believe, not because of thy saying: for we have heard him ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Saviour of the world.

entries.yo: Lẹhin ijọ meji o si ti ibẹ̀ kuro, o lọ si Galili.
entries.en: Now after two days he departed thence, and went into Galilee.

entries.yo: Nitori Jesu tikararẹ̀ ti jẹri wipe, Woli ki ini ọlá ni ilẹ on tikararẹ̀.
