entries.en: For Jesus himself testified, that a prophet hath no honour in his own country.

entries.yo: Nitorina nigbati o de Galili, awọn ara Galili gbà a, nitoriti nwọn ti ri ohun gbogbo ti o ṣe ni Jerusalemu nigba ajọ; nitori awọn tikarawọn lọ si ajọ pẹlu.
entries.en: Then when he was come into Galilee, the Galilaeans received him, having seen all the things that he did at Jerusalem at the feast: for they also went unto the feast.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Jesu tún wà si Kana ti Galili, nibiti o gbé sọ omi di waini. ọkunrin ọlọla kan si wà, ẹniti ara ọmọ rẹ̀ kò da ni Kapernaumu.
entries.en: So Jesus came again into Cana of Galilee, where he made the water wine. And there was a certain nobleman, whose son was sick at Capernaum.

entries.yo: Nigbati o gbọ́ pe, Jesu ti Judea wá si Galili, o tọ̀ ọ wá, o si mbẹ̀ ẹ, ki o le sọkalẹ wá ki o mu ọmọ on larada: nitoriti o wà li oju ikú.
entries.en: When he heard that Jesus was come out of Judaea into Galilee, he went unto him, and besought him that he would come down, and heal his son: for he was at the point of death.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Jesu wi fun u pe, Bikoṣepe ẹnyin ba ri àmi ati iṣẹ iyanu, ẹnyin kì yio gbagbọ́ lai.
entries.en: Then said Jesus unto him, Except ye see signs and wonders, ye will not believe.

entries.yo: Ọkunrin ọlọla na wi fun u pe, Oluwa, sọkalẹ wá, ki ọmọ mi ki o to ku.
entries.en: The nobleman saith unto him, Sir, come down ere my child die.

entries.yo: Jesu wi fun u pe, Mã ba ọ̀na rẹ lọ; ọmọ rẹ yè. ọkunrin na si gbà ọ̀rọ ti Jesu sọ fun u gbọ́, o si lọ.
entries.en: Jesus saith unto him, Go thy way; thy son liveth. And the man believed the word that Jesus had spoken unto him, and he went his way.

entries.yo: Bi o si ti nsọkalẹ lọ, awọn ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ̀ pade rẹ̀, nwọn si wi fun u pe, ọmọ rẹ yè.
entries.en: And as he was now going down, his servants met him, and told him, saying, Thy son liveth.

entries.yo: Nigbana li o bère wakati ti o bẹ̀rẹ si isàn lọwọ wọn. Nwọn si wi fun u pe, Li ana, ni wakati keje, ni ibà na fi i silẹ.
entries.en: Then inquired he of them the hour when he began to amend. And they said unto him, Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni baba na mọ̀ pe, ni wakati kanna ni, ninu eyi ti Jesu wi fun u pe, Ọmọ rẹ yè: on tikararẹ̀ si gbagbọ́, ati gbogbo ile rẹ̀.
entries.en: So the father knew that it was at the same hour, in the which Jesus said unto him, Thy son liveth: and himself believed, and his whole house.

entries.yo: Eyi ni iṣẹ́ ami keji, ti Jesu ṣe nigbati o ti Judea jade wá si Galili.
entries.en: This is again the second miracle that Jesus did, when he was come out of Judaea into Galilee.

entries.yo: LẸHIN nkan wọnyi ajọ awọn Ju kan kò; Jesu si gòke lọ si Jerusalemu.
entries.en: After this there was a feast of the Jews; and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Adagun omi kan si wà ni Jerusalemu, leti bodè agutan, ti a npè ni Betesda li ède Heberu, ti o ni iloro marun.
entries.en: Now there is at Jerusalem by the sheep market a pool, which is called in the Hebrew tongue Bethesda, having five porches.

entries.yo: Ninu wọnyi li ọ̀pọ awọn abirùn enia gbé dubulẹ si, awọn afọju, arọ ati awọn gbigbẹ, nwọn si nduro dè rirú omi.
entries.en: In these lay a great multitude of impotent folk, of blind, halt, withered, waiting for the moving of the water.

entries.yo: Nitori angẹli a ma digbà sọkalẹ lọ sinu adagun na, a si ma rú omi: lẹhin igbati a ba ti rú omi na tan ẹnikẹni ti o ba kọ́ wọ̀ inu rẹ̀, a di alaradidá ninu arùnkárun ti o ni.
entries.en: For an angel went down at a certain season into the pool, and troubled the water: whosoever then first after the troubling of the water stepped in was made whole of whatsoever disease he had.

entries.yo: Ọkunrin kan si wà nibẹ̀, ẹniti o wà ni ailera rẹ̀ li ọdún mejidilogoji.
entries.en: And a certain man was there, which had an infirmity thirty and eight years.

entries.yo: Bi Jesu ti ri i ni idubulẹ, ti o si mọ̀ pe, o pẹ ti o ti wà bẹ̃, o wi fun u pe, Iwọ fẹ ki a mu ọ larada bi?
entries.en: When Jesus saw him lie, and knew that he had been now a long time in that case, he saith unto him, Wilt thou be made whole?

entries.yo: Abirùn na da a lohùn wipe, Ọgbẹni, emi kò li ẹni, ti iba gbé mi sinu adagun, nigbati a ba nrú omi na: bi emi ba ti mbọ̀ wá, ẹlomiran a sọkalẹ sinu rẹ̀ ṣiwaju mi.
entries.en: The impotent man answered him, Sir, I have no man, when the water is troubled, to put me into the pool: but while I am coming, another steppeth down before me.

entries.yo: Jesu wi fun u pe, Dide, gbé akete rẹ, ki o si mã rin.
entries.en: Jesus saith unto him, Rise, take up thy bed, and walk.

entries.yo: Lọgan a si mu ọkunrin na larada, o si gbé akete rẹ̀, o si nrìn. Ọjọ na si jẹ ọjọ isimi.
entries.en: And immediately the man was made whole, and took up his bed, and walked: and on the same day was the sabbath.

entries.yo: Nitorina awọn Ju wi fun ọkunrin na ti a mu larada pe, Ọjọ isimi li oni: kò tọ́ fun ọ lati gbé akete rẹ.
entries.en: The Jews therefore said unto him that was cured, It is the sabbath day: it is not lawful for thee to carry thy bed.

entries.yo: O si da wọn lohùn wipe, Ẹniti o mu mi larada, on li o wi fun mi pe, Gbé akete rẹ, ki o si mã rìn.
entries.en: He answered them, He that made me whole, the same said unto me, Take up thy bed, and walk.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni nwọn bi i lẽre wipe, ọkunrin wo li ẹniti o wi fun ọ pe, Gbé akete rẹ, ki o si ma rìn?
entries.en: Then asked they him, What man is that which said unto thee, Take up thy bed, and walk?

entries.yo: Ẹniti a mu larada na kò si mọ̀ ẹniti iṣe: nitori Jesu ti kuto nibẹ̀, nitori awọn enia pipọ wà nibẹ̀.
entries.en: And he that was healed wist not who it was: for Jesus had conveyed himself away, a multitude being in that place.

entries.yo: Lẹhinna Jesu ri i ni tẹmpili o si wi fun u pe, Wo o, a mu ọ larada: máṣe dẹṣẹ mọ́, ki ohun ti o buru jù yi lọ ki o má bà ba ọ.
entries.en: Afterward Jesus findeth him in the temple, and said unto him, Behold, thou art made whole: sin no more, lest a worse thing come unto thee.

entries.yo: Ọkunrin na lọ, o si sọ fun awọn Ju pe, Jesu li ẹniti o mu on larada.
entries.en: The man departed, and told the Jews that it was Jesus, which had made him whole.

entries.yo: Nitori eyi li awọn Ju si nṣe inunibini si Jesu, nwọn si nwá ọ̀na ati pa a, nitoriti a nṣe nkan wọnyi li ọjọ isimi.
entries.en: And therefore did the Jews persecute Jesus, and sought to slay him, because he had done these things on the sabbath day.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Jesu da wọn lohùn wipe, Baba mi nṣiṣẹ titi di isisiyi, emi si nṣiṣẹ.
entries.en: But Jesus answered them, My Father worketh hitherto, and I work.

entries.yo: Nitori eyi li awọn Ju tubọ nwá ọ̀na ati pa a, ki iṣe nitoripe o ba ọjọ isimi jẹ nikan ni, ṣugbọn o wi pẹlu pe, Baba on li Ọlọrun iṣe, o nmu ara rẹ̀ ba Ọlọrun dọgba.
entries.en: Therefore the Jews sought the more to kill him, because he not only had broken the sabbath, but said also that God was his Father, making himself equal with God.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Jesu dahùn, o si wi fun wọn pe, Lõtọ, lõtọ ni mo wi fun nyin, Ọmọ kò le ṣe ohunkohun fun ara rẹ̀, bikoṣe ohun ti o ba ri pe Baba nṣe: nitori ohunkohun ti o ba nṣe, wọnyi li Ọmọ si nṣe bẹ̃ gẹgẹ.
entries.en: Then answered Jesus and said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, The Son can do nothing of himself, but what he seeth the Father do: for what things soever he doeth, these also doeth the Son likewise.

entries.yo: Nitori Baba fẹràn Ọmọ, o si fi ohun gbogbo ti on tikararẹ̀ nṣe hàn a: on ó si fi iṣẹ ti o tobi ju wọnyi lọ hàn a, ki ẹnu ki o le yà nyin.
entries.en: For the Father loveth the Son, and sheweth him all things that himself doeth: and he will shew him greater works than these, that ye may marvel.

entries.yo: Nitoripe gẹgẹ bi Baba ti njí okú dide, ti o si nsọ wọn di ãye; bẹ̃li Ọmọ si nsọ awọn ti o fẹ di ãye.
entries.en: For as the Father raiseth up the dead, and quickeneth them; even so the Son quickeneth whom he will.

entries.yo: Nitoripe Baba ki iṣe idajọ ẹnikẹni, ṣugbọn o ti fi gbogbo idajọ le Ọmọ lọwọ:
entries.en: For the Father judgeth no man, but hath committed all judgment unto the Son:

entries.yo: Ki gbogbo enia ki o le mã fi ọlá fun Ọmọ gẹgẹ bi nwọn ti nfi ọlá fun Baba. Ẹniti kò ba fi ọlá fun Ọmọ, kò fi ọlá fun Baba ti o rán a.
entries.en: That all men should honour the Son, even as they honour the Father. He that honoureth not the Son honoureth not the Father which hath sent him.

entries.yo: Lõtọ, lõtọ ni mo wi fun nyin, Ẹnikẹni ti o ba gbọ́ ọ̀rọ mi, ti o ba si gbà ẹniti o rán mi gbọ́, o ni iye ti kò nipẹkun, on kì yio si wá si idajọ; ṣugbọn o ti ré ikú kọja bọ si ìye.
entries.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that heareth my word, and believeth on him that sent me, hath everlasting life, and shall not come into condemnation; but is passed from death unto life.

entries.yo: Lõtọ, lõtọ ni mo wi fun nyin, Wakati na mbọ̀, o si de tan nisisiyi, nigbati awọn okú yio gbọ́ ohùn Ọmọ Ọlọrun: awọn ti o ba gbọ yio si yè.
entries.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The hour is coming, and now is, when the dead shall hear the voice of the Son of God: and they that hear shall live.

entries.yo: Nitoripe gẹgẹ bi Baba ti ni iye ninu ara rẹ̀; gẹgẹ bẹ̃li o si fifun Ọmọ lati ni iye ninu ara rẹ̀;
entries.en: For as the Father hath life in himself; so hath he given to the Son to have life in himself;

entries.yo: O si fun u li aṣẹ lati mã ṣe idajọ pẹlu, nitoriti on iṣe Ọmọ-enia.
entries.en: And hath given him authority to execute judgment also, because he is the Son of man.

entries.yo: Ki eyi ki o máṣe yà nyin li ẹnu; nitoripe wakati mbọ̀, ninu eyiti gbogbo awọn ti o wà ni isà okú yio gbọ́ ohùn rẹ̀.
entries.en: Marvel not at this: for the hour is coming, in the which all that are in the graves shall hear his voice,

entries.yo: Nwọn o si jade wá; awọn ti o ṣe rere, si ajinde ìye; awọn ti o si ṣe buburu, si ajinde idajọ.
entries.en: And shall come forth; they that have done good, unto the resurrection of life; and they that have done evil, unto the resurrection of damnation.

entries.yo: Emi kò le ṣe ohun kan fun ara mi: bi mo ti ngbọ́, mo ndajọ: ododo si ni idajọ mi; nitori emi kò wá ifẹ ti emi tikarami, bikoṣe ifẹ ti ẹniti o rán mi.
entries.en: I can of mine own self do nothing: as I hear, I judge: and my judgment is just; because I seek not mine own will, but the will of the Father which hath sent me.

entries.yo: Bi emi ba njẹri ara mi, ẹrí mi kì iṣe otitọ.
entries.en: If I bear witness of myself, my witness is not true.

entries.yo: Ẹlomiran li ẹniti njẹri mi; emi si mọ̀ pe, otitọ li ẹrí mi ti o jẹ́.
entries.en: There is another that beareth witness of me; and I know that the witness which he witnesseth of me is true.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin ti ranṣẹ lọ sọdọ Johanu, on si ti jẹri si otitọ.
entries.en: Ye sent unto John, and he bare witness unto the truth.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi kò gba ẹrí lọdọ enia: ṣugbọn nkan wọnyi li emi nsọ, ki ẹnyin ki o le là.
entries.en: But I receive not testimony from man: but these things I say, that ye might be saved.

entries.yo: On ni fitila ti o njó, ti o si ntànmọlẹ: ẹnyin si fẹ fun sã kan lati mã yọ̀ ninu imọlẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: He was a burning and a shining light: and ye were willing for a season to rejoice in his light.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi ni ẹri ti o pọ̀ju ti Johanu lọ: nitori iṣẹ ti Baba ti fifun mi lati ṣe pari, iṣẹ na pãpã ti emi nṣe ni njẹri mi pe, Baba li o rán mi.
entries.en: But I have greater witness than that of John: for the works which the Father hath given me to finish, the same works that I do, bear witness of me, that the Father hath sent me.

entries.yo: Ati Baba ti o rán mi ti jẹri mi. Ẹnyin kò gbọ́ ohùn rẹ̀ nigba kan ri, bẹ̃li ẹ kò ri àwọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the Father himself, which hath sent me, hath borne witness of me. Ye have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his shape.

entries.yo: Ẹ kò si ni ọ̀rọ rẹ̀ lati ma gbé inu nyin: nitori ẹniti o rán, on li ẹnyin kò gbagbọ́.
entries.en: And ye have not his word abiding in you: for whom he hath sent, him ye believe not.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin nwá inu iwe-mimọ́ nitori ẹnyin rò pe ninu wọn li ẹnyin ni ìye ti kò nipẹkun; wọnyi si li awọn ti njẹri mi.
entries.en: Search the scriptures; for in them ye think ye have eternal life: and they are they which testify of me.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin kò si fẹ lati wá sọdọ mi, ki ẹnyin ki o le ni ìye.
entries.en: And ye will not come to me, that ye might have life.

entries.yo: Emi kò gbà ogo lọdọ enia.
entries.en: I receive not honour from men.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi mọ̀ nyin pe, ẹnyin tikaranyin kò ni ifẹ Ọlọrun ninu nyin.
entries.en: But I know you, that ye have not the love of God in you.

entries.yo: Emi wá li orukọ Baba mi, ẹnyin kò si gbà mi: bi ẹlomiran ba wá li orukọ ara rẹ̀, on li ẹnyin ó gbà.
entries.en: I am come in my Father's name, and ye receive me not: if another shall come in his own name, him ye will receive.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin o ti ṣe le gbagbọ́, ẹnyin ti ngbà ogo lọdọ ara nyin, ti kò wá ogo ti o ti ọdọ Ọlọrun nikan wá?
entries.en: How can ye believe, which receive honour one of another, and seek not the honour that cometh from God only?

entries.yo: Ẹ máṣe rò pe, emi ó fi nyin sùn lọdọ Baba: ẹniti nfi nyin sùn wà, ani Mose, ẹniti ẹnyin gbẹkẹle.
entries.en: Do not think that I will accuse you to the Father: there is one that accuseth you, even Moses, in whom ye trust.

entries.yo: Nitoripe ẹnyin iba gbà Mose gbọ́, ẹnyin iba gbà mi gbọ́: nitori o kọ iwe nipa ti emi.
entries.en: For had ye believed Moses, ye would have believed me: for he wrote of me.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi ẹnyin kò ba gbà iwe rẹ̀ gbọ́, ẹnyin o ti ṣe gbà ọ̀rọ mi gbọ́?
entries.en: But if ye believe not his writings, how shall ye believe my words?

entries.yo: LẸHIN nkan wọnyi, Jesu kọja si apakeji okun Galili, ti iṣe okun Tiberia.
entries.en: After these things Jesus went over the sea of Galilee, which is the sea of Tiberias.

entries.yo: Ọpọ ijọ enia si tọ̀ ọ lẹhin, nitoriti nwọn ri iṣẹ àmi rẹ̀, ti o nṣe lara awọn alaisàn.
entries.en: And a great multitude followed him, because they saw his miracles which he did on them that were diseased.

entries.yo: Jesu si gùn ori òke lọ, nibẹ̀ li o si gbé joko pẹlu awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Jesus went up into a mountain, and there he sat with his disciples.

entries.yo: Ajọ irekọja, ọdun awọn Ju, si sunmọ etile.
entries.en: And the passover, a feast of the Jews, was nigh.

entries.yo: Njẹ bi Jesu ti gbé oju rẹ̀ soke, ti o si ri ọ̀pọ enia wá sọdọ rẹ̀, o wi fun Filippi pe, Nibo li a o ti rà akara, ki awọn wọnyi le jẹ?
entries.en: When Jesus then lifted up his eyes, and saw a great company come unto him, he saith unto Philip, Whence shall we buy bread, that these may eat?

entries.yo: O si sọ eyi lati dán a wò; nitoriti on tikararẹ̀ mọ̀ ohun ti on ó ṣe.
entries.en: And this he said to prove him: for he himself knew what he would do.

entries.yo: Filippi da a lohùn pe, Akara igba owo idẹ ko to fun wọn, ti olukuluku wọn iba fi mu diẹ-diẹ.
entries.en: Philip answered him, Two hundred pennyworth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may take a little.

entries.yo: Ọkan ninu awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀, Anderu, arakunrin Simoni Peteru wi fun u pe,
entries.en: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter's brother, saith unto him,

entries.yo: Ọmọdekunrin kan mbẹ nihinyi, ti o ni iṣu akara barle marun, ati ẹja kékèké meji: ṣugbọn kini wọnyi jẹ lãrin ọ̀pọ enia wọnyi bi eyi?
entries.en: There is a lad here, which hath five barley loaves, and two small fishes: but what are they among so many?

entries.yo: Jesu si wipe, Ẹ mu ki awọn enia na joko. Koriko pipọ si wà nibẹ̀. Bẹ̃li awọn ọkunrin na joko, ìwọn ẹgbẹdọgbọn enia ni iye.
entries.en: And Jesus said, Make the men sit down. Now there was much grass in the place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.

entries.yo: Jesu si mu iṣu akara wọnni; nigbati o si ti dupẹ, o pin wọn fun awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀, awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ si pín wọn fun awọn ti o joko; bẹ̃ gẹgẹ si li ẹja ni ìwọn bi nwọn ti nfẹ.
entries.en: And Jesus took the loaves; and when he had given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to them that were set down; and likewise of the fishes as much as they would.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si yó, o wi fun awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ pe, Ẹ kó ajẹkù ti o kù jọ, ki ohunkohun máṣe ṣegbé.
entries.en: When they were filled, he said unto his disciples, Gather up the fragments that remain, that nothing be lost.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni nwọn kó wọn jọ nwọn si fi ajẹkù ìṣu akara barle marun na kún agbọn mejila eyi ti o ṣikù, fun awọn ti o jẹun.
entries.en: Therefore they gathered them together, and filled twelve baskets with the fragments of the five barley loaves, which remained over and above unto them that had eaten.

entries.yo: Nitorina nigbati awọn ọkunrin na ri iṣẹ àmi ti Jesu ṣe, nwọn wipe, Lõtọ eyi ni woli na ti mbọ̀ wá aiye.
entries.en: Then those men, when they had seen the miracle that Jesus did, said, This is of a truth that prophet that should come into the world.

entries.yo: Nigbati Jesu si woye pe, nwọn nfẹ wá ifi agbara mu on lọ ifi jọba, o tún pada lọ sori òke on nikan.
entries.en: When Jesus therefore perceived that they would come and take him by force, to make him a king, he departed again into a mountain himself alone.

entries.yo: Nigbati alẹ si lẹ, awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ lọ sinu okun.
entries.en: And when even was now come, his disciples went down unto the sea,

entries.yo: Nwọn si bọ sinu ọkọ̀, nwọn si rekọja okun lọ si Kapernaumu. Okunkun si ti kùn, Jesu kò si ti ide ọdọ wọn.
entries.en: And entered into a ship, and went over the sea toward Capernaum. And it was now dark, and Jesus was not come to them.

entries.yo: Okun si nru nitori ẹfufu lile ti nfẹ.
entries.en: And the sea arose by reason of a great wind that blew.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn wà ọkọ̀ to bi ìwọn furlongi mẹdọgbọn tabi ọgbọ̀n, nwọn ri Jesu nrìn lori okun, o si sunmọ ọkọ̀; ẹ̀ru si bà wọn.
entries.en: So when they had rowed about five and twenty or thirty furlongs, they see Jesus walking on the sea, and drawing nigh unto the ship: and they were afraid.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn o wi fun wọn pe, Emi ni; ẹ má bẹ̀ru.
entries.en: But he saith unto them, It is I; be not afraid.

entries.yo: Nitorina nwọn fi ayọ̀ gbà a sinu ọkọ̀: lojukanna ọkọ̀ na si de ilẹ ibiti nwọn gbé nlọ.
entries.en: Then they willingly received him into the ship: and immediately the ship was at the land whither they went.

entries.yo: Ni ijọ keji, nigbati awọn enia ti o duro li apakeji okun ri pe, kò si ọkọ̀ miran nibẹ̀, bikoṣe ọkanna ti awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ wọ̀, ati pe Jesu kò ba awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ wọ̀ inu ọkọ̀ na, ṣugbọn awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ nikan li o lọ;
entries.en: The day following, when the people which stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was none other boat there, save that one whereinto his disciples were entered, and that Jesus went not with his disciples into the boat, but that his disciples were gone away alone;

entries.yo: (Ṣugbọn awọn ọkọ̀ miran ti Tiberia wá, leti ibi ti nwọn gbe jẹ akara, lẹhin igbati Oluwa ti dupẹ:)
entries.en: (Howbeit there came other boats from Tiberias nigh unto the place where they did eat bread, after that the Lord had given thanks:)

entries.yo: Nitorina nigbati awọn enia ri pe, Jesu kò si nibẹ̀, tabi awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀, awọn pẹlu wọ̀ ọkọ̀ lọ si Kapernaumu, nwọn nwá Jesu.
entries.en: When the people therefore saw that Jesus was not there, neither his disciples, they also took shipping, and came to Capernaum, seeking for Jesus.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si ri i li apakeji okun nwọn wi fun u pe, Rabbi, nigbawo ni iwọ wá sihinyi?
entries.en: And when they had found him on the other side of the sea, they said unto him, Rabbi, when camest thou hither?

entries.yo: Jesu da wọn lohùn o si wipe, Lõtọ, lõtọ ni mo wi fun nyin, Ẹnyin nwá mi, ki iṣe nitoriti ẹnyin ri iṣẹ àmi, ṣugbọn nitori ẹnyin jẹ iṣu akara wọnni, ẹnyin si yó.
entries.en: Jesus answered them and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Ye seek me, not because ye saw the miracles, but because ye did eat of the loaves, and were filled.

entries.yo: Ẹ máṣe ṣiṣẹ fun onjẹ ti iṣegbé, ṣugbọn fun onjẹ ti iwà ti di ìye ainipẹkun, eyiti Ọmọ-enia yio fifun nyin: nitoripe on ni, ani Ọlọrun Baba ti fi edidi dí.
entries.en: Labour not for the meat which perisheth, but for that meat which endureth unto everlasting life, which the Son of man shall give unto you: for him hath God the Father sealed.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni nwọn wi fun u pe, Kili awa o ha ṣe, ki a le ṣe iṣẹ Ọlọrun?
entries.en: Then said they unto him, What shall we do, that we might work the works of God?

entries.yo: Jesu dahùn o si wi fun wọn pe, Eyi ni iṣẹ Ọlọrun pe, ki ẹnyin ki o gbà ẹniti o rán gbọ́.
entries.en: Jesus answered and said unto them, This is the work of God, that ye believe on him whom he hath sent.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni nwọn wi fun u pe, Iṣẹ ami kini iwọ nṣe, ki awa le ri, ki a si gbà ọ gbọ́? iṣẹ kini iwọ ṣe?
entries.en: They said therefore unto him, What sign shewest thou then, that we may see, and believe thee? what dost thou work?

entries.yo: Awọn baba wa jẹ manna li aginjù; gẹgẹ bi a ti kọ o pe, O fi onjẹ fun wọn jẹ lati ọrun wá.
entries.en: Our fathers did eat manna in the desert; as it is written, He gave them bread from heaven to eat.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Jesu wi fun wọn pe, Lõtọ, lõtọ ni mo wi fun nyin, kì iṣe Mose li o fi onjẹ nì fun nyin lati ọrun wá; ṣugbọn Baba mi li o fi onjẹ otitọ nì fun nyin lati ọrun wá.
entries.en: Then Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Moses gave you not that bread from heaven; but my Father giveth you the true bread from heaven.

entries.yo: Nitoripe onjẹ Ọlọrun li ẹniti o ti ọrun sọkalẹ wá, ti o si fi ìye fun araiye.
entries.en: For the bread of God is he which cometh down from heaven, and giveth life unto the world.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni nwọn wi fun u pe, Oluwa, mã fun wa li onjẹ yi titi lai.
entries.en: Then said they unto him, Lord, evermore give us this bread.

entries.yo: Jesu wi fun wọn pe, Emi li onjẹ ìye: ẹnikẹni ti o ba tọ̀ mi wá, ebi kì yio pa a; ẹniti o ba si gbà mi gbọ́, orungbẹ kì yio gbẹ ẹ mọ́ lai.
entries.en: And Jesus said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall never hunger; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.

entries.yo: Sugbọn mo wi fun nyin pe, Ẹnyin ti ri mi, ẹ kò si gbagbọ́.
entries.en: But I said unto you, That ye also have seen me, and believe not.

entries.yo: Ohun gbogbo ti Baba fifun mi, yio tọ̀ mi wá; ẹniti o ba si tọ̀ mi wá, emi kì yio ta a nù, bi o ti wù ki o ri.
entries.en: All that the Father giveth me shall come to me; and him that cometh to me I will in no wise cast out.

entries.yo: Nitori emi sọkalẹ lati ọrun wá, ki iṣe lati mã ṣe ifẹ ti emi tikarami, bikoṣe ifẹ ti ẹniti o rán mi.
entries.en: For I came down from heaven, not to do mine own will, but the will of him that sent me.

entries.yo: Eyi si ni ifẹ Baba ti o rán mi, pe ohun gbogbo ti o fifun mi, ki emi ki o máṣe sọ ọkan nù ninu wọn, ṣugbọn ki emi ki o le ji wọn dide nikẹhin ọjọ.
entries.en: And this is the Father's will which hath sent me, that of all which he hath given me I should lose nothing, but should raise it up again at the last day.

entries.yo: Eyi si ni ifẹ ẹniti o rán mi, pe ẹnikẹni ti o ba rí Ọmọ, ti o ba si gbà a gbọ́, ki o le ni iye ainipẹkun: Emi ó si jí i dide nikẹhin ọjọ.
entries.en: And this is the will of him that sent me, that every one which seeth the Son, and believeth on him, may have everlasting life: and I will raise him up at the last day.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni awọn Ju nkùn si i, nitoriti o wipe, Emi ni onjẹ ti o ti ọrun sọkalẹ wá.
entries.en: The Jews then murmured at him, because he said, I am the bread which came down from heaven.

entries.yo: Nwọn si wipe, Jesu ha kọ́ eyi, ọmọ Josefu, baba ati iya ẹniti awa mọ̀? etiṣe wipe, Emi ti ọrun sọkalẹ wá?
entries.en: And they said, Is not this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? how is it then that he saith, I came down from heaven?

entries.yo: Nitorina Jesu dahùn, o si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ máṣe kùn lãrin ara nyin.
entries.en: Jesus therefore answered and said unto them, Murmur not among yourselves.

entries.yo: Kò si ẹnikẹni ti o le wá sọdọ mi, bikoṣepe Baba ti o rán mi fà a: Emi ó si jí i dide nikẹhin ọjọ.
entries.en: No man can come to me, except the Father which hath sent me draw him: and I will raise him up at the last day.

entries.yo: A sá ti kọ ọ ninu iwe awọn woli pe, A o si kọ́ gbogbo wọn lati ọdọ Ọlọrun wá. Nitorina ẹnikẹni ti o ba ti gbọ́, ti a si ti ọdọ Baba kọ́, on li o ntọ̀ mi wá.
entries.en: It is written in the prophets, And they shall be all taught of God. Every man therefore that hath heard, and hath learned of the Father, cometh unto me.

entries.yo: Koṣepe ẹnikan ti ri Baba bikoṣe ẹniti o ti ọdọ Ọlọrun wá, on li o ti ri Baba.
entries.en: Not that any man hath seen the Father, save he which is of God, he hath seen the Father.

entries.yo: Lõtọ, lõtọ ni mo wi fun nyin, Ẹniti o ba gbà mi gbọ́, o ni ìye ainipẹkun.
entries.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me hath everlasting life.

entries.yo: Emi li onjẹ ìye.
entries.en: I am that bread of life.

entries.yo: Awọn baba nyin jẹ manna li aginjù, nwọn si kú.
entries.en: Your fathers did eat manna in the wilderness, and are dead.

entries.yo: Eyi ni onjẹ ti o ti ọrun sọkalẹ wá, ki enia le mã jẹ ninu rẹ̀ ki o má si kú.
entries.en: This is the bread which cometh down from heaven, that a man may eat thereof, and not die.

entries.yo: Emi ni onjẹ ìye nì ti o ti ọrun sọkalẹ wá: bi ẹnikẹni ba jẹ ninu onjẹ yi, yio yè titi lailai: onjẹ na ti emi o si fifunni li ara mi, fun ìye araiye.
entries.en: I am the living bread which came down from heaven: if any man eat of this bread, he shall live for ever: and the bread that I will give is my flesh, which I will give for the life of the world.

entries.yo: Nitorina li awọn Ju ṣe mba ara wọn jiyàn, wipe, ọkunrin yi yio ti ṣe le fi ara rẹ̀ fun wa lati jẹ?
entries.en: The Jews therefore strove among themselves, saying, How can this man give us his flesh to eat?

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Jesu wi fun wọn pe, Lõtọ, lõtọ ni mo wi fun nyin, Bikoṣepe ẹnyin ba jẹ ara Ọmo-enia, ki ẹnyin si mu ẹ̀jẹ rẹ̀, ẹnyin kò ni ìye ninu nyin.
entries.en: Then Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except ye eat the flesh of the Son of man, and drink his blood, ye have no life in you.

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni ti o ba jẹ ara mi, ti o ba si mu ẹ̀jẹ mi, o ni ìye ti kò nipẹkun; Emi ó si jí i dide nikẹhin ọjọ.
entries.en: Whoso eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, hath eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.

entries.yo: Nitori ara mi li ohun jijẹ nitõtọ, ati ẹ̀jẹ mi li ohun mimu nitõtọ.
entries.en: For my flesh is meat indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba jẹ ara mi, ti o ba si mu ẹ̀jẹ mi, o ngbé inu mi, emi si ngbé inu rẹ̀.
entries.en: He that eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, dwelleth in me, and I in him.

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi Baba alãye ti rán mi, ti emi si ye nipa Baba: gẹgẹ bẹ̃li ẹniti o jẹ mi, on pẹlu yio yè nipa mi.
entries.en: As the living Father hath sent me, and I live by the Father: so he that eateth me, even he shall live by me.

entries.yo: Eyi si li onjẹ na ti o sọkalẹ lati ọrun wá: ki iṣe bi awọn baba nyin ti jẹ manna, ti nwọn si kú: ẹniti o ba jẹ onjẹ yi yio yè lailai.
entries.en: This is that bread which came down from heaven: not as your fathers did eat manna, and are dead: he that eateth of this bread shall live for ever.

entries.yo: Nkan wọnyi li o sọ ninu sinagogu, bi o ti nkọni ni Kapernaumu.
entries.en: These things said he in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.

entries.yo: Nitorina nigbati ọ̀pọ awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ gbọ́ eyi, nwọn wipe, ọ̀rọ ti o le li eyi; tani le gbọ́ ọ?
entries.en: Many therefore of his disciples, when they had heard this, said, This is an hard saying; who can hear it?

entries.yo: Nigbati Jesu si mọ̀ ninu ara rẹ̀ pe, awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ nkùn si ọ̀rọ na, o wi fun wọn pe, Eyi jẹ ikọsẹ̀ fun nyin bi?
entries.en: When Jesus knew in himself that his disciples murmured at it, he said unto them, Doth this offend you?

entries.yo: Njẹ, bi ẹnyin ba si ri ti Ọmọ-enia ngòke lọ sibi ti o gbé ti wà ri nkọ́?
entries.en: What and if ye shall see the Son of man ascend up where he was before?

entries.yo: Ẹmí ni isọni di ãye; ara kò ni ère kan; ọ̀rọ wọnni ti mo sọ fun nyin, ẹmi ni, ìye si ni.
entries.en: It is the spirit that quickeneth; the flesh profiteth nothing: the words that I speak unto you, they are spirit, and they are life.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn kan wà ninu nyin ti kò gbagbọ́. Nitori Jesu mọ̀ lati ìbẹrẹ wá ẹniti nwọn iṣe ti ko gbagbọ́, ati ẹniti yio fi on hàn.
entries.en: But there are some of you that believe not. For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were that believed not, and who should betray him.

entries.yo: O si wipe, Nitorina ni mo ṣe wi fun nyin pe, kò si ẹniti o le tọ̀ mi wá, bikoṣepe a fifun u lati ọdọ Baba mi wá.
entries.en: And he said, Therefore said I unto you, that no man can come unto me, except it were given unto him of my Father.

entries.yo: Nitori eyi ọ̀pọ awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ pada sẹhin, nwọn kò si ba a rìn mọ́.
entries.en: From that time many of his disciples went back, and walked no more with him.

entries.yo: Nitorina Jesu wi fun awọn mejila pe, Ẹnyin pẹlu nfẹ lọ bi?
entries.en: Then said Jesus unto the twelve, Will ye also go away?

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Simoni Peteru da a lohùn wipe, Oluwa, Ọdọ tali awa o lọ? iwọ li o ni ọ̀rọ ìye ainipẹkun.
entries.en: Then Simon Peter answered him, Lord, to whom shall we go? thou hast the words of eternal life.

entries.yo: Awa si ti gbagbọ́, a si mọ̀ pe, iwọ ni Kristi na, Ọmọ Ọlọrun alãye.
entries.en: And we believe and are sure that thou art that Christ, the Son of the living God.

entries.yo: Jesu da wọn lohùn pe, Ẹnyin mejila kọ́ ni mo yàn, ọkan ninu nyin kò ha si yà Èṣu?
entries.en: Jesus answered them, Have not I chosen you twelve, and one of you is a devil?

entries.yo: O nsọ ti Judasi Iskariotu ọmọ Simoni: nitoripe on li ẹniti yio fi i hàn, ọkan ninu awọn mejila.
entries.en: He spake of Judas Iscariot the son of Simon: for he it was that should betray him, being one of the twelve.

entries.yo: LẸHIN nkan wọnyi Jesu nrìn ni Galili: nitoriti kò fẹ rìn ni Judea, nitori awọn Ju nwá ọ̀na ati pa a.
entries.en: After these things Jesus walked in Galilee: for he would not walk in Jewry, because the Jews sought to kill him.

entries.yo: Ajọ awọn Ju ti iṣe ajọ ìpagọ́, sunmọ etile tan.
entries.en: Now the Jews' feast of tabernacles was at hand.

entries.yo: Nitorina awọn arakunrin rẹ̀ wi fun u pe, Lọ kuro nihinyi, ki o si lọ si Judea, ki awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ pẹlu ki o le ri iṣẹ rẹ ti iwọ nṣe.
entries.en: His brethren therefore said unto him, Depart hence, and go into Judaea, that thy disciples also may see the works that thou doest.

entries.yo: Nitoripe kò si ẹnikẹni ti iṣe ohunkohun nikọ̀kọ, ti on tikararẹ̀ si nfẹ ki a mọ̀ on ni gbangba. Bi iwọ ba nṣe nkan wọnyi, fi ara rẹ hàn fun araiye.
entries.en: For there is no man that doeth any thing in secret, and he himself seeketh to be known openly. If thou do these things, shew thyself to the world.

entries.yo: Nitoripe awọn arakunrin rẹ̀ kò tilẹ gbà a gbọ́.
entries.en: For neither did his brethren believe in him.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Jesu wi fun wọn pe, Akokò temi kò ti ide: ṣugbọn akokò ti nyin ni imura tan nigbagbogbo.
entries.en: Then Jesus said unto them, My time is not yet come: but your time is alway ready.

entries.yo: Aiye kò le korira nyin; ṣugbọn emi li o korira, nitoriti mo jẹri gbe e pe, iṣẹ rẹ̀ buru.
entries.en: The world cannot hate you; but me it hateth, because I testify of it, that the works thereof are evil.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin ẹ gòke lọ si ajọ yi: emi kì yio ti igoke lọ si ajọ yi; nitoriti akokò temi kò ti ide.
entries.en: Go ye up unto this feast: I go not up yet unto this feast; for my time is not yet full come.

entries.yo: Nigbati o ti sọ nkan wọnyi fun wọn tan, o duro ni Galili sibẹ̀.
entries.en: When he had said these words unto them, he abode still in Galilee.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati awọn arakunrin rẹ̀ gòke lọ tan, nigbana li on si gòke lọ si ajọ na pẹlu, kì iṣe ni gbangba, ṣugbọn bi ẹnipe nikọ̀kọ.
entries.en: But when his brethren were gone up, then went he also up unto the feast, not openly, but as it were in secret.

entries.yo: Nigbana li awọn Ju si nwá a kiri nigba ajọ, wipe, Nibo li o wà?
entries.en: Then the Jews sought him at the feast, and said, Where is he?

entries.yo: Kikùn pipọ si wà larin awọn ijọ enia nitori rẹ̀: nitori awọn kan wipe, Enia rere ni iṣe: awọn miran wipe, Bẹ̃kọ; ṣugbọn o ntàn enia jẹ ni.
entries.en: And there was much murmuring among the people concerning him: for some said, He is a good man: others said, Nay; but he deceiveth the people.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn kò si ẹnikan ti o sọ̀rọ rẹ̀ ni gbangba nitori ìbẹru awọn Ju.
entries.en: Howbeit no man spake openly of him for fear of the Jews.

entries.yo: Nigbati ajọ de arin Jesu gòke lọ si tẹmpili o si nkọ́ni.
entries.en: Now about the midst of the feast Jesus went up into the temple, and taught.

entries.yo: Ẹnu si yà awọn Ju, nwọn wipe, ọkunrin yi ti ṣe mọ̀ iwe, nigbati ko kọ́ ẹ̀kọ́?
entries.en: And the Jews marvelled, saying, How knoweth this man letters, having never learned?

entries.yo: Nitorina Jesu da wọn lohùn, o si wipe, Ẹkọ́ mi ki iṣe temi, bikoṣe ti ẹniti o rán mi.
entries.en: Jesus answered them, and said, My doctrine is not mine, but his that sent me.

entries.yo: Bi ẹnikẹni ba fẹ lati ṣe ifẹ rẹ̀, yio mọ̀ niti ẹkọ́ na, bi iba ṣe ti Ọlọrun, tabi bi emi ba nsọ ti ara mi.
entries.en: If any man will do his will, he shall know of the doctrine, whether it be of God, or whether I speak of myself.

entries.yo: Ẹniti nsọ̀ ti ara rẹ̀ nwá ogo ara rẹ̀: ṣugbọn ẹniti nwá ogo ẹniti o rán a, on li olõtọ, kò si si aiṣododo ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: He that speaketh of himself seeketh his own glory: but he that seeketh his glory that sent him, the same is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.

entries.yo: Mose kò ha fi ofin fun yin, kò si ẹnikẹni ninu nyin ti o pa ofin na mọ́? Ẽṣe ti ẹnyin fi nwá ọ̀na lati pa mi?
entries.en: Did not Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keepeth the law? Why go ye about to kill me?

entries.yo: Ijọ enia dahùn nwọn si wipe, Iwọ li ẹmi èṣu: tani nwá ọ̀na lati pa ọ?
entries.en: The people answered and said, Thou hast a devil: who goeth about to kill thee?

entries.yo: Jesu dahùn o si wi fun wọn pe, kìki iṣẹ àmi kan ni mo ṣe, ẹnu si yà gbogbo nyin.
entries.en: Jesus answered and said unto them, I have done one work, and ye all marvel.

entries.yo: Nitori eyi ni Mose fi ìkọlà fun nyin (kì iṣe nitoriti iṣe ti Mose, ṣugbọn ti awọn baba); nitorina ẹ si nkọ enia ni ilà li ọjọ isimi.
entries.en: Moses therefore gave unto you circumcision; (not because it is of Moses, but of the fathers;) and ye on the sabbath day circumcise a man.

entries.yo: Bi enia ba ngbà ikọla li ọjọ isimi, ki a ma bà rú ofin Mose, ẹ ha ti ṣe mbinu si mi, nitori mo mu enia kan larada ṣáṣa li ọjọ isimi?
entries.en: If a man on the sabbath day receive circumcision, that the law of Moses should not be broken; are ye angry at me, because I have made a man every whit whole on the sabbath day?

entries.yo: Ẹ máṣe idajọ nipa ode ara, ṣugbọn ẹ mã ṣe idajọ ododo.
entries.en: Judge not according to the appearance, but judge righteous judgment.

entries.yo: Nigbana li awọn kan ninu awọn ara Jerusalemu wipe, Ẹniti nwọn nwá ọ̀na ati pa kọ́ yi?
entries.en: Then said some of them of Jerusalem, Is not this he, whom they seek to kill?

entries.yo: Si wo o, o nsọrọ ni gbangba, nwọn kò si wi nkankan si i. Awọn olori ha mọ̀ nitõtọ pe, eyi ni Kristi na?
entries.en: But, lo, he speaketh boldly, and they say nothing unto him. Do the rulers know indeed that this is the very Christ?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awa mọ̀ ibi ti ọkunrin yi gbé ti wá: ṣugbọn nigbati Kristi ba de, kò si ẹniti yio mọ̀ ibiti o gbé ti wà.
entries.en: Howbeit we know this man whence he is: but when Christ cometh, no man knoweth whence he is.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Jesu kigbe ni tẹmpili bi o ti nkọ́ni, wipe, Ẹnyin mọ̀ mi, ẹ si mọ̀ ibiti mo ti wá: emi ko si wá fun ara mi, ṣugbọn olõtọ li ẹniti o rán mi, ẹniti ẹnyin kò mọ̀.
entries.en: Then cried Jesus in the temple as he taught, saying, Ye both know me, and ye know whence I am: and I am not come of myself, but he that sent me is true, whom ye know not.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi mọ̀ ọ: nitoripe lọdọ rẹ̀ ni mo ti wá, on li o si rán mi.
entries.en: But I know him: for I am from him, and he hath sent me.

entries.yo: Nitorina nwọn nwá ọ̀na ati mú u: ṣugbọn kò si ẹnikan ti o gbé ọwọ́ le e, nitoriti wakati rẹ̀ kò ti ide.
entries.en: Then they sought to take him: but no man laid hands on him, because his hour was not yet come.

entries.yo: Ọ̀pọ ninu ijọ enia si gbà a gbọ́, nwọn si wipe, Nigbati Kristi na ba de, yio ha ṣe iṣẹ àmi jù wọnyi lọ, ti ọkunrin yi ti ṣe?
entries.en: And many of the people believed on him, and said, When Christ cometh, will he do more miracles than these which this man hath done?

entries.yo: Awọn Farisi gbọ́ pe, ijọ enia nsọ nkan wọnyi labẹlẹ̀ nipa rẹ̀; awọn Farisi ati awọn olori alufã si rán awọn onṣẹ lọ lati mu u.
entries.en: The Pharisees heard that the people murmured such things concerning him; and the Pharisees and the chief priests sent officers to take him.

entries.yo: Nitorina Jesu wi fun wọn pe, Niwọn igba diẹ si i li emi wà pẹlu nyin, emi o si lọ sọdọ ẹniti o rán mi.
entries.en: Then said Jesus unto them, Yet a little while am I with you, and then I go unto him that sent me.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin yio wá mi, ẹnyin kì yio si ri mi: ati ibiti emi ba wà, enyin kì yio le wá.
entries.en: Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, thither ye cannot come.

entries.yo: Nitorina li awọn Ju mba ara wọn sọ pe, Nibo ni ọkunrin yi yio gbé lọ, ti awa kì yio fi ri i? yio ha lọ sarin awọn Hellene ti nwọn fọnká kiri, ki o si ma kọ́ awọn Hellene bi?
entries.en: Then said the Jews among themselves, Whither will he go, that we shall not find him? will he go unto the dispersed among the Gentiles, and teach the Gentiles?

entries.yo: Ọrọ kili eyi ti o sọ yi, Ẹnyin ó wá mi, ẹ kì yio si ri mi: ati ibiti emi ba wà, ẹnyin kì yio le wá?
entries.en: What manner of saying is this that he said, Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, thither ye cannot come?

entries.yo: Lọjọ ikẹhìn, ti iṣe ọjọ nla ajọ, Jesu duro, o si kigbe, wipe, Bi òrùngbẹ ba ngbẹ ẹnikẹni, ki o tọ mi wá, ki o si mu.
entries.en: In the last day, that great day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried, saying, If any man thirst, let him come unto me, and drink.

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni ti o ba gbà mi gbọ́, gẹgẹ bi iwe-mimọ́ ti wi, lati inu rẹ̀ ni odò omi ìye yio ti ma ṣàn jade wá.
entries.en: He that believeth on me, as the scripture hath said, out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water.

entries.yo: (Ṣugbọn o sọ eyi niti Ẹmí, ti awọn ti o gbà a gbọ́ mbọ̀wá gbà: nitori a kò ti ifi Ẹmí Mimọ́ funni; nitoriti a kò ti iṣe Jesu logo.)
entries.en: (But this spake he of the Spirit, which they that believe on him should receive: for the Holy Ghost was not yet given; because that Jesus was not yet glorified.)

entries.yo: Nitorina nigbati ọ̀pọ ninu ijọ enia gbọ́ ọ̀rọ wọnyi, nwọn wipe, Lotọ eyi ni woli na.
entries.en: Many of the people therefore, when they heard this saying, said, Of a truth this is the Prophet.

entries.yo: Awọn miran wipe, Eyi ni Kristi na. Ṣugbọn awọn kan wipe Kinla, Kristi yio ha ti Galili wá bi?
entries.en: Others said, This is the Christ. But some said, Shall Christ come out of Galilee?

entries.yo: Iwe-mimọ́ kò ha wipe, Kristi yio ti inu irú ọmọ Dafidi wá, ati Betlehemu, ilu ti Dafidi ti wà?
entries.en: Hath not the scripture said, That Christ cometh of the seed of David, and out of the town of Bethlehem, where David was?

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni iyapa wà larin ijọ enia nitori rẹ̀.
entries.en: So there was a division among the people because of him.

entries.yo: Awọn miran ninu wọn si fé lati mu u; ṣugbọn kò si ẹnikan ti o gbé ọwọ́ le e.
entries.en: And some of them would have taken him; but no man laid hands on him.

entries.yo: Nitorina awọn onṣẹ pada tọ̀ awọn olori alufa ati awọn Farisi wá; nwọn si wi fun wọn pe, Ẽṣe ti ẹnyin kò fi mu u wá?
entries.en: Then came the officers to the chief priests and Pharisees; and they said unto them, Why have ye not brought him?

entries.yo: Awọn onṣẹ dahùn wipe, Kò si ẹniti o ti isọ̀rọ bi ọkunrin yi ri.
entries.en: The officers answered, Never man spake like this man.

entries.yo: Nitorina awọn Farisi da wọn lohùn wipe, A ha tàn ẹnyin jẹ pẹlu bi?
entries.en: Then answered them the Pharisees, Are ye also deceived?

entries.yo: O ha si ẹnikan ninu awọn ijoye, tabi awọn Farisi ti o gbà a gbọ́?
entries.en: Have any of the rulers or of the Pharisees believed on him?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ijọ enia yi, ti kò mọ̀ ofin, di ẹni ifibu.
entries.en: But this people who knoweth not the law are cursed.

entries.yo: Nikodemu si wi fun wọn pe, (ẹniti o tọ̀ Jesu wá loru, o jẹ ọkan ninu wọn),
entries.en: Nicodemus saith unto them, (he that came to Jesus by night, being one of them,)

entries.yo: Ofin wa nṣe idajọ enia ki o to gbọ ti ẹnu rẹ̀, ati ki o to mọ̀ ohun ti o ṣe bi?
entries.en: Doth our law judge any man, before it hear him, and know what he doeth?

entries.yo: Nwọn dahùn nwọn si wi fun u pe, Iwọ pẹlu nṣe ara Galili ndan? Wá kiri, ki o si wò: nitori kò si woli kan ti o ti Galili dide.
entries.en: They answered and said unto him, Art thou also of Galilee? Search, and look: for out of Galilee ariseth no prophet.

entries.yo: Nwọn si lọ olukuluku si ile rẹ̀.
entries.en: And every man went unto his own house.

entries.yo: JESU si lọ si ori òke Olifi.
entries.en: Jesus went unto the mount of Olives.

entries.yo: O si tún pada wá si tẹmpili ni kutukutu owurọ̀, gbogbo enia si wá sọdọ rẹ̀; o si joko, o nkọ́ wọn.
entries.en: And early in the morning he came again into the temple, and all the people came unto him; and he sat down, and taught them.

entries.yo: Awọn akọwe ati awọn Farisi si mu obinrin kan wá sọdọ rẹ̀, ti a mu ninu panṣaga; nigbati nwọn si mu u duro larin,
entries.en: And the scribes and Pharisees brought unto him a woman taken in adultery; and when they had set her in the midst,

entries.yo: Nwọn wi fun u pe, Olukọni, a mu obinrin yi ninu panṣaga, ninu ṣiṣe e pãpã.
entries.en: They say unto him, Master, this woman was taken in adultery, in the very act.

entries.yo: Njẹ ninu ofin, Mose paṣẹ fun wa lati sọ iru awọn bẹ̃ li okuta pa: ṣugbọn iwọ ha ti wi?
entries.en: Now Moses in the law commanded us, that such should be stoned: but what sayest thou?

entries.yo: Eyini nwọn wi, nwọn ndán a wò, ki nwọn ba le ri ohun lati fi i sùn. Ṣugbọn Jesu bẹrẹ silẹ, o si nfi ika rẹ̀ kọwe ni ilẹ.
entries.en: This they said, tempting him, that they might have to accuse him. But Jesus stooped down, and with his finger wrote on the ground, as though he heard them not.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati nwọn mbi i lẽre sibẹsibẹ, o gbé ara rẹ̀ soke, o si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹniti o ba ṣe ailẹṣẹ ninu nyin, jẹ ki o kọ́ sọ okuta lù u.
entries.en: So when they continued asking him, he lifted up himself, and said unto them, He that is without sin among you, let him first cast a stone at her.

entries.yo: O si tún bẹ̀rẹ̀ silẹ, o nkọwe ni ilẹ.
entries.en: And again he stooped down, and wrote on the ground.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn gbọ eyi, nwọn si jade lọ lọkọ̃kan, bẹrẹ lati ọdọ awọn àgba titi de awọn ti o kẹhin; a si fi Jesu nikan silẹ, ati obinrin na lãrin, nibiti o ti wà.
entries.en: And they which heard it, being convicted by their own conscience, went out one by one, beginning at the eldest, even unto the last: and Jesus was left alone, and the woman standing in the midst.

entries.yo: Jesu si gbé ara rẹ̀ soke, o si wi fun u pe, Obinrin yi, awọn dà? kò si ẹnikan ti o da ọ lẹbi?
entries.en: When Jesus had lifted up himself, and saw none but the woman, he said unto her, Woman, where are those thine accusers? hath no man condemned thee?

entries.yo: O wipe, Kò si ẹnikan, Oluwa. Jesu si wi fun u pe, Bẹ̃li emi na kò da ọ lẹbi: mã lọ, lati igbayi lọ má dẹṣẹ̀ mọ́.
entries.en: She said, No man, Lord. And Jesus said unto her, Neither do I condemn thee: go, and sin no more.

entries.yo: Jesu si tun sọ fun wọn pe, Emi ni imọlẹ aiye; ẹniti o ba tọ̀ mi lẹhin kì yio rìn ninu òkunkun, ṣugbọn yio ni imọlẹ ìye.
entries.en: Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.

entries.yo: Nitorina awọn Farisi wi fun u pe, Iwọ njẹri ara rẹ; ẹrí rẹ kì iṣe otitọ.
entries.en: The Pharisees therefore said unto him, Thou bearest record of thyself; thy record is not true.

entries.yo: Jesu dahùn o si wi fun wọn pe, Bi mo tilẹ njẹri fun ara mi, otitọ li ẹrí mi: nitoriti mo mọ̀ ibiti mo ti wá, mo si mọ̀ ibiti mo nlọ; ṣugbọn ẹnyin kò le mọ̀ ibiti mo ti wá, ati ibiti mo nlọ.
entries.en: Jesus answered and said unto them, Though I bear record of myself, yet my record is true: for I know whence I came, and whither I go; but ye cannot tell whence I come, and whither I go.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin nṣe idajọ nipa ti ara; emi kò ṣe idajọ ẹnikẹni.
entries.en: Ye judge after the flesh; I judge no man.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi emi ba si ṣe idajo, otitọ ni idajọ mi: nitori emi nikan kọ́, ṣugbọn emi ati Baba ti o rán mi.
entries.en: And yet if I judge, my judgment is true: for I am not alone, but I and the Father that sent me.

entries.yo: Ẹ si kọ ọ pẹlu ninu ofin nyin pe, otitọ li ẹrí enia meji.
entries.en: It is also written in your law, that the testimony of two men is true.

entries.yo: Emi li ẹniti njẹri ara mi, ati Baba ti o rán mi si njẹri fun mi.
entries.en: I am one that bear witness of myself, and the Father that sent me beareth witness of me.

entries.yo: Nitorina nwọn wi fun u pe, Nibo ni Baba rẹ wà? Jesu dahùn pe, Ẹnyin kò mọ̀ mi, bẹli ẹ kò mọ̀ Baba mi: ibaṣepe ẹnyin mọ̀ mi, ẹnyin iba si ti mọ̀ Baba mi pẹlu.
entries.en: Then said they unto him, Where is thy Father? Jesus answered, Ye neither know me, nor my Father: if ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ wọnyi ni Jesu sọ nibi iṣura, bi o ti nkọ́ni ni tẹmpili: ẹnikẹni ko si mu u; nitori wakati rẹ̀ ko ti ide.
entries.en: These words spake Jesus in the treasury, as he taught in the temple: and no man laid hands on him; for his hour was not yet come.

entries.yo: Nitorina o tun wi fun wọn pe, Emi nlọ, ẹnyin yio si wá mi, ẹ ó si kú ninu ẹ̀ṣẹ nyin: ibiti emi gbe nlọ, ẹnyin kì ó le wá.
entries.en: Then said Jesus again unto them, I go my way, and ye shall seek me, and shall die in your sins: whither I go, ye cannot come.

entries.yo: Nitorina awọn Ju wipe, On o ha pa ara rẹ̀ bi? nitoriti o wipe, Ibiti emi gbé nlọ, ẹnyin kì ó le wá.
entries.en: Then said the Jews, Will he kill himself? because he saith, Whither I go, ye cannot come.

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹnyin ti isalẹ wá; emi ti oke wá: ẹnyin jẹ ti aiye yi; emi kì iṣe ti aiye yi.
entries.en: And he said unto them, Ye are from beneath; I am from above: ye are of this world; I am not of this world.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni mo ṣe wi fun nyin pe, ẹ ó kú ninu ẹ̀ṣẹ nyin: nitori bikoṣepé ẹ ba gbagbọ́ pe, emi ni, ẹ ó kú ninu ẹ̀ṣẹ nyin.
entries.en: I said therefore unto you, that ye shall die in your sins: for if ye believe not that I am he, ye shall die in your sins.

entries.yo: Nitorina nwọn wi fun u pe, Tani iwọ iṣe? Jesu si wi fun wọn pe, Ani eyinì ti mo ti wi fun nyin li àtetekọṣe.
entries.en: Then said they unto him, Who art thou? And Jesus saith unto them, Even the same that I said unto you from the beginning.

entries.yo: Mo ni ohun pupọ̀ lati sọ, ati lati ṣe idajọ nipa nyin: ṣugbọn olõtọ li ẹniti o ran mi, ohun ti emi si ti gbọ lati ọdọ rẹ̀ wá, nwọnyi li emi nsọ fun araiye.
entries.en: I have many things to say and to judge of you: but he that sent me is true; and I speak to the world those things which I have heard of him.

entries.yo: Kò yé wọn pe, ti Baba li o nsọ fun wọn.
entries.en: They understood not that he spake to them of the Father.

entries.yo: Nitorina Jesu wi fun wọn pe, Nigbati ẹ ba gbé Ọmọ-enia soke, nigbana li ẹ o mọ̀ pe, emi ni, ati pe emi kò dá ohunkohun ṣe fun ara mi; ṣugbọn bi Baba ti kọ́ mi, emi nsọ nkan wọnyi.
entries.en: Then said Jesus unto them, When ye have lifted up the Son of man, then shall ye know that I am he, and that I do nothing of myself; but as my Father hath taught me, I speak these things.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o rán mi si mbẹ pẹlu mi: kò jọwọ emi nikan si; nitoriti emi nṣe ohun ti o wù u nigbagbogbo.
entries.en: And he that sent me is with me: the Father hath not left me alone; for I do always those things that please him.

entries.yo: Bi o ti nsọ nkan wọnyi, ọ̀pọ enia gbà a gbọ́.
entries.en: As he spake these words, many believed on him.

entries.yo: Nitorina Jesu wi fun awọn Ju ti o gbà a gbọ́ pe, Bi ẹnyin ba duro ninu ọ̀rọ mi, nigbana li ẹnyin jẹ ọmọ-ẹhin mi nitõtọ.
entries.en: Then said Jesus to those Jews which believed on him, If ye continue in my word, then are ye my disciples indeed;

entries.yo: Ẹ ó si mọ̀ otitọ, otitọ yio si sọ nyin di omnira.
entries.en: And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.

entries.yo: Nwọn da a lohùn wipe, Irú-ọmọ Abrahamu li awa iṣe, awa kò si ṣe ẹrú fun ẹnikẹni ri lai: iwọ ha ṣe wipe, Ẹ o di omnira?
entries.en: They answered him, We be Abraham's seed, and were never in bondage to any man: how sayest thou, Ye shall be made free?

entries.yo: Jesu da wọn lohun pe, Lõtọ, lõtọ ni mo wi fun nyin, Ẹnikẹni ti o ba ndẹṣẹ, on li ẹrú ẹ̀ṣẹ.
entries.en: Jesus answered them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whosoever committeth sin is the servant of sin.

entries.yo: Ẹrú kì si igbé ile titilai: Ọmọ ni igbe ile titilai.
entries.en: And the servant abideth not in the house for ever: but the Son abideth ever.

entries.yo: Nitorina bi Ọmọ ba sọ nyin di omnira, ẹ ó di omnira nitõtọ.
entries.en: If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.

entries.yo: Mo mọ̀ pe irú-ọmọ Abrahamu li ẹnyin iṣe; ṣugbọn ẹ nwá ọ̀na ati pa mi, nitori ọ̀rọ mi kò ri àye ninu nyin.
entries.en: I know that ye are Abraham's seed; but ye seek to kill me, because my word hath no place in you.

entries.yo: Ohun ti emi ti ri lọdọ Baba ni mo nsọ: ẹnyin pẹlu si nṣe eyi ti ẹnyin ti gbọ lati ọdọ baba nyin.
entries.en: I speak that which I have seen with my Father: and ye do that which ye have seen with your father.

entries.yo: Nwọn dahùn nwọn si wi fun u pe, Abrahamu ni baba wa. Jesu wi fun wọn pe, Ibaṣepe ọmọ Abrahamu li ẹnyin iṣe, ẹnyin iba ṣe iṣẹ Abrahamu.
entries.en: They answered and said unto him, Abraham is our father. Jesus saith unto them, If ye were Abraham's children, ye would do the works of Abraham.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nisisiyi ẹnyin nwá ọ̀na ati pa mi, ẹniti o sọ otitọ fun nyin, eyi ti mo ti gbọ́ lọdọ Ọlọrun: Abrahamu kò ṣe eyi.
entries.en: But now ye seek to kill me, a man that hath told you the truth, which I have heard of God: this did not Abraham.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin nṣe iṣẹ baba nyin. Nigbana ni nwọn wi fun u pe, A ko bí wa nipa panṣaga: a ni Baba kan, eyini li Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Ye do the deeds of your father. Then said they to him, We be not born of fornication; we have one Father, even God.

entries.yo: Jesu wi fun wọn pe, Ibaṣepe Ọlọrun ni Baba nyin, ẹnyin iba fẹran mi: nitoriti emi ti ọdọ Ọlọrun jade, mo si wá: bẹ̃li emi kò si wá fun ara mi, ṣugbọn on li o rán mi.
entries.en: Jesus said unto them, If God were your Father, ye would love me: for I proceeded forth and came from God; neither came I of myself, but he sent me.

entries.yo: Ẽtiṣe ti ède mi kò fi yé nyin? nitori ẹ ko le gbọ́ ọ̀rọ mi ni.
entries.en: Why do ye not understand my speech? even because ye cannot hear my word.

entries.yo: Ti eṣu baba nyin li ẹnyin iṣe, ifẹkufẹ baba nyin li ẹ si nfẹ ṣe. Apania li on iṣe lati atetekọṣe, ko si duro ni otitọ; nitoriti kò si otitọ ninu rẹ̀. Nigbati o ba nṣeke, ninu ohun tirẹ̀ li o nsọ, nitori eke ni, ati baba eke.
entries.en: Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nitori emi sọ otitọ fun nyin, ẹ kò si gbà mi gbọ́.
entries.en: And because I tell you the truth, ye believe me not.

entries.yo: Tani ninu nyin ti o ti idá mi li ẹbi ẹ̀ṣẹ? Bi mo ba nsọ otitọ ẽṣe ti ẹnyin kò fi gbà mi gbọ́?
entries.en: Which of you convinceth me of sin? And if I say the truth, why do ye not believe me?

entries.yo: Ẹniti iṣe ti Ọlọrun, a ma gbọ́ ọ̀rọ Ọlọrun: nitori eyi li ẹnyin kò ṣe gbọ, nitori ẹnyin kì iṣe ti Ọlọrun.
entries.en: He that is of God heareth God's words: ye therefore hear them not, because ye are not of God.

entries.yo: Awọn Ju dahùn nwọn si wi fun u pe, Awa kò wi nitõtọ pe, ara Samaria ni iwọ iṣe, ati pe iwọ li ẹmi èṣu?
entries.en: Then answered the Jews, and said unto him, Say we not well that thou art a Samaritan, and hast a devil?

entries.yo: Jesu dahùn wipe, Emi kò li ẹmi èṣu; ṣugbọn emi mbọlá fun Baba mi, ẹnyin kò si bọla fun mi.
entries.en: Jesus answered, I have not a devil; but I honour my Father, and ye do dishonour me.

entries.yo: Emi kò wá ogo ara mi: ẹnikan mbẹ ti o nwà a ti o si nṣe idajọ.
entries.en: And I seek not mine own glory: there is one that seeketh and judgeth.

entries.yo: Lõtọ, lõtọ ni mo wi fun nyin, Bi ẹnikan ba pa ọ̀rọ mi mọ́, ki yio ri ikú lailai.
entries.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, If a man keep my saying, he shall never see death.

entries.yo: Awọn Ju wi fun u pe, Nigbayi ni awa mọ̀ pe iwọ li ẹmi èṣu. Abrahamu kú, ati awọn woli; iwọ si wipe, Bi ẹnikan ba pa ọ̀rọ mi mọ́, kì yio tọ́ ikú wò lailai.
entries.en: Then said the Jews unto him, Now we know that thou hast a devil. Abraham is dead, and the prophets; and thou sayest, If a man keep my saying, he shall never taste of death.

entries.yo: Iwọ ha pọ̀ju Abrahamu baba wa lọ, ẹniti o kú? awọn woli si kú: tani iwọ nfi ara rẹ pè?
entries.en: Art thou greater than our father Abraham, which is dead? and the prophets are dead: whom makest thou thyself?

entries.yo: Jesu dahùn wipe, Bi mo ba nyìn ara mi li ogo, ogo mi kò jẹ nkan: Baba mi ni ẹniti nyìn mi li ogo, ẹniti ẹnyin wipe, Ọlọrun nyin ni iṣe:
entries.en: Jesus answered, If I honour myself, my honour is nothing: it is my Father that honoureth me; of whom ye say, that he is your God:

entries.yo: Ẹ kò si mọ̀ ọ; ṣugbọn emi mọ̀ ọ: bi mo ba si wipe, emi kò mọ̀ ọ, emi ó di eke gẹgẹ bi ẹnyin: ṣugbọn emi mọ̀ ọ, mo si pa ọ̀rọ rẹ̀ mọ́.
entries.en: Yet ye have not known him; but I know him: and if I should say, I know him not, I shall be a liar like unto you: but I know him, and keep his saying.

entries.yo: Abrahamu baba nyin yọ̀ lati ri ọjọ mi: o si ri i, o si yọ̀.
entries.en: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day: and he saw it, and was glad.

entries.yo: Nitorina awọn Ju wi fun u pe, Ọdún rẹ kò ti ito adọta, iwọ si ti ri Abrahamu?
entries.en: Then said the Jews unto him, Thou art not yet fifty years old, and hast thou seen Abraham?

entries.yo: Jesu si wi fun wọn pe, Lõtọ, lõtọ ni mo wi fun nyin, Ki Abrahamu to wà, emi ti wà.
entries.en: Jesus said unto them, Verily,verily, I say unto you, Before Abraham was, I am.

entries.yo: Nitorina nwọn gbé okuta lati sọ lù u: ṣugbọn Jesu fi ara rẹ̀ pamọ́, o si jade kuro ni tẹmpili.
entries.en: Then took they up stones to cast at him: but Jesus hid himself, and went out of the temple, going through the midst of them, and so passed by.

entries.yo: BI o si ti nkọja lọ, o ri ọkunrin kan ti o fọju lati igba ibí rẹ̀ wá.
entries.en: And as Jesus passed by, he saw a man which was blind from his birth.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ si bi i lẽre, wipe. Olukọni, tani dẹṣẹ, ọkunrin yi tabi awọn obi rẹ̀, ti a fi bi i li afọju?
entries.en: And his disciples asked him, saying, Master, who did sin, this man, or his parents, that he was born blind?

entries.yo: Jesu dahùn pe, Kì iṣe nitoriti ọkunrin yi dẹṣẹ, tabi awọn obi rẹ̀: ṣugbọn ki a le fi iṣẹ Ọlọrun hàn lara rẹ̀.
entries.en: Jesus answered, Neither hath this man sinned, nor his parents: but that the works of God should be made manifest in him.

entries.yo: Emi kò le ṣe alaiṣe iṣẹ ẹniti o rán mi, nigbati iṣe ọsan: oru mbọ̀ wá nigbati ẹnikan kì o le ṣe iṣẹ.
entries.en: I must work the works of him that sent me, while it is day: the night cometh, when no man can work.

entries.yo: Niwọn igba ti mo wà li aiye, emi ni imọlẹ aiye.
entries.en: As long as I am in the world, I am the light of the world.

entries.yo: Nigbati o ti wi bẹ̃ tan, o tutọ́ silẹ, o si fi itọ́ na ṣe amọ̀, o si fi amọ̀ na pa oju afọju na,
entries.en: When he had thus spoken, he spat on the ground, and made clay of the spittle, and he anointed the eyes of the blind man with the clay,

entries.yo: O si wi fun u pe, Lọ, wẹ̀ ninu adagun Siloamu, (itumọ̀ eyi ti ijẹ Ránlọ.) Nitorina o gbà ọ̀na rẹ̀ lọ, o wẹ̀, o si de, o nriran.
entries.en: And said unto him, Go, wash in the pool of Siloam, (which is by interpretation, Sent.) He went his way therefore, and washed, and came seeing.

entries.yo: Njẹ awọn aladugbo ati awọn ti o ri i nigba atijọ pe alagbe ni iṣe, wipe, Ẹniti o ti njoko ṣagbe kọ́ yi?
entries.en: The neighbours therefore, and they which before had seen him that he was blind, said, Is not this he that sat and begged?

entries.yo: Awọn kan wipe, On ni: awọn ẹlomiran wipe, Bẹ̃kọ, o jọ ọ ni: ṣugbọn on wipe, Emi ni.
entries.en: Some said, This is he: others said, He is like him: but he said, I am he.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni nwọn wi fun u pe, Njẹ oju rẹ ti ṣe là?
entries.en: Therefore said they unto him, How were thine eyes opened?

entries.yo: O dahùn o si wi fun wọn pe, ọkunrin kan ti a npè ni Jesu li o ṣe amọ̀, o si fi kùn mi loju, o si wi fun mi pe, Lọ si adagun Siloamu, ki o si wẹ̀: emi si lọ, mo wẹ̀, mo si riran.
entries.en: He answered and said, A man that is called Jesus made clay, and anointed mine eyes, and said unto me, Go to the pool of Siloam, and wash: and I went and washed, and I received sight.

entries.yo: Nwọn si wi fun u pe, On na ha dà? O wipe, emi kò mọ̀.
entries.en: Then said they unto him, Where is he? He said, I know not.

entries.yo: Nwọn mu ẹniti oju rẹ̀ ti fọ́ ri wá sọdọ awọn Farisi.
entries.en: They brought to the Pharisees him that aforetime was blind.

entries.yo: Njẹ ọjọ isimi lọjọ na nigbati Jesu ṣe amọ̀ na, ti o si là a loju.
entries.en: And it was the sabbath day when Jesus made the clay, and opened his eyes.

entries.yo: Nitorina awọn Farisi pẹlu tún bi i lẽre, bi o ti ṣe riran. O si wi fun wọn pe, O fi amọ̀ le oju mi, mo si wẹ̀ mo si riran.
entries.en: Then again the Pharisees also asked him how he had received his sight. He said unto them, He put clay upon mine eyes, and I washed, and do see.

entries.yo: Nitorina awọn kan ninu awọn Farisi wipe, ọkunrin yi kò ti ọdọ Ọlọrun wá, nitoriti kò pa ọjọ isimi mọ́. Awọn ẹlomiran wipe, ọkunrin ti iṣe ẹlẹṣẹ yio ha ti ṣe le ṣe irú iṣẹ àmi wọnyi? Iyapa si wà larin wọn.
entries.en: Therefore said some of the Pharisees, This man is not of God, because he keepeth not the sabbath day. Others said, How can a man that is a sinner do such miracles? And there was a division among them.

entries.yo: Nitorina nwọn si tun wi fun afọju na pe, Kini iwọ wi nitori rẹ̀, nitoriti o là ọ loju? O si wipe, Woli ni iṣe.
entries.en: They say unto the blind man again, What sayest thou of him, that he hath opened thine eyes? He said, He is a prophet.

entries.yo: Nitorina awọn Ju kò gbagbọ́ nitori rẹ̀ pe, oju rẹ̀ ti fọ́ ri, ati pe o si tún riran, titi nwọn fi pe awọn obi ẹniti a ti là loju.
entries.en: But the Jews did not believe concerning him, that he had been blind, and received his sight, until they called the parents of him that had received his sight.

entries.yo: Nwọn si bi wọn lẽre, wipe, Eyi li ọmọ nyin, ẹniti ẹnyin wipe, a bí i li afọju? ẽhaṣe ti o riran nisisiyi?
entries.en: And they asked them, saying, Is this your son, who ye say was born blind? how then doth he now see?

entries.yo: Awọn obi rẹ̀ da wọn lohùn wipe, Awa mọ̀ pe ọmọ wa li eyi, ati pe a bí i li afọju:
entries.en: His parents answered them and said, We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi o ti ṣe nriran nisisiyi awa kò mọ̀; tabi ẹniti o la a loju, awa kò mọ̀: ẹniti o gbọ́njú ni iṣe; ẹ bi i lẽre: yio wi fun ara rẹ̀.
entries.en: But by what means he now seeth, we know not; or who hath opened his eyes, we know not: he is of age; ask him: he shall speak for himself.

entries.yo: Nkan wọnyi li awọn obi rẹ̀ sọ, nitoriti nwọn bẹ̀ru awọn Ju: nitori awọn Ju ti fi ohùn ṣọkan pe, bi ẹnikan ba jẹwọ pe, Kristi ni iṣe, nwọn ó yọ ọ kuro ninu sinagogu.
entries.en: These words spake his parents, because they feared the Jews: for the Jews had agreed already, that if any man did confess that he was Christ, he should be put out of the synagogue.

entries.yo: Nitori eyi li awọn obi rẹ̀ fi wipe, Ẹniti o gbọ́njú ni iṣe; ẹ bi i lẽre.
entries.en: Therefore said his parents, He is of age; ask him.

entries.yo: Nitorina nwọn pè ọkunrin afọju na lẹ̃keji, nwọn si wi fun u pe, Fi ogo fun Ọlọrun: awa mọ̀ pe ẹlẹṣẹ li ọkunrin yi iṣe.
entries.en: Then again called they the man that was blind, and said unto him, Give God the praise: we know that this man is a sinner.

entries.yo: Nitorina o dahùn o si wipe, Bi ẹlẹṣẹ ni, emi kò mọ̀: ohun kan ni mo mọ̀, pe mo ti fọju ri, mo riran nisisiyi.
entries.en: He answered and said, Whether he be a sinner or no, I know not: one thing I know, that, whereas I was blind, now I see.

entries.yo: Nitorina nwọn wi fun u pe, Kili o ṣe si ọ? o ti ṣe là ọ loju?
entries.en: Then said they to him again, What did he to thee? how opened he thine eyes?

entries.yo: O da wọn lohùn wipe, Emi ti sọ fun nyin na, ẹnyin ko si gbọ́: nitori kini ẹnyin ṣe nfẹ tún gbọ́? ẹnyin pẹlu nfẹ ṣe ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ bi?
entries.en: He answered them, I have told you already, and ye did not hear: wherefore would ye hear it again? will ye also be his disciples?

entries.yo: Nwọn si fi i ṣe ẹlẹyà, nwọn si wipe, Iwọ li ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀; ṣugbọn ọmọ-ẹhin Mose li awa.
entries.en: Then they reviled him, and said, Thou art his disciple; but we are Moses' disciples.

entries.yo: Awa mọ̀ pe Ọlọrun ba Mose sọ̀rọ: ṣugbọn bi o ṣe ti eleyi, awa kò mọ̀ ibiti o gbé ti wá.
entries.en: We know that God spake unto Moses: as for this fellow, we know not from whence he is.

entries.yo: Ọkunrin na dahùn o si wi fun wọn pe, Ohun iyanu sá li eyi, pe, ẹnyin kò mọ̀ ibiti o gbé ti wá, ṣugbọn on sá ti là mi loju.
entries.en: The man answered and said unto them, Why herein is a marvellous thing, that ye know not from whence he is, and yet he hath opened mine eyes.

entries.yo: Awa mọ̀ pe, Ọlọrun ki igbọ́ ti ẹlẹṣẹ: ṣugbọn bi ẹnikan ba ṣe olufọkansin si Ọlọrun, ti o ba si nṣe ifẹ rẹ̀, on ni igbọ́ tirẹ̀.
entries.en: Now we know that God heareth not sinners: but if any man be a worshipper of God, and doeth his will, him he heareth.

entries.yo: Lati igba ti aiye ti ṣẹ̀, a kò ti igbọ́ pe, ẹnikan là oju ẹniti a bí li afọju rí.
entries.en: Since the world began was it not heard that any man opened the eyes of one that was born blind.

entries.yo: Ibaṣepe ọkunrin yi ko ti ọdọ Ọlọrun wá, kì ba ti le ṣe ohunkohun.
entries.en: If this man were not of God, he could do nothing.

entries.yo: Nwọn si dahùn wi fun u pe, Ninu ẹṣẹ li a bi iwọ patapata, iwọ si nkọ́ wa bi? Nwọn si tì i sode.
entries.en: They answered and said unto him, Thou wast altogether born in sins, and dost thou teach us? And they cast him out.

entries.yo: Jesu gbọ́ pe, nwọn ti tì i sode; nigbati o si ri i, o wipe, Iwọ gbà Ọmọ Ọlọrun gbọ́ bi?
entries.en: Jesus heard that they had cast him out; and when he had found him, he said unto him, Dost thou believe on the Son of God?

entries.yo: On si dahùn wipe, Tani, Oluwa, ki emi ki o le gbà a gbọ́?
entries.en: He answered and said, Who is he, Lord, that I might believe on him?

entries.yo: Jesu wi fun u pe, Iwọ ti ri i, on na si ni ẹniti mba ọ sọ̀rọ yi.
entries.en: And Jesus said unto him, Thou hast both seen him, and it is he that talketh with thee.

entries.yo: O si wipe, Oluwa, mo gbagbọ́, o si wolẹ fun u.
entries.en: And he said, Lord, I believe. And he worshipped him.

entries.yo: Jesu si wipe, Nitori idajọ ni mo ṣe wá si aiye yi, ki awọn ti kò riran, le riran; ati ki awọn ti o riran le di afọju.
entries.en: And Jesus said, For judgment I am come into this world, that they which see not might see; and that they which see might be made blind.

entries.yo: Ninu awọn Farisi ti o wà lọdọ rẹ̀ gbọ́ nkan wọnyi, nwọn si wi fun u pe, Awa pẹlu fọju bi?
entries.en: And some of the Pharisees which were with him heard these words, and said unto him, Are we blind also?

entries.yo: Jesu wi fun wọn pe, Ibaṣepe ẹnyin fọju, ẹnyin kì ba ti li ẹ̀ṣẹ: ṣugbọn nisisiyi ẹnyin wipe, Awa riran; nitorina ẹ̀ṣẹ nyin wà sibẹ̀.
entries.en: Jesus said unto them, If ye were blind, ye should have no sin: but now ye say, We see; therefore your sin remaineth.

entries.yo: LÕTỌ, lõtọ ni mo wi fun nyin, Ẹniti kò ba gbà ẹnu-ọ̀na wọ̀ inu agbo agutan, ṣugbọn ti o ba gbà ibomiran gùn oke, on na li olè ati ọlọṣà.
entries.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that entereth not by the door into the sheepfold, but climbeth up some other way, the same is a thief and a robber.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹniti o ba ba ti ẹnu-ọ̀na wọle, on ni iṣe oluṣọ awọn agutan.
entries.en: But he that entereth in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.

entries.yo: On ni oludèna ṣilẹkun fun; awọn agutan si gbọ ohùn rẹ̀: o si pè awọn agutan tirẹ̀ li orukọ, o si ṣe amọ̀na wọn jade.
entries.en: To him the porter openeth; and the sheep hear his voice: and he calleth his own sheep by name, and leadeth them out.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si mu awọn agutan tirẹ̀ jade, o ṣiwaju wọn, awọn agutan si ntọ̀ ọ lẹhin: nitoriti nwọn mọ̀ ohùn rẹ̀.
entries.en: And when he putteth forth his own sheep, he goeth before them, and the sheep follow him: for they know his voice.

entries.yo: Nwọn kò jẹ tọ̀ alejò lẹhin, ṣugbọn nwọn a ma sá lọdọ rẹ̀: nitoriti nwọn kò mọ̀ ohùn alejò.
entries.en: And a stranger will they not follow, but will flee from him: for they know not the voice of strangers.

entries.yo: Owe yi ni Jesu pa fun wọn: ṣugbọn òye ohun ti nkan wọnni jẹ ti o nsọ fun wọn kò yé wọn.
entries.en: This parable spake Jesus unto them: but they understood not what things they were which he spake unto them.

entries.yo: Nitorina Jesu tún wi fun wọn pe, Lõtọ, lõtọ ni mo wi fun nyin, Emi ni ilẹkun awọn agutan.
entries.en: Then said Jesus unto them again, Verily, verily, I say unto you, I am the door of the sheep.

entries.yo: Olè ati ọlọṣà ni gbogbo awọn ti o ti wá ṣiwaju mi: ṣugbọn awọn agutan kò gbọ́ ti wọn.
entries.en: All that ever came before me are thieves and robbers: but the sheep did not hear them.

entries.yo: Emi ni ilẹkun: bi ẹnikan ba ba ọdọ mi wọle, on li a o gbà là, yio wọle, yio si jade, yio si ri koriko.
entries.en: I am the door: by me if any man enter in, he shall be saved, and shall go in and out, and find pasture.

entries.yo: Olè kì iwá bikoṣe lati jale, ati lati pa, ati lati parun: emi wá ki nwọn le ni ìye, ani ki nwọn le ni i lọpọlọpọ.
entries.en: The thief cometh not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly.

entries.yo: Emi ni oluṣọ-agutan rere: oluṣọ-agutan rere fi ẹmí rẹ̀ lelẹ nitori awọn agutan.
entries.en: I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his life for the sheep.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn alagbaṣe, ti kì iṣe oluṣọ-agutan, ẹniti awọn agutan kì iṣe tirẹ̀, o ri ikõkò mbọ̀, o si fi awọn agutan silẹ, o si sá lọ: ikõkò si mu awọn agutan, o si fọn wọn ká kiri.
entries.en: But he that is an hireling, and not the shepherd, whose own the sheep are not, seeth the wolf coming, and leaveth the sheep, and fleeth: and the wolf catcheth them, and scattereth the sheep.

entries.yo: Alagbaṣe sá lọ nitoriti iṣe alagbaṣe, kò si náni awọn agutan.
entries.en: The hireling fleeth, because he is an hireling, and careth not for the sheep.

entries.yo: Emi ni oluṣọ-agutan rere, mo si mọ̀ awọn temi, awọn temi si mọ̀ mi.
entries.en: I am the good shepherd, and know my sheep, and am known of mine.

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi Baba ti mọ̀ mi, ti emi si mọ̀ Baba; mo si fi ẹmí mi lelẹ nitori awọn agutan.
entries.en: As the Father knoweth me, even so know I the Father: and I lay down my life for the sheep.

entries.yo: Emi si ní awọn agutan miran, ti kì iṣe ti agbo yi: awọn li emi kò le ṣe alaimu wá pẹlu, nwọn ó si gbọ ohùn mi; nwọn o si jẹ agbo kan, oluṣọ-agutan kan.
entries.en: And other sheep I have, which are not of this fold: them also I must bring, and they shall hear my voice; and there shall be one fold, and one shepherd.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni Baba mi ṣe fẹran mi, nitoriti mo fi ẹmí mi lelẹ, ki emi ki o le tún gbà a.
entries.en: Therefore doth my Father love me, because I lay down my life, that I might take it again.

entries.yo: Ẹnikan kò gbà a lọwọ mi, ṣugbọn mo fi i lelẹ fun ara mi. Mo li agbara lati fi i lelẹ, mo si li agbara lati tún gbà a. Aṣẹ yi ni mo ti gbà lati ọdọ Baba mi wá.
entries.en: No man taketh it from me, but I lay it down of myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. This commandment have I received of my Father.

entries.yo: Nitorina iyapa tun wà larin awọn Ju nitori ọ̀rọ wọnyi.
entries.en: There was a division therefore again among the Jews for these sayings.

entries.yo: Ọpọ ninu wọn si wipe, O li ẹmi èṣu, ori rẹ̀ si bajẹ; ẽṣe ti ẹnyin ngbọ̀rọ rẹ̀?
entries.en: And many of them said, He hath a devil, and is mad; why hear ye him?

entries.yo: Awọn miran wipe, Wọnyi kì iṣe ọ̀rọ ẹniti o li ẹmi èsu. Ẹmi èsu le là oju awọn afọju bi?
entries.en: Others said, These are not the words of him that hath a devil. Can a devil open the eyes of the blind?

entries.yo: O si jẹ ajọ ọdun iyasimimọ́ ni Jerusalemu, igba otutù ni.
entries.en: And it was at Jerusalem the feast of the dedication, and it was winter.

entries.yo: Jesu si nrìn ni tẹmpili, nì ìloro Solomoni.
entries.en: And Jesus walked in the temple in Solomon's porch.

entries.yo: Nitorina awọn Ju wá duro yi i ká, nwọn si wi fun u pe, Iwọ ó ti mu wa ṣe iyemeji pẹ to? Bi iwọ ni iṣe Kristi na, wi fun wa gbangba.
entries.en: Then came the Jews round about him, and said unto him, How long dost thou make us to doubt? If thou be the Christ, tell us plainly.

entries.yo: Jesu da wọn lohùn wipe, Emi ti wi fun nyin, ẹnyin kò si gbagbọ́; iṣẹ ti emi nṣe li orukọ Baba mi, awọn ni njẹri mi.
entries.en: Jesus answered them, I told you, and ye believed not: the works that I do in my Father's name, they bear witness of me.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹnyin kò gbagbọ́, nitori ẹnyin kò si ninu awọn agutan mi, gẹgẹ bi mo ti wi fun nyin.
entries.en: But ye believe not, because ye are not of my sheep, as I said unto you.

entries.yo: Awọn agutan mi ngbọ ohùn mi, emi si mọ̀ wọn, nwọn a si ma tọ̀ mi lẹhin:
entries.en: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me:

entries.yo: Emi si fun wọn ni ìye ainipẹkun; nwọn kì o si ṣegbé lailai, kò si si ẹniti o le já wọn kuro li ọwọ́ mi.
entries.en: And I give unto them eternal life; and they shall never perish, neither shall any man pluck them out of my hand.

entries.yo: Baba mi, ẹniti o fi wọn fun mi, pọ̀ ju gbogbo wọn lọ; kò si si ẹniti o le já wọn kuro li ọwọ́ Baba mi.
entries.en: My Father, which gave them me, is greater than all; and no man is able to pluck them out of my Father's hand.

entries.yo: Ọ̀kan li emi ati Baba mi jasi.
entries.en: I and my Father are one.

entries.yo: Awọn Ju si tún he okuta, lati sọ lù u.
entries.en: Then the Jews took up stones again to stone him.

entries.yo: Jesu da wọn lohùn pe, Ọpọlọpọ iṣẹ rere ni mo fi hàn nyin lati ọdọ Baba mi wá; nitori ewo ninu iṣẹ wọnni li ẹnyin ṣe sọ mi li okuta?
entries.en: Jesus answered them, Many good works have I shewed you from my Father; for which of those works do ye stone me?

entries.yo: Awọn Ju si da a lohùn, wipe, Awa kò sọ ọ li okuta nitori iṣẹ rere, ṣugbọn nitori ọrọ-odi: ati nitori iwọ ti iṣe enia nfi ara rẹ ṣe Ọlọrun.
entries.en: The Jews answered him, saying, For a good work we stone thee not; but for blasphemy; and because that thou, being a man, makest thyself God.

entries.yo: Jesu da wọn lohùn pe, A kò ha ti kọ ọ ninu ofin nyin pe, Mo ti wipe, ọlọrun li ẹnyin iṣe?
entries.en: Jesus answered them, Is it not written in your law, I said, Ye are gods?

entries.yo: Bi o ba pè wọn li ọlọrun, awọn ẹniti a fi ọ̀rọ Ọlọrun fun, a kò si le ba iwe-mimọ́ jẹ,
entries.en: If he called them gods, unto whom the word of God came, and the scripture cannot be broken;

entries.yo: Ẹnyin ha nwi niti ẹniti Baba yà si mimọ́, ti o si rán si aiye pe, Iwọ nsọrọ-odi, nitoriti mo wipe Ọmọ Ọlọrun ni mi?
entries.en: Say ye of him, whom the Father hath sanctified, and sent into the world, Thou blasphemest; because I said, I am the Son of God?

entries.yo: Bi emi kò ba ṣe iṣẹ Baba mi, ẹ máṣe gbà mi gbọ́.
entries.en: If I do not the works of my Father, believe me not.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi emi ba ṣe wọn, bi ẹnyin kò tilẹ gbà mi gbọ́, ẹ gbà iṣẹ na gbọ́: ki ẹnyin ki o le mọ̀, ki o si le ye nyin pe, Baba wà ninu mi, emi si wà ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: But if I do, though ye believe not me, believe the works: that ye may know, and believe, that the Father is in me, and I in him.

entries.yo: Nwọn si tun nwá ọ̀na lati mu u: o si bọ́ lọwọ wọn.
entries.en: Therefore they sought again to take him: but he escaped out of their hand,

entries.yo: O si tún kọja lọ si apakeji Jordani si ibiti Johanu ti kọ́ mbaptisi; nibẹ̀ li o si joko.
entries.en: And went away again beyond Jordan into the place where John at first baptized; and there he abode.

entries.yo: Awọn enia pipọ si wá sọdọ rẹ̀, nwọn si wipe, Johanu ko ṣe iṣẹ àmi kan: ṣugbọn otitọ li ohun gbogbo ti Johanu sọ nipa ti ọkunrin yi.
entries.en: And many resorted unto him, and said, John did no miracle: but all things that John spake of this man were true.

entries.yo: Awọn enia pipọ nibẹ̀ si gbà a gbọ́.
entries.en: And many believed on him there.

entries.yo: ARA ọkunrin kan si ṣe alaidá, Lasaru, ara Betani, ti iṣe ilu Maria ati Marta arabinrin rẹ̀.
entries.en: Now a certain man was sick, named Lazarus, of Bethany, the town of Mary and her sister Martha.

entries.yo: (Maria na li ẹniti o fi ororo ikunra kùn Oluwa, ti o si fi irun ori rẹ̀ nù ẹsẹ rẹ̀ nù, arakunrin rẹ̀ ni Lasaru iṣe, ara ẹniti kò dá.)
entries.en: (It was that Mary which anointed the Lord with ointment, and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.)

entries.yo: Nitorina awọn arabinrin rẹ̀ ranṣẹ si i, wipe, Oluwa, wo o, ara ẹniti iwọ fẹran kò da.
entries.en: Therefore his sisters sent unto him, saying, Lord, behold, he whom thou lovest is sick.

entries.yo: Nigbati Jesu si gbọ́, o wipe, Aisan yi kì iṣe si ikú, ṣugbọn fun ogo Ọlọrun, ki a le yìn Ọmọ Ọlọrun logo nipasẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: When Jesus heard that, he said, This sickness is not unto death, but for the glory of God, that the Son of God might be glorified thereby.

entries.yo: Jesu si fẹran Marta, ati arabinrin rẹ̀, ati Lasaru.
entries.en: Now Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.

entries.yo: Nitorina nigbati o ti gbọ́ pe, ara rẹ̀ kò da, o gbé ijọ meji si i nibikanna ti o gbé wà.
entries.en: When he had heard therefore that he was sick, he abode two days still in the same place where he was.

entries.yo: Njẹ lẹhin eyi li o wi fun awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ pe, Ẹ jẹ ki a tún pada lọ si Judea.
entries.en: Then after that saith he to his disciples, Let us go into Judaea again.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ si wi fun u pe, Rabbi, ni lọ̃lọ̃ yi li awọn Ju nwá ọ̀na ati sọ ọ li okuta; iwọ si ntún pada lọ sibẹ̀?
entries.en: His disciples say unto him, Master, the Jews of late sought to stone thee; and goest thou thither again?

entries.yo: Jesu dahún pe, Wakati mejila ki mbẹ ninu ọsán kan? Bi ẹnikan ba rìn li ọsán, kì yio kọsẹ̀, nitoriti o ri imọlẹ aiye yi.
entries.en: Jesus answered, Are there not twelve hours in the day? If any man walk in the day, he stumbleth not, because he seeth the light of this world.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi ẹnikan ba rìn li oru, yio kọsẹ̀, nitoriti kò si imọlẹ ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: But if a man walk in the night, he stumbleth, because there is no light in him.

entries.yo: Nkan wọnyi li o sọ: lẹhin eyini o si wi fun wọn pe, Lasaru ọrẹ́ wa sùn; ṣugbọn emi nlọ ki emi ki o le jí i dide ninu orun rẹ̀.
entries.en: These things said he: and after that he saith unto them, Our friend Lazarus sleepeth; but I go, that I may awake him out of sleep.

entries.yo: Nitorina awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ wi fun u pe, Oluwa, bi o ba ṣe pe o sùn, yio sàn.
entries.en: Then said his disciples, Lord, if he sleep, he shall do well.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Jesu nsọ ti ikú rẹ̀: ṣugbọn nwọn rò pe, o nsọ ti orun sisun.
entries.en: Howbeit Jesus spake of his death: but they thought that he had spoken of taking of rest in sleep.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Jesu wi fun wọn gbangba pe, Lasaru kú.
entries.en: Then said Jesus unto them plainly, Lazarus is dead.

entries.yo: Emi si yọ̀ nitori nyin, ti emi kò si nibẹ̀, Ki ẹ le gbagbọ́; ṣugbọn ẹ jẹ ki a lọ sọdọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, to the intent ye may believe; nevertheless let us go unto him.

entries.yo: Nitorina Tomasi, ẹniti a npè ni Didimu, wi fun awọn ọmọ-ẹhin ẹgbẹ rẹ̀ pe, Ẹ jẹ ki awa na lọ, ki a le ba a kú pẹlu.
entries.en: Then said Thomas, which is called Didymus, unto his fellowdisciples, Let us also go, that we may die with him.

entries.yo: Nitorina nigbati Jesu de, o ri pe a ti tẹ́ ẹ sinu ibojì ni ijọ mẹrin na.
entries.en: Then when Jesus came, he found that he had lain in the grave four days already.

entries.yo: Njẹ Betani sunmọ Jerusalemu to furlongi mẹdogun:
entries.en: Now Bethany was nigh unto Jerusalem, about fifteen furlongs off:

entries.yo: Ọ̀pọ ninu awọn Ju si wá sọdọ Marta ati Maria, lati tù wọn ninu nitori ti arakunrin wọn.
entries.en: And many of the Jews came to Martha and Mary, to comfort them concerning their brother.

entries.yo: Nitorina nigbati Marta gbọ́ pe Jesu mbọ̀ wá, o jade lọ ipade rẹ̀: ṣugbọn Maria joko ninu ile.
entries.en: Then Martha, as soon as she heard that Jesus was coming, went and met him: but Mary sat still in the house.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Marta wi fun Jesu pe, Oluwa, ibaṣepe iwọ ti wà nihin, arakunrin mi kì ba tí kú.
entries.en: Then said Martha unto Jesus, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nisisiyi na, mo mọ̀ pe, ohunkohun ti iwọ ba bère lọwọ Ọlọrun, Ọlọrun yio fifun ọ.
entries.en: But I know, that even now, whatsoever thou wilt ask of God, God will give it thee.

entries.yo: Jesu wi fun u pe, Arakunrin rẹ yio jinde.
entries.en: Jesus saith unto her, Thy brother shall rise again.

entries.yo: Marta wi fun u pe, mo mọ̀ pe yio jinde li ajinde nigbẹhin ọjọ.
entries.en: Martha saith unto him, I know that he shall rise again in the resurrection at the last day.

entries.yo: Jesu wi fun u pe, Emi ni ajinde, ati ìye: ẹniti o ba gbà mi gbọ́, bi o tilẹ kú, yio yè:
entries.en: Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni ti o mbẹ lãye, ti o si gbà mi gbọ́, kì yio kú lailai. Iwọ gbà eyi gbọ́?
entries.en: And whosoever liveth and believeth in me shall never die. Believest thou this?

entries.yo: O wi fun u pe, Bẹ̃ni, Oluwa: emi gbagbọ́ pe, iwọ ni Kristi na Ọmọ Ọlọrun, ẹniti mbọ̀ wá aiye.
entries.en: She saith unto him, Yea, Lord: I believe that thou art the Christ, the Son of God, which should come into the world.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si ti wi eyi tan, o lọ, o si pè Maria arabinrin rẹ̀ sẹhin wipe, Olukọni de, o si npè ọ.
