entries.en: And when she had so said, she went her way, and called Mary her sister secretly, saying, The Master is come, and calleth for thee.

entries.yo: Nigbati o gbọ́, o dide lọgan, o si wá sọdọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: As soon as she heard that, she arose quickly, and came unto him.

entries.yo: Jesu kò sá ti iwọ̀ ilu, ṣugbọn o wà nibikanna ti Marta pade rẹ̀.
entries.en: Now Jesus was not yet come into the town, but was in that place where Martha met him.

entries.yo: Nitorina awọn Ju ti o wà lọdọ rẹ̀ ninu ile, ti nwọn ntù u ninu, nigbati nwọn ri ti Maria dide kánkan, ti o si jade, nwọn tẹ̀le e, nwọn ṣebi o nlọ si ibojì lọ isọkun nibẹ̀.
entries.en: The Jews then which were with her in the house, and comforted her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up hastily and went out, followed her, saying, She goeth unto the grave to weep there.

entries.yo: Nigbati Maria si de ibiti Jesu gbé wà, ti o si ri i, o wolẹ lẹba ẹsẹ rẹ̀, o wi fun u pe, Oluwa, ibaṣepe iwọ ti wà nihin, arakunrin mi kò ba má kú.
entries.en: Then when Mary was come where Jesus was, and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying unto him, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.

entries.yo: Njẹ nigbati Jesu ri i, ti o nsọkun, ati awọn Ju ti o ba a wá nsọkun pẹlu rẹ̀, o kerora li ọkàn rẹ̀, inu rẹ̀ si bajẹ,
entries.en: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews also weeping which came with her, he groaned in the spirit, and was troubled,

entries.yo: O si wipe, Nibo li ẹnyin gbé tẹ́ ẹ si? Nwọn si wi fun u pe, Oluwa, wá wò o.
entries.en: And said, Where have ye laid him? They said unto him, Lord, come and see.

entries.yo: Jesu sọkun.
entries.en: Jesus wept.

entries.yo: Nitorina awọn Ju wipe, sa wo o bi o ti fẹràn rẹ̀ to!
entries.en: Then said the Jews, Behold how he loved him!

entries.yo: Awọn kan ninu wọn si wipe, Ọkunrin yi, ẹniti o là oju afọju, kò le ṣe ki ọkunrin yi má ku bi?
entries.en: And some of them said, Could not this man, which opened the eyes of the blind, have caused that even this man should not have died?

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Jesu tún kerora ninu ara rẹ̀, o wá si ibojì. O si jẹ ihò, a si gbé okuta le ẹnu rẹ̀.
entries.en: Jesus therefore again groaning in himself cometh to the grave. It was a cave, and a stone lay upon it.

entries.yo: Jesu wipe, Ẹ gbé okuta na kuro. Marta, arabinrin ẹniti o kú na wi fun u pe, Oluwa, o ti nrùn nisisiyi: nitoripe o di ijọ mẹrin ti o ti kú.
entries.en: Jesus said, Take ye away the stone. Martha, the sister of him that was dead, saith unto him, Lord, by this time he stinketh: for he hath been dead four days.

entries.yo: Jesu wi fun u pe, Emi kò ti wi fun ọ pe, bi iwọ ba gbagbọ́, iwọ o ri ogo Ọlọrun?
entries.en: Jesus saith unto her, Said I not unto thee, that, if thou wouldest believe, thou shouldest see the glory of God?

entries.yo: Nigbana ni nwọn gbé okuta na kuro nibiti a gbe tẹ́ okú na si. Jesu si gbé oju rẹ̀ soke, o si wipe, Baba, mo dupẹ lọwọ rẹ, nitoriti iwọ gbọ́ ti emi.
entries.en: Then they took away the stone from the place where the dead was laid. And Jesus lifted up his eyes, and said, Father, I thank thee that thou hast heard me.

entries.yo: Emi si ti mọ̀ pe, iwọ a ma gbọ́ ti emi nigbagbogbo: ṣugbọn nitori ijọ enia ti o duro yi ni mo ṣe wi i, ki nwọn ki o le gbagbọ́ pe iwọ li o rán mi.
entries.en: And I knew that thou hearest me always: but because of the people which stand by I said it, that they may believe that thou hast sent me.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si ti wi bẹ̃ tan, o kigbe li ohùn rara pe, Lasaru, jade wá.
entries.en: And when he thus had spoken, he cried with a loud voice, Lazarus, come forth.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o kú na si jade wá, ti a fi aṣọ okú dì tọwọ tẹsẹ a si fi gèle dì i loju. Jesu wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ tú u, ẹ si jẹ ki o mã lọ.
entries.en: And he that was dead came forth, bound hand and foot with graveclothes: and his face was bound about with a napkin. Jesus saith unto them, Loose him, and let him go.

entries.yo: Nitorina li ọ̀pọ awọn Ju ti o wá sọdọ Maria, ti nwọn ri ohun ti Jesu ṣe, nwọn gbà a gbọ.
entries.en: Then many of the Jews which came to Mary, and had seen the things which Jesus did, believed on him.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn ẹlomiran ninu wọn tọ̀ awọn Farisi lọ, nwọn si sọ fun wọn ohun ti Jesu ṣe.
entries.en: But some of them went their ways to the Pharisees, and told them what things Jesus had done.

entries.yo: Nigbana li awọn olori alufa ati awọn Farisi pè igbimọ jọ, nwọn si wipe, Kili awa nṣe? nitori ọkunrin yi nṣe ọ̀pọlọpọ iṣẹ àmi.
entries.en: Then gathered the chief priests and the Pharisees a council, and said, What do we? for this man doeth many miracles.

entries.yo: Bi awa ba jọwọ rẹ̀ bẹ̃, gbogbo enia ni yio gbà a gbọ́: awọn ará Romu yio si wá gbà ilẹ ati orilẹ-ède wa pẹlu.
entries.en: If we let him thus alone, all men will believe on him: and the Romans shall come and take away both our place and nation.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Kaiafa, ọkan ninu wọn, ẹniti iṣe olori alufa li ọdún na, o wi fun wọn pe, Ẹnyin kò mọ̀ ohunkohun rara.
entries.en: And one of them, named Caiaphas, being the high priest that same year, said unto them, Ye know nothing at all,

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni ẹ kò si ronu pe, o ṣànfani fun wa, ki enia kan kú fun awọn enia, ki gbogbo orilẹ-ède ki o má bà ṣegbé.
entries.en: Nor consider that it is expedient for us, that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation perish not.

entries.yo: Ki iṣe fun ara rẹ̀ li o sọ eyi: ṣugbọn bi o ti jẹ olori alufa li ọdún na, o sọtẹlẹ pe, Jesu yio kú fun orilẹ-ède na:
entries.en: And this spake he not of himself: but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus should die for that nation;

entries.yo: Ki si iṣe kìki fun orilẹ-ède na nikan, ṣugbọn pẹlu ki o le kó awọn ọmọ Ọlọrun ti a ti funka kiri jọ li ọkanṣoṣo.
entries.en: And not for that nation only, but that also he should gather together in one the children of God that were scattered abroad.

entries.yo: Nitorina lati ọjọ na lọ ni nwọn ti jọ gbìmọ pọ̀ lati pa a.
entries.en: Then from that day forth they took counsel together for to put him to death.

entries.yo: Nitorina Jesu kò rìn ni gbangba larin awọn Ju mọ́; ṣugbọn o ti ibẹ̀ lọ si igberiko kan ti o sunmọ aginjù, si ilu nla ti à npè ni Efraimu, nibẹ̀ li o si wà pẹlu awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀.
entries.en: Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews; but went thence unto a country near to the wilderness, into a city called Ephraim, and there continued with his disciples.

entries.yo: Ajọ irekọja awọn Ju si sunmọ etile: ọ̀pọlọpọ lati igberiko wá si gòke lọ si Jerusalemu ṣiwaju irekọja, lati yà ara wọn si mimọ́.
entries.en: And the Jews' passover was nigh at hand: and many went out of the country up to Jerusalem before the passover, to purify themselves.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni nwọn nwá Jesu, nwọn si mba ara wọ́n sọ, bi nwọn ti duro ni tẹmpili, wipe, Ẹnyin ti rò o si? pe kì yio wá si ajọ?
entries.en: Then sought they for Jesus, and spake among themselves, as they stood in the temple, What think ye, that he will not come to the feast?

entries.yo: Njẹ awọn olori alufa ati awọn Farisi ti paṣẹ pe bi ẹnikan ba mọ̀ ibi ti o gbé wà, ki o fi i hàn, ki nwọn ki o le mu u.
entries.en: Now both the chief priests and the Pharisees had given a commandment, that, if any man knew where he were, he should shew it, that they might take him.

entries.yo: NITORINA nigbati ajọ irekọja kù ijọ mẹfa, Jesu wá si Betani, nibiti Lasaru wà, ẹniti o ti kú, ti Jesu ji dide kuro ninu okú.
entries.en: Then Jesus six days before the passover came to Bethany, where Lazarus was which had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.

entries.yo: Nwọn si se ase-alẹ fun u nibẹ: Marta si nṣe iranṣẹ: ṣugbọn Lasaru jẹ ọkan ninu awọn ti o joko nibi tabili pẹlu rẹ̀.
entries.en: There they made him a supper; and Martha served: but Lazarus was one of them that sat at the table with him.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Maria mu ororo ikunra nardi, oṣuwọn litra kan, ailabùla, olowo iyebiye, o si nfi kùn Jesu li ẹsẹ, o si nfi irun ori rẹ̀ nù ẹsẹ rẹ̀ nù: ile si kún fun õrùn ikunra na.
entries.en: Then took Mary a pound of ointment of spikenard, very costly, and anointed the feet of Jesus, and wiped his feet with her hair: and the house was filled with the odour of the ointment.

entries.yo: Nigbana li ọkan ninu awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀, Judasi Iskariotu, ọmọ Simoni, ẹniti yio fi i hàn, wipe,
entries.en: Then saith one of his disciples, Judas Iscariot, Simon's son, which should betray him,

entries.yo: Ẽṣe ti a kò tà ororo ikunra yi ni ọ̃durun owo idẹ ki a si fifun awọn talakà?
entries.en: Why was not this ointment sold for three hundred pence, and given to the poor?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn o wi eyi, ki iṣe nitoriti o náni awọn talakà; ṣugbọn nitoriti iṣe olè, on li o si ni àpo, a si ma gbé ohun ti a fi sinu rẹ̀.
entries.en: This he said, not that he cared for the poor; but because he was a thief, and had the bag, and bare what was put therein.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Jesu wipe, Ẹ jọwọ rẹ̀, o ṣe e silẹ dè ọjọ sisinku mi.
entries.en: Then said Jesus, Let her alone: against the day of my burying hath she kept this.

entries.yo: Nigbagbogbo li ẹnyin sá ni talakà pẹlu nyin; ṣugbọn emi li ẹ kò ni nigbagbogbo.
entries.en: For the poor always ye have with you; but me ye have not always.

entries.yo: Nitorina ijọ enia ninu awọn Ju li o mọ̀ pe o wà nibẹ̀: nwọn si wá, kì iṣe nitori Jesu nikan, ṣugbọn ki nwọn le ri Lasaru pẹlu, ẹniti o ti jí dide kuro ninu okú.
entries.en: Much people of the Jews therefore knew that he was there: and they came not for Jesus' sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn olori alufa gbìmọ ki nwọn le pa Lasaru pẹlu;
entries.en: But the chief priests consulted that they might put Lazarus also to death;

entries.yo: Nitoripe nipasẹ rẹ̀ li ọ̀pọ ninu awọn Ju jade lọ, nwọn si gbà Jesu gbọ́.
entries.en: Because that by reason of him many of the Jews went away, and believed on Jesus.

entries.yo: Ni ijọ keji nigbati ọ̀pọ enia ti o wá si ajọ gbọ́ pe, Jesu mbọ̀ wá si Jerusalemu,
entries.en: On the next day much people that were come to the feast, when they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,

entries.yo: Nwọn mu imọ̀-ọ̀pẹ, nwọn si jade lọ ipade rẹ̀, nwọn si nkigbe pe, Hosanna: Olubukun li ẹniti mbọ̀wá li orukọ Oluwa, Ọba Israeli.
entries.en: Took branches of palm trees, and went forth to meet him, and cried, Hosanna: Blessed is the King of Israel that cometh in the name of the Lord.

entries.yo: Nigbati Jesu si ri ọmọ kẹtẹkẹtẹ kan, o gùn u; gẹgẹ bi a ti kọwe pe,
entries.en: And Jesus, when he had found a young ass, sat thereon; as it is written,

entries.yo: Má bẹ̀ru, ọmọbinrin Sioni: wo o, Ọba rẹ mbọ̀ wá, o joko lori ọmọ kẹtẹkẹtẹ.
entries.en: Fear not, daughter of Sion: behold, thy King cometh, sitting on an ass's colt.

entries.yo: Nkan wọnyi kò tète yé awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀: ṣugbọn nigbati a ṣe Jesu logo, nigbana ni nwọn ranti pe, a kọwe nkan wọnyi niti rẹ̀, ati pe, on ni nwọn ṣe nkan wọnyi si.
entries.en: These things understood not his disciples at the first: but when Jesus was glorified, then remembered they that these things were written of him, and that they had done these things unto him.

entries.yo: Nitorina ijọ enia ti o wà lọdọ rẹ̀, nigbati o pè Lasaru jade ninu iboji rẹ̀, ti o si jí i dide kuro ninu okú, nwọn jẹri.
entries.en: The people therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of his grave, and raised him from the dead, bare record.

entries.yo: Nitori eyi ni ijọ enia si ṣe lọ ipade rẹ̀, nitoriti nwọn gbọ́ pe o ti ṣe iṣẹ àmi yi.
entries.en: For this cause the people also met him, for that they heard that he had done this miracle.

entries.yo: Nitorina awọn Farisi wi fun ara wọn pe, Ẹ kiyesi bi ẹ kò ti le bori li ohunkohun? ẹ wò bi gbogbo aiye ti nwọ́ tọ̀ ọ.
entries.en: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, Perceive ye how ye prevail nothing? behold, the world is gone after him.

entries.yo: Awọn Hellene kan si wà ninu awọn ti o gòke wá lati sìn nigba ajọ:
entries.en: And there were certain Greeks among them that came up to worship at the feast:

entries.yo: Awọn wọnyi li o tọ̀ Filippi wá, ẹniti iṣe ará Betsaida ti Galili, nwọn si mbère lọwọ rẹ̀, wipe, Alàgba, awa nfẹ ri Jesu.
entries.en: The same came therefore to Philip, which was of Bethsaida of Galilee, and desired him, saying, Sir, we would see Jesus.

entries.yo: Filippi wá, o si sọ fun Anderu; Anderu ati Filippi wá, nwọn si sọ fun Jesu.
entries.en: Philip cometh and telleth Andrew: and again Andrew and Philip tell Jesus.

entries.yo: Jesu si da wọn lohùn wipe, Wakati na de, ti a o ṣe Ọmọ-enia logo.
entries.en: And Jesus answered them, saying, The hour is come, that the Son of man should be glorified.

entries.yo: Lõtọ, lõtọ ni mo wi fun nyin, Bikoṣepe wóro alikama ba bọ́ si ilẹ̀, ti o ba si kú, o wà on nikan: ṣugbọn bi o ba kú, a si so ọ̀pọlọpọ eso.
entries.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except a corn of wheat fall into the ground and die, it abideth alone: but if it die, it bringeth forth much fruit.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba fẹ ẹmí rẹ̀ yio sọ ọ nù; ẹniti o ba si korira ẹmi rẹ̀ li aiye yi ni yio si pa a mọ́ titi fi di ìye ainipẹkun.
entries.en: He that loveth his life shall lose it; and he that hateth his life in this world shall keep it unto life eternal.

entries.yo: Bi ẹnikẹni ba nsìn mi, ki o ma tọ̀ mi lẹhin: ati nibiti emi ba wà, nibẹ̀ ni iranṣẹ mi yio wà pẹlu: bi ẹnikẹni ba nsìn mi, on ni Baba yio bù ọlá fun.
entries.en: If any man serve me, let him follow me; and where I am, there shall also my servant be: if any man serve me, him will my Father honour.

entries.yo: Nisisiyi li a npọ́n ọkàn mi loju; kili emi o si wi? Baba, gbà mi kuro ninu wakati yi: ṣugbọn nitori eyi ni mo ṣe wá si wakati yi.
entries.en: Now is my soul troubled; and what shall I say? Father, save me from this hour: but for this cause came I unto this hour.

entries.yo: Baba, ṣe orukọ rẹ logo. Nitorina ohùn kan ti ọrun wá, wipe, Emi ti ṣe e logo na, emi o si tún ṣe e logo.
entries.en: Father, glorify thy name. Then came there a voice from heaven, saying, I have both glorified it, and will glorify it again.

entries.yo: Nitorina ijọ enia ti o duro nibẹ̀, ti nwọn si gbọ́ ọ, wipe, Ãrá nsán: awọn ẹlomiran wipe, Angẹli kan li o mba a sọrọ.
entries.en: The people therefore, that stood by, and heard it, said that it thundered: others said, An angel spake to him.

entries.yo: Jesu si dahùn wipe, Ki iṣe nitori mi li ohùn yi ṣe wá, bikoṣe nitori nyin.
entries.en: Jesus answered and said, This voice came not because of me, but for your sakes.

entries.yo: Nisisiyi ni idajọ aiye yi de: nisisiyi li a o lé alade aiye yi jade.
entries.en: Now is the judgment of this world: now shall the prince of this world be cast out.

entries.yo: Ati emi, bi a ba gbé mi soke kuro li aiye, emi o fà gbogbo enia sọdọ ara mi.
entries.en: And I, if I be lifted up from the earth, will draw all men unto me.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn o wi eyi, o nṣapẹrẹ irú ikú ti on o kú.
entries.en: This he said, signifying what death he should die.

entries.yo: Nitorina awọn ijọ enia da a lohùn wipe, Awa gbọ́ ninu ofin pe, Kristi wà titi lailai: iwọ ha ṣe wipe, A kò le ṣaima gbé Ọmọ-enia soke? tani iṣe Ọmọ-enia yi?
entries.en: The people answered him, We have heard out of the law that Christ abideth for ever: and how sayest thou, The Son of man must be lifted up? who is this Son of man?

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Jesu wi fun wọn pe, Nigba diẹ si i ni imọlẹ wà lãrin nyin. Ẹ mã rìn nigbati ẹnyin ni imọlẹ, ki òkunkun máṣe ba le nyin: ẹniti o ba si nrìn li òkunkun kò mọ̀ ibiti on gbé nlọ.
entries.en: Then Jesus said unto them, Yet a little while is the light with you. Walk while ye have the light, lest darkness come upon you: for he that walketh in darkness knoweth not whither he goeth.

entries.yo: Nigbati ẹnyin ni imọlẹ, ẹ gbà imọlẹ gbọ́, ki ẹ le jẹ ọmọ imọlẹ. Nkan wọnyi ni Jesu sọ, o si jade lọ, o fi ara pamọ́ fun wọn.
entries.en: While ye have light, believe in the light, that ye may be the children of light. These things spake Jesus, and departed, and did hide himself from them.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi o ti ṣe ọ̀pọlọpọ iṣẹ ami to bayi li oju wọn, nwọn kò gbà a gbọ́;
entries.en: But though he had done so many miracles before them, yet they believed not on him:

entries.yo: Ki ọ̀rọ woli Isaiah lè ṣẹ, eyiti o sọ pe, Oluwa, tali o gbà iwasu wa gbọ́? ati tali a si fi apá Oluwa hàn fun?
entries.en: That the saying of Esaias the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spake, Lord, who hath believed our report? and to whom hath the arm of the Lord been revealed?

entries.yo: Nitori eyi ni nwọn kò fi le gbagbọ́, nitori Isaiah si tún sọ pe,
entries.en: Therefore they could not believe, because that Esaias said again,

entries.yo: O ti fọ́ wọn loju, o si ti se àiya wọn le; ki nwọn má ba fi oju wọn ri, ki nwọn má ba fi ọkàn wọn mọ̀, ki nwọn má ba yipada, ki emi má ba mu wọn larada.
entries.en: He hath blinded their eyes, and hardened their heart; that they should not see with their eyes, nor understand with their heart, and be converted, and I should heal them.

entries.yo: Nkan wọnyi ni Isaiah wi, nitori o ti ri ogo rẹ̀, o si sọ̀rọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: These things said Esaias, when he saw his glory, and spake of him.

entries.yo: Sibẹ ọ̀pọ ninu awọn olori gbà a gbọ́ pẹlu; ṣugbọn nitori awọn Farisi nwọn kò jẹwọ rẹ̀, ki a má bà yọ wọn kuro ninu sinagogu:
entries.en: Nevertheless among the chief rulers also many believed on him; but because of the Pharisees they did not confess him, lest they should be put out of the synagogue:

entries.yo: Nitori nwọn fẹ iyìn enia jù iyìn ti Ọlọrun lọ.
entries.en: For they loved the praise of men more than the praise of God.

entries.yo: Jesu si kigbe o si wipe, Ẹniti o ba gbà mi gbọ́, emi kọ li o gbàgbọ́, ṣugbọn ẹniti o rán mi.
entries.en: Jesus cried and said, He that believeth on me, believeth not on me, but on him that sent me.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba si ri mi, o ri ẹniti o rán mi.
entries.en: And he that seeth me seeth him that sent me.

entries.yo: Emi ni imọlẹ ti o wá si aiye, ki ẹnikẹni ti o ba gbà mi gbọ́ ki o máṣe wà li òkunkun.
entries.en: I am come a light into the world, that whosoever believeth on me should not abide in darkness.

entries.yo: Bi ẹnikẹni ba si gbọ́ ọ̀rọ mi, ti kò si pa wọn mọ, emi kì yio ṣe idajọ rẹ̀: nitoriti emi kò wá lati ṣe idajọ aiye, bikoṣe lati gbà aiye là.
entries.en: And if any man hear my words, and believe not, I judge him not: for I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba kọ̀ mi, ti kò si gbà ọ̀rọ mi, o ni ẹnikan ti nṣe idajọ rẹ̀: ọ̀rọ ti mo ti sọ, on na ni yio ṣe idajọ rẹ̀ ni igbẹhin ọjọ.
entries.en: He that rejecteth me, and receiveth not my words, hath one that judgeth him: the word that I have spoken, the same shall judge him in the last day.

entries.yo: Nitori emi kò dá ọrọ sọ fun ara mi, ṣugbọn Baba ti o rán mi, on li o ti fun mi li aṣẹ, ohun ti emi o sọ, ati eyiti emi o wi.
entries.en: For I have not spoken of myself; but the Father which sent me, he gave me a commandment, what I should say, and what I should speak.

entries.yo: Emi si mọ̀ pe ìye ainipẹkun li ofin rẹ̀: nitorina, ohun wọnni ti mo ba wi, gẹgẹ bi Baba ti sọ fun mi, bẹ̀ni mo wi.
entries.en: And I know that his commandment is life everlasting: whatsoever I speak therefore, even as the Father said unto me, so I speak.

entries.yo: NJE ki ajọ irekọja ki o to de, nigbati Jesu mọ̀ pe wakati rẹ̀ de tan, ti on ó ti aiye yi kuro lọ sọdọ Baba, fifẹ ti o fẹ awọn tirẹ̀ ti o wà li aiye, o fẹ wọn titi de opin.
entries.en: Now before the feast of the passover, when Jesus knew that his hour was come that he should depart out of this world unto the Father, having loved his own which were in the world, he loved them unto the end.

entries.yo: Bi nwọn si ti njẹ onjẹ alẹ, ti Èṣu ti fi i si ọkàn Judasi Iskariotu ọmọ Simoni lati fi i hàn;
entries.en: And supper being ended, the devil having now put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon's son, to betray him;

entries.yo: Ti Jesu si ti mọ̀ pe Baba ti fi ohun gbogbo le on lọwọ, ati pe lọdọ Ọlọrun li on ti wá, on si nlọ sọdọ Ọlọrun;
entries.en: Jesus knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he was come from God, and went to God;

entries.yo: O dide ni idi onjẹ alẹ, o si fi agbáda rẹ̀ lelẹ̀ li apakan; nigbati o si mu gèle, o di ara rẹ̀ li àmure.
entries.en: He riseth from supper, and laid aside his garments; and took a towel, and girded himself.

entries.yo: Lẹhinna o bù omi sinu awokòto kan, o si bẹ̀rẹ si ima wẹ̀ ẹsẹ awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀, o si nfi gèle ti o fi di àmure nù wọn.
entries.en: After that he poureth water into a bason, and began to wash the disciples' feet, and to wipe them with the towel wherewith he was girded.

entries.yo: Nigbana li o de ọdọ Simoni Peteru. On si wi fun u pe, Oluwa, iwọ nwẹ̀ mi li ẹsẹ?
entries.en: Then cometh he to Simon Peter: and Peter saith unto him, Lord, dost thou wash my feet?

entries.yo: Jesu dahùn o si wi fun u pe, Ohun ti emi nṣe iwọ kò mọ̀ nisisiyi; ṣugbọn yio ye ọ nikẹhin.
entries.en: Jesus answered and said unto him, What I do thou knowest not now; but thou shalt know hereafter.

entries.yo: Peteru wi fun u pe, Iwọ kì yio wẹ̀ mi li ẹsẹ lai. Jesu da a lohùn pe, Bi emi kò bá wẹ̀ ọ, iwọ kò ni ìpin lọdọ mi.
entries.en: Peter saith unto him, Thou shalt never wash my feet. Jesus answered him, If I wash thee not, thou hast no part with me.

entries.yo: Simoni Peteru wi fun u pe, Oluwa, kì iṣe ẹsẹ mi nikan, ṣugbọn ati ọwọ́ ati ori mi pẹlu.
entries.en: Simon Peter saith unto him, Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head.

entries.yo: Jesu wi fun u pe, Ẹniti a ti wẹ̀ kò tun fẹ ju ki a ṣan ẹsẹ rẹ̀, ṣugbọn o mọ́ nibi gbogbo: ẹnyin si mọ́, ṣugbọn kì iṣe gbogbo nyin.
entries.en: Jesus saith to him, He that is washed needeth not save to wash his feet, but is clean every whit: and ye are clean, but not all.

entries.yo: Nitoriti o mọ̀ ẹniti yio fi on hàn; nitorina li o ṣe wipe, Kì iṣe gbogbo nyin li o mọ́.
entries.en: For he knew who should betray him; therefore said he, Ye are not all clean.

entries.yo: Nitorina lẹhin ti o wẹ̀ ẹsẹ wọn tan, ti o si ti mu agbáda rẹ̀, ti o tún joko, o wi fun wọn pe, Ẹnyin mọ̀ ohun ti mo ṣe si nyin?
entries.en: So after he had washed their feet, and had taken his garments, and was set down again, he said unto them, Know ye what I have done to you?

entries.yo: Ẹnyin npè mi li Olukọni ati Oluwa: ẹnyin wi rere; bẹ̃ni mo jẹ.
entries.en: Ye call me Master and Lord: and ye say well; for so I am.

entries.yo: Njẹ bi emi ti iṣe Oluwa ati Olukọni nyin ba wẹ̀ ẹsẹ nyin, o tọ́ ki ẹnyin pẹlu si mã wẹ̀ ẹsẹ ara nyin.
entries.en: If I then, your Lord and Master, have washed your feet; ye also ought to wash one another's feet.

entries.yo: Nitori mo ti fi apẹ̃rẹ fun nyin, ki ẹnyin ki o le mã ṣe gẹgẹ bi mo ti ṣe si nyin.
entries.en: For I have given you an example, that ye should do as I have done to you.

entries.yo: Lòtọ, lõtọ ni mo wi fun nyin, Ọmọ-ọdọ kò tobi jù oluwa rẹ̀ lọ; bẹ̃ni ẹniti a rán kò tobi jù ẹniti o rán a lọ.
entries.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord; neither he that is sent greater than he that sent him.

entries.yo: Bi ẹnyin ba mọ̀ nkan wọnyi, alabukun-fun ni nyin, bi ẹnyin ba nṣe wọn.
entries.en: If ye know these things, happy are ye if ye do them.

entries.yo: Kì iṣe ti gbogbo nyin ni mo nsọ: emi mọ̀ awọn ti mo yàn: ṣugbọn ki iwe-mimọ́ ki o le ṣẹ, Ẹniti mba mi jẹun pọ̀ si gbé gigĩsẹ rẹ̀ si mi.
entries.en: I speak not of you all: I know whom I have chosen: but that the scripture may be fulfilled, He that eateth bread with me hath lifted up his heel against me.

entries.yo: Lati isisiyi lọ mo sọ fun nyin ki o to de, pe nigbati o ba de, ki ẹnyin ki o le gbagbọ́ pe emi ni.
entries.en: Now I tell you before it come, that, when it is come to pass, ye may believe that I am he.

entries.yo: Lõtọ, lõtọ ni mo wi fun nyin, Ẹniti o ba gbà ẹnikẹni ti mo rán, o gbà mi; ẹniti o ba si gbà mi o gbà ẹniti o rán mi.
entries.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that receiveth whomsoever I send receiveth me; and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.

entries.yo: Nigbati Jesu ti wi nkan wọnyi tan, ọkàn rẹ̀ daru ninu rẹ̀, o si jẹri, o si wipe, Lõtọ lõtọ ni mo wi fun nyin pe, ọkan ninu nyin yio fi mi hàn.
entries.en: When Jesus had thus said, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ nwò ara wọn loju, nwọn nṣiye-meji ti ẹniti o wi.
entries.en: Then the disciples looked one on another, doubting of whom he spake.

entries.yo: Njẹ ẹnikan rọ̀gún si àiya Jesu, ọkan ninu awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀, ẹniti Jesu fẹràn.
entries.en: Now there was leaning on Jesus' bosom one of his disciples, whom Jesus loved.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni Simoni Peteru ṣapẹrẹ si i, o si wi fun u pe, Wi fun wa ti ẹniti o nsọ.
entries.en: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, that he should ask who it should be of whom he spake.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o nrọ̀gún li àiya Jesu wi fun u pe, Oluwa, tani iṣe?
entries.en: He then lying on Jesus' breast saith unto him, Lord, who is it?

entries.yo: Nitorina Jesu dahùn pe, On na ni, ẹniti mo ba fi òkele fun nigbati mo ba fi run. Nigbati o si fi i run tan, o fifun Judasi Iskariotu ọmọ Simoni.
entries.en: Jesus answered, He it is, to whom I shall give a sop, when I have dipped it. And when he had dipped the sop, he gave it to Judas Iscariot, the son of Simon.

entries.yo: Lẹhin òkele na ni Satani wọ̀ inu rẹ̀ lọ. Nitorina Jesu wi fun u pe, Ohun ti iwọ nṣe nì, yara ṣe e kánkan.
entries.en: And after the sop Satan entered into him. Then said Jesus unto him, That thou doest, do quickly.

entries.yo: Kò si si ẹnikan nibi tabili ti o mọ̀ idi ohun ti o ṣe sọ eyi fun u.
entries.en: Now no man at the table knew for what intent he spake this unto him.

entries.yo: Nitori awọn miran ninu wọn rò pe, nitori Judasi li o ni àpo, ni Jesu fi wi fun u pe, Rà nkan wọnni ti a kò le ṣe alaini fun ajọ na; tabi ki o le fi nkan fun awọn talakà.
entries.en: For some of them thought, because Judas had the bag, that Jesus had said unto him, Buy those things that we have need of against the feast; or, that he should give something to the poor.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si ti gbà òkele na tan, o jade lojukanna: oru si ni.
entries.en: He then having received the sop went immediately out: and it was night.

entries.yo: Nitorina nigbati o jade lọ tan, Jesu wipe, Nisisiyi li a yìn Ọmọ-enia logo, a si yìn Ọlọrun logo ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: Therefore, when he was gone out, Jesus said, Now is the Son of man glorified, and God is glorified in him.

entries.yo: Bi a ba yìn Ọlọrun logo ninu rẹ̀, Ọlọrun yio si yìn i logo ninu on tikararẹ̀, yio si yìn i logo nisisiyi.
entries.en: If God be glorified in him, God shall also glorify him in himself, and shall straightway glorify him.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin ọmọde, nigba diẹ si i li emi wà pẹlu nyin. Ẹnyin ó wá mi: ati gẹgẹ bi mo ti wi fun awọn Ju pe, Nibiti emi gbé nlọ, ẹnyin kì o le wá; bẹ̃ni mo si wi fun nyin nisisiyi.
entries.en: Little children, yet a little while I am with you. Ye shall seek me: and as I said unto the Jews, Whither I go, ye cannot come; so now I say to you.

entries.yo: Ofin titun kan ni mo fifun nyin, Ki ẹnyin ki o fẹ ọmọnikeji nyin; gẹgẹ bi emi ti fẹran nyin, ki ẹnyin ki o si le fẹran ọmọnikeji nyin.
entries.en: A new commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another; as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.

entries.yo: Nipa eyi ni gbogbo enia yio fi mọ̀ pe, ọmọ-ẹhin mi li ẹnyin iṣe, nigbati ẹnyin ba ni ifẹ si ọmọnikeji nyin.
entries.en: By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.

entries.yo: Simoni Peteru wi fun u pe, Oluwa, nibo ni iwọ nlọ? Jesu da a lohùn pe, Nibiti emi nlọ, iwọ ki ó le tọ̀ mi nisisiyi; ṣugbọn iwọ yio tọ̀ mi nikẹhin.
entries.en: Simon Peter said unto him, Lord, whither goest thou? Jesus answered him, Whither I go, thou canst not follow me now; but thou shalt follow me afterwards.

entries.yo: Peteru wi fun u pe, Oluwa, ẽṣe ti emi ko fi le tọ̀ ọ nisisiyi? emi o fi ẹmí mi lelẹ nitori rẹ.
entries.en: Peter said unto him, Lord, why cannot I follow thee now? I will lay down my life for thy sake.

entries.yo: Jesu da a lohùn wipe, Iwọ o ha fi ẹmí rẹ lelẹ nitori mi? Lõtọ, lõtọ ni mo wi fun ọ, Akukọ kì yio kọ, ki iwọ ki o to sẹ́ mi nigba mẹta.
entries.en: Jesus answered him, Wilt thou lay down thy life for my sake? Verily, verily, I say unto thee, The cock shall not crow, till thou hast denied me thrice.

entries.yo: Ẹ maṣe jẹ ki ọkàn nyin dàru: ẹ gbà Ọlọrun gbọ́, ẹ gbà mi gbọ́ pẹlu.
entries.en: Let not your heart be troubled: ye believe in God, believe also in me.

entries.yo: Ninu ile Baba mi ọ̀pọlọpọ ibugbe li o wà: ibamáṣe bẹ̃, emi iba ti sọ fun nyin. Nitori emi nlọ ipèse àye silẹ fun nyin.
entries.en: In my Father's house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.

entries.yo: Bi mo ba si lọ ipèse àye silẹ fun nyin, emi o tún pada wá, emi o si mu nyin lọ sọdọ emi tikarami; pe nibiti emi gbé wà, ki ẹnyin le wà nibẹ pẹlu.
entries.en: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and receive you unto myself; that where I am, there ye may be also.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin si mọ̀ ibi ti emi gbé nlọ, ẹ si mọ̀ ọ̀na na.
entries.en: And whither I go ye know, and the way ye know.

entries.yo: Tomasi wi fun u pe, Oluwa, a kò mọ̀ ibiti o gbe nlọ; a o ha ti ṣe mọ̀ ọ̀na na?
entries.en: Thomas saith unto him, Lord, we know not whither thou goest; and how can we know the way?

entries.yo: Jesu wi fun u pe, Emi li ọ̀na, ati otitọ, ati iye: kò si ẹnikẹni ti o le wá sọdọ Baba, bikoṣe nipasẹ mi.
entries.en: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.

entries.yo: Ibaṣepe ẹnyin ti mọ̀ mi, ẹnyin iba ti mọ̀ Baba mi pẹlu: lati isisiyi lọ ẹnyin mọ̀ ọ, ẹ si ti ri i.
entries.en: If ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also: and from henceforth ye know him, and have seen him.

entries.yo: Filippi wi fun u pe, Oluwa, fi Baba na hàn wa, o si to fun wa.
entries.en: Philip saith unto him, Lord, shew us the Father, and it sufficeth us.

entries.yo: Jesu wi fun u pe, Bi akokò ti mo ba nyin gbé ti pẹ to yi, iwọ kò si ti imọ̀ mi sibẹ̀ Filippi? ẹniti o ba ti ri mi, o ti ri Baba; iwọ ha ti ṣe wipe, Fi Baba hàn wa?
entries.en: Jesus saith unto him, Have I been so long time with you, and yet hast thou not known me, Philip? he that hath seen me hath seen the Father; and how sayest thou then, Shew us the Father?

entries.yo: Iwọ kò ha gbagbọ́ pe, Emi wà ninu Baba, ati pe Baba wà ninu mi? ọ̀rọ ti emi nsọ fun nyin, emi kò da a sọ; ṣugbọn Baba ti ngbé inu mi, on ni nṣe iṣẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Believest thou not that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? the words that I speak unto you I speak not of myself: but the Father that dwelleth in me, he doeth the works.

entries.yo: Ẹ gbà mi gbọ́ pe, emi wà ninu Baba, Baba si wà ninu mi: bikoṣe bẹ̃, ẹ gbà mi gbọ́ nitori awọn iṣẹ na pãpã.
entries.en: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me: or else believe me for the very works' sake.

entries.yo: Lõtọ, lõtọ ni mo wi fun nyin, Ẹniti o ba gbà mi gbọ́, iṣẹ ti emi nṣe li on na yio ṣe pẹlu; iṣẹ ti o tobi jù wọnyi lọ ni yio si ṣe; nitoriti emi nlọ sọdọ Baba.
entries.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me, the works that I do shall he do also; and greater works than these shall he do; because I go unto my Father.

entries.yo: Ohunkohun ti ẹnyin ba si bère li orukọ mi, on na li emi ó ṣe, ki a le yìn Baba logo ninu Ọmọ.
entries.en: And whatsoever ye shall ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

entries.yo: Bi ẹnyin ba bère ohunkohun li orukọ mi, emi ó ṣe e.
entries.en: If ye shall ask any thing in my name, I will do it.

entries.yo: Bi ẹnyin ba fẹran mi, ẹ ó pa ofin mi mọ́.
entries.en: If ye love me, keep my commandments.

entries.yo: Emi ó si bère lọwọ Baba, on ó si fun nyin li Olutunu miran, ki o le mã ba nyin gbé titi lailai,
entries.en: And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may abide with you for ever;

entries.yo: Ani Ẹmí otitọ nì; ẹniti araiye kò le gbà, nitoriti kò ri i, bẹ̃ni kò si mọ̀ ọ: ṣugbọn ẹnyin mọ̀ ọ; nitoriti o mba nyin gbe, yio si wà ninu nyin.
entries.en: Even the Spirit of truth; whom the world cannot receive, because it seeth him not, neither knoweth him: but ye know him; for he dwelleth with you, and shall be in you.

entries.yo: Emi kì o fi nyin silẹ li alaini baba: emi ó tọ̀ nyin wá.
entries.en: I will not leave you comfortless: I will come to you.

entries.yo: Nigba diẹ si i, aiye ki ó si ri mi mọ́; ṣugbọn ẹnyin ó ri mi: nitoriti emi wà lãye, ẹnyin ó wà lãye pẹlu.
entries.en: Yet a little while, and the world seeth me no more; but ye see me: because I live, ye shall live also.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ na li ẹnyin o mọ̀ pe, emi wà ninu Baba mi, ati ẹnyin ninu mi, ati emi ninu nyin.
entries.en: At that day ye shall know that I am in my Father, and ye in me, and I in you.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba li ofin mi, ti o ba si npa wọn mọ́, on li ẹniti ọ fẹràn mi: ẹniti o ba si fẹràn mi, a o fẹrán rẹ̀ lati ọdọ Baba mi wá, emi o si fẹràn rẹ̀, emi o si fi ara mi hàn fun u.
entries.en: He that hath my commandments, and keepeth them, he it is that loveth me: and he that loveth me shall be loved of my Father, and I will love him, and will manifest myself to him.

entries.yo: Judasi wi fun u pe, (kì iṣe Iskariotu) Oluwa, ẽhatiṣe ti iwọ ó fi ara rẹ hàn fun awa, ti kì yio si ṣe fun araiye?
entries.en: Judas saith unto him, not Iscariot, Lord, how is it that thou wilt manifest thyself unto us, and not unto the world?

entries.yo: Jesu dahùn o si wi fun u pe, Bi ẹnikan ba fẹràn mi, yio pa ọ̀rọ mi mọ́: Baba mi yio si fẹran rẹ̀, awa o si tọ̀ ọ wá, a o si ṣe ibugbe wa pẹlu rẹ̀.
entries.en: Jesus answered and said unto him, If a man love me, he will keep my words: and my Father will love him, and we will come unto him, and make our abode with him.

entries.yo: Ẹniti kò fẹràn mi ni ko pa ọ̀rọ mi mọ́: ọ̀rọ ti ẹnyin ngbọ́ kì si iṣe ti emi, ṣugbọn ti Baba ti o rán mi.
entries.en: He that loveth me not keepeth not my sayings: and the word which ye hear is not mine, but the Father's which sent me.

entries.yo: Nkan wọnyi li emi ti sọ fun nyin, nigbati mo mba nyin gbe.
entries.en: These things have I spoken unto you, being yet present with you.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Olutunu na, Ẹmí Mimọ́, ẹniti Baba yio rán li orukọ mi, on ni yio kọ́ nyin li ohun gbogbo, yio si rán nyin leti ohun gbogbo ti mo ti sọ fun nyin.
entries.en: But the Comforter, which is the Holy Ghost, whom the Father will send in my name, he shall teach you all things, and bring all things to your remembrance, whatsoever I have said unto you.

entries.yo: Alafia ni mo fi silẹ fun nyin, alafia mi ni mo fifun nyin: kì iṣe gẹgẹ bi aiye iti fi funni li emi fifun nyin. Ẹ máṣe jẹ ki okàn nyin daru, ẹ má si jẹ ki o warìri.
entries.en: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin sá ti gbọ́ bi mo ti wi fun nyin pe, Emi nlọ, emi ó si tọ̀ nyin wá. Ibaṣepe ẹnyin fẹràn mi, ẹnyin iba yọ̀ nitori emi nlọ sọdọ Baba: nitori Baba mi tobi jù mi lọ.
entries.en: Ye have heard how I said unto you, I go away, and come again unto you. If ye loved me, ye would rejoice, because I said, I go unto the Father: for my Father is greater than I.

entries.yo: Emi si ti sọ fun nyin nisisiyi ki o to ṣẹ, pe nigbati o ba ṣẹ, ki ẹ le gbagbọ́.
entries.en: And now I have told you before it come to pass, that, when it is come to pass, ye might believe.

entries.yo: Emi kì o ba nyin sọ̀rọ pipọ: nitori aladé aiye yi wá, kò si ni nkankan lọdọ mi.
entries.en: Hereafter I will not talk much with you: for the prince of this world cometh, and hath nothing in me.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nitori ki aiye le mọ̀ pe emi fẹràn Baba; gẹgẹ bi Baba si ti fi aṣẹ fun mi, bẹ̃ni emi nṣe. Ẹ dide, ẹ jẹ ki a lọ kuro nihinyi.
entries.en: But that the world may know that I love the Father; and as the Father gave me commandment, even so I do. Arise, let us go hence.

entries.yo: EMI ni àjara tõtọ, Baba mi si ni oluṣọgba.
entries.en: I am the true vine, and my Father is the husbandman.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ẹká ninu mi ti kò ba so eso, on a mu u kuro: gbogbo ẹka ti o ba si so eso, on a wẹ̀ ẹ mọ́, ki o le so eso si i.
entries.en: Every branch in me that beareth not fruit he taketh away: and every branch that beareth fruit, he purgeth it, that it may bring forth more fruit.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin mọ́ nisisiyi nitori ọ̀rọ ti mo ti sọ fun nyin.
entries.en: Now ye are clean through the word which I have spoken unto you.

entries.yo: Ẹ mã gbé inu mi, emi o si mã gbé inu nyin. Gẹgẹ bi ẹka kò ti le so eso fun ara rẹ̀, bikoṣepe o ba ngbé inu àjara, bẹ̃li ẹnyin, bikoṣepe ẹ ba ngbé inu mi.
entries.en: Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; no more can ye, except ye abide in me.

entries.yo: Emi ni àjara, ẹnyin li ẹka. Ẹniti o ngbé inu mi, ati emi ninu rẹ̀, on ni yio so eso ọ̀pọlọpọ: nitori ni yiyara nyin kuro lọdọ mi, ẹ ko le ṣe ohun kan.
entries.en: I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.

entries.yo: Bi ẹnikan kò ba gbé inu mi, a gbe e sọnu gẹgẹ bi ẹka, a si gbẹ; nwọn a si kó wọn jọ, nwọn a si sọ wọn sinu iná, nwọn a si jóna.
entries.en: If a man abide not in me, he is cast forth as a branch, and is withered; and men gather them, and cast them into the fire, and they are burned.

entries.yo: Bi ẹnyin ba ngbé inu mi, ti ọ̀rọ mi ba si ngbé inu nyin, ẹ ó bère ohunkohun ti ẹ ba fẹ, a o si ṣe e fun nyin.
entries.en: If ye abide in me, and my words abide in you, ye shall ask what ye will, and it shall be done unto you.

entries.yo: Ninu eyi li a yìn Baba mi logo pe, ki ẹnyin ki o mã so eso pupọ; ẹnyin o si jẹ ọmọ-ẹhin mi.
entries.en: Herein is my Father glorified, that ye bear much fruit; so shall ye be my disciples.

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi Baba ti fẹ mi, bẹ̃li emi si fẹ nyin: ẹ duro ninu ifẹ mi.
entries.en: As the Father hath loved me, so have I loved you: continue ye in my love.

entries.yo: Bi ẹnyin ba pa ofin mi mọ́, ẹ o duro ninu ifẹ mi; gẹgẹ bi emi ti pa ofin Baba mi mọ́, ti mo si duro ninu ifẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: If ye keep my commandments, ye shall abide in my love; even as I have kept my Father's commandments, and abide in his love.

entries.yo: Nkan wọnyi ni mo ti sọ fun nyin, ki ayọ̀ mi ki o le wà ninu nyin, ati ki ayọ̀ nyin ki o le kún.
entries.en: These things have I spoken unto you, that my joy might remain in you, and that your joy might be full.

entries.yo: Eyi li ofin mi, pe ki ẹnyin ki o fẹran ara nyin, gẹgẹ bi mo ti fẹràn nyin.
entries.en: This is my commandment, That ye love one another, as I have loved you.

entries.yo: Ko si ẹnikan ti o ni ifẹ ti o tobi jù eyi lọ, pe ẹnikan fi ẹmí rẹ̀ lelẹ nitori awọn ọrẹ́ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.

entries.yo: Ọrẹ́ mi li ẹnyin iṣẹ, bi ẹ ba ṣe ohun ti emi palaṣẹ fun nyin.
entries.en: Ye are my friends, if ye do whatsoever I command you.

entries.yo: Emi kò pè nyin li ọmọ-ọdọ mọ́; nitori ọmọ-ọdọ kò mọ̀ ohun ti oluwa rẹ̀ nṣe: ṣugbọn emi pè nyin li ọrẹ́; nitori ohun gbogbo ti mo ti gbọ́ lati ọdọ Baba mi wá, mo ti fi hàn fun nyin.
entries.en: Henceforth I call you not servants; for the servant knoweth not what his lord doeth: but I have called you friends; for all things that I have heard of my Father I have made known unto you.

entries.yo: Ki iṣe ẹnyin li o yàn mi, ṣugbọn emi li o yàn nyin, mo si fi nyin sipo, ki ẹnyin ki o le lọ, ki ẹ si so eso, ati ki eso nyin le duro; ki ohunkohun ti ẹ ba bère lọwọ Baba li orukọ mi, ki o le fi i fun nyin.
entries.en: Ye have not chosen me, but I have chosen you, and ordained you, that ye should go and bring forth fruit, and that your fruit should remain: that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name, he may give it you.

entries.yo: Nkan wọnyi ni mo palaṣẹ fun nyin pe, ki ẹnyin ki o fẹran ara nyin.
entries.en: These things I command you, that ye love one another.

entries.yo: Bi aiye ba korira nyin, ẹ mọ̀ pe, o ti korira mi ṣaju nyin.
entries.en: If the world hate you, ye know that it hated me before it hated you.

entries.yo: Ibaṣepe ẹnyin iṣe ti aiye, aiye iba fẹ awọn tirẹ̀; ṣugbọn nitoriti ẹnyin kì iṣe ti aiye, ṣugbọn emi ti yàn nyin kuro ninu aiye, nitori eyi li aiye ṣe korira nyin.
entries.en: If ye were of the world, the world would love his own: but because ye are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world, therefore the world hateth you.

entries.yo: Ẹ ranti ọ̀rọ ti mo ti sọ fun nyin pe, Ọmọ-ọdọ kò tobi jù oluwa rẹ̀ lọ. Bi nwọn ba ti ṣe inunibini si mi, nwọn ó ṣe inunibini si nyin pẹlu: bi nwọn ba ti pa ọ̀rọ mi mọ́, nwọn ó si pa ti nyin mọ́ pẹlu.
entries.en: Remember the word that I said unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord. If they have persecuted me, they will also persecute you; if they have kept my saying, they will keep yours also.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn gbogbo nkan wọnyi ni nwọn o ṣe si nyin, nitori orukọ mi, nitoriti nwọn kò mọ̀ ẹniti o rán mi.
entries.en: But all these things will they do unto you for my name's sake, because they know not him that sent me.

entries.yo: Ibaṣepe emi kò ti wá ki n si ti ba wọn sọrọ, nwọn kì ba ti li ẹ̀ṣẹ: ṣugbọn nisisiyi nwọn di alairiwi fun ẹ̀ṣẹ wọn.
entries.en: If I had not come and spoken unto them, they had not had sin: but now they have no cloke for their sin.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba korira mi, o korira Baba mi pẹlu.
entries.en: He that hateth me hateth my Father also.

entries.yo: Ibaṣepe emi kò ti ṣe iṣẹ wọnni larin wọn, ti ẹlomiran kò ṣe ri, nwọn kì ba ti li ẹ̀ṣẹ: ṣugbọn nisisiyi nwọn ti ri, nwọn si korira ati emi ati Baba mi.
entries.en: If I had not done among them the works which none other man did, they had not had sin: but now have they both seen and hated both me and my Father.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn eyi ṣe ki ọ̀rọ ti a kọ ninu ofin wọn ki o le ṣẹ pe, Nwọn korira mi li ainidi.
entries.en: But this cometh to pass, that the word might be fulfilled that is written in their law, They hated me without a cause.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati Olutunu na ba de, ẹniti emi ó rán si nyin lati ọdọ Baba wá, ani Ẹmi otitọ nì, ti nti ọdọ Baba wá, on na ni yio jẹri mi:
entries.en: But when the Comforter is come, whom I will send unto you from the Father, even the Spirit of truth, which proceedeth from the Father, he shall testify of me:

entries.yo: Ẹnyin pẹlu yio si jẹri mi, nitoriti ẹnyin ti wà pẹlu mi lati ipilẹṣẹ wá.
entries.en: And ye also shall bear witness, because ye have been with me from the beginning.

entries.yo: NKAN wọnyi ni mo ti sọ fun nyin, ki a má ba mu nyin kọsẹ̀.
entries.en: These things have I spoken unto you, that ye should not be offended.

entries.yo: Nwọn o yọ nyin kuro ninu sinagogu: ani, akokò mbọ̀, ti ẹnikẹni ti o ba pa nyin, yio rò pe on nṣe ìsin fun Ọlọrun.
entries.en: They shall put you out of the synagogues: yea, the time cometh, that whosoever killeth you will think that he doeth God service.

entries.yo: Nkan wọnyi ni nwọn o si ṣe, nitoriti nwọn kò mọ̀ Baba, nwọn kò si mọ̀ mi.
entries.en: And these things will they do unto you, because they have not known the Father, nor me.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nkan wọnyi ni mo ti sọ fun nyin, pe nigbati wakati wọn ba de, ki ẹ le ranti wọn pe mo ti wi fun nyin. Ṣugbọn emi ko sọ nkan wọnyi fun nyin lati ipilẹṣẹ wá, nitoriti mo wà pẹlu nyin.
entries.en: But these things have I told you, that when the time shall come, ye may remember that I told you of them. And these things I said not unto you at the beginning, because I was with you.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nisisiyi emi nlọ sọdọ ẹniti o rán mi; kò si si ẹnikan ninu nyin ti o bi mi lẽre pe, Nibo ni iwọ nlọ?
entries.en: But now I go my way to him that sent me; and none of you asketh me, Whither goest thou?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nitori mo sọ nkan wọnyi fun nyin, ibinujẹ kún ọkàn nyin.
entries.en: But because I have said these things unto you, sorrow hath filled your heart.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn otitọ li emi nsọ fun nyin; Anfani ni yio jẹ fun nyin bi emi ba lọ: nitori bi emi kò ba lọ, Olutunu kì yio tọ̀ nyin wá: ṣugbọn bi mo ba lọ, emi o rán a si nyin.
entries.en: Nevertheless I tell you the truth; It is expedient for you that I go away: for if I go not away, the Comforter will not come unto you; but if I depart, I will send him unto you.

entries.yo: Nigbati on ba si de, yio fi òye yé araiye niti ẹ̀ṣẹ, ati niti ododo, ati niti idajọ:
entries.en: And when he is come, he will reprove the world of sin, and of righteousness, and of judgment:

entries.yo: Niti ẹ̀ṣẹ, nitoriti nwọn kò gbà mi gbọ́;
entries.en: Of sin, because they believe not on me;

entries.yo: Niti ododo, nitoriti emi nlọ sọdọ Baba, ẹnyin kò si ri mi mọ́;
entries.en: Of righteousness, because I go to my Father, and ye see me no more;

entries.yo: Niti idajọ, nitoriti a ti ṣe idajọ alade aiye yi.
entries.en: Of judgment, because the prince of this world is judged.

entries.yo: Mo ni ohun pipọ lati sọ fun nyin pẹlu, ṣugbọn ẹ kò le gbà wọn nisisiyi.
entries.en: I have yet many things to say unto you, but ye cannot bear them now.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati on, ani Ẹmí otitọ ni ba de, yio tọ́ nyin si ọ̀na otitọ gbogbo; nitori kì yio sọ̀ ti ara rẹ̀; ṣugbọn ohunkohun ti o ba gbọ́, on ni yio ma sọ: yio si sọ ohun ti mbọ̀ fun nyin.
entries.en: Howbeit when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he will guide you into all truth: for he shall not speak of himself; but whatsoever he shall hear, that shall he speak: and he will shew you things to come.

entries.yo: On o ma yìn mi logo: nitoriti yio gbà ninu ti emi, yio si ma sọ ọ fun nyin.
entries.en: He shall glorify me: for he shall receive of mine, and shall shew it unto you.

entries.yo: Ohun gbogbo ti Baba ni temi ni: nitori eyi ni mo ṣe wipe, on ó gbà ninu temi, yio si sọ ọ fun nyin.
entries.en: All things that the Father hath are mine: therefore said I, that he shall take of mine, and shall shew it unto you.

entries.yo: Nigba diẹ, ẹnyin kì o si ri mi: ati nigba diẹ ẹ̀wẹ, ẹ ó si ri mi, nitoriti emi nlọ sọdọ Baba.
entries.en: A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me, because I go to the Father.

entries.yo: Nitorina omiran ninu awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ mba ara wọn sọ pe, Kili eyi ti o nwi fun wa yi, Nigba diẹ, ẹnyin kì o si ri mi: ati nigba diẹ ẹ̀wẹ, ẹnyin o si ri mi: ati, Nitoriti emi nlọ sọdọ Baba?
entries.en: Then said some of his disciples among themselves, What is this that he saith unto us, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me: and, Because I go to the Father?

entries.yo: Nitorina nwọn wipe, Kili eyi ti o wi yi, Nigba diẹ? awa kò mọ̀ ohun ti o wi.
entries.en: They said therefore, What is this that he saith, A little while? we cannot tell what he saith.

entries.yo: Jesu sá ti mọ̀ pe, nwọn nfẹ lati bi on lẽre, o si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹnyin mbi ara nyin lẽre niti eyi ti mo wipe, Nigba diẹ, ẹnyin kì o si ri mi: ati nigba diẹ ẹ̀wẹ, ẹnyin o si ri mi?
entries.en: Now Jesus knew that they were desirous to ask him, and said unto them, Do ye inquire among yourselves of that I said, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me?

entries.yo: Lõtọ, lõtọ ni mo wi fun nyin pe, Ẹnyin o ma sọkun ẹ o si ma pohùnrere ẹkún, ṣugbọn awọn araiye yio ma yọ̀: inu nyin yio si bajẹ, ṣugbọn ibinujẹ nyin li yio si di ayọ̀.
entries.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, That ye shall weep and lament, but the world shall rejoice: and ye shall be sorrowful, but your sorrow shall be turned into joy.

entries.yo: Nigbati obinrin bá nrọbi, a ni ibinujẹ, nitoriti wakati rẹ̀ de: ṣugbọn nigbati o ba ti bí ọmọ na tan, on kì si iranti irora na mọ́, fun ayọ̀ nitori a bí enia si aiye.
entries.en: A woman when she is in travail hath sorrow, because her hour is come: but as soon as she is delivered of the child, she remembereth no more the anguish, for joy that a man is born into the world.

entries.yo: Nitorina ẹnyin ni ibinujẹ nisisiyi: ṣugbọn emi o tún ri nyin, ọkàn nyin yio si yọ̀, kò si si ẹniti yio gbà ayọ̀ nyin lọwọ nyin.
entries.en: And ye now therefore have sorrow: but I will see you again, and your heart shall rejoice, and your joy no man taketh from you.

entries.yo: Ati ni ijọ na ẹnyin kì o bi mi lẽre ohunkohun. Lõtọ, lõtọ ni mo wi fun nyin, Ohunkohun ti ẹnyin ba bère lọwọ Baba li orukọ mi, on o fifun nyin.
entries.en: And in that day ye shall ask me nothing. Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall ask the Father in my name, he will give it you.

entries.yo: Titi di isisiyi ẹ kò ti ibère ohunkohun li orukọ mi: ẹ bère, ẹ o si ri gbà, ki ayọ̀ nyin ki o le kún.
entries.en: Hitherto have ye asked nothing in my name: ask, and ye shall receive, that your joy may be full.

entries.yo: Nkan wọnyi ni mo ti fi owe sọ fun nyin: ṣugbọn akokò de, nigbati emi kì yio fi owe ba nyin sọrọ mọ́, ṣugbọn emi o sọ ti Baba fun nyin gbangba.
entries.en: These things have I spoken unto you in proverbs: but the time cometh, when I shall no more speak unto you in proverbs, but I shall shew you plainly of the Father.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ na ẹnyin o bère li orukọ mi: emi kò si wi fun nyin pe, emi o bère lọwọ Baba fun nyin:
entries.en: At that day ye shall ask in my name: and I say not unto you, that I will pray the Father for you:

entries.yo: Nitoriti Baba tikararẹ̀ fẹran nyin, nitoriti ẹnyin ti fẹràn mi, ẹ si ti gbagbọ́ pe, lọdọ Ọlọrun li emi ti jade wá.
entries.en: For the Father himself loveth you, because ye have loved me, and have believed that I came out from God.

entries.yo: Mo ti ọdọ Baba jade wá, mo si wá si aiye: ẹ̀wẹ, mo fi aiye silẹ, mo si nlọ sọdọ Baba.
entries.en: I came forth from the Father, and am come into the world: again, I leave the world, and go to the Father.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ wi fun u pe, Wo o, nigbayi ni iwọ nsọ̀rọ̀ gbangba, iwọ kò si sọ ohunkohun li owe.
entries.en: His disciples said unto him, Lo, now speakest thou plainly, and speakest no proverb.

entries.yo: Nigbayi li awa mọ̀ pe, iwọ mọ̀ ohun gbogbo, iwọ kò ni ki a bi ọ lẽre: nipa eyi li awa gbagbọ́ pe, lọdọ Ọlọrun ni iwọ ti jade wá.
entries.en: Now are we sure that thou knowest all things, and needest not that any man should ask thee: by this we believe that thou camest forth from God.

entries.yo: Jesu da wọn lohùn pe, Ẹnyin gbagbọ́ wayi?
entries.en: Jesus answered them, Do ye now believe?

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, wakati mbọ̀, ani o de tan nisisiyi, ti a o fọ́n nyin ká kiri, olukuluku si ile rẹ̀; ẹ ó si fi emi nikan silẹ: ṣugbọn kì yio si ṣe emi nikan, nitoriti Baba mbẹ pẹlu mi.
entries.en: Behold, the hour cometh, yea, is now come, that ye shall be scattered, every man to his own, and shall leave me alone: and yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.

entries.yo: Nkan wọnyi ni mo ti sọ fun nyin tẹlẹ̀, ki ẹnyin ki o le ni alafia ninu mi. Ninu aiye, ẹnyin o ni ipọnju; ṣugbọn ẹ tújuka; mo ti ṣẹgun aiye.
entries.en: These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.

entries.yo: NKAN wọnyi ni Jesu sọ, o si gbé oju rẹ̀ soke ọrun, o si wipe, Baba, wakati na de: yìn Ọmọ rẹ logo, ki Ọmọ rẹ ki o le yìn ọ logo pẹlu:
entries.en: These words spake Jesus, and lifted up his eyes to heaven, and said, Father, the hour is come; glorify thy Son, that thy Son also may glorify thee:

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi iwọ ti fun u li aṣẹ lori enia gbogbo, ki o le fi iye ainipẹkun fun gbogbo awọn ti o fifun u.
entries.en: As thou hast given him power over all flesh, that he should give eternal life to as many as thou hast given him.

entries.yo: Iye ainipẹkun na si li eyi, ki nwọn ki o le mọ̀ ọ, iwọ nikan Ọlọrun otitọ, ati Jesu Kristi, ẹniti iwọ rán.
entries.en: And this is life eternal, that they might know thee the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom thou hast sent.

entries.yo: Emi ti yìn ọ logo li aiye: emi ti parí iṣẹ ti iwọ fifun mi lati ṣe.
entries.en: I have glorified thee on the earth: I have finished the work which thou gavest me to do.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, Baba, ṣe mi logo pẹlu ara rẹ, ogo ti mo ti ní pẹlu rẹ ki aiye ki o to wà.
entries.en: And now, O Father, glorify thou me with thine own self with the glory which I had with thee before the world was.

entries.yo: Emi ti fi orukọ rẹ hàn fun awọn enia ti iwọ ti fifun mi lati inu aiye wá: tirẹ ni nwọn ti jẹ ri, iwọ si ti fi wọn fun mi; nwọn si ti pa ọ̀rọ rẹ mọ́.
entries.en: I have manifested thy name unto the men which thou gavest me out of the world: thine they were, and thou gavest them me; and they have kept thy word.

entries.yo: Nisisiyi nwọn mọ̀ pe, ohunkohun gbogbo ti iwọ ti fifun mi, lati ọdọ rẹ wá ni.
entries.en: Now they have known that all things whatsoever thou hast given me are of thee.

entries.yo: Nitori ọ̀rọ ti iwọ fifun mi, emi ti fifun wọn, nwọn si ti gbà a, nwọn si ti mọ̀ nitõtọ pe, lọdọ rẹ ni mo ti jade wá, nwọn si gbagbọ́ pe iwọ li o rán mi.
entries.en: For I have given unto them the words which thou gavest me; and they have received them, and have known surely that I came out from thee, and they have believed that thou didst send me.

entries.yo: Emi ngbadura fun wọn: emi kò gbadura fun araiye, ṣugbọn fun awọn ti iwọ ti fifun mi; nitoripe tirẹ ni nwọn iṣe.
entries.en: I pray for them: I pray not for the world, but for them which thou hast given me; for they are thine.

entries.yo: Tirẹ sá ni gbogbo ohun ti iṣe temi, ati temi si ni gbogbo ohun ti iṣe tirẹ; a si ti ṣe mi logo ninu wọn.
entries.en: And all mine are thine, and thine are mine; and I am glorified in them.

entries.yo: Emi kò si si li aiye mọ́, awọn wọnyi si mbẹ li aiye, emi si mbọ̀ wá sọdọ rẹ. Baba mimọ́, pa awọn ti o ti fifun mi mọ́, li orukọ rẹ, ki nwọn ki o le jẹ ọ̀kan, ani gẹgẹ bi awa.
entries.en: And now I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I come to thee. Holy Father, keep through thine own name those whom thou hast given me, that they may be one, as we are.

entries.yo: Nigbati mo wà pẹlu wọn li aiye, mo pa wọn mọ li orukọ rẹ: awọn ti iwọ fifun mi, ni mo ti pamọ́, ẹnikan ninu wọn kò si ṣègbe bikoṣe ọmọ egbé; ki iwe-mimọ́ ki o le ṣẹ.
entries.en: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in thy name: those that thou gavest me I have kept, and none of them is lost, but the son of perdition; that the scripture might be fulfilled.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nisisiyi emi si mbọ̀ wá sọdọ rẹ, nkan wọnyi ni mo si nsọ li aiye, ki nwọn ki o le ni ayọ̀ mi ni kikun ninu awọn tikarawọn.
entries.en: And now come I to thee; and these things I speak in the world, that they might have my joy fulfilled in themselves.

entries.yo: Emi ti fi ọ̀rọ rẹ fun wọn; aiye si ti korira wọn, nitoriti nwọn kì iṣe ti aiye, gẹgẹ bi emi kì iti iṣe ti aiye.
entries.en: I have given them thy word; and the world hath hated them, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

entries.yo: Emi ko gbadura pe, ki iwọ ki o mu wọn kuro li aiye, ṣugbọn ki iwọ ki o pa wọn mọ́ kuro ninu ibi.
entries.en: I pray not that thou shouldest take them out of the world, but that thou shouldest keep them from the evil.

entries.yo: Nwọn kì iṣe ti aiye, gẹgẹ bi emi kì ti iṣe ti aiye.
entries.en: They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

entries.yo: Sọ wọn di mimọ́ ninu otitọ: otitọ li ọ̀rọ rẹ.
entries.en: Sanctify them through thy truth: thy word is truth.

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi iwọ ti rán mi wá si aiye, bẹ̃ li emi si rán wọn si aiye pẹlu.
entries.en: As thou hast sent me into the world, even so have I also sent them into the world.

entries.yo: Emi si yà ara mi si mimọ́ nitori wọn, ki a le sọ awọn tikarawọn pẹlu di mimọ́ ninu otitọ.
entries.en: And for their sakes I sanctify myself, that they also might be sanctified through the truth.

entries.yo: Kì si iṣe kìki awọn wọnyi ni mo ngbadura fun, ṣugbọn fun awọn pẹlu ti yio gbà mi gbọ́ nipa ọ̀rọ wọn;
entries.en: Neither pray I for these alone, but for them also which shall believe on me through their word;

entries.yo: Ki gbogbo nwọn ki o le jẹ ọ̀kan; gẹgẹ bi iwọ, Baba, ti jẹ ninu mi, ati emi ninu rẹ, ki awọn pẹlu ki o le jẹ ọ̀kan ninu wa: ki aiye ki o le gbagbọ́ pe, iwọ li o rán mi.
entries.en: That they all may be one; as thou, Father, art in me, and I in thee, that they also may be one in us: that the world may believe that thou hast sent me.

entries.yo: Ogo ti iwọ ti fifun mi li emi si ti fifun wọn; ki nwọn ki o le jẹ ọ̀kan, gẹgẹ bi awa ti jẹ ọ̀kan;
entries.en: And the glory which thou gavest me I have given them; that they may be one, even as we are one:

entries.yo: Emi ninu wọn, ati iwọ ninu mi, ki a le ṣe wọn pé li ọ̀kan; ki aiye ki o le mọ̀ pe, iwọ li o rán mi, ati pe iwọ si fẹràn wọn gẹgẹ bi iwọ ti fẹràn mi.
entries.en: I in them, and thou in me, that they may be made perfect in one; and that the world may know that thou hast sent me, and hast loved them, as thou hast loved me.

entries.yo: Baba, emi fẹ ki awọn ti iwọ fifun mi, ki o wà lọdọ mi, nibiti emi gbé wà; ki nwọn le mã wò ogo mi, ti iwọ ti fi fifun mi: nitori iwọ sá fẹràn mi ṣiwaju ipilẹṣẹ aiye.
entries.en: Father, I will that they also, whom thou hast given me, be with me where I am; that they may behold my glory, which thou hast given me: for thou lovedst me before the foundation of the world.

entries.yo: Baba olododo, aiye kò mọ̀ ọ: ṣugbọn emi mọ̀ ọ, awọn wọnyi si mọ̀ pe iwọ li o rán mi.
entries.en: O righteous Father, the world hath not known thee: but I have known thee, and these have known that thou hast sent me.

entries.yo: Mo ti sọ orukọ rẹ di mimọ̀ fun wọn, emi ó si sọ ọ di mimọ̀: ki ifẹ ti iwọ fẹràn mi, le mã wà ninu wọn, ati emi ninu wọn.
entries.en: And I have declared unto them thy name, and will declare it: that the love wherewith thou hast loved me may be in them, and I in them.

entries.yo: NIGBATI Jesu si ti sọ nkan wọnyi tan, o jade pẹlu awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ lọ soke odò Kedroni, nibiti agbala kan wà, ninu eyi ti o wọ̀, on ati awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀.
entries.en: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went forth with his disciples over the brook Cedron, where was a garden, into the which he entered, and his disciples.

entries.yo: Judasi, ẹniti o fi i hàn, si mọ̀ ibẹ̀ pẹlu: nitori nigba-pupọ ni Jesu ima lọ sibẹ̀ pẹlu awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Judas also, which betrayed him, knew the place: for Jesus ofttimes resorted thither with his disciples.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Judasi, lẹhin ti o ti gbà ẹgbẹ ọmọ-ogun, ati awọn onṣẹ́ lati ọdọ awọn olori alufa ati awọn Farisi, wá sibẹ̀ ti awọn ti fitilà ati òguṣọ̀, ati ohun ijà.
entries.en: Judas then, having received a band of men and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees, cometh thither with lanterns and torches and weapons.

entries.yo: Nitorina bi Jesu ti mọ̀ ohun gbogbo ti mbọ̀ wá ba on, o jade lọ, o si wi fun wọn pe, Tali ẹ nwá?
entries.en: Jesus therefore, knowing all things that should come upon him, went forth, and said unto them, Whom seek ye?

entries.yo: Nwọn si da a lohùn wipe, Jesu ti Nasareti. Jesu si wi fun wọn pe, Emi niyi. Ati Judasi pẹlu, ẹniti o fi i hàn, duro pẹlu wọn.
entries.en: They answered him, Jesus of Nazareth. Jesus saith unto them, I am he. And Judas also, which betrayed him, stood with them.

entries.yo: Nitorina bi o ti wi fun wọn pe, Emi niyi, nwọn bi sẹhin, nwọn si ṣubu lulẹ.
entries.en: As soon then as he had said unto them, I am he, they went backward, and fell to the ground.

entries.yo: Nitorina o tún bi wọn lẽre, wipe, Tali ẹ nwá? Nwọn si wipe, Jesu ti Nasareti.
entries.en: Then asked he them again, Whom seek ye? And they said, Jesus of Nazareth.

entries.yo: Jesu dahùn pe, Mo ti wi fun nyin pe, emi niyi: njẹ bi emi li ẹ ba nwá, ẹ jẹ ki awọn wọnyi mã lọ:
entries.en: Jesus answered, I have told you that I am he: if therefore ye seek me, let these go their way:

entries.yo: Ki ọ̀rọ nì ki o le ṣẹ, eyi ti o wipe, Awọn ti iwọ fifun mi, emi kò sọ ọ̀kan nù ninu wọn.
entries.en: That the saying might be fulfilled, which he spake, Of them which thou gavest me have I lost none.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Simoni Peteru ẹniti o ni idà, o fà a yọ, o si ṣá ọmọ-ọdọ olori alufa, o si ke etí ọtun rẹ̀ sọnù. Orukọ iranṣẹ na ama jẹ Malku.
entries.en: Then Simon Peter having a sword drew it, and smote the high priest's servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant's name was Malchus.

entries.yo: Nitorina Jesu wi fun Peteru pe, Tẹ̀ idà rẹ bọ inu àkọ rẹ̀: ago ti Baba ti fifun mi, emi ó ṣe alaimu u bi?
entries.en: Then said Jesus unto Peter, Put up thy sword into the sheath: the cup which my Father hath given me, shall I not drink it?

entries.yo: Nigbana li ẹgbẹ ọmọ-ogun, ati olori ẹṣọ́, ati awọn onṣẹ awọn Ju mu Jesu, nwọn si dè e.
entries.en: Then the band and the captain and officers of the Jews took Jesus, and bound him,

entries.yo: Nwọn kọ́ fa a lọ sọdọ Anna; nitori on ni iṣe ana Kaiafa, ẹniti iṣe olori alufa li ọdún na.
entries.en: And led him away to Annas first; for he was father in law to Caiaphas, which was the high priest that same year.

entries.yo: Kaiafa sá ni iṣe, ẹniti o ti ba awọn Ju gbìmọ̀ pe, o ṣanfani ki enia kan kú fun awọn enia.
entries.en: Now Caiaphas was he, which gave counsel to the Jews, that it was expedient that one man should die for the people.

entries.yo: Simoni Peteru si ntọ̀ Jesu lẹhin, ati ọmọ-ẹhin miran kan: ọmọ-ẹhin na jẹ ẹni mimọ̀ fun olori alufa, o si ba Jesu wọ̀ afin olori alufa lọ.
entries.en: And Simon Peter followed Jesus, and so did another disciple: that disciple was known unto the high priest, and went in with Jesus into the palace of the high priest.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Peteru duro li ẹnu-ọ̀na lode. Nigbana li ọmọ-ẹhin miran nì, ti iṣe ẹni mimọ̀ fun olori alufa, o jade lọ, o si ba oluṣọna na sọ ọ, o si mu Peteru wọle.
entries.en: But Peter stood at the door without. Then went out that other disciple, which was known unto the high priest, and spake unto her that kept the door, and brought in Peter.

entries.yo: Nigbana li ọmọbinrin na ti nṣọ ẹnu-ọ̀na wi fun Peteru pe, Iwọ pẹlu ha ṣe ọkan ninu awọn ọmọ-ẹhin ọkunrin yi bi? O wipe, Emi kọ́.
entries.en: Then saith the damsel that kept the door unto Peter, Art not thou also one of this man's disciples? He saith, I am not.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ-ọdọ ati awọn onṣẹ si duro nibẹ̀, awọn ẹniti o ti daná ẹyín; nitori otutù mu, nwọn si nyána: Peteru si duro pẹlu wọn, o nyána.
entries.en: And the servants and officers stood there, who had made a fire of coals; for it was cold: and they warmed themselves: and Peter stood with them, and warmed himself.

entries.yo: Nigbana li olori alufa bi Jesu lẽre niti awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀, ati niti ẹkọ́ rẹ̀.
entries.en: The high priest then asked Jesus of his disciples, and of his doctrine.

entries.yo: Jesu da a lohùn wipe, Emi ti sọ̀rọ ni gbangba fun araiye; nigbagbogbo li emi nkọ́ni ninu sinagogu, ati ni tẹmpili nibiti gbogbo awọn Ju npejọ si: emi kò si sọ ohun kan ni ìkọkọ.
entries.en: Jesus answered him, I spake openly to the world; I ever taught in the synagogue, and in the temple, whither the Jews always resort; and in secret have I said nothing.

entries.yo: Ẽṣe ti iwọ fi mbi mi lẽre? bere lọwọ awọn ti o ti gbọ́ ọ̀rọ mi, ohun ti mo wi fun wọn: wo o, awọn wọnyi mọ̀ ohun ti emi wi.
entries.en: Why askest thou me? ask them which heard me, what I have said unto them: behold, they know what I said.

entries.yo: Bi o si ti wi eyi tan, ọkan ninu awọn onṣẹ ti o duro tì i fi ọwọ́ rẹ̀ lù Jesu, wipe, Olori alufa ni iwọ nda lohùn bẹ̃?
entries.en: And when he had thus spoken, one of the officers which stood by struck Jesus with the palm of his hand, saying, Answerest thou the high priest so?

entries.yo: Jesu da a lohùn wipe, Bi mo ba sọrọ buburu, jẹri si buburu na: ṣugbọn bi rere ba ni, ẽṣe ti iwọ fi nlù mi?
entries.en: Jesus answered him, If I have spoken evil, bear witness of the evil: but if well, why smitest thou me?

entries.yo: Nitori Anna rán a lọ ni didè sọdọ Kaiafa olori alufa.
entries.en: Now Annas had sent him bound unto Caiaphas the high priest.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Simoni Peteru duro, o si nyána. Nigbana ni nwọn wi fun u pe, Iwọ pẹlu ha ṣe ọkan ninu awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀? O si sẹ́, o si wipe, Emi kọ́.
entries.en: And Simon Peter stood and warmed himself. They said therefore unto him, Art not thou also one of his disciples? He denied it, and said, I am not.

entries.yo: Ọkan ninu awọn ọmọ-ọdọ olori alufa, ti iṣe ibatan ẹniti Peteru ke etí rẹ̀ sọnù, wipe, Emi kò ha ri ọ pẹlu rẹ̀ li agbala?
entries.en: One of the servants of the high priest, being his kinsman whose ear Peter cut off, saith, Did not I see thee in the garden with him?

entries.yo: Nitorina Peteru tún sẹ́: lojukanna akukọ si kọ.
entries.en: Peter then denied again: and immediately the cock crew.

entries.yo: Nitorina nwọn fa Jesu lati ọdọ Kaiafa lọ si ibi gbọ̀ngan idajọ: o si jẹ kùtukùtu owurọ̀; awọn tikarawọn kò wọ̀ ini gbọ̀ngàn idajọ, ki nwọn ki o má ṣe di alaimọ́, ṣugbọn ki nwọn ki o le jẹ àse irekọja.
entries.en: Then led they Jesus from Caiaphas unto the hall of judgment: and it was early; and they themselves went not into the judgment hall, lest they should be defiled; but that they might eat the passover.

entries.yo: Nitorina Pilatu jade tọ̀ wọn lọ, o si wipe, Ẹ̀sun kili ẹnyin mu wá si ọkunrin yi?
entries.en: Pilate then went out unto them, and said, What accusation bring ye against this man?

entries.yo: Nwọn si dahùn wi fun u pe, Ibamaṣepe ọkunrin yi nhùwa ibi, a kì ba ti fà a le ọ lọwọ.
entries.en: They answered and said unto him, If he were not a malefactor, we would not have delivered him up unto thee.

entries.yo: Nitorina Pilatu wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ mu u tikaranyin, ki ẹ si ṣe idajọ rẹ̀ gẹgẹ bi ofin nyin. Nitorina li awọn Ju wi fun u pe, Kò tọ́ fun wa lati pa ẹnikẹni:
entries.en: Then said Pilate unto them, Take ye him, and judge him according to your law. The Jews therefore said unto him, It is not lawful for us to put any man to death:

entries.yo: Ki ọ̀rọ Jesu ki o le ba ṣẹ, eyiti o sọ, ti o nṣapẹrẹ irú ikú ti on o kú.
entries.en: That the saying of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spake, signifying what death he should die.

entries.yo: Nitorina Pilatu tún wọ̀ inu gbọ̀ngan idajọ lọ, o si pè Jesu, o si wi fun u pe, Ọba awọn Ju ni iwọ iṣe?
entries.en: Then Pilate entered into the judgment hall again, and called Jesus, and said unto him, Art thou the King of the Jews?

entries.yo: Jesu dahùn pe, Iwọ sọ eyi fun ara rẹ ni, tabi awọn ẹlomiran sọ ọ fun ọ nitori mi?
entries.en: Jesus answered him, Sayest thou this thing of thyself, or did others tell it thee of me?

entries.yo: Pilatu dahùn wipe, Emi iṣe Ju bi? Awọn orilẹ-ède rẹ, ati awọn olori alufa li o fà ọ le emi lọwọ: kini iwọ ṣe?
entries.en: Pilate answered, Am I a Jew? Thine own nation and the chief priests have delivered thee unto me: what hast thou done?

entries.yo: Jesu dahùn wipe, Ijọba mi kì iṣe ti aiye yi: ibaṣepe ijọba mi iṣe ti aiye yi, awọn onṣẹ mi iba jà, ki a má bà fi mi le awọn Ju lọwọ: ṣugbọn nisisiyi ijọba mi kì iṣe lati ihin lọ.
entries.en: Jesus answered, My kingdom is not of this world: if my kingdom were of this world, then would my servants fight, that I should not be delivered to the Jews: but now is my kingdom not from hence.

entries.yo: Nitorina Pilatu wi fun u pe, Njẹ iwọ ha ṣe ọba bi? Jesu dahùn wipe, Iwọ wipe, ọba li emi iṣe. Nitori eyi li a ṣe bí mi, ati nitori idi eyi ni mo si ṣe wá si aiye, ki emi ki o le jẹri si otitọ. Olukuluku ẹniti iṣe ti otitọ ngbọ́ ohùn mi.
entries.en: Pilate therefore said unto him, Art thou a king then? Jesus answered, Thou sayest that I am a king. To this end was I born, and for this cause came I into the world, that I should bear witness unto the truth. Every one that is of the truth heareth my voice.

entries.yo: Pilatu wi fun u pe, Kili otitọ? Nigbati o si ti wi eyi tan, o tún jade tọ̀ awọn Ju lọ, o si wi fun wọn pe, Emi kò ri ẹ̀ṣẹ kan lọwọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Pilate saith unto him, What is truth? And when he had said this, he went out again unto the Jews, and saith unto them, I find in him no fault at all.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹnyin ni àṣa kan pe, ki emi ki o da ọkan silẹ fun nyin nigba ajọ irekọja: nitorina ẹ ha fẹ ki emi ki o da Ọba awọn Ju silẹ fun nyin bi?
entries.en: But ye have a custom, that I should release unto you one at the passover: will ye therefore that I release unto you the King of the Jews?

entries.yo: Nitorina gbogbo wọn tún kigbe wipe, Kì iṣe ọkunrin yi, bikoṣe Barabba. Ọlọṣa si ni Barabba.
entries.en: Then cried they all again, saying, Not this man, but Barabbas. Now Barabbas was a robber.

entries.yo: NITORINA ni Pilatu mu Jesu, o si nà a.
entries.en: Then Pilate therefore took Jesus, and scourged him.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ-ogun si hun ade ẹgún, nwọn si fi de e li ori, nwọn si fi aṣọ igunwà elesè àluko wọ̀ ọ.
entries.en: And the soldiers platted a crown of thorns, and put it on his head, and they put on him a purple robe,

entries.yo: Nwọn si wipe, Kabiyesi, Ọba awọn Ju! nwọn si fi ọwọ́ wọn gbá a loju.
entries.en: And said, Hail, King of the Jews! and they smote him with their hands.

entries.yo: Pilatu si tún jade, o si wi fun wọn pe, Wo o, mo mu u jade tọ̀ nyin wá, ki ẹnyin ki o le mọ̀ pe, emi kò ri ẹ̀ṣẹ kan lọwọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Pilate therefore went forth again, and saith unto them, Behold, I bring him forth to you, that ye may know that I find no fault in him.

entries.yo: Nitorina Jesu jade wá, ti on ti ade ẹgún ati aṣọ elesè àluko. Pilatu si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ wò ọkunrin na!
entries.en: Then came Jesus forth, wearing the crown of thorns, and the purple robe. And Pilate saith unto them, Behold the man!

entries.yo: Nitorina nigbati awọn olori alufa, ati awọn onṣẹ ri i, nwọn kigbe wipe, Kàn a mọ agbelebu, kàn a mọ agbelebu. Pilatu wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ mu u fun ara nyin, ki ẹ si kàn a mọ agbelebu: nitoriti emi ko ri ẹ̀ṣẹ lọwọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: When the chief priests therefore and officers saw him, they cried out, saying, Crucify him, crucify him. Pilate saith unto them, Take ye him, and crucify him: for I find no fault in him.

entries.yo: Awọn Ju da a lohùn wipe, Awa li ofin kan, ati gẹgẹ bi ofin wa o yẹ lati kú, nitoriti o fi ara rẹ̀ ṣe Ọmọ Ọlọrun.
entries.en: The Jews answered him, We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.

entries.yo: Nitorina nigbati Pilatu gbọ́ ọ̀rọ yi ẹ̀ru tubọ ba a.
entries.en: When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he was the more afraid;

entries.yo: O si tun wọ̀ inu gbọ̀ngan idajọ lọ, o si wi fun Jesu pe, Nibo ni iwọ ti wá? Ṣugbọn Jesu kò da a lohùn.
entries.en: And went again into the judgment hall, and saith unto Jesus, Whence art thou? But Jesus gave him no answer.

entries.yo: Nitorina Pilatu wi fun u pe, Emi ni iwọ ko fọhun si? iwọ kò mọ̀ pe, emi li agbara lati dá ọ silẹ, emi si li agbara lati kàn ọ mọ agbelebu?
entries.en: Then saith Pilate unto him, Speakest thou not unto me? knowest thou not that I have power to crucify thee, and have power to release thee?

entries.yo: Jesu da a lohun pe, Iwọ kì ba ti li agbara kan lori mi, bikoṣepe a fi i fun ọ lati oke wá: nitorina ẹniti o fi mi le ọ lọwọ li o ni ẹ̀ṣẹ pọ̀ju.
entries.en: Jesus answered, Thou couldest have no power at all against me, except it were given thee from above: therefore he that delivered me unto thee hath the greater sin.

entries.yo: Nitori eyi Pilatu nwá ọ̀na lati dá a silẹ: ṣugbọn awọn Ju kigbe, wipe, Bi iwọ ba dá ọkunrin yi silẹ, iwọ kì iṣe ọrẹ́ Kesari: ẹnikẹni ti o ba ṣe ara rẹ̀ li ọba, o sọ̀rọ òdi si Kesari.
entries.en: And from thenceforth Pilate sought to release him: but the Jews cried out, saying, If thou let this man go, thou art not Caesar's friend: whosoever maketh himself a king speaketh against Caesar.

entries.yo: Nitorina nigbati Pilatu gbọ́ ọ̀rọ wọnyi, o mu Jesu jade wá, o si joko lori itẹ́ idajọ ti a npè ni Okuta-titẹ, ṣugbọn li ede Heberu, Gabbata.
entries.en: When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he brought Jesus forth, and sat down in the judgment seat in a place that is called the Pavement, but in the Hebrew, Gabbatha.

entries.yo: O jẹ Ipalẹmọ́ ajọ irekọja, o jẹ iwọn wakati ẹkẹfa: o si wi fun awọn Ju pe, Ẹ wò Ọba nyin!
entries.en: And it was the preparation of the passover, and about the sixth hour: and he saith unto the Jews, Behold your King!

entries.yo: Nitorina nwọn kigbe wipe, Mu u kuro, mu u kuro, kàn a mọ agbelebu. Pilatu wi fun wọn pe, Emi o ha kàn Ọba nyin mọ agbelebu bi? Awọn olori alufa dahùn wipe,
entries.en: But they cried out, Away with him, away with him, crucify him. Pilate saith unto them, Shall I crucify your King? The chief priest answered, We have no king but Caesar.

entries.yo: Awa kò li ọba bikoṣe Kesari. Nigbana li o fà a le wọn lọwọ lati kàn a mọ agbelebu.
entries.en: Then delivered he him therefore unto them to be crucified. And they took Jesus, and led him away.

entries.yo: Nitorina nwọn mu Jesu, o si jade lọ, o rù agbelebu fun ara rẹ̀ si ibi ti a npè ni Ibi-agbari, li ede Heberu ti a npè ni Golgota:
entries.en: And he bearing his cross went forth into a place called the place of a skull, which is called in the Hebrew Golgotha:

entries.yo: Nibiti nwọn gbé kàn a mọ agbelebu, ati awọn meji miran pẹlu rẹ̀, niha ikini ati nìha keji, Jesu si wà larin.
entries.en: Where they crucified him, and two other with him, on either side one, and Jesus in the midst.

entries.yo: Pilatu si kọ iwe akọle kan pẹlu, o si fi i le ori agbelebu na. Ohun ti a si kọ ni, JESU TI NASARETI ỌBA AWỌN JU.
entries.en: And Pilate wrote a title, and put it on the cross. And the writing was, JESUS OF NAZARETH THE KING OF THE JEWS.

entries.yo: Nitorina ọpọ awọn Ju li o kà iwe akọle yi: nitori ibi ti a gbé kàn Jesu mọ agbelebu sunmọ eti ilu: a si kọ ọ li ède Heberu, ati ti Latini, ati ti Helene.
entries.en: This title then read many of the Jews: for the place where Jesus was crucified was nigh to the city: and it was written in Hebrew, and Greek, and Latin.

entries.yo: Nitorina awọn olori alufa awọn Ju wi fun Pilatu pe, Máṣe kọ ọ pe, Ọba awọn Ju; ṣugbọn pe on wipe, Emi li Ọba awọn Ju.
entries.en: Then said the chief priests of the Jews to Pilate, Write not, The King of the Jews; but that he said, I am King of the Jews.

entries.yo: Pilatu dahùn pe, Ohun ti mo ti kọ tan, mo ti kọ na.
entries.en: Pilate answered, What I have written I have written.

entries.yo: Nigbana li awọn ọmọ-ogun, nigbati nwọn kàn jesu mọ agbelebu tan, nwọn mu aṣọ rẹ̀, nwọn si pín wọn si ipa mẹrin, apakan fun ọmọ-ogun kọkan, ati àwọtẹlẹ rẹ̀: ṣugbọn àwọ̀tẹlẹ na kò li ojuran, nwọn hun u lati oke titi jalẹ.
entries.en: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments, and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also his coat: now the coat was without seam, woven from the top throughout.

entries.yo: Nitorina nwọn wi fun ara wọn pe, Ẹ má jẹ ki a fà a ya, ṣugbọn ki a ṣẹ kèké nitori rẹ̀, ti ẹniti yio jẹ: ki iwe-mimọ́ ki o le ṣẹ, ti o wipe, Nwọn pín aṣọ mi larin ara wọn, nwọn si ṣẹ kèké fun aṣọ ileke mi. Nkan wọnyi li awọn ọmọ-ogun ṣe.
entries.en: They said therefore among themselves, Let us not rend it, but cast lots for it, whose it shall be: that the scripture might be fulfilled, which saith, They parted my raiment among them, and for my vesture they did cast lots. These things therefore the soldiers did.

entries.yo: Iya Jesu ati arabinrin iya rẹ̀ Maria aya Klopa, ati Maria Magdalene, si duro nibi agbelebu.
entries.en: Now there stood by the cross of Jesus his mother, and his mother's sister, Mary the wife of Cleophas, and Mary Magdalene.

entries.yo: Nitorina nigbati Jesu ri iya rẹ̀, ati ọmọ-ẹhin na duro, ẹniti Jesu fẹràn, o wi fun iya rẹ̀ pe, Obinrin, wò ọmọ rẹ!
entries.en: When Jesus therefore saw his mother, and the disciple standing by, whom he loved, he saith unto his mother, Woman, behold thy son!

entries.yo: Lẹhin na li o si wi fun ọmọ-ẹhin na pe, Wò iya rẹ! Lati wakati na lọ li ọmọ-ẹhin na si ti mu u lọ si ile ara rẹ̀.
entries.en: Then saith he to the disciple, Behold thy mother! And from that hour that disciple took her unto his own home.

entries.yo: Lẹhin eyi, bi Jesu ti mọ̀ pe, a ti pari ohun gbogbo tan, ki iwe-mimọ́ le ba ṣẹ, o wipe, Orungbẹ ngbẹ mi.
entries.en: After this, Jesus knowing that all things were now accomplished, that the scripture might be fulfilled, saith, I thirst.

entries.yo: A gbé ohun èlo kan kalẹ nibẹ̀ ti o kún fun ọti kikan: nwọn si fi sponge ti o kun fun ọti kikan, sori igi hissopu, nwọn si fi si i li ẹnu.
entries.en: Now there was set a vessel full of vinegar: and they filled a spunge with vinegar, and put it upon hyssop, and put it to his mouth.

entries.yo: Nitorina nigbati Jesu si ti gbà ọti kikan na, o wipe, O pari: o si tẹ ori rẹ̀ ba, o jọwọ ẹmí rẹ̀ lọwọ.
entries.en: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, It is finished: and he bowed his head, and gave up the ghost.

entries.yo: Nitori o jẹ ọjọ Ipalẹmọ, ki okú wọn ma bà wà lori agbelebu li ọjọ isimi, (nitori ojọ nla ni ọjọ isimi na) nitorina awọn Ju bẹ̀ Pilatu pe ki a ṣẹ egungun itan wọn, ki a si gbe wọn kuro.
entries.en: The Jews therefore, because it was the preparation, that the bodies should not remain upon the cross on the sabbath day, (for that sabbath day was an high day,) besought Pilate that their legs might be broken, and that they might be taken away.

entries.yo: Nitorina awọn ọmọ-ogun wá, nwọn si ṣẹ́ egungun itan ti ekini, ati ti ekeji, ti a kàn mọ agbelebu pẹlu rẹ̀.
entries.en: Then came the soldiers, and brake the legs of the first, and of the other which was crucified with him.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati nwọn de ọdọ Jesu, ti nwọn si ri pe, o ti kú na, nwọn kò si ṣẹ́ egungun itan rẹ̀:
entries.en: But when they came to Jesus, and saw that he was dead already, they brake not his legs:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ọkan ninu awọn ọmọ-ogun na fi ọ̀kọ gún u li ẹgbẹ, lojukanna ẹ̀jẹ ati omi si tú jade.
entries.en: But one of the soldiers with a spear pierced his side, and forthwith came there out blood and water.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ri i si jẹri, otitọ si li ẹrí rẹ̀: o si mọ̀ pe õtọ li on wi, ki ẹnyin ki o le gbagbọ́.
entries.en: And he that saw it bare record, and his record is true: and he knoweth that he saith true, that ye might believe.

entries.yo: Nkan wọnyi ṣe, ki iwe-mimọ́ ki o le ṣẹ, ti o wipe, A kì yio fọ́ egungun rẹ̀.
entries.en: For these things were done, that the scripture should be fulfilled, A bone of him shall not be broken.

entries.yo: Iwe-mimọ́ miran ẹ̀wẹ si wipe, Nwọn o ma wò ẹniti a gún li ọ̀kọ.
entries.en: And again another scripture saith, They shall look on him whom they pierced.

entries.yo: Lẹhin nkan wọnyi ni Josefu ará Arimatea, ẹniti iṣe ọmọ-ẹhin Jesu, ṣugbọn ni ikọ̀kọ nitori ìbẹru awọn Ju, o bẹ̀ Pilatu ki on ki o le gbé okú Jesu kuro: Pilatu si fun u li aṣẹ. Nitorina li o wá, o si gbé okú Jesu lọ.
entries.en: And after this Joseph of Arimathaea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, besought Pilate that he might take away the body of Jesus: and Pilate gave him leave. He came therefore, and took the body of Jesus.

entries.yo: Nikodemu pẹlu si wá, ẹniti o tọ̀ Jesu wá loru lakọṣe, o si mu àdapọ̀ ojia ati aloe wá, o to ìwọn ọgọrun litra.
entries.en: And there came also Nicodemus, which at the first came to Jesus by night, and brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about an hundred pound weight.

entries.yo: Bẹni nwọn gbé okú Jesu, nwọn si fi aṣọ ọ̀gbọ dì i pẹlu turari, gẹgẹ bi iṣe awọn Ju ti ri ni isinkú wọn.
entries.en: Then took they the body of Jesus, and wound it in linen clothes with the spices, as the manner of the Jews is to bury.

entries.yo: Agbala kan si wà nibiti a gbé kàn a mọ agbelebu; ibojì titun kan sí wà ninu agbala na, ninu eyiti a ko ti itẹ́ ẹnikẹni si ri.
