entries.en: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden; and in the garden a new sepulchre, wherein was never man yet laid.

entries.yo: Njẹ nibẹ ni nwọn si tẹ́ Jesu si, nitori Ipalẹmọ́ awọn Ju; nitori ibojì na wà nitosi.
entries.en: There laid they Jesus therefore because of the Jews' preparation day; for the sepulchre was nigh at hand.

entries.yo: LI ọjọ ikini ọ̀sẹ ni kùtùkùtù nigbati ilẹ kò ti imọ́, ni Maria Magdalene wá si ibojì, o si ri pe, a ti gbé okuta kuro li ẹnu ibojì.
entries.en: The first day of the week cometh Mary Magdalene early, when it was yet dark, unto the sepulchre, and seeth the stone taken away from the sepulchre.

entries.yo: Nitorina o sare, o si tọ̀ Simoni Peteru wá, ati ọmọ-ẹhin miran na ẹniti Jesu fẹran, o si wi fun wọn pe, Nwọn ti gbé Oluwa kuro ninu ibojì, awa kò si mọ̀ ibi ti nwọn gbé tẹ́ ẹ si.
entries.en: Then she runneth, and cometh to Simon Peter, and to the other disciple, whom Jesus loved, and saith unto them, They have taken away the Lord out of the sepulchre, and we know not where they have laid him.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Peteru jade, ati ọmọ-ẹhin miran na, nwọn si wá si ibojì.
entries.en: Peter therefore went forth, and that other disciple, and came to the sepulchre.

entries.yo: Awọn mejeji si jùmọ sare: eyi ọmọ-ẹhin miran nì si sare yà Peteru, o si tètekọ de ibojì.
entries.en: So they ran both together: and the other disciple did outrun Peter, and came first to the sepulchre.

entries.yo: O si bẹ̀rẹ, o si wò inu rẹ̀, o ri aṣọ ọgbọ na lelẹ; ṣugbọn on kò wọ̀ inu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he stooping down, and looking in, saw the linen clothes lying; yet went he not in.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Simoni Peteru ti mbọ̀ lẹhin rẹ̀ de, o si wọ̀ inu ibojì, o si ri aṣọ ọ̀gbọ na wà nilẹ̀.
entries.en: Then cometh Simon Peter following him, and went into the sepulchre, and seeth the linen clothes lie,

entries.yo: Ati pe gèle, ti o wà nibi ori rẹ̀, kò si wà pẹlu aṣọ ọgbọ na, ṣugbọn a ká a jọ ni ibikan fun ara rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the napkin, that was about his head, not lying with the linen clothes, but wrapped together in a place by itself.

entries.yo: Nigbana li ọmọ-ẹhin miran na, ẹniti o kọ de ibojì, wọ̀ inu rẹ̀ pẹlu, o si ri, o si gbagbọ́.
entries.en: Then went in also that other disciple, which came first to the sepulchre, and he saw, and believed.

entries.yo: Nitoripe nwọn kò sá ti imọ̀ iwe-mimọ́ pe, on kò le ṣaima jinde kuro ninu okú.
entries.en: For as yet they knew not the scripture, that he must rise again from the dead.

entries.yo: Bẹli awọn ọmọ-ẹhin na si tun pada lọ si ile wọn.
entries.en: Then the disciples went away again unto their own home.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Maria duro leti ibojì lode, o nsọkun: bi o ti nsọkun, bẹli o bẹ̀rẹ, o si wò inu ibojì.
entries.en: But Mary stood without at the sepulchre weeping: and as she wept, she stooped down, and looked into the sepulchre,

entries.yo: O si kiyesi awọn angẹli meji alaṣọ funfun, nwọn joko, ọkan niha ori, ati ọkan niha ẹsẹ̀, nibiti oku Jesu gbé ti sùn si.
entries.en: And seeth two angels in white sitting, the one at the head, and the other at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.

entries.yo: Nwọn si wi fun u pe, Obinrin yi, ẽṣe ti iwọ fi nsọkun? O si wi fun wọn pe, Nitoriti nwọn ti gbé Oluwa mi, emi kò si mọ̀ ibiti nwọn gbé tẹ́ ẹ si.
entries.en: And they say unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? She saith unto them, Because they have taken away my Lord, and I know not where they have laid him.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si ti wi eyi tan, o yipada, o si ri Jesu duro, kò si mọ̀ pe Jesu ni.
entries.en: And when she had thus said, she turned herself back, and saw Jesus standing, and knew not that it was Jesus.

entries.yo: Jesu wi fun u pe, Obinrin yi, ẽṣe ti iwọ fi nsọkun? tani iwọ nwá? On ṣebi oluṣọgba ni iṣe, o wi fun u pe, Alàgba, bi iwọ ba ti gbé e kuro nihin, sọ ibiti o gbé tẹ ẹ si fun mi, emi o si gbé e kuro.
entries.en: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? whom seekest thou? She, supposing him to be the gardener, saith unto him, Sir, if thou have borne him hence, tell me where thou hast laid him, and I will take him away.

entries.yo: Jesu wi fun u pe, Maria. O si yipada, o wi fun u pe, Rabboni; eyi ti o jẹ Olukọni.
entries.en: Jesus saith unto her, Mary. She turned herself, and saith unto him, Rabboni; which is to say, Master.

entries.yo: Jesu wi fun u pe, Máṣe fi ọwọ́ kàn mi; nitoriti emi kò ti igòke lọ sọdọ Baba mi: ṣugbọn lọ sọdọ awọn arakunrin mi, si wi fun wọn pe, Emi ngòke lọ sọdọ Baba mi, ati Baba nyin; ati sọdọ Ọlọrun mi, ati Ọlọrun nyin.
entries.en: Jesus saith unto her, Touch me not; for I am not yet ascended to my Father: but go to my brethren, and say unto them, I ascend unto my Father, and your Father; and to my God, and your God.

entries.yo: Maria Magdalene wá, o si sọ fun awọn ọmọ-ẹhin pe, on ti ri Oluwa, ati pe, o si ti sọ nkan wọnyi fun on.
entries.en: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and that he had spoken these things unto her.

entries.yo: Lọjọ kanna, lọjọ ikini ọ̀sẹ nigbati alẹ́ lẹ́, ti a si ti tì ilẹkun ibiti awọn ọmọ-ẹhin gbé pejọ, nitori ìbẹru awọn Ju, bẹni Jesu de, o duro larin, o si wi fun wọn pe, Alafia fun nyin.
entries.en: Then the same day at evening, being the first day of the week, when the doors were shut where the disciples were assembled for fear of the Jews, came Jesus and stood in the midst, and saith unto them, Peace be unto you.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si ti wi bẹ̃ tan, o fi ọwọ́ ati ìha rẹ̀ hàn wọn. Nitorina li awọn ọmọ-ẹhin yọ̀, nigbati nwọn ri Oluwa.
entries.en: And when he had so said, he shewed unto them his hands and his side. Then were the disciples glad, when they saw the Lord.

entries.yo: Nitorina Jesu si tún wi fun wọn pe, Alafia fun nyin: gẹgẹ bi Baba ti rán mi, bẹ̃li emi si rán nyin.
entries.en: Then said Jesus to them again, Peace be unto you: as my Father hath sent me, even so send I you.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si ti wi eyi tan, o mí si wọn, o si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ gbà Ẹmí Mimọ́:
entries.en: And when he had said this, he breathed on them, and saith unto them, Receive ye the Holy Ghost:

entries.yo: Ẹṣẹ ẹnikẹni ti ẹnyin ba fi jì, a fi ji wọn; ẹ̀ṣẹ ẹnikẹni ti ẹnyin ba da duro, a da wọn duro.
entries.en: Whose soever sins ye remit, they are remitted unto them; and whose soever sins ye retain, they are retained.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Tomasi, ọkan ninu awọn mejila, ti a npè ni Didimu, kò wà pẹlu wọn nigbati Jesu de.
entries.en: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, was not with them when Jesus came.

entries.yo: Nitorina awọn ọmọ-ẹhin iyokù wi fun u pe, Awa ti ri Oluwa. Ṣugbọn o wi fun wọn pe, Bikoṣepe mo ba ri àpá iṣo li ọwọ́ rẹ̀ ki emi ki o si fi ika mi si àpá iṣó na, ki emi ki o si fi ọwọ́ mi si ìha rẹ̀, emi kì yio gbagbó.
entries.en: The other disciples therefore said unto him, We have seen the Lord. But he said unto them, Except I shall see in his hands the print of the nails, and put my finger into the print of the nails, and thrust my hand into his side, I will not believe.

entries.yo: Lẹhin ijọ mẹjọ awọn ọmọ-ẹhin si tún wà ninu ile, ati Tomasi pẹlu wọn: nigbati a si ti tì ilẹkun, Jesu de, o si duro larin, o si wipe, Alafia fun nyin.
entries.en: And after eight days again his disciples were within, and Thomas with them: then came Jesus, the doors being shut, and stood in the midst, and said, Peace be unto you.

entries.yo: Nigbana li o wi fun Tomasi pe, Mu ika rẹ wá nihin, ki o si wò ọwọ́ mi; si mu ọwọ́ rẹ wá nihin, ki o si fi si ìha mi: kì iwọ ki o máṣe alaigbagbọ́ mọ́, ṣugbọn jẹ onigbagbọ.
entries.en: Then saith he to Thomas, reach hither thy finger, and behold my hands; and reach hither thy hand, and thrust it into my side: and be not faithless, but believing.

entries.yo: Tomasi dahun o si wi fun u pe, Oluwa mi ati Ọlọrun mi!
entries.en: And Thomas answered and said unto him, My Lord and my God.

entries.yo: Jesu wi fun u pe, nitoriti iwọ ri mi ni iwọ ṣe gbagbọ́: alabukun-fun li awọn ti kò ri, ti nwọn si gbagbọ́.
entries.en: Jesus saith unto him, Thomas, because thou hast seen me, thou hast believed: blessed are they that have not seen, and yet have believed.

entries.yo: Ọpọlọpọ iṣẹ àmi miran ni Jesu ṣe niwaju awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀, ti a kò kọ sinu iwe yi:
entries.en: And many other signs truly did Jesus in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn wọnyi li a kọ, ki ẹnyin ki o le gbagbọ́ pe, Jesu ni iṣe Kristi na, Ọmọ Ọlọrun; ati ni gbigbàgbọ́, ki ẹnyin ki o le ni ìye li orukọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: But these are written, that ye might believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God; and that believing ye might have life through his name.

entries.yo: LẸHIN nkan wọnyi, Jesu tún fi ara rẹ̀ hàn fun awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ leti okun Tiberia; bayi li o si farahàn.
entries.en: After these things Jesus shewed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias; and on this wise shewed he himself.

entries.yo: Simoni Peteru, ati Tomasi ti a npè ni Didimu, ati Natanaeli ara Kana ti Galili, ati awọn ọmọ Sebede, ati awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ meji miran jùmọ wà pọ̀.
entries.en: There were together Simon Peter, and Thomas called Didymus, and Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two other of his disciples.

entries.yo: Simoni Peteru wi fun wọn pe, Emi nlọ ipẹja. Nwọn wi fun u pe, Awa pẹlu mba ọ lọ. Nwọn jade, nwọn si wọ̀ inú ọkọ̀; li oru na nwọn kò si mú ohunkohun.
entries.en: Simon Peter saith unto them, I go a fishing. They say unto him, We also go with thee. They went forth, and entered into a ship immediately; and that night they caught nothing.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati ilẹ bẹrẹ si imọ́, Jesu duro leti okun: ṣugbọn awọn ọmọ-ẹhin kò mọ̀ pe Jesu ni.
entries.en: But when the morning was now come, Jesus stood on the shore: but the disciples knew not that it was Jesus.

entries.yo: Nitorina Jesu wi fun wọn pe, Ẹnyin ọmọde, ẹ li onjẹ diẹ bi? Nwọn da a lohùn wipe, Rára o.
entries.en: Then Jesus saith unto them, Children, have ye any meat? They answered him, No.

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ sọ àwọn si apa ọtùn ọkọ̀, ẹnyin ó si ri. Nitorina nwọn sọ ọ, nwọn kò si le fà a jade nitori ọpọ ẹja.
entries.en: And he said unto them, Cast the net on the right side of the ship, and ye shall find. They cast therefore, and now they were not able to draw it for the multitude of fishes.

entries.yo: Nitorina li ọmọ-ẹhin na ti Jesu fẹran wi fun Peteru pe, Oluwa ni. Nigbati Simoni Peteru gbọ́ pe Oluwa ni, bẹli o di amure ẹ̀wu rẹ̀ mọra, (nitori o wà ni ìhoho), o si gbé ara rẹ̀ sọ sinu okun.
entries.en: Therefore that disciple whom Jesus loved saith unto Peter, It is the Lord. Now when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he girt his fisher's coat unto him, (for he was naked,) and did cast himself into the sea.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn ọmọ-ẹhin iyoku mu ọkọ̀ kekere kan wá (nitoriti nwọn kò jina silẹ, ṣugbọn bi iwọn igba igbọnwọ); nwọn nwọ́ àwọn na ti o kún fun ẹja.
entries.en: And the other disciples came in a little ship; (for they were not far from land, but as it were two hundred cubits,) dragging the net with fishes.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn gúnlẹ, nwọn ri iná ẹyín nibẹ, ati ẹja lori rẹ̀, ati akara.
entries.en: As soon then as they were come to land, they saw a fire of coals there, and fish laid thereon, and bread.

entries.yo: Jesu wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ mú ninu ẹja ti ẹ pa nisisiyi wá.
entries.en: Jesus saith unto them, Bring of the fish which ye have now caught.

entries.yo: Nitorina Simoni Peteru gòke, o si fà àwọn na wálẹ, o kún fun ẹja nla, o jẹ mẹtalelãdọjọ: bi nwọn si ti pọ̀ to nì, àwọn na kò ya.
entries.en: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land full of great fishes, and hundred and fifty and three: and for all there were so many, yet was not the net broken.

entries.yo: Jesu wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ wá jẹun owurọ̀. Kò si si ẹnikan ninu awọn ọmọ-ẹhin ti o jẹ bi i pe, Tani iwọ iṣe? nitoriti nwọn mọ̀ pe Oluwa ni.
entries.en: Jesus saith unto them, Come and dine. And none of the disciples durst ask him, Who art thou? knowing that it was the Lord.

entries.yo: Jesu wá, o si mu akara, o si fifun wọn, gẹgẹ bẹ̃ si li ẹja.
entries.en: Jesus then cometh, and taketh bread, and giveth them, and fish likewise.

entries.yo: Eyi ni igba kẹta nisisiyi ti Jesu farahàn awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀, lẹhin igbati o jinde kuro ninu okú.
entries.en: This is now the third time that Jesus shewed himself to his disciples, after that he was risen from the dead.

entries.yo: Njẹ lẹhin igbati nwọn jẹun owurọ̀ tan, Jesu wi fun Simoni Peteru pe, Simoni, ọmọ Jona, iwọ fẹ mi jù awọn wọnyi lọ bi? O si wi fun u pe, Bẹ̃ni Oluwa; iwọ mọ̀ pe, mo fẹràn rẹ. O wi fun u pe, Mã bọ́ awọn ọdọ-agutan mi.
entries.en: So when they had dined, Jesus saith to Simon Peter, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me more than these? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my lambs.

entries.yo: O tún wi fun u nigba keji pe, Simoni, ọmọ Jona, iwọ fẹ mi bi? O wi fun u pe, Bẹ̃ni Oluwa; iwọ mọ̀ pe, mo fẹràn rẹ. O wi fun u pe, Mã bọ́ awọn agutan mi.
entries.en: He saith to him again the second time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my sheep.

entries.yo: O wi fun u nigba kẹta pe, Simoni, ọmọ Jona, iwọ fẹràn mi bi? Inu Peteru bajẹ, nitoriti o wi fun u nigba ẹkẹta pe, Iwọ fẹràn mi bi? O si wi fun u pe, Oluwa, iwọ mọ̀ ohun gbogbo; iwọ mọ̀ pe, mo fẹràn rẹ. Jesu wi fun u pe, Mã bọ́ awọn agutan mi.
entries.en: He saith unto him the third time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? Peter was grieved because he said unto him the third time, Lovest thou me? And he said unto him, Lord, thou knowest all things; thou knowest that I love thee. Jesus saith unto him, Feed my sheep.

entries.yo: Lõtọ, lõtọ ni mo wi fun ọ, nigbati iwọ wà li ọdọmọde, iwọ a ma di ara rẹ li àmurè, iwọ a si ma rìn lọ si ibiti iwọ ba fẹ: ṣugbọn nigbati iwọ ba di arugbo, iwọ o nà ọwọ́ rẹ jade, ẹlomiran yio si di ọ li amure, yio si mu ọ lọ si ibiti iwọ kò fẹ.
entries.en: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, When thou wast young, thou girdedst thyself, and walkedst whither thou wouldest: but when thou shalt be old, thou shalt stretch forth thy hands, and another shall gird thee, and carry thee whither thou wouldest not.

entries.yo: O wi eyi, o fi nṣapẹrẹ irú ikú ti yio fi yìn Ọlọrun logo. Lẹhin igbati o si ti wi eyi tan, o wi fun u pe, Mã tọ̀ mi lẹhin.
entries.en: This spake he, signifying by what death he should glorify God. And when he had spoken this, he saith unto him, Follow me.

entries.yo: Peteru si yipada, o ri ọmọ-ẹhin nì, ẹniti Jesu fẹràn, mbọ̀ lẹhin; ẹniti o si rọ̀gun si àiya rẹ̀ nigba onjẹ alẹ ti o si wi fun u pe, Oluwa, tali ẹniti o fi ọ hàn?
entries.en: Then Peter, turning about, seeth the disciple whom Jesus loved following; which also leaned on his breast at supper, and said, Lord, which is he that betrayeth thee?

entries.yo: Nigbati Peteru ri i, o wi fun Jesu pe, Oluwa, Eleyi ha nkọ́?
entries.en: Peter seeing him saith to Jesus, Lord, and what shall this man do?

entries.yo: Jesu wi fun u pe, Bi emi ba fẹ ki o duro titi emi o fi de, kili eyini si ọ? iwọ mã tọ̀ mi lẹhin.
entries.en: Jesus saith unto him, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee? follow thou me.

entries.yo: Nitorina ọ̀rọ yi si tàn ka lãrin awọn arakunrin pe, ọmọ-ẹhin nì kì yio kú: ṣugbọn Jesu kò wi fun u pe, On kì yio kú; ṣugbọn, Bi emi ba fẹ ki o duro titi emi o fi de, kili eyinì si ọ?
entries.en: Then went this saying abroad among the brethren, that that disciple should not die: yet Jesus said not unto him, He shall not die; but, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee?

entries.yo: Eyi li ọmọ-ẹhin na, ti o jẹri nkan wọnyi, ti o si kọwe nkan wọnyi: awa si mọ̀ pe, otitọ ni èrí rẹ̀.
entries.en: This is the disciple which testifieth of these things, and wrote these things: and we know that his testimony is true.

entries.yo: Ọpọlọpọ ohun miran pẹlu ni Jesu ṣe, eyiti bi a ba kọwe wọn li ọkọ̃kan, mo rò pe aiye pãpã kò le gbà iwe na ti a ba kọ. Amin.
entries.en: And there are also many other things which Jesus did, the which, if they should be written every one, I suppose that even the world itself could not contain the books that should be written. Amen.

entries.yo: TEOFILU, ìhìn iṣaju ni mo ti rò, niti ohun gbogbo ti Jesu bẹ̀rẹ si iṣe, ati si ikọ́,
entries.en: The former treatise have I made, O Theophilus, of all that Jesus began both to do and teach,

entries.yo: Titi o fi di ọjọ ti a gbà a lọ soke, lẹhin ti o ti ti ipa Ẹmi Mimọ́ paṣẹ fun awọn aposteli ti o yàn:
entries.en: Until the day in which he was taken up, after that he through the Holy Ghost had given commandments unto the apostles whom he had chosen:

entries.yo: Awọn ẹniti o si farahàn fun lãye lẹhin ìjiya rẹ̀ nipa ẹ̀rí pupọ ti o daju, ẹniti a ri lọdọ wọn li ogoji ọjọ ti o nsọ ohun ti iṣe ti ijọba Ọlọrun:
entries.en: To whom also he shewed himself alive after his passion by many infallible proofs, being seen of them forty days, and speaking of the things pertaining to the kingdom of God:

entries.yo: Nigbati o si ba wọn pejọ, o paṣẹ fun wọn, ki nwọn ki o máṣe kuro ni Jerusalemu, ṣugbọn ki nwọn ki o duro dè ileri Baba, eyiti, o wipe, ẹnyin ti gbọ́ li ẹnu mi:
entries.en: And, being assembled together with them, commanded them that they should not depart from Jerusalem, but wait for the promise of the Father, which, saith he, ye have heard of me.

entries.yo: Nitori nitotọ ni Johanu fi omi baptisi; ṣugbọn a o fi Ẹmí Mimọ́ baptisi nyin, kì iṣe ọjọ pupọ lati oni lọ.
entries.en: For John truly baptized with water; but ye shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost not many days hence.

entries.yo: Nitorina nigbati nwọn si pejọ, nwọn bi i lere pe, Oluwa, lati igbayi lọ iwọ ó ha mu ijọba pada fun Israeli bi?
entries.en: When they therefore were come together, they asked of him, saying, Lord, wilt thou at this time restore again the kingdom to Israel?

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Kì iṣe ti nyin lati mọ̀ akoko tabi ìgba, ti Baba ti yàn nipa agbara on tikararẹ̀.
entries.en: And he said unto them, It is not for you to know the times or the seasons, which the Father hath put in his own power.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹnyin ó gbà agbara, nigbati Ẹmí Mimọ́ ba bà le nyin: ẹ o si ma ṣe ẹlẹri mi ni Jerusalemu, ati ni gbogbo Judea, ati ni Samaria, ati titi de opin ilẹ aiye.
entries.en: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judaea, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si ti wi nkan wọnyi, bi nwọn ti nwò, a gbé e soke; awọsanma si gbà a kuro li oju wọn.
entries.en: And when he had spoken these things, while they beheld, he was taken up; and a cloud received him out of their sight.

entries.yo: Bi nwọn si ti tẹ̀jumọ́ oju ọrun bi o ti nrè oke, kiyesi i, awọn ọkunrin meji alaṣọ àla duro leti ọdọ wọn;
entries.en: And while they looked stedfastly toward heaven as he went up, behold, two men stood by them in white apparel;

entries.yo: Ti nwọn si wipe, Ẹnyin ará Galili, ẽṣe ti ẹ fi duro ti ẹ nwò oju ọrun? Jesu na yi, ti a gbà soke ọrun kuro lọwọ nyin, yio pada bẹ̃ gẹgẹ bi ẹ ti ri i ti o nlọ si ọrun.
entries.en: Which also said, Ye men of Galilee, why stand ye gazing up into heaven? this same Jesus, which is taken up from you into heaven, shall so come in like manner as ye have seen him go into heaven.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni nwọn pada ti ori òke ti a npè ni Olifi lọ si Jerusalemu, ti o sunmọ Jerusalemu ni ìwọn ìrin ọjọ isimi kan.
entries.en: Then returned they unto Jerusalem from the mount called Olivet, which is from Jerusalem a sabbath day's journey.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si wọle, nwọn lọ si yara oke, nibiti Peteru, ati Jakọbu, ati Johanu, ati Anderu, ati Filippi, ati Tomasi, Bartolomeu, ati Matiu, Jakọbu ọmọ Alfeu, ati Simoni Selote, ati Juda arakunrin Jakọbu, gbe wà.
entries.en: And when they were come in, they went up into an upper room, where abode both Peter, and James, and John, and Andrew, Philip, and Thomas, Bartholomew, and Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, and Simon Zelotes, and Judas the brother of James.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn wọnyi fi ọkàn kan duro si adura ati si ẹ̀bẹ, pẹlu awọn obinrin, ati Maria iya Jesu ati awọn arakunrin rẹ̀ pẹlu.
entries.en: These all continued with one accord in prayer and supplication, with the women, and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brethren.

entries.yo: Ni ijọ wọnni ni Peteru si dide duro li awujọ awọn ọmọ-ẹhin (iye awọn enia gbogbo ninu ijọ jẹ ọgọfa,) o ni,
entries.en: And in those days Peter stood up in the midst of the disciples, and said, (the number of names together were about an hundred and twenty,)

entries.yo: Ẹnyin ará, Iwe-mimọ́ kò le ṣe ki o má ṣẹ, ti Ẹmi Mimọ́ ti sọtẹlẹ lati ẹnu Dafidi niti Judasi, ti o ṣe amọ̀na fun awọn ti o mu Jesu.
entries.en: Men and brethren, this scripture must needs have been fulfilled, which the Holy Ghost by the mouth of David spake before concerning Judas, which was guide to them that took Jesus.

entries.yo: Nitori a kà a kún wa, o si ni ipin ninu iṣẹ iranṣẹ yi.
entries.en: For he was numbered with us, and had obtained part of this ministry.

entries.yo: Njẹ ọkunrin yi sá ti fi ere aiṣõtọ rà ilẹ kan; nigbati o si ṣubu li ògedengbé, o bẹ́ li agbedemeji, gbogbo ifun rẹ̀ si tú jade.
entries.en: Now this man purchased a field with the reward of iniquity; and falling headlong, he burst asunder in the midst, and all his bowels gushed out.

entries.yo: O si di mimọ̀ fun gbogbo awọn ti ngbe Jerusalemu; nitorina li a fi npè igbẹ́ na ni Akeldama li ède wọn, eyini ni, Igbẹ́ ẹ̀jẹ.
entries.en: And it was known unto all the dwellers at Jerusalem; insomuch as that field is called in their proper tongue, Aceldama, that is to say, The field of blood.

entries.yo: A sá kọ ọ ninu Iwe Psalmu pe, Jẹ ki ibujoko rẹ̀ ki o di ahoro, ki ẹnikan ki o má si ṣe gbé inu rẹ̀, ati oyè rẹ̀, ni ki ẹlomiran gbà.
entries.en: For it is written in the book of Psalms, Let his habitation be desolate, and let no man dwell therein: and his bishoprick let another take.

entries.yo: Nitorina ninu awọn ọkunrin wọnyi ti nwọn ti mba wa rìn ni gbogbo akoko ti Jesu Oluwa nwọle, ti o si njade lãrin wa,
entries.en: Wherefore of these men which have companied with us all the time that the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,

entries.yo: Bẹ̀rẹ lati igba baptismu Johanu wá, titi o fi di ọjọ na ti a gbé e lọ soke kuro lọdọ wa, o yẹ ki ọkan ninu awọn wọnyi ṣe ẹlẹri ajinde rẹ̀ pẹlu wa.
entries.en: Beginning from the baptism of John, unto that same day that he was taken up from us, must one be ordained to be a witness with us of his resurrection.

entries.yo: Nwọn si yàn awọn meji, Josefu ti a npè ni Barsabba, ẹniti a sọ apele rẹ̀ ni Justu, ati Mattia.
entries.en: And they appointed two, Joseph called Barsabas, who was surnamed Justus, and Matthias.

entries.yo: Nwọn si gbadura, nwọn si wipe, Iwọ, Oluwa, olumọ̀ ọkàn gbogbo enia, fihàn ninu awọn meji yi, ewo ni iwọ yàn,
entries.en: And they prayed, and said, Thou, Lord, which knowest the hearts of all men, shew whether of these two thou hast chosen,

entries.yo: Ki o le gbà ipò ninu iṣẹ iranṣẹ yi ati iṣẹ aposteli, eyiti Judasi ṣubu kuro ninu rẹ̀ ki o le lọ si ipò ti ara rẹ̀.
entries.en: That he may take part of this ministry and apostleship, from which Judas by transgression fell, that he might go to his own place.

entries.yo: Nwọn si dìbo fun wọn; ìbo si mu Mattia; a si kà a mọ awọn aposteli mọkanla.
entries.en: And they gave forth their lots; and the lot fell upon Matthias; and he was numbered with the eleven apostles.

entries.yo: NIGBATI ọjọ Pentekosti si de, gbogbo nwọn fi ọkàn kan wà nibikan.
entries.en: And when the day of Pentecost was fully come, they were all with one accord in one place.

entries.yo: Lojijì iró si ti ọrun wá, gẹgẹ bi iró ẹ̀fũfu lile, o si kún gbogbo ile nibiti nwọn gbé joko.
entries.en: And suddenly there came a sound from heaven as of a rushing mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.

entries.yo: Ẹla ahọn bi ti iná si yọ si wọn, o pin ara rẹ̀ o si bà le olukuluku wọn.
entries.en: And there appeared unto them cloven tongues like as of fire, and it sat upon each of them.

entries.yo: Gbogbo nwọn si kún fun Ẹmí Mimọ́, nwọn si bẹ̀rẹ si ifi ède miran sọrọ, gẹgẹ bi Ẹmí ti fun wọn li ohùn.
entries.en: And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak with other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance.

entries.yo: Awọn Ju olufọkànsin lati orilẹ-ede gbogbo labẹ ọrun si ngbe Jerusalemu.
entries.en: And there were dwelling at Jerusalem Jews, devout men, out of every nation under heaven.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si gbọ iró yi, ọ̀pọlọpọ enia pejọ, nwọn si damu, nitoriti olukuluku gbọ́ nwọn nsọ̀rọ li ède rẹ̀.
entries.en: Now when this was noised abroad, the multitude came together, and were confounded, because that every man heard them speak in his own language.

entries.yo: Hà si ṣe gbogbo wọn, ẹnu si yà wọn, nwọn nwi fun ara wọn pe, Wo o, ara Galili ki gbogbo awọn ti nsọ̀rọ wọnyi iṣe?
entries.en: And they were all amazed and marvelled, saying one to another, Behold, are not all these which speak Galilaeans?

entries.yo: Ẽha si ti ṣe ti awa fi ngbọ́ olukuluku li ede wa ninu eyiti a bí wa?
entries.en: And how hear we every man in our own tongue, wherein we were born?

entries.yo: Awọn ará Partia, ati Media, ati Elamu, ati awọn ti ngbé Mesopotamia, Judea, ati Kappadokia, Pontu, ati Asia,
entries.en: Parthians, and Medes, and Elamites, and the dwellers in Mesopotamia, and in Judaea, and Cappadocia, in Pontus, and Asia,

entries.yo: Frigia, ati Pamfilia, Egipti, ati ẹkùn Libia niha Kirene, ati awọn atipo Romu, awọn Ju ati awọn alawọṣe Ju,
entries.en: Phrygia, and Pamphylia, in Egypt, and in the parts of Libya about Cyrene, and strangers of Rome, Jews and proselytes,

entries.yo: Awọn ara Krete ati Arabia, awa gbọ́ nwọn nsọ̀rọ iṣẹ iyanu nla Ọlọrun li ède wa.
entries.en: Cretes and Arabians, we do hear them speak in our tongues the wonderful works of God.

entries.yo: Hà si ṣe gbogbo wọn, o si rú wọn lojú, nwọn wi fun ara wọn pe, Kili a le mọ̀ eyi si?
entries.en: And they were all amazed, and were in doubt, saying one to another, What meaneth this?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn ẹlomiran nṣẹ̀fẹ nwọn si wipe, Awọn ọkunrin wọnyi kún fun waini titun.
entries.en: Others mocking said, These men are full of new wine.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Peteru dide duro pẹlu awọn mọkanla iyokù, o gbé ohùn rẹ̀ soke, o si wi fun wọn gbangba pe, Ẹnyin enia Judea, ati gbogbo ẹnyin ti ngbé Jerusalemu, ki eyiyi ki o yé nyin, ki ẹ si fetísi ọ̀rọ mi:
entries.en: But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice, and said unto them, Ye men of Judaea, and all ye that dwell at Jerusalem, be this known unto you, and hearken to my words:

entries.yo: Nitori awọn wọnyi kò mutiyó, bi ẹnyin ti fi pè; wakati kẹta ọjọ sá li eyi.
entries.en: For these are not drunken, as ye suppose, seeing it is but the third hour of the day.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn eyi li ọ̀rọ ti a ti sọ lati ẹnu woli Joeli wá pe;
entries.en: But this is that which was spoken by the prophet Joel;

entries.yo: Ọlọrun wipe, Yio si ṣe ni ikẹhin ọjọ, Emi o tú ninu Ẹmí mi jade sara enia gbogbo: ati awọn ọmọ nyin-ọkunrin ati awọn ọmọ nyin obinrin yio ma sọtẹlẹ, awọn ọdọmọkunrin nyin yio si ma ri iran, awọn arugbo nyin yio si ma lá alá:
entries.en: And it shall come to pass in the last days, saith God,I will pour out of my Spirit upon all flesh: and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, and your young men shall see visions, and your old men shall dream dreams:

entries.yo: Ati sara awọn ọmọ-ọdọ mi ọkunrin, ati sara awọn ọmọ-ọdọ mi obinrin li emi o tú ninu Ẹmí mi jade li ọjọ wọnni; nwọn o si ma sọtẹlẹ:
entries.en: And on my servants and on my handmaidens I will pour out in those days of my Spirit; and they shall prophesy:

entries.yo: Emi o si fi iṣẹ iyanu hàn loke li ọrun, ati àmi nisalẹ lori ilẹ: ẹ̀jẹ, ati iná, ati ríru ẹ̃fin;
entries.en: And I will shew wonders in heaven above, and signs in the earth beneath; blood, and fire, and vapour of smoke:

entries.yo: A o sọ õrùn di òkunkun, ati oṣupa di ẹ̀jẹ, ki ọjọ nla afiyesi Oluwa ki o to de:
entries.en: The sun shall be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before that great and notable day of the Lord come:

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, ẹnikẹni ti o ba pè orukọ Oluwa, a o gbà a là.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass, that whosoever shall call on the name of the Lord shall be saved.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin enia Israeli, ẹ gbọ́ ọ̀rọ wọnyi: Jesu ti Nasareti, ọkunrin ti a fi hàn fun nyin lati ọdọ Ọlọrun wá, nipa iṣẹ agbara ati ti iyanu, ati ti àmi ti Ọlọrun ti ọwọ́ rẹ̀ ṣe lãrin nyin, bi ẹnyin tikaranyin ti mọ̀ pẹlu:
entries.en: Ye men of Israel, hear these words; Jesus of Nazareth, a man approved of God among you by miracles and wonders and signs, which God did by him in the midst of you, as ye yourselves also know:

entries.yo: Ẹniti a ti fi le nyin lọwọ nipa ipinnu ìmọ ati imọtẹlẹ Ọlọrun; on li ẹnyin mu, ti ẹ ti ọwọ awọn enia buburu kàn mọ agbelebu, ti ẹ si pa.
entries.en: Him, being delivered by the determinate counsel and foreknowledge of God, ye have taken, and by wicked hands have crucified and slain:

entries.yo: Ẹniti Ọlọrun gbé dide, nigbati o ti tú irora ikú: nitoriti kò ṣe iṣe fun u lati dì i mu.
entries.en: Whom God hath raised up, having loosed the pains of death: because it was not possible that he should be holden of it.

entries.yo: Nitori Dafidi ti wi nipa tirẹ̀ pe, Mo ri Oluwa nigba-gbogbo niwaju mi, nitoriti o mbẹ li ọwọ́ ọtún mi, ki a mà bà ṣí mi ni ipò:
entries.en: For David speaketh concerning him, I foresaw the Lord always before my face, for he is on my right hand, that I should not be moved:

entries.yo: Nitorina inu mi dùn, ahọn mi si yọ̀; pẹlupẹlu ara mi yio si simi ni ireti:
entries.en: Therefore did my heart rejoice, and my tongue was glad; moreover also my flesh shall rest in hope:

entries.yo: Nitoriti iwọ ki yio fi ọkàn mi silẹ ni ipò-okú, bẹ̃ni iwọ ki yio jẹ ki Ẹni-Mimọ́ rẹ ki o ri idibajẹ.
entries.en: Because thou wilt not leave my soul in hell, neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.

entries.yo: Iwọ mu mi mọ̀ ọ̀na iye; iwọ ó mu mi kún fun ayọ̀ ni iwaju rẹ.
entries.en: Thou hast made known to me the ways of life; thou shalt make me full of joy with thy countenance.

entries.yo: Ará, ẹ jẹ ki emi ki o sọ fun nyin gbangba niti Dafidi baba nla pe, o kú, a si sin i, ibojì rẹ̀ si mbẹ lọdọ wa titi o fi di oni yi.
entries.en: Men and brethren, let me freely speak unto you of the patriarch David, that he is both dead and buried, and his sepulchre is with us unto this day.

entries.yo: Nitoriti iṣe woli, ati bi o ti mọ̀ pe, Ọlọrun ti fi ibura ṣe ileri fun u pe, Ninu irú-ọmọ inu rẹ̀, on ó mu ọ̀kan ijoko lori itẹ́ rẹ̀;
entries.en: Therefore being a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him, that of the fruit of his loins, according to the flesh, he would raise up Christ to sit on his throne;

entries.yo: O ri eyi tẹlẹ̀, o sọ ti ajinde Kristi pe, a kò fi ọkàn rẹ̀ silẹ ni ipò-okù, bẹ̃li ara rẹ̀ kò ri idibajẹ.
entries.en: He seeing this before spake of the resurrection of Christ, that his soul was not left in hell, neither his flesh did see corruption.

entries.yo: Jesu na yi li Ọlọrun ti ji dide, ẹlẹri eyiti gbogbo wa iṣe.
entries.en: This Jesus hath God raised up, whereof we all are witnesses.

entries.yo: Nitorina bi a ti fi ọwọ́ ọtún Ọlọrun gbe e ga, ti o si ti gbà ileri Ẹmí Mimọ́ lati ọdọ Baba, o tú eyi silẹ, ti ẹnyin ri, ti ẹ si gbọ́.
entries.en: Therefore being by the right hand of God exalted, and having received of the Father the promise of the Holy Ghost, he hath shed forth this, which ye now see and hear.

entries.yo: Dafidi kò sá gòke lọ si ọrun: ṣugbọn on tikararẹ̀ wipe, OLUWA wi fun Oluwa mi pe, Joko li ọwọ́ ọtún mi,
entries.en: For David is not ascended into the heavens: but he saith himself, The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand,

entries.yo: Titi emi o fi sọ awọn ọtá rẹ di apotì itisẹ rẹ.
entries.en: Until I make thy foes thy footstool.

entries.yo: Njẹ ki gbogbo ile Israeli ki o mọ̀ dajudaju pe, Ọlọrun ti fi Jesu na, ti ẹnyin kàn mọ agbelebu, jẹ Oluwa ati Kristi.
entries.en: Therefore let all the house of Israel know assuredly, that God hath made that same Jesus, whom ye have crucified, both Lord and Christ.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si gbọ́, ọkàn wọn gbọgbẹ, nwọn si sọ fun Peteru ati awọn aposteli iyokù pe, Ará, kini ki awa ki o ṣe?
entries.en: Now when they heard this, they were pricked in their heart, and said unto Peter and to the rest of the apostles, Men and brethren, what shall we do?

entries.yo: Peteru si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ ronupiwada, ki a si baptisi olukuluku nyin li orukọ Jesu Kristi fun idariji ẹ̀ṣẹ nyin, ẹnyin o si gbà ẹbun Ẹmi Mimọ́.
entries.en: Then Peter said unto them, Repent, and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins, and ye shall receive the gift of the Holy Ghost.

entries.yo: Nitori fun nyin ni ileri na, ati fun awọn ọmọ nyin, ati fun gbogbo awọn ti o jìna rére, ani gbogbo awọn ti Oluwa Ọlọrun wa ó pè.
entries.en: For the promise is unto you, and to your children, and to all that are afar off, even as many as the Lord our God shall call.

entries.yo: Ati ọ̀rọ pupọ miran li o fi njẹri ti o si nfi ngbà wọn niyanju wipe, Ẹ gbà ara nyin là lọwọ iran arekereke yi.
entries.en: And with many other words did he testify and exhort, saying, Save yourselves from this untoward generation.

entries.yo: Nitorina awọn ti o si fi ayọ̀ gbà ọ̀rọ rẹ̀ a baptisi wọn: li ọjọ na a si kà ìwọn ẹgbẹdogun ọkàn kún wọn.
entries.en: Then they that gladly received his word were baptized: and the same day there were added unto them about three thousand souls.

entries.yo: Nwọn si duro ṣinṣin ninu ẹkọ́ awọn aposteli, ati ni idapọ, ni bibu akara ati ninu adura.
entries.en: And they continued stedfastly in the apostles' doctrine and fellowship, and in breaking of bread, and in prayers.

entries.yo: Ẹ̀rù si ba gbogbo ọkàn: iṣẹ iyanu ati iṣẹ àmi pipọ li a ti ọwọ́ awọn aposteli ṣe.
entries.en: And fear came upon every soul: and many wonders and signs were done by the apostles.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn ti o si gbagbọ́ wà ni ibikan, nwọn ni ohun gbogbo ṣọkan;
entries.en: And all that believed were together, and had all things common;

entries.yo: Nwọn si ntà ohun ini ati ẹrù wọn, nwọn si npín wọn fun olukuluku, gẹgẹ bi ẹnikẹni ti ṣe alaini.
entries.en: And sold their possessions and goods, and parted them to all men, as every man had need.

entries.yo: Nwọn si nfi ọkàn kan duro li ojojumọ́ ninu tẹmpili ati ni bibu akara ni ile, nwọn nfi inu didùn ati ọkàn kan jẹ onjẹ wọn.
entries.en: And they, continuing daily with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread from house to house, did eat their meat with gladness and singleness of heart,

entries.yo: Nwọn nyin Ọlọrun, nwọn si ni ojurere lọdọ enia gbogbo. Oluwa si nyàn kún wọn li ojojumọ awọn ti a ngbalà.
entries.en: Praising God, and having favour with all the people. And the Lord added to the church daily such as should be saved.

entries.yo: NJẸ Peteru on Johanu jumọ ngòke lọ si tẹmpili ni wakati adura, ti iṣe wakati kẹsan ọjọ.
entries.en: Now Peter and John went up together into the temple at the hour of prayer, being the ninth hour.

entries.yo: Nwọn si gbé ọkunrin kan ti o yarọ lati inu iya rẹ̀ wá, ti nwọn ima gbé kalẹ li ojojumọ́ li ẹnu-ọna tẹmpili ti a npè ni Daradara, lati mã ṣagbe lọwọ awọn ti nwọ̀ inu tẹmpili lọ;
entries.en: And a certain man lame from his mother's womb was carried, whom they laid daily at the gate of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask alms of them that entered into the temple;

entries.yo: Nigbati o ri Peteru on Johanu bi nwọn ti fẹ wọ̀ inu tẹmpili, o ṣagbe.
entries.en: Who seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple asked an alms.

entries.yo: Peteru si tẹjumọ́ ọ, pẹlu Johanu, o ni, Wò wa.
entries.en: And Peter, fastening his eyes upon him with John, said, Look on us.

entries.yo: O si fiyesi wọn, o nreti ati ri nkan gbà lọwọ wọn.
entries.en: And he gave heed unto them, expecting to receive something of them.

entries.yo: Peteru wipe, Fadakà ati wura emi kò ni; ṣugbọn ohun ti mo ni eyini ni mo fifun ọ: Li orukọ Jesu Kristi ti Nasareti, dide ki o si mã rin.
entries.en: Then Peter said, Silver and gold have I none; but such as I have give I thee: In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth rise up and walk.

entries.yo: O si fà a li ọwọ́ ọtún, o si gbé e dide: li ojukanna ẹsẹ rẹ̀ ati egungun kokosẹ rẹ̀ si mokun.
entries.en: And he took him by the right hand, and lifted him up: and immediately his feet and ancle bones received strength.

entries.yo: O si nfò soke, o duro, o si bẹrẹ si rin, o si ba wọn wọ̀ inu tẹmpili lọ, o nrìn, o si nfò, o si nyìn Ọlọrun.
entries.en: And he leaping up stood, and walked, and entered with them into the temple, walking, and leaping, and praising God.

entries.yo: Gbogbo enia si ri i, o nrìn, o si nyìn Ọlọrun:
entries.en: And all the people saw him walking and praising God:

entries.yo: Nwọn si mọ̀ pe on li o ti joko nṣagbe li ẹnu-ọ̀nà Daradara ti tẹmpili: hà si ṣe wọn, ẹnu si yà wọn gidigidi si ohun ti o ṣe lara rẹ̀.
entries.en: And they knew that it was he which sat for alms at the Beautiful gate of the temple: and they were filled with wonder and amazement at that which had happened unto him.

entries.yo: Bi arọ ti a mu larada si ti di Peteru on Johanu mu, gbogbo enia jumọ sure jọ tọ̀ wọn lọ ni iloro ti a npè ni ti Solomoni, ẹnu yà wọn gidigidi.
entries.en: And as the lame man which was healed held Peter and John, all the people ran together unto them in the porch that is called Solomon's, greatly wondering.

entries.yo: Nigbati Peteru si ri i, o dahùn wi fun awọn enia pe, Ẹnyin enia Israeli, ẽṣe ti ha fi nṣe nyin si eyi? tabi ẽṣe ti ẹnyin fi tẹjumọ́ wa, bi ẹnipe agbara tabi iwa-mimọ́ wa li awa fi ṣe ti ọkunrin yi fi nrin?
entries.en: And when Peter saw it, he answered unto the people, Ye men of Israel, why marvel ye at this? or why look ye so earnestly on us, as though by our own power or holiness we had made this man to walk?

entries.yo: Ọlọrun Abrahamu, ati ti Isaaki, ati ti Jakọbu, Ọlọrun awọn baba wa, on li o ti yìn Jesu Ọmọ rẹ̀ logo; ẹniti ẹnyin ti fi le wọn lọwọ, ti ẹnyin si sẹ́ niwaju Pilatu, nigbati o ti pinnu rẹ̀ lati da a silẹ.
entries.en: The God of Abraham, and of Isaac, and of Jacob, the God of our fathers, hath glorified his Son Jesus; whom ye delivered up, and denied him in the presence of Pilate, when he was determined to let him go.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹnyin sẹ́ Ẹni-Mimọ́ ati Olõtọ nì, ẹnyin si bere ki a fi apania fun nyin;
entries.en: But ye denied the Holy One and the Just, and desired a murderer to be granted unto you;

entries.yo: Ẹnyin si pa Olupilẹṣẹ ìye, ẹniti Ọlọrun si ti ji dide kuro ninu okú; ẹlẹri eyiti awa nṣe.
entries.en: And killed the Prince of life, whom God hath raised from the dead; whereof we are witnesses.

entries.yo: Ati orukọ rẹ̀, nipa igbagbọ́ ninu orukọ rẹ̀, on li o mu ọkunrin yi lara le, ẹniti ẹnyin ri ti ẹ si mọ̀: ati igbagbọ́ nipa rẹ̀ li o fun u ni dida ara ṣáṣa yi li oju gbogbo nyin.
entries.en: And his name through faith in his name hath made this man strong, whom ye see and know: yea, the faith which is by him hath given him this perfect soundness in the presence of you all.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, ará, mo mọ̀ pe, nipa aimọ̀ li ẹnyin fi ṣe e, gẹgẹ bi awọn olori nyin pẹlu ti ṣe.
entries.en: And now, brethren, I wot that through ignorance ye did it, as did also your rulers.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ohun ti Ọlọrun ti sọ tẹlẹ lati ẹnu gbogbo awọn woli wá pe, Kristi rẹ̀ yio jìya, on li o muṣẹ bẹ̃.
entries.en: But those things, which God before had shewed by the mouth of all his prophets, that Christ should suffer, he hath so fulfilled.

entries.yo: Nitorina ẹ ronupiwada, ki ẹ si tun yipada, ki a le pa ẹ̀ṣẹ nyin rẹ́, ki akoko itura ba le ti iwaju Oluwa wá,
entries.en: Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;

entries.yo: Ati ki o ba le rán Kristi, ti a ti yàn fun nyin, aní Jesu;
entries.en: And he shall send Jesus Christ, which before was preached unto you:

entries.yo: Ẹniti ọrun kò le ṣaima gbà titi di igba imupadà ohun gbogbo, ti Ọlọrun ti sọ lati ẹnu awọn woli rẹ̀ mimọ́ ti nwọn ti mbẹ nigbati aiye ti ṣẹ̀.
entries.en: Whom the heaven must receive until the times of restitution of all things, which God hath spoken by the mouth of all his holy prophets since the world began.

entries.yo: Mose sa wipe, Oluwa Ọlọrun nyin yio gbé woli kan dide fun nyin ninu awọn arakunrin nyin, bi emi; on ni ẹnyin o ma gbọ́ tirẹ̀ li ohun gbogbo ti yio ma sọ fun nyin.
entries.en: For Moses truly said unto the fathers, A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall ye hear in all things whatsoever he shall say unto you.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, olukuluku ọkàn ti kò ba gbọ ti woli na, on li a o parun patapata kuro ninu awọn enia.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass, that every soul, which will not hear that prophet, shall be destroyed from among the people.

entries.yo: Ani gbogbo awọn woli lati Samueli wá, ati awọn ti o tẹle e, iye awọn ti o ti sọrọ, nwọn sọ ti ọjọ wọnyi pẹlu.
entries.en: Yea, and all the prophets from Samuel and those that follow after, as many as have spoken, have likewise foretold of these days.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin li ọmọ awọn woli, ati ti majẹmu tí Ọlọrun ti ba awọn baba nyin dá nigbati o wi fun Abrahamu pe, Ati ninu irú-ọmọ rẹ li a ti fi ibukun fun gbogbo idile aiye.
entries.en: Ye are the children of the prophets, and of the covenant which God made with our fathers, saying unto Abraham, And in thy seed shall all the kindreds of the earth be blessed.

entries.yo: Nigbati Ọlọrun jí Jesu Ọmọ rẹ̀ dide, o kọ́ rán a si nyin lati busi i fun nyin, nipa yiyi olukuluku nyin pada kuro ninu iwa buburu rẹ̀.
entries.en: Unto you first God, having raised up his Son Jesus, sent him to bless you, in turning away every one of you from his iniquities.

entries.yo: BI nwọn si ti mba awọn enia sọrọ, awọn alufa ati olori ẹṣọ́ tẹmpili ati awọn Sadusi dide si wọn.
entries.en: And as they spake unto the people, the priests, and the captain of the temple, and the Sadducees, came upon them,

entries.yo: Inu bi wọn, nitoriti nwọn nkọ́ awọn enia, nwọn si nwasu ajinde kuro ninu okú ninu Jesu.
entries.en: Being grieved that they taught the people, and preached through Jesus the resurrection from the dead.

entries.yo: Nwọn si nawọ́ mu wọn, nwọn si há wọn mọ́ ile tubu titi o fi di ijọ keji: nitoriti alẹ lẹ tan.
entries.en: And they laid hands on them, and put them in hold unto the next day: for it was now eventide.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ọ̀pọ awọn ti o gbọ́ ọ̀rọ na gbagbọ́; iye awọn ọkunrin na si to ẹgbẹ̃dọgbọn.
entries.en: Howbeit many of them which heard the word believed; and the number of the men was about five thousand.

entries.yo: O si ṣe nijọ keji, awọn olori wọn ati awọn alagba ati awọn akọwe, pejọ si Jerusalemu,
entries.en: And it came to pass on the morrow, that their rulers, and elders, and scribes,

entries.yo: Ati Anna olori alufa, ati Kaiafa, ati Johanu, ati Aleksanderu, ati iye awọn ti iṣe ibatan olori alufa.
entries.en: And Annas the high priest, and Caiaphas, and John, and Alexander, and as many as were of the kindred of the high priest, were gathered together at Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si mu wọn duro li ãrin, nwọn bère pe, Agbara tabi orukọ wo li ẹnyin fi ṣe eyi?
entries.en: And when they had set them in the midst, they asked, By what power, or by what name, have ye done this?

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Peteru kún fun Ẹmí Mimọ́, o si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹnyin olori awọn enia, ati ẹnyin àgbagbà.
entries.en: Then Peter, filled with the Holy Ghost, said unto them, Ye rulers of the people, and elders of Israel,

entries.yo: Bi o ba ṣe pe a nwadi wa loni niti iṣẹ rere ti a ṣe lara abirùn na, bi a ti ṣe mu ọkunrin yi laradá;
entries.en: If we this day be examined of the good deed done to the impotent man, by what means he is made whole;

entries.yo: Ki eyi ki o yé gbogbo nyin ati gbogbo enia Israeli pe, li orukọ Jesu Kristi ti Nasareti, ti ẹnyin kàn mọ agbelebu, ti Ọlọrun gbé dide kuro ninu okú, nipa rẹ̀ li ọkunrin yi fi duro niwaju nyin ni dida ara ṣaṣa.
entries.en: Be it known unto you all, and to all the people of Israel, that by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom ye crucified, whom God raised from the dead, even by him doth this man stand here before you whole.

entries.yo: Eyi li okuta ti a ti ọwọ́ ẹnyin ọmọle kọ̀ silẹ, ti o si di pàtaki igun ile.
entries.en: This is the stone which was set at nought of you builders, which is become the head of the corner.

entries.yo: Kò si si igbala lọdọ ẹlomiran: nitori kò si orukọ miran labẹ ọrun ti a fifunni ninu enia, nipa eyiti a le fi gbà wa là.
entries.en: Neither is there salvation in any other: for there is none other name under heaven given among men, whereby we must be saved.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si kiyesi igboiya Peteru on Johanu, ti nwọn si mọ̀ pe, alaikẹkọ ati òpe enia ni nwọn, ẹnu yà wọn; nwọn si woye wọn pe, nwọn a ti ma ba Jesu gbé.
entries.en: Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and perceived that they were unlearned and ignorant men, they marvelled; and they took knowledge of them, that they had been with Jesus.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si nwò ọkunrin na ti a mu larada, ti o ba wọn duro, nwọn kò ri nkan wi si i.
entries.en: And beholding the man which was healed standing with them, they could say nothing against it.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati nwọn si paṣẹ pe ki nwọn jade kuro ni igbimọ, nwọn ba ara wọn gbèro,
entries.en: But when they had commanded them to go aside out of the council, they conferred among themselves,

entries.yo: Wipe, Kili a o ti ṣe awọn ọkunrin wọnyi? ti pe iṣẹ àmi ti o daju ti ọwọ́ wọn ṣe, o hàn gbangba fun gbogbo awọn ti ngbé Jerusalemu; awa kò si le sẹ́ ẹ.
entries.en: Saying, What shall we do to these men? for that indeed a notable miracle hath been done by them is manifest to all them that dwell in Jerusalem; and we cannot deny it.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ki o má bà tàn kalẹ siwaju mọ́ lãrin awọn enia, ẹ jẹ ki a kìlọ fun wọn pe, lati isisiyi lọ ki nwọn ki o máṣe fi orukọ yi sọ̀rọ fun ẹnikẹni mọ́.
entries.en: But that it spread no further among the people, let us straitly threaten them, that they speak henceforth to no man in this name.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si pè wọn, nwọn paṣẹ fun wọn, ki nwọn máṣe sọ̀rọ rara, bẹni ki nwọn máṣe kọ́ni li orukọ Jesu mọ́.
entries.en: And they called them, and commanded them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Peteru on Johanu dahùn, nwọn si wi fun wọn pe, Bi o ba tọ́ li oju Ọlọrun lati gbọ́ ti nyin jù ti Ọlọrun lọ, ẹ gbà a rò,
entries.en: But Peter and John answered and said unto them, Whether it be right in the sight of God to hearken unto you more than unto God, judge ye.

entries.yo: Awa kò sá le ṣaima sọ ohun ti awa ti ri, ti a si ti gbọ́.
entries.en: For we cannot but speak the things which we have seen and heard.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si kìlọ fun wọn si i, nwọn jọwọ wọn lọwọ lọ, nigbati nwọn kò ti ri nkan ti nwọn iba fi jẹ wọn ni ìya, nitori awọn enia: nitori gbogbo wọn ni nyìn Ọlọrun logo fun ohun ti a ṣe.
entries.en: So when they had further threatened them, they let them go, finding nothing how they might punish them, because of the people: for all men glorified God for that which was done.

entries.yo: Nitori ọkunrin na jù ẹni-ogoji ọdún lọ, lara ẹniti a ṣe iṣẹ àmi dida ara yi.
entries.en: For the man was above forty years old, on whom this miracle of healing was shewed.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si jọwọ wọn lọwọ lọ, nwọn lọ sọdọ awọn ẹgbẹ wọn, nwọn si ròhin ohun gbogbo ti awọn olori alufa ati awọn agbàgba sọ fun wọn.
entries.en: And being let go, they went to their own company, and reported all that the chief priests and elders had said unto them.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si gbọ́, nwọn fi ọkàn kan gbé ohùn wọn soke si Ọlọrun nwọn si wipe, Oluwa, ìwọ ti o da ọrun on aiye, ati okun, ati ohun gbogbo ti mbẹ ninu wọn:
entries.en: And when they heard that, they lifted up their voice to God with one accord, and said, Lord, thou art God, which hast made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and all that in them is:

entries.yo: Iwọ nipa Ẹmi Mimọ́ ti o ti ẹnu Dafidi baba wa iranṣẹ rẹ wipe, Ẽṣe ti awọn keferi fi mbinu, ati ti awọn enia ngbero ohun asan?
entries.en: Who by the mouth of thy servant David hast said, Why did the heathen rage, and the people imagine vain things?

entries.yo: Awọn ọba aiye dide, ati awọn ijoye kó ara wọn jọ si Oluwa, ati si Kristi rẹ̀;
entries.en: The kings of the earth stood up, and the rulers were gathered together against the Lord, and against his Christ.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ sá ni, si Jesu Ọmọ mimọ́ rẹ, ẹniti iwọ ti fi oróro yàn, ati Herodu, ati Pontiu Pilatu, pẹlu awọn keferi, ati awọn enia Israeli pejọ si,
entries.en: For of a truth against thy holy child Jesus, whom thou hast anointed, both Herod, and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles, and the people of Israel, were gathered together,

entries.yo: Lati ṣe ohunkohun ti ọwọ́ rẹ ati imọ rẹ ti pinnu ṣaju pe yio ṣẹ.
entries.en: For to do whatsoever thy hand and thy counsel determined before to be done.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, Oluwa, kiyesi ikilọ wọn: ki o si fifun awọn ọmọ-ọdọ rẹ lati mã fi igboiya gbogbo sọ ọ̀rọ rẹ.
entries.en: And now, Lord, behold their threatenings: and grant unto thy servants, that with all boldness they may speak thy word,

entries.yo: Ki iwọ si fi ninà ọwọ́ rẹ ṣe dida ara, ati ki iṣẹ àmi ati iṣẹ iyanu ki o mã ṣe li orukọ Jesu Ọmọ mimọ́ rẹ.
entries.en: By stretching forth thine hand to heal; and that signs and wonders may be done by the name of thy holy child Jesus.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn gbadura tan, ibi ti nwọn gbé pejọ si mi titi; gbogbo wọn si kún fun Ẹmí Mimọ́, nwọn si nfi igboiya sọ ọ̀rọ Ọlọrun.
entries.en: And when they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were assembled together; and they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and they spake the word of God with boldness.

entries.yo: Ijọ awọn ti o gbagbọ́ si wà li ọkàn kan ati inu kan: kò si si ẹnikan ti o pè ohun kan ninu ohun ini rẹ̀ ni ti ara rẹ̀: ṣugbọn gbogbo nwọn ni gbogbo nkan ṣọkan.
entries.en: And the multitude of them that believed were of one heart and of one soul: neither said any of them that ought of the things which he possessed was his own; but they had all things common.

entries.yo: Agbara nla li awọn aposteli si fi njẹri ajinde Jesu Oluwa; ore-ọfẹ pipọ si wà lori gbogbo wọn.
entries.en: And with great power gave the apostles witness of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus: and great grace was upon them all.

entries.yo: Nitori kò si ẹnikan ninu wọn ti o ṣe alaini: nitori iye awọn ti o ni ilẹ tabi ile tà wọn, nwọn si mu owo ohun ti nwọn tà wá.
entries.en: Neither was there any among them that lacked: for as many as were possessors of lands or houses sold them, and brought the prices of the things that were sold,

entries.yo: Nwọn si fi i lelẹ li ẹsẹ awọn aposteli: nwọn si npín fun olukuluku, gẹgẹ bi o ti ṣe alaini si.
entries.en: And laid them down at the apostles' feet: and distribution was made unto every man according as he had need.

entries.yo: Ati Josefu, ti a ti ọwọ awọn aposteli sọ apele rẹ̀ ni Barnaba (itumọ̀ eyi ti ijẹ Ọmọ-Itùnu), ẹ̀ya Lefi, ati ara Kipru.
entries.en: And Joses, who by the apostles was surnamed Barnabas, (which is, being interpreted, The son of consolation,) a Levite, and of the country of Cyprus,

entries.yo: O ni ilẹ kan, o tà a, o mu owo rẹ̀ wá, o si fi i lelẹ li ẹsẹ awọn aposteli.
entries.en: Having land, sold it, and brought the money, and laid it at the apostles' feet.

entries.yo: ṢUGBỌN ọkunrin kan ti a npè ni Anania, pẹlu Safira aya rẹ̀, tà ilẹ iní kan.
entries.en: But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira his wife, sold a possession,

entries.yo: O si yàn apakan pamọ́ ninu owo na, aya rẹ̀ ba a mọ̀ ọ pọ̀, o si mu apakan rẹ̀ wá, o si fi i lelẹ li ẹsẹ awọn aposteli.
entries.en: And kept back part of the price, his wife also being privy to it, and brought a certain part, and laid it at the apostles' feet.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Peteru wipe, Anania, Ẽṣe ti Satani fi kún ọ li ọkàn lati ṣeke si Ẹmí Mimọ́, ti iwọ si fi yàn apakan pamọ́ ninu owo ilẹ na?
entries.en: But Peter said, Ananias, why hath Satan filled thine heart to lie to the Holy Ghost, and to keep back part of the price of the land?

entries.yo: Nigbati o wà nibẹ, tirẹ ki iṣe? nigbati a si ta a tan, kò ha wà ni ikawọ ara rẹ? Ẽha ti ṣe ti iwọ fi rò kini yi li ọkàn rẹ? enia ki iwọ ṣeke si bikoṣe si Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Whiles it remained, was it not thine own? and after it was sold, was it not in thine own power? why hast thou conceived this thing in thine heart? thou hast not lied unto men, but unto God.

entries.yo: Nigbati Anania si gbọ́ ọ̀rọ wọnyi, o ṣubu lulẹ, o si kú: ẹ̀ru nla si ba gbogbo awọn ti o gbọ́.
entries.en: And Ananias hearing these words fell down, and gave up the ghost: and great fear came on all them that heard these things.

entries.yo: Awọn ọdọmọkunrin si dide, nwọn dì i, nwọn si gbé e jade, nwọn si sin i.
entries.en: And the young men arose, wound him up, and carried him out, and buried him.

entries.yo: O si to bi ìwọn wakati mẹta, aya rẹ̀ laimọ̀ ohun ti o ti ṣe, o wọle.
entries.en: And it was about the space of three hours after, when his wife, not knowing what was done, came in.

entries.yo: Peteru si da a lohùn pe, Wi fun mi, bi iye bayi li ẹnyin tà ilẹ na? O si wipe, Lõtọ iye bẹ̃ ni.
entries.en: And Peter answered unto her, Tell me whether ye sold the land for so much? And she said, Yea, for so much.

entries.yo: Peteru si wi fun u pe, Ẽṣe ti ẹnyin fohùn ṣọkan lati dán Ẹmí Oluwa wò? wò o, ẹsẹ awọn ti o sinkú ọkọ rẹ mbẹ li ẹnu ọ̀na, nwọn o si gbé ọ jade.
entries.en: Then Peter said unto her, How is it that ye have agreed together to tempt the Spirit of the Lord? behold, the feet of them which have buried thy husband are at the door, and shall carry thee out.

entries.yo: O si ṣubu lulẹ li ẹsẹ rẹ̀ lojukanna, o si kú: awọn ọdọmọkunrin si wọle, nwọn bá a o kú, nwọn si gbé e jade, nwọn sin i lẹba ọkọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Then fell she down straightway at his feet, and yielded up the ghost: and the young men came in, and found her dead, and, carrying her forth, buried her by her husband.

entries.yo: Ẹru nla si ba gbogbo ijọ, ati gbogbo awọn ti o gbọ́ nkan wọnyi.
entries.en: And great fear came upon all the church, and upon as many as heard these things.

entries.yo: A si ti ọwọ́ awọn aposteli ṣe iṣẹ àmi ati iṣẹ iyanu pipọ lãrin awọn enia: gbogbo wọn si fi ọkàn kan wà ni iloro Solomoni.
entries.en: And by the hands of the apostles were many signs and wonders wrought among the people; (and they were all with one accord in Solomon's porch.

entries.yo: Ninu awọn iyokù ẹnikan kò daṣà ati dapọ mọ wọn: ṣugbọn enia nkókiki wọn.
entries.en: And of the rest durst no man join himself to them: but the people magnified them.

entries.yo: A si nyàn awọn ti o gbà Oluwa gbọ kun wọn si i, ati ọkunrin ati obinrin;
entries.en: And believers were the more added to the Lord, multitudes both of men and women.)

entries.yo: Tobẹ̃ ti nwọn ngbé awọn abirùn jade si igboro, ti nwọn ntẹ́ wọn si ori akete ati ohun ibĩrọgbọku, pe bi Peteru ba nkọja ki ojiji rẹ̀ tilẹ le ṣijibò omiran ninu wọn.
entries.en: Insomuch that they brought forth the sick into the streets, and laid them on beds and couches, that at the least the shadow of Peter passing by might overshadow some of them.

entries.yo: Ọ̀pọ enia si ko ara wọn jọ lati awọn ilu ti o yi Jerusalemu ka, nwọn nmu awọn abirùn wá, ati awọn ti ara kan fun ẹmi aimọ́: a si ṣe dida ara olukuluku wọn.
entries.en: There came also a multitude out of the cities round about unto Jerusalem, bringing sick folks, and them which were vexed with unclean spirits: and they were healed every one.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn olori alufa dide, ti on ti gbogbo awọn ti nwọn wà lọdọ rẹ̀ (ti iṣe ẹya ti awọn Sadusi), nwọn si kún fun owu.
entries.en: Then the high priest rose up, and all they that were with him, (which is the sect of the Sadducees,) and were filled with indignation,

entries.yo: Nwọn si nawọ́ mu awọn aposteli, nwọn si fi wọn sinu tubu.
entries.en: And laid their hands on the apostles, and put them in the common prison.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn angẹli Oluwa ṣí ilẹkun tubu li oru; nigbati o si mu wọn jade, o wipe,
entries.en: But the angel of the Lord by night opened the prison doors, and brought them forth, and said,

entries.yo: Ẹ lọ, ẹ duro, ki ẹ si mã sọ gbogbo ọ̀rọ iye yi fun awọn enia ni tẹmpili.
entries.en: Go, stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words of this life.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si gbọ́ yi, nwọn wọ̀ tẹmpili lọ ni kutukutu, nwọn si nkọ́ni. Ṣugbọn olori alufa de, ati awọn ti mbẹ lọdọ rẹ̀, nwọn si pè apejọ igbimọ, ati gbogbo awọn agbàgba awọn ọmọ Israeli, nwọn si ranṣẹ si ile tubu lati mu wọn wá.
entries.en: And when they heard that, they entered into the temple early in the morning, and taught. But the high priest came, and they that were with him, and called the council together, and all the senate of the children of Israel and sent to the prison to have them brought.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati awọn onṣẹ de ibẹ̀, nwọn kò si ri wọn ninu tubu, nwọn pada wá, nwọn si sọ pe,
entries.en: But when the officers came, and found them not in the prison, they returned, and told,

entries.yo: Awa bá ile tubu o sé pinpin, ati awọn oluṣọ duro lode niwaju ilẹkun: ṣugbọn nigbati awa ṣílẹkun, awa kò bá ẹnikan ninu tubu.
entries.en: Saying, The prison truly found we shut with all safety, and the keepers standing without before the doors: but when we had opened, we found no man within.

entries.yo: Nigbati olori ẹṣọ́ tẹmpili ati awọn olori alufa si gbọ́ ọ̀rọ wọnyi, nwọn dãmu nitori wọn pe, nibo li eyi ó yọri si.
entries.en: Now when the high priest and the captain of the temple and the chief priests heard these things, they doubted of them whereunto this would grow.

entries.yo: Nigbana li ẹnikan de, o wi fun wọn pe, Wo o, awọn ọkunrin ti ẹnyin fi sinu tubu wà ni tẹmpili, nwọn duro nwọn si nkọ́ awọn enia.
entries.en: Then came one and told them, saying, Behold, the men whom ye put in prison are standing in the temple, and teaching the people.

entries.yo: Nigbana li olori ẹṣọ́ lọ pẹlu awọn onṣẹ, o si mu wọn wá kì iṣe pẹlu ipa: nitoriti nwọn bẹ̀ru awọn enia, ki a má ba sọ wọn li okuta.
entries.en: Then went the captain with the officers, and brought them without violence: for they feared the people, lest they should have been stoned.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si mu wọn de, nwọn mu wọn duro niwaju ajọ igbimọ; olori alufa si bi wọn lẽre,
entries.en: And when they had brought them, they set them before the council: and the high priest asked them,

entries.yo: Wipe, Awa kò ti kìlọ fun nyin gidigidi pe, ki ẹ maṣe fi orukọ yi kọ́ni mọ́? si wo o, ẹnyin ti fi ẹkọ́ nyin kún Jerusalemu, ẹ si npete ati mu ẹ̀jẹ ọkunrin yi wá si ori wa.
entries.en: Saying, Did not we straitly command you that ye should not teach in this name? and, behold, ye have filled Jerusalem with your doctrine, and intend to bring this man's blood upon us.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Peteru ati awọn aposteli dahùn, nwọn si wipe, Awa kò gbọdọ má gbọ́ ti Ọlọrun jù ti enia lọ.
entries.en: Then Peter and the other apostles answered and said, We ought to obey God rather than men.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun awọn baba wa ji Jesu dide, ẹniti ẹnyin pa, tí ẹnyin si gbe kọ́ sori igi.
entries.en: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom ye slew and hanged on a tree.

entries.yo: On li Ọlọrun fi ọwọ́ ọtún rẹ̀ gbéga lati jẹ Ọmọ alade ati Olugbala, lati fi ironupiwada fun Israeli, ati idariji ẹ̀ṣẹ.
entries.en: Him hath God exalted with his right hand to be a Prince and a Saviour, for to give repentance to Israel, and forgiveness of sins.

entries.yo: Awa si li ẹlẹri nkan wọnyi; ati Ẹmí Mimọ́ pẹlu, ti Ọlọrun fifun awọn ti o gbọ́ tirẹ̀.
entries.en: And we are his witnesses of these things; and so is also the Holy Ghost, whom God hath given to them that obey him.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati nwọn gbọ́ eyi, àiya wọn gbà ọgbẹ́ de inu, nwọn gbèro ati pa wọn.
entries.en: When they heard that, they were cut to the heart, and took counsel to slay them.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ọkan ninu ajọ igbimọ, ti a npè ni Gamalieli, Farisi ati amofin, ti o ni iyìn gidigidi lọdọ gbogbo enia, o dide duro, o ni ki a mu awọn aposteli bì sẹhin diẹ;
entries.en: Then stood there up one in the council, a Pharisee, named Gamaliel, a doctor of the law, had in reputation among all the people, and commanded to put the apostles forth a little space;

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹnyin ọkunrin Israeli, ẹ kiyesi ara nyin li ohun ti ẹnyin npete ati ṣe si awọn ọkunrin wọnyi.
entries.en: And said unto them, Ye men of Israel, take heed to yourselves what ye intend to do as touching these men.

entries.yo: Nitori ṣaju ọjọ wọnyi ni Teuda dide, o nwipe ẹni nla kan li on; ẹniti ìwọn irinwo ọkunrin gbatì: ẹniti a pa; ati gbogbo iye awọn ti o gbà tirẹ̀, a tú wọn ká, a si sọ wọn di asan.
entries.en: For before these days rose up Theudas, boasting himself to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves: who was slain; and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered, and brought to nought.

entries.yo: Lẹhin ọkunrin yi ni Juda ti Galili dide lakoko kikà enia, o si fà enia pipọ lẹhin rẹ̀: on pẹlu ṣegbé; ati gbogbo iye awọn ti o gbà tirẹ̀, a fọn wọn ká.
entries.en: After this man rose up Judas of Galilee in the days of the taxing, and drew away much people after him: he also perished; and all, even as many as obeyed him, were dispersed.

entries.yo: Njẹ emi wi fun nyin nisisiyi, Ẹ gafara fun awọn ọkunrin wọnyi, ki ẹ si jọwọ wọn jẹ: nitori bi ìmọ tabi iṣẹ yi ba jẹ ti enia, a o bì i ṣubu:
entries.en: And now I say unto you, Refrain from these men, and let them alone: for if this counsel or this work be of men, it will come to nought:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi ti Ọlọrun ba ni, ẹnyin kì yio le bì i ṣubu; ki o ma ba jẹ pe, a ri nyin ẹ mba Ọlọrun jà.
entries.en: But if it be of God, ye cannot overthrow it; lest haply ye be found even to fight against God.

entries.yo: Nwọn si tẹ̀ si tirẹ̀: nigbati nwọn si pè awọn aposteli wọle, nwọn lù wọn, nwọn si kìlọ fun wọn pe, ki nwọn ki o máṣe sọ̀rọ li orukọ Jesu mọ́, nwọn si jọwọ wọn lọwọ lọ.
entries.en: And to him they agreed: and when they had called the apostles, and beaten them, they commanded that they should not speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.

entries.yo: Nitorina nwọn si lọ kuro niwaju ajọ igbimọ: nwọn nyọ̀ nitori ti a kà wọn yẹ si ìya ijẹ nitori orukọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And they departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer shame for his name.

entries.yo: Ati li ojojumọ́ ni tẹmpili ati ni ile, nwọn kò dẹkun ikọ́ni, ati lati wasu Jesu Kristi.
entries.en: And daily in the temple, and in every house, they ceased not to teach and preach Jesus Christ.

entries.yo: NJẸ li ọjọ wọnni, nigbati iye awọn ọmọ-ẹhin npọ̀ si i, ikùn-sinu wà ninu awọn Hellene si awọn Heberu, nitoriti a nṣe igbagbé awọn opó wọn ni ipinfunni ojojumọ́.
entries.en: And in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplied, there arose a murmuring of the Grecians against the Hebrews, because their widows were neglected in the daily ministration.

entries.yo: Awọn mejila si pè ọpọlọpọ awọn ọmọ-ẹhin jọ̀ sọdọ, nwọn wipe, Kò yẹ ti awa iba fi ọ̀rọ Ọlọrun silẹ, ki a si mã ṣe iranṣẹ tabili.
entries.en: Then the twelve called the multitude of the disciples unto them, and said, It is not reason that we should leave the word of God, and serve tables.

entries.yo: Nitorina, ará, ẹ wo ọkunrin meje ninu nyin, olorukọ rere, ẹniti o kún fun Ẹmí Mimọ́ ati fun ọgbọ́n, ẹniti awa iba yàn si iṣẹ yi.
entries.en: Wherefore, brethren, look ye out among you seven men of honest report, full of the Holy Ghost and wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awa o duro ṣinṣin ninu adura igbà, ati ninu iṣẹ iranṣẹ ọ̀rọ na.
entries.en: But we will give ourselves continually to prayer, and to the ministry of the word.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ na si tọ́ loju gbogbo ijọ: nwọn si yàn Stefanu, ọkunrin ti o kún fun igbagbọ́ ati fun Ẹmí Mimọ́, ati Filippi ati Prokoru, ati Nikanoru, ati Timoni, ati Parmena, ati Nikola alawọṣe Ju ara Antioku:
entries.en: And the saying pleased the whole multitude: and they chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Ghost, and Philip, and Prochorus, and Nicanor, and Timon, and Parmenas, and Nicolas a proselyte of Antioch:

entries.yo: Ẹniti nwọn mu duro niwaju awọn aposteli: nigbati nwọn si gbadura, nwọn fi ọwọ́ le wọn.
entries.en: Whom they set before the apostles: and when they had prayed, they laid their hands on them.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ Ọlọrun si gbilẹ; iye awọn ọmọ-ẹhin si pọ̀ si i gidigidi ni Jerusalemu; ọ̀pọ ninu ẹgbẹ awọn alufa si fetisi ti igbagbọ́ na.
entries.en: And the word of God increased; and the number of the disciples multiplied in Jerusalem greatly; and a great company of the priests were obedient to the faith.

entries.yo: Ati Stefanu, ti o kún fun ore-ọfẹ ati agbara, o ṣe iṣẹ iyanu, ati iṣẹ ami nla lãrin awọn enia.
entries.en: And Stephen, full of faith and power, did great wonders and miracles among the people.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn kan dide ninu awọn ti sinagogu, ti a npè ni ti awọn Libertine, ati ti ara Kirene, ati ti ara Aleksandria, ati ninu awọn ara Kilikia, ati ti Asia nwọn mba Stefanu jiyàn.
entries.en: Then there arose certain of the synagogue, which is called the synagogue of the Libertines, and Cyrenians, and Alexandrians, and of them of Cilicia and of Asia, disputing with Stephen.

entries.yo: Nwọn kò si le kò ọgbọ́n ati ẹmí ti o fi nsọrọ loju.
entries.en: And they were not able to resist the wisdom and the spirit by which he spake.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni nwọn bẹ̀ abẹtẹlẹ awọn ọkunrin, ti nwọn nwipe, Awa gbọ́ ọkunrin yi nsọ ọrọ-odi si Mose ati si Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Then they suborned men, which said, We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses, and against God.

entries.yo: Nwọn si rú awọn enia soke, ati awọn àgbagba, ati awọn akọwe, nwọn dide si i, nwọn gbá a mu, nwọn mu u wá si ajọ igbimọ.
entries.en: And they stirred up the people, and the elders, and the scribes, and came upon him, and caught him, and brought him to the council,

entries.yo: Nwọn si mu awọn ẹlẹri eke wá, ti nwọn wipe, ọkunrin yi kò simi lati sọ ọ̀rọ-òdi si ibi mimọ́ yi, ati si ofin:
entries.en: And set up false witnesses, which said, This man ceaseth not to speak blasphemous words against this holy place, and the law:

entries.yo: Nitori awa gbọ́ o wipe, Jesu ti Nasareti yi yio fọ́ ibi yi, yio si pa iṣe ti Mose fifun wa dà.
entries.en: For we have heard him say, that this Jesus of Nazareth shall destroy this place, and shall change the customs which Moses delivered us.

entries.yo: Ati gbogbo awọn ti o si joko ni ajọ igbimọ tẹjumọ́ ọ, nwọn nwò oju rẹ̀ bi ẹnipe oju angẹli.
entries.en: And all that sat in the council, looking stedfastly on him, saw his face as it had been the face of an angel.

entries.yo: NIGBANA li olori alufa wipe, Nkan wọnyi ha ri bẹ̃ bi?
entries.en: Then said the high priest, Are these things so?

entries.yo: On si wipe, Alàgba, ará, ati baba, ẹ fetisilẹ̀; Ọlọrun ogo fi ara hàn fun Abrahamu baba wa, nigbati o wà ni Mesopotamia, ki o to ṣe atipo ni Harani,
entries.en: And he said, Men, brethren, and fathers, hearken; The God of glory appeared unto our father Abraham, when he was in Mesopotamia, before he dwelt in Charran,

entries.yo: O si wi fun u pe, Jade kuro ni ilẹ rẹ, ati lọdọ awọn ibatan rẹ, ki o si wá si ilẹ ti emi ó fi hàn ọ.
entries.en: And said unto him, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and come into the land which I shall shew thee.

entries.yo: Nigbana li o jade kuro ni ilẹ awọn ara Kaldea, o si ṣe atipo ni Harani: lẹhin igbati baba rẹ̀ kú, Ọlọrun mu u ṣipo pada wá si ilẹ yi, nibiti ẹnyin ngbé nisisiyi.
entries.en: Then came he out of the land of the Chaldaeans, and dwelt in Charran: and from thence, when his father was dead, he removed him into this land, wherein ye now dwell.

entries.yo: Kò si fun u ni ini kan, ani to bi ẹsẹ ilẹ kan; ṣugbọn o leri pe, on ó fi i fun u ni ilẹ-nini, ati fun awọn irú-ọmọ rẹ̀ lẹhin rẹ̀, nigbati kò ti ili ọmọ.
entries.en: And he gave him none inheritance in it, no, not so much as to set his foot on: yet he promised that he would give it to him for a possession, and to his seed after him, when as yet he had no child.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si sọ bayi pe, irú-ọmọ rẹ̀ yio ṣe atipo ni ilẹ àjeji; nwọn ó si sọ wọn di ẹru, nwọn o si pọ́n wọn loju ni irinwo ọdún.
entries.en: And God spake on this wise, That his seed should sojourn in a strange land; and that they should bring them into bondage, and entreat them evil four hundred years.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun wipe, Orilẹ-ède na ti nwọn o ṣe ẹrú fun, li emi ó da lẹjọ: lẹhin na ni nwọn o si jade kuro, nwọn o si wá sìn mi nihinyi.
entries.en: And the nation to whom they shall be in bondage will I judge, said God: and after that shall they come forth, and serve me in this place.

entries.yo: O si fun u ni majẹmu ikọlà: bẹ̃li Abrahamu bí Isaaki, o kọ ọ ni ilà ni ijọ kẹjọ; Isaaki si bí Jakọbu; Jakọbu si bi awọn baba nla mejila.
entries.en: And he gave him the covenant of circumcision: and so Abraham begat Isaac, and circumcised him the eighth day; and Isaac begat Jacob; and Jacob begat the twelve patriarchs.

entries.yo: Awọn baba nla si ṣe ilara Josefu, nwọn si tà a si Egipti: ṣugbọn Ọlọrun wà pẹlu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the patriarchs, moved with envy, sold Joseph into Egypt: but God was with him,

entries.yo: O si yọ ọ kuro ninu ipọnju rẹ̀ gbogbo, o si fun u li ojurere ati ọgbọ́n li oju Farao ọba Egipti; on si fi i jẹ bãlẹ Egipti ati gbogbo ile rẹ̀.
entries.en: And delivered him out of all his afflictions, and gave him favour and wisdom in the sight of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and he made him governor over Egypt and all his house.

entries.yo: Iyan kan si wá imu ni gbogbo ilẹ Egipti ati ni Kenaani, ati ipọnju pipọ: awọn baba wa kò si ri onjẹ.
entries.en: Now there came a dearth over all the land of Egypt and Chanaan, and great affliction: and our fathers found no sustenance.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati Jakọbu gbọ́ pe alikama mbẹ ni Egipti, o rán awọn baba wa lọ lẹrinkini.
entries.en: But when Jacob heard that there was corn in Egypt, he sent out our fathers first.

entries.yo: Ati nigba keji Josefu fi ara rẹ̀ hàn fun awọn arakunrin rẹ̀; a si fi awọn ará Josefu hàn fun Farao.
entries.en: And at the second time Joseph was made known to his brethren; and Joseph's kindred was made known unto Pharaoh.

entries.yo: Josefu si ranṣẹ, o si pè Jakọbu baba rẹ̀, ati gbogbo awọn ibatan rẹ̀ sọdọ rẹ̀, arundilọgọrin ọkàn.
entries.en: Then sent Joseph, and called his father Jacob to him, and all his kindred, threescore and fifteen souls.

entries.yo: Jakọbu si sọkalẹ lọ si Egipti, o si kú, on ati awọn baba wa,
entries.en: So Jacob went down into Egypt, and died, he, and our fathers,

entries.yo: A si gbe wọn lọ si Sikemu, a si tẹ́ wọn sinu ibojì ti Abrahamu rà ni iye-owo fadaka lọwọ awọn ọmọ Emoru baba Sikemu.
entries.en: And were carried over into Sychem, and laid in the sepulchre that Abraham bought for a sum of money of the sons of Emmor the father of Sychem.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi akokò ileri ti Oluwa ṣe fun Abrahamu ti kù si dẹ̀dẹ, awọn enia na nrú, nwọn si nrẹ̀ ni Egipti,
entries.en: But when the time of the promise drew nigh, which God had sworn to Abraham, the people grew and multiplied in Egypt,

entries.yo: Titi ọba miran fi jẹ lori Egipti ti kò mọ̀ Josefu.
entries.en: Till another king arose, which knew not Joseph.

entries.yo: On na li o ṣe àrekerekè si awọn ibatan wa, nwọn si hùwa buburu si awọn baba wa, tobẹ̃ ti nwọn fi já awọn ọmọ-ọwọ wọn kuro lọwọ wọn nitori ki nwọn ki o máṣe yè.
entries.en: The same dealt subtilly with our kindred, and evil entreated our fathers, so that they cast out their young children, to the end they might not live.

entries.yo: Li akokò na li a bí Mose, ẹniti o li ẹwà pipọ, ti nwọn si bọ́ li oṣù mẹta ni ile baba rẹ̀:
entries.en: In which time Moses was born, and was exceeding fair, and nourished up in his father's house three months:

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si gbe e sọnù, ọmọbinrin Farao he e, o si tọ́ ọ dàgba li ọmọ ara rẹ̀.
entries.en: And when he was cast out, Pharaoh's daughter took him up, and nourished him for her own son.

entries.yo: A si kọ́ Mose ni gbogbo ọgbọ́n ará Egipti, o si pọ̀ li ọ̀rọ ati ni iṣe.
entries.en: And Moses was learned in all the wisdom of the Egyptians, and was mighty in words and in deeds.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si di ẹni iwọn ogoji ọdún, o sọ si i lọkan lati lọ ibẹ̀ awọn ọmọ Israeli ará rẹ̀ wò.
entries.en: And when he was full forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brethren the children of Israel.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si ri ọkan ninu wọn ti a njẹ ni ìya, o gbejà rẹ̀, o gbẹsan ẹniti nwọn njẹ ni ìya, o si lu ara Egipti na pa:
entries.en: And seeing one of them suffer wrong, he defended him, and avenged him that was oppressed, and smote the Egyptian:

entries.yo: O si ṣebi awọn ará on mọ̀ bi Ọlọrun yio ti ti ọwọ́ on gbà wọn: ṣugbọn nwọn kò mọ̀.
entries.en: For he supposed his brethren would have understood how that God by his hand would deliver them: but they understood not.

entries.yo: O si di ijọ keji o yọ si wọn bi nwọn ti njà, on iba si pari rẹ̀ fun wọn, o wipe, Alàgba, ará li ẹnyin; ẽṣe ti ẹnyin fi nṣe ohun ti kò tọ́ si ara nyin?
entries.en: And the next day he shewed himself unto them as they strove, and would have set them at one again, saying, Sirs, ye are brethren; why do ye wrong one to another?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹniti o finran si ẹnikeji rẹ̀ tì i kuro, o wipe, Tali o fi ọ jẹ olori ati onidajọ wa?
entries.en: But he that did his neighbour wrong thrust him away, saying, Who made thee a ruler and a judge over us?

entries.yo: Iwọ nfẹ pa mi gẹgẹ bi o ti pa ará Egipti laná?
entries.en: Wilt thou kill me, as thou diddest the Egyptian yesterday?

entries.yo: Mose si sá nitori ọ̀rọ yi, o si wa ṣe atipo ni ilẹ Midiani, nibiti o gbé bí ọmọ meji.
entries.en: Then fled Moses at this saying, and was a stranger in the land of Madian, where he begat two sons.

entries.yo: Nigbati ogoji ọdún si pé, angẹli Oluwa farahàn a ni ijù, li òke Sinai, ninu ọwọ́ iná ni igbẹ́.
entries.en: And when forty years were expired, there appeared to him in the wilderness of mount Sina an angel of the Lord in a flame of fire in a bush.

entries.yo: Nigbati Mose si ri i, ẹnu yà a si iran na: nigbati o si sunmọ ọ lati wò o fín, ohùn Oluwa kọ si i,
entries.en: When Moses saw it, he wondered at the sight: and as he drew near to behold it, the voice of the Lord came unto him,

entries.yo: Wipe, Emi li Ọlọrun awọn baba rẹ, Ọlọrun Abrahamu, ati Ọlọrun Isaaki, ati Ọlọrun Jakọbu. Mose si warìri, kò si daṣa lati wò o mọ́.
entries.en: Saying, I am the God of thy fathers, the God of Abrham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. Then Moses trembled, and durst not behold.

entries.yo: Oluwa si wi fun u pe, Tú bata rẹ kuro li ẹsẹ rẹ: nitori ibi ti iwọ gbé duro nì ilẹ mimọ́ ni.
entries.en: Then said the Lord to him, Put off thy shoes from thy feet: for the place where thou standest is holy ground.

entries.yo: Ni riri mo ti ri ipọnju awọn enia mi ti mbẹ ni Egipti, mo si ti gbọ́ gbigbin wọn, mo si sọkalẹ wá lati gbà wọn. Wá nisisiyi, emi o si rán ọ lọ si Egipti.
entries.en: I have seen, I have seen the affliction of my people which is in Egypt, and I have heard their groaning, and am come down to deliver them. And now come, I will send thee into Egypt.

entries.yo: Mose na yi ti nwọn kọ̀, wipe, Tali o fi ọ jẹ olori ati onidajọ? on na li Ọlọrun rán lọ lati ọwọ́ angẹli, ti o farahàn a ni igbẹ́, lati ṣe olori ati oludande.
entries.en: This Moses whom they refused, saying, Who made thee a ruler and a judge? the same did God send to be a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel which appeared to him in the bush.

entries.yo: On li o mu wọn jade, lẹhin igbati o ṣe iṣẹ iyanu ati iṣẹ àmi ni ilẹ Egipti, ati li Okun pupa, ati li aginjù li ogoji ọdún.
entries.en: He brought them out, after that he had shewed wonders and signs in the land of Egypt, and in the Red sea, and in the wilderness forty years.

entries.yo: Eyi ni Mose na ti o wi fun awọn ọmọ Israeli pe, Woli kan li Oluwa Ọlọrun nyin yio gbé dide fun nyin ninu awọn arakunrin nyin, bi emi; on ni ki ẹ gbọ́ tirẹ.
entries.en: This is that Moses, which said unto the children of Israel, A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall ye hear.

entries.yo: Eyi na li ẹniti o wà ninu ijọ ni ijù pẹlu angẹli na ti o ba a sọ̀rọ li òke Sinai, ati pẹlu awọn baba wa: ẹniti o gbà ọ̀rọ ìye lati fifun wa:
entries.en: This is he, that was in the church in the wilderness with the angel which spake to him in the mount Sina, and with our fathers: who received the lively oracles to give unto us:

entries.yo: Ẹniti awọn baba wa kò fẹ gbọ́ tirẹ, ṣugbọn nwọn tì i kuro lọdọ wọn, nwọn si yipada li ọkàn wọn si Egipti;
entries.en: To whom our fathers would not obey, but thrust him from them, and in their hearts turned back again into Egypt,

entries.yo: Nwọn wi fun Aaroni pe, Dà oriṣa fun wa ti yio ma tọ̀na ṣaju wa: nitori bi o ṣe ti Mose yi ti o mu wa ti ilẹ Egipti jade wá, a kò mọ̀ ohun ti o ṣe e.
entries.en: Saying unto Aaron, Make us gods to go before us: for as for this Moses, which brought us out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.

entries.yo: Nwọn si yá ere ẹgbọ̀rọ malu ni ijọ wọnni, nwọn si rubọ si ere na, nwọn si nyọ̀ ninu iṣẹ ọwọ́ ara wọn.
entries.en: And they made a calf in those days, and offered sacrifice unto the idol, and rejoiced in the works of their own hands.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si pada, o fi wọn silẹ lati mã sìn ogun ọrun; bi a ti kọ ọ ninu iwe awọn woli pe, Ẹnyin ara ile Israeli, ẹnyin ha mu ẹran ti a pa ati ẹbọ fun mi wá bi li ogoji ọdun ni iju?
entries.en: Then God turned, and gave them up to worship the host of heaven; as it is written in the book of the prophets, O ye house of Israel, have ye offered to me slain beasts and sacrifices by the space of forty years in the wilderness?

entries.yo: Ẹnyin si tẹwọgbà agọ́ Moloku, ati irawọ oriṣa Remfani, aworan ti ẹnyin ṣe lati mã bọ wọn: emi ó si kó nyin lọ rekọja Babiloni.
entries.en: Yea, ye took up the tabernacle of Moloch, and the star of your god Remphan, figures which ye made to worship them: and I will carry you away beyond Babylon.

entries.yo: Awọn baba wa ni agọ ẹri ni ijù, bi ẹniti o ba Mose sọrọ ti paṣẹ pe, ki o ṣe e gẹgẹ bi apẹrẹ ti o ti ri;
entries.en: Our fathers had the tabernacle of witness in the wilderness, as he had appointed, speaking unto Moses, that he should make it according to the fashion that he had seen.

entries.yo: Ti awọn baba wa ti o tẹle wọn si mu ba Joṣua wá si ilẹ-ini awọn Keferi, ti Ọlọrun lé jade kuro niwaju awọn baba wa, titi di ọjọ Dafidi;
entries.en: Which also our fathers that came after brought in with Jesus into the possession of the Gentiles, whom God drave out before the face of our fathers, unto the days of David;

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ri ojurere niwaju Ọlọrun, ti o si tọrọ lati ri ibugbe fun Ọlọrun Jakọbu.
entries.en: Who found favour before God, and desired to find a tabernacle for the God of Jacob.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Solomoni kọ́ ile fun u.
entries.en: But Solomon built him an house.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Ọgá-ogo kì igbé ile ti a fi ọwọ kọ́; gẹgẹ bi woli ti wipe,
entries.en: Howbeit the most High dwelleth not in temples made with hands; as saith the prophet,

entries.yo: Ọrun ni itẹ́ mi, aiye si li apoti itisẹ mi: irú ile kili ẹnyin o kọ́ fun mi? li Oluwa wi; tabi ibo ni ibi isimi mi?
