entries.en: Heaven is my throne, and earth is my footstool: what house will ye build me? saith the Lord: or what is the place of my rest?

entries.yo: Ọwọ́ mi kọ́ ha ṣe gbogbo nkan wọnyi?
entries.en: Hath not my hand made all these things?

entries.yo: Ẹnyin ọlọrùn-lile ati alaikọla àiya on etí, nigba-gbogbo li ẹnyin ima dèna Ẹmí Mimọ́: gẹgẹ bi awọn baba nyin, bẹ̃li ẹnyin.
entries.en: Ye stiffnecked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, ye do always resist the Holy Ghost: as your fathers did, so do ye.

entries.yo: Tani ninu awọn woli ti awọn baba nyin kò ṣe inunibini si? nwọn si ti pa awọn ti o ti nsọ asọtẹlẹ ti wíwa Ẹni Olõtọ nì; ẹniti ẹnyin si ti di olufihàn ati olupa:
entries.en: Which of the prophets have not your fathers persecuted? and they have slain them which shewed before of the coming of the Just One; of whom ye have been now the betrayers and murderers:

entries.yo: Ẹnyin ti o gbà ofin, gẹgẹ bi ilana awọn angẹli, ti ẹ kò si pa a mọ́.
entries.en: Who have received the law by the disposition of angels, and have not kept it.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si gbọ́ nkan wọnyi, àiya wọn gbọgbẹ́ de inu, nwọn si pahin si i keke.
entries.en: When they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed on him with their teeth.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn on kún fun Ẹmí Mimọ́, o tẹjumọ́ ọrun, o si ri ogo Ọlọrun, ati Jesu nduro li ọwọ́ ọtún Ọlọrun.
entries.en: But he, being full of the Holy Ghost, looked up stedfastly into heaven, and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing on the right hand of God,

entries.yo: O si wipe, Wò o, mo ri ọrun ṣí silẹ, ati Ọmọ-enia nduro li ọwọ́ ọtún Ọlọrun.
entries.en: And said, Behold, I see the heavens opened, and the Son of man standing on the right hand of God.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni nwọn kigbe li ohùn rara, nwọn si dì eti wọn, nwọn si fi ọkàn kan rọ́ lù u,
entries.en: Then they cried out with a loud voice, and stopped their ears, and ran upon him with one accord,

entries.yo: Nwọn si wọ́ ọ sẹhin ode ilu, nwọn sọ ọ lí okuta: awọn ẹlẹri si fi aṣọ wọn lelẹ li ẹsẹ ọmọkunrin kan ti a npè ni Saulu.
entries.en: And cast him out of the city, and stoned him: and the witnesses laid down their clothes at a young man's feet, whose name was Saul.

entries.yo: Nwọn sọ Stefanu li okuta, o si nképe Oluwa wipe, Jesu Oluwa, gbà ẹmí mi.
entries.en: And they stoned Stephen, calling upon God, and saying, Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.

entries.yo: O si kunlẹ, o kigbe li ohùn rara pe, Oluwa, má kà ẹ̀ṣẹ yi si wọn li ọrùn. Nigbati o si wi eyi, o sùn.
entries.en: And he kneeled down, and cried with a loud voice, Lord, lay not this sin to their charge. And when he had said this, he fell asleep.

entries.yo: SAULU si li ohùn si ikú rẹ̀. Li akoko na, inunibini nla kan dide si ijọ ti o wà ni Jerusalemu; a si tú gbogbo wọn kalẹ já àgbegbe Judea on Samaria, afi awọn aposteli.
entries.en: And Saul was consenting unto his death. And at that time there was a great persecution against the church which was at Jerusalem; and they were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judaea and Samaria, except the apostles.

entries.yo: Awọn enia olufọkànsin si dì okú Stefanu, nwọn si pohùnrére ẹkún kikan sori rẹ̀.
entries.en: And devout men carried Stephen to his burial, and made great lamentation over him.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Saulu, o ndà ijọ enia Ọlọrun ru, o nwọ̀ ojõjũle, o si nmu awọn ọkunrin ati obinrin, o si nfi wọn sinu tubu.
entries.en: As for Saul, he made havock of the church, entering into every house, and haling men and women committed them to prison.

entries.yo: Awọn ti nwọn si túka lọ si ibi gbogbo, nwọn nwasu ọ̀rọ na.
entries.en: Therefore they that were scattered abroad went every where preaching the word.

entries.yo: Filippi si sọkalẹ lọ si ilu Samaria, o nwasu Kristi fun wọn.
entries.en: Then Philip went down to the city of Samaria, and preached Christ unto them.

entries.yo: Awọn ijọ enia si fi ọkàn kan fiyesi ohun ti Filippi nsọ, nigbati nwọn ngbọ́, ti nwọn si ri iṣẹ ami ti o nṣe.
entries.en: And the people with one accord gave heed unto those things which Philip spake, hearing and seeing the miracles which he did.

entries.yo: Nitori ọpọ ninu awọn ti o ni ẹmi àimọ́ ti nkigbe lohùn rara, jade wá, ati ọpọ awọn ti ẹ̀gba mbajà, ati awọn amọ́kún, a si ṣe dida ara wọn.
entries.en: For unclean spirits, crying with loud voice, came out of many that were possessed with them: and many taken with palsies, and that were lame, were healed.

entries.yo: Ayọ̀ pipọ si wà ni ilu na.
entries.en: And there was great joy in that city.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ọkunrin kan wà, ti a npè ni Simoni, ti iti ima ṣe oṣó ni ilu na, ti isi mã jẹ ki ẹnu ya awọn ara Samaria, a mã wipe enia nla kan li on:
entries.en: But there was a certain man, called Simon, which beforetime in the same city used sorcery, and bewitched the people of Samaria, giving out that himself was some great one:

entries.yo: Ẹniti gbogbo wọn bọla fun, ati ewe ati àgba, nwipe, ọkunrin yi ni agbara Ọlọrun ti a npè ni Nla.
entries.en: To whom they all gave heed, from the least to the greatest, saying, This man is the great power of God.

entries.yo: On ni nwọn si bọlá fun, nitori ọjọ pipẹ li o ti nṣe oṣó si wọn.
entries.en: And to him they had regard, because that of long time he had bewitched them with sorceries.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati nwọn gbà Filippi gbọ́ ẹniti nwasu ihinrere ti ijọba Ọlọrun, ati orukọ Jesu Kristi, a baptisi wọn, ati ọkunrin ati obinrin.
entries.en: But when they believed Philip preaching the things concerning the kingdom of God, and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.

entries.yo: Simoni tikararẹ̀ si gbagbọ́ pẹlu: nigbati a si baptisi rẹ̀, o si mba Filippi joko, o nwò iṣẹ àmi ati iṣẹ agbara ti nti ọwọ́ Filippi ṣe, ẹnu si yà a.
entries.en: Then Simon himself believed also: and when he was baptized, he continued with Philip, and wondered, beholding the miracles and signs which were done.

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn aposteli ti o wà ni Jerusalemu si gbọ́ pe awọn ara Samaria ti gbà ọ̀rọ Ọlọrun, nwọn rán Peteru on Johanu si wọn:
entries.en: Now when the apostles which were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent unto them Peter and John:

entries.yo: Awọn ẹniti o si gbadura fun wọn, nigbati nwọn sọkalẹ, ki nwọn ki o le ri Ẹmí Mimọ́ gbà:
entries.en: Who, when they were come down, prayed for them, that they might receive the Holy Ghost:

entries.yo: Nitori titi o fi di igbana kò ti ibà le ẹnikẹni ninu wọn; kìki a baptisi wọn li orukọ Jesu Oluwa ni.
entries.en: (For as yet he was fallen upon none of them: only they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.)

entries.yo: Nigbana ni nwọn gbe ọwọ́ le wọn, nwọn si gbà Ẹmí Mimọ́.
entries.en: Then laid they their hands on them, and they received the Holy Ghost.

entries.yo: Nigbati Simoni ri pe nipa gbigbe ọwọ́ leni li a nti ọwọ́ awọn aposteli fi Ẹmí Mimọ́ funni, o fi owo lọ̀ wọn.
entries.en: And when Simon saw that through laying on of the apostles' hands the Holy Ghost was given, he offered them money,

entries.yo: O wipe, Ẹ fun emi na ni agbara yi pẹlu, ki ẹnikẹni ti mo ba gbe ọwọ́ le, ki o le gbà Ẹmí Mimọ́.
entries.en: Saying, Give me also this power, that on whomsoever I lay hands, he may receive the Holy Ghost.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Peteru da a lohùn wipe, Ki owo rẹ ṣegbé pẹlu rẹ, nitoriti iwọ rò lati fi owo rà ẹ̀bun Ọlọrun.
entries.en: But Peter said unto him, Thy money perish with thee, because thou hast thought that the gift of God may be purchased with money.

entries.yo: Iwọ kò ni ipa tabi ipín ninu ọ̀ràn yi: nitori ọkàn rẹ kò ṣe dédé niwaju Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Thou hast neither part nor lot in this matter: for thy heart is not right in the sight of God.

entries.yo: Nitorina ronupiwada ìwa buburu rẹ yi, ki o si gbadura sọdọ Ọlọrun, boya yio dari ete ọkàn rẹ jì ọ.
entries.en: Repent therefore of this thy wickedness, and pray God, if perhaps the thought of thine heart may be forgiven thee.

entries.yo: Nitoriti mo woye pe, iwọ wà ninu ikorò orõro, ati ni ìde ẹ̀ṣẹ.
entries.en: For I perceive that thou art in the gall of bitterness, and in the bond of iniquity.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Simoni dahùn, o si wipe, Ẹ gbadura sọdọ Oluwa fun mi, ki ọ̀kan ninu ohun ti ẹnyin ti sọ ki o máṣe ba mi.
entries.en: Then answered Simon, and said, Pray ye to the Lord for me, that none of these things which ye have spoken come upon me.

entries.yo: Ati awọn nigbati nwọn si ti jẹri, ti nwọn si ti sọ ọrọ Oluwa, nwọn pada lọ si Jerusalemu, nwọn si wasu ihinrere ni iletò pipọ ti awọn ara Samaria.
entries.en: And they, when they had testified and preached the word of the Lord, returned to Jerusalem, and preached the gospel in many villages of the Samaritans.

entries.yo: Angẹli Oluwa si sọ fun Filippi, pe, Dide ki o si ma lọ si ìha gusu li ọ̀na ti o ti Jerusalemu lọ si Gasa, ti iṣe ijù.
entries.en: And the angel of the Lord spake unto Philip, saying, Arise, and go toward the south unto the way that goeth down from Jerusalem unto Gaza, which is desert.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si dide, o lọ; si kiyesi i, ọkunrin kan ara Etiopia, iwẹfa ọlọlá pipọ lọdọ Kandake ọbabirin awọn ara Etiopia, ẹniti iṣe olori gbogbo iṣura rẹ̀, ti o si ti wá si Jerusalemu lati jọsin,
entries.en: And he arose and went: and, behold, a man of Ethiopia, an eunuch of great authority under Candace queen of the Ethiopians, who had the charge of all her treasure, and had come to Jerusalem for to worship,

entries.yo: On si npada lọ, o si joko ninu kẹkẹ́ rẹ̀, o nkà iwe woli Isaiah.
entries.en: Was returning, and sitting in his chariot read Esaias the prophet.

entries.yo: Ẹmí si wi fun Filippi pe, Lọ ki o si da ara rẹ pọ̀ mọ́ kẹkẹ́ yi.
entries.en: Then the Spirit said unto Philip, Go near, and join thyself to this chariot.

entries.yo: Filippi si sure lọ, o gbọ́, o nkà iwe woli Isaiah, o si bi i pe, Ohun ti iwọ nkà nì, o yé ọ?
entries.en: And Philip ran thither to him, and heard him read the prophet Esaias, and said, Understandest thou what thou readest?

entries.yo: O si dahùn wipe, Yio ha ṣe yé mi, bikoṣepe ẹnikan tọ́ mi si ọna? O si bẹ̀ Filippi ki o gòke wá, ki o si ba on joko.
entries.en: And he said, How can I, except some man should guide me? And he desired Philip that he would come up and sit with him.

entries.yo: Ibi iwe-mimọ́ ti o si nkà na li eyi, A fà a bi agutan lọ fun pipa; ati bi ọdọ-agutan iti iyadi niwaju olurẹrun rẹ̀, bẹ̃ni kò yà ẹnu rẹ̀:
entries.en: The place of the scripture which he read was this, He was led as a sheep to the slaughter; and like a lamb dumb before his shearer, so opened he not his mouth:

entries.yo: Ni irẹsilẹ rẹ̀ a mu idajọ kuro: tani yio sọ̀rọ iran rẹ̀? nitori a gbà ẹmí rẹ̀ kuro li aiye.
entries.en: In his humiliation his judgment was taken away: and who shall declare his generation? for his life is taken from the earth.

entries.yo: Iwẹfa si da Filippi lohùn, o ni, Mo bẹ̀ ọ, ti tani woli na sọ ọ̀rọ yi? ti ara rẹ̀, tabi ti ẹlomiran?
entries.en: And the eunuch answered Philip, and said, I pray thee, of whom speaketh the prophet this? of himself, or of some other man?

entries.yo: Filippi si yà ẹnu rẹ̀, o si bẹ̀rẹ lati ibi iwe-mimọ́ yi, o si wasu Jesu fun u.
entries.en: Then Philip opened his mouth, and began at the same scripture, and preached unto him Jesus.

entries.yo: Bi nwọn si ti nlọ li ọ̀na, nwọn de ibi omi kan: iwẹfa na si wipe, Wò o, omi niyi; kili o dá mi duro lati baptisi?
entries.en: And as they went on their way, they came unto a certain water: and the eunuch said, See, here is water; what doth hinder me to be baptized?

entries.yo: Filippi si wipe, Bi iwọ ba gbagbọ́ tọkàntọkan, a le baptisi rẹ. O si dahùn o ni, Mo gbagbọ́ pe Jesu Kristi, Ọmọ Ọlọrun ni.
entries.en: And Philip said, If thou believest with all thine heart, thou mayest. And he answered and said, I believe that Jesus Christ is the Son of God.

entries.yo: O si paṣẹ ki kẹkẹ́ duro jẹ: awọn mejeji si sọkalẹ lọ sinu omi, ati Filippi ati iwẹfa; o si baptisi rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he commanded the chariot to stand still: and they went down both into the water, both Philip and the eunuch; and he baptized him.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si jade kuro ninu omi, Ẹmí Oluwa ta Filippi pá, iwẹfa kò si ri i mọ́: nitoriti o mbá ọ̀na rẹ̀ lọ, o nyọ̀.
entries.en: And when they were come up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord caught away Philip, that the eunuch saw him no more: and he went on his way rejoicing.

entries.yo: Ni Asotu li a si ri Filippi; bi o si ti nkọja lọ, o nwasu ihinrere ni gbogbo ilu, titi o fi de Kesarea.
entries.en: But Philip was found at Azotus: and passing through he preached in all the cities, till he came to Caesarea.

entries.yo: ṢUGBỌN Saulu, o nmí ẹmi ikilọ ati pipa sibẹ si awọn ọmọ-ẹhin Oluwa, o tọ̀ olori alufa lọ;
entries.en: And Saul, yet breathing out threatenings and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went unto the high priest,

entries.yo: O bẽre iwe lọwọ rẹ̀ si Damasku si awọn sinagogu pe, bi on ba ri ẹnikẹni ti mbẹ li Ọna yi, iba ṣe ọkunrin, tabi obinrin, ki on le mu wọn ni didè wá si Jerusalemu.
entries.en: And desired of him letters to Damascus to the synagogues, that if he found any of this way, whether they were men or women, he might bring them bound unto Jerusalem.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, bi o ti nlọ, o si sunmọ Damasku: lojijì lati ọrun wá, imọlẹ si mọlẹ yi i ka:
entries.en: And as he journeyed, he came near Damascus: and suddenly there shined round about him a light from heaven:

entries.yo: O si ṣubu lulẹ, o gbọ́ ohùn ti o nfọ̀ si i pe, Saulu, Saulu, ẽṣe ti iwọ fi nṣe inunibini si mi?
entries.en: And he fell to the earth, and heard a voice saying unto him, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me?

entries.yo: O si wipe, Iwọ tani, Oluwa? Oluwa si wipe, Emi Jesu ni, ẹniti iwọ nṣe inunibini si: ohun irora ni fun ọ lati tapá si ẹgún.
entries.en: And he said, Who art thou, Lord? And the Lord said, I am Jesus whom thou persecutest: it is hard for thee to kick against the pricks.

entries.yo: O si nwarìri, ẹnu si yà a, o ni, Oluwa, kini iwọ nfẹ ki emi ki o ṣe? Oluwa si wi fun u pe, Dide, ki o si lọ si ilu na, a o sọ fun ọ li ohun ti iwọ o ṣe.
entries.en: And he trembling and astonished said, Lord, what wilt thou have me to do? And the Lord said unto him, Arise, and go into the city, and it shall be told thee what thou must do.

entries.yo: Awọn ọkunrin ti nwọn si mba a re àjo duro, kẹ́kẹ pa mọ́ wọn li ẹnu, nwọn gbọ́ ohùn na, ṣugbọn nwọn kò ri ẹnikan.
entries.en: And the men which journeyed with him stood speechless, hearing a voice, but seeing no man.

entries.yo: Saulu si dide ni ilẹ; nigbati oju rẹ̀ si là kò ri ohunkan: ṣugbọn nwọn fà a li ọwọ́, nwọn si mu u wá si Damasku.
entries.en: And Saul arose from the earth; and when his eyes were opened, he saw no man: but they led him by the hand, and brought him into Damascus.

entries.yo: O si gbé ijọ mẹta li airiran, kò si jẹ, bẹ̃ni kò si mu.
entries.en: And he was three days without sight, and neither did eat nor drink.

entries.yo: Ọmọ-ẹhin kan si wà ni Damasku, ti a npè ni Anania; Oluwa si wi fun u li ojuran pe, Anania. O si wipe, Wò o, emi niyi, Oluwa.
entries.en: And there was a certain disciple at Damascus, named Ananias; and to him said the Lord in a vision, Ananias. And he said, Behold, I am here, Lord.

entries.yo: Oluwa si wi fun u pe, Dide, ki o si lọ si ita ti a npè ni Ọgãnran, ki o si bère ẹniti a npè ni Saulu, ara Tarsu, ni ile Juda: sá wo o, o ngbadura.
entries.en: And the Lord said unto him, Arise, and go into the street which is called Straight, and inquire in the house of Judas for one called Saul, of Tarsus: for, behold, he prayeth,

entries.yo: On si ti ri ọkunrin kan li ojuran ti a npè ni Anania o wọle, o si fi ọwọ́ le e, ki o le riran.
entries.en: And hath seen in a vision a man named Ananias coming in, and putting his hand on him, that he might receive his sight.

entries.yo: Anania si dahùn wipe, Oluwa, mo ti gburó ọkunrin yi lọdọ ọ̀pọ enia, gbogbo buburu ti o ṣe si awọn enia mimọ́ rẹ ni Jerusalemu.
entries.en: Then Ananias answered, Lord, I have heard by many of this man, how much evil he hath done to thy saints at Jerusalem:

entries.yo: O si gbà aṣẹ lati ọdọ awọn olori alufa wá si ihinyi, lati dè gbogbo awọn ti npè orukọ rẹ.
entries.en: And here he hath authority from the chief priests to bind all that call on thy name.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Oluwa wi fun u pe, Mã lọ: nitori ohun elo àyo li on jẹ fun mi, lati gbe orukọ mi lọ si iwaju awọn Keferi, ati awọn ọba, ati awọn ọmọ Israeli:
entries.en: But the Lord said unto him, Go thy way: for he is a chosen vessel unto me, to bear my name before the Gentiles, and kings, and the children of Israel:

entries.yo: Nitori emi o fi gbogbo ìya ti kò le ṣaijẹ nitori orukọ mi han a.
entries.en: For I will shew him how great things he must suffer for my name's sake.

entries.yo: Anania si lọ, o si wọ̀ ile na; nigbati o si fi ọwọ́ rẹ̀ le e, o ni, Saulu Arakunrin, Oluwa li o rán mi, Jesu ti o fi ara hàn ọ li ọ̀na ti iwọ ba wá, ki iwọ ki o le riran, ki o si kún fun Ẹmí Mimọ́.
entries.en: And Ananias went his way, and entered into the house; and putting his hands on him said, Brother Saul, the Lord, even Jesus, that appeared unto thee in the way as thou camest, hath sent me, that thou mightest receive thy sight, and be filled with the Holy Ghost.

entries.yo: Lojukanna nkan si bọ kuro li oju rẹ̀ bi ipẹpẹ́: o si riran; o si dide, a si baptisi rẹ̀.
entries.en: And immediately there fell from his eyes as it had been scales: and he received sight forthwith, and arose, and was baptized.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si jẹun, ara rẹ̀ mokun: Saulu si wà pẹlu awọn ọmọ-ẹhin ni Damasku ni ijọ melokan.
entries.en: And when he had received meat, he was strengthened. Then was Saul certain days with the disciples which were at Damascus.

entries.yo: Lojukanna o si nwasu Kristi ninu awọn sinagogu pe, Ọmọ Ọlọrun li on iṣe.
entries.en: And straightway he preached Christ in the synagogues, that he is the Son of God.

entries.yo: Ẹnu si yà gbogbo awọn ti o ngbọ́, nwọn si wipe, Ẹniti o ti fõro awọn ti npè orukọ yi ni Jerusalemu kọ li eyi, ti o si ti itori na wá si ihinyi, lati mu wọn ni didè lọ sọdọ awọn olori alufa?
entries.en: But all that heard him were amazed, and said; Is not this he that destroyed them which called on this name in Jerusalem, and came hither for that intent, that he might bring them bound unto the chief priests?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Saulu npọ̀ si i li agbara o si ndãmu awọn Ju ti o ngbe Damasku, o nfi hàn pe, eyi ni Kristi na.
entries.en: But Saul increased the more in strength, and confounded the Jews which dwelt at Damascus, proving that this is very Christ.

entries.yo: Lẹhin igbati ọjọ pipọ kọja, awọn Ju ngbìmọ lati pa a:
entries.en: And after that many days were fulfilled, the Jews took counsel to kill him:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ìditẹ̀ wọn di mimọ̀ fun Saulu. Nwọn si nṣọ ẹnu-bode pẹlu li ọsán ati li oru lati pa a.
entries.en: But their laying await was known of Saul. And they watched the gates day and night to kill him.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn ọmọ-ẹhin rẹ̀ mu u li oru, nwọn si sọ̀ ọ kalẹ lara odi ninu agbọ̀n.
entries.en: Then the disciples took him by night, and let him down by the wall in a basket.

entries.yo: Nigbati Saulu si de Jerusalemu, o pete ati da ara rẹ̀ pọ̀ mọ awọn ọmọ-ẹhin: gbogbo nwọn si bẹ̀ru rẹ̀, nitori nwọn kò gbagbọ́ pe ọmọ-ẹhin kan ni.
entries.en: And when Saul was come to Jerusalem, he assayed to join himself to the disciples: but they were all afraid of him, and believed not that he was a disciple.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Barnaba mu u, o si sìn i lọ sọdọ awọn aposteli, o si sọ fun awọn bi o ti ri Oluwa li ọ̀na, ati pe o ti ba a sọ̀rọ, ati bi o ti fi igboiya wasu ni Damasku li orukọ Jesu.
entries.en: But Barnabas took him, and brought him to the apostles, and declared unto them how he had seen the Lord in the way, and that he had spoken to him, and how he had preached boldly at Damascus in the name of Jesus.

entries.yo: O si wà pẹlu wọn, o nwọle o si njade ni Jerusalemu.
entries.en: And he was with them coming in and going out at Jerusalem.

entries.yo: O si nfi igboiya sọ̀rọ li orukọ Jesu Oluwa, o nsọrọ lòdi si awọn ara Hellene, o si njà wọn niyàn: ṣugbọn nwọn npete ati pa a.
entries.en: And he spake boldly in the name of the Lord Jesus, and disputed against the Grecians: but they went about to slay him.

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn arakunrin si mọ̀, nwọn mu u sọkalẹ lọ si Kesarea, nwọn si rán a lọ si Tarsu.
entries.en: Which when the brethren knew, they brought him down to Caesarea, and sent him forth to Tarsus.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni ijọ wà li alafia yi gbogbo Judea ká ati ni Galili ati ni Samaria, nwọn nfẹsẹmulẹ; nwọn nrìn ni ìbẹru Oluwa, ati ni itunu Ẹmí Mimọ́, nwọn npọ̀ si i.
entries.en: Then had the churches rest throughout all Judaea and Galilee and Samaria, and were edified; and walking in the fear of the Lord, and in the comfort of the Holy Ghost, were multiplied.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, bi Peteru ti nkọja nlà ẹkùn gbogbo lọ, o sọkalẹ tọ̀ awọn enia mimọ́ ti ngbe Lidda pẹlu.
entries.en: And it came to pass, as Peter passed throughout all quarters, he came down also to the saints which dwelt at Lydda.

entries.yo: Nibẹ̀ li o ri ọkunrin kan ti a npè ni Enea ti o ti dubulẹ lori akete li ọdún mẹjọ, o ni àrun ẹ̀gba.
entries.en: And there he found a certain man named Aeneas, which had kept his bed eight years, and was sick of the palsy.

entries.yo: Peteru si wi fun u pe, Enea, Jesu Kristi mu ọ larada: dide, ki o si tún akete rẹ ṣe. O si dide lojukanna.
entries.en: And Peter said unto him, Aeneas, Jesus Christ maketh thee whole: arise, and make thy bed. And he arose immediately.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn ti ngbe Lidda ati Saroni si ri i, nwọn si yipada si Oluwa.
entries.en: And all that dwelt at Lydda and Saron saw him, and turned to the Lord.

entries.yo: Ọmọ-ẹhin kan si wà ni Joppa ti a npè ni Tabita, ni itumọ̀ rẹ̀ ti a npè ni Dorka: obinrin yi pọ̀ ni iṣẹ ore, ati itọrẹ-ãnu ti o ṣe.
entries.en: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, which by interpretation is called Dorcas: this woman was full of good works and almsdeeds which she did.

entries.yo: O si ṣe ni ijọ wọnni, ti o ṣaisàn, o si kú: nigbati nwọn wẹ̀ ẹ tan, nwọn tẹ́ ẹ si yara kan loke.
entries.en: And it came to pass in those days, that she was sick, and died: whom when they had washed, they laid her in an upper chamber.

entries.yo: Bi Lidda si ti sunmọ Joppa, nigbati awọn ọmọ-ẹhin gbọ́ pe Peteru wà nibẹ̀, awọn rán ọkunrin meji si i lọ ibẹ̀ ẹ pe, Máṣe jafara ati de ọdọ wa.
entries.en: And forasmuch as Lydda was nigh to Joppa, and the disciples had heard that Peter was there, they sent unto him two men, desiring him that he would not delay to come to them.

entries.yo: Peteru si dide, o si bá wọn lọ. Nigbati o de, nwọn mu u lọ si yara oke na: gbogbo awọn opó si duro tì i, nwọn nsọkun, nwọn si nfi ẹ̀wu ati aṣọ ti Dorka dá hàn a, nigbati o wà pẹlu wọn.
entries.en: Then Peter arose and went with them. When he was come, they brought him into the upper chamber: and all the widows stood by him weeping, and shewing the coats and garments which Dorcas made, while she was with them.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Peteru ti gbogbo wọn sode, o si kunlẹ, o si gbadura; o si yipada si okú, o ni, Tabita, dide. O si là oju rẹ̀: nigbati o si ri Peteru, o dide joko.
entries.en: But Peter put them all forth, and kneeled down, and prayed; and turning him to the body said, Tabitha, arise. And she opened her eyes: and when she saw Peter, she sat up.

entries.yo: O si nà ọwọ́ rẹ̀ si i, o fà a dide; nigbati o si pè awọn enia mimọ́ ati awọn opó, o fi i le wọn lọwọ lãye.
entries.en: And he gave her his hand, and lifted her up, and when he had called the saints and widows, presented her alive.

entries.yo: O si di mimọ̀ yi gbogbo Joppa ká; ọpọlọpọ si gba Oluwa gbọ́.
entries.en: And it was known throughout all Joppa; and many believed in the Lord.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, o gbé ọjọ pipọ ni Joppa lọdọ ọkunrin kan Simoni alawọ.
entries.en: And it came to pass, that he tarried many days in Joppa with one Simon a tanner.

entries.yo: ỌKUNRIN kan si wà ni Kesarea ti a npè ni Korneliu, balogun ọrún ti ẹgbẹ́ ọmọ-ogun ti a npè ni ti Itali,
entries.en: There was a certain man in Caesarea called Cornelius, a centurion of the band called the Italian band,

entries.yo: Olufọkansìn, ati ẹniti o bẹ̀ru Ọlọrun tilétilé rẹ̀ gbogbo, ẹniti o nṣe itọrẹ-ãnu pipọ fun awọn enia, ti o si ngbadura sọdọ Ọlọrun nigbagbogbo.
entries.en: A devout man, and one that feared God with all his house, which gave much alms to the people, and prayed to God alway.

entries.yo: Niwọn wakati kẹsan ọjọ, o ri ninu iran kedere angẹli Ọlọrun kan wọle tọ̀ ọ wá, o si wi fun u pe, Korneliu.
entries.en: He saw in a vision evidently about the ninth hour of the day an angel of God coming in to him, and saying unto him, Cornelius.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si tẹjumọ́ ọ, ti ẹ̀ru si ba a, o ni, Kini, Oluwa? O si wi fun u pe, Adura rẹ ati ọrẹ-ãnu rẹ ti goke lọ iwaju Ọlọrun fun iranti.
entries.en: And when he looked on him, he was afraid, and said, What is it, Lord? And he said unto him, Thy prayers and thine alms are come up for a memorial before God.

entries.yo: Si rán enia nisisiyi lọ si Joppa, ki nwọn si pè Simoni wá, ẹniti apele rẹ̀ jẹ Peteru:
entries.en: And now send men to Joppa, and call for one Simon, whose surname is Peter:

entries.yo: O wọ̀ si ile ẹnikan Simoni alawọ, ti ile rẹ̀ wà leti okun: on ni yio sọ fun ọ bi iwọ o ti ṣe.
entries.en: He lodgeth with one Simon a tanner, whose house is by the sea side: he shall tell thee what thou oughtest to do.

entries.yo: Nigbati angẹli na ti o ba Korneliu sọ̀rọ si fi i silẹ lọ, o pè meji ninu awọn iranṣẹ ile rẹ̀, ati ọmọ-ogun olufọkànsin kan, ninu awọn ti ima duro tì i nigbagbogbo;
entries.en: And when the angel which spake unto Cornelius was departed, he called two of his household servants, and a devout soldier of them that waited on him continually;

entries.yo: Nigbati o si ti rohin ohun gbogbo fun wọn, o rán wọn lọ si Joppa.
entries.en: And when he had declared all these things unto them, he sent them to Joppa.

entries.yo: Ni ijọ keji bi nwọn ti nlọ li ọ̀na àjo wọn, ti nwọn si sunmọ ilu na, Peteru gùn oke ile lọ igbadura niwọn wakati kẹfa ọjọ:
entries.en: On the morrow, as they went on their journey, and drew nigh unto the city, Peter went up upon the housetop to pray about the sixth hour:

entries.yo: Ebi si pa a gidigidi, on iba si jẹun: ṣugbọn nigbati nwọn npèse, o bọ si ojuran,
entries.en: And he became very hungry, and would have eaten: but while they made ready, he fell into a trance,

entries.yo: O si ri ọrun ṣí, ohun elo kan si sọkalẹ bi gọgọwú nla, ti a ti igun mẹrẹrin, sọkalẹ si ilẹ.
entries.en: And saw heaven opened, and a certain vessel descending unto him, as it had been a great sheet knit at the four corners, and let down to the earth:

entries.yo: Ninu rẹ̀ li olorijorí ẹranko ẹlẹsẹ mẹrin wà, ati ohun ti nrakò li aiye ati ẹiyẹ oju ọrun.
entries.en: Wherein were all manner of fourfooted beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air.

entries.yo: Ohùn kan si fọ̀ si i pe, Dide, Peteru; mã pa ki o si mã jẹ.
entries.en: And there came a voice to him, Rise, Peter; kill, and eat.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Peteru dahùn pe, Agbẹdọ, Oluwa; nitori emi kò jẹ ohun èwọ ati alaimọ́ kan ri.
entries.en: But Peter said, Not so, Lord; for I have never eaten any thing that is common or unclean.

entries.yo: Ohùn kan si tún fọ̀ si i lẹkeji pe, Ohun ti Ọlọrun ba ti wẹ̀nu, iwọ máṣe pè e li èwọ mọ́.
entries.en: And the voice spake unto him again the second time, What God hath cleansed, that call not thou common.

entries.yo: Eyi si ṣe li ẹrinmẹta: lojukanna a si gbé ohun elo na pada lọ soke ọrun.
entries.en: This was done thrice: and the vessel was received up again into heaven.

entries.yo: Bi o si ti ngọ́ Peteru ninu ara rẹ̀ bi a ba ti mọ̀ iran ti on ri yi si, si wo o, awọn ọkunrin ti a rán ti ọdọ Korneliu wá de, nwọn mbère ile Simoni, nwọn duro li ẹnu-ọ̀na,
entries.en: Now while Peter doubted in himself what this vision which he had seen should mean, behold, the men which were sent from Cornelius had made inquiry for Simon's house, and stood before the gate,

entries.yo: Nwọn nahùn bère bi Simoni ti a npè ni Peteru, wọ̀ nibẹ.
entries.en: And called, and asked whether Simon, which was surnamed Peter, were lodged there.

entries.yo: Bi Peteru si ti nronu iran na, Ẹmí wi fun u pe, Wo o, awọn ọkunrin mẹta nwá ọ.
entries.en: While Peter thought on the vision, the Spirit said unto him, Behold, three men seek thee.

entries.yo: Njẹ dide, sọkalẹ ki o si ba wọn lọ, máṣe kọminu ohunkohun: nitori emi li o rán wọn.
entries.en: Arise therefore, and get thee down, and go with them, doubting nothing: for I have sent them.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Peteru sọkalẹ tọ̀ awọn ọkunrin ti a rán si i lati ọdọ Korneliu wá; o ni, Wo o, emi li ẹniti ẹnyin nwá: ere idi rẹ̀ ti ẹ fi wá?
entries.en: Then Peter went down to the men which were sent unto him from Cornelius; and said, Behold, I am he whom ye seek: what is the cause wherefore ye are come?

entries.yo: Nwọn si wipe, Korneliu balogun ọrún, ọkunrin olõtọ, ati ẹniti o bẹ̀ru Ọlọrun, ti o si ni orukọ rere lọdọ gbogbo orilẹ-ede awọn Ju, on li a ti ọdọ Ọlọrun kọ́ nipasẹ angẹli mimọ́, lati ranṣẹ pè ọ wá si ile rẹ̀ ati lati gbọ́ ọ̀rọ li, ẹnu rẹ.
entries.en: And they said, Cornelius the centurion, a just man, and one that feareth God, and of good report among all the nation of the Jews, was warned from God by an holy angel to send for thee into his house, and to hear words of thee.

entries.yo: Nigbana li o pè wọn wọle, o si fi wọn wọ̀. Nijọ keji o si dide, o ba wọn lọ, ninu awọn arakunrin ni Joppa si ba a lọ.
entries.en: Then called he them in, and lodged them. And on the morrow Peter went away with them, and certain brethren from Joppa accompanied him.

entries.yo: Nijọ keji nwọn si wọ̀ Kesarea. Korneliu si ti nreti wọn, o si ti pè awọn ibatan ati awọn ọrẹ́ rẹ̀ timọtimọ jọ.
entries.en: And the morrow after they entered into Caesarea. And Cornelius waited for them, and had called together his kinsmen and near friends.

entries.yo: O si ṣe bi Peteru ti nwọle, Korneliu pade rẹ̀, o wolẹ li ẹsẹ rẹ̀, o si foribalẹ fun u.
entries.en: And as Peter was coming in, Cornelius met him, and fell down at his feet, and worshipped him.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Peteru gbé e dide, o ni, Dide; enia li emi tikarami pẹlu.
entries.en: But Peter took him up, saying, Stand up; I myself also am a man.

entries.yo: Bi o si ti mba a sọ̀rọ, o wọle, o si bá awọn enia pipọ ti nwọn pejọ.
entries.en: And as he talked with him, he went in, and found many that were come together.

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹnyin mọ̀ bi o ti jẹ ẽwọ̀ fun ẹniti iṣe Ju, lati ba ẹniti iṣe ara ilẹ miran kẹgbẹ, tabi lati tọ̀ ọ wá; ṣugbọn Ọlọrun ti fihàn mi pe, ki emi ki o máṣe pè ẹnikẹni li ẽwọ̀ tabi alaimọ́.
entries.en: And he said unto them, Ye know how that it is an unlawful thing for a man that is a Jew to keep company, or come unto one of another nation; but God hath shewed me that I should not call any man common or unclean.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni mo si ṣe wá li aijiyàn, bi a ti ranṣẹ pè mi: njẹ mo bère, nitori kili ẹnyin ṣe ranṣẹ pè mi?
entries.en: Therefore came I unto you without gainsaying, as soon as I was sent for: I ask therefore for what intent ye have sent for me?

entries.yo: Korneliu si dahùn pe, Ni ijẹrin, mo nṣe adura wakati kẹsan ọjọ ni ile mi titi di akoko yi, si wo o, ọkunrin kan alaṣọ àla duro niwaju mi.
entries.en: And Cornelius said, Four days ago I was fasting until this hour; and at the ninth hour I prayed in my house, and, behold, a man stood before me in bright clothing,

entries.yo: O si wipe, Korneliu, a gbọ́ adura rẹ, ọrẹ-ãnu rẹ si wà ni iranti niwaju Ọlọrun.
entries.en: And said, Cornelius, thy prayer is heard, and thine alms are had in remembrance in the sight of God.

entries.yo: Njẹ ranṣẹ lọ si Joppa, ki o si pè Simoni wá, ẹniti apele rẹ̀ jẹ Peteru; o wọ̀ ni ile Simoni alawọ leti okun: nigbati o ba de, yio sọ̀rọ fun ọ.
entries.en: Send therefore to Joppa, and call hither Simon, whose surname is Peter; he is lodged in the house of one Simon a tanner by the sea side: who, when he cometh, shall speak unto thee.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni mo si ti ranṣẹ si ọ lojukanna, iwọ si ṣeun ti o fi wá. Gbogbo wa pé niwaju Ọlọrun nisisiyi, lati gbọ́ ohun gbogbo ti a palaṣẹ fun ọ lati ọdọ Ọlọrun wá.
entries.en: Immediately therefore I sent to thee; and thou hast well done that thou art come. Now therefore are we all here present before God, to hear all things that are commanded thee of God.

entries.yo: Peteru si yà ẹnu rẹ̀, o si wipe, Nitõtọ mo woye pe, Ọlọrun kì iṣe ojuṣaju enia:
entries.en: Then Peter opened his mouth, and said, Of a truth I perceive that God is no respecter of persons:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ni gbogbo orilẹ-ède, ẹniti o ba bẹ̀ru rẹ̀, ti o si nṣiṣẹ ododo, ẹni itẹwọgba ni lọdọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: But in every nation he that feareth him, and worketh righteousness, is accepted with him.

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ ti Ọlọrun rán si awọn ọmọ Israeli, nigbati o wasu alafia nipa Jesu Kristi (on li Oluwa ohun gbogbo),
entries.en: The word which God sent unto the children of Israel, preaching peace by Jesus Christ: (he is Lord of all:)

entries.yo: Ẹnyin na mọ̀ ọ̀rọ na ti a kede rẹ̀ yiká gbogbo Judea, ti a bẹ̀rẹ si lati Galili wá, lẹhin baptismu ti Johanu wasu rẹ̀;
entries.en: That word, I say, ye know, which was published throughout all Judaea, and began from Galilee, after the baptism which John preached;

entries.yo: Ani Jesu ti Nasareti, bi Ọlọrun ti dà Ẹmi Mimọ́ ati agbara le e lori: ẹniti o nkiri ṣe ore, nṣe didá ara gbogbo awọn ti Èṣu si npọn loju; nitori Ọlọrun wà pẹlu rẹ̀.
entries.en: How God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Ghost and with power: who went about doing good, and healing all that were oppressed of the devil; for God was with him.

entries.yo: Awa si li ẹlẹri gbogbo ohun ti o ṣe, ni ilẹ awọn Ju, ati ni Jerusalemu; ẹniti nwọn pa, ti nwọn si fi gbékọ sori igi:
entries.en: And we are witnesses of all things which he did both in the land of the Jews, and in Jerusalem; whom they slew and hanged on a tree:

entries.yo: On li Ọlọrun jinde ni ijọ kẹta, o si fi i hàn gbangba:
entries.en: Him God raised up the third day, and shewed him openly;

entries.yo: Kì iṣe fun gbogbo enia, bikoṣe fun awọn ẹlẹri ti a ti ọwọ Ọlọrun yàn tẹlẹ, fun awa, ti a ba a jẹ, ti a si ba a mu lẹhin igbati o jinde kuro ninu okú.
entries.en: Not to all the people, but unto witnesses chosen before of God, even to us, who did eat and drink with him after he rose from the dead.

entries.yo: O si paṣẹ fun wa lati wasu fun awọn enia, ati lati jẹri pe, on li a ti ọwọ Ọlọrun yàn ṣe Onidajọ ãye on okú.
entries.en: And he commanded us to preach unto the people, and to testify that it is he which was ordained of God to be the Judge of quick and dead.

entries.yo: On ni gbogbo awọn woli jẹri si pe, nipa orukọ rẹ̀ li ẹnikẹni ti o ba gbà a gbọ, yio ri imukuro ẹ̀ṣẹ gbà.
entries.en: To him give all the prophets witness, that through his name whosoever believeth in him shall receive remission of sins.

entries.yo: Bi Peteru si ti nsọ ọ̀rọ wọnyi li ẹnu, Ẹmí Mimọ́ bà le gbogbo awọn ti o gbọ́ ọ̀rọ na.
entries.en: While Peter yet spake these words, the Holy Ghost fell on all them which heard the word.

entries.yo: Ẹnu si yà awọn onigbagbọ ti ìkọlà, iye awọn ti o ba Peteru wá, nitoriti a tu ẹbùn Ẹmi Mimọ́ sori awọn Keferi pẹlu.
entries.en: And they of the circumcision which believed were astonished, as many as came with Peter, because that on the Gentiles also was poured out the gift of the Holy Ghost.

entries.yo: Nitori nwọn gbọ́, nwọn nfọ onirũru ède, nwọn si nyìn Ọlọrun logo. Nigbana ni Peteru dahùn wipe,
entries.en: For they heard them speak with tongues, and magnify God. Then answered Peter,

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni ha le ṣòfin omi, ki a má baptisi awọn wọnyi, ti nwọn gbà Ẹmí Mimọ́ bi awa?
entries.en: Can any man forbid water, that these should not be baptized, which have received the Holy Ghost as well as we?

entries.yo: O si paṣẹ ki a baptisi wọn li orukọ Jesu Kristi. Nigbana ni nwọn bẹ̀ ẹ ki o duro ni ijọ melokan.
entries.en: And he commanded them to be baptized in the name of the Lord. Then prayed they him to tarry certain days.

entries.yo: AWỌN aposteli ati awọn arakunrin ti o wà ni Judea si gbọ́ pe awọn Keferi pẹlu ti gba ọ̀rọ Ọlọrun.
entries.en: And the apostles and brethren that were in Judaea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.

entries.yo: Nigbati Peteru si gòke wá si Jerusalemu, awọn ti ikọla mba a sọ,
entries.en: And when Peter was come up to Jerusalem, they that were of the circumcision contended with him,

entries.yo: Wipe, Iwọ wọle tọ̀ awọn enia alaikọlà lọ, o si ba wọn jẹun.
entries.en: Saying, Thou wentest in to men uncircumcised, and didst eat with them.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Peteru bẹ̀rẹ si ilà a fun wọn lẹsẹsẹ, wipe,
entries.en: But Peter rehearsed the matter from the beginning, and expounded it by order unto them, saying,

entries.yo: Emi wà ni ilu Joppa, mo ngbadura: mo ri iran kan li ojuran, Ohun elo kan sọkalẹ bi gọgọwu nla, ti a ti igun mẹrẹrin sọ̀ ka ilẹ lati ọrun wá; o si wá titi de ọdọ mi:
entries.en: I was in the city of Joppa praying: and in a trance I saw a vision, A certain vessel descend, as it had been a great sheet, let down from heaven by four corners; and it came even to me:

entries.yo: Mo tẹjumọ ọ, mo si fiyesi i, mo si ri ẹran ẹlẹsẹ mẹrin aiye, ati ẹranko igbẹ́, ati ohun ti nrakò, ati ẹiyẹ oju ọrun.
entries.en: Upon the which when I had fastened mine eyes, I considered, and saw fourfooted beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air.

entries.yo: Mo si gbọ́ ohùn kan ti o fọ̀ si mi pe, Dide, Peteru; mã pa, ki o si mã jẹ.
entries.en: And I heard a voice saying unto me, Arise, Peter; slay and eat.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn mo dahùn wipe, Agbẹdọ, Oluwa: nitori ohun èwọ tabi alaimọ́ kan kò wọ̀ ẹnu mi ri lai.
entries.en: But I said, Not so, Lord: for nothing common or unclean hath at any time entered into my mouth.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ohùn kan dahun lẹ̃keji lati ọrun wá pe, Ohun ti Ọlọrun ba ti wẹ̀nu, iwọ máṣe pè e li èwọ.
entries.en: But the voice answered me again from heaven, What God hath cleansed, that call not thou common.

entries.yo: Eyi si ṣe li ẹrinmẹta: a sì tun fà gbogbo rẹ̀ soke ọrun.
entries.en: And this was done three times: and all were drawn up again into heaven.

entries.yo: Si wo o, lojukanna ọkunrin mẹta duro niwaju ile ti a gbé wà, ti a rán lati Kesarea si mi.
entries.en: And, behold, immediately there were three men already come unto the house where I was, sent from Caesarea unto me.

entries.yo: Ẹmí si wi fun mi pe, ki emi ki o ba wọn lọ, ki emi máṣe kọminu ohunkohun. Awọn arakunrin mẹfa wọnyi si ba mi lọ, a si wọ̀ ile ọkunrin na:
entries.en: And the spirit bade me go with them, nothing doubting. Moreover these six brethren accompanied me, and we entered into the man's house:

entries.yo: O si sọ fun wa bi on ti ri angẹli kan ti o duro ni ile rẹ̀, ti o si wipe, Ranṣẹ lọ si Joppa, ki o si pè Simoni ti apele rẹ̀ jẹ Peteru;
entries.en: And he shewed us how he had seen an angel in his house, which stood and said unto him, Send men to Joppa, and call for Simon, whose surname is Peter;

entries.yo: Ẹniti yio sọ ọ̀rọ fun ọ, nipa eyiti a o fi gbà iwọ ati gbogbo ile rẹ là.
entries.en: Who shall tell thee words, whereby thou and all thy house shall be saved.

entries.yo: Bi mo si ti bẹ̀rẹ si isọ, Ẹmí Mimọ́ si bà le wọn, gẹgẹ bi o ti bà le wa li àtetekọṣe.
entries.en: And as I began to speak, the Holy Ghost fell on them, as on us at the beginning.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni mo ranti ọ̀rọ Oluwa, bi o ti wipe, Johanu fi omi baptisi nitõtọ; ṣugbọn a o fi Ẹmí Mimọ́ baptisi nyin.
entries.en: Then remembered I the word of the Lord, how that he said, John indeed baptized with water; but ye shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost.

entries.yo: Njẹ bi Ọlọrun si ti fi iru ẹ̀bun kanna fun wọn ti o ti fifun awa pẹlu nigbati a gbà Jesu Kristi Oluwa gbọ́, tali emi ti emi ó fi le dè Ọlọrun li ọ̀na?
entries.en: Forasmuch then as God gave them the like gift as he did unto us, who believed on the Lord Jesus Christ; what was I, that I could withstand God?

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si gbọ́ nkan wọnyi, nwọn si pa ẹnu wọn mọ́, nwọn si yìn Ọlọrun logo wipe, Njẹ Ọlọrun fi ironupiwada si ìye fun awọn Keferi pẹlu.
entries.en: When they heard these things, they held their peace, and glorified God, saying, Then hath God also to the Gentiles granted repentance unto life.

entries.yo: Nitorina awọn ti a si tuka kiri niti inunibini ti o ṣẹ̀ niti Stefanu, nwọn rìn titi de Fenike, ati Kipru, ati Antioku, nwọn kò sọ ọ̀rọ na fun ẹnikan, bikoṣe fun kìki awọn Ju.
entries.en: Now they which were scattered abroad upon the persecution that arose about Stephen travelled as far as Phenice, and Cyprus, and Antioch, preaching the word to none but unto the Jews only.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn kan mbẹ ninu wọn ti iṣe ara Kipru, ati Kirene; nigbati nwọn de Antioku nwọn sọ̀rọ fun awọn Hellene pẹlu, nwọn nwasu Jesu Oluwa.
entries.en: And some of them were men of Cyprus and Cyrene, which, when they were come to Antioch, spake unto the Grecians, preaching the Lord Jesus.

entries.yo: Ọwọ́ Oluwa si wà pẹlu wọn: ọpọlọpọ awọn ti o gbagbọ́ yipada si Oluwa.
entries.en: And the hand of the Lord was with them: and a great number believed, and turned unto the Lord.

entries.yo: Ihìn wọn si de etí ijọ ti o wà ni Jerusalemu: nwọn si rán Barnaba lọ titi de Antioku;
entries.en: Then tidings of these things came unto the ears of the church which was in Jerusalem: and they sent forth Barnabas, that he should go as far as Antioch.

entries.yo: Ẹniti, nigbati o de ti o si ri õre-ọfẹ Ọlọrun, o yọ̀, o si gba gbogbo wọn niyanju pe, pẹlu ipinnu ọkàn ni ki nwọn ki o fi ara mọ́ Oluwa.
entries.en: Who, when he came, and had seen the grace of God, was glad, and exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they would cleave unto the Lord.

entries.yo: Nitori on jẹ enia rere, o si kún fun Ẹmí Mimọ́, ati fun igbagbọ́: enia pipọ li a si kà kún Oluwa.
entries.en: For he was a good man, and full of the Holy Ghost and of faith: and much people was added unto the Lord.

entries.yo: Barnaba si jade lọ si Tarsu lati wá Saulu.
entries.en: Then departed Barnabas to Tarsus, for to seek Saul:

entries.yo: Nigbati o si ri i, o mu u wá si Antioku. O si ṣe, fun ọdun kan gbako ni nwọn fi mba ijọ pejọ pọ̀, ti nwọn si kọ́ enia pipọ. Ni Antioku li a si kọ́ pè awọn ọmọ-ẹhin ni Kristian.
entries.en: And when he had found him, he brought him unto Antioch. And it came to pass, that a whole year they assembled themselves with the church, and taught much people. And the disciples were called Christians first in Antioch.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ wọnni li awọn woli si ti Jerusalemu sọkalẹ wá si Antioku.
entries.en: And in these days came prophets from Jerusalem unto Antioch.

entries.yo: Nigbati ọkan ninu wọn, ti a npè ni Agabu si dide, o tipa Ẹmi sọ pe, ìyan nla yio mu ká gbogbo aiye: eyiti o si ṣẹ li ọjọ Klaudiu Kesari.
entries.en: And there stood up one of them named Agabus, and signified by the spirit that there should be great dearth throughout all the world: which came to pass in the days of Claudius Caesar.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ-ẹhin si pinnu, olukuluku gẹgẹ bi agbara rẹ̀ ti to, lati rán iranlọwọ si awọn arakunrin ti o wà ni Judea:
entries.en: Then the disciples, every man according to his ability, determined to send relief unto the brethren which dwelt in Judaea:

entries.yo: Eyiti nwọn si ṣe, nwọn si fi i ranṣẹ si awọn àgba lati ọwọ́ Barnaba on Saulu.
entries.en: Which also they did, and sent it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul.

entries.yo: LI akoko igbana ni Herodu ọba si nawọ́ rẹ̀ lati pọn awọn kan loju ninu ijọ.
entries.en: Now about that time Herod the king stretched forth his hands to vex certain of the church.

entries.yo: O si fi idà pa Jakọbu arakunrin Johanu.
entries.en: And he killed James the brother of John with the sword.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si ri pe, o dùnmọ awọn Ju, o si nawọ́ mu Peteru pẹlu. O si jẹ ìgba ọjọ àiwukàra.
entries.en: And because he saw it pleased the Jews, he proceeded further to take Peter also. (Then were the days of unleavened bread.)

entries.yo: Nigbati o si mu u, o fi i sinu tubu, o fi i le ẹ̀ṣọ́ mẹrin awọn ọmọ-ogun lọwọ lati ma ṣọ ọ; o nrò lati mu u jade fun awọn enia wá lẹhin Irekọja.
entries.en: And when he had apprehended him, he put him in prison, and delivered him to four quaternions of soldiers to keep him; intending after Easter to bring him forth to the people.

entries.yo: Nitorina nwọn pa Peteru mọ́ ninu tubu: ṣugbọn ijọ nfi itara gbadura sọdọ Ọlọrun fun u.
entries.en: Peter therefore was kept in prison: but prayer was made without ceasing of the church unto God for him.

entries.yo: Nigbati Herodu iba si mu u jade, li oru na Peteru sùn li arin awọn ọmọ-ogun meji, a fi ẹ̀wọn meji de e, ẹ̀ṣọ́ si wà li ẹnu-ọ̀na, nwọn nṣọ́ tubu na.
entries.en: And when Herod would have brought him forth, the same night Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains: and the keepers before the door kept the prison.

entries.yo: Si wo o, angẹli Oluwa duro tì i, imọlẹ si mọ́ ninu tubu: nigbati o si lù Peteru pẹ́pẹ li ẹgbẹ o ji i, o ni, Dide kánkan. Ẹwọn rẹ̀ si bọ́ silẹ kuro lọwọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And, behold, the angel of the Lord came upon him, and a light shined in the prison: and he smote Peter on the side, and raised him up, saying, Arise up quickly. And his chains fell off from his hands.

entries.yo: Angẹli na si wi fun u pe, Di àmure, ki o si so salubàta rẹ. O si ṣe bẹ̃. O si wi fun u pe, Da aṣọ rẹ bora, ki o si mã tọ̀ mi lẹhin.
entries.en: And the angel said unto him, Gird thyself, and bind on thy sandals. And so he did. And he saith unto him, Cast thy garment about thee, and follow me.

entries.yo: On si jade, o ntọ̀ ọ lẹhin; kò si mọ̀ pe otitọ li ohun na ṣe lati ọwọ́ angẹli na wá; ṣugbọn o ṣebi on wà li ojuran.
entries.en: And he went out, and followed him; and wist not that it was true which was done by the angel; but thought he saw a vision.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn kọja iṣọ ikini ati keji, nwọn de ẹnu-ọ̀na ilẹkun irin, ti o lọ si ilu, ti o si tikararẹ̀ ṣí silẹ fun wọn: nigbati nwọn si jade, nwọn nlọ titi li ọ̀na igboro kan; lojukanna angẹli na si fi i silẹ lọ.
entries.en: When they were past the first and the second ward, they came unto the iron gate that leadeth unto the city; which opened to them of his own accord: and they went out, and passed on through one street; and forthwith the angel departed from him.

entries.yo: Nigbati oju Peteru si walẹ, o ni, Nigbayi ni mo to mọ̀ nitõtọ pe, Oluwa rán angẹli rẹ̀, o si gbà mi li ọwọ́ Herodu, ati gbogbo ireti awọn enia Ju.
entries.en: And when Peter was come to himself, he said, Now I know of a surety, that the Lord hath sent his angel, and hath delivered me out of the hand of Herod, and from all the expectation of the people of the Jews.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si rò o, o lọ si ile Maria iya Johanu, ti apele rẹ̀ jẹ Marku; nibiti awọn enia pipọ pejọ si, ti nwọn ngbadura.
entries.en: And when he had considered the thing, he came to the house of Mary the mother of John, whose surname was Mark; where many were gathered together praying.

entries.yo: Bi o si ti kàn ilẹkun ẹnu-ọ̀na ọmọbinrin kan ti a npè ni Roda, o wá dahun.
entries.en: And as Peter knocked at the door of the gate, a damsel came to hearken, named Rhoda.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si ti mọ̀ ohùn Peteru, kò ṣí ilẹkun fun ayọ̀, ṣugbọn o sure wọle, o si sọ pe, Peteru duro li ẹnu-ọ̀na.
entries.en: And when she knew Peter's voice, she opened not the gate for gladness, but ran in, and told how Peter stood before the gate.

entries.yo: Nwọn si wi fun u pe, Iwọ nṣiwère. Ṣugbọn o tẹnumọ́ ọ gidigidi pe Bẹ̃ni sẹ. Nwọn si wipe, Angẹli rẹ̀ ni.
entries.en: And they said unto her, Thou art mad. But she constantly affirmed that it was even so. Then said they, It is his angel.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Peteru nkànkun sibẹ, nigbati nwọn si ṣí ilẹkun, nwọn ri i, ẹnu si yà wọn.
entries.en: But Peter continued knocking: and when they had opened the door, and saw him, they were astonished.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn o juwọ́ si wọn pe ki nwọn ki o dakẹ, o si ròhin fun wọn bi Oluwa ti mu on jade kuro ninu tubu. O si wipe, Ẹ lọ isọ nkan wọnyi fun Jakọbu, ati awọn arakunrin. Nigbati o si jade, o lọ si ibomiran.
entries.en: But he, beckoning unto them with the hand to hold their peace, declared unto them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison. And he said, Go shew these things unto James, and to the brethren. And he departed, and went into another place.

entries.yo: Nigbati ilẹ si mọ́, èmimì diẹ kọ li o wà lãrin awọn ọmọ-ogun pe, nibo ni Peteru gbé wà.
entries.en: Now as soon as it was day, there was no small stir among the soldiers, what was become of Peter.

entries.yo: Nigbati Herodu si wá a kiri, ti kò si ri i, o wádi awọn ẹ̀ṣọ, o paṣẹ pe, ki a pa wọn. O si sọkalẹ lati Judea lọ si Kesarea, o si joko nibẹ̀.
entries.en: And when Herod had sought for him, and found him not, he examined the keepers, and commanded that they should be put to death. And he went down from Judaea to Caesarea, and there abode.

entries.yo: Herodu si mbinu gidigidi si awọn ara Tire on Sidoni: ṣugbọn nwọn fi ọkàn kan wá sọdọ rẹ̀, nigbati nwọn si ti tu Blastu iwẹfa ọba loju, nwọn mbẹbẹ fun alafia; nitori lati ilu ọba lọ li a ti mbọ́ ilu wọn.
entries.en: And Herod was highly displeased with them of Tyre and Sidon: but they came with one accord to him, and, having made Blastus the king's chamberlain their friend, desired peace; because their country was nourished by the king's country.

entries.yo: Lọjọ afiyesi kan, Herodu gunwà, o joko lori itẹ́, o si nsọ̀rọ fun wọn.
entries.en: And upon a set day Herod, arrayed in royal apparel, sat upon his throne, and made an oration unto them.

entries.yo: Awọn enia si hó, wipe, Ohùn ọlọrun ni, kì si iṣe ti enia.
entries.en: And the people gave a shout, saying, It is the voice of a god, and not of a man.

entries.yo: Lojukanna angẹli Oluwa lù u, nitoriti kò fi ogo fun Ọlọrun: idin si jẹ ẹ, o si kú.
entries.en: And immediately the angel of the Lord smote him, because he gave not God the glory: and he was eaten of worms, and gave up the ghost.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ọ̀rọ Ọlọrun gbilẹ, o si bi si i.
entries.en: But the word of God grew and multiplied.

entries.yo: Barnaba on Saulu si pada ti Jerusalemu wá, nigbati nwọn si pari iṣẹ-iranṣẹ wọn, nwọn si mu Johanu wá pẹlu wọn, apele ẹniti ijẹ Marku.
entries.en: And Barnabas and Saul returned from Jerusalem, when they had fulfilled their ministry, and took with them John, whose surname was Mark.

entries.yo: AWỌN woli ati awọn olukọni si mbẹ ninu ijọ ti o wà ni Antioku; Barnaba, ati Simeoni ti a npè ni Nigeri, ati Lukiu ara Kirene, ati Manaeni, ti a tọ́ pọ̀ pẹlu Herodu tetrarki, ati Saulu.
entries.en: Now there were in the church that was at Antioch certain prophets and teachers; as Barnabas, and Simeon that was called Niger, and Lucius of Cyrene, and Manaen, which had been brought up with Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.

entries.yo: Bi nwọn si ti njọsìn fun Oluwa, ti nwọn si ngbàwẹ, Ẹmí Mimọ́ wipe, Ẹ yà Barnaba on Saulu sọtọ̀ fun mi fun iṣẹ ti mo ti pè wọn si.
entries.en: As they ministered to the Lord, and fasted, the Holy Ghost said, Separate me Barnabas and Saul for the work whereunto I have called them.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si ti gbàwẹ, ti nwọn si ti gbadura, ti nwọn si ti gbe ọwọ́ le wọn, nwọn si rán wọn lọ.
entries.en: And when they had fasted and prayed, and laid their hands on them, they sent them away.

entries.yo: Njẹ bi a ti rán wọn lati ọwọ́ Ẹmí Mimọ́ lọ, nwọn sọkalẹ lọ si Seleukia; lati ibẹ̀ nwọn si wọkọ̀ lọ si Kipru.
entries.en: So they, being sent forth by the Holy Ghost, departed unto Seleucia; and from thence they sailed to Cyprus.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si wà ni Salami, nwọn nwasu ọ̀rọ Ọlọrun ni sinagogu awọn Ju: nwọn si ni Johanu pẹlu fun iranṣẹ wọn.
entries.en: And when they were at Salamis, they preached the word of God in the synagogues of the Jews: and they had also John to their minister.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si là gbogbo erekùṣu já de Pafo, nwọn ri ọkunrin kan, oṣó, woli eke, Ju, orukọ ẹniti ijẹ Barjesu,
entries.en: And when they had gone through the isle unto Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew, whose name was Bar-jesus:

entries.yo: Ẹniti o wà lọdọ Sergiu Paulu bãlẹ ilu na, amoye enia. On na li o ranṣẹ pè Barnaba on Saulu, o si fẹ gbọ́ ọ̀rọ Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Which was with the deputy of the country, Sergius Paulus, a prudent man; who called for Barnabas and Saul, and desired to hear the word of God.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Elima oṣó na (nitori bẹ̃ni itumọ̀ orukọ rẹ̀) o takò wọn, o nfẹ pa bãlẹ ni ọkàn da kuro ni igbagbọ́.
entries.en: But Elymas the sorcerer (for so is his name by interpretation) withstood them, seeking to turn away the deputy from the faith.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Saulu (ti a si npè ni Paulu), o kún fun Ẹmí Mimọ́, o si tẹjumọ́ ọ, o si wipe,
entries.en: Then Saul, (who also is called Paul,) filled with the Holy Ghost, set his eyes on him,

entries.yo: Iwọ ti o kún fun arekereke gbogbo, ati fun iwà-ìka gbogbo, iwọ ọmọ Eṣu, iwọ ọta ododo gbogbo, iwọ kì yio ha dẹkun ati ma yi ọna titọ́ Oluwa po?
entries.en: And said, O full of all subtilty and all mischief, thou child of the devil, thou enemy of all righteousness, wilt thou not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord?

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, wo o, ọwọ́ Oluwa mbẹ lara rẹ, iwọ o si fọju, iwọ kì yio ri õrùn ni sã kan. Lojukanna owusuwusu ati òkunkun si bò o; o si nwá enia kiri lati fà a lọwọ lọ.
entries.en: And now, behold, the hand of the Lord is upon thee, and thou shalt be blind, not seeing the sun for a season. And immediately there fell on him a mist and a darkness; and he went about seeking some to lead him by the hand.

entries.yo: Nigbati bãlẹ ri ohun ti o ṣe, o gbagbọ́, ẹnu si yà a si ẹkọ́ Oluwa.
entries.en: Then the deputy, when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the doctrine of the Lord.

entries.yo: Nigbati Paulu ati awọn ti o wà pẹlu rẹ̀ si ṣikọ̀ ni Pafo, nwọn wá si Perga ni Pamfilia: Johanu si fi wọn silẹ, o si pada lọ si Jerusalemu.
entries.en: Now when Paul and his company loosed from Paphos, they came to Perga in Pamphylia: and John departing from them returned to Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si là Perga kọja, nwọn wá si Antioku ni Pisidia, nwọn si wọ̀ inu sinagogu li ọjọ isimi, nwọn si joko.
entries.en: But when they departed from Perga, they came to Antioch in Pisidia, and went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and sat down.

entries.yo: Ati lẹhin kìka iwe ofin ati iwe awọn woli, awọn olori sinagogu ranṣẹ si wọn, pe, Ará, bi ẹnyin ba li ọ̀rọ iyanju kan fun awọn enia, ẹ sọ ọ.
entries.en: And after the reading of the law and the prophets the rulers of the synagogue sent unto them, saying, Ye men and brethren, if ye have any word of exhortation for the people, say on.

entries.yo: Paulu si dide duro, o si juwọ́ si wọn, o ni, Ẹnyin enia Israeli, ati ẹnyin ti o bẹ̀ru Ọlọrun, ẹ fi etí silẹ.
entries.en: Then Paul stood up, and beckoning with his hand said, Men of Israel, and ye that fear God, give audience.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun awọn enia Israeli yi, yàn awọn baba wa, o si gbé awọn enia na leke, nigbati nwọn ṣe atipo ni ilẹ Egipti, apá giga li o si fi mu wọn jade kuro ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: The God of this people of Israel chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they dwelt as strangers in the land of Egypt, and with an high arm brought he them out of it.

entries.yo: Ni ìwọn igba ogoji ọdún li o fi mu sũru fun ìwa wọn ni ijù.
entries.en: And about the time of forty years suffered he their manners in the wilderness.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si ti run orilẹ-ède meje ni ilẹ Kenaani, o si fi ilẹ wọn fun wọn ni ini fun iwọn ãdọta-le-ni-irinwo ọdun.
entries.en: And when he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Chanaan, he divided their land to them by lot.

entries.yo: Ati lẹhin nkan wọnyi o fi onidajọ fun wọn, titi o fi di igba Samueli woli.
entries.en: And after that he gave unto them judges about the space of four hundred and fifty years, until Samuel the prophet.

entries.yo: Ati lẹhinna ni nwọn bère ọba: Ọlọrun si fun wọn ni Saulu ọmọ Kiṣi, ọkunrin kan ninu ẹ̀ya Benjamini, fun ogoji ọdún.
entries.en: And afterward they desired a king: and God gave unto them Saul the son of Cis, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, by the space of forty years.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si mu u kuro, o gbé Dafidi dide li ọba fun wọn; ẹniti o si jẹri rẹ̀ pe, Mo ri Dafidi ọmọ Jesse ẹni bi ọkàn mi, ti yio ṣe gbogbo ifẹ mi.
entries.en: And when he had removed him, he raised up unto them David to be their king; to whom also he gave testimony, and said, I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after mine own heart, which shall fulfil all my will.

entries.yo: Lati inu iru-ọmọ ọkunrin yi ni Ọlọrun ti gbe Jesu Olugbala dide fun Israeli gẹgẹ bi ileri,
entries.en: Of this man's seed hath God according to his promise raised unto Israel a Saviour, Jesus:

entries.yo: Nigbati Johanu ti kọ́ wãsu baptismu ironupiwada fun gbogbo enia Israeli ṣaju wíwa rẹ̀.
entries.en: When John had first preached before his coming the baptism of repentance to all the people of Israel.

entries.yo: Bi Johanu si ti nlà ipa tirẹ̀ já, o ni, Tali ẹnyin ṣebi emi iṣe? Emi kì iṣe on. Ṣugbọn ẹ kiyesi i, ẹnikan mbọ̀ lẹhin mi, bata ẹsẹ ẹniti emi kò to itú.
entries.en: And as John fulfilled his course, he said, Whom think ye that I am? I am not he. But, behold, there cometh one after me, whose shoes of his feet I am not worthy to loose.

entries.yo: Ará, ẹnyin ọmọ iran Abrahamu, ati ẹnyin ti o bẹ̀ru Ọlọrun, awa li a rán ọ̀rọ igbala yi si.
entries.en: Men and brethren, children of the stock of Abraham, and whosoever among you feareth God, to you is the word of this salvation sent.

entries.yo: Nitori awọn ti ngbe Jerusalemu, ati awọn olori wọn, nitoriti nwọn kò mọ̀ ọ, ati ọ̀rọ awọn woli, ti a nkà li ọjọjọ isimi, kò yé wọn, nwọn mu u ṣẹ ni didajọ rẹ̀ lẹbi.
entries.en: For they that dwell at Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they knew him not, nor yet the voices of the prophets which are read every sabbath day, they have fulfilled them in condemning him.

entries.yo: Ati bi nwọn kò tilẹ ti ri ọ̀ran iku si i, sibẹ nwọn rọ̀ Pilatu lati pa a.
entries.en: And though they found no cause of death in him, yet desired they Pilate that he should be slain.

entries.yo: Bi nwọn si ti mu nkan gbogbo ṣẹ ti a ti kọwe nitori rẹ̀, nwọn si sọ ọ kalẹ kuro lori igi, nwọn si tẹ́ ẹ si ibojì.
entries.en: And when they had fulfilled all that was written of him, they took him down from the tree, and laid him in a sepulchre.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Ọlọrun jí i dide kuro ninu okú:
entries.en: But God raised him from the dead:

entries.yo: O si farahàn li ọjọ pipọ fun awọn ti o ba a gòke lati Galili wá si Jerusalemu, awọn ti iṣe ẹlẹri rẹ̀ nisisiyi fun awọn enia.
entries.en: And he was seen many days of them which came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are his witnesses unto the people.

entries.yo: Awa si mu ihinrere wá fun nyin, ti ileri tí a ti ṣe fun awọn baba,
entries.en: And we declare unto you glad tidings, how that the promise which was made unto the fathers,

entries.yo: Bi Ọlọrun ti mu eyi na ṣẹ fun awọn ọmọ wa, nigbati o ji Jesu dide; bi a si ti kọwe rẹ̀ ninu Psalmu keji pe, Iwọ li Ọmọ mi, loni ni mo bí ọ.
entries.en: God hath fulfilled the same unto us their children, in that he hath raised up Jesus again; as it is also written in the second psalm, Thou art my Son, this day have I begotten thee.

entries.yo: Ati niti pe o ji i dide kuro ninu oku, ẹniti kì yio tun pada si ibajẹ mọ́, o wi bayi pe, Emi ó fun nyin ni ore mimọ́ Dafidi, ti o daju.
entries.en: And as concerning that he raised him up from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he said on this wise, I will give you the sure mercies of David.

entries.yo: Nitori o si wi ninu Psalmu miran pẹlu pe, Iwọ kì yio jẹ ki Ẹni Mimọ́ rẹ ri idibajẹ.
entries.en: Wherefore he saith also in another psalm, Thou shalt not suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.

entries.yo: Nitori lẹhin igba ti Dafidi sin iran rẹ̀ tan bi ifẹ Ọlọrun, o sùn, a si tẹ́ ẹ tì awọn baba rẹ̀, o si ri idibajẹ.
entries.en: For David, after he had served his own generation by the will of God, fell on sleep, and was laid unto his fathers, and saw corruption:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹniti Ọlọrun ji dide kò ri idibajẹ.
entries.en: But he, whom God raised again, saw no corruption.

entries.yo: Njẹ ki o yé nyin, ará, pe nipasẹ ọkunrin yi li a nwasu idariji ẹ̀ṣẹ fun nyin:
entries.en: Be it known unto you therefore, men and brethren, that through this man is preached unto you the forgiveness of sins:

entries.yo: Ati nipa rẹ̀ li a ndá olukuluku ẹniti o gbagbọ lare kuro ninu ohun gbogbo, ti a kò le da nyin lare ninu ofin Mose.
entries.en: And by him all that believe are justified from all things, from which ye could not be justified by the law of Moses.

entries.yo: Nitorina ẹ kiyesara, ki eyi ti a ti sọ ninu iwe awọn woli ki o maṣe de ba nyin, pe;
entries.en: Beware therefore, lest that come upon you, which is spoken of in the prophets;

entries.yo: Ẹ wo o, ẹnyin ẹlẹgàn, ki ẹnu ki o si yà nyin, ki a si fẹ nyin kù: nitori emi nṣe iṣẹ kan li ọjọ nyin, iṣẹ ti ẹnyin kò jẹ gbagbọ, bi ẹnikan tilẹ rohìn rẹ̀ fun nyin.
entries.en: Behold, ye despisers, and wonder, and perish: for I work a work in your days, a work which ye shall in no wise believe, though a man declare it unto you.

entries.yo: Bi nwọn si ti njade, nwọn bẹ̀bẹ pe ki a sọ̀rọ wọnyi fun wọn li ọjọ isimi ti mbọ̀.
entries.en: And when the Jews were gone out of the synagogue, the Gentiles besought that these words might be preached to them the next sabbath.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si jade ni sinagogu, ọ̀pọ ninu awọn Ju ati ninu awọn olufọkansìn alawọṣe tẹle Paulu on Barnaba: awọn ẹniti o ba wọn sọ̀rọ ti nwọn si rọ̀ wọn lati duro ninu ore-ọfẹ Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Now when the congregation was broken up, many of the Jews and religious proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas: who, speaking to them, persuaded them to continue in the grace of God.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ isimi keji, gbogbo ilu si fẹrẹ pejọ tan lati gbọ́ ọ̀rọ Ọlọrun.
entries.en: And the next sabbath day came almost the whole city together to hear the word of God.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati awọn Ju ri ọ̀pọ enia na, nwọn kún fun owu, nwọn nsọ̀rọ-òdi si ohun ti Paulu nsọ.
entries.en: But when the Jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with envy, and spake against those things which were spoken by Paul, contradicting and blaspheming.

entries.yo: Paulu on Barnaba si sọ laibẹru pe, Ẹnyin li o tọ ki a kọ́ sọ ọ̀rọ Ọlọrun fun: ṣugbọn bi ẹ ti ta a nù, ẹ sì kà ara nyin si alaiyẹ fun iyè ainipẹkun, wo o, awa yipada sọdọ awọn Keferi.
entries.en: Then Paul and Barnabas waxed bold, and said, It was necessary that the word of God should first have been spoken to you: but seeing ye put it from you, and judge yourselves unworthy of everlasting life, lo, we turn to the Gentiles.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li Oluwa sá ti paṣẹ fun wa pe, Mo ti gbé ọ kalẹ fun imọlẹ awọn Keferi, ki iwọ ki o le jẹ fun igbala titi de opin aiye.
entries.en: For so hath the Lord commanded us, saying, I have set thee to be a light of the Gentiles, that thou shouldest be for salvation unto the ends of the earth.

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn Keferi si gbọ́ eyi, nwọn yọ̀, nwọn si yìn ọ̀rọ Ọlọrun logo: gbogbo awọn ti a yàn si ìye ainipẹkun si gbagbọ́.
entries.en: And when the Gentiles heard this, they were glad, and glorified the word of the Lord: and as many as were ordained to eternal life believed.

entries.yo: A si tàn ọ̀rọ Oluwa ka gbogbo ẹkùn na.
entries.en: And the word of the Lord was published throughout all the region.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn Ju rú awọn obinrin olufọkansin ati ọlọlá soke ati awọn àgba ilu na, nwọn si gbe inunibini dide si Paulu on Barnaba, nwọn si ṣí wọn kuro li àgbegbe wọn.
entries.en: But the Jews stirred up the devout and honourable women, and the chief men of the city, and raised persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and expelled them out of their coasts.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nwọn gbọ̀n ekuru ẹsẹ wọn si wọn, nwọn si wá si Ikonioni.
entries.en: But they shook off the dust of their feet against them, and came unto Iconium.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ-ẹhin si kún fun ayọ̀ ati fun Ẹmí Mimọ́.
entries.en: And the disciples were filled with joy, and with the Holy Ghost.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, ni Ikonioni, nwọn jumọ wọ̀ inu sinagogu awọn Ju lọ, nwọn si sọrọ tobẹ̃, ti ọ̀pọlọpọ awọn Ju ati awọn Hellene gbagbọ́.
entries.en: And it came to pass in Iconium, that they went both together into the synagogue of the Jews, and so spake, that a great multitude both of the Jews and also of the Greeks believed.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn alaigbagbọ́ Ju rú ọkàn awọn Keferi soke, nwọn si rọ̀ wọn si awọn arakunrin na.
entries.en: But the unbelieving Jews stirred up the Gentiles, and made their minds evil affected against the brethren.

entries.yo: Nitorina nwọn gbe ibẹ̀ pẹ, nwọn nfi igboiya sọrọ ninu Oluwa, ẹniti o jẹri si ọ̀rọ ore-ọfẹ rẹ̀, o si nyọnda ki iṣẹ àmi ati iṣẹ iyanu mã ti ọwọ́ wọn ṣe.
entries.en: Long time therefore abode they speaking boldly in the Lord, which gave testimony unto the word of his grace, and granted signs and wonders to be done by their hands.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ọ̀pọ enia ilu na pin meji: apakan si dàpọ mọ́ awọn Ju, apakan si dàpọ mọ́ awọn aposteli.
entries.en: But the multitude of the city was divided: and part held with the Jews, and part with the apostles.

entries.yo: Bi awọn Keferi, ati awọn Ju pẹlu awọn olori wọn ti fẹ kọlù wọn lati ṣe àbuku si wọn, ati lati sọ wọn li okuta,
entries.en: And when there was an assault made both of the Gentiles, and also of the Jews with their rulers, to use them despitefully, and to stone them,

entries.yo: Nwọn mọ̀, nwọn si sá lọ si Listra ati Derbe ilu Likaonia, ati si àgbegbe ti o yiká:
entries.en: They were ware of it, and fled unto Lystra and Derbe, cities of Lycaonia, and unto the region that lieth round about:

entries.yo: Nibẹ̀ ni nwọn si nwasu ihinrere.
entries.en: And there they preached the gospel.

entries.yo: Ọkunrin kan si joko ni Listra, ẹniti ẹsẹ rẹ̀ kò mokun, arọ lati inu iya rẹ̀ wá, ti kò rìn ri.
entries.en: And there sat a certain man at Lystra, impotent in his feet, being a cripple from his mother's womb, who never had walked:

entries.yo: Ọkunrin yi gbọ́ bi Paulu ti nsọ̀rọ: ẹni, nigbati o tẹjumọ́ ọ, ti o si ri pe, o ni igbagbọ́ fun imularada,
entries.en: The same heard Paul speak: who stedfastly beholding him, and perceiving that he had faith to be healed,

entries.yo: O wi fun u li ohùn rara pe, Dide duro ṣanṣan li ẹsẹ rẹ. O si nfò soke o si nrìn.
entries.en: Said with a loud voice, Stand upright on thy feet. And he leaped and walked.

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn enia si ri ohun ti Paulu ṣe, nwọn gbé ohùn wọn soke li ède Likaonia, wipe, Awọn oriṣa sọkalẹ tọ̀ wa wá ni àwọ enia.
entries.en: And when the people saw what Paul had done, they lifted up their voices, saying in the speech of Lycaonia, The gods are come down to us in the likeness of men.

entries.yo: Nwọn si pè Barnaba ni Jupiteri ati Paulu ni Herme nitori on li olori ọ̀rọ isọ.
entries.en: And they called Barnabas, Jupiter; and Paul, Mercurius, because he was the chief speaker.

entries.yo: Alufa Jupiteri ti ile oriṣa rẹ̀ wà niwaju ilu wọn, si mu malu ati màriwo wá si ẹnubode, on iba si rubọ pẹlu awọn enia.
entries.en: Then the priest of Jupiter, which was before their city, brought oxen and garlands unto the gates, and would have done sacrifice with the people.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati awọn aposteli Barnaba on Paulu gbọ́, nwọn fà aṣọ wọn ya, nwọn si sure wọ̀ inu awujọ, nwọn nke rara.
entries.en: Which when the apostles, Barnabas and Paul, heard of, they rent their clothes, and ran in among the people, crying out,

entries.yo: Nwọn si nwipe, Ará, ẽṣe ti ẹnyin fi nṣe nkan wọnyi? Enia oniru ìwa kanna bi ẹnyin li awa pẹlu ti a nwasu ihinrere fun nyin, ki ẹnyin ki o yipada kuro ninu ohun asan wọnyi si Ọlọrun alãye, ti o da ọrun on aiye, ati okun, ati ohun gbogbo ti mbẹ ninu wọn:
entries.en: And saying, Sirs, why do ye these things? We also are men of like passions with you, and preach unto you that ye should turn from these vanities unto the living God, which made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and all things that are therein:

entries.yo: Ẹni, ni awọn iran ti o ti kọja jọwọ gbogbo orilẹ-ède, lati mã rìn li ọna tiwọn.
entries.en: Who in times past suffered all nations to walk in their own ways.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ko fi ara rẹ̀ silẹ li ailẹri, ni ti o nṣe rere, o nfun nyin ni òjo lati ọrun wá, ati akokò eso, o nfi onjẹ ati ayọ̀ kún ọkàn nyin.
entries.en: Nevertheless he left not himself without witness, in that he did good, and gave us rain from heaven, and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness.

entries.yo: Diẹ li o kù ki nwọn ki o ma le fi ọ̀rọ wọnyi da awọn enia duro, ki nwọn ki o máṣe rubọ bọ wọn.
entries.en: And with these sayings scarce restrained they the people, that they had not done sacrifice unto them.

entries.yo: Awọn Ju kan si ti Antioku ati Ikonioni wá, nigbati nwọn yi awọn enia li ọkàn pada, nwọn si sọ Paulu li okuta, nwọn wọ́ ọ jade kuro ni ilu na, nwọn ṣebi o kú.
entries.en: And there came thither certain Jews from Antioch and Iconium, who persuaded the people, and, having stoned Paul, drew him out of the city, supposing he had been dead.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati awọn ọmọ-ẹhin duro tì i yiká, o dide, o si wọ̀ ilu na lọ: ni ijọ keji o ba Barnaba lọ si Derbe.
entries.en: Howbeit, as the disciples stood round about him, he rose up, and came into the city: and the next day he departed with Barnabas to Derbe.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si ti wasu ihinrere fun ilu na, ti nwọn si ni ọmọ-ẹ̀hin pupọ, nwọn pada lọ si Listra, ati Ikonioni, ati si Antioku.
entries.en: And when they had preached the gospel to that city, and had taught many, they returned again to Lystra, and to Iconium, and Antioch,

entries.yo: Nwọn nmu awọn ọmọ-ẹhin li ọkàn le, nwọn ngbà wọn niyanju lati duro ni igbagbọ́, ati pe ninu ipọnju pipọ li awa o fi wọ̀ ijọba Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Confirming the souls of the disciples, and exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that we must through much tribulation enter into the kingdom of God.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si ti yàn awọn àgbagba fun olukuluku ijọ, ti nwọn si ti fi àwẹ gbadura, nwọn fi wọn le Oluwa lọwọ, ẹniti nwọn gbagbọ́.
entries.en: And when they had ordained them elders in every church, and had prayed with fasting, they commended them to the Lord, on whom they believed.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si là Pisidia já, nwọn wá si Pamfilia.
entries.en: And after they had passed throughout Pisidia, they came to Pamphylia.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si ti sọ ọ̀rọ na ni Perga, nwọn sọkalẹ lọ si Atalia:
entries.en: And when they had preached the word in Perga, they went down into Attalia:

entries.yo: Ati lati ibẹ̀ lọ nwọn ba ti ọkọ̀ lọ si Antioku, lati ibiti a gbé ti fi wọn le õre-ọfẹ Ọlọrun lọwọ, fun iṣẹ ti nwọn ṣe pari.
entries.en: And thence sailed to Antioch, from whence they had been recommended to the grace of God for the work which they fulfilled.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si de, ti nwọn si pè ijọ jọ, nwọn ròhin gbogbo ohun ti Ọlọrun fi wọn ṣe, ati bi o ti ṣí ilẹkun igbagbọ́ fun awọn Keferi.
entries.en: And when they were come, and had gathered the church together, they rehearsed all that God had done with them, and how he had opened the door of faith unto the Gentiles.

entries.yo: Ki iṣe igba diẹ ni nwọn ba awọn ọmọ-ẹhin gbé.
entries.en: And there they abode long time with the disciples.

entries.yo: AWỌN ọkunrin kan ti Judea sọkalẹ wá, nwọn si kọ́ awọn arakunrin pe, Bikoṣepe a ba kọ nyin ni ilà bi iṣe Mose, ẹnyin kì yio le là.
entries.en: And certain men which came down from Judaea taught the brethren, and said, Except ye be circumcised after the manner of Moses, ye cannot be saved.

entries.yo: Nigbati iyapa ati iyàn jijà ti mbẹ lãrin Paulu on Barnaba kò si mọ ni ìwọn, awọn arakunrin yàn Paulu on Barnaba, ati awọn miran ninu wọn, ki nwọn goke lọ si Jerusalemu, sọdọ awọn aposteli ati awọn àgbagba nitori ọ̀ran yi.
entries.en: When therefore Paul and Barnabas had no small dissension and disputation with them, they determined that Paul and Barnabas, and certain other of them, should go up to Jerusalem unto the apostles and elders about this question.

entries.yo: Nitorina nigbati ijọ si sìn wọn de ọna, nwọn là Fenike on Samaria kọja, nwọn nròhin iyipada awọn Keferi: nwọn si fi ayọ̀ nla fun gbogbo awọn arakunrin.
entries.en: And being brought on their way by the church, they passed through Phenice and Samaria, declaring the conversion of the Gentiles: and they caused great joy unto all the brethren.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si de Jerusalemu ijọ ati awọn aposteli ati awọn àgbagbà tẹwọgba wọn, nwọn si ròhin ohun gbogbo ti Ọlọrun ti fi wọn ṣe.
entries.en: And when they were come to Jerusalem, they were received of the church, and of the apostles and elders, and they declared all things that God had done with them.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn kan ti ẹya awọn Farisi ti nwọn gbagbọ́ dide, nwọn nwipe, a ni lati kọ wọn ni ilà, ati lati paṣẹ fun wọn pe ki nwọn ki o mã pa ofin Mose mọ́.
entries.en: But there rose up certain of the sect of the Pharisees which believed, saying, That it was needful to circumcise them, and to command them to keep the law of Moses.

entries.yo: Ati awọn aposteli ati awọn àgbagbà pejọ lati gbìmọ ọ̀ran yi.
entries.en: And the apostles and elders came together for to consider of this matter.

entries.yo: Nigbati iyàn si di pipọ, Peteru dide, o si wi fun wọn pe, Ará, ẹnyin mọ̀ pe, lati ibẹrẹ Ọlọrun ti yàn ninu nyin, ki awọn Keferi ki o le gbọ́ ọ̀rọ ihinrere li ẹnu mi, ki nwọn si gbagbọ́.
entries.en: And when there had been much disputing, Peter rose up, and said unto them, Men and brethren, ye know how that a good while ago God made choice among us, that the Gentiles by my mouth should hear the word of the gospel, and believe.

entries.yo: Ati Ọlọrun, ti iṣe olumọ-ọkàn, o jẹ wọn li ẹrí, o nfun wọn li Ẹmí Mimọ́, gẹgẹ bi awa:
entries.en: And God, which knoweth the hearts, bare them witness, giving them the Holy Ghost, even as he did unto us;

entries.yo: Kò si fi iyatọ si ãrin awa ati awọn, o nfi igbagbọ́ wẹ̀ wọn li ọkàn mọ́.
entries.en: And put no difference between us and them, purifying their hearts by faith.

entries.yo: Njẹ nitorina ẽṣe ti ẹnyin o fi dán Ọlọrun wò, lati fi àjaga bọ̀ awọn ọmọ-ẹhin li ọrùn, eyiti awọn baba wa ati awa kò le rù?
entries.en: Now therefore why tempt ye God, to put a yoke upon the neck of the disciples, which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awa gbagbọ́ pe nipa ore-ọfẹ Oluwa Jesu awa ó là, gẹgẹ bi awọn.
entries.en: But we believe that through the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ we shall be saved, even as they.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ajọ si dakẹ, nwọn si fi eti si Barnaba on Paulu, ti nwọn nròhin iṣẹ aṣẹ ati iṣẹ àmi ti Ọlọrun ti ti ọwọ́ wọn ṣe lãrin awọn Keferi.
entries.en: Then all the multitude kept silence, and gave audience to Barnabas and Paul, declaring what miracles and wonders God had wrought among the Gentiles by them.

entries.yo: Lẹhin ti nwọn si dakẹ, Jakọbu dahùn, wipe, Ará, ẹ gbọ ti emi:
entries.en: And after they had held their peace, James answered, saying, Men and brethren, hearken unto me:

entries.yo: Simeoni ti rohin bi Ọlọrun li akọṣe ti bojuwò awọn Keferi, lati yàn enia ninu wọn fun orukọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Simeon hath declared how God at the first did visit the Gentiles, to take out of them a people for his name.

entries.yo: Ati eyiyi li ọ̀rọ awọn woli ba ṣe dede; bi a ti kọwe rẹ̀ pe,
entries.en: And to this agree the words of the prophets; as it is written,

entries.yo: Lẹhin nkan wọnyi li emi o pada, emi o si tún agọ́ Dafidi pa ti o ti wó lulẹ; emi ó si tún ahoro rẹ̀ kọ́, emi ó si gbé e ró:
entries.en: After this I will return, and will build again the tabernacle of David, which is fallen down; and I will build again the ruins thereof, and I will set it up:

entries.yo: Ki awọn enia iyokù le mã wá Oluwa, ati gbogbo awọn Keferi lara ẹniti a npè orukọ mi,
entries.en: That the residue of men might seek after the Lord, and all the Gentiles, upon whom my name is called, saith the Lord, who doeth all these things.

entries.yo: Li Oluwa wi, ẹniti o sọ gbogbo nkan wọnyi di mimọ̀ fun Ọlọrun ni iṣẹ rẹ̀ gbogbo, lati igba ọjọ ìwa.
entries.en: Known unto God are all his works from the beginning of the world.

entries.yo: Njẹ ìmọràn temi ni, ki a máṣe yọ awọn ti o yipada si Ọlọrun lẹnu ninu awọn Keferi:
entries.en: Wherefore my sentence is, that we trouble not them, which from among the Gentiles are turned to God:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ki a kọwe si wọn, ki nwọn ki o fà sẹhin kuro ninu ẽri oriṣa, ati kuro ninu àgbere, ati kuro ninu ohun ilọlọrun-pa, ati kuro ninu ẹ̀jẹ.
entries.en: But that we write unto them, that they abstain from pollutions of idols, and from fornication, and from things strangled, and from blood.

entries.yo: Mose nigba atijọ sa ní awọn ti nwasu rẹ̀ ni ilu gbogbo, a ma kà a ninu sinagogu li ọjọjọ isimi.
entries.en: For Moses of old time hath in every city them that preach him, being read in the synagogues every sabbath day.

entries.yo: Nigbana li o tọ́ loju awọn aposteli, ati awọn àgbagbà pẹlu gbogbo ijọ, lati yàn enia ninu wọn, ati lati ran wọn lọ si Antioku pẹlu Paulu on Barnaba: Juda ti a npè apele rẹ̀ ni Barsaba, ati Sila, ẹniti o l'orukọ ninu awọn arakunrin.
entries.en: Then pleased it the apostles and elders, with the whole church, to send chosen men of their own company to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas; namely, Judas surnamed Barsabas, and Silas, chief men among the brethren:

entries.yo: Nwọn si kọ iwe le wọn lọwọ bayi pe, Awọn aposteli, ati awọn àgbagbà, ati awọn arakunrin, kí awọn arakunrin ti o wà ni Antioku, ati ni Siria, ati ni Kilikia ninu awọn Keferi:
entries.en: And they wrote letters by them after this manner; The apostles and elders and brethren send greeting unto the brethren which are of the Gentiles in Antioch and Syria and Cilicia:

entries.yo: Niwọnbi awa ti gbọ́ pe, awọn kan ti o ti ọdọ wa jade lọ fi ọ̀rọ yọ nyin li ẹnu, ti nwọn nyi nyin li ọkàn po, wipe, Ẹnyin kò gbọdọ ṣaima kọ ilà, ati ṣaima pa ofin Mose mọ́: ẹniti awa kò fun li aṣẹ:
entries.en: Forasmuch as we have heard, that certain which went out from us have troubled you with words, subverting your souls, saying, Ye must be circumcised, and keep the law: to whom we gave no such commandment:

entries.yo: O yẹ loju awa, bi awa ti fi imọ ṣọkan lati yàn enia ati lati rán wọn si nyin, pẹlu Barnaba on Paulu awọn olufẹ wa.
entries.en: It seemed good unto us, being assembled with one accord, to send chosen men unto you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,

entries.yo: Awọn ọkunrin ti o fi ẹmí wọn wewu nitori orukọ Oluwa wa Jesu Kristi.
entries.en: Men that have hazarded their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.

entries.yo: Nitorina awa rán Juda on Sila, awọn ti yio si fi ọ̀rọ ẹnu sọ ohun kanna fun nyin.
entries.en: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who shall also tell you the same things by mouth.

entries.yo: Nitori o dara loju Ẹmi Mimọ́, ati loju wa, ki a máṣe dì ẹrù kà nyin, jù nkan ti a ko le ṣe alaiṣe wọnyi lọ:
entries.en: For it seemed good to the Holy Ghost, and to us, to lay upon you no greater burden than these necessary things;

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o fà sẹhin kuro ninu ẹran apabọ oriṣa, ati ninu ẹ̀jẹ ati ninu ohun ilọlọrun-pa, ati ninu àgbere: ninu ohun ti, bi ẹnyin ba pa ara nyin mọ́ kuro, ẹnyin ó ṣe rere. Alafia.
entries.en: That ye abstain from meats offered to idols, and from blood, and from things strangled, and from fornication: from which if ye keep yourselves, ye shall do well. Fare ye well.
