entries.yo: Njẹ nigbati nwọn si jọwọ wọn lọwọ lọ, nwọn sọkalẹ wá si Antioku: nigbati nwọn si pè apejọ, nwọn fi iwe na fun wọn.
entries.en: So when they were dismissed, they came to Antioch: and when they had gathered the multitude together, they delivered the epistle:

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si kà a, nwọn yọ̀ fun itunu na.
entries.en: Which when they had read, they rejoiced for the consolation.

entries.yo: Bi Juda on Sila tikarawọn ti jẹ woli pẹlu, nwọn fi ọ̀rọ pipọ gbà awọn arakunrin niyanju, nwọn si mu wọn li ọkàn le.
entries.en: And Judas and Silas, being prophets also themselves, exhorted the brethren with many words, and confirmed them.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si pẹ diẹ, awọn arakunrin jọwọ wọn lọwọ lọ li alafia si ọdọ awọn ti o ran wọn.
entries.en: And after they had tarried there a space, they were let go in peace from the brethren unto the apostles.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn o wù Sila lati gbé ibẹ̀.
entries.en: Notwithstanding it pleased Silas to abide there still.

entries.yo: Paulu on Barnaba si duro diẹ ni Antioku, nwọn nkọ́ni, nwọn si nwasu ọ̀rọ Oluwa, ati awọn pipọ miran pẹlu wọn.
entries.en: Paul also and Barnabas continued in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.

entries.yo: Lẹhin ijọ melokan, Paulu si sọ fun Barnaba pe, Jẹ ki a tún pada lọ íbẹ awọn arakunrin wa wò, bi nwọn ti nṣe, ni ilu gbogbo ti awa ti wasu ọ̀rọ Oluwa.
entries.en: And some days after Paul said unto Barnabas, Let us go again and visit our brethren in every city where we have preached the word of the Lord, and see how they do.

entries.yo: Barnaba si pinnu rẹ̀ lati mu Johanu lọ pẹlu wọn, ẹniti apele rẹ̀ jẹ Marku.
entries.en: And Barnabas determined to take with them John, whose surname was Mark.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Paulu rò pe, kò yẹ lati mu u lọ pẹlu wọn, ẹniti o fi wọn silẹ ni Pamfilia, ti kò si ba wọn lọ si iṣẹ na.
entries.en: But Paul thought not good to take him with them, who departed from them from Pamphylia, and went not with them to the work.

entries.yo: Ìja na si pọ̀ tobẹ̃, ti nwọn yà ara wọn si meji: nigbati Barnaba si mu Marku, o ba ti ọkọ̀ lọ si Kipru;
entries.en: And the contention was so sharp between them, that they departed asunder one from the other: and so Barnabas took Mark, and sailed unto Cyprus;

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Paulu yàn Sila, o si lọ, bi a ti fi i lé ore-ọfẹ Oluwa lọwọ lati ọdọ awọn arakunrin.
entries.en: And Paul chose Silas, and departed, being recommended by the brethren unto the grace of God.

entries.yo: O si là Siria on Kilikia lọ, o nmu ijọ li ọkàn le.
entries.en: And he went through Syria and Cilicia, confirming the churches.

entries.yo: O si wá si Derbe on Listra: si kiyesi i, ọmọ-ẹhin kan wà nibẹ̀, ti a npè ni Timotiu, ọmọ obinrin kan ti iṣe Ju, ti o gbagbọ́; ṣugbọn Hellene ni baba rẹ̀:
entries.en: Then came he to Derbe and Lystra: and, behold, a certain disciple was there, named Timotheus, the son of a certain woman, which was a Jewess, and believed; but his father was a Greek:

entries.yo: Ẹniti a rohin rẹ̀ rere lọdọ awọn arakunrin ti o wà ni Listra ati Ikonioni.
entries.en: Which was well reported of by the brethren that were at Lystra and Iconium.

entries.yo: On ni Paulu fẹ ki o ba on lọ; o si mu u, o si kọ ọ ni ilà, nitori awọn Ju ti o wà li àgbegbe wọnni: nitori gbogbo wọn mọ̀ pe, Hellene ni baba rẹ̀.
entries.en: Him would Paul have to go forth with him; and took and circumcised him because of the Jews which were in those quarters: for they knew all that his father was a Greek.

entries.yo: Bi nwọn si ti nlà awọn ilu lọ, nwọn nfi awọn aṣẹ ti a ti pinnu le wọn lọwọ lati mã pa wọn mọ, lati ọdọ awọn aposteli ati awọn àgbagbà wá ti o wà ni Jerusalemu.
entries.en: And as they went through the cities, they delivered them the decrees for to keep, that were ordained of the apostles and elders which were at Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni awọn ijọ si fẹsẹmulẹ ni igbagbọ́, nwọn si npọ̀ si i ni iye lojojumọ.
entries.en: And so were the churches established in the faith, and increased in number daily.

entries.yo: Nwọn si là ẹkùn Frigia já, ati Galatia, ti a ti ọdọ Ẹmí Mimọ́ kọ̀ fun wọn lati sọ ọ̀rọ na ni Asia.
entries.en: Now when they had gone throughout Phrygia and the region of Galatia, and were forbidden of the Holy Ghost to preach the word in Asia,

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn de ọkankan Misia, nwọn gbé e wò lati lọ si Bitinia: ṣugbọn Ẹmí Jesu kò gbà fun wọn.
entries.en: After they were come to Mysia, they assayed to go into Bithynia: but the Spirit suffered them not.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si kọja lẹba Misia, nwọn sọkalẹ lọ si Troasi.
entries.en: And they passing by Mysia came down to Troas.

entries.yo: Iran kan si hàn si Paulu li oru: ọkunrin kan ara Makedonia duro, o si mbẹ̀ ẹ, wipe, Rekọja wá si Makedonia, ki o si ran wa lọwọ.
entries.en: And a vision appeared to Paul in the night; There stood a man of Macedonia, and prayed him, saying, Come over into Macedonia, and help us.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si ti ri iran na, lọgán awa mura lati lọ si Makedonia, a si gbà pe, Oluwa ti pè wa lati wasu ihinrere fun wọn.
entries.en: And after he had seen the vision, immediately we endeavored to go into Macedonia, assuredly gathering that the Lord had called us for to preach the gospel unto them.

entries.yo: Nitorina nigbati awa ṣikọ̀ ni Troasi a ba ọ̀na tàra lọ si Samotrakea, ni ijọ keji a si de Neapoli;
entries.en: Therefore loosing from Troas, we came with a straight course to Samothracia, and the next day to Neapolis;

entries.yo: Lati ibẹ̀ awa si lọ si Filippi, ti iṣe ilu Makedonia, olu ilu ìha ibẹ, ilu labẹ Romani: awa si joko ni ilu yi fun ijọ melokan.
entries.en: And from thence to Philippi, which is the chief city of that part of Macedonia, and a colony: and we were in that city abiding certain days.

entries.yo: Lọjọ isimi, awa si jade lọ si ẹhin odi ilu na, lẹba odò kan, nibiti a rò pe ibi adura wà; awa si joko, a si ba awọn obinrin ti o pejọ sọrọ.
entries.en: And on the sabbath we went out of the city by a river side, where prayer was wont to be made; and we sat down, and spake unto the women which resorted thither.

entries.yo: Ati obinrin kan ti orukọ rẹ̀ ijẹ Lidia, elesè àluko, ara ilu Tiatira, ẹniti o nsìn Ọlọrun, o gbọ́ ọ̀rọ wa: ọkàn ẹniti Oluwa ṣí, fetísi ohun ti a ti ẹnu Paulu sọ.
entries.en: And a certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, of the city of Thyatira, which worshipped God, heard us: whose heart the Lord opened, that she attended unto the things which were spoken of Paul.

entries.yo: Nigbati a si baptisi rẹ̀, ati awọn ará ile rẹ̀, o bẹ̀ wa, wipe, Bi ẹnyin ba kà mi li olõtọ si Oluwa, ẹ wá si ile mi, ki ẹ si wọ̀ nibẹ̀. O si rọ̀ wa.
entries.en: And when she was baptized, and her household, she besought us, saying, If ye have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come into my house, and abide there. And she constrained us.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, bi awa ti nlọ si ibi adura na, ọmọbinrin kan ti o li ẹmi afọṣẹ, pade wa, ẹniti o fi afọṣẹ mu ère pipọ fun awọn oluwa rẹ̀ wá:
entries.en: And it came to pass, as we went to prayer, a certain damsel possessed with a spirit of divination met us, which brought her masters much gain by soothsaying:

entries.yo: On na li o ntọ̀ Paulu ati awa lẹhin, o si nkigbe, wipe, Awọn ọkunrin wọnyi ni iranṣẹ Ọlọrun Ọgá-ogo, ti nkede ọ̀na igbala fun nyin.
entries.en: The same followed Paul and us, and cried, saying, These men are the servants of the most high God, which shew unto us the way of salvation.

entries.yo: O si nṣe eyi li ọjọ pipọ. Ṣugbọn nigbati inu Paulu bajẹ, ti o si yipada, o wi fun ẹmí na pe, Mo paṣẹ fun ọ li orukọ Jesu Kristi kí o jade kuro lara rẹ̀. O si jade ni wakati kanna.
entries.en: And this did she many days. But Paul, being grieved, turned and said to the spirit, I command thee in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her. And he came out the same hour.

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn oluwa rẹ̀ si ri pe, igbẹkẹle ère wọn pin, nwọn mu Paulu on Sila, nwọn si wọ́ wọn lọ si ọjà tọ̀ awọn ijoye lọ;
entries.en: And when her masters saw that the hope of their gains was gone, they caught Paul and Silas, and drew them into the marketplace unto the rulers,

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si mu wọn tọ̀ awọn onidajọ lọ, nwọn wipe, Awọn ọkunrin wọnyi ti iṣe Ju, nwọn nyọ ilu wa lẹnu jọjọ;
entries.en: And brought them to the magistrates, saying, These men, being Jews, do exceedingly trouble our city,

entries.yo: Nwọn si nkọni li àṣa ti kò yẹ fun wa, awa ẹniti iṣe ara Romu, lati gbà, ati lati tẹle.
entries.en: And teach customs, which are not lawful for us to receive, neither to observe, being Romans.

entries.yo: Ọpọ enia si jumọ dide si wọn: awọn olori si fà wọn li aṣọ ya, nwọn si paṣẹ pe, ki a fi ọgọ lù wọn.
entries.en: And the multitude rose up together against them: and the magistrates rent off their clothes, and commanded to beat them.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si lù wọn pupọ, nwọn sọ wọn sinu tubu, nwọn kìlọ fun onitubu ki o pa wọn mọ́ daradara:
entries.en: And when they had laid many stripes upon them, they cast them into prison, charging the jailor to keep them safely:

entries.yo: Nigbati o gbọ́ irú ikilọ bẹ̃, o sọ wọn sinu tubu ti inu lọhun, o si kàn ãbà mọ wọn li ẹsẹ.
entries.en: Who, having received such a charge, thrust them into the inner prison, and made their feet fast in the stocks.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn larin ọganjọ Paulu on Sila ngbadura, nwọn si nkọrin iyìn si Ọlọrun: awọn ara tubu si ntẹti si wọn.
entries.en: And at midnight Paul and Silas prayed, and sang praises unto God: and the prisoners heard them.

entries.yo: Lojiji iṣẹlẹ nla si ṣẹ̀, tobẹ̃ ti ipilẹ ile tubu mi titi: lọgan gbogbo ilẹkun si ṣí, ìde gbogbo wọn si tu silẹ.
entries.en: And suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison were shaken: and immediately all the doors were opened, and every one's bands were loosed.

entries.yo: Nigbati onitubu si tají, ti o si ri pe, awọn ikẹkun tubu ti ṣí silẹ, o fà idà rẹ̀ yọ, o si fẹ pa ara rẹ̀, o ṣebi awọn ara tubu ti sá lọ.
entries.en: And the keeper of the prison awaking out of his sleep, and seeing the prison doors open, he drew out his sword, and would have killed himself, supposing that the prisoners had been fled.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Paulu kọ kàrá, wipe, Máṣe pa ara rẹ lara: nitori gbogbo wa mbẹ nihinyi.
entries.en: But Paul cried with a loud voice, saying, Do thyself no harm: for we are all here.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si bere iná, o bẹ́ sinu ile, o nwariri, o wolẹ niwaju Paulu on Sila.
entries.en: Then he called for a light, and sprang in, and came trembling, and fell down before Paul and Silas,

entries.yo: O si mu wọn jade, o ni, Alàgba, kini ki emi ki o ṣe ki ng le là?
entries.en: And brought them out, and said, Sirs, what must I do to be saved?

entries.yo: Nwọn si wi fun u pe, Gbà Jesu Kristi Oluwa gbọ́, a o si gbà ọ là, iwọ ati awọn ará ile rẹ pẹlu.
entries.en: And they said, Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ, and thou shalt be saved, and thy house.

entries.yo: Nwọn si sọ ọ̀rọ Oluwa fun u, ati fun gbogbo awọn ará ile rẹ̀.
entries.en: And they spake unto him the word of the Lord, and to all that were in his house.

entries.yo: O si mu wọn ni wakati na li oru, o wẹ̀ ọgbẹ wọn; a si baptisi rẹ̀, ati gbogbo awọn enia rẹ̀ lojukanna.
entries.en: And he took them the same hour of the night, and washed their stripes; and was baptized, he and all his, straightway.

entries.yo: O si mu wọn wá si ile rẹ̀, o si gbé onjẹ kalẹ niwaju wọn, o si yọ̀ gidigidi pẹlu gbogbo awọn ará ile rẹ̀, nitori o gbà Ọlọrun gbọ.
entries.en: And when he had brought them into his house, he set meat before them, and rejoiced, believing in God with all his house.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati ilẹ mọ́, awọn onidajọ rán awọn ọlọpa pe, Da awọn enia wọnni silẹ.
entries.en: And when it was day, the magistrates sent the serjeants, saying, Let those men go.

entries.yo: Onitubu si sọ ọrọ na fun Paulu, wipe, Awọn onidajọ ranṣẹ pe ki a dá nyin silẹ: njẹ nisisiyi ẹ jade ki ẹ si mã lọ li alafia.
entries.en: And the keeper of the prison told this saying to Paul, The magistrates have sent to let you go: now therefore depart, and go in peace.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Paulu wi fun wọn pe, Nwọn lù wa ni gbangba, nwọn si sọ wa sinu tubu li aijẹbi, awa ẹniti iṣe ara Romu: nisisiyi nwọn si fẹ ti wa jade nikọ̀kọ? agbẹdọ; ṣugbọn ki awọn tikarawọn wá mu wa jade.
entries.en: But Paul said unto them, They have beaten us openly uncondemned, being Romans, and have cast us into prison; and now do they thrust us out privily? nay verily; but let them come themselves and fetch us out.

entries.yo: Awọn ọlọpa si sọ ọrọ wọnyi fun awọn onidajọ: ẹ̀ru si bà wọn, nigbati nwọn gbọ́ pe ara Romu ni nwọn.
entries.en: And the serjeants told these words unto the magistrates: and they feared, when they heard that they were Romans.

entries.yo: Nwọn si wá, nwọn ṣìpẹ fun wọn, nwọn si mu wọn jade, nwọn si bẹ̀ wọn pe, ki nwọn ki o jade kuro ni ilu na.
entries.en: And they came and besought them, and brought them out, and desired them to depart out of the city.

entries.yo: Nwọn si jade ninu tubu, nwọn si wọ̀ ile Lidia lọ: nigbati nwọn si ti ri awọn arakunrin, nwọn tù wọn ninu, nwọn si jade kuro.
entries.en: And they went out of the prison, and entered into the house of Lydia and when they had seen the brethren, they comforted them, and departed.

entries.yo: NIGBATI nwọn si ti kọja Amfipoli ati Apollonia, nwọn wá si Tessalonika, nibiti sinagogu awọn Ju wà:
entries.en: Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where was a synagogue of the Jews:

entries.yo: Ati Paulu, gẹgẹbi iṣe rẹ̀, o wọle tọ̀ wọn lọ, li ọjọ isimi mẹta o si mba wọn fi ọ̀rọ we ọ̀rọ ninu iwe-mimọ́,
entries.en: And Paul, as his manner was, went in unto them, and three sabbath days reasoned with them out of the scriptures,

entries.yo: O ntumọ, o si nfihàn pe, Kristi kò le ṣaima jìya, ki o si jinde kuro ninu okú; ati pe, Jesu yi, ẹniti emi nwasu fun nyin, on ni Kristi na.
entries.en: Opening and alleging, that Christ must needs have suffered, and risen again from the dead; and that this Jesus, whom I preach unto you, is Christ.

entries.yo: A si yi ninu wọn lọkàn pada, nwọn si darapọ̀ mọ́ Paulu on Sila; ati ninu awọn olufọkansìn Hellene ọ̀pọ pupọ, ati ninu awọn obinrin ọlọlá, kì iṣe diẹ.
entries.en: And some of them believed, and consorted with Paul and Silas; and of the devout Greeks a great multitude, and of the chief women not a few.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn Ju jowu, nwọn si fà awọn jagidijagan ninu awọn ijajẹ enia mọra, nwọn gbá ẹgbẹ jọ, nwọn si nrú ilu; nwọn si kọlù ile Jasoni, nwọn nfẹ mu wọn jade tọ̀ awọn enia wá.
entries.en: But the Jews which believed not, moved with envy, took unto them certain lewd fellows of the baser sort, and gathered a company, and set all the city on an uproar, and assaulted the house of Jason, and sought to bring them out to the people.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn kò si ri wọn, nwọn wọ́ Jasoni, ati awọn arakunrin kan tọ̀ awọn olori ilu lọ, nwọn nkigbe pe, Awọn wọnyi ti o ti yi aiye po wá si ihinyi pẹlu;
entries.en: And when they found them not, they drew Jason and certain brethren unto the rulers of the city, crying, These that have turned the world upside down are come hither also;

entries.yo: Awọn ẹniti Jasoni gbà si ọdọ: gbogbo awọn wọnyi li o si nhuwa lodi si aṣẹ Kesari, wipe, ọba miran kan wà, Jesu.
entries.en: Whom Jason hath received: and these all do contrary to the decrees of Caesar, saying that there is another king, one Jesus.

entries.yo: Awọn enia ati awọn olori ilu kò ni ibalẹ aiya nigbati nwọn gbọ́ nkan wọnyi.
entries.en: And they troubled the people and the rulers of the city, when they heard these things.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si gbà ogò lọwọ Jasoni ati awọn iyokù, nwọn jọwọ lọ.
entries.en: And when they had taken security of Jason, and of the other, they let them go.

entries.yo: Lọgan awọn arakunrin si rán Paulu on Sila lọ si Berea li oru: nigbati nwọn si de ibẹ̀, nwọn wọ̀ inu sinagogu awọn Ju lọ.
entries.en: And the brethren immediately sent away Paul and Silas by night unto Berea: who coming thither went into the synagogue of the Jews.

entries.yo: Awọn wọnyi si ni iyìn jù awọn ti Tessalonika lọ, niti pe nwọn fi tọkantọkan gbà ọ̀rọ na, nwọn si nwá inu iwe-mimọ́ lojojumọ́ bi nkan wọnyi ri bẹ̃.
entries.en: These were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, and searched the scriptures daily, whether those things were so.

entries.yo: Nitorina pipọ ninu wọn gbagbọ́; ati ninu awọn obinrin Hellene ọlọlá, ati ninu awọn ọkunrin, kì iṣe diẹ.
entries.en: Therefore many of them believed; also of honourable women which were Greeks, and of men, not a few.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati awọn Ju ti Tessalonika mọ̀ pe, Paulu nwasu ọ̀rọ Ọlọrun ni Berea, nwọn si wá sibẹ̀ pẹlu, nwọn rú awọn enia soke.
entries.en: But when the Jews of Thessalonica had knowledge that the word of God was preached of Paul at Berea, they came thither also, and stirred up the people.

entries.yo: Nigbana li awọn arakunrin rán Paulu jade lọgan lati lọ titi de okun: Ṣugbọn Sila on Timotiu duro sibẹ̀.
entries.en: And then immediately the brethren sent away Paul to go as it were to the sea: but Silas and Timotheus abode there still.

entries.yo: Awọn ti o sin Paulu wá si mu u lọ titi de Ateni; nigbati nwọn si gbà aṣẹ lọdọ rẹ̀ tọ̀ Sila on Timotiu wá pe, ki nwọn ki o yára tọ̀ on wá, nwọn lọ.
entries.en: And they that conducted Paul brought him unto Athens: and receiving a commandment unto Silas and Timotheus for to come to him with all speed, they departed.

entries.yo: Nigbati Paulu duro dè wọn ni Ateni, ọkàn rẹ̀ rú ninu rẹ̀, nigbati o ri pe ilu na kún fun oriṣa.
entries.en: Now while Paul waited for them at Athens, his spirit was stirred in him, when he saw the city wholly given to idolatry.

entries.yo: Nitorina o mba awọn Ju fi ọ̀rọ̀ we ọ̀rọ̀ ninu sinagogu, ati awọn olufọkansin, ati awọn ti o mba pade lọja lojojumọ.
entries.en: Therefore disputed he in the synagogue with the Jews, and with the devout persons, and in the market daily with them that met with him.

entries.yo: Ninu awọn Epikurei pẹlu, ati awọn ọjọgbọ́n Stoiki kótì i. Awọn kan si nwipe, Kili alahesọ yi yio ri wi? awọn miran si wipe, O dabi oniwasu ajeji oriṣa: nitoriti o nwasu Jesu, on ajinde fun wọn.
entries.en: Then certain philosophers of the Epicureans, and of the Stoicks, encountered him. And some said, What will this babbler say? other some, He seemeth to be a setter forth of strange gods: because he preached unto them Jesus, and the resurrection.

entries.yo: Nwọn si mu u, nwọn si fà a lọ si Areopagu, nwọn wipe, A ha le mọ̀ kili ẹkọ́ titun ti iwọ nsọrọ rẹ̀ yi jẹ́.
entries.en: And they took him, and brought him unto Areopagus, saying, May we know what this new doctrine, whereof thou speakest, is?

entries.yo: Nitoriti iwọ mu ohun ajeji wá si etí wa: awa si nfẹ mọ̀ kini itumọ nkan wọnyi.
entries.en: For thou bringest certain strange things to our ears: we would know therefore what these things mean.

entries.yo: Nitori gbogbo awọn ará Ateni, ati awọn alejò ti nṣe atipo nibẹ kì iṣe ohun miran jù, ki a mã sọ tabi ki a ma gbọ́ ohun titun lọ.
entries.en: (For all the Athenians and strangers which were there spent their time in nothing else, but either to tell, or to hear some new thing.)

entries.yo: Paulu si dide duro larin Areopagu, o ni, Ẹnyin ará Ateni, mo woye pe li ohun gbogbo ẹ kun fun oniruru isin ju.
entries.en: Then Paul stood in the midst of Mars' hill, and said, Ye men of Athens, I perceive that in all things ye are too superstitious.

entries.yo: Nitori bi mo ti nkọja lọ, ti mo wò ohun wọnni ti ẹnyin nsìn, mo si ri pẹpẹ kan ti a kọ akọle yi si, FUN ỌLỌRUN AIMỌ̀. Njẹ ẹniti ẹnyin nsìn li aimọ̀ on na li emi nsọ fun nyin.
entries.en: For as I passed by, and beheld your devotions, I found an altar with this inscription, TO THE UNKNOWN GOD. Whom therefore ye ignorantly worship, him declare I unto you.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun na ti o da aiye ati ohun gbogbo ti mbẹ ninu rẹ̀, on na ti iṣe Oluwa ọrun on aiye, kì igbé ile ti a fi ọwọ́ kọ́;
entries.en: God that made the world and all things therein, seeing that he is Lord of heaven and earth, dwelleth not in temples made with hands;

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni a kì ifi ọwọ́ enia sìn i, bi ẹnipe o nfẹ nkan, on li o fi ìye ati ẽmi ati ohun gbogbo fun gbogbo enia,
entries.en: Neither is worshipped with men's hands, as though he needed any thing, seeing he giveth to all life, and breath, and all things;

entries.yo: O si ti fi ẹ̀jẹ kanna da gbogbo orilẹ-ede lati tẹ̀do si oju agbaiye, o si ti pinnu akokò ti a yàn tẹlẹ, ati àla ibugbe wọn;
entries.en: And hath made of one blood all nations of men for to dwell on all the face of the earth, and hath determined the times before appointed, and the bounds of their habitation;

entries.yo: Ki nwọn ki o le mã wá Oluwa, boya bi ọkàn wọn ba le fà si i, ti wọn si ri i, bi o tilẹ ṣe pe kò jina si olukuluku wa:
entries.en: That they should seek the Lord, if haply they might feel after him, and find him, though he be not far from every one of us:

entries.yo: Nitori ninu rẹ̀ li awa gbé wà li ãye, ti awa nrìn kiri, ti a si li ẹmí wa; bi awọn kan ninu awọn olorin, ẹnyin tikaranyin ti wipe, Awa pẹlu si jẹ ọmọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: For in him we live, and move, and have our being; as certain also of your own poets have said, For we are also his offspring.

entries.yo: Njẹ bi awa ba ṣe ọmọ Ọlọrun, kò yẹ fun wa ki a rò pe, Iwa-Ọlọrun dabi wura, tabi fadaka, tabi okuta, ti a fi ọgbọ́n ati ihumọ enia ṣe li ọnà.
entries.en: Forasmuch then as we are the offspring of God, we ought not to think that the Godhead is like unto gold, or silver, or stone, graven by art and man's device.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu igba aimọ̀ yi li Ọlọrun ti foju fò da; ṣugbọn nisisiyi o paṣẹ fun gbogbo enia nibi gbogbo lati ronupiwada:
entries.en: And the times of this ignorance God winked at; but now commandeth all men every where to repent:

entries.yo: Niwọnbi o ti da ọjọ kan, ninu eyi ti yio ṣe idajọ aiye li ododo, nipasẹ ọkunrin na ti o ti yàn, nigbati o ti fi ohun idaniloju fun gbogbo enia, niti o jí i dide kuro ninu okú.
entries.en: Because he hath appointed a day, in the which he will judge the world in righteousness by that man whom he hath ordained; whereof he hath given assurance unto all men, in that he hath raised him from the dead.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn ti gbọ́ ti ajinde okú, awọn miran nṣẹ̀fẹ: ṣugbọn awọn miran wipe, Awa o tún nkan yi gbọ́ li ẹnu rẹ.
entries.en: And when they heard of the resurrection of the dead, some mocked: and others said, We will hear thee again of this matter.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Paulu si jade kuro larin wọn.
entries.en: So Paul departed from among them.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn ọkunrin kan fi ara mọ́ ọ, nwọn si gbagbọ́: ninu awọn ẹniti Dionisiu ara Areopagu wà, ati obinrin kan ti a npè ni Damari, ati awọn miran pẹlu wọn.
entries.en: Howbeit certain men clave unto him, and believed: among the which was Dionysius the Areopagite, and a woman named Damaris, and others with them.

entries.yo: LẸHIN nkan wọnyi, Paulu jade kuro ni Ateni, o si lọ si Korinti;
entries.en: After these things Paul departed from Athens, and came to Corinth;

entries.yo: O si ri Ju kan ti a npè ni Akuila, ti a bí ni Pontu, ti o ti Itali de nilọ̃lọ̃, pẹlu Priskilla aya rẹ̀; nitoriti Klaudiu paṣẹ pe, ki gbogbo awọn Ju ki o jade kuro ni Romu: o si tọ̀ wọn wá.
entries.en: And found a certain Jew named Aquila, born in Pontus, lately come from Italy, with his wife Priscilla; (because that Claudius had commanded all Jews to depart from Rome:) and came unto them.

entries.yo: Ati itori ti iṣe oniṣẹ ọnà kanna, o ba wọn joko, o si nṣiṣẹ: nitori agọ́ pipa ni iṣẹ ọnà wọn.
entries.en: And because he was of the same craft, he abode with them, and wrought: for by their occupation they were tentmakers.

entries.yo: O si nfọ̀rọ̀ we ọrọ fun wọn ninu sinagogu li ọjọjọ isimi, o si nyi awọn Ju ati awọn Hellene li ọkàn pada.
entries.en: And he reasoned in the synagogue every sabbath, and persuaded the Jews and the Greeks.

entries.yo: Nigbati Sila on Timotiu si ti Makedonia wá, ọrọ na ká Paulu lara, o nfi hàn, o sọ fun awọn Ju pe, Jesu ni Kristi na.
entries.en: And when Silas and Timotheus were come from Macedonia, Paul was pressed in the spirit, and testified to the Jews that Jesus was Christ.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si wà li òdi, ti nwọn si nsọrọ-odi, o gbọ̀n aṣọ rẹ̀, o si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ̀jẹ nyin mbẹ lori ara nyin; ọrùn emi mọ́: lati isisiyi lọ emi o tọ̀ awọn Keferi lọ.
entries.en: And when they opposed themselves, and blasphemed, he shook his raiment, and said unto them, Your blood be upon your own heads; I am clean: from henceforth I will go unto the Gentiles.

entries.yo: O si lọ kuro nibẹ̀, o wọ̀ ile ọkunrin kan ti a npè ni Titu Justu, ẹniti o nsìn Ọlọrun ti ile rẹ̀ fi ara mọ́ sinagogu tímọ́tímọ́.
entries.en: And he departed thence, and entered into a certain man's house, named Justus, one that worshipped God, whose house joined hard to the synagogue.

entries.yo: Ati Krispu, olori sinagogu, o gbà Oluwa gbọ́ pẹlu gbogbo ile rẹ̀; ati ọ̀pọ ninu awọn ara Korinti, nigbati nwọn gbọ́, nwọn gbagbọ́, a si baptisi wọn.
entries.en: And Crispus, the chief ruler of the synagogue, believed on the Lord with all his house; and many of the Corinthians hearing believed, and were baptized.

entries.yo: Oluwa si sọ fun Paulu li oru li ojuran pe, Má bẹ̀ru, sá mã sọ, má si ṣe pa ẹnu rẹ mọ́:
entries.en: Then spake the Lord to Paul in the night by a vision, Be not afraid, but speak, and hold not thy peace:

entries.yo: Nitoriti emi wà pẹlu rẹ, kò si si ẹniti yio dide si ọ lati pa ọ lara: nitori mo li enia pipọ ni ilu yi.
entries.en: For I am with thee, and no man shall set on thee to hurt thee: for I have much people in this city.

entries.yo: O si joko nibẹ̀ li ọdún kan on oṣù mẹfa, o nkọ́ni li ọ̀rọ Ọlọrun lãrin wọn.
entries.en: And he continued there a year and six months, teaching the word of God among them.

entries.yo: Nigbati Gallioni si jẹ bãlẹ Akaia, awọn Ju fi ọkàn kan dide si Paulu, nwọn si mu u wá siwaju itẹ idajọ.
entries.en: And when Gallio was the deputy of Achaia, the Jews made insurrection with one accord against Paul, and brought him to the judgment seat,

entries.yo: Nwọn wipe, ọkunrin yi nyi awọn enia li ọkàn pada, lati mã sin Ọlọrun lodi si ofin.
entries.en: Saying, This fellow persuadeth men to worship God contrary to the law.

entries.yo: Nigbati Paulu nfẹ ati dahùn, Gallioni wi fun awọn Ju pe, Ibaṣepe ọ̀ran buburu tabi ti jagidijagan kan ni, bi ọ̀rọ ti ri, ẹnyin Ju, emi iba gbè nyin:
entries.en: And when Paul was now about to open his mouth, Gallio said unto the Jews, If it were a matter of wrong or wicked lewdness, O ye Jews, reason would that I should bear with you:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi o ba ṣe ọ̀ran nipa ọ̀rọ ati orukọ, ati ti ofin nyin ni, ki ẹnyin ki o bojuto o fun ara nyin, nitoriti emi kò fẹ ṣe onidajọ nkan bawọnni.
entries.en: But if it be a question of words and names, and of your law, look ye to it; for I will be no judge of such matters.

entries.yo: O si lé wọn kuro ni ibi itẹ idajọ.
entries.en: And he drave them from the judgment seat.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn Hellene si mu Sostene, olori sinagogu, nwọn si lù u niwaju itẹ idajọ. Gallioni kò si ṣú si nkan wọnyi.
entries.en: Then all the Greeks took Sosthenes, the chief ruler of the synagogue, and beat him before the judgment seat. And Gallio cared for none of those things.

entries.yo: Paulu si duro si i nibẹ̀ li ọjọ pipọ, nigbati o si dágbere fun awọn arakunrin, o ba ti ọkọ̀ lọ si Siria, ati Priskilla ati Akuila pẹlu rẹ̀; o ti fá ori rẹ̀ ni Kenkrea: nitoriti o ti jẹjẹ.
entries.en: And Paul after this tarried there yet a good while, and then took his leave of the brethren, and sailed thence into Syria, and with him Priscilla and Aquila; having shorn his head in Cenchrea: for he had a vow.

entries.yo: O si sọkalẹ wá si Efesu, o si fi wọn silẹ nibẹ̀: ṣugbọn on tikararẹ̀ wọ̀ inu sinagogu lọ, o si ba awọn Ju fi ọrọ we ọrọ.
entries.en: And he came to Ephesus, and left them there: but he himself entered into the synagogue, and reasoned with the Jews.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si bẹ̀ ẹ pe, ki o ba awọn joko diẹ si i, o kọ̀;
entries.en: When they desired him to tarry longer time with them, he consented not;

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn o dágbere fun wọn, o si wipe, Emi kò gbọdọ ṣaima ṣe ajọ ọdún ti mbọ̀ yi ni Jerusalemu bi o ti wù ki o ri: ṣugbọn emi ó tún pada tọ̀ nyin wá, bi Ọlọrun ba fẹ. O si ṣikọ̀ ni Efesu.
entries.en: But bade them farewell, saying, I must by all means keep this feast that cometh in Jerusalem: but I will return again unto you, if God will. And he sailed from Ephesus.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si ti gúnlẹ ni Kesarea, ti o goke, ti o si ki ijọ, o sọkalẹ lọ si Antioku.
entries.en: And when he had landed at Caesarea, and gone up, and saluted the church, he went down to Antioch.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si gbé ọjọ diẹ nibẹ̀, o lọ, o si kọja ni ilẹ Galatia on Frigia lẹsẹsẹ, o nmu gbogbo awọn ọmọ-ẹhin li ọkàn le.
entries.en: And after he had spent some time there, he departed, and went over all the country of Galatia and Phrygia in order, strengthening all the disciples.

entries.yo: Ju kan si wà ti a npè ni Apollo, ti a bí ni Aleksandria, ọkunrin ọlọrọ li ẹnu, ti o pọ̀ ni iwe-mimọ́, o wá si Efesu.
entries.en: And a certain Jew named Apollos, born at Alexandria, an eloquent man, and mighty in the scriptures, came to Ephesus.

entries.yo: Ọkunrin yi li a ti kọ́ ni ọ̀na ti Oluwa; o si ṣe ẹniti o gboná li ọkàn, o nfi ãyan nsọ̀rọ, o si nkọ́ni ni nkan ti Oluwa; kìki baptismu ti Johanu li o mọ̀.
entries.en: This man was instructed in the way of the Lord; and being fervent in the spirit, he spake and taught diligently the things of the Lord, knowing only the baptism of John.

entries.yo: O si bẹ̀rẹ si fi igboiya sọrọ ni sinagogu: nigbati Akuila on Priskilla ti gbọ́ ọ̀rọ rẹ̀, nwọn mu u si ọdọ nwọn si tubọ sọ idi ọ̀na Ọlọrun fun u dajudaju.
entries.en: And he began to speak boldly in the synagogue: whom when Aquila and Priscilla had heard, they took him unto them, and expounded unto him the way of God more perfectly.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si nfẹ kọja lọ si Akaia, awọn arakunrin gba a ni iyanju, nwọn si kọwe si awọn ọmọ-ẹhin ki nwọn ki o gba a: nigbati o si de, o ràn awọn ti o gbagbọ́ nipa ore-ọfẹ lọwọ pupọ.
entries.en: And when he was disposed to pass into Achaia, the brethren wrote, exhorting the disciples to receive him: who, when he was come, helped them much which had believed through grace:

entries.yo: Nitoriti o sọ asọye fun awọn Ju ni gbangba, o nfi i hàn ninu iwe-mimọ́ pe, Jesu ni Kristi.
entries.en: For he mightily convinced the Jews, and that publickly, shewing by the scriptures that Jesus was Christ.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati Apollo ti wà ni Korinti, ti Paulu kọja lọ niha ẹkùn oke, o wá si Efesu: o si ri awọn ọmọ-ẹhin kan;
entries.en: And it came to pass, that, while Apollos was at Corinth, Paul having passed through the upper coasts came to Ephesus: and finding certain disciples,

entries.yo: O wi fun wọn pe, Ẹnyin ha gbà Ẹmí Mimọ́ na nigbati ẹnyin gbagbọ́? Nwọn si wi fun u pe, Awa kò gbọ́ rara bi Ẹmí Mimọ́ kan wà.
entries.en: He said unto them, Have ye received the Holy Ghost since ye believed? And they said unto him, We have not so much as heard whether there be any Holy Ghost.

entries.yo: O si wipe, Njẹ baptismu wo li a ha baptisi nyin si? Nwọn si wipe, Si baptismu ti Johanu.
entries.en: And he said unto them, Unto what then were ye baptized? And they said, Unto John's baptism.

entries.yo: Paulu si wipe, Nitõtọ, ni Johanu fi baptismu ti ironupiwada baptisi, o nwi fun awọn enia pe, ki nwọn ki o gbà ẹniti mbọ̀ lẹhin on gbọ, eyini ni Kristi Jesu.
entries.en: Then said Paul, John verily baptized with the baptism of repentance, saying unto the people, that they should believe on him which should come after him, that is, on Christ Jesus.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si gbọ́, a baptisi wọn li orukọ Jesu Oluwa.
entries.en: When they heard this, they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.

entries.yo: Nigbati Paulu si gbe ọwọ́ le wọn, Ẹmí Mimọ́ si bà le wọn; nwọn si nfọ̀ ède miran, nwọn si nsọ asọtẹlẹ.
entries.en: And when Paul had laid his hands upon them, the Holy Ghost came on them; and they spake with tongues, and prophesied.

entries.yo: Iye awọn ọkunrin na gbogbo to mejila.
entries.en: And all the men were about twelve.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si wọ̀ inu sinagogu lọ, o fi igboiya sọ̀rọ li oṣù mẹta, o nfi ọ̀rọ̀ we ọ̀rọ̀, o si nyi wọn lọkan pada si nkan ti iṣe ti ijọba Ọlọrun.
entries.en: And he went into the synagogue, and spake boldly for the space of three months, disputing and persuading the things concerning the kingdom of God.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati ọkàn awọn miran ninu wọn di lile, ti nwọn kò si gbagbọ́, ti nwọn nsọ̀rọ ibi si Ọna na niwaju ijọ enia, o lọ kuro lọdọ wọn, o si yà awọn ọmọ-ẹhin sọtọ̀, o si nsọ asọye li ojojumọ́ ni ile-iwe Tirannu.
entries.en: But when divers were hardened, and believed not, but spake evil of that way before the multitude, he departed from them, and separated the disciples, disputing daily in the school of one Tyrannus.

entries.yo: Eyi nlọ bẹ̃ fun iwọn ọdún meji; tobẹ̃ ti gbogbo awọn ti ngbe Asia gbọ́ ọ̀rọ Jesu Oluwa, ati awọn Ju ati awọn Hellene.
entries.en: And this continued by the space of two years; so that all they which dwelt in Asia heard the word of the Lord Jesus, both Jews and Greeks.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si ti ọwọ́ Paulu ṣe iṣẹ aṣẹ akanṣe,
entries.en: And God wrought special miracles by the hands of Paul:

entries.yo: Tobẹ̃ ti a fi nmu gèle ati ibantẹ́ ara rẹ̀ tọ̀ awọn olokunrun lọ, arùn si fi wọn silẹ, ati awọn ẹmi buburu si jade kuro lara wọn.
entries.en: So that from his body were brought unto the sick handkerchiefs or aprons, and the diseases departed from them, and the evil spirits went out of them.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn Ju kan alarinkiri, alẹmi-èṣu-jade, dawọle e li adabọwọ ara wọn, lati pè orukọ Jesu Oluwa si awọn ti o li ẹmi buburu, wipe, Awa fi orukọ Jesu ti Paulu nwasu fi nyin bu.
entries.en: Then certain of the vagabond Jews, exorcists, took upon them to call over them which had evil spirits the name of the Lord Jesus, saying, We adjure you by Jesus whom Paul preacheth.

entries.yo: Awọn meje kan si wà, ọmọ ẹnikan ti a npè ni Skefa, Ju, ati olori kan ninu awọn alufa, ti nwọn ṣe bẹ̃.
entries.en: And there were seven sons of one Sceva, a Jew, and chief of the priests, which did so.

entries.yo: Ẹmi buburu na si dahùn, o ni, Jesu emi mọ̀, Paulu emi si mọ̀; ṣugbọn tali ẹnyin?
entries.en: And the evil spirit answered and said, Jesus I know, and Paul I know; but who are ye?

entries.yo: Nigbati ọkunrin ti ẹmi buburu wà lara rẹ̀ si fò mọ́ wọn, o ba wọn dimú, o bori wọn, bẹ̃ni nwọn sá jade kuro ni ile na ni ìhoho ati ni ifarapa.
entries.en: And the man in whom the evil spirit was leaped on them, and overcame them, and prevailed against them, so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded.

entries.yo: Ihìn yi si di mimọ̀ fun gbogbo awọn Ju ati awọn ara Hellene pẹlu ti o ṣe atipo ni Efesu; ẹ̀ru si ba gbogbo wọn, a si gbé orukọ Jesu Oluwa ga.
entries.en: And this was known to all the Jews and Greeks also dwelling at Ephesus; and fear fell on them all, and the name of the Lord Jesus was magnified.

entries.yo: Ọ̀pọ awọn ti nwọn gbagbọ́ si wá, nwọn jẹwọ, nwọn si fi iṣẹ wọn hàn.
entries.en: And many that believed came, and confessed, and shewed their deeds.

entries.yo: Kì isi ṣe diẹ ninu awọn ti nṣe àlúpàyídà li o kó iwe wọn jọ, nwọn dáná sun wọn loju gbogbo enia: nwọn si ṣírò iye wọn, nwọn si ri i, o jẹ ẹgbã-mẹdọgbọ̀n iwọn fadaka.
entries.en: Many of them also which used curious arts brought their books together, and burned them before all men: and they counted the price of them, and found it fifty thousand pieces of silver.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li ọ̀rọ Oluwa si gbilẹ si i gidigidi, o si gbilẹ.
entries.en: So mightily grew the word of God and prevailed.

entries.yo: Njẹ bi nkan wọnyi ti pari tan, Paulu pinnu rẹ̀ li ọkàn pe, nigbati on ba kọja ni Makedonia ati Akaia, on ó lọ si Jerusalemu, o wipe, Lẹhin igba ti mo ba de ibẹ̀, emi kò le ṣaima ri Romu pẹlu.
entries.en: After these things were ended, Paul purposed in the spirit, when he had passed through Macedonia and Achaia, to go to Jerusalem, saying, After I have been there, I must also see Rome.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si ti rán meji ninu awọn ti nṣe iranṣẹ fun u lọ si Makedonia, Timotiu ati Erastu, on tikararẹ̀ duro ni Asia ni igba diẹ na.
entries.en: So he sent into Macedonia two of them that ministered unto him, Timotheus and Erastus; but he himself stayed in Asia for a season.

entries.yo: Li akokò na èmìmì diẹ ki o wà nitori Ọna na.
entries.en: And the same time there arose no small stir about that way.

entries.yo: Nitori ọkunrin kan ti a npè ni Demetriu, alagbẹdẹ fadaka, ti ima fi fadaka ṣe ile-oriṣa fun Diana, o mu ère ti kò mọ̀ ni iwọn fun awọn oniṣọnà wá;
entries.en: For a certain man named Demetrius, a silversmith, which made silver shrines for Diana, brought no small gain unto the craftsmen;

entries.yo: Nigbati o pè wọn jọ, ati irú awọn ọlọnà bẹ̃, o ni, Alàgba, ẹnyin mọ̀ pe nipa iṣẹ-ọna yi li awa fi li ọrọ̀ wa.
entries.en: Whom he called together with the workmen of like occupation, and said, Sirs, ye know that by this craft we have our wealth.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin si ri, ẹ si gbọ́ pe, kì iṣe ni Efesu nikanṣoṣo ni, ṣugbọn o fẹrẹ ṣe gbogbo Asia, ni Paulu yi nyi ọ̀pọ enia li ọkàn pada, ti o si ndari wọn wipe, Ohun ti a fi ọwọ́ ṣe, kì iṣe ọlọrun.
entries.en: Moreover ye see and hear, that not alone at Ephesus, but almost throughout all Asia, this Paul hath persuaded and turned away much people, saying that they be no gods, which are made with hands:

entries.yo: Ki si iṣe pe kìki iṣẹ-ọnà wa yi li o wà li ewu ati di asan; ṣugbọn ile Diana oriṣa nla yio si di gigàn pẹlu, ati gbogbo ọla nla rẹ̀ yio si run, ẹniti gbogbo Asia ati gbogbo aiye mbọ.
entries.en: So that not only this our craft is in danger to be set at nought; but also that the temple of the great goddess Diana should be despised, and her magnificence should be destroyed, whom all Asia and the world worshippeth.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn gbọ́ ọ̀rọ wọnyi, nwọn kún fun ibinu, nwọn kigbe, wipe, Oriṣa nla ni Diana ti ara Efesu.
entries.en: And when they heard these sayings, they were full of wrath, and cried out, saying, Great is Diana of the Ephesians.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ilu na si kún fun irukerudò: nwọn fi ọkàn kan rọ́ sinu ile ibĩṣire, nwọn si mu Gaiu ati Aristarku ara Makedonia, awọn ẹgbẹ ajọrin Paulu.
entries.en: And the whole city was filled with confusion: and having caught Gaius and Aristarchus, men of Macedonia, Paul's companions in travel, they rushed with one accord into the theatre.

entries.yo: Nigbati Paulu si nfẹ wọ̀ ãrin awọn enia lọ, awọn ọmọ-ẹhin kò jẹ fun u.
entries.en: And when Paul would have entered in unto the people, the disciples suffered him not.

entries.yo: Awọn olori kan ara Asia, ti iṣe ọrẹ́ rẹ̀, ranṣẹ si i, nwọn bẹ̀ ẹ pe, ki o máṣe fi ara rẹ̀ wewu ninu ile ibiṣire.
entries.en: And certain of the chief of Asia, which were his friends, sent unto him, desiring him that he would not adventure himself into the theatre.

entries.yo: Njẹ awọn kan nwi ohun kan, awọn miran nwi omiran: nitori ajọ di rudurudu; ati ọ̀pọ enia ni kò mọ̀ itori ohun ti nwọn tilẹ fi wọjọ pọ̀ si.
entries.en: Some therefore cried one thing, and some another: for the assembly was confused; and the more part knew not wherefore they were come together.

entries.yo: Nwọn si fà Aleksanderu kuro li awujọ, awọn Ju tì i ṣaju. Aleksanderu si juwọ́ si wọn, on iba si wi ti ẹnu rẹ̀ fun awọn enia.
entries.en: And they drew Alexander out of the multitude, the Jews putting him forward. And Alexander beckoned with the hand, and would have made his defence unto the people.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati nwọn mọ̀ pe Ju ni, gbogbo wọn li ohùn kan, niwọn wakati meji ọjọ, kigbe pe, Oriṣa nla ni Diana ti ara Efesu.
entries.en: But when they knew that he was a Jew, all with one voice about the space of two hours cried out, Great is Diana of the Ephesians.

entries.yo: Nigbati akọwe ilu si mu ki ijọ enia dakẹ, o ni, Ẹnyin ará Efesu, tali ẹniti o wà ti kò mọ̀ pe, ilu ara Efesu ni iṣe olusin Diana oriṣa nla, ati ti ere ti o ti ọdọ Jupiteri bọ́ silẹ?
entries.en: And when the townclerk had appeased the people, he said, Ye men of Ephesus, what man is there that knoweth not how that the city of the Ephesians is a worshipper of the great goddess Diana, and of the image which fell down from Jupiter?

entries.yo: Njẹ bi a ko ti le sọrọ odi si nkan wọnni, o yẹ ki ẹ dakẹ, ki ẹnyin ki o máṣe fi iwara ṣe ohunkohun.
entries.en: Seeing then that these things cannot be spoken against, ye ought to be quiet, and to do nothing rashly.

entries.yo: Nitoriti ẹnyin mu awọn ọkunrin wọnyi wá, nwọn kò kó ile oriṣa, bẹ̃ni nwọn kò sọrọ-odi si oriṣa wa.
entries.en: For ye have brought hither these men, which are neither robbers of churches, nor yet blasphemers of your goddess.

entries.yo: Njẹ nitorina bi Demetriu, ati awọn oniṣọnà ti o wà pẹlu rẹ̀, ba li ọ̀rọ kan si ẹnikẹni, ile-ẹjọ ṣí silẹ, awọn onidajọ si mbẹ: jẹ ki nwọn ki o lọ ifi ara wọn sùn.
entries.en: Wherefore if Demetrius, and the craftsmen which are with him, have a matter against any man, the law is open, and there are deputies: let them implead one another.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi ẹ ba nwadi ohun kan nipa ọ̀ran miran, a ó pari rẹ̀ ni ajọ ti o tọ́.
entries.en: But if ye inquire any thing concerning other matters, it shall be determined in a lawful assembly.

entries.yo: Nitori awa sá wà li ewu ati pè bi lẽrè nitori ariwo oni yi, kò sa nidi, ati nitori eyi awa kì yio le dahun fun iwọjọ yi.
entries.en: For we are in danger to be called in question for this day's uproar, there being no cause whereby we may give an account of this concourse.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si ti sọ bẹ̃ tan, o tú ijọ na ká.
entries.en: And when he had thus spoken, he dismissed the assembly.

entries.yo: NIGBATI ariwo na si rọlẹ, Paulu ranṣẹ pè awọn ọmọ-ẹhin, o si gbà wọn ni iyanju, o dagbere fun wọn, o dide lati lọ si Makedonia.
entries.en: And after the uproar was ceased, Paul called unto him the disciples, and embraced them, and departed for to go into Macedonia.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si ti là apa ìha wọnni kọja, ti o si ti fi ọ̀rọ pipọ gbà wọn ni iyanju, o wá si ilẹ Hellene.
entries.en: And when he had gone over those parts, and had given them much exhortation, he came into Greece,

entries.yo: Nigbati o si duro nibẹ̀ li oṣù mẹta, ti awọn Ju si dèna dè e, bi o ti npete ati ba ti ọkọ̀ lọ si Siria, o pinnu rẹ̀ lati ba ti Makedonia pada lọ.
entries.en: And there abode three months. And when the Jews laid wait for him, as he was about to sail into Syria, he purposed to return through Macedonia.

entries.yo: Sopateru ara Berea ọmọ Parru si ba a lọ de Asia; ati ninu awọn ara Tessalonika, Aristarku on Sekundu; ati Gaiu ara Derbe, ati Timotiu; ati ara Asia, Tikiku on Trofimu.
entries.en: And there accompanied him into Asia Sopater of Berea; and of the Thessalonians, Aristarchus and Secundus; and Gaius of Derbe, and Timotheus; and of Asia, Tychicus and Trophimus.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn wọnyi ti lọ ṣiwaju, nwọn nduro dè wa ni Troa.
entries.en: These going before tarried for us at Troas.

entries.yo: Awa si ṣikọ̀ lati Filippi wá lẹhin ọjọ aiwukara, a si de ọdọ wọn ni Troasi ni ijọ karun; nibiti awa gbé duro ni ijọ meje.
entries.en: And we sailed away from Philippi after the days of unleavened bread, and came unto them to Troas in five days; where we abode seven days.

entries.yo: Ati ni ọjọ ikini ọ̀sẹ nigbati awọn ọmọ-ẹhin pejọ lati bù akara, Paulu si wasu fun wọn, o mura ati lọ ni ijọ keji: o si fà ọ̀rọ rẹ̀ gùn titi di arin ọganjọ.
entries.en: And upon the first day of the week, when the disciples came together to break bread, Paul preached unto them, ready to depart on the morrow; and continued his speech until midnight.

entries.yo: Fitilà pipọ si wà ni yàrá oke na, nibiti a gbé pejọ si.
entries.en: And there were many lights in the upper chamber, where they were gathered together.

entries.yo: Ọdọmọkunrin kan ti a npè ni Eutiku si joko li oju ferese, orun si wọ̀ ọ lara: bi Paulu si ti pẹ ni iwasu, o ta gbọ́ngbọ́n loju orun, o ṣubu lati oke kẹta wá silẹ, a si gbé e dide li okú.
entries.en: And there sat in a window a certain young man named Eutychus, being fallen into a deep sleep: and as Paul was long preaching, he sunk down with sleep, and fell down from the third loft, and was taken up dead.

entries.yo: Nigbati Paulu si sọkalẹ, o wolẹ bò o, o gbá a mọra, o ni, Ẹ má yọ ara nyin lẹnu; nitori ẹmí rẹ̀ mbẹ ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And Paul went down, and fell on him, and embracing him said, Trouble not yourselves; for his life is in him.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si tún gòke lọ, ti o si bù akara, ti o si jẹ, ti o si sọ̀rọ pẹ titi o fi di afẹmọjumọ́, bẹ̃li o lọ.
entries.en: When he therefore was come up again, and had broken bread, and eaten, and talked a long while, even till break of day, so he departed.

entries.yo: Nwọn si mu ọmọkunrin na bọ̀ lãye, inu nwọn si dun gidigidi.
entries.en: And they brought the young man alive, and were not a little comforted.

entries.yo: Nigbati awa si ṣaju, awa si ṣikọ̀ lọ si Asso, nibẹ̀ li a nfẹ gbà Paulu si ọkọ̀: nitori bẹ̃li o ti pinnu rẹ̀, on tikararẹ̀ nfẹ ba ti ẹsẹ lọ.
entries.en: And we went before to ship, and sailed unto Assos, there intending to take in Paul: for so had he appointed, minding himself to go afoot.

entries.yo: Nigbati o pade wa ni Asso, ti a si ti gbà a si ọkọ̀, a lọ si Mitilene.
entries.en: And when he met with us at Assos, we took him in, and came to Mitylene.

entries.yo: Nigbati a si ṣikọ̀ nibẹ̀, ni ijọ keji a de ọkankan Kio; ni ijọ keji rẹ̀ a de Samo, a si duro ni Trogillioni; ni ijọ keji rẹ̀ a si de Miletu.
entries.en: And we sailed thence, and came the next day over against Chios; and the next day we arrived at Samos, and tarried at Trogyllium; and the next day we came to Miletus.

entries.yo: Paulu sá ti pinnu rẹ̀ lati mu ọkọ̀ lọ niha Efesu, nitori ki o ma ba fi igba na joko ni Asia: nitori o nyára bi yio ṣe iṣe fun u, lati wà ni Jerusalemu li ọjọ Pentikosti.
entries.en: For Paul had determined to sail by Ephesus, because he would not spend the time in Asia: for he hasted, if it were possible for him, to be at Jerusalem the day of Pentecost.

entries.yo: Ati lati Miletu o ranṣẹ si Efesu, lati pè awọn alàgba ijọ wá sọdọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And from Miletus he sent to Ephesus, and called the elders of the church.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si de ọdọ rẹ̀, o wi fun wọn pe, Ẹnyin tikaranyin mọ̀, lati ọjọ ikini ti mo ti de Asia, bi emi ti ba nyin gbé, ni gbogbo akoko na,
entries.en: And when they were come to him, he said unto them, Ye know, from the first day that I came into Asia, after what manner I have been with you at all seasons,

entries.yo: Bi mo ti nfi ìrẹlẹ ọkàn gbogbo sìn Oluwa, ati omije pipọ, pẹlu idanwò, ti o bá mi, nipa ìdena awọn Ju:
entries.en: Serving the Lord with all humility of mind, and with many tears, and temptations, which befell me by the lying in wait of the Jews:

entries.yo: Bi emi kò ti fà sẹhin lati sọ ohunkohun ti o ṣ'anfani fun nyin, ati lati mã kọ́ nyin ni gbangba ati lati ile de ile,
entries.en: And how I kept back nothing that was profitable unto you, but have shewed you, and have taught you publickly, and from house to house,

entries.yo: Ti mo nsọ fun awọn Ju, ati fun awọn Hellene pẹlu, ti ironupiwada sipa Ọlọrun, ati ti igbagbọ́ sipa Jesu Kristi Oluwa wa.
entries.en: Testifying both to the Jews, and also to the Greeks, repentance toward God, and faith toward our Lord Jesus Christ.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, wo o, ọkàn mi nfà si ati lọ si Jerusalemu, laimọ̀ ohun ti yio bá mi nibẹ̀:
entries.en: And now, behold, I go bound in the spirit unto Jerusalem, not knowing the things that shall befall me there:

entries.yo: Bikoṣe bi Ẹmí Mimọ́ ti nsọ ni ilu gbogbo pe, ìde on ìya mbẹ fun mi.
entries.en: Save that the Holy Ghost witnesseth in every city, saying that bonds and afflictions abide me.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi kò kà ẹmi mi si nkan rara bi ohun ti o ṣọwọn fun mi, ki emi ki o ba le fi ayọ̀ pari ire-ije mi ati iṣẹ-iranṣẹ ti mo ti gbà lọdọ Jesu Oluwa, lati mã ròhin ihinrere ore-ọfẹ Ọlọrun.
entries.en: But none of these things move me, neither count I my life dear unto myself, so that I might finish my course with joy, and the ministry, which I have received of the Lord Jesus, to testify the gospel of the grace of God.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, wo o, emi mọ̀ pe gbogbo nyin, lãrin ẹniti emi ti nkiri wãsu ijọba Ọlọrun, kì yio ri oju mi mọ́.
entries.en: And now, behold, I know that ye all, among whom I have gone preaching the kingdom of God, shall see my face no more.

entries.yo: Nitorina mo pè nyin ṣe ẹlẹri loni yi pe, ọrùn mi mọ́ kuro ninu ẹ̀jẹ enia gbogbo.
entries.en: Wherefore I take you to record this day, that I am pure from the blood of all men.

entries.yo: Nitoriti emi kò fà sẹhin lati sọ gbogbo ipinnu Ọlọrun fun nyin.
entries.en: For I have not shunned to declare unto you all the counsel of God.

entries.yo: Ẹ kiyesara nyin, ati si gbogbo agbo ti Ẹmí Mimọ́ fi nyin ṣe alabojuto rẹ̀, lati mã tọju ijọ Ọlọrun, ti o ti fi ẹ̀jẹ ara rẹ̀ rà.
entries.en: Take heed therefore unto yourselves, and to all the flock, over the which the Holy Ghost hath made you overseers, to feed the church of God, which he hath purchased with his own blood.

entries.yo: Nitoriti emi mọ̀ pe, lẹhin lilọ mi, ikõkò buburu yio wọ̀ ãrin nyin, li aidá agbo si.
entries.en: For I know this, that after my departing shall grievous wolves enter in among you, not sparing the flock.

entries.yo: Ati larin ẹnyin tikaranyin li awọn enia yio dide, ti nwọn o ma sọ̀rọ òdi, lati fà awọn ọmọ-ẹhin sẹhin wọn.
entries.en: Also of your own selves shall men arise, speaking perverse things, to draw away disciples after them.

entries.yo: Nitorina ẹ mã ṣọra, ki ẹ si mã ranti pe, fun ọdún mẹta, emi kò dẹkun ati mã fi omije kìlọ fun olukuluku li ọsán ati li oru.
entries.en: Therefore watch, and remember, that by the space of three years I ceased not to warn every one night and day with tears.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, ará, mo fi nyin le Ọlọrun lọwọ ati ọ̀rọ ore-ọfẹ rẹ̀, ti o le gbe nyin duro, ti o si le fun nyin ni ini lãrin gbogbo awọn ti a sọ di mimọ́.
entries.en: And now, brethren, I commend you to God, and to the word of his grace, which is able to build you up, and to give you an inheritance among all them which are sanctified.

entries.yo: Emi kò ṣe ojukòkoro fadaka, tabi wura, tabi aṣọ ẹnikẹni.
entries.en: I have coveted no man's silver, or gold, or apparel.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin tikaranyin sá mọ̀ pe, ọwọ́ wọnyi li o ṣiṣẹ fun aini mi, ati ti awọn ti o wà pẹlu mi.
entries.en: Yea, ye yourselves know, that these hands have ministered unto my necessities, and to them that were with me.

entries.yo: Ninu ohun gbogbo mo fi apẹrẹ fun nyin pe, nipa ṣiṣe iṣẹ bẹ̃, yẹ ki ẹ mã ràn awọn alailera lọwọ, ki ẹ si mã ranti ọ̀rọ Jesu Oluwa, bi on tikararẹ̀ ti wipe, Ati funni o ni ibukún jù ati gbà lọ.
entries.en: I have shewed you all things, how that so labouring ye ought to support the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, how he said, It is more blessed to give than to receive.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si ti wi nkan wọnyi, o kunlẹ, o si ba gbogbo wọn gbadura.
entries.en: And when he had thus spoken, he kneeled down, and prayed with them all.

entries.yo: Gbogbo wọn si sọkun gidigidi, nwọn si rọ̀ mọ́ Paulu li ọrùn, nwọn si fi ẹnu kò o li ẹnu,
entries.en: And they all wept sore, and fell on Paul's neck, and kissed him,

entries.yo: Inu wọn si bajẹ julọ fun ọ̀rọ ti o sọ pe, nwọn kì yio ri oju on mọ́. Nwọn si sìn i lọ sinu ọkọ̀.
entries.en: Sorrowing most of all for the words which he spake, that they should see his face no more. And they accompanied him unto the ship.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, nigbati awa kuro lọdọ wọn, ti a sì ṣikọ̀, awa ba ọ̀na tàra wá si Kosi, ni ijọ keji a si lọ si Rodu, ati lati ibẹ̀ lọ si Patara:
entries.en: And it came to pass, that after we were gotten from them, and had launched, we came with a straight course unto Coos, and the day following unto Rhodes, and from thence unto Patara:

entries.yo: Nigbati awa si ri ọkọ̀ kan ti nrekọja lọ si Fenike, awa wọ̀ ọkọ̀, a si ṣí.
entries.en: And finding a ship sailing over unto Phenicia, we went aboard, and set forth.

entries.yo: Nigbati awa si ti ri Kipru li òkere, ti awa fi i si ọwọ́ òsi, awa gbé ori ọkọ̀ le Siria, a si gúnlẹ ni Tire: nitori nibẹ̀ li ọkọ̀ yio gbé kó ẹrù silẹ.
entries.en: Now when we had discovered Cyprus, we left it on the left hand, and sailed into Syria, and landed at Tyre: for there the ship was to unlade her burden.

entries.yo: Nigbati a si ri awọn ọmọ-ẹhin, awa duro nibẹ̀ ni ijọ meje: awọn ẹniti o tipa Ẹmí wi fun Paulu pe, ki o máṣe lọ si Jerusalemu.
entries.en: And finding disciples, we tarried there seven days: who said to Paul through the Spirit, that he should not go up to Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Nigbati a si ti lò ọjọ wọnni tan, awa jade, a si mu ọ̀na wa pọ̀n; gbogbo nwọn si sìn wa, pẹlu awọn obinrin ati awọn ọmọde titi awa fi jade si ẹhin ilu: nigbati awa si gunlẹ li ebute, awa si gbadura.
entries.en: And when we had accomplished those days, we departed and went our way; and they all brought us on our way, with wives and children, till we were out of the city: and we kneeled down on the shore, and prayed.

entries.yo: Nigbati a si ti dágbere fun ara wa, awa bọ́ si ọkọ̀; ṣugbọn awọn si pada lọ si ile wọn.
entries.en: And when we had taken our leave one of another, we took ship; and they returned home again.

entries.yo: Nigbati a si ti pari àjo wa lati Tire, awa de Ptolemai; nigbati a si kí awọn ará, awa si ba wọn gbé ni ijọ kan.
entries.en: And when we had finished our course from Tyre, we came to Ptolemais, and saluted the brethren, and abode with them one day.

entries.yo: Ni ijọ keji awa lọ kuro, a si wá si Kesarea: nigbati awa si wọ̀ ile Filippi Efangelisti, ọkan ninu awọn meje nì; awa si wọ̀ sọdọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And the next day we that were of Paul's company departed, and came unto Caesarea: and we entered into the house of Philip the evangelist, which was one of the seven; and abode with him.

entries.yo: Ọkunrin yi si li ọmọbinrin mẹrin, wundia, ti ima sọtẹlẹ.
entries.en: And the same man had four daughters, virgins, which did prophesy.

entries.yo: Bi a si ti wà nibẹ̀ li ọjọ pipọ, woli kan ti Judea sọkalẹ wá, ti a npè ni Agabu.
entries.en: And as we tarried there many days, there came down from Judaea a certain prophet, named Agabus.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si de ọdọ wa, o mu amure Paulu, o si de ara rẹ̀ li ọwọ́ on ẹsẹ, o si wipe, Bayi li Ẹmí Mimọ́ wi, Bayi li awọn Ju ti o wà ni Jerusalemu yio de ọkunrin ti o ni amure yi, nwọn o si fi i le awọn Keferi lọwọ.
entries.en: And when he was come unto us, he took Paul's girdle, and bound his own hands and feet, and said, Thus saith the Holy Ghost, So shall the Jews at Jerusalem bind the man that owneth this girdle, and shall deliver him into the hands of the Gentiles.

entries.yo: Nigbati a si ti gbọ́ nkan wọnyi, ati awa, ati awọn ará ibẹ̀ na bẹ̀ ẹ pe, ki o máṣe gòke lọ si Jerusalemu.
entries.en: And when we heard these things, both we, and they of that place, besought him not to go up to Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Paulu dahùn wipe, Ewo li ẹnyin nṣe yi, ti ẹnyin nsọkun, ti ẹ si nmu ãrẹ̀ ba ọkàn mi; nitori emi mura tan, kì iṣe fun didè nikan, ṣugbọn lati kú pẹlu ni Jerusalemu, nitori orukọ Jesu Oluwa.
entries.en: Then Paul answered, What mean ye to weep and to break mine heart? for I am ready not to be bound only, but also to die at Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus.

entries.yo: Nigbati a kò le pa a li ọkàn dà, awa dakẹ, wipe, Ifẹ ti Oluwa ni ki a ṣe.
entries.en: And when he would not be persuaded, we ceased, saying, The will of the Lord be done.

entries.yo: Lẹhin ijọ wọnni, awa palẹmọ, a si gòke lọ si Jerusalemu.
entries.en: And after those days we took up our carriages, and went up to Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Ninu awọn ọmọ-ẹhin lati Kesarea ba wa lọ, nwọn si mu Mnasoni ọmọ-ẹhin lailai kan pẹlu wọn, ará Kipru, lọdọ ẹniti awa ó gbé wọ̀.
entries.en: There went with us also certain of the disciples of Caesarea, and brought with them one Mnason of Cyprus, an old disciple, with whom we should lodge.

entries.yo: Nigbati awa si de Jerusalemu, awọn arakunrin si fi ayọ̀ gbà wa.
entries.en: And when we were come to Jerusalem, the brethren received us gladly.

entries.yo: Ni ijọ keji awa ba Paulu lọ sọdọ Jakọbu; gbogbo awọn alàgba si wà nibẹ̀.
entries.en: And the day following Paul went in with us unto James; and all the elders were present.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si kí wọn tan, o ròhin ohun gbogbo lẹsẹsẹ ti Ọlọrun ṣe lãrin awọn Keferi nipa iṣẹ-iranṣẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And when he had saluted them, he declared particularly what things God had wrought among the Gentiles by his ministry.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si gbọ́, nwọn yin Ọlọrun logo, nwọn si wi fun u pe, Arakunrin, iwọ ri iye ẹgbẹgbẹrun ninu awọn Ju ti o gbagbọ, gbogbo nwọn li o si ni itara fun ofin.
entries.en: And when they heard it, they glorified the Lord, and said unto him, Thou seest, brother, how many thousands of Jews there are which believe; and they are all zealous of the law:

entries.yo: Nwọn si ti ròhin rẹ fun wọn pe, Iwọ nkọ́ gbogbo awọn Ju ti o wà lãrin awọn Keferi pe, ki nwọn ki o kọ̀ Mose silẹ, o si nwi fun wọn pe ki nwọn ki o máṣe kọ awọn ọmọ wọn ni ilà mọ́, ati ki nwọn ki o máṣe rìn gẹgẹ bi àṣa wọn.
entries.en: And they are informed of thee, that thou teachest all the Jews which are among the Gentiles to forsake Moses, saying that they ought not to circumcise their children, neither to walk after the customs.

entries.yo: Njẹ ewo ni ṣiṣe? ijọ kò le ṣaima pejọ pọ̀: dajudaju nwọn ó gbọ́ pe, iwọ de.
entries.en: What is it therefore? the multitude must needs come together: for they will hear that thou art come.

entries.yo: Njẹ eyi ti awa ó wi fun ọ yi ni ki o ṣe: Awa li ọkunrin mẹrin ti nwọn ni ẹ̀jẹ́ lara wọn;
entries.en: Do therefore this that we say to thee: We have four men which have a vow on them;

entries.yo: Awọn ni ki iwọ ki o mu, ki o si ṣe iwẹnumọ pẹlu wọn ki o si ṣe inawo wọn, ki nwọn ki o le fá ori wọn: gbogbo enia yio si mọ̀ pe, kò si otitọ kan ninu ohun ti nwọn gbọ si ọ; ṣugbọn pe, iwọ tikararẹ nrìn dede pẹlu, iwọ si npa ofin mọ́.
entries.en: Them take, and purify thyself with them, and be at charges with them, that they may shave their heads: and all may know that those things, whereof they were informed concerning thee, are nothing; but that thou thyself also walkest orderly, and keepest the law.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn niti awọn Keferi ti o gbagbọ́, awa ti kọwe, a si ti pinnu rẹ̀ pe, ki nwọn pa ara wọn mọ kuro ninu ohun ti a fi rubọ si oriṣa, ati ẹ̀jẹ ati ohun ilọlọrùnpa, ati àgbere.
entries.en: As touching the Gentiles which believe, we have written and concluded that they observe no such thing, save only that they keep themselves from things offered to idols, and from blood, and from strangled, and from fornication.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Paulu mu awọn ọkunrin na; ni ijọ keji o ṣe iwẹnumọ pẹlu wọn, o si wọ̀ inu tẹmpili lọ, o sọ ìgba ti ọjọ ìwẹ̀numọ́ na yio pé titi a fi rubọ fun olukuluku wọn.
entries.en: Then Paul took the men, and the next day purifying himself with them entered into the temple, to signify the accomplishment of the days of purifcation, until that an offering should be offered for every one of them.

entries.yo: Nigbati ọjọ meje si fẹrẹ pé, ti awọn Ju ti o ti Asia wa ri i ni tẹmpili, nwọn rú gbogbo awọn enia soke, nwọn nawọ́ mu u.
entries.en: And when the seven days were almost ended, the Jews which were of Asia, when they saw him in the temple, stirred up all the people, and laid hands on him,

entries.yo: Nwọn nkigbe wipe, Ẹnyin enia Israeli, ẹ gbà wa: Eyi li ọkunrin na, ti nkọ́ gbogbo enia nibigbogbo lòdi si awọn enia, ati si ofin, ati si ibi yi: ati pẹlu o si mu awọn ara Hellene wá si tẹmpili, o si ti ba ibi mimọ́ yi jẹ.
entries.en: Crying out, Men of Israel, help: This is the man, that teacheth all men every where against the people, and the law, and this place: and further brought Greeks also into the temple, and hath polluted this holy place.

entries.yo: Nitori nwọn ti ri Trofimu ará Efesu pẹlu rẹ̀ ni ilu, ẹniti nwọn ṣebi Paulu mu wá sinu tẹmpili.
entries.en: (For they had seen before with him in the city Trophimus an Ephesian, whom they supposed that Paul had brought into the temple.)

entries.yo: Gbogbo ilu si rọ́, awọn enia si sure jọ: nwọn si mu Paulu, nwọn si wọ́ ọ jade kuro ninu tẹmpili: lojukanna a si tì ilẹkun.
entries.en: And all the city was moved, and the people ran together: and they took Paul, and drew him out of the temple: and forthwith the doors were shut.

entries.yo: Bi nwọn si ti nwá ọ̀na ati pa a, ìhin de ọdọ olori ẹgbẹ ọmọ-ogun pe, gbogbo Jerusalemu dàrú.
entries.en: And as they went about to kill him, tidings came unto the chief captain of the band, that all Jerusalem was in an uproar.

entries.yo: Lojukanna o si ti mu awọn ọmọ-ogun ati awọn balogun ọrún, o si sure sọkalẹ tọ̀ wọn lọ: nigbati nwọn si ri olori ogun ati awọn ọmọ-ogun, nwọn dẹkun lilu Paulu.
entries.en: Who immediately took soldiers and centurions, and ran down unto them: and when they saw the chief captain and the soldiers, they left beating of Paul.

entries.yo: Nigbana li olori ogun sunmọ wọn, o si mu u, o paṣẹ pe ki a fi ẹ̀wọn meji dè e; o si bère ẹniti iṣe, ati ohun ti o ṣe.
entries.en: Then the chief captain came near, and took him, and commanded him to be bound with two chains; and demanded who he was, and what he had done.

entries.yo: Awọn kan nkígbe ohun kan, awọn miran nkigbe ohun miran ninu awujọ: nigbati kò si le mọ̀ eredi irukerudò na dajudaju, o paṣẹ ki nwọn ki o mu u lọ sinu ile-olodi.
entries.en: And some cried one thing, some another, among the multitude: and when he could not know the certainty for the tumult, he commanded him to be carried into the castle.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si de ori atẹgùn, gbigbé li a gbé e soke lọwọ awọn ọmọ-ogun nitori iwa-ipa awọn enia.
entries.en: And when he came upon the stairs, so it was, that he was borne of the soldiers for the violence of the people.

entries.yo: Nitori ọ̀pọ enia gbátì i, nwọn nkigbe pe, Mu u kuro.
entries.en: For the multitude of the people followed after, crying, Away with him.

entries.yo: Bi nwọn si ti fẹrẹ imu Paulu wọ̀ inu ile-olodi lọ, o wi fun olori-ogun pe, Emi ha gbọdọ ba ọ sọ̀rọ? O si dahùn wipe, Iwọ mọ̀ ède Hellene ifọ̀?
entries.en: And as Paul was to be led into the castle, he said unto the chief captain, May I speak unto thee? Who said, Canst thou speak Greek?

entries.yo: Iwọ ha kọ́ ni ara Egipti nì, ti o ṣọ̀tẹ ṣaju ọjọ wọnyi, ti o si ti mu ẹgbaji ọkunrin ninu awọn ti iṣe apania lẹhin lọ si iju?
entries.en: Art not thou that Egyptian, which before these days madest an uproar, and leddest out into the wilderness four thousand men that were murderers?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Paulu si wipe, Ju li emi iṣe, ara Tarsu ilu Kilikia, ọlọ̀tọ ilu ti kì iṣe ilu lasan kan, emi si bẹ ọ, bùn mi lãye lati ba awọn enia sọrọ.
entries.en: But Paul said, I am a man which am a Jew of Tarsus, a city in Cilicia, a citizen of no mean city: and, I beseech thee, suffer me to speak unto the people.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si ti bùn u lãye, Paulu duro lori atẹgùn, o si juwọ́ si awọn enia. Nigbati nwọn si dakẹrọrọ o ba wọn sọrọ li ède Heberu, wipe,
entries.en: And when he had given him licence, Paul stood on the stairs, and beckoned with the hand unto the people. And when there was made a great silence, he spake unto them in the Hebrew tongue, saying,

entries.yo: ẸNYIN ará, ati baba, ẹ gbọ ti ẹnu mi nisisiyi.
entries.en: Men, brethren, and fathers, hear ye my defence which I make now unto you.

entries.yo: (Nigbati nwọn si gbọ́ pe o mba wọn sọrọ li ede Heberu, nwọn tubọ parọrọ; o si wipe,)
entries.en: (And when they heard that he spake in the Hebrew tongue to them, they kept the more silence: and he saith,)

entries.yo: Ju li emi iṣe ẹniti a bí ni Tarsu ilu kan ni Kilikia, ṣugbọn ti a tọ́ ni ilu yi, li ẹsẹ Gamalieli, ti a kọ́ gẹgẹ bi lile ofin awọn baba wa, ti mo si jẹ onitara fun Ọlọrun ani gẹgẹ bi gbogbo nyin ti ri li oni.
entries.en: I am verily a man which am a Jew, born in Tarsus, a city in Cilicia, yet brought up in this city at the feet of Gamaliel, and taught according to the perfect manner of the law of the fathers, and was zealous toward God, as ye all are this day.

entries.yo: Mo si ṣe inunibini si Ọna yi titi o fi de iku, mo ndè, mo si nfi wọn sinu tubu, ati ọkunrin ati obinrin.
entries.en: And I persecuted this way unto the death, binding and delivering into prisons both men and women.

entries.yo: Bi olori alufa pẹlu ti jẹ mi li ẹri, ati gbogbo ajọ awọn alàgba: lọwọ awọn ẹniti mo si gbà iwe lọ sọdọ awọn arakunrin, ti mo si lọ si Damasku lati mu awọn ti o wà nibẹ̀ ni didè wá si Jerusalemu, lati jẹ wọn niyà.
entries.en: As also the high priest doth bear me witness, and all the estate of the elders: from whom also I received letters unto the brethren, and went to Damascus, to bring them which were there bound unto Jerusalem, for to be punished.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, bi emi ti nlọ, ti mo si sunmọ eti Damasku niwọn ọjọkanri, li ojijì, imọlẹ nla mọ́ ti ọrun wá yi mi ká.
entries.en: And it came to pass, that, as I made my journey, and was come nigh unto Damascus about noon, suddenly there shone from heaven a great light round about me.

entries.yo: Mo si ṣubu lùlẹ, mo si ngbọ́ ohùn kan ti o wi fun mi pe, Saulu, Saulu, ẽṣe ti iwọ fi nṣe inunibini si mi?
entries.en: And I fell unto the ground, and heard a voice saying unto me, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me?

entries.yo: Emi si dahùn wipe, Iwọ tani, Oluwa? O si wi fun mi pe, Emi Jesu ti Nasareti ni, ẹniti iwọ nṣe inunibini si.
entries.en: And I answered, Who art thou, Lord? And he said unto me, I am Jesus of Nazareth, whom thou persecutest.

entries.yo: Awọn ti o si wà pẹlu mi ri imọlẹ na nitõtọ, ẹ̀ru si ba wọn; ṣugbọn nwọn kò gbọ́ ohùn ẹniti mba mi sọrọ.
entries.en: And they that were with me saw indeed the light, and were afraid; but they heard not the voice of him that spake to me.

entries.yo: Mo si wipe, Kini ki emi ki o ṣe, Oluwa? Oluwa si wi fun mi pe, Dide, ki o si lọ si Damasku; nibẹ̀ li a o si sọ ohun gbogbo fun ọ ti a yàn fun ọ lati ṣe.
entries.en: And I said, What shall I do, Lord? And the Lord said unto me, Arise, and go into Damascus; and there it shall be told thee of all things which are appointed for thee to do.

entries.yo: Bi emi kò si ti le riran nitori itànṣan imọlẹ na, a ti ọwọ́ awọn ti o wà lọdọ mi fà mi, mo si de Damasku.
entries.en: And when I could not see for the glory of that light, being led by the hand of them that were with me, I came into Damascus.

entries.yo: Ẹnikan si tọ̀ mi wá, Anania, ọkunrin olufọkansìn gẹgẹ bi ofin, ti o li orukọ rere lọdọ gbogbo awọn Ju ti o ngbe ibẹ̀.
entries.en: And one Ananias, a devout man according to the law, having a good report of all the Jews which dwelt there,

entries.yo: O si duro tì mi, o si wi fun mi pe, Saulu arakunrin, riran. Ni wakati kanna mo si ṣiju soke wò o.
entries.en: Came unto me, and stood, and said unto me, Brother Saul, receive thy sight. And the same hour I looked up upon him.

entries.yo: O si wipe, Ọlọrun awọn baba wa yàn ọ, lati mọ̀ ifẹ rẹ̀, ati lati ri Olõtọ nì, ati lati gbọ́ ohùn li ẹnu rẹ̀,
entries.en: And he said, The God of our fathers hath chosen thee, that thou shouldest know his will, and see that Just One, and shouldest hear the voice of his mouth.

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o le ṣe ẹlẹri rẹ̀ fun gbogbo enia, li ohun ti iwọ ti ri ti iwọ si ti gbọ́.
entries.en: For thou shalt be his witness unto all men of what thou hast seen and heard.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi kini iwọ nduro de? Dide, ki a si baptisi rẹ, ki o si wẹ̀ ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ nù, ki o si mã pè orukọ Oluwa.
entries.en: And now why tarriest thou? arise, and be baptized, and wash away thy sins, calling on the name of the Lord.

entries.yo: O si ṣe pe, nigbati mo pada wá si Jerusalemu, ti mo ngbadura ni tẹmpili mo bọ si ojuran;
entries.en: And it came to pass, that, when I was come again to Jerusalem, even while I prayed in the temple, I was in a trance;

entries.yo: Mo si ri i, o wi fun mi pe, Yara, ki o si jade kuro ni Jerusalemu kánkán: nitori nwọn kì yio gbà ẹrí rẹ nipa mi.
entries.en: And saw him saying unto me, Make haste, and get thee quickly out of Jerusalem: for they will not receive thy testimony concerning me.

entries.yo: Emi si wipe, Oluwa, awọn pãpã mọ̀ pe, emi a ti mã sọ awọn ti o gbà ọ gbọ sinu tubu, emi a si mã lù wọn ninu sinagogu gbogbo:
entries.en: And I said, Lord, they know that I imprisoned and beat in every synagogue them that believed on thee:

entries.yo: Nigbati a si ta ẹ̀jẹ Stefanu ẹlẹri rẹ silẹ, emi na pẹlu duro nibẹ̀, mo si li ohùn si ikú rẹ̀, mo si nṣe itọju aṣọ awọn ẹniti o pa a.
entries.en: And when the blood of thy martyr Stephen was shed, I also was standing by, and consenting unto his death, and kept the raiment of them that slew him.

entries.yo: O si wi fun mi pe, Mã lọ: nitori emi ó rán ọ si awọn Keferi lokere réré.
entries.en: And he said unto me, Depart: for I will send thee far hence unto the Gentiles.

entries.yo: Nwọn si fi etí si i titi de ọ̀rọ yi, nwọn si gbé ohùn wọn soke wipe, Ẹ mu irú eyiyi kuro li aiye: nitori kò yẹ ki o wà lãye.
entries.en: And they gave him audience unto this word, and then lifted up their voices, and said, Away with such a fellow from the earth: for it is not fit that he should live.

entries.yo: Bi nwọn si ti nkigbe, ti nwọn si wọ́n aṣọ wọn silẹ, ti nwọn nku ekuru si oju ọrun,
entries.en: And as they cried out, and cast off their clothes, and threw dust into the air,

entries.yo: Olori ogun paṣẹ pe ki a mu u wá sinu ile-olodi, o ni ki a fi ẹgba bi i lẽre; ki on ki o le mọ̀ itori ohun ti nwọn ṣe nkigbe le e bẹ̃.
entries.en: The chief captain commanded him to be brought into the castle, and bade that he should be examined by scourging; that he might know wherefore they cried so against him.

entries.yo: Bi nwọn si ti fi ọsán dè e, Paulu bi balogun ọrún ti o duro tì i pe, O ha tọ́ fun nyin lati nà ẹniti iṣe ará Romu li aijẹbi?
entries.en: And as they bound him with thongs, Paul said unto the centurion that stood by, Is it lawful for you to scourge a man that is a Roman, and uncondemned?

entries.yo: Nigbati balogun ọrún si gbọ́, o lọ, o wi fun olori-ogun pe, Kili o fẹ ṣe yi: nitori ọkunrin yi ara Romu ni iṣe.
entries.en: When the centurion heard that, he went and told the chief captain, saying, Take heed what thou doest: for this man is a Roman.

entries.yo: Olori-ogun si de, o si bi i pe, Sọ fun mi, ara Romu ni iwọ iṣe? O si wipe, Bẹ̃ni.
entries.en: Then the chief captain came, and said unto him, Tell me, art thou a Roman? He said, Yea.

entries.yo: Olori-ogun si dahùn wipe, Owo pupọ ni mo fi rà ọlá ibilẹ yi. Paulu si wipe, Ṣugbọn a bí emi bẹ̃ ni.
entries.en: And the chief captain answered, With a great sum obtained I this freedom. And Paul said, But I was free born.

entries.yo: Nitorina awọn ti o mura lati bi i lẽre kuro lọdọ rẹ̀: lojukanna olori-ogun pẹlu si bẹ̀ru, nigbati o mọ̀ pe ara Romu ni iṣe, ati nitori o ti dè e.
entries.en: Then straightway they departed from him which should have examined him: and the chief captain also was afraid, after he knew that he was a Roman, and because he had bound him.

entries.yo: Ni ijọ keji, nitoriti o fẹ mọ̀ dajudaju ohun ti awọn Ju nfi i sùn si, o tú u silẹ, o paṣẹ ki awọn olori alufa ati gbogbo igbimọ pejọ, o si mu Paulu sọkalẹ, o si mu u duro niwaju wọn.
entries.en: On the morrow, because he would have known the certainty wherefore he was accused of the Jews, he loosed him from his bands, and commanded the chief priests and all their council to appear, and brought Paul down, and set him before them.

entries.yo: NIGBATI Paulu si tẹjumọ igbimọ, o ni, Ará, emi ti nfi gbogbo ẹri-ọkàn rere lò aiye mi niwaju Ọlọrun titi fi di oni yi.
entries.en: And Paul, earnestly beholding the council, said, Men and brethren, I have lived in all good conscience before God until this day.

entries.yo: Anania olori alufa si paṣẹ fun awọn ti o duro tì i pe, ki o gbún u li ẹnu.
entries.en: And the high priest Ananias commanded them that stood by him to smite him on the mouth.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Paulu wi fun u pe, Ọlọrun yio lù ọ, iwọ ogiri ti a kùn li ẹfun: iwọ joko lati dajọ mi ni gẹgẹ bi ofin, iwọ si pè ki a lù mi li òdi si ofin?
entries.en: Then said Paul unto him, God shall smite thee, thou whited wall: for sittest thou to judge me after the law, and commandest me to be smitten contrary to the law?

entries.yo: Awọn ti o duro tì i si wipe, Olori alufa Ọlọrun ni iwọ ngàn?
entries.en: And they that stood by said, Revilest thou God's high priest?

entries.yo: Paulu si wipe, Ará, emi kò mọ̀ pe olori alufa ni: nitori a ti kọ ọ pe, Iwọ kò gbọdọ sọ̀rọ olori awọn enia rẹ ni buburu.
entries.en: Then said Paul, I wist not, brethren, that he was the high priest: for it is written, Thou shalt not speak evil of the ruler of thy people.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati Paulu ṣakiyesi pe, apakan wọn jẹ Sadusi, apakan si jẹ Farisi, o kigbe ni igbimọ pe, Ará, Farisi li emi, ọmọ Farisi: nitori ireti ati ajinde okú li a ṣe ba mi wijọ.
entries.en: But when Paul perceived that the one part were Sadducees, and the other Pharisees, he cried out in the council, Men and brethren, I am a Pharisee, the son of a Pharisee: of the hope and resurrection of the dead I am called in question.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si ti wi eyi, iyapa de lãrin awọn Farisi ati awọn Sadusi: ajọ si pin meji.
entries.en: And when he had so said, there arose a dissension between the Pharisees and the Sadducees: and the multitude was divided.

entries.yo: Nitoriti awọn Sadusi wipe, kò si ajinde, tabi angẹli, tabi ẹmí: ṣugbọn awọn Farisi jẹwọ mejeji.
entries.en: For the Sadducees say that there is no resurrection, neither angel, nor spirit: but the Pharisees confess both.

entries.yo: O si di ariwo nla: ninu awọn akọwe ti o wà li apa ti awọn Farisi dide, nwọn njà, wipe, Awa kò ri ohun buburu kan lara ọkunrin yi: ki si ni bi ẹmi kan tabi angẹli kan li o ba a sọ̀rọ?
entries.en: And there arose a great cry: and the scribes that were of the Pharisees' part arose, and strove, saying, We find no evil in this man: but if a spirit or an angel hath spoken to him, let us not fight against God.

entries.yo: Nigbati iyapa si di nla, ti olori ogun bẹ̀ru ki Paulu ki o má bà di fifaya lọwọ wọn, o paṣẹ pe ki awọn ọmọ-ogun sọkalẹ lọ lati fi ipá mu u kuro lãrin wọn, ki nwọn si mu u wá sinu ile-olodi.
entries.en: And when there arose a great dissension, the chief captain, fearing lest Paul should have been pulled in pieces of them, commanded the soldiers to go down, and to take him by force from among them, and to bring him into the castle.

entries.yo: Li oru ijọ na Oluwa duro tì i, o si wipe, Tujuka: nitori bi iwọ ti jẹri fun mi ni Jerusalemu, bẹ̃ni iwọ kò le ṣaijẹrí ni Romu pẹlu.
entries.en: And the night following the Lord stood by him, and said, Be of good cheer, Paul: for as thou hast testified of me in Jerusalem, so must thou bear witness also at Rome.

entries.yo: Nigbati ilẹ mọ́, awọn Ju kan dimọlu, nwọn fi ara wọn bu pe, awọn kì yio jẹ bẹ̃li awọn kì yio mu, titi awọn ó fi pa Paulu.
entries.en: And when it was day, certain of the Jews banded together, and bound themselves under a curse, saying that they would neither eat nor drink till they had killed Paul.

entries.yo: Awọn ti o ditẹ yi si jù ogoji enia lọ.
entries.en: And they were more than forty which had made this conspiracy.

entries.yo: Nwọn si tọ̀ olori awọn alufa ati awọn àgbagba lọ, nwọn si wipe, Awa ti fi èpe nla bu ara wa pe, a kì yio tọ́ ohun nkan wò titi awa ó fi pa Paulu.
entries.en: And they came to the chief priests and elders, and said, We have bound ourselves under a great curse, that we will eat nothing until we have slain Paul.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi ki ẹnyin pẹlu ajọ igbimọ wi fun olori-ogun, ki o mu u sọkalẹ tọ̀ nyin wá, bi ẹnipe ẹnyin nfẹ wadi ọ̀ran rẹ̀ dajudaju: ki o to sunmọ itosi, awa ó si ti mura lati pa a.
entries.en: Now therefore ye with the council signify to the chief captain that he bring him down unto you to morrow, as though ye would inquire something more perfectly concerning him: and we, or ever he come near, are ready to kill him.

entries.yo: Nigbati ọmọ arabinrin Paulu si gburó idena wọn, o lọ, o si wọ̀ inu ile-olodi lọ, o si sọ fun Paulu.
entries.en: And when Paul's sister's son heard of their lying in wait, he went and entered into the castle, and told Paul.

entries.yo: Paulu si pè ọkan ninu awọn balogun ọrún sọdọ rẹ̀, o ni, Mu ọmọkunrin yi tọ̀ olori-ogun lọ: nitori o ni nkan lati sọ fun u.
entries.en: Then Paul called one of the centurions unto him, and said, Bring this young man unto the chief captain: for he hath a certain thing to tell him.

entries.yo: O mu u, o si sìn i lọ sọdọ olori-ogun, o si wipe, Paulu ondè pè mi sọdọ rẹ̀, o si bẹ̀ mi pe ki emi mu ọmọkunrin yi tọ̀ ọ wá, ẹniti o ni nkan lati sọ fun ọ.
entries.en: So he took him, and brought him to the chief captain, and said, Paul the prisoner called me unto him, and prayed me to bring this young man unto thee, who hath something to say unto thee.

entries.yo: Olori-ogun fà a lọwọ, o si lọ si apakan, o si bi i lere nikọkọ pe, Kili ohun ti iwọ ni isọ fun mi?
entries.en: Then the chief captain took him by the hand, and went with him aside privately, and asked him, What is that thou hast to tell me?

entries.yo: O si wipe, Awọn Ju fi ìmọ ṣọkan lati wá ibẹ̀ ọ ki o mu Paulu sọkalẹ wá si ajọ igbimọ li ọla, bi ẹnipe iwọ nfẹ bère nkan dajudaju nipa rẹ̀.
entries.en: And he said, The Jews have agreed to desire thee that thou wouldest bring down Paul to morrow into the council, as though they would inquire somewhat of him more perfectly.

entries.yo: Nitorina máṣe gbọ́ tiwọn: nitori awọn ti o dèna dè e ninu wọn jù ogoji ọkunrin lọ, ti nwọn fi ara wọn bu pe, awọn kì yio jẹ, bẹ̃li awọn kì yio mu titi awọn o fi pa a: nisisiyi nwọn si ti mura tan, nwọn nreti idahùn lọdọ rẹ.
entries.en: But do not thou yield unto them: for there lie in wait for him of them more than forty men, which have bound themselves with an oath, that they will neither eat nor drink till they have killed him: and now are they ready, looking for a promise from thee.

entries.yo: Nigbana li olori ogun jọwọ ọmọkunrin na lọwọ lọ, o si kìlọ fun u pe, Máṣe wi fun ẹnikan pe, iwọ fi nkan wọnyi hàn mi.
entries.en: So the chief captain then let the young man depart, and charged him, See thou tell no man that thou hast shewed these things to me.

entries.yo: O si pè meji awọn balogun ọrún sọdọ rẹ̀, o si wipe, Ẹ mura igba ọmọ-ogun silẹ, lati lọ si Kesarea, ati adọrin ẹlẹṣin, ati igba ọlọkọ̀, ni wakati kẹta oru;
entries.en: And he called unto him two centurions, saying, Make ready two hundred soldiers to go to Caesarea, and horsemen threescore and ten, and spearmen two hundred, at the third hour of the night;

entries.yo: O si wipe, ki nwọn pèse ẹranko, ki nwọn gbé Paulu gùn u, ki nwọn si le mu u de ọdọ Feliksi bãlẹ li alafia.
entries.en: And provide them beasts, that they may set Paul on, and bring him safe unto Felix the governor.

entries.yo: O si kọ iwe kan bayi pe:
entries.en: And he wrote a letter after this manner:

entries.yo: Klaudiu Lisia si Feliksi bãlẹ ọlọla julọ, alafia.
entries.en: Claudius Lysias unto the most excellent governor Felix sendeth greeting.

entries.yo: Awọn Ju mu ọkunrin yi, nwọn si npete ati pa a: nigbana ni mo de pẹlu ogun, mo si gbà a lọwọ wọn nigbati mo gbọ́ pe ara Romu ni iṣe.
entries.en: This man was taken of the Jews, and should have been killed of them: then came I with an army, and rescued him, having understood that he was a Roman.

entries.yo: Nigbati mo si nfẹ mọ̀ idi ọ̀ran ti nwọn fi i sùn si, mo mu u sọkalẹ lọ si ajọ igbimọ wọn:
