entries.en: And when I would have known the cause wherefore they accused him, I brought him forth into their council:

entries.yo: Ẹniti mo ri pe, nwọn fisùn nitori ọ̀ran ofin wọn, bẹ̃ni kò dà ọ̀ran kan ti o tọ́ si ikú ati si ìde.
entries.en: Whom I perceived to be accused of questions of their law, but to have nothing laid to his charge worthy of death or of bonds.

entries.yo: Nigbati a si ti sọ fun mi pe, nwọn ó dèna dè ọkunrin na, ọgan mo si rán a si ọ, mo si paṣẹ fun awọn olufisùn rẹ̀ pẹlu, lati sọ ohun ti nwọn ba ri wi si i niwaju rẹ.
entries.en: And when it was told me how that the Jews laid wait for the man, I sent straightway to thee, and gave commandment to his accusers also to say before thee what they had against him. Farewell.

entries.yo: Nigbana li awọn ọmọ-ogun gbà Paulu, nwọn si mu u li oru lọ si Antipatri, gẹgẹ bi a ti paṣẹ fun wọn.
entries.en: Then the soldiers, as it was commanded them, took Paul, and brought him by night to Antipatris.

entries.yo: Nijọ keji nwọn si jọwọ awọn ẹlẹṣin lati mã ba a lọ, nwọn si pada wá sinu ile-olodi.
entries.en: On the morrow they left the horsemen to go with him, and returned to the castle:

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn de Kesarea, ti nwọn si fi iwe fun bãlẹ, nwọn mu Paulu pẹlu wá siwaju rẹ̀.
entries.en: Who, when they came to Caesarea, and delivered the epistle to the governor, presented Paul also before him.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si ti kà iwe na, o bère pe ara ilẹ wo ni iṣe. Nigbati o si gbọ́ pe ara Kilikia ni;
entries.en: And when the governor had read the letter, he asked of what province he was. And when he understood that he was of Cilicia;

entries.yo: O ni, Emi ó gbọ́ ẹjọ rẹ, nigbati awọn olufisùn rẹ pẹlu ba de. O si paṣẹ pe ki nwọn ki o pa a mọ́ ni gbọ̀ngan idajọ Herodu.
entries.en: I will hear thee, said he, when thine accusers are also come. And he commanded him to be kept in Herod's judgment hall.

entries.yo: LẸHIN ijọ marun Anania olori alufa ni sọkalẹ lọ pẹlu awọn alàgba ati ẹnikan Tertulu agbẹjọrò ẹniti o fi Paulu sùn bãlẹ.
entries.en: And after five days Ananias the high priest descended with the elders, and with a certain orator named Tertullus, who informed the governor against Paul.

entries.yo: Nigbati a si ti pè e jade, Tertulu bẹ̀rẹ si ifi i sùn wipe, Bi o ti jẹ pe nipasẹ rẹ li awa njẹ alafia pipọ, ati pe nipasẹ itọju rẹ a nṣe atunṣe fun orilẹ yi.
entries.en: And when he was called forth, Tertullus began to accuse him, saying, Seeing that by thee we enjoy great quietness, and that very worthy deeds are done unto this nation by thy providence,

entries.yo: Nigbagbogbo, ati nibigbogbo, li awa nfi gbogbo ọpẹ́ tẹwọgbà a, Feliksi ọlọla julọ.
entries.en: We accept it always, and in all places, most noble Felix, with all thankfulness.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ki emi ki o má bà da ọ duro pẹ titi, mo bẹ̀ ọ ki o fi iyọnu rẹ gbọ́ ọ̀rọ diẹ li ẹnu wa.
entries.en: Notwithstanding, that I be not further tedious unto thee, I pray thee that thou wouldest hear us of thy clemency a few words.

entries.yo: Nitori awa ri ọkunrin yi, o jẹ onijagidi enia, ẹniti o ndá rukerudo silẹ lãrin gbogbo awọn Ju ti o wà ni gbogbo aiye, ati olori ẹ̀ya awọn Nasarene:
entries.en: For we have found this man a pestilent fellow, and a mover of sedition among all the Jews throughout the world, and a ringleader of the sect of the Nazarenes:

entries.yo: Ẹniti o gbidanwo lati bà tẹmpili jẹ: ti awa si mu, ti awa fẹ ba ṣe ẹjọ gẹgẹ bi ofin wa.
entries.en: Who also hath gone about to profane the temple: whom we took, and would have judged according to our law.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Lisia olori ogun de, o fi agbara nla gbà a li ọwọ wa:
entries.en: But the chief captain Lysias came upon us, and with great violence took him away out of our hands,

entries.yo: O paṣẹ ki awọn olufisùn rẹ̀ wá sọdọ rẹ: lati ọdọ ẹniti iwọ ó le ni oye gbogbo nkan wọnyi, nitori ohun ti awa ṣe fi i sùn nigbati iwọ ba ti wadi ẹjọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Commanding his accusers to come unto thee: by examining of whom thyself mayest take knowledge of all these things, whereof we accuse him.

entries.yo: Awọn Ju pẹlu si fi ohùn si i, wipe, bẹ̃ni nkan wọnyi ri.
entries.en: And the Jews also assented, saying that these things were so.

entries.yo: Nigbati bãlẹ ṣapẹrẹ si i pe ki o sọ̀rọ, Paulu si dahùn wipe, Bi mo ti mọ̀ pe lati ọdún melo yi wá, ni iwọ ti ṣe onidajọ orilẹ-ede yi, tayọtayọ ni ng o fi wi ti ẹnu mi.
entries.en: Then Paul, after that the governor had beckoned unto him to speak, answered, Forasmuch as I know that thou hast been of many years a judge unto this nation, I do the more cheerfully answer for myself:

entries.yo: Ki o le yé ọ pe, ijejila pére yi ni mo gòke lọ si Jerusalemu lati lọ jọsìn.
entries.en: Because that thou mayest understand, that there are yet but twelve days since I went up to Jerusalem for to worship.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni nwọn kò ri mi ni tẹmpili ki emi ki o ma ba ẹnikẹni jiyàn, bẹ̃li emi kò rú awọn enia soke, ibaṣe ninu sinagogu, tabi ni ilu:
entries.en: And they neither found me in the temple disputing with any man, neither raising up the people, neither in the synagogues, nor in the city:

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni nwọn kò le ladi ohun ti nwọn fi mi sùn si nisisiyi.
entries.en: Neither can they prove the things whereof they now accuse me.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn eyi ni mo jẹwọ fun ọ, pe bi Ọna ti a npè ni adamọ̀, bẹ̃li emi nsìn Ọlọrun awọn baba wa, emi ngbà nkan gbogbo gbọ́ gẹgẹ bi ofin, ati ti a kọ sinu iwe awọn woli:
entries.en: But this I confess unto thee, that after the way which they call heresy, so worship I the God of my fathers, believing all things which are written in the law and in the prophets:

entries.yo: Mo si ni ireti sipa ti Ọlọrun, eyi ti awọn tikarawọn pẹlu jẹwọ, pe ajinde okú mbọ̀, ati ti olõtọ, ati ti alaiṣõtọ.
entries.en: And have hope toward God, which they themselves also allow, that there shall be a resurrection of the dead, both of the just and unjust.

entries.yo: Ninu eyi li emi si nṣe idaraya, lati ni ẹri-ọkàn ti kò li ẹ̀ṣẹ sipa ti Ọlọrun, ati si enia nigbagbogbo.
entries.en: And herein do I exercise myself, to have always a conscience void of offence toward God, and toward men.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn lẹhin ọdún pipọ, mo mu ọrẹ-ãnu fun orilẹ-ède mi wá, ati ọrẹ-ẹbọ.
entries.en: Now after many years I came to bring alms to my nation, and offerings.

entries.yo: Larin wọnyi ni nwọn ri mi ni iwẹnu ni tẹmpili, bẹ̃ni kì iṣe pẹlu awujọ, tabi pẹlu ariwo.
entries.en: Whereupon certain Jews from Asia found me purified in the temple, neither with multitude, nor with tumult.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn Ju lati Asia wà nibẹ, awọn ti iba wà nihinyi niwaju rẹ, ki nwọn ki o já mi ni koro, bi nwọn ba li ohunkohun si mi.
entries.en: Who ought to have been here before thee, and object, if they had ought against me.

entries.yo: Bi kò ṣe bẹ̃, jẹ ki awọn enia wọnyi tikarawọn sọ iṣe buburu ti nwọn ri lọwọ mi, nigbati mo duro niwaju ajọ igbimọ yi,
entries.en: Or else let these same here say, if they have found any evil doing in me, while I stood before the council,

entries.yo: Bikoṣe ti gbolohùn kan yi, ti mo ke nigbati mo duro li ãrin wọn, Nitori ajinde okú li a ṣe ba mi wijọ lọdọ nyin loni yi.
entries.en: Except it be for this one voice, that I cried standing among them, Touching the resurrection of the dead I am called in question by you this day.

entries.yo: Nigbati Feliksi gbọ́ nkan wọnyi, oye sa ye e li ayetan nipa Ọna na; o tú wọn ká na, o ni, Nigbati Lisia olori ogun ba sọkalẹ wá, emi o wadi ọ̀ran nyin daju.
entries.en: And when Felix heard these things, having more perfect knowledge of that way, he deferred them, and said, When Lysias the chief captain shall come down, I will know the uttermost of your matter.

entries.yo: O si paṣẹ fun balogun ọrún kan pe, ki o mã ṣe itọju Paulu, ki o si bùn u làye, ati pe ki o máṣe dá awọn ojulumọ̀ rẹ̀ lẹkun, lati ma ṣe iranṣẹ fun u.
entries.en: And he commanded a centurion to keep Paul, and to let him have liberty, and that he should forbid none of his acquaintance to minister or come unto him.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn lẹhin ijọ melokan, Feliksi de ti on ti Drusilla obinrin rẹ̀, ti iṣe Ju, o si ranṣẹ pè Paulu, o si gbọ́ ọ̀rọ lọdọ rẹ̀ nipa igbagbọ́ ninu Kristi Jesu.
entries.en: And after certain days, when Felix came with his wife Drusilla, which was a Jewess, he sent for Paul, and heard him concerning the faith in Christ.

entries.yo: Bi o si ti nsọ asọye nipa ti ododo ati airekọja ati idajọ ti mbọ̀, ẹ̀ru ba Feliksi, o dahùn wipe, Mã lọ nisisiyi na; nigbati mo ba si ni akokò ti o wọ̀, emi o ranṣẹ pè ọ.
entries.en: And as he reasoned of righteousness, temperance, and judgment to come Felix trembled, and answered, Go thy way for this time; when I have a convenient season, I will call for thee.

entries.yo: O si nreti pẹlu pe a ba fun on li owo lati ọwọ́ Paulu wá, ki on ki o le da a silẹ: nitorina a si ma ranṣẹ si i nigbakugba, a ma ba a sọ̀rọ.
entries.en: He hoped also that money should have been given him of Paul, that he might loose him: wherefore he sent for him the oftener, and communed with him.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn lẹhin ọdún meji, Porkiu Festu rọpò Feliksi: Feliksi si nfẹ ṣe oju're fun awọn Ju, o fi Paulu silẹ li ondè.
entries.en: But after two years Porcius Festus came into Felix' room: and Felix, willing to shew the Jews a pleasure, left Paul bound.

entries.yo: NJẸ nigbati Festu de ilẹ na, lẹhin ijọ mẹta o gòke lati Kesarea lọ si Jerusalemu.
entries.en: Now when Festus was come into the province, after three days he ascended from Caesarea to Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Awọn olori alufa ati awọn enia pataki ninu awọn Ju fi Paulu sùn u, nwọn si bẹ̀ ẹ,
entries.en: Then the high priest and the chief of the Jews informed him against Paul, and besought him,

entries.yo: Nwọn nwá oju're rẹ̀ si Paulu, ki o le ranṣẹ si i wá si Jerusalemu: nwọn ndèna dè e lati pa a li ọna.
entries.en: And desired favour against him, that he would send for him to Jerusalem, laying wait in the way to kill him.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Festu dahun pe, a pa Paulu mọ́ ni Kesarea, ati pe on tikara on nmura ati pada lọ ni lọ̃lọ̃yi.
entries.en: But Festus answered, that Paul should be kept at Caesarea, and that he himself would depart shortly thither.

entries.yo: O ni, njẹ awọn ti o ba to ninu nyin, ki nwọn ba mi sọkalẹ lọ, bi ìwa buburu kan ba wà lọwọ ọkunrin yi, ki nwọn ki o fi i sùn.
entries.en: Let them therefore, said he, which among you are able, go down with me, and accuse this man, if there be any wickedness in him.

entries.yo: Kò si gbe ãrin wọn ju ijọ mẹjọ tabi mẹwa lọ, o sọkalẹ lọ si Kesarea; ni ijọ keji o joko lori itẹ́ idajọ, o si paṣẹ pè ki a mu Paulu wá.
entries.en: And when he had tarried among them more than ten days, he went down unto Caesarea; and the next day sitting on the judgment seat commanded Paul to be brought.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si de, awọn Ju ti o ti Jerusalemu sọkalẹ wá duro yi i ká, nwọn nkà ọ̀ran pipọ ti o si buru si Paulu lọrùn, ti nwọn kò le ladi.
entries.en: And when he was come, the Jews which came down from Jerusalem stood round about, and laid many and grievous complaints against Paul, which they could not prove.

entries.yo: Paulu si wi ti ẹnu rẹ̀ pe, Emi kò ṣẹ ẹṣẹkẹṣẹ kan si ofin awọn Ju, tabi si tẹmpili, tabi si Kesari.
entries.en: While he answered for himself, Neither against the law of the Jews, neither against the temple, nor yet against Caesar, have I offended any thing at all.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Festu nfẹ gbà oju're lọdọ awọn Ju, o si da Paulu lohùn, wipe, Iwọ ha nfẹ goke lọ si Jerusalemu, ki a si ṣe ẹjọ nkan wọnyi nibẹ̀ niwaju mi bi?
entries.en: But Festus, willing to do the Jews a pleasure, answered Paul, and said, Wilt thou go up to Jerusalem, and there be judged of these things before me?

entries.yo: Paulu si wipe, Niwaju itẹ́ idajọ Kesari ni mo duro nibiti o yẹ ki a ṣe ẹjọ mi: emi kò ṣẹ awọn Ju, bi iwọ pẹlu ti mọ̀ daju.
entries.en: Then said Paul, I stand at Caesar's judgment seat, where I ought to be judged: to the Jews have I done no wrong, as thou very well knowest.

entries.yo: Njẹ bi mo ba ṣẹ̀, ti mo si ṣe ohun kan ti o yẹ fùn ikú, emi kò kọ̀ lati kú: ṣugbọn bi kò ba si nkan wọnni ninu ohun ti awọn wọnyi fi mi sùn si, ẹnikan kò le fi mi ṣe oju're fun wọn. Mo fi ọ̀ran mi lọ Kesari.
entries.en: For if I be an offender, or have committed any thing worthy of death, I refuse not to die: but if there be none of these things whereof these accuse me, no man may deliver me unto them. I appeal unto Caesar.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni Festu lẹhin ti o ti ba ajọ igbìmọ sọ̀rọ, o dahùn pe, Iwọ ti fi ọ̀ran rẹ lọ Kesari: lọdọ Kesari ni iwọ ó lọ.
entries.en: Then Festus, when he had conferred with the council, answered, Hast thou appealed unto Caesar? unto Caesar shalt thou go.

entries.yo: Lẹhin ijọ melokan, Agrippa ọba, ati Bernike sọkalẹ wá si Kesarea lati kí Festu.
entries.en: And after certain days king Agrippa and Bernice came unto Caesarea to salute Festus.

entries.yo: Bi nwọn si ti wà nibẹ̀ li ọjọ pipọ, Festu mu ọ̀ran Paulu wá siwaju ọba, wipe, Feliksi fi ọkunrin kan silẹ li ondè:
entries.en: And when they had been there many days, Festus declared Paul's cause unto the king, saying, There is a certain man left in bonds by Felix:

entries.yo: Ẹniti awọn olori alufa ati awọn agbàgba awọn Ju fi sùn nigbati mo wà ni Jerusalemu nwọn nfẹ ki n da a lẹbi.
entries.en: About whom, when I was at Jerusalem, the chief priests and the elders of the Jews informed me, desiring to have judgment against him.

entries.yo: Awọn ẹniti mo si da lohùn pe, Kì iṣe iṣe awọn ara Romu lati da ẹnikẹni lẹbi, ki ẹniti a fisùn ki o to kò awọn olufisùn rẹ̀ loju, ki o si ri àye wi ti ẹnu rẹ̀, nitori ọ̀ran ti a kà si i lọrùn,
entries.en: To whom I answered, It is not the manner of the Romans to deliver any man to die, before that he which is accused have the accusers face to face, and have licence to answer for himself concerning the crime laid against him.

entries.yo: Nitorina nigbati nwọn jùmọ wá si ihinyi, emi kò jafara, nijọ keji mo joko lori itẹ́ idajọ, mo si paṣẹ pe ki a mu ọkunrin na wá.
entries.en: Therefore, when they were come hither, without any delay on the morrow I sat on the judgment seat, and commanded the man to be brought forth.

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn olufisùn na dide, nwọn kò kà ọ̀ran buburu iru eyi ti mo rò si i lọrùn.
entries.en: Against whom when the accusers stood up, they brought none accusation of such things as I supposed:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nwọn ni ọ̀ran kan si i, niti isin wọn, ati niti Jesu kan ti o ti kú, ti Paulu tẹnumọ́ pe o wà lãye.
entries.en: But had certain questions against him of their own superstition, and of one Jesus, which was dead, whom Paul affirmed to be alive.

entries.yo: Bi emi kò si ti mọ̀ bi a iti wadi nkan wọnyi, mo bi i lere bi o nfẹ lọ si Jerusalemu, ki a si ṣe ẹjọ nkan wọnyi nibẹ̀.
entries.en: And because I doubted of such manner of questions, I asked him whether he would go to Jerusalem, and there be judged of these matters.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati Paulu fi ọ̀ran rẹ̀ lọ Augustu, pe ki a pa on mọ fun idajọ rẹ̀, mo paṣẹ pe ki a pa a mọ titi emi o fi le rán a lọ sọdọ Kesari.
entries.en: But when Paul had appealed to be reserved unto the hearing of Augustus, I commanded him to be kept till I might send him to Caesar.

entries.yo: Agrippa si wi fun Festu pe, Emi pẹlu fẹ lati gbọ́ ọrọ ọkunrin na tikarami. O si wipe, Lọla iwọ o gbọ ọ.
entries.en: Then Agrippa said unto Festus, I would also hear the man myself. To morrow, said he, thou shalt hear him.

entries.yo: Njẹ ni ijọ keji, ti Agrippa on Bernike wá, ti awọn ti ọsọ́ pipọ, ti nwọn si wọ ile ẹjọ, pẹlu awọn olori ogun, ati awọn enia nla ni ilu, Festu paṣẹ, nwọn si mu Paulu jade.
entries.en: And on the morrow, when Agrippa was come, and Bernice, with great pomp, and was entered into the place of hearing, with the chief captains, and principal men of the city, at Festus' commandment Paul was brought forth.

entries.yo: Festu si wipe, Agrippa ọba, ati gbogbo ẹnyin enia ti o wà nihin pẹlu wa, ẹnyin ri ọkunrin yi, nitori ẹniti gbogbo ijọ awọn Ju ti rọgbaká mi, ni Jerusalemu ati nihinyi, ti nwọn nkigbe pe, Kò yẹ fun u lati wà lãye mọ́.
entries.en: And Festus said, King Agrippa, and all men which are here present with us, ye see this man, about whom all the multitude of the Jews have dealt with me, both at Jerusalem, and also here, crying that he ought not to live any longer.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi ri pe, kò ṣe ohun kan ti o yẹ si ikú, bi on tikararẹ̀ si ti fi ọ̀ran rẹ̀ lọ Augustu, mo ti pinnu lati rán a lọ.
entries.en: But when I found that he had committed nothing worthy of death, and that he himself hath appealed to Augustus, I have determined to send him.

entries.yo: Nipasẹ ẹniti emi kò ri ohun kan dajudaju lati kọwe si oluwa mi. Nitorina ni mo ṣe mu u jade wá siwaju nyin, ati pe siwaju rẹ, Agrippa ọba, pãpã lẹhin ti a ba ti wadi rẹ̀, ki emi ki o le ri ohun ti emi ó kọ.
entries.en: Of whom I have no certain thing to write unto my lord. Wherefore I have brought him forth before you, and specially before thee, O king Agrippa, that, after examination had, I might have somewhat to write.

entries.yo: Nitoriti kò tọ́ li oju mi lati rán ondè, ki a má si sọ ọ̀ran ti a kà si i lọrùn.
entries.en: For it seemeth to me unreasonable to send a prisoner, and not withal to signify the crimes laid against him.

entries.yo: AGRIPPA si wi fun Paulu pe, A fun ọ làye lati sọ ti ẹnu rẹ. Nigbana ni Paulu nawọ́, o si sọ ti ẹnu rẹ̀ pe:
entries.en: Then Agrippa said unto Paul, Thou art permitted to speak for thyself. Then Paul stretched forth the hand, and answered for himself:

entries.yo: Agrippa ọba, inu emi tikarami dùn nitoriti emi o wi ti ẹnu mi loni niwaju rẹ, niti gbogbo nkan ti awọn Ju nfi mi sùn si.
entries.en: I think myself happy, king Agrippa, because I shall answer for myself this day before thee touching all the things whereof I am accused of the Jews:

entries.yo: Pãpã bi iwọ ti mọ̀ gbogbo iṣe ati ọ̀ran ti mbẹ lãrin awọn Ju dajudaju, nitorina emi bẹ̀ ọ ki iwọ ki o fi sũru gbọ temi.
entries.en: Especially because I know thee to be expert in all customs and questions which are among the Jews: wherefore I beseech thee to hear me patiently.

entries.yo: Iwà aiye mi lati igba ewe mi, bi o ti ri lati ibẹrẹ, lãrin orilẹ-ede mi ati ni Jerusalemu, ni gbogbo awọn Ju mọ̀.
entries.en: My manner of life from my youth, which was at the first among mine own nation at Jerusalem, know all the Jews;

entries.yo: Nitori nwọn mọ̀ mi lati ipilẹṣẹ, bi nwọn ba fẹ́ jẹri pe, gẹgẹ bi ẹya ìsin wa ti o le julọ, Farisi li emi.
entries.en: Which knew me from the beginning, if they would testify, that after the most straitest sect of our religion I lived a Pharisee.

entries.yo: Ati nisisiyi nitori ireti ileri ti Ọlọrun ti ṣe fun awọn baba wa ni mo ṣe duro nihin fun idajọ.
entries.en: And now I stand and am judged for the hope of the promise made of God unto our fathers:

entries.yo: Ileri eyiti awọn ẹ̀ya wa mejejila ti nfi itara sin Ọlọrun lọsan ati loru ti nwọn nreti ati ri gba. Nitori ireti yi li awọn Ju ṣe nfi mi sùn, Agrippa Ọba.
entries.en: Unto which promise our twelve tribes, instantly serving God day and night, hope to come. For which hope's sake, king Agrippa, I am accused of the Jews.

entries.yo: Ẽṣe ti ẹnyin fi rò o si ohun ti a kò le gbagbọ́ bi Ọlọrun ba jí okú dide?
entries.en: Why should it be thought a thing incredible with you, that God should raise the dead?

entries.yo: Emi tilẹ rò ninu ara mi nitõtọ pe, o yẹ ki emi ki o ṣe ọpọlọpọ ohun òdi si orukọ Jesu ti Nasareti.
entries.en: I verily thought with myself, that I ought to do many things contrary to the name of Jesus of Nazareth.

entries.yo: Eyi ni mo si ṣe ni Jerusalemu: awọn pipọ ninu awọn enia mimọ́ ni mo há mọ́ inu tubu, nigbati mo ti gbà aṣẹ lọdọ awọn olori alufa; nigbati nwọn si npa wọn, mo li ohùn si i.
entries.en: Which thing I also did in Jerusalem: and many of the saints did I shut up in prison, having received authority from the chief priests; and when they were put to death, I gave my voice against them.

entries.yo: Nigbapipọ ni mo ṣẹ́ wọn niṣẹ ninu gbogbo sinagogu, mo ndù u lati mu wọn sọ ọrọ-odi; nigbati mo ṣoro si wọn gidigidi, mo ṣe inunibini si wọn de àjeji ilu.
entries.en: And I punished them oft in every synagogue, and compelled them to blaspheme; and being exceedingly mad against them, I persecuted them even unto strange cities.

entries.yo: Ninu rẹ̀ na bi mo ti nlọ si Damasku ti emi ti ọlá ati aṣẹ ikọ̀ lati ọdọ awọn olori alufa lọ,
entries.en: Whereupon as I went to Damascus with authority and commission from the chief priests,

entries.yo: Li ọsangangan, Ọba, mo ri imọlẹ kan lati ọrun wá, o jù riràn õrùn lọ, o mọlẹ yi mi ká, ati awọn ti o mba mi rè ajo.
entries.en: At midday, O king, I saw in the way a light from heaven, above the brightness of the sun, shining round about me and them which journeyed with me.

entries.yo: Nigbati gbogbo wa si ṣubu lulẹ, mo gbọ́ ohùn ti nfọ̀ si mi ni ède Heberu pe, Saulu, Saulu, ẽṣe ti iwọ fi nṣe inunibini si mi? Ohun irora ni fun ọ lati tapá si ẹgún.
entries.en: And when we were all fallen to the earth, I heard a voice speaking unto me, and saying in the Hebrew tongue, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me? it is hard for thee to kick against the pricks.

entries.yo: Emi si wipe, Iwọ tani, Oluwa? Oluwa si wipe, Emi ni Jesu ti iwọ nṣe inunibini si.
entries.en: And I said, Who art thou, Lord? And he said, I am Jesus whom thou persecutest.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn dide, ki o si fi ẹsẹ rẹ tẹlẹ: nitori eyi ni mo ṣe farahàn ọ lati yàn ọ ni iranṣẹ ati ẹlẹri, fun ohun wọnni ti iwọ ti ri, ati ohun wọnni ti emi ó fi ara hàn fun ọ;
entries.en: But rise, and stand upon thy feet: for I have appeared unto thee for this purpose, to make thee a minister and a witness both of these things which thou hast seen, and of those things in the which I will appear unto thee;

entries.yo: Emi o ma gbà ọ lọwọ awọn enia, ati lọwọ awọn Keferi, ti emi rán ọ si nisisiyi,
entries.en: Delivering thee from the people, and from the Gentiles, unto whom now I send thee,

entries.yo: Lati là wọn li oju, ki nwọn ki o le yipada kuro ninu òkunkun si imọlẹ, ati kuro lọwọ agbara Satani si Ọlọrun, ki nwọn ki o le gbà idariji ẹ̀ṣẹ, ati ogún pẹlu awọn ti a sọ di mimọ́ nipa igbagbọ ninu mi.
entries.en: To open their eyes, and to turn them from darkness to light, and from the power of Satan unto God, that they may receive forgiveness of sins, and inheritance among them which are sanctified by faith that is in me.

entries.yo: Nitorina, Agrippa ọba, emi kò ṣe aigbọran si iran ọ̀run na.
entries.en: Whereupon, O king Agrippa, I was not disobedient unto the heavenly vision:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn mo kọ́ sọ fun awọn ti o wà ni Damasku, ati ni Jerusalemu, ati já gbogbo ilẹ Judea, ati fun awọn Keferi, ki nwọn ki o ronupiwada, ki nwọn si yipada si Ọlọrun, ki nwọn mã ṣe iṣẹ ti o yẹ si ironupiwada.
entries.en: But shewed first unto them of Damascus, and at Jerusalem, and throughout all the coasts of Judaea, and then to the Gentiles, that they should repent and turn to God, and do works meet for repentance.

entries.yo: Nitori nkan wọnyi li awọn Ju ṣe mu mi ni tẹmpili, ti nwọn si fẹ pa mi.
entries.en: For these causes the Jews caught me in the temple, and went about to kill me.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi mo si ti ri iranlọwọ gbà lọdọ Ọlọrun, mo duro titi o fi di oni, mo njẹri fun ati ewe ati àgba, emi kò sọ ohun miran bikoṣe ohun ti awọn woli ati Mose ti wipe yio ṣẹ:
entries.en: Having therefore obtained help of God, I continue unto this day, witnessing both to small and great, saying none other things than those which the prophets and Moses did say should come:

entries.yo: Pe, Kristi yio jìya, ati pe nipa ajinde rẹ̀ kuro ninu oku, on ni yio kọ́ kede imọlẹ fun awọn enia ati fun awọn Keferi.
entries.en: That Christ should suffer, and that he should be the first that should rise from the dead, and should shew light unto the people, and to the Gentiles.

entries.yo: Bi o si ti nsọ t'ẹnu rẹ̀, Festu wi li ohùn rara pe, Paulu, ori rẹ bajẹ; ẹkọ́ akọjù ba ọ li ori jẹ.
entries.en: And as he thus spake for himself, Festus said with a loud voice, Paul, thou art beside thyself; much learning doth make thee mad.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Paulu wipe, Ori mi kò bajẹ, Festu ọlọlá julọ; ṣugbọn ọ̀rọ otitọ ati ti ìwa airekọja li emi nsọ jade.
entries.en: But he said, I am not mad, most noble Festus; but speak forth the words of truth and soberness.

entries.yo: Nitori ọba mọ̀ nkan gbogbo wọnyi, niwaju ẹniti emi nsọ̀rọ li aibẹ̀ru: nitori mo gbagbọ pe ọkan ninu nkan wọnyi kò pamọ fun u, nitoriti a kò ṣe nkan yi ni ìkọkọ.
entries.en: For the king knoweth of these things, before whom also I speak freely: for I am persuaded that none of these things are hidden from him; for this thing was not done in a corner.

entries.yo: Agrippa ọba, iwọ gbà awọn woli gbọ́? Emi mọ̀ pe, iwọ gbagbọ́.
entries.en: King Agrippa, believest thou the prophets? I know that thou believest.

entries.yo: Agrippa si wi fun Paulu pe, Pẹlu ọrọ iyanju diẹ si i, iwọ iba sọ mi di Kristiani.
entries.en: Then Agrippa said unto Paul, Almost thou persuadest me to be a Christian.

entries.yo: Paulu si wipe, Iba wu Ọlọrun, yala pẹlu ãpọn diẹ tabi pipọ pe, ki o maṣe iwọ nikan, ṣugbọn ki gbogbo awọn ti o gbọ́ ọ̀rọ mi loni pẹlu le di iru enia ti emi jẹ laisi ẹwọn wọnyi.
entries.en: And Paul said, I would to God, that not only thou, but also all that hear me this day, were both almost, and altogether such as I am, except these bonds.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si sọ nkan wọnyi tan, ọba dide, ati bãlẹ, ati Bernike, ati awọn ti o ba wọn joko:
entries.en: And when he had thus spoken, the king rose up, and the governor, and Bernice, and they that sat with them:

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn lọ si apakan, nwọn ba ara wọn sọ pe, ọkunrin yi kò ṣe nkankan ti o yẹ si ikú tabi si ẹ̀wọn.
entries.en: And when they were gone aside, they talked between themselves, saying, This man doeth nothing worthy of death or of bonds.

entries.yo: Agrippa si wi fun Festu pe, A ba dá ọkunrin yi silẹ ibamaṣepe kò ti fi ọ̀ran rẹ̀ lọ Kesari.
entries.en: Then said Agrippa unto Festus, This man might have been set at liberty, if he had not appealed unto Caesar.

entries.yo: Bi a si ti pinnu rẹ̀ pe ki a wọ̀ ọkọ lọ si Itali, nwọn fi Paulu, ati awọn ondè miran kan pẹlu, le balogun ọrún kan lọwọ, ti a npè ni Juliu, ti ẹgbẹ ọmọ-ogun Augustu.
entries.en: And when it was determined that we should sail into Italy, they delivered Paul and certain other prisoners unto one named Julius, a centurion of Augustus' band.

entries.yo: Nigbati a si wọ̀ ọkọ̀ Adramittiu kan, ti nfẹ lọ si awọn ilu ti o wà leti okun Asia, awa ṣikọ̀: Aristarku, ara Makedonia ti Tessalonika, wà pẹlu wa.
entries.en: And entering into a ship of Adramyttium, we launched, meaning to sail by the coasts of Asia; one Aristarchus, a Macedonian of Thessalonica, being with us.

entries.yo: Ni ijọ keji awa de Sidoni. Juliu si ṣe inu rere si Paulu, o si bùn u láye ki o mã tọ̀ awọn ọrẹ́ rẹ̀ lọ lati ri itọju.
entries.en: And the next day we touched at Sidon. And Julius courteously entreated Paul, and gave him liberty to go unto his friends to refresh himself.

entries.yo: Nigbati awa si ṣikọ̀ nibẹ̀, awa lọ lẹba Kipru, nitoriti afẹfẹ ṣọwọ òdi.
entries.en: And when we had launched from thence, we sailed under Cyprus, because the winds were contrary.

entries.yo: Nigbati awa ré okun Kilikia on Pamfilia kọja, awa de Mira Likia.
entries.en: And when we had sailed over the sea of Cilicia and Pamphylia, we came to Myra, a city of Lycia.

entries.yo: Nibẹ̀ ni balogun ọrún si ri ọkọ̀ Aleksandria kan, ti nlọ si Itali; o si fi wa sinu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And there the centurion found a ship of Alexandria sailing into Italy; and he put us therein.

entries.yo: Nigbati awa nlọ jẹ́jẹ li ọjọ pipọ, ti awa fi agbara kaka de ọkankan Knidu, ti afẹfẹ kò bùn wa làye, awa lọ lẹba Krete, li ọkankan Salmone;
entries.en: And when we had sailed slowly many days, and scarce were come over against Cnidus, the wind not suffering us, we sailed under Crete, over against Salmone;

entries.yo: Nigbati a si fi agbara kaka kọja rẹ̀, awa de ibi ti a npè ni Ebute Yiyanjú, ti o sunmọ ibiti ilu Lasea ti wà ri.
entries.en: And, hardly passing it, came unto a place which is called The fair havens; nigh whereunto was the city of Lasea.

entries.yo: Nigbati a si ti sọ ọjọ pipọ nù, ti a-ti ta igbokun wa idi ewu tan, nitori Awẹ ti kọja tan, Paulu da imọran,
entries.en: Now when much time was spent, and when sailing was now dangerous, because the fast was now already past, Paul admonished them,

entries.yo: O si wi fun wọn pe, Alàgba, mo woye pe iṣikọ̀ yi yio li ewu ati òfo pipọ, kì iṣe kìki ti ẹrù ati ti ọkọ̀, ṣugbọn ti ẹmí wa pẹlu.
entries.en: And said unto them, Sirs, I perceive that this voyage will be with hurt and much damage, not only of the lading and ship, but also of our lives.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn balogun ọrún gbà ti olori ọkọ̀ ati ti ọlọkọ̀ gbọ́, jù ohun wọnni ti Paulu wi lọ.
entries.en: Nevertheless the centurion believed the master and the owner of the ship, more than those things which were spoken by Paul.

entries.yo: Ati nitori ebute na kò rọrùn lati lo akoko otutu nibẹ̀, awọn pipọ si damọran pe, ki a lọ kuro nibẹ̀, bi nwọn ó le làkàka de Fenike lati lo akoko otutu, ti iṣe ebute Krete ti o kọju si òsi ìwọ õrùn, ati ọtún ìwọ õrùn.
entries.en: And because the haven was not commodious to winter in, the more part advised to depart thence also, if by any means they might attain to Phenice, and there to winter; which is an haven of Crete, and lieth toward the south west and north west.

entries.yo: Nigbati afẹfẹ gusù si nfẹ jẹ́jẹ, ti nwọn ṣebi ọwọ awọn tẹ̀ ohun ti nwọn nwá, nwọn ṣikọ̀, nwọn npá ẹba Krete lọ.
entries.en: And when the south wind blew softly, supposing that they had obtained their purpose, loosing thence, they sailed close by Crete.

entries.yo: Kò si pẹ lẹhin na ni ìji ti a npè ni Eurakuilo fẹ lù u.
entries.en: But not long after there arose against it a tempestuous wind, called Euroclydon.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si ti gbé ọkọ̀, ti kò si le dojukọ ìji na, awa jọwọ rẹ̀, o ngbá a lọ.
entries.en: And when the ship was caught, and could not bear up into the wind, we let her drive.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si gbá a lọ labẹ erekuṣu kan ti a npè ni Klauda, o di iṣẹ pipọ ki awa ki o to le sunmọ igbaja.
entries.en: And running under a certain island which is called Clauda, we had much work to come by the boat:

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si gbé e soke, nwọn nṣe iranlọwọ, nwọn ndì ọkọ ni isalẹ; nigbati nwọn si bẹ̀ru ki a ma ba gbá wọn sori iyanrìn diẹ̀, nwọn tagbokun, nwọn si ngbá kiri.
entries.en: Which when they had taken up, they used helps, undergirding the ship; and, fearing lest they should fall into the quicksands, strake sail, and so were driven.

entries.yo: Bi awa si ti nṣe lãlã gidigidi ninu ìji na, ni ijọ keji nwọn kó nkan dà si omi lati mu ọkọ̀ fẹrẹ;
entries.en: And we being exceedingly tossed with a tempest, the next day they lightened the ship;

entries.yo: Ati ni ijọ kẹta, a fi ọwọ́ ara wa kó ohun èlo ọkọ̀ danu.
entries.en: And the third day we cast out with our own hands the tackling of the ship.

entries.yo: Nigbati õrùn ati irawọ kò si hàn li ọjọ pipọ, ti ìji na kò si mọ̀ niwọn fun wa, abá a-ti-là kò si fun wa mọ́.
entries.en: And when neither sun nor stars in many days appeared, and no small tempest lay on us, all hope that we should be saved was then taken away.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn wà ni aijẹun li ọjọ pipọ, nigbana Paulu dide larin wọn, o ni, Alàgba, ẹnyin iba ti gbọ́ ti emi, ki a máṣe ṣikọ̀ kuro ni Krete, ewu ati òfo yi kì ba ti ba wa.
entries.en: But after long abstinence Paul stood forth in the midst of them, and said, Sirs, ye should have hearkened unto me, and not have loosed from Crete, and to have gained this harm and loss.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi mo gbà nyin niyanju, ki ẹ tújuka: nitori kì yio si òfo ẹmí ninu nyin, bikoṣe ti ọkọ̀.
entries.en: And now I exhort you to be of good cheer: for there shall be no loss of any man's life among you, but of the ship.

entries.yo: Nitori angẹli Ọlọrun, ti ẹniti emi iṣe, ati ẹniti emi nsìn, o duro tì mi li oru aná,
entries.en: For there stood by me this night the angel of God, whose I am, and whom I serve,

entries.yo: O wipe, Má bẹ̀ru, Paulu; iwọ kò le ṣaima duro niwaju Kesari: si wo o, Ọlọrun ti fi gbogbo awọn ti o ba ọ wọkọ̀ pọ̀ fun ọ.
entries.en: Saying, Fear not, Paul; thou must be brought before Caesar: and, lo, God hath given thee all them that sail with thee.

entries.yo: Njẹ nitorina, alàgba, ẹ daraya: nitori mo gbà Ọlọrun gbọ́ pe, yio ri bẹ̃ gẹgẹ bi a ti sọ fun mi.
entries.en: Wherefore, sirs, be of good cheer: for I believe God, that it shall be even as it was told me.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn a ó gbá wa jù si erekuṣu kan.
entries.en: Howbeit we must be cast upon a certain island.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati o di oru ijọ kẹrinla, ti awa ngbá sihin sọhún ni Adria, larin ọganjọ awọn atukọ̀ tànmã pe, awọn sunmọ eti ilẹ kan;
entries.en: But when the fourteenth night was come, as we were driven up and down in Adria, about midnight the shipmen deemed that they drew near to some country;

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si wọ̀n okun, nwọn ri i o jìn li ogún àgbaká: nigbati nwọn si sún siwaju diẹ, nwọn si tún wọ̀n okun, nwọn ri i o jìn ni àgbaká mẹ̃dogun.
entries.en: And sounded, and found it twenty fathoms: and when they had gone a little further, they sounded again, and found it fifteen fathoms.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn bẹ̀ru ki nwọn ki o máṣe gbá lù ibi okuta, nwọn sọ idakọró mẹrin silẹ ni idi ọkọ̀, nwọn nreti ojumọ́.
entries.en: Then fearing lest we should have fallen upon rocks, they cast four anchors out of the stern, and wished for the day.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati awọn atukọ̀ nwá ọ̀na ati sá kuro ninu ọkọ̀, ti nwọn si ti sọ igbaja kalẹ si oju okun bi ẹnipe nwọn nfẹ sọ idakọró silẹ niwaju ọkọ̀,
entries.en: And as the shipmen were about to flee out of the ship, when they had let down the boat into the sea, under colour as though they would have cast anchors out of the foreship,

entries.yo: Paulu wi fun balogun ọrún ati fun awọn ọmọ-ogun pe, Bikoṣepe awọn wọnyi ba duro ninu ọkọ̀ ẹnyin kì yio le là.
entries.en: Paul said to the centurion and to the soldiers, Except these abide in the ship, ye cannot be saved.

entries.yo: Nigbana li awọn ọmọ-ogun ke okùn igbaja, nwọn jọwọ rẹ̀ ki o ṣubu sọhún.
entries.en: Then the soldiers cut off the ropes of the boat, and let her fall off.

entries.yo: Nigbati ilẹ nmọ́ bọ̀, Paulu bẹ̀ gbogbo wọn ki nwọn ki o jẹun diẹ, o wipe, Oni li o di ijẹrinla ti ẹnyin ti nreti, ti ẹ kò dẹkun gbãwẹ, ti ẹ kò si jẹun.
entries.en: And while the day was coming on, Paul besought them all to take meat, saying, This day is the fourteenth day that ye have tarried and continued fasting, having taken nothing.

entries.yo: Nitorina mo bẹ̀ nyin, ki ẹ jẹun diẹ: nitori eyi ni fun igbala nyin: nitori irun kan kì yio re kuro li ori ẹnikan nyin.
entries.en: Wherefore I pray you to take some meat: for this is for your health: for there shall not an hair fall from the head of any of you.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si wi nkan wọnyi, ti o si mu akara, o dupẹ lọwọ Ọlọrun niwaju gbogbo wọn: nigbati o si bù u, o bẹ̀rẹ si ijẹ.
entries.en: And when he had thus spoken, he took bread, and gave thanks to God in presence of them all: and when he had broken it, he began to eat.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni gbogbo wọn si daraya, awọn pẹlu si gbà onjẹ.
entries.en: Then were they all of good cheer, and they also took some meat.

entries.yo: Gbogbo wa ti mbẹ ninu ọkọ̀ na si jẹ ọrinlugba ọkàn o dí mẹrin.
entries.en: And we were in all in the ship two hundred threescore and sixteen souls.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn jẹun yó tan, nwọn kó nkan danù kuro ninu ọkọ̀, nwọn si kó alikama dà si omi.
entries.en: And when they had eaten enough, they lightened the ship, and cast out the wheat into the sea.

entries.yo: Nigbati ilẹ si mọ, nwọn kò mọ̀ ilẹ na: ṣugbọn nwọn ri apa odò kan ti o li ebute, nibẹ̀ ni nwọn gbero, bi nwọn o ba le tì ọkọ̀ si.
entries.en: And when it was day, they knew not the land: but they discovered a certain creek with a shore, into the which they were minded, if it were possible, to thrust in the ship.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si ké idakọró kuro, nwọn jọ̀wọ wọn sinu okun, lẹsẹkanna nwọn tu ide ọkọ̀, nwọn si ta igbokun iwaju ọkọ̀ si afẹfẹ, nwọn wa kọju si ilẹ.
entries.en: And when they had taken up the anchors, they committed themselves unto the sea, and loosed the rudder bands, and hoised up the mainsail to the wind, and made toward shore.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si de ibiti okun meji pade, nwọn fi ori ọkọ̀ sọlẹ; iwaju rẹ̀ si kàn mọlẹ ṣinṣin, o duro, kò le yi, ṣugbọn agbara riru omi bẹrẹ si fọ́ idi ọkọ̀ na.
entries.en: And falling into a place where two seas met, they ran the ship aground; and the forepart stuck fast, and remained unmoveable, but the hinder part was broken with the violence of the waves.

entries.yo: Ero awọn ọmọ-ogun ni ki a pa awọn onde, ki ẹnikẹni wọn ki o má ba wẹ̀ jade sá lọ.
entries.en: And the soldiers' counsel was to kill the prisoners, lest any of them should swim out, and escape.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn balogun ọrún nfẹ gbà Paulu là, o kọ̀ ero wọn; o si paṣẹ fun awọn ti o le wẹ̀ ki nwọn ki o kọ́ bọ si okun lọ si ilẹ,
entries.en: But the centurion, willing to save Paul, kept them from their purpose; and commanded that they which could swim should cast themselves first into the sea, and get to land:

entries.yo: Ati awọn iyokù, omiran lori apako, ati omiran lori ẹfọkọ̀. Bẹ̃li o si ṣe ti gbogbo wọn yọ, li alafia de ilẹ.
entries.en: And the rest, some on boards, and some on broken pieces of the ship. And so it came to pass, that they escaped all safe to land.

entries.yo: NIGBATI gbogbo wa si yọ tan ni awa mọ̀ pe, Melita li a npè erekuṣu na.
entries.en: And when they were escaped, then they knew that the island was called Melita.

entries.yo: Kì si iṣe ore diẹ li awọn alaigbede na ṣe fun wa: nitoriti nwọn daná, nwọn si gbà gbogbo wa si ọdọ nitori òjo igba na, ati itori otutù.
entries.en: And the barbarous people shewed us no little kindness: for they kindled a fire, and received us every one, because of the present rain, and because of the cold.

entries.yo: Nigbati Paulu si ṣà ìdi iwọ́nwọ́n igi jọ, ti o si kó o sinu iná, pamọlẹ kan ti inu oru jade, o dì mọ́ ọ li ọwọ́.
entries.en: And when Paul had gathered a bundle of sticks, and laid them on the fire, there came a viper out of the heat, and fastened on his hand.

entries.yo: Bi awọn alaigbede na si ti ri ẹranko oloró na ti dì mọ́ ọ li ọwọ́, nwọn ba ara wọn sọ pe, Dajudaju apania li ọkunrin yi, ẹniti o yọ ninu okun tan, ṣugbọn ti ẹsan kò si jẹ ki o wà lãye.
entries.en: And when the barbarians saw the venomous beast hang on his hand, they said among themselves, No doubt this man is a murderer, whom, though he hath escaped the sea, yet vengeance suffereth not to live.

entries.yo: On si gbọ̀n ẹranko na sinu iná, ohunkohun kan kò ṣe e.
entries.en: And he shook off the beast into the fire, and felt no harm.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nwọn nwoye igbati yio wú, tabi ti yio si ṣubu lulẹ kú lojiji: nigbati nwọn wò titi, ti nwọn kò si ri nkankan ki o ṣe e, nwọn pa iyè da pe, oriṣa kan li ọkunrin yi.
entries.en: Howbeit they looked when he should have swollen, or fallen down dead suddenly: but after they had looked a great while, and saw no harm come to him, they changed their minds, and said that he was a god.

entries.yo: Li àgbegbe ibẹ̀ ni ilẹ ọkunrin ọlọlá erekuṣu na wà, orukọ ẹniti a npè ni Publiu; ẹniti o gbà wa si ọdọ, ti o si fi inu rere mu wa wọ̀ ni ijọ mẹta.
entries.en: In the same quarters were possessions of the chief man of the island, whose name was Publius; who received us, and lodged us three days courteously.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, baba Publiu dubulẹ arùn ibà ati ọ̀rin: ẹniti Paulu wọle tọ̀ lọ, ti o si gbadura fun, nigbati o si fi ọwọ́ le e, o mu u larada.
entries.en: And it came to pass, that the father of Publius lay sick of a fever and of a bloody flux: to whom Paul entered in, and prayed, and laid his hands on him, and healed him.

entries.yo: Nigbati eyi si ṣe tan, awọn iyokù ti o li arùn li erekuṣu na, tọ̀ ọ wá, o si mu wọn larada:
entries.en: So when this was done, others also, which had diseases in the island, came, and were healed:

entries.yo: Awọn ẹniti o bù ọlá pipọ fun wa; nigbati awa si nlọ, nwọn dì nkan gbogbo rù wa ti a ba ṣe alaini.
entries.en: Who also honoured us with many honours; and when we departed, they laded us with such things as were necessary.

entries.yo: Ati lẹhin oṣù mẹta awa wọ̀ ọkọ Aleksandria kan, ti o lo akoko otutu li erekuṣu na, àmi eyi ti iṣe Kastoru on Poluksu.
entries.en: And after three months we departed in a ship of Alexandria, which had wintered in the isle, whose sign was Castor and Pollux.

entries.yo: Nigbati awa gúnlẹ ni Sirakuse, awa gbé ibẹ̀ ni ijọ mẹta.
entries.en: And landing at Syracuse, we tarried there three days.

entries.yo: Lati ibẹ̀ nigbati awa lọ yiká, awa de Regioni: ati lẹhin ijọ kan afẹfẹ gusù dide, ni ijọ keji rẹ̀ awa si de Puteoli,
entries.en: And from thence we fetched a compass, and came to Rhegium: and after one day the south wind blew, and we came the next day to Puteoli:

entries.yo: Nibiti a gbé ri awọn arakunrin, ti nwọn si bẹ̀ wa lati ba wọn gbé ni ijọ meje: bẹ̃li awa si lọ si ìha Romu.
entries.en: Where we found brethren, and were desired to tarry with them seven days: and so we went toward Rome.

entries.yo: Ati lati ibẹ nigbati awọn arakunrin gburó wa, nwọn wá titi nwọn fi de Apii Foroni, ati Arojẹ mẹta, lati pade wa: nigbati Paulu si ri wọn, o dupẹ lọwọ Ọlọrun, o mu ọkàn le.
entries.en: And from thence, when the brethren heard of us, they came to meet us as far as Appiiforum, and The three taverns: whom when Paul saw, he thanked God, and took courage.

entries.yo: Nigbati awa si de Romu, balogun ọrún fi awọn ondè le olori ẹṣọ́ lọwọ: ṣugbọn nwọn jẹ ki Paulu ki o mã dagbe fun ara rẹ̀ pẹlu ọmọ-ogun ti ṣọ́ ọ.
entries.en: And when we came to Rome, the centurion delivered the prisoners to the captain of the guard: but Paul was suffered to dwell by himself with a soldier that kept him.

entries.yo: O si ṣe, lẹhin ijọ mẹta, Paulu pè awọn olori Ju jọ: nigbati nwọn si pejọ, o wi fun wọn pe, Ará, biotiṣe pe emi kò ṣe ohun kan lòdi si awọn enia, tabi si iṣe awọn baba wa, sibẹ nwọn fi mi le awọn ara Romu lọwọ li ondè lati Jerusalemu wá.
entries.en: And it came to pass, that after three days Paul called the chief of the Jews together: and when they were come together, he said unto them, Men and brethren, though I have committed nothing against the people, or customs of our fathers, yet was I delivered prisoner from Jerusalem into the hands of the Romans.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn si wádi ọ̀ran mi, nwọn fẹ jọwọ mi lọwọ lọ, nitoriti kò si ọ̀ran ikú lara mi.
entries.en: Who, when they had examined me, would have let me go, because there was no cause of death in me.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati awọn Ju sọ̀rọ lòdi si i, eyi sún mi lati fi ọ̀ran mi lọ Kesari; kì iṣe pe mo ni nkan lati fi orilẹ-ède mi sùn si.
entries.en: But when the Jews spake against it, I was constrained to appeal unto Caesar; not that I had ought to accuse my nation of.

entries.yo: Njẹ nitori ọ̀ran yi ni mo ṣe ranṣẹ pè nyin, lati ri nyin, ati lati ba nyin sọ̀rọ: nitoripe nitori ireti Israeli li a ṣe fi ẹ̀wọn yi dè mi.
entries.en: For this cause therefore have I called for you, to see you, and to speak with you: because that for the hope of Israel I am bound with this chain.

entries.yo: Nwọn si wi fun u pe, Awa kò ri iwe gbà lati Judea wá nitori rẹ, bẹ̃li ẹnikan ninu awọn arakunrin ti o ti ibẹ̀ wá kò rohin, tabi ki o sọ̀rọ ibi kan si ọ.
entries.en: And they said unto him, We neither received letters out of Judaea concerning thee, neither any of the brethren that came shewed or spake any harm of thee.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awa nfẹ gbọ́ li ẹnu rẹ ohun ti iwọ rò: nitori bi o ṣe ti ìsin iyapa yi ni, awa mọ̀ pe, nibigbogbo li a nsọ̀rọ lòdi si i.
entries.en: But we desire to hear of thee what thou thinkest: for as concerning this sect, we know that every where it is spoken against.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn dá ọjọ fun u, ọ̀pọlọpọ wọn li o tọ̀ ọ wá ni ile àgbawọ rẹ̀; awọn ẹniti o sọ asọye ọrọ ijọba Ọlọrun fun, o nyi wọn lọkàn pada sipa ti Jesu, lati inu ofin Mose ati awọn woli wá, lati owurọ̀ titi o fi di aṣalẹ.
entries.en: And when they had appointed him a day, there came many to him into his lodging; to whom he expounded and testified the kingdom of God, persuading them concerning Jesus, both out of the law of Moses, and out of the prophets, from morning till evening.

entries.yo: Ẹlomiran si gbà ohun ti o nwi gbọ́, ẹlomiran kò si gbagbọ́.
entries.en: And some believed the things which were spoken, and some believed not.

entries.yo: Nigbati ohùn wọn kò ṣọ̀kan lãrin ara wọn, nwọn tuká, lẹhin igbati Paulu sọ̀rọ kan pe, Otitọ li Ẹmí Mimọ́ sọ lati ẹnu woli Isaiah wá fun awọn baba wa,
entries.en: And when they agreed not among themselves, they departed, after that Paul had spoken one word, Well spake the Holy Ghost by Esaias the prophet unto our fathers,

entries.yo: Wipe, Tọ̀ awọn enia wọnyi lọ, ki o si wipe, Ni gbigbọ́ ẹnyin ó gbọ́, kì yio si yé nyin; ati ni riri ẹnyin ó ri, ẹnyin kì yio si woye:
entries.en: Saying, Go unto this people, and say, Hearing ye shall hear, and shall not understand; and seeing ye shall see, and not perceive:

entries.yo: Nitoriti àiya awọn enia yi sebọ, etí wọn si wuwo lati fi gbọ́, oju wọn ni nwọn si ti dì: nitori ki nwọn ki o má ba fi oju wọn ri, ki nwọn ki o má ba fi etí wọn gbọ́, ati ki nwọn ki o má ba fi ọkàn wọn mọ̀, ki nwọn ki o má ba yipada, ati ki emi ki o má ba mu wọn larada.
entries.en: For the heart of this people is waxed gross, and their ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes have they closed; lest they should see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and understand with their heart, and should be converted, and I should heal them.

entries.yo: Njẹ ki ẹnyin ki o mọ̀ eyi pe, a rán igbala Ọlọrun si awọn Keferi, nwọn ó si gbọ́.
entries.en: Be it known therefore unto you, that the salvation of God is sent unto the Gentiles, and that they will hear it.

entries.yo: Nigbati o si ti sọ ọ̀rọ wọnyi fun wọn tan, awọn Ju lọ, nwọn ba ara wọn jiyàn pipọ.
entries.en: And when he had said these words, the Jews departed, and had great reasoning among themselves.

entries.yo: Paulu si gbe ile àgbawọ rẹ̀ lọdun meji tọ̀tọ, o si ngbà gbogbo awọn ti o wọle tọ̀ ọ wá,
entries.en: And Paul dwelt two whole years in his own hired house, and received all that came in unto him,

entries.yo: O nwasu ijọba Ọlọrun, o si nfi igboiya gbogbo kọ́ni li ohun wọnni ti iṣe ti Jesu Kristi Oluwa, ẹnikan kò da a lẹkun.
entries.en: Preaching the kingdom of God, and teaching those things which concern the Lord Jesus Christ, with all confidence, no man forbidding him.

entries.yo: PAULU, iranṣẹ Jesu Kristi, ti a pè lati jẹ aposteli, ti a yà sọ̀tọ fun ihinrere Ọlọrun,
entries.en: Paul, a servant of Jesus Christ, called to be an apostle, separated unto the gospel of God,

entries.yo: (Ti o ti ṣe ileri tẹlẹ rí ninu iwe-mimọ́, lati ọwọ awọn woli rẹ̀),
entries.en: (Which he had promised afore by his prophets in the holy scriptures,)

entries.yo: Niti Ọmọ rẹ̀, ti a bí lati inu irú-ọmọ Dafidi nipa ti ara,
entries.en: Concerning his Son Jesus Christ our Lord, which was made of the seed of David according to the flesh;

entries.yo: Ẹniti a pinnu rẹ̀ lati jẹ pẹlu agbara Ọmọ Ọlọrun, gẹgẹ bi Ẹmí iwa mimọ́, nipa ajinde kuro ninu okú, ani Jesu Kristi Oluwa wa:
entries.en: And declared to be the Son of God with power, according to the spirit of holiness, by the resurrection from the dead:

entries.yo: Lati ọdọ ẹniti awa ri ore-ọfẹ ati iṣẹ aposteli gbà, fun igbọràn igbagbọ́ lãrin gbogbo orilẹ-ède, nitori orukọ rẹ̀:
entries.en: By whom we have received grace and apostleship, for obedience to the faith among all nations, for his name:

entries.yo: Larin awọn ẹniti ẹnyin pẹlu ti a pè lati jẹ ti Jesu Kristi:
entries.en: Among whom are ye also the called of Jesus Christ:

entries.yo: Si gbogbo ẹniti o wà ni Romu, olufẹ Ọlọrun, ti a pè lati jẹ mimọ́: Ore-ọfẹ si nyin ati alafia lati ọdọ Ọlọrun Baba wa wá, ati Jesu Kristi Oluwa.
entries.en: To all that be in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.

entries.yo: Mo kọ́ dupẹ na lọwọ Ọlọrun mi nipasẹ Jesu Kristi nitori gbogbo nyin, nitoripe a nròhin igbagbọ́ nyin yi gbogbo aiye ká.
entries.en: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for you all, that your faith is spoken of throughout the whole world.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun sá li ẹlẹri mi, ẹniti emi nfi ẹmi mi sìn ninu ihinrere Ọmọ rẹ̀, biotiṣepe li aisimi li emi nranti nyin nigbagbogbo ninu adura mi;
entries.en: For God is my witness, whom I serve with my spirit in the gospel of his Son, that without ceasing I make mention of you always in my prayers;

entries.yo: Emi mbẹ̀bẹ, bi lọna-kọna leke gbogbo rẹ̀, ki a le ṣe ọ̀na mi ni ire nipa ifẹ Ọlọrun, lati tọ̀ nyin wá.
entries.en: Making request, if by any means now at length I might have a prosperous journey by the will of God to come unto you.

entries.yo: Nitoriti emi nfẹ gidigidi lati ri nyin, ki emi ki o le fun nyin li ẹ̀bun ẹmi diẹ, ki a le fi ẹsẹ nyin mulẹ;
entries.en: For I long to see you, that I may impart unto you some spiritual gift, to the end ye may be established;

entries.yo: Eyini ni, ki a le jùmọ ni itunu ninu nyin nipa igbagbọ́ awa mejeji, ti nyin ati ti emi.
entries.en: That is, that I may be comforted together with you by the mutual faith both of you and me.

entries.yo: Ará, emi kò si fẹ ki ẹnyin ki o ṣe alaimọ̀ pe, nigba-pupọ li emi npinnu rẹ̀ lati tọ̀ nyin wá (ṣugbọn o di ẹtì fun mi di isisiyi,) ki emi ki o le ni eso diẹ ninu nyin pẹlu, gẹgẹ bi lãrin awọn Keferi iyokù.
entries.en: Now I would not have you ignorant, brethren, that oftentimes I purposed to come unto you, (but was let hitherto,) that I might have some fruit among you also, even as among other Gentiles.

entries.yo: Mo di ajigbese awọn Hellene ati awọn alaigbede; awọn ọlọ́gbọn ati awọn alaigbọn.
entries.en: I am debtor both to the Greeks, and to the Barbarians; both to the wise, and to the unwise.

entries.yo: Tobẹ̃ bi o ti wà ni ipá mi, mo mura tan lati wasu ihinrere fun ẹnyin ara Romu pẹlu.
entries.en: So, as much as in me is, I am ready to preach the gospel to you that are at Rome also.

entries.yo: Nitori emi kò tiju ihinrere Kristi: nitori agbara Ọlọrun ni si igbala fun olukuluku ẹniti o gbagbọ́; fun Ju ṣaju, ati fun Hellene pẹlu.
entries.en: For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ: for it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth; to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.

entries.yo: Nitori ninu rẹ̀ li ododo Ọlọrun hàn lati igbagbọ́ de igbagbọ́: gẹgẹ bi a ti kọ ọ pe, Ṣugbọn olododo yio wà nipa igbagbọ́.
entries.en: For therein is the righteousness of God revealed from faith to faith: as it is written, The just shall live by faith.

entries.yo: Nitori a fi ibinu Ọlọrun hàn lati ọrun wá si gbogbo aiwa-bi-Ọlọrun ati aiṣododo enia, awọn ẹniti o fi aiṣododo tẹ otitọ mọ́lẹ̀:
entries.en: For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men, who hold the truth in unrighteousness;

entries.yo: Nitori ohun ti ã le mọ̀ niti Ọlọrun o farahàn ninu wọn; nitori Ọlọrun ti fi i hàn fun wọn.
entries.en: Because that which may be known of God is manifest in them; for God hath shewed it unto them.

entries.yo: Nitori ohun rẹ̀ ti o farasin lati igba dida aiye a ri wọn gbangba, a nfi òye ohun ti a da mọ̀ ọ, ani agbara ati iwa-Ọlọrun rẹ̀ aiyeraiye, ki nwọn ki o le wà li airiwi:
entries.en: For the invisible things of him from the creation of the world are clearly seen, being understood by the things that are made, even his eternal power and Godhead; so that they are without excuse:

entries.yo: Nitori igbati nwọn mọ̀ Ọlọrun, nwọn kò yìn i logo bi Ọlọrun, bẹ̃ni nwọn kò si dupẹ; ṣugbọn èro ọkàn wọn di asán, a si mu ọkàn òmúgọ wọn ṣókunkun.
entries.en: Because that, when they knew God, they glorified him not as God, neither were thankful; but became vain in their imaginations, and their foolish heart was darkened.

entries.yo: Nwọn npè ara wọn li ọlọ́gbọn, nwọn di aṣiwere,
entries.en: Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools,

entries.yo: Nwọn si pa ogo Ọlọrun ti kì idibajẹ dà, si aworan ere enia ti idibajẹ, ati ti ẹiyẹ, ati ẹranko ẹlẹsẹ mẹrin, ati ohun ti nrakò.
entries.en: And changed the glory of the uncorruptible God into an image made like to corruptible man, and to birds, and fourfooted beasts, and creeping things.

entries.yo: Nitorina li Ọlọrun ṣe fi wọn silẹ ninu ifẹkufẹ ọkàn wọn si ìwa-ẽri lati ṣe aibọ̀wọ fun ara wọn larin ara wọn:
entries.en: Wherefore God also gave them up to uncleanness through the lusts of their own hearts, to dishonour their own bodies between themselves:

entries.yo: Awọn ẹniti o yi otitọ Ọlọrun pada si eke, nwọn si bọ, nwọn si sìn ẹda jù Ẹlẹda lọ, ẹniti iṣe olubukun titi lai. Amin.
entries.en: Who changed the truth of God into a lie, and worshipped and served the creature more than the Creator, who is blessed for ever. Amen.

entries.yo: Nitori eyiyi li Ọlọrun ṣe fi wọn fun ifẹ iwakiwa: nitori awọn obinrin wọn tilẹ yi ilo ẹda pada si eyi ti o lodi si ẹda:
entries.en: For this cause God gave them up unto vile affections: for even their women did change the natural use into that which is against nature:

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bẹ̃ li awọn ọkunrin pẹlu, nwọn a mã fi ilò obinrin nipa ti ẹda silẹ, nwọn a mã ni ifẹkufẹ gbigbona si ara wọn; ọkunrin mba ọkunrin ṣe eyi ti kò yẹ, nwọn si njẹ ère ìṣina wọn ninu ara wọn bi o ti yẹ si.
entries.en: And likewise also the men, leaving the natural use of the woman, burned in their lust one toward another; men with men working that which is unseemly, and receiving in themselves that recompence of their error which was meet.

entries.yo: Ati gẹgẹ bi nwọn ti kọ̀ lati ni ìro Ọlọrun ni ìmọ wọn, Ọlọrun fi wọn fun iyè rirà lati ṣe ohun ti kò tọ́:
entries.en: And even as they did not like to retain God in their knowledge, God gave them over to a reprobate mind, to do those things which are not convenient;

entries.yo: Nwọn kún fun aiṣododo gbogbo, àgbere, ìka, ojukòkoro, arankan; nwọn kún fun ilara, ipania, ija, itanjẹ, iwa-buburu; afi-ọrọ-kẹlẹ banijẹ,
entries.en: Being filled with all unrighteousness, fornication, wickedness, covetousness, maliciousness; full of envy, murder, debate, deceit, malignity; whisperers,

entries.yo: Asọrọ ẹni lẹhin, akorira Ọlọrun, alafojudi, agberaga, ahalẹ, alaroṣe ohun buburu, aṣaigbọran si obí,
entries.en: Backbiters, haters of God, despiteful, proud, boasters, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,

entries.yo: Alainiyè-ninu, ọ̀dalẹ, alainifẹ, agídi, alailãnu:
entries.en: Without understanding, covenantbreakers, without natural affection, implacable, unmerciful:

entries.yo: Awọn ẹniti o mọ̀ ilana Ọlọrun pe, ẹniti o ba ṣe irú nkan wọnyi, o yẹ si ikú, nwọn kò ṣe bẹ̃ nikan, ṣugbọn nwọn ni inu didùn si awọn ti nṣe wọn.
entries.en: Who knowing the judgment of God, that they which commit such things are worthy of death, not only do the same, but have pleasure in them that do them.

entries.yo: NITORINA alairiwi ni iwọ ọkunrin na, ẹnikẹni ti o wù ki o jẹ ti ndajọ: nitori ninu ohun ti iwọ nṣe idajọ ẹlomiran, iwọ ndá ara rẹ lẹbi; nitori iwọ ti ndajọ nṣe ohun kanna.
entries.en: Therefore thou art inexcusable, O man, whosoever thou art that judgest: for wherein thou judgest another, thou condemnest thyself; for thou that judgest doest the same things.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awa mọ̀ pe idajọ Ọlọrun jẹ gẹgẹ bi otitọ si gbogbo awọn ti o nṣe irú ohun bawọnni.
entries.en: But we are sure that the judgment of God is according to truth against them which commit such things.

entries.yo: Ati iwọ ọkunrin na ti nṣe idajọ awọn ti nṣe irú ohun bawọnni, ti iwọ si nṣe bẹ̃ na, iwọ ro eyi pe iwọ ó yọ ninu idajọ Ọlọrun?
entries.en: And thinkest thou this, O man, that judgest them which do such things, and doest the same, that thou shalt escape the judgment of God?

entries.yo: Tabi iwọ ngàn ọrọ̀ ore ati ipamọra ati sũru rẹ̀, li aimọ̀ pe ore Ọlọrun li o nfà ọ lọ si ironupiwada?
entries.en: Or despisest thou the riches of his goodness and forbearance and longsuffering; not knowing that the goodness of God leadeth thee to repentance?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn gẹgẹ bi lile ati aironupiwada ọkàn rẹ, ni iwọ nfi ibinu ṣura fun ara rẹ de ọjọ ibinu ati ti ifihàn idajọ ododo Ọlọrun:
entries.en: But after thy hardness and impenitent heart treasurest up unto thyself wrath against the day of wrath and revelation of the righteous judgment of God;

entries.yo: Ẹniti yio san a fun olukuluku gẹgẹ bi iṣẹ rẹ̀:
entries.en: Who will render to every man according to his deeds:

entries.yo: Fun awọn ti nfi sũru ni rere-iṣe wá ogo ati ọlá ati aidibajẹ, ìye ainipẹkun;
entries.en: To them who by patient continuance in well doing seek for glory and honour and immortality, eternal life:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn fun awọn onijà, ti nwọn kò si gbà otitọ gbọ́, ṣugbọn ti nwọn ngbà aiṣododo gbọ́, irunu ati ibinu yio wà.
entries.en: But unto them that are contentious, and do not obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, indignation and wrath,

entries.yo: Ipọnju ati irora, lori olukuluku ọkàn enia ti nhuwa ibi, ti Ju ṣaju, ati ti Hellene pẹlu;
entries.en: Tribulation and anguish, upon every soul of man that doeth evil, of the Jew first, and also of the Gentile;

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ogo, ati ọlá, ati alafia, fun olukuluku ẹni ti nhuwa rere, fun Ju ṣaju, ati fun Hellene pẹlu:
entries.en: But glory, honour, and peace, to every man that worketh good, to the Jew first, and also to the Gentile:

entries.yo: Nitori ojuṣaju enia kò si lọdọ Ọlọrun.
entries.en: For there is no respect of persons with God.

entries.yo: Nitori iye awọn ti o ṣẹ̀ li ailofin, nwọn ó si ṣegbé lailofin: ati iye awọn ti o ṣẹ̀ labẹ ofin, awọn li a o fi ofin dalẹjọ;
entries.en: For as many as have sinned without law shall also perish without law: and as many as have sinned in the law shall be judged by the law;

entries.yo: Nitori kì iṣe awọn olugbọ ofin li alare lọdọ Ọlọrun, ṣugbọn awọn oluṣe ofin li a o dalare.
entries.en: (For not the hearers of the law are just before God, but the doers of the law shall be justified.

entries.yo: Nitori nigbati awọn Keferi, ti kò li ofin, ba ṣe ohun ti o wà ninu ofin nipa ẹda, awọn wọnyi ti kò li ofin, jẹ ofin fun ara wọn:
entries.en: For when the Gentiles, which have not the law, do by nature the things contained in the law, these, having not the law, are a law unto themselves:

entries.yo: Awọn ẹniti o fihan pe, a kọwe iṣẹ ofin si wọn li ọkàn, ti ọkàn wọn si njẹ wọn lẹri, ti iro wọn larin ara wọn si nfi wọn sùn tabi ti o ngbè wọn,
entries.en: Which shew the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience also bearing witness, and their thoughts the mean while accusing or else excusing one another;)

entries.yo: Li ọjọ na nigbati Ọlọrun yio ti ipa Jesu Kristi ṣe idajọ aṣiri enia gẹgẹ bi ihinrere mi.
entries.en: In the day when God shall judge the secrets of men by Jesus Christ according to my gospel.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi a ba npè iwọ ni Ju, ti o si simi le ofin, ti o si nṣogo ninu Ọlọrun,
entries.en: Behold, thou art called a Jew, and restest in the law, and makest thy boast of God,

entries.yo: Ti o si mọ̀ ifẹ rẹ̀, ti o si dán ohun ti o yàtọ wò, ẹniti a ti kọ li ofin;
entries.en: And knowest his will, and approvest the things that are more excellent, being instructed out of the law;

entries.yo: Ti o si gbé oju le ara rẹ̀ pe iwọ li amọ̀na awọn afọju, imọlẹ awọn ti o wà li òkunkun,
entries.en: And art confident that thou thyself art a guide of the blind, a light of them which are in darkness,

entries.yo: Olukọ awọn alaimoye, olukọ awọn ọmọde, ẹniti o ni afarawe imọ ati otitọ ofin li ọwọ.
entries.en: An instructor of the foolish, a teacher of babes, which hast the form of knowledge and of the truth in the law.

entries.yo: Njẹ iwọ ti o nkọ́ ẹlomiran, iwọ kò kọ́ ara rẹ? iwọ ti o nwasu ki enia ki o má jale, iwọ njale?
entries.en: Thou therefore which teachest another, teachest thou not thyself? thou that preachest a man should not steal, dost thou steal?

entries.yo: Iwọ ti o nwipe ki enia ki o máṣe panṣaga, iwọ nṣe panṣaga? iwọ ti o ṣe họ̃ si oriṣa, iwọ njà tẹmpili li ole?
entries.en: Thou that sayest a man should not commit adultery, dost thou commit adultery? thou that abhorrest idols, dost thou commit sacrilege?

entries.yo: Iwọ ti nṣogo ninu ofin, ni riru ofin iwọ bù Ọlọrun li ọlá kù?
entries.en: Thou that makest thy boast of the law, through breaking the law dishonourest thou God?

entries.yo: Nitori orukọ Ọlọrun sá di isọrọ-buburu si ninu awọn Keferi nitori nyin, gẹgẹ bi a ti kọ ọ.
entries.en: For the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles through you, as it is written.

entries.yo: Nitori ikọla li ère lõtọ, bi iwọ ba pa ofin mọ́: ṣugbọn bi iwọ ba jẹ arufin, ikọla rẹ di aikọla.
entries.en: For circumcision verily profiteth, if thou keep the law: but if thou be a breaker of the law, thy circumcision is made uncircumcision.

entries.yo: Nitorina bi alaikọla ba pa ilana ofin mọ́, a kì yio ha kà aikọla rẹ̀ si ikọla bi?
entries.en: Therefore if the uncircumcision keep the righteousness of the law, shall not his uncircumcision be counted for circumcision?

entries.yo: Alaikọla nipa ti ẹda, bi o ba pa ofin mọ́, kì yio ha da ẹbi fun iwọ ti o jẹ arufin nipa ti iwe ati ikọla?
entries.en: And shall not uncircumcision which is by nature, if it fulfil the law, judge thee, who by the letter and circumcision dost transgress the law?

entries.yo: Kì iṣe eyi ti o farahan ni Ju, bẹni kì iṣe eyi ti o farahan li ara ni ikọla:
entries.en: For he is not a Jew, which is one outwardly; neither is that circumcision, which is outward in the flesh:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Ju ti inu ni Ju, ati ikọla ti ọkàn, ninu ẹmi ni, kì iṣe ti ode ara; iyìn ẹniti kò si lọdọ enia, bikoṣe lọdọ Ọlọrun.
entries.en: But he is a Jew, which is one inwardly; and circumcision is that of the heart, in the spirit, and not in the letter; whose praise is not of men, but of God.

entries.yo: NJẸ anfani ki ha ni ti Ju? tabi kini ère ilà kíkọ?
entries.en: What advantage then hath the Jew? or what profit is there of circumcision?

entries.yo: Pipọ lọna gbogbo; ekini, nitoripe awọn li a fi ọ̀rọ Ọlọrun le lọwọ.
entries.en: Much every way: chiefly, because that unto them were committed the oracles of God.

entries.yo: Njẹ ki ha ni bi awọn kan jẹ alaigbagbọ́? aigbagbọ́ wọn yio ha sọ otitọ Ọlọrun di asan bi?
entries.en: For what if some did not believe? shall their unbelief make the faith of God without effect?

entries.yo: Ki a má ri: k'Ọlọrun jẹ olõtọ, ati olukuluku enia jẹ eke; gẹgẹ bi a ti kọ ọ pe, Ki a le da ọ lare ninu ọ̀rọ rẹ, ṣugbọn ki iwọ le ṣẹgun nigbati iwọ ba wá si idajọ.
entries.en: God forbid: yea, let God be true, but every man a liar; as it is written, That thou mightest be justified in thy sayings, and mightest overcome when thou art judged.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi aiṣododo wa ba nyìn ododo Ọlọrun, kili awa o wi? Ọlọrun ti nfi ibinu rẹ̀ han ha ṣe alaiṣododo bi? (Mo fi ṣe akawe bi enia.)
entries.en: But if our unrighteousness commend the righteousness of God, what shall we say? Is God unrighteous who taketh vengeance? (I speak as a man)

entries.yo: Ki a má ri: bi bẹ̃ni, Ọlọrun yio ha ṣe le dajọ araiye?
entries.en: God forbid: for then how shall God judge the world?

entries.yo: Nitori bi otitọ Ọlọrun ba di pipọ si iyìn rẹ̀ nitori eke mi, ẽṣe ti a fi nda mi lẹjọ bi ẹlẹṣẹ mọ́ si?
entries.en: For if the truth of God hath more abounded through my lie unto his glory; why yet am I also judged as a sinner?

entries.yo: Ẽṣe ti a kò si wipe (gẹgẹ bi a ti nsọrọ wa ni ibi, ati gẹgẹ bi awọn kan ti nsọ pe, awa nwipe,) Ẹ jẹ ki a mã ṣe buburu, ki rere ki o le jade wá? awọn ẹniti ẹ̀bi wọn tọ́.
entries.en: And not rather, (as we be slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say,) Let us do evil, that good may come? whose damnation is just.

entries.yo: Njẹ ki ha ni? awa ha san jù wọn bi? Kò ri bẹ̃ rara: nitori a ti fihan ṣaju pe ati awọn Ju ati awọn Hellene, gbogbo nwọn li o wà labẹ ẹ̀ṣẹ;
entries.en: What then? are we better than they? No, in no wise: for we have before proved both Jews and Gentiles, that they are all under sin;

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi a ti kọ ọ pe, Kò si ẹniti iṣe olododo, kò si ẹnikan:
entries.en: As it is written, There is none righteous, no, not one:

entries.yo: Kò si ẹniti oyé yé, kò si ẹniti o nwá Ọlọrun.
entries.en: There is none that understandeth, there is none that seeketh after God.

entries.yo: Gbogbo nwọn li o ti yapa, nwọn jumọ di alailere; kò si ẹniti nṣe rere, kò tilẹ si ẹnikan.
entries.en: They are all gone out of the way, they are together become unprofitable; there is none that doeth good, no, not one.

entries.yo: Isà okú ti o ṣi silẹ li ọfun wọn; ahọn wọn ni nwọn fi nṣe itanjẹ; oró pamọlẹ mbẹ labẹ ète wọn:
entries.en: Their throat is an open sepulchre; with their tongues they have used deceit; the poison of asps is under their lips:

entries.yo: Ẹnu ẹniti o kún fun èpe ati fun ọ̀rọ kikoro:
entries.en: Whose mouth is full of cursing and bitterness:

entries.yo: Ẹsẹ wọn yara lati ta ẹ̀jẹ silẹ:
entries.en: Their feet are swift to shed blood:

entries.yo: Iparun ati ipọnju wà li ọ̀na wọn:
entries.en: Destruction and misery are in their ways:

entries.yo: Ọ̀na alafia ni nwọn kò si mọ̀:
entries.en: And the way of peace have they not known:

entries.yo: Ibẹru Ọlọrun kò si niwaju wọn.
entries.en: There is no fear of God before their eyes.

entries.yo: Awa si mọ̀ pe ohunkohun ti ofin ba wi, o nwi fun awọn ti o wà labẹ ofin: ki gbogbo ẹnu ki o le pamọ́, ati ki a le mu gbogbo araiye wá sabẹ idajọ Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Now we know that what things soever the law saith, it saith to them who are under the law: that every mouth may be stopped, and all the world may become guilty before God.

entries.yo: Nitoripe nipa iṣẹ ofin, a kì yio dá ẹnikẹni lare niwaju rẹ̀: nitori nipa ofin ni ìmọ ẹ̀ṣẹ ti wá.
entries.en: Therefore by the deeds of the law there shall no flesh be justified in his sight: for by the law is the knowledge of sin.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nisisiyi a ti fi ododo Ọlọrun hàn laisi ofin, ti a njẹri si nipa ofin ati nipa awọn woli;
entries.en: But now the righteousness of God without the law is manifested, being witnessed by the law and the prophets;

entries.yo: Ani ododo Ọlọrun nipa igbagbọ́ ninu Jesu Kristi, si gbogbo enia, ati lara gbogbo awọn ti o gbagbọ́: nitoriti kò si ìyatọ:
entries.en: Even the righteousness of God which is by faith of Jesus Christ unto all and upon all them that believe: for there is no difference:

entries.yo: Gbogbo enia li o sá ti ṣẹ̀, ti nwọn si kuna ogo Ọlọrun;
entries.en: For all have sinned, and come short of the glory of God;

entries.yo: Awọn ẹniti a ndalare lọfẹ nipa ore-ọfẹ rẹ̀, nipa idande ti o wà ninu Kristi Jesu:
entries.en: Being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus:

entries.yo: Ẹniti Ọlọrun ti gbe kalẹ lati jẹ ètutu nipa igbagbọ́ ninu ẹ̀jẹ rẹ̀, lati fi ododo rẹ̀ hàn nitori idariji awọn ẹ̀ṣẹ ti o ti kọja, ninu ipamọra Ọlọrun;
entries.en: Whom God hath set forth to be a propitiation through faith in his blood, to declare his righteousness for the remission of sins that are past, through the forbearance of God;

entries.yo: Lati fi ododo rẹ̀ hàn ni igba isisiyi: ki o le jẹ olódodo ati oludare ẹniti o gbà Jesu gbọ́.
entries.en: To declare, I say, at this time his righteousness: that he might be just, and the justifier of him which believeth in Jesus.

entries.yo: Ọna iṣogo da? A ti mu u kuro. Nipa ofin wo? ti iṣẹ? Bẹ́kọ: ṣugbọn nipa ofin igbagbọ́.
entries.en: Where is boasting then? It is excluded. By what law? of works? Nay: but by the law of faith.

entries.yo: Nitorina a pari rẹ̀ si pe nipa igbagbọ́ li a nda enia lare laisi iṣẹ ofin.
entries.en: Therefore we conclude that a man is justified by faith without the deeds of the law.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun awọn Ju nikan ha ni bi? ki ha ṣe ti awọn Keferi pẹlu? Bẹ̃ni, ti awọn Keferi ni pẹlu:
entries.en: Is he the God of the Jews only? is he not also of the Gentiles? Yes, of the Gentiles also:

entries.yo: Bi o ti jẹ pe Ọlọrun kan ni, ti yio da awọn akọla lare nipa igbagbọ́, ati awọn alaikọla nitori igbagbọ́ wọn.
entries.en: Seeing it is one God, which shall justify the circumcision by faith, and uncircumcision through faith.

entries.yo: Awa ha nsọ ofin dasan nipa igbagbọ́ bi? Ki a má ri: ṣugbọn a nfi ofin mulẹ.
entries.en: Do we then make void the law through faith? God forbid: yea, we establish the law.

entries.yo: NJẸ kili awa o ha wipe Abrahamu, baba wa nipa ti ara, ri?
entries.en: What shall we say then that Abraham our father, as pertaining to the flesh, hath found?

entries.yo: Nitori bi a ba da Abrahamu lare nipa iṣẹ, o ni ohun iṣogo; ṣugbọn kì iṣe niwaju Ọlọrun.
entries.en: For if Abraham were justified by works, he hath whereof to glory; but not before God.

entries.yo: Iwe-mimọ́ ha ti wi? Abrahamu gbà Ọlọrun gbọ́, a si kà a si ododo fun u.
entries.en: For what saith the scripture? Abraham believed God, and it was counted unto him for righteousness.

entries.yo: Njẹ fun ẹniti o ṣiṣẹ a kò kà ère na si ore-ọfẹ bikoṣe si gbese.
entries.en: Now to him that worketh is the reward not reckoned of grace, but of debt.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn fun ẹniti kò ṣiṣẹ, ti o si ngbà ẹniti o nda enia buburu lare gbọ́, a kà igbagbọ́ rẹ̀ si ododo.
entries.en: But to him that worketh not, but believeth on him that justifieth the ungodly, his faith is counted for righteousness.

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi Dafidi pẹlu ti pe oluwarẹ̀ na ni ẹni ibukun, ẹniti Ọlọrun kà ododo si laisi ti iṣẹ́,
entries.en: Even as David also describeth the blessedness of the man, unto whom God imputeth righteousness without works,

entries.yo: Wipe, Ibukún ni fun awọn ẹniti a dari irekọja wọn jì, ti a si bò ẹ̀ṣẹ wọn mọlẹ.
entries.en: Saying, Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, and whose sins are covered.

entries.yo: Ibukún ni fun ọkunrin na ẹniti Oluwa kò kà ẹ̀ṣẹ si li ọrùn.
entries.en: Blessed is the man to whom the Lord will not impute sin.

entries.yo: Ibukún yi ha jẹ ti awọn akọla nikan ni, tabi ti awọn alaikọla pẹlu? nitoriti a wipe, a kà igbagbọ́ fun Abrahamu si ododo.
entries.en: Cometh this blessedness then upon the circumcision only, or upon the uncircumcision also? for we say that faith was reckoned to Abraham for righteousness.

entries.yo: Bawo li a ha kà a si i? nigbati o wà ni ikọla tabi li aikọla? Kì iṣe ni ikọla, ṣugbọn li aikọla ni.
entries.en: How was it then reckoned? when he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? Not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision.

entries.yo: O si gbà àmi ikọla, èdidi ododo igbagbọ́ ti o ni nigbati o wà li aikọla: ki o le ṣe baba gbogbo awọn ti o gbagbọ́, bi a kò tilẹ kọ wọn ni ilà; ki a le kà ododo si wọn pẹlu:
entries.en: And he received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had yet being uncircumcised: that he might be the father of all them that believe, though they be not circumcised; that righteousness might be imputed unto them also:

entries.yo: Ati baba ikọla fun awọn ti kò si ninu kìki awọn akọla nikan, ṣugbọn ti nrin pẹlu nipasẹ igbagbọ́ Abrahamu baba wa, ti o ni li aikọla.
entries.en: And the father of circumcision to them who are not of the circumcision only, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham, which he had being yet uncircumcised.

entries.yo: Nitori ileri fun Abrahamu tabi fun irú-ọmọ rẹ̀ pe, on ó ṣe arole aiye, kì iṣe nipa ofin, bikoṣe nipa ododo igbagbọ́.
entries.en: For the promise, that he should be the heir of the world, was not to Abraham, or to his seed, through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.

entries.yo: Nitori bi awọn ti nṣe ti ofin ba ṣe arole, igbagbọ́ di asan, ileri si di alailagbara:
entries.en: For if they which are of the law be heirs, faith is made void, and the promise made of none effect:

entries.yo: Nitori ofin nṣiṣẹ́ ibinu: ṣugbọn nibiti ofin kò ba si, irufin kò si nibẹ̀.
entries.en: Because the law worketh wrath: for where no law is, there is no transgression.

entries.yo: Nitorina li o fi ṣe ti ipa igbagbọ́, ki o le ṣe ti ipa ore-ọfẹ; ki ileri ki o le da gbogbo irú-ọmọ loju; kì iṣe awọn ti ipa ofin nikan, ṣugbọn ati fun awọn ti inu igbagbọ́ Abrahamu pẹlu, ẹniti iṣe baba gbogbo wa,
entries.en: Therefore it is of faith, that it might be by grace; to the end the promise might be sure to all the seed; not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham; who is the father of us all,

entries.yo: (Gẹgẹ bi a ti kọ ọ pe, Mo ti fi ọ ṣe baba orilẹ-ède pupọ,) niwaju ẹniti on gbagbọ́, Ọlọrun tikararẹ̀, ti o sọ okú di ãye, ti o si pè ohun wọnni ti kò si bi ẹnipe nwọn ti wà;
entries.en: (As it is written, I have made thee a father of many nations,) before him whom he believed, even God, who quickeneth the dead, and calleth those things which be not as though they were.

entries.yo: Nigbati ireti kò si, ẹniti o gbagbọ ni ireti ki o le di baba orilẹ-ède pupọ, gẹgẹ bi eyi ti a ti wipe, Bayi ni irú-ọmọ rẹ yio ri.
entries.en: Who against hope believed in hope, that he might become the father of many nations; according to that which was spoken, So shall thy seed be.

entries.yo: Ẹniti kò ṣe ailera ni igbagbọ́, kò rò ti ara on tikararẹ̀ ti o ti kú tan (nigbati o to bi ẹni ìwọn ọgọrun ọdún), ati kíku inu Sara:
entries.en: And being not weak in faith, he considered not his own body now dead, when he was about an hundred years old, neither yet the deadness of Sara's womb:

entries.yo: Kò fi aigbagbọ ṣiyemeji ileri Ọlọrun; ṣugbọn o le ni igbagbọ́, o nfi ogo fun Ọlọrun;
entries.en: He staggered not at the promise of God through unbelief; but was strong in faith, giving glory to God;

entries.yo: Nigbati o sa ti mọ̀ dajudaju pe, ohun ti on ba ti leri, o si le ṣe e.
entries.en: And being fully persuaded that, what he had promised, he was able also to perform.

entries.yo: Nitorina li a si ṣe kà a si ododo fun u.
entries.en: And therefore it was imputed to him for righteousness.

entries.yo: A kò sá kọ ọ nitori tirẹ̀ nikan pe, a kà a si fun u,
entries.en: Now it was not written for his sake alone, that it was imputed to him;

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nitori tiwa pẹlu, ẹniti a o si kà a si fun, bi awa ba gbà a gbọ́, ẹniti o gbé Jesu Oluwa wa dide kuro ninu okú;
entries.en: But for us also, to whom it shall be imputed, if we believe on him that raised up Jesus our Lord from the dead;

entries.yo: Ẹniti a fi tọrẹ ẹ̀ṣẹ wa, ti a si jinde nitori idalare wa.
entries.en: Who was delivered for our offences, and was raised again for our justification.

entries.yo: NJẸ bi a si ti nda wa lare nipa igbagbọ́, awa ni alafia lọdọ Ọlọrun nipa Oluwa wa Jesu Kristi:
entries.en: Therefore being justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ:

entries.yo: Nipasẹ ẹniti awa si ti ri ọ̀na gbà nipa igbagbọ́ si inu ore-ọfẹ yi ninu eyi ti awa gbé duro, awa si nyọ̀ ni ireti ogo Ọlọrun.
entries.en: By whom also we have access by faith into this grace wherein we stand, and rejoice in hope of the glory of God.

entries.yo: Kì si iṣe bẹ̃ nikan, ṣugbọn awa si nṣogo ninu wahalà pẹlu: bi a ti mọ̀ pe wahalà nṣiṣẹ sũru;
entries.en: And not only so, but we glory in tribulations also: knowing that tribulation worketh patience;

entries.yo: Ati sũru nṣiṣẹ iriri; ati iriri ni nṣiṣẹ ireti:
entries.en: And patience, experience; and experience, hope:

entries.yo: Ireti kì si idojuti ni; nitori a ti tan ifẹ Ọlọrun ká wa lọ́kàn lati ọdọ Ẹmí Mimọ́ wá ti a fifun wa.
entries.en: And hope maketh not ashamed; because the love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Ghost which is given unto us.

entries.yo: Nitori igbati awa jẹ alailera, li akokò ti o yẹ, Kristi kú fun awa alaiwa-bi-Ọlọrun.
entries.en: For when we were yet without strength, in due time Christ died for the ungodly.

entries.yo: Nitori o ṣọ̀wọn ki ẹnikan ki o to kú fun olododo: ṣugbọn fun enia rere boya ẹlomiran tilẹ le dába ati kú.
entries.en: For scarcely for a righteous man will one die: yet peradventure for a good man some would even dare to die.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Ọlọrun fi ifẹ On papa si wa hàn ni eyi pe, nigbati awa jẹ ẹlẹṣẹ, Kristi kú fun wa.
entries.en: But God commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.

entries.yo: Melomelo si ni, ti a da wa lare nisisiyi nipa ẹ̀jẹ rẹ̀, li a o gbà wa là kuro ninu ibinu nipasẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we shall be saved from wrath through him.

entries.yo: Njẹ bi, nigbati awa wà li ọtá, a mu wa ba Ọlọrun làja nipa ikú Ọmọ rẹ̀, melomelo, nigbati a là wa ni ìja tan, li a o gbà wa là nipa ìye rẹ̀.
entries.en: For if, when we were enemies, we were reconciled to God by the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we shall be saved by his life.

entries.yo: Kì si iṣe bẹ̃ nikan, ṣugbọn awa nṣogo ninu Ọlọrun nipa Oluwa wa Jesu Kristi, nipasẹ ẹniti awa ti ri ìlaja gbà nisisiyi.
entries.en: And not only so, but we also joy in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom we have now received the atonement.

entries.yo: Nitori gẹgẹ bi ẹ̀ṣẹ ti ti ipa ọdọ enia kan wọ̀ aiye, ati ikú nipa ẹ̀ṣẹ; bẹ̃ni ikú si kọja sori enia gbogbo, lati ọdọ ẹniti gbogbo enia ti dẹṣẹ̀:
entries.en: Wherefore, as by one man sin entered into the world, and death by sin; and so death passed upon all men, for that all have sinned:

entries.yo: Nitori ki ofin ki o to de, ẹ̀ṣẹ ti wà li aiye; ṣugbọn a kò kà ẹ̀ṣẹ si ni lọrun nigbati ofin kò si.
entries.en: (For until the law sin was in the world: but sin is not imputed when there is no law.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ikú jọba lati igbà Adamu wá titi fi di igba ti Mose, ati lori awọn ti kò ṣẹ̀ bi afarawe irekọja Adamu, ẹniti iṣe apẹrẹ ẹniti mbọ̀.
entries.en: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam to Moses, even over them that had not sinned after the similitude of Adam's transgression, who is the figure of him that was to come.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn kì iṣe bi ẹ̀ṣẹ bẹ̃ si li ẹ̀bun ọfẹ. Nitori bi nipa ẹ̀ṣẹ ẹnikan, ẹni pupọ kú, melomelo li ore-ọfẹ Ọlọrun, ati ẹ̀bun ninu ore-ọfẹ ọkunrin kan, Jesu Kristi, di pupọ fun ẹni pupọ.
entries.en: But not as the offence, so also is the free gift. For if through the offence of one many be dead, much more the grace of God, and the gift by grace, which is by one man, Jesus Christ, hath abounded unto many.

entries.yo: Kì isi ṣe bi nipa ẹnikan ti o ṣẹ̀, li ẹ̀bun na: nitori idajọ ti ipasẹ ẹnikan wá fun idalẹbi ṣugbọn ẹ̀bun ọfẹ ti inu ẹ̀ṣẹ pupọ wá fun idalare.
entries.en: And not as it was by one that sinned, so is the gift: for the judgment was by one to condemnation, but the free gift is of many offences unto justification.

entries.yo: Njẹ bi nipa ẹ̀ṣẹ ọkunrin kan ikú jọba nipasẹ ẹnikanna; melomelo li awọn ti ngbà ọ̀pọlọpọ ore-ọfẹ ati ẹ̀bun ododo yio jọba ninu ìye nipasẹ ẹnikan, Jesu Kristi.
entries.en: For if by one man's offence death reigned by one; much more they which receive abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness shall reign in life by one, Jesus Christ.)

entries.yo: Njẹ bi nipa ẹ̀ṣẹ kan idajọ de bá gbogbo enia si idalẹbi; gẹgẹ bẹ̃ni nipa iwa ododo kan, ẹ̀bun ọfẹ de sori gbogbo enia fun idalare si ìye.
entries.en: Therefore as by the offence of one judgment came upon all men to condemnation; even so by the righteousness of one the free gift came upon all men unto justification of life.

entries.yo: Nitori gẹgẹ bi nipa aigbọran enia kan, enia pupọ di ẹlẹṣẹ bẹ̃ ni nipa igbọran ẹnikan, a o sọ enia pupọ di olododo.
entries.en: For as by one man's disobedience many were made sinners, so by the obedience of one shall many be made righteous.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ofin bọ si inu rẹ̀, ki ẹ̀ṣẹ le di pupọ. Ṣugbọn nibiti ẹ̀ṣẹ di pupọ, ore-ọfẹ di pupọ rekọja,
entries.en: Moreover the law entered, that the offence might abound. But where sin abounded, grace did much more abound:
