entries.yo: Pe, gẹgẹ bi ẹ̀ṣẹ ti jọba nipa ikú, bẹni ki ore-ọfẹ si le jọba nipa ododo titi ìye ainipẹkun nipasẹ Jesu Kristi Oluwa wa.
entries.en: That as sin hath reigned unto death, even so might grace reign through righteousness unto eternal life by Jesus Christ our Lord.

entries.yo: NJẸ awa o ha ti wi? Ki awa ki o ha joko ninu ẹ̀ṣẹ, ki ore-ọfẹ ki o le ma pọ̀ si i?
entries.en: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?

entries.yo: Ki a má ri. Awa ẹniti o ti kú si ẹ̀ṣẹ, awa o ha ṣe wà lãye ninu rẹ̀ mọ́?
entries.en: God forbid. How shall we, that are dead to sin, live any longer therein?

entries.yo: Tabi ẹ kò mọ̀ pe, gbogbo wa ti a ti baptisi sinu Kristi Jesu, a ti baptisi wa sinu ikú rẹ̀?
entries.en: Know ye not, that so many of us as were baptized into Jesus Christ were baptized into his death?

entries.yo: Njẹ a fi baptismu sinu ikú sin wa pọ̀ pẹlu rẹ̀: pe gẹgẹ bi a ti jí Kristi dide kuro ninu okú nipa ogo Baba bẹ̃ni ki awa pẹlu ki o mã rìn li ọtun ìwa.
entries.en: Therefore we are buried with him by baptism into death: that like as Christ was raised up from the dead by the glory of the Father, even so we also should walk in newness of life.

entries.yo: Nitori bi a ba ti so wa pọ̀ pẹlu rẹ̀ nipa afarawe ikú rẹ̀, a o si so wa pọ pẹlu nipa afarawe ajinde rẹ̀:
entries.en: For if we have been planted together in the likeness of his death, we shall be also in the likeness of his resurrection:

entries.yo: Nitori awa mọ eyi pe, a kàn ogbologbo ọkunrin wa mọ agbelebu pẹlu rẹ̀, ki a le pa ara ẹ̀ṣẹ run, ki awa maṣe sìn ẹ̀ṣẹ mọ́.
entries.en: Knowing this, that our old man is crucified with him, that the body of sin might be destroyed, that henceforth we should not serve sin.

entries.yo: Nitori ẹniti o kú, o bọ́ lọwọ ẹ̀ṣẹ.
entries.en: For he that is dead is freed from sin.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi awa ba bá Kristi kú, awa gbagbọ́ pe awa ó si wà lãye pẹlu rẹ̀:
entries.en: Now if we be dead with Christ, we believe that we shall also live with him:

entries.yo: Nitori awa mọ̀ pé bi a ti jí Kristi dide kuro ninu okú, kò ni ikú mọ́; ikú kò ni ipa lori rẹ̀ mọ́.
entries.en: Knowing that Christ being raised from the dead dieth no more; death hath no more dominion over him.

entries.yo: Nitori iku ti o kú, o kú si ẹ̀ṣẹ lẹ̃kan: nitori wiwà ti o wà lãye, o wà lãye si Ọlọrun.
entries.en: For in that he died, he died unto sin once: but in that he liveth, he liveth unto God.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni ki ẹnyin pẹlu kà ara nyin bi okú si ẹ̀ṣẹ, ṣugbọn bi alãye si Ọlọrun ninu Kristi Jesu.
entries.en: Likewise reckon ye also yourselves to be dead indeed unto sin, but alive unto God through Jesus Christ our Lord.

entries.yo: Nitorina ẹ maṣe jẹ ki ẹ̀ṣẹ ki o jọba ninu ara kiku nyin, ti ẹ o fi mã gbọ ti ifẹkufẹ rẹ̀;
entries.en: Let not sin therefore reign in your mortal body, that ye should obey it in the lusts thereof.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni ki ẹnyin ki o máṣe jọwọ awọn ẹ̀ya ara nyin lọwọ fun ẹ̀ṣẹ bi ohun elo aiṣododo; ṣugbọn ẹ jọwọ ara nyin lọwọ fun Ọlọrun, bi alãye kuro ninu okú, ati awọn ẹ̀ya ara nyin bi ohun elo ododo fun Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Neither yield ye your members as instruments of unrighteousness unto sin: but yield yourselves unto God, as those that are alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness unto God.

entries.yo: Nitori ẹ̀ṣẹ kì yio ni ipa lori nyin: nitori ẹnyin kò si labẹ ofin, bikoṣe labẹ ore-ọfẹ.
entries.en: For sin shall not have dominion over you: for ye are not under the law, but under grace.

entries.yo: Njẹ kini? ki awa ki o ha ma dẹṣẹ̀, nitoriti awa kò si labẹ ofin, bikoṣe labẹ ore-ọfẹ? Ki a má ri.
entries.en: What then? shall we sin, because we are not under the law, but under grace? God forbid.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin kò mọ̀ pe, ẹniti ẹnyin ba jọwọ ara nyin lọwọ fun bi ẹrú lati mã gbọ́ tirẹ̀, ẹrú ẹniti ẹnyin ba gbọ tirẹ̀ li ẹnyin iṣe; ibãṣe ti ẹ̀ṣẹ sinu ikú, tabi ti igbọran si ododo?
entries.en: Know ye not, that to whom ye yield yourselves servants to obey, his servants ye are to whom ye obey; whether of sin unto death, or of obedience unto righteousness?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ọpẹ́ ni fun Ọlọrun pe, bi ẹnyin ti jẹ ẹrú ẹ̀ṣẹ rí, ẹnyin jẹ olugbọran lati ọkàn wá si apẹrẹ ẹkọ ti a fi nyin le lọwọ.
entries.en: But God be thanked, that ye were the servants of sin, but ye have obeyed from the heart that form of doctrine which was delivered you.

entries.yo: Bi a si ti sọ nyin di omnira kuro ninu ẹ̀ṣẹ, ẹnyin di ẹrú ododo.
entries.en: Being then made free from sin, ye became the servants of righteousness.

entries.yo: Emi nsọ̀rọ bi enia nitori ailera ara nyin: nitori bi ẹnyin ti jọwọ awọn ẹ̀ya ara nyin lọwọ bi ẹrú fun iwa-ẽri ati fun ẹ̀ṣẹ de inu ẹ̀ṣẹ; bẹ̃ gẹgẹ ni ki ẹnyin ki o jọwọ awọn ẹ̀ya ara nyin lọwọ nisisiyi bi ẹrú fun ododo si ìwa-mimọ́.
entries.en: I speak after the manner of men because of the infirmity of your flesh: for as ye have yielded your members servants to uncleanness and to iniquity unto iniquity; even so now yield your members servants to righteousness unto holiness.

entries.yo: Nitori nigbati ẹnyin ti jẹ ẹrú ẹ̀ṣẹ, ẹnyin wà li omnira si ododo.
entries.en: For when ye were the servants of sin, ye were free from righteousness.

entries.yo: Njẹ eso kili ẹnyin ha ni nigbana ninu ohun ti oju ntì nyin si nisisiyi? nitori opin nkan wọnni ikú ni.
entries.en: What fruit had ye then in those things whereof ye are now ashamed? for the end of those things is death.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nisisiyi ti a sọ nyin di omnira kuro ninu ẹ̀ṣẹ, ti ẹnyin si di ẹrú Ọlọrun, ẹnyin ni eso nyin si ìwa mimọ́, ati opin rẹ̀ ìye ainipẹkun.
entries.en: But now being made free from sin, and become servants to God, ye have your fruit unto holiness, and the end everlasting life.

entries.yo: Nitori ikú li ère ẹ̀ṣẹ; ṣugbọn ẹ̀bun ọfẹ Ọlọrun ni ìye ti kò nipẹkun, ninu Kristi Jesu Oluwa wa.
entries.en: For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

entries.yo: TABI ẹnyin ha ṣe alaimọ̀, ará (nitori awọn ti o mọ̀ ofin li emi mba sọrọ), pe ofin ni ipa lori enia niwọn igbati o ba wà lãye?
entries.en: Know ye not, brethren, (for I speak to them that know the law,) how that the law hath dominion over a man as long as he liveth?

entries.yo: Nitori obinrin ti o ni ọkọ, ìwọn igbati ọkọ na wà lãye, a fi ofin dè e mọ́ ọkọ na; ṣugbọn bi ọkọ na ba kú, a tú u silẹ kuro ninu ofin ọkọ na.
entries.en: For the woman which hath an husband is bound by the law to her husband so long as he liveth; but if the husband be dead, she is loosed from the law of her husband.

entries.yo: Njẹ bi o ba ni ọkọ miran nigbati ọkọ rẹ̀ wà lãye, panṣaga li a o pè e: ṣugbọn bi ọkọ rẹ̀ ba kú, o bọ lọwọ ofin na; ki yio si jẹ panṣaga bi o ba ni ọkọ miran.
entries.en: So then if, while her husband liveth, she be married to another man, she shall be called an adulteress: but if her husband be dead, she is free from that law; so that she is no adulteress, though she be married to another man.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li ẹnyin ará mi, ẹnyin pẹlu ti di okú si ofin nipa ara Kristi: ki ẹnyin kì o le ni ẹlomiran, ani ẹniti a jinde kuro ninu okú, ki awa ki o le so eso fun Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Wherefore, my brethren, ye also are become dead to the law by the body of Christ; that ye should be married to another, even to him who is raised from the dead, that we should bring forth fruit unto God.

entries.yo: Nitori igbati awa wà nipa ti ara, ifẹkufẹ ẹ̀ṣẹ, ti o wà nipa ofin, o nṣiṣẹ ninu awọn ẹ̀ya ara wa lati so eso si ikú.
entries.en: For when we were in the flesh, the motions of sins, which were by the law, did work in our members to bring forth fruit unto death.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nisisiyi a fi wa silẹ kuro ninu ofin, nitori a ti kú si eyiti a ti dè wa sinu rẹ̀: ki awa ki o le mã sìn li ọtun Ẹmí, ki o má ṣe ni ode ara ti atijọ.
entries.en: But now we are delivered from the law, that being dead wherein we were held; that we should serve in newness of spirit, and not in the oldness of the letter.

entries.yo: Njẹ awa o ha ti wi? ofin ha iṣe ẹ̀ṣẹ bi? Ki a má ri. Ṣugbọn emi kò ti mọ̀ ẹ̀ṣẹ, bikoṣepe nipa ofin: emi kò sá ti mọ̀ ojukokoro, bikoṣe bi ofin ti wipe, Iwọ kò gbọdọ ṣojukòkoro.
entries.en: What shall we say then? Is the law sin? God forbid. Nay, I had not known sin, but by the law: for I had not known lust, except the law had said, Thou shalt not covet.

entries.yo: Ẹ̀ṣẹ si ti ipa ofin ri aye, o ṣiṣẹ onirũru ifẹkufẹ ninu mi. Nitori laisi ofin, ẹ̀ṣẹ kú.
entries.en: But sin, taking occasion by the commandment, wrought in me all manner of concupiscence. For without the law sin was dead.

entries.yo: Emi si ti wà lãye laisi ofin nigbakan rì: ṣugbọn nigbati ofin de, ẹ̀ṣẹ sọji, emi si kú.
entries.en: For I was alive without the law once: but when the commandment came, sin revived, and I died.

entries.yo: Ofin ti a ṣe fun ìye, eyi li emi si wa ri pe o jẹ fun ikú.
entries.en: And the commandment, which was ordained to life, I found to be unto death.

entries.yo: Nitori ẹ̀ṣẹ ti ipa ofin ri aye, o tàn mi jẹ, o si ti ipa rẹ̀ lù mi pa.
entries.en: For sin, taking occasion by the commandment, deceived me, and by it slew me.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni mimọ́ li ofin, mimọ́ si li aṣẹ, ati ododo, ati didara.
entries.en: Wherefore the law is holy, and the commandment holy, and just, and good.

entries.yo: Njẹ ohun ti o dara ha di ikú fun mi bi? Ki a má ri. Ṣugbọn ẹ̀ṣẹ ki o le farahan bi ẹ̀ṣẹ o nti ipa ohun ti o dara ṣiṣẹ́ ikú ninu mi, ki ẹ̀ṣẹ le ti ipa ofin di buburu rekọja.
entries.en: Was then that which is good made death unto me? God forbid. But sin, that it might appear sin, working death in me by that which is good; that sin by the commandment might become exceeding sinful.

entries.yo: Nitori awa mọ̀ pe ohun ẹmí li ofin: ṣugbọn ẹni ti ara li emi, ti a ti tà sabẹ ofin.
entries.en: For we know that the law is spiritual: but I am carnal, sold under sin.

entries.yo: Nitori ohun ti emi nṣe, emi kò mọ̀: nitori ki iṣe ohun ti mo fẹ li emi nṣe; ṣugbọn ohun ti mo korira, li emi nṣe.
entries.en: For that which I do I allow not: for what I would, that do I not; but what I hate, that do I.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn biobaṣepe ohun ti emi kò fẹ eyini li emi nṣe, mo gba pe ofin dara.
entries.en: If then I do that which I would not, I consent unto the law that it is good.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi kì iṣe emi li o nṣe e mọ́, bikoṣe ẹ̀ṣẹ ti o ngbe inu mi.
entries.en: Now then it is no more I that do it, but sin that dwelleth in me.

entries.yo: Nitori emi mọ̀ pe ko si ohun rere kan ti ngbe inu mi, eyini ninu ara mi: nitori ifẹ ohun ti o dara mbẹ fun mi, ṣugbọn ọna ati ṣe e li emi kò ri.
entries.en: For I know that in me (that is, in my flesh,) dwelleth no good thing: for to will is present with me; but how to perform that which is good I find not.

entries.yo: Nitori ire ti emi fẹ emi kò ṣe: ṣugbọn buburu ti emi kò fẹ, eyini li emi nṣe.
entries.en: For the good that I would I do not: but the evil which I would not, that I do.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn biobaṣepe ohun ti emi kò fẹ, eyini li emi nṣe, emi ki nṣe e mọ́, bikoṣe ẹ̀ṣẹ ti ngbe inu mi.
entries.en: Now if I do that I would not, it is no more I that do it, but sin that dwelleth in me.

entries.yo: Njẹ mo ri niti ofin pe, bi emi ti nfẹ lati mã ṣe rere, buburu a ma wà lọdọ mi.
entries.en: I find then a law, that, when I would do good, evil is present with me.

entries.yo: Inu mi sá dùn si ofin Ọlọrun nipa ẹni ti inu:
entries.en: For I delight in the law of God after the inward man:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn mo ri ofin miran ninu awọn ẹ̀ya ara mi, ti mba ofin inu mi jagun ti o si ndì mi ni igbekun wá fun ofin ẹ̀ṣẹ, ti o mbẹ ninu awọn ẹ̀ya ara mi.
entries.en: But I see another law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity to the law of sin which is in my members.

entries.yo: Emi ẹni òṣi! tani yio gbà mi lọwọ ara ikú yi?
entries.en: O wretched man that I am! who shall deliver me from the body of this death?

entries.yo: Mo dupẹ lọwọ Ọlọrun nipasẹ Jesu Kristi Oluwa wa. Njẹ nitorina emi tikarami nfi inu jọsin fun ofin Ọlọrun; ṣugbọn mo nfi ara jọsin fun ofin ẹ̀ṣẹ.
entries.en: I thank God through Jesus Christ our Lord. So then with the mind I myself serve the law of God; but with the flesh the law of sin.

entries.yo: NJẸ ẹbi kò si nisisiyi fun awọn ti o wà ninu Kristi Jesu, awọn ti kò rìn nipa ti ara, bikoṣe nipa ti Ẹmí.
entries.en: There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.

entries.yo: Nitori ofin Ẹmí ìye ninu Kristi Jesu ti sọ mi di omnira lọwọ ofin ẹ̀ṣẹ ati ti ikú.
entries.en: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus hath made me free from the law of sin and death.

entries.yo: Nitori ohun ti ofin kò le ṣe, bi o ti jẹ alailera nitori ara, Ọlọrun rán Ọmọ on tikararẹ̀ li aworan ara ẹ̀ṣẹ, ati bi ẹbọ fun ẹ̀ṣẹ, o si da ẹ̀ṣẹ lẹbi ninu ara:
entries.en: For what the law could not do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh, and for sin, condemned sin in the flesh:

entries.yo: Ki a le mu ododo ofin ṣẹ ninu awa, ti kò rin nipa ti ara, bikoṣe nipa ti Ẹmí.
entries.en: That the righteousness of the law might be fulfilled in us, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.

entries.yo: Nitori awọn ti o wà nipa ti ara, nwọn a mã ro ohun ti ara; ṣugbọn awọn ti o wà nipa ti Ẹmí, nwọn a mã ro ohun ti Ẹmí.
entries.en: For they that are after the flesh do mind the things of the flesh; but they that are after the Spirit the things of the Spirit.

entries.yo: Nitori ero ti ara ikú ni; ṣugbọn ero ti Ẹmí ni iye ati alafia:
entries.en: For to be carnally minded is death; but to be spiritually minded is life and peace.

entries.yo: Nitori ero ti ara ọtá ni si Ọlọrun: nitori ki itẹriba fun ofin Ọlọrun, on kò tilẹ le ṣe e.
entries.en: Because the carnal mind is enmity against God: for it is not subject to the law of God, neither indeed can be.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li awọn ti o wà ninu ti ara, kò le wù Ọlọrun.
entries.en: So then they that are in the flesh cannot please God.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹnyin kò si ninu ti ara, bikoṣe ninu ti Ẹmí, biobaṣepe Ẹmí Ọlọrun ngbe inu nyin. Ṣugbọn bi ẹnikẹni kò ba ni Ẹmí Kristi, on kò si ninu ẹni tirẹ̀.
entries.en: But ye are not in the flesh, but in the Spirit, if so be that the Spirit of God dwell in you. Now if any man have not the Spirit of Christ, he is none of his.

entries.yo: Bi Kristi ba si wà ninu nyin, ara jẹ okú nitori ẹ̀ṣẹ: ṣugbọn ẹmí jẹ iyè nitori ododo.
entries.en: And if Christ be in you, the body is dead because of sin; but the Spirit is life because of righteousness.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi Ẹmí ẹniti o jí Jesu dide kuro ninu okú ba ngbe inu nyin, ẹniti o ji Kristi Jesu dide kuro ninu okú yio fi Ẹmí rẹ̀ ti ngbe inu nyin, sọ ara kikú nyin di ãye pẹlu.
entries.en: But if the Spirit of him that raised up Jesus from the dead dwell in you, he that raised up Christ from the dead shall also quicken your mortal bodies by his Spirit that dwelleth in you.

entries.yo: Njẹ nitorina, ara, ajigbèsè li awa, ki iṣe ara li a jẹ ni gbese, ti a o fi mã wà nipa ti ara.
entries.en: Therefore, brethren, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.

entries.yo: Nitori bi ẹnyin ba wà ni ti ara, ẹnyin ó kú: ṣugbọn nipa Ẹmí bi ẹnyin ba npa iṣẹ́ ti ara run, ẹnyin ó yè.
entries.en: For if ye live after the flesh, ye shall die: but if ye through the Spirit do mortify the deeds of the body, ye shall live.

entries.yo: Nitori iye awọn ti a nṣe amọ̀na fun lati ọdọ Ẹmí Ọlọrun wá, awọn ni iṣe ọmọ Ọlọrun.
entries.en: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, they are the sons of God.

entries.yo: Nitori ẹnyin kò tun gbà ẹmí ẹrú lati mã bẹ̀ru mọ́: ṣugbọn ẹnyin ti gbà ẹmí isọdọmọ, nipa eyi ti awa fi nke pé, Abba, Baba.
entries.en: For ye have not received the spirit of bondage again to fear; but ye have received the Spirit of adoption, whereby we cry, Abba, Father.

entries.yo: Ẹmí tikararẹ̀ li o mba ẹmí wa jẹrí pe, ọmọ Ọlọrun li awa iṣe:
entries.en: The Spirit itself beareth witness with our spirit, that we are the children of God:

entries.yo: Bi awa ba si jẹ ọmọ, njẹ ajogun li awa, ajogun Ọlọrun, ati ajumọ-jogun pẹlu Kristi; biobaṣepe awa bá a jìya, ki a si le ṣe wa logo pẹlu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And if children, then heirs; heirs of God, and joint-heirs with Christ; if so be that we suffer with him, that we may be also glorified together.

entries.yo: Nitori mo ṣíro rẹ̀ pe, ìya igba isisiyi kò yẹ lati fi ṣe akawe ogo ti a o fihàn ninu wa.
entries.en: For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed in us.

entries.yo: Nitori ifojusọ́na ti ẹda nduro dè ifihàn awọn ọmọ Ọlọrun.
entries.en: For the earnest expectation of the creature waiteth for the manifestation of the sons of God.

entries.yo: Nitori a tẹri ẹda ba fun asan, ki iṣe ifẹ rẹ̀, ṣugbọn nitori ẹniti o tẹ ori rẹ̀ ba, ni ireti,
entries.en: For the creature was made subject to vanity, not willingly, but by reason of him who hath subjected the same in hope,

entries.yo: Nitori a ó sọ ẹda tikalarẹ di omnira kuro ninu ẹrú idibajẹ, si omnira ogo awọn ọmọ Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Because the creature itself also shall be delivered from the bondage of corruption into the glorious liberty of the children of God.

entries.yo: Nitori awa mọ̀ pe gbogbo ẹda li o jumọ nkerora ti o si nrọbi pọ̀ titi di isisiyi.
entries.en: For we know that the whole creation groaneth and travaileth in pain together until now.

entries.yo: Kì si iṣe awọn nikan, ṣugbọn awa tikarawa pẹlu, ti o ni akọ́so Ẹmí, ani awa tikarawa nkerora ninu ara wa, awa nduro dè isọdọmọ, ani idande ara wa.
entries.en: And not only they, but ourselves also, which have the firstfruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for the adoption, to wit, the redemption of our body.

entries.yo: Nitori ireti li a fi gbà wa là: ṣugbọn ireti ti a bá ri kì iṣe ireti: nitori tani nreti ohun ti o bá ri?
entries.en: For we are saved by hope: but hope that is seen is not hope: for what a man seeth, why doth he yet hope for?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi awa ba nreti eyi ti awa kò ri, njẹ awa nfi sũru duro dè e.
entries.en: But if we hope for that we see not, then do we with patience wait for it.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ gẹgẹ li Ẹmí pẹlu si nràn ailera wa lọwọ: nitori a kò mọ̀ bi ã ti igbadura gẹgẹ bi o ti yẹ: ṣugbọn Ẹmí tikararẹ̀ nfi irora ti a kò le fi ẹnu sọ bẹ̀bẹ fun wa.
entries.en: Likewise the Spirit also helpeth our infirmities: for we know not what we should pray for as we ought: but the Spirit itself maketh intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o si nwá inu ọkàn wo, o mọ̀ ohun ti inu Ẹmí, nitoriti o mbẹbẹ fun awọn enia mimọ́ gẹgẹ bi ifẹ Ọlọrun.
entries.en: And he that searcheth the hearts knoweth what is the mind of the Spirit, because he maketh intercession for the saints according to the will of God.

entries.yo: Awa si mọ̀ pe ohun gbogbo li o nṣiṣẹ pọ̀ si rere fun awọn ti o fẹ Ọlọrun, ani fun awọn ẹniti a pè gẹgẹ bi ipinnu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.

entries.yo: Nitori awọn ẹniti o ti mọ̀ tẹlẹ, li o si ti yàn tẹlẹ lati ri bi aworan Ọmọ rẹ̀, ki on le jẹ akọbi larin awọn arakunrin pupọ.
entries.en: For whom he did foreknow, he also did predestinate to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brethren.

entries.yo: Awọn ti o si ti yàn tẹlẹ, awọn li o si ti pè: awọn ẹniti o si ti pè, awọn li o si ti dalare: awọn ẹniti o si ti dalare, awọn li o si ti ṣe logo.
entries.en: Moreover whom he did predestinate, them he also called: and whom he called, them he also justified: and whom he justified, them he also glorified.

entries.yo: Njẹ kili awa o ha wi si nkan wọnyi? Bi Ọlọrun bá wà fun wa, tani yio kọ oju ija si wa?
entries.en: What shall we then say to these things? If God be for us, who can be against us?

entries.yo: Ẹniti kò da Ọmọ on tikararẹ̀ si, ṣugbọn ti o jọwọ rẹ̀ lọwọ fun gbogbo wa, yio ha ti ṣe ti kì yio fun wa li ohun gbogbo pẹlu rẹ̀ lọfẹ?
entries.en: He that spared not his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how shall he not with him also freely give us all things?

entries.yo: Tani yio ha kà ohunkohun si ọrùn awọn ayanfẹ Ọlọrun? Ihaṣe Ọlọrun ti ndare?
entries.en: Who shall lay any thing to the charge of God's elect? It is God that justifieth.

entries.yo: Tali ẹniti ndẹbi? Ihaṣe Kristi Jesu ti o kú, ki a sa kuku wipe ti a ti ji dide kuro ninu okú, ẹniti o si wà li ọwọ́ ọtun Ọlọrun, ti o si mbẹ̀bẹ fun wa?
entries.en: Who is he that condemneth? It is Christ that died, yea rather, that is risen again, who is even at the right hand of God, who also maketh intercession for us.

entries.yo: Tani yio ha yà wa kuro ninu ifẹ Kristi? ipọnju ni, tabi wahalà, tabi inunibini, tabi ìyan, tabi ìhoho, tabi ewu, tabi idà?
entries.en: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? shall tribulation, or distress, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi a ti kọ ọ pe, Nitori rẹ li a ṣe npa wa kú li gbogbo ọjọ; a nkà wa si bi agutan fun pipa.
entries.en: As it is written, For thy sake we are killed all the day long; we are accounted as sheep for the slaughter.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ninu gbogbo nkan wọnyi awa jù ẹniti o ṣẹgun lọ nipa ẹniti o fẹ wa.
entries.en: Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us.

entries.yo: Nitori o da mi loju pe, kì iṣe ikú, tabi ìye, tabi awọn angẹli, tabi awọn ijoye, tabi awọn alagbara, tabi ohun ìgba isisiyi, tabi ohun ìgba ti mbọ̀,
entries.en: For I am persuaded, that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor powers, nor things present, nor things to come,

entries.yo: Tabi òke, tabi ọgbun, tabi ẹda miran kan ni yio le yà wa kuro ninu ifẹ Ọlọrun, ti o wà ninu Kristi Jesu Oluwa wa.
entries.en: Nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

entries.yo: OTITỌ li emi nsọ ninu Kristi, emi kò ṣeke, ọkàn mi si njẹ mi li ẹrí ninu Ẹmí Mimọ́,
entries.en: I say the truth in Christ, I lie not, my conscience also bearing me witness in the Holy Ghost,

entries.yo: Pe mo ni ibinujẹ pupọ, ati ikãnu igbagbogbo li ọkàn mi.
entries.en: That I have great heaviness and continual sorrow in my heart.

entries.yo: Nitori mo fẹrẹ le gbadura pe ki a ké emi tikarami kuro lọdọ Kristi, nitori awọn ará mi, awọn ibatan mi nipa ti ara:
entries.en: For I could wish that myself were accursed from Christ for my brethren, my kinsmen according to the flesh:

entries.yo: Awọn ẹniti iṣe Israeli; ti awọn ẹniti isọdọmọ iṣe, ati ogo, ati majẹmu, ati ifunnilofin, ati ìsin Ọlọrun, ati awọn ileri;
entries.en: Who are Israelites; to whom pertaineth the adoption, and the glory, and the covenants, and the giving of the law, and the service of God, and the promises;

entries.yo: Ti ẹniti awọn baba iṣe, ati lati ọdọ awọn ẹniti Kristi ti wá nipa ti ara, ẹniti o bori ohun gbogbo, Ọlọrun olubukún lailai. Amin.
entries.en: Whose are the fathers, and of whom as concerning the flesh Christ came, who is over all, God blessed for ever. Amen.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn kì iṣe pe nitori ọrọ Ọlọrun di asan. Kì sá iṣe gbogbo awọn ti o ti inu Israeli wá, awọn ni Israeli:
entries.en: Not as though the word of God hath taken none effect. For they are not all Israel, which are of Israel:

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni kì iṣe pe, nitori nwọn jẹ irú-ọmọ Abrahamu, gbogbo wọn li ọmọ: ṣugbọn, Ninu Isaaki li a ó ti pè irú-ọmọ rẹ.
entries.en: Neither, because they are the seed of Abraham, are they all children: but, In Isaac shall thy seed be called.

entries.yo: Eyini ni pe, ki iṣe awọn ọmọ nipa ti ara, ni ọmọ Ọlọrun: ṣugbọn awọn ọmọ ileri li a kà ni irú-ọmọ.
entries.en: That is, They which are the children of the flesh, these are not the children of God: but the children of the promise are counted for the seed.

entries.yo: Nitori ọ̀rọ ileri li eyi, Niwoyi amọdun li emi ó wá; Sara yio si ni ọmọkunrin.
entries.en: For this is the word of promise, At this time will I come, and Sara shall have a son.

entries.yo: Kì si iṣe kìki eyi; ṣugbọn nigbati Rebekka pẹlu lóyun fun ẹnikan, fun Isaaki baba wa;
entries.en: And not only this; but when Rebecca also had conceived by one, even by our father Isaac;

entries.yo: Nitori nigbati a kò ti ibí awọn ọmọ na, bẹ̃ni nwọn kò ti iṣe rere tabi buburu, (ki ipinnu Ọlọrun nipa ti iyanfẹ ki o le duro, kì iṣe nipa ti iṣẹ, bikoṣe ti ẹni ti npè ni;)
entries.en: (For the children being not yet born, neither having done any good or evil, that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works, but of him that calleth;)

entries.yo: A ti sọ fun u pe, Ẹgbọn ni yio ma sìn aburo,
entries.en: It was said unto her, The elder shall serve the younger.

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi a ti kọ ọ pe, Jakọbu ni mo fẹran, ṣugbọn Esau ni mo korira.
entries.en: As it is written, Jacob have I loved, but Esau have I hated.

entries.yo: Njẹ awa o ha ti wi? Aiṣododo ha wà lọdọ Ọlọrun bi? Ki a má ri.
entries.en: What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with God? God forbid.

entries.yo: Nitori o wi fun Mose pe, Emi ó ṣãnu fun ẹniti emi ó ṣãnu fun, emi o si ṣe iyọ́nu fun ẹniti emi o ṣe iyọ́nu fun.
entries.en: For he saith to Moses, I will have mercy on whom I will have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I will have compassion.

entries.yo: Njẹ bẹ̃ni kì iṣe ti ẹniti o fẹ, kì si iṣe ti ẹniti nsáre, bikoṣe ti Ọlọrun ti nṣãnu.
entries.en: So then it is not of him that willeth, nor of him that runneth, but of God that sheweth mercy.

entries.yo: Nitori iwe-mimọ́ wi fun Farao pe, Nitori eyiyi na ni mo ṣe gbé ọ dide, ki emi ki o le fi agbara mi hàn lara rẹ, ki a si le mã ròhin orukọ mi ká gbogbo aiye.
entries.en: For the scripture saith unto Pharaoh, Even for this same purpose have I raised thee up, that I might shew my power in thee, and that my name might be declared throughout all the earth.

entries.yo: Nitorina li o ṣe nṣãnu fun ẹniti o wù u, ẹniti o wù u a si mu u li ọkàn le.
entries.en: Therefore hath he mercy on whom he will have mercy, and whom he will he hardeneth.

entries.yo: Iwọ o si wi fun mi pe, Kili ó ha tun ba ni wi si? Nitori tali o ndè ifẹ rẹ̀ lọ̀na?
entries.en: Thou wilt say then unto me, Why doth he yet find fault? For who hath resisted his will?

entries.yo: Bẹ̃kọ, iwọ enia, tani iwọ ti nda Ọlọrun lohùn? Ohun ti a mọ a ha mã wi fun ẹniti ti o mọ ọ pé, Ẽṣe ti iwọ fi mọ mi bayi?
entries.en: Nay but, O man, who art thou that repliest against God? Shall the thing formed say to him that formed it, Why hast thou made me thus?

entries.yo: Amọ̀koko kò ha li agbara lori amọ̀, ninu ìṣu kanna lati ṣe apakan li ohun elo si ọlá, ati apakan li ohun elo si ailọlá?
entries.en: Hath not the potter power over the clay, of the same lump to make one vessel unto honour, and another unto dishonour?

entries.yo: Njẹ bi Ọlọrun ba fẹ fi ibinu rẹ̀ hàn nkọ, ti o si fẹ sọ agbara rẹ̀ di mimọ̀, ti o si mu suru pupọ fun awọn ohun elo ibinu ti a ṣe fun iparun;
entries.en: What if God, willing to shew his wrath, and to make his power known, endured with much longsuffering the vessels of wrath fitted to destruction:

entries.yo: Ati ki o le sọ ọrọ̀ ogo rẹ̀ di mimọ̀ lara awọn ohun elo ãnu ti o ti pèse ṣaju fun ogo,
entries.en: And that he might make known the riches of his glory on the vessels of mercy, which he had afore prepared unto glory,

entries.yo: Ani awa, ti o ti pè, kì iṣe ninu awọn Ju nikan, ṣugbọn ninu awọn Keferi pẹlu?
entries.en: Even us, whom he hath called, not of the Jews only, but also of the Gentiles?

entries.yo: Bi o ti wi pẹlu ni Hosea pe, Emi ó pè awọn ti kì iṣe enia mi, li enia mi, ati ẹniti ki iṣe ayanfẹ li ayanfẹ.
entries.en: As he saith also in Osee, I will call them my people, which were not my people; and her beloved, which was not beloved.

entries.yo: Yio si ṣe, ni ibi ti a gbé ti sọ fun wọn pe, Ẹnyin kì iṣe enia mi, nibẹ̀ li a o gbé pè wọn li ọmọ Ọlọrun alãye.
entries.en: And it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people; there shall they be called the children of the living God.

entries.yo: Isaiah si kigbe nitori Israeli pe, Bi iye awọn ọmọ Israeli bá ri bi iyanrin okun, apakan li a ó gbala.
entries.en: Esaias also crieth concerning Israel, Though the number of the children of Israel be as the sand of the sea, a remnant shall be saved:

entries.yo: Nitori Oluwa yio mu ọrọ rẹ̀ ṣẹ lori ilẹ aiye, yio pari rẹ̀, yio si ke e kúru li ododo.
entries.en: For he will finish the work, and cut it short in righteousness: because a short work will the Lord make upon the earth.

entries.yo: Ati bi Isaiah ti wi tẹlẹ, Bikoṣe bi Oluwa awọn Ọmọ-ogun ti fi irú-ọmọ silẹ fun wa, awa iba ti dabi Sodomu, a ba si ti sọ wa dabi Gomora.
entries.en: And as Esaias said before, Except the Lord of Sabaoth had left us a seed, we had been as Sodoma, and been made like unto Gomorrha.

entries.yo: Njẹ kili awa o ha wi? Pe awọn Keferi, ti kò lepa ododo, ọwọ́ wọn tẹ̀ ododo, ṣugbọn ododo ti o ti inu igbala wá ni.
entries.en: What shall we say then? That the Gentiles, which followed not after righteousness, have attained to righteousness, even the righteousness which is of faith.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Israeli ti nlepa ofin ododo, ọwọ́ wọn kò tẹ̀ ofin ododo.
entries.en: But Israel, which followed after the law of righteousness, hath not attained to the law of righteousness.

entries.yo: Nitori kini? nitori nwọn ko wá a nipa igbagbọ́, ṣugbọn bi ẹnipe nipa iṣẹ ofin. Nitori nwọn kọsẹ lara okuta ikọsẹ ni;
entries.en: Wherefore? Because they sought it not by faith, but as it were by the works of the law. For they stumbled at that stumblingstone;

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi a ti kọ ọ pe, Kiyesi i, mo gbé okuta ikọsẹ ati àpata idugbolu kalẹ ni Sioni: ẹnikẹni ti o ba si gbà a gbọ, oju kì yio ti i.
entries.en: As it is written, Behold, I lay in Sion a stumblingstone and rock of offence: and whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed.

entries.yo: ARÁ, ifẹ ọkàn mi ati adura mi si Ọlọrun fun Israeli ni, fun igbala wọn.
entries.en: Brethren, my heart's desire and prayer to God for Israel is, that they might be saved.

entries.yo: Nitori mo gbà ẹri wọn jẹ pe, nwọn ni itara fun Ọlọrun, ṣugbọn kì iṣe gẹgẹ bi ìmọ.
entries.en: For I bear them record that they have a zeal of God, but not according to knowledge.

entries.yo: Nitori bi nwọn kò ti mọ ododo Ọlọrun, ti nwọn si nwá ọna lati gbé ododo ara wọn kalẹ, nwọn kò tẹriba fun ododo Ọlọrun.
entries.en: For they being ignorant of God's righteousness, and going about to establish their own righteousness, have not submitted themselves unto the righteousness of God.

entries.yo: Nitori Kristi li opin ofin si ododo fun olukuluku ẹniti o gbagbọ́.
entries.en: For Christ is the end of the law for righteousness to every one that believeth.

entries.yo: Mose sá kọ̀we rẹ̀ pe, ẹniti o ba ṣe ododo ti iṣe ti ofin, yio yè nipa rẹ̀.
entries.en: For Moses describeth the righteousness which is of the law, That the man which doeth those things shall live by them.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ododo ti iṣe ti igbagbọ́ sọ bayi pe, Máṣe wi li ọkàn rẹ pe, tani yio goke lọ si ọrun? (eyini ni, lati mu Kristi sọkalẹ:)
entries.en: But the righteousness which is of faith speaketh on this wise, Say not in thine heart, Who shall ascend into heaven? (that is, to bring Christ down from above:)

entries.yo: Tabi, tani yio sọkalẹ lọ si ọgbun? (eyini ni, lati mu Kristi goke ti inu okú wá).
entries.en: Or, Who shall descend into the deep? (that is, to bring up Christ again from the dead.)

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn kili o wi? Ọ̀rọ na wà leti ọdọ rẹ, li ẹnu rẹ, ati li ọkan rẹ: eyini ni, ọ̀rọ igbagbọ́, ti awa nwasu;
entries.en: But what saith it? The word is nigh thee, even in thy mouth, and in thy heart: that is, the word of faith, which we preach;

entries.yo: Pe, bi iwọ ba fi ẹnu rẹ jẹwọ Jesu li Oluwa, ti iwọ si gbagbọ́ li ọkàn rẹ pe, Ọlọrun jí i dide kuro ninu okú, a o gbà ọ là.
entries.en: That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved.

entries.yo: Nitori ọkàn li a fi igbagbọ́ si ododo; ẹnu li a si fi ijẹwọ si igbala.
entries.en: For with the heart man believeth unto righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation.

entries.yo: Nitori iwe-mimọ́ wipe, Ẹnikẹni ti o ba gbà a gbọ́ oju ki yio ti i.
entries.en: For the scripture saith, Whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed.

entries.yo: Nitori kò si ìyatọ ninu Ju ati Hellene: nitori Oluwa kanna l'Oluwa gbogbo wọn, o si pọ̀ li ọrọ̀ fun gbogbo awọn ti nkepè e.
entries.en: For there is no difference between the Jew and the Greek: for the same Lord over all is rich unto all that call upon him.

entries.yo: Nitori ẹnikẹni ti o ba sá pè orukọ, Oluwa, li a o gbàlà.
entries.en: For whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved.

entries.yo: Njẹ nwọn o ha ti ṣe kepe ẹniti nwọn kò gbagbọ́? nwọn o ha si ti ṣe gbà ẹniti nwọn kò gburó rẹ̀ rí gbọ́? nwọn o ha si ti ṣe gbọ́ laisi oniwasu?
entries.en: How then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed? and how shall they believe in him of whom they have not heard? and how shall they hear without a preacher?

entries.yo: Nwọn o ha si ti ṣe wasu, bikoṣepe a rán wọn? gẹgẹ bi a ti kọ ọ pe, Ẹsẹ awọn ti nwasu ihinrere alafia ti dara to, awọn ti nwãsu ihin ayọ̀ ohun rere!
entries.en: And how shall they preach, except they be sent? as it is written, How beautiful are the feet of them that preach the gospel of peace, and bring glad tidings of good things!

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ki iṣe gbogbo wọn li o gbọ́ ti ihinrere. Nitori Isaiah wipe, Oluwa, tali o gbà ihin wa gbọ́?
entries.en: But they have not all obeyed the gospel. For Esaias saith, Lord, who hath believed our report?

entries.yo: Njẹ nipa gbigbọ ni igbagbọ́ ti iwá, ati gbigbọ nipa ọ̀rọ Ọlọrun.
entries.en: So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn mo ni, Nwọn kò ha gbọ́ bi? Bẹni nitõtọ, Ohùn wọn jade lọ si gbogbo ilẹ, ati ọ̀rọ wọn si opin ilẹ aiye.
entries.en: But I say, Have they not heard? Yes verily, their sound went into all the earth, and their words unto the ends of the world.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn mo ni, Israeli kò ha mọ̀ bi? Mose li o kọ́ wipe, Emi o fi awọn ti kì iṣe enia mu nyin jowú, ati awọn alaimoye enia li emi o fi bi nyin ninu.
entries.en: But I say, Did not Israel know? First Moses saith, I will provoke you to jealousy by them that are no people, and by a foolish nation I will anger you.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Isaiah tilẹ laiya, o si wipe, Awọn ti kò wá mi ri mi; awọn ti kò bère mi li a fi mi hàn fun.
entries.en: But Esaias is very bold, and saith, I was found of them that sought me not; I was made manifest unto them that asked not after me.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nipa ti Israeli li o wipe, Ni gbogbo ọjọ ni mo nà ọwọ́ mi si awọn alaigbọran ati alariwisi enia.
entries.en: But to Israel he saith, All day long I have stretched forth my hands unto a disobedient and gainsaying people.

entries.yo: NJẸ mo ni, Ọlọrun ha ta awọn enia rẹ̀ nù bi? Ki a má ri. Nitori Israeli li emi pẹlu, lati inu irú-ọmọ Abrahamu, li ẹ̀ya Benjamini.
entries.en: I say then, Hath God cast away his people? God forbid. For I also am an Israelite, of the seed of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun kò ta awọn enia rẹ̀ nù ti o ti mọ̀ tẹlẹ. Tabi ẹnyin kò mọ̀ bi iwe-mimọ́ ti wi niti Elijah? bi o ti mbẹ̀bẹ lọdọ Ọlọrun si Israeli, wipe,
entries.en: God hath not cast away his people which he foreknew. Wot ye not what the scripture saith of Elias? how he maketh intercession to God against Israel, saying,

entries.yo: Oluwa, nwọn ti pa awọn woli rẹ, nwọn si ti wó awọn pẹpẹ rẹ lulẹ; emi nikanṣoṣo li o si kù, nwọn si nwá ẹmí mi.
entries.en: Lord, they have killed thy prophets, and digged down thine altars; and I am left alone, and they seek my life.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn idahun wo li Ọlọrun fifun u? Mo ti kù ẹ̃dẹ́gbãrin enia silẹ fun ara mi, awọn ti kò tẹ ẽkun ba fun Baali.
entries.en: But what saith the answer of God unto him? I have reserved to myself seven thousand men, who have not bowed the knee to the image of Baal.

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bẹ̃ si ni li akokò isisiyi pẹlu, apakan wà nipa iyanfẹ ti ore-ọfẹ.
entries.en: Even so then at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.

entries.yo: Bi o ba si ṣepe nipa ti ore-ọfẹ ni, njẹ kì iṣe ti iṣẹ mọ́: bi bẹ̃ kọ́, ore-ọfẹ kì iṣe ore-ọfẹ mọ́. Ṣugbọn biobaṣepe nipa ti iṣẹ́ ni, njẹ kì iṣe ti ore-ọfẹ mọ́: bi bẹ̃ kọ́, iṣẹ kì iṣe iṣẹ mọ́.
entries.en: And if by grace, then is it no more of works: otherwise grace is no more grace. But if it be of works, then is it no more grace: otherwise work is no more work.

entries.yo: Ki ha ni? ohun ti Israeli nwá kiri, on na ni kò ri; ṣugbọn awọn ẹni iyanfẹ ti ri i, a si sé aiya awọn iyokù le:
entries.en: What then? Israel hath not obtained that which he seeketh for; but the election hath obtained it, and the rest were blinded

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi a ti kọ ọ pe, Ọlọrun ti fun wọn li ẹmí orun: oju ki nwọn ki o má le woran, ati etí ki nwọn ki o má le gbọran, titi o fi di oni-oloni.
entries.en: (According as it is written, God hath given them the spirit of slumber, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should not hear;) unto this day.

entries.yo: Dafidi si wipe, Jẹ ki tabili wọn ki o di idẹkun, ati ẹgẹ́, ati ohun ikọsẹ, ati ẹsan fun wọn:
entries.en: And David saith, Let their table be made a snare, and a trap, and a stumbling block, and a recompence unto them:

entries.yo: Ki oju wọn ki o ṣokun, ki nwọn ki o má le riran, ki o si tẹ̀ ẹhin wọn ba nigbagbogbo.
entries.en: Let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see, and bow down their back alway.

entries.yo: Njẹ mo ni, Nwọn ha kọsẹ̀ ki nwọn ki o le ṣubu? Ki a má ri: ṣugbọn nipa iṣubu wọn, igbala dé ọdọ awọn Keferi, lati mu wọn jowú.
entries.en: I say then, Have they stumbled that they should fall? God forbid: but rather through their fall salvation is come unto the Gentiles, for to provoke them to jealousy.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi iṣubu wọn ba di ọrọ̀ aiye, ati bi ifasẹhin wọn ba di ọrọ̀ awọn Keferi; melomelo ni kíkún wọn?
entries.en: Now if the fall of them be the riches of the world, and the diminishing of them the riches of the Gentiles; how much more their fulness?

entries.yo: Ẹnyin ti iṣe Keferi li emi sa mba sọrọ, niwọnbi emi ti jẹ aposteli awọn Keferi, mo gbé oyè mi ga:
entries.en: For I speak to you Gentiles, inasmuch as I am the apostle of the Gentiles, I magnify mine office:

entries.yo: Bi o le ṣe ki emi ki o le mu awọn ará mi jowú, ati ki emi ki o le gbà diẹ là ninu wọn.
entries.en: If by any means I may provoke to emulation them which are my flesh, and might save some of them.

entries.yo: Nitori bi titanù wọn ba jẹ ìlaja aiye, gbigbà wọn yio ha ti ri, bikoṣe iyè kuro ninu okú?
entries.en: For if the casting away of them be the reconciling of the world, what shall the receiving of them be, but life from the dead?

entries.yo: Njẹ bi akọso ba mọ́, bẹ̃li akopọ: bi gbòngbo ba si mọ́, bẹ si li awọn ẹ̀ka rẹ̀ na.
entries.en: For if the firstfruit be holy, the lump is also holy: and if the root be holy, so are the branches.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi a ba yà ninu awọn ẹ̀ka kuro, ti a si lọ́ iwọ, ti iṣe igi oróro igbẹ́ sara wọn, ti iwọ si mba wọn pín ninu gbòngbo ati ọra igi oróro na;
entries.en: And if some of the branches be broken off, and thou, being a wild olive tree, wert graffed in among them, and with them partakest of the root and fatness of the olive tree;

entries.yo: Máṣe ṣe fefé si awọn ẹ̀ka na. Ṣugbọn bi iwọ ba nṣe fefé, iwọ kọ́ li o rù gbòngbo, ṣugbọn gbòngbo li o rù iwọ.
entries.en: Boast not against the branches. But if thou boast, thou bearest not the root, but the root thee.

entries.yo: Njẹ iwọ o wipe, A ti fà awọn ẹ̀ka na ya, nitori ki a le lọ́ mi sinu rẹ̀.
entries.en: Thou wilt say then, The branches were broken off, that I might be graffed in.

entries.yo: O dara; nitori aigbagbọ́ li a ṣe fà wọn ya kuro, iwọ si duro nipa igbagbọ́ rẹ. Máṣe gbé ara rẹ ga, ṣugbọn bẹ̀ru:
entries.en: Well; because of unbelief they were broken off, and thou standest by faith. Be not highminded, but fear:

entries.yo: Nitori bi Ọlọrun kò ba da ẹ̀ka-iyẹka si, kiyesara ki o máṣe alaida iwọ na si.
entries.en: For if God spared not the natural branches, take heed lest he also spare not thee.

entries.yo: Nitorina wo ore ati ikannu Ọlọrun: lori awọn ti o ṣubu, ikannu; ṣugbọn lori iwọ, ore, bi iwọ ba duro ninu ore rẹ̀: ki a má ba ke iwọ na kuro.
entries.en: Behold therefore the goodness and severity of God: on them which fell, severity; but toward thee, goodness, if thou continue in his goodness: otherwise thou also shalt be cut off.

entries.yo: Ati awọn pẹlu, bi nwọn kò ba joko sinu aigbagbọ́, a o lọ́ wọn sinu rẹ̀: nitori Ọlọrun le tún wọn lọ́ sinu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And they also, if they abide not still in unbelief, shall be graffed in: for God is able to graff them in again.

entries.yo: Nitori bi a ti ke iwọ kuro lara igi oróro igbẹ́ nipa ẹda, ti a si lọ́ iwọ sinu igi oróro rere lodi si ti ẹda: melomelo li a o lọ́ awọn wọnyi, ti iṣe ẹka-iyẹka sara igi oróro wọn?
entries.en: For if thou wert cut out of the olive tree which is wild by nature, and wert graffed contrary to nature into a good olive tree: how much more shall these, which be the natural branches, be graffed into their own olive tree?

entries.yo: Ará, emi kò sá fẹ ki ẹnyin ki o wà li òpe niti ohun ijinlẹ yi, ki ẹnyin má ba ṣe ọlọ́gbọn li oju ara nyin; pe ifọju bá Israeli li apakan, titi kíkún awọn Keferi yio fi de.
entries.en: For I would not, brethren, that ye should be ignorant of this mystery, lest ye should be wise in your own conceits; that blindness in part is happened to Israel, until the fulness of the Gentiles be come in.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li a o si gbà gbogbo Israeli là; gẹgẹ bi a ti kọ ọ pe, Ni Sioni li Olugbala yio ti jade wá, yio si yi aiwa-bi-Ọlọrun kuro lọdọ Jakọbu:
entries.en: And so all Israel shall be saved: as it is written, There shall come out of Sion the Deliverer, and shall turn away ungodliness from Jacob:

entries.yo: Eyi si ni majẹmu mi fun wọn, nigbati emi o mu ẹ̀ṣẹ wọn kuro.
entries.en: For this is my covenant unto them, when I shall take away their sins.

entries.yo: Nipa ti ihinrere, ọtá ni nwọn nitori nyin: bi o si ṣe ti iyanfẹ ni, olufẹ ni nwọn nitori ti awọn baba.
entries.en: As concerning the gospel, they are enemies for your sakes: but as touching the election, they are beloved for the fathers' sakes.

entries.yo: Nitori ailábámọ̀ li ẹ̀bun ati ipe Ọlọrun.
entries.en: For the gifts and calling of God are without repentance.

entries.yo: Nitori gẹgẹ bi ẹnyin kò ti gbà Ọlọrun gbọ́ ri, ṣugbọn nisisiyi ti ẹnyin ri ãnu gbà nipa aigbagbọ́ wọn:
entries.en: For as ye in times past have not believed God, yet have now obtained mercy through their unbelief:

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bẹ̃li awọn wọnyi ti o ṣe aigbọran nisisiyi, ki awọn pẹlu ba le ri ãnu gbà nipa ãnu ti a fi hàn nyin.
entries.en: Even so have these also now not believed, that through your mercy they also may obtain mercy.

entries.yo: Nitori Ọlọrun sé gbogbo wọn mọ pọ̀ sinu aigbagbọ́, ki o le ṣãnu fun gbogbo wọn.
entries.en: For God hath concluded them all in unbelief, that he might have mercy upon all.

entries.yo: Ã! ijinlẹ ọrọ̀ ati ọgbọ́n ati ìmọ Ọlọrun! awamáridi idajọ rẹ̀ ti ri, ọ̀na rẹ̀ si jù awari lọ!
entries.en: O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of God! how unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past finding out!

entries.yo: Nitori tali o mọ̀ inu Oluwa? tabi tani iṣe ìgbimọ rẹ̀?
entries.en: For who hath known the mind of the Lord? or who hath been his counseller?

entries.yo: Tabi tali o kọ́ fifun u, ti a o si san a pada fun u?
entries.en: Or who hath first given to him, and it shall be recompensed unto him again?

entries.yo: Nitori lati ọdọ rẹ̀, ati nipa rẹ̀, ati fun u li ohun gbogbo: ẹniti ogo wà fun lailai. Amin.
entries.en: For of him, and through him, and to him, are all things: to whom be glory for ever. Amen.

entries.yo: NITORINA mo fi iyọ́nu Ọlọrun bẹ̀ nyin, ará, ki ẹnyin ki o fi ara nyin fun Ọlọrun li ẹbọ ãye, mimọ́, itẹwọgbà, eyi ni iṣẹ-isìn nyin ti o tọ̀na.
entries.en: I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto God, which is your reasonable service.

entries.yo: Ki ẹ má si da ara nyin pọ̀ mọ́ aiye yi: ṣugbọn ki ẹ parada lati di titun ni iro-inu nyin, ki ẹnyin ki o le ri idi ifẹ Ọlọrun, ti o dara, ti o si ṣe itẹwọgbà, ti o si pé.
entries.en: And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.

entries.yo: Njẹ mo wi fun olukuluku enia ti o wà ninu nyin, nipa ore-ọfẹ ti a fifun mi, ki o máṣe rò ara rẹ̀ jù bi o ti yẹ ni rirò lọ; ṣugbọn ki o le rò niwọntun-wọnsìn, bi Ọlọrun ti fi ìwọn igbagbọ́ fun olukuluku.
entries.en: For I say, through the grace given unto me, to every man that is among you, not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think; but to think soberly, according as God hath dealt to every man the measure of faith.

entries.yo: Nitori gẹgẹ bi awa ti li ẹ̀ya pipọ ninu ara kan, ti gbogbo ẹ̀ya kò si ni iṣẹ kanna:
entries.en: For as we have many members in one body, and all members have not the same office:

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li awa, ti a jẹ́ pipọ, a jẹ́ ara kan ninu Kristi, ati olukuluku ẹ̀ya ara ọmọnikeji rẹ̀.
entries.en: So we, being many, are one body in Christ, and every one members one of another.

entries.yo: Njẹ bi awa si ti nri ọ̀tọ ọ̀tọ ẹ̀bun gbà gẹgẹ bi ore-ọfẹ ti a fifun wa, bi o ṣe isọtẹlẹ ni, ki a mã sọtẹlẹ gẹgẹ bi ìwọn igbagbọ́;
entries.en: Having then gifts differing according to the grace that is given to us, whether prophecy, let us prophesy according to the proportion of faith;

entries.yo: Tabi iṣẹ-iranṣẹ, ki a kọjusi iṣẹ-iranṣẹ wa: tabi ẹniti nkọ́ni, ki o kọjusi kíkọ́;
entries.en: Or ministry, let us wait on our ministering: or he that teacheth, on teaching;

entries.yo: Tabi ẹniti o ngbàni niyanju, si igbiyanju: ẹniti o nfi funni ki o mã fi inu kan ṣe e; ẹniti nṣe olori, ki o mã ṣe e li oju mejeji; ẹniti nṣãnu, ki o mã fi inu didùn ṣe e.
entries.en: Or he that exhorteth, on exhortation: he that giveth, let him do it with simplicity; he that ruleth, with diligence; he that sheweth mercy, with cheerfulness.

entries.yo: Ki ifẹ ki o wà li aiṣẹtan. Ẹ mã takéte si ohun ti iṣe buburu; ẹ faramọ́ ohun ti iṣe rere.
entries.en: Let love be without dissimulation. Abhor that which is evil; cleave to that which is good.

entries.yo: Niti ifẹ ará, ẹ mã fi iyọ́nu fẹran ara nyin: niti ọlá, ẹ mã fi ẹnikeji nyin ṣaju.
entries.en: Be kindly affectioned one to another with brotherly love; in honour preferring one another;

entries.yo: Niti iṣẹ ṣiṣe, ẹ má ṣe ọlẹ; ẹ mã ni igbona ọkàn; ẹ mã sìn Oluwa;
entries.en: Not slothful in business; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord;

entries.yo: Ẹ mã yọ̀ ni ireti; ẹ mã mu sũru ninu ipọnju; ẹ mã duro gangan ninu adura;
entries.en: Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer;

entries.yo: Ẹ mã pese fun aini awọn enia mimọ́; ẹ fi ara nyin fun alejò iṣe.
entries.en: Distributing to the necessity of saints; given to hospitality.

entries.yo: Ẹ mã súre fun awọn ti nṣe inunibini si nyin: ẹ mã sure, ẹ má si ṣepè.
entries.en: Bless them which persecute you: bless, and curse not.

entries.yo: Awọn ti nyọ̀, ẹ mã ba wọn yọ̀, awọn ti nsọkun, ẹ mã ba wọn sọkun.
entries.en: Rejoice with them that do rejoice, and weep with them that weep.

entries.yo: Ẹ mã wà ni inu kanna si ara nyin. Ẹ máṣe tọju ohun gíga, ṣugbọn ẹ mã tẹle awọn onirẹlẹ. Ẹ máṣe jẹ ọlọ́gbọn li oju ara nyin.
entries.en: Be of the same mind one toward another. Mind not high things, but condescend to men of low estate. Be not wise in your own conceits.

entries.yo: Ẹ máṣe fi buburu san buburu fun ẹnikẹni. Ẹ mã pèse ohun ti o tọ́ niwaju gbogbo enia.
entries.en: Recompense to no man evil for evil. Provide things honest in the sight of all men.

entries.yo: Bi o le ṣe, bi o ti wà ni ipa ti nyin, ẹ mã wà li alafia pẹlu gbogbo enia.
entries.en: If it be possible, as much as lieth in you, live peaceably with all men.

entries.yo: Olufẹ, ẹ máṣe gbẹsan ara nyin, ṣugbọn ẹ fi àye silẹ fun ibinu; nitori a ti kọ ọ pe, Oluwa wipe, Temi li ẹsan, emi ó gbẹsan.
entries.en: Dearly beloved, avenge not yourselves, but rather give place unto wrath: for it is written, Vengeance is mine; I will repay, saith the Lord.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi ebi ba npa ọtá rẹ, fun u li onjẹ; bi ongbẹ ba ngbẹ ẹ, fun u li omi mu: ni ṣiṣe bẹ̃ iwọ ó kó ẹyín ina le e li ori.
entries.en: Therefore if thine enemy hunger, feed him; if he thirst, give him drink: for in so doing thou shalt heap coals of fire on his head.

entries.yo: Maṣe jẹ ki buburu ṣẹgun rẹ, ṣugbọn fi rere ṣẹgun buburu.
entries.en: Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good.

entries.yo: KI olukuluku ọkàn ki o foribalẹ fun awọn alaṣẹ ti o wà ni ipo giga. Nitori kò si aṣẹ kan, bikoṣe lati ọdọ Ọlọrun wá: awọn alaṣẹ ti o si wà, lati ọdọ Ọlọrun li a ti làna rẹ̀ wá.
entries.en: Let every soul be subject unto the higher powers. For there is no power but of God: the powers that be are ordained of God.

entries.yo: Nitorina ẹniti o ba tapá si aṣẹ, o tapá si ìlana Ọlọrun: awọn ẹniti o ba si ntapá, yio gbà ẹbi fun ara wọn.
entries.en: Whosoever therefore resisteth the power, resisteth the ordinance of God: and they that resist shall receive to themselves damnation.

entries.yo: Nitori awọn ijoye kì iṣe ẹ̀ru si iṣẹ rere, bikoṣe si iṣẹ buburu. Njẹ iwọ ha fẹ ṣaibẹru aṣẹ wọn? ṣe eyi ti o dara, iwọ ó si gbà iyìn lati ọdọ rẹ̀:
entries.en: For rulers are not a terror to good works, but to the evil. Wilt thou then not be afraid of the power? do that which is good, and thou shalt have praise of the same:

entries.yo: Nitori iranṣẹ Ọlọrun ni iṣe si ọ fun rere. Ṣugbọn bi iwọ ba nṣe buburu, bẹru; nitori kò gbé idà na lasan: nitori iranṣẹ Ọlọrun ni iṣe, olugbẹsan lati ṣiṣẹ ibinu lara ẹniti nṣe buburu.
entries.en: For he is the minister of God to thee for good. But if thou do that which is evil, be afraid; for he beareth not the sword in vain: for he is the minister of God, a revenger to execute wrath upon him that doeth evil.

entries.yo: Nitorina ẹnyin kò gbọdọ ṣaima tẹriba, kì iṣe nitoriti ibinu nikan, ṣugbọn nitori ẹri-ọkàn pẹlu.
entries.en: Wherefore ye must needs be subject, not only for wrath, but also for conscience sake.

entries.yo: Nitori idi eyi na li ẹ ṣe san owo-ode pẹlu: nitori iranṣẹ Ọlọrun ni nwọn eyiyi na ni nwọn mbojuto nigbagbogbo.
entries.en: For for this cause pay ye tribute also: for they are God's ministers, attending continually upon this very thing.

entries.yo: Nitorina ẹ san ohun ti o tọ fun ẹni gbogbo: owo-ode fun ẹniti owo-ode iṣe tirẹ̀: owo-bode fun ẹniti owo-bode iṣe tirẹ̀; ẹ̀ru fun ẹniti ẹ̀ru iṣe tirẹ̀; ọlá fun ẹniti ọlá iṣe tirẹ̀.
entries.en: Render therefore to all their dues: tribute to whom tribute is due; custom to whom custom; fear to whom fear; honour to whom honour.

entries.yo: Ẹ máṣe jẹ ẹnikẹni ni gbese ohun kan, bikoṣepe ki a fẹran ọmọnikeji ẹni: nitori ẹniti o ba fẹran ọmọnikeji rẹ̀, o kó ofin já.
entries.en: Owe no man any thing, but to love one another: for he that loveth another hath fulfilled the law.

entries.yo: Nitori eyi, Iwọ kò gbọdọ ṣe panṣaga, Iwọ kò gbọdọ pania, Iwọ kò gbọdọ jale, Iwọ kò gbọdọ jẹri eke, Iwọ kò gbọdọ ṣojukòkoro; bi ofin miran ba si wà, a ko o pọ ninu ọ̀rọ yi pe, Fẹran ọmọnikeji rẹ bi ara rẹ.
entries.en: For this, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not kill, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness, Thou shalt not covet; and if there be any other commandment, it is briefly comprehended in this saying, namely, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.

entries.yo: Ifẹ kì iṣe ohun buburu si ọmọnikeji rẹ̀: nitorina ifẹ li akója ofin.
entries.en: Love worketh no ill to his neighbour: therefore love is the fulfilling of the law.

entries.yo: Ati eyi, bi ẹ ti mọ̀ akokò pe, o ti to wakati nisisiyi fun nyin lati ji loju orun: nitori nisisiyi ni igbala wa sunmọ etile jù igbati awa ti gbagbọ́ lọ.
entries.en: And that, knowing the time, that now it is high time to awake out of sleep: for now is our salvation nearer than when we believed.

entries.yo: Oru bukọja tan, ilẹ si fẹrẹ mọ́: nitorina ẹ jẹ ki a bọ́ ara iṣẹ òkunkun silẹ, ki a si gbe ihamọra imọlẹ wọ̀.
entries.en: The night is far spent, the day is at hand: let us therefore cast off the works of darkness, and let us put on the armour of light.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki a mã rìn ìrin titọ, bi li ọsán; kì iṣe ni iréde-oru ati ni imutipara, kì iṣe ni iwa-ẽri ati wọbia, kì iṣe ni ìja ati ilara.
entries.en: Let us walk honestly, as in the day; not in rioting and drunkenness, not in chambering and wantonness, not in strife and envying.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹ gbe Jesu Kristi Oluwa wọ̀, ki ẹ má si pèse fun ara, lati mã mu ifẹkufẹ rẹ̀ ṣẹ.
entries.en: But put ye on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make not provision for the flesh, to fulfil the lusts thereof.

entries.yo: ṢUGBỌN ẹniti o ba ṣe ailera ni igbagbọ́ ẹ gbà a, li aitọpinpin iṣiyemeji rẹ̀.
entries.en: Him that is weak in the faith receive ye, but not to doubtful disputations.

entries.yo: Ẹnikan gbagbọ́ pe on le mã jẹ ohun gbogbo: ẹlomiran ti o si ṣe alailera njẹ ewebẹ.
entries.en: For one believeth that he may eat all things: another, who is weak, eateth herbs.

entries.yo: Ki ẹniti njẹ máṣe kẹgan ẹniti kò jẹ; ki ẹniti kò si jẹ ki o máṣe dá ẹniti njẹ lẹjọ: nitori Ọlọrun ti gbà a.
entries.en: Let not him that eateth despise him that eateth not; and let not him which eateth not judge him that eateth: for God hath received him.

entries.yo: Tani iwọ ti ndá ọmọ-ọdọ ẹlomĩ lẹjọ? loju oluwa rẹ̀ li o duro, tabi ti o ṣubu. Nitotọ a o si mu u duro: nitori Oluwa ni agbara lati mu u duro.
entries.en: Who art thou that judgest another man's servant? to his own master he standeth or falleth. Yea, he shall be holden up: for God is able to make him stand.

entries.yo: Ẹlomĩ mbuyìn fun ọjọ kan jù omiran lọ: ẹlomĩ mbuyìn fun ọjọ gbogbo bakanna. Ki olukuluku ki o da ara rẹ̀ loju ni inu ara rẹ̀.
entries.en: One man esteemeth one day above another: another esteemeth every day alike. Let every man be fully persuaded in his own mind.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba nkiyesi ọjọ, o nkiyesi i fun Oluwa; ẹniti kò ba si kiyesi ọjọ, fun Oluwa ni kò kiyesi i. Ẹniti njẹun, o njẹun fun Oluwa, nitori o ndupẹ lọwọ Ọlọrun; ẹniti kò ba si jẹun, fun Oluwa ni kò jẹun, o si ndupẹ lọwọ Ọlọrun.
entries.en: He that regardeth the day, regardeth it unto the Lord; and he that regardeth not the day, to the Lord he doth not regard it. He that eateth, eateth to the Lord, for he giveth God thanks; and he that eateth not, to the Lord he eateth not, and giveth God thanks.

entries.yo: Nitori kò si ẹnikan ninu wa ti o wà lãye fun ara rẹ̀, kò si si ẹniti o nkú fun ara rẹ̀.
entries.en: For none of us liveth to himself, and no man dieth to himself.

entries.yo: Nitori bi a ba wà lãye, awa wà lãye fun Oluwa; bi a ba si kú, awa kú fun Oluwa: nitorina bi a wà lãye, tabi bi a kú ni, ti Oluwa li awa iṣe.
entries.en: For whether we live, we live unto the Lord; and whether we die, we die unto the Lord: whether we live therefore, or die, we are the Lord's.

entries.yo: Nitori idi eyi na ni Kristi ṣe kú, ti o si tún yè, ki o le jẹ Oluwa ati okú ati alãye.
entries.en: For to this end Christ both died, and rose, and revived, that he might be Lord both of the dead and living.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẽṣe ti iwọ fi nda arakunrin rẹ lẹjọ? tabi ẽsitiṣe ti iwọ fi nkẹgan arakunrin rẹ? gbogbo wa ni yio sá duro niwaju itẹ́ idajọ Kristi.
entries.en: But why dost thou judge thy brother? or why dost thou set at nought thy brother? for we shall all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.

entries.yo: Nitori a ti kọ ọ pe, Oluwa wipe, Bi emi ti wà, gbogbo ẽkún ni yio kunlẹ fun mi, ati gbogbo ahọn ni yio si jẹwọ fun Ọlọrun.
entries.en: For it is written, As I live, saith the Lord, every knee shall bow to me, and every tongue shall confess to God.

entries.yo: Njẹ nitorina, olukuluku wa ni yio jihin ara rẹ̀ fun Ọlọrun.
entries.en: So then every one of us shall give account of himself to God.

entries.yo: Nitorina ẹ máṣe jẹ ki a tun mã da ara wa lẹjọ mọ́: ṣugbọn ẹ kuku mã ṣe idajọ eyi, ki ẹnikẹni máṣe fi ohun ikọsẹ tabi ohun idugbolu si ọ̀na arakunrin rẹ̀.
entries.en: Let us not therefore judge one another any more: but judge this rather, that no man put a stumblingblock or an occasion to fall in his brother's way.

entries.yo: Mo mọ̀, o si dá mi loju ninu Jesu Oluwa pe, kò si ohun ti o ṣe aimọ́ fun ara rẹ̀: ṣugbọn ẹniti o ba kà ohunkohun si aimọ́, on li o ṣe aimọ́ fun.
entries.en: I know, and am persuaded by the Lord Jesus, that there is nothing unclean of itself: but to him that esteemeth any thing to be unclean, to him it is unclean.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi inu arakunrin rẹ ba bajẹ nitori onjẹ rẹ, njẹ iwọ kò rìn ninu ifẹ mọ́. Ẹniti Kristi kú fun, máṣe fi onjẹ rẹ pa a kúgbe.
entries.en: But if thy brother be grieved with thy meat, now walkest thou not charitably. Destroy not him with thy meat, for whom Christ died.

entries.yo: Njẹ ẹ máṣe jẹ ki a mã sọ̀rọ ire nyin ni buburu.
entries.en: Let not then your good be evil spoken of:

entries.yo: Nitori ijọba Ọlọrun kì iṣe jijẹ ati mimu; bikoṣe ododo, ati alafia, ati ayọ̀ ninu Ẹmí Mimọ́.
entries.en: For the kingdom of God is not meat and drink; but righteousness, and peace, and joy in the Holy Ghost.

entries.yo: Nitori ẹniti o ba nsìn Kristi ninu nkan wọnyi, li o ṣe itẹwọgbà lọdọ Ọlọrun, ti o si ni iyin lọdọ enia.
entries.en: For he that in these things serveth Christ is acceptable to God, and approved of men.

entries.yo: Njẹ nitorina, ki awa ki o mã lepa ohun ti iṣe ti alafia, ati ohun ti awa o fi gbe ara wa ró.
entries.en: Let us therefore follow after the things which make for peace, and things wherewith one may edify another.

entries.yo: Nitori onjẹ máṣe bi iṣẹ Ọlọrun ṣubu. Ohun gbogbo li o mọ́ nitõtọ; ṣugbọn ibi ni fun oluwarẹ̀ na ti o njẹun lọna ikọsẹ.
entries.en: For meat destroy not the work of God. All things indeed are pure; but it is evil for that man who eateth with offence.

entries.yo: O dara ki a má tilẹ jẹ ẹran, ki a má mu waini, ati ohun kan nipa eyi ti arakunrin rẹ yio kọsẹ, ati ti a o si fi sọ ọ di alailera.
entries.en: It is good neither to eat flesh, nor to drink wine, nor any thing whereby thy brother stumbleth, or is offended, or is made weak.

entries.yo: Iwọ ní igbagbọ́ bi? ní i fun ara rẹ niwaju Ọlọrun. Alabukun-fun ni oluwarẹ̀ na ti ko da ara rẹ̀ lẹbi ninu ohun ti o yàn.
entries.en: Hast thou faith? have it to thyself before God. Happy is he that condemneth not himself in that thing which he alloweth.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹniti o ba nṣiyemeji, o jẹbi bi o ba jẹ, nitoriti kò ti inu igbagbọ́ wá: ati ohunkohun ti kò ti inu igbagbọ wá, ẹṣẹ ni.
entries.en: And he that doubteth is damned if he eat, because he eateth not of faith: for whatsoever is not of faith is sin.

entries.yo: NJẸ o yẹ ki awa ti o lera iba mã ru ẹrù ailera awọn alailera, ki a má si ṣe ohun ti o wù ara wa.
entries.en: We then that are strong ought to bear the infirmities of the weak, and not to please ourselves.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki olukuluku wa ki o mã ṣe ohun ti o wù ọmọnikeji rẹ̀ si rere rẹ̀ lati gbe e ró.
entries.en: Let every one of us please his neighbour for his good to edification.

entries.yo: Nitori Kristi pẹlu kò ṣe ohun ti o wù ara rẹ̀; ṣugbọn gẹgẹ bi a ti kọ ọ pe, Ẹ̀gan awọn ti ngàn ọ ṣubu lù mi.
entries.en: For even Christ pleased not himself; but, as it is written, The reproaches of them that reproached thee fell on me.

entries.yo: Nitori ohunkohun ti a ti kọ tẹlẹ, a ti kọ ọ fun kíkọ wa, pe nipa sũru ati itunu iwe-mimọ́ ki a le ni ireti.
entries.en: For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.

entries.yo: Njẹ ki Ọlọrun sũru ati itunu ki o fi fun nyin lati ni inu kan si ara nyin gẹgẹ bi Kristi Jesu:
entries.en: Now the God of patience and consolation grant you to be likeminded one toward another according to Christ Jesus:

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o le fi ọkàn kan ati ẹnu kan yìn Ọlọrun, Baba Jesu Kristi Oluwa, logo.
entries.en: That ye may with one mind and one mouth glorify God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

entries.yo: Nitorina ẹ gbá ara nyin mọra, gẹgẹ bi Kristi ti gbá wa mọra fun ogo Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Wherefore receive ye one another, as Christ also received us to the glory of God.

entries.yo: Mo si wipe, a ti fi Jesu Kristi ṣe iranṣẹ ikọla nitori otitọ Ọlọrun, ki o ba le mu awọn ileri na duro ti a ti ṣe fun awọn baba,
entries.en: Now I say that Jesus Christ was a minister of the circumcision for the truth of God, to confirm the promises made unto the fathers:

entries.yo: Ati ki awọn Keferi ki o le yìn Ọlọrun logo nitori ãnu rẹ̀; gẹgẹ bi a ti kọ ọ pe, Nitori eyi li emi ó ṣe yin ọ lãrin awọn Keferi, emi o si kọrin si orukọ rẹ.
entries.en: And that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy; as it is written, For this cause I will confess to thee among the Gentiles, and sing unto thy name.

entries.yo: O si tún wipe, Ẹnyin Keferi, ẹ mã yọ̀ pẹlu awọn enia rẹ̀.
entries.en: And again he saith, Rejoice, ye Gentiles, with his people.

entries.yo: Ati pẹlu, Ẹ yìn Oluwa gbogbo ẹnyin Keferi; ẹ si kokikí rẹ̀, ẹnyin enia gbogbo.
entries.en: And again, Praise the Lord, all ye Gentiles; and laud him, all ye people.

entries.yo: Isaiah si tún wipe, Gbòngbo Jesse kan mbọ̀ wá, ati ẹniti yio dide ṣe akoso awọn Keferi; on li awọn Keferi yio ni ireti si.
entries.en: And again, Esaias saith, There shall be a root of Jesse, and he that shall rise to reign over the Gentiles; in him shall the Gentiles trust.

entries.yo: Njẹ ki Ọlọrun ireti ki o fi gbogbo ayọ̀ on alafia kún nyin ni gbigbagbọ, ki ẹnyin ki o le pọ̀ ni ireti nipa agbara Ẹmí Mimọ́.
entries.en: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.

entries.yo: Ará mi, o si da emi tikarami loju nipa ti nyin pe, ẹnyin si kun fun ore, a si fi gbogbo imọ kún nyin, ẹnyin si le mã kìlọ fun ara nyin.
entries.en: And I myself also am persuaded of you, my brethren, that ye also are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish one another.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn, ará mi, mo fi igboiya kọwe si nyin li ọna kan, bi ẹni tun nrán nyin leti, nitori ore-ọfẹ ti a ti fifun mi lati ọdọ Ọlọrun wá,
entries.en: Nevertheless, brethren, I have written the more boldly unto you in some sort, as putting you in mind, because of the grace that is given to me of God,

entries.yo: Ki emi ki o le ṣe iranṣẹ Jesu Kristi si awọn Keferi, lati ta ọrẹ ihinrere Ọlọrun, ki ọrẹ awọn Keferi ki o le di itẹwọgbà, ti a sọ di mimọ́ nipa Ẹmí Mimọ́.
entries.en: That I should be the minister of Jesus Christ to the Gentiles, ministering the gospel of God, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be acceptable, being sanctified by the Holy Ghost.

entries.yo: Nitorina mo ni iṣogo ninu Jesu Kristi nipa ohun ti iṣe ti Ọlọrun.
entries.en: I have therefore whereof I may glory through Jesus Christ in those things which pertain to God.

entries.yo: Emi kò sá gbọdọ sọ ohun kan ninu eyi ti Kristi kò ti ọwọ́ ṣe, si igbọran awọn Keferi nipa ọ̀rọ ati iṣe,
entries.en: For I will not dare to speak of any of those things which Christ hath not wrought by me, to make the Gentiles obedient, by word and deed,

entries.yo: Nipa agbara iṣẹ-àmi ati iṣẹ-iyanu, nipa agbara Ẹmí Ọlọrun; tobẹ̃ lati Jerusalemu ati yiká kiri ani titi fi de Illirikoni, mo ti wasu ihinrere Kristi ni kikun.
entries.en: Through mighty signs and wonders, by the power of the Spirit of God; so that from Jerusalem, and round about unto Illyricum, I have fully preached the gospel of Christ.

entries.yo: Mo du u lati mã wasu ihinrere na, kì iṣe nibiti a gbé ti da orukọ Kristi ri, ki emi ki o máṣe mọ amọle lori ipilẹ ẹlomiran.
entries.en: Yea, so have I strived to preach the gospel, not where Christ was named, lest I should build upon another man's foundation:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn gẹgẹ bi a ti kọ ọ pe, Awọn ẹniti a kò ti sọ̀rọ rẹ̀ fun, nwọn ó ri i: ati awọn ti kò ti gbọ́, òye yio yé wọn.
entries.en: But as it is written, To whom he was not spoken of, they shall see: and they that have not heard shall understand.

entries.yo: Nitorina pẹlu li àye ṣe há fun mi li akoko wọnyi lati tọ̀ nyin wá.
entries.en: For which cause also I have been much hindered from coming to you.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nisisiyi bi emi kò ti li àye mọ́ li ẹkùn wọnyi, bi emi si ti fẹ gidigidi lati ọdún melo wọnyi lati tọ̀ nyin wá,
entries.en: But now having no more place in these parts, and having a great desire these many years to come unto you;

entries.yo: Nigbakugba ti mo ba nlọ si Spania, ng ó tọ̀ nyin wá: nitori mo nireti pe emi o ri nyin li ọ̀na àjo mi, ati pe ẹ o mu mi já ọ̀na mi nibẹ̀ lati ọdọ nyin lọ, bi mo ba kọ kún fun ẹgbẹ nyin li apakan.
entries.en: Whensoever I take my journey into Spain, I will come to you: for I trust to see you in my journey, and to be brought on my way thitherward by you, if first I be somewhat filled with your company.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nisisiyi mo nlọ si Jerusalemu lati ṣe iranṣẹ fun awọn enia mimọ́.
entries.en: But now I go unto Jerusalem to minister unto the saints.

entries.yo: Nitoriti o wù awọn ará Makedonia ati Akaia lati da owo jọ fun awọn talakà awọn enia mimọ́ ti o wà ni Jerusalemu.
entries.en: For it hath pleased them of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor saints which are at Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ ifẹ inu rere wọn ni; ajigbese wọn ni nwọn sá ṣe. Nitori bi o ba ṣepe a fi awọn Keferi ṣe alajọni ninu ohun ẹmí wọn, ajigbese si ni wọn lati fi nkan ti ara ta wọn lọrẹ.
entries.en: It hath pleased them verily; and their debtors they are. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, their duty is also to minister unto them in carnal things.

entries.yo: Nitorina nigbati mo ba ti ṣe eyi tan, ti mo ba si ti dí èdidi eso yi fun wọn tan, emi ó ti ọdọ nyin lọ si Spania.
entries.en: When therefore I have performed this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will come by you into Spain.

entries.yo: Mo si mọ pe, nigbati mo ba de ọdọ nyin, emi o wá ni kikún ibukún ihinrere Kristi.
entries.en: And I am sure that, when I come unto you, I shall come in the fulness of the blessing of the gospel of Christ.

entries.yo: Mo si bẹ̀ nyin, ará, nitori Oluwa wa Jesu Kristi, ati nitori ifẹ Ẹmí, ki ẹnyin ki o ba mi lakaka ninu adura nyin si Ọlọrun fun mi;
entries.en: Now I beseech you, brethren, for the Lord Jesus Christ's sake, and for the love of the Spirit, that ye strive together with me in your prayers to God for me;

entries.yo: Ki a le gbà mi lọwọ awọn alaigbọran ni Judea ati ki iṣẹ-iranṣẹ ti mo ni si Jerusalemu le jẹ itẹwọgbà lọdọ awọn enia mimọ́.
entries.en: That I may be delivered from them that do not believe in Judaea; and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be accepted of the saints;

entries.yo: Ki emi ki o le fi ayọ̀ tọ̀ nyin wá nipa ifẹ Ọlọrun, ati ki emi le ni itura pọ pẹlu nyin.
entries.en: That I may come unto you with joy by the will of God, and may with you be refreshed.

entries.yo: Njẹ ki Ọlọrun alafia ki o wà pẹlu gbogbo nyin. Amin.
entries.en: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.

entries.yo: MO fi Febe, arabinrin wa, le nyin lọwọ ẹniti iṣe diakoni ijọ ti o wà ni Kenkrea:
entries.en: I commend unto you Phebe our sister, which is a servant of the church which is at Cenchrea:

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin le gbà a ninu Oluwa, bi o ti yẹ fun awọn enia mimọ́, ki ẹnyin ki o si ràn a lọwọ iṣẹkiṣẹ ti o nwá ni iranlọwọ lọdọ nyin: nitori on pẹlu ti nṣe oluranlọwọ fun ẹni pipọ, ati fun emi na pẹlu.
entries.en: That ye receive her in the Lord, as becometh saints, and that ye assist her in whatsoever business she hath need of you: for she hath been a succourer of many, and of myself also.

entries.yo: Ẹ kí Priskilla ati Akuila, awọn alabaṣiṣẹ mi ninu Kristi Jesu:
entries.en: Greet Priscilla and Aquila my helpers in Christ Jesus:

entries.yo: Awọn ẹniti, nitori ẹmí mi, nwọn fi ọrùn wọn lelẹ: fun awọn ẹniti kì iṣe kiki emi nikan li o ndupẹ, ṣugbọn gbogbo ijọ larin awọn Keferi pẹlu.
entries.en: Who have for my life laid down their own necks: unto whom not only I give thanks, but also all the churches of the Gentiles.

entries.yo: Ẹ si kí ijọ ti o wà ni ile wọn. Ẹ ki Epenetu, olufẹ mi ọwọn, ẹniti iṣe akọso Asia fun Kristi.
entries.en: Likewise greet the church that is in their house. Salute my wellbeloved Epaenetus, who is the firstfruits of Achaia unto Christ.

entries.yo: Ẹ kí Maria, ti o ṣe lãla pipọ lori wa.
entries.en: Greet Mary, who bestowed much labour on us.

entries.yo: Ẹ kí Androniku ati Junia, awọn ibatan mi, ati awọn ẹgbẹ mi ninu tubu, awọn ẹniti o ni iyìn lọdọ awọn Aposteli, awọn ẹniti o ti wà ninu Kristi ṣaju mi pẹlu.
entries.en: Salute Andronicus and Junia, my kinsmen, and my fellowprisoners, who are of note among the apostles, who also were in Christ before me.

entries.yo: Ẹ kí Ampliatu olufẹ mi ninu Oluwa.
entries.en: Greet Amplias my beloved in the Lord.

entries.yo: Ẹ kí Urbani, alabaṣiṣẹ wa ninu Kristi, ati Staki olufẹ mi.
entries.en: Salute Urbane, our helper in Christ, and Stachys my beloved.

entries.yo: Ẹ ki Apelle ẹniti a mọ̀ daju ninu Kristi. Ẹ kí awọn arãle Aristobulu.
entries.en: Salute Apelles approved in Christ. Salute them which are of Aristobulus' household.

entries.yo: Ẹ kí Herodioni, ibatan mi. Ẹ kí awọn arãle Narkissu, ti o wà ninu Oluwa.
entries.en: Salute Herodion my kinsman. Greet them that be of the household of Narcissus, which are in the Lord.

entries.yo: Ẹ kí Trifena ati Trifosa, awọn ẹniti nṣe lãlã ninu Oluwa. Ẹ kí Persi olufẹ, ti o nṣe lãlã pipọ ninu Oluwa.
entries.en: Salute Tryphena and Tryphosa, who labour in the Lord. Salute the beloved Persis, which laboured much in the Lord.

entries.yo: Ẹ kí Rufu ti a yàn ninu Oluwa, ati iya rẹ̀ ati ti emi.
entries.en: Salute Rufus chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.

entries.yo: Ẹ kí Asinkritu, Flegoni, Herma, Patroba, Herme, ati awọn arakunrin ti o wà pẹlu wọn.
entries.en: Salute Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermas, Patrobas, Hermes, and the brethren which are with them.

entries.yo: Ẹ kí Filologu, ati Julia, Nereu, ati arabinrin rẹ̀, ati Olimpa, ati gbogbo awọn enia mimọ́ ti o wà pẹlu wọn.
entries.en: Salute Philologus, and Julia, Nereus, and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints which are with them.

entries.yo: Ẹ fi ifẹnukonu mimọ́ ki ara nyin. Gbogbo ijọ Kristi kí nyin.
entries.en: Salute one another with an holy kiss. The churches of Christ salute you.

entries.yo: Ará, emi si bẹ̀ nyin, ẹ mã ṣọ awọn ti nṣe ìyapa, ati awọn ti nmu ohun ikọsẹ̀ wá lodi si ẹkọ́ ti ẹnyin kọ́; ẹ si kuro ni isọ wọn.
entries.en: Now I beseech you, brethren, mark them which cause divisions and offences contrary to the doctrine which ye have learned; and avoid them.

entries.yo: Nitori awọn ti o ri bẹ̃ kò sìn Jesu Kristi Oluwa wa, bikoṣe ikùn ara wọn; ọ̀rọ rere ati ọ̀rọ didùndidùn ni nwọn fi npa awọn ti kò mọ̀ meji li ọkàn dà.
entries.en: For they that are such serve not our Lord Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by good words and fair speeches deceive the hearts of the simple.

entries.yo: Nitori igbagbọ́ nyin tàn kalẹ de ìbi gbogbo. Nitorina mo ni ayọ̀ lori nyin: ṣugbọn emi fẹ ki ẹ jẹ ọlọgbọn si ohun ti o ṣe rere, ki ẹ si ṣe òpe si ohun ti iṣe buburu.
entries.en: For your obedience is come abroad unto all men. I am glad therefore on your behalf: but yet I would have you wise unto that which is good, and simple concerning evil.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun alafia yio si tẹ̀ Satani mọlẹ li atẹlẹsẹ nyin ni lọ̃lọ. Ore-ọfẹ Jesu Kristi Oluwa wa ki o wà pẹlu nyin. Amin.
entries.en: And the God of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.

entries.yo: Timotiu, alabaṣiṣẹ mi, ati Lukiu, ati Jasoni, ati Sosipateru, awọn ibatan mi, ki nyin.
entries.en: Timotheus my workfellow, and Lucius, and Jason, and Sosipater, my kinsmen, salute you.

entries.yo: Emi Tertiu ti nkọ Episteli yi, kí nyin ninu Oluwa.
entries.en: I Tertius, who wrote this epistle, salute you in the Lord.

entries.yo: Gaiu, bãle mi, ati ti gbogbo ijọ, ki nyin. Erastu, olutọju iṣura ilu, kí nyin, ati Kuartu arakunrin.
entries.en: Gaius mine host, and of the whole church, saluteth you. Erastus the chamberlain of the city saluteth you, and Quartus a brother.

entries.yo: Ore-ọfẹ Jesu Kristi Oluwa wa, ki o wà pẹlu gbogbo nyin. Amin.
entries.en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

entries.yo: Njẹ fun ẹniti o li agbara lati fi ẹsẹ nyin mulẹ gẹgẹ bi ihinrere mi ati iwasu Jesu Kristi, gẹgẹ bi iṣipaya ohun ijinlẹ, ti a ti pamọ́ lati igba aiyeraiye,
entries.en: Now to him that is of power to stablish you according to my gospel, and the preaching of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery, which was kept secret since the world began,

entries.yo: Ti a si nfihàn nisisiyi, ati nipa iwe-mimọ́ awọn woli, gẹgẹ bi ofin Ọlọrun aiyeraiye, ti a nfihàn fun gbogbo orilẹ-ède si igbọràn igbagbọ́:
entries.en: But now is made manifest, and by the scriptures of the prophets, according to the commandment of the everlasting God, made known to all nations for the obedience of faith:

entries.yo: Ọlọrun ọlọ́gbọn nikanṣoṣo nipasẹ Jesu Kristi li ogo wà fun lailai. Amin.
entries.en: To God only wise, be glory through Jesus Christ for ever. Amen.

entries.yo: PAULU, ẹniti a pè lati jẹ Aposteli Jesu Kristi nipa ifẹ Ọlọrun, ati Sostene arakunrin,
entries.en: Paul, called to be an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, and Sosthenes our brother,

entries.yo: Si ijọ enia Ọlọrun ti o wà ni Korinti, awọn ti a sọ di mimọ́ ninu Kristi Jesu, awọn ẹniti a npè li enia mimọ́, pẹlu gbogbo awọn ti npè orukọ Jesu Kristi Oluwa wa nibigbogbo, ẹniti iṣe tiwọn ati tiwa:
entries.en: Unto the church of God which is at Corinth, to them that are sanctified in Christ Jesus, called to be saints, with all that in every place call upon the name of Jesus Christ our Lord, both theirs and ours:

entries.yo: Ore-ọfẹ si nyin, ati alafia, lati ọdọ Ọlọrun Baba wa ati Oluwa wa Jesu Kristi.
entries.en: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.

entries.yo: Mo dupẹ lọwọ Ọlọrun mi nigbagbogbo nitori nyin, nitori ore-ọfẹ Ọlọrun ti a fifun nyin ninu Jesu Kristi;
entries.en: I thank my God always on your behalf, for the grace of God which is given you by Jesus Christ;

entries.yo: Nitoripe nipasẹ rẹ̀ li a ti sọ nyin di ọlọrọ̀ li ohun gbogbo, ninu ọ̀rọ-isọ gbogbo, ati ninu ìmọ gbogbo;
entries.en: That in every thing ye are enriched by him, in all utterance, and in all knowledge;

entries.yo: Ani gẹgẹ bi a ti fi idi ẹrí Kristi kalẹ ninu nyin:
entries.en: Even as the testimony of Christ was confirmed in you:

entries.yo: Tobẹ ti ẹnyin kò fi rẹ̀hin ninu ẹ̀bunkẹbun; ti ẹ si nreti ifarahàn Oluwa wa Jesu Kristi:
entries.en: So that ye come behind in no gift; waiting for the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ:

entries.yo: Ẹniti yio si fi idi nyin kalẹ titi de opin, ki ẹnyin ki o le jẹ alailẹgàn li ọjọ Oluwa wa Jesu Kristi.
entries.en: Who shall also confirm you unto the end, that ye may be blameless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.

entries.yo: Olododo li Ọlọrun, nipasẹ ẹniti a pè nyin sinu ìdapọ Ọmọ rẹ̀ Jesu Kristi Oluwa wa.
entries.en: God is faithful, by whom ye were called unto the fellowship of his Son Jesus Christ our Lord.

entries.yo: Mo si bẹ̀ nyin, ará, li orukọ Oluwa wa Jesu Kristi, ki gbogbo nyin mã sọ̀rọ ohun kanna, ati ki ìyapa ki o máṣe si ninu nyin; ṣugbọn ki a le ṣe nyin pé ni inu kanna, ati ni ìmọ kanna.
entries.en: Now I beseech you, brethren, by the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that ye all speak the same thing, and that there be no divisions among you; but that ye be perfectly joined together in the same mind and in the same judgment.

entries.yo: Nitori a ti fihàn mi nipa tinyin, ará mi, lati ọdọ awọn ara ile Kloe, pe ìja mbẹ larin nyin.
entries.en: For it hath been declared unto me of you, my brethren, by them which are of the house of Chloe, that there are contentions among you.

entries.yo: Njẹ eyi ni mo wipe, olukuluku nyin nwipe, Emi ni ti Paulu; ati emi ni ti Apollo; ati emi ni ti Kefa; ati emi ni ti Kristi.
entries.en: Now this I say, that every one of you saith, I am of Paul; and I of Apollos; and I of Cephas; and I of Christ.

entries.yo: A ha pin Kristi bi? iṣe Paulu li a kàn mọ agbelebu fun nyin bi? tabi li orukọ Paulu li a baptisi nyin si?
entries.en: Is Christ divided? was Paul crucified for you? or were ye baptized in the name of Paul?

entries.yo: Mo dupẹ lọwọ Ọlọrun pe emi kò baptisi ẹnikẹni ninu nyin, bikoṣe Krispu ati Gaiu;
entries.en: I thank God that I baptized none of you, but Crispus and Gaius;

entries.yo: Ki ẹnikẹni ki o máṣe wipe mo ti mbaptisi li orukọ emi tikarami.
entries.en: Lest any should say that I had baptized in mine own name.

entries.yo: Mo si baptisi awọn ara ile Stefana pẹlu: lẹhin eyi emi kò mọ̀ bi mo ba baptisi ẹlomiran pẹlu.
entries.en: And I baptized also the household of Stephanas: besides, I know not whether I baptized any other.

entries.yo: Nitori Kristi kò rán mi lọ ibaptisi, bikoṣe lati wãsu ihinrere: kì iṣe nipa ọgbọ́n ọ̀rọ, ki a máṣe sọ agbelebu Kristi di alailagbara.
entries.en: For Christ sent me not to baptize, but to preach the gospel: not with wisdom of words, lest the cross of Christ should be made of none effect.

entries.yo: Nitoripe wère li ọ̀rọ agbelebu si awọn ti o nṣegbé; ṣugbọn si awa ti a ngbalà, agbara Ọlọrun ni.
entries.en: For the preaching of the cross is to them that perish foolishness; but unto us which are saved it is the power of God.

entries.yo: Nitoriti a kọ ọ pe, Emi ó pa ọgbọ́n awọn ọlọ́gbọn run, emi ó si sọ òye awọn olóye di asan.
entries.en: For it is written, I will destroy the wisdom of the wise, and will bring to nothing the understanding of the prudent.

entries.yo: Ọlọ́gbọn na ha da? akọwe na ha da? ojiyan aiye yi na ha da? Ọlọrun kò ha ti sọ ọgbọ́n aiye yi di wère?
entries.en: Where is the wise? where is the scribe? where is the disputer of this world? hath not God made foolish the wisdom of this world?

entries.yo: Nitoripe ninu ọgbọ́n Ọlọrun niwọnbi aiye kò ti mọ̀ nitori ọgbọ́n, o wù Ọlọrun nipa wère iwasu lati gbà awọn ti o gbagbọ́ là.
entries.en: For after that in the wisdom of God the world by wisdom knew not God, it pleased God by the foolishness of preaching to save them that believe.

entries.yo: Nitoripe awọn Ju mbère àmi, awọn Hellene si nṣafẹri ọgbọ́n:
entries.en: For the Jews require a sign, and the Greeks seek after wisdom:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awa nwasu Kristi ti a kàn mọ agbelebu, ikọsẹ̀ fun awọn Ju, ati wère fun awọn Hellene,
entries.en: But we preach Christ crucified, unto the Jews a stumblingblock, and unto the Greeks foolishness;

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn fun awọn ti a pè, ati Ju ati Hellene, Kristi li agbara Ọlọrun, ati ọgbọ́n Ọlọrun.
entries.en: But unto them which are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ the power of God, and the wisdom of God.

entries.yo: Nitoripe wère Ọlọrun gbọ́n jù enia lọ; ati ailera Ọlọrun li agbara jù enia lọ.
entries.en: Because the foolishness of God is wiser than men; and the weakness of God is stronger than men.

entries.yo: Ẹ sa wo ìpè nyin, ará, bi o ti ṣepe kì iṣe ọ̀pọ awọn ọlọ́gbọn enia nipa ti ara, kì iṣe ọ̀pọ awọn alagbara, kì iṣe ọ̀pọ awọn ọlọlá li a pè:
entries.en: For ye see your calling, brethren, how that not many wise men after the flesh, not many mighty, not many noble, are called:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Ọlọrun ti yàn awọn ohun wère aiye lati fi dãmu awọn ọlọgbọ́n; Ọlọrun si ti yàn awọn ohun ailera aiye lati fi dãmu awọn ohun ti o li agbara;
