entries.en: If any thing be revealed to another that sitteth by, let the first hold his peace.

entries.yo: Gbogbo nyin le mã sọtẹlẹ li ọkọ̃kan, ki gbogbo nyin le mã kọ ẹkọ ki a le tu gbogbo nyin ni inu.
entries.en: For ye may all prophesy one by one, that all may learn, and all may be comforted.

entries.yo: Ẹmí awọn woli a si ma tẹriba fun awọn woli.
entries.en: And the spirits of the prophets are subject to the prophets.

entries.yo: Nitori Ọlọrun kì iṣe Ọlọrun ohun rudurudu, ṣugbọn ti alafia, gẹgẹ bi o ti jẹ ninu gbogbo ijọ enia mimọ́.
entries.en: For God is not the author of confusion, but of peace, as in all churches of the saints.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki awọn obinrin nyin dakẹ ninu ijọ: nitori a kò fifun wọn lati sọrọ, ṣugbọn jẹ ki wọn wà labẹ itẹriba, gẹgẹ bi ofin pẹlu ti wi.
entries.en: Let your women keep silence in the churches: for it is not permitted unto them to speak; but they are commanded to be under obedience, as also saith the law.

entries.yo: Bi nwọn ba si fẹ kọ́ ohunkohun, ki nwọn ki o bère lọwọ ọkọ wọn ni ile: nitori ohun itiju ni fun awọn obinrin lati mã sọrọ ninu ijọ.
entries.en: And if they will learn any thing, let them ask their husbands at home: for it is a shame for women to speak in the church.

entries.yo: Kini? lọdọ nyin li ọ̀rọ Ọlọrun ti jade ni? tabi ẹnyin nikan li o tọ̀ wá?
entries.en: What? came the word of God out from you? or came it unto you only?

entries.yo: Bi ẹnikẹni ba ro ara rẹ̀ pe on jẹ woli, tabi on jẹ ẹniti o li ẹmí, jẹ ki nkan wọnyi ti mo kọ si nyin ki o ye e daju pe ofin Oluwa ni nwọn.
entries.en: If any man think himself to be a prophet, or spiritual, let him acknowledge that the things that I write unto you are the commandments of the Lord.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi ẹnikan ba jẹ òpe, ẹ jẹ ki o jẹ òpe.
entries.en: But if any man be ignorant, let him be ignorant.

entries.yo: Nitorina, ará, ẹ mã fi itara ṣafẹri lati sọtẹlẹ ki ẹ má si ṣe danilẹkun lati fi ède fọ̀.
entries.en: Wherefore, brethren, covet to prophesy, and forbid not to speak with tongues.

entries.yo: Ẹ mã ṣe ohun gbogbo tẹyẹtẹyẹ ati lẹsẹlẹsẹ.
entries.en: Let all things be done decently and in order.

entries.yo: NJẸ, ará, emi nsọ ihinrere na di mimọ̀ fun nyin ti mo ti wãsu fun nyin, eyiti ẹnyin pẹlu ti gbà, ninu eyi ti ẹnyin si duro;
entries.en: Moreover, brethren, I declare unto you the gospel which I preached unto you, which also ye have received, and wherein ye stand;

entries.yo: Nipaṣe eyiti a fi ngbà nyin là pẹlu, bi ẹnyin ba di ọ̀rọ ti mo ti wãsu fun nyin mú ṣinṣin, bikoṣepe ẹnyin ba gbagbọ́ lasan.
entries.en: By which also ye are saved, if ye keep in memory what I preached unto you, unless ye have believed in vain.

entries.yo: Nitoripe ṣiwaju ohun gbogbo mo fi eyiti emi pẹlu ti gbà le nyin lọwọ, bi Kristi ti kú nitori ẹ̀ṣẹ wa gẹgẹ bi iwe-mimọ́ ti wi;
entries.en: For I delivered unto you first of all that which I also received, how that Christ died for our sins according to the scriptures;

entries.yo: Ati pe a sinkú rẹ̀, ati pe o jinde ni ijọ kẹta gẹgẹ bi iwe-mimọ́ ti wi:
entries.en: And that he was buried, and that he rose again the third day according to the scriptures:

entries.yo: Ati pe o farahan Kefa, lẹhin eyini awọn mejila:
entries.en: And that he was seen of Cephas, then of the twelve:

entries.yo: Lẹhin eyini o farahan awọn ará ti o jù ẹ̃dẹgbẹta lọ lẹkanna; apakan ti o pọ̀ju ninu wọn wà titi fi di isisiyi, ṣugbọn awọn diẹ ti sùn.
entries.en: After that, he was seen of above five hundred brethren at once; of whom the greater part remain unto this present, but some are fallen asleep.

entries.yo: Lẹhin eyini o farahan Jakọbu; lẹhinna fun gbogbo awọn Aposteli.
entries.en: After that, he was seen of James; then of all the apostles.

entries.yo: Ati nikẹhin gbogbo wọn o farahàn mi pẹlu, bi ẹni ti a bí ṣiwaju akokò rẹ̀.
entries.en: And last of all he was seen of me also, as of one born out of due time.

entries.yo: Nitori emi li ẹniti o kere jùlọ ninu awọn Aposteli, emi ẹniti kò yẹ ti a ba pè li Aposteli, nitoriti mo ṣe inunibini si ijọ enia Ọlọrun.
entries.en: For I am the least of the apostles, that am not meet to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nipa õre-ọfẹ Ọlọrun, mo ri bi mo ti ri: õre-ọfẹ rẹ̀ ti a fifun mi kò si jẹ asan; ṣugbọn mo ṣiṣẹ lọpọlọpọ jù gbogbo wọn lọ: ṣugbọn kì iṣe emi, bikoṣe õre-ọfẹ Ọlọrun ti o wà pẹlu mi.
entries.en: But by the grace of God I am what I am: and his grace which was bestowed upon me was not in vain; but I laboured more abundantly than they all: yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.

entries.yo: Nitorina ibã ṣe emi tabi awọn ni, bẹ̃li awa wãsu, bẹ̃li ẹnyin si gbagbọ́.
entries.en: Therefore whether it were I or they, so we preach, and so ye believed.

entries.yo: Njẹ bi a ba nwasu Kristi pe o ti jinde kuro ninu okú, ẽhatiṣe ti awọn miran ninu nyin fi wipe, ajinde okú kò si?
entries.en: Now if Christ be preached that he rose from the dead, how say some among you that there is no resurrection of the dead?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi ajinde okú kò si, njẹ Kristi kò jinde:
entries.en: But if there be no resurrection of the dead, then is Christ not risen:

entries.yo: Bi Kristi kò ba si jinde, njẹ asan ni iwãsu wa, asan si ni igbagbọ́ nyin pẹlu.
entries.en: And if Christ be not risen, then is our preaching vain, and your faith is also vain.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu a mu wa li ẹlẹri eke fun Ọlọrun; nitoriti awa jẹri Ọlọrun pe o jí Kristi dide: ẹniti on kò jí dide, bi o ba ṣe pe awọn okú kò jinde?
entries.en: Yea, and we are found false witnesses of God; because we have testified of God that he raised up Christ: whom he raised not up, if so be that the dead rise not.

entries.yo: Nitoripe bi a kò bá ji awọn oku dide, njẹ a kò jí Kristi dide:
entries.en: For if the dead rise not, then is not Christ raised:

entries.yo: Bi a kò ba si jí Kristi dide, asan ni igbagbọ́ nyin; ẹnyin wà ninu ẹ̀ṣẹ nyin sibẹ.
entries.en: And if Christ be not raised, your faith is vain; ye are yet in your sins.

entries.yo: Njẹ awọn pẹlu ti o sùn ninu Kristi ṣegbé.
entries.en: Then they also which are fallen asleep in Christ are perished.

entries.yo: Bi o ba ṣe pe ni kìki aiye yi nikan li awa ni ireti ninu Kristi, awa jasi òtoṣi jùlọ ninu gbogbo enia.
entries.en: If in this life only we have hope in Christ, we are of all men most miserable.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi Kristi ti jinde kuro ninu okú, o si di akọbi ninu awọn ti o sùn.
entries.en: But now is Christ risen from the dead, and become the firstfruits of them that slept.

entries.yo: Nitori igbati o ti ṣepe nipa enia ni ikú ti wá, nipa enia li ajinde ninu okú si ti wá pẹlu.
entries.en: For since by man came death, by man came also the resurrection of the dead.

entries.yo: Nitori bi gbogbo enia ti kú ninu Adamu, bẹ̃ni a ó si sọ gbogbo enia di alãye ninu Kristi.
entries.en: For as in Adam all die, even so in Christ shall all be made alive.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn olukuluku enia ni ipa tirẹ̀: Kristi akọbi; lẹhin eyini awọn ti iṣe ti Kristi ni bibọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: But every man in his own order: Christ the firstfruits; afterward they that are Christ's at his coming.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni opin yio de, nigbati o ba ti fi ijọba fun Ọlọrun ani Baba; nigbati o ba ti mu gbogbo aṣẹ ati gbogbo ọla ati agbara kuro.
entries.en: Then cometh the end, when he shall have delivered up the kingdom to God, even the Father; when he shall have put down all rule and all authority and power.

entries.yo: Nitori on kò le ṣaima jọba titi yio fi fi gbogbo awọn ọta sabẹ ẹsẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: For he must reign, till he hath put all enemies under his feet.

entries.yo: Ikú ni ọtá ikẹhin ti a ó parun.
entries.en: The last enemy that shall be destroyed is death.

entries.yo: Nitori o ti fi ohun gbogbo sabẹ ẹsẹ rẹ̀. Ṣugbọn nigbati o wipe ohun gbogbo li a fi sabẹ rẹ̀, o daju pe, on nikanṣoṣo li o kù, ti o fi ohun gbogbo si i labẹ.
entries.en: For he hath put all things under his feet. But when he saith, all things are put under him, it is manifest that he is excepted, which did put all things under him.

entries.yo: Nigbati a ba si fi ohun gbogbo sabẹ rẹ̀ tan, nigbana li a ó fi Ọmọ tikararẹ̀ pẹlu sabẹ ẹniti o fi ohun gbogbo sabẹ rẹ̀, ki Ọlọrun ki o le jasi ohun gbogbo li ohun gbogbo.
entries.en: And when all things shall be subdued unto him, then shall the Son also himself be subject unto him that put all things under him, that God may be all in all.

entries.yo: Njẹ kili awọn ti a baptisi nitori okú yio ha ṣe, bi o ba ṣe pe awọn okú kò jinde rara? nitori kili a ha ṣe mbaptisi wọn nitori okú?
entries.en: Else what shall they do which are baptized for the dead, if the dead rise not at all? why are they then baptized for the dead?

entries.yo: Nitori kili awa si ṣe mbẹ ninu ewu ni wakati gbogbo?
entries.en: And why stand we in jeopardy every hour?

entries.yo: Mo sọ nipa ayọ̀ ti mo ni lori nyin ninu Kristi Jesu Oluwa wa pe, emi nkú lojojumọ́.
entries.en: I protest by your rejoicing which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.

entries.yo: Ki a wi bi enia, bi mo ba ẹranko jà ni Efesu, anfãni kili o jẹ́ fun mi? bi o ba ṣe pe awọn okú kò jinde, ẹ jẹ ki a mã jẹ, ẹ jẹ ki a mã mu; ọla li awa o sá kú.
entries.en: If after the manner of men I have fought with beasts at Ephesus, what advantageth it me, if the dead rise not? let us eat and drink; for to morrow we die.

entries.yo: Ki a má tàn nyin jẹ: ẹgbẹ́ buburu bà ìwa rere jẹ.
entries.en: Be not deceived: evil communications corrupt good manners.

entries.yo: Ẹ jí iji ododo, ki ẹ má si dẹṣẹ̀; nitori awọn ẹlomiran kò ni ìmọ Ọlọrun: mo sọ eyi ki oju ki o le ti nyin.
entries.en: Awake to righteousness, and sin not; for some have not the knowledge of God: I speak this to your shame.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹnikan yio wipe, Bawo li a o ha ji awọn okú dide? iru ara wo ni nwọn o pada si?
entries.en: But some man will say, How are the dead raised up? and with what body do they come?

entries.yo: Iwọ alaimoye, ohun ti iwọ fọnrugbin ki iyè bikoṣepe o ba kú:
entries.en: Thou fool, that which thou sowest is not quickened, except it die:

entries.yo: Ati eyiti iwọ fọnrugbin, ara ti mbọ̀ ki iwọ fọnrugbin, ṣugbọn irugbin lasan ni, ibã ṣe alikama, tabi irú miran.
entries.en: And that which thou sowest, thou sowest not that body that shall be, but bare grain, it may chance of wheat, or of some other grain:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Ọlọrun fun u li ara bi o ti wù u, ati fun olukuluku irú ara tirẹ̀.
entries.en: But God giveth it a body as it hath pleased him, and to every seed his own body.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ẹran-ara kì iṣe ẹran-ara kanna: ṣugbọn ọ̀tọ li ẹran-ara ti enia, ọ̀tọ li ẹran-ara ti ẹranko, ọ̀tọ ni ti ẹja, ọ̀tọ si ni ti ẹiyẹ.
entries.en: All flesh is not the same flesh: but there is one kind of flesh of men, another flesh of beasts, another of fishes, and another of birds.

entries.yo: Ara ti oke ọrun mbẹ, ara ti aiye pẹlu si mbẹ: ṣugbọn ogo ti oke ọrun ọ̀tọ, ati ogo ti aiye ọ̀tọ.
entries.en: There are also celestial bodies, and bodies terrestrial: but the glory of the celestial is one, and the glory of the terrestrial is another.

entries.yo: Ọtọ li ogo ti õrùn, ọ̀tọ li ogo ti oṣupa, ọ̀tọ si li ogo ti irawọ; irawọ sá yàtọ si irawọ li ogo.
entries.en: There is one glory of the sun, and another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars: for one star differeth from another star in glory.

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bẹ̃ si li ajinde okú. A gbìn i ni idibajẹ; a si jí i dide li aidibajẹ:
entries.en: So also is the resurrection of the dead. It is sown in corruption; it is raised in incorruption:

entries.yo: A gbìn i li ainiyìn; a si jí i dide li ogo: a gbìn i li ailera, a si jí i dide li agbara:
entries.en: It is sown in dishonour; it is raised in glory: it is sown in weakness; it is raised in power:

entries.yo: A gbìn i li ara iyara; a si jí i dide li ara ẹmí. Bi ara iyara ba mbẹ, ara ẹmí si mbẹ.
entries.en: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body, and there is a spiritual body.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li a si kọ ọ pe, Adamu ọkunrin iṣaju, alãye ọkàn li a da a; Adamu ikẹhin ẹmí isọnidãye.
entries.en: And so it is written, The first man Adam was made a living soul; the last Adam was made a quickening spirit.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn eyi ti iṣe ẹlẹmí kọ́ tète ṣaju, bikoṣe eyi ti iṣe ara iyara; lẹhinna eyi ti iṣe ẹlẹmí.
entries.en: Howbeit that was not first which is spiritual, but that which is natural; and afterward that which is spiritual.

entries.yo: Ọkunrin iṣaju ti inu erupẹ̀ wá, ẹni erupẹ̀: ọkunrin ekeji Oluwa lati ọrun wá ni.
entries.en: The first man is of the earth, earthy: the second man is the Lord from heaven.

entries.yo: Bi ẹni erupẹ̀ ti ri, irú bẹ̃ si ni awọn ti iṣe ti erupẹ̀: bi ẹni ti ọrun ti ri, irú bẹ si ni awọn ti iṣe ti ọrun.
entries.en: As is the earthy, such are they also that are earthy: and as is the heavenly, such are they also that are heavenly.

entries.yo: Bi awa si ti rù aworan ẹni erupẹ̀, bẹ̃li awa ó si ru aworan ẹni ti ọrun.
entries.en: And as we have borne the image of the earthy, we shall also bear the image of the heavenly.

entries.yo: Ará, njẹ eyi ni mo wipe, ara on ẹ̀jẹ kò le jogún ijọba Ọlọrun; bẹ̃ni idibajẹ kò le jogún aidibajẹ.
entries.en: Now this I say, brethren, that flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of God; neither doth corruption inherit incorruption.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, ohun ijinlẹ ni mo sọ fun nyin; gbogbo wa kì yio sùn, ṣugbọn gbogbo wa li a o palarada,
entries.en: Behold, I shew you a mystery; We shall not all sleep, but we shall all be changed,

entries.yo: Lọgan, ni iṣẹ́ju, nigba ipè ikẹhin: nitori ipè yio dún, a o si jí awọn okú dide li aidibajẹ, a ó si pawalara dà.
entries.en: In a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trump: for the trumpet shall sound, and the dead shall be raised incorruptible, and we shall be changed.

entries.yo: Nitoripe ara idibajẹ yi kò le ṣaigbé aidibajẹ wọ̀, ati ara kikú yi kò le ṣaigbé ara aiku wọ̀.
entries.en: For this corruptible must put on incorruption, and this mortal must put on immortality.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati ara idibajẹ yi ba ti gbe aidibajẹ wọ̀, ti ara kikú yi ba si ti gbe aikú wọ̀ bẹ̃ tan, nigbana ni ọ̀rọ ti a kọ yio ṣẹ pe, A gbé ikú mì ni iṣẹgun.
entries.en: So when this corruptible shall have put on incorruption, and this mortal shall have put on immortality, then shall be brought to pass the saying that is written, Death is swallowed up in victory.

entries.yo: Ikú, oró rẹ dà? Isà okú, iṣẹgun rẹ dà?
entries.en: O death, where is thy sting? O grave, where is thy victory?

entries.yo: Oró ikú li ẹ̀ṣẹ; ati agbara ẹ̀ṣẹ li ofin.
entries.en: The sting of death is sin; and the strength of sin is the law.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ọpẹ́ ni fun Ọlọrun ẹniti o fi iṣẹgun fun wa nipa Oluwa wa Jesu Kristi.
entries.en: But thanks be to God, which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

entries.yo: Nitorina ẹnyin ará mi olufẹ ẹ mã duro ṣinṣin, laiyẹsẹ, ki ẹ mã pọ̀ si i ni iṣẹ Oluwa nigbagbogbo, niwọn bi ẹnyin ti mọ̀ pe iṣẹ nyin kì iṣe asan ninu Oluwa.
entries.en: Therefore, my beloved brethren, be ye stedfast, unmoveable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, forasmuch as ye know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord.

entries.yo: NJẸ niti idawo fun awọn enia mimọ́, bi mo ti fi aṣẹ fun awọn ijọ Galatia, bẹ̃ gẹgẹ ni ki ẹ ṣe.
entries.en: Now concerning the collection for the saints, as I have given order to the churches of Galatia, even so do ye.

entries.yo: Li ọjọ ikini ọ̀sẹ, ki olukuluku nyin fi sinu iṣura lọdọ ara rẹ̀ li apakan, gẹgẹ bi Ọlọrun ti ṣe rere fun u, ki o máṣe si ikojọ nigbati mo ba de.
entries.en: Upon the first day of the week let every one of you lay by him in store, as God hath prospered him, that there be no gatherings when I come.

entries.yo: Ati nigbati mo ba de, ẹnikẹni ti ẹ ba fi iwe nyin yàn, awọn li emi ó rán lati mu ẹ̀bun nyin gòke lọ si Jerusalemu.
entries.en: And when I come, whomsoever ye shall approve by your letters, them will I send to bring your liberality unto Jerusalem.

entries.yo: Bi o ba si yẹ ki emi ki o lọ pẹlu, nwọn ó si ba mi lọ.
entries.en: And if it be meet that I go also, they shall go with me.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi o tọ̀ nyin wá, nigbati emi ba ti kọja lọ larin Makedonia: nitori emi ó kọja larin Makedonia.
entries.en: Now I will come unto you, when I shall pass through Macedonia: for I do pass through Macedonia.

entries.yo: Boya emi ó si duro, ani, emi a si lo akoko otutu pẹlu nyin, ki ẹnyin ki o le sìn mi li ọ̀na àjo mi, nibikibi ti mo ba nlọ.
entries.en: And it may be that I will abide, yea, and winter with you, that ye may bring me on my journey whithersoever I go.

entries.yo: Nitori emi kò fẹ ri nyin li ọ̀na-ajò nisisiyi; nitori emi nreti ati duro lọdọ nyin nigba diẹ, bi Oluwa ba fẹ.
entries.en: For I will not see you now by the way; but I trust to tarry a while with you, if the Lord permit.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi o duro ni Efesu titi di Pẹntikọsti.
entries.en: But I will tarry at Ephesus until Pentecost.

entries.yo: Nitoripe ilẹkun nla ati aitase ṣi silẹ fun mi, ọ̀pọlọpọ si li awọn ọtá ti mbẹ.
entries.en: For a great door and effectual is opened unto me, and there are many adversaries.

entries.yo: Njẹ bi Timotiu ba de, ẹ jẹ́ ki o wà lọdọ nyin laibẹ̀ru: nitori on nṣe iṣẹ Oluwa, bi emi pẹlu ti nṣe.
entries.en: Now if Timotheus come, see that he may be with you without fear: for he worketh the work of the Lord, as I also do.

entries.yo: Nitorina ki ẹnikẹni máṣe kẹgan rẹ̀. Ṣugbọn ẹ sìn i jade lọna-ajò li alafia, ki on ki o le tọ̀ mi wá: nitoriti emi nwò ọ̀na rẹ̀ pẹlu awọn arakunrin.
entries.en: Let no man therefore despise him: but conduct him forth in peace, that he may come unto me: for I look for him with the brethren.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn niti Apollo arakunrin wa, mo bẹ ẹ pupọ ki o tọ̀ nyin wá pẹlu awọn arakunrin: ṣugbọn kì iṣe ifẹ rẹ̀ rara lati wá nisisiyi; ṣugbọn on o wá nigbati o ba ni akokò ti o wọ̀.
entries.en: As touching our brother Apollos, I greatly desired him to come unto you with the brethren: but his will was not at all to come at this time; but he will come when he shall have convenient time.

entries.yo: Ẹ mã ṣọra, ẹ duro gangan ni igbagbọ́, ẹ ṣe bi ọkunrin, ẹ jẹ alagbara.
entries.en: Watch ye, stand fast in the faith, quit you like men, be strong.

entries.yo: Ẹ mã fi ifẹ ṣe gbogbo nkan nyin.
entries.en: Let all your things be done with charity.

entries.yo: Njẹ mo bẹ nyin, ará (ẹ sá mọ̀ ile Stefana, pe awọn ni akọso Akaia, ati pe, nwọn si ti fi ara wọn fun iṣẹ-iranṣẹ awọn enia mimọ́),
entries.en: I beseech you, brethren, (ye know the house of Stephanas, that it is the firstfruits of Achaia, and that they have addicted themselves to the ministry of the saints,)

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o tẹriba fun irú awọn bawọnni, ati fun olukuluku olubaṣiṣẹ pọ̀ pẹlu wa ti o si nṣe lãla.
entries.en: That ye submit yourselves unto such, and to every one that helpeth with us, and laboureth.

entries.yo: Mo yọ̀ fun wíwa Stefana ati Fortunatu ati Akaiku: nitori eyi ti o kù nipa tinyin nwọn ti fi kún u.
entries.en: I am glad of the coming of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus: for that which was lacking on your part they have supplied.

entries.yo: Nitoriti nwọn tù ẹmí mi lara ati tinyin: nitorina ẹ mã gbà irú awọn ti o ri bẹ̃.
entries.en: For they have refreshed my spirit and yours: therefore acknowledge ye them that are such.

entries.yo: Awọn ijọ ni Asia kí nyin. Akuila ati Priskilla kí nyin pupọ ninu Oluwa, pẹlu ijọ ti o wà ni ile wọn.
entries.en: The churches of Asia salute you. Aquila and Priscilla salute you much in the Lord, with the church that is in their house.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn arakunrin kí nyin. Ẹ fi ifẹnukonu mimọ́ kí ara nyin.
entries.en: All the brethren greet you. Greet ye one another with an holy kiss.

entries.yo: Ikíni ti emi Paulu, lati ọwọ́ emi tikarami wá.
entries.en: The salutation of me Paul with mine own hand.

entries.yo: Bi ẹnikẹni kò ba fẹ Jesu Kristi Oluwa, ẹ jẹ ki o di Anatema. Maranata.
entries.en: If any man love not the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be Anathema Maranatha.

entries.yo: Õre-ọfẹ Jesu Kristi Oluwa ki o pẹlu nyin.
entries.en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

entries.yo: Ifẹ mi wà pẹlu gbogbo nyin ninu Kristi Jesu. Amin.
entries.en: My love be with you all in Christ Jesus. Amen.

entries.yo: PAULU Aposteli Jesu Kristi nipa ifẹ Ọlọrun, ati Timotiu arakunrin wa, si ijọ Ọlọrun ti o wà ni Korinti, pẹlu, gbogbo awọn enia mimọ́ ti o wà ni gbogbo Akaia:
entries.en: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timothy our brother, unto the church of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints which are in all Achaia:

entries.yo: Õre-ọfẹ si nyin ati alafia lati ọdọ Ọlọrun Baba wa, ati Jesu Kristi Oluwa.
entries.en: Grace be to you and peace from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.

entries.yo: Olubukún li Ọlọrun, ati Baba Jesu Kristi Oluwa wa, Baba iyọ́nu, ati Ọlọrun itunu gbogbo;
entries.en: Blessed be God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies, and the God of all comfort;

entries.yo: Ẹniti ntù wa ninu ni gbogbo wahalà wa, nipa itunu na ti a fi ntù awa tikarawa ninu lati ọdọ Ọlọrun wá, ki awa ki o le mã tù awọn ti o wà ninu wahala-ki-wahala ninu.
entries.en: Who comforteth us in all our tribulation, that we may be able to comfort them which are in any trouble, by the comfort wherewith we ourselves are comforted of God.

entries.yo: Nitoripe bi ìya Kristi ti di pipọ ninu wa, gẹgẹ bẹ̃ni itunu wa di pipọ pẹlu nipa Kristi.
entries.en: For as the sufferings of Christ abound in us, so our consolation also aboundeth by Christ.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi a ba si npọ́n wa loju ni, o jasi bi itunu ati igbala nyin, ti nṣiṣẹ ni ifàiyarán awọn iya kannã ti awa pẹlu njẹ: tabi bi a ba ntù wa ninu, o jasi fun itunu ati igbala nyin.
entries.en: And whether we be afflicted, it is for your consolation and salvation, which is effectual in the enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer: or whether we be comforted, it is for your consolation and salvation.

entries.yo: Ati ireti wa nipa tiyin duro ṣinṣin, awa si mọ̀ pe, bi ẹnyin ti jẹ alabapin ninu ìya, bẹ̃li ẹnyin jẹ ninu itunu na pẹlu.
entries.en: And our hope of you is stedfast, knowing, that as ye are partakers of the sufferings, so shall ye be also of the consolation.

entries.yo: Ará, awa kò sá fẹ ki ẹnyin ki o wà li aimọ̀ nipa wahalà wa, ti o dé bá wa ni Asia, niti pe a pọ́n wa loju gidigidi rekọja agbara wa, tobẹ̃ ti ireti kò tilẹ si fun ẹmi wa mọ́:
entries.en: For we would not, brethren, have you ignorant of our trouble which came to us in Asia, that we were pressed out of measure, above strength, insomuch that we despaired even of life:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awa ni idahùn ikú ninu ara wa, ki awa ki o máṣe gbẹkẹle ara wa, bikoṣe Ọlọrun ti njí okú dide:
entries.en: But we had the sentence of death in ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God which raiseth the dead:

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ti gbà wa kuro ninu ikú ti o tobi tobẹ̃, ti o si ngbà wa: ẹniti awa gbẹkẹ wa le pe yio si mã gbà wa sibẹsibẹ;
entries.en: Who delivered us from so great a death, and doth deliver: in whom we trust that he will yet deliver us;

entries.yo: Ẹnyin pẹlu nfi adura nyin ṣe iranlọwọ fun wa, pe nitori ẹ̀bun ti a fifun wa lati ọwọ ọ̀pọlọpọ enia, ki ọ̀pọlọpọ ki o le mã dupẹ nitori wa.
entries.en: Ye also helping together by prayer for us, that for the gift bestowed upon us by the means of many persons thanks may be given by many on our behalf.

entries.yo: Nitori eyi ni iṣogo wa, ẹ̀rí-ọkàn wa, pe, ni iwa-mimọ́ ati ododo Ọlọrun, kì iṣe nipa ọgbọ́n ara, bikoṣe nipa ore-ọfẹ Ọlọrun, li awa nhuwa li aiye, ati si nyin li ọ̀pọlọpọ.
entries.en: For our rejoicing is this, the testimony of our conscience, that in simplicity and godly sincerity, not with fleshly wisdom, but by the grace of God, we have had our conversation in the world, and more abundantly to you-ward.

entries.yo: Nitoripe awa kò kọwe ohun miran si nyin jù eyi ti ẹnyin kà lọ, tabi ti ẹnyin ti gbà pẹlu: mo si gbẹkẹle pe ẹnyin ó gba a titi de opin;
entries.en: For we write none other things unto you, than what ye read or acknowledge; and I trust ye shall acknowledge even to the end;

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi ẹnyin si ti jẹwọ wa pẹlu li apakan pe, awa ni iṣogo nyin, gẹgẹ bi ẹnyin pẹlu ti jẹ iṣogo wa li ọjọ Jesu Oluwa.
entries.en: As also ye have acknowledged us in part, that we are your rejoicing, even as ye also are ours in the day of the Lord Jesus.

entries.yo: Ati ninu igbẹkẹle yi ni mo ti ngbèro ati tọ̀ nyin wá niṣãjú, ki ẹnyin ki o le ni ayọ nigbakeji;
entries.en: And in this confidence I was minded to come unto you before, that ye might have a second benefit;

entries.yo: Ati lati kọja lọdọ nyin lọ si Makedonia, ati lati tún wá sọdọ nyin lati Makedonia, ati lati mu mi lati ọdọ nyin lọ si Judea.
entries.en: And to pass by you into Macedonia, and to come again out of Macedonia unto you, and of you to be brought on my way toward Judaea.

entries.yo: Nitorina nigbati emi ngbèro bẹ̃, emi ha ṣiyemeji bi? tabi ohun wọnni ti mo pinnu, mo ha pinnu wọn gẹgẹ bi ti ara bi, pe ki o jẹ bẹ̃ni bẹ̃ni, ati bẹ̃kọ, bẹ̃kọ lọdọ mi?
entries.en: When I therefore was thus minded, did I use lightness? or the things that I purpose, do I purpose according to the flesh, that with me there should be yea yea, and nay nay?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi Ọlọrun ti jẹ olõtọ, ọ̀rọ wa fun nyin kì iṣe bẹ̃ni ati bẹ̃kọ.
entries.en: But as God is true, our word toward you was not yea and nay.

entries.yo: Nitoripe Jesu Kristi, Ọmọ Ọlọrun, ẹniti a ti wasu rẹ̀ larin nyin nipasẹ wa, ani nipasẹ emi ati Silfanu ati Timotiu, kì iṣe bẹ̃ni ati bẹ̃kọ, ṣugbọn ninu rẹ̀ ni bẹ̃ni.
entries.en: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us, even by me and Silvanus and Timotheus, was not yea and nay, but in him was yea.

entries.yo: Nitoripe bi o ti wu ki ileri Ọlọrun pọ̀ to, ninu rẹ̀ ni bẹ̃ni: ati ninu rẹ̀ pẹlu ni Amin, si ogo Ọlọrun nipasẹ wa.
entries.en: For all the promises of God in him are yea, and in him Amen, unto the glory of God by us.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi, ẹniti o fi ẹsẹ wa mulẹ pẹlu nyin ninu Kristi, ti o si fi àmi oróro yàn wa, ni Ọlọrun;
entries.en: Now he which stablisheth us with you in Christ, and hath anointed us, is God;

entries.yo: Ẹniti o si ti fi èdidi di wa pẹlu, ti o si ti fi akọso eso Ẹmí si wa li ọkàn.
entries.en: Who hath also sealed us, and given the earnest of the Spirit in our hearts.

entries.yo: Mo si pè Ọlọrun ṣe ẹlẹri li ọkàn mi pe, nitori lati dá nyin si li emi kò ṣe ti wá si Korinti.
entries.en: Moreover I call God for a record upon my soul, that to spare you I came not as yet unto Corinth.

entries.yo: Kì iṣe nitoriti awa tẹ́ gàbá lori igbagbọ́ nyin, ṣugbọn awa jẹ́ oluranlọwọ ayọ̀ nyin: nitori ẹnyin duro nipa igbagbọ́.
entries.en: Not for that we have dominion over your faith, but are helpers of your joy: for by faith ye stand.

entries.yo: ṢUGBỌN mo ti pinnu eyi ninu emi tikarami pe, emi kì yio tun fi ibinujẹ tọ̀ nyin wá.
entries.en: But I determined this with myself, that I would not come again to you in heaviness.

entries.yo: Nitoripe bi emi ba mu inu nyin bajẹ, njẹ tali ẹniti o si nmu inu mi dùn, bikoṣe ẹniti mo ti bà ninu jẹ?
entries.en: For if I make you sorry, who is he then that maketh me glad, but the same which is made sorry by me?

entries.yo: Emi si kọwe nitori eyi kanna si nyin pe, nigbati mo ba si de, ki emi ki o máṣe ni ibinujẹ lọdọ wọn, nitori awọn ti emi iba mã yọ̀: nitoriti mo ni igbẹkẹle ninu gbogbo nyin, nitori ayọ̀ mi li ayọ̀ fun gbogbo nyin.
entries.en: And I wrote this same unto you, lest, when I came, I should have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all, that my joy is the joy of you all.

entries.yo: Nitoripe ninu ọ̀pọlọpọ wahalà ati arodun ọkan mi ni mo ti fi ọ̀pọlọpọ omije kọwe si nyin; kì iṣe nitori ki a le bà nyin ninu jẹ, ṣugbọn ki ẹnyin ki o le mọ̀ ifẹ ti mo ni si nyin lọpọlọpọ rekọja.
entries.en: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote unto you with many tears; not that ye should be grieved, but that ye might know the love which I have more abundantly unto you.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi ẹnikẹni ba ti mu ibinujẹ wá, on kò bà mi ni inu jẹ, bikoṣe niwọn diẹ: ki emi ki o máṣe di ẹru l'ẹ̀ru gbogbo nyin.
entries.en: But if any have caused grief, he hath not grieved me, but in part: that I may not overcharge you all.

entries.yo: Ìya yi ti ọpọlọpọ ti fi jẹ iru enia bẹ̃, o to fun u.
entries.en: Sufficient to such a man is this punishment, which was inflicted of many.

entries.yo: Kaka bẹ ẹ, ẹnyin iba kuku darijì i, ki ẹ si tù u ninu, lọnakọna ki ọpọlọpọ ibanujẹ má bã bò iru enia bẹ̃ mọlẹ.
entries.en: So that contrariwise ye ought rather to forgive him, and comfort him, lest perhaps such a one should be swallowed up with overmuch sorrow.

entries.yo: Nitorina mo bẹ̀ nyin, ẹ fi ifẹ nyin han daju si oluwarẹ̀.
entries.en: Wherefore I beseech you that ye would confirm your love toward him.

entries.yo: Nitori eyi na pẹlu ni mo ti kọwe, ki emi ki o le mọ̀ ẹri nyin, bi ẹnyin ba ṣe eletí ọmọ li ohun gbogbo.
entries.en: For to this end also did I write, that I might know the proof of you, whether ye be obedient in all things.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹniti ẹnyin ba fi ohunkohun jì fun, emi fi jì pẹlu: nitori ohun ti emi pẹlu ba ti fi jì, bi mo ba ti fi ohunkohun jì, nitori tinyin ni mo ti fi ji niwaju Kristi.
entries.en: To whom ye forgive any thing, I forgive also: for if I forgave any thing, to whom I forgave it, for your sakes forgave I it in the person of Christ;

entries.yo: Ki Satani má bã rẹ́ wa jẹ: nitori awa kò ṣe alaimọ̀ arekereke rẹ̀.
entries.en: Lest Satan should get an advantage of us: for we are not ignorant of his devices.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati mo de Troa lati wãsu ihinrere Kristi, ti ilẹkun si ṣí silẹ fun mi lati ọdọ Oluwa wá,
entries.en: Furthermore, when I came to Troas to preach Christ's gospel, and a door was opened unto me of the Lord,

entries.yo: Emi kò ni alafia li ọkàn mi, nitoriti emi ko ri Titu arakunrin mi: ṣugbọn nigbati mo ti dagbere fun wọn, mo rekọja lọ si Makedonia.
entries.en: I had no rest in my spirit, because I found not Titus my brother: but taking my leave of them, I went from thence into Macedonia.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ọpẹ́ ni fun Ọlọrun, ẹniti nyọ̀ ayọ iṣẹgun lori wa nigbagbogbo ninu Kristi, ti o si nfi õrùn ìmọ rẹ̀ hàn nipa wa nibigbogbo.
entries.en: Now thanks be unto God, which always causeth us to triumph in Christ, and maketh manifest the savour of his knowledge by us in every place.

entries.yo: Nitori õrun didùn Kristi li awa jẹ fun Ọlọrun, ninu awọn ti a ngbalà, ati ninu awọn ti o nṣegbé:
entries.en: For we are unto God a sweet savour of Christ, in them that are saved, and in them that perish:

entries.yo: Fun awọn kan, awa jẹ õrun ikú si ikú, ati fun awọn miran õrun iyè. Tali o ha si to fun nkan wọnyi?
entries.en: To the one we are the savour of death unto death; and to the other the savour of life unto life. And who is sufficient for these things?

entries.yo: Nitori awa kò dabi awọn ọ̀pọlọpọ, ti mba ọ̀rọ Ọlọrun jẹ́: ṣugbọn bi nipa otitọ inu, ṣugbọn bi lati ọdọ Ọlọrun wá, niwaju Ọlọrun li awa nsọ̀rọ ninu Kristi.
entries.en: For we are not as many, which corrupt the word of God: but as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God speak we in Christ.

entries.yo: AWA ha tún bẹ̀rẹ lati mã yìn ara wa bi? tabi awa ha nfẹ iwe iyìn sọdọ nyin, tabi lati ọdọ nyin bi awọn ẹlomiran?
entries.en: Do we begin again to commend ourselves? or need we, as some others, epistles of commendation to you, or letters of commendation from you?

entries.yo: Ẹnyin ni iwe wa, ti a ti kọ si wa li ọkàn, ti gbogbo enia ti mọ̀, ti nwọn sì ti kà:
entries.en: Ye are our epistle written in our hearts, known and read of all men:

entries.yo: Bi a ti fi nyin hàn pe, iwe Kristi ni nyin, ti a nṣe iranṣẹ fun, kì iṣe eyiti a fi tadawa kọ, bikoṣe Ẹmí Ọlọrun alãye; kì iṣe ninu tabili okuta, bikoṣe ninu tabili ọkàn ẹran.
entries.en: Forasmuch as ye are manifestly declared to be the epistle of Christ ministered by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in tables of stone, but in fleshy tables of the heart.

entries.yo: Irú igbẹkẹle yi li awa si ni nipa Kristi sọdọ Ọlọrun:
entries.en: And such trust have we through Christ to God-ward:

entries.yo: Kì iṣe pe awa to fun ara wa lati ṣirò ohunkohun bi ẹnipe lati ọdọ awa tikarawa; ṣugbọn lati ọdọ Ọlọrun ni tito wa;
entries.en: Not that we are sufficient of ourselves to think any thing as of ourselves; but our sufficiency is of God;

entries.yo: Ẹniti o mu wa tó bi iranṣẹ majẹmu titun; kì iṣe ti iwe, bikoṣe ti ẹmí: nitori iwe a mã pani, ṣugbọn ẹmí a mã sọni di ãye.
entries.en: Who also hath made us able ministers of the new testament; not of the letter, but of the spirit: for the letter killeth, but the spirit giveth life.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi iṣẹ-iranṣẹ ti ikú, ti a ti kọ ti a si ti gbẹ́ si ara okuta, ba jẹ ologo, tobẹ̃ ti awọn ọmọ Israeli kò le tẹjumọ ati wò oju Mose, nitori ogo oju rẹ̀ (ogo nkọja lọ),
entries.en: But if the ministration of death, written and engraven in stones, was glorious, so that the children of Israel could not stedfastly behold the face of Moses for the glory of his countenance; which glory was to be done away:

entries.yo: Yio ha ti ri ti iṣẹ-iranṣẹ ti ẹmí kì yio kuku jẹ ogo jù?
entries.en: How shall not the ministration of the spirit be rather glorious?

entries.yo: Nitoripe bi iṣẹ-iranṣẹ idalẹbi ba jẹ ologo, melomelo ni iṣẹ-iranṣẹ ododo yio rekọja li ogo.
entries.en: For if the ministration of condemnation be glory, much more doth the ministration of righteousness exceed in glory.

entries.yo: Nitori eyi ti a tilẹ ṣe logo, kò li ogo mọ́ nitori eyi, nipasẹ ogo ti o tayọ.
entries.en: For even that which was made glorious had no glory in this respect, by reason of the glory that excelleth.

entries.yo: Nitoripe bi eyi ti nkọja lọ ba li ogo, melomelo li eyi ti o duro li ogo.
entries.en: For if that which is done away was glorious, much more that which remaineth is glorious.

entries.yo: Njẹ nitorina bi a ti ni irú ireti bi eyi, awa nfi igboiya pupọ sọ̀rọ.
entries.en: Seeing then that we have such hope, we use great plainness of speech:

entries.yo: Kì si iṣe bi Mose, ẹniti o fi iboju bo oju rẹ̀, ki awọn ọmọ Israeli má ba le tẹjumọ wo opin eyi ti nkọja lọ.
entries.en: And not as Moses, which put a vail over his face, that the children of Israel could not stedfastly look to the end of that which is abolished:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn oju-inu wọn fọ́: nitoripe titi fi di oni oloni ní kika majẹmu lailai, iboju na wà laiká soke; iboju ti a ti mu kuro ninu Kristi.
entries.en: But their minds were blinded: for until this day remaineth the same vail untaken away in the reading of the old testament; which vail is done away in Christ.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn titi di oni oloni, nigbakugba ti a ba nkà Mose, iboju na mbẹ li ọkàn wọn.
entries.en: But even unto this day, when Moses is read, the vail is upon their heart.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati on o ba yipada si Oluwa, a o mu iboju na kuro.
entries.en: Nevertheless when it shall turn to the Lord, the vail shall be taken away.

entries.yo: Njẹ Oluwa li Ẹmí na: nibiti Ẹmí Oluwa ba si wà, nibẹ̀ li omnira gbé wà.
entries.en: Now the Lord is that Spirit: and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn gbogbo wa nwò ogo Oluwa laisi iboju bi ẹnipe ninu awojiji, a si npawada si aworan kanna lati ogo de ogo, ani bi lati ọdọ Oluwa ti iṣe Ẹmí.
entries.en: But we all, with open face beholding as in a glass the glory of the Lord, are changed into the same image from glory to glory, even as by the Spirit of the Lord.

entries.yo: NITORINA bi awa ti ni iṣẹ-iranṣẹ yi, gẹgẹ bi a ti ri ãnu gbà, ãrẹ̀ kò mu wa;
entries.en: Therefore seeing we have this ministry, as we have received mercy, we faint not;

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awa ti kọ̀ gbogbo ohun ìkọkọ ti o ni itiju silẹ, awa kò rìn li ẹ̀tan, bẹ̃li awa kò fi ọwọ́ ẹ̀tan mu ọ̀rọ Ọlọrun; ṣugbọn nipa fifi otitọ hàn, awa nfi ara wa le ẹri-ọkàn olukuluku enia lọwọ niwaju Ọlọrun.
entries.en: But have renounced the hidden things of dishonesty, not walking in craftiness, nor handling the word of God deceitfully; but by manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man's conscience in the sight of God.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi ihinrere wa ba si farasin, o farasin fun awọn ti o nù:
entries.en: But if our gospel be hid, it is hid to them that are lost:

entries.yo: Ninu awọn ẹniti ọlọrun aiye yi ti sọ ọkàn awọn ti kò gbagbọ́ di afọju, ki imọlẹ ihinrere Kristi ti o logo, ẹniti iṣe aworan Ọlọrun, ki o máṣe mọlẹ ninu wọn.
entries.en: In whom the god of this world hath blinded the minds of them which believe not, lest the light of the glorious gospel of Christ, who is the image of God, should shine unto them.

entries.yo: Nitori awa kò wãsu awa tikarawa, bikoṣe Kristi Jesu Oluwa; awa tikarawa si jẹ ẹrú nyin nitori Jesu.
entries.en: For we preach not ourselves, but Christ Jesus the Lord; and ourselves your servants for Jesus' sake.

entries.yo: Nitori Ọlọrun, ẹniti o wipe ki imọlẹ ki o mọlẹ lati inu òkunkun jade, on li o ti nmọlẹ li ọkàn wa, lati fun wa ni imọlẹ ìmọ ogo Ọlọrun li oju Jesu Kristi.
entries.en: For God, who commanded the light to shine out of darkness, hath shined in our hearts, to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awa ni iṣura yi ninu ohun èlo amọ̀, ki ọlá nla agbara na ki o le ṣe ti Ọlọrun, ki o má ti ọdọ wa wá.
entries.en: But we have this treasure in earthen vessels, that the excellency of the power may be of God, and not of us.

entries.yo: A npọn wa loju niha gbogbo, ṣugbọn ara kò ní wa: a ndãmú wa, ṣugbọn a kò sọ ireti nù.
entries.en: We are troubled on every side, yet not distressed; we are perplexed, but not in despair;

entries.yo: A nṣe inunibini si wa, ṣugbọn a kò kọ̀ wa silẹ; a nrẹ̀ wa silẹ, ṣugbọn a kò si pa wa run;
entries.en: Persecuted, but not forsaken; cast down, but not destroyed;

entries.yo: Nigbagbogbo awa nru ikú Jesu Oluwa kiri li ara wa, ki a le fi ìye Jesu hàn pẹlu li ara wa.
entries.en: Always bearing about in the body the dying of the Lord Jesus, that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our body.

entries.yo: Nitoripe nigbagbogbo li a nfi awa ti o wà lãyè fun ikú nitori Jesu, ki a le fi ìye Jesu hàn ninu ara kikú wa pẹlu.
entries.en: For we which live are alway delivered unto death for Jesus' sake, that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our mortal flesh.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni ikú nṣiṣẹ ninu wa, ṣugbọn ìye ninu nyin.
entries.en: So then death worketh in us, but life in you.

entries.yo: Awa li ẹmí igbagbọ́ kanna, gẹgẹ bi a ti kọ́ ọ pe, emi gbagbọ́, nitorina li emi ṣe sọ: awa pẹlu gbagbọ́, nitorina li awa si ṣe nsọ;
entries.en: We having the same spirit of faith, according as it is written, I believed, and therefore have I spoken; we also believe, and therefore speak;

entries.yo: Awa mọ̀ pe, ẹniti o jí Jesu Oluwa dide yio si jí wa dide pẹlu nipa Jesu, yio si mu wa wá iwaju rẹ̀ pẹlu nyin.
entries.en: Knowing that he which raised up the Lord Jesus shall raise up us also by Jesus, and shall present us with you.

entries.yo: Nitoripe tinyin li ohun gbogbo, ki ọpọ̀ ore-ọfẹ nipa awọn pipọ le mu ki ọpẹ di pipọ fun ogo Ọlọrun.
entries.en: For all things are for your sakes, that the abundant grace might through the thanksgiving of many redound to the glory of God.

entries.yo: Nitori eyi ni ãrẹ̀ kò ṣe mu wa; ṣugbọn bi ọkunrin ti ode wa ba nparun, sibẹ ọkunrin ti inu wa ndi titun li ojojumọ́.
entries.en: For which cause we faint not; but though our outward man perish, yet the inward man is renewed day by day.

entries.yo: Nitori ipọnju wa ti o fẹrẹ, ti iṣe fun iṣẹ́ju kan, o nṣiṣẹ ogo ainipẹkun ti o pọ̀ rekọja fun wa.
entries.en: For our light affliction, which is but for a moment, worketh for us a far more exceeding and eternal weight of glory;

entries.yo: Niwọn bi a kò ti wò ohun ti a nri, bikoṣe ohun ti a kò ri: nitori ohun ti a nri ni ti igba isisiyi; ṣugbọn ohun ti a kò ri ni ti aiyeraiye.
entries.en: While we look not at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen: for the things which are seen are temporal; but the things which are not seen are eternal.

entries.yo: NITORI awa mọ̀ pe, bi ile agọ́ wa ti aiye bá wó, awa ni ile kan lati ọdọ Ọlọrun, ile ti a kò fi ọwọ́ kọ́, ti aiyeraiye ninu awọn ọrun.
entries.en: For we know that if our earthly house of this tabernacle were dissolved, we have a building of God, an house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens.

entries.yo: Nitori nitõtọ awa nkerora ninu eyi, awa si nfẹ gidigidi lati fi ile wa lati ọrun wá wọ̀ wa:
entries.en: For in this we groan, earnestly desiring to be clothed upon with our house which is from heaven:

entries.yo: Bi o ba ṣepe a ti wọ̀ wa li aṣọ, a kì yio bá wa ni ìhoho.
entries.en: If so be that being clothed we shall not be found naked.

entries.yo: Nitori awa ti mbẹ ninu agọ́ yi nkerora nitõtọ, ẹrù npa wa: kì iṣe nitori ti awa nfẹ ijẹ alaiwọ̀ṣọ, ṣugbọn ki a le wọ̀ wa li aṣọ, ki iyè ki o le gbé ara kiku mì.
entries.en: For we that are in this tabernacle do groan, being burdened: not for that we would be unclothed, but clothed upon, that mortality might be swallowed up of life.

entries.yo: Njẹ ẹniti o ṣe wa fun nkan yi ni Ọlọrun, ẹniti o si ti fi akọso Ẹmí fun wa pẹlu.
entries.en: Now he that hath wrought us for the selfsame thing is God, who also hath given unto us the earnest of the Spirit.

entries.yo: Nitorina awa ni igboiya nigbagbogbo, awa si mọ̀ pe, nigbati awa mbẹ ni ile ninu ara, awa kò si lọdọ Oluwa:
entries.en: Therefore we are always confident, knowing that, whilst we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord:

entries.yo: (Nitoripe nipa igbagbọ́ li awa nrìn, kì iṣe nipa riri:)
entries.en: (For we walk by faith, not by sight:)

entries.yo: Mo ni, awa ni igboiya, awa si nfẹ ki a kuku ti inu ara kuro, ki a si le wà ni ile lọdọ Oluwa.
entries.en: We are confident, I say, and willing rather to be absent from the body, and to be present with the Lord.

entries.yo: Nitorina awa ndù u, pe bi awa ba wà ni ile tabi bi a kò si, ki awa ki o le jẹ ẹni itẹwọgbà lọdọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Wherefore we labour, that, whether present or absent, we may be accepted of him.

entries.yo: Nitoripe gbogbo wa kò le ṣaima fi ara hàn niwaju itẹ́ idajọ Kristi; ki olukuluku ki o le gbà nkan wọnni ti o ṣe ninu ara, gẹgẹ bi eyi ti o ti ṣe, ibã ṣe rere ibã ṣe buburu.
entries.en: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ; that every one may receive the things done in his body, according to that he hath done, whether it be good or bad.

entries.yo: Nitorina bi awa ti mọ̀ ẹ̀ru Oluwa, awa nyi enia li ọkàn pada; ṣugbọn a nfi wa hàn fun Ọlọrun; mo si gbagbọ́ pe, a si fi wa hàn li ọkàn nyin pẹlu.
entries.en: Knowing therefore the terror of the Lord, we persuade men; but we are made manifest unto God; and I trust also are made manifest in your consciences.

entries.yo: Nitori awa kò si ni tún mã yìn ara wa si nyin mọ́, ṣugbọn awa fi àye fun nyin lati mã ṣogo nitori wa, ki ẹ le ni ohun ti ẹ ó fi da wọn lohùn, awọn ti nṣogo lode ara kì isi iṣe li ọkàn.
entries.en: For we commend not ourselves again unto you, but give you occasion to glory on our behalf, that ye may have somewhat to answer them which glory in appearance, and not in heart.

entries.yo: Nitorina bi ori wa ba bajẹ, fun Ọlọrun ni: tabi bi iye wa ba walẹ̀, fun nyin ni.
entries.en: For whether we be beside ourselves, it is to God: or whether we be sober, it is for your cause.

entries.yo: Nitori ifẹ Kristi nrọ̀ wa; nitori awa rò bayi, pe bi ẹnikan ba ti kú fun gbogbo enia, njẹ gbogbo wọn li o ti kú:
entries.en: For the love of Christ constraineth us; because we thus judge, that if one died for all, then were all dead:

entries.yo: O si ti kú fun gbogbo wọn, pe ki awọn ti o wà lãye ki o má si ṣe wà lãye fun ara wọn mọ́, bikoṣe fun ẹniti o kú nitori wọn, ti o si ti jinde.
entries.en: And that he died for all, that they which live should not henceforth live unto themselves, but unto him which died for them, and rose again.

entries.yo: Nitorina lati isisiyi lọ awa kò mọ̀ ẹnikan nipa ti ara mọ́; bi awa tilẹ ti mọ̀ Kristi nipa ti ara, ṣugbọn nisisiyi awa kò mọ̀ ọ bẹ̃ mọ́.
entries.en: Wherefore henceforth know we no man after the flesh: yea, though we have known Christ after the flesh, yet now henceforth know we him no more.

entries.yo: Nitorina bi ẹnikẹni ba wà ninu Kristi, o di ẹda titun: ohun atijọ ti kọja lọ; kiyesi i, nwọn si di titun.
entries.en: Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.

entries.yo: Ohun gbogbo si ti ọdọ Ọlọrun wá, ẹniti o si ti ipasẹ Jesu Kristi ba wa laja sọdọ ara rẹ̀, ti o si ti fi iṣẹ-iranṣẹ ìlaja fun wa;
entries.en: And all things are of God, who hath reconciled us to himself by Jesus Christ, and hath given to us the ministry of reconciliation;

entries.yo: Eyini ni pe, Ọlọrun wà nínu Kristi, o mba araiye làja sọdọ ara rẹ̀, kò si kà irekọja wọn si wọn lọrùn; o si ti fi ọ̀rọ ìlaja le wa lọwọ.
entries.en: To wit, that God was in Christ, reconciling the world unto himself, not imputing their trespasses unto them; and hath committed unto us the word of reconciliation.

entries.yo: Nitorina awa ni ikọ̀ fun Kristi, bi ẹnipe Ọlọrun nti ọdọ wa ṣipẹ fun nyin: awa mbẹ̀ nyin nipò Kristi, ẹ ba Ọlọrun làja.
entries.en: Now then we are ambassadors for Christ, as though God did beseech you by us: we pray you in Christ's stead, be ye reconciled to God.

entries.yo: Nitori o ti fi i ṣe ẹ̀ṣẹ nitori wa, ẹniti kò mọ̀ ẹ̀ṣẹkẹṣẹ rí; ki awa le di ododo Ọlọrun ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: For he hath made him to be sin for us, who knew no sin; that we might be made the righteousness of God in him.

entries.yo: NJẸ bi alabaṣiṣẹpọ pẹlu rẹ̀, awa mbẹ̀ nyin ki ẹ máṣe gbà ore-ọfẹ Ọlọrun lasan.
entries.en: We then, as workers together with him, beseech you also that ye receive not the grace of God in vain.

entries.yo: (Nitori o wipe, emi ti gbohùn rẹ li akokò itẹwọgbà, ati li ọjọ igbala ni mo si ti ràn ọ lọwọ: kiyesi i, nisisiyi ni akokò itẹwọgbà; kiyesi i, nisisiyi ni ọjọ igbala.)
entries.en: (For he saith, I have heard thee in a time accepted, and in the day of salvation have I succoured thee: behold, now is the accepted time; behold, now is the day of salvation.)

entries.yo: A kò si ṣe ohun ikọsẹ li ohunkohun, ki iṣẹ-iranṣẹ ki o máṣe di isọrọ buburu si.
entries.en: Giving no offence in any thing, that the ministry be not blamed:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn li ohun gbogbo awa nfi ara wa han bi awọn iranṣẹ Ọlọrun ninu ọ̀pọlọpọ sũru, ninu ipọnju, ninu aini, ninu wahalà,
entries.en: But in all things approving ourselves as the ministers of God, in much patience, in afflictions, in necessities, in distresses,

entries.yo: Nipa ìnà, ninu tubu, nipa ìrúkerudo, nipa ìṣẹ́, ninu iṣọra, ninu igbawẹ;
entries.en: In stripes, in imprisonments, in tumults, in labours, in watchings, in fastings;

entries.yo: Nipa ìwa mimọ́, nipa ìmọ, nipa ipamọra, nipa iṣeun, nipa Ẹmi Mimọ́, nipa ifẹ aiṣẹtan,
entries.en: By pureness, by knowledge, by longsuffering, by kindness, by the Holy Ghost, by love unfeigned,

entries.yo: Nipa ọ̀rọ otitọ, nipa agbara Ọlọrun, nipa ihamọra ododo li apa ọtún ati li apa òsi,
entries.en: By the word of truth, by the power of God, by the armour of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,

entries.yo: Nipa ọlá ati ẹ̀gan, nipa ìhin buburu ati ìhin rere: bi ẹlẹtan, ṣugbọn a jasi olõtọ;
entries.en: By honour and dishonour, by evil report and good report: as deceivers, and yet true;

entries.yo: Bi ẹniti a kò mọ̀, ṣugbọn a mọ̀ wa dajudaju; bi ẹniti nkú lọ, si kiyesi i, awa wà lãye; bi ẹniti a ńnà, a kò si pa wa;
entries.en: As unknown, and yet well known; as dying, and, behold, we live; as chastened, and not killed;

entries.yo: Bi ẹniti o kún fun ibinujẹ, ṣugbọn awa nyọ̀ nigbagbogbo; bi talakà, ṣugbọn awa nsọ ọ̀pọlọpọ di ọlọrọ̀; bi ẹniti kò ni nkan, ṣugbọn awa ni ohun gbogbo.
entries.en: As sorrowful, yet alway rejoicing; as poor, yet making many rich; as having nothing, and yet possessing all things.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin ara Korinti, a ti bá nyin sọ otitọ ọ̀rọ, ọkàn wa ṣipayá sí nyin.
entries.en: O ye Corinthians, our mouth is open unto you, our heart is enlarged.

entries.yo: A kò ni nyin lara nitori wa, ṣugbọn a ńni nyin lara nitori ifẹ-ọkàn ẹnyin tikaranyin.
entries.en: Ye are not straitened in us, but ye are straitened in your own bowels.

entries.yo: Njẹ fun ẹsan iru kanna (emi nsọ bi ẹnipe fun awọn ọmọ mi,) ki ẹnyin di kikún pẹlu.
entries.en: Now for a recompence in the same, (I speak as unto my children,) be ye also enlarged.

entries.yo: Ẹ máṣe fi aidọgba dàpọ pẹlu awọn alaigbagbọ́: nitori ìdapọ kili ododo ni pẹlu aiṣododo? ìdapọ kini imọlẹ si ni pẹlu òkunkun?
entries.en: Be ye not unequally yoked together with unbelievers: for what fellowship hath righteousness with unrighteousness? and what communion hath light with darkness?

entries.yo: Irẹpọ̀ kini Kristi si ni pẹlu Beliali? tabi ipin wo li ẹniti o gbagbọ́ ni pẹlu alaigbàgbọ?
entries.en: And what concord hath Christ with Belial? or what part hath he that believeth with an infidel?

entries.yo: Irẹpọ̀ kini tẹmpili Ọlọrun si ni pẹlu oriṣa? nitori ẹnyin ni tẹmpili Ọlọrun alãye; gẹgẹ bi Ọlọrun ti wipe, Emi ó gbé inu wọn, emi o si mã rìn ninu wọn; emi o si jẹ Ọlọrun wọn, nwọn o si jẹ enia mi.
entries.en: And what agreement hath the temple of God with idols? for ye are the temple of the living God; as God hath said, I will dwell in them, and walk in them; and I will be their God, and they shall be my people.

entries.yo: Nitorina ẹ jade kuro larin wọn, ki ẹ si yà ara nyin si ọ̀tọ, li Oluwa wi, ki ẹ máṣe fi ọwọ́ kàn ohun aimọ́; emi o si gbà nyin.
entries.en: Wherefore come out from among them, and be ye separate, saith the Lord, and touch not the unclean thing; and I will receive you,

entries.yo: Emi o si jẹ Baba fun nyin, ẹnyin o si jẹ ọmọkunrin mi ati ọmọbinrin mi, li Oluwa Olodumare wi.
entries.en: And will be a Father unto you, and ye shall be my sons and daughters, saith the Lord Almighty.

entries.yo: NITORINA, ẹnyin olufẹ, bi a ti ni ileri wọnyi, ẹ jẹ ki a wẹ̀ ara wa mọ́ kuro ninu gbogbo ẹgbin ti ara ati ti ẹmí, ki a mã sọ ìwa mimọ́ di pipé ni ìbẹru Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Having therefore these promises, dearly beloved, let us cleanse ourselves from all filthiness of the flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.

entries.yo: Ẹ gbà wa tọkàntọkàn; a kò fi ibi ṣe ẹnikẹni, a kò bà ẹnikẹni jẹ, a kò rẹ́ ẹnikẹni jẹ.
entries.en: Receive us; we have wronged no man, we have corrupted no man, we have defrauded no man.

entries.yo: Emi kò sọ eyi lati da nyin lẹbi: nitori mo ti wi ṣãjú pe, ẹnyin wà li ọkàn wa ki a le jumọ kú, ati ki a le jumọ wà lãye.
entries.en: I speak not this to condemn you: for I have said before, that ye are in our hearts to die and live with you.

entries.yo: Mo ni igboiya nla lati ba nyin sọ̀rọ, iṣogo mi lori nyin pọ̀, mo kun fun itunu, mo si nyọ̀ rekọja ninu gbogbo ipọnju wa.
entries.en: Great is my boldness of speech toward you, great is my glorying of you: I am filled with comfort, I am exceeding joyful in all our tribulation.

entries.yo: Nitoripe nigbati awa tilẹ de Makedonia, ara wa kò balẹ, ṣugbọn a nwahalà wa niha gbogbo; ìja mbẹ lode, ẹ̀ru mbẹ ninu.
entries.en: For, when we were come into Macedonia, our flesh had no rest, but we were troubled on every side; without were fightings, within were fears.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹniti ntù awọn onirẹlẹ ninu, ani Ọlọrun, o tù wa ninu nipa didé Titu;
entries.en: Nevertheless God, that comforteth those that are cast down, comforted us by the coming of Titus;

entries.yo: Kì si iṣe nipa didé rẹ̀ nikan, ṣugbọn nipa itunu na pẹlu ti ẹ ti tù u ninu, nigbati o rohin fun wa ifẹ gbigbona nyin, ibanujẹ nyin, ati itara nyin fun mi; bẹni mo si tubọ yọ̀.
entries.en: And not by his coming only, but by the consolation wherewith he was comforted in you, when he told us your earnest desire, your mourning, your fervent mind toward me; so that I rejoiced the more.

entries.yo: Nitoripe bi mo tilẹ fi iwe mu inu nyin bajẹ, emi kò kãbámọ̀, bi mo tilẹ ti kabamọ rí: nitoriti mo woye pe iwe nì mu nyin banujẹ, bi o tilẹ jẹ pe fun igba diẹ.
entries.en: For though I made you sorry with a letter, I do not repent, though I did repent: for I perceive that the same epistle hath made you sorry, though it were but for a season.

entries.yo: Emi yọ̀ nisisiyi, kì iṣe nitoriti a mu inu nyin bajẹ, ṣugbọn nitoriti a mu inu nyin bajẹ si ironupiwada: nitoriti a mu inu nyin bajẹ bi ẹni ìwa-bi-Ọlọrun, ki ẹnyin ki o maṣe tipasẹ wa pàdanù li ohunkohun.
entries.en: Now I rejoice, not that ye were made sorry, but that ye sorrowed to repentance: for ye were made sorry after a godly manner, that ye might receive damage by us in nothing.

entries.yo: Nitoripe ibanujẹ ẹni ìwa-bi-Ọlọrun a ma ṣiṣẹ ironupiwada si igbala ti kì mu abamọ wá: ṣugbọn ibanujẹ ti aiye a ma ṣiṣẹ ikú.
entries.en: For godly sorrow worketh repentance to salvation not to be repented of: but the sorrow of the world worketh death.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, nitori ohun kanna yi ti a mu nyin banujẹ fun bi ẹni ìwa-bi-Ọlọrun, iṣọra ti o mu ba nyin ti kara to, ijirẹbẹ nyin ti tó, ani irunu, ani ibẹru, ani ifẹ gbigbona, ani itara, ani igbẹsan! Ninu ohun gbogbo ẹ ti farahan pe ara nyin mọ́ ninu ọran na.
entries.en: For behold this selfsame thing, that ye sorrowed after a godly sort, what carefulness it wrought in you, yea, what clearing of yourselves, yea, what indignation, yea, what fear, yea, what vehement desire, yea, what zeal, yea, what revenge! In all things ye have approved yourselves to be clear in this matter.

entries.yo: Nitorina, bi mo tilẹ ti kọwe si nyin, emi kò kọ ọ nitori ẹniti o ṣe ohun buburu na, tabi nitori ẹniti a fi ohun buburu na ṣe, ṣugbọn ki aniyan nyin nitori wa le farahan niwaju Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Wherefore, though I wrote unto you, I did it not for his cause that had done the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered wrong, but that our care for you in the sight of God might appear unto you.

entries.yo: Nitorina a ti fi itunu nyin tù wa ninu; ati ni itunu wa a yọ̀ gidigidi nitori ayọ̀ Titu, nitori lati ọdọ gbogbo nyin li a ti tu ẹmi rẹ̀ lara.
entries.en: Therefore we were comforted in your comfort: yea, and exceedingly the more joyed we for the joy of Titus, because his spirit was refreshed by you all.

entries.yo: Bi mo tilẹ ti leri ohunkohun fun u nitori nyin, a kò dojuti mi; ṣugbọn gẹgẹ bi awa ti sọ ohun gbogbo fun nyin li otitọ, gẹgẹ bẹ̃li ori ti a lé niwaju Titu si jasi otitọ.
entries.en: For if I have boasted any thing to him of you, I am not ashamed; but as we spake all things to you in truth, even so our boasting, which I made before Titus, is found a truth.

entries.yo: Iyọ́nu rẹ̀ si di pupọ̀ gidigidi si nyin, bi on ti nranti igbọran gbogbo nyin, bi ẹ ti fi ibẹru ati iwarìri tẹwọgbà a.
entries.en: And his inward affection is more abundant toward you, whilst he remembereth the obedience of you all, how with fear and trembling ye received him.

entries.yo: Mo yọ̀ nitoripe li ohun gbogbo mo ni igbẹkẹle ninu nyin.
entries.en: I rejoice therefore that I have confidence in you in all things.

entries.yo: PẸLUPẸLU, ará, awa nsọ fun nyin niti ore-ọfẹ Ọlọrun, ti a fifun awọn ijọ Makedonia;
entries.en: Moreover, brethren, we do you to wit of the grace of God bestowed on the churches of Macedonia;

entries.yo: Bi o ti jẹ pe ninu ọpọ idanwò ipọnju, ọ̀pọlọpọ ayọ̀ wọn ati ibu aini wọn di pipọ si ọrọ̀ ilawọ wọn,
entries.en: How that in a great trial of affliction the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded unto the riches of their liberality.

entries.yo: Nitori mo jẹri pe gẹgẹ bi agbara wọn, ani ju agbara wọn, nwọn ṣe e lati ifẹ inu ara wọn,
entries.en: For to their power, I bear record, yea, and beyond their power they were willing of themselves;

entries.yo: Nwọn nfi ẹ̀bẹ pipọ rọ̀ wa niti ẹbun ọfẹ yi, ati ti idapọ ninu iṣẹ-iranṣẹ fun awọn enia mimọ́:
entries.en: Praying us with much intreaty that we would receive the gift, and take upon us the fellowship of the ministering to the saints.

entries.yo: Ati eyi, ki iṣe bi awa ti rò rí, ṣugbọn nwọn tètekọ fi awọn tikarawọn fun Oluwa, ati fun wa, nipa ifẹ Ọlọrun;
entries.en: And this they did, not as we hoped, but first gave their own selves to the Lord, and unto us by the will of God.

entries.yo: Tobẹ̃ ti awa fi gba Titu niyanju pe, bi o ti bẹ̀rẹ na, bẹ̃ni ki o si pari ẹbun ọfẹ yi ninu nyin pẹlu.
entries.en: Insomuch that we desired Titus, that as he had begun, so he would also finish in you the same grace also.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi ẹnyin ti pọ̀ li ohun gbogbo, ni igbagbọ́, ati ọ̀rọ, ati ìmọ, ati ninu igbiyanjú gbogbo, ati ni ifẹ nyin si wa, ẹ kiyesi ki ẹnyin ki o pọ̀ ninu ẹbun ọfẹ yi pẹlu.
entries.en: Therefore, as ye abound in every thing, in faith, and utterance, and knowledge, and in all diligence, and in your love to us, see that ye abound in this grace also.

entries.yo: Kì iṣe nipa aṣẹ ni mo fi nsọ, ṣugbọn ki a le ri idi otitọ ifẹ nyin pẹlu, nipa igbiyanjú awọn ẹlomiran.
entries.en: I speak not by commandment, but by occasion of the forwardness of others, and to prove the sincerity of your love.

entries.yo: Nitori ẹnyin mọ̀ ore-ọfẹ Oluwa wa Jesu Kristi, pe bi on ti jẹ ọlọrọ̀ rí, ṣugbọn nitori nyin o di talaka, ki a le sọ nyin di ọlọrọ̀ nipa aini rẹ̀.
entries.en: For ye know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that, though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that ye through his poverty might be rich.

entries.yo: Ati ninu eyi ni mo fi imọran mi fun nyin: nitori eyi ṣanfani fun nyin, ẹnyin ti o kọ́ bẹrẹ niwọn ọdún ti o kọja, kì iṣe lati ṣe nikan, ṣugbọn lati fẹ́ pẹlu.
entries.en: And herein I give my advice: for this is expedient for you, who have begun before, not only to do, but also to be forward a year ago.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi ẹ pari ṣiṣe na pẹlu; bi imura-tẹlẹ ati ṣe ti wa, bẹni ki ipari si wa lati inu agbara nyin:
entries.en: Now therefore perform the doing of it; that as there was a readiness to will, so there may be a performance also out of that which ye have.

entries.yo: Nitori bi imura-tẹlẹ ba wà ṣaju, o jasi itẹwọgbà gẹgẹ bi ohun ti enia bá ni, kì iṣe gẹgẹ bi ohun ti kò ni.
entries.en: For if there be first a willing mind, it is accepted according to that a man hath, and not according to that he hath not.

entries.yo: Nitori emi kò fẹ ki awọn ẹlomiran wà ni irọrun, ki o si jẹ ipọnju fun nyin,
entries.en: For I mean not that other men be eased, and ye burdened:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nipa idọgba, pe ki ọpọlọpọ ini nyin li akoko yi le ṣe ẹkún aini wọn, ki ọ̀pọlọpọ ini wọn pẹlu le ṣe ẹkún aini nyin: ki idọgba ki o le wà:
entries.en: But by an equality, that now at this time your abundance may be a supply for their want, that their abundance also may be a supply for your want: that there may be equality:

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi a ti kọ ọ pe, Ẹniti o kó pọ̀ju, kò ni nkan le; ẹniti o si kó kere ju, kò ṣe alainito.
entries.en: As it is written, He that had gathered much had nothing over; and he that had gathered little had no lack.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ọpẹ́ ni fun Ọlọrun, ẹniti o fi itara aniyan kanna yi si ọkàn Titu fun nyin.
entries.en: But thanks be to God, which put the same earnest care into the heart of Titus for you.

entries.yo: Nitori on gbà ọ̀rọ iyanju nitõtọ; ṣugbọn bi o ti ni itara pipọ, on tikararẹ̀ tọ̀ nyin wá fun ara rẹ̀.
entries.en: For indeed he accepted the exhortation; but being more forward, of his own accord he went unto you.

entries.yo: Awa ti rán arakunrin na pẹlu rẹ̀, iyìn ẹniti o wà ninu ihinrere yiká gbogbo ijọ.
entries.en: And we have sent with him the brother, whose praise is in the gospel throughout all the churches;

entries.yo: Kì si iṣe bẹ̃ nikan, ṣugbọn ẹniti a ti yàn pẹlu lati ọdọ ijọ wá lati mã bá wa rìn kiri ninu ọran ore-ọfẹ yi, ti awa nṣe iranṣẹ rẹ̀ fun ogo Oluwa, ati imura-tẹlẹ wa.
entries.en: And not that only, but who was also chosen of the churches to travel with us with this grace, which is administered by us to the glory of the same Lord, and declaration of your ready mind:

entries.yo: Awa nyẹra fun eyi, ki ẹnikẹni má bã ri wi si wa nitori ọ̀pọ yi ti awa pin.
entries.en: Avoiding this, that no man should blame us in this abundance which is administered by us:

entries.yo: Awa ngbero ohun rere, kì iṣe niwaju Oluwa nikan, ṣugbọn niwaju enia pẹlu.
entries.en: Providing for honest things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.

entries.yo: Awa si ti rán arakunrin wa pẹlu wọn, ẹniti awa ri daju nigba pipọ pe o ni itara ninu ohun pipọ, ṣugbọn nisisiyi ni itara rẹ̀ tubọ pọ si i nipa igbẹkẹle nla ti o ni si nyin.
entries.en: And we have sent with them our brother, whom we have oftentimes proved diligent in many things, but now much more diligent, upon the great confidence which I have in you.

entries.yo: Bi ẹnikẹni ba mbère ẹniti Titu iṣe, ẹlẹgbẹ ati olubaṣiṣẹ mi ni nitori nyin: tabi awọn arakunrin wa li ẹnikẹni mbère ni, iranṣẹ ijọ ni nwọn iṣe, ati ogo Kristi.
entries.en: Whether any do inquire of Titus, he is my partner and fellowhelper concerning you: or our brethren be inquired of, they are the messengers of the churches, and the glory of Christ.

entries.yo: Nitorina ẹ fi ẹri ifẹ nyin hàn wọn niwaju ijọ, ati iṣogo wa nitori nyin.
entries.en: Wherefore shew ye to them, and before the churches, the proof of your love, and of our boasting on your behalf.

entries.yo: NITORI nipa ti ipinfunni fun awọn enia mimọ́, kò ni pe mo nkọwe si nyin ju bẹ̃ lọ.
entries.en: For as touching the ministering to the saints, it is superfluous for me to write to you:

entries.yo: Nitori mo mọ̀ imura-tẹlẹ nyin, eyiti mo fi yangàn fun awọn ara Makedonia nitori nyin, pe, Akaia ti mura tan niwọn ọdún kan ti o kọja; itara nyin si ti rú ọ̀pọlọpọ soke.
entries.en: For I know the forwardness of your mind, for which I boast of you to them of Macedonia, that Achaia was ready a year ago; and your zeal hath provoked very many.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn mo ti rán awọn arakunrin, ki iṣogo wa nitori nyin ki o máṣe jasi asan niti ọ̀ran yi; pe gẹgẹ bi mo ti wi, ki ẹnyin ki o le mura tẹlẹ:
entries.en: Yet have I sent the brethren, lest our boasting of you should be in vain in this behalf; that, as I said, ye may be ready:

entries.yo: Bi awọn ninu ará Makedonia ba bá mi wá, ti nwọn si bá nyin li aimura tẹlẹ, ki oju ki o máṣe tì wa (laiwipe ẹnyin,) niti igbẹkẹle yi.
entries.en: Lest haply if they of Macedonia come with me, and find you unprepared, we (that we say not, ye) should be ashamed in this same confident boasting.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni mo ṣe rò pe o yẹ lati gbà awọn arakunrin niyanju, ki nwọn ki o ṣaju tọ̀ nyin wá, ki nwọn ki o si mura ẹ̀bun nyin silẹ, ti ẹ ti ṣe ileri tẹlẹ ki a le ṣe eyi na silẹ, ki o le jasi bi ohun ẹ̀bun, ki o má si ṣe dabi ti ojukòkoro.
entries.en: Therefore I thought it necessary to exhort the brethren, that they would go before unto you, and make up beforehand your bounty, whereof ye had notice before, that the same might be ready, as a matter of bounty, and not as of covetousness.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn eyi ni mo wipe, Ẹniti o ba funrugbin kiun, kiun ni yio ká; ẹniti o ba si funrugbin, pupọ, pupọ ni yio ká.
entries.en: But this I say, He which soweth sparingly shall reap also sparingly; and he which soweth bountifully shall reap also bountifully.

entries.yo: Ki olululuku enia ki o ṣe gẹgẹ bi o ti pinnu li ọkàn rẹ̀; kì iṣe àfẹ̀kùnṣe, tabi ti alaigbọdọ má ṣe: nitori Ọlọrun fẹ oninudidun ọlọrẹ.
entries.en: Every man according as he purposeth in his heart, so let him give; not grudgingly, or of necessity: for God loveth a cheerful giver.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si le mu ki gbogbo ore-ọfẹ ma bisi i fun nyin; ki ẹnyin, ti o ni anito ohun gbogbo nigbagbogbo, le mã pọ̀ si i ni iṣẹ́ rere gbogbo:
entries.en: And God is able to make all grace abound toward you; that ye, always having all sufficiency in all things, may abound to every good work:

entries.yo: (Gẹgẹ bi a ti kọ ọ pe, O ti fọnka; o ti fifun awọn talakà: ododo rẹ̀ duro lailai.
entries.en: (As it is written, He hath dispersed abroad; he hath given to the poor: his righteousness remaineth for ever.

entries.yo: Njẹ ẹniti nfi irugbin fun afunrugbin, ati akara fun onjẹ, yio fi irugbin fun nyin, yio si sọ ọ di pipọ fun irugbin, yio si mu eso ododo nyin bi si i.)
entries.en: Now he that ministereth seed to the sower both minister bread for your food, and multiply your seed sown, and increase the fruits of your righteousness;)

entries.yo: Ẹnyin ti a ti sọ di ọlọrọ̀ ninu ohun gbogbo, fun ilawọ gbogbo ti nṣiṣẹ ọpẹ si Ọlọrun nipa wa.
entries.en: Being enriched in every thing to all bountifulness, which causeth through us thanksgiving to God.

entries.yo: Nitori iṣẹ-iranṣẹ ìsin yi kò fi kun iwọn aini awọn enia mimọ́ nikan, ṣugbọn o tubọ pọ si i nipa ọ̀pọlọpọ ọpẹ́ si Ọlọrun,
entries.en: For the administration of this service not only supplieth the want of the saints, but is abundant also by many thanksgivings unto God;

entries.yo: Lẹhin ti nwọn fi iṣẹ-isin yi dan nyin wo, nwọn yin Ọlọrun li ogo fun itẹriba ijẹwọ́ nyin si ihinrere Kristi, ati fun ilàwọ ìdawó nyin fun wọn ati fun gbogbo enia;
entries.en: Whiles by the experiment of this ministration they glorify God for your professed subjection unto the gospel of Christ, and for your liberal distribution unto them, and unto all men;

entries.yo: Nigbati awọn tikarawọn pẹlu ẹ̀bẹ nitori nyin nṣafẹri nyin nitori ọpọ ore-ọfẹ Ọlọrun ti mbẹ ninu nyin.
entries.en: And by their prayer for you, which long after you for the exceeding grace of God in you.

entries.yo: Ọpẹ́ ni fun Ọlọrun nitori alailesọ ẹ̀bun rẹ̀.
entries.en: Thanks be unto God for his unspeakable gift.

entries.yo: ṢUGBỌN emi Paulu tikarami fi inu tutù ati ìwa pẹlẹ Kristi bẹ̀ nyin, emi ẹni irẹlẹ loju nyin nigbati mo wà larin nyin, ṣugbọn nigbati emi kò si, mo di ẹni igboiya si nyin.
entries.en: Now I Paul myself beseech you by the meekness and gentleness of Christ, who in presence am base among you, but being absent am bold toward you:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi bẹ̀ nyin pe ki o máṣe nigbati mo wà larin nyin ni mo fi igboiya han pẹlu igbẹkẹle ti mo rò pe mo ni igboiya si awọn kan, ti nrò wa si bi ẹniti nrin nipa ti ara.
entries.en: But I beseech you, that I may not be bold when I am present with that confidence, wherewith I think to be bold against some, which think of us as if we walked according to the flesh.

entries.yo: Nitoripe bi awa tilẹ nrìn ni ti ara, ṣugbọn awa kò jagun nipa ti ara:
entries.en: For though we walk in the flesh, we do not war after the flesh:

entries.yo: (Nitori ohun ija wa kì iṣe ti ara, ṣugbọn o li agbara ninu Ọlọrun lati wó ibi giga palẹ;)
entries.en: (For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds;)

entries.yo: Awa nsọ gbogbo ero kalẹ, ati gbogbo ohun giga ti ngbé ara rẹ̀ ga si ìmọ Ọlọrun, awa si ndi gbogbo ero ni igbekun wá si itẹriba fun Kristi;
entries.en: Casting down imaginations, and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ;

entries.yo: Awa si ti mura tan lati gbẹsan gbogbo aigbọran, nigbati igbọran nyin ba pé.
entries.en: And having in a readiness to revenge all disobedience, when your obedience is fulfilled.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin si nwò nkan gẹgẹ bi nwọn ti fi ara hàn lode. Bi ẹnikẹni ba gbẹkẹle ara rẹ̀ pe, ti Kristi li on iṣe, ẹ jẹ ki on ki o si tún rò eyi ninu ara rẹ̀ pe, bi on ti jẹ́ ti Kristi, gẹgẹ bẹ̃li awa pẹlu si jẹ́ ti Kristi.
entries.en: Do ye look on things after the outward appearance? If any man trust to himself that he is Christ's, let him of himself think this again, that, as he is Christ's, even so are we Christ's.

entries.yo: Nitori bi mo tilẹ nṣogo aṣerekọja nitori aṣẹ wa, ti Oluwa ti fifun wa fun idagbasoke nyin ki iṣe fun ìbiṣubu nyin, oju ki yio tì mi;
entries.en: For though I should boast somewhat more of our authority, which the Lord hath given us for edification, and not for your destruction, I should not be ashamed:

entries.yo: Ki o máṣe dabi ẹnipe emi o fi iwe-kikọ dẹruba nyin.
entries.en: That I may not seem as if I would terrify you by letters.

entries.yo: Nitori nwọn wipe, iwe rẹ̀ wuwo, nwọn si lagbara; ṣugbọn ìrísi rẹ̀ jẹ alailera, ọ̀rọ rẹ̀ kò nilari.
entries.en: For his letters, say they, are weighty and powerful; but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech contemptible.

entries.yo: Ki irú enia bẹ̃ ki o ro bayi pe, irú ẹniti awa iṣe li ọ̀rọ nipa iwe-kikọ nigbati awa kò si, irú bẹ̃li awa o si jẹ ni iṣe pẹlu nigbati awa ba wà.
entries.en: Let such an one think this, that, such as we are in word by letters when we are absent, such will we be also in deed when we are present.

entries.yo: Nitoripe awa kò daṣa ati kà ara wa mọ́, tabi ati fi ara wa wé awọn miran ninu wọn ti ńyìn ara wọn; ṣugbọn awọn tikarawọn jẹ alailoye nigbati nwọn nfi ara wọn diwọn ara wọn, ti nwọn si nfi ara wọn wé ara wọn.
entries.en: For we dare not make ourselves of the number, or compare ourselves with some that commend themselves: but they measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves among themselves, are not wise.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awa kò ṣogo rekọja ãlà wa, ṣugbọn nipa ãlà ti Ọlọrun ti pín fun wa, ani ãlà kan lati de ọdọ nyin.
entries.en: But we will not boast of things without our measure, but according to the measure of the rule which God hath distributed to us, a measure to reach even unto you.

entries.yo: Nitori awa kò nawọ́ wa rekọja rara, bi ẹnipe awa kò de ọdọ nyin: nitori awa tilẹ de ọdọ nyin pẹlu ninu ihinrere Kristi.
entries.en: For we stretch not ourselves beyond our measure, as though we reached not unto you: for we are come as far as to you also in preaching the gospel of Christ:

entries.yo: Awa kò ṣogo rekọja ãlà wa, eyini ni lori iṣẹ ẹlomiran; ṣugbọn awa ni ireti pe, bi igbagbọ nyin ti ndagba si i, gẹgẹ bi àla wa awa o di gbigbega lọdọ nyin si i lọpọlọpọ,
entries.en: Not boasting of things without our measure, that is, of other men's labours; but having hope, when your faith is increased, that we shall be enlarged by you according to our rule abundantly,

entries.yo: Ki a ba le wasu ihinrere ani ni ẹkùn ti mbẹ niwaju nyin, ki a má si ṣogo ninu ãlà ẹlomiran nipa ohun ti o wà li arọwọto.
entries.en: To preach the gospel in the regions beyond you, and not to boast in another man's line of things made ready to our hand.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹniti o ba nṣogo, ki o mã ṣogo ninu Oluwa.
entries.en: But he that glorieth, let him glory in the Lord.

entries.yo: Nitoripe kì iṣe ẹniti nyìn ara rẹ̀ li o yanju, bikoṣe ẹniti Oluwa yìn.
entries.en: For not he that commendeth himself is approved, but whom the Lord commendeth.

entries.yo: ẸNYIN iba gbà mi diẹ ninu wère mi: ati nitotọ, ẹ gbà mi.
entries.en: Would to God ye could bear with me a little in my folly: and indeed bear with me.

entries.yo: Nitoripe emi njowú lori nyin niti owú ẹni ìwa-bi-Ọlọrun: nitoriti mo ti fi nyin fun ọkọ kan, ki emi ki o le mu nyin wá bi wundia ti o mọ́ sọdọ Kristi.
entries.en: For I am jealous over you with godly jealousy: for I have espoused you to one husband, that I may present you as a chaste virgin to Christ.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹru mba mi pe, li ohunkohun, gẹgẹ bi ejò ti tàn Efa jẹ nipasẹ arekereke rẹ̀, ki a maṣe mu ero-ọkàn nyin bajẹ kuro ninu inu kan ati iwa mimọ́ nyin si Kristi.
entries.en: But I fear, lest by any means, as the serpent beguiled Eve through his subtilty, so your minds should be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.

entries.yo: Nitori bi ẹniti mbọ̀ wá ba nwãsu Jesu miran, ti awa kò ti wasu rí, tabi bi ẹnyin ba gbà ẹmí miran, ti ẹnyin kò ti gbà ri, tabi ihinrere miran, ti ẹnyin kò ti tẹwọgbà, ẹnyin iba ṣe rere lati fi ara da a.
entries.en: For if he that cometh preacheth another Jesus, whom we have not preached, or if ye receive another spirit, which ye have not received, or another gospel, which ye have not accepted, ye might well bear with him.

entries.yo: Nitori mo ṣiro rẹ pe emi kò rẹ̀hin li ohunkohun si awọn Aposteli gigagiga na.
entries.en: For I suppose I was not a whit behind the very chiefest apostles.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi mo tilẹ jẹ òpe li ọ̀rọ, ki iṣe ni ìmọ; ṣugbọn awa ti fihan dajudaju fun nyin lãrin gbogbo enia.
entries.en: But though I be rude in speech, yet not in knowledge; but we have been throughly made manifest among you in all things.

entries.yo: Tabi ẹ̀ṣẹ ni mo dá ti emi nrẹ̀ ara mi silẹ ki a le gbé nyin ga, nitoriti mo ti wasu ihinrere Ọlọrun fun nyin lọfẹ?
entries.en: Have I committed an offence in abasing myself that ye might be exalted, because I have preached to you the gospel of God freely?

entries.yo: Emi ja ijọ miran li ole, mo ngbà owo ki emi ki o le sìn nyin.
entries.en: I robbed other churches, taking wages of them, to do you service.

entries.yo: Nigbati mo si wà pẹlu nyin, ti mo si ṣe alaini, emi kò jẹ́ ẹrù fun ẹnikẹni: nitoriti ohun ti mo ṣe alaini awọn ara ti o ti Makedonia wá fi kún u; ati ninu ohun gbogbo mo ti pa ara mi mọ́ ki emi maṣe jẹ ẹrù fun nyin, bẹ̃li emi ó si mã pa ara mi mọ́.
entries.en: And when I was present with you, and wanted, I was chargeable to no man: for that which was lacking to me the brethren which came from Macedonia supplied: and in all things I have kept myself from being burdensome unto you, and so will I keep myself.

entries.yo: Bi otitọ Kristi ti mbẹ ninu mi, kò sí ẹniti o le da mi lẹkun iṣogo yi ni gbogbo ẹkùn Akaia.
entries.en: As the truth of Christ is in me, no man shall stop me of this boasting in the regions of Achaia.

entries.yo: Nitori kini? nitori emi kò fẹran nyin ni bi? Ọlọrun mọ̀.
entries.en: Wherefore? because I love you not? God knoweth.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ohun ti mo nṣe li emi ó si mã ṣe, ki emi ki o le mu igberaga kuro lọwọ awọn ti gberaga pe ninu ohun ti nwọn nṣogo, ki a le ri wọn gẹgẹ bi awa.
entries.en: But what I do, that I will do, that I may cut off occasion from them which desire occasion; that wherein they glory, they may be found even as we.

entries.yo: Nitori irú awọn enia bẹ̃ li awọn eke Aposteli, awọn ẹniti nṣiṣẹ ẹ̀tan, ti npa ara wọn dà di Aposteli Kristi.
entries.en: For such are false apostles, deceitful workers, transforming themselves into the apostles of Christ.

entries.yo: Kì si iṣe ohun iyanu; nitori Satani tikararẹ̀ npa ara rẹ̀ dà di angẹli imọlẹ.
entries.en: And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.

entries.yo: Nitorina kì iṣe ohun nla bi awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀ pẹlu ba pa ara wọn dà bi awọn iranṣẹ ododo; igbẹhin awọn ẹniti yio ri gẹgẹ bi iṣẹ wọn.
entries.en: Therefore it is no great thing if his ministers also be transformed as the ministers of righteousness; whose end shall be according to their works.

entries.yo: Mo si tún wipe, Ki ẹnikẹni ki o máṣe rò pe aṣiwère ni mi; ṣugbọn bi bẹ̃ ba ni, ẹ gbà mi bi aṣiwere, ki emi ki o le gbé ara mi ga diẹ.
entries.en: I say again, Let no man think me a fool; if otherwise, yet as a fool receive me, that I may boast myself a little.

entries.yo: Ohun ti emi nsọ, emi kò sọ ọ nipa ti Oluwa, ṣugbọn bi aṣiwèrè ninu igbẹkẹle iṣogo yi.
entries.en: That which I speak, I speak it not after the Lord, but as it were foolishly, in this confidence of boasting.

entries.yo: Ọpọlọpọ li o sa nṣogo nipa ti ara, emi ó ṣogo pẹlu.
entries.en: Seeing that many glory after the flesh, I will glory also.

entries.yo: Nitori ẹnyin fi inu didùn gbà awọn aṣiwère, nigbati ẹnyin tikaranyin jẹ ọlọ́gbọn.
entries.en: For ye suffer fools gladly, seeing ye yourselves are wise.

entries.yo: Nitori ẹnyin farada a bi ẹnikan ba sọ nyin di ondè, bi ẹnikan ba jẹ nyin run, bi ẹnikan ba gbà lọwọ nyin, bi ẹnikan ba gbé ara rẹ̀ ga, bi ẹnikan ba gbá nyin loju.
entries.en: For ye suffer, if a man bring you into bondage, if a man devour you, if a man take of you, if a man exalt himself, if a man smite you on the face.

entries.yo: Emi nwi lọna ẹ̀gan, bi ẹnipe awa jẹ alailera. Ṣugbọn ninu ohunkohun ti ẹnikan ni igboiya (emi nsọrọ were), emi ni igboiya pẹlu.
entries.en: I speak as concerning reproach, as though we had been weak. Howbeit whereinsoever any is bold, (I speak foolishly,) I am bold also.

entries.yo: Heberu ni nwọn bi? bẹ̃li emi. Israeli ni nwọn bi? bẹ̃li emi. Irú ọmọ Abrahamu ni nwọn bi? bẹ̃li emi.
entries.en: Are they Hebrews? so am I. Are they Israelites? so am I. Are they the seed of Abraham? so am I.

entries.yo: Iranṣẹ Kristi ni nwọn bi? (emi nsọ bi aṣiwère) mo ta wọn yọ; niti lãlã lọpọlọpọ, niti paṣan mo rekọja, niti tubu nigbakugba, niti ikú nigbapupọ.
entries.en: Are they ministers of Christ? (I speak as a fool) I am more; in labours more abundant, in stripes above measure, in prisons more frequent, in deaths oft.

entries.yo: Nigba marun ni mo gbà paṣan ogoji dín kan lọwọ awọn Ju.
entries.en: Of the Jews five times received I forty stripes save one.

entries.yo: Nigba mẹta li a fi ọgọ lù mi, ẹkanṣoṣo li a sọ mi li okuta, ẹ̃mẹta li ọkọ̀ rì mi, ọsán kan ati oru kan ni mo wà ninu ibú.
entries.en: Thrice was I beaten with rods, once was I stoned, thrice I suffered shipwreck, a night and a day I have been in the deep;

entries.yo: Ni ìrin àjò nigbakugba, ninu ewu omi, ninu ewu awọn ọlọṣa, ninu ewu awọn ara ilu mi, ninu ewu awọn keferi, ninu ewu ni ilu, ninu ewu li aginjù, ninu ewu loju okun, ninu ewu larin awọn eke arakunrin;
entries.en: In journeyings often, in perils of waters, in perils of robbers, in perils by mine own countrymen, in perils by the heathen, in perils in the city, in perils in the wilderness, in perils in the sea, in perils among false brethren;

entries.yo: Ninu lãlã ati irora, ninu iṣọra nigbakugba, ninu ebi ati orùngbẹ, ninu àwẹ nigbakugba, ninu otutù ati ìhoho.
entries.en: In weariness and painfulness, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, in cold and nakedness.

entries.yo: Pẹlu nkan wọnni ti o wà lode, eyi ti nwọjọ tì mi li ojojumọ́, emi ko yé ṣe aniyan gbogbo ijọ.
entries.en: Beside those things that are without, that which cometh upon me daily, the care of all the churches.

entries.yo: Tani iṣe alailera, ti emi kò ṣe alailera? tabi tali a mu kọsẹ̀, ti ara mi kò gbina?
entries.en: Who is weak, and I am not weak? who is offended, and I burn not?

entries.yo: Bi emi kò le ṣaima ṣogo, emi o kuku mã ṣogo nipa awọn nkan ti iṣe ti ailera mi.
entries.en: If I must needs glory, I will glory of the things which concern mine infirmities.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun ati Baba Oluwa wa Jesu Kristi, ẹniti iṣe olubukún julọ lailai, mọ̀ pe emi kò ṣeke.
entries.en: The God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which is blessed for evermore, knoweth that I lie not.

entries.yo: Ni Damasku, bãlẹ ti o wà labẹ ọba Areta fi ẹgbẹ ogun ká ilu awọn ara Damasku mọ́, o nfẹ mi lati mu:
entries.en: In Damascus the governor under Aretas the king kept the city of the Damascenes with a garrison, desirous to apprehend me:

entries.yo: Ati loju ferese ninu agbọ̀n li a si ti sọ̀ mi kalẹ lẹhin odi, ti mo si bọ́ lọwọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And through a window in a basket was I let down by the wall, and escaped his hands.

entries.yo: EMI ko le ṣe aiṣogo bi kò tilẹ ṣe anfani. Nitori emi ó wá si iran ati iṣipaya Oluwa.
entries.en: It is not expedient for me doubtless to glory. I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.

entries.yo: Emi mọ̀ ọkunrin kan ninu Kristi ni ọdún mẹrinla sẹhin, (yala ninu ara ni, emi kò mọ̀; tabi lati ara kuro ni, emi kò mọ̀; Ọlọrun ni o mọ): a gbé irú enia bẹ̃ lọ si ọ̀run kẹta.
entries.en: I knew a man in Christ above fourteen years ago, (whether in the body, I cannot tell; or whether out of the body, I cannot tell: God knoweth;) such an one caught up to the third heaven.

entries.yo: Emi si ti mọ̀ irú ọkunrin bẹ̃, (yala li ara ni, tabi lati ara kuro ni, emi kò mọ̀: Ọlọrun mọ̀)
entries.en: And I knew such a man, (whether in the body, or out of the body, I cannot tell: God knoweth;)
