entries.yo: Bi a ti gbé e lọ soke si Paradise, ti o si gbọ́ ọ̀rọ ti a kò le sọ, ti kò tọ́ fun enia lati mã sọ.
entries.en: How that he was caught up into paradise, and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.

entries.yo: Nipa irú ẹni bẹ̃ li emi ó ma ṣogo: ṣugbọn nipa ti emi tikarami emi kì yio ṣogo, bikoṣe ninu ailera mi.
entries.en: Of such an one will I glory: yet of myself I will not glory, but in mine infirmities.

entries.yo: Nitoripe bi emi tilẹ nfẹ mã ṣogo, emi kì yio jẹ aṣiwère; nitoripe emi ó sọ otitọ: ṣugbọn mo kọ̀, ki ẹnikẹni ki o má bã fi mi pè jù ohun ti o ri ti emi jẹ lọ, tabi ju eyiti o gbọ lẹnu mi.
entries.en: For though I would desire to glory, I shall not be a fool; for I will say the truth: but now I forbear, lest any man should think of me above that which he seeth me to be, or that he heareth of me.

entries.yo: Ati nitori ọ̀pọlọpọ iṣipaya, ki emi ki o má ba gbé ara mi ga rekọja, a si ti fi ẹgún kan si mi lara, iranṣẹ Satani, lati pọn mi loju, ki emi ki o má ba gberaga rekọja.
entries.en: And lest I should be exalted above measure through the abundance of the revelations, there was given to me a thorn in the flesh, the messenger of Satan to buffet me, lest I should be exalted above measure.

entries.yo: Nitori nkan yi ni mo ṣe bẹ̀ Oluwa nigba mẹta pe, ki o le kuro lara mi.
entries.en: For this thing I besought the Lord thrice, that it might depart from me.

entries.yo: On si wi fun mi pe, Ore-ọfẹ mi to fun ọ: nitoripe a sọ agbara mi di pipé ninu ailera. Nitorina tayọ̀tayọ̀ li emi ó kuku ma ṣogo ninu ailera mi, ki agbara Kristi ki o le mã gbe inu mi.
entries.en: And he said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.

entries.yo: Nitorina emi ni inu didùn ninu ailera gbogbo, ninu ẹ̀gan gbogbo, ninu aini gbogbo, ninu inunibini gbogbo, ninu wahalà gbogbo nitori Kristi: nitori nigbati mo ba jẹ alailera, nigbana ni mo di alagbara.
entries.en: Therefore I take pleasure in infirmities, in reproaches, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses for Christ's sake: for when I am weak, then am I strong.

entries.yo: Mo di wère nipa ṣiṣogo; ẹnyin li o mu mi ṣe e: nitoriti o tọ́ ti ẹ ba yìn mi: nitoriti emi kò rẹ̀hin li ohunkohun si awọn Aposteli gigagiga na, bi emi kò tilẹ jamọ nkankan.
entries.en: I am become a fool in glorying; ye have compelled me: for I ought to have been commended of you: for in nothing am I behind the very chiefest apostles, though I be nothing.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ a ti ṣe iṣẹ àmi Aposteli larin nyin ninu sũru gbogbo, ninu iṣẹ àmi, ati iṣẹ iyanu, ati iṣẹ agbara.
entries.en: Truly the signs of an apostle were wrought among you in all patience, in signs, and wonders, and mighty deeds.

entries.yo: Nitori ninu kili ohun ti ẹnyin rẹ̀hin si ijọ miran, bikoṣe niti pe emi tikarami ko jẹ oniyọnu fun nyin? ẹ dari aṣiṣe yi ji mi.
entries.en: For what is it wherein ye were inferior to other churches, except it be that I myself was not burdensome to you? forgive me this wrong.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, igba kẹta yi ni mo mura tan lati tọ̀ nyin wá; emi kì yio si jẹ oniyọnu fun nyin: nitoriti emi kò wá nkan nyin, bikoṣe ẹnyin tikaranyin: nitoriti kò tọ́ fun awọn ọmọ lati mã tò iṣura jọ fun awọn õbi wọn, bikoṣe awọn õbi fun awọn ọmọ wọn.
entries.en: Behold, the third time I am ready to come to you; and I will not be burdensome to you: for I seek not yours, but you: for the children ought not to lay up for the parents, but the parents for the children.

entries.yo: Emi ó si fi ayọ̀ náwo, emi ó si ná ara mi fun ọkàn nyin nitõtọ; bi mo tilẹ fẹ nyin lọpọlọpọ, diẹ li a ha fẹran mi?
entries.en: And I will very gladly spend and be spent for you; though the more abundantly I love you, the less I be loved.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn o dara bẹ̃, ti emi kò dẹruba nyin: ṣugbọn bi ọlọgbọn, emi nfi ẹ̀rọ mu nyin.
entries.en: But be it so, I did not burden you: nevertheless, being crafty, I caught you with guile.

entries.yo: Emi ha rẹ́ nyin jẹ nipa ẹnikẹni ninu awọn ti mo rán si nyin bi?
entries.en: Did I make a gain of you by any of them whom I sent unto you?

entries.yo: Mo bẹ̀ Titu, mo si rán arakunrin kan pẹlu rẹ̀; Titu ha rẹ́ nyin jẹ bi? nipa ẹmí kanna kọ́ awa rìn bi? ọ̀na kanna kọ́ awa tọ̀ bi?
entries.en: I desired Titus, and with him I sent a brother. Did Titus make a gain of you? walked we not in the same spirit? walked we not in the same steps?

entries.yo: Ẹnyin ha rò pe ni gbogbo akoko yi àwa nṣe àwíjàre niwaju nyin? awa nsọ̀rọ niwaju Ọlọrun ninu Kristi: ṣugbọn awa nṣe ohun gbogbo, olufẹ ọwọn, lati mu nyin duro.
entries.en: Again, think ye that we excuse ourselves unto you? we speak before God in Christ: but we do all things, dearly beloved, for your edifying.

entries.yo: Nitori ẹru mba mi pe, nigbati mo ba de, emi kì yio bá nyin gẹgẹ bi irú eyi ti mo fẹ, ati pe ẹnyin ó si ri mi gẹgẹ bi irú eyi ti ẹnyin kò fẹ: ki ija, owu-jijẹ, ibinu, ipinya, isọrọ-ẹni-lẹhin, ijirọsọ, igberaga, irukerudo, ki o má ba wà:
entries.en: For I fear, lest, when I come, I shall not find you such as I would, and that I shall be found unto you such as ye would not: lest there be debates, envyings, wraths, strifes, backbitings, whisperings, swellings, tumults:

entries.yo: Ati nigbati mo ba si pada de, ki Ọlọrun mi má ba rẹ̀ mi silẹ loju nyin, ati ki emi ki o má bã sọkun nitori ọpọlọpọ awọn ti o ti ṣẹ̀ na, ti nwọn kò si ronupiwada ẹ̀ṣẹ ìwa-ẽri, ati ti àgbere, ati ti wọ̀bia ti nwọn ti dá.
entries.en: And lest, when I come again, my God will humble me among you, and that I shall bewail many which have sinned already, and have not repented of the uncleanness and fornication and lasciviousness which they have committed.

entries.yo: EYI li o di igba kẹta ti emi ntọ̀ nyin wá. Li ẹnu ẹlẹri meji tabi mẹta li a o fi idi ọ̀rọ gbogbo mulẹ.
entries.en: This is the third time I am coming to you. In the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.

entries.yo: Mo ti sọ fun nyin ṣaju, mo si nsọ fun nyin tẹlẹ, bi ẹnipe mo wà pẹlu nyin nigba keji, ati bi emi kò ti si lọdọ nyin nisisiyi, mo kọwe si awọn ti o ti ṣẹ̀ na, ati si gbogbo awọn ẹlomiran, pe bi mo ba tún pada wá, emi kì yio da wọn si:
entries.en: I told you before, and foretell you, as if I were present, the second time; and being absent now I write to them which heretofore have sinned, and to all other, that, if I come again, I will not spare:

entries.yo: Niwọnbi ẹnyin ti nwá àmi Kristi ti nsọ̀rọ ninu mi, ẹniti ki iṣe ailera si nyin, ṣugbọn ti o jẹ agbara ninu nyin.
entries.en: Since ye seek a proof of Christ speaking in me, which to you-ward is not weak, but is mighty in you.

entries.yo: Nitoripe a kàn a mọ agbelebu nipa ailera, ṣugbọn on wà lãye nipa agbara Ọlọrun. Nitori awa pẹlu jasi alailera ninu rẹ̀, ṣugbọn awa ó wà lãye pẹlu rẹ̀ nipa agbara Ọlọrun si nyin.
entries.en: For though he was crucified through weakness, yet he liveth by the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we shall live with him by the power of God toward you.

entries.yo: Ẹ mã wadi ara nyin, bi ẹnyin bá wà ninu igbagbọ́; ẹ mã dan ara nyin wò. Tabi ẹnyin tikaranyin kò mọ̀ ara nyin pe Jesu Kristi wà ninu nyin? afi bi ẹnyin ba jẹ awọn ti a tanù.
entries.en: Examine yourselves, whether ye be in the faith; prove your own selves. Know ye not your own selves, how that Jesus Christ is in you, except ye be reprobates?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn mo ni igbẹkẹle pe ẹnyin ó mọ̀ pe, awa kì iṣe awọn ti a tanù.
entries.en: But I trust that ye shall know that we are not reprobates.

entries.yo: Njẹ awa ngbadura si Ọlọrun, ki ẹnyin ki o máṣe ibikibi kan; kì iṣe nitori ki awa ki o le fi ara hàn bi awọn ti a mọ̀ daju, ṣugbọn ki ẹnyin ki o le mã ṣe eyi ti o dara, bi awa tilẹ dabi awọn ti a tanù.
entries.en: Now I pray to God that ye do no evil; not that we should appear approved, but that ye should do that which is honest, though we be as reprobates.

entries.yo: Nitori awa kò le ṣe ohun kan lodi si otitọ, bikoṣe fun otitọ.
entries.en: For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.

entries.yo: Nitori awa nyọ̀, nigbati awa jẹ alailera, ti ẹnyin si jẹ alagbara: eyi li awa si ngbadura fun pẹlu, ani pipe nyin.
entries.en: For we are glad, when we are weak, and ye are strong: and this also we wish, even your perfection.

entries.yo: Nitori idi eyi, nigbati emi kò si, mo kọwe nkan wọnyi pe, nigbati mo ba de, ki emi ki o má bã lò ikannú, gẹgẹ bi aṣẹ ti Oluwa ti fifun mi fun idagbasoke, kì si iṣe fun iparun.
entries.en: Therefore I write these things being absent, lest being present I should use sharpness, according to the power which the Lord hath given me to edification, and not to destruction.

entries.yo: Li akotan, ará, odigboṣe. Ẹ jẹ pipé, ẹ tújuka, ẹ jẹ oninu kan, ẹ mã wà li alafia; Ọlọrun ifẹ ati ti alafia yio wà pẹlu nyin.
entries.en: Finally, brethren, farewell. Be perfect, be of good comfort, be of one mind, live in peace; and the God of love and peace shall be with you.

entries.yo: Ẹ fi ifẹnukonu mimọ́ kí ara nyin.
entries.en: Greet one another with an holy kiss.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn enia mimọ́ kí nyin.
entries.en: All the saints salute you.

entries.yo: Ore-ọfẹ Jesu Kristi Oluwa, ati ifẹ Ọlọrun, ati ìdapọ ti Ẹmí Mimọ́, ki o wà pẹlu gbogbo nyin. Amin.
entries.en: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the communion of the Holy Ghost, be with you all. Amen.

entries.yo: PAULU, Aposteli (ki iṣe lati ọdọ enia wá, tabi nipa enia, ṣugbọn nipa Jesu Kristi, ati Ọlọrun Baba, ẹniti o jí i dide kuro ninu okú),
entries.en: Paul, an apostle, (not of men, neither by man, but by Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead;)

entries.yo: Ati gbogbo awọn arakunrin ti o wà pẹlu mi, si awọn ijọ Galatia:
entries.en: And all the brethren which are with me, unto the churches of Galatia:

entries.yo: Ore-ọfẹ si nyin ati alafia lati ọdọ Ọlọrun Baba wá, ati Jesu Kristi Oluwa wa,
entries.en: Grace be to you and peace from God the Father, and from our Lord Jesus Christ,

entries.yo: Ẹniti o fi on tikalarẹ̀ fun ẹ̀ṣẹ wa, ki o le gbà wa kuro ninu aiye buburu isisiyi, gẹgẹ bi ifẹ Ọlọrun ati Baba wa:
entries.en: Who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us from this present evil world, according to the will of God and our Father:

entries.yo: Ẹniti ogo wà fun lai ati lailai. Amin.
entries.en: To whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

entries.yo: Ẹnu yà mi nitoriti ẹ tete kuro lọdọ ẹniti o pè nyin sinu ore-ọfẹ Kristi, si ihinrere miran:
entries.en: I marvel that ye are so soon removed from him that called you into the grace of Christ unto another gospel:

entries.yo: Eyiti kì iṣe omiran; bi o tilẹ ṣe pe awọn kan wà ti nyọ nyin lẹnu, ti nwọn si nfẹ yi ihinrere Kristi pada.
entries.en: Which is not another; but there be some that trouble you, and would pervert the gospel of Christ.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi o ṣe awa ni, tabi angẹli kan lati ọrun wá, li o ba wasu ihinrere miran fun nyin ju eyiti a ti wasu fun nyin lọ, jẹ ki o di ẹni ifibu.
entries.en: But though we, or an angel from heaven, preach any other gospel unto you than that which we have preached unto you, let him be accursed.

entries.yo: Bi awa ti wi ṣaju, bẹ̃ni mo si tún wi nisisiyi pe, Bi ẹnikan ba wasu ihinrere miran fun nyin jù eyiti ẹnyin ti gbà lọ, jẹ ki o di ẹni ifibu.
entries.en: As we said before, so say I now again, If any man preach any other gospel unto you than that ye have received, let him be accursed.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi enia ni emi nyi lọkàn pada tabi Ọlọrun? tabi enia ni emi nfẹ lati wù? nitoripe bi emi ba si nwù enia, emi kì yio le ṣe iranṣẹ Kristi.
entries.en: For do I now persuade men, or God? or do I seek to please men? for if I yet pleased men, I should not be the servant of Christ.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn, ará, mo fẹ ki ẹ mọ̀ pe ihinrere ti mo ti wasu kì iṣe nipa ti enia.
entries.en: But I certify you, brethren, that the gospel which was preached of me is not after man.

entries.yo: Nitori kì iṣe lọwọ enia ni mo ti gbà a, bẹ̃li a kò fi kọ́ mi, ṣugbọn nipa ifihan Jesu Kristi.
entries.en: For I neither received it of man, neither was I taught it, but by the revelation of Jesus Christ.

entries.yo: Nitori ẹnyin ti gburó ìwa-aiye mi nigba atijọ ninu ìsin awọn Ju, bi mo ti ṣe inunibini si ijọ enia Ọlọrun rekọja ãlà, ti mo si bà a jẹ:
entries.en: For ye have heard of my conversation in time past in the Jews' religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the church of God, and wasted it:

entries.yo: Mo si ta ọpọlọpọ awọn ẹlẹgbẹ́ mi yọ ninu isin awọn Ju larin awọn ara ilu mi, mo si ni itara lọpọlọpọ si ofin atọwọdọwọ awọn baba mi.
entries.en: And profited in the Jews' religion above many my equals in mine own nation, being more exceedingly zealous of the traditions of my fathers.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati o wù Ọlọrun, ẹniti o yà mi sọtọ lati inu iya mi wá, ti o si pè mi nipa ore-ọfẹ rẹ̀,
entries.en: But when it pleased God, who separated me from my mother's womb, and called me by his grace,

entries.yo: Lati fi Ọmọ rẹ̀ hàn ninu mi, ki emi le mã wasu rẹ̀ larin awọn Keferi; lojukanna emi kò bá ara ati ẹ̀jẹ gbìmọ pọ̀:
entries.en: To reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the heathen; immediately I conferred not with flesh and blood:

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni emi kò gòke lọ si Jerusalemu tọ̀ awọn ti iṣe Aposteli ṣaju mi; ṣugbọn mo lọ si Arabia, mo si tún pada wá si Damasku.
entries.en: Neither went I up to Jerusalem to them which were apostles before me; but I went into Arabia, and returned again unto Damascus.

entries.yo: Lẹhin ọdún mẹta, nigbana ni mo gòke lọ si Jerusalemu lati lọ kí Peteru, mo si gbé ọdọ rẹ̀ ni ijọ mẹdogun.
entries.en: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to see Peter, and abode with him fifteen days.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi kò ri ẹlomiran ninu awọn Aposteli miran, bikoṣe Jakọbu arakunrin Oluwa.
entries.en: But other of the apostles saw I none, save James the Lord's brother.

entries.yo: Nkan ti emi nkọ̀we si nyin yi, kiyesi i, niwaju Ọlọrun emi kò ṣeke.
entries.en: Now the things which I write unto you, behold, before God, I lie not.

entries.yo: Lẹhin na mo si wá si ẹkùn Siria ati ti Kilikia;
entries.en: Afterwards I came into the regions of Syria and Cilicia;

entries.yo: Mo sì jẹ ẹniti a kò mọ̀ li oju fun awọn ijọ ti o wà ninu Kristi ni Judea:
entries.en: And was unknown by face unto the churches of Judaea which were in Christ:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn kìki nwọn ti gbọ́ pe, Ẹniti o ti nṣe inunibini si wa rí, si nwasu igbagbọ́ na nisisiyi, ti o ti mbajẹ nigbakan rí.
entries.en: But they had heard only, That he which persecuted us in times past now preacheth the faith which once he destroyed.

entries.yo: Nwọn si nyin Ọlọrun logo nitori mi.
entries.en: And they glorified God in me.

entries.yo: LẸHIN ọdún mẹrinla, nigbana ni mo tún gòke lọ si Jerusalemu pẹlu Barnaba, mo si mu Titu lọ pẹlu mi.
entries.en: Then fourteen years after I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, and took Titus with me also.

entries.yo: Mo si gòke lọ nipa ifihan, mo si gbe ihinrere na kalẹ niwaju wọn ti mo nwasu larin awọn Keferi, ṣugbọn nikọ̀kọ fun awọn ti o jẹ ẹni-nla, ki emi kì o má ba sáre, tabi ki o má ba jẹ pe mo ti sáre lasan.
entries.en: And I went up by revelation, and communicated unto them that gospel which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately to them which were of reputation, lest by any means I should run, or had run, in vain.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn a kò fi agbara mu Titu ti o wà pẹlu mi, ẹniti iṣe ara Hellene, lati kọla:
entries.en: But neither Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised:

entries.yo: Ati nitori awọn eke arakunrin ti a yọ́ mu wọ̀ inu wa wá, awọn ẹniti o yọ́ wa iṣe amí lati ri omnira wa, ti awa ni ninu Kristi Jesu, ki nwọn ki o le mu wa wá sinu ìde:
entries.en: And that because of false brethren unawares brought in, who came in privily to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage:

entries.yo: Awọn ẹniti awa kò si fi àye fun lati dari wa fun wakati kan; ki otitọ ìhinrere ki o le mã wà titi pẹlu nyin.
entries.en: To whom we gave place by subjection, no, not for an hour; that the truth of the gospel might continue with you.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn niti awọn ti o dabi ẹni nla, ohunkohun ti o wù ki nwọn jasi, kò jẹ nkankan fun mi: Ọlọrun kò ṣe ojuṣãju ẹnikẹni: ani awọn ti o dabi ẹni-nla, kò kọ́ mi ni nkankan.
entries.en: But of these who seemed to be somewhat, (whatsoever they were, it maketh no matter to me: God accepteth no man's person:) for they who seemed to be somewhat in conference added nothing to me:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn kàkà bẹ̃, nigbati nwọn ri pe a ti fi ihinrere ti awọn alaikọla le mi lọwọ, bi a ti fi ihinrere ti awọn onila le Peteru lọwọ;
entries.en: But contrariwise, when they saw that the gospel of the uncircumcision was committed unto me, as the gospel of the circumcision was unto Peter;

entries.yo: (Nitori ẹniti o ṣiṣẹ ninu Peteru si iṣẹ Aposteli ti ikọla, on kanna li o ṣiṣẹ ninu mi fun awọn Keferi pẹlu),
entries.en: (For he that wrought effectually in Peter to the apostleship of the circumcision, the same was mighty in me toward the Gentiles:)

entries.yo: Ati nigbati Jakọbu, ati Kefa, ati Johanu, awọn ẹniti o dabi ọwọ̀n, woye ore-ọfẹ ti a fifun mi, nwọn si fi ọwọ́ ọtún ìdapọ fun emi ati Barnaba, pe ki awa ki o mã lọ sọdọ awọn Keferi, ati awọn sọdọ awọn onila.
entries.en: And when James, Cephas, and John, who seemed to be pillars, perceived the grace that was given unto me, they gave to me and Barnabas the right hands of fellowship; that we should go unto the heathen, and they unto the circumcision.

entries.yo: Kìki nwọn fẹ ki a mã ranti awọn talakà, ohun kanna gan ti mo nfi titaratitara ṣe pẹlu.
entries.en: Only they would that we should remember the poor; the same which I also was forward to do.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati Peteru wá si Antioku, mo ta kò o li oju ara rẹ̀, nitoriti o jẹ ẹniti a ba bawi.
entries.en: But when Peter was come to Antioch, I withstood him to the face, because he was to be blamed.

entries.yo: Nitoripe ki awọn kan ti o ti ọdọ Jakọbu wá to de, o ti mba awọn Keferi jẹun: ṣugbọn nigbati nwọn de, o fà sẹhin, o si yà ara rẹ̀ si apakan, o mbẹ̀ru awọn ti iṣe onila.
entries.en: For before that certain came from James, he did eat with the Gentiles: but when they were come, he withdrew and separated himself, fearing them which were of the circumcision.

entries.yo: Awọn Ju ti o kù si jùmọ ṣe agabagebe bẹ̃ gẹgẹ pẹlu rẹ̀; tobẹ̃ ti nwọn si fi agabagebe wọn fà Barnaba tikararẹ lọ.
entries.en: And the other Jews dissembled likewise with him; insomuch that Barnabas also was carried away with their dissimulation.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati mo ri pe nwọn kò rìn dẽdẽ gẹgẹ bi otitọ ihinrere, mo wi fun Peteru niwaju gbogbo wọn pe, Bi iwọ, ti iṣe Ju, ba nrìn gẹgẹ bi ìwa awọn Keferi, laiṣe bi awọn Ju, ẽṣe ti iwọ fi nfi agbara mu awọn Keferi lati mã rìn bi awọn Ju?
entries.en: But when I saw that they walked not uprightly according to the truth of the gospel, I said unto Peter before them all, If thou, being a Jew, livest after the manner of Gentiles, and not as do the Jews, why compellest thou the Gentiles to live as do the Jews?

entries.yo: Awa ti iṣe Ju nipa ẹda, ti kì si iṣe ẹlẹṣẹ ti awọn Keferi,
entries.en: We who are Jews by nature, and not sinners of the Gentiles,

entries.yo: Ti a mọ̀ pe a ko da ẹnikẹni lare nipa iṣẹ ofin, bikoṣe nipa igbagbọ́ ninu Jesu Kristi, ani awa na gbà Jesu Kristi gbọ́, ki a ba le da wa lare nipa igbagbọ́ ti Kristi, kì si iṣe nipa iṣẹ ofin: nitoripe nipa iṣẹ ofin kò si enia kan ti a o dalare.
entries.en: Knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law, but by the faith of Jesus Christ, even we have believed in Jesus Christ, that we might be justified by the faith of Christ, and not by the works of the law: for by the works of the law shall no flesh be justified.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati awa ba nwá ọ̀na lati ri idalare nipa Kristi, bi a ba si ri awa tikarawa li ẹlẹṣẹ, njẹ́ Kristi ha nṣe iranṣẹ ẹ̀ṣẹ bi? Ki a má ri.
entries.en: But if, while we seek to be justified by Christ, we ourselves also are found sinners, is therefore Christ the minister of sin? God forbid.

entries.yo: Nitoripe bi mo ba si tun gbe ohun wọnni ti mo ti wó palẹ ró, mo fi ara mi han bi arufin.
entries.en: For if I build again the things which I destroyed, I make myself a transgressor.

entries.yo: Nitoripe nipa ofin mo ti di oku si ofin, ki emi ki o le wà lãye si Ọlọrun.
entries.en: For I through the law am dead to the law, that I might live unto God.

entries.yo: A ti kàn mi mọ agbelebu pẹlu Kristi: ṣugbọn mo wà lãye, sibẹ ki iṣe emi mọ́, ṣugbọn Kristi wà lãye ninu mi: wiwà ti mo si wà lãye ninu ara, mo wa lãye ninu igbagbọ Ọmọ Ọlọrun, ẹniti o fẹ mi, ti o si fi on tikararẹ̀ fun mi.
entries.en: I am crucified with Christ: nevertheless I live; yet not I, but Christ liveth in me: and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself for me.

entries.yo: Emi kò sọ ore-ọfẹ Ọlọrun di asan: nitoripe bi ododo ba ti ipa ofin wá, njẹ Kristi kú lasan.
entries.en: I do not frustrate the grace of God: for if righteousness come by the law, then Christ is dead in vain.

entries.yo: ẸNYIN alaironu ara Galatia, tani ha tàn nyin jẹ, ki ẹnyin ki o máṣe gbà otitọ gbọ́, li oju ẹniti a fi Jesu Kristi hàn gbangba lãrin nyin li ẹniti a kàn mọ agbelebu.
entries.en: O foolish Galatians, who hath bewitched you, that ye should not obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ hath been evidently set forth, crucified among you?

entries.yo: Kìki eyi ni mo fẹ mọ̀ lọwọ nyin pe, Nipa iṣẹ ofin li ẹnyin gbà Ẹmí bi, tabi nipa igbọran igbagbọ́?
entries.en: This only would I learn of you, Received ye the Spirit by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?

entries.yo: Bayi li ẹnyin ṣe alaironu to? ẹnyin ti o ti bẹ̀rẹ nipa ti Ẹmí a ha ṣe nyin pé nisisiyi nipa ti ara?
entries.en: Are ye so foolish? having begun in the Spirit, are ye now made perfect by the flesh?

entries.yo: Ẹnyin ha ti jìya ọ̀pọlọpọ nkan wọnni lasan? bi o tilẹ ṣepe lasan ni.
entries.en: Have ye suffered so many things in vain? if it be yet in vain.

entries.yo: Nitorina ẹniti o fun nyin li Ẹmí na, ti o si ṣe iṣẹ-agbara larin nyin, nipa iṣẹ ofin li o fi nṣe e bi, tabi nipa igbọran igbagbọ́?
entries.en: He therefore that ministereth to you the Spirit, and worketh miracles among you, doeth he it by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi Abrahamu ti gbà Ọlọrun gbọ́, a si kà a si fun u li ododo.
entries.en: Even as Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.

entries.yo: Nitorina ki ẹnyin ki o mọ̀ pe awọn ti iṣe ti igbagbọ́, awọn na ni iṣe ọmọ Abrahamu.
entries.en: Know ye therefore that they which are of faith, the same are the children of Abraham.

entries.yo: Bi iwe-mimọ́ si ti ri i tẹlẹ pe, Ọlọrun yio dá awọn Keferi lare nipa igbagbọ́, o ti wasu ihinrere ṣaju fun Abrahamu, o nwipe, Ninu rẹ li a o bukún fun gbogbo orilẹ-ède.
entries.en: And the scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the heathen through faith, preached before the gospel unto Abraham, saying, In thee shall all nations be blessed.

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bẹ̃li awọn ti iṣe ti igbagbọ́ jẹ ẹni alabukún-fun pẹlu Abrahamu olododo.
entries.en: So then they which be of faith are blessed with faithful Abraham.

entries.yo: Nitoripe iye awọn ti mbẹ ni ipa iṣẹ ofin mbẹ labẹ ègún: nitoriti a ti kọ ọ pe, Ifibu ni olukuluku ẹniti kò duro ninu ohun gbogbo ti a kọ sinu iwe ofin lati mã ṣe wọn.
entries.en: For as many as are of the works of the law are under the curse: for it is written, Cursed is every one that continueth not in all things which are written in the book of the law to do them.

entries.yo: Nitori o daniloju pe, a kò da ẹnikẹni lare niwaju Ọlọrun nipa iṣẹ ofin: nitoripe, Olododo yio yè nipa igbagbọ́.
entries.en: But that no man is justified by the law in the sight of God, it is evident: for, The just shall live by faith.

entries.yo: Ofin kì si iṣe ti igbagbọ́: ṣugbọn Ẹniti nṣe wọn yio yè nipasẹ wọn.
entries.en: And the law is not of faith: but, The man that doeth them shall live in them.

entries.yo: Kristi ti rà wa pada kuro lọwọ egun ofin, ẹniti a fi ṣe egun fun wa: nitoriti a ti kọ ọ pe, Ifibu li olukuluku ẹniti a fi kọ́ sori igi:
entries.en: Christ hath redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us: for it is written, Cursed is every one that hangeth on a tree:

entries.yo: Ki ibukún Abrahamu ki o le wá sori awọn Keferi nipa Kristi Jesu; ki awa ki o le gbà ileri Ẹmí nipa igbagbọ́.
entries.en: That the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Jesus Christ; that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.

entries.yo: Ará, emi nsọ̀rọ bi enia; bi o tilẹ jẹ pe majẹmu enia ni, ṣugbọn bi a ba ti fi idi rẹ̀ mulẹ, kò si ẹniti o le sọ ọ di asan, tabi ti o le fi kún u mọ́.
entries.en: Brethren, I speak after the manner of men; Though it be but a man's covenant, yet if it be confirmed, no man disannulleth, or addeth thereto.

entries.yo: Njẹ fun Abrahamu ati fun irú-ọmọ rẹ̀ li a ti ṣe awọn ileri na. On kò wipe, Fun awọn irú ọmọ, bi ẹnipe ọ̀pọlọpọ; ṣugbọn bi ẹnipe ọ̀kan, ati fun irú-ọmọ rẹ, eyiti iṣe Kristi.
entries.en: Now to Abraham and his seed were the promises made. He saith not, And to seeds, as of many; but as of one, And to thy seed, which is Christ.

entries.yo: Eyi ni mo nwipe, majẹmu ti Ọlọrun ti fi idi rẹ̀ mulẹ niṣãju, ofin ti o de lẹhin ọgbọ̀n-le-nirinwo ọdún kò le sọ ọ di asan, ti a ba fi mu ileri na di alailagbara.
entries.en: And this I say, that the covenant, that was confirmed before of God in Christ, the law, which was four hundred and thirty years after, cannot disannul, that it should make the promise of none effect.

entries.yo: Nitori bi ijogun na ba ṣe ti ofin, kì iṣe ti ileri mọ́: ṣugbọn Ọlọrun ti fi i fun Abrahamu nipa ileri.
entries.en: For if the inheritance be of the law, it is no more of promise: but God gave it to Abraham by promise.

entries.yo: Njẹ ki ha li ofin? a fi kun u nitori irekọja titi irú-ọmọ ti a ti ṣe ileri fun yio fi de; a si ti ipasẹ awọn angẹli ṣe ìlana rẹ̀ lati ọwọ́ alarina kan wá.
entries.en: Wherefore then serveth the law? It was added because of transgressions, till the seed should come to whom the promise was made; and it was ordained by angels in the hand of a mediator.

entries.yo: Njẹ alarina kì iṣe alarina ti ẹnikan, ṣugbọn ọ̀kan li Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Now a mediator is not a mediator of one, but God is one.

entries.yo: Nitorina ofin ha lodi si awọn ileri Ọlọrun bi? Ki a má ri: nitori ibaṣepe a ti fi ofin kan funni, ti o lagbara lati sọni di ãye, nitotọ ododo iba ti ti ipasẹ ofin wá.
entries.en: Is the law then against the promises of God? God forbid: for if there had been a law given which could have given life, verily righteousness should have been by the law.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn iwe-mimọ́ ti sé gbogbo nkan mọ́ sabẹ ẹ̀ṣẹ, ki a le fi ileri nipa igbagbọ́ ninu Jesu Kristi fun awọn ti o gbagbọ́.
entries.en: But the scripture hath concluded all under sin, that the promise by faith of Jesus Christ might be given to them that believe.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ki igbagbọ́ to de, a ti pa wa mọ́ labẹ ofin, a si sé wa mọ́ de igbagbọ́ ti a mbọwa fihàn.
entries.en: But before faith came, we were kept under the law, shut up unto the faith which should afterwards be revealed.

entries.yo: Nitorina ofin ti jẹ olukọni lati mu ni wá sọdọ Kristi, ki a le da wa lare nipa igbagbọ́.
entries.en: Wherefore the law was our schoolmaster to bring us unto Christ, that we might be justified by faith.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn lẹhin igbati igbagbọ́ ti de, awa kò si labẹ olukọni mọ́.
entries.en: But after that faith is come, we are no longer under a schoolmaster.

entries.yo: Nitoripe ọmọ Ọlọrun ni gbogbo nyin, nipa igbagbọ́ ninu Kristi Jesu.
entries.en: For ye are all the children of God by faith in Christ Jesus.

entries.yo: Nitoripe iye ẹnyin ti a ti baptisi sinu Kristi, ti gbe Kristi wọ̀.
entries.en: For as many of you as have been baptized into Christ have put on Christ.

entries.yo: Kò le si Ju tabi Hellene, ẹrú tabi omnira, ọkunrin tabi obinrin: nitoripe ọ̀kan ni gbogbo nyin jẹ ninu Kristi Jesu.
entries.en: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither bond nor free, there is neither male nor female: for ye are all one in Christ Jesus.

entries.yo: Bi ẹnyin ba si jẹ ti Kristi, njẹ ẹnyin ni irú-ọmọ Abrahamu, ati arole gẹgẹ bi ileri.
entries.en: And if ye be Christ's, then are ye Abraham's seed, and heirs according to the promise.

entries.yo: NJẸ mo wipe, niwọn igbati arole na ba wà li ewe, kò yàtọ ninu ohunkohun si ẹrú bi o tilẹ jẹ oluwa ohun gbogbo;
entries.en: Now I say, That the heir, as long as he is a child, differeth nothing from a servant, though he be lord of all;

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn o wà labẹ olutọju ati iriju titi fi di akokò ti baba ti yàn tẹlẹ.
entries.en: But is under tutors and governors until the time appointed of the father.

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bẹ̃ si li awa, nigbati awa wà li ewe, awa wà li ondè labẹ ipilẹṣẹ ẹda:
entries.en: Even so we, when we were children, were in bondage under the elements of the world:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati akokò kíkun na de, Ọlọrun rán Ọmọ rẹ̀ jade wá, ẹniti a bí ninu obinrin, ti a bi labẹ ofin,
entries.en: But when the fulness of the time was come, God sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,

entries.yo: Lati ra awọn ti mbẹ labẹ ofin pada, ki awa ki o le gbà isọdọmọ.
entries.en: To redeem them that were under the law, that we might receive the adoption of sons.

entries.yo: Ati nitoriti ẹnyin nṣe ọmọ, Ọlọrun si ti rán Ẹmí Ọmọ rẹ̀ wá sinu ọkàn nyin, ti nke pe, Abba, Baba.
entries.en: And because ye are sons, God hath sent forth the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, Abba, Father.

entries.yo: Nitorina iwọ kì iṣe ẹrú mọ́, bikoṣe ọmọ; ati bi iwọ ba iṣe ọmọ, njẹ iwọ di arole Ọlọrun nipasẹ Kristi.
entries.en: Wherefore thou art no more a servant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati ẹnyin kò ti mọ̀ Ọlọrun rí, ẹnyin ti nsìnrú fun awọn ti kì iṣe ọlọrun nipa ẹda.
entries.en: Howbeit then, when ye knew not God, ye did service unto them which by nature are no gods.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nisisiyi, nigbati ẹnyin ti mọ̀ Ọlọrun tan, tabi ki a sá kuku wipe, ẹ di mimọ̀ fun Ọlọrun, ẽha ti ri ti ẹ fi tun yipada si alailera ati alagbe ipilẹṣẹ ẹda, labẹ eyiti ẹnyin tun fẹ pada wa sinru?
entries.en: But now, after that ye have known God, or rather are known of God, how turn ye again to the weak and beggarly elements, whereunto ye desire again to be in bondage?

entries.yo: Ẹnyin nkiyesi ọjọ, ati oṣù, ati akokò, ati ọdún.
entries.en: Ye observe days, and months, and times, and years.

entries.yo: Ẹru nyin mba mi, ki o má ba ṣe pe lasan ni mo ti ṣe lãlã lori nyin.
entries.en: I am afraid of you, lest I have bestowed upon you labour in vain.

entries.yo: Ará, mo bẹ̀ nyin, ẹ dà bi emi; nitori emi dà bi ẹnyin: ẹnyin kò ṣe mi ni ibi kan.
entries.en: Brethren, I beseech you, be as I am; for I am as ye are: ye have not injured me at all.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹnyin mọ̀ pe ailera ara li o jẹ ki nwasu ihinrere fun nyin li akọṣe.
entries.en: Ye know how through infirmity of the flesh I preached the gospel unto you at the first.

entries.yo: Eyiti o si jẹ idanwo fun nyin li ara mi li ẹ kò kẹgàn, bẹni ẹ kò si kọ̀; ṣugbọn ẹnyin gbà mi bi angẹli Ọlọrun, ani bi Kristi Jesu.
entries.en: And my temptation which was in my flesh ye despised not, nor rejected; but received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.

entries.yo: Njẹ ayọ nyin igbana ha da? nitori mo gbà ẹ̀ri nyin jẹ pe, iba ṣe iṣe, ẹ ba yọ oju nyin jade, ẹ ba si fi wọn fun mi.
entries.en: Where is then the blessedness ye spake of? for I bear you record, that, if it had been possible, ye would have plucked out your own eyes, and have given them to me.

entries.yo: Njẹ mo ha di ọta nyin nitori mo sọ otitọ fun nyin bi?
entries.en: Am I therefore become your enemy, because I tell you the truth?

entries.yo: Nwọn nfi itara wá nyin, ṣugbọn ki iṣe fun rere; nwọn nfẹ já nyin kuro, ki ẹnyin ki o le mã wá wọn.
entries.en: They zealously affect you, but not well; yea, they would exclude you, that ye might affect them.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn o dara lati mã fi itara wá ni fun rere nigbagbogbo, kì si iṣe nigbati mo wà pẹlu nyin nikan.
entries.en: But it is good to be zealously affected always in a good thing, and not only when I am present with you.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin ọmọ mi kekeke, ẹnyin ti mo tún nrọbi titi a o fi ṣe ẹda Kristi ninu nyin.
entries.en: My little children, of whom I travail in birth again until Christ be formed in you,

entries.yo: Iba wù mi lati wà lọdọ nyin nisisiyi, ki emi ki o si yi ohùn mi pada nitoripe mo dãmu nitori nyin.
entries.en: I desire to be present with you now, and to change my voice; for I stand in doubt of you.

entries.yo: Ẹ wi fun mi, ẹnyin ti nfẹ wà labẹ ofin, ẹ kò ha gbọ́ ofin?
entries.en: Tell me, ye that desire to be under the law, do ye not hear the law?

entries.yo: Nitori a ti kọ ọ pe, Abrahamu ni ọmọ ọkunrin meji, ọkan lati ọdọ ẹrú-binrin, ati ọkan lati ọdọ omnira-obinrin.
entries.en: For it is written, that Abraham had two sons, the one by a bondmaid, the other by a freewoman.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn a bí eyiti iṣe ti ẹrúbinrin nipa ti ara; ṣugbọn eyi ti omnira-obinrin li a bí nipa ileri.
entries.en: But he who was of the bondwoman was born after the flesh; but he of the freewoman was by promise.

entries.yo: Nkan wọnyi jẹ apẹrẹ: nitoripe awọn obinrin wọnyi ni majẹmu mejeji; ọkan lati ori oke Sinai wá, ti a bí li oko-ẹrú, ti iṣe Hagari.
entries.en: Which things are an allegory: for these are the two covenants; the one from the mount Sinai, which gendereth to bondage, which is Agar.

entries.yo: Nitori Hagari yi ni òke Sinai Arabia, ti o si duro fun Jerusalemu ti o wà nisisiyi, ti o si wà li oko-ẹrú pẹlu awọn ọmọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: For this Agar is mount Sinai in Arabia, and answereth to Jerusalem which now is, and is in bondage with her children.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Jerusalemu ti oke jẹ omnira, eyiti iṣe iya wa.
entries.en: But Jerusalem which is above is free, which is the mother of us all.

entries.yo: Nitori a ti kọ ọ pe, Mã yọ̀, iwọ àgan ti kò bímọ: bú si ayọ̀ ki o si kigbe soke, iwọ ti kò rọbi rí; nitori awọn ọmọ ẹni alahoro pọ̀ jù ti abilekọ lọ.
entries.en: For it is written, Rejoice, thou barren that bearest not; break forth and cry, thou that travailest not: for the desolate hath many more children than she which hath an husband.

entries.yo: Njẹ ará, ọmọ ileri li awa gẹgẹ bi Isaaki.
entries.en: Now we, brethren, as Isaac was, are the children of promise.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi eyiti a bí nipa ti ara ti ṣe inunibini nigbana si eyiti a bí nipa ti Ẹmi, bẹ̃ si ni nisisiyi.
entries.en: But as then he that was born after the flesh persecuted him that was born after the Spirit, even so it is now.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn iwe-mimọ́ ha ti wi? Lé ẹrú-binrin na jade ati ọmọ rẹ̀: nitori ọmọ ẹrú-binrin kì yio ba ọmọ omnira-obinrin jogun pọ̀.
entries.en: Nevertheless what saith the scripture? Cast out the bondwoman and her son: for the son of the bondwoman shall not be heir with the son of the freewoman.

entries.yo: Nitorina, ará, awa kì iṣe ọmọ ẹrú-binrin, bikoṣe ti omnira-obinrin.
entries.en: So then, brethren, we are not children of the bondwoman, but of the free.

entries.yo: NITORINA ẹ duro ṣinṣin ninu omnira na eyi ti Kristi fi sọ wa di omnira, ki ẹ má si ṣe tún fi ọrùn bọ àjaga ẹrú mọ́.
entries.en: Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free, and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, emi Paulu li o wi fun nyin pe, bi a ba kọ nyin nila, Kristi ki yio li ère fun nyin li ohunkohun.
entries.en: Behold, I Paul say unto you, that if ye be circumcised, Christ shall profit you nothing.

entries.yo: Mo si tún sọ fun olukuluku enia ti a kọ ni ila pe, o di ajigbese lati pa gbogbo ofin mọ́.
entries.en: For I testify again to every man that is circumcised, that he is a debtor to do the whole law.

entries.yo: A ti yà nyin kuro lọdọ Kristi, ẹnyin ti nfẹ ki a da nyin lare nipa ofin; ẹ ti ṣubu kuro ninu ore-ọfẹ.
entries.en: Christ is become of no effect unto you, whosoever of you are justified by the law; ye are fallen from grace.

entries.yo: Nitori nipa Ẹmí awa nfi igbagbọ duro de ireti ododo.
entries.en: For we through the Spirit wait for the hope of righteousness by faith.

entries.yo: Nitori ninu Kristi Jesu ikọla kò jẹ ohun kan, tabi aikọla; ṣugbọn igbagbọ́ ti nṣiṣẹ nipa ifẹ.
entries.en: For in Jesus Christ neither circumcision availeth anything, nor uncircumcision; but faith which worketh by love.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin ti nsáre daradara; tani ha dí nyin lọwọ ki ẹnyin ki o máṣe gba otitọ?
entries.en: Ye did run well; who did hinder you that ye should not obey the truth?

entries.yo: Iyipada yi kò ti ọdọ ẹniti o pè nyin wá.
entries.en: This persuasion cometh not of him that calleth you.

entries.yo: Iwukara kiun ni imu gbogbo iyẹfun wu.
entries.en: A little leaven leaveneth the whole lump.

entries.yo: Mo ni igbẹkẹle si nyin ninu Oluwa pe, ẹnyin kì yio ni ero ohun miran; ṣugbọn ẹniti nyọ nyin lẹnu yio rù idajọ tirẹ̀, ẹnikẹni ti o wù ki o jẹ.
entries.en: I have confidence in you through the Lord, that ye will be none otherwise minded: but he that troubleth you shall bear his judgment, whosoever he be.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn, ara, bi emi ba nwasu ikọla sibẹ, ehatiṣe ti a nṣe inunibini si mi sibẹ? njẹ ikọsẹ agbelebu ti kuro.
entries.en: And I, brethren, if I yet preach circumcision, why do I yet suffer persecution? then is the offence of the cross ceased.

entries.yo: Emi iba fẹ ki awọn ti nyọ nyin lẹnu tilẹ ké ara wọn kuro.
entries.en: I would they were even cut off which trouble you.

entries.yo: Nitori a ti pè nyin si omnira, ará; kiki pe ki ẹ máṣe lò omnira nyin fun àye sipa ti ara, ṣugbọn ẹ mã fi ifẹ sìn ọmọnikeji nyin.
entries.en: For, brethren, ye have been called unto liberty; only use not liberty for an occasion to the flesh, but by love serve one another.

entries.yo: Nitoripe a kó gbogbo ofin já ninu ọ̀rọ kan, ani ninu eyi pe; Iwọ fẹ ọmọnikeji rẹ bi ara rẹ.
entries.en: For all the law is fulfilled in one word, even in this; Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi ẹnyin ba mbù ara nyin ṣán, ti ẹ si njẹ ara nyin run, ẹ kiyesara ki ẹ máṣe pa ara nyin run.
entries.en: But if ye bite and devour one another, take heed that ye be not consumed one of another.

entries.yo: Njẹ mo ni, Ẹ ma rìn nipa ti Ẹmí, ẹnyin kì yio si mu ifẹkufẹ ti ara ṣẹ.
entries.en: This I say then, Walk in the Spirit, and ye shall not fulful the lust of the flesh.

entries.yo: Nitoriti ara nṣe ifẹkufẹ lodi si Ẹmí, ati Ẹmí lodi si ara: awọn wọnyi si lodi si ara wọn; ki ẹ má ba le ṣe ohun ti ẹnyin nfẹ.
entries.en: For the flesh lusteth against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh: and these are contrary the one to the other: so that ye cannot do the things that ye would.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi a ba nti ọwọ Ẹmí ṣamọna nyin, ẹnyin kò si labẹ ofin.
entries.en: But if ye be led of the Spirit, ye are not under the law.

entries.yo: Njẹ awọn iṣẹ ti ara farahàn, ti iṣe wọnyi; panṣaga, àgbere, ìwa-ẽri, wọ̀bia,
entries.en: Now the works of the flesh are manifest, which are these; Adultery, fornication, uncleanness, lasciviousness,

entries.yo: Ibọriṣa, oṣó, irira, ìja, ilara, ibinu, asọ, ìṣọtẹ, adamọ̀,
entries.en: Idolatry, witchcraft, hatred, variance, emulations, wrath, strife, seditions, heresies,

entries.yo: Arankàn, ipania, imutipara, iréde-oru, ati iru wọnni: awọn ohun ti mo nwi fun nyin tẹlẹ, gẹgẹ bi mo ti wi fun nyin tẹlẹ rí pe, awọn ti nṣe nkan bawọnni kì yio jogún ijọba Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Envyings, murders, drunkenness, revellings, and such like: of the which I tell you before, as I have also told you in time past, that they which do such things shall not inherit the kingdom of God.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn eso ti Ẹmí ni ifẹ, ayọ̀, alafia, ipamọra, ìwa pẹlẹ, iṣore, igbagbọ́,
entries.en: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,

entries.yo: Ìwa tutù, ati ikora-ẹni-nijanu: ofin kan kò lodi si iru wọnni.
entries.en: Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.

entries.yo: Awọn ti iṣe ti Kristi Jesu ti kàn ara mọ agbelebu ti on ti ifẹ ati ifẹkufẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And they that are Christ's have crucified the flesh with the affections and lusts.

entries.yo: Bi awa ba wà lãye sipa ti Ẹmí, ẹ jẹ ki a si mã rìn nipa ti Ẹmí.
entries.en: If we live in the Spirit, let us also walk in the Spirit.

entries.yo: Ẹ máṣe jẹ ki a mã ṣogo-asan, ki a má mu ọmọnikeji wa binu, ki a má ṣe ilara ọmọnikeji wa.
entries.en: Let us not be desirous of vain glory, provoking one another, envying one another.

entries.yo: ARÁ, bi a tilẹ mu enia ninu iṣubu kan, ki ẹnyin ti iṣe ti Ẹmí ki o mu irú ẹni bẹ̃ bọ̀ sipò ni ẹmí iwa tutu; ki iwọ tikararẹ mã kiyesara, ki a má ba dan iwọ nã wò pẹlu.
entries.en: Brethren, if a man be overtaken in a fault, ye which are spiritual, restore such an one in the spirit of meekness; considering thyself, lest thou also be tempted.

entries.yo: Ẹ mã rù ẹrù ọmọnikeji nyin, ki ẹ si fi bẹ̃ mu ofin Kristi ṣẹ.
entries.en: Bear ye one another's burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.

entries.yo: Nitori bi enia kan ba nrò ara rẹ̀ si ẹnikan, nigbati kò jẹ nkan, o ntàn ara rẹ̀ jẹ.
entries.en: For if a man think himself to be something, when he is nothing, he deceiveth himself.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ki olukuluku ki o yẹ iṣẹ ara rẹ̀ wò, nigbana ni yio si ni ohun iṣogo nipa ti ara rẹ̀ nikan, kì yio si ṣe nipa ti ọmọnikeji rẹ̀.
entries.en: But let every man prove his own work, and then shall he have rejoicing in himself alone, and not in another.

entries.yo: Nitori olukuluku ni yio rù ẹrù ti ara rẹ̀.
entries.en: For every man shall bear his own burden.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ki ẹniti a nkọ́ ninu ọ̀rọ na mã pese ohun rere gbogbo fun ẹniti nkọni.
entries.en: Let him that is taught in the word communicate unto him that teacheth in all good things.

entries.yo: Ki a máṣe tàn nyin jẹ; a kò le gàn Ọlọrun: nitori ohunkohun ti enia ba funrugbin, on ni yio si ká.
entries.en: Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap.

entries.yo: Nitori ẹniti o ba nfunrugbin sipa ti ara rẹ̀, nipa ti ara ni yio ká idibajẹ; ṣugbọn ẹniti o ba nfunrugbin sipa ti Ẹmí, nipa ti Ẹmí ni yio ká ìye ainipẹkun.
entries.en: For he that soweth to his flesh shall of the flesh reap corruption; but he that soweth to the Spirit shall of the Spirit reap life everlasting.

entries.yo: Ẹ má si jẹ ki agãra da wa ni rere iṣe: nitori awa ó ká nigbati akokò ba de, bi a kò bá ṣe ãrẹ̀.
entries.en: And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.

entries.yo: Njẹ bi a ti nri akoko, ẹ jẹ ki a mã ṣore fun gbogbo enia, ati pãpa fun awọn ti iṣe ara ile igbagbọ́.
entries.en: As we have therefore opportunity, let us do good unto all men, especially unto them who are of the household of faith.

entries.yo: Ẹ wò bi mo ti fi ọwọ ara mi kọwe gàdàgbà-gàdàgbà si nyin.
entries.en: Ye see how large a letter I have written unto you with mine own hand.

entries.yo: Iye awọn ti nfẹ ṣe aṣehan li ara, nwọn nrọ̀ nyin lati kọla; kiki nitoripe ki a ma ba ṣe inunibini si wọn nitori agbelebu Kristi.
entries.en: As many as desire to make a fair shew in the flesh, they constrain you to be circumcised; only lest they should suffer persecution for the cross of Christ.

entries.yo: Nitori awọn ti a kọ nilà pãpã kò pa ofin mọ́, ṣugbọn nwọn nfẹ mu nyin kọla, ki nwọn ki o le mã ṣogo ninu ara nyin.
entries.en: For neither they themselves who are circumcised keep the law; but desire to have you circumcised, that they may glory in your flesh.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ki a máṣe ri pe emi nṣogo, bikoṣe ninu agbelebu Jesu Kristi Oluwa wa, nipasẹ ẹniti a ti kàn aiye mọ agbelebu fun mi, ati emi fun aiye.
entries.en: But God forbid that I should glory, save in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom the world is crucified unto me, and I unto the world.

entries.yo: Nitoripe ninu Kristi Jesu ikọla kò jẹ ohun kan, tabi aikọla, bikoṣe ẹda titun.
entries.en: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision availeth anything, nor uncircumcision, but a new creature.

entries.yo: Iye awọn ti o si nrìn gẹgẹ bi ìwọn yi, alafia lori wọn ati ãnu, ati lori Israeli Ọlọrun.
entries.en: And as many as walk according to this rule, peace be on them, and mercy, and upon the Israel of God.

entries.yo: Lati isisiyi lọ, ki ẹnikẹni máṣe yọ mi lẹnu mọ́: nitori emi nrù àpá Jesu Oluwa kiri li ara mi.
entries.en: From henceforth let no man trouble me: for I bear in my body the marks of the Lord Jesus.

entries.yo: Ará, ore-ọfẹ Jesu Kristi Oluwa wa, ki o wà pẹlu ẹmí nyin. Amin.
entries.en: Brethren, the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.

entries.yo: PAULU, Aposteli Jesu Kristi nipa ifẹ Ọlọrun, si awọn enia mimọ́ ti o wà ni Efesu, ati si awọn onigbagbọ ninu Kristi Jesu:
entries.en: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, to the saints which are at Ephesus, and to the faithful in Christ Jesus:

entries.yo: Ore-ọfẹ si nyin, ati alafia, lati ọdọ Ọlọrun Baba wa ati Jesu Kristi Oluwa.
entries.en: Grace be to you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.

entries.yo: Olubukún li Ọlọrun ati Baba Jesu Kristi Oluwa wa, ẹniti o ti fi gbogbo ibukún ẹmí ninu awọn ọrun bukún wa ninu Kristi:
entries.en: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who hath blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Christ:

entries.yo: Ani gẹgẹ bi o ti yàn wa ninu rẹ̀ ṣaju ipilẹṣẹ aiye, ki awa ki o le jẹ mimọ́ ati alailabùku niwaju rẹ̀ ninu ifẹ:
entries.en: According as he hath chosen us in him before the foundation of the world, that we should be holy and without blame before him in love:

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ti yàn wa tẹlẹ si isọdọmọ nipa Jesu Kristi fun ara rẹ̀, gẹgẹ bi ìdunnú ifẹ rẹ̀:
entries.en: Having predestinated us unto the adoption of children by Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his will,

entries.yo: Fun iyin ogo ore-ọfẹ rẹ̀, eyiti o dà lù wa ninu Ayanfẹ nì:
entries.en: To the praise of the glory of his grace, wherein he hath made us accepted in the beloved.

entries.yo: Ninu ẹniti awa ni irapada wa nipa ẹjẹ rẹ̀, idariji ẹ̀ṣẹ wa, gẹgẹ bi ọrọ̀ ore-ọfẹ rẹ̀;
entries.en: In whom we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of sins, according to the riches of his grace;

entries.yo: Eyiti o sọ di pupọ fun wa ninu gbogbo ọgbọ́n ati oye,
entries.en: Wherein he hath abounded toward us in all wisdom and prudence;

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ti sọ ohun ijinlẹ ifẹ rẹ̀ di mimọ̀ fun wa, gẹgẹ bi idunnú rẹ̀, eyiti o ti pinnu ninu rẹ̀,
entries.en: Having made known unto us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he hath purposed in himself:

entries.yo: Fun iṣẹ iriju ti kikun akoko na, ki o le ko ohun gbogbo jọ ninu Kristi, iba ṣe eyiti mbẹ ninu awọn ọrun, tabi eyiti mbẹ li aiye, ani ninu rẹ̀:
entries.en: That in the dispensation of the fulness of times he might gather together in one all things in Christ, both which are in heaven, and which are on earth; even in him:

entries.yo: Ninu ẹniti a fi wa ṣe ini rẹ̀ pẹlu, awa ti a ti yan tẹlẹ, gẹgẹ bi ipinnu ẹniti nṣiṣẹ ohun gbogbo gẹgẹ bi ìmọ ifẹ rẹ̀:
entries.en: In whom also we have obtained an inheritance, being predestinated according to the purpose of him who worketh all things after the counsel of his own will:

entries.yo: Ki awa ki o le jẹ fun iyin ogo rẹ̀, awa ti a ti ni ireti ṣaju ninu Kristi;
entries.en: That we should be to the praise of his glory, who first trusted in Christ.

entries.yo: Ninu ẹniti, ẹnyin pẹlu, nigbati ẹnyin ti gbọ ọrọ otitọ nì, ihinrere igbala nyin, ninu ẹniti nigbati ẹnyin ti gbagbọ pẹlu, a fi Ẹmi Mimọ́ ileri nì ṣe edidi nyin,
entries.en: In whom ye also trusted, after that ye heard the word of truth, the gospel of your salvation: in whom also after that ye believed, ye were sealed with that holy Spirit of promise,

entries.yo: Eyiti iṣe ẹri ini wa, fun irapada ohun ini Ọlọrun si iyìn ogo rẹ̀.
entries.en: Which is the earnest of our inheritance until the redemption of the purchased possession, unto the praise of his glory.

entries.yo: Nitori eyi, emi pẹlu, nigbati mo ti gburó igbagbọ ti mbẹ larin nyin ninu Jesu Oluwa, ati ifẹ nyin si gbogbo awọn enia mimọ́,
entries.en: Wherefore I also, after I heard of your faith in the Lord Jesus, and love unto all the saints,

entries.yo: Emi kò si simi lati mã dupẹ nitori nyin, ati lati mã darukọ nyin ninu adura mi;
entries.en: Cease not to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers;

entries.yo: Pe ki Ọlọrun Jesu Kristi Oluwa wa, Baba ogo, le fun nyin li Ẹmi nipa ti ọgbọ́n ati ti ifihan ninu ìmọ rẹ̀:
entries.en: That the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give unto you the spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him:

entries.yo: Ki oju ọkàn nyin le mọlẹ; ki ẹnyin ki o le mọ ohun ti ireti ìpe rẹ̀ jẹ, ati ohun ti ọrọ̀ ogo ini rẹ̀ ninu awọn enia mimọ́ jẹ,
entries.en: The eyes of your understanding being enlightened; that ye may know what is the hope of his calling, and what the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,

entries.yo: Ati agbara rẹ̀ ti o tobi julọ si awa ti o gbagbọ́, gẹgẹ bi iṣẹ agbara rẹ̀,
entries.en: And what is the exceeding greatness of his power to usward who believe, according to the working of his mighty power,

entries.yo: Eyiti o ti ṣiṣẹ ninu Kristi, nigbati o ti jí dide kuro ninu okú, ti o si fi i joko li ọwọ́ ọtún ninu awọn ọrun,
entries.en: Which he wrought in Christ, when he raised him from the dead, and set him at his own right hand in the heavenly places,

entries.yo: Ga ju gbogbo ijọba ati ọla, ati agbara, ati oyè, ati gbogbo orukọ ti a ndá, ki iṣe li aiye yi nikan, ṣugbọn li eyiti mbọ̀ pẹlu.
entries.en: Far above all principality, and power, and might, and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this world, but also in that which is to come:

entries.yo: O si ti fi ohun gbogbo sabẹ ẹsẹ rẹ̀, o si ti fi i ṣe ori lori ohun gbogbo fun ijọ,
entries.en: And hath put all things under his feet, and gave him to be the head over all things to the church,

entries.yo: Eyiti iṣe ara rẹ̀, ẹkún ẹniti o kún ohun gbogbo ninu ohun gbogbo.
entries.en: Which is his body, the fulness of him that filleth all in all.

entries.yo: ẸNYIN li a si ti sọ di àye, nigbati ẹnyin ti kú nitori irekọja ati ẹ̀ṣẹ nyin,
entries.en: And you hath he quickened, who were dead in trespasses and sins;

entries.yo: Ninu eyiti ẹnyin ti nrin rí gẹgẹ bi ipa ti aiye yi, gẹgẹ bi alaṣẹ agbara oju ọrun, ẹmí ti nṣiṣẹ nisisiyi ninu awọn ọmọ alaigbọran:
entries.en: Wherein in time past ye walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit that now worketh in the children of disobedience:

entries.yo: Ninu awọn ẹniti gbogbo wa pẹlu ti wà rí ninu ifẹkufẹ ara wa, a nmu ifẹ ara ati ti inu ṣẹ; ati nipa ẹda awa si ti jẹ ọmọ ibinu, gẹgẹ bi awọn iyoku pẹlu.
entries.en: Among whom also we all had our conversation in times past in the lusts of our flesh, fulfilling the desires of the flesh and of the mind; and were by nature the children of wrath, even as others.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Ọlọrun, ẹniti iṣe ọlọrọ̀ li ãnu, nitori ifẹ nla rẹ̀ ti o fi fẹ wa,
entries.en: But God, who is rich in mercy, for his great love wherewith he loved us,

entries.yo: Nigbati awa tilẹ ti kú nitori irekọja wa, o sọ wa di ãye pẹlu Kristi (ore-ọfẹ li a ti fi gba nyin là).
entries.en: Even when we were dead in sins, hath quickened us together with Christ, (by grace ye are saved;)

entries.yo: O si ti ji wa dide pẹlu rẹ̀, o si ti mu wa wa joko pẹlu rẹ̀ ninu awọn ọrun ninu Kristi Jesu:
entries.en: And hath raised us up together, and made us sit together in heavenly places in Christ Jesus:

entries.yo: Pe ni gbogbo ìgba ti mbọ ki o ba le fi ọrọ̀ ore-ọfẹ rẹ̀ ti o pọ rekọja han ninu iṣeun rẹ̀ si wa ninu Kristi Jesu.
entries.en: That in the ages to come he might shew the exceeding riches of his grace in his kindness toward us through Christ Jesus.

entries.yo: Nitori ore-ọfẹ li a ti fi gbà nyin là nipa igbagbọ́; ati eyini kì iṣe ti ẹnyin tikaranyin: ẹ̀bun Ọlọrun ni:
entries.en: For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God:

entries.yo: Kì iṣe nipa iṣẹ, ki ẹnikẹni má bã ṣogo.
entries.en: Not of works, lest any man should boast.

entries.yo: Nitori awa ni iṣẹ ọwọ́ rẹ̀ ti a ti dá ninu Kristi Jesu fun iṣẹ rere, ti Ọlọrun ti pèse tẹlẹ, ki awa ki o le mã rìn ninu wọn.
entries.en: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works, which God hath before ordained that we should walk in them.

entries.yo: Nitorina ẹ ranti pe, nigba atijọ ri, ẹnyin ti ẹ ti jẹ Keferi nipa ti ara, ti awọn ti a npè ni Akọla ti a fi ọwọ ṣe li ara npè li Alaikọla,
entries.en: Wherefore remember, that ye being in time past Gentiles in the flesh, who are called Uncircumcision by that which is called the Circumcision in the flesh made by hands;

entries.yo: Pe li akokò na ẹnyin wà laini Kristi, ẹ jẹ ajeji si anfani awọn ọlọtọ Israeli, ati alejo si awọn majẹmu ileri nì, laini ireti, ati laini Ọlọrun li aiye:
entries.en: That at that time ye were without Christ, being aliens from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of promise, having no hope, and without God in the world:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nisisiyi ninu Kristi Jesu ẹnyin ti o ti jìna réré nigba atijọ rí li a mu sunmọ tosi, nipa ẹ̀jẹ Kristi.
entries.en: But now in Christ Jesus ye who sometimes were far off are made nigh by the blood of Christ.

entries.yo: Nitori on ni alafia wa, ẹniti o ti ṣe mejeji li ọ̀kan, ti o si ti wó ogiri ìkélé nì ti mbẹ lãrin;
entries.en: For he is our peace, who hath made both one, and hath broken down the middle wall of partition between us;

entries.yo: O si ti fi opin si ọta nì ninu ara rẹ̀, ani si ofin aṣẹ wọnni ti mbẹ ninu ilana; ki o le fi awọn mejeji dá ẹni titun kan ninu ara rẹ̀, ki o si ṣe ilaja,
entries.en: Having abolished in his flesh the enmity, even the law of commandments contained in ordinances; for to make in himself of twain one new man, so making peace;

entries.yo: Ati ki o le mu awọn mejeji ba Ọlọrun làja ninu ara kan nipa agbelebu; o si ti pa iṣọta na kú nipa rẹ̀:
entries.en: And that he might reconcile both unto God in one body by the cross, having slain the enmity thereby:

entries.yo: O si ti wá, o si ti wasu alafia fun ẹnyin ti o jìna réré, ati fun awọn ti o sunmọ tosi:
entries.en: And came and preached peace to you which were afar off, and to them that were nigh.

entries.yo: Nitori nipa rẹ̀ li awa mejeji ti ni ọ̀na nipa Ẹmí kan sọdọ Baba.
entries.en: For through him we both have access by one Spirit unto the Father.

entries.yo: Njẹ nitorina ẹnyin kì iṣe alejò ati atipo mọ́, ṣugbọn àjumọ jẹ ọlọ̀tọ pẹlu awọn enia mimọ́, ati awọn ará ile Ọlọrun;
entries.en: Now therefore ye are no more strangers and foreigners, but fellowcitizens with the saints, and of the household of God;

entries.yo: A si ngbé nyin ró lori ipilẹ awọn aposteli, ati awọn woli, Jesu Kristi tikararẹ̀ jẹ pàtaki okuta igun ile;
entries.en: And are built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ himself being the chief corner stone;

entries.yo: Ninu ẹniti gbogbo ile na, ti a nkọ ṣọkan pọ, ndagbà soke ni tẹmpili mimọ́ ninu Oluwa:
entries.en: In whom all the building fitly framed together groweth unto an holy temple in the Lord:

entries.yo: Ninu ẹniti a ngbé nyin ró pọ pẹlu fun ibujoko Ọlọrun ninu Ẹmí.
entries.en: In whom ye also are builded together for an habitation of God through the Spirit.

entries.yo: NITORI eyina, emi Paulu, ondè Jesu Kristi nitori ẹnyin Keferi,
entries.en: For this cause I Paul, the prisoner of Jesus Christ for you Gentiles,

entries.yo: Bi ẹnyin ba ti gbọ ti iṣẹ iriju ore-ọfẹ Ọlọrun, ti a fifun mi fun nyin:
entries.en: If ye have heard of the dispensation of the grace of God which is given me to youward:

entries.yo: Bi o ti ṣepe nipa ifihan li o ti fi ohun ijinlẹ nì hàn fun mi, (gẹgẹ bi mo ti kọ ṣaju li ọrọ diẹ,
entries.en: How that by revelation he made known unto me the mystery; (as I wrote afore in few words,

entries.yo: Nigbati ẹnyin ba kà a, nipa eyi ti ẹnyin ó fi le mọ oye mi ninu ijinlẹ Kristi,)
entries.en: Whereby, when ye read, ye may understand my knowledge in the mystery of Christ)

entries.yo: Eyiti a kò ti fihàn awọn ọmọ enia rí ni irandiran miran, bi a ti fi wọn hàn nisisiyi fun awọn aposteli rẹ̀ mimọ́ ati awọn woli nipa Ẹmí;
entries.en: Which in other ages was not made known unto the sons of men, as it is now revealed unto his holy apostles and prophets by the Spirit;

entries.yo: Pe, awọn Keferi jẹ àjumọjogun ati ẹya-ara kanna, ati alabapin ileri ninu Kristi Jesu nipa ihinrere:
entries.en: That the Gentiles should be fellowheirs, and of the same body, and partakers of his promise in Christ by the gospel:

entries.yo: Iranṣẹ eyiti a fi mi ṣe gẹgẹ bi ẹ̀bun ore-ọfẹ Ọlọrun ti a fifun mi, gẹgẹ bi iṣẹ agbara rẹ̀.
entries.en: Whereof I was made a minister, according to the gift of the grace of God given unto me by the effectual working of his power.

entries.yo: Fun emi ti o kere ju ẹniti o kere julọ ninu gbogbo awọn enia mimọ́, li a fi ore-ọfẹ yi fun, lati wasu awamáridi ọrọ̀ Kristi fun awọn Keferi;
entries.en: Unto me, who am less than the least of all saints, is this grace given, that I should preach among the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ;

entries.yo: Ati lati mu ki gbogbo enia ri kini iṣẹ-iriju ohun ijinlẹ na jasi, eyiti a ti fi pamọ́ lati aiyebaiye ninu Ọlọrun, ẹniti o dá ohun gbogbo nipa Jesu Kristi:
entries.en: And to make all men see what is the fellowship of the mystery, which from the beginning of the world hath been hid in God, who created all things by Jesus Christ:

entries.yo: Ki a ba le fi ọ̀pọlọpọ onirũru ọgbọ́n Ọlọrun hàn nisisiyi fun awọn ijoye ati awọn alagbara ninu awọn ọrun, nipasẹ ijọ,
entries.en: To the intent that now unto the principalities and powers in heavenly places might be known by the church the manifold wisdom of God,

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi ipinnu ataiyebaiye ti o ti pinnu ninu Kristi Jesu Oluwa wa:
entries.en: According to the eternal purpose which he purposed in Christ Jesus our Lord:

entries.yo: Ninu ẹniti awa ni igboiya, ati ọ̀na pẹlu igbẹkẹle nipa igbagbọ́ wa ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: In whom we have boldness and access with confidence by the faith of him.

entries.yo: Nitorina mo bẹ̀ nyin ki ãrẹ̀ ki o máṣe mu nyin ni gbogbo wahalà mi nitori nyin, ti iṣe ogo nyin.
entries.en: Wherefore I desire that ye faint not at my tribulations for you, which is your glory.

entries.yo: Nitori idi eyi ni mo ṣe nfi ẽkun mi kunlẹ fun Baba Oluwa wa Jesu Kristi,
entries.en: For this cause I bow my knees unto the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,

entries.yo: Orukọ ẹniti a fi npè gbogbo idile ti mbẹ li ọrun ati li aiye,
entries.en: Of whom the whole family in heaven and earth is named,

entries.yo: Ki on ki o le fifun nyin, gẹgẹ bi ọrọ̀ ogo rẹ̀, ki a le fi agbara rẹ̀ mú nyin li okun nipa Ẹmí rẹ̀ niti ẹni inu;
entries.en: That he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, to be strengthened with might by his Spirit in the inner man;

entries.yo: Ki Kristi ki o le mã gbé inu ọkàn nyin nipa igbagbọ; pe bi ẹ ti nfi gbongbo mulẹ, ti ẹ si nfi ẹsẹ mulẹ ninu ifẹ,
entries.en: That Christ may dwell in your hearts by faith; that ye, being rooted and grounded in love,

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o le li agbara lati mọ̀ pẹlu gbogbo awọn enia mimọ́, kini ìbú, ati gigùn, ati jijìn, ati giga na jẹ,
entries.en: May be able to comprehend with all saints what is the breadth, and length, and depth, and height;

entries.yo: Ati lati mọ ifẹ Kristi ti o ta ìmọ yọ, ki a le fi gbogbo ẹ̀kún Ọlọrun kun nyin.
entries.en: And to know the love of Christ, which passeth knowledge, that ye might be filled with all the fulness of God.

entries.yo: Njẹ ẹniti o le ṣe lọpọlọpọ jù gbogbo eyiti a mbère tabi ti a nrò lọ, gẹgẹ bi agbara ti nṣiṣẹ ninu wa,
entries.en: Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that worketh in us,

entries.yo: On ni ki a mã fi ogo fun ninu ijọ ati ninu Kristi Jesu titi irandiran gbogbo, aiye ainipẹkun. Amin.
entries.en: Unto him be glory in the church by Christ Jesus throughout all ages, world without end. Amen.

entries.yo: NITORINA emi ondè ninu Oluwa, mbẹ̀ nyin pe, ki ẹnyin ki o mã rìn bi o ti yẹ fun ìpe na ti a fi pè nyin,
entries.en: I therefore, the prisoner of the Lord, beseech you that ye walk worthy of the vocation wherewith ye are called,

entries.yo: Pẹlu irẹlẹ gbogbo ati inu tutù, pẹlu ipamọra, ẹ mã fi ifẹ farada a fun ẹnikeji nyin;
entries.en: With all lowliness and meekness, with longsuffering, forbearing one another in love;

entries.yo: Ki ẹ si mã lakaka lati pa iṣọkan Ẹmí mọ́ ni ìdipọ alafia.
entries.en: Endeavouring to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.

entries.yo: Ara kan ni mbẹ, ati Ẹmí kan, ani bi a ti pè nyin sinu ireti kan ti ipè nyin;
entries.en: There is one body, and one Spirit, even as ye are called in one hope of your calling;

entries.yo: Oluwa kan, igbagbọ́ kan, baptismu kan,
entries.en: One Lord, one faith, one baptism,

entries.yo: Ọlọrun kan ati Baba gbogbo, ẹniti o wà lori gbogbo ati nipa gbogbo ati ninu nyin gbogbo.
entries.en: One God and Father of all, who is above all, and through all, and in you all.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn olukuluku wa li a fi ore-ọfẹ fun gẹgẹ bi oṣuwọn ẹ̀bun Kristi.
entries.en: But unto every one of us is given grace according to the measure of the gift of Christ.

entries.yo: Nitorina o wipe, Nigbati o gòke lọ si ibi giga, o di igbekun ni igbekun, o si fi ẹ̀bun fun enia.
entries.en: Wherefore he saith, When he ascended up on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts unto men.

entries.yo: (Njẹ niti pe o goke lọ, kili o jẹ, bikoṣepe o kọ́ sọkalẹ pẹlu lọ si iha isalẹ ilẹ?
entries.en: (Now that he ascended, what is it but that he also descended first into the lower parts of the earth?

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ti sọkalẹ, on kanna li o si ti goke rekọja gbogbo awọn ọrun, ki o le kún ohun gbogbo.)
entries.en: He that descended is the same also that ascended up far above all heavens, that he might fill all things.)

entries.yo: O si ti fi awọn kan funni bi aposteli; ati awọn miran bi woli; ati awọn miran bi efangelisti, ati awọn miran bi oluṣọ-agutan ati olukọni;
entries.en: And he gave some, apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, pastors and teachers;

entries.yo: Fun aṣepé awọn enia mimọ́ fun iṣẹ-iranṣẹ, fun imudagba ara Kristi:
entries.en: For the perfecting of the saints, for the work of the ministry, for the edifying of the body of Christ:

entries.yo: Titi gbogbo wa yio fi de iṣọkan igbagbọ́ ati ìmọ Ọmọ Ọlọrun, titi a o fi di ọkunrin, titi a o fi de iwọn gigun ẹ̀kún Kristi:
entries.en: Till we all come in the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, unto a perfect man, unto the measure of the stature of the fulness of Christ:

entries.yo: Ki awa ki o máṣe jẹ ewe mọ́, ti a nfi gbogbo afẹfẹ ẹ̀kọ́ tì siwa tì sẹhin, ti a si fi ngbá kiri, nipa itanjẹ enia, nipa arekereke fun ọgbọnkọgbọn ati múni ṣina;
entries.en: That we henceforth be no more children, tossed to and fro, and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the sleight of men, and cunning craftiness, whereby they lie in wait to deceive;

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ki a mã sọ otitọ ni ifẹ, ki a le mã dàgbasoke ninu rẹ̀ li ohun gbogbo, ẹniti iṣe ori, ani Kristi:
entries.en: But speaking the truth in love, may grow up into him in all things, which is the head, even Christ:

entries.yo: Lati ọdọ ẹniti ara na ti a nso ṣọkan pọ, ti o si nfi ara mọra, nipa gbogbo orike ipese, (gẹgẹ bi iṣẹ olukuluku ẹya-ara ni ìwọn tirẹ̀) o nmu ara na bi si i fun idagbasoke on tikararẹ ninu ifẹ.
entries.en: From whom the whole body fitly joined together and compacted by that which every joint supplieth, according to the effectual working in the measure of every part, maketh increase of the body unto the edifying of itself in love.

entries.yo: Njẹ eyi ni mo nwi, ti mo si njẹri ninu Oluwa pe, lati isisiyi lọ ki ẹnyin ki o máṣe rìn mọ́, ani gẹgẹ bi awọn Keferi ti nrin ninu ironu asan wọn,
entries.en: This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that ye henceforth walk not as other Gentiles walk, in the vanity of their mind,

entries.yo: Òye awọn ẹniti o ṣòkunkun, awọn ti o si ti di àjeji si ìwa-bi-Ọlọrun nitori aimọ̀ ti mbẹ ninu wọn, nitori lile ọkàn wọn:
entries.en: Having the understanding darkened, being alienated from the life of God through the ignorance that is in them, because of the blindness of their heart:

entries.yo: Awọn ẹniti ọkàn wọn le rekọja, ti nwọn si ti fi ara wọn fun wọ̀bia, lati mã fi iwọra ṣiṣẹ ìwa-ẽri gbogbo.
entries.en: Who being past feeling have given themselves over unto lasciviousness, to work all uncleanness with greediness.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn a kò fi Kristi kọ́ nyin bẹ̃;
entries.en: But ye have not so learned Christ;

entries.yo: Bi o ba ṣe pe nitotọ li ẹ ti gbohùn rẹ̀, ti a si ti kọ́ nyin ninu rẹ̀, gẹgẹ bi otitọ ti mbẹ ninu Jesu:
entries.en: If so be that ye have heard him, and have been taught by him, as the truth is in Jesus:

entries.yo: Pe, niti iwa nyin atijọ, ki ẹnyin ki o bọ ogbologbo ọkunrin nì silẹ, eyiti o dibajẹ gẹgẹ bi ifẹkufẹ ẹ̀tan;
entries.en: That ye put off concerning the former conversation the old man, which is corrupt according to the deceitful lusts;

entries.yo: Ki ẹ si di titun ni ẹmi inu nyin;
entries.en: And be renewed in the spirit of your mind;

entries.yo: Ki ẹ si gbé ọkunrin titun nì wọ̀, eyiti a da nipa ti Ọlọrun li ododo ati li iwa mimọ́ otitọ́.
entries.en: And that ye put on the new man, which after God is created in righteousness and true holiness.

entries.yo: Nitorina ẹ fi eke ṣiṣe silẹ, ki olukuluku nyin ki o mã ba ọmọnikeji rẹ̀ sọ otitọ, nitori ẹ̀ya-ara ọmọnikeji wa li awa iṣe.
entries.en: Wherefore putting away lying, speak every man truth with his neighbour: for we are members one of another.

entries.yo: Ẹ binu; ẹ má si ṣe ṣẹ̀: ẹ máṣe jẹ ki õrùn wọ̀ bá ibinu nyin:
entries.en: Be ye angry, and sin not: let not the sun go down upon your wrath:

entries.yo: Bẹni ki ẹ má ṣe fi àye fun Èṣu.
entries.en: Neither give place to the devil.

entries.yo: Ki ẹniti njale máṣe jale mọ́: ṣugbọn ki o kuku mã ṣe lãlã, ki o mã fi ọwọ́ rẹ̀ ṣiṣẹ ohun ti o dara, ki on ki o le ni lati pín fun ẹniti o ṣe alaini.
entries.en: Let him that stole steal no more: but rather let him labour, working with his hands the thing which is good, that he may have to give to him that needeth.

entries.yo: Ẹ máṣe jẹ ki ọ̀rọ idibajẹ kan ti ẹnu nyin jade, ṣugbọn iru eyiti o dara fun ẹ̀kọ́, ki o le mã fi ore-ọfẹ fun awọn ti ngbọ́.
entries.en: Let no corrupt communication proceed out of your mouth, but that which is good to the use of edifying, that it may minister grace unto the hearers.

entries.yo: Ẹ má si ṣe mu Ẹmí Mimọ́ Ọlọrun binu, ẹniti a fi ṣe èdidi nyin dè ọjọ idande.
entries.en: And grieve not the holy Spirit of God, whereby ye are sealed unto the day of redemption.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ìwa kikorò, ati ibinu, ati irunu, ati ariwo, ati ọ̀rọ buburu ni ki a mu kuro lọdọ nyin, pẹlu gbogbo arankàn:
entries.en: Let all bitterness, and wrath, and anger, and clamour, and evil speaking, be put away from you, with all malice:

entries.yo: Ẹ mã ṣore fun ọmọnikeji nyin, ẹ ni iyọ́nu, ẹ mã darijì ara nyin, gẹgẹ bi Ọlọrun ninu Kristi ti darijì nyin.
entries.en: And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ's sake hath forgiven you.

entries.yo: NITORINA ẹ mã ṣe afarawe Ọlọrun bi awọn ọmọ ọ̀wọ́n;
entries.en: Be ye therefore followers of God, as dear children;

entries.yo: Ẹ si mã rìn ni ifẹ, gẹgẹ bi Kristi pẹlu ti fẹ wa, ti o si fi ara rẹ̀ fun wa li ọrẹ ati ẹbọ fun Ọlọrun fun õrùn didun.
entries.en: And walk in love, as Christ also hath loved us, and hath given himself for us an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweetsmelling savour.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn àgbere, ati gbogbo ìwa ẽrí, tabi ojukòkoro, ki a má tilẹ darukọ rẹ̀ larin nyin mọ́, bi o ti yẹ awọn enia mimọ́;
entries.en: But fornication, and all uncleanness, or covetousness, let it not be once named among you, as becometh saints;

entries.yo: Ibã ṣe ìwa ọ̀bun, ati isọ̀rọ wère, tabi iṣẹ̀fẹ, awọn ohun ti kò tọ́: ṣugbọn ẹ kuku mã dupẹ.
entries.en: Neither filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not convenient: but rather giving of thanks.

entries.yo: Nitori ẹnyin mọ̀ eyi daju pe, kò si panṣaga, tabi alaimọ́ enia, tabi olojukòkoro, ti iṣe olubọriṣa, ti yio ni ini kan ni ijọba Kristi ati ti Ọlọrun.
entries.en: For this ye know, that no whoremonger, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, hath any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.

entries.yo: Ẹ máṣe jẹ ki ẹnikẹni fi ọ̀rọ asan tàn nyin jẹ: nitori nipasẹ nkan wọnyi ibinu Ọlọrun mbọ̀ wá sori awọn ọmọ alaigbọran.
entries.en: Let no man deceive you with vain words: for because of these things cometh the wrath of God upon the children of disobedience.

entries.yo: Nitorina ẹ máṣe jẹ alajọpin pẹlu wọn.
entries.en: Be not ye therefore partakers with them.

entries.yo: Nitori ẹnyin ti jẹ òkunkun lẹ̃kan, ṣugbọn nisisiyi, ẹnyin di imọlẹ nipa ti Oluwa: ẹ mã rìn gẹgẹ bi awọn ọmọ imọlẹ:
entries.en: For ye were sometimes darkness, but now are ye light in the Lord: walk as children of light:

entries.yo: (Nitori eso Ẹmí wà niti iṣore gbogbo, ati ododo, ati otitọ;)
entries.en: (For the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth;)

entries.yo: Ẹ si mã wadi ohun ti iṣe itẹwọgbà fun Oluwa.
entries.en: Proving what is acceptable unto the Lord.

entries.yo: Ẹ má si ba aileso iṣẹ òkunkun kẹgbẹ pọ̀, ṣugbọn ẹ kuku mã ba wọn wi.
entries.en: And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather reprove them.

entries.yo: Nitori itiju tilẹ ni lati mã sọ̀rọ nkan wọnni ti nwọn nṣe nikọ̀kọ.
entries.en: For it is a shame even to speak of those things which are done of them in secret.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ohun gbogbo ti a mba wi ni imọlẹ ifi han: nitori ohunkohun ti o ba fi nkan hàn, imọlẹ ni.
entries.en: But all things that are reproved are made manifest by the light: for whatsoever doth make manifest is light.

entries.yo: Nitorina li o ṣe wipe, Jí, iwọ ẹniti o sùn, si jinde kuro ninu okú, Kristi yio si fun ọ ni imọlẹ.
entries.en: Wherefore he saith, Awake thou that sleepest, and arise from the dead, and Christ shall give thee light.

entries.yo: Nitorina ẹ kiyesi lati mã rìn ni ìwa pipé, kì iṣe bi awọn alailọgbọn, ṣugbọn bi awọn ọlọgbọn;
entries.en: See then that ye walk circumspectly, not as fools, but as wise,

entries.yo: Ẹ mã ra ìgba pada, nitori buburu li awọn ọjọ.
entries.en: Redeeming the time, because the days are evil.

entries.yo: Nitorina ẹ máṣe jẹ alailoye, ṣugbọn ẹ mã moye ohun ti ifẹ Oluwa jasi.
entries.en: Wherefore be ye not unwise, but understanding what the will of the Lord is.

entries.yo: Ẹ má si ṣe mu waini li amupara, ninu eyiti rudurudu wà; ṣugbọn ẹ kún fun Ẹmí;
entries.en: And be not drunk with wine, wherein is excess; but be filled with the Spirit;

entries.yo: Ẹ si mã bá ara nyin sọ̀rọ ninu psalmu, ati orin iyìn, ati orin ẹmí, ẹ mã kọrin, ki ẹ si mã kọrin didun li ọkàn nyin si Oluwa;
entries.en: Speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;

entries.yo: Ẹ mã dupẹ nigbagbogbo fun ohun gbogbo lọwọ Ọlọrun, ani Baba, li orukọ Jesu Kristi Oluwa wa;
entries.en: Giving thanks always for all things unto God and the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ;

entries.yo: Ẹ mã tẹriba fun ara nyin ni ìbẹru Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Submitting yourselves one to another in the fear of God.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin aya, ẹ mã tẹriba fun awọn ọkọ nyin, gẹgẹ bi fun Oluwa.
entries.en: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as unto the Lord.

entries.yo: Nitoripe ọkọ ni iṣe ori aya, gẹgẹ bi Kristi ti ṣe ori ijọ enia rẹ̀: on si ni Olugbala ara.
entries.en: For the husband is the head of the wife, even as Christ is the head of the church: and he is the saviour of the body.

entries.yo: Nitorina gẹgẹ bi ijọ ti tẹriba fun Kristi, bẹ̃ si ni ki awọn aya ki o mã ṣe si ọkọ wọn li ohun gbogbo.
entries.en: Therefore as the church is subject unto Christ, so let the wives be to their own husbands in every thing.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin ọkọ, ẹ fẹran awọn aya nyin, gẹgẹ bi Kristi si ti fẹran ìjọ, ti o si fi ara rẹ̀ fun u;
entries.en: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it;

entries.yo: Ki on ki o le sọ ọ di mimọ́ lẹhin ti a ti fi ọ̀rọ wẹ ẹ mọ́ ninu agbada omi,
entries.en: That he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word,

entries.yo: Ki on ki o le mu u wá sọdọ ara rẹ̀ bi ìjọ ti o li ogo li aini abawọn, tabi alẽbu kan, tabi irú nkan bawọnni; ṣugbọn ki o le jẹ mimọ́ ati alaini àbuku.
entries.en: That he might present it to himself a glorious church, not having spot, or wrinkle, or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li o tọ́ ki awọn ọkunrin ki o mã fẹràn awọn aya wọn gẹgẹ bi ara awọn tikarawọn. Ẹniti o ba fẹran aya rẹ̀, o fẹran on tikararẹ̀.
entries.en: So ought men to love their wives as their own bodies. He that loveth his wife loveth himself.

entries.yo: Nitori kò si ẹnikan ti o ti korira ara rẹ̀; bikoṣepe ki o mã bọ́ ọ ki o si mã ṣikẹ rẹ̀ gẹgẹ bi Kristi si ti nṣe si ìjọ.
entries.en: For no man ever yet hated his own flesh; but nourisheth and cherisheth it, even as the Lord the church:

entries.yo: Nitoripe awa li ẹ̀ya-ara rẹ̀, ati ti ẹran-ara rẹ̀, ati ti egungun ara rẹ̀.
entries.en: For we are members of his body, of his flesh, and of his bones.

entries.yo: Nitori eyi li ọkunrin yio ṣe fi baba ati iya rẹ̀ silẹ, on o si dàpọ mọ́ aya rẹ̀, awọn mejeji a si di ara kan.
entries.en: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall be joined unto his wife, and they two shall be one flesh.

entries.yo: Aṣiri nla li eyi: ṣugbọn emi nsọ nipa ti Kristi ati ti ijọ.
entries.en: This is a great mystery: but I speak concerning Christ and the church.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ki olukuluku nyin ki o fẹran aya rẹ̀ bẹ̃ gẹgẹ bi on tikararẹ̀; ki aya ki o si bẹru ọkọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Nevertheless let every one of you in particular so love his wife even as himself; and the wife see that she reverence her husband.

entries.yo: ẸNYIN ọmọ, ẹ mã gbọ ti awọn õbi nyin ninu Oluwa: nitoripe eyi li o tọ́.
entries.en: Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right.

entries.yo: Bọ̀wọ fun baba ati iya rẹ (eyi ti iṣe ofin ikini pẹlu ileri),
entries.en: Honour thy father and mother; (which is the first commandment with promise;)

entries.yo: Ki o le dara fun ọ, ati ki iwọ ki o le wà pẹ li aiye.
entries.en: That it may be well with thee, and thou mayest live long on the earth.

entries.yo: Ati ẹnyin baba, ẹ máṣe mu awọn ọmọ nyin binu: ṣugbọn ẹ mã tọ́ wọn ninu ẹkọ́ ati ikilọ Oluwa.
entries.en: And, ye fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin ọmọ-ọdọ, ẹ mã gbọ ti awọn oluwa nyin nipa ti ara, pẹlu ibẹru ati iwarìri, ni otitọ ọkàn nyin, bi ẹnipe si Kristi;
entries.en: Servants, be obedient to them that are your masters according to the flesh, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as unto Christ;

entries.yo: Ki iṣe ti arojuṣe bi awọn ti nwù enia; ṣugbọn gẹgẹ bi awọn ẹrú Kristi, ẹ mã ṣe ifẹ Ọlọrun lati inu wá;
entries.en: Not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but as the servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart;

entries.yo: Ẹ mã fi inu rere sin bi si Oluwa, kì si iṣe si enia:
entries.en: With good will doing service, as to the Lord, and not to men:

entries.yo: Bi ẹnyin ti mọ pe ohun rere kohunrere ti olukuluku ba ṣe, on na ni yio si gbà pada lọdọ Oluwa, ibã ṣe ẹrú, tabi omnira.
entries.en: Knowing that whatsoever good thing any man doeth, the same shall he receive of the Lord, whether he be bond or free.

entries.yo: Ati ẹnyin oluwa, ẹ mã ṣe ohun kanna si wọn, ẹ mã din ibẹru nyin kù; bi ẹnyin ti mọ pe Oluwa ẹnyin tikaranyin si mbẹ li ọrun; kò si si ojuṣãju enia lọdọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And, ye masters, do the same things unto them, forbearing threatening: knowing that your Master also is in heaven; neither is there respect of persons with him.

entries.yo: Lakotan, ará mi, ẹ jẹ alagbara ninu Oluwa, ati ninu agbara ipá rẹ̀.
entries.en: Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.

entries.yo: Ẹ gbe gbogbo ihamọra Ọlọrun wọ̀, ki ẹnyin ki o le kọ oju ija si arekereke Eṣu.
entries.en: Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.

entries.yo: Nitoripe kì iṣe ẹ̀jẹ ati ẹran-ara li awa mba jijakadi, ṣugbọn awọn ijoye, awọn ọlọla, awọn alaṣẹ ibi òkunkun aiye yi, ati awọn ẹmí buburu ni oju ọrun.
entries.en: For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.

entries.yo: Nitorina ẹ gbe gbogbo ihamọra Ọlọrun wọ̀ ki ẹnyin ki o le duro tiri si ọjọ ibi, nigbati ẹnyin bá si ti ṣe ohun gbogbo tan, ki ẹ si duro.
entries.en: Wherefore take unto you the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.

entries.yo: Ẹ duro nitorina lẹhin ti ẹ ti fi àmure otitọ di ẹgbẹ nyin, ti ẹ si ti di ìgbaiya ododo nì mọra;
entries.en: Stand therefore, having your loins girt about with truth, and having on the breastplate of righteousness;

entries.yo: Ti ẹ si ti fi imura ihinrere alafia wọ̀ ẹsẹ nyin ni bàta;
entries.en: And your feet shod with the preparation of the gospel of peace;

entries.yo: Léke gbogbo rẹ̀, ẹ mu apata igbagbọ́, nipa eyiti ẹnyin ó le mã fi paná gbogbo ọfa iná ẹni ibi nì.
entries.en: Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked.

entries.yo: Ki ẹ si mu aṣibori igbala, ati idà Ẹmí, ti iṣe ọ̀rọ Ọlọrun:
entries.en: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God:

entries.yo: Pẹlu gbogbo adura ati ẹbẹ ni ki ẹ mã gbadura nigbagbogbo ninu Ẹmí, ki ẹ si mã ṣọra si i ninu iduroṣinṣin gbogbo, ati ẹ̀bẹ fun gbogbo enia mimọ́;
entries.en: Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints;

entries.yo: Ati fun mi, ki a le fi ohùn fun mi, ki emi ki o le mã fi igboiya yà ẹnu mi, lati mã fi ohun ijinlẹ ihinrere hàn,
entries.en: And for me, that utterance may be given unto me, that I may open my mouth boldly, to make known the mystery of the gospel,

entries.yo: Nitori eyiti emi jẹ ikọ̀ ninu ẹ̀wọn: ki emi ki o le mã fi igboiya sọ̀rọ ninu rẹ̀, gẹgẹ bi o ti tọ́ fun mi lati mã sọ.
entries.en: For which I am an ambassador in bonds: that therein I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ki ẹnyin pẹlu ki o le mọ̀ bi nkan ti ri fun mi, bi mo ti nṣe si, Tikiku arakunrin olufẹ ati iranṣẹ olõtọ ninu Oluwa, yio sọ ohun gbogbo di mimọ̀ fun nyin:
entries.en: But that ye also may know my affairs, and how I do, Tychicus, a beloved brother and faithful minister in the Lord, shall make known to you all things:

entries.yo: Ẹniti mo rán si nyin nitori eyi kanna, ki ẹ le mọ bi a ti wà, ki on ki o le tu ọkàn nyin ninu.
entries.en: Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that ye might know our affairs, and that he might comfort your hearts.

entries.yo: Alafia fun awọn ará, ati ifẹ pẹlu igbagbọ́, lati ọdọ Ọlọrun Baba wá, ati Oluwa Jesu Kristi.
