entries.en: Peace be to the brethren, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

entries.yo: Ki ore-ọfẹ wà pẹlu gbogbo awọn ti o fẹ Oluwa wa Jesu Kristi li aiṣẹ̀tan.
entries.en: Grace be with all them that love our Lord Jesus Christ in sincerity. Amen.

entries.yo: PAULU ati Timotiu, awọn iranṣẹ Jesu Kristi, si gbogbo awọn enia mimọ́ ninu Kristi Jesu ti o wà ni Filippi, pẹlu awọn biṣopu ati awọn diakoni:
entries.en: Paul and Timotheus, the servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus which are at Philippi, with the bishops and deacons:

entries.yo: Ore-ọfẹ si nyin, ati alafia, lati ọdọ Ọlọrun Baba wa, ati Oluwa Jesu Kristi.
entries.en: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.

entries.yo: Mo dupẹ lọwọ Ọlọrun mi fun gbogbo iranti nyin ti mo nṣe,
entries.en: I thank my God upon every remembrance of you,

entries.yo: Nigbagbogbo ninu gbogbo adura mi fun nyin li emi nfi ayọ̀ bẹ̀bẹ,
entries.en: Always in every prayer of mine for you all making request with joy,

entries.yo: Nitori ìdapọ nyin ninu ihinrere lati ọjọ kini wá titi fi di isisiyi.
entries.en: For your fellowship in the gospel from the first day until now;

entries.yo: Ohun kan yi sa da mi loju, pe ẹniti o ti bẹ̀rẹ iṣẹ rere ninu nyin, yio ṣe aṣepe rẹ̀ titi fi di ọjọ Jesu Kristi:
entries.en: Being confident of this very thing, that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ:

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi o ti tọ́ fun mi lati rò eyi fun gbogbo nyin, nitoriti ọkàn nyin wà lọdọ mi, niwọn bi o ti ṣepe gbogbo nyin ni iṣe alabapin ore-ọfẹ pẹlu mi ninu idè mi ati ninu idahùn-ẹjọ mi ati ifẹsẹmulẹ ihinrere.
entries.en: Even as it is meet for me to think this of you all, because I have you in my heart; inasmuch as both in my bonds, and in the defence and confirmation of the gospel, ye all are partakers of my grace.

entries.yo: Nitori Ọlọrun li ẹlẹri mi, bi mo ti nṣafẹri nyin to gidigidi ninu iyọ́nu Jesu Kristi.
entries.en: For God is my record, how greatly I long after you all in the bowels of Jesus Christ.

entries.yo: Eyi si ni mo ngbadura fun pe, ki ifẹ nyin ki o le mã pọ si i siwaju ati siwaju ninu imọ̀ ati imoye gbogbo.
entries.en: And this I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and in all judgment;

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o le dán ohun ti o yàtọ wò; ki ẹ si jasi olododo ati alaijẹ-ohun-ikọsẹ titi fi di ọjọ Jesu Kristi;
entries.en: That ye may approve things that are excellent; that ye may be sincere and without offence till the day of Christ;

entries.yo: Lẹhin igbati ẹ ti kun fun eso ododo lati ọdọ Jesu Kristi, fun ogo ati iyìn Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Being filled with the fruits of righteousness, which are by Jesus Christ, unto the glory and praise of God.

entries.yo: Njẹ emi fẹ ki ẹnyin ki o mọ̀, ará, pe nkan wọnni ti o de bá mi, o kuku yọri si ilọsiwaju ihinrere;
entries.en: But I would ye should understand, brethren, that the things which happened unto me have fallen out rather unto the furtherance of the gospel;

entries.yo: Tobẹ ti idè mi gbogbo farahan ninu Kristi larin awọn ọmọ-ogun ãfin ati gbogbo awọn ẹlomiran;
entries.en: So that my bonds in Christ are manifest in all the palace, and in all other places;

entries.yo: Ati pe ọ̀pọlọpọ awọn arakunrin ninu Oluwa, ti o ni igbẹkẹle si ìde mi nfi igboiya gidigidi sọrọ Ọlọrun laibẹru.
entries.en: And many of the brethren in the Lord, waxing confident by my bonds, are much more bold to speak the word without fear.

entries.yo: Nitotọ awọn ẹlomiran tilẹ nfi ija ati ilara wasu Kristi; awọn ẹlomiran si nfi inu rere ṣe e.
entries.en: Some indeed preach Christ even of envy and strife; and some also of good will:

entries.yo: Awọn kan nfi ìja wasu Kristi, kì iṣe pẹlu õtọ inu, nwọn ngbèro lati fi ipọnju kún ìde mi:
entries.en: The one preach Christ of contention, not sincerely, supposing to add affliction to my bonds:

entries.yo: Awọn kan ẹwẹ si nfi ifẹ ṣe e, nitoriti nwọn mọ̀ pe a gbe mi dide fun idahun-ẹjọ ihinrere.
entries.en: But the other of love, knowing that I am set for the defence of the gospel.

entries.yo: Njẹ kini? bikoṣepe nibi gbogbo, iba ṣe niti àfẹ̀tànṣe tabi niti otitọ, a sa nwasu Kristi; emi si nyọ̀ nitorina, nitõtọ, emi ó si ma yọ̀.
entries.en: What then? notwithstanding, every way, whether in pretence, or in truth, Christ is preached; and I therein do rejoice, yea, and will rejoice.

entries.yo: Nitoriti mo mọ̀ pe eyi ni yio yọri si igbala fun mi lati inu adura nyin wá, ati ifikún Ẹmí Jesu Kristi,
entries.en: For I know that this shall turn to my salvation through your prayer, and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi ìnàgà ati ireti mi pe ki oju ki o máṣe tì mi li ohunkohun, ṣugbọn pẹlu igboiya gbogbo, bi nigbagbogbo, bẹ̃ nisisiyi pẹlu a o gbé Kristi ga lara mi, ibã ṣe nipa ìye, tabi nipa ikú.
entries.en: According to my earnest expectation and my hope, that in nothing I shall be ashamed, but that with all boldness, as always, so now also Christ shall be magnified in my body, whether it be by life, or by death.

entries.yo: Nitori, niti emi, lati wà lãye jẹ Kristi, lati kú jẹ ere.
entries.en: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi lati wà lãye ninu ara ba jẹ eso iṣẹ mi, nigbana ohun ti emi o yàn, emi kò mọ.
entries.en: But if I live in the flesh, this is the fruit of my labour: yet what I shall choose I wot not.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi mbẹ ni iyemeji, mo ni ifẹ lati lọ ati lati wà lọdọ Kristi; nitori o dara pupọ ju:
entries.en: For I am in a strait betwixt two, having a desire to depart, and to be with Christ; which is far better:

entries.yo: Sibẹ lati wà ninu ara jẹ anfani nitori ti nyin.
entries.en: Nevertheless to abide in the flesh is more needful for you.

entries.yo: Bi eyi si ti da mi loju, mo mọ̀ pe emi ó duro, emi ó si mã bá gbogbo nyin gbé fun ilọsiwaju ati ayọ̀ nyin ninu igbagbọ;
entries.en: And having this confidence, I know that I shall abide and continue with you all for your furtherance and joy of faith;

entries.yo: Ki iṣogo nyin ki o le di pupọ gidigidi ninu Jesu Kristi ninu mi nipa ipada wá mi sọdọ nyin.
entries.en: That your rejoicing may be more abundant in Jesus Christ for me by my coming to you again.

entries.yo: Kìki ki ẹ sá jẹ ki ìwa-aiye nyin ki o mã ri gẹgẹ bi ihinrere Kristi: pe yala bi mo tilẹ wá wò nyin, tabi bi emi kò si, ki emi ki o le mã gburó bi ẹ ti nṣe, pe ẹnyin duro ṣinṣin ninu Ẹmí kan, ẹnyin jùmọ njijakadi nitori igbagbọ́ ihinrere, pẹlu ọkàn kan;
entries.en: Only let your conversation be as it becometh the gospel of Christ: that whether I come and see you, or else be absent, I may hear of your affairs, that ye stand fast in one spirit, with one mind striving together for the faith of the gospel;

entries.yo: Ki ẹ má si jẹ ki awọn ọta dẹruba nyin li ohunkohun: eyiti iṣe àmi ti o daju fun iparun wọn, ṣugbọn ti igbala nyin, ati eyini ni lati ọwọ́ Ọlọrun wá.
entries.en: And in nothing terrified by your adversaries: which is to them an evident token of perdition, but to you of salvation, and that of God.

entries.yo: Nitori niti Kristi, ẹnyin li a ti yọnda fun, kì iṣe lati gbà a gbọ́ nikan, ṣugbọn lati jìya nitori rẹ̀ pẹlu:
entries.en: For unto you it is given in the behalf of Christ, not only to believe on him, but also to suffer for his sake;

entries.yo: Ẹ si ni ìja kanna ti ẹnyin ti ri ninu mi, ti ẹnyin si gbọ́ nisisiyi pe o wà ninu mi.
entries.en: Having the same conflict which ye saw in me, and now hear to be in me.

entries.yo: NITORINA bi itunu kan ba wà ninu Kristi, bi iṣipẹ ifẹ kan ba si wà, bi ìdapọ ti Ẹmí kan ba wà, bi ìyọ́nu-anu ati iṣeun ba wà,
entries.en: If there be therefore any consolation in Christ, if any comfort of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any bowels and mercies,

entries.yo: Ẹ mu ayọ̀ mi kún, ki ẹnyin ki o le jẹ oninu kanna, ki imọ̀ nyin ki o ṣọkan, ki ẹ si ni ọkàn kan.
entries.en: Fulfil ye my joy, that ye be likeminded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind.

entries.yo: Ẹ máṣe fi ìja tabi ogo asan ṣe ohunkohun: ṣugbọn ni irẹlẹ ọkàn ki olukuluku ro awọn ẹlomiran si ẹniti o san ju on tikararẹ̀ lọ.
entries.en: Let nothing be done through strife or vainglory; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves.

entries.yo: Ki olukuluku nyin ki o máṣe wo ohun tirẹ̀, ṣugbọn olukuluku ohun ti ẹlomiran.
entries.en: Look not every man on his own things, but every man also on the things of others.

entries.yo: Ẹ ni ero yi ninu nyin, eyi ti o ti wà pẹlu ninu Kristi Jesu:
entries.en: Let this mind be in you, which was also in Christ Jesus:

entries.yo: Ẹniti o tilẹ jẹ aworan Ọlọrun, ti kò ka a si iwọra lati ba Ọlọrun dọgba:
entries.en: Who, being in the form of God, thought it not robbery to be equal with God:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn o bọ́ ogo rẹ̀ silẹ, o si mu awọ̀ iranṣẹ, a si ṣe e ni awòran enia.
entries.en: But made himself of no reputation, and took upon him the form of a servant, and was made in the likeness of men:

entries.yo: Nigbati a si ti ri i ni ìri enia, o rẹ̀ ara rẹ̀ silẹ, o si tẹriba titi di oju ikú, ani ikú ori agbelebu.
entries.en: And being found in fashion as a man, he humbled himself, and became obedient unto death, even the death of the cross.

entries.yo: Nitorina Ọlọrun pẹlu si ti gbé e ga gidigidi, o si ti fi orukọ kan fun u ti o bori gbogbo orukọ:
entries.en: Wherefore God also hath highly exalted him, and given him a name which is above every name:

entries.yo: Pe, li orukọ Jesu ni ki gbogbo ẽkun ki o mã kunlẹ, awọn ẹniti mbẹ li ọrun, ati awọn ẹniti mbẹ ni ilẹ, ati awọn ẹniti mbẹ nisalẹ ilẹ;
entries.en: That at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of things in heaven, and things in earth, and things under the earth;

entries.yo: Ati pe ki gbogbo ahọn ki o mã jẹwọ pe, Jesu Kristi ni Oluwa, fun ogo Ọlọrun Baba.
entries.en: And that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

entries.yo: Nitorina ẹnyin olufẹ mi, gẹgẹ bi ẹnyin ti ngbọran nigbagbogbo, kì iṣe nigbati mo wà lọdọ nyin nikan, ṣugbọn papa nisisiyi ti emi kò si, ẹ mã ṣiṣẹ igbala nyin yọri pẹlu ìbẹru ati iwarìri,
entries.en: Wherefore, my beloved, as ye have always obeyed, not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.

entries.yo: Nitoripe Ọlọrun ni nṣiṣẹ ninu nyin, lati fẹ ati lati ṣiṣẹ fun ifẹ inu rere rẹ̀.
entries.en: For it is God which worketh in you both to will and to do of his good pleasure.

entries.yo: Ẹ mã ṣe ohun gbogbo li aisi ikùnsinu ati ijiyan.
entries.en: Do all things without murmurings and disputings:

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o le jẹ alailẹgàn ati oniwa tutu, ọmọ Ọlọrun, alailabawọn, larin oniwà wíwọ ati alarekereke orilẹ-ede, larin awọn ẹniti a nri nyin bi imọlẹ li aiye;
entries.en: That ye may be blameless and harmless, the sons of God, without rebuke, in the midst of a crooked and perverse nation, among whom ye shine as lights in the world;

entries.yo: Ẹ si mã na ọwọ ọ̀rọ ìye jade; ki emi ki o le ṣogo li ọjọ Kristi pe emi kò sáre lasan, bẹni emi kò si ṣe lãlã lasan.
entries.en: Holding forth the word of life; that I may rejoice in the day of Christ, that I have not run in vain, neither laboured in vain.

entries.yo: Ani, bi a tilẹ tú mi dà sori ẹbọ ati iṣẹ isin igbagbọ́ nyin, mo yọ̀, mo si mba gbogbo nyin yọ̀ pẹlu.
entries.en: Yea, and if I be offered upon the sacrifice and service of your faith, I joy, and rejoice with you all.

entries.yo: Bakanna ni ki ẹnyin ki o mã yọ̀, ki ẹ si mã ba mi yọ̀ pẹlu.
entries.en: For the same cause also do ye joy, and rejoice with me.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn mo ni ireti ninu Jesu Oluwa, lati rán Timotiu si nyin ni lọ̃lọ yi, ki emi pẹlu le ni ifọkanbalẹ nigbati mo ba gburó ijoko nyin.
entries.en: But I trust in the Lord Jesus to send Timotheus shortly unto you, that I also may be of good comfort, when I know your state.

entries.yo: Nitori emi kò ni ẹni oninu kanna ti o dabi rẹ̀, ti yio ma fi tinutinu ṣe aniyan nyin.
entries.en: For I have no man likeminded, who will naturally care for your state.

entries.yo: Nitori gbogbo wọn ni ntọju nkan ti ara wọn, kì iṣe nkan ti iṣe ti Jesu Kristi.
entries.en: For all seek their own, not the things which are Jesus Christ's.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹnyin ti mọ̀ ọ dajudaju, pe gẹgẹ bi ọmọ lọdọ baba rẹ̀, bẹ̃li o si ti mba mi ṣiṣẹ pọ̀ ninu ihinrere.
entries.en: But ye know the proof of him, that, as a son with the father, he hath served with me in the gospel.

entries.yo: Nitorina on ni mo ni ireti lati rán si nyin nisisiyi, nigbati mo ba woye bi yio ti ri fun mi.
entries.en: Him therefore I hope to send presently, so soon as I shall see how it will go with me.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn mo gbẹkẹle Oluwa, pe emi tikarami pẹlu yio wá ni lọ̃lọ.
entries.en: But I trust in the Lord that I also myself shall come shortly.

entries.yo: Mo ka a si pe n ko le ṣairan Epafroditu arakunrin mi si nyin, ati olubaṣiṣẹ mi ati ọmọ-ogun ẹgbẹ mi, ṣugbọn iranṣẹ nyin, ati ẹniti nṣe iranṣẹ fun mi ninu aini mi.
entries.en: Yet I supposed it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, and companion in labour, and fellowsoldier, but your messenger, and he that ministered to my wants.

entries.yo: Nitoriti ọkàn rẹ̀ fà si gbogbo nyin, o si kún fun ibanujẹ, nitoriti ẹnyin ti gbọ́ pe on ti ṣe aisan.
entries.en: For he longed after you all, and was full of heaviness, because that ye had heard that he had been sick.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ li o ti ṣe aisan titi de oju ikú: ṣugbọn Ọlọrun ti ṣãnu fun u; kì si iṣe fun on nikan, ṣugbọn fun mi pẹlu, ki emi ki o màṣe ni ibanujẹ lori ibanujẹ.
entries.en: For indeed he was sick nigh unto death: but God had mercy on him; and not on him only, but on me also, lest I should have sorrow upon sorrow.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni mo ṣe fi titara-titara rán a, pe nigbati ẹnyin ba si tún ri i, ki ẹnyin ki o le yọ̀, ati ki ibanujẹ mi ki o le dínkù.
entries.en: I sent him therefore the more carefully, that, when ye see him again, ye may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.

entries.yo: Nitorina ẹ fi ayọ̀ pupọ gbà a nipa ti Oluwa; ki ẹ si ma bù ọlá fun irú awọn ẹni bẹ̃:
entries.en: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all gladness; and hold such in reputation:

entries.yo: Nitoripe nitori iṣẹ Kristi li o ṣe sunmọ ẹnu-ọ̀na ikú, ti kò si kà ẹmí ara rẹ̀ si, lati mu aitó iṣẹ isin nyin si mi kun.
entries.en: Because for the work of Christ he was nigh unto death, not regarding his life, to supply your lack of service toward me.

entries.yo: LI akotan, ará, ẹ mã yọ̀ ninu Oluwa. Kì iṣe inira fun mi lati kọwe ohun kanna si nyin, ṣugbọn fun nyin o jẹ ailewu.
entries.en: Finally, my brethren, rejoice in the Lord. To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not grievous, but for you it is safe.

entries.yo: Ẹ kiyesara lọdọ awọn ajá, ẹ kiyesara lọdọ awọn oniṣẹ-buburu, ẹ kiyesara lọdọ awọn onilà.
entries.en: Beware of dogs, beware of evil workers, beware of the concision.

entries.yo: Nitori awa ni onilà, ti nsìn Ọlọrun nipa ti Ẹmí, awa si nṣogo ninu Kristi Jesu, awa kò si ni igbẹkẹle ninu ẹran-ara;
entries.en: For we are the circumcision, which worship God in the spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh.

entries.yo: Bi emi tikarami tilẹ ni igbẹkẹle ninu ara. Bi ẹnikẹni ba rò pe on ni igbẹkẹle ninu ara, temi tilẹ ju:
entries.en: Though I might also have confidence in the flesh. If any other man thinketh that he hath whereof he might trust in the flesh, I more:

entries.yo: Ẹniti a kọ nilà ni ijọ kẹjọ, lati inu kukuté Israeli wá, lati inu ẹ̀ya Benjamini, Heberu lati inu Heberu wá; niti ofin, Farisi li emi;
entries.en: Circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, an Hebrew of the Hebrews; as touching the law, a Pharisee;

entries.yo: Niti itara, emi nṣe inunibini si ijọ; niti ododo ti o wà ninu ofin, mo jẹ alailẹgan.
entries.en: Concerning zeal, persecuting the church; touching the righteousness which is in the law, blameless.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ohunkohun ti o ti jasi ère fun mi, awọn ni mo ti kà si òfo nitori Kristi.
entries.en: But what things were gain to me, those I counted loss for Christ.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ laiṣe ani-ani mo si kà ohun gbogbo si òfo nitori itayọ ìmọ Kristi Jesu Oluwa mi: nitori ẹniti mo ti ṣòfo ohun gbogbo, mo si kà wọn si igbẹ́, ki emi ki o le jère Kristi,
entries.en: Yea doubtless, and I count all things but loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord: for whom I have suffered the loss of all things, and do count them but dung, that I may win Christ,

entries.yo: Ki a si le bá mi ninu rẹ̀, li aini ododo ti emi tikarami, ti o ti inu ofin wá, ṣugbọn eyi ti o ti inu igbagbọ wá ninu Kristi, ododo ti Ọlọrun nipasẹ igbagbọ́:
entries.en: And be found in him, not having mine own righteousness, which is of the law, but that which is through the faith of Christ, the righteousness which is of God by faith:

entries.yo: Ki emi ki o le mọ̀ ọ, ati agbara ajinde rẹ̀, ati alabapin ninu ìya rẹ̀, nigbati mo ba faramọ ikú rẹ̀;
entries.en: That I may know him, and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, being made conformable unto his death;

entries.yo: Bi o le ṣe ki emi ki o le de ibi ajinde awọn okú.
entries.en: If by any means I might attain unto the resurrection of the dead.

entries.yo: Kì iṣe pe ọwọ mi ti tẹ ẹ na, tabi mo ti di pipé: ṣugbọn emi nlepa nṣo, bi ọwọ́ mi yio le tẹ̀ ère na, nitori eyiti a ti di mi mu pẹlu, lati ọdọ Kristi Jesu wá.
entries.en: Not as though I had already attained, either were already perfect: but I follow after, if that I may apprehend that for which also I am apprehended of Christ Jesus.

entries.yo: Ará emi kò kà ara mi si ẹniti ọwọ́ rẹ̀ ti tẹ̀ ẹ na: ṣugbọn ohun kan yi li emi nṣe, emi ngbagbé awọn nkan ti o wà lẹhin, mo si nnàgà wò awọn nkan ti o wà niwaju,
entries.en: Brethren, I count not myself to have apprehended: but this one thing I do, forgetting those things which are behind, and reaching forth unto those things which are before,

entries.yo: Emi nlepa lati de opin ire-ije nì fun ère ìpe giga Ọlọrun ninu Kristi Jesu.
entries.en: I press toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.

entries.yo: Nitorina, ẹ jẹ ki iye awa ti iṣe ẹni pipé ni ero yi: bi ẹnyin bá si ni ero miran ninu ohunkohun, eyi na pẹlu ni Ọlọrun yio fi hàn nyin.
entries.en: Let us therefore, as many as be perfect, be thus minded: and if in any thing ye be otherwise minded, God shall reveal even this unto you.

entries.yo: Kiki pe, ibiti a ti de na, ẹ jẹ ki a mã rìn li oju ọna kanna, ki a ni ero kanna.
entries.en: Nevertheless, whereto we have already attained, let us walk by the same rule, let us mind the same thing.

entries.yo: Ará, ẹ jumọ ṣe afarawe mi, ẹ si ṣe akiyesi awọn ti nrìn bẹ̃, ani bi ẹ ti ni wa fun apẹrẹ.
entries.en: Brethren, be followers together of me, and mark them which walk so as ye have us for an ensample.

entries.yo: (Nitori ọ̀pọlọpọ ni nrìn, nipasẹ awọn ẹniti mo ti nwi fun nyin nigbakugba, ani, ti mo si nsọkun bi mo ti nwi fun nyin nisisiyi, pe, ọtá agbelebu Kristi ni nwọn:
entries.en: (For many walk, of whom I have told you often, and now tell you even weeping, that they are the enemies of the cross of Christ:

entries.yo: Igbẹhin ẹniti iṣe iparun, ikùn ẹniti iṣe ọlọrun wọn, ati ogo ẹniti o wà ninu itiju wọn, awọn ẹniti ntọju ohun aiye.)
entries.en: Whose end is destruction, whose God is their belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who mind earthly things.)

entries.yo: Nitori ilu-ibilẹ wa mbẹ li ọrun: lati ibiti awa pẹlu gbé nfojusọna fun Olugbala, Jesu Kristi Oluwa:
entries.en: For our conversation is in heaven; from whence also we look for the Saviour, the Lord Jesus Christ:

entries.yo: Ẹniti yio sọ ara irẹlẹ wa di ọ̀tun ki o le bá ara ogo rẹ̀ mu, gẹgẹ bi iṣẹ-agbara nipasẹ eyiti on le fi tẹ ori ohun gbogbo ba fun ara rẹ̀.
entries.en: Who shall change our vile body, that it may be fashioned like unto his glorious body, according to the working whereby he is able even to subdue all things unto himself.

entries.yo: NITORINA, ẹnyin ará mi olufẹ, ti mo si nṣafẹri gidigidi, ayọ̀ ati ade mi, ẹ duro ṣinṣin bẹ̃ ninu Oluwa, ẹnyin olufẹ mi.
entries.en: Therefore, my brethren dearly beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, so stand fast in the Lord, my dearly beloved.

entries.yo: Emi mbẹ̀ Euodia, mo si mbẹ̀ Sintike, ki nwọn ni inu kanna ninu Oluwa.
entries.en: I beseech Euodias, and beseech Syntyche, that they be of the same mind in the Lord.

entries.yo: Mo si bẹ ọ pẹlu, bi alajọru-ajaga mi tõtọ, ran awọn obinrin wọnni lọwọ, nitori nwọn mba mi ṣiṣẹ pọ̀ ninu ihinrere, ati Klementi pẹlu, ati awọn olubaṣiṣẹ mi iyoku pẹlu, orukọ awọn ti mbẹ ninu iwe ìye.
entries.en: And I intreat thee also, true yokefellow, help those women which laboured with me in the gospel, with Clement also, and with other my fellowlabourers, whose names are in the book of life.

entries.yo: Ẹ mã yọ̀ ninu Oluwa nigbagbogbo: mo si tún wi, Ẹ mã yọ̀.
entries.en: Rejoice in the Lord alway: and again I say, Rejoice.

entries.yo: Ẹ jẹ ki ipamọra nyin di mimọ̀ fun gbogbo enia. Oluwa mbẹ nitosi.
entries.en: Let your moderation be known unto all men. The Lord is at hand.

entries.yo: Ẹ máṣe aniyàn ohunkohun; ṣugbọn ninu ohun gbogbo, nipa adura ati ẹbẹ pẹlu idupẹ, ẹ mã fi ìbere nyin hàn fun Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.

entries.yo: Ati alafia Ọlọrun, ti o jù ìmọran gbogbo lọ, yio ṣọ ọkàn ati ero nyin ninu Kristi Jesu.
entries.en: And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.

entries.yo: Li akotan, ará, ohunkohun ti iṣe õtọ, ohunkohun ti iṣe ọ̀wọ, ohunkohun ti iṣe titọ́, ohunkohun ti iṣe mimọ́, ohunkohun ti iṣe fifẹ, ohunkohun ti o ni irohin rere; bi ìwa titọ́ kan ba wà, bi iyìn kan ba si wà, ẹ mã gbà nkan wọnyi rò.
entries.en: Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honest, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report; if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, think on these things.

entries.yo: Nkan wọnni, ti ẹnyin ti kọ́, ti ẹnyin si ti gbà, ti ẹnyin si ti gbọ́, ti ẹnyin si ti ri lọwọ mi, ẹ mã ṣe wọn: Ọlọrun alafia yio si wà pẹlu nyin.
entries.en: Those things, which ye have both learned, and received, and heard, and seen in me, do: and the God of peace shall be with you.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi yọ̀ gidigidi ninu Oluwa pe, asiwá-asibọ̀ ero nyin tun sọji fun mi, eyiti ẹ ti nro nitotọ, ṣugbọn ẹnyin kò ni akokò ti o wọ̀.
entries.en: But I rejoiced in the Lord greatly, that now at the last your care of me hath flourished again; wherein ye were also careful, but ye lacked opportunity.

entries.yo: Kì iṣe pe emi nsọ nitori aini: nitoripe ipòkipo ti mo ba wà, mo ti kọ́ lati ni itẹlọrùn ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: Not that I speak in respect of want: for I have learned, in whatsoever state I am, therewith to be content.

entries.yo: Mo mọ̀ bi ã ti iṣe di rirẹ̀-silẹ, mo mọ bi ã ti iṣe di pupọ: li ohunkohun ati li ohun gbogbo mo ti kọ́ aṣiri ati mã jẹ ajẹyó ati lati wà li aijẹ, lati mã ni anijù ati lati ṣe alaini.
entries.en: I know both how to be abased, and I know how to abound: every where and in all things I am instructed both to be full and to be hungry, both to abound and to suffer need.

entries.yo: Emi le ṣe ohun gbogbo ninu Kristi ẹniti nfi agbara fun mi.
entries.en: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹnyin ṣeun gidigidi niti pe ẹnyin ṣe alabapin ninu ipọnju mi.
entries.en: Notwithstanding ye have well done, that ye did communicate with my affliction.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin papa si mọ̀ pẹlu, ẹnyin ara Filippi, pe li ibẹrẹ ihinrere, nigbati mo kuro ni Makedonia, kò si ijọ kan ti o ba mi ṣe alabapin niti gbigbà ati fifunni, bikoṣe ẹnyin nikanṣoṣo.
entries.en: Now ye Philippians know also, that in the beginning of the gospel, when I departed from Macedonia, no church communicated with me as concerning giving and receiving, but ye only.

entries.yo: Nitori ni Tessalonika gidi, ẹnyin ranṣẹ, ẹ si tun ranṣẹ fun aini mi.
entries.en: For even in Thessalonica ye sent once and again unto my necessity.

entries.yo: Kì iṣe nitoriti emi nfẹ ẹ̀bun na: ṣugbọn emi nfẹ eso ti yio mã di pupọ nitori nyin.
entries.en: Not because I desire a gift: but I desire fruit that may abound to your account.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn mo ni ohun gbogbo, mo si ti di pupọ: mo si kún nigbati mo ti gbà nkan wọnni ti a ti rán lati ọdọ nyin wá lọwọ Epafroditu, ọrẹ olõrùn didùn, ẹbọ itẹwọgbà, ti iṣe inu didùn gidigidi si Ọlọrun.
entries.en: But I have all, and abound: I am full, having received of Epaphroditus the things which were sent from you, an odour of a sweet smell, a sacrifice acceptable, wellpleasing to God.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Ọlọrun mi yio pèse ni kikún fun gbogbo aini nyin, gẹgẹ bi ọrọ̀ rẹ̀ ninu ogo ninu Kristi Jesu.
entries.en: But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ogo ni fun Ọlọrun ati Baba wa lai ati lailai. Amin.
entries.en: Now unto God and our Father be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

entries.yo: Ẹ kí olukuluku enia mimọ́ ninu Kristi Jesu. Awọn ara ti o wà pẹlu mi kí nyin.
entries.en: Salute every saint in Christ Jesus. The brethren which are with me greet you.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn enia mimọ́ kí nyin, papa awọn ti iṣe ti agbo ile Kesari.
entries.en: All the saints salute you, chiefly they that are of Caesar's household.

entries.yo: Ore-ọfẹ Jesu Kristi Oluwa wa, ki o wà pẹlu ẹmi nyin. Amin.
entries.en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

entries.yo: A kọ ọ si awọn ara Filippi lati Romu lọ lati ọwọ́ Epafroditu.
PAULU, Aposteli Jesu Kristi nipa ifẹ Ọlọrun, ati Timotiu arakunrin wa,
entries.en: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timotheus our brother,

entries.yo: Si awọn enia mimọ́ ati awọn ará wa olõtọ ninu Kristi ti o wà ni Kolosse: Ore-ọfẹ fun nyin, ati alafia, lati ọdọ Ọlọrun Baba wa, ati Jesu Kristi Oluwa.
entries.en: To the saints and faithful brethren in Christ which are at Colosse: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

entries.yo: Awa ndupẹ lọwọ Ọlọrun ati Baba Jesu Kristi Oluwa wa, awa si ngbadura fun nyin nigbagbogbo,
entries.en: We give thanks to God and the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,

entries.yo: Nigbati awa gburó igbagbọ́ nyin ninu Kristi Jesu, ati ifẹ ti ẹnyin ni si gbogbo awọn enia mimọ́,
entries.en: Since we heard of your faith in Christ Jesus, and of the love which ye have to all the saints,

entries.yo: Nitori ireti ti a gbé kalẹ fun nyin li ọrun, nipa eyiti ẹnyin ti gbọ́ ṣaju ninu ọ̀rọ otitọ ti ihinrere,
entries.en: For the hope which is laid up for you in heaven, whereof ye heard before in the word of the truth of the gospel;

entries.yo: Eyiti o de ọdọ nyin, ani bi o ti nso eso pẹlu ni gbogbo aiye ti o si npọ si i, bi o ti nṣe ninu nyin pẹlu, lati ọjọ ti ẹnyin ti gbọ́, ti ẹnyin si ti mọ̀ ore-ọfẹ Ọlọrun li otitọ:
entries.en: Which is come unto you, as it is in all the world; and bringeth forth fruit, as it doth also in you, since the day ye heard of it, and knew the grace of God in truth:

entries.yo: Ani bi ẹnyin ti kọ́ lọdọ Epafra iranṣẹ ẹlẹgbẹ wa olufẹ, ẹniti iṣe olõtọ iranṣẹ Kristi nipo wa,
entries.en: As ye also learned of Epaphras our dear fellowservant, who is for you a faithful minister of Christ;

entries.yo: Ti o si ròhin ifẹ nyin ninu Ẹmí fun wa pẹlu.
entries.en: Who also declared unto us your love in the Spirit.

entries.yo: Nitori eyi, lati ọjọ ti awa ti gbọ, awa pẹlu kò simi lati mã gbadura ati lati mã bẹ̀bẹ fun nyin pe ki ẹnyin ki o le kún fun ìmọ ifẹ rẹ̀ ninu ọgbọ́n ati imoye gbogbo ti iṣe ti Ẹmí;
entries.en: For this cause we also, since the day we heard it, do not cease to pray for you, and to desire that ye might be filled with the knowledge of his will in all wisdom and spiritual understanding;

entries.yo: Ki ẹ le mã rìn ni yiyẹ niti Oluwa si ìwu gbogbo, ki ẹ ma so eso ninu iṣẹ rere gbogbo, ki ẹ si mã pọ si i ninu ìmọ Ọlọrun;
entries.en: That ye might walk worthy of the Lord unto all pleasing, being fruitful in every good work, and increasing in the knowledge of God;

entries.yo: Ki a fi ipá gbogbo sọ nyin di alagbara, gẹgẹ bi agbara ogo rẹ̀, sinu suru ati ipamọra gbogbo pẹlu ayọ̀;
entries.en: Strengthened with all might, according to his glorious power, unto all patience and longsuffering with joyfulness;

entries.yo: Ki a mã dupẹ lọwọ Baba, ẹniti o mu wa yẹ lati jẹ alabapin ninu ogún awọn enia mimọ́ ninu imọlẹ:
entries.en: Giving thanks unto the Father, which hath made us meet to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light:

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ti gbà wa kuro lọwọ agbara òkunkun, ti o si ṣi wa nipo sinu ijọba ayanfẹ ọmọ rẹ̀:
entries.en: Who hath delivered us from the power of darkness, and hath translated us into the kingdom of his dear Son:

entries.yo: Ninu ẹniti awa ni idande nipa ẹ̀jẹ rẹ̀, ani idariji ẹ̀ṣẹ:
entries.en: In whom we have redemption through his blood, even the forgiveness of sins:

entries.yo: Ẹniti iṣe aworan Ọlọrun ti a kò ri, akọbi gbogbo ẹda:
entries.en: Who is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of every creature:

entries.yo: Nitori ninu rẹ̀ li a ti dá ohun gbogbo, ohun ti mbẹ li ọrun, ati ohun ti mbẹ li aiye, eyiti a ri, ati eyiti a kò ri, nwọn iba ṣe itẹ́, tabi oye, tabi ijọba, tabi ọla: nipasẹ rẹ̀ li a ti dá ohun gbogbo, ati fun u:
entries.en: For by him were all things created, that are in heaven, and that are in earth, visible and invisible, whether they be thrones, or dominions, or principalities, or powers: all things were created by him, and for him:

entries.yo: On si wà ṣaju ohun gbogbo, ati ninu rẹ̀ li ohun gbogbo duro ṣọkan.
entries.en: And he is before all things, and by him all things consist.

entries.yo: On si jẹ ori fun ara, eyini ni ìjọ: ẹniti iṣe ipilẹṣẹ, akọbi lati inu okú wá; pe, ninu ohun gbogbo ki on ki o le ni ipò ti o ga julọ.
entries.en: And he is the head of the body, the church: who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead; that in all things he might have the preeminence.

entries.yo: Nitori didun inu Baba ni pe ki ẹkún gbogbo le mã gbé inu rẹ̀;
entries.en: For it pleased the Father that in him should all fulness dwell;

entries.yo: Ati nipasẹ rẹ̀ lati bá ohun gbogbo lajà, lẹhin ti o ti fi ẹjẹ agbelebu rẹ̀ pari ija; mo ni, nipasẹ rẹ̀, nwọn iba ṣe ohun ti mbẹ li aiye, tabi ohun ti mbẹ li ọrun.
entries.en: And, having made peace through the blood of his cross, by him to reconcile all things unto himself; by him, I say, whether they be things in earth, or things in heaven.

entries.yo: Ati ẹnyin ti o ti jẹ alejò ati ọtá rí li ọkàn nyin ni iṣẹ buburu nyin, ẹnyin li o si ti bá laja nisisiyi,
entries.en: And you, that were sometime alienated and enemies in your mind by wicked works, yet now hath he reconciled

entries.yo: Ninu ara rẹ̀ nipa ikú, lati mu nyin wá iwaju rẹ̀ ni mimọ́ ati ailabawọn ati ainibawi;
entries.en: In the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and unblameable and unreproveable in his sight:

entries.yo: Bi ẹnyin ba duro ninu igbagbọ́, ti ẹ fẹsẹmulẹ ti ẹ si duro ṣinṣin, ti ẹ kò si yẹsẹ kuro ninu ireti ihinrere ti ẹnyin ti gbọ́, eyiti a si ti wasu rẹ̀ ninu gbogbo ẹda ti mbẹ labẹ ọrun, eyiti a fi emi Paulu ṣe iranṣẹ fun.
entries.en: If ye continue in the faith grounded and settled, and be not moved away from the hope of the gospel, which ye have heard, and which was preached to every creature which is under heaven; whereof I Paul am made a minister;

entries.yo: Nisisiyi emi nyọ̀ ninu ìya mi nitori nyin, emi si nmu ipọnju Kristi ti o kù lẹhin kún li ara mi, nitori ara rẹ̀, ti iṣe ìjọ:
entries.en: Who now rejoice in my sufferings for you, and fill up that which is behind of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body's sake, which is the church:

entries.yo: Eyiti a fi emi ṣe iranṣẹ fun, gẹgẹ bi iṣẹ iriju Ọlọrun ti a fifun mi fun nyin lati mu ọ̀rọ Ọlọrun ṣẹ;
entries.en: Whereof I am made a minister, according to the dispensation of God which is given to me for you, to fulfil the word of God;

entries.yo: Ani ohun ijinlẹ ti o ti farasin lati aiyeraiye ati lati irandiran, ṣugbọn ti a ti fihàn nisisiyi fun awọn enia mimọ́ rẹ̀:
entries.en: Even the mystery which hath been hid from ages and from generations, but now is made manifest to his saints:

entries.yo: Awọn ẹniti Ọlọrun fẹ lati fi ọrọ̀ ohun ijinlẹ yi larin awọn Keferi hàn fun, ti iṣe Kristi ninu nyin, ireti ogo:
entries.en: To whom God would make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles; which is Christ in you, the hope of glory:

entries.yo: Ẹniti awa nwasu rẹ̀ ti a nkìlọ fun olukuluku enia, ti a si nkọ́ olukuluku enia ninu ọgbọ́n gbogbo; ki a le mu olukuluku enia wá ni ìwa pipé ninu Kristi Jesu:
entries.en: Whom we preach, warning every man, and teaching every man in all wisdom; that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus:

entries.yo: Eyiti emi nṣe lãlã ti mo si njijakadi fun pẹlu, gẹgẹ bi iṣẹ agbara rẹ̀, ti nfi agbara ṣiṣẹ gidigidi ninu mi.
entries.en: Whereunto I also labour, striving according to his working, which worketh in me mightily.

entries.yo: NITORI emi nfẹ ki ẹnyin ki o mọ̀ bi iwaya-ìja ti mo ni fun nyin ti pọ̀ to, ati fun awọn ará Laodikea, ati fun iye awọn ti kò ti iri oju mi nipa ti ara;
entries.en: For I would that ye knew what great conflict I have for you, and for them at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;

entries.yo: Ki a le tu ọkàn wọn ninu, bi a ti so wọn pọ̀ ninu ifẹ ati si gbogbo ọrọ̀ ẹ̀kún oye ti o daju, si imọ̀ ohun ijinlẹ Ọlọrun ani Kristi;
entries.en: That their hearts might be comforted, being knit together in love, and unto all riches of the full assurance of understanding, to the acknowledgement of the mystery of God, and of the Father, and of Christ;

entries.yo: Inu ẹniti a ti fi gbogbo iṣura ọgbọ́n ati ti ìmọ pamọ́ si.
entries.en: In whom are hid all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.

entries.yo: Eyi ni mo si nwi, ki ẹnikẹni ki o má bã fi ọ̀rọ ẹtàn mu nyin ṣina.
entries.en: And this I say, lest any man should beguile you with enticing words.

entries.yo: Nitoripe bi emi kò tilẹ si lọdọ nyin li ara, ṣugbọn emi mbẹ lọdọ nyin li ẹmí, mo nyọ̀, mo si nkiyesi eto nyin, ati iduroṣinṣin igbagbọ́ nyin ninu Kristi.
entries.en: For though I be absent in the flesh, yet am I with you in the spirit, joying and beholding your order, and the stedfastness of your faith in Christ.

entries.yo: Nitorina bi ẹnyin ti gbà Kristi Jesu Oluwa, bẹ̃ni ki ẹ mã rìn ninu rẹ̀:
entries.en: As ye have therefore received Christ Jesus the Lord, so walk ye in him:

entries.yo: Ki ẹ fi gbongbo mulẹ, ki a si gbe nyin ro ninu rẹ̀, ki ẹ si fi ẹsẹ mulẹ ninu igbagbọ nyin, gẹgẹ bi a ti kọ́ nyin, ki ẹ si mã pọ̀ ninu rẹ̀ pẹlu idupẹ.
entries.en: Rooted and built up in him, and stablished in the faith, as ye have been taught, abounding therein with thanksgiving.

entries.yo: Ẹ mã kiyesara ki ẹnikẹni ki o máṣe fi ìmọ ati ẹ̀tan asan dì nyin ni igbekun, gẹgẹ bi itan enia, gẹgẹ bi ipilẹṣẹ ẹkọ aiye, ti ki iṣe bi ti Kristi.
entries.en: Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the rudiments of the world, and not after Christ.

entries.yo: Nitoripe ninu rẹ̀ ni gbogbo ẹ̀kún Iwa-Ọlọrun ngbé li ara-iyara.
entries.en: For in him dwelleth all the fulness of the Godhead bodily.

entries.yo: A si ti ṣe nyin ni kikún ninu rẹ̀, ẹniti iṣe ori fun gbogbo ijọba ati agbara:
entries.en: And ye are complete in him, which is the head of all principality and power:

entries.yo: Ninu ẹniti a ti fi ikọla ti a kò fi ọwọ kọ kọ nyin ni ila, ni bibọ ara ẹ̀ṣẹ silẹ, ninu ikọla Kristi:
entries.en: In whom also ye are circumcised with the circumcision made without hands, in putting off the body of the sins of the flesh by the circumcision of Christ:

entries.yo: Bi a si ti sin nyin pọ̀ pẹlu rẹ̀ ninu baptismu, ninu eyiti a si ti jí nyin dide pẹlu rẹ̀ nipa igbagbọ́ ninu iṣẹ Ọlọrun, ẹniti o jí i dide kuro ninu okú.
entries.en: Buried with him in baptism, wherein also ye are risen with him through the faith of the operation of God, who hath raised him from the dead.

entries.yo: Ati ẹnyin, ẹniti o ti kú nitori ẹ̀ṣẹ nyin ati aikọla ara nyin, mo ni, ẹnyin li o si ti sọdi ãye pọ̀ pẹlu rẹ̀, o si ti dari gbogbo ẹ̀ṣẹ nyin jì nyin;
entries.en: And you, being dead in your sins and the uncircumcision of your flesh, hath he quickened together with him, having forgiven you all trespasses;

entries.yo: O si ti pa iwe majẹmu nì rẹ́, ti o lodi si wa, ti a kọ ninu ofin, eyiti o lodi si wa: on li o si ti mu kuro loju ọ̀na, o si kàn a mọ agbelebu;
entries.en: Blotting out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us, and took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross;

entries.yo: O si ti já awọn ijọba ati agbara kuro li ara rẹ̀, o si ti dojuti wọn ni gbangba, o nyọ̀ ayọ̀ iṣẹgun lori wọn ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a shew of them openly, triumphing over them in it.

entries.yo: Nitorina ẹ máṣe jẹ ki ẹnikẹni mã ṣe idajọ nyin niti jijẹ, tabi niti mimu, tabi niti ọjọ ase, tabi oṣù titun, tabi ọjọ isimi:
entries.en: Let no man therefore judge you in meat, or in drink, or in respect of an holyday, or of the new moon, or of the sabbath days:

entries.yo: Awọn ti iṣe ojiji ohun ti mbọ̀; ṣugbọn ti Kristi li ara.
entries.en: Which are a shadow of things to come; but the body is of Christ.

entries.yo: Ẹ máṣe jẹ ki ẹnikẹni fi adabọwọ irẹlẹ ati bibọ awọn angẹli lọ́ ere nyin gbà lọwọ nyin, ẹniti nduro lori nkan wọnni ti o ti ri, ti o nti ipa ero rẹ̀ niti ara ṣeféfe asan,
entries.en: Let no man beguile you of your reward in a voluntary humility and worshipping of angels, intruding into those things which he hath not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,

entries.yo: Ti kò si di Ori nì mu ṣinṣin, lati ọdọ ẹniti a nti ipa orike ati iṣan pese fun gbogbo ara, ti a si nso o ṣọkan pọ, ti o si ndagba nipa ibisi Ọlọrun.
entries.en: And not holding the Head, from which all the body by joints and bands having nourishment ministered, and knit together, increaseth with the increase of God.

entries.yo: Bi ẹnyin ba ti kú pẹlu Kristi kuro ninu ipilẹṣẹ aiye, ẽhatiṣe ti ẹnyin ntẹriba fun ofin bi ẹnipe ẹnyin wà ninu aiye,
entries.en: Wherefore if ye be dead with Christ from the rudiments of the world, why, as though living in the world, are ye subject to ordinances,

entries.yo: Maṣe fọwọkàn, maṣe tọ́wò, maṣe fọwọbà,
entries.en: (Touch not; taste not; handle not;

entries.yo: (Gbogbo eyiti yio ti ipa lilo run), gẹgẹ bi ofin ati ẹkọ́ enia?
entries.en: Which all are to perish with the using;) after the commandments and doctrines of men?

entries.yo: Awọn nkan ti o ni afarawe ọgbọ́n nitõtọ, ni adabọwọ ìsin, ati irẹlẹ, ati ìpọn-ara-loju, ṣugbọn ti kò ni ere kan ninu fun ifẹkufẹ ara.
entries.en: Which things have indeed a shew of wisdom in will worship, and humility, and neglecting of the body; not in any honour to the satisfying of the flesh.

entries.yo: NJẸ bi a ba ti ji nyin dide pẹlu Kristi, ẹ mã ṣafẹri awọn nkan ti mbẹ loke, nibiti Kristi gbé wà ti o joko li ọwọ́ ọtun Ọlọrun.
entries.en: If ye then be risen with Christ, seek those things which are above, where Christ sitteth on the right hand of God.

entries.yo: Ẹ mã ronu awọn nkan ti mbẹ loke kì iṣe awọn nkan ti mbẹ li aiye.
entries.en: Set your affection on things above, not on things on the earth.

entries.yo: Nitori ẹnyin ti kú, a si fi ìye nyin pamọ́ pẹlu Kristi ninu Ọlọrun.
entries.en: For ye are dead, and your life is hid with Christ in God.

entries.yo: Nigbati Kristi, ẹniti iṣe ìye wa yio farahàn, nigbana li ẹnyin pẹlu o farahàn pẹlu rẹ̀ ninu ogo.
entries.en: When Christ, who is our life, shall appear, then shall ye also appear with him in glory.

entries.yo: Nitorina ẹ mã pa ẹ̀ya-ara nyin ti mbẹ li aiye run: àgbere, iwa-ẽri, ifẹkufẹ, ifẹ buburu, ati ojukòkoro, ti iṣe ibọriṣa:
entries.en: Mortify therefore your members which are upon the earth; fornication, uncleanness, inordinate affection, evil concupiscence, and covetousness, which is idolatry:

entries.yo: Nitori ohun tí ibinu Ọlọrun fi mbọ̀wa sori awọn ọmọ alaigbọran.
entries.en: For which things' sake the wrath of God cometh on the children of disobedience:

entries.yo: Ninu eyiti ẹnyin pẹlu ti nrìn nigbakan rí, nigbati ẹnyin ti wà ninu nkan wọnyi.
entries.en: In the which ye also walked some time, when ye lived in them.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nisisiyi, ẹ fi gbogbo wọnyi silẹ pẹlu; ibinu, irunu, arankàn, ọrọ-odi, ati ọrọ itiju kuro li ẹnu nyin.
entries.en: But now ye also put off all these; anger, wrath, malice, blasphemy, filthy communication out of your mouth.

entries.yo: Ẹ má si ṣe purọ́ fun ẹnikeji nyin, ẹnyin sa ti bọ́ ogbologbo ọkunrin nì silẹ pẹlu iṣe rẹ̀;
entries.en: Lie not one to another, seeing that ye have put off the old man with his deeds;

entries.yo: Ẹ si ti gbé ọkunrin titun nì wọ̀, eyiti a sọ di titun si ìmọ gẹgẹ bi aworan ẹniti o da a:
entries.en: And have put on the new man, which is renewed in knowledge after the image of him that created him:

entries.yo: Nibiti kò le si Hellene ati Ju, ikọla ati aikọla, alaigbede, ara Skitia, ẹrú ati omnira: ṣugbọn Kristi li ohun gbogbo, ninu ohun gbogbo.
entries.en: Where there is neither Greek nor Jew, circumcision nor uncircumcision, Barbarian, Scythian, bond nor free: but Christ is all, and in all.

entries.yo: Nitorina, bi ayanfẹ Ọlọrun, ẹni mimọ́ ati olufẹ, ẹ gbé ọkàn ìyọ́nu wọ̀, iṣeun, irẹlẹ, inu tutù, ipamọra;
entries.en: Put on therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering;

entries.yo: Ẹ mã farada a fun ara nyin, ẹ si mã dariji ara nyin bi ẹnikẹni bá ni ẹ̀sun si ẹnikan: bi Kristi ti darijì nyin, gẹgẹ bẹ̃ni ki ẹnyin ki o mã ṣe pẹlu.
entries.en: Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as Christ forgave you, so also do ye.

entries.yo: Ati bori gbogbo nkan wọnyi, ẹ gbé ifẹ wọ̀, ti iṣe àmure ìwa pipé.
entries.en: And above all these things put on charity, which is the bond of perfectness.

entries.yo: Ẹ si jẹ ki alafia Ọlọrun ki o mã ṣe akoso ọkàn nyin, sinu eyiti a pè nyin pẹlu ninu ara kan; ki ẹ si ma dupẹ.
entries.en: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to the which also ye are called in one body; and be ye thankful.

entries.yo: Ẹ jẹ ki ọ̀rọ Kristi mã gbé inu nyin li ọ̀pọlọpọ ninu ọgbọ́n gbogbo; ki ẹ mã kọ́, ki ẹ si mã gbà ara nyin niyanju ninu psalmu, ati orin iyìn, ati orin ẹmí, ẹ mã fi ore-ọfẹ kọrin li ọkàn nyin si Oluwa.
entries.en: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord.

entries.yo: Ohunkohun ti ẹnyin ba si nṣe li ọ̀rọ tabi ni iṣe, ẹ mã ṣe gbogbo wọn li orukọ Jesu Oluwa, ẹ mã fi ọpẹ́ fun Ọlọrun Baba nipasẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And whatsoever ye do in word or deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God and the Father by him.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin aya, ẹ mã tẹriba fun awọn ọkọ nyin, gẹgẹ bi o ti yẹ ninu Oluwa.
entries.en: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as it is fit in the Lord.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin ọkọ, ẹ mã fẹran awọn aya nyin, ẹ má si ṣe korò si wọn.
entries.en: Husbands, love your wives, and be not bitter against them.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin ọmọ, ẹ mã gbọ ti awọn õbi nyin li ohun gbogbo: nitori eyi dara gidigidi ninu Oluwa.
entries.en: Children, obey your parents in all things: for this is well pleasing unto the Lord.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin baba, ẹ máṣe mu awọn ọmọ nyin binu, ki nwọn má bã rẹwẹsi.
entries.en: Fathers, provoke not your children to anger, lest they be discouraged.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin ọmọ-ọdọ, ẹ gbọ ti awọn oluwa nyin nipa ti ara li ohun gbogbo; kì iṣe ni arojuṣe, bi awọn alaṣewù enia; ṣugbọn ni otitọ inu, ni ibẹ̀ru Ọlọrun:
entries.en: Servants, obey in all things your masters according to the flesh; not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but in singleness of heart, fearing God:

entries.yo: Ohunkohun ti ẹnyin ba nṣe, ẹ mã fi tọkàntọkàn ṣe e, gẹgẹ bi fun Oluwa, kì si iṣe fun enia;
entries.en: And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;

entries.yo: Ki ẹ mọ̀ pe lọwọ Oluwa li ẹnyin ó gbà ère ogun: nitori ẹnyin nsìn Oluwa Kristi.
entries.en: Knowing that of the Lord ye shall receive the reward of the inheritance: for ye serve the Lord Christ.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹnikẹni ti o ba ṣe aiṣododo, yio gbà pada nitori aiṣododo na ti o ti ṣe: kò si si ojuṣãju enia.
entries.en: But he that doeth wrong shall receive for the wrong which he hath done: and there is no respect of persons.

entries.yo: ẸNYIN oluwa, ẹ ma fi eyiti o tọ́ ti o si dọgba fun awọn ọmọ-ọdọ nyin; ki ẹ si mọ̀ pe ẹnyin pẹlu ni Oluwa kan li ọrun.
entries.en: Masters, give unto your servants that which is just and equal; knowing that ye also have a Master in heaven.

entries.yo: Ẹ mã duro ṣinṣin ninu adura igbà, ki ẹ si mã ṣọra ninu rẹ̀ pẹlu idupẹ;
entries.en: Continue in prayer, and watch in the same with thanksgiving;

entries.yo: Ju gbogbo rẹ̀, ẹ mã gbadura fun wa pẹlu, ki Ọlọrun le ṣí ilẹkun fun wa fun ọrọ na, lati mã sọ ohun ijinlẹ Kristi, nitori eyiti mo ṣe wà ninu ìde pẹlu:
entries.en: Withal praying also for us, that God would open unto us a door of utterance, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds:

entries.yo: Ki emi ki o le fihan, gẹgẹ bi o ti tọ́ fun mi lati mã sọ.
entries.en: That I may make it manifest, as I ought to speak.

entries.yo: Ẹ mã rìn nipa ọgbọ́n si awọn ti mbẹ lode, ki ẹ si mã ṣe ìrapada ìgba.
entries.en: Walk in wisdom toward them that are without, redeeming the time.

entries.yo: Ẹ jẹ ki ọ̀rọ nyin ki o dàpọ mọ́ ore-ọfẹ nigbagbogbo, eyiti a fi iyọ̀ dùn, ki ẹnyin ki o le mọ̀ bi ẹnyin ó ti mã dá olukuluku enia lohùn.
entries.en: Let your speech be alway with grace, seasoned with salt, that ye may know how ye ought to answer every man.

entries.yo: Gbogbo bi nkan ti ri fun mi ni Tikiku yio jẹ́ ki ẹ mọ̀, arakunrin olufẹ ati olõtọ iranṣẹ, ati ẹlẹgbẹ ninu Oluwa:
entries.en: All my state shall Tychicus declare unto you, who is a beloved brother, and a faithful minister and fellowservant in the Lord:

entries.yo: Ẹniti mo ti rán si nyin nitori eyi kanna, ki ẹnyin le mọ̀ bi a ti wà, ki on ki o le tù ọkàn nyin ninu;
entries.en: Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that he might know your estate, and comfort your hearts;

entries.yo: Pẹlu Onesimu, arakunrin olõtọ ati olufẹ, ẹniti iṣe ọ̀kan ninu nyin. Awọn ni yio sọ ohun gbogbo ti a nṣe nihinyi fun nyin.
entries.en: With Onesimus, a faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They shall make known unto you all things which are done here.

entries.yo: Aristarku, ẹlẹgbẹ mi ninu tubu ki nyin, ati Marku, ọmọ arabinrin Barnaba (nipasẹ ẹniti ẹnyin ti gbà aṣẹ: bi o ba si wá sọdọ nyin, ẹ gbà a),
entries.en: Aristarchus my fellowprisoner saluteth you, and Marcus, sister's son to Barnabas, (touching whom ye received commandments: if he come unto you, receive him;)

entries.yo: Ati Jesu, ẹniti a npè ni Justu, ẹniti iṣe ti awọn onila. Awọn wọnyi nikan ni olubaṣiṣẹ mi fun ijọba Ọlọrun, awọn ẹniti o ti jasi itunu fun mi.
entries.en: And Jesus, which is called Justus, who are of the circumcision. These only are my fellowworkers unto the kingdom of God, which have been a comfort unto me.

entries.yo: Epafra, ẹniti iṣe ọkan ninu nyin, iranṣẹ Kristi, kí nyin, on nfi iwaya-ija gbadura nigbagbogbo fun nyin, ki ẹnyin ki o le duro ni pipé ati ni kíkun ninu gbogbo ifẹ Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, saluteth you, always labouring fervently for you in prayers, that ye may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.

entries.yo: Nitori mo jẹri rẹ̀ pe, o ni itara pupọ fun nyin, ati fun awọn ti o wà ni Laodikea, ati awọn ti o wà ni Hierapoli.
entries.en: For I bear him record, that he hath a great zeal for you, and them that are in Laodicea, and them in Hierapolis.

entries.yo: Luku, oniṣegun olufẹ, ati Dema ki nyin.
entries.en: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas, greet you.

entries.yo: Ẹ kí awọn ará ti o wà ni Laodikea, ati Nimfa, ati ijọ ti o wà ni ile rẹ̀.
entries.en: Salute the brethren which are in Laodicea, and Nymphas, and the church which is in his house.

entries.yo: Nigbati a ba si kà iwe yi larin nyin tan, ki ẹ mu ki a kà a pẹlu ninu ìjọ Laodikea; ki ẹnyin pẹlu si kà eyi ti o ti Laodikea wá.
entries.en: And when this epistle is read among you, cause that it be read also in the church of the Laodiceans; and that ye likewise read the epistle from Laodicea.

entries.yo: Ki ẹ si wi fun Arkippu pe, Kiyesi iṣẹ-iranṣẹ ti iwọ ti gbà ninu Oluwa, ki o si ṣe e ni kikún.
entries.en: And say to Archippus, Take heed to the ministry which thou hast received in the Lord, that thou fulfil it.

entries.yo: Ikíni nipa ọwọ́ emi Paulu. Ẹ mã ranti ìde mi. Ki ore-ọfẹ ki o wà pẹlu nyin. Amin.
entries.en: The salutation by the hand of me Paul. Remember my bonds. Grace be with you. Amen.

entries.yo: PAULU, ati Silfanu, ati Timotiu, si ijọ awọn ara Tessalonika, ninu Ọlọrun Baba, ati ninu Jesu Kristi Oluwa: Ore-ọfẹ si nyin, ati alafia, lati ọdọ Ọlọrun Baba wa, ati Jesu Kristi Oluwa.
entries.en: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians which is in God the Father and in the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.

entries.yo: Awa ndupẹ lọwọ Ọlọrun nigbagbogbo fun gbogbo nyin, awa nṣe iranti nyin ninu adura wa;
entries.en: We give thanks to God always for you all, making mention of you in our prayers;

entries.yo: Li aisimi li awa nranti iṣẹ igbagbọ́ nyin ati lãla ifẹ ati sũru ireti nyin ninu Oluwa wa Jesu Kristi, niwaju Ọlọrun ati Baba wa;
entries.en: Remembering without ceasing your work of faith, and labour of love, and patience of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, in the sight of God and our Father;

entries.yo: Nitoripe awa mọ yiyan nyin, ara olufẹ ti Ọlọrun,
entries.en: Knowing, brethren beloved, your election of God.

entries.yo: Bi ihinrere wa kò ti wá sọdọ nyin li ọ̀rọ nikan, ṣugbọn li agbara pẹlu, ati ninu Ẹmí Mimọ́, ati ni ọ̀pọlọpọ igbẹkẹle; bi ẹnyin ti mọ̀ irú enia ti awa jẹ́ larin nyin nitori nyin.
entries.en: For our gospel came not unto you in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Ghost, and in much assurance; as ye know what manner of men we were among you for your sake.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin si di alafarawe wa, ati ti Oluwa, lẹhin ti ẹnyin ti gbà ọ̀rọ na ninu ipọnju ọ̀pọlọpọ, pẹlu ayọ̀ Ẹmí Mimọ́:
entries.en: And ye became followers of us, and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Ghost:

entries.yo: Ti ẹnyin si jẹ apẹrẹ fun gbogbo awọn ti o gbagbọ́ ni Makedonia ati Akaia.
entries.en: So that ye were ensamples to all that believe in Macedonia and Achaia.

entries.yo: Nitori lati ọdọ nyin lọ li ọ̀rọ Oluwa ti dún jade, kì iṣe ni kìki Makedonia ati Akaia nikan, ṣugbọn ni ibi gbogbo ni ìhin igbagbọ́ nyin si Ọlọrun tàn kalẹ; tobẹ̃ ti awa kò ni isọ̀rọ ohunkohun.
entries.en: For from you sounded out the word of the Lord not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith to God-ward is spread abroad; so that we need not to speak any thing.

entries.yo: Nitoripe awọn tikarawọn ròhin nipa wa, irú iwọle ti awa ti ni sọdọ nyin, bi ẹnyin si ti yipada si Ọlọrun kuro ninu ère lati mã sìn Ọlọrun alãye ati otitọ;
entries.en: For they themselves shew of us what manner of entering in we had unto you, and how ye turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God;

entries.yo: Ati lati duro dè Ọmọ rẹ̀ lati ọrun wá, ẹniti o si ji dide kuro ninu okú, ani Jesu na, ẹniti ngbà wa kuro ninu ibinu ti mbọ̀.
entries.en: And to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead, even Jesus, which delivered us from the wrath to come.

entries.yo: NITORI ẹnyin tikaranyin mọ̀, ará, irú iwọle wa si nyin pe kì iṣe lasan:
entries.en: For yourselves, brethren, know our entrance in unto you, that it was not in vain:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn lẹhin ti awa ti jìya ṣaju, ti a si ti lo wa ni ilo itiju ni Filippi gẹgẹ bi ẹnyin ti mọ̀, awa ni igboiya ninu Ọlọrun wa lati sọ̀rọ ihinrere Ọlọrun fun nyin pẹlu ọ̀pọlọpọ ìwàyá ìjà.
entries.en: But even after that we had suffered before, and were shamefully entreated, as ye know, at Philippi, we were bold in our God to speak unto you the gospel of God with much contention.

entries.yo: Nitori ọ̀rọ iyanju wa kì iṣe ti ẹ̀tan, tabi ti ìwa aimọ́, tabi ninu arekereke:
entries.en: For our exhortation was not of deceit, nor of uncleanness, nor in guile:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi a ti kà wa yẹ lati ọdọ Ọlọrun wá bi ẹniti a fi ihinrere le lọwọ, bẹ̃ li awa nsọ; kì iṣe bi ẹniti nwù enia bikoṣe Ọlọrun, ti ndan ọkàn wa wò.
entries.en: But as we were allowed of God to be put in trust with the gospel, even so we speak; not as pleasing men, but God, which trieth our hearts.

entries.yo: Nitori awa kò lo ọrọ ipọnni nigbakan rí gẹgẹ bi ẹnyin ti mọ̀, tabi iboju ojukòkoro; Ọlọrun li ẹlẹri:
entries.en: For neither at any time used we flattering words, as ye know, nor a cloke of covetousness; God is witness:

entries.yo: Bẹni awa kò wá ogo lọdọ enia, tabi lọdọ nyin, tabi lọdọ awọn ẹlomiran, nigbati awa iba fẹ ọla lori nyin bi awọn aposteli Kristi.
entries.en: Nor of men sought we glory, neither of you, nor yet of others, when we might have been burdensome, as the apostles of Christ.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awa nṣe pẹlẹ lọdọ nyin, gẹgẹ bi abiyamọ ti ntọju awọn ọmọ on tikararẹ:
entries.en: But we were gentle among you, even as a nurse cherisheth her children:

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ gẹgẹ bi awa ti ni ifẹ inu rere si nyin, inu wa dun jọjọ lati fun nyin kì iṣe ihinrere Ọlọrun nikan, ṣugbọn ẹmí awa tikarawa pẹlu, nitoriti ẹnyin jẹ ẹni ọ̀wọ́n fun wa.
entries.en: So being affectionately desirous of you, we were willing to have imparted unto you, not the gospel of God only, but also our own souls, because ye were dear unto us.

entries.yo: Nitori ẹnyin ranti, ará, ìṣẹ́ ati lãlã wa: nitori awa nṣe lãlã li ọsán ati li oru, ki awa ko má bã di ẹrù ru ẹnikẹni ninu nyin, awa wasu ihinrere Ọlọrun fun nyin.
entries.en: For ye remember, brethren, our labour and travail: for labouring night and day, because we would not be chargeable unto any of you, we preached unto you the gospel of God.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin si li ẹlẹri, ati Ọlọrun pẹlu, bi awa ti wà lãrin ẹnyin ti o gbagbọ́ ni mimọ́ iwà ati li ododo, ati li ailẹgan:
entries.en: Ye are witnesses, and God also, how holily and justly and unblameably we behaved ourselves among you that believe:

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi ẹnyin si ti mọ̀ bi awa ti mba olukuluku nyin lo gẹgẹ bi baba si awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, a ngba nyin niyanju, a ntu nyin ninu, a si kọ́,
entries.en: As ye know how we exhorted and comforted and charged every one of you, as a father doth his children,

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o le mã rìn ni yiyẹ Ọlọrun, ẹniti o npè nyin sinu ijọba ati ogo On tikararẹ.
entries.en: That ye would walk worthy of God, who hath called you unto his kingdom and glory.

entries.yo: Nitori eyi li awa ṣe ndupẹ lọwọ Ọlọrun pẹlu li aisimi, pe nigbati ẹnyin gba ọ̀rọ ti ẹnyin gbọ lọdọ wa, ani ọ̀rọ Ọlọrun, ẹnyin kò gbà a bi ẹnipe ọ̀rọ enia, ṣugbọn gẹgẹ bi o ti jẹ nitõtọ, bi ọ̀rọ Ọlọrun, eyiti o ṣiṣẹ gidigidi ninu ẹnyin ti o gbagbọ́ pẹlu.
entries.en: For this cause also thank we God without ceasing, because, when ye received the word of God which ye heard of us, ye received it not as the word of men, but as it is in truth, the word of God, which effectually worketh also in you that believe.

entries.yo: Nitori, ará, ẹnyin di alafarawe awọn ijọ Ọlọrun ti mbẹ ni Judea, ninu Kristi Jesu: nitoripe ẹnyin pẹlu jìya iru ohun kanna lọwọ awọn ara ilu nyin, gẹgẹ bi awọn pẹlu ti jìya lọwọ awọn Ju:
entries.en: For ye, brethren, became followers of the churches of God which in Judaea are in Christ Jesus: for ye also have suffered like things of your own countrymen, even as they have of the Jews:

entries.yo: Awọn ẹniti o pa Jesu Oluwa, ati awọn woli, nwọn si tì wa jade; nwọn kò si ṣe eyiti o wu Ọlọrun, nwọn si wà lodi si gbogbo enia:
entries.en: Who both killed the Lord Jesus, and their own prophets, and have persecuted us; and they please not God, and are contrary to all men:

entries.yo: Nwọn kọ̀ fun wa lati sọ̀rọ fun awọn Keferi ki nwọn ki o le là, lati mã sọ ẹ̀ṣẹ wọn di kikun nigbagbogbo: ṣugbọn ibinu de bá wọn titi de opin.
entries.en: Forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they might be saved, to fill up their sins alway: for the wrath is come upon them to the uttermost.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn, ará, awa ti a gbà kuro lọdọ nyin fun sã kan li ara, ki iṣe li ọkàn, pẹlu itara ọpọlọpọ li awa ṣe aniyan ti a si fẹ gidigidi lati ri oju nyin.
entries.en: But we, brethren, being taken from you for a short time in presence, not in heart, endeavoured the more abundantly to see your face with great desire.

entries.yo: Nitori awa fẹ lati tọ̀ nyin wá, ani emi Paulu lẹ̃kini ati lẹ̃keji; Satani si dè wa li ọ̀na.
entries.en: Wherefore we would have come unto you, even I Paul, once and again; but Satan hindered us.

entries.yo: Nitori kini ireti wa, tabi ayọ̀ wa, tabi ade iṣogo wa? kì ha iṣe ẹnyin ni niwaju Jesu Oluwa wa ni àbọ rẹ̀?
entries.en: For what is our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing? Are not even ye in the presence of our Lord Jesus Christ at his coming?

entries.yo: Nitori ẹnyin ni ogo ati ayọ̀ wa.
entries.en: For ye are our glory and joy.

entries.yo: NITORINA nigbati ara wa kò gba a mọ́, awa rò pe o dara ki a fi awa nikan sẹhin ni Ateni;
entries.en: Wherefore when we could no longer forbear, we thought it good to be left at Athens alone;

entries.yo: Awa si rán Timotiu, arakunrin wa, ati iranṣẹ Ọlọrun ninu ihinrere Kristi, lati fi ẹsẹ nyin mulẹ, ati lati tù nyin ninu niti igbagbọ́ nyin:
entries.en: And sent Timotheus, our brother, and minister of God, and our fellowlabourer in the gospel of Christ, to establish you, and to comfort you concerning your faith:

entries.yo: Ki a máṣe mu ẹnikẹni yẹsẹ nipa wahalà wọnyi: nitori ẹnyin tikaranyin mọ̀ pe a ti yàn wa sinu rẹ̀.
entries.en: That no man should be moved by these afflictions: for yourselves know that we are appointed thereunto.

entries.yo: Nitori nitõtọ nigbati awa wà lọdọ nyin, a ti nsọ fun nyin tẹlẹ pe, awa ó ri wahalà; gẹgẹ bi o si ti ṣẹ, ti ẹnyin si mọ̀.
entries.en: For verily, when we were with you, we told you before that we should suffer tribulation; even as it came to pass, and ye know.

entries.yo: Nitori eyi, nigbati ara mi kò gba a mọ́, mo si ranṣẹ ki emi ki o le mọ igbagbọ́ nyin ki oludanwò nì má bã ti dan nyin wo lọnakọna, ki lãlã wa si jẹ asan.
entries.en: For this cause, when I could no longer forbear, I sent to know your faith, lest by some means the tempter have tempted you, and our labour be in vain.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nisisiyi ti Timotiu ti ti ọdọ nyin wá sọdọ wa, ti o si ti mu ihinrere ti igbagbọ́ ati ifẹ nyin wá fun wa, ati pe ẹnyin nṣe iranti wa ni rere nigbagbogbo, ẹnyin si nfẹ gidigidi lati ri wa, bi awa pẹlu si ti nfẹ lati ri nyin:
entries.en: But now when Timotheus came from you unto us, and brought us good tidings of your faith and charity, and that ye have good remembrance of us always, desiring greatly to see us, as we also to see you:

entries.yo: Nitori eyi, ará, awa ni itunu lori nyin ninu gbogbo wahalà ati ipọnju wa nitori igbagbọ́ nyin:
entries.en: Therefore, brethren, we were comforted over you in all our affliction and distress by your faith:

entries.yo: Nitori awa yè nisisiyi, bi ẹnyin ba duro ṣinṣin ninu Oluwa.
entries.en: For now we live, if ye stand fast in the Lord.

entries.yo: Nitori ọpẹ́ kili awa le tún ma dá lọwọ Ọlọrun nitori nyin, fun gbogbo ayọ̀ ti awa nyọ̀ nitori nyin niwaju Ọlọrun wa;
entries.en: For what thanks can we render to God again for you, for all the joy wherewith we joy for your sakes before our God;

entries.yo: Li ọsán ati li oru li awa ngbadura gidigidi pe, ki awa ki o le ri oju nyin, ki a si ṣe aṣepé eyiti o kù ninu igbagbọ́ nyin?
entries.en: Night and day praying exceedingly that we might see your face, and might perfect that which is lacking in your faith?

entries.yo: Njẹ ki Ọlọrun ati Baba wa tikararẹ, ati Jesu Kristi Oluwa wa, ṣe amọ̀na wa sọdọ nyin.
entries.en: Now God himself and our Father, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way unto you.

entries.yo: Ki Oluwa si mã mu nyin bisi i, ki ẹ si mã pọ̀ ninu ifẹ si ọmọnikeji nyin, ati si gbogbo enia, gẹgẹ bi awa ti nṣe si nyin:
entries.en: And the Lord make you to increase and abound in love one toward another, and toward all men, even as we do toward you:

entries.yo: Ki o ba le fi ọkàn nyin balẹ li ailabukù ninu ìwa mimọ́ niwaju Ọlọrun ati Baba wa, nigba atiwá Jesu Kristi Oluwa wa pẹlu gbogbo awọn enia mimọ́ rẹ̀.
entries.en: To the end he may stablish your hearts unblameable in holiness before God, even our Father, at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ with all his saints.

entries.yo: NJẸ li akotan, ará, awa mbẹ̀ nyin, awa si ngbà nyin niyanju ninu Jesu Oluwa, pe bi ẹnyin ti gbà lọwọ wa bi ẹnyin iba ti mã rìn, ti ẹnyin iba si mã wù Ọlọrun, ani gẹgẹ bi ẹnyin ti nrìn, ki ẹnyin le mã pọ̀ siwaju si i.
entries.en: Furthermore then we beseech you, brethren, and exhort you by the Lord Jesus, that as ye have received of us how ye ought to walk and to please God, so ye would abound more and more.

entries.yo: Nitori ẹnyin mọ̀ irú aṣẹ ti a ti pa fun nyin lati ọdọ Jesu Oluwa.
entries.en: For ye know what commandments we gave you by the Lord Jesus.

entries.yo: Nitori eyi ni ifẹ Ọlọrun, ani wiwà ni mimọ́ nyin, pe ki ẹnyin ki o takéte si àgbere:
entries.en: For this is the will of God, even your sanctification, that ye should abstain from fornication:

entries.yo: Ki olukuluku nyin le mọ̀ bi on iba ti mã ko ohun èlo rẹ̀ ni ijanu ni ìwa-mimọ́ ati ni ọlá;
entries.en: That every one of you should know how to possess his vessel in sanctification and honour;

entries.yo: Kì iṣe ni ṣiṣe ifẹkufẹ, gẹgẹ bi awọn Keferi ti kò mọ̀ Ọlọrun:
entries.en: Not in the lust of concupiscence, even as the Gentiles which know not God:

entries.yo: Ki ẹnikẹni máṣe rekọja, ki o má si ṣe ṣẹ arakunrin rẹ̀ ninu nkan na: nitori Oluwa ni olugbẹsan ninu gbogbo nkan wọnyi, gẹgẹ bi awa ti kilọ fun nyin tẹlẹ, ti a si jẹri pẹlu.
entries.en: That no man go beyond and defraud his brother in any matter: because that the Lord is the avenger of all such, as we also have forewarned you and testified.

entries.yo: Nitori Ọlọrun kò pè wa fun ìwa ẽri, ṣugbọn ni ìwamimọ́.
entries.en: For God hath not called us unto uncleanness, but unto holiness.

entries.yo: Nitorina ẹnikẹni ti o bá kọ̀, ko kọ̀ enia, bikoṣe Ọlọrun, ẹniti o fun nyin ni Ẹmí Mimọ́ rẹ̀ pẹlu.
entries.en: He therefore that despiseth, despiseth not man, but God, who hath also given unto us his holy Spirit.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn niti ifẹ awọn ará, ẹ kò tun fẹ ki ẹnikẹni kọwe si nyin: nitori a ti kọ́ ẹnyin tikaranyin lati ọdọ Ọlọrun wá lati mã fẹ ara nyin.
entries.en: But as touching brotherly love ye need not that I write unto you: for ye yourselves are taught of God to love one another.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ ẹnyin si nṣe e si gbogbo awọn ará ti o wà ni gbogbo Makedonia: ṣugbọn awa mbẹ̀ nyin, ará, pe ki ẹnyin ki o mã pọ̀ siwaju si i;
entries.en: And indeed ye do it toward all the brethren which are in all Macedonia: but we beseech you, brethren, that ye increase more and more;

entries.yo: Ati pe ki ẹnyin ki o mã dù u gidigidi lati gbé jẹ, lati mã gbọ ti ara nyin, ki ẹ mã fi ọwọ́ nyin ṣiṣẹ, gẹgẹ bi awa ti paṣẹ fun nyin;
entries.en: And that ye study to be quiet, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, as we commanded you;

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o le mã rìn ìrin ẹ̀tọ́ si awọn ti mbẹ lode, ki ẹ le má ṣe alaini ohunkohun.
entries.en: That ye may walk honestly toward them that are without, and that ye may have lack of nothing.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awa kò fẹ ki ẹnyin ki o jẹ òpe, ará, niti awọn ti o sùn, pe ki ẹ má binujẹ gẹgẹ bi awọn iyoku ti kò ni ireti.
entries.en: But I would not have you to be ignorant, brethren, concerning them which are asleep, that ye sorrow not, even as others which have no hope.

entries.yo: Nitori bi awa ba gbagbọ́ pe Jesu ti kú, o si ti jinde, gẹgẹ bẹ̃ni Ọlọrun yio mu awọn ti o sùn pẹlu ninu Jesu wá pẹlu ara rẹ̀.
entries.en: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so them also which sleep in Jesus will God bring with him.

entries.yo: Nitori eyiyi li awa nwi fun nyin nipa ọ̀rọ Oluwa, pe awa ti o wà lãye, ti a si kù lẹhin de atiwá Oluwa, bi o ti wu ki o ri kì yio ṣaju awọn ti o sùn.
entries.en: For this we say unto you by the word of the Lord, that we which are alive and remain unto the coming of the Lord shall not prevent them which are asleep.

entries.yo: Nitori Oluwa tikararẹ̀ yio sọkalẹ lati ọrun wá ti on ti ariwo, pẹlu ohùn olori awọn angẹli, ati pẹlu ipè Ọlọrun; awọn okú ninu Kristi ni yio si kọ́ jinde:
entries.en: For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of God: and the dead in Christ shall rise first:

entries.yo: Nigbana li a ó si gbà awa ti o wà lãye ti o si kù lẹhin soke pẹlu wọn sinu awọsanma, lati pade Oluwa li oju ọrun: bẹ̃li awa ó si ma wà titi lai lọdọ Oluwa.
entries.en: Then we which are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air: and so shall we ever be with the Lord.

entries.yo: Nitorina, ẹ mã fi ọ̀rọ wọnyi tu ara nyin ninu.
entries.en: Wherefore comfort one another with these words.

entries.yo: ṢUGBỌN niti akokò ati ìgba wọnni, ará, ẹnyin kò tun fẹ ki a kọ ohunkohun si nyin,
entries.en: But of the times and the seasons, brethren, ye have no need that I write unto you.

entries.yo: Nitoripe ẹnyin tikaranyin mọ̀ dajudaju pe, ọjọ Oluwa mbọ̀wá gẹgẹ bi olè li oru.
entries.en: For yourselves know perfectly that the day of the Lord so cometh as a thief in the night.

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn ba nwipe, alafia ati ailewu; nigbana ni iparun ojijì yio de sori wọn gẹgẹ bi irọbi lori obinrin ti o lóyun; nwọn kì yio si le sálà.
entries.en: For when they shall say, Peace and safety; then sudden destruction cometh upon them, as travail upon a woman with child; and they shall not escape.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹnyin, ará, kò si ninu òkunkun, ti ọjọ na yio fi de bá nyin bi olè.
entries.en: But ye, brethren, are not in darkness, that that day should overtake you as a thief.

entries.yo: Nitori gbogbo nyin ni ọmọ imọlẹ, ati ọmọ ọsán: awa kì iṣe ti oru, tabi ti òkunkun.
entries.en: Ye are all the children of light, and the children of the day: we are not of the night, nor of darkness.

entries.yo: Nitorina ẹ máṣe jẹ ki a sùn, bi awọn iyoku ti nṣe; ṣugbọn ẹ jẹ ki a mã ṣọna ki a si mã wa ni airekọja.
entries.en: Therefore let us not sleep, as do others; but let us watch and be sober.

entries.yo: Nitori awọn ti nsùn, ama sùn li oru; ati awọn ti nmutipara, ama mutipara li oru.
entries.en: For they that sleep sleep in the night; and they that be drunken are drunken in the night.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹ jẹ ki awa, bi a ti jẹ ti ọsán, mã wà li airekọja, ki a mã gbé igbaiya igbagbọ́ ati ifẹ wọ̀; ati ireti igbala fun aṣibori.
entries.en: But let us, who are of the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love; and for an helmet, the hope of salvation.

entries.yo: Nitori Ọlọrun yàn wa ki iṣe si ibinu, ṣugbọn si ati ni igbala nipasẹ Jesu Kristi Oluwa wa,
entries.en: For God hath not appointed us to wrath, but to obtain salvation by our Lord Jesus Christ,

entries.yo: Ẹniti o kú fun wa, pe bi a ba jí, tabi bi a ba sùn, ki a le jùmọ wà lãye pẹlu rẹ̀.
entries.en: Who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.

entries.yo: Nitorina ẹ mã gbà ara nyin niyanju, ki ẹ si mã fi ẹsẹ ara nyin mulẹ, ani gẹgẹ bi ẹnyin ti nṣe.
entries.en: Wherefore comfort yourselves together, and edify one another, even as also ye do.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awa mbẹ̀ nyin, ará, lati mã mọ awọn ti nṣe lãla larin nyin, ti nwọn si nṣe olori nyin ninu Oluwa, ti nwọn si nkìlọ fun nyin;
entries.en: And we beseech you, brethren, to know them which labour among you, and are over you in the Lord, and admonish you;

entries.yo: Ki ẹ si mã bu ọla fun wọn gidigidi ninu ifẹ nitori iṣẹ wọn. Ẹ si mã wà li alafia lãrin ara nyin.
entries.en: And to esteem them very highly in love for their work's sake. And be at peace among yourselves.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awa mbẹ̀ nyin, ará, ki ẹ mã kìlọ fun awọn ti iṣe alaigbọran, ẹ mã tù awọn alailọkàn ninu, ẹ mã ràn awọn alailera lọwọ, ẹ mã mu sũru fun gbogbo enia.
entries.en: Now we exhort you, brethren, warn them that are unruly, comfort the feebleminded, support the weak, be patient toward all men.

entries.yo: Ẹ kiyesi i, ki ẹnikẹni ki o máṣe fi buburu san buburu fun ẹnikẹni; ṣugbọn ẹ mã lepa eyi ti iṣe rere nigbagbogbo, lãrin ara nyin, ati larin gbogbo enia.
entries.en: See that none render evil for evil unto any man; but ever follow that which is good, both among yourselves, and to all men.

entries.yo: Ẹ mã yọ̀ nigbagbogbo.
entries.en: Rejoice evermore.

entries.yo: Ẹ mã gbadura li aisimi.
entries.en: Pray without ceasing.

entries.yo: Ẹ mã dupẹ ninu ohun gbogbo: nitori eyi ni ifẹ Ọlọrun ninu Kristi Jesu fun nyin.
entries.en: In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.

entries.yo: Ẹ máṣe pa iná Ẹmí.
entries.en: Quench not the Spirit.

entries.yo: Ẹ máṣe kẹgan isọtẹlẹ.
entries.en: Despise not prophesyings.

entries.yo: Ẹ mã wadi ohun gbogbo daju; ẹ dì eyiti o dara mu ṣinṣin.
entries.en: Prove all things; hold fast that which is good.

entries.yo: Ẹ mã takéte si ohun gbogbo ti o jọ ibi.
entries.en: Abstain from all appearance of evil.

entries.yo: Ki Ọlọrun alafia tikararẹ̀ ki o sọ nyin di mimọ́ patapata; ki a si pa ẹmí ati ọkàn ati ara nyin mọ́ patapata li ailabukù ni ìgba wíwa Oluwa wa Jesu Kristi.
entries.en: And the very God of peace sanctify you wholly; and I pray God your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved blameless unto the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

entries.yo: Olododo li ẹniti o pè nyin, ti yio si ṣe e.
entries.en: Faithful is he that calleth you, who also will do it.

entries.yo: Ará, ẹ mã gbadura fun wa.
entries.en: Brethren, pray for us.

entries.yo: Ẹ fi ifẹnukonu mimọ́ kí gbogbo awọn ará.
entries.en: Greet all the brethren with an holy kiss.

entries.yo: Mo fi Oluwa mu nyin bura pe, ki a ka iwe yi fun gbogbo awọn ará.
entries.en: I charge you by the Lord that this epistle be read unto all the holy brethren.

entries.yo: Ki ore-ọfẹ Oluwa wa Jesu Kristi ki o wà pẹlu nyin. Amin.
entries.en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.

entries.yo: PAULU, ati Silfanu, ati Timotiu, si ijọ Tessalonika, ninu Ọlọrun Baba wa ati Jesu Kristi Oluwa:
entries.en: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:

entries.yo: Ore-ọfẹ si nyin, ati alafia, lati ọdọ Ọlọrun Baba, ati Jesu Kristi Oluwa.
entries.en: Grace unto you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

entries.yo: Iṣẹ wa ni lati mã dupẹ lọwọ Ọlọrun nigbagbogbo nitori nyin, ará, ani gẹgẹ bi o ti yẹ, nitoripe igbagbọ́ nyin ndàgba gidigidi, ati ifẹ olukuluku nyin gbogbo si ara nyin ndi pupọ;
entries.en: We are bound to thank God always for you, brethren, as it is meet, because that your faith groweth exceedingly, and the charity of every one of you all toward each other aboundeth;

entries.yo: Tobẹ̃ ti awa tikarawa nfi nyin ṣogo ninu ijọ Ọlọrun, nitori sũru ati igbagbọ́ nyin ninu gbogbo inunibini ati wahalà nyin ti ẹnyin nfarada,
entries.en: So that we ourselves glory in you in the churches of God for your patience and faith in all your persecutions and tribulations that ye endure:

entries.yo: Eyiti iṣe àmi idajọ ododo Ọlọrun ti o daju, ki a le kà nyin yẹ fun ijọba Ọlọrun, nitori eyiti ẹnyin pẹlu ṣe njìya:
entries.en: Which is a manifest token of the righteous judgment of God, that ye may be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which ye also suffer:

entries.yo: Bi o ti jẹ pe ohun ododo ni fun Ọlọrun lati fi ipọnju gbẹsan lara awọn ti npọ́n nyin loju,
entries.en: Seeing it is a righteous thing with God to recompense tribulation to them that trouble you;

entries.yo: Ati fun ẹnyin, ti a npọ́n loju, isimi pẹlu wa, nigba ifarahàn Jesu Oluwa lati ọrun wá ninu ọwọ́ ina pẹlu awọn angẹli alagbara rẹ̀,
entries.en: And to you who are troubled rest with us, when the Lord Jesus shall be revealed from heaven with his mighty angels,

entries.yo: Ẹniti yio san ẹsan fun awọn ti kò mọ Ọlọrun, ti nwọn kò si gbà ihinrere Jesu Oluwa wa gbọ́:
entries.en: In flaming fire taking vengeance on them that know not God, and that obey not the gospel of our Lord Jesus Christ:

entries.yo: Awọn ẹniti yio jiya iparun ainipẹkun lati iwaju Oluwa wá, ati lati inu ogo agbara rẹ̀,
entries.en: Who shall be punished with everlasting destruction from the presence of the Lord, and from the glory of his power;

entries.yo: Nigbati o ba de lati jẹ ẹni ãyìn logo ninu awọn enia mimọ́ rẹ̀, ati ẹni iyanu ninu gbogbo awọn ti o gbagbọ́ (nitori a ti gbà ẹrí ti a jẹ fun nyin gbọ) li ọjọ na.
entries.en: When he shall come to be glorified in his saints, and to be admired in all them that believe (because our testimony among you was believed) in that day.

entries.yo: Nitori eyiti awa pẹlu ngbadura fun nyin nigbagbogbo, pe ki Ọlọrun wa ki o le kà nyin yẹ fun ìpe nyin, ki o le mu gbogbo ifẹ ohun rere ati iṣẹ igbagbọ́ ṣẹ ni agbara:
entries.en: Wherefore also we pray always for you, that our God would count you worthy of this calling, and fulfil all the good pleasure of his goodness, and the work of faith with power:

entries.yo: Ki a le yìn orukọ Jesu Oluwa wa logo ninu nyin, ati ẹnyin ninu rẹ̀, gẹgẹ bi ore-ọfẹ Ọlọrun wa ati ti Jesu Kristi Oluwa.
entries.en: That the name of our Lord Jesus Christ may be glorified in you, and ye in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.

entries.yo: ṢUGBỌN awa mbẹ̀ nyin, ará, nitori ti wíwa Jesu Kristi Oluwa wa, ati ti ipejọ wa sọdọ rẹ̀,
entries.en: Now we beseech you, brethren, by the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, and by our gathering together unto him,

entries.yo: Ki ọkàn nyin ki o máṣe tete mì, tabi ki ẹ máṣe jaiya, yala nipa ẹmí, tabi nipa ọ̀rọ, tabi nipa iwe bi lati ọdọ wa wá, bi ẹnipe ọjọ Oluwa de.
entries.en: That ye be not soon shaken in mind, or be troubled, neither by spirit, nor by word, nor by letter as from us, as that the day of Christ is at hand.

entries.yo: Ẹ máṣe jẹ ki ẹnikẹni tàn nyin jẹ lọnakọna; nitoripe ọjọ na ki yio de, bikoṣepe ìyapa nì ba kọ́ de, ki a si fi ẹni ẹ̀ṣẹ nì hàn, ti iṣe ọmọ ègbé;
entries.en: Let no man deceive you by any means: for that day shall not come, except there come a falling away first, and that man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition;

entries.yo: Ẹniti nṣòdì, ti o si ngbé ara rẹ̀ ga si gbogbo ohun ti a npè li Ọlọrun, tabi ti a nsin; tobẹ ti o joko ni tẹmpili Ọlọrun, ti o nfi ara rẹ̀ hàn pe Ọlọrun li on.
entries.en: Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God, or that is worshipped; so that he as God sitteth in the temple of God, shewing himself that he is God.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin kò ranti pe, nigbati mo wà lọdọ nyin, mo nsọ̀ nkan wọnyi fun nyin?
entries.en: Remember ye not, that, when I was yet with you, I told you these things?

entries.yo: Ati nisisiyi ẹnyin mọ ohun ti o nṣe idena, ki a le ba fi i hàn li akokò rẹ̀.
entries.en: And now ye know what withholdeth that he might be revealed in his time.

entries.yo: Nitoripe ohun ijinlẹ ẹ̀ṣẹ ti nṣiṣẹ ná: kìki pe ẹnikan wà ti nṣe idena nisisiyi, titi a ó fi mu u ti ọ̀na kuro.
entries.en: For the mystery of iniquity doth already work: only he who now letteth will let, until he be taken out of the way.

entries.yo: Nigbana li a ó si fi ẹ̀ṣẹ nì hàn, ẹniti Oluwa yio fi ẽmi ẹnu rẹ̀ pa, ti yio si fi ifihan wíwa rẹ̀ sọ di asan:
entries.en: And then shall that Wicked be revealed, whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth, and shall destroy with the brightness of his coming:

entries.yo: Ani on, ẹniti wíwa rẹ̀ yio ri gẹgẹ bi iṣẹ Satani pẹlu agbara gbogbo, ati àmi ati iṣẹ-iyanu eke,
entries.en: Even him, whose coming is after the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,

entries.yo: Ati pẹlu itanjẹ aiṣododo gbogbo fun awọn ti nṣegbé; nitoriti nwọn kò gbà ifẹ otitọ ti a ba fi gbà wọn là.
entries.en: And with all deceivableness of unrighteousness in them that perish; because they received not the love of the truth, that they might be saved.

entries.yo: Ati nitori eyi, Ọlọrun rán ohun ti nṣiṣẹ iṣina si wọn, ki nwọn ki o le gbà eke gbọ́:
entries.en: And for this cause God shall send them strong delusion, that they should believe a lie:

entries.yo: Ki a le ṣe idajọ gbogbo awọn ti kò gbà otitọ gbọ́, ṣugbọn ti nwọn ni inu didùn ninu aiṣododo.
entries.en: That they all might be damned who believed not the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn iṣẹ wa ni lati mã dupẹ lọwọ Ọlọrun nigbagbogbo nitori nyin, ará, olufẹ nipa ti Oluwa, nitori lati àtetekọṣe li Ọlọrun ti yàn nyin si igbala ninu isọdimimọ́ Ẹmí ati igbagbọ́ otitọ:
entries.en: But we are bound to give thanks alway to God for you, brethren beloved of the Lord, because God hath from the beginning chosen you to salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief of the truth:

entries.yo: Eyiti o ti pè nyin si nipa ihinrere wa, ki ẹnyin ki o le gbà ogo Jesu Kristi Oluwa wa.
entries.en: Whereunto he called you by our gospel, to the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.

entries.yo: Nitorina, ará, ẹ duro ṣinṣin, ki ẹ si dì ẹkọ́ wọnni mu ti a ti fi kọ́ nyin, yala nipa ọ̀rọ, tabi nipa iwe wa.
entries.en: Therefore, brethren, stand fast, and hold the traditions which ye have been taught, whether by word, or our epistle.

entries.yo: Njẹ ki Jesu Kristi Oluwa wa tikararẹ̀, ati Ọlọrun Baba wa, ẹniti o ti fẹ wa, ti o si ti fi itunu ainipẹkun ati ireti rere nipa ore-ọfẹ fun wa,
entries.en: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God, even our Father, which hath loved us, and hath given us everlasting consolation and good hope through grace,

entries.yo: Ki o tù ọkan nyin ninu, ki o si fi ẹsẹ nyin mulẹ ninu iṣẹ ati ọrọ rere gbogbo.
entries.en: Comfort your hearts, and stablish you in every good word and work.

entries.yo: LAKOTAN, ará, ẹ mã gbadura fun wa, ki ọ̀rọ Oluwa le mã sáre, ki o si jẹ ãyìn logo, ani gẹgẹ bi o ti ri lọdọ nyin:
entries.en: Finally, brethren, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may have free course, and be glorified, even as it is with you:

entries.yo: Ati ki a le gbà wa lọwọ awọn aṣodi ati awọn enia buburu: nitoripe ki iṣe gbogbo enia li o gbagbọ́.
entries.en: And that we may be delivered from unreasonable and wicked men: for all men have not faith.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn olododo li Oluwa, ẹniti yio fi ẹsẹ nyin mulẹ, ti yio si pa nyin mọ́ kuro ninu ibi.
entries.en: But the Lord is faithful, who shall stablish you, and keep you from evil.

entries.yo: Awa si ni igbẹkẹle ninu Oluwa niti nyin, pe nkan wọnni ti a palaṣẹ fun nyin li ẹnyin nṣe ti ẹ o si mã ṣe.
entries.en: And we have confidence in the Lord touching you, that ye both do and will do the things which we command you.

entries.yo: Ki Oluwa ki o si mã tọ́ ọkan nyin sinu ifẹ Ọlọrun, ati sinu sũru Kristi.
entries.en: And the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God, and into the patient waiting for Christ.

entries.yo: Awa si paṣẹ fun nyin, ará, li orukọ Jesu Kristi Oluwa wa, ki ẹnyin ki o yẹra kuro lọdọ olukuluku arakunrin, ti nrin ségesège, ti kì iṣe gẹgẹ bi ìlana ti nwọn ti gbà lọwọ wa.
