entries.en: Now we command you, brethren, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that ye withdraw yourselves from every brother that walketh disorderly, and not after the tradition which he received of us.

entries.yo: Nitori ẹnyin tikaranyin mọ̀ bi o ti yẹ ki ẹnyin na farawe wa: nitori awa kò rin ségesège larin nyin;
entries.en: For yourselves know how ye ought to follow us: for we behaved not ourselves disorderly among you;

entries.yo: Bẹ̃li awa kò si jẹ onjẹ ẹnikẹni lọfẹ; ṣugbọn ninu ãpọn ati lãlã li a nṣiṣẹ́ lọsan ati loru, ki awa ki o ma bã dẹruba ẹnikẹni ninu nyìn:
entries.en: Neither did we eat any man's bread for nought; but wrought with labour and travail night and day, that we might not be chargeable to any of you:

entries.yo: Kì iṣe pe awa kò li agbara, ṣugbọn awa nfi ara wa ṣe apẹrẹ fun nyin ki ẹnyin kì o le mã farawe wa.
entries.en: Not because we have not power, but to make ourselves an ensample unto you to follow us.

entries.yo: Nitori nigbati awa tilẹ wà pẹlu nyin, eyi li awa palaṣẹ fun nyin, pe bi ẹnikẹni kò bá fẹ ṣiṣẹ, ki o maṣe jẹun.
entries.en: For even when we were with you, this we commanded you, that if any would not work, neither should he eat.

entries.yo: Nitori awa gburo awọn kan ti nrin ségesège larin nyìn ti nwọn kò nṣiṣẹ rara, ṣugbọn nwọn jẹ àtọjú-ile-kiri.
entries.en: For we hear that there are some which walk among you disorderly, working not at all, but are busybodies.

entries.yo: Njẹ irú awọn ẹni bẹ̃ li awa npaṣẹ fun, ti a si nrọ̀ ninu Oluwa Jesu Kristi, pe ki nwọn ki o mã fi ìwa pẹlẹ ṣiṣẹ, ki nwọn ki o si mã jẹ onjẹ awọn tikarawọn.
entries.en: Now them that are such we command and exhort by our Lord Jesus Christ, that with quietness they work, and eat their own bread.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹnyin, ará, ẹ máṣe ṣãrẹ̀ ni rere iṣe.
entries.en: But ye, brethren, be not weary in well doing.

entries.yo: Bi ẹnikẹni kò ba si gbà ọ̀rọ wa gbọ́ nipa iwe yi, ẹ sami si oluwarẹ, ki ẹ má si ṣe ba a kẹgbẹ, ki oju ki o le tì i.
entries.en: And if any man obey not our word by this epistle, note that man, and have no company with him, that he may be ashamed.

entries.yo: Sibẹ ẹ máṣe kà a si ọtá, ṣugbọn ẹ mã gbà a niyanju bi arakunrin.
entries.en: Yet count him not as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.

entries.yo: Njẹ ki Oluwa alafia tikararẹ̀ mã fun nyin ni alafia nigbagbogbo lọna gbogbo. Ki Oluwa ki o pẹlu gbogbo nyin.
entries.en: Now the Lord of peace himself give you peace always by all means. The Lord be with you all.

entries.yo: Ikíni emi Paulu lati ọwọ́ ara mi, eyiti iṣe àmi ninu gbogbo iwe; bẹ̃ni mo nkọwe.
entries.en: The salutation of Paul with mine own hand, which is the token in every epistle: so I write.

entries.yo: Ore-ọfẹ Oluwa wa Jesu Kristi ki o wà pẹlu gbogbo nyin. Amin.
entries.en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

entries.yo: PAULU, Aposteli Kristi Jesu, gẹgẹ bi aṣẹ Ọlọrun Olugbala wa, ati Kristi Jesu ireti wa;
entries.en: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the commandment of God our Saviour, and Lord Jesus Christ, which is our hope;

entries.yo: Si Timotiu, ọmọ mi tõtọ ninu igbagbọ́: Ore-ọfẹ, ãnu, alafia lati ọdọ Ọlọrun Baba wá, ati Kristi Jesu Oluwa wa.
entries.en: Unto Timothy, my own son in the faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God our Father and Jesus Christ our Lord.

entries.yo: Bi mo ti gba ọ niyanju lati joko ni Efesu, nigbati mo nlọ si Makedonia, ki iwọ ki o le paṣẹ fun awọn kan, ki nwọn ki o máṣe kọ́ni li ẹkọ́ miran,
entries.en: As I besought thee to abide still at Ephesus, when I went into Macedonia, that thou mightest charge some that they teach no other doctrine,

entries.yo: Ki nwọn má si ṣe fiyesi awọn itan lasan, ati ti ìran ti kò li opin, eyiti imã mú ijiyan wa dipo iṣẹ iriju Ọlọrun ti mbẹ ninu igbagbọ́; bẹni mo ṣe nisisiyi.
entries.en: Neither give heed to fables and endless genealogies, which minister questions, rather than godly edifying which is in faith: so do.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn opin aṣẹ na ni ifẹ lati ọkàn mimọ́ ati ẹri-ọkan rere ati igbagbọ́ aiṣẹtan wa.
entries.en: Now the end of the commandment is charity out of a pure heart, and of a good conscience, and of faith unfeigned:

entries.yo: Lati inu eyiti awọn ẹlomiran ti yapa kuro ti nwọn si ya sapakan si ọrọ asan;
entries.en: From which some having swerved have turned aside unto vain jangling;

entries.yo: Nwọn nfẹ ṣe olukọ ofin; òye ohun ti nwọn nwi kò yé wọn, tabi ti ohun ti nwọn ntẹnumọ́.
entries.en: Desiring to be teachers of the law; understanding neither what they say, nor whereof they affirm.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awa mọ̀ pe ofin dara, bi enia ba lò o bi ã ti ilo ofin;
entries.en: But we know that the law is good, if a man use it lawfully;

entries.yo: Bi a ti mọ̀ eyi pe, a kò ṣe ofin fun olododo, bikoṣe fun awọn alailofin ati awọn alaigbọran, fun awọn alaiwa-bi-Ọlọrun ati awọn ẹlẹṣẹ, fun awọn alaimọ́ ati awọn ẹlẹgan, fun awọn apa-baba ati awọn apa-iya, fun awọn apania,
entries.en: Knowing this, that the law is not made for a righteous man, but for the lawless and disobedient, for the ungodly and for sinners, for unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,

entries.yo: Fun awọn àgbere, fun awọn ti nfi ọkunrin ba ara wọn jẹ́, fun awọn ají-enia tà, fun awọn eke, fun awọn abura eke, ati bi ohun miran ba si wà ti o lodi si ẹkọ́ ti o yè koro,
entries.en: For whoremongers, for them that defile themselves with mankind, for menstealers, for liars, for perjured persons, and if there be any other thing that is contrary to sound doctrine;

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi ihinrere ti ogo Ọlọrun olubukún, ti a fi si itọju mi.
entries.en: According to the glorious gospel of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.

entries.yo: Mo dupẹ lọwọ Ẹniti o fun mi li agbara, ani Kristi Jesu Oluwa wa, nitoriti o kà mi si olõtọ ni yiyan mi si iṣẹ rẹ̀;
entries.en: And I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who hath enabled me, for that he counted me faithful, putting me into the ministry;

entries.yo: Bi mo tilẹ jẹ asọ ọ̀rọ-odì lẹkan rí, ati oninunibini, ati elewu enia: ṣugbọn mo ri ãnu gbà, nitoriti mo ṣe e li aimọ̀ ninu aigbagbọ.
entries.en: Who was before a blasphemer, and a persecutor, and injurious: but I obtained mercy, because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.

entries.yo: Ore-ọfẹ Oluwa wa si pọ̀ rekọja pẹlu igbagbọ́ ati ifẹ, ti mbẹ ninu Kristi Jesu.
entries.en: And the grace of our Lord was exceeding abundant with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

entries.yo: Otitọ li ọrọ na, o si yẹ fun itẹwọgbà, pe Kristi Jesu wá si aiye lati gbà ẹlẹṣẹ là; ninu awọn ẹniti emi jẹ pàtaki.
entries.en: This is a faithful saying, and worthy of all acceptation, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nitori eyi ni mo ṣe ri ãnu gbà, pe lara mi, bi olori, ni ki Jesu Kristi fi gbogbo ipamọra rẹ̀ hàn bi apẹrẹ fun awọn ti yio gbà a gbọ́ si ìye ainipẹkun nigba ikẹhin.
entries.en: Howbeit for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first Jesus Christ might shew forth all longsuffering, for a pattern to them which should hereafter believe on him to life everlasting.

entries.yo: Njẹ fun Ọba aiyeraiye, aidibajẹ, airi, Ọlọrun kanṣoṣo, ni ọlá ati ogo wà fun lai ati lailai. Amin.
entries.en: Now unto the King eternal, immortal, invisible, the only wise God, be honour and glory for ever and ever. Amen.

entries.yo: Aṣẹ yi ni mo pa fun ọ, Timotiu ọmọ mi, gẹgẹ bi isọtẹlẹ wọnni ti o ti ṣaju lori rẹ, pe nipa wọn ki iwọ ki o le mã jà ogun rere;
entries.en: This charge I commit unto thee, son Timothy, according to the prophecies which went before on thee, that thou by them mightest war a good warfare;

entries.yo: Mã ni igbagbọ́ ati ẹri-ọkàn rere; eyiti awọn ẹlomiran tanu kuro lọdọ wọn ti nwọn si rì ọkọ̀ igbagbọ́ wọn:
entries.en: Holding faith, and a good conscience; which some having put away concerning faith have made shipwreck:

entries.yo: Ninu awọn ẹniti Himeneu ati Aleksanderu wà; awọn ti mo ti fi le Satani lọwọ, ki a le kọ́ wọn ki nwọn ki o má sọrọ-odi mọ́.
entries.en: Of whom is Hymenaeus and Alexander; whom I have delivered unto Satan, that they may learn not to blaspheme.

entries.yo: NITORINA mo gbà nyin niyanju ṣaju ohun gbogbo, pe ki a mã bẹ̀bẹ, ki a mã gbadura, ki a mã ṣìpẹ, ati ki a mã dupẹ nitori gbogbo enia;
entries.en: I exhort therefore, that, first of all, supplications, prayers, intercessions, and giving of thanks, be made for all men;

entries.yo: Fun awọn ọba, ati gbogbo awọn ti o wà ni ipo giga; ki a le mã lo aiye wa ni idakẹjẹ ati pẹlẹ ninu gbogbo ìwa-bi-Ọlọrun ati ìwa agbà.
entries.en: For kings, and for all that are in authority; that we may lead a quiet and peaceable life in all godliness and honesty.

entries.yo: Nitori eyi dara o si ṣe itẹwọgbà niwaju Ọlọrun Olugbala wa;
entries.en: For this is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Saviour;

entries.yo: Ẹniti o nfẹ ki gbogbo enia ni igbala ki nwọn si wá sinu ìmọ otitọ.
entries.en: Who will have all men to be saved, and to come unto the knowledge of the truth.

entries.yo: Nitori Ọlọrun kan ni mbẹ, Onilaja kan pẹlu larin Ọlọrun ati enia, on papa enia, ani Kristi Jesu;
entries.en: For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus;

entries.yo: Ẹniti o fi ara rẹ̀ ṣe irapada fun gbogbo enia, ẹrí li akokò rẹ̀;
entries.en: Who gave himself a ransom for all, to be testified in due time.

entries.yo: Nitori eyiti a yàn mi ṣe oniwasu, ati aposteli, (otitọ li emi nsọ, emi kò ṣeke;) olukọ awọn Keferi ni igbagbọ́ ati otitọ.
entries.en: Whereunto I am ordained a preacher, and an apostle, (I speak the truth in Christ, and lie not;) a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and verity.

entries.yo: Nitorina mo fẹ ki awọn ọkunrin mã gbadura nibi gbogbo, ki nwọn mã gbé ọwọ́ mimọ́ soke, li aibinu ati li aijiyan.
entries.en: I will therefore that men pray every where, lifting up holy hands, without wrath and doubting.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ gẹgẹ ki awọn obinrin ki o fi aṣọ iwọntunwọnsin ṣe ara wọn li ọṣọ́, pẹlu itiju ati ìwa airekọja; kì iṣe pẹlu irun didì ati wura, tabi pearli, tabi aṣọ olowo iyebiye,
entries.en: In like manner also, that women adorn themselves in modest apparel, with shamefacedness and sobriety; not with broided hair, or gold, or pearls, or costly array;

entries.yo: Bikoṣe pẹlu iṣẹ́ rere (eyi ti o yẹ fun awọn obinrin ti o jẹwọ ìwa-bi-Ọlọrun).
entries.en: But (which becometh women professing godliness) with good works.

entries.yo: Jẹ ki obinrin ki o mã fi idakẹjẹ ati itẹriba gbogbo kọ́ ẹkọ́.
entries.en: Let the woman learn in silence with all subjection.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi kò fi aṣẹ fun obinrin lati mã kọ́ni, tabi lati paṣẹ lori ọkunrin, bikoṣepe ki o dakẹjẹ.
entries.en: But I suffer not a woman to teach, nor to usurp authority over the man, but to be in silence.

entries.yo: Nitori Adamu li a kọ́ dá, lẹhin na, Efa.
entries.en: For Adam was first formed, then Eve.

entries.yo: A kò si tàn Adamu jẹ, ṣugbọn obinrin na, nigbati a tàn a, o ṣubu sinu ẹ̀ṣẹ.
entries.en: And Adam was not deceived, but the woman being deceived was in the transgression.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn a o gbà a là nipa ìbimọ rẹ̀, bi nwọn ba duro ninu igbagbọ́ ati ifẹ, ati ìwa mimọ́ pẹlu ìwa airekọja.
entries.en: Notwithstanding she shall be saved in childbearing, if they continue in faith and charity and holiness with sobriety.

entries.yo: OTITỌ ni ọ̀rọ na, bi ẹnikan ba fẹ oyè biṣopu, iṣẹ rere li o nfẹ.
entries.en: This is a true saying, If a man desire the office of a bishop, he desireth a good work.

entries.yo: Njẹ biṣopu jẹ alailẹgan, ọkọ aya kan, oluṣọra, alairekọja, oniwa yiyẹ, olufẹ alejò ṣiṣe, ẹniti o le ṣe olukọ.
entries.en: A bishop then must be blameless, the husband of one wife, vigilant, sober, of good behaviour, given to hospitality, apt to teach;

entries.yo: Ki o má jẹ ọmuti, tabi onijà, tabi olojukokoro, bikoṣe onisũru, ki o má jẹ onija, tabi olufẹ owo;
entries.en: Not given to wine, no striker, not greedy of filthy lucre; but patient, not a brawler, not covetous;

entries.yo: Ẹniti o kawọ ile ara rẹ̀ girigiri, ti o mu awọn ọmọ rẹ̀ tẹriba pẹlu ìwa àgba gbogbo;
entries.en: One that ruleth well his own house, having his children in subjection with all gravity;

entries.yo: (Ṣugbọn bi enia kò ba mọ̀ bi ã ti ṣe ikawọ ile ara rẹ̀, on o ha ti ṣe le tọju ijọ Ọlọrun?)
entries.en: (For if a man know not how to rule his own house, how shall he take care of the church of God?)

entries.yo: Ki o má jẹ ẹni titun, kí o má bã gbéraga, ki o si ṣubu sinu ẹbi Èṣu.
entries.en: Not a novice, lest being lifted up with pride he fall into the condemnation of the devil.

entries.yo: O si yẹ kí o ni ẹri rere pẹlu lọdọ awọn ti mbẹ lode: kí o má ba bọ sinu ẹ̀gan ati sinu idẹkun Èṣu.
entries.en: Moreover he must have a good report of them which are without; lest he fall into reproach and the snare of the devil.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ gẹgẹ li o yẹ fun awọn diakoni lati ni ìwa àgba, ki nwọn má jẹ ẹlẹnu meji, kì nwọn má fi ara wọn fun waini pupọ̀, ki nwọn má jẹ olojukokoro.
entries.en: Likewise must the deacons be grave, not doubletongued, not given to much wine, not greedy of filthy lucre;

entries.yo: Ki nwọn mã di ohun ijinlẹ igbagbọ́ mu li ọkàn funfun.
entries.en: Holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.

entries.yo: Ki a si kọ́ wá idi awọn wọnyi daju pẹlu; nigbana ni ki a jẹ ki nwọn jẹ oyè diakoni, bi nwọn ba jẹ alailẹgan.
entries.en: And let these also first be proved; then let them use the office of a deacon, being found blameless.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ gẹgẹ li o yẹ fun awọn obinrin lati ni iwa àgba, kì nwọn má jẹ asọrọ-ẹni-lẹhin bikoṣe alairekọja, olõtọ li ohun gbogbo.
entries.en: Even so must their wives be grave, not slanderers, sober, faithful in all things.

entries.yo: Ki awọn diakoni jẹ ọkọ obinrin kan, ki nwọn ki o káwọ awọn ọmọ wọn ati ile ara wọn daradara.
entries.en: Let the deacons be the husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.

entries.yo: Nitori awọn ti o lò oyè diakoni daradara rà ipo rere fun ara wọn, ati igboiya pupọ ni igbagbọ́ ti mbẹ ninu Kristi Jesu.
entries.en: For they that have used the office of a deacon well purchase to themselves a good degree, and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.

entries.yo: Iwe nkan wọnyi ni mo kọ si ọ, mo si nreti ati tọ̀ ọ wá ni lọ̃lọ̃.
entries.en: These things write I unto thee, hoping to come unto thee shortly:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi mo ba pẹ, ki iwọ ki o le mọ̀ bi o ti yẹ fun awọn enia lati mã huwa ninu ile Ọlọrun, ti iṣe ijọ Ọlọrun alãye, ọwọ̀n ati ipilẹ otitọ.
entries.en: But if I tarry long, that thou mayest know how thou oughtest to behave thyself in the house of God, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.

entries.yo: Laiṣiyemeji, titobi ni ohun ijinlẹ ìwa-bi-Ọlọrun, ẹniti a fihan ninu ara, ti a dalare ninu Ẹmí, ti awọn angẹli ri, ti a wasu rẹ̀ lãrin awọn orilẹ-ede, ti a gbagbọ ninu aiye, ti a gba soke sinu ogo.
entries.en: And without controversy great is the mystery of godliness: God was manifest in the flesh, justified in the Spirit, seen of angels, preached unto the Gentiles, believed on in the world, received up into glory.

entries.yo: ṢUGBỌN Ẹmí ntẹnumọ ọ pe, ni igba ikẹhin awọn miran yio kuro ninu igbagbọ́, nwọn o mã fiyesi awọn ẹmí ti ntan-ni-jẹ, ati ẹkọ́ awọn ẹmí èṣu;
entries.en: Now the Spirit speaketh expressly, that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits, and doctrines of devils;

entries.yo: Nipa agabagebe awọn ti nṣeke, awọn ti ọkàn awọn tikarawọn dabi eyiti a fi irin gbigbona jó.
entries.en: Speaking lies in hypocrisy; having their conscience seared with a hot iron;

entries.yo: Awọn ti nda-ni-lẹkun ati gbeyawo, ti nwọn si npaṣẹ lati ka ẽwọ onjẹ ti Ọlọrun ti da fun itẹwọgba pẹlu ọpẹ awọn onigbagbọ ati awọn ti o mọ otitọ.
entries.en: Forbidding to marry, and commanding to abstain from meats, which God hath created to be received with thanksgiving of them which believe and know the truth.

entries.yo: Nitori gbogbo ohun ti Ọlọrun dá li o dara, kò si ọkan ti o yẹ ki a kọ̀, bi a ba fi ọpẹ́ gbà a.
entries.en: For every creature of God is good, and nothing to be refused, if it be received with thanksgiving:

entries.yo: Nitori a fi ọ̀rọ Ọlọrun ati adura yà a si mimọ́.
entries.en: For it is sanctified by the word of God and prayer.

entries.yo: Bi iwọ ba nrán awọn ará leti nkan wọnyi, iwọ o jẹ iranṣẹ rere ti Kristi Jesu, ti a nfi ọrọ igbagbọ́ ati ẹ̀kọ rere bọ́, eyiti iwọ ti ntẹle.
entries.en: If thou put the brethren in remembrance of these things, thou shalt be a good minister of Jesus Christ, nourished up in the words of faith and of good doctrine, whereunto thou hast attained.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn kọ̀ ọrọ asan ati itan awọn agba obinrin, si mã tọ́ ara rẹ si ìwa-bi-Ọlọrun.
entries.en: But refuse profane and old wives' fables, and exercise thyself rather unto godliness.

entries.yo: Nitori ṣíṣe eré ìdaraya ní èrè diẹ, ṣugbọn ìwa-bi-Ọlọrun li ère fun ohun gbogbo, o ni ileri ti aiye isisiyi ati ti eyi ti mbọ̀.
entries.en: For bodily exercise profiteth little: but godliness is profitable unto all things, having promise of the life that now is, and of that which is to come.

entries.yo: Otitọ ni ọrọ na, o si yẹ fun itẹwọgbà gbogbo.
entries.en: This is a faithful saying and worthy of all acceptation.

entries.yo: Nitori fun eyi li awa nṣe lãlã ti a si njijakadi, nitori awa ni ireti ninu Ọlọrun alãye, ẹniti iṣe Olugbala gbogbo enia, pẹlupẹlu ti awọn ti o gbagbọ́.
entries.en: For therefore we both labour and suffer reproach, because we trust in the living God, who is the Saviour of all men, specially of those that believe.

entries.yo: Nkan wọnyi ni ki o mã palaṣẹ ki o si mã kọ́ni.
entries.en: These things command and teach.

entries.yo: Máṣe jẹ ki ẹnikẹni ki o gàn ewe rẹ; ṣugbọn ki iwọ ki o jẹ apẹrẹ fun awọn ti o gbagbọ́, ninu ọ̀rọ, ninu ìwa hihu, ninu ifẹ, ninu ẹmí, ninu igbagbọ́, ninu ìwa mimọ́.
entries.en: Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity.

entries.yo: Titi emi o fi de, mã tọju iwe kikà ati igbaniyanju ati ikọ́ni.
entries.en: Till I come, give attendance to reading, to exhortation, to doctrine.

entries.yo: Máṣe ainani ẹ̀bun ti mbẹ lara rẹ, eyiti a fi fun ọ nipa isọtẹlẹ pẹlu ifọwọle awọn àgba.
entries.en: Neglect not the gift that is in thee, which was given thee by prophecy, with the laying on of the hands of the presbytery.

entries.yo: Mã fiyesi nkan wọnyi; fi ara rẹ fun wọn patapata; ki ilọsiwaju rẹ ki o le hàn gbangba fun gbogbo enia.
entries.en: Meditate upon these things; give thyself wholly to them; that thy profiting may appear to all.

entries.yo: Mã ṣe itọju ara rẹ ati ẹkọ́ rẹ; mã duro laiyẹsẹ ninu nkan wọnyi: nitori ni ṣiṣe eyi, iwọ ó gbà ara rẹ ati awọn ti ngbọ́ ọ̀rọ rẹ là.
entries.en: Take heed unto thyself, and unto the doctrine; continue in them: for in doing this thou shalt both save thyself, and them that hear thee.

entries.yo: MÁṢE ba alàgba wi, ṣugbọn ki o mã gba a niyanju bi baba; awọn ọdọmọkunrin bi arakunrin;
entries.en: Rebuke not an elder, but intreat him as a father; and the younger men as brethren;

entries.yo: Awọn àgba obinrin bi iya; awọn ọdọmọbirin bi arabinrin ninu ìwa mimọ́.
entries.en: The elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, with all purity.

entries.yo: Bọ̀wọ fun awọn opó ti iṣe opó nitõtọ.
entries.en: Honour widows that are widows indeed.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi opó kan ba li ọmọ tabi ọmọ-ọmọ, jẹ ki nwọn tète kọ́ ati ṣe itọju ile awọn tikarawọn, ki nwọn ki o si san õre awọn obi wọn pada: nitoripe eyi li o ṣe itẹwọgbà niwaju Ọlọrun.
entries.en: But if any widow have children or nephews, let them learn first to shew piety at home, and to requite their parents: for that is good and acceptable before God.

entries.yo: Njẹ ẹniti iṣe opó nitõtọ, ti o ṣe on nikan, a mã gbẹkẹle Ọlọrun, a si mã duro ninu ẹ̀bẹ ati ninu adura lọsán ati loru.
entries.en: Now she that is a widow indeed, and desolate, trusteth in God, and continueth in supplications and prayers night and day.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹniti o ba fi ara rẹ̀ fun aiye jijẹ, o kú nigbati o wà lãye.
entries.en: But she that liveth in pleasure is dead while she liveth.

entries.yo: Nkan wọnyi ni ki iwọ ki o si mã palaṣẹ, ki nwọn ki o le wà lailẹgan.
entries.en: And these things give in charge, that they may be blameless.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi ẹnikẹni kò bá pèse fun awọn tirẹ, papa fun awọn ará ile rẹ̀, o ti sẹ́ igbagbọ́, o buru ju alaigbagbọ́ lọ.
entries.en: But if any provide not for his own, and specially for those of his own house, he hath denied the faith, and is worse than an infidel.

entries.yo: Máṣe kọ orukọ ẹniti o ba din ni ọgọta ọdún silẹ bi opó, ti o ti jẹ obinrin ọkọ kan,
entries.en: Let not a widow be taken into the number under threescore years old, having been the wife of one man,

entries.yo: Ẹniti a jẹri rẹ̀ fun iṣẹ rere; bi o ba ti ntọ́ ọmọ ri, bi o ba ti ngba alejò, bi o bá ti nwẹ ẹsẹ awọn enia mimọ́, bi o ba ti nràn awọn olupọnju lọwọ, bi o ba ti nlepa iṣẹ rere gbogbo.
entries.en: Well reported of for good works; if she have brought up children, if she have lodged strangers, if she have washed the saints' feet, if she have relieved the afflicted, if she have diligently followed every good work.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn kọ̀ awọn opo ti kò dagba: nitoripe nigbati nwọn ba ti ṣe ifẹkufẹ lodi si Kristi, nwọn a fẹ gbeyawo;
entries.en: But the younger widows refuse: for when they have begun to wax wanton against Christ, they will marry;

entries.yo: Nwọn a di ẹlẹbi, nitoriti nwọn ti kọ̀ igbagbọ́ wọn iṣaju silẹ.
entries.en: Having damnation, because they have cast off their first faith.

entries.yo: Ati pẹlu nwọn nkọ́ lati ṣe ọlẹ, lati mã kiri lati ile de ile; ki iṣe ọlẹ nikan, ṣugbọn onisọkusọ ati olofòfo pẹlu, nwọn a ma sọ ohun ti kò yẹ.
entries.en: And withal they learn to be idle, wandering about from house to house; and not only idle, but tattlers also and busybodies, speaking things which they ought not.

entries.yo: Nitorina mo fẹ ki awọn opo ti kò dagba mã gbeyawo, ki nwọn mã bímọ, ki nwọn ki o mã ṣe alabojuto ile, ki nwọn ki o máṣe fi àye silẹ rara fun ọtá na lati sọ̀rọ ẹ̀gan.
entries.en: I will therefore that the younger women marry, bear children, guide the house, give none occasion to the adversary to speak reproachfully.

entries.yo: Nitori awọn miran ti yipada kuro si ẹhin Satani.
entries.en: For some are already turned aside after Satan.

entries.yo: Bi obinrin kan ti o gbagbọ́ ba ni awọn opó, ki o mã ràn wọn lọwọ, ki a má si di ẹrù le ijọ, ki nwọn ki o le mã ràn awọn ti iṣe opó nitõtọ lọwọ.
entries.en: If any man or woman that believeth have widows, let them relieve them, and let not the church be charged; that it may relieve them that are widows indeed.

entries.yo: Awọn alàgba ti o ṣe akoso daradara ni ki a kà yẹ si ọlá ilọpo meji, pẹlupẹlu awọn ti o ṣe lãlã ni ọ̀rọ ati ni kikọni.
entries.en: Let the elders that rule well be counted worthy of double honour, especially they who labour in the word and doctrine.

entries.yo: Nitoriti iwe-mimọ́ wipe, Iwọ kò gbọdọ dì malu ti ntẹ̀ ọkà li ẹnu. Ati pe, ọ̀ya alagbaṣe tọ si i.
entries.en: For the scripture saith, Thou shalt not muzzle the ox that treadeth out the corn. And, The labourer is worthy of his reward.

entries.yo: Máṣe gbà ẹ̀sun si alàgba kan, bikoṣe lati ẹnu ẹlẹri meji tabi mẹta.
entries.en: Against an elder receive not an accusation, but before two or three witnesses.

entries.yo: Ba awọn ti o ṣẹ̀ wi niwaju gbogbo enia, ki awọn iyokù pẹlu ki o le bẹ̀ru.
entries.en: Them that sin rebuke before all, that others also may fear.

entries.yo: Mo paṣẹ fun ọ niwaju Ọlọrun, ati Kristi Jesu, ati awọn angẹli ayanfẹ, ki iwọ ki o mã ṣakiyesi nkan wọnyi, laiṣe ojuṣãju, lai fi ègbè ṣe ohunkohun.
entries.en: I charge thee before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, and the elect angels, that thou observe these things without preferring one before another, doing nothing by partiality.

entries.yo: Máṣe fi ikanju gbe ọwọ́ le ẹnikẹni, bẹ̃ni ki o má si ṣe jẹ alabapin ninu ẹ̀ṣẹ̀ awọn ẹlomiran: pa ara rẹ mọ́ ni ìwa funfun.
entries.en: Lay hands suddenly on no man, neither be partaker of other men's sins: keep thyself pure.

entries.yo: Máṣe mã mu omi nikan, ṣugbọn mã lo waini diẹ nitori inu rẹ, ati nitori ailera rẹ igbakugba.
entries.en: Drink no longer water, but use a little wine for thy stomach's sake and thine often infirmities.

entries.yo: Ẹ̀ṣẹ awọn ẹlomiran a mã han gbangba, a mã lọ ṣãju si idajọ; ti awọn ẹlomiran pẹlu a si mã tẹle wọn.
entries.en: Some men's sins are open beforehand, going before to judgment; and some men they follow after.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ gẹgẹ pẹlu ni iṣẹ rere wà ti nwọn hàn gbangba; awọn iru miran kò si le farasin.
entries.en: Likewise also the good works of some are manifest beforehand; and they that are otherwise cannot be hid.

entries.yo: KI gbogbo awọn ti iṣe ẹrú labẹ ìrú mã ka awọn oluwa ti o ni wọn yẹ si ọla gbogbo, ki a má bã sọrọ-odi si orukọ Ọlọrun ati ẹkọ́ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Let as many servants as are under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honour, that the name of God and his doctrine be not blasphemed.

entries.yo: Awọn ti o si ni oluwa onigbagbọ́, ki nwọn máṣe gàn wọn nitori arakunrin ni nwọn; ṣugbọn ki nwọn tubọ mã sìn wọn, nitori awọn ti iṣe alabapin iṣẹ rere wọn jẹ onigbagbọ́ ati olufẹ. Nkan wọnyi ni ki o mã kọ́ni ki o si mã fi gba-ni-niyanju.
entries.en: And they that have believing masters, let them not despise them, because they are brethren; but rather do them service, because they are faithful and beloved, partakers of the benefit. These things teach and exhort.

entries.yo: Bi ẹnikẹni ba nkọ́ni li ẹkọ miran, ti kò si gba ọ̀rọ ti o ye kõro, ani ọ̀rọ Jesu Kristi Oluwa wa, ati ẹkọ́ gẹgẹ bi ìwa-bi-Ọlọrun.
entries.en: If any man teach otherwise, and consent not to wholesome words, even the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the doctrine which is according to godliness;

entries.yo: O gberaga, kò mọ nkan kan, bikoṣe ifẹ iyan-jija ati ìja-ọ̀rọ ninu eyiti ilara, ìya, ọrọ buburu ati iro buburu ti iwá,
entries.en: He is proud, knowing nothing, but doting about questions and strifes of words, whereof cometh envy, strife, railings, evil surmisings,

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ̀ ayipo awọn enia ọlọkan ẽri ti kò si otitọ ninu wọn, ti nwọn ṣebi ọna si ere ni ìwa-bi-Ọlọrun: yẹra lọdọ irú awọn wọnni.
entries.en: Perverse disputings of men of corrupt minds, and destitute of the truth, supposing that gain is godliness: from such withdraw thyself.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn iwa-bi-Ọlọrun pẹlu itẹlọrùn ère nla ni.
entries.en: But godliness with contentment is great gain.

entries.yo: Nitori a kò mu ohun kan wá si aiye, bẹni a kò si le mu ohunkohun jade lọ.
entries.en: For we brought nothing into this world, and it is certain we can carry nothing out.

entries.yo: Bi a ba si li onjẹ ati aṣọ ìwọnyi yio tẹ́ wa lọrùn.
entries.en: And having food and raiment let us be therewith content.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn ti nfẹ di ọlọrọ̀ a mã bọ́ sinu idanwò ati idẹkun, ati sinu wère ifẹkufẹ pipọ ti ipa-ni-lara, iru eyiti imã rì enia sinu iparun ati ègbé.
entries.en: But they that will be rich fall into temptation and a snare, and into many foolish and hurtful lusts, which drown men in destruction and perdition.

entries.yo: Nitori ifẹ owo ni gbòngbo ohun buburu gbogbo: eyiti awọn miran nlepa ti a si mu wọn ṣako kuro ninu igbagbọ́, nwọn si fi ibinujẹ pupọ̀ gún ara wọn li ọ̀kọ̀.
entries.en: For the love of money is the root of all evil: which while some coveted after, they have erred from the faith, and pierced themselves through with many sorrows.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn iwọ enia Ọlọrun, sá fun nkan wọnyi; ki o si mã lepa ododo, ìwa-bi-Ọlọrun, igbagbọ́, ifẹ, sũru, ìwa tutù.
entries.en: But thou, O man of God, flee these things; and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, patience, meekness.

entries.yo: Mã jà ìja rere ti igbagbọ́, di ìye ainipẹkun mu ninu eyiti a gbé pè ọ si, ti iwọ si ṣe ijẹwo rere niwaju ẹlẹri pupọ̀.
entries.en: Fight the good fight of faith, lay hold on eternal life, whereunto thou art also called, and hast professed a good profession before many witnesses.

entries.yo: Mo paṣẹ fun ọ niwaju Ọlọrun, ti nsọ ohun gbogbo di ãye, ati niwaju Jesu Kristi, ẹni, niwaju Pontiu Pilatu, ti o jẹri ijẹwọ rere,
entries.en: I give thee charge in the sight of God, who quickeneth all things, and before Christ Jesus, who before Pontius Pilate witnessed a good confession;

entries.yo: Ki iwọ ki o pa ofin mọ́ li ailabawọn, li ailẹgan, titi di ifarahàn Oluwa wa Jesu Kristi:
entries.en: That thou keep this commandment without spot, unrebukeable, until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ:

entries.yo: Eyiti yio fihàn ni igba tirẹ̀, Ẹniti iṣe Olubukún ati Alagbara na kanṣoṣo, Ọba awọn ọba, ati Oluwa awọn oluwa;
entries.en: Which in his times he shall shew, who is the blessed and only Potentate, the King of kings, and Lord of lords;

entries.yo: Ẹnikanṣoṣo ti o ni aikú, ti ngbe inu imọlẹ ti a kò le sunmọ, ẹniti enia kan kò ri rí ti kò si le ri: ẹniti ọla ati agbara titi lai iṣe tirẹ. Amin.
entries.en: Who only hath immortality, dwelling in the light which no man can approach unto; whom no man hath seen, nor can see: to whom be honour and power everlasting. Amen.

entries.yo: Kìlọ fun awọn ti o lọrọ̀ li aiye isisiyi, ki nwọn máṣe gberaga, bẹni ki nwọn máṣe gbẹkẹle ọrọ̀ aidaniloju, bikoṣe le Ọlọrun alãye, ti nfi ohun gbogbo fun wa lọpọlọpọ lati lo;
entries.en: Charge them that are rich in this world, that they be not highminded, nor trust in uncertain riches, but in the living God, who giveth us richly all things to enjoy;

entries.yo: Ki nwọn ki o mã ṣõre, ki nwọn ki o mã pọ̀ ni iṣẹ rere, ki nwọn mura lati pin funni, ki nwọn ki o ni ẹmi ibakẹdun;
entries.en: That they do good, that they be rich in good works, ready to distribute, willing to communicate;

entries.yo: Ki nwọn ki o mã tò iṣura ipilẹ rere jọ fun ara wọn dè igba ti mbọ̀, ki nwọn ki o le di ìye tõtọ mu.
entries.en: Laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold on eternal life.

entries.yo: Timotiu, ṣọ ohun ni ti a fi si itọju rẹ, yà kuro ninu ọ̀rọ asan ati ijiyan ohun ti a nfi eke pè ni imọ;
entries.en: O Timothy, keep that which is committed to thy trust, avoiding profane and vain babblings, and oppositions of science falsely so called:

entries.yo: Eyiti awọn ẹlomiran jẹwọ rẹ̀ ti nwọn si ṣina igbagbọ́. Ki ore-ọfẹ ki o wà pẹlu rẹ. Amin.
entries.en: Which some professing have erred concerning the faith. Grace be with thee. Amen.

entries.yo: PAULU, Aposteli Kristi Jesu nipa ifẹ Ọlọrun, gẹgẹ bi ileri ìye ti mbẹ ninu Kristi Jesu,
entries.en: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, according to the promise of life which is in Christ Jesus,

entries.yo: Si Timotiu, ọmọ mi olufẹ ọwọn: Ore-ọfẹ, ãnu, ati alafia, lati ọdọ Ọlọrun Baba wá, ati Kristi Jesu Oluwa wa.
entries.en: To Timothy, my dearly beloved son: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

entries.yo: Mo dupẹ lọwọ Ọlọrun, ti emi nsìn lati ọdọ awọn baba mi wá ninu ẹri-ọkan funfun, pe li aisimi li emi nṣe iranti rẹ ninu adura mi,
entries.en: I thank God, whom I serve from my forefathers with pure conscience, that without ceasing I have remembrance of thee in my prayers night and day;

entries.yo: T'ọsan t'oru li emi njaìyà ati ri ọ, ti mo nranti omije rẹ, ki a le fi ayọ̀ kún mi li ọkàn;
entries.en: Greatly desiring to see thee, being mindful of thy tears, that I may be filled with joy;

entries.yo: Nigbati mo ba ranti igbagbọ́ ailẹtan ti mbẹ ninu rẹ, eyiti o kọ́ wà ninu Loide iya-nla rẹ, ati ninu Eunike iya rẹ; mo si gbagbọ pe, o mbẹ ninu rẹ pẹlu.
entries.en: When I call to remembrance the unfeigned faith that is in thee, which dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois, and thy mother Eunice; and I am persuaded that in thee also.

entries.yo: Nitori idi eyi ni mo ṣe nran ọ leti pe ki iwọ ki o mã rú ẹ̀bun Ọlọrun soke eyiti mbẹ ninu rẹ nipa gbigbe ọwọ mi le ọ.
entries.en: Wherefore I put thee in remembrance that thou stir up the gift of God, which is in thee by the putting on of my hands.

entries.yo: Nitoripe Ọlọrun kò fun wa ni ẹmí ibẹru; bikoṣe ti agbara, ati ti ifẹ, ati ti ọkàn ti o yè kõro.
entries.en: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.

entries.yo: Nitorina máṣe tiju ẹrí Oluwa wa, tabi emi ondè rẹ̀: ṣugbọn ki iwọ ki o ṣe alabapin ninu ipọnju ihinrere gẹgẹ bi agbara Ọlọrun;
entries.en: Be not thou therefore ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner: but be thou partaker of the afflictions of the gospel according to the power of God;

entries.yo: Ẹniti o gbà wa là, ti o si fi ìpe mimọ́ pè wa, kì iṣe gẹgẹ bi iṣe wa, ṣugbọn gẹgẹ bi ipinnu ati ore-ọfẹ tirẹ̀, ti a fifun wa ninu Kristi Jesu lati aiyeraiye,
entries.en: Who hath saved us, and called us with an holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given us in Christ Jesus before the world began,

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ti a fihàn nisisiyi nipa ifarahàn Jesu Kristi Olugbala wa, ẹniti o pa ikú rẹ́, ti o si mu ìye ati aidibajẹ wá si imọlẹ nipasẹ ihinrere,
entries.en: But is now made manifest by the appearing of our Saviour Jesus Christ, who hath abolished death, and hath brought life and immortality to light through the gospel:

entries.yo: Fun eyiti a yàn mi ṣe oniwasu, ati aposteli, ati olukọ.
entries.en: Whereunto I am appointed a preacher, and an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.

entries.yo: Nitori idi eyiti emi ṣe njìya wọnyi pẹlu: ṣugbọn oju kò tì mi: nitori emi mọ̀ ẹniti emi gbagbọ́, o si da mi loju pe, on le pa ohun ti mo fi le e lọwọ mọ́ titi di ọjọ nì.
entries.en: For the which cause I also suffer these things: nevertheless I am not ashamed: for I know whom I have believed, and am persuaded that he is able to keep that which I have committed unto him against that day.

entries.yo: Dì apẹrẹ awọn ọ̀rọ ti o yè koro ti iwọ ti gbọ́ lọdọ mi mu, ninu igbagbọ́ ati ifẹ ti mbẹ ninu Kristi Jesu.
entries.en: Hold fast the form of sound words, which thou hast heard of me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

entries.yo: Ohun rere nì ti a ti fi le ọ lọwọ, pa a mọ́ nipa Ẹmí Mimọ́ ti ngbe inu wa.
entries.en: That good thing which was committed unto thee keep by the Holy Ghost which dwelleth in us.

entries.yo: Eyi ni iwọ mọ̀, pe gbogbo awọn ti o wà ni Asia yipada kuro lẹhin mi; ninu awọn ẹniti Figellu ati Hermogene gbé wà.
entries.en: This thou knowest, that all they which are in Asia be turned away from me; of whom are Phygellus and Hermogenes.

entries.yo: Ki Oluwa ki o fi ãnu fun ile Onesiforu; nitoriti ima tù mi lara nigba pupọ̀, ẹ̀wọn mi kò si tì i loju:
entries.en: The Lord give mercy unto the house of Onesiphorus; for he oft refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati o wà ni Romu, o fi ẹsọ̀ wá mi, o si ri mi.
entries.en: But, when he was in Rome, he sought me out very diligently, and found me.

entries.yo: Ki Oluwa ki o fifun u ki o le ri ãnu lọdọ Oluwa li ọjọ nì: iwọ tikararẹ sá mọ̀ dajudaju iye ohun ti o ṣe fun mi ni Efesu.
entries.en: The Lord grant unto him that he may find mercy of the Lord in that day: and in how many things he ministered unto me at Ephesus, thou knowest very well.

entries.yo: NITORINA, iwọ ọmọ mi, jẹ alagbara ninu ore-ọfẹ ti mbẹ ninu Kristi Jesu.
entries.en: Thou therefore, my son, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.

entries.yo: Ati ohun wọnni ti iwọ ti gbọ́ lọdọ mi lati ọwọ ọ̀pọlọpọ ẹlẹri, awọn na ni ki iwọ fi le awọn olõtọ enia lọwọ, awọn ti yio le mã kọ́ awọn ẹlomiran pẹlu.
entries.en: And the things that thou hast heard of me among many witnesses, the same commit thou to faithful men, who shall be able to teach others also.

entries.yo: Ṣe alabapin pẹlu mi ninu ipọnju, bi ọmọ-ogun rere Jesu Kristi.
entries.en: Thou therefore endure hardness, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ.

entries.yo: Kò si ẹniti njàgun ti ifi ohun aiye yi dí ara rẹ̀ lọwọ, ki o le mu inu ẹniti o yàn a li ọmọ-ogun dùn.
entries.en: No man that warreth entangleth himself with the affairs of this life; that he may please him who hath chosen him to be a soldier.

entries.yo: Bi ẹnikẹni ba si njà, a kì dé e li ade, bikoṣepe o ba jà li aiṣe erú.
entries.en: And if a man also strive for masteries, yet is he not crowned, except he strive lawfully.

entries.yo: Àgbẹ ti o nṣe lãlã li o ni lati kọ́ mu ninu eso wọnni.
entries.en: The husbandman that laboureth must be first partaker of the fruits.

entries.yo: Gbà ohun ti emi nsọ rò; nitori Oluwa yio fun ọ li òye ninu ohun gbogbo.
entries.en: Consider what I say; and the Lord give thee understanding in all things.

entries.yo: Ranti Jesu Kristi, ti o jinde kuro ninu okú, lati inu irú-ọmọ Dafidi, gẹgẹ bi ihinrere mi,
entries.en: Remember that Jesus Christ of the seed of David was raised from the dead according to my gospel:

entries.yo: Ninu eyiti emi nri ipọnju titi dé inu ìde bi arufin; ṣugbọn a kò dè ọ̀rọ Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Wherein I suffer trouble, as an evil doer, even unto bonds; but the word of God is not bound.

entries.yo: Nitorina mo nfarada ohun gbogbo nitori ti awọn ayanfẹ, ki awọn na pẹlu le ni igbala ti mbẹ ninu Kristi Jesu pẹlu ogo ainipẹkun.
entries.en: Therefore I endure all things for the elect's sakes, that they may also obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.

entries.yo: Otitọ li ọrọ na: Nitoripe bi awa ba bá a kú, awa ó si bá a yè:
entries.en: It is a faithful saying: For if we be dead with him, we shall also live with him:

entries.yo: Bi awa ba farada, awa ó si ba a jọba: bi awa ba sẹ́ ẹ, on na yio si sẹ́ wa.
entries.en: If we suffer, we shall also reign with him: if we deny him, he also will deny us:

entries.yo: Bi awa kò ba gbagbọ́, on duro li olõtọ: nitori on kò le sẹ́ ara rẹ̀.
entries.en: If we believe not, yet he abideth faithful: he cannot deny himself.

entries.yo: Nkan wọnyi ni ki o mã rán wọn leti, mã kìlọ fun wọn niwaju Oluwa pe, ki nwọn ki o máṣe jijà ọ̀rọ ti kò lere, fun iparun awọn ti ngbọ.
entries.en: Of these things put them in remembrance, charging them before the Lord that they strive not about words to no profit, but to the subverting of the hearers.

entries.yo: Ṣãpọn lati fi ara rẹ hàn niwaju Ọlọrun li ẹniti o yege, aṣiṣẹ́ ti kò ni lati tiju, ti o npín ọ̀rọ otitọ bi o ti yẹ.
entries.en: Study to shew thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn yà kuro ninu ọ̀rọ asan, nitoriti nwọn ó mã lọ siwaju ninu aiwa-bi-Ọlọrun,
entries.en: But shun profane and vain babblings: for they will increase unto more ungodliness.

entries.yo: Ọrọ wọn yio si mã jẹ bi egbò kikẹ̀; ninu awọn ẹniti Himeneu ati Filetu wà;
entries.en: And their word will eat as doth a canker: of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus;

entries.yo: Awọn ẹniti o ti ṣìna niti otitọ, ti nwipe ajinde ti kọja na; ti nwọn si mbì igbagbọ́ awọn miran ṣubu.
entries.en: Who concerning the truth have erred, saying that the resurrection is past already; and overthrow the faith of some.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ipilẹ Ọlọrun ti o daju duro ṣinṣin, o ni èdidi yi wipe, Oluwa mọ̀ awọn ti iṣe tirẹ̀. Ati pẹlu, ki olukuluku ẹniti npè orukọ Oluwa ki o kuro ninu aiṣododo.
entries.en: Nevertheless the foundation of God standeth sure, having this seal, The Lord knoweth them that are his. And, Let every one that nameth the name of Christ depart from iniquity.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ninu ile nla, kì iṣe kìki ohun elo wura ati ti fadaka nikan ni mbẹ nibẹ̀, ṣugbọn ti igi ati ti amọ̀ pẹlu; ati omiran si ọlá, ati omiran si ailọlá.
entries.en: But in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of earth; and some to honour, and some to dishonour.

entries.yo: Bi ẹnikẹni ba wẹ̀ ara rẹ̀ mọ́ kuro ninu wọnyi, on ó jẹ ohun èlo si ọlá, ti a yà si ọ̀tọ, ti o si yẹ fun ìlo bãle, ti a si ti pèse silẹ si iṣẹ rere gbogbo.
entries.en: If a man therefore purge himself from these, he shall be a vessel unto honour, sanctified, and meet for the master's use, and prepared unto every good work.

entries.yo: Mã sá fun ifẹkufẹ ewe: si mã lepa ododo, igbagbọ́, ifẹ, alafia, pẹlu awọn ti nkepè Oluwa lati inu ọkàn funfun wá.
entries.en: Flee also youthful lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ibẽre wère ati alaini ẹkọ́ ninu ni ki o kọ̀, bi o ti mọ̀ pe nwọn ama dá ìja silẹ.
entries.en: But foolish and unlearned questions avoid, knowing that they do gender strifes.

entries.yo: Iranṣẹ Oluwa kò si gbọdọ jà; bikoṣe ki o jẹ ẹni pẹlẹ si enia gbogbo, ẹniti o le kọ́ni, onisũru,
entries.en: And the servant of the Lord must not strive; but be gentle unto all men, apt to teach, patient,

entries.yo: Ẹniti yio mã kọ́ awọn aṣodi pẹlu iwa tutu; boya Ọlọrun le fun wọn ni ironupiwada si imọ otitọ;
entries.en: In meekness instructing those that oppose themselves; if God peradventure will give them repentance to the acknowledging of the truth;

entries.yo: Nwọn o si le sọji kuro ninu idẹkun Èṣu, awọn ti a ti dì ni igbekun lati ọwọ́ rẹ̀ wá si ifẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And that they may recover themselves out of the snare of the devil, who are taken captive by him at his will.

entries.yo: ṢUGBỌN eyi ni ki o mọ̀, pe ni ikẹhin ọjọ ìgbà ewu yio de.
entries.en: This know also, that in the last days perilous times shall come.

entries.yo: Nitori awọn enia yio jẹ olufẹ ti ara wọn, olufẹ owo, afunnú, agberaga, asọ̀rọbuburu, aṣaigbọran si obi, alailọpẹ, alaimọ́,
entries.en: For men shall be lovers of their own selves, covetous, boasters, proud, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,

entries.yo: Alainifẹ, alaile darijini, abanijẹ́, alaile-kó-ra-wọnnijanu, onroro, alainifẹ-ohun-rere,
entries.en: Without natural affection, trucebreakers, false accusers, incontinent, fierce, despisers of those that are good,

entries.yo: Onikupani, alagidi, ọlọkàn giga, olufẹ fãji jù olufẹ Ọlọrun lọ;
entries.en: Traitors, heady, highminded, lovers of pleasures more than lovers of God;

entries.yo: Awọn ti nwọn ni afarawe iwa-bi-Ọlọrun, ṣugbọn ti nwọn sẹ́ agbara rẹ̀: yẹra kuro lọdọ awọn wọnyi pẹlu.
entries.en: Having a form of godliness, but denying the power thereof: from such turn away.

entries.yo: Nitori ninu irú eyi li awọn ti nrakò wọ̀ inu ile, ti nwọn si ndì awọn obinrin alailọgbọn ti a dì ẹ̀ṣẹ rù ni igbekùn, ti a si nfi onirũru ifẹkufẹ fà kiri,
entries.en: For of this sort are they which creep into houses, and lead captive silly women laden with sins, led away with divers lusts,

entries.yo: Nwọn nfi igbagbogbo kẹ́kọ, nwọn kò si le de oju ìmọ otitọ.
entries.en: Ever learning, and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.

entries.yo: Njẹ gẹgẹ bi Janesi ati Jamberi ti kọ oju ija si Mose, bẹ̃li awọn wọnyi kọ oju ija si otitọ: awọn enia ti inu wọn dibajẹ, awọn ẹni ìtanù niti ọran igbagbọ́.
entries.en: Now as Jannes and Jambres withstood Moses, so do these also resist the truth: men of corrupt minds, reprobate concerning the faith.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nwọn kì yio lọ siwaju jù bẹ̃lọ: nitori wère wọn yio farahan fun gbogbo enia gẹgẹ bi tiwọn ti yọri si.
entries.en: But they shall proceed no further: for their folly shall be manifest unto all men, as theirs also was.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn iwọ ti mọ̀ ẹkọ́ mi, igbesi aiye mi, ipinnu, igbagbọ́, ipamọra, ifẹ́ni, sũru,
entries.en: But thou hast fully known my doctrine, manner of life, purpose, faith, longsuffering, charity, patience,

entries.yo: Inunibini, iyà; awọn ohun ti o dé bá mi ni Antioku, ni Ikonioni ati ni Listra; awọn inunibini ti mo faradà: Oluwa si gbà mi kuro ninu gbogbo wọn.
entries.en: Persecutions, afflictions, which came unto me at Antioch, at Iconium, at Lystra; what persecutions I endured: but out of them all the Lord delivered me.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ, gbogbo awọn ti o fẹ mã gbé igbé ìwa-bi-Ọlọrun ninu Kristi Jesu, yio farada inunibini.
entries.en: Yea, and all that will live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn enia buburu, ati awọn ẹlẹtàn yio mã gbilẹ siwaju si i, nwọn o mã tàn-ni-jẹ, a o si mã tàn wọn jẹ.
entries.en: But evil men and seducers shall wax worse and worse, deceiving, and being deceived.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn iwọ duro ninu nkan wọnni ti iwọ ti kọ́, ti a si ti jẹ ki oju rẹ dá ṣáṣa si, ki iwọ ki o si mọ̀ ọdọ ẹniti iwọ gbé kọ́ wọn;
entries.en: But continue thou in the things which thou hast learned and hast been assured of, knowing of whom thou hast learned them;

entries.yo: Ati pe lati igba ọmọde ni iwọ ti mọ̀ iwe-mimọ́, ti o le sọ ọ di ọlọ́gbọn si igbala nipasẹ igbagbọ́ ninu Kristi Jesu.
entries.en: And that from a child thou hast known the holy scriptures, which are able to make thee wise unto salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.

entries.yo: Gbogbo iwe-mimọ́ ti o ni imísi Ọlọrun li o si ni ère fun ẹkọ́, fun ibani-wi, fun itọ́ni, fun ikọ́ni ti o wà ninu ododo:
entries.en: All scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness:

entries.yo: Ki enia Ọlọrun ki o le pé, ti a ti mura silẹ patapata fun iṣẹ rere gbogbo.
entries.en: That the man of God may be perfect, throughly furnished unto all good works.

entries.yo: NITORINA mo paṣẹ fun ọ niwaju Ọlọrun, ati Kristi Jesu, ẹniti yio ṣe idajọ alãye ati okú, ati nitori ifarahàn rẹ̀ ati ijọba rẹ̀,
entries.en: I charge thee therefore before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, who shall judge the quick and the dead at his appearing and his kingdom;

entries.yo: Wasu ọ̀rọ na; ṣe aisimi li akokò ti o wọ̀, ati akokò ti kò wọ̀; baniwi, ṣe itọ́ni, gbà-ni-niyanju pẹlu ipamọra ati ẹ̀kọ́ gbogbo.
entries.en: Preach the word; be instant in season, out of season; reprove, rebuke, exhort with all longsuffering and doctrine.

entries.yo: Nitoripe ìgba yio de, ti nwọn kì yio le gba ẹkọ́ ti o yè kõro; ṣugbọn bi nwọn ti jẹ ẹniti eti nrìn nwọn ó lọ kó olukọ jọ fun ara wọn ninu ifẹkufẹ ara wọn.
entries.en: For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine; but after their own lusts shall they heap to themselves teachers, having itching ears;

entries.yo: Nwọn ó si yi etí wọn pada kuro ninu otitọ, nwọn ó si yipada si ìtan asan.
entries.en: And they shall turn away their ears from the truth, and shall be turned unto fables.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn mã ṣe pẹlẹ ninu ohun gbogbo, mã farada ipọnju, ṣe iṣẹ efangelisti, ṣe iṣẹ iranṣẹ rẹ laṣepe.
entries.en: But watch thou in all things, endure afflictions, do the work of an evangelist, make full proof of thy ministry.

entries.yo: Nitori a nfi mi rubọ nisisiyi, atilọ mi si sunmọ etile.
entries.en: For I am now ready to be offered, and the time of my departure is at hand.

entries.yo: Emi ti jà ìja rere, emi ti pari ire-ije mi, emi ti pa igbagbọ́ mọ́:
entries.en: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith:

entries.yo: Lati isisiyi lọ a fi ade ododo lelẹ fun mi, ti Oluwa, onidajọ ododo, yio fifun mi li ọjọ na, kì si iṣe kìki emi nikan, ṣugbọn pẹlu fun gbogbo awọn ti o ti fẹ ifarahàn rẹ̀.
entries.en: Henceforth there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, shall give me at that day: and not to me only, but unto all them also that love his appearing.

entries.yo: Sa ipa rẹ lati tete tọ̀ mi wá.
entries.en: Do thy diligence to come shortly unto me:

entries.yo: Nitori Dema ti kọ̀ mi silẹ, nitori o nfẹ aiye isisiyi, o si lọ si Tessalonika; Kreskeni si Galatia, Titu si Dalmatia.
entries.en: For Demas hath forsaken me, having loved this present world, and is departed unto Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia, Titus unto Dalmatia.

entries.yo: Luku nikan li o wà pẹlu mi. Mu Marku wá pẹlu rẹ: nitori o wulo fun mi fun iṣẹ iranṣẹ.
entries.en: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark, and bring him with thee: for he is profitable to me for the ministry.

entries.yo: Mo rán Tikiku ni iṣẹ lọ si Efesu.
entries.en: And Tychicus have I sent to Ephesus.

entries.yo: Aṣọ otutu ti mo fi silẹ ni Troa lọdọ Karpu, nigbati iwọ ba mbọ̀ mu u wá, ati iwe wọnni, pẹlupẹlu iwe-awọ wọnni.
entries.en: The cloke that I left at Troas with Carpus, when thou comest, bring with thee, and the books, but especially the parchments.

entries.yo: Aleksanderu alagbẹdẹ bàba ṣe mi ni ibi pupọ̀: Oluwa yio san a fun u gẹgẹ bi iṣẹ rẹ̀:
entries.en: Alexander the coppersmith did me much evil: the Lord reward him according to his works:

entries.yo: Lọdọ ẹniti ki iwọ ki o mã ṣọra pẹlu; nitoriti o kọ oju ija si iwasu wa pupọ̀.
entries.en: Of whom be thou ware also; for he hath greatly withstood our words.

entries.yo: Li àtetekọ jẹ ẹjọ mi, kò si ẹniti o bá mi gba ẹjọ ro, ṣugbọn gbogbo enia li o kọ̀ mi silẹ: adura mi ni ki a máṣe kà a si wọn li ọrùn.
entries.en: At my first answer no man stood with me, but all men forsook me: I pray God that it may not be laid to their charge.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Oluwa gbà ẹjọ mi ro, o si fun mi lagbara; pe nipasẹ mi ki a le wãsu na ni awàjálẹ̀, ati pe ki gbogbo awọn Keferi ki o le gbọ́: a si gbà mi kuro li ẹnu kiniun nì.
entries.en: Notwithstanding the Lord stood with me, and strengthened me; that by me the preaching might be fully known, and that all the Gentiles might hear: and I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.

entries.yo: Oluwa yio yọ mi kuro ninu iṣẹ buburu gbogbo, yio si gbé mi de inu ijọba rẹ̀ ọrun: ẹniti ogo wà fun lai ati lailai. Amin.
entries.en: And the Lord shall deliver me from every evil work, and will preserve me unto his heavenly kingdom: to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

entries.yo: Kí Priskilla ati Akuila, ati ile Onesiforu.
entries.en: Salute Prisca and Aquila, and the household of Onesiphorus.

entries.yo: Erastu wà ni Korinti: ṣugbọn mo fi Trofimu silẹ ni Miletu ninu aisan.
entries.en: Erastus abode at Corinth: but Trophimus have I left at Miletum sick.

entries.yo: Sa ipa rẹ lati tete wá ṣaju ìgba otutù. Eubulu kí ọ, ati Pudeni, ati Linu, ati Klaudia, ati gbogbo awọn arakunrin.
entries.en: Do thy diligence to come before winter. Eubulus greeteth thee, and Pudens, and Linus, and Claudia, and all the brethren.

entries.yo: Ki Oluwa ki o wà pẹlu ẹmí rẹ. Ki ore-ọfẹ ki o wà pẹlu nyin. Amin.
entries.en: The Lord Jesus Christ be with thy spirit. Grace be with you. Amen.

entries.yo: PAULU, iranṣẹ Ọlọrun, ati Aposteli Jesu Kristi, gẹgẹ bi igbagbọ́ awọn ayanfẹ Ọlọrun, ati imọ otitọ ti mbẹ gẹgẹ bi ìwa-bi-Ọlọrun,
entries.en: Paul, a servant of God, and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God's elect, and the acknowledging of the truth which is after godliness;

entries.yo: Ni ireti ìye ainipẹkun, ti Ọlọrun, Ẹniti kò le ṣèké, ti ṣe ileri ṣaju ipilẹṣẹ aiye;
entries.en: In hope of eternal life, which God, that cannot lie, promised before the world began;

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ni akokò tirẹ̀ o fi ọ̀rọ rẹ̀ hàn ninu iwasu, ti a fi le mi lọwọ gẹgẹ bi aṣẹ Ọlọrun Olugbala wa;
entries.en: But hath in due times manifested his word through preaching, which is committed unto me according to the commandment of God our Saviour;

entries.yo: Si Titu, ọmọ mi nitõtọ nipa igbagbọ́ ti iṣe ti gbogbo enia: Ore-ọfẹ, ãnu, ati alafia, lati ọdọ Ọlọrun Baba wá ati Kristi Jesu Olugbala wa.
entries.en: To Titus, mine own son after the common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Saviour.

entries.yo: Nitori idi eyi ni mo ṣe fi ọ silẹ ni Krete, ki iwọ ki o le ṣe eto ohun ti o kù, ki o si yan awọn alagba ni olukuluku ilu, bi mo ti paṣẹ fun ọ.
entries.en: For this cause left I thee in Crete, that thou shouldest set in order the things that are wanting, and ordain elders in every city, as I had appointed thee:

entries.yo: Bi ẹnikan ba ṣe alailẹgan, ọkọ aya kan, ti o ni ọmọ ti o gbagbọ́, ti a kò fi sùn fun wọbia, ti nwọn kò si jẹ alagidi.
entries.en: If any be blameless, the husband of one wife, having faithful children not accused of riot or unruly.

entries.yo: Nitori o yẹ ki biṣopu jẹ alailẹgàn, bi iriju Ọlọrun; ki o má jẹ aṣe-tinu-ẹni, oninu-fùfu, ọmuti, aluni, olojukokoro;
entries.en: For a bishop must be blameless, as the steward of God; not selfwilled, not soon angry, not given to wine, no striker, not given to filthy lucre;

entries.yo: Bikoṣe olufẹ alejò ṣiṣe, olufẹ awọn enia rere, alairekọja, olõtọ, ẹni mimọ́, ẹni iwọntunwọnsi;
entries.en: But a lover of hospitality, a lover of good men, sober, just, holy, temperate;

entries.yo: Ti o ndì ọ̀rọ otitọ mu ṣinṣin eyiti iṣe gẹgẹ bi ẹ̀kọ́, ki on ki o le mã gbani-niyanju ninu ẹ̀kọ́ ti o yè kõro, ki o si le mã da awọn asọrọ-odi lẹbi.
entries.en: Holding fast the faithful word as he hath been taught, that he may be able by sound doctrine both to exhort and to convince the gainsayers.

entries.yo: Nitoripe ọpọlọpọ awọn alagídi, awọn asọ̀rọ asan, ati awọn ẹlẹtàn ni mbẹ, papa awọn ti ikọla:
entries.en: For there are many unruly and vain talkers and deceivers, specially they of the circumcision:

entries.yo: Awọn ẹniti a kò le ṣaipa li ẹnu mọ, nitoriti wọn nda odidi agbo ilé rú, ti nwọn nkọni ni ohun ti kò yẹ nitori ere aitọ́.
entries.en: Whose mouths must be stopped, who subvert whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for filthy lucre's sake.

entries.yo: Ọkan ninu wọn, ani woli awọn tikarawọn, wipe, Eke ni awọn ará Krete nigbagbogbo, ẹranko buburu, ọlẹ alajẹki.
entries.en: One of themselves, even a prophet of their own, said, The Cretians are alway liars, evil beasts, slow bellies.

entries.yo: Otitọ li ẹrí yi. Nitorina bá wọn wi gidigidi, ki nwọn ki o le yè kõro ni igbagbọ́;
entries.en: This witness is true. Wherefore rebuke them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith;

entries.yo: Ki nwọn máṣe fiyesi ìtan lasan ti awọn Ju, ati ofin awọn enia ti nwọn yipada kuro ninu otitọ.
entries.en: Not giving heed to Jewish fables, and commandments of men, that turn from the truth.

entries.yo: Ohun gbogbo ni o mọ́ fun awọn ẹniti o mọ́, ṣugbọn fun awọn ti a sọ di ẹlẹgbin ati awọn alaigbagbọ́ kò si ohun ti o mọ́; ṣugbọn ati inu ati ẹ̀ri-ọkan wọn li a sọ di ẹgbin.
entries.en: Unto the pure all things are pure: but unto them that are defiled and unbelieving is nothing pure; but even their mind and conscience is defiled.

entries.yo: Nwọn jẹwọ pe nwọn mọ̀ Ọlọrun; ṣugbọn nipa iṣẹ nwọn nsẹ́ ẹ, nwọn jẹ ẹni irira, ati alaigbọran, ati niti iṣẹ rere gbogbo alainilari.
entries.en: They profess that they know God; but in works they deny him, being abominable, and disobedient, and unto every good work reprobate.

entries.yo: ṢUGBỌN iwọ mã sọ ohun ti o yẹ si ẹkọ́ ti o yè kõro:
entries.en: But speak thou the things which become sound doctrine:

entries.yo: Ki awọn àgba ọkunrin jẹ ẹni iwọntunwọnsin, ẹni-ọ̀wọ, alairekọja, ẹniti o yè kõro ni igbagbọ́, ni ifẹ, ni sũru.
entries.en: That the aged men be sober, grave, temperate, sound in faith, in charity, in patience.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ gẹgẹ ni ki awọn agba obinrin jẹ ẹni-ọ̀wọ ni iwa, ki nwọn má jẹ asọrọ-ẹni-lẹhin, tabi ọmuti, bikoṣe olukọni ni ohun rere;
entries.en: The aged women likewise, that they be in behaviour as becometh holiness, not false accusers, not given to much wine, teachers of good things;

entries.yo: Ki nwọn ki o le tọ́ awọn ọdọmọbirin lati fẹran awọn ọkọ wọn, lati fẹran awọn ọmọ wọn,
entries.en: That they may teach the young women to be sober, to love their husbands, to love their children,

entries.yo: Lati jẹ alairekọja, mimọ́, òṣiṣẹ́ nile, ẹni rere, awọn ti ntẹriba fun awọn ọkọ wọn, ki ọrọ Ọlọrun ki o máṣe di isọ̀rọ-òdi si.
entries.en: To be discreet, chaste, keepers at home, good, obedient to their own husbands, that the word of God be not blasphemed.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ gẹgẹ ni ki o gbà awọn ọdọmọkunrin niyanju lati jẹ alairekọja.
entries.en: Young men likewise exhort to be sober minded.

entries.yo: Ninu ohun gbogbo mã fi ara rẹ hàn li apẹrẹ iṣẹ rere: ninu ẹkọ́ mã fi aiṣebajẹ hàn, ìwa àgba,
entries.en: In all things shewing thyself a pattern of good works: in doctrine shewing uncorruptness, gravity, sincerity,

entries.yo: Ọ̀rọ ti o yè kõro, ti a kò le da lẹbi; ki oju ki o tì ẹniti o nṣòdi, li aini ohun buburu kan lati wi si wa.
entries.en: Sound speech, that cannot be condemned; that he that is of the contrary part may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say of you.

entries.yo: Gbà awọn ọmọ-ọdọ niyanju lati mã tẹriba fun awọn oluwa wọn, ki nwọn ki o mã ṣe ohun ti o wu wọn ninu ohun gbogbo; ki nwọn ki o má gbó wọn lohùn;
entries.en: Exhort servants to be obedient unto their own masters, and to please them well in all things; not answering again;

entries.yo: Ki nwọn ki o máṣe irẹjẹ, ṣugbọn ki nwọn ki o mã fi iwa otitọ rere gbogbo han; ki nwọn ki o le mã ṣe ẹkọ́ Ọlọrun Olugbala wa li ọṣọ́ ninu ohun gbogbo.
entries.en: Not purloining, but shewing all good fidelity; that they may adorn the doctrine of God our Saviour in all things.

entries.yo: Nitori ore-ọfẹ Ọlọrun ti nmu igbala fun gbogbo enia wá ti farahan,
entries.en: For the grace of God that bringeth salvation hath appeared to all men,

entries.yo: O nkọ́ wa pe, ki a sẹ́ aiwa-bi-Ọlọrun ati ifẹkufẹ aiye, ki a si mã wà li airekọja, li ododo, ati ni ìwa-bi-Ọlọrun ni aiye isisiyi;
entries.en: Teaching us that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly, righteously, and godly, in this present world;

entries.yo: Ki a mã wo ọna fun ireti ti o ni ibukún ati ifarahan ogo Ọlọrun wa ti o tobi, ati ti Olugbala wa Jesu Kristi;
entries.en: Looking for that blessed hope, and the glorious appearing of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ;

entries.yo: Ẹniti o fi ara rẹ̀ fun wa, ki on ki o le rà wa pada kuro ninu ẹ̀ṣẹ gbogbo, ki o si le wẹ awọn enia kan mọ́ fun ara rẹ̀ fun ini on tíkararẹ awọn onitara iṣẹ rere.
entries.en: Who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify unto himself a peculiar people, zealous of good works.

entries.yo: Nkan wọnyi ni ki iwọ ki o mã sọ, ki o si ma gbà-ni-niyanju, ki o si mã fi aṣẹ gbogbo ba-ni-wi. Máṣe jẹ ki ẹnikẹni ki o gàn ọ.
entries.en: These things speak, and exhort, and rebuke with all authority. Let no man despise thee.

entries.yo: MÃ rán wọn leti lati mã tẹriba fun awọn ijoye, ati fun awọn alaṣẹ, lati mã gbọ́ ti wọn, ati lati mã mura si iṣẹ rere gbogbo,
entries.en: Put them in mind to be subject to principalities and powers, to obey magistrates, to be ready to every good work,

entries.yo: Ki nwọn má sọrọ ẹnikẹni ni ibi, ki nwọn má jẹ onija, bikoṣe ẹni pẹlẹ, ki nwọn mã fi ìwa tutù gbogbo han si gbogbo enia.
entries.en: To speak evil of no man, to be no brawlers, but gentle, shewing all meekness unto all men.

entries.yo: Nitori awa pẹlu ti jẹ were nigbakan rí, alaigbọran aṣako, ẹniti nsin onirũru ifẹkufẹ ati adùn aiye, a wà ninu arankàn ati ilara, a jẹ ẹni irira, a si nkorira awọn ọmọnikeji wa.
entries.en: For we ourselves also were sometimes foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving divers lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati ìṣeun Ọlọrun Olugbala wa ati ifẹ rẹ̀ si enia farahan,
entries.en: But after that the kindness and love of God our Saviour toward man appeared,

entries.yo: Kì iṣe nipa iṣẹ ti awa ṣe ninu ododo ṣugbọn gẹgẹ bi ãnu rẹ̀ li o gbà wa là, nipa ìwẹnu atúnbi ati isọdi titun Ẹmí Mimọ́,
entries.en: Not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according to his mercy he saved us, by the washing of regeneration, and renewing of the Holy Ghost;

entries.yo: Ti o dà si wa lori lọpọlọpọ nipasẹ Jesu Kristi Olugbala wa;
entries.en: Which he shed on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Saviour;

entries.yo: Ki a le dá wa lare nipa ore-ọfẹ rẹ̀, ki a si le sọ wa di ajogún gẹgẹ bi ireti ìye ainipẹkun.
entries.en: That being justified by his grace, we should be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.

entries.yo: Otitọ li ọ̀rọ na, emi si nfẹ ki iwọ ki o tẹnumọ nkan wọnyi gidigidi, ki awọn ti o gbà Ọlọrun gbọ́ le mã tọju ati ṣe iṣẹ rere. Nkan wọnyi dara, nwọn si ṣe anfani fun enia.
entries.en: This is a faithful saying, and these things I will that thou affirm constantly, that they which have believed in God might be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable unto men.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn yà kuro ni ìbẽre wère, ati ìtan iran, ati ijiyan, ati ija nipa ti ofin; nitoripe alailere ati asan ni nwọn.
entries.en: But avoid foolish questions, and genealogies, and contentions, and strivings about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba ṣe aladamọ̀ lẹhin ìkilọ ikini ati ekeji, kọ̀ ọ;
entries.en: A man that is an heretick after the first and second admonition reject;

entries.yo: Ki o mọ̀ pe irú ẹni bẹ̃ ti yapa, o si ṣẹ̀, o dá ara rẹ̀ lẹbi.
entries.en: Knowing that he that is such is subverted, and sinneth, being condemned of himself.

entries.yo: Nigbati mo ba rán Artema si ọ, tabi Tikiku, yara tọ̀ mi wá ni Nikopoli: nitori ibẹ ni mo ti pinnu lati lo akoko otutu.
entries.en: When I shall send Artemas unto thee, or Tychicus, be diligent to come unto me to Nicopolis: for I have determined there to winter.

entries.yo: Pese daradara fun Sena amofin ati Apollo li ọ̀na àjo wọn, ki ohunkohun maṣe kù wọn kù.
entries.en: Bring Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey diligently, that nothing be wanting unto them.

entries.yo: Ki awọn enia wa pẹlu si kọ́ lati mã ṣe iṣẹ rere fun ohun ti a kò le ṣe alaini, ki nwọn ki o má ba jẹ alaileso.
entries.en: And let ours also learn to maintain good works for necessary uses, that they be not unfruitful.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn ti mbẹ lọdọ mi kí ọ. Kí awọn ti o fẹ wa ninu igbagbọ́. Ki ore-ọfẹ ki o wà pẹlu gbogbo nyin. Amin.
entries.en: All that are with me salute thee. Greet them that love us in the faith. Grace be with you all. Amen.

entries.yo: PAULU, onde Kristi Jesu, ati Timotiu arakunrin wa, si Filemoni olufẹ ati alabaṣiṣẹ wa ọwọn,
entries.en: Paul, a prisoner of Jesus Christ, and Timothy our brother, unto Philemon our dearly beloved, and fellowlabourer,

entries.yo: Ati si Affia arabinrin wa, ati si Arkippu ọmọ-ogun ẹgbẹ wa, ati si ìjọ inu ile rẹ:
entries.en: And to our beloved Apphia, and Archippus our fellowsoldier, and to the church in thy house:

entries.yo: Ore-ọfẹ, ati alafia sí nyin, lati ọdọ Ọlọrun Baba wa, ati Jesu Kristi Oluwa.
entries.en: Grace to you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

entries.yo: Emi ndupẹ lọwọ Ọlọrun mi nigbagbogbo, emi nṣe iranti rẹ ninu adura mi,
entries.en: I thank my God, making mention of thee always in my prayers,

entries.yo: Bi mo ti ngbọ́ ti ifẹ rẹ ati igbagbọ́ ti iwọ ni si Jesu Oluwa, ati si gbogbo awọn enia mimọ́;
entries.en: Hearing of thy love and faith, which thou hast toward the Lord Jesus, and toward all saints;

entries.yo: Ki idapọ igbagbọ́ rẹ le lagbara, ni imọ ohun rere gbogbo ti mbẹ ninu nyin si Kristi.
entries.en: That the communication of thy faith may become effectual by the acknowledging of every good thing which is in you in Christ Jesus.

entries.yo: Emi sá ni ayọ̀ pupọ ati itunu nitori ifẹ rẹ, nitoriti a tù ọkàn awọn enia mimọ́ lara lati ọwọ́ rẹ wá, arakunrin.
entries.en: For we have great joy and consolation in thy love, because the bowels of the saints are refreshed by thee, brother.

entries.yo: Nitorina, bi mo tilẹ ni igboiya pupọ̀ ninu Kristi lati paṣẹ ohun ti o yẹ fun ọ,
entries.en: Wherefore, though I might be much bold in Christ to enjoin thee that which is convenient,

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nitori ifẹ emi kuku bẹ̀bẹ, iru ẹni bi emi Paulu arugbo, ati nisisiyi ondè Kristi Jesu pẹlu.
entries.en: Yet for love's sake I rather beseech thee, being such an one as Paul the aged, and now also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.

entries.yo: Emi bẹ̀ ọ fun ọmọ mi, ti mo bí ninu ìde mi, Onesimu:
entries.en: I beseech thee for my son Onesimus, whom I have begotten in my bonds:

entries.yo: Nigbakan rí ẹniti o jẹ alailere fun ọ, ṣugbọn nisisiyi o lere fun ọ ati fun mi:
entries.en: Which in time past was to thee unprofitable, but now profitable to thee and to me:

entries.yo: Ẹniti mo rán pada, ani on tikalarẹ̀, eyini ni olufẹ mi:
entries.en: Whom I have sent again: thou therefore receive him, that is, mine own bowels:

entries.yo: Ẹniti emi iba fẹ daduro pẹlu mi, ki o le mã ṣe iranṣẹ fun mi nipo rẹ ninu ìde ihinrere:
entries.en: Whom I would have retained with me, that in thy stead he might have ministered unto me in the bonds of the gospel:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn li aimọ̀ inu rẹ emi kò fẹ ṣe ohun kan; ki ore rẹ ki o má ba dabi afiyanjuṣe, bikoṣe tifẹtifẹ.
entries.en: But without thy mind would I do nothing; that thy benefit should not be as it were of necessity, but willingly.

entries.yo: Nitori boya idi rẹ̀ li eyi ti o fi kuro lọdọ rẹ fun igba diẹ, ki iwọ ki o ba le ni i titi lai;
entries.en: For perhaps he therefore departed for a season, that thou shouldest receive him for ever;

entries.yo: Kì iṣe bi ẹrú mọ, ṣugbọn o jù ẹrú lọ, arakunrin olufẹ, papa fun mi, melomelo jubẹ̃lọ fun ọ, nipa ti ara ati nipa ti Oluwa.
entries.en: Not now as a servant, but above a servant, a brother beloved, specially to me, but how much more unto thee, both in the flesh, and in the Lord?

entries.yo: Nitorina bi iwọ ba kà mi si ẹlẹgbẹ rẹ, gbà a bi emi tikarami.
entries.en: If thou count me therefore a partner, receive him as myself.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi o ba ti ṣẹ̀ ọ rara, tabi ti o jẹ ọ nigbese kan, kà a si mi lọrùn.
entries.en: If he hath wronged thee, or oweth thee ought, put that on mine account;

entries.yo: Emi Paulu li o fi ọwọ́ ara mi kọ ọ, emi ó san a pada: ki emi má sọ fun ọ, bi o ti jẹ mi nigbese ara rẹ pẹlu.
entries.en: I Paul have written it with mine own hand, I will repay it: albeit I do not say to thee how thou owest unto me even thine own self besides.

entries.yo: Nitõtọ, arakunrin, jẹ ki emi ki o ni ayọ̀ rẹ ninu Oluwa: tù ọkan mi lara ninu Kristi.
entries.en: Yea, brother, let me have joy of thee in the Lord: refresh my bowels in the Lord.

entries.yo: Bi mo ti ni igbẹkẹle ni igbọràn rẹ ni mo fi kọwe si ọ: nitori mo mọ̀ pe, iwọ ó tilẹ ṣe jù bi mo ti wi lọ.
entries.en: Having confidence in thy obedience I wrote unto thee, knowing that thou wilt also do more than I say.

entries.yo: Ati pẹlu, pese ìbuwọ̀ silẹ dè mi; nitori mo gbẹkẹle pe nipa adura nyin, a ó fi mi fun nyin.
entries.en: But withal prepare me also a lodging: for I trust that through your prayers I shall be given unto you.

entries.yo: Epafra, ondè ẹlẹgbẹ mi ninu Kristi Jesu kí ọ;
entries.en: There salute thee Epaphras, my fellowprisoner in Christ Jesus;

entries.yo: Marku, Aristarku, Dema, Luku, awọn olubaṣiṣẹ mi kí ọ pẹlu.
entries.en: Marcus, Aristarchus, Demas, Lucas, my fellowlabourers.

entries.yo: Ore-ọfẹ Jesu Kristi Oluwa wa ki o wà pẹlu ẹmí nyin. Amin.
entries.en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.

entries.yo: ỌLỌRUN, ẹni, ni igba pupọ̀ ati li onirũru ọna, ti o ti ipa awọn woli ba awọn baba sọ̀rọ nigbãni.
entries.en: God, who at sundry times and in divers manners spake in time past unto the fathers by the prophets,

entries.yo: Ni ikẹhin ọjọ wọnyi o ti ipasẹ Ọmọ rẹ̀ ba wa sọ̀rọ, ẹniti o fi ṣe ajogun ohun gbogbo, nipasẹ ẹniti o dá awọn aiye pẹlu;
entries.en: Hath in these last days spoken unto us by his Son, whom he hath appointed heir of all things, by whom also he made the worlds;

entries.yo: Ẹniti iṣe itanṣan ogo rẹ̀, ati aworan on tikararẹ, ti o si nfi ọ̀rọ agbara rẹ̀ mu ohun gbogbo duro, lẹhin ti o ti ṣe ìwẹnu ẹ̀ṣẹ, o joko li ọwọ́ ọtún Ọlánla li oke;
entries.en: Who being the brightness of his glory, and the express image of his person, and upholding all things by the word of his power, when he had by himself purged our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high;

entries.yo: O si ti fi bẹ̃ di ẹniti o sàn ju awọn angẹli lọ, bi o ti jogun orukọ ti o ta tiwọn yọ.
entries.en: Being made so much better than the angels, as he hath by inheritance obtained a more excellent name than they.

entries.yo: Nitori ewo ninu awọn angẹli li o wi fun rí pe, Iwọ li Ọmọ mi, loni ni mo bí ọ? Ati pẹlu, Emi yio jẹ Baba fun u, on yio si jẹ Ọmọ fun mi?
entries.en: For unto which of the angels said he at any time, Thou art my Son, this day have I begotten thee? And again, I will be to him a Father, and he shall be to me a Son?

entries.yo: Ati pẹlu, nigbati o mu akọbi ni wá si aiye, o wipe, Ki gbogbo awọn angẹli Ọlọrun ki o foribalẹ fun u.
entries.en: And again, when he bringeth in the firstbegotten into the world, he saith, And let all the angels of God worship him.

entries.yo: Ati niti awọn angẹli, o wipe, Ẹniti o dá awọn angẹli rẹ̀ li ẹmí, ati awọn iranṣẹ rẹ̀ li ọwọ́ iná.
entries.en: And of the angels he saith, Who maketh his angels spirits, and his ministers a flame of fire.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn niti Ọmọ li o wipe, Itẹ́ rẹ, Ọlọrun, lai ati lailai ni; ọpá alade ododo li ọpá alade ijọba rẹ.
entries.en: But unto the Son he saith, Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever: a sceptre of righteousness is the sceptre of thy kingdom.

entries.yo: Iwọ fẹ ododo, iwọ si korira ẹ̀ṣẹ; nitorina li Ọlọrun, ani Ọlọrun rẹ, ṣe fi oróro ayọ̀ yan ọ jù awọn ẹgbẹ rẹ lọ.
entries.en: Thou hast loved righteousness, and hated iniquity; therefore God, even thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.

entries.yo: Ati Iwọ, Oluwa, li atetekọṣe li o ti fi ipilẹ aiye sọlẹ; awọn ọrun si ni iṣẹ ọwọ́ rẹ:
entries.en: And, Thou, Lord, in the beginning hast laid the foundation of the earth; and the heavens are the works of thine hands:

entries.yo: Nwọn ó ṣegbe; ṣugbọn iwọ ó wà sibẹ, gbogbo wọn ni yio si gbó bi ẹwu;
entries.en: They shall perish; but thou remainest; and they all shall wax old as doth a garment;

entries.yo: Ati bi aṣọ ni iwọ o si ká wọn, a o si pàrọ wọn: ṣugbọn bakanna ni iwọ, ọdún rẹ kì yio si pin.
entries.en: And as a vesture shalt thou fold them up, and they shall be changed: but thou art the same, and thy years shall not fail.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ewo ninu awọn angẹli li o sọ nipa rẹ̀ ri pe, Joko li ọwọ́ ọtún mi, titi emi o fi sọ awọn ọtá rẹ di apoti itisẹ rẹ?
entries.en: But to which of the angels said he at any time, Sit on my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool?

entries.yo: Ẹmí ti njiṣẹ ki gbogbo wọn iṣe, ti a nran lọ lati mã jọsin nitori awọn ti yio jogun igbala?
entries.en: Are they not all ministering spirits, sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation?

entries.yo: NITORINA o yẹ ti awa iba mã fi iyè gidigidi si ohun wọnni ti awa ti gbọ́, ki a má bã gbá wa lọ kuro ninu wọn nigbakan.
entries.en: Therefore we ought to give the more earnest heed to the things which we have heard, lest at any time we should let them slip.

entries.yo: Nitori bi ọ̀rọ ti a ti ẹnu awọn angẹli sọ ba duro ṣinṣin, ati ti olukuluku irekọja ati aigbọran si gbà ẹsan ti o tọ́;
entries.en: For if the word spoken by angels was stedfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just recompence of reward;

entries.yo: Awa o ti ṣe là a, bi awa kò ba nani irú igbala nla bi eyi; ti àtetekọ bẹ̀rẹ si isọ lati ọdọ Oluwa, ti a si fi mulẹ fun wa lati ọdọ awọn ẹniti o gbọ́;
entries.en: How shall we escape, if we neglect so great salvation; which at the first began to be spoken by the Lord, and was confirmed unto us by them that heard him;

entries.yo: Ọlọrun si nfi iṣẹ àmi ati iṣẹ iyanu, ati onirũru iṣẹ agbara, ati ẹ̀bun Ẹmí Mimọ́ bá wọn jẹri gẹgẹ bí ifẹ rẹ̀?
entries.en: God also bearing them witness, both with signs and wonders, and with divers miracles, and gifts of the Holy Ghost, according to his own will?

entries.yo: Nitoripe ki iṣe abẹ awọn angẹli li o fi aiye ti mbọ̀ ti awa nsọrọ rẹ̀ si.
entries.en: For unto the angels hath he not put in subjection the world to come, whereof we speak.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹnikan sọ nibikan wipe, Kili enia ti o fi nṣe iranti rẹ̀, tabi ọmọ enia, ti o mbẹ̀ ẹ wò?
entries.en: But one in a certain place testified, saying, What is man, that thou art mindful of him? or the son of man, that thou visitest him?

entries.yo: Iwọ dá a rẹlẹ̀ diẹ jù awọn angẹli lọ; iwọ fi ogo ati ọlá dé e li ade, iwọ si fi i jẹ olori iṣẹ ọwọ́ rẹ:
entries.en: Thou madest him a little lower than the angels; thou crownedst him with glory and honour, and didst set him over the works of thy hands:

entries.yo: Iwọ fi ohun gbogbo sabẹ ẹsẹ rẹ̀. Nitori niti pe o fi ohun gbogbo sabẹ rẹ̀ kò kù ohun kan ti kò fi sabẹ rẹ̀. Ṣugbọn nisisiyi awa kò iti ri pe a fi ohun gbogbo sabẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: Thou hast put all things in subjection under his feet. For in that he put all in subjection under him, he left nothing that is not put under him. But now we see not yet all things put under him.

entries.yo: Awa ri ẹniti a dá rẹlẹ̀ diẹ jù awọn angẹli lọ, ani Jesu, ẹniti a fi ogo ati ọlá dé li ade nitori ijiya ikú; ki o le tọ́ iku wò fun olukuluku enia nipa õre-ọfẹ Ọlọrun.
entries.en: But we see Jesus, who was made a little lower than the angels for the suffering of death, crowned with glory and honour; that he by the grace of God should taste death for every man.

entries.yo: Nitoripe o yẹ fun u, nitori ẹniti ohun gbogbo ṣe wà, ati nipasẹ ẹniti ohun gbogbo wà, ni mimu awọn ọmọ pupọ̀ wá sinu ogo, lati ṣe balogun igbala wọn li aṣepé nipa ìjiya.
entries.en: For it became him, for whom are all things, and by whom are all things, in bringing many sons unto glory, to make the captain of their salvation perfect through sufferings.

entries.yo: Nitori ati ẹniti nsọni di mimọ́ ati awọn ti a nsọ di mimọ́, lati ọdọ ẹnikanṣoṣo ni gbogbo wọn: nitori eyiti ko ṣe tiju lati pè wọn ni arakunrin,
entries.en: For both he that sanctifieth and they who are sanctified are all of one: for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brethren,

entries.yo: Wipe, Emi ó sọ̀rọ orukọ rẹ fun awọn ará mi, li ãrin ijọ li emi o kọrin iyìn rẹ.
entries.en: Saying, I will declare thy name unto my brethren, in the midst of the church will I sing praise unto thee.

entries.yo: Ati pẹlu, Emi o gbẹkẹ̀ mi le e. Ati pẹlu, Kiyesi i, emi ati awọn ọmọ ti Ọlọrun fifun mi.
entries.en: And again, I will put my trust in him. And again, Behold I and the children which God hath given me.

entries.yo: Njẹ niwọn bi awọn ọmọ ti ṣe alabapin ara on ẹ̀jẹ, bẹ̃ gẹgẹ li on pẹlu si ṣe alabapin ninu ọkanna; ki o le ti ipa ikú pa ẹniti o ni agbara ikú run, eyini ni Eṣu;
entries.en: Forasmuch then as the children are partakers of flesh and blood, he also himself likewise took part of the same; that through death he might destroy him that had the power of death, that is, the devil;

entries.yo: Ki o si le gbà gbogbo awọn ti o ti itori ibẹru iku wà labẹ ìde lọjọ aiye wọn gbogbo.
entries.en: And deliver them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.

entries.yo: Nitoripe, nitõtọ ki iṣe awọn angẹli li o ṣe iranlọwọ fun, ṣugbọn irú-ọmọ Abrahamu li o ṣe iranlọwọ fun.
entries.en: For verily he took not on him the nature of angels; but he took on him the seed of Abraham.

entries.yo: Nitorina o yẹ pe ninu ohun gbogbo ki o dabi awọn ará rẹ̀, ki o le jẹ alãnu ati olõtọ Olori Alufa ninu ohun ti iṣe ti Ọlọrun, ki o le ṣe etutu fun ẹ̀ṣẹ awọn enia.
entries.en: Wherefore in all things it behoved him to be made like unto his brethren, that he might be a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God, to make reconciliation for the sins of the people.

entries.yo: Nitori niwọnbi on tikararẹ̀ ti jiya nipa idanwo, o le ràn awọn ti a ndan wo lọwọ.
entries.en: For in that he himself hath suffered being tempted, he is able to succour them that are tempted.

entries.yo: NITORINA ẹnyin ará mimọ́, alabapín ìpe ọ̀run, ẹ gbà ti Aposteli ati Olori Alufa ijẹwọ wa ro, ani Jesu;
entries.en: Wherefore, holy brethren, partakers of the heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our profession, Christ Jesus;

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ṣe olõtọ si ẹniti o yàn a, bi Mose pẹlu ti ṣe ninu gbogbo ile rẹ̀.
entries.en: Who was faithful to him that appointed him, as also Moses was faithful in all his house.

entries.yo: Nitori a kà ọkunrin yi ni yiyẹ si ogo jù Mose lọ niwọn bi ẹniti o kọ́ ile ti li ọla jù ile lọ.
entries.en: For this man was counted worthy of more glory than Moses, inasmuch as he who hath builded the house hath more honour than the house.

entries.yo: Lati ọwọ́ enia kan li a sá ti kọ́ olukuluku ile; ṣugbọn ẹniti o kọ́ ohun gbogbo ni Ọlọrun.
entries.en: For every house is builded by some man; but he that built all things is God.

entries.yo: Mose nitõtọ si ṣe olõtọ ninu gbogbo ile rẹ̀, bi iranṣẹ, fun ẹrí ohun ti a o sọ̀rọ wọn nigba ikẹhin;
entries.en: And Moses verily was faithful in all his house, as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were to be spoken after;

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Kristi bi ọmọ lori ile rẹ̀; ile ẹniti awa iṣe, bi awa ba dì igbẹkẹle ati iṣogo ireti wa mu ṣinṣin titi de opin.
entries.en: But Christ as a son over his own house; whose house are we, if we hold fast the confidence and the rejoicing of the hope firm unto the end.

entries.yo: Nitorina gẹgẹbi Ẹmí Mimọ́ ti wi, Loni bi ẹnyin bá gbọ́ ohùn rẹ̀,
entries.en: Wherefore (as the Holy Ghost saith, To day if ye will hear his voice,

entries.yo: Ẹ máṣe sé ọkàn nyin le, bi igba imunibinu, bi li ọjọ idanwò li aginjù:
entries.en: Harden not your hearts, as in the provocation, in the day of temptation in the wilderness:

entries.yo: Nibiti awọn baba nyin dán mi wò, nipa wiwadi mi, ti nwọn si ri iṣẹ mi li ogoji ọdún.
entries.en: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my works forty years.

entries.yo: Nitorina inu mi bajẹ si iran na, mo si wipe, Nigbagbogbo ni nwọn nṣìna li ọkàn wọn; nwọn kò si mọ̀ ọ̀na mi.
entries.en: Wherefore I was grieved with that generation, and said, They do alway err in their heart; and they have not known my ways.

entries.yo: Bi mo ti bura ni ibinu mi, nwọn ki yio wọ̀ inu isimi mi.
entries.en: So I sware in my wrath, They shall not enter into my rest.)

entries.yo: Ẹ kiyesara, ará, ki ọkàn buburu ti aigbagbọ́ ki o máṣe wà ninu ẹnikẹni nyin, ni lilọ kuro lọdọ Ọlọrun alãye.
entries.en: Take heed, brethren, lest there be in any of you an evil heart of unbelief, in departing from the living God.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹ mã gbà ara nyin niyanju li ojojumọ́, niwọn igbati a ba npè e ni Oni, ki a má bã sé ọkàn ẹnikẹni ninu nyin le nipa ẹ̀tan ẹ̀ṣẹ.
entries.en: But exhort one another daily, while it is called To day; lest any of you be hardened through the deceitfulness of sin.

entries.yo: Nitori awa di alabapín pẹlu Kristi, bi awa ba dì ipilẹṣẹ igbẹkẹle wa mu ṣinṣin titi de opin;
entries.en: For we are made partakers of Christ, if we hold the beginning of our confidence stedfast unto the end;

entries.yo: Nigbati a nwipe, Loni bi ẹnyin bá gbọ́ ohùn rẹ̀, ẹ máṣe sé ọkàn nyin le, bi igba imunibinu.
entries.en: While it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts, as in the provocation.

entries.yo: Nitori awọn tani bi nyin ninu nigbati nwọn gbọ́? Ki ha iṣe gbogbo awọn ti o ti ipasẹ Mose jade lati Egipti wá?
entries.en: For some, when they had heard, did provoke: howbeit not all that came out of Egypt by Moses.

entries.yo: Awọn tali o si binu si fun ogoji ọdún? Ki ha iṣe si awọn ti o dẹṣẹ, okú awọn ti o sun li aginjù?
entries.en: But with whom was he grieved forty years? was it not with them that had sinned, whose carcases fell in the wilderness?

entries.yo: Awọn tali o si bura fun pe nwọn kì yio wọ̀ inu isimi on, bikoṣe fun awọn ti kò gbọran?
entries.en: And to whom sware he that they should not enter into his rest, but to them that believed not?

entries.yo: Awa si ri pe nwọn kò le wọ̀ inu rẹ̀ nitori aigbagbọ́.
entries.en: So we see that they could not enter in because of unbelief.

entries.yo: NITORINA, ẹ jẹ ki a bẹ̀ru, bi a ti fi ileri ati wọ̀ inu isimi rẹ̀ silẹ fun wa, ki ẹnikẹni ninu nyin ki o má bã dabi ẹnipe o ti kùna rẹ̀.
entries.en: Let us therefore fear, lest, a promise being left us of entering into his rest, any of you should seem to come short of it.
