entries.yo: Nitoripe a ti wasu ihinrere fun wa gẹgẹ bi fun awọn na, ṣugbọn ọ̀rọ ti nwọn gbọ́ kò ṣe wọn ni ire, nitoriti kò dàpọ mọ́ igbagbọ́ ninu awọn ti o gbọ́ ọ.
entries.en: For unto us was the gospel preached, as well as unto them: but the word preached did not profit them, not being mixed with faith in them that heard it.

entries.yo: Nitoripe awa ti o ti gbagbọ́ wọ̀ inu isimi gẹgẹ bi o ti wi, Bi mo ti bura ninu ibinu mi, nwọn ki yio wọ̀ inu isimi mi: bi o tilẹ ti ṣe pe a ti pari iṣẹ wọnni lati ipilẹ aiye.
entries.en: For we which have believed do enter into rest, as he said, As I have sworn in my wrath, if they shall enter into my rest: although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.

entries.yo: Nitori o ti sọ nibikan niti ọjọ keje bayi pe, Ọlọrun si simi ni ijọ keje kuro ninu iṣẹ rẹ̀ gbogbo.
entries.en: For he spake in a certain place of the seventh day on this wise, And God did rest the seventh day from all his works.

entries.yo: Ati nihinyi ẹ̀wẹ pe, Nwọn ki yio wọ̀ inu isimi mi.
entries.en: And in this place again, If they shall enter into my rest.

entries.yo: Nitorina bi o ti jẹ pe, o kù ki awọn kan wọ̀ inu rẹ̀, ati awọn ti a ti wasu ihinrere nã fun niṣãju kò wọ inu rẹ̀ nitori aigbọran:
entries.en: Seeing therefore it remaineth that some must enter therein, and they to whom it was first preached entered not in because of unbelief:

entries.yo: Ẹ̀wẹ, o yan ọjọ kan, o wi ninu Iwe Dafidi pe, Loni, lẹhin igba pipẹ bẹ̃; bi a ti wi niṣãju, Loni bi ẹnyin ba gbọ́ ohùn rẹ̀, ẹ máṣe sé ọkàn nyin le.
entries.en: Again, he limiteth a certain day, saying in David, To day, after so long a time; as it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts.

entries.yo: Nitori ibaṣepe Joṣua ti fun wọn ni isimi, on kì ba ti sọrọ nipa ọjọ miran lẹhinna.
entries.en: For if Jesus had given them rest, then would he not afterward have spoken of another day.

entries.yo: Nitorina isimi kan kù fun awọn enia Ọlọrun.
entries.en: There remaineth therefore a rest to the people of God.

entries.yo: Nitoripe ẹniti o ba bọ́ sinu isimi rẹ̀, on pẹlu simi kuro ninu iṣẹ tirẹ̀, gẹgẹ bi Ọlọrun ti simi kuro ni tirẹ̀.
entries.en: For he that is entered into his rest, he also hath ceased from his own works, as God did from his.

entries.yo: Nitorina ẹ jẹ ki a mura giri lati wọ̀ inu isimi na, ki ẹnikẹni ki o má ba ṣubu nipa apẹrẹ aigbagbọ́ kanna.
entries.en: Let us labour therefore to enter into that rest, lest any man fall after the same example of unbelief.

entries.yo: Nitori ọ̀rọ Ọlọrun yè, o si li agbara, o si mú jù idàkídà oloju meji lọ, o si ngúnni ani tìti de pipín ọkàn ati ẹmí niya, ati oríke ati ọrá inu egungun, on si ni olumọ̀ erò inu ati ète ọkàn.
entries.en: For the word of God is quick, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.

entries.yo: Kò si si ẹda kan ti kò farahan niwaju rẹ̀, ṣugbọn ohun gbogbo ni o wà nihoho ti a si ṣipaya fun oju rẹ̀ ẹniti awa ni iba lo.
entries.en: Neither is there any creature that is not manifest in his sight: but all things are naked and opened unto the eyes of him with whom we have to do.

entries.yo: Njẹ bi a ti ni Olori Alufa nla kan, ti o ti la awọn ọ̀run kọja lọ, Jesu Ọmọ Ọlọrun, ẹ jẹ ki a di ijẹwọ wa mu ṣinṣin.
entries.en: Seeing then that we have a great high priest, that is passed into the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold fast our profession.

entries.yo: Nitori a kò ni olori alufa ti kò le ṣai ba ni kẹdun ninu ailera wa, ẹniti a ti danwo li ọna gbogbo gẹgẹ bi awa, ṣugbọn lailẹ̀ṣẹ.
entries.en: For we have not an high priest which cannot be touched with the feeling of our infirmities; but was in all points tempted like as we are, yet without sin.

entries.yo: Nitorina ẹ jẹ ki a wá si ibi itẹ ore-ọfẹ pẹlu igboiya, ki a le ri ãnu gbà, ki a si ri ore-ọfẹ lati mã rànnilọwọ ni akoko ti o wọ̀.
entries.en: Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.

entries.yo: NITORI olukuluku olori alufa ti a yàn ninu awọn enia, li a fi jẹ fun awọn enia niti ohun ti iṣe ti Ọlọrun, ki o le mã mu ẹ̀bun wá ati lati ṣe ẹbọ nitori ẹ̀ṣẹ:
entries.en: For every high priest taken from among men is ordained for men in things pertaining to God, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins:

entries.yo: Ẹniti o le bá awọn alaimoye ati awọn ti o ti yapa kẹdun, nitori a fi ailera yi on na ká pẹlu.
entries.en: Who can have compassion on the ignorant, and on them that are out of the way; for that he himself also is compassed with infirmity.

entries.yo: Nitori idi eyi li o si ṣe yẹ, bi o ti nṣe ẹbọ nitori ẹ̀ṣẹ fun awọn enia, bẹ̃ pẹlu ni ki o ṣe fun ara rẹ̀.
entries.en: And by reason hereof he ought, as for the people, so also for himself, to offer for sins.

entries.yo: Kò si si ẹniti o gbà ọlá yi fun ara rẹ̀, bikoṣe ẹniti a pè lati ọdọ Ọlọrun wá, gẹgẹ bi a ti pè Aaroni.
entries.en: And no man taketh this honour unto himself, but he that is called of God, as was Aaron.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Kristi pẹlu kò si ṣe ara rẹ̀ logo lati jẹ́ Olori Alufa; bikoṣe ẹniti o wi fun u pe, Iwọ li Ọmọ mi, loni ni mo bí ọ.
entries.en: So also Christ glorified not himself to be made an high priest; but he that said unto him, Thou art my Son, to day have I begotten thee.

entries.yo: Bi o ti wi pẹlu nibomiran pe, Iwọ ni alufa titi lai nipa ẹsẹ Melkisedeki.
entries.en: As he saith also in another place, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.

entries.yo: Ẹni nigba ọjọ rẹ̀ ninu ara, ti o fi ẹkún rara ati omije gbadura, ti o si bẹ̀bẹ lọdọ ẹniti o le gbà a silẹ lọwọ ikú, a si gbohun rẹ̀ nitori ẹmi ọ̀wọ rẹ̀,
entries.en: Who in the days of his flesh, when he had offered up prayers and supplications with strong crying and tears unto him that was able to save him from death, and was heard in that he feared;

entries.yo: Bi o ti jẹ Ọmọ nì, sibẹ o kọ́ igbọran nipa ohun ti o jìya;
entries.en: Though he were a Son, yet learned he obedience by the things which he suffered;

entries.yo: Bi a si ti sọ ọ di pipé, o wá di orisun igbala ainipẹkun fun gbogbo awọn ti o ngbọ́ tirẹ̀:
entries.en: And being made perfect, he became the author of eternal salvation unto all them that obey him;

entries.yo: Ti a yàn li Olori Alufa lati ọdọ Ọlọrun wá nipa ẹsẹ Melkisedeki.
entries.en: Called of God an high priest after the order of Melchisedec.

entries.yo: Niti ẹniti awa ni ohun pupọ̀ lati sọ, ti o si ṣoro lati tumọ, nitoripe ẹ yigbì ni gbigbọ́.
entries.en: Of whom we have many things to say, and hard to be uttered, seeing ye are dull of hearing.

entries.yo: Nitori nigbati akokò tó ti o yẹ ki ẹ jẹ olukọ, ẹ tun wà ni ẹniti ẹnikan yio mã kọ́ ni ibẹrẹ ipilẹ awọn ọ̀rọ Ọlọrun; ẹ si di irú awọn ti kò le ṣe aini wàra, ti nwọn kò si fẹ onjẹ lile.
entries.en: For when for the time ye ought to be teachers, ye have need that one teach you again which be the first principles of the oracles of God; and are become such as have need of milk, and not of strong meat.

entries.yo: Nitori olukuluku ẹniti nmu wàra jẹ́ alailoye ọ̀rọ ododo: nitori ọmọ-ọwọ ni.
entries.en: For every one that useth milk is unskilful in the word of righteousness: for he is a babe.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn onjẹ lile ni fun awọn ti o dagba, awọn ẹni nipa ìriri, ti nwọn nlò ọgbọ́n wọn lati fi iyatọ sarin rere ati buburu.
entries.en: But strong meat belongeth to them that are of full age, even those who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern both good and evil.

entries.yo: NITORINA ki a fi ipilẹṣẹ ẹkọ́ Kristi silẹ, ki a lọ si pipé; li aitún fi ipilẹ ironupiwada kuro ninu okú iṣẹ lelẹ, ati ti igbagbọ́ sipa ti Ọlọrun,
entries.en: Therefore leaving the principles of the doctrine of Christ, let us go on unto perfection; not laying again the foundation of repentance from dead works, and of faith toward God,

entries.yo: Ati ti ẹkọ́ ti iwẹnu, ati ti igbọwọle-ni, ati ti ajinde okú, ati ti idajọ ainipẹkun.
entries.en: Of the doctrine of baptisms, and of laying on of hands, and of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.

entries.yo: Eyi li awa ó si ṣe, bi Ọlọrun fẹ.
entries.en: And this will we do, if God permit.

entries.yo: Nitori awọn ti a ti là loju lẹ̃kan, ti nwọn si ti tọ́ ẹ̀bùn ọ̀run wò, ti nwọn si ti di alabapin Ẹmí Mimọ́,
entries.en: For it is impossible for those who were once enlightened, and have tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Holy Ghost,

entries.yo: Ti nwọn si ti tọ́ ọ̀rọ rere Ọlọrun wò, ati agbara aiye ti mbọ̀,
entries.en: And have tasted the good word of God, and the powers of the world to come,

entries.yo: Ti nwọn si ti ṣubu kuro, ko le ṣe iṣe lati sọ wọn di ọtun si ironupiwada, nitori nwọn tún kàn Ọmọ Ọlọrun mọ agbelebu si ara wọn li ọtun, nwọn si dojutì i ni gbangba.
entries.en: If they shall fall away, to renew them again unto repentance; seeing they crucify to themselves the Son of God afresh, and put him to an open shame.

entries.yo: Nitori ilẹ ti o fi omi ojò ti nrọ̀ sori rẹ̀ nigbagbogbo mu, ti o si nhù ewebẹ ti o dara fun awọn ti a nti itori wọn ro o pẹlu, ngbà ibukún lọwọ Ọlọrun.
entries.en: For the earth which drinketh in the rain that cometh oft upon it, and bringeth forth herbs meet for them by whom it is dressed, receiveth blessing from God:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn eyiti o nhù ẹgún ati oṣuṣu, a kọ̀ ọ, kò si jìna si egún; opin eyiti yio jẹ fun ijona.
entries.en: But that which beareth thorns and briers is rejected, and is nigh unto cursing; whose end is to be burned.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn, olufẹ, awa ni igbagbọ ohun ti o dara jù bẹ̃ lọ niti nyin, ati ohun ti o faramọ igbala, bi awa tilẹ nsọ bayi.
entries.en: But, beloved, we are persuaded better things of you, and things that accompany salvation, though we thus speak.

entries.yo: Nitori Ọlọrun kì iṣe alaiṣododo ti yio fi gbagbé iṣẹ nyin ati ifẹ ti ẹnyin fihàn si orukọ rẹ̀, nipa iṣẹ iranṣẹ ti ẹ ti ṣe fun awọn enia mimọ́, ti ẹ si nṣe.
entries.en: For God is not unrighteous to forget your work and labour of love, which ye have shewed toward his name, in that ye have ministered to the saints, and do minister.

entries.yo: Awa si fẹ ki olukuluku nyin ki o mã fi irú aisimi kanna hàn, fun ẹ̀kún ireti titi de opin:
entries.en: And we desire that every one of you do shew the same diligence to the full assurance of hope unto the end:

entries.yo: Ki ẹ máṣe di onilọra, ṣugbọn alafarawe awọn ti nwọn ti ipa igbagbọ́ ati sũru jogún awọn ileri.
entries.en: That ye be not slothful, but followers of them who through faith and patience inherit the promises.

entries.yo: Nitori nigbati Ọlọrun ṣe ileri fun Abrahamu, bi kò ti ri ẹniti o pọju on lati fi bura, o fi ara rẹ̀ bura, wipe,
entries.en: For when God made promise to Abraham, because he could swear by no greater, he sware by himself,

entries.yo: Nitõtọ ni bibukún emi o bukún fun ọ, ati ni bibisi emi o mu ọ bisi i.
entries.en: Saying, Surely blessing I will bless thee, and multiplying I will multiply thee.

entries.yo: Bẹna si ni, lẹhin igbati o fi sũru duro, o ri ileri na gbà.
entries.en: And so, after he had patiently endured, he obtained the promise.

entries.yo: Nitori enia a mã fi ẹniti o pọjù wọn bura: ibura na a si fi opin si gbogbo ijiyan wọn fun ifẹsẹ mulẹ ọ̀rọ.
entries.en: For men verily swear by the greater: and an oath for confirmation is to them an end of all strife.

entries.yo: Ninu eyiti bi Ọlọrun ti nfẹ gidigidi lati fi aileyipada ìmọ rẹ̀ han fun awọn ajogún ileri, o fi ibura sãrin wọn.
entries.en: Wherein God, willing more abundantly to shew unto the heirs of promise the immutability of his counsel, confirmed it by an oath:

entries.yo: Pe, nipa ohun aileyipada meji, ninu eyiti ko le ṣe iṣe fun Ọlọrun lati ṣeke, ki awa ti o ti sá sabẹ ãbo le ni ìṣírí ti o daju lati dì ireti ti a gbé kalẹ niwaju wa mu:
entries.en: That by two immutable things, in which it was impossible for God to lie, we might have a strong consolation, who have fled for refuge to lay hold upon the hope set before us:

entries.yo: Eyiti awa ni bi idakọ̀ro ọkàn, ireti ti o daju ti o si duro ṣinṣin, ti o si wọ̀ inu ile lọ lẹhin aṣọ ikele;
entries.en: Which hope we have as an anchor of the soul, both sure and stedfast, and which entereth into that within the veil;

entries.yo: Nibiti aṣaju wa ti wọ̀ lọ fun wa, ani Jesu, ti a fi jẹ Olori Alufa titi lai nipa ẹsẹ Melkisedeki.
entries.en: Whither the forerunner is for us entered, even Jesus, made an high priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.

entries.yo: NITORI Melkisedeki yi, ọba Salemu, alufa Ọlọrun Ọgá-ogo, ẹniti o pade Abrahamu bi o ti npada lati ibi pipa awọn ọba bọ̀, ti o si sure fun u;
entries.en: For this Melchisedec, king of Salem, priest of the most high God, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings, and blessed him;

entries.yo: Ẹniti Abrahamu si pin idamẹwa ohun gbogbo fun; li ọna ekini ni itumọ rẹ̀ ọba ododo, ati lẹhinna pẹlu ọba Salemu, ti iṣe ọba alafia;
entries.en: To whom also Abraham gave a tenth part of all; first being by interpretation King of righteousness, and after that also King of Salem, which is, King of peace;

entries.yo: Laini baba, laini iyá, laini ìtan iran, bẹ̃ni kò ni ibẹrẹ ọjọ tabi opin ọjọ aiye; ṣugbọn a ṣe e bi Ọmọ Ọlọrun; o wà li alufa titi.
entries.en: Without father, without mother, without descent, having neither beginning of days, nor end of life; but made like unto the Son of God; abideth a priest continually.

entries.yo: Njẹ ẹ gbà a rò bi ọkunrin yi ti pọ̀ to, ẹniti Abrahamu baba nla fi idamẹwa ninu awọn aṣayan ikogun fun.
entries.en: Now consider how great this man was, unto whom even the patriarch Abraham gave the tenth of the spoils.

entries.yo: Ati nitõtọ awọn ti iṣe ọmọ Lefi, ti o gbà oyè alufa, nwọn ni aṣẹ lati mã gbà idamẹwa lọwọ awọn enia gẹgẹ bi ofin, eyini ni, lọwọ awọn arakunrin wọn, bi o tilẹ ti jẹ pe, nwọn ti inu Abrahamu jade.
entries.en: And verily they that are of the sons of Levi, who receive the office of the priesthood, have a commandment to take tithes of the people according to the law, that is, of their brethren, though they come out of the loins of Abraham:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn on ẹniti a kò tilẹ pitan iran rẹ̀ lati ọdọ wọn wá, ti gbà idamẹwa lọwọ Abrahamu, o si ti sure fun ẹniti o gbà ileri.
entries.en: But he whose descent is not counted from them received tithes of Abraham, and blessed him that had the promises.

entries.yo: Ati li aisijiyan rara ẹniti kò to ẹni li ã sure fun lati ọdọ ẹniti o jù ni.
entries.en: And without all contradiction the less is blessed of the better.

entries.yo: Ati nihin, awọn ẹni kikú gbà idamẹwa; ṣugbọn nibẹ̀, ẹniti a jẹri rẹ̀ pe o mbẹ lãye.
entries.en: And here men that die receive tithes; but there he receiveth them, of whom it is witnessed that he liveth.

entries.yo: Ati bi a ti le wi, Lefi papa ti ngbà idamẹwa, ti san idamẹwa nipasẹ Abrahamu.
entries.en: And as I may so say, Levi also, who receiveth tithes, payed tithes in Abraham.

entries.yo: Nitori o sá si mbẹ ni inu baba rẹ̀, nigbati Melkisedeki pade rẹ̀.
entries.en: For he was yet in the loins of his father, when Melchisedec met him.

entries.yo: Njẹ ibaṣepe pipé mbẹ nipa oyè alufa Lefi, (nitoripe labẹ rẹ̀ li awọn enia gbà ofin), kili o si tún kù mọ́ ti alufa miran iba fi dide nipa ẹsẹ Melkisedeki, ti a kò si wipe nipa ẹsẹ Aaroni?
entries.en: If therefore perfection were by the Levitical priesthood, (for under it the people received the law,) what further need was there that another priest should rise after the order of Melchisedec, and not be called after the order of Aaron?

entries.yo: Nitoripe bi a ti pàrọ oyè alufa, a kò si le ṣai pàrọ ofin.
entries.en: For the priesthood being changed, there is made of necessity a change also of the law.

entries.yo: Nitori ẹniti a nsọ̀rọ nkan wọnyi nipa rẹ̀ jẹ ẹ̀ya miran, lati inu eyiti ẹnikẹni koi jọsin ri nibi pẹpẹ.
entries.en: For he of whom these things are spoken pertaineth to another tribe, of which no man gave attendance at the altar.

entries.yo: Nitori o han gbangba pe lati inu ẹ̀ya Juda ni Oluwa wa ti dide; nipa ẹ̀ya ti Mose kò sọ ohunkohun niti awọn alufa.
entries.en: For it is evident that our Lord sprang out of Juda; of which tribe Moses spake nothing concerning priesthood.

entries.yo: O si tún han gbangba jù bẹ̃ lọ bi o ti jẹ pe alufa miran dide gẹgẹ bi Melkisedeki,
entries.en: And it is yet far more evident: for that after the similitude of Melchisedec there ariseth another priest,

entries.yo: Eyiti a kò fi jẹ gẹgẹ bi ofin ilana nipa ti ara, bikoṣe nipa agbara ti ìye ailopin.
entries.en: Who is made, not after the law of a carnal commandment, but after the power of an endless life.

entries.yo: Nitori a jẹri pe, Iwọ ni alufa titi lai nipa ẹsẹ Melkisedeki.
entries.en: For he testifieth, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.

entries.yo: Nitori a mu ofin iṣaju kuro, nitori ailera ati ailere rẹ̀.
entries.en: For there is verily a disannulling of the commandment going before for the weakness and unprofitableness thereof.

entries.yo: (Nitori ofin kò mu ohunkohun pé), a si mu ireti ti o dara jù wá nipa eyiti awa nsunmọ Ọlọrun.
entries.en: For the law made nothing perfect, but the bringing in of a better hope did; by the which we draw nigh unto God.

entries.yo: Niwọn bi o si ti ṣe pe kì iṣe li aibura ni.
entries.en: And inasmuch as not without an oath he was made priest:

entries.yo: (Nitori a ti fi wọn jẹ alufa laisi ibura, nipa ẹniti o wi fun u pe, Oluwa bura, kì yio si ronupiwada, Iwọ ni alufa kan titi lai nipa ẹsẹ Melkisedeki:)
entries.en: (For those priests were made without an oath; but this with an oath by him that said unto him, The Lord sware and will not repent, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec:)

entries.yo: Niwọn bẹ̃ ni Jesu ti di onigbọ̀wọ́ majẹmu ti o dara jù.
entries.en: By so much was Jesus made a surety of a better testament.

entries.yo: Ati nitõtọ awọn pupọ̀ li a ti fi jẹ alufa, nitori nwọn kò le wà titi nitori ikú:
entries.en: And they truly were many priests, because they were not suffered to continue by reason of death:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn on, nitoriti o wà titi lai, o ni oyè alufa ti a kò le rọ̀ nipò.
entries.en: But this man, because he continueth ever, hath an unchangeable priesthood.

entries.yo: Nitorina o si le gba wọn là pẹlu titi de opin, ẹniti o ba tọ̀ Ọlọrun wá nipasẹ rẹ̀, nitoriti o mbẹ lãye titi lai lati mã bẹ̀bẹ fun wọn.
entries.en: Wherefore he is able also to save them to the uttermost that come unto God by him, seeing he ever liveth to make intercession for them.

entries.yo: Nitoripe irú Olori Alufa bẹ̃ li o yẹ wa, mimọ́, ailẹgan, ailẽri, ti a yà si ọ̀tọ kuro ninu ẹlẹṣẹ, ti a si gbéga jù awọn ọrun lọ;
entries.en: For such an high priest became us, who is holy, harmless, undefiled, separate from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;

entries.yo: Ẹniti kò ni lati mã kọ́ rubọ lojojumọ, bi awọn olori alufa wọnni, fun ẹ̀ṣẹ ti ara rẹ̀ na, ati lẹhinna fun ti awọn enia: nitori eyi li o ti ṣe lẹ̃kanṣoṣo, nigbati o fi ara rẹ̀ rubọ.
entries.en: Who needeth not daily, as those high priests, to offer up sacrifice, first for his own sins, and then for the people's: for this he did once, when he offered up himself.

entries.yo: Nitoripe ofin a mã fi awọn enia ti o ni ailera jẹ olori alufa; ṣugbọn ọ̀rọ ti ibura, ti a ṣe lẹhin ofin, o fi Ọmọ jẹ, ẹniti a sọ di pipé titi lai.
entries.en: For the law maketh men high priests which have infirmity; but the word of the oath, which was since the law, maketh the Son, who is consecrated for evermore.

entries.yo: NJẸ pataki ninu ohun ti a nsọ li eyi: Awa ni irú Olori Alufa bẹ̃, ti o joko li ọwọ́ ọtún itẹ́ ọla nla ninu awọn ọrun:
entries.en: Now of the things which we have spoken this is the sum: We have such an high priest, who is set on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens;

entries.yo: Iranṣẹ ibi mimọ́, ati ti agọ́ tõtọ, ti Oluwa pa, kì iṣe enia.
entries.en: A minister of the sanctuary, and of the true tabernacle, which the Lord pitched, and not man.

entries.yo: Nitori a fi olukuluku olori alufa jẹ lati mã mu ẹ̀bun wá ati lati mã rubọ: nitorina olori alufa yi pẹlu kò le ṣe aini ohun ti yio fi rubọ.
entries.en: For every high priest is ordained to offer gifts and sacrifices: wherefore it is of necessity that this man have somewhat also to offer.

entries.yo: Nisisiyi ibaṣepe o mbẹ li aiye, on kì bá tilẹ jẹ alufa, nitori awọn ti nfi ẹbun rubọ gẹgẹ bi ofin mbẹ:
entries.en: For if he were on earth, he should not be a priest, seeing that there are priests that offer gifts according to the law:

entries.yo: Awọn ẹniti njọsìn fun apẹrẹ ati ojiji awọn ohun ọrun, bi a ti kọ́ Mose lati ọdọ Ọlọrun wá nigbati o fẹ pa agọ́: nitori o wipe, kiyesi ki o ṣe ohun gbogbo gẹgẹ bi apẹrẹ ti a fihàn ọ lori òke.
entries.en: Who serve unto the example and shadow of heavenly things, as Moses was admonished of God when he was about to make the tabernacle: for, See, saith he, that thou make all things according to the pattern shewed to thee in the mount.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nisisiyi o ti gbà iṣẹ iranṣẹ ti o ni ọlá jù, niwọn bi o ti jẹ pe alarina majẹmu ti o dara jù ni iṣe, eyiti a fi ṣe ofin lori ileri ti o sàn jù bẹ̃ lọ.
entries.en: But now hath he obtained a more excellent ministry, by how much also he is the mediator of a better covenant, which was established upon better promises.

entries.yo: Nitori ibaṣepe majẹmu iṣaju nì kò li àbuku, njẹ a kì ba ti wá àye fun ekeji.
entries.en: For if that first covenant had been faultless, then should no place have been sought for the second.

entries.yo: Nitoriti o ri àbuku lara wọn, o wipe, Kiyesi i, ọjọ mbọ̀, li Oluwa wi, ti emi o bá ile Israeli ati ile Juda dá majẹmu titun.
entries.en: For finding fault with them, he saith, Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah:

entries.yo: Kì iṣe gẹgẹ bi majẹmu ti mo ti bá awọn baba wọn dá, li ọjọ na ti mo fà wọn lọwọ lati mu wọn jade kuro ni ilẹ Egipti; nitoriti nwọn kò duro ninu majẹmu mi, emi kò si kà wọn si, ni Oluwa wi.
entries.en: Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day when I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt; because they continued not in my covenant, and I regarded them not, saith the Lord.

entries.yo: Nitori eyi ni majẹmu ti emi ó ba ile Israeli da lẹhin ọjọ wọnni, li Oluwa wi; Emi ó fi ofin mi si inu wọn, emi o si kọ wọn si ọkàn wọn: emi o si mã jẹ́ Ọlọrun fun wọn, nwọn o si mã jẹ́ enia fun mi:
entries.en: For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days, saith the Lord; I will put my laws into their mind, and write them in their hearts: and I will be to them a God, and they shall be to me a people:

entries.yo: Olukuluku kì yio si mã kọ́ ara ilu rẹ̀ ati olukuluku arakunrin rẹ̀ wipe, Mọ̀ Oluwa: nitoripe gbogbo wọn ni yio mọ̀ mi, lati kekere de àgba.
entries.en: And they shall not teach every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying, Know the Lord: for all shall know me, from the least to the greatest.

entries.yo: Nitoripe emi o ṣãnu fun aiṣododo wọn, ati ẹ̀ṣẹ wọn ati aiṣedede wọn li emi kì yio si ranti mọ́.
entries.en: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness, and their sins and their iniquities will I remember no more.

entries.yo: Li eyi ti o wipe, Majẹmu titun, o ti sọ ti iṣaju di ti lailai. Ṣugbọn eyi ti o ndi ti lailai ti o si ngbó, o mura ati di asan.
entries.en: In that he saith, A new covenant, he hath made the first old. Now that which decayeth and waxeth old is ready to vanish away.

entries.yo: NJẸ majẹmu iṣaju papa pẹlu ní ìlana ìsin, ati ibi mimọ́ ti aiye yi.
entries.en: Then verily the first covenant had also ordinances of divine service, and a worldly sanctuary.

entries.yo: Nitoripe a pa agọ́ kan; eyi ti iṣaju ninu eyi ti ọpá fitila, ati tabili, ati akara ifihàn gbé wà, eyiti a npè ni ibi mimọ́.
entries.en: For there was a tabernacle made; the first, wherein was the candlestick, and the table, and the shewbread; which is called the sanctuary.

entries.yo: Ati lẹhin aṣọ ikele keji, on ni agọ́ ti a npè ni ibi mimọ julọ;
entries.en: And after the second veil, the tabernacle which is called the Holiest of all;

entries.yo: Ti o ni awo turari wura, ati apoti majẹmu ti a fi wura bò yiká, ninu eyi ti ikoko wura ti o ni manna gbé wà, ati ọpá Aaroni ti o rudi, ati awọn walã majẹmu;
entries.en: Which had the golden censer, and the ark of the covenant overlaid round about with gold, wherein was the golden pot that had manna, and Aaron's rod that budded, and the tables of the covenant;

entries.yo: Ati lori rẹ̀ ni awọn kerubu ogo ti o ṣijibo ìtẹ́ ãnu; eyiti a kò le sọrọ rẹ̀ nisisiyi lọkọ̃kan.
entries.en: And over it the cherubims of glory shadowing the mercyseat; of which we cannot now speak particularly.

entries.yo: Njẹ nigbati a ti ṣe ètò nkan wọnyi bayi, awọn alufa a mã lọ nigbakugba sinu agọ́ ekini, nwọn a mã ṣe iṣẹ ìsin.
entries.en: Now when these things were thus ordained, the priests went always into the first tabernacle, accomplishing the service of God.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn sinu ekeji ni olori alufa nikan imã lọ lẹ̃kanṣoṣo li ọdún, kì iṣe li aisi ẹ̀jẹ, ti on fi rubọ fun ara rẹ̀ na, ati fun ìṣina awọn enia:
entries.en: But into the second went the high priest alone once every year, not without blood, which he offered for himself, and for the errors of the people:

entries.yo: Ẹmí Mimọ́ ntọka eyi pé a kò ti iṣi ọ̀na ibi mimọ́ silẹ niwọn igbati agọ́ ekini ba duro.
entries.en: The Holy Ghost this signifying, that the way into the holiest of all was not yet made manifest, while as the first tabernacle was yet standing:

entries.yo: Eyiti iṣe apẹrẹ fun igba isisiyi gẹgẹ bi eyiti a nmu ẹ̀bun ati ẹbọ wá, ti kò le mu olusin di pipé niti ohun ti ẹri-ọkàn,
entries.en: Which was a figure for the time then present, in which were offered both gifts and sacrifices, that could not make him that did the service perfect, as pertaining to the conscience;

entries.yo: Eyiti o wà ninu ohun jijẹ ati ohun mimu ati onirũru ìwẹ, ti iṣe ìlana ti ara nikan ti a fi lelẹ titi fi di igba atunṣe.
entries.en: Which stood only in meats and drinks, and divers washings, and carnal ordinances, imposed on them until the time of reformation.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nigbati Kristi de bi Olori Alufa awọn ohun rere ti mbọ̀, nipaṣe agọ́ ti o tobi ti o si pé ju ti iṣaju, eyiti a kò fi ọwọ́ pa, eyini ni, ti kì iṣe ti ẹ̀da yi.
entries.en: But Christ being come an high priest of good things to come, by a greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this building;

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni kì iṣe nipasẹ ẹ̀jẹ ewurẹ ati ọmọ malu, ṣugbọn nipa ẹ̀jẹ on tikararẹ̀ o wọ ibi mimọ́ lẹ̃kanṣoṣo, lẹhin ti o ti ri idande ainipẹkun gbà fun wa.
entries.en: Neither by the blood of goats and calves, but by his own blood he entered in once into the holy place, having obtained eternal redemption for us.

entries.yo: Nitori bi ẹ̀jẹ akọ malu ati ewurẹ ti a fi nwọ́n awọn ti a ti sọ di alaimọ́ ba nsọ-ni-di-mimọ́ fun iwẹnumọ ara,
entries.en: For if the blood of bulls and of goats, and the ashes of an heifer sprinkling the unclean, sanctifieth to the purifying of the flesh:

entries.yo: Melomelo li ẹ̀jẹ Kristi, ẹni nipa Ẹmí aiyeraiye ti a fi ara rẹ̀ rubọ si Ọlọrun li aini àbawọn, yio wẹ̀ ẹrí-ọkàn nyin mọ́ kuro ninu okú ẹṣẹ lati sìn Ọlọrun alãye?
entries.en: How much more shall the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without spot to God, purge your conscience from dead works to serve the living God?

entries.yo: Ati nitori eyi li o ṣe jẹ alarina majẹmu titun pe bi ikú ti mbẹ fun idande awọn irekọja ti o ti wà labẹ majẹmu iṣaju, ki awọn ti a ti pè le ri ileri ogún ainipẹkun gbà.
entries.en: And for this cause he is the mediator of the new testament, that by means of death, for the redemption of the transgressions that were under the first testament, they which are called might receive the promise of eternal inheritance.

entries.yo: Nitori nibiti iwe-ogún ba gbé wà, ikú ẹniti o ṣe e kò le ṣe aisi pẹlu.
entries.en: For where a testament is, there must also of necessity be the death of the testator.

entries.yo: Nitori iwe-ogún li agbara lẹhin igbati enia ba kú: nitori kò li agbara rara nigbati ẹniti o ṣe e ba mbẹ lãye.
entries.en: For a testament is of force after men are dead: otherwise it is of no strength at all while the testator liveth.

entries.yo: Nitorina li a kò ṣe yà majẹmu iṣaju papa si mimọ́ laisi ẹ̀jẹ.
entries.en: Whereupon neither the first testament was dedicated without blood.

entries.yo: Nitori nigbati Mose ti sọ gbogbo aṣẹ fun gbogbo awọn enia gẹgẹ bi ofin, o mu ẹ̀jẹ ọmọ malu ati ti ewurẹ, pẹlu omi, ati owu ododó, ati ewe hissopu, o si fi wọ́n ati iwe pãpã ati gbogbo enia,
entries.en: For when Moses had spoken every precept to all the people according to the law, he took the blood of calves and of goats, with water, and scarlet wool, and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book, and all the people,

entries.yo: Wipe, Eyi li ẹ̀jẹ majẹmu ti Ọlọrun palaṣẹ fun nyin.
entries.en: Saying, This is the blood of the testament which God hath enjoined unto you.

entries.yo: Bẹ gẹgẹ li o si fi ẹ̀jẹ wọ́n agọ́, ati gbogbo ohun èlo ìsin.
entries.en: Moreover he sprinkled with blood both the tabernacle, and all the vessels of the ministry.

entries.yo: O si fẹrẹ jẹ́ ohun gbogbo li a fi ẹ̀jẹ wẹ̀nu gẹgẹ bi ofin; ati laisi itajẹsilẹ kò si idariji.
entries.en: And almost all things are by the law purged with blood; and without shedding of blood is no remission.

entries.yo: Nitorina a kò le ṣai fi iwọnyi wẹ̀ awọn apẹrẹ ohun ti mbẹ lọrun mọ́; ṣugbọn o yẹ ki a fi ẹbọ ti o san ju iwọnyi lọ wẹ̀ awọn ohun ọrun pãpã mọ́.
entries.en: It was therefore necessary that the patterns of things in the heavens should be purified with these; but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.

entries.yo: Nitori Kristi kò wọ̀ ibi mimọ́ ti a fi ọwọ́ ṣe lọ ti iṣe apẹrẹ ti otitọ; ṣugbọn o lọ si ọ̀run pãpã, nisisiyi lati farahan ni iwaju Ọlọrun fun wa:
entries.en: For Christ is not entered into the holy places made with hands, which are the figures of the true; but into heaven itself, now to appear in the presence of God for us:

entries.yo: Kì si iṣe pe ki o le mã fi ara rẹ̀ rubọ nigbakugba, bi olori alufa ti ima wọ̀ inu ibi mimọ́ lọ li ọdọ̃dún ti on ti ẹ̀jẹ ti ki ṣe tirẹ̀;
entries.en: Nor yet that he should offer himself often, as the high priest entereth into the holy place every year with blood of others;

entries.yo: Bi bẹ̃kọ on kì bá ṣai mã jìya nigbakugba lati ipilẹ aiye: ṣugbọn nisisiyi li o fi ara hàn lẹ̃kanṣoṣo li opin aiye lati mu ẹ̀ṣẹ kuro nipa ẹbọ ara rẹ̀.
entries.en: For then must he often have suffered since the foundation of the world: but now once in the end of the world hath he appeared to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself.

entries.yo: Niwọn bi a si ti fi lelẹ fun gbogbo enia lati kú lẹ̃kanṣoṣo, ṣugbọn lẹhin eyi idajọ:
entries.en: And as it is appointed unto men once to die, but after this the judgment:

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni Kristi pẹlu lẹhin ti a ti fi rubọ lẹ̃kanṣoṣo lati ru ẹ̀ṣẹ ọ̀pọlọpọ, yio farahan nigbakeji laisi ẹ̀ṣẹ fun awọn ti nwo ọna rẹ̀ fun igbala.
entries.en: So Christ was once offered to bear the sins of many; and unto them that look for him shall he appear the second time without sin unto salvation.

entries.yo: NITORI ofin bi o ti ni ojiji awọn ohun rere ti mbọ̀ laijẹ aworan pãpã awọn nkan na, nwọn kò le fi ẹbọ kanna ti nwọn nru nigbagbogbo li ọdọ̃dún mu awọn ti nwá sibẹ̀ di pipé.
entries.en: For the law having a shadow of good things to come, and not the very image of the things, can never with those sacrifices which they offered year by year continually make the comers thereunto perfect.

entries.yo: Bikoṣe bẹ̃, a kì bá ha ti dẹkun ati mã rú wọn, nitori awọn ti nsìn kì bá tí ni ìmọ ẹ̀ṣẹ, nigbati a ba ti wẹ wọn mọ lẹ̃kanṣoṣo.
entries.en: For then would they not have ceased to be offered? because that the worshippers once purged should have had no more conscience of sins.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ninu ẹbọ wọnni ni a nṣe iranti ẹ̀ṣẹ li ọdọdún.
entries.en: But in those sacrifices there is a remembrance again made of sins every year.

entries.yo: Nitori ko ṣe iṣe fun ẹ̀jẹ akọ malu ati ti ewurẹ lati mu ẹ̀ṣẹ kuro.
entries.en: For it is not possible that the blood of bulls and of goats should take away sins.

entries.yo: Nitorina nigbati o wá si aiye, o wipe, Iwọ kò fẹ ẹbọ ati ọrẹ, ṣugbọn ara ni iwọ ti pèse fun mi:
entries.en: Wherefore when he cometh into the world, he saith, Sacrifice and offering thou wouldest not, but a body hast thou prepared me:

entries.yo: Ẹbọ sisun ati ẹbọ fun ẹ̀ṣẹ ni iwọ kò ni inu didùn si.
entries.en: In burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin thou hast had no pleasure.

entries.yo: Nigbana ni mo wipe, Kiyesi i (ninu iwe-kiká nì li a gbé kọ ọ nipa ti emi) Mo dé lati ṣe ifẹ rẹ, Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Then said I, Lo, I come (in the volume of the book it is written of me,) to do thy will, O God.

entries.yo: Nigbati o wi ni iṣaju pe, Iwọ kò fẹ ẹbọ ati ọrẹ, ati ẹbọ sisun, ati ẹbọ fun ẹ̀ṣẹ, bẹ̃ni iwọ kò ni inu didun si wọn (awọn eyiti a nrú gẹgẹ bi ofin).
entries.en: Above when he said, Sacrifice and offering and burnt offerings and offering for sin thou wouldest not, neither hadst pleasure therein; which are offered by the law;

entries.yo: Nigbana ni o wipe, Kiyesi i, Mo dé lati ṣe ifẹ rẹ, Ọlọrun. O mu ti iṣaju kuro, ki o le fi idi ekeji mulẹ.
entries.en: Then said he, Lo, I come to do thy will, O God. He taketh away the first, that he may establish the second.

entries.yo: Nipa ifẹ na li a ti sọ wa di mimọ́ nipa ẹbọ ti Jesu Kristi fi ara rẹ̀ rú lẹ̃kanṣoṣo.
entries.en: By the which will we are sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.

entries.yo: Ati olukuluku alufa si nduro li ojojumọ́ o nṣe ìsin, o si nṣe ẹbọ kanna nigbakugba, ti kò le mu ẹ̀ṣẹ kuro lai:
entries.en: And every priest standeth daily ministering and offering oftentimes the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn on, lẹhin igbati o ti ru ẹbọ kan fun ẹ̀ṣẹ titi lai, o joko li ọwọ́ ọtún Ọlọrun;
entries.en: But this man, after he had offered one sacrifice for sins for ever, sat down on the right hand of God;

entries.yo: Lati igbà na lọ, ó nreti titi a o fi fi awọn ọtá rẹ̀ ṣe apoti itisẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: From henceforth expecting till his enemies be made his footstool.

entries.yo: Nitori nipa ẹbọ kan o ti mu awọn ti a sọ di mimọ́ pé titi lai.
entries.en: For by one offering he hath perfected for ever them that are sanctified.

entries.yo: Ẹmí Mimọ́ si njẹri fun wa pẹlu: nitori lẹhin ti o ti wipe,
entries.en: Whereof the Holy Ghost also is a witness to us: for after that he had said before,

entries.yo: Eyi ni majẹmu ti emi ó ba wọn dá lẹhin ọjọ wọnni, li Oluwa wi, emi o fi ofin mi si wọn li ọkàn, inu wọn pẹlu li emi o si kọ wọn si;
entries.en: This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days, saith the Lord, I will put my laws into their hearts, and in their minds will I write them;

entries.yo: Ẹ̀ṣẹ wọn ati aiṣedede wọn li emi kì yio si ranti mọ́.
entries.en: And their sins and iniquities will I remember no more.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nibiti imukuro iwọnyi ba gbé wà, irubọ fun ẹ̀ṣẹ kò si mọ́.
entries.en: Now where remission of these is, there is no more offering for sin.

entries.yo: Ará, njẹ bi a ti ni igboiya lati wọ̀ inu ibi mimọ́ nipasẹ ẹ̀jẹ Jesu,
entries.en: Having therefore, brethren, boldness to enter into the holiest by the blood of Jesus,

entries.yo: Nipa ọ̀na titun ati ãye, ti o yà si mimọ́ fun wa, ati lati kọja aṣọ ikele nì, eyini ni, ara rẹ̀;
entries.en: By a new and living way, which he hath consecrated for us, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh;

entries.yo: Ati bi a ti ni alufa giga lori ile Ọlọrun;
entries.en: And having an high priest over the house of God;

entries.yo: Ẹ jẹ ki a fi otitọ ọkàn sunmọ tosi ni ẹ̀kún igbagbọ́, ki a si wẹ̀ ọkàn wa mọ́ kuro ninu ẹri-ọkàn buburu, ki a si fi omi mimọ́ wẹ̀ ara wa nù.
entries.en: Let us draw near with a true heart in full assurance of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience, and our bodies washed with pure water.

entries.yo: Ẹ jẹ ki a dì ijẹwọ ireti wa mu ṣinṣin li aiṣiyemeji; (nitoripe olõtọ li ẹniti o ṣe ileri;)
entries.en: Let us hold fast the profession of our faith without wavering; (for he is faithful that promised;)

entries.yo: Ẹ jẹ ki a yẹ ara wa wo lati rú ara wa si ifẹ ati si iṣẹ rere:
entries.en: And let us consider one another to provoke unto love and to good works:

entries.yo: Ki a má mã kọ ipejọpọ̀ ara wa silẹ, gẹgẹ bi àṣa awọn ẹlomiran; ṣugbọn ki a mã gbà ara ẹni niyanju: pẹlupẹlu bi ẹnyin ti ri pe ọjọ nì nsunmọ etile.
entries.en: Not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as the manner of some is; but exhorting one another: and so much the more, as ye see the day approaching.

entries.yo: Nitori bi awa ba mọ̃mọ̀ dẹṣẹ lẹhin igbati awa ba ti gbà ìmọ otitọ kò tun si ẹbọ fun ẹ̀ṣẹ mọ́,
entries.en: For if we sin wilfully after that we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remaineth no more sacrifice for sins,

entries.yo: Bikoṣe ireti idajọ ti o ba ni lẹrù, ati ti ibinu ti o muná, ti yio pa awọn ọtá run.
entries.en: But a certain fearful looking for of judgment and fiery indignation, which shall devour the adversaries.

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni ti o ba gàn ofin Mose, o kú li aisi ãnu nipa ẹri ẹni meji tabi mẹta:
entries.en: He that despised Moses' law died without mercy under two or three witnesses:

entries.yo: Melomelo ni ẹ ro pe a o jẹ oluwa rẹ̀ ni ìya kikan, ẹniti o ti tẹ Ọmọ Ọlọrun mọlẹ ti o si ti kà ẹ̀jẹ̀ majẹmu ti a fi sọ ọ di mimọ́ si ohun aimọ́, ti o si ti kẹgan Ẹmí ore-ọfẹ.
entries.en: Of how much sorer punishment, suppose ye, shall he be thought worthy, who hath trodden under foot the Son of God, and hath counted the blood of the covenant, wherewith he was sanctified, an unholy thing, and hath done despite unto the Spirit of grace?

entries.yo: Nitori awa mọ̀ ẹniti o wipe, Ẹsan ni ti emi, Oluwa wipe, Emi o gbẹsan. Ati pẹlu, Oluwa yio ṣe idajọ awọn enia rẹ̀.
entries.en: For we know him that hath said, Vengeance belongeth unto me, I will recompense, saith the Lord. And again, The Lord shall judge his people.

entries.yo: Ohun ẹ̀ru ni lati ṣubu si ọwọ́ Ọlọrun alãye.
entries.en: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹ ranti ọjọ iṣaju, ninu eyiti, nigbati a ti ṣí nyin loju, ẹ fi ara da wahala ijiya nla;
entries.en: But call to remembrance the former days, in which, after ye were illuminated, ye endured a great fight of afflictions;

entries.yo: Lapakan, nigbati a sọ nyin di iran wiwo nipa ẹ̀gan ati ipọnju; ati lapakan, nigbati ẹnyin di ẹgbẹ awọn ti a ṣe bẹ̃ si.
entries.en: Partly, whilst ye were made a gazingstock both by reproaches and afflictions; and partly, whilst ye became companions of them that were so used.

entries.yo: Nitori ẹnyin bá awọn ti o wà ninu ìde kẹdun, ẹ si fi ayọ̀ gbà ìkolọ ẹrù nyin, nitori ẹnyin mọ̀ ninu ara nyin pe, ẹ ni ọrọ̀ ti o wà titi, ti o si dara ju bẹ̃ lọ li ọ̀run.
entries.en: For ye had compassion of me in my bonds, and took joyfully the spoiling of your goods, knowing in yourselves that ye have in heaven a better and an enduring substance.

entries.yo: Nitorina ẹ máṣe gbe igboiya nyin sọnu, eyiti o ni ère nla.
entries.en: Cast not away therefore your confidence, which hath great recompence of reward.

entries.yo: Nitori ẹnyin kò le ṣe alaini sũru, nitori igbati ẹnyin ba ti ṣe ifẹ Ọlọrun tan, ki ẹnyin ki o le gbà ileri na.
entries.en: For ye have need of patience, that, after ye have done the will of God, ye might receive the promise.

entries.yo: Nitori niwọn igba diẹ si i, Ẹni nã ti mbọ̀ yio de, kì yio si jafara.
entries.en: For yet a little while, and he that shall come will come, and will not tarry.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn olododo ni yio yè nipa igbagbọ́: ṣugbọn bi o ba fà sẹhin, ọkàn mi kò ni inu didùn si i.
entries.en: Now the just shall live by faith: but if any man draw back, my soul shall have no pleasure in him.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awa kò si ninu awọn ti nfà sẹhin sinu egbé; bikoṣe ninu awọn ti o gbagbọ́ si igbala ọkàn.
entries.en: But we are not of them who draw back unto perdition; but of them that believe to the saving of the soul.

entries.yo: NJẸ igbagbọ́ ni idaniloju ohun ti a nreti, ijẹri ohun ti a kò ri.
entries.en: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.

entries.yo: Nitori ninu rẹ̀ li awọn alàgba ti ni ẹri rere.
entries.en: For by it the elders obtained a good report.

entries.yo: Nipa igbagbọ́ li a mọ̀ pe a ti da aiye nipa ọ̀rọ Ọlọrun; nitorina ki iṣe ohun ti o hàn li a fi dá ohun ti a nri.
entries.en: Through faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of God, so that things which are seen were not made of things which do appear.

entries.yo: Nipa igbagbọ́ ni Abeli ru ẹbọ si Ọlọrun ti o san ju ti Kaini lọ, nipa eyiti a jẹri rẹ̀ pe olododo ni, Ọlọrun si njẹri ẹ̀bun rẹ̀: ati nipa rẹ̀ na, bi o ti kú ni, o nfọhùn sibẹ̀.
entries.en: By faith Abel offered unto God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, by which he obtained witness that he was righteous, God testifying of his gifts: and by it he being dead yet speaketh.

entries.yo: Nipa igbagbọ́ li a ṣí Enoku nipò pada ki o máṣe ri ikú; a kò si ri i, nitoriti Ọlọrun ṣí i nipò pada: nitori ṣaju iṣipopada rẹ̀, a jẹrí yi si i pe o wù Ọlọrun.
entries.en: By faith Enoch was translated that he should not see death; and was not found, because God had translated him: for before his translation he had this testimony, that he pleased God.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn li aisi igbagbọ́ ko ṣe iṣe lati wù u; nitori ẹniti o ba ntọ̀ Ọlọrun wá kò le ṣai gbagbọ́ pe o mbẹ, ati pe on ni olusẹsan fun awọn ti o fi ara balẹ wá a.
entries.en: But without faith it is impossible to please him: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and that he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.

entries.yo: Nipa igbagbọ́ ni Noa, nigbati Ọlọrun kilọ ohun ti koi ti iri fun u, o bẹru Ọlọrun, o si kàn ọkọ̀ fun igbala ile rẹ̀, nipa eyiti o dá aiye lẹbi, o si di ajogún ododo ti iṣe nipa igbagbọ́.
entries.en: By faith Noah, being warned of God of things not seen as yet, moved with fear, prepared an ark to the saving of his house; by the which he condemned the world, and became heir of the righteousness which is by faith.

entries.yo: Nipa igbagbọ́ ni Abrahamu, nigbati a ti pè e lati jade lọ si ibi ti on yio gbà fun ilẹ-ini, o gbọ́, o si jade lọ, lai mọ̀ ibiti on nrè.
entries.en: By faith Abraham, when he was called to go out into a place which he should after receive for an inheritance, obeyed; and he went out, not knowing whither he went.

entries.yo: Nipa igbagbọ́ li o ṣe atipo ni ilẹ ileri, bi ẹnipe ni ilẹ àjeji, o ngbé inu agọ́, pẹlu Isaaki ati Jakọbu, awọn ajogún ileri kanna pẹlu rẹ̀:
entries.en: By faith he sojourned in the land of promise, as in a strange country, dwelling in tabernacles with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise:

entries.yo: Nitoriti o nreti ilu ti o ni ipilẹ̀; eyiti Ọlọrun tẹ̀do ti o si kọ́.
entries.en: For he looked for a city which hath foundations, whose builder and maker is God.

entries.yo: Nipa igbagbọ́ ni Sara tikararẹ̀ pẹlu fi ni agbara lati lóyun, nigbati o kọja ìgba rẹ̀, nitoriti o kà ẹniti o ṣe ileri si olõtọ.
entries.en: Through faith also Sara herself received strength to conceive seed, and was delivered of a child when she was past age, because she judged him faithful who had promised.

entries.yo: Nitorina li ọ̀pọlọpọ ṣe ti ara ẹnikan jade, ani ara ẹniti o dabi okú, ọ̀pọ bi irawọ oju ọrun li ọ̀pọlọpọ, ati bi iyanrin eti okun li ainiye.
entries.en: Therefore sprang there even of one, and him as good as dead, so many as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as the sand which is by the sea shore innumerable.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn wọnyi li o kú ni igbagbọ́, lai ri ileri wọnni gbà, ṣugbọn ti nwọn ri wọn li òkere rere, ti nwọn si gbá wọn mú, ti nwọn si jẹwọ pe alejò ati atipò li awọn lori ilẹ aiye.
entries.en: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them afar off, and were persuaded of them, and embraced them, and confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.

entries.yo: Nitoripe awọn ti o nsọ irú ohun bẹ̃, fihan gbangba pe, nwọn nṣe afẹri ilu kan ti iṣe tiwọn.
entries.en: For they that say such things declare plainly that they seek a country.

entries.yo: Ati nitõtọ, ibaṣepe nwọn fi ilu tí nwọn ti jade wa si ọkàn, nwọn iba ti ri aye lati pada.
entries.en: And truly, if they had been mindful of that country from whence they came out, they might have had opportunity to have returned.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nisisiyi nwọn nfẹ ilu kan ti o dara jù bẹ̃ lọ, eyini ni ti ọ̀run: nitorina oju wọn kò ti Ọlọrun, pe ki a mã pe On ni Ọlọrun wọn; nitoriti o ti pèse ilu kan silẹ fun wọn.
entries.en: But now they desire a better country, that is, an heavenly: wherefore God is not ashamed to be called their God: for he hath prepared for them a city.

entries.yo: Nipa igbagbọ́ ni Abrahamu, nigbati a dán a wò, fi Isaaki rubọ: ẹniti o si ti fi ayọ̀ gbà ileri wọnni fi ọmọ-bíbi rẹ̀ kanṣoṣo rubọ.
entries.en: By faith Abraham, when he was tried, offered up Isaac: and he that had received the promises offered up his only begotten son,

entries.yo: Niti ẹniti a wipe, Ninu Isaaki li a o ti pè irú-ọmọ rẹ:
entries.en: Of whom it was said, That in Isaac shall thy seed be called:

entries.yo: O si pari rẹ̀ si pe Ọlọrun tilẹ le gbe e dide, ani kuro ninu oku, ati ibiti o ti gbà a pada pẹlu ni apẹrẹ.
entries.en: Accounting that God was able to raise him up, even from the dead; from whence also he received him in a figure.

entries.yo: Nipa igbagbọ́ ni Isaaki sure fun Jakọbu ati Esau niti ohun ti mbọ̀.
entries.en: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau concerning things to come.

entries.yo: Nipa igbagbọ́ ni Jakọbu, nigbati o nkú lọ, o súre fun awọn ọmọ Josefu ni ọ̀kọ̃kan; o si tẹriba, o simi le ori ọpá rẹ̀.
entries.en: By faith Jacob, when he was a dying, blessed both the sons of Joseph; and worshipped, leaning upon the top of his staff.

entries.yo: Nipa igbagbọ́ ni Josefu, nigbati o nkú lọ, o ranti ìjadelọ awọn ọmọ Israeli; o si paṣẹ niti awọn egungun rẹ̀.
entries.en: By faith Joseph, when he died, made mention of the departing of the children of Israel; and gave commandment concerning his bones.

entries.yo: Nipa igbagbọ́ ni awọn obi Mose pa a mọ́ fun oṣu mẹta nigbati a bí i, nitoriti nwọn ri i ni arẹwa ọmọ; nwọn kò si bẹ̀ru aṣẹ ọba.
entries.en: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hid three months of his parents, because they saw he was a proper child; and they were not afraid of the king's commandment.

entries.yo: Nipa igbagbọ́ ni Mose, nigbati o dàgba, o kọ̀ ki a mã pè on li ọmọ ọmọbinrin Farao;
entries.en: By faith Moses, when he was come to years, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh's daughter;

entries.yo: O kuku yàn ati mã bá awọn enia Ọlọrun jìya, jù ati jẹ fãji ẹ̀ṣẹ fun igba diẹ;
entries.en: Choosing rather to suffer affliction with the people of God, than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a season;

entries.yo: O kà ẹ̀gan Kristi si ọrọ̀ ti o pọju awọn iṣura Egipti lọ: nitoriti o nwo ère na.
entries.en: Esteeming the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures in Egypt: for he had respect unto the recompence of the reward.

entries.yo: Nipa igbagbọ́ li o kọ̀ Egipti silẹ li aibẹ̀ru ibinu ọba: nitoriti o duro ṣinṣin bi ẹniti o nri ẹni airi.
entries.en: By faith he forsook Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king: for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.

entries.yo: Nipa igbagbọ́ li o dá ase irekọja silẹ, ati ibuwọ́n ẹ̀jẹ, ki ẹniti npa awọn akọbi ọmọ ki o má bã fi ọwọ́ kàn wọn.
entries.en: Through faith he kept the passover, and the sprinkling of blood, lest he that destroyed the firstborn should touch them.

entries.yo: Nipa igbagbọ́ ni nwọn là okun pupa kọja bi ẹnipe ni iyangbẹ ilẹ: ti awọn ara Egipti danwò, ti nwọn si rì.
entries.en: By faith they passed through the Red sea as by dry land: which the Egyptians assaying to do were drowned.

entries.yo: Nipa igbagbọ́ li awọn odi Jeriko wó lulẹ, lẹhin igbati a yi wọn ká ni ijọ meje.
entries.en: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down, after they were compassed about seven days.

entries.yo: Nipa igbagbọ́ ni Rahabu panṣaga kò ṣegbé pẹlu awọn ti kò gbọran, nigbati o tẹwọgbà awọn amí li alafia.
entries.en: By faith the harlot Rahab perished not with them that believed not, when she had received the spies with peace.

entries.yo: Ewo li emi o si tun mã wi si i? nitoripe ãyè kò ni tó fun mi lati sọ ti Gideoni, ati Baraku, ati Samsoni, ati Jefta; ti Dafidi, ati Samueli, ati ti awọn woli:
entries.en: And what shall I more say? for the time would fail me to tell of Gedeon, and of Barak, and of Samson, and of Jephthae; of David also, and Samuel, and of the prophets:

entries.yo: Awọn ẹni nipasẹ igbagbọ́ ti nwọn ṣẹgun ilẹ ọba, ti nwọn ṣiṣẹ ododo, ti nwọn gbà ileri, ti nwọn dí awọn kiniun li ẹnu,
entries.en: Who through faith subdued kingdoms, wrought righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions,

entries.yo: Ti nwọn pa agbara iná, ti nwọn bọ́ lọwọ oju-idà, ti a sọ di alagbara ninu ailera, ti nwọn di akọni ni ìja, nwọn lé ogun awọn àjeji sá.
entries.en: Quenched the violence of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, out of weakness were made strong, waxed valiant in fight, turned to flight the armies of the aliens.

entries.yo: Awọn obinrin ri okú wọn gbà nipa ajinde: a si dá awọn ẹlomiran lóro, nwọn kọ̀ lati gbà ìdasilẹ; ki nwọn ki o le ri ajinde ti o dara jù gbà:
entries.en: Women received their dead raised to life again: and others were tortured, not accepting deliverance; that they might obtain a better resurrection:

entries.yo: Awọn ẹlomiran si ri idanwò ti ẹsín, ati ti ìnà, ati ju bẹ̃ lọ ti ìde ati ti tubu:
entries.en: And others had trial of cruel mockings and scourgings, yea, moreover of bonds and imprisonment:

entries.yo: A sọ wọn li okuta, a fi ayùn rẹ́ wọn meji, a dán wọn wò, a fi idà pa wọn: nwọn rìn kákiri ninu awọ agutan ati ninu awọ ewurẹ; nwọn di alaini, olupọnju, ẹniti a nda loro;
entries.en: They were stoned, they were sawn asunder, were tempted, were slain with the sword: they wandered about in sheepskins and goatskins; being destitute, afflicted, tormented;

entries.yo: Awọn ẹniti aiye kò yẹ fun: nwọn nkiri ninu aṣálẹ, ati lori òke, ati ninu ihò ati ninu ihò abẹ ilẹ.
entries.en: (Of whom the world was not worthy:) they wandered in deserts, and in mountains, and in dens and caves of the earth.

entries.yo: Gbogbo awọn wọnyi ti a jẹri rere sí nipa igbagbọ́, nwọn kò si ri ileri na gbà:
entries.en: And these all, having obtained a good report through faith, received not the promise:

entries.yo: Nitori Ọlọrun ti pèse ohun ti o dara jù silẹ fun wa, pe li aisi wa, ki a má ṣe wọn pé.
entries.en: God having provided some better thing for us, that they without us should not be made perfect.

entries.yo: NITORINA bi a ti fi awọsanmọ ti o kún to bayi fun awọn ẹlẹri yí wa ká, ẹ jẹ ki a pa ohun idiwọ gbogbo tì si apakan, ati ẹ̀ṣẹ ti o rọrun lati dì mọ wa, ki a si mã fi sũru sure ije ti a gbé ka iwaju wa,
entries.en: Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,

entries.yo: Ki a mã wò Jesu olupilẹṣẹ ati alaṣepe igbagbọ́ wa; ẹni, nitori ayọ̀ ti a gbé ká iwaju rẹ̀, ti o farada agbelebu, laika itiju si, ti o si joko li ọwọ́ ọtún itẹ́ Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of our faith; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God.

entries.yo: Sá ro ti ẹniti o farada irú isọrọ-odì yi lati ọdọ awọn ẹlẹṣẹ si ara rẹ̀, ki ẹ má ba rẹwẹsi ni ọkàn nyin, ki ãrẹ si mu nyin.
entries.en: For consider him that endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, lest ye be wearied and faint in your minds.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin kò ìtĩ kọ oju ija si ẹ̀ṣẹ titi de ẹ̀jẹ ni ijakadi nyin.
entries.en: Ye have not yet resisted unto blood, striving against sin.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin si ti gbagbé ọ̀rọ iyanju ti mba nyin sọ bi ọmọ pe, Ọmọ mi, má ṣe alainani ibawi Oluwa, ki o má si ṣe rẹwẹsi nigbati a ba nti ọwọ́ rẹ̀ ba ọ wi:
entries.en: And ye have forgotten the exhortation which speaketh unto you as unto children, My son, despise not thou the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when thou art rebuked of him:

entries.yo: Nitoripe ẹniti Oluwa fẹ, on ni ibawi, a si mã nà olukuluku ọmọ ti o gbà.
entries.en: For whom the Lord loveth he chasteneth, and scourgeth every son whom he receiveth.

entries.yo: Ẹ mã mu suru labẹ ibawi: Ọlọrun mba nyin lo bi ọmọ ni; nitoripe ọmọ wo ni mbẹ ti baba ki ibawi?
entries.en: If ye endure chastening, God dealeth with you as with sons; for what son is he whom the father chasteneth not?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi ẹnyin ba wà li aisi ibawi, ninu eyiti gbogbo enia ti jẹ alabapin, njẹ ọmọ àle ni nyin, ẹ kì isi iṣe ọmọ.
entries.en: But if ye be without chastisement, whereof all are partakers, then are ye bastards, and not sons.

entries.yo: Pẹlupẹlu awa ni baba wa nipa ti ara ti o ntọ́ wa, awa si mbù ọlá fun wọn: awa kì yio kuku tẹriba fun Baba awọn ẹmí ki a si yè?
entries.en: Furthermore we have had fathers of our flesh which corrected us, and we gave them reverence: shall we not much rather be in subjection unto the Father of spirits, and live?

entries.yo: Nitori nwọn tọ́ wa fun ọjọ diẹ bi o ba ti dara loju wọn; ṣugbọn on fun ère wa, ki awa ki o le ṣe alabapin ìwa mimọ́ rẹ̀.
entries.en: For they verily for a few days chastened us after their own pleasure; but he for our profit, that we might be partakers of his holiness.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ibawi kò dabi ohun ayọ̀ nisisiyi, bikoṣe ibanujẹ; ṣugbọn nikẹhin a so eso alafia fun awọn ti a ti tọ́ nipa rẹ̀, ani eso ododo.
entries.en: Now no chastening for the present seemeth to be joyous, but grievous: nevertheless afterward it yieldeth the peaceable fruit of righteousness unto them which are exercised thereby.

entries.yo: Nitorina ẹ na ọwọ́ ti o rọ, ati ẽkun ailera;
entries.en: Wherefore lift up the hands which hang down, and the feeble knees;

entries.yo: Ki ẹ si ṣe ipa-ọna ti o tọ fun ẹsẹ nyin, ki eyiti o rọ má bã kuro lori iké ṣugbọn ki a kuku wo o san.
entries.en: And make straight paths for your feet, lest that which is lame be turned out of the way; but let it rather be healed.

entries.yo: Ẹ mã lepa alafia pẹlu enia gbogbo, ati ìwa mimọ́, li aisi eyini kò si ẹniti yio ri Oluwa:
entries.en: Follow peace with all men, and holiness, without which no man shall see the Lord:

entries.yo: Ẹ mã kiyesara ki ẹnikẹni ki o máṣe kùna ore-ọfẹ Ọlọrun; ki gbòngbo ikorò kan ki o má ba hù soke ki o si yọ nyin lẹnu, ọ̀pọlọpọ a si ti ipa rẹ̀ di aimọ́;
entries.en: Looking diligently lest any man fail of the grace of God; lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you, and thereby many be defiled;

entries.yo: Ki o má bã si àgbere kan tabi alaiwa-bi-Ọlọrun bi Esau, ẹniti o ti itori òkele onjẹ kan tà ogún ibí rẹ̀.
entries.en: Lest there be any fornicator, or profane person, as Esau, who for one morsel of meat sold his birthright.

entries.yo: Nitori ẹnyin mọ̀ pe lẹhinna ní ani nigbati o fẹ lati jogun ibukun na, a kọ̀ ọ (nitori kò ri aye ironupiwada) bi o tilẹ ti fi omije wá a gidigidi.
entries.en: For ye know how that afterward, when he would have inherited the blessing, he was rejected: for he found no place of repentance, though he sought it carefully with tears.

entries.yo: Nitori ẹnyin kò wá si òke, ti a le fi ọwọ kàn, ati si iná ti njó, ati si iṣúdùdu ati òkunkun, ati iji,
entries.en: For ye are not come unto the mount that might be touched, and that burned with fire, nor unto blackness, and darkness, and tempest,

entries.yo: Ati iró ipè, ati ohùn ọ̀rọ, eyiti awọn ti o gbọ́ bẹ̀bẹ pe, ki a máṣe sọ ọ̀rọ si i fun wọn mọ́:
entries.en: And the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which voice they that heard intreated that the word should not be spoken to them any more:

entries.yo: Nitoripe ara wọn kò le gbà ohun ti o palaṣẹ, Bi o tilẹ jẹ ẹranko li o farakan òke na, a o sọ ọ li okuta, tabi a o gún u li ọ̀kọ pa.
entries.en: (For they could not endure that which was commanded, And if so much as a beast touch the mountain, it shall be stoned, or thrust through with a dart:

entries.yo: Iran na si lẹrù tobẹ̃, ti Mose wipe, ẹ̀ru bà mi gidigidi mo si warìri.
entries.en: And so terrible was the sight, that Moses said, I exceedingly fear and quake:)

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹnyin wá si òke Sioni, ati si ilu Ọlọrun alãye, si Jerusalemu ti ọ̀run, ati si ẹgbẹ awọn angẹli ainiye,
entries.en: But ye are come unto mount Sion, and unto the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to an innumerable company of angels,

entries.yo: Si ajọ nla ati ìjọ akọbi ti a ti kọ orukọ wọn li ọ̀run, ati sọdọ Ọlọrun onidajọ gbogbo enia, ati sọdọ awọn ẹmí olõtọ enia ti a ṣe li aṣepé,
entries.en: To the general assembly and church of the firstborn, which are written in heaven, and to God the Judge of all, and to the spirits of just men made perfect,

entries.yo: Ati sọdọ Jesu alarina majẹmu titun, ati si ibi ẹ̀jẹ ibuwọ́n nì, ti nsọ̀rọ ohun ti o dara jù ti Abeli lọ.
entries.en: And to Jesus the mediator of the new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling, that speaketh better things than that of Abel.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, ki ẹ máṣe kọ̀ ẹniti nkilọ. Nitori bi awọn wọnni kò ba bọ́ nigbati nwọn kọ̀ ẹniti nkilọ li aiye, melomelo li awa kì yio bọ́ awa ti o pẹhinda si ẹniti nkilọ lati ọrun wá:
entries.en: See that ye refuse not him that speaketh. For if they escaped not who refused him that spake on earth, much more shall not we escape, if we turn away from him that speaketh from heaven:

entries.yo: Ohùn ẹniti o mì aiye nigbana: ṣugbọn nisisiyi o ti ṣe ileri, wipe, Lẹ̃kan si i emi kì yio mì kìki aiye nikan, ṣugbọn ọrun pẹlu.
entries.en: Whose voice then shook the earth: but now he hath promised, saying, Yet once more I shake not the earth only, but also heaven.

entries.yo: Ati ọ̀rọ yi, Lẹ̃kan si i, itumọ rẹ̀ ni mimu awọn ohun wọnni ti a nmì kuro, bi ohun ti a ti da, ki awọn ohun wọnni ti a kò le mì le wà sibẹ.
entries.en: And this word, Yet once more, signifieth the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that are made, that those things which cannot be shaken may remain.

entries.yo: Nitorina bi awa ti ngbà ilẹ ọba ti a kò le mì, ẹ jẹ ki a ni ore-ọfẹ nipa eyiti awa le mã sin Ọlọrun ni itẹwọgbà pẹlu ọ̀wọ ati ibẹru rẹ̀.
entries.en: Wherefore we receiving a kingdom which cannot be moved, let us have grace, whereby we may serve God acceptably with reverence and godly fear:

entries.yo: Nitoripe Ọlọrun wa, iná ti ijonirun ni.
entries.en: For our God is a consuming fire.

entries.yo: KI ifẹ ará ki o wà titi.
entries.en: Let brotherly love continue.

entries.yo: Ẹ máṣe gbagbé lati mã ṣe alejò; nitoripe nipa bẹ̃ li awọn ẹlomiran ṣe awọn angẹli li alejò laimọ̀.
entries.en: Be not forgetful to entertain strangers: for thereby some have entertained angels unawares.

entries.yo: Ẹ mã ranti awọn onde bi ẹniti a dè pẹlu wọn, ati awọn ti a npọn loju bi ẹnyin tikaranyin pẹlu ti mbẹ ninu ara.
entries.en: Remember them that are in bonds, as bound with them; and them which suffer adversity, as being yourselves also in the body.

entries.yo: Ki igbéyawo ki o li ọla larin gbogbo enia, ki akete si jẹ alailẽri: nitori awọn àgbere ati awọn panṣaga li Ọlọrun yio dá lẹjọ.
entries.en: Marriage is honourable in all, and the bed undefiled: but whoremongers and adulterers God will judge.

entries.yo: Ki ọkàn nyin ki o máṣe fa si ifẹ owo, ki ohun ti ẹ ni ki o to nyin; nitori on tikalarẹ ti wipe, Emi kò jẹ fi ọ silẹ, bẹni emi kò jẹ kọ ọ silẹ.
entries.en: Let your conversation be without covetousness; and be content with such things as ye have: for he hath said, I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee.

entries.yo: Nitorina ni awa ṣe nfi igboiya wipe, Oluwa li oluranlọwọ mi, emi kì yio bẹ̀ru; kili enia le ṣe si mi?
entries.en: So that we may boldly say, The Lord is my helper, and I will not fear what man shall do unto me.

entries.yo: Ẹ mã ranti awọn ti nwọn jẹ olori nyin, ti nwọn ti sọ ọ̀rọ Ọlọrun fun nyin; ki ẹ mã ro opin ìwa-aiye wọn, ki ẹ si mã ṣe afarawe igbagbọ́ wọn.
entries.en: Remember them which have the rule over you, who have spoken unto you the word of God: whose faith follow, considering the end of their conversation.

entries.yo: Jesu Kristi ọkanna ni li aná, ati li oni, ati titi lai.
entries.en: Jesus Christ the same yesterday, and to day, and for ever.

entries.yo: Ẹ máṣe jẹ ki a fi onirũru ati ẹkọ́ àjeji gbá nyin kiri. Nitori o dara ki a mu nyin li ọkàn le nipa ore-ọfẹ, kì iṣe nipa onjẹ, ninu eyiti awọn ti o ti nrìn ninu wọn kò li ère.
entries.en: Be not carried about with divers and strange doctrines. For it is a good thing that the heart be established with grace; not with meats, which have not profited them that have been occupied therein.

entries.yo: Awa ni pẹpẹ kan, ninu eyi ti awọn ti nsìn agọ́ kò li agbara lati mã jẹ.
entries.en: We have an altar, whereof they have no right to eat which serve the tabernacle.

entries.yo: Nitoripe ara awọn ẹran wọnni, ẹ̀jẹ eyiti olori alufa mu wá si ibi mimọ́ nitori ẹ̀ṣẹ, a sun wọn lẹhin ibudo.
entries.en: For the bodies of those beasts, whose blood is brought into the sanctuary by the high priest for sin, are burned without the camp.

entries.yo: Nitorina Jesu pẹlu, ki o le fi ẹ̀jẹ ara rẹ̀ sọ awọn enia di mimọ́, o jìya lẹhin bode.
entries.en: Wherefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people with his own blood, suffered without the gate.

entries.yo: Nitorina ẹ jẹ ki a jade tọ̀ ọ lọ lẹhin ibudo, ki a mã rù ẹ̀gan rẹ̀.
entries.en: Let us go forth therefore unto him without the camp, bearing his reproach.

entries.yo: Nitoripe awa kò ni ilu ti o wà titi nihin, ṣugbọn awa nwá eyiti mbọ̀.
entries.en: For here have we no continuing city, but we seek one to come.

entries.yo: Njẹ nipasẹ rẹ̀, ẹ jẹ ki a mã ru ẹbọ iyìn si Ọlọrun nigbagbogbo, eyini ni eso ète wa, ti njẹwọ orukọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: By him therefore let us offer the sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of our lips giving thanks to his name.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ati mã ṣõre on ati mã pinfunni ẹ máṣe gbagbé: nitori irú ẹbọ wọnni ni inu Ọlọrun dùn si jọjọ.
entries.en: But to do good and to communicate forget not: for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.

entries.yo: Ẹ mã gbọ ti awọn ti nṣe olori nyin, ki ẹ si mã tẹriba fun wọn: nitori nwọn nṣọ ẹṣọ nitori ọkàn nyin, bi awọn ti yio ṣe iṣíro, ki nwọn ki o le fi ayọ̀ ṣe eyi, li aisi ibinujẹ, nitori eyiyi yio jẹ ailere fun nyin.
entries.en: Obey them that have the rule over you, and submit yourselves: for they watch for your souls, as they that must give account, that they may do it with joy, and not with grief: for that is unprofitable for you.

entries.yo: Ẹ mã gbadura fun wa: nitori awa gbagbọ pe awa ni ẹri-ọkàn rere, a si nfẹ lati mã wà lododo ninu ohun gbogbo.
entries.en: Pray for us: for we trust we have a good conscience, in all things willing to live honestly.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn emi mbẹ̀ nyin gidigidi si i lati mã ṣe eyi, ki a ba le tète fi mi fun nyin pada.
entries.en: But I beseech you the rather to do this, that I may be restored to you the sooner.

entries.yo: Njẹ Ọlọrun alafia, ẹniti o tun mu oluṣọ-agutan nla ti awọn agutan, ti inu okú wá, nipa ẹ̀jẹ majẹmu aiyeraiye, ani Oluwa wa Jesu,
entries.en: Now the God of peace, that brought again from the dead our Lord Jesus, that great shepherd of the sheep, through the blood of the everlasting covenant,

entries.yo: Ki o mu nyin pé ninu iṣẹ rere gbogbo lati ṣe ifẹ rẹ̀, ki o mã ṣiṣẹ ohun ti iṣe itẹwọgba niwaju rẹ̀ ninu wa nipasẹ Jesu Kristi; ẹniti ogo wà fun lai ati lailai. Amin.
entries.en: Make you perfect in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is wellpleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ; to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

entries.yo: Emi si mbẹ nyin, ará, ẹ gbà ọ̀rọ iyanju mi; nitori iwe kukuru ni mo kọ si nyin.
entries.en: And I beseech you, brethren, suffer the word of exhortation: for I have written a letter unto you in few words.

entries.yo: Ẹ mọ̀ pé a dá Timotiu arakunrin wa silẹ; bi o ba tete de, emi pẹlu rẹ̀ yio ri nyin.
entries.en: Know ye that our brother Timothy is set at liberty; with whom, if he come shortly, I will see you.

entries.yo: Ẹ kí gbogbo awọn ti nṣe olori nyin, ati gbogbo awọn enia mimọ́. Awọn ti o ti Itali wá kí nyin.
entries.en: Salute all them that have the rule over you, and all the saints. They of Italy salute you.

entries.yo: Ki ore-ọfẹ ki o wà pẹlu gbogbo nyin. Amin.
entries.en: Grace be with you all. Amen.

entries.yo: JAKỌBU, iranṣẹ Ọlọrun ati ti Jesu Kristi Oluwa, si awọn ẹ̀ya mejila ti o túka kiri, alafia.
entries.en: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are scattered abroad, greeting.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin ará mi, nigbati ẹnyin ba bọ́ sinu onirũru idanwò, ẹ kà gbogbo rẹ̀ si ayọ;
entries.en: My brethren, count it all joy when ye fall into divers temptations;

entries.yo: Ki ẹ si mọ̀ pe, idanwò igbagbọ́ nyin nṣiṣẹ sũru.
entries.en: Knowing this, that the trying of your faith worketh patience.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹ jẹ ki sũru ki o ṣe iṣẹ aṣepé, ki ẹnyin ki o le jẹ pipe ati ailabuku, ki o má kù ohun kan fun ẹnikẹni.
entries.en: But let patience have her perfect work, that ye may be perfect and entire, wanting nothing.

entries.yo: Bi o ba kù ọgbọn fun ẹnikẹni, ki o bère lọwọ Ọlọrun, ẹniti ifi fun gbogbo enia ni ọ̀pọlọpọ, ti kì isi ibaniwi; a o si fifun u.
entries.en: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ki o bère ni igbagbọ́, li aiṣiyemeji rara. Nitori ẹniti o nṣiyemeji dabi ìgbi omi okun, ti nti ọwọ́ afẹfẹ bì siwa bì sẹhin ti a si nrú soke.
entries.en: But let him ask in faith, nothing wavering. For he that wavereth is like a wave of the sea driven with the wind and tossed.

entries.yo: Nitori ki iru enia bẹ̃ máṣe rò pe, on yio ri ohunkohun gbà lọwọ Oluwa;
entries.en: For let not that man think that he shall receive any thing of the Lord.

entries.yo: Enia oniyemeji jẹ alaiduro ni ọ̀na rẹ̀ gbogbo.
entries.en: A double minded man is unstable in all his ways.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn jẹ ki arakunrin ti iṣe talaka mã ṣogo ni ipo giga rẹ̀.
entries.en: Let the brother of low degree rejoice in that he is exalted:

entries.yo: Ati ọlọrọ̀, ni irẹ̀silẹ rẹ̀, nitori bi itanná koriko ni yio kọja lọ.
entries.en: But the rich, in that he is made low: because as the flower of the grass he shall pass away.

entries.yo: Nitori õrun là ti on ti õru mimu, o si gbẹ koriko, itanná rẹ̀ si rẹ̀ danu, ẹwà oju rẹ̀ si parun: bẹ̃ pẹlu li ọlọrọ̀ yio ṣegbe ni ọ̀na rẹ̀.
entries.en: For the sun is no sooner risen with a burning heat, but it withereth the grass, and the flower thereof falleth, and the grace of the fashion of it perisheth: so also shall the rich man fade away in his ways.

entries.yo: Ibukún ni fun ọkunrin ti o fi ọkàn rán idanwò: nitori nigbati o ba yege, yio gbà ade ìye, ti Oluwa ti ṣe ileri fun awọn ti o fẹ ẹ.
entries.en: Blessed is the man that endureth temptation: for when he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life, which the Lord hath promised to them that love him.

entries.yo: Ki ẹnikẹni ti a danwò máṣe wipe, Lati ọwọ́ Ọlọrun li a ti dán mi wò: nitori a kò le fi buburu dán Ọlọrun wò, on na kì isi idán ẹnikẹni wò:
entries.en: Let no man say when he is tempted, I am tempted of God: for God cannot be tempted with evil, neither tempteth he any man:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn olukuluku ni a ndanwò, nigbati a ba ti ọwọ́ ifẹkufẹ ara rẹ̀ fà a lọ ti a si tàn a jẹ.
entries.en: But every man is tempted, when he is drawn away of his own lust, and enticed.

entries.yo: Njẹ, ifẹkufẹ na nigbati o ba lóyun, a bí ẹ̀ṣẹ: ati ẹ̀ṣẹ na nigbati o ba si dagba tan, a bí ikú.
entries.en: Then when lust hath conceived, it bringeth forth sin: and sin, when it is finished, bringeth forth death.

entries.yo: Ki a má ṣe tan nyin jẹ, ẹnyin ará mi olufẹ.
entries.en: Do not err, my beloved brethren.

entries.yo: Gbogbo ẹ̀bun rere ati gbogbo ẹ̀bun pipé lati oke li o ti wá, o si nsọkalẹ lati ọdọ Baba imọlẹ wá, lọdọ Ẹniti kò le si iyipada tabi ojiji àyida.
entries.en: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and cometh down from the Father of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning.

entries.yo: Nipa ifẹ ara rẹ̀ li o fi ọ̀rọ otitọ bí wa, ki awa ki o le jẹ bi akọso awọn ẹda rẹ̀.
entries.en: Of his own will begat he us with the word of truth, that we should be a kind of firstfruits of his creatures.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin mọ eyi, ẹnyin ará mi olufẹ; ṣugbọn jẹ ki olukuluku enia ki o mã yara lati gbọ́, ki o lọra lati fọhùn, ki o lọra lati binu:
entries.en: Wherefore, my beloved brethren, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath:

entries.yo: Nitori ibinu enia kì iṣiṣẹ ododo Ọlọrun.
entries.en: For the wrath of man worketh not the righteousness of God.

entries.yo: Nitorina ẹ fi gbogbo ẽri ati buburu aṣeleke lelẹ li apakan, ki ẹ si fi ọkàn tutù gbà ọ̀rọ na ti a gbin, ti o le gbà ọkàn nyin là.
entries.en: Wherefore lay apart all filthiness and superfluity of naughtiness, and receive with meekness the engrafted word, which is able to save your souls.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ki ẹ jẹ oluṣe ọ̀rọ na, ki o má si ṣe olugbọ́ nikan, ki ẹ mã tàn ara nyin jẹ.
entries.en: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.

entries.yo: Nitori bi ẹnikan ba jẹ olugbọ́ ọ̀rọ na, ti kò si jẹ oluṣe, on dabi ọkunrin ti o nṣakiyesi oju ara rẹ̀ ninu awojiji:
entries.en: For if any be a hearer of the word, and not a doer, he is like unto a man beholding his natural face in a glass:

entries.yo: Nitori o ṣakiyesi ara rẹ̀, o si ba tirẹ̀ lọ, lojukanna o si gbagbé bi on ti ri.
entries.en: For he beholdeth himself, and goeth his way, and straightway forgetteth what manner of man he was.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹniti o ba nwo inu ofin pipé, ofin omnira nì, ti o si duro ninu rẹ̀, ti on kò jẹ olugbọ́ ti ngbagbé, bikoṣe oluṣe iṣẹ, oluwarẹ̀ yio jẹ alabukun ninu iṣẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: But whoso looketh into the perfect law of liberty, and continueth therein, he being not a forgetful hearer, but a doer of the work, this man shall be blessed in his deed.

entries.yo: Bi ẹnikẹni ba ro pe on nsìn Ọlọrun nigbati kò kó ahọn rẹ̀ ni ijanu, ṣugbọn ti o ntàn ọkàn ara rẹ̀ jẹ, ìsin oluwarẹ̀ asan ni.
entries.en: If any man among you seem to be religious, and bridleth not his tongue, but deceiveth his own heart, this man's religion is vain.

entries.yo: Ìsin mimọ́ ati ailẽri niwaju Ọlọrun ati Baba li eyi, lati mã bojutó awọn alainibaba ati awọn opó ninu ipọnju wọn, ati lati pa ara rẹ̀ mọ́ lailabawọn kuro li aiyé.
entries.en: Pure religion and undefiled before God and the Father is this, To visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep himself unspotted from the world.

entries.yo: ẸNYIN ará mi, ẹ máṣe fi iṣãju enia dì igbagbọ́ Oluwa wa Jesu Kristi Oluwa ogo mu.
entries.en: My brethren, have not the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Lord of glory, with respect of persons.

entries.yo: Nitori bi ọkunrin kan ba wá si ajọ nyin, pẹlu oruka wura, ati aṣọ daradara, ti talakà kan si wá pẹlu li aṣọ ẽri;
entries.en: For if there come unto your assembly a man with a gold ring, in goodly apparel, and there come in also a poor man in vile raiment;

entries.yo: Ti ẹnyin si bu iyìn fun ẹniti o wọ̀ aṣọ daradara, ti ẹ si wipe, Iwọ joko nihinyi ni ibi daradara; ti ẹ si wi fun talakà na pe, Iwọ duro nibẹ̀, tabi joko nihin labẹ apoti itisẹ mi:
entries.en: And ye have respect to him that weareth the gay clothing, and say unto him, Sit thou here in a good place; and say to the poor, Stand thou there, or sit here under my footstool:

entries.yo: Ẹnyin kò ha nda ara nyin si meji ninu ara nyin, ẹ kò ha si di onidajọ ti o ni ero buburu?
entries.en: Are ye not then partial in yourselves, and are become judges of evil thoughts?

entries.yo: Ẹ fi etí silẹ, ẹnyin ará mi olufẹ, Ọlọrun kò ha ti yàn awọn talakà aiye yi ṣe ọlọrọ̀ ni igbagbọ́, ati ajogun ijọba na, ti o ti ṣe ileri fun awọn ti o fẹ ẹ?
entries.en: Hearken, my beloved brethren, Hath not God chosen the poor of this world rich in faith, and heirs of the kingdom which he hath promised to them that love him?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹnyin ti bù talakà kù. Awọn ọlọrọ̀ kò ha npọ́n nyin loju, nwọn kò ha si nwọ́ nyin lọ si ile ẹjọ?
entries.en: But ye have despised the poor. Do not rich men oppress you, and draw you before the judgment seats?

entries.yo: Nwọn kò ha nsọ ọrọ-odi si orukọ rere nì ti a fi npè nyin?
entries.en: Do not they blaspheme that worthy name by the which ye are called?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi ẹnyin ba nmu olú ofin nì ṣẹ gẹgẹ bi iwe-mimọ́, eyini ni, Iwọ fẹ ẹnikeji rẹ bi ara rẹ, ẹnyin nṣe daradara.
entries.en: If ye fulfil the royal law according to the scripture, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself, ye do well:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi ẹnyin ba nṣe ojuṣãju enia, ẹnyin ndẹ̀ṣẹ, a si nda nyin lẹbi nipa ofin bi arufin.
entries.en: But if ye have respect to persons, ye commit sin, and are convinced of the law as transgressors.

entries.yo: Nitori ẹnikẹni ti o ba pa gbogbo ofin mọ́, ti o si rú ọ̀kan, o jẹbi gbogbo rẹ̀.
entries.en: For whosoever shall keep the whole law, and yet offend in one point, he is guilty of all.

entries.yo: Nitori ẹniti o wipe, Máṣe ṣe panṣaga, on li o si wipe, Máṣe pania. Njẹ bi iwọ kò ṣe panṣaga, ṣugbọn ti iwọ pania, iwọ di arufin.
entries.en: For he that said, Do not commit adultery, said also, Do not kill. Now if thou commit no adultery, yet if thou kill, thou art become a transgressor of the law.

entries.yo: Ẹ mã sọrọ bẹ̃, ẹ si mã huwa bẹ̃, bi awọn ti a o fi ofin omnira dá li ẹjọ.
entries.en: So speak ye, and so do, as they that shall be judged by the law of liberty.

entries.yo: Nitori ẹniti kò ṣãnu, li a o ṣe idajọ fun laisi ãnu; ãnu nṣogo lori idajọ.
entries.en: For he shall have judgment without mercy, that hath shewed no mercy; and mercy rejoiceth against judgment.

entries.yo: Ere kili o jẹ, ará mi, bi ẹnikan wipe on ni igbagbọ́, ṣugbọn ti kò ni iṣẹ? igbagbọ́ nì le gbà a là bi?
entries.en: What doth it profit, my brethren, though a man say he hath faith, and have not works? can faith save him?

entries.yo: Bi arakunrin tabi arabinrin kan ba wà ni ìhoho, ti o si ṣe aili onjẹ õjọ,
entries.en: If a brother or sister be naked, and destitute of daily food,

entries.yo: Ti ẹnikan ninu nyin si wi fun wọn pe, Ẹ mã lọ li alafia, ki ara nyin ki o maṣe tutu, ki ẹ si yó; ṣugbọn ẹ kò fi nkan wọnni ti ara nfẹ fun wọn; ère kili o jẹ?
entries.en: And one of you say unto them, Depart in peace, be ye warmed and filled; notwithstanding ye give them not those things which are needful to the body; what doth it profit?

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ si ni igbagbọ́, bi kò ba ni iṣẹ, o kú ninu ara.
entries.en: Even so faith, if it hath not works, is dead, being alone.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹnikan le wipe, Iwọ ni igbagbọ́, emi si ni iṣẹ: fi igbagbọ́ rẹ hàn mi li aisi iṣẹ, emi o si fi igbagbọ́ mi hàn ọ nipa iṣẹ mi.
entries.en: Yea, a man may say, Thou hast faith, and I have works: shew me thy faith without thy works, and I will shew thee my faith by my works.

entries.yo: Iwọ gbagbọ́ pe Ọlọrun kan ni mbẹ; o dara: awọn ẹmí èṣu pẹlu gbagbọ́, nwọn si warìri.
entries.en: Thou believest that there is one God; thou doest well: the devils also believe, and tremble.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn, iwọ alaimoye enia, iwọ ha fẹ mọ̀ pe, igbagbọ́ li aisi iṣẹ asan ni?
entries.en: But wilt thou know, O vain man, that faith without works is dead?

entries.yo: Kì ha iṣe nipa iṣẹ li a dá Abrahamu baba wa lare, nigbati o fi Isaaki ọmọ rẹ̀ rubọ lori pẹpẹ?
entries.en: Was not Abraham our father justified by works, when he had offered Isaac his son upon the altar?

entries.yo: Iwọ ri pe igbagbọ́ bá iṣẹ rẹ̀ rìn, ati pe nipa iṣẹ li a sọ igbagbọ́ di pipé.
entries.en: Seest thou how faith wrought with his works, and by works was faith made perfect?

entries.yo: Iwe-mimọ́ si ṣẹ ti o wipe, Abrahamu gbà Ọlọrun gbọ́, a si kà a si ododo fun u: a si pè e li ọ̀rẹ́ Ọlọrun.
entries.en: And the scripture was fulfilled which saith, Abraham believed God, and it was imputed unto him for righteousness: and he was called the Friend of God.

entries.yo: Njẹ ẹnyin ri pe nipa iṣẹ li a ndá enia lare, kì iṣe nipa igbagbọ́ nikan.
entries.en: Ye see then how that by works a man is justified, and not by faith only.

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bẹ̃ pẹlu kí a ha dá Rahabu panṣaga lare nipa iṣẹ, nigbati o gbà awọn onṣẹ, ti o si rán wọn jade gba ọ̀na miran?
entries.en: Likewise also was not Rahab the harlot justified by works, when she had received the messengers, and had sent them out another way?

entries.yo: Nitori bi ara li aisi ẹmí ti jẹ́ okú, bẹ̃ gẹgẹ pẹlu ni igbagbọ́ li aisi iṣẹ jẹ́ okú.
entries.en: For as the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without works is dead also.

entries.yo: ẸNYIN ará mi, ẹ máṣe jẹ olukọni pipọ, ki ẹnyin ki o mọ̀ pe awa ni yio jẹbi ju.
entries.en: My brethren, be not many masters, knowing that we shall receive the greater condemnation.

entries.yo: Nitori ninu ohun pipọ ni gbogbo wa nṣì i ṣe. Bi ẹnikan kò ba ṣì i ṣe ninu ọ̀rọ, on na li ẹni pipé, on li o si le kó gbogbo ara ni ijanu.
entries.en: For in many things we offend all. If any man offend not in word, the same is a perfect man, and able also to bridle the whole body.

entries.yo: Bi a bá si fi ijanu bọ̀ ẹṣin li ẹnu, ki nwọn ki o le gbọ́ ti wa, gbogbo ara wọn li awa si nyi kiri pẹlu.
entries.en: Behold, we put bits in the horses' mouths, that they may obey us; and we turn about their whole body.

entries.yo: Kiyesi awọn ọkọ̀ pẹlu, bi nwọn ti tobi to nì, ti a si nti ọwọ ẹfũfu lile gbá kiri, itọkọ̀ kekere li a fi ndari wọn kiri, sibikibi ti o bá wù ẹniti ntọ́ ọkọ̀.
entries.en: Behold also the ships, which though they be so great, and are driven of fierce winds, yet are they turned about with a very small helm, whithersoever the governor listeth.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ pẹlu li ahọn jẹ ẹ̀ya kekere, o si nfọnnu ohun nla. Wo igi nla ti iná kekere nsun jóna!
entries.en: Even so the tongue is a little member, and boasteth great things. Behold, how great a matter a little fire kindleth!

entries.yo: Iná si ni ahọ́n, aiye ẹ̀ṣẹ si ni: li arin awọn ẹ̀ya ara wa, li ahọn ti mba gbogbo ara jẹ́ ti o si ntinabọ ipa aiye wa; ọrun apãdi si ntinabọ on na.
entries.en: And the tongue is a fire, a world of iniquity: so is the tongue among our members, that it defileth the whole body, and setteth on fire the course of nature; and it is set on fire of hell.

entries.yo: Nitori olukuluku ẹda ẹranko, ati ti ẹiyẹ, ati ti ejò, ati ti ohun ti mbẹ li okun, li a ntù loju, ti a si ti tù loju lati ọwọ ẹda enia wá.
entries.en: For every kind of beasts, and of birds, and of serpents, and of things in the sea, is tamed, and hath been tamed of mankind:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ahọn li ẹnikẹni kò le tù loju; ohun buburu alaigbọran ni, o kún fun oró iku ti ipa-ni.
entries.en: But the tongue can no man tame; it is an unruly evil, full of deadly poison.

entries.yo: On li awa fi nyìn Oluwa ati Baba, on li a si fi mbú enia, ti a dá li aworan Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Therewith bless we God, even the Father; and therewith curse we men, which are made after the similitude of God.

entries.yo: Lati ẹnu kanna ni iyìn ati ẽbú ti njade. Ẹnyin ará mi, nkan wọnyi kò yẹ ki o ri bẹ̃.
entries.en: Out of the same mouth proceedeth blessing and cursing. My brethren, these things ought not so to be.

entries.yo: Orisun a ha mã sun omi tutù ati omiró jade lati ojusun kanna wá bi?
