entries.en: Doth a fountain send forth at the same place sweet water and bitter?

entries.yo: Ẹnyin ará mi, igi ọpọtọ ha le so eso olifi bi? tabi ajara le so eso ọpọtọ? bẹ̃li orisun kan kò le sun omiró ati omi tutù.
entries.en: Can the fig tree, my brethren, bear olive berries? either a vine, figs? so can no fountain both yield salt water and fresh.

entries.yo: Tali o gbọ́n ti o si ni imọ̀ ninu nyin? ẹ jẹ ki o fi iṣẹ rẹ̀ hàn nipa ìwa rere, nipa ìwa tutù ti ọgbọn.
entries.en: Who is a wise man and endued with knowledge among you? let him shew out of a good conversation his works with meekness of wisdom.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi ẹnyin ba ni owú kikorò ati ìja li ọkàn nyin, ẹ máṣe ṣeféfe, ẹ má si ṣeke si otitọ.
entries.en: But if ye have bitter envying and strife in your hearts, glory not, and lie not against the truth.

entries.yo: Ọgbọ́n yi ki iṣe eyiti o ti oke sọkalẹ wá, ṣugbọn ti aiye ni, ti ara ni, ti ẹmí èṣu ni.
entries.en: This wisdom descendeth not from above, but is earthly, sensual, devilish.

entries.yo: Nitori ibiti owú on ìja bá gbé wà, nibẹ̀ ni rudurudu ati iṣẹ buburu gbogbo wà.
entries.en: For where envying and strife is, there is confusion and every evil work.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ọgbọ́n ti o ti oke wá, a kọ́ mọ́, a si ni alafia, a ni ipamọra, kì isí iṣoro lati bẹ̀, a kún fun ãnu ati fun eso rere, li aisi ègbè, ati laisi agabagebe.
entries.en: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceable, gentle, and easy to be intreated, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.

entries.yo: Eso ododo li a ngbìn li alafia fun awọn ti nṣiṣẹ alafia.
entries.en: And the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace of them that make peace.

entries.yo: NIBO ni ogun ti wá, nibo ni ija si ti wá larin nyin? lati inu eyi ha kọ? lati inu ifẹkufẹ ara nyin, ti njagun ninu awọn ẹ̀ya-ara nyin?
entries.en: From whence come wars and fightings among you? come they not hence, even of your lusts that war in your members?

entries.yo: Ẹnyin nfẹ, ẹ kò si ni: ẹnyin npa, ẹ si nṣe ilara, ẹ kò si le ni: ẹnyin njà, ẹnyin si njagun; ẹ ko ni, nitoriti ẹnyin kò bère.
entries.en: Ye lust, and have not: ye kill, and desire to have, and cannot obtain: ye fight and war, yet ye have not, because ye ask not.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin bère, ẹ kò si ri gbà, nitoriti ẹnyin ṣì i bère, ki ẹnyin ki o le lò o fun ifẹkufẹ ara nyin.
entries.en: Ye ask, and receive not, because ye ask amiss, that ye may consume it upon your lusts.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin panṣaga ọkunrin, ati panṣaga obinrin, ẹ kò mọ̀ pe ìbarẹ́ aiye ìṣọtá Ọlọrun ni? nitorina ẹnikẹni ti o ba fẹ lati jẹ́ ọrẹ aiye di ọtá Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Ye adulterers and adulteresses, know ye not that the friendship of the world is enmity with God? whosoever therefore will be a friend of the world is the enemy of God.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin ṣebi iwe-mimọ́ sọ lasan pe, Ẹmí ti o fi sinu wa njowu gidigidi lori wa?
entries.en: Do ye think that the scripture saith in vain, The spirit that dwelleth in us lusteth to envy?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn o nfunni li ore-ọfẹ si i. Nitorina li o ṣe wipe, Ọlọrun kọ oju ija si awọn agberaga, ṣugbọn o fi ore-ọfẹ fun awọn onirẹlẹ ọkàn.
entries.en: But he giveth more grace. Wherefore he saith, God resisteth the proud, but giveth grace unto the humble.

entries.yo: Nitorina ẹ tẹriba fun Ọlọrun. Ẹ kọ oju ija si Èṣu, on ó si sá kuro lọdọ nyin.
entries.en: Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

entries.yo: Ẹ sunmọ Ọlọrun, on o si sunmọ nyin, Ẹ wẹ̀ ọwọ́ nyin mọ́, ẹnyin ẹlẹṣẹ; ẹ si ṣe ọkàn nyin ni mimọ́, ẹnyin oniye meji.
entries.en: Draw nigh to God, and he will draw nigh to you. Cleanse your hands, ye sinners; and purify your hearts, ye double minded.

entries.yo: Ki inu nyin ki o bajẹ, ki ẹ si gbàwẹ, ki ẹ si mã sọkun: ẹ jẹ ki ẹrín nyin ki o di àwẹ, ati ayọ̀ nyin ki o di ikãnu.
entries.en: Be afflicted, and mourn, and weep: let your laughter be turned to mourning, and your joy to heaviness.

entries.yo: Ẹ rẹ̀ ara nyin silẹ niwaju Oluwa, on o si gbé nyin ga.
entries.en: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he shall lift you up.

entries.yo: Ará, ẹ máṣe sọ̀rọ ibi si ara nyin. Ẹniti o ba nsọ̀rọ ibi si arakunrin rẹ̀, ti o si ndá arakunrin rẹ̀ lẹjọ, o nsọ̀rọ ibi si ofin, o si ndá ofin lẹjọ; ṣugbọn bi iwọ ba ndá ofin lẹjọ, iwọ kì iṣe oluṣe ofin, bikoṣe onidajọ.
entries.en: Speak not evil one of another, brethren. He that speaketh evil of his brother, and judgeth his brother, speaketh evil of the law, and judgeth the law: but if thou judge the law, thou art not a doer of the law, but a judge.

entries.yo: Olofin ati onidajọ kanṣoṣo ni mbẹ, ani ẹniti ó le gbala ti o si le parun; ṣugbọn tani iwọ ti ndá ẹnikeji rẹ lẹjọ?
entries.en: There is one lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy: who art thou that judgest another?

entries.yo: Ẹ wá nisisiyi, ẹnyin tí nwipe, Loni tabi lọla awa ó lọ si ilu bayi, a o si ṣe ọdún kan nibẹ, a o si ṣòwo, a o si jère:
entries.en: Go to now, ye that say, To day or to morrow we will go into such a city, and continue there a year, and buy and sell, and get gain:

entries.yo: Nigbati ẹnyin kò mọ̀ ohun ti yio hù lọla. Kili ẹmí nyin? Ikũku sá ni nyin, ti o hàn nigba diẹ, lẹhinna a si túka lọ.
entries.en: Whereas ye know not what shall be on the morrow. For what is your life? It is even a vapour, that appeareth for a little time, and then vanisheth away.

entries.yo: Eyi ti ẹ bá fi wipe, bi Oluwa ba fẹ, awa o wà lãye, a o si ṣe eyi tabi eyini.
entries.en: For that ye ought to say, If the Lord will, we shall live, and do this, or that.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn nisisiyi ẹnyin nṣeféfe ninu ifọnnu nyin: gbogbo irú iṣeféfe bẹ̃, ibi ni.
entries.en: But now ye rejoice in your boastings: all such rejoicing is evil.

entries.yo: Nitorina ẹniti o ba mọ̀ rere iṣe ti kò si ṣe, ẹ̀ṣẹ ni fun u.
entries.en: Therefore to him that knoweth to do good, and doeth it not, to him it is sin.

entries.yo: Ẹ wá nisisiyi, ẹnyin ọlọrọ̀, ẹ mã sọkun ki ẹ si mã pohunréré ẹkun nitori òṣi ti mbọ̀wá ta nyin.
entries.en: Go to now, ye rich men, weep and howl for your miseries that shall come upon you.

entries.yo: Ọrọ̀ nyin dibajẹ, kòkoro si ti jẹ̀ aṣọ nyin.
entries.en: Your riches are corrupted, and your garments are motheaten.

entries.yo: Wura on fadaka nyin diparà; iparà wọn ni yio si ṣe ẹlẹri si nyin, ti yio si jẹ ẹran ara nyin bi iná. Ẹnyin ti kó iṣura jọ dè ọjọ ikẹhin.
entries.en: Your gold and silver is cankered; and the rust of them shall be a witness against you, and shall eat your flesh as it were fire. Ye have heaped treasure together for the last days.

entries.yo: Kiyesi i, ọ̀ya awọn alagbaṣe ti nwọn ti ṣe ikore oko nyin, eyiti ẹ kò san, nke rara; ati igbe awọn ti o ṣe ikore si ti wọ inu eti Oluwa awọn ọmọ-ogun.
entries.en: Behold, the hire of the labourers who have reaped down your fields, which is of you kept back by fraud, crieth: and the cries of them which have reaped are entered into the ears of the Lord of sabaoth.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin ti jẹ adùn li aiye, ẹnyin si ti fi ara nyin fun aiye jijẹ; ẹnyin ti bọ́ li ọjọ pipa.
entries.en: Ye have lived in pleasure on the earth, and been wanton; ye have nourished your hearts, as in a day of slaughter.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin ti da ẹbi fun olododo, ẹ si ti pa a; on kò kọ oju ija si nyin.
entries.en: Ye have condemned and killed the just; and he doth not resist you.

entries.yo: Nitorina ará, ẹ mu sũru titi di ipadawa Oluwa. Kiyesi i, àgbẹ a mã reti eso iyebiye ti ilẹ, a si mu sũru de e, titi di igbà akọrọ̀ ati arọ̀kuro òjo.
entries.en: Be patient therefore, brethren, unto the coming of the Lord. Behold, the husbandman waiteth for the precious fruit of the earth, and hath long patience for it, until he receive the early and latter rain.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin pẹlu ẹ mu sũru; ẹ fi ọkàn nyin balẹ̀: nitori ipadawa Oluwa kù si dẹdẹ.
entries.en: Be ye also patient; stablish your hearts: for the coming of the Lord draweth nigh.

entries.yo: Ẹ máṣe kùn si ọmọnikeji nyin, ará, ki a má bã dá nyin lẹbi: kiyesi i, onidajọ duro li ẹnu ilẹkun.
entries.en: Grudge not one against another, brethren, lest ye be condemned: behold, the judge standeth before the door.

entries.yo: Ará mi, ẹ fi awọn woli ti o ti nsọ̀rọ li orukọ Oluwa ṣe apẹrẹ ìya jijẹ, ati sũru.
entries.en: Take, my brethren, the prophets, who have spoken in the name of the Lord, for an example of suffering affliction, and of patience.

entries.yo: Sawò o, awa a mã kà awọn ti o farada ìya si ẹni ibukún. Ẹnyin ti gbọ́ ti sũru Jobu, ẹnyin si ri igbẹhin ti Oluwa ṣe; pe Oluwa kún fun iyọ́nu, o si ni ãnu.
entries.en: Behold, we count them happy which endure. Ye have heard of the patience of Job, and have seen the end of the Lord; that the Lord is very pitiful, and of tender mercy.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn jù ohun gbogbo lọ, ará mi, ẹ máṣe búra, iba ṣe ifi ọrun búra, tabi ilẹ, tabi ibura-kibura miran: ṣugbọn jẹ ki bẹ̃ni nyin jẹ bẹ̃ni; ati bẹ̃kọ nyin jẹ bẹ̃kọ; ki ẹ má bã bọ́ sinu ẹbi.
entries.en: But above all things, my brethren, swear not, neither by heaven, neither by the earth, neither by any other oath: but let your yea be yea; and your nay, nay; lest ye fall into condemnation.

entries.yo: Inu ẹnikẹni ha bajẹ ninu nyin bi? jẹ ki o gbadura. Inu ẹnikẹni ha dùn? jẹ ki o kọrin mimọ́.
entries.en: Is any among you afflicted? let him pray. Is any merry? let him sing psalms.

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni ṣe aisan ninu nyin bi? ki o pè awọn àgba ijọ, ki nwọn si gbadura sori rẹ̀, ki nwọn fi oróro kùn u li orukọ Oluwa:
entries.en: Is any sick among you? let him call for the elders of the church; and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord:

entries.yo: Adura igbagbọ́ yio si gbà alaisan na là, Oluwa yio si gbé e dide; bi o ba si ṣe pe o ti dẹ̀ṣẹ, a o dari jì i.
entries.en: And the prayer of faith shall save the sick, and the Lord shall raise him up; and if he have committed sins, they shall be forgiven him.

entries.yo: Ẹ jẹwọ ẹ̀ṣẹ nyin fun ara nyin, ki ẹ si mã gbadura fun ara nyin, ki a le mu nyin larada. Iṣẹ ti adura olododo nṣe li agbara pupọ.
entries.en: Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much.

entries.yo: Enia oniru ìwa bi awa ni Elijah, o gbadura gidigidi pe ki ojo ki o máṣe rọ̀, ojo kò si rọ̀ sori ilẹ fun ọdún mẹta on oṣù mẹfa.
entries.en: Elias was a man subject to like passions as we are, and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain: and it rained not on the earth by the space of three years and six months.

entries.yo: O si tún gbadura, ọrun si tún rọ̀jo, ilẹ si so eso rẹ̀ jade.
entries.en: And he prayed again, and the heaven gave rain, and the earth brought forth her fruit.

entries.yo: Ará, bi ẹnikẹni ninu nyin ba ṣìna kuro ninu otitọ, ti ẹnikan si yi i pada;
entries.en: Brethren, if any of you do err from the truth, and one convert him;

entries.yo: Jẹ ki o mọ̀ pe, ẹniti o ba yi ẹlẹṣẹ kan pada kuro ninu ìṣina rẹ̀, yio gbà ọkàn kan là kuro lọwọ ikú, yio si bò ọ̀pọlọpọ ẹ̀ṣẹ mọlẹ.
entries.en: Let him know, that he which converteth the sinner from the error of his way shall save a soul from death, and shall hide a multitude of sins.

entries.yo: PETERU, Aposteli Jesu Kristi, si awọn ayanfẹ ti nṣe atipo ti nwọn tuka kiri si Pontu, Galatia, Kappadokia, Asia, ati Bitinia,
entries.en: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the strangers scattered throughout Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi ìmọtẹlẹ Ọlọrun Baba, nipa isọdimimọ́ Ẹmí, si igbọran ati ibuwọ́n ẹ̀jẹ Jesu Kristi: Ki ore-ọfẹ ati alafia ki o mã bi si i fun nyin.
entries.en: Elect according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, through sanctification of the Spirit, unto obedience and sprinkling of the blood of Jesus Christ: Grace unto you, and peace, be multiplied.

entries.yo: Olubukún li Ọlọrun ati Baba Jesu Kristi Oluwa wa, Ẹniti o tún wa bí, gẹgẹ bi ọ̀pọlọpọ ãnu rẹ̀, sinu ireti ãye nipa ajinde Jesu Kristi kuro ninu okú,
entries.en: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which according to his abundant mercy hath begotten us again unto a lively hope by the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,

entries.yo: Sinu ogún aidibajẹ, ati ailabawọn, ati eyi ti kì iṣá, ti a ti fi pamọ́ li ọrun dè nyin,
entries.en: To an inheritance incorruptible, and undefiled, and that fadeth not away, reserved in heaven for you,

entries.yo: Ẹnyin ti a npamọ́ nipa agbara Ọlọrun nipa igbagbọ́ si igbala, ti a mura lati fihàn ni igba ikẹhin.
entries.en: Who are kept by the power of God through faith unto salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.

entries.yo: Ninu eyiti ẹnyin nyọ̀ pipọ, bi o tilẹ ṣe pe nisisiyi fun igba diẹ, niwọnbi o ti yẹ, a ti fi ọ̀pọlọpọ idanwo bà nyin ninu jẹ:
entries.en: Wherein ye greatly rejoice, though now for a season, if need be, ye are in heaviness through manifold temptations:

entries.yo: Ki idanwò igbagbọ́ nyin, ti o ni iye lori jù wura ti iṣegbe lọ, bi o tilẹ ṣe pe iná li a fi ndán a wò, ki a le ri i fun iyìn, ati ọlá, ati ninu ogo ni igba ifarahàn Jesu Kristi:
entries.en: That the trial of your faith, being much more precious than of gold that perisheth, though it be tried with fire, might be found unto praise and honour and glory at the appearing of Jesus Christ:

entries.yo: Ẹniti ẹnyin fẹ lairi, ẹniti ẹnyin gbagbọ, bi o tilẹ ṣepe ẹ kò ri i nisisiyi, ẹnyin si nyọ ayọ̀ ti a kò le fi ẹnu ṣo, ti o si kun fun ogo:
entries.en: Whom having not seen, ye love; in whom, though now ye see him not, yet believing, ye rejoice with joy unspeakable and full of glory:

entries.yo: Ẹnyin si ngbà opin igbagbọ́ nyin, ani igbala ọkàn nyin;
entries.en: Receiving the end of your faith, even the salvation of your souls.

entries.yo: Igbala ti awọn woli wadi, ti nwọn si wá jinlẹ, awọn ti nwọn sọ asọtẹlẹ ti ore-ọfẹ ti mbọ̀ fun nyin:
entries.en: Of which salvation the prophets have inquired and searched diligently, who prophesied of the grace that should come unto you:

entries.yo: Nwọn nwadi igba wo tabi irú sã wo ni Ẹmi Kristi ti o wà ninu wọn ntọ́ka si, nigbati o jẹri ìya Kristi tẹlẹ ati ogo ti yio tẹlé e.
entries.en: Searching what, or what manner of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them did signify, when it testified beforehand the sufferings of Christ, and the glory that should follow.

entries.yo: Awọn ẹniti a fihàn fun, pe kì iṣe fun awọn tikarawọn, bikoṣe fun awa ni nwọn ṣe iranṣẹ ohun wọnni, ti a ròhin fun nyin nisisiyi, lati ọdọ awọn ti o ti nwãsu ihinrere fun nyin pẹlu Ẹmí Mimọ́ ti a rán lati ọrun wá; ohun ti awọn angẹli nfẹ lati wò.
entries.en: Unto whom it was revealed, that not unto themselves, but unto us they did minister the things, which are now reported unto you by them that have preached the gospel unto you with the Holy Ghost sent down from heaven; which things the angels desire to look into.

entries.yo: Nitorina ẹ di ọkàn nyin li amure, ẹ mã wa li airekọja, ki ẹ si mã reti ore-ọfẹ nì titi de opin, eyiti a nmu bọ̀ fun nyin wá ni igba ifarahàn Jesu Kristi:
entries.en: Wherefore gird up the loins of your mind, be sober, and hope to the end for the grace that is to be brought unto you at the revelation of Jesus Christ;

entries.yo: Bi awọn eleti ọmọ, li aifi ara nyin dáṣà bi ifẹkufẹ atijọ ninu aimọ̀ nyin:
entries.en: As obedient children, not fashioning yourselves according to the former lusts in your ignorance:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn gẹgẹ bi Ẹni ti o pè nyin ti jẹ mimọ́, bẹ̃ni ki ẹnyin na si jẹ mimọ́ ninu ìwa nyin gbogbo:
entries.en: But as he which hath called you is holy, so be ye holy in all manner of conversation;

entries.yo: Nitori a ti kọ ọ pe, Ẹ jẹ mimọ́; nitoriti mo jẹ mimọ́.
entries.en: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.

entries.yo: Bi ẹnyin ba si nkepè Baba, ẹniti nṣe idajọ gẹgẹ bi iṣẹ olukuluku, li aiṣe ojuṣaju enia, ẹ mã lo igba atipo nyin ni ìbẹru:
entries.en: And if ye call on the Father, who without respect of persons judgeth according to every man's work, pass the time of your sojourning here in fear:

entries.yo: Niwọnbi ẹnyin ti mọ̀ pe, a kò fi ohun ti idibajẹ rà nyin pada, bi fadaka tabi wura, kuro ninu ìwa asan nyin, ti ẹnyin ti jogun lati ọdọ awọn baba nyin,
entries.en: Forasmuch as ye know that ye were not redeemed with corruptible things, as silver and gold, from your vain conversation received by tradition from your fathers;

entries.yo: Bikoṣe ẹ̀jẹ iyebiye, bi ti ọdọ-agutan ti kò li abuku, ti kò si li abawọn, ani ẹ̀jẹ Kristi;
entries.en: But with the precious blood of Christ, as of a lamb without blemish and without spot:

entries.yo: Ẹniti a ti mọ̀ tẹlẹ nitõtọ ṣaju ipilẹṣẹ aiye, ṣugbọn ti a fihan ni igba ikẹhin wọnyi nitori nyin,
entries.en: Who verily was foreordained before the foundation of the world, but was manifest in these last times for you,

entries.yo: Ani ẹnyin ti o ti ipasẹ rẹ̀ gbà Ọlọrun gbọ́, ẹniti o jí i dide kuro ninu okú, ti o si fi ogo fun u; ki igbagbọ́ ati ireti nyin ki o le wà lọdọ Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Who by him do believe in God, that raised him up from the dead, and gave him glory; that your faith and hope might be in God.

entries.yo: Niwọnbi ẹnyin ti wẹ̀ ọkàn nyin mọ́ nipa ìgbọran nyin si otitọ nipa Ẹmí si ifẹ ará ti kò li ẹ̀tan, ẹ fẹ ọmọnikeji nyin gidigidi lati ọkàn wá.
entries.en: Seeing ye have purified your souls in obeying the truth through the Spirit unto unfeigned love of the brethren, see that ye love one another with a pure heart fervently:

entries.yo: Bi a ti tun nyin bi, kì iṣe lati inu irú ti idibajẹ wá, bikoṣe eyiti ki idibajẹ, nipa ọ̀rọ Ọlọrun ti mbẹ lãye ti o si duro.
entries.en: Being born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, by the word of God, which liveth and abideth for ever.

entries.yo: Nitoripe gbogbo ẹran ara dabi koriko, ati gbogbo ogo rẹ̀ bi itanná koriko. Koriko a mã gbẹ, itanná rẹ̀ a si rẹ̀ silẹ:
entries.en: For all flesh is as grass, and all the glory of man as the flower of grass. The grass withereth, and the flower thereof falleth away:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ọ̀rọ Oluwa duro titi lai. Ọ̀rọ yi na si ni ihinrere ti a wãsu fun nyin.
entries.en: But the word of the Lord endureth for ever. And this is the word which by the gospel is preached unto you.

entries.yo: NITORINA ẹ fi arankàn gbogbo lelẹ li apakan, ati ẹ̀tan gbogbo, ati agabagebe, ati ilara, ati sisọ ọ̀rọ buburu gbogbo.
entries.en: Wherefore laying aside all malice, and all guile, and hypocrisies, and envies, and all evil speakings,

entries.yo: Bi ọmọ-ọwọ titun, ki ẹ mã fẹ wàra ti Ẹmí na eyiti kò li ẹ̀tan, ki ẹnyin ki o le mã ti ipasẹ rẹ̀ dàgba si igbala,
entries.en: As newborn babes, desire the sincere milk of the word, that ye may grow thereby:

entries.yo: Bi ẹnyin ba ti tọ́ ọ wò pe, olõre li Oluwa:
entries.en: If so be ye have tasted that the Lord is gracious.

entries.yo: Ẹniti ẹnyin ntọ̀ bọ̀, bi si okuta ãye, ti a ti ọwọ́ enia kọ̀ silẹ nitõtọ, ṣugbọn lọdọ Ọlọrun, àṣayan, iyebiye,
entries.en: To whom coming, as unto a living stone, disallowed indeed of men, but chosen of God, and precious,

entries.yo: Ẹnyin pẹlu, bi okuta ãye, li a kọ ni ile ẹmí, alufa mimọ́, lati mã ru ẹbọ ẹmí, ti iṣe itẹwọgbà lọdọ Ọlọrun nipa Jesu Kristi.
entries.en: Ye also, as lively stones, are built up a spiritual house, an holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God by Jesus Christ.

entries.yo: Nitori o mbẹ ninu iwe-mimọ́ pe, Kiyesi i, Mo fi pàtaki okuta igunle, àṣayan, iyebiye, lelẹ ni Sioni: ẹniti o ba si gbà a gbọ́ oju kì yio ti i.
entries.en: Wherefore also it is contained in the scripture, Behold, I lay in Sion a chief corner stone, elect, precious: and he that believeth on him shall not be confounded.

entries.yo: Nitorina fun ẹnyin ti o gbagbọ́, ọla ni: ṣugbọn fun awọn ti kò gbagbọ́, okuta ti awọn ọmọle kọ̀ silẹ, on na li o di pàtaki igunle,
entries.en: Unto you therefore which believe he is precious: but unto them which be disobedient, the stone which the builders disallowed, the same is made the head of the corner,

entries.yo: Ati pẹlu, okuta idigbolu, on apata ikọsẹ̀. Nitori nwọn kọsẹ nipa ṣiṣe aigbọran si ọrọ na ninu eyiti a gbé yàn wọn si pẹlu.
entries.en: And a stone of stumbling, and a rock of offence, even to them which stumble at the word, being disobedient: whereunto also they were appointed.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹnyin ni iran ti a yàn, olu-alufa, orilẹ-ède mimọ́, enia ọ̀tọ; ki ẹnyin ki o le fi ọla nla ẹniti o pè nyin jade kuro ninu òkunkun sinu imọlẹ iyanu rẹ̀ hàn:
entries.en: But ye are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people; that ye should shew forth the praises of him who hath called you out of darkness into his marvellous light:

entries.yo: Ẹnyin ti kì iṣe enia nigbakan rí, ṣugbọn nisisiyi ẹnyin di enia Ọlọrun, ẹnyin ti kò ti ri ãnu gbà ri, ṣugbọn nisisiyi ẹ ti ri ãnu gbà.
entries.en: Which in time past were not a people, but are now the people of God: which had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.

entries.yo: Olufẹ, mo bẹ̀ nyin, bi alejò ati bi èro, lati fà sẹhin kuro ninu ifẹkufẹ ara, ti mba ọkàn jagun;
entries.en: Dearly beloved, I beseech you as strangers and pilgrims, abstain from fleshly lusts, which war against the soul;

entries.yo: Ki ìwa nyin larin awọn Keferi kí o dara; pe, bi nwọn ti nsọ̀rọ nyin bi oluṣe buburu, nipa iṣẹ rere nyin, ti nwọn o mã kiyesi, ki nwọn ki o le mã yìn Ọlọrun logo li ọjọ ìbẹwo.
entries.en: Having your conversation honest among the Gentiles: that, whereas they speak against you as evildoers, they may by your good works, which they shall behold, glorify God in the day of visitation.

entries.yo: Ẹ mã tẹriba fun gbogbo ìlana enia nitori ti Oluwa: ibãṣe fun ọba, bi fun olori;
entries.en: Submit yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord's sake: whether it be to the king, as supreme;

entries.yo: Tabi fun awọn bãlẹ, bi fun awọn ti a rán lati ọdọ rẹ̀ fun igbẹsan lara awọn ti nṣe buburu, ati fun iyìn awọn ti nṣe rere.
entries.en: Or unto governors, as unto them that are sent by him for the punishment of evildoers, and for the praise of them that do well.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ sá ni ifẹ Ọlọrun, pe ni rere iṣe, ki ẹ le dá òpe awọn wère enia lẹkun:
entries.en: For so is the will of God, that with well doing ye may put to silence the ignorance of foolish men:

entries.yo: Bi omnira, laisi lo omnira nyin fun ohun bibo arakàn nyin mọlẹ, ṣugbọn bi ẹrú Ọlọrun.
entries.en: As free, and not using your liberty for a cloke of maliciousness, but as the servants of God.

entries.yo: Ẹ bọ̀wọ fun gbogbo enia. Ẹ fẹ awọn ará. Ẹ bẹru Ọlọrun. Ẹ bọ̀wọ fun ọba.
entries.en: Honour all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honour the king.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin ọmọ-ọ̀dọ, ẹ mã tẹriba fun awọn oluwa nyin pẹlu ìbẹru gbogbo; ki iṣe fun awọn ẹni rere ati oniwa tutu nikan, ṣugbọn fun awọn onrorò pẹlu.
entries.en: Servants, be subject to your masters with all fear; not only to the good and gentle, but also to the froward.

entries.yo: Nitoripe eyi ni ìtẹwọgba, bi enia ba fi ori tì ibanujẹ, ti o si njìya laitọ́, nitori ọkàn rere si Ọlọrun.
entries.en: For this is thankworthy, if a man for conscience toward God endure grief, suffering wrongfully.

entries.yo: Nitori ogo kili o jẹ, nigbati ẹ ba ṣẹ̀ ti a si lù nyin, bi ẹ ba fi sũru gbà a? ṣugbọn nigbati ẹnyin ba nṣe rere; ti ẹ si njiya, bi ẹnyin ba fi sũru gbà a, eyi ni itẹwọgbà lọdọ Ọlọrun.
entries.en: For what glory is it, if, when ye be buffeted for your faults, ye shall take it patiently? but if, when ye do well, and suffer for it, ye take it patiently, this is acceptable with God.

entries.yo: Nitori inu eyi li a pè nyin si: nitori Kristi pẹlu jìya fun nyin, o fi apẹrẹ silẹ fun nyin, ki ẹnyin ki o le mã tọ̀ ipasẹ rẹ̀:
entries.en: For even hereunto were ye called: because Christ also suffered for us, leaving us an example, that ye should follow his steps:

entries.yo: Ẹniti kò dẹṣẹ̀, bẹni a kò si ri arekereke lì ẹnu rẹ̀:
entries.en: Who did no sin, neither was guile found in his mouth:

entries.yo: Ẹni, nigbati a kẹgan rẹ̀, ti kò si pada kẹgan; nigbati o jìya, ti kò si kilọ; ṣugbọn o fi ọ̀ran rẹ̀ le ẹniti nṣe idajọ ododo lọwọ:
entries.en: Who, when he was reviled, reviled not again; when he suffered, he threatened not; but committed himself to him that judgeth righteously:

entries.yo: Ẹniti on tikararẹ̀ fi ara rẹ̀ rù ẹ̀ṣẹ wa lori igi, pe ki awa ki o le di okú si ẹ̀ṣẹ ki a si di ãye si ododo: nipa ìnà ẹniti a mu nyin larada.
entries.en: Who his own self bare our sins in his own body on the tree, that we, being dead to sins, should live unto righteousness: by whose stripes ye were healed.

entries.yo: Nitori ẹnyin ti nṣako lọ bi agutan, ṣugbọn nisisiyi ẹnyin pada si ọdọ Oluṣọ-agutan ati Biṣopu ọkàn nyin.
entries.en: For ye were as sheep going astray; but are now returned unto the Shepherd and Bishop of your souls.

entries.yo: BẸ̃ gẹgẹ, ẹnyin aya, ẹ mã tẹriba fun awọn ọkọ nyin; pe, bi ẹnikẹni bá tilẹ nṣe aigbọran si ọ̀rọ na, ki a lè jere wọn li aisọrọ nipa ìwa awọn aya wọn,
entries.en: Likewise, ye wives, be in subjection to your own husbands; that, if any obey not the word, they also may without the word be won by the conversation of the wives;

entries.yo: Nigbati nwọn ba nwò ìwa rere ti on ti ẹ̀ru nyin:
entries.en: While they behold your chaste conversation coupled with fear.

entries.yo: Ọṣọ́ ẹniti ki o má jẹ ọṣọ́ ode, ti irun didì, ati ti wura lilo, tabi ti aṣọ wiwọ̀;
entries.en: Whose adorning let it not be that outward adorning of plaiting the hair, and of wearing of gold, or of putting on of apparel;

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ki o jẹ ti ẹniti o farasin li ọkàn, ninu ọ̀ṣọ́ aidibajẹ ti ẹmí irẹlẹ ati ẹmí tutù, eyiti iṣe iyebiye niwaju Ọlọrun.
entries.en: But let it be the hidden man of the heart, in that which is not corruptible, even the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of God of great price.

entries.yo: Nitori bayi li awọn obinrin mimọ́ igbãni pẹlu, ti nwọn gbẹkẹle Ọlọrun, fi ṣe ara wọn li ọ̀ṣọ́, nwọn a mã tẹriba fun awọn ọkọ tiwọn.
entries.en: For after this manner in the old time the holy women also, who trusted in God, adorned themselves, being in subjection unto their own husbands:

entries.yo: Gẹgẹ bi Sara ti gbọ́ ti Abrahamu, ti o npè e li oluwa: ọmọbinrin ẹniti ẹnyin iṣe, bi ẹnyin ba nṣe rere, ti ohunkohun kò si dẹruba nyìn.
entries.en: Even as Sara obeyed Abraham, calling him lord: whose daughters ye are, as long as ye do well, and are not afraid with any amazement.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ gẹgẹ ẹnyin ọkọ, ẹ mã fi oye bá awọn aya nyin gbé, ẹ mã fi ọla fun aya, bi ohun èlo ti kò lagbara, ati pẹlu bi ajumọ-jogun ore-ọfẹ ìye; ki adura nyin ki o má bã ni ìdena.
entries.en: Likewise, ye husbands, dwell with them according to knowledge, giving honour unto the wife, as unto the weaker vessel, and as being heirs together of the grace of life; that your prayers be not hindered.

entries.yo: Lakotan, ki gbogbo nyin ṣe oninu kan, ẹ mã ba ará nyin kẹdun, ẹ ni ifẹ ará, ẹ mã ṣe ìyọnú, ẹ ni ẹmí irẹlẹ.
entries.en: Finally, be ye all of one mind, having compassion one of another, love as brethren, be pitiful, be courteous:

entries.yo: Ẹ máṣe fi buburu san buburu, tabi fi ẽbú san ẽbú; ṣugbọn kàka bẹ̃, ẹ mã súre; nitori eyi li a pè nyin si, ki ẹnyin ki o le jogún ibukún.
entries.en: Not rendering evil for evil, or railing for railing: but contrariwise blessing; knowing that ye are thereunto called, that ye should inherit a blessing.

entries.yo: Nitori, Ẹniti yio ba fẹ ìye, ti yio si ri ọjọ rere, ki o pa ahọn rẹ̀ mọ́ kuro ninu ibi, ati ète rẹ̀ kuro ni sisọ ọrọ ẹ̀tan:
entries.en: For he that will love life, and see good days, let him refrain his tongue from evil, and his lips that they speak no guile:

entries.yo: Ki o yà kuro ninu ibi, ki o si mã ṣe rere; ki o mã wá alafia, ki o si mã lepa rẹ̀.
entries.en: Let him eschew evil, and do good; let him seek peace, and ensue it.

entries.yo: Nitori oju Oluwa mbẹ lara awọn olododo, etí rẹ̀ si ṣí si ẹbẹ wọn: ṣugbọn oju Oluwa nwo awọn ti nṣe buburu.
entries.en: For the eyes of the Lord are over the righteous, and his ears are open unto their prayers: but the face of the Lord is against them that do evil.

entries.yo: Tani yio si ṣe nyin ni ibi, bi ẹnyin ba jẹ onítara si ohun rere?
entries.en: And who is he that will harm you, if ye be followers of that which is good?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi ẹnyin ba jìya nitori ododo, alafia ni: ẹ máṣe bẹru wọn, ki ẹ má si ṣe kọminu;
entries.en: But and if ye suffer for righteousness' sake, happy are ye: and be not afraid of their terror, neither be troubled;

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹ bọ̀wọ fun Kristi bi Oluwa lọkan nyin: ki ẹ si mura tan nigbagbogbo lati dá olukuluku lohùn ti mbere ireti ti o mbẹ ninu nyin, ṣugbọn pẹlu ọkàn tutù ati ìbẹru.
entries.en: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts: and be ready always to give an answer to every man that asketh you a reason of the hope that is in you with meekness and fear:

entries.yo: Ki ẹ mã ni ẹri-ọkàn rere, bi nwọn ti nsọ̀rọ nyin ni ibi, ki oju ki o le ti awọn ti nkẹgan iwa rere nyin ninu Kristi.
entries.en: Having a good conscience; that, whereas they speak evil of you, as of evildoers, they may be ashamed that falsely accuse your good conversation in Christ.

entries.yo: Nitori o san, bi o bá jẹ ifẹ Ọlọrun, ki ẹ jìya fun rere iṣe jù fun buburu iṣe lọ.
entries.en: For it is better, if the will of God be so, that ye suffer for well doing, than for evil doing.

entries.yo: Nitoriti Kristi pẹlu jìya lẹ̃kan nitori ẹ̀ṣẹ wa, olõtọ fun awọn alaiṣõtọ, ki o le mu wa de ọdọ Ọlọrun, ẹniti a pa ninu ara, ṣugbọn ti a sọ di ãye ninu ẹmí:
entries.en: For Christ also hath once suffered for sins, the just for the unjust, that he might bring us to God, being put to death in the flesh, but quickened by the Spirit:

entries.yo: Ninu eyiti o lọ pẹlu, ti o si wãsu fun awọn ẹmí ninu tubu:
entries.en: By which also he went and preached unto the spirits in prison;

entries.yo: Awọn ti o ṣe alaigbọran nigbakan, nigbati sũru Ọlọrun duro pẹ ni sã kan ni ọjọ Noa, nigbati nwọn fi nkàn ọkọ̀ ninu eyiti à gba ọkàn diẹ là nipa omi, eyini ni ẹni mẹjọ;
entries.en: Which sometime were disobedient, when once the longsuffering of God waited in the days of Noah, while the ark was a preparing, wherein few, that is, eight souls were saved by water.

entries.yo: Apẹrẹ eyiti ngbà nyin là nisisiyi pẹlu, ani baptismu, kì iṣe ìwẹ ẽri ti ara nù, bikoṣe idahùn ọkàn rere sipa Ọlọrun, nipa ajinde Jesu Kristi:
entries.en: The like figure whereunto even baptism doth also now save us (not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God,) by the resurrection of Jesus Christ:

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ti lọ si ọrun, ti o si mbẹ li ọwọ́ ọtún Ọlọrun; awọn angẹli, ati awọn ọlọlá, ati awọn alagbara si ntẹriba fun.
entries.en: Who is gone into heaven, and is on the right hand of God; angels and authorities and powers being made subject unto him.

entries.yo: NJẸ bi Kristi ti jìya fun wa nipa ti ara, irú inu kanna ni ki ẹnyin fi hamọra: nitori ẹniti o ba ti jìya nipa ti ara, o ti bọ́ lọwọ ẹ̀ṣẹ;
entries.en: Forasmuch then as Christ hath suffered for us in the flesh, arm yourselves likewise with the same mind: for he that hath suffered in the flesh hath ceased from sin;

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o máṣe fi ìgba aiye nyin iyokù wà ninu ara mọ́ si ifẹkufẹ enia, bikoṣe si ifẹ Ọlọrun.
entries.en: That he no longer should live the rest of his time in the flesh to the lusts of men, but to the will of God.

entries.yo: Nitori igba ti o ti kọja ti to fun ṣiṣe ifẹ awọn keferi, rinrìn ninu iwa wọ̀bia, ifẹkufẹ, ọti amupara, ìrède oru, kiko ẹgbẹ ọmuti, ati ìbọriṣa ti iṣe ohun irira.
entries.en: For the time past of our life may suffice us to have wrought the will of the Gentiles, when we walked in lasciviousness, lusts, excess of wine, revellings, banquetings, and abominable idolatries:

entries.yo: Eyi ti o yà wọn lẹnu pe ẹnyin kò ba wọn súré sinu iru aṣejù iwa wọbia wọn, ti nwọn sì nsọrọ nyin ni buburu,
entries.en: Wherein they think it strange that ye run not with them to the same excess of riot, speaking evil of you:

entries.yo: Awọn ẹniti yio jihin fun ẹniti o mura ati ṣe idajọ ãye on okú.
entries.en: Who shall give account to him that is ready to judge the quick and the dead.

entries.yo: Nitori eyi li a sá ṣe wasu ihinrere fun awọn okú, ki a le ṣe idajọ wọn gẹgẹ bi enia nipa ti ara, ṣugbọn ki nwọn ki o le wà lãye si Ọlọrun nipa ti ẹmí.
entries.en: For for this cause was the gospel preached also to them that are dead, that they might be judged according to men in the flesh, but live according to God in the spirit.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn opin ohun gbogbo kù si dẹ̀dẹ: nitorina ki ẹnyin ki o wà li airekọja, ki ẹ si mã ṣọra ninu adura.
entries.en: But the end of all things is at hand: be ye therefore sober, and watch unto prayer.

entries.yo: Jù gbogbo rẹ̀ lọ, ẹ ni ifẹ ti o gbóna larin ara nyin: nitori ifẹ ni mbò ọ̀pọlọpọ ẹ̀ṣẹ mọlẹ.
entries.en: And above all things have fervent charity among yourselves: for charity shall cover the multitude of sins.

entries.yo: Ẹ mã ṣe ara nyin li alejò laisi ikùn sinu.
entries.en: Use hospitality one to another without grudging.

entries.yo: Bi olukuluku ti ri ẹ̀bun gbà, bẹ̃ni ki ẹ mã ṣe ipinfunni rẹ̀ larin ara nyin, bi iriju rere ti onirũru ore-ọfẹ Ọlọrun.
entries.en: As every man hath received the gift, even so minister the same one to another, as good stewards of the manifold grace of God.

entries.yo: Bi ẹnikẹni ba nsọ̀rọ, ki o mã sọ bi ọ̀rọ Ọlọrun; bi ẹnikẹni ba nṣe iṣẹ iranṣẹ, ki o ṣe e bi agbara ti Ọlọrun fifun u: ki a le mã yìn Ọlọrun logo li ohun gbogbo nipa Jesu Kristi, ẹniti ogo ati ìjọba wà fun lai ati lailai. Amin.
entries.en: If any man speak, let him speak as the oracles of God; if any man minister, let him do it as of the ability which God giveth: that God in all things may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom be praise and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.

entries.yo: Olufẹ, ẹ máṣe ka idanwò iná ti mbẹ larin nyin eyiti o de si nyin lati dan nyin wò bi ẹnipe ohun àjeji li o de bá nyin:
entries.en: Beloved, think it not strange concerning the fiery trial which is to try you, as though some strange thing happened unto you:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn niwọnbi ẹnyin ti jẹ alabapin ìya Kristi, ẹ mã yọ̀, ki ẹnyin ki o le yọ̀ ayọ̀ pipọ nigbati a ba fi ogo rẹ̀ hàn.
entries.en: But rejoice, inasmuch as ye are partakers of Christ's sufferings; that, when his glory shall be revealed, ye may be glad also with exceeding joy.

entries.yo: Bi a ba ngàn nyin nitori orukọ Kristi, ẹni ibukun ni nyin; nitori Ẹmí ogo ati ti Ọlọrun bà le nyin: nipa tiwọn nwọn nsọ̀rọ rẹ̀ ni ibi, ṣugbọn nipa tinyin a nyìn i logo.
entries.en: If ye be reproached for the name of Christ, happy are ye; for the spirit of glory and of God resteth upon you: on their part he is evil spoken of, but on your part he is glorified.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹ má jẹ ki ẹnikẹni ninu nyin ki o jìya bi apania, tabi bi olè, tabi bi oluṣe-buburu, tabi bi ẹniti ntojubọ ọ̀ran ẹlomiran.
entries.en: But let none of you suffer as a murderer, or as a thief, or as an evildoer, or as a busybody in other men's matters.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi o ba jìya bi Kristiani, ki oju ki o máṣe tì i; ṣugbọn ki o kuku yìn Ọlọrun logo ni orukọ yi.
entries.en: Yet if any man suffer as a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God on this behalf.

entries.yo: Nitoriti ìgba na de, ti idajọ yio bẹ̀rẹ lati ile Ọlọrun wá: bi o ba si tète ti ọdọ wa bẹ̀rẹ, opin awọn ti kò gbà ihinrere Ọlọrun gbọ́ yio ha ti ri?
entries.en: For the time is come that judgment must begin at the house of God: and if it first begin at us, what shall the end be of them that obey not the gospel of God?

entries.yo: Biobaṣepe agbara káka li a fi gba olododo là, nibo ni alaiwà-bi-Ọlọrun on ẹlẹṣẹ yio gbé yọju si?
entries.en: And if the righteous scarcely be saved, where shall the ungodly and the sinner appear?

entries.yo: Nitorina ẹ jẹ ki awọn ti njìya gẹgẹ bi ifẹ Ọlọrun, fi ọkàn wọn le e lọwọ pẹlu ni rere iṣe, bi ẹnipe fun Ẹlẹda olõtọ.
entries.en: Wherefore let them that suffer according to the will of God commit the keeping of their souls to him in well doing, as unto a faithful Creator.

entries.yo: AWỌN alàgba ti mbẹ lãrin nyin ni mo bẹ̀, emi ẹniti iṣe alàgba bi ẹnyin, ati ẹlẹri ìya Kristi, ati alabapin ninu ogo ti a o fihàn:
entries.en: The elders which are among you I exhort, who am also an elder, and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and also a partaker of the glory that shall be revealed:

entries.yo: Ẹ mã tọju agbo Ọlọrun ti mbẹ lãrin nyin, ẹ mã bojuto o, kì iṣe afipáṣe, bikoṣe tifẹtifẹ; bẹni ki iṣe ọrọ ère ijẹkujẹ, ṣugbọn pẹlu ọkàn ti o mura tan.
entries.en: Feed the flock of God which is among you, taking the oversight thereof, not by constraint, but willingly; not for filthy lucre, but of a ready mind;

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ni ki iṣe bi ẹniti nlo agbara lori ijọ, ṣugbọn ki ẹ ṣe ara nyin li apẹrẹ fun agbo.
entries.en: Neither as being lords over God's heritage, but being ensamples to the flock.

entries.yo: Nigbati olori Oluṣọ-agutan ba si fi ara hàn, ẹnyin ó gbà ade ogo ti kì iṣá.
entries.en: And when the chief Shepherd shall appear, ye shall receive a crown of glory that fadeth not away.

entries.yo: Bẹ̃ pẹlu, ẹnyin ipẹ̃rẹ, ẹ tẹriba fun awọn àgba. Ani, gbogbo nyin, ẹ mã tẹriba fun ara nyin, ki ẹ si fi irẹlẹ wọ̀ ara nyin li aṣọ: nitori Ọlọrun kọ oju ija si awọn agberaga, ṣugbọn O nfi ore-ọfẹ fun awọn onirẹlẹ.
entries.en: Likewise, ye younger, submit yourselves unto the elder. Yea, all of you be subject one to another, and be clothed with humility: for God resisteth the proud, and giveth grace to the humble.

entries.yo: Nitorina ẹ rẹ̀ ara nyin silẹ labẹ ọwọ́ agbara Ọlọrun, ki on ki o le gbé nyin ga li akokò.
entries.en: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time:

entries.yo: Ẹ mã kó gbogbo aniyan nyin le e; nitoriti on nṣe itọju nyin.
entries.en: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.

entries.yo: Ẹ mã wà li airekọja, ẹ mã ṣọra; nitori Èṣu, ọtá nyin, bi kiniun ti nke ramuramu, o nrìn kãkiri, o nwá ẹniti yio pajẹ kiri:
entries.en: Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour:

entries.yo: Ẹniti ki ẹnyin ki o kọ oju ija si pẹlu iduroṣinṣin ninu igbagbọ́, ki ẹnyin ki o mọ̀ pe ìya kanna ni awọn ara nyin ti mbẹ ninu aiye njẹ.
entries.en: Whom resist stedfast in the faith, knowing that the same afflictions are accomplished in your brethren that are in the world.

entries.yo: Ọlọrun ore-ọfẹ gbogbo, ti o ti pè nyin sinu ogo rẹ̀ ti kò nipẹkun ninu Kristi Jesu, nigbati ẹnyin ba ti jìya diẹ, On tikarãrẹ, yio si ṣe nyin li aṣepé, yio fi ẹsẹ nyin mulẹ, yio fun nyin li agbara, yio fi idi nyin kalẹ.
entries.en: But the God of all grace, who hath called us unto his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after that ye have suffered a while, make you perfect, stablish, strengthen, settle you.

entries.yo: Tirẹ̀ li ogo ati agbara titi lailai. Amin.
entries.en: To him be glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.

entries.yo: Nipa Silfanu, arakunrin wa olõtọ gẹgẹbi mo ti ka a si, ni mo kọwe kukuru si nyin, ti mo ngbà nyin niyanju, ti mo si njẹri pe, eyi ni otitọ ore-ọfẹ Ọlọrun: ẹ duro ṣinṣin ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: By Silvanus, a faithful brother unto you, as I suppose, I have written briefly, exhorting, and testifying that this is the true grace of God wherein ye stand.

entries.yo: Ijọ ti mbẹ ni Babiloni, ti a yàn pẹlu nyin, kí nyin; bẹ̃ si ni Marku ọmọ mi pẹlu.
entries.en: The church that is at Babylon, elected together with you, saluteth you; and so doth Marcus my son.

entries.yo: Ẹ fi ifẹnukonu ifẹ kí ara nyin. Amin.
entries.en: Greet ye one another with a kiss of charity. Peace be with you all that are in Christ Jesus. Amen.

entries.yo: SIMONI Peteru, iranṣẹ ati Aposteli Jesu Kristi, si awọn ti o ti gbà irú iyebiye igbagbọ́ kanna pẹlu wa, ninu ododo Ọlọrun wa ati ti Jesu Kristi Olugbala:
entries.en: Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle of Jesus Christ, to them that have obtained like precious faith with us through the righteousness of God and our Saviour Jesus Christ:

entries.yo: Ki ore-ọfẹ ati alafia ki o mã bisi i fun nyin ninu ìmọ Ọlọrun, ati ti Jesu Oluwa wa,
entries.en: Grace and peace be multiplied unto you through the knowledge of God, and of Jesus our Lord,

entries.yo: Bi agbara rẹ̀ bi Ọlọrun ti fun wa li ohun gbogbo ti iṣe ti ìye ati ti ìwa-bi-Ọlọrun, nipa ìmọ ẹniti o pè wa nipa ogo ati ọlanla rẹ̀:
entries.en: According as his divine power hath given unto us all things that pertain unto life and godliness, through the knowledge of him that hath called us to glory and virtue:

entries.yo: Nipa eyiti o ti fi awọn ileri rẹ̀ ti o tobi pupọ ti o si ṣe iyebiye fun wa: pe nipa iwọnyi ni ki ẹnyin ki o le di alabapin ninu ìwa Ọlọrun, nigbati ẹnyin bá ti yọ kuro ninu ibajẹ ti mbẹ ninu aiye nipa ifẹkufẹ.
entries.en: Whereby are given unto us exceeding great and precious promises: that by these ye might be partakers of the divine nature, having escaped the corruption that is in the world through lust.

entries.yo: Ati nitori eyi nã pãpã, ẹ mã ṣe aisimi gbogbo, ẹ fi ìwarere kún igbagbọ́, ati ìmọ kún ìwarere;
entries.en: And beside this, giving all diligence, add to your faith virtue; and to virtue knowledge;

entries.yo: Ati airekọja kún ìmọ; ati sũru kún airekọja; ati ìwa-bi-Ọlọrun kún sũru;
entries.en: And to knowledge temperance; and to temperance patience; and to patience godliness;

entries.yo: Ati ifẹ ọmọnikeji kún ìwa-bi-Ọlọrun; ati ifẹni kún ifẹ ọmọnikeji.
entries.en: And to godliness brotherly kindness; and to brotherly kindness charity.

entries.yo: Nitori bi ẹnyin bá ni nkan wọnyi ti nwọn bá si pọ̀, nwọn kì yio jẹ ki ẹ ṣe ọ̀lẹ tabi alaileso ninu ìmọ Oluwa wa Jesu Kristi.
entries.en: For if these things be in you, and abound, they make you that ye shall neither be barren nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.

entries.yo: Nitori ẹniti o ba ṣe alaini nkan wọnyi, o fọju, kò le riran li òkẽre, o si ti gbagbé pe a ti wẹ̀ on nù kuro ninu ẹ̀ṣẹ rẹ̀ atijọ.
entries.en: But he that lacketh these things is blind, and cannot see afar off, and hath forgotten that he was purged from his old sins.

entries.yo: Nitorina, ará, ẹ tubọ mã ṣe aisimi lati sọ ìpe ati yiyàn nyin di dajudaju: nitori bi ẹnyin ba nṣe nkan wọnyi, ẹnyin kì yio kọsẹ lai.
entries.en: Wherefore the rather, brethren, give diligence to make your calling and election sure: for if ye do these things, ye shall never fall:

entries.yo: Nitori bayi li a ó pese fun nyin lọpọlọpọ lati wọ ijọba ainipẹkun ti Oluwa ati Olugbala wa Jesu Kristi.
entries.en: For so an entrance shall be ministered unto you abundantly into the everlasting kingdom of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ.

entries.yo: Nitorina emi ó mã mura lati mã mu nkan wọnyi wá si iranti nyin nigbagbogbo bi ẹnyin tilẹ ti mọ̀ wọn, ti ẹsẹ nyin si mulẹ ninu otitọ ti ẹnyin ni.
entries.en: Wherefore I will not be negligent to put you always in remembrance of these things, though ye know them, and be established in the present truth.

entries.yo: Emi si rò pe o yẹ, niwọn igbati emi ba mbẹ ninu agọ́ yi, lati mã fi iranti rú nyin soke;
entries.en: Yea, I think it meet, as long as I am in this tabernacle, to stir you up by putting you in remembrance;

entries.yo: Bi emi ti mọ̀ pe, bibọ́ agọ́ mi yi silẹ kù si dẹdẹ, ani bi Oluwa wa Jesu Kristi ti fihàn mi.
entries.en: Knowing that shortly I must put off this my tabernacle, even as our Lord Jesus Christ hath shewed me.

entries.yo: Emi o si mã ṣãpọn pẹlu, ki ẹnyin ki o le mã ranti nkan wọnyi nigbagbogbo lẹhin ikú mi.
entries.en: Moreover I will endeavour that ye may be able after my decease to have these things always in remembrance.

entries.yo: Nitori ki iṣe bi ẹniti ntọ ìtan asan lẹhin ti a fi ọgbọ́n-kọgbọn là silẹ, li awa fi agbara ati wíwá Jesu Kristi Oluwa wa hàn nyin, ṣugbọn ẹlẹri ọlá nla rẹ̀ li awa iṣe.
entries.en: For we have not followed cunningly devised fables, when we made known unto you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but were eyewitnesses of his majesty.

entries.yo: Nitoriti o gbà ọlá on ogo lati ọdọ Ọlọrun Baba, nigbati irú ohùn nì fọ̀ si i lati inu ogo nla na wá pe, Eyi li ayanfẹ Ọmọ mi, ẹniti inu mi dùn si jọjọ.
entries.en: For he received from God the Father honour and glory, when there came such a voice to him from the excellent glory, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.

entries.yo: Ohùn yi ti o ti ọrun wá li awa si gbọ́, nigbati awa mbẹ pẹlu rẹ̀ lori òke mimọ́ na.
entries.en: And this voice which came from heaven we heard, when we were with him in the holy mount.

entries.yo: Awa si ni ọ̀rọ asọtẹlẹ ti o fẹsẹmulẹ jubẹ̃lọ; eyiti o yẹ ki ẹ kiyesi bi fitila ti ntàn ni ibi òkunkun, titi ilẹ yio fi mọ́, ti irawọ owurọ̀ yio si yọ li ọkàn nyin.
entries.en: We have also a more sure word of prophecy; whereunto ye do well that ye take heed, as unto a light that shineth in a dark place, until the day dawn, and the day star arise in your hearts:

entries.yo: Ki ẹ kọ́ mọ̀ eyi, pe kò si ọ̀kan ninu asọtẹlẹ inu iwe-mimọ́ ti o ni itumọ̀ ikọkọ.
entries.en: Knowing this first, that no prophecy of the scripture is of any private interpretation.

entries.yo: Nitori asọtẹlẹ kan kò ti ipa ifẹ enia wá ri; ṣugbọn awọn enia nsọrọ lati ọdọ Ọlọrun bi a ti ndari wọn lati ọwọ́ Ẹmí Mimọ́ wá.
entries.en: For the prophecy came not in old time by the will of man: but holy men of God spake as they were moved by the Holy Ghost.

entries.yo: ṢUGBỌN awọn woli eke wà lãrin awọn enia na pẹlu, gẹgẹ bi awọn olukọ́ni eke yio ti wà larin nyin, awọn ẹniti yio yọ́ mu adámọ ègbé wọ̀ inu nyin wá, ani ti yio sẹ́ Oluwa ti o rà wọn, nwọn o si mu iparun ti o yara kánkán wá sori ara wọn.
entries.en: But there were false prophets also among the people, even as there shall be false teachers among you, who privily shall bring in damnable heresies, even denying the Lord that bought them, and bring upon themselves swift destruction.

entries.yo: Ọpọlọpọ ni yio si mã tẹle ìwa wọbia wọn; nipa awọn ẹniti a o fi mã sọ ọrọ-odi si ọ̀na otitọ.
entries.en: And many shall follow their pernicious ways; by reason of whom the way of truth shall be evil spoken of.

entries.yo: Ati ninu ojukòkoro ni nwọn o mã fi nyin ṣe ere jẹ nipa ọrọ ẹtàn: idajọ ẹniti kò falẹ̀ lati ọjọ ìwa, ìparun wọn kò si tõgbé.
entries.en: And through covetousness shall they with feigned words make merchandise of you: whose judgment now of a long time lingereth not, and their damnation slumbereth not.

entries.yo: Nitoripe bi Ọlọrun kò ba dá awọn angẹli si ti nwọn ṣẹ, ṣugbọn ti o sọ wọn si isalẹ ọrun apadi, ti o si fi wọn sinu ọgbun òkunkun biribiri awọn ti a pamọ́ de idajọ;
entries.en: For if God spared not the angels that sinned, but cast them down to hell, and delivered them into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment;

entries.yo: Ti kò si dá aiye igbãni si, ṣugbọn o pa Noa pẹlu awọn meje miran mọ́, oniwasu ododo, nigbati o mu kikun omi wá sori aiye awọn alaiwà-bi-Ọlọrun;
entries.en: And spared not the old world, but saved Noah the eighth person, a preacher of righteousness, bringing in the flood upon the world of the ungodly;

entries.yo: Ti o sọ awọn ilu Sodomu on Gomorra di ẽru, nigbati o fi ifọ́ afọbajẹ dá wọn lẹbi, ti o fi wọn ṣe apẹrẹ fun awọn ti yio jẹ alaiwà-bi-Ọlọrun;
entries.en: And turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrha into ashes condemned them with an overthrow, making them an ensample unto those that after should live ungodly;

entries.yo: O si yọ Loti olõtọ, ẹniti ìwa wọbia awọn enia buburu bà ninu jẹ:
entries.en: And delivered just Lot, vexed with the filthy conversation of the wicked:

entries.yo: (Nitori ọkunrin olõtọ nì bi o ti ngbe ãrin wọn, ti o nri, ti o si ngbọ́, lojojumọ ni ìwa buburu wọn mba ọkàn otitọ rẹ̀ jẹ́):
entries.en: (For that righteous man dwelling among them, in seeing and hearing, vexed his righteous soul from day to day with their unlawful deeds;)

entries.yo: Oluwa mọ̀ bi ã ti íyọ awọn ẹni ìwa-bi-Ọlọrun kuro ninu idanwo ati bi ã ti ípa awọn alaiṣõtọ ti a njẹ niya mọ dè ọjọ idajọ:
entries.en: The Lord knoweth how to deliver the godly out of temptations, and to reserve the unjust unto the day of judgment to be punished:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn pãpã awọn ti ntọ̀ ara lẹhin ninu ifẹkufẹ ẽri, ti nwọn si ngàn awọn ijoye, awọn ọ̀yájú, aṣe-tinuẹni, nwọn kò bẹ̀ru ati mã sọ̀rọ ẹgan si awọn oloye.
entries.en: But chiefly them that walk after the flesh in the lust of uncleanness, and despise government. Presumptuous are they, selfwilled, they are not afraid to speak evil of dignities.

entries.yo: Bẹni awọn angẹli bi nwọn ti pọ̀ ni agbara ati ipá tõ nì, nwọn kò dá wọn lẹjọ ẹ̀gan niwaju Oluwa.
entries.en: Whereas angels, which are greater in power and might, bring not railing accusation against them before the Lord.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn wọnyi, bi ẹranko igbẹ́ ti kò li ero, ẹranko ṣa ti a dá lati mã mu pa, nwọn nsọ̀rọ ẹgan ninu ọran ti kò yé wọn; a o pa wọn run patapata ninu ibajẹ ara wọn.
entries.en: But these, as natural brute beasts, made to be taken and destroyed, speak evil of the things that they understand not; and shall utterly perish in their own corruption;

entries.yo: Nwọn o si jẹ ère aiṣododo, awọn ti nwọn kà a si aiye jijẹ lati mã jẹ adùn aiye li ọsán. Nwọn jẹ́ abawọn ati àbuku, nwọn njaiye ninu asè-ifẹ́ wọn nigbati nwọn ba njẹ ase pẹlu nyin;
entries.en: And shall receive the reward of unrighteousness, as they that count it pleasure to riot in the day time. Spots they are and blemishes, sporting themselves with their own deceivings while they feast with you;

entries.yo: Awọn oloju ti o kún fun panṣaga, ti kò si le dẹkun ẹ̀ṣẹ idá; ti ntàn awọn ọkàn ti kò fi ẹsẹ mulẹ jẹ: awọn ti nwọn ni ọkàn ti o ti fi ojukòkoro kọ́ra; awọn ọmọ ègún:
entries.en: Having eyes full of adultery, and that cannot cease from sin; beguiling unstable souls: an heart they have exercised with covetous practices; cursed children:

entries.yo: Nwọn kọ̀ ọ̀na ti o tọ́ silẹ, nwọn si ṣako lọ, nwọn tẹle ọ̀na Balaamu ọmọ Beori, ẹniti o fẹràn ère aiṣododo;
entries.en: Which have forsaken the right way, and are gone astray, following the way of Balaam the son of Bosor, who loved the wages of unrighteousness;

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn a ba a wi nitori irekọja rẹ̀: odi kẹtẹkẹtẹ fi ohùn enia sọ̀rọ, o si fi opin si were wolĩ na.
entries.en: But was rebuked for his iniquity: the dumb ass speaking with man's voice forbad the madness of the prophet.

entries.yo: Awọn wọnyi ni kanga ti kò li omi, ikũku ti ẹfũfu ngbá kiri; awọn ẹniti a pa òkunkun biribiri mọ́ de tití lai.
entries.en: These are wells without water, clouds that are carried with a tempest; to whom the mist of darkness is reserved for ever.

entries.yo: Nitori igbati nwọn ba nsọ̀rọ ihalẹ asan, ninu ifẹkufẹ ara, nipa wọbia, nwọn a mã tan awọn ti nwọn fẹrẹ má ti ibọ tan kuro lọwọ ti nwọn wà ninu iṣina.
entries.en: For when they speak great swelling words of vanity, they allure through the lusts of the flesh, through much wantonness, those that were clean escaped from them who live in error.

entries.yo: Nwọn a mã ṣe ileri omnira fun wọn, nigbati awọn pãpã jẹ ẹrú idibajẹ́: nitori ẹniti o ba ṣẹgun ẹni, on na ni isi sọ ni di ẹrú.
entries.en: While they promise them liberty, they themselves are the servants of corruption: for of whom a man is overcome, of the same is he brought in bondage.

entries.yo: Nitori lẹhin ti nwọn ba ti yọ tan kuro ninu ẽri aiye, nipa mimọ̀ Oluwa ati Olugbala wa Jesu Kristi, bi nwọn ba si tun fi ara kó o, ti a si ṣẹgun wọn, igbẹhin wọn a buru jù ti iṣaju lọ.
entries.en: For if after they have escaped the pollutions of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ, they are again entangled therein, and overcome, the latter end is worse with them than the beginning.

entries.yo: Nitori ìba san fun wọn, ki nwọn ki o má mọ̀ ọ̀na ododo, jù lẹhin ti nwọn mọ̀ ọ tan, ki nwọn ki o yipada kuro ninu ofin mimọ́ ti a fifun wọn.
entries.en: For it had been better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than, after they have known it, to turn from the holy commandment delivered unto them.

entries.yo: Owe otitọ nì ṣẹ si wọn lara, Ajá tún pada si ẽbì ara rẹ̀; ati ẹlẹdẹ ti a ti wẹ̀ mọ́ sinu àfọ ninu ẹrẹ̀.
entries.en: But it is happened unto them according to the true proverb, The dog is turned to his own vomit again; and the sow that was washed to her wallowing in the mire.

entries.yo: OLUFẸ, eyi ni iwe keji ti mo nkọ si nyin; ninu mejeji na li emi nrú inu funfun nyin soke nipa riran nyin leti:
entries.en: This second epistle, beloved, I now write unto you; in both which I stir up your pure minds by way of remembrance:

entries.yo: Ki ẹnyin ki o le mã ranti ọ̀rọ ti a ti ẹnu awọn woli mimọ́ sọ ṣaju, ati ofin Oluwa ati Olugbala wa lati ọdọ awọn aposteli nyin:
entries.en: That ye may be mindful of the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets, and of the commandment of us the apostles of the Lord and Saviour:

entries.yo: Ki ẹ kọ́ mọ̀ eyi pe, nigba ọjọ ikẹhin, awọn ẹlẹgan yio de pẹlu ẹgan wọn, nwọn o mã rin nipa ifẹ ara wọn,
entries.en: Knowing this first, that there shall come in the last days scoffers, walking after their own lusts,

entries.yo: Nwọn o si mã wipe, Nibo ni ileri wíwa rẹ̀ gbé wà? lati igbati awọn baba ti sùn, ohun gbogbo nlọ bi nwọn ti wà rí lati ìgba ọjọ ìwa.
entries.en: And saying, Where is the promise of his coming? for since the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation.

entries.yo: Nitori eyi ni nwọn mọ̃mọ ṣe aifẹ̃mọ, pe nipa ọ̀rọ Ọlọrun li awọn ọrun ti wà lati ìgba atijọ, ati ti ilẹ yọri jade ninu omi, ti o si duro ninu omi:
entries.en: For this they willingly are ignorant of, that by the word of God the heavens were of old, and the earth standing out of the water and in the water:

entries.yo: Nipa eyi ti omi bo aiye ti o wà nigbana, ti o si ṣegbe:
entries.en: Whereby the world that then was, being overflowed with water, perished:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn ọrun ati aiye, ti mbẹ nisisiyi, nipa ọ̀rọ kanna li a ti tojọ bi iṣura fun iná, a pa wọn mọ́ dè ọjọ idajọ ati iparun awọn alaiwa-bi-Ọlọrun.
entries.en: But the heavens and the earth, which are now, by the same word are kept in store, reserved unto fire against the day of judgment and perdition of ungodly men.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn, olufẹ, ẹ máṣe gbagbe ohun kan yi, pe ọjọ kan lọdọ Oluwa bi ẹgbẹ̀run ọdún li o ri, ati ẹgbẹ̀run ọdún bi ọjọ kan.
entries.en: But, beloved, be not ignorant of this one thing, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.

entries.yo: Oluwa kò fi ileri rẹ̀ jafara, bi awọn ẹlomiran ti ikà a si ijafara; ṣugbọn o nmu sũru fun nyin nitori kò fẹ ki ẹnikẹni ki o ṣegbé, bikoṣe ki gbogbo enia ki o wá si ironupiwada.
entries.en: The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ọjọ Oluwa mbọ̀wá bi olè li oru; ninu eyi ti awọn ọrun yio kọja lọ ti awọn ti ariwo nla, ati awọn imọlẹ oju ọrun yio si ti inu oru gbigbona gidigidi di yíyọ, aiye ati awọn iṣẹ ti o wà ninu rẹ̀ yio si jóna lulu.
entries.en: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night; in the which the heavens shall pass away with a great noise, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat, the earth also and the works that are therein shall be burned up.

entries.yo: Njẹ bi gbogbo nkan wọnyi yio ti yọ́ nì, irú enia wo li ẹnyin iba jẹ ninu ìwa mimọ́ gbogbo ati ìwa-bi-Ọlọrun,
entries.en: Seeing then that all these things shall be dissolved, what manner of persons ought ye to be in all holy conversation and godliness,

entries.yo: Ki ẹ mã reti, ki ẹ si mã mura giri de díde ọjọ Ọlọrun, nitori eyiti awọn ọ̀run yio gbiná, ti nwọn yio di yíyọ́, ti awọn imọlẹ rẹ̀ yio si ti inu õru gbigbona gidigidi di yíyọ?
entries.en: Looking for and hasting unto the coming of the day of God, wherein the heavens being on fire shall be dissolved, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat?

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn gẹgẹ bi ileri rẹ̀, awa nreti awọn ọrun titun ati aiye titun, ninu eyiti ododo ngbé.
entries.en: Nevertheless we, according to his promise, look for new heavens and a new earth, wherein dwelleth righteousness.

entries.yo: Nitorina, olufẹ, bi ẹnyin ti nreti irú nkan wọnyi, ẹ mura giri, ki a le bá nyin li alafia, li ailabawọn, ati li ailàbuku li oju rẹ̀.
entries.en: Wherefore, beloved, seeing that ye look for such things, be diligent that ye may be found of him in peace, without spot, and blameless.

entries.yo: Ki ẹ si mã kà a si pe, sũru Oluwa wa igbala ni; bi Paulu pẹlu, arakunrin wa olufẹ, ti kọwe si nyin, gẹgẹ bi ọgbọ́n ti a fifun u;
entries.en: And account that the longsuffering of our Lord is salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also according to the wisdom given unto him hath written unto you;

entries.yo: Bi o ti nsọ̀rọ nkan wọnyi pẹlu ninu iwe rẹ̀ gbogbo; ninu eyi ti ohun miran ti o ṣòro lati yéni gbé wà, eyiti awọn òpè ati awọn alaiduro nibikan nlọ́, bi nwọn ti nlọ́ iwe mimọ́ iyoku, si iparun ara wọn.
entries.en: As also in all his epistles, speaking in them of these things; in which are some things hard to be understood, which they that are unlearned and unstable wrest, as they do also the other scriptures, unto their own destruction.

entries.yo: Nitorina ẹnyin olufẹ, bi ẹnyin ti mọ̀ nkan wọnyi tẹlẹ ẹ mã kiyesara, ki a má ba fi ìṣina awọn enia buburu fà nyin lọ, ki ẹ si ṣubu kuro ni iduro ṣinṣin nyin.
entries.en: Ye therefore, beloved, seeing ye know these things before, beware lest ye also, being led away with the error of the wicked, fall from your own stedfastness.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹ mã dàgba ninu õre-ọfẹ ati ninu ìmọ Oluwa ati Olugbala wa Jesu Kristi; ẹniti ogo wà fun nisisiyi ati titi lai. Amin.
entries.en: But grow in grace, and in the knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ. To him be glory both now and for ever. Amen.

entries.yo: EYITI o ti wà li àtetekọṣe, ti awa ti gbọ́, ti awa ti fi oju wa ri, ti awa si ti tẹjumọ, ti ọwọ́ wa si ti dìmu, niti Ọrọ ìye;
entries.en: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we have looked upon, and our hands have handled, of the Word of life;

entries.yo: (Ìye na si ti farahàn, awa si ti ri i, awa si njẹri, awa si nsọ ti ìye ainipẹkun na fun nyin, ti o ti mbẹ lọdọ Baba, ti o si farahàn fun wa;)
entries.en: (For the life was manifested, and we have seen it, and bear witness, and shew unto you that eternal life, which was with the Father, and was manifested unto us;)

entries.yo: Eyiti awa ti ri, ti awa si ti gbọ́ li awa nsọ fun nyin, ki ẹnyin pẹlu ki o le ní ìdapọ pẹlu wa: nitõtọ ìdapọ wa si mbẹ pẹlu Baba, ati pẹlu Ọmọ rẹ̀ Jesu Kristi.
entries.en: That which we have seen and heard declare we unto you, that ye also may have fellowship with us: and truly our fellowship is with the Father, and with his Son Jesus Christ.

entries.yo: Awa si kọwe nkan wọnyi si nyin, ki ayọ̀ nyin ki o le di kikún.
entries.en: And these things write we unto you, that your joy may be full.

entries.yo: Eyi si ni iṣẹ ti awa ti gbọ́ lẹnu rẹ̀ ti awa si njẹ́ fun nyin, pe imọlẹ li Ọlọrun, òkunkun kò si sí lọdọ rẹ̀ rara.
entries.en: This then is the message which we have heard of him, and declare unto you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.

entries.yo: Bi awa ba wipe awa ní ìdapọ pẹlu rẹ̀, ti awa si nrìn ninu òkunkun, awa nṣeke, awa kò si ṣe otitọ:
entries.en: If we say that we have fellowship with him, and walk in darkness, we lie, and do not the truth:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn bi awa ba nrìn ninu imọlẹ, bi on ti mbẹ ninu imọlẹ, awa ní ìdapọ pẹlu ara wa, ẹ̀jẹ Jesu Kristi Ọmọ rẹ̀ ni nwẹ̀ wa nù kuro ninu ẹṣẹ gbogbo.
entries.en: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship one with another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanseth us from all sin.

entries.yo: Bi awa ba wipe awa kò li ẹ̀ṣẹ, awa tàn ara wa jẹ, otitọ kò si si ninu wa.
entries.en: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.

entries.yo: Bi awa ba jẹwọ ẹ̀ṣẹ wa, olõtọ ati olododo li on lati dari ẹṣẹ wa jì wa, ati lati wẹ̀ wa nù kuro ninu aiṣododo gbogbo.
entries.en: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

entries.yo: Bi awa ba wipe awa kò dẹṣẹ̀, awa mu u li eke, ọ̀rọ rẹ̀ kò si si ninu wa.
entries.en: If we say that we have not sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.

entries.yo: ẸNYIN ọmọ mi, iwe nkan wọnyi ni mo kọ si nyin, ki ẹ má bã dẹṣẹ̀. Bi ẹnikẹni ba si dẹṣẹ̀, awa ni alagbawi lọdọ Baba, Jesu Kristi olododo:
entries.en: My little children, these things write I unto you, that ye sin not. And if any man sin, we have an advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous:

entries.yo: On si ni ètutu fun ẹ̀ṣẹ wa: kì si iṣe fun tiwa nikan, ṣugbọn fun ti gbogbo araiye pẹlu.
entries.en: And he is the propitiation for our sins: and not for ours only, but also for the sins of the whole world.

entries.yo: Nipa eyi li a si mọ̀ pe awa mọ̀ ọ, bi awa ba npa ofin rẹ̀ mọ́.
entries.en: And hereby we do know that we know him, if we keep his commandments.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba wipe, emi mọ̀ ọ, ti kò si pa ofin rẹ̀ mọ́, eke ni, otitọ kò si si ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: He that saith, I know him, and keepeth not his commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹnikẹni ti o ba npa ofin rẹ̀ mọ́, lara rẹ̀ li a gbé mu ifẹ Ọlọrun pé nitõtọ. Nipa eyi li awa mọ̀ pe awa mbẹ ninu rẹ̀,
entries.en: But whoso keepeth his word, in him verily is the love of God perfected: hereby know we that we are in him.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba wipe on ngbé inu rẹ̀, on na pẹlu si yẹ lati mã rìn gẹgẹ bi on ti rìn.
entries.en: He that saith he abideth in him ought himself also so to walk, even as he walked.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin olufẹ, ki iṣe ofin titun ni mo nkọwe rẹ̀ si nyin, ṣugbọn ofin atijọ ti ẹnyin ti ni li àtetekọṣe. Ofin atijọ ni ọ̀rọ na ti ẹnyin ti gbọ́.
entries.en: Brethren, I write no new commandment unto you, but an old commandment which ye had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which ye have heard from the beginning.

entries.yo: Ẹ̀wẹ, ofin titun ni mo nkọwe rẹ̀ si nyin, eyiti iṣe otitọ ninu rẹ̀ ati ninu nyin, nitori òkunkun nkọja lọ, imọlẹ otitọ si ti ntàn.
entries.en: Again, a new commandment I write unto you, which thing is true in him and in you: because the darkness is past, and the true light now shineth.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba wipe on mbẹ ninu imọlẹ, ti o si korira arakunrin rẹ̀, o mbẹ ninu òkunkun titi fi di isisiyi.
entries.en: He that saith he is in the light, and hateth his brother, is in darkness even until now.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba fẹran arakunrin rẹ̀, o ngbe inu imọlẹ, kò si si ohun ikọsẹ̀ ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: He that loveth his brother abideth in the light, and there is none occasion of stumbling in him.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹniti o ba korira arakunrin rẹ̀ o ngbe inu òkunkun, o si nrìn ninu òkunkun, kò si mọ̀ ibiti on nrè, nitoriti òkunkun ti fọ ọ li oju.
entries.en: But he that hateth his brother is in darkness, and walketh in darkness, and knoweth not whither he goeth, because that darkness hath blinded his eyes.

entries.yo: Emi nkọwe si nyin, ẹnyin ọmọ mi, nitoriti a dari ẹ̀ṣẹ nyin jì nyin nitori orukọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: I write unto you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name's sake.

entries.yo: Emi nkọwe si nyin, ẹnyin baba, nitoriti ẹnyin ti mọ̀ ẹniti o wà li àtetekọṣe. Emi nkọwe si nyin, ẹnyin ọdọmọkunrin, nitoriti ẹnyin ti ṣẹgun ẹni buburu nì. Emi nkọwe si nyin, ẹnyin ọmọ mi, nitori ẹnyin ti mọ̀ Baba.
entries.en: I write unto you, fathers, because ye have known him that is from the beginning. I write unto you, young men, because ye have overcome the wicked one. I write unto you, little children, because ye have known the Father.

entries.yo: Emi kọwe si nyin, ẹnyin baba, nitoriti ẹnyin ti mọ̀ ẹniti o wà li àtetekọṣe. Emi ti kọwe si nyin, ẹnyin ọdọmọkunrin, nitoriti ẹnyin li agbara, ti ọ̀rọ Ọlọrun si duro ninu nyin, ti ẹ si ṣẹgun ẹni buburu nì.
entries.en: I have written unto you, fathers, because ye have known him that is from the beginning. I have written unto you, young men, because ye are strong, and the word of God abideth in you, and ye have overcome the wicked one.

entries.yo: Ẹ máṣe fẹran aiye, tabi ohun ti mbẹ ninu aiye. Bi ẹnikẹni ba fẹran aiye, ifẹ ti Baba kò si ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world. If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him.

entries.yo: Nitori ohun gbogbo ti mbẹ li aiye, ifẹkufẹ ara, ati ifẹkufẹ oju, ati irera aiye, ki iṣe ti Baba, bikoṣe ti aiye.
entries.en: For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, and the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not of the Father, but is of the world.

entries.yo: Aiye si nkọja lọ, ati ifẹkufẹ rẹ̀: ṣugbọn ẹniti o ba nṣe ifẹ Ọlọrun ni yio duro lailai.
entries.en: And the world passeth away, and the lust thereof: but he that doeth the will of God abideth for ever.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin ọmọ mi, igba ikẹhin li eyi: bi ẹnyin si ti gbọ́ pe Aṣodisi-Kristi mbọ̀wá, ani nisisiyi Aṣodisi-Kristi pupọ̀ ni mbẹ; nipa eyiti awa fi mọ̀ pe igba ikẹhin li eyi.
entries.en: Little children, it is the last time: and as ye have heard that antichrist shall come, even now are there many antichrists; whereby we know that it is the last time.

entries.yo: Nwọn ti ọdọ wa jade, ṣugbọn nwọn ki iṣe ará wa; nitori nwọn iba ṣe ará wa, nwọn iba bá wa duro: ṣugbọn nwọn jade ki a le fi wọn hàn pe gbogbo nwọn ki iṣe ará wa.
entries.en: They went out from us, but they were not of us; for if they had been of us, they would no doubt have continued with us: but they went out, that they might be made manifest that they were not all of us.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹnyin ni ifororo-yan lati ọdọ Ẹni Mimọ́ nì wá, ẹnyin si mọ̀ ohun gbogbo.
entries.en: But ye have an unction from the Holy One, and ye know all things.

entries.yo: Emi kò kọwe si nyin nitoripe ẹnyin kò mọ̀ otitọ, ṣugbọn nitoriti ẹnyin mọ̀ ọ, ati pe kò si eke ninu otitọ.
entries.en: I have not written unto you because ye know not the truth, but because ye know it, and that no lie is of the truth.

entries.yo: Tani eke, bikoṣe ẹniti o ba sẹ́ pe Jesu kì iṣe Kristi? Eleyi ni Aṣodisi-Kristi, ẹniti o ba sẹ́ Baba ati Ọmọ.
entries.en: Who is a liar but he that denieth that Jesus is the Christ? He is antichrist, that denieth the Father and the Son.

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni ti o ba sẹ́ Ọmọ, on na ni kò gbà Baba: ṣugbọn ẹniti o ba jẹwọ Ọmọ, o gbà Baba pẹlu.
entries.en: Whosoever denieth the Son, the same hath not the Father: (but) he that acknowledgeth the Son hath the Father also.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹnyin, ki eyini ki o mã gbe inu nyin, ti ẹnyin ti gbọ́ li àtetekọṣe. Bi eyiti ẹnyin ti gbọ́ li àtetekọṣe ba ngbe inu nyin, ẹnyin ó si duro pẹlu ninu Ọmọ ati ninu Baba.
entries.en: Let that therefore abide in you, which ye have heard from the beginning. If that which ye have heard from the beginning shall remain in you, ye also shall continue in the Son, and in the Father.

entries.yo: Eyi si ni ileri na ti o ti ṣe fun wa, ani ìye ainipẹkun.
entries.en: And this is the promise that he hath promised us, even eternal life.

entries.yo: Nkan wọnyi ni mo kọwe si nyin niti awọn ti ntàn nyin jẹ.
entries.en: These things have I written unto you concerning them that seduce you.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ìfororó-yàn ti ẹnyin ti gbà lọwọ rẹ̀, o ngbe inu nyin, ẹnyin kò si ni pe ẹnikan nkọ́ nyin: ṣugbọn ìfororó-yàn na nkọ́ nyin li ohun gbogbo ti o jẹ otitọ, ti kì si iṣe èké, ani gẹgẹ bi o si ti kọ́ nyin, ẹ mã gbe inu rẹ̀.
entries.en: But the anointing which ye have received of him abideth in you, and ye need not that any man teach you: but as the same anointing teacheth you of all things, and is truth, and is no lie, and even as it hath taught you, ye shall abide in him.

entries.yo: Ati nisisiyi, ẹnyin ọmọ mi, ẹ mã gbe inu rẹ̀; pe, nigbati on o ba farahàn, ki a le ni igboiya niwaju rẹ̀, ki oju má si tì wa niwaju rẹ̀ ni igba wiwá rẹ̀.
entries.en: And now, little children, abide in him; that, when he shall appear, we may have confidence, and not be ashamed before him at his coming.

entries.yo: Bi ẹnyin ba mọ̀ pe olododo ni on, ẹ mọ̀ pe a bi olukuluku ẹniti nṣe ododo nipa rẹ̀.
entries.en: If ye know that he is righteous, ye know that every one that doeth righteousness is born of him.

entries.yo: Ẹ wo irú ifẹ ti Baba fi fẹ wa, ti a fi npè wa ni ọmọ Ọlọrun; bẹ̃ li a sa jẹ. Nitori eyi li aiye kò ṣe mọ̀ wa, nitoriti ko mọ̀ ọ.
entries.en: Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God: therefore the world knoweth us not, because it knew him not.

entries.yo: Olufẹ, ọmọ Ọlọrun li awa iṣe nisisiyi, a kò si ti ifihàn bi awa ó ti ri: awa mọ pe, nigbati a bá fihan, a ó dabi rẹ̀; nitori awa o ri i ani bi on ti ri.
entries.en: Beloved, now are we the sons of God, and it doth not yet appear what we shall be: but we know that, when he shall appear, we shall be like him; for we shall see him as he is.

entries.yo: Olukuluku ẹniti o ba si ni ireti yi ninu rẹ̀, a wẹ̀ ara rẹ̀ mọ́, ani bi on ti mọ́.
entries.en: And every man that hath this hope in him purifieth himself, even as he is pure.

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni ti o ba ndẹṣẹ o nrú ofin pẹlu: nitori ẹ̀ṣẹ ni riru ofin.
entries.en: Whosoever committeth sin transgresseth also the law: for sin is the transgression of the law.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin si mọ̀ pe, on farahàn lati mu ẹ̀ṣẹ kuro; ẹ̀ṣẹ kò si si ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And ye know that he was manifested to take away our sins; and in him is no sin.

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni ti o ba ngbé inu rẹ̀ ki idẹṣẹ; ẹnikẹni ti o ba ndẹṣẹ kò ri i, bẹ̃ni kò mọ̀ ọ.
entries.en: Whosoever abideth in him sinneth not: whosoever sinneth hath not seen him, neither known him.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin ọmọ mi, ẹ máṣe jẹ ki ẹnikẹni ki o tàn nyin: ẹniti o ba nṣe ododo, o jasi olododo, gẹgẹ bi on ti iṣe olododo.
entries.en: Little children, let no man deceive you: he that doeth righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba ndẹṣẹ ti Èṣu ni; nitori lati àtetekọṣe ni Èṣu ti ndẹṣẹ. Nitori eyi li Ọmọ Ọlọrun ṣe farahàn, ki o le pa iṣẹ Èṣu run.
entries.en: He that committeth sin is of the devil; for the devil sinneth from the beginning. For this purpose the Son of God was manifested, that he might destroy the works of the devil.

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni ti a ti ipa Ọlọrun bí, ki idẹṣẹ; nitoriti irú rẹ̀ ngbe inu rẹ̀: kò si le dẹṣẹ nitoripe a ti ti ipa Ọlọrun bi i.
entries.en: Whosoever is born of God doth not commit sin; for his seed remaineth in him: and he cannot sin, because he is born of God.

entries.yo: Ninu eyi li awọn ọmọ Ọlọrun nfarahan, ati awọn ọmọ Èṣu: ẹnikẹni ti kò ba nṣe ododo kì iṣe ti Ọlọrun, ati ẹniti kò fẹràn arakunrin rẹ̀.
entries.en: In this the children of God are manifest, and the children of the devil: whosoever doeth not righteousness is not of God, neither he that loveth not his brother.

entries.yo: Nitori eyi ni iṣẹ ti ẹnyin ti gbọ́ li àtetekọṣe, ki awa ki o fẹràn ara wa.
entries.en: For this is the message that ye heard from the beginning, that we should love one another.

entries.yo: Ki iṣe bi Kaini, ti jẹ́ ti ẹni buburu nì, ti o si pa arakunrin rẹ̀. Nitori kili o si ṣe pa a? Nitoriti iṣẹ on jẹ buburu, ti arakunrin rẹ̀ si jẹ ododo.
entries.en: Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother's righteous.

entries.yo: Ki ẹnu ki o máṣe yà nyin, ẹnyin ará mi, bi aiye ba korira nyin.
entries.en: Marvel not, my brethren, if the world hate you.

entries.yo: Awa mọ̀ pe awa ti rekọja lati inu ikú sinu ìye, nitoriti awa fẹràn awọn ará. Ẹniti kò ba ni ifẹ o ngbé inu ikú.
entries.en: We know that we have passed from death unto life, because we love the brethren. He that loveth not his brother abideth in death.

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni ti o ba korira arakunrin rẹ̀ apania ni: ẹnyin si mọ̀ pe kò si apania ti o ni ìye ainipẹkun lati mã gbé inu rẹ̀.
entries.en: Whosoever hateth his brother is a murderer: and ye know that no murderer hath eternal life abiding in him.

entries.yo: Nipa eyi li awa mọ̀ ifẹ nitoriti o fi ẹmí rẹ̀ lelẹ fun wa: o si yẹ ki awa fi ẹmí wa lelẹ fun awọn ará.
entries.en: Hereby perceive we the love of God, because he laid down his life for us: and we ought to lay down our lives for the brethren.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹniti o ba ni ohun ini aiye, ti o si ri arakunrin rẹ̀ ti iṣe alaini, ti o si sé ilẹkun ìyọ́nu rẹ̀ mọ ọ, bawo ni ifẹ Ọlọrun ti ngbé inu rẹ̀?
entries.en: But whoso hath this world's good, and seeth his brother have need, and shutteth up his bowels of compassion from him, how dwelleth the love of God in him?

entries.yo: Ẹnyin ọmọ mi, ẹ máṣe jẹ ki a fi ọrọ tabi ahọn fẹran, bikoṣe ni iṣe ati li otitọ.
entries.en: My little children, let us not love in word, neither in tongue; but in deed and in truth.

entries.yo: Ati nipa eyi li awa ó mọ̀ pe awa jẹ ti otitọ, ati pe awa o si dá ara wa loju niwaju rẹ̀,
entries.en: And hereby we know that we are of the truth, and shall assure our hearts before him.

entries.yo: Ninu ohunkohun ti ọkàn wa ba ndá wa lẹbi; nitoripe Ọlọrun tobi jù ọkàn wa lọ, o si mọ̀ ohun gbogbo.
entries.en: For if our heart condemn us, God is greater than our heart, and knoweth all things.

entries.yo: Olufẹ, bi ọkàn wa kò ba dá wa lẹbi, njẹ awa ni igboiya niwaju Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Beloved, if our heart condemn us not, then have we confidence toward God.

entries.yo: Ati ohunkohun ti awa ba bère, awa nri gbà lọdọ rẹ̀, nitoriti awa npa ofin rẹ̀ mọ́, awa si nṣe nkan wọnni ti o dara loju rẹ̀.
entries.en: And whatsoever we ask, we receive of him, because we keep his commandments, and do those things that are pleasing in his sight.

entries.yo: Eyi si li ofin rẹ̀, pe ki awa ki o gbà orukọ Jesu Kristi Ọmọ rẹ̀ gbọ́, ki a si fẹràn ara wa, gẹgẹ bi o ti fi ofin fun wa.
entries.en: And this is his commandment, That we should believe on the name of his Son Jesus Christ, and love one another, as he gave us commandment.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba si pa ofin rẹ̀ mọ́ ngbé inu rẹ̀, ati on ninu rẹ̀. Ati nipa eyi li awa mọ̀ pe o ngbé inu wa, nipa Ẹmí ti o fifun wa.
entries.en: And he that keepeth his commandments dwelleth in him, and he in him. And hereby we know that he abideth in us, by the Spirit which he hath given us.

entries.yo: OLUFẸ, ẹ máṣe gbà gbogbo ẹmí gbọ́, ṣugbọn ẹ dán awọn ẹmí wò bi nwọn ba ṣe ti Ọlọrun: nitori awọn woli eke pupọ̀ ti jade lọ sinu aiye.
entries.en: Beloved, believe not every spirit, but try the spirits whether they are of God: because many false prophets are gone out into the world.

entries.yo: Eyi li ẹ o fi mọ̀ Ẹmí Ọlọrun: gbogbo ẹmí ti o ba jẹwọ pe, Jesu Kristi wá ninu ara, ti Ọlọrun ni:
entries.en: Hereby know ye the Spirit of God: Every spirit that confesseth that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is of God:

entries.yo: Gbogbo ẹmí ti kò si jẹwọ pe, Jesu Kristi wá ninu ara, kì iṣe ti Ọlọrun: eyi si li ẹmí Aṣodisi-Kristi na, ti ẹnyin ti gbọ́ pe o mbọ̀, ati nisisiyi o si ti de sinu aiye.
entries.en: And every spirit that confesseth not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is not of God: and this is that spirit of antichrist, whereof ye have heard that it should come; and even now already is it in the world.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin ọmọ mi, ti Ọlọrun li ẹnyin, ẹnyin si ti ṣẹgun wọn: nitori ẹniti mbẹ ninu nyin tobi jù ẹniti mbẹ ninu aiye lọ.
entries.en: Ye are of God, little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you, than he that is in the world.

entries.yo: Ti aiye ni nwọn, nitorina ni nwọn ṣe nsọrọ bi ẹni ti aiye, aiye si ngbọ́ ti wọn.
entries.en: They are of the world: therefore speak they of the world, and the world heareth them.

entries.yo: Ti Ọlọrun li awa: ẹniti o ba mọ̀ Ọlọrun o ngbọ́ ti wa: ẹniti kì ba nṣe ti Ọlọrun kò ngbọ́ ti wa. Nipa eyi li awa mọ̀ ẹmí otitọ, ati ẹmí eke.
entries.en: We are of God: he that knoweth God heareth us; he that is not of God heareth not us. Hereby know we the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.

entries.yo: Olufẹ, ẹ jẹ ki a fẹràn ara wa: nitori ifẹ ti ọdọ Ọlọrun wá; ati gbogbo ẹniti o ba ni ifẹ, a bí i nipa ti Ọlọrun, o si mọ̀ Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Beloved, let us love one another: for love is of God; and every one that loveth is born of God, and knoweth God.

entries.yo: Ẹniti kò ba ni ifẹ kò mọ̀ Ọlọrun: nitoripe ifẹ ni Ọlọrun.
entries.en: He that loveth not knoweth not God; for God is love.

entries.yo: Nipa eyi li a gbé fi ifẹ Ọlọrun hàn ninu wa, nitoriti Ọlọrun rán Ọmọ bíbi rẹ̀ nikanṣoṣo si aiye, ki awa ki o le yè nipasẹ rẹ̀.
entries.en: In this was manifested the love of God toward us, because that God sent his only begotten Son into the world, that we might live through him.

entries.yo: Ninu eyi ni ifẹ wà, kì iṣe pe awa fẹ Ọlọrun, ṣugbọn on fẹ wa, o si rán Ọmọ rẹ̀ lati jẹ ètutu fun ẹ̀ṣẹ wa.
entries.en: Herein is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son to be the propitiation for our sins.

entries.yo: Olufẹ, bi Ọlọrun ba fẹ wa bayi, o yẹ ki a fẹràn ara wa pẹlu.
entries.en: Beloved, if God so loved us, we ought also to love one another.

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni kò ri Ọlọrun nigba kan ri. Bi awa ba fẹràn ara wa, Ọlọrun ngbé inu wa, a si mu ifẹ rẹ̀ pé ninu wa.
entries.en: No man hath seen God at any time. If we love one another, God dwelleth in us, and his love is perfected in us.

entries.yo: Nipa eyi li awa mọ̀ pe awa ngbé inu rẹ̀, ati on ninu wa, nitoriti o ti fi Ẹmí rẹ̀ fun wa.
entries.en: Hereby know we that we dwell in him, and he in us, because he hath given us of his Spirit.

entries.yo: Awa ti ri, a si jẹri, pe Baba rán Ọmọ rẹ̀ lati jẹ́ Olugbala fun araiye.
entries.en: And we have seen and do testify that the Father sent the Son to be the Saviour of the world.

entries.yo: Ẹnikẹni ti o ba jẹwọ pe Jesu Ọmọ Ọlọrun ni, Ọlọrun ngbé inu rẹ̀, ati on ninu Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Whosoever shall confess that Jesus is the Son of God, God dwelleth in him, and he in God.

entries.yo: Awa ti mọ̀, a si gbà ifẹ ti Ọlọrun ní si wa gbọ́. Ifẹ ni Ọlọrun; ẹniti o ba si ngbé inu ifẹ o ngbé inu Ọlọrun, ati Ọlọrun ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And we have known and believed the love that God hath to us. God is love; and he that dwelleth in love dwelleth in God, and God in him.

entries.yo: Ninu eyi li a mu ifẹ ti o wà ninu wa pé, ki awa ki o le ni igboiya li ọjọ idajọ: nitoripe bi on ti ri, bẹ̃li awa si ri li aiye yi.
entries.en: Herein is our love made perfect, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment: because as he is, so are we in this world.

entries.yo: Ìbẹru kò si ninu ifẹ; ṣugbọn ifẹ ti o pé nlé ibẹru jade: nitoriti ìbẹru ni iyà ninu. Ẹniti o bẹ̀ru kò pé ninu ifẹ.
entries.en: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear: because fear hath torment. He that feareth is not made perfect in love.

entries.yo: Awa fẹran rẹ̀ nitori on li o kọ́ fẹran wa.
entries.en: We love him, because he first loved us.

entries.yo: Bi ẹnikẹni ba wipe, Emi fẹran Ọlọrun, ti o si korira arakunrin rẹ̀, eke ni: nitori ẹniti kò fẹran arakunrin rẹ̀ ti o ri, bawo ni yio ti ṣe le fẹran Ọlọrun ti on kò ri?
entries.en: If a man say, I love God, and hateth his brother, he is a liar: for he that loveth not his brother whom he hath seen, how can he love God whom he hath not seen?

entries.yo: Ofin yi li awa si ri gbà lati ọwọ́ rẹ̀ wá, pe ẹniti o ba fẹran Ọlọrun ki o fẹran arakunrin rẹ̀ pẹlu.
entries.en: And this commandment have we from him, That he who loveth God love his brother also.

entries.yo: OLUKULUKU ẹniti o ba gbagbọ́ pe Jesu ni Kristi, a bí i nipa ti Ọlọrun: ati gbogbo ẹniti o fẹran ẹniti o bí ni, o fẹran ẹniti a bí nipasẹ rẹ̀ pẹlu.
entries.en: Whosoever believeth that Jesus is the Christ is born of God: and every one that loveth him that begat loveth him also that is begotten of him.

entries.yo: Nipa eyi li awa mọ̀ pe awa fẹran awọn ọmọ Ọlọrun, nigbati awa fẹran Ọlọrun, ti a si npa ofin rẹ̀ mọ́.
