entries.en: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God, and keep his commandments.

entries.yo: Nitori eyi ni ifẹ Ọlọrun, pe ki awa ki o pa ofin rẹ̀ mọ́: ofin rẹ̀ kò si nira.
entries.en: For this is the love of God, that we keep his commandments: and his commandments are not grievous.

entries.yo: Nitori olukuluku ẹniti a bí nipa ti Ọlọrun o ṣẹgun aiye: eyi si ni iṣẹgun ti o ṣẹgun aiye, ani igbagbọ́ wa.
entries.en: For whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world: and this is the victory that overcometh the world, even our faith.

entries.yo: Tani ẹniti o ṣẹgun aiye, bikoṣe ẹniti o gbagbọ́ pe Ọmọ Ọlọrun ni Jesu iṣe?
entries.en: Who is he that overcometh the world, but he that believeth that Jesus is the Son of God?

entries.yo: Eyi li ẹniti o wá, pẹlu omi ati ẹjẹ̀, ani Jesu Kristi, kì iṣe pẹlu omi nikan, bikoṣe pẹlu omi ati ẹ̀jẹ. Ẹmí li o si njẹri, nitoripe otitọ li Ẹmí.
entries.en: This is he that came by water and blood, even Jesus Christ; not by water only, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit that beareth witness, because the Spirit is truth.

entries.yo: Nitoripe awọn mẹta li o njẹri li ọrun, Baba, Ọrọ̀, ati Ẹmi Mimọ; awọn mẹtẹ̃ta yi si jẹ ọ̀kan
entries.en: For there are three that bear record in heaven, the Father, the Word, and the Holy Ghost: and these three are one.

entries.yo: Nitoripe awọn mẹta li o njẹri, Ẹmí, ati omi, ati ẹ̀jẹ: awọn mẹtẹ̃ta sì fi ohun ṣọkan.
entries.en: And there are three that bear witness in earth, the spirit, and the water, and the blood: and these three agree in one.

entries.yo: Bi awa ba ngbà ẹ̀rí enia, ẹ̀rí Ọlọrun tobi ju: nitọri ẹri Ọlọrun li eyi pe O ti jẹri niti Ọmọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater: for this is the witness of God which he hath testified of his Son.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba gbà Ọmọ Ọlọrun gbọ́, o ni ẹrí ninu ara rẹ̀: ẹniti kò ba gbà Ọlọrun gbọ́, o ti mu u li eke; nitori kò gbà ẹrí na gbọ́ ti Ọlọrun jẹ niti Ọmọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: He that believeth on the Son of God hath the witness in himself: he that believeth not God hath made him a liar; because he believeth not the record that God gave of his Son.

entries.yo: Ẹ̀rí na si li eyi pe Ọlọrun fun wa ni ìye ainipẹkun, ìye yi si mbẹ ninu Ọmọ rẹ̀.
entries.en: And this is the record, that God hath given to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.

entries.yo: Ẹniti o ba ni Ọmọ, o ni ìye; ẹniti kò ba si ni Ọmọ Ọlọrun, kò ni ìye.
entries.en: He that hath the Son hath life; and he that hath not the Son of God hath not life.

entries.yo: Nkan wọnyi ni mo kọwe rẹ̀ si nyin ani si ẹnyin ti o gbà orukọ Ọmọ Ọlọrun gbọ́; ki ẹnyin ki o le mọ̀ pe ẹnyin ni iye ainipẹkun, ani fun ẹnyin ti o gbà orukọ Ọmọ Ọlọrun gbọ́.
entries.en: These things have I written unto you that believe on the name of the Son of God; that ye may know that ye have eternal life, and that ye may believe on the name of the Son of God.

entries.yo: Eyi si ni igboiya ti awa ni niwaju rẹ̀, pe bi awa ba bère ohunkohun gẹgẹ bi ifẹ rẹ̀, o ngbọ ti wa:
entries.en: And this is the confidence that we have in him, that, if we ask any thing according to his will, he heareth us:

entries.yo: Bi awa ba si mọ̀ pe o ngbọ́ ti wa, ohunkohun ti awa ba bère, awa mọ̀ pe awa rí ibere ti awa ti bère lọdọ rẹ̀ gbà.
entries.en: And if we know that he hear us, whatsoever we ask, we know that we have the petitions that we desired of him.

entries.yo: Bi ẹnikẹni ba ri arakunrin rẹ̀ ti ndá ẹ̀ṣẹ ti kì iṣe si ikú, on o bère, On o si fun ni ìye fun awọn ti ndá ẹ̀ṣẹ ti ki iṣe si ikú. Ẹṣẹ kan mbẹ si ikú: emi kò wipe ki on ki o gbadura fun eyi.
entries.en: If any man see his brother sin a sin which is not unto death, he shall ask, and he shall give him life for them that sin not unto death. There is a sin unto death: I do not say that he shall pray for it.

entries.yo: Gbogbo aiṣododo ni ẹ̀ṣẹ: ẹṣẹ̀ kan sì mbẹ ti ki iṣe si ikú.
entries.en: All unrighteousness is sin: and there is a sin not unto death.

entries.yo: Awa mọ̀ pe ẹnikẹni ti a bí nipa ti Ọlọrun kì idẹṣẹ: ṣugbọn ẹniti a bí nipa ti Ọlọrun a mã pa ara rẹ̀ mọ́, ẹni buburu nì ki si ifọwọ́kàn a.
entries.en: We know that whosoever is born of God sinneth not; but he that is begotten of God keepeth himself, and that wicked one toucheth him not.

entries.yo: Awa mọ̀ pe ti Ọlọrun ni wa, ati gbogbo aiye li o wa ni agbara ẹni buburu nì.
entries.en: And we know that we are of God, and the whole world lieth in wickedness.

entries.yo: Awa si mọ̀ pe Ọmọ Ọlọrun de, o si ti fi òye fun wa, ki awa ki o le mọ̀ ẹniti iṣe otitọ, awa si mbẹ ninu ẹniti iṣe otitọ, ani ninu Ọmọ rẹ̀ Jesu Kristi. Eyi li Ọlọrun otitọ, ati ìye ainipẹkun.
entries.en: And we know that the Son of God is come, and hath given us an understanding, that we may know him that is true, and we are in him that is true, even in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God, and eternal life.

entries.yo: Ẹnyin ọmọ mi, ẹ pa ara nyin mọ́ kuro ninu oriṣa. Amin.
entries.en: Little children, keep yourselves from idols. Amen.

entries.yo: EMI alàgba si ayanfẹ obinrin ọlọlá ati awọn ọmọ rẹ̀, awọn ti mo fẹ li otitọ; kì si iṣe emi nikan, ṣugbọn gbogbo awọn ti o mọ̀ otitọ pẹlu;
entries.en: The elder unto the elect lady and her children, whom I love in the truth; and not I only, but also all they that have known the truth;

entries.yo: Nitori otitọ ti ngbé inu wa, yio si mã ba wa gbé titi.
entries.en: For the truth's sake, which dwelleth in us, and shall be with us for ever.

entries.yo: Õre-ọfẹ, ãnu, ati alafia, yio wà pẹlu wa, lati ọdọ Ọlọrun Baba, ati lati ọdọ Jesu Kristi, Ọmọ Baba, ninu otitọ ati ninu ifẹ.
entries.en: Grace be with you, mercy, and peace, from God the Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.

entries.yo: Mo yọ̀ gidigidi pe mo ti ri ninu awọn ọmọ rẹ ti nrin ninu otitọ, ani bi awa ti gbà ofin lati ọdọ Baba.
entries.en: I rejoiced greatly that I found of thy children walking in truth, as we have received a commandment from the Father.

entries.yo: Njẹ nisisiyi mo bẹ̀ ọ, obinrin ọlọlá, kì iṣe bi ẹnipe emi nkọwe ofin titun kan si ọ, bikọse eyi ti awa ti ni li àtetekọṣe, pe ki awa ki o fẹràn ara wa.
entries.en: And now I beseech thee, lady, not as though I wrote a new commandment unto thee, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.

entries.yo: Eyi si ni ifẹ, pe, ki awa ki o mã rìn nipa ofin rẹ̀. Eyi li ofin na, ani bi ẹ ti gbọ́ li àtetekọṣe, pe, ki ẹnyin ki o mã rìn ninu rẹ̀.
entries.en: And this is love, that we walk after his commandments. This is the commandment, That, as ye have heard from the beginning, ye should walk in it.

entries.yo: Nitori ẹlẹtàn pupọ̀ ti jade wá sinu aiye, awọn ti kò jẹwọ pe Jesu Kristi wá ninu ara. Eyi li ẹlẹtàn ati Aṣodisi Kristi.
entries.en: For many deceivers are entered into the world, who confess not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh. This is a deceiver and an antichrist.

entries.yo: Ẹ kiyesara nyin, ki ẹ má sọ iṣẹ ti awa ti ṣe nù, ṣugbọn ki ẹnyin ki o ri ère kíkún gbà.
entries.en: Look to yourselves, that we lose not those things which we have wrought, but that we receive a full reward.

entries.yo: Olukuluku ẹniti o ba nru ofin ti kò si duro ninu ẹkọ́ Kristi, kò gba Ọlọrun. Ẹniti o ba duro ninu ẹkọ́, on li o gbà ati Baba ati Ọmọ.
entries.en: Whosoever transgresseth, and abideth not in the doctrine of Christ, hath not God. He that abideth in the doctrine of Christ, he hath both the Father and the Son.

entries.yo: Bi ẹnikẹni bá tọ̀ nyin wá, ti kò si mu ẹkọ́ yi wá, ẹ máṣe gbà a si ile, ki ẹ má si ṣe kí i.
entries.en: If there come any unto you, and bring not this doctrine, receive him not into your house, neither bid him God speed:

entries.yo: Nitori ẹniti o ba ki i, o ni ọwọ́ ninu iṣẹ buburu rẹ̀.
entries.en: For he that biddeth him God speed is partaker of his evil deeds.

entries.yo: Bi mo ti ni ohun pupọ̀ lati kọwe si nyin, emi kò fẹ lo tákàdá ati tàdãwa. Ṣugbọn emi ni ireti lati tọ nyin wá ati lati ba nyin sọrọ lojukoju, ki ayọ̀ nyin ki o le kún.
entries.en: Having many things to write unto you, I would not write with paper and ink: but I trust to come unto you, and speak face to face, that our joy may be full.

entries.yo: Awọn ọmọ arabinrin rẹ ayanfẹ ki ọ. Amin.
entries.en: The children of thy elect sister greet thee. Amen.

entries.yo: ALÀGBA si Gaiu olufẹ, ẹniti mo fẹ ninu otitọ.
entries.en: The elder unto the wellbeloved Gaius, whom I love in the truth.

entries.yo: Olufẹ, emi ngbadura pe ninu ohun gbogbo ki o le mã dara fun ọ, ki o si mã wà ni ilera, ani bi o ti dara fun ọkàn rẹ.
entries.en: Beloved, I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health, even as thy soul prospereth.

entries.yo: Nitori mo yọ̀ gidigidi, nigbati awọn arakunrin de ti nwọn si jẹri si otitọ rẹ, ani bi iwọ ti nrìn ninu otitọ.
entries.en: For I rejoiced greatly, when the brethren came and testified of the truth that is in thee, even as thou walkest in the truth.

entries.yo: Emi kò ni ayọ̀ ti o pọjù eyi lọ, ki emi ki o mã gbọ́ pe, awọn ọmọ mi nrìn ninu otitọ.
entries.en: I have no greater joy than to hear that my children walk in truth.

entries.yo: Olufẹ, iwọ nṣe iṣẹ igbagbọ li ohunkohun ti o bá nṣe fun awọn ti iṣe ará ati fun awọn alejò;
entries.en: Beloved, thou doest faithfully whatsoever thou doest to the brethren, and to strangers;

entries.yo: Ti nwọn jẹri ifẹ rẹ niwaju ijọ: bi ìwọ bá npese fun wọn li ọna ajo wọn bi o ti yẹ nipa ti Ọlọrun, iwọ o ṣe ohun ti o dara.
entries.en: Which have borne witness of thy charity before the church: whom if thou bring forward on their journey after a godly sort, thou shalt do well:

entries.yo: Nitoripe nitori orukọ rẹ̀ ni nwọn ṣe jade lọ, li aigbà ohunkohun lọwọ awọn Keferi.
entries.en: Because that for his name's sake they went forth, taking nothing of the Gentiles.

entries.yo: Njẹ o yẹ ki awa ki o gbà irú awọn wọnni, ki awa ki o le jẹ́ alabaṣiṣẹpọ pẹlu otitọ.
entries.en: We therefore ought to receive such, that we might be fellowhelpers to the truth.

entries.yo: Emi kọwe si ijọ: ṣugbọn Diotrefe, ẹniti o fẹ lati jẹ olori larin wọn, kò gbà wa.
entries.en: I wrote unto the church: but Diotrephes, who loveth to have the preeminence among them, receiveth us not.

entries.yo: Nitorina bi mo ba de, emi o mu iṣẹ rẹ̀ ti o ṣe wá si iranti, ti o nsọ ọrọ buburu ati isọkusọ si wa: eyini kò si tẹ́ ẹ lọrùn, bẹ̃ni on tikararẹ̀ kò gbà awọn ará, awọn ti o si nfẹ gbà wọn, o ndá wọn lẹkun, o si nlé wọn jade kuro ninu ijọ.
entries.en: Wherefore, if I come, I will remember his deeds which he doeth, prating against us with malicious words: and not content therewith, neither doth he himself receive the brethren, and forbiddeth them that would, and casteth them out of the church.

entries.yo: Olufẹ, máṣe afarawe ohun ti iṣe ibi, bikoṣe ohun ti iṣe rere. Ẹniti o ba nṣe rere ti Ọlọrun ni: ẹniti o ba nṣe buburu kò ri Ọlọrun.
entries.en: Beloved, follow not that which is evil, but that which is good. He that doeth good is of God: but he that doeth evil hath not seen God.

entries.yo: Demetriu li ẹri rere lọdọ gbogbo enia ati ti otitọ tikararẹ̀ pẹlu: nitõtọ, awa pẹlu si gbà ẹrí rẹ̀ jẹ; ẹnyin si mọ̀ pe otitọ ni ẹrí wa.
entries.en: Demetrius hath good report of all men, and of the truth itself: yea, and we also bear record; and ye know that our record is true.

entries.yo: Emi ní ohun pupọ̀ lati kọwe si ọ, ṣugbọn emi kò fẹ fi tàdãwa on kalamu kọ wọn.
entries.en: I had many things to write, but I will not with ink and pen write unto thee:

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn mo ni ireti lati ri ọ laipẹ, a o si sọrọ li ojukoju.
entries.en: But I trust I shall shortly see thee, and we shall speak face to face. Peace be to thee. Our friends salute thee. Greet the friends by name.

entries.yo: Alafia fun ọ. Awọn ọrẹ́ kí ọ. Kí awọn ọrẹ́ li ọkọ̃kan.
JUDA, iranṣẹ Jesu Kristi, ati arakunrin Jakọbu, si awọn ti a pè, olufẹ ninu Ọlọrun Baba, ti a si pamọ́ fun Jesu Kristi:
entries.en: Jude, the servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, to them that are sanctified by God the Father, and preserved in Jesus Christ, and called:

entries.yo: Ki ãnu, ati alafia, ati ifẹ ki o mã bi si i fun nyin.
entries.en: Mercy unto you, and peace, and love, be multiplied.

entries.yo: Olufẹ, nigbati mo fi aisimi gbogbo kọwe si nyin niti igbala ti iṣe ti gbogbo enia, nko gbọdọ ṣaima kọwé si nyin, ki n si gbà nyin niyanju lati mã ja gidigidi fun igbagbọ́, ti a ti fi lé awọn enia mimọ́ lọwọ lẹ̃kanṣoṣo.
entries.en: Beloved, when I gave all diligence to write unto you of the common salvation, it was needful for me to write unto you, and exhort you that ye should earnestly contend for the faith which was once delivered unto the saints.

entries.yo: Nitori awọn enia kan mbẹ ti nwọn nyọ́ wọle, awọn ẹniti a ti yàn lati igbà atijọ si ẹbi yi, awọn alaiwa-bi-Ọlọrun, ti nyi ore-ọfẹ Ọlọrun wa pada si wọbia, ti nwọn si nsẹ́ Oluwa wa kanṣoṣo na, ani Jesu Kristi Oluwa.
entries.en: For there are certain men crept in unawares, who were before of old ordained to this condemnation, ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into lasciviousness, and denying the only Lord God, and our Lord Jesus Christ.

entries.yo: Njẹ emi nfẹ lati rán nyin leti bi ẹnyin tilẹ ti mọ̀ gbogbo rẹ̀ lẹ̃kan ri, pe Oluwa, nigbati o ti gbà awọn enia kan là lati ilẹ Egipti wá, lẹhinna o run awọn ti kò gbagbọ́.
entries.en: I will therefore put you in remembrance, though ye once knew this, how that the Lord, having saved the people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed them that believed not.

entries.yo: Ati awọn angẹli ti kò tọju ipò ọla wọn ṣugbọn ti nwọn fi ipò wọn silẹ, awọn ni o pamọ́ ninu ẹ̀wọn ainipẹkun nisalẹ òkunkun de idajọ ọjọ nla nì.
entries.en: And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.

entries.yo: Ani bi Sodomu ati Gomorra, ati awọn ilu agbegbe wọn, ti fi ara wọn fun àgbere iṣe bakanna, ti nwọn si ntẹle ara ajeji lẹhin, awọn li a fi lelẹ bi apẹrẹ, nwọn njìya iná ainipẹkun.
entries.en: Even as Sodom and Gomorrha, and the cities about them in like manner, giving themselves over to fornication, and going after strange flesh, are set forth for an example, suffering the vengeance of eternal fire.

entries.yo: Bakanna ni awọn wọnyi pẹlu nsọ ara di ẽri ninu àlá wọn, nwọn si ngan ijoye, nwọn si nsọ̀rọ buburu si awọn ọlọlá.
entries.en: Likewise also these filthy dreamers defile the flesh, despise dominion, and speak evil of dignities.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn Mikaeli, olori awọn angẹli, nigbati o mba Èṣu jà, ti o nṣì jijakadi nitori okú Mose, kò si gbọdọ sọ ọ̀rọ-odi si i, ṣugbọn o wipe, Oluwa ni yio ba ọ wi.
entries.en: Yet Michael the archangel, when contending with the devil he disputed about the body of Moses, durst not bring against him a railing accusation, but said, The Lord rebuke thee.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn awọn wọnyi nsọ̀rọ-òdi si ohun gbogbo ti nwọn kò mọ̀: ṣugbọn ohun gbogbo ti nwọn mọ̀ nipa ẹda, bi ẹranko tí kò ni iyè, ninu nkan wọnyi ni nwọn di ẹni iparun.
entries.en: But these speak evil of those things which they know not: but what they know naturally, as brute beasts, in those things they corrupt themselves.

entries.yo: Egbé ni fun wọn! nitoriti nwọn ti rìn li ọ̀na Kaini, nwọn si fi iwọra súré sinu ìṣina Balaamu nitori ère, nwọn si ṣegbé ninu iṣọtẹ̀ Kora.
entries.en: Woe unto them! for they have gone in the way of Cain, and ran greedily after the error of Balaam for reward, and perished in the gainsaying of Core.

entries.yo: Awọn wọnyi li o jẹ abawọn ninu àse ifẹ nyin, nigbati nwọn mba nyin jẹ ase, awọn oluṣọ-agutan ti mbọ́ ara wọn laibẹru: ikũku laini omi, ti a nti ọwọ afẹfẹ gbá kiri: awọn igi alaileso li akoko eso, nwọn kú lẹ̃meji, a fà wọn tu ti gbongbo ti gbongbo;
entries.en: These are spots in your feasts of charity, when they feast with you, feeding themselves without fear: clouds they are without water, carried about of winds; trees whose fruit withereth, without fruit, twice dead, plucked up by the roots;

entries.yo: Omi okun ti nrú, ti nhó ifõfó itiju ara wọn jade; alarinkiri irawọ, awọn ti a pa òkunkun biribiri mọ́ dè lailai.
entries.en: Raging waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, to whom is reserved the blackness of darkness for ever.

entries.yo: Awọn wọnyi pẹlu ni Enoku, ẹni keje lati ọdọ Adamu, sọtẹlẹ fun, wipe Kiyesi i, Oluwa mbọ̀ pẹlu ẹgbẹgbãrun awọn enia rẹ̀ mimọ́,
entries.en: And Enoch also, the seventh from Adam, prophesied of these, saying, Behold, the Lord cometh with ten thousands of his saints,

entries.yo: Lati ṣe idajọ gbogbo enia, lati dá gbogbo awọn alaiwa-bi-Ọlorun lẹbi niti gbogbo iṣe aiwa-bi-Ọlorun wọn, ti nwọn ti fi aiwa-bi-Ọlorun ṣe, ati niti gbogbo ọ̀rọ lile ti awọn ẹlẹṣẹ aiwa-bi-Ọlọrun ti sọ si i.
entries.en: To execute judgment upon all, and to convince all that are ungodly among them of all their ungodly deeds which they have ungodly committed, and of all their hard speeches which ungodly sinners have spoken against him.

entries.yo: Awọn wọnyi li awọn ti nkùn, awọn alaroye, ti nrìn nipa ifẹkufẹ ara wọn; ẹnu wọn a mã sọ ọ̀rọ ìhalẹ, nwọn a mã ṣojuṣãjú nitori ere.
entries.en: These are murmurers, complainers, walking after their own lusts; and their mouth speaketh great swelling words, having men's persons in admiration because of advantage.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹnyin olufẹ, ẹ ranti awọn ọ̀rọ ti a ti sọ ṣaju lati ọwọ́ awọn Aposteli Oluwa wa Jesu Kristi;
entries.en: But, beloved, remember ye the words which were spoken before of the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ;

entries.yo: Bi nwọn ti wi fun nyin pe, awọn ẹlẹgàn yio wà nigba ikẹhin, ti nwọn o mã rìn gẹgẹ bi ifẹkufẹ aiwa-bi-Ọlọrun ti ara wọn.
entries.en: How that they told you there should be mockers in the last time, who should walk after their own ungodly lusts.

entries.yo: Awọn wọnyi ni awọn ẹniti nya ara wọn si ọtọ, awọn ẹni ti ara, ti nwọn kò ni Ẹmí.
entries.en: These be they who separate themselves, sensual, having not the Spirit.

entries.yo: Ṣugbọn ẹnyin, olufẹ, ti ẹ ngbe ara nyin ró lori ìgbagbọ́ nyin ti o mọ́ julọ, ti ẹ ngbadura ninu Ẹmí Mimọ́,
entries.en: But ye, beloved, building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Ghost,

entries.yo: Ẹ mã pa ara nyin mọ́ ninu ifẹ Ọlọrun, ẹ mã reti ãnu Oluwa wa Jesu Kristi titi di iye ainipẹkun.
entries.en: Keep yourselves in the love of God, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ unto eternal life.

entries.yo: Ẹ mã ṣãnu awọn ẹlomiran, ẹ mã fi ìyatọ han:
entries.en: And of some have compassion, making a difference:

entries.yo: Ẹ mã fi ẹ̀ru gba awọn ẹlomiran là, ẹ mã fà wọn yọ kuro ninu iná; ẹ tilẹ mã korira ẹ̀wu tí ara ti sọ di ẽri.
entries.en: And others save with fear, pulling them out of the fire; hating even the garment spotted by the flesh.

entries.yo: Njẹ ti ẹniti o le pa nyin mọ́ kuro ninu ikọsẹ, ti o si le mu nyin wá siwaju ogo rẹ̀ lailabuku pẹlu ayọ nla,
entries.en: Now unto him that is able to keep you from falling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory with exceeding joy,

entries.yo: Ti Ọlọrun ọlọ́gbọn nikanṣoṣo, Olugbala wa, li ogo ati ọlá nla, ijọba ati agbara, nisisiyi ati titi lailai. Amin.
entries.en: To the only wise God our Saviour, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and ever. Amen.
